When Connor opened his eyes again, the class was already over.
“Connor, wake up. Let’s go to the bar outside the school. Cindy and the others are waiting for us there!”
Dominic patted Connor’s shoulder and whispered.
“Okay…”
Connor rubbed the sleep from his eyes and followed Dominic and Spencer out of the school.
“Connor, you’re the one who’s treating today. Don’t let your tongue slip today!
“I have already given you some money earlier. Later, just pretend to be generous in front of the girls. Just spend that money…”
Dominic reminded Connor in a low voice as he led Connor out of the school.
“Okay, I know what to do!”
Connor nodded and didn’t say anything else.
“Connor, as long as you act nice today, I think you will land Cindy’s roommate. After all, Cindy’s roommates are not students of Porthampton University. They don’t know much about your situation…” Spencer looked at Connor and continued.
“Spencer, what are you talking about?”
Dominic seemed upset by Spencer’s words.
“No… nothing…”
Spencer replied awkwardly.
“So what if they knew Connor’s situation? There is nothing wrong with Connor besides being a little poor, right?
“Moreover, a man’s youth is his capital. Even if he’s poor now, he can’t be poor forever!”
Dominic looked at Spencer and said.
“I was just saying. Why are you so agitated?”
Spencer did feel that he had gone overboard earlier, so he quickly defended himself.
“You’d better not say things like that again. Connor only has two friends. What will other people think of him if even you think of him that way?” Dominic said to Spencer seriously.
“Bro, it’s okay. Spencer was just messing with me. 1 didn’t take that to heart…”
Connor felt touched by his friends’ words.
He knew that Spencer did not mean any harm with what he said.
“Yeah, I was just joking. Connor, please don’t take it to heart!” Spencer said.
Dominic glanced at them and didn’t say anything. He then walked out of the school..

chapters.title: Chapter 57 - 57: Cindy’s Insult
chapters.content:
Chapter 57: Cindy’s Insult
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
A moment later, Connor and his friends arrived at the gate.
“Dominic, I’m here!”
A girl in a white T-shirt and jean shorts waved at Dominic as she called out with a smile.
Connor looked up at the girl. He knew that this girl was Cindy Stone, whom Dominic had chased this whole time. Connor was not very sure if the two were officially in a relationship.
Cindy wasn’t considered someone who would catch others’ attention at first sight. She was more like a girl-next-door type.
However, Cindy was very good at dressing up. Her clothes and accessories were branded, so she looked pretty youthful and beautiful.
Cindy and Dominic were high school classmates. Now, she was studying at Porthampton Academy of Art.
Before, when she had no classes, Cindy would go to Porthampton University to hang out with Dominic. Therefore, Connor had seen her a few times and considered her an acquaintance.
However, Connor did not have a good impression of her because he knew that Cindy only took the initiative to come to Porthampton University to hang out with Dominic at every end of the month when she did not have any money left to spend.
When her family gave her allowance at the beginning of the month, Cindy would seem as if she had disappeared without a trace.
To put it bluntly, in Connor’s point of view, Cindy merely treated Dominic as her ATM.
Connor and Spencer, however, knew exactly what was happening.
However, as Dominic was right in the thick of it, he had no idea what Cindy was doing.
Connor and Spencer were too shy to expose her, so they could only pretend not to notice.
“Hey, Cindy!”
Dominic saw Cindy standing at the gate, so he quickly walked up to her excitedly.
“Why are you late? I’ve been waiting for you for more than an hour…” Cindy pouted and said coquettishly.
“Class just ended. I rushed over here as soon as I could!”
Dominic was worried that Cindy would be upset, so he quickly explained.
“Okay, since you were in class, I would let it go this time!”
Cindy replied indifferently, then continued, “Let’s go. My roommates should have arrived by now. Don’t let them wait…”
“Okay!”
Dominic nodded and walked toward the bar near the university.
However, at this moment, Cindy suddenly turned to look at Connor and said in disgust, “Dominic Turner! Why is this delivery guy following us? Tell him to go away quickly. What if my roommates see him? I don’t want my roommates to know that 1 hang out with a loser of a delivery guy!”
Dominic was stunned. He seemed to feel awkward. No one had expected Cindy to be so direct. She literally had zero EQ.
Due to what she said, Dominic, Spencer, and Connor became extremely embarrassed.
“Cindy, what are you talking about? Please show some respect!”
Spencer shouted at Cindy unhappily.
“I wasn’t talking about you. Why are you so agitated?
“Moreover, I am going to Dusk with Dominic to have fun with my roommates. What has that got to do with the delivery boy? I don’t want to bring a delivery boy with me to Dusk. Is there a problem with that?”
Cindy rolled her eyes and replied disdainfully.
“You…”
Spencer was rendered speechless, not knowing how to counter that.
After hesitating, Spencer grabbed Connor and whispered, “Connor, let’s go. We don’t have to go!”
“Okay!”
Connor didn’t like the noise in the bar, and Cindy didn’t seem to welcome him anyway, so he did want to leave.
“Connor, Spencer, wait!”
Seeing that Connor was about to leave, Dominic quickly reached out to stop him. After all, he had asked Cindy to bring her roommates today because he wanted to match Connor with someone.
If Connor were to leave now, what was the point of going to the bar then?
“Bro, Cindy’s words were so offensive! Since she looks down on Connor, why are we still going to Dusk?”
Spencer shouted at Dominic, flustered.
Dominic seemed awkward after what Spencer said as he replied in a low voice, “Actually, Cindy didn’t mean that. She may have a sharp tongue, but she has a soft heart. Don’t take it to heart. Do this for me as a bro, okay?”
H H
Looking at Dominic’s earnestness, Spencer hesitated.
After all, it was Dominic who invited them today. Even if they didn’t want to go because of Cindy, they should do it for Dominic.
“Dominic, isn’t this loser a delivery boy? Why did you bring him? Isn’t it embarrassing enough?”
At this moment, Cindy rolled her eyes and sneered.
“Cindy, can you stop talking for a moment!”
Dominic shouted, somewhat a little embarrassed and annoyed. Then, he walked up to Cindy and dragged her aside. “Cindy, come with me for a moment. 1 have something to say to you…”
“What more is there to say? I definitely won’t let this delivery guy go to Dusk with us today. If my roommates find out, won’t I be a laughing stock then?”
Cindy said loudly and emotionally to Dominic.
“Today, Connor will treat us to drinks at the bar. If he doesn’t go, who will pay?” Dominic asked helplessly.
“He is treating us to drinks at the bar?”
A trace of surprise flashed in Cindy’s eyes as she asked with a puzzled expression, “How can a poor chap like him have the money to treat us to drinks at the bar? Besides, didn’t you say that you wanted to introduce my roommate to your friend? That friend isn’t Connor, right?”
“That’s right, it is Connor!”
Dominic nodded.
“Dominic, are you crazy? Connor is a broke chap, how could my roommate like him?
“You’d better ask him to leave immediately! Don’t embarrass yourself, okay?”
When Cindy found out that the so-called friend Dominic mentioned was Connor, she immediately became angry and started screeching.
She was very, and she didn’t care about Connor’s feelings at all.
When the students passing by heard Cindy, they all looked at her, Dominic, and the others curiously.
“Cindy, can you keep your voice down? Connor is my best friend. He just broke up with someone not long ago, so I only wanted to comfort him. What’s wrong with that?”
Dominic gritted his teeth and said to Cindy in a low voice.
“Dominic, why are you friends with a broke chap like Connor?”
Cindy asked in confusion.
“Cindy, aren’t you pushing it a little too much today?”
At this moment, Spencer finally couldn’t hold it in anymore and shouted at Cindy.
“How am I pushing it too much? I’m just telling the truth. Isn’t Connor just a broke boy who delivers food?
“Whatever it is, I don’t care. If Connor comes to Dusk with us today, I’m not going. I won’t introduce my roommate to someone like him!”
Cindy pouted and said arrogantly.
“Bro, why don’t you guys go? I don’t want to join anymore!”
Connor, who had been silent all this time, finally spoke.
After saying this, Connor walked away without looking back..

chapters.title: Chapter 58 - 58:I Have One Condition
chapters.content:
Chapter 58:I Have One Condition
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
“Connor, don’t leave!”
Seeing that Connor McDonald was about to leave, Dominic Turner quickly reached out to stop him.
Then, he turned to Cindy Stone and said, “Cindy, if you don’t want Connor to join us at the bar, you can go on your own!”
Cindy was stunned. She seemed to be in disbelief.
“Dominic Turner, what did you just say to me?”
Cindy asked Dominic with a slightly angry expression.
“1 said, if you don’t want Connor to join us at the bar, you can go on your own. Besides, Connor is treating us to drinks today. If Connor is not coming, then 1 won’t go either!” Dominic gritted his teeth and growled.
“Dominic Turner, are you out of your mind? You are picking a broke chap who delivers food over me?”
Cindy’s eyes widened in disbelief.
“Cindy, I’ve told you many times. Whether Connor is a poor man, he is my best friend. 1 indeed like you, but that doesn’t mean that you can humiliate my friend like this. If you think we don’t have the right to drink with you, you can leave!”
Dominic, silently tolerating Cindy before, finally exploded and growled at Cindy.
“Alright, Dominic Turner, you are asking me to leave? Fine, I’ll leave. Do you think I’m afraid of you?”
Cindy shouted in return and then turned around to leave.
After Connor saw that Cindy had really left, he felt a little apologetic. He took a step forward and said to Dominic softly, “Bro, you didn’t have to do that. I don’t really want to go to the bar. Moreover, even if 1 did go, the girl might not like me anyway. Why don’t you go and ask Cindy to come back?”
“She really went too far today. How dare she talk to you like this? 1 can’t keep giving leeway to her!”
Dominic said softly.
Connor stood where he was, not knowing what to do.
After all, no one had expected this whole thing to escalate to this point.
“Forget it. You two should go to the bar. Don’t let me ruin your fun!”
Connor had been worried about Mina being tricked into someone else’s bed.
Cindy’s departure gave him a reason not to go to the bar, so he turned to leave after saying that.
“Without Cindy, can’t the three of us go to the bar anyway? There are plenty of other pretty girls in the bar. I’ll be your wingman!”
Spencer quickly reached out to grab Connor.
Meanwhile, Cindy was about to leave Porthampton University when her phone suddenly rang.
Cindy hesitated before answering her phone, “Tiana, what’s up?”
“Cindy, where are you now? Natasha and I have already arrived at Dusk near Porthampton University. Didn’t you say that you wanted to introduce a handsome guy to us? Why aren’t you here yet?”
The girl on the other end of the phone asked with a charming smile.
“What handsome guy? He’s just a delivery boy. How could Natasha fall for someone like him…”
Cindy couldn’t help but mutter in a low voice.
“A delivery boy? What delivery boy?”
Cindy’s roommate, Tiana Johns, was puzzled.
“No… nothing… Today’s outing has been canceled. Let’s go back to the dormitory!”
Cindy was infuriated by Dominic. She simply didn’t want to go to the bar anymore.
“What? The outing has been canceled?”
When Tiana heard that, she immediately cried out in surprise, then she continued, “Cindy, are you kidding me? Natasha and I have ordered our drinks. Moreover, the drinks have been served. Who will pay the bill if the outing is canceled now?”
“Why did you order the drinks so soon?”
Cindy was stunned for a moment and asked angrily.
“Didn’t you ask us to order our drinks? You said that there will be a rich kid coming later. He’s your side boy. You told us to spend as much as we want, and the rich kid would come and pay for it…”
Tiana said helplessly.
“How much did you order?” Cindy asked
“Not much. This booth costs at least two thousand dollars. We only ordered two thousand dollars worth of drinks!” Tiana said slowly.
When Cindy heard that, she immediately frowned.
She initially thought that if Tiana hadn’t ordered too much, she would go over and foot the bill.
But she never thought that her roommate would be so generous and spend two thousand dollars in one go.
She didn’t even have five hundred dollars on her now. It wasn’t enough to pay the bill.
“Cindy, are you pulling our legs?” Tiana asked suspiciously when she didn’t get a response from Cindy.
“Why would I be pulling your legs? I’ll bring some people over later. Just you wait!”
Cindy whispered and hung up the phone.
After hanging up the phone, Cindy calmed herself down and turned to look at Dominic and his friends.
Although she felt conflicted, she still turned around and went back to Dominic and his friends.
At this moment, Tiana and Natasha were still at the bar. If she didn’t bring someone to save the day, how could she face them in the dormitory in the future.
Therefore, even though Cindy despised Connor, she could only helplessly accept bringing him to the bar.
“Cindy, why are you back?”
When Dominic saw that Cindy had returned, he smiled and asked, pleasantly surprised.
“Didn’t you want to bring this poor chap to the bar? Let’s go then!”
Cindy said to Dominic very reluctantly.
Dominic froze for a moment, then looked at Cindy in surprise and said, “Cindy, 1 knew you were kind-hearted!”
“If it weren’t for the fact that he is your friend, 1 wouldn’t have agreed to let him tag along with us to the bar. After all, he is just a delivery boy. How can he mingle with people like us?”
Cindy sized Connor up and said with disdain.
When Dominic was happy that Cindy had agreed to bring Connor along to the bar, so he said to Connor and Spencer happily, “That’s great! Spencer, Connor, let’s go to the bar!”
Although Dominic didn’t know Cindy’s true color, it didn’t mean that Spencer and Connor were blind to it.
They knew that Cindy definitely didn’t just have a change of heart. So, Spencer took a step forward and looked at Cindy, saying, “Why is Connor not allowed to go when you say so? Now you are allowing him to tag along, so he should go now? Who do you think you are?”
“Spencer, what are you talking about?”
Cindy stared at Spencer and shouted at him.
“i will go to the bar with Connor, but I have one condition!” Spencer said slowly.
“What is it?”
Cindy frowned and asked..

chapters.title: Chapter 59 - 59: Dusk
chapters.content:
Chapter 59: Dusk
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
“If you treat us today, the three of us will go. If you don’t treat us, we won’t go!”
Spencer knew why Cindy had suddenly changed her mind. To her, they were just rich kids who were her ATMs.
Therefore, he would use this opportunity to teach Cindy a lesson.
Cindy was instantly stunned. She seemed a little awkward.
“Spencer, aren’t you going a little overboard? How could you ask a girl like Cindy to treat us to drinks? Moreover, there’s no reason for us to let a girl treat us to drinks when we’re out having fun!”
Dominic felt that Cindy was already giving him a lot of leeway by agreeing to let Connor tag along.
But now Spencer was asking Cindy to treat them to drinks. This was really going a little overboard.
“Why can’t girls treat us? Didn’t you guys always say that men and women are equal? Now is our chance. We were the ones who treated when we went out the previous times. Cindy didn’t even spend a single cent. What’s wrong with asking her to treat us this time?”
Spencer replied impolitely.
Previously, because of Dominic, Spencer had treated Cindy to many meals.
After all, Spencer was from a pretty well-off family. Moreover, Dominic had always been pursuing Cindy. Spencer felt that it was only right to spend some money for his best friend.
However, Cindy had humiliated Connor in front of many people today. So, Spencer felt very uncomfortable.
Therefore, he naturally would not make it easy for her either.
“Spencer, why are you such a stingy man?”
Cindy shouted at Spencer unhappily.
“I’m not stingy, but I’m giving you an opportunity to feel gender equality. Since you want me to go, are you not going to show some sincerity?
“You said so many mean things to Connor before. It’s not a problem to treat us now, right? It’s okay if you don’t have the money to treat us. As long as you apologize to Connor, we’ll let this be water under the bridge!”
Spencer seemed to have made up his mind. He wanted to teach Cindy a lesson, so he spoke with a very firm tone.
“Spencer, you…”
Cindy glared at Spencer, feeling very helpless.
Cindy could not bring herself to apologize to a person like Connor. However, neither did she have the money to treat them either.
Therefore, Cindy had her backed up against a corner. She could only look at Dominic, hoping he would help.
“Didn’t we agree that 1 would treat today? Cindy probably didn’t mean the things she said earlier. I think we should just let it go this time!”
At this moment, Conner suddenly said.
Cindy quickly looked at Connor, surprised.
She did not expect Connor to speak up for her this time.
In fact, Connor only didn’t want to continue wasting time. He wanted to finish drinking with Dominic and the others as soon as possible and then go home to check on Mina.
Now, Spencer was too embarrassed to continue making things difficult for Cindy. So, he walked toward Dusk.
However, Dominic looked at Connor with gratitude. Connor didn’t lower himself to Cindy’s level. He was doing Dominic a favor.
After all, if this continued, Dominic would be in a very difficult position.
A few minutes later, everyone arrived at the bar, Dusk that was near Porthampton University.
Dusk was the most prominent bar near Porthampton University. Since it had just opened, the interior design was very new, so students liked to come here to hang out.
However, when Connor and the others entered the bar, Cindy suddenly stopped in her tracks.
While Spencer and Dominic were not paying attention, she turned her head and said to Connor, “Cnnor, when you see my roommates later, don’t tell them that you’re a delivery boy. I don’t want my roommates to know that 1 know someone like you, understand?”
Cindy seemed to have forgotten who had helped her out as she spoke to Connor rudely.
“Understood!”
Connor didn’t want to waste more time with Cindy, so he replied nonchalantly.
“By the way, you’d better not have any thoughts about my roommate. My roommate will never fall for a poor chap like you. You’d better know your place!” Cindy continued.
Connor couldn’t help but be stunned for a moment.
Then, he stopped walking and said expressionlessly, “Cindy Stone, if it weren’t for Dominic, I wouldn’t have come here with you. Moreover, 1 already have a fiancee, and I’m not interested in your roommate, so you don’t have to worry!” “You have a fiancee? What are you bragging about? Who would take a fancy to a loser like you?”
Cindy rolled her eyes at him and said disdainfully.
Connor ignored Cindy and walked straight into the bar.
As Dominic and Spencer had already entered the bar ahead of them, they didn’t hear the conversation between Connor and Cindy.
In the bar, under the dim lights.
Men and women dressed in bright and beautiful clothes, accompanied by loud and ear-splitting music, were twisting their bodies on the dance floor, the hormones of youth floating in the air.
It was seven o’clock in the evening. Although it was still early, this time was just the start of their exciting night for people who liked nightlife.
There were a lot of people at the bar today. Most of them were students of Porthampton University.
It was Connor’s first time here, so he was shocked by the scene inside as soon as he entered.
When Cindy saw Connor acting like a country bumpkin, she couldn’t help but smirk disdainfully.
However, because Dominic and Spencer were still standing next to Connor, she didn’t try to make any remarks.
“Cindy, over here!”
At this moment, a coy girl wearing heavy makeup waved at Cindy and the others.
She was wearing a tight black T-shirt that perfectly accentuated her body. Her legs were slender and fair, and her golden wavy hair was casually draped over her shoulders, giving her an extremely youthful aura.
Although the girl’s attire was very sexy and charming, her appearance was only average. She was not even as pretty as Cindy.
However, even so, her figure was very hot. Her legs were slender, and her chest was ample. It was not that of what a normal female university student should have.
“Tiana, I’m coming!”
Cindy turned her head and replied. Then, she said to Dominic and the others, “That is my roommate, Tiana Johns. Let’s go over!”
“Okay!”
Dominic hurriedly nodded.
Cindy then turned her head and glanced at Connor. She said in a low voice, “Connor, don’t spew nonsense when you meet my roommate later. Don’t expose the fact that you’re poor…”
“Cindy, can you stop?”
Dominic couldn’t help but frown and scold her.
“I didn’t mean anything by it. Didn’t you want me to find Connor a girlfriend?
“If my roommate knew that he was a loser who delivers food, she probably wouldn’t even want to talk to him. I’m just giving him a friendly reminder for his own good!”
Cindy explained disdainfully and then walked to the booth..

chapters.title: Chapter 60 - 60: The Inevitable Clash
chapters.content:
Chapter 60: The Inevitable Clash
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
A moment later, everyone arrived at the table that Tiana had reserved beforehand.
The few of them introduced each other before sitting down.
Although Tiana looked average, she did not lack male friends because she was usually dressed sexily.
She knew that Dominic had always been after Cindy, and although Dominic’s family was quite wealthy, his looks were too average.
Connor was quite good-looking, but Tiana naturally didn’t have much interest in Connor because of his shabby outfit.
Initially, Tiana thought that Cindy would bring a few decent rich kids over this time.
However, she didn’t expect Cindy to bring people like Connor and Spencer. Tiana immediately lost interest and sat alone on the sofa, playing with her phone.
“Tiana, where did Natasha go? Didn’t she come with you?”
At this moment, Cindy suddenly asked Tiana softly.
“Natasha went to the restroom!”
Tiana replied absent-mindedly as she continued paying attention to her phone and flirting with some handsome guys nearby on Bumble.
Since the two men that Cindy brought were not up to Tiana’s expectations, she would not waste her time with them.
Therefore, she was ready to hook up with the handsome men nearby whom she found on Bumble. Who knows, she might even hook up with a rich man.
“Oh, then let’s wait. I reckon that Natasha will be back soon!”
Cindy said indifferently.
However, just as she finished speaking, she saw a tall and beautiful woman in high heels walking toward them.
“Natasha, over here!”
After seeing the beautiful woman, Cindy hurriedly called out to her.
Then, she stood up and greeted her, leading the beautiful woman back to their table.
“Let me introduce everyone. This is one of the top ten campus belles of Porthampton Academy of Art, Natasha Scott!”
Cindy dragged the beautiful woman to her side and introduced her arrogantly.
When Connor heard that, he couldn’t help but raise his head to look at the woman next to Cindy.
It had to be said that the campus belle of Porthampton Academy of Art was indeed much more beautiful than Cindy and Tiana.
Moreover, Natasha also seemed noble and cold at the same time. Be it her figure or her appearance, she was pretty high-class.
Natasha wore a cross-shoulder dress. Her jet-black hair flowed naturally over her bare shoulder. She was tall and had a calm temperament. There was no makeup on her face, but she had a different kind of charm.
Under the dim light, she seemed covered in a pleasant, dreamlike glow.
“Natasha, these three are my friends, Dominic, Spencer, and Connor!”
Cindy turned around and introduced her to Connor and his friends.
“Hello!”
Natasha greeted them softly.
“Hello, beautiful!”
Dominic grinned at Natasha and continued, “Since everyone is here, let’s get going. Order whatever you want. Connor is treating us today anyway…”
When Tiana heard that, she could not help but turn to look at Connor. Her eyes were filled with surprise.
That was because Connor was just an ordinary student. His outfit was, in her eyes, very shabby.
However, she never expected that Connor would be the one treating them this time.
Therefore, Tiana’s opinion of Connor had changed a little. Perhaps Connor was the kind of rich kid that liked to pretend to be poor!
Tiana hesitated and was about to find an opportunity to sit next to Connor and flirt with him.
However, Tiana didn’t expect that before she could make a move, Dominic pulled Natasha to Connor’s side and said with a smile, “Natasha, you can sit here!”
Natasha couldn’t help but feel stunned for a moment before sitting down next to Connor anyway.
Although Connor looked a bit of a loser, he was still quite handsome.
Moreover, he was the one who would be treating them today. This meant that he had some money, so Natasha naturally did not reject him.
Tiana immediately frowned and felt a little unhappy.
However, she was too embarrassed to say anything and could only stay put and fume.
Cindy did not expose Connor because she understood Natasha enough to know that she would avoid Connor once she knew that he was a pauper.
Therefore, Cindy tacitly agreed to Dominic’s plan to set Connor up with Natasha.
After everyone sat down, they began to drink and chat.
Natasha might look a little cold on the surface, but she was not introverted.
She took the initiative to chat with Connor.
After all, today was the first time they met. She definitely wouldn’t develop any feelings for Connor.
However, Natasha’s impression of Connor was still pretty good. It shouldn’t be a problem for them to be friends.
When Connor saw that the girl was so enthusiastic about getting to know him, he naturally felt embarrassed to continue being cold, so he responded enthusiastically.
Just as Connor and Natasha were chatting enthusiastically, a group of people walked into Dusk.
This group of people was none other than Brandon Guthrie, who had been humiliated by Connor many times.
Behind Brandon Mandy Hines, May Young, Lily Sullivan, and a few other students from the same class.
In the bar.
Brandon and his companions walked into the bar. Then, they found a table that started at three thousand dollars and sat down.
“Mr. Guthrie, why does that guy look so familiar?”
At this moment, Charlie Bones, next to Brandon, noticed Connor.
“Isn’t that Connor? Why is he here?”
Lily Sullivan also saw Connor chatting with Natasha, not far away. She was confused.
“Hehe, I didn’t expect this loser to have the money to come here. Moreover, he is sitting at a table that costs the same as ours. What’s up with Connor recently? Why does he seem like a different person all of a sudden…” Charlie curled his lips and said in a low voice.
After hearing what Charlie said, Brandon’s expression instantly darkened. He felt as if he was sitting on pins.
After all, he had brought them to Dusk and sat at a table that started at three thousand dollars. Brandon had already felt that he had spent enough. However, he did not expect Connor to afford the same table as his.
Mandy narrowed her eyes and looked at Natasha, chatting happily with Connor not far away.
Be it her figure, appearance, or clothes, Natasha was better than Mandy. This made Mandy feel very uncomfortable.
She had only just broken up with Connor recently, but Connor was already out and about. He even found a girl who was more beautiful than her. This ultimately ignited Mandy’s jealousy.
“Connor must be on a date with that girl!”
May suddenly commented.
“May Young, what kind of joke are you making?
“Connor is a stinking loser who delivers food. Everyone at Porthampton University knows that! Other than Mandy, who else would be willing to date someone like him?”
Lily replied sarcastically as if she had long forgotten that Connor had once saved her from Todd Knowles.
May looked at Connor and hesitated without saying anything.
After all, May had never told anyone about the incident at Seven Days Hotel.
After experiencing that, May believed that Connor was not as simple as the stinking loser they claimed him to be..

chapters.title: Chapter 61 - 61: Mandy The Party Pooper
chapters.content:
Chapter 61: Mandy The Party Pooper
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
“Girls from Porthampton University won’t date Connor, but it doesn’t mean that girls from other schools won’t date him!”
Brandon Guthrie suddenly said coldly.
Everyone was stunned. Then, they realized what was going on.
“Connor must have hooked up with girls from other schools. He’s here pretending to be a rich kid to pick up girls!” Charlie quickly said.
“Hehe…”
Brandon couldn’t help but sneer. He had been thinking of ways to take revenge on Connor for the past few days, but he had never found an opportunity.
Now that the opportunity had finally come, how could he let Connor go?
“Mr. Guthrie, do you want me to expose Connor now?” Charlie asked Brandon excitedly.
“Don’t worry, let’s wait a little longer. I want to wait until he’s about to succeed and expose him. Only then will it be interesting!”
Brandon smiled sinisterly.
Everyone understood what Brandon meant.
On the other side, at one of the tables.
After a short exchange with Connor, Natasha realized that Connor actually had a pretty good personality, and he didn’t look too bad either.
Most importantly, Natasha felt that Connor did not have ulterior motives like the other guys. Most of the guys were always thinking about getting her into bed or having some fun with her. However, Connor did not seem to have any intention in this regard.
This also made Natasha feel that Connor was a very decent gentleman, so her impression improved.
Although Natasha would not fall in love with Connor simply because of this, at the very least, she was not averse to chatting with Connor.
When they chatted, a faint smile played on Natasha’s lips.
Connor had a good impression of her, too. However, he wasn’t sure if Natasha would still talk to him like this after she found out that he was a pauper.
Dominic saw that Connor and Natasha were getting along quite well, so he was very happy for them.
However, Cindy simply couldn’t bring herself to be happy for them.
She did not expect Natasha to get along so well with Connor. Even after chatting for so long, she still didn’t show any disgust toward him.
Cindy was a little hesitant. When they returned to the dormitory, should she tell Natasha about Connor?
Although Cindy didn’t want her roommate to know that she had a loser friend like Connor, she couldn’t bear seeing her best friend being deceived by a loser like Connor.
“Natasha, you haven’t had a boyfriend before, right?”
Dominic suddenly asked Natasha with a smile.
Natasha was stunned for a moment.
Then, she replied softly, “Yeap, I haven’t met someone to my liking, so I have been single my whole life so far…”
“You’re so beautiful; there must be a lot of guys pursuing you, right?”
Dominic grinned, then he looked at Natasha and continued, “Well, Connor is my best friend. I know him very well. He is recently single. Why don’t you two give each other a chance?”
“Dominic, what nonsense are you talking about? Natasha and Connor have only known each other for less than two hours. Why are you asking them to give each other a chance?”
Cindy remarked angrily.
Meanwhile, Dominic turned to look at Cindy. A hint of helplessness flashed across his face because he didn’t expect her to ruin the moment.
“I think the same that Connor and I have only just met. We can start as friends…”
Natasha hesitated for a moment and said softly.
“That’s true. You two have only just met today. It’s better to start as friends!”
Dominic grinned and then reached out to nudge Connor. He said in a low voice, “Connor, what are you waiting for? Quickly add Natasha on Facebook. You guys can chat when you are free…”
Natasha didn’t seem to mind. So, she elegantly took out her phone from her Gucci handbag and tapped on the Facebook app.
Connor couldn’t help but hesitate when he saw what Natasha was doing. He then took out his phone.
Connor had a good impression of this woman, Natasha Scott. After all, she was better than Mandy Hines in many aspects.
Although she couldn’t be compared to a woman like Freya Phillips, Freya didn’t seem interested in Connor. There was no need for Connor to suffer. So, he took out his phone to add Natasha on Facebook.
He planned to tell Natasha that he was penniless to test her reaction after adding her on Facebook.
If she was still willing to date him, he didn’t mind getting along with her.
But if she turned hostile and refused to acknowledge him, he wouldn’t waste his time on such a woman.
“Ah, who did I think it was? Isn’t this the King of Delivery of our university, Connor McDonald?”
Just as Connor was about to add Natasha on Facebook, a girl suddenly walked up to Connor and called out strangely.
Hearing this mocking voice, Connor was stunned, then turned to look behind him.
He realized that it was none other than his ex-girlfriend, Mandy Hines. Behind Mandy were Brandon, May, Lily, and others.
“Mandy, what are you doing here?”
When Dominic saw Mandy, he immediately knew that something was up. He quickly stepped in and spoke loudly.
“Dominic, what do you mean? You don’t own Duck. If you can come and hang out here, can’t we come to hang out, too?”
Mandy sneered and replied disdainfully.
“My family may not own Dusk, but this is our table. You are not welcome here. Please leave!”
Dominic knew that Mandy wanted to stir up trouble, so he wanted to get rid of her as soon as possible.
“Dominic, we’re all classmates. You don’t have to be so calculative!”
Brandon stood up and said with a smile.
“That’s right. You’re in such a hurry to chase us away. Are you feeling guilty?”
Lily also stood up and shouted.
Natasha, Cindy, and Tiana seemed puzzled when Mandy and the others suddenly appeared.
They didn’t know how this group of people was related to Connor..

chapters.title: Chapter 62 - 62: They Are Right
chapters.content:
Chapter 62: They Are Right
Translator: End Less Fantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
“Guilty? Why should 1 feel guilty?”
Dominic Turner was stunned. Then, he frowned and retorted softly.
“Yeah, why should we feel guilty?”
Spencer echoed.
At this moment, Connor was the only one who stood rooted to the ground. He looked at Mandy Hines, May Young, and the others.
From the moment Mandy appeared, Connor had already guessed what she and the others wanted to do.
“Why should you all feel guilty? Don’t you know what you’re doing? Aren’t you all afraid that I’ll expose Connor and make you all feel embarrassed?”
Mandy looked at Dominic and sneered in disdain.
Then, she walked up to Natasha and carefully looked at her. She smiled and asked, “You aren’t a student of Porthampton University, right?”
“No…”
Natasha shook her head. She didn’t know what Mandy was trying to do.
“Hehe, that’s why!”
Mandy sneered and said, “Let me introduce myself. My name is Mandy Hines. I’m Connor’s ex-girlfriend…”
Natasha subconsciously turned to look at Connor.
Although Dominic had said that Connor was recently single, she never thought she would meet his ex-girlfriend here. So, she was a little surprised.
“What do you want?”
Natasha looked at Mandy and asked.
“I don’t want anything. 1 only want to tell you something about Connor. I’m worried that a great girl like you would be deceived by a subpar guy like Connor!” Mandy said sneakily.
“Mandy Hines, what nonsense are you talking about? We don’t welcome you here. Please leave now!”
Dominic became increasingly agitated. He spoke at the top of his lungs.
“Don’t welcome me? Why not? I’m not done speaking!”
Mandy sneered. Then, she glanced at Connor and said softly, “You aren’t students of Porthampton University. You might not know Connor, but 1 know him very well.
“Connor is famous for being poor at Porthampton University, and he is especially poor. Look at his torn shoes. He has been wearing them for almost three years and has never changed them. Moreover, Connor is the infamous King of Delivery. He has been earning a living as a delivery boy. I chose to break up with Connor because he is too poor. That’s why we broke up!”
When Natasha heard Mandy’s claims, she stood rooted in disbelief.
Although Connor was indeed dressed a little poorly to Natasha, she had never expected that he was actually poor and made a living by delivering food. If he really made a living by delivering food, how could he possibly have the money to treat everyone to a drink at Dusk?
At this moment, Tiana’s eyes were widened in shock.
She had not expected Connor actually to be so poor. She was secretly glad that she did not take the initiative to seduce him. Otherwise, it was very likely that he would have deceived her.
“If you don’t believe me, suit yourself. You can ask anyone at Porthampton University. They should know Connor!”
Mandy continued after seeing that Natasha hadn’t said anything.
“I can be witness that Connor is a poor loser who delivers food!”
“Yes, I can be a witness too!”
At this moment, most of the students in the bar were from Porthampton University.
When they heard what Mandy said, they stood up to second Mandy’s claims.
After all, Connor was known as the Delivery Boy at Porthampton University. Many students knew him.
Dominic and Spencer were speechless. They didn’t know how to refute Mandy. After all, everything she said was the truth.
It was true that Connor was poor, and it was also true that he delivered food, too.
“I’m guessing you probably don’t know about this. Connor didn’t tell you about it either, right? And he even pretended to be a rich kid and wanted to hit on you, right?” Mandy looked at Natasha and continued.
“He didn’t pretend to be a rich kid. He only wanted to treat me to a drink!”
Natasha bit her lip and replied in a low voice.
“That’s right, Connor should still have the money to treat you to a drink, but this is from his lottery scratchcard a few days ago, so he now has the money to treat you to a drink!” Mandy said with a sneer.
“Yes, after Connor won the lottery scratchcard, he even treated our classmates to a meal at Brasserie Le Bernardin. He wanted to pretend to be a rich kid, but Connor is a fool to us. It was only by luck that he won the lottery, and he used it to treat everyone to a meal. He doesn’t even know how to improve his lifestyle; it’s a joke!” Lily commented loudly.
At this moment, May, standing at the side, hesitated before standing up and shouting, “That’s right. Connor won the lottery scratchcard. He even offered me fifty thousand dollars to sleep with him. However, I rejected him. He didn’t even look at himself in the mirror before asking me to sleep with him. He’s a toad who wants to kiss the princess!”
Connor did not react to whatever they said. However, when he heard what May claimed, he couldn’t help but look up at her.
But he didn’t refute anything. Instead, he sat there with a cold expression.
It was as if he had tacitly agreed to the things that Mandy, Lily, and May had claimed.
Natasha seemed angry now. She had always been proud and arrogant, and she had never accepted any male pursuits.
Today, she had finally developed some interest in Connor but was deceived.
If this were to get to the art academy, she would very likely become the school’s laughing stock.
After a moment of hesitation, she turned to look at Connor. Then, she stared at him as she asked, “Connor, are they telling the truth?”
Connor sat without saying anything. Neither did he refute anything.
“I’m asking you a question. Are the things they said true?”
Natasha looked at Connor and continued to shout.
“Connor, say something!” Dominic prompted anxiously.
Connor took a deep breath and said expressionlessly, “Yes, it’s true!”
After Connor admitted to those claims, Natasha was stunned. She became distraught.
Cindy’s expression had also turned very ugly because she was the one who allowed Connor to tag along. Now that Connor had admitted that he was a delivery man, it showed that her friend was a poor loser.
This was simply a huge blow to Cindy, who had always been vain.
“Alright, since you already know the truth, I won’t say anything more. You guys can decide the rest for yourselves!”
Mandy looked at Connor and smiled disdainfully. She didn’t say anything more and just turned around to leave. All she needed to do now was to wait for the drama..

chapters.title: Chapter 63 - 63: Freya Phillips’ Phone Call
chapters.content:
Chapter 63: Freya Phillips’ Phone Call
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Natasha glared at Connor angrily.
After hesitating, Natasha bit her lip and asked softly, “Connor, why did you do this? Since you don’t have money, why did you pretend to be a rich kid? Can’t you just go back and deliver food?”
After hearing that, Connor couldn’t help but look up at Natasha and didn’t say anything.
Initially, Connor planned to tell Natasha the truth after he added her on Facebook just to see how she would react.
But now, it seemed that there was no need for that because Mandy had already probed her on Connor’s behalf.
“What rotten luck!”
Natasha cursed emotionally, then picked up her bag and turned to leave.
“Natasha, don’t go. It’s not what you think…”
When Natasha was about to leave, Cindy quickly reached out to stop her.
“Cindy, we’ve been roommates for so many years. You should know me well. It’s fine to introduce me to a delivery man, but you have actually teamed up with him to lie to me. 1 didn’t expect you to be this kind of person!”
Natasha cursed coldly and then walked out of the bar.
“Cindy, you have indeed gone a little overboard with this. Even if you introduce an ordinary person to Natasha, she wouldn’t be so angry. But you have actually introduced a person like Connor to her. It’s really…”
Tiana added before catching up with Natasha and leaving the bar together.
Mandy Hines and the others saw Natasha and Tiana leaving the bar not far away. They smiled smugly and began to drink and celebrate.
Connor looked at Mandy’s smug expression and felt amused.
He could not understand why. He had already broken up with her. Moreover, when they were still together, he had treated her very well. However, why was she making things difficult for him now?
“Dominic, I told you earlier not to bring this person to the bar. Natasha would never be friends with a delivery boy. You didn’t listen to me. Now that things have turned out this way, are you happy now?”
Cindy was filled with burning anger right now. She had nowhere to vent it, so she could only shout at Dominic.
Dominic seemed helpless. How could he have predicted things to turn out like this?
“And you, Connor, you’re a lame delivery boy. Why are you pretending to be a rich kid to pick up girls? I don’t know what’s going on in your head!” Cindy said as she turned to Connor.
“Weren’t you the one who begged me to join you all? I didn’t say 1 want to join!”
Connor replied expressionlessly.
“You…”
Upon hearing what Connor said, Cindy was speechless. After all, she was the one who asked Connor to come.
“You stinking loser. You’ll be single for the rest of your life. How disgusting!”
After saying that, Cindy turned around and left, too.
After the few girls left, only Connor, Dominic, and Spencer were left at the table.
Seeing this, Spencer hurried to Connor comforted him, “Connor, don’t be sad. It’s just one woman. If this doesn’t work, let’s look for another. 1’11 introduce you to someone more beautiful than Natasha in a few days…”
“Yes, yes, Connor. I’m sorry. I didn’t expect things to turn out like this today. If I knew, I wouldn’t have asked Cindy and the others to come here…” Dominic Turner said guiltily.
“It’s all Mandy, May, and the others’ fault. We’re all classmates. Is there a need to ruin everything like this? Even a stranger is kinder!” Spencer looked at Mandy and the others and said emotionally.
“Dominic, you don’t have to introduce me to a girlfriend. I already have a fiancee!”
Connor suddenly said.
“What? Connor, you have a fiancee?”
When Dominic heard that, he exclaimed in disbelief.
“Yes!”
Connor nodded slightly.
“Really? What’s your fiancee’s name? Is she from Porthampton University?” Spencer asked curiously.
“My fiancee’s name is Freya Phillips!”
Connor didn’t want Dominic and Spencer to worry about his relationship status, so he told them about his engagement with Freya.
“Freya… Freya Phillips?” Spencer asked
Spencer seemed very shocked when he heard the name.
Dominic reacted the same too.
“You know Freya Phillips?”
Connor couldn’t help but ask Dominic and Spencer after seeing their reaction.
“As far as I know, there is indeed a woman named Freya Phillips in Porthampton. However, she is Phillips Corporation’s chairman’s daughter. I don’t know if you are talking about the same ‘Freya Phillips’ that I know!” Dominic said slowly and hesitantly.
“Bro, what nonsense are you talking about? If Connor’s fiancee is the daughter of the chairman of Phillips Corporation, then how could he be drinking with us here? His fiancee might have the same name as Freya Phillips!” Spencer said quickly.
“That’s right. Maybe it’s just a coincidence!”
Dominic smiled faintly and didn’t say anything else.
As the daughter of the chairman of Phillips Corporation, Freya was exceptionally beautiful. She had a sexy figure, too. In addition to her wealthy family background, she had at least hundreds of suitors.
How could such a fairy like her be Connor’s fiancee?
So Dominic simply accepted that it was someone else with the same name.
“Connor, you’re something! You have a fiancee and didn’t even say a word. Why didn’t you tell us?”
Dominic patted Connor’s shoulder and said with a smile.
“Yeah, if you had told us earlier that you have a fiancee, we wouldn’t have introduced you to someone!” Spencer added.
“I only found out about it a few days ago!”
Connor replied helplessly.
“Oh, 1 see! Oh, right, invite your fiancee to hang out with us when you have the chance!” Dominic said with a smile.
“Okay!”
Connor nodded and didn’t say anything.
Mandy and the others heard the conversation between Connor and Dominic.
When Mandy and her friends found out that Connor had a fiancee, they looked disdainful.
“A loser like Connor found himself a fiancee? Which Idiot wants to marry him?” May couldn’t help but mutter.
“Hehe, how can you believe what he said? He must be suffering because of his pride. To show off, he is lying about this. How shameless!” Lily pouted and said.
“That’s right. Connor must be bragging!” Mandy nodded and said.
“Mandy, after you broke up with Connor, he seemed to be acting crazy all the time. Moreover, he is starting to brag more. 1 think he is still not over you!” May said to Mandy softly.
“So what? I was blind to have been with a loser like him. Now, there is just no chance. Brandon is so much better. He’s rich and considerate…”
Mandy said as she nestled in Brandon’s arms, deliberately showing off.
Connor, Dominic, and Spencer chatted for a while. When they saw that it was late, they got ready to leave the bar and go home.
However, just as Connor was about to get up, his phone suddenly rang.
Connor was stunned for a moment. He quickly took out his phone and glanced at it. There was a woman’s name on the screen.
It was none other than Connor’s fiancee, Freya Phillips!

chapters.title: Chapter 64 - 64: Pick Up The Money
chapters.content:
Chapter 64: Pick Up The Money
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Ever since the last time they parted at New Century Restaurant, Connor had not contacted Freya Phillips.
Although the two of them had exchanged phone numbers, Freya had never taken the initiative to call Connor.
At this moment, Connor looked at the name ‘Freya Phillips’ on the phone screen, puzzled.
He couldn’t understand why Freya would call him so late at night.
Dominic saw ‘Freya Phillips’ on Connor’s phone screen, too. He couldn’t help but laugh and say, “Connor, your fiancee is calling you. Why aren’t you answering?”
“Yeah, answering it!”
Spencer chipped in.
Connor hesitated, then answered the call, “Hello?”
“Where are you now?”
Freya asked coldly from the other end of the phone.
“I’m at the Dusk. What’s up?” Connor was stunned before replying softly.
“Then wait for me there. 1’11 go to you now…”
Freya replied indifferently. Then, she hung up without waiting for Connor to respond.
Connor seemed a little helpless, having been hung up on. He didn’t know what Freya was up to.
“Connor, what did your fiancee say to you?”
Dominic asked curiously.
“Nothing. Let’s go!”
Connor said indifferently and turned around to leave.
He didn’t want to expose his true identity. If he told Dominic and Spencer that Freya would come to him in a while, then the two would want to stay to see his fiancee.
If Dominic and Spencer knew that it was the one and only Freya Phillips, then it would be difficult for Connor to still keep his secret.
Therefore, he planned to leave this place for now and then come back secretly.
When Dominic and Spencer noticed that something didn’t seem right, they didn’t ask any further questions. They followed Connor out of the bar.
A few minutes later, Connor and the other two went their separate ways at the university’s gate. Then, he returned to the bar entrance alone and waited quietly for Freya to arrive.
Ten minutes later, a taxi stopped at the entrance of Dusk.
However, the person who got out of the taxi was not Freya but Maya Phillips, with whom Connor had an encounter before.
Today, Maya was wearing a short dress. Her sexy figure was even more attractive in contrast to the dress. She was irresistible from head to toe.
Her beautiful face wore light makeup. Her eyes were charming, and her sexy lips had a slick of pink lipstick. The short dress wrapped snugly over her sexy buttocks.
Her slender and fair legs were pleasantly exposed.
Maya got out of the taxi and briefly glanced at the entrance of Dusk.
When Maya saw Connor, her eyes were filled with disgust. She walked up to him as her heels clicked against the ground.
“Didn’t your sister want to see me? Why are you here?”
Connor asked Maya gently.
“Do you think I want to meet a lame delivery boy like you?”
Maya replied rudely and continued, “My sister is tied up with something at the company, so she can’t come here in person. She has asked me to give you your allowance!”
“Allowance?”
Connor was surprised.
“Didn’t you tell my sister to give you twenty thousand dollars a month? There are 120 000 dollars here! It’s your allowance for half a year…”
Maya handed a black bag to Connor as she spoke.
Connor only realized what was going on when he saw the money in the bag. When he had negotiated with Freya at New Century Restaurant, he had indeed asked her for twenty thousand dollars a month.
Connor reached out to take the bag, but Maya had deliberately let go of the bag a second earlier.
Thud.
The bag fell to the ground.
Connor couldn’t help but feel stunned when he saw the bag drop. However, he didn’t say anything. Instead, he slowly bent down to pick up the bag.
Maya looked even more disdainful when she saw Connor grovel. She couldn’t help but mock, “Connor McDonald, are you even a real man? You’re a man, yet you are asking for money from my sister. You’re a loser. Don’t you have any dignity as a human being?”
“Your sister is my fiancee. We’re going to get married soon. It’s only right for me to spend her money. What does it have to do with you?”
Connor replied indifferently. Then, he unzipped the bag in front of her and started counting seriously.
“You…”
When Maya heard that, she seemed even more upset.
“Humph! No wonder the students of your school ridiculed you. People like you are a loser. How can you keep your chin up when living off a woman? 1 really admire you. How can a man like you exist?”
Maya said mercilessly, her tone extremely harsh and unkind, venting her dissatisfaction toward Connor.
“A man like me?”
A strange look flashed through his eyes.
“That’s right, a man like you. You’re disgusting!” Maya said quickly.
“Hehe…”
Connor looked at Maya and sneered. Then, without thinking, he tore the black bag and threw it into the air.
Crash!
Countless banknotes fluttered in the wind. It looked extremely spectacular.
“Connor McDonald, what are you doing? Are you crazy?”
Maya shouted at Connor in horror.
“Pick up the money and give it to me!” Connor said to Maya expressionlessly.
“You threw the money yourself. Why should 1 help you pick them up? Do you want it or not?”
Maya obviously wouldn’t do what Connor told her to do.
“You’re not picking them up, right?”
Connor smiled faintly and then continued, “Then, go back and tell Freya that I haven’t received my allowance for this month. If 1 don’t see twenty thousand dollars within three days, my agreement with her will not be effective. She must become my legal wife!”
“Connor McDonald, you…”
As Maya was about to say something, Connor turned around and walked away.
Maya hesitated. She knew that her mission today was to deliver money to Connor. If he didn’t receive the money, she would have to reimburse this 120 000 dollars from her pocket.
Maya’s family was wealthy, and she was a fair, rich, and beautiful woman.
However, she was only a student now. 120 000 dollars was still a considerable amount of money for her.
“Connor McDonald, you bastard!”
Maya cursed and quickly bent down to pick up the banknotes from the ground.
However, the people in the bar seemed to have noticed the banknotes. So, they rushed out of the bar and started to grab them.
“Don’t take them! This is my money! You bandits, stop!”
Maya shouted angrily at the people who had rushed out to grab the banknotes.
However, the people were greedy for money. They didn’t care about Maya and started to fight for the money.
Even Mandy, May, Lily and others joined the crowd to grab the money.
Maya, who was arrogant before, tried to pick up the banknotes from the ground like a crazy person. She looked extremely pathetic.
Connor, who was not far away, could not help but grin as he watched the chaos from a distance away. He waved to hail a taxi and was ready to go home..

chapters.title: Chapter 65 - 65: Connor and Hector
chapters.content:
Chapter 65: Connor and Hector
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Nine o’clock at night.
Connor returned to his rented apartment. He wasn’t sure if it was what happened with Natasha or what Maya said to him today that affected his good mood.
As he walked into the hallway absent-mindedly and was about to return to his room, he suddenly realized that Mina’s door was open.
Mina was sitting on the bed, chatting with a handsome boy. She looked delighted.
When Connor saw that Mina had a man in her room, he was stunned.
He knew very well that Mina had gone on a date with the hacker today.
Now, there was a stranger in her room, which meant that this man was probably the one who hacked his account.
The man in Mina’s room was in his early twenties. He looked average, but he must come from a pretty well-off family, judging from the way he dressed.
He wore a Versace shirt, Armani pants, and a Rolex watch. He looked like a playboy.
At this moment, Connor was still wearing his old clothes from before. As he had had them for too long, his clothes were yellowing, making him look shabby.
Compared to the man in Mina’s room, Connor was like a farmer’s child. Even a fool could see who was the real CeeM on Twitch.
Connor hesitated. He wanted to take out his phone and take a picture of the man’s face. Then, he would ask Kyle Hayes to investigate the hacker’s identity and get his account back.
However, just as Connor was about to take out his phone to take a picture, Mina in the room suddenly turned her head to look into the hallway.
To not let Mina find out what he was about to do, Connor had to put his phone back.
“Connor, when did you come back?”
When Mina saw him, she asked in confusion.
“I just got back…”
Connor glanced at Mina and said indifferently.
When the man in the room saw Connor, he was stunned for a moment. Then, he stood up and asked Mina with a smile, “Mina, is this your friend?”
“Yes, he is Connor, the one I told you about. He is my good friend and housemate!”
Mina replied with a smile and then walked up to Connor, whispering to him, “Connor, this is the CeeM whom I told you about before. We are just done with dinner. He was the one who sent me back…”
H H
Connor’s face darkened.
At this moment, he was 100% sure that the man standing next to Mina was the one who had hacked his account.
The man did not seem to know that Connor was the real CeeM. He smiled and extended his right hand to Connor, saying politely, “Hello!”
Connor looked at the extended hand but didn’t shake it. Instead, he turned his head and said to Mina, “I have something to do, so I’ll return to my room!”
After saying that, Connor turned around and returned to his room.
Connor naturally didn’t have a good impression of the villain who hacked his account and was going to use his account to deceive women.
He planned to wait until the man had left and then find out about him from Mina. He would then ask Kyle to use the information to find out more about that man.
With Kyle’s influence in Porthampton, it would be easy for him to find the man.
As for whether Mina would be deceived, Connor did not care anymore.
After all, he had already explained to her before, but she did not believe him, so he did not want to continue insisting on his truth.
A hint of dissatisfaction flashed in the man’s eyes after Connor ignored his handshake.
Mina seemed a little awkward, too. She explained, “Hector, I’m really sorry. That’s Connor, don’t mind him…”
Hector quickly smiled gentlemanly and said softly, “Mina, does Connor like you?”
“Does Connor like me?”
Mina was a little puzzled.
“Yeah, is it because Connor likes you and saw you bringing me home that he’s so cold to me?”
Hector asked with a smile.
“How is that possible? Don’t overthink. Connor and 1 are just housemates. Why would he like me? And even if he likes me, I…”
Mina stopped mid-sentence, but what she was trying to say was apparent.
Mina was telling Hector that she would never fall in love with Connor.
The reason Mina said that was not because Connor was a broke loser. On the contrary, Mina had a very good impression of Connor. After all, he had a great personality and was very handsome. It was just that he was a little poor. However, she was not a materialistic person.
Previously, Mina had taken the initiative to invite Connor to share an apartment with her because she had a good impression of Connor.
However, Mina felt that Connor was too narrow-minded after what happened yesterday.
Moreover, she felt that Connor’s attitude toward Hector was because he was jealous of Hector’s good looks and money.
Therefore, Mina’s impression of him had deteriorated. Let alone have romantic feelings for him; now, the question was if she could even continue living with him.
“You what?” Hector asked Mina with a smile.
“No… nothing…”
Mina replied indifferently and then reached out to close the door.
The two did not let Connor’s action dampen their moods and continued to chat happily.
Mina’s good impression of Connor had changed for the worse, but her impression of Hector had improved.
Mina felt that Hector was not only handsome and rich but also very gentlemanly and easy-going compared to Connor. He was so much better than Connor in many ways.
Meanwhile, after Connor returned to his room, he immediately took out his phone and began to call Twitch’s customer service to get his account back.
But after exchanging a few words, the customer service personnel hung up on him.
This was because when Connor registered his account, he did not connect the account to his phone or email.
And now, Hector had already connected CeeM’s to his phone, so Connor had no way of getting it back.
The customer service personnel thought Connor was only pestering them, so he had hung up on Connor.
In the end, Connor had no choice but to give up on getting his account back.
Instead, he planned to quietly wait for the man to leave and ask Mina about him. Later, he would ask Kyle to investigate.
Time passed quickly. Soon, half an hour had passed.
Connor, lying in bed quietly waiting, began to feel drowsy.
Bang!
At this moment, a loud sound suddenly came from the hallway.
“Ah!”
Following that, Mina screamed.
When Connor heard Mina’s scream, he immediately sat up straight.
“That’s it. Something has happened to Mina!”
Connor panicked. He quickly put on his pants and rushed out of his room.
When a man and a woman were in the same room, it was obvious that something would happen!
Connor guessed that the man must have been unable to control his lust and wanted to bed Mina. However, he was rejected by Mina, so he could only force himself on Mina.
After hearing Mina scream, Connor rushed into the hallway.
Mina’s room door was open. Connor hesitated before walking into the room.
However, after seeing the scene in the room, he was shocked..

chapters.title: Chapter 66 - 66:I Am CeeM
chapters.content:
Chapter 66:I Am CeeM
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
This was because Connor discovered that there were five bulky men in Mina’s room other than Hector.
Connor was stunned when he saw that. Could it be that Hector planned for Mina to be assaulted by a group of men?
“What do you want? Who let you all in?”
At this moment, Mina looked very frightened. She couldn’t help but take a few steps back while shouting at the men.
“You are Mina, right?”
One of the strong men walked up to her and carefully sized her up as he asked, seemingly very perverted.
“Yes, I am Mina!”
Mina looked at the man and nodded.
“Hehe, that’s great!”
The man smiled wretchedly and walked toward Mina.
At this moment, Mina instinctively took two steps back and hurriedly hid behind Hector.
Hector also seemed frightened by these burly men. However, he wanted to leave a good image in Mina’s mind to sleep with her.
Hector gritted his teeth and stood in front of Mina. He growled at the burly man, “Who are you? What are you trying to do? It’s illegal to barge into a house like this, do you understand?”
“Who the f*ck mm 1? What does it have to do with you? As for why I am looking for Mina, 1 advise you to mind your own business and stay aside. Otherwise, 1’11 break your lackeys, do you hear me?”
The burly man threatened Hector with disdain.
“You… Get out of here now, or I’ll call the police!”
Hector shouted while trembling.
Slap!
The burly man slapped Hector across his face.
Then, he glared at Hector and scolded, “Who the f*ck are you? Are you threatening me?”
Hector was sent flying by the burly man before he fell heavily to the ground. Blood flowed from his nose.
Standing at the door, Connor did not feel sorry for Hector despite seeing him being beaten up. Instead, he felt a little satisfied.
Although these burly men were not good people, Hector was not a good person either.
“Hector, are you okay?”
Mina saw Hector falling to the ground and bleeding from his nose. She hurriedly ran over and started tearing.
After Connor heard what Mina said, he finally knew this person’s real name, Hector.
“Mina, I’m fine…”
Hector reached out to wipe the blood from his mouth. Then, he struggled to stand up as he shouted at the burly man, “You hit me. Do you know who 1 am? I will make you regret it…”
“Hehe, who are you?”
The burly man smiled at Hector in disdain.
“I am CeeM. How dare you hit me? 1 think you have a death wish. None of you is leaving today!”
Hector shouted and took out his phone to call for help.
However, when the burly man heard what Hector said, he was stunned. Then, he asked his lackeys behind him, “Have any of you heard of CeeM?”
“Nope!”
“Never!”
They all shook their heads.
When Hector saw everyone’s reaction, he was utterly speechless.
He was trying to scare them. In fact, he did not have any backups. After all, he was not the real CeeM.
He was just an ordinary young man.
However, Hector did not expect these people not to know CeeM. Therefore, he could not use this name to scare them!
“Bro, 1 remember something. Not long ago on Twitch, a rich kid often went against Mr. Knowles. That rich kid’s username is CeeM!”
At this moment, one of the lackeys suddenly recalled ‘CeeM’. He quickly approached Kenzo, the group leader, and whispered.
After hearing his lackey’s words, Kenzo couldn’t help but laugh playfully. Then, he walked up to Hector and said to him in a low voice, “So you are CeeM? You’re the one who’s always been against Mr. Knowles, right?”
“Mr. Knowles?”
Hearing what Kenzo said, Mina was instantly extremely surprised.
She realized that this group of people was Knowles of Porthampton’s people.
“That’s right. I’m CeeM. Scared? I advise you to get out of here quickly or else… !”
At this moment, Hector thought that Kenzo would be in awe of her after knowing his identity, so he shouted arrogantly.
“Hehe, or else… ?”
Kenzo sneered, then he said expressionlessly, “A few days ago, Mr. Knowles asked us to investigate your identity and told us to teach you a good lesson. I didn’t expect you to deliver yourself to us today. I’ll take care of you as well!”
H ii
Hector was instantly dumbfounded.
He didn’t expect the other party to not have the slightest bit of respect after knowing he was CeeM.
On the contrary, they seemed even more provoked because of his identity as CeeM.
Hector was starting to feel regretful. If he knew that CeeM had enmity with these people, he would not have dared to admit that he was CeeM even if he had nine lives!
Now that his identity had been exposed, not only did he not scare away Kenzo and his lackeys, but he had also provoked Kenzo even more.
Hector was going to die!
Meanwhile, Connor stood in the hallway and looked at Hector, who was in Mina’s room. He could not help but smile playfully. In his heart, he lamented that Hector was a foolish person.
He had told his nemesis, Knowles of Porthampton, that he was CeeM. Wasn’t he teasing Death?
“Beat him up!”
Kenzo suddenly shouted.
Rumble!
Four burly men surrounded Hector and kicked at Hector’s head.
Mina instinctively wanted to stop these people, but unfortunately, she was powerless. She couldn’t stop these men and was pushed to the floor.
Thud thud thud!
The four men took turns kicking Hector’s face.
Hector did not expect to fail to lure Mina to bed and also get beaten up for hacking CeeM’s Twitch account.
“Stop it! Aren’t you all here for me? Don’t hit my friend…”
Mina stood up and shouted at the men.
However, the four men didn’t seem to hear Mina and continued to punch and kick Hector.
Hector was looking incredibly pathetic right now. He wanted to admit to Kenzo that he wasn’t CeeM and that he had hacked the account.
However, Kenzo’s men didn’t give Hector a chance to speak as they continuously kicked his face.
They did not stop until Hector spat blood, and his face was swollen like a pig’s head. He did not even have the strength to speak.
Connor stood near the sofa in the living room. He had been coldly watching Hector get beaten up, but he had no intention of helping him..

chapters.title: Chapter 67 - 67: Who Are You To Me?
chapters.content:
Chapter 67: Who Are You To Me?
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
At this moment, Mina saw Connor standing in the hallway. She hurriedly shouted, “Connor, what are you standing there for? Come over and help!” “Help?”
Connor couldn’t help but smile faintly when he heard that.
“Connor, we are still friends, right? I’m begging you, okay? Hurry up and help Hector!”
Mina shouted at Hector, flustered.
At this moment, only Connor could lend a hand. Therefore, Mina placed all her hopes on him.
“How do I help you? There are so many of them. I can’t beat them all!”
Connor spread his arms and said helplessly.
Mina despaired when she heard that.
After all, Hector had hacked Connor’s account. To Connor, he was not a good person.
Therefore, Connor thought he could use Kenzo and the others to teach Hector a good lesson.
Moreover, Connor came here to help Mina. Right now, Mina was not in trouble, so Connor naturally did not need to rush in to help.
Connor had just called Kyle Hayes. He guessed that Kyle’s men were downstairs. So, if Mina were in any danger, Connor would order Kyle’s men to come up.
But now, Hector was the one who was in trouble. So, Connor wasn’t so inclined to help.
“Connor, you…”
Mina looked at Connor with disdain. She seemed to be in disbelief.
Mina had never expected Connor to be this kind of person. She couldn’t help but shout, “Connor, since you’re not here to help, then why are you here? You’re just here to watch the show, right?”
“Yes!”
Connor nodded lightly and continued, “Isn’t he CeeM? Isn’t he influential? I feel that he doesn’t need my help with his capabilities!”
Connor was reminding Mina of what he had told her. If Hector was CeeM, he definitely had a way to resolve this.
Yet, at this moment, being in this sorry state, Hector still hadn’t asked anyone for help. This meant that Hector wasn’t CeeM.
However, Mina couldn’t understand what Connor was implying. She felt that Connor chose only to watch because he was jealous of Hector.
“Connor McDonald, you’re really too despicable. Hector has already been beaten to such a state, yet you still have the mood to make sarcastic remarks. I didn’t expect you to be such a person!”
Mina looked at him and shouted in disappointment.
Connor looked at Mina indifferently and did not say anything.
“Connor, don’t think that I don’t know what you’re thinking. Aren’t you jealous when you see me with Hector because you like me? But let me tell you, even if all the men in the world die, I, Mina, will not fall in love with you. You are a piece of trash, a complete piece of trash!”
Seeing that Connor was not saying anything, Mina continued to shout.
Mina’s words were like a sharp blade, stabbing fiercely into Connor’s heart.
A trace of anger flashed in Connor’s eyes, but he still didn’t say anything nor help.
“Enough, stop!”
At this moment, Kenzo suddenly shouted.
When Kenzo’s lackeys heard his order, they stopped what they were doing.
“Hector, are you okay? Say something!”
Mina quickly ran to Hector and asked him with tears in her eyes.
When Connor saw that Mina was concerned about Hector, an inexplicable emotion filled his heart.
“Mina, don’t worry, I… I’m fine!”
Hector wiped the blood off his face and replied weakly.
“You’ve been beaten up so badly, how can you be fine? I… I’ll take you to the hospital now…”
Mina helped Hector up as she spoke. Then, she walked out of the room.
“Wait!”
At this moment, Kenzo suddenly shouted coldly.
“You’ve already beaten Hector up so badly, what else do you want?”
Mina looked at Kenzo and shouted agitatedly.
“Before you leave, I want to tell you something…”
Kenzo said to Mina expressionlessly.
Mina took a deep breath and gritted her teeth before asking, “Who are you? What do you want?”
“We are the people of Mr. Knowles of Porthampton. We are here today because Mr. Knowles wants us to deliver a message to you. You must sign the contract with him within three days. If you still don’t sign the contract with him by then, we will come and look for you again. When we come for you again, things won’t be as simple as today. Do you understand what I mean?” Kenzo said to Mina expressionlessly.
Mina looked at Kenzo. A strange look flashed in her eyes, but she didn’t say anything.
“Did you hear what 1 said to you just now?”
Kenzo continued at the unresponsive Mina.
“I… I got it!”
Mina was thinking about taking Hecto to the hospital as soon as possible. She wasn’t in the mood to waste time talking to Kenzo.
“Alright, since you got the message, my job here is done!”
Kenzo smiled coldly and turned to look at Hector. He said coldly to Hector, “Kid, don’t let me see you in the future. Otherwise, I’ll beat you up every time I see you. Do you hear me…”
Hector gritted his teeth and looked at Kenzo. His heart was broken.
He had initially hacked Connor’s account because he wanted to use this account to deceive female streamers on Twitch and trick them into sleeping with him.
But he never would have thought that it would cause so much trouble.
“I’m f*cking talking to you. You didn’t hear me, did you?”
Kenzo shouted angrily as I lector did not respond.
“I… I heard you!”
Hector was so scared that his whole body was trembling. He hurriedly nodded.
When Kenzo saw Hector’s reaction, he smiled disdainfully. Then, he turned around and left with his people.
A moment later, Kenzo and the others were gone.
“Hector, let’s go. I’ll take you to the hospital now. I’m sorry for what happened today. It’s all my fault for implicating you…” Mina said to Hector guiltily.
“Mina, I’m fine. It’s all just minor injuries. There’s no need to go to the hospital!”
Hector hesitated for a moment and said in a low voice.
After all, he hadn’t slept with Mina yet. How could he go to the hospital now?
“No, you’ve been beaten up so badly. How can you not go to the hospital!”
Mina said as she dragged Hector out of the room.
But at that moment, Connor suddenly reached out to stop Mina and said expressionlessly, “He can go to the hospital alone. You don’t have to go with him!”
Mina heard what Connor and suddenly looked up at him.
Then she shouted at Connor angrily, “Connor McDonald, who are you to me? What does it have to do with you whether I go to the hospital with him?”

chapters.title: Chapter 68 - 68: Be My Girlfriend
chapters.content:
Chapter 68: Be My Girlfriend
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
The reason Connor wanted to stop Mina was straightforward.
If anything happened to Mina when he was still around, he could immediately call Kyle Hayes’ men.
However, if Mina and Hector went to the hospital and something happened along the way, Connor wouldn’t know and wouldn’t be able to save her immediately.
Mina didn’t know what Connor was thinking. Connor watched Hector get beaten up, but he didn’t say anything. This made Mina very angry.
Mina was about to bring Hector to the hospital, but Connor stopped her. Mina even began to wonder if something was wrong with Connor.
“Connor, get lost!”
Mina shouted at him coldly.
“Mina, i think what Connor said makes sense. I can go to the hospital by myself. You can stay at home…”
At this moment, Hector was the one to suggest that Mina stay home.
When Mina heard what Hector said, she was filled with gratitude. She looked at him with stars in her eyes.
The pure and kind Mina thought Hector did not want to trouble her, so he asked her to stay home.
Connor, on the other hand, was confused. He could not understand why Hector asked Mina not to bring him to the hospital.
“No, you were beaten because of me just now. I have to send you to the hospital!”
Mina insisted.
Hector seemed a little awkward when he heard that, but he did not say anything.
Seeing that Hector did not reject her, Mina helped Hector out of the apartment.
“You can’t go to the hospital with him!”
But Connor reached out to stop Mina again.
“Connor, get out of my way. You don’t have to care about me! It’s fine if you didn’t help Hector when he was beaten up just now, but now you are stopping me from taking him to the hospital. What are you thinking?”
Mina roared impatiently. Then, she pushed Connor aside and helped Hector out of the apartment.
Connor looked on as Mina and Hector departed before sighing helplessly, but he didn’t chase after them to stop them.
Besides, Connor had already told Mina what he should say. Since Mina didn’t believe him, Connor couldn’t do anything about it.
A moment later, Mina and Hector went into the elevator.
Connor returned to his room alone, but his cell phone suddenly rang at this moment.
He quickly took out his cell phone and looked at it. It was a call from Kyle.
Earlier, Connor watched Hector get beaten up, so he forgot about Kyle and the others, who were still waiting downstairs.
“Hello?”
Connor answered the call.
“Mr. McDonald, should we go up now? What’s happening there?” Kyle asked hurriedly.
“Kyle, you don’t have to ask anyone to come here. The matter has been resolved!”
Connor replied indifferently.
“Okay, Mr. McDonald!”
Kyle had waited downstairs for two hours. In the end, Connor didn’t need him at all.
Kyle would have gone up to kill him if it had been anyone else. However, it was Connor. Not only did Kyle not dare to be angry with Connor, he even responded respectfully.
“By the way, Kyle, I need you to help me investigate two more people!”
Connor continued.
“Who are they?” Kyle asked quickly.
“One of them is from Twitch. His username is Knowles of Porthampton, and the other one is Hector Flynn!” Connor said slowly.
“Well…”
Kyle sounded like he was in a difficult position when he heard Connor’s request.
“Is there a problem?”
Connor asked softly.
“Mr. McDonald, I don’t think there’s a problem to investigate Knowles of Porthampton. After all, as long as 1 can find his people, I can find out about him. However, 1 think it’s a little difficult to investigate Hector Flynn. After all, there are many Hector Flynns…” Kyle explained slowly.
“This Hector Flynn is from Porthampton, and I’ve seen him before!” Connor said hesitantly.
“If that’s the case, then it’s much simpler. I’ll ask my men to collect the photos of all the Hector Flynns in Porthampton and show them to you, Mr. McDonald. This way, we’ll be able to find the person you’re talking about!” Kyle quickly suggested.
“Okay!”
Connor agreed and ended the call.
Meanwhile, Mina helped Hector out of the apartment building and tried to hail a taxi to send Huang Feng to the hospital.
“Hector, hang in there. My place is very close to the hospital. We should be there soon…”
Mina said gently to Hector.
“Mina, I’m fine. These are all minor injuries. We don’t have to go to the hospital?”
Hector said to Mina helplessly.
He didn’t want Mina to send him to the hospital because he didn’t have the money to see a doctor at all.
All his money was used to treat Mina to a meal. Moreover, Hector had rented branded clothes from a clothing store to disguise himself as a rich kid.
The rent for this set of clothes was costly. If Hector did not return it on time before midnight tonight, he would have to pay a large sum of late fees.
Hector did not even have the money to see a doctor. How could he have the money to pay the late fees?
“No, you’re bleeding. I have to take you to the hospital!”
Mina replied very stubbornly.
“Mina, 1 don’t need to go to the hospital. I have other things to do later. Why don’t you go back? After I’m done with my things, 1’11 go to the hospital myself, okay?” Hector said to Mina gently.
“You have other things to do? What could be more important than going to the hospital to see a doctor?”
Mina was stunned for a moment before asking.
