“I… I need to find someone to investigate that Knowles of Porthampton, who made things difficult for you. Since he dared to bully you like this and even sent someone to beat me up, I definitely won’t let them off!”
Hector could only make up an excuse in a moment of desperation. Then, he continued, “Mina, it’s fortunate that I’m here today. Otherwise, who knows what they might have done to you. 1 absolutely won’t allow anyone to bully you like this. 1 must find this Knowles of Porthampton today and teach him a good lesson!”
Upon hearing that, Mina was instantly touched.
Hector was beaten and bruised, but he was still thinking about how to help her get revenge.
Mina covered her mouth as she was indescribably touched. She wished she could take off her clothes right now and give herself to him.
“Hector, you… Why are you so good to me?”
Mina’s eyes were filled with tears as she asked Hector softly.
“Didn’t I tell you? I’ve fallen in love with you since the first time I saw you. If you agree to be my girlfriend, 1 think everything I’ve suffered today is worth it!” Hector looked at Mina lovingly and said.
“Hector, you…”
Mina was speechless because of Hector’s sudden confession.
“Mina, 1 really like you. Can you be my girlfriend?”
Hector struck while the iron was hot..

chapters.title: Chapter 69 - 69: A Successful Confession
chapters.content:
Chapter 69: A Successful Confession
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Hector had already confessed to Mina once while having dinner with her today.
After all, he had spent so much effort hacking Connor’s account to get Mina to sleep with him.
Meanwhile, Mina felt that she had just met Hector today, so it would be unreserved if she agreed to be with him immediately.
Also, Mina felt that she did not know Hector very well, so she suggested that they get to know each other first.
However, Mina was moved after the incident tonight, so her heart began to waver.
“Mina, can you give me a chance? Although we haven’t known each other for long, I swear that I like you. 1 will only treat you well in my life!”
Hector continued after seeing that Mina was hesitating.
“Can… can 1 think about it?”
Mina said to Hector shyly.
“What are you still thinking about? Can’t you feel my sincerity?” Hector asked agitatedly.
“I know you treat me very well, but I still have to think about it. After all, we have only known each other for less than a day. Can you let me think about it?” Mina asked nervously.
“Alright, Mina, then you should think about it!”
Hector replied with a slightly expectant look. He knew that since Mina had said that, she had already promised him in her heart.
However, girls were a little reserved, so Hector did not continue to push Mina to make a decision.
Moreover, there was still something very important that Hector had to do. There was less than an hour left before he had to return his clothes. He was not in the mood to continue wasting time with Mina.
“Okay…”
Mina looked at him and nodded lightly.
Hector took advantage of Mina’s lack of attention and reached out to hail a taxi. He then turned around and rushed into the taxi.
“Hector, what are you doing…”
Mina had initially planned to send Hector to the hospital, but he had already gotten into the taxi in the blink of an eye.
Mina watched as the taxi slowly disappeared from her sight. She could not help but feel a surge of warmth in her heart.
Although Mina was very sad because Kenzo had beaten Hector up today, she was able to see two people’s true colors.
One was Connor, and the other was Hector.
When Mina was on a date with Hector, Mina had rejected Hector’s proposal to be together, mainly because of Connor.
But now, Mina felt that she had already seen Connor’s true colors.
What Connor did today had disappointed Mina, while Hector had touched Mina.
Mina initially had planned to ask Connor’s opinion on if she should agree to be with Hector. After all, Connor was her only friend in Porthampton, and she had a pretty solid impression of Connor.
However, after tonight’s incident, Mina’s good impression of Connor was utterly shattered. What replaced it was disgust.
Five minutes later, Mina returned to the apartment alone.
Meanwhile, Hector, sitting in the taxi, was also in a good mood.
Although he had been inexplicably beaten up today, he felt that if Mina had agreed to be with him, today’s beating would not have been in vain.
“Young man, should I send you to the hospital?”
The taxi driver saw that Hector’s head was bloodied, so he had asked with some concern.
“No. Why should I go to the hospital with such minor injuries? Take me to Henry’s Clothing Rental!”
Hector wiped the blood from his face and said loudly.
“He’s bleeding so badly but refuses to go to the hospital? This young man…”
The taxi driver sighed helplessly and then drove to the place that Hector had mentioned.
Hector, who was in the back seat, took out his phone. Then, he opened Porthampton University’s forum online. He published a post titled, “Successfully confessed to a female streamer tonight. I am only one step away from getting her into my bed. When the time comes, I’ll broadcast it live to everyone!”.
After editing, Hector quickly published that post. He also attached a photo of Mina’s thighs that he secretly took during dinner today.
Although it was almost 11 o’clock at night, Hector’s post had already received thousands of likes and comments less than a minute after it was published.
Hector looked at the post with a lusty smile.
The next day, at nine o’clock in the morning.
Connor entered Porthampton University’s classroom.
When he walked into the classroom, the students in the class were all looking at him strangely. Their faces were filled with disdain.
Connor didn’t need to think to know what was going on. It must be because he had pretended to be a rich kid to deceive some girls in Dusk last night. Brandon and Mandy must have spread rumors about him. That was why the students in the class were looking at Connor weirdly.
“All, isn’t this Connor? Why did you arrive so late? Don’t you usually arrive very early?”
Lily Sullivan mocked him when she saw him enter the classroom.
“Does it have anything to do with you when I come to school?”
Connor replied expressionlessly.
“We’re classmates. I’m just concerned about you…” Lily said sweetly.
“I don’t need your concern!”
After saying that, Connor walked to the back row of the classroom.
“Connor, after we exposed you last night, you didn’t get that beautiful girl from the art academy. Did you have trouble sleeping?”
May Young mocked him.
Perhaps because of yesterday’s incident, May felt she had made a comeback. Therefore, she dared to take a hit at Connor.
“Does this have anything to do with you?”
Connor sized her up as he asked calmly.
“It doesn’t matter. I just want to know how it feels like to be exposed for pretending to be a rich kid!” May smiled at him and said.
“I don’t feel anything!”
Connor retorted and then continued to the back row.
“Don’t go, Connor. Why Don’t you tell everyone about what happened last night?”
“I’m curious. Just what did you tell that beautiful girl from the art academy that she was convinced that you’re a rich kid!”
Seeing that Connor was about to leave, Mandy thought she had hit a sore spot, so she continued to tease him relentlessly.
Connor didn’t want to argue with Mandy and the others about last night. However, now even May had dared to mock him, and on top of that, there was the incident with Hector last night. So, Connor was not in the mood to be nice.
Connor stopped in his tracks and glared at May icily.
“Connor, why are you looking at me like that? Are you unhappy after being exposed by us? Do you still want to hit me?”
May was shocked by Connor’s glare. She couldn’t help but stumble backward as she said to Connor in a low voice.
“May Young, have you forgotten who was the one who stripped naked in the hotel and begged me to have sex with her?”
Connor asked May teasingly..

chapters.title: Chapter 70 - 70: An Apology Or Return My Money
chapters.content:
Chapter 70: An Apology Or Return My Money
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Tu-tump!
Hearing what Connor said, the entire classroom instantly started to buzz.
This sentence was like a ticking time bomb exploded in the classroom.
The students who were mocking Connor instantly froze, puzzled.
Even May Young herself did not expect Connor to say that aloud.
May seemed to have been struck by lightning. Her jaw fell as she looked at Connor in a daze.
After Connor finished speaking, a pin-drop silence filled the classroom.
Everyone’s eyes were widened as they looked at Connor and May in a daze. It wasn’t easy to guess what they were thinking.
After all, the students did not expect Connor to have such a juicy rumor about May Young.
May had stripped naked in a hotel room and asked to have sex with Connor?
To the students, this sounded impossible.
Let alone a beautiful girl like May, even the most ordinary-looking girl in the class, would not ask to have sex with Connor.
Moreover, May had always hated Connor. Why would she do such a thing?
May’s eyes widened as she stared at Connor. She couldn’t hide the embarrassment on her face.
She regretted her decision to try to sleep with Connor now.
She didn’t expect him to reveal what happened in the hotel room to the class.
In fact, Connor didn’t plan to expose her, even though she was a hateful woman to him.
After all, they were classmates. If he had exposed her, it would have had a massive impact on her.
But today, Connor wasn’t in a good mood. In addition, May was making things difficult for him. That was why he told the whole class about the hotel incident.
“Connor, what the f*ck are you talking about?”
A tall and strong boy rushed over from the front row of the classroom. He shouted at Connor agitatedly.
Connor glanced up at the boy, Harvey McAdam. He was a committee member of the sports’ club. He was tall and strong, but he was not very bright. To put it bluntly, he was more brawny than brainy.
Everyone knew that Harvey had a crush on May. He had confessed to May many times in class, but May would reject him.
Although May did not like Harvey, she had always kept him waiting and treated him as a spare.
Whenever Harvey was about to give up on her, May would give tease him with some attention and make him continue bowing to her.
Now, Connor claimed that May had taken the initiative to strip naked and beg him to have sex with her. Harvey found it humiliating to May.
“Am I making things up?”
Connor looked up at Harvey and said with a faint smile, “You can ask May if I am spewing nonsense!”
When the students in the classroom heard this, they all turned their heads to look at Ye Mei.
On the other hand, May was still in a state of confusion. She had not recovered from what had just happened, so she did not know how to explain herself.
“May Young, say something! Quickly say that what Connor said is fake. As long as you say the word, I will help you beat him up!”
Harvey shouted at May; his eyes widened.
May stood there in silence for a whole minute. Then, she burst into tears without explaining anything.
“May! May!” Seeing May crying, Mandy quickly walked to May and held her up.
Then, she turned to look at Connor and said coldly, “Connor, since you claim that May had begged you to have sex with her, do you have any proof?”
“Do you need proof for such a thing?”
Connor replied indifferently.
“Since you don’t have any proof, 1 think you’re making things up. As a man, how could you bully a woman like that? What kind of man are you? You must apologize to May, now!” Mandy shouted at Connor righteously.
“I can apologize, but May must return the 50,000 dollars I lent her. You can ask May now if she wants me to apologize or that she would return the money to me!”
Connor said expressionlessly.
Mandy froze and then turned to look at May, puzzled. When did May borrow 50,000 dollars from Connor?
“May, do you owe him money?”
Harvey asked May softly.
“I… I…”
Tears flowed down May’s face as she stuttered. She didn’t know how to explain this to everyone.
“Ring!”
At this moment, the bell for the start of the class suddenly rang.
“Alright, get back to your places. If there’s anything, it will be solved resolved privately! Ms. Wallace would be annoyed when she comes in and sees us gathering like this!”
Hearing the bell ring, the class president, Eunice Tanner, shouted coldly as if she wanted to help Connor out of his predicament.
Just as Eunice finished speaking, the students could hear the sounds of high heels clicking from outside the classroom.
The lecturer, Rachel Wallace, wore a sexy uniform when she appeared at the classroom entrance.
When the students in the class saw Rachel enter, they all returned to their seats.
Mandy, Harvey, and the others hesitated and didn’t dare continue talking about what happened with Connor earlier, so they went back to their seats.
In the end, no one knew whether May asked Connor to sleep with her. They didn’t know if it was true that May even wanted to sleep with Connor.
And why did May borrow 50,000 dollars from Connor? After all, 50,000 dollars was not a tiny amount for university students.
The most puzzling thing was how a broke loser like Connor had 50,000 dollars at his disposal?
Connor returned to his seat. When Dominic and Spencer saw Connor approach his seat, they seemed puzzled.
“Connor, is that true what you said earlier?”
Spencer asked Connor in a whisper.
“What do you think?”
Connor replied indifferently.
“May wouldn’t want to have sex with you, would she?”
Spencer was still in shock as he asked curiously.
“Haha…”
Connor looked at Spencer and smiled faintly. He didn’t explain much.
Connor revealed that to shut May’s mouth and to vent his dissatisfaction toward her.
Now that his goal has been achieved, Connor would not continue to deal with her.
Although Dominic and Spencer were suspicious, they didn’t dare to pester Connor about it as this was Rachel’s class, and they were not allowed to talk in class..

chapters.title: Chapter 71 - 71: I’ll Prove It
chapters.content:
Chapter 71: I’ll Prove It
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Over half an hour later, the class bell rang.
As Connor was now in junior year, he did not need to go to class all day. After this class was over, there was no other class today.
Usually, after class, the students would scramble to leave the classroom, get lunch, and return to the dormitory to rest.
However, none of the students in the class left today. The atmosphere was very strange.
Connor packed his things and was prepared to leave. However, at this moment, Harvey McAdam, Brandon Guthrie, and a few other boys in the class who were on good terms with Brandon stopped Connor at the classroom door.
“It’s over. Connor is in big trouble today!”
Dominic Turner said solemnly upon seeing this scene.
The students in the class all looked at Connor at the same time. They seemed like they were waiting for a good show.
Although Rachel Wallace’s appearance had interrupted Brandon, Harvey, and the others from interrogating Connor, they did not intend to let him go now.
What Connor said earlier was indeed a little unbelievable. After all, he had destroyed May Young’s innocence.
After Connor had packed up his textbooks, he was about to walk out of the classroom.
However, Harvey stood at the classroom door and blocked Connor’s way. His eyes were ice-cold as he looked at Connor. It was as if he was interrogating Connor.
“Move aside!”
Connor looked up at Harvey and said expressionlessly.
“Hah, get out of the way?”
After hearing what Connor said, Harvey couldn’t help but sneer and growled, “Connor McDonald, don’t you owe us an explanation?”
“What explanation?”
Connor snarled.
“You insulted May. Shouldn’t you explain this to everyone? If you just leave now, May’s innocence will be affected by your slander. Therefore, you must explain this today!” Harvey shouted righteously.
Connor looked at Harvey and couldn’t help but grin.
Harvey was like May’s loyal dog.
Even though May was promiscuous outside and sold her body for 50,000 dollars, Harvey still tried to speak up for May. Connor found that funny.
“I said that May begged me to have sex with her. That’s a private matter between May and me. It has nothing to do with you, right?”
Before, Connor might be afraid of Harvey. After all, he knew Harvey and didn’t want to make a big deal out of it. However, Connor was no longer the same as before. He was not as weak as before.
Connor’s response stunned Harvey because this had nothing to do with him.
Harvey could now feel that Connor seemed to have changed into a different person.
Previously, before Harvey even opened his mouth to speak, Connor would have already started to tremble in fear. How would he dare to talk to him like this?
The students in the classroom seemed to have noticed this as well. They all looked at Connor strangely.
“That’s right. This has nothing to do with us. But as May’s friend, we can’t just stand by and watch as you slander her like this, right? So it would be best if you gave us an explanation on this today. Otherwise, you will kneel and apologize to May!”
Without waiting for Connor to speak, Brandon stepped forward and shouted at him.
Connor turned and glanced at Brandon. He knew that Brandon was the initiator of today’s incident. Brandon planned to take this opportunity to take revenge on him.
“Harvey, Brandon, what are you two doing blocking the classroom door? Are you not letting everyone go when class is done?”
As Connor was about to speak, the class representative, Eunice Tanner, suddenly walked over to Connor and snapped at Harvey and Brandon.
After Dominic and Spencer heard what Eunice said, they headed over to Harvey and Branded before roaring, “Harvey, whatever happened between Connor and May has nothing to do with you, right? Let the two settle their affairs. What’s the matter with you, standing in the way?”
When Connor saw how these three people stood up to speak for him, he felt moved. At least three people in the class were willing to help him.
After Dominic, Eunice, and Spencer stood up for Connor, Harvey seemed not as arrogant as before. He then glanced hesitantly at Brandon.
Brandon hesitated and said to Eunice, “Eunice, you’re mistaken. We are only stopping Connor and not letting him go. If the others want to leave, they can leave now!”
“Why can’t Connor leave?” Eunice stared at Brandon and shouted.
“Didn’t 1 say just now that Connor’s claim has a huge impact on May? So, Connor must explain this to everyone. Otherwise, how will May be able to cope with the aftermath?”
Brandon said calmly.
“You…”
“Eunice, you don’t have to bother with these people!”
Just as Eunice was about to retort, Connor suddenly interrupted her. Then, he looked at Brandon and asked, “Do you want an explanation from me now?”
“Yes. If you can prove that your claim is true, I will let you go. If you can’t prove it, then you have to kneel and apologize to May. Otherwise, you won’t be walking out of this place today!” Brandon threatened.
Brandon was deliberately making things difficult for Connor because he knew that whether May really begged to sleep with him, Connor would not be able to produce any proof.
As long as Connor could not produce any proof, then he had to kneel and apologize to May.
Kneeling and apologizing to a girl in front of so many people was very humiliating to a man.
Brandon wanted Connor to know that no one who went against him would live to tell the tale!
Mandy sat beside May. Her face was filled with disdain because she knew that Connor would kneel and apologize to May today.
Otherwise, there was no way Brandon and the others would let Connor go, not even if Eunice spoke up for him.
“As long as I can prove that what I said before is true, you will let me go, right?”
Connor asked Brandon softly.
“Yes, as long as you can prove that what you said before is true, we will let you go!” Brandon nodded lightly.
“Alright, then I will prove it to you now!”
Connor smiled playfully. Then, he turned to look at May and shouted softly, “May, tell everyone now, is what 1 said before true?”
When the students in the class heard what Connor said, they were stunned for a moment. Then, everyone began to laugh.
Even Brandon and Harvey could not help but smile. That was because Connor was undoubtedly courting death.
May was the victim of this situation.. Even if she really begged to sleep with Connor, why would she admit it when Connor asked her this in front of the whole class?

chapters.title: Chapter 72 - 72: The Fate Of A Lapdog
chapters.content:
Chapter 72: The Fate Of A Lapdog
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
When May heard Connor’s question, she was so frightened that she trembled.
She opened her mouth, but no words came.
She did not know how she should answer Zhang Feng’s question.
When Connor asked May to stand up and testify for him, the students burst into laughter. They were very contemptuous. No one had expected Connor to be so stupid to such an extent.
Connor had slandered May, and now, he was asking her to help testify for him. Was he not playing with fire?
May felt regretful for ridiculing Connor before. If not for her folly, would Connor have brought up that incident again?
If Connor hadn’t brought it up, Harvey and the others wouldn’t have been so pumped to denounce him!
Now, Connor was making her admit that she had stripped naked before him and begged him to sleep with her in front of the whole class.
May felt that if she admitted that today, her reputation would be ruined forever! She couldn’t do that!
Therefore, at this moment, May was very hesitant. She wondered if she should admit to that or not.
After a burst of laughter, the students turned to look at May. They were waiting for an answer from her.
However, May didn’t immediately deny this as everyone had imagined.
Instead, she sat with a nervous expression. She pursed her lips tightly and refused to say a word.
“May, say something. What are you standing there for? Brandon and the others will make Connor kneel and apologize to you if you shake your head now!”
Mandy quickly tried to persuade May when she saw that May was not responding.
The reason Mandy and Brandon were so excited was not to help May.
They just wanted to take revenge on Connor for what happened at New Century Restaurant.
“I…”
May hesitated before beginning to speak.
“May, I advise you not to lie. Otherwise, I’ll find Todd Knowles and the others and ask them to have a good chat with you. 1 can’t guarantee what will happen then!”
At this moment, Connor suddenly said to May coldly.
When May heard that, her face immediately turned pale with fright. She shouted at Harvey and the others, terrified, “Please let Connor go. 1… I don’t want his apology…”
The reason why she was so conflicted about lying was that she had considered this point.
If she lied and said that Connor was making things up, Connor might look for Todd to deal with her.
By then, not only would May’s innocence be threatened, it was very likely that even her body would suffer some unimaginable violations.
When the students heard what May said, they were all stunned. Everyone seemed to be in disbelief.
Everyone knew what that meant!
Although May did not admit it, what she said was no different from admitting it!
“Ma… May, are you crazy? Are you going to let Connor go?”
Harvey’s eyes were widened, and his voice was trembling.
Mandy and Brandon had the same expression on their faces. They couldn’t understand why May would say something like that!
“Yes, let Connor go!”
May nodded as tears streamed down her face.
May didn’t want just to let him go, but this was her only choice.
“No, you can’t let him go. He insulted you before. Why would you let him go? Connor must have threatened you. That’s why you say this, isn’t it?”
Harvey couldn’t believe it for a moment. He quickly ran up to may and questioned her agitatedly.
“Yeah, May. Did Connor threaten you? Why would you beg to sleep with him?”
Mandy could not accept May’s answer. So she frowned and asked softly.
“Can you guys stop asking? Let Connor go!”
May did not want to continue to embarrass herself in the face of everyone’s questioning. So, she could only be pathetic as she said that.
After all, the students were still watching. The more May explained, the more embarrassed she would be.
“May, hurry up and tell me this isn’t true! How could you beg to sleep with Connor? This is impossible! You wouldn’t fall for a stinky loser like Connor!”
Harvey couldn’t accept that for a moment, and he roared in a moment of desperation.
H ii
After hearing what Harvey screamed, May’s expression suddenly turned cold. Then, she slapped his face hard and scolded him agitatedly, “When did I f*cking say that I beg Connor to sleep with me? Watch your words!”
May’s heart was filled with anger. Today’s incident was caused by her continuous mocking of Connor, which had pushed him to leak the incident.
However, if it weren’t because Harvey kept adding pepper and salt and refusing to let Connor leave after class, the matter wouldn’t have escalated to this point!
May felt like venting all her anger on Harvey at this moment.
After May slapped him, Harvey’s face immediately turned red. The class fell into a dead silence.
No one had expected May to slap Harvey. After all, Harvey was trying to protect May’s reputation, and Connor was the one who had slandered her.
The whole situation tickled Connor.
Harvey McAdam, who had been protecting May from the start, was slapped by May herself. The fate of a lapdog indeed!
Just when everyone thought that Harvey would fall out with May after the slap, May’s expression changed.
Harvey didn’t ask May why she had slapped him. Instead, he let out a silly laugh, then, he looked at May and said, “May, that means you did not beg Connor to sleep with you, right? Nothing happened between the two of you, right?”
When everyone heard what Harvey said, they gaped so hard one could stuff a whole egg into their mouths. This whole thing was like a sitcom.
Harvey had played out the definition of the lapdog to its perfection.
He was still concerned about whether May had slept with Connor!
Connor was not in the mood to continue battering these people. So, he walked out of the classroom.
Dominic, Eunice, and the others followed Connor out of the classroom.
The other students watched Connor and the others leave, their gazes filled with complex emotions.
After leaving the classroom, Connor’s phone suddenly rang. He took out his phone to look at the called ID and realized that it was a call from Kyle Hayes.
However, as Dominic and the others were still nearby, Connor did not answer the call. Instead, he declined the call right away.
Kyle then quickly sent a text message.
The text message said, “Mr. McDonald, there’s an update about the two people you asked me to investigate yesterday. I’m waiting for you at the entrance of Porthampton University!”
After Connor saw the message, he could not help but smile.
After all, he felt that exposing the identity of the hacker, Hector Flynn, was the most important thing to do right now..

chapters.title: Chapter 73 - 73: Eunice’s Good Intention
chapters.content:
Chapter 73: Eunice’s Good Intention
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Eunice Tanner and the other two left the classroom with Connor. They were all puzzled.
They could not understand why May, who had always looked down on Connor, would ask Connor to sleep with her.
Although May did not admit to this today, they could tell from her words and actions that this was most likely true. Otherwise, she would not have asked Connor to leave in such a hurry.
This implied that she had admitted to everything, too!
“Connor, what happened between you and May?”
Dominic couldn’t hold it in any longer. He walked up to Connor and asked him softly.
“Yeah, bro. Why would May ask you to sleep with her?” Spencer asked curiously.
Connor turned and glanced at the two. Then, he briefly told them about how Todd kidnapped May, and how she had called Connor to ask him to pay them ransom and save her.
Although Connor didn’t want to reveal his identity to Dominic, Spencer and the others, he felt that there won’t be an issue telling them about the incident.
After listening to Connor’s explanation, Dominic suddenly realized. He quickly said, “May asked to sleep with you to ‘repay’ the 50,000 dollars you lent her, right?”
“Yes, but I wasn’t interested in her, so I didn’t touch her. I didn’t think of telling anyone else about this, but May went overboard today. I couldn’t control myself for a moment, so I spilled it!”
Connor explained softly.
“Oh, I see!”
Spencer nodded slightly, the doubts he had dissipated.
Dominic and Spencer thought Connor’s explanation entirely believable.
If that wasn’t the case, why would May, who was so arrogant, ask Connor to sleep with her?
“But Connor, where did you get that 50,000 dollars from?”
Eunice seemed to have noticed something amiss. She frowned and asked Connor in a low voice,
“That’s right, Connor. The other time, you said that it was because you won the lottery scratchcard that you had the money to treat everyone to a meal. But didn’t you already spend most of it back then? Where did you get this 50,000 dollars from?” Dominic suddenly realized that. So he turned to look at Connor and asked.
“Uh…”
When Connor was faced with the two questions, he was like a deer caught in the headlights. Then, he whispered, “Actually, 1 didn’t tell you the truth back then. I won a total of 150,000 dollars from the lottery scratchcard. I spent nearly 100,000 dollars on the meal. 1 used the remaining 50,000 dollars to save May and Lily. That’s why I have spent all the money now…”
Eunice, Dominic, and Spencer’s eyes widened Connor. They were visibly shocked.
They had never expected that Connor, who had always been labelled a penniless loser, would be so lucky to win the grand prize of 150,000 dollars in one go.
The students of Porthampton University came from all walks of life. Students from ordinary families received only around 2,000 dollars a month.
Only a very small number of students from wealthy families would receive more than 3,000 dollars a month in allowance.
Therefore, when Connor mentioned 150,000 dollars, it was an astronomical figure to Dominic and the others.
What was even more incomprehensible to them was that after Connor won the 150,000 dollar prize, he had actually spent all of it treating everyone to a meal and saving May and Lily!
The three of them did not know what Connor was thinking. Could it be that he was used to being poor and did not know how to deal with much money after winning it?
Although they did not know why Connor would waste this money like this, they believed his story.
“Connor, since you won so much money, why didn’t you save the money? Even with just some interest, it could improve your life…”
Eunice seemed to be very bothered that Connor had wasted all this money like that. She frowned as she spoke to Connor.
“That money was a windfall to me. Even if it was wasted, it won’t affect me!”
Connor explained indifferently.
“But this money is very useful to you. If you didn’t spend this money, you won’t have to deliver food anymore. You can also buy a new set of clothes to wear. This way, nobody would look down on you anymore!” Eunice quickly continued.
“Will everyone look up to me if I wore a new set of clothes?”
Connor could not help but laugh when he heard what Eunice said, then he continued, “You’re too naive. They don’t look down on me because of the clothes on my body, but because they have already identified me as a poor loser!
“If I use this money to buy an expensive set of clothes for myself, they will still think that I picked it up somewhere or stole it. Even if I take out proof that I bought them myself, they will still think that I’m an idiot. It still won’t change that they will look down on me!”
Eunice was rendered speechless. Connor did make a bit of sense.
“Whether you can make others look up to you, the key lies in others and not in yourself. Look at me wearing this tattered set of clothes now. You still choose to stay by me and be my friend. And those who look down on me, will still look down on me even if I started wearing branded stuff!”
Connor paused before continuing, “I think what I am wearing is pretty good. There’s no need for me to change anything because of other people’s opinions!”
“Actually, I think Connor is right. As long as you’re happy with what you’re wearing, that’s all that matters. There’s no need to force yourself to change because of other people’s opinions!” Dominic seemed to agree with Connor’s approach. He spoke with a smile.
“All well, even if Connor doesn’t want to buy new clothes, he can still use this money to do something else. He doesn’t have to waste it like this!” Eunice said, still a little unsatisfied with the way Connor had spent the money.
Connor knew that the reason Eunice was saying all these was for his good.
So, he didn’t refute anything. Instead, he took out his phone and looked at the time. Then, he said, “Look, I have something to do in a bit, so ciao!”
After saying this, Connor walked to the gate of Porthampton University.
Connor was not in the mood to continue chatting with Eunice and the others. After all, he did not care about that 150,000 dollars.
After all, he was now the wealthiest person in the world who had inherited ten trillion dollars. A mere 150,000 dollars was nothing to him.
Moreover, Connor was still worried about Mina.
As for whether he should buy new clothes, Connor had indeed bought a few sets of new clothes earlier.
But he soon felt that his old clothes were more comfortable. At the very least, he could see people’s true color in the way they treated him.
This was also why Connor was still dressed so shabbily despite having bought new clothes..

chapters.title: Chapter 74 - 74: An Old Acquaintance
chapters.content:
Chapter 74: An Old Acquaintance
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
A few minutes later, Connor arrived at the northwest gate of Porthampton University.
As fewer students were coming in and out of this place, Kyle Hayes deliberately parked his car here to prevent other students from seeing Connor talking to him.
Although Kyle looked like a burly man with no brains, he was very meticulous.
Kyle had noticed long ago that Connor had been deliberately hiding his identity.
Upon reaching the gate, Connor quickly found Kyle’s Bentley. He opened the door and got in.
“Mr. McDonald!”
Kyle greeted Connor respectfully when he saw him.
“How’s the investigation going?”
Connor asked expressionlessly.
“Mr. McDonald, let’s start with Knowles of Porthampton, a streamer on Twitch. He is quite interesting. Also, Mr. McDonald, you might know him!”
Kyle took out a document and handed it to Connor as he spoke.
“I know him?”
Connor couldn’t help but feel stunned when he heard that. Then, he reached out and took the document.
When Connor saw the photo on the document, he was surprised. Then, he smiled helplessly and mumbled, “1 do know him…”
Connor looked at the document Kyle gave him regarding Knowles of Porthampton. He couldn’t help but smile playfully. He sighed that he and Knowles of Porthampton were really fated.
This was because Knowles of Porthampton was none other than Todd Knowles, who had previously had a conflict with Connor!
However, this was good anyway. As long as Kyle gave the order, Todd would not dare to continue making things difficult for Mina.
“Mr. McDonald, do you want me to bring you to Todd Knowles now?”
Kyle asked Connor softly.
“There’s no need to waste time with this kind of person. Just help me handle this matter. Tell him not to make things difficult for a female streamer named Mina in the future. Otherwise, he will taste the consequences!” Connor instructed.
“Yes, sir!”
Kyle immediately responded.
“Right, don’t expose my identity. Do you understand what 1 mean?” Connor hesitated and then continued.
“Mr. McDonald, don’t worry. I know what to do!” Kyle quickly replied.
“Great!”
Connor nodded slightly and then continued to say, “Oh right, what about Hector Flynn?”
“It’s basically done, but…”
Kyle hesitated, then took out a thick file and handed it to Connor. Then, he said in a low voice, “But there are more than a thousand people called Hector Flynn in Porthampton. It’s complicated to investigate this person!”
After hearing what Kyle reported, Connor instantly felt despaired!
More than a thousand ‘Hector Flynns’. By the time Connor found the real Hector Flynn, he would have played Mina through.
What would it matter if Connor managed to expose Hector Flynn by then?
“But, Mr. McDonald, according to the information you provided, 1 have filtered out about fifty Hector Flynn’s in Porthampton, who are around twenty years old, for you. You can see if there is the person you are looking for among these people!” Kyle looked at Connor and continued.
“Fifty is more like it!”
Connor sighed in relief. Kyle really knew how to keep him in suspense. It was as if he was on a roller coaster.
After heaving a sigh of relief, Connor quickly took the file from Kyle and began to read the content carefully.
Meanwhile…
After Connor left the classroom, the other students left, too.
After all, the main character of the incident, Connor, had already left. There was nothing to watch anymore, so there was no point in staying.
After seeing that all the students had left, Mandy Brandon, Harvey, and others gathered around May.
“May, what’s going on between you and Connor? Did Connor threaten you? Or does he have something on you?”
Mandy asked. She didn’t understand why May acted so strangely today and allowed Connor to leave just like that.
“He didn’t threaten me. 1 do owe him 50,000 dollars!”
May leaned on the table as she replied helplessly.
“You owe Connor money?” Mandy looked at May in surprise. She couldn’t understand why May owed Connor money.
“May, why do you owe him money?”
Brandon frowned and asked.
“Brandon, shouldn’t you know why?”
At this moment, Lily Sullivan, who had been silent, finally couldn’t hold it in anymore. She stood up and shouted at Brandon.
“Lily, what do you mean? What does it have to do with me that May owes Connor money?” Brandon asked Lily in embarrassment.
“When Mandy offended Todd Knowles, we were also implicated. Todd kidnapped us and took us to a private room. May and 1 needed 50,000 dollars to get us out. But after you used the money to save Mandy, you didn’t care about us at all. May knew that Connor had won the lottery scratchcard a few days ago, so she called him and borrowed money from him to save us. That’s what happened. Do you get it now?”
Lily shouted agitatedly, her eyes bulging.
Brandon and Mandy looked a little embarrassed when they heard Lily’s explanation. They didn’t know how to face May.
Harvey was unusually triggered. He shouted at the top of his lungs, “May, why didn’t you call me when you needed money back then?”
“What’s the use of calling you? We needed 50,000 dollars to get us out. Do you have that much money?”
May replied with a bitter smile.
Harvey was taken aback. He didn’t know what to say.
Although Harvey’s family was well-off, 50,000 dollars was not a small amount to him. He indeed didn’t have that much money.
“I don’t, but how could Connor, that poor delivery guy, have so much money?”
Harvey retorted, completely upset.
“Didn’t 1 just say that Connor won the lottery scratchcard, so he had the money to treat everyone to a meal at Brasserie Le Bernardin, and he even had the money to save the two of us!” Lily replied helplessly.
“If Connor won so much money, do you think he would be willing to use this money to treat everyone to a meal? Would he be willing to use this money to save the two of you?”
At this moment, Mandy suddenly sneered.
When everyone heard what Mandy said, they were a little confused.
“I was with Connor for two years. I know him very well. If Connor really won the lottery scratchcard, he wouldn’t be so generous!” she continued.
“Mandy, what do you mean by that?” Brandon asked hesitantly.
“Simple. This money doesn’t belong to Connor!” Mandy said firmly.
“It doesn’t belong to him?”
Everyone was puzzled again.
“Gosh, why are you all so stupid? Haven’t we got a lot of burglaries at our university recently? Many students had their money stolen. The police even came to our university to investigate it the last time, but they couldn’t find the thief…” Mandy said slowly.
“Mandy, are you saying that Connor is the thief?”
May exclaimed.
“I don’t know if Connor is the culprit, but I think Connor has been acting weird lately. He even told us that May tried to sleep with him. If we don’t teach Connor a lesson, 1 think he will be even more arrogant in the future!”
Mandy said coldly.
Brandon and the others looked at each other and seemed to agree with Mandy’s suggestion.
“But how do we teach Connor a lesson now?”
Harvey was stunned as he asked.
“Harvey, if I remember correctly, isn’t there a PE lesson tomorrow, right?” Mandy narrowed her eyes and asked.
“Yes, why?” Harvey nodded lightly.
“The plan is…”
Mandy whispered into their ears and began to plan the lesson they would teach Connor the next day..

chapters.title: Chapter 75 - 75: Chloe Lawson’s Call
chapters.content:
Chapter 75: Chloe Lawson’s Call
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
At Porthampton University’s entrance.
Connor was sitting in Kyle’s Bentley, carefully reading the file’s content in his hands.
However, after looking through all the information, Connor was surprised to find that the ‘Hector Flynn’ he saw last night was not on the list of people!
“Kyle, are you sure that all the Hector Flynns are on this list?” Connor put down the file and asked seriously.
“I’m sure. 1 asked someone to find all of them. Even if he’s not a local in Porthampton, I’ve collected every ‘Hector Flynn’ studying or working in Porthampton. So, this list is the most extensive!” Kyle replied.
“So why isn’t the person I’m looking for there?”
Connor looked at the file in his hands and asked, puzzled.
He really couldn’t understand. Since Kyle had already collected all the information about Hector Flynn, why wasn’t the man he saw last night on the list?
“Mr. McDonald, are you sure that the person’s real name is Hector Flynn?”
Kyle saw how puzzled Connor was and hesitated before asking softly.
“Uhm…”
Something flashed in Connor’s eyes.
He realized then that he had no way to confirm whether the person who hacked his account was called Hector Flynn. After all, he had never seen that man’s identity card.
“Mr. McDonald, I got this list from someone working at the National Registrar Department. It is unlikely that there has been a mistake. However, if that person’s name isn’t Hector Flynn or Hector Flynn is just an alias of his, then I have no way to investigate him!” Kyle looked at Connor and explained.
“This is challenging!”
Connor sighed softly.
“Mr. McDonald, do you know anything else about this person? For example, do you have a photo or a cell phone number?” Kyle asked.
“No…”
Connor shook his head.
“Then, it is indeed challenging!”
Kyle, too, felt a little helpless. He didn’t know how to find the person that Connor was looking for.
“What about this? I’ll find a way to take a photo of that person. I’ll send it to you after I’ve gotten hold of a photo of him!”
Connor knew that it would be impossible to find Hector with just a name.
Therefore, Connor could only wait for him to appear at the apartment again. Then, he would find an opportunity to take a photo of Hector for Kyle secretly.
“That’s all we can do now!”
Kyle nodded lightly.
“Alright, help me deal with Todd. I have something to do later!”
Connor pushed open the car door as he spoke and got out of the car.
After seeing Connor leave, Kyle took out his cell phone and called Peter Knowles.
“Ring, ring…”
After a few rings, Peter answered the call and said respectfully, “Kyle, what’s up?”
“Where’s your brother, Todd? Get him!”
Kyle said domineeringly. It was as if he was a completely different person.
Peter’s heart skipped a beat when he noticed something in Kyle’s tone that didn’t sound too friendly. He quickly handed the phone to Todd, who was standing beside him.
“Ky… Kyle? Do… Do you need something?” Todd stuttered after getting the phone.
“Have you troubled a female streamer named Mina?”
Kyle’s tone was cold as he questioned Todd.
“Mina?”
Todd was stunned when he heard the name.
“I’ll give you two hours to apologize to Mina. You’re not allowed to bother her in the future. Otherwise, you’ll have to bear the consequences. Do you understand?”
When Kyle heard Todd’s answer and tone, he could tell that Todd knew Mina, so he was direct with his order.
“O-okay, I got it!”
Todd answered with a trembling voice and then continued, “Kyle, do you know Mina?”
“Toot toot toot!”
Kyle ignored Todd and hung up before driving away.
Todd was dumbfounded when the call was cut.
He had sent people to investigate Mina and found out that she did not know anyone in Porthampton. That was why he had dared to make a move on her.
However, he could not understand how Mina would know an influential person like Kyle Hayes.
Meanwhile, after Connor and Kyle parted ways, he headed straight back to his apartment.
With Kyle’s help, Connor was able to find Knowles of Porthampton and help Mina solve a huge problem. However, he wasn’t able to find the real Hector Flynn.
Connor was still apprehensive about Mina’s safety. He was afraid that something might happen to her.
Buzz! Buzz! Buzz!
Just as Connor was about to reach home, his phone suddenly vibrated.
He thought that Kyle had found something, so he answered the phone without thinking.
“Hello, Mr. McDonald!”
Someone spoke from the other end of the call, but it was not Kyle’s voice. Instead, it was a sexy and seductive female voice.
Connor could tell that the person who called him was none other than the showroom manager who had made things difficult for him at the showroom, Chloe Lawson.
Chloe was sexy and charming. She also had a mature aura about her. She was a standard beautiful woman. Her voice carried the unique allure of a mature woman. Therefore, Connor could tell the moment he heard her voice.
“How did you get my number?”
Connor was stunned for a moment before he asked.
“I got your number from Lily Schmidt!” Chloe replied sweetly.
“I see. What’s the matter?”
Connor had provided his phone number before upon purchasing the property before, so it was not surprising that Chloe had his number.
“So, Mr. McDonald, I told you before that our company has started working on a new villa settlement. There’s a great unit, be it in terms of size and location. The price might be a little more expensive, but it shouldn’t be a problem for you. Do you have time in the afternoon? Shall I show you the unit?” Chloe said quickly.
Connor hesitated even though he didn’t have anything to do in the afternoon.
But he was worried about Mina’s safety, so he wasn’t in the mood to see any property now.
“Mr. McDonald, this villa is the best of our real estate. If you don’t hurry, someone else will likely buy it first!”
Chloe noticed Connor’s hesitance, so she tried to convince him.
“Okay then. I don’t have anything to do anyway, so I’ll go and take a look!”
Connor immediately agreed.
“Great. Where are you now, Mr. McDonald? I’ll go and pick you up!” Chloe said excitedly.
“I’m in Capstone district!”
Connor did not think much about Chloe’s offer to pick him up. So, he shared his location with Chloe without questioning it.
“Okay, I’ll go pick you up now!”
After Chloe responded, she hung up the phone.
Connor put his phone into his pocket and then stood at the entrance of the district, waiting for Chloe.
Suddenly, Connor noticed a familiar figure walking toward him..

chapters.title: Chapter 76 - 76: Mina Is Disappointed
chapters.content:
Chapter 76: Mina Is Disappointed
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Mina was wearing a low-cut halter dress, and she looked sexy.
Her legs were exposed, and she was wearing white yoga pants. She looked gorgeous.
She was carrying a few shopping bags. She looked like she had just returned from the supermarket.
Mina looked a little tired, possibly because of the heavy bags.
Connor hesitated for a moment, then hurriedly walked up to Mina and said with a smile, “Mina, let me help you with the bags!”
Mina turned and glared at him. She didn’t say anything and walked straight into the residential area. She didn’t want to pay Connor any attention.
Connor seemed a little awkward as he stood in place. He felt very uncomfortable.
After all, he had been silently protecting Mina, worrying about her.
However, Mina’s cold shoulder and disregard were what he got in return. That was hard to swallow.
Just as Mina was about to enter the residential area, the roar of an engine suddenly came from afar.
A black Honda Accord slowed to a stop arrogantly at the residential area entrance.
Then, Todd got out of the car, panicking.
When Connor saw Todd, he was instinctively surprised.
He had never expected that Kyle would act so fast on the matter.
It had only been less than half an hour, and he had already solved the problem? Connor panicked a little. If Todd saw him, he would take the initiative to talk to him.
If Mina were to see that, Connor’s identity might very well be exposed. Therefore, Connor was momentarily paralyzed, unsure about what to do! When Connor saw Todd appear at the residential area entrance, he was a little nervous.
Although Connor had previously told Mina that he was CeeM, Connor had only impulsively revealed his identity out of his concern for Mina’s safety.
However, Connor did not intend to reveal his identity back then. He did not want Mina to know what happened between him and Todd Knowles.
After getting out of the car, Todd walked straight into the residential area.
Perhaps because he was in a hurry, Todd did not notice Connor immediately. After hesitating, Connor hid behind a car.
“Mina!”
At that moment, Todd suddenly shouted.
When Mina heard someone calling her name, she was stunned before turning to look at Todd.
Mina did not know that Todd was Knowles of Porthampton, who had been making things difficult for her in Twitch. However, she knew Kenzo, who was following Todd.
When Mina saw Kenzo, a trace of panic flashed in her eyes. Then, she instinctively looked at Connor at the residential area entrance.
After all, Mina had just seen Connor standing there. She thought Connor wouldn’t leave so soon, so she hoped that he was still there to help her.
However, when Mina saw Connor behind the car, she was surprised. Then, disdain came over her expression.
She could see Connor hiding behind the car from where she was standing, while Todd and Kenzo could not see him.
“Yesterday, when Hector was beaten up, Connor hid in the living room without saying anything. Now that Kenzo is here looking for me, Connor is hiding again. I was blind back then to be friends with someone like Connor!”
Mina sighed disappointedly. Then, she turned around and walked toward Todd and the others.
“You’re Mina, right?”
Todd scanned Mina from head to toe and asked her gently.
“That’s right. I’m Mina. I thought about it last night. As long as you guys don’t cause trouble for my friends and me, 1 will sign a contract with Knowles of Porthampton on Twitch!”
Mina felt that she, a weak woman, was no match for these people, so she gave in weakly.
“Well, Mina, I think you might have misunderstood!” Todd looked at Mina and grinned, then continued, “I’m Knowles of Porthampton from Twitch!” “You’re Knowles of Porthampton?”
After hearing what Todd had to say, a hint of confusion flashed in Mina’s eyes.
“Yes, yes. I’m Knowles of Porthampton!”
Todd nodded lightly, looked at Mina, and continued, “Well, I feel that there might have been some misunderstanding between us. It was indeed a little rude of me to send someone to you earlier. For that, I apologize!”
After Todd said that, he bowed deeply to Mina.
Mina looked at Todd, surprised.
She really couldn’t understand why Todd, who had sent people to threaten her last night, was now acting like a different person. He had come to apologize to her!
After Kenzo and the others saw Todd apologize, they bowed and apologized to Mina.
“What’s this?”
Mina shouted in confusion.
“Miss Mina, we don’t mean to scare you. We just came here to apologize to you.
If you had said earlier that you knew Mr. Kyle Hayes, we wouldn’t have dared to make things difficult for you even if we were beaten to death!” Todd said with a smile.
“Mr. Kyle Hayes?”
Mina was utterly dumbfounded because she had no idea what Todd was talking about!
“Miss Mina, here’s 50,000 dollars. I heard that one of my men injured your friend yesterday. This is for the medical expenses. In the future, you can do whatever you want on Twitch. I won’t bother you anymore, and I won’t force you to sign a contract with me!”
Todd said as he handed 50,000 dollars to Mina.
Then, before Mina could react, Todd turned around and left with his men.
A moment later, the black Honda Accord disappeared from the residential area entrance.
Mina held the 50,000 dollars in her hand. She looked very confused.
“Is this Hector?”
Mina could not help but mutter softly after returning to her senses.
Not many people knew that Mina and Todd had a conflict. Only Connor and
Hector knew about it.
When Connor saw Todd and his men arriving, he immediately hid.
Mina felt that it was not Connor who helped her. If it were really Connor who helped her, he would have already stepped up and asked for praise!
So if it wasn’t Connor, then it should be Hector.
After all, when he left last night, Hector said he wanted to investigate who was threatening Mina.
Thinking of this, Mina felt warmth fill her heart, and her gratitude toward Hector grew even stronger.
She was initially hesitant about being Hector’s girlfriend, but now she knew her answer.
Hector was handsome, rich, and had a very good personality. Most importantly, he was able to stand up and protect her when the situation called for it. He was not a coward like Connor, who hid behind a car when he saw Todd and his men. Mina found it funny when she thought about it.
Earlier, Mina had a pretty good impression of Connor. Although he was a little poor, he was a good person.. But now, it was true that she should not judge a book by its cover!

chapters.title: Chapter 77 - 77: The Strength Of Oprana Dollars
chapters.content:
Chapter 77: The Strength Of Oprana Dollars
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Connor McDonald watched as Todd Knowles and the others left before he walked out from the back of the car.
Then, he smiled and said to Mina, “Those people were the ones who threatened you yesterday, right? Now that they’ve apologized to you, you shouldn’t be in any danger anymore!”
“What does it have to do with you whether I’m in danger?”
Mina sounded very cold as she replied.
When Connor noticed Mina’s tone when speaking to him, he was very puzzled. He thought that Mina should be in a good mood now!
“What were you doing hiding behind the car? Did you think that these people came to find trouble with me, so you were afraid of being implicated by me?”
Mina looked at him disdainfully and continued to speak.
It was only now that Connor realized that Mina had misunderstood him!
Connor hid behind the car because he was worried that Todd would expose his identity.
But to Mina, he was a coward who was afraid of being implicated.
“I didn’t mean to hide…”
Connor tried to explain.
But at this moment, a BMW mini suddenly stopped by the roadside.
“Bang!”
With a muffled sound, the door of the BMW mini opened.
The sexy and beautiful showroom manager, Chloe Lawson, got out of the
BMW. She scanned the surroundings. When she saw Connor, she walked toward him.
When Connor saw Chloe, he immediately frowned.
He had just avoided Todd, and now there was Chloe.
“Looks like there’s no way to hide this anymore!”
Connor knew that it would be too late even if he tried to hide his identity now.
As long as Chloe talked to him, Mina would notice that something was up. By then, Connor would not be able to hide his identity even if he wanted to.
At the entrance of the Capstone district.
After Chloe got out of the BMW, she walked right up to Connor.
Chloe was very attractive today. Her long, silky black hair, casually draped over her shoulders, reached her waist. Her figure was sexy, and her long legs were smooth and exquisite. It was almost impossible to look away from her.
Her perfect facial features were flawless even without any makeup. She was tall, voluptuous, and attractive. She wore a black professional outfit, which accentuated her almost perfect figure.
She already had had a mature aura, but she looked even more charming in this outfit.
Even her casual movements were seductive. It was hard not to look at her.
“Mr. McDonald!”
When Chloe was close enough, she waved at Connor enthusiastically.
When Mina heard how Chloe addressed Connor, confusion flashed in her eyes.
She couldn’t understand why a woman who got out of a BMW would address Connor so politely?
Connor looked at Chloe and smiled helplessly. He turned and whispered to
Mina, “My friend is here to pick me up. 1’11 leave for now!”
“Your friend?”
Mina looked at the sexy and charming woman, Chloe, and was even more confused.
Mina was a girl, too. She recognized that Chloe’s clothes and accessories were not cheap stuff. Perhaps a random earring of that woman’s was worth all of Connor’s clothes.
How could a poor boy like Connor know a woman like Chloe?
“Yes, my friend!”
Connor nodded slightly. He was not in the mood to continue chatting with
Mina. Instead, he walked right up to Chloe.
Mina was stunned. She looked at Connor with a puzzled expression. She really could not understand what was going on.
Connor walked to Chloe and whispered to her, “Let’s go!”
“Okay, Mr. McDonald!”
Chloe nodded, then turned to look at Mina, who was not far away, and asked
Connor softly, “Mr. McDonald, is that beautiful girl your girlfriend?”
“No…”
Connor shook his head.
“Ah, I see!”
Chloe nodded thoughtfully and then made a move that made Connor and Mina dumbfounded.
Chloe reached out and wrapped her arms around Connor’s arm intimately.
Connor was shocked by Chloe’s move. For a moment, he forgot to push Chloe away.
Chloe’s intention was apparent. She wanted Mina to see the intimacy between her and Connor so that Mina would think that they were a couple.
Mina only knew Connor as a poor kid. However, Chloe knew that Connor was one of the few rich kids in Porthampton.
As long as she could seize this opportunity, Chloe’s dream of marrying into a wealthy family would soon come true.
Chloe had been pursuing the dream of marrying into a wealthy family for so many years.
Even if she couldn’t marry Connor, she would still be happy to be his lover.
However, Chloe knew that many beautiful girls would surround a rich kid like Connor. These girls would think like her, and Mina must be one of them.
Therefore, Chloe did this to make Mina back off and eliminate a potential competitor.
She had no idea what Mina was thinking.
Meanwhile, when Mina saw how intimate Connor and Chloe were, a hint of surprise flashed in her eyes, followed by disgust.
“I didn’t expect Connor to be a rich woman’s sugar baby. How disgusting!”
Mina didn’t think that Connor and Chloe were a normal couple. Besides, Chloe looked almost thirty years old and was dressed very sexily and maturely. That was why Mina thought that Connor was her sugar baby.
To Mina, a man who was a sugar baby was not good.
So after Mina cursed in a low voice, she turned around and walked back to the residential area.
Meanwhile, Connor didn’t know what Mina had thought about him. Chloe dragged him into the BMW.
After getting into the car, Chloe let go of Connor’s arm and got into the driver’s seat to start the car.
After the car started, Chloe held the steering wheel with one hand and drew circles on her creamy thigh with the other hand. She would wink at Connor, who was sitting in the passenger seat, from time to time.
“Mr. McDonald, I think you look very handsome today!”
Chloe licked her lips and said to him in a very seductive tone.
“That’s not what you said the last time!”
Connor was speechless.
Chloe treated him like a broke delivery boy when she first met Connor. She didn’t even want to talk to him.
But now, Chloe had taken the initiative to hold his arm and wink at him while driving.
Oprana dollars were mighty indeed. So powerful that it could instantly change a person’s view of someone.
Chloe was very sexy and charming, her body covered in a seductive aura.
However, Connor had no interest in such a woman because he felt that the reason Chloe treated him this way was because of his money.
“Hmm, didn’t she mistake me the last time?”
Chloe sighed at Connor and then stretched her sexy legs that were exposed under her short skirt. Her posture was very seductive..

chapters.title: Chapter 78 - 78: I’ll Buy It For You Now
chapters.content:
Chapter 78: I’ll Buy It For You Now
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
When Connor saw Chloe’s beautiful legs, he couldn’t help but gulp.
Then, he said, “You’d better drive safe. I don’t want to die on the road!”
“Okay!”
Seeing that Connor was indifferent to her seduction, Chloe could only respond that way and then start the car.
Half an hour later, Chloe parked the car in front of a showroom.
“Mr. McDonald, we’re here!” Chloe said to Connor softly.
“Okay!”
Connor nodded and pushed the door open.
When Connor was about to get out of the car, he suddenly saw a very familiar figure walking out of the showroom.
“Why is she here?”
Connor couldn’t help but mutter softly.
When Chloe heard that, she quickly turned to look at the showroom entrance. She saw a pretty woman in a black skirt with a perky butt walking out of the showroom in high heels.
That woman was none other than Connor’s fiancee, Freya Phillips!
“Mr. McDonald, do you know her?”
Chloe noticed Connor acting a little weird after seeing Freya. He didn’t move from where he was standing. So, Chloe couldn’t help but ask in a low voice.
“Yes, please wait for me in the showroom. I’ll go in and look for you in a moment!”
Connor replied expressionlessly.
Connor was not worried about exposing his identity to Mina, but he was more concerned about exposing his identity to Freya.
The inheritance agreement had a clear stipulation – Connor could not reveal his identity before marrying Freya.
Connor willingly hid his identity from others to keep a low profile and prevent others from ruining his life.
If everyone knew that he had inherited ten trillion dollars, he wouldn’t be able to live a normal life anymore. Many people would come looking for him.
However, he hid his identity from Freya because he was forced to. It was his grandfather’s cousin’s fault for making such a deceitful will. He could only choose to accept it.
After hearing what Connor said, Chloe hesitated, but she walked into the showroom in the end.
Meanwhile, Connor approached Freya. Freya wore a tight-fitting T-shirt that perfectly accentuated the curves of her body. Her slender waist was seductive.
She wore a short black skirt that was wrapped tightly around her buttocks. The skirt was very short and only covered her sexy buttocks. Her beautiful jade-like feet sported a pair of black high heels. She was a sight for sore eyes.
During his three years of studying at Porthampton University, Connor had seen many beautiful women, but he felt that no woman could compare to Freya Phillips.
Freya was the best of the best, both in temperament and appearance.
This amazing woman was his fiancee. This was probably the ultimate dream of most men.
Unfortunately, she was just his fiancee in the name. Connor couldn’t have anything with her at all!
Connor knew that if he wanted to marry Freya, she would never fall in love with him unless he told her his real identity.
“Sigh!”
Connor sighed softly, then walked up to Freya and said with a smile, “What a coincidence to meet you here!”
“Connor?”
Freya, who was frowning, was shocked when she saw Connor.
“Why are you here?”
Freya looked at Connor and asked.
“I…”
Connor was about to say something when a phone rang.
“Give me a moment! I need to take this call…”
Freya quickly took out her phone from her bag and answered the call.
“Freya, how’s the villa your dad asked you to look at today?” A middle-aged woman’s voice came from the other end of the phone.
“Mom, I’m at the showroom now. I’ve seen the unit just now. The location is pretty good, and it’s very close to the office. The surrounding facilities are excellent. The neighborhood’s environment is great, too!” Freya replied sweetly.
“If you think it’s good, then hurry up and buy it. Hasn’t your dad been getting you to buy a villa recently?” Mrs. Phillips said slowly.
Freya subconsciously glanced at Connor, then she said with a slightly helpless tone, “Mom, that villa is indeed great, but it is a little expensive. The villa that I like is priced at over fifty million dollars. Dad’s company has just recovered from a turbulent period. If we spent so much money at once, I’m afraid we won’t have that much money should dad’s company face any difficulties again!”
“I see!”
Mrs. Phillips responded and then continued, “Alright then. I’ll discuss it with your dad when you get back. If it doesn’t work out, we’ll take out a loan!” “Okay!”
Freya nodded and ended the call.
“Are you going to buy a villa here?”
Connor saw Freya had ended the call, so he asked with a smile.
“Yes!”
Freya nodded and continued, “My dad’s company’s office has just moved. The villa here is closer to my dad’s office, so my parents plan to get a new place for me!”
“Oh!”
Connor nodded and didn’t say anything else.
“What are you doing here? Are you working part-time here?”
Freya scanned Connor up and down. She thought that Connor was not here to buy a property.
After all, all the properties here were villas. The most affordable villa was at least thirty million dollars.
Even someone as wealthy as Freya could not buy one at a lump sum, let alone a loser like Connor.
“I’m also here to look at some properties!”
Connor replied indifferently.
“You’re here to look at the properties?”
Freya could not help but feel stunned. Then, she pouted and said, “Do you know how much the properties here cost? Can you afford one?”
“Even if I can’t afford one, can’t I look at them?”
Connor said playfully.
Freya was rendered speechless. She could not understand why her father would arrange for such a strange fiance for her.
Not that Freya would agree to be with him if he was a little more normal anyway.
However, Freya felt that Connor was a little not right in his mind. She did not even know what he was thinking. Naturally, Freya would not agree to marry him.
“Oh right, I heard you on the phone just now. You have your eyes on a villa, but you can’t afford it because you lack some money, right?” Connor looked at Freya and asked.
“Why? Are you going to lend me money?”
Freya asked, annoyed.
“You’re my fiancee, so you shouldn’t be talking about borrowing money from me. Shall I just buy that villa and give it to you as a gift?” Connor suggested with a smile.
“Okay, if you can buy this villa and give it to me, 1 won’t just pretend to be with you anymore. I’ll marry you right away. I’ll do whatever you want me to do!”
Freya knew that Connor was just bragging to her. How could he afford that villa?
After all, she had to pay his allowance every month.
How could he have so much money to buy a villa worth fifty million dollars?
“Are you serious?”
Connor asked immediately.
“Of course!”
Freya nodded with a faint smile. She felt that it was impossible that Connor had the money to buy a villa here.
“Wait here for a moment!”
Connor replied indifferently, then turned around and walked into the showroom..

chapters.title: Chapter 79 - 79: Two Materialistic Women
chapters.content:
Chapter 79: Two Materialistic Women
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Freya looked at Connor as he left, and a strange look appeared on her face.
Earlier, when Connor turned around…
Freya suddenly felt that Connor was not joking with her.
“Connor, wait a minute!”
Freya hesitated and suddenly shouted.
“Yes?”
Connor turned to look at Freya as he asked softly.
“What’s your bank account number? I asked Maya to send you the allowance the last time, but you didn’t accept it. I’ll transfer that to you directly!” Freya said softly.
“Oh, Hl share my bank account number on Facebook later!”
Connor replied indifferently and continued into the showroom.
A few minutes later, Freya received a message from Connor.
When Freya saw the Facebook message from Connor, a hint of helplessness flashed in her eyes.
Then, she shook her head with a bitter smile and said, “A man who gets a 20,000 dollars allowance from me every month is claiming that he is buying a villa for me. What a joke!”
Connor was not joking when he said he wanted to buy a villa for Freya. After all, Freya was his fiancee to a certain extent.
Even if they hadn’t had a relationship yet, Connor felt that Freya was a pretty good woman. She wasn’t a bad person in nature.
Moreover, if she hadn’t agreed to marry him, Connor wouldn’t have been able to inherit the money so smoothly.
That was why Connor considered buying a villa for her.
However, Connor was thinking about how he should gift the villa to Freya so that he wouldn’t expose his identity.
With these doubts in mind, he walked into the showroom.
When Connor walked into the showroom, he was utterly shocked by the luxury inside.
As expected of a place that sold villas, the entire showroom looked much more upscale than the one that Connor went to before.
In addition, the sales ladies here were all more beautiful than in the previous one, and they were also hotter than the previous ones. However, there was still a big difference between them and Chloe Lawson.
“Mr. McDonald, you’re finally here!”
When Chloe saw Connor, she ran to him and called out coquettishly.
“I bumped into a friend earlier. We had a casual chat!”
Connor looked at Chloe and explained.
“It’s okay. Let me give you a brief introduction to the villa we are showing!”
Chloe held Connor’s arm and walked to the sand table. Then, she presented the villa to Connor in a seductive voice.
When the other sales ladies in the showroom saw how intimate Chloe and Connor were, they were all shocked and looked at Chloe with complicated expressions.
“Chloe said she would bring a rich kid in to buy a villa today. Could this be him?”
“How is that possible? This guy looks like a loser. How could he have the money to buy a villa?”
“That’s right. This guy looks poor. Look at the clothes he is wearing. They are all cheap brands!”
“But if he is poor, why would Chloe treat him like that? It doesn’t make sense!”
The sales ladies started to discuss in low voices. Their eyes were filled with disbelief.
But even so, they looked at Connor with disdain. They simply could not believe that Connor could afford the villa in the showroom.
“Mr. McDonald, the villas here are all tastefully decorated. You can move in immediately once you pay. What do you think?”
Chloe briefly presented the surrounding environment of the villa, then asked Connor expectantly.
“It’s not bad.”
Connor replied indifferently, then she looked at Chloe and said, “Earlier, a very beautiful girl in a tight short skirt came to the showroom to see some properties. Help me ask your colleagues which villa she had her eyes on!”
When Chloe heard that, she could not help but be stunned. Then, she recalled that she and Connor had met Freya at the showroom entrance.
“Mr. McDonald, 1’11 help you find my colleague who served your friend before. You can ask her anything then.”
Chloe said softly.
“Okay!”
Connor nodded and walked to the sitting area. He sat on the sofa and started to play with his phone.
Meanwhile, Chloe walked to the front desk. She asked the receptionist softly, “Fiona, can you please do me a favor and check who served the lady in the tight short skirt earlier?”
The receptionist quickly looked at the record on the computer and said softly, “Ms. Patel served her!”
“Ms. Patel?”
When Chloe heard that name, she couldn’t help but be stunned, and a trace of helplessness flashed in her eyes.
Chloe had worked in Evergrande Real Estate for a few years. She generally got along well with other colleagues, but not Ms. Patel.
Ms. Patel’s name was Yvonne Patel, and she was Chloe’s university classmate. They hadn’t had a great relationship since then.
After they graduated from university, the two had joined Evergrande Real Estate at the same time. When they first joined the company, their relationship was pretty good.
However, because Yvonne often played tricks behind the scenes and stole clients from Chloe, the conflict between the two drew a gulf between them.
Moreover, just last year, Chloe and Yvonne competed for the sales manager position.
However, because Yvonne’s boyfriend was related to the company’s boss, Yvonne became the sales manager of the luxury properties showroom via connections. Meanwhile, Chloe was assigned to be the showroom sales manager in an ordinary residential area.
Although both of them were managers, Chloe, as a manager, could not be compared with Yvonne at all. Their salaries were vastly different.
Chloe was obviously more capable than Yvonne. Other than sleeping with men, Yvonne was useless.
Therefore, this incident made Chloe realize that sometimes, it was more important for a woman to find the right man than anything else.
Both Chloe and Yvonne were very materialistic women. They would do anything to earn money.
However, the way the two did things was completely different. Yvonne had no bottom line when it came to selling properties. She often slept with clients or higher-ups.
Even though Chloe also loved money, she had always held onto her principles.
Unless it was someone like Connor, a rich kid who could make Chloe willingly give up her body. No ordinary man could convince Chloe otherwise.
“Ms. Lawson, do you want me to call Ms. Patel now?”
The pretty receptionist at the front desk asked Chloe softly.
“Yes, go and get her!”
Chloe hesitated before nodding.
She wanted to take advantage of Connor’s presence today to suppress Yvonne’s arrogance.
The receptionist then quickly walked into the showroom..

chapters.title: Chapter 80 I’ll Buy This Villa
chapters.content:
80  I’ll Buy This Villa
After a short while, the beautiful woman at the reception walked out with a seductive woman.
"Ah, I thought someone else was looking for me. It's just you, Chloe!"
When Yvonne saw Chloe, she greeted her warmly.
"Yvonne, my client has something to ask you!"
Chloe was not in the mood to argue with Yvonne today, so she went straight to the point.
"Your client?"
When Yvonne heard that, she was stunned,. Then, she said breezily, "Where is your client?"
"Mr. McDonald is waiting over there!"
Chloe walked toward Connor as she spoke.
Although Yvonne had never been on good terms with Chloe, she knew Chloe's capabilities very well.
She knew that Chloe would never personally receive an ordinary client. The client she would personally receive was someone who could afford a villa.
A moment later, Chloe went up to Connor. She then respectfully said, "Mr. McDonald, I've already found the person who served your friend earlier. If there's anything you need, ask her!"
When Yvonne saw Chloe talking to Connor Feng so respectfully, she was utterly stunned. She was in disbelief.
She did not expect that Chloe's client was this poor loser dressed in shabby clothes.
If Chloe hadn't taken the initiative to talk to Connor earlier, Yvonne wouldn't have even looked at Connor. She wouldn't even think that Connor could afford a villa here.
"Chloe, is this the client you're talking about?"
Yvonne took a step forward and asked Chloe with a puzzled expression.
"Yes, this is Mr. McDonald. Do you have any questions?" Chloe said lightly.
"Chloe Lawson, have you been deceived by this kid? This kid is dressed so shabbily. How could he have the money to afford a villa here?" Yvonne said with disdain.
"Mr. McDonald bought a villa at my showroom and gifted it to someone else. Do you think a tycoon like him can't afford a villa here?"
Chloe replied arrogantly as if Connor had given the villa to her.
After hearing what Chloe said, the sales ladies in the showroom, who initially looked down on Connor, looked at him with sparkling eyes as if they would eat Connor.
Yvonne could not help but look at Connor again and sighed. "I didn't expect rich kids to be so low-key nowadays. They are now going out dressed like this?"
"Earlier, a girl in a tight short dress browsing in your showroom. Do you still remember which villa she looked at?" Connor was not in the mood to pay attention to the shocked gazes of the crowd. He took a step forward and asked Yvonne directly.
"Yes, she was looking at villa number eight!" Yvonne was stunned before replying politely.
"I'll buy it!"
Connor did not ask how much the villa was and how big the area was. He said it so casually as if he was buying a bunch of vegetables at the market.
When Yvonne heard what Connor said, she was instantly shocked.
When the sales ladies in the showroom heard Connor, they gaped, unable to say a word.
Those who came to the showroom to buy a villa were usually the upper class of Porthampton, and the sales ladies had seen many wealthy people.
However, they had never seen a wealthy person as straightforward as Connor. He did not even ask how much the villa cost and if there were any discounts or other information.
He went directly to the point and decided to buy the villa. It was very domineering.
Among all the beautiful women present, only Chloe was not shocked. After all, only she knew what kind of person Connor was.
"Uhm... Sir, are you sure you want us to buy villa number eight? Don't you need to think about it?"
Yvonne was still shocked by Connor's decisiveness. She stammered as she asked Connor.
It was every salesperson's dream to meet such a straightforward customer.
However, this customer was standing right in front of Yvonne right now. She found it hard to accept it for a moment.
"Isn't it just a villa? What's there to consider?"
Connor looked at Yvonne indifferently and said calmly, sounding surreal to her.
"No, sir. I mean, do you know the price of this villa? Or do you want to place a deposit on it for now..."
Yvonne looked at Connor and asked nervously.
"Yvonne, what do you mean by that? Are you worried that Mr. McDonald doesn't have the money to buy this villa?"
Chloe looked at Yvonne and said with disdain.
Then, she continued, "A few days ago, Mr. McDonald bought a villa in my showroom. Back then, he didn't ask for the exact price of the villa either. Mr. McDonald is no ordinary rich man. The cost of this villa is nothing in his eyes..."
"But..."
Yvonne wanted to continue speaking. After all, she still felt that Connor's straightforwardness in purchasing this villa was a little unreal.
"There are no buts. Since Mr. McDonald has already said that he wants to buy this villa, he will buy it. Why are you still standing there in a daze? Hurry up and get the contract for Mr. McDonald!"
At this moment, Chloe was in high spirits. Her eyes bulged as she shouted Yvonne.
If Connor really bought this villa, Chloe would be able to get most of the commission.
