The elegant pavilions added a bit of beauty to this villa.
Connor smelled the light scent of lotus flowers. He saw a pool with a few pink lotus flowers floating on it, following the scent. They emitted a very pleasing light fragrance!
“Heaven on earth indeed!” this thought suddenly crossed Connor’s mind.
Building the villa in the middle of a royal garden-like layout made this villa f*cking top-class!
‘It’s so beautiful! The air seems much fresher here.’ Natasha sighed internally.
She felt as if she had walked into a natural oxygen bar. Outside were tall buildings and skyscrapers, but there was only a small bridge and flowing water here. It was very relaxing.
Sean pointed at the pebbles in the pool and said, “Mr. McDonald, the pool under your feet isn’t just ordinary. The pebbles in it were all flown in from Italy. After being thoroughly polished and meticulously carved by a craftsman, every pebble in this pool is unique.”
As they spoke, they had already walked through the entire garden and arrived at the back of the villa. Connor saw a pool of nearly 200 square meters.
The pool was turquoise. Looking at it, one could not help but feel tempted to jump into it for a swim.
Following that, Sean led everyone to the villa entrance. He tapped the password on the door and led everyone into the villa.
A spiral-shaped glass staircase immediately came into view as soon as they entered. There was also a private elevator next to it that led to the top floor.
The villa was divided into five floors. The fourth and fifth floors were entertainment rooms like the cinema, the gym, a mini karaoke room, game rooms, and all kinds of entertainment facilities imaginable.
The second and third floors were bedrooms. Each bedroom was exquisitely decorated with different themes such as Nordic, Baroque, Gothic, and so on.
The first floor was the hall, kitchen, and study.
Although it was just a building, the interior design was extremely luxurious and classy.
“Mr. McDonald, I still have something to do. Please excuse me!”
Sean still had to report to the headquarters that he had sold the Mansion. He also needed to contact Freya Phillips to come over and sign the contract, so he thought of taking his leave first.
“Okay, go ahead!”
Connor looked at Sean and nodded.
After seeing Sean leave, Kyle and Michael left, too.
After all, the two were not very interested in these things. They were happy just to take a house tour to see what it was like inside.
Only Connor, Natasha, and Chloe were left in the villa..

chapters.title: Chapter 93 - 93: Natasha’s Forced Kiss
chapters.content:
Chapter 93: Natasha’s Forced Kiss
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Connor turned to look at Natasha, who was looking around, and said softly, “Natasha, come in with me for a moment. I have something to tell you!”
When Natasha heard that, she blushed, but she nodded at Connor.
At this moment, Chloe’s face was flushed red with anger, and she was very unhappy.
She had finally brought Connor to the villa, and before she could do anything, she was intercepted by Natasha, this little sc*mbag?
“Mr. McDonald, what is it that you can’t say in front of me?”
Chloe asked Connor with jealousy.
“What does what I say to Mr. McDonald have anything to do with you?”
Natasha looked at Chloe and replied provocatively. Then, she followed Connor to the second floor.
When they reached the second floor of the villa, Connor casually opened a bedroom door and walked in with Natasha.
After entering the room, Connor was shocked by the scene inside.
The room was romantically decorated. With a large red round bed, coupled with the soft lighting and some whips and other items, it was not difficult to guess that this was a room specially prepared for couples.
Connor really could not understand why there was such a room in such a high-end villa.
After Natasha saw the room, her face immediately flushed red, and her breathing hastened.
She had never thought that Connor would be so impatient to sleep with her that he brought her to such a room in broad daylight.
Natasha really wanted to be the hostess of this villa, and her impression of Connor was quite positive.
However, Chloe was still downstairs, so Natasha suddenly became nervous. She quickly clenched her jaw, and determination flashed in her eyes. She had already given up a chance yesterday.
Today, she would not miss this opportunity again.
Therefore, after entering the room, Natasha gently locked the door behind her.
Then, she slowly approached Connor. With a seductive expression, she asked, “Mr. McDonald, why did you ask me to come in here?”
“Natasha, I…”
Connor was about to speak.
However, he suddenly smelled a burst of fragrance. Natasha had wrapped her arms around Connor’s neck. Her beautiful face was right in front of Connor, and she kissed him.
“Mmph!”
Before Connor could react, Natasha forcefully kissed him!
Although Connor and Mandy had been together for two years, they were not very involved.
Connor did not even think about such an intimate kiss.
However, he did not expect his first kiss to be snatched away by someone like this.
Natasha’s lips were very soft and sweet. It was very pleasant.
Connor, who had never kissed a girl before, hugged the soft body tightly. He did not even want to let go.
However, he felt it was a little insulting for a man to be forcefully kissed by a woman.
Therefore, after hesitating, he quickly reached out and pushed Natasha away.
Natasha was stunned for a moment. Then, she shyly asked, “Connor, what’s wrong? Did 1 move a little too quickly? It’s… It’s my first time kissing someone, so I’m not too familiar… I’m sorry…”
Natasha did not lie. She was very beautiful and had a good figure, she had had many suitors since she was young.
However, she had been pampered since she was young. Coupled with Yvonne’s influence, Natasha was not interested in those ordinary boys at school.
She had very high expectations of her boyfriend. Be it the body figure, appearance, or family influence, she had very strict requirements.
However, the financial resources that Connor showed he had today clearly met her requirements. That was why she had taken the initiative to kiss Connor. Connor was at a loss after hearing what she said. After hesitating, he asked, “Why did you kiss me?”
H H
Natasha was stunned. Then, she whispered, “Connor, didn’t you bring me into this room to ask me to be your girlfriend and do that kind of thing with you?” “When did I say that 1 want you to be my girlfriend?”
When Connor heard that, he became even more speechless.
“If you don’t want me to be your girlfriend, why did you add me on Facebook? Moreover, didn’t we have a good chat in Dusk last night?”
A trace of doubt flashed in Natasha’s eyes, then she continued, “Although we might have had a little misunderstanding yesterday, these misunderstandings have been cleared out now. I… I have a pretty good impression of you. I’m willing to be your girlfriend…”
“Ohhh girl, you misunderstood me. I didn’t mean it like that!”
Connor replied helplessly. Then, he continued, “I did enjoy chatting with you yesterday. I wanted to add you on Facebook because I really wanted to continue seeing you. However, after that incident last night, I feel that we aren’t compatible. You are not the type of girlfriend I want either!”
Natasha felt as if she was struck by lightning. She had always been proud and arrogant since she was young. Many boys had pursued her, but she had rejected them all.
Natasha felt that they weren’t good enough for her.
But now, Natasha was finally willing to put herself out there and pursue a guy, but that guy thought they weren’t compatible?
Natasha could not accept that.
“Connor, am I not beautiful enough? Is my body not sexy enough? Do you know how many boys are pursuing me? Why don’t you like me?”
Natasha stared at Connor and shouted at him emotionally.
“You are very beautiful and are sexy, but you want to be with me not because you like me, but because you like my money. I will not be with a gold-digger like you!” Connor replied nonchalantly.
“Since you don’t want to be with me, then why did you ask me to add you on Facebook? Why did you bring me to this room alone?”
Natasha glared at Connor and asked.
“I brought you here just to tell you not to tell others about my identity. I didn’t mean anything else!” Connor said slowly.
“So when you added me on Facebook and asked me to promise you something, you didn’t mean for me to sleep with you but to promise you that I won’t expose your identity. Is that it?”
Natasha finally came to a realization. Tears started to well up in her eyes as she whispered to Connor.
“That’s right!”
Connor nodded..

chapters.title: Chapter 94 - 94: Too Many Temptations
chapters.content:
Chapter 94: Too Many Temptations
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Natasha looked at Connor with a pitiful look.
“If I didn’t laugh at you with Mandy and the others last night, and if I didn’t expose your identity in front of so many people today, would you have considered being with me?” Natasha was silent before she clenched her jaw and asked.
“Maybe,” Connor replied indifferently.
As a girl, Natasha was the cream of the crop in terms of both her figure and appearance.
Moreover, she wasn’t as snobbish as Mandy Hines and May Young. Connor had felt this when they were at the nightclub last night.
However, Natasha couldn’t accept that Connor was a delivery boy because she felt that if Connor were really one, she would lose her reputation if she were to be with Connor.
Therefore, Connor felt that if yesterday’s incident had not happened, he might not have rejected the idea of being with Natasha!
“That means that your impression of me is pretty good, right?”
Natasha said agitatedly.
Connor was stunned because he did not know how to answer that.
“You have a good impression of me. That means I still have a chance. 1 will not give up. Sooner or later, 1 will make you fall for me!” Natasha shouted at Connor, determined.
“What you want to do is none of my business. I only have one request, and that is not to expose my identity. If Cindy and the others find out about my identity, 1 will definitely not let you go!”
Connor did not want to continue this conversation with Natasha. He spoke coldly, then turned around and walked out of the room.
“Connor, 1 will not give up easily. Sooner or later, 1 will get you!”
Natasha watched and swore to herself as Connor left.
As for Connor being worried that Natasha would expose his identity, he was only overthinking.
This was because Natasha had no such intention. After all, the more people knew Connor’s identity, the more girls would want to seduce him. Natasha’s competitors would also increase then.
She was not stupid enough to reveal Connor’s identity.
On the other side, after seeing Connor leave the room, Chloe immediately heaved a sigh of relief.
Nothing could have happened between Connor and Natasha in the room in such a short time.
Judging from the situation, he didn’t seem to have slept with Natasha. Otherwise, the two would definitely have walked out hand in hand.
“Mr. McDonald, you’re out!”
Chloe walked gracefully up to Connor. She then casually held Connor’s arm.
Connor looked at Chloe impatiently.
Natasha had just kissed him in the room, and now there was Chloe. It seemed that being rich was not necessarily a good thing. There were too many temptations.
“Let’s go!”
Connor said to Chloe.
“Okay, Mr. McDonald. It’s getting late. Why don’t we go have a meal to celebrate the villa you just bought?” Chloe said to Connor with a smile.
H ti
When Connor heard that, he couldn’t help but be stunned. Then, he said, “Okay, 1 happen to be a little hungry too!”
“So, let’s go now!”
Chloe’s face immediately lit up with joy upon Connor’s agreement. She hurriedly dragged Connor out of the villa and left Natasha alone in the villa.
When Natasha walked out of the bedroom, Connor and Chloe had already left.
Chloe drove the car with Connor to the restaurant.
Ten minutes later, when the car passed by a luxury goods store, Connor was surprised.
A large group of people surrounded the entrance of the store. In the middle of the crowd, a handsome young man in a suit was holding a bouquet of roses and kneeling on one knee before a beautiful girl. It seemed that he was confessing his love to this girl.
And this girl was none other than Mina!
The one kneeling before Mina was Hector, who had hacked Connor’s account.
Connor sat in the car and stared at Hector, kneeling on one knee before Mina. He felt very uncomfortable, and even his breathing became hectic.
“Mr. McDonald, are you okay?”
Chloe noticed something wrong with Connor and asked, “Are you okay?
“I’m fine…”
Connor shook his head gently.
He thought of Mina’s attitude toward him these past few days and what Mina had said to him, and he felt a chill in his heart.
So Connor secretly swore that no matter what happened to Mina in the future, he would not be bothered anymore.
In any case, he and Mina were just ordinary housemates. Even if Mina was deceived by Hector, it would not affect him.
However, just as Chloe was about to drive past the store, Connor could not help but ask her to stop the car.
Chloe quickly stepped on the brake and turned to look at Connor. She asked with a puzzled expression, “Mr. McDonald, is there something you need?”
“Yes, I’ll go and take care of it. 1’11 be right back!”
Connor replied in a low voice. Then, he pushed open the car door and walked toward Mina and Hector.
Chloe hesitated for a moment, then followed him.
At the entrance of the luxury goods shop.
Hector held a bouquet of ninety-nine roses and kneeled on one knee.
Mina looked at Hector with a face full of shock because she had never thought that Hector would confess to her here.
“Mina, I’ve liked you since the first day I met you. 1 swear that 1’11 treat you well as long as you’re with me. I beg you, don’t reject me. Stay with me!”
Hector said to Mina sincerely.
At this moment, Mina seemed conflicted because she didn’t know if she liked Hector or not, and she didn’t know if she should agree to his confession.
After all, Hector had helped her in her live stream back then, and after that, Hector had helped solve her issue with Todd Knowles.
So, Mina had a bit of a good impression of Hector, but she didn’t know if what she felt was love or simply an infatuation!
“Mina, 1 know that you’re feeling very conflicted right now. We have only known each other for a relatively short period of time. Perhaps you don’t know me well enough, but 1 really like you. As long as you give me a chance, we could start dating and get to know each other simultaneously!”
Hector was very well-prepared this time. After seeing that Mina was beginning to hesitate, he continued emotionally.
“Hector, I…”
Mina hesitated, not knowing how to answer Hector.
“Say yes!”
“Say yes!”
At this moment, two young men suddenly walked out of the door of the luxury goods store and took the lead to shout.
The onlookers were encouraged and started to shout at the top of their lungs, making the atmosphere very lively.
Mina seemed to be influenced by that, so she was ready to agree to Hector’s suggestion of dating and getting to know each other.
“Hector, ye…”
Mina hesitated and wanted to say ‘yes’.
However, before she could say the last word…
Someone rushed in front of her and snatched the bouquet from Hector’s hand..

chapters.title: Chapter 95 - 95: You Can’t Be With Him
chapters.content:
Chapter 95: You Can’t Be With Him
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
At the store entrance, a not-so-tall figure rushed over and snatched the rose bouquet from Hector’s hand.
When the crowd saw this person, they were all stunned, their faces full of confusion.
At this moment, Hector, who was kneeling, seemed sullen.
Mina subconsciously glanced at the person standing before her, then she shouted in surprise, “Connor, why are you here?”
“You can’t be with him!”
Connor said to Mina expressionlessly.
“Connor, what does this have to do with you? What’s it to you if I agreed to be with Hector or not?”
After Mina came to her senses, she shouted at Connor emotionally.
“I don’t care if you want to be with other people, but you absolutely can’t be with this person. He’s a liar!”
Connor growled.
“No, bro, what do you mean by that?”
Hector slowly stood up and asked Connor provocatively.
Connor turned and glanced at Hector. He didn’t say anything. Instead, he grabbed Mina’s hand, wanting to leave this place.
“Connor, why are you doing this? Let me go now. I’m warning you. If you continue to be so unreasonable, 1’11 be furious! Moreover, we are just ordinary friends. Whether I agree to be with Hector has nothing to do with you…”
Mina struggled with all her might and shouted at Connor agitatedly.
Noticing Mina overreacting, Connor finally let go of her after hesitating.
“You can’t be with this person!”
Connor looked at Mina and said.
“Bro, what’s wrong with you? What’s that gotta do with you? Are you here looking for trouble with me?”
Hector was about to confess his feelings, but he didn’t expect to be interrupted by Connor.
Hector was distraught, but he didn’t show it because Mina was still there.
“Are you crazy? What does it have to do with you?”
“That’s right. Why did you come to cause trouble? Hurry up and get lost!”
“That’s because that young man has a good temper. I would have already gone up and beat him up if it were me. He confessed his love, and you came out to cause trouble. Who do you think you are!”
The surrounding crowd criticized Connor.
“D*mn, isn’t that the delivery guy from Porthampton University? What is this poor loser doing here?”
At this moment, a student from Porthampton University recognized Connor and shouted with disdain.
“Yeah, I know him! He is the delivery boy from Porthampton University. He must have seen his goddess being asked out and felt uncomfortable, so he came out to cause trouble!”
“This is so funny. Look at yourself. This girl is so beautiful and hot. How could she like him? A toad wants to kiss a princess!”
“Is there something wrong with this guy’s brain? Even if the girl isn’t with this handsome guy, she wouldn’t be with a poor guy like him!”
“I heard that his ex-girlfriend cheated on him. Maybe there’s something wrong with his mind!”
After recognizing Connor, a few students from Porthampton University started to ridicule him.
The surrounding spectators also shouted for Connor to get lost!
For a moment, Connor seemed to have become a street rat. Everyone hated Connor very much.
“Kiddo, did you hear that?”
“I advise you to get lost quickly, or I won’t be nice to you!”
Hector stepped forward and pointed at Connor as he scolded.
“Being rude to me?”
After Connor heard that, he couldn’t help but sneer. He hadn’t been rude to Hector, yet Hector was rude to him.
Connor had initially planned to wait for Mina to leave before dealing with this Hector.
After all, in Connor’s eyes, Mina was just an innocent victim. There was no need for her to get hurt.
However, he did not expect Hector to be so eager to confess to Mina now.
If this continued, Mina would go to a hotel to sleep with him after. By then, it would be too late.
Therefore, Connor quickly took out his cell phone and was ready to call Kyle to ask him to come and deal with this matter.
“Connor, leave now. My life has nothing to do with you. Whether I want to be with Hector is not up to you to decide!”
At this moment, Mina suddenly shouted at Connor coldly.
Connor could not help but be stunned when he heard this. Then, he raised his head and glanced at Mina.
“Kiddo, if you don’t get lost now, I will not be nice anymore!”
When Hector saw that Connor did not seem to have any intention of leaving, he gritted his teeth and shouted at Connor.
“Click click click…”
Before Connor could speak, he suddenly heard the sound of high heels clicking upon the ground from behind him.
Chloe’s hip swayed as she walked right up to Connor. Then, she pointed at Hector and shouted, “Hey, how can you talk to Mr. McDonald like this?”
“Mr. McDonald, what kind of Mr. McDonald is he? Isn’t he just a broke delivery boy? A few days ago, he was cheated on by his ex-girlfriend. Moreover, he was the one who delivered food to the hotel. He just happened to see his ex-girlfriend and the rich kid in bed. Only then did he know that he was cheated on. Who at Porthampton University doesn’t know about this? How can such a person be addressed with such politeness?”
Hector asked disdainfully.
When he saw Connor at Mina’s apartment before, he had sent people to investigate Connor.
At first, Hector thought that Connor was his competitor, but he did not expect Connor to be a loser delivery guy, so he was relieved.
“Hahahaha…”
When the onlookers heard Hector’s explanation, they laughed and looked at Connor with disdain.
At this moment, Connor was no different from a green-furred turtle to the crowd.
Mina’s expression had turned ugly. She didn’t expect Hector to say such things in front of many people.
Although Mina didn’t know why Connor had to stop her from being together with Hector, she felt that Connor was still her friend no matter what. There was no need to use such harsh words.
When Chloe saw Hector insulting Connor, she couldn’t help but feel shocked. Then, she raised her hand and slapped Hector.
“Slap!”
It was a loud slap!
Everyone present was instantly stunned. Their eyes widened as they looked at the scene in a daze.
No one had expected that this woman, Chloe, would be so intrepid as to slap Hector in the face..

chapters.title: Chapter 96 - 96: None Of Your Business
chapters.content:
Chapter 96: None Of Your Business
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
After Hector was slapped in the face, he held his face and shouted at Chloe, his eyes bulging, “You… How dare you hit me?”
“So what if 1 hit you?”
With Connor backing her up, Chloe was filled with confidence.
After all, Connor was someone that even the notorious mafia boss of Porthampton, Kyle Hayes, was afraid of. So, she had no scruples in standing up for Connor.
“Who do you think you are? How can you just hit others like that?”
When Mina saw someone hit Hector, she instantly became upset. She took a step forward and shouted agitatedly at Chloe.
“This guy’s mouth is cheap and needs a beating. Besides, what does it have to do with you if I hit him?”
Chloe said in an unusually domineering manner.
“You…”
Mina pointed at Chloe angrily. She was so angry that she couldn’t speak. Then, she turned and asked Hector, “Hector, are you okay?”
“I’m… I’m fine!”
Hector rubbed his cheek and replied in a low voice.
Mina was still present, and Hector had to maintain his gentlemanly image so he didn’t fight with Chloe.
Hector would have shown his true colors and slapped her back if Mina wasn’t there.
After Mina heard Hector’s response, she turned to look at Connor, then, with an emotional expression, she said, “Connor, 1 beg you, don’t meddle in other people’s business anymore, okay? Whether 1 agree to be with Hector is my business. It has nothing to do with you!
“I admit that I did treat you as my best friend before, but I didn’t expect you to be such a person. Perhaps you don’t think Hector is a good person. 1 can understand. But no matter what, Hector is better than a toyboy. So, please don’t interfere in my life in the future. I don’t have a friend like you!”
“Better than a toyboy like me?”
Connor looked at Mina and asked, puzzled.
“Are you still going to quibble with me at a time like this? Wasn’t this woman standing up for you earlier?”
Mina turned and glanced at Chloe, then continued, “Although this woman is a little older, she is quite good-looking. You are lucky to have found a sugar mommy like her!”
The crowd looked at Connor and Chloe incredulously.
If it weren’t for what Mina said, they wouldn’t have thought that Connor was Chloe’s sugar baby.
“I can’t believe that even a loser of a delivery boy is willing to be a sugar baby. The world is full of wonders!”
“Yeah, is this beautiful woman blind? She has such a trashy sugar baby!”
“And this woman is quite pretty. What kind of dumb luck does this man have?”
The crowd started to discuss among themselves as they watched Chloe and Connor.
Meanwhile, Connor looked at Mina helplessly.
He did not expect Mina to think that he was Chloe’s sugar baby.
“Mina, you’ve misunderstood me. We don’t have that kind of relationship!”
Connor explained, then took a step forward and continued, “Mina, I think you…”
“Connor, you don’t have to explain to me. 1 don’t want to hear about your life, and 1 don’t want to care about it. 1 hope you won’t interfere in my life in the future!”
Mina’s face was stern as she interrupted Connor’s sentence. Then, she turned and said to Hector, “Hector, let’s go!”
“Mina, have you agreed to be my girlfriend?”
Hector asked Mina.
n ii
Mina frowned and hesitated, then said in a low voice, “Yes, I’m willing to be your girlfriend!”
After hearing Mina’s agreement, Connor felt as if he had been struck by lightning, and he was stunned.
He felt as if thousands of arrows had pierced through his heart, and his heart ached.
He knew that if he hadn’t come over to stop Mina, Mina would have likely rejected Hector.
But at this moment, Mina had agreed to be Hector’s boyfriend out of anger.
When Hector heard Mina’s answer, he immediately looked happy. He turned and looked provocatively at Connor, then led Mina to the street.
Not long after, Hector stopped a taxi, got into the car with Mina, and left.
Seeing this, Connor felt helpless.
It wouldn’t be long before Hector slept with Mina, if he guessed correctly.
Even if Connor went to stop Mina, Mina would still think that he was stirring up trouble for no reason.
As Mina and Connor were getting deeper and deeper, Mina was dead set on the idea that CEEM was Hector, and the person helping her was also Hector.
These were not things that Connor could explain clearly right now.
Moreover, Mina had no intention of listening to Connor’s explanation.
Therefore, Connor could only place his hopes on Kyle. As long as Kyle could find Hector and help him get his account back, the rest would be simple.
“Mr. McDonald, are you alright?”
Seeing Connor standing there in a daze, Chloe asked with concern, “Are you okay?”
“I’m fine…”
Connor replied indifferently and didn’t say anything else.
After all, the matter between him and Mina couldn’t be clarified with just a few words.
“Alright, let’s go!”
Connor noticed that many people were still looking at him as if he was an idiot, so he turned and told Chloe that he wanted to leave.
“Okay!”
Chloe agreed. Then, she held Connor’s hand and walked toward the parking lot.
***
Five minutes later, Chloe drove with Connor to a restaurant.
“Mr. McDonald, this is the only three-star Michelin restaurant in Porthampton. Usually, only registered members can come here to eat. Even if you are a member, it’s hard to get a seat here. 1 have pulled many favors to get a reservation here!”
After getting off the car, Chloe explained to Connor with a smile.
When Connor heard this, he looked up at the restaurant’s name and found that it was New Century Restaurant, where he had met with Freya Phillips before.
“I’ve been to this restaurant before!”
Connor told Chloe.
When Chloe heard that, she was stunned. Then, she said with a smile, “Mr. McDonald, shouldn’t a rich person like you often come to this restaurant to spend money?”
“That’s true!”
Connor replied indifferently and didn’t say anything else. He followed Chloe into the restaurant.
After entering the restaurant, Connor found many people were waiting in line.
Among the people in line, Connor saw two familiar figures. They were Mina and Hector.
Obviously, after Hector had successfully confessed to Mina, to continue playing the role of a rich kid, he especially borrowed a membership card from a friend and also some money. Then, he made a reservation at New Century Restaurant.
The purpose was to make Mina believe in him through and through. After this meal, he was going to take Mina to a hotel..

chapters.title: Chapter 97 - 97: Why Are You Here, Mr. McDonald?
chapters.content:
Chapter 97: Why Are You Here, Mr. McDonald?
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
At this moment, Hector was arguing with the receptionist of the restaurant. He seemed agitated.
“Didn’t 1 already reserve a seat? Now you’re telling me there is no seat?
Shouldn’t you give me an explanation?” Hector shouted at the beautiful woman at the reception desk.
“Sir, 1 have already explained to you. This is the peak hour. Even if you reserved a table in advance, you would still have to queue!” the beautiful woman at the desk said to Hector impatiently.
“Since we have already reserved a seat, why do we still have to queue for it? Why do 1 have to reserve a table then?” Hector shouted angrily.
“Sir, if you didn’t reserve a table in advance, you might not even have the chance to queue up!” the beauty said indifferently.
Hector was instantly speechless when he heard this. After all, he had never been to such a high-end restaurant before. Naturally, he didn’t know that New Century Restaurant had such a rule.
“What’s wrong with you? We’ve already reserved a table before, but we are also queuing for it. If you don’t want to queue up, hurry up and get lost. Don’t waste our time!”
At this moment, the customers standing behind Hector shouted impatiently.
Mina looked at Hector and hesitated before saying softly, “Hector, why don’t we forget about it? Isn’t it the same no matter where we eat? We can go eat somewhere else!”
“No, this is our first meal together. 1 must treat you to the best!”
Hector said to Mina seriously.
When Mina heard that, a trace of emotion flashed in her eyes flashed, and she didn’t say anything more.
The reason Hector wasn’t willing to go somewhere else wasn’t that he wanted to treat Mina to a meal here.
He had paid a deposit of 500 dollars in advance when he made the reservation. If he didn’t dine here today, the deposit would be used up. Hector didn’t want to waste 500 dollars!
“So, let’s queue for it!”
Mina said to Hector softly.
“We can only queue for now. Mina, I’m really sorry. I didn’t know this restaurant had such a rule. If 1 knew, 1 definitely wouldn’t have brought you here!”
Hector said to Mina apologetically.
“It’s okay. I only have to wait a little longer. I’m not very hungry now anyway!” Mina said very kindly.
“As long as you don’t mind!” Hector revealed a charming smile when he heard Mina’s answer.
However, at this moment, Connor and Chloe went into the restaurant.
When Hector saw Connor, the smile on his face instantly disappeared. Then, he shouted at Connor with an unfriendly tone, “What’s wrong with you? Why are you so clingy? You follow us wherever we go. What are you trying to do?”
When Mina saw Connor and Chloe enter, a strange look appeared on her face. She hesitated for two seconds and didn’t take the initiative to speak to Connor.
“Who cares about following you? Does your family own this restaurant? If you can dine here, why can’t we?” Chloe glared at Hector and shouted.
“How can a poor delivery boy have the money to eat here?” Hector continued to shout.
When the people in the restaurant heard this, they all turned to look at Connor.
Connor was dressed very ordinarily. He didn’t look like a person who could afford to eat here. Therefore, a trace of disdain appeared in everyone’s eyes.
“Who are you calling a delivery boy? Do you want to get slapped again?”
Chloe shouted very agitatedly.
“Stop arguing. What are you shouting for? Customers behind, please come over and take your number and queue up!” The receptionist shouted impatiently when she saw that Chloe was arguing with Hector.
When Chloe heard what the receptionist said, she quickly walked over to her and whispered, “I’ve reserved a seat in your restaurant. It’s room number eight!”
“It’s the rush hour now. You guys can go ahead and queue up!”
The receptionist took out a number plate and handed it to Chloe as she said expressionlessly.
Chloe was stunned when she saw the number plate.
“Don’t think about it. The people in front of you have already reserved their seats. They are waiting in line now!” The receptionist said to Chloe as if she saw the confusion in her eyes.
Chloe hesitated and handed the number plate back to the receptionist. She pouted and said, “Forget it. We are not eating here anymore!”
“If you don’t queue for it, the deposit will not be refunded!”
The receptionist reminded her softly.
“Isn’t it just 500 dollars? I’ll just let it go. I’m not like some people who can’t even bear to give up 500 dollars. Just standing here and waiting in line. If you don’t have money, don’t pretend to be a rich kid!”
It was obvious that Chloe was implying Hector.
When Hector heard this, his facial expression immediately turned ugly.
Today, Chloe was going to treat Connor to a meal. She wanted please him, but if she brought him to queue here, it wouldn’t look good on her.
Therefore, Chloe planned to treat Connor to a meal at another restaurant.
“Mr. McDonald, we would have to queue for this restaurant. Let’s go to another one!” Chloe Lawson said to Connor.
Connor hesitated before turning around to leave.
Mina and Hector were both there. Connor felt bad when he saw them, so he planned to take this opportunity to leave.
However, just as Connor was about to turn around and leave, a middle-aged man in a suit suddenly walked into the restaurant.
When the middle-aged man saw Connor, he was stunned. Then, he respectfully greeted Connor and said aloud, “Mr. McDonald, why are you here? Why didn’t you tell me you were coming to our restaurant?”
When everyone heard the middle-aged man, their eyes widened as they turned to look at Connor. They were very shocked.
The middle-aged man who walked in was none other than the manager of New Century Restaurant, Andrew Sullivan!
“Mr. McDonald, are you here at our restaurant for a meal?”
Andrew walked up to Connor with a slight bow and asked flatteringly.
“Yes, I was planning to have a meal with my friend here, but there are no more seats in your restaurant. I was thinking of going to another restaurant!”
Connor looked at Andrew and replied expressionlessly.
When everyone heard the conversation between Connor and Andrew, they were all visibly puzzled.
They really couldn’t understand why a poor loser like Connor, who looked very shabby in his clothes, would know the manager of New Century Restaurant.
Of course, the most shocked were Hector and Mina..

chapters.title: Chapter 98 - 98: A Verified Membership Card
chapters.content:
Chapter 98: A Verified Membership Card
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
“How does Connor know the manager here?”
Mina muttered, puzzled.
“Mr. McDonald, I’m sorry. The restaurant is really full today. If 1 knew you were coming today, 1 would have prepared a private room!”
Hearing what Connor said, Andrew Sullivan was so scared that he broke out in a cold sweat.
Andrew was the boss of Thomas Morgan’s New Century Restaurant, and Connor was Thomas Morgan’s boss. Andrew definitely knew where he was in the food chain.
Therefore, when he was dealing Connor, he didn’t dare to be negligent even for a bit.
“It’s okay. I’ll eat somewhere else!”
Connor waved his hand and said. After saying that, he turned to glance at Chloe and then walked away.
“Mr. McDonald, since you’re here, how can 1 just let you walk away like that?”
Andrew quickly stopped Connor and said nervously, “Mr. McDonald, please wait for a moment. I’ll arrange a private room for you right now!”
Connor was embarrassed to leave when Andrew was treating him so warmly. He could only stay and watch.
The customers waiting in line in New Century Restaurant were all looking at Connor in shock.
New Century Restaurant was one of the best high-end restaurants in Porthampton. Those who could afford to eat here were mostly the wealthy of Porthampton.
As New Century Restaurant’s manager, Andrew’s status naturally rose.
However, at this moment, he took the initiative to arrange a private room for Connor. How important was Connor?
Hector’s face was also filled with shock when he looked at Connor.
Andrew briefly communicated with the reception desk, then turned around and ran to Connor’s side. He smiled and said to Connor, “Mr. McDonald, we have arranged a VIP room. Please follow me!”
“Okay!”
Connor nodded slightly, then walked to the VIP room.
Meanwhile, Chloe followed behind Connor with excitement. She felt that she was honored to be able to have dinner with a super-rich kid like Connor. That elevated her status too.
However, when Connor and Chloe passed by Hector, Hector suddenly said, “Connor, 1 think you are not only a sugar baby to a wealthy woman, but also to the owner of this restaurant, right?”
When the customers in the restaurant heard Hector, they were all stunned. As they knew Connor’s identity, no one dared to laugh.
Connor turned and glanced at Hector, then said indifferently, “Get this person out of here!”
“Yes, Mr. McDonald!”
Andrew nodded.
Meanwhile, Connor led Chloe into the private room.
After seeing Connor leave, Andrew shouted to the security guards at the door, “What are you waiting for? Get this guy out of here!”
After the security guards heard what their manager said, they ran toward Hector.
“What… What do you want? I’m a member of your restaurant. Is this how you treat members?”
Hector shouted nervously when he saw a few fierce security guards surrounding him.
“You’re a member of our restaurant? How come I’ve never seen you before?”
Andrew looked at Hector and a hint of suspicion flashed across his face.
New Century Restaurant was very strict with giving out memberships. Every member had to go through a rigorous screening process. Andrew knew more or less each member. That way, he knew how to treat each member accordingly.
“This is my membership card!”
In desperation, Hector took out the membership card that he borrowed, wanting to prove his identity.
But he had no idea how stupid that action was.
“May 1 look at your membership card?”
Andrew asked Hector.
“Of course!”
Hector handed the membership card to Andrew.
Andrew took the membership card and handed it to the receptionist. He said softly, “Please verify this membership card!”
“Okay!”
The receptionist nodded and inserted the membership card into the computer reader.
Hector’s facial expression changed when he heard Andrew’s order. He had borrowed the membership card, so it was not his.
“Mina, let’s go!”
Hector was afraid that his identity would be exposed, so he tugged at Mina and wanted to leave the restaurant.
“Okay!”
Mina hurriedly nodded and wanted to leave with Hector.
But at this moment, Andrew suddenly reached out to stop Hector, then said gloomily, “You can’t leave now!”
“Why… Why not?”
Hector stammered.
“Because your identity hasn’t been confirmed yet!”
Andrew replied calmly.
“Mr. Sullivan, this membership card belongs to Mr. Campbell of Dynamics Group!” the receptionist’s voice echoed throughout the restaurant.
Hearing that, Andrew smiled and said expressionlessly, “1 have met Mr. Campbell of Dynamics Group. You are not Mr. Campbell, are you?”
Hector looked at Andrew in a daze. He opened his mouth but no words came.
Mina looked at Hector in confusion. She couldn’t understand why Hector would use someone else’s membership card since he was rich?
“Hector, what’s going on?”
Mina hesitated and asked Hector softly.
“Mina, 1 borrowed this membership card!”
Hector knew that he could no longer hide it, so he could only confess to Mina.
“You borrowed this card?”
Mina was instantly speechless when she heard this.
“Since you have admitted it, we can deal with this easily now!”
Andrew announced.
“Deal with this easily? What do you mean by that?” Hector asked Andrew, puzzled.
“Our restaurant has a clear rule. You will be fined if you stole or borrowed someone else’s membership card to enter the restaurant!” Andrew said expressionlessly.
“Fined?”
Hector looked at Andrew incredulously.
“Yes, a fine of 50,000 dollars!”
Andrew replied.
When Hector heard that, he immediately frowned. Even the usually calm Hector couldn’t remain calm at this moment.
This was because he couldn’t even take out 500 dollars, but now he had to pay a fine of 50,000 dollars!
This was a death sentence to him!
To create the image of a super-rich kid in Mina’s eyes, Hector had to go through a lot of trouble to borrow a New Century Restaurant membership card from a friend.
He initially thought that by taking out the membership card just now, he would be able to make things easier for himself.
But what Hector did not expect was that the membership card was linked to its owner’s name.
What made him even more devastated was that New Century Restaurant had an explicit rule that was a 50,000 dollar fine on any misappropriation or borrowing of another person’s membership card.
To pursue Mina these past few days, Hector had been taking her around and touring all the famous scenic spots in Porthampton. Although the expenditure wasn’t much, it still cost 10,000 to 20,000 dollars a day.
To built his identity as a super-rich kid, he had specially rented a BMW car and an expensive suit.
Hector borrowed most of his money from his friends, so he was already heavily in debt.. Therefore, he could not afford the 50,000 dollars!

chapters.title: Chapter 99 - 99: Snacks In Bayside District
chapters.content:
Chapter 99: Snacks In Bayside District
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
“You only have to pay 50,000 dollars, and you can leave!”
Andrew Sullivan said to Hector expressionlessly.
When Hector heard this, he immediately frowned and growled, “What right do you have to make me pay? If I don’t pay today, will you detain me?”
“Of course, we won’t hold you back, but if you don’t pay this fine, the restaurant will revoke the cardholder’s membership!”
Andrew narrowed his eyes and replied.
Hector was stunned when he heard this, and his expression turned ugly.
Hector borrowed this membership card from a rich kid in his class. If that rich kid knew that his membership had been revoked, he definitely would not let Hector off.
After all, New Century Restaurant’s membership card was a priceless item. An ordinary person couldn’t own it.
Hector looked at Andrew and hesitated for two seconds. Then, he hissed, “I left in a hurry today when 1 went out. I forgot to bring my credit card. Can 1 return this money some other day?”
“It doesn’t matter if you forgot to bring your card. You may also transfer money via cell phone. You can use Paypal or direct transfer. Or, 1 can get someone to follow you to the bank to withdraw money!” Andrew said calmly.
H 11
Hearing Andrew’s words, Hector’s face instantly turned ugly. He opened his mouth and didn’t know what to say. After all, he couldn’t take out so much money right now!
When Mina saw the expression on Hector’s face, she was bewildered.
After all, in Mina’s eyes, Hector was the famous CeeM of Twitch. He could spend millions just with a flick of his hand. Why couldn’t he take out even 50,000 dollars now?
Moreover, as a tycoon, Hector didn’t even have a New Century Restaurant membership card. This really didn’t fit his identity.
Mina suddenly felt that Hector was somewhat suspicious.
“Mina, do you have the money? Why don’t you help me pay for it first? After I go home and get my card, I’ll return the money to you!”
Hector suddenly turned and said to Mina.
When the customers in the restaurant heard Hector, they looked at him in disdain. After all, most people who could afford to come to a place like New Century Restaurant were wealthy people.
Therefore, when Hector wanted to borrow money from a girl, they naturally expressed their disdain for him.
However, Hector had no time to think things through. He wanted to pay the fine as soon as possible and leave with Mina.
Mina did not refuse Hector. Instead, she took out her phone from her bag and walked to Andrew. She said, “1’11 pay this fine for now!”
Andrew glanced at Mina indifferently and did not say anything. He brought her to the reception desk of the restaurant.
Mina used her cell phone to transfer the money and paid 50,000 dollars.
After paying the fine, Hector finally breathed a sigh of relief. Then, he walked out of the restaurant with Mina.
After walking out of the restaurant, Mina hesitated for a moment. She stopped and asked Hector softly, “Hector, are you hiding something from me?”
“How could I hide something from you?”
Hector pretended to be calm and replied, then he continued, “Mina, you’re not suspecting me just because 1 borrowed 50,000 dollars from you, right? I told you just now. 1 only forgot to bring my card with me when I left home today. I will return the money to you!”
“I didn’t mean that!”
Mina quickly replied.
“What do you mean then?”
“I just want to know if you have something on your mind. If you do, you can tell me!”
Mina felt that there was something wrong with Hector today. His style of doing things was very different from CeeM’s. That was why she asked.
“Don’t worry, I’m fine. Let’s eat at another restaurant!”
Hector heaved a sigh of relief when he saw that Mina did not see through his identity.
“Alright then!”
Mina looked at Hector and nodded without saying anything.
Ten minutes later, Hector brought Mina to Bayside Snacks.
Mina started to doubt Hector’s identity even more with his choice of place to eat.
Although eating in Bayside Snacks was not shameful to Mina, she felt that if Hector was a super-rich kid, why would he bring her to Bayside Snacks?
‘Could what Connor said before be true? Is Hector a liar?’
A very bold idea suddenly flashed through Mina’s mind.
However, Mina quickly shook her head and brushed that thought away. Then, she followed Hector into Bayside Snacks.
Meanwhile, after returning to her own house, Freya Phillips kicked off her high heels and walked toward the sofa barefooted.
“Freya, are you back?”
Maya ran out of the bedroom and greeted Freya with a smile.
“Maya, why are you here?” Freya looked surprised when she saw Maya.
“Oh, 1 was bored at school on my own, so 1 thought I’d come over to hang out with you!”
Maya explained, then continued, “Oh right, Freya, I heard that you went to see the villa today. How did it go?”
“The location of the villa is not bad. The surrounding facilities are convenient, and the scenery is stunning. However, it is too expensive. One unit actually costs more than fifty million dollars. Even now, 1 don’t have so much money!”
After hearing Maya’s question, Freya replied somewhat disappointedly.
“Fifty million dollars?”
When Maya heard the number, she could not help but exclaim in surprise. Then, her eyes widened as she said, “Are these people crazy? A villa actually costs fifty million dollars. That is daylight robbery, isn’t it?”
“The location of this villa is strategic, so it’s not a surprise that it is worth that much. But something else happened today that was very strange. Guess who 1 met at the showroom today?”
Freya said.
“Who?”
Maya blinked and asked.
“I met Connor!”
Freya whispered and then continued, “And he said he would buy that villa for me. Don’t you think it’s funny?”
“Hahaha…”
Maya burst into laughter when she heard that. She clutched her stomach tightly and said, “Is Connor stupid? He’s just a poor delivery boy. Even if he delivers food his entire life, it’s impossible for him to buy a villa worth fifty million dollars!”
“Haha, that’s right…”
Freya was about to speak when she suddenly realized that her phone was ringing.
She answered the phone and asked, “Hello, who’s this?”
“Are you Miss Phillips?”
The person on the other end of the phone asked politely.
“Yes, that’s me!”
“I’m the general manager of Evergrande Real Estate’s showroom, Sean
Quintin!”
When Freya heard this, she was stunned and a hint of confusion flashed in her eyes.
She could not understand why the general manager of Evergrande Real Estate would call her..

chapters.title: Chapter 100 - 100: Someone Bought You A Villa
chapters.content:
Chapter 100: Someone Bought You A Villa
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
“General manager of Evergrande Real Estate? Is there something you need me for?”
Freya hesitated before asking.
“Miss Phillips, did you come by to look at the properties in our showroom today?” Sean asked with a smile.
Freya only came to her senses when she heard that. It must be because she went to the showroom to see the house today. They probably wanted to ask about the property and when she could buy it.
Freya had visited all the property showrooms in Porthampton over the past few days. Naturally, she had received many such calls.
However, it was the first time Freya had received such a call from the general manager.
“I did go to your showroom to look at a villa today. The villas there are quite good, but I don’t have that much money now. I’ll call you again when I am ready to buy it!”
Freya was about to hang up after she said that.
“Miss Phillips, you have misunderstood me. I didn’t mean to ask you when you’ll buy the villa!”
Sean said hurriedly.
“You are not going to ask that? So why did you call me? Are you asking for feedback on the staff in the showroom?” Freya sounded even more confused.
“Miss Phillips, I’m calling to tell you that someone has bought the villa you like and is prepared to give it to you. When will you have time to come over and sign the contract?”
Sean said respectfully.
“Someone bought the villa that I like and wants to give it to me? Are you kidding me? That villa is worth more than fifty million dollars!”
After hearing Sean’s explanation, Freya’s jaw dropped in shock.
“Miss Phillips, I’m not kidding you. I’m telling you the truth. You only have to bring your ID card to the showroom and sign the contract!”
Sean quickly said.
Freya couldn’t help but hesitate, then she said, “Your scam is too cheap. There is nothing free in this world. How could someone give me a villa for no reason? I’m not a fool. I won’t fall for it!”
After saying this, Freya directly hung up the phone. Then, she pouted and said, “These salespeople nowadays are unreliable. I only went to their showroom this afternoon, and I’m already receiving a fraudulent call at night!”
Freya thought that the people in the showroom had leaked her data and Sean was a swindler. First, he claimed that someone wanted to give her the villa. Then, he would make excuses to make her pay all kinds of fees.
This swindling tactic was very common, and people would fall for it from time to time. It was often reported on the news.
“Who was that?”
When Maya saw Freya ending the call, she asked with a smile.
“No one, it’s just a fraudulent call!”
Freya did not take the phone call to heart and replied calmly.
“A fraudulent phone call? But I just heard that someone bought the villa and wants to give it to you.” Maya continued.
“That’s right. That villa is worth more than fifty million dollars. How could someone buy that and give it to me?” Freya sighed softly.
“That might not be true. Didn’t Connor say that he would buy that villa and give it to you? Maybe it was Connor who bought it?” Maya said teasingly.
“Maya Phillips, can you stop joking? Connor is a poor man. How could he have the money to buy that villa?”
Freya looked at Maya helplessly.
“Oh, Freya, maybe Connor is pretending to be poor? He delivers food when he has nothing to do, but maybe in truth, his family is wealthy. So, when he heard that you wanted to buy a villa today, he bought it right away and gave it to you!”
Although Maya said that, she did not believe that Connor had the money to buy the villa and give it to Freya for nothing.
Connor was a poor loser. Almost everyone at Porthampton University knew that.
“Maya, don’t joke about Connor. Connor is just a little poor, but he’s quite good-natured!”
Freya said softly.
“He’s good-natured? The first time I met him, he fell on purpose and took advantage of me. He even asked you for an allowance of 20,000 dollars a month. The most infuriating thing is that he threw all that money away when I gave him money. Whenever 1 think of this, I feel like slapping him!”
Maya shouted excitedly.
“You must have said something to him that triggered him to throw the money away the last time 1 asked you that to him. Do you think I didn’t know what was going on?”
Freya couldn’t help but roll her eyes at Maya. The two grew up together. She knew exactly what kind of character Maya had.
When Maya heard that, she pursed her lips and quibbled, “I didn’t say anything provocative to Connor that day. Who knew he had such a bad temper…”
“Everyone has their dignity, much less a man. You’d better watch your attitude when you talk to others in the future!” Freya said.
“Connor is a toyboy. What dignity can a toyboy have? 1 have no respect for such guys!”
“You…”
As Freya was about to speak, her phone rang again.
Freya hesitated before answering the phone.
“Hello, Miss Phillips!” It was Sean again.
“You again? Didn’t 1 tell you just now? Your trick is too cheap. I won’t fall for that. You’d better find a better excuse to cheat people of their money!”
After hearing Sean’s voice, Freya said impatiently.
“Miss Phillips, I’m not trying to cheat you…”
“If you call me again, I’ll call the police. Believe me. I will!” Freya said in embarrassment.
“Miss Phillips, if you don’t believe me, you can look up this number’s ID. This is the phone number of our showroom. If I were a liar, how would I be reaching out to you with this number?
“Moreover, we aren’t charging you a single cent now. You only have to come to our showroom to take a look. If I were a liar, would I dare to ask you to come to the showroom?” Sean explained quickly.
When Freya heard this, she quickly looked at her phone screen. Sure enough, a number ending with six sixes was displayed.
To find out more about the villa, Freya had taken the initiative to call Evergrande Real Estate earlier. It was the same number Sean was calling her with!
“Did someone really buy a villa and gave it to me?”
Freya murmured in shock.
Then, she recalled what Connor told her.
Freya had met Connor at the showroom. Connor had said that he would buy the villa and give it to her.
However, Freya had previously thought that Connor was joking with her, so she did not take him seriously.
Moreover, Freya had also joked with Connor that if Connor bought the villa and gave it to her, she would really marry him.
“Connor didn’t really buy the villa, did he? But where did he get so much money? This villa is worth more than fifty million dollars!”
When Freya confirmed Sean’s identity, several questions crossed her mind..

chapters.title: Chapter 101 - 101: His Identity Can’t Be Exposed
chapters.content:
Chapter 101: His Identity Can’t Be Exposed
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
“Miss Phillips, are you still there?”
Sean asked softly.
“Yes, I am!”
Freya was stunned for a moment before hurriedly replying. Then, she asked in a puzzled tone, “Are you the general manager of Evergrande Real Estate?”
“Miss Phillips, if you don’t believe me, you can come directly to our showroom to take a look. We won’t charge you a single cent. We can even reimburse your travel expenses!”
Sean said softly.
“Alright, I’ll go to your showroom later!”
Freya replied softly before hanging up. She turned to Maya and said, “Maya, I have something to do now. I need to go out for a bit…”
“Where are you going, Freya? Do you really believe what that scammer said? How could someone give you a villa for no reason?” Maya shouted in confusion.
“The person who called using the showroom’s number just now. He even took the initiative to invite me to the showroom to take a look. If he was really a scammer, why would he ask me to go to the showroom?” Freya replied softly as she packed her bag.
“That’s impossible unless Connor bought that villa. However, he’s a poor delivery man who depends on you for monthly living expenses. How can he have fifty million to buy a villa? He probably won’t be able to come up with 500 thousand, let alone fifty million!” Maya whispered.
“It’s pointless to talk about this now. I’ll know when I go to the showroom!”
Freya picked up her bag and left the house, her heels clicking against the floor.
“Hey, wait for me. I’ll go with you!”
Maya put down her iPad and ran out with Freya
***
Half an hour later, Freya drove to the showroom of Evergrande Real Estate.
“Freya, I think we should just stay in the car. What if that scammer is from the showroom and kidnaps us when we go in?”
After leaving the car, Maya voiced her fear.
“It’s okay, Maya. Evergrande Real Estate is one of the top developers in the country. They are very reputable in the country. Moreover, their company has always focused on high-end villa projects. How could such a large group have scammers?”
Freya wasn’t worried about this at the moment. She was only concerned about whether someone wanted to buy that villa for her.
“Are you sure?” Maya blinked.
“Don’t worry!”
Freya replied indifferently. She then brushed her hair and walked into the showroom elegantly.
Maya hesitated for a moment before following Freya in.
At this moment, Sean, waiting anxiously in the showroom, saw Freya enter and quickly approached her. With a smile, he said, “Miss Phillips, you’re finally here. We would have gotten off work if you hadn’t come over!”
Freya scanned the situation in the showroom and found that everything was normal.
Freya had seen a few of the sales ladies when she came in the afternoon.
“Are you the general manager of the showroom?”
Freya asked with a frown.
“Yes, Miss Phillips. This is my business card!”
Sean respectfully took out a business card and handed it to Freya. Then, he continued, “Miss Phillips, now that you’re here, you shouldn’t have to worry about someone lying to you now, right?”
Freya took Sean’s name card and glanced at it briefly before saying softly, “Mr. Quintin, you said on the phone just now that someone bought the villa and wanted to give it to me. Is this true? Is your showroom doing some promotional activities?”
“Exactly! Are you guys pulling our legs?”
After Maya entered the showroom and confirmed there was no problem, she mustered up her courage and shouted at Sean.
“Miss Phillips, don’t worry. We’re just doing business. How could we lie to you? I’ve already prepared the purchase contract just now. You only need to sign the contract; that villa will be yours. You don’t have to spend a single cent, and you can move in immediately!” Sean said with a smile.
“How one just get a free villa without any attachment? Are you sure what you said is true?”
Freya still couldn’t believe Sean.
“I can guarantee with our company’s reputation that what 1 said is true!”
Sean looked at Freya and nodded sincerely before continuing, “Miss Phillips, you can come over and look at the contract!”
Freya hesitated for a moment before following Sean to the reception room.
Sean took out the contract he had prepared beforehand and handed it to Freya. After Freya had read it carefully, she found that there was no problem. This was just an ordinary purchase contract, and there were no loopholes in the contents of the contract. The villa on it was also the villa that Freya had taken a fancy to.
“Mr. Quintin, what’s going on?”
Freya put down the contract in her hand and asked Sean, confused.
“Miss Phillips, I’ve already told you very clearly on the phone. Someone bought this villa and told us he wants to give it to you. That’s why I called you and asked you to come over!”
Sean said slowly.
“So, who is giving me this villa?”
Freya hurriedly asked.
“Miss Phillips, when the other party bought this villa, he specially instructed us not to expose his identity, so 1 can’t tell you who gave this villa to you!” Sean said lightly.
Freya looked at Sean, puzzled.
“Freya, do you think Connor bought it for you?”
Maya couldn’t help but whisper to Freya after hearing Sean’s words.
“This is impossible! How could Connor have the money to buy this villa?” Freya replied softly.
“So, who could it be?”
Freya was also very puzzled.
“Miss Phillips, if you’re okay with everything, you can sign the contract now!” Sean looked at Freya and said.
“Tell me, who gave me this villa?” Freya looked at Sean seriously and asked.
“Miss Phillips, I can’t tell you that!” Sean shook his head lightly.
“If you don’t tell me who gave me this villa, I won’t sign this contract, and I won’t accept the villa!”
After saying this, Freya returned the contract to Sean and left the reception room..

chapters.title: Chapter 102 - 102: Could It Really Be Connor?
chapters.content:
Chapter 102: Could It Really Be Connor?
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Sean did not expect Freya to give up on this villa.
He quickly caught up to Freya and said helplessly, “Miss Phillips, I can’t tell you who bought this villa because I’ve already promised the client before, so I must abide by it strictly!”
“If you won’t tell me, I won’t sign this contract!” Freya said calmly.
“Don’t you want this villa anymore?” Sean quickly asked.
“Yeah, I don’t even know who gave it to me. Of course I can’t accept it. Unless you tell me who bought this villa, I won’t accept anything from anyone!”
Although Freya really wanted to buy this villa, this did not mean that she could accept other people’s things as she pleased.
This was the difference between Freya and the other girls.
If it were any other girl, they would have signed the contract without asking for anything, let alone a villa.
Moreover, it was a villa worth fifty million dollars. Even if it was sold again, it could be sold for thirty to forty million dollars. This amount of money was enough for an ordinary person to spend for a lifetime.
However, even in the face of such a huge temptation, Freya still maintained her rationality.
She knew very well that there were no free things in this world. Usually, the more expensive the item, the greater the price.
Therefore, Freya would never accept this villa without knowing who the other party was and why he gave it to her.
“Miss Phillips, I’m also completing the customer’s request now. Can you take it as a favor and sign the contract?”
Sean looked at Freya and begged.
“I’ve already made it very clear to you just now. If you don’t tell me who gave me this villa, I won’t sign it!”
Freya replied indifferently before turning to Maya and shouting, “Maya, come with me!”
“Freya, don’t rush this!”
Maya had no intention of leaving. Instead, she looked greedily at the contract on the table.
“Maya, what are you still standing there for? Hurry up, and come on!”
Freya saw Maya’s hesitant look and frowned as she berated her.
“Freya, this is a villa worth fifty million dollars. As long as you sign the contract, it will be yours. Are you going to leave just like that?” Maya shouted agitatedly at Freya.
“Nothing is free in this world. Maya, come with me!” Freya said helplessly.
“Freya, I don’t understand what you’re thinking. Even if nothing’s free, you can’t just say no to this fifty-million dollars villa!”
Maya shouted in disappointment, then looked at Sean’s seat and said with a smile, “Mr. Quintin, I’m her cousin. If she doesn’t want it, can I have it instead?”
“No, the person who bought this villa said it can only be given to Miss Freya Phillips alone!”
Sean shook his head helplessly.
“Maya, what nonsense are you talking about? Hurry up, and come on!”
When Freya heard Maya’s words, she was so angry that her face turned red. She hurriedly dragged Maya out of the showroom.
“Miss Phillips, do you not want this villa anymore?” Sean shouted after her nervously.
“Tell the person who bought this villa to contact me himself!” Freya replied indifferently before leaving the showroom.
Maya followed behind Freya helplessly, not knowing what to say.
Meanwhile, the sales ladies in the showroom were also looking at Freya strangely.
They couldn’t understand why someone would not accept a free villa worth fifty million dollars. Was there something wrong with this woman’s brain?
Sean could only sigh helplessly after Freya left.
Then, he took out his phone and dialed Connor’s number, but it showed that the other party had turned off his phone!
***
After Freya and Maya left the showroom.
Maya asked Freya gloomily, “Freya, why don’t you want that villa? That’s a whole fifty million!”
“Maya, you’re still too young. Nothing’s free in this world, and no one would give me a villa for no reason!”
Freya returned to the car and replied expressionlessly.
Back then, when Freya’s father’s company had financial problems, someone said they wanted to help Freya’s father, but the price was to make Freya Connor’s wife.
After this incident, Freya understood that the easier it was to obtain something, the greater the price one had to pay.
“I wonder who bought this villa to give to you, Freya. Moreover, he won’t let anyone expose his identity. It’s so strange!” Maya could only mutter helplessly when she saw that Freya was determined not to take this villa.
“I’m not sure.”
Freya shook her head lightly. She had already filtered through all the rich kids she knew in her mind. Although many rich people pursued her, none of them were so generous.
After all, the guys pursuing Freya were just ordinary rich heirs. They weren’t rich enough to buy a fifty million dollar villa and give it to someone, much less a woman!
“Freya, could it really be Connor?”
Maya’s eyes widened as she exclaimed.
“How is that possible…”
Freya smiled bitterly. She did not believe that Connor could afford this villa.
“Freya, why don’t you call Connor and ask him? Maybe he won the lottery, and that’s why he has the money to buy this villa…” Maya advised softly.
“This villa is worth fifty million dollars, and the first lottery prize is only five million. Connor must win at least ten times that amount to afford this villa. Do you think that’s possible?” Freya replied coldly.
“Well, maybe he bought ten bets at once. Hurry up and ask him. Other than Connor, who else would buy you a villa?” Maya continued.
Freya hesitated for a moment. She could not help but recall what she had promised Connor before, so she took out her phone and dialed Connor’s number.
“Connor’s phone is switched off!”
A few seconds later, Freya turned and said to Maya.
“Freya, why don’t I ask my friend where Connor lives? We can go to his house and ask him…”
Maya took out her phone and started contacting her friends at Porthampton University.
After all, Connor was considered a celebrity at Porthampton University. It wouldn’t be difficult to find where Connor lived.
Freya saw that Maya wanted to find out where Connor lived. She hesitated for a moment but did not stop Maya.
She was very curious now.. Did Connor buy this villa for her?

chapters.title: Chapter 103 - 103: The Anxious Hector
chapters.content:
Chapter 103: The Anxious Hector
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Meanwhile, inside Bayside Snacks.
Hector brought Mina to Bayside Snacks and ordered two signature duck leg rice servings.
While eating, Mina was thinking about Hector.
After all, what happened today made Mina feel that Hector wasn’t a rich heir at all. Instead, Connor was more like a rich heir.
However, Mina didn’t say much. After all, Hector said he forgot his bank card today, so he couldn’t spare fifty thousand dollars.
Although this excuse was a little lame, it was not out of ordinary.
Mina slowly put down the chopsticks in her hand and looked at Hector.
“Mina, are you full?” Hector asked with a smile.
“Yeap, I’m full. Send me home!”
Mina nodded lightly.
When Hector heard this, he could not help but be stunned for a moment. Then, he said softly, “Mina, it’s still early. I bought two movie tickets. Why don’t we go watch a movie together?”
“I’m a little tired after shopping all day. You should send me home to rest!” Mina whispered.
Hector looked at Mina and hesitated momentarily before continuing, “Mina, since you’re tired, why don’t you go home today?”
“If 1 don’t go home, where should I go?”
Mina blinked and asked with a puzzled expression.
“We can get a room at a nearby hotel. 1 can stay with you for a while!” Hector said innocently.
When Mina heard what Hector said, she froze, a hint of embarrassment flashing in her eyes.
She never expected Hector to bring her to a hotel!
If Mina and Hector had been together for some time, Mina might not have found it strange. After all, it was normal for couples to want to get a room after a long time.
But now, Mina and Hector had only known each other for less than three days, and Mina had only agreed to go out with Hector today.
The two hadn’t even held hands before, yet Hector wanted to bring Mina to a room. Wasn’t this a little too rushed?
Hector also knew he was rushing things a little when he asked to get a room with Mina.
However, he had no choice. If he continued to waste time with Mina, his identity might be exposed.
Moreover, in Hector’s eyes, dating Mina was not only a waste of money but also a waste of energy. It was not easy to pretend to be a rich kid.
To maintain his identity as a rich heir, Hector had to tip tens of thousands of dollars in Mina’s live broadcast room daily. Renting a suit and a BMW for a day would cost thousands of dollars, and there was also the cost of dating!
Hector had already owed others hundreds of thousands of dollars in less than three days.
Moreover, Hector had borrowed this money from the loan sharks. If Hector did not return the money immediately, the loan sharks might come looking for him anytime.
Hector’s plan was simple. He wanted to get a room with Mina and sleep with her. He wanted to take a few nude photos of Mina and use them to blackmail her for money.
This way, not only would Hector be able to sleep with Mina for free, but he would also be able to get a large sum of money from her to clear his current debt.
“Hector, I don’t think our relationship has reached that stage yet, right? Although I agreed to go out with you today, it doesn’t mean that I’m willing to have anything with you. I agreed to be with you just to allow you to continue being with me!”
At this moment, Mina’s cold voice interrupted all of Hector’s fantasies.
Mina looked at Hector, her face filled with disappointment.
She originally wanted to give Hector a chance but never thought that Hector would be such a desperate person.
“Mina, have you misunderstood me?”
Hector smiled at Mina, then hurriedly explained, “I said that I wanted to take you to a hotel room, not to have sex with you. I just feel your place is too far away from here. Moreover, you said you are tired now, so 1 thought 1 might as well book a room for you in the hotel to rest well. I promise that I won’t do anything to you!”
“You promise you won’t do anything to me?”
After Mina heard what Hector said, she couldn’t help but laugh. Then, she lightly said, “Hector, who do you think I am? I’m not one of those innocent girls in school. Do you think I’ll believe your nonsense? 1 know exactly what you want to do!”
“Mina, what are you trying to say?”
After Hector heard Mina’s words, he raised his voice agitatedly.
“I’m not trying to say anything. I just want to tell you I’m not that kind of woman. Even if 1 agree to be with you, 1 won’t sleep with you so casually. I say you should give up on this idea!” Mina said coldly.
“Mina, aren’t you going a little overboard? I feared you would be too tired, so I wanted to take you to a hotel. But I didn’t expect you to think of me like this. I’m disappointed. Am I such a person in your eyes?”
Hector saw that Mina had seen through his trick and immediately began to make up another story, raising his voice at Mina agitatedly.
When the customers in Bayside Snacks heard Hector, they turned to look at the two of them.
At this moment, Mina’s eyes flashed with a trace of guilt. She secretly guessed that she had wronged Hector.
Perhaps Hector was not as bad as she thought. He simply wanted her to rest?
“Mina, we have only officially gotten together today. No matter how anxious I am, I can’t possibly get into your pants on the first date, right? Even a fool would know that such a thing shouldn’t be done! Do you think I would do such a thing?”
Hector said agitatedly, his eyes widened.
“Hector…Why are you so worked up?”
After Mina saw Hector’s furious appearance, she secretly regretted saying that to Hector.
After Hector saw Mina’s guilty expression, he struck while the iron was hot and said, “Mina, if you’re afraid that I’ll do something to you in the hotel, then I’ll send you home now, okay?”
After saying that, Hector turned around and walked out of the restaurant.
“Hector!”
Mina saw that Hector had really left and hurriedly called out, then she chased after him.
After Hector left Bayside Snacks, he opened the car door and shouted at Mina expressionlessly, “Get in the car. I’ll send you home now!”
“Hector, I’m sorry. I shouldn’t have said that to you just now. I have misunderstood you!” Mina said apologetically to Hector.
After Hector heard that, he frowned and said affectionately, “Mina, I really like you, that’s why I’m with you. I’m not the kind of person who like to rush things. 1 know you’re prejudiced against me now, but time will prove my sincerity!”
After Mina heard Hector’s affectionate confession, she felt touched and blamed herself.
She felt that it must be because too many things had happened today that made her doubt Hector’s identity. Therefore, when she heard Hector wanted to bring her to a hotel, she instinctively resisted.
“Mina, let me send you home now!”
Hector whispered to Mina.
“Yes!”
Mina nodded, then gracefully walked into the car.
Seeing Mina nodding, Hector immediately smiled wretchedly.
He thought, ‘Not going to the hotel with me, are you? When we return to the place, I can still do you!’

chapters.title: Chapter 104 - 104: Spiked Drink
chapters.content:
Chapter 104: Spiked Drink
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
After getting into the car, Mina was too embarrassed to look Hector in the eye.
What Mina said earlier was too hurtful.
“Hector, I’m sorry. I misunderstood you!”
Mina bit her sexy red lip and whispered to Hector.
“It’s okay. 1 didn’t take those words to heart. Besides, your thinking that way shows that you’re a good girl. I can understand!” Hector replied indifferently.
After Mina heard Hector’s magnanimous words, her good impression of him instantly increased.
“Mina, are you thirsty? Here, drink some water!”
At this moment, Hector suddenly took a bottle of mineral water from the car and handed it to Mina.
Mina didn’t think too much about it and instinctively took it, then took a small sip.
When Hector saw Mina drink the bottle of mineral water, the corners of his mouth couldn’t help but curl up slightly, revealing a proud smile. ‘Mina, oh Mina, luckily, 1 was prepared beforehand. Otherwise, you would have escaped today!*
When Mina saw the smile on Hector’s face, she couldn’t help but feel stunned for a moment before saying, “Hector, what are you smiling at?”
“What? No… Nothing!” Hector replied in a panic.
Mina felt that something was off about Hector. She quickly looked up at the road outside the car and realized this was not the way home.
“Hector, where exactly are you taking me…”
Before Mina could finish her sentence, she suddenly felt dizzy.
At this moment, Mina realized that Hector might have spiked the water!
After all, Mina hadn’t eaten anything strange on the way here. She had only taken a sip of the mineral water Hector had given her and immediately started to feel dizzy.
This meant that there was something wrong with the water. Thinking about Hector’s smug smile, Mina was 100% sure that Hector had drugged her. “Hector, you drugged me!”
Mina took a deep breath and shouted at Hector.
After Hector heard this, he turned to look at Mina and smiled playfully, ignoring her.
At this moment, Hector had completely exposed his true nature. He did not really like Mina at all. He only approached Mina to trick her into sleeping with him and extort her ruthlessly.
Mina was extremely regretful now. She regretted not listening to Connor and staying away from Hector.
“Mina, you didn’t think 1 was going to send you home, did you? 1 was lying to you just now. I guessed you might refuse to get a room with me, so I spiked the water…”
Hector turned to look at Mina, who was about to faint, and laughed pervertedly.
“Hector, I didn’t expect you to be such a person. Why… Why are you doing this?”
Mina shouted at Hector.
“Why would I do that?”
Hector sneered and said indifferently, “I’ve spent so much money on you and given you so many gifts in your live stream. Don’t you know that?
“Do you think I was giving you gifts because 1 like you? Don’t you female streamers know that very well? They’ll sleep with whoever gives them the most gifts. Why are you still pretending to be innocent?”
H H
When Mina heard what Hector said, she was so angry that she couldn’t say anything.
“I don’t like you at all. I’m willing to spend money on you just to get you into bed. Don’t worry, I don’t have any other intentions!”
Hector continued after seeing Mina remain silent.
Mina gritted her teeth and quietly took out her phone, wanting to call Connor for help.
But what she did not expect was that Connor’s phone was switched off.
Mina had no choice but to call the police. However, at this moment, Hector suddenly noticed what she was doing. He snatched the phone away and threw it out of the car window.
When Mina saw Hector throw her phone out of the car, her eyes were filled with despair, and she fainted.
Hector turned to look at Mina with a lewd smile on his face. Then, he drove to the hotel he had booked earlier.
***
Twenty minutes later, Hector parked the car in front of a hotel.
Then, he helped the unconscious Mina from the passenger seat and into the hotel.
When the hotel staff saw Hector helping Mina, a trace of doubt flashed in their eyes, but they did not ask much.
As Hector’s friend owned this hotel, Hector had already discussed it with the hotel staff in advance and even gave the front desk 2,000 dollars as a bribe.
Hector brought Mina to the room he had booked beforehand and threw Mina onto the bed.
At this moment, Mina was already delirious and was completely out.
Hector looked at Mina’s ample chest and two long, fair legs. A hint of greed flashed in his eyes, and he couldn’t help but lick his lips. He then muttered to himself, “1 finally got you into bed. Let’s see how you’re going to escape this time!”
After saying this, Hector quickly took out his phone and took a few photos of Mina.
After taking the photos, Hector randomly picked a photo of Mina without her face and posted it on Porthampton University’s forum. He also edited a post titled ‘Beautiful streamer has taken the bait, ready to do it at any time!’
This post had only been posted for less than thirty seconds but had already received tens of thousands of replies and reposts.
“Mr. CeeM is awesome!”
“Mr. CeeM is really a perverted talent!”
“Mr. CeeM, can you live stream the entire thing? I want to see what this beautiful streamer looks like!”
Most comments below the post praised Hector, and some hoped that Hector could live stream the entire thing.
After Hector saw these comments, he smiled satisfactorily.
Obviously, Hector enjoyed the attention he was getting on the internet.
After posting, Hector threw his phone aside and walked toward Mina.
“It is unexpected that I, Hector, will be able to get my hands on such a top-grade woman one day. Haha…”
Hector licked his lips pervertedly, then grabbed Mina’s clothes.
After a while, Hector took off Mina’s tank top, revealing her sexy lace bra.
Hector couldn’t help but gulp and was ready to strip Mina..
