chapters.title: Chapter 105 - 105: How Are You Awake?
chapters.content:
Chapter 105: How Are You Awake?
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Buzz buzz!
However, at this moment, Hector’s phone suddenly vibrated.
He was about to pick up his phone to decline the call.
However, when he saw the name ‘Taylor’, he was stunned.
After hesitating for two seconds, he did not decline the call. Instead, he reached out and tapped on the screen to answer the call.
“Taylor, what’s up?”
Hector asked flatteringly.
“Don’t f*cking play dumb with me. Let me ask you, when do you plan to pay me back?” the other party said very impolitely.
“Taylor, can you give me another two days? 1’11 return the money to you in two days!” Hector hurriedly replied.
“Hector, do you think I’m a fool? How many days have 1 given you? Are you not going to return the hundred thousand you borrowed from me?” Taylor said angrily.
“Taylor, what are you saying? Even if 1 had the guts, I wouldn’t dare not return your money! Didn’t I just ’catch’ a female streamer? I’m going to have money soon. Can you give me two more days?” Hector begged softly.
“Alright, two days! I’ll give you two more days. If you don’t pay me back in two days, just wait for me to look for you at your university!” Taylor hesitated for a moment and said coldly.
“Okay, Taylor. I’ll bring the money to you in two days!”
At this moment, Hector felt that he had already won over Mina, so there was no problem for him to return the money!
“You better keep your word!” Taylor said coldly and hung up.
“F*ck, after I get the money, 1’11 see if you still dare to talk to me like this, you b*stard!”
After Hector heard the call end, he couldn’t help but curse in a low voice. Then, he turned to look at Mina and was ready to continue taking off Mina’s clothes.
In the hotel room.
Mina’s face was red as she lay on the bed with her eyes closed as if she didn’t know what had happened.
Hector looked at Mina’s perfect figure, his face full of excitement.
Long and fair legs, a charming and alluring face…
It was as if every part of Mina’s body was so tempting.
Hector took a deep breath, then his hands trembled as he was about to continue taking off Mina’s clothes.
But just as he was about to reach out, Mina suddenly opened her eyes and kicked Hector between his legs.
Thud!
Still, in a daze, Hector did not expect Mina to wake up suddenly and was kicked to the ground.
Mina had learned taekwondo when she was young, so the lethality of this kick was quite high.
At this moment, Mina was still wearing high heels. The sharp heel directly hit the middle of Hector’s crotch. That feeling was especially harsh!
After Mina kicked Hector to the ground, she quickly reached out to pick up the clothes on the bed.
“F*ck, why are you f*cking awake?”
Hector kneeled on the ground and clutched his crotch tightly, screaming in pain.
He felt his entire body numb, and a cold sweat broke out on his forehead from the pain.
Mina quickly put on her clothes and ran out of the room with a flustered expression.
By the time Hector recovered, he found that Mina had already run out of the room!
“Sh*t!” Hector cried in his heart and hurriedly chased after her.
“Someone! Help!”
After Mina ran out of the room, she immediately shouted for help.
However, the hotel was located in a remote area, with only a few people around. Hence, no one came out to answer Mina’s call.
Hector knew that he had to get Mina today, no matter what. If Mina ran away, he would not be able to pay back the loan sharks he owed and might even be thrown into jail.
“Help me stop that woman!”
When Hector saw that Mina was almost at the hotel entrance, he shouted at the front desk.
As the front desk staff had taken Hector’s bribe, after hesitating for a moment, he reached out to stop Mina.
“What are you doing? This person wants to rape me. Hurry up and help me call the police…”
Mina looked at the hotel receptionist, who stopped her and shouted.
“Don’t listen to her nonsense. She’s my girlfriend. We just had a little conflict just now!”
Hector shouted after hearing Mina’s words.
The hotel receptionist sized up Mina and said softly, “Why call the police when it’s just a couple’s squabble? Hurry up and go back!”
Mina finally understood after hearing what the receptionist said.
This receptionist was obviously in cahoots with Hector. Otherwise, he would never have stopped him.
Mina pushed the receptionist away and rushed to the street. She shouted, “Help! Help! Someone wants to rap…”
But before Mina could finish, Hector rushed out of the hotel and covered Mina’s mouth.
Then, he smiled and explained to the people on the street, “I’m sorry, everyone. I had a conflict with my girlfriend just now. She’s throwing a tantrum with me here…”
“Mngh…”
After Mina heard Hector’s words, she tried to struggle out of his grip.
However, Hector could not say a word because she had covered her mouth tightly.
“Everyone, stop crowding around. Go on your way now! The two are a couple. They were fine when they came but suddenly had a conflict.”
When the receptionist saw more and more onlookers at the door, he stepped forward and explained on Hector’s behalf.
After all, today’s incident was related to him. If something happened to Hector, he would be involved.
When everyone heard what the receptionist said, they nodded thoughtfully as if they understood.
If Hector were the only one who claimed this, it would naturally not be credible. However, this was still very credible if the receptionist also said this.
Hence, the passersby treated Mina and Hector as a couple who were quarreling. No one took Mina’s cry for help seriously and dispersed.
After Hector saw that the passersby had dispersed, he sighed in relief. Then, he dragged Mina into the hotel.
Mina struggled with all her might, but the effects of the drug had yet to wear off, so she simply did not have the strength to break free from Hector’s grip.
At the same time, in a car on the street.
Connor and Chloe had just left New Century Restaurant after dinner.
Chloe was about to drive Connor home and see if something could happen between them.
However, when they were less than 500 meters away from the restaurant, Connor was at the hotel entrance and saw Hector dragging Mina into the hotel..

chapters.title: Chapter 106 - 106: Kill Him For Me!
chapters.content:
Chapter 106: Kill Him For Me!
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
“Stop the car!”
When Connor saw this scene, he quickly shouted at Chloe.
“Mr. McDonald, what’s wrong?”
Chloe was stunned for a moment, then she stepped on the brakes and looked at Connor, puzzled.
Connor did not explain anything to her. Instead, he pushed open the car door and ran toward the hotel.
Mina and Hector were at the hotel’s entrance, and Connor knew that Hector had approached Mina to trick her into getting a room.
However, he never expected Hector to move so quickly. He had just confessed today and brought Mina to a hotel room.
Moreover, Connor could feel from Mina’s expression that Mina probably didn’t voluntarily come to get a room with Hector.
“Mr. McDonald, where are you going?”
Chloe saw Connor get out of the car and quickly shouted.
“Save someone!” Connor replied expressionlessly.
At this moment, Chloe also saw Mina and Hector at the hotel entrance.
She hurriedly grabbed Connor and said agitatedly, “Mr. McDonald, are you crazy? Have you forgotten how the two of them treated you before? If you go over now, people will say you’re meddling in other people’s business. Why do you have to go up and ask for trouble?”
Connor was stunned when he heard that. He couldn’t help but recall what Mina had said to him before.
However, after hesitating for two seconds, Connor felt he could not just watch Mina get tricked.
Therefore, he rushed across the road and ran into the hotel.
“Mr. McDonald, why are you doing this?” Chloe shouted helplessly.
When Connor entered the hotel, he found that Hector had already dragged Mina to the elevator door and was about to enter the elevator.
Seeing this scene, Connor could not care less and directly rushed over.
A loud thud sounded!
Connor directly punched Hector’s face, causing him to daze. He staggered back a few steps before supporting himself against the wall to stabilize his body.
“Conn… Connor?”
Mina stared at Connor, who descended from the sky, her face full of surprise.
“Am I late?”
Connor turned to look at Mina and asked calmly.
When Mina heard this, her eyes instantly became moist, and tears flowed.
At this moment, she was very regretful. She regretted not listening to Connor’s words back then. Even if she had only listened to a word of advice, today’s incident would not have happened.
Moreover, she had said so many outrageous things to Connor, and now Connor stood up to help her. Mina felt that she had gone too far back then.
“You little brat, I advise you to mind your business!”
Hector’s eyes widened as he shouted at Connor.
“I don’t care, you scum!”
Connor growled and rushed toward Hector.
Hector and Connor started fighting.
Connor was much stronger than Hector because he delivered food all year round. He pressed Hector to the ground and punched him in the face.
Hector’s head was like a bowling ball, which kept hitting the ground, making muffled sounds.
At this moment, Connor vented all the anger he had suppressed in his heart.
However, just as Mina felt that Connor had the upper hand and that she could escape from danger, a group of people rushed in from the hotel entrance again!
When Mina saw the leader, she was instantly dumbfounded!
The group leader was Mr. Knowles of Porthampton, a Twitch streamer.
Todd was passing by just now and noticed someone fighting in the hotel.
Therefore, he wanted to come in and watch the show but didn’t expect the person fighting to be Connor, so he hurriedly rushed in.

“What do I want to do?”
Maya sneered, then looked at Mina beside Connor and said softly, “Connor, I didn’t expect you to be able to trick such a beautiful woman into staying in a room with you. You’re quite capable!”
“Connor and 1 are just ordinary friends. It’s not the kind of relationship you think!”
Mina seemed to be disgusted by Maya’s words as she frowned.
“The two of you have already booked a room together, and you still say you’re just ordinary friends. Do you think 1’11 believe you?”
Maya smiled disdainfully.
“Maya, what are you trying to do?” Connor shouted at the top of his lungs.
“I didn’t want to do anything. 1 just bumped into you and came over to say hello. Can’t 1?”
Maya looked at the hotel before her and continued, “This hotel isn’t cheap, right? A delivery man like you shouldn’t be able to afford to stay in such a hotel. Did you use the living expenses my sister gave you to bring another woman to a hotel?”
When Mina heard this, she could not help but be stunned.
Then, he secretly guessed that Maya was the sister of the woman she saw at the neighborhood entrance.
Mina finally reacted. Although the misunderstanding with Hector had been resolved, the matter of Connor being kept by a woman had not been resolved.
Back then, Mina had thought Connor was Chloe’s kept woman, but it was just a guess. But now, Maya’s words made Mina think her guess was right.
A woman was keeping Connor!
“What does it have to do with you what money 1 used to get a room?” Connor said to Maya.
After Mina heard that, she was even more certain that a woman was keeping Connor. Otherwise, why didn’t Connor refute Maya now?
“Connor, you’re too shameless. How can you be so righteous when eating off a woman’s paycheck!”
Maya looked at Connor and raised her eyebrows. Then, she turned to Mina and said, “I advise you to stay away from Connor. He’s just a poor loser who gives takeout. He relies on the twenty thousand dollars my sister gives him monthly to cheat people. This person is simply shameless to the extreme!”
Mina looked at Maya without saying anything.
“Connor, I’ll tell Freya about you sleeping with another woman. I want her to get rid of you as soon as possible!” Maya turned her head and said to Connor before turning around and walking away.
Connor sighed helplessly as he watched Maya leave. He didn’t know what to say.
Mina was also looking at Connor strangely.
“Connor, you… Are you really being kept by a woman?”
Mina hesitated for a long time before biting her lip and asking softly.
“Mina, things aren’t how you think they are…” Connor tried to explain.
“You don’t have to explain to me. We are just ordinary friends. Even if you’re a kept man, it has nothing to do with me!” Mina heartlessly interrupted Connor’s words, then walked toward the street.
“Mina, listen to me. We…” Connor hurriedly chased after her.
“Connor, I’ve already told you our relationship hasn’t reached that stage yet.
You don’t have to explain anything to me!”
Mina looked at Connor and shouted before continuing, “Connor, 1 know you’ve always liked me. Although you’re a little poor, you’re kind-hearted and treat me very well. If you confessed to me, perhaps I’d agree, but 1 never expected you to be a gigolo who lives off a woman. You’ve disappointed me…”
Connor stared at Mina, stunned.
When did he say that he liked Mina?
Connor had always wanted a girlfriend. After all, he and Freya were just a couple in the title. If Freya had a boyfriend, Connor naturally had to find a girlfriend.
Mina’s figure and appearance were very good in all aspects and were indeed within Connor’s consideration. But right now, it wasn’t a matter of whether he liked her, right?
Also, Connor did not know he was now a gigolo!
“Connor, you’re an able man. If you don’t have money, you can earn it. Why do you have to live off a woman? You’re so useless!”
Mina looked at Connor and sneered. She then reached out to flag down a taxi and entered the car..

chapters.title: Chapter 112 - 112: The Revenge Plan
chapters.content:
Chapter 112: The Revenge Plan
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
After a while, Mina disappeared from Connor’s sight.
Connor looked very helpless. Because of his relationship with Mina, it was not easy to get relief.
At this moment, because of Maya’s appearance, the temperature instantly dropped to the freezing point.
After Mina left, Connor hailed a taxi and rushed to Porthampton University.
The scene at the entrance of the hotel made Maya mistakenly think that he had booked a room with Mina, and it also made Mina mistakenly think that he was a gigolo who was being kept by a woman.
However, Connor had never done these two things, so he was very troubled.
‘I guess it’s not easy to hide your identity!’
Connor sat in the taxi and could not help but sigh softly.
Twenty minutes later, Connor arrived at Porthampton University and entered the classroom.
As he was delayed at the hotel entrance, when Connor arrived at the classroom, most of the students had already arrived.
However, when Connor entered the classroom, all the students looked at him strangely.
Connor hesitated momentarily before walking to the back of the classroom and finding a seat next to Dominic.
“Did something happen in our class?” After Connor saw the strange gazes of his classmates, he was a little worried that his identity had been exposed, so he asked Dominic guiltily.
“Connor, tell me the truth. Did you really get all that money from the lottery?” Dominic asked with a serious expression.
“Yes… That’s right. Otherwise, how could I have so much money?”
Connor thought that his identity had been exposed, so he looked even more guilty. He stammered back.
“You’re not lying to me, right?” Dominic questioned.
“Of course not!” Connor nodded.
“That’s good!”
Dominic sighed a long sigh of relief and whispered, “Let me tell you, there has been a thief in our school recently. Although no one in our class has lost anything yet, people in the other classes have lost money one after another. You have to be careful recently!”
“Someone lost money?”
When Connor heard this, he couldn’t help but be stunned momentarily. Then, he instantly realized why the students in the class were looking at him with strange gazes. It turned out that they all mistook him for a thief!
“You asked me those questions just now because you suspected I was the thief, right?” Connor asked Dominic angrily.
Connor could still accept others doubting him, but he didn’t expect even his best buddy Dominic to doubt him.
“I’m not suspecting you. I’m just asking!” Dominic replied awkwardly.
“Connor, it’s normal for everyone to suspect you. After all, you spent so much money treating everyone to a meal a few days ago. Moreover, you’ve been spending money extravagantly recently. You’re like a completely different person from before. They will suspect you immediately!” Spencer said to Connor.
“Forget it. Let them think whatever they want. I’m not a thief anyway!” Connor hesitated and felt that what Spencer said made some sense.
After all, he used to be a poor loser who delivered food, but now he suddenly became a spendthrift. He was very different from before, so it was normal to doubt him.
“By the way, Dominic was the one who paid for our shift change fee just now!” Spencer looked at Connor and continued.
“I’ll return the money to you. How much is it?” Connor asked Dominic.
“Forget it. It’s not that much money. Treat me to a meal at noon and treat it as returning it to me!” Dominic said casually.
“Alright then!” Connor nodded.
In fact, Dominic had paid for Connor’s class fees because he knew Connor didn’t have any money. Then, Connor casually treated Dominic to a meal and treated it as paying him back.
Although Connor did not say anything, he had always remembered this in his heart.
“Click click click!”
As Connor was in a daze, high heels tapping on the ground came from outside the classroom.
When the students in the class heard the sound of footsteps, they instantly became alert.
Ms. Wallace carried teaching materials as she walked into the classroom.
Rachel was dressed very sexy today. She wore a tight black shirt exposing her fair and slender neck. She looked as beautiful as a swan under the contrast of the black shirt. The shirt tightly bound her full and round chest, outlining an alluring curve.
She was wearing a black skirt that wrapped around her hips. The skirt wrapped around her charming buttocks tightly, revealing a pair of tempting slender legs.
Seeing Rachel’s appearance, the male students in the class instantly became restless, all looking at Rachel with fiery gazes.
“I heard… There have been a few theft cases in our school recently. If any student loses something, you must report it to me immediately. Also, don’t bring expensive things to school!” Rachel put down the teaching materials in her hand and said softly.
When the students heard Rachel’s words, they all turned to look at Connor’s seat.
Rachel seemed to have noticed everyone’s gaze but did not say anything. Instead, she said expressionlessly, “Take out your handouts and get ready for class!”
Connor felt very uncomfortable when all the students in the classroom were looking at him.
However, he couldn’t be bothered to explain anything. After all, they would not believe it, no matter what Connor said.
***
At the entrance of the classroom.
Brandon, Mandy, May, Lily, May’s loyal bootlicker, Harvey, and others sat together and whispered.
“Harvey, are you ready?” Brandon narrowed his eyes and asked Harvey.
“Don’t worry, man. I’m ready!”
Harvey grinned and continued, “Eunice just collected the class fee today, and the money is still in her bag. When the students in the class leave, we just need to find a way to get Connor into the classroom and then put the class fee in Connor’s bag!”
“Hehe, Harvey, this move of yours is brilliant!”
Brandon smiled cunningly, then turned his head to look at Connor and said fiercely, “Connor, let’s see what you’re going to do this time. Fight with me, and you will die!”
“Why don’t we forget about this?” May said worriedly.
“Forget it? Why should 1 forget about it? Have you forgotten how Connor humiliated you a few days ago?” Mandy said to May unhappily.
“I’m just worried. What if someone finds out?” May said hesitantly.
“May, don’t worry. No one will find out about this!” Harvey said with a smile.
“So, who will do this?” Lily suddenly asked.
After everyone heard this, they all focused their gazes on Harvey.
“Harvey, didn’t you say that you like May? Now is the time for you to express your stance…”
Mandy was vicious, so she naturally wouldn’t let Brandon do such a thing.
After all, if this were really exposed, her reputation would be ruined, so she targeted Harvey.
Harvey hesitated, then nodded and said, “Alright then, I’ll do it!”
“Harvey, you…”
May started to speak.
“May, you don’t have to say anymore. I’m willing to do anything for you!”
Harvey looked at May affectionately.
After May heard Harvey’s words, she cursed him silently for being an idiot and then stopped talking..

chapters.title: Chapter 113 - 113: Ms. Wallace’s Concern
chapters.content:
Chapter 113: Ms. Wallace’s Concern
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
“Ring, ring, ring!”
Time passed very quickly.
After hearing the bell, Ms. Wallace announced that the class was over. Then, she took the textbook and walked out of the classroom.
“Ms. Wallace’s figure is cream of the crop. If I can find a girlfriend like this, I’m willing to be ten centimeters shorter…”
Spencer looked at Ms. Wallace’s charming figure and could not help but sigh softly.
“Ten centimeters shorter? Are you going to shrink everything else too?” Dominic looked at Spencer and said jokingly.
“Shrink your a*s. 1 am a well-endowed man…” Spencer replied unhappily.
After Connor heard the conversation between Dominic and the bespectacled man, he couldn’t help but recall the scene in Ms. Wallace’s dormitory.
Although Ms. Wallace was naturally charming and had a hot figure, the students in the class often fantasized about her in private.
However, Connor knew that although Ms. Wallace looked coquettish on the surface and usually dressed very sexily, she was very traditional in her bones. At least, she was not as open as everyone claimed.
“Connor!”
At this moment, Ms. Wallace, who had already left the classroom, suddenly walked back and stood at the door, talking to Connor.
“Ma’am, what’s wrong?”
After Connor heard Ms. Wallace call his name, he hurriedly stood up and asked with a puzzled expression.
“Come out with me, 1 have something to say to you!” Ms. Wallace said lightly and walked out of the classroom.
Connor hesitated for a moment before following Ms. Wallace out of the classroom.
After Dominic and Spencer saw Connor leave, doubt flashed in their eyes.
“Dominic, have you noticed that Connor and Ms. Wallace have been getting closer recently?” Spencer whispered to Dominic.
“A little!”
Dominic lightly nodded and then said with a wretched smile, “Do you think something is going on between Connor and Ms. Wallace?”
“What nonsense are you talking about? How could Ms. Wallace like Connor?” Spencer said speechlessly.
“How is it impossible? Isn’t Connor just a little poor? Other than being poor, he’s not bad looking, and he has a great figure. It’s not impossible for her to take a fancy to him!” Dominic replied softly.
When Spencer heard that, he was rendered speechless for a moment. Then, he said thoughtfully, “Dominic, what you said just now does make sense. Ms. Wallace’s family should be quite rich, and she doesn’t care if Connor is rich. Maybe the two of them are together!”
“We’ll ask Connor when he comes back!” Dominic nodded and said.
***
On the other side, after Connor and Ms. Wallace left the classroom.
Ms. Wallace walked to where no one was and then turned around to look at Connor.
At this moment, Connor was also looking at Ms. Wallace. He couldn’t help but think that Ms. Wallace was too charming. Her entire body was emitting an alluring aura.
Moreover, Connor was currently at the age where he was full of vigor. Even if he wanted to restrain the restlessness in his heart, he still could not help but look at Ms. Wallace’s fair long legs and the seductive curves wrapped in a short skirt.
Ms. Wallace’s figure was simply perfect.
Moreover, Ms. Wallace was not only good-looking, but her figure was also extremely good. She had a natural charm. Even her casual movements carried a seductive temperament that made people deeply immersed and unable to extricate themselves.
“You done looking?” Ms. Wallace suddenly chastised Connor.
“Ma’am, you’re too good-looking…” After Connor heard Ms. Wallace’s question, he quickly scratched his head and replied with a smile.
Ms. Wallace rolled her eyes at Connor, then took a name card from her pocket and said softly, “This is my friend’s business card. Her bar is opening this afternoon. The address of the bar is on the business card. You can go there if you don’t have classes in the afternoon. The salary is two hundred dollars a day. You get paid on the same day!”
“Thank you, Ms. Wallace!”
Although Connor didn’t want to be a bartender, he had already promised Ms. Wallace before, so he couldn’t reject her now.
“You don’t have to thank me. I’m your teacher!”
“But I must tell you, my friend has a bad temper. You’d better not provoke her!” Ms. Wallace warned.
“Alright!” Connor nodded again.
“Alright, that’s all I wanted to say. You can go back!” Ms. Wallace waved her hand at Connor, then turned around and prepared to leave.
Connor turned around and walked toward the classroom.
“Right, Connor!”
Just as Connor was about to return to the classroom, Ms. Wallace suddenly spoke again.
“Ms. Wallace, is there anything else?”
Connor turned his head and asked Ms. Wallace.
“Connor, there’s been a thief in our school recently. You should know about it, right?” Ms. Wallace looked at Connor and asked.
After Connor heard that, he could not help but frown because he felt Ms. Wallace’s words meant she was doubting him.
“I… I do!” Connor lightly nodded.
“It’s good that you know. You should be more careful these days. Don’t leave your wallet in the dormitory. Also, the students in the class might have misunderstood you, but it doesn’t matter. I know you’re not that kind of person. You don’t have to care about their opinions. When I find the thief, the truth will be revealed!” Ms. Wallace looked at Connor and said very seriously.
Connor looked at Ms. Wallace and felt an indescribable feeling in his heart.
He had thought Ms. Wallace would be like his classmates and misunderstood that he was the thief, so he felt very wronged.
But Connor did not expect that Ms. Wallace was comforting him.
“Alright, that’s all I wanted to say. Remember to go to work at the bar in the afternoon!”
After Ms. Wallace saw that Connor didn’t say anything, she turned around and walked away.
Connor looked at Ms. Wallace’s charming and moving back view, feeling myriad emotions in his heart.
Although Connor had inherited ten trillion dollars, some people would care about themselves from the bottom of their hearts, whether Connor was rich or not.
And Ms. Wallace was one of them!
“Connor, stop staring. It’s time for P.E. class!”
Dominic and Spencer walked out of the classroom and shouted at Connor.
“Yeah!” Connor replied indifferently, then turned around and followed Dominic and the others toward the sports field.
“Connor, you seem to be a little close to Ms. Wallace recently! Is there something going on between the two of you?” Spencer put his arm around Connor’s neck and asked with a smile.
“That’s right, Connor. Why does Ms. Wallace keep looking for you?” Dominic also asked.
“She looked for me because she wants me to work part-time at her friend’s bar. If the two of you want to work part-time, I can give you this opportunity!” Connor explained helplessly.
“All, forget it. I don’t want to do any part-time job!” Spencer quickly refused.
“I am not interested either…” Dominic added..

chapters.title: Chapter 114 - 114: A Premeditated Trap
chapters.content:
Chapter 114: A Premeditated Trap
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
At the same time, in the classroom.
Brandon, Mandy, May, Harvey, and others had been chatting in their seats. They had no intention of leaving the classroom.
A few minutes later, most of the students in the classroom had left.
Eunice was the only one sitting in her seat. Her expression conflicted.
Because at this moment, she had just collected the class fee in her bag. She was considering whether she should take it with her.
Brandon and the others knew very well that their plans would all be ruined if Eunice took away the class fees now.
Therefore, Brandon turned his head and winked at Mandy, May, and Lily.
Mandy reacted instantly. She stood up and walked to Eunice’s side. She smiled and said, “Eunice, why aren’t you leaving yet? Let’s go to P.E. class together!”
Eunice was about to speak when Lily walked up and held Eunice’s arm. Then, she said anxiously, “Eunice, what are you still waiting for? If you don’t go over now, you would be late! The PE teacher has a bad temper. If we’re late, we’ll be scolded…”
Mandy and Lily dragged Eunice out of the classroom.
After Brandon hesitated, he followed the girls out of the classroom.
After Eunice and the others left, only Harvey was left in the classroom.
***
Porthampton University, East Stadium.
All the students from the finance faculty had already arrived and lined up in a square. Only Harvey was late.
“Where’s the sports committee member of your class?” At this moment, a burly bald middle-aged man walked in front of everyone and shouted with an unhappy expression.
“Sir, Harvey went to the toilet. He should be here soon!” After Brandon heard this, he quickly shouted.
“This is outrageous. The sports committee member is late for P.E. class?”
The PE teacher frowned, looking very unhappy.
“Sir!” At this moment, Harvey ran over from the direction of the teaching building, panting heavily.
“Where did you go? How can you be late for PE class? How did you become a sports committee member?” The PE teacher’s eyes widened as he shouted angrily at Harvey.
When the students in the class heard the PE teacher, they all gloated.
Usually, Harvey relied on his status as a sports committee member to bully the students who went against him in class.
Now that Harvey had received his retribution, they were naturally happy.
“Hehe, I didn’t expect him to have such a day!”
Dominic looked at Harvey and cursed in a low voice.
“Teacher, I had to pee just now, so 1 went to the toilet!” Harvey explained in a low voice with a humble expression.
“Stop talking nonsense and quickly take attendance!” The PE teacher threw the attendance book to Harvey, found a cool place, and started looking at his phone.
Harvey began to call out names.
After the roll call, Harvey turned to the PE teacher and said, “Sir, everyone is here. Are we going to have a physical fitness test today?”
“Didn’t 1 tell you last time? First, run around the field, the girls can do whatever they want, the boys can play football, and finally, the physical fitness test. Are you out of your mind? You can’t even remember such a small thing!” the physical education teacher cursed agitatedly.
“Um, sir, I forgot to bring the footballs…” Harvey pretended to be helpless and said in a low voice.
“So why are you still standing there? Hurry up and go back to get them!”
At this time, the PE teacher was on the verge of exploding. Usually, Harvey would not make such a mistake, but today, he did not know what was wrong with him. First, he was late. Now, he even forgot to bring the footballs.
Harvey couldn’t help but snicker when he heard the PE teacher’s words.
He knew what he had to bring today, but he deliberately didn’t bring them because he could make Connor go back to the classroom openly.
According to Harvey’s dumb personality, he definitely couldn’t think of such a thorough plan. Brandon thought of all of this.
At this moment, Harvey was quite impressed by Brandon.
“Connor, quickly go to the classroom and bring the footballs over. The others will start the physical fitness test!” Harvey shouted at Connor.
“Harvey, you forgot to bring something. Why are you asking Connor to go get it?”
Dominic felt Harvey was deliberately making things difficult for Connor, so he retorted, upset.
“Yeah, the classroom is so far away from the field. Why did you ask Connor to go alone?” Spencer shouted.
“I am the sports committee member. Whoever I ask to go has to go. This is my right! Besides, I have to supervise everyone’s physical fitness test. Connor’s physical education results have always been good. What’s wrong with me asking him to go?” Harvey shouted with his eyes wide open.
“Connor can’t take so many footballs alone. I’ll go back with him!” Eunice suddenly offered.
When Harvey heard Eunice’s offer, he was stunned.
If Eunice returned to the classroom with Connor, their plot might be exposed.
Brandon, Mandy, and the others also seemed nervous.
“Eunice, today’s physical fitness test is quite important. You’d better not go back. After all, there aren’t many things to bring over!”
Harvey hesitated for a moment before he smiled and said to Eunice.
“But…”
Eunice started to speak.
“It’s okay. It’s just a few footballs. 1 can take them alone. 1’11 go back by myself!”
At this moment, Connor suddenly stood up and shouted expressionlessly.
When Harvey, Brandon, and the others heard Connor, they smiled smugly.
Originally, they still felt this was a little troublesome, but they did not expect Connor to take the initiative to stand up and say that he wanted to return alone. Things would be much simpler.
“Alright, Connor, hurry up and go back!” Harvey shouted at Connor.
Connor didn’t know this was a trap set up by Harvey and the others, so he didn’t hesitate and walked toward the classroom.
***
Ten minutes later, Connor returned to the field with a basket of footballs.
At this moment, the students in the class had also completed their physical fitness test.
Dominic, Spencer, and the others were resting under a big tree. When they saw Connor carrying so many things, they couldn’t help but say angrily, “Harvey has gone overboard. He made Connor carry so many things by himself!”
“These footballs are not very heavy. There’s no need to lower yourself to Harvey’s level!” Connor replied expressionlessly.
“Only you would put up with this, Connor. If it were anyone else, they would not go…”
“Ring, ring, ring!”
Before Dominic could finish, his phone suddenly rang.
“Cindy, what’s wrong?” Dominic took out his phone and answered the call.
“Dominic, what are you doing? I don’t have class this afternoon. How about 1 go over and hang out with you?” Cindy said with a smile.
“Okay, then come over in the afternoon!” Dominic quickly replied. Then, he looked at Connor at the side and said softly, “Oh right, Cindy, is your roommate Natasha coming along?”
At this moment, Dominic seemed to want to matchmake Connor and Natasha.
“Dominic, why are you asking this? Don’t tell me you still want to introduce Natasha to your poor roommate. Natasha is so beautiful, and her family is rich. How could she fall for Connor? And because of what happened last time, Natasha has been angry with me for a few days. You should let that loser give up. Natasha won’t like him!” Cindy commented angrily.
“Right… Alright then!” Dominic turned his head to look at Connor and replied awkwardly.
“Wait for me in the afternoon. See you!” After saying this, Cindy hung up the phone..

chapters.title: Chapter 115 - 115: Hanging Out With Connor
chapters.content:
Chapter 115: Hanging Out With Connor
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Porthampton Academy of Art, in the female dormitory.
After Cindy hung up the phone with Dominic, she went to the bathroom to shower and put on her makeup. After ensuring everything was fine, she got up and was prepared to leave the dormitory.
Actually, Cindy didn’t really want to go to Porthampton University to hang out with Dominic.
It was mainly because it was the end of the month now. She did not have much money, so she could only go to Dominic to get some food and drinks to survive this month.
However, before Cindy could leave the dormitory, Natasha, wearing a sexy short skirt, walked in with her high heels.
Natasha had a faint smile, and she seemed to be in a good mood.
When Cindy saw Natasha, she quickly lowered her head and her expression became awkward.
Cindy had always felt that she had let Natasha down by introducing her to someone like Connor, so she didn’t dare to look her in the eye.
“Cindy, are you going out?”
Natasha took the initiative to tell Cindy when she saw her fully armed appearance.
After Cindy heard Natasha’s words, she was stunned, she seemed very confused.
As she had introduced Connor to Natasha the last time, Natasha hadn’t spoken to her for a few days. But today, she took the initiative to greet her.
“Natasha, have you forgiven me?” Cindy asked Natasha with a puzzled expression after she saw that Natasha had taken the initiative to talk to her. “Forgive you? You didn’t do anything wrong. Why should I forgive you?” Natasha looked at Cindy and blinked as she asked with a smile.
“Natasha, did you lose your memory?” Cindy asked Natasha in a low voice. “What do you mean?” As Natasha spoke, she took a cup of bubble tea from her bag and handed it to Cindy. She said softly, “1 happened to pass by Nayuki Bubble Tea Shop and remembered that you especially like their bubble tea, so 1 specially bought you a cup…”
“Natasha, are you alright? Aren’t you angry at me? Why are you buying me bubble tea now? Are you agitated by Connor’s matter?”
Cindy dared not take the bubble tea from Natasha’s hands, afraid she would poison it. She couldn’t help but ask loudly.
After Natasha heard this, she finally understood what was going on. She couldn’t help but laugh.
But Cindy didn’t know that Natasha wouldn’t be angry at her for introducing her to Connor.
On the contrary, Natasha was very grateful to her for introducing her to a super-rich heir like Connor.
However, Natasha had her concerns. She would not tell Cindy Connor’s true identity because the more people knew about Connor’s identity, the more sl*ts would surround him.
By then, she would have more competitors.
It would be best if no one knew Connor’s true identity. That way, she could easily deal with Connor.
“Natasha, did you get agitated by that loser Connor? 1 admit that it was my fault, but back then, 1 didn’t know that the friend Dominic was talking about was Connor. I also knew that he wasn’t worthy of you. Can you not be like this? You’re scaring me!” Cindy said to Natasha with a self-reproachful expression when she saw Natasha’s silent expression.
“Sigh, Cindy, how could 1 blame you? I’ve long forgotten about Connor. You don’t have to take it to heart!”
Natasha looked at Cindy and smiled faintly.
“So… Natasha, do you forgive me now?” Cindy looked at Natasha and asked.
“Of course I forgive you!”
Natasha nodded heavily. She didn’t want to continue discussing this with Cindy, so she changed the topic. “Cindy, you’re dressed so beautifully. Where are you going?”
“I… I’m going to Porthampton University to hang out with Dominic!” Cindy stuttered.
She was confused by Natasha’s reaction. Natasha didn’t talk to her a few days ago because of Connor’s issue. Now, she said that she had forgiven her. What was going on?!
“Oh! Is Connor also at Porthampton University?” Natasha exclaimed, her expression excited as she asked Cindy.
“Yes… He is!” Cindy nodded lightly at Natasha.
“Then, 1’11 go with you. I’ll go see Connor!” Natasha said.
After Cindy heard Natasha’s words, her expression instantly turned into shock and confusion.
Natasha was going to hang out with Connor?
What the hell was this?
Natasha, who had previously despised Connor, seemed to have changed into a different person. She wanted to take the initiative to hang out with Connor. “Cindy, wait for me! I’ll go back and change my clothes!”
After Natasha found out that she would meet Connor, she became excited. She hurriedly entered the dormitory and walked toward the wardrobe.
Cindy looked at Natasha with a dumbfounded expression. Her mouth was agape, but she couldn’t say anything.
Cindy found it unbelievable that Natasha had taken the initiative to hang out with Connor. But now, Natasha wanted to change her clothes, too.
“Natasha, are you sure you want to see Connor?” Cindy asked Natasha doubtfully.
“Yeah, I have nothing to do in the afternoon anyway. I can accompany you to Porthampton University to have fun!” Natasha replied with a smile. Then, she took a few sets of clothes from the wardrobe and held them in front of the mirror.
However, Natasha was still a little dissatisfied, so she changed several more sets of clothes.
“I get it now!” Cindy stood at the dormitory door and said to Natasha, who was carefully choosing her clothes.
After Natasha heard this, she turned to look at Cindy and asked with a puzzled expression, “You get it? What do you know?”
“Natasha, you’re going to Porthampton University to take revenge on Connor, right?” Cindy said to Natasha seriously.
“Revenge on Connor?”
Natasha was taken aback. A trace of confusion flashed in her beautiful eyes.
“Well, yeah. Connor pretended to be a rich kid and lied to you at the bar a few days ago. You must be thinking of going to Porthampton University to take revenge on Connor, right?”
Cindy felt that based on Natasha’s personality, she definitely wouldn’t fall for Connor.
But now, Natasha was taking the initiative to look for Connor. It was obvious that she wanted to take revenge on him.
“Uhm…”
After Natasha heard Cindy, her expression became a little absent-minded. For a moment, she didn’t know how to answer her.
“Natasha, don’t worry. I will cooperate with you and humiliate Connor…” To express her apology to Natasha, Cindy vowed.
“Right… Okay!” Natasha didn’t know how to explain this to Cindy, so she could only agree helplessly.
“Alright, you don’t have to change. You look good in anything. Let’s go quickly!”
Cindy couldn’t wait to go to Porthampton University to humiliate Connor.
Natasha looked at Cindy helplessly and followed her out of the dormitory..

chapters.title: Chapter 116 - 116: Did I Pretend to Be a Rich Heir?
chapters.content:
Chapter 116: Did I Pretend to Be a Rich Heir?
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
On the other side.
University of Rivertown, East Stadium.
Time passed very quickly.
As the P. E. class was the last in the morning, the students walked toward the cafeteria after hearing the bell.
“Dominic, Spencer, I’ll treat the two of you to a meal today!”
Connor turned and said to Dominic and Spencer.
“Sure, I’m a little hungry too!” Dominic grinned and agreed readily.
He knew Connor treated him and Spencer to a meal because he had paid Connor’s class fee.
Spencer did not refuse. The three of them walked straight to the cafeteria.
But not long after, Dominic’s phone suddenly rang.
Dominic hurriedly stopped and took out his phone to answer the call. He said softly, “Cindy, are you here already?”
“Yeah, Natasha and I are already at the entrance of Porthampton University. Come and pick us up quickly!” Cindy replied with a smile.
“What is it? Natasha is here too?” When Dominic heard this, he exclaimed.
“Yup, Natasha came with me. You can ask your roommate Connor to come along too. Natasha is here to see him!” Cindy said slowly.
After Dominic heard this, he seemed even more shocked.
Previously, he had wanted Cindy to bring Natasha over and explain to her what had happened at the bar. However, Cindy said that Natasha would not be coming over again.
But now, Natasha took the initiative to look for Connor.
“What is going on?”
After hanging up the phone, Dominic couldn’t help but mutter softly. He seemed very puzzled.
He really couldn’t understand what Natasha and Cindy were up to.
Previously, Dominic took the initiative to ask Cindy to bring Natasha over, but Cindy was very certain that Natasha would not come to Porthampton University again.
But now, Natasha took the initiative to come over and even said she was there to look for Connor.
Dominic faintly felt that Natasha and Cindy’s actions today were slightly off.
“What’s wrong, bro?” Spencer asked with a frown when he saw Dominic’s expression.
“Nah… It’s nothing!”
Dominic nodded and continued, “Cindy and Natasha are at our school. They’re at the school gate now!”
“Natasha? Is she the girl you introduced to Connor previously?” When Spencer heard Natasha’s name, he seemed doubtful.
“Yes, that girl!” Dominic lightly nodded.
“Didn’t she say at the bar yesterday that she didn’t want to see Connor anymore? What is she doing here today?” Spencer asked softly.
“I don’t know either. Cindy said she is here to look for Connor!” Dominic said slowly.
“Look for Connor?”
Spencer was even more confused when he heard this. He narrowed his eyes and said, “Previously, she despised Connor. Why is she looking for Connor now?”
“I don’t know either!” Dominic helplessly shook his head, then looked at Connor and asked, “Connor, do you want to see Natasha? It’s fine if you don’t want to see her. I’ll tell them that you’re not in school…”
“Since she’s here, let’s meet!” Connor replied indifferently.
“Alright, the two of them are at the school gate now. Let’s go over!”
After Dominic saw that Connor did not object, he headed to the school gate.
Spencer followed Connor and said softly to Connor, “Connor, I feel that Natasha does not have simple intentions when she’s here to look for you today. You’d better be careful!”
“I know!” Connor looked at Spencer and smiled faintly.
Although Dominic, Spencer, and Connor didn’t know why Natasha came to find him today, Connor knew very well.
Now that Natasha knew Connor was a super-rich kid. She naturally wanted to take the initiative to curry favor with him and even seduce him.
Connor had indescribable feelings toward Natasha. He didn’t like her, but he didn’t hate her either.
Of course, Connor didn’t think of being together with Natasha because he knew Natasha only approached him for his money.
It was impossible for Connor to find a woman willing to sell her body for money to be his girlfriend.
But if they were just friends, Connor could still accept it.
Five minutes later.
When Connor and the other two arrived at the school gate, they saw Cindy and Natasha waiting.
Natasha was wearing a white dress with spaghetti straps. Her black wavy hair was casually draped over her shoulders. Her figure was tall and sexy, and her long, fair legs were smooth and delicate. It was almost impossible to take one’s eyes off her as if everything around her had been overshadowed. The noble and cold temperament on her body was natural, and her every move was elegant.
On the other hand, Cindy, standing beside Natasha, looked much weaker.
“Cindy!” Dominic greeted Cindy politely.
Cindy and Natasha turned to look at Connor and Dominic.
When Cindy saw Connor, her beautiful eyes flashed with disdain. She turned to Natasha and whispered, “Natasha, that stinky loser is here. How do you plan to humiliate him…”
However, before Cindy could finish her sentence, she realized that Natasha had already run to Connor. She said excitedly to Connor, “Conn… Connor, you’re here?”
When everyone saw Natasha taking the initiative to greet Connor and in such a tone, their jaws fell, and they looked on incredulously.
“What is Natasha doing? Why did you take the initiative to talk to that poor b*stard Connor?”
Cindy looked at Natasha, confused.
Dominic and Spencer’s eyes widened, and they looked at this scene in a daze. They were no better than Cindy.
They felt that Natasha was completely different from the person she was when they met her at the bar.
Connor turned his head to look at Natasha, nodded coldly, and didn’t say anything else.
“Connor, what kind of attitude is this? Natasha took the initiative to talk to you. It’s fine if you don’t speak but act so cold. Who do you think you are?”
Cindy was very dissatisfied with Connor’s attitude. She glared at him with fox-like eyes and stepped forward to chastise him.
“What does it have to do with you whether I speak or not?” Connor looked at Cindy and coldly replied.
“Gosh, you’re just a poor loser delivering food. You’re still putting on airs with me, right?”
After Cindy heard Connor’s words, she became even more furious. She pointed at Connor’s nose and coldly scolded him, “Don’t be so shameless! I haven’t settled the score with you for pretending to be a rich kid at the bar last time. Why are you so arrogant?”
“When did I pretend to be a rich kid?”
Connor looked at Cindy and couldn’t help but sneer. He felt that it was all a little comical.
Since when did he have to pretend to be a rich kid?
He was a super-rich heir!

chapters.title: Chapter 117 - 117: Phillips’ Signature
chapters.content:
Chapter 117: Phillips’ Signature
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
“You know very well when you were pretending to be rich!
“Natasha happens to be here today. Apologize to her now. Maybe Natasha will be in a good mood today and forgive you!” Cindy berated Connor.
When the students passing by heard Cindy’s words, they stopped and turned to look at Cindy, Connor, and the others.
When Cindy saw that more and more students were gathering around, a smug smile appeared.
She felt that Connor had to apologize to Natasha in front of everyone. This was the only way to completely humiliate Connor and eliminate the estrangement between her and Natasha.
“Cindy, isn’t the matter from that incident in the past? Why are you still holding that grudge?”
Although Dominic had long expected Natasha’s visit this time was not purely to hang out with Connor.
However, he didn’t expect Cindy to go so far as to make Connor apologize to Natasha in front of so many people. Wasn’t this humiliating?
“He pretended to be a rich kid at the bar and embarrassed Natasha in front of so many people. What’s wrong with me asking him to apologize to Natasha now?” Cindy said confidently.
“Cindy, don’t go too far!” Spencer couldn’t stand it anymore. He stepped forward and pointed at Cindy.
“I am going too far? How am 1 going too far? If Connor doesn’t apologize to Natasha today, Natasha and I will leave now!”
Cindy felt that with Connor’s character, he would apologize, so she dared to speak arrogantly.
“Then leave!”
However, no one expected Connor to speak up suddenly.
Cindy couldn’t help but be stunned when she heard Connor. She gritted her teeth and said, “Connor, I hope you don’t regret it. I wanted to give you a chance to make Natasha forgive you, but I didn’t expect you to be so ungrateful. Natasha, let’s go!”
After saying this, Cindy dragged Natasha and wanted to leave.
However, after Cindy tugged at her, she realized that Natasha was still standing there without any intention of leaving.
“Natasha, what are you still standing here for? If this loser doesn’t apologize to you, let’s go!” Cindy prompted Natasha in confusion.
“If you want to leave, then leave. I’m not leaving…” Natasha replied coldly.
After Cindy heard that, she was stunned and very confused.
She had originally planned to use this opportunity to threaten Connor and make him apologize to Natasha.
However, she didn’t expect Connor to refuse to apologize. What was even more unexpected to Cindy was that Natasha had no intention of leaving.
Cindy was completely dumbfounded. She opened her mouth but couldn’t say anything.
“Natasha, he refused to apologize to you. What are you still standing here for?” Cindy asked Natasha with a puzzled expression.
After Natasha heard Cindy’s words, she asked in disdain, “When did I say that 1 wanted Connor to apologize?”
“Natasha, what…”
Cindy looked at Natasha with confusion.
“Previously at the bar, Connor did not say he was a rich kid. We just misunderstood him. This time, 1 specially came to apologize to Connor!”
After speaking, Natasha walked up to Connor and said softly, “Connor, we have misunderstood you regarding the previous meet up. 1 am sorry…”
Hearing Natasha’s words, Dominic and the surrounding students widened their eyes in shock.
Connor should have been the one apologizing to Natasha, but now Natasha took the initiative to apologize to Connor. What was going on?
Seeing Natasha’s actions, everyone present was dumbfounded.
“It’s alright!” Connor looked at Natasha and replied indifferently.
“Cindy, what are you waiting for? Hurry up and apologize to Connor!” Natasha turned her head and said to Cindy.
“Natasha, why? Why should we apologize to this loser?” Cindy retorted agitatedly.
“We were in the wrong in the first place. I shouldn’t have left so abruptly back then. Is there a problem with me apologizing to Connor now?” Natasha replied coldly.
“Even if… Even if you shouldn’t have left, 1 won’t apologize to him. Who does he think he is?” Cindy pouted.
“Cindy, if you don’t apologize to Connor today, I’ll cut ties with you!” Natasha said coldly.
“Natasha, what happened to you? You want to end our friendship with me because of Connor?”
At this moment, Cindy felt Natasha’s brain wasn’t working properly. In less than two days, Natasha’s attitude toward Connor had drastically changed.
Dominic, Spencer, and the others were also puzzled.
“Are you apologizing or not?” Natasha asked Cindy impatiently.
ii H
Cindy stood rooted to the ground, feeling very conflicted. Then, she reluctantly approached Connor and whispered, “I’m sorry. I shouldn’t have said that about you previously…”
Connor glanced at Cindy indifferently and ignored her.
Although he could forgive Natasha and choose to be friends with her, it did not mean he would forgive Cindy.
This was because Cindy was a typical gold digger who used her beauty to get money.
In addition, Cindy had always treated Dominic as a back burner, playing with Dominic’s feelings. This made Connor hate Cindy very much.
“Alright, since the misunderstanding has been resolved, all is well!”
After Dominic saw Connor not speaking, he hurriedly stood up to smooth things over.
Then, he turned to Cindy and said, “Have you two eaten? Why don’t we eat together at the cafeteria? Connor is treating today!”
The canteen of Porthampton University was not expensive—a meal cost at most fifteen or sixteen dollars.
That was why Dominic deliberately said that Connor was treating. This could be considered as helping Connor’s reputation.
Although Cindy had apologized to Connor, she was still very unconvinced in her heart.
When she heard Connor would treat her to a meal, she quickly pursed her lips and said, “Natasha and I came all the way here. You guys aren’t considering treating us to lousy cafeteria food, are you?”
“If we don’t go to the cafeteria, where else do you want to go? Shall 1 take you to Brasserie Le Bernardin?” Spencer also hated Cindy and couldn’t help but snap loudly.
“There’s no need for Brasserie Le Bernardin. I heard that your school has a good restaurant that seems pretty good. Why don’t we go there for dinner?” Cindy said slowly.
“Phillips’ Signature?”
When Dominic and Spencer heard this, they were momentarily stunned. Then, they secretly sighed in their hearts that Cindy was ruthless!
The school specially prepared Phillips’ Signature for those rich kids. A casual meal was enough for them to eat in the cafeteria for a month.
Not to mention Connor, even Dominic and Spencer did not have the money to eat at Phillips’ Signature.
“What’s wrong? Don’t tell me you can’t bear to spend this little money?” Cindy said with disdain after seeing Connor, Dominic, and the others fall silent..

chapters.title: Chapter 118 - 118: Connor’s Improving
chapters.content:
Chapter 118: Connor’s Improving
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
“Cindy, Phillips’ Signature is quite expensive. Look…” Dominic opened his mouth, wanting to persuade Cindy.
But Connor suddenly said, “Alright, since you want to go to Philip’s Restaurant, let’s go!”
After hearing Connor’s words, Spencer, Dominic, and the others turned to look at Connor with a puzzled expression.
They had never thought that Connor would agree.
Connor agreed to Cindy’s request wasn’t because he was afraid of Cindy, but because of Dominic and Spencer.
In any case, Connor had inherited ten trillion dollars of inheritance now. He did not care about the money for food at all.
In the three years of university, Dominic and Spencer had been helping Connor silently, so Connor could take this opportunity to treat them to a good meal.
“Connor, are you sure you want to go to Phillips’ Signature?” Dominic looked at Connor and asked.
“Yes!”
Connor nodded gently, then turned around and walked into the school.
Natasha quickly walked to Connor’s side and started to chat with him.
Seeing Natasha’s abnormal behavior, Cindy, Dominic, and Spencer were all confused. They could not understand why Natasha was so passionate about Connor.
Although there were many beauties at Porthampton University, seeing a beauty like Natasha was still very rare.
In Connor’s impression, Natasha was one of the best beauties he knew. She was slightly inferior to Freya and was on par with Mina.
As for girls like Mandy and May, they were no match compared to Natasha.
Therefore, when Natasha appeared at Porthampton University, she immediately attracted the attention of many people.
However, when the students saw Natasha taking the initiative to talk to Connor, they were all surprised.
They couldn’t understand why such a beautiful girl would be with a lame delivery boy. Moreover, it seemed like Natasha was very passionate about Connor.
A few minutes later, Connor and the others arrived at Phillips’ Signature.
After entering Phillips’ Signature, everyone could feel that the interior of this place was much more stylish than the cafeteria.
If one weren’t a rich kid, he wouldn’t have come to such a place to eat.
Most of the students in the cafeteria were dressed in bright and beautiful clothes. They were also wearing branded items.
At this moment, Connor was wearing a set of street goods. It was obvious that he did not fit in with this place.
Just as Connor and the others walked into the restaurant, a few people eating in the corner looked at Connor simultaneously.
“Isn’t this the girl from the bar that day? Why did she come here to eat with Connor?” May saw Natasha beside Connor and couldn’t help but mutter softly.
“How could Connor afford to eat at such a place? And what was up with that girl? Why is she still with Connor?”
When Mandy saw Natasha taking the initiative to talk to Connor, a trace of jealousy flashed in her eyes.
She could not accept that Connor could find a new girlfriend so quickly, nor could she accept that Connor’s new girlfriend was prettier than her.
She couldn’t wait for Connor’s life to deteriorate after she abandoned him. Only then could she prove that she was right to leave Connor!
However, what Mandy did not expect was that not only did Connor not get worse, but his life had improved!
“Connor has the money to come here to eat. That means that the thief in our school must be Connor, and Connor must have cheated that girl with money!” Brandon squinted and said softly.
“This bastard, I’m going to expose him now!”
Hearing this, Mandy stood up and walked toward Connor.
When Brandon saw that Mandy was ready to expose Connor, he quickly reached out and grabbed Mandy, then said expressionlessly, “Where are you going?”
“Connor must be using the money he stole to cheat people. He invited others here for a meal. I want to expose him in front of everyone!” Mandy gritted her teeth and replied in a low voice.
“Why are you so impulsive? Do you have any evidence to expose him now?” Brandon said helplessly.
“Yeah, Mandy, we’ve already set up a trap. In the afternoon, the class monitor will discover her missing money. By then, we’ll catch him red-handed and expose Connor in front of the whole class. If you expose Connor now, you’ll only alert the enemy!” Lily quickly advised.
H ii
After Mandy heard what Lily said, she was taken aback for a moment and then sat back down.
“Don’t worry. Connor will be beaten back to his original state soon. When the time comes, I want everyone to know that Connor is a thief. The school will expel him!” Brandon said to Mandy with a smile.
Mandy turned her head to look at Connor’s position and said coldly, “Connor, let’s see how long you can pretend. After today, you’re no longer a student of Porthampton University…”
Brandon hesitated momentarily, secretly took out his phone and took a photo of Connor, then pretended to eat with his head down.
***
On the other side.
Connor noticed Mandy, Brandon, and the others when he walked into the restaurant.
However, what surprised Connor was that Mandy and the others did not take the initiative to find trouble with him.
Connor felt that Mandy and the others should have learned their lesson after the last lesson so they did not dare to find trouble with him.
Connor was unbothered and casually found a seat to sit down.
When the waiter saw Connor and the others sit down, he hurriedly came up with the menu.
However, when the waiter saw Connor’s poor appearance, he chose to ignore him.
He felt Connor must have followed his classmates to eat at this place, so he handed the menu to Natasha and said with a smile, “Ma’am, what would you like to have?”
“I’m fine with anything. Let Connor order!”
Natasha took the menu and handed it to Connor.
When the waiter saw Natasha’s actions, a hint of confusion flashed in his eyes.
“This is the first time a country bumpkin like Connor has come to a proper restaurant to dine. How could he possibly know how to order? Let me do it!” Cindy commented, then snatched the menu from Natasha’s hands and began to order.
“Give me a Marseille fish soup first, then a Paris lobster, and French borscht…”
Cindy knew it was Connor’s treat today and ordered without hesitation. In a short while, she ordered seven or eight dishes.
When Dominic and Spencer heard what Cindy ordered, their expressions turned ugly.
This restaurant was not cheap. Cindy had ordered a few dishes, and it had cost nearly 1,000 dollars!
Dominic and Spencer were worried about whether Connor had the money to pay the bill.
But at this moment, Connor seemed very calm.
“Give me another serving of French foie gras…” Cindy didn’t seem to have any intention of stopping.
“… Cindy, that’s enough. There are only five of us. We won’t be able to finish it even if you order so much!” Dominic couldn’t stand it anymore and quickly persuaded Cindy.
Cindy glanced at the menu and hesitated momentarily before saying softly, “I still have a caviar I haven’t ordered…”
“You have ordered so much. Can you finish them all?” Spencer asked Cindy in displeasure.
“Why not?” Cindy replied indignantly.
“Since she can eat, let her order!” Connor suddenly spoke..

chapters.title: Chapter 119 - 119: Pretending To Be A Boyfriend
chapters.content:
Chapter 119: Pretending To Be A Boyfriend
Translator: End less Fantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
When everyone heard this, they turned to look at Connor with puzzled expressions.
They felt that Natasha wasn’t the only abnormal person today. Connor was also acting very abnormal.
When Cindy heard Connor allowing her to order whatever she wanted, she was also very surprised.
She had ordered so many things not because she wanted to eat but purely because she wanted to make things difficult for Connor.
However, she realized that Connor was unperturbed. She was disappointed and said, “Do you think I’ll order just because you want me to? 1 won’t order then!”
After saying this, Cindy handed the menu to the waiter beside her and said softly, “That’s all for now!”
“Alright, i’ll get the kitchen to prepare it immediately!” the waiter replied respectfully, leaving with the menu.
“I’m going to the restroom!” Natasha stood up and whispered to Connor.
“Sure!” Connor nodded.
After Cindy saw Natasha leave, she hurriedly followed Natasha to the restroom.
After Cindy left, Dominic asked Connor, “Connor, what’s going on between you and Natasha? Why do 1 feel that there’s something wrong with the two of you today?”
“That’s right. Didn’t she just leave at the bar that day? Why does she seem to be closer to you today?” Spencer asked.
“After i left the bar that day, i secretly added Natasha’s WeChat and explained everything to her. She forgave me!”
Connor naturally wouldn’t say that Natasha treated him like this because she knew his identity as a rich heir. He could only find an excuse to deal with it.
“I didn’t expect you to be so influential!”
Dominic looked at Connor and smiled. Then, a trace of helplessness flashed across his face as he said softly, “Connor, do you still have money on hand? Is it enough to pay for today’s meal? It’s the end of the month now, and I just paid the class fee today. I don’t have much money left!”
“Don’t worry. Ms. Wallace introduced me to a part-time job in a bar. 1 have some money now, so it shouldn’t be a problem for me to pay for it!” Connor looked at Dominic and said with a smile.
“Oh, that’s good!”
Dominic looked at Connor and nodded, not saying anything more.
***
Meanwhile.
Cindy and Natasha went to the restroom.
“Natasha, what’s wrong with you today? Didn’t we agree to humiliate Connor together? Why did you suddenly become a different person? Not only did you not help me humiliate Connor, but you even asked me to apologize to Connor!” Cindy pouted as she looked at Natasha, who was touching up her makeup in front of the mirror.
“When did I say I wanted to humiliate Connor?” Natasha replied nonchalantly.
“Natasha… Didn’t you come here today to humiliate Connor?”
Cindy was stunned for a moment.
“i didn’t come here to humiliate Connor!”
“So why are you here?”
Cindy looked at Natasha and asked, puzzled.
“I came here today to ask Connor to be my boyfriend!” Natasha said methodically as she touched up her foundation.
“Ask… Ask Connor… To be your boyfriend?”
Cindy was stunned when she heard Natasha’s words.
“Natasha, are you crazy? Why do you want Connor to be your boyfriend? He’s just a poor loser who delivers food!”
After Cindy heard Natasha’s words, she couldn’t help but inhale sharply as she exclaimed.
” Yeah, i know he’s a poor loser who delivers food, but I want a poor loser to be my boyfriend now!”
Natasha put away her compact powder and said calmly.
“Why? There are so many rich kids pursuing you in our school! Why do you want a loser to be your boyfriend?” Cindy asked hysterically.
When Natasha heard Cindy, she couldn’t help but laugh secretly in her heart.
Compared to Connor, those rich kids were on a completely different level!
Of course, Natasha didn’t want to expose Connor’s identity yet, so she could only reply casually, “Because… 1 don’t really want Connor to be my boyfriend, but 1 want him to be a temporary placeholder…”
“Temporary placeholder? What does that mean?”
Cindy was still confused.
“What else could it be? Leon Lynch from our school has been harassing me. Although Leon’s family background is not bad, he’s too ugly. To stop him from pestering me, 1 decided to ask Connor to be my boyfriend. This way, Leon would leave me alone. Do you understand what 1 mean?” Natasha said helplessly.
“Oh, 1 see!”
Cindy nodded in a half-understanding manner and continued, “But Natasha, even if you want to find someone to pretend to be your boyfriend, you don’t have to find someone like Connor. Connor is just a delivery boy. How embarrassing would it be if word got out?”
“I chose Connor because i was embarrassed. 1 want Leon to understand that I, Natasha, am not a materialistic girl. No matter how rich his family is, if 1 don’t like him, 1 just don’t. 1 don’t want him to send me roses every day in the future. I’m going to be annoyed to death by him!”
Natasha had been thinking about this excuse for a long time. Just now, she was too enthusiastic toward Connor, which would arouse Cindy’s suspicion.
The entire art academy would know if Cindy found out about Connor’s identity. That was why she made up such an excuse.
“Oh, 1 understand what you mean!”
Cindy nodded at Natasha, then said regretfully, “Actually, 1 think Leon is quite good. Isn’t he just a little ugly? But he’s honest. At least he won’t sleep with other women behind your back. Besides, his family is rich!”
“Although Connor doesn’t have money, he’s quite good-looking. That’s why 1 chose Connor to be my boyfriend. After Leon completely gives up on me, I’ll just dump Connor, right?”
Natasha stood in front of the mirror. After confirming that her face was flawless, she turned to look at Cindy in satisfaction.
Cindy still couldn’t understand Natasha’s actions. After all, in her eyes, it didn’t matter whether a man was handsome or not. The key was money.
If a rich kid like Leon would take the initiative to pursue her, Cindy would agree without thinking.
“By the way, don’t tell Connor about this. I’m using him now. He won’t agree to be with me if he knows the truth!” Natasha whispered to Cindy.
“Natasha, don’t worry, I know what to do! And even if Connor knew, what can he do? He’s just a poor loser. To find a girlfriend like you, he can wake up laughing even in his dreams!” Cindy pouted and said disdainfully.
After Natasha heard Cindy’s words, she couldn’t help but snicker in her heart.
If Connor could become her boyfriend, the person who would wake up smiling in her dreams would not be Connor but Natasha herself.
The naive Cindy thought that Natasha was only doing this to make use of Connor, so she didn’t think much of it..

chapters.title: Chapter 120 - 120: Apologize To My Girlfriend
chapters.content:
Chapter 120: Apologize To My Girlfriend
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Meanwhile…
Connor and Dominic sat at the dining table and waited for a few minutes.
The waiter in the kitchen suddenly shouted, “Gentlemen, your dishes are ready. Please come and pick them up!”
Although Phillips’ Signature was the best restaurant at Porthampton University, there were many rich heirs in the school. So the waiters in the dining hall were simply too busy. Usually, during the peak hours, the students would fetch their food.
When Connor, Dominic, and the others heard the waiter’s call, they hurriedly stood up and walked toward the counter.
“I didn’t expect Phillips’ Signature to be like our cafeteria. We have to get our food!”
It was also Dominic’s first time coming to such a place. He casually picked up a dish and said with a smile.
“Yeah, this is my first time eating here. I don’t know if it’s good or not!” Spencer replied.
“If you two like it, 1 can bring you here often in the future!” Connor said softly after hearing the conversation between Dominic and Spencer.
“Come here often?”
Dominic looked at Connor and couldn’t help but be stunned momentarily. Then, he frowned and said, “Connor, today’s meal will cost more than a thousand dollars. If you come over to eat often in the future, I think you’ll go bankrupt after two meals…”
“Haha…” Connor smiled but didn’t say anything.
Dominic and Spencer left with the dishes. A bowl of Marseilles fish soup was still left in the dining area. Connor picked up the fish soup and walked toward their seats.
But before Connor could walk far, a figure suddenly rushed before him.
“All!” A scream followed.
A girl in a denim dress was so anxious that she didn’t notice Connor, so she bumped into Connor.
The Marseille fish soup in Connor’s hand instantly toppled over and spilled directly onto the girl’s skirt.
“Baby, are you okay?” A short fatty ran up from behind after hearing the girl’s scream and asked the girl in a panic.
“Babe, this bastard deliberately bumped into me just now and dirtied my dress!”
When the girl saw that the fish soup dirtied her dress, she shouted aggrievedly.
■I ii
The fatty’s face instantly darkened when he heard the girl’s words.
Then, he raised his head and looked at Connor before him. His eyes were cold as he said, “It’s you, kid!”
At this moment, Connor ] carefully sized up the boy before him.
Connor realized that this boy was his high school classmate. His name was Zach Zabinski, but because he was relatively fat, everyone liked to call him Zach the Fatty.
Zach’s family was in the real estate business. When he was in high school, his family’s conditions were very good. He often relied on his family’s wealth to do evil and bully Connor.
In recent years, Zach the Fatty’s family’s real estate business had risen with the tide. They had earned much money from real estate, and Zach the Fatty’s personality had become even more arrogant and domineering.
“Hah, 1 was wondering who it was. It’s you, Connor!”
Zach was worried that it would be difficult for him if his girlfriend offended the rich kids of Porthampton University.
After all, there was much hidden wealth at Porthampton University. Although Zach’s family had some money, it didn’t mean he could afford to provoke anyone.
However, when he saw Connor, his anxious heart instantly relaxed. He took two steps forward and said, “Connor, you’re working as a waiter at Phillips’ Signature now, right?”
“I’m here to dine!” Connor replied calmly.
“You came here to eat?”
Zach looked at Connor and could not help but laugh. Then, he said disdainfully, “A poor loser like you can afford to eat here? Do you know how much it costs to eat here? Do you even have enough to eat in the cafeteria?”
After Connor heard Zach’s words, he looked at him disgustedly.
As Dominic and the others were present, Connor didn’t want to continue talking nonsense with him, so he said, “Just now, your girlfriend bumped into me and knocked over my dish. We’re old classmates, so 1 won’t hold this matter against you!”
“Nonsense. You were the one who bumped into me just now, and you even got the soup on my dress!”
The girl beside Zach hurriedly accused.
Connor ignored her and wanted to leave.
Zach suddenly stopped Connor. Then, he sneered and said, “Connor, it’s not a matter of whether you want to hold a grudge against me. It’s a matter of you dirtying my babe’s dress. Don’t you have to give me an explanation?”
Not far away, Brandon, Mandy, and the others narrowed their eyes and looked in Connor’s direction with a gloating expression. They couldn’t wait to see Connor make a fool of himself.
Mandy had originally planned to expose Connor in front of everyone, but after considering their plan, she did not want to alert the enemy.
But now that Zach had suddenly appeared, they could watch the drama.
Dominic and Spencer also noticed the situation here.
“Aren’t you being unreasonable? It was your girlfriend who bumped into Connor just now. It’s already good enough that we didn’t ask you to compensate us. You want us to give you an explanation?” Dominic walked over and shouted angrily at Zach.
“Who are you? Do you have evidence proving that my girlfriend bumped into Connor?” Zach replied aggressively.
After Dominic heard Zach’s words, he was speechless because he had no evidence to prove that the girl had bumped into Connor.
Moreover, he had left earlier, so he did not see how the collided.
“What do you want now?” Connor asked Zach.
“You dirtied my babe’s clothes. On account of us being classmates, 1’11 give you two choices. The first is to compensate, and the second is to kneel and apologize to her. Take a pick!” Zach said arrogantly.
“Kneel and apologize?” After Connor heard this, something strange flashed in his eyes.
“How much do you want?”
Dominic didn’t want to make a big deal out of it, so he hesitated momentarily and asked Zach.
“I bought this denim skirt for two thousand dollars!” After the girl heard Dominic’s words, she pouted and said delicately.
When Dominic and Spencer heard the amount, they were stunned, their faces full of shock.
They had never expected that this girl’s dress would be so expensive!
Two thousand dollars! Dominic simply couldn’t take out that much money now!
Not far away, Brandon, Mandy, and the others saw this scene, and their faces suddenly bloomed with smiles.
In their impression, Connor would never be able to take out two thousand dollar, so Connor would choose to kneel and apologize in the end.
“Connor, I know you’re a pauper. You usually make a living by delivering food in the school, so 1 think you shouldn’t pay any money. Just kneel and apologize to my girlfriend!” Zach said to Connor in disdain after seeing the awkward expressions on Dominic and Spencer’s faces..

chapters.title: Chapter 121 - 121: Pick Up The Money
chapters.content:
Chapter 121: Pick Up The Money
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Connor stood there expressionlessly, looking at Zach without saying a word. He was thinking about how to deal with this guy.
Dominic, Spencer, and the rest were still here. If Connor called Kyle, it would expose his identity. It would be difficult to explain to Dominic and the rest.
“So this guy is the loser who delivered food in our school?”
At this moment, the girl looked at Connor with disgust, then pouted and said, “I’m unlucky today. 1 met such a loser the moment I went out. 1 heard that his girlfriend cheated on this guy a few days ago. Look at him. How could a girl like him fall for him? This person deserves to be single for the rest of his life. Hurry up and apologize to me. 1 still have to change my clothes…”
Natasha and Cindy heard the girl’s words.
They had just come out of the bathroom and happened to see this scene.
“Why does this Connor always cause trouble wherever he goes?”
Although Cindy didn’t know what was happening, she could guess from the girl’s words that Connor must have offended her.
After hesitating momentarily, Natasha walked to Connor’s side and asked the girl coldly, “What did you just say about Connor?”
“I said he’s a loser. No girl likes him. He deserves to be single for life!” the girl pursed her lips and replied coldly.
After Natasha heard this, she raised her hand and slapped the girl’s face without hesitation.
“Slap!” it was loud.
The entire Phillips’ Signature fell into a dead silence. Everyone’s mouths were wide open as they watched this scene with deep shock in their eyes!
They had never expected Natasha to be so aggressive. Just because of a single sentence from the girl, she had slapped her!
After Natasha slapped Zach’s girlfriend, the girl was shocked and covered her face tightly.
She never thought Natasha would slap herself without asking for more details.
Dominic, Spencer, Connor, and the others were also confused. No one expected Natasha to take action.
Brandon, Mandy, and the others sat in the distance, and their eyes seemed even more puzzled.
They couldn’t understand why Natasha would stand up for Connor. Mandy had exposed Connor’s identity at the bar. Logically speaking, Natasha should have broken off all ties with Connor.
But now, not only did Natasha come out for a meal with Connor, but she also took the initiative to help Connor beat someone up. This made them extremely surprised because this was too illogical.
“What’s the relationship between this girl and Connor?” Harvey couldn’t help but sigh softly.
“Has Connor already successfully wooed this girl?” Lily hesitated for a moment and asked softly.
“That’s impossible. This girl is so beautiful, and she’s wearing branded clothes. Why would she fall for a poor loser like Connor? That’s impossible!”
Mandy couldn’t accept that Connor could find such a beautiful girlfriend like Natasha, so she denied it agitatedly.
When everyone heard what Mandy said, they turned to look at her.
Mandy narrowed her eyes at Connor and Natasha. Her eyes were filled with unwillingness and anger. She could not believe that Natasha was with Connor.
If Connor and Natasha got together, it meant that it wasn’t that Connor wasn’t worthy of her, but that she wasn’t worthy of Connor!
