Connor had left her, but he could still find a girlfriend who was more beautiful and more elegant than her.
Mandy could only accept the fact that Connor was a loser, but she could not accept that after she left, there would still be a girl who liked Connor, and that girl was a hundred thousand times better than her!
***
“How dare you hit me?”
On the other side, Zach’s girlfriend shouted after realizing what was happening. Then, she bared her teeth and pounced at Natasha.
However, before the girl could take two steps, Zach grabbed her.
“Why are you pulling me? Didn’t you see this b*tch hit me? Hurry up and help me call back…” The girl glared at Zach and screamed.
At this moment, Zach’s expression was extremely ugly. His entire face was scrunched up. He whispered to Natasha, “Natasha, why are you here?”
When everyone heard Zach’s words, their eyes widened in shock.
No one expected Zach to know Natasha.
Natasha knew this girl was Zach’s girlfriend, so she hit her!
The girl beside Zach was also very confused. She did not expect Zach to know this girl!
“Zach, it looks like you’ve been doing pretty well at Porthampton University recently.” Natasha looked at Zach and sneered.
“I… It’s been okay…”
Zach stuttered.
“Then, do you want me to talk with Uncle Zabinski about your recent performance at Porthampton University? A few days ago, your father came to my house for dinner…” Natasha looked at Zach and continued.
“No, Natasha, there’s no need!”
After Zach heard Natasha’s words, his expression changed drastically, and he hurriedly replied.
Zach’s father and Natasha’s father were classmates and comrades in arms. The two of them had a very close relationship. Naturally, Zach and Natasha had known each other since they were young.
Therefore, Zach was very afraid of Natasha. If Natasha went to his father and said something, Zach would be done for.
“What happened?” Natasha looked at Zach and asked.
“Just… Just now…”
Zach looked at Natasha and hesitated momentarily before saying in a low voice, “It was just a misunderstanding. My girlfriend accidentally bumped into Connor and knocked over the food in his hand. Now that everything has been cleared up, Natasha, you guys can eat since you’re friends with Connor. I won’t disturb you anymore…” Zach seemed to have changed into a different person as he replied extremely humbly.
After saying this, Zach dragged his girlfriend and wanted to leave.
“Wait a minute!” Natasha called out expressionlessly.
“Natasha, is there anything else?” Zach turned to Natasha and asked nervously.
“I don’t know what happened just now, but since Connor dirtied your girlfriend’s clothes, we’ll compensate for this dress!”
After Natasha said this, she threw a stack of cash from her bag at the girl’s face.
“Phew!”
A large stack of cash was slapped on the girl’s face and flew up in the wind, stunning everyone present.
Even Mandy, Brandon, and the others didn’t expect Natasha to be so rich. The moment she made a move, cash flew everywhere.
There were at least seven to eight thousand dollars in this pile of banknotes. It was indeed a little surprising that a student could take out so much money.
After all, an ordinary student at Porthampton University would only have two to three thousand dollars a month.
At this moment, Natasha threw out seven to eight thousand without frowning. This was a true fair, rich, and beautiful woman!
The girl next to Zach stared at Natasha with a complicated expression. She knew that Natasha was humiliating her.
“Why are you looking at me? Hurry up and pick up the money!” Natasha said to the girl coldly.
“I…” The girl opened her mouth to speak.
Zach quickly covered her mouth and bent down to pick up the money on the ground. Then, he dragged the girl and wanted to leave.
“Did I say you can go?” Natasha said again when she saw Zach dragging the girl away..

chapters.title: Chapter 122 - 122: Natasha’s Confession
chapters.content:
Chapter 122: Natasha’s Confession
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Hearing Natasha’s words, Zach hurriedly turned around and said to Natasha with a helpless expression, “Natasha, is there anything else?”
Natasha ignored Zach and walked to the girl. She said to her, “You said no one likes Connor, right?”
The girl’s eyes widened, not knowing how to answer her question.
“Let me tell you, i like Connor, and i was the one who helped him slap you just now!” Natasha said coldly.
The entire restaurant fell into dead silence again. Everyone’s eyes were widened, and their expressions were of incredulity.
They never expected Natasha to admit that she liked Connor.
Connor looked at Natasha calmly. He wasn’t surprised by Natasha’s words.
He had long wanted to pursue Natasha. It was just that he didn’t have any thoughts about Natasha now.
Natasha slowly turned to look at Connor in front of everyone’s surprised gazes and said loudly, “Connor, 1 like you. Are you willing to be my boyfriend?”
Seeing this scene, Brandon, Mandy, and others gaped, their jaws about to hit the floor.
A fair, rich, and beautiful woman with good looks and figures took the initiative to confess to a poor loser like Connor.
After hearing Natasha’s words, all the students in the dining hall turned their attention to Natasha. Everyone’s eyes were equally shocked.
Only Connor and Cindy remained calm.
Cindy already knew that Natasha was going to confess to Connor. However, she didn’t know that Natasha was really planning to be with Connor and not just use Connor to chase Leon away.
Connor knew that Natasha would confess to him because of the money in his hands.
Natasha had already confessed to him once back at Evergrande Villa.
However, the students in the cafeteria didn’t know what was happening. It was as if a storm was raging in their hearts.
This was simply a plot that only appeared in television dramas, right?
A fair, rich, and beautiful woman would pursue a poor boy?
Dominic and Spencer were stunned, looking at Connor dully.
Natasha, who had been looking down on Connor in the bar a few days ago, had taken the initiative to confess to Connor.
What was going on? This didn’t make sense!
They really couldn’t understand what had happened between Connor and Natasha to cause such a huge change in Natasha.
Of course, the ones who were the most shocked at this time were Brandon, Mandy, and the others.
Mandy’s gaze was extremely complicated at this moment. She could not believe what she was seeing. She pinched herself hard, but the pain told her everything was real!
“What’s wrong with this Connor? How did he make a girl like Natasha confess to him? Did he drug Natasha?” May also widened her eyes and sighed.
“Who knows? Connor must have used some tricks to make Natasha confess to him!” Lily said indignantly.
“I want to expose this Connor! We can’t let him succeed!”
Mandy couldn’t accept the fact that Connor and Natasha were together. She hurriedly got up and walked toward Natasha.
“Mandy, can you calm down? If you go now, won’t all the traps we set up before be in vain?” Brandon quickly reached out to grab Mandy and said anxiously.
“Don’t worry, I won’t tell anyone about that. 1 have other ways to break them up!” Mandy replied very calmly, then shook off Brandon’s hand and walked toward Natasha.
Brandon looked at Mandy, feeling a little helpless.
“Connor, I really like you. Can you be my boyfriend?”
Natasha felt that she had just helped Connor out of his predicament. If she confessed to Connor now, perhaps Connor would agree to be with her once he was touched.
“I…” Connor opened his mouth and was about to speak.
“Natasha, you can’t be with Connor!” However, before Connor could finish speaking, Mandy’s voice rang out in the dining room.
After Natasha heard Mandy’s words, she couldn’t help but look back.
When she saw Mandy appear, a trace of disgust flashed in her beautiful eyes.
She wouldn’t have misunderstood Connor if Mandy hadn’t come out to cause trouble at the bar. Perhaps she would have been with Connor now.
“Why can’t I be with Connor?” Natasha asked Mandy coldly.
“He’s just a delivery boy. He must have tricked you!” Mandy said loudly.
“I know he’s a loser, and he usually makes a living by delivering food, but I don’t care about these things. What I like is his personality, not his money. Even if he’s a junk picker, 1 still like him. Anyway, it’s fine as long as I have money!” Natasha replied expressionlessly, then continued, “I know you’re Connor’s ex-girlfriend. You broke up with Connor because he didn’t have money and couldn’t give you the life you wanted, right?”
“I…” Mandy never expected Natasha to say everything she wanted to say.
“I want to tell you that not all women in this world are as vain as you, and not all women will give up love for money. You and 1 are different people, so you don’t have to persuade me. I like Connor. Whether he’s rich or not, I like him!” Natasha looked at Mandy and continued.
Connor narrowed his eyes and looked at Natasha. He couldn’t help but feel amused.
If Natasha didn’t know his identity and could say such words, Connor might feel very touched and might agree to be together with Natasha.
However, Natasha had already known about his identity. Furthermore, wasn’t the reason why Natasha said such words now because Connor was rich?
Therefore, in Connor’s eyes, Natasha and Mandy were the same people.
The two were birds of a feather, the pot calling the kettle black!
After Mandy heard Natasha’s words, her mind instantly went blank. She did not expect Natasha to be so stubborn.
Encountering such a situation, Mandy was also desperate. She said to Natasha, a hint of madness in her eyes, “You think I left Connor because he had no money, right?”
“Isn’t that so?” Natasha asked with a sneer.
“No!” Mandy shouted with red eyes and continued, “It wasn’t me who dumped Connor.. It was Connor who dumped me!”

chapters.title: Chapter 123 - 123: We’re Not Very Compatible
chapters.content:
Chapter 123: We’re Not Very Compatible
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
When everyone heard Mandy’s words, they were all stunned.
Even Brandon, Lily, May, and the others didn’t know what Mandy was doing.
“If I left Connor because of money, then why did I get together with Connor back then? And I was with him for two years at that.
“There are so many rich kids pursuing me, and any one is richer than him. So why should 1 still be with him? Isn’t it because 1 think he treats me well?
“As long as Connor treats me well, I will do anything for him. Even if it’s to get an abortion for him, I wouldn’t say anything. However, I didn’t expect Connor to be a sc*mbag. Not only is he poor, but he also often flirts with women. When he’s tired of playing with me, he wants to throw me away and have fun with other women. I couldn’t stand it, so I broke up with him!”
After Mandy said this, she started crying in front of everyone.
After listening to Mandy’s touching speech, Connor was unusually speechless.
Connor might have believed Mandy’s words if he didn’t know what was going on.
“Sc*mbag, this kind of person is disgusting. He’s poor and a sc*mbag!”
“That’s right. How can there be such a person at Porthampton University? He’s really a disgrace to our school!”
“Natasha, don’t get together with such a person. Otherwise, you’ll regret it!”
After the students in the cafeteria heard Mandy’s speech, they instantly got angry. Everyone stood up and began to condemn Connor.
Even Cindy believed Mandy at this moment. She hurriedly walked to Natasha’s side and whispered, “Natasha, Connor is too disgusting. Why don’t you find someone else?”
When Natasha heard this, she turned to look at Cindy but didn’t say anything.
“Maybe you think I’m talking nonsense, but i don’t want to see you walk down my old path, so I stood up to stop you!”
After Mandy saw Natasha’s solemn expression, she felt that Natasha had begun to believe her, so she quickly added fuel to the fire.
Natasha looked at Mandy and hesitated momentarily, then slowly said, “Are you done?”
“I…” Mandy was stunned.
“Although the story you just told was very interesting, what does it have to do with me? 1 like Connor now. So what if Connor is poor? So what if it was Connor? I like him like this. What does this have to do with you?” Natasha said expressionlessly.
“Is… Is there something wrong with your brain? He’s already such a sc*mbag, and you still like him?” Mandy looked at Natasha and was completely speechless. She had already said all those nasty things just now, but Natasha still liked Connor.
Mandy couldn’t understand what kind of knockout powder Connor had given Natasha to make her so devoted.
If Connor was tall, rich, and handsome, Mandy might understand Natasha’s current actions, but Connor was just a poor loser who delivered food.
What exactly was Natasha doing this for?
“You’re the one with the problem. It’s not your place to meddle in my affairs!” Natasha shouted in an unfriendly tone, then turned to Connor and said, “Connor, no matter what you are, no matter how poor or sc*mbag you are, I still like you. Are you willing to be my boyfriend?”
No one would have thought that after Natasha heard Mandy’s words, she did not give up on pursuing Connor.
In the eyes of everyone, the scene before them was like watching a television drama.
It was already dramatic enough for a fair, rich, and beautiful woman like Natasha to like a poor loser like Connor.
However, after Mandy finished telling the story, Natasha still liked Connor. This was a little confusing.
Mandy looked at Natasha before her and felt like she had become a joke.
She had said so many impassioned words just now, but Natasha hadn’t even heard a single word.
Meanwhile, Dominic and Spencer stood rooted, not knowing how to describe their feelings. Although they had always thought Connor was not bad, it was not good enough for a fair, rich beauty like Natasha to chase after him, right?
“Connor, what are you waiting for? Hurry up and promise Natasha!”
Even though Dominic didn’t know what was happening, Natasha’s words could be considered touching, which was why Dominic was so anxious to get Connor to agree to Natasha’s confession.
Connor looked at Natasha indifferently and then said something that shocked everyone present. “Natasha, I don’t think we are compatible. Let’s be friends first!”
After hearing Connor’s words, the restaurant fell into dead silence again.
Everyone’s mouth was wide open, and the expressions on their faces were so shocked that they could not be more shocked.
No one had expected that Connor would directly reject Natasha’s confession.
Facing such a beautiful woman’s pursuit, even if it were any other man, he would probably accept her proposal immediately, right?
Yet, Connor rejected her!
Brandon, May, and the others also widened their eyes in shock.
Mandy was stunned on the spot. She opened her mouth but could not speak.
They really could not understand what Connor was thinking!
“Connor rejected Natasha? What was going on? Is Connor’s brain damaged?” Cindy shouted in shock.
“Connor, are you not going to give me a chance?” Natasha looked at Connor pitifully.
“You’re a good person, but we aren’t compatible. Let’s be friends first!” Connor replied expressionlessly.
“Connor, are you crazy? Natasha took the initiative to confess to you. Why didn’t you agree?” When Dominic heard Connor’s words, he said anxiously.
Connor turned and glanced at Dominic, looking very helpless.
There were too many things that Dominic and Spencer did not know, so it was difficult for Connor to explain them to them.
“Connor, what are you thinking?” Spencer was also confused.
“I’m not thinking about anything. I just feel that I’m not compatible with her…” Connor said nonchalantly.
“Connor, do you have any shame? Natasha had already taken the initiative to confess, yet you’re still pretending to be arrogant? It’s your fortune that Natasha likes you, you know?” Cindy took a step forward and shouted at Connor.
“Cindy, don’t spout nonsense. Connor has the right to choose!” Natasha frowned and scolded.
Cindy was speechless when she heard Natasha’s scolding. She didn’t know what to say.
“Connor, I know you might not like me now, but i won’t give up easily. I’ll make you like me!” Natasha took a step forward and said to Connor affectionately.
Connor didn’t know whether to laugh or cry as he looked at Natasha. He didn’t know how to answer her..

chapters.title: Chapter 124 - 124: The Thief Has Appeared
chapters.content:
Chapter 124: The Thief Has Appeared
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
The students in the cafeteria were also looking at Connor in surprise.
They couldn’t understand why Connor would reject Natasha.
In their eyes, Natasha’s confession to Connor was already a blessing that Connor would never have.
But Connor rejected her. Wasn’t this obvious that he didn’t want to improve his social status?
“Let’s go back to our table and eat. Let’s not stand around!”
Connor didn’t want to stay here and have everyone look at him. He turned around and walked toward the dining area.
Natasha, Cindy, and the others followed Connor back to their seats and prepared to eat.
After Mandy saw Connor and the others leave, she stood rooted to the ground and suddenly shouted at Connor, “Connor, I know why you rejected Natasha. I finally understand what’s going on!”
After Connor heard Mandy’s words, he could not help but look up at Mandy.
“You still can’t let go of me, right? You’ve always wanted to get back together with me, right?” Mandy shouted proudly.
Connor looked at Mandy without saying anything.
“Since you didn’t say anything, you’ve tacitly agreed. You still can’t let go of me, so you asked Natasha to act with you. Your goal is to provoke and make me change my mind, right? But Connor, let me tell you, you should give up on this idea. I will never be with you again in this life. 1 will never fall in love with you. A poor loser like you is not worthy of me. You and Brandon are simply incomparable, you know?”
Mandy looked at Connor and continued to shout.
In her opinion, this was the only explanation for today’s incident.
Connor first found Natasha to put on an act to provoke him, then rejected Natasha in front of everyone, wanting to change his mind.
Otherwise, how could Connor reject a beautiful woman’s confession? How could Natasha possibly fancy Connor?
However, if everything that happened just now was Connor’s act to save her, everything made sense.
When May, Lily, and the others heard Mandy’s words, they felt that what she said made sense.
Connor looked at Mandy indifferently and sneered, “Are you crazy?”
“Connor, you don’t have to quibble anymore. Can’t I see through your little plot? You’ve put in a lot of effort for me. But I’m sorry, I won’t like a poor loser like you. You’d better not waste your energy on me!” Mandy replied proudly, then turned around and walked out of the restaurant.
Brandon, Lily, and the others also quickly followed Mandy out of the restaurant.
After Spencer saw Mandy leave, he seemed slightly puzzled. He asked Connor softly, “Connor, were you acting with Natasha just now?”
“Do you think I’m that bored?”
Natasha glared at Spencer and continued, “I really like Connor. Who would put on an act for that gold digger!”
Spencer looked at Natasha awkwardly and didn’t say anything.
***
Perhaps it was because Connor had rejected Natasha, so no one spoke during the meal. The atmosphere was a little awkward.
In less than twenty minutes, Connor and the others finished their meal.
Dominic took out his phone, looked at the time, and said, “It’s still early. Cindy, Natasha, are you two free this afternoon? There’s a new Marvel movie recently. Shall we go watch it together?”
“Sure, I’m free this afternoon!” Cindy quickly nodded.
“I have nothing to do in the afternoon…” Natasha replied. She came here today for Connor, so she naturally didn’t want to go back.
“Alright, let’s go watch a movie. The cinema is quite close to here…”
Dominic was very happy to see the two girls agree. He got up and prepared to leave.
“I’ll get the bill!” After Connor said this, he turned around and walked toward the cashier.
After Dominic saw that Connor would pay the bill, he wanted to go with Connor because he was worried that Connor did not have enough money.
But at this moment, his phone suddenly rang.
Dominic glanced at the number on the phone and realized that it was a call from his classmate, so he quickly picked up the phone and said with a smile, “Daniel, what’s up?”
“Dominic, are you with Connor and Spencer?” After Dominic picked up the phone, the other party asked anxiously.
“Yeah, why?” Dominic replied softly.
“Hurry up and get Connor and Spencer. The three of you should hurry back to class. Something big has happened in our class!”
“Something big happened? What’s the big deal?” Dominic asked, puzzled.
“There’s a thief in our class. All the students in the class are back. We’re only missing the three of you!”
“Was there a thief in our class?”
When Dominic heard this, he immediately frowned, and a trace of confusion flashed across his eyes.
“Alright, 1 won’t talk to you anymore! Come back quickly. Remember to bring Connor and Spencer, too. The whole class is all here!” Daniel said anxiously.
“Alright, 1 got it!”
Dominic felt that Daniel was not joking, so he quickly agreed softly and hung up the phone.
“Dominic, what’s wrong?” Cindy asked Dominic after he hung up the phone.
“Cindy Natasha, the two of you go to the cinema and wait for us. Something happened in our class, and we must go back now!” Dominic said slowly.
“What happened? If it’s not important, don’t go back. It wasn’t easy for Natasha and I to come here today…” Cindy didn’t seem to want Dominic and the other two to leave, so she pouted and said.
“It’s quite important. Wait for the three of us to settle it, and we’ll come and find you!” Dominic said helplessly.
“Alright then!” Cindy nodded gently.
“Let’s go!” Dominic said to Spencer, then turned around and left the restaurant.
“What’s wrong, bro?” When he returned, Connor had just paid the bill and saw Dominic and Spencer wanting to leave in a hurry.
“Connor, there seems to be a thief in our class. Daniel called me just now and said that all the students in the class have gone back. We’re the only ones left!” Dominic hurriedly explained.
“A thief?” After Connor heard Dominic’s words, doubt flashed in his eyes.
This morning, the students in the class were discussing this. Then, the thief appeared in the afternoon. Wasn’t this too much of a coincidence?
However, before Connor could think further, Dominic dragged Connor out of the restaurant.
“Connor, when we return to class later, those students will suspect you’re the thief. But don’t worry, Spencer and I can testify for you. You’ve been with the two of us all this time. There was no time for you to commit the crime!”
Previously, because Natasha and Cindy were present, Dominic did not say this out loud.
After leaving the restaurant, Dominic whispered to Connor.
“Yes, 1 can testify too!” Spencer nodded at Connor.
After Connor heard what the two said, he smiled and said nothing..

chapters.title: Chapter 125 - 125: Connor Stole the Money
chapters.content:
Chapter 125: Connor Stole the Money
Translator: End less Fantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Inside Phillips’ Signature.
After Cindy saw Dominic and the others leave, she hurriedly asked Natasha softly, “Natasha, are you planning to be with Connor?”
“That’s right!” Natasha nodded lightly.
“I think it’s too disadvantageous for you to be with someone like Connor because of Leon. Didn’t you hear what Connor’s ex-girlfriend said just now? He’s simply a sc*mbag. He doesn’t have money but still likes to flirt around and pretend to be a rich kid. It’s really disgusting!” Cindy said with a frown.
“I’m just using him as a placeholder. 1 don’t want to be with him!” Natasha looked at the innocent Cindy beside her and replied with a smile.
“But you can’t let Connor off so easily. Moreover, this Connor even rejected you. 1 don’t understand. What right does he have to reject you? Why doesn’t he take a piss and look at yourself? How can a stinky loser like him be so mischievous!” Cindy continued to say indignantly.
“Don’t worry, I’ll settle him sooner or later!” Natasha said confidently.
“That’s true. Natasha, you’re so beautiful. Which man in the world would reject you?” Cindy smiled and nodded.
***
Meanwhile…
Connor, Dominic, and Spencer returned to the classroom. At this moment, all the students in the classroom were sitting in their seats.
A fierce-looking middle-aged man stood upright on the podium and looked at the students in the classroom seriously.
When Connor saw this middle-aged man, he was shocked.
This middle-aged man was the dean of the third-year students at Porthampton University, Dylan Wagner!
Although Connor did not have much contact with Dylan, he knew that Dylan was not a good person.
Usually, he relied on his identity as the dean to act tyrannically in school and commit all kinds of evil.
For those rich students who fawned over him, even if they made a mistake, he would pretend that he didn’t see it. However, if it were an ordinary student who made a mistake, they would be beaten up or even expelled.
Moreover, it was said that Dylan often harassed female students, so his reputation in the school was extremely bad and very unpopular.
“What are you guys still standing at the door for? Hurry up and get in here!”
When Dylan saw Connor and the other two, he growled with a straight face.
Connor hesitated for a moment before walking into the classroom.
“Are all the students here now?”
Dylan asked Eunice expressionlessly after seeing Connor and the others sit down.
“Everyone is here!” The class monitor, Eunice, replied in a low voice.
Eunice’s eyes were a little red at this moment, and her voice was a little choked up, indicating that she had probably cried before.
“Alright, Eunice. Then tell everyone what happened!”
Dylan said to Eunice.
“Sir, this is what happened. This morning, 1 collected a class fee of loo dollars from each student. There were fifty students in total, so I collected a total of 5,000 dollars. That money was placed in my bag, but during the physical education class, 1 was afraid that I would lose the money, so I left my bag in the classroom…”
“But after the PE class, when I returned to the classroom, I realized that the money was gone…” Eunice explained.
“Tell me, how did you become the class monitor? 1 even emphasized on the morning announcement that thieves were in our school and that valuable things must be carried with you. In the afternoon, you lost the money. Are you right in the head?” Dylan screamed.
“I… I didn’t do it on purpose!”
When Eunice heard Dylan’s words, she immediately burst into tears.
“Alright, I don’t mean to scold you. You’d better think about how to get the money back. If you can get the money back, you don’t have to be responsible for this matter. You can discuss it with your classmates if you can’t get it back. Let’s see if you can make up the money, or everyone will pay the class fee again!”
At this moment, Dylan was completely indifferent, as if a thief had appeared in the school and had nothing to do with him, the dean.
After all, it wasn’t just a day or two that there had been a theft in the school. However, Dylan had not caught this thief.
After the students in the classroom heard Dylan’s order, they began to whisper.
After all, most of them were ordinary students. Although loo dollars was not much to them, they would not be willing to pay it again.
However, if Eunice had to pay the compensation alone, it would be a huge sum for her to bear!
Connor looked at the aggrieved expression on Eunice’s face and hesitated. He secretly thought that if Eunice lost the money, he could find an opportunity to help Eunice pay the money.
After all, 5,000 dollars was an astronomical figure for an ordinary student, but it was a piece of cake for Connor. He didn’t care at all.
“Mr. Wagner!” At this moment, Harvey suddenly stood up and said.
“Is there anything you need?” Dylan turned to look at Harvey and asked.
“Mr. Wagner, I know who stole this money!” Harvey continued.
When the students in the classroom heard Harvey’s claim, they all turned to look at him in surprise.
On the other hand, Harvey looked at Connor smugly, sneering in his heart, “Connor, let’s see how you can still be arrogant with me now. It’s time for retribution!”
“Did you say you know who the thief is?” Dylan narrowed his eyes and asked Harvey.
“Yes, I do!” Harvey nodded, then pointed at Connor and shouted, “The person who stole the money is Connor!”
“Connor?” Dylan could not help but be stunned.
The students in the classroom also turned to look at Connor with strange expressions on their faces.
The students in the class had long suspected Connor, but they kept their suspicions quiet. There was no conclusive evidence to prove that Connor was the thief.
“Harvey, what nonsense are you talking about? What right do you have to say that Connor is a thief?” At this moment, Dominic stood up and rebutted agitatedly.
“Yes, do you have any evidence? Connor has always been with the two of us and has never left. Dominic and I can prove that Connor is not a thief!” Spencer also stood up and shouted at Harvey.
“Are you sure you’ve been with Connor all this time?” Harvey looked at Dominic and laughed coldly.
“I’m sure!”
“Yes, I’m sure too!” Spencer nodded.
“Hehe, you two are still too naive!” Harvey suddenly sneered.
Connor narrowed his eyes and looked at Harvey. He could feel from Harvey’s expression that today’s issue was not as simple as the missing money..

chapters.title: Chapter 126 - 126: The Two Suspects
chapters.content:
Chapter 126: The Two Suspects
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
“Click clack, click clack…”
The sound of high heels clicking on the floor could be heard from the classroom door.
Then, a faint perfume smell wafted into the classroom from the door.
When everyone heard the voice, they looked at the classroom door simultaneously.
A charming woman walked in from the classroom door. She had light makeup on her face, and her long, smooth black hair was casually draped over her shoulders. She was tall and voluptuous.
Dressed in a black professional dress, she accentuated her almost perfect figure.
“It’s Ms. Wallace!”
“Why is Ms. Wallace here?”
After the students saw Rachel Wallace, they began to discuss.
Rachel walked to Dylan and looked at him with a faint smile. She said softly, “Mr. Wagner, I’m sorry to trouble you to make a trip personally for such a small matter!11
“It s okay. I’m the school’s dean. This is within my scope of responsibility!”
Dylan turned and looked at the sexy and enchanting woman before him. His gaze perverted as he stared at Rachel Wallace1 s full breasts.
Rachel naturally noticed Dylan’s fiery gaze but did not say anything.
Everyone from Porthampton University knew that Dylan was not a good person.
Previously, when he was at work, Dylan had hinted to Rachel many times that he wanted to ask her for sexual favors, but she rejected him.
“Harvey, you claim that Connor is the thief. Do you have any evidence?” Rachel turned to look at Harvey and asked coldly.
Although the students in the class were suspicious of Connor, Rachel still did not believe Connor would do such a thing.
“Ma’am, I won’t just accuse Connor. I have evidence to prove this!” Harvey replied confidently, then looked at everyone and said, “I think only our classmates know about the collection of class fees today, so I’m sure rhe thief is from our class!”
When rhe students heard Harvey’s explanation, they all nodded because they felt that Harvey’s explanation was very reasonable.
When Harvey saw that the students all agreed with his statement, he seemed even more proud.
He continued deducing, “The student representative said the money was in her bag, which was still there before the P. E. class. But it was gone when she returned from the physical education class, lit other words, this money must have been lost during the P. E. class!”
Connor looked at Harvey expressionlessly. He secretly thought that with Harvey’s intelligence, it was impossible for him to deduce so many things. Therefore, someone must have instructed Harvey to say these.
But who had instructed Harvey?
The answer was obvious!
“So, according to the two clues I mentioned, I think the person most likely to have stolen the money in our class is Connor because he was the only one who returned to the classroom during P. E. class!” Harvey methodically told him what Brandon Guthrie had told him.
After hearing that, the students in the class nodded because they felt that what Harvey said was very reasonable.
At this moment, Rachel turned to look at Connor. A trace of doubt flashed in her beautiful eyes. She secretly sighed. Could Connor really be that thief? Did she trust Connor too much?
“Ms. Wallace, Mr. Wagner, 1 think we just need to search for Connor now. We will find the class fee!’1 Harvey continued.
“Yes, search Connor. During the P. E. class, only Connor came back!”
“He stole rhe class fee! The thief is Connor!” the students in the classroom also began to shout.
“Connor, do you have anything else to say now?” Rachel hesitated for a moment before turning to Connor and asking.
Connor slowly stood up and said calmly, “Harvey’s analysis is very reasonable, but I think he might have forgotten one thing. 1 returned during the P. E. class, but Harvey was the last to leave. All the students in our class saw that Harvey was late for the P. E. class today. Maybe Harvey stole the money himself and wanted to frame me?”
“That’s right. According to Harvey’s words, he is also a suspect!”
“Connor is right. Harvey was indeed late for P. E. class today!” Dominic and Spencer hurriedly shouted.
When Harvey heard that, he couldn’t help but laugh.
Not only was he not nervous, but he said to Dylan calmly, “Mr. Wagner, since everyone suspects Connor and me now, why don’t we let you decide on this? You just have to search us and see who the money is with. Then, won’t the truth be revealed?”
“Yes, search them!”
“Search them!”
When the students in rhe classroom heard Harvey’s words, they began to shout.
At this moment, Connor frowned and was very puzzled.
He couldn’t understand why Harvey had to search him, why he was so sure that he was the thief.
“Connor, do you agree to a body search?”
Rachel hesitated for a moment before asking Connor.
After Rachel finished speaking, all the students turned to look at Connor.
At this time, Brandon was also smiling proudly.
Connor’s refusal to be searched would mean he was the thief. However, if he agreed to be searched, their trap would succeed.
Everything seemed to be developing according to Brandon s imagination.
Connor calmly looked at Harvey. At this moment, he could already vaguely sense a trace of conspiracy.
For Harvey to deduce so many things and be so calm meant that everything was planned by someone else.
Moreover, Harvey was so determined to search him that the money must be in Connor’s desk.
All of this was a trap set by someone else!
Harvey was the last to leave the classroom. He then stole the class fee from Eunice and placed it in his desk.
Finally, when Eunice realized the money was missing, Harvey stepped forward to report Connor and asked everyone to search him.
“Well? Do you dare to let everyone search you, Connor?” Harvey asked Connor teasingly when he saw Connor standing there without saying a word.
“Why not? However, your actions are so stupid!” Connor said coldly to Harvey..

chapters.title: Chapter 127 - 127: Eunice To The Rescue
chapters.content:
Chapter 127: Eunice To The Rescue
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
“What… What do you mean by that?” Harvey looked at Connor, stunned.
Connor looked at Harvey without saying anything.
“Mr. Wagner, I think Connor must have a guilty conscience now, so he doesn’t dare to let you search him. Connor is a thief!” Harvey said agitatedly to Dylan.
Dylan hesitated momentarily, then whispered to Rachel, “Ms. Wallace, you can see the current situation. Since Harvey and Connor are both suspects, 1 think it’s best to search them now!”
“Mr. Wagner, it’s illegal to search someone without permission. You’d better think about it carefully!” Rachel replied softly.
“Uhm…”
After Dylan heard this, he seemed to be in a difficult position.
He knew very well that without Connor’s consent, it was illegal to search him.
“Mr. Wagner, how about this? 1’11 search Connor. If 1 can’t find anything, let Connor search me too!”
Harvey saw that things weren’t going as planned, so he wasn’t willing to give up so easily and suggested that.
“I think your idea is not bad. Go and search Connor!”
After hearing Harvey’s suggestion, Dylan immediately agreed.
After all, if Connor and Harvey searched each other, even if Connor wasn’t a thief, it wouldn’t affect him at all. The person who would bear the responsibility was Harvey.
Harvey walked toward Connor, but he didn’t search his clothes. Instead, he walked toward his seat.
Harvey had hidden the money in Connor’s desk.
Connor noticed this as well. He looked at Harvey and said softly, “You guys really went to great lengths to frame me!”
“Frame you? What nonsense are you talking about? Who framed you?” Harvey sneered.
“Remember this. In an hour, you will pay for your actions!”
At this moment, Connor did not look nervous at all. Instead, he was very calm.
In Connor’s opinion, Harvey’s tricks were too clumsy. How could a rich kid who had inherited ten trillion in assets steal money?
However, Harvey was very pleased with himself. He knew that as long as he found the money in Connor’s desk, Connor would never have a chance to turn the tables.
The entire classroom fell silent. Only Harvey’s footsteps could be heard.
Brandon, Mandy, and the others saw Harvey walking toward Connor’s desk, and they couldn’t help but smile smugly.
May was a little nervous.
But the most nervous person was the student representative Eunice!
Eunice seemed to have realized that something was wrong with today’s incident. Harvey was so sure that Connor was the thief.
That meant that there were two possibilities. The first possibility was that Connor was the thief, and the second possibility was that Harvey framed Connor.
“There’s no need to look for it!” Eunice suddenly stood up and said.
When everyone heard Eunice’s words, they all turned to look at her. Harvey also stopped in his tracks, his eyes filled with confusion.
“I remember now. Actually… I didn’t lose the money. Instead, I have deposited
it in the bank. I was anxious just now and forgot about it…”
Eunice grabbed the corner of her shirt tightly and lied. She sounded very nervous.
Eunice did that to protect Connor. Although she didn’t know if Connor had stolen the class fee, if Harvey found the money in Connor’s desk, Connor would be labeled as a thief and might even be expelled from school.
Therefore, Eunice would rather take responsibility than see Connor expelled from school.
“Eunice, what are you talking about?” Rachel asked in confusion after hearing what Eunice said.
“Ms. …Ms. Wallace, the money was not lost. I… 1 deposited it…” Eunice stuttered.
“That’s impossible!” Harvey shouted agitatedly. During the P. E. class, he had personally hidden the class fee in Connor’s desk.
But now that Eunice said she didn’t lose the money, he wouldn’t believe it even if he was beaten to death.
“How do you know that’s impossible?” Eunice saw Harvey’s reaction and felt something was wrong, so she asked him directly.
“Why… Why do you care how I know? Anyway, it’s such an important matter. How could you forget it?” Harvey was suddenly stumped by Eunice’s question and replied incoherently.
“Eunice, you said you deposited the class fees into the bank, right?” Mandy saw the situation getting out of hand, so she stood up and asked Eunice.
“Yes… That’s right!” Eunice nodded lightly.
“But you seemed to have said just now that you returned to the classroom after your P. E. class. When did you deposit the money? And where is the bank where you deposit your money? Do you have a receipt for the deposit?” Mandy asked a few questions in a row, which stunned Eunice.
Eunice stood rooted to the ground, not knowing how to answer these questions.
“If you really deposited the money in the bank, it doesn’t matter. Take us to the bank now to withdraw the money. If we can withdraw the money, we believe you made a mistake. But if we can’t produce that money, 1 can suspect that you colluded with Connor to steal from the collection.” Mandy said sharply.
“I… I…” Eunice was so anxious that she didn’t know what to say. Tears flowed again.
“Eunice, you don’t have to explain. Since they want to search me, then let them search me!” Connor suddenly spoke.
Connor knew that Eunice was doing this to protect him, so he couldn’t bear to see Eunice being bullied.
“Connor, you asked for it!” Harvey sneered, then walked directly to Connor’s desk and began to flip through it.
After a while, he found a pink wallet under the table.
“Thud!”
Harvey threw the wallet on the table and shouted at the top of his lungs, “Connor, please explain to me now. What is this?”
When the students in the classroom saw that Harvey found the wallet in Connor’s desk, they were instantly in an uproar!
The students in the class were all suspecting that the thief in the school was Connor.
After all, Connor had undergone a huge change recently. Not only did he spend money extravagantly, but he also treated his classmates to a meal at the Brasserie Le Bernardin. He did not look like a poor student who relied on delivering food to make a living.
However, when they confirmed Connor was the thief, they all were shocked.
“I didn’t expect this Connor to be a thief!”
“That’s right. Connor is really disgusting. Although he usually looks poorly in school, I thought he was honest. I didn’t expect him to be such a person!”
“I’ve long guessed that Connor is a thief. Otherwise, how could he have so much money to treat us to a meal that day?”
The students began to discuss among themselves.
Dominic and Spencer turned to look at Connor. They seemed extremely shocked. They could not believe that Connor had done such a thing.
Eunice and Wallace were stunned too..

chapters.title: Chapter 128 - 128: Chancellor Jesse Zachman
chapters.content:
Chapter 128: Chancellor Jesse Zachman
Translator: End less Fantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
“Ms. Wallace, did Connor take the money?” Eunice asked Rachel with a puzzled expression.
“I’m not sure either!”
Rachel Wallace had been a lecturer for many years and had seen all kinds of students, but she had never seen someone like Connor.
In her eyes, Connor had a good character. At the very least, Rachel trusted Connor very much. However, at this time, he was caught red-handed. Rachel was not sure if Connor was a thief.
“Did something happen to Connor’s family?” Eunice continued.
Rachel gently shook her head. At this moment, she did not want to express any opinions.
Mandy, Brandon, Lily, and the others were very proud. After planning for so long, they could finally see Connor make a fool of himself. How could they not be happy?
After Connor saw Harvey remove the wallet from his desk, he remained calm. He narrowed his eyes and sized up everyone present, secretly remembering their expressions.
At this moment, one could see a person’s true nature more clearly.
‘It seems the mastermind behind today’s incident should be Brandon, Mandy, and the others. Otherwise, how could they not be surprised at all?’
When Connor saw the expressions of Mandy, Brandon, and the others, he secretly sighed.
Connor had never understood that Mandy had let him down first, and Brandon had also stolen his girlfriend.
Connor had never done anything to them, but the two of them had made things difficult for him one after another.
“Eunice, is this your wallet?” Harvey asked.
Eunice couldn’t believe what she was seeing. She stared at Connor as if she was waiting for Connor’s explanation.
Harvey saw that Eunice didn’t say anything, so he opened the wallet, and the cash inside was immediately exposed to everyone.
“Mr. Wagner, Connor has been caught red-handed! How do you want to deal with him?” Harvey asked Dylan when he saw that Eunice was silent.
“Alright, 1 didn’t expect you to do such a thing. You usually look like an honest kid. Come with me to the Academic Affairs Office now. I want to discuss with the other lecturers and see how to deal with you!” Dylan said angrily.
“The Academic Affairs Office?”
When the students heard that, they all looked fearful.
As long as they were students of Porthampton University, no one came out of the Academic Affairs Office unscathed.
“Mr. Wagner, I think you should interrogate Connor properly. Maybe he was the one who stole the money from us before!” Harvey said to Dylan with a sinister expression.
“It’s not up to you to teach me how to deal with this!” Dylan snorted coldly, then looked at Connor and said, “Alright, you brat, follow me!”
“I want to see the chancellor!” Connor said calmly to Dylan.
“What did you say?” Dylan was stunned for a moment and asked.
“I said 1 want to see the principal!” Connor calmly repeated and continued, “According to the school rules, the chancellor should deal with a theft incident. If it’s serious, the student will be expelled from school. If it’s light, the student will be placed on probation. Therefore, I want to see the principal now!”
When Connor first entered the school, he was worried that he would not be able to get the poverty grant, so he remembered every school rule in his heart.
If Connor went to the Academic Affairs Office with Dylan now, he would definitely be beaten up.
People like Dylan had always done things without thinking. No matter how powerful Connor’s background was, he could not explain it to him.
Therefore, Connor’s idea was very simple. He wanted to make a move on the chancellor directly.
As long as he could deal with the chancellor, they wouldn’t be able to talk nonsense even if he stole the money.
“Hehe, not bad, kid. You know the school rules. Alright then, I’ll bring you to see the chancellor now!” Dylan looked at Connor and smiled.
If this were handed over to the principal, Connor would be expelled. This would save him trouble.
When Brandon, Mandy, and the others heard that Connor had taken the initiative to meet the principal, their hearts were filled with joy. Wasn’t this a death wish?
“Let’s go!” Dylan said coldly to Connor.
H H
Connor turned his head, gave Harvey a cold look, and walked out of the classroom.
When Connor passed by Rachel, she suddenly reached out and grabbed Connor. Then, she asked Connor softly, “Connor, tell me the truth. Did you steal the money?”
“No…” Connor lightly shook his head.
“Don’t get too nervous when you see the chancellor later. 1’11 do my best to help you!” Rachel said to Connor with a very serious expression.
“Thank you!” After Connor heard what Rachel said, he was very touched.
***
A few minutes later, Dylan brought Connor to the office of the chancellor of the Porthampton University.
“Wait at the door. I’ll go in and…”
Dylan opened his mouth and was about to speak.
Connor pushed open the door of the chancellor’s office and walked in.
“You brat, stop right there!” Dylan hurriedly shouted when he saw Connor barge in.
However, it was too late. After Connor entered the chancellor’s office, he said nothing else and sat directly on the sofa opposite the desk. He was very arrogant.
Previously, there were other students in the classroom, so Connor had been hiding his identity.
However, there were only Dylan and the principal in the office now. Connor naturally did not have to hide anything.
“Who are you? How dare you barge into the chancellor’s office?”
The principal of Porthampton University seemed frightened by Connor’s actions and asked angrily.
“Do I need to knock to enter your office?” Connor squinted and replied indifferently.
He was extremely domineering and stunned the chancellor of Porthampton University, Jesse Zachman.
Connor treated Jesse with such an attitude because he wanted to act tough but because he knew that although the chancellor of Porthampton University, Jesse, looked like a human dog, he was not a good person at all.
Although Jesse wasn’t as unscrupulous as Dylan, he had done some heartless things in private, such as forcing female lecturers to get in bed with him and deliberately using scholarships and degree certificates to trick female students.
Connor had heard many such things, but most students only discussed them in private. No one dared to bring these things up.
After all, Porthampton University was now under the control of Jesse and Dylan. The students had no right to offend them.
However, because others did not dare to offend him, it did not mean Connor did not dare to!

chapters.title: Chapter 129 - 129:1 Will Make You Regret Forever
chapters.content:
Chapter 129:1 Will Make You Regret Forever
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
“Mr. Wagner, who is this? What is he doing here?” When Jesse saw Connor’s arrogant look, he asked Dylan angrily.
Dylan was also shocked by Connor’s behavior. He rushed forward and shouted at Connor, “Brat, do you know who this is? Hurry up and apologize to him!”
Connor looked up at Jesse and said coldly, “This kind of person doesn’t deserve my apology!”
“You… You…”
Jesse was so angry that he trembled. He glared at Connor and scolded, “Mr. Wagner, what’s wrong with this guy? Why did you bring him here?”
“Mr. Zachman, you know how there have been thefts happening in our school? This kid is the thief, so I brought him here to ask you how to deal with this kid!”
Dylan felt that Connor must have known that he would be expelled today, so he was so fearless. Therefore, he quickly explained to Jesse.
“Is he the thief?” Jesse frowned and said coldly, “I didn’t expect Porthampton University to produce a sc*m like you. A person like you doesn’t deserve to study in our school. From now on, you’re expelled. I’ll also inform the other universities in Porthampton to blacklist you and never admit you again!”
Connor’s provocative actions earlier had already thoroughly infuriated Jesse.
Not only did Jesse want to get rid of Connor, but he also wanted to inform the other universities in Porthampton to work together to get rid of Connor.
If that were the case, not only would Porthampton University expel Connor, but the other universities would also never enrol Connor as a student after knowing about this.
Connor would not have the chance to attend another university even if he wanted to.
“You want to expel me?” Connor asked playfully.
“Yes! If 1 don’t expel a misbehaving student like you now, it will ruin our school’s reputation in the future!” Jesse shouted emotionally.
“Hah, I’m not afraid to tell you. No one can expel me unless 1 don’t want to study at Porthampton University anymore!” Connor said with a smile.
“What… What did you say? Do you know who 1 am? I’m the chancellor of Porthampton University, and you’re saying I can’t expel you? That’s a great joke!” Jesse looked at Connor and sneered.
“If 1 say you can’t expel me, then you can’t expel me!” Connor’s expression was still calm.
“Humph!”
Jesse didn’t want to waste his breath on Connor. He picked up the phone on the table and dialed a number.
“Mr. Waag, please pull out the file of a student named Connor McDonald from our school. 1 want to expel this student now!”
Jesse gave an order into the phone and hung up. He turned to Connor and said, “Just wait. Your file will be sent over in a while. I’ll see how arrogant you will act later!”
“Haha…” Connor looked at Jesse, who was furious from embarrassment and smiled playfully. Then, he took out his phone and made a call.
“Are you only remembering to ask for help now?” Dylan looked at Connor and sneered. Then, he continued, “If you had a better attitude when you came in just now and apologized to Mr. Zachman, perhaps the chancellor would have given you a chance to stay in school with just a slap on the wrist. But it’s too late now. No matter who you ask for help, it’s useless. Just wait to be expelled!”
Connor ignored Dylan and focused on dialing his phone.
“Hello, Mr. McDonald!” Soon, the other party picked up the call.
“In ten minutes, in the office of the chancellor of Porthampton University!” Connor said.
“Understood!”
The other party did not ask Connor what had happened at all and hurriedly agreed.
“Hehe, kid, it’s useless even if you call the Director of Education today! No one can stop me from expelling a student! I’ve been a chancellor for so many years, but this is the first time I’ve met a student like you!” Jessesaid provocatively after Connor hung up the phone.
“Aren’t you being a little too arrogant?” Connor replied calmly.
“If you don’t believe me, wait and see!”
After Jesse saw Connor’s arrogant appearance, the hatred in his heart for Connor deepened.
He felt that Connor’s current actions simply provoked him.
Moreover, he could see that Connor’s clothes were very ordinary. He was not a rich kid, so it was naturally impossible for him to have any powerful background.
Jesse said that even if the Director of Education came, he would still expel Connor. He was just bragging.
He knew Connor would never be able to summon the Director of Education casually. He would probably scare Jesse half to death if he called him over.
Connor was lying on the sofa with his legs crossed, looking satisfied.
Jesse and Dylan looked at Connor angrily. The atmosphere in the office was very strange.
***
At this moment, the classroom was in a mess.
All the students were whispering and discussing that Connor was a thief.
Mandy, Brandon, Harvey, and the others were secretly happy. Connor was finally going to be expelled by the chancellor. This was a good thing.
Mandy had even begun to think about how she should mock Connor when he left the school.
However, May was a little nervous because she felt that whatever happened today was not simple.
Eunice sat in her seat with a regretful expression on her face. She shouldn’t have told anyone about the money.
Rachel kept making phone calls, trying to find connections for Connor so the chancellor wouldn’t expel him.
Spencer, Dominic, and the others sat in their spots, their eyes glazed over. They had no idea what they should do now.
***
In the blink of an eye, ten minutes had passed.
A middle-aged man with sparse hair entered the chancellor’s office with Connor’s file. Then, he respectfully said to Jesse, “Mr. Zachman, I’ve brought you the file you wanted!”
“Good!” Jesse reached out and took Connor’s file. He turned to look at Connor and then took out the document on Connor.
“Connor, do you dare say 1 can’t expel you?” Jesse took out the seal representing the withdrawal of a student’s status and coldly asked Connor.
“If you dare to stamp my file, 1’11 make you regret it for the rest of your life!” Connor looked at Jesse and said coldly.
“Hah, make me regret it for the rest of my life? Do you think I’m afraid?” Jesse smiled disdainfully. He picked up the seal and was about to stamp it on Connor’s file.
“Bang!” However, just as Jesse was about to stamp his seal, the door of the principal’s office was suddenly pushed open.
Jesse instinctively looked up. Then, he was stunned.
When Dylan saw the person who just opened the door, his jaw fell, and his eyes were filled with deep shock.
Only Connor sat calmly because he already knew who the person who came in was..

chapters.title: Chapter 130 - 130: Thomas Morgan Arrives
chapters.content:
Chapter 130: Thomas Morgan Arrives
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
At Porthampton University, in the chancellor’s office.
Dylan and Jesse were shocked when they saw the middle-aged man walking into the office.
“Mr. Morgan, why are you here today?”
Jesse quickly stood up and walked up to the middle-aged man, asking flatteringly.
“Yes, Mr. Morgan, aren’t you supposed to be at the school board meeting today?” Dylan asked.
The person who appeared in the chancellor’s office was Thomas Morgan.
When Thomas introduced Connor’s grandfather and cousin’s inheritance to him, he even mentioned that Connor’s grandfather’s cousin was also the president of the board of directors of Porthampton University.
After Connor’s grandfather’s cousin died, Thomas took his place and became the acting chairman of the board of directors.
Connor was fearless because he knew that Thomas was the president of the board of directors of Porthampton University. That was why he was so calm.
It could be said that the chancellor of Porthampton University was entirely up to Thomas.
As long as Connor didn’t want to leave, no one in Porthampton University could expel him!
Porthampton University itself was a private university. The shareholders invested all the funds in the school board.
The Empire World Corporation, which Thomas Morgan managed, held 71% of the shares of Porthampton University. It could be said to be the largest shareholder of Porthampton University.
Connor was Thomas’ boss, meaning the entire school belonged to Connor. What right did Jesse have to expel Connor?
Thomas glanced at Jesse and Dylan indifferently and ignored them.
Instead, he bent down and walked before Connor, respectfully saying, “I’m sorry, Mr. McDonald, I’m late!”
When Jesse and Dylan heard Thomas’ words, their mouths were wide open, and their expressions were extremely shocked.
They never thought a poor kid like Connor could know a big shot like Thomas.
Jesse’s brows began to furrow, and cold sweats kept appearing on his forehead. At this moment, he finally understood why Connor was so arrogant and even dared to say that no one could expel him.
If Connor knew Thomas, Jesse did not have the guts to expel Connor.
“It’s okay. You’re not late!” Connor replied indifferently. Then, he stood up and asked Thomas, “Mr. Morgan, how many shares do 1 own in Porthampton University now?”
“Mr. McDonald, you now own 71% of the shares of Porthampton University and have absolute control!” Thomas hurriedly replied.
When Jesse and Dylan heard this, they were dumbfounded again.
They couldn’t understand why Connor would suddenly own 71% of the shares of Porthampton University. Shouldn’t these shares belong to Thomas Morgan?
“Jesse, I forgot to introduce you. This is Mr. McDonald. He is also the only legal heir of the Empire World Corporation. Therefore, the 71% shares of Porthampton University that the Empire World Corporation previously owned are now all owned by Mr. McDonald. I have always been the acting chairman of the board of directors, but now that Mr. McDonald has inherited the Empire World Corporation, the position of the chairman should belong to Mr. McDonald!” Thomas turned to Jesse and said calmly.
Although Thomas’s voice wasn’t loud, his words sparked a storm in Jesse and Dylan’s hearts.
Who would have thought that this ordinary-looking poor kid who usually made a living by delivering food would suddenly become the heir of the Empire World Corporation and the president of the school’s board of directors?
To Jesse, this was like a bolt from the blue!
Jesse did not know how powerful the Empire World Corporation was, but he knew how terrifying Thomas was.
At this moment, even Thomas had become Connor’s subordinate. Connor’s influence was simply unimaginable!
“The entire school is mine now. Do you still want to expel me?” Connor took a step forward and asked Jesse softly with narrowed eyes.
“Conn… Mr. McDonald…”
Jesse hurriedly took two steps back. A trace of fear flashed in his eyes before he fell to the ground with a thud.
Connor looked at Jesse, who was scared shitless by him, and smiled coldly. Then, he turned to Thomas and asked, “Thomas, do I have the right to change the chancellor?”
When Jesse and Dylan heard Connor’s words, they became even more fearful.
“Mr. McDonald, a board meeting is needed to replace the school’s chancellor, and it needs the approval of 51% of the shareholders. However, you now have 71% of the shares, so you can symbolically hold a board meeting,” Thomas said slowly.
“I know!” Connor nodded lightly and looked at Jesse. “I told you before that unless I want to leave, no one can expel me. Now, not only can you not expel me, but 1 will also fire you!”
When Jesse heard Connor’s words, his face instantly turned pale, and his entire body went limp.
He had never expected that this seemingly poor student in front of him was such a strong existence!
Who would have thought that a rich kid who had inherited the Empire World Corporation would be so bored that he would be delivering food at school and pretending to be poor?
“Mr. McDonald, will you retire Chancellor Jesse from his position now?” Thomas stepped forward and asked Connor.
“Mr. McDonald, no!” Jesse hurriedly kneeled on the ground and shouted.
“Mr. Morgan, Mr. McDonald, it’s indeed my fault today. I was unaware of who 1 was dealing with and offended Mr. McDonald. You two can punish me however you want, but please don’t fire me. After all, I’ve been at Porthampton University for so many years. Even if I don’t have any merit, I’ve worked hard!” Jesse begged.
After hesitating, Dylan kneeled on the ground and said to Connor, “Mr. McDonald, we failed to recognize you today and offended you. I beg you to give us another chance. Please don’t fire us!”
Dylan was not a fool. He knew that the reason he could do whatever he wanted at Porthampton University was all because of his uncle, Jesse.
If Connor fired Jesse now, it would not end well for him.
Connor narrowed his eyes at the two people kneeling before him. He was filled with disdain.
Dylan and Jesse, who were still swaggering around, were kneeling in front of him like dogs, begging him to let them go.
If Connor was just an ordinary student, he might not have had a chance to explain himself today and would have been expelled by Jesse.
Therefore, Connor naturally wouldn’t let them off easily!
Jesse looked at Connor abnormally nervously, hoping Connor would let him off.
Originally, as the chancellor of Porthampton University, Jesse could decide Connor’s student status with a single word.
However, they had swapped positions. A single sentence from Connor could determine Jesse’s career..

chapters.title: Chapter 131 - 131: Under Two Conditions
chapters.content:
Chapter 131: Under Two Conditions
Translator: End less Fantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
On the other side, in the classroom.
A student ran into the classroom and shouted at Rachel while panting, “Ms. Wallace, Connor might have already been expelled!”
When Rachel heard this, she suddenly looked at the student and asked with widened eyes, “How did you know?”
“I saw Mr. Waag from the archives department walk into the principal’s office with a file in his hand!” the student replied.
“It’s over. Connor might have been expelled!” Rachel muttered in despair.
As a lecturer at Porthampton University, Rachel naturally knew what the archives office was for.
There were only two possibilities if someone took out the files. The first was that a lecturer had resigned, and the second was that a student had transferred to another school or had been expelled.
“No, I have to go to the chancellor!” Rachel muttered softly, then turned around and ran toward the principal’s office.
Eunice hesitated for a moment before following Rachel out.
When Brandon, Mandy, and the others heard the news of Connor being expelled, their faces suddenly bloomed with smiles. They had already begun to discuss where they should go to celebrate tonight.
Meanwhile, Dominic and Spencer were in despair. They never thought that Connor would really be expelled just like that.
***
Porthampton University, in the chancellor’s office.
Jesse and Dylan kneeled before Connor and begged him to give them a chance.
Connor had been thinking about how to punish them.
After all, if they were expelled, it would not be easy to find a suitable chancellor in a short time.
However, if he didn’t fire the two, he would be letting down the girls in the school who they had defiled because these two people were not qualified to be educators at all.
Therefore, Connor hesitated for a moment.
“Click clack, click clack!”
At this moment, the sound of high heels could be heard from outside the office.
After Connor heard this sound, he could not help but be stunned momentarily.
“Knock, knock!”
Then, there was a knock on the door.
“Mr. Zachman, are you there?” Rachel asked in a somewhat hurried tone.
“Why is Ms. Wallace here?”
After Connor heard Rachel’s voice, a trace of shock appeared in his heart. Then, he realized that Rachel might have come to plead for him.
At this moment, Connor did not want to expose his true identity, so after hesitating, he whispered to Jesse, “Get up. When Ms. Wallace comes in later, don’t tell her my identity. Do you understand what 1 mean?”
“Unde… Understood!” Jesse quickly nodded and stood up to sit down.
Connor stood in front of Jesse with his head lowered. He looked like a primary school student who had made a mistake.
Dylan and Thomas sat on the sofa at the side.
“Who is it?” Jesse calmed himself down and called out expressionlessly.
“Mr. Zachman, it’s Ms. Wallace!” Rachel hurriedly said.
“Ms. Wallace, please come in!” Jesse said calmly.
After Rachel heard Jesse’s permission, she quickly pushed open the door and walked into the office.
When Rachel saw the file on Jesse’s desk, she was even more certain that Jesse was about to get rid of Connor.
“Mr. Zachman, I don’t think Connor is a thief. I’ve known Connor for so long, so 1 don’t think he’s such a person!” Rachel looked at Jesse and said.
“That’s right, Mr. Zachman. I lost the money, but 1 no longer want to pursue this. Can you not expel Connor?” Eunice added.
Even then, Rachel and Eunice were still pleading for him. Connor was very touched. He even wanted to lay his cards on the table with the two of them.
However, Connor was worried that Rachel and Eunice would think he had lied to them, so he suppressed his urge.
“Ms. Wallace, you don’t have to worry about whether Connor is a thief. We are still investigating. After we have investigated this, I will inform you immediately!” Jesse said to Rachel without smiling.
“But Mr. Zachman…”
“Ms. Wallace, don’t you trust me? If you can prove Connor is not a thief, I can let him go now. But if you can’t, then go back and wait!”
Jesse had been thinking about whether Connor wanted to fire him, so he didn’t want to dilly-dally with Rachel.
After Rachel saw Jesse’s attitude, she dared not say anything more. She turned to Connor and said, “Connor, you must cooperate with Mr. Zachman’s investigation, understand?”
“Yes, Ms. Wallace!” Connor replied in a low voice.
“Eunice, let’s go!” Rachel sighed helplessly, then turned around and walked out of the office.
Eunice hesitated for a moment before leaving with Rachel. At this moment, the two of them hoped that Jesse could prove Connor’s innocence.
After Rachel and Eunice leave, Jesse hurriedly stood up and said to Connor,
“Mr. McDonald, please take a seat. Did I do well just now?”
Connor sat on Jesse’s chair and said softly, “Jesse, do you still want to continue being the chancellor?”
“Yes, Mr. McDonald. I beg you to give me another chance!” Jesse said anxiously.
Connor was planning to get rid of Jesse just now, but the appearance of Rachel and Eunice made Connor realize that if he fired Jesse now, it would arouse the suspicion of others. Moreover, the enmity between him, Brandon, and Harvey had not yet settled. He still needed Jesse and Dylan to continue helping him play the game.
Therefore, Connor changed his mind and said, “Alright, i won’t fire you under two conditions!”
“Please name them, Mr. McDonald. I’ll agree to ten conditions!” Jesse said enthusiastically.
“The first condition is that you can’t tell anyone that I’m the president of the board of directors of Porthampton University. If anyone finds out, I’ll fire you immediately!” Connor said slowly.
” Mr. McDonald, don’t worry. Only a few of us know about this. I won’t tell anyone else!”
Although Jesse didn’t know why Connor wanted to do this, he still readily agreed.
“The second condition is that you and Dylan have to write down all the bad things you and Dylan have done in school and stamp your fingerprints. You have to promise that you won’t do such things again. Otherwise, not only will I fire you, but I will also hand these things over to the police and let them deal with you!”
Connor knew Jesse had done many bad things in the past few years. He was worried that Jesse would do it again, so he needed something to control Jesse and Dylan.
“Uhm…” Jesse’s eyes flashed with a hint of embarrassment.
“Otherwise, I’ll fire you now!” Connor said slowly.
“Alright, alright. I will!” Jesse said anxiously and continued, “Don’t worry, Mr. McDonald. I’ll give you these documents tomorrow!”
“Good!” Connor nodded lightly, then turned around and said to Dylan, “Call Harvey over now!”
“Alright, 1’11 do that now!” Dylan quickly agreed, then turned around and walked out of the office..

chapters.title: Chapter 132 - 132: Who Do You Think You Are
chapters.content:
Chapter 132: Who Do You Think You Are
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
After dealing with Jesse and Dylan, Connor began to prepare to deal with Brandon, Mandy, and the others.
Now that Connor wanted to deal with Mandy, Brandon, and the others, it was very simple.
He only needed one sentence to get Jesse to expel them.
However, Connor didn’t do that because he hadn’t explained the matter of his stealing yet. If he didn’t explain it clearly, the entire school would think that he was a thief in the future. Then, how could Connor continue to stay at Porthampton University?
Therefore, he had to explain this clearly.
On the other side, Dylan was still shocked by Connor’s heaven-defying identity. Even when he arrived at the classroom door, his expression was still very shocked.
“Phew…”
Dylan took a deep breath and walked into the classroom.
“Mr. Wagner, why are you here? Is there a result for Connor’s thievery?”
When Rachel saw Dylan come in, she hurriedly asked Dylan excitedly.
“I’m here to retrieve someone!” Dylan replied expressionlessly. Then, he turned his head and shouted at Harvey, who was in the back row of the classroom, “Harvey McAdam, follow me!”
Harvey was still immersed in the joy of Connor being expelled from the school. When he heard Dylan’s order, he was stunned for a moment. Then, he stood up and asked, “Mr. Wagner, is there anything you need from me?”
“The chancellor wants you to go over!” Dylan whispered.
“Alright, I got it!” Harvey chuckled and agreed. Then, he followed Dylan out of the classroom.
“I didn’t expect Harvey to get something good in return this time. The chancellor must have called him over to praise him. He might even reward him!” Lily said enviously when she saw Harvey being called out.
“Yeah, if 1 had known that this would go so smoothly, 1 would have done it myself. Now, I even let that idiot Harvey take all the credit!” Brandon felt some regret.
After all, Harvey had contributed greatly to catching Connor, the thief. Perhaps the school would even give him the title of a model student.
“As long as we can get Connor expelled, it doesn’t matter if we get the credit!” Mandy was in a good mood. She had already thought of how to mock Connor later.
***
On the other side, Harvey seemed to think the chancellor had called him over to praise him.
Hence, he turned around and asked Dylan with a smile, “Mr. Wagner, do you think the school will give me a reward or something if 1 help the school catch Connor, the thief?”
“A reward?” When Dylan heard this, he could not help but sneer. He cursed the idiot in his heart. He wanted a reward! It would be great if the chancellor expelled him later!
“Mr. Wagner, let me tell you, people like Connor should be expelled directly and sent to the police station. The few cases of money theft in our school before should all be done by Connor. We can’t be lenient toward such people!” Harvey looked at Dylan and continued.
“You’d better mind your own business!” Dylan replied coldly.
“My own business?”
When Harvey heard Dylan’s words, he was stunned for a moment. Then, he asked with some doubt, “Mr. Wagner, what do you mean? What do you mean by my own business?”
“You’ll know soon!” Dylan replied expressionlessly. Then, he reached out and pushed open the door of the principal’s office.
Harvey was confused, but he still followed Dylan into the office.
When Harvey walked into the office, he found Connor sitting on the principal’s office chair, and the principal, Jesse, stood beside him.
Harvey gaped in shock, looking at this scene in a daze, he was confused.
However, he quickly regained his senses and shouted, “Connor, you delivery guy, what right do you have to sit there? Get up quickly!”
“Thud!”
As soon as Harvey finished speaking, Dylan kicked Harvey’s butt behind him without thinking. He shouted at Harvey, his eyes widened, “Who do you think you are? How dare you speak to Mr. McDonald like this?”
“Mr…. Mr. McDonald?”
After Harvey was kicked to the ground by Dylan, he was very puzzled.
He couldn’t understand why Dylan seemed to have changed into a different person. He called Connor ‘Mr. McDonald’. Moreover, even their school’s chancellor was standing respectfully beside Connor.
Harvey was dumbfounded. He had no idea what was going on.
Connor slowly stood up and approached Harvey. Then, he narrowed his eyes and said, “Harvey, you’ve always been a clown in my eyes, so even if you’ve made things difficult for me repeatedly, I didn’t hold it against you. Because I feel that it would insult my character to hold it against trash like you. But I didn’t expect you to be so stubborn. You’ve even learned to accuse others and want to push me into the fire. You’re vicious!”
“Accuse you?” Harvey was stunned momentarily, then shouted at the top of his lungs, “When did I accuse you? What evidence do you have to prove that I accused you?”
“Harvey, you’re still not going to admit it now?” Connor replied softly.
“Why should 1 admit anything? What 1 said is the truth!” Harvey roared angrily, then looked at Jesse’s position and sneered, “1 understand what’s going on. You must have used the stolen money to bribe the chancellor and Mr. Wagner, right? Connor, oh, Connor, you’re cunning. You can even bribe the chancellor. How much money did you steal?”
Connor looked at Harvey and smiled helplessly. He didn’t know what to say. Harvey’s brain was indeed different from normal people’s.
“Mr. Zachman, you have to explain what happened today. Otherwise, I’ll call the police now and say that you accepted bribes from students!” Harvey gritted his teeth and shouted at Jesse.
“Harvey, I forgot to tell you that I’m the president of our school’s board of directors, so I suggest you tell me the truth. Otherwise, 1 can expel you right now. Do you understand?” Connor looked at Harvey and said.
“Hahaha, Connor, why are you putting up an act with me? If you’re the school board’s president, then I’m the Director of Education!” Harvey hollered as if he had heard the funniest joke in the world.
“Mr. McDonald is not bragging. He is the president of our school’s board of directors. Moreover, he doesn’t need to bribe me at all. You claimed Mr. McDonald stole your class fee. 1 think with Mr. McDonald’s status, he wouldn’t do such a thing for a mere few thousand dollars!” Jesse said expressionlessly.
When Harvey heard this, he was instantly stunned. He was very shocked and seemed somewhat dazed.
Harvey might not believe Connor, but now that Jesse had admitted it, it meant that what Connor had said was true.
At this moment, no matter how stupid Harvey was, he could feel that Jesse was not joking with him just now!
Was Connor the president of the school board?
How was this possible?
Wasn’t Connor just a poor delivery boy?
Harvey’s eyes widened as he looked at Connor in disbelief..

chapters.title: Chapter 133 - 133: Do Not Expose My Identity
chapters.content:
Chapter 133: Do Not Expose My Identity
Translator: End less Fantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
“Harvey, what exactly happened today? 1 need an explanation!” Connor narrowed his eyes and questioned Harvey.
“Today… Today’s matter…”
Harvey was completely shocked by Connor’s identity. A trace of fear flashed in his eyes, and he didn’t know how to answer Connor.
Originally, Harvey had planned to confess everything, but just as he was about to speak, he suddenly realized that if he admitted to accusing Connor, the principal would treat him as a thief, and he would still be expelled.
In other words, whether Harvey admitted it or not, he would face the risk of being expelled.
However, if he didn’t admit it, he might still have a chance of survival.
Harvey hesitated momentarily before saying, “Today’s matter has nothing to do with me. I didn’t accuse Connor!”
“You’re still stubborn at this point, aren’t you?” Connor looked at Harvey and said expressionlessly.
“I… I’m not being stubborn. This has nothing to do with me in the first place. I only found out about your theft by chance. 1 don’t know anything!” Harvey told Connor with determination.
“Harvey, 1 originally wanted to allow you to admit your mistake, but since you don’t know what’s good for you, don’t blame me for being mean!” Connor said coldly. Then, he looked at Dylan and said softly, “Dylan, if I remember correctly, cameras are installed in all the classrooms in our school, right?”
Hearing Connor’s words, Harvey’s eyes flashed with fear.
Only then did he suddenly remember the cameras in the school classroom.
“Mr. McDonald, our school has indeed installed cameras in the classroom, but these cameras are not turned on…” Dylan replied helplessly.
When Harvey heard this, he couldn’t help but snicker. If these cameras weren’t turned on, Connor wouldn’t have been able to find evidence that he had accused him.
He could not do anything to him if he refused to admit it, even if Connor was the board of directors chairman.
“It’s okay. Although the cameras in the classroom are off, the cameras in the corridor should be working, right? Get someone to pull out the surveillance video of the corridor for me now!”
After studying at Porthampton University for three years, Connor naturally knew that the cameras in the classroom were purely for decoration.
However, when he came to the principal’s office just now, Connor noticed that the camera in the corridor was turned on. Moreover, the camera in the corridor could not only capture the situation in the corridor but could also see into the classroom.
Thus, Connor had already considered how to deal with Harvey and the others.
“Yes, Mr. McDonald!” Dylan quickly agreed.
Meanwhile, Harvey sat on the ground in despair.
At this moment, his emotion was like riding a roller coaster. One moment it went up, and the next moment it was down. When he heard what Connor said, he was about to collapse.
How could Harvey have thought that the cameras in the corridor could capture the situation in the classroom?
A few minutes later, Dylan returned to the office with a hard disk. Then, he handed the hard disk to Connor and said softly, “Mr. McDonald, the videos you want are all here!”
After Connor took the hard drive, he had no intention of opening it because he knew what the video was.
“Harvey, it has all come to this. Are you still not going to tell me the truth?” Connor waved the hard disk in his hand at Harvey and asked softly.
