Harvey was completely out of it now. After hesitating, he begged, “Connor, I know I was wrong. 1 was blinded. Please don’t expel me. I know 1 was wrong. 1 shouldn’t have accused you. I’m not human…”
“Now you admit it!” Connor looked at Harvey and sneered. Then, he said playfully, “I can let you stay at Porthampton University, but you have to promise me three things!”
“What is it?” Harvey quickly asked.
“First, don’t expose my identity!”
Harvey looked at Connor and was stunned. Then, he nodded and said, “Alright, alright, 1 definitely won’t tell anyone!”
“The second thing is, come back to the classroom with me and admit to what you’ve done before. Then, tell me who instructed you behind the scenes!” Connor continued.
Harvey’s eyes flashed with hesitation.
“If you don’t agree to that, you can get lost now!” Connor said lightly.
“I agree… I promise you!”
Although Harvey did not want to betray Brandon, Mandy, and the others, he had no choice but to obey Connor to protect himself.
Harvey’s intestines were about to turn green with regret. Who would have thought Connor had been pretending to be a poor kid all along?
As a super-rich heir, not only did he usually wear tattered clothes, but he also delivered food in his spare time. He was simply asking for it!
“Alright, let’s go!”
Connor took the hard disk and turned around to walk toward the classroom.
“Connor, what about the third thing?” Harvey asked after Connor.
“I’ll tell you the third thing later!” Connor replied indifferently and then walked out of the office.
Dylan, Jesse, and Harvey quickly followed Connor and left. As for Thomas, he didn’t follow Connor back to the classroom.
Because once Thomas appeared, Connor’s identity would be exposed.
On the way back to the classroom.
Dylan, Jesse, and Harvey had been looking at Connor with reverence. The three of them were filled with curiosity and confusion.
They couldn’t understand why a person like Connor would pretend to be poor in school and even specifically told the three of them not to expose his identity. What was the meaning of Connor doing this?
In fact, it was all very simple. If everyone knew that he had inherited a ten trillion dollar inheritance, then Connor would no longer be able to live an ordinary life. He would also have no way to distinguish between those around him who were sincere to him and those who were only for his money.
It was like someone who had won a five-million-dollar prize wouldn’t brag about it.
Once his relatives and friends knew about this, it would bring a lot of trouble.
Connor had also thought of this..

chapters.title: Chapter 134 - 134: The Classmates’ Reaction
chapters.content:
Chapter 134: The Classmates’ Reaction
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Five minutes later.
Connor and the others returned to the classroom.
However, when the students in the classroom saw Connor return, they looked at him with disdain. They hated thieves like Connor from the bottom of their hearts.
Rachel and Eunice didn’t know what had happened in the chancellor’s office, so when they saw Connor and the others return, they thought they were there to announce Connor’s expulsion.
“Connor, oh Connor, are you finally going to be expelled from school? Let’s see how you can still be arrogant this time!”
Mandy looked at Connor and sneered. Then, she said to Connor in a strange tone, “Hah, if it isn’t our class’ thief, Connor McDonald? Are you returning to beg everyone to forgive you and give you a chance to turn over a new leaf?”
When Connor heard this, he looked up at Mandy.
“Why should we give this kind of person a chance to change? He should be expelled!”
“Yes, sc*m like him should not be forgiven!”
“It’s already good that we didn’t call the police to arrest him!”
The students in the classroom shouted indignantly.
“Everyone, stop talking. Connor stole the money for a reason. After all, he’s so poor and likes to act tough. If he doesn’t have money, he can only rely on stealing money to maintain his reputation!” Brandon spoke up.
“Can’t he behave himself if he doesn’t have money? He likes to act tough and steal other people’s money to pretend to be a rich kid. He’s so shameless!” Mandy quickly said.
Connor looked at Mandy and Brandon expressionlessly. Not only was there no anger in his heart, but he even wanted to laugh.
Connor was very curious about how they would react after they knew the truth!
When the students in the classroom saw Connor and the others return to the classroom, they thought that Connor must have admitted his mistake to the chancellor. After returning to the classroom, he probably wanted to beg everyone to give him a chance to turn over a new leaf.
Therefore, most of them stood up and cursed at Connor.
Connor’s popularity in the class was not very good, to begin with. Now that he had been suspected of having stolen money, the students in the class despised Connor even more.
Dominic and Spencer were stunned. Until now, they still could not believe that Connor had stolen the money.
Dylan and Jesse wanted to go to the podium to clarify this, but Connor stopped them.
“Mr. McDonald, I’ll explain on your behalf now!” Dylan whispered to Connor.
“There is no need. 1 just like to see these people gloating. I’ll make them pay the price later!” Connor said coldly. Then, he walked up to the podium and narrowed his eyes at the students below the podium.
Connor felt that it was only at this moment that he could see a person’s true appearance. He had to remember every student who had once mocked him and then take revenge.
When Dylan, Jesse, and the others saw that Connor did not want them to intervene, they said nothing and stood quietly at the side.
But at this moment, Rachel felt that something was wrong. If Connor had really been expelled, then Dylan should have announced this immediately. Why was he standing at the side and not saying anything?
“Mr. Wagner, what’s going on?”
Rachel hesitated for a moment before asking Jesse softly.
“You’ll know in a while!” Jesse replied indifferently.
After Rachel heard this, she seemed to be even more puzzled.
When the students in the classroom saw Connor walk up to the podium, they immediately became agitated.
“Connor, how dare you still come back to the class? For our class to have a thief like you, it’s a disgrace to our finance faculty!”
“Yeah, I thought you were an honest person. I didn’t expect you to be such a person! I was wondering why you suddenly became rich. It turns out that you were stealing other people’s money!”
“Using other people’s money to pretend to be a rich kid is shameless!” the students shouted excitedly at Connor.
Connor stood on the podium indifferently, accepting everyone’s criticism without any intention of refuting it.
“Connor, what’s going on?”
At this moment, a beautiful person ran in from outside the classroom and asked Connor in confusion.
“I’m fine…”
Connor turned and saw that it was Natasha and Cindy.
Natasha and Cindy had been waiting in the cinema for too long, and Dominic didn’t pick up their calls, so they came to the classroom to see what was happening.
However, as soon as they entered the classroom, they saw Connor being criticized by everyone.
When Dominic saw Natasha and Cindy, a trace of panic flashed across his face.
He felt that if Natasha knew Connor had stolen something, she would leave Connor again.
Therefore, Dominic hurriedly stood up and walked up to Natasha. He then pulled Natasha aside and said, “Cindy, Natasha, why are you two here?” “Because the three of you never showed up and didn’t pick up your calls. That’s why we came straight to you…” Cindy pursed her lips and replied. Then, she turned to look at Connor and continued to ask, “Dominic, what happened here? Why are they all criticizing Connor?”
“Uh… It’s just a small misunderstanding. You two should leave now!” Dominic casually replied.
“A small misunderstanding? Why doesn’t it look like it? Did Connor do something bad?” Cindy replied with a frown.
“No, why would Connor…”
Before Dominic could finish speaking, Mandy suddenly stood up and shouted, “You guessed right. Connor did something bad. He stole our class fee and was caught red-handed. We’re now discussing how to deal with him!”
Mandy had long wanted to break up Connor and Natasha. Previously, when they were at Phillip’s Signature, Mandy was very unhappy when Natasha confessed to Connor.
Now that Natasha had taken the initiative to come over, Mandy naturally wouldn’t let go of this opportunity.
“Connor, you stole money? How could you do such a thing?”
After Cindy heard Mandy’s words, she shouted at Connor in disbelief.
Connor glanced at Cindy without saying anything.
Natasha felt that her brain was not working properly. How could a rich heir like Connor steal money?
Could Connor have stolen the money to buy the villa?
This was impossible!
How could a super-rich heir who could easily buy a mansion worth 200 million do something like steal money?
Even if Natasha were beaten to death, she still wouldn’t believe it!

chapters.title: Chapter 135 - 135: Who Gave You The Orders?
chapters.content:
Chapter 135: Who Gave You The Orders?
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
“Well? What a shocker, eh?”
When Mandy saw Natasha standing rooted to the ground, she became even more smug as she said, “1 told you before not to get together with Connor because he’s a poor loser, but you didn’t listen. Do you regret it now? Connor is a thief, and you want to be with a thief. This is so funny!”
“How could Connor be a thief?” Natasha replied, puzzled.
“How is that possible? The class fee is hidden in Connor’s desk now that the evidence is conclusive. The students in the class have also seen it, but you still don’t believe it?” Mandy asked coldly.
“Impossible, this is impossible!”
Natasha knew Connor’s identity. She knew that Connor would never steal such a small amount of money.
“Looks like this Connor has cast a spell on you…”
Seeing that Natasha still didn’t believe Connor was a thief, Mandy shook her head helplessly.
“Alright, stop talking nonsense with people like Connor. Hurry up and expel him!”
“Right, hurry up and expel this trash! He must have committed the previous thefts in our school!”
“That’s right. We have to make him hand over all the money he stole before!”
The students in the classroom completely ignored Natasha and shouted excitedly at Connor.
After Mandy saw everyone’s angry expression, she looked at Connor and said with a playful smile, “Connor, do you still want to continue pretending now?”
“Are you all done?” Connor looked around at everyone in the classroom and asked calmly.
When everyone heard Connor’s words, they were instantly stunned.
“Since you’ve finished speaking, let me say a few words. I’ve already remembered those who stood out to criticize me. Later, you’ll have to pay the price for what you said just now!”
Connor looked at everyone and continued.
The students who had stood up to criticize Connor looked confused when they heard this because they didn’t know what Connor meant.
Connor looked at Dylan and said softly, “Mr. Wagner, tell them everything about this!”
“Sure!” Dylan nodded and walked up to the podium. He walked to Connor’s side and said expressionlessly, “After Mr. Zachman and I investigated, we discovered that today’s matter is not as simple as everyone thought. The thief is not Connor, but Harvey himself!”
“What?”
When the students in the classroom heard this, their eyes widened in disbelief.
“Harvey stole the class fee while everyone had P. E. class and hid it in Connor’s desk. Then, he framed Connor for it. Classic!” Dylan continued.
As soon as he finished speaking, the entire classroom fell into a dead silence.
Everyone’s mouths were wide open. Mandy, Brandon May, and the others were completely dumbfounded.
Rachel and Eunice were also shocked.
Natasha heaved a sigh of relief. If this was the case, then everything made sense. Why would a super-rich heir like Connor steal the class fees?
Was this a joke?
“Mr. Wagn… Mr. Wagner, are you sure that the thief is Harvey himself?” Brandon hesitated for a moment and asked Dylan.
“Yeah, Mr. Wagner, are you mistaken? How could Harvey be a thief? Has Connor bribed you? The money was found in Connor’s desk. If he’s not a thief, who is?”
Mandy knew that it had been exposed then, but she still retorted with conviction.
“That’s right, Mr. Wagner. Connor must be the thief. Connor couldn’t have bribed you, right?”
A few of Brandon’s lackeys also stood up and shouted.
“Bang!”
After Dylan heard the words of Mandy, Brandon, and the others, he suddenly slammed the table before him and shouted, “All of you shut your mouths. What do you mean Connor bribed me? Do you think Mr. Zachman and I were bribed?”
After hearing Dylan’s words, Brandon’s lackeys became completely quiet.
Dylan turned to look at Harvey and said coldly, “Harvey, what are you still standing there for? Hurry up and apologize to everyone!”
Harvey hesitated momentarily, gritted his teeth, and approached the podium. Then he said in a low voice, “Mr. Wagner is right. I was indeed the one who did this today. I stole the class fee and deliberately placed it in Connor’s desk to frame Connor!”
“Clang!”
Mandy, originally fearless, immediately took two steps back after hearing Harvey’s words. Then, she sat down on the chair, her eyes filled with panic.
Brandon looked at Harvey with bloodshot eyes. He really couldn’t understand why Harvey would admit to it!
May looked at Harvey and smiled bitterly. May had opposed this plan before. She had always felt that something was wrong. As expected, things were exposed in the end.
After the students in the classroom saw Harvey admit it, they were shocked.
They had never thought that Connor was not the thief. The real thief was Harvey himself!
Dominic and Spencer were extremely excited.
“That’s great. Connor is not a thief!” Dominic shouted happily.
“Yeah, I already said that Connor would never steal anything!” Spencer quickly added.
“We’ve already investigated this thoroughly. The real thief is Harvey, and Connor is the victim. So, I’ve discussed this with Mr. Zachman just now. We’ll let Connor decide how to deal with Harvey!” Dylan announced to the students below the podium expressionlessly.
After Harvey knew that his fate was in Connor’s hands, he quickly turned his head to look at Connor’s position and said nervously, “Connor, I know 1 was wrong. 1 shouldn’t have framed you. I beg you. As long as you don’t expel me, I’ll do anything you want. 1 beg you…”
When Mandy, Brandon, and the others saw Harvey’s begging, their hearts instantly turned cold.
Who would have thought that Connor, who was about to be expelled, would come to be the decision-maker of this case?
Until now, Brandon still couldn’t understand why Harvey admitted to it. If Harvey didn’t admit it, even if he couldn’t frame Connor as a thief, it couldn’t prove that Harvey did these things!
“Harvey, do you remember the second thing you promised me?” Connor asked Harvey expressionlessly.
“I do…” Harvey quickly nodded.
“Tell me, who is the one who instigated you behind the scenes!” Connor prompted.
After Brandon heard Connor’s words, he was instantly shocked because he never thought Connor knew someone was instigating Harvey behind the scenes.
Brandon started to hyperventilate. He was worried that Harvey would expose him.
Mandy, May, Lily, and the others also subconsciously avoided Harvey’s gaze..

chapters.title: Chapter 136 - 136: Kneel!
chapters.content:
Chapter 136: Kneel!
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Harvey hesitated, then gritted his teeth and said, “The person who instigated me behind my back is Brandon! Brandon has always wanted to find an opportunity to take revenge on you. This was all Brandon’s idea. I’m only responsible for executing this!”
“Woah!”
After hearing Harvey’s words, the students in the classroom exploded. Everyone turned to look at Brandon.
No one would have thought that the mastermind behind this was Brandon!
“Harvey, what nonsense are you talking about? When did I order you to do that? I’m warning you not to slander me!” Brandon shouted angrily.
“You were the one who planned this. i still have the Facebook message you sent me. If you don’t admit it, I can show them to everyone now!” Harvey quickly retorted.
After Brandon heard this, his face instantly turned pale, and sweat appeared on his forehead. For a moment, he didn’t know how to explain himself.
“Connor, since the two people who framed you have been found, how do you plan to deal with them now?” Jesse walked to Connor and asked him seriously.
“What the two of them have done should be enough to expel them, right?” Connor said slowly.
“Enough!” Jesse quickly said.
Connor turned and looked at Brandon coldly.
After Brandon saw the expression on Connor’s face, he instantly panicked.
In the past, Brandon’s father had spent a lot of money and connections to get Brandon to study at Porthampton University.
If Brandon were expelled from school now, his father would beat him to death!
Therefore, Brandon was also very afraid that Connor would expel him.
“Connor… i shouldn’t have framed you. I beg you, give me a chance. If you don’t get me expelled, I’ll do anything you want!”
Brandon, who had always been domineering in class, finally lowered his head before Connor and spoke very humbly.
As for the students in the classroom, after seeing Brandon’s servile appearance, they were a little stunned. They felt that all of this was too unbelievable.
Who would have thought that the richest kid in the class would beg a poor delivery boy, Connor?
“Brandon, you don’t have to beg him. Who does he think he is?”
Mandy seemed unable to accept that Brandon had lost to Connor, and she shouted at Brandon nervously.
“Connor, I beg you, give me a chance! If you don’t get me expelled, 1’11 do anything…”
Brandon ignored Mandy. To retain his student status, he could only give up his dignity and beg Connor.
The students in the classroom were all shocked.
No one had expected that today’s matter would have a shocking result!
The real thief was not Connor but Brandon and Harvey.
There were two reasons why Harvey only mentioned Brandon. The first reason was that he didn’t want to betray May. The second reason was that he only had evidence that Brandon had instructed him to do so. There was no evidence that anyone else had contacted him, so it was useless to say it.
“Connor, how do you plan to deal with these two?”
Jesse knew Connor’s identity, so he naturally left dealing with Harvey and Brandon to Connor.
“You two don’t want to be expelled, right?” Connor hesitated before narrowing his eyes and asking Brandon.
“Yes, as long as you don’t expel me, I’ll do anything!” Brandon said without thinking.
“Alright, since you have said so, I will let you off…”
Hearing Connor’s words, Harvey and Brandon immediately heaved a sigh of relief.
But Connor’s following words made the two frown hard.
“However, I want the two of you to kneel outside the classroom until seven o’clock at night. Then, I’ll let you go!” Connor said expressionlessly.
The students in the classroom gasped when they heard Connor’s words.
“Connor, aren’t you going a little overboard? Don’t push your luck. Let me tell you…”
Mandy stepped forward and shouted at Connor with a pair of fox-like eyes.
“If you think I’m going overboard, you can choose not to kneel and be expelled!” Connor turned to look at Mandy and said coldly.
“You…”
Mandy was at a loss for words. She did not know how to answer Connor.
As for Brandon, he glared at Connor. He felt Connor’s request was too much and simply couldn’t accept it.
But if he didn’t accept it, he could only face the risk of being expelled.
“Connor, we’re all classmates. There’s no need to be so ruthless, right?”
“Yeah, isn’t asking Brandon to kneel outside the classroom a bit too much?”
“Connor, you’re going a little overboard!”
After the students in the classroom heard Connor’s request, they stood up one after another to defend Brandon and Harvey.
“I went overboard?”
After Connor heard everyone’s words, he could not help but sneer. Then, he said expressionlessly, “When the two of them framed me as a thief, why didn’t you say anything? Now I’m the one who has gone overboard?”
Everyone looked at Connor with some embarrassment. After hesitating, no one spoke up for Brandon and Harvey anymore.
“Will you kneel or not?”
Connor walked up to Brandon and asked coldly.
“Connor, you win! I’ll kneel, I’ll kneel, alright?” Brandon gritted his teeth and said.
After Harvey saw Brandon agree to Connor’s request, he quickly said, “1 will kneel too, 1 will kneel too…”
After the students in the classroom heard Brandon’s words, they were stunned and shocked.
They had never thought Brandon and Harvey would agree to Connor’s unreasonable request.
Rachel narrowed her eyes and looked at Connor, but she said nothing.
She felt Connor was so ruthless because Brandon had bullied him for too long, and Brandon had stolen Connor’s girlfriend.
The combination of old and new grudges made Connor do such a thing.
Therefore, Rachel did not say anything.
After punishing Harvey and Connor, Connor turned to look at the other students in the classroom.
The students who had insulted Connor before seemed terrified when they saw Connor’s gaze.
They knew that after Connor dealt with Brandon and Harvey, he would make a move on them.
“Do you still remember what 1 told you before?” Connor said to the students in the classroom expressionlessly..

chapters.title: Chapter 137 - 137: Apologize for Your Recklessness
chapters.content:
Chapter 137: Apologize for Your Recklessness
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Hearing what Connor said, the students in the classroom were stunned.
“If you’ve forgotten, then I’ll help you recall. I’ve said it before, all of you have to be responsible for what you’ve said!” Connor said firmly.
“Connor, we’re classmates. There’s no need to be so ruthless!”
“Yeah, we’re not the ones who framed you. Why are you holding on to us?”
The few boys who stood up for Brandon before shouted at Connor nervously.
“Hah, classmates? Why didn’t you say you were classmates when you humiliated Connor earlier?” Spencer quickly stood up and snorted when he heard what these people said.
“That’s right. Didn’t you say that you wanted Connor expelled just now? Why didn’t you guys think that you were classmates then? Have you forgotten that Connor invited you all to the Brasserie Le Bernardin for a meal?” Dominic also shouted.
“I… We didn’t know that Connor was framed. We all thought Connor was a thief then, so we said that…”
A boy explained nervously.
“You guys don’t even know the truth, yet you dare to humiliate others so casually. Is it because Brandon is rich, and I’m just a delivery boy? There are so many unjust cases in the world. It’s because of people like you that black and white are reversed, and good people become bad people!” Connor said coldly.
“Connor is right. Students like you who insult others casually are no different from Brandon and Harvey. If we hadn’t investigated the matter today, you people might have forced Connor to drop out of school. Therefore, 1 must punish you properly and let the entire Porthampton University understand that you have to be responsible for every word you say before we figure out the truth!” Jesse’s ability to bootlick was quite good. After knowing that Connor wanted to deal with these students, he hurriedly stood up and spoke righteously.
When the students in the classroom heard Jesse’s words, their eyes widened in fear.
They weren’t afraid if Connor wanted to deal with them because many people had mocked Connor just now. Connor couldn’t do anything to them.
However, things would be very different if Jesse wanted to punish them. Jesse was the chancellor of Porthampton University. He could punish them however he wanted. No one dared to go against the chancellor’s wishes.
“Connor, what do you think about giving each of them a major demerit?” Jesse turned his head and asked Connor.
“Everyone will be given a major demerit?”
Everyone was dumbfounded when they heard this. No one had expected Jesse to be so heartless.
Just because they had humiliated Connor, they had to give each of them a big demerit. This punishment was a little heavy.
Rachel looked at Jesse and Connor, her beautiful eyes filled with confusion. She really couldn’t understand why Jesse treated Connor so well.
Even if these students had insulted Connor before, it was not to the extent of giving everyone a big demerit, right?
“Connor, 1 don’t think they’re targeting you on purpose. You’re all classmates. It’s better not to make such a big deal!” Rachel hesitated for a moment before softly speaking to Connor.
“That’s right, Connor. We didn’t do it on purpose. Hurry up and plead with Mr. Zachman. Don’t let him punish us!”
“We’re all classmates. We still have to get along in the future. There’s no need to make things so difficult, right?”
At this moment, the students were anxious. They looked at Connor and begged softly.
“Connor, why don’t we forget about this?”
The kind-hearted Eunice walked to Connor and advised him softly.
Connor originally planned to follow Jesse’s suggestion and give each of them a big demerit.
However, after hearing Eunice’s words, Connor’s heart softened. He looked at everyone expressionlessly and said, “You don’t want to get a major demerit, do you?”
“No!”
“Of course not!”
Everyone hurriedly shook their heads and mumbled.
“Alright then. I will give you a chance today because of Eunice and Miss Wallace. 1 can ask Mr. Zachman not to give you a major demerit, but all of you have to apologize to me! Apologize for your recklessness earlier!” Connor said.
When the students in the classroom heard this, they finally understood that Connor was now retaliating against them.
Not only did they have to apologize for what they said today, but they also had to apologize for what they said to Connor before!
The poor loser Connor, who everyone had always ridiculed, finally revealed his fangs. He was showing everyone that he was not easy to bully!
Everyone looked at Connor with a hint of confusion in their eyes.
They had never expected that Connor would not even let go of the students who had not spoken. He had asked everyone who humiliated Connor to stand up and apologize.
“We didn’t frame you just now. Why should we apologize?”
“Yeah, we didn’t do anything wrong. There’s no need to apologize!”
Although the students in the class already knew that Connor was not a thief, they were still unwilling to stand up and apologize to Connor.
Even though they had bullied Connor with Brandon!
“It’s fine if you don’t apologize. Then, I’ll give you all a huge demerit!”
Connor was not in the mood to continue talking nonsense with them. He turned his head and said to Jesse.
“Yes!” Jesse nodded without thinking.
“Connor…”
A girl who had mocked Connor before quickly stood up and said to Connor in a low voice when she realized Connor was going to punish her.
“Yes?” Connor replied indifferently.
“I’ll apologize to you. But can you not record it?” The girl bit her lip and said in a low voice.
Connor looked at the girl without saying anything.
“Connor, I’m sorry. I shouldn’t have mocked you just now!” the girl approached Connor and whispered to him.
“This person doesn’t need to be given demerit!” Connor said to Jesse after the girl apologize to him.
“Alright!” Jesse nodded again.
“I also apologize…”
“Connor, I apologize too!”
Although no one was willing to apologize to Connor, they were even more unwilling to be given demerits because of this, so they all stood up and apologized to Connor.
Connor smiled a little as he looked at these people’s expressions playfully. He could not help but feel a little amused.
“Connor, I’m sorry!”
“Connor, I’m sorry. i shouldn’t have slandered you before!”
For a moment, the classroom was filled with mumbles of apologies.
Regardless of whether they had mocked Connor, they all stood up and apologized to Connor..

chapters.title: Chapter 138 - 138: Spare Me Some Dignity
chapters.content:
Chapter 138: Spare Me Some Dignity
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Seeing the students apologizing, Connor was very calm.
Meanwhile, Dominic and Spencer two looked at Connor and sighed silently.
Connor had been with the students in the class for three years. No matter how they bullied him in these three years, he never retaliated. Only Dominic and Spencer and the other two would stand up for him.
In many people’s eyes, Connor was a poor loser who could be bullied easily.
But today, Connor seemed to have changed into a different person. His entire being emitted the domineering aura of a superior. Moreover, he had returned all the humiliation he had suffered before.
Natasha was also looking at Connor in shock, her beautiful eyes filled with confusion.
She really couldn’t understand why a super-rich heir like Connor would hide his identity.
If Connor revealed his true identity, he would probably scare all the students present to death.
Rachel was still calm. Although she didn’t know Connor’s true identity, she could understand Connor’s actions today.
Previously, the students in the class had always looked down on Connor and thought he was a poor delivery boy. They often used this to humiliate Connor. Rachel knew all these, but she couldn’t change anything.
Today, Connor finally found a chance to be a new person. Of course, he had to return all the humiliation he had suffered.
Any normal person would do this.
Mandy, Harvey, Brandon, and the others had ashen expressions. They never thought the trap they had carefully planned for so long would end up like this.
Originally, they wanted to use this to get the school to expel Connor. However, no one expected that in the end, not only did Connor not get expelled, but they almost got themselves expelled.
“What’s up with Connor? Why did Mr. Zachman help him?”
Mandy was still unable to accept the fact. She gritted her teeth and spoke up.
Brandon turned and glanced at Mandy. He was not in the mood to care about these things because he was worried that he would have to go outside the classroom door to apologize to Connor.
If he really kneeled and apologized to Connor at the door of the classroom, how could he continue to walk with his head held high at Porthampton University in the future?
A few minutes later.
The students who had humiliated Connor before stood up and apologized to him.
After Connor heard these people’s apologies, he remained calm.
In fact, he didn’t ask these people to apologize to take revenge on them. He just wanted them to understand one thing.
He, Connor, was not that easy to bully.
“There’s no need to give these people demerits!”
Connor turned and said to Jesse. Then, he approached Brandon and Harvey and said coldly, “What are you two still standing there for? Hurry up and kneel at the classroom door!”
“Connor, can we do this somewhere else?” Brandon gritted his teeth and whispered to Connor.
After Connor heard what Brandon said, he sneered and said coldly, “Do you think you’re in a place to negotiate with me now?”
“You…”
Brandon was stunned by Connor’s question.
“I’m not in the mood to talk nonsense with you now. Do you want to kneel or not?” Connor asked Brandon.
Brandon stood in place and hesitated for two seconds, then nodded at Connor.
Connor saw Brandon nodding and couldn’t help but laugh, “1 thought you had a backbone, but it turns out that you’re just a coward!”
“You…”
After Brandon heard Connor’s mocking, he glared at Connor.
“Let’s go!” Connor turned around and walked toward the classroom door.
Brandon stood in place and hesitated for two seconds, then gritted his teeth and followed Connor out of the classroom.
Harvey turned to look at May, took a deep breath, and then followed Connor and Brandon.
The students in the classroom were all very curious. Would Brandon and Harvey kneel and apologize to Connor?
Therefore, everyone followed Connor and the other two to the classroom door with the thought of watching the drama.
Soon, the classroom door was filled with students.
Connor looked at Brandon and Harvey calmly.
“Hurry up and kneel. I don’t have time to waste with you!” Connor looked at the two and said casually.
“Connor, it was my fault for framing you previously, but I’ve already admitted my mistake. Can’t you let me off the hook?”
Harvey saw that students surrounded the classroom door. He seemed to be backing out. He didn’t want to kneel like this.
“I’m already letting you off by asking you to kneel and apologize!” Connor said coldly.
Harvey looked at Connor and hesitated for a moment. Then, he gritted his teeth and said softly, “Connor, I can kneel and apologize, but can we return to the classroom? There are so many people here. Can you spare me some dignity?”
“Spare you some dignity?”
When Connor heard this, he couldn’t help but laugh. Then, he said in a playful tone, “When you framed me back then, why didn’t you think of sparing me some?”
“Kneel!” Connor roared coldly.
“Thud!”
Perhaps Harvey was frightened by Connor’s imposing manner, but when he heard this roar, his legs immediately went soft, and he kneeled before Connor in front of everyone.
When everyone saw Harvey kneeling in front of Connor, they gaped, and they were shocked.
Harvey’s kneeling dealt a heavy blow to his personality!
However, the humiliation he suffered now was not even a ten-thousandth of the humiliation Connor suffered back then.
In the past, Harvey had followed Brandon to bully Connor, but now, Connor made Harvey kneel in front of him.
The expressions of the students standing at the side and watching the show changed drastically. It was only at this moment that they realized that the current Connor was no longer the Connor they knew before.
After Connor saw Harvey kneeling before him, he smiled coldly and turned to Brandon, “He’s already kneeling. What are you still standing there for?”
Brandon looked at Connor with a dull gaze, and his expression was very conflicted.
He knew that if he kneeled before Connor today, he would never be able to live his life as before anymore.
Brandon was very unwilling!
He was unwilling to lose to someone like Connor.
“Brandon Guthrie, don’t kneel. 1 don’t believe that Connor can do anything to you!” Just as Brandon hesitated, Mandy suddenly stood up and said to Brandon..

chapters.title: Chapter 139 - 139: Does He Dare to Get Up?
chapters.content:
Chapter 139: Does He Dare to Get Up?
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Porthampton University, at the entrance of the classroom.
Many students gathered near Connor, Brandon, and Harvey. A large number of them were students from other classes.
These people all knew Connor was a poor delivery boy, but they didn’t know why Harvey was kneeling before Connor.
When Brandon saw Harvey kneel to Connor, his expression was very ugly, and he did not know if he should kneel down or not.
If Brandon and Harvey knew that things would turn out like this, they wouldn’t have dared to frame Connor even if they were beaten to death.
At this moment, their intestines were about to turn green with regret!
As for the culprit of this matter, May, she looked as if it had nothing to do with her.
She expressionlessly looked at Harvey kneeling before Connor, her heart very calm.
May had warned them not to offend Connor, but they didn’t listen. Now that things had turned out this way, May had no choice.
“Brandon, don’t kneel before Connor! 1 don’t believe that Connor can get you expelled today! Doesn’t your dad know someone from the Education Bureau? Hurry up and call them!” Mandy quickly walked to Brandon and said to him. If Mandy didn’t say that, Brandon might not kneel to Connor for his dignity.
But when Brandon heard Mandy say that, he didn’t think about it and kneeled before Connor.
After everyone saw Brandon kneel, they all inhaled sharply, deeply shocked.
Who would have thought that Brandon, the rich kid from Porthampton University, would kneel before a poor loser who delivered food for a living?
Didn’t this only happen in television dramas?
Even Mandy was shocked because she couldn’t understand why Brandon suddenly kneeled before Connor.
Mandy might not know that Brandon was able to enter Porthampton University because his father had been looking for connections everywhere, licking boots and bottoms everywhere. It was not easy for him to build a relationship with the people from the Education Bureau and send Brandon to study at Porthampton University.
But now, if Brandon was expelled from the school, his father might kill him. Brandon’s future would not be good if he didn’t kill him.
Therefore, he was so worried that he kneeled before Connor.
The surrounding students watching the show began to discuss after seeing Brandon kneel.
“Why would Brandon kneel to someone like Connor?”
“I remember that Brandon went to a hotel with Connor’s girlfriend a few days ago. Moreover, Connor caught them there. What’s going on today?” The students from the neighboring class asked in confusion.
“You guys still don’t know, right? Brandon and Harvey framed Connor for being a thief, and the chancellor found out. Now they are apologizing to Connor!” a girl in Connor’s class replied carefully.
“Ah! So that’s what happened!”
“1 didn’t expect Brandon and Harvey to be so shameless. They framed Connor as a thief. They’re so shameless…”
“Although Connor is a little poor, you can’t bully him like this!”
Everyone stood on Connor’s side, criticizing Harvey and Brandon.
Brandon gritted his teeth and kneeled. Listening to the voices of these people accusing him, his face turned red. He had never suffered such humiliation since he was young.
“Brandon, why are you kneeling to Connor? Hurry up and get up…”
Mandy couldn’t accept such a thing and shouted at Brandon hysterically.
“Mandy, don’t worry about this anymore. Go do what you have to do!”
Brandon felt he was already embarrassed enough and did not want Mandy to continue making trouble.
“Why? You’re my boyfriend. Why can’t 1 tell you what to do?” Mandy shouted at the top of her lungs.
“It’s my fault for framing Connor. Kneeling and apologizing to him is also what 1 promised Connor before. Hurry up and leave!” Brandon said helplessly.
“Brandon…” Mandy looked at Brandon, her eyes full of confusion.
She really couldn’t understand how the always arrogant Brandon could be willing to kneel to Connor now.
“Connor, quickly ask Brandon to get up!” Mandy turned and shouted at Connor.
“Who are you? Why should I listen to you? Besides, he wanted to kneel!” Connor said coldly.
“You… How can you be so shameless?”
Mandy was so angry that she didn’t know what to say. She glared at Connor and scolded him.
“I’m shameless?” Connor could not help but sneer. He did not want to continue talking to Mandy.
He looked at Brandon and Harvey and said, “The two of you can kneel here until seven o’clock in the evening. If 1 find out that the two of you have left early, you will bear the consequences!”
“We… We will!” Harvey looked at Connor and hurriedly replied.
Brandon did not speak.
“Alright, let’s go!”
Connor looked at Dominic, Natasha, and the others and shouted. Then, he turned around and was about to leave the school.
“Connor, stop right there!” Mandy saw that Connor was about to leave and quickly reached out to grab him.
“Is there anything else?” Connor asked Mandy calmly.
“Connor, don’t think you can do whatever you want just because you have the chancellor’s support. Let me tell you, Brandon is not someone you can afford to offend. You’d better let Brandon get up quickly. Otherwise, I’ll make you regret it for the rest of your life!” Mandy frowned and said excitedly.
“If I ask him to get up now, will he dare to?” Connor said to Mandy mockingly.
“You…”
Mandy was so angry by Connor’s words that her entire body trembled. She pointed at Connor and screamed, “Don’t think 1 don’t know why you’re doing this. Because I’m with Brandon, and you can’t swallow this, so you want to take revenge on Brandon, right?”
Connor looked at Mandy and smiled helplessly. He didn’t know what to say.
“Connor, let me tell you. When I broke up with you and chose to be with Brandon, it was not because Brandon snatched me away from you. Do you know why I wanted to be with Brandon?”
Connor looked at Mandy and remained silent.
“Because, in my opinion, you’re a complete garbage. 1 don’t see any hope in you at all. You’re a poor wretch who only knows how to deliver food all day. I’ve never been happy with you, do you know that?” Mandy did not consider Connor’s feelings and shouted in an extremely sharp and mean tone.
Connor was still looking at Mandy calmly. In Connor’s eyes, Mandy was really funny.
Connor wondered if Mandy would still have the guts to say such words if she knew his true identity..

chapters.title: Chapter 140 - 140: The Person Who Should Regret Is You
chapters.content:
Chapter 140: The Person Who Should Regret Is You
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
“What nonsense are you spouting?”
Of all the people present, only Natasha knew Connor’s true identity.
Therefore, when she heard Mandy’s words, she couldn’t help but step forward to argue with Mandy.
“What 1 said is the truth. Let me tell you, Connor is a poor loser! If you continue to be with such a person, you’ll regret it sooner or later!” Mandy turned her head and shouted at Natasha.
At this moment, Mandy’s pretty face looked a little ferocious because of anger.
Connor felt that it was fortunate that Mandy had left him back then. Otherwise, spending the rest of his life with such a woman would be scary.
“Will 1 regret it?”
Natasha couldn’t help but laugh. She secretly sighed that Mandy was really funny. Even in her dreams, she was thinking about how to be with Connor.
And Mandy said that she would regret it. To Natasha, this was simply a huge joke.
However, Natasha was still very grateful to Mandy. After all, if Mandy hadn’t taken the initiative to leave Connor, she wouldn’t have had the chance to get with Connor.
“It’s up to you whether you believe it or not. Anyway, I’ve already told you. By the time you regret it, it’ll be too late. Because a person like Connor doesn’t deserve a girlfriend at all!”
At this moment, Mandy had gone crazy and humiliated Connor without reservation.
Connor looked at Mandy and hesitated for two seconds. Then, he walked to Mandy and said in a low voice, “Mandy, let me tell you, the one who should regret it should be you. Sooner or later, you will realize how stupid your current actions are!”
“I should be the one regretting?”
When Mandy heard this, she sneered disdainfully and then said with a pout, “What will 1 regret? Do you think I’ll regret breaking up with a delivery guy like you?”
“Who said I’m a delivery guy?” Connor roared angrily. He finally could not control the anger in his heart. He wanted to reveal his identity and then ruthlessly slapped Mandy’s face to let her understand who was standing before her now!
“If you’re not a delivery guy, what are you? Connor, I’ve been with you for so long. Do you think 1 don’t understand you? You can pretend to be a rich heir in front of others, but in my eyes, you’re a completely poor loser. Your identity as a rich heir is all an act…” Mandy looked at Connor and shouted disdainfully.
“I…” As Connor was about to speak, Natasha suddenly stopped him and said, “Even if Connor is a poor loser, it’s not up to a woman like you to say that. Besides, whether Connor is rich or not, I still like him. I don’t care about those things and won’t regret it!”
Natasha was a little agitated when she saw Connor just now. She was worried that Connor would reveal his identity.
At that time, all the students at Porthampton University would know that Connor was a super-rich heir.
At that time, there would be more girls who wanted to compete with Natasha, which was why Natasha stood out and interrupted Connor.
Connor looked at Natasha and calmed down a little. Then, he swallowed the words he wanted to say.
“What does it have to do with me, whether you regret it or not? Brandon, get up quickly. Let’s go!” Mandy didn’t want to continue discussing these things with Natasha, so she dragged Brandon and left.
“Mandy, can you stop? Haven’t you embarrassed yourself enough? Do you still want me to continue embarrassing myself?” Brandon shouted at Mandy angrily.
Initially, there were not many students surrounding the classroom door. However, more and more students gathered to watch after Mandy’s commotion.
Brandon wanted to slap Mandy to shut her up.
After Mandy heard this sentence, she was completely stunned. She looked at Brandon foolishly and said aggrievedly, “I… I just don’t want you to kneel here. I don’t mean anything else!”
“Hurry up and get lost! You don’t have to care about my matters. Get lost!” Brandon vented all the anger in his heart at Mandy and shouted extremely angrily.
“Brandon, you…”
Mandy did not expect that Brandon would insult her at this time. She had tried her best to protect Brandon just now but was insulted by him.
Mandy couldn’t hold back her tears.
“What about me? I told you to get lost. Didn’t you hear me?” Brandon looked at Mandy and continued to shout.
“Mandy, hurry up and leave. Don’t you think we’re embarrassed enough?” Harvey, kneeling on the ground, shouted helplessly.
H ii
Mandy stood where she was and hesitated for two seconds. She never thought her good intentions would be treated like nothing.
“Why aren’t you leaving? What are you looking at?” Brandon gritted his teeth and shouted coldly.
“Alright, I’ll leave! I’ll leave now!” Mandy shouted and ran away with tears in her eyes.
Connor looked at Mandy as she left and sighed helplessly.
Mandy, who he had treated as a goddess, was now a plaything in Brandon’s eyes.
“Let’s go!”
Connor turned his head and said to Dominic, Natasha, and the others before turning around and walking out of the school.
Dominic, Spencer, and the others looked at Brandon kneeling on the ground. They didn’t say anything and left the school with Connor.
***
“Connor, you’re so cool today. You finally taught Brandon a good lesson!” After leaving the school, Dominic said excitedly.
“That’s right. When I saw you being taken away by Dylan today, I was scared out of my wits. 1 thought you were a thief!” Spencer said.
“I would never steal!” Connor looked at Spencer helplessly and said unhappily.
“Connor, how did you explain it to the chancellor? Why do I feel like the chancellor was a little afraid of you earlier?”
Dominic thought of Jesse’s attitude when he spoke to Connor just now and asked Connor with a slightly puzzled expression.
“He’s the chancellor of Porthampton University. Why would he be afraid of me? Mr. Zachman feels I’ve been wrongly accused and wants to fight for me!” Connor replied with a smile.
“I didn’t expect Mr. Zachman to be so kind. It’s not like what the outside world says!”
Dominic also felt that he might have sensed wrongly and then continued to ask, “By the way, Connor, how did you prove that you’re not a thief?”
“I asked Dylan to look at the surveillance video in the corridor and found that Harvey stole the money and hid it in my desk, so I proved my innocence!” Connor explained softly.
“I see!” Dominic nodded, put his arm around Connor’s shoulder, and said, “1 knew you wouldn’t steal anything. How could you be a thief?”
“Alright, can we not talk about this anymore? Because of this, Natasha and 1 have been waiting for the whole afternoon. Are we still going to watch the movie?”
Connor was cleared of suspicion and humiliated Brandon and the others. Dominic and Spencer were naturally happy, but Cindy was not.
She thought she had something on Connor and could use this to humiliate him.
However, he did not expect that Connor was not a thief at all.
“I’ll buy the tickets now. Let’s go to the cinema…”
When Dominic heard Cindy’s suggestion, he quickly took out his phone and prepared to buy tickets.
But at this moment, Connor’s phone suddenly rang.
Connor took out his phone and realized that it was Rachel..

chapters.title: Chapter 141 - 141: A Cold Beautiful Woman
chapters.content:
Chapter 141: A Cold Beautiful Woman
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
“Hello, Ms. Wallace. What’s up?” Connor hurriedly picked up the phone.
“Connor, hurry up and report to the bar if you’re done with school. My friend has a bad temper. If you’re late, she’ll be angry!” Rachel softly reminded Connor.
“Oh, right! 1 almost forgot about this!”
Connor suddenly remembered that he was going to work part-time in Rachel’s friend’s bar.
“Hurry up and go over. See ya!” Rachel replied lightly before hanging up.
“You guys go watch the movie. I have something to do!”
After Connor put away his phone, he whispered to Dominic and the others.
“Connor, what do you mean? Natasha and I have been waiting for you for so long, and now you’re saying you’re not going?” Cindy said unhappily when she heard what Connor said.
“Yeah, Connor, Natasha has been waiting for you for so long. Why can’t you do it another day?” Dominic also advised helplessly.
“I promised Ms. Wallace 1 would work part-time at her friend’s bar. Now that they’re about to open for business, it’s not good not to go!” Connor seemed to feel a little embarrassed and replied in a low voice.
“What part-time job? How much can that earn?” Cindy pouted and muttered.
“Since Connor has something to do, let him do it…”
Dominic knew this part-time job was very important to Connor, so he hesitated and spoke for Connor.
“If there’s a chance in the future, I’ll treat you guys to a movie!” Connor replied indifferently, then walked into the distance.
Natasha looked at Connor as he left, a hint of confusion flashed in her beautiful eyes.
She couldn’t understand why a rich heir like Connor would work part-time at a bar.
***
After Connor parted ways with Dominic and the others, he walked to the roadside and hailed a taxi.
The taxi slowly stopped, and Connor opened the door and got inside.
“Mister, I want to go…”
“Are you comfortable?” Connor was about to tell the driver where he was going when he suddenly heard a woman’s voice behind him.
Connor was stunned for a moment. He quickly turned around to look and then froze.
When he got into the car just now, Connor had been watching the situation on Dominic’s side, so he did not see the situation inside the car. Naturally, he did not notice that there was another person in the car!
At this moment, Connor was sitting on the lap of a beautiful woman!
Connor looked at the woman awkwardly. At this moment, he could even smell the fragrance coming from the woman’s collar.
The beautiful woman whom Connor was sitting on also seemed helpless.
When Connor got into the car, the woman had been sleeping the whole time, so she didn’t know someone had gotten into the car. She only woke up when Connor sat on her.
“Why aren’t you getting up? Do you want to continue taking advantage of me?”
Even though Connor was sitting on her, the woman did not shout. Instead, she spoke very calmly.
“I’m sorry. I was in a hurry and didn’t see you in the car!”
Connor awkwardly explained to the beauty, then slowly got up and moved to the seat beside the beauty.
The beauty looked up at Connor. A trace of disdain flashed in her beautiful eyes. She did not say anything and closed her eyes to continue resting.
Connor turned his head and sized up the woman. The woman had light makeup and looked around thirty years old. She was wearing a low-cut spaghetti top today. Her black hair was beautiful, and her figure was very hot. Her legs were wrapped in black stockings, and she wore a navy blue short skirt. She was dressed extremely coquettishly.
However, this woman’s aura was cold, making people feel she was unapproachable.
“Young man, where do you want to go?”
The taxi driver started the car and turned to ask Connor.
“Mister, to Dusk, please!” Connor replied softly.
“Hah, what a coincidence. This woman is also going to Dusk!”
When the taxi driver realized Connor and the beautiful woman in the car were going to the same place, he smiled happily.
Connor turned to look at the woman beside him, feeling a little puzzled.
It was only six o’clock in the afternoon. It was a little too early if the woman was going to a bar to hang out.
Most bars were not open for business yet, and this woman did not look like she was going to a bar to have fun.
‘Could she work at Dusk?’ Connor wondered.
When the woman heard Connor was going to Dusk, she turned and looked at Connor indifferently without saying anything.
Originally, Connor had planned to use this opportunity to talk to the beauty.
However, when he saw the cold look on the beautiful woman’s face, he did otherwise. Instead, he took out his phone and gamed.
Twenty minutes later.
The car slowly stopped at the entrance of Dusk.
After Connor and the woman paid the fare, they got off the car together.
“Do you also work at Dusk?” Connor hesitated for a moment before asking the woman softly.
The beautiful woman glanced at Connor indifferently and did not have the intention to pay attention to Connor at all. She turned her head and walked into Dusk.
Connor smiled helplessly after she ignored him. He followed her into the bar.
After entering the bar, Connor briefly scanned the environment inside the bar and found that the environment inside was still the same. There was not much change.
Although Dusk had just opened, it was famous in Porthampton because of its reach.
No customers were inside because it was still early and the bar had not officially opened. Only a few waiters were cleaning.
“I’m sorry, sir. Our bar hasn’t opened yet!”
At this moment, a girl said to Connor.
“I’m not here for a drink. I’m here to work part-time!” Connor quickly replied.
“A part-time job?”
The girl hurriedly put down the tools in her hand and walked to Connor. She smiled and said, “Hello, I’m the manager of this bar, Lucy Green. You can call me Lucy!”
“Hello, Lucy. My name is Connor!” Connor said very politely.
“I know your name is Connor. Rachel got you here, right? Let me bring you to meet the owner of our bar!” Lucy said slowly.
“Sure!” Connor nodded.
Lucy turned around and walked toward the second floor of the bar. Connor followed behind Lucy.
Although Lucy looked average, her figure was very attractive. She had big breasts and a big butt. When she walked, her hips swayed and was very alluring..

chapters.title: Chapter 142 - 142: Forced Marriage
chapters.content:
Chapter 142: Forced Marriage
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
A few minutes later…
Lucy brought Connor to an office and knocked on the door.
“Who is it?” A woman’s voice came from the office.
“Ms. Hunt, the boy that Rachel introduced to work part-time is already in the shop.” Lucy replied softly.
“Let him in!”
“Alright!” Lucy answered, then turned to Connor and said, “Go on in. Ms. Hunt is waiting for you!”
“Thank you, Lucy!” Connor quickly said.
“What a gentleman you are…” Lucy gave Connor a flirtatious smile, then left with her hips swaying.
After Connor saw Lucy leave, he pushed open the door and walked straight into the office.
When he walked into the office, he was stunned.
The beautiful woman sitting in the office was none other than the woman Connor met in the taxi just now.
When the woman saw Connor enter, she was momentarily surprised as well. Then, her eyes widened, and she asked, “Are you the student that Rachel introduced?”
“Yes!” Connor hurriedly nodded.
“What’s your name?” The woman asked coldly.
“My name is Connor…” Connor replied.
“Connor?”
The beauty squinted and sized up Connor, then said softly, “Since Rachel introduced you, Rachel should have told you about my situation and your salary, right?”
“Rachel told me everything!” Connor nodded.
“Great. Find Lucy later and ask her to get you a work uniform. Then you can get to work. My bar just opened not long ago and is currently lacking manpower. You can work for some time. When I have recruited enough people, you no longer have to come!”
The woman looked at Connor expressionlessly. Her voice was emotionless as she spoke to Connor coldly.
“Alright, I got it!” Connor nodded helplessly.
“Since you already know, what are you still standing there for? Hurry up and get to work!”
The woman didn’t seem to have a good impression of Connor and ordered him to leave.
“Ms. Hunt, I still don’t know your name!” Connor asked the woman with a smile.
“Xena Hunt!” the woman replied coldly, then continued, “If there’s nothing else, you can leave!”
“Yes!” Connor agreed, then turned around and walked out of the office.
***
After seeing Connor leave, Xena sighed.
Her attitude toward Connor was so bad, but not because Connor took advantage of her in the taxi.
It was because she had been troubled by something for the past few days.
“Ring ring ring…”
At this moment, Xena’s phone on the table suddenly vibrated.
Xena looked at her phone. When she saw the caller ID, her expression darkened.
After hesitating for a while, she picked up her phone and answered the call.
“Xena, are you busy now?” A woman’s voice came from the other end of the phone.
“Mom, if you have something to say, just say it! You don’t have to call me every two or three days!” Xena said helplessly.
“Xena, the day after tomorrow is your engagement party with Uncle Shenaur’s youngest son. You mustn’t miss it, okay?” her mom said slowly.
“Mom, how many times have I told you? I won’t marry that bastard. Can you stop forcing me?” Xena shouted angrily.
Connor, who had just walked out of the office, happened to hear that. He couldn’t help but sigh. ‘No wonder Xena has such a bad temper. Her parents are urging her to get married!’
Meanwhile, in the office.
Xena held her phone and listened to her mother. Her face was filled with despair.
Xena was born into a merchant family. Her parents were very famous businessmen in Porthampton. Her family background was very good. In addition, Xena was also very beautiful. She could be considered a standard white, rich, and beautiful woman.
However, Xena had had a strange habit since she was young. She was a very serious germaphobe. She could not accept living with a man.
Therefore, even though she was already twenty-eight, she had never been in a relationship, nor did she have any thoughts of falling in love.
Not long ago, Xena’s parents found a blind date for her. The blind date was good-looking and had a good family background. However, Xena was not interested in this man. On the contrary, she felt that this man was a little dirty.
However, her parents liked this man very much. Without Xena’s consent, they had arranged a marriage with him.
Xena was worried sick about this. She had never lived with a man since she was young, and she didn’t know how to get along with a man she didn’t like. Moreover, she had to marry this man and have children with him. It was scary just thinking about it.
“Xena, Uncle Shenaur’s son is handsome and has a good job. Why don’t you like him? Moreover, you’re not young anymore. If you continue wasting time like this, how long more will you wait? Just listen to Mom’s advice and quickly get engaged to him. I can save a lot of trouble!” Xena’s mother said gently.
“Mom, just give up. I will never marry someone 1 don’t want to marry!” Xena gritted her teeth and growled.
“Tell me then, who do you want to marry?” her mother asked angrily.
“I… I don’t know yet!”
“Xena, can you stop arguing with me? I’ve already discussed it with your father. If you don’t get engaged to Uncle Shenaur’s son, we’ll take back your bar. I’ll see how you can still mess around outside then!”
After saying that, her mother hung up the phone.
Xena listened to the busy tone on the other end of the phone, and her face was full of despair. Owning a bar had always been her dream, but she could not run this bar with her funds. Most of the funds for her bar were given by her parents.
But now, her parents were threatening her with taking away the bar, she felt like she was about to break down.
If she agreed to marry that man, it would be completely forced. However, if she didn’t agree, her parents would confiscate Dusk.
Xena sat in her office chair, deeply troubled. She didn’t know what to do now.
“Ring ring ring…”
At this moment, Xena’s phone rang again..

chapters.title: Chapter 143 - 143: Lucy’s Temptation
chapters.content:
Chapter 143: Lucy’s Temptation
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Xena picked up her phone and saw it was Rachel, so she quickly answered the call.
“Xena, is my student at the bar?” Rachel asked with a smile.
“He’s already here. I’ve arranged all the work for him. Don’t worry, 1’11 take good care of the person you introduced!” Xena replied softly.
“That’s good. Connor is actually quite pitiful. His parents died when he was in primary school. He has been working part-time to study in school, so you must take good care of him, okay?” Rachel slowly said.
“Is Connor so pitiful?” Xena recalled her attitude toward Connor and suddenly felt a little guilty.
After all, her attitude toward Connor wasn’t so bad because he had taken advantage of her in the taxi.
Xena was in a bad mood because her parents were urging her to get married. That was why she vented her anger on Connor.
“Yeah, Connor was even misunderstood as a thief today!” Rachel replied softly.
“Oh, dear…” Xena replied absentmindedly.
“Xena, why do you sound like you’re in a bad mood? Did something happen?” Rachel noticed Xena’s strange behavior and asked with concern.
“It’s the blind date the other day. My parents have been urging me to get engaged to him. I really don’t know what they’re thinking!” Xena replied weakly with her head down.
“I can’t help you with this. You’d better think of a way yourself!” Rachel knew a thing or two about Xena being forced to marry, but as an outsider, she couldn’t interfere in other people’s family affairs.
“Sigh, if only I had a boyfriend now. 1 could tell my parents that I don’t want to marry that bastard!” Xena pouted.
“But you think men are dirty! How will you get a boyfriend?” Rachel smiled faintly.
“Sigh…” Xena sighed helplessly. She didn’t know what to do now.
***
On the other side.
After Connor left the office, he followed Lucy to the changing room of the bar.
During the short time, Connor found that Lucy was not only coquettish, but her behavior was also very unrestrained. She often touched Connor’s arm, and from time to time, she would use words to tease Connor.
If it was the previous Connor, he might not have any resistance against a woman like Lucy.
Although Lucy looked very ordinary, she was extremely hot. To a virgin like Connor, she was still very attractive.
But now, Connor had seen a large number of beautiful women. Be it Freya, Chloe, or Natasha, any one of them was better than Lucy. Therefore, Connor naturally had no interest in Lucy now.
After changing into his work uniform, Connor followed Lucy to the front desk of the bar. He briefly introduced the staff in the bar and then began to work.
As Connor had also worked part-time in the bar before, he was familiar with the work in the bar and could do it with ease.
Xena, who had just finished the call with Rachel, walked out of the office and saw Connor working hard.
Xena nodded in satisfaction and walked toward Connor, wanting to praise him.
However, Xena had only taken two steps when she suddenly stopped. A strange look flashed in her originally dim and beautiful eyes.
Xena thought of what her mother had told her before, and then she thought of what Rachel had told her about Connor’s background.
A bold idea suddenly appeared in Xena’s mind.
“If that’s the case, does that mean I don’t have to get engaged to that b*stard?”
Xena stood before the handrail on the second floor, posing in a sexy and seductive position, staring at Connor who was working hard.
“Connor seems to be cleaner than other men…” A moment later, Xena took a deep breath and confirmed her plan.
“Click clack, click clack…” Xena walked downstairs.
When Connor heard the footsteps, he subconsciously looked behind him.
“Helio, Ms. Hunt!” Connor greeted Xena politely when he saw her.
“You don’t have to be so polite with me. Just call me Xena!” Xena looked at Connor and said.
After Connor heard Xena’s words, his expression suddenly became slightly confused. ‘A woman’s heart is like a needle at the bottom of the sea! She was so cold to me just now, and now she wants me to call her by her name?’ “Connor, are you okay with the working environment here?” Xena looked at Connor from head to toe and asked him thoughtfully.
“Sure!” Connor hurriedly nodded.
“You’ll get used to it. 1 heard from Rachel that you’ve been working part-time, right?” Xena looked at Connor and asked.
“That’s right. My parents passed away when I was in primary school. 1 have to work to support myself!” Connor said slowly.
“I didn’t expect you to be so strong!” Xena looked at Connor with a faint smile and continued, “I’ve already told Rachel just now that your original salary was twenty dollars per hour. I’ll give you an increase of fifty dollars now. You must work hard here!”
Connor looked at Xena with a hint of confusion.
He couldn’t understand why Xena was suddenly so nice to him. Not only did she talk to him more warmly, but she also wanted to raise his salary.
“Connor, Ms. Hunt said he wants to give you a raise. What are you waiting for? Hurry up and thank Ms. Hunt!” Lucy walked to Connor and said to him with a smile.
“Thank you, Xena!” Connor said to Xena.
Connor wasn’t very interested in the salary raise. He didn’t lack this bit of money at all. What interested him was why Xena’s attitude toward him had changed so much.
When Xena saw Lucy coming over, she didn’t want to continue chatting with Connor. Instead, she turned her head and shouted at the others, “Everyone, get ready. The business is about to start!”
“Okay, Ms. Hunt!” the other waiters quickly answered.
Xena glanced at Connor indifferently, then walked upstairs in her high heels.
After seeing Xena leave, Lucy turned her head and asked Connor softly, “Lil Connie, what’s your relationship with Ms. Hunt?”
“Nothing… there’s no relationship. We just met today…” Connor replied in a low voice.
“That’s impossible. You must have some kind of relationship with Ms. Hunt. Otherwise, why would Ms. Hunt give only you a raise? ”
Lucy held Connor’s arm as she spoke, then rubbed her soft body against Connor’s arm and said sweetly, “Tell me the truth. What’s your relationship with Ms. Hunt?”
Connor looked at Lucy’s snow-white collar, and his face instantly blushed.
“Say something. What are you looking at!”
When Lucy saw Connor’s shy look, she hurriedly exerted more strength and hugged Connor’s arm harder.
“Lucy, 1 have nothing to do with Ms. Hunt. Let’s go back to work!”
Connor was afraid that if Lucy continued to hug him like this, he might be unable to hold it in and give into her.
Therefore, Connor hurriedly pushed Lucy away and turned around to walk away.
Lucy looked at Connor, and a trace of passion flashed in her eyes. Then, she licked her lips and said, “Lil Connie, you’re still pretending to be innocent. I’ll make you willingly bed me in two days.. 1 don’t believe 1 can’t control a virgin like you…”

chapters.title: Chapter 144 - 144: Meeting Freya By Chance
chapters.content:
Chapter 144: Meeting Freya By Chance
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
At eight o’clock in the evening, the number of customers in the bar gradually increased.
Young men and women dressed in bright clothes danced on the dance floor with loud music, releasing a cloud of youthful hormones.
Although it was still early for people who liked nightlife, this was the beginning of their exciting life.
As the bar had just opened, the waiters were all newly recruited, so the efficiency of these people was not as high as Connor’s.
The three might not have done as much as Connor alone.
“Connor, help me send these bottles of wine to Room 8.1 need to go to the bathroom!” A charming waitress winked at Connor and said sweetly.
Like Connor, this waitress was also here to work part-time.
“Jenny, I’ve helped you so many times. How do you plan to thank me?” Connor took the beer from the waitress and said with a smile.
“Come on, 1 know you’re the best to me. When I get my salary, I’ll treat you to a meal, okay?” the waitress said with a charming smile.
“That’s more like it…”
“Alright, I’m not going to talk to you anymore. I’m going to the bathroom!”
The waitress patted Connor’s shoulder and walked toward the bathroom.
Connor carried the alcohol to the door of Room 8 and knocked on the door gently.
“Who is it?” A man’s voice soon came from the private room.
“It’s the waiter. Your wine, sir!” Connor replied loudly.
“Come in!” When Connor heard this, he hurriedly pushed open the door and walked in.
“What’s wrong with your bar? I ordered a few bottles of wine awhile ago. Why are they only here now? Is your bar still open for business?” At this moment, a handsome young man shouted at Connor impatiently.
“Sir, I’m sorry. Our bar has just opened for business, so we lack manpower. I hope you can forgive us!” Connor hurriedly explained.
He had already encountered this kind of thing several times, so he did not take it too seriously this time.
“What lousy bar? I’m never coming back!” The young man saw that Connor’s attitude was quite sincere, so he didn’t continue to make things difficult for Connor. Instead, he muttered in a low voice.
“Mr. Shenaur Jr., calm down. Hasn’t the wine been served now? There’s no need to lower yourself to his level…”
A beautiful woman beside the young man quickly persuaded him with a smile.
Connor walked to the booth and wanted to put down the alcohol in his hand.
However, at this moment, a beautiful woman sitting on the sofa and playing with her phone suddenly looked up at Connor and exclaimed surprisedly, “Connor? Why are you here?”
When Connor heard this, he quickly looked up and saw Freya on the sofa with a surprised expression.
Connor looked at Freya before him with a hint of shock.
He had not expected to bump into Freya in the bar.
Freya was dressed very sexy today. She was wearing a white dress with spaghetti straps. The fabric was very saggy, and the side was slit like a dress, revealing her slender and fair legs. She wore a pair of white high-heeled sandals and looked sexy with a hint of dignity. She looked like a goddess.
Freya’s expression was the same as Connor’s. She was also shocked.
Freya didn’t like to hang out in bars, but recently, her cosmetics company had some financial problems.
Mr. Shenaur Jr., talking to Connor just now, wanted to invest in Freya’s company. That was why Freya followed them to Dusk and discussed the contract.
However, she did not expect to meet Connor here.
Moreover, Connor was a waiter here.
Now, Freya would give Connor 20,000 dollars as living expenses every month. As long as Connor didn’t spend too much, this money would be enough for a month’s living expenses. Freya couldn’t understand why Connor still worked here as a waiter.
“Freya, do you know him?” Mr. Shenaur Jr. turned his head and asked Freya with a smile.
“Yes… I guess you can say so!” Freya did not want these people to know that Connor was her fiance, so she replied awkwardly.
“Freya, how do you know such a person?”
“Yeah, how do you know the waiters in the bar?”
After hearing Freya’s words, everyone asked in confusion.
After all, the Phillips Family that Freya belonged to was considered a prestigious family in Porthampton.
Freya had been a goddess-like existence since she was young. To others, Freya was an even more unreachable existence. How could she know a nobody at the bottom of society like Connor?
When Connor heard what these people said, he could not help but blush. Not to mention Freya, even Connor felt a little embarrassed.
“Connor, what are you waiting for? Why aren’t you putting down the drinks?”
To prevent Connor from being humiliated by these people, Freya hurriedly said to Connor.
Connor put down the bottles in his hand, then turned around and walked out of the private room.
“Freya, it’s not that I want to criticize you, but as the eldest daughter of the Phillips family, 1 think you should have less contact with these losers in the future. After all, they’re nobodies at the bottom of society. They won’t be of any help to your career and will even bring you some unnecessary trouble. The most important thing to make friends is still to look at a person’s ability and character!”
After Connor left, a slightly older young man said to Freya with a smile that was not a smile.
“Yeah, I think what you said makes sense, Cody. We should get to know more people like Shenaur Jr.. He’s young, rich, and talented!” A girl quickly flattered him.
After hearing the girl’s flattery, Cody revealed a very satisfied smile.
Freya hesitated momentarily before saying softly, “Mr. Shenaur Jr., I’m going to the washroom!”
“Alright!” Mr. Shenaur Jr. looked at Freya and nodded gently.
Freya walked out of the room. Seeing that Connor had not gone far, she hurriedly shouted, “Connor, wait a moment!”
When Connor heard Freya’s call, he turned to look at her and asked softly, “Is there something you need?”
Freya walked up to Connor and carefully sized him up. She asked, puzzled, “Why are you working as a waiter here?”
After Connor heard Freya’s question, he was somewhat unhappy. Moreover, with Freya’s attitude toward him just now, Connor was even more unhappy.
“Didn’t we agree before that we wouldn’t interfere in each other’s private affairs? It shouldn’t have anything to do with you whether I’m a waiter or not, right?”
Freya looked at Connor and laughed coldly. Then, she remembered that Maya had said she saw Connor in a room with another girl. She said expressionlessly, “You must have used the living expenses I gave you to trick other girls into bed, right? Now that you’ve spent all your money, that’s why you came here to work, right?”
When Connor heard this, he couldn’t help but be stunned momentarily. Then, he frowned and asked, “You came out just to tell me this?”
“Of course not!” Freya shook her head and said softly, “A few days ago, someone bought a villa for me at Evergrande Real Estate.. Was that you?”

chapters.title: Chapter 145 - 145: Cody’s Proposal
chapters.content:
Chapter 145: Cody’s Proposal
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Connor looked at Freya and had the urge to nod and admit it.
However, the inheritance contract clearly stated that Connor could not reveal his identity to Freya. Otherwise, he would lose the right to inherit the inheritance.
Connor hid his identity from others because he did not want his life disturbed.
However, he had no choice but to hide his identity from Freya.
Seeing that Connor was silent and couldn’t help but sneer. Then, she said in a playful tone, “Alright, say nothing. 1 already know the answer just by looking at you. How can a person like you afford a villa? Moreover, it’s a villa worth fifty million dollars. I’m indeed overthinking!”
“That’s right, I really can’t afford a villa!”
Connor looked at Freya and nodded before continuing, “Is there anything else? If not, I have to get back to work!”
Freya hesitated momentarily before looking at Connor and saying, “1 don’t want others to know about our relationship. So if someone asks how you know me later, just say we met at a bar. Do you understand?”
“Understood!” Connor nodded.
“Also, since I’ve already promised to marry you, 1 won’t go back on my word. Let’s get our marriage certificate tomorrow!”
Freya knew that her marriage to Connor was an unavoidable fact.
Furthermore, the person who requested Freya to marry Connor had already helped her father’s company overcome the difficulties. Therefore, Freya did not want to delay any longer. She might as well get her marriage certificate with Connor.
“You want to get the marriage certificate so soon?” Connor’s eyes flashed with excitement when he heard Freya’s words.
“Don’t think too much about it. We’re just getting a marriage certificate. You’re still you in the future, and I’m still me. We have nothing to do with each other!” Freya was afraid that Connor would misunderstand, so she hurriedly explained to him.
“Oh, 1 see!” Connor nodded in disappointment when he saw Freya’s attitude.
However, he felt that it was a good thing for him to be able to register his marriage with Freya.
After all, as long as he got the certificate, Connor could rightfully inherit the ten trillion dollar inheritance and no longer need to hide his identity in front of Freya.
“Alright, that’s all 1 wanted to tell you. Go and do your work!” Freya looked at Connor and said indifferently.
“So when are we going to register our marriage tomorrow?” Connor asked.
“Wait for my call. I’ll tell you!” Freya replied softly before turning around and walking toward the private room.
After Connor saw Freya leave, he helplessly turned around and returned to the bar’s front desk.
Although Freya had already agreed to register her marriage with Connor, he was not happy at all for some reason.
He felt that his relationship with Freya seemed to have come to an end, Connor was in a very low mood and did not work as hard as before.
In the blink of an eye, two hours had passed.
During these two hours, Connor had been absent-minded. He was thinking about Freya’s cold attitude toward him in the private room and what she had said to him just now.
“Please make way! Make way!”
At this moment, a man in a bar uniform walked in with a large bouquet of roses.
When everyone saw the roses in the man’s arms, they all were curious.
“Wayne, where did you get these roses?”
Lucy asked puzzledly when she saw the rose in the man’s hand.
“This is the rose that the guest in Room 8 wanted. It seems that there is a guest in the room who wants to propose to a woman!” the man replied with a smile.
“Room 8?”
When Connor heard the man’s words, he was momentarily stunned. Then, he remembered that Freya was in Room 8.
When Connor entered the private room, he realized only two girls were in Room 8. One of the girls seemed to have a boyfriend, and Mr. Shenaur Jr. was looking at Freya strangely. Could Mr. Shenaur Jr. want to confess to Freya?
Although Connor knew that even if someone wanted to confess to Freya, it had nothing to do with him, he still couldn’t suppress the curiosity in his heart. He quickly approached the staff member and whispered, “Wayne, give me the roses. I’ll deliver them…”
“That won’t do. The customer inside promised to give me a tip of 200 dollars!” the man called Wayne quickly refused.
Connor didn’t even think about it. He took two bills from his pocket and pushed them into Wayne’s hand. Then, he grabbed the roses and walked toward Room 8.
After Wayne took the money from Connor, he suddenly became a little puzzled. He scratched his head and said, “Why is he so agitated when she is being confessed to?”
After Connor snatched the roses from Wayne, he strode toward Room 8.
“Creak!” Connor reached out and pushed open the door of Room 8.
Mr. Shenaur Jr., sitting on the sofa, saw Connor come in with roses and scolded him with great dissatisfaction, “Are you a f*cking turtle? You’re so slow to buy flowers!”
After saying this, Cody snatched the rose from Connor’s hand and slowly walked up to Freya.
When Connor saw this, he was even more certain that Mr. Shenaur Jr. was going to confess to Freya.
Freya did not notice Connor, who had just entered. Instead, she focused her attention on Mr. Shenaur Jr. and asked with a puzzled expression, “Cody, what are you doing?”
“Plop!” Cody did not even think about it and kneeled before Freya.
