“Mr. McDonald, Carlos Lane is a very powerful fighter. He will be responsible for your safety in the future!” Thomas looked at Connor and added.
“Mr. McDonald, my name is Bruno. You can call me Bruno!”
The slightly plump man was also introduced to Connor.
“Bruno is a computer expert. In the future, Mr. McDonald, you can let Bruno do it if you have any network matters. Bruno is one of the top ten hackers in the world!” Thomas looked at Connor and continued.
“He’s that good?”
After Connor heard Thomas’s words, he could not help but sigh softly.
At this moment, only one woman left had not introduced herself. The woman walked toward Connor. As she swayed her hips, her full breasts bounced too, exuding charm.
The woman approached Connor and deliberately made a seductive pose, exposing her seductive figure to Connor without reservation. She stared straight at Connor and said softly to Connor, “Mr. McDonald, my name is Diana Murphy. You can call me Diana in the future. I’m not very capable, but I can help you warm your bed…”
“Uh… Warm the bed…” Connor was stunned when he heard Diana’s introduction. He looked helpless.
“Diana, be serious now!” Thomas scolded coldly, then looked at Connor and said, “Mr. McDonald, Diana is your secretary. If you need anything, you can ask her directly!”
“She’s my secretary.”
Connor looked at Diana and exclaimed. Then he suddenly recalled the phrase, ‘If there’s something, the secretary will do it. If there’s nothing, then do it yourself!’
“That’s right. From today onward, I’m your secretary. You have to treat me well!” Diana winked at Connor and said sweetly.
“Uh…”
Connor was speechless. He turned and said to Thomas, “Thomas, I know you asked these people to protect me for my good, but 1 spend most of my time at school now, so I shouldn’t be in any danger. Moreover, if 1 bring them with me daily, my classmates will notice something wrong, so you’d better not let them follow me. If anything happens, 1’11 contact the three of them directly!”
“That’s fine too…”
Thomas looked at Connor and hesitated before nodding gently.
Connor heaved a sigh of relief when Thomas agreed. If he brought Diana, Carlos, and Bruno with him, he would be monitored no matter what he did in the future. This made Connor feel very uncomfortable.
“Mr. McDonald, if you don’t want to bring so many people, you can keep me by your side!”
After Diana heard Connor’s suggestion, she told him reluctantly.
“Well, men and women shouldn’t be close to each other. It’s not very convenient for me to bring you along!” Connor replied, then took out his phone to look at the time. He turned to Thomas and said, “Thomas, 1 have something to do later. Send me back to the city!”
“Yes, Mr. McDonald!” Thomas quickly nodded and then led Connor out of the villa..

chapters.title: Chapter 170 - 170: Kneeling And Apologize To Brandon
chapters.content:
Chapter 170: Kneeling And Apologize To Brandon
Translator: End less Fantasy Translation Editor: End less Fantasy Translation
After Diana saw Connor, Thomas, and the others leave, she looked a little unhappy. She pouted and said to Bruno and Carlos, “It must be because rhe two of you look so unapproachable that you scared Mr. McDonald away!”
“Why don’t you say that you scared Mr. McDonald away?” Bruno replied angrily.
“I’m so pretty. How could Mr. McDonald be scared away by me? Didn’t you see the way Mr. McDonald looked at me?” Diana retorted.
“Don’t all men look at you like that?” Bruno said speechlessly.
“What do you know? Let me tell you, I’ve already made up my mind. I’m going to get Mr. McDonald and become Mr. McDonald’s mistress openly. By then, you two will be my bodyguards, so you’d better behave yourselves…”
Diana swayed her sexy body and smiled.
When Bruno and Carlos heard that, their expressions were full of disdain. None of them paid attention to Diana and went their separate ways.
On the other side, Connor asked Thomas to drive him to Dusk.
However, Connor didn’t stop the car at the entrance of rhe bar. Instead, he stopped at a place some distance away from the bar. After Connor exited the car, he walked toward the bar alone.
When Connor arrived at rhe bar, it was already 9 PM.
This was the busiest time in the bar, so the waiters in the bar were all busy.
“Connor, you’re here!”
The front desk manager, Lucy, saw Connor come in and quickly called out.
“Lucy, I’m really sorry. I had something to do just now, so I came late…”
Connor said to Lucy guiltily when he saw how busy everyone was.
“Ah, it’s okay. You came at the right time. There was no one in the bar just now!” Lucy smiled and replied. She then handed a few bottles of red wine and a snack to Connor and said softly, “Connor, don’t change your clothes first. This is the alcohol that rhe guest in Room 3 ordered. They have been urging you.” “Alright!” Connor nodded and then walked toward Room 3 with the red wine and snacks.
Knock, knock, knock!
Connor walked to the door of the private room and knocked on it.
“Come in!” a man responded.
Connor hurriedly pushed open the door and walked into the private room.
However, after Connor entered the private room, everyone in rhe private room was stunned.
The guests in this private room were none other than Brandon, Mandy, May, and Lily!
Connor didn’t expect to meet Brandon and the others in Dusk!
“Connor?”
Lily could not help but exclaim when she saw Connor.
Connor looked up at Lily and didn’t say anything.
“I didn’t expect a rich heir who usually flaunted his power in school would work as a waiter at a bar. Connor, oh Connor, 1 thought you had some ability, that’s why you dared to be so arrogant in school. I didn’t expect you to be that useless poor loser still!” Mandy held a grudge against Connor for making Brandon kneel and admit his mistake. Now that she saw Connor, she naturally had to ridicule him.
Connor placed the snacks and red wine on the coffee table. He didn’t want to pay attention to Mandy, Brandon, and the others. He turned around and wanted to leave.
“Wait a minute!”
But at this time, a man sitting among them suddenly shouted at Connor.
Connor was surprised when he heard the man call out to him. Then, he turned and asked the man, “Yes? Is there anything else I can do for you?”
The man narrowed his eyes and scanned Connor. He didn’t answer Connor’s question but turned to Brandon and asked, “Brandon, is this the Connor you told me about just now?”
“Yes, Brian, it’s him!” Brandon gritted his teeth and replied ruthlessly.
Previously, Connor had embarrassed Brandon in school, and Brandon didn’t know Connor’s true identity, so he was still thinking about how to take revenge on Connor.
Brandon felt Connor must have bribed the chancellor with money before, so Jesse stood on Connor’s side. Therefore, Brandon was prepared to use his social connections to deal with Connor.
The man who spoke just now was called Brian White, a gangster he knew.
As long as Brandon encountered any problems, he would find Brian to help him solve them. After the matter was settled, Brandon would also give this person a sum of money as a reward. The relationship between the two people was strong.
To take revenge on Connor, Brandon especially borrowed 30,000 dollars from his friend to pay Brian. He wanted Brian to teach Connor a good lesson and let Connor remember it.
Brian saw that Brandon had prepared 30,000 dollars, and it was to deal with a poor student, so he agreed without thinking.
However, no one had expected Connor to appear just as Brandon told Brian about him!
“Brian, it was Connor who made Brandon kneel. You must seek justice for Brandon!” Mandy said enthusiastically.
“Mandy, don’t worry. Brandon is my bro. I will help him ger back at Connor!” Brian looked at Mandy and replied. Then, he stood up and walked to Connor. He asked Connor, “You made Brandon kneel in school, right?”
“What does it have to do with you?” Connor asked coldly.
“What does it have to do with me?” Brian sneered, then pointed at Connor’s nose and shouted, “Do you know my relationship with Brandon? You dare to bully him. 1 think you have a death wish, right?”
“I don’t care what relationship you have with Brandon. Even if you are his father, it’s none of my business!” Connor felt that Brian’s question was idiotic, so he replied impatiently.
“Ah, f*ck! You’re quite brave!” Brian looked at Connor and shouted. Then, he said arrogantly, “Let me tell you, my name is Brian White, Brandon’s big brother. You bullied Brandon in school. Shouldn’t you give me an explanation?” “What explanation do you want?” Connor asked Brian calmly.
“It’s very simple. Didn’t you ask Brandon to kneel and apologize to you? Kneel and apologize to my bro now, and I’ll let you off today…” Brian pointed at Connor’s nose and shouted.
“Hah, and if don’t?” Connor asked disdainfully.
“Whoosh!’1
When Brian heard Connor’s provocation, he picked up the bottle on the table and pointed at Connor’s nose.. “Little bastard, don’t put on airs with me! If you don’t kneel to Brandon today, don’t even think about leaving this room!”

chapters.title: Chapter 171 - 171: This Is My Territory
chapters.content:
Chapter 171: This Is My Territory
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
After hearing Brian White’s words, the young men in the box stood up one after another and looked at Connor fiercely, as if they would attack him at any time. Seeing this scene, Mandy smirked gleefully. She secretly thought that since there was no way to deal with Connor in school, she could only deal with Connor through a hooligan like Brian.
Brian had been doing well in Porthampton these years. Rumor has it that he started working under a powerful person, so it should be very easy for Brian to deal with Connor.
“Haha…”
Connor looked at Brian and sneered disdainfully. He couldn’t understand why Brandon, Mandy, and the others were still trying to take revenge on him after having suffered so many losses.
When Connor asked Brandon to kneel at the door of the classroom, it was actually a warning to Brandon. He hoped that Brandon would be sensible in the future and not come looking for trouble again.
However, not only did Brandon not hide from him, but he became even more unscrupulous.
There was also this guy named Brian. At this moment, in Connor’s opinion, his behavior was no different from courting death.
“Connor, what are you waiting for? Hurry up and kneel down to Brandon!”
Mandy crossed her arms and shouted at Connor coldly.
“Yeah, Connor, don’t think that you’re all that just because you have the principal’s support. We’re not in school right now, so you’re nothing but trash. If you dare to anger Brother Brian, I guarantee you’ll regret it!”
Lily Sullivan also looked at Connor and shouted.
May Young sat on the sofa alone, looking a little nervous.
“I advise you to put down the bottle, or you’ll regret it!”
Connor whispered to Brian.
Since this was Xena Hart’s bar, Connor didn’t intend to cause trouble here.
“Kid, I’m not in the mood for nonsense like this. I’ll count down from three. If you still refuse to kneel down and kowtow to Brandon, then don’t blame me for being rude!”
Brian looked at Connor and shouted.
Brandon walked directly to Connor and said coldly, “Connor, aren’t you very arrogant in school? Go on! Show me that arrogance of yours now.”
H 11
Connor raised his head and looked at Brandon coldly. He really couldn’t understand why Brandon had to provoke him.
“Three!”
At this moment, Brian shouted.
H H
Connor looked at Brian. He did not move and had no intention of kneeling down.
Mandy looked at Connor with disdain. She felt that according to Connor’s cowardly character, he would definitely kneel down and kowtow to Brandon.
“Two!”
Brian continued to shout.
Connor still didn’t react.
“One!”
Brian shouted one last time.
Mandy looked at Connor with a shocked expression because she did not expect Connor to really not kneel down. Instead, he was standing there calmly.
“Brat, since you don’t know what’s good for you, then don’t blame me for what’s about to happen!”
Brian shouted, then directly picked up the bottle in his hand and wanted to smash it on Connor’s head.
Creak!
Before Brian could smash the bottle on Connor’s head, the door of the private room was suddenly pushed open from the outside.
When everyone heard the voice, they could not help but be stunned.
When Brian heard the sound of the door opening, he stopped what he was doing and turned to look at the door.
“Brian, what are you doing here?”
A young man with blonde hair and earrings swaggered in from outside and asked Brian casually.
“Brother Wade, why are you here?”
Brian was stunned for a moment, and then he quickly ran toward the young man with a flattering face.
“Why can’t I be here? This is my territory. I can come whenever 1 want…”
The blond-haired youth spat out the cigarette butt in his mouth, then turned his head to look at Connor. He pursed his lips and asked, “What’s going on?”
“Brother Wade, this kid bullied my brother. I was just about to teach him a lesson!” Brian quickly explained.
“F*ck, is there something wrong with you? How many times have 1 told you? I have shares in this bar now. If you want to cause trouble, do it outside. Don’t cause problems here, you got it?” The blonde-haired young man shouted at Brian in a very unhappy tone.
“Brother Wade, please don’t be angry. I was impulsive and forgot what you told me…” Brian said humbly.
The blonde-haired youth turned his head and looked at Connor, then said in a disdainful tone, “I don’t care how you want to deal with him, but don’t cause trouble in my bar. This kid looks like a loser. When he leaves the bar, you can deal with him however you want. You don’t have to do it here!”
“I know, Brother Wade!” Brian nodded.
“What are you still doing here? Hurry up and get lost!”
The blonde-haired youth turned his head and shouted at Connor.
Connor glanced at the blonde and didn’t say anything. He turned around and walked out of the room.
After leaving the room, Connor took out his phone and called Kyle Hayes.
He knew that Brian and the others would definitely continue to find trouble with him after he got off work, so for safety reasons, Connor asked Kyle to wait for him outside the Dusk.
“Connor, quickly help me send this bottle of wine over!”
Connor had just called Kyle when Lucy Green shouted at Connor,
“Got it!”
Connor helplessly agreed, then ran to Lucy’s side, picked up the bottle, and ran to the booth beside the dance floor.
In the blink of an eye, more than two hours had passed.
There were now fewer customers in the bar, so Connor had some time to rest.
But just as he sat down, he saw the blonde-haired young man who had talked to Brian come out of the box.
Connor suddenly remembered what the blonde-haired young man had said to Brian. The blonde-haired young man said that he had shares in this bar, but Xena said that she was the sole owner of this bar!
“Is this person related to Xena?”
Connor could not help but mutter to himself.
“Connor, are you resting?”
At this moment, Linda, who was also working part-time at the bar, walked up to Connor and asked with a smile.
“Yeah. Since there aren’t many people now, I’m taking a break!”
Connor looked at Linda and nodded lightly. Then, he hesitated for a moment and pointed in the direction of the blonde-haired youth. “Linda, do you know that person?”
“You mean Brother Wade?”
Linda called out softly when she saw the blonde-haired youth.
“Do you know him?”
Connor quickly asked.
“Of course, I know him. His name is Wade Wolfhard, and he’s a shareholder of our bar. However, this Wade guy has a bad temper and often bullies new employees. Last time, because 1 broke a cup, he deducted three days’ worth of my salary. In the end, Ms. Hart pleaded for me, and that was how I managed to get my money back. Besides that, he is always bothering Lucy. He’s definitely not a good person.”
When Linda spoke, her tone was filled with disgust, as if she hated Wade to the bone.
When Connor heard what Linda said, his expression became even more confused. He continued to ask, “Isn’t this bar owned by Ms. Hart alone? How could this Wade guy be a shareholder?”
“It’s true that the bar is owned by Ms. Hart alone, but if you want to open a bar in Porthampton, you have to have someone backing you up. 0then-vase, people will often come and cause trouble. At that time, the bar won’t be able to operate normally. Wade Wolfhard is the guy backing the bar, that’s why Ms. Hart gave 10% of the shares to him.” Linda said.
“What nonsense is that!”
Connor sighed softly.
“Exactly. Although this Wade isn’t a good person, his background is very terrifying. Ever since he started taking care of our bar, no one has really dared to cause trouble…”
Linda didn’t know much about Wade Wolfhard’s situation, so she could only briefly introduce him to Connor.
“Gotcha!”
Connor nodded thoughtfully.
“Alright. I have to get back to work!”
Linda saw that the number of customers in the bar had started to increase again. She waved at Connor and turned around to run toward the front desk.
Connor also got up and got back to work..

chapters.title: Chapter 172 - 172: Kyle Hayes’s Confidant
chapters.content:
Chapter 172: Kyle Hayes’s Confidant
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
On the other side, in the private room where Brian White, Brandon Guthrie and the others were.
After sending Wade Wolfhard off, Brian returned to the private room with a smile on his face. He seemed to be in a good mood.

“You don’t know who Brother Wade is?”
Brian said with a surprised expression.
“I don’t…”
Brandon gently shook his head.
“Then, do you know Wyatt Wolfhard?”
Brian asked helplessly.
“Brother Brian, are you talking about Brother Wyatt from Porthampton?”
A trace of shock flashed across Brandon’s eyes.
“Yes, that Wyatt Wolfhard. Wade is Wyatt’s younger brother. Now you know what kind of person Wade is, right?” Brian said lightly.
“This Wade is actually Wyatt’s younger brother. No wonder you were so polite to him just now!”
Brandon couldn’t help but exclaim.
After Mandy Hines and the others heard the conversation between Brian and Brandon, they were very puzzled.
“Hubby, who is this Wyatt Wolfhard you’re talking about?” Mandy hesitated and asked Brandon softly.
“Wyatt Wolfhard is a famous guy in the Southern New District of Porthampton. Basically, as long as it’s in the entertainment area in the Southern New District, it’s under the supervision of Wyatt’s men. Without Wyatt’s consent, entertainment establishments like bars and KTVs can’t be opened at all. Even if they are opened, they will close down soon after…” Brandon replied softly.
“I didn’t expect this Wyatt guy to be so powerful.”
Mandy exclaimed with her mouth wide open.
“You bet!”

When Brandon heard this name, he suddenly sucked in a breath of cold air, and the expression on his face was that of shock.
After all, in the eyes of Brandon and the others, Kyle Hayes was a legendary figure. Brandon had heard countless stories about Kyle Hayes, but he had never seen this person.
He knew that in Porthampton, Kyle was the one who could control the world.
“By the way, Brother Brian, how do you plan to deal with Connor McDonald?”
Mandy was not in the mood to listen to Brian’s story. She was only concerned about Connor.
“Since this is Brother Wade’s place, we can’t make a move here. Let’s wait for this kid to get off work before we make a move. 1’11 definitely make this kid kneel down and apologize to you!”
Brian replied with a smile.
After Brandon and Mandy heard Brian’s words, they suddenly became excited.
The two of them had waited for so long and finally had the chance to take revenge on Connor!
In the blink of an eye, two hours had passed.

“Connor, you must be exhausted today, right? When you get your salary this month, 1’11 give you a bonus!”
At this moment, a familiar voice sounded in Connor’s ear.
Connor quickly turned his head and saw that Xena Hart was right beside him.
Xena’s outfit today was also very attractive. She was wearing a spaghetti top that accentuated her beautiful curves. Her slender waist was exuding a seductive aura. She was wearing a short black skirt that seemed to be able to expose her buttocks at any time. Her slender and fair legs were exposed to the air, and she was wearing a pair of high-heeled sandals, giving people a very happy feeling.
He didn’t know why, but after what happened last time, Connor couldn’t look Xena in the eye anymore.
After all, if it wasn’t for Freya Phillips’s call that day, Connor and Xena would have already done the deed.
Although Xena was only twenty-six or twenty-seven years old, she had always exuded the charm of a mature woman.
Although she wasn’t as sexy and flirtatious as Rachel Wallace, she had always had an alluring aura on her that made one’s heart flutter.
“Why are you looking at me like that? Don’t you recognize me?”
Xena asked with a smile when she saw Connor in a daze.

Xena nodded lightly.
“Oh…”
Connor answered and then opened his mouth to continue speaking.
But at this moment, Linda suddenly ran to Xena’s side and whispered to her, “Ms. Hart, Brother Wyatt is here. Do you want to go over and say hello?”
H H
Xena’s expression changed when she heard Linda’s words.
“Connor, if you are tired, you can go back first. I will go and entertain the guests!”
Xena turned to Connor and instructed him. Then, she hurriedly walked toward the entrance of the bar in her high heels.
Connor narrowed his eyes and looked at Xena’s back, feeling puzzled.
Something was obviously off with Xena after she heard Linda’s words..

chapters.title: Chapter 173 - 173: Let Sister Lucy Go
chapters.content:
Chapter 173: Let Sister Lucy Go
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
“Brother Wyatt, what brings you here?”
At this moment, Xena walked to the entrance of the bar and called out with a smile.
“Boss Hart, your bar’s business is pretty good!”
A young man wearing a Versace shirt and a Rolex watch walked into the bar with a smile.
The young man wasn’t very old and looked to be in his early thirties. He was quite handsome, but there was a long scar on his face, which looked very scary. “Isn’t this all thanks to you, Brother Wyatt?”
Xena looked at the young man and flattered him. Then, she took the initiative to lead the young man to the private room.
When Connor saw Xena and the others leave, he couldn’t help but turn to Linda and ask, “Linda, who is this Brother Wyatt? Sister Xena seems to be very afraid of him!”
“No way, you don’t even know who Brother Wyatt is?”
Linda shouted in surprise when she heard Connor’s words.
“I don’t…”
Connor lightly shook his head.
“Brother Wyatt’s name is Wyatt Wolfhard. Sister Xena isn’t the only person afraid of him. Any bar owner in the Southern New District would be afraid of him.”
Linda frowned and continued, “Wyatt is a famous guy in the Southern New District, and Wade Wolfhard is Wyatt’s younger brother!”
“I see!”
Connor nodded thoughtfully.
Now, he had basically figured out what was going on. Although this bar was owned by Xena, people would usually come to cause trouble in entertainment establishments. Therefore, Xena took out 10% of the shares and gave it to Wade to help keep an eye on the place.
Wade, on the other hand, had used the fact that he was Wyatt’s younger brother to flaunt his power in the bar and commit all kinds of evil.
“Wyatt is not a good person either. He comes over to harass Ms. Hart for no reason, just like his younger brother, Wade!”
Linda looked at Connor and continued.
Connor couldn’t help but frown when he heard this. He was thinking whether he should help Xena or not.
After all, as long as Connor said something, Kyle Hayes could come over and protect Xena’s bar. In this way, Xena wouldn’t have to give Wade and Wyatt the shares of the bar.
“Wade, what are you trying to do? Let go of me!”
At this moment, a scream suddenly came from the corner of the bar.
H 11
When Connor and Linda heard the scream, they were stunned for a moment and quickly turned to look at the corner of the bar.
In a dark corner, Wade and Lucy Green were tugging at each other, as if something had happened.
“Wade is definitely harassing Sister Lucy again!”
When Linda saw this scene, she shouted angrily, but she had no intention of stopping him.
Moreover, the staff around Lucy did not react after hearing Lucy’s scream. They pretended not to see it and continued to work!
Connor hesitated for a moment before he got up to go over and see what was going on!
However, just as Connor stood up, Linda quickly reached out and grabbed him. She whispered to Connor, “Connor, where are you going?”
“I’ll go and see what’s going on!”
Connor replied indifferently.
“Are you crazy? Didn’t you see everyone’s reaction? If you go over and meddle in other people’s business, Wade will definitely not let you off!” Linda shouted helplessly at Connor.
“Sister Lucy is usually treats everyone quite well. Why are you pretending not to see what’s happening? Why are you letting her fend for herself?”
Connor was stunned for a moment and asked Linda.
“What else could it be? When Wade was harassing Sister Lucy, someone tried to stop Wade, but he was fired by Wade. Later, I heard that that person was beaten up by Wade until he was half-paralyzed and is still lying in the hospital! After such a thing has happened, everyone won’t dare to meddle in other people’s business in order to protect themselves…” Linda explained to Connor with a helpless expression.
“Then, isn’t Sister Xena going to do anything about this?”
Connor frowned and asked.
“Sister Xena wants to, but she can’t go up against them. If she offends Wade, it won’t end well. So, she can only think of ways to compensate Sister Lucy, but she can’t stop Wade…”
Linda looked at Connor and sighed helplessly. Then, she continued, “Connor, don’t be a busybody. If you go over now, Wade will definitely…”
However, before Linda could finish speaking, Connor was already walking toward Wade and Lucy.
“Connor, are you crazy?”
Linda stomped her feet anxiously after seeing Connor leave and shouted in a low voice.
However, Connor did not seem to hear Linda’s words at all and continued to walk forward…
In a corner of the bar.
Wade grabbed Lucy’s hand and shouted with bright eyes, “Lucy, no matter what happens today, I’m going to have you so that you won’t seduce me every single day…”
“Brother Wyatt, forgive me. I will never wear revealing clothes again. Please let me go!”
Lucy tugged at Wade’s clothes as she pleaded with a sob.
“No, you have to leave with me today. I’ve asked you out so many times, but you’ve always found an excuse to reject me. You even pretended to be innocent in front of me. You have to go to a hotel with me today…” Wade’s breath reeked of alcohol. He was obviously drunk.
“Wade, don’t be so shameless! How many times have I told you? I don’t like you at all. If you continue to harass me like this, I’m going to call the police!”
Lucy was clearly unable to control her emotions at this moment. She shouted angrily at Wade.
“Hehe, then you can go and call the police. I want to see who would dare to interfere in my matters. My brother is Wyatt Wolfhard. Who in the entire Southern New District doesn’t know who he is? Even if the police were to come, it wouldn’t work!”
Now that Wade was drunk, it was obvious that he was not using his brain when he spoke.
“Wade, 1 beg you, please let me go…”
At this moment, Lucy’s face was filled with despair because she could feel that Wade was not acting the way he usually acted.
Although Wade liked to harass her before, he would at most take advantage of her. He would never force her to get a room with him.
“I’m telling you, even if the emperor comes today, you’re still mine. You’d better leave with me quickly!”
Wade shouted and dragged Lucy out of the bar.
“Let Sister Lucy go!”
However, just as Wade was dragging Lucy out, a thin figure stood up and shouted at Wade coldly..

chapters.title: Chapter 174 - 174: Slapping Wade Wolfhard in the Face
chapters.content:
Chapter 174 - 174: Slapping Wade Wolfhard in the Face
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
After hearing this, Lucy quickly looked up in front of her.
When Lucy saw that it was Connor who had stopped Wade, her mouth fell open in shock.
She had never thought that the person who stood up to help her at this time would actually be Connor.
“Connor, are you crazy?”
When Linda saw Connor standing toward Wade, she quickly ran to Connor’s side, wanting to pull him back.
However, no matter how Linda tried to push him, Connor still would not budge. He still stood there expressionlessly.
“Little brat, I’m in a good mood today. I don’t want to argue with you. Hurry up and get lost. I can pretend that you didn’t say those words just now…”
Wade shouted at Connor, reeking of alcohol.
“Let go of Sister Lucy!”
Connor looked at Wade and repeated.
“What did you say?”
When Wade heard Connor’s words, he shouted with an extremely ferocious expression.
“Connor, I’m fine. Go back quickly. Don’t be a busybody!”
Although Lucy was very touched to see Connor stand up for her, she also knew that Wade was not someone to be trifled with. Anyone who had offended Wade in the past would not have a good ending.
Therefore, at this time, Lucy did not want to implicate Connor because of this matter.
“Connor, let’s go. Wade is not someone you can afford to offend!”
Linda also pulled Connor and shouted.
“Linda, let go of me!”
Connor turned his head and shouted at Linda.
Hearing Connor’s words, Linda was shocked and quickly let go of his hand.
Connor took a step forward and pointed at Wade’s nose as he said fiercely, “I’m telling you one last time, let go of Sister Lucy!”
“Damn, you’re quite arrogant, aren’t you? Who the hell are you? Do you know who 1 am? How dare you talk to me like that?”
Wade was clearly more awake now. He bared his teeth and shouted at Connor.
“Connor, don’t worry about me. Leave right now!”
Lucy saw that Wade seemed to be really angry and quickly shouted at Connor.
Connor acted as if he did not hear Lucy’s words and continued to say coldly to Wade, “1 don’t care who the f*ckyou are. You’d better let go of Sister Lucy and get out of here!”
“Haha…”
Wade looked at Connor and sneered. Then, he said expressionlessly,”Your name is Connor, right? If you kneel down and kowtow to me now, I’ll let you off. Otherwise, 1’11 make you leave this bar lying down!”
Wade shouted, and the entire bar fell silent. Even the music stopped abruptly. All the customers turned to look at Connor and Wade.
When they saw the conflict between Connor and Wade, they all looked at Connor with pity.
Who didn’t know the consequences of offending Wade in the Dusk?
After Mandy Hines, Brandon Guthrie, May Young, Brian White and the others heard the commotion outside, they quickly ran out of the private room.
However, when they saw that it was Connor and Wade who had a conflict, they were all stunned on the spot. They felt that the whole thing was incredulous.
“Is Connor crazy? He even dares to offend Brother Wade…”
Brian looked at Connor and exclaimed in horror.
“That’s right, this guy is really too arrogant, he even dares to offend Brother Wade. Brother Wade is Wyatt Wolfhard’s younger brother. Isn’t he courting death by provoking Brother Wade?” Lily Sullivan also shouted.
When Mandy and Brandon saw this scene, they looked at each other with a tacit understanding and smiled. They looked gleeful.
“I wanted to ask Brother Brian to help teach Connor a lesson. Now, things have turned out even better. Without waiting for Brother Brian to make a move, Connor actually took the initiative to provoke Brother Wade. 1 think he might not be able to walk out of this bar today…”
Brandon looked at Connor and laughed coldly.
“Yeah, Connor is brainless. Forget about him pretending to be a rich second-generation heir in school, but now he actually dares to offend Wade. 1 think he’s really tired of living!”
Mandy quickly replied.
In their eyes, Connor was just a loser who delivered food.
Now that he dared to offend Wade, he would definitely be beaten up by him to the point where he begged for mercy.
“Wade, today’s incident has nothing to do with Connor. He’s a new waiter and doesn’t know the rules here. 1 beg you, please let him go.”
Lucy saw that something was wrong and quickly shouted at Wade.
H ii
Wade turned to look at Lucy and said softly, “Lucy, I’ll give you face today. Get Connor to apologize to me now, and I’ll let him go!”
When Mandy, Brandon, and the others heard Wade’s words, they suddenly became disappointed.
After all, if Connor really apologized to Wade, they wouldn’t be able to see Connor kneeling and begging for mercy.
“Connor, what are you waiting for? Hurry up and apologize to Brother Wade!”
After Lucy heard Wade’s words, she shouted at Connor with an excited expression.
“Apologize?”
Connor couldn’t help but sneer, and then said expressionlessly, “1 have a fortune of ten trillion. Do you think I’ll be bullied by a scoundrel like you?” “You… What did you say?”
Wade didn’t hear Connor’s words clearly and was about to speak.
However, Connor did not give Wade a chance to speak. He took a step forward and slapped Wade’s face.
Smack!
A crisp sound rang out.
Wade was already a little drunk today. In addition, Connor had used a lot of strength in his slap, so after Wade staggered for a bit, he fell to the ground with a thud.
When everyone saw that Connor actually dared to attack Wade, they were all stunned. They were extremely shocked.
No one had expected Connor’s temper to be so bad. He had not even spoken a few words before he actually hit someone.
Lucy stood beside Connor with a desperate expression on her face!
She thought that she would leave with Wade today and Connor would apologize to Wade, then this matter would be over.
However, she had never expected that Connor would actually dare to hit Wade!
“Connor, are you crazy? Do you know who he is?”
Lucy shouted at Connor in desperation.
“I don’t need to know who he is, because you’ll know who 1 am later!”
Connor replied expressionlessly..

chapters.title: Chapter 175 - 175: Brother Wade Was Beaten Up!
chapters.content:
Chapter 175 - 175: Brother Wade Was Beaten Up!
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
After inheriting the ten trillion dollar inheritance, Connor had been hiding his identity so that his life would not be affected.
Therefore, this entire month, Connor had been living like an ordinary person. Unless someone took the initiative to provoke Connor, he would control his emotions and not let himself lose control.
However, as time passed, Connor felt more and more depressed.
Especially what happened in Freya Phillips’s company that day, it deeply agitated Connor.
At this moment, the anger that had been suppressed in Connor’s heart for many years was finally ignited!
Wade had unfortunately become a tool for Connor to vent his emotions.
“You… You dare to f*cking hit me?”
At this moment, Wade stood up shakily and shouted at Connor with a ferocious expression.
“Today, I’m going to beat you up until you kneel down and admit your mistake!”
Connor replied coldly. Then, he rushed toward Wade, lifted his leg, and kicked Wade in the stomach.
Thud!
Wade, who had just stood up, fell to the ground again.
Connor walked over and grabbed Wade’s hair. He used his other hand to slap Wade’s face.
Smack!
Smack!
Smack!
A series of crisp slaps echoed throughout the bar.
Everyone present was stunned, their eyes revealing deep shock.
The security guards in the bar were often bullied by Wade, so when they saw Wade being beaten up, they stood not far away and watched Connor beat Wade up. However, no one wanted to stand up and stop Connor.
“Is Connor crazy? What is he doing?”
Mandy Hines widened her big watery eyes and looked at Connor with an unusually shocked expression.
She really could not understand why Connor seemed to have changed into a different person today, actually becoming so brave.
Back when he was in school, even if Connor was bullied, he would only swallow his anger.
But now, Connor actually dared to make a move on someone like Wade. In Mandy’s eyes, this was not something Connor could do!
Brandon also looked at Connor’s actions in a daze. He was also very puzzled. He couldn’t understand where Connor got the courage to actually attack Wade like that.
“Is… is this kid crazy? He actually dared to hit Brother Wade. He’s so dead…”
When Brian White saw this scene, he could not help but shout.
However, he didn’t rush over to stop Connor. Instead, he turned around and ran toward the private room.
Brian knew that Wyatt Wolfhard was in the private room of the bar, so he wanted to get Wyatt to uphold justice.
“Connor, stop! He’s Wade Wolfhard! Do you really want to die?”
Lucy Green and Linda reacted to his actions, and they quickly ran to Connor’s side and shouted.
However, it was as if Connor did not hear them at all. He continued to slap Wade with all his might, causing blood to spurt out from Wade’s mouth. The scene was very bloody.
In the blink of an eye, Connor had slapped Wade nearly a hundred times. Wade’s head instantly swelled up like a pig’s head. Blood covered his face, and he looked extremely miserable.
“Do you still want me to apologize to you now?”
Connor’s hands seemed to have gotten sore from the beating. He rubbed his palms and asked Wade expressionlessly.
“No, no, no. You don’t need…”
Wade was completely terrified by Connor’s beating. He shook his head with a terrified expression.
Everyone gasped when they heard Wade’s words. Their faces were filled with shock. Who would have thought that Wade would actually be beaten up by a waiter like Connor?
However, they might have forgotten that Wade himself was not very capable. He was only able to achieve what he had today because of his relationship with Wyatt.
Therefore, no one dared to say anything even if Wade was bossy in the bar. However, if he really met someone who was not afraid of death, Wade would be afraid.
“Alright, since you wanted me to apologize to you, then apologize to Sister Lucy!”
Connor grabbed Wade’s hair and dragged him directly in front of Lucy.
Wade looked at Lucy in front of him with a hesitant expression.
He knew that if he apologized to Lucy today, he would not be able to survive in this bar in the future.
Because at this moment, Wade had not only embarrassed himself, but also Wyatt.
“Connor, I don’t need Wade’s apology.”
Lucy shouted agitatedly at Connor.
“No, he must apologize to you today!”
Connor replied expressionlessly.
Wade lay on the ground and looked at Lucy in front of him. He was very conflicted. He didn’t know if he should apologize now.
On the other side, Wyatt and Xena Hart were chatting in the private room. They had no idea what was happening outside the bar.
“Ms. Hart, the business in your bar seems to be quite good these days!”
Wyatt said to Xena with a smile.
“It’s all because of you taking care of us, Brother Wyatt!”
Xena replied lightly.
“Hehe, it’s mainly because Ms. Hart runs it well!”
Wyatt smiled faintly and continued, “Well, Wade is doing well on your side, right?”
“Wade has always been a responsible person!”
“That’s good!”
Wyatt looked at Xena and nodded. Then, he narrowed his eyes and said, “Since Wade is doing quite well here, shouldn’t Ms. Hart consider giving Wade and the others a raise?”
Xena couldn’t help but frown when she heard Wyatt’s words. In fact, she had already guessed the purpose of Wyatt’s visit today, but she couldn’t find a good excuse to reject him.
“Brother Wyatt, how much do you think is appropriate for a raise?”
Xena knew that she couldn’t leave Wyatt and Wade, so even if she was unwilling, she could only choose to accept this fact.
“Ms. Hart, how about you give Wade another 10% of the shares?”
Wyatt said calmly.
Hearing this, Xena was surprised.
She didn’t expect Wyatt to make such a ridiculous proposition. If she were to offer another 10% of the shares now, Wade would have 20% of the shares of the Dusk.
“Brother Wyatt, isn’t 10% a little too much?”
Xena asked in a low voice.
“Ms. Hart, it’s not easy for Wade to help you look after your place every day. Wade also has a lot of credit for how good your bar’s business is now, so you must not disappoint us. Otherwise, Ms. Hart, you’ll be the one who suffers!”
Wyatt picked up the wine glass on the table and took a sip.
Xena looked at Wyatt with a conflicted expression. She didn’t know if she should agree to Wyatt’s request.
Creak!
However, at this moment, the door of the private room was suddenly pushed open from the outside.
Brian rushed in and shouted at Wyatt, “Brother Wyatt, something has happened. Brother Wade was beaten up!”
“What? Wade was beaten up?”
After Wyatt heard Brian’s words, his expression changed drastically. He said with a gloomy face, “Who is so bold enough to hit Wade?”
“Yes… It’s one of the waiters in their bar!”
Brian said breathlessly.
When Wyatt heard this, he couldn’t help but turn to look at Xena.
Xena’s eyes flashed with confusion. She couldn’t understand why a waiter in her bar would hit Wade..

chapters.title: Chapter 176 - 176: How About I Break a Leg?
chapters.content:
Chapter 176: How About I Break a Leg?
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
“Motherf—take me there!”
Wyatt cursed angrily and then walked out of the private room. Xena hesitated for a moment before following him out of the room.
After a while, Xena and the others arrived at the bar.
However, when Xena saw that the person who had a conflict with Wade was Connor, she was stunned!
“Is Connor crazy? He actually dared to beat Wade up? Is he looking for death?”
Xena shouted inwardly as she looked at Connor with an extremely broken expression.
When Wyatt and Xena walked into the hall, the crowd that had been surrounding Connor stepped back to make way for them.
“President Hart, I didn’t expect the waiter in your bar to have such a temper. He even dared to hit my brother!” Wyatt said coldly to Xena.
“Wyatt, there must be some misunderstanding. Let me handle this matter!” Xena hurriedly replied, a nervous expression on her face. At this moment, her mind was filled with thoughts about how she could protect Connor.
After Brian brought Xena and Wyatt to the hall, he returned to Brandon and the others with a proud face.
“Brian, what did you do just now?” Brandon quickly asked Brian when he saw him return.
Brian pointed at Wyatt. “Do you see that person?” he asked with a smile.
“I saw him. Who is he?” Brandon asked in confusion.
“That person is the Wyatt I told you about before. This time, we won’t have to do anything, and that Connor guy probably won’t be walking out of this bar!” Brian said with a smile.
When Brandon, Mandy, and the others heard this, excitement appeared on their faces; they never expected that Brian would actually manage to find Wyatt!
And who was Wyatt? The infamous “Big Brother” of the New Southern Region.
Now that Connor had beaten Wade to such a state, Wyatt would definitely not let Connor off so easily.
“Hehe, now we just have to sit and wait for a good show…”
Brandon looked at Connor not far away and sneered to himself. The expression on his face was very happy.
On the other side, Wade, who was still hesitating on whether he should apologize to Lucy, acted like Wyatt was his savior as soon as the latter appeared. He rushed to Wyatt’s side like a madman and shouted, “Wyatt, you’re finally here! This poor waiter slapped me several times in front of so many people! You have to help me kill him. This isn’t just about slapping me, but about tarnishing your image, too!”
Wyatt looked at Wade helplessly and said impatiently, “You still have the d*mn nerve to tell me about this? If you can’t even beat a waiter, how are you going to help others?”
“This kid is too strong. I…I’m not a match for him! You have to help me!” Wade said with a trembling voice.
When the surrounding customers heard the conversation between Wade and Wyatt, their expressions instantly became shocked.
“Could this person be Wade’s cousin, Wyatt?”
“I didn’t expect Wyatt to be so young. 1 heard that he’s a well-known “Big Brother” in the Southern New District. Not only that, he’s with Kyle Hayes! His background is very powerful!”
“This Connor guy is really unlucky today to provoke someone like Wyatt…”
After everyone found out Wyatt’s identity, they began to discuss among themselves in hushed voices, looking at Connor with more and more pitiful eyes.
The waiters in the bar had a good relationship with Connor, so they were all worried for him.
Only Brandon, Mandy, and the others were in a good mood. They stood in the distance and waited for the show to begin.
When Lucy saw Wyatt and Xena walking over, she took a deep breath, then walked up and shouted, “President Hart, I caused this incident today. It has nothing to do with Connor. If you want to deal with it, please deal with me!” “Who beat him up?”
Wyatt asked Lucy expressionlessly.
Lucy could not help but be stunned when she heard this.
Connor directly walked in front of Wyatt and said with a very casual expression, “1 hit this person!”
“Hehe, you’re pretty awesome, kid. You have the guts to hit my younger brother!” Wyatt looked at Connor and sneered, then turned to Xena and asked, “President Hart, how do you plan to deal with this matter today?”
After Xena heard this, her expression suddenly stiffened. She said in a low voice, “Wyatt, Mr. McDonald just came to work at my bar. He might not know Wade’s identity yet. Could you please be merciful this time and let him go?” “Why should we let him go? He beat me up! He must pay the price today!” Wade shouted excitedly after hearing what Xena said.
Wyatt turned his head and glanced at Wade without saying a word. Xena hesitated for a moment, then gritted her teeth and said to Wyatt, “Wyatt, how about this: As long as you let Connor go today, I’m willing to give you 20 percent of the shares!”
“20 percent?”
Wyatt smiled faintly and turned to Wade, asking, “Wade, do you think 20 percent is enough?”
“Of course not. This kid beat me up in front of so many people, so it must be at least 30 percent!” Wade, having understood what Wyatt meant, shouted at the top of his lungs.
“President Hart, as long as you promise to give 30 percent of the shares to Wade, then we’ll let this kid kneel down and kowtow to my brother to apologize, and this matter will be over. What do you think?” Wyatt asked Xena softly.
Xena hesitated for two seconds, then turned around and shouted at Connor, “Connor, apologize to Wade!”
After Connor heard Xena’s words, he looked at Wade with disdain, then turned back to her and said, “Why should I apologize to such a person?”
“Connor, what do you want to do? I’m using 30 percent of the bar’s shares to keep you alive. Why are you so ungrateful?” Xena shouted.
“Xena, you don’t have to give shares to such a person!” Connor replied indifferently, then walked to Wyatt and asked calmly, “You are Wyatt, right?” “That’s right!”
“Ask your brother to return 10 percent of the shares to Xena, then apologize to the waiter in the bar. Also, don’t let me see the two of you in the Dusk again,” Connor whispered to Wyatt.
“Connor, are you crazy? What nonsense are you talking about?
Xena’s expression changed drastically as she shouted at Connor.
“President Hart, don’t say anything!” Wyatt waved his hand at Xena, then walked to Connor and said with a playful look, “You just said that you would let me go after I hand over my shares, right?”
“Yes!”
Connor lightly nodded.
“Then if 1 don’t return the shares to President Hart, what are you going to do with me?” Wyatt asked Connor with a faint smile.
“How about I break one of your legs?” Connor said in a joking tone.
“Hahahaha!” After Wyatt heard Connor’s words, he suddenly burst into laughter. Then, he pointed at Connor and said, “You’re really interesting. You actually want to break one of my legs? Oh man, I’m gonna die of laughter…” Connor looked at Wyatt and asked, “Have you laughed enough?”
“Hahaha, you brat, you’re really…”
“Smack!”
Before Wyatt could finish speaking, Connor raised his right hand and slapped him across the face..

chapters.title: Chapter 177 - 177: Why Should I Apologize to Him?
chapters.content:
Chapter 177: Why Should I Apologize to Him?
Translator: End less Fantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
When everyone saw Connor slap Wyatt, they were all dumbfounded.
The smile on Wyatt’s face instantly froze, and his expression became one of fury.
For a moment, everyone was stunned they felt that everything was too unbelievable. No one had expected Connor to slap Wyatt right after slapping Wade!
“It’s over, it’s completely over this time. Connor, you’re looking for death!”
Xena’s mouth was wide open as she stared at Connor’s position with a dumbfounded expression. She knew that if Connor continued to slap those two, her bar would be finished, and so would Connor!
“I’m asking you a question. Have you laughed enough?” At this moment, Connor’s voice resounded throughout the bar again.
But this time, no one dared to laugh.
“You… You dare hit me?” Wyatt clutched at his face and shouted at Connor with an angry expression.
“If you still dare to laugh, I don’t mind slapping you again!”‘ Connor replied coldly.
After Brandon, Mandy, and the others heard Connor’s words, they suddenly became dumbfounded. None of them thought that Connor would actually dare to attack Wyatt, much less speak to Wyatt so arrogantly. This was simply too unbelievable!
May stared at Connor with her big, watery eyes. The expression on her face was extremely complicated; back in school, even if girls like May herself had bullied Connor, Connor would choose to swallow his anger.
However, he was actually so domineering when facing a gangster like Wyatt!
They could not understand why Connor had such a big change today!
“Good, very good! I was originally planning to let you off on account of President Hart, but since you don’t know what’s good for you, don’t blame me for being rude!” Wyatt shouted at Connor with a ferocious expression.
“Wyatt, you have to teach this guy a lesson today. Otherwise, how else will he survive in the Southern New District in the future! ‘1
Wade said excitedly to Wyatt.
“Wyatt, Connor is insensible. Can you please let him off?’’ Xena said excitedly to Wyatt.
“President Hart, he slapped me in the face today. If 1 don’t teach him a lesson, how will he survive here in the future?”
Wyatt roared and took out his phone to make a call. “Pete, hurry up and bring people to the Dusk!”
After saying that, Wyatt hung up the phone.
Xena looked at Connor in despair after Wyatt finished the call. She knew that Wyatt was determined to teach Connor a lesson today. No matter who came to plead for mercy, it would be useless!
She looked at Connor in front of her and couldn’t help but whisper, “Connor, why did you have to offend Wyatt? Wouldn’t everything be fine if you apologized to him just now?”
At this moment, Connor stood alone on the spot. He looked tiny, like a lamb waiting to be slaughtered.
His eyes were extremely calm, but in everyone else’s eyes, this was just the despair before death.
Xena was so anxious that she didn’t know what to say. She quickly walked up to Connor and shouted, “Connor, just take it as me begging you, okay? Hurry up and apologize to Wyatt! As long as you apologize to him, I will definitely find a way to protect you! ”
“Why should I apologize to him?”
Connor replied expressionlessly.
“Why else? You slapped Wyatt. Shouldn’t you apologize to him? Besides, Wyatt is not someone you can afford to provoke. Do you want to see yourself crippled by him? Even if you don’t think about yourself, you should think about your parents, right?”
Xena’s big, watery eyes were wide open as she shouted angrily.
“I don’t have parents!” Connor said indifferently.
After Xena heard Connor’s words, she froze on the spot.
Although Connor knew that Xena was thinking about his safety, he still didn’t have any intentions of making peace.
If it was a few days ago, Connor felt that he might have apologized to Wyatt. But now, Connor felt that Wyatt was living in an overly egregious way; he clearly already had a huge amount of wealth, but he still lived like an idiot.
Even a big shot like Kyle Hayes would respectfully address Connor as Mr. McDonald when he saw him. Compare that to now, where Connor was being bullied by a little punk!
If it was people like Freya who were pushing him around, he would just tolerate it. After all, he could not expose his identity in front of Freya.
But what were Wyatt and Wade to him?
Kyle would be here soon. By then, no matter how powerful Wyatt and Wade were, they would have to kneel down and kowtow to Kyle!
There was another important reason why Connor was doing this: he wanted Brandon, Mandy, and the others to know his true identity so that they would hide far away when they saw him in the future.
Otherwise, this adulterous couple would really be a constant thorn in his side. They would keep harassing him and find trouble with Connor everywhere.
Connor felt that the time he made Brandon kneel at the door of the classroom was already a big lesson for Brandon, but he definitely didn’t expect that idiot not to remember it at all.
Connor didn’t plan to continue arguing with the two of them, so he would make his identity known and ask rhe two of them to get lost. Only then could he also have a lot of peace.
“Connor, 1 just want you to apologize, right? Why is it so difficult? You’re a poor loser, so what’s wrong with apologizing to Wyatt?”
At this moment, Mandy also stood up and mocked Connor; was worried that he would really lower his head and admit his mistake. If he did, she wouldn’t be able to see him make a fool of himself, so she deliberately provoked Connor.
In Mandy’s opinion, Connor was so strong now because he wanted to show her how brave and powerful he was in front of her, trying to make her change her mind.
After Connor heard Mandy’s words, he couldn’t help but look up at her. After cursing her in his heart, he didn’t say anything.
He couldn’t help but think that he was blind back then. Why would he get a dumb person like Mandy as his girlfriend?
Other than being a little beautiful, Mandy’s IQ was in the negatives!
“Clang!”
At this moment, the sound of footsteps came from the entrance of rhe bar.
Hearing the noise, everyone turned to look.
At the entrance of the bar, a large group of people holding baseball bats and steel pipes walked inside..

chapters.title: Chapter 178 - 178: Rachel Wallace’s Appearance
chapters.content:
Chapter 178: Rachel Wallace’s Appearance
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
After seeing these people enter, Wyatt’s eyes flashed with ruthlessness.
“Connor, weren’t you very arrogant just now? You continue to be arrogant! Now that my brother’s men are here, you can wait for death!”
Wade’s entire face was swollen like a pig’s head, but he still shouted at Connor arrogantly.
As soon as Wade finished speaking, a large group of people instantly walked in front of Wyatt and called out to him in unison.” Wyatt!”
“This kid was the one who hit my brother just now. Hurry up and break his legs!” Wade pointed at Connor and shouted.
When everyone heard Wade’s words, they all turned to look at Wyatt, as if they were asking for his opinion.
“Throw this kid out and break his four legs!” Wyatt didn’t waste any words and shouted expressionlessly.
“Yes, Boss!”
When the gangsters heard this, they picked up the weapons in their hands and rushed towards Connor aggressively.
When Brandon, Mandy, and the others saw this scene, they could not help but smile proudly. After all, the two of them had been waiting for this scene for too long.
“Wyatt, I beg you to let Connor go! He just started working at the bar today and doesn’t know the rules here. I’m willing to take out 50 percent of my bar’s shares. Can you let Connor off this time?” Xena stood in front of Connor and begged Wyatt in a humble tone.
“This kid slapped me just now. If I don’t kill him, how can I, Wyatt, survive here in the future?” Wyatt shouted coldly.
While Wyatt was talking, Connor took out his phone and dialed Kyle Hayes’s number.
“Mr. McDonald!” Kyle quickly picked up the phone.
“How long will it take for you to arrive?” Connor frowned and asked.
“About three more minutes!” Kyle answered after a moment of hesitation.
“Right now, I’m—” Before Connor could finish his sentence, he suddenly realized that Xena had been pushed to the ground by a hooligan.
“You even hit a woman—Are you still a man?” Connor shouted. He picked up the bottle beside him and smashed it at the head of the gangster who had pushed Xena.
“Bang!”
There was a loud bang. The wine bottle smashed hard on the gangster’s head, and the glass shards instantly scattered.
The thug swayed a few times and fell to the ground with a thud.
“Mr. McDonald? Mr. McDonald?”
Kyle shouted excitedly after he heard the cursing. However, Connor had already thrown his phone to the side. He kept picking up the wine bottles beside him and aiming them at the gangsters’ heads.
Previously, Connor’s temper had always been very good and he would never pick a fight with others. He was worried that if the school found out about his fights, they would punish him. If that happened, he would not be able to get his poverty grant, and he might even be expelled.
That was why Connor chose to swallow his anger when he was humiliated by others.
However, swallowing his anger did not mean that Connor was not good at fighting.
Connor had practiced some fist techniques with his father since he was young. In addition, he had been delivering food all these years, so although he looked weak, he was actually quite skilled.
At the very least, he was stronger than ordinary people.
Connor and Wyatt’s dozen underlings fought together. At first, Connor was barely able to deal with them, but as the other party fought more and more bravely, Connor slowly found himself getting exhausted.
As the saying went, two fists can’t fight four legs. Although those television shows usually showed one person fighting against ten people, it was impossible in real life. No matter how powerful you were, even managing to hold on for ten minutes against more than ten fully armed hooligans was already a show of skill. If you said you wanted to defeat all of them, that was nigh impossible!
“Bang!”
At this moment, a hooligan saw an opportunity to kick Connor in the stomach.
Connor staggered back two steps and fell to the ground.
“Woooo!”
When everyone saw Connor fall, they directly rushed towards him.
When Xena saw Connor collapse, her face filled with despair. She knew that if he collapsed, it meant that he would never have the chance to stand up again.
“Stop!”
However, at this moment, a cold voice suddenly came from the entrance of the bar.
When everyone heard this sound, they all looked towards the source of it.
A tall and beautiful woman walked into the bar in her high heels with a murderous aura.
She was wearing a gray pencil skirt. She looked charming and had a lovely figure. Her legs were wrapped in black stockings, and she was wearing a pair of red high heels. She looked extremely sexy and beautiful.
When everyone saw this beauty, a trace of confusion flashed across their faces.
“Who is this beauty?”
“I don’t know, but she’s really hot!”
“It seems that she’s no ordinary person. Otherwise, why would she dare to speak up for Connor?”
When the customers in the bar saw this beauty, they were all puzzled. However, Connor, Xena Mandy Brandon, and the others were all stunned. The expressions on their faces were ones of disbelief.
Mandy opened her mouth and could not help but exclaim, “Wallace…Why is Ms. Wallace here?”
That’s right, the beauty who appeared at the entrance of the Dusk was none other than Connor’s university counselor, the demon-like existence, Rachel Wallace!
Connor narrowed his eyes and looked at Rachel, his expression also carrying a trace of confusion.
It was then that Xena quickly remembered that Rachel had called her just now and said that she wanted to come to the bar to take a look. However, after the incident with Connor, Xena had forgotten about this.
However, to everyone’s surprise, Wyatt was also stunned when he saw Rachel.
Then, his body shook like a poor peasant who had seen the emperor. He quickly walked in front of Rachel and half-bowed as he asked,” Wallace…Miss Wallace, why did you come over?”
When everyone heard Wyatt’s words, they immediately sucked in a breath of cold air, deep shock in their eyes.
They couldn’t understand why Wyatt would be so respectful to Rachel!
Of course, Connor, Mandy, Brandon and Xena were the most shocked after seeing this scene.
In their impression, Rachel was just a university counselor. She shouldn’t have any interactions with people like Wyatt!
“Buzz!”
At this moment, Connor suddenly realized that the phone beside him was ringing.
Connor quickly picked up the phone and answered the call.
“Mr. McDonald, I’m already at the entrance of the bar, do you still need me to go in?” Kyle asked anxiously.
Connor suddenly felt that something was wrong with Rachel, so he hurriedly replied, “Um, wait a minute. Come in when 1 call you in!”
“Alright then, I’ll wait for you at the entrance of the bar!” Kyle quickly said..

chapters.title: Chapter 179 - 179: An Unknown Identity
chapters.content:
Chapter 179: An Unknown Identity
Translator: End Less Fantasy Translation Editor: End LessFantasy Translation
After hanging up the phone, Connor quickly looked at Rachel.
Wyatt saw that Rachel did not answer his question, so he quickly asked again, “Miss Wallace, why did you come to this bar today?”
Rachel chose to ignore Wyatt and instead walk toward Connor in her high heels.
When Wyatt saw Rachel treat him so coldly, a trace of annoyance flashed across his eyes, and his brows furrowed tightly.
After a while, Rachel made it to Connor and asked him softly, “Connor, are you alright?”
Connor hesitated for a moment before replying in a low voice, “Ms. Wallace,
I’m fine…”
“You’re bleeding, yet you still say you’re fine?” Rachel rolled her eyes at Connor, then took out a scarf from her bag and gently wiped his face.
Seeing this scene, Mandy and Brandon were suddenly a little stunned. They couldn’t understand why Rachel treated Connor so well, and they couldn’t understand why someone like Wyatt would be afraid of Rachel.
Connor looked at Rachel in front of him and could clearly smell the fragrance from her body. At this time, he was also wondering why Wyatt was so afraid of Rachel!
“Could it be that Rachel is the same as me and has some unknown identity?” he could not help but think.
After seeing Rachel wiping the blood on Connor’s face, Wyatt’s expression became very ugly, and his forehead broke out in a cold sweat.
He never wT ould’ve thought that Connor knew someone like Rachel!
Although Wyatt didn’t know Rachel’s background, he knew that she had a mysterious identity.
When Wyatt was Kyle Hayes’s driver, Kyle was very respectful to Rachel. Wyatt had been with Kyle for so many years, but he had never seen him be so respectful to anyone, not even Thomas Morgan.
Later on, Wyatt heard that Rachel had gone to Porthampton University to be a counselor. She was very low-key, so no one knew who she was.
Wyatt had once asked Kyle about her, but Kyle had only answered him with one sentence: don’t provoke this woman, or else you will die a horrible death!
Wyatt had never seen Kyle so afraid of someone!
So at that time, he remembered Rachel in his heart.
In the blink of an eye, a few years had passed. Wyatt did not expect to meet Rachel again, let alone in such a scene!
“Get your ass over here!”
At this moment, Rachel had already helped Connor wipe the blood off his face and turned to Wyatt.
Wyatt stood there and hesitated for two seconds. Then, he walked up to Rachel in fear and trepidation and said softly to Rachel,” Miss Wallace, I didn’t know that Connor knew you. I… If 1 knew that Connor knew you, 1 wouldn’t dare do it even if I had bottomless courage…”
“You bullied Connor just now, right?” Rachel wasn’t in the mood to listen to Wyatt s explanation and interrupted him.
“Miss Wallace, he was the one who hit my brother first, so 1…”
“Let me ask you, did you bully Connor just now?” Rachel repeated impatiently.
“He hit me first!” Wyatt gritted his teeth as he said that with a broken expression.
“Connor is the most honest student in my class. Why would he hit you? And just now, I only saw your people bullying Connor!” Rachel replied indifferently. Then, she turned her head and said, “Connor, come here!”
“Ms. Wallace, what’s wrong?”
“Beat him up for me!” Rachel pointed at Wyatt.
After Wyatt heard Rachel’s words, he was stunned. His expression was extremely broken, and he was crying inwardly.
The customers in the bar also widened their eyes in shock. They had never expected that the charming and sexy woman in front of them would have such a domineering personality. She was completely unreasonable!
After Connor heard Rachel’s words, he also had a dumbfounded expression.
He had originally planned to borrow this opportunity to call Kyle and give Mandy and Brandon a good slap in the face so that they would not dare to harass him again. However, he never would have thought that Rachel would randomly show up and snatch all the limelight.
Xena widened her eyes and looked at Rachel. She actually had nor known Rachel for long; it was just that Xena’s younger sister was studying at Porthampton University and happened to be in Rachel s class. She ended up becoming good friends with Rachel after a few interactions.
In Xena’s eyes, Rachel was no different from an ordinary person, except for her domineering personality. However, she didn’t expect Rachel to have such a terrifying background that even Wyatt was afraid of her.
“Connor, what are you still standing there for? Smack him around!
At this moment, Rachel’s cold voice sounded again.
Connor didn’t hesitate and walked towards Wyatt.
“Whoaaaa!”
When Wyatt’s lackeys saw Connor walk over, they immediately stood in front of Wyatt.
“What is the meaning of this?”
Rachel frowned and asked Wyatt.
Wyatt hesitated for two seconds, then gritted his teeth and shouted, “All of you, get lost!”
When everyone heard this, their bravado dropped. Who would have thought that Wyatt would be so afraid of Rachel?
“I told you to get lost, didn’t you hear me?” Wyatt continued to shout when he saw that his lackeys did not respond.
Everyone immediately moved aside.
Connor didn’t hesitate. He walked forward and slapped Wyatt’s face.
“Smack!”
A crisp sound rang out.
Connor’s slap was full of strength, causing Wyatt to take a few steps back. Blood also flowed down the corner of Wyatt’s mouth.
Wyatt felt extremely aggrieved, bur he could only grit his teeth and stand where he was. Someone at his level definitely couldn’t afford to offend a woman that even Kyle was afraid of!
“Hit him again!”
Rachel narrowed her alluring eyes and spoke to Connor in a calm tone.
Connor didn’t hesitate to slap Wyatt again.
Seeing this scene, rhe customers in rhe bar were stunned, shock in their eyes. They really couldn’t understand why Wyatt was so afraid of Rachel he didn’t even dare retaliate after being beaten!
Connor took advantage of this opportunity to vent his anger as he and kept slapping Wyatt’s face..

chapters.title: Chapter 180 - 180: Big Brother’s Mistress
chapters.content:
Chapter 180: Big Brother’s Mistress
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Not long after, Wyatt’s face was covered in blood from Connor’s beating. He looked very miserable.
Mandy and Brandon looked at Connor in a daze, their faces full of confusion.
Until now, the two of them still couldn’t understand why Wyatt was so afraid of Rachel.
After Connor slapped Wyatt’s face more than ten times, he felt his hands go numb. He stopped and turned to Rachel, “Ms. Wallace, I’m a little tired. Let’s leave it at that for now…”
“Good!”
Rachel nodded gently and walked to Wyatt.
Wyatt stood in place with red eyes. At this time, there were at least a hundred people watching in the bar. He was a big shot in the Southern New District, but now he’d been beaten up by Connor. Wyatt felt that he had suffered a huge humiliation, but he didn’t know how to take revenge on Connor.
“Do you know who he is?”
Rachel pointed at Connor and asked Wyatt coldly.
H 11
Wyatt gritted his teeth and didn’t say anything.
“Remember, Connor is my younger brother. From today onwards, no one is allowed to bully Connor. If I see such a thing happen again, 1 will definitely make you suffer,” Rachel said to him.
Wyatt was not a fool. He knew that Rachel did not intend to continue arguing with him about this matter, so he quickly said, “I’ll remember it!”
“Get lost!” Rachel said indifferently.
When Wyatt heard this, he immediately heaved a sigh of relief and hurriedly turned around to walk out of the bar with his lackeys.
Everyone looked at the backs of Wyatt and the others as they left. They couldn’t help but sigh in their hearts. Who would have thought that it would end up like this?
Connor was very depressed; he had originally planned to get Kyle to come over and deal with this matter, but he didn’t expect it to end up like this.
“Why does it feel like I’m Rachel’s gigolo?” Connor muttered helplessly.
A few seconds later, Wyatt left the bar with his men.
“I’m really sorry for delaying everyone’s drinking and entertainment time today. All prices today will be 50 percent off. Everyone, drink and have fun!” Xena shouted at the customers in the bar.
When everyone heard this, they immediately burst into cheers and went back to their own business.
Although Connor beating up Wyatt was a big news, now that Wyatt had left, there was no point in continuing to surround them.
Mandy, Brandon, and Brian looked at Connor with a trace of unwillingness in their eyes. Originally, they thought that Connor would definitely be taught a lesson by Wyatt today, but they didn’t expect Rachel to show up and help Connor. And not only did she help Connor out, she also made him look good in front of so many people.
“Connor is really lucky!” Mandy pouted and muttered disdainfully.
“Alright, let’s go too, lest Ms. Wallace sees us!”
Brandon sighed helplessly and then walked out of the bar.
On the other hand.
After Wyatt and the others left, Xena quickly ordered the waiters in the bar to serve the guests.
Connor walked to Rachel’s side and said softly, “Ms. Wallace, thank you for today!”
“What do you have to thank me for? 1 was the one who asked you to work at this bar. If someone bullies you, I’ll definitely help you!” Rachel replied indifferently.
“Ms. Wallace, do you know this Wyatt? Why is he so afraid of you?” Connor asked cautiously.
“It’s nothing, really.” Rachel waved her hand at Connor and continued, “1 don’t actually know this Wyatt, but 1 know his boss. He probably thinks that I have a good relationship with his boss, which is why he’s afraid of me…”
H 11
When Connor heard Rachel’s words, he could not help but be stunned for a moment. Then, he said in a low voice, “Ms. Wallace, don’t tell me you’re ‘acquainted’ with some big shot?”
In Connor’s impression, the boss of a person like Wyatt was probably a gangster!
“Get lost!” Rachel rolled her eyes at Connor and said indifferently, “Since you’ve been beaten up like this, you should go home and rest. 1 haven’t seen Xena in a long time.”
After saying this, Rachel no longer paid attention to Connor. Instead, she sauntered towards Xena’s seat with a sway of her hips.
Connor knew that Rachel must be avoiding his questions, so he didn’t ask anything more, instead turning around and walking out of the bar. He knew that Kyle’s men had been waiting for him outside the bar, so he was going to ask Kyle about Rachel.
Wyatt was Kyle’s underling. Since Wyatt knew Rachel’s identity, then Kyle must know her identity too!
After walking out of the bar, Connor saw the bodyguards brought by Kyle standing nervously by the door. They didn’t know what had happened in the bar.
“Mr. McDonald, you’re out?”
Kyle shouted after seeing Connor walk out of the bar.
“I’m sorry to have made you wait outside for so long!” Connor turned his head and looked at Kyle and his bodyguards.
“We were late today…” Kyle replied with some guilt. Then, he looked at the wound on Connor’s face and asked, “Mr. McDonald, how did you get hurt?” “Let’s talk in the car. 1 have something to ask you!”
Connor knew that this was the entrance of the bar. From time to time, there would be waiters passing by. If he accidentally let those waiters see him talking to Kyle, it would definitely cause a misunderstanding, so Connor planned to find a place where no one was talking to Kyle.
“Good!”
Kyle quickly agreed and then opened the car door for Connor, after which Connor directly sat in the car.
“Mr. McDonald, what happened inside? What happened to your face?” Kyle asked after getting into the car.
“Let’s not talk about this matter for now. Let me ask you, do you know Rachel Wallace?” Connor narrowed his eyes and asked softly.
“Rachel Wallace?”
When Kyle heard the name, he couldn’t help but be stunned for a moment.
Then, he said softly, “Mr.. McDonald, are you talking about Miss Wallace?”

chapters.title: Chapter 181 - 181: Rachel Wallace’s Identity
chapters.content:
Chapter 181: Rachel Wallace’s Identity
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
“I don’t know if she’s that Ms. Wallace. 1 only know her name is Rachel Wallace, and she’s a lecturer at Porthampton University!” Connor said slowly.
“That should be the same Ms. Wallace!” Kyle looked at Connor and nodded.
“Do you know her?” Connor saw Kyle’s reaction and asked quickly.
“I guess so. When Ms. Wallace first came to Porthampton, 1 was in charge of receiving her. 1 also helped her contact the principal of Porthampton University and helped her find a job as a lecturer. However, after Ms. Wallace went to Porthampton University, she never contacted me again!”
Kyle looked at Connor and paused. Then, he asked with a puzzled expression, “Mr. McDonald, why are you asking this?”
“She’s my university counselor. It was Rachel who saved me today. Do you know who Rachel Wallace is?” Connor asked Kyle anxiously.
“I don’t know…”
Kyle shook his head without thinking.
“You don’t know? Since you don’t know who she is, why did you receive her? Why did you help her find a way to work?” Connor asked with a puzzled expression.
“I only know that Ms. Wallace is from another city, but 1 don’t know her exact identity. I also only know Ms. Wallace has a very powerful background. As for my receiving her back then, it was just a mission given to me by my boss. I’m quite curious about Ms. Wallace’s identity. Even my boss is afraid of her…” Kyle looked at Connor and explained seriously.
“Your boss? Am I not your boss?”
Connor was confused by Kyle’s words because he didn’t know that there was another boss behind Kyle.
“Mr. McDonald, you’re my boss now, but when Ms. Wallace came to Porthampton, 1 was just the company’s vice president, and our company’s chairman was my boss!” Kyle said slowly.
“So, where is the chairman of your company now?” Connor quickly asked.
“He’s dead, so 1 got promoted to the new chairman position. Otherwise, you would be speaking to my previous boss, not me!” Kyle explained.
Only then did Connor realize what Kyle was talking about.
Kyle and Thomas were helping Connor with his business.
However, when the former chairman was still alive, Thomas and Kyle’s elder brother should have helped him manage the business.
However, when it came to Connor, Kyle’s elder brother was already died, so Kyle took over his elder brother’s position!
“So, according to what you said, no one knows Rachel Wallace’s identity now, right?” Connor asked.
“I tried to investigate Ms. Wallace’s identity before but couldn’t find anything. Thomas probably doesn’t know Rachel Wallace’s identity either!” Kyle said slowly.
“I didn’t expect Rachel Wallace’s identity to be so secretive!”
Connor could not help but sigh softly.
At this moment, the more secretive Rachel Wallace’s identity was, the more curious Connor was.
However, since Kyle said he couldn’t find out, Connor definitely couldn’t. Kyle wouldn’t lie to him about such things.
“Phew…”
Connor took a deep breath, then asked Kyle, “You probably know Wyatt Wolf hard, right?”
“I do. Wyatt was my driver before. The person who offended you today is Wyatt, right?” Kyle looked at Connor and said.
“That’s right, Wyatt caused the wound on my face!” Connor replied indifferently.
“All, Wyatt, is he asking for death?”
When Kyle heard this, he was furious.
He had to be careful with his words and actions when he spoke to Connor. Now that one of his underlings had beaten up his boss, how could Kyle not be angry?
“If it weren’t for Rachel’s timely appearance, my legs would have been crippled by Wyatt!” Connor turned to look at Kyle and continued.
“Mr. McDonald, don’t be angry. I’ll help you deal with Wyatt now!” Kyle replied nervously, then took out his phone and dialed Wyatt’s number.
“Beep, beep, beep…”
The phone rang twice before Wyatt picked it up and said respectfully, “Kyle, it’s late. What’s up?”
“Wyatt, where are you now?” Kyle suppressed the anger in his heart and asked coldly.
“Ky- Kyle, my bro, did something happen?” Wyatt felt something was wrong with Kyle’s tone, so he asked carefully.
“Cut the crap. Let me ask you again, where are you now?” Kyle said through gritted teeth.
“I… I’m at home now!” Wyatt replied with a trembling voice.
“Beep beep beep!”
After hearing Wyatt’s answer, Kyle hung up the phone and ordered his driver, “Wayne, go to Wyatt’s house now!”
“Alright!” the driver quickly agreed and started the car.
At the same time.
Rachel stood seductively in front of the floor-to-ceiling window of the bar’s private room. She narrowed her mesmerizing big eyes and looked at the scenery outside the bar.
When she saw Kyle’s car leave, Rachel couldn’t help but lick her seductive red lips and said softly, “Dear Connor, it seems 1 have underestimated you. 1 didn’t expect you to know Kyle Hayes..”

chapters.title: Chapter 182 - 182: Coming To The Door
chapters.content:
Chapter 182: Coming To The Door
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
1AM.
In a residential area in Porthampton.
Wyatt wiped his swollen face with an egg. His expression was very serious.
He had just offended Rachel, and then Kyle called. Wyatt vaguely felt that something was not right.
“Wyatt, why are you afraid of that woman?” At this moment, Wade came in drunk and asked Wyatt agitatedly.
“You don’t have to worry about my life…” Wyatt shouted impatiently.
“I just feel that today’s matter is really unfair. We were actually beaten up by that loser, Connor. If this gets out, how are we going to survive in Porthampton?” Wade walked up to Wyatt and shouted at the top of his lungs.
“Who knows what kind of luck that kid has to know someone like Ms. Wallace!” Wyatt replied.
“Wade, are you going to let this go just like that?” Wade shook Wyatt’s shoulder and shouted at him frustratedly.
H H
After Wyatt heard this, his expression darkened. He frowned and said, “What else do you plan to do? Kyle already called just now. I heard his tone and he didn’t seem very happy. 1 don’t know if it’s because of Connor…”
“That can’t be. Didn’t that woman say that she won’t hold it against us? How could she complain to Kyle about it?” Wade asked in exasperation.
“It would be best if it wasn’t because of that!”
Wyatt heaved a sigh of relief and continued, “During this time, don’t find trouble with Connor. When the focus on this is over, 1 will find an opportunity to teach him a lesson!”
