“Alright!” Wade nodded lightly and did not say anything else.
“Bang bang bang!” At this moment, a series of urgent knocks came from outside.
When Wyatt heard the knock on the door, he couldn’t help but be stunned for a moment. Then, without thinking, he quickly ran to the door and opened it.
However, when Wyatt opened the door and saw Connor standing outside, he was stunned on the spot, his eyes filled with confusion.
“Connor? What are you doing here?” Wyatt raised his voice and shouted angrily at Connor.
Although Wyatt did not intend to let Connor off, he was afraid of the relationship between Connor and Rachel. Therefore, he was prepared to find someone to deal with Connor after this was over.
Even if Rachel pursued it by then, Wyatt could refuse to admit it.
However, he did not expect Connor to knock on his door.
“That’s right, it’s me!” Connor looked at Wyatt and replied calmly.
“Kid, let me tell you, I let you off today because of Ms. Wallace. If it weren’t for Ms. Wallace, I would have broken your legs long ago. So you’d better get lost now and not let me see you again, do you hear me?” Wyatt pointed at Connor’s nose and shouted angrily.
“If it weren’t for Rachel, do you think you would still be standing and talking to me now?” Connor said mockingly. He pushed Wyatt aside and walked into Wyatt’s house.
“Ah, f*ck, Connor, do you f*cking think that just because you know Ms. Wallace, we won’t dare to do anything to you?”
At this moment, Wade, sitting on the sofa, shouted at Connor. Then, he picked up the ashtray on the table and rushed toward Connor.
“Wyatt and Wade, are you two tired of living?” At this moment, a man’s voice suddenly came from behind Connor.
When Wyatt and Wade heard this, they froze. They were very shocked.
Kyle slowly walked into the room.
“Ky…Kyle?”
When Wyatt saw Kyle, his eyes immediately widened. He was usually calm, but not right now.
“Clang!”
The ashtray in Wade’s hand fell to the ground.
Connor smiled disdainfully when he saw the reaction of these two people. He walked directly into the hall and sat on the sofa with a faint smile.
In fact, Connor had long guessed that Wyatt and Wade would have such a reaction!
“Ky…Kyle, wh… Why are you here?” Wyatt looked at Kyle and swallowed hard. He asked Kyle with a terrified expression.
“Smack!”
Kyle didn’t answer his question. Instead, he slapped Wyatt’s face and shouted, “Wyatt, who the hell do you think you are? He even dared to hit Mr. McDonald? Do you have a f*cking death wish?”
“Mr… Mr. McDonald?”
After being slapped by Kyle, Wyatt didn’t dare to resist at all. He looked at Connor, who was on the sofa, trembling with fear.
At this moment, Wade was even more dumbfounded!
He could not understand. Wasn’t Connor just a waiter in the bar? How was he Mr. McDonald?
“Kyle… What… What’s going on?” Wyatt covered his pig face and asked Kyle.
“Mr. McDonald is the new chairman of our company. What do you think is going on?” Kyle replied coldly.
Wyatt was shocked again after hearing Kyle’s words.
Although Kyle, Wyatt, and the others were famous gangsters in Porthampton, Kyle set up a company in Porthampton to manage his subordinates.
In the company, according to the identity of each underling, they were assigned different positions.
When Wyatt was Kyle’s driver, he was just a driver. Later, because Wyatt saved Kyle’s life, he was promoted to the manager of the southern new district.
In the eyes of outsiders, Wyatt was ‘the Gangster’ of the southern new district. The entire new southern district was managed by Wyatt alone.
Kyle’s position in the company was the general manager, so in the eyes of outsiders, Kyle was the real boss of Porthampton. Almost all the places in Porthampton were under his control.
Wyatt originally thought that Kyle was already the boss of the company, but he didn’t expect that there was a boss above Kyle. That meant that Kyle had been working for Connor for so many years.
Connor was their boss, and his status was even higher than Kyle’s!
“Kyle, are you kidding me? How can Connor be the chairman of our company?” Wyatt stood on the spot and said shakily. The expression on his face was an indescribable shock!
“Do you think I’m joking with you?” Kyle looked at Wyatt and snorted.
Only now did Wyatt understand what Connor had meant!
The person Rachel saved today was not Connor, but Wyatt himself!
If Wyatt broke Connor’s leg, it would be the same as breaking his brother’s leg!
At the thought of this, Wyatt’s legs couldn’t help but go soft, and he directly kneeled before Connor!
“What… What’s going on?”
Standing at the side, Wade seemed not to understand the current situation. When he saw Wyatt kneeling before Connor, he could not help but exclaim..

chapters.title: Chapter 183 - 183: Connor Was Kidnapped
chapters.content:
Chapter 183: Connor Was Kidnapped
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
“Wyatt, why are you kneeling to this loser?”
When Wade saw Wyatt kneeling before Connor, he immediately widened his eyes and shouted.
“You f*cking kneel too!”
When Wyatt heard Wade’s words, he felt his heart drop and hurriedly shouted at Wade.
“Why?”
Wade was stunned for a moment and asked in confusion.
“Smack!”
However, the answer he got was a slap from Wyatt. Wyatt slapped Wade hard on the face and shouted at the top of his lungs, “I told you to f*cking kneel. Didn’t you hear me?”
H j 11
“Smack!”
Wyatt raised his hand and slapped him again. Then, he widened his eyes and shouted, “Kneel!”
H 11
Wade stood on the spot and hesitated for two seconds before unwillingly kneeling before Connor.
Wyatt quickly kneeled and said to Connor in horror, “Mr. McDonald, it’s all my fault for not knowing that you’re the chairman of our company. If I had known, I wouldn’t have dared to touch you even if 1 had ten thousand guts!”
“Now you’re afraid?” Connor narrowed his eyes and asked Wyatt softly.
“I do… I know it now…” Wyatt quickly nodded.
“If it weren’t for Rachel, you wouldn’t even have the chance to kneel and apologize to me now. Do you understand?” Connor looked at Wyatt and continued.
“I… I understand!” Wyatt said in a panic.
“Alright, since you know you’re wrong, I won’t make things difficult for you!”
Connor had slapped Wyatt dozens of times in front of so many people today, so he didn’t want to continue arguing with Wyatt.
Although Connor knew that if he said the word, Kyle would immediately break Wyatt and Wade’s legs, Connor felt there was no need to do so. He didn’t want to waste time on an insignificant person like Wyatt.
“Mr. McDonald, it’s all my fault today. I was unaware of whom I was dealing with. 1 deserve to die!”
After hearing that Connor would not make things difficult for him, Wyatt did not intend to get up. Instead, he raised his hands and kept slapping his face.
“Alright, cut the act!” Connor saw Wyatt’s expression and waved his hand helplessly.
Wyatt quickly stopped what he was doing and looked up at Connor. He knew that since Connor didn’t come to take revenge on him, there must be something else.
“I’m here to tell you to return the shares you stole from Xena. Can you do that?” Connor asked Wyatt softly.
“Yes… I can do that!” After Wyatt heard Connor’s words, he nodded without thinking.
“Also, I can forgive you for what happened today, but from today onward, you will be responsible for the safety of Dusk. If anyone dares to cause trouble in Xena’s bar in the future, I will be the first to find you!” Connor looked at Wyatt and continued.
“Mr. McDonald, don’t worry. I’ll manage the bar well!” Wyatt said enthusiastically.
“Yes!”
Connor looked at Wyatt and nodded. Then, he stood up and walked out of the room.
Kyle respectfully followed behind Connor. Wyatt and Wade also hurriedly stood up to see Connor off.
As Connor was about to walk to the door, he suddenly turned around and looked at Wyatt. He said calmly, “I don’t want others to know my identity, so you’d better keep your mouth shut!”
H ii
Hearing that, Wyatt was stunned. Then, he nodded and said, “Mr… Mr. McDonald, don’t worry. 1 will never expose your identity!”
H ii
Connor looked at Wyatt expressionlessly and left the room without saying anything.
***
A few minutes later, Wyatt and Wade sent Connor and Kyle to the car.
Wyatt finally heaved a sigh of relief when he saw the car disappear into the street.
“Wade, who is Connor? Why are you so afraid of him?”
Wade was a fool. He didn’t understand what was happening.
“You still have the nerve to say that? Don’t you know how much trouble you caused me today?” Wyatt turned to look at Wade and shouted.
“What trouble did I cause?”
Wade was stunned as he asked with a puzzled expression.
H ii
Wyatt looked at Wade, and a hint of helplessness flashed across his face. He turned around and walked toward the neighborhood.
Wyatt felt it was already a blessing in disguise for him to be slapped dozens of times by Connor today. Connor was already very kind by not letting Kyle deal with him.
Who would have thought that a big shot like Connor would hide his identity and work as a waiter in a small bar?
Wyatt was like a mute who couldn’t even speak!
***
Meanwhile, in the Bentley.
“Mr. McDonald, are you going to let Wyatt off just like that?” Kyle hesitated and asked Connor softly.
“Yes, I don’t want to lower myself to the same level as this kind of person. Moreover, he’s someone from your company. If 1 let you cripple him, who will care for the southern new district? Besides, if you crippled Wyatt, it will be very difficult for you as the boss. So let’s forget it!” Connor replied expressionlessly.
He did not argue with Wyatt, not because he feared making things worse, but for Kyle’s sake.
“Thank you, Mr. McDonald!” Hearing that, Kyle was a little touched and replied softly.
“What’s there to thank? If you want to thank me, I should be the one thanking you. You’ve helped me a lot too!” Connor said lightly.
“I’m your bro, it’s only right for me to help you!” Kyle said with a smile.
H ii
When Connor heard this, he looked up at Kyle and smiled. Then he said softly, “Alright, send me home!”
“Sure!” Kyle quickly nodded.
***
Half an hour later, Kyle sent Connor to the entrance of Capstone district.
Connor was worried that others would see him with Kyle, so he didn’t let Kyle send him into the neighborhood. Instead, he got off at the entrance.
After entering the neighborhood, Connor walked toward the building where he lived.
“Thump thump thump…”
As Connor was about to enter the elevator door, he suddenly heard noisy footsteps behind him.
It was already two in the morning.
At this time, there was not even a ghost in the neighborhood. Suddenly, such rapid footsteps appeared. Connor was surprised and then subconsciously looked behind him.
“Bang!”
There was a loud bang.
Before Connor could see who was behind him, something hit Connor’s head.
Connor felt his vision turn black as he staggered and fell to the ground.
“Put it on him!”
At this moment, a voice sounded in Connor’s ear.
Immediately after, a sack was placed on Connor’s head.
Connor felt that breathing was a little difficult and fainted.
When the person who attacked saw Connor faint, he did not say anything else and carried Connor into a white van.
“Click clack, click clack!”
The sound of high heels hitting the floor was heard.
A sexy woman walked out from the corner of the building. The woman then got into the van with a smug smile..

chapters.title: Chapter 184 - 184: Why Don11 You Get A Man For Yourself?
chapters.content:
Chapter 184 - 184: Why Don11 You Get A Man For Yourself?
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
In Dusk.
To compensate for the impact of Connor and Wyatt’s incident on the customers, Xena announced that all the purchases tonight would be 50% off.
When the customers in the bar heard the news, they immediately called their friends over. This also led to another high in the bar’s business.
Xena and the waiters in the bar worked for nearly an hour before they sent the customers away.
“Xena, the business of your bar is quite good…”
Rachel poured a glass of red wine for Xena and said with a smile.
“It’s all because of you. You caused such a big hiatus in my bar…”
Xena took the glass of red wine from Rachel and said, “Rachel, why didn’t 1 know you are so powerful before? Even someone like Wyatt is afraid of you. If I had known you were so powerful, I wouldn’t have agreed to give Wyatt 10% of the shares!”
“Do you also want to know my identity?”
Rachel was lying on the sofa with her legs crossed. She gently swirled the red wine glass, looking extremely sexy.
“I’m not interested in your identity. Since you didn’t plan to tell me, there’s no point for me to ask now. You won’t tell me for sure!” Xena said.
H 11
Hearing that, Rachel couldn’t help but smile. Then, she stroked her hair and narrowed her eyes at Xena. “Do you know why I became friends with you?”
“Nope…” Xena shook her head.
“Because 1 think getting along with you is very easy!” Rachel said with a smile.
“Although I’m not very interested in your identity, I’m very interested in your relationship with Connor!” Xena said with a gossipy look.
“My relationship with Connor?”
When Rachel heard this, she could not help but be stunned. Then, she asked with a puzzled expression, “What relationship do 1 have with Connor?”
“Don’t try to fool me. When Connor was bullied today, I felt you were very angry. Moreover, the way you looked at Connor was also a little strange. I’ve never seen you look at others like this! So, what is your relationship with Connor? Did something unspeakable happen between the two of you?” Xena asked with a smile.
“Nonsense! Connor is my student. Moreover, I was the one who asked him to work part-time here. If Connor was bullied, I have to stand up for him…” Rachel hurriedly explained.
“That’s not right. I saw that how you looked at Connor today was not right!” Xena shook her head.
“Don’t let your imagination run wild. I feel that Connor is pitiful…”
“Pitiful?”
Xena was taken aback and asked, puzzled, “How is Connor pitiful?”
“You have no idea what happened in school. It’s pointless to tell you…” Rachel said indifferently.
“Are you sure you don’t have any funny thoughts about Connor? If you don’t, I’ll take it as a chance to make a move. Maybe one day, I’ll get Connor. By then, don’t be angry…” Xena licked her sexy red lips and said with a smile.
“You’re not interested in men at all. Stop lying to me!” Rachel replied in disdain.
“I have no interest in men, but 1 think Connor is different. Although he’s a little poor, he’s handsome and has a good personality,” Xena analyzed.
“Connor is too young and not suitable for you!” Rachel said directly.
“Is that suitable for you?” Xena asked with a smile.
“It’s not suitable for me either…”
Rachel gently shook her head, then looked at Xena and asked, “Alright, let’s not talk about Connor. How are your parents doing? Did they urge you to go on a blind date?”
“Of course they do. I told them I already have a boyfriend, so they don’t rush me anymore…” Xena said slowly.
“You have a boyfriend? Since when?” Rachel asked Xena with a confused expression.
“All, this is just a tactic to delay things. How can I have a boyfriend?”
When she said this, Xena’s eyes were a little evasive.
As she deliberately hid the matter with Connor. She didn’t want Rachel to know what happened between Connor and her.
Xena had always been a woman with a good sixth sense. She could feel that Rachel had some feelings toward Connor. She was worried that she would have a grudge if Rachel found out about her relationship with Connor.
“I think you should find a boyfriend and try things out. You can’t be single forever, right? If you’re always single, what if you have those thoughts?” Rachel said to Xena with an ambiguous look.
H H
After Xena heard that, she didn’t know why Connor suddenly appeared in her mind or the things she had done with Connor.
“I’m talking to you. Why are you in a daze?” Rachel frowned and asked when she saw that Xena was in a daze.
“I want to find a boyfriend I like, too, but I haven’t been able to meet the right one. What can I do?”
Xena tickled Rachel’s armpit and smiled, “Alright, let’s not talk about me. Aren’t you only twenty-seven years old now? Why don’t you get a man for yourself? Your good looks will be wasted if you don’t find a man.”
“How dare you joke with me about stuff like this?!”
Rachel quickly dodged Xena’s attack and reached out to touch Xena’s body.
In an instant, the private room was filled with lust.
“Ring, ring, ring…”
But at this moment, Xena’s phone suddenly rang.
“Alright, I won’t argue with you anymore. My phone is ringing!”
Xena squealed at Rachel, then quickly stood up and picked up her phone.
A strange look flashed in Xena’s beautiful eyes when she saw the number on the phone. She subconsciously turned to look at Rachel.
The person who called Xena was none other than Wyatt, who had just been chased out of the bar by Rachel!
“Why are you looking at me? Answer the phone!” Rachel tidied up her clothes and said indifferently.
H H
Xena looked at Rachel and hesitated. In the end, she tapped the answer button and answered the call.
“Ms…. Ms. Hart, are you free to speak now?”
After Xena answered the call, Wyatt greeted her nervously..

chapters.title: Chapter 185 - 185: I’ll Work For You For Free
chapters.content:
Chapter 185 - 185: I’ll Work For You For Free
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
“Yes. What is it? Speak!” Xena asked with a frown.
“Uhm, Ms. Hart, I’m sorry about what happened today. I thought about it and decided to return all the shares of your bar to you…” Wyatt knew Connor didn’t want to expose his identity, so he spoke tactfully.
H 11
Xena was surprised when she heard that. Then, her eyes widened as she asked, “Wyatt, what do you mean? The matter between you and Connor today has nothing to do with me, right? And the person who hit you was Connor. I didn’t provoke you. What do you mean by returning all the shares of the bar now? Who in the southern new district doesn’t know that if you have no shares in a bar, it won’t be able to continue operating? You’re doing this to shut my bar down, right?”
In fact, Xena had already guessed that Wyatt would do this.
After all, Wyatt was beaten up by a waiter in her bar today. Wyatt would feel embarrassed. However, he could not afford to offend Rachel, so he could only vent his anger on Xena.
At this moment, Xena felt that the reason Wyatt returned the shares of the bar to her was to tell Xena that she didn’t care about her bar anymore. ‘If there are any problems with her bar in the future, please don’t come to me for help.’
This was also why Xena turned to look at Rachel when she saw Wyatt calling her.
“Well, Ms. Hart, please don’t misunderstand me! I’m returning the shares to you, but it doesn’t mean that I won’t care about your bar in the future. In the future, as long as something happens to your bar, I’ll still care. Moreover, from tomorrow onward, I’ll personally go to your bar to take care of it, but I don’t want your shares in the bar anymore…” After hearing Xena’s words, Wyatt’s expression changed drastically, and he hurriedly explained nervously.
“Are you saying that you’ll return all the shares of the bar to me and that you’ll still care if something happens to my bar in the future?” Xena calmed herself down and asked, puzzled.
“Yes, yes, that’s right. That’s what 1 meant. Ms. Hart, don’t worry. In the future, your bar’s issues will be mine to bear. I will help you take care of the bar. 1 will not let anyone cause trouble in your bar…” Wyatt chuckled.
“Wyatt, what are you trying to do?” Xena was confused. She couldn’t understand why Wyatt would do that.
“Ms. Hart, I’ve already made myself clear to you! I’ll help you look after the bar in the future, but I don’t want the shares of the bar. I’ll bring the share transfer contract to you tomorrow!” Wyatt said.
“Uhm…” Xena was rendered speechless. Only now did she realize that Wyatt would work for her for free!
“Why would you do that?” Xena asked.
“There’s no reason…”
Wyatt smiled and said, “Alright, Ms. Hart, let’s talk about it tomorrow!”
After saying this, Wyatt hung up the phone.
Xena was confused.
“What’s wrong?” Rachel couldn’t help but ask after seeing the expression on Xena’s face.
“Rachel, did you ask Wyatt to return the shares to me?” Xena looked at Rachel and asked in confusion.
“How is that possible? Although Wyatt is afraid of me, I’m not powerful enough to make him return the shares to you. The shares of your bar are worth a lot of money, right?” Rachel replied indifferently.
“So why is Wyatt suddenly returning the shares to me?”
After Xena heard Rachel’s words, she became even more confused.
A strange look flashed across Rachel’s face. She hesitated but didn’t say anything to Xena.
***
Meanwhile…
After Connor was sent back to the neighborhood by Kyle, he was attacked by a group of people for no reason before he could enter the elevator. They even knocked him unconscious and took him to the van.
After being unconscious for nearly half an hour, Connor gradually woke up.
When Connor opened his eyes, he found that his vision was pitch-black. Someone must have covered his eyes with a black cloth.
However, Connor could feel that he should be in the car. From time to time, he could hear people talking.
“Who are you, people? Why did you kidnap me?”
Connor hesitated and shouted at the top of his lungs.
H ii
There was silence in the car. No one answered Connor’s question.
“What exactly are you doing? If you want money, I can give it to you now!”
After Connor realized that no one spoke, he struggled desperately.
“Thud!”
The young man sitting next to Connor clenched his fist and punched Connor’s stomach. He then growled, “You’d better be f*cking quiet. Otherwise, you’ll suffer…”
After Connor took the punch, he instantly became quiet. Then, he began to analyze in his mind who would kidnap him.
First of all, Connor felt that the person most likely to kidnap him should be the competitor that Thomas had told him about.
However, Connor felt that they should have killed him directly if the other party wanted to fight for the inheritance. There was no need to do anything unnecessary!
Therefore, Connor quickly rejected this idea.
‘Could someone have known my identity and wants to kidnap me for money?’
A bold idea instantly appeared in Connor’s minnd. Then, he recalled how many people knew his identity and had the courage to attack him.
“Screech!”
Not long after, the sound of a sudden brake was heard.
The car slowly stopped.
“We’re here. Get out of the car!”
The young man sitting next to Connor shouted at Connor, then dragged Connor out of the car.
“Hey, can you take off the blindfold on my face? It hurts when you press on my eyes…” Connor said.
“Cut the crap!” The young man slapped Connor’s head and brought him into a warehouse.
After entering the warehouse, Connor was tied to a chair with a rope.
“It’s finally settled!”
After tying Connor up, the young man let out a long sigh and sighed softly.
“Who are you? Why did you kidnap me?”
As Connor was still blindfolded, he had no idea what was happening.
“Connor, are you afraid?”
At this moment, a familiar voice spoke.
“Click clack, click clack!”
Then, there was the sound of high heels hitting the ground.
The woman approached Connor and reached out to pull off the blindfold over Connor’s eyes.
When Connor saw the woman before him, he was instantly stunned and in disbelief!
“How dare you?” Connor looked at the woman and shouted in shock.
“What’s wrong? Are you surprised to see me?” The woman’s lips curled into a playful smile..

chapters.title: Chapter 186 - 186: Wyatt Wolfhard Must Kneel Down Too
chapters.content:
Chapter 186: Wyatt Wolfhard Must Kneel Down Too
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
In an abandoned factory.
After the blindfold on Connor’s face was taken off by the kidnappers, he finally saw the woman in front of him clearly.
However, Connor never expected that the people who had kidnapped him were actually Mandy Hines, Brandon Guthrie, Brian White, and the others!
H H
Connor looked at Mandy, who was in front of him, with a helpless expression.
Because he really could not understand what Mandy, this stupid woman, wanted to do. Why did she kidnap him and bring him to such a place!
‘Do Mandy and Brandon already know my identity?’
Connor could not help but wonder to himself.
“So? Do you still dare to be so arrogant now? Was he so scared that he wet his pants?”
Mandy glanced at Connor’s pants as she spoke and asked him with a disdainful expression.
“Mandy Hines, are you crazy? Do you know that kidnapping is illegal? Do you want to go to jail?”
Connor’s eyes widened, and he shouted at Mandy with a dejected expression.
“Of course, I know kidnapping is illegal, but I didn’t kidnap you. 1 just wanted to bring you here to meet someone!” Mandy replied casually.
“Meet someone?”
When Connor heard Mandy’s words, he could not help but be stunned for a moment. He was even more puzzled.
“That’s right, meet someone!” Mandy looked at Connor and nodded gently.
“Who is it?”
Connor frowned and asked.
“You’ll know later!”
Mandy did not answer Connor’s question. Instead, she turned around and walked toward Brandon, Brian, and the others.
Connor looked at the retreating back of this stupid woman, Mandy Hines, and he was very speechless because he could not understand what she wanted to do to him.
At this time, there were five people in the factory. In addition to Brandon, Mandy, Lily Sullivan, there were two young men. Connor had never seen these two people before. They should be Brian’s underlings.
“Brother Brian, are you sure it’s okay to kidnap this kid? 1 heard that this kid seems to know a very powerful big shot. He even beat up Brother Wyatt and Brother Wade at the Dusk today!”
One of the underlings asked Brian softly after hesitating for a moment.
“That’s right, bro. Although we’re all gangsters, this is my first time kidnapping someone. What if this kid calls the police?” The other underling also chimed in.
“Call the police?”
After hearing this, Brian sneered disdainfully and then said expressionlessly, “This kid probably won’t have the chance to call the police…”
H H
After Connor heard Brian’s words, he could not help but be stunned. A touch of fear flashed in his eyes because he felt that Brian didn’t just want to kidnap him.
“What exactly do you want?”
Connor hesitated for a moment and shouted at the top of his lungs.
Brandon slowly got up and walked in front of Connor, then said to Connor with a smile, “Connor, it’s already this time. Don’t you know what we want to do? Looks like you’re really not smart enough!”
“Brandon, although the two of us have some conflicts in school, you don’t have to kidnap me because of this, right?”
Connor looked up at Brandon and shouted in a low voice.
“You’re right. I shouldn’t kidnap you just for that. Besides, 1 don’t have the guts to kidnap you!”
Brandon nodded gently and continued, “I thought that you wouldn’t have a good ending after offending Wyatt Wolfhard at the Dusk today. However, I didn’t expect Rachel Wallace, that b*tch, to suddenly appear. Also, Wyatt was a little afraid of her, so you escaped from a terrible ending. You even made a name for yourself in the bar and slapped Wyatt more than ten times in a row. You’re really too lucky…”
“What are you trying to say?”
Connor wasn’t in the mood to listen to Brandon’s nonsense and shouted expressionlessly.
“Connor, you offended Wyatt. With Wyatt’s character, he definitely won’t let you off. So, I just discussed it with Brother Brian. It’s better to do Wyatt a favor by kidnapping you, bringing you to him and letting him deal with you!”
Brandon sneered.
When Brandon was in the bar, after seeing Connor beat Wyatt up like that, he felt that Wyatt would definitely not let Connor go. At that time, he was just afraid of Rachel, so he did not dare to fight back. But after she left, Wyatt would definitely deal with Connor.
Therefore, after Brandon discussed with Brian, he wanted to kidnap Connor and do Wyatt a favor.
In this case, Brandon could not only take revenge on Connor, but also make Wyatt owe him a favor. It was simply killing two birds with one stone.
H H
Connor looked at the proud Brandon, and his heart fell.
Because he never thought that the two idiots, Brandon and Mandy, would kidnap him to do Wyatt a favor and let Wyatt take revenge on him!
At this time, Connor really didn’t know how to explain to Brandon and Mandy how he felt because he found this hilarious!
However, after Connor found out about Brandon and the other’s plan, he felt much more relaxed.
No matter what, he was most probably not in any danger now.
“Brandon, I advise you to let me go!”
Connor said to Brandon expressionlessly.
“Let you go? Connor, what are you thinking about? I went through so much trouble to kidnap you, how could 1 let you go? You should just stay here obediently and wait for Brother Wyatt to come! When the time comes, you’ll definitely suffer…”
Brandon sneered.
“Brandon, do you believe that Wyatt will be so scared that he will kneel down when he sees me?”
Connor said to Brandon expressionlessly.
“You’re still in the mood to act tough at a time like this? You’re lucky that Wyatt didn’t break your legs…”
After Mandy heard Connor’s words, she sneered with a disdainful expression.
“Today, 1 slapped Wyatt more than ten times, but he didn’t dare to retaliate. Do you think he still dares to take revenge on me?” Connor said lightly.
“Today, Wyatt didn’t dare to fight back because Rachel Wallace was there, not because he was afraid of you. Now that she isn’t here, you’re just a loser who delivers food, why would Wyatt be afraid of you?”
Mandy shouted at Connor in disdain.
H ii
Connor looked at Mandy and shook his head helplessly. He knew that no matter what he said now, she would not believe him.
Therefore, he simply shut his mouth and waited quietly for Wyatt to come.
“Brandon, are you sure this kid has nothing to do with that woman? When the time comes, don’t cause me any trouble!”
At this time, Brian suddenly shouted at Brandon. His IQ.was obviously higher than both Brandon and Mandy. He was afraid that he would provoke someone he shouldn’t.
“Brother Brian, don’t worry. Rachel Wallace is our university’s counselor. Although I don’t know why Brother Wyatt is afraid of her, I know that this kid has absolutely nothing to do with her. Hurry up and call Brother Wyatt and ask him to come over…” Brandon replied casually.
In his eyes, Rachel had saved Connor today because they were teacher and student.
“Alright, then!”
Brian helplessly agreed, then took out his mobile phone and dialed Wyatt’s phone.
Mandy and Brandon looked at Connor with smug expressions. They felt that Connor would definitely not be able to escape today..

chapters.title: Chapter 187 - 187: Do You Dare to Bet With Me?
chapters.content:
Chapter 187: Do You Dare to Bet With Me?
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
In the abandoned factory.
Brian took out his mobile phone and dialed Wyatt Wolfhard’s number.
“Beep, beep, beep…”
The phone rang twice before Wyatt picked it up. He shouted impatiently, “Who is it, calling me so late at night!”
Connor’s incident today had dealt a huge blow to Wyatt, and his mood was very unstable.
“Brother Wyatt, it’s me, Brian…”
Brian knew why Wyatt was in a bad mood, so he replied in a low voice.
“I know it’s you. If you have something to say, say it quickly. Don’t spout nonsense!”
Wyatt shouted.
“Brother Wyatt, I’ve prepared a gift for you. Can you come to my factory?” Brian deliberately kept Wyatt in suspense and didn’t tell him that he had kidnapped Connor to the factory.
Connor, on the other hand, looked at Brian expressionlessly and did not speak.
Since Brandon Guthrie and Mandy Hines were still unwilling to give up, then Connor would have them give up completely this time.
As long as Wyatt came over later, no matter how stupid the two of them were, they should be able to understand what was going on.
“Gift? What gift?”
Wyatt asked in confusion after hearing Brian’s words.
“Brother Wyatt, this matter can’t be explained in one or two sentences. You’d better come over quickly!” At this time, Brian had already begun to imagine how Wyatt would praise him when he saw Connor. Perhaps he would even give him a chance to watch.
“What the hell are you doing? Why are you being so mysterious?”
The more Wyatt listened, the more he felt that something was wrong.
“Brother Wyatt, you’ll know when you come over. I’ve prepared a big gift for you. You won’t be disappointed with this gift!” Brian shouted proudly.
“Are you sure you’re not joking around with me?” Wyatt asked in a low voice,
“Brother Wyatt, how would I dare to joke around with you?”
Brian replied with a smile.
“Alright, I’ll go over now. Just you wait!”
After Wyatt had finished speaking, he directly hung up the phone.
After Brian heard the busy tone on the other end of the phone, he turned his head to look at Connor with a very proud expression on his face.
“Connor, Brother Wyatt is coming over soon. Let’s see if you dare to be so arrogant then. Didn’t you say that Brother Wyatt will kneel down to you when he sees you? Then, I want to see how Brother Wyatt will kneel down to you!”
Brandon walked to Connor and said in an extremely arrogant tone.
“Then, you can just open your eyes wide and look!”
Connor looked at Brandon with a playful smile.
“Haha…”
After Brandon heard Connor’s words, he sneered disdainfully and then said expressionlessly, “Connor, oh, Connor, you’re still acting tough at this point? To be honest, I know so many people, but I’ve never seen someone like you. You’re already on the verge of death, but you’re still so stubborn. You’re really something!”
“If Wyatt sees that you’ve tied me up here, he will definitely kneel down before me without saying a word.”
Connor raised his eyebrows and told Brandon.
“Did you think I’d believe you? Stop bragging to me. Don’t you know what kind of person you are? If it weren’t for Rachel Wallace, Brother Wyatt would have broken your legs long ago. Do you really think you’re so great just because you won the lottery? Let me tell you, a loser is a loser. No matter how hard you struggle, you can’t change your lowly fate. You can’t change it in this lifetime!”
Brandon pointed at Connor and shouted excitedly.
“Then, why don’t we make a bet? If Wyatt doesn’t kneel down, you win. If he does, 1 win.”
Connor calmly asked Brandon.
“Alright, then what do you want to bet on?”
Brandon agreed without hesitation.
“What to bet on?”
Connor frowned and thought for a moment, then slowly said, “How about the two of us bet on Mandy?”
“You want to bet with me on Mandy?”
Brandon exclaimed with a playful expression, then he squinted at Connor and said, “Connor, I’ve already slept with Mandy. What’s the use of betting with me on Mandy now? What is there to it if you win the bet? Are you going to sleep with the woman that I’ve slept with so many times?”
“This has nothing to do with you. I want to bet with you on Mandy. If you lose, return her to me. If I lose, I will do whatever you ask me to do.” Connor raised his eyebrows and asked.
“Hehe, fine. I’m not afraid of you!”
Brandon replied confidently.
“Brandon Guthrie!”
Mandy didn’t expect Brandon to actually agree, so she quickly stepped forward and shouted.
“Come on, baby, don’t worry. I definitely won’t lose!”
Brandon turned his head to look at Mandy and said casually.
In fact, in Brandon’s eyes, Mandy was just a plaything. He treated her as an asset that would do his bidding.
Anyway, Brandon was a little tired of playing with Mandy, and he felt that he could not lose today, so he agreed to bet with Connor.
“Connor, you stinky loser. I knew you wouldn’t give up. How can you be so shameless? Who wants to be with you? Even if Brandon loses today, I won’t be with you. I’ll never be with a poor loser like you ever!”
Mandy was extremely ashamed and angry. She pointed at Connor and shouted loudly.
“Brandon, this bet is rather disobedient!”
Connor did not respond to Mandy but turned his head and said to Brandon.
“Mandy, what are you doing? Since Connor wants to play, then let’s play with him. Anyway, it’s not like the two of us can’t afford to play. If the two of us lose, then you get back together with Connor. If the two of us win, won’t you be able to humiliate Connor however you want?”
Brandon said to Mandy with a faint smile.
“But…”
Mandy opened her mouth to speak.
“But what? Don’t tell me you refuse to listen to me?”
Brandon shouted with his eyes wide open.
Mandy saw that Brandon was about to get angry, so she quickly pouted and said, “Alright, then I’ll gamble with you today. If Brandon loses today, I’ll reconcile with Connor!”
Connor looked at Mandy disdainfully and said softly, “Mandy, there’s actually one thing that I can’t understand. When we were together, I was obedient to you, but why do you keep making things difficult for me? Even if the two of us have already broken up, you don’t have to target me like this, right?”
“Hehe, I just don’t like you, okay? I just feel that since I’ve been with a loser like you before, it’s very embarrassing, so 1 just want to make things difficult for you. I just want to humiliate you. Do you have any objections?”
Mandy replied coldly.
“If I tell you now that I’m actually very rich, will you still choose to break up with me?”
Connor narrowed his eyes and asked Mandy.
“You’re very rich? Hahaha!”
When Mandy heard Connor’s words, she suddenly burst into laughter. She pointed at Connor and shouted, “Connor, are you dreaming? You’re just a delivery man. What kind of money do you have…”
H H
When Connor saw Mandy’s mocking look, he could not help but laugh bitterly deep down.
Bang! Bang! Bang!
At this moment, a series of urgent knocks came from outside the factory.
“Brother Wyatt is finally here!”
An excited look flashed across Brian’s face. He ran straight to the door and opened it.
“Brian, why did you ask me to come here in the middle of the night?”
Wyatt walked into the factory with a cigarette butt in his mouth and asked Brian impatiently..

chapters.title: Chapter 188 - 188: He’s Brother Kyle’s Boss?
chapters.content:
Chapter 188: He’s Brother Kyle’s Boss?
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
“Brother Wyatt, don’t be angry. Look who I caught for you!”
Brian smiled and pointed at Connor in the factory.
Wyatt subconsciously looked into the factory. When he saw Connor tied to the chair, he was instantly dumbfounded.
The cigarette butt that Wyatt had in his mouth fell to the ground.
“Brother Wyatt, I know that you have a conflict with this kid, so I specially rushed to this kid’s residence today and captured him. Now that there are no outsiders here, you…”
Before Brian could finish his sentence, he suddenly felt that Wyatt seemed to have become shorter.
Thud!
Wyatt’s legs went weak, and he couldn’t help but kneel on the ground.
After Brandon and Mandy saw Wyatt really kneel in front of Connor, they were utterly shocked, and they were a little dazed.
“What… What’s going on?”
Brandon stuttered. He couldn’t understand why Wyatt would kneel down just as Connor had said.
“Brother Wyatt, why are you kneeling? Did you collapse because of your anger? You must be so angry that your legs have gone weak…”
Brian had yet to figure out what was going on and reached out to help Wyatt up.
“Get lost!”
Wyatt turned his head and shouted at Brian. Then, he moved his knees and crawled in front of Connor. He stuttered, “Mr… Mr. McDonald, today’s incident really has nothing to do with me! 1 don’t know why these idiots kidnapped you… 1 really didn’t instruct them to do this. If you want to put the blame on someone, put it on them. It really has nothing to do with me!”
At this time, Wyatt’s face was twisted, and even his speech was somewhat incoherent.
As for Brandon, Brian, and Mandy, they stood rooted to the ground with stunned expressions on their faces.
They did not expect that Wyatt would suddenly become so afraid of Connor!
“What… What’s going on?”
Mandy’s eyes widened, and she looked at the scene in front of her with a dumbfounded expression.
She thought that Wyatt would teach Connor a lesson when he saw him, maybe even break his legs.
However, she never thought that Wyatt would have such a reaction after seeing Connor.
“Brother Wyatt, this kid has nothing to do with Rachel Wallace. I’ve already asked around for you. Why are you afraid of him?”
Brian seemed to be a little discontented. He took a step forward and shouted at Wyatt.
“Get the f*ck out of here. Do you know who Mr. McDonald is? Do you know what his background is? You must want to die really badly. How dare you kidnap Mr. McDonald!”
Wyatt roared at Brian.
At this moment, he was cursing Brian and his whole family.
Brian called to say that he wanted to give Wyatt a surprise. Wyatt didn’t expect it to be a f*cking surprise. He was almost scared to death!
Wyatt thought that Connor would forgive him if he returned the shares of the bar and then went to Xena Hart’s bar to take care of it himself.
But who would have thought that Brian, Brandon, and the others would actually kidnap Connor!
Wyatt was feeling tortured!
“Mr… Mr. McDonald?”
A trace of doubt flashed in Brian’s eyes.
“When did Connor become Mr. McDonald?” Mandy also muttered softly.
“Brian, do you want to f*cking die? Do you know who Mr. McDonald is? He’s the chairman of our company and also Brother Kyle’s boss. You actually dared to kidnap Brother Kyle’s boss?” Wyatt said as he ran to Connor and began to untie him.
“He… He’s Brother Kyle’s boss?”
After hearing Wyatt’s words, Brian was stunned for a couple of seconds. Then, he felt his vision go black, and his legs went soft, and he fell to the ground.
Brandon’s legs also began to tremble slightly. He was very clear who Wyatt was talking about. After all, there was only one Brother Kyle in the entire Porthampton!
Kyle Hayes was already a powerful existence in Porthampton. If Connor was Kyle’s boss, how terrifying would he be?
Brandon didn’t even dare to think about it now!
Mandy stood rooted to the ground and was so shocked that she felt dizzy. She couldn’t understand how this loser ex-boyfriend in front of her had become the boss of a big shot like Kyle Hayes.
Not to mention being Kyle Hayes’s boss, even if Connor was Kyle’s shoe carrier, Mandy didn’t think Connor was worthy of it.
“Brother… Brother Wyatt, are you joking with me?”
Brian kneeled on the ground and shouted at Wyatt while trembling.
“Do you think I’m joking with you?”
Wyatt shouted with his eyes wide open.
After hearing this, Brian was completely dumbfounded.
At this time, Wyatt’s reaction was obviously telling Brian that he was not joking at all. Otherwise, he would not be so nervous.
“I’m done for. I’m really done for this time…”
Brian knelt on the ground and shouted with a trembling voice.
As for Brandon and Mandy, they stood rooted to the ground with their mouths agape, unable to speak.
A few seconds later, Wyatt untied the rope on Connor’s body and said to Connor with a very respectful expression, “Mr. McDonald, how do you plan to deal with these three people? Do you want to break their legs or throw them into the river to feed the fish?”
Thud!
After Brandon heard Wyatt’s words, he directly knelt on the ground.
Wyatt and Kyle were people that even Brandon’s father didn’t dare to offend.
However, today, he had actually provoked them. Brandon knew that as long as Connor nodded, Wyatt would definitely ask someone to throw him into the river.
“Connor… Connor, I… I beg you, let me go. I beg you…”
At this time, Brandon felt fear in his heart and said to Connor.
Connor turned his head and looked at Brandon coldly, the expression on his face was very calm.
However, with just one look, Brandon was so scared that he peed his pants, and his entire crotch became wet.
“Brandon, in my eyes, you have always been an insignificant trash, but you have provoked me again and again. Do you really think that 1 don’t dare to take revenge on you? What good will it do you to anger me?”
Connor shouted at Brandon coldly.
“Connor, I was wrong. Can you give me a chance? 1 beg you…” Brandon knelt in front of Connor and begged.
Connor hesitated for a moment, then reached out and grabbed Brandon’s hair, then said in a cold tone, “From today onward, don’t ever let me see your face again. Do you understand me?”
“I understand! 1 understand!”
Brandon quickly nodded.
“Get lost!”
Connor said lightly.
After Brandon heard this, he hurriedly ran out of the factory, leaving a urine stain on the ground.
After Brian saw Brandon leave, he opened his mouth and wanted to talk to Connor.
However, Connor did not have any deep hatred for Brian, so he said, “Get lost. Don’t let me see you again!”
“Thank… Thank you, Mr. McDonald. I’ll leave right now!”
Brian said to Connor as if he had been relieved of a heavy burden, and then he left the factory.
At this moment, only Connor, Wyatt and Mandy were left in the factory.
Mandy was stunned on the spot. She looked at Connor in a daze and felt that everything was too unbelievable..

chapters.title: Chapter 189 - 189: The Shameless Mandy Hines
chapters.content:
Chapter 189: The Shameless Mandy Hines
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
In the abandoned factory.
Brandon, Mandy, and Brian kidnapped Connor and brought him here. They wanted to give Connor to Wyatt so that he could teach Connor a lesson.
However, the three of them didn’t think that Wyatt would kneel down in front of Connor after seeing him.
Moreover, Wyatt even said that Connor was Kyle Hayes’s boss!
Kyle Hayes was a well-known figure in Porthampton. If someone heard his name being mentioned, they would be shocked.
But now, Wyatt actually said that Connor was Kyle’s boss. How terrifying was Connor?
After Brandon learned of Connor’s true identity, his forehead broke out in cold sweat.
Because he finally understood how stupid his actions of provoking Connor were.
Mandy’s mouth was agape as she stood rooted to the ground. Her large, watery eyes were filled with shock as she looked at Connor, who was sitting on the sofa.
Although Mandy still couldn’t believe that Connor was actually Kyle’s boss, she had to admit this unbelievable fact through Wyatt’s reaction.
At this moment, Connor was also looking at Mandy with narrowed eyes. He felt very uncomfortable.
A woman whom he once treated like a goddess had betrayed him for no reason. After breaking up, she went against him everywhere, humiliating and mocking him.
It was as if in Mandy’s eyes, Connor would only be a poor loser who delivered food for the rest of his life. It was impossible for him to have a chance to turn things around, and it was impossible for him to find a girlfriend who was better than himself.
“Mandy Hines!”
Connor called out slowly.
Thud!
When Mandy heard Connor call her name, her legs went weak, and she involuntarily collapsed on the ground.
At this moment, she no longer had the domineering aura from before. She looked like she was at the mercy of the king.
“Connor… Connor, you… Who exactly are you?”
Mandy stuttered as she asked Connor.
“What does my identity have to do with you?”
Connor replied expressionlessly.
“You… You’re not Kyle Hayes’s boss, right? Wyatt is just someone you found to put on a show, right?”
Mandy shouted at Connor.
“Put on a show?”
When Wyatt heard Mandy’s words, he couldn’t help but sneer. Then, he looked at her and said, “Let me tell you, Mr. McDonald is not only Brother Kyle’s boss, but also the chairman of the Empire World Corporation in Porthampton. Mr. McDonald holds shares in most of the top 500 companies in Oprana. Mr. McDonald has trillions of assets. Do you think Mr. McDonald is so bored that he would put on a show for someone like you?”
In fact, Wyatt didn’t know much about Connor’s identity. What he said was just his speculation.
Even a simple estimate of Connor’s assets was already in the trillions. However, for someone like Mandy, it was shocking enough to have assets of more than 100 million, let alone trillions!
“Connor… Connor’s assets are worth trillions?”
Mandy looked at the expression on Connor’s face and was extremely shocked. She never dreamed that Connor would suddenly become a wealthy second-generation heir overnight!
Mandy found it hard to accept this fact. She pinched herself hard. The clear pain told her that she was not dreaming!
“This is impossible!”
Mandy shouted, then pointed at Connor and said, “I was with Connor for three years. How could 1 not know what kind of person he is? He isn’t a rich second-generation heir. He’s just a poor loser, a poor loser who delivers food!” “You’re right. I was indeed a poor loser before, but even an ugly duckling can turn into a beautiful swan, let alone a person!”
Connor slowly said to Mandy.
“Connor, where did you get this money from? How do you know someone like Kyle Hayes? What’s going on?”
Mandy shouted at Connor as she broke down.
“Why should I explain these things to you?”
Connor narrowed his eyes and replied softly.
H 11
Mandy hesitated for a while before she suddenly calmed down.
She knew that there was no need for Connor to lie to her. At this moment, Wyatt’s attitude toward Connor, as well as how he had changed at school during this period of time, seemed to indicate that Connor was no longer the same Connor from before!
Connor might have always been a wealthy second-generation heir, but he was just pretending to be someone else.
Mandy finally realized how stupid it was to break up with Connor and choose to be with Brandon.
However, Mandy felt that there might still be room for redemption now!
“Connor, I’m sorry… I was wrong before. I beg you to forgive me!”
Mandy instantly became a different person as she called out to Connor affectionately.
Connor couldn’t help but laugh when he heard Mandy’s words. Then, he looked at her playfully. He wanted to see what this woman would say next.
“Connor, I know I was wrong. Please forgive me! Didn’t you make a bet with Brandon just now? As long as Wyatt kneels down to you, you will win, and I will have to be with you, right?”
Mandy suddenly remembered what Connor had said to Brandon, so she felt that even if Connor had become a wealthy second-generation heir, he still loved her. Otherwise, Connor would never have made a bet with Brandon.
Although Brandon was also a rich second-generation heir, compared to Connor, he was simply insignificant!
If Mandy broke up with Brandon now and then returned to Connor’s side, it would be a blessing in disguise for her.
“Yes, I did make a bet with Brandon!”
Connor looked at Mandy and nodded gently.
When Mandy heard this, she was ecstatic because Connor’s reaction told her that Connor might still like her.
“Connor, aren’t you doing this because you want to be with me again? I know I was wrong. Let’s get back together! I swear that I will never betray you again in this life. I will always be by your side…”
Mandy took a step forward and exclaimed affectionately.
“Will you always be by my side? You won’t betray me?”
Connor couldn’t help but laugh when he heard Mandys’s words.
“That’s right, I’ll always be with you. I’ll only be good to you! I’ve already thought it through. Actually, Connor, you’re my true love. I’ve always loved you. It was Brandon who forced me to leave you. I didn’t want to be with him at all!”
Mandy shouted excitedly.
“Didn’t you tell me that you wanted to be with Brandon?”
Connor said to Mandy playfully.
“I… I didn’t do it willingly. It was Brandon who forced me to do it. Moreover, the things that you were framed of doing were also done by Brandon. Connor, you don’t know how hurt I was when I saw him bullying you, but I had no choice because I knew that the two of us were not his opponents. 1 chose to break up with you because I was actually protecting you!”
Mandy shouted at Connor.
Even Wyatt, who was beside Connor, couldn’t help but laugh when he heard Mandy’s words. This woman was really shameless..

chapters.title: Chapter 190 - 190: The Woman Who Abandoned Her Dignity
chapters.content:
Chapter 190: The Woman Who Abandoned Her Dignity
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
“Connor, I know you’re still angry with me, but I’m being sincere. Can you give me another chance? Let’s get back together, okay?”
Mandy crawled toward Connor and hugged his thigh tightly.
Connor looked at Mandy and hesitated for a while, then said softly, “Alright, I can get back together with you!”
When Wyatt Wolfhard and Mandy heard Connor’s words, they were instantly stunned. They were extremely shocked!
Because neither of them expected that Connor would really agree to get back together with Mandy!
Wyatt stood rooted to the ground with a puzzled expression on his face. He couldn’t understand why Connor wanted to get back together with a woman like Mandy Hines!
“Connor, is what you said true? Are you really going to get back together with me?”
Mandy asked Connor excitedly.
“Of course, it’s true!”
Connor nodded again; his expression very calm.
After Mandy heard Connor’s words, she was extremely excited.
She never thought that Connor would reconcile with her so easily!
‘This Connor is indeed a loser. He actually agreed to reconcile with me so easily. If it were me, 1 would have put forth some excessive conditions. But this is good. Although 1 have already broken up with Brandon, a second-generation rich kid like him is nothing in front of Connor. 1 didn’t expect that I would actually benefit from this disaster and become the girlfriend of a wealthy second-generation kid!”
Mandy couldn’t help but snicker deep down. Then, she wiped the tears on her face and walked to Connor. She said pitifully, “Connor, after so many days, 1 finally understand. The person I love the most has always been you. I chose to break up with you back then so that Brandon wouldn’t hurt you…”
“Is that so?”
Connor turned to look at Mandy and asked.
“That’s right, I chose to be with Brandon to protect you. If I didn’t agree with him, he would never let you go!”
Mandy paused for a moment, then leaned into Connor’s arms with a sly smile and continued, “But now, all these unpleasant things have passed. I’ve returned to your side. 1 promise that I’ll never leave you again. 1’11 serve you well for the rest of my life!”
“Are you planning to serve me for the rest of your life, or are you planning to serve my money for the rest of your life?”
Connor asked Mandy with a faint smile.
“What… What do you mean? Of course 1 want to serve you for the rest of my life. Am I such a materialistic woman in your eyes? Didn’t 1 get together with you when you had no money?”
Mandy was stunned for a moment and quickly retorted.
“Oh!”
Connor nodded gently and pushed Mandy away from his arms.
“Connor, what’s wrong? It wasn’t easy for the two of us to get back together. Don’t you want to be intimate with me?”
Mandy seemed to want to lean closer to Connor.
When Connor saw Mandy like this, he did not even think about it and directly slapped her face.
Smack!
There was a loud crisp sound.
Mandy cried out and fell to the ground.
This slap contained all of Connor’s hatred for Mandy during this period of time.
Connor knew that if it was not because he had inherited trillions of assets and had the help of Kyle Hayes and Thomas Morgan, he would have already been played to death by Mandy.
Regardless of whether it was when she framed Connor for stealing or Wyatt’s incident today, Mandy was determined to kill Connor. He couldn’t understand why she was so vicious and why she wanted to kill him.
Back then, in order to support Mandy and satisfy her vanity, Connor worked hard to deliver food. Even if he only ate one meal a day, he would buy her a set of cosmetics that she liked.
Connor had given up everything for Mandy, but in exchange, he only got her betrayal and toying.
However, at this time, Mandy actually wanted to get back together with him because of money. Connor felt that she was simply disgusting.
“Connor, why did you hit me? Did I do something wrong?”
After Mandy was slapped, she did not dare to lose her temper at Connor. Instead, she looked at Connor with an aggrieved expression and asked.
“Aren’t women like you asking for a beating? Do you have any objections if I hit you?”
Connor asked Mandy expressionlessly.
When Mandy heard this, she couldn’t help but be stunned for a moment. Then, she quickly said, “You’re right. 1 deserve it. If you haven’t vented enough, you can continue hitting me!””
H ii
Connor looked at Mandy, who was close to going crazy for money, and felt very helpless. He finally understood why some women could give up their dignity for money.
Because people like them had no dignity at all!
“Mandy, let me tell you this. The more you act like this, the more disgusted I feel. I have never hit a woman, but I gave you that slap just now. I just wanted you to remember it and stop pestering me in the future.”
Connor looked at Mandy and said.
“Connor, what do you mean? Didn’t you say you wanted to get back together with me? Why did you hit me?”
Mandy shouted anxiously.
“We did get back together just now, but now, I’ve dumped you, so please don’t pester me again in the future. We are nothing to each other from now on, you understand?”
Connor replied in a low voice.
“Connor, are you kidding me? Since you don’t want to be with me, why did you still get back together with me?”
Mandy shouted in a crazed manner.
“Kidding?”
After Connor heard Mandy’s words, he couldn’t help but sneer. Then, he said in a playful tone, “Mandy, you think too highly of yourself. From the moment you betrayed me, 1 no longer have you in my eyes. Every time 1 see you, I feel disgusted!”
“If that’s the case, then why did you get back together with me? Why did you still bet with Brandon?”
Mandy asked Connor coldly.
“I made a bet with Brandon to let you know that to him, you’re just a plaything. And I got back together with you to let you know that to me, you’re nothing. I can win you back with money now, and I can also abandon you at will. To me, you’re no longer important.”
Connor said to Mandy expressionlessly.
“I… I understand…”
Mandy was stunned and replied with a dazed expression.
“From today onward, 1 don’t want to see you appear in front of me again. Don’t pester me again in the future, or 1’11 definitely not be polite to you!”
Connor revealed his dominance and said to Mandy word by word.
Mandy looked at Connor in front of her and suddenly felt a chill run down her spine. She realized that Connor was no longer the same Connor from before!
“Connor, you will regret this!”
Mandy gritted her teeth and said to Connor.
“Regret? Regret not getting back together with you?”
Connor asked Mandy expressionlessly.
“You’ll regret it sooner or later. Since you made things difficult for me, I won’t let you off either!”
Mandy shouted at Connor with a crazy expression.
When Connor saw Mandy like this, he could not help but sneer. Then, he turned around and walked out of the factory.
Wyatt glanced at Mandy indifferently and then left with Connor.
“Connor, I will definitely make you regret it…”
Mandy shouted with a gloomy expression after seeing Connor leave..

chapters.title: Chapter 191 - 191: The Beautiful Yelena
chapters.content:
Chapter 191: The Beautiful Yelena
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
On the other side, after seeing Connor walk out of the factory, Wyatt also hurriedly ran out, then said in a very respectful tone, “Young Master McDonald, do you want me to drive you back?”
“No need. I want to be alone!” Connor replied indifferently.
“Oh…Alright then!”
Wyatt nodded lightly and walked away tactfully. He did not continue to follow Connor.
Connor walked alone on the street, looking at the neon lights flashing in the skyscrapers. His heart felt inexplicably empty.
Perhaps it was because he had completely revealed his identity to Mandy today, so the big stone that had been weighing on his heart had finally been lifted.
After taking revenge on Mandy and Brandon, Connor did not feel a trace of happiness at all, but rather helplessness; he was well aware the only reason he could step on Mandy and Brandon was that he had inexplicably inherited that inheritance, not because of his own efforts.
“Hah…”
Connor heaved a heavy sigh of relief and then walked towards his home.
“Beep beep beep!”
However, at this moment, a car horn suddenly sounded behind him. Connor instinctively froze for a moment, then turned around and saw a Maserati parked beside him.
The car window slowly rolled down, and a beautiful woman stuck her head out and waved at Connor, then shouted, “Get in the car and follow me home!”
Connor looked at the girl’s pretty face, and a trace of doubt flashed in his eyes. He frowned and asked, “Do you know me?”
“Nope!” the beauty replied.
“Then why are you asking me to go home with you?” Connor’s expression became even more puzzled when he heard the beautiful woman’s words.
The beauty hesitated for a moment before speaking to Connor. “I drank some wine at the bar just now, you see. I’m worried that I’ll be stopped by the traffic police later, so please drive me home. I’ll give you money…”
“O-Oh!”
Connor nodded lightly, then said with some difficulty, “Well, you should call a designated driver. I’m preparing to go home now!”
“It’s so late already, so where can I find a designated driver? Besides, my house is only a few kilometers away from here. I’ll give you 500 dollars, okay?”
The beautiful woman did look slightly tipsy. Under the illumination of the street lights, she looked particularly charming.
Connor stood there and hesitated for two seconds. He felt that if he let her drive back like this, he would feel bad if something really did happen , so he walked towards the Maserati.
When the beauty saw that Connor was about to get into the car, she quickly opened the door and got out.
After getting out of the car, Connor could clearly see her true appearance.
She had thick makeup on her face and wore revealing clothes—a low-cut T-shirt and very short jean shorts. Other than her alluring clothes, her extremely sexy appearance also gave her a great boost, making her look like a femme fatale. Her every frown and smile exuded charisma and sexiness, but also gave people a feeling of innocent charm.
The beautiful woman seemed to have drunk wine, and her face was flushed red. She looked very attractive.
“What are you waiting for? Hurry up and get in the car!” she shouted at Connor.
“Alright…”
After Connor heard this, he hurriedly replied, then directly opened the door and got into the car.
The beautiful woman returned to the front passenger seat. Her fair legs were slightly closed as she said to Connor with a charming expression, “Drive straight ahead, then turn right and drive for another kilometer!”
Connor didn’t say anything because his attention was completely attracted by the beauty’s peerless appearance.
Seeing that Connor did not answer her, the girl pouted and shouted, “Little man, why do you keep staring at me? Don’t tell me you’re thinking of taking advantage of me?”
“No… That’s not it…” Connor replied awkwardly, then started the car and drove forward.
“What’s your name? Have I seen you somewhere? Why do I feel that you look a little familiar?” The beauty turned her head and looked at Connor with a puzzled expression.
“My name is Connor McDonald!” Connor replied indifferently.
“I’ve never heard of this name!” The beauty shook her head gently.
Connor hesitated for a moment and asked the beautiful woman, “Then what’s your name?”
“Yelena Allen!”
When Connor heard this name, his eyes widened. He looked at her in disbelief and said, “Are you that Yelena Allen from Porthampton University?”
“Yeah? Do you know me?” Yelena asked lightly.
“It really is you!” Connor couldn’t help but exclaim when he heard the beauty’s answer. The expression on his face was even more shocked.
Yelena pouted and said, “I didn’t expect to be so famous for some random person to know who I am!”
When Connor first came to Porthampton University to study, he had heard others talk about Yelena. It was said that she was the number one campus belle of Porthampton University. Moreover, she was an internet celebrity with more than five million fans on Tiktok.
“I’m a junior at Porthampton University. I’ve heard about you before and that that you’re an internet celebrity!” Connor said to Yelena with a smile.
“What internet celebrity? That’s just what my fans call me,” Yelena said to him.
“Uh….”
H 11
Connor subconsciously looked at Yelena and her slender legs. He could not help but sigh in his heart.” Isn’t this too wasteful?”
“So you better not have any ideas about me, understand?”
Yelena whispered to Connor.
“How could an internet celebrity like yourself mingle with an ordinary person like me? Besides, I don’t have any feelings for you. It’s just that your legs are quite good-looking!” Connor said expressionlessly.
“Then do you want to touch them?” Yelena asked Connor with an ambiguous expression.
“Uh…”
When Connor heard this, he was stunned again.
“Come on, say something. Do you want to?” Yelena asked in a seductive tone as she leaned towards Connor’s seat.
“Yes!”
Connor nodded honestly.
“Then work hard; when you have money in the future, you can play with a beauty like me however you want!” Yelena said casually.
Connor’s expression was one of helplessness. He’d thought that Yelena would let him touch her legs!
After a while, Connor sent Yelena back to the neighborhood where she lived. Then, Yelena tried to give him 500 dollars as promised, but Connor didn’t ask for money. Instead, he chose to add her on Facebook.
Yelena hesitated for a while and didn’t refuse his request, but reminded him not to have any ideas about her.
After adding each other on Facebook, Connor took a taxi home.
After a whole night, Connor went back home and fell asleep..

chapters.title: Chapter 192 - 192:I Didn’t Think You Were This Kind Of Person
chapters.content:
Chapter 192:I Didn’t Think You Were This Kind Of Person
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
The next day, at eight o’clock in the morning, Connor got up and washed up briefly before going to school to prepare for class.
When Connor walked into the classroom, he found that all the students in the classroom were looking at him strangely. However, he didn’t care too much because these students had always looked down on him, so they were always looking at him with a strange gaze.
After entering the classroom, Connor subconsciously looked at Brandon and Mandy.
Brandon didn’t come to class, but Mandy was still there. However, at this moment, she was lying on the table while May, Lily, and some other people were sitting beside her and talking about something.
Connor walked to his seat with a puzzled expression and found that Dominic and Spencer were also looking at him with a strange gaze. “No, why are you looking at me like that?”
Connor asked Dominic and Spencer in confusion.
At this moment, Dominic said, “The news about you and Mandy has spread!”
“About me and Mandy?” Connor asked in confusion.
“Well, you should take a look for yourself!” Dominic interjected helplessly. Then, he took out a large stack of photos from under the table and handed them to Connor.
Connor hesitated for a moment before taking them. When he saw the contents of the photo, he was instantly dumbfounded, an expression of utter shock on his face.
These photos were none other than photos of Connor and Mandy sleeping on a bed. Although the important parts were blurred out, the posture of the two people was very ambiguous. It was obvious what they were doing.
“Where did you get these photos?”
Connor gritted his teeth and whispered to Dominic.
“When I came to school for class this morning, I found that the school bulletin board was filled with photos of you and Mandy. Moreover, these photos are also in every classroom in our school. Spencer and 1 tried to collect them all this morning, but we only managed to collect a few. The rest should have been taken away by someone…” Dominic said to Connor with a helpless expression.
“Who the hell did this?”
Connor couldn’t help but curse in a low voice.
Now Connor finally understood why Mandy was crying on the table and why the students in the class were looking at him like that. It was all because of these photos!
However, Connor had never even kissed Mandy on the mouth, so how on earth could he have slept with her?
These photos weren’t real at all. It was obvious that someone wanted to use these photos to mess with Connor.
“Connor, you’re now very infamous in our school. Basically, all the classrooms have photos of the two of you!” Spencer said.
“That’s right, Con. Didn’t you tell me before that you never slept with Mandy? Then where did these photos come from?” Dominic also asked Connor in confusion.
“These photos are all fake! Can’t you see?”
Connor gritted his teeth and said in a low voice.
“Fake?”
When Spencer, Dominic and the others heard this, they were stunned. They all wore a look of puzzlement on their faces.
“How could I take such photos with Mandy? These photos were all photoshopped by someone else!” Connor shouted, feeling like he was about to collapse.
“Photoshopped? Connor, did you offend someone?” Spencer asked.
“I don’t know what’s going on either!” Connor said helplessly.
“Buzz!”
At this moment, Connor’s phone suddenly vibrated. He quickly took out his phone and saw that it was a Facebook message from Yelena.
“Little man, I didn’t expect you to be so powerful that you can cause such a huge commotion!”
After Yelena sent this message, she also sent a smirking emoji to Connor.
“Who the hell did this?”
Connor threw his phone on the table and said with an annoyed expression.
“You’d better think about whether you’ve offended someone recently!” Dominic said to Connor with some sympathy.
At this moment, Lily suddenly stood up and shouted, “Connor, 1 didn’t expect you to be this kind of person. You’re really too despicable!”
Connor was stunned for a moment and turned to ask Lily, “I’m despicable? How am I despicable?”
“Don’t you know how despicable you are? Mandy was really blind back then to be with someone like you!” Lily shouted.
“No, can’t you make yourself clear? What exactly happened to me? Why are you calling me despicable?” Connor asked with a gloomy face.
“You’re still playing dumb with me at a time like this? Weren’t you the one who spread these photos?” Lily said with her big watery eyes.
“Is there something wrong with your brain? Why would 1 post such photos? Stop bothering me!”
Connor really couldn’t figure out what Lily was thinking. Who would be so stupid as to spread their own nude photos? What good would this possibly do to him?
Even if Connor wanted to be famous, he wouldn’t use such a method to become famous, right?
“It’s because you wanted to get back together with Mandy, but she ignored you. You then used the photos to threaten her, but she would rather die than kowtow to you, so you spread these photos to the school and let everyone know that you slept with Mandy! This way, no one would dare to be with Mandy anymore, and Brandon will be so angry at these photos that he’ll leave the school. Why are you still putting on an act?!”
Lily pointed at Connor and shouted.
After Connor heard Lily’s words, he was suddenly a little dumbfounded. He did not know how to answer her.
“Connor, I didn’t expect you to be this kind of person. You’re really too despicable!”
“Yeah, as the saying goes, a happy reunion means a happy parting. Since the two of you have already broken up, why are you still pestering each other? Wouldn’t you ruin Mandy’s reputation by doing this?”
“I think this loser is a psychopath. Otherwise, why would he do such a thing?”
The students in the classroom started scolding Connor.
“These photos were photoshopped. Are you all crazy?” Connor shouted in despair.
“Do you have any evidence to prove that these photos were photoshopped?”
Lily looked at Connor and asked.
Connor hesitated for a moment before walking directly to Mandy and shouting at her, “Mandy, tell them, did the two of us sleep together? Are these photos fake?”
Mandy lay on the table and continued to sob without saying a word.
“Say something! We didn’t even sleep together…” Connor shouted at Mandy helplessly.
“Connor, I didn’t expect you to be such a person. What are you trying to do? You want to ruin my reputation before you’re satisfied?”
Mandy suddenly raised her head and shouted at Connor. After that, she ran out of the classroom without looking back. After Connor saw Mandy run away, he was stunned on the spot again.
When Lily saw Mandy run away, she shouted at Connor. “Connor, even Mandy has run away because of you. What else do you have to say? You must be the one who did this!”
The students in the classroom also glared angrily..

chapters.title: Chapter 193 - 193: There’s No Clearing His Name
chapters.content:
Chapter 193: There’s No Clearing His Name
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
“Buzz!”
At this moment, Connor’s phone rang again. When he picked up his phone and sawt the screen, he realized that it was Freya calling him.
Connor looked at Freya’s name flashing on the screen, and a hint of nervousness flashed across his face. Usually, she would never call him; if she was, it meant that something big had happened.
“It’s over. Did Freya receive those photos too?”
Connor muttered helplessly. His relationship with Freya had only eased a little after much difficulty. If she saw these photos now, there would be no clearing his name, not even if he jumped into a river.
Connor took a deep breath, then picked up his phone and ran out of the classroom, after which he answered the call.
“Hello, Connor!” Freya’s sweet voice rang out.
“Yes… Why did you call me?”
Connor asked nervously.
“What’s wrong? Can’t I call you if I have nothing to do?”
Freya replied jokingly.
When Connor heard Freya’s words, he couldn’t help but be stunned for a moment. A strange look flashed across his eyes. He felt that if Freya had seen those photos, she wouldn’t have spoken to him in such a tone.
“No, I’m so happy that you called me!” he quickly replied.
“Alright, I won’t talk to you anymore. Didn’t we agree to get our marriage certificate today? Where are you now? I’ll go and pick you up!” Freya said slowly.
When Connor heard this, he heaved a sigh of relief. It was fine as long as Freya did not see those photos.
“I’m at school now!” Connor said in a low voice.
“Are you free this afternoon? If you don’t have time, I can go and look for you in the afternoon!”
“I have time now. Come over quickly!”
“Alright, wait for me then. I’ll be there in ten minutes!” she replied softly.
“Alright!”
Connor nodded, then hung up the phone and turned around to return to the classroom.
“Connor, you still have the face to come back? People like you shouldn’t stay in the Porthampton University….”
When Lily saw Connor return to the classroom, she shouted excitedly at Connor.
Connor turned to look at Lily and did not say anything because he felt that he had no way to explain it to her now. Right now, he would go get his marriage certificate with Freya, then ask Kyle to investigate who did this.
Although Connor had offended many people recently, he felt that this matter was a little strange. He couldn’t figure out who was the idiot that would put a naked photo of him and Mandy up in the classrooms. What was the meaning of their doing this?
“Clack clack clack!”
At this moment, the sound of high heels could be heard from outside the classroom.
Rachel Wallace walked into the classroom.
When Connor saw Rachel, he suddenly remembered what happened in the bar.
In Connor’s eyes, she was just an ordinary Ms. Wallace. Other than her figure and appearance being a little sexier than the average teacher, there was nothing special about her.
However, after what happened last night, Connor’s impression of her had changed drastically. He knew that her identity was definitely not as simple as it seemed on the surface.
When the students in the classroom saw Rachel enter, they instantly fell silent.
Today, Rachel was dressed very nicely; she was wearing a short black dress that perfectly accentuated her beautiful curves. Her oval-shaped face was smooth and delicate, like a ripe apple that would lure people into taking a bite out of it. Her charming fox-like eyes exuded an intoxicating charm. Looking at the sexy and seductive counselor in front of them, the students in the class could not take their eyes off her.
At this time, Rachel walked up to the podium and shouted, “Connor, come out with me!”
After Connor heard this, he couldn’t help but be stunned for a moment. He secretly felt that something was wrong, but he still got up and followed Rachel out of the classroom.
After leaving the classroom, Rachel went to a place with no one around and asked Connor softly, “Connor, what happened between you and Mandy in those photos? Everyone in the school is talking about this now, you know?”
“Ms. Wallace, those photos are all fake. They were photoshopped by someone else. I broke up with Mandy a long time ago…” Connor said to Rachel with a helpless expression.
“Are those photos fake?”
When Rachel heard this, she could not help but be stunned for a moment. Then, she continued, “Alright, regardless of whether these photos are real or not, this incident will have a very bad impact on the school. You’d better behave yourself for the time being and stop causing trouble for me. I’m worried that the principal will come for you after finding out about this!”
“Yes, I know!” Connor nodded casually. He was not worried about the principal; after all, both Jesse and Dylan knew who he was. Even if Connor had really spread these photos, they would not dare to do anything to him.
Rachel looked at Connor and said, “Alright, then you can go back to class!”
“Ms. Wallace, can I take leave now?” Connor asked softly.
Rachel was stunned for a moment and asked, “Leave? Why do you want to take leave?”
“I need to go deal with some private matters…”
Connor did not know how to explain to Rachel that he was going to register his marriage with Freya, so he could only find an excuse to deal with it.
H H
Rachel hesitated for a moment before saying indifferently, “Alright, I’ll give you half a day off. It’s inevitable that you’ll be a little depressed after such a thing happens. Be careful when you take photos in the future!”
After saying that, Rachel turned around and walked towards the classroom.
Connor stood rooted to the ground and was stunned for a moment. Then, he shouted at the top of his voice, “Ms. Wallace, I already said that those photos were photoshopped!”
“Only a ghost would believe you!”
Rachel stuck out her tongue at Connor and replied very playfully.
H H
Connor was speechless as he looked at his back.
“Buzz!”
At this moment, Connor’s phone vibrated again. It was a message from Freya telling him that she was already at the school gate.
When Connor thought about how he would be able to register his marriage with Freya soon, his mood instantly improved. He hurriedly strode towards the school gate.
After a while, Connor made it to the school gate. After arriving, he saw Freya standing gracefully in front of a white BMW.
Today, Freya was wearing a white halter dress, exposing her snow-white neck. Against the white dress, she was as beautiful as a swan. She was wearing a pair of red high heels, making her look sexy and dignified, giving off a very pleasing feeling.
Compared to Rachel, Freya was a little less sexy and flirtatious, but was more elegant and dignified.
“Freya!”
Connor waved at Freya.
