Freya smiled when she heard him call for her. She then said softly, “I happened to be free today, so I thought I’d go with you to get my certificate. You’ve brought your household register and everything, right?”
Connor was stunned for a moment when he heard this, then awkwardly replied, “I still have my household register at home. Why don’t you accompany me back?”
“That works too!”
Freya nodded lightly and turned to enter the car.
However, at that moment, a gentle breeze blew past, and a piece of paper flew to Freya’s feet.
Freya instinctively lowered her head to take a look. However, when she saw the contents of the paper, she was instantly stunned.
Connor was also stunned because the piece of paper was a photo of him and Mandy.
“It can’t be such a coincidence, right?”
Connor said helplessly as a bitter smile crossed his face..

chapters.title: Chapter 194 - 194:I Can Help You Find the Mastermind
chapters.content:
Chapter 194:I Can Help You Find the Mastermind
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
At the entrance of Porthampton University.
Freya slowly bent down to pick up the photo on the ground. When she saw the contents of the photo, a look of shock flashed across her face. She then turned to look at Connor.
“Freya, I can explain. This photo was photoshopped by someone else. It’s not real at all…”
Connor had never imagined that things would be so coincidental. He had quite literally just met up with Freya, and somehow she’d already seen those photos.
When Freya called Connor in the morning, he hadn’t realized anything about the photos at all. Now that Connor and Mandy’s photos were all over the school, he should not have asked Freya to come over.
“Connor, you’ve really disappointed me. 1 didn’t expect you to be this kind of person!”
Freya’s big, watery eyes widened as she shouted at Connor.
Initially, after Freya experienced the company’s financing, she had already begun to slowly accept Connor’s existence. Although she did not have much love for Connor, she felt that she could first register her marriage with him, then the two of them would try to get to know each other slowly and see if they could live together.
After all, her parents were also in an arranged marriage. The two of them did not have any feelings for each other initially. Their feelings were slowly nurtured together after marriage.
Freya naively thought that as long as she got along well with Connor, she might be in a relationship as loving as her parents in the future.
However, Freya had never expected Connor to do such a thing.
“Freya, these photos are all fake. They were photoshopped to frame me!” Connor cried.
“Someone photoshopped it to frame you?” When Freya heard Connor’s words, she could not help but sneer. “Oh Connor, who do you think you are? Are you a superstar or a millionaire? You’re just a poor student from Porthampton University. Who would photoshop something just to frame you?”
H ii
Connor looked at Freya and was stunned for a moment. For a moment, he was speechless because he did not know how to answer Freya’s question.
In Freya’s eyes, Connor was just a poor student. There was no way someone would photoshop these photos just to frame him.
“A few days ago, Xiao Man said that she saw you go to a hotel with another woman. I thought it was just a misunderstanding, but now it seems that all of that was true. Connor, you really disappoint me.”
Freya saw that Connor did not say anything and thought that he had tacitly agreed to this matter. After she said her piece, she turned around and walked towards the BMW.
“Freya, can you listen to my explanation?”
Connor saw that Freya was about to leave and hurriedly stepped forward to grab her.
Freya turned her head and replied coldly, “Now that there’s conclusive evidence, what else do you have to explain?”
Then, with a disappointed expression, she said, “Connor, 1 thought that even though you were just a little poor, you still had a good personality in all aspects. I even thought that since you knew someone like Thomas Morgan, it meant that you were capable. 1 believed that you won’t be poor for your entire life, so I was willing to marry you, but I didn’t expect…”
“Didn’t expect…?” Connor asked.
“1 didn’t expect you to be so poor and have such a bad character. You actually spread photos of yourself sleeping with another woman all over the school. 1 really can’t accept such a thing.”
Freya gritted her teeth, then shook off Connor’s hand and turned around to walk into the distance.
Connor stood rooted to the ground in a daze. Looking at Freya’s departing figure, a look of despair appeared on his face. He had no idea how to explain this matter to her.
A moment later, Freya entered the BMW and disappeared from Connor’s sight.
As she drove the car, her emotions slowly went out of control. Tears kept flowing from her eyes. After all, she had already made preparations to marry Connor today. This meant that she had begun to slowly accept him.
However, who would have thought that she would encounter such a thing?
Ever since she was young, Freya had never been in a relationship because she had a very serious obsession with keeping herself pure. Therefore, after knowing that she was going to marry Connor, Freya had always been strict with herself and had never done anything to let Connor down.
But now, Connor was secretly fooling around with another woman behind her back, and on top of that, everyone in the school knew about it. She could not accept such a thing at all!
Connor stood alone at the entrance of the Porthampton University with a helpless expression on his face.
At this moment, his mind was blank. He didn’t know who he had offended, nor did he understand the purpose of the other party’s actions. Moreover, Connor couldn’t find any clues about this matter.
“Sigh, we were about to get our marriage certificate, but I didn’t expect to encounter such a thing!”
Connor sighed helplessly, the expression on his face broken.
At this moment, a voice came from behind him.
“Little man, I didn’t expect your girlfriend to be so pretty.”
After hearing this voice, Connor turned his head to take a look and found that it was the beautiful Internet celebrity, Yelena, that he met last night. She was walking towards him.
“Since you have such a beautiful girlfriend, why did you still fool around? Looks like men really are still animals with lower bodies. Good thing 1 don’t like men…”
Yelena quietly walked up to Connor and continued to taunt him.
“Are you here to make a fool of me?” he asked helplessly.
“I’m not that bored. I just happened to pass by!” Yelena replied indifferently and then continued, “You’re really something to spread such photos. What on earth were you thinking?”
“Those photos are all fake. They were all photoshopped by someone to frame me. Moreover, 1 was with that girl for three years, yet I never even kissed her on the lips!” Connor shouted at Yelena helplessly.
“Together for three years, but you never even kissed her on the lips?”
After Yelena heard Connor’s words, she could not help but be stunned for a moment. Then, she began to laugh loudly, and the expression on her face was one of mirth.
“What are you laughing at?”
Connor shouted at Yelena in frustration.
“Little man, aren’t you too naive? You were together for three years and never kissed…Wow, I really don’t know what to say about you!”
Yelena smiled. Connor looked at her indifferently. He was not in the mood to talk nonsense with her. He turned around and was about to walk into Porthampton University when she suddenly called out to him.
“Little man, if these photos were really photoshopped to frame you, 1 have a way to help you find the mastermind!”
After Connor heard Yelena’s words, he was stunned and asked with an excited expression, “Is what you said true?”
“Of course it’s true!”
Yelena nodded gently..

chapters.title: Chapter 195 - 195: Why Is It Her?
chapters.content:
Chapter 195: Why Is It Her?
Translator: End less Fantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Connor quickly ran to Yelena’s side and asked softly, “How will you help me find the mastermind?”
Yelena hesitated for a moment after hearing Connor’s words, then continued, “I can tell you how to find them, but you have to promise me one thing!”
“What is it? Hurry up and tell me!” Connor said anxiously.
“I haven’t thought of it yet, but I can’t help you for free. So, promise me one thing now. When I think of something to ask of you in the future, I’ll let you know,” Yelena said with a smile.
“Alright, alright, stop dawdling. Hurry up and tell me how to find that person!” Connor shouted anxiously.
Yelena glared at him. “Who do you think you’re talking to? Watch your attitude when you talk to me. I’m your savior now, I’m telling you…”
“Are you going to tell me or not?”
Connor was not in the mood to waste time with Yelena. He just wanted to find the mastermind behind this matter as soon as possible.
“Forget it. Seeing that you’re so pitiful, 1’11 tell you how to find that person!”
Yelena picked up a photo from the ground and looked at Connor. “Finding the mastermind is actually a simple matter; you just need to take this photo to the print shop near the school and ask about it. Because there are so many photos, there’s no way these were all printed privately, so the mastermind must’ve printed them in batches at a shop. Not only that, these photos are so exciting, so they’ll definitely have left a deep impression on the person in charge of printing them. They should be able to tell you who printed these photos. On top of that, most print shops now have surveillance cameras, so you can easily see who was behind this from the footage.”
“That’s right. Why didn’t I think of such a method?” Connor looked at Yelena in front of him, excited.
“You ordinary people have never experienced something like this before. Back when I was at the height of my popularity on Tiktok, some competitors photoshopped some photos of me and posted them everywhere with the aim of slandering me. 1 used this method to find out who it was, so I’m very experienced in dealing with these things. After all, there’s a lot of trouble when you’re famous!” Yelena replied with a smile.
“Thank you, I know what to do!” Connor said in a low voice. At this moment, Connor’s heart was filled with gratitude. After all, if he hadn’t gotten acquainted with Yelena yesterday, he really wouldn’t have thought of this method.
“Alright, I’ve already told you the method. As for whether you can find that printing shop, that’ll be up to you!”
Yelena waved at Connor, then turned around and walked into the school. After seeing her leave, Connor took out his phone and dialed Kyle’s number. He felt that getting Kyle to do this would be the most efficient.
Kyle’s power was basically all over Porthampton, and these photos must have been printed by someone Connor knew. The people Connor knew were also in Porthampton, so it shouldn’t be difficult to find this person.
Five minutes later, Kyle drove a Land Rover and slowly stopped in front of Connor.
Connor pulled open the car door and got inside.
Kyle turned his head and asked Connor with a smile, “Young Master McDonald, do you have any orders?”
Connor couldn’t help but be stunned when he heard this. He felt a bit uneasy; after all, he felt that he had troubled Kyle too many times recently. Connor also felt that after getting his inheritance, the troubles around him had begun to increase.
“I’m sorry for calling you out last night and today…” Connor whispered to Kyle.
Kyle forced a smile and replied, “Young Master McDonald, you’re being a little too polite. After all, the entire company is yours. I’m your employee; apart from helping you take care of the company’s matters, it’s also my duty to solve some of your private matters, so you don’t have to be polite with me!”
H H
Connor turned his head and looked at Kyle. He couldn’t think of any way to thank him. Kyle was of a high status, after all, nor did he lack money.
“Young Master McDonald, why did you call me out in such a hurry?” Kyle asked after some hesitation.
Connor took out the photo and handed it to him. Then, he said quietly, “1 need you to help me investigate which print shop printed these photos and who printed them!”
H ii
Kyle glanced at the photo and instantly understood what Connor meant. Then, he said quietly, “Alright, I know what to do!”
Connor squinted his eyes and asked, “How long do you need to investigate?”
“If I’m fast, it’ll take two to three hours. If not, it’ll take a day!” Kyle replied lightly.
“Alright, then quickly get your people to investigate. I’m going back to school for class. Call me when there are results!”
After Connor said this, he pushed open the car door and got out.
Kyle didn’t say anything else and drove away.
After separating from Kyle, Connor originally planned to return to the classroom to continue his lessons.
However, when he thought about the way the students in the classroom looked at him, he felt a little annoyed, so he turned around and walked towards his house.
When he got home, he locked himself in his room and played with his phone for a while.
After waiting for almost two hours, Kyle finally called him.
“How was it? Did you find that person?”
After Connor picked up the phone, he shouted excitedly.
Kyle had always been very meticulous, and he replied, “Yes, Young Master McDonald. We’ve found the printing shop. I’m now pulling out the surveillance footage!”
“Send it to me now!” Connor hurriedly shouted.
“Alright!” Kyle replied softly and then hung up.
Not long after, McDonald received a video from Kyle.
However, when he clicked on the video and saw the content, he was instantly stunned on the spot, his eyes filled with shock.
“Why is it her?”
Connor muttered softly, his face full of disbelief, because he really couldn’t understand why the person in question was doing this.
“Phew…”
Connor took a deep breath and walked out of the room with his phone.
No matter what, he had to clarify this matter today. Otherwise, Freya might continue to misunderstand..

chapters.title: Chapter 196 - 196: Catch the Pervert!
chapters.content:
Chapter 196: Catch the Pervert!
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
“Connor?”
Connor had just walked out of the room when he saw Mina walking out of the elevator with a package.
“What a coincidence! Did you just come back from outside?” Connor looked up at Mina and asked.
Today, Mina was dressed very seductively. She was wearing a body-hugging T-shirt that was tight around her chest as if her breasts were about to spill over. She wore a short black skirt that revealed her slender and fair legs, looking very attractive. On her delicate little feet was a pair of pink high-heeled sandals, making her look sexy and a little playful.
In Connor’s impression, Mina seemed to like wearing a miniskirt very much. Basically, other than wearing pajamas at home, she would wear miniskirts or hip shorts most of the time.
But thinking about it, the most perfect part of Mina’s body was her slender white legs. Her long legs, which were like chopsticks could be said to be the most beautiful legs that Connor had ever seen. It would be a waste if she didn’t show them off.
“That’s right!” Mina nodded.
“Well, I still have something to do, so I won’t chat with you anymore!”
Connor was not in the mood to admire Mina’s beautiful legs. After replying, he hurriedly walked toward the elevator.
“Are you alright? Why do you look so anxious?”
Mina saw something wrong with Connor’s behavior, so she quickly walked up to him and asked.
Connor was surprised and then whispered, “I’m fine. I have something to deal with!”
“Oh, oh!”
Mina nodded lightly. After a moment of hesitation, she bit her lip and said, “Connor, I saw photos of you and another girl downstairs in our neighborhood today. Are those photos real?”
When Connor heard Mina’s words, he was instantly dumbfounded.
He did not expect them to be so crazy. They did not even spare his place. Were they not just trying to push him into a dead end?

Connor narrowed his eyes and did not speak. He was thinking about how to resolve this matter.
“By the way, you should know my situation very well. My parents got divorced when I was in kindergarten, and I don’t have any relatives by my side, so you don’t have to think about using my relatives to threaten me. Either you get back together with me now, or I’ll pester you for the rest of your life. Think about it carefully!”
Mandy continued.
“You’re simply a lunatic!”
Connor gritted his teeth and replied in a low voice.
“That’s right, I’m a madman. I’m like this because you left me no choice!”
Mandy said to Connor while eating.
At this moment, Connor finally understood how important it was to hide his identity!
Once your identity was exposed, the huge amount of wealth would change the people around you. The trouble that would come from this would definitely not be less than when you were poor.
Connor was starting to regret it. He should not have let Brandon Guthrie and Mandy know his identity.
If Mandy didn’t know about his identity, she would at most find trouble with him for no reason. However, Mandy was no longer a problem, but a ticking time bomb.
“Connor, let’s get back together. Although I’m no longer clean, I’ll definitely be loyal to you. I’ll do whatever you want me to do. Moreover, I can tolerate you finding other women. No matter how many women you have outside, as long as you come home, 1 won’t meddle, okay?”
Mandy looked at Connor and said.
“Stop dreaming. Even if I were to be a bachelor for the rest of my life, 1 would never be with a woman like you!”
Connor replied coldly.
“Then, are you willing to let me haunt you for the rest of your life? I’m telling you, your life will be ruined!”
Mandy shouted maniacally.
H H
Connor looked at Mandy and did not say anything. He really could not do anything to her now.
After all, if Mandy continued to pester him, Freya Phillips would never be able to resolve her misunderstanding about Connor.
Connor wasn’t worried about what Mandy would do. He was only concerned about how he could explain this to Freya Phillips.
“Connor, if you really don’t want to be with me, it’s not impossible, but I have a condition. As long as you agree to this condition, I won’t disturb you anymore!”
At this moment, Mandy suddenly said to Connor.
“What condition?”
When Connor heard this, he could not help but be stunned for a moment.
“My condition is actually very simple. As long as you give me five million now, 1 won’t disturb you anymore!”
Mandy could feel from Connor’s attitude toward her that Connor would never get back together with her. Since Connor did not want to get back together, Mandy felt that she might as well be straightforward and ask Connor for money.
Anyway, Mandy had done so many things just to get some money from Connor. She had no feelings for Connor at all!
“Haha…”
When Connor heard Mandy’s words, he could not help but sneer.
It was only now that he finally understood. It turned out that Mandy still wanted money after going through so much trouble!
“I heard from Wyatt Wolfhard that you seem to be very rich now. Since you don’t want to get back together with me, then give me some money. As long as you give me five million, I’ll disappear from your sight immediately!”
Mandy looked at Connor and continued.
“Do you still have any shame?”
Connor gritted his teeth and asked Mandy in a low voice.
“Why would I have any? Shame can’t feed me. In this society, money is the most important thing!”
Mandy said calmly.
“Then, why should 1 give you five million?”
Connor shouted at Mandy coldly.
“Why? Just because you deliberately pretended to be poor in front of me and let me live a hard life for three years. This five million will be your breakup fee!” Mandy said confidently.
“Don’t forget that you were the one who said you wanted to break up with me back then. Why should 1 give you a breakup fee?”
Connor stood up and pointed at Mandy fiercely. “Mandy, you’d better stop dreaming. 1 won’t give you a single cent!”
He felt that Mandy was obviously threatening him now. Connor did not like this feeling.
“Alright, if you don’t give me the money, then I’ll continue to post photos of the two of us in school!”
Mandy said coldly.
“Hehe, if you want to do it, then do it! 1 don’t care!”
Connor looked at Mandy and smiled, then he walked out of the restaurant.
Mandy saw that Connor was really planning to leave, and a trace of panic flashed across her eyes. She did not expect Connor to be so cruel. He would rather let her continue to make a scene than give her money.
Mandy quickly stood up and shouted at Connor, “Connor, don’t think that I don’t know that you have a fiancee. If I tell your fiancee about the abortion, how do you think she will feel?”
After Connor heard Mandy’s words, he was instantly stunned, and he was extremely shocked.
Because he had never imagined that Mandy would actually know that he had a fiancee!
Not many people knew about the relationship between Connor and Freya, and no one in the school knew that Connor had a fiancee. So how did Mandy know?
Connor felt that with Mandy’s IQ, it was impossible for her to think of such a meticulous plan to deal with him.
He felt that there must be someone pulling the strings behind her.. Moreover, the other party should also know about Freya’s existence!

chapters.title: Chapter 202 - 202: Could It Be the Lee Family?
chapters.content:
Chapter 202: Could It Be the Lee Family?
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
“Who told you that i have a fiancee?”
Connor McDonald stepped forward and asked Mandy Hines.
“You don’t have to worry about that. The important thing is that i know you have a fiancee. Moreover, I also know that if you don’t marry your fiancee, you will lose all the wealth you have now!”
Mandy was indeed a stupid woman. She didn’t even think when she spoke.
Although she did not tell Connor how she knew that he had a fiancee, he could analyze who was behind Mandy’s words.
First of all, not many people knew about the relationship between Connor and Freya Phillips. Secondly, there were even fewer people who knew about the contents of the inheritance contract.
Therefore, the other party did not ask Mandy to do these things to help her. Instead, they hoped that she would destroy Connor’s relationship with Freya Phillips.
“Could it be the Lee Family?”
Connor felt that this matter was very likely instructed by the person who wanted to compete for the old chairman’s inheritance that Thomas Morgan told him about.
“Connor, if you don’t pay me, not only will I spread the photos of the two of us in school, but i will also show these photos to your fiancee. If you think the photos are not exciting enough, i can also forge a document proving that we aborted the child.”
Mandy knew that her words just now had an effect, so she said to Connor with a very proud expression.
Connor stood in the same spot and hesitated for a while. Then, he walked to Mandy and whispered, “You want money now, right?”
“That’s right, i want money!”
Mandy nodded gently.
“I can give you five million, but you have to tell me who told you that I have a fiancee!”
Connor said slowly.
When Mandy heard this, a trace of hesitation flashed across her face because the other party had asked her to keep this matter a secret.
“If you don’t tell me, 1’11 leave now!”
Connor turned around and wanted to leave.
“Connor, don’t go. I’ll tell you, okay?”
Mandy would do anything for money now, so she naturally would not abide by the previous agreement.
“Alright, go ahead!”
Connor nodded lightly and returned to his chair.
Mandy looked at Connor and hesitated for a moment, then said in a low voice, “Actually, I don’t know who the person who told me about this is, but last night, 1 suddenly received a phone call. The person told me about your relationship with Freya Phillips and asked me to do these things. He also said that if I don’t have a way to threaten you, 1 should use her to threaten you. He said you would definitely give in then.”
“Are you sure you don’t know who called you?”
Connor asked.
“I’ve already told you everything. Is there a need for me to hide his identity from you? 1 only know that the person who called me yesterday was a man, and it was a foreign number. When I called him today, the other party’s phone was turned off!”
Mandy looked at Connor and explained.
“Give me your phone!”
Connor hesitated for a moment and whispered to Mandy.
Mandy quickly took out her phone and handed it to Connor.
Connor took the phone and opened the call log. He saw that the other party was a York number.
“It’s indeed the Lee family!”
Connor sighed softly.
Thomas Morgan had told Connor that the Lee Family that wanted to compete with Connor for the inheritance was a big family in York.
“Connor, I’ve already told you everything. Can you give me the money now?”
Mandy bit her red lips and asked Connor.
Connor looked up at Mandy and said indifferently, “Mandy, do you think that you can have everything as long as you get this money from me?”
“Won’t I?”
Mandy asked softly.
“I can give you this money, but let me tell you this, even if you have this money, there are still many things that you can’t solve. You won’t be able to live the life you want!”
Connor said expressionlessly.
“Stop talking nonsense. You’d better hurry up and give me the money!”
Mandy saw that Connor had agreed and shouted with an anxious expression.
Connor felt that the expression on Mandy’s face at this time was really disgusting. He took out his mobile phone and dialed the bank manager Michael Page’s phone number.
“Beep, beep, beep…”
The phone rang twice before Michael picked up the call. Then, he said respectfully, “Mr. McDonald, how can 1 help you?”
“Withdraw five million in cash and send it to the Michelin restaurant. Then, give it to a woman named Mandy Hines!”
Connor said lightly.
“Alright, I’ll send it to you now!”
Michael quickly replied.
Connor hung up the phone directly, then turned to Mandy and asked, “Do you know how much five million in cash is?”
“How would 1 know that?”
When Mandy knew that she was about to get the money, she was in a very good mood. All she could think about now was how she should spend the five million later!
Connor looked at Mandy with a disdainful smile, then got up and wanted to leave.
He had already recorded the conversation between them using his phone. In addition to the apology letter that Lily Sullivan had written to him, these two pieces of evidence were enough to prove Connor’s innocence. Therefore, Connor wanted to find Freya to explain this matter clearly.
Mandy saw that Connor was about to leave, so she naturally did not ask him to stay. After all, she only wanted Connor’s money.
“Hubby, it was that loser who used money to slap my face just now. You have to help me teach him a lesson today!”
At this moment, two people suddenly walked into the restaurant.
One of them was the beautiful woman who had a conflict with Connor before.
There were five or six young men following behind the beauty. The young man in the front had an afro and was dressed in a strange way, giving people the feeling of a village punk.
The young man with the afro walked directly toward Connor.
When the security guard at the entrance of the restaurant saw that the situation was not right, he hurriedly blocked the young man’s way. Then, he smiled and asked the young man, “Brother, what’s going on?”
“Get lost! My wife was bullied by others. I’ll kill whoever stops me today!”
The afro guy shouted at the security guard with his eyes wide open.
“Brother, our restaurant doesn’t allow trouble. If you have to deal with this matter, can’t you settle it outside?”
The security guard said awkwardly.
“Pa!”
One of the underlings behind the afro guy reached out and grabbed the security guard’s collar. Then, he glared at him and shouted, “What? Didn’t you hear Brother Zill talking to you? He told you to get lost, didn’t you hear him? Don’t be a busybody. I’m telling you…”
The security guard hesitated for a while after hearing this, then he stood aside and did not dare to say anything.
The afro man, Brother Zill, swaggered in front of Connor, then raised his eyebrows and shouted at Connor, “You were the one who bullied my wife just now, right?”

chapters.title: Chapter 203 - 203: Kneel Down and Apologize
chapters.content:
Chapter 203: Kneel Down and Apologize
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
“Yes, what’s the matter?”
Connor McDonald looked at the afro with disdain and asked calmly.
“You’re quite arrogant, kid. You actually used money to slap my wife’s face!”
Brother Zill shouted and pointed at Connor’s nose. “You’re rich, aren’t you?”
“Not bad, richer than you!”
Connor nodded expressionlessly.
“You… you’re richer than me?”
After hearing Connor’s words, Brother Zill with the afro burst out laughing. He then turned to the girl beside him and asked, “Baby, did you hear what this kid said just now? He actually said he’s richer than me! Hahaha…”
“He really doesn’t know the immensity of heaven and earth. Look at how poor he is. He probably has to spend a month’s salary to come to a Michelin restaurant, and he still dares to say that he’s richer than my husband.”
The coquettish woman added sarcastically.
“Hahaha…”
The underlings behind the afro man also laughed out loud. What Connor said just now was simply a huge joke to them.
“You don’t believe me?”
Connor took a step forward and asked the guy with the afro.
“Of course, I don’t believe you. No one has ever dared to say that they are rich in front of me, Zill Zonah.”
The young man with the afro was actually not a rich second-generation heir. He was just the owner of a clothing factory. He said this just to show off in front of the woman.
“Is that so?”
Connor asked indifferently.
The youth with the afro, Zill Zonah, smiled disdainfully. He then reached into his pocket and took out a large stack of cash. He then said to Connor, “Brat, weren’t you very arrogant just now, saying that you’re very rich? And I have a habit of dealing with people using money!”
“How?”
Connor squinted his eyes and asked.
“Here’s 10,000. If you kneel down and apologize to my wife now, this money will be yours!”
Zill waved the money in his hand and shouted in disdain.
He felt that at this time, he had to use money to settle Connor to make himself look good, so he gave up the idea of beating Connor up.
H H
When Connor heard this, he couldn’t help but look at Zill and coldly said, “I’ll give you 20,000. Kneel down and apologize to me!”
“You brat, are you still going to fight with me?”
After Zill heard Connor’s words, he couldn’t help but curse loudly.
“Can you take out 20,000? Why are you acting so cool?”
“Yeah, can you take out 20,000?”
“Look at how poor he is. He definitely can’t take out 20,000.”
The woman and Zill’s underlings began to mock Connor.
“I’ll give you 50,000. Kneel down and apologize to my wife now!”
Zill said coldly to Connor.
“I’ll give you 80,000!”
Connor replied calmly.
H H
Zill looked at Connor and could not help but be stunned for a moment. He did not know if Connor could really take that amount of money out, but he did not expect Connor to directly raise the amount to 80,000.
Originally, Zill thought that Connor would agree to his offer of 50,000. After Connor left, he would be able to snatch the money back.
This way, not only would he not suffer any losses, but he could also act tough in front of the woman. It was simply killing two birds with one stone.
Moreover, Zill had been with the woman for more than a month and had not found a suitable opportunity to bring her to a hotel. Zill felt that today was his chance.
However, he did not expect that not only did Connor not agree, but he even went against him and kept increasing the amount.
“I’ll give you 100,000, and you’ll f*cking kneel down!”
Zill hesitated for a moment before gritting his teeth and shouting.
Anyway, he was going to get the money back later. If he raised the price a little, he would just make himself look even better. At that time, the woman would be more willing to go to a hotel with him.
“A hundred thousand?”
When Connor heard the price, he couldn’t help but laugh. Then, he sighed in deep down. “There are so many country bumpkins in this society. They’re actually willing to spend 100,000 just to please a piece of trash!”
If it was the previous Connor, he might have knelt down by now. However, Connor did not lack the money at all, so he naturally would not agree.
Mandy Hines also noticed the situation here, but her mind was filled with thoughts about how to spend the five million later. She was not in the mood to care about Connor’s matters.
“Say something. 100,000. Are you going to f*cking kneel or not?”
Zill saw that Connor was keeping quiet, so he raised his eyebrows as he asked.
“I’ll give you a million. Kneel down and admit your mistake!”
Connor hesitated for a moment before replying indifferently.
When everyone heard Connor’s words, their eyes immediately widened, and they felt that it was absurd.
No one expected Connor to directly increase the amount to one million!
One had to know that the 100,000 that Zill had mentioned was a huge sum of money. However, if Zill was really rich, it would not be a problem for him to take out 100,000 to show off.
After all, 100,000 might be a huge sum of money for ordinary people, but it was nothing for a rich second-generation heir.
However, the one million that Connor had just said was really a little scary.
Even the rich second-generation heirs of Porthampton couldn’t afford to fork out a million at once, just to make the other party kneel down and admit his mistake.
When Zill heard Connor’s words, he couldn’t help but be stunned. Then, he raised his head and sized up Connor. He asked with a very unhappy expression, “Are you kidding me? Can you f*cking take out a million?”
“Yeah, even if I sell you, I don’t think 1 can get a million, right?”
The woman, who was beside Zill, also mocked.
“It’s my business whether 1 can take out a million or not. Didn’t you want to use cash to slap my face? If you can take out a million, I might even consider kneeling down and apologizing to you!”
Connor looked at Zill and said calmly.
When everyone heard Connor’s words, they instantly understood. The reason why Connor shouted out a million was just to raise the amount a little.
“So? Can you take out a million?”
Connor asked Zill with a smile.
“You… Do you f*cking think I’m an idiot? Why should I give you a million?”
Zill shouted.
“In my opinion, you’re an idiot. If you don’t have money, get lost quickly. Don’t embarrass yourself here!”
Connor pushed Zill and walked out of the restaurant.
“Stop right there! Who said you could leave?”
Zill shouted at Connor.
When the lackeys behind him heard this, they immediately rushed in front of Connor and surrounded him.
But the door of the restaurant was suddenly pushed open by a man, Michael Page and another bank employee carrying a huge money box walked in.
When the customers in the restaurant saw Michael carrying the box in, they were all stunned, and they were very puzzled.
They had no idea what was in the box that two men had to carry in.
Zill and the others were also confused..

chapters.title: Chapter 204 - 204: Giving You Face by Hitting You
chapters.content:
Chapter 204 - 204: Giving You Face by Hitting You
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
“Mr. McDonald!”
When Michael saw Connor, he hurriedly walked up and greeted him respectfully.
“Did you bring the money?”
Connor glanced at Michael and asked calmly.
“Yes!”
Michael quickly nodded.
When Mandy Hines saw Michael coming over to give Connor the money, she quickly got up and ran to Connor with an excited expression on her face.
“Michael, open the box!”
Connor shouted expressionlessly.
Michael hesitated for a moment when he heard this. Then, he opened the box with the money.
“Gasp!”
When Michael opened the box, everyone present sucked in a breath of cold air, unable to hide the shocked expression on their faces.
Because no one expected that the box Michael brought would be filled with red banknotes!
This was a whole box of money!
People who could eat at Michelin restaurants were mostly very wealthy, but they had never seen so much money at the same time!
At this moment, the man Connor called over had actually casually brought a big box of money over. At this moment, the way everyone looked at Connor completely changed, and their eyes revealed deep shock.
Mandy looked at the money in the box, and her eyes sparkled. She did not know how to describe her feelings now.
The afro haired Zill Zonah and the woman were also very surprised because they knew that Michael was here to give Connor money.
“Is… is this kid really so rich?”
Zill’s eyes widened as he looked at Connor, his face filled with disbelief.
“Yeah, I… I didn’t expect him to be a rich second-generation heir!”
The woman replied with a trembling voice.
“Mandy, here’s five million. Do you want to count it?”
Connor turned his head and asked Mandy.
“No, no…”
Mandy looked at the money with a bright light in her eyes. She was very excited. She hurriedly shook her head hard.
“Alright, from now on, this five million is all yours. 1 hope you won’t find trouble with me again in the future. If I find out that you have malicious intentions toward me again, I will definitely not let you off.”
Connor said coldly to Mandy.
“Got it!”
Mandy quickly nodded.
When Connor saw Mandy’s greedy look, he couldn’t help but laugh deep down. Then, he said indifferently, “Mandy, do you still remember what I told you just now?”
“No, I don’t remember…”
Mandy shook her head gently.
“In this world, there are many things that are more important than money. Even if you have this money, you won’t be able to live the life you want!”
Connor said lightly, then directly walked out of the restaurant.
However, just as Connor passed by Zill, Zill suddenly stretched out his hand and stopped Connor.
“Is there anything else?”
Connor turned his head and asked Zill.
“Brother, you said that if I kneel down and apologize to you, you’ll give me a million. Is that still true?”
Zill asked Connor excitedly.
Previously, Zill thought that Connor was joking with him, so he did not take Connor’s words to heart.
In his opinion, Connor was a poor loser. He might not even be able to take out 100,000, let alone a million.
But now, Connor actually gave Mandy five million. Zill suddenly realized that Connor’s previous words might not be a joke!
Just by kneeling down and admitting his mistake, he could get a million. Where could Zill find such a good thing?
“What do you think?”
Connor turned his head and looked coldly at Zill.
Thud!
When Zill heard Connor’s words, he immediately knelt on the ground and shouted, “Brother, it was my fault just now. 1 was blind to not recognize a great person such as yourself. My apologies!”
Connor looked at Zill and smiled, then shifted his gaze to the woman.
“What are you waiting for? Hurry up and kneel down and apologize to this big brother!”
Zill shouted at the woman.
“I… I was wrong. 1 shouldn’t have said that about you!”
In order to get Connor’s one million, the woman also knelt on the ground.
When the crowd saw Zill and the woman kneeling on the ground, they did not show any disdain on their faces. If they were in the same situation, they would have done the same.
Just by kneeling down and apologizing, they could get a million. They would probably kneel till their knees bled!
Not only did everyone not look down on Zill, but they also envied his good luck.
When Connor saw the two of them kneel down, he shook his head helplessly and turned to walk out of the restaurant.
“Well, big brother, I’ve already knelt down to apologize to you. Why aren’t you giving me the money?”
Zill saw that Connor was about to leave and quickly caught up with him, asking with a smile.
“Give you?”
Connor looked at Zill and smiled, then said playfully, “Actually, I was just joking with you earlier…”
“You…”
When Zill heard this, he was instantly dumbfounded. He bared his teeth and roared, “Are you f*cking kidding me? Believe it or not, I’ll…”
Smack!
Before Zill could finish his sentence, Michael had already walked up and slapped Zill’s face.
“Rumble!”
When Zill’s underlings saw Michael making a move, they all grabbed their weapons and were prepared to charge forward.
However, at this moment, five people suddenly rushed in from outside the restaurant. These five people were all fully armed. Not only were they holding assault rifles, but they were also wearing bulletproof vests.
These five people were none other than the special forces in charge of security in the bank.
Although five million wasn’t a lot, it wasn’t a small amount either. The most important thing was that the person who wanted the money was Connor. Michael naturally didn’t dare to be negligent, so he specially called a few special forces soldiers over.
H ii
When Zill’s underlings saw these special forces soldiers, they could not remain calm. They stood rooted to the ground, not daring to breathe loudly.
“Mr. McDonald is giving you face by hitting you. Please mind your attitude!”
Michael said to Zill expressionlessly.
“Yes, I was wrong!”
Zill replied with a trembling voice.
“Mr. McDonald, this way please!”
Michael turned his head and said respectfully to Connor.
“Alright!”
Connor nodded gently, then turned around and walked out of the restaurant.
When Mandy Hines saw that Connor was about to leave, she couldn’t help but be stunned for a moment. Then, she shouted at the top of her voice, “Connor, don’t go! If you leave, how am I going to take the money with me?”
“Didn’t you say that money is the most important thing? Now that you’re so rich, I believe you can solve this problem!”
Connor turned his head to look at Mandy and said in a playful tone.
H ii
Mandy was instantly dumbfounded when she heard this.
Connor left the restaurant with Michael and the others.
When Mandy saw that Connor had really left, she looked extremely dejected.
The five million in cash weighed nearly loo pounds. A girl like her could not carry it at all!
When Connor withdrew five million from the bank, he had also put it on the electric car before he could transport the money..

chapters.title: Chapter 205 - 205: The Hidden Wealthy Second-Generation Heir
chapters.content:
Chapter 205 - 205: The Hidden Wealthy Second-Generation Heir
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
“Mr. McDonald, are you really going to give the money to this woman?”
After leaving the restaurant, Michael asked Connor with a puzzled tone.
“Do you think I gave her a sum of money or a timed bomb?”
Connor replied indifferently.
“Timed bomb?”
When Michael heard this, he could not help but be stunned for a moment. Then, a trace of doubt appeared on his face.
“Do you know how to destroy a person in the shortest time possible?”
Connor turned his head and asked Michael.
“I don’t…”
Michael shook his head lightly.
“The simplest way is to give her a windfall for her to squander. This money can’t be too much, but it can’t be too little either. 1 think five million is just right!”
Connor replied indifferently.
“I understand what you mean, Mr. McDonald!”
Michael understood and smiled.
“Alright, drive me to Freya Cosmetics!”
Connor whispered to Michael.
“Alright!”
Michael nodded and brought Connor to Freya Cosmetics.
At this time, Connor didn’t care what Mandy would do after getting the five million because he knew that she would die because of the five million sooner or later.
Connor’s top priority now was to find Freya Phillips and explain to her about what happened between him and Mandy. After all, Connor still didn’t know if Freya would forgive him!
Along the way, Connor squinted at the scenery outside the window.
After hesitating for a long time, Connor took out his phone and made a call.
“Beep, beep, beep…”
The phone rang twice before the other party picked up.
“Co… Connor?”
The other party asked softly.
“I need you to do something for me now…”
Connor replied indifferently.
“What is it?”
The other party hesitated for a moment before answering softly.
“It’s like this…”
In the next few minutes, Connor briefly explained his plan to the other party.
After hearing Connor’s words, the other party was very puzzled. He could not understand why Connor would do this.
Even Michael, who was sitting next to Connor, was equally puzzled.
“Connor, you… Why are you doing this?”
The other party stuttered.
“You don’t need to know too much. Just do whatever I ask you to do!”
Connor replied indifferently.
“Alright, then!”
The other party helplessly agreed and then hung up.
When Michael saw Connor put away his phone, he couldn’t help but turn to look at Connor. However, after hesitating for a moment, Michael didn’t ask the question and focused on driving.
Elsewhere, in a Michelin restaurant.
Mandy looked at the big box of cash in front of her, and she looked extremely dejected.
The customers in the restaurant looked at Mandy with envy. If it weren’t for the security guards in the Michelin restaurant, they would have already robbed her.
After all, this was a total of five million!
Who wouldn’t be tempted?
Mandy got her wish and got five million from Connor. She was naturally very happy.
But now, there was a very serious problem in front of her: how was she going to bring the cash with her?
Even an adult man would find it difficult to carry five million in cash, let alone a weak woman like Mandy!
Back then, Connor also relied on the electric car he used to deliver food to transport five million.
Therefore, Mandy had no way to bring the money with her now. However, she was a little worried about asking someone for help.
Although the security guards of the Michelin restaurant had already helped Mandy move the box into the private room, no one dared to help her take the money out of the restaurant.
After all, it was such a large sum of money. If anything happened on the way, the security guards could not bear the responsibility!
Mandy sat alone in the private room and looked at the huge money box in front of her. She was extremely helpless.
“What should I do?”
Mandy sighed helplessly. Then, she hesitated for a moment before taking out her phone. She decided to call Lily Sullivan and ask her to come over and help her take the money.
Lily was Mandy’s roommate, and she also helped frame Connor this time, so she trusted Lily a great deal.
“Hello, Lily? Where are you now?”
When the call was connected, Mandy asked anxiously.
“I’m in the dormitory. What’s the matter?”
At this moment, Lily was still immersed in the fear of Connor looking for her just now, so she was trembling as she spoke.
“Can you help me get some things from the Michelin Restaurant? When you come, bring two backpacks. The bigger the better, understand?”
Mandy quickly said.
“What do you want to do?”
Lily asked in confusion.
“Don’t ask so many questions. Come over quickly!”
Mandy frowned and shouted.
“I feel sick. Get someone else to help you!”
Lily hesitated for a moment and wanted to refuse.
“Then, do you still want the 50,000 I promised you before?”
Mandy asked.
When Lily heard this, her expression changed drastically. She quickly said, “Wait for me. I’ll go over now!”
“Alright!”
Mandy happily replied after Lily had agreed and hung up the phone.
Half an hour later.
Lily carried two huge bags and ran into the private room of the Michelin restaurant. When she saw Mandy, she asked with a puzzled expression, “Mandy, why did you call me over in such a hurry? What are you up to?”
“Hurry up and help me put all the money in the box into the bags. Then, the two of us will go to the bank to deposit the money!”
Mandy replied softly.
“The money in the box?”
When Lily heard this, she seemed a little puzzled.
Mandy reached out and opened the lid of the box.
The banknotes were instantly revealed to Lily.
When Lily saw the money, she was instantly dumbfounded. She trembled and said, “Mandy, this… this is all yours?”
“That’s right!”
Mandy nodded happily, then took out 100,000 from the box and casually handed it to Lily. She said with a smile, “This money is yours!”
“Mandy, why do you suddenly have so much money?”
Lily looked at the banknotes in the box and asked with a frightened expression.
“You don’t have to worry. This money is legal. It wasn’t stolen or robbed…”
Mandy replied indifferently. Then, she picked up one of the bags that Lily had brought and started to put money into it.
Lily stood rooted to the ground in a daze. She could not understand where Mandy had gotten so much money.
“What are you waiting for? Hurry up and help me put the money in!”
Mandy turned her head and shouted at Lily.
“All…”
Lily came back to her senses and quickly squatted down to help Mandy put the money into her bag.
“Mandy, where did you get this money from? Did you really not do anything illegal?”
Lily asked Mandy curiously as she loaded the bag with cash.
“If I told you that Connor gave me all this money, would you believe me?”
Mandy turned to look at Lily and asked playfully.
“Connor? Connor gave it to you?”
When Lily heard that, she was in even more disbelief.
“You might not know this, but Connor is actually a hidden second-generation heir. This is the breakup fee he gave me. Anyway, let’s not talk about it anymore. Let’s hurry up and put the money in. Otherwise, the bank will close soon!”
Mandy explained casually, then continued to put money into her bag.
Lily looked at Mandy with a complicated expression on her face, but she did not say anything. Instead, she did as she was told..

chapters.title: Chapter 206 - 206: A Call From Yelena
chapters.content:
Chapter 206 - 206: A Call From Yelena
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Ten minutes later.
Lily and Mandy each carried a big bag in their hands and left the restaurant. Then, the two of them called a taxi and went to the nearby Oprana Bank.
After depositing the money, Mandy looked at the bank card in her hand and revealed a very satisfied smile.
Then, she turned to Lily.” Lily, don’t tell anyone about what happened today, especially the people in our school. Do you understand?”
“I know…” Lily nodded lightly, her expression a little awkward.
“You’re the only one who knows that I’m so rich now, so as long as you don’t tell anyone my secret, I’ll definitely treat you well!” Mandy continued.
“Yes!”
Lily nodded again.
“By the way, do you know any fun places in Porthampton? I’m so rich now, so I have to experience the life of a rich person!” Mandy asked Lily excitedly.
“A fun place?” When Lily heard this, she couldn’t help but be stunned for a moment. Then, she said in a low voice, “Mandy, I know a place that’s especially fun, and only the rich in Porthampton can go there. Why don’t the two of us go and take a look?”
“Alright, I like to go to places where rich people play. I’m not interested in places where poor people gather!” Mandy quickly agreed.
Lily raised her head and looked at Mandy indifferently. A strange look flashed across her eyes, but in the end, she still reached out to flag down a taxi and brought Mandy into the car.
On the other hand.
Michael drove Connor to the entrance of Freya Cosmetics.
This was because Connor had come over today to explain the problem to Freya. Not only that, the incident with Mandy’s was a little complicated.
Therefore, Connor did not bring Michael and the others up. Instead, he asked them to leave first.
After Connor entered the company, the receptionist recognized him at a glance. After all, Connor was Freya’s fiance, and it was he who had found a new investor for the company back then. Therefore, the beautiful receptionist hurriedly ran to Connor.
“Mr. McDonald, you’re here?” The beautiful receptionist greeted Connor with a smile and a very respectful tone.
“That’s right. Is President Phillips here?” Connor replied indifferently.
“Mr. McDonald, I’m really sorry. President Phillips went on a business trip today!” the receptionist replied softly.
“On a business trip?”
After Connor heard this, he was instantly rendered speechless. Then, he continued to ask, “Then do you know when she will be back?”
The receptionist thought for a moment and replied, “President Phillips is going on a business trip for two days. She should be back the day after tomorrow!”
H 11
Connor stood there and hesitated for two seconds. Then, he said helplessly, “Alright then, I’ll come back the day after tomorrow!”
“Mr. McDonald, is there something urgent that you want to talk to President Phillips about? If you have anything urgent, you can give her a call first!” The beautiful receptionist suggested softly.
“No need, it’s not an emergency!”
Connor waved his hand, then turned around and walked out of the building. Actually, he wanted to give Freya a call to explain himself, but Freya was not picking up his calls at all, so he had no choice but to come and look for her.
The beautiful receptionist looked at Connor’s back with a puzzled expression. She couldn’t understand why the two of them acted like strangers even though Connor was Freya’s fiance, especially since Connor didn’t even know that Freya was going on a business trip.
After leaving Freya Cosmetics, Connor stood by the roadside and took out his phone to call Freya. However, she still did not pick up his call. She was probably still angry at Connor.
“Forget it. I’ll let her calm down while she’s on a business trip. I’ll explain to her when she comes back!”
Connor sighed helplessly, then put away his phone and prepared to take a taxi home.
“Ring!”
At this moment, Connor’s phone suddenly rang. Connor thought that Freya was calling him, so he took out his phone and answered the call without thinking.
“Freya…”
” What Freya?! It’s me, Yelena!”
Before Connor could finish, Yelena’s voice came from the phone.
“Why is it you?” After Connor heard that it was Yelena who called him, his tone instantly became a little disappointed.
“What’s wrong? Why are you unhappy when you hear that your sister called you? Do you know how many people are chasing me in our school? You should be honored that I’m calling you, Little Man!” Yelena said with embarrassment.
“What does it have to do with them chasing you?”
Connor was a little frustrated because of Freya’s matter, so he replied impatiently.
“Forget it, 1 can’t explain it to you. Come to Aurora Bar now. I’m drunk.” Yelena said lightly.
“I’m not free!” Connor didn’t even think about it and directly refused.
“What did you say?” Yelena shouted unhappily.
“I’m not your driver. Why do you always ask me to drive for you? You’d better find a substitute driver yourself. I’m not in a good mood now!” Connor coldly explained.
“Oh Little Man, why don’t you know how to take pity on women? Do you know that there are a lot of news reports saying that a designated driver once forced himself on a female car owner? I’m so beautiful and have a hot figure, so what if those designated drivers have a lecherous heart and do something to me?” Yelena said sweetly.
“Aren’t you afraid that I’ll lust after you?” Connor was stunned for a moment, then replied with a playful tone.
“I feel quite safe with you because you don’t have the guts!” Yelena said with a smile.
Connor felt that Yelena was obviously looking down on him, so he shouted excitedly, “Yelena, just based on what you said just now, I won’t go today. You’d better think of a way yourself!”
“Do you still have a conscience? 1 did you a big favor today, have you forgotten? Could it be that you have the heart to let such a beautiful little girl like me be harmed?” Yelena also shouted.
“You…”
After Connor heard this, his heart suddenly softened and he said in a low voice, “Alright, seeing that you’ve helped me before, I’ll help you again!”
“I knew you were the best. Come over quickly!”
After Yelena saw that Connor had agreed, she replied happily and then hung up the phone.
“You know that you’re an internet celebrity, but you still drink every day. It would be strange if something happened!” After Connor saw that the call was hung up, he muttered this with a straight face, then reached out to flag down a taxi and rushed straight to Aurora Bar..

chapters.title: Chapter 207 - 207: The Young Master of the Luther Family
chapters.content:
Chapter 207 - 207: The Young Master of the Luther Family
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
7 PM.
Connor took a taxi to Aurora Bar.
As soon as he got out of the taxi, Connor saw Yelena standing at the entrance of the bar waiting for him.
Today, Yelena was dressed very sexily. She was wearing a white tight skirt, and her chest was full and extremely attractive. There was light makeup on her exquisite face. Her snow-like skin was especially delicate, and her fair legs were exposed to the air without reservation.
Of course, the most important thing was that Yelena was not lying to Connor. She was really drunk today—her pretty face was red like a ripe apple, luring everyone in to take a bite. She looked especially attractive.
After Yelena saw Connor appear, she hurriedly waved her small hand.
Connor walked towards her.
However, at this moment, a red Ferrari stopped in front of her.
Everyone turned their attention to Yelena when they saw the Ferrari.
The Ferrari’s streamlined door slowly opened, and a handsome man walked out of the car with a bouquet of pink roses in hand.
When Yelena saw the man, a hint of helplessness flashed in her eyes.
“Yelena, 1 love you. Be my girlfriend!”
Before anyone could react, the man shouted at Yelena.
After everyone heard the man’s words, they all surrounded Yelena and the young man like they had nothing better to do than stare.
After all, one of the people involved was a Tiktok Internet celebrity, while the other was a rich second-generation heir who drove a Ferrari. Such a combination would naturally attract the attention of many people.
Yelena looked at the man in front of her and replied helplessly, “Fabien, how many times have I told you that it’s impossible between you and me? Why do you keep pestering me?”
“Yelena, 1 already know that you’re not interested in women. You’re just finding excuses to reject those suitors. Can you give me a chance? I swear that I will only love you in this life!”
The man seemed to be unwilling to give up and shouted at her.
Yelena looked at the man in front of her and hesitated for two seconds. Then, she gritted her teeth and said softly, “Fabien, you want me to be your girlfriend, right?”
“That’s right!” The man quickly nodded.
“Alright, since you’re so stubborn, I’ll tell you the truth. Actually, I already have a boyfriend, so please don’t pester me anymore. Otherwise, my boyfriend won’t let you off!” Yelena replied indifferently.
When everyone heard Yelena’s words, they were a little shocked, and incredulity appeared on their faces. After all, Yelena was a famous internet celebrity on Tiktok, and many people present were her fans.
Moreover, these people all knew that Yelena wasn’t interested in men, so when they found out that Yelena had a boyfriend, they were naturally very surprised.
“You already have a boyfriend? Why didn’t I know about it?”
The young man shouted in surprise.
Connor, who had just gotten out of the taxi, immediately cried out in his heart when he heard Yelena’s words. He hurriedly turned around and was about to leave when
“Connor, stop right there! Why are you running?”
After Yelena saw Connor leave, she didn’t even think about it and immediately chased after him. Then, she grabbed him and said, “Fabien, this man is my boyfriend!”
When everyone heard this, they all turned their heads to look at Connor’s position, their eyes revealing deep shock.
Only Connor had a difficult expression on his face as he stopped in his tracks. Then, he revealed a bitter smile to everyone. In fact, he had felt that Yelena was planning to use him as a shield, so he wanted to leave. However, he was still a step too slow.
At this time, the young man standing in front of Yelena with ninety-nine roses in his hand was called Fabien Luther. He was the son of the chairman of the Luther Group in Porthampton.
Not only was he handsome, but his family background was also very good. Basically, all the rich people in Porthampton knew about Young Master Luther of the Luther family. He was also one of the most famous tall, rich, and handsome men in Porthampton.
Some time ago, Fabien saw the short video posted by Yelena on Tiktok and instantly fell in love with her. Soon, he used his own relationship with the world to investigate who she was, and then began to launch a very fierce courtship attack on her.
However, Yelena had always used the excuse that she wasn’t interested in men to reject Fabien. However, what Yelena did not expect was that after knowing that she was interested in women, not only did Fabien not retreat, but rather further stimulated his desire for her.
Not only was Yelena beautiful, but she also had a hot figure and a unique temperament. Even though she was open about her sexuality to the public, she still had many pursuers of the opposite sex.
Because for a man, conquering a woman like Yelena would be a great sense of accomplishment! This was also the reason why so many boys were still willing to pursue Yelena even after knowing about her sexuality.
But today, no one expected Yelena to actually admit that she had a boyfriend in front of so many people! Moreover, her boyfriend seemed to be a poor loser no matter how they looked at him. Most importantly, he looked like he had a very weak personality.
Because when he saw his girlfriend being confessed to, Connor’s first reaction was not to stand up to protect his girlfriend, but to turn around and escape. In everyone’s eyes, Connor’s behavior was simply a typical good-for-nothing.
The surrounding crowd cast disdainful gazes at him.
Of course, among the onlookers, the most shocked person was none other than the girl that Dominic liked, Cindy Stone!
Cindy had met Connor a few times, so she was naturally able to recognize him at a glance. She had originally come to Aurora Bar to hang out with her friends, but before she could enter the bar, she saw a large group of people gathered at the door, so she joined in the fun and watched the happenings.
However, Cindy was almost scared out of her wits. She never thought that a poor loser like Connor would be Yelena’s boyfriend. Even if Cindy wasn’t a student at the Porthampton University, she knew exactly who Yelena was!
She was a huge influencer on Tiktok with five million fans!
“This… What’s going on? How could Connor, a poor delivery boy, be Yelena’s boyfriend? Did Connor get lucky?” Cindy’s eyes were wide open as she stared at the scene in front of her. The expression on her face was one of shock. She felt that everything in front of her was too unbelievable..

chapters.title: Chapter 208 - 208: You’re No Better Than a Delivery Man
chapters.content:
Chapter 208 - 208: You’re No Better Than a Delivery Man
Translator: End less Fantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Yelena ignored everyone’s strange gazes and directly dragged Connor to Fabien.
Then, she looked at Fabien and said, “Fabien, this man is my boyfriend. So, please don’t pester me anymore. Do you understand?”
When Fabien heard Yelena’s words, he couldn’t help but be stunned for a moment. Then, he raised his head and looked at Connor, his face full of shock.
He never thought that he would actually lose to someone like Connor! No matter how he looked at it, he beat this man in every aspect; although Connor’s looks were not bad, he was obviously a loser from his clothes. However, Fabien was different. Whether it was the way he dressed or the Ferrari he drove, it was as if he was telling everyone that he was a real rich second-generation heir.
in times like these, who would choose a poor loser over a tall, rich, and handsome man?
in fact, nor only did Fabien have such doubts in his heart, but also the onlookers were also very puzzled.
Of all the people present, only Connor had a helpless expression. He originally did not want to get involved in Yelena’s matters because Connor felt that if he got involved, he would definitely ger into a lot of unnecessary trouble.
Recently, there had been enough trouble around Connor. Now, he only wanted to keep a low profile and live a rich second-generation heir’s life. He wanted to explain the incident involving Mandy to Freya and get the marriage certificate as soon as possible.
As for other things, Connor really had no interest in getting involved now.
Fabien carefully sized up Connor, then took a step forward and asked him provocatively, “You’re Yelena s boyfriend?”
“I’m not…”
Connor was just about to open his mouth to cut ties with Yelena, but before he could finish speaking, he suddenly felt a sharp pain from his waist, followed by a miserable cry.
Connor hurriedly turned his head to look at Yelena and found that Yelena’s delicate hand was placed on his waist. The expression on her face seemed to be warning him not to speak nonsense or she would kill him.
Connor had no choice but to compromise and whispered, “That’s right. I’m Yelena’s boyfriend!”
“This is impossible!” Fabien shouted after hearing this.
Yelena frowned and asked, “Why is it impossible?1‘
“Yelena, although 1 haven’t known you for a long time, I knowyour character very well. 1 know that there are many rich young masters pursuing you in Porthampton, but you rejected all of them. I also know that you’ve always been very proud, so it’s absolutely impossible for you to like such a poor loser!”
Fabien shouted at Yelena with his eyes wide open.
Yelena could not help but frown when she heard Fabien’s words.
She didn’t expect Fabien to be so smart. He figured out that she was just asking Connor to pretend to be her boyfriend.
“That’s right. How could Goddess Yelena like such a boy?”
“This man is a poor loser at first glance. He’s not worthy of Goddess Yelena at all!”
“This kid is definitely an imposter!”
Everyone present did not believe that Connor would be Yelena’s boyfriend, so when these people heard Fabien’s words, they all started to shout.
Cindy also heaved a sigh of relief. A hint of relief flashed across her eyes as she muttered to herself, “I knew it. How could a loser like Connor be a Tiktok star’s boyfriend? So he was just a shield. Without even mentioning Yelena, even ordinary girls wouldn’t like him, right?”
After Connor heard the cheers of the surrounding crowd, the expression on his face was a little unhappy. Although he did not look as good as Fabien, he was not as bad as they said, right?
If it was Connor, he might not have had any reaction and he would just let the humiliation pass.
However, Connor was still a super rich second generation with a net worth of ten trillion dollars. Now that he was actually being belittled by these people, Connor would definitely get a little emotional.
Fabien saw that Yelena did not speak, so he quickly stepped forward and continued, “Yelena, stop acting with me. This kid isn’t your boyfriend at all.
Look at how poor he is. He’s worse than a delivery man. How can you like him?”
“Fabien, what are you saying? Who are you calling a delivery man? Can’t you speak with some manners?” Yelena’s pretty face flashed with anger as she shouted at Fabien with her big watery eyes.
Fabien pointed at Connor and said, “I told you he’s not as good as a delivery man!”
“Fabien, you…”
Before Yelena could finish her sentence, Connor finally reached the end of his patience. He walked directly to Yelena and said to Fabien expressionlessly, “You said that I m not even as good as a delivery man, right?”
Connor originally did not care about the matter between Yelena and Fabien. After all, it would be better to avoid trouble now.
However, Fabien had provoked him non stop. In addition, Connor had just gotten into a misunderstanding and then had five million yuan extorted from him by Mandy. Although five million yuan was not a lot of money to Connor, it still didn’t sit well with him.
Therefore, at this moment, he finally couldn’t take it anymore and stood up.
Fabien did not expect that Connor, who looked like a coward just now, would actually dare to stand up and talk to him.
He was stunned for a moment, then looked up and asked, “Kid, 1 told you that you’re not as good as a delivery man. You got something to say about that?”
In fact, Fabien had just said that Connor was not as good as a delivery man. He was just humiliating Connor. He felt that even if Connor’s family background was really good, he was at most an ordinary person.
As the eldest son of the Luther family in Porthampton, it was a given that Fabien would want to show up an ordinary person.
“You seem to like the job of delivering food, right?” Connor looked at Fabien and smiled faintly.
“You… What do you mean?”
Fabien looked at Connor and couldn’t help but be stunned for a moment. A trace of confusion flashed across his face.
“Nothing much. Since you like to deliver food so much, you can deliver food from today onwards!”
Connor replied indifferently, then took out his phone to call Thomas Morgan.
In Porthampton City, anyone with a bit of fame would have dealings with Thomas. It could be said that he was the boss of Porthampton. A single word from Thomas could definitely make a family bankrupt. Even if Thomas couldn’t do it, Connor could use his own connections to do it.
Therefore, in Connor s eyes, Fabien’s Luther family was nothing more than an ant. If Connor wanted to make the Luther family become destitute, it would only take him one sentence..

chapters.title: Chapter 209 - 209: What Are You Putting on An Act For?
chapters.content:
Chapter 209 - 209: What Are You Putting on An Act For?
Translator: End less Fantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
After everyone heard Connor’s words, they were all a little stunned, and their eyes revealed a trace of confusion. They didn’t know what Connor meant!
“You want me to deliver food?” Fabien looked at Connor and asked.
Connor ignored him and found Thomas’s number in his phone address book, then dialed it. He was not in the mood to talk nonsense with Fabien at all.
“Is there something wrong with your brain?”
“That’s right. Are you crazy? You’re actually asking Young Master Luther to go deliver food? I really don’t know what you’re thinking?”
“Who do you think you are? If you ask Young Master Luther to deliver food, does he have to do it at all? I’m dying of laughter!
“He might not know what Young Master Luthier does for a living. You’re really not afraid of being struck by lightning!”
Everyone seemed to think that Connor was acting tough, so they all mocked him.
“Connor, what nonsense are you talking about? I asked you to pretend to be my boyfriend, but I didn’t ask you to say these things!”
Yelena also seemed to not understand Connor’s current approach. She felt that Connor might just want to scare Fabien. But even if he wanted to scare Fabien, he should have thought of a more reasonable approach. What’s going on with his asking Fabien to deliver food?
“He seems to be obsessed with food deliveries? Didn’t he look down on delivery people? Then let him experience it!”
Connor waited for Thomas to pick up the phone and said calmly.
Yelena was speechless as she shouted, “Little Man, who do you think you are? If you ask Fabien to deliver food, do you think he’ll actually do it?
“I told him to go, so he has to go!” Connor replied indifferently.
“Young Master McDonald!”
At this moment, Thomas finally picked up the phone.
” Thomas…’
Just as Connor was about to speak, Cindy, who was originally standing at the side to watch the show, suddenly stood up and pointed at Connor, shouting, “Connor, what are you putting on an act for? Is there any meaning in wasting everyone’s time to play along with you? Didn’t you rely on delivering food to earn enough money for your tuition fees? All the students in Porthampton University know about this. Young Master Luther said that there was nothing wrong with you looking like a delivery man!”
At this moment, Cindy’s intentions were very obvious. She had always disliked Connor. Moreover, the person Connor had offended was Fabien. Cindy felt that if she stood up for Fabien at this time, she might be able to leave a good impression on him, and was excited to be able to befriend a rich second-generation heir like Fabien.
“I didn’t expect you to really be a delivery man!”
“Yeah, no wonder he was so agitated when Young Master Luther said that to him just now. It turns out that Young Master Luther was right and he just felt inferior!”
“Hehe, I thought this kid was some hidden rich second-generation heir, which was why he dared to speak so arrogantly. It turns out that he’s just a delivery man. What a waste!”
After everyone heard Cindy’s words, they started to mock Connor.
“Is what you said true?” Fabien asked Cindy with a smile.
“Of course I’m telling the truth. Connor is a famous takeaway king in our school. If you don’t believe me, you can ask any student at Porthampton University! “Cindy replied firmly.
“Hahaha, I believe you!” Fabien couldn’t help but laugh. He didn’t expect that his casual words would actually be true—this Connor guy was actually a delivery man!
When Connor saw Cindy, he was also stunned. He originally thought that with so many people present, no one would recognize him except Yelena. That was why he wanted to expose his identity and get Thomas come over to teach Fabien a lesson.
However, Connor had never expected Cindy to step forward at this time. Her appearance instantly disrupted all of his plans.
Because once Cindy found out about Connor’s identity, it meant that Dominic, Spencer and the rest would also know about it. If that happened, things would become even more complicated.
“Young Master McDonald, did you run into some trouble?” At this moment, Thomas’s voice came from the other end of the phone.
“No… It’s alright now!” Connor replied with a faint tone before hanging up.
Since Cindy was present, Connor would definitely not risk exposing his identity by asking Thomas to come over. He could only use his own methods to solve today’s issue.
When everyone saw Connor put down his phone, they all thought that Connor had been exposed by Cindy, so he didn’t dare to continue acting.
This made everyone even more convinced of Cindy’s words.
“I’m sorry. I didn’t expect you to actually be a delivery man!”
Fabien stepped forward and sneered at Connor.
Connor narrowed his eyes and looked at Fabien without saying anything.
Fabien looked at Connor and continued.
“Since you’re a delivery man, then Yelena definitely won’t be with someone like you. So you’re not Yelena’s boyfriend at all, right?”
“Fabien, who told you that I wouldn’t be with a delivery man?” Yelena shouted. “Alright! Yelena, don’t put on an act in front of me. Hurry up and tell the truth. How could you like a loser who delivers food for a living?”
Fabien said lightly.
“I’m sorry, maybe Yelena likes losers like me!”
At this moment, Connor suddenly shouted. Then, he reached out and hugged Yelena’s slender and soft waist, pulling her into his embrace.
When everyone saw this scene, they instantly went into an uproar! Everyone widened their eyes and looked at this scene in a daze. They felt that everything was too unbelievable.
Because everyone felt that if Connor was really Yelena’s boyfriend, then Connor wouldn’t have done such an intimate thing with Yelena!
However, no one expected him to hug her in front of so many people.
Even Yelena herself didn’t expect Connor to be so bold.
Cindy’s fox-like eyes widened as she looked at them in shock. She didn’t even know how to describe her feelings.
“Could it be…Is Connor really Yelena’s boyfriend?”
Cindy couldn’t help but whisper..

chapters.title: Chapter 210 - 210: If You Hit Below The Belt, Be Ready to Be Hit Back!
chapters.content:
Chapter 210 - 210: If You Hit Below The Belt, Be Ready to Be Hit Back!
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
The reason why Connor was doing this was to provoke Fabien.
Moreover, Yelena had just admitted that Connor was her boyfriend and wanted Connor to be her shield. Therefore, Connor felt that even if he did something out of line, Yelena would not reject him.
As an A-list internet celebrity with five million fans, her figure and temperament were also top-notch, especially her pair of slender legs, which made people drool just by looking at them.
To be able to hold such a woman in his arms was something that many men dreamed of!
At this moment, Connor embraced Yelena’s delicate body in front of so many people. Waves of her perfume’s fragrance immediately surged into Connor’s nose.
When Connor first met her, he had smelled this fragrance. Now, this scent was even more obvious.
Perhaps it was because of the position of the two people, Connor hugged Yelena from behind. In addition, Yelena was wearing a tulle dress today, so Connor could clearly feel Yelena’s smooth and delicate skin with his right hand. It felt very comfortable.
After Yelena was suddenly hugged by Connor, she could not help but tremble. Then, she whispered to Connor, “Who told you to hug me?”
“If you’re acting, you have to act properly!” Connor replied indifferently.
“You…”
Yelena was speechless, but since things had already come to this, she didn’t dare let go of Connor.
“Fabien, Yelena is my girlfriend. Even if I’m a delivery man and I’m poor, she still likes me. So from now on, 1 hope you won’t pester her anymore,” Connor shouted arrogantly at Fabien.
“Impossible, how could Yelena be with someone like you!”
Fabien’s eyes widened. He couldn’t accept this fact at all. He couldn’t accept that Yelena would rather be with a poor delivery man than him.
“Fabien, I’ve told you many times that Connor is my boyfriend, so please don’t bother me anymore, understand?” Yelena took this opportunity to warn Fabien, then turned to Connor and said, “Connor, let’s go back. I’ll make you something to eat when I get home!”
“Good!”
Connor nodded lightly and turned around to leave with Yelena. After everyone heard the conversation between them, their eyes widened, and their expressions became extremely complicated.
Because from Yelena’s words just now, they could hear that Connor actually lived together with Yelena!
“This… What’s going on?”
At this moment, Cindy was also completely dumbfounded. She opened her mouth and looked at this scene in a daze. Her mouth was so wide that an entire egg could be stuffed into it.
“Stop!”
At this moment, Fabien suddenly shouted at Connor.
Connor turned his head to look at Fabien and asked calmly, “Is there anything else?”
“1 want you to break up with Yelena now, or 1’11 make you regret it for the rest of your life!” Fabien said with red eyes.
“If I don’t break up, what can you do to me?” Connor asked softly.
“You…”
Fabien’s eyes flashed with anger.
Since he was young, he had never been bullied like this. Therefore, after hesitating for a moment, he directly rushed towards Connor.
“Bang!”
Connor saw that Fabien was about to make a move, and without thinking, he kicked Fabien’s stomach.
After Fabien was heavily kicked by Connor, he took two steps back and fell to the ground with a thud.
Connor was pressed to the ground by a 2oo-pound girl in the girls’ dormitory today, so he was already very angry. After all, that girl was too heavy. In addition, Connor had only ever hit Mandy in his life, so he was too embarrassed to fight with girls.
However, just because he couldn’t beat that fat girl didn’t mean that Connor couldn’t beat Fabien. Connor had been exercising since he was young.
