Moreover, before geting the inheritance, he had been delivering food and doing various part-time jobs, so his physical fitness was naturally much better than ordinary people.
Fabien was just a rich young master who was addicted to wine and sex. It was normal for Connor to kick him away easily.
After everyone saw this scene, they all revealed a surprised expression. No one expected Connor to actually dare to attack Fabien!
That was the young master of the Luther Family in Porthampton!
“Connor, why did you hit him?”
After Yelena saw Connor make a move, a trace of helplessness flashed across her face. Because she knew Fabien’s identity and background, she was worried that Fabien would take revenge on Connor.
I’ll kill him first!”
Connor replied indifferently, then continued to walk forward.
“You stinky delivery guy, how dare you hit me? Do you believe that 1’11 kill your entire family?” After Fabien fell to the ground, he shouted at the top of his lungs with a ferocious expression.
“Kill…my whole family?”
After Connor heard Fabien’s words, his face instantly darkened. Then, he repeated what Fabien had just said.
Connor’s temperament had also undergone a huge change. As the saying went, if you hit someone below the belt, then prepare to be hit back!
Everyone had a bottom line. Once it was touched, there was no room for redemption! Connor naturally had his own pride. Even when he was at his poorest, he could give up his dignity, but he would never allow anyone to insult his family!
Because Connor had lost his parents when he was young, his family would always be his greatest weakness!
“I’m sorry, I’m an orphan. You won’t have this chance!”
Connor looked at Fabien and said in a cold tone. Then, he directly walked towards Fabien.
“Connor, what are you doing?” Yelena saw that something was wrong with him and hurriedly reached out to pull him.
“Let go of me!”
Connor shook off Yelena and walked to Fabien with a murderous look.
“You… What are you doing?”
Fabien was also completely dumbfounded at this time, because he did not expect that his words just now would actually make Connor so angry.
“What am 1 doing?” A cold light flashed in Connor’s eyes. He then said indifferently, “1 want you to know what it means to kill your entire family!”
After Fabien heard Connor’s words, he couldn’t help but feel a little scared.
Connor did not continue to talk nonsense with Fabien. He picked up the bottle on the ground and smashed it on Fabien’s head without thinking.
“Bang!”
There was a loud bang.
The wine bottle exploded on Fabien’s head!
Blood flowed down Fabien’s forehead slowly. Everyone was stunned, and the expressions on their faces were all of disbelief..

chapters.title: Chapter 211 - 211: Yelena The Temptation
chapters.content:
Chapter 211 - 211: Yelena The Temptation
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
No one expected that Connor, who looked extremely weak before, to be like this.
It was as if he had changed into a different person. He had become incomparably brave and started fighting at the slightest disagreement!
In fact, Fabian was quite unlucky. If it were the usual Connor, he would never do such an impulsive thing. Even if he were bullied, Connor would stand up for himself.
However, Connor was not in a good mood today. Moreover, Fabian had just mentioned Connor’s family. Connor was naturally very angry, so he suddenly went berserk.
Originally, he had planned to call Thomas over to deal with Fabian, but Connor did not expect Cindy to be here.
Since Cindy was here, Connor naturally couldn’t expose his identity. Since he couldn’t expose his identity, he could only use the simplest and crudest method to resolve today’s matter.
“Connor, are you crazy?”
After Yelena reacted, she hurriedly shouted at Connor.
She never thought Connor would be so impulsive as to hit Fabian in the head with a beer bottle!
“Flehe, Connor, you’re done for today. You even dared to hit Mr. Luther,” Cindy shouted after she reacted.
“How dare you hit me? I think you have a death wish!”
Fabian wiped the blood on his forehead and shouted at the top of his voice.
Connor looked at Fabian in disdain, and without saying anything, he went up and kicked Fabian’s stomach.
Fabian, who had just stood up, fell to the ground again after being kicked by Connor.
Connor then ran over and used his knee to support Fabian’s neck. Then he picked up the beer bottle on the ground and smashed it onto Fabian’s head.
‘Crash!’
The beer bottle exploded on Fabian’s head again.
After smashing the beer bottle, Connor still had no intention of stopping. He continued to slap Fabian’s face ruthlessly.
With every slap, Fabian’s head shook like a rattle-drum. Blood fell to the ground as he shook. The scene was extremely bloody.
“Didn’t you want to kill my entire family? Come on!” Connor shouted at Fabian with bloodshot eyes.
“I… 1 was wrong, please let me go…”
Connor had beaten Fabian with blood all over his head. While dodging Connor’s slap, he begged.
From his current expression, he was obviously afraid of Connor.
“Connor, stop hitting him. Let him go!”
When Yelena reacted, she quickly reached out and pulled Connor off Fabian.
After being pulled away by Yelena, Connor’s anger was still boiling, and he wanted to rush toward Fabian.
However, Fabian stood up and ran away.
Connor was really angry today. The main reason was that Connor had been too misunderstood recently, and Fabian had mentioned his family.
Although Connor was usually very low-key, it didn’t mean that others could bully him!
What was the point of being a rich kid if even Fabian, this trash, could step on his face?
“Little brat, how dare you hit me? Just you wait. If I don’t kill you, 1 must be dumb!”
Fabian’s face was covered in blood, but he didn’t forget to speak harshly to Connor.
“If you’re not convinced, let’s continue!”
Connor narrowed his eyes and looked at Fabian in the distance.
“You crazy? Continue? Just you wait. 1’11 get someone to kill you right now!” Fabian replied with a ferocious look on his face and then got straight into the Ferrari.
The whole thing took less than ten seconds before Fabian disappeared.
A Ferrari’s speed was indeed a little shocking.
After the crowd saw Fabian leave, they were dumbfounded and looked at Connor in disbelief.
No one had expected that today would turn out like this!
“Is Connor crazy? Did he actually hit Fabian? What exactly does he want?” Cindy looked at Connor and muttered with a shocked expression.
At this moment, the people present were also a little dazed, but they no longer suspected the relationship between Connor and Yelena.
They felt that Connor dared to attack Fabian today because Yelena was Connor’s girlfriend. Otherwise, why would Connor do such a thing?
However, most people were looking at Connor with sympathy because they felt that things would not end well for Connor if he dared to beat Fabian up like this.
“Connor, are you alright?”
Yelena ran to Connor’s side and asked worriedly.
“I’m fine…” Connor replied indifferently.
“It’s good that you’re fine. We should leave quickly. Otherwise, you’ll be in trouble when Fabian calls someone over!” Yelena looked at Connor and urged him softly.
When Connor heard this, he couldn’t help but turn to look at Cindy in the crowd. Then, he whispered, “Alright, let’s go!”
Connor would have called Thomas and Kyle over if Cindy weren’t here today.
However, with Cindy here, Connor didn’t want to expose his identity, so he could only leave with Yelena.
After a while, Connor entered Yelena’s car and disappeared from everyone’s sight.
“Connor is Yelena’s boyfriend? How could Yelena like someone like Connor?”
Cindy watched as Connor and Yelena got into the car, and her expression became even more incredulous.
One was a TikTok influencer with five million fans, while the other was a poor loser who made a living by delivering food. Cindy really couldn’t connect the two of them!
“Could that poor loser have turned the tables on the rich and beautiful?” Cindy hesitated before she muttered.
***
On the other side, Connor and Yelena drove away from Aurora Bar.
As Yelena drank, Connor took the initiative to sit in the driver’s seat and helped Yelena start the car.
Yelena was sitting in the passenger seat, looking at Connor.
After a long time, she smiled and said, “Connor, I didn’t expect you to be so manly just now. You beat up a rich heir like Fabian for me…”
When Connor heard this, he couldn’t help but turn to look at Yelena with an awkward smile on his face.
Connor didn’t beat Fabian up for her, but because of what Fabian said to him.
“I’m touched by you today. Connor, why don’t you stop pretending to be my boyfriend and be my boyfriend? I’m rich, and i don’t mind you being poor. Just take it as me supporting you!” Yelena said to Connor with a faint smile.
“You supporting me?”
When Connor heard this, he was stunned.
Yelena sat on the passenger seat and licked her lips. She said to Connor seductively, “Well? I heard you aren’t rich. Do you want me to support you?”
After Connor heard Yelena’s words, he couldn’t help but size her up.
Under Yelena’s short dress, her fair and slender legs were extremely alluring..

chapters.title: Chapter 212 - 212: Let’s Make a Bet
chapters.content:
Chapter 212: Let’s Make a Bet
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
“Aren’t you gay?”
Connor looked at Yelena’s beautiful legs and could not help but gulp.
However, he quickly shook his head to calm himself down. He was worried that he would do something to Yelena if he could not control himself.
“Are you really stupid, or are you pretending to be stupid? Even Fabian knows I’m pretending to be gay to reject those suitors,” Yelena replied indifferently.
“Oh!” Connor nodded lightly and didn’t say anything.
“Have you thought about what I told you just now? Do you want me to support you?” Yelena licked her sexy red lips and asked seductively.
“No!” Connor refused.
“Why?” After Yelena heard Connor’s words, a trace of confusion flashed in her eyes. Then, she looked at Connor and asked, “Is it because I’m not beautiful and hot enough? Or are you worried that I won’t give you enough money?”
“None of them…” Connor lightly shook his head.
“So why did you reject me? So many rich heirs are pursuing me at Porthampton University, and I’ve already rejected them. Now that I’m taking the initiative to ask you to be my guy, you’re rejecting me? Are you gay?” Yelena asked as she sized up Connor.
“I’m not gay!” Connor replied.
“So, why?” Yelena continued to ask.
“Because I already have a fiancee, and my fiancee is even more beautiful than you!” Connor said indifferently.
“You have a fiancee? And even prettier than me?” Yelena could not help but exclaim when she heard what Connor said. She looked at Connor incredulously.
“That’s right!” Connor lightly nodded.
“Impossible. How can you have a fiancee? And she’s prettier than me? Are you lying to me?” Yelena coldly looked at Connor and said.
Connor was speechless when he heard this.
Did he deserve to be single for the rest of his life in her eyes?
‘Ring, ring, ring!’
Yelena’s phone suddenly rang.
“Hello, Lucy. What’s up?” Yelena was stunned, then she answered the phone and asked softly.
“Yelena, I heard that your boyfriend beat up Fabian. Is this true?” The girl on the other end of the phone asked anxiously.
When Yelena heard this, she couldn’t help but turn her head to look at Connor, then said softly, “Yeah, why?”
“Is your boyfriend crazy? Hitting Fabian? 1 heard Fabian has found many thugs to take revenge on your boyfriend. You’d better think of something quickly! If Fabian finds your boyfriend, he will end up in a very miserable state!”
“Got… got it!” Yelena was stunned for a moment before she replied softly.
“By the way, 1 thought you don’t like men? Why do you suddenly have a boyfriend?” The girl asked in confusion.
“I’ll explain this to you later. I’ll think of a way now!”
Yelena was not in the mood to talk about these things. After saying this, she hung up the phone and sighed softly.
Yelena had been flirting with Connor earlier, so she had forgotten about Fabian. If it weren’t for the call from her crush, she would have forgotten about it.
After hanging up the phone, Yelena’s expression became serious.
She knew very well what kind of rich heir Fabian was.
Connor was just a poor student. He was not a match for Fabian at all. So Yelena picked up her phone and wanted to call the people she knew in her circle to see if she could find someone to use their connections to calm Fabian down.
After all, Connor offended Fabian because of her today. Yelena naturally couldn’t leave Connor alone.
“What’s wrong?” Connor turned and asked Yelena.
“What else could it be? Fabian is going to take revenge on you. You’re dead!” Yelena frowned and replied in a low voice. Then, she dialed a phone number.
“Yelena, what’s up?”
A middle-aged man’s voice came from the other end of the phone.
“Liam, my friend had a conflict with someone today. Can you help me resolve it?” Yelena asked with a smile.
“You called me for help. How could I reject you? Who did your friend have a conflict with? I’ll help you fix the situation…” Liam asked with a smile.
“Do you know Fabian?” Yelena asked hesitantly.
After Liam heard the name ‘Fabian’, he suddenly fell silent. After a long time, he continued, “Yelena, the person who beat up Mr. Luther at Aurora Bar today is your friend?”
“Yeap…” Yelena nodded gently.
“Yelena, it’s not that 1 don’t want to help you, but I’m just a gangster. Fabian is a famous heir in Porthampton. I can’t afford to offend such a person!” Liam said helplessly.
“Alright then!” Yelena replied disappointedly after hearing Liam’s words. Then, she hung up the phone and began to call others.
After a few phone calls, Yelena was in complete despair.
After hearing Fabian’s name, all her friends rejected Yelena’s request for help.
“Sigh…”
Yelena turned off her phone in despair and turned to Connor. “Tell me, what were you thinking? 1 only asked you to pretend to be my boyfriend. Who asked you to hit Fabian? Now that things have turned out this way, let’s see how you will get away with this!”
“Don’t worry, Fabian will be delivering food in a few days!” Connor replied indifferently.
“What… If you ask Fabian to deliver food, do you think he would? Who do you think you are?”
Yelena thought Connor was joking, her eyes widened as she shouted.
“Why don’t we make a bet?” Connor asked Yelena with a smile.
“A bet?” Yelena was stunned and then said helplessly, “Connor, do you understand what’s happening? Yet, you’re still in the mood to bet with me when Fabian has already started to look for you in Porthampton. Once he finds you, you will die brutally!”
“So, do you want to bet with me?”
Connor didn’t take Fabian’s matter to heart at all because, to Connor, Fabian was just an insignificant person.
“What do you want to bet on?” Yelena asked weakly as she flipped through her phone’s contact list to help Connor find reinforcements.
“Let’s bet whether Fabian will deliver food within three days!” Connor said lightly.
“Alright, if Fabian doesn’t deliver food within three days, what will you owe me?” Yelena replied softly.
“What do you want?” Connor asked.
“What do I want?”
After hearing this, Yelena immediately put down her phone and looked at Connor with a charming smile..

chapters.title: Chapter 213 - 213: One Million Dollars Earned
chapters.content:
Chapter 213: One Million Dollars Earned
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
After Connor saw Yelena’s expression, he couldn’t help but gulp. Then, he embarrassedly said, “Why are you looking at me like that?”
“Nothing. Didn’t you say you wanted to bet with me just now?”
Yelena lifted her beautiful legs and sat beside Connor, replying seductively.
“Have you thought about what you want to bet?”
Connor looked at Yelena and asked.
“If Fabian doesn’t deliver food within three days, 1 win. You have to agree to be my boyfriend.” Yelena licked her sexy red lips and said with a smile.
“Be your boyfriend?” Connor was instantly speechless when he heard this.
Logically speaking, a beautiful woman like Yelena probably wouldn’t have any issues getting any man she wanted. Connor could not understand why Yelena kept wanting him to be her boyfriend!
‘Does Yelena know my identity?’ Connor wondered.
However, he quickly denied this idea. After all, the panic on Yelena’s face when she found out that Fabian was about to attack him was not faked.
If Yelena knew his identity, she shouldn’t be worried about this.
“Well? What do you think?” Yelena asked Connor with a smile.
“Didn’t I just tell you I have a fiancee?” Connor replied indifferently.
“It doesn’t matter. You can break up with her first and then be my boyfriend…” Yelena said matter-of-factly.
“No, I just don’t understand. There are so many rich heirs pursuing you. Why do you have to be with me?” Connor was very puzzled as he asked Yelena.
“There’s no reason. I just want to be with you.” Yelena pouted and said.
Connor was instantly speechless when he heard this.
“Are you scared to put the bet down?” Yelena looked at Connor teasingly.
Connor looked at Yelena and hesitated. Then, he nodded and said, “Why would I be scared?”
Connor felt he could not bear to lose, so he agreed.
“Alright, although you will lose this time, we must make things clear in advance. If you win, what do you want me to do?”
Seeing that Connor agreed, she smiled proudly and asked Connor.
“Today, you helped me find the person who framed me. You have asked me to promise you one thing. If I win this time, I’ll write off what I owe you.”
Connor felt that Yelena could do anything, so he wanted to take back what he had promised Yelena before!
“No problem!” Yelena immediately nodded.
Connor turned to look at Yelena, his expression very calm.
He knew he could ask Fabian to deliver the food with just a word, so he would never lose.
Yelena had the same thought. Fabian was part of the Luther Family, and the Luther Family’s fixed assets in Porthampton were close to 100 million.
Even if the Luther Family were really bankrupt, Fabian would not be able to deliver food. Therefore, she felt that it was impossible for her to lose.
***
Meanwhile…
At the entrance of Harlem’s Gold.
Mandy and Lily walked out of the casino. Mandy looked very proud, and the corners of her mouth were filled with a bright smile.
After Mandy received five million from Connor, she had always wanted to find a place to spend it.
After all, she suddenly became a millionaire from being ordinary. Naturally, she wanted to experience the life of a rich person.
Therefore, Lily showed Mandy to the most famous casino in Porthampton, Harlem’s Gold.
Harlem’s Gold wasn’t just a casino. It was also an entertainment and leisure center combining restaurants, theaters, hotels, and many other establishments.
It was not an exaggeration to say that Harlem’s Gold was a place for the rich to squander money. Money was spent like water inside. The entrance ticket alone cost 20,000 dollars, but 20,000 dollars was nothing to Mandy now.
When she first entered the casino, Mandy was still a little nervous. She only exchanged 100,000 dollars in chips and found the Blackjack station she had played with Brandon at other casinos.
After Mandy entered the gambling den, she had been playing very cautiously. Each round was neither big nor small, costing exactly 1,000 dollars.
After all, she didn’t come here to make money but to experience the atmosphere of this casino. She also took a few selfies and posted them on her Facebook account to show off so everyone would know that she, Mandy Hines, had been to Harlem’s Gold.
But Mandy did not expect that her luck today was abundant.
In less than half an hour, the 100,000 dollars in her hand had become 300,000 dollars, attracting the attention of countless people.
Mandy also seemed to enjoy the feeling of being the center of attention. She began to become bolder and bet more and more.
Meanwhile, Lily sat beside Mandy and looked at her with envy.
Mandy had earned more than a million dollars in less than two hours!
One had to know that a million dollars was a lifetime income for an ordinary person!
But at this time, Mandy won easily in less than two hours.
If it were her before, it would be something that she would not even dare to dream of.
“Lily, this place you brought me here is so fun! i won a million dollars today. If it was before, I don’t think I could earn so much money in my life!”
Mandy turned and said to Lily excitedly.
“Yeah, Mandy, your luck is through the roof!” Lily said enviously.
“I don’t think it’s a matter of luck. It’s mainly because i have money now, so I’m bolder. As long as I’m bolder, I can naturally win money.”
Mandy shared her experience of winning money with Lily.
“Makes sense!”
Lily nodded gently and continued, “But Mandy, I think it’s better for us not to come to such places. Moreover, you’ve already earned more than a million dollars today. It should be enough for you to spend a long time!”
“Ah, why are you so timid? I’ve been very lucky. i think this should be a chance given to me by the heavens, so I’ll come back tomorrow!” Mandy looked at Lily and said.
“But what if you lose?” Lily asked.
“Don’t worry, I won’t lose. I’ll use the one million I won today as a bargaining chip. If I lose everything, then I won’t gamble anymore. If I win, then it’ll be a net profit! I’m going to win five million and then stop!” Mandy said with a smile.
“That’s right. You won’t lose anything even if you lose this one million dollars. You’re really smart!” Lily quickly said after she reacted.
“Hehe, that’s right! If I’m not smart, how can I get five million from that fool?”
Mandy replied proudly, then reached out to flag down a taxi and rushed to school..

chapters.title: Chapter 214 - 214: Come to My Place!
chapters.content:
Chapter 214 - 214: Come to My Place!
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
On the other side, Connor drove Yelena to the entrance of the neighborhood.
“I’m off!” After getting off the car, Connor whispered to Yelena.
“Don’t you wanna come over to mine for a bit?”
Seeing that Connor was about to leave, Yelena hurriedly asked.
“Next time. I’m a little tired today and want to go back and rest early!” Connor said as he prepared to walk out of the neighborhood.
“If you want to rest, you can rest at my house. If you think it’s too late, you can stay at mine tonight!”
Yelena reached out and pulled Connor back, speaking to him softly.
Connor was instantly stunned.
If another girl said she wanted Connor to stay at hers, Connor might not think too much, but Yelena was different.
When they were in the car, Yelena said that she wanted to ‘support’ Connor and even took the initiative to seduce him.
Now, she was even more straightforward and said that she wanted Connor to stay in his house!
Wasn’t she coming on a little too strong?
Connor really couldn’t understand what kind of luck he had recently to be taken in by a TikTok influencer like Yelena!
Yelena noticed the hesitation in Connor’s eyes and said with a smile, “Connor, what are you waiting for? Hurry up and follow me upstairs!”
“We’re alone. It’s not appropriate for us to stay together, right?” Connor said.
“What’s inappropriate about it? Are you afraid that 1’11 kill you?” Yelena smiled teasingly.
“Didn’t you say you wanted me to be your boyfriend?” Connor replied, embarrassed.
After Yelena heard this, she was stunned for a moment before she burst into laughter.
“What are you laughing at?” Connor asked Yelena, puzzled.
“Haha, you’re funny… Do you really think I’ve fallen for you? Who am I, Yelena? Some so many men like me. Why should 1 chase after a poor loser like you who doesn’t have money or looks!” Yelena laughed as she pointed at Connor.
“Since you don’t like me, why do you want me to stay over? I’d better go back!”
Connor was a little angry at Yelena’s words, so he turned around and walked toward the compound without thinking.
“Are you angry?” Yelena saw Connor’s expression and hurriedly asked.
“No, I’m just a little tired and want to go back early!” Connor said without turning back.
“Connor, I only asked you to spend the night at mine because I was worried that you would meet Fabian and his people on the way. Don’t forget that Fabian is looking for you all over Porthampton.”
“He won’t dare to do anything to me!” Connor replied indifferently.
“Are you crazy? People like Fabian are vengeful. Are you sure he won’t dare to touch you? No matter what, you offended Fabian because of me. 1 don’t want to see anything happen to you, so you’d better not leave. Just stay at my house for a night!”
When Yelena saw that Connor was going to leave, she couldn’t help but raise her voice a little.
When Connor heard Yelena’s words, a trace of hesitation flashed across his face. He suddenly felt that what Yelena said just now was quite reasonable.
Fabian had been beaten up by him just now, and he knew Connor had left with Yelena. If Fabian found someone to intercept him on the way, Connor would be in danger. It was getting late, and Connor did not want to trouble Kyle and the others to protect him.
So now that Connor and Yelena were staying at home for a night, it could reduce unnecessary trouble.
“Alright then. Since you don’t mind, I’ll stay at yours tonight!” Connor gave in reluctantly.
“Tsk!”
After Yelena heard that, she couldn’t help but snort. Then, she rolled her eyes and said, “Do you know how many people dream of spending the night at mine? I rejected them all. But here 1 am, inviting you to stay at mine for the night yet you make it look like I’m forcing you. Who do you think you are?”
Connor smiled awkwardly when he heard that. Then, he followed Yelena into the compound.
***
Ten minutes later, Connor arrived at Yelena’s house.
Yelena’s place was not particularly big. It was a standard two-bedroom apartment.
Although the house wasn’t big, it was very homey and clean.
“Are you renting this apartment or do you own it?” Connor sat on the sofa and asked Yelena.
“1 bought this place. There are two rooms inside. You can sleep in the other room tonight!” Yelena replied indifferently.
“Alright!” Connor nodded gently and prepared to get up to take a look at the guest room.
However, at this moment, Yelena suddenly reached out and unbuttoned her shirt as if she was about to take off her clothes.
“What… What are you doing?”
Connor was shocked by Yelena’s action and stammered.
“Taking off my clothes! What else?!” Yelena replied indifferently and took off her shirt.
Connor subconsciously closed his eyes.
When Yelena saw Connor’s reaction, she couldn’t help but laugh. Then, she said, “Connor, why are so funny? Hurry up and open your eyes. I’m wearing clothes underneath!”
When Connor heard this, he was stunned for a moment. Then, he slowly opened his eyes. He realized that Yelena was not lying to him.
At this moment, Yelena was still wearing a white body-hugging tank top that wrapped around her voluptuous body. She looked especially alluring.
“Phew!”
Connor couldn’t help but take a deep breath to calm his restlessness.
However, Yelena was too tempting. Her body seemed filled with magic, constantly attracting Connor’s attention.
“Well? I’m pretty hot, right? Am 1 not hotter than your fiancee?”
Seeing Connor like this, the smile on Yelena’s face became even more charming as she asked Connor gently.
“Not as good as my fiancee!” Connor shook his head without thinking.
“Tsk!” Yelena couldn’t help but roll her eyes at Connor, then softly said, “Entertain yourself with the TV for a bit. I’m going to take a shower!”
After saying this, Yelena walked into the bathroom without looking back, not giving Connor a chance to speak.
Shower?
Connor was stunned. Then, he remembered that Xena had used the same trick before.
First, she tricked him into going home with her and then said she would take a shower. After showering, she would probably change into sexy clothes to seduce him.
In fact, it was not that Connor was too vigilant. The main thing was that Yelena was acting strange.
Furthermore, Connor didn’t want to do anything to let Freya down, which was why he was so suspicious.
The most important thing was that what Yelena did today was the same as what Xena did back then. It was the same trick!
“These women know how to play. I’d better leave!”
Connor sat on the sofa and hesitated before getting up and leaving. He felt that if he stayed here, something would happen later.
However, just as Connor was about to get up and leave, the bathroom door suddenly opened.
When Connor saw Yelena walking out of the bathroom, his eyes instantly widened, and he was very surprised.
Connor did not expect Yelena to finish showering so quickly and was already in a new set of clothes!
Yelena was wearing a black lace nightdress. Her hair was wet, and her body was hot. The night dress wrapped around Yelena’s curvaceous figure, exposing her beautiful legs to Connor’s eyes.
Looking at the sexy and seductive Yelena before him, Connor could not take his eyes off her.
After a long time, Connor finally recovered and couldn’t help but sigh internally. ‘What is this Yelena doing? Is she really seducing me?’
Connor couldn’t understand.. If Yelena wasn’t seducing him, why would she wear such sexy pajamas around him?

Natasha looked at Cindy’s anxious expression and couldn’t help but turn around to take a look. Then, she asked in confusion, “Cindy, what’s wrong with you?”
“Natasha, guess who 1 ran into at Aurora Bar today?” Cindy rushed up to Natasha and panted.
“Who?” Natasha asked.
“I met that loser Connor at Aurora Bar. Now I finally understand why Connor rejected you when you confessed to him!” Cindy said loudly.
When Natasha confessed to Connor at Phillips’ Signature, Connor rejected her outright. To prevent Cindy from finding out Connor’s identity, Natasha made up an excuse that she wanted to use Connor as a shield.
“Connor?”
Natasha’s interest was piqued when she heard the name. She looked at Cindy and asked, “Why did Connor reject me?”
“Connor rejected you because he already has a girlfriend. Moreover, Connor’s girlfriend is the popular influencer Yelena from Porthampton University!”
“Who?” After Natasha heard what Cindy said, her heartbeat accelerated.
She never thought Connor would be snatched away by someone else after not looking for him for a few days. Moreover, the woman who snatched Connor away was an influencer!
“It’s that Yelena who’s recently been very popular on TikTok!”
Cindy replied before continuing, “1 didn’t expect Connor to be so popular that he could even hook up with Yelena. If I hadn’t seen Connor offend Fabian for Yelena today, I wouldn’t have believed they were together!”
“It’s over…”
Natasha looked at Cindy beside her and called out with a despairing expression.
“What do you mean?” Cindy asked in confusion.
“No… It’s nothing…” Natasha gritted her teeth and replied. At this moment, her intestines were about to turn green with regret.
If she had known that someone else would take Connor, she would not have been indifferent these few days.
“Are you saying that Connor is finished? Connor was finished this time. He dared to offend someone like Fabian. Fabian would not let him off for sure!” Cindy said slowly.
Natasha turned her head and looked at Cindy, speechless. In Cindy’s eyes, Connor might not be able to offend Fabian, but Natasha was very clear about Connor’s identity. Not to mention Fabian, even the Luther Family backing him might not be a match for Connor.
Only one thing was on her mind now: how she should snatch Connor back from Yelena!
If another girl had snatched Connor away, Natasha might not have collapsed like this. However, she was helpless because this girl turned out to be Yelena, the influencer!
Natasha’s figure and appearance were probably inferior to Yelena’s, so she didn’t know what to do.
***
In Yelena’s house.
When Connor saw Yelena walk out of the bathroom, he was instantly stunned. He was very nervous.
Back at Xena’s house, it was the same situation. Xena first tricked Connor into returning to hers, then said she would shower. After that, she started to seduce Connor.
Last time, Connor almost had sex with Xena. Fortunately, Freya called him, and he managed to control himself.
It didn’t matter if it was Xena or Yelena; these women were too tempting. To a little virgin like Connor, they were simply like sirens!
However, a voice in Connor’s heart was telling him that he absolutely could not do anything to let Freya down!
Connor had fallen for Xena’s tricks because he felt his relationship with Freya was superficial. Even if he slept with Xena, it had nothing to do with Freya.
However, the situation was different now. Freya had already made it very clear to Connor. She could slowly try to accept Connor. If she married Connor, she would not like other men.
Furthermore, the inheritance contract clearly stated that Connor had to sincerely make Freya fall in love with him within the stipulated time!
Connor had fallen in love with Freya from the moment he saw her. He felt it was impossible between him and Freya because of Freya’s cold attitude.
But now that Connor had seen hope in Freya, he naturally had to put all his feelings on Freya.
Although rich people liked to flirt with women everywhere, Connor was still a traditional boy.
When Yelena saw that Connor was about to leave, she hurriedly asked, “Connor, what are you doing?”
“Well, I suddenly remembered that I still have something to do. I think I should leave now?” Connor replied nervously.
“You have something to do?” Yelena couldn’t help but laugh. Then, she sat on the sofa and smiled. “Connor, are you afraid that I will do something to you, so you are in a hurry to go back?”
When Connor heard that, he could not help but be stunned. Then, he said bluntly, “You’re already dressed like this, and you still have the cheek to say that you don’t have any feelings for me?”
Yelena couldn’t help but look up at Connor. A strange look flashed in her beautiful eyes.
“I already told you that I have a fiancee. Why won’t you let me go? 1 won’t have anything to do with you!” Connor looked at Yelena and said righteously. Then, he turned around and was about to leave.
“Wait!” Yelena saw that Connor was really going to leave and hurriedly called out.
“What now?”
The more Connor looked at Yelena, the more danger he sensed. There was only one thought in his mind: to leave this place as soon as possible.
“Connor, are you really going to leave me here alone?”
Yelena stared at Connor with her big, charming eyes.
“Yelena, what are you trying to do?”
When Connor saw Yelena acting like that, his guard came down.
“I am not trying to do anything. Come and sit over here. It’s not like I’ll kill you…”
As Yelena spoke, she stroked her sexy and fair legs under the lace nightdress.
When Connor heard this, he seemed to become somewhat hesitant.
Especially when he saw Yelena’s beautiful legs, even his breathing became heavy.
That was because Yelena’s beautiful legs were too alluring. They were not only of moderate thickness but also smooth and tender, making them look especially sexy and charming..

Chapter 216: Misunderstanding Yelena Allen
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
“I have something to do. Goodbye.”
Connor gritted his teeth and replied in a low voice.
“Connor, why are you acting this way? I’m asking you to take advantage of me, but you refuse to do so. Hurry up and come over. 1 want to talk with you!” Yelena said with a smile.
“What do you want to talk about? Can’t we talk right where we’re standing?” “Connor, 1 have such a good figure. Don’t you want to come over and feel it?” Yelena slightly parted her beautiful legs and continued to seduce Connor. To be able to have sex with a beautiful internet celebrity was perhaps the dream of most men, and it was naturally the same for Connor.
But at this moment, Connor looked at the beautiful Yelena in front of him and felt a little uneasy.
Connor was not a gentleman, and he also wanted to have a relationship with such a beautiful woman.
However, at this moment, there was a voice in Connor’s mind that kept reminding him to stay calm. There was no free lunch in this world, let alone a beautiful woman who would deliver herself to his door. This must be a trap!
The misunderstanding between Connor and Freya Phillips had yet to be resolved. If he really had sex with Yelena and fell into her trap, then Yelena might very well become the second Mandy Hines!
Connor took a deep breath and calmed his restless emotions. Then, he looked at Yelena expressionlessly and asked, “Why are you doing this?”
“Why?”
When Yelena heard this, she couldn’t help but be stunned for a moment. Then, she widened her foxlike eyes and said, “I don’t have any ulterior motives. I just want you to come over and chat with me.”
“Do you already know my identity? You want to seduce me and use this to threaten me, right?”
Connor took a step forward and shouted at Yelena.
If Yelena didn’t know his identity, then Connor really couldn’t understand why a beauty like Yelena would take the initiative to give herself to him.
After all, in her eyes, Connor was just a poor kid who had no money or status. If it was just because Connor had helped Yelena beat Fabien Luther up, it would obviously be unreasonable.
Therefore, Connor felt that Yelena knew his real identity, which was why she was doing this.
Mandy’s matter had taught Connor a lesson. He would never make the same mistake a second time.
“Your identity?”
When Yelena heard this, she could not help but be stunned for a moment.
Then, she asked in a puzzled tone, “Who are you?”
“You don’t have to care about my identity. What exactly do you want to do? If you don’t tell me upfront, I’ll leave now!”
Connor shouted.
Yelena looked at Connor with disdain and laughed, “You’re no fun. Forget it, 1 won’t joke with you anymore!”
After saying this, Yelena yawned and turned around to walk toward her bedroom.
“Joke with me? What do you mean?”
Connor was a little confused by Yelena’s words and quickly asked.
“Actually, I’ve never thought of having sex with you. When I saw how innocent you looked, 1 wanted to play a joke on you. Otherwise, why do you think 1 would tease you? I’m so good-looking, with big breasts and a curvy waist. Why should I sleep with a delivery man like you?”
Yelena replied indifferently.
“If you didn’t want to sleep with me, then why did you seduce me and bring me to your house?”
Connor was stunned for a moment and asked.
“Didn’t 1 already explain it to you? I brought you to my house because I wanted you to stay at my house for a night. 1 was worried that Fabien would find you and beat you until you were paralyzed.”
Yelena said lightly as she smoothened her nightgown.
“Then, why are you dressed so sexily?”
Connor quickly asked the second question in his heart.
“What’s wrong with wearing a nightgown after taking a shower? Besides, I’m not dressed like this for you. Why are you so narcissistic?”
Yelena could not help but roll her eyes at Connor.
“There are only the two of us here. If you’re not wearing it for me, are you wearing it for ghosts?”
Connor shouted righteously.
“Sigh…”
Yelena shook her head gently and said helplessly, “I’m going to start a live broadcast later. Can’t I dress like this for my fans?”
“You want to broadcast it live?
Connor was stunned when he heard this.
“That’s right. I just signed a contract with Twitch a few days ago. Otherwise, where would 1 get so much money to buy a car and a house?”
Yelena replied softly, then strode into her bedroom.
Connor hesitated for a moment before following Yelena in.
Yelena’s bedroom was also decorated very warmly. Most of it was pink, including the curtains, carpets, and bed covers.
There was also a computer beside the bed, and it had a complete set of equipment like a ring light, microphone, and other things.
Previously, Connor had seen Mina’s live broadcast equipment. It was similar to Yelena’s current one.
“Did 1 really misunderstand Yelena? She didn’t dress like this for me but for the live broadcast?”
At this moment, Connor’s heart began to waver.
If Yelena really didn’t know his identity, then she really had no reason to seduce Connor.
Yelena stood in front of the camera and briefly adjusted the equipment. After confirming that there was no problem, she turned on the computer.
Then, she turned and said to Connor, “When I’m broadcasting later, don’t speak. Don’t appear in the stream either. Otherwise, the netizens will misunderstand.”
“Oh!”
Connor lightly nodded.
When Yelena saw Connor nod in agreement, she started the Twitch livestream. Yelena then appeared on the computer screen.
When the live broadcast room was opened, a large number of netizens instantly entered. These netizens also started to send comments to greet Yelena.
“Good evening, everyone. I’m a little late for the broadcast tonight. I hope everyone won’t criticize me!”
Yelena also began to interact with the netizens in the live broadcast room.
“It doesn’t matter. It doesn’t matter that you’re late. After all, the goddess is beautiful!”
“Yes, yes, yes. Even if the beauty is late, we are willing to wait!”
“Goddess Yelena, your pajamas today are so sexy!”
The bootlickers in the live broadcast room began to spam stream with comments.
Connor stood at the side with an awkward expression. He finally realized that Yelena wasn’t dressed like this to seduce him.
She was dressed like this for the live broadcast.
He was the one who was thinking too much.
Connor looked at Yelena, who was chatting with her fans, and instantly felt like he was alone.
Because today’s matter was really too embarrassing.. Yelena was so beautiful; why should she take the initiative to seduce a poor loser like him!

chapters.title: Chapter 217 - 217: Meeting an Acquaintance in the Livestream Room
chapters.content:
Chapter 217: Meeting an Acquaintance in the Livestream Room
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
In the blink of an eye, two hours had passed.
Connor had been sitting on the sofa in the bedroom, quietly watching Yelena’s livestream.
Yelena’s livestream was very popular, even more popular than Mina’s. She also received a lot of tips.
After all, Yelena had more than five million fans on the Twitch platform. Naturally, she would be able to bring in a lot of traffic on the Twitch live broadcast platform.
“Goddess Yelena, the platform’s PK competition is about to begin. Aren’t we going to watch the show?”
At this moment, a comment suddenly popped up.
Yelena was stunned for a moment after seeing the comment, then she said softly, “Alright then, I’ll bring you guys to the PK competition later. You guys must work hard and help me get first place! I’ll use this time to prepare. I’ll see you later! Bye bye…”
After saying that, Yelena directly ended the livestream.
In fact, Yelena had no interest in this PK competition at all. She just wanted to find an excuse to end the livestream.
“I’m so tired. I can finally rest!”
After ending the livestream, Yelena stretched her back.
“They can’t hear you now?”
Connor was stunned for a moment and asked Yelena softly.
“I’ve already ended my stream, so they can’t hear me. However, I’m going to participate in the PK competition later, so I’ll have to start streaming again!”
Yelena explained calmly. Then, she clicked her mouse twice and entered the page of the PK competition.
After a while, Yelena opened a streamer’s live broadcast room.
However, when Connor saw the streamer that Yelena had clicked on, he was stunned. His expression was one of disbelief.
Because Connor never thought that he would actually see her here!
The female streamer who appeared on the computer screen was none other than Connor’s roommate, Mina.
Connor didn’t think that Mina would also participate in the Twitch streaming platform’s PK competition.
As Connor had been busy recently, he had not seen Mina for a long time. Naturally, he had not been to Mina’s live broadcast room to watch her live broadcast.
Mina was dressed very seductively today. She was wearing a white spaghetti-strap short skirt and had an oval-shaped face without any makeup. It was smooth and delicate, making people want to take a bite out of her.
Mina seemed to be in a good mood today, with a faint smile on her face.
“Do you know this female streamer?”
Yelena couldn’t help but ask curiously when she saw how excited Connor was.
“Yeah, sort of. I’ve watched her live broadcast before!”
Connor hesitated for a moment and replied.
“This female streamer is called Mina. She was not a well-known streamer! However, because of the sudden appearance of a tycoon called CeeM in her live broadcast room, Mina made it big. At her peak, her popularity was even higher than mine. It’s just that recently, CeeM hasn’t been showing himself, so her popularity has dropped a lot!”
Yelena softly explained to Connor.
“Oh, I see!”
Connor nodded lightly and didn’t say anything else.
“I know a little secret about Mina. Do you want to hear it?”
Yelena asked Connor mysteriously.
“What secret?”
Connor was stunned.
“If you want to hear it, come sit on my lap…”
Yelena didn’t forget to tease Connor and gently patted her slender and fair legs.
In fact, Yelena did not really want to do anything with Connor. After all, she was a very conservative girl. She just liked to see Connor being all shy.
“Yelena, can you stop joking with me? What secret do you want to tell me?”
Connor naturally wouldn’t fall for it now, so he replied helplessly.
“Hehe…”
Seeing Connor like this, Yelena smiled cheekily and said lightly, “I heard from my friend that the rich guy in Mina’s stream wanted to rape Mina, but Mina found out and reported him to the police. He was sent to the police station. He hasn’t been released yet, so the popularity of Mina’s stream plummeted!”
“Who… Who did you hear this from?”
Connor exclaimed.
The person who was sent to the police station by Mina was Hector Flynn. Hector was simply pretending to be CeeM, and Connor was the real CeeM!
“This matter has long been circulating in the circle, and Mina herself didn’t deny it. Why are you so agitated?”
Yelena pouted and replied softly.
“Nonsense!”
Connor clearly felt like he was being falsely accused of committing rape, so he became even more agitated.
“How am I spouting nonsense? This matter has already spread throughout the circle! Since the rich man had given Mina so many bits, even if she didn’t want to sleep with him, she didn’t have to call the police, right? What if he takes revenge on her after his release?” Yelena said indifferently.
Connor turned to look at Yelena and opened his mouth but didn’t say anything.
He wanted to explain on Mina’s behalf, but when he thought about how Yelena didn’t know that he was the real CeeM, even if he explained, Yelena probably wouldn’t believe him.
However, Yelena’s words reminded Connor that it had been a long time since he went to Mina’s livestream to buy bits. It was easy for people to misunderstand.
“What is this PK competition?”
Connor hesitated for a moment before asking Yelena softly.
“The PK competition is something that Twitch recently organized. During a live broadcast, a streamer can challenge a streamer from another live broadcast room. Two female streamers will PK together. Within a specified time, the streamer who receives the most bits will win. The winner will be able to enter the next round until they get first place!”
Yelena explained softly.
“Isn’t this a way of getting lots of money? They are stimulating the netizens to give the female streamers bits.” Connor had heard Mina mention these things before.
“Yeah, that’s more or less what it means!”
Yelena nodded and continued, “Although it’s said to be a way to get lots of money from the netizens, as long as you enter the top three in the PK, you will be able to get one million cash as reward. However, if you are eliminated in the first round, the bits that the streamer receive this month will be taken by the streaming platform. Moreover, this PK competition is mandatory for all streamers. Even if you can’t get a million cash as reward, everyone doesn’t want to work for nothing this month!”
“I didn’t expect the live broadcast platform to be so evil.”
Connor could not help but sigh.
“Of course, there are many unspoken rules in the live streaming industry. Don’t think that the platform only earns money from the netizens,” Yelena said indignantly,
“Haha…”
Connor looked at Yelena and smiled without saying anything..

Queenie, on the other hand, had an indifferent expression on her face, as if she did not feel the slightest bit of regret for the viewers’ departure.

“She doesn’t care about these losers at all. Anyway, she knows that she can’t lose today, so she naturally won’t spoil them!” Yelena said lightly.

In the blink of an eye, twenty minutes had passed.
Mina received bits of nearly 20,000 dollars, while Queenie’s bits were still around 100 dollars.
However, Queenie wasn’t in a hurry at all. She sat on the spot and played with her phone. Compared to the previous Queenie who tried her best to get bits, it was as if she was a completely different person.

“Call Me Big Brother Ocean gave [Queenie] 50,000 bits!”
“Call Me Big Brother Ocean gave [Queenie] 100,000 bits!”
Similar comments kept appearing in Queenie’s live broadcast room.
The viewers in Mina’s live stream were all dumbfounded.
After all, the other party had offered 100,000 dollars in one go. Each of them would only have a few hundred dollars at most. They were no match for the other party’s nouveau riche.
“Even if I have to eat dirt this month, I will help Goddess Mina win!”
“That’s right, brothers, hurry up and buy bits. F*ck Queenie to death!”
“Everyone, hurry up and top up. We have more people, so we can definitely help Goddess Mina win the competition!”
The viewers in Mina’s livestream seemed to be a little unconvinced and began to send some small bits, but the effect was still not very obvious.
“Everyone, stop sending me bits. It’s not easy for you to earn money. I’ll just admit defeat in today’s competition!”
Actually, Mina didn’t really want to win. After all, this was just a way for the live streaming platform to make money.
Therefore, when she saw the other party’s tycoon starting to show his strength, she began to appeal to those netizens to stop sending gifts.
Two minutes passed.
Queenie’s rewards had already exceeded 500,000, and Mina’s rewards had reached 100,000 with the support of the netizens.
“I didn’t expect Mina to receive bits of 100,000 dollars today. She’s really amazing…”
Yelena looked at the computer screen and sighed softly.
“You seemed to have known from the start that Mina was going to lose. How did you know?”
Connor hesitated for a moment, then turned to Yelena and asked.
“Queenie is considered a second-tier streamer in Twitch. Although she doesn’t have many fans, all the streamers on this platform know her. Because her boyfriend is a rich second-generation heir, that’s the guy called Brother Ocean. So, at the last moment, her boyfriend would definitely appear and help her win the competition!” Yelena said slowly.
“Haha…”
Connor couldn’t help but laugh when he heard this. Then, he said indifferently, “Since that person is her boyfriend, why doesn’t he just give her the money? Why did he come to the platform to buy bits? In the end, wouldn’t the platform take a commission?”
“What do you know?”
Yelena rolled her eyes at Connor and continued to explain, “If Queenie can enter the top three in this PK competition, then all the gifts she has received during this period of time will be returned 100%. Moreover, she will also receive a reward of one million dollars. In other words, as long as you have enough money, you can give as much as you want. As long as you enter the top three, not only will you not lose money, but you will also earn money!”
“F*ck, what a trick!”
Connor seemed to be speechless.
“That’s right. There are many tricks in our live streaming industry!”
Yelena replied indifferently.
“So, if they return 100% of the money for the bits, how will the platform make money?” Connor was stunned for a moment before asking.
“Are you stupid?”
Yelena rolled her eyes at Connor, then pouted and said, “Only the top three streamers can get 100% of the bits. Most of the remaining streamers’ bits will be taken by the platform as commission. Moreover, some of the streamers’ bits will be confiscated by the platform, so the platform will rely on these streamers to earn money!”
“I see!”
Connor nodded lightly and didn’t say anything.
If Yelena hadn’t explained these things to him today, Connor really wouldn’t have known that there were so many tricks in the live broadcast industry.
Just as Connor was talking to Yelena, there were less than three minutes left in the match between Mina and Queenie.
Mina felt that even if she lost today, it was not a big deal. Wasn’t it just losing a month’s worth of bits?
Last time, Connor had given her several million dollars in her live broadcast room. She did not lack money at all now, so she began to persuade the viewers in the live broadcast room not to send bits anymore.
“Mina, it seems like you’re going to lose. Why don’t you ask that tycoon of yours to come and give bits?”
Queenie asked Mina with a smug expression when she saw that she was about to win.
Mina was stunned when she heard Queenie’s words.
“Haha, you guys might not know this. Mina sent the rich man from her live streaming room to the police station…”
“This woman is really too vicious. She took money from CeeM and not only did she not sleep with him, but she also called the police and said that he wanted to rape her. I’ve never seen a streamer like her!”
“Yeah, she usually looks cold and aloof, but she’s actually a b*tch. Don’t you find it disgusting looking at such a person?”
The rich tycoons who had sent Queenie bits went to Mina’s live broadcast room and started to send comments to mock Mina.
“Who do you think you are now that CeeM is gone? You actually want to beat my wife? How shameless! 1’11 give everyone a locked gift!”
After Brother Ocean sent the comment, he sent a locked gift worth 8,888 dollars.
A locked gift required a password, and the password for the gift was ‘B*tch Mina’!
Any netizen who sent these two words could share the gift money.
In an instant, Mina’s live broadcast room was covered by the words ‘B*itch Mina’..

chapters.title: Chapter 220 - 220: CeeM Is Back
chapters.content:
Chapter 220 - 220: CeeM Is Back
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
When Mina saw the words ‘B*tch Mina’ all over her screen, her expression turned ugly.
She had already planned to give up on this competition, but she did not expect them to use such vicious means to attack her.
Mina couldn’t help but tear up.
The viewers who supported Mina had no way to help her. After all, Brother Ocean was too rich. They were no match for him.
“If only CeeM is here!”
“That’s right. If CeeM were here, this group of people wouldn’t dare to be so arrogant!”
The viewers in the live broadcast room began to continuously spam the word ‘CeeM’.
In an instant, the word ‘CeeM’ covered the words ‘B*tch Mina’.
Connor looked at the computer screen expressionlessly with a hint of anger in his eyes.
“CeeM!”
“CeeM!”
“CeeM!”
The netizens started to spammer in Mina’s live broadcast room, and the word ‘CeeM’ kept appearing on the screen.
Those who supported Mina knew that at this moment, only CeeM could help Mina.
“Why the f*ck are you guys still spamming ‘CeeM’? CeeM has already been sent to the police station by this b*tch. Brothers, I’ll send another locked gift. Drown them bootlickers!”
After Brother Ocean sent the comment, he sent a 18,880-dollar locked gift.
The locked gift’s password was still ‘B*tch Mina’.
For a moment, the words ‘B*itch Mina’ and ‘CeeM’ were locked in a fierce battle.
It was unknown whether Mina was touched by the viewers or angered by the people who were scolding her, but tears kept falling from her eyes. She looked very pitiful.
Connor took a deep breath, then turned to Yelena and said, “I need to use the bathroom. Where is it?”
“On the right side of the corridor!”
Yelena was currently staring at the computer screen, so she did not notice that Connor’s expression was a little off.
Connor originally didn’t want to care about Mina’s matter. After all, he could feel that Mina herself didn’t really want to win this match.
However, the other party had gone too far. It was fine if they won the match using tricks, but they were using CeeM to insult Mina. Moreover, it was all fake, so Connor had no choice but to make a move.
However, because Yelena was sitting next to Connor, he definitely couldn’t give Mina bits in front of Yelena, so he could only find an excuse to go to the bathroom.
On the other side, Mina seemed to be unable to endure the other party’s humiliation.
Moreover, there was only less than a minute left before the end of the PK. She felt that she was definitely going to lose today, so Mina decided to close the live broadcast room.
However, just as Mina was about to close the livestream, a comment popped up.
“Welcome [Emperor] to Mina’s livestream!”
When Mina saw this comment, a hint of shock flashed in her eyes. It had been a long time since she had seen this name.
When the netizens in the live broadcast room saw CeeM, they instantly became excited!
“CeeM is here!”
“CeeM is here. The other side is dead!”
“CeeM didn’t go to jail at all. Those people are clearly talking nonsense!”
“CeeM, hurry up and smash the other side!”
“CeeM, hurry up and make your move!”
The netizens began to spam comments. Connor instantly felt as if he was being treated as an emperor.
Mina looked at the word ‘CeeM’ in a daze. She thought that CeeM would never appear in her stream again, but she didn’t expect that he would actually return!
Queenie and the others were also dumbfounded. They thought that Mina had already thrown him into prison.
But if CeeM had really been locked up, how did he enter the livestream?
“I’m sorry for making everyone wait!”
After entering the live broadcast room, Connor slowly typed these words.
For a moment, the viewers in Mina’s livestream was stunned. They did not know how to answer this greeting and could only spam the word ‘CeeM’!
“CeeM rewarded [Mina] with 1,000,000 bits!”
In an instant, 1,000,000 bits appeared on the screen, and the effect was extremely shocking.
This was the highest number given so far!
“CeeM rewarded [Mina] with 1,000,000 bits!”
Before the audience in the live broadcast room could react, Connor gave another 1,000,000 bits!
In the blink of an eye, 400,000 dollars had been given to Mina!
Now, Mina’s reward progress bar had already surpassed Queenie’s. Both of them had nearly 500,000 dollars in rewards.
Mina looked at the computer screen in disbelief. She did not know how to describe her feelings.
“CeeM, you don’t need to send bits. 1 don’t care if I lose!”
Mina hurriedly shouted.
“It’s fine. This little money is nothing to me!”
Connor replied.
The viewers in the live broadcast room were also very excited at this time. Some people were praising Connor, while others began to mock Queenie and the others.
“Hubby, they’re actually mocking me. Hurry up and give me bits!”
Queenie couldn’t sit still anymore and shouted agitatedly.
After hearing this, Brother Ocean gritted his teeth and continued to send gifts.
After all, they had already thrown in 400,000 dollars. If they were to lose now, all the money would go down the drain.
Brother Ocean was naturally unwilling to give up, so he quickly took advantage of the last moment to send bits worth 100,000 dollars.
However, when he had just given the bits, he was stunned.
“CeeM rewarded [Mina] with 10,000,000 bits!”
Seeing the bits exploding on the screen, all the viewers were shocked!
“10,000,000 bits?”
Brother Ocean stared at the computer screen with his eyes wide open, not knowing how to describe his feelings.
10,000,000 bits was worth 2 million dollars!
Brother Ocean had only prepared 500,000 dollars today. 500,000 dollars was nothing compared to 2 million dollars!
For a moment, Mina’s reward progress bar once again crushed Queenie’s progress bar. The people who had given Queenie bits before were also dumbfounded!
Yelena thought that the match had already ended and that it was impossible for Mina to win against Queenie.
However, when she saw CeeM appear in Mina’s livestream and giving so many gifts, she was stunned.
“Uh… Wasn’t CeeM sent to the police station? How can he still give bits?”
Yelena stared at her charming big eyes and sighed with an incredulous expression on her face..

chapters.title: Chapter 221 - 221: This Is A Real Tycoon!
chapters.content:
Chapter 221 - 221: This Is A Real Tycoon!
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
A minute later, the match finally ended.
Queenie and Brother Ocean had never expected such a result. Not only did they not win the competition, but they also lost more than 500,000 dollars for nothing!
Queenie sat on the spot with a dull gaze. She no longer looked as arrogant as before.
“This is what a real tycoon looks like!”
“Yeah, CeeM is the real tycoon. Who does that Brother Ocean think he is?”
“Where’s Brother Ocean? Why aren’t you talking? Still trying to act cool?”
The netizens in Mina’s livestream began to mock Queenie, Brother Ocean, and the others.
“Remember this, Mina is my friend. If anyone dares to bully her in the future, I will definitely not let you off!” Connor typed in the live chat and sent his message.
When Mina saw Connor’s comment, a warm feeling surged in her heart, and a sense of security that she had never felt before welled up in her. She wanted to thank CeeM, but before she could say anything, he had already left her livestream!
After everyone saw Connor leave the livestream, they were still discussing the matter of Connor spending a thousand dollars just now. At this moment, the popularity of Mina’s live stream had soared to five or six times its usual level.
The rumors about Mina sending CeeM to the police station were also dispelled.
In addition, the last sentence that Connor left in the livestream could be considered to have completely suppressed the arrogance of Queenie, Brother Ocean, and the others.
Mina looked at her computer screen and saw the live chat that Connor had left behind. Her face was filled with happiness.
She didn’t know why this CeeM could always appear when she needed protection the most. Not only that, the way they protected her was very simple —that was to throw money at her!
In CeeM’s own words, this small amount of money was nothing in his eyes.
After Queenie saw that she had lost, she quickly closed the livestream dejectedly. Mina thanked the audience present and also went offline.
Yelena, on the other hand, was staring at the computer screen with her big, watery eyes. The expression on her face was one of disbelief.
“Creak!”
At this moment, Connor pushed open the door and walked in.
After Yelena heard him come in, she quickly turned her head to look at him and asked excitedly, “Connor, do you know who won the game just now?”
Connor pretended to know nothing and asked with a smile, “Who is it?”
“Mina won! The tycoon who had disappeared for a long time actually appeared in her livestream again and even tipped her more than two million dollars. Isn’t he too rich?” Yelena shouted excitedly.
“Haha…” After Connor heard Yelena’s words, he couldn’t help but laugh. Then, he said softly, “Didn’t you say that CeeM has been sent to the police station?”
“Maybe my source was wrong; after all, 1 heard it from hearsay. It’s normal for the news to be wrong!” Yelena replied awkwardly.
“In the future, if you don’t know what happened, don’t spread it around. Some things are spread by you people…” Connor said softly.
“Aw, are you trying to educate me?”
Yelena couldn’t help but glare at Connor, then continued, “Let me tell you, even if Mina didn’t send CeeM to the police station, then their relationship must be abnormal. 1 think she must be his woman or something…”
“Who did you hear that from?” Connor asked with a broken expression.
“Isn’t this obvious? Who else do you need to hear it from? If Mina wasn’t supported by CeeM, why would he give her so many gifts? Two million in one go is enough to buy a suite in Porthampton. 1 want a tycoon like that too!”
Yelena sighed softly, then directly got up and lay on the bed. She turned her head to look at Connor and said, “Little Connor, if I can be supported by such a rich man, 1 won’t have to do livestreams anymore. I’ll eat and drinkwell every day. At that time, I’ll take out a portion of the money to support you as well. What do you think?”
“Not much…” Connor shook his head without thinking.
“Tsk, I’ve given you a chance, yet you don’t know how to cherish it. Being able to be kept by a great beauty like me is a blessing that you’ve cultivated in your previous life. You’re actually still making excuses here…”
Yelena couldn’t help but roll her eyes at Connor, then continued, “By the way, Little Man, who is your fiancee?”
“My fiancee…”
Before Connor could finish speaking, Yelena’s phone suddenly rang.
Yelena quickly picked up the phone and answered the call. Then, she said with a smile, “Sister Zion, what’s wrong?”
“Yelena, you’re coming up in a while. Your opponent this time is one of Twitch’s top five streamers, Peggy Walter. Peggy has the support of several tycoons. I heard that she seems to be aiming for first place this time,” the woman on the other end of the phone said softly.
“Since Peggy is so powerful, then I’ll just give up!” Yelena replied absent-mindedly and then hung up the phone.
“What’s wrong?”
Connor couldn’t help but ask after Yelena hung up the phone.
“Nothing much. My manager just wants me to treat today’s match well. The other party seems to be one of the top five streamers on Twitch, and she has a few tycoons backing her. However, I’ve only been streaming for a few days, and I don’t have many fans. Not only that, I don’t have a tycoon like CeeM to help me. I definitely can’t beat the other party, so I might as well give up on this match!” Yelena said casually.
Connor frowned and asked, “If you give up, won’t you not get the tip money?”
“I don’t care about that little bit of reward money. Besides, Twitch is holding this competition so they can sell more stocks to investors. I don’t want to cheat my fans of their money!”
Yelena said to Connor with a serious face.
Connor asked Yelena with a puzzled expression, “Aren’t your livestreams there to scam your fans? Otherwise, how are you going to make money?”
“I’m different from those streamers. Back then, in order to poach me over, Twitch gave me a huge sum of money to sign the contract. They even promised to tailor an online drama for me and let me be the female lead. When I saw their conditions, I agreed to switch from Tiktok to Twitch!”
Yelena continued to explain.
“So that’s how it is!”
Connor nodded lightly and didn’t say anything.
“I’ve always wanted to be an actor since I was young, but my family’s conditions are limited. It’s impossible for me to go to art school, so 1 wanted to become an internet celebrity and enter the entertainment industry when I’m famous!”
Yelena smiled and then looked at Connor. “Twitch offered me such conditions and even gave me a large sum of money, so I had no reason to reject them, which is why I’m here now!”
Connor saw Yelena’s serious expression and hesitated for a moment before speaking. “If you want to be an actor, 1 happen to know some CEOs of film companies. 1 can introduce them to you!”
When Connor listened to Thomas Morgan introducing his assets to him, he knew that Thomas had shares in several large film and television companies in the country. Moreover, Yelena was a good-looking girl with a large number of fans. This, coupled with the resources in Connor’s hands, should not be a problem to make Yelena famous.
When Yelena heard Connor’s words, she was stunned and looked at Connor in disbelief..

chapters.title: Chapter 222 - 222:I Choose to Give Up
chapters.content:
Chapter 222:I Choose to Give Up
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
When Yelena heard that Connor wanted to introduce her to the boss of the film company, she was stunned. Then, she looked at Connor in disbelief.
“Why are you looking at me like that?”
Connor was a little embarrassed by Yelena’s stare.
“You said you wanted to introduce me to a CEO of a film company, right?” Yelena asked excitedly.
“Yeah, why?”
Connor nodded lightly.
Yelena hesitated for a moment, then pouted and said, “Don’t brag to me. You’re a poor student. What kind of boss do you know? Moreover, even if you know them, they are probably some old perverts who think about how to sleep with female celebrities every day. I’m not going to go…”
“Uh…”
When Connor heard Yelena’s words, a trace of embarrassment flashed in his eyes. After all, Yelena did not know his identity, so it was normal for her to not believe what he’d said.
“If you don’t believe me, then forget it!” Connor said indifferently.
At this moment, Connor’s thoughts were very simple. Since Yelena did not believe him, and Connor did not want to expose his identity, it was better to let those CEOs contact Yelena privately. This way, it could save a lot of trouble.
“I didn’t say I didn’t believe you. It’s just that the entertainment industry is a mixed bag, so I’m worried that you’ve met some scammers. Moreover, even if you really know some of the bosses of some film companies, why would they let me act in their movies? Unless you’re their boss, they might give you face. Otherwise, there’s no need for them to hire me!”
Yelena patted Connor’s shoulder and comforted him with a smile. No matter what, she was still very touched by his words of wanting to help her.
Connor looked up at Yelena and couldn’t help but sigh in his heart. “You’re right. I’m the boss of those film companies. If I want anyone to be the female lead, those people definitely won’t dare to reject me!”
However, these words could only be said in his heart. He would definitely not say them out loud.
“Buzz!”
At this moment, a notification suddenly appeared on Yelena’s phone. Twitch was informing Yelena that the competition had begun.
Yelena walked slowly to the computer and opened the PK competition interface, but did not enter her livestream room. Therefore, there was only one female streamer on the PK interface, while Yelena’s screen was pitch black.
Yelena’s opponent this time was Peggy Walter, a streamer ranked in the top five on Twitch.
She definitely surpassed Queenie, whether it was her figure or her looks, Connor had also seen this female streamer a few times when was browning some livestreams on Twitch.
Peggy looked very sweet and sang very well. There was a lot of news about this female streamer on the Internet.
“The PK officially begins!”
At this moment, these words suddenly appeared in the livestream room.
The thirty-minute countdown started.
When the countdown began, the match between Yelena and the other female streamer officially began.
After Peggy saw that the match had started, she greeted the audience briefly and then began to sing.
When the viewers in Yelena’s live streaming room saw that Yelena had not appeared for a long time, they began to send some comments asking Yelena why she was still not streaming.
“Goddess Yelena, the competition has already started. Why aren’t you broadcasting yet?”
“Did Goddess Yelena go to take a shower?”
“Goddess Yelena, even if you’re going to take a shower, you have to remember to turn on the camera, or we’ll lose today!”
On the live chat, the netizens began to tease her.
However, other than these teasing comments, there were also some discordant voices.
“Hehe, is she too ugly to show herself?”
“That’s right. The host must be afraid of Peggy, so she doesn’t dare to show herself, right?”
“Yelena, come out quickly! Don’t worry, even if you lose today, we won’t laugh at you!”
These were all Peggy’s fans who had come to mock Yelena.
After Yelena saw these bullet comments, her expression immediately turned ugly. She glared and scolded, “Bastard, how dare you say that I’m not streaming because I’m ugly? Little Connor, are you saying that I’m ugly?”
Connor was stunned for a moment before hurriedly shaking his head. “No, no, no. You’re not ugly!”
“If they’re not ugly, then what are you still standing there for? Hurry up and send a comment to help me scold them. Curse all their ancestors for me…”
Yelena pointed at the computer screen and shouted.
“Big sister, there are so many people on the other side. How can 1 scold them all by myself? Why don’t you turn on the livestream?” Connor asked Yelena incredulously.
“I don’t want my fans to spend money on me. If I start a livestream now, people will definitely send me gifts. But 1 can’t win today; I don’t want the higher ups to earn money!” Yelena pouted and replied.
When Connor heard Yelena’s words, he could not help but be stunned for a moment. Then, he said softly, “I didn’t expect you to be so smart…”
“That’s right. They won’t be able to take a single cent from my fans!”
Yelena smiled proudly and continued, “Forget it, I’ll turn off the computer. Let’s play a game. Do you know how to play Honor of Kings?”
“No…”
Connor shook his head.
“What about PUBG?”
Yelena continued to ask.
“Don’t know that either…”
Connor continued to shake his head.
Yelena looked at Connor incredulously. “Bro, are you a student or not? You don’t even know how to play Honor of Kings or PUBG?”
“My previous phone was too lousy. 1 couldn’t even download Facebook, so I didn’t really know how to play the games you guys played…” Connor explained awkwardly.
“So it’s like that. Well, never mind—I’ll teach you to play properly!”
As Yelena spoke, she took out her phone and prepared to teach Connor how to play games.
“Buzz!”
But at this moment, Yelena’s phone rang again.
“Sister Zion, what’s wrong now?” Yelena answered the call and asked helplessly.
“Yelena, the competition has already started. Why aren’t you streaming? What are you doing?” the other party asked excitedly.
“Sister Zion, didn’t I already tell you? It was impossible for me to win against Peggy, so I gave up!” Yelena replied indifferently.
“How can you give up? If you don’t enter the top three of the PK competition, the role of the female lead will not be yours. Do you want to give up on the opportunity to act in the web drama?” Sister Zion asked loudly.
“What?” When Yelena heard this, her expression instantly changed. She shouted excitedly.
“Sister Zion, Are you kidding me?” Yelena stuttered as she held her phone..

chapters.title: Chapter 223 - 223: So Poor That All That’s Left Is Money
chapters.content:
Chapter 223: So Poor That All That’s Left Is Money
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
“Why would i joke with you? When you signed the contract with Twitch, you clearly had this term in the contract. Did you forget?” Sister Zion said helplessly.
“I remember that when i signed the contract with them, it said that as long as I streamed on twitch, they would let me act. However, they didn’t say that I had to get the top three in this competition!” Yelena replied in a low voice.
“You’re really too careless. Although the contract says that they want you to act, it doesn’t say what role they want you to play. So this time, they’ll only let you play the female lead if you enter the top three. Do you know that?” Sister Zion shouted helplessly.
“Then…What should I do now?”
Yelena was completely panicking at this moment, and the hand holding the phone began to tremble.
After all, she had come to the livestream for the role of female lead. If she couldn’t get the role now, then all of Yelena’s efforts this month would be in vain.
“What else can you do but hurry up and open the livestream. I’ll get someone to help you buy some gifts and see if you can win this round first!” Sister Zion said.
“The money for the gift?”
Yelena asked hesitantly.
“Your signing fee should be five million, right? I think it shouldn’t be a problem to use this money to defeat Peggy. Anyway, when you enter the top three, this money will be returned to you, so you won’t suffer a loss…” Sister Zion said lightly.
“But i don’t have that much money on hand now. I’ve used all my money to buy a car and a house!”
Yelena was so anxious that tears began to fall. If she had known that there was such a rule, she would not have spent the money in the first place.
“You…”
Sister Zion didn’t know what to say when she heard this. She could only ask in a low voice, “Then how much money do you have on hand now?”
Yelena bit her lips and replied, “There’s about a million left!”
After Sister Zion heard Yelena’s words, she couldn’t help but hesitate for a moment. Then, she said in a low voice, “Yelena, I’ll help you borrow some money later, but it shouldn’t be a lot. If you can get 500,000 dollars, then i’ll add on the one million dollars you have.”
“How much money does Peggy have?” Yelena asked hesitantly.
“How would I know? We shouldn’t care about how much she’s farming now. Anyway, we only have this much money in our hands. It depends on whether you dare to take a gamble!” Sister Zion said softly.
Yelena looked at the computer, her expression a little awkward.
“Alright, 1 won’t talk to you anymore. I’ll help you borrow money. If you want to bet, just open the livestream. If you want to give up this opportunity, then you don’t have to open the livestream!” Sister Zion called out anxiously before hanging up.
When Yelena saw that the call had been hung up, she instantly lay helplessly on the bed. The expression on her face was very desperate.
When Connor saw Yelena’s desperate look, he could not help but ask, “What’s wrong?”
Yelena looked up at Connor and then briefly explained her situation to him.
Connor roughly understood what she was saying. The current situation was that if Yelena wanted to participate in this competition, she would have to gamble all her savings and owe 500,000 dollars in debt.
If Yelena won in the end, she wouldn’t lose anything and could even get the role of the female lead. However, if she lost, she would have nothing.
“Connor, do you want me to bet?”
Yelena was very conflicted now, so she wanted to hear Connor’s opinion.
Connor looked at Yelena without saying anything.
Yelena no longer looked indifferent like before. She looked at Connor pitifully and said, “1 don’t know how much money Peggy has prepared. If the tycoon behind her has prepared a lot of gifts, then all my money might go down the drain. But if I have to give up this opportunity like this, I’m very unwilling!” “Why don’t you take a gamble? 1 think you can win!” Connor whispered to Yelena.
“Can I really?”
When Yelena heard this, she was stunned for a moment. Then, she looked at Connor with despair and said, “How can I win? If I had an oil baron like CeeM, I might have won…”
“Who knows, CeeM might come to your livestream to buy gifts!”
Connor replied with a smile and then continued, “Anyway, you have a house and a car now. Even if you lose, it won’t affect you much. At most, you can earn more money in the future!”
Yelena looked at Connor and hesitated for a moment before nodding, “That’s true. I think what you said makes a lot of sense. If I give up now, I’ll definitely feel bad, so I might as well take a gamble. At most, I’ll start all over again!”
After saying this, Yelena hurriedly ran to the mirror to touch up her makeup. Then, she returned to her chair and opened her livestream.
Connor sat on the spot and looked at Yelena’s back. He could not help but sigh in his heart. “Yelena helped me before, so I’ll help her this time. It won’t cost much anyway!” he thought.
