“Yeah. How could your cousin like such a person? Your cousin is famous for being fair, rich, and beautiful in Porthampton!”
“Maya, you must be lying to us, right? This person is definitely not your cousin’s fiance!”
When Maya’s friends heard what she said, they were all shocked as they exclaimed one after another.
Freya was famous for being fair, rich, and beautiful in Porthampton. When she was in school, many rich second-generation heirs pursued her, but she rejected them all.
Maya’s friends were all children of the rich in Porthampton, so they had naturally heard of Freya.
That was why they were so shocked when they heard that Connor was Freya’s fiance..

chapters.title: Chapter 236 - 236: The Banquet’s VIP
chapters.content:
Chapter 236: The Banquet’s VIP
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
“Why would I lie to you?”
Maya pouted and said in a bad mood, “This Connor really is my cousin’s fiance!”
“Why would your cousin get such a person to be her fiance? Other than his good looks, he doesn’t have any other good points, alright? What is your cousin thinking?” Maya’s friend quickly asked.
“Actually, Connor is just a little poor. In other aspects, he is quite good!”
For some reason, Maya, who had always looked down on Connor, actually put in a good word for him. Perhaps it was because Connor had helped Freya find an investor for her company last time that her impression of Connor had changed subtly.
However, this still did not change the fact that Maya thought that Connor was a poor loser. She just did not think that he was that annoying anymore.
“I don’t see what’s good about him. The Immortal Lake Manor is closed today, but he’s still trying to go in. There must be something wrong with his brain!” Maya’s friend said with a pout.
“That’s right. There’s a company banquet at the Immortal Lake Manor today. Why would he go in?”
Maya only reacted when she heard this. She quickly shouted in Connor’s general direction. “Connor, Immortal Lake Manor is holding a company banquet today. Ordinary guests have been chased out, so you can’t enter!”
Maya thought that Connor was going to buy tickets, so she kindly reminded him of this fact.
Although she didn’t think that Connor would come here to spend money, Connor should still be able to afford a ticket that cost a few thousand yuan.
Connor turned to look at Maya and said lightly, “Just because you two can’t enter doesn’t mean that I can’t!”
“You…”
Maya glared fiercely at Connor and was instantly speechless. She then scolded loudly, “You really don’t know what’s good for you!”
Maya had wanted to remind Connor out of kindness that the manor was no longer receiving guests, but she did not expect Connor to say something like that. Maya was naturally very angry.
“Maya, it seems that your cousin’s fiance is not only poor, but also likes to act cool! The staff inside said that there would be a company banquet at the resort today, so all the famous CEOs in Porthampton would be there. Other than then, no one can enter at all. But this kid actually said that he could enter. This is too funny!”
A girl who was not on good terms with Maya could not help but mock her softly.
“That’s right, this kid is definitely posturing! If he could really enter, it means that he’s a waiter at the resort. Otherwise, he would definitely not be able to enter!” another girl added.
“There is a second possibility. Perhaps this kid is the distinguished guest that the Immortal Lake Manor is preparing to receive!” The girl beside Maya said in a strange tone.
“Hahaha…”
When the surrounding girls heard this, they immediately burst out laughing with disdain on their faces.
Obviously, they all felt that Connor was not a VIP of the Immortal Lake Manor, so they all treated this as a joke.
After Maya heard everyone’s mocking laughter, she suddenly felt very uncomfortable. She felt that these people were not only mocking Connor, but also Freya and even herself.
“This damned Connor, why do I run into him everywhere I go? What a nuisance!” Maya couldn’t help but curse in her heart. Then, she turned her head and shouted at her friend beside her, “Alright, stop laughing. Let’s go!”
When everyone saw that Maya seemed to be a little angry, they all stopped laughing and walked towards the roadside.
Meanwhile, Connor stood at the door and waited quietly for Thomas’s men to come and welcome him. His expression was very relaxed; the whole of the Immortal Lake Manor belonged to him.
“Young Master McDonald!”
Connor waited for two minutes before a middle-aged man in a black suit ran out of the manor with a flustered expression.
Connor turned his head and looked at the middle-aged man indifferently.
“Young Master McDonald, I’m really sorry. I was delayed by something just now, so 1 came a little late. 1 hope you won’t hold it against me and don’t lower yourself to my level!”
The middle-aged man explained to Connor respectfully.
When the two security guards at the door heard the middle-aged man’s words, their eyes widened in disbelief. This was because they knew that the man who had appeared here was none other than the general manager of the Immortal Lake Resort, Titus Jenkins.
Even when the deputy mayor of Porthampton came to inspect, Titus wasn’t nearly as nervous. However, when he faced a poor loser who looked a little shabby, he actually showed such a panicked expression. The security guard felt that everything was unbelievable.
Connor sized up the middle-aged man and asked indifferently. “You are the person in charge of the Immortal Lake Manor?”
“Yes, yes! My name is Titus, and I’m now the general manager of Immortal Lake Manor!” the middle-aged man replied respectfully.
“Oh, 1 see!” Connor nodded his head lightly and didn’t say anything.
“Young Master McDonald, it’s too hot outside. Let’s go inside and talk!” At this moment, Titus was very respectful to Connor. When he spoke to Connor, his was half-bent over in a bow.
“Yes!”
Connor didn’t argue with Titus about his tardiness. After all, he’d called Thomas Morgan only when he arrived here, so it was normal for Titus to be late.
“Young Master McDonald, this way please!” Titus called out respectfully, then led Connor into the Immortal Lake Manor.
On the other side, Maya and her friend were standing by the roadside, waiting for a taxi to arrive.
At that moment, a girl suddenly shouted at Maya. “Maya, your cousin’s fiance seems to have really entered the manor!”
When Maya heard this, she quickly turned around and saw Connor and Titus walking into the manor.
When she saw this, her mouth dropped open and she couldn’t help but exclaim, “Connor actually went in?”
When the others saw Connor walk into the manor, they all revealed shocked expressions, their eyes filled with surprise.
Just now, the staff of the Immortal Lake Manor had said that there was an important banquet to be held today, so they’d chased all the tourists out of the manor. Maya and the others happened to be among the ones who were chased out.
And yet, at this moment, Connor could actually enter the Immortal Lake Manor.. Could he really be the VIP of this banquet?

chapters.title: Chapter 237 - 237: A Gift for You
chapters.content:
Chapter 237: A Gift for You
Translator: End Less Fantasy Translation Editor: End loss Fantasy Translation
“Maya, who is your cousin’s fiance? Why was he able ro enter? Could he really be a distinguished guest of the Immortal Lake Manor?” Maya’s friend asked softly.
“I don’t know either…”
Maya shook her head in a daze. If it was before, she would never believe that a poor loser like Connor could enter the Immortal Lake Manor. However, after the last incident, Maya’s opinion of Connor had changed slightly.
She felt that Connor might not be as bad as she thought. Maybe he wasn’t just an ordinary poor student.
At this moment, a girl stood up and shouted, “How could such a loser be a VIP of the Immortal Lake Manor? He must have come to the Immortal Lake Manor to work. Wouldn’t it be normal for a waiter to enter the manor?”
When everyone heard the girl s words, they were all stunned.
“I think Yenny’s right. Look at the clothes that kid is wearing how can he be a VIP of the Immortal Lake Manor? If he was really a VIP guest here, he would have to dress up a little before coming!”
“Yes, he must be the waiter here!” The other girls also agreed.
Maya was a little suspicious because she didn’t know what was going on. Logically, Connor couldn’t be a VIP at Immortal Lake Manor, but Maya felt that now that Freya was giving Connor 20,000 dollars of living expenses every month, Connor probably wouldn’t be working as a waiter at such a place!
“This person is definitely not a waiter here! ”
At this moment, Maya s friend suddenly shouted.
When everyone heard her words, they all focused their gazes on the girl, and their expressions were somewhat puzzled.
“How do you know that Connor isn’t a waiter here?”
Maya hesitated for a moment before asking the girl softly.
“Maya, do you know who the person who brought Connor into the Manor was?” the girl replied excitedly.
“Who is it?” Maya asked.
“That person is the general manager of Immortal Lake Manor, Titus Jenkins!”
Hearing this, everyone was stunned on the spot, and their expressions were incredulous.
If Connor really came here to work, why would the general manager of Immortal Lake Manor come out to welcome him personally?
Even a fool could understand this!
The girl looked at Maya and continued. “The person who brought Connor into the Manor just now is the general manager of the Immortal Lake Manor. Not only that, did you see how the manager spoke to Connor? He was very respectful. This means that Connor is definitely not here to work. Why would the general manager be so respectful to a waiter?”
Maya looked at the backs of Connor and Titus, and her eyes flashed with confusion.
The girls who had mocked Connor before also shut their mouths and stopped talking.They knew that what the girl said just now was very reasonable!
“Could it be that Connor is really a distinguished guest?”
“This is impossible. How could he be a VIP?’1
“Yeah, look at how poor he is. I can still believe that he is a waiter at Immortal Lake Manor, but isn’t it too unbelievable for him to be a VIP?”
A few girls seemed to be a little unwilling to give up and discussed this among themselves.
“Whether Connor is a VIP here or not, I’ll go in and ask!” Maya said with a frown, then directly walked towards the entrance of the Immortal Lake Manor.
Maya’s friends were also very curious about Connor’s identity, so they all followed Maya.
However, by the time they ran to the door, Connor and Titus had already disappeared.
Maya wanted ro break into the manor, but the two security guards at the door reached out and stopped her. Then, they said expressionlessly, “Miss, I’m sorry. Our Manor is closed for business today. You can’t enter!”
“Why can’t we go in? Even that loser just now went in!” The girl behind Maya shouted.
The security guard couldn’t help but laugh when he heard the girl’s words. Then, he said indifferently, “That gentleman just now is a distinguished guest of our Manor. Are you?”
“Geh!”
Maya and the others were all dumbfounded when they heard the security guard’s words. Their expressions were extremely incredulous.They had never thought that Connor was actually a VIP!
“This… How is this possible? Connor…Connor is really a VIP of the Immortal Lake Manor?” Maya stood rooted to the ground with a dazed expression and sighed in shock.
However, Maya didn’t know that not only was Connor a VIP of the Immortal Lake Manor, but also the manor’s owner!
On the other side, Connor walked into the Immortal Lake Manor while following Titus’s lead.
After entering the Manor, Titus had been informing him of the situation inside.
At this moment, the manor was empty, so rhe environment was very quiet. The entire manor felt like it was being clouded in a white fog. Although the faint smell of grass and trees could not be seen or touched, the atmosphere surrounded Connor and soothed him.
Walking in the Immortal Lake Manor, Connor found that other than the huge lake, there were many magnificent buildings.
The main business projects of the manor were not only hot springs, but also a series of entertainment venues such as hotels and casinos. At rhe front was rhe Immortal Lake Hotel, and behind the hotel were the hot springs. Behind the hot springs was the Immortal Lake Manor, which was known as a man’s paradise.
It was said that this Immortal Lake Manor was the most profitable outlet in the area. As long as you had money, you could enjoy all kinds of services in this manor. There was nothing that rhe Immortal Lake Manor couldn’t provide!
After Tirus introduced the situation in the Manor, he smiled at Connor and said, “Young Master McDonald, I knew you were coming today, so I specially prepared a gift for you!”
“A gift?” Connor couldn’t help but laugh when he heard Titus’s words.
Now, the entire Immortal Lake Manor belonged to him, and yet Titus actually prepared a gift for him here?
“Yes, this is my first rime meeting you. This is the greeting gift I prepared for you!” Tirus replied with a smile.

After Harriet heard Connor’s words, her expression instantly became despair.
At this moment, she was filled with regret. If she had known that the man in front of her was Mr. McDonald, she would not have dared to do such a thing even if she had nine lives!
Originally, Harriet was still planning how to show off in front of Mr.
McDonald, but she didn’t expect that her first meeting with Mir. McDonald would be so awkward.
“Mr. McDonald, how do you want to deal with these people?”
Titus was also filled with anger. He had painstakingly prepared a gift for half a month, but Harriet and the others destroyed it. How could he not be angry?
“Mr. McDonald, 1 know I’m wrong. Please spare me this time. It’s my honor to be able to see my body. If you have time, I can go with you to find a quiet place. I’ll strip naked and let you look at me as much as you want…” After Harriet heard Titus’s offer, she panicked and quickly pleaded with Connor.
“Strip naked and let me see as much as 1 want?” When Connor heard this, he couldn’t help but smile ambiguously.
“Titus, chase these people out! Let them be cleaners for a month, and then make them leave after a month!” Connor pointed at the girls who had mocked him before and ordered.
He wouldn’t do anything to these women. After all, they were just gold-diggers. Therefore, he planned to let these women work as cleaners at Immortal Lake Manor for a month as a punishment for them!
After hearing Connor’s order, all the beautiful women felt lucky. After all, Connor’s punishment was much lighter than Titus’s.
“Alright!” Titus was shocked before he hurriedly nodded.
Then, he turned to look at Harriet and asked Connor softly, “Mr. McDonald, how do you plan to deal with Harriet?”
“She’s coming with me!” Connor replied expressionlessly, then walked out of Welcoming Lake..

chapters.title: Chapter 243 - 243: Isn’t This A Quiet Place?
chapters.content:
Chapter 243: Isn’t This A Quiet Place?
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
“She’s going with you?”
All the women were stunned when they heard what Connor said.
They couldn’t understand what Connor meant!
Harriet kneeled and hesitated before revealing a happy smile.
She thought it must be because Connor had seen her body just now, so he wanted to bring her to a quiet place to enjoy it. This was simply a dream for Harriet!
Originally, she thought it was already a blessing in disguise that she could leave the Immortal Lake Manor unscathed today.
However, she didn’t expect that she could benefit from this misfortune and get a chance to serve Connor. Harriet had already started to secretly plan what position she should use to ‘serve’ Connor well later.
If she could ‘serve’ Connor well, not only would she not be in any danger, but she might even be able to marry a wealthy man. This was great!
“Harriet, what are you still standing there for? Quickly get up and follow Mr. McDonald!” Titus shouted at the top of his voice when he saw Harriet kneeling.
“Ye… Yes!” Harriet agreed excitedly, then got up and followed Connor.
When the women saw Connor, Titus, and Harriet preparing to leave, they were all envious.
Harriet had offended Connor. Not only did Harriet, the main culprit, not get into trouble, but she also got to serve Mr. McDonald. However, they had to be cleaners at Immortal Lake Manor for a month. It was unfair.
“Looks like the good-looking ones are still the most popular!”
“That’s right. Not only does Harriet not need to be a cleaner, but she also gets Mr. McDonald’s favor. Isn’t it very unfair?”
“It’s pointless to compare to someone like that!”
The girls watched Connor, Harriet, and the others leave with envy in their eyes.
When Connor was about to leave the lake entrance, he suddenly saw Willow standing at the side with a restrained expression.
Connor had a good impression of Willow because he was beside her when she was chatting with the other women.
He also knew Willow had come today because she wanted to earn enough money for her mother’s medical expenses.
“You follow me too!” Connor pointed at Willow and said expressionlessly.
When Willow heard Connor’s words, she was surprised. Then, her eyes widened as she said delicately, “Mr. McDo… Mr. McDonald, did you mean me?”
“Yes, you!” Connor nodded.
Willow stood rooted to the ground, dumbfounded. She was shocked because she didn’t expect Mr. McDonald to ask her to leave with him.
After hesitating, Willow took a deep breath and walked to Connor’s side.
When the ladies saw Connor taking Willow away, they became even more surprised.
It was within their expectations that Connor would take Harriet away. After all, Harriet had a voluptuous figure and a face that could start a war. Regardless of her figure or appearance, she was the cream of the crop.
They could naturally understand that Connor would take Harriet away.
But now, Connor wanted to take Willow too. This made people a little confused.
Although Willow was quite good-looking, she was only beautiful among ordinary people.
However, if she were placed among the group of beautiful women at Welcoming Lake, Willow’s figure and appearance were only considered above average.
Titus had called Willow over because he had taken a fancy to Willow’s pure temperament.
“Why did Mr. McDonald choose Willow? Am 1 not better than her?” Faye pouted and complained.
“Yeah, what’s so good about Willow? What right does she have to be chosen by Mr. McDonald?!”
“I don’t know what Mr. McDonald is thinking!”
Everyone began to discuss softly, their voices filled with envy and jealousy toward Willow and Harriet.
***
Two minutes later, Connor led Titus, Harriet, and Willow out of Welcoming Lake.
At this moment, Titus had a faint smile on his face. Although there was a small episode in today’s matter, no matter what, the outcome was still good. In the end, Connor still chose to take Willow and Harriet.
At this moment, Harriet was ecstatic. Being taken in by a super-rich heir like Connor was simply a blessing she had cultivated in her previous life!
However, Willow was a little nervous because she had never done that kind of thing with a man before. She did not know what would happen next.
After Connor led the three of them for a short distance, he suddenly stopped and turned to Titus, asking, “Titus, do you have a public toilet here?”
“Mr. McDonald, do you want to go to the toilet? If you want to use the toilet, I can take you to the hotel’s…” Titus hurriedly replied.
“I don’t want a hotel toilet, I want a public toilet. Do you have one here?” Connor repeated.
“Mr. McDonald, there is a public toilet on this road, but that toilet is for the employees of the manor, so it’s a little dirty. I think it’s better for people like you not to go there!”
Titus said respectfully to Connor.
“Haha, it’s fine…”
Connor couldn’t help but laugh when he heard Titus’s words. Then, he said indifferently, “The dirtier, the better!”
“Mr. McDonald, should I take you there now?” Titus was confused. After hesitating for a moment, he whispered to Connor.
“Yes!” Connor nodded.
Titus quickly led the way for him.
Harriet and Willow followed closely behind Connor. They did not know what Connor wanted to do.
A few minutes later, Connor, Titus, Harriet, and Willow arrived at the public toilet specially used by the employees of Immortal Lake Manor.
Although the four of them had yet to enter the toilet, they could smell a pungent smell and see a group of flies flying around it.
When Harriet and Willow smelled the stench from the toilet, they frowned and looked disgusted.
“Mr. McDonald, what are we doing here? Let’s go!” Harriet covered her nose and complained unhappily.
She was worried that the stench here would spread to her body. If she were to ‘serve’ Connor later, the smell of a public toilet would affect her mood!
“Leave?”
Connor turned to look at Harriet and said indifferently, “Didn’t you want to find a quiet place? Isn’t this a quiet place?”

chapters.title: Chapter 244 - 244: My Name Is Willow Tate
chapters.content:
Chapter 244: My Name Is Willow Tate
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
“Here?”
When Harriet heard Connor’s words, she immediately frowned and was puzzled.
“Mr. McDonald, do you want to do that with me here?” Harriet asked Connor with a confused expression.
“Of course, I won’t do that with you here, but you must go in!” Connor said calmly as he looked at Harriet.
Harriet looked at Connor in a daze. Her eyes were filled with confusion.
She didn’t understand what Connor meant by what he said just now. What did he mean by she had to go in?
“Mr. McDonald, what do you want me to do?”
Harriet hesitated and asked Connor, puzzled.
“What I want you to do is very simple. You have to wash the toilets here for a month. If you don’t want to do it, then 1’11 have Titus settle the scores with you…” Connor calmly said to Harriet.
When Harriet heard Connor’s words, her eyes instantly widened. She did not expect Connor to bring her to this place so that she could clean the toilet.
Harriet had thought that she could escape from the blunder and not have to be a cleaner. However, she did not expect Connor to specially prepare a job to clean toilets for her!
Connor had always been a person who would repay kindness and hatred.
Although those girls in Welcoming Lake had offended Connor, they had only mocked him a few times. They did not have any deep hatred for Connor.
But Harriet was different. If Connor wasn’t the boss of the Immortal Lake Manor, he felt that this woman would definitely blind Titus to the truth. Facing such a vicious woman, Connor naturally wouldn’t be polite.
“Harriet, do you understand what Mr. McDonald said? Do you want to wash the toilet here, or do you want me to deal with you?” Titus shouted after hearing Connor’s words.
Harriet subconsciously looked up at Titus. Although the toilet was very dirty, she knew that if she fell into Titus’s hands, her fate would be a hundred times worse than just cleaning the toilet.
Therefore, she hurriedly shouted at Connor, “Mr. McDonald, 1 beg you to let me go, okay? As long as you let me go, I’ll do anything you want…”
“I’m not interested in women like you. You don’t have to beg me!” Connor replied expressionlessly, then turned around and walked away.
Titus hurriedly left with Connor, while Harriet stood before the toilet door. Looking at the smelly toilet, she was at a loss for what to do, and tears flowed out of her eyes!
Harriet had never been humiliated like this in her entire life.
As a beautiful woman, Harriet was always sought after by men no matter where she went. When had she ever been despised and humiliated by a man like this?
***
“Mr. McDonald, if you think that Harriet’s punishment is too light, 1 can also get someone to teach her a lesson!”
Titus was worried that what happened today would affect Connor’s mood, so he whispered to Connor.
“No need, there’s no need to be too calculative with a woman!”
Connor only wanted to give these people a warning today. He did not want to condemn them all.
“Mr. McDonald, you’re really generous!” Titus chuckled.
“In the future, you don’t have to prepare these fancy things for me. I have a fiancee, so I’m not interested in these beautiful women. 1 won’t mistreat my employees as long as you do your job well!” Connor looked at Titus and continued.
“Alright, alright…”
Titus repeatedly nodded at Connor’s instructions.
Although Titus said so, he still couldn’t help but glance at Willow, who was beside Connor. “Although Mr. McDonald said he doesn’t need this kind of thing, didn’t he still choose a woman from the company? How could there be a man in this world who did not cheat?”
Willow was also nervous because she didn’t know what awaited her.
“What’s your name?”
At this moment, Connor suddenly turned and asked Willow.
“Mr. McDon… McDonald, my name is Willow Tate. You… You can just call me Willow…” Willow stuttered nervously.
“Oh, oh, you don’t have to be nervous!”
Connor patted Willow’s shoulder and said lightly, “1 didn’t mean anything by asking you out. 1 just heard that your mother is sick, so you are in need of a large sum of money to treat her illness, right?”
“Mr. McDonald…”
Willow looked up at Connor. Her beautiful eyes filled with confusion.
“How much does your mother need?” Connor interrupted Willow and asked calmly.
“I should need about 800,000 more. I have saved up 100,000 dollars!” Willow replied timidly.
“800, 000 dollars!”
Connor smiled faintly and turned to Titus. “Go prepare 800,000 dollars for Willow. After the party is over, let her leave!”
“Yes, Mr. McDonald!” Titus quickly agreed.
“Mr. McDonald, what… What do you mean?”
Willow didn’t expect Connor to be so generous. He didn’t even ask about her mother’s illness and directly gave her 800,000 dollars.
“I don’t mean anything else. You don’t have to worry about what I’ll do to you. 1 think that it’s very rare for you to give so much to your parents. 800,000 dollars may be a life to you, but it’s just a number to me. When your mother recovers, find a proper job and don’t do these things anymore, understand?” Connor looked at Willow and said.
Willow looked at Connor, and her eyes widened. She was so happy that she couldn’t speak. She didn’t know how to describe her feelings.
“Willow, why are you still standing there? Hurry up and thank Mr. McDonald!” Titus quickly reminded Willow when he saw that she was frozen.
“Thank you, Mr. McDonald!” Willow quickly bowed deeply to Connor.
“You’re welcome!” Connor smiled faintly.
“Mr. McDonald, I know there’s no such thing as a free lunch. If you have any requests, feel free to ask. As long as I, Willow Tate, can do it, 1 will do it…” Willow looked at Connor and offered.
“If you have any requests, feel free to ask.”
When Connor heard this, he could not help but be stunned. Then, he carefully sized up Willow.
Although Willow’s figure could not compare to those women’s in Welcoming Lake, her unique pure temperament was still very charming. She was a very cute little girl.
If he could have a relationship with such a beauty, it would be something else.
“Yes, Mr. McDonald, you saved my mother’s life. I’ll do anything you want. You already have a fiancee, but I can be your mistress. I won’t interfere with your private affairs!”
Willow was no longer as nervous as before. So she looked at Connor and said sincerely..

chapters.title: Chapter 245 - 245: Be My Guest At The Party
chapters.content:
Chapter 245: Be My Guest At The Party
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Hearing Willow’s words, Connor could not help but be stunned. Then, he sized Willow up.
However, Connor didn’t have such thoughts, so he shook his head and said, “You don’t have to think so much. I didn’t give you the money to do anything to you. If you feel embarrassed taking my money, then take it as me lending it to you. When you have money, you can return it to me!”
“Really?” Willow asked excitedly.
“Of course!” Connor nodded.
“Mr. McDonald, thank you so much! You’re a good person!” Willow looked at Connor and squealed. Connor’s actions were undoubtedly a lifesaving one.
“You don’t have to thank me!”
Connor waved his hand and continued, “You are free, right?”
“Yeap…” Willow shook her head without thinking.
“Then be my guest at the party!” Connor said indifferently and walked away.
In fact, after inheriting the ten trillion, Connor felt that he had never done anything meaningful. Most of his energy was spent eating, drinking, and having fun.
Now, he could use this money to save a person’s life and even change the fate of a family. He felt that this was very meaningful. At least it was more meaningful than using money to teach a woman like Mandy a lesson.
Connor walked into the hotel lobby five minutes later with Titus’s lead.
The hotel lobby was already filled with people. Everyone was waiting for Mr. McDonald to appear.
Connor glanced at the people in the hall. He realized that many of these people were entrepreneurs who often appeared on the Porthampton TV channel!
Once upon a time, Connor didn’t even dare to dream that he could interact with these people and even be here as their boss.
But now, Connor felt these people did not seem so unapproachable.
When Thomas and Kyle saw Connor walk in, they quickly approached Connor and said with a smile, “Mr. McDonald, you’re here!”
When the crowd heard Thomas’ words, they immediately paid attention to him. They all focused their gazes on Connor, and their expressions were that of incredulity.
This was because they did not expect that the super-rich kid who had inherited ten trillion in assets would dress so simply. He was no different from poor students.
Although everyone was very surprised, as experienced people who had been in society for many years, they were still more shrewd than the people Connor knew in school. The surprise on their faces only appeared for a fleeting moment, and then they stood up and greeted Connor warmly.
After all, Connor was their real boss now. If these people didn’t curry favor with Connor, who else would they curry favor with?
Next, Connor exchanged a few pleasantries with them. Thomas stood behind Connor and introduced the bosses to him one by one.
Meanwhile, Willow followed behind Connor timidly. Only now, Willow completely understood how influential Connor was!
Connor didn’t even need to say a word. His appearance had caused such a huge sensation, attracting all the big shots to come over and chat. This kind of influence was probably something that even Thomas, Kyle, and Titus were afraid of!
After a simple conversation, the banquet officially began.
Thomas originally planned to let Connor go on stage to say a few words before starting the banquet, but because Connor didn’t like to be in the limelight, and Connor felt that even if he went up, he didn’t know what to say, he refused.
The party lasted for two hours before it finally came to an end.
All the CEOs of Connor’s companies had also spoken to Connor. Their purpose of coming here this time had been achieved. Therefore, after the party ended, they bid farewell to Connor, Thomas, and the others and left in a hurry.
“Mr. McDonald, it’s getting late. Why don’t I arrange a room for you and Miss Tate?”
Titus seemed reluctant to give up on the fact that Connor was not interested in beautiful women. He was trying to find ways to help Connor get into someone’s pants.
After Willow heard this, a trace of shyness flashed in her beautiful eyes, but she did not refuse. After all, Connor had helped her so much. Even if she had to sleep with him, she would.
“There is no need for that. You should go and arrange for Willow’s mother’s surgery. I’ll get Thomas to send me back!” Connor rejected the suggestion and walked out of the hotel.
Hearing Connor’s words, Willow was a little disappointed. She secretly thought it was because Connor did not like her, so he did not want to go to the hotel with her!
Titus stood rooted to the ground in a daze. He couldn’t understand how Connor could still control himself around beautiful women. This was too unbelievable.
***
After Mandy received the five million dollars from Connor, she enjoyed a spoiled life and the happiness that money brought her. Therefore, she never returned to school. Lily had disappeared with Mandy.
As for Brandon, after experiencing the last incident, he never appeared in Connor’s life again.
The disappearance of these three people was a great thing for Connor. After all, these three people were the ones who liked to cause trouble for Connor at school.
Connor also welcomed a rare period of peace!
Usually, Connor would go to class when he had classes and then treat Dominic and Spencer to nicer meals. After all, Dominic and Spencer had helped Connor in the same way.
Connor would work part-time at Xena’s bar if he didn’t have classes. Of course, he wasn’t working for money now. He just wanted to help Xena.
As for Yelena, she hadn’t appeared for a long time. Later, Connor found out that Yelena had won third place in the PK on Twitch and had successfully taken on the female lead role in a web drama. Now, she had already joined the crew to film, so she naturally didn’t have time to disturb Connor.
However, Natasha and Chloe often came to the school to look for Connor, and Connor only treated them as ordinary friends.
As for Natasha and Chloe, they knew Connor’s identity. Naturally, they tried various ways to seduce Connor, but Connor remained unmoved.
All in all, Connor had a very calm time in school.
Not only did he have money to spend, but he also had beautiful women to accompany him. The most important thing was that there were no more clowns like Mandy and Brandon to provoke him.
Half a month later, it was finally summer break!
If it were before, Connor wouldn’t have been particularly excited about summer vacation.
Summer vacation meant work. There was no time to rest at all. However, this summer vacation was different!
This time, Connor would attend Freya’s grandfather’s ninetieth birthday!
The moment he thought about how he would be able to see Freya soon, he became excited..

chapters.title: Chapter 246 - 246: Going to the Phillips Estate
chapters.content:
Chapter 246 - 246: Going to the Phillips Estate
Translator: Endless Fantasy Translation Editor: End less Fantasy Translation
Frey a Phillips used to stay in the Phillips Estate.
The Phillips Estate was not far from Porthampton. If they drove there, it would take at most two hours.
Although the name ‘Phillips Estate’ wasn’t very famous, most people in Porthampton had heard of it because many powerful entrepreneurs in the city were from the Phillips Family.
After these people retired, they would also return to the Phillips Estate and spend the rest of their days there. Freya’s grandfather was one of them.
Therefore, the environment in the Phillips Estate was not inferior to that of Porthampton. The buildings in the large estate was extremely brilliant. It was like a mini city of its own. There were luxury cars and mansions everywhere on the roadside!
After the school holidays, Connor bought a ticket to the Phillips Estate. Then, he packed his luggage and set off for the Phillips Estate alone.
However, before he went to the Phillips Estate, Connor changed into the clothes he bought. These clothes were obviously much better than the one he was wearing. At least Connor looked like a normal person. No one would think that he was a poor loser.
Connor didn’t want the Phillips Family to know his identity. However, he was attending as Freya’s fiance, even if he couldn’t expose his identity, he couldn’t embarrass her, right?
After getting on the bus to the Phillips Estate, Connor started admiring the scenery outside the window.
At this moment, all he could think about was how he was about to meet Freya, so his emotions were all over the place.
In the blink of an eye, two hours passed.
Connor knew that he was about to reach the Phillips Estate, so he took out his phone and dialed Freya’s number.
“Connor, have you arrived at the Phillips Estate?”
Freya quickly picked up the call and asked with a smile.
“Yeah, I’ll probably be there in ten minutes!” Connor replied indifferently.
“That’s great. 1’11 pick you up now. Did you come by train or bus?’”
Freya asked softly.
“Bus!”
“Alright!”
Freya replied before hanging up.
After Freya had hung up the phone, he seemed to be a little excited, lie turned his head and continued to look at the scenery outside the window.
On the other side.
In front of the bus station in front of the Phillips Estate.
A white BMW slowly stopped, and three fashionable beauties in sexy clothes walked out of the car.
When these three beauties appeared in front of the station, they instantly attracted the attention of countless people.
The girl walking in front was none other than Connor’s fiancee, Freya Phillips.
Freya was dressed very casually today. She was wearing a white spaghetti top, revealing her sexy and fair neck. She had on a short skirt that was wrapped tightly around her round buttocks. On her feet were a pair of high-heeled sandals, making her look extremely sexy and charming.
The girl behind Freya was slightly younger. She was wearing a light blue shirt, looking youthful and beautiful. She was wearing a short skirt that showed off her long and fair legs. She was exceptionally charming.
This girl was called Ailee West, the daughter of Freya’s fourth aunt.
The other sexy woman, who was about the same age as Freya, was called Qahira Zeller. She was the daughter of Freya’s eldest aunt.
Freya’s grandfather had a total of four sons and four daughters, so the Phillips Family had many descendants.
Connor only knew Freya and Maya. He had never seen Ailee and Qahira.
This time, Ailee and Qahira had followed Freya to the bus station not because the three of them had a good relationship. On the contrary, Qahira had always treated Freya as her imaginary enemy.
After all, Freya was superior to Qahira in both looks and ability. In addition, Freya’s grandfather had always doted on Freya, which further aroused Qahira’s jealousy.
Therefore, no matter what she did, Qahira liked to compare herself with Freya.
Freya had opened a cosmetics company, and Qahira was also in the cosmetics industry. However, Qahira’s company was much smaller than Freya’s company!
Qahira was secretly gleeful when she found out that Freya’s company was about to close down. However, she did not expect things to take a turn. Freya had found a new investor, and this new investor was the famous Empire World Corporation in Porthampton.
This deeply provoked Qahira. Later on, Qahira received news from somewhere that Freya was able to find a new investor because of her fiance’s help.
At this moment, Freya’s fiance was about to arrive. Naturally, Qahira had to follow along to see who Freya’s fiance was.
Ailee, who was a little younger, came to watch the show.
“Freya! Qahira!”
At this moment, a Mercedes-Benz slowly stopped beside Freya and the others.
Three boys and a girl open the doors and got out.
“Zander, why are you here?”
Freya could not help but frown when she saw the young man in the lead.
“My brother-in-law is here, of course I have to come take a look!”
Zander Phillips replied while gritting his teeth.
Freya looked at Zander coldly and did not say anything. She knew very well that Zander would definitely nor have any good intentions.
Ever since she was young, Freya had always had a good relationship with the Phillips Family. Fl owe ver, Zander was the only one who went against her in every way possible, and their relationship was extremely strained. Furthermore, Zander was the son of Freya’s fourth uncle, so Freya couldn’t really do anything to him.
“It’s so freaking hot today. I’m already sweating. If I continue to wait like this, I’ll definitely get a heatstroke!”
Qahira suddenly complained.
“I told you not to come, but you insisted on coming!”
Freya had never liked Qahira, so she was short with her.
“Where is your fiance? Why is he talcing so long? The makeup on my face costs tens of thousands. If I get sunburned, can he afford to pay for it?”
Qahira pouted and shouted.
“That’s right, Freya. Ask Brother-in-Law when he’ll be arriving. If it’s going to take some time, let’s wait in the car!” Ailee had a good relationship with Qahira, so she naturally had to speak up for Qahira.
Freya didn’t want the talk to the two of them anymore. She took out her phone and was about to call Connor.
But at this moment, a white bus slowly drove in..

chapters.title: Chapter 247 - 247: Qahira Zeller’s Fiance
chapters.content:
Chapter 247 - 247: Qahira Zeller’s Fiance
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
When Freya saw the bus approaching, she hurriedly put down her phone because she knew that Connor was inside the bus.
When Qahira Zeller and Ailee West saw Freya put down her phone, a hint of confusion flashed across their faces. They asked Freya with a puzzled expression, “Freya, why didn’t you call your fiance?”
“Connor should be on this bus. There’s no need to call him!”
Freya pointed at the oncoming bus and replied expressionlessly.
“Your fiance actually came here in such a broken bus?”
Qahira was shocked when she heard Freya’s words. She then asked in confusion.
“Can’t he?”
Freya naturally understood what Qahira meant, so she replied coldly.
“Of course, he can. It’s just that I didn’t expect your fiance to be so thrifty. He doesn’t even drive his own car when he goes out. Instead, he took a bus here…”
Qahira smiled playfully; her eyes filled with disdain.
“Freya, are you joking with me? Your fiance actually came by bus? Doesn’t he have his own car?” Ailee also asked.
“Yes! Connor doesn’t have a car!”
Freya had already known that they would say this, but she didn’t care anymore, so she merely remarked casually.
Zander Phillips could not help but laugh coldly when he heard that, but he did not say anything.
He had indeed come here today to see Freya make a fool of herself. However, Freya’s fiance had yet to appear. If he were to mock Freya just because of a bus, that would be a little too hasty.
Zander was very smart. He knew that there were many rich people in this world who usually kept a low profile. What if Freya’s fiance was a low-profile rich second-generation heir who did not like to drive?
If he was, wouldn’t he be slapping his own face? Therefore, Zander was not in a hurry to mock Freya. Instead, he waited in silence.
Soon, the bus arrived and stopped at the entrance of the station.
“What kind of crappy bus is this? It’s swaying and making such a loud sound.”
Qahira hurriedly took a few steps back and shouted disdainfully.
Ailee and Zander also stepped backward.
Only Freya remained standing where she was, allowing the old bus to pass by her as she quietly waited for Connor to get off.
Screech!
The sound of a sudden brake was heard, and the bus came to a halt.
“We’ve arrived at the Phillips Estate. Those who want to get off, get off quickly!”
The bus driver shouted at the top of his lungs.
The passengers did not move. After all, the people in the Phillips Family were very rich. It was impossible for them to take such an old bus home.
Only Connor stood up. Then, under everyone’s surprised gazes, he slowly got off the car.
“Connor!”
When Freya saw Connor coming down from the bus, she hurriedly waved her hand.
Meanwhile, Zander, Qahira, and Ailee turned to look at Connor.
When the three of them saw Connor, a puzzled expression flashed across their faces.
“Freya!”
Connor shouted at Freya excitedly.
After all, he had not seen Freya for half a month. Seeing Freya again, Connor was still very excited.
However, at this moment, he also noticed Qahira and Ailee standing behind Freya Phillips. He realized that there was something wrong with the way they were looking at him.
“Qahira, why doesn’t Freya’s fiance look like a rich second-generation heir?”
Ailee looked at Connor carefully and turned to Qahira.
Although Connor had changed into a new set of clothes today, and it was obviously much better than his previous set of clothes, in front of a real rich second-generation heir like Qahira, this set of clothes was nothing.
In their eyes, the typical rich second-generation heir would at least go out with luxury brands like Versace and Armani.
However, the casual clothes that Connor was wearing now did look a little shabby.
“Freya’s fiance is a poor loser. Have you ever seen a rich second-generation heir wearing such clothes?”
Qahira replied disdainfully.
“But didn’t everyone say that Freya’s fiance is very powerful? Even the CEO of the Empire World Corporation has to give him some face…”
Ailee said calmly.
“Does the Empire World Corporation’s CEO giving him face prove that he’s a rich second-generation heir?”
Qahira couldn’t help but sneer.
Ailee blinked her eyes and pouted. She muttered with a puzzled expression, “Why did Freya choose such a person as her fiance? I really don’t know what she’s thinking!”
Qahira looked at Connor, who was chatting with Freya, and she was indescribably happy. She finally found a chance to step on Freya.
“You must be tired after traveling for two hours. I’ve already reserved a hotel room for you. Why don’t I take you to the hotel now?”
Freya asked Connor with a smile.
“Alright!”
Connor nodded.
This was because many members of the Phillips Family would return to the Phillips Estate. Not only would Freya’s parents’ relatives come, but even Freya’s grandfather’s siblings would also come.
Therefore, the manor in the Phillips Estate did not have so many rooms for them to stay in. Only the elders of the Phillips Family would stay in the Phillips Family’s old residence. The younger generation were all staying in the hotel.
“Freya, why are you in such a hurry to leave? You haven’t introduced your fiance to us yet.”
At this moment, Zander suddenly shouted in a weird tone.
When Zander saw that Connor came by bus, he had already started to suspect Connor’s identity, but he did not say anything.
However, after Zander saw Connor’s outfit, he was certain that Connor was not a rich second-generation heir, so he naturally had to mock him.
Freya turned and looked at Zander coldly before saying expressionlessly, “Why should I introduce my fiance to you?”
Of course, Freya knew what Zander wanted to do, so she replied with a slightly displeased tone.
“Freya, you must be afraid of introducing him to us.” Zander smiled playfully.
Freya glanced at Zander indifferently and ignored him. She took Connor by the hand and wanted to leave.
“Freya, don’t be in a hurry to leave! Qahira’s fiance will pass by later. Let’s wait together!”
At this moment, Ailee suddenly shouted..

chapters.title: Chapter 248 - 248: I’m Still a Student
chapters.content:
Chapter 248: I’m Still a Student
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
When Freya heard those words, she couldn’t help but be stunned.
It came to her realization that Qahira had insisted on coming over not to mock her, but because Qahira’s fiance was also coming.
At this moment, a domineering Land Rover sped toward Qahira, Ailee, and the others.
After a series of emergency brakes, the Land Rover stopped steadily in front of Qahira.
Because the Land Rover was too fast, it set off thick smoke on the road. However, Qahira and Ailee didn’t seem to mind the dust. They wanted to jump into the Land Rover.
Freya and Connor stood at the side, looking at the Land Rover with complicated expressions.
Freya knew very well that Qahira was doing this on purpose.
She clearly knew that Connor would come today, so she specially asked her fiance to appear at this time. Her goal was to compare her fiance with Connor to humiliate her.
After the Land Rover stopped, a handsome man in a black suit walked out of the car.
“Hubby, why are you so late? I’ve been waiting for you for so long!”
When Qahira saw the man get out of the car, she threw herself into his arms and called out with a bitter expression.
“Baby, I’m sorry for making you wait!” the man replied dotingly.
“It’s okay, I don’t blame you. After all, the road in the countryside is a little difficult to navigate!”
Qahira chuckled.
“Hello, Brother-in-Law!”
Ailee and Zander had met Qahira’s fiance before, so they greeted him in a familiar tone.
When the man heard this, he quickly turned to look at Ailee and Zander. He smiled and said, “Zander, Ailee, you two are here too?”
“That’s right, Brother-in-Law. I came here specially to wait for you!”
Ailee replied with a smile.
“Brother-in-Law, how’s your business recently? The company you asked me to invest in last time is about to go public. I’m going to make a fortune! Do you have any other exclusive news to reveal to me this time?” Zander grinned as well.
At this moment, Ailee and Zander’s attitude toward the man was completely different from their attitude toward Connor.
When the two of them saw Connor just now, they didn’t even say a word. They kept looking at Connor with disdain.
Now, when they were facing Qahira’s fiance, they were trying to curry favor with him in every possible way, just like two pugs.
At this moment, Qahira’s expression was very smug because she had arranged everything.
She knew that Connor would be coming today, so she followed Freya to the bus station and told her fiance to wait nearby.
When Qahira saw Connor, if she felt that her fiance could beat him, she would call him over. If he couldn’t, then she didn’t plan to let her fiance show himself to avoid embarrassment.
After all, Qahira’s fiance was not some rich second-generation heir. He was just a self-made man who was working his way up in life.
But now, the contrast between the two of them was very obvious.
Compared to Qahira’s fiance, Connor did not have any advantage in terms of appearance, temperament, or dressing.
Moreover, Qahira’s fiance was the deputy general manager of an investment company in Porthampton. His annual salary was more than ten million dollars. Qahira felt that Connor should not be able to compare to him in this aspect.
In fact, before Qahira met Connor, she was still very worried that her fiance could not compare to Connor.
After all, she had heard some rumors about Connor.
It was said that Connor knew the CEO of the Empire World Corporation. Back then, it was Connor who invited the CEO of the corporation to Freya’s company. The corporation even invested 200 million dollars in her company to revive it.
Qahira felt that since Connor was so influential that he could invite the CEO of the Empire World Corporation, his background must be extraordinary.
Her fiance was just a senior executive of a company. Naturally, he could not be compared to those rich second-generation heirs.
However, when Qahira saw Connor, she realized that her worries were unnecessary.
Connor was not a rich second-generation heir at all. The news that he knew the CEO of the Empire World Corporation was probably fake.
‘Freya, even if you’re prettier than me and have higher academic qualifications, that means nothing. My fiance is more outstanding than yours. As a woman, marrying a good husband is the most important thing!’
Qahira looked at Freya and Connor who were not far away and could not help but mutter to herself.
Qahira’s fiance turned to look at Freya and Connor after chatting with Ailee and Zander for a while.
When he saw Freya, a hint of surprise flashed in his eyes.
Although he had long heard that Qahira had a very beautiful cousin, he did not expect Freya to be so beautiful. Whether it was her figure, temperament, or appearance, she was perfect. She was simply a few streets ahead of Qahira.
However, Qahira’s fiance’s eyes flashed with a trace of doubt at the same time. He knew that Connor, who was standing beside Freya, was her fiance.
How could a peerless beauty like Freya be with such an ordinary person?
Qahira’s fiance really couldn’t understand that.
“Freya, this is your first time meeting Shane, right?”
At this moment, Qahira shouted at Freya with a smug expression.
Then, she held onto her fiance, Shane Zimmerman’s arm, and walked over to Connor and Freya. She introduced him to Freya softly, “Freya, this is my fiance, Shane Zimmerman. He’s now the deputy general manager of Eon Investment Company. You should have heard of Eon Investment Company, right?”
■I 11
When Freya heard Qahira’s words, she couldn’t help but be stunned. Then, she raised her head and looked at Shane with a hint of surprise in her eyes.
Eon Investment was considered one of the top investment companies in Porthampton. It was really terrifying that Shane could become the deputy general manager of this company at such a young age.
“Hubby, this is my cousin, Freya Phillips. She runs a cosmetics company in Porthampton. You two can get to know each other!”
Qahira turned her head and introduced him.
“Freya, hello!”
Shane greeted Freya with a smile.
“Hello!”
Freya nodded expressionlessly, as if she was not interested in Shane.
“And this is?”
Shane turned his head to look at Connor and asked in a puzzled tone.
“This is Freya’s fiance, Connor McDonald!”
Qahira quickly replied.
“Oh!”
Shane nodded thoughtfully, then looked at Connor and asked, “1 wonder where Mr. McDonald is making a fortune now?”
“I’m still a student!”
Connor replied calmly.
“Hahaha!”
Shane couldn’t help but laugh when he heard Connor’s words. He obviously looked down on Connor.
Qahira, Ailee, and the others also laughed out loud..

chapters.title: Chapter 249 - 249: Everyone’s Taunt
chapters.content:
Chapter 249: Everyone’s Taunt
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
When Freya saw Shane Zimmerman and the others laughing at Connor, a hint of anger appeared on her face. She took a step forward and was about to speak but was stopped by Connor.
Connor narrowed his eyes and asked Shane, “Is the general manager of Eon Investment Company called Joshua Qualls?”
When Shane heard Connor’s words, he couldn’t help but be stunned for a moment. Then, he frowned and asked, “Do you know the general manager of Eon Investment?”
Qahira, Ailee, and the others were also confused. After all, in their eyes, Connor was just a poor loser. It was impossible for him to know such a person.
Freya was also dumbfounded.
“I don’t…”
Connor smiled and shook his head, then continued, “I’ve only heard of this person’s name!”
“Oh! I knew it! Someone like you wouldn’t know Shane’s boss!”
Qahira quickly added.
“Shane’s boss?”
Connor couldn’t help but reveal a playful smile. Qahira probably didn’t know that Shane’s real boss was standing right in front of her.
Although the general manager of Eon Investment was Joshua Qualls, the real chairman of Eon Investment was Thomas Morgan.
In other words, Connor was actually the boss of Joshua Qualls’ boss!
Joshua only held 30% of the shares of the company, while Connor held 60%.
Previously, at the company banquet at the Fairy Lake Resort, Joshua had to queue for more than an hour before he could speak to Connor!
The reason why Connor mentioned Joshua’s name was to make Shane restrain himself. However, looking at Shane’s expression, he knew that Shane probably didn’t understand what he meant.
“I wonder what major Brother McDonald is studying in school now. If it’s related to finance, you can come to my company after you graduate. 1’11 arrange a job with a monthly salary of ten thousand dollars for you.”
Shane took a step forward and pretended to be enthusiastic as he spoke to Connor.
In fact, his words were very skillful. Not only could he inadvertently humiliate Connor, but he also said it in such a way that did not allow Connor to find any faults with his words. Most importantly, he could also show off his ability. It could be said that he was killing two birds with one stone.
“Nah!”
Connor said indifferently to Shane.
“Connor, you should be appreciative. Shane won’t casually introduce a job to someone. Are you sure you don’t want it? After you graduate, it’s basically impossible for you to find a job with a monthly salary of more than ten thousand dollars. But now, as long as Shane says the word, you can easily earn more than ten thousand a month. When you become a full-time employee, it won’t be a problem for you to earn fifty or sixty thousand dollars!” Qahira shouted at Connor in a strange tone.
“After Connor graduates, he will join my company, so you don’t have to worry about his work!”
Freya shouted with a frown, then pulled Connor and wanted to leave.
At this moment, Freya’s face had darkened. After all, no matter what, Connor was her fiance. But now, these people actually humiliated Connor in front of her. They simply did not put her in their eyes.
“Since Mr. McDonald is going to help Miss Freya’s company in the future, then 1 won’t do anything unnecessary. After all, it’s much easier to work under your fiancee!”
Shane sneered.
“Hahaha, Brother-in-Law, you just have to say that Connor is someone who depends on his wife. You don’t have to be so tactful!”
Zander burst out laughing.
Qahira and Ailee were also laughing hysterically.
When Connor heard Shane’s words, he could not help but turn his head and glare at Shane.
At this moment, in his gleeful delight of mocking Connor, Shane did not know how miserable he would be in the future.
At this moment, he was humiliating and mocking Connor without any restraint. However, Connor only needed one phone call to change Shane’s life.
“Connor, let’s go!”
Freya grabbed Connor and was prepared to leave.
“Freya, don’t be in a hurry to leave. Shane just booked a restaurant. Let’s go over and have a meal before leaving!”
Qahira saw that Freya was about to leave with Connor and hurriedly called out.
“You guys go ahead. Connor and I will go back first!”
Freya called out without turning her head.
“Don’t. Uncle and the others have already arrived at the restaurant. Isn’t it inappropriate if you don’t bring Connor over?” Qahira shouted again.
When Freya heard this, her expression changed drastically. She had not expected Qahira to call her parents over.
On the other hand, Qahira’s expression was very smug. She naturally wouldn’t let today’s scene end like this.
She wanted to utterly humiliate Connor in front of the Phillips Family and Freya’s parents, so she had already asked them to go to the restaurant.
“Qahira, why did you call my parents out when you want to eat with your fiance?”
Freya shouted angrily at Qahira.
“Isn’t your fiance here today? What’s wrong with us having fun together?”
Qahira replied with a smile, then continued, “Let’s hurry over. If we wait any longer, Uncle and the others will get angry…”
Freya looked at Qahira’s expression and was furious. She had never expected Qahira to go so far. Not only did she humiliate Connor here, but she even wanted to bring Connor to her parents and humiliate him in front of them. Wasn’t she clearly trying to embarrass her parents?
“Freya, don’t tell me you don’t dare to go over because you think Connor is too embarrassing?”
Zander said when he saw her standing there without saying anything.
“Why won’t 1 dare to go over?”
Freya gritted her teeth and replied softly, her expression becoming firm.
She knew that if she continued to reject her like this, it was very likely that it would affect Connor’s mood, so Freya pulled Connor and said, “Connor, let’s go. Someone is buying us a meal; it’s a waste not to eat free food!”
H 11
Connor glanced at Freya indifferently, his face turning dark.
Back then, he had refused to come to the Phillips Estate because he was worried that something like this would happen. However, he did not expect the Phillips Family to go so far.
Connor was really unwilling to let Freya and her parents lose face just because of his identity.
However, he couldn’t reveal his identity in front of Freya yet. Otherwise, Connor would show Shane that an idiot who didn’t want to die shouldn’t do anything stupid.
Shane and Qahira saw that Freya had agreed, so they got into the Land Rover and drove off.
Connor followed Freya into the Mercedes-Benz, while Ailee got into Zander’s BMW.
The three cars drove straight to the restaurant.
“Connor, I’m sorry. Qahira’s personality has been like this since she was young. If she says anything to you, don’t take it to heart!”
Freya whispered to Connor as she was driving.
“I should be the one who’s sorry. I’m the one who embarrassed you!”
Connor replied guiltily.
“Why would you embarrass me? You’re my fiance. As long as 1 feel that there’s nothing wrong with you, you’ll still be the best in my heart!” Freya hurriedly said.
When Connor heard Freya’s words, a warm feeling surged in his heart..

chapters.title: Chapter 250 - 250: A Society That Only Values Money
chapters.content:
Chapter 250 - 250: A Society That Only Values Money
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Ten minutes later.
Connor and the others came to the restaurant that Shane had booked.
Four middle-aged people stood at the entrance of the restaurant. Two of them were Freya’s parents, while the other two were Qahira’s parents.
The four stood at the entrance of the restaurant, eagerly waiting for Freya, Qahira, and the others to arrive.
When Freya saw the four middle-aged people at the entrance of the restaurant, a hint of nervousness flashed across her eyes. She turned to Connor and said, “Connor, my parents and my uncle and aunt have already arrived. Let’s get off the car!”
“Okay!”
Connor nodded lightly. This was the first time he was meeting Freya’s parents, so he was a little nervous.
But before Connor and Freya could get out of the car, Qahira pulled Shane’s arm and walked toward the four middle-aged people.
“Dad, Mom, Uncle, Auntie!”
Qahira smiled cutely and greeted the four elders.
Freya’s mother, Laura Crawford, turned to look at Shane, who was beside Qahira. She smiled and asked, “Qahira, this must be your boyfriend, right?”
“That’s right, Auntie. This is my boyfriend, Shane!”
Qahira quickly nodded.
“Not bad. He looks dignified and is a good match for Qahira!”
Freya’s father, Sean Phillips, called out with a smile.
Meanwhile, Qahira’s mother, Sandra Phillips, looked at Shane with a smile on her face.
After all, be it his figure, appearance, or clothes, Shane looked very good.
On the other hand, Qahira’s family background was not very good. Although her mother was a member of the Phillips Family, her father was an office worker.
Therefore, Sandra felt that it was very good for Qahira to find such an outstanding boyfriend.
Shane politely greeted Qahira’s parents and Freya’s parents. The atmosphere was quite harmonious.
“Sandra, Qahira is really amazing. She actually found such an outstanding boyfriend.”
Freya’s mother, Laura, said to Sandra with a smile.
“Laura, what are you talking about? Qahira isn’t as good as Freya! Your son-in-law is definitely better than mine!” Sandra replied.
When Sean and Laura heard this, they sighed almost at the same time.
After all, Sean had arranged such a marriage for Freya in order to prevent his company from going bankrupt.
Initially, Sean thought that he had found a good family for Freya. However, he later found out that his future son-in-law was actually a poor student who delivered food. He did not have any family background at all!
After Sean found out about Connor’s background, it immediately crushed his fantasy of having a good son-in-law. When Freya’s company was in trouble, Sean had originally planned to cancel the marriage and matchmake Freya and Cody Shenaur.
If that was the case, not only would he be proud, but Freya would also not have to suffer with Connor anymore.
However, for some reason, Freya refused to agree to this matter no matter what. Cody then no longer had any thoughts about Freya.
Sean had always been very puzzled by this matter.
Therefore, the two of them inevitably felt a little guilty after hearing Sandra’s words.
“If my son-in-law can be one-tenth as good as Shane, 1’11 be satisfied!”
Laura sighed helplessly.
“Laura, look at what you’re saying. You’re really too humble! I heard that your son-in-law is very powerful. He even knows the CEO of the Empire World Corporation!”
Sandra hurriedly replied, then turned to Qahira and asked, “Qahira, didn’t you say that Freya’s fiance would be coming today? Where are they now?”
“Mom!”
Sandra had just finished speaking when Freya’s voice suddenly rang out.
When everyone heard Freya’s voice, they all turned to look.
Connor and Freya slowly walked over.
When Sandra saw Freya, she hurriedly walked over to her and said in an intimate manner, “Freya, you’re finally here. I haven’t seen you in years!”
“Hello, Aunt and Uncle!”
Freya didn’t have a good impression of Sandra’s family, but she still greeted them out of politeness.
“My eldest niece is really getting more and more beautiful now…”
Sandra smiled faintly, then looked at Freya and asked, “Freya, I heard that your fiance is here today. Where is he? Hurry up and ask him to say hello!”
Freya was stunned when she heard this. Then, she looked at Connor awkwardly and said, “Auntie, this is my fiance, Connor McDonald!”
Sandra turned her head to look at Connor, and she suddenly had a look of incredulity on her face.
In fact, Sandra had also noticed Connor just now, but she saw that Connor looked like a loser, so she thought that Connor was Freya’s driver.
However, she had never expected that Freya’s fiance would be this guy who looked like a loser.
Sean and Laura looked awkward.
In their opinion, Connor didn’t look that shabby now. Although the clothes he was wearing were very ordinary, the young man was still quite energetic and not as wretched as other men who were losers.
As for his family background, the two of them were already mentally prepared.
However, Shane was still present. The difference between the two was obvious.
“Freya, your fiance is quite energetic!”
Sandra looked at Freya and said with a fake smile. Then, she instantly lost interest in talking and turned around to leave. From the beginning to the end, she did not say a word to Connor.
Initially, she had wanted to compare Freya’s fiance to her daughter’s fiance. However, it seemed that there was no need for that.
After Sandra left, Freya brought Connor to her parents and gave them a brief introduction.
“Hello, Uncle and Auntie!”
Connor quickly greeted Sean and Laura.
Sean snorted coldly.
Laura didn’t say a word. She turned her head and said to Sandra, “Sandra, where is our room? Let’s go in and eat!”
At this moment, Sean and Laura were both thinking that they had let their daughter down. They had actually married her off to a person like Connor. It was really too unfair to Freya.
“The private room is upstairs. This time, Shane specially booked a big private room for us. Let’s go in!”
Sandra hurriedly replied and enthusiastically dragged Shane into the restaurant.
“Freya, let’s go!”
Laura also dragged Freya in.
In the blink of an eye, everyone had walked into the restaurant.
Only Connor was left standing alone at the door. An unprecedented sense of humiliation suddenly emerged in his heart.
Connor could clearly feel the attitude of Sean and Laura toward him, but he felt that it was normal.
After all, those who didn’t know Connor’s identity would feel that he wasn’t worthy of Freya.
At first, Connor also figured that such a thing would happen, but when it really happened, Connor felt that he still couldn’t accept it.
“I don’t know when it started, but it seems that the society only values money. Without money, you don’t even deserve a wife!”
Connor sighed helplessly and walked into the restaurant..

chapters.title: Chapter 251 - 251: Meeting an Acquaintance
chapters.content:
Chapter 251 - 251: Meeting an Acquaintance
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation Phillips Manor.
Inside Lume Hotel.
Qahira and the rest walked into the restaurant majestically while Laura dragged Freya along.
As a result, even Freya did not notice that Connor had been left behind. Even if she did, she would not have the chance to call for him.
“Freya, I don’t want to criticize you, but I know that you’re not young anymore, and it’s normal for you to want a boyfriend. But you can’t just find a random cat or dog to be your boyfriend, right? What do you think is going on with that Connor you’re looking for?” Sandra said to Freya meaningfully.
When Freya heard these words, she was instantly unhappy. She said with a straight face, “Whoever 1 want to be with is my own business. 1 don’t need you to judge me! If you really have the time, you should discipline Qahira…”
After saying this, Freya shook off Laura’s hand and turned around to look for Connor.
Although Freya had some misunderstandings with Connor before, she felt that he was not as bad as she had imagined. Moreover, she had also started to accept his existence slowly, so when she heard others say bad things about Connor, Freya was naturally unhappy.
“You… Look at this child. Why is she still throwing a tantrum at me? Although what I said just now was a little harsh, wasn’t it out of kindness?” Sandra said awkwardly after Freya left.
“Big Sis, Freya is with Connor not because she really likes him, but rather because she was forced to! There are many things that you don’t know,” Sean replied helplessly.
“Forced?”
When Sandra heard this, she couldn’t help but be stunned for a moment. Then, she frowned and asked, “Why was she forced to do this?”
“Forget it, I won’t be able to explain it to you in a short time. I’ll tell you when I have time in the future!” Sean waved his hand helplessly and walked into the private room.
At this moment, the waiters in the private room had already served all the dishes. There were all kinds of delicacies sitting on the table. Every dish looked, smelled, and tasted delicious. Just looking at it would make people drool.
Sean often came here to eat, so he could tell at a glance that the dishes on this table cost at least a hundred thousand dollars, not including drinks.
“Shane, we’re just here for a simple meal. Did you have to make it like this? This is too excessive!” Sean asked Shane softly.
“That’s right, Shane, you’re too extravagant and wasteful. You can’t do this next time!” Sandra agreed. Although she said that, she was actually overjoyed; After all, Shane did this for her sake.
Shane’s annual salary was 10 million dollars, but this meal would cost him nearly 200,000 dollars!
And what was 200,000 dollars? That amount of money could buy a low-end SUV or pay the down payment for a third- or fourth-tier house.
However, Shane had spent nearly 200,000 dollars just to treat everyone to a meal. Even if he had that much money, he would still feel a little heartache.
He then remembered that this was the first time treating Qahira’s parents to a meal. Freya’s parents were also present.
Therefore, for the sake of Qahira and his own image, he could only grit his teeth and book this private room.
Shane and Qahira had known each other for more than half a year, but their relationship had not progressed at all. They were still at the stage of holding hands and kissing.
Every time Shane suggested going out to get a room, Qahira would think of all sorts of ways to reject him. Therefore, in order to successfully get her, he felt that it was worth spending so much money today.
At this moment, Qahira was also very happy; her fiance, Shane, was so outstanding that he could beat up Freya’s fiance, Connor.
This was also the first time she’d managed to successfully bully Freya, so her impression of Shane began to soar.
On the other side, after Freya left the restaurant, she ran straight to the door to look for Connor. However, when she arrived at the entrance of the restaurant, she didn’t see him anywhere. Freya began to grow anxious.
She was worried that her parents ‘attitude and Sandra’s words had angered Connor and made him leave.
However, what she didn’t know was that Connor didn’t leave the restaurant. Instead, it was because he met an acquaintance in the restaurant.
In the corner of a corridor of Lume, a middle-aged man was talking to Connor with a smile on his face. This man was none other than the general manager of Immortal Lake Manor, Titus.
Titus was not only the general manager of Immortal Lake Manor, but also the general manager of Lume.
To put it simply, Connor himself did not know that the restaurant they were in was actually his property as well. Titus was here to inspect the work today, but he didn’t expect to meet Connor here.
“Young Master McDonald, why didn’t you give me a call beforehand? 1 would’ve gotten someone to come over and receive you…”
Titus said to Connor with a smile.
“I came here with my fiancee this time, but I didn’t know that this restaurant actually belongs to our company!” Connor replied indifferently.
“So that’s how it is!” Titus nodded thoughtfully.
“By the way, my fiancee doesn’t know my true identity yet, nor do 1 want her to know. Do you understand what 1 mean?” Connor whispered to Titus.
Titus was stunned for a moment and asked, “You don’t want her to know your identity? What does this mean?”
Connor looked at Titus’s expression, speechless. He opened his mouth and was about to explain when he suddenly realized that his phone was ringing.
He took out his phone and saw that it was a call from Freya.
“My fiancee’s calling me, so I can’t talk to you anymore. Anyway, remember not to let these people know that I’m the owner of this restaurant, understand?”
Connor was worried that if he continued to chat with Titus, Freya would see him and things would get troublesome. Hence, after giving a simple reminder, he left in a hurry.
Titus stood there with a puzzled expression. He couldn’t understand what Connor meant.
After Connor parted ways with Titus, he went straight to the entrance of the restaurant to find Freya.
“Connor, where did you go? I was worried that you had left!” Freya called out excitedly when she saw Connor.
“I just went to the toilet!” Connor replied with a smile.
“Oh, it’s good that you didn’t leave. Let’s go to the private room quickly. The dishes are already served!” Freya dragged Connor along and walked towards the private room.
However, when Connor and Freya returned to the private room, they found a very awkward problem.
There was one less seat in the private room!

chapters.title: Chapter 252 - 252: Let Connor Eat Somewhere Else
chapters.content:
Chapter 252 - 252: Let Connor Eat Somewhere Else
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Originally, there were only eight seats in this private room, but now there were ten people including Freya and Connor.
Laura had asked the waiter to add an extra chair for Freya, but no one had added a seat for Connor.
On top of that, the space in the private room was not very big to begin with, so even if they wanted to add more chairs, they could not.
The private rooms in Lume had a minimum cost. When Shane booked the private room, he had specially chosen a smaller private room so that the minimum cost would be lower.
Normally, this private room could only accommodate eight people. However, when Laura saw that her daughter did not have a seat, she asked the waiter to add an extra seat.
However, if they wanted to add another seat, the entire private room would seem a little crowded, so they’d selectively ignored Connor’s existence.
After Freya sat down, she instinctively turned to look at Connor. When she realized that Connor had no seat, she frowned and said, “Why didn’t you guys give Connor a chair?”
“Freya, this private room is only this big. Just now, we also wanted to add a seat for Connor, but the waiter said that we can only add one seat at most. If we add more, we won’t be able to fit him…” Qahira replied indifferently.
“That’s right. The waiter just said that this private room can only accommodate a maximum of nine people!” Ailee said.
When Freya heard Qahira and Ailee’s words, her expression instantly changed. She could clearly feel that they were deliberately making things difficult for Connor.
“Freya, how about this? Get Connor to go out and eat whatever he wants. We’ll pay for his meal!” Sandra suddenly said.
When Freya heard Sandra’s words, she was stunned on the spot, and her expression turned into one of fury.
Were they implying that Connor came here today just to freeload? Everyone was eating in the private room, and yet they wanted Connor to be the only one who went out to eat. Wasn’t this insulting?
Even Sean and Laura had ugly expressions on their faces when they heard Sandra’s words. No matter how much the two of them disliked Connor, he was still their son-in-law. Sandra humiliating Connor now was equivalent to humiliating the two of them.
However, Shane was the one who treated them to this meal today, so the two of them couldn’t say much. They could only sit in their seats and wait for Connor to leave on his own. This way, they could suffer less humiliation.
“Aunt, you said you want Connor to eat out?” Freya asked in disbelief.
“That’s right. If he doesn’t want to go out to eat, he can stand here and eat. Let’s see what he chooses!”
Sandra clearly wasn’t even thinking about Connor this time and replied very flippantly.
“Shane treating someone like Connor to a meal is already a privilege. Moreover, isn’t it a matter of where we eat? Freya, you’d better get Connor out quickly, lest he gets in the way here!” Ailee called out to Freya with a smile.
Connor stood there expressionlessly. At this moment, there was only one thought in his mind: the moment he could expose his identity in front of Freya, he would definitely teach these people a lesson!
If they were just humiliating Connor, he would not be so angry; after all, this world was a society that valued money.
However, they were not only humiliating Connor, but also Freya.
Connor would never allow anyone to humiliate her, so he had to remember what had happened today. He would return the favor a hundredfold in the future!
“Freya, she’s right. I can eat anywhere. I’d better go outside!”
Connor didn’t want to make things difficult for Freya, and he also didn’t want to eat with these people, so he called out to Freya calmly and turned to leave the private room.
“You… You guys are really too much. Since you don’t like Connor so much, I won’t eat here. I’ll go out with Connor to eat!” Freya looked at the crowd and shouted loudly. Then, she left with Connor without looking back.
After hearing Freya’s words, Connor was very touched. No matter how everyone else treated him, at least Freya treated him very well.
As long as Freya didn’t give up on him, Connor didn’t care how others humiliated him!
When Sandra saw that Freya was really about to leave, she hurriedly stopped her. “Freya, what are you doing? So what if Connor leaves? Besides, whatever he eats will be paid for by Shane. There is still a seat in this private room. You can stay!”
“The whole family is eating here. Why should Connor go out alone? Why don’t you ask your son-in-law to get out? Connor is my fiance. If you don’t respect my fiance now, that means you don’t respect me!”
Freya didn’t intend to give Sandra any face at this time, so she shouted unreservedly.
When Sandra heard this, her expression suddenly became a little awkward. Only now did she realize that she’d gone a little overboard in what she’d said. She hurriedly called out, “Freya, what are you saying? How can we not respect you and Connor? I was just joking with you just now. How can I really ask Connor to go out to eat?”
n 11
Freya looked at Sandra coldly without saying anything.
“Shane, hurry up and ask the waiter to change us to a bigger private room!” Sandra quickly said to him.
“Alright… Fine!”
Shane nodded helplessly.
