“I see. I thought you really slept with Connor!” Priscilla replied with a faint smile.
“We’ve known each other for so long. Don’t you know my personality? 1 haven’t agreed to be with Connor yet, so why would I sleep with him?” Freya shouted with her big, watery eyes before continuing, “My mother must really be so anxious for me to be with Connor to even tell other people about this kind of thing…”
“Connor is no longer the poor kid from before.. In the eyes of our elders, Connor is now a super rich second-generation heir. Auntie will definitely not be willing to let you miss out on Connor!” Priscilla said helplessly.
“Hah…”
After hearing this, Freya sighed helplessly, not knowing what to say.
“Other people can think whatever they want. In my eyes, Connor is still that poor loser. He was just lucky enough to meet Thomas Morgan. As long as my cousin didn’t sleep with Connor, I don’t want to let that bastard Connor get away with it!” Maya pouted and said fiercely.
it
Freya looked at Maya helplessly. If she had known that the Phillips family would have such a reaction, she would not have let Connor pretend to be a rich second-generation heir.
“Alright, stop talking. Connor is here. Let’s get in rhe car!”
At this moment, Priscilla saw Connor drive his Mercedes-Benz out of the garage. She reached out and pulled Freya and Maya towards the car..

chapters.title: Chapter 327 - 327: The Arrival of a Mysterious Beauty
chapters.content:
Chapter 327 - 327: The Arrival of a Mysterious Beauty
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
At the same time, at Porthampton Airport.
A boeing 747, arriving from Gloradia, landed in Porthampton.
Five minutes later, a beautiful woman with a hot figure and sexy clothes slowly got off the plane with a limited-edition Gucci bag slung around her shoulder.
In an instant, all the mens’ attention was focused on this beautiful woman.
The beautiful woman was wearing a white strapless top and a navy blue skirt. Her long and fair legs were tightly wrapped in black stockings, and she was wearing a pair of sexy red high heels. Her exquisite face and sexy figure made her look extremely attractive.
The male passengers who had just alighted from the plane, and even the airport staff, who were used to seeing beautiful flight attendants, could not help but swallow when they saw this beauty. They began to wonder what it would be like to be with such a beautiful woman!
The beauty was very tall, and after wearing high heels, she looked even taller. She was about 1.8 meters tall. This height was enough to kill most of the men present. Moreover, her every frown and smile had a hint of charm, as if she could easily capture all these men.
However, this was not the most charming part of this woman. The most charming part of this woman was her lips. Under the high nose bridge, there she had delicate and beautiful lips, like two rose-colored flowers that had just bloomed.
Perhaps it was because she was a little thirsty, or perhaps she was thinking about something, the beautiful woman licked her lips inadvertently. She looked especially seductive, but at the same time, she had a hint of dignity and coldness in her eyes.
Under everyone’s gaze, the beauty slowly walked out of the airport lobby with her Gucci bag. Then, she looked at the square in front of her and revealed a charming smile. She said softly, “Connor, I’m here. Have you thought about how you want your sister to die?”
After saying this, the beauty took out her phone and made a call.
“Hey, brother, I’ve already arrived in Porthampton!” she said lightly.
A man’s voice came from the other end of the phone. “Okay, I got it. Howard and the others should have already arrived at the airport to pick you up.” “Alright!”
The beauty nodded and hung up.
“Beauty, where are you going? Do you want me to give you a piece?”
As soon as the beauty hung up the phone, a middle-aged man with a wretched appearance walked up to the beauty and asked with a smile.
When the beauty heard this, she could not help but frown. A trace of disgust flashed across her eyes as she replied expressionlessly, “No need!”
After the middle-aged man heard this, he was more or less disappointed, but he was still unwilling to give up just like that, so he continued, “Lady, actually, I want to treat you to a meal. 1 wonder if you can…”
“A person like you is not qualified to eat with me. Get lost before 1 get angry!” The beautiful woman narrowed her eyes, her sexy and charming red lips opening and closing. Her words were very domineering.
“You…”
When the middle-aged man heard this, his expression instantly turned ugly. He gritted his teeth and shouted fiercely, “Do you know who I am? You actually dare to act in front of me…”
“Pa!”
Before he could finish, the beauty raised her small hand and slapped the man’s face.
The man was stunned by the slap from the beauty. He stood rooted to the ground and looked at the beauty in front of him, speechless for a long time. He had never expected that this beauty in front of him would have such a hot temper. He had barely spoken a few words when she slapped him directly.
“B*tch, how dare you hit me? Do you know who I am?” The man angrily pointed at the beautiful woman and cursed loudly.
“I don’t care who you are. As long as you dare to spew such profanity to me, then you can only die!” the beautiful woman replied coldly and then walked away.
When the middle-aged man saw that the beauty was about to leave, he reached out his hand to grab her.
However, before he could touch the arm of the beauty, five or six strong men in black suits rushed out of an off-road vehicle and pinned the middle-aged man to the ground in an instant. Then, they started punching and kicking the man without caring about the onlookers.
At the same time, a middle-aged man in a white suit walked up to the beautiful woman and greeted respectfully, “Miss, I’m sorry we’re late!”
When the passengers in the airport saw this middle-aged man, they were all dumbfounded. This middle-aged man was Howard Duncan, the man who was as famous as Kyle Hayes in Porthampton!
To be able to make Howard so respectful, how terrifying must this woman’s background be?
Howard was originally a very famous big shot in Porthampton. Later, due to various reasons, his group was dissolved and replaced by a company called Fortuna Company.
Howard was now the general manager of Fortuna Company.
However, instead of calling it a company, what he was doing now was no different from what the company was doing before. It was just that he had changed the name to a better one.
It was said that Fortuna Company had nearly 1,000 shareholders. This scale was comparable to Kyle Hayes’s. It was just that since Kyle had Thomas Morgan’s support, Howard wasn’t as well known as Kyle was.
“How are the preparations going?” the beauty asked Howard expressionlessly.
“Don’t worry, Miss. I’ve already prepared everything!” Howard quickly replied.
“Good!”
The beauty nodded and walked toward the Land Rover.
Howard followed closely behind the beauty and asked carefully, “Miss, do you plan to rest in Porthampton for a few days before dealing with that Connor, or do you plan to go directly to the Phillips Estate?”
The beautiful woman hesitated for a moment before saying, “There’s nothing fun to do in Porthampton, so let’s go directly to the Phillips Estate. I can’t wait to see Connor!”
“Alright…”
Howard quickly nodded and continued, “Miss, how do you want to deal with that person just now?”
“Just cripple him.”
The beauty replied calmly. There was no emotion on her face when she said this, as if she was dealing with an insect..

chapters.title: Chapter 328 - 328: Freya Was Beaten Up
chapters.content:
Chapter 328 - 328: Freya Was Beaten Up
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
A moment later.
The beauty got into the Land Rover and slowly disappeared from everyone’s sight.
The middle-aged man who had tried to hit on the beauty was lying on the ground, being punched and kicked by five strong men in black. From time to time, he would let out painful howls.
Countless passersby saw this scene, but no one dared to stand up and say anything, because they all knew that these men in front of them were Howard Duncan’s men!
In Porthampton, Kyle Hayes was not to be trifled with, and Howard was even more so.
At the same time, Connor did not know that danger was gradually approaching him. He was still strolling around the mall with Freya, Maya, and the others.
After John’s birthday banquet ended, Connor and Freya stayed at the Phillips Estate for about a week.
Perhaps it was because of what happened on John’s birthday banquet, but everyone’s attitude towards Connor had changed drastically. No one dared to mock and humiliate him anymore.
Therefore, in this week, Connor’s life had been very comfortable. He didn’t need to look at anyone’s face at all.
Usually, when he had nothing to do during the day, he would follow Freya, Maya and Priscilla to do some shopping, or visit the scenic spots around the Phillips Estate.
At night, Connor slept on the same bed as Freya. Although they slept on the same bed, Connor did not do anything to her. It wouldn’t be nice if he forced anything on her, so he was patiently awaiting her reply.
A week passed quickly, and Connor’s vacation was coming to an end. Freya, Sean, and the others also began planning to return to Porthampton.
Although so many things had happened in the Phillips Estate, Connor had still not revealed his identity. Moreover, his relationship with Freya was gradually warming up, so Connor was very satisfied with his trip to the Phillips Estate.
And not only that, Freya had promised Connor that she would give him an answer before she left the Phillips Estate, regardless of whether she was willing to be his fiancee or not.
Thus, Connor had been waiting for Freya’s answer.
However, something happened that directly disrupted his current plans.
On the eve of leaving the Phillips Estate, Freya, Maya and Priscilla went to attend their primary school classmate’s birthday party.
Connor didn’t know their elementary school classmate, and he was also considered a celebrity in the Phillips Estate. Basically, all kinds of big shots would come to the Phillips Estate every day to curry favor with him.
In order to avoid unnecessary trouble, Connor did not attend the birthday party with Freya. Instead, he stayed at home and watched TV alone.
However, less than an hour after Freya and the others left, Connor’s phone rang.
Connor looked down at his phone and saw that it was Maya calling. He picked up the call and asked softly, “Maya, what’s wrong?”
After a week of contact, the relationship between Connor and Maya had also eased a lot. Although Maya still did not want to admit that Connor was her brother-in-law, they had no problems getting along.
“Connor, come over quickly. My cousin is being bullied!” Maya shouted.
“Freya was bullied?” When Connor heard this, he frowned and asked excitedly, “Who’s bullying her? Where are you now?”
“We’re at Lume now. Come over quickly. I can’t talk to you anymore—Freya…!”
Maya shouted and hung up.
“Maya, Maya!”
When Connor heard Maya’s last word, he felt that something was wrong, so he hurriedly shouted twice. However, Maya had already hung up the phone.
Connor called her again, but no one picked up even after a long time.
“Something must have happened to Freya!”
Connor took a deep breath and hung up the phone. Then, he picked up the car keys on the table and ran out of the courtyard house. Connor knew that Lume was the restaurant that Shane had treated them to a meal. It was not far from the Phillips Estate.
Twenty minutes later, Connor arrived at Lume.
After getting out of the car, Connor rushed inside without thinking. He asked the waiter and quickly found the private room where Freya and the others were.
The girl who was celebrating her birthday today was called Amy Day. She was Freya and Priscilla’s primary school classmate. The Day family’s status in Davenport was similar to the Phillips family’s; they were both families with lots of generational wealth.
Even so, Amy was still very popular. Moreover, they were all primary school classmates, so most of the wealthy heirs of the Phillips family had come to attend her birthday party.
At this moment, the private room was filled with young people. After Connor swept his gaze across the crowd, he quickly found where Freya and the others were.
“Freya, Maya, are you alright?”
Connor rushed to them, shouting excitedly.
“Connor, why are you only here now? My cousin was beaten up, do you know that?” Maya shouted with her big, watery eyes.
“Freya was beaten up?”
Connor couldn’t help but turn to look at Freya, who was standing beside Maya.
Freya was currently covering her pretty face with her hand, but Connor could still see the palm print on Freya’s face. It was exceptionally glaring.
Freya wiped the tears from the corners of her eyes and asked Connor with a puzzled expression, “Connor, you…Why are you here?”
“Freya, who hit you?” Connor asked as he gritted his teeth. Connor could accept being insulted by others. Even if he was attacked verbally, he could pretend that he did not hear anything However, he absolutely could not accept someone bullying his woman!
If a man couldn’t even protect his woman, then what could he do even if he had more money?
Freya was Connor’s bottom line, and someone had already crossed it.
“Connor, this matter has nothing to do with you.”
Freya knew that Connor was not a real rich second generation. His connections were only because of Thomas Morgan, so she did not want to see Connor blow up the matter. She was worried that this matter would affect him.
“I’m asking you, who hit you?”
Connor looked at Freya and repeated himself through gritted teeth.
Freya stared at Connor with her big, watery eyes. Her expression was extremely nervous because she had never seen Connor so angry before.
Even when John chased him out of the restaurant in front of so many people, he wasn’t nearly this angry!

chapters.title: Chapter 329 - 329: A Price to Pay!
chapters.content:
Chapter 329: A Price to Pay!
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Lume, in a private room.
“Maya, tell me, who hit Freya?”
Connor knew that Freya probably wouldn’t tell him, so he turned his head and shouted at Maya.
Maya seemed to be frightened by Connor’s expression. After a moment of shock, she pointed at a young man standing not far from Freya and said in a low voice, “That one… Me was the one who hit my cousin. Just now, he even…”
Before Maya could finish her sentence, Connor walked up to the young man and asked him expressionlessly, “You were the one who hit my girlfriend just now, right?”
The young man standing in front of Connor was called Alvin Jacob. Hailey, who had a small conflict with Connor Freya, and the others at Collective Strokes, was Alvin’s sister.
After Alvin found out that his sister Hailey had been bullied by Freya and Priscilla, he had been looking for an opportunity to get back at them. Today, he happened to bump into Freya and Priscilla, so he couldn’t help but mock them.
Alvin had not been at the Phillips Estate recently, so he did not know what had happened at John’s birthday banquet. He was still under the impression that Connor was just a poor delivery boy, so he mocked Freya for not being able to get married and having to get a delivery boy as her fiance. Alvin’s friends also laughed at Freya.
After Freya heard Alvin insulting Connor, she felt very uncomfortable, so she started to refute and directly hit Alvin’s sore spots. Alvin’s biggest sore spot was that he was still a good-for-nothing in his thirties. He couldn’t do anything and had no ability other than squandering money.
After Freya said that, Alvin was so angry that he hit her.
Connor was not in the mood to understand what had happened. He walked directly to Alvin and asked with a gloomy face, “Did you hit my girlfriend just now?”
Alvin looked at Connor with disdain and sneered, “You’re the delivery boy, right?”
“Let me ask you, did you hit my girlfriend just now?”
Connor repeated expressionlessly.
“That’s right, 1 did it. What can you do to me?”
Alvin replied in an unusually disdainful tone.
“Bang!”
Connor didn’t give Alvin any chance to react. He raised his fist and smashed it into Alvin’s face.
“Bang!”
There was a loud thud as Connor’s fist landed hard on Alvin’s face.
Connor didn’t want to know what had happened at all. In his eyes, his woman had been bullied, so he had to fight back fiercely.
In this punch, Connor had practically used up all the strength in his body.
Alvin himself didn’t expect Connor to be so overbearing, attacking as he wished.
He felt his vision suddenly turn black, and then he fell to the ground with a thud. The dining table behind Alvin collapsed instantly, and the food spilled all over the ground.
Freya, Maya and Priscilla’s eyes widened in disbelief as they looked at Connor. The three of them did not expect him to actually make a move!
“Isn’t Connor too handsome? He’s so manly!” Maya covered her mouth and could not help but exclaim.
Freya’s eyes widened as she looked at Connor. She was very touched, but at this moment, she was more worried about Connor.
Although Alvin was a complete prodigal, it was said that Alvin also knew some great big shots in Porthampton. She was worried that if things got out of hand, not even Thomas Morgan would be able to save Connor.
“You f*cking…”
Alvin stood up shakily and pointed at Connor’s nose.
However, Connor did not give Alvin a chance to speak. He took a step forward and raised his fist to smash Alvin’s face again.
“Bang!”
Everyone heard a muffled sound.
Connor’s punch landed directly on Alvin’s nose, breaking it.
“Master Jacob!”
The rich heirs who usually had a good relationship with Alvin ran to his side and reached out to help him up.
Scarlet blood slowly flowed down Alvin’s nose, dyeing his white shirt red. He looked very pitiful. However, what was funny was that Alvin was actually beaten to tears by Connor’s two punches. He wiped his tears and pointed at Connor while cursing.
Freya walked to Connor’s side and whispered to him, “Connor, you’re too impulsive!”
“If anyone dares to bully you, I’ll make them pay a painful price!”
Connor turned his head to look at Freya and replied domineeringly.
When Freya heard Connor’s words, she was completely stunned. A strange look flashed across her beautiful eyes. Although she felt that Connor’s actions were very irrational, they gave her a very strong sense of security!
No matter how strong a woman was, she needed a sense of security, and Freya was no exception.
Thus, Freya did not continue to scold Connor.
Maya looked at Connor with a puzzled expression. She suddenly realized that Connor, who had always been unmanly, did not seem so annoying at this moment.
At the very least, Connor’s performance today was very manly in her eyes.
“Bro, do you know who Mr. Jacob is? You actually dare to attack him?”
“That’s right. Aren’t you a little too ignorant?”
When the surrounding rich young masters saw Alvin being beaten up by Connor, they all stood up for him.
“Don’t you know the immensity of heaven and earth?” After Connor heard these people’s words, he could not help but sneer. Then, he walked up to Alvin and said to him in a very serious tone, “If you kneel down and apologize to my girlfriend today, 1’11 spare your life!”
After inheriting the old Chairman’s inheritance, Connor had never done anything to bully the weak, nor had he bullied the weak just because he was richer than others. However, today, Connor planned to use his power as much as he could.
“You want me to kneel down and apologize? Who do you think you are?” Alvin shouted excitedly after hearing Connor’s words.
Although it was Alvin’s fault for beating up Freya today, Connor had broken his nose without even a reason. This should be considered even, right?
However, Connor had no intention of stopping and wanted Alvin to apologize to Freya. Wasn’t this a little too much of a bully?
Connor shouted at him, “I’m not a big shot, but I still want you to apologize.. You have to apologize to me today!”

chapters.title: Chapter 330 - 330: Mr. McDonald, Why Are You Here?
chapters.content:
Chapter 330: Mr. McDonald, Why Are You Here?
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
“You really think you’re something, don’t you? There aren’t many people in Davenport who dare to speak to me like this. 1’11 definitely make you regret it today…” Alvin roared and got up to leave.
However, Connor stood in front of Alvin and said with an unusually cold expression, “If you don’t apologize to my girlfriend today, don’t even think about leaving this place!”
After hearing Connor’s words, Alvin was stunned on the spot. He looked at Connor in front of him with an angry expression.
He had never thought that Connor would be so arrogant. Not only did he break his nose, but he was even forcing him to apologize to Freya. He was completely looking down on him!
That’s right, Connor did not take Alvin seriously at all.
Since Alvin dared to hit Freya, Connor would definitely return the favor a hundredfold. If it was any other matter, Connor could choose to endure it, but he would not back down on this matter.
Alvin’s actions had completely violated Connor’s bottom line of patience.
“Kid, that’s enough. Don’t be so shameless!”
“Yes, this is Lume. If this matter really blows up, it won’t be good for anyone!”
In the private room, the rich heirs who came to attend the birthday banquet stood up and said to Connor, “Mr. Jacob is the eldest son of the Jacob family while you’re just a poor kid. Once you provoke Mr. Jacob, you won’t be able to bear the consequences. You’d better stop as soon as possible!”
Even the host of the banquet, Amy Day, ran to Freya’s side and said softly, “Freya, it’s Alvin’s fault for hitting you today, but your boyfriend helped you take revenge just now. You’d better persuade your boyfriend to stop!”
“I…” Freya was about to speak, but before she could say anything, Maya shouted at the top of her lungs.
“Why should Connor stop?” After all, in Maya’s eyes, Connor knew many big shots, so she did not have to worry about the Jacob family’s power at all.
“It was Alvin who hit my cousin just now, so it’s natural that he apologize to my cousin now. I don’t think there’s anything wrong with what Connor did!” Maya’s eyes widened as she shouted excitedly.
When Amy heard Maya’s words, she was instantly speechless. She stood rooted to the ground with a blank expression, not knowing what to say. She had never thought that so many things would happen at her birthday party.
“Kid, I advise you to get lost now, or 1’11 make you regret it for the rest of your life.” Alvin pointed at Connor’s nose and scolded loudly.
“Apologize to my girlfriend first!” Connor repeated indifferently.
“I think you won’t cry until you see the coffin!”
Alvin shouted and tried to take out his phone to call someone. However, before Alvin could take out his phone, a middle-aged man’s voice rang out:
“What happened? Who has the guts to cause trouble in Lume?”
When everyone heard this voice, they all turned to look at the door of the private room. Their expressions immediately turned to surprise.
Caleb, the manager of Lume, walked up to Alvin and said coldly, “Mr. Jacob, if you want to cause trouble, you have to take a look at this place, right? This is Lume. If you really make President Jenkins angry, the Jacobs won’t be able to bear the responsibility!”
Alvin’s expression changed when he saw Caleb. He quickly explained with a smile, “Mr. Woods, you’ve really misunderstood me today. It’s not that 1 want to cause trouble here, but rather because someone hit me and wants me to apologize to him.”
“Is that so? Then 1 want to see who dares to be so arrogant!”
Because Connor was standing in the crowd, Caleb didn’t see him at all.
Therefore, he hurriedly took two steps forward and directly walked in front of Connor.
However, when Caleb saw Connor’s face clearly, he was stunned. He stood rooted to the ground with fear in his eyes.
When the rich heirs present saw this scene, they all looked at Connor with pity because they felt that Connor had offended Alvin first and had now indirectly offended the people of Lume. He would definitely not have a good ending. “M-Mr. McDonald, why are you here?” Caleb shouted at Connor with a trembling voice. He looked extremely nervous.
After Caleb said that, the entire room fell into a dead silence. Everyone stared at Caleb and Connor with their eyes wide open. Even Alvin himself was in disbelief.
This was Caleb’s second time meeting Connor. The last time they met was when Sean had broken the vase in Lume. When Titus saw Connor, he had directly said that the real vase was fake. From this point, Caleb could see that Connor’s identity and background were not simple.
A few days ago, Caleb heard that many company presidents had gone to Phillips Estate to celebrate John Phillips’s birthday because of Connor, which further proved that Connor’s identity was not simple.
Although Caleb didn’t know the relationship between Connor and Titus, he knew that he couldn’t afford to offend Connor.
Naturally, the rich heirs present didn’t know about the relationship between Caleb and Connor.
Connor turned his head and glanced at Caleb, then said calmly, “This person hit my girlfriend just now. I want him to apologize to my girlfriend. Do you think there’s a problem?”
“No… there’s no problem at all!” Caleb shook his head without thinking.
When everyone heard this, they were instantly in an uproar, and their expressions were extremely incredulous.
No one expected Caleb to be so respectful to Connor!
Of course, that wasn’t the most shocking thing. What Caleb said next was the most shocking thing:
“Mr. McDonald, do you need me to call the security guards over to help? If you need, I can call the security guards immediately!” Caleb asked Connor as if he was treading on thin ice.
After hearing Caleb’s words, Alvin’s heart was filled with incredulity!
So Caleb didn’t come out to help him solve the problem, but rather to help Connor call the security guards in the restaurant to teach him a lesson?
Alvin couldn’t understand why Caleb was so afraid of Connor. He was the eldest son of the Jacob family—how could he be treated worse than a poor delivery boy?
“No need, I can handle it myself!” Connor directly rejected Caleb’s kindness; he felt that he alone was enough to deal with Alvin.
“Alright, Mr. McDonald. If you need anything, you can tell me at any time!” Caleb replied with a smile. Then, he gave Alvin a fierce look, turned around, and left.
Everyone looked at Caleb’s back with complicated feelings. No one had expected such a result..

chapters.title: Chapter 331 - 331: Apologize to My Girlfriend!
chapters.content:
Chapter 331 - 331: Apologize to My Girlfriend!
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
After Caleb left, everyone started discussing Connor’s identity.
Alvin also realized that something was wrong. He felt that Caleb, in charge of Lume, was also one of Titus’s capable subordinates.
He wouldn’t even be so polite to a rich young kid like him, but he was so attentive to Connor.
This meant that Connor’s identity was not as simple as he thought!
“Did Hailey lie to me?” Alvin could not help but wonder.
“If you apologize to my girlfriend now, I might spare your life!” Connor walked up to Alvin and said to him coldly.
The meaning behind Connor’s words was self-explanatory. If Alvin had apologized directly, Connor might not have hit him. However, no matter whether Alvin apologized or not, Connor would still hit him. Connor might have hit him a little more gently if it was just an apology.
At this moment, the entire private room fell silent.
Connor’s tone had a trace of coldness that made people tremble.
Freya, Maya, and Priscilla looked at Connor in shock. They didn’t seem to recognize him.
Alvin looked at Connor with a trace of fear in his eyes. He felt Connor must have something to rely on to dare say such words.
However, with so many people watching, Alvin definitely wouldn’t apologize to Freya in front of them.
If he apologized today, how could he walk with his head up in Phillips Estate in the future?
“1 didn’t do anything. Why should I apologize to her?” Alvin widened his eyes and shouted at Connor timidly.
“Why? You can’t beat me now!” Connor smiled coldly. He didn’t want to continue talking nonsense and walked toward Alvin.
Connor only had one thought in his mind. Since Alvin did not want to apologize, he would beat him until he apologized.
Sometimes, Connor found that strength was more useful than money.
“What… What are you doing?”
When Alvin saw Connor approaching him with a murderous aura, he hurriedly took two steps back and shouted at Connor with a frightened expression.
This time, Connor didn’t choose to waste his breath on Alvin. He raised his fist and punched Alvin’s stomach.
Although Connor was not a martial artist, he had learned how to punch from his father since he was young. His physical fitness was naturally not something that ordinary people could compare to.
Moreover, Connor had been doing physical labor since he became an adult. Although he looked thin and weak, Connor’s physical fitness was not something a playboy like Alvin could compare to.
After Connor’s punch, Alvin’s entire body arched like shrimp.
A heart-wrenching pain instantly engulfed Alvin’s head.
“Poof!”
Alvin could not help but spit out a mouthful of blood.
When everyone saw this, they all inhaled sharply and could not help but tremble.
How powerful was that punch just now? It made Alvin vomit blood.
“Connor, you…” Alvin opened his mouth and was about to speak.
However, Connor did not give Alvin any chance to speak. He raised his fist and smashed it on Alvin’s head.
“Buzz!”
Alvin suddenly felt his vision go black, and a buzzing sound filled his ears. He staggered back two steps and almost fell to the ground.
At this moment, Alvin was in a very sorry state. Blood slowly flowed down his nose, and his entire body swayed back and forth as if he was drunk.
“Crack!”
Connor made another move and kicked Alvin’s knee.
“Thud!”
Alvin’s knees suddenly bent, and he kneeled on the ground.
At this moment, Alvin was kneeling in the direction where Freya and the others were standing.
Freya, Maya, and the other girls subconsciously took two steps back. Their eyes widened as they looked at Alvin in disbelief.
Alvin was completely stunned by Connor’s attack.
“Thud!”
Connor stepped on Alvin’s shoulder and said to him expressionlessly, “Apologize to my girlfriend!”
When Alvin heard Connor’s words, he could not help but tremble.
He was really scared of Connor now because he knew that if he didn’t apologize now, Connor might do anything.
By then, if he were beaten up, it would not be worth it.
“I’m sorry…”
Alvin kneeled and hesitated. Then, he gritted his teeth and said to Freya.
“Louder, weren’t you so arrogant just now?” Connor ordered expressionlessly.
“Ms. Phillips, I’m sorry. It was my fault just now. 1 shouldn’t have hit you!”
Alvin shouted in an unusually sincere tone.
Seeing this scene, the rich young kids in the private room sighed.
No one had expected Alvin to apologize to Freya, and he even kneeled to apologize!
“Connor, let him go!”
Freya was worried that Connor would blow up the matter if he continued to make a scene, so she hurriedly urged Connor.
Connor looked at Alvin indifferently and kicked him away. Then, he said coldly, “1 know you must be very unconvinced now. If you want to take revenge on me, I can accompany you at any time, but if you dare to touch my girlfriend, 1’11 make the Stewart Family suffer!”
When Alvin heard this, he turned and looked at Connor. Then, he gritted his teeth and said, “Alright, kid, you have guts. Just you wait. I’ll call someone over now!”
“Go on, then!” Connor replied in an unusually disdainful tone.
“Just you wait!” Alvin shouted. Then, he got up and ran to the private room door. He took out his phone and made a call.
“Hailey, get someone to beat up some people. It’s Freya, Connor, and the others. Quickly send some people over now!” Alvin shouted agitatedly as he held his phone.
“Alright, 1’11 go over now!” After Hailey heard Alvin’s words, she quickly agreed and hung up the phone.
“Just you wait!” Alvin stood at the door and looked at Connor, Freya, and the others angrily.
At this moment, he did not intend to leave this place. He wanted to regain all the reputation he had lost just now.
“Connor, you’re so handsome today. I’ll give you a ‘Like’!” Maya quickly ran to Connor’s side and shouted at him excitedly.
“Maya, can you stop making a ruckus here!” Freya chided softly before looking at Connor. “Connor, you were really too impulsive just now. Alvin, he…”
“Freya, is your face alright?” Before Freya could finish her sentence, Connor asked gently.
“I… I’m fine!” A hint of gratitude flashed in her eyes when Freya heard Connor’s words. She swallowed back the words that she wanted to say to Connor..

chapters.title: Chapter 332 - 332: A Mad Dog
chapters.content:
Chapter 332: A Mad Dog
Translator: End less Fantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
“Connor, you were too impulsive just now. Why did you hit Alvin? Do you know how terrifying the Stewart Family is?”
Freya hesitated, but she still couldn’t help but ask Connor.
“No matter how terrifying the Stewart Family is, as long as someone dares to bully you, 1’11 make him pay the price!” Connor turned to look at her and replied in an unusually calm tone.
When Freya heard Connor’s words, she was stunned. She was indescribably touched.
She had never thought that Connor would be able to show such a domineering side for her.
Maya, Priscilla, and the others seemed to be used to the useless Connor, so they were more or less shocked when they saw Connor like this.
Only now did the three of them understand that it wasn’t that Connor was a coward but that there were some things that Connor didn’t care about.
Freya looked at Connor and felt very touched. However, at the same time, she was also a little worried. All sorts of emotions were mixed. She did not know how to express her current feelings. She could only look at Connor silently and enjoy the sense of security that Connor gave her.
“Freya, what are you guys still standing here for? Hurry up and leave. If you don’t leave now, you might not be able to leave later!”
At this moment, Amy hurriedly ran to Freya, Connor, and the others and urged.
“Why won’t 1 be able to leave?” Freya was stunned for a moment and asked in confusion.
“I heard Alvin calling someone over just now. You know how Alvin is. He’s always vengeful. Your boyfriend beat him real bad, so he definitely won’t let it go!” Amy quickly said.
“Isn’t it just Alvin? What else can he do to us?” Maya replied disdainfully with a pout.
“Maya, I know you’re not afraid of Alvin, but that doesn’t mean your cousin-in-law isn’t afraid. Moreover, you’re not usually in Phillips Estate. There’s no need to continue pestering people like Alvin. You’ve taken advantage of him today. If you’re really blocked by Alvin’s people later, it won’t be worth it if anything happens!” Amy advised earnestly.
The reason Amy was in such a hurry to get Freya and the others to leave was not entirely because she was worried about their safety. She did not want to see this blow up. After all, she was the one celebrating her birthday today. If this really blew up, she would also be responsible.
“I think Amy is right. Anyway, Alvin has already apologized to me just now. There’s no need for us to continue wasting time with him. Let’s hurry up and leave!”
Freya hesitated before calling out softly.
“Okay!” Connor nodded. He had no intention of staying here anyway.
“That’s great. I’ll walk you out now!” Amy saw that Freya and Connor had agreed to leave, so she chirped and hurried toward the restaurant’s entrance.
When Maya saw that Connor and the others were about to leave, she was a little unhappy because she felt it would be embarrassing to leave now.
However, Freya and the others had already agreed to leave. She dared not refute and could only pout as she followed Freya toward the restaurant entrance.
After a while.
Everyone came to the restaurant’s entrance, but Alvin blocked them before Connor and the others could walk out.
“Alvin, what are you doing?” Amy wanted to send Freya and the others away. Seeing Alvin blocking the door, she was very unhappy.
“What am 1 doing? This kid beat me until 1 vomited blood and even made me kneel to apologize to Freya. Now that I’ve apologized and been beaten, they want to leave?” Alvin shouted with bloodshot eyes.
“Alvin, I know you’re very upset now, but today is my birthday. If you have any issues, you can look for them to resolve them later,” Amy said to Alvin helplessly.
“Respect you?”
When Alvin heard this, he could not help but laugh hideously. Then, he shouted at the top of his lungs, “I respected you, but who the f*ck respected me? Why didn’t you stand up for me when 1 was beaten up just now? Now you know how to ask me for respect. Let me tell you; this isn’t over yet. No one can leave. You have to wait here!”
“Alvin, you…”
Amy looked at Alvin and was speechless. She didn’t know what to say.
Connor suddenly walked up to Alvin.
When Alvin saw Connor, he instinctively took two steps back because he was worried that Connor would hit him!
“What… What are you doing?” Alvin took two steps back and stammered at Connor.
“Get lost!” Connor said calmly to Alvin.
“I’m standing here. What can you do to me?” Alvin widened his eyes and shouted.
You haven’t been beaten enough, right? 1 advise you to get out of my way. Otherwise, I don’t mind hitting you again, understand?” Connor said coldly to Alvin.
“Connor, let me tell you, don’t be too arrogant! My people are coming over soon. I won’t move aside no matter what. Kill me if you can!”
Alvin was determined to keep Connor here, so he claimed he would rather die than submit and blocked the restaurant’s entrance.
If Alvin let Connor leave today, he wouldn’t be able to stay in Phillips Estate anymore. Therefore, he had to take advantage of those people present just now to fix his reputation.
Connor looked at Alvin and smiled helplessly. He wasn’t in the mood to continue arguing with Alvin. He had hit Alvin just now because he wanted Alvin to apologize to Freya.
However, Connor had no reason to make a move now. Moreover, Connor knew that even if he made a move, Alvin might not give way. Therefore, Connor was in a dilemma.
“Connor, weren’t you very arrogant just now? Come on, hit me! If you dare to touch me now, I’ll return it to you a hundredfold later!” Alvin continued to provoke aggressively when he saw that Connor did not speak.
“Do you really think 1 won’t dare to hit you?” Connor replied indifferently.
“Hehe, then you can try!” Alvin took a step forward and said like a mad dog.
At the same time, there was a roar on the street outside Lume.
A motorcade led by a Lamborghini drove toward Lume grandly..

chapters.title: Chapter 333 - 333: An Unexpected Guest
chapters.content:
Chapter 333 - 333: An Unexpected Guest
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
At the entrance of Lume.
Alvin blocked the path of Connor, Freya, and the others, refusing to let them leave.
Connor stood there and hesitated, then walked straight to Alvin.
Alvin seemed to think that Connor wanted to attack him, so he instinctively took two steps back and kept a certain distance from Connor. Then, he stuttered, “Connor, I… I’m telling you, my people are about to arrive. You better watch yourself!”
Connor looked at Alvin indifferently, then smiled playfully and said, “Didn’t you say you wanted me to try? Why are you scared now?”
H j n
Alvin looked at Connor with a conflicted expression. He wanted to stop Connor, but he was afraid that Connor would attack him, so he was in a dilemma.
“Freya, Maya, let’s go. If this Alvin dares to stop you, I’ll break his legs!” Connor was obviously trying to scare Alvin.
However, it worked. When Alvin heard Connor’s words, he was so scared that he stood rooted to the ground and did not dare to move. He was worried that Connor would break his legs.
“Why don’t you stop us? Didn’t you say that even if you were beaten to death by Connor, you wouldn’t let us go?” Maya mocked Alvin smugly.
Alvin gritted his teeth and stood rooted to the ground. His expression was hideous.
At this moment, the people in the restaurant also cast disdainful gazes at Alvin.
No one had expected that Alvin, who had always been a tyrant in Phillips Estate would actually be subdued by Connor.
“Maya, stop fooling around. Let’s go!” Freya was worried that Alvin’s men would really come over later. By then, they wouldn’t be able to leave even if they wanted to, so she hurriedly urged him.
“Got it, Freya!”
Maya gave Alvin the middle finger and followed Connor and the others out of the restaurant.
“Stop right there!” Seeing Connor and the others were about to leave, Alvin quickly shouted at the top of his lungs. Then, he took out his phone and was about to make a call.
However, just as Alvin took out his phone, a call came in.
When Alvin heard his phone’s ringtone, he could not help but be stunned for a moment. Then, he picked up the phone and said anxiously, “Hailey, where are your people? Connor and the others are already at the door…”
“That’s good. We’re at the entrance of the restaurant now!” Hailey replied lightly and hung up the phone.
“Great, Hailey’s people are finally here. 1 want to see how you’ll walk out of this restaurant today!”
After Alvin put down his phone, he shouted excitedly and ran toward the restaurant entrance.
When the people in the private room heard Alvin’s words, they knew that a good show would be coming up, so they ran out of the private room without caring about Amy being in the way.
***
On the other side, Connor, Freya, Maya, and Priscilla left the private room and headed straight for the restaurant entrance.
“Connor, you’re really handsome today. 1 didn’t expect you to have such a manly side!” Maya followed Connor and said to him excitedly.
Maya felt it was cool for Connor to be daring to hit Alvin today. Her impression of Connor instantly improved.
Connor looked at Maya and smiled without saying anything.
Connor acted so impulsively today because he had seen Freya beaten up. If it were the usual, he would not be so impulsive.
“Seeing that you stood up for Freya today, this young lady will reluctantly agree to you being together with Freya!” Maya said after seeing that Connor did not say anything.
“Maya, what nonsense are you spouting here? What does it have to do with you whether I’m with Connor or not?” When Freya heard this, her face turned red, and she glared at Maya.
“All, Freya, don’t pretend to be innocent here. 1 heard everything you said last night. Aren’t you already prepared to agree…”
“Maya, don’t spout nonsense!” Seeing that Maya was about to reveal her secret, she quickly berated her.
Maya immediately shut her mouth when she heard that. Then, she smiled awkwardly at Connor and whispered, “Connor, I was just spewing nonsense. You didn’t hear anything. Do you understand?”
“Haha…”
Connor smiled. Just as he was about to ask Freya what she said last night, a blinding light suddenly shot toward Connor and the others.
Freya, Maya, and the other girls instinctively raised their arms to block their eyes.
Following closely behind were Alvin and the people in the private room. All of them rushed out from behind Connor and the others.
Alvin was unusually excited. When the others saw the situation outside the restaurant, they were all dumbfounded. They stood rooted to the ground with their mouths agape. The expression on their faces was an indescribable shock.
Freya, Maya, and Priscilla slowly put down their arms. Then, they saw an extremely shocking scene.
A massive fleet of cars drove directly toward the restaurant’s entrance, and the one driving at the front was a Lamborghini!
This Lamborghini was worth tens of millions of dollars. There were only forty of them in the world, and every single one was extremely collectible. Moreover, the value of these cars could not be measured by money.
No more than ten people in Oprana could afford a Lamborghini like this!
And behind the Lamborghini were more than a dozen Hummers. This shocked everyone present.
“Who is this? They drove a convoy over?”
“A Lamborghini Venero? Isn’t this awesome?”
“Yeah, since when did Phillips Estate have such a rich man who can afford to drive a Lamborghini Venero?”
“Isn’t this car really cool? Are the Stewart Family here?”
When everyone saw the Lamborghini, they discussed it in low voices.
Alvin thought that his sister, Hailey, had brought people over. He was extremely excited. However, when he saw the Lamborghini, he was stunned. A trace of doubt flashed in his eyes.
Alvin was a member of the Stewart Family, so he naturally knew the financial strength of his family. Hailey would never drive such a car over, and the Stewart Family did not have the money to buy such a car.
Since it wasn’t Hailey, could Connor have called someone over?
Thinking of this, Alvin could not help but turn to look at Connor. A trace of fear flashed in his eyes.
“Whoosh, whoosh, whoosh!”
At this moment, the doors of the off-road car opened almost at the same time.
Everyone turned their attention to the Lamborghini.. They wanted to see who could afford to drive such a car!

chapters.title: Chapter 334 - 334: Howard Duncan Is Here!
chapters.content:
Chapter 334 - 334: Howard Duncan Is Here!
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Dozens of luxury cars were parked neatly at the entrance of Lume. The scene was extremely spectacular.
Although Phillips Estate had been developing very quickly in recent years, be it the surrounding facilities or the prosperity of the urban area, it could already be compared to a big city like Porthampton.
Moreover, there were quite a few rich people in Phillips Estate. However, today’s scene was still very shocking to the people of Phillips Estate.
One had to know that even in the entire Davenport, no one could gather such a convoy!
The Lamborghini Veneno led the way, followed by Hummer SUVs. These Hummer SUVs were all worth more than a million!
This scene not only stunned the rich heirs who came to attend the birthday party but also Alvin.
He knew the Stewart Family’s standing. He felt that even if Mr. Stewart Sr. came personally, he couldn’t cause such a huge commotion, right?
Therefore, Alvin could not help but wonder if these people were reinforcements Connor had called over!
If Connor was the one who called the convoy over, then Alvin felt that he might have gotten into big trouble today, so the expression on his face was much more nervous.
“Whoosh, whoosh, whoosh!”
At this moment, the car door opened almost at the same time.
Dozens of muscular, fierce-looking men in black rushed out of the car. These men were at least 1.9 meters tall, and their shoulders were as wide as mountains. Their loose suits could not hide their muscles. They walked like tigers descending from the mountain.
Seeing this group of men in black, everyone present shuddered.
Some young ladies who wanted to watch the show turned around and ran back into the restaurant. They looked at these people through the window. They were worried they would be implicated if the two sides fought.
“What… What’s going on?”
When Maya saw these men in black, a trace of fear flashed across her face as she stammered to Connor.
It was obvious that Maya, who had always been fearless, was also a little flustered. After all, who wouldn’t be afraid of such a large group of black-clothed men?
“It’s okay, don’t be afraid!”
Connor remained calm as he turned to look at Maya.
As Connor saw that Alvin was also standing there dumbfounded, Connor suspected that these people were not reinforcements that Alvin had called over.
“What do you want? Do you know what kind of place this is? How dare you come here to cause trouble?”
Caleb Woods, the manager of Lume, mustered up his courage and ran to the men in black, shouting angrily.
No matter what, Caleb had worked under Titus for many years. He had seen all kinds of big shots.
Therefore, Caleb wasn’t so scared that he couldn’t say a word!
“Mr. Woods, it’s been a few years since we last met. Don’t tell me you’ve forgotten about me?”
However, at this moment, a burly middle-aged man walked out of the crowd. Although the middle-aged man looked ordinary, his aura made people shudder. Moreover, there was a hint of coldness in his eyes. One would never forget such a person once they saw him.
After hearing that, Caleb suddenly looked up at the middle-aged man. Then, he froze on the spot with a look of disbelief.
“Mr…. Mr. Duncan?”
Caleb’s eyes widened as he exclaimed in shock.
“Hehe, looks like Mr. Woods still remembers me!”
Howard smiled faintly, then turned and glanced at everyone present. He said expressionlessly, “I thought that everyone had forgotten that I was still in Porthampton after so many years!”
After Howard said that, everyone fell silent.
At this moment, the air seemed to have frozen!
Although most of the people present were young, they were still very familiar with the name Howard Duncan.
Howard was the only other gangster in Porthampton who was as famous as Kyle!
More than ten years ago, two influential figures appeared in Porthampton. One of them was the current number one figure in Porthampton, Kyle Hayes.
The other one was Howard, who was standing in front of them.
At that time, Howard and Kyle were equally strong. Some people thought Howard was stronger, while others thought Kyle was stronger.
Anyway, there was a period when people often argued about who was the number one person in Porthampton between Howard and Kyle.
However, because of Thomas’s appearance, Porthampton was completely reshuffled.
This reshuffle also created the current situation in Porthampton.
In terms of business, no one could shake the business empire that Thomas managed.
Howard and Thomas were not in the same camp in the grey area, but Thomas was on Kyle’s side, so Kyle naturally sat in first place.
Howard knew he couldn’t afford to offend someone like Thomas, so he gradually retired and rarely appeared in public.
This gave people the feeling that Kyle was the only one in Porthampton.
If one were to ask who the number one person in Porthampton was now, there was no doubt that Kyle was the one. This was something that everyone recognized.
But was Howard afraid of Kyle?
Howard wasn’t afraid of Kyle. He was afraid of Thomas, who was behind Kyle!
Howard knew that the richest man in the world backed Thomas!
And now, the richest man in the world was Connor!
However, in many cases, the contest between the two sides did not mean that whoever was stronger would have the upper hand. There were also many benefits involved.
Even though Howard hadn’t appeared in Porthampton for a long time, many people in Porthampton had heard of his name and about him. Therefore, they still felt an inexplicable fear when Howard stood before them.
Connor narrowed his eyes and looked at Howard. Although he didn’t know about the past between Howard and Kyle, he could still feel pressure.
Alvin himself was dumbfounded. He had called Hailey to ask her to find someone to teach Connor a lesson. However, he did not expect to get someone like Howard here!
If Howard were really called over by Hailey, it would be fine!
However, Alvin was most worried that if Connor called over Howard, things would be a little troublesome!

chapters.title: Chapter 335 - 335: Stephanie Lee Of The Lee Family
chapters.content:
Chapter 335: Stephanie Lee Of The Lee Family
Translator: End less Fantasy Translation Editor: End less Fantasy Translation
“Why would Howard come to our Phillips Estate?11
“Yeah, I heard that Howard has retired. Why did he appear again?”
“Is Howard the reinforcement that Alvin called over? When did the Stewart Family become so powerful? How could they know such a big shot like Howard Duncan?”
After the onlookers at the restaurant entrance discovered Howard’s identity, they began discussing in low voices.
Caleb was also perplexed. He couldn’t figure out why Howard would suddenly appear here.
“Mr. Duncan, what brings you here today? Are you here for dinner?” Caleb took a deep breath, then walked to Howard and asked nervously.
“I came here today to deal with some matters. I hope Mr. Woods can give me space and not meddle in other people’s business. Otherwise, don’t blame me for being ruthless!” Howard replied coldly.
Caleb’s heart skipped a beat when he heard Howard’s words. He knew what Howard meant!
Howard was not here for dinner or to look for someone. He was here to cause trouble!
“Mr. Duncan, what exactly do you want?” Caleb asked Howard nervously.
Howard didn’t answer Caleb’s question. Instead, he walked to the Lamborghini at the front and gently opened the door.
When everyone saw this scene, they turned their attention to the Lamborghini again. They were curious about what kind of big shot could make Howard open the car door.
The car door slowly opened.
A pair of slender and fair legs slowly stretched out of the car.
When the men present saw the pair of beautiful legs, they couldn’t help but inhale sharply. They were abnormally excited. Even if they didn’t look at the face, just looking at these beautiful legs was already the cream of the crop.
No one expected that the person sitting in the Lamborghini was a woman.
Not only was she a woman, but she was also a goddess.
A moment later, a beautiful woman walked out of the Lamborghini. Her aura instantly shocked everyone present.
The woman had a good figure. She was wearing a tight leather jacket and a pair of hot pants. Her slender and fair legs were exceptionally attractive. She was wearing a pair of black boors. She looked extremely noble and unapproachable. Her entire being emitted an aura that kept people a thousand miles away.
This woman was like a queen in a movie, especially when paired with such a cool appearance. She made people feel that she was a woman of a head gangster.
In an instant, everyone’s attention was focused on this woman.
At the same time, a girl came out of the front passenger seat of the Lamborghini, although this girl’s appearance and aura were not as good as the previous girl’s, she was still almost as attractive, so she instantly attracted the attention of many people.
This girl was Alvin’s biological sister, Hailey, who had a conflict with Priscilla ad Freya at Collective Strokes!
Hailey’s appearance could only prove one thing!
Hailey had summoned Howard and the others. Otherwise, why would Hailey appear in the Lamborghini?
When Alvin saw Hailey, he immediately became excited and ran toward Hailey.
“Hailey, did you call these people over?” Alvin asked Hailey excitedly.
“That’s right. These blind people dared to bully my brother. Today, 1 must make them pay rhe price!” Hailey replied with a domineering expression. Then, she walked to the girl’s side and said softly, “Ms. Lee, this is my brother, Alvin!”
After Stephanie Lee heard this, she turned and looked at Alvin indifferently without saying anything.
“Alvin, this is Stephanie Lee!” Hailey quickly said to Alvin.
“Hel… Hello, Ms. Lee!” Alvin greeted Stephanie nervously.
Stephanie wasn’t interested in Alvin at all. She only nodded slightly and then focused her attention on Connor.
In fact, be it Hailey or Alvin, they were just pawns to Stephanie!
Stephanie was Yannick’s half-sister. She only had one purpose for coming here: to expose Connor’s identity in front of Freya.
If Connor exposed his identity to Freya, then Yannick could get the inheritance from Connor!
Stephanie discovered Connor’s biggest weakness was that emotions easily swayed him. That was why she took the initiative to look for Hailey and used Alvin to anger Connor. In the end, she would appear and resolve these matters.
Based on the current situation, Stephanie had achieved her goal. Hailey and Alvin were no longer of any use to her.
“Who beat you up like this?”
Stephanie couldn’t expose her identity now because she knew Connor would be on guard if she knew about her relationship with Yannick. By then, it wouldn’t be easy for Connor to expose her identity.
Therefore, Stephanie had to continue to pretend.
Alvin was stunned for a moment after hearing Stephanie s words. Then, he quickly turned to look at Connor. He pointed at Connor and said, “Ms. Lee, this is the person who hit me!”
Stephanie smiled faintly when she heard this. Then, she walked toward Connor. Howard followed behind Stephanie.
When everyone saw Stephanie and the others walking over, they took two steps back and took the initiative to make way for them.
Only Connor, Freya, and Maya were left standing there alone.
At this moment, Connor might not know that he had fallen into someone else’s trap!
Everyone looked at Connor and the others pitifully.
As they felt that Connor would not have a good ending today.
“Who is this woman? She made a big shot like Howard listen to her orders!”
“When did Hailey get to know such a big shot?”
“To make Howard follow her obediently, this woman’s background must be extraordinary!”
The rich heirs present watched the commotion and discussed softly.
“Con… Connor, what should we do now?1 ’ Maya saw Stephanie and the others approaching step by step and asked Connor, unusually nervous.
“Don’t worry. This today has nothing to do with you. If there’s anything, 1’11 bear it alone!” Connor replied calmly.
“But…”
Maya opened her mouth and was about to speak.
But at this time, Stephanie and the others were already standing before Connor.. Stephanie sized up Connor and asked in an unusually domineering tone, “You were the one who hit him just now, right?”

chapters.title: Chapter 336 - 336: I’ll Give You Three Options
chapters.content:
Chapter 336: I’ll Give You Three Options
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Stephanie walked up to Connor and looked at him with disdain.
She really couldn’t understand why someone like Connor would be favored by the old chairman and become the heir to his ten trillion dollar fortune.
However, she also knew that now was not the time to think about these things.
Right now, there was a more important thing waiting for her to do, which was to expose Connor’s identity in front of Freya.
In order to make sure that she had not found the wrong person, Stephanie looked at Connor and continued to ask, “What’s your name?”
“Connor!”
Connor didn’t have the slightest fear on his face at this moment. His tone was very calm as he said.
“Connor?”
The smile on Stephanie’s face seemed to become even more disdainful. She turned her head and glanced at Howard indifferently.
When Howard saw the look in her eyes, he instantly understood what was going on. He immediately muttered to the bodyguard beside him.
Soon, the bodyguard brought a chair out of the restaurant and placed it behind Stephanie.
Stephanie sat elegantly on the chair and naturally crossed her slender and fair legs. At this moment, Stephanie looked like a queen who had walked out of a movie. Her aura was very shocking, and everyone present could not help but reveal a trace of awe.
Alvin, Hailey, and Howard stood side by side behind Stephanie, quietly waiting for her next instructions.
They knew that as long as Stephanie spoke, Connor and the others would have a tragic ending.
However, Stephanie did not come here today to avenge Alvin. Her ultimate goal was to make Connor expose his true identity in front of Freya.
“You hit Alvin just now. Shouldn’t you give me an explanation for this matter, boy?”
Stephanie looked at Connor with a playful expression.
“What explanation do you want? Alvin was the one who hit my cousin first…”
Maya mustered her courage and shouted at Stephanie.
When Stephanie heard Maya’s words, she couldn’t help but turn her head to look at Maya. Then, she said in an unusually cold tone, “Little girl, 1 advise you to shut your mouth quickly. Otherwise, 1’11 get someone to cut off your tongue right now!”
Maya was frightened by Stephanie’s aura. She quickly took two steps back and stared at Stephanie’s position with her big eyes, not daring to say a word.
Connor was probably the only person who could remain calm at this moment. He asked Stephanie expressionlessly, “What explanation do you want?”
“It’s very simple. Since you’ve beaten up my people, you have to come with me. However, before you leave, I’ll allow you to call your family. After all, you might never see them again in the future. The three women behind you have good figures and looks. I’m going to sell the three of them overseas. As for you…”
Stephanie paused for a moment, then said lightly, “I’m going to hand you over to Alvin. As for how he wants to deal with you, that’s not up to me. It depends on what he does. You got it?”
It was obvious that Stephanie was deliberately using Freya, Maya, and the others to provoke Connor.
Because in the previous investigation, Stephanie found that Connor seemed to care a lot about Freya. Freya was also Connor’s biggest weakness.
When Freya, Maya and Priscilla heard Stephanie’s words, a trace of fear flashed across their eyes, and they were extremely nervous.
The rich kids around them looked at Stephanie in a daze. Their eyes could not help but show a trace of fear.
They couldn’t understand who Stephanie was to say such things in front of so many people. Was there really no law in Stephanie’s eyes?
“This kid was so arrogant just now. Now, he must be dumbfounded!”
“That’s right. This kid is simply courting death. He even dares to offend someone like Alvin!”
“I don’t know when Alvin got to know such a big shot. He even called Howard Duncan over!”
Everyone looked at Connor and the others and began to discuss in low voices.
Connor looked at Stephanie expressionlessly, and a trace of doubt suddenly flashed across his eyes.
He could not understand. Didn’t he just beat Alvin up? Did this woman have to make such a big fuss?
In fact, Connor was not the only one having such doubts in his heart, even Alvin himself did not expect things to turn out like this.
He called Hailey to ask her to call people over because he wanted to teach Connor and the others a lesson. However, now that they were about to die, Alvin was starting to feel a little nervous.
“Miss Lee, isn’t this a little inappropriate? I don’t actually hate them. You can just teach them a lesson…”
Alvin was worried that if the matter blew up, he would not be able to get away with it, so he quickly stepped forward and whispered to Stephanie.
When Stephanie heard Alvin’s words, she couldn’t help but turn around and look at him. Then, she said calmly, “Alright, since you’ve said so, I’ll give them a chance. As long as the few of you kneel down and apologize, and then have that woman be with you for a night, I won’t hold it against you!”
Stephanie pointed at Freya as she spoke.
At this moment, Stephanie was still using Freya to provoke Connor.
“Miss Lee, I think that your suggestion is a good one!”
After hearing Stephanie’s words, Alvin was instantly delighted. If Connor and the rest could kneel down and apologize to him, he would naturally regain his dignity. Moreover, he would not have to kill anyone. Most importantly, he could have Freya accompany him for a night.
Freya was the famous ice queen of the Phillips Family. Alvin would probably wake up laughing in his dreams if he could sleep with such a woman.
Connor looked at Stephanie with a hint of anger in his eyes.
“How do you plan to choose now?”
Stephanie asked Connor softly.
“What if 1 don’t choose either of these options?”
Connor gritted his teeth and replied in a low voice.
“None?”
Stephanie sneered and narrowed her eyes at Connor. “If you don’t choose either of them, then 1 actually have a third option. Moreover, I’m also very inclined toward this option. Just now, you hit Alvin because your girlfriend was bullied by him, right? Then I’ll let Alvin scratch your girlfriend’s face in front of you.
As long as you can tolerate your girlfriend becoming an ugly monster, I’ll let all of you go. What do you think?”
Connor stood rooted to the ground, and he became even more furious.
The onlookers also revealed terrified expressions.
“I think this option should be the best for you. After all, you only have to sacrifice your girlfriend, and it can be exchanged for the safety of all of you. What do you think?”
Stephanie was like a devil as she continued to ask with a cold smile..

chapters.title: Chapter 337 - 337: A Difficult Decision
chapters.content:
Chapter 337 - 337: A Difficult Decision
Translator: End Less Fantasy Translation Editor: E nd LcssFantasy Translation
No one had expected Stephanie to say something like this. She actually planned to disfigure Freya in front of so many people.
However, these people didn’t know that Stephanie was only doing this to provoke Connor into revealing his true identity.
Stephanie had given Connor two option just now, but he still did nor react in any way. Stephanie felt that perhaps it was because her words just now did not really agitate Connort so she proposed the idea of disfiguring Freya.
Very clearly, the current Connor was already on the verge of rage and could erupt at anytime.
Stephanie also felt the anger in Connor s eyes. She felt that if she provoked him a little more, he would definitely go berserk and reveal his own identity.
“Howard, I don’t want to talk nonsense with these people anymore.”
At this moment, Stephanie suddenly shouted.
“Alright, Miss Lee!”
Howard obviously understood what Stephanie wanted to do. He immediately took out a small knife from his clothes and rushed toward Freya.
“Freya, be careful!”
Maya shouted instinctively when she saw Howard rushing over.
Freya was so frightened that she hurriedly took two steps back. Perhaps because she was too nervous, she lost her balance and fell to the ground.
Howard approached Freya step by step.
The surrounding spectators all ran off into the distance. No one was willing to step forward to help Freya.
Howard held a small knife in his hand, a sinister smile on his face as he slowly walked up to Freya.
“I’m sorry!”
At this moment, Howard suddenly shouted at Freya. Then, he raised the knife in his hand and slashed at Freya’s face.
“Ah…”
Freya screamed out of fear and closed her eyes.
In the next second, blood spurted out.
However, Howard s knife did not cut Freya’s face. Instead, it stabbed into Connor’s back.
Just as Howard was about to attack, Connor suddenly rushed over and hugged Freya, using his back to shield her.
“Ugh…”
When Connor felt the pain coming from his back, he could not help but gasp.
Meanwhile, Freya stared at Connor with an incredulous expression. She never thought that Connor would save her at such a critical moment!
“Connor, are… are you alright? Are you stupid?”
Freya’s eyes instantly became moist as she exclaimed.
Connor raised his head and glanced at Freya. He forced out a smile and said in a low voice, “If this knife were to cut your face, how could I bear to…”
When Freya heard Connor’s words, she froze on the spot. Tears could not help but fall from her eyes. She was really touched by his action.
When Stephanie saw this scene, the corners of her mouth curled up slightly, revealing a smug smile.
Because she knew that her goal had been achieved. At this moment, Connor must have been completely angered by her.
Connor endured the pain on his back and slowly got up to look at Stephanie. He asked with an unusually sinister expression, “Do you know how stupid your actions are now?”
“Stupid? Is it really?”
Stephanie looked at Connor with a disdainful smile.
“Do you know what will happen if you anger me?”
Connor continued coldly.
“I don’t know what will happen if 1 anger you, but I know that you know Kyle Hayes and Thomas Morgan. I’m in a good mood today, so I’ll give you a chance to call them and ask them to get someone to help you!”
Stephanie replied lightly, then took out a phone and threw it in front of Connor.
Connor looked down at the phone on the ground. At this moment, he finally understood why Stephanie did this!
Stephanie wanted Connor to call Kyle and Thomas so that he would have to expose his identity in front of Freya.
“Stephanie Lee and Yannick Lee! ”
Connor shook his head and smiled bitterly. Then, he said indifferently, “Looks like you guys really put in a lot of effort this time!”
II1 II
When Stephanie heard Connor’s words, she could not help but be stunned for a moment. Then, she sneered.
Then, she stood up and walked in front of Connor. She used a voice that only Connor could hear and said, “Connor, since you’ve already found out, 1’11 tell you the truth. Everything that happened today was actually planned by me. My real goal is to expose your identity in front of Freya and make you lose the right to inherit the inheritance.”
“Are you so sure that I will expose my identity in front of Freya?”
Connor gritted his teeth and replied in a low voice.
“I’m not, but you only have two options now. The first is to watch your fiancee get disfigured, but you still have the right to inherit the old chairman’s inheritance. The second is to use all the power you have to protect her, but you have to expose your identity in front of Freya.”
“On one side is your beloved woman, and on the other side is ten trillion in wealth. I’m also very curious what you’ll choose!”
Stephanie looked at Connor with a faint smile, then sat back down on the chair and looked at Connor with a playful expression.
Connor stood there expressionlessly, gritting his teeth and not saying a word.
Stephanie was right. There were only two paths in front of Connor. One was the path to Freya, and the other was the path to ten trillion.
At this moment, Connor had to make a choice. Between money and woman, he had to give up one!
No matter who was in front of this multiple-choice question, it would be a difficult decision to make.
No one knew how to choose.
What was the most important thing between a woman he loved and a huge amount of wealth?
Freya, Maya, Priscilla, and the others looked at Connor with puzzled expressions. They didn’t know what Stephanie had just said to Connor, nor did they know what Connor was thinking.
“Connor, I’m not in the mood to waste time with you. My patience is limited, so I’ll give you three minutes to consider. If you still haven’t made a choice after three minutes, then don’t blame me for what’s about to happen next!”
At this moment, Stephanie shouted at Connor again..

chapters.title: Chapter 338 - 338: I’ll Play With You
chapters.content:
Chapter 338 - 338: I’ll Play With You
Translator: End less Fantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
After hearing Stephanie’s words, everyone present focused their attention on Connor.
Although they did not know what Stephanie’s true goal was, they knew that she was waiting for Connor to make a decision.
Stephanie narrowed her eyes at Connor. Her face was calm, but she was very nervous.
Stephanie was worried that if Connor really chose to give up on Freya, then all her plans for today would be ruined.
Money and love.
It was an extremely difficult decision to make for anyone, and Connor was no exception.
He had just inherited the inheritance for less than a year. All this while, Connor had experienced the life of a rich person and knew how much money would bring about changes in his life.
If he really wanted Connor to give up everything now, he would definitely be very unwilling.
However, if he did not give up, what awaited Freya would be disfigurement!
Freya had nothing to do with this. She didn’t even know why Stephanie was treating Connor like this.
To put it bluntly, Freya was just an innocent bystander. Connor felt that it would be too unfair for an innocent woman to be injured because of his selfishness.
Furthermore, this woman was the person that Connor loved the most.
“You have one minute left. Connor, have you thought about what to choose?”
At this moment, Stephanie suddenly asked Connor.
Connor took a deep breath and slowly squatted down.
When Stephanie saw Connor squat down, a smug smile appeared on her face. She knew that her plan had succeeded.
Freya, Maya, and the others naturally did not know what kind of choice Connor was facing, nor did they know what Connor was thinking about just now. However, they could feel that when Connor squatted down, he seemed to be very conflicted and very unwilling.
However, in the end, Connor still reached out and picked up the phone in front of him. Then, he gritted his teeth and stood up.
“It seems that heroes can’t resist when it comes to love!”
Stephanie smiled faintly when she saw Connor pick up the phone. She was unusually happy.
“Since you want to play with me so badly, I’ll play along with you. I want you to know how stupid your actions today are!”
Connor gritted his teeth and shouted at Stephanie coldly.
“Make the call!”
Stephanie looked at Connor and replied calmly.
Connor held the phone and hesitated for two seconds. He knew that this might be the last time he would use the old chairman’s resources. After today, he might have to return to being a poor loser who delivered food.
However, as long as he could ensure Freya’s safety, he did not regret it.
After hesitating for a moment, Connor dialed a number on the phone.
Ring… Ring…
The phone rang for a while before the other party picked up.
“Mr. McDonald, do you need something?”
Thomas Morgan’s voice sounded.
“Meet me at Lume at the Phillips Estate in ten minutes!”
Connor said expressionlessly.
H 11
When Thomas heard Connor’s words, he couldn’t help but be stunned for a moment. Then, he asked in a puzzled tone, “Mr. McDonald, did something happen?”
“In ten minutes, bring your men to Lume to meet me. Do you understand me?”
At this moment, Connor was not in the mood to explain too much to Thomas. His tone was abnormally cold as he repeated himself.
“Alright, I’ll go over now!”
Thomas had never heard Connor speak to him in such a serious tone. He knew that Connor was being very serious now, so he must have encountered something urgent.
Connor then hung up the phone and dialed Kyle Hayes’s number.
“Hello?”
Kyle quickly picked up the phone.
“In ten minutes, bring all the bodyguards and anyone who can fight from your company to meet me at Lume in the Phillips Estate!”
Connor told Kyle the exact same thing he told Thomas. Even his tone had not changed.
“Alright, I’ll go over now!”
Kyle agreed without any hesitation.
Connor hung up the phone again. After hesitating for a moment, he dialed the third number.
The third call was to Carlos Lane!
In order to protect Connor, Thomas had specially hired three bodyguards for him. They were Carlos, Bruno Lawson, and the Diana Murphy!
However, nothing major had happened to Connor, so he had never used the three of them. Connor felt that since today was the last time he would enjoy such treatment, he might as well use all the connections he could use.
Since Stephanie wanted to play with him, then he would play with her till the end.
“Mr. McDonald!”
Soon, Carlos answered the call.
“Come to Lume in ten minutes. Call everyone you can, understand?” Connor gritted his teeth and said in a low voice.
“Mr. McDonald, what is going on?”
Carlos could not help but ask softly when he sensed that something was wrong with Connor’s tone.
H H
When Connor heard this, he slowly raised his head and looked at Stephanie.
Then, he said coldly, “I want to kill someone!”
When Stephanie heard Connor’s words, a strange look flashed across her eyes. She did not expect Connor to be so angry at this time!
Alvin Jacob and Hailey Jacob were near Connor, so they heard what he said very clearly.
When the two of them heard Connor’s words, they were also shocked.
“Okay, Mr. McDonald, I understand!”
Carlos answered quickly and hung up the phone.
“Stephanie, didn’t you want to play with me? Then, I’ll play with you today…”
Connor slowly put down his phone and said to Stephanie expressionlessly.
Stephanie revealed a disdainful smile and said lightly, “Connor, do you really think that you can kill me just because you called Thomas Morgan and Kyle Hayes over? Do you think I’m that easy to deal with?”
H 11
Connor looked at Stephanie coldly and did not say anything. He narrowed his eyes and looked at the opposite street.
“Connor, what’s going on?”
Freya saw that Connor had made three calls and suddenly felt that something was wrong. She hurriedly ran to Connor’s side and asked him anxiously.
Connor turned his head and glanced at Freya before saying calmly, “It’s okay. You’ll know what’s going on later!”
Not long after he said this, the roar of an engine suddenly sounded on the street opposite Lume.
Everyone turned to look.
They saw a mighty convoy rushing toward Connor!

chapters.title: Chapter 339 - 339: Mr. McDonald, I’m Sorry I’m Late!
chapters.content:
Chapter 339 - 339: Mr. McDonald, I’m Sorry I’m Late!
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
When everyone saw this mighty convoy, their faces revealed puzzled expressions.
“Why are there even more people now?”
“That’s right. When did so many luxury cars come to the Phillips Estate?”
“Could these people be reinforcements that Connor called over?”
“How is that possible? Look at him. How could he know these people?”
When the crowd saw the convoy drive over, they began to discuss in low voices.
A moment later, the convoy slowly stopped at the entrance of Lume.
However, compared to Stephanie’s previous fleet, this fleet was obviously more inferior. Most of them were common BMW and Mercedes-Benz cars.
When Freya saw these cars, she instantly reacted. This was because the people who came were not the reinforcements that Connor had called over. They were people from the Phillips Family!
When John Phillips, Sean Phillips, and the others heard that Connor, Freya, and the others were trapped in Lume, they immediately mobilized their entire family to save them.
After all, in their eyes, Connor was no longer the Connor from before, so John was still very worried about his safety.
“Grandpa and the others are here!”
Maya shouted excitedly when she saw John running out of the car.
“That’s right, we’re saved now…”
Priscilla replied innocently.
Soon, the Phillips family members ran to Connor and the others in a grandiose manner.
John looked at Stephanie, Howard Duncan, and the others and was stunned for a moment. Then, he asked in a puzzled tone, “Connor Freya, what… what’s going on?”
“Grandpa, Alvin Jacob asked them to come. They even wanted to disfigure Freya’s face!”
Maya shouted first.
“Alvin Jacob?”
John was stunned for a moment. Then, he turned his head to look at Alvin, who was behind Stephanie. He widened his eyes and shouted, “Alvin, the Phillips Family and the Jacob Family have always minded our own business. Why are you doing this to my granddaughter? Why are you asking people to trap my family members here?”
Alvin was stunned when he heard John’s words. Then, he said helplessly, “Grandpa John, today’s matter has nothing to do with me. Moreover, this matter is not up to me to decide. You’d better tell Miss Lee yourself!”
“Miss Lee?”
John was stunned for a moment, then turned his attention to Stephanie.
“May I know who you are, Miss Lee? Why are you holding our family members here?”
At this moment, John did not know who Stephanie was, so he asked her politely.
“Nothing. 1 just want to disfigure that woman’s face!”
Stephanie pointed at Freya and said viciously.
“Who… Who exactly are you? How can you bully my family just because you want to?”
