John shouted with his eyes wide open.
“John, if I remember correctly, we haven’t seen each other for ten years. Do you still remember who 1 am?”
At this moment, Howard said with a faint smile.
John turned to look at Howard. When he saw Howard’s face, he was stunned. His face was filled with disbelief.
“Howard Duncan?”
John stammered.
“Since you still know me, today’s matter will be easy to handle…”
Howard looked at John with a faint smile and said softly, “John, today’s matter is not something you can interfere in. Therefore, I advise you to stand at the side and wait. Otherwise, 1’11 make everyone in your family suffer…”
John looked at Howard and was completely dumbfounded. Although he didn’t know who Stephanie was, he knew who Howard was!
Since Howard had already said so, it meant that Connor, Freya, and the others must have offended some powerful figure with an astonishing background. Moreover, with the current strength of the Phillips Family, there was indeed no way they could go against someone like Howard.
“Connor, what… what’s going on?” John hesitated for a moment before turning his head and asking Connor in a low voice.
“Just stand aside and wait!”
Connor was not in the mood to explain these things to John. He replied very calmly.
John looked at Connor and hesitated for a moment. He could feel that today’s matter might not be as simple as he had imagined, so he did not dare to say anything more. He walked directly to Freya and the others and began to ask what had happened today.
Vroom!
Just as John turned around and left, the roar of an engine came from the street opposite Lume again.
“Someone else is here!”
“Yeah, who is it this time?”
When everyone heard this sound, they all turned their heads to look.
Stephanie also turned her head to take a look and immediately revealed a very satisfied smile.
Because she saw the Rolls-Royce Phantom at the front. The license plate number was L88888!
In Porthampton, almost everyone knew what this license plate number represented!
Other than Thomas Morgan, the richest man in Porthampton, who else was qualified to use this license plate number?
The size and momentum of Thomas’s motorcade were not inferior to Stephanie’s motorcade in the slightest.
“It’s Thomas Morgan’s motorcade!”
Someone in the crowd recognized Thomas’s license plate number and shouted at the top of his voice.
“Oh my God, what’s going on here? There are actually so many big shots who have come personally!”
“Yeah, could it be that Thomas Morgan is the reinforcement that Connor called over?”
“How is that possible? How could someone like Connor know Thomas Morgan? I think Thomas Morgan must be here for that woman…”
“If Thomas Morgan was really called over by that woman, that’s too awesome, right? What kind of big shot could invite people like Thomas Morgan and Howard Duncan?”
The onlookers who were standing at the side and watching the show began to discuss softly at this moment. They were very excited.
A moment later, a Rolls-Royce Phantom and five Mercedes-Benz GMs were parked neatly at the entrance of Lume.
Thomas pushed open the car door and got out.
When Stephanie saw him, the smile on her face became even brighter. She knew that Thomas’s appearance meant that her plan had succeeded.
Under everyone’s gaze, Thomas walked directly to Connor and made an unexpected move!
Thomas bowed deeply to Connor, then respectfully shouted, “Mr. McDonald, I’m sorry I’m late!”
Everyone was in an uproar.
Thomas was actually called over by Connor!

chapters.title: Chapter 340 - 340: Don’t Even Think About Leaving!
chapters.content:
Chapter 340 - 340: Don’t Even Think About Leaving!
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Actually, when Thomas saw Stephanie, Howard, and the others, he had already guessed what had happened.
However, he also knew that since Connor dared to call him, it meant that Connor was ready to expose his identity.
That was why Thomas ignored Freya and the others and respectfully addressed Connor as Mr. McDonald.
This was the first time Thomas addressed Connor like this in front of so many people, but he also knew that this might be the last time.
To put it bluntly, Connor was just a poor student. Back then, he was only lucky enough to inherit the old chairman’s legacy.
However, in terms of schemes, Connor was no match for Stephanie and Yannick Lee.
After all, children who grew up in big families were destined to be more scheming and shrewder than ordinary people.
When everyone heard Thomas call him Mr. McDonald, they were all dumbfounded.
Almost everyone in Davenport knew who Thomas was and what his status was.
However, Thomas was actually treating Connor so respectfully. Even a fool could see that Connor’s identity and background were definitely not something they could imagine.
Of course, the people who were the most shocked were probably those from the Phillips Family.
Although John had already guessed that Connor’s background might not be simple, he never dreamed that Connor’s background would be so terrifying!
Meanwhile, Freya looked at Connor in shock. After all, Freya thought that the relationship between Connor and Thomas existed only because Connor had saved Thomas and that Thomas was grateful to him.
However, their relationship with each other was not as simple as that!
“Is Connor really a rich heir? Has he been lying to me all this time?”
Freya looked at Connor in disbelief, her heart filled with shock and doubt.
For a moment, the entire restaurant entrance fell silent. Everyone stared at Connor and Thomas with their mouths agape.
“Mr. McDonald, how do you plan to deal with today’s matter?”
Thomas asked Connor softly.
“Not everyone has arrived. Let’s wait a little longer!”
Connor replied indifferently.
“Alright!”
Thomas nodded and went to stand behind Connor.
Thomas’s bodyguards also stood behind Connor. Their imposing manner was not inferior to Stephanie, Howard, and the others.
Stephanie looked at Connor with a smile and said lightly, “Connor, do you think it’s necessary to wait any longer? You’ve already lost…”
“I did lose, but 1 don’t want to lose too badly. I’m still the heir to the old chairman, and 1 still have the right to deal with you. Since you want to play, I’ll let you know what the consequences are for offending me!”
Connor replied expressionlessly.
When Stephanie heard Connor’s words, a hint of nervousness flashed across her eyes. Then, she suddenly stood up and shouted at him, “Connor, what do you want to do?”
“You’ll know in a while!”
Connor said lightly.
Stephanie’s plan today was very simple. She wanted to use Freya to anger Connor and make him get Thomas to come over.
In this way, Connor’s identity would be made public, and he would lose the right to inherit the inheritance.
However, Stephanie had no intention of fighting Connor to the death.
“Since Mr. Thomas has already personally come forward, 1 still have to give you face. Let’s forget about this matter today. I’m not in the mood to continue playing with you!”
Stephanie was afraid that Connor would do something crazy, so she quickly found a way out for herself.
She had already achieved her goal today. There was no need for her to continue staying here and wasting time with Connor.
Therefore, after Stephanie said this, she turned around and planned to leave.
“Why are you in such a hurry to leave? It isn’t over yet!”
Connor shouted expressionlessly.
Anyway, Connor had already exposed his identity, which meant that he had lost the right to inherit the inheritance. Of course, he would not let Stephanie and the others leave so easily.
“Connor, what do you mean?”
Stephanie slowly turned to look at Connor and asked angrily.
“It’s very simple. None of you can leave today. Do you understand me?”
Connor replied coldly.
“Connor, don’t forget that you’re about to lose the right to inherit the inheritance. By then, you’re just an ordinary person. It’s easier for me to kill you than to kill an ant. So, you’d better leave some leeway for yourself. I’m sure you don’t want to lose both the inheritance and your life!”
Stephanie gritted her teeth and shouted at Connor coldly.
According to Stephanie’s previous plan, she was prepared to use Freya to threaten Connor, then get him to call Thomas and the others over, and finally force him to expose his identity in front of Freya.
What she wanted had come true.
After all, based on Stephanie’s previous investigation, Connor was not a tough person. She figured that once Connor had ensured Freya’s safety, he would not cause her any trouble.
However, Connor’s actions were completely out of her expectations. He actually did not intend to end this matter so easily.
Therefore, Stephanie wanted to threaten Connor so that he understood what kind of situation he was in.
“Lose my life?”
Connor looked at Stephanie and sneered, then said indifferently, “You’re right. If 1 don’t have this inheritance, I might just be an ordinary person, or even worse than an ordinary person. However, I’m still the heir of the inheritance. You set me up and made me lose everything.”
Stephanie looked at Connor in front of her and smiled disdainfully. She said coldly, “So what if you’re still the heir? If I want to leave, do you think you can stop me?”
At this time, Thomas had brought less than 20 bodyguards, but Howard had brought 30 bodyguards, and all of them were Howard’s elites. If the two sides fought, Connor would not have any advantage.
“Let’s go!”
Stephanie called out with an expressionless face, then turned around and walked away.
However, the moment Stephanie turned around, the roar of an engine came from across the street again.
“If Mr. McDonald doesn’t allow someone to leave, that person can never leave!”
Kyle Hayes shouted expressionlessly and then walked out of the Land Rover with 50 bodyguards. The scene was extremely shocking..

chapters.title: Chapter 341 - 341: Tit For Tat
chapters.content:
Chapter 341: Tit For Tat
Translator: End Less Fantasy Translation Editor: End less Fantasy Translation
“Oil my god it’s Kyle Hayes!”
“No way, how could Kyle be here? Was he also called by Connor?”
“Who is this Connor? He managed to bring Kyle and Thomas here together!”
“It seems that Connor is a rich heir. Only he could have the qualifications to bring both Kyle and Thomas. No one else in rhe entire Davenport could do that.”
After seeing Kyle appearance, everyone couldn’t help but exclaim in astonishment, their expressions showing extreme shock.
Ir was already beyond everyone’s expectations that Connor could bring Thomas. But now he had also brought Kyle, which was terrifying!
Although Kyle’s status in Davenport was not as high as Thomas’, he was still a big shot in Porthampton, while Thomas was just a businessman.
Moreover, when someone like Kyle with a dark background appeared, it would definitely be more awe-inspiring than Thomas.
Stephanie, upon seeing Kyle and his men, immediately showed a trace of nervousness in her eyes. She instinctively took two steps back and turned to look at Howard next to her.
Howard’s expression at this time was also very unpleasant. If it were only Thomas or Kyle alone, he would definitely have the confidence to take Stephanie away.
But both of them appeared at the same time, he doesn’t have the confidence at all.
“Connor really lied to me!”
At this moment, Freya also realized what was happening.
When she saw Thomas earlier, she had some doubts in her mind. But now, seeing Kyle s appearance, she could basically confirm that Connor had been acting with her all along.
He was not some poor loser but he was an incredibly powerful rich heir with an astonishing background.
“No wonder he asked me how I would react if he is a rich heir…”
Recalling the words he had said to her before, she couldn’t help but shake her head with a bitter smile.
“Swoosh!”
The fifty bodyguards brought by Kyle directly surrounded the entrance of Lume, ensuring that Stephanie had no way to escape from any direction.
“Miss Stephanie… what should we do now?”
Alvin was completely dumbfounded when he saw Kyle’s men surrounding them. He never could have imagined that things would escalate to this extent!
He only wanted to get back at Connor, but who could have thought that it would attract Thomas and Kyle!
He still didn’t realize that in Stephanie’s eyes, he was just a pawn.
She was in no mood to deal with him at the moment. Frowning, she shouted at Kyle, “Kyle, do you know who I am? Now that Connor has lost his inheritance rights, and my brother is about to inherit it, you will be under my brother’s command. So, I advise you to be sensible and get your men to leave immediately…”
After hearing her words, Kyle stopped in his tracks.
He knew that what she said was true. At this time, Connor had lost the qualification to inherit the inheritance, and Yannick was likely to become his new boss. So he was technically offending Yannick.
Kyle was different from Thomas. Thomas was the notary of the late chairman’s inheritance and the person in charge of all the businesses of the late chairman.
Therefore, no matter who inherited the inheritance, Thomas was irreplaceable because only he can continue rhe late chairman’s business!
But Kyle was different. He was just an employee and can be replaced at any time.
Connor looked at Kyle and felt nervous. He didn’t know what choice Kyle would make at this moment.
“I’m sorry, I don’t know who you are, and I don’t want to know who you are. I only know that Mr. Connor is my boss now. My boss told me to keep you here, so you can’t leave!”
At this moment, Kyle suddenly shouted at Stephanie and then walked towards Connor.
Connor stared at Kyle in surprised.
“You…”
Stephanie was stunned when she heard these words.
She never expected that Kyle would willingly risk offending his future boss to protect Connor.
“Mr. Connor, I’m sorry for being late!” Kyle walked to Connor’s side and said respectfully.
“I’m sorry, 1 didn’t consider that Yannick might be your boss in the future…”
Connor turned his head and looked at him and was deeply moved.
“Mr. Connor, it doesn’t matter who my boss will be in the future. What matters is that you are still my boss now!”
Kyle replied calmly and then stood behind Connor.
The people from the Phillips family looked at Connor, their expressions filled with astonishment.
They never expected that Connor’s background would be so powerful as he was capable of making Thomas and Kyle his subordinate.
“Cousin, what inheritance did Connor actually inherit? What’s going on?”
Maya was also confused as she looked at Freya and asked in a puzzled tone.
“I… I don’t know what’s going on either…”
Freya shook her head and replied softly.
She only now realized that she knew too little about Connor.
After seeing that Kyle didn’t change his mind, Stephanie became panicked. She turned to Howard and asked, “Uncle Howard, what should we do now?”
“Miss Stephanie, go straight to the car now!” he replied expressionlessly.
“Okay!”
Stephanie knew that at this moment, the only person who could save her was Howard. She had full trust in him and directly turned around and walked towards the parking area.
“Swoosh!”
When Kyle’s men saw Stephanie trying to leave, they hurriedly rushed towards her.
But a trace of ruthlessness flashed in Howard’s eyes. Before anyone could react, he took out a handgun from his pocket.
“Bang!”
He fired a shot directly at Kyle’s men!
The gunshot echoed throughout the street.
Everyone present was dumbfounded. No one expected him to pull out a gun in front of so many people!
Even Kyle and Thomas were stunned in their tracks!

chapters.title: Chapter 342 - 342: Can’t Even Defend Myself or Others
chapters.content:
Chapter 342: Can’t Even Defend Myself or Others
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
At the entrance of Lume.
After Howard fired a shot at Kyle’s subordinate, the onlookers immediately became restless, with fear evident on their faces.
After all, most of the people present were ordinary citizens. Although their family backgrounds might be slightly better than average, they had never witnessed such a scene before!
Therefore, it was normal for these people to appear panicked and at a loss in the face of this situation.
Even Connor himself was stunned in place.
“Help!”
“Help! Someone is trying to kill!”
“Quick, someone help! Save us!”
Cries for help echoed through the air.
All the members of the Phillips family took shelter inside Lume, seemingly afraid that Howard would shoot at them.
Outside the restaurant, only Freya, Maya and Priscilla stood behind Connor.
Howard, with an expressionless face, looked at Connor the others, directly pointing his gun at Connor. He grinned and shouted, “Miss Stephanie, you go first. If anyone dares to touch you, I’ll blow his head off!”
Stephanie glanced at Howard, without saying a word, she turned around and walked towards the parking lot.
Thomas and Kyle stared at Howard intently, their faces filled with tension.
Because both of them knew that once Howard went crazy, he was capable of doing anything.
“Howard, if you dare to shoot now, your life will be over, do you understand?”
Thomas shouted coldly at him.
“Even if I don’t shoot today, I won’t have a good ending in your hands. Moreover, protecting Miss Stephanie is my mission. Rest assured, as long as I can complete the mission, I won’t harm him!”
Howard licked his lips and shouted with a ferocious expression.
After hearing this, Kyle and Thomas couldn’t help but show a hint of helplessness on their faces.
After all, they hadn’t expected Howard to bring a gun, so they had no way to help Connor out of this predicament.
The bodyguards brought by Kyle stopped in their tracks when they saw Howard pointing a gun at Connor. They didn’t dare to continue obstructing Stephanie.
They were worried that if they really angered him, Connor would undoubtedly be doomed, and no one would be able to bear that responsibility.
Stephanie marched away in high heels, swaying her hips, and walked to the front of the Hummer. She glanced disdainfully at Connor, then reached out to open the car door and got in.
“Vroom…”
After she got into the car, the Hummer roared loudly and rushed toward the street.
When Howard saw Stephanie getting ready to leave in the Hummer, his expression visibly relaxed, and he was prepared to let go of the gun in his hand.
Since he had a weapon now, as long as Stephanie could safely leave this place, Kyle and his men would have no chance of keeping him there.
But just as he was about to put down the gun, a figure suddenly rushed out from the crowd.
He reacted quickly and raised his gun, ready to aim at Connor again, but before he could raise the gun…
A cold light flashed.
The next second, a dagger pierced through his wrist.
“Clang!”
His gun fell to the ground.
“Damn it, I was careless!”
At this moment, he had no mood to consider his own injury. He gritted his teeth, cursed under his breath, and then bent down to pick up the gun from the ground.
Unfortunately, by the time he reacted, it was already too late.
Carlos rushed to Howard in swift steps and kicked him directly in the stomach.
“Thud!”
Howard flew high in the air before crashing onto the ground.
Carlos was a professionally trained special forces soldier. With one kick, even a wild buffalo could be knocked unconscious.
Not to mention that Howard was just an ordinary person.
After he fell to the ground, he let out a painfully agonized howl and struggled to stand up.
Upon seeing this scene, the crowd was dumbfounded.
Carlos’ skills had completely shocked them. In their eyes, this kind of person seemed to only exist in movies, but now he appeared before them so vividly.
While he struggled to stand up, he managed to hold on for only a couple of seconds before falling heavily to the ground again.
He felt as if he had been hit by a truck just now. Every part of his body was aching, and he had no strength to stand up.
Kyle’s reaction speed was also very fast. He stepped forward and immediately stomped on Howard’s head.
“Mr. Connor, sorry for the long wait. Are you alright?”
After seeing Howard being subdued by Kyle, Carlos walked respectfully to Connor’s side and spoke in a highly respectful tone.
“I’m fine…”
Connor replied in a low voice, then turned his head to look at the Hummer where Stephanie was.
Stephanie saw Howard being kicked away by Carlos while inside the car, she was currently in a predicament herself and had no mood to care about his well-being. She could only urge the driver to drive faster.
At this moment, she had only one thought in her mind which was to leave this cursed place as soon as possible.
The situation had developed to a point where it was completely beyond her control.
“Bang!”
But at that moment, there was another loud noise on the street.
After hearing this sound, everyone shifted their attention from Du Shenghao to the location of the Hummer.
A white van crashed directly into the Hummer where Li Zhitong was.
The car door of the Hummer instantly dented, creating a spectacular scene.
“Don’t mind this car, just go!”
Li Zhitong knew that the van that crashed into them must also belong to Zhang Feng’s people, so she quickly shouted at the Hummer driver.
The driver hesitated for a moment, disregarding the blood on his forehead, and immediately stepped on the accelerator to try to restart the Hummer.
“Bang!”
But before the Hummer could start, a hammer smashed directly onto the car window.
The glass instantly shattered into pieces!
Following that, a small knife gleaming with a cold light was pressed against Stephanie’s neck.
“Miss Stephanie, get out of the car!”
A voice of a fat man came from outside the car..

chapters.title: Chapter 343 - 343: Break His Right Arm
chapters.content:
Chapter 343: Break His Right Arm
Translator: End Less Fantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
When Stephanie saw the small knife held against her neck, she froze.
She never expected that Connor would have his subordinates lurking among the crowd.
She turned her head and glanced at the fat man outside the car window. Through gritted teeth, she said in a low voice, “How much did Connor pay you?
1 will give you ten times that amount. Just let me go now, and I can immediately give you the money!”
Upon hearing her words, Bruno couldn’t help but smile. With a smirk, he replied, “Miss, your offer is indeed tempting, but you see, 1 am Mr. Connor’s bodyguard. 1 do whatever he asks me to do. You can go talk to him and see if he is willing to let you go!”
“You…” Stephanie’s face instantly flashed with despair.
She couldn’t understand why these people were so devoted to protecting Connor, who had already lost everything.
“Miss Stephanie, we don’t want to harm you, so 1 advise you to obediently step out of the car. Otherwise, with such a sharp knife, if it accidentally cuts your pretty face, it won’t be worth it!” said Diana, who had a hot figure and had now approached the Hummer, shouting at Stephanie.
Diana was dressed very sexily. She wore a white off-shoulder tank top on her upper body and a light yellow miniskirt on her lower body. The skirt was extremely short, barely covering her sexy and round ass. She wore a pair of black stockings on her long and fair legs and a pair of red high-heeled sandals on her feet. With her exquisite face and seductive figure, she looked very beautiful.
When she appeared at the entrance of the restaurant, she instantly attracted the attention of numerous male onlookers.
“You are all a bunch of lunatics! Connor is about to become an ordinary person, why are you still helping him? My brother will soon be your new boss. Aren’t you afraid of his retaliation for treating me like this?” Stephanie exclaimed with extreme anger.
“Miss Stephanie, 1 don’t know if your brother will become my boss in the future, but currently, my only boss is Mr. Connor. I do whatever he asks me to do!” replied Diana calmly.
Stephanie trembled with anger upon hearing these words. She gritted her teeth in silence for a moment, then looked down at the small knife on her neck.
She knew that her resistance was meaningless at this point, and Diana and the others seemed extremely loyal to Connor. Her words couldn’t possibly intimidate them.
“Miss Stephanie, get off the car!” Bruno shouted.
“Put down your knife. If it accidentally cuts my face, 1 will definitely kill your whole family!” Stephanie coldly shouted back at him.
Bruno chuckled upon hearing this and put away the small knife in his hand.
Stephanie took a deep breath, then reached out and pushed open the car door. She turned her head and shouted at Connor, who was standing at the entrance of the restaurant, “Connor, what do you want now?”
As soon as she finished speaking, Diana slapped her across the face without hesitation.
She took two steps back, wearing an expression of incredulity as she stared at Diana with her eyes wide open. She exclaimed, “How dare you hit me! Do you know who I am? Do you have a death wish!”
“A woman like you is not qualified to call Mr. Connor by his name!” Diana replied calmly.
“You… Well, all of you wait for me. After my brother inherits the inheritance, I will personally kill all of you!” Stephanie shouted frantically with an insane expression.
“Then let’s wait until your brother inherits the inheritance!” Diana sneered disdainfully.
At the same time, Connor, Kyle, Thomas and others had already approached Stphanie.
“Mr. Connor!”
“Mr. Connor!”
Diana and Bruno both greeted Connor almost at the same time.
“Thank you both for your hard work!” Connor replied calmly, then squinted his eyes as he looked at Stephanie’s position.
“Connor, what do you want?” Stephanie shouted with emotions towards Connor.
“Before, due to the inheritance issue, I couldn’t be too aggressive with you all. But now that 1 don’t even have the qualification to inherit the inheritance, I have nothing to be afraid of! You wanted to have fun with me today, right? Then I’ll play with you until the end!” Connor gritted his teeth, shouting with extreme anger.
All the things Stephanie did today were about to make Connor lose everything that should have belonged to him. There was no way he could stay calm about it.
“What… What do you want to do?” She felt that his emotions seemed off, so she quickly took two steps back, shouting with a frightened expression.
He ignored her and turned his head to look at Alvin and Hailey.
In Connor’s eyes, these two people were Stephanie’s accomplices and equally despicable.
At this moment, Alvin was completely dumbfounded, standing in place with a blank expression, looking at Connor with an extremely fearful expression.
Even now, he still hadn’t figured out what exactly had happened today!
“If it wasn’t for you, we wouldn’t have had so much trouble today, right?” Connor softly said to Alvin.
“Bang!”
After hearing Connor’s words, Alvin was so frightened that he immediately knelt in front of him and kept bowing down while shouting, “Mr. Connor, 1 know I am wrong. Please spare me!”
“Mr. Connor, I know my wrongs too. Please spare me!” Hailey followed suit, kneeling in front of Connor.
If they had known that today’s events would turn out like this, they wouldn’t dare to provoke Connor.
Connor looked at Alvin for two seconds, feeling that he and Hailey were already scared out of their wits. Hence it would be useless for him to punish them.
So he turned his head and looked at Kyle, emotionless, and shouted, “Kyle!”
“Here!” Kyle quickly replied.
“Do you remember which hand this guy used to point the gun at me just now?” Connor squinted his eyes and looked at Howard lying on the ground, asking in a solemn voice.
“His right hand!” Kyle recalled and answered.
“Then break his right hand for me!” Connor ordered without any hesitation.
Upon hearing his words, Freya and the others were stunned in place, their expressions filled with shock.
They didn’t expect Connor to be so ruthless and ordered Kyle to break Howard’s right hand.
Kyle didn’t hesitate and walked straight to Howard.
However, before he could reach Howard’s side, a sharp siren suddenly sounded on the street!

chapters.title: Chapter 344 - 344: Cuff and Take Them Away
chapters.content:
Chapter 344: Cuff and Take Them Away
Translator: End less Fantasy Translation Editor: EndtcssFantasy Translation
A piercing sound of sirens kept coming from a distance.
Upon hearing the sirens, everyone turned their attention to the opposite side of the road.
Suddenly, a dozen police cars rushed in and surrounded Kyle and the others.
Connor squinted at the police cars and turned to Thomas, asking, “Did you call them?11
“No…11
Thomas shook his head hurriedly. As the general manager of the Empire World Building, he wasn’t foolish enough to call the police to handle such matters.
Stephanie also turned her head to look at the direction of the police cars, wearing a puzzled expression. She never expected the police to show up at this moment.
Therefore, these police officers were not called by Connor or Stephanie. It was highly likely that the people present at the scene had reported the incident when Howard fired his gun.
“Mr. Connor, if the police come, things might get complicated!” Thomas hesitated for a moment and whispered to Connor.
“Do you have a solution?” Connor asked.
“It’s not easy…” Thomas shook his head lightly. If it were in Porthampton, the police would show him some respect due to his position as the general manager. Bur this was Phillips Estate. Thomas didn’t even know the police in this area.
Upon hearing his words, Connor couldn’t help but frown, feeling extremely unwilling. He knew that if he let Stephanie and the others go today, he might never have a chance for revenge again. So even if rhe police arrived, he had no intention of giving up.
Freya and the others stood behind Connor, looking at him with puzzled expressions. They had no idea what he was thinking at the moment.
“Mr. Connor, 1 still have some connections in Phillips Estate. I can give it a try!” Thomas suddenly spoke up.
“Alright!” Connor replied indifferently upon hearing his words.
“Listen, all of you. You are completely surrounded by us. Now, immediately drop your weapons, or we will take actions!” At that moment, a middle-aged man in a police uniform stepped out of the police car and shouted at Connor and the others using a loudspeaker.
Upon hearing this, Kyle’s men turned their heads to look at him.
“Put down your weapons!” Kyle ordered expressionlessly.
Upon hearing his command, they naturally didn’t dare to act rashly. They quickly dropped their weapons and made way for the police officers.
The police officers, more than a dozen of them, immediately rushed toward Connor and the others.
“Chief Hans, what’s going on?” Kyle saw the police officers preparing to take action and quickly stepped forward, smiling as he asked at the middle-aged police officer.
Chief Hans, the middle-aged police officer, couldn’t help but pause. His tone became puzzled as he said to Kyle, “Mr. Kyle, what are you doing here?”
It was evident that Chief Hans spoke very politely to Kyle.
“Chief Hans, this is my boss, Mr. Connor. Why did you come here this time?’1 Kyle directly stated Connor’s identity.
After Hans Mason found out about Connor’s identity, his eyes were obviously a little surprised.
He had never thought that the man standing in front of him was Kyle’s boss!
Hans knew very well what Kyle’s boss represented.
“Mr. Kyle, 1 just received a report that someone was shooting here, so I brought a team over to see what’s going on!”
Hans explained to Kyle with a smile and then continued, “Mr. Kyle, you should have been here during the gunfire, right?”
“That’s right, I’m here too!”
Kyle nodded slightly, then looked down at Howard who was lying on the ground and said in a low voice, “Chief Hans, this was the person who fired the gun just now. But don’t worry, my bodyguards have already helped you take down this person!”
“So that’s how it is!”
Hans also glanced down at Howard who was lying half-dead on the ground, and continued speaking, “1 am truly grateful to Mr. Kyle for eliminating harm for the people. Your bodyguards are not injured, right?’1
“No…”
Kyle shook his head lightly.
“That’s good…”
Hans flashed a tight lip smile, then turned his head and shouted at the police behind him, “What are you all standing there for? Hurry up and handcuff this person and take him away…”
“Yes!”
The police behind him nodded quickly and walked towards Howard.
“Oh, and bring that woman with me too. She is associated with the suspect!”
He pointed at Stephanie with a blank expression and shouted.
After hearing his words, Kyle was stunned in place, a him of surprise flashed across his face.
He had never mentioned the relationship between Stephanie and Howard to Hans. So how was it possible for Hans to know that they were working together.
Furthermore, if the police were to take both of them away, it would no longer be Connor’s decision on how to handle them, but the decision of rhe police!
“Chief Hans, you can’t take these two people away!”
Kyle stepped forward and directly confronted Hans.
“I can’t rake them away?”
Hans couldn’t help but pause when he heard this, then his face suddenly changed, and he looked at Kyle and asked, “Mr. Kyle, what do you mean by that? These two people are the suspects in the shooting incident just now. Why shouldn’t 1 take them away?”
“Chief Hans, you misunderstood me. Here’s the situation, these two people still have some personal grudges with my boss, Mr. Connor, that have nor been resolved. So, could you wait until we settle all these matters, and then you can take them away?” Kyle said with a smile.
“Mr. Kyle, this is Phillips Estate, not Porthampton. I don’t know what it’s like in Porthampton, but here we follow the law. So, I must take these two people away immediately. Do you understand what I mean?” Hans said solemnly.
“What if 1 don’t let you take them away?”
At that moment, Connor suddenly spoke up.
Hans turned his head and glanced at Connor, then said sternly, “Anyone who dares to obstruct us from performing our official duties today will be immediately handcuffed and taken away!”
After hearing Hans’ words, Connor, Kyle and Thomas were stunned in place, their expressions extremely unpleasant..

chapters.title: Chapter 345 - 345: The Abnormal Hans
chapters.content:
Chapter 345: The Abnormal Hans
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Generally speaking, after knowing Connor’s identity, Hans will definitely be wary of him.
After all, standing beside him were Thomas and Kyle.
These two individuals were influential figures in Porthampton. Not only in Porthampton, but even in the entire Davenport. There were only a few people who dared to offend them!
Compared to him, Hans was a nobody. Under normal circumstances, he doesn’t even have the qualifications to speak to Thomas and Kyle
But today, he was acting out of character and not giving Kyle any face.
There was only one possibility to his strange behaviour.
Hans hadn’t came there because he received news that there was a gunfire.
Instead, someone gave him the orders to come and rescue Howard and Stephanie.
After all, if they were taken away by him, he will have complete control over them.
“Hans, I have a good relationship with Mr. Gordon from Davenport. Can you give me face today? I will visit and thank you in person another day!”
Thomas tried to convince Hans.
“Mr. Thomas, I’m sorry, but today it doesn’t matter who comes, 1 must take these two people away. After all, it’s my duty!”
Hans looked at Thomas with a serious expression and shouted.
Upon hearing this, a trace of helplessness flashed across Thomas’ face because he knew Hans was determined.
He had mentioned Mr. Gordon, but Han still didn’t give him any face. This meant that the force behind Hans was even stronger than Mr. Gordon!
“It seems that Yannick has intervened in this matter!”
Thomas sighed softly and then walked to Connor’s side, whispering, “Mr. Connor, if Yannick is involve in this then we might not be able to keep these two people today!”
Upon hearing this, Connor couldn’t help but grit his teeth, his expression showing great unwillingness.
“What are you all standing around for? Hurry up and grab them!”
Hans, seeing that Connor remained silent, turned his head and shouted at his subordinates behind him.
“Whoosh!”
After hearing this, more than a dozen burly men immediately strode towards Howard’s direction.
Carlos, Bruno and Diana had no idea what was happening and instinctively stood in front of those people.
“Mr. Connor, do you want to keep them? If you just say a word, we can knock them all down, and whatever happens next, the three of us can handle it!”
Carlos knew that Connor didn’t want to let Howard go, so he shouted at Connor.
“What do you mean? Do you still want to fight us?”
Hans never expected that Carlos and the others would dare to defy him and not take his words seriously.
“Who do you think you are? I’ll beat you up if you keep talking!”
Bruno sneered and replied disdainfully.
“You… Are you three trying to rebel?”
Hans shouted loudly and turned his head to Connor, asking, “Mr. Connor, don’t you take care of the people under your command?”
Connor squinted his eyes and remained silent, as he stared at Carlos, Bruno and Diana.
“Mr. Connor, if you say the word now, the three of us can immediately take action!” Diana yelled.
“Connor, if you dare to let them make a move today, I guarantee that none of you will escape!” Hans threatened him.
Now, no one would move without Connor’s command.
In that instant, everyone’s attention focused on him.
“Connor, let them take Howard away. If you really make a move against Hans, your life will be ruined!” Freya suddenly stepped forward and shouted loudly at Connor.
Although she hadn’t figured out who he really was or his true identity, she knew that if Connor really made a move against Hans, the situation would be completely different!
Kyle had been in Porthampton for so many years, and even in his most arrogant age, he didn’t have the courage to make a move against Hans!
Going against him was like going against the entire law enforcement department. No matter how powerful one’s background was, one can’t single-handedly change the situation.
After hearing Freya’s words, Connor turned his head and glanced at her, then took a deep breath and shouted in a low voice, “Carlos, Bruno and Diana step aside!”
“Mr. Connor!”
Carlos and the other two almost simultaneously exclaimed, their expressions filled with emotions.
“I know all three of you are doing it for my own good, but starting from tomorrow, I won’t be your boss anymore. So, the three of you should step aside.” Connor said calmly.
“Mr. Connor, whether you are still our boss tomorrow or not, as long as you are our boss now, we will uphold your dignity and won’t stand by while you are being humiliated!” Carlos exclaimed with wide eyes. Even if he had to let Howard and the others go, he felt extremely unwilling in his heart.
“Yes, Mr. Connor, all you need to do is say a word, and we will immediately take action and keep them here!” Bruno also shouted along.
Connor hesitated for two seconds in his place, then gritted his teeth and shouted, “Didn’t 1 tell you to step aside? Can’t you hear me?”
The three were momentarily stunned upon hearing this.
“Mr. Connor…”
Diana softly called out.
“Step aside!” Connor shouted loudly, his expression extremely agitated.
Carlos took a deep breath and slowly stepped back two steps, clearing the way for the people in front of him.
Diana and Bruno also followed suit and took two steps back after seeing Carlos step aside.
Hans, upon witnessing this scene, immediately wore a triumphant smile on his face.
Stephanie also smiled smugly. She knew that she had won.
“Alright, take them away!” Hans happily shouted.
“Woosh!”
Upon hearing these words, Hans’ subordinates directly walked toward Howard.
“Boom…”
However, at that moment, a loud rumbling sound came from the distant sky.
Upon hearing this sound, everyone looked up at the sky.
They saw three black dots slowly flying towards them..

chapters.title: Chapter 346 - 346: A Mysterious Middle-aged Man
chapters.content:
Chapter 346: A Mysterious Middle-aged Man
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
“F * ck, what is that?”
“A helicopter! It’s a helicopter!”
“Those helicopters seem to be heading towards us!”
“Who is this Connor? He actually called a helicopter over…”
Everyone looked at the black dots not far away and began to discuss amongst themselves excitedly.
Although everyone had more or less seen helicopters in movies, it was still very rare for ordinary people to see helicopters in real life. After all, this kind of thing was not something that ordinary people could afford.
The cheapest helicopter would cost tens of millions, and this was the most basic cost. If the usual maintenance and fuel costs were added on, it would cost hundreds of millions a year. Therefore, even those super rich heirs in Opr ana were reluctant to use so much money to buy a helicopter.
When Connor saw the helicopter, he was also stunned for a moment. Then, he turned to look at Kyle and Thomas behind him.
They both shook their heads at Connor, indicating that these helicopters had nothing to do with them. The two of them did not call anyone over at all, so they did not know who drove these helicopters over!
After Connor saw Thomas and Kyle’s reaction, he couldn’t help but frown. If these helicopters weren’t called over by Thomas and the others, it was very likely that they were called over by Stephanie.
However, Stephanie was about to be picked up by Hans Mason. What was the point of calling a helicopter over?
Stephanie, Hans, and the others also looked up at the helicopter in the sky with a puzzled expression.
Stephanie looked at the helicopter in the sky and could not help but think to herself, “Is it Brother Yannick? But there didn’t seem to be so many helicopters at home.”
At this moment, the helicopter slowly approached, and the roar became more and more obvious.
“F * ck! It really is a helicopter!”
“It’s flying towards us…”
“One…Two…Three… Four…Five!”
“There are actually five helicopters. Who are these people to actually call five helicopters over…”
Everyone looked up at the sight in the sky and shouted excitedly.
Freya narrowed her eyes as she looked at the sky. Her expression was extremely solemn. Everything that had happened today had given her too much shock, so her expression was starting to turn numb.
Maya and the rest of the Phillips family did not know how to describe their feelings.
“Rumble!”
As the helicopter flew closer and closer, the roar became louder and louder. The propeller set off a gale in the air, blowing everyone’s hair in all directions.
A moment later, five helicopters slowly stopped at the entrance of Lume.
When everyone saw the helicopters, their faces immediately revealed a shocked expression. If it was a single helicopter, many people might have seen it before. However, when these five large helicopters, which were more than 15 meters long, were neatly arranged in front of them, everyone felt an indescribable sense of shock and a sense of insignificance.
People would feel how small they were standing in front of the helicopter.
“Who called for these helicopters?”
“Could it be that Connor called them over?”
“How is that possible? How can Connor be so powerful?”
“I don’t think it’s Connor either. Look at the words ‘Wild Tigers’ written on the helicopters!”
“Wild Tigers?”
“Are these the Wild Tigers? Who here is so amazing as to call all of them over?”
When everyone saw the words on the helicopter, they began to discuss excitedly. After all, this scene was too shocking for the ordinary people present. They had never seen a real helicopter up close in their lives! On top of that, these helicopters were from the Wild Tigers! Such an experience was enough for them to brag outside for a long time.
At this moment, the door of the helicopter opened, and a dozen burly men in black jumped out of the cabin.
These strong men were all fully armed and wore thick bulletproof vests. Their aura was not something that the bodyguards present could compare to.
“Why are the Wild Tigers here?”
Hans was completely dumbfounded. He quickly ran to Stephanie’s side and stammered, “Miss Lee, did you call these people over?”
“I don’t know…”
Stephanie shook her head gently. She didn’t know anyone from the Wild Tigers, nor did she have any connections in this area. However, she wasn’t sure if these people were called by her brother Yannick.
“If these people weren’t called by Mr. Yannick, then it would be a bit troublesome!” Hans stammered.
After the men in black landed, they quickly ran to the front of the leading helicopter and lined up in two rows in an orderly manner. However, they didn’t do anything after that. Instead, they waited for someone to appear with a serious expression on their faces.
Connor narrowed his eyes and looked at the helicopter at the front. It was also the only helicopter that had not opened its hatch.
At this moment, Connor was very puzzled because he still didn’t know who the person who had come was.
“Bang!”
The door of the leading helicopter was slowly pulled open.
A middle-aged man in a business suit walked out of the cabin with vigorous steps. While the man was not tall, the aura he emitted was extremely dignified, making people not dare to look at him directly.
“Who is this person?”
“He looks very powerful? But what is he doing here?”
“Someone who can be picked up by a helicopter must not be an ordinary person!”
When everyone saw this middle-aged man, they began to whisper.
After the man left the cabin, he glanced around and finally fixed his gaze on Connor.
“Thump thump thump…”
The man walked steadily towards Connor.
When Connor saw the man walking over, his expression immediately became nervous.
He didn’t know who this man was, nor did he know why he had come this time!
“It’s actually him?”
However, at this moment, Thomas suddenly cried out in surprise. His expression was incredulous. Kyle also looked at the man and was shocked. He stuttered, “He… Why is he here?”
After Connor heard the words of these two people, he turned his head and was about to speak, but he realized that the middle-aged man had already walked in front of him..

chapters.title: Chapter 347 - 347: The Tiger Commander, Joey Shaw
chapters.content:
Chapter 347: The Tiger Commander, Joey Shaw
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Initially, everyone thought that after Hans came over, this matter would be considered over.
Even Kyle, Thomas, and the others didn’t dare to go against Hans. However, they didn’t expect someone to fly a helicopter over.
Everyone present was dumbfounded. No one knew the background of the man who had appeared at this time. Even Connor and Stephanie did not know.
Upon seeing the man in a suit, Kyle and Thomas widened their eyes in shock. This was because the two of them did not expect that the person who came at this time would actually be such a big shot!
The man who had appeared in front of them was none other than Joey Shaw, the general manager of Davenport’s Wild Tiger Special Forces, also known as the Tiger Commander!
Joey’s name was well-known in Davenport. Although not many people knew about him, that was only because people without a certain status had no way to come into contact with a big shot like Joey.
It was very rare for someone to be the chief of the Wild Tigers before he was even fifty years old! Moreover, it was said that Joey started from scratch; he did not have any family background at all and had only relied on his own hands to get to where he was today.
Of course, there were also many people who said that Joey was able to get to where he was today because he met a benefactor. However, no one knew who this benefactor was.
In any case, Joey’s status in Davenport was not something that Thomas or Kyle could compare to.
Thomas and Kyle stood rooted to the ground, staring blankly at Joey. The expressions on their faces were very nervous.
This was because both of them knew very well that although the old Chairman’s sphere of influence was very wide, it involved not only the business world but also the political world.
But even so, it was impossible for them to contend with Joey!
Therefore, Joey’s appearance at this place was obviously not to help Connor. After all, all of Connor’s connections were left behind by the old Chairman. In other words, why would someone who had no contact with the old Chairman come to help Connor now?
If Joey did not come for Connor, then there was only one possibility: he was here for Stephanie!
Just Hans alone was enough to give Thomas and Kyle a headache. If Joey was added to the mix, things might become even more troublesome.
“President Morgan, what should we do now?” Kyle asked Thomas nervously when he saw Joey walking towards Connor.
“I had a meal with Joey once, but that was many years ago. I’m not sure if he still remembers me, so I can only go up and give it a try!”
Thomas replied in a low voice. Then, he walked towards Joey and forced a smile. He shouted, “Hello there, Mr. Shaw!”
When Thomas finished speaking, everyone present was dumbfounded.
Although they did not know who Joey was, hearing Thomas address him so politely was enough to shock everyone. After all, how many people in Davenport could be called the Tiger Commander?
“Tiger…Tiger Commander?”
John’s reaction seemed to be more intense than everyone else’s. He stared at Joey with a shocked expression!
Freya hurriedly turned her head and asked after seeing John’s reaction, “Grandpa, do you know this person?”
“I don’t know this person…”
John shook his head gently and said with a trembling voice, “Although I don’t know who this person is, 1 know that there’s only one Tiger Commander in Davenport. That person’s name is Joey. Moreover, Thomas called this person Mr. Shaw just now, so I suspect that this person is very likely…”
Before John could finish his sentence, everyone present was already dumbfounded. They looked at Joey with their mouths agape, not knowing how to describe their current feelings.
Who would have thought that such a small matter today would actually attract the Tiger Commander over? And he even flew over in a helicopter!
How great of a boon was this!
Freya couldn’t help but turn her head to look at Connor, an indescribable feeling in her heart. If this Tiger Commander was here to help Connor, then just how heaven-defying was Connor’s background?!
And on the other hand, if this Tiger Commander was here to help Stephanie, then how would Connor get out of his predicament today?
Freya’s emotions were very complicated.
On the other side, after Joey saw Thomas, he looked at him indifferently and said expressionlessly, “President Morgan, you’re actually here!”
“Yes, something happened to my boss, so 1 came over to take a look!” Thomas replied with an unusually respectful attitude. Then, he smiled and asked Joey, “Mr. Shaw, why are you here today?”
“I came for him!”
Joey pointed at Connor. Without waiting for Thomas’ reply, he walked directly to Connor and asked in a low voice, “Your name is Connor McDonald, right?”
H H
Connor looked at Joey and took a deep breath. Then, he gritted his teeth and said, “That’s right, I’m Connor!”
Joey looked at Connor from head to toe and then said indifferently, “Did someone bully you just now?”
“Someone? Bully me?”
Connor was stunned when he heard this.
“Well? Did someone bully you just now?”
Joey repeated impatiently.
“It can’t be considered bullying, right?” Connor rubbed his head and said with a puzzled expression.
“I don’t care. Anyway, I just received news that a kid called Connor was bullied and asked me to come over to help. I’ll help you with whoever bullied you just now!” Joey shouted at the top of his voice.
When Connor heard this, he was instantly stunned on the spot, and so was everyone else!
They had never thought that Joey would actually come to help Connor!
Stephanie, Howard, Hans, and the others were dumbfounded. They looked at Connor in a daze. Other than shock, there was surprise in their eyes!
Stephanie felt her legs go soft, and she almost collapsed to the ground!
No one would have thought that Connor would actually be able to call a big shot like the Tiger Commander over to help!

chapters.title: Chapter 348 - 348: Someone You Shouldn’t Provoke
chapters.content:
Chapter 348: Someone You Shouldn’t Provoke
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
After Connor heard Joey’s words, the expression on his face was extremely shocked because he could not understand why Joey would come over to help him!
If Joey came to help Connor because he had some friendship with the old Chairman, then it would make sense. However, the key point now was that even Thomas Morgan, who had been with the old Chairman for so many years, did not know Joey. This meant that Joey definitely did not come to help Connor because of the old chairman!
If it wasn’t because of the old Chairman, who else could it be?
Connor really could not understand who else in this world would help him.
“Brat, did they bully you just now?”
Seeing that Connor didn’t say anything, Joey’s expression became a little impatient as he shouted at Connor.
Connor hesitated for a moment before asking Joey in a low voice, “Who asked you to come over?”
“I can’t tell you who asked me to come over because when the other party called me, he specifically instructed me not to expose his identity. So you don’t have to ask me this now. Just tell me if these people bullied you just now. If they did, I’ll help you deal with them. This way, I’ll have completed my mission…” Joey said casually.
“Ah…”
After Connor heard Joey’s words, he couldn’t help but take a deep breath. He then gritted his teeth and said in a low voice, “That’s right, these people did bully me!”
“That’s good…”
Joey smiled, then turned his head and shouted at his subordinates behind him, “Don’t just stand there. Hurry up and do it!”
“Yes, sir!”
After Joey’s subordinates heard this, they didn’t hesitate at all. They directly rushed towards the people Howard had brought.
When Hans saw this scene, he was also scared silly. He hurriedly ran up to Joey and shouted excitedly, “M-Mr. Tiger Commander, I… I’m Hans Mason from the Phillips Estate…”
After Joey heard this, he turned his head and looked at Hans indifferently. Then, he asked expressionlessly, “Hans Mason? Is there anything you need?”
“Mr. Tiger Commander, the situation is like this: Just now, we received a report from a warm-hearted citizen that a shooting incident had occurred here, so I think it’s better to leave this matter to us. There’s no need to trouble your subordinates to do anything…” Hans stammered.
“Let you handle it?” Joey could not help but laugh when he heard this. Then, he said expressionlessly, “Hans, I’m officially informing you that this matter will be taken over by the Wild Tigers. You should hurry up and get your men out of here.”
“But Mr. Tiger Commander, you…lsn’t this a little against the rules?” Hans said helplessly.
Joey pointed at Connor and shouted, “How is it against the rules? That kid is a member of my Wild Tigers. Now that someone wants to attack my subordinates, don’t 1 have the right to interfere in this matter?”
“Nonsense, Connor is just an ordinary university student. When did he become a member of your Wild Tigers? You’re clearly abusing your power now!”
After Stephanie heard Joey’s words, she shouted impulsively.
“Misuse of private rights, you say?” When Joey heard this, he could not help but sneer. Then, he said with a serious expression, “I’m the Tiger Commander of Oprana. If 1 say that this kid is a member of our Wild Tigers, then he’s a member of the Wild Tigers. Do I need to prove anything to you people? Mr. Mason, 1 order you to leave this place quickly, or you will bear the consequences!”
“But Mr. Tiger Commander, sir…Miss Lee is…” Hans seemed to want to remind Joey of something, but he was cut off before he could.
“I don’t care who she is. Even if she is the daughter of the emperor, you have to leave now. Do you understand?”
Joey shouted with his eyes wide open.
Hans stood where he was and hesitated for two seconds before saying in a low voice, “Tiger Commander, I understand what you mean. 1’11 take my men and leave now!”
Hans knew very well what Joey’s current attitude meant: he was just an insignificant figure, and Joey was the dignified Tiger Commander of Oprana. Even if he had the guts of a thousand men, he would not dare to provoke Joey!
“Hans, you…You can’t leave! If you leave, what will happen to me?”
When Stephanie saw that Hans was really planning to leave, she shouted at him desperately.
“Miss Lee, since Connor is under Mr. Shaw, then there is no problem in letting Mr. Shaw handle this matter. I have no right to care about these things now,” Hans replied to Stephanie with a helpless expression. Then, he turned his head and shouted at his subordinates behind him, “Leave the rest to the Tiger Commander’s men. Let’s go!”
After Hans finished his sentence, everyone’s mouths fell open, unable to say a word.
Because what he said just now conveyed two messages!
The first message was that the middle-aged man who appeared in front of them was not here for Stephanie, but for Connor!
The second piece of information was that the middle-aged man standing in front of them was actually a big shot at the rank of Tiger Commander!
No one had expected that such a small matter would actually escalate to this extent!
In the end, even the most famous Tiger Commander in Oprana was lured out. The people present felt that all of this was a little unreal—too unbelievable, even.
Stephanie was stunned on the spot, her eyes filled with despair. She knew that if Hans really left with his men, she would definitely die today.
Therefore, she was very unwilling to lose in such a way. She hurriedly ran to Hans’s side and shouted with an unusually excited expression, “Brother Mason, you can’t leave! If 1 fall into Connor’s hands, I will definitely die. Can you save me for my brother’s sake?”
“Miss Lee, don’t blame me for being heartless. You really provoked someone you shouldn’t have. Since the other party could call Tiger Commander over, even if your brother came, he wouldn’t be able to do anything to him!”
Hans replied helplessly. Then, he shook off Stephanie’s hand and turned around to enter the car.
A moment later, Hans drove away from the scene.
Connor narrowed his eyes and looked at Stephanie who had collapsed on the ground.. He shouted at Joey with a very casual expression, “Let’s start!”

chapters.title: Chapter 349 - 349: I’ve underestimated Connor
chapters.content:
Chapter 349: I’ve underestimated Connor
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
After Joey heard Connor’s words, he turned his head and gave a look to his subordinates behind him.
When the subordinates saw the look in Joey’s eyes, they instantly reacted and rushed into the crowd without any nonsense.
Howard’s thugs were dumbfounded. They only had one thought in their minds, and that was to escape as soon as possible. After all, they were just some ignorant hooligans—usually, they would have to take a detour when they saw the police. But this time, the person standing in front of them was not a police officer at all, but the Tiger Commander himself!
Although the Tiger Commander hadn’t brought many people, they were all elites among elites; their skills were naturally not something that ordinary people could compare to.
For a moment, miserable screams could be heard coming from the entrance of Lume.
Everyone watched Howard’s men fall one after another. Other than shock, there was also fear on their faces. At this moment, they were all secretly rejoicing in their hearts. It was a good thing that they did not provoke Connor just now, or they’d be the one being beaten up now!
Alvin and Hailey had already fainted from the shock of the scene. They were just ordinary rich heirs. When had they ever experienced such a thing?
In stark contrast to everyone else, Connor looked at everything calmly.
He knew very well that after today, everything he had might turn into nothingness.
What happened in the past two months was like a dream. In order to successfully inherit the inheritance, Connor had always been treading on thin ice, afraid that his identity would be discovered.
But now, Connor could finally do what he wanted to do.
“Phew…”
Connor took a deep breath, then said with a bitter smile, “Now that 1 think about it, everything that happened during this period of time felt like a dream. However, there will definitely be a day when I wake up.”
After Hans left with his subordinates, he hesitated for a long time before taking out his phone and dialing a phone number marked “Mr. Lee.”
“Ding, ding, ding…”
The phone rang a few times before the other party picked up the call. Then, the person asked arrogantly, “Hans, how’s the situation on your side? Did you manage to save Stephanie and the others?”
H ii
After Hans heard this, he could not help but be silent for a while. Then, he gritted his teeth and said in a low voice, “Mr. Lee, I’m really sorry. 1 couldn’t save Miss Lee…”
“What?”
When the other party heard this, he could not help but shout at the top of his voice. Then, he said with an unusually excited expression, “Is this Connor crazy? He actually still has the guts to go against you?”
“Connor did not oppose us…”
“Then what’s going on?”
Yannick asked after being stunned for a while.
“Davenport’s Tiger Commander Joey Shaw came out personally. Mr. Shaw said that Connor was one of his subordinates and that they should be in charge of today’s matter. I’m just an insignificant figure, and it’s impossible for me to go against someone like Joey, so 1 could only leave first!”
Hans explained in a low voice.
“Joey? Tiger Commander?”
After hearing this, Yannick’s face suddenly became shocked.
As the eldest son of the Lee family, Yannick had more or less heard of the Tiger Commander. Yannick himself was also one of the heirs of the old Chairman.
However, the premise was that Connor had to lose the right to inherit the inheritance—only then could he take Connor’s place in inheriting the io trillion dollar inheritance. Yannick knew the power of the old chairman very well.
He knew that there was no friendship between the old Chairman and Joey at all. Then why would Joey appear to help Connor at this time?
Yannick hesitated for a moment and then asked Hans in a low voice, “Do you know the relationship between Joey and Connor?”
“Mr. Lee, this Joey does not seem to know Connor. Joey should have come here today to help someone else…”
Hans replied softly after thinking about what had happened for a moment.
H H
Hearing this, Yannick was silent for a while and then said in a low voice, “Looks like I’ve underestimated this Connor. 1 didn’t think that he would actually be able to know someone like the Tiger Commander.”
“Mr. Lee, what do you plan to do with Miss Lee?” Hans asked in a low voice.
“Since the Tiger Commander has already made a move, then 1 don’t have any other choice now but to let her fend for herself! Besides, her mission has been completed. Tomorrow, I will personally go to Davenport. At that time, 1 will take revenge on behalf of Stephanie…”
Yannick didn’t hesitate and chose to give up on Stephanie.
After Hans heard this sentence, a strange look flashed across his eyes. He had never thought that Yannick would be so cruel to be able to give up his own sister so easily. It had to be said that this kind of personality was really incomparable to ordinary people.
On the other side, at the entrance of Lume.
It took Joey’s men about three minutes to put Howard’s men down on the ground. They lost their ability to move almost instantly.
“Isn’t this too awesome?”
“That’s right, as expected of the Tiger Commander’s men. They’re really too powerful!”
“They were all knocked out in less than three minutes. How unbelievable—It’s like a scene out of a movie!”
Everyone looked at the thugs lying on the ground and sighed in their hearts. After all, such a scene was not something that could be seen casually.
“Report, all personnel have been dealt with. Requesting further instructions!” At this moment, one of the subordinates ran in front of Joey and shouted loudly at him.
Joey turned his head and looked at Connor. He narrowed his eyes and asked, “Connor, what do you plan to do next?”
“Bring those two over!”
Connor pointed at Stephanie, who was lying on the ground, and Howard, who was on the verge of death.
Stephanie was paralyzed on the ground. Her face was pale, and her expression was filled with terror.
“Good!”
Joey didn’t waste any words and directly shot a look at his two subordinates.
The two subordinates immediately understood and walked towards Stephanie.
When Stephanie saw them walking towards her, she shouted, “You… What are you doing? Do you know who I am? Hurry up and get lost…!”
The two subordinates were not in the mood to talk nonsense with Stephanie. They reached out and grabbed Stephanie’s arm, then dragged her in front of Connor.
Connor narrowed his eyes and sized up Stephanie with a playful expression..

chapters.title: Chapter 350 - 350:I Can Go to A Hotel With You
chapters.content:
Chapter 350:I Can Go to A Hotel With You
Translator: End less Fantasy Translation Editor: EndlcssFantasy Translation
After seeing Connor’s expression, Stephanie’s face turned ashen.
At this moment, she was silting on the ground, her eyes revealing a deep despair.
How could she have thought that today s incident would actually develop to this extent?
“Connor, you should know what kind of person 1 am. If you dare to touch me today, I can guarantee that it won’t end well for you. My brother will definitely not let you off…”
Stephanie was a woman with a stunning appearance. She was sitting on the ground with her long and fair legs casually placed beside her. She looked like a concubine who had just been doted on. Her face was red and her beautiful eyes were sparkling with tears, looking like she was at the mercy of the king.
At this moment; any normal man would probably not have the heart to bully Stephanie when he saw her like this.
However, Connor looked at Stephanie without any expression and ignored her. Instead , he turned to Kyle who was not far away and said softly; “Kyle, do you still remember what 1 told you before?”
”I remember…”
Kyle nodded, then hurried over to Howard.
“Mr. Hayes, what are you doing?” Howard shouted, having finally come to his senses.
“It’s not what I want, but rather what Mr. McDonald wants!” Kyle replied calmly. Then, he took out a knife from his clothes and continued to walk towards Howard.
“M-Mr Hayes, you… What do you want? I’m warning you not to mess around you know that my power in Porthampton is not inferior to yours. If you dare to do anything to me, my subordinates will definitely not let you off!”
When Howard saw Kyle was really going to attack him, he shouted excitedly.
When Kyle heard this, he smiled helplessly and said softly, “Oh Mr. Duncan… how haven’t you understood the situation at this time?”
“U-Understand the situation?” Howard stuttered.
“The person who wanted to attack you today is not me, and the person you offended today is not me, so what’s the use in threatening me? Moreover, the Tiger Commander is here today. Do you think I’m afraid of you?” Kyle said lightly.
When Howard heard the words “Tiger Commander,” he finally reacted. He quickly crawled in front of Connor and shouted at him, “M-Mr. McDonald, I… 1 know 1 was wrong. 1 beg you, can you be magnanimous and let me go? As long as you let me go today, I promise 1 won’t come looking for trouble with you again. Please give me a chance!”
Connor narrowed his eyes and looked at Howard in front of him without saying anything.
The expressions on the faces of the others present were extremely shocked. No one had expected that today would actually be such a situation.
When Howard appeared at Lume, everyone thought that Connor was dead for sure. After all, in their eyes, offending a person like Howard was no different from offending the King of Hell.
But who would have thought that Howard would beg Connor for mercy in such a lowly manner?
“Mr. McDonald, I was also ordered by someone else to find trouble with you. I haven’t had any trouble with you before, so please be kind and let me off!”
Howard continued to beg when he saw that Connor wasn’t speaking.
Connor hesitated for a moment, then walked up to Kyle and took the knife from his hand. He threw the knife in front of Howard and said expressionlessly, “You should know what to do now, right?”
Howard looked at the knife in front of him and hesitated for a moment. Then he gritted his teeth and nodded. “Yes…”
After saying this, Howard picked up the knife from the ground with an unusually determined expression.
Then, a cold light flashed.
What followed was a scream of pain.
Howard raised his hand and swung the knife down. Without blinking, he directly cut his own finger off.
When everyone saw this scene, they were stunned on the spot. Their faces were filled with horror. No one had expected Howard to be so desperate as to cut off one of his own fingers.
Even Connor, who was standing in front of Howard, had a strange look in his eyes. He had never seen such a determined person.
“From today onwards, don’t let me see you again. If 1 do, it won’t be as simple as a finger. Do you understand?” Connor whispered to Howard.
“Un… Understood…”
Howard gritted his teeth and nodded.
Connor extended his right hand to Howard and said in a low voice, “Give me your gun!”
Howard was stunned when he heard this. He quickly took out his gun and handed it to Connor.
After Connor took the gun, he turned around and walked in front of Stephanie.
When Stephanie saw Connor walking over, she stood up, wanting to flee, but rhe subordinates brought by Joey did not give her any chance at all as they directly pressed Stephanie to the ground.
“Thump thump thump…”
Connor walked up to Stephanie and aimed his gun at her head.
“Connor, I’m Yannick’s younger sister, and my father is Horace Lee. If you dare attack me today, 1 will make you regret it for the rest of your life.”
Stephanie seemed to have gone crazy as she shouted at him with an unusually feral expression.
After Connor heard Stephanie’s words, he smiled disdainfully and said, “Anyway, you just said that from now on, I’ve lost the right to inherit the inheritance, and I’ll have nothing. Do you think a person who has nothing will still care about your Lee family’s revenge?”
II II
When Stephanie heard this, she could not help but be stunned for a moment. Then, she said with a trembling voice, “Connor, as long as you let me go now, I guarantee that our Lee family will never find trouble with you again. You can be an ordinary person again…”
“Become an ordinary person again?”
Connor sneered, then gritted his teeth and shouted, “Even if your Lee family gives me this chance, will the people 1 offended before give me this chance? Would Howard give me a chance? Would my enemies give me a chance? Do you think I, Connor, still have a way to go back? You destroyed everything for me, so I’m going to destroy you!”
As Stephanie spoke, she lifted her beautiful legs and said to Connor with an extremely seductive expression, “Connor, as long as you can let me go today, 1 will do anything you want! I can go to a hotel with you. I know you hate me now, but 1 can use my body to make it up to you.”
She knew that there was no point in threatening Connor now, so she could only use other methods to beg for forgiveness..

chapters.title: Chapter 351 - 351: Leaving A Way Out
chapters.content:
Chapter 351: Leaving A Way Out
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Stephanie was charming and attractive, to begin with. Today, she was wearing a low-cut spaghetti strap short skirt. She was tall and sexy.
Iler fair legs under the short skirt were exposed. She was also wearing a pair of high-heeled sandals. Iler breasts looked like they were about to spill over the top of her shirt. Although her pretty face was slightly nervous, she was still very sexy and charming. She was not inferior to the two beautiful women, Freya and Hailey.
Moreover, Stephanie might be a little older than Freya, so she looked more mature and charming.
If Stephanie took the initiative to throw herself into a man’s arms, any normal man would probably not reject her.
Therefore, when Stephanie said she would use her body for compensation, she looked at Connor smugly.
But unfortunately, Connor’s expression stayed calm.
This was because Connor was not moved by Stephanie’s words at all. On the contrary, he pressed the gun’s muzzle even closer to Stephanie’s head as if he would pull the trigger at any time.
“Conn… Connor, no…”
After Stephanie saw the murderous intent in Connor’s eyes, she hurriedly shook her head at Connor.
However, Connor did not pay any attention to her. At this moment, he only had one thought in his mind, and that was to kill Stephanie.
“Connor!” However, just as Connor was about to pull the trigger, Freya suddenly stepped forward and shouted.
Connor was stunned when he heard Freya. He then turned and looked at Freya indifferently.
“Connor, stop it. If you kill Stephanie now, you might not be turning back. Although I don’t know who you are and what kind of inheritance you want to get, if you shoot in front of so many people, even if you have Tiger Commander to protect you, you will not be able to escape the punishment of the law,” Freya walked up to Connor and shouted excitedly.
“That’s right, Connor. If you shoot her, your life will be ruined. You have to think carefully!” Maya hesitated before shouting out as well.
Although the two still did not know what was happening today, they knew that the consequences would be unimaginable if Connor shot Stephanie!
Meanwhile, Connor turned to look at Freya with a hint of hesitation in his eyes.
With so many people present, it was useless to persuade Connor no matter who it was other than Freya.
But at this moment, Freya had to step forward!
“Connor, I would suggest you think it through. If you dare to attack me now, the Lee Family will fight you to the death. Even if you’re not worried about the Lee Family’s revenge, aren’t you worried about your fiancee and your own family? Could you bear to see them all get implicated by you?
Stephanie was very smart. When she saw Connor start to hesitate, she hurriedly spoke to Connor.
When Connor heard this, he was stunned again. He calmed down a little.
After Stephanie saw that it was effective, she continued to persuade him, “Connor, as long as you let me go now, I can guarantee you that even if you lose the qualification to inherit the inheritance, the Lee Family will never find trouble with you or your fiancee. However, if you still refuse to come to your senses, then I can guarantee you that everyone around you will be done for!”
When Connor heard Stephanie’s words, he stepped forward and asked Stephanie calmly, “Are you threatening me now?”
“Connor, I’m not threatening you. I’m just telling you the truth. You should know why I’m here today. I want you to lose the right to inherit. Once you lose the right to inherit the inheritance, you won’t be a threat to the Lee Family anymore. Naturally, the Lee Family won’t have trouble with you anymore. However, if you kill me now, the nature of the matter will be very different. Moreover, it will implicate many unrelated people. Do you understand what I mean?” Stephanie widened her eyes and said nervously.
“Yes, Connor, I beg you, stop!” Freya also advised Connor.
However, Freya was not worried about her safety. She was worried that if Connor killed Stephanie, it would likely bring him fatal trouble.
“Phew…”
Connor stood still and took a deep breath. Then, he looked at Joey in a low voice, “Mr. Shaw, can I ask you to do something for me?”
“Go ahead. As long as it’s within my ability, I’ll do my best to help you!” Joey replied expressionlessly.
“I want you to take this woman away and arrange for her to stay in a hotel. If 1 need anything, I’ll contact you!” Connor said lightly.
Connor knew that what Stephanie said just now was not a joke. If he really attacked her now, it would likely attract the crazy revenge of the Lee Family.
However, if Connor let Stephanie leave just like that, he could not guarantee that Stephanie and the Lee Family would really let him and the Phillips Family off.
Moreover, tomorrow, Connor would no longer have the help of Thomas and Kyle. Connor could not resist the Le Family, so Connor had to leave a way out for himself.
He felt that as long as he still controlled Stephanie, the Lee Family would not dare to mess around.
After Joey heard Connor’s order, he hesitated, then walked to Connor and whispered, “I can help you to take this woman away, but I can’t lock her up for too long. Half a month would be the limit. If you think it’s okay, 1 can take her away now!”
“Alright, thank you!” Connor thanked Joey very seriously.
“I’m just helping someone else. You don’t have to thank me!” Joey looked at Connor with a faint smile, then asked his subordinates to bring Stephanie onto the helicopter.
Stephanie was quite satisfied with this outcome. After all, as long as she did not die in Connor’s hands, there was still hope.
Connor turned to look at Joey and asked softly, “Mr. Shaw, who asked you to help me today?”
Connor was curious about this. After all, Joey wasn’t working for Thomas and Kyle.
And Connor himself was just a poor student, so why did Joey, the Tiger Commander, personally come over to help him?
Connor could not understand just what kind of person had such influence and power to be able to order the Tiger Commander around!

chapters.title: Chapter 352 - 352: Who Are You?
chapters.content:
Chapter 352: Who Are You?
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
After Joey heard Connor’s question, he couldn’t help but laugh. He then asked Connor, “You really want to know, right?”
“Yes!” Connor hurriedly nodded.
“I can’t tell you who sent me here yet, but I feel that sooner or later, that person will tell you personally!” Joey replied with a smile. Then, without giving Connor any time to react, he walked directly toward the helicopter.
Stephanie had already been taken to the helicopter, and Howard had already run away. At this time, only the hooligans who had been knocked to the ground were crying in pain at the entrance of Lume.
Naturally, no one cared about them.
A few minutes later, Joey boarded the plane.
With a roar, the helicopter slowly took off and disappeared from everyone’s sight.
Everyone’s eyes widened as they looked at the sky. Other than shock, there was envy on their faces. After all, who wouldn’t envy such a cool way of traveling?
However, they also knew that the gap between them and Joey and Connor was too big. Perhaps they would never be able to live such a life in this lifetime.
As the helicopter gradually disappeared into the sky, today’s drama ended.
In everyone’s eyes, Connor might be the final winner. After all, he had been in the limelight in front of many people.
But in fact, they didn’t know that Connor was the one who lost. The things that Connor lost were simply what these people couldn’t imagine.
“Mr. McDonald…” At this moment, Thomas walked to Connor’s side and said his name expressionlessly.
Connor turned to look at Thomas and said softly,”I’ve already lost the right to inherit. You don’t have to call me Mr. McDonald anymore…”
“Whether you are qualified to inherit is not up to me. The former chairman has a very professional team of lawyers around him.
