Connor wasn’t very interested in Mr. Lee’s other businesses; after all, he himself wasn’t cut out for business. However, if Connor could become the boss of this big consortium, he would still be very happy. Rockefeller controlled companies like Penguin and Alibaba that Connor could come into contact with in his daily life.
Connor felt excited just thinking about becoming a major shareholder of Penguin Corporation!
“Rockefeller Financial Group has nothing to do with you now!”
However, Thomas’s words were like a bucket of cold water that was poured directly on Connor’s head, extinguishing all the fantasies in his heart.
“No, didn’t you just say that the Rockefeller consortium was established by Mr. Lee? Since it was established by Mr. Lee, and I am his successor, how can Rockefeller have nothing to do with me?” Connor asked Thomas helplessly.
“Rockefeller was established by the old Chairman, but that was decades ago. Now, Rockefeller has nothing to do with our company!” Thomas said slowly.
When Connor heard this, he was extremely speechless. He frowned and said, “Since this Rockefeller has nothing to do with us, why are you telling me so much?”
“Mr. McDonald, don’t be so hasty. Let me finish first!” Thomas replied calmly.
Connor raised his head and glanced at Thomas, then pursed his lips and said, “Alright, go ahead!”
“Rockefeller was indeed founded by the old Chairman, and it was also he who brought Rockefeller from an unknown small investment company to one of the top investment companies in the world today. It can be said that a large part of the credit for Rockefeller’s achievements today is due to Mr. Lee!”
“And then?”
“But then, a traitor appeared in Rockefeller. In order to take Rockefeller away from the old Chairman, they did not hesitate to install a time bomb on the chairman’s private plane.. Fortunately, the bodyguards on the plane discovered it in time, and the old chairman survived!”

chapters.title: Chapter 390 - 390: Take Rockefeller Back!
chapters.content:
Chapter 390: Take Rockefeller Back!
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Connor looked at Thomas in front of him and felt that what Thomas had told him was too shocking.
“I didn’t expect the old Chairman to experience such a dangerous thing. The people in Rockefeller are too sinister!” Connor exclaimed.
“Fortunately, the old director was lucky and didn’t let those evildoers succeed!” Thomas said angrily.
Back then, Steven’s own men had installed a time bomb on Steven’s plane in order to take Rockefeller away from him, forcing Steven to choose to jump off the plane.
Although Steven’s private plane had a parachute at that time, Steven was not a professional parachutist himself, so he was seriously injured when he landed. In addition, after Rockefeller’s people knew that Steven was not dead, they specially hired assassins to assassinate Steven. As a result, Steven could not return to Rockefeller’s headquarters at that time and could only temporarily hide in the country.
At that time, Steven didn’t know who had betrayed him, so he couldn’t contact any of his subordinates. He was living abroad and had no friends in the country. In addition, he was seriously injured and couldn’t find a job, so he could only choose to beg for a living.
At this time, Freya happened to meet Steven, who was on the verge of death, in Porthampton. She used her pocket money to buy a plane ticket for him.
That was why Steven had left Connor with such a will, telling him that he had to marry Freya.
Connor hesitated for a moment and could not help but say, “However, I still don’t understand what he wants me to do…”
“After the old Chairman returned to Rockefeller, he found that Rockefeller had long been taken over by his subordinates. At that time, the old chairman could be said to be penniless, and all the executives loyal to him had been fired, so Rockefeller was no longer his. Steven was not qualified to fight with those people in Rockefeller, so he could only compromise. He used all his shares in Rockefeller in exchange for a chance to live!”
Thomas paused for a moment and then continued, “In the end, the people in Rockefeller also agreed to the old Chairman’s request. They got the shares, and the old chairman chose to leave Risu and come to Eigona alone!”
“After coming to Eigona, the old Chairman made a comeback with the help of his friends. It was then that 1 met him and worked as his secretary for fifteen years!”
“I didn’t expect Steven Lee’s life to be so terrifying…”
Connor sighed softly.
“Yes, when he was young, he was ostracized by the Lee family, so he went to Risu alone to establish Rockefeller. However, I didn’t expect that more than ten years later, Rockefeller would be taken away just like that. Later, the old chairman escaped to Eigona and re-established a business empire comparable to Rockefeller!” Thomas said slowly.
“Is Rockefeller more powerful now, or is the Empire World Corporation that I inherited more powerful?” Connor asked Thomas curiously.
When Connor had gotten the inheritance, Thomas had told him that Steven was the richest man in the world. But now that Connor had heard the full story, he felt that Steven wasn’t as rich as the people of the Rockefeller consortium!
“Of course, Rockefeller is even more powerful!” Thomas answered directly.
“Since Rockefeller is more powerful, why did you say that Steven was the richest man in the world?” Connor asked.
“It’s true that the old Chairman is the richest man in the world, but this is only because he has more physical industries in his hands. Rockefeller controls the shares of various large companies and groups. These shares can’t be counted as personal assets, but the companies in Rockefeller’s hands are basically all over the world, and they are all top companies!”
“The old Chairman’s company, which is now yours, has been inherited by the Empire World Corporation. Its main industries are distributed in Eigona and Oprana, and it has basically not been involved with other countries. Therefore, whether it is in terms of capital or influence, the Empire World Corporation is definitely not as good as Rockefeller!” Thomas replied.
“To put it bluntly, even if I inherit Steven’s inheritance, I still can’t compare to Rockefeller, right?” Connor asked.
“You can also understand it that way!”
Thomas nodded lightly.
“Then who is the real boss of Rockefeller now?”
Connor asked curiously.
“The original boss of Rockefeller was Mr. Steven Lee, but after he left, Rockefeller no longer had a real boss and was instead jointly managed by three people. These three people were the old chairman’s former subordinates, and now they are the three bosses of Rockefeller!”
Thomas paused for a moment and then continued, “This is also the reason why the old Chairman is still the richest man in the world even though Rockefeller is much bigger than our company.”
“That means that the three of them are in control of the consortium, right?” Connor asked softly.
“Yes, the hierarchy of Rockefeller is very clear. It is distributed in the shape of a pyramid. The top three people are the three bosses, and there are nine people below the three. Generally, the employees of Rockefeller like to call these nine people the Big Nine, and there are other people under them, too. These people form a very large network, controlling Rockefeller and the core enterprises in Rockefeller’s hands!” Thomas patiently explained to Connor.
“The Big Nine?”
Connor couldn’t help but shake his head and smile. He felt that what Thomas said was like a joke. It didn’t seem real at all. However, he knew that Thomas would not joke with him like this.
“That’s right, you can also understand that these twelve people are the true masters of Rockefeller!” Thomas nodded lightly.
“Forget it. Rockefeller isn’t mine anyway. You’ve been talking to me for so long, but 1 still don’t understand what you’re trying to say to me!” Connor frowned, not in the mood to discuss these things with Thomas now.
“What 1 want to tell you is actually very simple: I hope that you can snatch Rockefeller back from these people!” Thomas didn’t waste any more words with Connor and went straight to the point.
“Get Rockefeller back?”
Connor looked at Thomas with deep shock in his eyes. He felt that all of this was too unbelievable.
He widened his eyes and continued, “Bro, are you joking with me? Even the old Chairman couldn’t get Rockefeller back, so how could I?”

chapters.title: Chapter 391 - 391: What Did You Say?
chapters.content:
Chapter 391: What Did You Say?
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Connor had never thought that Thomas would want him to snatch Rockefeller back!
In Connor’s eyes, this was simply a fantasy. Although Connor had inherited the former chairman’s inheritance, he couldn’t take back Rockefeller.
This was because he also knew that it was not something that could be done with money. Otherwise, Steven would have snatched Rockefeller back a long time ago!
Moreover, Steven had almost died at the hands of Rockefeller and the others. Now that Connor was going to deal with Rockefeller and the others, wasn’t it obvious that Connor was going to die too?
If he didn’t inherit the former chairman’s inheritance, Connor would be a loser who delivered food. Not to mention taking back Rockefeller, even if Connor managed the current company, Connor would find it difficult because he didn’t have any experience.
“Mr. McDonald, the late Mr. Lee’s greatest effort in his life was Rockefeller. He had been planning how to get Rockefeller back when he was alive, but before his plan could be implemented, he, unfortunately, passed away. Therefore, I think that regaining Rockefeller is the last wish of the former chairman. As his heir, you are responsible and obligated to complete this last will!” Thomas said sincerely to Connor.
“But there’s no such clause in the contract, okay?” Connor said helplessly to Thomas.
“There is indeed no such rule in the contract, but Mr. McDonald, don’t forget that the former chairman left you such a large amount of property. His greatest wish when he was alive was to take back Rockefeller,” Thomas said.
Connor hesitated then said, “Bro, can you stop fooling me? I just want to inherit this inheritance properly. Why do you cause so much trouble for me?”
“Mr. McDonald, what you want to inherit is not an ordinary inheritance, but the inheritance of the richest man in the world!” Thomas reminded him softly.
“Even if I inherit the inheritance of the richest man in the world, you can’t make me do such a dangerous thing, right?” Connor spoke frustratedly and continued, “First of all, you just told me how Rockefeller and the others dealt with Steven. They installed a time bomb on the plane. These people kill without conscience. If I were to snatch Rockefeller from them, they might kill me, too! It wasn’t easy for me to inherit the inheritance. 1 still want to enjoy life. Can you not send me to my grave?”
“Mr. McDonald, you don’t have to worry about this. We will protect your safety!” Thomas quickly said.
“How are you going to protect me? With the three bodyguards you found for me? Can they deal with Rockefeller’s people?” Connor pursed his lips and asked.
“They should be fine. If you don’t think it’s enough, I can help you find a few more!”
“There’s no need. The three of them are enough!” Connor shook his head and refused. He was worried that if Thomas found a few more bodyguards, he might be annoyed.
“Alright, even if you can protect me, tell me, how can I get Rockefeller back? I’m just an ordinary university student. I don’t know anything except for money.” Connor looked at Thomas and continued to ask.
“Mr. McDonald, you don’t have to worry about this. Because taking back Rockefeller isn’t something that can be done in a day or two, so we’re not in a hurry. You can learn how to manage our company first. When you start managing our company, we can discuss how to take back Rockefeller. What do you think?” Thomas said slowly.
“Forget it. I’m not interested in managing a company!” Connor waved his hand at Thomas and refused again.
“Don’t you want the former chairman to die in peace?” Seeing Connor’s attitude, he asked Connor emotionally.
“Of course, I want him to rest peacefully, but his last wish is so dangerous! If it’s something 1 can do, I’ll help, but it’s not that simple to take back Rockefeller. 1 don’t even know what Rockefeller does. Tell me, how can I take it back? Do you think 1 can get Rockefeller back if I agree to it now?” Connor shot back at Thomas.
“Mr. McDonald, I’ve already said that as long as you’re willing, 1 can help you grow quickly. You will be able to take back Rockefeller in the future. This is also why 1 chose to help you inherit the inheritance instead of Yannick. I know that if Yannick inherited this inheritance, he would not agree to deal with those people in Rockefeller. But Mr. McDonald, you might be different…” Thomas looked at Connor and said in a solemn tone.
“I’m sorry, I have the same attitude as Yannick on this. I don’t want to provoke those people of Rockefeller because I know I’m not their opponent. I just want to live well…” Connor waved at Thomas and got up to leave.
“Mr. McDonald, are you really not planning to take Rockefeller back?” Thomas shouted after Connor as he left.
“I’ve inherited enough inheritance now. I don’t have that much ambition. I don’t understand why you have to go against Rockefeller. Isn’t everything just fine as they are now?” Connor asked helplessly.
“Mr. McDonald, your enemy is not only Yannick but also Rockefeller’s men. Even if you don’t attack them, they will attack you!”
“If they want to make a move, let’s wait for them to make a move first. In any case, I will not take the initiative to provoke them. Moreover, I am not interested in what you have said…” Connor looked at Thomas and said.
“But…” Thomas tried to speak.
“There are no buts. I can’t deal with Rockefeller!”
After saying this, Connor turned around and walked out of the office.
“Mr. McDonald, if I say that a certain executive in Rockefeller is related to the death of your parents, will you change your mind?”
However, just as Connor was about to leave Thomas’ office, Thomas suddenly dropped a truth bomb on him.
When Connor heard Thomas’ words, he couldn’t help but be stunned momentarily.. His right foot, which was already out the door, moved back into the room as he turned to look at Thomas and asked, “What did you just say?”

chapters.title: Chapter 392 - 392: The Cause Of His Parents’ Death
chapters.content:
Chapter 392: The Cause Of His Parents’ Death
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Connor never dreamed that his parents’ deaths would be related to Rockefeller.
Therefore, when he heard Thomas’s words, even the usually calm him could not remain calm.
He stopped in his tracks and turned to stare at Thomas.
In fact, Connor had always had a lot of doubts about his parents’ deaths because their deaths were too strange. Moreover, they died in a traffic accident!
It could be said that the death of Connor’s parents changed Connor’s life.
Connor had always wanted to know how his parents died back then. Why did no one in the McDonald Family take the initiative to mention this to him after his parents died?
Originally, Connor’s family was quite wealthy. Although Connor’s family couldn’t be compared with those prominent families, it was still doing very well compared to ordinary people.
Moreover, Connor’s parents were in charge of the McDonald Family back then. Basically, most of the McDonald Family’s businesses were managed by Connor’s parents. When Connor’s parents were alive, their attitude toward the McDonald Family was never very good.
This was because they could not stand how the McDonald Family handled things. It was just that everyone did not dare to show it because of Connor’s father.
When those McDonald Family members found out that Connor’s parents had passed away, they all scrambled to divide the inheritance of Connor’s parents. Naturally, Connor became a thorn in their eyes. In the end, Connor had no choice but to leave the McDonald Family and live on his own.
At that time, Connor also suspected that the death of his parents had something to do with the McDonald Family. However, Connor was only twelve years old then, and his survival was a problem. Naturally, he had no way to investigate the cause of his parents’ death.
It wasn’t until Connor inherited the inheritance that he asked Kyle to investigate the cause of his parents’ death!
“What did you mean by that?” Connor’s eyes widened as he strode toward Thomas and asked agitatedly.
“Mr. McDonald, you don’t have to be so agitated…” Thomas replied indifferently.
“Don’t keep me in suspense. Let me ask you, what exactly happened? Why did you say that my parents’ deaths had something to do with Rockefeller?”
Connor might not be so worked up about other things, but he could not remain calm.
“Mr. McDonald, your father’s name is Dawson McDonald, and your mother’s name is Sharon Lee, right?” Thomas asked Connor softly.
“Yes!”
Connor had not heard anyone mention his parents’ names for a long time, so he felt they were a little unfamiliar at this moment.
“According to the information I have now, the death of your parents is very likely related to the people of Rockefeller!” Thomas replied, then looked at Connor and continued, “But I haven’t found out how your parents died and whether it was Rockefeller’s people who killed your parents…”
“Since you didn’t investigate, why did you say that my parents’ death has something to do with Rockefeller? Are you planning to use this to get me to help you get Rockefeller back?” Connor gritted his teeth and said coldly.
The death of Connor’s parents had always been a sore spot in his heart. He absolutely could not tolerate Thomas using this to trap him.
“Mr. McDonald, you’re my boss now. How could I lie to you?” Thomas hurriedly explained, then continued, “I’ve also told you about Rockefeller. Rockefeller is now mainly controlled by three elders. These three people can be said to be the true controllers of Rockefeller, and under the three elders are the Nine Heavenly Kings…”
“I’m not in the mood to listen to your nonsense. I’m asking you, what does my parents’ death have to do with Rockefeller? Please answer my question!” Connor widened his eyes and interrupted Thomas, impatient.
“Mr. McDonald, please listen to me first. Then you will know what Rockefeller has to do with your parents’ death!” Thomas said lightly.
“Phew…”
Connor took a deep breath, gritted his teeth and said, “Alright, go ahead!”
“Rockefeller’s business is mainly distributed in Asia, Europe, and North America. Each continent has the highest-level person in charge, namely the three elders of Rockefeller. In addition to these three elders, three deputy persons are in charge, namely the Big Nine. Below the Big Nine are managers distributed in various cities in various countries. For example, Yarlford, York, and Memphis all have persons in charge on this level. Because too many people are in charge at this level, there is no way to count them!” Thomas looked at Connor patiently.
“So?” Connor looked at Thomas and asked.
“When you asked Kyle to investigate the cause of your parents’ death, he found out that your father’s last phone call before he died was to Warren Schroder, the person in charge of the Rockefeller’s Yarlford branch!” Thomas explained directly.
“Warren Schroder?”
Connor was stunned when he heard this name because it sounded familiar.
“In addition to calling Warren before his death, your father had also had such a call with Warren many times before this. Therefore, if you really want to investigate the cause of your parents’ death, you have to find Warren. As the person in charge of Rockefeller in Yarlford, Warren rarely publicly shows his face. It is challenging for ordinary people to see him, but your father can have a close relationship with Warren. So your father must have some relationship with Rockefeller. Otherwise, your father would never be able to contact Warren!” Thomas looked at Connor and said with a somber expression.
“Can you contact Warren now? Can you find Warren and ask him about my father?” Connor asked Thomas excitedly.
“Mr. McDonald, you think too simply of Rockefeller. Let alone Warren, I can’t even find someone in charge who are several levels lower than him. This is because the people in charge of Rockefeller have never taken the initiative to reveal their identities. On the surface, they may be the bosses of a small company, but behind their backs, they control all of Rockefeller’s businesses in this city!” Thomas said with a smile.
“But how did you know about Warren?” Connor frowned and asked.
“Because Warren retired five years ago, and now the person who has taken over Warren’s position is his daughter, Birdie Schroder. But because no one knows what Birdie looks like, it’s harder than going to the heavens to find Warren and Birdie!” Thomas said slowly.
Connor was shocked.
He had never thought the clue he had finally found about his parents’ death would be cut off just like that..

chapters.title: Chapter 393 - 393: A Difficult Choice
chapters.content:
Chapter 393: A Difficult Choice
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
In the office.
Seeing the disappointed expression on Connor’s face, Thomas felt a little guilty. He stepped forward and said softly, “Mr. McDonald, Rockefeller is the largest financial group in the world, after all. Their confidentiality work is still very complete. Ordinary people have no way to obtain their internal information. Once Rockefeller’s internal information is leaked, it is forecasted that the world will have an economic crisis. By then, the people will be displaced. The United Nations will not allow such a financial group to exist. After all, so many leading enterprises are controlled by a financial group. It’s equivalent to controlling the world’s commercial lifeline. When the time comes, the United Nations will take action…”
“I don’t care about Rockefeller at all. 1 only care about what Rockefeller has to do with my parents’ death!” Connor gritted his teeth and growled.
“Mr. McDonald, if you really want to know the true cause of your parents’ death, then there is only one way: to get Rockefeller back. That way, you can find Warren and Birdie and ask them what happened back then!” Thomas looked at Connor and said.
“Apart from this, is there no other way?” Connor took a deep breath and slowly said.
“No…” Thomas shook his head gently and continued, “We have no way to get in touch with Warren and Birdie now. Even with my connections, 1 can’t do it. But if we get Rockefeller back, then Rockefeller will be yours, Mr. McDonald. It will be a piece of cake to find Warren and Birdie…”
“…” Connor looked at Thomas with complicated feelings.
At this moment, he finally understood why Thomas risked his life to help him today. It was because Thomas knew he would choose to go with him to deal with Rockefeller.
The death of Connor’s parents had a lot to do with Rockefeller!
“Alright, I agree to get Rockefeller back with you, but how do you plan to get it back?” Connor whispered to Thomas.
“Mr. McDonald, now is not the time for us to reclaim it. I still have a lot of preparations to do. Moreover, I can only control a small portion of the former chairman’s business in the country. There are still many resources left behind by the former chairman that we can’t control!” Thomas said softly.
“What do you mean? What do you mean there’s no way to control it?” Connor frowned and asked.
He was completely confused by Thomas because he had never encountered such a complicated matter.
“Mr. McDonald, although our company is not as large as Rockefeller, our businesses are all over the world. There are many regional leaders. I’m only the person in charge of the Porthampton region. I can’t control all the businesses left behind by the former chairman. There are many regional leaders like me, so the only person who can control this business empire is you, Mr. McDonald. After all, you’re the real heir!”
“No wonder you want me to take Rockefeller back…” Connor looked at Thomas and smiled helplessly.
“That’s right. If we want to take back Rockefeller, we must control all the company’s resources first. In this way, we might still have a glimmer of hope.” Thomas smiled faintly.
“How can I control the people in charge of the other areas?” Connor asked Thomas softly.
“It’s very simple. As long as you marry Ms. Phillips and get her to marry you sincerely, you will have fulfilled the will left behind by the former chairman. Only then can you successfully inherit the entire inheritance. After you truly inherit the entire inheritance, I will gather all the regional managers and announce your identity. By then, you will be the real chairman of the company!”
Thomas paused and continued, “After I announce your identity, you still need to make these people acknowledge your identity as the chairman from the bottom of their hearts. This may be the most difficult step but also the most critical one. After all, only when these people truly acknowledge you will they obey you. Only then can you successfully take over all the former chairman’s inheritance!”
“Why is it so troublesome? I’ve already inherited the inheritance. Why do I need their approval?” When Connor heard this, he shook his head, frustrated. He did not expect that inheriting the inheritance would be so troublesome.
“When the former chairman was still alive, there were also many people the former chairman did not convince. There’s no other way. There are too many people in our company. No one can make everyone acknowledge you and obey you!” Thomas said with a smile.
Connor looked at Thomas and didn’t say anything. He was very conflicted now because he knew that although what Thomas said sounded very simple, it was easier said than done.
“Of course, Mr. McDonald, you don’t have to complete these things. You can choose not to agree with me. In this case, you don’t have to get the approval of the people in charge. You don’t even need to become the chairman of the company. Anyway, the assets left by the former chairman are enough for you to enjoy the rest of your life, so what you do next is entirely up to you!
“However, if you want to control the company left behind by the former chairman completely, I will do my best to help you. But, if you think these are unnecessary for you, it doesn’t matter. You can also choose to give up!” Thomas looked at Connor seriously.
“I…” Connor opened his mouth to speak.
“Mr. McDonald, you don’t have to give me an answer now. Please feel free to think about it when you go back and give me an answer. After all, everyone has their train of thought. If you want to investigate the cause of your parents’ death, I will do my best to help you investigate. I don’t want you to agree with me because of this. I need you to do it from the bottom of your heart. After all, only if you want to do it can you do it well!” Thomas interrupted Connor.
Connor looked at Thomas without saying anything.
“But no matter what, the most important thing for you now is to coax Ms. Phillips first. Only after you and Ms. Phillips get married can we plan our next steps!” Thomas smiled and said to Connor.
“Sigh…” Connor looked at Thomas and sighed helplessly. He had a headache whenever he thought about Freya!
He didn’t know how to coax Freya!

chapters.title: Chapter 394 - 394: Make Stephanie Yours!
chapters.content:
Chapter 394: Make Stephanie Yours!
Translator: End less Fantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
“Mr. McDonald, it doesn’t have to be so difficult. In the end, it’s still up to you to decide. Whether you agree or not, I will support you!” Thomas couldn’t help but say to Connor after seeing him in a dilemma.
“If I can marry Freya, what do you think the chances of me controlling the entire company are?” Connor hesitated and asked Thomas.
“Uhm…” Thomas’s eyes flashed with hesitation. He did not know how to answer Connor’s question.
“You don’t have to hold back. Just tell me the truth…” Connor looked at Thomas and said.
“According to your current situation, the probability could be less than ten percent!” Thomas said helplessly.
“Less than ten percent?” Connor smiled bitterly, but he knew his capabilities. If it weren’t for Thomas’s help today, he might not even be able to keep his position as the heir, let alone control the entire company.
Moreover, the people in charge of the company were all at Thomas’ level. If he wanted these cunning old foxes to approve of Connor, the probability of ten percent was not low.
“Mr. McDonald, you don’t have to worry about the probability. As long as you want to do this, you will succeed!” Thomas comforted Connor softly.
“I understand what you mean!” Connor nodded gently and got up to leave. He felt that his thoughts were in a mess. He didn’t know what to do.
“By the way, Mr. McDonald, what is your relationship with Joey Shaw?” Seeing that Connor was about to leave, Thomas quickly asked.
“I don’t know this Joey. 1 also don’t know why he wants to help me…” Connor replied indifferently.
“Joey is the Tiger Commander of Oprana. His power is not something that ordinary people can compare to. Mr. McDonald, if you can use your relationship with Joey, 1 think it will greatly help you control the company…” Thomas said slowly.
“I’ll try to get in touch with him in the future, but 1 don’t think he’ll interact much with me!” Connor said in a low voice.
“Right, how do you plan to deal with Stephanie?” Thomas asked.
“Stephanie?”
When Connor heard this name, he was stunned, and a strange look flashed in his eyes.
Back then, Connor had left Stephanie behind to ensure his safety in the future. However, now that Connor had regained his identity as the heir, Stephanie was naturally useless to him!
“I’ll call Joey tomorrow and ask him to let her go. Stephanie is no longer useful to me!” Connor replied.
“Mr. McDonald, I don’t think you can let Stephanie go just like that…” Thomas thought for a moment and said.
“Why not? Besides, she’s a woman. Moreover, 1 don’t have any deep hatred for her, so I don’t want to be calculative with her…” Connor said.
“I don’t want you to do anything to her, but I’ve investigated the situation of the Lee Family. Stephanie is a very important character to Yannick. Moreover, she’s Yannick’s half-sister. If we can turn Stephanie into our people, it will certainly be very helpful for us to understand the situation of the Lee Family. Although Yannick failed this time, based on my understanding of Yannick, he will not let it go!” Thomas looked at Connor with a grave expression.
“Turn Stephanie into one of us?”
After Connor heard this, he was puzzled. Then, he shook his head and said, “I don’t think Stephanie is that easy to bribe. Why should she side with us?” “That’s right. We won’t be able to bribe Stephanie if we use normal methods. After all, Stephanie is related to the Lee Family by blood. However, if we use other methods, things might be different…” Thomas said with a smile.
Connor saw the strange smile on Thomas’s face and asked curiously, “What other method?”
“Mr. McDonald, if Stephanie becomes yours and bears your child for you, things might be different!” Thomas said with a smile.
“Make Stephanie mome?”
When Connor heard this, he could not help but gape. He was extremely shocked. Stephanie’s seductive face and sexy figure appeared in his mind.
Among the many women Connor knew, Stephanie was considered the best regarding both figure and appearance. However, this woman had a shortcoming, and that was that her personality was not very good. She was a little vicious. However, if he could conquer such a thorny rose, it would be very fulfilling!
However, Connor was not in the mood to have anything to do with Stephanie. All he could think about was how to resolve the matter with Freya.
“Mr. McDonald, if you can make Stephanie yours and make her give you a child, that means you have a relationship with her. She will not do anything to betray you!” Thomas looked at Connor and said.
“You old fool, what are you thinking?” Connor cursed helplessly, then continued, “Ask Stephanie to bear you a child. That way, Stephanie will listen to you and naturally not betray me!”
“Uhm…”
When Thomas heard this, he was stunned. Then, he said awkwardly, “Mr. McDonald, quit joking. I’m already so old. I’m not interested in women anymore!”
“How do you know I’m interested in Stephanie? Also, didn’t the contract say 1 must marry Freya?” Connor frowned and said.
“The contract does say that you have to marry Freya, but this has nothing to do with making Stephanie yours. It’s fine as long as Ms. Phillips doesn’t know about this!” Thomas replied lightly, then took a step forward and said with a serious expression, “Mr. McDonald, Stephanie is a famous beauty in York. Are you not interested in her at all?”
When Connor heard Thomas’s words, he could not help but be stunned.
He had never thought that Thomas would come up with such a way to get Stephanie to come over to their side. Connor himself admitted that if he could have sex with a beautiful woman like Stephanie, it would indeed satisfy a man’s desire to conquer her.
However, the problem was that Connor had no feelings for Stephanie. He also did not want to have any relationship with a woman like Stephanie..

chapters.title: Chapter 395 - 395: Thomas1 Plan
chapters.content:
Chapter 395 - 395: Thomas1 Plan
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
“Mr. McDonald…”
Thomas saw that Connor did not speak for a long time, so he could not help but say his name.
“You don’t have to persuade me. I’m not interested in Stephanie. I only have Freya in my heart now!” Connor interrupted Thomas and continued, “Moreover, I think that even if Stephanie bears my child, she won’t easily yield to me. If I do that, she might hate me even more. If she stabs me behind my back, I might not know how I died!”
“Mr. McDonald, those who achieve great things do not care about trifles!” Seeing that Connor rejected his idea directly, he continued, “I admit that even if Stephanie bears your child, she might not necessarily be on our side. But there’s no harm in trying, right? Besides, how would you know if you don’t try?”
“How do you know there are no hidden edges?” Connor whispered to Thomas.
“Isn’t the worst outcome of this just you having sex? Even if Stephanie wouldn’t side with us in the future, I can’t think of any disadvantages at all!” Thomas replied.
“If Freya finds out about my relationship with Stephanie, what should 1 do? I don’t want to have any more conflicts with Freya now!” Connor said, his eyes widened.
Seeing Connor’s emotional state, he sighed helplessly and said, “Mr. McDonald, 1 think you might not have figured out your situation yet!”
“My situation?” Connor was stunned and asked.
“First of all, the biggest enemy standing before you isn’t the people from Rockefeller. After all, Rockefeller has no intention of making a move on you. Once Rockefeller realizes your growth, they will make a move on you! The biggest enemy now is the Lee Family. The Lee Family has been watching you and wants to take away the former chairman’s inheritance from you. Moreover, you should be very clear about the Lee Family’s style of doing things. Before these two enemies, not to mention taking back Rockefeller, it will be a problem whether you can successfully inherit the inheritance in the end. Therefore, 1 think if you are still so soft-hearted, let alone inheriting the inheritance, you might not even be able to protect Ms. Phillips in the end, do you know that?” Thomas said to Connor solemnly.
Connor looked at Thomas and was shocked.
“But if you can successfully control Stephanie, once there is any movement on the Lee Family’s side, we will be the first to know. This way, we can prevent it from happening before it happens, and it is equivalent to setting up a protective barrier for ourselves. We can also put all our energy on how to deal with those people from Rockefeller!”
Thomas paused, then looked at Connor and continued, “1 know that you’ve been worried about Ms. Phillips, but I’m not asking you to really fall in love with Stephanie, nor am I asking you to marry Stephanie. I just want Stephanie to bear your child. This way, we’ll have a way to control Stephanie. If Stephanie is still unwilling to be on our side after the child, we can use the child to threaten Stephanie. They will definitely not trust Stephanie anymore. By then, Stephanie can only be on our side!”
After hearing Thomas’s idea, Connor was shocked.
He finally realized that Thomas wanting Stephanie to bear a child for him was not his whim. It was something that he had considered for a long time!
All of this was Thomas’s plan.
Although Connor did not want to have sex with Stephanie, he felt that Thomas was being very reasonable, so he did not know what to do now.
“Phew…”
Connor took a deep breath and said, “I can’t give you an answer to what you’ve said yet. I’ll think about it when I get back…”
“Good!” Thomas saw Connor seemed to have eased up a little, so he quickly nodded.
Connor looked up at Thomas, stood up, and walked out of the office.
Thomas watched as Connor walked into the elevator. When the elevator door slowly closed, Thomas sighed helplessly.
“Mr. McDonald, I know that these things may be difficult for you to accept, but if you really want to take back Rockefeller, this is only the beginning. The things you need to face in the future are not something that these can compare to!”
After saying this, Thomas turned around and returned to his office.
***
When Connor left the Empire World Building, it was already nine o’clock at night.
The city at night was full of tall buildings and a bustling scene.
Connor was walking aimlessly on the street. What happened today was too shocking for Connor, so shocking that he couldn’t completely digest it.
He originally thought that inheriting Steven’s inheritance was a delightful thing. After all, as long as it was a normal person, they should be pleased to get a windfall of ten trillion dollars.
However, Connor was not happy because he had only discovered today that so many things were hidden behind this wealth.
How should he deal with the Lee Family? How could he get Rockefeller back? Also, what did his parents’ death have to do with Rockefeller? How should he explain it to Freya?
This series of questions surfaced in Connor’s mind. Connor had no clue at all.
Moreover, there was another important question: should he have a child with Stephanie?
Connor thought about how to deal with Stephanie as he walked aimlessly on the street.
Unknowingly, Connor roamed on the street for nearly an hour.
In the end, he found that he had returned to the neighborhood he had rented before. Perhaps in Connor’s subconscious mind, that room less than ten square meters was his real home, and the villa he bought was extremely unfamiliar as if it did not belong to him at all.
Connor stood at the bottom of the building and smiled bitterly. Then, he sighed softly, “Perhaps I’m still a loser.. I have come home without realizing it…”

chapters.title: Chapter 396 - 396: Help Me Ask Connor Out
chapters.content:
Chapter 396 - 396: Help Me Ask Connor Out
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
After lamenting, he walked straight to the elevator.
After a while, Connor returned to the apartment he was renting with Mina.
It was dark inside the apartment, and no one seemed to be at home.
Connor didn’t go next door to look for Mina, but went straight back to his own room.
After entering the room, Connor found that the room seemed to have been tidied up by someone. Everything was placed very neatly and looked very clean. “Someone was in my room?”
Connor muttered with a puzzled expression. Then, he didn’t think too much about it and directly lay on the bed.
At this time, Connor was already exhausted. Now, he only wanted to lie on the bed and get a good rest.
Soon, Connor entered dreamland.
On the other side, on the pedestrian street.
Cindy Stone was carrying a few branded bags in her hands, and her face was filled with happiness as she followed behind Scarlett Moore.
Cindy’s family background was very ordinary. The bags in her hands added up to almost 100,000 dollars, so she definitely didn’t buy them with her own money. They were all given to her by Scarlett.
Scarlett was the front desk manager of the Empire World Corporation. Her monthly salary was at least 70,000 to 80,000 dollars. With some bonuses, her monthly salary was close to 100,000 dollars. These bags were equivalent to spending her monthly salary.
However, Scarlett didn’t feel bad about it because she had a reason for buying these bags for Cindy.
“Scarlett, why are you so good to me today? You’ve actually bought me so many branded bags!”
Cindy was not a fool. Although Scarlett was her cousin, their relationship was not that good. Usually, Scarlett would only buy one or two clothes for Cindy, but today, she actually bought her branded bags that were close to 100,000 dollars. It was rather unusual.
“You’re my cousin. Isn’t it normal for me to buy you a few bags?” Scarlett replied indifferently.
“But you’ve bought way too many bags for me today…”
Cindy whispered.
“Do you mean that I don’t usually buy enough for you?”
Scarlett asked Cindy with a faint smile.
“No, no…”
When Cindy heard Scarlett’s words, she quickly shook her head and explained with a nervous expression, “Scarlett, it’s not that I dislike the things you usually buy for me, but you’ve really bought too many today…”
“Do you like these bags?”
Scarlett asked softly.
“Of… Of course, I like them, but I think these bags are too expensive. Usually, I have to save up for a long time to buy any one of them, but today, you bought all of them in one go. I’m just in disbelief…”
Cindy whispered.
Scarlett turned to look at Cindy and said softly, “Cindy, since you can tell, then 1 won’t beat around the bush with you. Actually, the reason why I bought so many bags for you is because I have something I need your help with!”
“Scarlett, just tell me what you want. 1 won’t dare to take these bags with me if you don’t want something from me!”
Cindy finally heaved a sigh of relief when she heard this and shouted excitedly.
“Cindy, you and Mr. McDonald… Wait, how’s your relationship with Connor?”
Scarlett hesitated for a moment before asking Cindy softly.
“How’s my relationship with Connor?”
Hearing Scarlett’s words, Cindy was stunned. A puzzled expression flashed across her face, and she asked with a pout, “Scarlett, why are you suddenly asking about Connor?”
“I just wanted to ask you, are you familiar with Connor?”
Scarlett didn’t answer Cindy’s question.
“I guess. Didn’t I tell you before? That fool Dominic Turner has always been pursuing me, but I’m not interested in him at all. I’m just using him as a spare tire, and Connor is his roommate.”
Cindy replied softly after thinking for a moment.
“Oh!”
Scarlett nodded thoughtfully.
“Scarlett, why are you asking me about Connor?”
Cindy asked Scarlett in confusion.
Scarlett looked at Cindy and hesitated for a couple of seconds before saying softly, “Cindy, actually, I want you to help me ask Connor out…”
“Help you ask Connor out?”
When Cindy heard Scarlett’s words, her eyes widened in shock.
“Scarlett, Connor is just a poor delivery boy. Why do you want to ask him out?”
Cindy exclaimed with a puzzled expression.
“I know that Connor is a poor loser. That’s why I wanted to ask him out and then expose his true colors in person…”
Scarlett didn’t want to tell Cindy about Connor’s true identity, and she didn’t dare to ask Connor out herself. After all, Connor was her boss, so she could only ask Cindy to ask Connor out and create an opportunity for her to be alone with Connor.
“What do you mean by exposing his true colors?”
Cindy asked Scarlett in confusion.
“You know my best friend, Tanya, right?”
Scarlett asked softly.
“Of course, I know her. Didn’t we have dinner with her last time?” Cindy nodded.
“Connor has been pursuing Tanya recently, pretending to be a rich heir in front of her. I’m worried that Tanya will be cheated by Connor, so 1 plan to ask Connor out and then pretend to seduce him to expose his true colors. When the time comes, 1’11 record this and show it to Tanya. This way, she should know what kind of person Connor is, and she won’t be fooled!”
Scarlett found a random excuse to explain.
“Oh. Scarlett, you’re planning to make a fool of Connor, right?”
Cindy said in realization when she heard Scarlett’s words.
“That’s right. Tanya is my best friend. 1 won’t watch helplessly as she gets deceived by Connor. I must expose his true colors…”
Scarlett did not expect Cindy to believe her so quickly, so she could only go along with what she said.
“If that’s the case, I’ll definitely help you. I’ll call Connor out now!”
Cindy didn’t even think about it and took out her phone. She was ready to ask Dominic for Connor’s contact information. After all, in her opinion, there was nothing more important than embarrassing Connor.
Seeing that Cindy was about to make a call, Scarlett hurriedly reached out to stop her. She hadn’t prepared anything yet. If Cindy called Connor out now, her plan might all be ruined.
Scarlett’s plan was actually very simple. She planned to have Cindy ask Connor out first, then she would take the opportunity to appear and bring him to a random private room in the bar.
At that time, when the man and woman were alone in the room, Scarlett would spike Connor’s drink. In that case, Connor would probably take advantage of the drug’s effect to sleep with her. Scarlett would then have Connor in her grasp. Perhaps, she would even be able to get pregnant with Connor’s child. In that case, she would be one step closer to marrying into a wealthy family.
However, Scarlett had not reserved a private room, nor had she prepared any drugs. Even if she called Connor out, it was impossible for him to sleep with her.
“Cindy, it’s getting late. Forget it. You can call Connor out when you have time some other day!” Scarlett quickly reached out to stop Cindy.
Cindy looked down at her phone and smiled. “Yeah, it’s almost eleven o’clock. Then, I’ll call Connor out some other day!”
“Yeah!”
Scarlett nodded quickly, a hint of excitement flashing in her eyes..

chapters.title: Chapter 397 - 397: Long Time No See, Mina
chapters.content:
Chapter 397: Long Time No See, Mina
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
The next day, at eight o’clock in the morning.
Connor slowly opened his eyes and woke up from his sleep.
Last night could be said to be the best sleep Connor had in this month.
After getting up, Connor stretched and was ready to go wash up. After all, there were still many things waiting for Connor to do today.
Bang! Bang!
However, just as Connor was about to leave, a series of hurried knocks came from the door.
“Connor, are you back?”
Mina’s voice sounded from outside the room.
When Connor heard Mina’s voice, he couldn’t help but be stunned for a moment before saying, “Yes, I’m back. Wait a moment!”
After saying this, Connor hurriedly picked up his clothes and put them on. Then, he quickly ran to the door and opened it.
When the door opened up, a beautiful figure immediately entered his sight.
Mina was dressed very beautifully today. She was wearing a low-cut dress with spaghetti straps. Her jet-black hair was casually draped over her shoulders. Her perfect facial features were flawless. Every inch of her skin seemed to be hinting at the creator’s bias. Her pair of big, watery eyes occasionally exuded waves of charm that made people intoxicated. Her slender, fair legs were exposed. Connor was stunned by the sexy and seductive Mina in front of him.
After not seeing her for so long, Mina seemed to have become prettier.
“Connor, it’s actually you!”
Mina saw Connor in front of her and couldn’t help but cover her mouth as she shouted excitedly.
“Yeah, this is my room. Who else could it be?”
Connor replied with a smile.
“I haven’t seen you for so long. I thought you’d already moved…”
Mina looked at Connor and explained.
“I didn’t move. I’ve been busy with other things recently, so I didn’t come back!”
After Connor said this, he took the initiative to make way for Mina.
Mina hesitated for a moment, then walked into Connor’s room and said with a smile, “I thought 1 would never see you again!”
“Nah. Even if 1 really wanted to move out, 1 would have told you!”
Connor smiled and replied, then looked at Mina and asked, “By the way, when I wasn’t around, did you help me tidy up the room?”
“Yeah. I’d come over every once in a while to help you tidy up the house. I was planning to go out just now, but when I saw that your door was closed, I knocked on the door. I didn’t expect you to really be back…”
Mina did not hide the smile on her face when she spoke.
“Actually, I…”
Connor was about to explain to Mina that he might not come back often in the future. After all, Freya Phillips already knew Connor’s identity, and he did not plan to continue staying here.
“By the way, Connor, a girl named Mandy Hines came here to look for you a few times. It seemed to be urgent.”
Before Connor could say anything, Mina interrupted him.
“Mandy Hines?”
When Connor heard this name, he was stunned for a moment. During this period of time, Connor had been at the Phillips Estate. He had long forgotten about Mandy.
However, he knew clearly in his heart why Mandy had come to look for him.
“Alright…”
Connor looked at Mina and nodded.
Ring! Ring!
At this moment, Mina’s phone suddenly rang.
Mina quickly took out her phone and looked at it, then whispered to Connor, “Connor, I have some things to do. 1’11 talk to you when 1 come back tonight!” “Okay!”
Connor nodded helplessly.
Mina looked at Connor with a smile, then directly left the room in her high heels.
Connor looked at Mina’s back as she left, a hint of confusion flashing in his eyes.
Because he could feel that Mina seemed to be very anxious, but from what he knew, Mina didn’t seem to have any friends in Porthampton!
“Does Mina have a boyfriend?”
Connor could not help but mutter.
Ring! Ring!
At this moment, Connor’s phone rang.
Connor looked at his phone and realized that it was Thomas Morgan calling. After hesitating for a moment, he chose to answer the call.
“Mr. McDonald, have you thought about how to deal with Stephanie Lee?”
Thomas asked directly.
Connor couldn’t help but hesitate for a moment when he heard this. Then, he said in a low voice, “I’ll give Joey Shaw a call now. The two of us will go and have a good chat with Stephanie. If Stephanie agrees to stand on our side, that would be the best possible outcome. However, if she doesn’t agree to do it, then we’ll do it your way.”
“Alright, Mr. McDonald!”
Thomas said excitedly seeing that Connor had agreed to it.
After thinking about it last night, Connor felt that what Thomas said was very reasonable.
He was in a very dangerous situation now. Whether it was the Lee Family or the people from Rockefeller Consortium, if these people really attacked Connor, he might not even have the chance to fight back.
Therefore, for his personal safety, Connor felt that it was indeed necessary to have a spy in the Lee Family!
However, Connor was very resistant to Thomas’s method!
He wanted Stephanie to become Connor’s woman, and he even wanted him to make her pregnant to threaten her!
Although Stephanie was indeed beautiful and had a very hot figure, Connor still didn’t want to have anything to do with such a woman.
This was because he felt that Stephanie was too dangerous. He was worried that once he provoked her, he might never be able to get rid of her for the rest of his life.
However, Connor also knew that Thomas’s method might be the best method at the moment. Moreover, if he really wanted to have sex with Stephanie, Connor did not seem to have anything to lose.
Connor’s current thoughts were very simple. He wanted to have a good chat with Stephanie first. If Stephanie knew what was good for her, that would naturally be the best. However, if Stephanie didn’t know what was good for her, then Connor couldn’t do anything about it. He could only follow Thomas’s method.
At this critical moment, Connor felt that his safety was more important than anything else. He didn’t want Yannick Lee’s incident to repeat itself!
In Thomas’s words, those who achieved great things did not care about trifles. Yannick’s incident had also sounded the alarm for Connor. If he wanted to inherit Steven Lee’s inheritance, he must be ruthless and not give the enemy a chance to breathe!
“Phew!”
Connor took a deep breath, then dialed Stephanie’s number..

Half an hour later, the Bentley stopped in front of a villa in the suburbs of Porthampton.
“Mr. McDonald, Mr. Morgan, we’ve arrived!”

“You two wait here. 1’11 go in with Mr. McDonald!”
Thomas knew that Stephanie was currently being controlled by Joey’s men, so he and Connor should not be in any danger. Therefore, he did not have the intention of letting the driver and bodyguard follow them in.
“Alright!”
The chauffeur hurriedly nodded.
Connor followed Thomas out of the Bentley and walked into the villa complex.
Although Connor looked calm and collected, he was actually very nervous because he knew that what was going to happen next might change the trajectory of his entire life!
All he could think about now was whether he should have sex with Stephanie if she didn’t cooperate with him later.
Thomas seemed to have noticed the nervousness in Connor’s eyes, but he did not say anything.
Because in Thomas’s eyes, those who achieved great things could not be held back by trifles. If Connor could not even handle this well, then he was not qualified to deal with Rockefeller at all.
Connor and Thomas followed the address given by Joey and found the villa in the area.
Connor stood in front of the villa door and hesitated for a moment. In the end, he reached out and gently knocked on the villa door.
“Who is it?”
A man’s voice came from inside the villa.
“I’m Connor. Joey Shaw asked me to come over!”

“Oh, Mr. McDonald! Please wait a moment!”
The other party shouted, and then he heard a series of hurried footsteps coming from inside.
Creak!
The door of the villa slowly opened, and a man in a suit stuck his head out. After confirming that the people standing outside were indeed Connor and Thomas, he smiled and said, “Mr. McDonald, Mr. Morgan, hello!”
“You are Joey’s man?”
Connor sized up the man in the suit and asked in a low voice.
“That’s right, I’m Mr. Shaw’s driver. Mr. McDonald, you can just call me William!”
The man in the suit replied respectfully.
As Joey’s driver, he naturally knew who Connor and Thomas were, so he was extremely humble.
“It’s been hard on you guys these past few days. Where’s Stephanie Lee?”
Connor didn’t waste any time and asked directly.
“In the bedroom. Mr. McDonald, Mr. Morgan, please come with me!”
William opened the villa’s door and then took the initiative to make way for Connor and Thomas.
Connor hesitated for a moment, then walked into the villa..

When Stephanie heard the sound of the door opening, she shouted in a hoarse voice, “Bastards, let me out now. I’m telling you; my brother is about to inherit the inheritance. When that time comes, I’ll definitely make you suffer…”
“Haha…”
Connor chortled helplessly after hearing Stephanie’s words. Perhaps Stephanie was still fantasizing that Yannick Lee would inherit Steven Lee’s inheritance and come to save her.
At this moment, Stephanie saw Connor and Thomas standing at the door of the room. When Stephanie saw Connor, she was stunned, and a trace of confusion flashed across her eyes.
“Why… Why are you guys here? Where’s my brother?”
Stephanie subconsciously took two steps back and shouted at Connor with a frightened expression.
“Your brother has already returned to York. He won’t come to save you…”
Connor calmly replied to Stephanie.
“No… That’s impossible! My brother will definitely come and save me. You better let me go! You’re no longer the heir. If my brother wants to kill you, it’ll be easier than killing an ant. If you let me go now, I might be able to plead for you. Otherwise, you’ll definitely die a brutal death!”
Stephanie shouted viciously at Connor.
“Who told you that I’m not the heir?”

Connor has clearly exposed his identity in front of Freya Phillips. How can he still have the right to inherit? You must be lying to me…”
“If your plan didn’t fail, then why is Thomas still standing by my side instead of standing by your brother’s side?”

When Stephanie heard Connor’s words, she finally realized that something was wrong.

At the thought of this, Stephanie felt her legs go weak, and she collapsed onto the ground. Her pretty face was filled with fear. She seemed to have guessed what would happen next.

Connor said to Stephanie in disdain.

Therefore, she hurriedly pretended to be pitiful, hoping to gain Connor’s sympathy so that he would let her go.
H H
Connor narrowed his eyes and looked at Stephanie without saying anything.
Stephanie was sitting on the ground with her legs crossed. Her long and fair legs were exposed in front of Connor. She raised her pretty face slightly and looked at Connor with an alluring gaze. She looked so shy and innocent. She was indeed a famous beauty in York. Any normal man would not be able to control himself seeing Stephanie like this.

chapters.title: Chapter 400 - 400: I’ll Give You Two Options

Chapter 400 - 400: I’ll Give You Two Options
Translator: End less Fantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
“What is it?”
Stephanie could not help but ask.
“I want you to help me monitor the Lee Family. If therers any movement on their side, you have to report to me immediately!”
Connor said to Stephanie with a serious expression.
After Stephanie heard Connor s words, she was stunned. She did not expect Connor to actually want her to be a spy and monitor the Lee Family.
“There are only two paths in front of you now. Either you agree to my condition, or you die here.”
Of course, Connor didn’t want to kill Stephanie. He only said this to scare Stephanie.
Stephanie sat on the spot and hesitated for a couple of seconds. Then, she whispered to Connor, “Okay, I promise you. As long as you let me go, I’ll help you monitor the Lee Family, okay?”

Connor smiled and nodded.
Seeing that Connor had agreed to her request, and a hint of excitement flashed across Stephanie’s face. She did not expect Connor to be so gullible. He really believed her when she said that she would help him monitor the Lee Family!
The reason why she agreed to Connor so readily was because she wanted to hurry up and leave this place. Once Stephanie had gotten rid of Connor, he had no say in anything that she did.
“But how do 1 know you won’t lie to me? If 1 let you go, what if you don’t help me monitor the Lee Family?”
But at this moment, Connor asked Stephanie.
Stephanie looked at Connor with a complicated expression on her face.
Because she didn’t expect Connor to be so smart. He had actually guessed her little plan.
“Then… Then what will make you believe me?”
Stephanie hesitated for a moment before biting her lip and asking Connor softly.
“I remember that you gave me two options back at the Phillips Estate. To be fair, I’ll give you two options now…”
Connor looked at Stephanie with a playful expression.
“What options?”
Stephanie asked.
“The first option is very simple. You help me kill Yannick and record the process of killing Yannick. Then, you give me the video. In this way, I will have the evidence of you killing Yannick.”

This matter was not Thomas Morgan s idea but Connor’s own idea. Connor felt that Thomas was right. Those who achieved great things must not be bothered by trifles!
Since he had already made up his mind to deal with the Lee Family and Rockefeller, there was no need to be soft-hearted. Killing Yannick and successfully controlling Stephanie was a good thing for Connor.

Connor knew that as the heir of the richest man in the world, if he continued to be timid, he would not be able to deal with Rockefeller at all, nor would he be able to investigate the cause of his parents’ deaths. He would not even be able to protect his beloved woman.
Previously, Connor had never had any ambitions. He felt that his current life was good enough. He was surrounded by beautiful women, and he was rich enough to rival a country. This was already very good for a poor loser.
However, when Thomas said that the cause of his parents’ death was very likely related to Rockefeller, Connor’s thoughts began to change.
Connor felt that he could not live like this by relying on his inheritance. He wanted to use the resources in his hands to do something that he had never dared to think of doing before!
The Lee Family had always been Connor’s biggest enemy. If Connor could control Stephanie and get her to get rid of Yannick, then the Lee Family would never dare to have any intention against Connor.
Stephanie didn’t expect Connor to be so cruel and merciless. He even wanted her to kill Yannick. Looking at Connor’s cold expression, she felt that Connor was completely different from the Connor in the Phillips Estate. It was as if he was a different person.
“What do you think of this option?”
Connor asked Stephanie softly.
“Impossible, I won’t kill Yannick. If 1 really do that, my life will be ruined…”
Stephanie had been with Yannick for so many years. She knew how terrifying he was. She was worried that if she failed, the consequences would be unimaginable.
Moreover, Stephanie had never thought of helping Connor monitor the Lee Family from the beginning, so she naturally would not agree to this request.
“Haha…”
Connor seemed to have guessed that Stephanie would reject this request, so he smiled playfully.
“What about the second option? What is the other option?”
Seeing that Connor wasn’t saying anything, she hurriedly asked him.
“The second option is also very simple. 1 want you to become my woman and help me bear a child!”
Connor whispered to Stephanie.
“Become your woman? And you want to give birth to a child for you?”
When Stephanie heard Connor’s words, her mouth was wide open, and she could not speak for a moment.
She never thought that Connor would give her a second option that was even worse than the first one. Although Stephanie looked very charming and was usually dressed in a very mature and sexy way, she had never had sex with a man, nor had she ever been in a relationship.
Stephanie knew very well that a woman’s most precious thing was her body. Therefore, unless it was absolutely necessary, Stephanie would never easily sell her body as a bargaining chip.
“As long as you become my woman and help me give birth to a child, I will let you go. In this case, you don’t have to help me kill Yannick!”
Connor looked at Stephanie coldly..

chapters.title: Chapter 401 - 401:I Can Bear Your Children
chapters.content:
Chapter 401:I Can Bear Your Children
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
“You’re dreaming! Even if I die, I won’t help you bear a child!”
Stephanie looked at Connor and shook her head abruptly, speaking with a resolute tone.
“Miss Stephanie, do you think you have the qualification to negotiate with me?”
He looked her, a faintly smiled appeared on his face and continued, “There are only two options in front of you now. The first is to murder Yannick, and the second is to give birth to a child for me. Otherwise, you will never leave this place!”
“Why?”
She shouted at him, then asked in an puzzled tone, “Why do you insist on forcing me to have your child? What’s the connection between these two things?”
“The reason is simple. Because you are a member of the Lee family. Although you are the half-sister of Yannick, you still carry the blood of the Lee family. 1 can’t fully trust you. What if one day you betray me? So you must show me your loyalty!”
Connor looked at her and explained lightly, then continued, “Either you go and get rid of Yannick now, then I can trust your loyalty because once the Lee family knows about this, they won’t spare you. Or you have sex with me and give birth to my child. In that case, I will be the father of your child. Even if you are ruthless, you probably won’t easily harm me for the sake of the child. Moreover, if the Lee family knows that you have given birth to a child for me, they probably won’t trust you anymore!”
She stared at him with a horrified gaze. After two seconds of silence, she whispered, “Are you trying to cut off with the Lee family?”
“Yes, you can understand it that way. After all, once you give birth to a child for me, you can only wholeheartedly follow me. 1 don’t have to worry about you betraying me!” He looked at her and said straightforwardly.
Upon hearing his words, her expression darkened, and she gritted her teeth and said, “What if 1 don’t choose either of these options?”
“If you don’t choose, then don’t blame me for being ruthless!”
A coldness flashed in his eyes.
Although he didn’t actually want to kill her at this moment, he had to say it like that because only in this way would she feel fear.
Stephanie stared at Connor with widened eyes. At this moment, her gaze towards him had undergone a tremendous change compared to when she saw him in the Phillips Estate. She originally thought that he was just a pathetic loser who happened to inherit Steven’s inheritance due to luck.
But now she realized that he was not as weak as she had imagined. Not only was he meticulous in his thinking, but his methods were also extremely cruel.
Both of these options were extremely lethal for her.
Stephanie had initially thought that she could pretend to agree to Connor first, then, after leaving this place, she could give some false information to Connor and help Yannick regain the inheritance.
But now, she felt that her idea was too naive and too simplistic.
In other words, she underestimated him.
“Miss Stephanie, I know these two options must be difficult for you to choose. So 1 will give you five minutes to consider. After five minutes, I’ll come back to you!”
After saying this, Connor stood up and left the room, leaving her sitting on the floor with a dazed look.
When he walked out of the room, Thomas hurriedly approached him and asked in a low voice, “Mr. Connor, how is the situation with Miss Stephanie?”
“I gave her five minutes to consider. 1 think she will agree to my request!” Connor replied expressionlessly.
“That’s good!”
After hearing his words, Thomas let out a long sigh of relief. As long as Stephanie stood on his side, it was equivalent to planting a spy within the Lee family. In that case, the threat of the Lee family to Connor would be minimal.
“Tick tock…”
Time passed by, and the living room of the villa was very quiet.
Connor sat on the sofa, absent-mindedly staring at the garden outside the villa, contemplating the actions he had taken today.
If it were the previous Connor, he wouldn’t dare to do such things!
But after experiencing the series of things from Yannick, he was no longer the same person. He understood very well how terrifying the struggles in the upper-class society could be. Even if he didn’t want to, he had to force himself to adapt to this environment.
Because if he didn’t adapt, he would end up dying in a very miserable way sooner or later!
The five minutes quickly passed. Thomas turned his head and glanced at Connor, then whispered, “Mr. Connor, the time is up!”
Connor took a deep breath, then got up and walked towards the room where Stephanie was.
Thomas hesitated for two seconds but ultimately chose not to go in. He believed that Connor could handle the situation well.
“Squeak!”
Upon hearing the sound of the door opening, Stephanie suddenly looked up and glanced at Connor who entered.
“Miss Stephanie, the five minutes are up. Have you made your decision?” He stood at the door and calmly asked her.
She hesitated for two seconds while sitting on the floor, then suddenly raised her head and looked at him. She spoke in a low voice, “I can become your woman and give birth to your child!”
Upon hearing her words, Connor stood frozen in place, his face expressing an indescribable shock.
He never expected that things would go so smoothly today.. Stephanie actually agreed to give birth to his child, and she agreed so readily!

chapters.title: Chapter 402 - 402: Are You Incapable?
chapters.content:
Chapter 402: Are You Incapable?
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
“Are you serious?” Connor asked Stephanie excitedly.
“Of course!”

Seeing him readily agreeing, she was momentarily stunned. She then stood up slowly and walked to his side, whispering, “As long as you agree to these two conditions, we can go to bed now!”

This situation left him unsure of how to respond.
Stephanie stared at him with a calm expression.
In fact, she had already thought it through. She believed that having a child with Connor might not be a bad thing. After all, he was now the heir of Steven, with an abundance of money. If she could have a child with him, it would provide some security for her lifetime.
If she continued to stay in the Lee family, there was no guarantee of a good outcome. Either she would be taken by Yannick, as she was aware of his intentions towards her. If it weren’t because of Horace, Yannick would had done that a long time ago.
Or she would be married off to some rich heir chosen by Horace. After all, her status in the Lee family was low, and she had no right to choose.
Stephanie knew that whether she married a rich heir or became Yannick’s possession, in the end, she would become a plaything in someone else’s hands. When these people got tired of her and she became old, she would be discarded.
Therefore, she felt that if she could have a child with Connor, it would not only solve the current problem but also provide a good guarantee for her future.
“Are you sure you want to have a child with me?”
At this moment, Connor couldn’t help but ask her again.

After hearing Thomas’s words, Stephanie’s delicate body trembled slightly, and her expression darkened.
“Miss Lee, don’t worry. I still have an antidote in my hands. As long as you take this antidote on time every week, the poison of the Erosion Pill will not take effect in your body. So, from now on, you just have to listen to me. 1 will send someone to deliver the antidote to you every week. But if you don’t listen to me, don’t blame me for being rude…”
Thomas continued to threaten Stephanie.
When Stephanie heard this, she could not help but be stunned for a moment. Then, she shouted excitedly at Thomas, “What exactly do you want? Why are you torturing me like this?”
“I want you to be Mr. McDonald’s servant for the rest of your life. From today onwards, he is your master. Do you understand?”
Thomas’s eyes flashed with a hint of ruthlessness as he said to Stephanie coldly.
“Be Mr. McDonald’s servant?”
When Stephanie heard this, she could not help but be stunned..

chapters.title: Chapter 408 - 408: What Will You Choose?
chapters.content:
Chapter 408: What Will You Choose?
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
“Be Mr. McDonald’s servant?”
After hearing Thomas’s words, a trace of despair flashed across Stephanie’s face.
Only now did she understand what Thomas’s purpose was.
“I originally wanted you to give birth to a child for Mr. McDonald so that we could control you. However, I didn’t expect you to have evil intentions towards Mr. McDonald and want to use this matter to threaten him.”
Thomas said calmly to Stephanie.
When Stephanie heard this, a trace of despair flashed across her beautiful eyes.
At this moment, she finally realized why Thomas said that she did not cherish this opportunity.
Because now it seemed that being able to give birth to Connor’s child was also a good thing!
“You only have two choices now: the first choice is to be tortured to death by the Erosion Pill. The second choice is to be a servant of Mr. McDonald obediently and do whatever he asks you to do. I will get someone to deliver the medicine to you every week. In this way, I can guarantee that you will never experience the pain like before again.”
Thomas whispered to Stephanie.
“When will the poison of the Erosion Pill completely disappear from my body?”
Stephanie hesitated for a moment before asking Thomas in a low voice.
“In ten years!” Thomas replied indifferently.
“Ten years!”
Stephanie’s eyes flashed with despair when she heard this. She gritted her teeth and shouted, “Thomas Morgan, you’re really vicious! You’re actually prepared to use this thing to torture me for ten years…”
“I’m vicious?”
When Thomas heard Stephanie’s words, he could not help but sneer. Then, he said softly, “If you hadn’t framed Mr. McDonald, and if you didn’t realize your mistake today and try to blackmail him, would 1 have used this method to deal with you today?”
“You…”
Stephanie stared at Thomas, unable to say a word. She knew that she had brought this upon herself.
“I don’t have time to talk nonsense with you now. What do you want to choose?”
Thomas asked Stephanie expressionlessly.
“I… I’m willing to be Mr. McDonald’s servant. Mr. McDonald will be my master from now on. I’ll do whatever Mr. McDonald asks me to do!”
Although Stephanie wanted to do anything else but this, in order to protect her life, she could only choose to submit at this moment.
“From now on, on the first of every month, I will get someone to send you the antidote. As long as you take the antidote before your illness acts up, nothing will happen to you,” Thomas said.
“Understood…”
Stephanie nodded lightly.
After Thomas heard Stephanie’s answer, he did not continue to waste his breath on her. He stood up and walked out of the room.
The chauffeur glanced at Stephanie with a complicated look in his eyes. He turned around and left with Thomas.
A few minutes later, Thomas and the driver returned to the Bentley.
After getting into the car, the driver turned to look at Thomas and said softly, “President Morgan, didn’t that woman just take the antidote? Wasn’t there no more poison from the Erosion Pill in her body?”
H H
After Thomas heard the driver’s words, he looked up at the driver and said expressionlessly, “If 1 tell Stephanie now that she has already taken the antidote, do you think she will still be so obedient?”
“So that’s what’s going on!”
The driver sighed softly and then asked with a puzzled expression, “Then, President Morgan, what if Stephanie finds out?”
“That won’t happen…” Thomas shook his head gently and said in a low voice, “The pain of the Erosion Pill is not something that ordinary people can withstand. As long as Stephanie has experienced it once, she will never forget it for the rest of her life. Therefore, she won’t have the guts to not take the antidote…”
“That’s true. President Morgan, you’re very cunning!” the driver said with a smile.
Thomas looked at the scenery outside the window and hesitated for a moment. Then, he sighed softly and said, “Mr. McDonald has just come into contact with these things. There are some things that he can’t bear to do, so only 1 can do it for him. Don’t tell Mr. McDonald about this today.”
“Good!”
The driver nodded and started the car.
On the other hand, after Connor left the Panorama Hotel, he had no idea what Thomas had done to Stephanie, nor did he know what had happened in the presidential suite just now.
Of course, Connor did not care about these things; at this moment, he was still thinking about Freya, so he could not do anything to let her down.
Connor hailed a taxi and went straight to the Empire World Building.
At first, Connor thought that he might lose the qualification to get the inheritance, so he wanted to squander the property in his hands and finally experience the life of a rich person. Therefore, he bought a limited edition Ferrari sports car at the 4S showroom.
However, because of the conversation with Thomas yesterday, Connor’s plans were disrupted. In addition, Connor was in the habit of walking around everywhere, so when he went home last night, he’d actually forgotten that he had a sports car in the parking lot of the Empire World Building.
When he left the Panorama Hotel, Connor suddenly remembered that he still had a sports car, so he planned to get it first before looking for Chloe.
Back then, Connor had promised Chloe that as long as he could regain his status as a rich man, he would buy all the remaining houses in their real estate.
Now that he had regained his identity as the heir, he had to fulfill his promise to her.
Connor had never had a good impression of Chloe before because he felt that she was very materialistic. He’d thought that the reason why she was so good to him was that she wanted to get some benefits from him.
However, when Chloe knew that Connor might become a pauper, she could still clearly say that she would be friends with Connor. It really touched him deeply.
Connor felt that Chloe might not be as unbearable as he thought.
After arriving at the parking lot, Connor briefly recalled where he had parked his car, and then began to look for it in the parking lot.
However, not long after Connor left, he suddenly found a large group of people surrounding his sports car and discussing something in low voices.
Most importantly, there was a little girl crying beside the sports car.
When Connor saw this scene, he couldn’t help but be stunned for a moment.
Then, he walked towards the crowd..

chapters.title: Chapter 409 - 409: Chance Meeting with Melissa Sachs
chapters.content:
Chapter 409: Chance Meeting with Melissa Sachs
Translator: Endless Fantasy Translation Editor: End loss Fantasy Translation
In the parking lot of rhe the Empire World Building.
Connor originally thought that his Ferrari was too cool, which was why it attracted so many people to watch.
However, when Connor walked in to take a look, he realized that something was wrong.
The rear of his sports car was severely deformed, and there was a pink BMW Mini parked behind the Ferrari.
The BMW Mini’s hood also had very obvious collision marks!
It was obvious that Connor’s Ferrari had been hit by this BMW Mini, and from the degree of distortion of the rear of the sports car, it could be seen that the impact was no light tap!
After Connor saw this scene, the expression on his face was abnormally helpless. He had only bought this Ferrari for a few days, yet it was alreadydamaged by someone. Connor really did not know if he was lucky or unlucky!
“Little girl) hurry up and call your parents. Don’t cry here..11
“That’s right, young lady. I heard that this car is a limited-edition Ferrari. It costs at least tens of millions. If you crash into someone elses car like this, the owner will definitely come after you later…”
“With such a crash, the repair fee should be at least one or Two million!”
The onlookers surrounding the sports car began to persuade the girl who was squatting on the ground.
After the girl heard everyone’s words, she cried even harder.
Seeing this scene, Connor instantly understood that the person who hit his sports car was probably the girl who was crying on the ground.
Because the girl had been hiding her head between her legs and crying, Connor could not see the girl’s face clearly.
However, just by looking at her figure, this girl was not bad.
She was wearing a light blue strapless top and a black leather miniskirt. The miniskirt was wrapped tightly around her slender legs, and her fair legs were covered with black stockings.
