She was wearing a pair of high heels, and her exquisite face was paired with her jet-black curly hair. She looked very beautiful.
“I just don’t know what this girl looks like!”
Connor could not help but sigh softly in his heart. Then, he secretly made a decision in his heart. If the other party was a beautiful woman, then he would forget about today’s matter.
Perhaps this Ferrari might be a priceless existence in the eyes of others, but in Connor’s eyes, it was nothing at all. Even if he smashed this sports car, Connor wouldn’t even blink.
Therefore, Connor directly walked up to the girl and said softly, “Hello, I m…’’
When the girl heard Connor’s words, she instinctively thought that the owner of the sports car had arrived, so she slowly raised her head.
When the girl saw Connor, she was stunned on the spot.
When Connor saw the woman, he was also dumbfounded.
What Connor saw was a breathtakingly beautiful face and seemed to be about the same age as Connor. Her jet-black hair was casually draped over her shoulders, and her chest was rather ample, as if it could break free from the shackles of her clothes at any time.
The woman in front of him could be said to be the best of the best. Her figure and appearance were not much inferior to those celebrities who relied on their looks to make a living on television!
Perhaps it was because the girl had just cried, but her eyes were red and swollen. Her big, watery eyes looked very teary, giving people a pitiful feeling.
Any normal man, upon seeing a girl like this, would not help but want to pull her into his arms and take good care of her.
“Connor, why is it you?”
At this moment, the girl suddenly shouted at Connor.
After Connor heard the girl’s words, a hint of helplessness flashed across his eyes, and his expression shifted into one of tiredness.
He had never expected to meet this girl here!
When Connor first came to Porthampton University to study, the school required everyone to join a club. Connor didn’t have any hobbies at that time, so he randomly chose to join the Zither club.
At this time, the girl who hit Connor’s car was none other than the president of the zither Club of the Porthampton University, Melissa Sachs!
Although Connor had joined the zither club, he rarely took part in the club’s activities because he had to deliver food and would often ask Melissa for leave. After a few times, they got to know each other.
In Connor’s impression, Melissa was a pretty good girl. Not only was she beautiful, but she was also very kind. At the very least, she was much better than the average rich girl. Her personality was very approachable.
Melissa knew that Connor’s conditions were not very good, so every time Connor came to ask for leave, Melissa would agree very quickly. Moreover, she would usually take the initiative to introduce some part-time jobs to Connor.
The most important thing was that Melissa had never asked Connor for the club fees.’The Zither Club needed to pay a large sum of money every year to maintain the maintenance and upkeep of the zithers they played, and this cost was spread across equally by the members.
Melissa knew that Connor’s family was not well off, so she had never asked Connor for the money.
Connor looked helplessly at Melissa and stuttered, “Miss Sachs, why are you here?”
At this moment, Connor was still very devastated. If the person who hit his car was a stranger, then Connor could completely expose his identity and let her leave.
But what Connor never expected was that the person who hit his car was actually Melissa!
Although Freya already knew Connor’s identity, he still did not want too many people in school to know about him.
As the saying goes, if you’re poor in the city, no one will care about you, but if you’re wealthy in the mountains, everyone will try to become your family member.
If others knew that he was rich, it would definitely bring some unnecessary trouble.
Therefore, when Connor looked at Melissa, he didn’t know what to do.
“President Sachs, what’s going on?”
Connor frowned and asked Melissa.
“What else could it be? When I was reversing my car just now, 1 accidentally hit this sports car. I’m waiting for the owner to come over now. I heard that this sports car seems to be quite expensive…” Melissa said pitifully to Connor.
Connor stood there and hesitated for two seconds, then said in a low voice, “Well, President Sachs, why don’t you leave first? Leave this matter to me!” “Leave it to you?”
After Melissa heard Connor’s words, she was stunned on the spot. Her expression was one of surprise..

chapters.title: Chapter 410 - 410: Are You Trying to Run?
chapters.content:
Chapter 410: Are You Trying to Run?
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
“Leave it to you?”
Melissa, who was sobbing on the ground, was stunned when she heard Connor’s words. Her face was filled with disbelief because she didn’t know what Connor meant!
“That’s right, Miss Sachs. Drive away now. Leave the rest to me!” Connor repeated.
Connor didn’t want to expose his identity in front of Melissa, so he could only get her to leave first. After she left, he would drive the sports car out.
“But 1 hit this sports car. How are you going to explain it to the owner?” Melissa asked Connor in confusion.
When the passersby around Melissa heard Connor’s words, they all revealed disdainful expressions.
“Young man, now is not the time for you to be a hero. Do you know how much this sports car is worth?”
A middle-aged man in a suit stood up and shouted at Connor.
“Yeah, I heard that this sports car seems to be a limited edition Ferrari. It costs at least 10 million dollars. Now that this girl has crashed into someone else’s car, and it’s so serious, she’ll have to pay at least one or two million dollars. Do you have that much money to help her pay?” a middle-aged woman also shouted.
“Young people these days really don’t know the immensity of heaven and earth. In order to show off in front of girls, they don’t even know their own worth. They actually dare to boast shamelessly that they can solve anything.”
Everyone saw Connor, who looked like a loser, and this coupled with the fact that the Ferrari was indeed very expensive and that the maintenance cost was not something that ordinary people could afford, they all felt that Connor could not afford the maintenance cost of this car at all, and they all began to mock him.
After Connor heard everyone’s mockery, he turned his head and looked at these people indifferently, but did not argue with them.
Instead, he turned to Melissa and said, “Miss Sachs, you’d better leave quickly. 1’11 definitely be able to help you settle the rest of the matter…”
“Connor, I’m really grateful that you stood up to help me at this time, but I know that this car is very expensive and the maintenance cost is very high. This money is not something you can afford, so you’d better leave quickly…”
Melissa thought for a moment and rejected Connor.
Melissa felt that since Connor could stand up and say these words at this time, it meant that Connor definitely did not realize how serious this matter was.
In Melissa’s eyes, Connor was just a poor student. It was normal for a poor student to not know how expensive this sports car was.
After Connor heard Melissa’s words, he was instantly speechless. He didn’t know how to explain, but he knew that Melissa rejected him at this time because she didn’t want to implicate him.
“Miss Sachs, I can really resolve this matter. Please leave quickly!”
Connor didn’t waste any time talking nonsense and directly reached out to grab Melissa, who was squatting on the ground, and pulled her up.
“Connor, what are you doing? Quickly let go of me…”
Melissa saw Connor grab her arm and struggled with all her might.
Connor didn’t bother with Melissa. Even if he explained it to her, she probably wouldn’t believe him.
Therefore, he could only ask Melissa to leave as soon as possible and then drive the sports car away.
Connor dragged Melissa to the side of the BMW, then reached out and pulled open the door of the BMW, pushing Melissa into the BMW.
“Connor, what are you doing? I’ve already told you that this matter isn’t something you can solve. Why are you showing off? Do you know how much this car is worth? In a while, the driver will come over and ask you for money. What are you going to give him?”
Melissa sat in the BMW and shouted excitedly at Connor.
After Connor heard Melissa’s words, he couldn’t help but hesitate for a moment. Then, he whispered, “Miss Sachs, let me tell you the truth. This sports car belongs to my friend. If he comes over later and finds out that you hit his car, he will definitely make you pay for it. You know how expensive this sports car is. You definitely can’t afford the repair fees, so you should hurry up and drive away…”
“If I leave, what will happen to you?”
Melissa was stunned for a moment and asked Connor with a puzzled expression.
“When my friend comes later, I’ll tell him that his car was hit. My friend also knows that I don’t have money, so he definitely won’t hold it against me. If you don’t want to lose everything because of this matter, then you should leave quickly…”
Connor said to Melissa with a serious expression.
Melissa finally understood what Connor meant. She asked in a low voice, “Connor, if I leave now, you’ll really be fine, right?”
“Miss Sachs, why would I lie to you? I don’t have any money on hand to pay for the repair of this sports car. My friend also knows my situation, so he definitely won’t ask me for this money. At most, he will scold me!”
Connor replied with a smile and then continued, “Do you think it’s more appropriate for me to be scolded or for you to compensate my friend until you go bankrupt?”
Melissa looked at Connor in front of her, and her expression was indescribably touched. She hesitated for a moment before saying softly, “Connor, thank you so much for today’s matter…”
Miss Sachs, why are you being so polite with me? Hurry up and drive away…”
Connor looked at Melissa with a faint smile, then reached out and closed the car door.
The innocent Melissa felt that what Connor said just now was true. If this sports car really belonged to Connor’s friend, then he really had a way to solve this problem.
Melissa definitely couldn’t afford the repair fee of one or two million dollars, so she hesitated for a moment and thanked Connor again before starting the car.
After Connor saw Melissa start the car, he finally let out a sigh of relief. No matter what, as long as Melissa was taken away, the rest of the matter would be easy to solve.
“Hey! What are you two doing? Are you trying to run?”
However, before Melissa drove away, two men in security uniforms rushed towards Melissa and Connor.
When Connor saw the security guard coming over, he shouted in his heart, “Miss Sachs, hurry up and drive away. What are you waiting for?”
“Stop right there! Neither of you can leave today!”
After the security guard heard Connor’s words, he hurriedly shouted at the top of his voice..

chapters.title: Chapter 411 - 411: Insensible Security Guards
chapters.content:
Chapter 411: Insensible Security Guards
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
In the parking lot of the Empire World Building.
Connor had just explained his relationship with the sports car’s owner to Melissa, and Mellisa had accepted Connor’s suggestion and wanted to drive away.
However, no one expected that as Melissa was about to drive away, all the security guards in the parking lot rushed out.
This was the parking lot of the Empire World Corporation. The parking lot had countless luxury cars, so the security was very good.
The security guards had seen Melissa crash the sports car, but they didn’t come over to intervene when they saw Melissa squatting on the ground and waiting for the car owner to come over.
However, the security guard had never expected a poor kid to appear out of nowhere and incite Melissa to leave.
If the security guards let Melissa go, they wouldn’t be able to come to work tomorrow.
“Melissa, what are you waiting for? Hurry up and drive!” Connor shouted anxiously at Melissa when he saw the security guard rushing toward them.
“Connor, I… 1 think I should stay here. What if I run away and get caught by them?”
Melissa was just an inexperienced college student. When had he ever experienced such a thing?
When he saw the security guards running toward her like crazy, she became even more nervous.
“If you don’t run now, you won’t have a chance later!” Connor shouted at Melissa helplessly.
Melissa looked at Connor with a troubled gaze. She didn’t know what to do.
“Young lady, there are cameras in this parking lot. If you run away now, the cameras have already recorded all your actions. Do you think you can hide? If the driver calls the police, the police would be able to catch you very quickly!” At this moment, the middle-aged man walked up and shouted at Melissa again.
“That’s right, young lady. Don’t do anything stupid. If you run away now, it will be considered a hit-and-run. The consequences will be dire!”
The others also stepped forward to persuade Melissa.
After hearing the words of these onlookers, Connor was disappointed. He wanted to rush up and slap each of them.
This car belonged to Connor. He didn’t want to expose his identity in front of Melissa, so he asked Melissa to leave. After Melissa left, Connor would naturally deal with the rest.
However, Connor did not expect that these onlookers would be so nosy. Not only did they stop Melissa from leaving, but they even threatened her that this was a hit-and-run!
Melissa seemed to be frightened by these people’s words. She turned to Connor and said, “Connor, I know you’re kind enough to help me today, but let’s wait for the car owner to come back…”
After saying this, Melissa stopped the car, pushed open the door, and got out.
When Connor saw Melissa leave the car, he was speechless.
“Since you want to stay here and wait for the car owner to come, you can wait here…” Connor helplessly replied to Melissa, then turned around and prepared to leave.
Connor felt that since Melissa did not plan to leave, he should leave first.
Melissa couldn’t wait here forever. Therefore, Connor planned to wait until the dead of the night. After Melissa and the onlookers had left, he would secretly drive the car away. In this way, as long as he didn’t ask Melissa to take responsibility, Melissa wouldn’t have to pay any compensation.
“Little brat, did 1 say 1 will let you go?”
When the security guard in the parking lot saw Connor was about to leave, he hurriedly shouted at the top of his lungs.
In the eyes of these security guards, Connor and Melissa were obviously in cahoots, so they would not let Connor leave so easily.
After Connor heard the security guard’s words, he couldn’t help but look back.
Then, he cursed in a low voice and continued to walk away.
“I told you to stop. Didn’t you hear me?”
The security guard saw that Connor had no intention of stopping. Instead, he continued to walk forward and shouted angrily.
“Sir, that person is my classmate. He has nothing to do with this…” Melissa quickly stood up and explained to the security guard.
“We saw it clearly from over there just now. This kid instigated you to escape, so this kid can’t leave. He must stay with you and wait for the car owner to come!” the security guard shouted righteously.
The security guard’s voice was very loud just now. Connor, who was less than 500 meters away from them, heard it clear as day.
A trace of helplessness flashed in his eyes after Connor heard the security guard’s words. Then, he could not help but curse in his heart, ‘From where did Thomas find these stupid security guards? They don’t even know their boss…’ Although he felt like he was being bullied, Connor subconsciously quickened his pace. He knew it would be troublesome if the security guards caught him.
When the security guards saw that Connor was walking faster and faster, they thought he was guilty and wanted to escape, so they hurriedly rushed toward Connor.
After hesitating, Connor couldn’t care less. He strode out of the parking lot. “These idiots! I’ll get Thomas to fire all of you tomorrow…”
Connor mumbled as he ran, looking at the security guards chasing him.
Connor’s physical fitness was very good. He had been delivering food all year round, so his speed was not something these security guards could compare to.
In the blink of an eye, Connor was a few hundred meters away from the security guards behind him.
When the security guards saw Connor running further and further away, they hurriedly stopped and took out their walkie-talkies. They whispered, “Captain, captain, someone crashed into a car in the parking lot and wants to escape. He’s about to reach the exit of the building.”
“Roger!” A reply came from the walkie-talkie.
When Connor saw that the security guards behind him did not catch up, he heaved a sigh of relief. He instinctively slowed down his pace and walked toward the street.
However, at this moment, a large group of security guards suddenly rushed out of the Empire World Building.
Connor was instantly dumbfounded when he saw these security guards!

chapters.title: Chapter 412 - 412: Scarlett Moore Appears
chapters.content:
Chapter 412: Scarlett Moore Appears
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Just as Connor ran out of the parking lot, he saw a large group of security guards rushing out of the Empire World Building. His expression immediately turned ugly.
“Do these security guards have nothing better to do?” Connor cursed desperately. Then, he turned around and was about to run away.
However, there were too many security guards rushing out of the Empire World Building. They rushed up to Connor and surrounded him in less than two minutes.
“Kid, did you hit someone else’s car just now? Hurry up and follow me to the security room…”
The head security guard’s eyes widened and shouted at Connor angrily.
Connor hesitated after hearing the head security guard’s order. After confirming that Melissa was absent, he asked the head security guard expressionlessly, “Do you know who I am?”
“I don’t know who you are, but I know you hit someone else’s car just now, so you can’t leave yet!” the security captain shouted at Connor seriously.
“If you don’t know who 1 am, I can tell you now. I’m the chairman of Empire World Corporation. The Ferrari that was hit in the parking lot is my car, so get out of my way now. Otherwise, I’ll fire all of you tomorrow,” Connor told the head security guard expressionlessly.
After hearing Connor’s words, the security captain was stunned. Then, he sized up Connor and began to laugh.
The others also laughed out loud. They looked at Connor as if he was an idiot.
“Kid, you said you’re the chairman of Empire World Corporation?” the security captain asked Connor mockingly.
Connor looked at the security captain helplessly. For a moment, he didn’t know what to say because he could see from the expressions on the faces of these security guards that these people didn’t know him at all!
“You didn’t even hit the nail on the head. Who doesn’t know that the chairman of Empire World Corporation is Mr. Thomas Morgan? If you were the chairman of Empire World Corporation, my name would be written backward!” the security captain shouted at Connor. Then, he turned and shouted at his subordinates, “Alright, cut the crap. Quickly take this brat away…”
Connor stood where he was, completely helpless. He thought it was all his fault for being too low-key. Now, even the security guards of his company did not recognize him.
‘Looks like 1 have to show my face in the company more often in the future. Otherwise, it’ll be so embarrassing if something like this happens again…’ Connor couldn’t help but mutter in his heart. Then, he took out his phone and said expressionlessly, “You guys don’t know me, right?”
“Yeah, who are you?” the security captain replied with an unusually disdainful expression.
“It doesn’t matter if you don’t know me as long as you know Thomas Morgan. I’ll call him now.” After Connor said this, he was about to call Thomas.
However, at this moment, Melissa ran out of the parking lot and shouted, “Connor didn’t hit that car. Connor is just my university classmate. Let Connor go!”
When Connor saw Melissa running out of the parking lot, a trace of helplessness flashed in his eyes. He knew that Melissa would know his identity if he called Thomas now.
Therefore, after Connor hesitated, he put down his phone.
The head security guard looked at Melissa, running out of the parking lot, and said, “No matter who hit this car, the two of you can’t leave now. You must follow me to the security room to wait for the owner…”
Melissa looked at the head security guard with a hint of helplessness in her eyes. She didn’t expect Connor to be involved in this.
“Kid, didn’t you want to call Mr. Morgan just now? Why did you stop? Does he not know Mr. Morgan’s phone number? If you don’t, I can tell you now!” Seeing that Connor didn’t make a call, the security captain smiled and said to Connor.
Connor narrowed his eyes and looked at the head security guard. He seemed extremely helpless. All he could think about now was waiting for a chance to fire this stupid security guard. He was so blind!
“Alright, since you’re not going to call, the two of you can follow me to the security room!” The security captain waved his hand and walked into the Empire World Building.
Connor also knew that with so many security guards surrounding him, he couldn’t escape. Moreover, Connor could not contact Thomas now, so he could only choose to leave with the head security guard first and then find an opportunity to contact Thomas.
“Connor, I’m really sorry. 1 didn’t expect that today’s matter to involve you!”
Melissa walked to Connor and said to him, embarrassed.
After Connor heard Melissa’s words, he couldn’t help but turn to look at Melissa and then said with a smile, “Melissa, don’t worry. That Ferrari belongs to my friend. My friend will not make things difficult for you because of me…”
Melissa looked up at Connor and didn’t say anything.
Melissa felt that Connor was bragging. If that sports car belonged to Connor’s friend, why did Connor run away just now?
However, Melissa didn’t expose Connor to save his face.
Connor and Melissa followed behind the head security guard into the Empire World Building.
‘Click, clack, click, clack…’
However, just as they were about to enter the Empire World Building, the sound of high heels clicking against the floor suddenly came from behind Connor.
When the head security guard heard the footsteps, he instinctively turned around and saw the lobby manager, Scarlett Moore, walking over.
“Hello, Ms. Moore!” the security captain greeted Scarlett politely.
“Mr. Calnan, what happened? Why is it so noisy over here?” Scarlett asked the head security guard.
“Ms. Moore, these two just crashed into a sports car in our parking lot. This kid wanted to escape just now, but I caught him…” The head security guard quickly replied.
“I see!” Scarlett replied indifferently, then subconsciously looked at Connor.
However, when Scarlett saw Connor, she was completely shocked..

chapters.title: Chapter 413 - 413: That Sports Car Is Mine!
chapters.content:
Chapter 413: That Sports Car Is Mine!
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Originally, Connor planned to follow the head security guard to the security room first, then find an opportunity to call Thomas and get him to communicate with the head security guard.
However, Connor never expected that he and Melissa would bump into Scarlett before entering Empire World Building.
The head security guard didn’t know Connor, but Scarlett did!
Moreover, Scarlett had been planning how to hook up with Connor for the past few days. Therefore, when Scarlett saw Connor, she was stunned.
“Ms. Moore, if nothing else, I’ll bring these two people in first.”
The head security guard did not notice the strange expression on Scarlett’s face at all. He smiled and spoke to Scarlett.
Scarlett ignored the head security guard. Instead, she approached Connor and said excitedly, “Mr. McDonald, why are you here?”
After Connor heard Scarlett’s words, a trace of helplessness flashed in his eyes. He knew that he might not be able to hide it anymore.
The head security guard and Melissa were stunned when they heard Scarlett. It was obvious that Scarlett knew Connor. Otherwise, why would she call Connor ‘Mr. McDonald’?
“Ms. Moo… Ms. Moore, do… Do you know this kid?”
The head security guard hesitated and asked Scarlett with a trembling voice.
“Florian, do you want to be fired from Empire World Corporation? Do you know who this person is? You even dare to arrest Mr. McDonald. Are you crazy?”
Scarlett’s fox-like eyes widened as she shouted at the head security guard, unnerved.
When the head security guard heard Scarlett’s words, he was completely dumbfounded. He asked Scarlett with a trembling voice, “Ms. Moore, who…Who is this person?”
“Mr. McDonald is the chairman of Empire World Corporation…” Scarlett shouted angrily.
When everyone heard Scarlett’s claim, they were all stunned. They were indescribably shocked!
Previously, Connor had told Florian Calnan that he was the chairman of the Empire World Corporation, but Florian didn’t take Connor seriously at all. He thought that Connor was just bragging.
However, he never expected Scarlett to say that Connor was the chairman of Empire World Corporation. This confused Florian.
Melissa stood beside Connor with an even more incredulous expression because she knew Connor better than anyone else present.
She knew that Connor was just a poor student. He usually relied on delivering food to earn his living expenses. How did he suddenly become the chairman of Empire World Corporation?
“Ms. Moore, are you kidding me? Isn’t the chairman of our group AAr. Morgan? How could it be this kid?” Florian said to Scarlett with a bitter smile.
“What do you know…” Scarlett started to explain.
When Connor saw that the situation was not going the way he wanted to, he hurriedly reached out to stop Scarlett and said, “Ms. Moore, I think you should make it clear to everyone. I’m not the chairman of Empire World Corporation. I’m just a friend of the chairman of Empire World Corporation, Thomas…”
Scarlett was stunned when she heard Connor’s words. Then, she looked at Connor suspiciously.
Connor was worried that Scarlett did not understand what he meant, so he continued to blink pointedly at Scarlett.
Scarlett was a very smart woman. Moreover, she knew Connor did not like exposing his identity, so she naturally understood what Connor meant.
She quickly smiled and said, “That’s right. Mr. McDonald is A4r. Morgan’s friend. How dare you arrest Mr. Morgan’s friend? Florian, do you want to be fired?”
Florian immediately understood what Scarlett meant, and his expression turned ugly.
Although Connor was not the chairman of Empire World Corporation, he was Thomas Morgan’s friend. Just this relationship alone was enough to make Florian suffer.
“Mr. McDonald, I’m really sorry. I was blind and didn’t know you were Mr. Morgan’s friend. If 1 had known, I wouldn’t have dared to speak to you like that, right?”
Florian was able to get to the position of head security guard, so he could read people’s expressions.
He hurriedly ran to Connor and apologized to him with a smile.
Connor looked at Florian helplessly and sighed in his heart. If Florian had let him go just now, wouldn’t everything have been fine?
“Can my friend and I leave now?” Connor was not in the mood to talk nonsense with Florian and asked him.
Florian looked at Connor and hesitated before saying, “Mr. McDonald, of course, you can leave now, but your friend has crashed into someone else’s car in the parking lot. We might have to communicate with this lady about the situation, so she can’t leave now. Otherwise, when the sports car owner comes over and finds out that someone has hit his car, we won’t be able to explain it to him…”
After A/Ielissa heard Florian’s words, she couldn’t help but turn to look at Connor. Then, she whispered, “Connor, you should leave first. I was indeed the one who crashed into someone else’s car today. This is what I should take care of…”
“Yes, this young lady makes sense!”
Florian nodded with a smile, then looked at Connor and said, “Mr. McDonald, don’t worry. Since this lady is your friend, 1’11 speak up for her when the car owner appears. I’ll try to get her a discount for the compensation…”
Connor looked at Florian and Melissa, helpless.
The car owner was standing before the two of them, but they couldn’t tell.
Seeing that things had come to this point, there was no point hiding it.
Moreover, Melissa was waiting for the car owner to return. If he did not expose his identity, they would not be able to meet the car owner even if they waited until they died.
“Alright, you don’t have to wait for the car owner to return!” Connor hesitated and said expressionlessly.
“Why not?” Melissa asked him, puzzled.
“Because that car is mine!” Connor replied directly.
“Yours?” Melissa stared at Connor, shocked!
“Mr. McDonald, stop joking with us. How can that car be yours?” Florian said to Connor with a smile.
However, Scarlett was very calm because she knew that since Connor said the car was his, it must be his!
After all, among so many people present, only Scarlett knew Connor’s true identity..

chapters.title: Chapter 414 - 414: You’d Better Tell Me the Truth
chapters.content:
Chapter 414: You’d Better Tell Me the Truth
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
At Empire World Building.
When Connor claimed that the sports car was his, everyone was stunned.
Especially Melissa, her big bright eyes were filled with confusion.
When Connor said the sports car was his friend’s, Melissa felt it was unbelievable. But now, Connor claimed that he was the owner. Melissa didn’t know what Connor wanted to do.
“Connor, I know you want to help me, but you don’t have to lie. It’s my responsibility as I crashed into someone else’s car. If the other party asks me to compensate, I will compensate.”
Melissa knew that Connor was only saying this to help her, but she felt Connor’s claim was too stupid.
As long as one had a brain, one should be able to see that Connor did not look like someone who could afford to drive such a sports car.
“That’s right, Mr. McDonald. Don’t kid us…” Florian said to Connor helplessly.
“I said that this sports car is mine, so it’s mine!” Connor replied unusually domineeringly, then turned around and walked toward the parking lot.
When everyone saw Connor walking toward the parking lot, they were all puzzled. Now, they did not know what Connor wanted to do.
“Let’s go over and take a look. 1 don’t think Mr. McDonald will lie!” Scarlett pouted and said to Florian, Melissa, and the others. Then, she walked toward the parking lot.
A few minutes later, Connor brought Melissa, Florian, and the others to the Ferrari.
Onlookers were still surrounding Connor’s sports car. From time to time, they would whisper a few words.
“Such a good sports car has been crashed into such a state…”
“Yeah, if the owner sees this, he’ll be heartbroken. I heard that this sports car is quite expensive…”
“I estimate the repair fee will be at least one to two million. What a pity…”
Everyone pointed at Connor’s sports car as if the Ferrari was theirs.
“Please make way. Don’t crowd around here!” After Connor saw that these people had surrounded his sports car, he had no way to get to his car, so he could only shout helplessly.
“All, isn’t this the kid who escaped just now? How dare you come back?”
“That’s right. How can you still have the face to come back? He left the little girl here!”
“This kid is not a good person. He wanted to run away after crashing into someone else’s car. He’s so shameless…”
When everyone saw Connor, they all criticized him with disdainful expression.
Connor was not in the mood to pay attention to these people now. He removed the car key from his clothes and gently pressed it.
‘Beep beep!’ the Ferrari sounded.
When everyone heard the sound of the Ferrari, they were all stunned and turned to look around the parking lot.
“Is the owner of the car here?”
“It must be the owner of the car. Otherwise, why would the car beep…”
“This car owner must be a rich heir to be able to afford such a sports car!”
Everyone saw the sports car unlock but didn’t realize Connor had pressed the car key. They continued to discuss it foolishly.
“Please make way. Didn’t you hear me?” Connor shouted impatiently, then pushed the young man in front of the sports car away and opened the door. “Brat, what are you doing?” When everyone saw Connor open the car door, they shouted at him agitatedly.
H ii
Connor ignored these people. After opening the car door, he got into the sports car and started the car.
“Vroom!”
The fiery red supercar let out a deafening roar.
After seeing this scene, everyone present was too stunned to speak.
Connor slowly rolled down the car window and shouted at the onlookers expressionlessly, “Do you know what I want now? I’m the owner of this sports car. What do you think I’m going to do?”
Everyone was instantly dumbfounded when Connor was sitting in the sports car. They could not hide the surprise on their faces.
Connor started the car in front of everyone. Now, no one dared to think that Connor was not the owner of this sports car.
However, everyone could not understand that since Connor owned this sports car, why did Connor run away just now? Why didn’t he say that he was the owner of this car?
Florian and Melissa also understood that Connor wasn’t bragging. He was indeed the owner of this sports car.
However, the two of them were also dumbfounded. They gaped, speechless.
“Can my friend leave now?” Connor asked Florian.
“Yes… Yes!” Florian nodded without thinking. After all, if this sports car belonged to Connor, then Connor could do whatever he wanted. Florian naturally did not dare to meddle in other people’s business.
“Alright, you guys don’t have to stand around here anymore,” Scarlett tactfully shouted at the crowd, smiled at Connor, and turned around to walk toward the Empire World Building.
Florian quickly left with the security guards.
The onlookers who had originally planned to watch the show did not expect such an outcome.
Although they were still slightly surprised that Connor could afford such a luxurious car since Connor had already proved his identity, they could do nothing if they stayed here, so they went their ways.
After everyone left, only Connor and Melissa were left in the parking lot.
Melissa stood rooted to the ground, dumbfounded. She knew Connor was just a poor student, but she couldn’t understand how Connor could suddenly afford such a luxury car.
Melissa felt that this was not as simple as she thought!
“Melissa!” Connor laughed and nudged Melissa.
“Connor, did you steal this car? How can you afford such a sports car?”
Melissa hesitated, then quickly walked up to Connor and asked curiously.
“Stole it?” Connor was stunned when he heard Melissa’s question.
“Connor, you’d better tell me the truth. What’s going on with this sports car? If you don’t tell me the truth, 1’11 call the police now!”
Melissa took out her phone as she spoke as if she was going to call the police..

chapters.title: Chapter 415 - 415: Unrewarded Kindness
chapters.content:
Chapter 415: Unrewarded Kindness
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
In the parking lot.
Connor spent a lot of effort to convince Florian and the others that the car was his.
However, Connor didn’t expect that Melissa still didn’t believe that the sports car was hers. She even assumed Connor had stolen it.
Connor was angrier because he had helped Melissa out of kindness. Yet, Melissa was ready to call the police and tell them to come and arrest him!
Connor finally experienced someone being ungrateful toward him!
“Melissa, what do you mean?” Connor frowned and asked Melissa unhappily.
He had never expected Melissa to do this. Even if this car wasn’t his, she couldn’t just call the police to arrest him, right?
“Connor, is this sports car really yours?” Melissa asked him earnestly.
“Now that the car keys are in my hands and I’m already sitting in the car, whose car do you think it is if not mine?” Connor asked Melissa impatiently.
“Do you know how much this car is worth?” Melissa asked Connor, surprised.
“…” Connor looked at Melissa and said nothing.
“If you don’t, I can tell you that this Ferrari is a limited edition model. There are less than twenty of them worldwide; we only have this one in Porthampton. You must have stolen this car, right?”
After Melissa crashed into the sports car, she immediately took out her phone and looked up the car’s information online. She would not have known if she had not looked it up. Once she did, she was shocked!
Melissa never dreamed that this sports car would be so expensive. This was why she was on the ground, crying. She knew that even if her family was well-off, she still could not afford to pay for the maintenance of this sports car.
That was why Melissa was shocked when Connor claimed the sports car was his. She knew Connor’s financial situation. How could a poor student who didn’t even have the money to pay his tuition fees afford such a luxury car? Melissa would never believe it!
“Melissa, what do you mean?” Connor asked Melissa.
“Connor, if you stole this sports car, 1 advise you to return the car to the owner as soon as possible. Maybe the owner will forgive you on account of your young age, but if you continue to drive this sports car around, you will be caught by the police sooner or later,” Melissa advised Connor.
Connor sat in the sports car, speechless. This sports car was originally his, so who would he return it to?
“Melissa, this Ferrari is really mine…” Connor explained to Melissa.
“Connor, you’re still lying to me, right? Believe me, I’ll call the police now?” Melissa shouted at Connor.
“So you don’t believe 1 can afford to drive such a car?”
Connor was trying to help Melissa out of kindness today, but he didn’t expect Melissa to treat him like this. He felt miserable, so his tone was a little emotional.
“Connor, if this was just an ordinary car, 1 might believe you, but this sports car is worth more than ten million dollars. How do 1 believe you? Are you going to tell me that you bought the car with the money you earned from delivering food?” Melissa asked Connor, agitated.
“Buying a car with the money 1 earned from delivering food?” Connor couldn’t help but laugh when he heard Melissa’s words. He wasn’t laughing at Melissa but at himself.
He laughed at himself for being so generous to help Melissa. If Connor knew this would be the result, he would never have stepped up to help Melissa.
“Connor, I advise you to return the car to him as soon as possible. When the time comes, I will plead for you. 1 believe that the car owner will forgive you and not hold it against you!” Melissa said to Connor seriously.
“This car is mine. Who do you want me to return it to?” Connor shouted at Melissa.
“Connor, why are you still not telling the truth now? Do you believe that 1 will call the police right now?” Melissa raised her phone and shouted.
“If you want to call the police, then just call them. 1 don’t want to waste my time with you!” Connor replied impatiently and started the car.
“Vroom!”
The sports car let out an ear-piercing roar and then rushed toward the street.
When Melissa saw that Connor was about to drive away, she hurriedly shouted, “Connor, don’t be stubborn. Come back quickly…”
Connor acted as if he didn’t hear Melissa. He floored the accelerator and disappeared from Melissa’s sight.
Melissa stood in place and watched Connor disappear. Her gaze was extremely complicated.
“How did Connor turn out like this?” Melissa couldn’t help but mutter. Then, she picked up her phone and was about to call the police.
She did not want Connor to continue making mistakes like this.
However, when Melissa called the police, she hesitated before hanging up.
“I can’t call the police yet. If I call the police, Connor’s life will be ruined. 1 must persuade Connor to hurry up and return the car…”
Melissa muttered softly, then turned around and entered her Mercedes-Benz, disappearing into the parking lot.
***
Meanwhile, Connor drove his fiery red Ferrari, instantly attracting the attention of many.
It couldn’t be helped. Connor’s sports car was too dazzling. No matter where it went, it would attract attention.
Meanwhile, Connor, who was in the car, did not look too pleased. He didn’t care if Melissa called the police or not.
Even if Melissa called the police, Connor had nothing to fear. After all, this car was indeed his. Many people in the 4S showroom could testify for Connor.
However, Connor wasn’t in a good mood. He had wanted to help Melissa out of kindness, but he didn’t expect Melissa to accuse him. The feeling of being misunderstood was really uncomfortable.
A few minutes later, Connor drove to Chloe Lawson’s showroom.
After parking the car, Connor walked straight into the showroom.
However, before Connor could enter the showroom, he saw a middle-aged fatty wearing gold-rimmed glasses standing before Chloe. He was scolding her angrily. His insults were extremely unbearable.
When Connor saw this, a trace of anger flashed across his face. He pushed open the door of the showroom and walked into it..

chapters.title: Chapter 416 - 416: The Vile Manager, Mr. Queen
chapters.content:
Chapter 416: The Vile Manager, Mr. Queen
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
In the showroom.
A middle-aged man in a suit and gold-rimmed spectacles stood in front of Chloe Lawson, cursing her with a savage expression.
When Connor saw this scene, he could not help but frown.
He could feel that Chloe was being scolded because he didn’t buy any villas that day.
After the employees in the showroom saw Chloe being scolded, they all hid far away as if they were afraid of being implicated. No one stood up for Chloe.
“Chloe is so pitiful. She was already the vice president of Evergrande Real Estate, but who would have thought that she would be deceived by a person pretending to be a rich heir!”
“That’s right. I heard that our company’s president was very angry when he found out about this. He demoted Chloe from vice president to salesperson…” “She was demoted to a salesperson? This is really a direct drop from heaven to hell!”
“If it wasn’t for this, how would the new manager dare to speak to Chloe like this?”
“Exactly. Mr. Mason was fired because of Chloe. Sigh…”
A few sales ladies gathered together and began to discuss in low voices.
When Connor heard these sales ladies talking, a trace of helplessness flashed across his eyes.
Because Connor knew that the person who pretended to be a rich heir was him.
Because Connor didn’t buy any villas that day, Chloe was implicated and demoted from the company’s vice president to an ordinary employee in the showroom.
The new manager, Mr. Queen, saw that Chloe looked good and had a hot figure, so he wanted to sleep with her.
It was a pity that a woman like Chloe did not like him, the manager of the showroom. In Chloe’s eyes, even if she could not find a super-rich guy like Connor, she should at least find a company president as a partner.
Therefore, Chloe directly rejected Mr. Queen in front of everyone, and her words were very unpleasant. This made Mr. Queen feel very embarrassed, so he started to find trouble and bully Chloe incessantly.
Chloe was only a few minutes late today, but she was being scolded by Mr. Queen.
Although Chloe seemed to be a strong woman, she was being scolded for so long in front of so many colleagues and customers. Any normal person would probably not be able to take it.
At this moment, Chloe’s makeup was smudged from all the crying. She looked pitiful, making people want to hug her and comfort her.
However, Mr. Queen continued to insult Chloe, as if he had no intention of stopping.
“Why is Mr. Queen being so relentless?”
“That’s right. Chloe was only a few minutes late.”
“I think we should be more careful of Mr. Queen in the future. I think this person might be a little perverted. Is there a need to take revenge on Chloe like this?”
A few sales ladies hid in the distance and discussed softly.
As Connor was not very far away from these girls, he could hear what these girls were saying.
“Chloe was already the vice president of our company. If it weren’t for that Mr. McDonald from that day, how could she have fallen to this state?”
“Yeah, it’s all that stupid loser’s fault. If he didn’t have money, why did he pretend to be a rich heir? He should have said so earlier if he couldn’t afford a villa! Now, not only did she cause Chloe to lose her job, but she is also being harassed by this old pervert!”
When Connor heard what these girls said, a trace of embarrassment flashed across his eyes.
He knew that Chloe was in this state because of him.
Connor took a deep breath and walked toward Chloe.
“Chloe, do you know what you’ve done wrong today?”
At this time, Mr. Queen calmed down and asked Chloe in a low voice.
When Chloe heard Mr. Queen’s words, she took a deep breath and said unwillingly, “Ye… Yes!”
“As long as you know what you’ve done wrong!”
Mr. Queen smiled faintly and then whispered to Chloe, “Chloe, I’m actually saying this for your own good. You’re no longer the vice president of the company. If you’re late, wouldn’t it be a little unfair to the other colleagues?” “Yes, sir!”
Chloe looked at the temperamental Mr. Queen in front of her and nodded helplessly.
“Chloe, are you free tonight? If you have time, how about having a meal with me?”
Mr. Queen bared his teeth and asked Chloe with a wretched look.
When Chloe heard Mr. Queen’s words, a hint of helplessness flashed across her face. She knew that Mr. Queen was talking about something more than just eating.
“Chloe, you should know very well how I treat you. As long as you can be my girlfriend, I promise that no one will dare to bully you again.”
Mr. Queen continued after seeing that Chloe did not respond.
“Jared Queen, how many times have I told you? I don’t like you, and I won’t be your girlfriend!”
Chloe responded to Mr. Queen’s sudden confession huffily.
“Chloe, why are you pretending to be so high and mighty? It’s not like I haven’t heard of your nonsense. You like money, right? I’ll give you money. How much do you want to book a room with me?”
Jared shouted angrily at Chloe.
When Chloe heard Jared’s words, a trace of anger flashed in her eyes. She gritted her teeth and said to Jared, “Jared Queen, are you still human? You’re already married, yet you’re still flirting with me! Also, you just asked me how much money 1 need to get a room with you, right? I’m telling you now, the money 1 want is not something you can ever fork out. You’d better know your place. You’re just a small showroom manager. What right do you have to book a room with me?”
After being humiliated by Chloe, Jared’s expression suddenly became gloomy. He did not expect Chloe to be so direct.
“You’re a f*cking b*tch. Why are you being so pretentious?”
Jared cursed, then raised his right hand and was about to hit Chloe’s face..

chapters.title: Chapter 417 - 417: Get Out of the Showroom!
chapters.content:
Chapter 417: Get Out of the Showroom!
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
But before Jared’s hand could hit Chloe’s face, Connor suddenly appeared and grabbed Jared’s wrist.
Jared was stunned for a moment before he turned to look at Connor.
“Who are you? Let go of my hand!”
Jared’s eyes widened as he shouted at Connor angrily.
“What are you trying to prove in hitting a woman? If you want to prove yourself, come and fight with me!”
Connor said to Jared in an unusually domineering manner.
At this moment, Chloe saw Connor, and trace of excitement flashed in her eyes because she did not expect that the person who stood up to help her at this time would actually be Connor.
The employees in the showroom seemed to have recognized Connor!
“Isn’t this the rich guy from yesterday?”
“Yeah, how dare he come to our showroom?”
“If it wasn’t for him, Chloe wouldn’t have been bullied like this. This guy actually has the face to come here…”
Everyone looked at Connor and whispered.
Although these employees hated what Jared did to Chloe, they felt that the culprit was Connor.
If it weren’t for Connor, Chloe wouldn’t have fallen to this state. Therefore, these employees hated Connor even more.
Jared turned his head and glared at Connor. He said expressionlessly, “I told you to let go, didn’t you hear me?”
“If you apologize to Chloe now, I’ll let you go!”
Connor gritted his teeth and replied in a low voice.
“No, who do you think you are? What does it have to do with you if 1 teach my employees a lesson?”
Jared shouted at Connor with an extremely ferocious expression.
“Mr. McDonald, this matter has nothing to do with you. You should leave!”
Chloe hesitated for a moment and quickly said to Connor.
“I said, if you apologize to Chloe now, I will let you go. Do you understand me?”
Connor said calmly to Jared.
H ii
Jared looked at Connor and hesitated for a moment. Then, he asked with widened eyes, “Do you know who I am?”
“I don’t care who you are. Even if you are the king, you must apologize to Chloe today!”
Connor was still very calm. People like Jared were nothing in Connor’s eyes.
“Who the f*ck do you think you are? If I don’t apologize today, what can you do to me?”
Seeing that Connor looked like a loser, he thought that Connor might be Chloe’s bootlicker, so he didn’t take Connor seriously at all.
“What can I do to you?”
When Connor heard Jared’s words, he could not help but smile faintly.
When Chloe saw that something was wrong, she quickly ran to Connor and whispered to him, “Connor, I know you’re doing this for my own good, but I beg you, don’t continue to cause trouble. Otherwise, 1 really won’t be able to settle this…”
Chloe knew that the current Connor was no longer the Connor from before. Although Connor didn’t explain his situation to Chloe that day, she could vaguely feel that something big might have happened to Connor. Otherwise, Connor’s funds wouldn’t have been frozen by the bank.
Therefore, Chloe was worried that if he continued to cause trouble, there might be some danger. Moreover, she might also be fired by the company.
“Kid, 1 advise you to be sensible and let go of my hand. Otherwise, 1 will definitely make you suffer!”
Jared glared at Connor with a vicious expression.
Jared did not put Connor in his eyes at all because he was not only the manager of the showroom, but also the nephew of Harry Queen, the new vice president of Evergrande Real Estate. It was because of this relationship that Jared dared to bully Chloe so unscrupulously!
“Connor, this person is the nephew of our company’s vice president. He’s not someone we can afford to provoke. Can you let him go?”
Chloe said to Connor anxiously.
Connor didn’t know who Jared’s uncle was, but Chloe knew very well.
Jared’s uncle was called Harry Queen. He had a good relationship with the president of Evergrande Real Estate. Moreover, Harry was considered a very famous gangster in Porthampton. He had a lot of underlings and was quite famous in Porthampton.
Back then, Harry mainly carried out forced evictions in Porthampton. No matter how powerful the people were, as long as it was in Harry’s hands, they would eventually move obediently.
Real estate companies were actually most afraid of people who refused to leave, and Harry happened to have a way to deal with these people. That was why the president of Evergrande Real Estate asked Harry to be the vice president.
Jared relied on his uncle’s connections to become the manager of the showroom.
This was also the reason why Chloe still didn’t dare to resist even though she was being bullied by Jared. She knew that she was just a weak woman. People like Harry and Jared weren’t people she could afford to provoke. Of course, she didn’t want to see Connor offend these people.
If Connor was still the same guy from before, Chloe would definitely be very happy to see him deal with Jared.
But unfortunately, the current Connor was no longer the person from before.
“Is this person crazy? He even dares to provoke Mr. Queen!”
“That’s right. I think there must be something wrong with this person’s brain. Back then, he pretended to be a rich heir and said that he wanted to buy all the villas in our showroom. Now, he’s here to be a hero and has offended Mr. Queen.”
“He actually has the face to come here. If it wasn’t for him, how could Chloe have ended up like this?”
At this moment, the surrounding girls began to whisper among themselves.
When Connor heard Chloe’s words, he couldn’t help but take a deep breath and slowly let go of Jared’s arm.
When Jared’s arm was grabbed by Connor, he felt as if he was being clamped by an iron clamp. In less than a minute, his arm had already started to ache.
“Kid, at least you have some foresight. As long as you apologize to me now and get out of the showroom, I won’t stoop to your level!”
Jared knew that Connor must have let go of him because he was afraid of his identity, so he said to Connor arrogantly..

chapters.title: Chapter 418 - 418: Falling in Love with Connor
chapters.content:
Chapter 418: Falling in Love with Connor
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
When Chloe heard Jared’s words, she finally heaved a sigh of relief.
Because she knew that as long as Connor apologized to Jared now, today’s incident might just be over.
However, she probably did not know that Connor would never apologize to someone like Jared.
Today, when they were in the parking lot of the Empire World Building, Connor kindly saved Melissa Sachs, but she made a false accusation and mistook him for a thief.
This matter had already made Connor feel discomfort.
After arriving at the showroom, Connor saw that Chloe was being bullied because of him. He got even angrier.
Connor couldn’t vent his anger on Melissa, but he could vent it on Jared.
Jared was the nephew of the vice president of Evergrande Real Estate. In Chloe’s eyes, he was not someone to be trifled with.
But in Connor’s eyes, he was nothing at all.
At most, Connor could just buy Evergrande Real Estate and let Chloe be the president.
Jared probably did not know that he had become Connor’s punching bag.
He felt that Connor had let go of him because he was afraid of him, so he smiled at Connor and said, “Kid, apologize to me now and get out of the showroom. 1 won’t stoop to the same level as people like you!”
“You won’t stoop to my level?”
When Connor heard Jared’s words, he could not help but sneer.
“That’s right, you seem to be quite smart…”
Jared opened his mouth and was about to speak.
Smack!
Connor didn’t even think about it and directly slapped Jared’s face.
Connor’s slap was very sudden. He did not give Jared any chance to react at all. Moreover, Connor had used up almost all of his strength in this slap, so the effect was very shocking.
Jared took two steps back and fell to the ground with a thud. Blood slowly flowed down his nose.
After seeing this scene, everyone present was stunned, and they were shocked to the core.
Chloe’s eyes were also wide open. She looked at Connor, and her chest heaved up and down.
Chloe never expected that the usually gentle and refined Connor would have such a fiery temper!
“Mr. McDonald, what are you doing?”
Chloe shouted.
Connor turned and glanced at Chloe. He didn’t say anything and walked toward Jared.
“You little brat, how dare you hit me?”
Jared did not expect Connor to hit him. He struggled to stand up and shouted at Connor with a ferocious expression.
“Do you know why 1 let go of you just now?”
Connor asked Jared expressionlessly.
Jared looked at Connor with a hint of confusion in his eyes because he did not know what Connor meant by this.
“I didn’t let you go just now because I was afraid of you, but because I wanted to free my hands to hit you!”
Connor looked at Jared and smiled coldly. Before Jared could react, Connor rushed toward him.
“Security! Hurry up and send someone!”
Jared knew very well that he was no match for Connor, so when he saw Connor rushing over, he hurriedly shouted at the top of his voice.
However, Jared often bullied the security guards in the showroom. When the security guards heard Jared’s cry for help, they acted as if they did not hear anything and stood there expressionlessly.
When Jared saw that the security guards were not moving at all, a trace of despair flashed across his eyes. He turned around and wanted to escape.
But at this moment, Connor had already rushed behind Jared. He reached out and grabbed Jared’s hair, then pressed him to the ground.
“Connor, I… I’m telling you, I’m Harry Queen’s nephew. If you dare to touch me today, I…”
When Jared was pressed to the ground by Connor, he shouted at Connor with a frightened expression.
But Connor couldn’t care less. He raised his right hand and slapped Jared’s face.
Smack!
A crisp sound rang out.
Blood immediately flowed out of Jared’s nose. The scene was unusually bloody.
When the girls in the showroom saw this scene, they covered their eyes one after another. They never thought that the seemingly refined Connor would be so ruthless.
And this slap was just the beginning. Connor pulled Jared’s hair and kept slapping Jared’s face.
“How dare you bully Chloe!”
“How dare you bully Chloe!”
H ii
Connor cursed as he hit.
Chloe, who was standing not far away, looked at Connor who was on top of Jared. She was very touched because she knew that Connor was so irritable today because of her.
Chloe suddenly had a feeling of being protected. This feeling was something that Chloe had never felt before.
When Chloe first met Connor, it was indeed because of money that she took the initiative to approach him.
But at this moment, Chloe felt that even if Connor did not have money, she could still dedicate herself to him.
‘Even if he doesn’t have money, to have a man like Mr. McDonald protecting me… 1 would still be happy, right?’
Chloe stared at Connor with her big, watery eyes. Her eyes were filled with gratitude.
At this time, Chloe felt that even if he did not have money, it was not that important.
Chloe felt that she might have really fallen in love with Connor. When you really fall in love with someone, you wouldn’t care if that person was rich or not!
Just as Chloe was infatuated, Connor waved his hand and kept slapping Jared. Basically, every slap used up all of Connor’s strength.
The reason why Connor was so angry today was partly to vent his anger for Chloe, and partly to vent the anger in his heart.
Because Connor had been very depressed during this period of time, so he had to vent all the anger in his heart.
After slapping dozens of times, Connor seemed to be a little tired, and his movements had clearly slowed down.
Jared was beaten black and blue. His entire face was swollen like a pig’s head. Blood was slowly flowing down his nose, and he could not help but tremble slightly.
“Stop!”
However, just as Connor was about to raise his right hand to slap Jared’s face again, the door of the showroom was suddenly pushed open!

chapters.title: Chapter 419 - 419: Kill This Kid
chapters.content:
Chapter 419: Kill This Kid
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
At this moment, a middle-aged man walked into the showroom with two bodyguards.
When everyone saw this middle-aged man, they all revealed surprised expressions.
When Chloe saw the middle-aged man, a trace of shock flashed across her eyes.
The middle-aged man was none other than Jared’s uncle, Harry Queen, who was the current vice president of Evergrande Real Estate.
Connor subconsciously turned his head to look at Harry.
“Hehe, this kid is dead for sure. Harry Queen is here!”
“I heard that Mr. Queen is a famous gangster in Porthampton. Now that Connor has beaten Jared up to this state, Mr. Queen will definitely not let Connor off easily…”
“Yeah, 1 want to see how this Connor guy will end up. It’s not so easy to be a hero saving a damsel in distress!”
When everyone saw Harry appear, they began to discuss in low voices.
Jared seemed to have seen his savior. He pushed Connor away and ran to Harry. He shouted, “Uncle, you’re finally here. This kid beat me up! You have to help me get justice today!”
Harry turned and looked at Jared’s swollen face. A trace of anger flashed in his eyes.
One had to know that Harry had no children, and his favorite person was Jared.
Seeing Jared being beaten up by Connor, he was naturally very angry.
Harry clenched his fists and strode to Connor. Then, he gritted his teeth and asked Connor fiercely, “Did you hit my nephew?”
“Yes!”
Connor lightly nodded.
“Haha…”
Harry couldn’t help but laugh when he saw Connor’s arrogant look. Then, he said with a disdainful expression, “1 don’t want to stoop to the same level as a kid like you. How about this? Get your parents here and we’ll talk!”
“I don’t have a family. If you want to say something, just tell me!”
Connor looked at Harry calmly and said in an indifferent tone.
“Kid, you have quite the character!”
Harry smiled coldly, then turned to the two bodyguards behind him and said, “Don’t just stand there. Capture this brat. 1 want to find a place with no one to have a good chat with him…”
When everyone heard Harry’s words, they could not help but gasp.
Everyone understood what Harry meant.
Chloe’s eyes flashed with despair because she knew that if Harry really took Connor away now, he would definitely end up very miserable.
Therefore, Chloe rushed to Harry and begged, “Mr. Queen, can you let him go for my sake? He was insensible and has offended you. Can you let him off this time?”
When Harry heard Chloe’s words, he glanced at her indifferently and then looked directly at her full chest. He licked his lips and said softly, “It’s you, Chloe!”
“Mr. Queen, this friend of mine doesn’t know that you’re Jared’s uncle. If he did, he wouldn’t have dared to lay a hand on Jared.”
Chloe was not in the mood to entertain Harry’s wretched gaze right now. She begged in a very humble tone.
Harry hesitated for a moment, then said with a wretched expression, “Since you’re the one asking, 1’11 let him off…”
“Uncle!”
Jared shouted when he saw that Harry seemed to be considering letting Connor go-
“Shut up!”
Harry turned and scolded Jared. Then he stared at Chloe’s chest lecherously and said, “Chloe, if you want me to let him go, 1 can do that. But 1 have two conditions…”
“What conditions?”
Chloe asked in confusion.
“First, you have to make this kid kneel down and apologize to my nephew!”
Harry looked at Chloe up and down, then continued, “Secondly, you have to sleep with me tonight. What do you think about that?”
Chloe was stunned when she heard Harry’s words. She never thought that Jared and Harry would be the same.
“Chloe, do you agree to my two conditions?”
I larry laughed and asked Chloe.
“Mr. Queen, don’t joke with me…”
Chloe bit her lip and replied helplessly.
“Does it look like I’m joking with you?”
Harry replied lecherously and reached out to pull Chloe into his arms.
“F*ck you, get your dirty hands off her!”
However, at this moment, Connor rushed toward Harry and kicked his butt.
Harry was already over fifty years old. How could he withstand Connor’s flying kick? His body smashed onto the floor, and he was almost kicked to death by Connor.
“How dare you touch my uncle? You must want to die really badly!” When Jared saw what happened, he shouted. Then, he turned and shouted at the two bodyguards behind him, “What are you two still standing there for? Didn’t you see my uncle being beaten up? Hurry up and kill this kid!”
When the two bodyguards heard Jared’s words, they rushed toward Connor.
Although Connor’s physical fitness was much stronger than the average person because he had been delivering food all year round, he was probably not strong enough to face two professional bodyguards.
Connor hesitated for a moment before taking out the Ferrari car keys and slamming them on the table. Then, he turned and shouted at the security guards at the entrance of the showroom, “If anyone of you knock these two people down today, I’ll give this car to whoever you want!”
When the security guards heard Connor’s words, they were all stunned.
“Kid, are you serious?”
One of the security guards asked Connor with a puzzled expression.
“Of course, it’s true. My sports car is parked outside right now. If you don’t believe me, go and see for yourself…”
Connor quickly replied.
The security guard raised his head to look outside the door and saw that there was indeed a red sports car parked outside.
“How do we know if that sports car is yours?”
The security guard asked Connor with some doubt.
Beep!
Connor pressed the car key without thinking, and the Ferrari instantly rang.
The security guards were still hesitant when they saw that the sports car really belonged to Connor. After all, they were Harry’s men.
“I bought this sports car for 18 million dollars. If the four of you work together, each of you will get at least 4 million dollars. This money is enough for you to spend for a lifetime!”
Connor saw that the security guards were still hesitating and shouted expressionlessly..

chapters.title: Chapter 420 - 420: Do You Have the Right to Do That?
chapters.content:
Chapter 420: Do You Have the Right to Do That?
Translator: End less Fantasy Translation Editor: End less Fantasy Translation
When rhe security guards heard Connor’s words, they no longer had any scruples in their hearts. After all, that was a whole four million dollars!
They worked as security guards in the showroom, and their annual salary was at most 50,000 dollars. Four million dollars was something they would only get if they worked hard for several lifetimes.
Therefore, at this moment, they could not care less. Even if the other party was the king, for the four million, they had to brace themselves and charge forward.
In the blink of an eye, the four security guards and the two bodyguards brought by Harry started fighting.
Connor smiled faintly when he saw this scene, then sighed softly, “T hat’s the power of money!”
As the saying goes, money makes the world go round.
Now, Connor finally understood the truth of this sentence!
When Connor said that he would use his Ferrari as a reward, the four security guards in the showroom actually believed Connor s words. After all, Connor had already proven to them that the sports car was indeed Connor s.
Moreover, there were four of them. Connor was only one person. They did not have to worry that Connor would go back on his word.
The four security guards fought hard with Harry’s two bodyguards because they knew that as long as they could subdue these two bodyguards today, they would no longer have to live a miserable life and would no longer be looked down upon by others. In the face of such an opportunity, of course, they would not let it go easily.
Meanwhile, Connor stood at the side and watched the commotion with a playful expression. At this moment, he was finally experiencing the happiness of the rich.
However, Chloe, who was standing beside Connor, looked anxious because she knew that Connor might already be bankrupt and had no money on hand.
If it was Connor from before who had provoked Harry and the others, Chloe would definitely not say anything. However, in Chloe’s eyes, Connor was no longer the Connor from before. If this matter really blew up, Chloe was worried that he would not be able to clean up the mess.
Also, Chloe felt that Connor’s act of using the sports car as a reward was too impulsive. That was a luxury car worth 18 million dollars. He could sell the car and do something with the money.
Why did he have to do something like this just to beat someone up?
However, Chloe probably did not know that this sports car was nothing in Connor’s eyes.
“Connor, you should stop these people. If this continues on, it won’t do anyone any good!”
Chloe shouted at Connor anxiously.
“Won’t do anyone any good? I doubt it.”
Connor turned to look at Chloe and replied calmly.
When Chloe heard Connor’s words, a trace of confusion flashed across her eyes because she couldn’t understand why he was doing this.
In fact, Connor himself didn’t know why. Maybe it was to protect Chloe, or maybe it was to vent the anger in his heart.
After the incident with Yannick Lee, Connor’s mindset had changed a lot.
Back then, because Connor didn’t have money, no matter what happened, he liked to solve problems in a peaceful way. In Chloe’s words, Connor didn’t dare to make a fuss because he was afraid that he wouldn’t be able to clean up the mess.
Even after inheriting the inheritance, Connor was the same. No matter what he did, it was like he was walking on thin ice.
But at this time, Connor felt that there was no need for him to keep quiet. He was already the richest man in the world. Why should he be afraid of these small figures?
“Connor, I’m begging you. Hurry up and make these people stop! ”
Chloe didn’t know what Connor was thinking at this time. She urged him anxiously.
Connor glanced at Chloe and asked softly, “Do you think Harry will let me go if 1 stop now?”
II’ II
When Chloe heard Connor’s words, she was stunned.
Because she knew very well that Connor had kicked Harry just now. Even if Connor stopped now, Harry would definitely not let Connor off.
Although the two bodyguards brought by Harry were professionally trained, the security guards in the showroom had the advantage in numbers.
In less than three minutes, the four security guards had taken down Harry’s bodyguards.
The two bodyguards had completely lost their ability to move. Connor smiled faintly and walked directly toward Harry and Jared.
At this moment, Harry was completely dumbfounded because he did not expect Connor to be so bold. Not only did he dare to attack him, but he also dared to incite the security guards to attack the bodyguards he brought.
If he had known that such a thing would happen today, he would never have brought only two bodyguards with him.
‘Co… Connor, what… what do you want?”‘
After being kicked by Connor, Harry still felt a faint pain in his butt, so he asked Connor with a frightened expression.
“What do you think I want to do?”
Connor narrowed his eyes and replied.
“Connor, I’m Harry Queen. If you dare to touch me today, I’ll make sure you die a horrible death!”
Harry no longer had that arrogant look on his face. He gritted his teeth and threatened Connor.
Smack!
Connor went up and slapped Harry’s face hard. Then, he stepped forward and pulled Harry’s hair. He narrowed his eyes and asked, “What did you just say to me?”
When everyone saw that, they were all stunned. They were indescribably shocked.
No one expected Connor to be so ruthless. He even dared to bear up a gangster like Harry!
Chloe had a worried look on her face because she knew that Connor was going to make a big deal out of today’s incident.
“Co… Connor, you can be unafraid of me, but don’t forget Chloe. If you dare to touch me again, 1 will definitely fire her…”
Harry gritted his teeth and shouted at Connor.
“Eire Chloe?”
When Connor heard Harry’s words, he couldn’t help but smile faintly.. Then, he said disdainfully, “Do you think you still have the right to do that?”

chapters.title: Chapter 421 - 421: Is Connor the Richest Man in the World?
chapters.content:
Chapter 421: Is Connor the Richest Man in the World?
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
“I am the deputy general manager of Evergrande Real Estate. I low am 1 not qualified?” Harry shouted.
“You will soon no longer be qualified!”
Connor calmly replied, then grabbed Harry’s clothes and dragged him in front of Chloe. He spoke in a calm tone, “If you apologize to Chloe now, 1’11 let you off the hook…”
Harry looked up at the terrified Chloe in front of him, then turned his head to glance at Connor beside him. He spoke in a low voice, “Connor, 1 can apologize to her, but can 1 make a phone call first?”
“A phone call?”
Connor hesitated for a moment, then smiled and asked him, “Still not convinced, huh?”
“That’s right, 1 am not convinced!” Harry shouted with wide eyes.
“Fine, 1’11 give you this chance today. Go ahead and make your phone call!”
Connor knew very well that when it comes to dealing with people like Harry, either don’t make a move at all, or go all out and make Harry tremble at the mere mention of his name in the future. Otherwise, who knows what kind of trouble Harry might cause in the future.
When Harry saw Connor agreeing to his request, a hint of shock flashed in his eyes because he never expected Connor to actually agree to let him make a phone call.
As for the onlookers present, anyone who wasn’t a fool could tell that Harry’s intention in making the phone call was clearly to call for reinforcements.
But what they couldn’t understand was why Connor agreed to it because he was walking right into Harry’s trap.
“Connor, have you gone mad? If he makes that call now, he’s definitely calling for people to come deal with you. If you let him make the call, you’re done for, do you understand?”
Chloe realized this and shouted agitated as she stepped forward, her bright eyes fixed on Connor.
He turned his head and calmly glanced at her, then said in a calm voice, “Don’t worry, I’ll be fine.”
After saying this, he disdainfully looked at Harry lying on the ground, and said disdainfully, “Why are you still dawdling? Don’t you want to make a phone call for help? Go ahead and make it!”
Harry hesitated for a moment, then took out his phone and dialed a number.
“Ring ring…”
After a couple of rings, the other end picked up the call.
“Mr. Harry!”
“Oscar, gather all the men and come to the showroom immediately, I’ve been attacked!”
“Understood, Mr. Harry!”
After hearing Harry’s words, the other person quickly replied.
Without hesitation, Harry hung up the phone and glared at Connor. “Just you wait and see. My subordinates will be here soon. You wanted me to apologize, right? Today, I’ll show you whether you have the ability to make me apologize or not!”
When Chloe saw Harry ended the call, a hint of despair flashed in her eyes, and her face showed a look of helplessness.
She knew that it was already too late for her to say anything after Harry made that phone call.
“Connor, while Harry’s subordinates haven’t arrived yet, you should run away quickly!”
Chloe hesitated for a moment before she ran to Connor’s side, and whispered to him.
He turned his head and glanced lightly at her, then asked softly, “If 1 run away now, what will you do?”
Chloe, looking at Connor in front of her, was instantly moved by his words. This was already the second time he had moved her like this!
She never imagined that even at this point, he would still care about her.
What was more shocking was that despite him being poor, she still felt a stirring in her heart!
After seeing Chloe standing there in a daze without speaking, he directly turned around and asked the few security guards inside the showroom, “You four helped me just now, and I promised to give you that car. 1 bought the car for 1.8 million, so if you split it evenly, each of you can get 4 million. Do you want the car or the money?”
“What?”
The four security guards couldn’t help but pause when they heard Connor’s words.
“I’m asking you, do you want the money or the car?” he repeated with a helpless expression.
“We want the money! If you can give us the money, of course, we want the money…”
The leading security guard quickly realized and excitedly shouted.
Connor smiled faintly at the security guards, then took out his phone and walked away.
When Harry saw that Connor seemed to be planning to leave, he quickly widened his eyes and shouted, “Kid, where are you going? You’re not thinking of escaping, are you?”
“If 1 wanted to run, I would have done it a long time ago. Why would 1 wait until now?” he replied calmly and then dialed a phone number on his phone..

chapters.title: Chapter 422 - 422: I’ll Give You Ten Times the Price!
chapters.content:
Chapter 422: I’ll Give You Ten Times the Price!
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
At this moment, Connor arrived at the corner of the showroom to ensure that no one would overhear his phone conversation.
He quickly finished the call and returned to the side of the security guards. He said, “1 have already arranged for the money you requested to be delivered…” Upon hearing his words, Chloe’s eyes flashed with a hint of despair.
She had originally thought that he went out to make a phone call in order to call for reinforcements against Harry.
However, she never expected that he would actually call these security guards asking for money.
However, a trace of confusion also flashed in her eyes because she suddenly realized that he was already broke and wondered where he got the money from.
But before she could ask him about this matter, more than a dozen white vans parked directly in front of the showroom.
A large group of thugs emerged from the vans and ran straight towards the showroom.
These people were holding steel pipes, baseball bats, and similar weapons.
They were all strong and fierce-looking, with bulging muscles that threatened to burst through their clothes.
Upon seeing this scene, Chloe couldn’t help but tremble slightly, as she knew very well that these people were targeting Connor!
“What should we do? You should run away quickly! These people are after you!” She turned to him and shouted.
“What difference does it make if they’re after me?” he replied calmly.
“Didn’t you see that they’re all armed? How can you possibly win against so many of them alone? You’d better run away quickly. 1 can lead you out through the back door…” Chloe’s tone sounded helpless as she shouted at Connor.
“What difference does it make if there are more people? Even if Harry calls ten thousand people today, it still won’t match up to me alone!” he replied.
After hearing his words, she couldn’t help but pause for a moment, her eyes showing a hint of confusion because she didn’t understand what he meant by that statement.
While he was talking to her, the hired thugs summoned by Harry had already rushed into the showroom.
The leading thug quickly ran up to Harry, helping him up and eagerly asking, “Mr. Harry, are you alright?”
“What do you think? Do you think I’m fine?” Harry shouted angrily, his expression filled with intense anger.
Perhaps because he saw his subordinates had arrived, he felt confident in his words.
“Which bastard dared to attack Mr. Harry? Show yourself!” The leading thug glared and shouted at the people inside the showroom.
The people inside the showroom seemed to be frightened by Harry’s subordinates. They remained silent, as if afraid of being implicated by Connor.
Connor hesitated for a moment and took a step forward to speak.
However, Chloe reached out and stopped him, standing in front of him and shouted loudly, “It was me who did it!”
The leading thug paused for a moment upon hearing her words, his eyes filled with confusion. He couldn’t understand how a girl like Chloe could have beaten Harry like that.
“It wasn’t her, it was the kid behind her who did it!” Harry quickly shouted, his face filled with excitement. He wanted to see Connor being taught a lesson.
“Are you the one who hit Mr. Harry, kid?”
The thug squinted his eyes and asked Connor who was standing behind Chloe in a low voice.
“Yes, it’s me,” Connor replied calmly, nodding slightly.
