chapters.content:
Chapter 435 - 435: A Call From Cindy
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
However, just as Connor was about to ‘mount his horse’, Mina suddenly reached out and pushed him.
Mina pushed Connor away, and he instinctively froze for a moment because he didn’t know why Mina pushed him away.
Connor looked at Mina, who was seductive, and a hint of confusion flashed in his eyes. He then whispered to Mina, “What’s wrong?”
Mina didn’t answer Connor’s question. Instead, she got up and ran toward the bathroom.
Not long after, the sound of retching came from the bathroom.
It was obvious that Mina had drunk too much just now, so she was starting to feel nauseous.
Connor sat on the sofa and recalled what had happened just now. He has calmed down a little.
Just now, Mina had taken the initiative, and Connor had almost lost control of himself. However, he did not want to do anything that would let Freya down.
“What was I doing just now?”
Connor raised his hand and slapped himself hard. Then, he got up and was about to leave.
But just as Connor was about to return to his room, he suddenly remembered that Mina was still in the bathroom.
Connor hesitated. He felt leaving Mina alone in the bathroom would be bad.
Moreover, Mina was drunk now. If she fell asleep inside, she would fall sick.
Therefore, Connor finally walked into the bathroom.
After entering the bathroom, Connor found that Mina had fallen asleep by the toilet bowl.
Connor sighed helplessly and walked to Mina.
But he didn’t wake Mina up because he didn’t know what crazy things Mina would do after waking up.
So Connor carried Mina and walked into her bedroom. He removed Mina’s shoes and gently placed her on the bed, preparing to leave.
“Connor, I… 1 really like you…If it weren’t for you back then, I might have been… I’ve ruined it.
But just as Connor was about to leave the bedroom, Mina suddenly muttered to herself.
After Connor heard Mina’s words, he couldn’t help but look back at her.
At this moment, Mina’s face was flushed red, and she would occasionally let out a soft snort. It was tempting.
Actually, if Connor had not fallen in love with Freya, he felt that being able to be with a girl like Mina was not a bad thing.
However, Connor had already fallen in love with Freya. There was no place in his heart for any other girl.
“Phew…” Connor took a deep breath and then walked out of the room.
A moment later, Connor returned to his room and lay on the bed, looking at the mottled ceiling and feeling myriad emotions in his heart.
In fact, sometimes Connor did not know if he was lucky. If he was lucky, Connor felt that even if he inherited such a large inheritance, his life seemed not as easy as before when he had no money. Although he had no money back then, at least Connor lived very simply!
However, Connor’s luck was not something ordinary people could compare to. Who dared to say that Connor’s luck was terrible when he inexplicably inherited such a large inheritance?
Therefore, Connor was also very puzzled.
With such doubts, Connor closed his eyes and gradually entered dreamland.
***
The next day, at 8 AM.
Connor opened his eyes and walked into the bathroom to wash up.
After washing up, Connor returned to his room and sat alone in a daze on the bed.
There was still a week before school started. Freya had left, and Connor had finished dealing with Yannick.
Connor suddenly realized that there was nothing else he could do.
Connor hesitated momentarily, then took out his phone and was about to call Dominic and Spencer.
They hadn’t seen each other for nearly two months. Connor was going to ask the two of them to hang out.
“Ring, ring, ring!” However, just as Connor took out his phone, it suddenly rang.
Connor glanced at his phone and realized that it was an unfamiliar number. A trace of doubt flashed in Connor’s eyes. Then, he softly pressed the answer button and asked,”Who is it?”
“Connor, it’s me!” A girl’s voice suddenly replied.
“Who are you?” Connor asked speechlessly.
“Cindy, can’t you recognize my voice?” Cindy asked, disappointed.
When Connor heard that it was Cindy, he was dumbfounded.
He didn’t know why Cindy had called him or how she had gotten his number.
Connor didn’t have much interaction with Cindy. They had only met a few times. In addition, Connor didn’t have a good impression of Cindy, so he couldn’t understand why Cindy would suddenly call him!
“What’s up?” Connor hesitated and asked, puzzled.
“Why else would I look for you? Do you have time now? I have something to tell you!” Cindy said, irritated.
“I’m not free!” Connor didn’t want to bother with Cindy because he had never had a good impression of her.
Moreover, as Dominic’s friend, it seemed inappropriate for Connor to meet Cindy alone.
“All, you still dare to reject me when I asked you out? Connor, do you really think you’re a rich heir?”
Cindy didn’t expect Connor to reject her. After hearing Connor’s rejection, she spoke angrily.
“If there’s nothing else, 1 will hang up!” Connor didn’t want to waste time on her.
“Why would I call you for nothing? Am 1 that bored? Come to the Old Captain’s Bar at eight tonight. 1 have something very important to tell you…” Cindy said impatiently.
“What do you want? Can’t we talk over the phone?” Connor asked speechlessly.
“Of course not over the phone. You must come to the Old Captain’s Bar at eight tonight. If you don’t, I’ll tell Dominic and the others about you pretending to be a rich heir in the showroom.” Cindy ended the call after saying this.
When Connor saw that the call had ended, a hint of helplessness flashed in his eyes. He had no idea what Cindy wanted.
However, Connor was worried that Cindy would reveal what happened in the showroom that day. Once Dominic and the others knew about it, it would be difficult for him to explain it.
Therefore, it was better to avoid trouble. In addition, Connor had nothing to do today, so after thinking for a while, he decided to go over at eight to see what Cindy wanted..

On the other side.

On the other side.
After Cindy Stone parted ways with Connor and Scarlett, she began to stroll around the streets alone.
From time to time, Cindy would take out her phone and take a look. It seemed that she was waiting for Scarlett to expose Connor’s true colors so that she could go back and watch the show!
However, Cindy did not know that Scarlett’s plan today was not as simple as exposing Connor’s true colors!
Scarlett was planning to do what she wanted with Connor.
Cindy strolled along the street for a few minutes, but she didn’t find it interesting. So, she found a random KFC and ordered a set meal.
“Since Scarlett is sacrificing so much for Tanya, if Tanya doesn’t see Connor’s true colors with her own eyes, wouldn’t that be a shame?”
Cindy sat in the KFC and couldn’t help but whisper to herself. Then, she pretended to be smart and said, “Scarlett is really stupid. Do I still need to record a video of Connor? Can’t 1 just get Tanya to come over and take a look…”
Thinking of this, Cindy took out her phone and dialed Scarlett’s best friend Tanya Lewis’s number.
However, the innocent Cindy didn’t know that Connor and Tanya didn’t know each other at all. The two of them hadn’t even met before.
Scarlett was just looking for an excuse to get close to Connor. She had no intention of helping her best friend expose Connor’s true colors.
If Scarlett knew that Cindy was making this call, she would probably be so angry that she would vomit blood on the spot!
However, Scarlett was still lingering with Connor on the dance floor and had no idea what Cindy was doing outside.
Ring! Ring!
The phone rang twice before the other party picked up.
“Cindy, why are you calling me? What’s the matter?”
Tanya and Cindy had met a few times, and their relationship was not bad.
“Tanya, can you come to the Old Captain’s Bar now? I have something to tell you…”
Cindy said gently.
“Cindy, what’s wrong?”
Tanya felt that Cindy’s tone sounded a bit off.
“Tanya, don’t ask so many questions. Just hurry over…”
Of course, Cindy wouldn’t reveal her true motive. After all, she didn’t know if Scarlett had succeeded or not.
“Cindy, are you really alright?”
Tanya seemed to be a little worried and continued to ask.
“I’m fine! Hurry up and come over. Otherwise, you’ll miss it…” Cindy shouted helplessly.
“Al… Alright, then…”
Tanya could feel the urgency in Cindy’s tone, so she could only helplessly agree..

chapters.title: Chapter 440 - 440: Let’s Go to the Private Room
chapters.content:
Chapter 440: Let’s Go to the Private Room
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Seeing that Tanya had agreed, she hung up the phone with satisfaction.
But after a while, Cindy took out her phone and made a call.
Cindy felt that if she only called Tanya over today, it would be too easy on Connor.
Therefore, she was prepared to call one of Scarlett’s admirers and ask him to come over and teach Connor a lesson.
The phone rang twice before it was picked up by a man.
“Quinlan, I’m Scarlett’s cousin, Cindy Stone. Do you still remember me?”
Cindy said coquettishly.
“Oh, Cindy. What’s the matter?”
When Quinlan found out Cindy’s identity, he replied with a smile.
“Um, Quinlan, are you free now? Can you come to the Old Captain’s Bar? I have something to tell you…”
Cindy said softly after a moment of hesitation.
“What is it? Can’t we talk over the phone?”
Quinlan’s tone was filled with confusion.
“Quinlan, this matter has something to do with Scarlett. Moreover, if 1 tell you now, you definitely won’t believe me, so you’d better come over quickly!” Cindy explained slowly.
After hearing Cindy’s words, Quinlan was silent for a while before he asked softly, “Cindy, are you sure this has something to do with Scarlett?”
“Quinlan, why would I lie to you about something like this? Just come over quickly!”
Cindy replied helplessly.
“Alright, then!”
Quinlan agreed helplessly and then hung up.
After the call ended, Cindy’s expression was unusually smug.
Scarlett’s admirer was a rich heir. His family was very rich, and he was very well-connected in society. He knew many people in the underworld.
If Quinlan saw Connor and Scarlett together, Quinlan would definitely not let Connor off easily. At that time, Connor would definitely not have a good ending!
“Connor, oh, Connor, I want to see how you’ll escape this calamity today!”
Cindy looked at the scenery outside KFC and couldn’t help but sneer.
At the same time, on the dance floor of the Old Captain’s Bar.
Perhaps it was because the lights were too dim, Connor and Scarlett were hugging each other in an extremely suggestive position, just like most of the young men and women on the dance floor.
Just as Scarlett was kissing Connor, his right hand seemed to be out of control as well, directly reaching toward her waist.
Scarlett did not try to stop him at all. She nestled her small head on Connor’s body, and her black hair naturally fell on Connor’s shoulder.
On the other side.
Cindy took a taxi back to the entrance of the Old Captain’s Bar. She couldn’t wait to go in and watch the show.
However, Tanya and Quinlan weren’t there yet, so Cindy didn’t go in.
“Why aren’t they here yet?”
Cindy took out her phone and looked at it, muttering anxiously.
However, at this moment, a black Mazda stopped beside Cindy, and a sexy beauty in high heels stepped out of the car.
When Cindy saw the girl, she hurriedly waved and shouted, “Tanya, I’m here!”
“Cindy, it’s already so late. Why did you ask me to come here?”
Tanya walked to Cindy and asked her with a puzzled expression.
“I called you over because I have a good show for you to watch. Wait a little longer. I’m still waiting for someone else…”
Cindy replied with a smile.
“Someone else? Who is it?”
Tanya couldn’t help but be stunned when she heard Cindy’s words.
“The guy who is pursuing Scarlett, Quinlan Jefferson!”
Cindy said lightly.
“Why did you ask him to come? What do you want to do?” When Tanya heard Cindy’s words, she seemed to be even more confused.
Just as Cindy was about to speak, a white Mercedes-Benz stopped beside her.
A fat man with a greasy face got out of the car and asked Cindy, “Cindy, why did you ask me to come here?”
“Quinlan, Tanya, let’s go. You’re in for a good show tonight!”
Cindy smiled mysteriously and didn’t explain anything. She walked straight into the bar.
When Quinlan and Tanya saw Cindy like this, they became even more confused.
Neither of them knew what Cindy was up to!
However, since the two of them were already here, they definitely wouldn’t leave just like that. In the end, they followed Cindy into the bar..

chapters.title: Chapter 441 - 441: Are You Drugged?
chapters.content:
Chapter 441: Are You Drugged?
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
On the other hand, Scarlett had no idea what Cindy had been doing behind her back.
After bringing Connor into the private room, she immediately closed the door.
Although she had also taken some drug earlier, it was lesser than him, so she was a little sober.
But that wasn’t the case for Connor. He had completely lost his sanity and his eyes were filled with madness.
Upon seeing him in such a state, Scarlett had a triumphant expression on her face. Today, she would finally have him in her grasp.
“Mr. Connor…” she exclaimed sweetly, then directly threw herself into his arms.
“Bang!”
Suddenly, the door of the private room was forcefully pushed open from the outside.
She had been too hasty and forgot about locking the door.
However, she didn’t pay much attention as she thought it was a bartender.
After all, such things happened frequently in bars, so with a frowning face, she shouted, “Get out…”
But Cindy, who had just entered the private room, froze upon hearing Scarlett’s words. The scene before her was too shocking.
Scarlett was sitting on Connor’s lap, continuously kissing him, and her other hand was about to undress him.
If she n had come in a little later, they probably would have already done what needed to be done!
“Cousin, aren’t you taking this acting too far?”
Cindy looked at her with a puzzled expression. She still hadn’t fully grasped what was happening and asked in disbelief.
Quinlan and Tessa were dumbfounded when they witnessed this scene!
They couldn’t have imagined that Condy had brought them here to witness such a scene!
This scene was too distressing for Quinlan!
Quinlan, a rich heir with a decent family background, had been pursuing
Scarlett for years, but due to his unattractive appearance, she had never agreed.
But who could have thought that she would end up fooling around with a random guy who appeared out of nowhere!
His expression turned ferocious. What could be more painful than seeing the person he loved in bed with someone else?
“Cindy, did you call me here just to see this?”
Tessa hesitated for a moment, furrowing her brows as she asked Cindy.
“Tessa, don’t you recognize that person?”
Cindy pointed to Connor.
“Who is that person? I don’t know him!”
Tessa lightly shook her head and continued, “Cindy, it’s your cousin’s choice who she’s with. What are you doing now? Playing a prank?”
“No, Tessa, don’t you really recognize that person? He is Connor!” Cindy anxiously exclaimed.
“Connor? 1 don’t know anyone named Connor…”
Tessa took a look at Connor for a moment, then shook her head once again.
“Cindy, quickly bring them out!”
At that moment, Scarlett suddenly shouted.
She was clearly getting emotional, and with the added fact that she didn’t want her plan to be ruined by Cindy, she didn’t care to explain. She directly ordered Cindy to take these people and leave.
“Cousin, what’s wrong with you?”
Cindy could clearly feel that something was wrong with Scarlett’s emotions, so she hurriedly rushed to her.
At this moment, Scarlett’s eyes were filled with lust, and her expression seemed a bit off.
“Scarlett, were you drugged?”
Quinlan also realized what was happening and looked at Scarlett with a puzzled expression.
“Connor, you bastard, how dare you drug my cousin?”
Cindy finally understood what was going on and rushed to Connor, slapping him in the face.
“Slap!”
Her slap landed directly on Connor’s face.
After being slapped by Cindy, Connor felt much more sober, and he instinctively looked at his right hand that had been inside Scarlett’s clothes, his expression becoming fearful.
“What the hell am I doing?”
A hint of despair flashed through his eyes, and he quickly withdrew his right hand from Scarlett’s clothes.
When she no longer felt the warmth of his hand, a trace of anger flashed in her eyes.
First of all, in order for everything to go smoothly today, Scarlett not only drugged Connor but also drugged herself. So, she was also very eager to sleep with him.
Moreover, she had been waiting for this opportunity today. But she never expected that everything would be ruined by Cindy and the others. Naturally, she was extremely angry.
“Connor, how could you drug my cousin? 1’11 fight you…”
At this moment, Cindy, who was unaware of the truth, rushed forward aggressively and raised her right hand to strike Connor’s face.
But before her slap could land on Connor’s face, Scarlett retaliated and fiercely slapped her face.
Although Scarlett’s mind was somewhat clouded due to the effects of the drug, she had taken a small dosage, so she was still very aware. She knew clearly that the people who had been called here by Cindy were Quinlan and Tessa.
Her carefully planned scheme was ruined. Of course, she was angry. And in the heat of anger, she slapped Cindy.
After being slapped, Cindy instinctively took two steps back, looking at her with disbelief.
She couldn’t understand why Scarlett would physically attack her when she had just saved her..

chapters.title: Chapter 442 - 442: Get Out!
chapters.content:
Chapter 442: Get Out!
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
“Could it be that the drug is so strong that it can control my cousin’s behavior?” Cindy’s eyes revealed a hint of surprise.
At this moment, Scarlett didn’t have the mood to explain so much to Cindy. She quickly rushed to Connor’s side, wearing a concerned expression, and asked him, “Mr. Connor, are you okay? Cindy didn’t mean it. Please don’t be mad at her because of this…”
Upon hearing her words, the expressions on everyone’s faces seemed even more astonished.
They felt that Scarlett didn’t seem to be drugged at all. From her words and expressions, it was evident that she had actually developed feelings for Connor. Her words were filled with affection for him.
Connor, still in a dazed state, kept seeing Freya in his mind. If Scarlett hadn’t spoken, he might have mistaken her for Freya.
“Cindy, is this guy your cousin’s boyfriend? Are you mistaken?” Tessa, being a woman herself, could see that Scarlett genuinely like Connor, which was why she did all this.
“Tessa, what are you joking about? How could my cousin possibly like a poor loser like Connor?” Cindy shouted without hesitation upon hearing this.
Seeing her reaction, Tessa looked even more puzzled. After all, if Scarlett didn’t like him, why would she do all this?
Quinlan had a very ugly expression on his face as he stood by the side. After a moment of silence, he walked towards Connor, unable to accept the fact that the woman he love was involved with someone else. He had only one thought in his mind at this moment which was to confront Connor and get this matter clarified.
When Scarlett saw him approaching Connor, a trace of anger flashed in her eyes. She quickly rushed in front of Quinlan, staring at him with her seductive eyes, and shouted, “What do you want?”
“Scarlett, get out of my way. 1 have something to ask this guy…” he replied through clenched teeth.
“What do you want to ask? Just ask me directly!” She intervened, worried that he might do something to Connor, so she quickly stood up and blocked his path.
“Ask you?”
Upon hearing these words, he couldn’t help but sneer and pointed harshly at Connor, looking at her and asking, “Fine, I’ll ask you then. What is your relationship with this guy? What are you two doing now?”
“Mr. Connor is my boyfriend, and he didn’t drug me. Everything is consensual. Do you understand now?” Without hesitation, Scarlett replied directly.
Upon hearing this, Quinlan widened his eyes in disbelief, staring at Scarlett in front of him. He never expected that she would actually admit her relationship with Connor.
He instinctively looked at Connor and exclaimed, “Scarlett, are you joking with me? You’re saying this person is your boyfriend?”
“Yes, Mr. Connor is my boyfriend!” She nodded without hesitation.
Seeing her firm expression, Quinlan instantly understood. It seemed that she and Connor were truly together. Otherwise, she wouldn’t say such things or do such things inside the private room.
But this fact was even more difficult for Quinlan to accept than the idea of Connor drugging Scarlett!
He couldn’t understand why she had always refused his pursuit but would she choose to be with a poor guy in a private room.
He couldn’t comprehend why she would prefer someone like Connor over him.
“Scarlett, you would rather be involved with this poor loser than be with me. 1 can’t understand what’s wrong with me compared to him. Tell me!” He shouted, his eyes wide with anger.
In fact, it wasn’t just Quinlan who couldn’t comprehend the situation at this moment. Tessa and Cindy were also in a state of confusion. They never imagined that Scarlett would end up with Connor. It was like a fantasy.
Moreover, what surprised Cindy the most was that Scarlett had previously agreed to deceive Connor as part of their act. But now, for some reason, it had turned into a real affair!
With a fierce glare at Quinlan, Scarlett didn’t hesitate and delivered a slap to his face.
This left Cindy and Tessa even more puzzled. No one expected Scarlett would slap him.
Scarlett’s behavior was extremely strange. First, she slapped Cindy, and now she had slapped Quinlan. They couldn’t figure out what she was planning to do.
It should be noted that while others didn’t know Connor’s true identity, Scarlett was well aware of it.
Even high-level figures like Kyle and Thomas showed respect to Connor. Scarlett would never allow someone like Quinlan to humiliate him.
That was why she had the audacity to offend Quinlan.
“Scarlett, how dare you hit me?” Quinlan angrily shouted at her.
“What’s wrong with me hitting you?” Scarlett showed no fear at all. With Connor as her strong support, no one could harm her.
Moreover, she was about to succeed today. Connor’s belt had already been undone by her, but it was ruined by Quinlan and the rest. Naturally, she was furious, and she vented her anger on him.
“Cousin, what are you doing?”
Cindy was completely dumbfounded. She had called these people over to witness Connor’s humiliation, but she never expected the situation to turn out like this.
Scarlett turned her head and glanced indifferently at Cindy, completely ignoring her.. She then stared at Quinlan and shouted, “What are you still doing here? Get out, do you hear me?

chapters.title: Chapter 443 - 443: You Two Stay
chapters.content:
Chapter 443: You Two Stay
Translator: End less Fantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
“Scarlett, I don’t want to stoop to your level…”
Quinlan gritted his teeth and replied in a low voice, then shouted directly at Connor, “You little bastard, did you steal my girlfriend? 1 advise you to break up with her right now. Otherwise, 1’11 find someone to break your legs. Do you hear me?”
At this moment, Connor hadn’t fully recovered from the effects of the drug. He sat on the sofa with a dazed expression, trying to calm his emotions.
But no matter how hard he tried to control himself, the feeling of touching Scarlett kept appearing in his mind.
That feeling was so intoxicating to him!
“Are you mute, kid? I’m talking to you!” Quinlan grew even more agitated when Connor remained silent.
Connor looked ordinary at the moment, and he didn’t seem very old, so Quinlan wasn’t afraid of him. On the contrary, he was prepared to intimidate him.
“Quinlan, who do you think you are? What right do you have to make Mr. Connor break up with me? Get out of here quickly…”
Upon hearing Quinlan speak to Connor in this manner, Scarlett’s expression seemed even more agitated. She rushed forward and slapped Quinlan’s face twice, then pointed at his nose and cursed, “Quinlan, I told you to get lost. Didn’t you hear me? With your despicable behavior, there’s no way 1’11 ever be with you in this lifetime. Take a good look at yourself before thinking you’re worthy of being with me!”
Upon hearing this, he was dumbfounded as he stared at her. He never expected her to be so ruthless with her words.
“What do you mean?” Quinlan gritted his teeth and asked her in a low voice.
“Can’t you understand what 1 mean? I’m telling you to get lost. Someone like you is not worthy of me!” she shouted.
“Scarlett, you’re going too far.” Cindy couldn’t bear to watch any longer and frowned as she shouted.
“Shut up!” Upon hearing her words, Scarlett became even more furious. After all, if it weren’t for Cindy, the situation wouldn’t have turned out like this.
“Fine, the two of you gang up on me, huh? Just wait and see!” Quinlan had been humiliated to the extreme by Scarlett and had no desire to stay any longer. After saying these words, he turned around and left the private room.
When Cindy saw him leave, a hint of helplessness flashed in her eyes. At this moment, she didn’t know how to describe her own feelings.
If she had known it would turn out like this, she would never have called him to come here!
After seeing Quinlan leave, Scarlett finally breathed a sigh of relief. She quickly ran to Connor’s side and asked in a gentle tone, “Mr. Connor, are you okay? Does the slap hurt? Would you like me to massage it for you?”
She had taken a smaller dose of the drug herself, and after the commotion, she had fully regained her clarity.
But it wasn’t the same case for Connor. He had taken a dose of the drug ten times stronger than hers, and he wouldn’t be able to regain consciousness for several hours.
However, he had been trying to control his desires!
Scarlett had originally given him such a large dose of the drug as a precaution. She was worried that the drug might not be as effective as she had imagined, so she added a few extra pills. But no one could have anticipated that the drug’s effect would be so astonishing!
Images of his interactions with Freya kept appearing in Connor’s mind, and a voice in his head kept telling him to leave this place as soon as possible.
But unfortunately, he felt as if his body was bound, unable to move.
“What are you two still doing here? Hurry up and leave!”
Knowing that Connor’s drug hadn’t worn off yet, Scarlett didn’t want to give up this opportunity. She wanted to drive Cindy and Tessa away as well.
“Cousin…”
After hearing Scarlett’s words, Cindy frowned and called out.
“What? I’m telling you two to get out of here. Didn’t you hear me?” Scarlett shouted with an agitated expression.
Cindy and Tessa exchanged helpless glances upon seeing her resolute attitude. They didn’t dare to stay any longer and reluctantly turned around to leave the private room.
“What’s wrong with her today? Could she really have fallen for Connor?”
After turning around to leave, Cindy couldn’t help but mutter quietly.
They never imagined that Scarlett would actually develop feelings for Connor and even drive them away.
When they saw her firm attitude, they naturally didn’t dare to stay any longer and could only leave the private room.
“Wait!”
However, at that moment, Connor suddenly spoke up.
Cindy and Tessa looked at each other in confusion upon hearing Connor’s words, wondering what he wanted to do.
“You two stay, I’ll go…”
He gritted his teeth and shouted, then struggled to stand up and walked unsteadily towards the exit of the private room.
“Mr. Connor, what are you doing?”
When Scarlett saw him trying to leave, she quickly reached out to support him and called out in a coquettish voice.
“Let go of me!”
Connor angrily shouted at her, his expression full of fury.
He wasn’t a fool. He was well aware that Scarlett had most likely drugged him. But at this moment, he didn’t want to argue with her about these things. All he had in mind was to leave as soon as possible.
If he continued to stay here, he didn’t know what he might do.
Scarlett was actually very afraid of Connor. After all, he was her boss.
So when she heard his words, a hint of fear flashed in her eyes, and she instinctively let go of his hand that she was holding.
Connor struggled to walk towards the exit of the private room. Each step was difficult. Cindy and Tessa stood at the doorway of the room, their expressions filled with even more confusion.
Because they felt that it seemed more like Scarlett had drugged Connor rather than the other way around.
When she saw him leaving like this, she felt extremely distressed but helpless at the same time. She could only watch as Connor walked out of the private room..

chapters.title: Chapter 444 - 444: Stay at My House
chapters.content:
Chapter 444: Stay at My House
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
After a moment, Connor left the private room in dazed.
With a thud, Scarlett sat on the sofa as if she had been struck.
“Cousin, are you okay?”
Cindy hurriedly ran to her side, her expression filled with worry.
Scarlett didn’t answer her question. Instead, she burst into loud sobs.
After all, she had planned this for such a long time, and she was so close to succeeding. But she never expected that such a thing would happen!
All her previous efforts had been in vain, and the culprit behind all of this was Cindy, who was currently trying to console her.
Originally, Scarlett had planned to wait until she and Connor confirmed their relationship before explaining everything to Cindy.
But now it was too late for anything. She didn’t intend to explain anything to Cindy because even if she told her about Connor’s identity, it wouldn’t change anything.
On the other side, Connor aimlessly walked the streets after leaving Old Captain’s Bar.
At this moment, he felt weak in his limbs and completely dazed. There was only one thought in his mind, which was to find a woman and release his innermost desires.
After walking for a few minutes along the street, he suddenly felt a dizziness in his brain, and his body tilted before collapsing on the ground.
The reason why his reaction was so intense was largely due to Scarlett overdosing him with drugs.
His collapse quickly attracted the attention of several passersby. After all, this was the busiest street in Porthampton, and there was a considerable flow of people.
“What’s wrong with this guy?”
“Is he drunk? I can smell alcohol on him!”
“He must be drunk. We should take him to the hospital…”
Several stylishly dressed young people whispered to each other while looking at Connor.
“Let’s not take him to the hospital. What if he blames us for knocking him over and demands medical expenses?”
Just then, a sexy woman in a cropped top shouted.
“I agree. Why should we bother? Let’s hurry up and go to the karaoke lounge. The others are waiting for us. If we call the hospital, we’ll have to wait here. I’m not in the mood to waste time with him.” A guy with an afro hairstyle added.
“Maybe it’s not good to just leave him here like this?” Another delicate-looking girl frowned and said.
“Otherwise, let’s call his friend and have them come to pick him up!”
Just then, a chubby guy shouted and walked up to Connor. He gently shook
Connor and called out in a low voice, “Bro, are you okay…”
At this moment, Connor was in a semi-conscious state. He instinctively wanted to respond to the chubby guy’s words, but he realized he couldn’t speak.
“How much did you drink? How could you end up like this? Let me use your phone to call your friend. Don’t worry, we won’t harm you…”
The chubby guy spoke while reaching into his clothes.
After a while, the chubby guy found Connor’s phone, opened the call log, and dialed the first number.
However, in his call log, the first call was from Cindy, who was currently consoling Scarlett and had no time to answer the call.
So the chubby guy had to try another phone number.
“Ring ring…”
After two rings, the call was answered on the other side.
Before the person could speak, the chubby guy shouted first, “Hey, uh, your friend passed out on Jackson Avenue. He’s lying on the street right now. Hurry up and come pick him up, or something bad might happen later!”
“Passed out?”
Upon hearing the chubby guy’s words, the person on the other end showed a hint of confusion in their eyes.
“Yeah, he drank too much. Hurry up and come pick him up!”
The chubby guy wasn’t in the mood for small talk and hung up the phone after saying that. He put Connor’s phone back into his clothes and turned around to leave with his friends.
Connor witnessed everything that had just happened. He actually wanted to thank these people, but he couldn’t speak at the moment, so he could only watch them leave.
Ten minutes later, a Ferrari stopped in front of him.
He looked up at the car and saw a pair of slender and fair legs in his line of sight.
Seeing these two flawless legs, his desire was ignited once again. However, he had no idea who was coming to pick him up.
“Click click…”
The sound of high heels tapping on the ground echoed.
Chloe almost jogged over to Connor’s side, panting, and asked, “Mr. Connor, are you okay? How did you end up like this after drinking?”
Upon hearing her words, Connor quickly looked at her. At this moment, he really wanted to tell Chloe to quickly take him to the hospital.
He knew that he ended up like this because Scarlett had drugged him. He needed to go to the hospital to have the drugs flushed out of his system, or the consequences would be severe.
But unfortunately, he couldn’t say a word now. He could only stare at her.
“Mr. Connor, if you want to drink, you can ask me. Why did you come out to drink alone? It’s very dangerous!”
She still didn’t know what had happened to him. She supported his body with all her strength.
At this moment, Connor’s body was weak, and it was a bit difficult for Chloe to get him into the car. After struggling for a while, she was sweaty and exhausted, but they hadn’t gone far.
“Mr. Connor, how much did you drink? How did you end up like this?”
She looked at him with a helpless expression and murmured, then continued to help him towards the car.
Fortunately, a few people happened to pass by and gave her a hand.
After getting in the car, Chloe was panting heavily, her ample chest rising and falling.
Connor turned his head and glanced at her, as if he wanted to say something, but he couldn’t utter a word.
Inside, he was starting to doubt what kind of drug Scarlett had given him. If it was just a sedative, how could it have such an effect?
But he didn’t know that his current condition was simply a result of excessive drug use.
As long as the effects of the drugs subsided a bit, he would naturally start to recover.
“Mr. Connor, my place isn’t far from here. How about you stay at my house tonight…”
She still didn’t know what was wrong with him. She thought he had simply drunk too much, so she wanted to take him to her home and let him rest.
Since he couldn’t speak at all, he couldn’t refuse her, so he could only let her take charge!

chapters.title: Chapter 445 - 445: Becoming Connor’s Woman
chapters.content:
Chapter 445: Becoming Connor’s Woman
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Twenty minutes later.
Chloe parked the car at the entrance of the neighborhood, then helped Connor out of the car and slowly walked into the neighborhood.
At this time, he seemed to have gradually recovered. Although his body still felt a little weak, it was much better than before. At least now, he could walk with Chloe’s help.
“Mr. Connor, how much did you drink?” she asked gently after seeing that he was better.
“Not much…” he replied in a low voice.
Although he could speak now, he still felt a little weak, so he didn’t tell her that he had been drugged.
She saw that he didn’t seem to want to talk, so she didn’t ask much and helped him to her house.
Because she was supporting him, their bodies would inevitably touch. From time to time, he would accidentally feel her soft waist and full chest. This feeling instantly ignited the desire in Connor’s body. He could only try his best to control himself not to think about those places.
A few minutes later, Chloe finally brought him back to her home.
Although she wasn’t a local, she had worked in real estate sales for so many years and naturally earned a lot of money. Therefore, she bought her own house in Porthampton.
Although the house wasn’t very big, the interior was decorated very warmly. It was all pink as far as the eye could see. It was obvious that only girls would decorate it like this.
After entering the room, Chloe was about to send him into the bedroom, but he laid down on the sofa.
“Mr. Connor, please rest here for a while. I’ll go make a pot of tea to relieve your hangover…”
She saw him lying on the sofa and called out softly. Then, she turned around and walked towards the kitchen.
Connor lay on the sofa alone. At this moment, all the drugs in his body had been activated. His consciousness began to blur, and all he could think of was Freya.
“Freya, don’t go. Please stay!”
He originally thought that since he could walk and talk, the drug effect in his body should have passed, but he didn’t know that it was just the side effect of the drug overdosage that had disappeared. This was the time when the drug in his stomach really took effect.
Not long after, Chloe returned to Connor’s side with a pot of tea. When she heard his shout, a trace of jealousy flashed in her eyes.
“Mr. Connor should be calling out for his girlfriend now. No wonder he didn’t have feelings for me. It turns out that he is so infatuated with his girlfriend.”
Chloe sighed softly, then hesitated for a moment before walking over to Connor’s side and offering him the tea to drink.
She knew that he couldn’t drink water on his own in his current state.
She carefully sat on the sofa and was about to bring the cup of water.
“Freya, I really like you!”
But at that moment, Connor suddenly opened his arms and pulled Chloe into his embrace.
Her delicate body couldn’t help but tremble in his arms.
This embrace was something she had longed for a long time, but she didn’t expect it to happen so soon.
“Freya, I beg you, don’t leave, okay?”
His consciousness had completely blurred by now, so he instinctively mistook Chloe in front of him for Freya.
Connor tightly held Chloe’s body, feeling the warmth emanating from her.
Chloe was a seductive woman. She was a few years older than Connor, and both her figure and appearance could be considered top-notch.
Moreover, she exuded a mature woman’s aura, a feeling that greatly fascinated him.
Under normal circumstances, he would definitely be able to control his desire for her.
But at this moment, the effects of the drug in his body had completely taken hold, and he had no idea whether the woman in front of him was Chloe or Freya.
“Freya, I really like you, please don’t leave me, okay?”
Connor pleaded pitifully as he held Chloe.
“Mr. Connor, 1 am not your girlfriend, I am Chloe…”
She struggled forcefully, seemingly trying to break free from his embrace.
Although she had long fallen in love with him and had hinted at wanting to be his woman, it didn’t mean that she would take advantage of the situation!
Women were always the most sensitive creatures, and while she might not care about the title, she cared very much about her position in his heart.
“Freya, don’t go please!”
Connor tightly held Chloe, as if unwilling to let her go.
“Mr. Connor, I’ve told you, I’m not your girlfriend, 1 am Chloe, can’t you snap out of it!”
She forcefully shook his body, seemingly trying to wake him up.
But he showed no reaction at all, still incessantly chanting Freya’s name.
She took a deep breath and looked at him. She could sense that something was off about him today, so she got up and prepared to leave.
“Freya, please, don’t go…”
Upon hearing his words, a hint of hesitation flashed in Chloe’s eyes because she didn’t know what she should do in this situation.
She thought that he had simply had too much to drink, which caused him to mistake her for Freya.
Being Connor’s woman had always been her dream, and he could be considered the perfect man in her heart. Even if she couldn’t become his wife, she would willingly be his lover.
But she didn’t know if she should engage in a relationship with him at this moment.
She felt that if she truly gave in to his advances at this moment, it might seem like taking advantage of him in a vulnerable state.
Moreover, what bothered her the most was that he was mistaking her for another woman.
Just as Chloe was indecisive, Connor’s hands began to wander, reaching towards her clothes.
Feeling the warmth of his hands, her body trembled slightly, and she seemed to enjoy this sensation.
Although she seemed bold on the surface, she was actually very conservative in her heart. She had never had a boyfriend in her life, and now that she was approaching thirty, she couldn’t help but yearn for a man to warm her heart during the quiet nights.
And now, sensing the pheromones emanating from Connor’s body, she felt her body softening, leaning against his embrace.
She bit her lip and tightly clenched her fist, feeling conflicted inside.
But at that moment, Connor suddenly lost control. He abruptly stood up and pressed Chloe onto the sofa, then lowered his head and kissed her enticing lips.
After being kissed by him, she couldn’t control her emotions anymore. Her fair arms instinctively wrapped around his neck as she actively responded to him.
She loved him, and she was willing to offer her body to him.
And his instincts seemed to be triggered by her as well. His actions became more forceful, and Chloe seemed to be lost in the moment, her breathing becoming increasingly rapid.
Soon, he became dissatisfied with the current situation. He reached out to unbutton her clothes.
But after fumbling for a while, he couldn’t take off her clothes.
Connor became impatient, and with a forceful pull, he tore open Chloe’s clothes and threw them aside.
She could never have imagined that she would end up becoming his woman in this way..

chapters.title: Chapter 446 - 446: The Real Victim
chapters.content:
Chapter 446: The Real Victim
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
It was a sleepless night.
When Connor opened his eyes, Chloe’s flawless body was exposed to Connor’s eyes without reservation.
After seeing this scene, Connor was in a state of confusion. The expression on his face was very shocked. He simply couldn’t remember what had happened last night.
He didn’t know why he was in Chloe’s house, nor did he know why she was lying beside him. He tried hard to recall what happened last night!
However, all Connor could remember was that Scarlett and Cindy had invited him to the Old Captain’s Bar. After entering the bar, Connor had had a glass of wine and then went to the dance floor to watch Scarlett dance.
He couldn’t remember what happened after that.
Connor stared at the sleeping girl beside him with wide eyes. The expression on his face was nothing but shock.
“What did I do with Chloe last night? It can’t be?”
Thinking of this, Connor quickly looked down at Chloe.
He realized that he and Chloe were both naked. He couldn’t tell what had happened last night.
Connor was shocked—he couldn’t remember what he did last night. He even started to wonder if he was dreaming!
Connor pinched himself hard, but the clear pain told him that he was not dreaming.
Connor shook his head hard, trying to recall what happened last night, but no matter how hard he tried, he didn’t get anything.
Therefore, he could only shift his gaze to Chloe. At this moment, Chloe was sprawled over his body like an octopus. Her pretty face was flushed with embarrassment, as if she was very satisfied.
Connor was going to wake Chloe up and ask her what happened last night, but when he saw her like this, he hesitated.
In the end, Connor had no choice but to continue lying on the sofa and wait for Chloe to wake up. Then, he would ask her what happened last night!
After a long time, Chloe finally opened her eyes. When she saw Connor staring at her, she suddenly sat up straight and stammered to Connor, “M-Mr. McDonald, you’re awake?”
“Yes!”
Connor nodded gently, then looked at Chloe and asked, “What happened last night?”
After Chloe heard Connor’s words, a trace of disappointment flashed in her eyes. She could clearly feel that Connor’s tone was very cold.
Chloe felt a little scared.
“Say something! What happened between us last night? Why am 1 in your house? And what happened between us?”
Connor had never thought of having sex with other women. Although Freya was no longer in Oprana, Connor still loved her in his heart. He could not accept that he had done something wrong to Freya.
This was also the reason why Connor was so cold to Chloe!
When Chloe saw Connor like this, her expression seemed to be a little frightened. She trembled and asked Connor, “Mr. McDonald, about last night, you… Do you really not remember anything?”
“I don’t remember. I only remember that I went to a bar to drink, and then I fainted on the street alone. 1 don’t remember anything else after that!”
Connor hesitated for a moment before replying to Chloe softly.
After Chloe heard Connor’s words, she couldn’t help but take a deep breath and then whispered, “Mr. McDonald, you drank too much in the bar yesterday. You were lying on the street alone and couldn’t go home. A kind person called me and asked me to pick you up, but when 1 arrived, I found that you were unconscious. 1 had no choice but to bring you back to my house…”
After Connor heard Chloe’s words, the expression on his face seemed to be even more puzzled. Because Connor clearly remembered that he only drank a glass of whiskey last night.
Connor was very aware of his alcohol tolerance. There was no way a single glass of whiskey would bring him down like that!
“What happened after that? Why are the two of us lying on the sofa?”
Connor looked down at Chloe’s flawless body.
She had an extremely sexy appearance, fair collarbones, and a full chest that was extremely alluring. There was no flaw at all. Below that was a pair of slender and straight legs. Her figure was extremely perfect. The places that should be protruding were protruding, and the places that should be perky were perky.
“What happened after that…”
Chloe looked at Connor and hesitated for a moment, then said with a pitiful expression, “What happened after that…Mr. McDonald, you lay on the sofa and called out your girlfriend’s name. I was going to give you some tea to wake up, but you treated me as your girlfriend. You even hugged me and started kissing me. I…1 really didn’t take the initiative to seduce you…”
After Connor heard Chloe’s words, he was very shocked.
He had never thought that he would mistake Chloe for Freya yesterday and even have that kind of relationship with her!
At the beginning, Connor had some doubts about whether Chloe’s words were true or not, but when he felt the abnormality in his lower abdomen, Connor felt that Chloe was not lying to him.
However, Connor could not understand. He had only drunk a glass of wine last night. How could he be so drunk?
Previously, he and Mina had drunk almost a dozen beers, but Connor was still able to stay awake. But last night, Connor had only drunk a glass of whiskey, yet he was already in such a state as to think that Chloe was Freya. Connor felt that this was really unbelievable.
Chloe bit her lip tightly, looking very wronged. After all, she was the real victim.
Any woman would feel wronged if Connor questioned her in such a tone the moment he woke up..

chapters.title: Chapter 447 - 447:I Was Willing!
chapters.content:
Chapter 447:I Was Willing!
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Seeing Chloe’s aggrieved look, Connor also became silent.
He sat quietly on the sofa and kept recalling what happened last night. However, his mind was blank and he couldn’t remember anything.
However, Connor was not a fool. He knew very well that he would never have sex with Chloe just because he drank too much. He would never mistake Chloe for Freya.
Connor felt that there must be something fishy about this matter.
“Did we really sleep together last night?”
Connor hesitated for a moment and asked Chloe with a frown.
“Mr. McDonald, are we already like this? Why would 1 lie to you? Do you think I seduced you last night? Am I, Chloe, so cheap in your eyes that I have to sleep with you? Do you think 1 can’t find a man that isn’t you?”
After Chloe heard Connor’s words, the emotions that she had suppressed in her heart finally exploded as she shouted at Connor with an excited expression.
Connor couldn’t help but be stunned when he saw Chloe like this. Only then did he realize that what he said just now was obviously a little too much.
So Connor quickly picked up his clothes and draped them over Chloe. He said softly,” Chloe, don’t be angry. I didn’t mean it that way; I only drank a single glass of whiskey last night. 1 know how much alcohol I can hold, so there’s no way I’d end up blackout drunk after that amount. 1 want to find out what’s going on…”
After Chloe heard Connor’s words, her expression softened a lot. She reached out and threw her clothes on the sofa, then pouted and said, “Last night, you did everything you should have done. What’s the use of helping me wear clothes now?”
“Uh…”
After hearing Chloe’s words, Connor’s eyes flashed with a trace of embarrassment. Then, he asked softly, “Chloe, calm down. Did 1 do anything else after 1 left the bar last night?”
“I don’t know what you did last night, but when 1 saw you, you were already unconscious. You were lying on the street. 1 was the one who brought you back. After you came back, you shouted Freya’s name and treated me as her. You started kissing me and taking off my clothes. No matter how much I resisted, it was useless…”
Chloe said slowly after recalling for a while.
After hearing Chloe’s words, Connor’s expression seemed to become even more awkward. He didn’t expect that he would go so far last night.
“Did you feel that something was wrong with me last night?”
Connor hesitated for a moment before asking Chloe.
After Chloe heard Connor’s words, a trace of doubt flashed across her eyes. Then, she slowly said, “Mr. McDonald, you were crazy last night. You only stopped at four in the morning. Moreover, you were in a daze during this period of time. Logically speaking, if you were really drunk, it would be impossible for you to not wake up for such a long time. I think Mr. McDonald, you seemed to be…”
“Like what?”
Connor quickly asked.
“It was like you’d taken an aphrodisiac. You were extremely crazy…” Chloe replied shyly.
After hearing Chloe’s words, Connor finally recalled what had happened last night.
Although Connor couldn’t remember all the details of the matter, he’d drunk with Scarlett, then went with her to the dance floor, and Cindy Stone and the others were also there. These scattered images instantly appeared in Connor’s mind.
Connor finally remembered that he was probably drugged by Scarlett last night, which was why he became like this.
Later, Connor ran out of the bar and was brought back to her home by Chloe.
At this time, Connor’s drug took effect, so he mistook Chloe for Freya.
Recalling all of this, Connor couldn’t help but look up at Chloe. The expression on his face was very guilty because Connor knew that she was actually the real victim of this matter.
If Chloe had not helped him expel the drug last night, the consequences would have been unimaginable!
Connor had gone overboard by questioning Chloe after waking up.
It was no wonder that she was angry at Connor just now. After all, any normal person would probably not be able to accept such a situation.
“Chloe, actually, 1 was drugged last night, so…That’s why 1 did those things to you…”
Connor pinched the bridge of his nose and said to Chloe with a helpless expression.
When Chloe heard Connor’s words, a trace of surprise flashed across her eyes. She quickly walked up to Connor and asked him with a puzzled expression, “Mr. McDonald, what did you say? You said you were drugged last night?”
“Yes, I was drugged when 1 was in the bar, so I mistook you for Freya. I’m really sorry!”
Connor said to Chloe with a guilty expression.
At this moment, Connor kept his head down, not daring to look at her.
It couldn’t be helped. Chloe was too alluring. In addition, she wasn’t wearing any clothes at all. She looked like a ripe peach, exuding extreme temptation!
After Chloe heard Connor’s words, her emotions clearly calmed down a lot. She frowned and asked Connor, “Then, ATr. McDonald, who drugged you?”
“It’s a friend of mine…”
Connor lowered his head and replied helplessly.
“Your friend? Why did she drug you?”
Chloe sat next to Connor and asked with a puzzled expression.
“What else could it be?”
Connor smiled bitterly and continued, “She definitely wants to sleep with me and then use this matter to blackmail me…”
Connor was not a fool. He was still very familiar with the thoughts of a woman like Scarlett. At this moment, Connor was not in the mood to think about her at all. He had been thinking about how he should deal with this matter right now.
After all, it wasn’t Chloe’s fault last night. To put it bluntly, Connor had taken the initiative to sleep with Chloe, so he didn’t know how to deal with his relationship with her now.
“Mr. McDonald…”
Just when Connor didn’t know how to deal with this matter, Chloe took the initiative to call Connor.
Connor looked up at Chloe and asked with a puzzled expression, “What’s wrong?”
“Actually, I was willing to do it last night, so you don’t have to feel guilty. If I wasn’t, it would be useless no matter how much you force me…” Chloe smiled and said to Connor.
After Connor heard Chloe’s words, he was stunned on the spot.
He didn’t expect Chloe to say such a thing!

chapters.title: Chapter 448 - 448: Who Would Want to Live Like Me?
chapters.content:
Chapter 448: Who Would Want to Live Like Me?
Translator: End Less Fantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
In the living room.
When Connor heard Chloe say that she was willing, his face immediately revealed an incredulous expression.
He didn’t know why Chloe was telling him all this.
“Mr. McDonald, you don’t have to feel guilty for me. 1 did what I did last night willingly, and only the two of us know about it. As long as we don’t tell anyone, no one else will know. So you don’t have to worry about others knowing about this,” Chloe said to Connor sensibly.
After Connor heard her words, the expression on his face became even more shocked because he didn’t expect her to say such a thing.
In Connor’s eyes, Chloe and Scarlett were both women, but Chloe was much better than Scarlett was. However, the two of them had the same goal: getting in touch with Connor. They wanted to become Connor’s woman and enjoy endless glory and wealth.
But now that such an opportunity was in front of Chloe, she chose to give up. She had no intention of using this matter to threaten Connor, which was something he never expected.
Chloe seemed to have noticed the worry in Connor’s heart and said softly, “Mr. McDonald, I know your situation. You already have a fiancee, and you have a very good relationship with her. Although 1 like money, I know my limits. I won’t use this matter to threaten you, so you can leave this place without worry…”
“Didn’t you always want to be my woman?”
Connor hesitated for a moment and asked Chloe softly.
“Yes, 1 have always wanted to be your woman, but I want you to really like me, not force you to be with me because we had sex. As long as you really like me, it doesn’t matter even if I don’t have any status. But if you don’t have me in your heart, then what does it matter?”
Chloe paused for a moment and then looked at Connor. “I definitely won’t do something like taking advantage of someone’s misfortune…”
After Connor understood what Chloe meant, he took a deep breath and said expressionlessly, “Since the two of us have already had sex, I will definitely take responsibility for you. I, Connor McDonald, am not the kind of person who is heartless…”
“Take responsibility?”
After Chloe heard Connor’s words, she couldn’t help but sneer. Then, she sized up Connor and asked softly, “Mr. McDonald, how do you plan to take responsibility for me now? Would you choose to break up with your fiancee because of this? And then be with me?”
Connor turned his head and glanced at Chloe without saying anything.
He knew that there was no way he could do this. No matter how he looked at it, he would never break up with Freya.
Chloe saw that Connor didn’t say anything and continued. “Or are you planning to give me a sum of money and then send me away? I’ve already gotten a lot of money from you, so I’m not short of money!”
Connor took a deep breath and asked, “Tell me, what do you want now? As long as it’s within my ability, I’ll definitely do my best to satisfy you!”
“I want Mr. McDonald to always be by my side. Can you do that?” Chloe asked Connor directly.
After Connor heard Chloe’s words, he was stunned. A trace of helplessness flashed across his eyes. He didn’t know what to say.
“You can’t do it?”
Chloe smiled faintly and said slowly, “I know that a woman like me is not worthy of you. I don’t even have the qualifications to be your lover. In the eyes of many people, I, Chloe, am a materialistic woman. As long as I have enough money, I will do anything. I am indeed such a woman. No matter what, I will put money first!”
Connor looked at Chloe and remained silent.
“If I could be born into a wealthy family, of course I would want to pursue my own love! If it wasn’t for money, who the hell would want to live like me?”
As Chloe spoke, tears welled up in her eyes. Tears slowly dripped down her delicate cheeks and onto the ground.
When Connor saw Chloe suddenly cry, he was obviously at a loss. He hurriedly said to Chloe, “Chloe, 1 didn’t mean to look down on you. Why are you crying?”
“I know you don’t look down on me, Mr. McDonald, but aren’t I just a materialistic woman in your eyes? Otherwise, why would you treat me like this now?”
Chloe looked at Connor and called out. Then, she picked up a tissue to wipe her tears and said softly, “Mr. McDonald, do you want to hear my story?”
“Your story?”
Connor asked Chloe.
Chloe looked at Connor and hesitated for two seconds. Then, she said softly, “Actually, when 1 was young, my family was quite rich. Although we weren’t very rich, at least my family could live a carefree life. However, for some reason, my father suddenly became addicted to drugs. Not only did he squander all the savings in the family, but he also secretly sold our house and owed a large sum of money to loan sharks. Later on, my father really couldn’t afford to repay the money, so he chose to commit suicide to end it all…”
“At that time, I was only in primary school. After experiencing these things in primary school, I began to understand how important it was to find a reliable man!”
After listening to Chloe’s words, Connor’s eyes flashed with shock because he didn’t expect Chloe to have experienced such a thing.
“After my father died, those loan sharks didn’t let my mother and 1 off. Before my father died, he still owed two million dollars to loan sharks. At that time, this amount of money was simply an astronomical figure to my mother and me. My mother was just a regular employee. She was a woman who could not afford to repay this money!”
Chloe paused for a moment, then continued to sob, “However, those tenants didn’t want to let us off at all. They came to us every day to ask for money and even used me to threaten my mother. In the end, my mother really had no choice but to become a prostitute. Because she was a woman and had no formal education, this was the only way she could earn money to pay off her debts!”
When Connor heard this, he suddenly looked up at Chloe, his eyes full of sympathy and pity..

chapters.title: Chapter 449 You Can Be My Lover
chapters.content:
Chapter 449  You Can Be My Lover
Connor looked at Chloe beside him and couldn't help but show sympathy because he didn't expect Chloe to have such a background!
Connor felt that his family was already miserable enough, but he didn't expect Chloe's family to be even worse off than his.
Chloe glanced at Connor and said softly, "At that time, I didn't know that my mother had become a prostitute. I thought that my mother had just changed her job and earned more money to pay off her debts. However, when I was in junior high school, my classmates told me that my mother had been working as a prostitute in a clubhouse. When I heard this news, I cried, but I didn't blame my mother because I knew that if there was a second path, my mother would never have become a prostitute!"
"From then on, I realized how important money is. If a person doesn't have money, then there's no dignity. This is also the reason why I worship money so much now. In this society, the things that money can bring you are far more than the value of money itself!"
"Then you should be very rich now, right?"
Connor whispered to Chloe.
"That's right. I'm indeed rich now, but my mother is no longer around…" Chloe replied calmly.
"..."
When Connor heard Chloe's words, he was instantly stunned. The expression on his face was extremely shocked.
"Five years ago, when I was still in university, my mother went to entertain a strange guest in order to earn money for my tuition fees. That guest strangled my mother to death…"
Chloe started crying halfway through her sentence.
"If I had more money earlier, perhaps this wouldn't have happened. But at that time, I was only a junior year student and couldn't earn much money at all. I couldn't change anything at all."
Chloe wiped the tears from the corner of her eyes and continued, "After my mother died, I swore in my heart that I would definitely earn a lot of money. I would never let my children live the same life as me. Even if I couldn't change my fate, I would find a man who could."
Connor looked at Chloe, whose tears were falling like rain, and the softest part of his heart was touched!
Connor took a deep breath and pulled Chloe into his arms. He knew that she needed a hug.
Chloe leaned against Connor's chest and cried bitterly.
For so many years, these things had always been in Chloe's heart. No matter who it was, Chloe had never told anyone about these things.
At this time, facing Connor, Chloe finally opened her heart.
If they could be happy and stable in this life, who would be willing to wander?
"Mr. McDonald, I admit that I did have a purpose when I first met you, but I am not a casual woman. I have a lot of rich heirs around me. Many of these people are from aristocratic families and are well-off. If I choose to be with these people, I can definitely change my fate and live a rich life!"
"I don't know why, but when I face these people, I don't feel anything. I do want to marry a rich man, but this doesn't mean that I will be that desperate."
Chloe looked at Connor gently and continued, "But after I got to know you, Mr. McDonald, I suddenly realized that not all men in this world treat me well just because they want to sleep with me. Slowly, I realized that I fell in love with you. I fell in love with you without any purpose. For you, I can give up everything. I don't care if you have money or not. I just want to be with you…"
"..."
Connor looked at Chloe and didn't say anything because he was already touched.
"But I also know that a woman like me is not worthy of you, so let's just pretend that nothing happened last night. In the future, you're still Mr. McDonald, and I'm still me."
Chloe blinked her red eyes and asked Connor softly.
"It's true that I can't marry you, but if you're willing, you can be my lover!"
At this moment, Connor didn't know how to continue to reject Chloe, so he suddenly changed his mind.
Originally, Connor didn't want to do anything to let Freya down. However, since this matter had already happened, Connor felt that he should be responsible for Chloe.
"Be your lover?"
When Chloe heard Connor's words, she couldn't help but be stunned.
Connor saw the expression on Chloe's face and quickly added, "If you are unwilling, then pretend that I never said anything…"
"Of course I'm willing. It's my honor to be your lover!"
Chloe shouted excitedly and pressed herself against Connor's body. She used her seductive red lips to gently kiss Connor.
Chloe nestled in Connor's arms and asked him softly, "Mr. McDonald, what if your fiancée finds out about our relationship?"
"Only you and I know about this. You can't let a third person know. Do you understand what I mean?"
Chloe's words reminded Connor of that matter, so Connor quickly said that to Chloe.
"Oh, of course!"
After Chloe heard Connor's words, a strange look flashed across her eyes. Then, she nodded lightly and did not say anything.
After all, Chloe was already very satisfied to be Connor's lover.

chapters.title: Chapter 450 Mina's Request
chapters.content:
Chapter 450  Mina's Request
At Chloe's house.
Connor and Chloe spent the entire day together, and it was as if they didn't know fatigue.
It wasn't until eight o'clock that Connor and Chloe left the house.
Then, the two of them found a random restaurant in the commercial street near the neighborhood and ate something.
At night, Chloe originally planned to let Connor stay the night; after all, she enjoyed spending time with Connor very much. However, Connor was worried that if he stayed at her house for too long, someone might find out about him and Chloe.
Especially since Yannick and the others had been watching Connor. If Yannick knew the relationship between Connor and Chloe, he would definitely tell Freya about it. At that time, Connor would not only lose Freya, but also lose the inheritance.
Men were animals that thought with their lower bodies. Although Connor loved Freya in his heart, he could not refuse Chloe's gentleness.
Chloe originally planned to drive Connor home, but she was rejected by Connor, so he chose to take a taxi home alone.
After a whole day, not even Iron Man would not be able to take it. Therefore, Connor only wanted to do one thing after returning home, and that was to lie in bed and have a good rest.
But when Connor returned home and was about to open his door, Mina walked out of her room.
"Connor, what did you do last night? I waited for you all night, but you didn't come back. Moreover, you didn't answer my calls…"
Mina shouted excitedly at Connor. She looked like a resentful wife waiting for her husband to come home. Her expression was extremely resentful.
"Uh..."
After Connor heard Mina's words, he was stunned for a moment, then explained softly, "I drank too much at the bar last night, so I went to my friend's house to spend the night. My phone also ran out of battery…"
"Connor, what happened to you? Why do you always go out to drink these days?" Mina asked Connor with a puzzled expression.
"Actually, there's nothing much. I'm just not in a good mood, so I want to drink some wine…" Connor looked at Mina and explained with a smile.
"So that's how it is!"
Mina looked at Connor and nodded thoughtfully. In fact, Mina also knew that Connor was definitely hiding something from her.
However, Connor clearly didn't want to talk about it now, so Mina didn't want to continue asking.
Connor saw that Mina seemed to want to say something and stopped, so he asked Mina, "Why were you looking for me?"
"Um, do you have time tomorrow?"
Mina hesitated for a moment before asking Connor softly.
"Tomorrow?" Connor was stunned for a moment, then shook his head gently and said, "I don't have anything to do tomorrow. What's wrong?"
Connor indeed had nothing to do tomorrow. Although he was prepared to go to the Empire World Building to ask Scarlett about the drug last night, Connor was not in a hurry to do it because he knew what Scarlett was thinking. Moreover, Connor would definitely not do anything to her because of this!
"Didn't I tell you? I have a few friends who are coming to Porthampton to play, and there's someone who's celebrating his birthday tomorrow. I want to ask if you're free tomorrow. If you're free, can you do me a favor..."
Mina asked Connor in a low voice.
"What favor?"
Connor asked with a puzzled expression.
"I... "When I was with Hector, I told them about him and asked for their opinions. They were also very supportive of me being with Hector, but I didn't expect him to be a big liar, so I broke up with him. But really, him pretending to be a rich heir isn't nice at all, so I was worried that if I told them about this, they would definitely laugh at me in their hearts. That's why I didn't tell them that I had already broken up with Hector!"
Mina looked at Connor and hesitated for a moment. Then, she bit her lips and said softly, "So can you pretend to be my boyfriend tomorrow?"
"Pretend to be your boyfriend?"
Connor was stunned when he heard Mina's words.
"That's right. Didn't CeeM tip a lot of money in my livestream back then? "My friends are all very curious as to what Hector looks like. Other than coming to play with me, they mainly want to see Hector. Besides, I don't have any friends in Porthampton other than you, so I can only ask you to pretend to be my boyfriend this time…"
Mina looked at Connor and explained.
After hearing Mina's words, Connor finally understood what was going on.
In fact, Mina was asking Connor to pretend to be Hector, her former boyfriend, as well as asking him to pretend to be CeeM.
However, Mina might not know that Connor was actually the real CeeM.
To put it simply, Mina was asking Connor to pretend to be himself!
"Since you broke up with Hector for so long, why didn't you tell your friends? You could have thought of another reason to say that the two of you broke up!" Connor asked Mina with a doubtful tone.
After Mina heard Connor's words, she helplessly sighed and said, "Actually, I wanted to tell them about this too, but during the Twitch PK competition, CeeM came to my livestream again and gave me a lot of gifts. If I told them that I had broken up with Hector, they definitely wouldn't believe me. So this time, they insisted on seeing what Hector looks like…"
"Then didn't you show them Hector's photo?"
Connor looked at Mina and asked.
"I'd only been with Hector for less than half a day. How could I have gotten his photo?" Mina said helplessly.
"..."
Connor looked at Mina in front of him with a helpless expression. In fact, he didn't really like doing this kind of thing because he felt that pretending to be someone else's boyfriend usually wouldn't end well.
"Connor, I'm begging you, please help me. If they don't see my boyfriend tomorrow, they will definitely think that I'm being kept by someone. At that time, I won't be able to explain myself!" Mina said pitifully.
In fact, the reason why Mina was so anxious to make Connor pretend to be her boyfriend was that she did not want her friends to continue misunderstanding.
CeeM had given her so many gifts in Mina's livestream, so her friends all thought that she must have been kept by someone!

chapters.title: Chapter 451 - 451: The Most Important Thing Is Personality
chapters.content:
Chapter 451 - 451: The Most Important Thing Is Personality
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Connor saw Mina’s pitiful appearance and was too embarrassed to reject her.
After Connor fell in love with Freya, he had already decided to keep a distance from the women around him.
However, after having sex with Chloe yesterday, Connor’s thoughts began to change again.
Although Connor didn’t want to do anything to let Freya down, there were times when he couldn’t control himself.
Moreover, since he had already had sex with Chloe, Connor felt that he should be responsible for Chloe. However, Connor felt that having Chloe as his lover was enough. He did not want to have anything to do with other women.
After all, things would become very troublesome once a woman became jealous.
So today, Connor didn’t want to agree to Mina’s request to pretend to be his boyfriend, but unfortunately, Mina had put on a puppy face. Moreover, her friends misunderstood Mina because Connor had sent so many gifts on Mina’s live stream channel.
To put it bluntly, Connor caused this. Connor felt that he was obligated to take responsibility for this.
“Connor, if you feel uncomfortable, pretend 1 didn’t say anything to you!” Seeing that Connor did not agree for a long time, she whispered to Connor.
“There’s nothing to be embarrassed about. I’m just worried 1 might not look like a rich heir. If your friend finds out, it won’t be good!” Connor looked at Mina and said softly.
“It’s okay. You don’t have to do anything when the time comes. Just show your face. If you can’t stay any longer, 1’11 tell them you have something else to do and let you leave first!” Mina hurriedly replied.
“If that’s the case, I’ll help you!” Connor said lightly.
“Really?” After Connor agreed, a trace of excitement flashed in her eyes, and she squealed at Connor in disbelief.
“Of course it’s true!” Connor looked at Mina and nodded lightly.
“That’s great. It’s getting late. You should go and rest. We’ll set off at 8 AM tomorrow!” Mina said to him excitedly.
“Okay!” Connor nodded gently, then turned around and returned to his room.
After Mina saw Connor return to his room, she smiled satisfactorily, opened the door, and walked in.
After Connor entered the house, he briefly looked at his phone and found no important information other than some spam calls and junk messages, so Connor turned off his phone and prepared to rest.
‘Ring, ring, ring!’
But at this moment, Connor’s phone suddenly rang.
Connor glanced at his phone and realized it was a Facebook message from Yelena.
Connor had not contacted Yelena the entire summer vacation. He did not know what Yelena was doing now, but Connor had somehow felt that Yelena was very strange, so Connor deliberately avoided her.
Connor knew that Yelena was different from all the other women around him because he could never guess what this woman was thinking. Connor was worried that Yelena had some ulterior motive for contacting him, so he did not dare to get too close to Yelena.
“Connor, what are you doing?” Yelena’s message to Connor was very simple.
After Connor saw this message, he hesitated and did not reply to Yelena.
Connor turned off his phone and closed his eyes to sleep.
***
The next day, at 8 AM.
A knock on the door awakened Connor.
After waking up, Connor shouted in a daze, “Who’s there?”
“Connor, it’s me. Are you awake? We have to go. My friends and the others are leaving at 8:30!”
Mina’s voice sounded from outside the room.
After hearing Mina’s words, Connor suddenly remembered that he had to pretend to be Mina’s boyfriend.
Connor put on his clothes and shouted, “Uhm, wait for me!”
“Alright!” Mina replied and then didn’t say anything else.
Connor put on his clothes and ran to the door to open it.
After opening the door, what greeted Connor’s eyes was an extremely beautiful face. Today, Mina had dressed up well.
Mina had heavy makeup on her face. Her facial features were prominent, and her clothes were alluring. A black spaghetti top perfectly outlined her voluptuous chest, and she wore a white hip-length skirt. Her figure was tall and sexy, and her beautiful legs were smooth and fair under the skirt. It was almost impossible to take one’s eyes off her.
As it was autumn, the weather on the southeastern coast was still relatively hot.
Hence, Mina’s outfit was very cool but also very sexy and alluring. Not only did she have thick makeup on her face, but her clothes were also very revealing. It felt like her breasts were about to spill over the top.
Connor was at Chloe’s house the entire day yesterday, having sex with her. He had a certain understanding of women.
Mina noticed the strange look in Connor’s eyes and quickly asked, “Is there something wrong with how 1 look today?”
“No… There’s nothing wrong with it. It’s just that you’re so beautiful. If we stand together, 1 don’t think anyone will think we’re a couple, right?” Connor still looked like a poor loser, so he replied with a smile.
“I think you’re handsome too. Sometimes, what a person wears isn’t the most important. 1 think what’s important is the personality!” Mina smiled as she replied to Connor.
“You’re right. The most important thing is personality!”
Connor nodded, but he felt his personality was no better.
“Have you not brushed your teeth yet? We still have some time. Why don’t you hurry up and wash up!” Mina scanned Connor from head to toe and whispered to him.
“Right!” Connor nodded and turned around to walk toward the bathroom.
However, the moment Connor turned around, his phone suddenly rang.
When Connor heard the ringtone, he quickly looked back at the phone he had placed by the bed. It was Chloe!
When Connor saw that Chloe called him, he was stunned.
As Mina was close to his phone, she instinctively walked toward it..

chapters.title: Chapter 452 - 452: Connor Is My Boyfriend
chapters.content:
Chapter 452 - 452: Connor Is My Boyfriend
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Inside the room.
When Connor saw Chloe’s call, he was stunned.
If Chloe had called him when no one was around, Connor would not be worried.
After all, he had just had sex with Chloe. It was normal for Chloe to miss him and call him.
But unfortunately, Mina was still present. If Mina knew about Chloe’s existence, this would be troublesome!
In an instant, the air in the entire room became still.
Mina instinctively picked up Connor’s phone, and a trace of nervousness flashed in Connor’s eyes.
The next second, Mina handed Connor his phone and said softly, “Connor, someone is calling you!”
“Phew…”
When Connor saw Mina pass the phone to him, he heaved a sigh of relief. Fortunately, Mina did not help him answer the call.
If Mina picked up the call, Connor would be in trouble today.
He might be unable to explain.
Mina didn’t know Freya, nor did she know Connor’s true identity.
However, Connor felt it was best not to let anyone know about his relationship with Chloe. The more people knew about it, the higher the chance it was exposed.
Fortunately, Mina didn’t answer the call for him.
Connor took the phone from Mina’s hand and walked to the bathroom.
After entering the bathroom, Connor carefully picked up the phone.
“Darling, what are you doing?” Chloe asked him sweetly.
“Hey, Chloe, 1 can’t talk now. I’ll call you back later!” Connor whispered into the phone.
“Okay, darling!” Chloe was quite sensible. After hearing Connor’s tone, she hung up the phone.
Seeing that the call had ended, Connor heaved a sigh of relief. Then, he put down his phone and started to wash up.
Ten minutes later, Connor and Mina left the neighborhood.
Mina was originally very tall. In addition to Mina’s empire-waist dress, she looked taller than Connor.
Connor felt pressured as he walked beside Mina.
Along the way, anyone who saw Mina and Connor would turn around and take a second look at them.
This feeling made Connor very uncomfortable!
Fortunately, after they left the neighborhood, they took a taxi to Porthampton Airport.
