After the two arrived at Porthampton Airport, they waited for nearly ten minutes before a large group of people walked toward Connor and Mina.
“Connor, those are my friends from my hometown…”
Mina looked at the young men and women who had just left the airport and took the initiative to speak to Connor.
“Oh!” Connor nodded lightly and didn’t say anything. Instead, he narrowed his eyes and sized up these people.
At this moment, there were a total of five people walking toward Mina Connor. Among them, there were two boys and three girls.
Moreover, these five people were from very good families. Their outfits were very fashionable. It was obvious that they were wearing clothes from international brands.
“Mina!”
At this moment, a girl with a fit figure shouted at Mina. Then, she ran up to Mina and gave her a big hug!
“Ciara, 1 haven’t seen you for a long time. You seem to have become prettier!” Mina said happily as she looked at the girl.
“No matter how beautiful 1 am, I can’t be as beautiful as you,” Ciara replied with a smile.
At this moment, the other four people walked up to Mina and began to chat with her.
As Connor’s outfit was too ordinary, these people did not notice Connor.
“Mina, didn’t you say you brought your rich boyfriend with you? Where is he? 1 don’t see him!” At this moment, a girl in a short skirt looked around and asked Mina in confusion.
When Mina heard the girl’s words, she couldn’t help but be stunned. Then, she quickly took the initiative to hold Connor’s arm and intimately pulled Connor in front of everyone. She smiled and said, “This is my boyfriend, Connor. He’s the CeeM you’ve been waiting for!”
Mina’s three best friends and the other two boys were dumbfounded when they heard Mina’s explanation. Their eyes widened as they looked at Mina and Connor, their faces filled with disbelief.
“No, Mina, are you joking with us? Isn’t this person your driver? He’s CeeM?” one of Mina’s best friends asked.
After Connor heard this girl’s words, his expression became even more awkward.
“Mavis, what nonsense are you talking about? Connor is my boyfriend!” Mina replied, displeased.
Everyone looked at each other. At this moment, they really couldn’t imagine Connor to be ‘CeeM’, but since Mina said so, they naturally didn’t dare to continue doubting.
“I didn’t expect your boyfriend to be so low-key. If Mina didn’t introduce him to us, we wouldn’t have been able to associate Connor with that super-rich kid on the internet!”
At this moment, Ciara took the initiative to break the awkwardness. She walked up to Connor and smiled at him. “Hello, handsome. I’m Mina’s best friend, Ciara Caddell!”
“Hello, I’m Connor!”
Although Connor was slightly embarrassed by everyone, he quickly got together and replied casually.
“Mavis Cage!”
“Sasha Stein!”
“Calvin Young!”
“Dustin Ward!”
The other four people walked over and took the initiative to greet Connor.
Even though they were suspicious of Connor’s identity, as Mina’s friends, they couldn’t show it directly.
“Alright, everyone, don’t just stand around. Let’s go and get a bite. You’ve been on the plane for such a long time. You are probably hungry!”
At this moment, Mina took the initiative to call out to everyone.
“Sure. 1 heard of a place called ‘Immortal Lake Manor’ in Porthampton. Why don’t we go there for dinner? I heard it’s nice there but a little expensive,” Ciara suggested.
When Mina and Connor heard Ciara’s suggestion, they were both stunned..

chapters.title: Chapter 453 - 453: Going To Immortal Lake Manor
chapters.content:
Chapter 453: Going To Immortal Lake Manor
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
When Connor heard that Mina’s friend wanted to go to the Immortal Lake Manor for a meal, he was completely dumbfounded.
Immortal Lake Manor was Connor’s territory!
If Titus and the others saw Connor, they would recognize him.
Connor would have to explain things. When he thought about these things, he felt a headache coming.
Mina was dumbfounded because she didn’t expect her friend to go so far. She had just arrived in Porthampton and would eat at Immortal Lake Manor.
Although Mina wasn’t a local of Porthampton, she had heard of Immortal Lake Manor.
It was quite expensive to dine at Immortal Lake Manor. If so many people went to eat together, it would cost at least a hundred thousand dollars. Although Mina had earned a few million dollars through live streams, she did not want to waste her money on such a place.
“It’s kinda expensive at Immortal Lake Manor. Why don’t we go somewhere else?” Mina hesitated before saying softly.
“Mina, your boyfriend is so rich. Why do you still care about this little bit of money?” Mavis wasn’t holding back at all as she replied to Mina.
“Yeah, Mina, we’ve heard about the Immortal Lake Manor before we came to Porthampton. It’s not easy for us to be here. What’s wrong with spending some money to treat us to a meal? Besides, it’s not like you are broke now. Didn’t you earn a few million from your live stream the last time?” the other girl, Sasha, added.
Connor wanted to persuade these people not to go to Immortal Lake Manor. After all, Connor had eaten at Immortal Lake Manor before, and many employees knew Connor’s identity. Connor would not be able to hide it even if he wanted to.
However, seeing her friends insistent, Mina was too embarrassed to refuse, so she could only helplessly agree, “Alright then. Since everyone wants to go to the Immortal Lake Manor, let’s go there!”
Mina naturally didn’t know Connor’s worries. After all, no matter where they went to eat, the person who would pay the bill, in the end, would be him.
Seeing Mina agree, Connor became nervous.
Initially, he had planned to agree with Mina and help her find a restaurant that wasn’t inferior to Immortal Lake Manor, but who would have thought Mina would agree?
“That’s great, 1 knew Mina’s the best!” Sasha squealed happily when Mina agreed.
After all, girls were vain creatures. They felt they would already be very proud as long as they could go to Immortal Lake Manor for a meal and then post it on their Instagram.
Seeing that everyone was so happy, Connor naturally knew his place and did not say anything.
“Since we’ve decided, let’s not stand here anymore. Mina, where did you park your car? Let’s go to Immortal Lake Manor!” Ciara said.
“Connor and I didn’t drive here. Let’s take a taxi!” Mina quickly replied.
When everyone heard Mina’s words, they were once again in disbelief.
“Mina, don’t joke with us. Connor is so rich. How could he not drive over…” Ciara exclaimed in disbelief.
After all, in their eyes, Connor was a super-rich heir who could spend millions.
How could such a rich kid not have a car?
Not only should there be a car, but he should also have a limited-edition sports car!
These people were still fantasizing about what kind of car Connor would drive!
But they never expected that Connor and Mina would take a taxi here!
Mina was a very innocent girl and did not have any schemes. She did not have so many worries when she said this just now.
However, when she heard Ciara’s words, she was completely dumbfounded. For a moment, she did not know how to answer her question.
Logically speaking, a rich heir like Connor should have his car!
Mina had never thought of this before. Otherwise, she would help Connor rent a luxury car!
However, it was too late to say anything now!
“My car was hit by someone yesterday. It’s in the 4S shop for repairs now…”
However, as Mina felt awkward and didn’t know how to answer these people, Connor suddenly spoke.
“I see!” Ciara nodded when she heard Connor’s explanation. Then, she looked at Connor and continued, “Connor, what kind of car do you drive?”
“Ferrari F12!” Connor replied calmly.
After hearing Connor’s answer, everyone was in disbelief because they never expected Connor to drive a Ferrari F12!
Connor wasn’t lying. After all, he had a Ferrari sports car. If these people didn’t believe him, Connor could ask Chloe to drive the car there and then explain to Mina that he borrowed the car.
After all, Connor’s villa belonged to his ‘friend’, so the car could naturally be the same.
Therefore, Connor was not worried that his identity would be exposed.
Mina felt Connor was bragging, so she quickly stood up and changed the topic, “Alright, let’s not hang around. Let’s hurry up and set off. Otherwise, Immortal Lake Manor will be closed in a while!”
“That’s right, let’s leave quickly. If they are closed, we won’t be able to eat anything!” Sasha didn’t care what kind of car Connor was driving. All she could think about was going to Immortal Lake Manor for dinner.
With Mina’s arrangement, everyone took two taxis and headed straight for Immortal Lake Manor.
The four girls went in the same taxi, while Connor went with two other boys.
Along the way, the two boys, Dustin and Calvin, took the initiative to talk to Connor. They were very respectful.
Although Connor’s performance today disappointed them, they still instinctively regarded Connor as a super-rich kid. Naturally, they would take the initiative to please Connor.
Connor knew what these two people were thinking, so he only responded simply.
After Dustin and Calvin noticed Connor was a little cold, they did not continue to talk to Connor. Instead, they sat quietly in the car.
However, it was not because Connor had a cold personality that he didn’t talk much.. He was thinking about how he should hide his identity when he go to Immortal Lake Manor later!

chapters.title: Chapter 454 - 454: Would It Kill You to Get a Member Card?
chapters.content:
Chapter 454: Would It Kill You to Get a Member Card?
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndtessFantasy Translation
Half an hour later.
Everyone took a taxi and arrived at the entrance of Immortal Lake Manor.
After getting out of the car, Ciara, Sasha, and the other girls were all shocked by the entrance of Immortal Lake Manor.
Although these girls’ families were relatively rich and they often traveled, it was their first time seeing a restaurant of this scale.
A few girls excitedly took out their phones and started taking selfies.
Mina hesitated before walking toward the entrance of Immortal Lake Manor. Connor followed closely behind Mina.
Connor was still a little perturbed. After all, if the staff of Immortal Lake Manor really recognized him, then he would have to explain his identity to Mina. It would be too troublesome.
“I’m sorry. Please show me your membership card!”
However, just as Connor and Mina were about to enter Immortal Lake Manor, a security guard suddenly reached out and stopped Connor, asking him.
Connor was surprised when he heard the security guard. Then, he suddenly looked up at the security guard.
Connor realized that he had never seen this security guard before. The security guard that Connor met when he first came to Immortal Lake Manor was probably fired by Titus.
“A membership card?” Mina was also stunned when she heard the security guard. So she asked the security guard with a puzzled expression.
“Miss, our Immortal Lake Manor has now implemented a membership system. Those not members of Immortal Lake Manor are not allowed to enter and spend money!” the security guard replied indifferently, then glanced at Connor beside Mina, his eyes filled with disdain.
After all, Connor was dressed very ordinarily and came by taxi. The security guard naturally did not take Connor seriously.
After Connor knew that he needed a membership card to enter Immortal Lake Manor, he finally let out a sigh of relief. After all, as long as Mina and the others could not enter Immortal Lake Manor, and the security guard at the door did not know Connor’s identity, Connor did not have to worry about his identity being exposed.
When Ciara, Sasha, and the other girls saw that the security guards stopped Connor and Mina, they came over and asked what had happened.
“Mina, what happened?” Ciara asked Mina.
“This security guard said that if we want to dine at Immortal Lake Manor, we must have a membership card. If we don’t have a membership card, we can’t enter!” Mina explained helplessly.
“So show him a membership card. Your boyfriend is so rich, and he’s from Porthampton. I heard these rich heirs in Porthampton like to come here to dine!” Sasha said to Connor with a surprised expression when she found out they couldn’t go in for dinner.
“I don’t like to eat at places like this, so I don’t have a membership card here!” Connor replied indifferently.
“So what happens now? If we can’t even enter Immortal Lake Manor, wouldn’t we have come in vain?” Mavis muttered unhappily. Then, she turned to the security guard and asked, “How can I become a member of Immortal Lake Manor?”
“It’s very simple to join Immortal Lake Manor as a member. You only to pay a membership fee of five million dollars!” the security guard replied disdainfully.
Everyone turned to look at Connor after hearing the security guard’s words.
After all, in their eyes, Connor was a real wealthy heir. He could casually tip a few million dollars on Mina’s live stream. Five million dollars should not be much to Connor!
Therefore, they had a very simple thought. That was to get Connor to buy a membership card and bring them in for dinner.
“Connor, you’re so rich. Why don’t you just get a membership card? You can come here to dine in the future anyway!” Sasha said to Connor after hesitating.
“Sasha, what nonsense? A membership card costs five million! Five million is not a small sum!” Ciara called out pretentiously.
When Sasha saw the expression on Clara’s face, she instantly understood what she meant. She continued, “Five million is definitely not a small amount to us, but it should not be a big deal to a rich heir like Connor. After all, Mr.
McDonald is so rich…”
“That’s right. Five million dollars shouldn’t be much to Connor, right?” Mavis pouted and said.
Connor narrowed his eyes and looked at the three girls. At this moment, he was very clear that these three girls just wanted him to spend money to get a membership card.
However, the three might not have dreamed that Immortal Lake Manor belonged to Connor!
Connor didn’t need a membership card to go in for dinner. He just needed to take out his phone and call Titus.
However, Connor knew that if he did this, he would expose his identity. Connor did not want to expose his identity to Mina.
“Five million is not a small sum of money to anyone. Even if Connor gets this membership card, he won’t be able to use it in the future, so let’s go somewhere else to eat!” Mina suddenly said.
When Ciara, Sasha, Mavis, and the others heard Mina’s words, they were stunned.
They never expected that the person who rejected them was not Connor but Mina.
Mina didn’t know that Connor was rich. Even she couldn’t take out five million dollars.
And even if she could afford it, Mina would never do so. Spending five million dollars just for a meal here was too much waste.
“Mina!” Sasha whined reluctantly.
“Sasha, Connor is indeed rich, but no one’s money comes from nowhere. Spending five million on a meal here is really a waste.” Mina knew exactly what Sasha wanted to say, so she replied with a straight face and walked toward the main road.
At this moment, Mina was already upset with her friends’ behavior. She felt that her friends had gone too far.
“Mina, we’re already here. Isn’t it not nice to leave like this…” Seeing that Mina was about to leave, Sasha quickly reached out and pulled Mina.
Connor stood in place and saw Mina and her friend in such a state. He couldn’t bear it, so he would call Titus and ask the security guards to let them in.
“Connor, you’re so rich. Would it kill you to get a membership card?” However, just as Connor was about to take out his phone, Sasha shouted at him.
When Connor heard Sasha’s words, he was instantly stunned..

chapters.title: Chapter 455 - 455: He’s Not A Rich Heir At All
chapters.content:
Chapter 455: He’s Not A Rich Heir At All
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
“You’re so rich. Would it kill you to get a membership card?” Connor could not help but sneer when he heard Sasha’s provocation. Then, he put his phone back helplessly.
Connor never thought that Sasha would be so shameless. Did he have to spend five million to treat them to a meal just because he was rich?
Who were they?
Connor didn’t want Mina to lose face in front of her friends, so he was soft-hearted and wanted to call Titus.
However, when he heard Sasha’s words, he instantly changed his mind. He said to Sasha expressionlessly, “You’re right. I’m indeed rich. It won’t kill me to get a membership card.”
Mina couldn’t help but be stunned when she heard Connor’s words. She didn’t understand what Connor meant!
“Does Connor really want to apply for a membership card? Where would he get the money from? Is he crazy?” Mina wondered.
When Sasha, Ciara, and the others heard Connor’s claim, they also thought Connor was planning to apply for the membership because he wanted to keep his reputation.
“Since you have money, go get the membership card now. We don’t have to wait here!” Sasha said excitedly to Connor.
“I can get a membership card, but I want to ask you a question!” Connor said slowly.
When Sasha heard Connor’s words, she was stunned for a moment. Then, she hurriedly asked, “What’s it?”
“I want to ask you, why do I have to apply for a membership card just to treat you guys to a meal?” Connor asked indifferently.
Sasha looked at Connor with a trace of doubt in her eyes.
“Five million is indeed nothing to me, but why should I spend it on someone like you? I didn’t want to argue with you because of Mina. You said you wanted to come here for dinner, so here we are. But remember, I’m treating you, and you’re not paying. I’m not close to you, but do you think I should spend five million dollars on someone like you?” Connor asked Sasha domineeringly.
Sasha was dumbfounded. She never expected Connor, who seemed submissive, to speak so domineeringly now.
“Mina, let’s go!” Seeing that Sasha didn’t say anything, he called out to Mina.
Mina looked at Connor and was also very surprised. She didn’t think that Connor would dare to say these words.
Although Mina had always wanted to say this, she didn’t dare to. But now, Connor had said all these.
Connor didn’t leave because he felt it hurt to take out the five million dollars. He mostly felt that Sasha and the others had gone over the top. Why did he have to treat them to a meal just because he was rich? How was that a good reason?
When Ciara, Mavis, Sasha, and the others saw that Mina and Connor were really planning to leave, they were very unhappy. Sasha, in particular, stood rooted to the ground awkwardly.
“What kind of rich heir is Connor?” To ease the awkwardness, Ciara couldn’t help but mutter.
“Yeah, it was as if we were asking him to give his kidney. This is the first time I’ve met such a rich heir!” Mavis added.
After a moment of hesitation, Calvin said softly, “Don’t you guys feel that there’s something wrong with Connor?”
“Something’s wrong?” After Mavis heard Calvin’s assumption, she was stunned. She asked Calvin with a puzzled expression, “What do you mean by that?”
“I somehow feel Connor isn’t a rich heir…” Calvin said slowly.
After hearing Calvin’s words, the three girls were stunned again.
“Calvin, cut the crap. Connor tipped Mina on her live stream with millions. How could he have so much money if he’s not a rich heir?” Ciara quickly said.
“How do we know it was Connor?” Calvin couldn’t help but sneer and continue, “Look at his outfit. How does he look like a rich heir? Which rich heir would dress like Connor?”
Everyone couldn’t help but turn to look at Connor, who was standing not far away. They began to agree with Calvin’s words.
“What Calvin said makes sense. Connor is dressed so shabbily, and he even needs to take a taxi when he goes out. Now, he can’t even bear to spend five million. If he’s really a rich heir, how can he be reluctant to spend even this little bit of money? In front of his girlfriend, on top of that!” Dustin hurriedly followed up.
“You mean Connor might have deceived Mina?” Ciara asked softly after a moment of hesitation.
“I think so. 1 think even Mina herself doesn’t know that Connor is a fake rich heir. I’ve met so many rich heirs but never seen someone like Connor!” Calvin said slowly.
“There must be something wrong with Connor!” Sasha also shouted.
“So what should we do now? Should we tell Mina that Connor might have deceived her?” Mavis said anxiously.
“Mavis, are you stupid? We don’t have any evidence at all. If you tell Mina that Connor is a liar and that he’s not a rich heir, do you think Mina will believe you?” Ciara quickly said.
“But we can’t just ignore everything now, right? What if Connor scammed Mina?” Mavis said anxiously.
Ciara stood in the same spot for two seconds before whispering, “You don’t have to worry about this. I have a way to expose Connor’s true colors!”
After saying that, Ciara took out her cell phone and made a call.
‘Ring, ring, ring…’ After the phone rang twice, the call connected.
“Yves, what are you doing?” Ciara asked softly.
“Nothing much. What’s up?” Yves replied with a smile.
“Do you have time now? I came to Porthampton with my friends…” Ciara said lightly,
“You are in Porthampton? Where are you? I’ll pick you up now!” He spoke excitedly when the other party found out Ciara was in Porthampton.
When Ciara saw Yves’ reaction, she smiled smugly..

chapters.title: Chapter 456 - 456: Ciara Caddell’s Plan
chapters.content:
Chapter 456 - 456: Ciara Caddell’s Plan
Translator: End less Fantasy Translation Editor: End LessFantasy Translation
At the entrance of the Fairy Lake Resort.
As Connor didn’t plan to apply for a membership card, Mina’s friends began to suspect his identity.
No matter how one looked at it, Connor did not look like a rich heir.
Ciara then called her friend Yves Lynn.
After Ciara rejected Yves’s invitation to pick her up, she said softly, “Yves, I heard that your family owns a restaurant. How about I bring my friends there for dinner later?’1
“Sure, when are you coming over? I’m in the restaurant now!11
Yves replied excitedly after hearing Ciara’s words.
“Send me your address. I’ll go over now!’1
Ciara said lightly.
“Alright, I’ll send you the location later!”
Yves hurriedly replied before hanging up.
After the call ended, Ciara revealed a very proud smile. Then, she narrowed her eyes and looked at Connor.
“Ciara, who were you calling just now?”
Sasha asked Ciara in confusion.
“It’s a friend I met in Porthampton. His name is Yves. He seems to be interested in me, but he’s ugly.”
Ciara explained.
“Then, why did you call him?” Sasha looked at Ciara and asked in confusion.
“Why are you so slow?”
Ciara couldn’t help but roll her eyes at Sasha before continuing, “Yves’s family is also very rich. Moreover, Yves is nor young anymore, but he is considered a rich heir. If Connor is really a rich heir, Yves will definitely know him. So, when we go to Yves’s family’s restaurant to eat, we can see how Yves will react when he sees Connor.”
“Then, what if Connor is a rich heir but your friend doesn’t know him?”
Sasha hesitated for a moment and asked Ciara softly.
“That doesn’t matter. Yves knows a lot of rich heirs in Porthampton. When rhe time comes, Ill just ger Yves to investigate Connor’s identity.”
Ciara replied softly as she proudly pursed her lips.
“That’s true. Ciara, you’re so smart!”
Sasha smiled happily and turned to look at Connor and Mina who were standing by the roadside.
Because of what Connor had said to Sasha previously, she hated him. Therefore, she could not wait to see Yves expose Connor’s true colors. At that time, she could humiliate him.
“Mina, I just called my friend. Why don’t we go to my friend’s restaurant for dinner?”
At this moment, Ciara walked to Mina’s side and whispered to her.
“Go to your friend’s restaurant? Would that really be alright?”
At this moment, Mina still did not know what Ciara, Sasha, and the others were planning. Even though Mina felt that them wanting to come eat at the Fairy Lake Resort was a bit too much, she could still buy them to a meal elsewhere.
“Why not? That person is interested in me, but I haven’t agreed to be with him. Anyway, we have nowhere else to go now, so why don’t we go to his restaurant for dinner?”
Ciara said with a smile.
Since Ciara had already put it that way, Mina couldn’t say anything more. She could only helplessly say, “Alright then. In that case, let’s go to your friend’s restaurant. I’ll still pay though.”
“Alright, alright. I know you’ve found a rich heir as your boyfriend. No one’s going to fight for the bill.”
After Ciara said this, she gave Connor a meaningful look.
Mina was very innocent and did not know what Ciara wanted to do.
However, Connor could feel that something was wrong. However, he did not take it to heart. After all, he was only accompanying Mina today, so he did not say much.
Seeing that Mina did not turn her down, Ciara hailed two taxis, and they were headed to Yves’s restaurant.
Connor followed Dustin Ward and Calvin Young into one taxi.
Meanwhile, Mina Ciara, and the other two girls were sitting in another taxi.
“Mina, what does your boyfriend do?”
Ciara asked Mina softly after a moment of hesitation.
When Mina heard Ciara’s words, she couldn’t help but be stunned for a moment. Then, she said softly, “Connor is still studying at the Porthampton University. He’s not working!”
“Then, do you know what Connor’s family does?”
Ciara looked at Mina and continued to ask.
“I’m not too sure about this either…”
Mina continued to shake her head.
“You don’t even know what Connor’s family does but you’re with him?”
Ciara pretended to be very surprised and exclaimed with her mouth open.
In actually fact, Ciara was deliberately saying these things to Mina. Her intentions were clear. She wanted to ask about Connor’s family situation and see if Mina knew him well.
After hearing Mina’s answer, Ciara also had an answer in her heart, because she realized that Mina did not seem to understand Connor at ail.
“I’m with Connor because of him, not because of his family. Why should I care about his family background?”
Mina replied indifferently.
“True!”
Ciara nodded gently and continued, “My friend, Yves Lynn, is also from Porthampton, and he’s also a rich heir. He seems to be studying at Porthampton University. Maybe Yves knows Connor!”
When Mina heard Ciara’s words, she was instantly stunned.
If Ciara’s friend really knew Connor, then wouldn’t Connor’s act of pretending to be a rich heir be exposed?
Hence, Mina started to feel a little nervous.
A few minutes later.
The taxi stopped in front of a restaurant with a rather grand decoration. The name of the restaurant was Lorenzo Hotel.
Although the Lorenzo Hotel could not be compared to the large holiday resorts like rhe Fairy Lake Resort, it was still very high-end compared to ordinary restaurants.
At this moment, a man in a white suit was standing at the entrance of the hotel.
When Connor saw this man, he was instantly stunned..

chapters.title: Chapter 457 - 457: Maybe You Know Each Other
chapters.content:
Chapter 457: Maybe You Know Each Other
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
At the entrance of the Lorenzo Hotel.
When Connor saw the man in a white suit, he was instantly stunned. He was extremely shocked.
Because Connor knew this man!
This man was called Yves Lynn. He was also a student at the Porthampton University, but Yves was one year older than Connor.
Yves was considered a well-known rich heir in the Porthampton University. After all, his family owned such a big hotel. He was considered a famous person in the university!
Logically speaking, Connor and a rich heir like Yves would not cross paths.
However, Connor had joined a Zither club when he was in university, and the president of the Zither club was Melissa Sachs, who had crashed into Connor’s car some time ago.
When Connor first came to the Porthampton University, Yves was crazily pursuing Melissa. He had also joined the Zither club.
However, Melissa had never taken a fancy to Yves. Although Yves’s family was very rich, he was ugly. Not only was he fat, but he also had pimples all over his face. No matter how rich Yves’s family was, Melissa would never be with such a guy.
Connor had seen Yves a few times when he was in the Zither club, but fortunately, Connor did not go to the Zither club many times. Moreover, seeing that Melissa did not accept his feelings for her, Yves gave up pursuing her, so he did not go to the Zither club again.
Connor did not know if Yves still recognized him!
“Connor, what’s wrong?”
Mina seemed to have noticed that something was wrong with Connor’s expression and couldn’t help but ask him softly.
“Nothing…”
Connor hurriedly replied.
Mina was very smart. She knew that there must be a reason Connor was like this. After hesitating for a moment, she asked Connor softly, “Connor, do you know this guy?”
“I guess, but I don’t know if he still remembers me…”
Connor felt that there was no need to hide this kind of stuff, so he directly replied.
H H
When Mina heard Connor’s words, a trace of nervousness flashed across her face. She then whispered, “It doesn’t matter. It’s fine even if you know each other. At most, we’ll just be exposed by them…”
Mina did not expect Ciara and the others to know the students from Porthampton University. However, since everyone was already here, if they suddenly said that they wanted to leave, it would definitely make them suspicious. Therefore, Mina had no intention of leaving.
Connor took a deep breath and followed Mina to where Ciara and the others were.
At this moment, Ciara was chatting with Yves and the others. It could be seen that Yves had given up on pursuing Melissa and was preparing to pursue Ciara.
Just like Melissa, Ciara felt that Yves was ugly and had no intention of being with him at all. If it were not for what happened at the entrance of Fairy Lake Resort, Ciara would not have told Yves that she was in Porthampton.
“Mina, this is the good friend I told you about, Yves Lynn!”
When Ciara saw Mina walking over, she introduced her with a smile.
“Hello!”
Mina looked at Yves with a faint smile and greeted him.
When Yves saw Mina, he couldn’t help but gulp, he was stunned.
After all, Mina was the most beautiful among the girls. Whether it was her figure or her appearance, she was the best of the best. Most importantly, Mina’s temperament was very good. It was not something that an ordinary girl like Ciara could compare to.
Yves looked at Mina lecherously and ignored Ciara and the others.
Ciara was no fool. She knew very well what Yves’s reaction meant.
Ciara could not help but curse Yves in her heart. Then, she coughed twice and pointed at Connor. “Yves, this is Mina’s boyfriend, Connor. He’s also a student at Porthampton University.”
“Connor?”
When Yves heard this name, he was obviously stunned for a moment. A trace of doubt flashed across his eyes.
This was because Yves clearly felt that he had heard this name somewhere before. Also, he felt that Connor seemed a little familiar.
However, Yves’s memory was not very good. He actually did not remember who Connor was for a moment!
Moreover, most of Yves’s attention was on Mina’s slender and fair legs. He had no mood to think about who Connor was!
“Hello!”
Connor took the initiative to greet Yves when he saw that Yves did not speak to him for a long time.
“Hello!”
Yves replied before turning his attention back to Mina. He smiled and asked Mina, “Miss Mina, are you from Porthampton too?”
“No…”
Mina lightly shook her head.
“No wonder! If you were from Porthampton, there’s no way 1 wouldn’t have seen such a beauty like yourself before!”
Yves grinned and wanted to get close to Mina.
Ciara stood beside Yves with an awl<ward expression on her face. After all, Yves was Ciara’s admirer, and it was Ciara who had brought Mina and the others over.
However, Yves could not move when he saw Mina. He even ignored Ciara who was standing at the side. Even though Ciara was not interested in Yves, she was still very unhappy!
“Yves, this is our first time here. Are you going to just let us stand here?”
Ciara frowned and shouted in displeasure.
“Ah…”
Yves came to after hearing this. He quickly reached out and patted his forehead. Then, he smiled at Ciara and said, “Ciara, I’ve already asked someone to prepare a private room. Let’s go in. You’ve been on the move for the whole day, so you must be hungry now!”
“Hmph!”
Ciara snorted coldly, then turned around and walked straight into the hotel.
Yves was not in the mood to care about Ciara at all. Instead, he focused all his attention on Mina. Even though Mina’s boyfriend, Connor, was still standing beside Mina, Yves did not care at all.
After all, from the interaction just now, Yves could feel that Connor was just an ordinary person, so he did not take Connor seriously at all!
Moreover, he was prepared to poach Mina in front of Connor!
However, Mina ignored Yves, her expression extremely helpless..

chapters.title: Chapter 458 - 458: Do You Know Connor?
chapters.content:
Chapter 458: Do You Know Connor?
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Five minutes later.
Under Yves’s lead, everyone quickly arrived at the Lorenzo Hotel’s private room.
After Ciara, Mavis Cage, and Sasha Stein entered the private room, all of them revealed surprised expressions.
The three of them had never expected that Yves’s hotel would be so luxurious. The decoration of the private room could completely rival that of a five-star hotel.
“Yves, your hotel is really luxurious.”
Ciara’s attitude toward Yves seemed to have changed. She stared at Yves with her big, watery eyes.
The person who knew Yves the best was probably Ciara. However, because Ciara was not a local of Porthampton, she spent most of her time chatting with Yves online, asking him to buy her some cosmetics.
Yves had always been very generous. Ciara felt that Yves’s family must be very rich. Later, she found out that Yves’s family owned a hotel.
This was Ciara’s first time coming to Yves’s hotel. She did not expect Yves’s hotel to be so big and luxurious. If Ciara had known earlier, she would have been with Yves a long time ago.
Even if Yves was a little ugly, so what?
As long as he had money!
However, Ciara knew that even if she wanted to be with Yves now, there was probably no chance for her to do so. This was because Yves’s mind was completely focused on Mina.
If Ciara and Mina were put together, anyone who wasn’t a fool would choose Mina. No one would choose Ciara.
When Connor saw Yves being so attentive to Mina, he didn’t have any reaction at all. After all, Connor and Mina weren’t really boyfriend and girlfriend. Moreover, Connor was very clear in his heart that Mina wouldn’t fall for someone like Yves.
Connor’s guess was right. Mina really disliked Yves. After dealing with Yves in a perfunctory manner, she took the initiative to chat with Connor.
Yves smiled awkwardly when he saw that Mina was ignoring him. He then took out the menu and handed it to Ciara and the others. He said softly, “Ciara, take a look at what you want to eat. Order whatever you want. I’ll pay for this meal today…”
“Really?”
Sasha shouted excitedly when she heard Yves’s words.
“Of course, it’s true. You’re all Ciara’s friends. You don’t come to Porthampton much, so how could I not buy you guys a meal?”
Yves looked at Sasha and replied with a smile.
“Yves, you’re really dashing, unlike some people who can’t even fork out some money to buy us a meal!”
Mavis insinuated.
“Yeah, they’re both rich heirs, but why is the difference so big? Some people look down on ordinary people like us just because they have some money…” Sasha pouted and said.
When Sasha said this, she turned her head to look at Connor who was sitting beside Mina. It was clear what she meant.
Connor naturally knew what Sasha and Mavis were talking about, but he did not care at all. He even felt like laughing at them. What kind of logic was this?
“Yves, can I talk to you outside?”
At that moment, Ciara suddenly stood up and spoke.
Ciara had been so jealous that she had almost forgotten the purpose of her visit. She did not bring Connor and the others here for a meal. She wanted to expose Connor’s identity.
However, with Mina and Connor present, Ciara was too embarrassed to say some things out loud. She could only call Yves out first and then explain the situation to him.
When Yves heard Ciara’s words, he could not help but be stunned for a moment. Then, he asked Ciara with a puzzled expression, “Ciara, what’s the matter?”
“Just follow me.”
Ciara replied impatiently. Then, she stood up and walked out of the private room.
Yves sat on the spot and hesitated for a moment. Then, he smiled and said, “Um, Ciara and 1 are going to go out for a while. You guys take a look at the menu first and order whatever you like!”
After saying that, Yves stood up and followed Ciara out of the private room.
Sasha, Mavis, Dustin Ward, and the others did not seem to know what was going on either, so they did not pay too much attention to it. They took out the menu and began to look through it.
On the other side, Yves followed Ciara out of the private room and came to a corner at the end of the corridor.
Yves looked at Ciara impatiently. Then, he frowned and asked Ciara, “Why did you want to speak to me personally?”
“Yves, do you know Connor?”
When Ciara saw how Yves was acting, she knew that he no longer had any feelings for her, so she asked directly.
When Yves heard Ciara’s words, he was stunned for a moment. A trace of confusion flashed across his eyes. Then, he asked in a low voice, “What do you mean by that?”
“Don’t worry about what 1 mean. Do you know him or not?”
Ciara replied impatiently.
Yves hesitated for a moment, then said in a low voice, “When I first saw this guy, I felt that he looked a little familiar. 1 must have seen this person in school…”
“Then, do you think Connor is a rich heir?”
Ciara hurriedly asked Yves.
“Rich heir?”
Yves smiled disdainfully when he heard Ciara’s words. Then, he said indifferently, “Don’t joke with me here. Do you think that kid is a rich heir?”
“But Mina has always said that this Connor is a rich guy. I brought Connor here this time because 1 want you to help me investigate his identity and see what his background is!”
Ciara said softly.
Yves looked at Ciara in front of him, and a strange look flashed across his eyes.
He finally understood why Ciara had called him out.
Yves blinked his wretched little eyes. He felt that this matter was also beneficial to him, so he asked Ciara softly, “Are you sure this kid is a student at Porthampton University?”
“How can 1 be sure of that? I’m not studying at your university, but Mina has always said that he’s a student at Porthampton University. Didn’t you just say that you’ve seen Connor in campus?”
Ciara thought for a moment before replying softly to Yves.
“If this Connor is really a rich heir and a student of at Porthampton, then there’s no way I wouldn’t know him!”
Yves stood there and hesitated for a while before he whispered to Ciara..

chapters.title: Chapter 459 - 459: He’s a Poor Loser!
chapters.content:
Chapter 459: He’s a Poor Loser!
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Hearing Yves’s words, Ciara could not help but be stunned for a moment. A trace of doubt flashed across her eyes.
She looked at Yves and asked with a puzzled expression, “Why?”
“Because there are only a few rich heirs in Porthampton University. Although there are many young people who are from influential families in the school, there are less than ten rich heirs who are considered famous. Although we don’t really know each other, we know about each other…”
Yves hurriedly replied.
“What if Connor is a very low-key rich heir?”
Ciara asked.
“That’s not impossible…” Yves nodded lightly.
“That’s why I want to find out Connor’s true identity. I’m worried that Mina will be deceived by Connor!”
Ciara paused for a moment, then looked at Yves and continued, “And I can see that you seem to be interested in Mina. If you can prove that Connor is a fake rich heir, Mina will definitely choose to break up with Connor.”
“Ciara, what do you mean by that? I’ve always loved you. I was just putting on an act with Mina…”
Although Ciara had exposed Yves, he knew that his relationship with Mina was not over yet. Moreover, Mina’s was still very cold to him, so he did not intend to give up on Ciara as a backup.
“Even if you’re not interested in Mina, can you help me since she’s my friend?”
Ciara replied softly.
“Of course. Your matter is my matter. I definitely won’t stand by and watch!”
Yves patted his chest and shouted, then continued, “I’ll call my friend now and ask them to investigate who this Connor is!”
“Can your friend find out?”
Ciara asked worriedly.
“Don’t worry. As long as this kid is a student at Porthampton University, I’ll definitely be able to find out his identity!”
Yves replied without thinking.
“Alright, then I’ll go back in first!”
Ciara nodded gently, then turned around and walked into the private room.
When Yves saw Ciara go back, a smug smile appeared on his face. Although he said that he was doing this because of Ciara, he was actually doing it for Mina.
Once he had exposed Connor’s true identity, it would be of great help to Yves in pursuing Mina.
Yves took out his phone and dialed a friend’s number.
“Hey Hudson, can you get the deets on someone for me?”
After the call was connected, Yves said with a smile.
“Who is it?”
The other party asked arrogantly,
“Is there a rich heir named Connor McDonald in our university? Do you know him?”
Yves said slowly.
“Connor McDonald?”
When the other party heard this name, he could not help but be stunned for a moment. Then, he asked in a puzzled tone, “Which year is he in?”
“He should be in his third year. Anyway, he’s not from our batch. Otherwise, I would definitely know him!”
Yves replied after thinking for a moment.
“Third year’s Connor McDonald?”
The other party recalled briefly and then said loudly, “What the f*ck. This Connor McDonald you’re talking about can’t be the poor Connor McDonald from our school, right?”
“Poor?”
Yves suddenly remembered something.
“Yeah, have you forgotten? It’s that Connor that you joined the Zither club with that time. He’s that poor loser who goes to deliver food after class every day. I heard that he was cheated on by his girlfriend who then got together with Brandon Guthrie…” The other party hurriedly said.
“Now that you mention it, I have some impression of that happening…”
After hearing the other party’s words, Yves grinned and continued, “I was wondering why this kid looked a little familiar just now. So, he’s the poor loser who delivers food in our school! Hehe, interesting…”
“Why are you suddenly asking me about this kid?”The other party asked with some doubt.
“It’s nothing. I’m just casually asking…”
Yves replied casually and hung up the phone. He walked into the private room with a smile on his face. He was prepared to expose Connor’s identity in front of everyone.
Yves felt that as long as Mina knew Connor’s identity, she would definitely break up with Connor on the spot. At that time, he would comfort Mina. Perhaps he would be able to bring the beauty home.
“Haha, such a good opportunity for me!”
Yves suppressed the joy in his heart and hurriedly walked toward the private room.
However, at that moment, the door to the private room opened again and Ciara walked out.
“Yves, how’s your investigation going?”
Ciara asked Yves excitedly when she saw him.
“Don’t worry. I’ve already investigated it clearly. This Connor is not some rich second-generation heir at all. He’s a famous poor loser in our school. He usually relies on delivering food outside the school to make a living. I’m going in now to expose this kid’s true colors!”
Yves said proudly to Ciara.
When Ciara heard Yves’s words, a hint of excitement flashed across her eyes. She had long suspected Connor’s identity. Now that Yves had confirmed it, it meant that Connor was definitely not a rich heir.
“Let’s go. I can’t wait to expose his real identity. At that time, I want to see how he is going to explain this matter…”
Yves reached out and tugged at Ciara as he said with a smug expression.
“Wait a minute!”
Ciara suddenly glanced at Yves and said softly, “If you go in now, do you have any evidence to prove that what you said is true?”
“Do we still need evidence? The entire Porthampton University knows that Connor is a poor loser. I reckon that as long as I say it out loud, he will definitely be scared silly. He might even be unable to speak…”
Yves said with a smile.
H 11
Ciara looked at Yves helplessly, not knowing what to say.
“Ciara, don’t worry. This guy is famous for being a poor loser in our school. As long as I reveal his identity, he’ll definitely pee his pants on the spot…”
Yves could not help but want to expose Connor’s identity, so he dragged Ciara into the private room..

chapters.title: Chapter 460 - 460: Don’t Hold Back On Me!
chapters.content:
Chapter 460: Don’t Hold Back On Me!
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
“Don’t be so anxious!”
Ciara called out helplessly and continued, “Since this Connor dares to pretend to be a rich heir, it means that he’s prepared to be exposed. If you rush in rashly now, not only will Mina not believe you, but she will also think that you are framing Connor. After all, you don’t have any evidence now…”
When Yves heard Clara’s words, he could not help but be stunned for a moment. Then, he frowned and asked, “Ciara, what do you think we should do about this?”
Ciara stood in the same spot for a while before saying softly, “Actually, it’s very simple. In any case, we already know Connor’s identity. So, we don’t need to be in a hurry to expose him…”
“Then, when are we going to expose him?”
Yves asked helplessly.
“That’s simple. After we go in, we’ll pretend that nothing happened. We’ll eat and drink as we should. Don’t provoke Connor on purpose or talk to him. When we’re done eating and ready to pay, I’ll take the initiative to stand up and say that you shouldn’t be the one to treat us, but Connor should be the one to treat us!”
Ciara paused for a moment before continuing, “In the end, we’ll let Connor pay the bill. If Connor is really a poor loser, then he definitely won’t have the money to pay the bill. After all, there are so many of us eating here, so it will cost at least tens of thousands of dollars.”
“Ciara, your idea is pretty good!”
Yves said excitedly.
“When that time comes, we will have evidence to prove that Connor is not some rich heir at all. Then, you can do your part and expose Connor. Mina will definitely believe you!
Ciara said proudly to Yves.
“Ciara, you’re way smarter than I am. If it were me, 1 definitely wouldn’t have thought of that!”
Yves grinned and seemed to have agreed with Clara’s idea.
“Remember, when the two of us go in later, pretend that nothing happened. Do you understand what I mean?”
Ciara whispered to Yves.
“Don’t worry, I understand!”
Yves nodded without thinking.
Ciara smiled in satisfaction and walked into the private room.
In fact, Ciara had done so many things not entirely for Mina’s sake. She was not afraid that Mina would be deceived.
She did it for her vanity.
Ever since she was young, Ciara liked to compare herself with Mina.
Ever since Ciara found out that Mina had found a very rich boyfriend, she was very dissatisfied. Why could Mina find such a rich boyfriend, but she couldn’t get a rich boyfriend?
Although Ciara did not show it on her face, she was still very unhappy deep down. That was why she had always wanted to come to Porthampton to meet Mina’s boyfriend and see if he was really as rich as Mina said.
Ciara had finally found a good opportunity to expose Connor. Of course, she was not willing to let it go.
Some girls looked like best friends on the surface, but they were actually comparing themselves to each other deep down. Moreover, this kind of comparison was very scary.
After Yves and Ciara returned to the private room, everyone was ready to order.
As Yves and Ciara had known each other for a long time, the others did not pay much attention to their disappearance.
“Has everyone decided on what to eat? You don’t have to be shy with me today. Just order whatever you want to eat. Anyway, this hotel is owned by my family. Don’t save money for me!”
When Yves entered the private room, he exclaimed heroically.
“Yves, if that’s the case, then we’re going to order whatever we want!”
Sasha Stein blinked and said to Yves.
“Don’t be shy. If you’re shy, then you must think 1 can’t afford it!” Yves grinned and replied.
He was not worried that Sasha and the others would order too much. On the contrary, he was worried that these people would order too little.
“Yves’s spirit is really different. He’s much more generous than some people!” Sasha said with a smile.
Mina naturally understood what Sasha meant. She couldn’t help but frown slightly and opened her mouth to speak.
But at this moment, Connor suddenly reached out and touched Mina, then shook his head at her, signaling her to ignore these people.
Mina took a deep breath. She was very unhappy, but she did not say anything. Instead, she lowered her head and looked at the menu in front of her.
Everyone began to order.
Perhaps because they knew that this was a hotel owned by Yves’s family, Sasha, Mavis Cage, Dustin Ward, and the others did not hold back at all. They picked up the menu and began to order crazily.
They ordered sea cucumbers and abalones, shark fin soup, papaya stewed snow clams, steamed trout… and whatever else was expensive!
In the blink of an eye, these people had ordered nearly 50,000 dollars’ worth of dishes.
When Yves saw that Sasha and the others had ordered so many things, not only was he not unhappy, but he also had a very bright smile on his face.
Connor did not know what Yves and Ciara were planning. He felt that Yves might be stupid and rich. In order to be in the limelight in front of Mina, he was actually spending so much money. It was really not worth it!
“Connor, aren’t you going to eat anything? I see that you haven’t ordered anything!”
Yves asked Connor with a smile after seeing Mina and Connor sitting there without saying anything.
“Nope, what they’ve ordered is enough!”
Connor looked at Yves and shook his head gently.
When Yves heard Connor’s words, he smiled faintly. Then, he reached out and picked up the menu. He looked at everyone and asked, “Is there anything else that everyone wants to eat? Don’t hold back on me!”
“Yves, we’ve already ordered enough. If we order more, we might not be able to finish it…”
Sasha hurriedly replied.
Yves looked directly at the door and said softly to the waiter, “Let me see the list. I want to see how many things they’ve ordered!”
The waiter quickly came over and handed the list to Yves.
After Yves took the list, he glanced at it briefly and he was instantly shocked.
This was because he realized that Sasha and the others had actually ordered dishes that cost nearly 50,000 dollars. They really did not hold back!
A meal that cost 50,000 dollars was quite shocking!
Back then, when Connor treated the entire class to a meal, he only spent 70,000 dollars.
However, there were fewer than ten people here, and they had already ordered so many things.. This meant that Sasha and the others did not hold back at all, and they did not have the slightest intention of saving money for Yves!

chapters.title: Chapter 461 - 459: He’s a Poor Loser!
chapters.content:
Chapter 459: He’s a Poor Loser!
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Hearing Yves’s words, Ciara could not help but be stunned for a moment. A trace of doubt flashed across her eyes.
She looked at Yves and asked with a puzzled expression, “Why?”
“Because there are only a few rich heirs in Porthampton University. Although there are many young people who are from influential families in the school, there are less than ten rich heirs who are considered famous. Although we don’t really know each other, we know about each other…”
Yves hurriedly replied.
“What if Connor is a very low-key rich heir?”
Ciara asked.
“That’s not impossible…” Yves nodded lightly.
“That’s why I want to find out Connor’s true identity. I’m worried that Mina will be deceived by Connor!”
Ciara paused for a moment, then looked at Yves and continued, “And I can see that you seem to be interested in Mina. If you can prove that Connor is a fake rich heir, Mina will definitely choose to break up with Connor.”
“Ciara, what do you mean by that? I’ve always loved you. I was just putting on an act with Mina…”
Although Ciara had exposed Yves, he knew that his relationship with Mina was not over yet. Moreover, Mina’s was still very cold to him, so he did not intend to give up on Ciara as a backup.
“Even if you’re not interested in Mina, can you help me since she’s my friend?”
Ciara replied softly.
“Of course. Your matter is my matter. i definitely won’t stand by and watch!”
Yves patted his chest and shouted, then continued, “i’ll call my friend now and ask them to investigate who this Connor is!”
“Can your friend find out?”
Ciara asked worriedly.
“Don’t worry. As long as this kid is a student at Porthampton University, I’ll definitely be able to find out his identity!”
Yves replied without thinking.
“Alright, then I’ll go back in first!”
Ciara nodded gently, then turned around and walked into the private room.
When Yves saw Ciara go back, a smug smile appeared on his face. Although he said that he was doing this because of Ciara, he was actually doing it for Mina.
Once he had exposed Connor’s true identity, it would be of great help to Yves in pursuing Mina.
Yves took out his phone and dialed a friend’s number.
“Hey Hudson, can you get the deets on someone for me?”
After the call was connected, Yves said with a smile.
“Who is it?”
The other party asked arrogantly,
“Is there a rich heir named Connor McDonald in our university? Do you know him?”
Yves said slowly.
“Connor McDonald?”
When the other party heard this name, he could not help but be stunned for a moment. Then, he asked in a puzzled tone, “Which year is he in?”
“He should be in his third year. Anyway, he’s not from our batch. Otherwise, 1 would definitely know him!”
Yves replied after thinking for a moment.
“Third year’s Connor McDonald?”
The other party recalled briefly and then said loudly, “What the f*ck. This Connor McDonald you’re talking about can’t be the poor Connor McDonald from our school, right?”
“Poor?”
Yves suddenly remembered something.
“Yeah, have you forgotten? It’s that Connor that you joined the Zither club with that time. He’s that poor loser who goes to deliver food after class every day. I heard that he was cheated on by his girlfriend who then got together with Brandon Guthrie…” The other party hurriedly said.
“Now that you mention it, I have some impression of that happening…”
After hearing the other party’s words, Yves grinned and continued, “I was wondering why this kid looked a little familiar just now. So, he’s the poor loser who delivers food in our school! Hehe, interesting…”
“Why are you suddenly asking me about this kid?”The other party asked with some doubt.
“It’s nothing. I’m just casually asking…”
Yves replied casually and hung up the phone. He walked into the private room with a smile on his face. He was prepared to expose Connor’s identity in front of everyone.
Yves felt that as long as Mina knew Connor’s identity, she would definitely break up with Connor on the spot. At that time, he would comfort Mina. Perhaps he would be able to bring the beauty home.
“Haha, such a good opportunity for me!”
Yves suppressed the joy in his heart and hurriedly walked toward the private room.
However, at that moment, the door to the private room opened again and Ciara walked out.
“Yves, how’s your investigation going?”
Ciara asked Yves excitedly when she saw him.
“Don’t worry. I’ve already investigated it clearly. This Connor is not some rich second-generation heir at all. He’s a famous poor loser in our school. He usually relies on delivering food outside the school to make a living. I’m going in now to expose this kid’s true colors!”
Yves said proudly to Ciara.
When Ciara heard Yves’s words, a hint of excitement flashed across her eyes. She had long suspected Connor’s identity. Now that Yves had confirmed it, it meant that Connor was definitely not a rich heir.
“Let’s go. 1 can’t wait to expose his real identity. At that time, 1 want to see how he is going to explain this matter…”
Yves reached out and tugged at Ciara as he said with a smug expression.
“Wait a minute!”
Ciara suddenly glanced at Yves and said softly, “If you go in now, do you have any evidence to prove that what you said is true?”
“Do we still need evidence? The entire Porthampton University knows that Connor is a poor loser. I reckon that as long as I say it out loud, he will definitely be scared silly. He might even be unable to speak…”
Yves said with a smile.
Ciara looked at Yves helplessly, not knowing what to say.
“Ciara, don’t worry. This guy is famous for being a poor loser in our school. As long as 1 reveal his identity, he’ll definitely pee his pants on the spot…”
Yves could not help but want to expose Connor’s identity, so he dragged Ciara into the private room..

chapters.title: Chapter 462 - 460: Don’t Hold Back On Me!
chapters.content:
Chapter 460: Don’t Hold Back On Me!
Translator: End less Fantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
“Don’t be so anxious!”
Ciara called out helplessly and continued, “Since this Connor dares to pretend to be a rich heir, it means that he’s prepared to be exposed. If you rush in rashly now, not only will Mina not believe you, but she will also think that you are framing Connor. After all, you don’t have any evidence now…”
When Yves heard Clara’s words, he could not help but be stunned for a moment. Then, he frowned and asked, “Ciara, what do you think we should do about this?”
Ciara stood in the same spot for a while before saying softly, “Actually, it’s very simple. In any case, we already know Connor’s identity. So, we don’t need to be in a hurry to expose him…”
“Then, when are we going to expose him?”
Yves asked helplessly.
“That’s simple. After we go in, we’ll pretend that nothing happened. We’ll eat and drink as we should. Don’t provoke Connor on purpose or talk to him. When we’re done eating and ready to pay, 1’11 take the initiative to stand up and say that you shouldn’t be the one to treat us, but Connor should be the one to treat us!”
Ciara paused for a moment before continuing, “In the end, we’ll let Connor pay the bill. If Connor is really a poor loser, then he definitely won’t have the money to pay the bill. After all, there are so many of us eating here, so it will cost at least tens of thousands of dollars.”
“Ciara, your idea is pretty good!”
Yves said excitedly.
“When that time comes, we wall have evidence to prove that Connor is not some rich heir at all. Then, you can do your part and expose Connor. Mina will definitely believe you!
Ciara said proudly to Yves.
“Ciara, you’re way smarter than 1 am. If it were me, 1 definitely wouldn’t have thought of that!”
Yves grinned and seemed to have agreed with Ciara’s idea.
“Remember, when the two of us go in later, pretend that nothing happened. Do you understand what I mean?”
Ciara whispered to Yves.
“Don’t worry, 1 understand!”
Yves nodded without thinking.
Ciara smiled in satisfaction and walked into the private room.
In fact, Ciara had done so many things not entirely for Mina’s sake. She was not afraid that Mina would be deceived.
She did it for her vanity.
Ever since she was young, Ciara liked to compare herself with Mina.
Ever since Ciara found out that Mina had found a very rich boyfriend, she was very dissatisfied. Why could Mina find such a rich boyfriend, but she couldn’t get a rich boyfriend?
Although Ciara did not show it on her face, she was still very unhappy deep down. That was why she had always wanted to come to Porthampton to meet Mina’s boyfriend and see if he was really as rich as Mina said.
Ciara had finally found a good opportunity to expose Connor. Of course, she was not willing to let it go.
Some girls looked like best friends on the surface, but they were actually comparing themselves to each other deep down. Moreover, this kind of comparison was very scary.
After Yves and Ciara returned to the private room, everyone was ready to order.
As Yves and Ciara had known each other for a long time, the others did not pay much attention to their disappearance.
“Has everyone decided on what to eat? You don’t have to be shy with me today. Just order whatever you want to eat. Anyway, this hotel is owned by my family. Don’t save money for me!”
When Yves entered the private room, he exclaimed heroically.
“Yves, if that’s the case, then we’re going to order whatever we want!”
Sasha Stein blinked and said to Yves.
“Don’t be shy. If you’re shy, then you must think 1 can’t afford it!” Yves grinned and replied.
He was not worried that Sasha and the others would order too much. On the contrary, he was worried that these people would order too little.
“Yves’s spirit is really different. He’s much more generous than some people!” Sasha said with a smile.
Mina naturally understood what Sasha meant. She couldn’t help but frown slightly and opened her mouth to speak.
But at this moment, Connor suddenly reached out and touched Mina, then shook his head at her, signaling her to ignore these people.
Mina took a deep breath. She was very unhappy, but she did not say anything. Instead, she lowered her head and looked at the menu in front of her.
Everyone began to order.
Perhaps because they knew that this was a hotel owned by Yves’s family, Sasha, Mavis Cage, Dustin Ward, and the others did not hold back at all. They picked up the menu and began to order crazily.
They ordered sea cucumbers and abalones, shark fin soup, papaya stewed snow clams, steamed trout… and whatever else was expensive!
In the blink of an eye, these people had ordered nearly 50,000 dollars’ worth of dishes.
When Yves saw that Sasha and the others had ordered so many things, not only was he not unhappy, but he also had a very bright smile on his face.
Connor did not know what Yves and Ciara were planning. He felt that Yves might be stupid and rich. In order to be in the limelight in front of Mina, he was actually spending so much money. It was really not worth it!
“Connor, aren’t you going to eat anything? I see that you haven’t ordered anything!”
Yves asked Connor with a smile after seeing Mina and Connor sitting there without saying anything.
“Nope, what they’ve ordered is enough!”
Connor looked at Yves and shook his head gently.
When Yves heard Connor’s words, he smiled faintly. Then, he reached out and picked up the menu. He looked at everyone and asked, “Is there anything else that everyone wants to eat? Don’t hold back on me!”
“Yves, we’ve already ordered enough. If we order more, we might not be able to finish it…”
Sasha hurriedly replied.
Yves looked directly at the door and said softly to the waiter, “Let me see the list. I want to see how many things they’ve ordered!”
The waiter quickly came over and handed the list to Yves.
After Yves took the list, he glanced at it briefly and he was instantly shocked.
This was because he realized that Sasha and the others had actually ordered dishes that cost nearly 50,000 dollars. They really did not hold back!
A meal that cost 50,000 dollars was quite shocking!
Back then, when Connor treated the entire class to a meal, he only spent 70,000 dollars.
However, there were fewer than ten people here, and they had already ordered so many things.. This meant that Sasha and the others did not hold back at all, and they did not have the slightest intention of saving money for Yves!

chapters.title: Chapter 463 - 463: What Else Do You Want Me to Explain?
chapters.content:
Chapter 463 - 463: What Else Do You Want Me to Explain?
Translator: End less Fantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
“100,000 dollars?”
Upon hearing the waiter’s words, Connor couldn’t help but pause for a moment. Then he took out his bank card, prepared to let the waiter swipe it.
Although he knew that doing so might expose his identity, he believed he could explain it to Mina later. He didn’t think Mina would suspect him because of this 100,000 dollars!
“I’ll pay…”
Just as he took out his bank card and was about to speak.
“I’ll cover this meal!”
But before he could finish his sentence, Mina suddenly shouted and directly handed her bank card to the waiter.
She believed that he couldn’t possibly come up with so much money. If Connor really had 100,000 dollars he wouldn’t be sharing an apartment with her.
However, Mina had earned quite a bit of money from her recent livestreams, so 100,000 dollars was nothing to her!
“Mina, what are you doing?”
Upon seeing Mina’s offer to pay, Clara couldn’t stand it anymore. She stared at her and exclaimed in an agitated tone.
“What do you mean? You’re all my friends, and you came to Porthampton to hang out with me. So, this meal shouldn’t be paid by Connor, it should be on me,” Mina replied coldly.
“Oh, if Connor is so wealthy, just let him pay. It’s not like he can’t afford it, right?”
Ciara didn’t want Mina to spend that money at all. Her purpose today was to expose Connor’s act to pretend to be a rich heir. If Mina ended up paying, her plan would be ruined.
“Just because Connor has money, he should treat us to a meal? Not to mention it’s a very expensive meal. Where’s the logic in that?” Mina’s tone was slightly displeased as she questioned Ciara.
“Mina, just listen to me. Let him pay for this meal. There’s a reason behind my actions!”
Ciara shouted at Mina with an exceptionally worked up expression.
Mina looked at Ciara up and down, her expression even more puzzled. She couldn’t understand why Ciara insisted on letting Connor treat everyone to a meal!
“Ciara, why do you insist on having Connor pay for this meal?”
Mina sensed that something was off and quickly asked her.
“Oh, I can’t explain this to you right now. Anyway, it’s right to let Connor pay the bill!”
Ciara realized she had let something slip and quickly tried to explain.
“No, you have to explain everything to me today. What is your motive for doing this?”
Mina exclaimed, staring with wide eyes.
The more Ciara and the others tried to conceal the truth, the more suspicious Mina became.
“Fine, Mina, I’ll tell you the truth!”
She knew that the truth might no longer be hidden, so she reluctantly spoke.
“What’s going on?”
Mina asked with a furrowed brow.
“Mina, let me explain. I had Yves’ friend investigate Connor, and it turns out he’s not a rich heir at all. He’s just a poor student at Porthampton University, and he works as a delivery boy. I think he might be pretending to be a rich heir to deceive you. That’s why 1 wanted him to pay for the meal. It’s an expensive meal, 100,000 dollars, which is indeed a lot for us, but I don’t think it’s much for a rich heir, right?”
Ciara reluctantly revealed the truth.
After hearing these words, everyone present stood still in shock. Although they had suspected Connor’s identity might be fake, no one expected it to be true. He was not only not a rich heir but also a poor delivery driver!
“I knew it! How could he be a rich heir? He doesn’t even have a car, and look at how he’s dressed. It’s so funny! Even the securities at my school dresses better than him!” Mavis pouted and exclaimed.
“No wonder he was so excited when I asked him to get a membership card at Immortal Lake Manor. It’s because he didn’t have any money!”
Sasha also quickly added.
Upon hearing the mocking remarks about Connor, Mina was stunned, her expression filled with astonishment. She never expected Ciara and the others to actually investigate his identity.
“Ciara, you’re not joking with me, right? How could Zhang Feng be a fraud?”
Mina tried to maintain a calm demeanor and stuttered as she spoke to Ciara.
“Why is it impossible for him to be a fraud?” she sneered.
“If Connor is really a fraud, then… how could he have sent so many gifts to my livestream? Can you explain that?”
Mina responded with a touch of helplessness.
“Mina, you’re too naive. Just because he claims to be a local tyrant, you believe him? Can he open his Twitch account for us to see now? And in the current situation, as long as he can pay for this meal, it will prove his identity. Just let him pay for the meal, can’t you do that?”
Ciara quickly shouted.
Upon hearing her words, Mina was instantly dumbfounded. She stood there with a vacant expression, unsure of how to refute Clara’s words.
First of all, Mina didn’t believe Connor could log into his Twitch account. After all, she knew he was pretending to be Hector and had called him over.
And then there was the idea of spending 100,000 dollars to prove his identity. Mina felt it was even more impossible. After all, he was just a poor student. How could he have 100,000 dollars?
Mina stood there in embarrassment, not knowing what to do.
“Mina, 1 know it’s hard for you to accept right now. We weren’t planning to tell you about this. We wanted to gather evidence first and then inform you. But now that you’ve asked, I can only tell you the truth!”
Ciara arrogantly shouted at Mina.
But at this moment, Connor suddenly stood up, walked to Mina’s side, and whispered to her, “Can we leave now?”
“Why should you leave? You haven’t explained the matter of you pretending to be a rich heir!”
Ciara loudly exclaimed when she saw that Connor seemed to want to leave.
He coldly glanced at her and said expressionlessly, “I’ve already paid for this meal.. What else do you want me to explain?”

chapters.title: Chapter 464 - 464: Proving Them Wrong!
chapters.content:
Chapter 464 - 464: Proving Them Wrong!
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
“You’ve already paid the bill?”
After hearing Connor’s words, everyone present was stunned, their expressions filled with shock.
“That’s right, Mr. Connor did pay the bill just now…”
At that moment, the waiter suddenly spoke up.
Ciara, Yves and the others shifted their attention to the waiter, their eyes filled with confusion.
Because no one expected that while Ciara and Mina were discussing whether he was a second-generation rich person, he had already secretly paid the bill.
Connor’s actions at this moment undoubtedly proved everyone wrong!
Just now, Ciara stated that if he could pay the bill, it would prove that he wasn’t lying and that he really was a rich heir.
Now they stood frozen in place. Mina too froze in place. Everyone looked at him with strange eyes.
Just a moment ago, Ciara and Yves were confident, thinking that Connor was just a poor loser who delivered food and couldn’t come up with 100,000 dollars.
So they thought they could expose his true identity.
But what they never expected was that Connor actually had the money, and he paid the bill!
“How… How is this possible?”
Yves was completely dumbfounded now, standing still with a blank expression on his face, looking very puzzled. He couldn’t understand where Connor got this money from.
“How can he have the money to pay the bill?”
Ciara also looked bewildered and hurriedly ran up to the waiter, shouting loudly, “Are you sure Connor already paid the bill just now?”
“Yes, Mr. Connor swiped his card just now, a total of 100,000 dollars!”
The waiter nodded in confirmation.
She turned to look at Connor and shouted incredulously, “Where did you get the money?”
“What does it have to do with you where I got the money?”
He replied expressionlessly, then turned to Mina and said, “I’ve already paid the bill. Shall we leave now?”
“Okay… okay…”
Mina stammered in response, then followed Connor as they walked out of the private room. Only Yves, Ciara, and the others stood in place, looking baffled. They still couldn’t understand what was going on.
“Yves, didn’t you say this guy was just a poor loser who delivered food? How could he have the money to pay the bill?” Ciara angrily shouted at Li Yan.
She had wanted to humiliate Mina through this incident, but she never expected it would turn out like this.
“My friend told me this he is just a food delivery guy, and he even skimps on meals. Could it be that my friend got it wrong?”
Yves was also visibly confused now. After all, if Connor was really a poor loser he couldn’t have come up with 100,000 dollars?
“Yves, why don’t you call your friend and verify? If this Zhang Feng is really a rich heir, it’s not good for us to offend him like this. What if he retaliates against us in the future?”
Sasha said to Yves in a worried tone.
After hesitating for a moment, he felt that her words made sense, so he took out his phone and dialed his friend’s number.
“Ring, ring, ring…”
After the phone rang for a while, the other party picked up.
“Mr. Yves, is there anything else?”
The other party asked in a casual manner.
“Hudson, you told me that Connor is a poor loser. Are you sure you didn’t get it wrong?”
Yves frowned and asked in a low voice.
“Of course I’m sure. There’s indeed a poor loser named Connor in our school.
He usually sends food out. Many students know him.”
The other party replied with certainty.
“Then why did this kid spend 100,000 dollars in my restaurant just now without blinking? If he’s really a poor loser like you said, then he shouldn’t be able to take out 100,000 dollars!”
Yves said helplessly.
When the other party heard this, he could not help but be stunned for a moment. With a puzzled expression, he said, “That doesn’t make sense. I heard that this kid usually doesn’t even eat to support his girlfriend. Why is he so generous now? Could it be that he won the lottery…”
“What lottery? Could it be that the Connor you’re talking about is not the same person as the Connor I’m meeting now?” Yves frowned and muttered.
“It should be possible!”
After thinking for a moment, the other party muttered softly.
After all, according to Yves’ description just now, he was not sure if the Connor that he knew was the same person from their school.
When Yves heard this, his expression turned ugly. After a moment of silence, he said in a low voice, “Hudson, can you help me get photos of Connor now? I want to confirm if this Connor is the same person you mentioned!”
“Uh…”
The other party seemed to be in a difficult position. After hesitating for two seconds, he continued, “I’ll try my best to help you find it. After all, I don’t know this Connor, so I’m not sure if I can find a photo of him.”
“Alright, try your best!”
Yves replied indifferently before hanging up.
“Yves, what did your friend say?”
Ciara saw that he had hung up the phone and quickly stepped forward to ask with a nervous expression.
“This matter is a little troublesome. My friend actually doesn’t know Connor. He just heard some things about him, so now there’s no way to determine whether he is a poor loser or a rich heir!” he replied helplessly.
“What kind of friend is this? He had just said that Connor was a poor loser. Why is he uncertain now? If Connor is really a rich second-generation heir, then didn’t we offend him just now?” Ciara pouted and shouted with a helpless expression.
“Don’t worry, I’ve already asked my friend to find Connor’s photo. As long as my friend can find his photo, we’ll know the truth.” Yves explained.
“Then what should we do now?”
Sasha seemed to be a little afraid as she asked.
She was worried that if Connor was really a rich heir and a local of Porthampton, he might take revenge on them if he got angry over this matter!

chapters.title: Chapter 465 - 465: Spring Blossom Manor
chapters.content:
Chapter 465: Spring Blossom Manor
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
“Right, if Connor is reaily a rich heir, he will definitely seek revenge on us!”
Mavis and Sasha were clearly bullies who fear those stronger than them.
At this moment, they don’t care about anything else, only their own safety.
“Don’t worry. If he really wants to seek revenge on you, I will protect you!” After hesitating for a moment, Yves said tot them.
“Moreover, Connor is Mina’s boyfriend. I don’t think he would go too far!” Ciara also added at this time.
Upon hearing this, Mavis and Sasha visibly relaxed, but deep down, they still felt regretful. They regretted why they had humiliated him in the first place.
“Let’s pretend nothing happened when we go out later. After all, his identity has not been confirmed yet. When my friend finds Connor’s photo and we confirm that he is indeed a rich heir, we can apologize to him. But if he is not a rich heir, then I will teach him a lesson!”
Yves stood in place, expressionless, and spoke to everyone.
After hearing his words, everyone nodded in agreement. After all, his suggestion was the best option at the moment.
And they had no choice but to rely on Yves. If Connor really sought revenge on them, only he could save them.
On the other side, after leaving the hotel, Mina and Connor noticed that Yves and the others had not come out yet.
They had no idea what they were discussing inside the private room. Mina didn’t seem to care much about it either. She was constantly wondering where Connor got so much money from.
“Connor…”
She felt that speculating aimlessly was pointless, so after hesitating for a moment, she directly called out to him.
He turned his head and glanced at her casually, then smiled and said, “Are you going to ask me about the money?”
“Yes. Where did you get so much money from? Aren’t you always poor?” she asked with a puzzled expression.
“Well…” Upon hearing her question, a hint of embarrassment flashed across his face.
But he quickly recovered and said expressionlessly, “This money is my tuition fee and the money I earned from working this summer. I paid the bill earlier to prevent your situation from being exposed…”
“That is your tuition fee?” Mina covered her mouth in astonishment, her expression incredibly incredulous. She never expected that he would use his tuition fee to pay the bill.
“How else could I have so much money? This money was what I earned from delivering takeout for half a year. Originally, I planned to use it to pay my tuition fees. But now, I’ve used it to treat your friends.” He smiled and explained to her.
In fact, Connor had already planned what excuse to use to hide this from Mina, so his words came naturally.
“I see.” She looked at him and felt deeply moved. She realized that how good a man treats you is not measured by how much money he spends on you, but by his willingness to spend all the money he has on you.
This sum of money might not be much, but it was enough to show his feelings for her.
His actions had deeply touched her at this moment.
“Connor, don’t worry, I will definitely pay you back this money!” she promised him.
Connor couldn’t help but pause for a moment after hearing Mina’s words. He had no intention of asking her for the money back. After all, this amount of money meant nothing to him.
“Um, Mina, I… I think you may have misunderstood me. 1 didn’t say those words to ask you for the money. I…” he quickly explained to her.
She looked at him with a faint smile and said softly, “You don’t have to explain anything to me. I know what you mean. But rest assured, I will definitely return this money to you. After all, you work hard to earn it. I’ve earned a lot of money from my recent live broadcasts, and this hundred thousand is just half a year’s savings for you, but for me, it may be the money I make from a single live stream. So, 1 will definitely give this money back to you…”
