Upon hearing her words, his expression became extremely helpless.
For Mina, this hundred thousand dollars might be the amount she earns from a single live stream.
But for him, he could make ten times or even hundreds of times more money in just a second!
He had originally planned to continue discussing this matter with Mina, but suddenly he heard footsteps coming from the hotel.
Connor instinctively glanced at the hotel entrance and found that it was Yves, Ciara and the rest coming out of the hotel.
After hesitating for a moment, he didn’t continue discussing this matter with Mina as he was worried that they might overhear.
“Mina, Connor, I’m sorry. 1 arranged for the driver, so it took a bit of time!”
Perhaps because Yves still couldn’t determine Connor’s true identity, he was still very polite when speaking to him.
“It’s okay,” Mina replied indifferently.
Yves glanced meaningfully at Connor but didn’t say much.
At this moment, three BMW cars directly parked in front of the hotel.
“My arranged cars have arrived. Let’s get in and go to the villa area!”
He said with a smile to Mina.
“Okay.”
Mina nodded.
She noticed that they didn’t seem to mention what happened in the private room just now, so she naturally didn’t bring it up either.
“Mina, where is the villa you rented located?”
Just then, Ciara suddenly asked her.
“In Spring Blossom Manor!”
Mina instinctively replied.
Upon hearing her words, Connor’s eyes flashed with surprise.
He had already given Mina the key to his own villa, but his villa was not in Spring Blossom Manor.
This meant that she didn’t choose to rent his villa!
He couldn’t understand why she suddenly wanted to change the location.. Was she dissatisfied with his villa?

chapters.title: Chapter 466 - 466: It’s Not As Good As My Family’s Villa!
chapters.content:
Chapter 466: It’s Not As Good As My Family’s Villa!
Translator: End less Fantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Five minutes later.
Everyone got into the BMW and rushed to the Purple County Garden Villa Complex.
Although Ciara, Yves, and the others did not know if Connor was a real rich heir or not, because of what had happened in the private room just now, everyone was too embarrassed to approach Connor.
Therefore, Connor and Mina sat in one car, Yves, Dustin, and Calvin sat in another car, and Ciara, Sasha, and Mavis sat in the third car.
After the car started, Connor was still a little puzzled as to why Mina didn’t choose his villa. After all, Connor’s villa could be said to be a priceless mansion. It was not comparable to an ordinary villa.
There was no reason for Mina to choose another villa over his own!
“Why didn’t you go to the villa I lent you? Is my villa not good enough?” Connor asked Mina softly.
After Mina heard Connor’s words, a trace of embarrassment flashed across her eyes. She then smiled and said, “No… 1 just felt that the villa you lent me was too luxurious. I was worried that my friends would destroy the things in the villa, so 1 rented another one…”
“Oh, oh!”
Connor heard Mina’s explanation and nodded lightly. He didn’t say anything because he felt that Mina’s words made sense.
After all, his villa really was too luxurious; any one piece of furniture in it would cost a few million. Ordinary people would definitely feel uncomfortable living in it.
Mina saw that Connor didn’t say anything, so she quickly looked at Connor and added, “Connor, 1 don’t mind the villa you lent me. Don’t think too much about it!”
“No, I wasn’t…” Connor said with a smile.
“That’s good…”
Mina nodded lightly and did not say anything more. She turned her head to look at the scenery outside the car.
Connor saw that Mina didn’t say anything, so he didn’t say anything either. Instead, he closed his eyes and started to rest.
However, Connor might not know that Mina had chosen another villa not because his villa was too luxurious. On the contrary, Mina did not go in to see what it looked like.
That day Mina followed the address given to her by Connor and found the residential area where the villa was located. She was shocked by the environment inside. Although she didn’t know that this villa was the king of the residential area, she could feel that the price of this villa was definitely not affordable by ordinary people. The person who could live here was definitely one of the top figures in Porthampton!
However, Connor said that this villa belonged to his friend. Mina couldn’t understand how an ordinary person like Connor could know such a rich man.
Therefore, Mina vaguely felt that something was not right, so she did not enter the villa. Instead, she found the security guard in the community and asked about the situation of the villa. She wanted to ask who the owner of this villa was and whether it could be Connor’s friend.
However, the security guard told her that the villa had been sold a long time ago, but no one knew who the owner of the villa was. No one had seen anyone living in the villa. Only some housekeeping staff or people from the showroom came to clean the house every day.
After Mina heard the security guard’s words, the doubt in her heart became even stronger.
She felt that Connor should be working in the showroom of this villa during the summer vacation. This way, Connor would have a chance to get the key to this villa.
Moreover, Connor knew that no one lived in this villa at all, and the owner would not come back. That was why Connor said that this villa belonged to his friend and gave him the key so that he could bring his friend over.
After all, only this explanation could explain why Connor had the key to the villa.
If Connor really knew such a rich man, Mina would never believe it. After all, to be able to buy such a villa was not something that an ordinary rich person could do. Such a person had to be worth at least tens of billions of dollars!
Mina knew that this villa didn’t belong to Connor, nor did it belong to Connor’s friend, so she naturally didn’t dare to bring her friends here. If the owner of the villa found out, they would call the police and arrest them all.
Which was why she’d rented a different villa.
However, the kind-hearted Mina did not intend to tell Connor about this because she felt that since Connor had stolen the villa key for her, if she told him about this, it would definitely hurt Connor’s self-esteem.
Thus, Mina could only find a random excuse to temporarily fool Connor.
The Purple County Garden Villa Complex was not far from the hotel. About 20 minutes later, the three BMW stopped in front of a neighborhood with a good environment.
“We’re here!”
Mina stretched out her hand and gently pushed Connor who had fallen asleep in the car.
Connor opened his eyes in a daze, then turned his head to look at the environment outside. He whispered to Mina, “This villa doesn’t seem to be as good as the villa 1 lent you!”
“Yeah, it’s definitely not as good as that one!”
Mina looked at Connor with a faint smile, then directly reached out to open the car door and got out.
After Connor saw Mina get off the car, he didn’t say anything and directly followed Mina out of the car.
After he got out of the car, he realized that Yves and the others had already entered the neighborhood.
“The environment of this villa is quite ordinary!” Yves looked around and said disdainfully.
“Yeah, it looks a little shabby!” Ciara quickly added.
After Mina heard the conversation between the two of them, her expression seemed a little awkward. She said softly, “The villas that can be rented in Porthampton right now are considered to be quite okay. The environments of the other villas might not be as good as this!”
“Why didn’t you tell me earlier that you wanted to rent a villa? I could’ve also lent you a villa. My villa is much better than this!” Yves shouted loudly.
After Dustin heard this, he hurriedly asked Yves with a smile, “Mr. Lynn, where is your house?”
“It’s in the Tomson Luxury Villa Complex!” Yves declared proudly.
When everyone heard Yves’s words, they were all stunned on the spot.. Their expressions were extremely shocked!

chapters.title: Chapter 467 - 467: I’m Renting A Room With Someone Now
chapters.content:
Chapter 467: I’m Renting A Room With Someone Now
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
“Tomson Luxury Villa Complex?”
After Dustin heard this, the expression on his face seemed to be even more shocked.
Ciara and the others looked at Yves with envy.
Tomson Luxury Villa Complex could be said to be the most famous villa complex in Porthampton. Any villa in it was priceless.
Those who could live in Tomson Luxury Court usually had a worth of more than 100 million!
“Mr. Lynn, you’re amazing to be able to live in Tomson Luxury Villa Complex. You’re too amazing!”
At this moment, Sasha’s eyes were already shining as she looked at Yves. However, Sasha actually did not know how expensive a house in Tomson Luxury Villa Complex was. She only judged it from the expressions of Dustin and the others.
“What is a mere royal court?”
Yves shouted arrogantly. Then, he looked at everyone and asked, “Do you know what the best and most expensive villa in Porthampton is?”
“The best villa in Porthampton?”
When Dustin heard this, he could not help but be stunned for a moment. Then, he said in a low voice, “I heard that the most expensive villa in Porthampton should be the Royal Villas villa of Evergrande Real Estate. It is said that the most expensive and luxurious villa in Porthampton is in the Royal Villas complex. It’s worth hundreds of millions, but it seems that it hasn’t been sold yet. Such an expensive villa must not be easy to sell!”
“I didn’t expect Dustin to be so knowledgeable!”
Yves smiled faintly after hearing Dustin’s words.
“My family is in the real estate business, and I’m also interested in things like houses, so I know a little more than ordinary people. However, compared to you, Mr. Lynn, I might still be far behind!”
Dustin smiled and flattered.
Yves smiled again, then looked at everyone and said, “Just now, Dustin was right. The best villa in Porthampton is indeed the mansion in Royal Villas. It is known as the priceless treasure of Porthampton. However, there’s something Dustin said that was wrong. The villa has been sold for several hundred million. My father originally planned to buy that villa, but he had no choice.”
“So that’s how it is!”
Dustin nodded his head lightly. The way he looked at Yves had obviously changed.
Yves had explained so much because he wanted to tell everyone that his family had the ability to buy that villa. It was just that someone had beat them to it.
Ciara, Sasha, and the others looked at Yves with even more excitement. If he was willing to buy a villa worth hundreds of millions, then how rich was Yves’s family?
Mina didn’t say a word from the beginning to the end because the villa in Royal Villas and Royal Villas that Yves mentioned was actually the one that Connor had lent to her. Mina finally realized the true value of the villa at this moment, and she was even more certain that Connor definitely didn’t know the owner of the villa.
“Mr. Lynn, is your family actually so rich?”
Sasha said to Yves with her charming eyes.
“It’s alright. If it weren’t for the fact that someone beat me to it, I would probably be living in Royal Villas now!” Yves replied smugly. He knew that his words had achieved his goal.
Meanwhile, Connor kept smiling at Yves as if he was looking at a fool.
Others might not know if what Yves said was true or false, but Connor knew very well in his heart!
First of all, Royal Villas was Connor’s property. Connor had bought two villas in Royal Villas, but he had given them away at that time.
Moreover, Connor had heard from Chloe that Royal Villas was too expensive and that no one could afford it. At most, only the likes of Thomas Morgan and Kyle Hayes could afford it.
However, since Thomas and Kyle already had houses, they would not waste their money on this place.
Yves had said that her family wanted to buy this villa, but there was no such thing!
“I don’t know what kind of person is so rich as to be able to buy such an expensive house!” Ciara could not help but sigh softly.
“I heard that he seems to be a mysterious rich heir, but I don’t know who he is exactly…”
Yves said indifferently.
“If only Mr. Lynn had bought the mansion back then. We would have had a chance to take a good look at it…” Sasha whispered.
“Haha, there will be plenty of opportunities in the future. Porthampton is developing rapidly, and there will definitely be a villa better than the Royal Villas in the future. I will buy it then.”
Yves grinned.
“Then, we can use you, Mr. Lynn!”
Dustin said with a smile.
“Yeah, we probably won’t be able to afford such an expensive house in our lifetime, but if we can borrow your light to stay in for a night, it’s also very good!” Calvin quickly followed up and said,
“I didn’t expect your family to be so rich, Mr. Lynn. You’re really amazing…”
Sasha wished she could strip herself naked and throw herself into Yves’s arms. So what if Yves was a little ugly? As long as Yves was rich, it would be fine.
However, at this moment, Ciara suddenly noticed Connor, who had been standing silently at the side, and asked Connor with a smile, “By the way, Connor, where do you live?”
“Where do I live?”
When Connor heard Clara’s words, he couldn’t help but be stunned.
Mina couldn’t help but feel her heart tighten. She was worried that if Connor spilled the beans, then the fact that he was pretending to be her boyfriend would be exposed.
As expected, Connor did not think too much and directly replied, “I’m renting a house with someone now!”
“Renting with someone else?”
When everyone heard Connor’s words, they were all stunned on the spot. Their expressions were extremely shocked.
No one had expected Connor to say that he was living in a rented house, and that he was sharing it with someone else!
If Connor was really a rich heir, why would he share a room with someone else?
Mina also looked at Connor with a broken expression, because after Connor said this, all her plans might be ruined.
“Connor, can you stop joking with us? How can you share a room with someone else when you’re so rich?”
Ciara said to Connor with a look of interest.
“What’s wrong with sharing a room?”
Connor replied to Ciara calmly..

chapters.title: Chapter 468 - 468: He’s a Liar!
chapters.content:
Chapter 468: He’s a Liar!
Translator: End less Fantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
When everyone heard that Connor was rooming with someone else, they all revealed shocked expressions.
Because they felt that if Connor was really a rich second generation, how could he have fallen to the point of sharing a room with someone else?
Even if Connor didn’t live in the villa, he should have a house of his own, right?
But Connor had actually admitted that he lived in the rented house in front of so many people. This was really unbelievable.
After Ciara heard Connor’s words, she couldn’t help but laugh and said to Connor with a playful expression, “1 didn’t expect you to live in a rented house, Connor. I thought you lived in the villa too!”
“Yeah! A rich heir? Living in a rental house now? It’s really too funny…” Sasha hurriedly shouted.
Mina was worried that Connor would reveal the truth, so she quickly frowned and called out, “Connor, what nonsense are you talking about?”
Connor looked at Mina indifferently, then said in a very casual tone, “I live in a rented house, but I also have a villa in Royal Villas…”
“Hahaha!”
After Yves and the others heard Connor’s words, not only did they not stop mocking Connor, but they even laughed even more heartily. In their eyes, Connor’s words were clearly trying to justify his actions!
Yves was just trying to show off that he was rich. That was why he said he wanted to buy a villa in Royal Villas. However, he knew very well that the villa in Royal Villas was not something that ordinary people could afford. Even if his family was very rich, it was impossible for them to spend hundreds of millions to buy a house in that place.
The others laughed at Connor because he said that he lived in a rented house, yet he had a villa in Royal Villas. This was obviously impossible.
If Connor really had a villa, then why didn’t he live in the villa instead of renting a room with someone? This was obviously illogical!
“Connor, can you stop joking with us? If you have a villa, why don’t you stay in the villa? Yet you’re saying you’re renting a room with someone else?”
“Yeah, I’ve never seen a rich heir like you who doesn’t want to live in a good villa and instead rents a room with someone else?!”
“What do you know? Maybe Connor probably just likes to keep a low profile. Look at the clothes he’s wearing. You can’t tell that he’s a rich heir at all, but he says he’s rich. What can you do?” Ciara said with a sneer as she sized up Connor.
When Mina heard the crowd mocking Connor, her expression immediately turned ugly. She felt that even if Connor was indeed bragging just now, these people shouldn’t humiliate him like this, right?
“It’s getting late. Let’s go in and take a look!” Mina took a deep breath and shouted at the crowd with a cold expression.
Ciara and the others could feel that Mina was a little unhappy, so they stopped mocking Connor and walked towards the villa.
Connor sighed helplessly and walked in. Although Connor was pretending to be Mina’s boyfriend, what he’d said just now was the truth. Although he lived in the rented house, Connor also had his own villa outside, and it was not just the one.
However, these people did not believe Connor’s words, so he was not in the mood to explain to them.
A moment later, Mina brought everyone to the front door of the villa she rented and took out the key to open the door.
After entering the villa, Ciara and the others briefly scanned the interior of the villa.
Although the villa looked very ordinary from the outside, the interior decoration style of the villa was unique. At the very least, Ciara and the others were very satisfied.
Ciara sat on the sofa and whispered, “Mina, thank you!”
“It’s okay, as long as you’re satisfied!” Mina replied indifferently.
“The environment here is quite good. I’m going to decorate this place briefly later, and then 1’11 ask my friends to come over to my birthday party tomorrow!”
Ciara said with a smile.
The main reason why she asked Mina to rent a house in Porthampton was that some of Clara’s friends were studying here. In the past, Ciara had always celebrated her birthday in her hometown. However, this time, she wanted to show off in front of her friends.
“Ding, ding, ding…”
At this moment, Mina’s phone suddenly rang!
Mina glanced at the name on her phone and said softly, “The landlord called me. I’m going to answer the call!”
After saying this, Mina turned around and left.
“Ciara, how do you plan to decorate this villa?” Sasha walked to Clara’s side and asked her softly.
Ciara thought for a moment and said, “I haven’t thought about how to decorate it yet, but we still have to buy some things. We can come back and think about how to decorate it; after all, a birthday party has to look like a birthday party!”
After Yves heard Ciara’s words, he quickly said, “Sure, I’m more familiar with the situation in Porthampton, and my chauffeur is still waiting outside. Tell me what you want to buy, and I’ll take you there!”
“That’s great!”
Ciara naturally would not reject Yves. After thinking for a moment, she said softly, “1 think that although this villa’s interior is not bad, but the lighting facilities seem to be quite ordinary. Why don’t we go and get some colorful lights first?”
“Leave the lighting to me. 1’11 call my friends now and ask them to send some lanterns over!” Yves replied casually. Then, he took out his phone and was about to make a call. However, just as Yves took out his phone, he saw a message.
Yves quickly opened the message and realized that it was a photo. The person in the photo was Connor!
“Mr. Lynn, this kid is the poor loser from our school. I don’t know if you met this Connor!” Immediately after, a message was sent. When Yves saw the message, a sinister smile flashed across his face. He then turned around and walked towards Ciara.
Now that he had this photo, it could prove that Connor was not a rich heir at all, but was rather a complete liar.
“Ciara, I found the photo!”
Yves whispered to Ciara.
When Ciara heard Yves’s words, a hint of excitement flashed across her eyes!

chapters.title: Chapter 469 - 469: The Landlord’s Phone Call
chapters.content:
Chapter 469: The Landlord’s Phone Call
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
“Really?”
When Clara heard Yves’s words, a hint of excitement flashed across her eyes.
“Yes, the photo that my friend sent me is Connor. This means that Connor is not some rich heir at all—he’s just a poor loser from our school…”
Yves quickly nodded. Then, he took out his cell phone and handed it to Ciara.
Ciara reached out and took Yves’s phone. She looked at it seriously and confirmed that the person in the photo was Connor.
Although this photo was taken when Connor first joined the Zither Club, Connor was still a freshman at that time. However, one could still tell that the person in the photo was indeed Connor.
“I didn’t expect this Connor to be a fake rich heir!”
Ciara looked at the photo on her phone and could not help but sneer. Then, she continued, “Connor had the nerve to say that he had a villa in Royal Villas. That’s hilarious. Why would someone not live in a good villa and instead rent out a room with someone else?”
“Ciara, let’s go find Mina and expose Connor!”
Se??ch ?ew?o?e?o?g o? ?oo?l?
Yves said excitedly to Ciara.
“Right!”
Ciara felt that she already had evidence in her hands. She would definitely not let go of such a good opportunity. She immediately picked up her phone and walked towards Mina.
At this moment, Mina had just finished her phone call, but her expression was a little ugly. She didn’t know what the person on the phone had said to her.
“Mina, we have something to tell you!”
Ciara called out to Mina.
When Mina heard Clara’s words, she sighed helplessly and whispered, “Ciara, I also have something to tell you…”
“You have something to tell me too?”
When Ciara heard Mina’s words, she was stunned. However, when she saw that Mina’s expression seemed a little off, she quickly asked, “Mina, what do you want to tell me?”
“Ciara, the owner of the villa called me just now. He said that he won’t be renting this house to us for the time being because his parents will be coming back from overseas tomorrow.”
Mina said to Ciara with a helpless expression.
“What?”
When Ciara heard Mina’s words, she was stunned on the spot, and her expression was extremely ugly.
“Ciara, I’m so sorry…”
Mina said apologetically to Ciara.
Ciara stood rooted to the ground with a blank look on her face. For a moment, she did not know what to say. After all, she had already informed her friends in Porthampton to come to her birthday party tomorrow. If the landlord wanted to take back the villa now, then Ciara would have no place to hold her birthday party.
“Mina, are you joking with me?”
Ciara was not in the mood to tell Mina about Connor now. After all, if she could not hold a birthday party tomorrow, it would be a fatal blow to her.
“Ciara, I’m not joking. The landlord just called me and said that he’s not going to rent this house anymore…”
Mina was also embarrassed. After all, she knew how important this birthday party was to Ciara.
“Then can’t we give him more money now?”
Ciara bit her lips and whispered.
“I told the landlord just now. I said that I would give him double the price, but he refused…” Mina replied helplessly.
When Ciara heard Mina’s words, she was completely dumbfounded. Her eyes instantly turned red, and her expression was very aggrieved.
It was almost seven o’clock in the evening now. Even if they were to look for a new house, it would definitely be too late. However, now that the house was suddenly not going to be rented to them, it meant that they might not be able to hold Clara’s birthday party.
Ciara, who had been so smug just a moment ago, suddenly had an ugly expression on her face! She was a girl with a strong sense of vanity. In order to make her birthday party look more presentable, she had specially asked Mina to help her find a villa in the city. However, she had never expected things to turn out this way.
At this moment, Sasha ran to Clara’s side and asked with a puzzled expression, “Ciara, why are your eyes red?”
“It’s all my fault. Just now, the landlord called me and said that he’s not renting this villa to us!”
Mina looked at Sasha helplessly and explained softly.
“Not renting it to us?”
When Sasha heard this, she was stunned for a moment before she shouted, “Then what about Ciara’s birthday party? Ciara has already informed her friends in Porthampton. If they can’t hold this birthday party tomorrow, how is Ciara going to explain it to them?”
“That’s right. Ciara has been planning this birthday party for such a long time. We can’t just not have a birthday party just because this villa won’t be rented to us anymore, right?”
Mavis hurriedly shouted.
“Mina, can you communicate with this landlord again?” Dustin took a step forward and whispered to Mina.
“I’ve already begged the landlord several times just now. I said all kinds of good things, but he just refuses to rent the house to us, or his parents won’t have a place to live…” Mina replied helplessly.
After Connor heard the conversation between these people, he seemed to have guessed what had happened, but he still stood quietly in place and did not speak.
“It’s almost seven o’clock in the evening now. If we go out to look for a house, we definitely won’t be able to find one. Moreover, we might not be able to find a suitable one!”
Dustin whispered as he looked at Ciara, whose eyes were red.
When Sasha heard this, she was stunned for a moment. Then, she hurriedly looked at Yves’s position and shouted, “Mr. Lynn, didn’t you say that you have a villa? Why don’t you lend us your villa?”
Yves did not expect that this matter would involve him. He was stunned for a moment, then said with a troubled expression, “Well, my family stays in my villa. If I suddenly bring you back now, my parents will definitely not agree…” “Mr. Lynn, your family is so rich. You should have more than one villa, right?” Sasha quickly continued.
“Uh…”
Yves was a little speechless by Sasha’s words. He said helplessly, “I do have other villas, but none of them have been renovated, and they are all dilapidated. Even if you go over, you won’t be able to do anything!”
When everyone heard Yves’s words, they were all stunned on the spot. Actually, they could also tell that Yves just did not want to lend them the house..

chapters.title: Chapter 470 - 470: Stop Acting!
chapters.content:
Chapter 470: Stop Acting!
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
“Then what should we do now?” Sasha shouted.
But at this moment, Mavis suddenly shouted, “By the way, other than Mr. Lynn, doesn’t one of us have a villa?”
When everyone heard this, they turned their heads to look at Connor. Connor was also instinctively stunned.
Just now, Connor did say that he also had a villa, and this villa was in the most famous villa district in Porthampton, Royal Villas!
Of course, the most unbelievable thing was that Connor actually said that his villa was the mansion in the area. The mansion was the most luxurious villa in the whole of Porthampton, worth hundreds of millions. Ordinary people were not qualified to live in that villa.
When Connor said that, everyone thought that he was bragging and even laughed at him.
But now, the landlord wanted to take back Mina’s rented villa, and Yves obviously didn’t want to lend them his villa. They could only pin their hopes on Connor.
Although everyone knew that the words that Connor said before were probably just bragging, if that villa really belonged to him, wouldn’t the current problem be solved?
“Connor, is that villa yours or not?” Sasha shouted at Connor anxiously.
Se??ch ?ew?o?e?o?g o? ?oo?l?
“Yeah, Connor, if that villa is really yours, then you can lend it to us for a night. Ciara has been preparing for this birthday party for a few days, and we’ve come all the way here. If we go back just because we don’t have a suitable villa, it’s not worth it, right?”
Mavis also hurriedly shouted.
At this moment, the two girls had not seen the photo in Yves’s hand. They did not know if Connor was really a rich heir, so they begged Connor so earnestly.
However, after Connor heard Sasha and Mavis’s words, he ignored them.
Connor felt that Mina must have a reason for bringing these people to this villa instead of the one in Royal Villas.
But Connor didn’t know why Mina did this. He was worried that if he agreed, it would affect Mina. More importantly, Connor did not have any good feelings for girls like Ciara and Sasha. Why should he lend the villa to them?
Connor couldn’t wait for their birthday party to fail so that he could go home earlier.
“Connor, what are you doing there? Say something? Is that villa yours or not? If it’s not yours, you should have told us earlier. We’ll think of another way. If it’s yours, then lend us the villa!” Sasha shouted at Connor excitedly when she saw him standing there without saying a word.
Connor couldn’t help but hesitate when he heard Sasha’s words. He then looked up at Mina’s position, wanting to ask for her opinion.
After all, the key to the villa was in Mina’s hands, and these people were all her friends!
At this moment, Mina’s expression was very conflicted. She did not know if she should agree or not.
Mina still felt that this villa didn’t belong to Connor at all. She thought Connor was just working in the showroom and had stolen the key to the villa.
If she really brought Ciara and the others over, they would no longer suspect Connor’s identity. However, if the owner of the villa found out, they would probably be in deep trouble. This was also a problem that Mina had been struggling with.
“Mina, it’s already this time, stop acting with us!”
But at that moment, Ciara suddenly called out.
The others were still waiting for Connor’s reply, but Ciara already had an answer in her heart. Because she knew that Connor was not a rich heir at all, and that villa could not belong to Connor. Whether Connor agreed or not, it would not affect him at all.
Therefore, Ciara planned to expose Connor’s true colors in front of so many people. Since her birthday party was ruined, no one would have a good time!
“Acting?”
Mina looked at Ciara with a puzzled expression. She didn’t know what she meant by that, so she asked, “Ciara, what kind of show did 1 put on?”
“You know very well what kind of show you’re putting on!”
Ciara smiled disdainfully and walked up to Connor. She looked at Connor with disdain and said coldly, “Just now, Yves found a photo of Connor. He’s not some rich heir at all. He’s just a poor loser who delivers food!”
“Mina, 1 think you should also know Connor’s identity, so you’ve been covering for him, right? This Connor shouldn’t be your boyfriend, right? You brought him here to lie to us so that you can cover up the fact that you’re being kept by a rich man!”
Ciara was in a very bad mood at the moment, so she naturally did not leave any room for negotiation.
When Mina heard Clara’s words, she was stunned. Other than the fact that Mina was being kept by a rich man, Ciara was right about everything else. This was what shocked Mina the most, because she did not expect Ciara to really find out Connor’s true identity.
The others were also shocked. They stared at Ciara with wide eyes.
They knew very well that since Ciara had already said so, it meant that Ciara must have obtained very important evidence.
Connor, on the other hand, stood where he was calmly. After all, Connor knew very well whether he was a rich heir or not.
Even if Ciara had any evidence, it was impossible to change the fact that he was, in fact, a rich heir!
“Ciara, don’t be so agitated. After all, Connor is Mina’s boyfriend. Isn’t it a little inappropriate for you to say that?”
Dustin was still a loyal person. He felt that Ciara’s words were too overboard, so he could not help but stand up and speak softly.
“Not appropriate?”
Ciara sneered, then turned to look at Mina and shouted, “It’s not appropriate for me to say that? Then is it appropriate for Mina to lie to us? Everyone knew that she definitely has a sugar daddy, but she just didn’t want to admit it. Now, she actually got a poor loser to pretend to be her boyfriend. Isn’t what she did even more overboard?”
“Ciara, it’s not what you think!” Mina couldn’t help but stand up, wanting to explain herself.
“If it’s not what I think, then what is it like?”
Ciara smiled disdainfully.. Then, she took out Yves’s cell phone and shouted at the crowd, “You can take a good look at this photo to see if the person in it is Connor!”

chapters.title: Chapter 471 - 471: Let’s Go to My Villa and Take a Look
chapters.content:
Chapter 471: Let’s Go to My Villa and Take a Look
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
When Ciara took out Yves’ phone, everyone was stunned.
Mina was also stunned on the spot, and her expression became nervous.
At this moment, she thought about how to explain this later!
“Let me see what photo it is!” Sasha was naturally the one who wanted to see Connor make a fool of himself. After all, Connor had humiliated her in front of so many people at Immortal Lake Manor.
Therefore, Sasha quickly reached out and took the phone from Clara’s hand. Then, she carefully sized up Connor in the photo and Connor who was standing beside them.
“This must be Connor. Although Connor was more of a loser at that time, this must be him!” Ciara said firmly.
“Let me take a look too…”
Mavis also hurriedly reached out to take the phone and carefully observed it. Then, she said softly, “That’s right, this is Connor!”
Calvin and Dustin also looked at the photo on their phones and realized it was indeed Connor.
“Ciara, this is indeed Connor, but I don’t think you can doubt Connor’s identity just because of a photo, right?” Dustin did not want this to get ugly, so he whispered to Ciara.
“That’s right, Ciara. This photo is just an ordinary headshot. It doesn’t prove anything at all!” Calvin hurriedly added.
“Of course, the photo doesn’t prove anything, but any student of Porthampton University knows the person in the photo. This person is the famous poor loser of Porthampton University. He usually relies on delivering food to make a living. He can’t even afford his tuition fees and is often bullied by others. Since the person in the photo is Connor, and the two have the same name, this kid is the poor loser at our university!” At this moment, Yves suddenly stood up and pointed at Connor.
When everyone heard Yves’ words, they were all stunned. They were extremely shocked.
The photo just now could not prove anything, but if it matched what Yves said now, it could prove Connor’s true identity.
“I didn’t expect this Connor to be a poor loser!” Sasha covered her mouth and could not help but exclaim.
“Yeah, 1 was a little suspicious of his identity before. If Connor was really a rich heir, then he shouldn’t be so low-key. I didn’t expect this Connor to be a poor loser!” Mavis hurriedly added.
“Connor, you’re so disgusting. You pretended to be a rich heir. Why don’t you take a piss and look at yourself? You don’t look like a crown prince even if you wear a royal robe!”
“That’s right. You were even looking down on us just now. You’re so shameless. Mina, even if you want to find someone to pretend to be your boyfriend, you should find someone normal, right?”
After Mavis and Sasha knew Connor’s true identity, they naturally had nothing to fear. They mocked Connor in a very vicious tone.
Dustin and Calvin, who could still help Connor to speak up, did not dare to say anything at this time. After all, with so much evidence in front of them, they could not continue to speak up for Connor.
A smug look flashed in Clara’s eyes. After all, this was what she wanted to see. Since her birthday party would not happen anyway, no one would be able to have it easy!
“Mina, is there anything else you want to say?” Ciara walked up to Mina and asked her provocatively.
Mina stood where she was and took a deep breath. Then, she was prepared to admit that Connor was indeed an actor she had found and was not a rich heir at all!
Mina’s reason for admitting these things was very simple. She couldn’t bear to let these people continue to mock Connor because she felt that these people’s words were simply an insult to Connor’s character.
“Ciara, Sasha, Mavis, I…” Mina opened her mouth to speak.
Connor suddenly walked before Mina and said softly, “Mina, I just recalled I gave you the keys to the villa, right?”
Mina heard Connor’s words and couldn’t help but be stunned momentarily. Then, she looked up at Connor with a puzzled expression.
“Since your friends want to go to Royal Villas, let’s take them there!” Connor looked at Mina and continued.
“But…”
Mina bit her lip and didn’t dare to voice her assumption. If she did, these people would only laugh at Connor even more.
“There’s no buts. That villa was mine, to begin with, and I said before that 1 would lend this villa to you, but I don’t know why you suddenly changed your mind. Since this villa can’t be used anymore, let’s go to my villa and look!” Connor calmly said to Mina.
Mina’s eyes were dull as she stood there, not knowing what to say.
“Connor, why are you still putting up an act with us? You’re just a poor loser. How can you own a villa?” Ciara shouted at Connor.
“Won’t you know if 1 have a villa or not when you go over and take a look?” Connor replied to Ciara indifferently and then walked out of the villa.
When Mina saw that Connor was planning to leave, she quickly grabbed Connor, then whispered, “Connor, it’s getting late today, and your villa is quite far from here. Why don’t we go another day?”
“Why do we have to go another day? Aren’t they having a birthday party tomorrow?” Connor replied indifferently and then continued to walk out of the villa.
Everyone was already confused by Connor’s behavior and was very puzzled.
If Connor wasn’t the villa’s owner, why would he take the initiative to bring people over?
If they went over later and discovered that the villa was not Connor’s, wouldn’t he be asking for humiliation?
Mina became even more confused. She felt she had already given Connor a way out, so Connor had no reason to go over!
“What is Connor trying to do?”
Seeing Connor taking the initiative to bring them to the villa to take a look, they began to retreat because they couldn’t understand Connor’s current behavior..

chapters.title: Chapter 472 - 472: The Royal Villas
chapters.content:
Chapter 472: The Royal Villas
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
“Connor, why don’t we just forget about it? It’s a little late today, and Clara’s birthday party is only tomorrow night. We’ll go to the agency in the morning to take a look.” Dustin was timid, and he didn’t want to see Ciara and Mina make things too awkward, so he couldn’t help but persuade Connor again.
After Connor heard what Dustin said, he could not help but turn around and glance at Dustin.
Originally, in Connor’s eyes, Dustin and Calvin were both snobbish people who would curry favor with whoever had money. But now, Connor’s impression of these two people had changed.
However, Connor did not seem to want to change his mind. Instead, he continued to walk out of the villa.
After everyone saw Connor leave the villa, they were very puzzled. They couldn’t understand why Connor was doing this!
“What is this Connor thinking? Dustin has already made it obvious just now, but he still wants to bring us to the villa…” Sasha sighed in confusion.
“Yeah, could the villa really belong to Connor?” Mavis frowned and said.
“Ciara, what should we do now?” Sasha hesitated before asking Ciara softly.
“What else can we do? Since Connor wants to take a look, let’s go over and take a look. 1 want to see how Connor will explain when he can’t open the villa’s door later!” Ciara smiled disdainfully. At this moment, she was already certain that Connor was not some rich heir. Otherwise, Mina would not have been rendered speechless by her words just now.
“Mina, since Connor said so, let’s go and look!” Mavis turned her head and called out to Mina softly.
Mina took a deep breath. She knew that even if she didn’t go with them, she couldn’t change anything. So, she could only smile bitterly and leave the villa with the others.
“Some people really won’t shed tears until they see the coffin. I want to see if he lives in Royal Villas today. My driver is waiting outside.” At this moment, Yves also stood up and said disdainfully.
“Yes!” Ciara quickly agreed.
Everyone followed Yves out of the villa.
After leaving the villa, Yves asked his chauffeur to drive Connor and the others to Royal Villas.
Ciara and the others had never been to Royal Villas before. They had only heard of Royal Villas before. They were very excited to see the most luxurious villa complex in Porthampton with their own eyes.
As for whether Royal No. 1 was Connor’s house or not, they were not that concerned because they felt Connor could not afford such an expensive villa at all.
Mina sat in the car and looked at Connor anxiously. Then, she whispered, “Connor, Dustin gave you a way out just now. Why are you still bringing these people to Royal Villas? What if they find out that the villa isn’t yours?”
“It’s okay. We have the key to that villa. They won’t find out!” Connor replied to Mina calmly.
“But…” Mina wanted to say something but was afraid that her words would hurt Connor’s pride, so she swallowed the words on the tip of her tongue.
Mina was very clear that Connor had the key to the villa. Since Connor was so confident that he could bring them to see the house, it meant that the key that Connor gave Mina was real.
However, Mina felt Connor must have stolen the key from the showroom. If Ciara wanted to hold a birthday party in this villa, it would run for at least two days. How could she guarantee that no one would find out in these two days? How could he guarantee that the owner of this villa would not suddenly return? If the villa’s owner found them, they might be chased out or even thought that Connor and the others were thieves. They might even be sent to the police station. By then, things might become even more troublesome.
However, Mina could not bear to expose Connor in front of so many people, so she could only think about what excuse she should use to get Ciara and the others out when they entered the villa.
This was because they were only going in to take a look. If they did not stay for long, they should not be discovered. Even if they were discovered, they should not be treated as thieves.
Just as Mina was thinking about these questions, the BMW slowly stopped before a luxurious villa.
When the crowd saw the words ‘Royal Villas’, their eyes widened in shock.
“As expected of the number one villa district in Porthampton. Looking at this door, it’s not something other villa districts can compare to…” Sasha could not help but sigh softly after getting out of the car.
“That’s right. If I can live in such a villa area, I’ll die without regrets!” Mavis added.
“We definitely won’t have the chance to live in such a villa area, but we can use Connor’s key to go in and look!” Sasha said sarcastically, then turned to Connor and said, “Connor, don’t you think so?”
A hint of displeasure flashed across his face when Connor heard Sasha’s mocking.
Naturally, he could understand what Sasha meant by her words, so he ignored her and continued walking forward.
“I didn’t expect this Connor to be so cold. He ignored me…” Seeing Connor enter the villa ground, she smiled faintly and turned to Ciara. “Ciara, let’s go in too!” “Yes!” Ciara replied softly before she walked into the villa complex.
However, just as Connor was about to enter the villa area, the security guard from the security room suddenly rushed out and shouted at Connor, “Who are you? Why did you come in?”
After seeing the security guard rush out, Connor was stunned.
Previously, when Connor came here to look at the house, Chloe had always accompanied him. Connor had only come once late at night, so the security guard overlooked Connor.
However, it was different this time. It was exactly seven o’clock in the evening, the peak period for villa owners to return home.
Moreover, Connor and his group were too big a target, so it was inevitable that the security guards would be on guard!

chapters.title: Chapter 473 - 473: The Most Luxurious Villa
chapters.content:
Chapter 473 - 473: The Most Luxurious Villa
Translator: End less Fantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
After hearing the security guard’s question, Connor was stunned momentarily. Then, he looked up at the security guard and said expressionlessly, “I’m here to look at the villa!”
“Look at the villa? Are you an owner at Royal Villas?”
When the security guard heard Connor’s words, he was surprised. Then, he scanned Connor and seemed even more puzzled.
Those who could live in Royal Villas were big shots in Porthampton. They were the top in Porthampton. Ordinary people could not afford to buy a house here.
The security guard saw that Connor’s clothes were very ordinary. He did not look like a rich person at all, so it was normal for him to suspect Connor’s identity.
“Mr. McDonald the Tycoon, we can’t even enter the villa, right?” Sasha said disdainfully when she saw Connor being stopped by the security guard.
“Didn’t you just say you wanted to bring us in to see your villa? Now, you can’t even enter the villa. What’s wrong with you?” Mavis added.
Ciara and Yves revealed a disdainful smile because they had already expected this situation. Even if beaten to death, they would never believe Connor would own a house here.
“Connor, why don’t we go back!” Mina felt that something was wrong. After hesitating, she whispered to Connor.
“Go back?” Connor smiled faintly and said softly, “Since we’re already here, why must we go back?”
After saying this, Connor walked to the security guard and said expressionlessly, “You can check now if there’s a landlord named Connor McDonald in this neighborhood!”
When the security guard heard Connor’s words, he was shocked. The expression on his face became awkward.
He felt that if Connor weren’t the owner of this place, he definitely wouldn’t be so calm when he stopped him!
So the security guard hesitated, then narrowed his eyes and asked Connor softly, “Are you really an owner here?”
“I told you, if you don’t believe me, you can check it out now!” Connor replied again.
“You guys go in first. I’ll look for a landlord named Connor McDonald later. If I find out you’re lying to me later, I’ll chase you out!” The security guard was worried that if Connor was really the owner and he offended Connor because of this, he might lose his job.
That was why the security guards agreed to let Connor and the others enter first.
When Ciara, Yves, and the others saw that the security guards had let Connor in, they instantly became puzzled. This was because they felt that Connor should not have been able to enter under normal circumstances!
However, Connor did not bother with these people and directly walked into the community.
“I didn’t expect the security of Royal Villas to be so weak!” Yves could not help but sigh softly. Then, he followed Connor into the neighborhood.
After entering the neighborhood, everyone did not think much about Connor being stopped by the security guards. After all, they all felt that Connor’s entry into the neighborhood did not mean that he was an owner in the neighborhood, nor did it mean that he really owned a villa here.
As Yves had said, even the security of Royal Villas might not be very good.
“Isn’t this neighborhood beautiful?” Sasha took out her phone and began to take pictures of the scenery in the neighborhood.
The layout of Royal Villas was designed according to the medieval aristocratic garden, so after entering the community, it was as if they had traveled into an ancient Europe palace.
Sasha and the others had never been to Royal Villas before, so they were all shocked by the scene inside.
“Royal Villas is located on Spring Hills. As the highest hill in Porthampton, you can see the beautiful night view of Porthampton. Royal No. 1 is the most luxurious villa in Royal Villas. It not only has an open-air swimming pool, a mini golf course, a private football field, a rockery, a lake, sculptures, a basketball court, and other facilities but also has a private exhibition hall, which can be used to display the private collections of the villa owner!” Yves seemed to know a lot about Royal No. 1, so he started to talk to everyone.
When Connor heard what Yves said, he was a little surprised because he had never heard of what Yves said. Connor only knew that his villa was very expensive.
“I didn’t expect Royal No. 1 to be so cool!” Ciara could not help but sigh softly. Then, she continued, “I wonder who can live in such a villa!”
“There aren’t many people in Porthampton who can afford this villa. Thomas Morgan and Kyle Hayes are one of them, but neither bought this villa. They probably thought that the price of this villa was a little too high, so a mysterious rich man bought it. But 1 don’t know who that rich man is either…” Yves replied calmly.
“If you can sell such a house, you should be able to earn a lot of money, right?” Sasha blinked and said softly.
“Yes, this house was built by the CEO of Evergrande Real Estate, Hendrick Canfield. Canfield wanted to build a unique luxury villa community, but after the house was built, a problem embarrassed Canfield!” Yves explained.
“What’s the problem?” Ciara quickly asked.
“The problem is that the construction cost of Royal Villas is too high, so the price is naturally much higher than other villas. For a time, the villas here were unsalable. Hendrick had bet all his assets on Royal Villas. It took half a year to sell a few villas, and they were all small villas. As for Royal No. 1, the king villa of Royal Villas, no one cared about it at all. Not even many people came to ask for the price!” Yves said slowly.
When Connor heard this, he could not help but turn to look at Yves.
At this moment, he finally understood why Chloe Lawson was so excited when she sold this villa to him..

chapters.title: Chapter 474 - 474: Is That Villa Yours?
chapters.content:
Chapter 474 - 474: Is That Villa Yours?
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
“What happened after that? How was Royal No. 1 sold?” Clara seemed to be very interested in what Yves said and quickly asked.
“Later on, the mysterious rich man from Porthampton appeared. It was said that this rich man first bought two townhouses in Royal Villas and then gave them to one of the sales ladies. Not long after that, he bought Royal No. 1!” Yves seemed very familiar with Connor’s matters and spoke as if he knew everything.
“This saleslady is so lucky! If you can give me these two villas, I’ll wake up laughing even in my dreams!” Ciara covered her mouth and could not help but exclaim.
“That’s right, this saleslady has such great luck…” Sasha hurriedly piqued.
When Yves heard Sasha and Clara’s conversation, he smiled disdainfully and said indifferently, “You two don’t understand. Not only is that saleslady lucky, but she also has a good figure and looks…”
“Huh?” When the girls heard Yves’s words, they were stunned.
“The saleslady is called Chloe Lawson. When I went to the showroom to look at the villas, she received me once. She was indeed very beautiful and sexy. The people in the sales department said that Chloe was the mistress of that rich man. That’s why he gave the villa to Chloe. Moreover, Chloe became the vice president of Evergrande Real Estate because she sold Royal No. 1!” Yves said with a smile.
“It’s easy when you’re good-looking. No matter what you do, you have the help of a nouveau riche…”
Ciara subconsciously glanced at Mina, who was not far away. Her eyes were filled with jealousy. She was very jealous of people like Chloe and Mina. After all, such women did not have to do anything. They could get everything they wanted just by their looks.
Mina knew very well what Ciara meant but was not in the mood to pay attention to Ciara.
“And? What happened to Chloe?” Sasha asked Yves.
“Hehe, two days ago, 1 heard that the tycoon bought Evergrande Real Estate and made Chloe the general manager of Evergrande Real Estate!” Yves replied with a smile and continued, “I have to say, this tycoon is indeed wealthy. He bought such a big real estate company just like that. Chloe’s really lucky. In less than two months, she went from a showroom to the CEO of Evergrande Real Estate!”
After Ciara, Sasha, and the other girls heard Yves’s story, they became even more envious.
This story was so dramatic!
“When can 1 meet such a rich tycoon?” Ciara sighed softly.
“Of course, it’s good to meet a tycoon, but I’m afraid of meeting a poor loser who impersonates a tycoon!” Sasha smiled.
“That’s right.” Ciara quickly nodded and smiled. “Even if 1 can’t meet a rich man, 1 don’t want to be tricked by a poor loser. If I get tricked by him, I’ll be in trouble…”
“Ciara, what do you mean by that?” Hearing Clara’s words, Mina finally couldn’t hold it in anymore. She frowned and shouted.
“Mina, don’t overthink. I wasn’t talking about you, 1 was just lamenting!” Ciara quickly replied. Then, she turned to Connor and asked, “Connor, where is your villa? Why aren’t we there yet!”
“That’s the one up in front!” Connor pointed at the most luxurious villa before him and replied very indifferently.
Everyone was stunned.
“Connor, are you joking with us? Are you saying this villa is your house?” Ciara’s fox-like eyes widened as she exclaimed in surprise.
“Do you think I’m in the mood to joke with you?” Connor said calmly.
“Hehe, Connor, what the f*ck are you pretending for? Do you know what that villa is?” Yves asked Connor with a sneer.
“What is it?” Connor turned and looked at Yves indifferently as he asked very calmly.
“You don’t even know what that villa is, and you dare to claim the villa is yours. You’re such a joker…” Yves said expressionlessly. Then, he pointed at the villa and said loudly, “For your information, that villa is Royal No. 1. A mysterious rich man in Porthampton has bought it. How dare you say that this villa is yours?”
Yves felt Connor couldn’t even afford the cheapest villa here, let alone Royal No. 1.
“The mysterious rich man you mentioned just now is me. I bought this villa. Also, Chloe is not my mistress. Chloe and 1 are just friends!” Connor said to Yves expressionlessly.
“Would… Would it kill you not to brag? If 1 didn’t mention that just now, you might not even know who Chloe Lawson is!” Yves’s eyes widened as he shouted at Connor agitatedly.
Connor smiled coldly at Yves and did not explain anything.
He felt that he didn’t need to explain this at all. As long as he opened the door of Royal No. 1, everything would be solved.
Everyone looked at Connor in a daze. They felt that all of this was really unbelievable.
“Is there something wrong with Connor’s brain? He claims that Royal No. 1 was his?”
“Yeah, I think Connor must be crazy. Why else would he dare to say that Royal No. 1 is his?”
“Hehe, in my opinion, Connor is a madman!” Sasha, Mavis, and the others couldn’t help but discuss softly.
Mina was worried because she knew from what Yves said that the owner of this villa seemed to be very influential.
She was now a little worried that if she really brought Ciara and the others into the villa, they would be in deep trouble if the villa’s owner found out. After all, such a rich man was not someone ordinary people like them could afford to provoke!
“What is this Connor trying to do? 1 gave him a way out just now. Why did he have to bring Yves and the others over? What if something happened?” Mina muttered in despair..

chapters.title: Chapter 475 - 475:I Have The Key
chapters.content:
Chapter 475:I Have The Key
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
After Mina heard what Yves had said, she started to feel a little scared.
After all, the person who could buy Royal No. 1 must be very powerful.
If Connor brought them into the villa and the owner found out, the consequences would be unimaginable.
So after thinking for a while, Mina felt she shouldn’t just stand by and watch this happen. She had to do something!
However, at this moment, they had already reached the gate of Royal No. 1.
Just by looking at the main door of the villa, everyone could feel that Royal No.
1 was very different from other villas. It was much more luxurious than ordinary villas.
Ciara turned and glanced at Connor. Then, with a contemptuous expression, she said, “Connor, didn’t you say that this villa is yours? So open the gate and let us in!”
“Yeah, I want to see if you have the key to this villa!” Sasha hurriedly shouted as well. Her eyes were filled with disdain for Connor.
Connor turned to look at Mina, and then lightly said, “Did you bring the key?”
“I…” Mina opened her mouth to speak.
“If you’ve brought them, open the gate and let them in to look…”
Connor knew that Mina had the key with her, so he didn’t wait for Mina to finish her sentence before speaking.
Mina looked at Connor and hesitated before saying softly, “Connor, why don’t we go back?”
“That’s right, Connor. Stop acting here. If you admit this villa isn’t yours now, we won’t laugh at you!” Mavis said with a smile.
At this moment, everyone felt this villa couldn’t belong to Connor.
If they didn’t know the value of this villa, they might have thought otherwise.
But now, they all knew that this villa was the most luxurious in Porthampton. Not to mention that Connor was just a poor loser who delivered food; even if Connor was a rich heir, he would not be able to afford this villa.
“Since they’re already here, open the door and let them in!”
Connor saw Mina standing there without saying anything and said to her indifferently.
“But…” Mina hesitated, then whispered, “Connor, 1 didn’t bring the key. Let’s go back!”
At this moment, no matter what, Mina could not let Connor bring these people into the villa.
If they went in, the nature of the matter would change. But if they didn’t go in, at most, Connor’s impersonation of a rich heir would be exposed. There wouldn’t be any other consequences.
“You didn’t bring the key?” When Connor heard Mina’s words, he couldn’t help but be stunned. He raised his eyebrows and said softly, “It’s okay if you didn’t bring the key. 1 did…”
After saying this, Connor took a spare key from his pocket and walked toward the villa’s door.
Mina was stunned when Mina saw Connor take out another key. Her face was filled with shock.
She did not expect Connor to have a spare key with him!
What was even more difficult for Mina to understand was why Connor insisted on bringing Ciara and the others into the villa. Wasn’t Connor worried about being discovered?
There were three keys to this villa. Two were in Connor’s hands, and the other was with Chloe. It was convenient for Chloe to call someone to help Connor clean up!
Connor had lent his key to Mina, so he still had a key in his hand.
When Ciara and the others saw that Connor had taken out the key, they were all stunned. They seemed extremely shocked.
“Is Connor really the owner of Royal No. 1?” Sasha could not help but mutter softly. It was obvious that she was starting to waver.
“What nonsense are you talking about?” When Ciara heard Sasha’s words, she could not help but scold her coldly. Then, she continued, “Look at Connor. He’s so poor. Do you think he can afford Royal No. 1?”
“So why does he have the key to the villa?” Sasha replied helplessly.
“Do you believe him just because he said so? He hasn’t opened the gate of the villa yet. How do you know if he took out a random key to fool us?” Ciara scolded coldly.
“Makes sense…” Sasha nodded thoughtfully and did not say anything.
Connor took the key and walked to the gate of the villa. Then, under everyone’s gaze, he directly opened the gate.
When the door opened, everyone was stunned. Their mouths were wide open, and their faces were filled with shock.
They had never expected Connor to have the key to this villa!
Everyone was shocked.
No one expected Connor to open the gate of Royal No. 1.
“How… How is that possible?” Yves exclaimed, his eyes widened.
“Is… Is Connor really the owner of this villa?” Ciara hurriedly said.
Mina’s eyes flashed with despair because she knew very well that from the moment the door of the villa opened, this was already out of her control.
Everything would be over if anyone found out that they had sneaked in.
Mina really couldn’t understand why Connor would do this!
“What are you guys still standing there for? Didn’t you want to come in and take a look? You can come in now…” Connor walked into the villa but found that Yves, Ciara, and the others were standing rooted to their spots as if they had no intention of coming in at all.
“Conn… Connor, is this villa really yours?” Ciara hesitated, then couldn’t help but gasp. She asked Connor anxiously.
“What do you think?” Connor replied to Ciara playfully before walking straight into the villa.
Ciara turned to look at Yves and asked with a puzzled expression, “Yves, is your information accurate? Didn’t you say that Connor was a poor loser who delivered food? How could a delivery man afford such a luxurious villa?”
When Yves heard Clara’s words, he was trembling.
He was starting to doubt whether his friend was telling the truth!

chapters.title: Chapter 476 - 476: Confess to Mina
chapters.content:
Chapter 476: Confess to Mina
Translator: End less Fantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
After seeing Connor open the door of the villa, everyone present went silent.
They felt like they were dreaming.
The people who had previously suspected Connor’s identity no longer dared to suspect Connor the moment the villa’s door opened.
To be able to buy such a villa that was worth hundreds of millions, what else could he be but a tycoon?
“Is the mysterious tycoon in Porthampton Connor?”
Yves muttered with a puzzled expression.
“Yves, is your friend reliable? If Connor is really a rich heir, then we have greatly offended him today!”
Ciara shouted at Yves as if she was a little afraid.
“I… 1 don’t know either…”
Yves gritted his teeth and replied helplessly.
“Alright, don’t just stand there. Go in and take a look!”
Since Connor had already opened the door to the villa and had already developed to this point, even if Mina left, it wouldn’t change anything.
Therefore, she wanted Ciara and the others to go in and take a look so that they could leave this place as soon as possible.
When Ciara and the others heard Mina’s words, they could not help but hesitate for a moment. Then, they walked into the villa one after another.
After entering the villa, everyone present, including Mina, was shocked by the interior decoration of the villa.
This was because they had never seen such a luxurious villa in their lives. The floor was paved with black marble, the tiles were as bright as mirrors, and the gorgeous crystal chandelier emitted a dazzling light. The magnificent design and the golden decorations made the owner of this villa look even more brilliant.
Moreover, Yves knew that the antique paintings hanging on the walls of this villa were all priceless. Any one of them would cost tens of millions!
Just imagine, how rich must a tycoon be to be able to live in such a villa?
They really couldn’t relate the shabbily dressed Connor to such a luxurious villa.
In an instant, everyone was stunned. No one dared to move casually.
They were all worried that if they broke the things in the villa, they wouldn’t be able to afford it even if they sold themselves.
However, Connor looked relaxed. He sat on the sofa and said calmly, “This villa has four floors. Haven’t you always wanted to come in and take a look? Now you can look around freely!”
When everyone heard Connor’s words, they still did not have any reaction. They stood at the door with their mouths agape and did not dare to move.
“Co… Connor, this villa… Is it really yours?”
Ciara hesitated for a couple of seconds before she stuttered and asked Connor.
“You’ve asked me this question before. Now that I’ve already opened the door for you, don’t you believe that this villa is mine?”
Connor said lightly.
Everyone looked at Connor with extremely shocked expressions on their faces. They were so shocked that they were even somewhat speechless.
They felt that the things that happened today were too unbelievable.
“How is that possible?”
“This is the most luxurious villa in Porthampton. The price is at least 300 million dollars. Those who can live in this villa must be worth at least 1 billion dollars. You’re just an ordinary person, so how could you afford to buy this villa?”
Yves felt as if there were 10,000 wild horses galloping past his head. He really could not believe that Connor was actually the owner of the villa!
Sasha Stein, Mavis Cage, Dustin Ward, Calvin Young, and the others all widened their eyes and mouths in shock!
Dustin’s family was in the real estate business, so he knew very well how much this villa was worth.
Connor, who was dressed so ordinarily, could actually live in such a shocking villa. They simply could not believe it!
“Since things have already reached this point, we can only let nature take its course!”
Mina was also very shocked, but she could still maintain a trace of calmness because only she knew that Connor was not the owner of this villa.
Connor was only able to come in because he got the key from the showroom.
After saying this, Mina directly walked into the villa.
Ciara and the others hesitated for a moment before following Mina into the villa.

Mina hesitated for a moment before looking at Connor who was sitting on the sofa and said softly, “Connor, can you come out with me for a while? 1 have something to tell you…”

At the entrance of the villa.

H H

You’re from the showroom, so you should know very well how rich and powerful a person must be to be able to buy such a villa. Now that you’ve let my friends into this villa, if someone finds out, we’ll definitely be arrested as thieves, do you understand?”

When Mina was done, she opened the door of the villa and returned to the villa.

chapters.title: Chapter 479 - 479: Hand Connor Over
chapters.content:
Chapter 479: Hand Connor Over
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation

chapters.title: Chapter 480 - 480: What Right Do They Have to Arrest Me?

“Connor, why are you still sitting there? Hurry tip and say something!”

I want to report that someone sneaked into Royal No. 1 in the Royal Villas. Come and take this person away now!”

“I’m not bragging. Since you don’t believe that this villa is mine, won’t you know when the security guards come?”

“Haha…”
Yves looked at Connor and smiled disdainfully. Then, he widened his eyes and said, “Connor, you really don’t know how bad the situation is right now! Things have already reached this point, yet you still dare to say that this villa is yours. You’re really shameless…”

“He is being stubborn now. When the security guards come later, I’ll see how he can still be arrogant with us!”

“When the security guards arrive, Connor will probably be so scared that he will kneel on the ground and beg for mercy…” Sasha said disdainfully.
“Hehe, just you wait!”
Yves smiled lightly and looked at Connor provocatively..

“Is Connor too stunned to move?”

“That must be it. Let’s see what he does now!”

Soon, several security guards arrived in front of Connor. The leading security guard pointed at him and shouted, “So it’s you who stole the villa keys and brought people into the villa?”

“This villa belongs to you?”

Yves, Mina, Ciara and the others were even more puzzled. They could not understand what was going on. They were baffled that the security guard of the showroom knew Connor.
Moreover, Frank had actually called him Mr. Connor just now. Everyone could feel that this he seemed to respect Connor very much.
“Frank, you know this person?”
The security leader asked him with a puzzled expression.
“Captain, this is Mr. Connor. He’s the one who bought Royal No. 1 at our showroom,” Frank quickly replied.
