He quickly reached out to stop the captain of the security team, with a puzzled expression on his face, and shouted, “What is going on here? How could Connor possibly be the owner of this villa? You must have made a mistake…”
Upon hearing his words, the expression on the captain of the security team’s face instantly turned ugly.
After all, if it wasn’t for Yves’ phone call, they wouldn’t have come to this place in the middle of the night and indirectly offended their company’s boss.
“You didn’t hear what Frank just said? He personally saw Mr. Connor buy this villa! Do you think Frank is blind? Can he mistake such a prominent figure?!”
The captain of the security team scolded with a darkened face.
“How is that possible? Connor is clearly a poor loser. How could he afford to buy this villa?”
Yves stood in place, completely confused, looking at the captain of the security team, unsure of what to say.
“Connor is a poor loser?”
The security guard, who had recognized Connor earlier, smirked disdainfully, then casually said, “If he is a poor loser, then there are no wealthy people in this world!”
“Enough, I think this person is just jealous of Mr. Connor, so he deliberately caused trouble here. Let’s go!”
The captain of the security team said with some displeasure, then led his men to walk outside the villa.
A moment later, all the security guards from the showroom had left the villa.
Now, inside the villa, there were only Connor, Yves, and Mina along with her friends.
Everyone looked at Connor with a strange gaze, their expressions filled with shock. Because no one had expected that the outcome would turn out like this. No one had expected that he would actually be the owner of this villa!
Mina had always thought that Connor was able to get the keys to this villa because he worked at the showroom.
But if that were the case, then these security guards should have immediately recognized his identity. After all, these security guards also worked at the sales office, and if he really worked there, they would surely know him.
But the security guards just said that Connor was the owner of this villa, and they personally saw him buy it.
Mina could tell that the security guard called Frank respected Connor. This indicated that Connor was likely the owner of this villa!
For a moment, Mina felt that her mind couldn’t keep up. She dumbfoundedly looked at Connor, her gaze dull.
“Connor, is this… is this villa really… really yours?”
Ciara stammered as she asked him.
“Now that things have come to this point, whether this villa is mine or not, it’s none of your concern, right? I don’t want to explain anything to you anymore. Whether you believe it or not, it doesn’t matter to me. Of course, if you still think I stole the keys, you can continue to call and report me!”
Connor replied indifferently to her.
“How is that possible?”
Yves widened his eyes and shouted, pointing at Connor, “You’re just a poor loser. How could you afford the most luxurious villa in our city, and even buy three of them at once? Who are you, really?”
After Connor heard his words, he turned his head and looked at Yves indifferently. Then, he said in a disdainful tone,” What does it have to do with you who 1 am?”
“You…”
Yves was left speechless by his question. At this moment, he didn’t know how to describe his feelings.
“Connor, since this villa is yours, that’s great. Just now, we accidentally misunderstood you, but now the misunderstanding has been resolved…”
Ciara suddenly called out.
“That’s right. We misunderstood you before. 1 didn’t expect you to be a rich heir. Now that the misunderstanding has been resolved, we won’t doubt your identity anymore,” Mavis also hurriedly added.
“Connor, I’m really sorry about what happened earlier. It’s all because of this Yves. He insisted on calling you a poor loser who delivers takeout, so we misunderstood you. Now 1 apologize to you and hope you can forgive us…”
Ciara walked up to him and had a complete change of attitude, apologizing to him in a coquettish manner.
Meanwhile, Yves stared at Ciara in disbelief, his expression filled with anger.
He never expected that she would change her attitude so quickly!
If it weren’t for her asking him to investigate Connor’s identity, he wouldn’t have offended Connor. And if it weren’t for her, things wouldn’t escalated to this point?
Yves gritted his teeth and looked at Ciara, his expression filled with anger. At this moment, he finally realized what kind of person she truly was!
Ciara had been using him all along, and now that she knew Connor was indeed a rich heir, she instantly changed her demeanor. It was at this moment that Yves realized he had been played by her.
“Ciara, what’s the meaning of this? Weren’t you the one who had doubts about Connor’s identity all along?”
Yves stepped forward, staring at her with wide eyes, his expression filled with agitation.
“Yes, I did have doubts about Connor before. After all, his appearance and dressing were very ordinary. But did 1 ask you to call the security guards and report him? 1 think what you did just now was too much!”
Ciara turned her head and glanced at him, replying in a flat tone.
Upon hearing these words, he stood frozen in place.
“Yes, Yves, what you did just now was really excessive. We’re all friends here, so why did you call the security guards?!” Sasha also quickly joined in and shouted.
“Fortunately, this villa really belongs to Connor. If it weren’t his, what would have happened to him if he had been taken away?!”
Mavis also shouted at Yves
Clearly, at this moment, Ciara, Mavis and the others had all sided with Connor, leaving Yves alone. He felt like a fool being toyed with by these three women..

chapters.title: Chapter 483 - 483: Get Out!
chapters.content:
Chapter 483: Get Out!
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Yves stood silently in place for a moment, then gritted his teeth and said fiercely, “Fine. Now that you know Connor is a rich heir, you gang up to bully me, right? Just you wait!”
After saying these words, he turned around and walked towards the outside of the villa.
Ciara and the others had no intention of stopping him at all because in their eyes, he no longer had any value to exploit.
After he left, Ciara turned her head and glanced at Connor, then coquettishly said to him, “Connor, now that the misunderstanding is cleared up and Yves has left, can you lend me this villa for my birthday party?”
In fact, the reason why her attitude towards Connor had changed so drastically was mainly to please him and convince him to lend her the villa.
She thought that since this villa really belonged to him, she had nothing to worry about. If she could hold her birthday party in such a luxurious villa, she would definitely gain a lot pride!
That was why she intentionally angered Yves earlier, with the purpose of pleasing Connor and telling him that she wasn’t the mastermind, but Yves was!
Upon hearing her words, Mina couldn’t help but raise her head and look at her with an expression of disbelief. She was at lost for words.
She couldn’t understand where Ciara found the courage to say such things. She was actually planning to ask Connor to lend her the villa for a birthday party? Wasn’t it her who kept calling him a liar and a loser?
“Oh, Connor, now that the misunderstanding is cleared up, can’t Ciara hold her birthday party in your villa?” Sasha also looked at Connor and said.
After hearing the words of these two girls, he slowly raised his head, glanced at them expressionlessly, and said, “You want to borrow my villa for a birthday party?”
“Yes. You are Mina’s boyfriend, and we are all Mina’s good friends. You wouldn’t refuse our request, right?” Ciara hurriedly answered.
He stared at her with a faint smile, then said softly, “When I lent the keys to this villa to Mina, I actually intended to lend it to all of you…”
Upon hearing his words, Clara’s eyes flashed with excitement.
“But I never expected that you would turn out to be this kind of person. Do you think you still deserve to hold a birthday party in my villa now?”
But at this moment, Connor’s tone suddenly turned cold as he questioned them.
Ciara, Sasha and Mavis were all stunned in place after hearing his words, their expressions filled with confusion.
“What do you mean, Connor? What are you trying to say?” Ciara hesitated for a moment and asked him with doubt.
“What do 1 mean? Don’t you understand?” he sneered and then stood up, pointing towards the villa’s entrance. “All of you get out of here. My villa doesn’t welcome people like you, understood?”
“Get… get out?”
Ciara stared blankly at Connor in front of her, a trace of embarrassment flashing across her pretty face. She stammered, “Connor, can you stop joking? We… we have already apologized to you before, and we are all friends of Mina. How can you ask us to leave?”
Connor had made his intentions clear, yet she still had no intention of leaving.
“I’m not in the mood to waste time with you. I’ll give you one minute. If you haven’t left my villa after one minute, I will call the security guards to come and kick you out. Got it?”
He shouted coldly at her and the others.
Seeing that he was about to call the security guards, she was instantly stunned. With a somewhat embarrassed expression, she said, “Connor, we are all friends. Do you really need to handle things so harshly?”
“Forty seconds left,” he replied indifferently to her.
At this moment, she hesitated for a moment, then turned her head to look at Mina and begged in a humble manner, “Mina, please say something for us?” “What should I say for you? When Yves was mocking Connor just now, why didn’t you say something for him? If it weren’t for you looking down on him and thinking he’s a fraud, how could things have turned out like this?”
Mina glanced coldly at Ciara and spoke in a very indifferent tone.
“Mina, you…”
She never expected that even Mina wouldn’t speak up for her at this moment.
“Fifteen seconds left!”
Connor said while taking out his phone.
“Fine! So what if you’re rich? It’s nothing special!” she shouted with widened eyes, her expression filled with anger.
Then, she turned and said to Sasha and Mavis, “Let’s go!”
After saying these words, she directly turned around and ran towards the entrance of the villa, looking extremely disheveled.
Sasha and Mavis didn’t actually want to leave at this moment. After all, being able to stay overnight in such a villa was something they had always dreamed of. However, whenever they thought of the things they said to Connor earlier, they felt that he would definitely not let them stay. So they followed Ciara and left the villa together.
Calvin and Dustin didn’t offend Connor. On the contrary, the two of them even spoke up for him a few times. But since Ciara and the others had already left, they had no reason to stay here, so they also left together.
“What’s so great about being rich?” Ciara cursed angrily after leaving the villa.
“He is not as simple as being rich. He could afford Royal Villas indicates that his background must be extremely powerful. It’s already very good that he didn’t retaliate against you for mocking him earlier!” Calvin helplessly said to her.
Ciara was stunned for a moment and didn’t say much.
She had lost what she had initially expected to gain, but also incurred setbacks in the process during her trip to Porthampton.
Even if she had offended Connor, she could still rely on Yves to help hold the birthday party. But she had drove him away, and Connor didn’t even bother with them.
She was truly at her wit’s end!

chapters.title: Chapter 484 - 484: You’re Actually CeeM?
chapters.content:
Chapter 484: You’re Actually CeeM?
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
“Ciara, what are we going to do about your birthday party?”
Sasha hesitated for a moment before asking Ciara
Upon hearing her words, Ciara didn’t know what to say in her anger.
After a long while, she frowned and shouted, “What else can we do? Of course, we won’t have it anymore. Or do you want to find a mansion for me?”
“I…”
Sasha’s eyes flashed with helplessness, not knowing what to say.
“Call a cab for me now. I want to go home!” Ciara shouted at Dustin with an annoyed expression.
After Ciara, Sasha, and the others left the villa, only Connor and Mina were left inside.
Mina stood still with a stunned expression, looking at Connor sitting on the sofa, her face filled with shock.
Even at this moment, she couldn’t believe that he was the owner of this villa.
And he didn’t rush to explain these things to her either. He knew very well that Mina needed some time to digest all of this.
After a long silence, she took a deep breath and walked up to him, asking in a soft voice, “Connor, what just happened? Why did the security guards say that this villa is yours? Do you know them? Did you hire those security guards to put up an act? ”
“I hire them to act?”
Connor glanced at Mina with a faint smile and said softly, “Those security guards were not hired by me, and they weren’t acting for me. This villa was originally purchased by me. I just didn’t want to let you know about my identity, so I didn’t tell you the truth. But now that things have come to this, 1 have nothing more to hide!”
“This villa really belongs to you?”
Mina exclaimed when she heard his words, then quickly shook her head, finding it hard to believe, and said, “This is impossible. You must be lying to me. This villa is not yours!”
“Why would I lie to you?” Connor replied expressionlessly.
“I don’t know why you would lie to me, but I know for sure that this villa can’t possibly be yours!”
She couldn’t accept the truth at all as she shouted at him.
He glanced at her indifferently and didn’t say much because he didn’t want to explain anything further to her.
Seeing that Connor stopped talking, Mina’s expression seemed even more agitated. She exclaimed, “You’re just an ordinary student. You can’t possibly afford such an expensive villa. If you’re really that rich, then why do you still work as a delivery driver? Why do you live in a rented house? This villa definitely isn’t yours. Tell me the truth!”
“What else do you want me to say? I’ve already told the truth. This villa is mine, and I am the owner!” he replied directly.
“Fine! If that’s the case, then why do you still live in a rented house?”
“I live in a rented house because I’m used to it. Although this villa is luxurious, it doesn’t suit me in my opinion, so I didn’t live here!” he answered calmly.
“Haha…”
Mina couldn’t help but smirk after hearing Connor’s words. She whispered, “do you think I’ll believe what you’re saying? It’s just the two of us now, can’t you be honest with me? Regardless, I won’t mock you!”
“I’ve been telling the truth. 1 understand that you might not believe me right away, but I’ll show you something that will prove I’m not lying to you!”
As he spoke, he took out his phone and directly opened the app Mina usually livestreamed on, Twitch.
When she saw this, a hint of surprise flashed through her eyes. She didn’t know what he was up to.
“This is my account on Twitch. Once you see this account, you should understand that I’m not deceiving you!”
After saying this, he handed his phone directly to her.
She took a deep breath and accepted his phone.
When Mina saw that Connor’s account name was ‘CeeM’, she was dumbfounded. The expression on her face was incredibly incredulous.
She stood still, her gaze blank, and stuttered, “This… How is this possible? You’re actually CeeM?”
“That’s right, I am CeeM from Twitch!” He nodded calmly.
Things had progressed to this point, and he felt that he didn’t need to continue hiding. It was better to explain everything to Mina clearly to avoid any further misunderstandings.
“Impossible, this… This can’t be true. How could you be CeeM? You must be lying to me!”
Mina shouted with her watery eyes wide open because she couldn’t accept the reality in front of her.
“If you still don’t believe, 1 can show you the transaction records. Transaction records don’t lie!”
He sat on the sofa, maintaining a calm expression as he spoke to Mina.
Upon hearing his words, she was momentarily stunned, and then she directly opened the transaction records, which accurately recorded all the gifts Connor had given her during her streams.
At first, she thought that he had merely changed his account name and profile picture to deceive her. But if it were just a fake account, these transaction records couldn’t be fabricated!
However, even so, Mina still couldn’t believe that Connor was truly CeeM.
After all, she had been deceived once before when Hector had stolen CeeM’s account to deceive her!
She sneered at him, then threw the phone at him, and said in a low voice, “You stole this account too, didn’t you? Just like Hector, both of you are thieves!”
Connor glanced at Mina helplessly when he heard her words.
He never expected that he would reach a point where she still wouldn’t believe that he was CeeM, even after he had explained so much!
“Since you don’t believe this account is mine, then 1 can prove it to you now!”
He thought it was understandable that Mina didn’t believe him at this point.
After all, one was a rich streamer on Twitch, while one was a poor delivery driver.
It was difficult for anyone to connect the two, but Connor had already made up his mind. He had to explain everything to Mina today..

chapters.title: Chapter 485 - 485: Telling the Truth to Mina
chapters.content:
Chapter 485: Telling the Truth to Mina
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
“Proof? How can you prove it to me?”
Mina stood in place, worked up, as she shouted at Connor.
He was different from Hector. Although Hector stole his account initially, Hector was essentially a poor loser. A serious investigation would reveal that he was not CeeM!
But Connor was different. He was the rightful owner of this account.
Moreover, he was also a rich heir, so it was very simple for him to prove his identity.
“Connor, aren’t you going to say anything? How do you plan to prove to me that you are CeeM? If you can’t prove it today, 1 will immediately call the police and report that you stole someone’s account!”
Mina took out her phone, her expression unusually agitated as she yelled at him.
“It’s actually very simple to prove this matter!”
He replied calmly to Mina and then, in front of her, opened the top-up interface for Twitch.
She stared at him, unsure of what he was planning to do.
After opening the top-up interface, he directly entered a top-up amount of one million dollars. In Twitch, buying a Twitch gift card was required before sending gifts.
To prove his identity, he just needed to top up his account in front of her, and he did it with an amount of one million dollars.
As long as he could successfully top up, it would mean that he was definitely the owner of this account.
Firstly, if Connor could really top up one million dollars, it would prove that he was not as poor as Mina thought.
Secondly, being able to top up one million dollars into the account would prove that he definitely did not steal the account. After all, if this account was stolen, he wouldn’t be able to top up one million in it!
“What are you doing?” she asked with some confusion.
“Don’t you want me to prove it? Then I’ll prove it to you now!”
He replied casually and then directly clicked the confirmation button on his phone and entered his password.
“Ding Dong!”
“Congratulations! Top-up successful, receiving one million Twitch gift card!”
Soon, a notification sound came from Connor’s phone.
After hearing this notification sound, Mina instantly froze in place, her face filled with shock.
Because she was a live streamer on Twitch, she knew very well that if Connor had topped up one million into his account, it meant that he had just spent one million dollars.
“How is this possible? Connor, you must be tricking me! What are you trying to do!”
Mina shouted frantically at him with a crazed expression.
“At this point, do you still think I’m trying to deceive you?” he sneered and asked her.
“Don’t think I don’t know about your tricks!”
Mina shouted loudly and then stepped forward, snatching the phone from Connor’s hand.
When she saw that there really was an additional one million Twitch gift card in his account, she was once again stunned, and she nervously said, “This… this can’t be possible. You must be tricking me. It’s all fake…”
“Is the one million I topped up also fake? I would be stupid to spend a million dollars just to lie to you and act as a rich heir.” He smiled.
When she heard his words, a strange look flashed in her eyes.
With trembling hands, she found a live streaming room on Twitch. Then she randomly sent a few small gifts to the streamer.
“Wow, thanks to the generous donor CeeM for the gifts on our platform. Thank you so much!”
When the streamer saw the gifts Mina sent, she stood up in excitement, her pretty face blushing as she shouted at the screen.
Upon seeing the streamer’s reaction, Mina was completely dumbfounded. “Clang!”
The phone slipped gently from her hand and fell directly to the ground.
Meanwhile, the streamer continued to shout CeeM’s name in excitement.
“How… how is this possible? What is going on here?”
Mina muttered to herself for a moment and then slumped directly onto the ground. Her slender and fair legs were fully exposed in front of Connor, looking extremely enticing.
However, her eyes were hollow, as if she had heard the most unbelievable thing in the world. Despite Connor using various methods to prove his identity, she still refused to believe that he was CeeM!
“This can’t be, it’s absolutely impossible! Connor, you must be tricking me. How could you possibly be CeeM!”
Mina shouted to herself.
Connor walked up to her and picked up his phone from the ground, looking expressionless as he stared at her but didn’t say anything.
He knew that she probably needed some time to digest all of this.
Mina suddenly looked up at him, then reached out and grabbed him, her expression filled with emotions as she shouted, “Connor, you must be tricking me, right? You’re not some rich heir, and you’re not CeeM either. You’re just the ordinary person I know, right?”
“Mina, I haven’t tricked you. I am indeed CeeM!”
He calmly replied to her and continued, “I admit that I have been deceiving you all along, but I am not deceiving you now. I truly am CeeM. This villa is indeed mine, and I have so much money that I can’t even count it myself!”
She glanced at him and stuttered, “If you really are CeeM, then why did you deceive me before? Why didn’t you admit these things to me?”
“The reason 1 didn’t admit these things to you before is that 1 suddenly inherited a fortune. But the condition of inheriting this fortune was that I couldn’t let my fiancee know that 1 was wealthy. I was worried that the more people who knew about my identity, the higher the chances of my fiancee finding out. So I kept this a secret from everyone, including you. I came across your livestream by chance and saw someone bullying you, so I impulsively sent you some gifts. But I didn’t have any ulterior motives in sending you gifts. After all, this money means nothing to me, and I didn’t expect you to bring me any returns. That’s why I never admitted my identity to you. Now, do you understand what 1 mean?”
He looked at her calmly.
She froze in place, not knowing how to respond to his question..

chapters.title: Chapter 486 - 486: A Call from Aunt Candace
chapters.content:
Chapter 486: A Call from Aunt Candace
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
After Mina heard Connor’s words, she was instantly stunned on the spot, her face filled with disbelief.
Because Mina had never thought that Connor would actually be CeeM himself!
Back then, in order to help Mina to get rid of Hector, Connor even took the initiative to admit his identity to Mina, but unfortunately, Mina did not believe Connor’s words at that time.
Mina was silent for a long time, and finally asked Connor in shock, “Connor, are you really not lying to me? You’re the real CeeM right?”
“Why would I lie to you at a time like this? Moreover, I’ve already proven my identity to you just now. If you still don’t believe me, then there’s nothing 1 can do!” Connor sat on the sofa and said to Mina helplessly.
“Then if these things didn’t happen, would you never tell me that you were the real CeeM?” Mina shouted excitedly at Connor.
“Even if you knew that I’m CeeM, so what? This will only cause some estrangement between the two of us. Back then, when you didn’t know my identity, you could still treat me as a friend. But now that you know my identity, will you still treat me as a friend? Can you still treat me like before?”
Connor replied with a serious expression.
Mina looked at Connor and couldn’t help but sigh. She then said in a low voice, “You’re right. 1 might not be able to get along with you in the same way as before. After all, you’re no longer the Connor 1 knew!”
Connor looked at Mina without saying anything.
In fact, Connor had already guessed that this would be the result. As long as Connor told Mina the truth, she would definitely not be able to accept these things. Moreover, she would not know how to face Connor in the future.
This was also the reason Connor had never mentioned his status to anyone even though he could. Connor didn’t want to lose his previous life, nor did he want to see his friends gradually alienate him because of the change in his identity.
In many people’s eyes, if someone suddenly became rich, their friends would definitely try all kinds of ways to curry favor with them. But in fact, things were not like that at all. Those who knew that you were rich and came to curry favor with you were not your friends at all!
Those people could only be considered fair-weather friends at most. Real friends would never come over to curry favor with you just because you were rich. On the contrary, they would gradually alienate you because of the difference in status between you and them.
Connor did not lack fair-weather friends, nor did he lack people who flattered him. What he lacked was friends who would stand by his side regardless of whether they were rich or poor.
Mina was precisely this kind of person. Back then, Mina did not despise Connor just because he was poor, so Connor had helped Mina again and again.
But now that Mina knew Connor’s identity, she didn’t know how to get along with him anymore.
“Connor, thank you for your help, but I really didn’t expect you to be CeeM. Thank you for the gifts you sent in my livestream, but I won’t take a single cent of that money. I’ll return it all to you in two days…”
After saying this, Mina turned around and ran out of the villa.
Connor sat on the sofa and looked at Mina’s back. He couldn’t help but sigh, but he didn’t chase after her because he knew that even if he chased after her now, he wouldn’t be able to make her stay.
“Ah…”
Connor took a deep breath. He did not expect things to end up like this.
He had only wanted to lend the villa to Mina out of kindness, but how could he have imagined that Mina’s friend would cause such a mess?
After some time, Connor slowly got up and walked to the bedroom.
He didn’t plan to return to the rented house anymore. After all, if he met Mina again, Connor didn’t know what he should say to her.
Connor went to the bathroom to take a shower and then went straight back to the bedroom.
Although the bedroom in the villa was very comfortable and the space was much larger than the rented house that Connor had lived in before, for some reason, Connor still liked the previous house better.
This villa was empty. Connor was indeed a little lonely living alone.
Connor lay on the bed and thought that if Chloe moved in, it would be better, but he quickly dismissed the idea.
After all, he couldn’t let anyone know about his relationship with Chloe. If Chloe lived with him, it would definitely be exposed.
Therefore, Connor felt that it was better for him to live alone in this villa.
The next day, at eight o’clock in the morning.
Connor slowly opened his eyes, then picked up his phone to look at the time.
There were only less than three days left before Connor would start school again. Connor was prepared to move to the dormitory in the school when that happened.
That way, he could still be with Dominic, Spencer and the others every day.
Although the environment was not bad, living alone in such a big villa was really lonely.
“Ring!”
At this moment, Connor’s phone suddenly rang.
Connor subconsciously looked at his phone and found that an unfamiliar number was calling him.
Connor originally thought that it was just a scam call, so he hung up without thinking.
However, just as Connor hung up the phone, the other party called again.
Connor looked at his phone and was stunned for a moment. He felt that if it was a scam call, the other party would usually not call again after hanging up once.
But now that the phone was ringing again, it meant that the person who called was not a stranger, but someone who wanted to talk to him about something.
So in the end, Connor picked up the phone and said softly, “Hello, who is it?”
“Connor, you’re getting bolder now. You actually dare to hang up on me!”
A woman’s voice came from the other end of the phone. Her voice was very elegant.
“Aunt Candace, why did you call me?”
Connor asked with a puzzled expression after hearing the woman’s voice.
“Why? Can’t your Aunt Candace call you? I’m in Porthampton now. Do you want to meet up?”
The woman chuckled..

chapters.title: Chapter 487 - 487: A Tall and a Short Woman
chapters.content:
Chapter 487: A Tall and a Short Woman
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
At this moment, the woman who called Connor was called Candace Steadman, a very good friend of Connor’s mother.
When Candace and Connor’s mother were young, they were already close to each other. But later, Connor’s parents got into a car accident, and Connor became an orphan.
After Candace found out about this, she specially went to visit Connor and even took the initiative to adopt him.
However, Connor did not want to be adopted because he knew that Candace had her own family—Candace’s husband was still working in the government and could not earn much money, and the two of them had children. If they adopted Connor, the pressure would be very great.
Moreover, Candace’s husband didn’t agree to this matter, so Connor didn’t go to Rockford where Candace was, instead coming to Porthampton by himself.
Candace had also secretly transferred money to Connor a few times, but because Candace’s husband found out, she did not continue to help Connor.
Connor hadn’t contacted Candace for a long time, but if there was anyone in the world who was sincere to Connor, Candace was definitely one of them.
This was why Connor was so excited when he heard her voice.
“Aunt Candace, why did you come to Porthampton? Where are you now? I’ll pick you up immediately!”
Connor shouted excitedly when he heard that Candace wanted to meet him.
“I’m at Porthampton’s high-speed rail station now. Why don’t you come here to find us?” Candace replied.
“Okay. Why did you suddenly come to Porthampton? Is there something wrong?”
Connor asked in confusion.
“You see, your uncle was transferred from Rockford to Porthampton as part of his job. He’s working in Porthampton now, and our Sadie has also been admitted to your Porthampton University. Isn’t school starting soon? Our family of three bought a house in Porthampton and prepared to settle down in Porthampton in the future!” Candace explained with a smile.
“Then Aunt Candace, you’ll be living in Porthampton from now on?” Connor shouted excitedly after hearing Candace’s words.
“That’s right, we can meet often in the future!”
Candace replied happily.
“That’s great. Aunt Candace, 1’11 go to the high-speed rail station to pick you up now!” Connor quickly said.
“Alright, see you later!”
Candace replied lightly and hung up the phone.
After Connor saw that the phone was hung up, he quickly put on his clothes and washed up before leaving the villa.
At the same time, in the square in front of Porthampton’s high-speed rail station, there were two beautiful women, one tall and one small.
Whether it was their figures or looks, these two beauties could be said to be the best of the best, so they naturally attracted the attention of many people.
The slightly older beauty looked to be in her forties. However, because she often took care of herself, she looked very young. Moreover, her clothes were very stylish—he wore a tight black dress, which accentuated her tall and sexy figure. Her entire body was emitting an irresistible temptation.
As for the younger beauty, she was very pure-looking. She was wearing a white knitted shirt and light blue denim shorts. Her slender and fair legs were exposed to the air without reservation. She was also wearing a pair of high heels. Her exquisite face coupled with her pure and refined temperament gave off an aura of cute charm.
These two beauties were Candace, who had called Connor earlier, and Candace’s daughter, Sadie Colt.
Sadie was frowning at this time, and her expression was very unhappy. She pouted and asked Candace, “Mom, when is that Connor coming over? How long have we been waiting here?”
“I just called Connor. No matter how fast he is, he will only arrive in half an hour!”
Candace had always been a gentle person, so she replied with a smile.
“Another half an hour?!”
After Sadie heard this, her expression seemed to be even more unhappy. She said with a straight face, “I already made an appointment with my friend to go to the internet cafe later, but you had to call me out to wait for someone. I really don’t know what’s the point of meeting him.”
“Why are you so insensible!”
Candace frowned slightly when she heard Sadie’s words. Then, she whispered, “Back then, Connor’s parents were kind to our family. Connor’s father was the one who got your father his job. Now that we’re in Porthampton, we naturally have to meet Connor, right? He doesn’t have any relatives here. How pitiful is it for a child to be all alone?”
“What’s so pitiful about him? Didn’t you transfer money to Connor many times back then? But Connor didn’t even say thank you. I think hes an ingrate…”
Sadie replied.
“Sadie, what nonsense are you talking about? When Connor comes later, you can’t talk nonsense, understand?”
Candace quickly scolded him and then continued, “Originally, you and Connor were already engaged when you were young…”
“What did you say? I’m bethrothed to Connor?”
Sadie was stunned when she heard Candace’s words. Her face was filled with disbelief.
“That’s right. Back then, Connor’s mother and I had already discussed this matter. However, Connor’s parents had an accident and Connor became an orphan,” Candace replied softly.
“Mom, are you really planning to marry me to this Connor? I’m telling you now, 1 don’t want to marry someone 1 don’t even know. Moreover, I heard that Connor is very poor…” Sadie shouted excitedly.
“Of course I don’t have any intention of letting you marry Connor. After all, Connor’s parents are no longer around. I’m the only one who knows about this engagement. If I don’t say anything, no one will know. However, I feel that doing this is a little unfair to Connor. After all, when the McDonald family was doing well, we had an engagement with them. Now that we see they’ve fallen, we changed our minds. This is a little bad…”
Candace blamed herself.
“What’s wrong with that? It’s already the 21st century. How could there be such a thing as a child betrothal?” Sadie pouted as she replied.
Candace sighed helplessly and did not say anything..

chapters.title: Chapter 488 - 488: Help Me Take Care of Sadie
chapters.content:
Chapter 488: Help Me Take Care of Sadie
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
At the entrance of the high-speed rail station.
Although Candace said that she didn’t want Sadie to marry Connor, she was actually very willing to matchmake Connor and Sadie together.
This was also the reason why Candace had insisted on bringing Sadie here to meet Connor. However, she was worried that Sadie would resist, so she didn’t say what she was thinking.
“Sadie, I’ve seen Connor before. He’s very honest. Moreover, both of you will be studying at the Porthampton University in the future. He should be in junior year now. You must get along well with Connor, understand?” Candace said earnestly to Sadie.
“I get it, I get it. As long as you don’t make me marry that Connor, I’ll do anything you want!” Sadie replied impatiently.
In fact, Sadie was not a fool. On the contrary, she was very smart and very vigilant. She could sense that Candace seemed to want to matchmake her and Connor, so she also had a lot of resistance to Connor in her heart.
“Aunt Candace, I’m sorry to have kept you waiting!”
At this moment, Connor quickly walked up to Candace and Sadie and greeted them with a smile.
“This person is Connor?”
After Sadie heard Connor’s words, she couldn’t help but size him up.
“He doesn’t look very tall, at most about 1.75 meters. He’s quite handsome, but his temperament is a little lacking. The clothes he’s wearing aren’t from any big brands either. It’s okay if we’re just friends, but he’s still far from being a boyfriend!” Sadie couldn’t help but comment in her heart.
Obviously, the first impression Connor gave Sadie was that he was just an ordinary person.
However, Sadie didn’t know that Connor had changed into a new set of clothes to meet Candace today and wasn’t wearing the tattered clothes he used to wear.
Although this set of clothes was also a famous brand, in the eyes of a rich girl like Sadie, Connor’s clothes could only be described as ordinary.
Therefore, Sadie looked at him with disdain.
“My mother actually wants me to marry someone like Connor. Isn’t this a joke? This Connor is like the difference between heaven and earth when compared to Sheldon…” Sadie couldn’t help but sigh in her heart.
The Sheldon that Sadie was talking about was one of Sadie’s suitors.
Sheldon Campbell had also been admitted to Porthampton University. He was the nephew of the deputy mayor of Rockford. He was a famous figure in high school and had been pursuing Sadie for some time.
However, Sadie had never agreed to be with Sheldon because she had not properly tested him. After all, agreeing to Sheldon too easily would only make him think that she was too needy, but Sadie’s impression of Sheldon was actually very good.
“In the blink of an eye, we haven’t seen each other for a few years, but Connor has actually grown so big!”
Candace looked at Connor with a smile on her face. She quickly held Connor’s hand as if she was very satisfied with Connor. She turned her head and introduced him to Sadie, “Connor, this is my daughter, Sadie…”
“Hello, Sadie!”
Connor took the initiative to greet Sadie. Perhaps it was because of Candace’s efforts, but Connor had a very good impression of Sadie. After all, she was Candace’s daughter, so he would certainly treat her as his own sister.
Although Sadie was very disdainful of Connor, she still said very politely, “Connor, how are you? My mother often mentions you!”
It might be a problem with family education. Sadie would not show her emotions, but Mina’s friends were different. After seeing Connor, they would immediately display their doubts and disdain for Connor on their faces.
“Connor, Sadie has also been admitted to Porthampton University. In the future, the two of you will be classmates. You must help me take good care of Sadie, understand?” Candace smiled at Connor.
“Aunt Candace, don’t worry. I’ll definitely take care of Sadie as if she’s my biological sister!”
Connor smiled and replied.
“Who wants to be your biological sister? It’s already very good for a person like you to be able to take care of yourself, yet you actually want to take care of me!” Sadie couldn’t help but mutter in her heart. However, her pretty face didn’t change at all. She was still very calm.
Connor glanced at Sadie indifferently. This was the first time he had seen Sadie. He had a good impression of Sadie, but he didn’t know how Sadie would evaluate him!
“Sadie, if you encounter anything in school in the future, you can come to me at any time…”
Connor turned his head and whispered to Sadie.
If it was the previous Connor, he definitely wouldn’t have the confidence to say these words. After all, before Connor obtained the inheritance, he couldn’t even take care of himself, let alone take care of others.
However, he was different now. He believed that there was nothing in the Porthampton University that he couldn’t handle.
If there were any mishaps, Connor could ask Kyle Hayes to deal with it. Therefore, Connor was very confident when he said this.
After Sadie heard Connor’s words, she couldn’t help but feel a little surprised because she could feel that Connor, who was standing in front of her, didn’t seem to have any ill intentions towards her at all. He didn’t have any other dirty thoughts because Connor’s eyes were very clear.
What a rare situation.
“Does Connor really intend to treat me as his sister?” Sadie couldn’t help but mutter in her heart, but on the surface, she still said to Connor very enthusiastically, “Alright, I’ll come find you if there’s anything 1 need…”
Although Sadie said that, she didn’t take Connor’s words seriously.
This was because the Colt Family that Sadie belonged to was very different from the previous Colt family Connor was used to. Back then, Candace was just a housewife. However, she was now the CEO of a listed company with a net worth of more than 100 million dollars. Sadie’s father, Tony Colt, was also the deputy director of the Porthampton Industry and Commerce Bureau.
Such a family environment, coupled with the deputy mayor’s nephew as a suitor, would result in Sadie having nothing to trouble Connor with.
The reason why Sadie answered Connor like this was just to be polite.
Candace saw that Connor and Sadie were getting along quite well, and she was very happy in her heart. She smiled and said to Connor, “Alright, let’s not stand here anymore. Hurry up and go to my house!”
“Right!”
Connor lightly nodded in agreement..

chapters.title: Chapter 489 - 489: The Houses in Royal Villas
chapters.content:
Chapter 489: The Houses in Royal Villas
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
After leaving the high-speed rail station, Connor, Sadie, and Candace took a taxi and rushed to Candace’s house.
Candace even asked Connor and Sadie to sit at the back.
In the beginning, the two of them might have chatted casually, but it was just some polite words.
Connor had always treated Sadie like a younger sister, while Sadie was very disdainful of Connor. In addition, the two of them had different social circles, hobbies, and so on. Naturally, there was nothing to talk about.
So later, the two of them simply stopped talking.
Connor directly turned his head to look out of the window, closed his eyes and began to meditate. He wasn’t intentionally trying to be cold, but because of Mina’s matter last night, Connor was a little tired. Now, there was nothing to talk about with Sadie, so he chose to rest.
After Sadie saw Connor closing his eyes to rest, a strange look flashed across her eyes. Then, she also looked at the scenery outside the window.
In fact, Connor gave Sadie a very good impression. However, because Sadie was a goddess pursued by countless people in school, her standards were naturally very high. When she saw that Connor did not speak, she would definitely not take the initiative to talk to Connor.
Sadie had seen many boys who liked to pretend to be cold and aloof when they were pursuing her, but Sadie did not fall for it.
Ten minutes later, the taxi stopped at the entrance of a villa.
This villa community was actually not very far from Connor’s villa.
Although Connor did not know much about houses, to be able to buy such a villa in Porthampton would cost at least five to six million dollars.
In Connor’s impression, Candace’s family condition was not very good. At most, she was just an ordinary family, which was also the reason why Candace could not give Connor money to help Connor.
However, after so many years, Candace’s family conditions must have changed. Otherwise, Candace would never have bought such a villa in Porthampton.
Candace seemed to have noticed Connor’s confusion and explained to him, “Connor, I’ve been running my own company for the past few years, so I’ve earned some money!”
“So that’s how it is!”
Connor nodded his head lightly and didn’t say anything.
Previously, Connor was still considering whether he should give Candace some money to repay her kindness.
However, it seemed that Candace was not short of money. If Connor gave her money, it would be a little rude. Even if he gave it to Candace, she might not want it.
Most importantly, Connor was still considering whether he should tell Candace that he was a rich heir.
Candace’s villa was very good, but it was still a far cry from Connor’s mansion.
“Aunt Candace, this villa of yours should cost a lot of money, right?” Connor asked Candace with a smile.
“Yes, 1 bought this villa for six million dollars, but I was not very satisfied with this villa at that time. 1 prefer the ones in Royal Villas…” Candace replied.
After hearing Candace’s words, Connor was stunned. A trace of shock flashed across his eyes because the Royal Villas that Candace mentioned happened to be the residential area where Connor’s own villa was located.
“Royal Villas is the best villa community in Porthampton. The environment is elegant and the location is not bad. Moreover, the villas there are also very beautiful. My mother liked them very much after seeing them, but the villas there were too expensive. The cheapest one cost tens of millions, and the more expensive ones cost hundreds of millions. That’s why my mother bought a house here later…”
Sadie saw that Connor didn’t have any reaction after hearing the words “Royal Villas.” She thought that Connor might not know what Royal Villas was at all, so she took the initiative to explain this to Connor.
“Those who can buy a house in Royal Villas are all rich people in Porthampton. Although I’ve made some money over the years, I’m still far from those rich people!” Candace sighed helplessly.
“I think your house is already very good. The environment and everything else are quite good…” Connor smiled and replied to Candace. After hesitating for a moment, he continued, “Aunt Candace, if you like the house in Royal Villas, 1’11 buy one for you when I have money in the future…”
“Haha, then when you have money in the future, don’t forget about me!” Candace replied happily.
At this time, Candace only took Connor’s words as a joke. In her eyes, Connor was just an ordinary university student. It was impossible for him to have the money to buy such an expensive villa.
Connor had intended to say that he had a few villas in Royal Villas and could give them to Candace directly.
However, after thinking about it, Connor felt that if he said that, Candace would be scared silly. At that time, she would be like Mina’s friends who would doubt whether what he said was true or not. Connor was not in the mood to explain these things to these people, so he said it immediately and fooled them.
Connor felt that it was better to slowly tell Candace about his identity. This way, it might be easier for Candace to accept it.
However, Sadie couldn’t help but frown after hearing Connor’s words.
Earlier, she had also said that the villa at Royal Villas was worth at least tens of millions. It was impossible for Connor to have so much money, so he felt that Connor was obviously bragging.
“I thought that Connor was different from the boys in my school, but 1 didn’t expect them to all be like this. They all like to brag. The house in Royal Villas is so expensive. You can’t buy it just because you say you want to…”
Sadie couldn’t help but whisper in her heart. She looked at Connor indifferently and didn’t say anything, but her previously good impression of Connor had been swept away.
A few minutes later, Connor followed Candace and Sadie into a double-story villa.
The interior of the villa was luxuriously decorated in typical European-style designs. The furniture was also made of real leather.
After entering the villa, Connor found a middle-aged man wearing
gold-rimmed glasses, sitting on the sofa watching TV.
This middle-aged man was none other than Sadie’s father, Tony Colt.
Although Connor had a good impression of Candace, he didn’t have a good impression of Tony!

chapters.title: Chapter 490 - 490: Candace’s Wish
chapters.content:
Chapter 490: Candace’s Wish
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Tony Colt was originally just a small civil servant and did not have much power in Rockford.
However, for some reason, Tony had risen to the top in the past few years and became the deputy director of Rockford’s Industry and Commerce Bureau.
Moreover, he had recently been transferred to the industrial and commercial bureau of Porthampton, and his position was still the deputy director.
However, there was still a huge gap between the status of the deputy chief of Rockford and the deputy chief of Porthampton.
After all, Porthampton was a new first-tier city. It was far more developed than Rockford, a third-tier city. Tony naturally had more power.
Tony had never liked Connor, so when he saw Connor come in, he only nodded his head slightly in acknowledgement.
“Connor, hurry up and sit on the sofa. Sadie, go get Connor a glass of water. I’ll go to the kitchen and heat up the dishes. We can eat in a while!”
After Candace entered, she began to make arrangements. Sadie looked at Connor and asked, “Connor, what do you want to drink?”
“Anything is fine!” Connor replied indifferently.
“Alright then!” Sadie replied softly, then turned around and walked into the kitchen to pour Connor a glass of juice.
Tony turned his head and glanced at Connor. He smiled and said to Connor, “Connor, are you used to living alone in Porthampton now?”
“I’m quite used to it!” Connor replied indifferently.
“In the future, your Aunt Candace and I will also live in Porthampton. If you encounter anything, you can come to my house to look for me at any time!”
Tony looked at Connor and continued.
“Alright!”
Connor nodded lightly, but he knew in his heart that Tony’s words were just some polite words. If something really happened to Connor, Candace might help, but Tony would definitely not help.
Tony looked at Connor and asked, “By the way, Connor, how are your grades?”
“My academic performance is not bad, but I usually need to go out to work to earn money, so I don’t have much time to study!” Connor replied.
Tony turned to look at Sadie and said with a smile, “You should learn more from Connor. Connor is already working part-time while in school. Look at you, you only know how to spend money!”
“Aiya, I know!”
Sadie replied impatiently. In her heart, she was still very disdainful of work-study programs. After all, who would be willing to work if they came from a wealthy family?
Tony turned his head and glanced at Connor, then said lightly, “Connor, your uncle is still very supportive of you, but you have to remember that studies are the most important at all times, so you must not fall behind in them. You must study hard. If I didn’t study back then, how could I have gotten to where I am today?”
Connor could tell that Tony was only bragging.
However, Tony might not know that Connor could not focus on his studies now.
Studying was very important to ordinary people, but it was nothing to Connor. After all, he had inherited ten trillion dollars of assets. There was no need for him to look for a job through his studies, so he simply replied to Tony with a word of gratitude.
After Tony saw Connor’s attitude, he was still very disappointed in him.
Previously, Candace had also told Tony that she wanted to matchmake Connor and Sadie.
Tony felt that if Connor knew how to improve himself, this matter could actually be considered. After all, the Colt family’s conditions were already very good. They did not care about money at all. When the time came, they would just treat Connor as a son-in-law.
However, from his interaction with Connor just now, Tony felt that Connor was obviously a person who was willing to degenerate. How could Tony marry his daughter to someone like Connor?
“It seems that I’ll have to have a good chat with Sadie. This Connor is not worthy of Sadie at all. The two of them probably won’t have a good ending!”
Tony couldn’t help but sigh softly in his heart. Then, he turned his head and looked at Sadie’s seat. He felt that if he was familiar with Sadie’s tastes in men, she wouldn’t take a fancy to Connor at all.
“What are you guys talking about here?”
At this moment, Candace came out of the kitchen with food and asked Connor and Tony with a smile.
“I didn’t talk about anything. I was just casually chatting with Connor!” Tony replied with a smile. Then, he patted Connor’s shoulder and said with a smile, “Alright, Connor, let’s go eat!”
“Alright.”
Connor nodded and followed Tony into the dining room.
During the meal, Tony and Candace also inquired about Connor’s recent situation. However, they only talked about some irrelevant topics, so the meal was tasteless.
After dinner, Connor took the initiative to help clean up the table.
Meanwhile, Tony and Sadie were sitting on the sofa and watching TV. They had no intention of helping at all.
Candace didn’t mind. With Connor’s help, she cleaned up the table and whispered to Connor, “Connor, come over here!”
After saying that, Candace turned around and walked into the bedroom.
Connor looked at Candace’s back and hesitated for a moment before following her in.
After entering the bedroom, Candace looked at Connor and said seriously, “Connor, 1 know that you haven’t been doing very well these past few years. I’ve been trying to contact you these past few years, but 1 haven’t been able to find your contact information.”
“Aunt Candace, actually, I…” Connor opened his mouth to speak, but was cut off by Candace.
“I know that you’re very independent, but sometimes you can’t bear everything on your own, right?” After Candace said this, she took out a bank card from her pocket and handed it to Connor. Then she whispered, “Connor, this is for you. There’s 500,000 dollars in it. I don’t have any other intentions. I just hope that you can live a better life!”
“Aunt Candace, what are you doing?” Connor said helplessly.
One had to know that 500,000 dollars wasn’t much to Connor at all. However, to Candace, 500,000 dollars was not a small sum of money. She was definitely not rich enough to ignore 500,000 dollars.
“Connor, quickly accept it. This is a little token of my appreciation!”
Candace directly stuffed the bank card into Connor’s hand..

chapters.title: Chapter 491 - 491: Give Me The Bank Card
chapters.content:
Chapter 491: Give Me The Bank Card
Translator: End less Fantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Inside the bedroom.
Connor looked at the bank card in his hand with a helpless expression.
Connor was not short of money at ail, and he felt a little guilty. After all, he did not contact Candace immediately after he had money, but Candace still took the initiative to find Connor.
Although 500,000 dollars was nothing to Connor now, if it was before, he would have been so excited that he could nor speak if someone suddenly gave him such a large sum of money.
Connor looked at the bank card and took a deep breath, lie decided to tell Candace about his inheritance.
“Aunt Candace, you should keep this money for yourself. Actually, I’m quite rich now!” Connor whispered to Candace.
“How can a student like you have money? I heard what Uncle Tony said to you just now. Other than going to school, you still have to go out and work. You’d better keep this money quickly.” Candace looked at Connor and said.
“Aunt Candace, I really…” Connor tried to explain to Candace.
But then, Sadie s voice suddenly came from outside the room.
“Mom, what are you doing?”
“It’s okay. I’ll pack my things!” Candace replied in a low voice. Then, she gave Connor a look and said softly, “I am giving you this money. Uncle Tony doesn’t know about this. You can t tell anyone, okay?”
Connor opened his mouth to speak, but Candace didn’t give him a chance to speak at all. She turned around and walked out of the room.
Connor looked at the bank card in his hand helplessly. After hesitating, Connor found Candace’s bag and returned the bank card.
“Connor, come out for a moment!”
At this moment, Candace called out to him again.
Connor quickly walked out of the bedroom and asked Candace with a smile, “Candace, what’s up?”
“Well, Sadie said she wants to go out and buy some things for school. I can stay ar home. Why don’t you go out with Sadie?” Candace smiled at Connor.
Connor looked up at Sadie and nodded, “Sure!”
“Let’s go. The mall is closing soon!” Sadie said arrogantly to Connor, then turned around and left the villa.
Connor hesitated, then politely greeted Candace and Tony before following Sadie out of the villa.
After Tony saw Connor and Sadie leave, he whispered to Candace, “Candace, I don’t think Connor is very suitable for Sadie. Why don’t we forget about it?” “How is he unsuitable?” Candace was stunned momentarily when she heard this before asking sullenly.
“Can’t you tell? Connor is a lazy and useless person. You know Sadie’s personality. Sadie likes boys who are capable and motivated. The two will not be together. Even if they are together, it won’t end well. I advise you to give up on this idea as soon as possible!” Tony said solemnly.
“What do you mean? You’ve just met Connor, and Connor is just a student now. How can you tell that he has no ambition?” Candace frowned and said unhappily.
“Can’t I tell if he’s ambitious or not?” Tony said.
“Forget it, forget it. Whether Connor and Sadie can be together or not is between the two of them. It has nothing to do with us! If these two children can get together, 1’11 naturally be happy, but if they can’t, I won t force Sadie!” Candace said helplessly.
“It’s good that you think like this. You have to know there’s no happiness if you force yourself!” Tony said.
Candace sighed softly. She was somewhat helpless.
In fact, Candace could also see that Sadie was not interested in Connor.
***
Meanwhile, Sadie and Connor left the villa.
Sadie turned and looked at Connor. Then, she asked Connor with a straight face, “Did my mom give you money just now?”
Connor was stunned after hearing this. Then, he frowned and asked, “How do you know about that?”
“My mom took me to rhe bank today to deposit 500,000 dollars, and she didn’t want me to tell my dad. This means that this money is definitely for you. When you were in the room with my mom just now, did my mom give you the bank card?” Sadie asked coldly.
“Yes, she did!” Seeing that Sadie had already found out that Candace had given him money, he didn’t deny it and admitted it openly.
“Give me the bank card!” Sadie extended her hand to Connor and said coldly.
“Give you rhe bank card?” When Connor heard Sadie’s words, he was stunned and a little confused.
“That’s right. That’s our family’s money. Why should we give it to an outsider like you? And you’re really shameless. You accepted so much money just like that. How can you be so shameless?”
At this moment, because no one else was present, Sadie did not show mercy when she spoke to Connor.
Connor looked at Sadie without saying anything.
“Connor, actually, I had a good impression of you at first. At least you’re not as loud as other boys. However, rhe fact that you accepted my mother’s money made me very disappointed in you. I know your parents are gone, and you’ve been working to support yourself. You must be very short of money, but you can’t ask for all kinds of money, right? A man can be poor, but he can’t be spineless. Hurry up and give me the bank card! ” Sadie scolded Connor earnestly.
“What do you want this bank card for?” Connor hesitated before asking Sadie.
“I won’t use the money. I’m just helping you keep it for the rime being. When you really need money, you can come to me ro get the money. I don’t want you to squander this money just because my mother gave you this bank card!” Sadie said seriously.
Connor looked at Sadie with a strange look in his eyes. Originally, Connor thought that Sadie wanted the money for her use.
However, Connor didn’t expect Sadie to be worried that he would squander the money.
This improved Sadie’s image in Connor’s heart.
“I’ve already returned the bank card to Candace, so you don’t have to worry that 1’11 squander the money. What you said just now was right. A man can be poor, but he can’t be spineless!” Connor looked at Sadie and said.
After Sadie heard Connor’s words, she was stunned, and a trace of surprise flashed in her eyes.
“You didn’t take the money my mom gave you?” Sadie said in shock.
She felt that if a person like Connor could get 500,000 dollars for no reason, he would be very happy.. How could Connor not want this money?

chapters.title: Chapter 492 - 492: Punching Above One’s Weight
chapters.content:
Chapter 492: Punching Above One’s Weight
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
“Are you lying to me?” Sadie stared at Connor.
“Why would I lie to you? This 500, 000 dollars is nothing to me!” Connor replied to Sadie with some disdain.
When Sadie heard that Connor didn’t want the money, her impression of Connor finally improved.
However, when she heard Connor’s words, her impression of Connor began to decrease greatly.
“Does it hurt not to brag? You said you wanted to buy a house for my mother in Royal Villas, and now you say that 500, 000 dollars is nothing to you. Do you think 1 don’t know who you are?” Sadie said disdainfully to Connor, then continued, “I’ve already heard from my mother that you can’t even afford your tuition fees. Moreover, you have to rely on delivering food to make a living. Have you ever seen 500, 000 dollars as a delivery man?” Connor looked at Sadie with a faint smile, not explaining anything.
He knew that Sadie wouldn’t believe him no matter what he explained, so he might as well save his breath.
“You really don’t have the money my mother gave you, right?” Seeing that Connor didn’t say anything, Sadie continued to ask him.
“No, I’ve already returned the bank card to your mother. If you don’t believe me, you can go back and check on that!” Connor said lightly.
Sadie hesitated for a moment. She felt that Connor was not lying, so she looked at Connor and said, “Alright, since you don’t want the money, forget it. I’m going shopping with my friends later. You can go home!”
Sadie had no intention of bringing Connor along.
“Okay!” Connor looked at Sadie and nodded, then turned around and walked to the roadside.
Sadie looked at Connor in disbelief.
Sadie thought Connor would follow her, but she never thought Connor would agree so readily.
Sadie looked at Connor’s back and suddenly felt a little guilty because her attitude toward Connor was bad. She even had the urge to call Connor back.
However, Sadie thought of the gap between her and Connor and what Connor had said just now, so she finally suppressed this impulse.
‘Sadie, the gap between you and Connor is very big. The two of you are not from the same world at all.’ Sadie sighed in her heart and left.
***
Two hours later.
Sadie bought the daily necessities she needed for the start of school and then returned home.
When Candace saw Sadie come back alone, she asked Sadie in confusion, “Sadie, why didn’t Connor come back with you?”
“He went home after we bought the things!” Sadie replied lightly.
“Then why didn’t you bring Connor back? I was planning to invite Connor for dinner!” Candace shouted unhappily.
“Ah, Mom! Connor is from a different world. We can’t be together!”
Sadie knew what Candace was thinking, but she had never said anything to save Candace’s face.
However, Sadie seemed a little impatient, so she frowned and said to Candace.

However, when Connor came over this time, Tony realized that the gap between Connor and Sheldon was too big. He decided to get Sadie and Sheldon to be together.
Candace wanted to matchmake Connor and Sadie, while Tony wanted to matchmake Sheldon and Sadie.

At this moment, the two girls were curled up in a corner. Their faces were very pale, and their eyes were filled with deep fear.
One of the girls was wearing a tight-fitting T-shirt. She looked very charming and had a very hot figure. Her chest was ample.
The other girl was dressed up a little more sexily. She was wearing a tube top and a short white skirt. Her slender and fair legs were exposed without reservation, making her exceptionally charming.
These two girls were none other than Connor’s ex-girlfriend, Mandy Hines, and Mandy’s best friend, Lily Sullivan.

The leader, a burly man with a scar on his face, asked Mandy.
“I do, I do…” Mandy curled up in the corner and nodded gently.
“Since you do, then I will cut the crap short. When will you pay back the twenty million you owe us?” the scar-faced man asked in a low voice.
“Julio, can you give me a little more time? I will return this money to you!” At this moment, Mandy’s face was filled with fear as she replied with a trembling voice.
“Haha…” When the scar-faced man heard this, he couldn’t help but sneer.. Then, he said with a straight face, “Give you a little more time? Mandy, how many times have you said this to me? How much time have I given you? But where is your money?”

chapters.content:
Chapter 493: Mandy Hines In Desperation
Translator: End less Fantasy Translation Editor: End loss Fantasy Translation
In an unfinished building in Porthampton.
Mandy curled up in the corner, her entire body trembling. The expression on her face was very fearful.
She looked at the burly man before her and stuttered, “Julio, give me three more days. 1 will return the money to you within three days! ”
“I’m not in the mood to waste time with you now. Since you don’t intend to pay me back, don’t blame me for being rude!”
The scar-faced man looked at Mandy and shouted. Then, he turned his head and shouted at his underlings behind him, “What are you guys still standing there for? Quickly strip her clothes and take a photo of her and send it to her family. Let her family bring the money to redeem her!”
“Yes, sir!”
When everyone heard this, they immediately rushed toward Mandy and prepared to make a move on her.
“Julio, I beg you, can you give me another chance? I’ll return the money to you in three days. Don’t tell my family about this!”
Seeing that these people were ready to make a move, she hurriedly shouted nervously.
“No, I don’t trust you anymore. This has to be resolved by your family. You’ve already owed us twenty million dollars for over a month!” The scar-faced man said expressionlessly.
“But Julio, my parents are just ordinary workers. Even if you kidnapped me, my parents wouldn’t have the money to redeem me!”
Mandy kneeled on the ground and begged desperately.
“Are your parents ordinary workers?”
When Julio heard this, he was stunned for a moment. A trace of confusion flashed in his eyes. Then, he frowned and asked Mandy, “Since your parents are both ordinary workers, how did you get the money to go to Harlem’s Gold?”
Mandy looked up at Julio and said nothing.
“Mandy, let me tell you, if you dare to play tricks with me now, I won’t be nice, do you hear me?”
Julio looked at Mandy and threatened her gloomily.
Mandy took a deep breath. She still looked hesitant, but she knew that if she didn’t tell the truth now, Julio and the others would definitely not let her off.
Therefore, Mandy could only say, “Julio, my parents are indeed ordinary workers, and my family doesn’t have much money. Even if I sold everything in my family, I won’t be able to gather so much money. All my money was given to me by my ex-boyfriend!”
“Is your ex-boyfriend so rich to give you that much money?”
When Julio heard Mandy’s explanation, a trace of shock flashed in his eyes.
“Yes, my ex-boyfriend inherited a fortune and is very rich now. I have something on him. I’ve already contacted him before, but I haven’t been able to contact him. I believe that as long as I can find him, I can get money from him!” Mandy said seriously.
The scar-faced man looked at Mandy, puzzled.
“Julio, if you don’t believe me, you can ask my best friend to see if I’m telling the truth!” Seeing that Julio didn’t seem to believe her words, she quickly suggested.
“Is what she said true?” Julio turned to look at Lily and asked with a frown.
“It’s true, Julio. Mandy is not lying to you. Her ex-boyfriend is indeed very rich!” Lily nodded without thinking.
Julio knew very well that if Mandy really did not have money, it would be useless even if he raped Mandy now.
After all, it was a society ruled by law now. It was impossible for him to sell Mandy. Moreover, even if he sold Mandy, he probably wouldn’t be able to get back the twenty million!
Therefore, after hesitating, Julio said to Mandy, “Alright, Mandy, I’ll give you three more days. If you don’t return the money to me after three days, you know the consequences.”
“Yes, I know. Thank you, Julio. Thank you! ” Mandy shouted excitedly.
“Let’s go!” Julio snorted and left with his men.
A moment later, Julio and the others left. Mandy stood up, desperate.
Three months ago, Mandy used rhe photos to extort ten million from Connor. After getting the money, Mandy bought a house in Porthampton for herself and then brought Lily to the bar every day to get drunk.
However, after a while, Mandy felt that this kind of life was not what she wanted. Therefore, Mandy went to the largest casino in Porthampton, Harlem’s Gold, with Lily’s suggestion.
In the beginning, Mandy was just playing around. Sometimes she could win a little money, and sometimes she would lose a little money.
However, the winning and losing were not very big. At most, it was only a few tens of thousands of dollars.
However, as Mandy went to the casino more often, she got to know more people and the bets she made became bigger and bigger.
Moreover, Mandy’s luck was usually very good. At most, she could win a few million in one night!
This made Mandy more and more confident!
However, the good times did not last long. When Mandy won almost ten million, she began to lose money crazily.
In less than a week, she had lost all the money she had won.
After losing all the money, Mandy planned to wash her hands of the game. She did not go to Harlem’s Gold for a long time!
However, Mandy felt reluctant that she had lost all the money just like that. So she returned to Harlem’s Gold.
However, this time Mandy had lost everything. Not only did she lose all the money in her hands, but she also owed a loan shark twenty million.
That was why Julio was asking her for money.
Mandy was basically penniless now, and she still owed a lot of loan sharks.
In the end, she had no choice but to go to her family to ask for money.
However, Mandy’s family was very ordinary. It was impossible for them to take out so much money to pay her debt. Therefore, some time ago, Mandy called Connor, but Connor did not answer the phone.
Mandy was very desperate because she had no way out!
“Mandy, what do you plan to do next?” Lily asked Mandy softly.
The loan sharks that Mandy owed had nothing to do with Lily because she did not participate in gambling at all.
Moreover, not only did she not lose money, but when Mandy won money, she also gave Lily a lot of benefits.
So now Lily had some money in her hands, bur she would definitely not use this money to pay off Mandy’s debts!
Mandy hesitated for a long time before taking a deep breath. Then, she took out her phone and was going to call Connor..

’’Ring!”

IF 11

In a bubble tea shop near Porthampton University.

To them, a girl like Mandy was simply a goddess-level existence. She had a great figure and a beautiful face.

After Mandy saw Connor was a little cold, she did not continue to chat with Connor. She sat directly opposite Connor and said softly, “Connor, I actually came here today to ask you for help!”
Connor looked at Mandy without saying anything.
Connor knew that Mandy must have something to trouble him to ask him out. Otherwise, Mandy would never take the initiative to contact him.
“Connor, I know I was wrong to cheat on you with Brandon back then, but I regret it very much now. I really shouldn’t have done that back then, I…” Mandy’s eyes began to tear up as she spoke. Mandy’s acting skills were indeed very good. It was enough to surpass many celebrities in the entertainment industry.
She had met Connor for less than five minutes but had already started crying.
However, Connor was already numb to Mandy’s tricks, so he said indifferently, “You regret breaking up with me because you know I’m rich, not because of anything else. So, you don’t have to put on a fake act with me. If you have something to say, say it!”

“Connor, don’t go!” Mandy quickly reached out and grabbed Connor, then said nervously, “Can’t 1 tell you how 1 feel? Why are you in such a hurry to leave?”

When Connor heard Mandy’s words, he couldn’t help but sneer. Then, he said nonchalantly, “A whole ten million in cash. How many months has it been? Did you spend it all? You do know how to spend money…”

Connor sneered in disdain and then said indifferently, “Mandy, I came to see you today not because you’re in my heart but because I want to see how you’ll live after you take the money I gave you. I’ve said that not everything in this world can be solved with money. Also, what does your life and death have to do with me? Didn’t you ask for all of this?”
After saying this, Connor turned around and was about to leave the bubble tea shop.
‘Thud!’

Mandy had been forced to a dead end. She did not care about what others thought of her, nor did she care about her dignity. Now there was only one thought in her mind: to get the money from Connor.
When Connor saw Mandy kneel, he could not help but frown, and a trace of confusion flashed in his eyes.
He asked Mandy with a straight face, “What are you doing?”
“Connor, I beg you, please help me!
“As long as you’re willing to help me, I’ll do anything you want!” Mandy looked at Connor and begged.
When Connor heard this, he was stunned. He seemed uncomfortable..

“As long as you’re willing to lend me money, I’ll do anything you want!

Seeing that he was leaving so heartlessly, she sat on the ground with a desperate expression.
This was because Connor was Mandy’s last life-saving straw, and this life-saving straw was leaving so heartlessly.
Mandy sat on the ground in despair. For a moment, she did not know what she should do.
“Beauty, do you want someone to be your sugar daddy? Do you think I can do it?”
At this moment, a somewhat wretched, greasy middle-aged man walked up to Mandy and asked her with a smile.
When Mandy heard the middle-aged man’s words, she turned to look at him and said in a disdainful tone, “You want to be my sugar daddy, right?” “That’s right!”

In the blink of an eye, two days had passed.
In these two days, Connor spent most of his time alone in the villa, playing games and watching movies. His days were very comfortable.
These two days were also the first time that Connor experienced the feeling of being a rich heir. Although Connor was also very rich before, it was very difficult for him to have time to completely relax. There were always all kinds of things happening around him.
Within two days, no one could contact Connor or find him.
There was only one day left before school started. Connor was ready to contact Dominic Turner, Spencer and the others as well as prepare for school.

Ring! Ring!

“Connor, tomorrow is Sadie’s first day of school. Do you have time? If you have time, can you help her with the admission procedures and all the other stuff? Your Uncle Tony and I are busy tomorrow, so we can’t accompany her!”

Chapter 497: A Friend’s Birthday Party
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
The next day, at eight o’clock in the morning.

Today was the orientation for the freshmen of the Porthampton University, and classes only start the day after tomorrow.
Porthampton University was considered one of the top universities in Davenport. Basically, those who could get into this university would have good academic results.
When Connor and Sadie arrived at the entrance of the Porthampton University, they found that the entrance was already packed with people. Most of them were new students who were preparing to enter the school, and some of them were seniors who were responsible for welcoming new students.
“I didn’t expect Porthampton University to be so big!”

“It’s alright. When I first arrived, it felt quite big, but after I got used to it, I realized that it’s actually not that big!”
Connor looked at Sadie and said calmly.
“I heard that you often deliver food outside the school. Is that true?”
