“It’s true!”
Connor nodded lightly.
When Sadie heard Connor’s words, a strange look flashed across her eyes. It was unknown whether it was intentional or unintentional.
She gradually slowed down her steps and pulled away from Connor, as if she didn’t want others to see her following Connor.
After all, Sadie was considered a goddess in their high school. If her classmates found out that she was with a poor delivery boy, it would definitely affect her reputation.
When Connor saw Sadie’s action, he understood what she meant. However, Connor felt that based on Sadie’s personality, she had already given him face by not directly asking him to keep a distance from her.
Furthermore, Connor didn’t care about these things at all, so he didn’t say anything else and walked straight into the school.
Although Sadie didn’t usually stay in the dormitory and chose to stay at home, her parents still let her go through the accommodation procedures to prevent any accidents.
Fortunately, Sadie didn’t bring any luggage with her, so Connor was able to relax.
Because Connor was familiar with the Porthampton University, it took him less than an hour to help Sadie complete all the admission procedures.
After completing the procedures, Connor took Sadie around the school and introduced her to the school, including the school hospital and cafeteria. He took her to see everything so that she would know what to do if she encountered any problems in the future!
Sadie was touched to see Connor being so diligent and responsible. Her impression of Connor also changed.
Sadie felt that although Connor was a little poor, he did not take the money her mother gave him, so he still had some backbone.
Moreover, Connor had brought Sadie to do so many things today. Connor did everything for her and did not ask Sadie to do anything at all. If it was not for his help, these procedures would be enough to tire Sadie out.
Connor didn’t complain at all, which made Sadie feel touched.
“Although Connor is not suitable as a boyfriend, he’s still quite good as a friend!”
Sadie couldn’t help but sigh. She walked to Connor and handed him a bottle of water. “Connor, thank you so much for today…”
Connor couldn’t help but be stunned when he heard her words.
He didn’t expect such a cold girl like Sadie to thank him!
“There’s no need to thank me. I’m just helping out because of Aunt Candance!”
Connor replied lightly, then took out his phone and said to Sadie, “What’s your phone number?”
Sadie was stunned for a moment. She looked at Connor and didn’t say anything, as if she was reluctant to give him her phone number.
“Don’t think too much about it. I just want to give you my phone number so that you can find me if you need anything in the future. I know you mind that I’m a poor loser who delivers food, but if you encounter any trouble in the future, I might be able to help you solve it. After all, I’ve been in this school for a much longer time than you…”
Although Connor was not very interested in her, he was still very enthusiastic because of Candance.
“Alright, then!”

“It’s getting late. Do you want to eat something?”
Connor asked Sadie softly after exchanging phone numbers with her.
“No, I’m going back to the dormitory to pack up and then go find my friends!”
Sadie refused.
“Alright then, I’ll be heading back now. If you need anything, you can call me!”
Seeing that Sadie had no intention of eating with him, Connor didn’t say anything more and turned around to leave.
Sadie looked at Connor’s back with some hesitation in her eyes. She stood there and hesitated for a couple of seconds before shouting softly, “Connor, it’s my friend’s birthday tonight. My mother asked me to bring you over. If you don’t have anything to do, come with me tonight!”
In fact, Sadie didn’t plan to invite Connor because she felt that he was too weak. Bringing him along would only embarrass her.
But today, she felt that Connor had worked very hard to help her. Moreover, it was just a small birthday party. It was not a one-on-one date with Connor, so it should be fine.
“Is it okay for me to go over?”
Connor didn’t agree like Sadie had expected. Instead, he turned around and asked Sadie.
“It’s okay. No one knows you anyway. Moreover, this is what my mother asked me to do. If 1 don’t bring you there, my mother will definitely scold me.”
Sadie whispered.
“Alright, then!”
Connor nodded in agreement.
“Then, come to the milk tea shop next to the school at seven tonight. I’ll wait for you there!”
Sadie called out softly.
“Okay!”
Connor nodded and turned to leave..

chapters.title: Chapter 498 - 498: There’s No Shortage of Decent People
chapters.content:
Chapter 498: There’s No Shortage of Decent People
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
7 PM.
Sadie and a few of her best friends were already gathered in the milk tea shop near the Porthampton University.
All of Sadie’s best friends had been admitted to the Porthampton University, and it was one of her friends’ birthday today.
That was why the few of them had gathered together to prepare a small birthday party.
Initially, Sadie didn’t plan to ask Connor to join. After all, she didn’t have any relationship with him. Moreover, Sadie didn’t have any feelings for him.
However, Candance had been trying to matchmake them. Sadie didn’t want to make Candance sad because of this. In addition, Connor had helped her with the admission procedures today and had been busy for the whole day. Sadie felt that it was a favor to him by asking him to join.
Sadie was worried that Connor had forgotten the time and place, so she specially called him.
“Connor, my friends are already at the shop. Come over quickly. Don’t let my friend wait too long!””
Sadie said softly while holding the phone.
“Alright, 1’11 be there soon!”
Connor replied faintly to Sadie and then hung up the phone.
Sadie couldn’t help but sigh when the call ended. Then, she put down her phone.
“Sadie, who did you call just now?”
At this moment, a sexy and charming girl asked Sadie with a puzzled expression.
There was a girl in a white spaghetti strap dress sitting beside them. These two were Sadie’s best friends.
“It’s a friend of mine!”
Sadie replied indifferently with an expressionless face.
“Boyfriend?” Yara Xenos, the charming girl, shouted with a smile.
“What boyfriend?”
When Sadie heard this, her face instantly turned dark. Then, she frowned and said, “This person is my mother’s friend’s son. I don’t know what my mother likes about him. She actually wants to matchmake the two of us. 1 really had no choice, so I asked him to join…”
“Oh!”
After hearing Sadie’s words, Yara became even more curious. She blinked and asked, “What does your friend look like? Is he rich? Can he be compared to my boyfriend, Levin?”
Levin Strong was Yara’s boyfriend. He was a very famous rich heir in their high school, and his family was in the hotel business.
They owned five-star hotel chains in several cities. Of course, Yara’s family background was quite good too. She was the typical fair, rich, and beautiful woman. The two of them were of equal social status.
“Yara, why are you so shallow? All you care about is money…”
At this moment, a beautiful woman in a long dress sitting beside them said helplessly.
“Sabrina, don’t you think I’m right? If the guy doesn’t have money, background, and looks, is he even compatible with Sadie? Does he even have the right to be with Sadie?”
Yara pouted and shouted.
“Yara, what nonsense are you talking about? I’m just ordinary friends with that person. He doesn’t have any intention of pursuing me at all!”
Sadie quickly explained and then continued, “That person’s parents have passed away a long time ago. He doesn’t have any background at all, but he’s quite handsome and decent…”
“Decent?”
Yara couldn’t help but laugh when she heard this. She was speechless and said loudly, “Sadie, are you kidding me? In today’s society, there’s no shortage of decent people!”
“Sadie, although Yara’s words seem harsh, it actually makes sense. If this person really doesn’t have any family background, even if you like him, the two of you won’t have a good ending because the two of you are from different worlds. He might not even be able to support himself in the future, let alone support you!”
The girl in the long dress reminded her softly and then continued, “Although in this society, one can’t just look at whether a person has money or not, economic conditions are definitely a very important factor!”
“What nonsense are the two of you talking about?”
Sadie shouted impatiently, then pouted and said, “I’ve already told you guys just now that my mother likes him and wants to matchmake the two of us, but 1 don’t like him!”
“Alright, since you don’t like him, I’ll teach this kid a lesson when he comes over later. 1’11 make him realize the difference between you and him. That way, he won’t have the guts to continue pestering you!”
Yara pouted and said to Sadie.
Sadie sighed helplessly after hearing Yara’s words. She didn’t know what to say.
At this moment, Connor happened to walk into the milk tea shop.
Although there were quite a lot of people in the milk tea shop at this time, because Sadie, Yara, and the best friend in the long dress were very beautiful, they were very eye-catching, so he found them at a glance.
In fact, Connor didn’t want to join their gathering because he didn’t know Sadie’s friends.
However, Connor knew that this was Candance’s intention, so he was embarrassed to refuse.
“You’re here!”
Sadie said faintly when she saw Connor. Her tone seemed a little cold. Perhaps it was because of what her best friend said just now, so Sadie was obviously deliberately keeping a certain distance from Connor.
The best friend wearing a spaghetti strap dress didn’t even look at Connor. She held a cup of milk tea in her hand and looked at the scenery outside the window with her beautiful eyes, giving people a feeling that they could only watch from afar and not go near her.
“You’re Sadie’s friend?”
At this moment, Yara stood up and sized up Connor with a disdainful expression.
The clothes that Connor was wearing were actually international brands. Chloe Lawson had specially bought them for Connor and placed them in his wardrobe. When Connor went out today, he was a little anxious, so he casually found two sets to wear.
However, Connor did not recognize these brands at all, nor did he know that the clothes he was wearing now would cost at least 100,000 dollars!
The reason why Yara was looking at Connor with such disdain was because she knew that his background was very ordinary, and it was impossible for ordinary people to afford such branded clothes.
Therefore, Connor’s clothes were all fake. Yara felt that she could use this to humiliate him..

chapters.title: Chapter 499 - 499: My Name Is Sabrina Ziegler!
chapters.content:
Chapter 499: My Name Is Sabrina Ziegler!
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Yara looked at Connor from head to toe and realized that all the clothes he was wearing were from internationally renowned brands.
Any one of them could cost tens of thousands!

Yara raised her head and asked Connor, “How much did you spend on these clothes?”
After hearing Yara’s words, Connor couldn’t help but be stunned for a moment. He was a little puzzled. He didn’t understand why Yara would ask him this question.
“Hey, I’m asking you a question. Didn’t you hear me?”
Seeing that Connor did not respond, Yara became even more smug.
He must be feeling guilty, so he didn’t dare to answer her question!
“Someone bought me these clothes. I don’t know how much they cost!”
Connor replied expressionlessly.
Although Yara’s behavior made him very uncomfortable, he didn’t say anything because Yara was Sadie’s friend.
“Who would give you branded clothes like these?”
Yara shouted in a strange tone. Then, she reached out and grabbed Connor’s clothes. “Kid, do you know what brand this is? Do you know how much this shirt costs?”
“I already said that these clothes were given to me by someone else!”
Connor repeated expressionlessly.
“Hehe, since you don’t know, then let me tell you. My boyfriend also has this jacket. It’s Versace’s latest autumn design and costs more than 80,000 dollars. Tell me, what friend would give you such an expensive shirt?”
Yara shouted in disdain.
When Sadie heard Yara’s words, a hint of disappointment flashed across her eyes.
Sadie thought that Connor was a very honest boy who was very low-key in doing things, though he liked to brag. However, she never expected him to be so vain!
He came out to meet her best friend in fake branded clothes!
‘I really don’t know what he’s thinking. Does he think that just because he wears a high-quality imitation, he can make others look up to him? A person’s background is not something that can be proven by a piece of clothing!’

“Kid, not everyone is that easy to fool. I’ve been exposed to more branded goods than you could ever imagine. I can tell at a glance whether the clothes you’re wearing are real or fake!”
Yara pouted and shouted at Connor.
“Then, do you think the clothes I’m wearing are real or fake?”
Connor asked Yara.
“Of course, it’s fake!”
Yara replied without thinking.
When Connor heard her words, he couldn’t help but smile faintly. Chloe Lawson had bought all these clothes.
Chloe was now the vice president of Evergrande Real Estate. She was very rich. There was no way she would buy fake clothes for him.
However, Connor was not in the mood to argue with Yara about these things. After all, he was only here to accompany Sadie today.
As for whether these people thought his clothes were real or fake, Connor did not care at all.
Connor wanted to walk to Sadie’s side, but Yara stopped him and shouted with her big watery eyes, “Kid, why are you in such a hurry to leave? I haven’t finished speaking yet.”
“Do you have anything else to say?”
Connor replied calmly.
“Do you think you can pursue Sadie just because you wear fake branded clothes? Why don’t you take look at yourself? Do you know how many people in our school are pursuing her?”
Yara shouted at Connor.
“I don’t care how many people are interested in her,” Connor smiled and said.
“Someone like you who has no money or background has no right to pursue Sadie. You’d better give up. do you hear me?”
Yara said disdainfully.
“Yara, what are you talking about?”
Sadie felt that Yara’s was being much to mean, so she quickly frowned and shouted.
“Sadie, don’t stop me. When dealing with such a shameless person, you should make things clear to him. Otherwise, he will never be able to face reality!”
Yara ignored Sadie and continued to curse Connor viciously.
Connor did not seem to care about Yara at all. He said expressionlessly, “I don’t have any intention of pursuing Sadie. I’m only here today because of Aunt Candance’s request, so your worries are a little unnecessary…”
“My worries are unnecessary?”
Yara said with a puzzled expression.
“If you really have the time, you should worry about yourself. It’s not your turn to worry about Sadie and me!”
Connor said coldly to Yara.
“Connor, don’t misunderstand her. Yara didn’t mean it that way!”
Sadie looked at Connor and explained.
“Haha…”
Connor smiled coldly, then found a seat in the milk tea shop and sat down, ignoring Sadie.
In Connor’s eyes, what Yara said just now would have been acquiesced by Sadie, so Sadie was just using Yara’s mouth to express some of her thoughts to him.
Connor had no intention of pursuing Sadie, so he naturally didn’t care about these things.
When Sadie and Yara saw that Connor was silent, they felt that they had achieved their goal.
Therefore, they ignored Connor and started to chat in a low voice.
Connor subconsciously glanced at the other best friend who was not far away from him.
Whether it was her figure or her appearance, this girl was definitely better than Sadie and Yara in all aspects.
She was wearing a white spaghetti strap short skirt. Her figure was tall and sexy. Under the short skirt, her beautiful legs were exposed for all to see. She was also wearing a pair of high heels. Her breasts were so full that it seemed as though they were about to fall out. Her beautiful face had light makeup on, but even so, she was still very sexy and charming.
Her exquisite face, sexy figure, and cold temperament made her a rare sexy beauty.
The beauty seemed to have noticed that Connor was sizing her up, but her reaction shocked everyone.
The beauty did not show any disgust at all. Instead, she took the initiative to say to Connor, “Hello, my name is Sabrina Ziegler!”
“Hello!”
Connor was stunned for a moment before he hurriedly replied softly..

chapters.title: Chapter 500 - 500: Connor, Where’s Your Car?
chapters.content:
Chapter 500: Connor, Where’s Your Car?

Although Sabrina greeted Connor, it was just a polite greeting. She did not want to continue the conversation.
After greeting her, Sabrina turned away and continued to admire rhe scenery outside the window.
Seeing that Sabrina was not talking to him, Connor took out his phone and started playing with it.

“It’s Levin and the others!”
When Yara saw the group of handsome men and beautiful women, she shouted excitedly. Then, she turned to Sabrina and Sadie and said, “Let’s go over!”

Connor hesitated for a moment before following them.
Yara was Levin1 s girlfriend, so when she saw Levin, she threw herself into his arms.
Levin was tall and handsome, and he was dressed very fashionably, it was obvious that he was a rich guy!
Since Sadie, Sabrina, and the others had met Levin before, they exchanged some simple greetings.
Levin turned to Connor and asked Yara, “Baby, who is this person?”
“This person is Sadie’s friend. Her mother asked him to come…”

However, Connor was quite far away from them, so he couldn’t hear what Yara and Levin were talking about.
But even if Connor couldn’t hear it, he could guess.
After hearing Yara’s words. Levin’s eyes flashed with disdain.
Then, he walked to Connor and extended his right hand. He said in a very arrogant tone, “Hello, I’m Levin Strong, Yara’s boyfriend!”

When Levin saw that Connor had ignored him, a trace of embarrassment flashed across his eyes.

Everyone looked at Levin in disbelief.
“Sadie, your friend is quite interesting!1 ’
Levin turned to look at Sadie, then slowly withdrew his right hand and said with a gloomy face, “Alright, we’ll all be at the Porthampton University in the future anyway. Just wait and see! ”

If Connor offended Levin, Levin would definitely take revenge!
Back in high school, there was a student who offended Levin and had his leg broken by Levin.
Moreover, Levin even said that he would continue to beat him up when the student was discharged. Later on, the student had no choice but to drop out of school.
Because Levin’s family owned a chain hotel, his father was also very powerful in society.
Even if this student called the police, he would only be compensated with some money. He couldn’t do anything to Levin.
However, no one took Levin’s words to heart. Yara asked Levin sweetly, “Hubby, what are our plans for today?”
“Let’s go to a nightclub and have some fun. After we’re done, we ll go to my family’s restaurant for dinner. I’ve prepared a luxurious private room for you. We can enjoy to our hearts’ content. Everything’s on me today!”

“Levin, I heard that there’s a new Golden Bell Nightclub in Porthampton. The place seems good, and it’s packed every day. Why not we go there and have some fun?”

Just as Levin was about to leave, Yara suddenly pointed at Connor outside the car window and shouted, “Hubby, that guy hasn’t gotten into his car yet!”

“He took a taxi here!”
Sadie was also sitting in Levin’s car and said expressionlessly.
“Oh!”
Levin smiled faintly, then looked at Connor who was outside and continued, “Connor, look, my car is full. The other cars are also full. Why not you take a taxi there yourself? When you tell the driver that you’re going to the Golden Bell Nightclub, they should know where it is!”
“Hahaha!”
Everyone burst into laughter when they heard Levin’s words..

chapters.title: Chapter 501 - 501: Golden Bell Nightclub
chapters.content:

The words Connor said to Levin earlier had already made many people present dissatisfied.

She had just entered university, yet she was able to drive such a car. That meant her family background was definitely very good.
Levin couldn’t help but turn his head and look at Sabrina, his expression showing a hint of confusion, because he couldn’t understand why she would help Connor.

“Thank you,” he whispered.
“You’re welcome!” She looked at him with a faint smile, then started the car.
Connor looked at Sabrina, who was driving attentively, and his opinion of her underwent a significant change.
He felt that although she appeared cold, her heart was actually very kind. At least she was much better than Levin and the others.
After about half an hour, they finally arrived at the famous bar street in Porthampton.
This bar street was filled with numerous bars, nightclubs, karaoke lounge, and restaurants. Basically, any entertainment venue you could think of could be found in this area.

Upon witnessing this scene, Sabrina, who came in with Connor, showed a trace of displeasure in her eyes. After all, it was her first time in such a nightclub, and she seemed to dislike the environment.
However, she didn’t say much because she had come here today to celebrate Yara’s birthday.
“Mr. Levin, you actually came in person!”
The manager at the nightclub’s front desk seemed to recognize Levin and stepped forward with a smiling face to greet him.
“Mr. Trey, today is my girlfriend’s birthday. I want to book a private room. Is that possible?”

Other people would struggle to even book an ordinary private room here, yet Mr. Trey was giving Levin priorities. This made him feel quite happy inside.
So he didn’t waste any words and immediately shouted, “Alright, 1 won’t trouble you, Mr. Trey!”
“Hahaha!”
Seeing Levin’s readily agreed response, Mr. Trey couldn’t help but burst into laughter, then led Levin, Connor and the others towards the private room.
After a while, they arrived at the private room.

Only Connor sat quietly on the sofa, feeling somewhat out of place among these people.
Sadie, Sabrina, and the others were chatting on the side and naturally had no interest in interacting with Connor.

Shortly after the drinks arrived, everyone started singing and playing games.
Connor, on the other hand, felt as if he was being ignored by everyone, sitting alone in solitude.
However, they hadn’t played for long when the door to the private room was pushed open.
A beautiful woman wearing a tight black shirt walked into the private room with a smile..

Levin and the others instantly became upset, and coincidentally, the woman’s boyfriend came out of the restroom at that moment.
The two groups didn’t exchange many words before they started fighting directly. However, because Levin’s side had more people, they immediately pinned the guy to the ground and started beating him.
After a few minutes of beating, they realized that the man had lost the ability to resist, so they stopped their actions and returned to the private room.
“Kid, keep your eyes wide open from now on. In this world, there are many people you can’t mess with!”
Levin arrogantly shouted at the man lying on the ground, then turned his head and gave Connor a fierce glare, as if he was also threatening him qwith those words..

chapters.title: Chapter 503 - 503: Come With Us
chapters.content:
Chapter 503: Come With Us
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
After beating up the person, Levin proudly returned to the private room with several guys.
However, they may not have realized that this incident had caused a significant impact.
Back in the private room, they continued drinking and singing as if they didn’t care about what had happened.
But Connor faintly felt that this matter was not that simple.
“Levin, what should we do if that guy comes looking for us later?”
At this moment, one of the young men frowned and whispered to Levin.
“Yeah, after all, this is not our territory. It could be troublesome if they actually come looking for us!”
Another young man echoed.
After all, Levin and the others were not locals of Porthampton. Their connections were mostly in Rockford, not Porthampton.
If something really happened, even if these people had some connections, it probably wouldn’t be of much use!
“Maybe we should leave first. It could be troublesome if we get into trouble later!”
Sadie expressed her concerns and hesitated before speaking.
“Sadie, don’t worry. Levin’s dad knows a lot of people in Porthampton. Otherwise, the female CEO wouldn’t have personally come over to toast him. Don’t worry, nothing will happen!”
Yara, with a carefree expression, reassured them.
“Sadie, don’t worry. If something really happens, my dad can definitely handle it!”
Levin felt even more proud after being praised by Yara.
Originally, he had thought of leaving, but since the topic had come up, if he left now, it would be like all his previous showing off had been in vain. So he pretended to be calm and said to Sadie.
Meanwhile, Connor worried that they might actually encounter trouble later.
Moreover, this matter had nothing to do with him. To be on the safe side, he whispered to Sadie, “It’s getting late. Maybe we should leave first.”
In fact, the reason why he chose to leave was not because he was afraid of trouble.
After all, all he needed to do was to make a phone call to settle any matter.
After experiencing so many things, he had great confidence in Thomas and Kyle’s abilities, especially since this scene involved Kyle’s nephew.
However, Connor didn’t want to get involved in Levin and the others’ affairs, nor did he want to reveal his identity in front of Sadie. That was why he wanted to leave.
“What do you mean, kid?”
But as soon as he finished speaking, one of the young men stood up and pointed at Connor, shouting.
“You can leave if you want, but what do you mean by taking Sadie with you?” Yara also shouted.
“Heh…”
Levin looked at Connor and sneered, then said lightly, “Connor, if you’re too scared to stay, that’s fine. But if you want to take Sadie with you, it depends on her opinion, right?”
“That’s right, Sadie, do you want to go with him or stay with us?” Yara pouted and asked her.
Yara’s question clearly meant that she wanted Sadie to make a choice between them and Connor.
After hesitating for two seconds, she said softly, “Since none of you want to leave, of course, 1 can’t leave first.”
Obviously, Sadie still felt that these friends were more important than Connor.
After saying this, she turned to him and whispered, “Connor, if you want to leave, then you can leave first.”
When Yara heard this, her expression became very proud. She turned her head to look at Connor and said in disdain, What are you doing here? Yara told you to scram. Didn’t you hear her?”
She purposely used the word ‘scram’ as if she wanted to anger Connor.
When everyone heard this, they began to laugh, as if they were mocking him.
“Why are you still sitting here?”
Yara was already upset with him. Now, she could take this opportunity to humiliate him even more.
Sabrina turned to look at Sadie, as if she wanted her to say something to stop these people from laughing at Connor.
However, Sadie took a deep breath and kept quite.
She knew that if she spoke up for Connor now, it would be equivalent to offending Yara and Levin
In her eyes, they were obviously more important than Connor.
When he saw the look on her face, he knew that she had no intention of leaving with him at that moment.
So he took a deep breath and turned around to leave.
Originally, he intended to leave with Sadie, but since she didn’t want to go, he had no choice.
But just as he was about to get up and leave, the door of the private room was kicked open from the outside.
Dozens of burly men in black suits rushed into the room in a frenzy.
Upon seeing this scene, everyone stood up with expressions of shock and fear, not knowing what was happening.
“What… what do you want?”
Levin stammered when he saw these menacing men.
The black-clad men lined up and stared at him without speaking.
“Is it these people, Mr. Campbell?”
One of the burly men turned his head and asked the man standing behind him.
And when everyone saw this so-called Mr. Campbell, they understood what was going on.
Because he was none other than the person who had been beaten up by Levin and the others at the restroom entrance before.
Connor’s intuition was correct. This man’s identity was indeed extraordinary!
“Yes, it’s these guys!”
The battered man shouted with excitement, clutching his bruised face and raising his voice.
“Please come with us, gentlemen. Our boss wants to see you!”
The leading burly man waved his hand, and in an instant, dozens of burly men charged towards Levin and the others’ position.
The scene instantly descended into chaos, and everyone’s faces were filled with fear.
“What… What do you want? Do you know who 1 am? Are you all crazy?”
Levin was also filled with fear at this moment, trembling as he shouted at the burly men..

chapters.title: Chapter 504 - 504: Wilson Hayes!
chapters.content:
Chapter 504: Wilson Hayes!
Translator: End less Fantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
“Who are you?”
When the leading burly man heard Levin’s question, he couldn’t help but pause for a moment.
Then he signaled his subordinates beside him to release Levin.
After all, Porthampton was a huge city with many rich heirs, and there were indeed many rich heirs who frequented the Golden Bell Nightclub.
So the leading burly man was worried that Levin might have some powerful background. If they accidentally offended someone influential, it would be troublesome for him. Therefore, he decided to first clarify his identity before making any decisions.
“My father is Jamie Clover, the owner of Stellar Hotel. My dad knows Wilson Hayes, the owner of this nightclub!”
Levin hesitated for a moment and shouted in a low voice at the leading burly man.
“Jamie Clover?”
Upon hearing these words, the leading burly man was momentarily stunned. Then he said expressionlessly, “1 don’t know the person you’re talking about, and the order I received was to bring you people to meet my boss!”
Levin took a deep breath. He felt that this person was just a thug, so it was normal for him not to know his father.
So he directly said, “Alright, let’s go meet Mr. Wilson now, but can you release me and my friends first?”
“Sure, but you can’t run away!”
The leading thug furrowed his brow and said.
“This is your turf. Even if we run, you can find a way to catch us, right?” Sun Lei said expressionlessly.
“Hehe, I didn’t expect you to be quite sensible. Then come with us!”
The leading thug sneered and turned to leave.
Upon seeing the thugs leave the private room, the people inside became visibly nervous.
“What should we do now? Should we use our connections to get us out of this trouble?” Yara anxiously asked Levin.
“Don’t be afraid. My dad knows Wilson, and they have a good relationship. I don’t think he will do anything to us. Today, 1 want to see what he wants!” Levin said confidently, followed by addressing everyone, “Don’t be afraid. There are so many of us. Even he can’t do anything to us. Let’s go now!”
After saying this, he directly walked towards the exit of the private room, and everyone followed closely behind him.
Originally, Connor planned to take this opportunity to leave, but later he realized that Sadie was also following Levin and the others.
In case something happened to her, he didn’t want to explain to Candace.
So after hesitating for a moment, he also followed them out of the private room.
A moment later, Connor and the others entered an office.
The office was very large, even bigger than the private room they were in before.
The decoration inside was also very luxurious. Just by looking at the valuable paintings on the walls, one could tell their worth.
Inside the office, there was a genuine leather sofa, on which sat a man in his thirties. The man had some resemblance to Kyle, wearing a white suit and a gloomy expression. Connor could tell that this person should be Wilson, whom Levin and the others had mentioned.
But there were also several beautiful women sitting beside him. These women were top-notch in terms of their figures and looks, and they were quite young. They were dressed provocatively and were very alluring.
And behind the sofa stood a row of brawny men in black suits, looking very imposing.
In Wilson’s arms was a charming and beautiful young woman. The young woman nestled sweetly in his embrace, allowing his hands to caress her body.
Connor recognized her. She was the female manager who had served drinks to Levin before.
The manager had heavy makeup on her face, looking extremely enchanting. She had a great figure, and her extremely short shorts barely covered her round buttocks, revealing a pair of long and fair legs.
After seeing the scene in the office, Connor couldn’t help but smile faintly.
It had to be said that Wilson was living a more comfortable life than Kyle. Even Connor, who was Kyle’s boss, felt somewhat inferior.
But he didn’t rush to speak to Wilson because he wanted to see if Levin could handle the situation today.
If Levin could resolve it, Connor wouldn’t need to intervene, and he wouldn’t have to worry about exposing his identity.
“Mr. Wilson, hello!”
Levin walked up to Wilson and respectfully greeted him.
“Are you the one who hit Mr. Campbell?”
Wilson looked Levin up and down, expressionless, as he asked.
Levin was momentarily stunned upon hearing this question.
Then he turned his head and glanced at the young man beside Wilson, whispering, “Mr. Wilson, I did have a little conflict with this person before, but I didn’t know he’s your friend at that time…”
“The Golden Bell Nightclub won’t tolerate anyone who cause trouble. Regardless of whether Mr. Campbell is my friend or not, it is wrong for you to hit someone,” Wilson said calmly.
Upon hearing his words, the expressions on everyone’s faces became visibly tense.
After all, he was a powerful figure, while they were just ordinary people. Even if they had the courage, they wouldn’t dare to provoke him.
“Mr. Wilson, I am Jamie Clover’s son. Can you spare me for the sake of my father…” Levin tried to bring up his father, hoping to appeal to Wilson.
“Jamie?”
Upon hearing this name, Wilson sneered disdainfully. Then he said in a calm tone, “Are you talking about Jamie from Stellar Hotel?”
“Yes, yes!”
Levin hurriedly nodded.
Hearing this, Wilson chuckled coldly and looked at him, saying, “Who do you think Jamie is? Do you think I will let you go just because you’re his son?”
Upon hearing his words, everyone present was stunned in place, their expressions filled with extreme fear.
After all, they had placed all their hopes on Levin. They thought that since his family ran a hotel business and knew some influential people in Porthampton, Wilson wouldn’t dare to do anything to Levin.
But no one had expected that Wilson not only didn’t care about his father, Jamie, but also looked down on Jamie.
At this moment, Levin himself was dumbfounded. He looked at Wilson with a mix of awe and fear on his face, completely shocked.
Because he had never expected Wilson to react like this!

chapters.title: Chapter 505 - 505: The Three Girls Stay
chapters.content:
Chapter 505: The Three Girls Stay
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
“Mr. Campbell, how do you plan to handle this matter today?”
At this moment, Wilson turned his head and looked at Mr. Campbell behind him, smiling as he asked.
Upon hearing his words, Mr. Campbell couldn’t help but pause for a moment.
He then walked up to the man who had harassed his girlfriend earlier, lifted his leg, and delivered a fierce kick to the man’s stomach.
The man fell to the floor and his face showed extreme pain.
Instinctively, he looked towards Levin, seemingly hoping that Levin would help him plead for mercy.
However, Levin understood that his father meant nothing to Wilson.
He was currently in a vulnerable position himself, so how could he help this person plead?
Even if he did plead, there was no guarantee that Wilson would give him face!
So he could only stand helplessly on the side, not daring to say a word.
Mr. Campbell continued to rain punches and kicks on the man, relentlessly attacking for over ten minutes.
Finally, he stopped, panting heavily, and pointed at the man lying on the ground, cursing, “Weren’t you arrogant just now? Why aren’t you talking now?”
“I know I was wrong, please spare me. I really know 1 was wrong!”
With Levin no longer protecting him, the young man naturally didn’t dare to further offend Mr. Campbell who obviously had a powerful background.
So he could only cower on the ground, begging for mercy, hoping that Mr. Campbell would let him go.
“Let you go?”
After hearing this, Mr. Campbell couldn’t help but sneer and playfully said, “Heh, alright, if you want me to let you go, have your girlfriend spend the night with me. Then 1’11 let you go. What do you think?”
Upon hearing these words, the expression on the young woman’s face instantly turned panicked, and she couldn’t help but take two steps back.
As Yara had a good relationship with this girl, she looked up at Levin, hoping that he would speak up.
After all, everyone was well aware of what would happen if Mr. Campbell took the girl away.
Although Connor had the ability to stop Wilson and the others, his relationship with these people was not good.
Moreover, the girl had mocked him before, so he had no intention of intervening.
“Mr. Wilson, today’s matter is our fault. I apologize to you, but it has nothing to do with this girl.” Levin hesitated for two seconds and finally mustered the courage to step forward and say in a low voice.
After hearing these words, Wilson glanced at him indifferently, then said expressionlessly, “I’ve met your father a few times, and I won’t trouble you today. You can take your people and leave!”
“Thank you, Mr. Wilson!” Levin was overjoyed upon hearing this and quickly shouted to the people behind him, “Let’s go!”
The others were also pleasantly surprised by his words, and their expressions were filled with joy. Everyone started walking away.
“Wait!”
But at that moment, Wilson suddenly shouted.
They paused and turned to look at him, their expressions filled with confusion.
“Everyone else can leave, but those two must stay!” He pointed at the young man who had been beaten and the girl next to him.
It was obvious that Wilson still had no intention of letting the two of them go.
Levin knew very well that if he left now, he would definitely become a joke in the eyes of others. No one would dare to be friends with him i in the future.
“Mr. Wilson, what are you doing?” Levin’s eyes flashed with helplessness.
Yara rushed to Wilson and shouted, “Who are you? Why should the two of them stay just because you say so!”
After Levin heard Yara’s words, his expression immediately broke down.
He never expected her to speak to Wilson like that.
One had to know that her current behavior was no different from courting death!
When Wilson heard her words, he couldn’t help but laugh out loud.
The rest of the thugs also laughed.
“You’re asking who 1 am?” Wilson smiled and asked her.
“That’s right, even if you’re the owner of this nightclub, you don’t have the right to keep them!” Yara shouted loudly.
“Alright, today I’ll let you see whether 1 have the right to keep them!” Wilson shouted, then directly said, “1 originally intended to keep these two, and the rest of you could go, but since it’s like this, none of you can leave, all of you stay!”
Upon hearing these words, the expressions on the faces of the crowd became even more fearful.
Levin seemed to realize that something was amiss and quickly walked up to Wilson, stuttering as he spoke, “Mr. Wilson, this is my girlfriend. She hasn’t seen much of the world and doesn’t know any better. Please don’t lower yourself to her level. Just consider it as giving my father face!”
“Smack!”
Wilson backhandedly slapped Levin across the face, glaring at him and shouting, “Who do you think your father is? Go back and ask him if he dares to speak to me like that!”
Levin stood in place, holding his face, not knowing what to do for a moment.
“The three of you girls, stay with me, the rest of you get lost immediately, or else no one can leave!” Wilson shouted expressionlessly.
The three girls mentioned were none other than Sadie, Sabrina, and Yara.
In fact, Wilson had already taken a liking to these three girls from the moment they entered the office.
Now he had the perfect excuse to keep them.
After hearing his words, the expressions on the faces of the crowd were visibly shaken. After all, they didn’t want to offend him over such a small matter.
“Then let’s leave first!”
Just at that moment, a girl anxiously said to her boyfriend.
Although loyalty was important, at this moment, it was not about loyalty anymore.
Wilson turned his head and glanced at the thugs by his side. They immediately understood his meaning and walked towards the three girls..

chapters.title: Chapter 506 - 506: I’m Someone You Can’t Afford to Offend!
chapters.content:
Chapter 506: I’m Someone You Can’t Afford to Offend!
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
When everyone saw this scene, their eyes widened in shock.
Initially, they thought that Wilson only wanted to keep the young man who had a conflict with Mr. Campbell and his girlfriend behind, then this matter would be over.
However, no one expected Yara’s words to anger Wilson. At this moment, not only did Wilson want the young man to stay, but he also wanted Yara, Sadie, and Sabrina to stay.
Everyone knew very well what they were staying for.
A few strong men in black suits walked aggressively toward Sadie and the others.
Levin’s friends no longer cared about brotherhood at this point. They turned around and ran out of the office.
In the blink of an eye, only Connor, Levin, Sadie, and Yara were left in the office.
The reason why Connor didn’t leave was simple: it was because this matter already involved Sadie.
Connor couldn’t leave her here alone, otherwise he wouldn’t be able to explain himself to Candace.
Sadie turned her head and looked at Connor beside her, feeling a little surprised because Levin’s friends had already left, but Connor was still here. This was something Sadie didn’t expect.
However, Sadie knew that even if Connor stayed here, he wouldn’t be able to solve any problems.
However, she did not feel afraid because of this, because her father worked in an organization and more or less had some connections. Even though Wilson had a lot of connections, he wouldn’t dare to go against the people from the government.
Therefore, Sadie knew that she wouldn’t be in any danger today. As for whether Sabrina, Yara, and the others could leave this place safely, she wasn’t sure.
Sabrina’s expression was very calm, as if she was not too afraid. Only Yara was scared silly. She hid behind Levin and didn’t even dare to breathe loudly.
Levin was no longer as arrogant as before as he kept apologizing to Wilson.
However, Wilson didn’t even look at Levin. After all, in Wilson’s eyes, even if Jamie Clover was the one pleading for mercy, Wilson might not give him face.
Wilson was Kyle Hayes’s nephew. He had followed Kyle for many years and was quite well known.
Although he wasn’t as scary as Kyle was, most people in Porthampton City respected him.
At this moment, the black-robed man had already walked up to Sadie and the others. He reached out his hand and wanted to grab Sadie.
Sadie was about to say her father’s name, but just as she was about to speak, a hand suddenly stopped her.
This person was none other than Connor.
When everyone saw Connor stand out, their eyes widened. They looked at this scene in a daze, and their expressions were extremely shocked. They did not expect that Connor would actually stand up at this time!
“Connor…”
Sadie frowned at Connor, but he didn’t pay attention to Sadie at all. Instead, he walked up to Wilson and said calmly, “These mo girls are my friends. Give me some face and let them go now!”
Because Connor didn’t want to expose his identity in front of Sadie, he said this very tactfully!
“Connor, are you crazy? What nonsense are you talking about?”
After Sadie heard Connor’s words, she instantly broke out in a cold sweat. She quickly reached out and pulled Connor back, frowning and scolding him in a low voice.
After all, Sadie had yet to realize how scary Wilson was. She felt that as long as she said her father’s name and apologized properly, this matter would probably be over.
But now that Connor suddenly stood up and said such a sentence, this matter might become very troublesome.
Wilson also noticed Connor, who had never spoken a word.
Wilson looked at Connor from head to toe and said in a disdainful tone, “Who do you think you are? Why should I give you face?”
At this moment, Wilson was actually very angry in his heart. After all, Levin and the others were the ones who’d started this incident.
Moreover, Yara’s words had made Wilson very unhappy. Now that Connor had stepped forward, Wilson was even angrier.
“Who am I?” Connor looked at Wilson and was stunned for a moment. Then, he said coldly, “I’m someone you can never afford to offend!”
After Connor said this, everyone present was dumbfounded. Their mouths were wide open, and they felt that everything was too unbelievable. No one expected Connor to actually have the guts to say such a sentence.
The way everyone looked at Connor at this moment was as if they were looking at a madman.
“Connor, what nonsense are you talking about? Do you know that your words might kill all of us!”
Levin stood behind Connor and shouted at him excitedly.
At this moment, Levin was fully prepared to die. If he knew that Connor would be so brainless and say such words, he would never have brought Connor here!
Originally, it was just a small conflict, but now that Connor had caused such a ruckus, things might be different.
“You said that you are someone I can’t afford to offend?” Wilson looked at Connor and smiled. Then, his eyes flashed with ruthlessness. He squinted and said coldly, “I’ve never seen anyone in Porthampton that 1 can’t afford to offend!”
“Then you’ve already seen it!” Connor replied to Wilson lightly.
“Hahaha!”
When Wilson heard this, he laughed maniacally. He pointed at Connor and shouted, “Alright, kid. Today, I’ll let you see if you and 1 can afford to offend you!”
“It’s over. This matter has blown up today!”
After hearing Wilson’s words, Sadie’s eyes flashed with fear.
She knew very clearly that Connor’s words had completely angered Wilson!
“What is this Connor thinking? He was still trying to show off at a time like this! Even someone like Levin didn’t dare to offend Wilson, so what right did Connor have to offend him?”
Sadie couldn’t understand what Connor was thinking.
At this moment, Wilson pointed at Connor’s position and ordered his men.
“Cripple this kid!”

chapters.title: Chapter 507 - 507: You Know Kyle Hayes?
chapters.content:
Chapter 507: You Know Kyle Hayes?
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
“Okay, thank you!”
When the thugs heard this, they hurriedly agreed and then walked towards Connor’s position.
These thugs were all tall and strong, and their faces were extremely fierce. Their bulging muscles almost tore through their suits.
They walked in front of Connor aggressively, as if they really wanted to kill Connor.
Sabrina seemed to have never seen such a scene before. There was a flash of panic in her eyes. She asked Sadie nervously, “Sadie, what do we do? Hurry up and think of something!”
“What can I do? Connor was practically asking to die! I originally thought that as long as I told Wilson about my father’s identity, Wilson would let us off for my father’s sake. But Connor had to provoke Wilson… He doesn’t have any background, so how could Wilson let he off so easily?”
Sadie stood there and replied helplessly.
When Sabrina heard Sadie’s words, she started to hesitate. She bit her lips tightly as if she was about to say something, but she didn’t know if she should say it.
At this moment, those thugs had already walked in front of Connor.
One of the brawny men sneered at Connor and said indifferently, “Brat, since you want to die so badly today, we’ll fulfill your wish!”
Connor looked up at the thug and said to Wilson calmly, “Before your underlings make a move, 1 have a request!”
“Request?”
Wilson looked at Connor and asked in confusion, “Do you have any requests? Tell me about it…”
“Let my friend leave. The two of us will settle the rest!”
Connor said calmly.
“Let your friend leave?”
Wilson sneered disdainfully and said in a mocking tone, “Who do you think you are? Why should I listen to you?”
When Connor saw that Wilson didn’t agree to his request, the expression on his face became awkward.
If he called Kyle Hayes in front of Sadie, his identity would be exposed.
So after Connor considered for a moment, he chose to walk towards Wilson’s position.
“What are you doing?”
One of the brawny men reached out his hand to stop Connor and shouted fiercely at him.
“Don’t worry, I won’t do anything. I just have something to say to him!”
Connor replied helplessly.
“Let him come over!”
Wilson felt that Connor was just an ordinary student. With so many underlings protecting him, Connor probably wouldn’t do anything to him, so he shouted at Connor with confidence.
Hearing Wilson’s words, the burly man hesitated for a moment and slowly let go of Connor’s right hand.
Connor directly walked towards Wilson, while Sadie, Sabrina and the others looked at Connor with puzzled expressions. At this moment, they didn’t know what Connor was going to do.
“What the hell is this Connor doing? Could it be that he really wants to kill all of us before he’ll be happy?”
Levin looked at Connor and shouted with a broken expression.
Sadie turned her head and looked at Levin with disdain.
Although Connor’s actions were very reckless in her eyes, no matter what, his actions today were indeed more responsible than Levin’s.
At the very least, Connor would stand up for them while Levin was thinking about how he could leave this place!
When comparing the two, Sadie felt that Connor was more responsible than Levin today.
On the other side, Connor walked to Wilson’s side and whispered something into his ear.
When Wilson heard Connor’s words, he raised his head and looked at Connor with a strange look in his eyes.
“Is what you said true?”
Wilson whispered to Connor.
“If you don’t want to make a big deal out of this matter, you can let my friend go now. I’ll stay and the two of us will settle the rest!”
Connor calmly replied to Wilson.
Wilson stood there and hesitated for two seconds. Then, he said to his subordinate, “Release these people!”
“Alright, President Hayes!”
The leader nodded hurriedly.
When Sadie, Yara, Levin, and the others heard Wilson’s words, they were all stunned on the spot. Their faces were full of confusion; no one expected that Wilson would let them off because of Connor’s words.
When Levin, Yara, and the young man who had offended Mr. Campbell heard Wilson’s words, they immediately felt relieved.
Without any hesitation, they turned around and ran out of the office.
Meanwhile, Sadie and Sabrina stood there in confusion. They couldn’t understand how Connor did it!
“What are you two still standing there for? President Hayes told you two to leave, didn’t you hear?”
When the leader saw that Sadie and Sabrina did not seem to have any intention of leaving, he hurriedly shouted at them.
“Connor, you…”
Sabrina could not help but shout at Connor.
“You two go first. I’ll take care of the rest!” Connor turned to look at Sabrina and said calmly.
“But…”
Sabrina looked at Connor and wanted to say something.
“You guys can leave. I’ll be fine!”
Connor interrupted Sabrina.
When Sabrina saw how determined Connor was, she could not help but turn to look at Sadie who was behind her.
“Connor, will you really be fine?”
Sadie frowned and asked Connor.
“Of course!”
Connor nodded expressionlessly.
“Alright, Sadie, let’s go outside and wait for him!”
Sadie could feel that Connor was not joking, so she thought for a moment and prepared to leave.
Sadie’s current thoughts were very simple. After she left, she could contact Tony immediately.
If Connor really encountered any danger, he could call Tony and ask him to come over and help.
Sabrina looked at Connor worriedly. After hesitating for two seconds, she turned around and left the office with Sadie.
After the two girls left, Wilson pushed the beautiful young woman in his arms away and walked to Connor. He carefully sized up Connor and asked calmly, “Just now, you said that you know Kyle Hayes. Is this true?”
“When Kyle Hayes sees me, he has to call me Mr. McDonald!” Connor replied to Wilson expressionlessly.
What Connor said to Wilson just now was actually just a simple sentence implying that he knew Kyle Hayes!

chapters.title: Chapter 508 - 508:I Just Wanted to Hit You
chapters.content:
Chapter 508:I Just Wanted to Hit You
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
After Wilson heard Connor’s words, his face revealed a trace of surprise.
He frowned and asked Connor, “Brat, do you know what consequences your words will bring you?”
“Then do you know what the consequences of saying this to me will be?”
Connor replied calmly.
“You!”
Wilson opened his mouth and was about to speak when
“Smack!”
However, before Wilson could finish his sentence, Connor did something unexpected.
He raised his right hand and slapped Wilson’s face!
“How dare you hit President Hayes!”
“Brat, you’re asking for death!”
When the strong men in the office saw Connor slap Wilson, their expressions suddenly became angry.
After all, there were so many thugs watching. Who would have thought that Connor would dare to hit someone directly? And it was a big shot like Wilson, no less!
Even the beautiful young woman sitting on the sofa couldn’t help but reveal a shocked expression when she saw this scene. She covered her mouth with her small hand, and her eyes widened in shock.
Although she hadn’t been by Wilson’s side for a long time and had only become his mistress for the past six months, she was still very familiar with Wilson’s character and temper.
The last time, someone had said something bad about Wilson, and he was almost beaten to death by his men.
At this moment, Connor had actually slapped Wilson. This beautiful young woman didn’t even dare to imagine how miserable a state Connor would end up.
Wilson’s men were shocked for a moment before they rushed towards Connor.
“I advise you to keep your subordinates away from me, or you will regret it!”
Connor shouted at Wilson expressionlessly when he saw the burly men rushing over.
“Don’t move!”
Wilson felt that something was wrong and quickly shouted. He wasn’t a fool; He felt that Connor should be very clear about his current situation, and yet Connor still dared to hit him. Previously, Lily and May had humiliated Connor many times. However, when Lily faced Connor now, it was as if she had changed into a different person. It was as if she was very afraid of Connor.
“Is there something going on between Lily and Connor?” Spencer wondered aloud with a frown.
“I don’t know, but 1 feel Connor has been acting strange for some time. Moreover, Mandy didn’t come to class today, and Brandon dropped out. 1 think these things should have something to do with Connor!” Dominic analyzed in a low voice.
“What does this have to do with Connor? Does Connor have the ability to make Brandon drop out of school?” Spencer pouted and said.
“I’m not sure either, but 1 feel something is wrong!” Dominic said lightly.
Spencer looked up at Dominic and opened his mouth but did not say anything because he, too, felt something was wrong.
***
Meanwhile, they went straight to an empty corner after Lily and Connor left the classroom.
“What’s up?” Connor asked Lily softly.
“Connor, did Mandy try to borrow money from you?” Lily hesitated and asked Connor in a low voice.
“Yes, but 1 didn’t lend any to her!” Connor replied.
“Why didn’t you lend it to her? She’s already at her wit’s end. What else do you want her to do? Do you really want to see her killed by those people in the casino? Do you know that Mandy already has suicidal thoughts?” Lily shouted at Connor excitedly.
“I’ll handle her matters. You don’t have to worry about it!”
After hearing that Mandy would commit suicide, Connor was still very calm.
“I don’t have to worry about it?”
Lily was stunned, then shouted at Connor, “If this has nothing to do with me, then I definitely wouldn’t care. However, you were the one who threatened me back then and asked me to bring Mandy to the casino. If you hadn’t forced me to bring her to the casino, she wouldn’t have owed so much money to others, and today’s incident wouldn’t have happened!”
“…” Connor looked at Lily without saying anything.
“You caused all of this. If Mandy really committed suicide, then I am your accomplice, so I beg you to help her. This bit of money should be nothing to you!” Lily said to Connor anxiously.
“I told you, you don’t have to worry about this!” Connor replied to Lily coldly, then turned around and walked away..

chapters.title: Chapter 514 - 514: Confessing To Rachel Wallace
chapters.content:
Chapter 514: Confessing To Rachel Wallace
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
“Connor!” Seeing that Connor was about to leave, and hurriedly shouted.
Connor did not even look at Lily and walked straight ahead.
After Mandy took ten million from Connor, Connor threatened Lily and asked her to bring Mandy to Harlem’s Gold.
Connor knew Mandy very well. Once Mandy entered the casino, she would fall into it and could not extricate herself!
Therefore, Mandy was now in debt to loan sharks. This was also something that Connor had expected.
Of course, Connor did not expect Mandy to owe so much money in one go!
As for how to solve this next, it was very simple, so Connor was not in a hurry to deal with Mandy’s matter.
After parting ways with Lily, Connor returned to the classroom and found Dominic and Spencer waiting for him.
“Connor, what did Lily want?” Dominic asked Connor curiously.
“Nothing much. She just told me about Mandy!” Connor replied indifferently.
“About Mandy?”
They were stunned and puzzled when Dominic and Spencer heard Connor’s words.
“Yeah, Mandy seems to have owed someone money during the summer vacation. Lily came to borrow money from me!”
Connor raised his head and glanced at Dominic before continuing, “But you all know my financial situation. 1 can’t take out that much money at all, so I rejected it…”
“Mandy owes someone money? What did she do? Why would she owe someone money?”
When Dominic heard Connor’s answer, his expression was one of disbelief.
Although Mandy was usually very vain in class, Dominic felt that Mandy was not the kind of person who would borrow money from others. On the contrary, Mandy was very beautiful. There must be many people who were willing to spend money on Mandy.
“I heard from Lily that Mandy seemed to have lost money because of gambling!” Connor explained expressionlessly, then continued, “Forget it. It’s been a long time since Mandy broke up with me. Her problem has nothing to do with me. Let’s go now. Otherwise, there might be no seats later!”
“Alright!” Dominic and Spencer didn’t doubt Connor’s explanation. After all, they also felt that Lily didn’t look for Connor because of them.
Connor’s explanation was also very reasonable!
The three packed their things and left the classroom.
Not long after, Connor, Dominic, and Spencer arrived at the newly opened hotpot restaurant at the school gate.
Perhaps it was because today was the first day of school, the business of the hotpot restaurant was very good. It was full.
When Connor, Spencer, and Dominic arrived at the hotpot restaurant, they realized there were no more seats!
“There are no more seats. I told you we should have come earlier!” Dominic looked at the bustling crowd in the hotpot restaurant and said helplessly.
“Why don’t we eat at another restaurant? There are so many hotpot restaurants in Northampton, so we don’t have to eat here!” Connor hesitated for a moment before softly suggesting.
In fact, Connor wanted to treat Dominic and Spencer to a big meal, but they had no choice but to come to the hot pot restaurant at the school gate to save money for Connor.
Connor could not find a reason to reject these two people, so he reluctantly agreed.
The hotpot restaurant was already full. Connor could take this opportunity to bring Dominic and Spencer to a better restaurant for dinner. After all, the cost of a meal was nothing to Connor.
“But this hotpot restaurant has just opened, and the drinks are free!” Dominic whispered to Connor.
Dominic knew Connor’s financial situation very well. He didn’t want Connor to spend too much money to treat them to a meal. After all, Connor’s money was his.
“It’s okay. 1 earned some money this summer. A few hundred dollars mean nothing!” Connor replied with a smile and then took the lead to walk out of the hotpot restaurant.
After Dominic and Spencer saw that Connor didn’t seem to care, they didn’t say anything more and followed Connor out of the hotpot restaurant.
“Connor, where were you working during the summer vacation? Is it still at the same bar?” Dominic had just heard that Connor had earned quite a sum from his summer job, so he asked curiously.
“No, 1 went to the showroom to sell houses during the summer vacation. The basic salary there is relatively high, and I can get a commission from selling the houses, so 1 earned more than 20, ooo dollars this summer vacation,” Connor said to Dominic with a smile.
“More than 20, ooo dollars?” When Dominic and Spencer heard this amount, they both were in disbelief.
The two did not expect Connor to be able to earn so much money in just two months.
“Is selling houses so profitable now? 1’11 sell houses after 1 graduate!” Dominic said excitedly to Connor.
“Actually, it’s not that easy to earn money. I’m just lucky. I happened to meet some rich people, so 1 got a lot of commission!” Connor said helplessly.
Connor said it casually because he worried Dominic and Spencer would take his words seriously and enter real estate. Wouldn’t that harm them?
“I see. 1 guess 1 won’t. I’m not that lucky!” Dominic frowned and replied to Connor as if he had already dispelled the idea of selling the house.
“Look, why are there so many people over there!”
Spencer suddenly pointed at a restaurant beside the school and shouted puzzledly.
When Connor and Dominic heard this, they turned to look at the restaurant. They found that the restaurant’s entrance was full of people, as if something had happened inside.
“Let’s go over and take a look. Is there a fight?” Dominic had always liked to gossip. He naturally wouldn’t miss such a good opportunity, so he took the lead and ran toward the restaurant.
Connor and Spencer had no choice but to follow.
When Connor, Dominic, and Spencer ran to the restaurant entrance, Dominic grabbed a classmate he knew and asked, puzzled, “Harris, what’s going on?”
“I don’t know either. Someone is confessing to our school’s goddess, Ms. Wallace!” Harris replied in a low voice.
When Connor, Dominic, and Spencer heard Harris’ words, they were surprised!

chapters.title: Chapter 515 - 515: What A Waste Of Resources!
chapters.content:
Chapter 515: What A Waste Of Resources!
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Be it her figure or appearance, Rachel was the best of the best.
Even compared to Victoria’s Secret supermodels, she was not inferior!
Many people pursued Rachel at the university.
Connor, Dominic, and the others had seen this situation several times before.
However, there was no exception. No matter how outstanding a boy was, Rachel would reject him mercilessly in the end.
It was not strange for someone to confess to Rachel, but it was the first time such a huge commotion had occurred.
“So it’s just someone confessing to Ms. Wallace? What’s there to make a fuss about? Let’s go eat quickly!” Spencer knew that Rachel would reject him after seeing someone confess to her.
He was not very interested in this confession because he had seen such a scene many times. He dragged Connor and Dominic away.
“This confession is different from the usual ones…”
But at this moment, Dominic’s friend, Harris, spoke.
“How is it different?” Dominic asked Harris excitedly.
“This time, the person confessing to Ms. Wallace is not a man, but a woman!” Harris said mysteriously.
“A woman?” Upon hearing Harris’s words, Dominic and Spencer gaped, their faces filled with shock.
No one expected the person who confessed to Rachel this time would be a woman.
“Harris, are you kidding me? The person who confessed to Ms. Wallace is a woman?” Dominic asked Harris in disbelief.
“Of course it’s true. I just received the news that a beautiful woman is confessing to Ms. Wallace in the restaurant. They are all here to see what this woman looked like!” Harris pointed at the people outside the restaurant and said with certainty.
“F*ck, I didn’t expect Ms. Wallace to have such a great charm. Not only did she catch all the men, but she also got the women too!” Dominic sighed emotionally, then turned to Connor and Spencer and said, “What are you two still standing there for? Hurry up and follow me to see what kind of woman dares to confess to Ms. Wallace…”
“Bro, there are so many people outside. Let’s not go in!” Spencer said helplessly to Dominic.
“Why not? Aren’t the two of you curious?” Dominic replied with a gossipy look on his face. Then, he pulled Connor and wanted to squeeze into the dining area.
Connor had no choice but to follow Dominic into the restaurant.
As the restaurant was already full, Dominic, Connor, and Spencer spent a lot of effort to squeeze into the restaurant.
After squeezing into the restaurant, everyone finally saw Rachel and the woman who confessed to her.
When Connor and the others saw the woman who confessed to Rachel, they were all dumbfounded.
The woman confessing to Rachel was indeed very beautiful. Even compared to a sexy woman like Rachel, she was not inferior.
The woman had a head full of brown wavy curls, wearing a tight T-shirt that accentuated her beautiful curves. Her chest was full, giving her a alluring feeling. Her slender waist was seductive. She wore a red miniskirt and was tall and sexy. Under the miniskirt, beautiful legs were unreservedly exposed. On her feet was a pair of high heels. Her entire being looked so seductive.
Looking at the sexy and seductive beauty, the men in the restaurant could not take their eyes off her.
A woman like this could make one’s imagination run wild just by looking at her. She was the kind of woman any man would want to take to bed as soon as one saw her.
However, this woman was confessing to Rachel, which meant that this woman was gay!
One had to know that there were tens of millions of male bachelors in Oprana!
Such a beautiful woman being gay was a waste of resources.
“Harris, are you sure this woman is confessing to Ms. Wallace?” Connor turned to look at Harris and asked helplessly.
“It seems so!” Harris seemed to be a little puzzled as he replied helplessly.
“That’s impossible. How can such a beautiful woman be gay?” Dominic couldn’t help but frown and mutter.
But at this moment, the woman finally spoke. “Rachel, do you know how hard it has been for me to find you during this period?”
The woman’s words instantly made the entire restaurant restless.
Her words could prove that she was indeed confessing to Rachel.
“Madison, I’ve told you many times. I don’t like you and can’t be with you!”
Rachel sounded very helpless as she rejected the woman before her.
Connor heard this and observed that the woman who confessed to Rachel was called Madison.
Moreover, looking at her age, Madison should be about the same age as Rachel and older than Connor and the others.
“Rachel, why can’t you be with me?” Madison’s beautiful eyes were completely wet. She looked at Rachel without moving.
Her delicate and pitiful appearance, charming face, snow-white skin, and slender and fair legs were unforgettable.
At this moment, countless men had fallen in love with Madison. No man could resist the charm of a beautiful woman like Madison.
She also could make any man go crazy over her!
However, who would have thought that such a beautiful woman was gay? Moreover, she was confessing to the goddess of Porthampton University, Rachel Wallace!
If these two women were together, who knew how many guys at Porthampton University would have sleepless nights!
Madison was a native of Porthampton. Last month, she met Rachel in Dusk and fell in love with her.
During the last summer vacation, she fiercely pursued Rachel, but Rachel had never agreed to be with Madison.
This was also why Rachel was a bit absent-minded today. It was because she had been a little distracted by Madison recently.
Connor narrowed his eyes as he looked at Rachel. He was also filled with interest.
After all, Rachel had always been a queen-like woman and had even teased him before.
But at this time, Connor noticed that cold sweat had already begun to appear on Rachel’s forehead.
Knowing Rachel for three years, Connor had never seen Rachel so nervous!

chapters.content:

Although Madison was a lesbian, she was still quite famous in Porthampton.

However, because of her sexual orientation, Madison had never been in a relationship.
Logically speaking, when the rich guys of Porthampton found out that Madison was a lesbian, they would have given up on her.
However, it was not the case because men had a desire to conquer.
If they could conquer a lesbian like Madison and make her lie in their bed willingly, it would definitely be more exciting than conquering an ordinary woman.
Rachel seemed to have never met such a suitor. If it was an ordinary man, she would have left long ago.

Madison didn’t seem to give up in the face of Rachel’s rejection. Instead, she chased after her relentlessly.
Madison’s beautiful eyes stared at Rachel, waiting for her answer.

Originally, Rachel planned to make things clear to Madison today so that she would not pester her in the future.
However, she did not expect Madison to confess to her again. Moreover, it had caused such a huge commotion. She did not know how to end it now.
“Phew!”
Rachel took a deep breath and tried her best to adjust her emotions. Then, she said indifferently, “Madison, I’ve already told you many times. It’s impossible for us to be together!”
“Why?”
Madison shouted.
“Because I’m a normal woman. I like men. I won’t be with a woman. Do you understand what 1 mean?”
Rachel’s words were very direct. Previously, she had always been worried about Madison’s feelings, so she had never spoken ill of her.
But this time, she felt that she could no longer remain calm.
She hoped that Madison would give up the idea of being with her after this.
“I know you like men, but there’s a possibility that things might change!”
But what Rachel never expected was that Madison still had no intention of giving up.
“You…”
Rachel looked at Madison and was instantly speechless. For a moment, she didn’t know what to say.
“Rachel, I know you like men, but you don’t have a boyfriend now. You can try dating me.”
Madison looked at Rachel with a pitiful expression which made anyone who saw her want to coddle her.
If the person standing in front of Madison wasn’t Rachel but a normal man, someone would agree without hesitation if he were asked to die, let alone agree to be with Madison.
“I’m really different from you. I can’t do this!”
Rachel frowned and replied.
“Anyway, you don’t have a boyfriend now, nor do you have a man you like. Why can’t you be with me?”
Madison shouted with her big watery eyes.
Connor, who was standing not far away, was watching the commotion with relish. This was the first time seeing the cold and elegant Rachel with such an embarrassed look.
Connor knew so many women, and each of them was an existence that would stir up hundreds and thousands of hearts. However, there were only three women that left the deepest impression on Connor!
The first one was Rachel, whom he had known for the longest time. From the first time Connor saw her, he felt that she was more than meets the eye She had an indescribable charm. Even Connor, who had inherited the inheritance, was still very afraid of her.
The second was Connor’s favorite, Freya Phillips.
The third was the beautiful internet celebrity Yelena Allen, who had always given him a headache.
Connor felt that Yelena was special because he could never guess what was going on in her mind. The things that she did had always made Connor feel confused.
“Who told you that I don’t have a man I like?”
Rachel made up an excuse in order to make Madison give up.
“You already have a man you like?”
Madison’s expression changed when she heard Rachel’s words. She asked nervously, “Who is the man you like?”
“This doesn’t have anything to do with you!”
Rachel said coldly.
Madison’s eyes flashed with a trace of doubt. She took two steps forward and stared at Rachel with her bright eyes for two seconds. Then, she said softly, “Rachel, you must be lying to me. I had someone investigate you. You don’t have a boyfriend, nor do you have anyone you like. Many people have confessed to you, but you rejected them all!”
“I really have someone i like. Don’t bother me anymore!”
Rachel replied helplessly before turning around to leave.
However, Madison directly reached out and grabbed Rachel. She widened her bright eyes and shouted, “Rachel, if you want me to stop harassing you, that’s fine, but you have to tell me who the person you like is! If you can say his name today, I’ll leave immediately. But if you can’t, then you have to promise to be with me!”
It was obvious that the current Madison was planning to force herself on Rachel.
When Rachel heard Madison’s words, she was exasperated.
After all, she really didn’t have anyone she liked right now. She was just lying to Madison.
“Rachel, say something. Don’t you already have someone you like? Tell me now who the person you like is!”
Madison asked Rachel.
Rachel frowned. She swept her gaze over the people who were watching the show. Finally, her gaze landed on Connor.. She bit her lips and said in a low voice, “The person i like is him!”

“Miss, what does it have to do with you whether I have the right to be with Miss Wallace or not?”
Connor walked up to Madison and said coldly..

Initially, Madison’s confession to Rachel had nothing to do with Connor.

chapters.title: Chapter 520 - 520: I’m Not a Lesbian

Chapter 520: I’m Not a Lesbian
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
This was Madison’s first kiss.

She didn’t even have the chance to experience what it felt like to kiss before she bit Connor’s lips!
“All!”
Connor screamed and instantly came to his senses. He hurriedly took two steps back and looked at the disheveled Madison in front of him.
“What am 1 doing!”
Connor shook his head and sighed helplessly.
Perhaps it was because he had sex with Chloe Lawson not long ago, so he always had a desire in his heart, and it was this desire that caused him to lose control of his body just now.
“Alih…”
When Connor let go of her, she squatted on the ground and cried loudly.
She had never been treated like this before. Moreover, she was pressed onto the table by a man and forced to kiss him!
“Miss Phillips, I’m really sorry for what happened just now. I lost control…”
Connor hurriedly said to Madison.
“Get lost, you’re a stinky hooligan. A person like you doesn’t deserve to be with Rachel. Get lost!”
