“I’m sorry. It was my fault just now. However, Miss Phillips, you’re really attractive…”
Connor hurriedly picked up a tissue and handed it to her, apologizing sincerely.
“Get lost!”
Madison reached out and knocked away the tissue that Connor handed over.
Connor stood there and hesitated for a couple of seconds. He couldn’t help but sigh and then turned around to leave.
“Stop right there!”
But Madison suddenly shouted again.
Connor was stunned for a moment, then turned to look at her.
“What is your relationship with Rachel?”
Madison wiped the tears from the corner of her eyes and asked Connor.
“Miss Phillips, actually, Miss Wallace doesn’t like me at all. I’m just a poor loser. 1 don’t have money or the looks. Miss Wallace is so good-looking and is the goddess of our school. Why would she like me? The reason why she said that today was just to reject you!”
Seeing that Madison was in such a state, he naturally couldn’t bear to continue lying to her, so he could only tell her the truth.
Madison looked at Connor and was stunned for a moment. Then, she asked in an excited tone, “Is what you said true?”
“Of course, it’s true. I don’t have to lie to you!”
Connor replied indifferently.
When Madison heard Connor’s words, her mood instantly improved. She pursed her lips and said to Connor, “I knew it. How could Rachel fall in love with a boy like you…”
Connor looked at her with a hint of helplessness in his eyes, but he thought of what he had done to Madison just now, so he didn’t refute her.
“Miss Phillips, it was indeed my fault just now…”
Connor looked at Madison as if he wanted to explain.
“You don’t have to explain anything to me. I know what you men are like, but I hope that no third person will find out what happened just now. Do you understand what 1 mean?”
Madison’s mood had obviously eased a lot as she whispered to Connor.
“Yes!”
Connor hurriedly replied.
After all, Connor wasn’t a fool. If what happened just now was exposed, it wouldn’t do him any good. He definitely didn’t want others to know about this. “Then, you can leave!”
Madison didn’t seem to want to pursue this any further. She waved her hand at Connor, indicating that he could leave now.
When Connor reached the door, he suddenly stopped and turned to look at Madison, who was standing in the private room with a flirtatious look. He asked with a puzzled tone, “Miss Phillips, there’s actually something I can’t figure out…”
“What is it?”
Madison replied softly.
“A girl like you is not only very beautiful, but also very rich. You must have a lot of suitors around you. Why don’t you like boys but like women instead?”
Connor really couldn’t understand why a girl like Madison would like women. If it was a girl who couldn’t find a boyfriend, Connor might be able to accept it.
But Madison didn’t seem like the kind of girl who couldn’t find a boyfriend!
“What’s so good about men?”
Madison looked at Connor and smiled, then continued, “Actually, I’m not a lesbian. I just hate men. Back then, my father abandoned my mother and me. I’ve been living by my grandfather’s side. My surname wasn’t Phillips, but because my father ran away with another woman, I took on the same surname as my mother!”
“So, this was triggered by your father?”
Connor frowned and asked.
“Maybe!”
Madison sighed helplessly, then looked at Connor and continued, “After my father left my mother, my mother had been instilling in me the idea that men are not good. I grew up in such an environment, so i have been very resistant to men since I was young. I don’t like men either. No matter how outstanding my pursuers are, I won’t fall for them because I know that they’re just trying to trick me into sleeping with them. You men are all animals that think with your lower body. You’ll abandon us women…”
When Connor heard Madison’s words, he wanted to defend himself.
However, when he thought of what he had done to Madison just now, he felt that it was better to let it go. He did not seem to have the right to say this.
“Although I’ve always hated men, 1 don’t like women very much either. Until I met Rachel some time ago. 1 seem to like Rachel, but I’m not sure if 1 really love her. I just want to be with her!”
Madison looked at Connor and continued.
“Actually, Miss Phillips, 1 think you should see a psychiatrist. After all, you don’t know if you simply hate men or if you’re really lesbian!”
Connor said in a low voice.
“A psychiatrist?”
Madison couldn’t help but sneer when she heard this. Then, she shook her head gently and said, “Everyone in the entire Porthampton knows who i am. If I really go to see a psychiatrist, won’t everyone know that I’m a lesbian?”
“Everyone knows that you confessed to Rachel so openly today.”
Connor replied helplessly.
“That’s different. 1 don’t care if outsiders know, but it’s fine as long as my grandfather and mother don’t know!”

Chapter 521: Yelena’s Phone Call
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
After listening to Madison’s story, Connor realized that she wasn’t actually a lesbian; she simply had a strong dislike for men.
As she finished sharing her story with him, she felt a sense of emotional release that had been pent up inside her.
Without saying much, she picked up her bag and walked away.
Connor watched Madison’s figure, filled with infinite regret.
Because he truly believed that women like Madison would be a loss for the male population if she were a lesbian.
After she left, he also walked out of the private room.
However, when he stepped out of the room, he noticed that the people who had been waiting to watch the commotion had already left, and Rachel was nowhere to be found.
Inside the restaurant, only Dominic and Spencer remained, having ordered beverages and sitting in the lobby, waiting for Connor.
“Connor, what were you doing with that girl in the private room? Why did it take you so long to come out?” Dominic hurriedly approached Connor, asking with a puzzled tone.
“Nothing much, we just talked about Rachel. She wanted me to leave her!” Connor replied casually.
“What did you say then?” Dominic continued to ask.
“What else could 1 say? At first, I said it was impossible for me to leave Rachel, considering I still have to study at Porthampton University. But later, I had no choice but to admit that Rachel didn’t actually like me, she was just lying. Madison believed my words and let me go!” Connor replied indifferently.
“She just let you go that easily?” Dominic exclaimed with a hint of disappointment in his voice.
“What could she do to me? Beat me up in the private room?” Connor said helplessly.
“Then why did 1 hear someone crying in the private room just now?” Dominic blinked and softly asked Connor.
“Uh…” Connor felt a hint of awkwardness in his eyes upon hearing Dominic’s words. He quickly explained, “Maybe you misheard?”
“It’s not possible. 1 really heard someone crying in there…” Dominic said firmly.
“Alright, you must have misheard. You two have been waiting outside for so long, I’m sure you’re both hungry. How about we have a meal here?” Connor didn’t want to continue discussing this topic with Dominic, so he suggested having a meal at the western restaurant they were in.
“Have you gone crazy? The expenses at this restaurant are very high. The three of us having a meal here would cost at least two thousand dollars!” Spencer stood up and said to Connor.
“Yeah, we just ordered two glasses of juice earlier, and it already cost us a hundred dollars!” Dominic added.
“It’s alright, I’m not short of money. Let’s eat here!” Due to the incident with Madison, Connor had no interest in continuing the ordeal. He directly waved to a nearby waiter and softly said, “Waiter, we want to order!”
“Sure!” The waiter smiled and agreed, then brought a menu over to Connor.
Dominic and Spencer didn’t try to stop him anymore and found a seat to sit down.
After a while, Connor finished ordering the food and began chatting with them.
However, Connor’s mind was filled with the scene that had just happened with Madison in the private room, so he had no mood to chat with Dominic and Spencer. He kept staring at the scenery outside the restaurant.
There weren’t many people inside the restaurant, so shortly after he placed the order, the waiter started serving the dishes.
Although Dominic and Spencer came from relatively well-off families, it was their first time dining at such a high-end Western restaurant.
When they saw the exquisite dishes being served one by one, their eyes lit up.
“Come on, you two, start eating. There are still several dishes yet to be served!” Connor smiled and said to the two.
“Connor, why did you order so many dishes? How much is this going to cost?” Spencer furrowed his brow and seemed to feel sorry for Connor.
“It’s fine. 1 earned over 20,000 dollars during the summer break. That’s enough for us to have a good meal!” Connor replied casually, then picked up his chopsticks and started eating heartily.
Seeing that Connor had already started enjoying the food, Dominic and Spencer naturally followed suit, eating and drinking to their heart’s content. “Ring!”
Less than five minutes into their meal, Connor’s phone rang.
He paused for a moment upon hearing the ringing, then took out his phone and glanced at it. To his surprise, the caller was Yelena!
Today was the first day of the new semester at Porthampton University, and she must have also gone to the school.
However, he had no idea why she was calling him, and he had a bad feeling that it couldn’t be anything good.
So after hesitating for a moment, he chose to hang up.
But just as Connor ended the call, Yelena called again.
He was well aware of her personality. If he kept ignoring the call, she would definitely keep calling. So in the end, he reluctantly answered the phone.
“Hello.” Connor answered the call and said softly.
“Connor, what are you doing? Why didn’t you answer my call just now!” she sounded displeased upon hearing his voice.
“I’m having dinner with my roommates. Do you need something?” he asked helplessly.
“What could 1 have to talk to you about? Today is the first day of school, and 1 specially rushed back from the set. We haven’t seen each other for such a long time. Don’t you miss me? Why don’t you treat me to a meal as well?” Yelena said with a smile.
“Stop teasing me, okay? There are so many people at our school who would want to treat you to a meal. Why did you specifically come looking for me?” He always felt that she had some issues in her mind. He couldn’t figure out what she wanted to do, so he believed it was better to keep some distance from her.
“Little Connor, what do you mean by that? Don’t you want to meet with me?” she sounded somewhat agitated.
“I don’t want to!” Connor replied directly, then hung up the phone.
Although he knew that his actions might seem heartless, he believed it was better to keep some distance from Yelena.
This woman was just too eccentric. He already had enough women around him, and there was no benefit for him to get too close to her..

Soon, she rushed out of the restaurant and got into her own Maserati, disappearing on the streets.
Spencer and Dominic watched Yelena’s vanishing figure and had expressions of great astonishment on their faces.
“No, what’s going on? Why does Yelena want to find Connor? Did Connor owe her money?”
Spencer muttered in confusion.
“Well, 1 hope you won’t be shocked when 1 tell you…”
Dominic replied calmly.
“What? What do you mean, ‘don’t be shocked’?”
Spencer turned to give Dominic a puzzled look and asked.
“Just now, Yelena told me that she is Connor’s girlfriend,” Dominic whispered.
Upon hearing this, Spencer froze as he was in disbelief, and he looked at Dominic, saying, “You’re not joking with me, right? Yelena is actually Connor’s girlfriend?”
“Why would I lie to you? She told me herself!” Dominic answered helplessly..

chapters.title: Chapter 524 - 524: Harlem’s Gold
chapters.content:
Chapter 524: Harlem’s Gold
Translator: End less Fantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
After leaving the restaurant, Connor directly hailed a taxi and got into the car.
“Young man, where are you going?” the taxi driver turned his head and asked with a smile.
“To Royal Villas…” Connor replied in a hurried tone.
The taxi driver visibly paused when he heard Connor mention Royal Villa After all, it was very famous in Porthampton, and anyone who could stay there was worth billions.
However, the young man in front of him was dressed very casually and didn’t look like someone who could stay in such a place.
“Young man, do you have relatives living there?” the taxi driver asked softly while starting the car.
“Sort of!” Connor absentmindedly replied. He just wanted to quickly get away from Yelena, that crazy woman, and had no interest in talking to the taxi driver.
“If you have relatives living there, your family must be quite wealthy,” the driver seemed very interested in him and continued talking while driving.
Meanwhile, Connor stared fixedly at the back of the car, fearing that Yelena would catch up.
After a few minutes, he realized that she hadn’t caught up, and he finally breathed a sigh of relief.
He took out his phone and glanced briefly. He found more than a dozen missed calls, all from his classmates.
Clearly, everyone who knew him must have heard about him being wanted by Yelena throughout the entire network.
“Why does Yelena keep causing trouble for me!” Connor turned off his phone directly and sighed helplessly.
Originally, he had always wanted to keep a low profile, but now he couldn’t stay low-key anymore!
“Ring!”
Just then, his phone suddenly rang. He initially thought it was Yelena calling and instinctively wanted to hang up. But when he saw that the caller ID wasn’t Yelena’s, he couldn’t help but pause for a moment. Then he pressed the answer button and asked in a low voice, “Who is this?”
“Mr. Connor, hello, I am Luke Phillips, the owner of the Harlem’s Gold!” the other party said respectfully to Connor.
“Oh, the owner of Harlem’s Gold!” Connor replied indifferently.
“Yes, Mr. Connor, we have already taken care of the matter you entrusted to us. The person is now at Harlem’s Gold. What do you plan to do with this person?” Luke asked politely.
Upon hearing Luke’s words, Mandy’s image appeared in Connor’s mind, and he couldn’t help but sigh softly, “It’s time to put an end to this woman!”
“So, Mr. Connor, do you want me to take care of this matter for you?” Luke asked hurriedly.
“No, I will come over later!” Connor quickly replied.
“Okay, I’ll be waiting for you!”
“Alright!”
After agreeing, Connor hung up the phone directly and said to the taxi driver, “Sir, don’t go to Royal Villa. Go directly to Harlem’s Gold!”
“Alright!”
The taxi driver seemed even more curious about Connor’s identity now. Both Harlem’s Gold and Royal Villa were not places that ordinary people could go to.
The taxi driver seemed to want to continue chatting with Connor and inquire about his identity. However, when he saw Connor closing his eyes to rest, he didn’t continue talking.
On the other side, inside of Harlem’s Gold.
It was almost 8 PM, and the guests were entering the casino one after another.
One had to know that casinos were very popular in Horton and Masonville.
But in reality, casinos were very rare in the country gambling was illegal.
However, Harlem’s Gold was able to operate and attracts a large number of customers every day, which proves how strong the connections were behind the owner of this casino!
It was said that the owner of the Harlem’s Gold was surnamed Phillips, named Luke. He was a very famous entrepreneur in Porthampton. He made his fortune through gambling when he was young. Later, he established a casino called ‘Harlem’s Gold’ by leveraging his connections in Porthampton.
Although the name of the Harlem’s Gold suggests that it was a club, it was actually a casino. It was named as such to avoid being easily discovered.
After all, no one can openly operate a casino in the country!
The scale of the Harlem’s Gold was very large. One building can accommodate nearly a thousand people and the size of the gambling depend on the amount of chips. The level of service one receive also varies accordingly.
On the first floor, most of the players were tourists or students. The gambling here was very simple, such as slot machines, where the wins and losses were not significant. It mainly serves as entertainment and can easily deceive people during inspections.
Anyone can enter the first floor without any requirements.
However, the second floor was different. To enter the second floor, one must have more than 50,000 dollars worth of chips in their hand. The gambling options were diverse and basically include everything one could find in a casino.
The standards for the third floor were millionaires. These customers usually had their own private rooms, so the environment was very comfortable, and there were dedicated personnel to serve them. Mandy lost her money on the third floor.
As for the fourth floor, it was even more exclusive. Customers who can go up to the fourth floor are generally billionaires, and they must have tens of millions or more chips in hand.
For ordinary people, it was already a great privilege to play on the third floor. The fourth floor was simply beyond their reach.
Because on the fourth floor, one can lose tens of millions or even billions in just one night. Such high stakes were simply unaffordable for ordinary people.
The fifth floor of the Harlem’s Gold was the office for the staff. Both the managers and the general managers work here.
The Harlem’s Gold can be said to be the largest and most famous casino in the Davenport. This place has always been very safe. No one comes here to cause trouble, and no one dares to cheat.
After all, the entire building of the Harlem’s Gold was under surveillance, even the restrooms were monitored. If anyone dared to cheat here, they will have a dead end!
There are nearly a hundred security guards in the casino and they were professionally trained, and many of them were former special forces. If a cheater was caught by the security, the consequences will be extremely dire.
It was said that there was a person who cheated in the Harlem’s Gold before and was directly beaten to death by the security. After that incident, no one dared to cheat here anymore. After all, no one was willing to risk their own life for gambling!
Of course, there was also a special situation in the Harlem’s Gold, which is when the people from the casino themselves cheat. No one can discover such a situation, and no one will investigate it.. After all, it’s their own territory!

chapters.title: Chapter 525 - 525: Mandy in Despair
chapters.content:
Chapter 525: Mandy in Despair
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
At Harlem’s Gold, inside an office.
Mandy and Lily sat on the sofa, their faces filled with tension as if walking on thin ice.
The deadline for Mandy to pay Zill had arrived, but she couldn’t come up with the 20 million.
So, this time, Zill had someone bring her directly to Harlem’s Gold.
Since Lily was Mandy’s roommate, Zill was worried that she might call the police, so he had her brought along as well.
“Zill, I beg you, can you give me a few more days? I will definitely repay you this money!” Mandy pleaded in a humble tone to Zill.
“Give you more time?” Upon hearing Mandy’s words, he couldn’t help but burst into laughter, then said calmly, “Mandy, how many days have I already given you? Where is the money? Even if you can repay half of it now, it would be fine. But so far, I haven’t seen a single penny. How can 1 give you more time?”
“Zill, my boyfriend is really wealthy. I’m sure 1 can get this money from him!” At this point, Mandy had placed all her hopes on Connor because she knew deep down that only he could come up with that money and help her.
“Do you think I will still believe you? Just wait here quietly! The boss of our casino will be here soon, and then we’ll see how he deals with you!”
He impatiently said to her.
“Wait?” She was puzzled when she heard his words, then asked with a hint of confusion, “What do you want me to wait for?”
“What else can you wait for? Our casino’s boss will be here soon, and then we’ll see how he handles both of you. It’s not up to me to decide,” replied Zill indifferently.
Upon hearing his words, a look of nervousness appeared on her face.
She had heard about the boss of Harlem’s Gold before. She knew that if he came, she would have no good outcome. The lightest punishment could be being sold to a wealthy person as a lover, and the heaviest could be her life being taken away.
“Zill, please, I’m begging you, can you give me two more days? I promise I can repay you this money!” Mandy said and kneeled on the ground as her expression pitiful as she shouted at Zill.
However, he didn’t even spare a glance at her because he knew he had no say in how to deal with her at this point.
“Zill, I… I didn’t owe you any money. Can you just let me go? I promise I won’t say anything after I leave…” Lily, who had started to get nervous as well, stammered as she spoke to Zill.
“Shut the hell up! I’ve already said it. The boss of our Harlem’s Gold will be here soon, and how he handle the two of you will not be up to me. It depends on what our boss says!” Zill shouted impatiently.
Seeing his attitude, Mandy knew that she was definitely in trouble today. She slumped to the ground, her face extremely pale.
“Mandy, think of a solution quickly! These people won’t let us go…” Lily’s expression became even more nervous as she urged Mandy.
“What solution can I come up with now? Should I call Connor? He would never help me!” Mandy exclaimed in an agitated tone.
Upon hearing the name Connor, Zill glanced at Mandy indifferently without saying a word.
“You should try again. You’ve been together with Connor for two whole years. I believe he won’t abandon you in times of need!” Lily exclaimed.
After hesitating for a moment, Mandy looked up at Zill and whispered, “Zill, can I make a phone call to my boyfriend?”
He glanced at her hesitating for two seconds, then signaled to the bodyguard beside him.
The bodyguard immediately took out her phone and handed it to her.
After receiving the phone, she quickly found Connor’s number and dialed it.
“Ring… Ring…”
After two rings, Connor unexpectedly answered the call.
“Hello.”
Connor’s voice came through.
Upon hearing his voice, she became excited and hastily shouted, “Connor, is that you?”
“It’s me. What’s the matter?” he replied calmly.
“Connor, do you remember what 1 told you last time? I’ve been caught by the people from Harlem’s Gold. I’m begging you, please, just consider it for the sake of the two years we’ve been together. Can you help me repay this money? I’m willing to do anything you ask…” Mandy rambled on incoherently.
“Mandy, do you remember what you said to me when we broke up?” He calmly interrupted her words.
Mandy stood frozen in place.
“I remember you told me that someone like me is not worthy of being with you. An orphan like me, with no money, no power, no background. Even if I spent my whole life delivering takeout, I still wouldn’t compare to a single hair of Brandon’s!”
“Back then, I was so disgraceful and subservient in your eyes. And now you come to me, begging. Don’t you think you have no shame? Now you realize that we’ve been together for two years. But when you humiliated me in front of so many people, did you ever consider my feelings?”
The two sentences from Connor left Mandy speechless.
She stood there holding the phone, her expression blank, unsure how to answer his questions.
“Furthermore, when you took away ten million from my hands, didn’t you say you would never come to me again? So why are you seeking me out now?”
Upon seeing her silence, he continued his cold questioning.
“Connor , I… I was wrong back then…” she stuttered.
“Since you know you were wrong back then, now you should bear the consequences of your past actions!” he coldly replied to her, then without any hesitation, he hung up the phone.
“Connor , please listen to me. I truly regret it now. 1 can make it up to you…” Mandy tried to explain, but Connor had already ended the call, leaving only the sound of the dial tone on the phone.
“Clang!”
The phone slipped from her hand.
Despair filled her expression.. Only now did she realize what a foolish decision it was to break up with Connor back then!

chapters.title: Chapter 526 - 526: Give Me Another Chance
chapters.content:
Chapter 526: Give Me Another Chance
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
On the other side.
After Connor hung up the phone with Mandy, he called a car and went straight to Harlem’s Gold.
At this moment, at the entrance of Harlem’s Gold, a young man who had been waiting for a long time saw Connor appear and quickly ran to his side. Then, he asked Connor in a very respectful tone, “You must be Mr. McDonald?” “Yes!”
Connor nodded lightly.
Walt made an inviting gesture to Connor and said very politely, “I’m Mr. Phillips’s assistant, Walt. Mr. Phillips has been waiting for you for a long time. Please follow me!”
“Alright!”
Connor nodded gently and followed Walt into the casino.
At this moment, Walt was still a little shocked because he did not expect this so-called Mr. McDonald to be so low-key. If he hadn’t seen Connor’s photo before, he wouldn’t have believed that this ordinary young man in front of him was an existence that could make countless big shots in Porthampton bow down to him.
Connor didn’t notice that when he followed Walt into the casino, a black Maserati stopped at the entrance of the casino.
Yelena Allen, who was dressed in a rather revealing manner, walked out of the Maserati in her high heels. Then, she looked up at the Harlem’s Gold in front of her with a puzzled expression.
Yelena was also from Porthampton, so she naturally knew what kind of place the Harlem’s Gold in Porthampton was.
“What is Connor doing here?”
Yelena could not help but mutter softly, then continued, “Could Connor have come here to gamble? Where did he get the money?”
With such doubts in mind, Yelena walked into the casino in her high heels.
However, after entering the casino, Yelena searched around the first floor but did not find any trace of Connor, so she prepared to go to the second floor to take a look.
It was Yelena’s first time at Harlem’s Gold, so she didn’t know the rules of the casino at all. Before she could go up to the second floor, she was stopped by the security guard at the door.
“Hello, Miss. Please show me your chips!”
The security guard saw that Yelena was dressed very beautifully, so he was very polite when he spoke to her. After all, most of the fair, rich, and beautiful women who came here to play were rich heirs or mistresses of rich people. The security guard obviously thought that Yelena was the latter!
“A bargaining chip?”
When Yelena heard the security guard’s words, she was stunned for a moment. Then, she frowned and said, “What chips?”
“Miss, is this your first time coming to our casino?” The security guard asked with a smile.
“That’s right, I’m here to look for someone!”
Yelena nodded.
“If you’re here to look for someone, you can call your friend now and ask him to come down and bring you up. Otherwise, according to our casino’s rules, customers who enter the second floor must have chips worth more than 50,000 dollars in their hands,” the security guard said.
” More than 50,000 dollars’ worth of chips?”
When Yelena heard this, she could not help but open her mouth wide. She was not surprised by the 50,000 dollars. After all, as one of the top internet celebrities in Tiktok, 50,000 dollars was nothing to Yelena.
She was just surprised that Connor could take out 50,000 dollars!
In Yelena’s impression, Connor had always been very poor!
The security guard saw that Yelena did not speak and asked her softly, “Miss, do you want to call your friend or exchange your chips?”
“I don’t gamble, why would I exchange so many chips?” Yelena frowned and replied, then continued, “Do we have to use this passage to get to the second floor?”
“That’s right, you have to go through this passage!”
The security guard nodded.
“Alright then, I’ll wait here. I don’t believe that Connor won’t come out yet!”
Yelena pouted and snorted coldly. Then, she actually moved a chair and sat at the entrance of the passage. She played with her phone while waiting for Connor to come out.
The security guard saw that since Yelena was not causing trouble or violating any rules, he ignored Yelena and continued to stand by the side of the passageway on duty.
On the other side, in the casino office.
After Mandy called Connor, she was in despair—her last hope was gone just like that. She sat on the ground, her face extremely pale.
Lily stood there foolishly. She was very confused because she couldn’t figure out what Connor wanted to do.
“Do you still want to make a call?”
Zill walked in front of Mandy and asked her expressionlessly.
“I won’t fight anymore…”
Mandy looked up at Zill and shook her head in despair.
Zill picked up Mandy’s phone and sat on the sofa, waiting quietly.
About ten minutes later, the office door was pushed open.
A white-haired old man in a white tunic suit walked into the office with two bodyguards.
This old man was none other than the real boss of Harlem’s Gold, Luke Phillips!
When Zill and the others saw Luke, they all stood up and called out respectfully, “Hello, boss!”
Luke waved his hand at Zill and the others and said with a smile, “There are no outsiders here. There is no need to be so polite…”
“Alright, boss!”
Zill replied with a smile, then walked to Luke’s side and said softly to Luke, “Boss, this person is Mandy Hines, who owes our casino 20 million dollars…”
After hearing this, Luke turned to look at Mandy and said lightly, “You owe me so much money at such a young age. That’s no small feat!”
“Mr. Phillips, I’m begging you. Give me another chance. 1’11 definitely think of a way to return the money!”
Mandy shouted excitedly at Luke.
“Haha…”
Luke smiled faintly when he heard Mandy’s words.
Zill took out a chair and placed it behind Luke, after which Luke sat on the chair in an orderly manner. He looked at Mandy up and down and whispered to her, “Miss, I’ve investigated your family background. Your parents are ordinary workers, and you’re just a university student. Although you’re not bad looking, if you rely on just your looks, it’ll probably be difficult for you to earn 20 million in your lifetime…”
“Mr. Phillips, even if 1 have to work like a cow or a horse for the rest of my life, I will return this money to you…”
Mandy shouted excitedly.
“Forget it, I’ll just treat this money as lost. 1 don’t want it!”
Luke replied expressionlessly.
“You don’t want this money?”
Mandy looked at the expression on Luke’s face in shock!

chapters.title: Chapter 527 - 527: On One Condition!
chapters.content:
Chapter 527: On One Condition!
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Hearing Luke’s words, Mandy was stunned on the spot, and her face was filled with unspeakable surprise.
“Mr. Phillips, thank you so much!”
Mandy was so excited that she didn’t know what to do. She knelt on the ground and kept kowtowing to Luke.
Never in her wildest dreams did she expect that this matter would be resolved so easily. This was simply a great thing for her!
“Thank me?” Luke looked at Mandy with a faint smile, then said with a playful expression, “Why are you thanking me?”
“Mr. Phillips, didn’t you just say that you don’t want me to return the money?”
Mandy was stunned for a moment. She felt that there was something wrong with Luke’s expression.
“I don’t intend to let you return the money because I know you won’t be able to pay it back in your lifetime. However, not letting you return the money doesn’t mean that 1’11 let you off just like that,” Luke said lightly.
“There are conditions?”
Mandy took a deep breath and said with a disappointed expression, “That’s true. It’s normal for you to not want me to pay you back for so much money. Mr. Phillips, if you have any conditions, just say it. As long as it’s within my ability, I’ll definitely do my best!”
“Don’t worry, my condition is very simple. You can definitely do it!” Luke replied softly.
Mandy looked at Luke with a nervous expression and couldn’t help but think in her heart, could it be that Luke has taken a fancy to me and wants to keep me as a mistress?
Although Mandy was willing to be Connor’s lover for the 20 million dollars, it did not mean that she would be willing to be the other party’s lover for the 20 million dollars!
Connor was very good-looking and young. The most important thing was that he was very rich. Mandy felt that she would not suffer a loss even if she was Connor’s mistress.
However, Luke was different. Luke was old enough to be Mandy’s grandfather. Besides, Mandy felt that she would not get any benefits from being with such a man, so she was still very resistant to this matter.
“Mr. Phillips, what are your conditions?”
Mandy asked Luke softly after hesitating for a while.
“My condition is very simple. According to the rules of Harlem’s Gold, 20 million is enough to buy your life, but I see that you’re still young, so 1 plan to give you a chance to start over. How about this? I’ll get someone to cut off both of your hands, and the 20 million you owe me will be written off.”
Luke said this without any emotion, as if it was normal for him to cut off other people’s hands.
Mandy couldn’t accept this fact for a moment, so she shouted at Luke while trembling, “M-Mr. Phillips, if you really cut off my hands, won’t I become a cripple?”
Lily, who was standing beside Mandy, was also completely dumbfounded. She never thought that Luke would actually want to cut off Mandy’s hands.
“It’s only right to pay back a debt, no? Before you borrowed money, you should have thought of this outcome. Now that you can’t pay, I can only take something else from your body!” Luke replied coldly.
“Mr. Phillips, I… I’m begging you. I really know my mistake. It’s my fault. I shouldn’t have borrowed so much money from you! But can you give me another chance? Don’t cut off my hand, okay?”
Mandy originally thought that Luke would let her go, but she never thought that Luke would be so ruthless and ready to cut off her hands.
If her hands were really cut off, Mandy may as well be dead!
“You have no right to bargain with me now.”
Luke didn’t want to waste his breath on Mandy, so he turned his head and shouted at Zill.
“Yes, boss!”
Zill nodded his head lightly and then led his bodyguards towards Mandy’s position.
“No,-n-no! Don’t…”
Mandy shouted in horror when she saw Zill walking towards her with his bodyguards. However, Zill and the others acted as if they did not hear Mandy’s words at all. They walked straight to Mandy.
“Mr. Phillips, I beg you, please give me another chance. I will definitely return this money to you!”
Mandy knelt on the ground and cried as she shouted at Luke.
“Return the money?”
Luke couldn’t help but sneer when he heard that. Then, he said lightly, “How are you going to pay me back?”
“I’ll really pay you back. Please let me go!”
Mandy shouted excitedly at Luke.
Luke glanced at Mandy and did not say anything, because he was not in the mood to talk nonsense with someone like Mandy.
“Hold her down!”
Zill shouted at the bodyguards behind him expressionlessly.
When the bodyguards heard Zill’s words, they rushed in front of Mandy and pressed her to the ground.
Mandy seemed to have gone crazy. She kept struggling and shouting. The expression on her face was filled with despair, but no one paid attention to her!
Lily was completely scared out of her wits. Her eyes were dull as she stood on the spot. Her legs were slightly trembling. She did not know what she should do, nor did she know if these people would attack her. There was only endless fear in her heart.
Although Mandy had been struggling, she was only a girl after all, and her strength was limited.
The bodyguards pressed Mandy to the ground without any effort. Two of the bodyguards held her body down, while the other two held her hands down.
Mandy’s entire body was pinned to the floor. Her body was in a big position, like a fish on a chopping board, waiting to be slaughtered!
Luke sat on the chair expressionlessly and looked at Mandy coldly.
“No, Mr. Zonah, I beg you, let me go…”
Even now, Mandy still did not give up begging for mercy.
However, it was obviously ineffective.
Zill took out a machete from somewhere. This machete was specially used to deal with those gamblers who didn’t pay their debts!
Mandy looked at the white machete, and a trace of fear flashed in her eyes.
“I hope you can remember this!”
Zill looked at Mandy. Then, he raised his machete and slashed at Mandy’s right hand.
“Bang!”
With a loud bang, the machete fell steadily..
