Zill also showed a puzzled expression and whispered to Luke, “But Boss, I don’t understand why Mr. McDonald wants us to put on such a show. If he wanted to deal with this woman, he could have let us do it directly. Why did Mr. McDonald want us to scare her?”
“You have never experienced the fear of death, so you don’t know how terrifying this feeling is. I think Mr. McDonald asked us to do this because he wants this girl to remember how terrifying that feeling was!”
Luke explained with his eyes narrowed.
Although there were many rumors about Connor outside, saying that Connor did not have any talent at all and was just lucky enough to inherit Steven Lee’s property!
However, Luke felt that the rumors outside were not true. At the very least, he felt that Connor was very smart.
The fact that Connor could think of such a way to deal with Mandy proved that he was much smarter than the average person.
Connor didn’t want anyone to kill Mandy, nor did he want to hurt her, because no matter what, Mandy had been with Connor before.
But under such circumstances, Connor was worried that Mandy would keep using their relationship to threaten him. In this case, she might become a problem that Connor could not solve!
Therefore, Connor felt that the only way to solve this was by making Mandy really afraid of him, so much so that every time she saw him, she would think of the terrifying fear just now. Otherwise, Mandy would definitely keep asking for money from him.
After Connor gave Mandy 10 million dollars, he went straight to Lily and asked her to bring Mandy to Harlem’s Gold.
Connor had something on Lily, so she naturally did not dare to reject his request. She brought Mandy to Harlem’s Gold according to his instructions.
Then, Connor asked Kyle Hayes to negotiate with the people of Harlem’s Gold. His plan was very simple, and that was to let Mandy fall to this point step by step.
Although Luke Phillips was not Connor’s employee, he had heard about Connor. In addition, Kyle Hayes had a good relationship with Connor, so Luke needed to give Connor some leeway.
Therefore, from the moment Mandy stepped into the casino, she was under surveillance.
Not only that, but the people from Harlem’s Gold had also cheated on purpose. They let her win a few rounds, then baited her into losing.
Mandy, of course, couldn’t accept such ups and downs. After losing money, she naturally wanted to win it back. However, winning money required capital, so she could only borrow money from Harlem’s Gold!
In less than two months, Mandy had experienced the ups and downs that she had never experienced before. First, she went from an ordinary university student to a multimillionaire, and then from a multimillionaire to a gambler with a debt of 20 million dollars.
In order to avoid the people in the casino, Mandy had no choice but to hide and live a life worse than death every day.
In the end, Connor began to pull in the net, deliberately letting Luke and Zill put on a show.
In this way, Mandy would understand what true fear was!
Luke felt that Connor being able to set up such a big trap over a long period of time was definitely not something that ordinary people could do.
Most importantly, Connor had never appeared in this plan. This was also his most powerful aspect.
That was why Luke felt that Connor was not useless. He was much more powerful than the outside world thought.
“Creak!”
At this moment, the office door was suddenly pushed open from the outside.
Connor walked into the office!
“Mr. McDonald!”
“Mr. McDonald!”
Zill and Luke hurriedly stood up and greeted Connor.
Lily looked at Connor who walked into the office in a daze. Now she finally understood what was going on.
It turned out that she was just a chess piece in Connor’s plan!
“How is Mandy?”
Connor asked expressionlessly.
“Mr. McDonald, Mandy Hines just fainted. She must have been too frightened!” Luke replied.
“Wake her up. I have something to say to her…”
Connor replied lightly and then sat on the chair that Luke had sat on before.
Zill and the rest did not dare to be negligent. They hurriedly ran to the bathroom to get a large basin of cold water and splashed it directly on Mandy’s face!
“All!”
Mandy screamed and instantly woke up.
“My hand…”
Mandy thought that her hands had been chopped off by Zill, so the first thing she did after waking up was to check her body.
But what Mandy did not expect was that her body was actually unharmed, and both her hands were still intact.
“This… What’s going on?”
Mandy muttered in disbelief. Then, she suddenly looked up and found an extremely familiar face.
At this moment, Connor was squinting at Mandy.
“Connor, you…Why are you here?”
Mandy stuttered as she asked Connor. The expression on her face was very shocked!
“Why do you think I’m here?” Connor smiled faintly.
“You’re here to save me, right?”
Mandy shouted excitedly.
“Save you?”
Connor sneered, then shook his head and said, “Mandy, you’re really naive!”
“Mandy, Connor is in cahoots with these people…”
Lily could not help but remind Mandy softly.
“Together?”
Mandy felt that her brain was not enough.
She sat on the ground and hesitated for two seconds.. Then, she shouted excitedly, “Connor, you colluded with these people to harm me, right?”

chapters.title: Chapter 529 - 529: Get Lost!
chapters.content:
Chapter 529: Get Lost!
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
“I colluded with these people to harm you?”
After hearing Mandy’s words, Connor couldn’t help but laugh. Then, he said expressionlessly, “You asked to come to the casino, and you owe me the money. What does it have to do with me? Did I force you to borrow money from the casino?”
“You…”
Mandy was so angry that her eyes turned red. After hesitating for two seconds, she said in a low voice, “No wonder you were willing to lend me money back then. It turns out that all of this was planned by you. What exactly do you want?”
“I don’t want anything. This is between you and Harlem’s Gold. I’m just here to watch the show!”
Connor said with a smile.
After Mandy heard Connor’s words, a trace of fear flashed across her eyes.
She quickly crawled to Connor’s side and hugged Connor’s thigh tightly as she shouted, “Connor, 1 know that you are in cahoots with these people. If you speak up for me, they will definitely listen to you. So, quickly speak up for me and ask these people to let me go. 1 really know my mistake…”
“Mandy, do you remember what I told you when you took the ten million dollars from me?”
Connor asked Mandy softly.
“What did you tell me?”
Mandy looked at Connor and was stunned for a moment. A trace of confusion flashed in her eyes.
“Looks like you have forgotten…” Connor couldn’t help but sigh. Then, he said with a playful expression, “I told you before that you can’t do whatever you want in this society just because you have money. There are many things that you can’t solve with money!”
In fact, Connor was still very qualified to say this. After all, he was already very rich now. It was not an exaggeration to say that he was the richest man in the world.
However, he still had a lot of troubles. Some things could be solved with money, but some things couldn’t.
“I don’t understand what you said, but my problem can be solved with money. As long as 1 pay the money back, Mr. Phillips will let me go!”
Mandy shouted at Connor with an excited expression.
“Then can you return it?”
Connor asked Mandy softly.
“I can’t pay it back, but you can help me pay it back!”
Mandy hurriedly replied.
“Haha…”
Connor couldn’t help but laugh when he heard this. Then, he said in a playful tone, “Do I have money to spend? Why should I help you pay back this money?” H H
Mandy looked at Connor in front of her and was instantly dumbfounded. She shouted at Connor with an excited expression, “Connor, I know that you came here today to help me. Otherwise, you wouldn’t have come. Just tell me what you want from me!”
Mandy was a very smart woman. She felt that Connor was definitely not just here to watch the show today.
Connor didn’t want to continue talking nonsense with Mandy and said directly, “Alright, then I’ll be clear with you. I can indeed help you this time, but I won’t help you repay this money…”
“Then what do you want?”
Mandy looked at Connor and asked in confusion.
“Although I won’t help you pay back the money, I can ask Mr. Phillips not to ask you for the money for the time being…”
Connor whispered to Mandy.
“You won’t ask me for money for the time being? What does that mean?” Mandy was stunned for a moment and asked Connor with a frown.
“What 1 mean is very simple: from today onwards, I don’t want to see you anymore. As long as I don’t see you, Mr. Phillips won’t ask you for this money. However, if 1 see you again, or if you use my fiancee to blackmail me again, 1 won’t care about the matter between Mr. Phillips and you…” Connor said calmly to Mandy.
Mandy was almost driven crazy by Luke, Zill, and the others. Connor’s offer was simply too tempting compared to the torture of Zill and the others.
Therefore, Mandy did not hesitate at all and shouted at Connor, “Alright, I agree to your condition. As long as these people don’t come looking for me anymore, I won’t look for you anymore. I’ll drop out of school and leave Porthampton immediately. I promise that 1 won’t appear in your life again…” Connor narrowed his eyes and asked softly, “Are you sure you can do it?” In fact, Connor had gone around in such a big circle with the purpose of making Mandy disappear completely from his life. The last time Mandy asked Connor for money, it was also a wake-up call. He felt that if Mandy didn’t disappear, his life would never be peaceful.
If Mandy still used the same method to threaten him, would Connor give money? Although this money was nothing to Connor, human desires were endless. Who could guarantee what Mandy would do in the future?
Therefore, Connor had made up his mind at that time. He had to make Mandy disappear, no matter what.
Mandy was different from Brandon Guthrie—she was a very shameless woman, and Connor didn’t have anything on her.
When Connor dealt with Brandon, he could use his father to pressure him. However, Mandy herself was an ordinary person. Her family did not have any businesses. She was simply shameless, unreasonable, and had nothing to lose! It was impossible for Connor to make Mandy disappear using normal methods. If he had killed Mandy directly, things would have been much simpler.
However, Connor did not want to use such a method because he knew Mandy, and he himself was averse to killing people.
That was why Connor thought up this plan!
“Connor, don’t worry. As long as these people don’t come to me for money, I definitely won’t come to you again. I can definitely do this!” Mandy shouted at Connor very seriously.
“Alright, since you’ve said so, 1 won’t make things difficult for you anymore. But remember, if you dare to appear in my life again or contact me, then I won’t interfere in the matter between you and Mr. Phillips.”
Connor asked Mandy coldly.
Mandy nodded without thinking.
“Then get lost!” Connor shouted with an expressionless face.
When Mandy heard Connor’s words, she felt as if she had escaped death. She hurriedly stood up and ran out of the office..

chapters.title: Chapter 530 - 530: A Favor Worth 29 Million Dollars
chapters.content:
Chapter 530: A Favor Worth 29 Million Dollars
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
However, just as Mandy was about to run out of the office.
Mandy suddenly stopped in her tracks and turned to look at Connor.
“Is there anything else?”
Connor asked Mandy softly.
Mandy stood in place and hesitated for two seconds. Then, she stared at Connor with her big, watery eyes and asked, “Connor, who are you?”
In fact, Mandy had always been curious about this question. After all, when they were together, he was just a poor loser who delivered food. But now, Connor had turned into an existence that even the boss of Harlem’s Gold had to fear.
Mandy really could not understand what kind of change had happened to Connor.
“Who am I?”
When Connor heard this, he smiled playfully and then said indifferently, “I don’t know who I am either. Why don’t you help me answer it, Mr. Phillips?”
Luke looked at Connor for a moment, then said with a very serious expression, “Mr. McDonald, I don’t know much about your background, but I know that you have the final say in the entire Porthampton now. The Empire World Corporation under your banner has already spread across all walks of life in Porthampton. You exist in both the legal and illegal industries. It’s not an exaggeration to say that you’re the number one young master of Porthampton.”
After hearing Luke’s words, Mandy was instantly dumbfounded. The expression on her face was extremely shocked.
Originally, Mandy thought that Connor was just a rich heir. However, she never expected Connor’s background to be so terrifying!
Luke was a well-known figure in Porthampton. Mandy knew that Luke would not lie.
“Of course, this is only your influence in Porthampton. As for your influence in other cities, I don’t know!”
Luke turned his head to look at Mandy as he spoke, and then said lightly, “Young lady, you were able to be together with Mr. McDonald back then. That was a blessing that you had cultivated for eight lifetimes, but you didn’t know how to cherish it. You might not know how many young ladies in Porthampton City wished to have such an opportunity, but they didn’t have your luck!”
Mandy stood rooted to the ground, her expression unusually regretful.
She felt that abandoning Connor and choosing to be with Brandon Guthrie was simply the stupidest thing in the world!
It felt like she’d lost a hundred million dollars for a hundred dollars!
Unfortunately, there was no medicine for regret in this world. It was too late for Mandy to regret now.
Lily, who was standing at the side, looked even more incredulous. She now had a new understanding of Connor’s identity.
“Is there anything else you want to ask?”
Connor turned his head and looked at Mandy indifferently. He asked Mandy coldly.
“No… There’s nothing else…”
Mandy stuttered as she replied. Then, she walked out of the office with an extremely uneasy mood.
“Connor, I…Can 1 leave now?”
Lily hesitated for a moment before asking Connor.
H H
Connor turned to look at Lily and said softly, “You know too much. I don’t want to see you again. Tomorrow, you and Mandy will go through the withdrawal procedures and leave Porthampton…”
“Alright…Alright, 1’11 go through the withdrawal procedures tomorrow!”
Lily hurriedly agreed. She did not dare to go against Connor’s wishes now.
H ii
Connor stood where he was and hesitated for two seconds. He felt that Lily did not have any blood feud with him. Back then, she had only verbally humiliated Connor a few times.
However, Connor would not make her drop out of school for no reason just because of this.
Connor suddenly changed his mind.
“Forget it. I’ll get the principal to help you with the transfer procedures tomorrow. When the time comes, you can transfer to another school. That way, your studies won’t be affected!”
After Lily heard Connor’s words, her expression was very excited. She hurriedly shouted, “Connor, thank you, thank you!”
“Mr. Phillips, get your men to prepare 100,000 dollars in cash for her. Just treat it as compensation!”
Connor ignored Lily and turned to Luke.
“Mr. McDonald, you really have a good heart!”
Luke sighed and turned to look at Zill. Of course, Zill knew what Luke meant, so he hurried to Lily’s side and said softly to her, “Miss, come with me to get the money!”
Lily’s expression was very excited because she never dreamed that Connor would not take revenge on her, instead handling the transfer procedures for her and giving her 100,000 dollars. This was simply a great thing for her! “Connor, thank you. Thank you so much!”
Lily thanked Connor as she followed Zill out of the office.
“Wait!” But at this moment, Connor suddenly shouted.
When Lily heard this, she hurriedly stopped and looked at Connor’s position. She felt that Connor might have changed his mind.
“Give her 200,000 dollars and 100,000 dollars to Mandy!” Connor said softly.
“Alright…!”
Lily answered in surprise and then walked out of the office.
After Mandy, Lily, and the others left, Connor heaved a sigh of relief. This big problem was finally solved.
Connor turned to look at Luke and said sincerely, “Mr. Phillips, thank you for this!”
“Mr. McDonald, this is just a small matter. There’s no need to thank me. It’s my honor to be able to help you, Mr. McDonald…” Luke hurriedly replied.
After all, Luke didn’t spend much effort on Mandy’s matter, and he didn’t lose anything. Why not let Connor owe him a favor?
After saying this, Luke quickly took out a bank card and handed it to Connor. Then he said to Connor with a flattering face, “Mr. McDonald, the 20 million that Mandy lost in our casino…”
“Keep it, just treat it as compensation for Zill and the others!”
Connor said lightly.
After all, he did not lack the 20 million dollars.
“Mr. McDonald, we can’t accept this money. After all, it’s your money!”
Luke handed the bank card to Connor as he spoke.
Connor also knew what Luke meant. If he accepted this bank card now, it would mean that he owed Luke a favor. However, if Connor did not accept this bank card, then he would not owe him a favor.
One was Connor’s favor, and the other was 20 million dollars.. Luke was clearly aware of which one was worth more!

chapters.title: Chapter 531 - 531: Granddaughter’s Birthday Party
chapters.content:
Chapter 531: Granddaughter’s Birthday Party
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
“Mr. McDonald, please accept this money!” Luke said to Connor seriously.
After seeing Luke’s persistence, Connor didn’t continue to refuse.
After ail, this money was nothing to the two of them. Connor knew what Luke meant.
After Connor accepted the bank card, he couldn’t help but feel a little amused. He didn’t expect the money to return to his hands.
“Mr. Robert, if you need help, please ask. As long as it’s something I can help with, I’ll help you!” Connor whispered to Luke.
“Mr. McDonald, since you’ve said so, I do have something 1 need your help with!” Luke was waiting for Connor to say this, so he quickly replied excitedly.
After hearing Luke, Connor’s eyes flashed with a trace of helplessness.
Although Connor knew what Luke meant by giving him twenty million, wasn’t Luke too anxious to get his money worth so soon?
“What is it?”
Although Connor groaned in his heart, he said nothing and asked expressionlessly.
“It’s my granddaughter’s birthday party in a few days. 1 hope you can attend it as a show of support,” Luke said with a smile.
“That’s it?” Connor was stunned for a moment and asked.
“This is not simple. Mr. McDonald, if you can come, the Roberts Family will be honored!” Luke said excitedly.
Many people in Porthampton knew Connor’s identity and that he was the boss of Thomas Morgan and Kyle Hayes.
If such a big shot attended Luke’s granddaughter’s birthday party, the meaning was self-evident!
The bosses in Porthampton would probably understand the relationship between Luke and Connor, which was a great thing for the Roberts Family.
Moreover, Luke did not just want to use Connor to help him build momentum. He had a more important reason.
That was, Luke’s granddaughter was about the same age as Connor. He wanted to use this opportunity to matchmake the two of them. Once his granddaughter married Connor, the Roberts Family would be considered to have a meteoric rise.
“Okay, then give me a call. If 1 have time, I’ll go over!” Connor replied indifferently, then stood up and about to leave.
“Mr. McDonald, let me send you off!”
Luke was in a good mood after Connor agreed so readily. He got up and about to send Connor out of the casino.
“All good, I can go out by myself!” Connor directly refused Luke. After all, many people were in the casino, and Connor did not want others to find out his identity.
If he went out with Luke and was seen by someone with ulterior motives, it would cause unnecessary trouble.
“I forgot that Mr. McDonald doesn’t like to be too ostentatious. I won’t send you off then!” Luke said after understanding Connor’s meaning.
“Sure!” Connor nodded gently and walked out of the office alone.
After leaving the office, Connor went straight to the first floor.
It was almost nine o’clock in the evening, and the gamblers on the first floor were at their peak.
However, these gamblers were ordinary people who liked to play slot machines.
“I didn’t expect the business of Harlem’s Gold to be so good…”
Connor looked at the gamblers coming and going on the first floor and could not help but sigh softly. Then, he turned around and was about to leave.
But at this moment, a beautiful woman suddenly appeared before Connor.
Connor was stunned for a moment. Then, he looked up and realized that the person standing before him was Yelena!
Yelena was dressed very sexy today. She wore a tight black short skirt. Her sexy figure looked especially charming under the short skirt. Her slender and fair legs were of moderate thickness. She wore black stockings and a pair of high heels. Her exquisite face and black curly hair gave people an indescribable temptation.
However, Connor was not in the mood to appreciate Yelena’s beauty.
He looked at Yelena in surprise and asked helplessly, “Why… Why are you here?”
“Connor, I have finally found you…”
Yelena crossed her arms and sneered. Then, she widened her eyes and continued, “What were you doing just now?”
“What I did has nothing to do with you, right? Why are you always pestering me?” Connor asked.
“So why have you been avoiding me?” Yelena directly asked.
“Girl, you’ve been following me all this time, okay? If you weren’t following me, would 1 hide from you?” Connor said helplessly.
“That’s because you refused to see me. That’s why 1 pestered you…” Yelena replied indifferently, then dragged Connor out of the casino.
“Why are you dragging me with you?” Connor asked Yelena helplessly.
“I’m going back to Horizon tomorrow, so you have to treat me to a meal today…” Yelena said domineeringly.
“What does it have to do with me whether you return to Horizon? Besides, why should I treat you to a meal?” Connor asked..
“Why are you so slow? I’m giving you a chance by asking you to treat me to a meal. Do you know how many men want to treat me to a meal? I won’t give them a chance!” Yelena pursed her lips and replied indifferently.
“Are you sure it’s just treating you to a meal and nothing else?” Connor hesitated and asked Yelena with a frown.
“Anything else? What else do you want to do with me?” Yelena blinked and asked Connor with a smile.
“I don’t want to do anything else with you. I’m just asking if there’s anything else!” Connor said speechlessly.
“No, as long as you have a meal with me, 1 will let you go…” Yelena replied indifferently.
“All right then!” Connor helplessly agreed. He felt that it was just a meal with Yelena. There was nothing else, so it wouldn’t take long.
“Can you let go of me? I’ve already agreed to have dinner with you!” Connor said to Yelena helplessly.
“If I let you go, you won’t run, right?” Yelena asked softly.
“Why would I run?” Connor asked helplessly.
“All right then, I’ll let you go!” Yelena replied faintly and then let go of her hand.
Connor followed Yelena helplessly because he really didn’t know what Yelena wanted to do..

chapters.title: Chapter 532 - 532: Who Told You I’m Single?
chapters.content:
Chapter 532: Who Told You I’m Single?
Translator: End less Fantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
In the end, Connor had no choice but to compromise.
He followed Yelena our of the casino and was going to accompany her to dinner.
“I just don’t understand. Some so many people like you. Why do you want me to go to dinner with you?
“You only have to ask on Twitch, and many people will fight to dine with you. Moreover, you don’t even have to pay for it. Why do you have to pester me?” Connor asked Yelena helplessly.
“Why do you ask so many questions? 1 like to eat with you, can’t I?” Yelena pouted and replied to Connor.
Connor looked at Yelena and didn’t know what to say. He said in a low voice, “By the way, quickly delete that video of yours. It has seriously affected my life, do you know that?”‘
Til delete it after you have dinner with me!”
Yelena smiled at Connor, then reached out to pinch Connor’s cheek.
“What are you doing?11 Connor subconsciously dodged.
“Can you stop acting like you’ve been abused? It’s your honor to be able to eat with me…” Yelena looked at Connor and smiled.
“I don’t feel that way…” Connor replied speechlessly.
“You really don’t know what’s good for you. 1 don’t even know what to say about you…”
Yelena waved at Connor and then walked toward the parking lot.
However, just as Connor and Yelena were about to go to the parking lot, a Mercedes-Benz stopped at the casino’s entrance. A man came out of the Mercedes-Benz.
When rhe man saw Yelena, he immediately looked happy. He shouted excitedly, “Yelena, you’re here!”
“F*ck, 1 knew nothing good would come our of being with you!” Connor saw that the man was coming for Yelena and sighed out loud.
“Why is he here?” Yelena looked at the man who walked out of the Mercedes-Benz and muttered puzzledly.
“You know this person?” Connor frowned and asked.
“Yes, this is an actor I met while filming in Horizon. 1 heard that his family seems to be quite rich. He has been wooing me recently, but I don’t like him, so
I didn’t agree to date him!” Yelena explained, then turned to look at Connor.
“Girl, what are you trying to do?” Connor noticed that Yelena’s eyes were a little strange and hurriedly asked.
“Connor, do me a favor!” Yelena said with a smile.
“What? I knew that you were up to no good. If you want help, you’d better find someone else to help you. I’m going home!”
Connor knew that Yelena was going to ask him to pretend to be her boyfriend again, so he turned around and planned to leave without thinking.
“Connor, if you dare to leave now, I’ll say I’m your girlfriend later! ”
Yelena saw that Connor was about to leave and quickly threatened him.
II?? II
When Connor heard Yelena’s words, he was instantly stunned and reluctant.
“Girl, what are you trying to do? Did I offend you in any way? Why do you insist on pestering me?” Connor asked Yelena helplessly.
“I have no choice. You’re the only guy by my side now. What will I do if you leave?” Yelena pouted and replied.
Connor knew how terrifying Yelena’s fans were. Now that Yelena had posted a video of Connor being wanted in the entire city, Connor had already been known by everyone.
If Yelena were to publish a video claiming she was Connor’s girlfriend, the consequences would be unimaginable!
“What do you plan to do now?” Connor frowned and asked Yelena.
“It’s very simple. You pretend to be my boyfriend and help me chase this annoying Jack away, and 1 won’t bother you anymore.” Yelena smiled as she told Connor.
“You want me to pretend to be your boyfriend again?” Connor asked speechlessly.
Previously, when Connor was in the restaurant, he helped Rachel put on a show.
Now, he was helping Yelena act again. Connor did not know if he was lucky or not!
“No, Connor, what do you mean? I asked you to pretend to be my boyfriend, and you’re unhappy about it?” Yelena shouted at Connor.
“As long as 1 help you get rid of this person, you won’t pester me anymore, right?” Connor gritted his teeth and asked Yelena in a low voice.
“Yes, as long as you help me get rid of this person, I won’t bother you anymore!” Yelena looked at Connor and nodded.
“All right, I hope you keep your word!” Connor gritted his teeth and agreed. He knew that he had no way out now.
He could help Yelena chase this man away or wait for her to post a video calling him her boyfriend.
Connor knew that Yelena wasn’t someone that could be easily offended. Once he offended Yelena, she would do anything.
Just as Connor and Yelena were talking, Yelena’s admirer, Jack, had already walked up to Yelena.
Then, he smiled and said to Yelena, “Yelena, I finally found you. 1 didn’t expect you to be here.”
“Why were you looking for me?” Yelena sized Jack up and asked impatiently.
Connor was also sizing up Jack. He could recognize that Jack was a very famous young hunk in the country. He had delicate features, but his acting skills were very bad. Rumors had it that his family was very rich.
When he was filming in Horizon, Jack met Yelena and fell in love at first sight. Then, he started to pursue Yelena crazily.
However, Yelena did not like him at all, so she had rejected Jack several times.
Jack went to Horizon two days ago to look for Yelena, but he heard that Yelena had returned to Porthampton because school had started again.
Therefore, Jack came to Porthampton again. With the help of his friends, he knew that Yelena’s car was parked at the entrance of Harlem’s Gold, so he ran to Harlem’s Gold.
But what Jack did nor expect was that Yelena was really here!
“Yelena, I’ve booked a seat at a Michelin restaurant in Porthampton. Why don’t you go eat with me?” Jack said to Yelena with a smile.
“What for?” Yelena rolled her eyes at Jack and said coldly, “Jack, I’ve already made it very clear to you back then. 1 don’t like you at all, and I won’t be with you, so you’d better give up!”
“Yelena, you don’t have a boyfriend now anyway. You can give me a chance to try. How will you know I’m suitable if you don’t try?”
Perhaps it was because he had been rejected by Yelena too many times; Jack was already a little numb now and did not seem to get angry at all.
“Who told you that I’m single?” However, Yelena’s words left Jack speechless..

chapters.title: Chapter 533 - 533: Coward!
chapters.content:
Chapter 533: Coward!
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
When Jake heard Yelena’s words, he was stunned.
Then, he asked Yelena in disbelief, “Yelena, what…What did you just say?”
“I said 1 already have a boyfriend!” Yelena coldly replied to Jake, then held Connor’s arm and said to Jake with a provocative look, “This is my boyfriend, Connor. We just got together!”
“Is… Is this your boyfriend?”
When Jake heard that, he was dumbfounded and very shocked!
Jake had also seen Connor beside Yelena just now, but Jake saw that Connor was dressed very ordinarily. He did not look like a rich person at all, and his appearance was not as good as his.
Therefore, Jake felt she would not like Connor since Yelena did not like him. He felt that Connor was just Yelena’s friend.
“Yelena, can you stop joking with me? Why are you with such a person?” Jake looked at Connor and said with a puzzled tone.
When Connor heard Jake’s words, he seemed upset.
This was already the second time others had looked down upon Connor. Previously, it was a woman; now, a man.
Connor didn’t know whom he had offended to keep encountering such things. “Jake, what nonsense are you spouting here? What does it have to do with you whether I’m with Connor or not?”
Before Connor could speak, Yelena had already voiced her concern, shouting at Jake.
“But this person is not worthy of you at all!” Jake lamented helplessly.
“Whether Connor is worthy of me is up to me, not you!” Yelena replied coldly, then continued, “Now that you’ve seen it, I already have a boyfriend, so please don’t harass me in the future. I can’t be with you…”
“Yelena, you’ve always wanted to be a big star. I can make you famous if you break up with this person now. By then, you can act in any show you want,” Jake shouted at Yelena.
“I’m sorry. I want to become a celebrity, but I want to become a celebrity through my efforts and not by relying on others. I’m doing well with Connor now,” Yelena said coldly to Jake.
“Yelena, why would you rather be with such a person than be with me? Am I inferior to this poor loser in any way?” Jake’s eyes widened as he spoke, frustrated.
“What Connor can give me is not something money can measure!” Yelena replied lightly, then dragged Connor’s arm and walked toward the parking lot. “Yelena, don’t go!”
When Jake saw that Yelena was about to leave, he hurriedly grabbed her.
“Jake, what are you doing? Let go of me!” Yelena shouted.
“Yelena, if you don’t break up with this person today, I won’t let you off!” Jake shouted back at Yelena.
When Yelena heard this, a trace of helplessness flashed in her eyes. She said, “Jake if you don’t let go of me, I’ll call the police now. Get it?”
“Call the police. 1 don’t believe the police can do anything to me!” Jake was using his shameless spirit to the extreme. No matter what Yelena said, he refused to let go.
Connor stood at the side and watched the commotion. He felt that Jake did not take him seriously.
Although Connor was just a fake boyfriend, what Jake said just now had already made Connor very angry.
Therefore, after hesitating momentarily, Connor walked to Jake and asked, “Please let go of my girlfriend…”
H H
When Jake heard this, he looked up at Connor. Then, he glared at him and angrily shouted, “Who the f*ck do you think you are?”
“I told you to let go of my girlfriend. Didn’t you hear me?” Connor said coldly.
“I won’t let go today. What are you going to do to me?” Jake shouted at Connor.
“Are you sure you won’t let go?” Connor asked with a smile.
“That’s right. Even if the president comes today, I won’t let go!” Jake said.
“Great! So great!” Connor looked at Jake with a faint smile, then turned around and walked into the casino.
After Yelena saw Connor leave, she was puzzled because she did not understand what Connor wanted to do.
“Yelena, did you see it? Your boyfriend is a coward. Why do you still want to be with such a person? Hurry up and break up with him!” After Jake saw Connor leave, he said to Yelena proudly.
“Jake, I won’t be with you even if 1 break up with Connor. Just give up!” Yelena replied to Jake coldly.
At this moment, Connor, who had already left, walked out of the casino with a machete.
They were even more puzzled after everyone saw the machete in Connor’s hand.
On the other hand, Jake had a calm expression on his face because he felt that Connor wouldn’t dare to do anything to him!
Connor walked up to Jake expressionlessly and asked with a smile, “Just now, you said that even if the president came, you wouldn’t let go, right?”
“That’s right. What will you do if 1 don’t let go? Will you kill me?” Jake asked Connor provocatively.
“Hah, 1 do not dare to kill you, but…”
Before Connor could finish speaking, he raised the machete and swung it at Jake.
The speed of the machete falling was extremely fast, so fast that it shocked people!
“Are you f*cking crazy?” Jake shouted when he realized what was happening, and then he let go of his hand out of instinct.
The machete stopped midair!
“Didn’t you say you wouldn’t let go just now?” Connor asked Jake playfully.
“You…”
Jake turned to look at Connor awkwardly. After all, he did say something like that just now.
“Do you think a person like you is worthy of snatching my girlfriend?”
Connor looked at Jake with a disdainful smile, then turned to Yelena and said, “Yelena, let’s go!”
“Coward!” Yelena didn’t forget to mock Jake as well. Then, she turned and was about to leave with Connor.
“Brat, do you dare to make a bet with me?” But at this moment, Jake suddenly shouted at Connor..

chapters.title: Chapter 534 - 534: Let’s Go In And Make A Bet
chapters.content:
Chapter 534: Let’s Go In And Make A Bet
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
“Want to bet?”
Connor was surprised at Jake’s suggestion.
He didn’t know what Jake meant.
“This is a casino, so let’s do things according to the rules of the casino. Come in with me and gamble. Whoever loses will leave Yelena,” Jake glared at Connor and suggested.
After Connor heard Jake’s suggestion, he could not help but laugh.
He did not expect Jake to be so childish. He wanted to solve the problem by gambling.
“I’m sorry, I don’t like gambling, and I’m not interested in gambling with you!” Connor replied to Jake indifferently and was about to leave with Yelena.
“You don’t dare to bet with me, right?”
After Jake heard Connor’s words, he immediately sneered. Then, he raised his chin and said arrogantly, “I don’t think you have the money to gamble with me. Why don’t I lend you some money?”
“Jake, what nonsense are you spouting here?”
After Yelena heard Jake’s words, she was very unhappy. She shouted, her eyes widened.
“How am I spouting nonsense? I’m telling the truth. This guy is a coward. He doesn’t even dare to make a bet. If he doesn’t have money, why would he pretend to be a rich heir to pick up girls?”
Jake was trying to goad Connor into gambling with him.
However, Jake’s provocation was useless against Connor. Connor whispered to Yelena, “Let’s go…”
“Go?” Yelena pouted and shouted. Then, she looked at Connor and said, “Why are you leaving? Since Jake wants to make a bet, let’s make a bet with him…”
Connor didn’t expect Yelena to be fooled. He said helplessly, “What bet? 1 only have a few hundred dollars on hand now. How can 1 gamble with him?”
Although Connor was rich, he didn’t want to waste time on someone like Jake. Besides, he wasn’t Yelena’s boyfriend. No matter if he won or lost, it wouldn’t benefit Connor at all.
“It’s okay. I have money on hand. You can rest assured and bet with him!” Yelena replied to Connor happily.
As one of TikTok’s top ten internet celebrities, Yelena had received many gifts and endorsement fees in the past few years.
Last time, Connor had also sent gifts worth several million dollars in Yelena’s live stream. Now, Yelena could be considered a veritable rich woman.
“What if I lose?” Connor frowned and asked Yelena.
“If you lose, it’s mine. No matter what, you can’t let this Jake look down on you today!” Yelena answered without thinking.
“Alright then!” Connor helplessly agreed after seeing Yelena’s determined look.
After all, Connor didn’t care about the money at all. If he really lost, he could go to Yelena’s live stream to return the money to her. It was just that it was a little cheap for Jake.
“What’s wrong? Have you thought it through and decided to bet with me?” Jake asked Connor with a smile when he saw Connor’s helpless expression.
“Since you want to make a bet, I’ll play with you!” Connor replied indifferently.
“How do you want to play? Do you know how to play poker and baccarat?”
Jake usually liked to play these two games, and he knew that once these two games were played, the outcome would be very high.
Therefore, he was prepared to win a huge sum from Connor!
“I don’t know how to play poker. Why don’t we play baccarat?” Connor said to Jake expressionlessly.
When Jake heard Connor’s words, he was instantly happy because he could feel that Connor probably didn’t know how to gamble.
There was no such thing as two people playing baccarat!
“Bro, are you joking with me? How can two people play baccarat?” Jake asked Connor with a smile.
“Can’t the two of us directly deal the cards and compete? I don’t know how to play other games. If you want to play, then let’s play. Otherwise, I’ll leave now!” Connor replied indifferently.
Connor had never been to a casino since he was young. He had only played baccarat with Dominic and Spencer once. He was also clear about baccarat rules, so Connor chose to play this now.
Jake looked at Connor and hesitated for two seconds. He did not want to lose such a good chance to win money.
Therefore, Jake said directly, “All right then. Let’s place our bets before the cards are dealt. Whoever has the bigger hand wins. What do you think?”
“Sure!” Connor nodded lightly.
“Then, let’s go!” Jake sneered, then turned around and walked into the casino.
Yelena also hurriedly dragged Connor into the casino.
After entering the casino, he exchanged his chips, and Yelena was ready to do the same.
But at this moment, Luke, who was about to go home from work, happened to see Connor waiting in the hall.
He hurriedly walked up to Connor and said with a smile, “Mr. McDonald, you haven’t left yet?”
“I ran into some trouble. Don’t expose my identity later, okay?”
Connor saw that Yelena wasn’t there and quickly reminded Luke.
He was worried that Luke would accidentally spill the beans when he gambled with Jake. Then, things would be troublesome.
“Don’t worry, I understand!”
Luke whispered back to Connor, then quickly turned around and walked to the security guard’s side to ask about the situation.
A faint smile appeared on his face after Luke knew that Connor and Jake would gamble. He couldn’t help but look at Yelena and then secretly compare her with his granddaughter.
“Although this girl is pretty, my granddaughter is not bad either. Since Mr.
McDonald likes this girl, he will like my granddaughter!”
Luke couldn’t help but mutter in his heart and then begin to plan how he should matchmake Connor and his granddaughter secretly.
A moment later, Jake and Yelena exchanged their chips.
Jake exchanged one million dollars in one go. Yelena saw that Jake had exchanged one million dollars, so she exchanged one million dollars for Connor.
No matter what, Yelena would never lose in terms of aura.
Since Connor and Luke knew each other, Luke had specially cleared the table for Connor and Jake. He also found a very sexy and beautiful dealer to deal cards to the two of them.
Jake foolishly thought that Luke had recognized him, so he was so attentive. He took the initiative to chat with Luke.
However, he did not know that Luke did not know who he was!

chapters.title: Chapter 535 - 535:I Got Royal Flush!
chapters.content:
Chapter 535:I Got Royal Flush!
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Inside Harlem’s Gold.
Connor and Jake sat opposite each other at the gambling table.
Yelena stood beside Connor, her face filled with nervousness.
Although Yelena looked bold and unrestrained on the surface, she had never been to a casino before or been in such a scene. Naturally, she was very nervous.
“Are the two of you ready?” the sexy dealer asked Connor and Jake with a smile.
“I’m ready. Let’s get started!” Jake couldn’t wait to win Connor, so he shouted anxiously.
“Mr…. Mr. McDonald, are you ready?” the beautiful dealer knew Connor’s identity, so she almost let it slip.
Connor quickly turned and glared at the beautiful dealer, then said indifferently, “1 am also ready…”
The dealer realized that she had said something wrong just now. She couldn’t help but cough and then looked at Connor apologetically.
The interaction between Connor and the dealer was very secretive, so Yelena and Jake did not notice anything unusual.
Jake carefully sized up the chips in front of Connor. He felt it would be meaningless to continue playing with Connor like this.
After all, if Connor was timid and placed very small bets, they could play for an entire night without a winner.
“Connor, if the two of us only compete in size, how should we bet?” Jake asked Connor with a smile.
“What do you mean by how should we bet?” Connor was stunned for a moment and asked Jake with a puzzled expression.
“Look, the situation is like this. When we place our bets, won’t it be unfair if I placed a million and you only placed ten thousand? There would be no way to continue playing, right?” Jake said to Connor with a smile.
“So what do you think is appropriate as a bet?” Connor asked indifferently.
“Let’s not bet in the first round. Whoever wins will decide how many chips to bet in the next round. If you win, you decide. If I win, I decide.” Jake was setting a trap for Connor.
Connor did not know much about baccarat, so he turned to look at Yelena and asked her softly, “What do you think of this?”
“All right, I think it’s quite fair…” Yelena nodded.
“All right, we’ll do as you say!” Connor replied to Jake, then turned to Yelena and asked, “Do you know how to play baccarat?”
“I know a little, but I haven’t played much…”
Yelena whispered back to Connor, then looked at Connor from head to toe. She shouted at Connor incredulously, “Bro, are you trying to tell me that you’ve never played baccarat before?”
Connor scratched his head awkwardly and said in a low voice,” Well, I used to play with my roommates, but I don’t remember how to play it now…”
“Bro, are you kidding me? Since you don’t even know how to play with the wheel, why didn’t you say so earlier? We can go play poker!” Yelena said, disappointed.
She felt that her one million dollars would go down the drain!
“Well, it’s still not too late for you to tell me how to play it now!” Connor said to Yelena with a smile.
“Phew…” Yelena looked at Connor and took a deep breath to calm herself. Then, she whispered, “Actually, the gameplay is quite simple. Everyone is dealt three cards, and the person closest to nine wins. If it exceeds nine, then you take a single digit. For example, if you get three sixes, your score is eighteen, so you take an eight. Do you understand what I mean?”
“Understood!” Connor chuckled and nodded.
“That’s right. If there are J, Qj K, or 10 in your hand, it will be counted as zero!” Yelena looked at Connor and added.
“Got it…” Connor looked at Yelena and nodded again.
“Bro, I am about to give up on you. If you had told me earlier that you didn’t know how to play baccarat, I wouldn’t have let you play…” Yelena hissed at Connor.
“I told you thought, but you did not believe me…” Connor felt misunderstood.
“Who knew you didn’t know how to play it at all? I thought you were pretending to be dumb to win and pretending to be low-key with me!” Yelena pouted and shouted.
“Girl, have you read too much fiction?” Connor snorted.
H ii
Yelena looked at Connor and didn’t know what to say.
Just as the two discussed how to play baccarat, the dealer had already begun to deal the cards!
First, everyone was given a card. Jake’s luck was indeed very good. The first two cards he got were six and three, meaning Jake had nine points!
Connor’s luck was very bad. He got a ten and a four. In this case, Connor’s points were three.
Of course, the most important third card had not been dealt yet.
If Connor could get a five, he would also have nine points!
Soon, the third card was dealt.
Jake got a king, while Connor got a three.
“I have nine points. You have seven points. You lose!” Jake said with a smile after seeing their cards.
“Almost!” Yelena said with some pity.
“It doesn’t matter. Anyway, I didn’t place a bet on the first round…”
Connor comforted Yelena softly, then looked at Jake and said, “According to the rules, the next bet is yours. How much are you prepared to bet?”
“We’re both men, so there’s no need to be so wishy-washy. I’ll play poker. One million!”
When Jake saw that his plan had succeeded, he did not hesitate and pushed all the chips before him to the middle of the table.
Luke, who was standing not far away, saw this. A strange look flashed in his eyes, but he didn’t say anything.
“Are you going to give me a hundred million bucks? Are you crazy?”
Of course, Connor didn’t have any reaction to this one million dollars. After all, one million dollars was nothing to Connor.
However, Yelena was very shocked because she did not expect Jake to place a bet so big.. Wasn’t he bullying Connor for the sake of it?

chapters.title: Chapter 536 - 536: I’ll Continue Gambling With You
chapters.content:
Chapter 536: I’ll Continue Gambling With You
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
“Jack, isn’t this too much?”
Yelena frowned and shouted at Jack.
“Nah. Isn’t it just a million dollars?”
Jack replied with a smile.
The passers-by who were originally watching the show around the gambling table all revealed shocked expressions when Jack bet a million.
Although Harlem’s Gold was the largest casino in Porthampton and was very famous in the country, it was still very rare to gamble a million dollars!
After all, one million was not a small amount. If someone gambled with one million in real life, it would definitely be a very shocking thing unless the person was really rich!
But how many people could be as rich as Connor?
To put it bluntly, in this society, a person with tens of millions of assets was enough to achieve financial freedom. Who would really gamble with a million?
When Connor saw Yelena’s shocked expression, he also pretended to be surprised and whispered to Jack, “I don’t think there’s a need to play so big, right? Why don’t you bet less…”
“If you don’t go big when playing Baccarat, can you still call it Baccarat?”
Jack looked at Connor and sneered.
“But 1 only have one million chips in my hand. If I lose, it’ll be gone…”
Connor continued to act.
Even Luke Phillips, who was standing not far away, couldn’t help but laugh when he heard Connor’s words. He secretly commended Connor for his acting skills!
When Luke gave Connor 20 million dollars, Connor didn’t even blink. Now, his heart ached because of this one million dollars? Was this a joke?
“If you lose everything, you can go exchange for chips!”
“But we all agreed just now that whoever wins the first round can decide the bet for the next round. Many people heard it just now. You’re not trying to weasel your way out of this, right?”
Jack sneered.
“Weasel my way out?”
When Yelena heard this, she pouted and shouted, then continued, “When did we say we’re going to go back on our words? Isn’t it just a million? I can afford to lose that much…”
After saying that, Yelena pushed all the chips in front of Connor.
Jack was very unhappy when he saw Yelena standing up for Connor again and again.
He also knew that the money was not Connor’s, but Yelena’s!
Jack knew Yelena’s financial situation. One million dollars might be a small sum of money to him.
But for Yelena, it was a lot.
Moreover, Yelena was able to spend so much money on Connor. This was enough to prove how important he was to her.
“Deal the cards!”
Jack took a deep breath and turned to the beautiful dealer.
“Alright!”
The beautiful dealer quickly agreed and began to deal.
Connor and Yelena stared nervously at the card in front of Connor. After all, this card was related to a million chips. If they lost, they would lose a million.
Soon, Connor’s three cards were dealt!
When Yelena and Connor saw the cards, their faces turned dark.
Because Connor got a Jack, a queen, and a two, Connor’s points were two points!
Two points was very small in Baccarat. Unless he encountered one point and zero, it was impossible to win.
“It’s over, we’re definitely going to lose!”
Yelena looked at Connor in dismay.
“My luck today might be a little bad…”
Connor replied helplessly, then threw the cards in his hand on the table and said in a low voice, “1 have two points!”
“Hahaha!”
When Jack saw the cards in Connor’s hand, he laughed proudly.
Although Jack didn’t know what his cards were, he felt that no matter how small his cards were, they couldn’t be smaller than two points!
At this moment, the other onlookers looked at Connor with pitiful eyes.
After all, this was a gamble worth a million. Connor actually got such a bad card. His luck was pretty bad.
“You guys better hurry up and exchange your chips!”
Jack shouted at him proudly, then slowly opened the three cards in his hand.
Jack’s cards were an eighty, a ten, and a king!
“Eight points!”
Jack bared his teeth and shouted.
He still won this round!
H 11
Connor thought that there would be a miracle, but when he saw Jack’s cards, he knew that there was no miracle at all.
Reality was cruel. A million dollars worth of chips had been lost in the blink of an eye.
“I’m sorry, I lost…”
Connor said to Yelena apologetically.
“It’s okay. Isn’t it just a million dollars? It’s nothing!”
Yelena pouted and replied to Connor. Then, she pulled him and continued, “Let’s not play anymore. Let’s go!”
“Okay!”
Connor nodded and was prepared to leave with Yelena.
“If the two of you want to leave, that’s fine. But Yelena, you have to break up with Connor and be with me. Otherwise, the two of you have to stay here and play with me!”
Seeing Connor and Yelena preparing to leave, Jack hurriedly shouted.
“Why?”
Yelena turned and glared at Jack as she shouted angrily.
“Why?”
Jack sneered and said indifferently, “Just because I’ve already made a bet with Connor. This game is not just about money. Whoever loses has to leave you. Now that you’ve lost and are about to leave, Connor has to leave you!”
“You’re really shameless. It’s my freedom to be with whoever I like. What does that have to do with you? Who are you? What right do you have to decide my matters!”
Yelena was already very unhappy after losing one million. After hearing Jack’s unreasonable request, she was naturally even angrier.
“Yelena, this is what we agreed on. You’re not going back on your word, are you?”
Jack asked with a vicious expression.
“When did 1 tell you…”
Yelena opened her mouth to speak, but Connor suddenly reached out to stop her. Then, he asked Jack expressionlessly, “If you lose today, you won’t harass Yelena anymore, right?”
“That’s right. I have always kept my word!”
Jack nodded lightly.
“Alright, then I’ll continue to gamble with you!”
Connor called out calmly, then turned to Yelena and said, “Go and exchange for more chips!”

chapters.title: Chapter 537 - 537: Four Million in Chips
chapters.content:
Chapter 537: Four Million in Chips
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Hearing Connor ask her to exchange for more chips, Yelena could not help but be stunned.
She stood there and hesitated for a couple of seconds. Then, she frowned and said in a low voice, “Alright, I’ll go exchange for more chips now!”
“I’m going to bet two million dollars on the next round. You’d better exchange for more chips!”
Jack quickly called out to her with a smile.
“Two million?”
When Yelena heard Jack’s words, she felt that this was getting out of hand.
She stared at Jack with her big watery eyes and said with an agitated expression, “Jack, are you crazy?”
“How am I crazy? I already told Connor. 1 won the last round, so I plan to bet two million this time. Do you have any objections?”
Jack replied playfully.
It was obvious that Jack was forcing Yelena and Connor to admit defeat. “Alright, you plan to bet two million, right? Then, I’ll play with you!” Yelena gritted her teeth and shouted fiercely. Then, she walked to the front desk of the casino and took out her bank card. She said to the beautiful receptionist, “Please give me two million in chips!”
“Alright!”
When the receptionist heard that Yelena wanted to exchange two million dollars in chips, she quickly swiped Yelena’s bank card in the system.
Luke Phillips noticed that something was wrong. When Yelena wasn’t paying attention, he walked to Connor and whispered to Connor, “Mr. McDonald, do you need my help?”
After all, Luke was the boss of the casino. If Luke wanted to help Connor cheat, it was very easy.
“You don’t need to cheat for such a small sum of money!”
Connor replied.
Luke didn’t say anything as he understood what Connor meant. He turned around and left.
Soon, Yelena returned to Connor’s side with the chips she had exchanged. Then, she whispered to him, “Connor, don’t be nervous. I still have more than five million in my card. At most, both of us will lose today. I can still earn it back in the future, but I can’t let Jack succeed!”
“Don’t worry, I won’t lose this time!”
Connor replied expressionlessly.
“I believe you!”
Yelena did not hesitate at all and nodded.
Connor, Yelena, and Jack returned to the gambling table.
Jack pushed out all his chips and then said to Connor provocatively, “I bet two million this time!”
“I also bet two million!”
This time, Connor did not hesitate at all and pushed out the chips in front of him.
“Hehe, you’re planning to fight to the death!”
Jack looked at Connor and sneered. Then, he turned to look at the beautiful dealer, indicating that she could deal the cards.
The beautiful dealer quickly finished dealing the cards.
Jack picked up the three cards in front of him and looked at them carefully.
Then, a smug smile appeared on his face.
“A three, a five, and a king. I’m sorry, eight points!”
Jack said to Connor with a smile.
In Baccarat, eight points was second only to nine points.
Unless Connor could get nine points, he would lose without a doubt.
This was also the reason why Jack’s expression was so smug.
From the time the dealer dealt the cards to when Jack looked at the cards, Connor had been sitting in his original position without moving, so no one knew what cards he had.
Connor took a deep breath and slowly opened his first card. It was a queen! Queen represented zero in Baccarat, so this card had no effect at all. Following that, Connor flipped the second card. It was an ace!
Right now, Connor’s point was 1, which meant that if Connor’s last card was a seven, the two of them would be tied. If it was an eight, Connor would win. For a moment, the atmosphere became tense.
Yelena frowned and stared at the last card in Connor’s hand.
After all, this card was related to the winning or losing of two million. Those who had nothing to do with Connor could not help but break out in cold sweat for him.
Flip!
Connor flipped the last card in his hand and threw it on the table.
A red Eight of Hearts appeared in everyone’s sight.
Everyone present was stunned!
No one expected Connor to really get nine points!
Jack looked at Connor with a dumbfounded expression. He could not even believe that the scene in front of him was real.
“Wow, it’s really nine points. Connor, you’re so dashing!”
After Yelena reacted, she shouted happily.
Unable to control herself, Yelena hugged Connor’s head and kissed him on the cheek with her sexy, red lips.
After being kissed by Yelena, Connor felt a little awkward.
However, Yelena didn’t think too much about it. She pointed at Jack and shouted, “Jack, weren’t you very arrogant just now? Why aren’t you talking now?”
“Isn’t it just one round? It’s not like I can’t afford to lose. Let’s continue!”
Jack gritted his teeth and replied softly.
“These should all be mine, right?”
Connor pointed at the chips on the table.
“That’s right, it’s all ours!”
Yelena was very happy and wanted to take back her chips.
However, Connor stopped her and said indifferently, “There’s no need to take them back!”
“Why?”
Yelena blinked her big watery eyes and asked Connor with a puzzled expression.
“According to our previous agreement, if I win this round, 1’11 decide the stakes for the next round, so I’m prepared to bet four million!”
Connor said lightly.
“Four million?”
Yelena looked at Connor in disbelief.
Because she didn’t expect Connor to become so crazy, ready to throw all his money in.
“Connor, are you kidding me? If we lose, we’ll lose everything!”
Yelena said hesitantly.
“Relax, we won’t lose…”
Connor replied expressionlessly. Then, he narrowed his eyes and asked Jack, “So? Do you dare to continue playing?”
It was obvious that Connor was using the same tactic as Jack.
Connor felt that there was no point in continuing to play with Jack, so he might as well bet a little more to scare Jack away.
“Kid, you have got guts!”
Jack took a deep breath and took out a bank card from his wallet.. He handed it to the bunny girl beside him and said in a low voice, “Give me four million in chips!”

chapters.content:

Yelena agreed happily.
When Jack heard Connor’s words, he was so angry that he almost vomited blood.

Even if Jack won, he would only win back the money he lost.

“I guess. According to the rules we’ve set, I have the final say on how much this round is. If you don’t have money, you can admit defeat now!”
Connor said lightly.
“Who said I don’t have the money?!”
Jack roared with a ferocious expression, then turned his head and shouted at the bunny girl beside him, “Go get me five million in chips!”
“Alright!”
The bunny girl then turned around and left with Jack’s bank card.
A moment later, the bunny girl returned to Jack’s side.
Jack pushed the chips in front of him and said to Connor with a fierce face, “Kid, I’m not afraid to tell you that there’s 20 million in my card. If you’re really powerful, you can win all my money today…”
“Haha…”
Connor couldn’t help but laugh when he heard this, but he didn’t say anything.
The beautiful dealer began to deal the cards.
The results this time were the same as the previous time. Jack had three points and Connor had eight points.
Connor won!
Jack looked at the chips on the table, and his eyes were red because he had already lost 10 million to Connor!
At this moment, all the money on the table belonged to Jack alone!
Even though Jack was very rich, losing ten million for no reason still made his heart ache.
“Do you still want to continue playing?”
Connor asked Jack with a smile.
“Why not? I f*cking told you, if you really have the ability, win all 20 million in my card!”
Jack shouted at the top of his lungs.
“Why are you doing this?”
Connor smiled helplessly, then took out five million from the chips on the table and handed them to Yelena. He smiled and said, “This is the five million we won. Keep it properly!”
“Alright!”
Seeing Connor win money, Yelena was naturally very happy.
“Why did you take away another five million?”
Jack glared at Connor and shouted.
“It’s my money. I can do whatever I want!”
Connor replied indifferently and then continued, “I’m still betting five million this round!”
“Calll-
Jack shouted, then threw the bank card to the bunny girl and shouted, “Exchange all the money in my card into chips. I don’t believe that…” “Alright, Mr. Fenton!”
The bunny girl agreed helplessly, then turned around and left with the bank card.
A moment later, the bunny girl returned to Jack’s side with nearly ten million in chips.
In fact, Connor’s bet was just to let Jack stop while he was ahead. Moreover, Connor was also giving Jack a chance. After all, Connor only took a small portion of the money. If Jack could win one round, he still had a chance to recoup his losses.
However, Jack was possessed today. Other than the first two wins, he didn’t win a single round.
Connor even suspected that Luke Phillips was secretly helping him, but Luke gave Connor a look indicating that he had nothing to do with this matter!
After a few rounds, Connor had already won all the chips in Jack’s hands that were close to 20 million.
The entire table of chips belonged to Jack.
These chips were placed in front of Jack, but he just couldn’t win them back!
Jack was very unconvinced. He was not willing to lose money to Connor like this.
However, there was a very real problem in front of him now, and that was that he no longer had any money on hand!

chapters.title: Chapter 539 - 539: Ten Percent Interest!
chapters.content:
Chapter 539: Ten Percent Interest!
Translator: End less Fantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
In less than half an hour, Jack had lost more than 20 million in chips to Connor.
No matter where this money was placed, it was definitely an unimaginable sum of money.
After all, this 20 million was enough for a person to live for a lifetime, and it was the kind of life where they did not have to worry about food and clothing.
However, this money was nothing in Connor’s eyes.
Because Connor did not lack this bit of money at all!
Yelena stood behind Connor with an excited expression on her face.
Because Yelena had only taken out three million, and now it had become more than 20 million. How could Yelena not be excited?
Jack looked at the nearly 28 million chips on the gambling table, and his expression was unusually ferocious.
Connor had already asked Yelena to take away the eight million chips, so there was still twenty million left on the table.
Connor felt that if he continued to gamble like this, he would definitely lose. If he lost, all the chips on the table would belong to Jack.
However, Connor had Yelena take eight million. In this case, even if Connor lost, the two of them could still win nearly five million. This money was already a lot for Yelena.
Therefore, Connor felt that if he lost, he would admit defeat and stop playing.
Connor was different from Jack. He didn’t care about his face now. After all, the money in his hands was real.
Jack looked at the chips on the table and was very unwilling.
At this moment, he no longer had the arrogant expression from before. All he could think about was how to win back the money.
Although Jack was a rich heir, 20 million was not a small sum to him.
However, he was in a dire situation, and that was that Jack no longer had any money in his hands.
Moreover, Jack was not from Porthampton and did not have many friends here, so he had to borrow money from others to continue gambling.
“Where is the boss of your casino?”
Jack shouted at the staff beside him expressionlessly.
The staff member was stunned when he heard Jack’s words. Then, he quickly turned to look at Luke, who was standing not far away.
Luke hesitated for a while, then walked to Jack with a smile and asked Jack softly, “Hello, sir. I’m the owner of this casino, Luke Phillips. Is there something I can help you with?”
“Can 1 borrow money here?”
Jack said in a low voice with red eyes.
It was not Jack’s first time visiting a casino. He knew that most casinos would provide loan shark services.
Therefore, in his opinion, Harlem’s Gold would naturally provide such a service.
“Are you planning to borrow money?”
Luke asked with a smile.
“That’s right!”
Jack nodded lightly.
“Then, how much do you plan to borrow?”
Luke looked at Jack and continued to ask.
Jack glanced indifferently at the chips on the table, gritted his teeth, and said softly, “1 want to borrow 20 million!”
“This…”
Luke looked troubled when he heard the number.
After all, he didn’t know Jack, and he didn’t know if Jack had the ability to repay the loan.
“Sir, that’s a huge sum, and we don’t know you, so I might not be able to lend you this money!”
Luke said in a low voice.
“My name is Jack, and my father is Jefferey Fenton. You should have heard of my father’, right?
“If you haven’t heard of him, you can ask your subordinates to ask around. Even the casinos in Horton and Masonville won’t hesitate if 1 say 1 want to borrow 100 million!”
Jack said confidently.
Luke was surprised when he heard that.
He didn’t expect Jack’s father to be Jefferey Fenton, so he asked Jack in disbelief, “Are you the young master of the Fenton Family?”
“You know my father?”
Jack glanced at Luke and asked calmly.
“I do!”
Luke nodded slightly, then turned to look at Connor, as if asking for his opinion.
After all, if Luke lent money to Jack, and Jack used the money to gamble with Connor, he was worried that he would offend Connor by doing so.
H H
After hesitating for a moment, Connor felt that if Luke didn’t lend Jack money, Jack would definitely not let it go. Moreover, even if he lost, he could help Yelena win five million dollars, which was a lot of money, so he gently nodded and acquiesced to Luke’s loan.
Jack looked confused when he saw the eye contact between Connor and Luke, because he felt that the relationship between the two was not simple. Otherwise, Luke would not have looked at Connor like that.
However, Jack was obviously in a hurry. He couldn’t care less about that. All he wanted to do now was to win back the money he had lost.
“What are you still standing there for? Hurry up and bring the loan contract over!”
Luke turned and shouted at the staff beside him.
“Alright, Mr. Phillips!”
The manager agreed and turned to leave.
A few minutes later, the staff returned to Luke with a loan contract and handed it to him.
When Luke took the contract, he smiled and said to Jack, “Mr. Fenton, this is the loan contract. There is the repayment period and interest on it.”
“1 don’t need to look at all that.”
Jack shouted with a frown.
“I think you’d better take a look!”
Luke replied indifferently.
After hearing Luke’s words, Jack couldn’t help but be stunned for a moment. Then, he picked up the contract and read it carefully.
When Jack saw the monthly interest of ten percent written on the contract, he was completely stunned.
He turned his head and shouted at Luke, “Why is the monthly interest rate of your casino so high?”
“I’m sorry, Mr. Fenton. Our establishment has always had this interest rate. If you can accept it, then sign it. If you can’t, then forget it!”
Luke replied with a smile.
It was obvious that Luke had deliberately doubled the interest rate. He hoped that this way, Jack would stop as soon as possible. After all, if Jack continued to lose like this, he would definitely have to borrow money, and it might cause big trouble.
Since Luke had raised the interest rate, Jack probably would not dare to borrow from them. Connor could also win some money. This was a good thing.
“Mr. Fenton, do you still want to borrow money?”
Luke asked Jack with a smile when he saw that Jack hadn’t said anything..

chapters.title: Chapter 540 - 540: Are You Playing With Me?
chapters.content:
Chapter 540: Are You Playing With Me?
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Although Jack often came to the casino to play, this was the first time he borrowed money from the casino.
After all, as the eldest young master of the Fenton Family, Jack had never lacked money. He did not need to borrow money from the casino at all.
However, Jack never thought that he would lose all the money in his hand. He had no choice but to borrow money from Luke.
Luke did not want to get involved in the matter between Connor and Jack.
However, when he found out that Jack’s father was Jefferey Fenton, he could only bite the bullet and give him face. After all, Luke and Jefferey had a good relationship.
Jack looked at the loan contract in his hand with a conflicted expression.
If he borrowed 20 million from Luke, he had to pay it back in two months. No matter when he would pay it back, he had to pay back 24 million.
An extra four million dollars in interest in two months was even worse than usury!
“Mr. Fenton, why not we forget about it? Your luck today isn’t very good, so there’s no need to continue playing!”
Luke saw Jack’s hesitation and advised him kindly.
“How is my luck bad today?”
Jack roared with a straight face and then said hatefully, “I don’t believe that this kid can keep winning today!”
After saying this, Jack picked up a pen and signed his name on the contract.
Luke sighed helplessly, not knowing what to say.
Luke had seen too many rich young masters like this. These rich heirs actually had one thing in common, and that was that they didn’t know how precious money was. After all, their money was not earned through hard work!
Connor was different from these rich heirs. Connor was very rational from the beginning to the end.
Even if he lost money, he wouldn’t get emotional. Just now, Connor had only lost one million dollars and was planning to stop. One must know that one million dollars might be as little as one hundred dollars to Connor, but he knew that enough was enough, but Jack didn’t understand this principle.
“Go get the chips!”
After Jack had signed the contract, he threw it to Luke and said with a ferocious expression.
Luke checked the contract carefully. After making sure that there were no problems, he nodded to the manager beside him.
The manager left with the contract.
A few minutes later, the manager returned to Jack’s side with 20 million dollars in chips.
When everyone saw the pile of chips, they were very excited.
After all, this amount of money might not be earned by ordinary people even if they were given several lifetimes, but Jack was able to squander it so casually!
Perhaps this was the difference between rich people and ordinary people!
Jack took a deep breath and whispered to Connor, “Can we start now?”
“Of course!”
Connor nodded lightly and then took all the chips on the table in front of him.
“What are you doing?”
Jack asked in confusion when he saw Connor put away the chips again.
“I think what you said just now was right. No one will win forever. 1 think I might lose this round, so I’m not going to bet too much this round…”
Connor said with a smile.
Bang!
When Jack heard Connor’s words, he slammed the table with an extremely angry expression. Then, he glared at Connor and shouted, “Are you kidding me?”
“Jack, what are you saying?”
Yelena pouted and shouted at Jack, then continued, “You set this rule yourself. Whoever wins can decide how much to bet in the next round. Are you going to go back on your word now? If you go back on your word, we won’t play anymore…”
H 11
Jack looked at Yelena and hesitated for a moment. Then, he calmed himself down and slowly said, “Alright, tell me. How much do you plan to bet this time?”
Connor looked at the chips in front of him and hesitated for a couple of seconds. Then, he took out a million dollars and threw it in the middle of the table. He smiled and said, “I’ll bet a million this round!”
“I’ll raise one million!”
Jack looked at Connor and shouted.
Crash!
Jack threw the chips in his hand onto the middle of the table, then turned to the beautiful dealer and shouted, “What are you waiting for? Deal the cards!”
“Alright…”
The dealer was a little scared as she replied, and then began to quickly deal the cards.
Soon, all three cards had been dealt.
Jack slowly picked up the three cards in front of him. When Jack saw the cards in his hand, he was unusually excited, but this excitement quickly disappeared.
This was because he had gotten the biggest card, nine points!
If it was the previous few rounds, Jack could have won back all the money he had just lost.
Unfortunately, Connor did not bet all his chips on this round. Instead, he bet a million!
This also meant that Jack could only win one million!
“I have a six!”
Connor grinned at Jack.
“I have a nine!”
As Jack spoke, he gritted his teeth fiercely, his expression abnormally ferocious!
Although Jack won this round, he was still very aggrieved!
Previously, when he placed a big bet, Jack only received small cards. Now that he had placed a small bet, Jack received a big card. Jack was about to collapse.
“If you win, these chips are all yours!”
Connor pointed at the chips in the middle of the table and said to Jack with a smile.
Crash!
After hearing Connor’s words, Jack did not hesitate at all. He pushed all the chips in front of him to the middle of the table and then shouted with his eyes wide open, “I won the last round, so I have the final say in this round. I want to bet 21 million. Are you in or out?”
At this moment, Jack’s chips were the 20 million he had just borrowed from Luke and the 1 million he had won from Connor. A total of 21 million!
Connor still had 19 million in chips left, as well as the 8 million that he had asked Yelena to keep.
Connor turned and looked at Yelena. Yelena took out two million chips and placed them in front of Connor.
Connor pushed all the chips to the middle of the table, then smiled at Jack and said, “I’ll raise!”
“Alright!”
Jack gritted his teeth and replied in a low voice. Then, he turned his head and shouted at the beautiful dealer, “Hurry up and deal the cards!”
Seeing this scene, everyone present was stunned.
Because there were almost 50 million in chips on the table. How big was this bet!
The beautiful dealer hurriedly began to deal the cards.
“Wait!”
But at this moment, Jack suddenly shouted.
“Mr. Fenton, what’s wrong?”
The beautiful dealer asked Jack softly..

chapters.title: Chapter 541 - 541: You Colluded
chapters.content:
Chapter 541: You Colluded
Translator: End less Fantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
“I want you to show all the cards when dealing, 1 want to watch you do it!”
Just as the dealer was preparing to deal the cards, Jack suddenly shouted with wide eyes.
After hearing Jack’s words, a hint of uneasiness flashed across the dealer’s face, and she said softly, “Mr. Jack, our casino doesn’t have a rule to deal cards openly.”
“I say we do!”
Jack shouted with a stern face, then looked at Connor and asked, “Connor, do you dare to deal the cards openly?”
The reason why Jack made such a request was very simple.
He felt that Connor was acting strange today. Whenever he placed a big bet, Connor would win, but if it was a small bet, Connor would lose. So Jack suspected that Connor might be cheating.
But if the cards were dealt openly, he wouldn’t have the opportunity to touch the cards, and naturally, he wouldn’t have the chance to cheat.
Connor knew what Jack was thinking, so he calmly said, “Since you want to deal the cards openly, then let’s do it openly…”
“Hehe…”
Jack smiled smugly when he saw Connor agree, then turned his head to the dealer and said, “Start dealing the cards!”
“Alright!”
The dealer nodded quickly and started dealing the cards directly.
Since Connor lost the previous round, he was dealt the cards first this time.
When everyone saw the dealer start dealing the cards, they widened their eyes, held their breath, and their faces showed excitement, as if they were afraid of missing anything.
Soon, the first card was dealt.
Connor’s first card was a 6.
And Jack’s first card was a Q.
Next was Connor’s second card, a 5 of clubs!
At this point, Connor had a point count of one, so Jack’s expression began to tense.
Because he knew that Connor’s next card would be crucial.
As long as Connor got a card with a value of nine or higher, his point count would be very low, and the chances of that happening were quite high.
After all, in baccarat, J, Ct and K are counted as ten.
Jack’s second card was an Ace!
At this point, both of them had a point count of one!
So all that was left was to see their third card!
In an instant, the entire casino became quiet. Everyone stared wide-eyed, their expressions tense, as they watched the dealer.
Even Yelena couldn’t help but clasp her hands together, afraid to take a breath.
The dealer took a deep breath and then began dealing the third card.
Soon, Connor’s third card appeared before everyone’s eyes.
But what shocked everyone, including Jack himself, was that Connor’s third card turned out to be a Q]
When everyone saw Connor’s card, they were all stunned, their expressions filled with disbelief.
No one expected that in such a crucial round, Connor would get a point count of one. It was simply like a joke!
Yelena stood behind Connor, her expression filled with helplessness. She knew what that one point represented!
Connor turned his head and glanced calmly at Yelena, then smiled and said, “It’s alright, even if we lose this round, don’t we still have six million chips in hand? We’ve already won six million…”
“That’s true. If you lose, so be it!”
On the other hand, Jack had a very proud expression on his face because he believed his plan had worked.
Since Connor couldn’t touch the cards, he naturally couldn’t cheat, so it was normal for him to get small cards.
“I don’t believe your luck can be good all night!”
He smiled smugly at Connor, as if he already had the victory in his hands.
Although his point count was also 1 at the moment, as long as his last card wasn’t a nine, he would at least tie with Connor. However, it was clear that he had a higher chance of winning.
The dealer hesitated for a moment and slowly drew the third card, placing it in front of Jack.
But when everyone saw Jack’s third card, they were all dumbfounded, including Jack himself.
He couldn’t believe his eyes. He stared dumbfounded at the poker card on the table, and his expression instantly froze.
Because his third card was actually a nine!
So his total point count was zero, the smallest possible score in baccarat.
“How… How is this possible?”
His expression was incredibly incredulous. He originally thought he would definitely win this round, but he never expected to end up with zero points!
All the chips on the gambling table belonged to Jack, totaling 42 million, of which he even borrowed 20 million from Luke!
