Jack sat in place, his face blank, and his expression dazed. He felt that everything was too unbelievable.
“Did… Did we win?”
Yelena stared at Connor with her watery eyes, finding it hard to believe, and asked.
“It seems like we did…”
Connor turned his head and glanced at her, smiling as he replied.
“Connor, you’re amazing! We actually won so much money?”
She couldn’t help but exclaim and then hugged him, starting to cheer.
However, this time she was noticeably more composed and didn’t kiss him proactively.
Seeing them so happy, Jack’s face looked ugly.
He suddenly stood up and pointed at Connor, shouting, “You fucking cheated!”
After Jack said these words, the entire casino fell silent, and everyone’s gaze focused on him.
He felt that this whole incident was too strange, too unbelievable to be true!
From the beginning until now, except for the first and middle rounds where Connor lost, he had been winning all along.
Moreover, in the round where he lost, he suddenly reduced his bet, so Jack believed that he must be cheating.
“Jack, what did you just say?”
Luke stepped forward with a dark expression and asked Jack.
“Mr. Luke, 1 think this Connor is cheating, otherwise, he wouldn’t have won this round for sure!”
Jack pointed at Connor, his expression full of excitement as he shouted.
“Jack, you shouldn’t say things recklessly. The dealer is our casino’s employee, and she dealt the cards according to your instructions. Connor didn’t touch the cards from start to finish, so how could he cheat?”
Luke asked with an expressionless face.
Among the people present, only Luke knew Connor’s identity. So he knew that Connor couldn’t possibly be cheating. How could a trillionaire like him cheat for such a small amount of money?
“But what if your casino colluded with Connor?”
Jack didn’t care anymore and blurted out this offending remark..

chapters.title: Chapter 542 - 542: A Sum of Huge Money
chapters.content:
Chapter 542: A Sum of Huge Money
Translator: End less Fantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Luke never expected that Jack would dare to say such words to him.
Although Luke had considered helping Connor initially, he was rejected by him. Therefore, there was no unfairness in the gambling between Connor and Jack today.
“Jack, what do you mean by that? Our Harlem’s Gold has always relied on the words ‘integrity’ and ‘trustworthiness.’ That’s why we have such a thriving business. But now, you’re actually saying that our casino colluded with Connor to cheat?” Luke shouted at Jack with a cold tone.
Although Luke would give face to Jack’s father, it didn’t mean that he feared the Fenton family. He had been in the casino industry for many years, and he had formidable economic strength and connections. If they really fell out, he was not afraid of the Fenton family at all.
Jack seemed to realize that he had said something wrong, and his expression became tense.
After all, Harlem’s Gold had been known as the most fair casino for many years. Not only did the employees of Harlem’s Gold not cheat, but the gamblers inside also dared not cheat.
“Mr. Luke, that’s not what I meant. I just spoke without thinking in the heat of the moment!” Jack hastily explained, then turned his head to look at Connor and whispered, “I think this kid must be hiding cards on him. He must be cheating!”
“Me, cheating?” Connor couldn’t help but smile lightly upon hearing his words. He squinted at Jack and said, “So now you suspect me of cheating?”
“Yes, I do suspect you of cheating!” He nodded quickly.
“Hehe…” Connor sneered and turned to Luke, asking, “Mr. Luke, what would you do if someone cheated in your casino?”
“Cut off their hands and return the winnings double!” Luke answered straightforwardly.
“Alright, I see!” Connor nodded lightly, then squinted his eyes and whispered to Jack, “If you suspect me of cheating, then I’ll give you a chance. I can allow the staff of Harlem’s Gold to frisk me. If they find any cards, I will return the winnings double as before, and you can even cut off my hands. But if they don’t find anything, you will cut off your hands and give me 50 million. What do you think?”
Upon hearing his words, Jack was instantly stunned.
He never expected Connor to be so audacious. Now he found himself in a difficult situation. He could sense his confidence when he spoke, indicating that he hadn’t cheated at all.
Jack had just lost nearly 50 million, and he didn’t know how to repay that amount. If Connor didn’t cheat, not only would he lose his hands, but he would also have to compensate him with 50 million. This deal clearly didn’t favor him!
“How about it? Do you dare to gamble with me? We can have Mr. Luke as the witness. If you don’t dare, then shut your mouth!” Connor stepped forward and domineeringly confronted Jack.
He hesitated for a moment, then gritted his teeth and said fiercely, “Fine, Connor, you’re ruthless!”
After saying that, He turned his head and glanced at Luke, then whispered, “Mr. Luke, I want to borrow another 50 million!”
At this moment, Jack surprisingly hadn’t given up and wanted to continue gambling with Connor.
Upon hearing this, Luke couldn’t help but smile helplessly and calmly said, “Mr. Jack, according to the rules of our casino, we cannot lend you any money until you have fully repaid your previous loan. Even if you repay the money, we cannot lend you 50 million because you don’t have the qualifications.”
“Mr. Luke, are you doubting my repayment ability?” Jack exclaimed, his eyes widening.
At this point, Luke didn’t give Jack any face at all. He simply nodded and said with a smile, “Yes, I am doubting your repayment ability now. If you really want to borrow money, you can call your father, Jeffery, right now. As long as he agrees, I can lend you money anytime.”
“You…” Jack’s expression turned extremely ugly upon hearing these words.
Because he dared not let his father know about this!
If his father found out that he had lost over 40 million in the casino, he would probably beat him to death.
“Fine, are you all ganging up on me?” Jack gritted his teeth and muttered.
“Mr. Jack, please watch your language. What do you mean by ‘ganging up on you’? If you continue to slander our casino, I will have the security directly throw you out!” Luke coldly said.
“No need for you to throw me out, I’ll leave by myself!” Jack shouted loudly, then walked straight up to Connor and pointed at his nose, saying, “Kid, I’ll remember you! Just wait for me!”
“Sure, I’ll be waiting for you to come and bring me money…” Connor replied with a smile.
“You…” Jack clenched his teeth and turned his head, walking outside the casino.
A few minutes later, he disappeared inside the casino.
Yelena looked at the chips on the table and could hardly believe what she was seeing. It was a whopping 50 million!
“Connor, are all these money really ours?” she asked Connor with her watery eyes.
“It is…” He gently shook his head.
“Well, we have to exchange them for cash!” she murmured to herself, then continued, “Connor, don’t just stand there, let’s quickly exchange these chips for cash…”
Connor looked at Yelena, and a hint of hesitation flashed in his eyes.
Because the amount of money in front of her was simply too much.
This money might not be much for Connor, but for Yelena, it was undoubtedly a huge sum. If she suddenly had such a large amount of money, he was worried that her life might be affected.
It’s a good thing to make someone rich, but it might not be a good thing if someone suddenly becomes wealthy.
Moreover, half of this money belonged to Connor as well. Once Connor agreed to let Yelena take the money, he would also become a rich man, and he wouldn’t be able to hide his identity anymore.
So, for the sake of both himself and Yelena, he believed that he must resolve this money issue.
And the fastest way to resolve it was to lose this money!

chapters.title: Chapter 543 - 543: Why Should I Give It to You?
chapters.content:
Chapter 543: Why Should I Give It to You?
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
“Yelena, I feel like I’m having a great streak of luck today. How about I play another round? What do you think?” Connor earnestly asked Yelena.
Yelena, who was originally sorting out the chips, couldn’t help but pause when she heard his words.
Then, with a puzzled expression, she shouted at Connor, “Connor, have you gone crazy? We’ve already won so much money. Why do you want to continue gambling?”
“I’ve never seen so much money in my life, and I always feel like this money doesn’t belong to the two of us. So I don’t want to take it!” he said to her.
She paused for a moment after hearing his words, and she could understand where he was coming from.
After all, he wasn’t a wealthy person. On the contrary, he used to be very poor and had to rely on delivering takeout to support himself.
Now suddenly receiving such a large sum of money, it was understandable that he couldn’t accept it.
It felt like a windfall dropping from the sky, but when that windfall landed in front of you, you wouldn’t have the courage to spend it because you would feel extremely uneasy.
“So what do you plan to do now?” Yelena hesitated and asked Connor softly.
“I don’t know how to handle this money right now, so I’m thinking of letting fate make the decision for me. Let me gamble this money one last time. If I win, we’ll take the money and go. If I lose, you still have eight million in your hands, right? We both would have won money, so there’s nothing to regret!” He smiled and said to her.
“Then let’s take out all the money we’ve won!” She thought for a moment and generously said to him.
Connor didn’t expect Yelena to agree so readily, but in fact, he wanted to leave the eight million to her.
Although this amount of money wasn’t particularly significant to Yelena, it could still help her change her current life.
But he never expected that she would want to take it all!
“It’s alright. Let’s just use the chips on the table. Even if we lose later, we won’t be at a loss!” Connor smiled and said to Yelena.
“Okay, I support your decision!” Yelena, who wasn’t lacking money herself, didn’t care much about this sum of money.
Moreover, she believed that all this money was won by Connor alone, so even if he lost in the end, it wouldn’t matter.
He was surprised to see Yelena’s enthusiastic agreement. His impression of her had also changed quite a bit at this moment. He realized that although her personality was sometimes quirky, she was actually very kind and not very materialistic.
“So, how do you plan to gamble?” Yelena asked Connor softly.
“I don’t think ordinary people would dare to gamble with us!” Connor casually replied, then looked up at Luke’s position and smiled as he said, “Mr. Luke, are you interested in gambling with me? Same rules as before with Jack. If you win, all these chips are yours. If I win, you’ll give me the corresponding chips!”
“Mr. Connor, what are you…” Luke couldn’t help but pause, his expression filled with confusion.
“Mr. Luke, 1 feel like winning this money too easily. If I just take it like this, I’ll feel uneasy. So I want to gamble one more time. If I win, it means this money truly belongs to me. But if I lose, then it’s not meant for me!” He explained to Luke while blinking his eyes, signaling him to quickly take away the money they had won.
Luke looked at him, stunned for a moment, and instantly understood his meaning. Based on his understanding of Connor, he believed that Connor didn’t actually want to keep the money, which was why he said such things.
“I don’t think there will be anyone in the casino willing to play at this scale with me. So how about you and I play a round, Mr. Luke?” he continued and stared at Luke.
“Hehe…” Luke smiled and nodded, understanding Connor’s intentions. He then said softly, “Alright, since Mr. Connor is interested, 1 will definitely accompany you. We’ll determine the outcome in one round. Let me have the chips prepared.”
“No need to go through all that trouble. Just deal the cards directly. You’re the owner here, I believe you won’t welch on the bet!” Connor replied with a smile.
“Mr. Connor is indeed straightforward. Let’s begin then!” Luke smiled in response and then turned to look at the manager beside him. He said in a low voice, “Ms. Lawson, why don’t you handle the dealing?”
Ms. Lawson was a skilled cheater, proficient in various techniques. At this moment, when Luke personally asked her to deal the cards, it held a certain meaning, which she naturally understood.
“Alright, Mr. Luke!” Ms. Lawson smiled and responded. She then walked over to the gambling table, started shuffling the cards, and dealt three cards to Connor and Luke.
Connor picked up his three cards, carefully examined them, and then placed them on the table. He said, “1 have seven points!”
“I’m sorry, Mr. Connor, I have nine points!” Luke revealed his cards and smiled.
“All…” Connor pretended to sigh with regret and then turned to Yelena, saying, “It seems like fate doesn’t want me to take this money!”
“If I knew this would happen, I wouldn’t have let you gamble. With this money, we wouldn’t have to do anything for the rest of our lives!” she pouted and said to him.
“Yeah, if I had known, I wouldn’t have gambled!” Connor helplessly replied.
“Alright, don’t be sad. I still have eight million in my hands. Aside from my three million, the remaining five million is the money you won today. I’ll give you half of it. Although this money won’t let you live comfortably for a lifetime, it’s enough for your livelihood!” she said softly to him after seeing him seemingly saddened.
Connor couldn’t help but turn his head and look at Yelena after hearing her words.
“How about it? Are you touched? Do you think I’m treating you well?” Yelena asked Connor with great joy.
“That’s the money I won myself. Why should I give you half?” He hesitated for a moment and then smilingly asked her.
“Oh, you heartless person! If it weren’t for me lending you money, would you have earned so much? And now you want to keep it all to yourself?” Yelena glared at Connor, her expression agitated as she shouted at him..

chapters.title: Chapter 544 - 544:I Will Kill You!
chapters.content:
Chapter 544:I Will Kill You!
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
“Connor, I never expected you to be such a heartless person!”
“If I hadn’t lent you money in the first place, how could you have won so much money? And now you want to keep it all to yourself? You have no conscience!”
Yelena, after seeing Connor’s intention to keep the money for himself, angrily shouted at him.
“You… You…”
She stared at him with angry eyes, her expression filled with fury, unable to find a way to refute him.
“Alright, I won’t joke with you anymore. 1 won’t take a single penny of this money, 1’11 give it all to you!”
It was only a mere five million, which he didn’t care about at all. He was just teasing her earlier.
“You… You won’t take any of this money?”
She was surprised to hear his words, her expression filled with disbelief.
“Yes, 1 lost so much money earlier, and I don’t want the remaining amount…”
Connor casually replied to Yelena.
She looked at him for a moment, then whispered, “Connor, 1 know your situation very well. I know you’re not a wealthy person. If we split this money evenly, you would still get over two million. Why don’t you want this money?”
She couldn’t understand his actions. Even an ordinary person, let alone someone like Connor, wouldn’t give up on over two million.
“Remember what 1 said earlier?”
He asked her in a soft voice.
“What did you say earlier?”
She paused for a moment, puzzled, and asked him.
“I said, if 1 won this round, it means that fate decided this money belongs to me, and I would take it. But if I lost, it means this money doesn’t belong to me…” he said casually.
“Connor, is there something wrong with your brain?”
She stared at him, her tone filled with confusion.
“What’s wrong with my brain?”
Connor paused, furrowed his brow, and replied.
“Don’t think I don’t know about your situation. You have to rely on delivering takeout to support yourself. Now you’re pretending to be a rich second generation. If you really had money, I wouldn’t stop you. After all, one less person to split the money means more for me. But your situation isn’t good, you can’t even afford your tuition. Now there are two million in front of you, why don’t you want it? Tell me!”
Yelena’s eyes were filled with tears as she was worked up.
“Even if I don’t have money, I can still support myself. But 1 definitely won’t take this money!”
He didn’t expect her to be so stubborn, insisting that he take the money.
“No, you must take this money today!”
Yelena raised her voice, blocking Connor’s way.
He looked at her, his expression speechless, not knowing what to say.
“I said 1 wanted to keep the money, and you disagreed. Now I say I won’t take a single penny, and you still disagree. What exactly do you want?”
He asked her, feeling a bit overwhelmed.
Yelena took a deep breath, then furrowed her brow and said to Connor, “1 don’t have the mood to discuss these things with you now. We must split this money in half. That way, you won’t have to worry about tuition anymore. I’ve never seen someone like you before. Even if 1 give you money, you don’t want it. Is there something wrong with your brain?”
“If you insist on giving me this money, I’ll go and lose it right now…” he replied indifferently.
“What exactly are you thinking?”
She felt completely overwhelmed after hearing his words, not knowing what to say.
While they were discussing how to divide the five million, Jack sat alone in his Mercedes, his expression filled with anger.
Originally, he came for Yelena today, but not only did he fail to win her over, he was also humiliated by Connor.
However, what made him angrier was that he lost a whopping fifty million to Connor!
Even as a wealthy second generation, that number made him feel a pang of pain!
“Connor, I will definitely kill you. Just you wait!”
Jack took a deep breath, then started the car to leave.
But at that moment, Connor and Yelena walked out of the casino.
Connor couldn’t argue with Yelena, but he couldn’t keep this money in his own hands either. If he accepted the money, Yelena would know he was rich, and others might find out too.
So they agreed that they would split the money evenly between them. However, all the money would be in Yelena’s hands. If he encountered any urgent need for money, he could take it from her.
She also thought this was a more reliable approach, so she agreed to it.
He knew that under normal circumstances, he wouldn’t need this money, but if something unexpected happened, like what happened with Yannick last time, and he really lost his eligibility to inherit the fortune, he would have a backup plan.
After all, this over two million was not Steven’s inheritance, nor was it earned through his inheritance. It was all money Connor won himself.
If the time came when he really lost the trillion-dollar inheritance, he could still live a good life with this money.
They walked out of the casino, chatting and laughing.
At this moment, Yelena’s mood was still very good. After all, Connor had just taught Jack a lesson, and she had also won so much money from him. Naturally, her mood was uplifted.
Inside the Mercedes, when Jack saw the two of them laughing and talking, his expression seemed even more angry. His face twisted with fury.
“It’s all because of this damn Connor. If it weren’t for him, Yelena might have been with me by now!”
He muttered in a sinister tone, then began searching for weapons inside the car..

chapters.title: Chapter 545 - 545: Jack Had Lost His Mind
chapters.content:
Chapter 545: Jack Had Lost His Mind
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Jack searched for a while in the Mercedes car and finally found a folding knife. Today’s events had completely driven him insane. He looked at the folding knife in his hand and a sly smile appeared on his face. He immediately hid the folding knife in his clothes, opened the car door, and got out of the car.
“Connor, what would you like to eat later? 1 have money now. I can treat you to anything you want. Even a five-star hotel is not a problem…”
Yelena asked Connor with a smile.
“Anything is fine. I don’t have any specific preferences for food…” he replied with a smile.
“Alright then, I know there is a good private restaurant in our city. Let’s go there…” she answered after thinking for a moment.
“Okay!”
Connor nodded and followed Yelena towards the parking lot.
However, at that moment, he suddenly noticed that Jack was walking towards them.
“Yelena!”
Jack tried to control his anger and shouted at Yelena.
“Jack, why are you still here?”
She was surprised when she saw him and asked with a puzzled tone.
“Yelena, I really like you. Can you reconsider being with me? This guy is simply not worthy of being with you…”
Jack seemed to still have hope and pleaded to her.
“Jack, I’ve told you many times already. I don’t like you at all. Even if 1 break up with Connor, I would never be with someone like you. So just give up!” she impatiently shouted at him.
“Yelena, are you really not considering being with me anymore?”
Jack gritted his teeth and asked her in a low voice.
At this moment, she was not aware of the danger at all and disdainfully said, “That’s right, I will never be with someone like you in my entire life. Even if I have to die, I won’t be with you. So just leave!”
“Heh…”
He sneered and stared at her.
“Connor, let’s go!”
She grabbed his hand and turned around, walking towards the roadside.
Connor could sense that something was off with Jack, but he couldn’t pinpoint what exactly was wrong. He thought maybe Jack was just in a bad mood after losing money, so he didn’t think much of it and turned to leave.
Just as they turned around, Jack suddenly revealed a sinister look in his eyes. Without hesitation, he took out the folding knife from his clothes and shouted loudly, “Since you refuse to be with me, then you can die!”
After saying this, Jack raised the folding knife in his hand and stabbed it directly towards Yelena’s back.
Everything happened so suddenly that she couldn’t react in time.
Connor, however, quickly reacted and pulled her into his embrace.
“All!”
Yelena instinctively screamed.
Connor turned around and blocked Yelena with his arm.
Although his reaction was quick, he was still an ordinary person, so the folding knife cut his arm.
Blood instantly stained his arm.
“Die!”
Jack shouted when he saw that his stab didn’t hit Yelena. He raised the folding knife in his hand again and stabbed towards Connor’s arm.
“Bang!”
Connor didn’t give Jack a chance to succeed, and he kicked him directly in the body.
Perhaps feeling his life was threatened, Connor put almost all his strength into that kick, directly hitting Jack’s chest.
Jack, a rich heir, had already been drained by his indulgence in alcohol and women, so his physical condition naturally couldn’t compare to Connor’s.
After receiving Connor’s powerful kick, he took several steps back, then crashed into his Mercedes car with a loud bang.
Ignoring the wound on his arm, Connor chased after him.
Knowing that he couldn’t match Connor, he quickly pulled open the car door and got inside.
“Vroom, vroom…”
Once inside the car, he started the engine and drove towards the street.
After crashing into two guardrails in succession, he disappeared from Connor’s sight.
“Connor, are you… alright?”
It was only now that Yelena realized what had happened and hurriedly rushed to Connor’s side. She looked at his arm, which was already stained red with blood, and tears instantly welled up in her eyes.
She was well aware that Jack had clearly come after her.
If it wasn’t for Connor taking the knife for her, she might have lost her life by now!
“Jack is not a professional assassin, and the stab wasn’t very deep. It shouldn’t be a big deal.”
Connor turned his head and glanced at her, softly reassuring her.
“Should… Should we call the police?”
She took out her phone, stuttering as she asked him.
Clearly, she hadn’t realized how crazy Jack had become today, daring to wield a knife and attack someone in broad daylight.
“You said Jack comes from a powerful family, right? If we really call the police and they see my minor injury, they probably won’t be able to give Jack a sentence. Otherwise, let’s forget about it!”
Connor replied nonchalantly.
At this moment, his thoughts were very simple. There was no need to involve the police in such a small matter.
Although he could use his influence to deal with Jack, he didn’t want to do so.
Because if he did, then what was originally a simple matter could become very complicated.
“Well, what you said makes some sense. Then let’s go to the hospital and bandage your wound first. Your hand is still bleeding!”
After seeing that Connor’s injury wasn’t too severe, Yelena’s expression visibly relaxed. She quickly took out the car keys, started the car, and drove towards the hospital..

chapters.title: Chapter 546 - 546: Because I’m Poor!
chapters.content:
Chapter 546: Because I’m Poor!
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
The injury on Connor’s hand was not very serious. Although he had lost a lot of blood just now, the injury did not hurt his artery. Therefore, when Yelena brought Connor to the hospital, the doctor only helped Connor bandage it up briefly, and then he could be discharged.
After Yelena confirmed with the doctor several times that Connor was really not in any danger, she left the hospital with Connor in peace.
“You really scared me to death today…”
After leaving the hospital, Yelena let out a heavy sigh and turned to look at Connor. She asked Connor with some heartache, “Does your arm still hurt?”
“It’s alright. It hurt a little at the beginning, but it’s much better now!” Connor replied with a smile.
“Why are you so stupid? Why didn’t you dodge just now?”
Yelena seemed somewhat exasperated as she shouted at Connor.
“If I had dodged just now, wouldn’t this knife have stabbed you? Now that the two of us are fine, isn’t that pretty good?” Connor said indifferently.
After Yelena heard Connor’s words, a trace of gratitude flashed across her eyes.
After all, Connor had risked his life to save her just now. No matter who it was, they would be very touched when they encountered such a thing.
Yelena hesitated for a moment before speaking to Connor. “Thank you so much for today. If it weren’t for you, 1 might have lost my life long ago!”
“You don’t have to thank me. I think Jack might still find trouble with you, so you’d better be careful during this period of time. Try not to go out at night!”
Connor whispered to Yelena.
“You don’t have to worry about that. I’m going back to Horizon to continue filming in two days. There will be so many people in the production team. Jack definitely won’t dare to cause trouble for me!”
Yelena whispered back to Connor.
“By the way, you seem to have been filming this summer. How’s your acting going? When will the film be released?”
Connor had nothing to do, so he started to chat with Yelena.
“I… My movie is pretty good, but it will only be released after a while!”
When Yelena said this, her eyes were obviously evasive, and her tone was also a little nervous, as if she was hiding something from Connor.
Connor could feel that something was wrong with Yelena, so he frowned and asked, “Did you encounter any trouble while filming?”
Yelena was stunned for a moment before she hurriedly replied, “No… It’s not much trouble. I’m quite good at filming…”
Connor finally realized that Yelena had never brought up her filming career, and she had never told anyone how the filming was going.
Connor felt that this was not like her at all. Not only that, Yelena was stammering at this time. He felt that something might be wrong, so he wanted to continue asking Yelena if she had encountered any trouble.
If Yelena really encountered any trouble, he could still help her.
After today’s events, Connor had begun to accept Yelena.
“I mean, there’s nothing 1 can do about it. I’m fine, though. Where do you live? I’ll send you home!”
However, it was obvious that Yelena did not want to answer Connor’s question, so she changed the topic.
When Connor heard that Yelena wanted to send him home, he suddenly remembered that he was living in the mansion at Royal Villas.
If Connor really asked Yelena to send him back, then Yelena would definitely find something wrong.
However, if he didn’t let Yelena go, if he knew her personality well, she definitely wouldn’t let the matter go. Moreover, Connor really couldn’t find an excuse not to let Yelena send him home.
After all, Connor didn’t drive, but Yelena did.
Therefore, Connor hesitated for a moment before saying softly, “Didn’t you say you wanted to treat me to a meal? Let’s go eat first!”
Connor was going to take Yelena to the restaurant to drink some wine. In this way, Yelena would not be able to drive, and Connor could openly take a taxi home.
After Yelena heard Connor’s words, she couldn’t help but roll her eyes at Connor. Then, she pouted and said, “Bro, you’re already in this state, yet you’re still in the mood to eat?”
“I’m a little hungry…”
Connor said to Yelena with a smile.
Yelena looked at Connor speechlessly and said softly, “Can your current body handle it?”
“I’m going to eat, not fight. What’s wrong with that?”
Connor replied helplessly.
“I really have to hand it to you. You were almost killed just now, but you still have an appetite!”
Although Yelena said so, she still pulled open the door of her red Maserati and said, “What are you still doing? Hurry up and get in the car. Besides, I’m going back in a few days, so I won’t have the chance to eat with you then…”
Connor smiled and walked into the Maserati.
After getting into the car, Connor simply looked at the situation inside the car and then asked Yelena with a smile, “Your car seems quite expensive, right?”
“It’s okay. It’s only about two million. Compared to the money you lost today, it’s nothing!” Yelena replied indifferently.
“Where did you get so much money?”
Connor asked Yelena in disbelief.
“I can earn more than a hundred thousand just by taking on any advertisement or shooting a video. Don’t forget that I’m a big internet celebrity with five million fans! It’s just that I’m usually lazy and don’t like to take on advertisements, so I earn less money. However, this money is enough for me to live for a long time. You even helped me win so much money today, so I don’t have to take on advertisements anymore…”
Yelena explained as she drove.
“I see. But you’re already so rich, so why do you still want to act?”
Connor seemed puzzled as he asked Yelena.
After Yelena heard Connor’s words, she couldn’t help but turn her head to look at Connor. Then, she said softly, “My dream since I was young was to be an actor. I didn’t become an actor to make money.”
“Dreams?”
Connor couldn’t help but laugh when he heard Yelena’s words.
“What are you laughing at? Don’t you have any dreams?”
Yelena asked Connor unhappily.
“I…”
Connor looked at Yelena and hesitated for a moment before saying softly, “Actually, I also had a dream, but 1 don’t have it anymore!”
“Why?”
Yelena asked in a puzzled tone.
“Because I’m poor!”
Connor said lightly..

chapters.title: Chapter 547 - 547: Private Restaurant
chapters.content:
Chapter 547: Private Restaurant
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Because Yelena often went to that private restaurant to eat, she was very familiar with the road.
In less than half an hour, Yelena parked the car in front of a private restaurant called Garden of Spices.
Along the way, Yelena and Connor talked about a lot of things from before.
Connor realized that although Yelena’s behavior was a little strange, her heart was still very kind. At the very least, she was much better than what Connor had imagined.
This also made his impression of her much better.
However, Connor found something very strange. Whenever Connor mentioned Yelena’s filming career, she would stutter, as if she was not very willing to talk about it.
Therefore, Connor did not continue to press her on the topic. Since Yelena was unwilling to say it, Connor did not need to continue to ask.
“I often come to this restaurant to eat. The food here is quite good. You must eat more…”
Yelena said to Connor with a smile as she led him into the restaurant.
“Don’t worry, I’ll definitely eat more. Besides, I’m not the one paying…”
Connor replied with a smile.
Yelena was wearing a low-cut dress with spaghetti straps today. Her figure was extremely voluptuous. Most internet celebrities liked to push their beauty to the maximum when they posted videos.
However, Yelena never turned on her beauty filter because she was very beautiful. Her delicate oval face without makeup gave people an especially refreshing feeling. Her skin was smooth and delicate, and she wore a silver necklace that rested on her collarbone, looking extremely dazzling.
Even so, it was already enough to charm all living beings. If she used a beauty filter, the effect might be counterproductive.
Yelena was about 1.7 meters tall, and she was wearing a pair of 8cm high heels today. Her overall height was nearly 1.8 meters, which made Connor, who was only 1.75 meters tall, feel a little awkward.
When the two of them walked together, Yelena was obviously a head taller than Connor.
Connor didn’t think too much about it, but when the people in the restaurant saw him and Yelena come in together, they all misunderstood that Connor was Yelena’s boyfriend.
One of them was a poor student who looked very ordinary, while the other was a peerless beauty who could topple a country. These two people were obviously not a good match when placed together.
“Wow, that girl is so beautiful. She’s really tall…”
Many of the girls showed envious expressions when they saw Yelena.
“This beauty is indeed beautiful, but isn’t her boyfriend a little too short? The two of them are obviously not a good match!”
“If I can find a girlfriend like this, I won’t even need to sleep at night…”
“This man must be very rich. Otherwise, how could he find such a beautiful girlfriend?”
The discussions of the surrounding guests spread into Connor and Yelena’s ears.
Yelena turned her head to look at Connor and said proudly, “Did you hear what these people said?”
“They were talking so loudly, how could I not hear them?”
Connor pursed his lips and replied helplessly.
“They thought that the two of us were a couple, and they even said that you weren’t worthy of me!” Yelena said with a smile.
“They are obviously blind…”
Connor replied in a low voice as he found a table near the window.
Yelena sat across from Connor and said, “Why are they blind? It’s obvious that everyone can see that you’re not worthy of me, okay?”
“I don’t like you that way, so what if I’m not worthy of you?”
Connor replied indifferently.
“Tsk, you’re so boring!”
Yelena rolled her eyes at Connor and waved at the waiter not far away.
The waiter hurriedly took the menu and walked to Connor and Yelena’s side. Then, he asked with a smile, “What would you like to eat?”
“Connor, you order!”
Yelena looked at him, but Connor said, “Forget it. It’s my first time here and I’m not familiar with the food. You should order. I’m not picky.”
“Then I won’t hold back!” Yelena smiled happily and began to order.
Perhaps it was because she often came here to eat, but she was very familiar with the cuisines here. She ordered many dishes in one go, and there were many meat dishes among them.
Connor looked at Yelena and said helplessly, “”Big Sister, there are only two of us. Can you eat so much?”
“Why can’t I eat it?”
Yelena pouted and replied, then continued, “I’m going back to Horizon to film soon. You don’t know how hard it is to be on the production team. I have to eat enough outside this time before going back…”
“The food in the production team shouldn’t be very bad now, right?”
Connor said helplessly.
“It’s alright, but it’s still far from being comparable to the outside world…”
Yelena replied lightly, then returned the menu to the waiter and said softly, “Alright, let’s order these things first. If it’s not enough, I’ll order more…” “Alright!”
The waiter politely replied to Yelena, then turned around and left with the menu.
“Wait!”
But at this moment, Connor suddenly shouted.
After Yelena heard Connor’s words, she blinked her eyes and asked Connor with a puzzled expression, “Is there anything else?”
“Well, I want to drink some wine…”
Connor whispered to Yelena.
“Drink?”
When Yelena heard Connor’s words, she could not help but be stunned for a moment. Then, she said softly, “Why do you suddenly want to drink?”
“I think we won so much money today and escaped a disaster. Shouldn’t we drink some wine to celebrate?”
Connor grinned.
“You’re not trying to get me drunk and then plot against me, are you?” Yelena asked Connor with a smile.
“If that’s what you think, then don’t drink anymore. If you drink too much later, who knows who might be plotting against whom?” Connor said helplessly.
“I was just joking with you. Why are you so stingy? I do think we should drink some wine to celebrate today. What do you want? Red wine or white wine?” Yelena asked Connor softly.
“Some beer. It’s not that intoxicating!”
Connor’s purpose of letting Yelena drink was to make her unable to drive so that he could take a taxi home. This way, Connor would not have to worry about exposing his identity.
“Then get us two bottles of beer!”
Yelena turned her head and said to the waiter with a smile.
“Alright!”
The waiter nodded and turned to leave.
After Connor and Yelena chatted for a while, the waiter began to serve the dishes.
It had to be said that the dishes in this private kitchen were indeed very good. At the very least, Connor was eating very well. After the dishes were served, the two of them began to eat their own food and did not talk too much.
But at this moment, Connor did not know that danger was gradually approaching!

chapters.title: Chapter 548 - 548: Grizzly Bear and Leopard
chapters.content:
Chapter 548: Grizzly Bear and Leopard
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
At the entrance of the private restaurant.
A white van slowly stopped beside Yelena’s Maserati.
The car window slowly rolled down, and a man wearing a baseball cap poked his head out and carefully observed Yelena’s car.
Then, he turned to the burly man beside him and said, “Big Brother, it’s this Maserati. They should be in the hotel…”
“Get out of the car!”
The burly man replied expressionlessly, then pushed open the car door and got out.
The man in the cap also got out of the car and walked straight to the restaurant.
“What are you doing?”
The burly man shouted with his eyes wide open when he saw the man in the cap walking straight into the restaurant.
“What else can I do? Aren’t we here to kill? Now that those two guys are in the restaurant, can’t the two of us just go in and kill them?”
The man in the cap grinned and said.
“Pa!”
When the burly man heard this, he slapped the man in the cap on the head and glared at him. “Is there something wrong with your brain? There are so many people in the restaurant. If the two of us go in now, even if we can kill those two people, how are the two of us going to come out?”
After hearing the burly man’s words, the man in the cap could not help but be stunned for a moment. Then, he blinked and asked, “Then what do you think we should do now, Big Brother?”
“How many times have I f*cking told you? In our line of work, you must use your brain. You must not be impulsive. Otherwise, you won’t even know when you’ll be killed…”
The middle-aged man replied softly. Then, he found a medium-sized machine from the van. When the security guard at the door was not paying attention, he walked directly to Yelena’s Maserati and installed the machine on the door.
After about ten minutes, the middle-aged man wiped the sweat off his forehead and said with a frown, “This Maserati is awesome. It took so long to open it!”
After saying this, the middle-aged man reached out and opened the door, then walked into the Maserati.
After getting into the car, the burly man briefly checked the situation inside the car. After confirming that there was no problem, he turned his head and said to the man in the cap, “The two of us will ambush them in the backseat. After they finish eating, they will definitely drive back. Moreover, they will definitely sit in the front row. When the two of them get in the car, you and I will shoot them both.”
The man in the cap hurriedly nodded and took out a gun. After hesitating for a moment, he asked the burly man, “Then should I install the silencer?”
“Did a pig eat your f*cking brain? Why wouldn’t you install one? Wouldn’t the security guards at the door know when we shoot? How are the two of us going to run?” The burly man shouted excitedly with his eyes wide open.
The man in the cap nodded, then took out the silencer and installed it on the gun.
The burly man sat in the back row with his eyes narrowed. He looked at the entrance of the restaurant and quietly waited for Connor and Yelena to come out.
These two people were very infamous assassins in Porthampton. They had committed many crimes, but had never been caught by the police. It was said that the fees of these two people were very high—one million dollars to kill one person.
No one knew the real name of the slightly older man, but those who knew him liked to call him Grizzly Bear.
The other one who was slightly younger was Grizzly Bear’s younger brother, Leopard.
“Big brother, after I finish this order, 1 don’t plan to continue working…”
Leopard whispered to Grizzly Bear while smoking.
When Grizzly Bear heard this, he couldn’t help but be stunned for a moment. Then, he frowned and asked, “Why?”
“Didn’t you say that the two of us would get 20 million dollars after finishing this job? I think this money is enough for the two of us to live freely for the rest of our lives, so there’s no need to continue working. We’re so worried every day. If we die one day, won’t all this money be for nothing?”
Leopard lowered his hat and said in a low voice.
H H
Grizzly Bear thought for a moment, then said in a low voice, “What you said is also very reasonable. After the two of us finish this deal, we’ll wash our hands of it and go back to our hometown to open a small business…”
“Yes!”
Leopard quickly nodded.
“By the way, did you get rid of all the cameras on the street?”
Grizzly Bear asked Leopard cautiously.
“I’ve dealt with it long ago. Don’t worry about this. It’s not the first time we’ve done this kind of thing. I’ve already done what needs to be done.”
Leopard grinned and took out two photos from his clothes. One of them was of Connor, and the other was of Yelena.
“Big brother, what kind of trouble do you think this kid has gotten into? Someone actually offered 20 million to kill him. No matter how 1 look at it, I don’t think this kid is worth 20 million…”
Leopard looked at the photo and muttered softly.
“Since someone is willing to pay 20 million to kill him, it means that he is definitely worth this price…” Grizzly Bear said expressionlessly.
Leopard looked at the photo in his hand with a hint of passion in his eyes. Then, he said softly, “Big Brother, can I discuss something with you?”
“What is it?”
Grizzly Bear was stunned for a moment and asked softly.
“I think the other woman is very beautiful. She seems to be an internet celebrity and seems to have a great figure. It’s not easy for the two of us to meet such a beautiful woman. Isn’t it a waste to kill her directly?” Leopard grinned and said.
When Grizzly Bear heard this, he couldn’t help but look at Yelena’s photo. Then, he licked his lips and said, “This woman does look pretty good…”
“Big brother, our main mission this time is to kill Connor, and this b*tch is just a side job. After the two of us finish this job, we can be considered to be set for the rest of our lives. Why don’t we not kill her today?”
Leopard chuckled.
Grizzly Bear was silent for two seconds before whispering, “If I can get such a woman into bed, I’ll be happy to take five million less. Let’s do as you say!”
It was obvious that Grizzly Bear was also very interested in Yelena.
“Hehe…”
After hearing Grizzly Bear’s words, Leopard smiled a little wretchedly and continued to stare at the restaurant entrance.
Killing Connor alone would earn him 20 million, and he could have sex with a beauty like Yelena. Leopard felt excited just thinking about it..

chapters.title: Chapter 549 - 549: Those Two Have Disappeared!
chapters.content:
Chapter 549: Those Two Have Disappeared!
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
In the restaurant.
Connor and Yelena had no idea that they were being targeted by a pair of assassins.
Half an hour later, Yelena finally put down her utensils.
Then, she said to Connor with satisfaction, “I’m so stuffed I could die… I wonder how many pounds 1’11 gain after this meal…”
“You’re so thin. You have to eat more!” Connor replied indifferently.
“That won’t do. I’m a famous actress. I have to maintain my figure at all times!” Yelena replied with a pout. Then, she waved at the waiter and said with a smile, “Waiter, the bill, please!”
“Miss, you spent a total of 2,538 dollars today!”
The waiter handed the bill to Yelena as he spoke. After Yelena took the menu, she glanced at it briefly, then took out her bank card and handed it to the waiter.
When Connor heard the price of this meal, his face immediately revealed a trace of surprise.
He didn’t expect this meal to be so expensive. Although Connor was very rich now, he still felt that it was a bit too much for the two of them to spend more than 2,000 dollars for a meal.
“The food here has always been so expensive. Otherwise, it wouldn’t be so delicious!” Yelena said with a smile after seeing Connor’s surprised expression.
“Even if it’s delicious, it can’t be so expensive!”
Connor replied lightly, then stood up and walked out of the restaurant. Yelena followed closely behind him.
A moment later, Connor and Yelena walked out of the restaurant.
It was already eleven o’clock at night. There were not many pedestrians on the street, only a few cars were driving.
Yelena took out her car keys from her bag and walked towards her Maserati.
The two assassins in the Maserati became nervous when they saw Yelena and Connor coming out of the restaurant.
“They’re coming out. Get down quickly!” Grizzly Bear said to Leopard in a low voice.
Leopard was stunned for a moment. Then, he quickly lay down in the back seat and quietly waited for Connor and Yelena to get into the car.
At this moment, no one from the outside could see that there were two people hiding in the car.
“Connor, let me drive you home!” Yelena said to Connor with a smile as she walked towards the Maserati.
“Well, you drank just now, so you shouldn’t drive!” Connor quickly said.
When Yelena heard Connor’s words, she realized that she had drunk wine and said softly, “That’s right. I drank just now, so I can’t drive…”
“Let’s take a taxi back. I’ll send you home first, and then I’ll go back!”
Connor said lightly.
“Alright then!”
Yelena nodded helplessly, then took two steps to the side of the road. Suddenly, she turned her head and shouted at Connor, “Your place isn’t far from Davenport River in our city. Since the two of us have nothing to do, why don’t you accompany me for a walk by the river?”
After Connor heard Yelena’s words, he was about to open his mouth to reject her. However, he realized that Yelena did not care about his opinion at all; she walked straight to the riverside in her high heels.
At this moment, Yelena seemed to be in a very good mood. She was holding a yellow Gucci bag in her hand.
After walking to the riverside, Yelena couldn’t help but stretch and feel the breeze blowing on her face.
Perhaps it was because of the light, but Yelena’s perfect figure was directly exposed to Connor’s line of sight. Her waterfall-like soft long hair fell over her shoulders. Her figure was hot, and her legs were slender and fair. She looked extremely attractive.
It had to be said that there was a reason why Yelena could become an internet celebrity, and that was that every part of her body satisfied the aesthetic standards of most men.
Connor also felt that Yelena was very beautiful. However, he already had Freya in his heart, and he also had Chloe as his lover, so he did not want to have anything to do with Yelena.
At the same time, inside the Maserati, Leopard and Grizzly Bear were still quietly waiting for Connor and Yelena to get into the car.
However, after waiting for a few minutes, Leopard suddenly felt that something was wrong. He could not help but whisper to Grizzly Bear, “Big Brother, how long has it been? Why haven’t the two of them gotten into the car yet?”
“How the f * ck would I know…” Grizzly Bear replied impatiently.
“Why don’t I take a look?” Leopard asked softly.
“Alright, take a look!”
Grizzly Bear and Leopard were lying in the car. Although the people outside couldn’t see them, they couldn’t see outside either.
“Be careful. Don’t let anyone see you…”
Grizzly Bear said, his eyes wide open.
“I know…” Leopard replied in a low voice, then slowly raised his head and looked out of the car window.
“Those two people…”
“What happened to those two?” Grizzly Bear asked anxiously.
“They seem to have disappeared!” Leopard said in surprise.
“What?”
When Grizzly Bear heard this, his eyes instantly widened. Then, he suddenly sat up and looked out of the car window. He realized that Connor and Yelena had really disappeared.
“F * ck, where did they go?”
Grizzly Bear shouted with his eyes wide open, and then began to look around for Connor and Yelena.
“Big brother, did they discover us?” Leopard asked nervously.
“Impossible, how could they know that the two of us were in the car?!” Grizzly Bear replied expressionlessly, then continued, “These two must have gone on a date somewhere else. Let’s get out of the car and look for them…”
After saying this, Grizzly Bear directly reached out and pushed open the car door. Then, he got out of the car and walked towards the riverside.
After all, that was the only place they could’ve gone to.
Davenport had always been a famous scenic spot in Porthampton City because it could be said to be the most beautiful place in the entire city. Once night fell, many couples would gather here.
There was another Plaza in front of Davenport, called Davenport Plaza, but most young people liked to call it “Pecker Plaza.”
This was because many couples would choose to kiss here.
However, because Connor and Yelena arrived late, there was no one in the plaza at the moment. It was very quiet.
Yelena walked to the riverside and placed her arm on the railing. The cool breeze gently blew her hair.
At this moment, Yelena’s face had a faint blush, and her perfect figure was exposed to Connor’s sight without reservation.
At the same time, Leopard and Grizzly Bear also arrived at the riverside and happened to see Connor and Yelena.
“Should we make a move?”
Leopard asked Grizzly Bear excitedly..

chapters.title: Chapter 550 - 550: Can You Swim?
chapters.content:
Chapter 550: Can You Swim?
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Davenport Plaza.
Because of the angle, Yelena’s round buttocks were exposed to Connor’s line of sight.
Connor would always unconsciously stare at Yelena’s alluring body.
It couldn’t be helped—her figure was too charming. Even if Connor didn’t have any other thoughts about Yelena, he couldn’t help but take a few more glances at her.
Yelena turned around and asked Connor softly, “Connor, do you know what this place is called?”
“1 don’t know. I’ve never been to this place before!”
Connor lightly shook his head. After all, whenever he had time, he would work to earn money. He had no time to play around. As a result, even though Connor had lived in Porthampton for a long time, he was not very familiar with many places in the area.
Yelena turned her head to look at Connor and said softly, “This place is called Pecker Plaza. When 1 first came to Porthampton, 1 had heard of this place. I thought that if 1 had the chance in the future, 1 would definitely bring my boyfriend here, but I never got one. 1 didn’t expect to end up here with you…”
“Didn’t you say you weren’t interested in men?” Connor said helplessly to Yelena.
“I said that just to make those people who pursued me give up. Actually, I like men too. Can’t you tell?”
Yelena rolled her eyes at Connor helplessly.
“So that’s how it is!” Connor nodded thoughtfully, then looked at Yelena and asked, “Do you have someone you like now?”
“Yes!” Yelena nodded gently.
“Who is the person you like?”
After Connor heard Yelena say that she had someone she liked, he was somewhat curious. After all, it was very difficult for a woman like Yelena to have a man she liked.
“Why would 1 tell you?”
Yelena pouted and replied, then pointed at the fence and said, “Connor, I want to try climbing up there!”
After Connor heard Yelena’s words, he shouted helplessly, “Are you crazy? You’re wearing high heels, why do you want to go up there?”
“I just want to stand up and take a look. Can’t you help me?” Yelena replied willfully.
“Then can you climb up by yourself?”
Connor frowned.
“Aren’t you talking nonsense? If 1 could climb up, why would 1 ask you to help me? Moreover, I’m wearing a short skirt now. If 1 go up, you’ll be able to see everything…How about this? You go up first and then pull me up…” Yelena said lightly.
Connor looked at Yelena and hesitated for before saying in a low voice, “Then why don’t you go up and take a look, and then we’ll go home together?” “Alright!”
Yelena agreed happily.
Connor had no choice but to follow Yelena’s instructions and jump directly onto the fence. After he stabilized himself, he offered his right hand to Yelena and said softly to her, “Come up!”
Yelena quickly stretched out her small hand and grabbed Connor’s palm tightly.
Connor pulled her up.
However, Yelena was wearing a pair of high heels, so she wasn’t as stable as Connor. Therefore, he had been using all his strength to help Yelena stand up.
“All!”
At this moment, Yelena’s body tilted and she lost her balance.
Connor’s reaction speed was still very fast. He reached out and hugged Yelena’s slender and soft waist, pulling her into his embrace.
One had to admit that Yelena’s waist was very soft, and it was very comfortable to hug her.
After Yelena saw Connor hugging her, she knew that Connor was doing this to protect her safety, so she didn’t say anything more. However, a trace of shyness flashed in her eyes, and she regretted that she shouldn’t have come up. Now that she was taken advantage of by Connor, she couldn’t say anything.
“Can we go down now?”
Connor whispered to Yelena.
“Take my phone out of my bag. I want to take a photo…”
Yelena said softly.
“It’s already so late. What’s there to shoot? Moreover, it’s pitch black on the other side. You can’t take any pictures, right?”
Connor shouted at Yelena with a broken tone.
“What do you know? Hurry up and take out my phone…” Yelena pouted and replied.
H ii
Connor couldn’t possibly beat Yelena in a contest of stubbornness, so he could only helplessly reach out and open her bag, preparing to take out her phone.
However, the moment Connor lowered his head, he suddenly saw Leopard and Grizzly Bear running towards him and Yelena.
After Connor saw these two people, a trace of doubt flashed across his eyes.
Because it was almost midnight, there was no one by the river at this time. The appearance of these two people was obviously not right.
Moreover, there was another very important point: Connor saw that those two people were dressed very warmly. Not only were they wearing windbreakers, but they were also wearing hats!
Although the summer heat had passed, the temperature was still very hot. And these two people were dressed so warmly that they looked very out of place!
The expression on Connor’s face suddenly became nervous. He could not help but recall what Jack did at the entrance of the casino tonight.
Even if these two people had nothing to do with Jack, Connor himself had many enemies—whether it be Rockefeller’s men or Yannick Lee’s men, it was very likely that they would hire someone to assassinate him!
“Connor, did you find my phone? Are you taking advantage of me on purpose?”
Yelena saw that Connor had been rummaging in her bag for a long time but still hadn’t found her phone. She could not help but frown and shout at Connor.
Connor hesitated for a moment before asking Yelena softly, “Do you know how to swim?”
“Swim?”
After Yelena heard Connor’s words, she was obviously stunned for a moment. She asked in a puzzled tone, “What are you talking about?”
“I asked if you can swim?” Connor repeated in a low voice.
“I… I know a little…” Yelena was stunned for a moment before answering.
“That’s good!”
Connor replied indifferently, then suddenly pushed Yelena into the Davenport River!
“All!”
Yelena instinctively screamed, unable to react to what was going on.
After pushing Yelena into the Davenport River, Connor also jumped in.
When Leopard and Grizzly Bear saw this scene, a trace of shock flashed across their eyes. The two of them simply did not expect that Connor would actually discover them.
“Attack!”
Grizzly Bear shouted and quickly took out his gun from under his clothes and ran towards the fence.
“How did this kid react so quickly?”
Leopard couldn’t help but sigh and quickly chased after him.
However, when the two of them came to the fence, they found that Connor and
Yelena had completely fallen into the river and were nowhere to be seen..

chapters.title: Chapter 551 - 551: A Narrow Escape
chapters.content:
Chapter 551: A Narrow Escape
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Near Davenport.
When Leopard and Grizzly Bear saw Connor and Yelena jump into River Davenport, they were abnormally angry.
After all, Connor’s current life was worth twenty million. Moreover, the two initially thought killing Connor would be very simple.
But they never expected Connor to escape under their noses.
Leopard stared at River Davenport below the fence and asked Grizzly Bear angrily, “Bro, what should we do now?”
“What else can we do? If we don’t kill this kid, it won’t be so easy for us to make a move next time. Help me keep an eye here. 1’11 go down and kill this kid…”
As Grizzly Bear spoke, he took off his coat and threw his phone to the side of the road. He took out a dagger and jumped down without thinking.
Leopard was not very good at swimming, so he did not jump in. Instead, he stood on the shore and stared at the river.
There were very few people near Davenport at the moment. Basically, no one had seen the thrilling scene that had just happened.
Leopard held the gun tightly and stared at the river nervously. As soon as Connor appeared, he would shoot him to death.
After Connor and Yelena jumped into River Davenport, Yelena instinctively struggled and wanted to stick her head out.
However, Connor quickly reached out and held Yelena down, indicating that Yelena must not reveal herself.
Connor had seen Leopard and Grizzly Bear pull out something from their pants, so he knew very well that they must have guns in their hands.
If Yelena revealed herself now, it would expose their location.
Connor was good at swimming. He had been lurking in the water and observing the situation on the surface. Connor felt that since the other two were professional hitmen, they would chase after them.
After a while, Connor found nothing unusual in the water. He reached out and gently pulled Yelena, then brought her forward.
Fortunately, it was midnight. Connor and Yelena would have no chance of survival if they were on a busy street.
After all, the other party had a gun in his hand. However, it was dark around Davenport, and there was no light.
Connor felt that as long as he could carry Yelena as he swim for a distance, no matter how skilled the hitmen were, it would be impossible for them to find the two of them.
Although Yelena did not know what was happening, she knew in her heart that Connor was in danger. Therefore, she followed Connor’s instructions and swam forward.
After about two minutes, Connor felt it was difficult to breathe, so he instinctively wanted to raise his head to catch his breath and observe the hitmen’s position.
“All!”
But just as Connor was about to raise his head, Yelena suddenly screamed.
Connor suddenly turned around and looked at Yelena. He found a hand holding Yelena’s ankle; it was Grizzly Bear.
“Not good!” Connor exclaimed in his heart and quickly swam toward Yelena.
When Grizzly Bear saw Connor coming over, he immediately let go of Yelena and stabbed at Connor with a dagger in his right hand.
Under normal circumstances, Connor would not be a match for Grizzly Bear.
However, they were in the water now. Grizzly Bear had already wasted much energy to catch up to Connor and Yelena.
Moreover, due to the resistance of the water, when Grizzly Bear stabbed at Connor with its knife, he couldn’t move fast enough.
Connor instinctively dodged. The blade did not stab Connor’s vital points but cut his arm.
Connor couldn’t care less about the pain in his arm as he stuck his head out of the water and let out a long breath.
Grizzly Bear seemed to be planning to take advantage of this opportunity to catch its breath, but Connor did not give Grizzly Bear this opportunity at all. He kicked Grizzly Bear’s head.
“Thud!”
Grizzly Bear, already lacking in oxygen, found his right leg cramping after being kicked by Connor. He struggled crazily in the water.
Connor knew that Grizzly Bear must have cramped up, but he was not in the mood to care about the Grizzly Bear’s life and death. He shouted at Yelena, “Quickly swim forward…”
After Yelena heard Connor’s order, she quickly waved her hands and swam forward.
Connor looked at Grizzly Bear, still struggling in the water, and his heart suddenly wavered.
However, he was worried that it would be troublesome if Grizzly Bear was acting to trick him.
“You’re on your own!” Connor looked at Grizzly Bear, sighed softly, and swam toward Yelena.
“Bro, what’s wrong?”
Leopard on the shore saw that something was wrong and hurriedly shouted.
“My… My leg is cramping. Hurry up and come down to save me…” Grizzly Bear was struggling in the water as he shouted intermittently.
“F*ck, why do you have a leg cramp now?” Leopard cried desperately. Then, he took off his clothes and jumped into the water.
After Connor saw the second person jump into the water, he was relieved because he knew the hitman’s accomplice must have come down to save him. At least no one would die.
“Connor, I think I have cramps too. 1 can’t swim anymore…” Yelena suddenly shouted at Connor.
Although the weather in Porthampton was hot, it was still very cold in the water. A normal person would have cramps when they went in.
Connor hesitated momentarily before pulling Yelena into his arms and swimming toward the shore.
“Connor, where are we going now?”
Yelena was in Connor’s arms, and her face suddenly turned red. After all, she had never been so close to a man.
“Swim to the opposite shore. The hitman just now had a cramp in his leg. If they return the way we came, we will die!” Connor calmly analyzed.
“Will that person die?” Yelena asked Connor with a frightened expression.
Yelena had experienced two assassination attempts in a day. She must be very nervous. Connor could feel her body trembling.
“I don’t think so. I heard his accomplices come down to save him…” Connor said lightly.
“That’s…That’s good!”
Yelena replied to Connor with a trembling voice but said nothing else.
Fortunately, the distance between the two banks of River Davenport was not very far. It was at most about 500 meters.
Therefore, even if Connor had to carry Yelena, he could still swim across. If it were River Yarlford in Yarlford, they would probably die in the river..

chapters.title: Chapter 552 - 552: Take A Shower At Mine
chapters.content:
Chapter 552: Take A Shower At Mine
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Ten minutes later, Connor and Yelena finally swam to the shore.
After the two people came ashore, they shook off the dirty water on their clothes and looked very sorry.
Fortunately, neither of them suffered any serious injuries. It was just that Grizzly Bear slashed Connor’s arm again.
If not for Connor’s quick reaction, they would have died at the hands of Grizzly Bear and Leopard.
A breeze blew, and Connor and Yelena were drenched.
Yelena trembled as she said, “Connor, thank you so much for just now. I didn’t expect this Jake to be so crazy, so crazy to hire hitmen to kill me!”
“The other party might not be after you but me!” Connor replied in a low voice.
“They are after you?”
After Yelena heard that, she couldn’t help but be stunned. She said with a puzzled expression, “How is that possible? You’re just an ordinary student. Who has such a huge grudge against you? To even hire hitmen to kill you…”
“If they are hitmen hired by Jake, I don’t think they would have come looking for us so soon. After all, it takes time for Jake to find hitmen…” Connor analyzed out loud.
“Did you offend someone?” Yelena frowned and asked Connor.
“…” When Connor heard this, he glanced at Yelena.
He didn’t want to tell Yelena about his issues yet, so he could only say indifferently, “Maybe the people in the casino have their eyes on the money in our hands, so they want to kidnap the two of us to extort money…”
“That’s also possible!” Yelena nodded gently.
Connor felt that Jake did not send these two hitmen.
It was impossible for Jake to find the hitmen so quickly. Connor felt these two people would likely be Rockefeller’s or Yannick’s men!
Yannick had the guts to do such a vicious thing.
“Well, Connor, it’s not very far from my place. Why don’t you shower and change your clothes at mine first?” Yelena was shivering from the cold as she stammered to Connor.
“Sure…” Connor nodded gently, then helped Yelena up and walked toward the roadside.
A few minutes later, Connor and Yelena came to the roadside. A taxi happened to pass by, and Connor hurriedly hailed the taxi.
When the taxi driver saw Connor and Yelena in such a state, he couldn’t help but be momentarily stunned. He asked in a puzzled tone, “What were you two doing? Swimming?”
“…” Yelena was an internet celebrity. She was worried the taxi driver would recognize her, so she kept covering her face with her hand.
“Sir, we accidentally fell into River Davenport just now…” Connor explained helplessly.
“You have to be careful. 1 heard River Davenport is not shallow…” The taxi driver replied indifferently, then looked at Yelena and said softly, “Young man, remember to make some ginger water for your girlfriend when you get home. Girls are built differently from us men. Don’t catch a cold…”
“Yes!” Connor nodded lightly and didn’t say anything more to the taxi driver.
About ten minutes later, Connor and Yelena arrived at the residential area of Yelena’s place.
This was not the first time Connor had come to Yelena’s house, so they quickly returned home.
When she got home, Yelena realized that Connor’s arm was bleeding. She hurriedly asked Connor, “Connor, why is your arm bleeding again? Should we go to the hospital?”
“There’s no need to go to the hospital. Just find some gauze and bandage it!” Connor replied indifferently.
Connor had always thought that nothing good would happen when he met Yelena. Now, this came true. Connor hadn’t met Yelena for the entire summer vacation, and nothing happened. However, as soon as he met Yelena today, he was injured twice.
“Are you going to be fine?” Yelena frowned and asked Connor.
“I’m fine. Don’t worry, I’m not that weak!” Connor replied Yelena.
“All right then!”
Yelena looked at Connor and nodded helplessly. Then, she took some gauze and disinfectant from the drawer in the living room and helped Connor bandage it up.
After the bandages were done, Yelena whispered to Connor, “Well, Connor, why don’t you shower first?”
“You should go first. I’m not very cold now…” Connor replied to Yelena lightly. He found that Yelena was shivering from the cold, and her clothes were wet. If she didn’t take a shower, she would catch a cold.
“So I’ll go take a shower first?” Yelena was also quite cold then, so she whispered to Connor.
“Go on! Don’t freeze and catch a cold!” Connor indifferently replied to Yelena.
Yelena looked at Connor, took a deep breath, then turned around and walked into the bathroom.
“Whoosh…”
A few seconds later, Connor heard water flowing from the bathroom.
Connor took out his phone, but he found that his phone had died because of the water.
So Connor found Yelena’s home phone, picked up the phone, and then put in Thomas’s phone number from his memory.
“Ring, ring!”
The phone rang twice before Thomas picked it up and asked softly, “Who is it?”
“It’s Connor!” Connor said in a low voice.
“Mr. McDonald?”
Thomas was stunned when he heard Connor’s voice. Then, he asked in a puzzled tone, “Mr. McDonald, why are you using this number to contact me? Did something happen?”
“I met two hitmen just now. These two probably came for me!” Connor said slowly.
“Someone wants to kill you?”
Thomas’s tone changed drastically when he heard that. He hurriedly replied, “Mr. McDonald, where are you now? I’ll bring someone over to look for you now…”
“There’s no need…” Connor replied indifferently and continued, “I’m out of danger now. I’m calling you to help me investigate the information of these two hitmen. They should still be in Porthampton. You’d better find them and ask the mastermind behind them.”
“Understood…” Thomas hurriedly said.
Connor briefly described the appearance and appearance of the two hitmen to Thomas. Although it was not very detailed, it was fortunate that the physical characteristics of these two people were very obvious.
Connor felt that if Thomas followed these characteristics, he should be able to find these two people very quickly.
“Okay, Mr. McDonald, I got it. I’ll get someone to look for it now!” Thomas hurriedly replied after listening to Connor’s description..

chapters.title: Chapter 553 - 553: Do You Have Extra Clothes?
chapters.content:
Chapter 553: Do You Have Extra Clothes?
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Connor had just finished talking to Thomas on the phone when Yelena walked out of the bathroom.
Perhaps it was because she had just showered, but Yelena looked very sexy.
Her wet hair was draped over her shoulders, and her pretty face was red like a ripe apple.
Yelena usually wore only a nightgown in the bathroom at home. This nightgown was very revealing. Her long snow-white legs swayed in the air leisurely. She looked very pleasing to the eye.
Connor was stunned when he saw Yelena. He secretly sighed in his heart that Yelena was really attractive. It invoked the desire in others!
However, Connor did not have such thoughts at the moment. All he could think about was who had attacked him.
“Connor, who did you call just now?” Yelena wiped her hair and asked Connor softly.
“My friend…” Connor replied casually, stood up, and said, “Are you done? I’ll go shower now…”
“Hurry up and go. Don’t freeze!” Yelena replied to Connor.
Connor walked toward the bathroom, but he suddenly stopped after two steps. He turned to Yelena and asked, “By the way, do you still have any clothes at home? My clothes are all wet. 1 might not be able to dry them for a while…”
“My house is full of my clothes. You probably can’t wear them… How about this, you take a shower first? When my hair is dry, I’ll buy you clothes. There should be a mall open now!” Yelena hurriedly replied to Connor.
“That’ll be great, thanks!” Connor replied in a low voice. After all, he couldn’t wear Yelena’s clothes.
“What trouble? 1 might have died long ago if it weren’t for you today. I should be the one thanking you!” Yelena smiled and replied to Connor.
Connor looked at Yelena with a faint smile and turned to walk into the bathroom.
Yelena saw Connor enter the bathroom and find a hairdryer to dry his hair. Then, he changed his clothes and left the house in a hurry.
Ten minutes later, Connor finished his shower and walked out of the bathroom wrapped in Yelena’s towel.
Yelena had not returned yet. Connor sat on the sofa and took out the hairdryer to dry his phone.
Not long after, the water stains on Connor’s phone were all blown dry. Connor pressed the power button.
iPhone was quite good. It still worked.
After turning on the phone, Connor immediately dialed Thomas’ number.
“Beep, beep, beep…”

After all, as a goddess on Tiktok, Yelena felt that she would not lose to other women in any aspect.
However, at this moment, she realized that she was still unable to replace Freya’s position in Connor’s heart.
Even at this time, Yelena had no way to get Connor to say “I like you”!
“Connor, why are you so stupid? Even if you lie to me, 1 won’t mind!”
Yelena couldn’t help but mutter. Then, she helplessly smiled bitterly and said softly, “Perhaps this is why I chose you over other men! Because you’re different from other men. You won’t lie to me. If you like something, then you like it. If you don’t like it, then you don’t like it!”
After saying this, Yelena turned around and returned to her bedroom.
After Connor left Yelena’s house, he walked alone on the street.
It was almost three in the morning, and there was no one on the street.
Although the temperature in Porthampton was still quite high during the day, it was obviously much colder in the early hours of the morning.
In fact, Connor did not know if he liked Yelena or not, but he knew that what he did just now was just to sleep with her, not because he really liked her.
Even then, Connor could not help but think of Freya.
“Huff…”
Connor took a deep breath, feeling unusually helpless.
After inheriting Steven Lee’s inheritance, Connor felt that his luck seemed to have become better. All kinds of beautiful women began to appear by his side, and all kinds of temptations appeared.
Connor was also a normal man. Faced with such temptation, he had also thought of indulging himself, but in the end, he could not do anything to let Freya down.
Of course, Chloe Lawson’s incident was an accident because Connor couldn’t control himself then.
Beep beep beep beep…
At this moment, a horn suddenly sounded behind Connor.
When Connor heard the horn, he couldn’t help but be stunned for a moment. Then, he turned his head and saw that it was a taxi.
“Young man, do you need a ride?”
The taxi driver rolled down the window and asked Connor with a smile.
Connor hesitated for a moment, then reached out to open the car door and got into the car.
“Young man, where are you going?”
The taxi driver turned his head to look at Connor and asked with a smile.
“To the Royal Villas!”
Connor replied indifferently.
When the taxi driver heard Connor, he was stunned for a moment, and a trace of shock flashed across his eyes.
However, he didn’t say anything. He started the car and drove toward the Royal Villas.
Ring! Ring!
At this moment, Connor’s phone suddenly rang.
Connor took out his phone and saw that it was Yelena calling.
Connor looked at the name ‘Yelena’ on the phone, and he seemed to feel a little awkward because he didn’t know what to say to her.
Connor took a deep breath and answered the phone. He said softly, “Hello?”
“Connor, let’s pretend that nothing happened today. In the future, can… can we still be friends?”
Yelena said nervously.
When Connor heard that, he was completely stunned.

chapters.title: Chapter 559 - 559: Don’t Want to Let Yelena Down
chapters.content:
Chapter 559: Don’t Want to Let Yelena Down
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
“Can we still be friends?”
Connor was stunned when he heard that.
Because Connor didn’t expect Yelena to call him just to say this.
This sentence was like a bolt from the blue, directly striking Connor’s head. If not for Freya Phillips, Connor would definitely choose to be with Yelena. Because Connor felt that he would be very lucky to find a girlfriend like Yelena. However, Connor couldn’t be with her now because he didn’t want to do anything that would let Freya down.
“Yelena, I think you’re a very good person, but I really can’t be with you because I don’t think I’m worthy of you!”
Connor whispered back to Yelena.
“Are you trying to comfort me?”
When she heard that, she could not help but laugh bitterly.
“I’m not comforting you. I really don’t deserve you!”
Connor repeated.
“Alright, I don’t want to hear you say this now. Let me ask you, are we still friends?”
She seemed to be choking up as she asked.
H H
Connor furrowed his brows, and he was unusually conflicted.
He didn’t know how to deal with his relationship with Yelena.
“You don’t dare to answer my question now because you’re worried that you might fall in love with me in the future, right?”
Yelena asked with a smile.
“Yes!”
Connor did not hide this fact and admitted it to her.
“What’s wrong with falling in love with me?”
Yelena asked lightly.
“Because even if 1 fall in love with you, I can’t marry you. Moreover, I can’t give you any status. I feel that this is unfair to you, so 1 don’t want to affect your life!”
Connor said in a low voice.
“But 1 don’t care about these things. If I can be with you, I don’t care about these things.”
Yelena said calmly.
“I don’t understand. You have so many outstanding pursuers around you. Why do you like me?”
Connor asked in confusion.
“I don’t know why I like you either, but 1 feel that you’re different from other guys. Perhaps 1 just like how different you are…”
Yelena explained lightly and then continued, “You haven’t answered my question yet. Can the two of us still be friends in the future?”
Connor took a deep breath and slowly put down his phone.
“Connor, I’m asking you a question!”
On the other end of the phone, Yelena shouted when she was greeted with silence.
Connor looked at the phone and fell silent.
The taxi driver turned to look at Connor and then said with a smile, “Young man, although 1 don’t know what’s going on, let me give you a piece of advice. Sometimes, you need to face your feelings. Some things can’t be avoided!” When Connor heard the taxi driver’s words, he couldn’t help but be stunned for a moment. Then, he gritted his teeth and said in a low voice, “Sir, please turn around. Let’s go back!”
“Are you sure you want to go back?”
The taxi driver asked with a smile.
“I’m sure!”
Connor nodded.
“Okay!”
The taxi driver smiled and agreed. Then, he turned around and drove straight to the neighborhood where Yelena’s family lived.
Connor knew that he loved Freya.
But just now, when Connor heard what Yelena said, he felt that it was his fortune to be able to meet a woman like Yelena. He did not want to let Yelena down.
When the taxi driver made a U-turn, he sprinted all the way and stopped the car at the entrance of Yelena’s residential area in less than five minutes.
Connor reached out to find his wallet to pay for the ride, but he was in a hurry when he came out and had forgotten his wallet. He was wearing the clothes that Yelena bought, and his wallet was still in the bathroom in her house.
“Young man, forget it if you don’t have money. This time, it’s my treat!”
The taxi driver seemed to have noticed that Connor had forgotten to bring his wallet, so he smiled and said to Connor.
“Sir, 1 will return the money to you!”
Connor replied indifferently, then reached out to push open the car door and got out.
