After getting out of the car, Connor glanced at the taxi’s license plate number, then turned around and ran toward the neighborhood where Yelena’s house was located.
Bang bang bang!
After arriving at Yelena’s house, Connor did not hesitate and knocked on the door.
Creak!
The door opened and Yelena walked out wearing a lace nightgown.
When Yelena saw Connor standing at the door, a trace of shock flashed across her eyes. She asked Connor in disbelief, “Why… Why are you back?”
Connor didn’t answer Yelena’s question. Instead, he reached out and pulled Yelena into his arms. The two of them kissed.
Yelena hugged Connor tightly, feeling the man’s dominance.
A moment later, Yelena’s delicate body trembled slightly. Her eyes were filled with shyness and charm as she asked Connor in a delicate voice, “Have… Have you thought about it?”
“Yes, I’ve thought things through!”
Connor replied in a low voice.
“Love me!”
Yelena looked at Connor affectionately and said.
Hearing Yelena’s words, Connor’s blood boiled.
Without any hesitation, he carried Yelena to the sofa in the living room and took off his clothes.
When Yelena saw Connor take off his clothes, she took the initiative to take off her nightgown and then gently hugged his neck.
Connor looked at Yelena, his expression unusually excited. This was the first time he was seeing Yelena so close up.
Her delicate and charming face, rosy lips, and the faint fragrance on her body were enough to make Connor go crazy.
Yelena’s beautiful eyes were tightly shut. Her curved eyelashes trembled slightly, covering the nervousness in her heart!
Every part of Yelena was so exquisite and perfect. Connor only had one thought in his heart at this time, and that was to take good care of this woman.
“Are you ready?”
Connor asked Yelena softly.
“Yes…”
Yelena closed her eyes tightly and her lips trembled slightly. She was extremely beautiful.
“Alih…”
A moment later, Yelena moaned and frowned.
Seeing Yelena like this, his heart ached, and he hurriedly stopped.
A few seconds later, Yelena slowly opened her eyes and said to Connor, “I’m okay…”
When Connor heard this, it was as if he had received some order and began to go wild.
Yelena looked at Connor, her eyes filled with love..

chapters.title: Chapter 560 - 560: Save Time
chapters.content:
Chapter 560: Save Time
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Seeing Yelena’s bashful look, Connor began to get really naughty.
That night, Connor and Yelena first went to the living room, then to the bathroom, and finally back to the bedroom.
The two of them did the deed for an entire night before they slowly stopped.
Connor patted Yelena on the back and said weakly, “I’m tired. Let’s rest!”
“Hold me…”
Yelena said sweetly to Connor.
“Okay!”
When Connor heard that, he immediately pulled her into his arms and said softly, “Hurry up and sleep!”
“Okay!”
Yelena nodded obediently, then leaned into Connor’s arms and slowly closed her eyes.
Perhaps it was because she had done a lot just now, Yelena quickly closed her eyes and fell asleep.
At this moment, Yelena had already shed her goddess halo in front of Connor.
Right now, she was just an angel who was willing to be his little woman. Connor knew that he had no way of rejecting such a woman.
Connor lay on the bed and looked at the snow-white ceiling with a helpless expression on his face.
Because Connor felt that what he had experienced today was like a dream. It was very unbelievable.
First, he gambled in the casino, then he encountered two assassinations. Especially when he was in Davenport, Connor faced two very professional assassins.
If it wasn’t for Connor’s quick reaction, he and Yelena might have died by the river.
Of course, what Connor did not expect the most was that he had actually slept with Yelena!
Connor had never thought that the reason she kept pestering him was because she liked him.
Connor heaved a heavy sigh of relief and then fell asleep in a daze.
Perhaps it was because he had done the deed many times, Connor slept until noon.
When Connor opened his eyes again, a beautiful face that could bring disaster to a country and its people was reflected in Connor’s eyes.
At this moment, Yelena was staring at Connor with her seductive eyes.
“When did you wake up?”
Connor reached out and pulled Yelena into his arms. Then, he began to reach under her clothes and caress her.
Perhaps it was because the two of them had already had sex last night, Yelena had no intention of pulling away. On the contrary, she took the initiative to nestle into Connor’s arms.
“I just woke up not long ago!”
Yelena lightly replied.
“Then, were you just looking at me the whole time?”
Connor was stunned for a moment and asked with a smile.
“Yeap!”
Yelena nodded gently.
“When did you start having feelings for me?”
Connor hesitated for a moment before asking her softly.
“I don’t know either…”
Yelena shook her head gently and continued, “Anyway, 1 just like you. I think you’re different from all the men I know…”
“Do you want to do it again?”
Connor asked Yelena with a smile.
“No. 1 was almost torn apart by you last night…”
When Yelena heard Connor’s words, she quickly pouted and replied.
“This is not something you can decide!”
Connor looked at Yelena and smiled. Then, he turned around and pressed her under his body.
“Ah!”
A moment later, Yelena cried out.
They got busy until two o’clock in the afternoon.
After that, Yelena walked into the bathroom and took a quick shower before changing into a new set of clothes.
No matter what she wore, she was so beautiful.
At this moment, Yelena was wearing a short dress that was wrapped around her hips. Her soft long hair was tied up behind her head, and her figure was extremely hot. Her pair of slender and straight thighs were smooth and delicate, making it almost impossible for people to take their eyes off her.
Connor lay on the bed and looked at Yelena. He secretly sighed deep down. What good thing did he do in his previous life to actually have a relationship with such a woman?
“You should get up quickly. 1 want to eat. I’m hungry!”
When Yelena saw Connor lying on the bed, she rolled her eyes at him flirtatiously.
“How can you eat so much?”
Connor replied helplessly.
“Isn’t that all because of you…”
Yelena said with a seductive gaze.
Connor smiled helplessly and got up to go to the bathroom. Then, he took a quick shower and changed into Yelena’s new set of clothes.
After the two of them got dressed, they left the neighborhood hand in hand.
After leaving the neighborhood, the two of them called a taxi and went to a restaurant in the city center. Then, they ordered some food.
“When are you going back to Horizon?”
Connor asked softly.
“Tonight!”
Yelena replied softly while eating.
When Connor heard that, he couldn’t help but be stunned for a moment. His face revealed a trace of disappointment, and then he said in a low voice, “You’re leaving so soon?”
“That’s right. I came back this time only to report to school. 1 don’t plan to stay for long…”
Yelena said reluctantly.
“When are you coming back?”
Connor looked at her and asked.
“You can’t bear to part with me?”
When Yelena heard Connor’s words, she smiled happily.
“Of course I can’t bear to part with you!”
Connor quickly said.
“I don’t know when I’ll be back, but don’t worry. As long as 1 have time, I’ll come back to see you!” Yelena said with a smile.
“Alright then, hurry up and eat…”
Connor looked at her and said.
“Hurry up and eat?”
When Yelena heard Connor’s words, she was stunned for a moment. She seemed to be somewhat puzzled as she asked, “Why do we have to eat faster?”
“To save time. The two of us can go back and do it again…”
Connor grinned.
“You pervert, why is your mind only filled with these things?”
Yelena looked at Connor helplessly and said indifferently, “After dinner, watch a movie with me and then send me to the airport. My flight is at eight o’clock in the evening, so I should still be able to make it…”
“Aren’t we going home?”
Connor asked helplessly.
“No!”
Yelena glared fiercely at Connor, then took out her bag and took out a car key from inside. She handed it to Connor and said softly, “Oh right, my car is still parked in front of the restaurant where we had dinner last night. If you have time, drive the car back. 1 don’t need it anyway. You can use it. It’ll be more convenient…”
“I won’t drive it…”
Connor replied indifferently.
“Why?”
Yelena asked in confusion.
“I can’t afford to refuel…”
“You…”
Yelena looked at Connor and felt helpless. She didn’t know what to say.

chapters.title: Chapter 561 - 561: Connor Is My Boss!
chapters.content:
Chapter 561: Connor Is My Boss!
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
After finishing their meal, Connor and Yelena went to a movie theater and watched a newly released romantic film. She cried from the beginning to the end, while he fell asleep halfway through.
After the movie, he took her to Porthampton Airport.
“Connor, this is my bank card. If you ever need money, you can use it. After all, you are my man now. Don’t work and earn money anymore. 1 will support you!”
When he was taking her to the airport, she took out a bank card from her wallet and handed it to him.
He was stunned when he saw the bank card and then smiled, saying, “Are you planning to support me by giving me a car and money?”
“Yes, 1 want to support you. 1 know that ever since you started university, you have been making a living by delivering food. Last time, you won me a lot of money at the casino, so you should keep this money. Besides, 1 don’t lack money either…”
Yelena said seriously to Connor.
“No need, I have enough money now…” he replied casually.
“How can you have money? Don’t lie to me…” she said helplessly to him.
“I’m not lying to you, 1 really don’t need money. You should keep this money for yourself!”
He didn’t know how to explain his wealth to her, so he didn’t say much and directly put the bank card into her bag.
“Connor, this money is what you won from Jack. You don’t have to be embarrassed!” she said softly to him.
“I’m not embarrassed. 1 really don’t need money now. You should keep this money for yourself. If I really need money someday, 1 will call and ask you for it!” he said lightly.
Seeing that he really didn’t want the money, she reluctantly nodded and put the bank card away.
“I have to board the plane…”
She looked at the time and said reluctantly to him.
“Okay.” he nodded.
Yelena hesitated for a moment, lightly kissed Connor’s face, and then turned and ran towards the airport entrance.
He watched her figure and smiled helplessly, then turned around to leave the airport.
“Ring ring ring!”
Just at that moment, his phone suddenly rang.
He took out his phone and glanced at it, only to find that it was a call from Thomas.
Connor quickly answered the call and asked in a low voice, “Did you find those two assassins?”
“We found them…”
Thomas replied in a low voice.
“Did you find out who hired them?”
Connor asked eagerly.
“That may not be possible…”
Thomas said helplessly.
Connor was stunned when he heard this, and his expression was full of disbelief.
“You mean those two assassins were already dead last night? ”
“Yes, they are dead, and they were all shot. The murder was done in a clean and precise way. I think the other party must have known that they failed in the assassination and took action against them!”
Thomas analyzed in a low voice.
“What about Stephanie? Any news from her?”
Connor asked in a low voice.
“Yannick is still abroad. If it was Yannick who made a move against you, it’s basically impossible!”
Thomas said slowly.
“Since it’s not Yannick, then it must be Jack or Rockefeller’s men!”
Connor hesitated for a moment, then said lightly, “I asked you to contact Jeffery Fenton. Did you contact him?”
“I did. Mr. Connor, what time do you think you are free tonight? We can meet him…”
“I have time now. Find a random restaurant. I want to meet him,” Connor said.
“Alright!”
Thomas replied and then hung up the phone.
8 PM at night.
Connor found the Maserati that Yelena parked in front of the restaurant and then drove alone to the restaurant where Thomas and Jeffery had arranged to meet.
“Sir, do you have a reservation?”
After entering the restaurant, the receptionist smiled at Connor and asked.
“Which private room is Thomas in?”
Connor replied indifferently.
“Are you Mr. Thomas’ guest?”
The receptionist’s face immediately changed upon hearing Connor’s words, and she nervously asked.
“Yes.”
He nodded lightly.
“Mr. Thomas is already in the private room, please follow me…”
After learning that he was a guest invited by Thomas, the receptionist’s attitude towards him changed significantly. She quickly led him to a private room door and whispered, “Sir, Mr. Thomas is inside this private room!”
“Thank you.”
Connor smiled at the receptionist and then walked straight into the private room.
Upon entering the private room, he noticed three people inside.
One was Thomas, and the other two were Jack and Jack’s father, Jeffery.
When Jack saw Connor entering the private room, he couldn’t help but pause for a moment. Then he quickly stood up and shouted at Connor, “Connor, what are you doing here?”
“Smack!”
Upon hearing Jack’s words, Jeffery didn’t hesitate and slapped Jack directly in the face. He glared and yelled, “How dare you talk to Mr. Connor like that?”
“Mr. Connor?”
Jack was completely stunned. His face showed an extremely shocked expression as he pointed at Connor and said, “Dad, do you know this Connor?”
“This is Mr. Connor!”
Jeffery shouted, his eyes wide open. Then he hurriedly walked up to Connor, his expression nervous, and said, “Mr. Connor, I’m really sorry. My ignorant son didn’t know your identity. 1 hope you won’t blame him…”
“No, Dad, this Connor is just a poor student. How did he become Mr. Connor?”
Jack still hadn’t figured out the current situation and exclaimed in an agitated tone.
“Mr. Connor is my boss. He wanted to meet both of you today!”
Standing next to Jack, Thomas calmly explained.
“Connor is your boss, Mr. Thomas?”
After hearing this, Jack was dumbfounded. He stood still, his face wearing an incredibly incredulous expression..

chapters.title: Chapter 562 - 562: Do You Know These Two People?
chapters.content:
Chapter 562: Do You Know These Two People?
Translator: End less Fantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Previously, at the Harlem’s Casino, Jack lost a whopping 50 million to Connor.
Although Jack later thought of killing Yelena, it was thwarted by Connor.
So now he hated him to the bone. After returning home, he decided to investigate his identity.
The investigation results surprised Jack. He discovered that Connor was just a poor student who relied on delivering food to make a living. He had no notable background whatsoever.
Therefore, Jack planned to find an opportunity to teach Connor a lesson.
Just now, Thomas called Jeffery and said that someone wanted to meet the two of them, and that person was Thomas’s boss.
Jeffery was originally under Thomas’s command, so naturally, he knew that Thomas’s boss was Connor.
During the banquet at Xianhu Villa Group, he had seen Connor once.
But he never found a chance to speak with Connor, so he was naturally excited when Connor took the initiative to meet him this time.
As for Jack, he was completely confused about these matters. He had no idea that Connor was actually Mr. Connor, Jeffery’s boss.
After hearing Thomas’s words, Jack’s expression was incredulous and he said, “Mr. Thomas, are you… are you mistaken? This Connor is just a poor student. How could he possibly be Mr. Connor?”
“Do you think 1 would mistake my own boss?” Thomas asked with an expressionless face.
“No… no, of course not,” Jack hesitated for a moment and quickly shook his head.
Thomas glanced at Jack indifferently, then walked directly to Connor and said softly, “Mr. Connor, I’ve brought both of them…”
“Good!” Connor nodded gently and walked straight to Jack, saying softly, “We meet again, huh?”
“Connor, who… who are you really?” Jack was completely dumbfounded at this point, stuttering as he asked him.
“You can ask your father who I am!” Connor turned his head and glanced at Jeffery.
By now, Jeffery could sense that Jack definitely knew Connor and that there must be some conflict between them, otherwise he would never have called them here.
“Dad, who is Connor exactly?” Jack hesitated for a moment and stuttered as he asked Jeffery.
“Did you offend Mr. Connor?” Jeffery gritted his teeth and asked Jack in a low voice.
“I… I…” Jack’s eyes flashed with a hint of nervousness when he heard Jeffery’s words, as if he didn’t know how to answer.
“Did you not hear me when I asked you a question?” Jeffery shouted with a stern face, pointing at Jack and asking, “I’m asking you, did you offend Mr. Connor?”
“Maybe… maybe it’s not considered offending, I just played a few rounds with Connor at the casino…” He was completely dumbfounded at this point, sounding scared.
“Kneel down!” Jeffery shouted loudly upon hearing this.
And Jack was so scared that he knelt down directly on the ground.
“Mr. Connor, I’m really sorry. It’s all because of this damn bastard’s lack of vision. He won your money at the casino, but now I’ll make sure he pays it back to you…” Jeffery said in a tense tone, addressing Connor.
“Do you think I’m short of money?” Connor narrowed his eyes and asked softly.
At this moment, Jeffery was convinced that Jack must have won Connor’s money at the casino, which was why he called them over.
But when he heard Connor’s words, his expression became somewhat puzzled.
“Dad, I did play a few rounds with Connor at the casino yesterday, but 1 didn’t win any money. In fact, not only did I not win, but 1 also lost several tens of millions to him…” Jack knelt on the ground, sounding extremely aggrieved.
Jeffery couldn’t help but pause for a moment when he heard Jack’s words, then he whispered, “So you owe Mr. Connor money?”
“I borrowed all the money from the casino, I don’t owe him anything!” Jack shouted at the top of his lungs.
“Mr. Connor, what is going on here?” Jeffery was now also confused and asked Connor with a puzzled tone.
“What’s going on, he knows it well himself!” Connor pointed at Jack with his hand.
“What else did you do? Speak up!” Jeffery turned his head and looked at Jack, shouting angrily.
“What else did I do?” Jack was stunned for a moment when he heard Jeffery’s words, then stammered, “I… I was planning to kill that bitch Yelena with a knife, but Mr. Connor stopped me with a kick. After that, I didn’t do anything else, really!”
“You actually wanted to kill someone?” Jeffery didn’t know how to respond to Jack’s words.
“I… I was just impulsive at the time, that’s why I wanted to kill her with a knife. But Mr. Connor stopped me, and… and I went after Yelena, not Mr. Connor!” Jack explained in a stuttering manner.
“Mr. Connor, I’m really sorry. I didn’t expect this damn bastard to have such audacity, daring to lay hands on you, Mr. Connor. I’m truly sorry…” Jeffery was pale with fright by Jack’s words, and he knelt directly on the ground, his expression extremely agitated as he shouted at Connor.
Connor glanced indifferently at Jeffery, then said expressionlessly, “There’s no need for you to kneel down so eagerly, and what I said has nothing to do with this matter…”
Upon hearing Connor’s words, Jeffery was so infuriated that he almost fainted.
He quickly turned his head and shouted at Jack, “What else have you done, damn it? Can’t you just say it all at once?”
“What else have I done?” Jack also seemed dumbfounded, couldn’t help but glance up at him, then stuttered, “After leaving the casino yesterday, I went straight home. I didn’t do anything… really…”
“Are you sure you didn’t do anything?” Connor asked Jack in a low voice.
“Yes, my dad can vouch for me. I returned home at 11 o’clock last night and went to my room to sleep. 1 didn’t do anything!” Jack quickly shook his head.
Connor turned his head and glanced at Thomas, giving him a signal.
After seeing his signal, Thomas took out the photos of the Leopard and the Grizzly Bear, walked up to Jack, and with a serious expression, asked him, “Do you recognize the two people in these photos?”
Jack quickly lowered his head and glanced at the photo, then directly shook his head and said, “I don’t recognize them, I don’t know these two people!”

chapters.title: Chapter 563 - 563: Rockferri’s Subordinate
chapters.content:
Chapter 563: Rockferri’s Subordinate
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
“Do you really not recognize them?” Connor squinted his eyes and continued to ask.
Jack knelt in front of him, his expression filled with fear.
He looked at Connor with fear and said, “Connor, I really don’t know these two people. Who are they?”
At this moment, Jack and Jeffery had no idea what was going on.
“Last night, when Connor left the casino, he encountered two assassins, and these two assassins are the same as the ones in the photo!”
Thomas stood beside Jack and emotionlessly said to him.
Upon hearing his words, Jack and Jeffery were dumbfounded.
“Connor, what time did you encounter these two assassins last night?” Jeffery asked Connor.
“After one o’clock in the morning,” Connor said calmly.
“But Connor, these two assassins couldn’t have been sent by Jack. Jack had already returned home by midnight yesterday…” Jeffery anxiously explained.
“Just because Jack wasn’t the one who personally attacked Connor doesn’t mean he couldn’t have hired the assassins to do it. Even if Jack had already returned home by then, he could have found the assassins to target you. So it doesn’t prove that these two people weren’t hired by Jack!” Thomas said expressionlessly.
“Jack, you better think clearly before talking to me because those two assassins are still alive. If I find them, you should know the consequences…” Connor said softly to Jack.
“I really have no connection with these two people. I swear 1 absolutely don’t know them. If they were really hired by me, my whole family would be wiped out!” Jack shouted emotionally at Connor.
“Yes, Connor, 1 know Jack’s character. Although he can be unruly at times, he doesn’t have the courage to hire assassins. 1 hope you can investigate this matter thoroughly!” Jeffery also shouted.
Connor looked at them, his eyes showing a hint of strangeness.
Because he knew that the two assassins were already dead, there was no solid evidence to prove whether Jack was responsible for it or not.
But he could feel from Jack’s reaction that it seemed like he really didn’t do it, and he also seemed to genuinely not know these two people.
“Jack, if I find these two people, will you dare to confront them face to face?” he asked Jack softly.
“I will, Connor. I really don’t know these two people. 1 admit that I acted impulsively towards you and Yelena, but 1 didn’t target you specifically. And even if 1 did hire assassins, they wouldn’t have attacked you so quickly!” Jack said seriously.
Connor stood there and contemplated for a moment, then waved his hand lightly to Jack and Jeffery without any expression on his face, saying, “You two can leave for now. If there’s anything, I will find both of you again!”
“Thank you, Mr. Connor! Thank you, Mr. Connor!”
Upon hearing his words, Jack felt relieved and quickly thanked Connor before preparing to leave.
Jeffery hesitated for a moment, stood up, and said to Connor, “Connor, I know my son’s character very well. 1 can guarantee that he didn’t do this. He doesn’t have the courage for it…”
Connor glanced at Jeffery lightly and calmly said, “I understand. I am not an unreasonable person. You can rest assured!”
“Alright, if there’s no any other matters, I’ll take my leave!”
Jeffery quickly nodded towards him and then turned around and left the private room.
After seeing Jeffery and Jack leave, Connor let out a heavy sigh. He turned to Thomas, who was standing by, and asked, “What do you think about this matter?”
“I don’t think it was Jack who did it,” Thomas answered seriously.
“Why?” Connor asked calmly.
“Based on his reaction just now, it seemed like he truly doesn’t know the two people in the photo,” Thomas said slowly.
“Now that the people are already dead, we don’t know for sure if what he said was true. 1 was just trying to intimidate him earlier…” Connor said softly.
“I know you were intentionally trying to scare Jack. But his reaction just now couldn’t have been faked. 1 could feel the fear in his eyes. It indicates that he definitely doesn’t know those two assassins. Otherwise, his reaction wouldn’t have been like that,” Thomas said, looking at Connor.
Connor paused for a moment and then continued, “And yesterday, I had someone investigate those two assassins. It turns out they are highly skilled professionals. They usually track their targets for a long time before making a move. They wouldn’t have acted so quickly if Jack had hired them. Considering the conflict between Jack and me yesterday evening, even if he did hire them, they wouldn’t have targeted me that same night!”
Connor looked at Thomas hesitantly and said, “I think your analysis makes sense. But if it isn’t Jack or Yannick, then who else could it be? And killing those two immediately afterward clearly indicates that they didn’t want us to know about their existence!”
“Perhaps it was the people from Rockefeller,” Thomas whispered.
“The people from Rockefeller targeting me?”
Upon hearing Thomas’s words, Connor’s eyes showed a hint of surprise.
In fact, what he was most worried about right now was Rockefeller’s people targeting him because Rockefeller was currently his most formidable enemy.
“I think Rockefeller might not really want to kill you. This time, they were probably just testing the security around you to facilitate their future actions,” Thomas paused and continued, “If Rockefeller’s people really wanted to kill you, they could have hired more professional assassins. But this time, they only hired two very ordinary ones. I believe their true intention was to test you, making it easier for them to take action in the future!”
“So, are you saying that Rockefeller’s people are likely to target me again?” Connor instantly understood Thomas’s meaning and asked him excitedly..

chapters.title: Chapter 564 - 564: Enhancing Ability
chapters.content:
Chapter 564: Enhancing Ability
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
After listening to Thomas’s analysis, Connor’s face instantly showed a surprised expression.
After all, if it was really as Thomas said, then Rockefeller was just testing Connor’s words.
So, they will definitely target him for a second assassination!
He was fortunate enough this time to successfully escape by jumping into the river.
But if Rockefeller’s people find more skilled assassins, he may not have an easy time surviving.
“Mr. Connor, you are now the only person who poses a threat to Rockefeller. Because they are well aware of your relationship with the Chairman, they will definitely try every means to eliminate you!” Thomas said softly to Connor.
“But 1 haven’t officially taken over the company yet, and 1 haven’t posed any threat to them. Why are they so eager to come after me? What benefit do they have in killing me?” Connor asked in a low voice, looking at him.
“The only benefit for them in killing you is to eliminate a potential threat. Rockefeller’s subordinates have always been ruthless in their actions, so it is normal for them to come after you. But 1 can’t understand why they are in such a hurry, why they moved against you so quickly when you haven’t posed any threat to them.” Thomas wondered.
“If it is indeed Rockefeller’s subordinates who attacked me, then this is definitely not the last time. 1 think they will definitely send assassins again in the future…” Connor said with some concern.
“Mr. Connor, next, I will have Diana and Carlos follow you closely. This way, we can also protect your safety.”
“Even if they are always by my side, it is only treating the symptoms and not the root cause. After all, no matter how skilled they are, those people from Rockefeller can definitely find a way to kill me…” Connor said helplessly.
Thomas looked at him hesitating for a moment, then said, “Mr. Connor, I think what you said is right. If we really want to prevent such situations from happening again, the simplest way is to improve your own combat capabilities. Only when your own combat capabilities improve will it be the safest way!”
“I am just an ordinary person. If 1 encounter an average assassin, maybe there is still a chance, but if I encounter a truly professional assassin, I don’t think even with Carlos and Diana, they can necessarily save me!” Connor replied to Thomas in a low voice, then asked curiously, “What do you mean by improving my combat capabilities?”
“Mr. Connor, I know a hidden expert. I think if you can become his disciple, your combat capabilities will greatly improve in a short period of time. Then you will have the ability to protect yourself in such situations in the future!” Thomas said seriously to Connor.
“Hehe…” He smiled helplessly upon hearing this, then said lightly, “Are you suggesting that I become a disciple and learn martial arts?”
“Right now, besides this method, I don’t have any other better options!” Thomas frowned and said.
Connor looked at him hesitating for two seconds, then said in a low voice, “Classes had already started, and I have to go to classes regularly. I simply don’t have time to learn martial arts. Moreover, Rockefeller’s subordinates have already come after me, so it’s too late for me to become a disciple and learn martial arts…”
“I just gave you a suggestion earlier. Ultimately, the decision depends on your own thoughts. All 1 can do now is strengthen your security measures!” Thomas said to Connor.
“Okay, 1 understand your point!” Connor nodded lightly and stood up, looking at Thomas. “Make sure your people keep a close eye on Jack. If anything suspicious happens, contact me immediately. Also, investigate his call records from that night and see if he had any other means of contacting the two assassins!”
“Understood!” Thomas agreed and escorted Connor out of the private room.
By the time he left the hotel, it was already io p.m.
He returned to the Royal Villa alone and, after freshening up, prepared to go to bed.
However, just as he lay down on the bed, his phone suddenly rang.
Connor picked up his phone and saw that it was a call from Yelena.
“Have you arrived at Horizon?” he answered the call and asked with a smile.
“I arrived a long time ago. I’ve been off the plane for two hours already. You didn’t call me, so 1 had to call you. Aren’t you a bit heartless?” Yelena complained in a somewhat resentful tone upon hearing his words.
“I had something going on, so 1 forgot to call you. I actually planned to call you earlier…” he quickly explained.
“Really?” she asked.
“Of course!” He nodded quickly.
“What have you been busy with?” she asked softly.
“It’s nothing, just a bit busy with the start of the new semester…” He didn’t want to disclose everything to her for now, so he made up a random excuse.
She also felt that he didn’t have any serious matters to attend to and that most of it was related to school, so she didn’t ask further.
Connor and Yelena chatted for almost half an hour before she reluctantly hung up the phone.
After putting down his phone, he lay on the bed alone, thinking about the events of the past few days.
If the two assassins he encountered yesterday were sent by Jack, things would have been much simpler.
After all, Jack was just a wealthy second generation, and dealing with him would be a straightforward task for Connor.
But if those two assassins were not sent by Jack, then things might become troublesome.
It wasn’t Jack’s doing, nor was it Yannick’s.
Those two assassins were likely sent by Rockefeller’s subordinates. If that were the case, Connor’s biggest enemy, Rockefeller, would also reveal himself, the case, Connor’s biggest enemy, Rockefeller, would also reveal himself.
But he was not prepared to deal with Rockefeller at the moment, nor did he have the ability to confront Rockefeller’s subordinates.
Buzz!
Just as Connor was contemplating these issues, his phone vibrated again.
He paused for a moment, then took out his phone and saw that it was an unknown number..

chapters.title: Chapter 565: An Affair With Connor!
chapters.content:
Chapter 565: An Affair With Connor!
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Connor looked at the unfamiliar number on his phone, a puzzled expression appearing on his face.
After all, it was already midnight, who would call at this time?
He hesitated for two seconds before finally pressing the answer button and softly asking, “Hello, who is this?”
“Mr. Connor , I am Luke, the owner of the Harlem’s Gold. We’ve met before, you should remember, right?” Luke asked in a very respectful tone.
“Mr. Luke, why are you calling me so late? Is there something wrong?” He paused for a moment and asked calmly.
“Mr. Connor , it’s like this. Last time at the casino, didn’t you lose 50 million to me? I know you deliberately lost that money to me, so whenever you have time, when can you come and collect the money?” Luke asked very understandingly.
In fact, this wasn’t the first time Luke had called Connor. He had called him once before when Connor was at Yelena’s house. However, at that time, Connor was busy entangled with Yelena and had no time to answer the call.
“That money was lost to you, just keep it…” Connor said softly into the phone.
“Mr. Connor , I dare not accept this money. You’d better take it away!” Luke quickly replied.
Originally, he had planned to use this money to repay the favor Luke had done for him, but Luke had no intention of accepting this money at all.
Moreover, Luke certainly didn’t want to use this money to make up for his favor.
“Do you really not want this money?” he asked softly.
“This is your money, Mr. Connor . Of course, 1 can’t accept it,” Luke said.
“Mr. Connor , when do you have time to come and collect it, or should I transfer the money directly to you?” he said with a smile.
“Well…” After hearing his words, Connor didn’t refuse anything and could only reluctantly give Luke his bank account number.
“Mr. Connor , the finance department has already closed for the day. Tomorrow, I’ll have someone transfer the money to you. How does that sound?”
“It’s alright, no hurry…” Connor replied lightly and continued, “You called me so late, 1 suppose you have more than just returning my money in mind, right?”
“Hehe…” Luke laughed awkwardly upon hearing that and then said softly, “Mr. Connor , you really can predict things. I do have something else I want to discuss with you…”
“What is it?” Connor asked softly.
“It’s like this, Mr. Connor . 1 remember 1 mentioned to you before that my granddaughter will be having a birthday party in a few days. 1 hope you can come and grace us with your presence. Do you still remember this?” Luke asked softly.
“I remember that. When is your granddaughter’s birthday party?” Connor didn’t want to owe him any more favors, so he asked directly.
“It’s the day after tomorrow…” Luke replied.
“The day after tomorrow?” Connor’s eyes flashed with a hint of helplessness because he knew that he would be in class on that day.
“What’s wrong? Mr. Connor , is it inconvenient for you?” Luke hurriedly asked when he noticed Connor’s tone wasn’t right.
“Two days from now is fine. Where is it?” Connor said helplessly.
“Seven o’clock in the evening, in Borealis City next to Porthampton,” Luke said.
“Borealis City?” Connor’s expression seemed even more frustrated after hearing those three words.
Initially, he had thought that Luke’s granddaughter’s birthday party would be held in Porthampton. Although he had classes that day, he could have waited until after class to attend.
But what he didn’t expect was that the birthday party was actually taking place in Borealis City!
Although Borealis City wasn’t very far from Porthampton, it would still take at least a two-hour drive.
If he waited until after his class to go, it would basically be too late.
“Mr. Connor, if it’s inconvenient for you, we can change the date…” Luke quickly said.
“How can we change the date for your granddaughter’s birthday?” Connor replied speechlessly.
“I’m just concerned that it might not be convenient for you, Mr. Connor,” Luke said with a smile.
“I don’t have any inconvenience. 1 might have to take a leave from school that day, but it’s no big deal…” Connor said calmly.
“So, Mr. Connor, are you saying that you will come to my granddaughter’s birthday party the day after tomorrow?” Luke asked excitedly upon hearing his agreement.
“Yes, I will go the day after tomorrow. Don’t worry,” He replied.
“That’s great! If you don’t have anything else, I won’t disturb your rest, Mr. Connor!” Luke exclaimed happily and quickly hung up the phone.
Connor slowly put down his phone, his expression filled with helplessness.
Because he knew that if he wanted to attend Luke’s granddaughter’s birthday party, he would have to ask Rachel for a leave.
Whenever he thought of her, he felt a headache.
But now he owed Luke a favor, and Luke hadn’t made any unreasonable demands. He just wanted Connor to attend the birthday party, and he even extended a polite invitation. So Connor naturally couldn’t refuse.
The next day, at 8 o’clock in the morning.
Connor arrived at the university.
At this point, he had become somewhat of a celebrity within Porthampton University.
First, Rachel had declared that she liked Connor , and then Yelena had released a video searching for Connor .
These two incidents alone had thrust him into the spotlight!
After entering the school, he could feel his classmates looking at him with curious eyes, which made him feel speechless.
The first class was Rachel’s class, and Connor had been thinking about how to ask for a leave from her.
He knew Rachel’s personality very well. Unless it was a special circumstance, she would never agree to let Connor take a leave!
So he had already planned to use Madison’s matter to threaten Rachel.
“Ring!”
The bell for the end of the class rang.
After packing up her teaching materials, Rachel directly called out to Connor , “Connor, come with me…”
“Okay…”
He quickly replied and got up to follow her out of the classroom.
“Is Connor really with Miss Rachel now?”
The students in the classroom all showed shocked expressions.
If it were before, these students wouldn’t have thought anything unusual.
After all, Rachel had often approached Connor before. But after the incident with Madison confessing to Rachel, everyone felt that Rachel and Connor’s relationship was extraordinary.
She had always been very aloof and naturally didn’t bother to explain these things.
So everyone thought that she and Connor must be involved in a romantic relationship!

chapters.title: Chapter 566: How About I Be Your Girlfriend?
chapters.content:
Chapter 566: How About I Be Your Girlfriend?
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
After leaving the classroom.
Rachel walked straight to the office in her high heels.
Connor knew that Rachel probably had something to say to him, so he didn’t say anything and quietly followed behind Rachel.
Today, Rachel was dressed very nicely; she wore a pair of black boots, a striped shirt, and a suit. Her long hair was casually draped over her shoulders, and her pretty face was in a light layer of foundation. She was sexy and beautiful, dignified yet not pretentious.
Of course, this wasn’t the most exciting part for Connor. What made Connor feel the most excited was Rachel’s pair of slender white legs.
Today, Rachel was wearing a pair of denim shorts. Her slender and fair legs were directly exposed to the air.
Rachel’s thighs were as fair and white as ivory. Moreover, her calves were very straight and slender. The contrast with her long boots made her look particularly attractive.
A few minutes later, Connor followed Rachel into the office.
“Close the door!”
Rachel turned her head and whispered to Connor.
“Okay…”
Connor answered instinctively and closed the office door.
After entering the office, Rachel placed the teaching materials in her hands on the table. Then, she raised her slender white legs and elegantly crossed them together. She turned her head and asked Connor softly, “After I left that day, what did you say to Madison Phillips in the private room?”
“I don’t have to say anything, 1 just told her directly that the person she liked wasn’t me and that she just wanted to use me to reject someone. After that, she let me go,” Connor replied indifferently, the expression on his face very calm.
In fact, Connor had long expected Rachel to ask him this question, so he naturally wouldn’t be stupid enough to say that he molested Madison in the private room.
“You…” After Rachel heard Connor’s words, a trace of anger flashed across her eyes. She frowned and said fiercely, “Connor, how could you betray me?”
“Ms. Wallace, this is between you and Madison, and it has nothing to do with me. If 1 didn’t tell the truth, Madison wouldn’t have let me off at all.”
Connor explained helplessly.
“But you didn’t have to betray me, no?”
Rachel rubbed her temples and frowned.
“The main thing is that Ms. Wallace, you were too disappointing that day. It’s fine that you used me as a shield, but after you saw me being brought into the private room by Madison, you actually ran away? Do you know that Madison was ready to attack me after 1 entered the private room with her? Fortunately, I reacted quickly, or 1 might have been lying in the hospital now…” Connor said as if he had been wronged.
“Connor, you really have no conscience. I even helped you back then. Now that I’m asking you to help me with such a small matter, you actually betrayed me…” Rachel complained to Connor unhappily.
Madison’s matter had always given Rachel a headache. Rachel had even made plans to pretend to like Connor.
Moreover, she was prepared to let Connor pretend to be her boyfriend, but Rachel never thought that Connor would actually sell her out in the blink of an eye.
Connor’s actions directly disrupted all of Rachel’s plans.
“Ms. Wallace, you said you helped me? When have you ever helped me?”
Connor could not help but be stunned when he heard Rachel’s words. He asked Rachel with a puzzled expression.
Rachel saw that Connor had suddenly realized that he had said something wrong because he was a little excited just now. He hurriedly explained, “Didn’t I introduce you to a part-time job at a bar? Besides, haven’t I helped you enough?”
“Ms. Wallace, I know you treat me very well, but I really had no choice that day. If I didn’t tell the truth, Madison definitely wouldn’t let me go!”
Although Connor said so, he could feel from Rachel’s reaction that the thing that she said she’d helped him with was definitely not the part-time job at the bar!
“Sigh…”
Rachel looked at Connor and sighed softly. Then, she said helplessly, “Forget it, since you’ve already said it, then let’s do it!”
“Ms. Wallace, who is this Madison Phillips? Why do I feel like you’re very afraid of her?” Connor hesitated for a moment before asking Rachel softly.
Actually, Connor also found it hard to see Rachel in such a difficult position.
“It’s not that I’m afraid of her. I just feel that she’s a little pitiful. Moreover, she’s a girl. Other than asking you to put on an act, I really can’t find any way to make her give up…” Rachel said softly.
“So that’s how it is!” Connor nodded thoughtfully. Then, he looked at Rachel and continued, “Then, Ms. Wallace, if you’re so troubled, I’ll help put on another act…”
“You’ve already told Madison the truth. What’s the use of acting now?” Rachel lightly rolled her eyes at Connor.
“Right…”
Connor replied with a smile. In fact, he was just being polite. He was not in the mood to continue helping Rachel, and he was also too lazy to get involved in the matters between these two women.
“Alright, there is nothing else I need from you. You can leave now…” Rachel lightly waved her hand at Connor.
“Well, Ms. Wallace, 1 have something I want to ask you for help with…” Connor said to Rachel with a smile.
“What is it?”
Rachel was stunned for a moment.
“Ms. Wallace, I’m going to take a day off tomorrow. I’m going to Borealis City…” Connor said slowly.
“What are you going to Borealis City for? You should have classes tomorrow, right?” Rachel said to Connor as she looked down at the schedule for the next day.
“I do have classes, but 1 have something to deal with tomorrow, so I wanted to take some leave!” Connor said with a smile.
Rachel looked at Connor without saying anything.
Connor was worried that Rachel wouldn’t give him leave, so he hurriedly opened his mouth to explain, “Ms. Wallace, are you planning to use your position to take revenge? 1 really didn’t do that thing with Madison on purpose…”
“What do you have to deal with?”
Rachel sized up Connor and asked indifferently.
“Uh…”
Connor knew that he definitely couldn’t say that he was going to Luke Phillips’s granddaughter’s birthday party. If he did, Rachel would definitely not let him go…
“Ms. Wallace, it’s for personal reasons…” Connor replied in a low voice.
“Are you going on a date with your girlfriend?” Rachel narrowed her eyes and asked softly.
“Ms. Wallace, don’t joke with me. How can I have a girlfriend? I really have some private matters to deal with. I’ll be back soon…” Connor said helplessly. “Connor, do you really not have a girlfriend?”
Rachel was stunned for a moment and asked Connor softly.
“Yeah, I broke up with my girlfriend a long time ago. I’m still single now…”
Connor nodded lightly.
“Then how about I be your girlfriend?”
Rachel suddenly asked Connor..

chapters.title: Chapter 567: Rachel Wallace’s Identity
chapters.content:
Chapter 567: Rachel Wallace’s Identity
Translator: End less Fantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
“Uh…”
After Connor heard Rachel’s words, his entire person was stunned, and the expression on his face was extremely shocked. He did not expect that Rachel would actually say such words to him!
“Ms. Wallace, are you confessing to me?” Connor asked Rachel helplessly.
“That’s right!”
Rachel nodded very directly and continued, “You don’t have a girlfriend now, and I don’t have a boyfriend either. The two of us can be together, but only in name. I won’t have anything to do with you, nor will I marry you. This way, Madison won’t be able to continue pestering me.”
“Ms. Wallace, are you playing with me? If you want to get together with me, and yet 1 can’t have sex with you, then why should I get together with you?” Connor shouted at Rachel helplessly.
“What’s wrong? Don’t tell me you still want to have sex with me?”
Rachel frowned at Connor.
“Uh…” When Connor heard this, he was stunned for a moment. Then, he hurriedly shook his head and said, “M-Ms. Wallace, that’s not what I meant…” “Aren’t you happy just to be my boyfriend? Forget it, you’d better get out quickly. I’m not in the mood to talk to you now!”
Rachel waved at Connor impatiently, indicating for him to leave quickly.
“Ms. Wallace, about my leave?” Connor asked with a smile.
After Rachel hesitated for a moment, she said, “I’ll give you a day off. If you don’t come to class the day after tomorrow, I’ll consider it as you skipping class!”
“Thank you, Ms. Wallace!”
Connor shouted happily, then turned around and ran out of the office.
However, after taking two steps, Connor suddenly stopped and turned to Rachel and asked, “Ms. Wallace, do you know anyone from the military?” “Someone from the military?” Rachel was stunned for a moment after hearing Connor’s words. Then, the corners of her mouth rose slightly as she asked in a soft voice, “Why are you suddenly asking me this question?”
“It’s nothing. I’m just curious…”
Connor said lightly.
“Then why do you think I know someone from the military?”
Rachel said gently. Connor looked at Rachel and hesitated for two seconds, then smiled and said, “Ms. Wallace, just pretend that I didn’t say anything. I’ll leave first!”
After saying this, Connor turned around and walked out of the office.
Rachel narrowed her eyes as she looked at Connor’s departing back. A faint smile hung on the corner of her mouth, and no one knew what she was thinking.
After Connor left Rachel’s office, his face was filled with confusion.
Rachel had obviously let it slip just now, saying that she had helped Connor before.
Yes, she had indeed helped Connor before and had paid his tuition fees several times. However, Connor knew that Rachel wasn’t talking about this matter. Otherwise, she would never have said something like that.
There weren’t many people who had helped Connor before. The only time they had done so was when they were at the Phillips Family Estate. At that time, the Tiger Commander, Joey Shaw, had been asked by a mysterious person to help Connor.
Thomas Morgan, Kyle Hayes, and the others had also been investigating this matter, but they still could not find out who had asked Joey to come and help Connor that day.
Connor once heard from Kyle Hayes that Rachel’s identity was very mysterious. Moreover, Rachel’s own background was also very powerful, but no one knew who she was, nor did anyone know what her family did. When he connected all these pieces together, Connor felt that it was very likely that Rachel was the one who’d helped him in secret that day.
However, Connor did not understand two things: how did Rachel know that something happened to him that day? And if she was the one who’d helped him, then why was she unwilling to admit these things?
Connor could feel from Rachel’s reaction that she probably didn’t want to talk about this matter with him. Since she didn’t want to talk about it, Connor didn’t continue asking.
After leaving Rachel’s office, Connor returned to the classroom.
When Dominic and Spencer saw that Connor had returned, they immediately surrounded him and began to ask what Rachel had said to Connor.
Connor didn’t say much to Dominic and Spencer and just casually answered their questions.
6 PM.
When the school bell rang, Connor did not go to the cafeteria with Dominic and Spencer. Instead, he called a taxi and went straight home.
After reaching home, Connor took out his phone and dialed Thomas Morgan’s number.
“Beep, beep, beep…”
After the phone rang twice, Thomas picked up the call.
“How’s the investigation of the assassin going?” Connor asked directly after Thomas answered the phone.
“There’s still no progress. These two killers have very few social connections, and they don’t have any relatives. It’s quite difficult to investigate them…” Thomas said helplessly.
“If it really doesn’t work, then let’s not waste any more time. I think the other party is so clean and efficient, they probably won’t leave any clues for us!” Connor paused for a moment and then continued, “By the way, I’m going to Borealis City tomorrow to attend Luke Roberts’s granddaughter’s birthday party!”
“Then I’ll get someone to drive you there,” Thomas quickly said.
“No need, I’ll take a bus over!” Connor replied indifferently.
“A bus?”
After Thomas heard Connor’s words, his tone carried a trace of doubt.
“If there are many people in the bus, 1 think even if Rockefeller’s people wanted to attack me, they wouldn’t dare to do so in a place with so many people, so 1 think going by bus should be the safest…” Connor said.
“That’s true. I’ll get Miss Murphy and Mr. Lane to go with you!” Thomas continued.
“I think it’ll be better to just have Carlos come along. Diana is too pretty, and having a pretty girl following me around might be a little…”
Connor didn’t want to expose his identity now. If he really let such a beautiful girl like Diana Murphy follow him, it would definitely cause misunderstandings.
“That’s fine too. I’ll call Carlos Lane later and let him know!”
Thomas agreed.
“Good!”
Connor nodded his head and continued, “By the way, I asked you to investigate the matter about Joey Shaw. How’s your investigation going?”
“There isn’t much progress. After all, Mr. Shaw is from the military and is different from ordinary people,” Thomas said directly.
“Oh…” Connor sighed helplessly and then said lightly, “Alright, I got it. If there’s anything, contact me by phone!”
“Alright!”
Thomas agreed and hung up the phone..

chapters.title: Chapter 568: A Cold Beauty
chapters.content:
Chapter 568: A Cold Beauty
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
After the call with Thomas, Connor lay on the bed and closed his eyes to rest.
Since the two killers were already dead and did not leave behind any useful clues, it was basically impossible for him to find out anything from them.
Therefore, Connor could only give up on investigating these two people for now and wait for the other party to make his next move.
The next day, at eight o’clock in the morning.
After Connor woke up, he washed up briefly, then put on his clothes and left the mansion. After leaving, Connor flagged down a taxi and headed straight for the bus station in Porthampton.
Borealis City wasn’t far from Porthampton, and the two places were already connected by train. However, it would take a long time if they were to take the train, not to mention that it was more troublesome, so Connor chose to take a bus to Borealis City instead.
There were more people in the bus. Connor felt that no matter how bold Rockerfeller’s people were, they definitely wouldn’t dare to attack him in the bus.
When they arrived at the bus station in Porthampton, Connor found that Carlos had been waiting for them for a long time, had been waiting tor them tor a long time.
Connor waved his hand at Carlos and walked toward him.
“Mr. McDonald, you’re here.” Carlos greeted Connor with a smile when he saw him walking over.
“Thank you for your hard work!” Connor said sheepishly. In fact, if it were not for the two killers he’d run into, he’d rather not trouble Carlos and the others because he felt that it was very awkward to have them around.
However, for the sake of safety, Connor could only ask Carlos to go to Borealis City with him. Otherwise, if he really encountered any danger on the way, he would not be able to handle it himself.
Carlos grinned and said, “Mr. McDonald, you’re too polite. My duty is to protect you, after all!”
“Alright, I’ll get Thomas Morgan to raise your salary when we get back!”
Connor patted Carlos’s shoulder gently and walked toward the ticket counter.
Carlos stopped Connor and said softly, “Mr. McDonald, I’ve already bought the tickets. You can just get on the bus…”
Connor glanced at Carlos indifferently. Without saying anything, he turned around and walked toward the bus.
It had to be said that with Carlos by Connor’s side, Connor was able to enjoy the feeling of being served. He did not need to do anything himself. He only needed to instruct Carlos to do something, and it would be done.
However, Connor did not treat Carlos as his subordinate. On the contrary, he preferred to get along with Carlos and the others as friends so that he could relax a lot.
A few minutes later, Connor and Carlos got on the bus. Although it was a bus, Carlos had bought the most luxurious bus ticket, so the interior was much better than that of a regular bus. Of course, the ticket price was also much higher…
Connor and Carlos found their seats quickly.
“Mr. McDonald, I was going to buy you a private room ticket, but those tickets were already sold out…” Carlos whispered to Connor.
“It doesn’t matter as long as we have a seat. It won’t be long anyway!” Connor replied to Carlos lightly and continued, “Also, when you talk to me, you don’t have to be so polite. Just treat me as a friend, or you’ll attract attention…” “Alright, I got it!” Carlos nodded slightly.
Connor ignored Carlos and took out his phone to chat with Yelena on WeChat.
Carlos was the calmest of Connor’s three bodyguards. Although he was a little introverted, he was also the best fighter.
When Carlos saw that Connor was silent, he turned to look at the scenery outside the window and did not take the initiative to talk to Connor.
“Clack clack clack!”
At this moment, the sound of high heels hitting the floor suddenly rang out. A girl wearing a black spaghetti strap dress and high heels quickly walked to Connor’s side. Then, she took out her ticket and checked it carefully. She turned her head and shouted at the girl behind her, “Yana, our seats are here…” “1 know!” The girl behind the spaghetti dress replied calmly. She was carrying a suitcase in her hand. Although the suitcase was not very big, it did not look very light, either. It would be very difficult for the girl to move the suitcase to the luggage rack.
Therefore, after hesitating for a moment, Connor stood up and said to the girl, “Let me help you!”
The girl in the spaghetti strap dress was stunned for a moment when she heard Connor’s words. Then, she quickly smiled and said, “Thank you!”
Carlos wanted to stand up and help Connor, but he was stopped by Connor. Connor moved the girl’s suitcase to the luggage rack alone, and then moved her friend’s suitcase up as well.
The girl in the spaghetti strap dress was very good-looking. Her skin was also very fair, giving off a feeling of purity. She seemed to be a few years younger than Connor.
The girl’s friend was also a top-grade beauty, both in figure and appearance. She had a beautiful face that could topple a country and its people, and there was a hint of charm in her eyes. She was not inferior to the pretty girls that Connor knew.
The beauty was dressed very sexily. She was wearing a white tight-fitting T-shirt and a short skirt, which perfectly accentuated her figure. Her slender and fair legs were exposed, and she was wearing a pair of ten-centimeter high heels. She looked extremely seductive.
After this beauty appeared, she instantly attracted the attention of countless men in the car.
There was no helping it; no matter where such a beautiful woman went, she would always be an extremely attractive existence.
The beauty in front of him was not only good-looking, but her figure was also very good. Even a casual movement of hers carried a seductive temperament that would lure one’s attention and make them unable to look away!
The beauty seemed to be used to people being attentive to her no matter where she went, so when she saw Connor take the initiative to move the suitcase up, she just smiled at Connor and didn’t say anything.
At this moment, the girl in the spaghetti strap dress said to Connor with a smile, “Hello there. Yana has always been like this, so please don’t mind her. Thank you so much for just now. If you hadn’t helped us move our suitcases, the two of us wouldn’t have known what to do…”
“It’s fine…”
Connor replied indifferently and then returned to his seat..

chapters.title: Chapter 569: I’m Making It Easier for My Friend to Come Out!
chapters.content:
Chapter 569: I’m Making It Easier for My Friend to Come Out!
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Inside the bus.
The girl in a spaghetti strap dress and the cold beauty sat opposite Connor and Carlos.
Carlos was introverted. He had been observing the people in the carriage to prevent any accidents, so he had no time to chat.
The tall and cold woman had been sitting in her original position since she got into the car and did not say a word.
“What’s your name?”
The girl in a spaghetti dress blinked and asked Connor.
“Connor McDonald…” Connor replied softly and then asked, “What’s your name?”
“My name is Lena Cox…”
Lena smiled faintly and turned to look at Carlos, who was beside Connor. She asked softly, “Is this person your friend?”
“Yes, he is!” Connor nodded lightly.
Lena was a talkative girl; when she saw that Connor was easy to get along with, she started chatting with him without any reservations.
After some small talk, Connor found out that Lena was a student at Porthampton Medical School and was on vacation for the next two days, so she was going home with the cold beauty to see how things were going.
The cold beauty was called Yana Weaver. She was pretty and had a good figure. As a result, many people pursued her in Porthampton’s Medical School. She was one of the more famous school beauties in the medical school.
Porthampton Medical School was still quite a distance away from the Porthampton University where Connor was, so it was normal for the students of the two schools to not know each other.
Connor felt that since Yana was so beautiful, she must have a lot of bootlickers around her. It was normal for her to be arrogant.
“Connor, why are you going to Borealis City?”
Lena asked with a smile.
“I’m going to a friend’s birthday party!” Connor replied indifferently.
“Then do you want to stay in our Borealis City for a few more days? I’m a resident of Borealis City, so when the time comes, I can bring you around for free…” Lena said enthusiastically.
Yana, who was sitting next to Lena, had a strange look in her eyes when she heard Lena’s words, but she didn’t say anything.
“No need. I’m just going to a birthday party and don’t plan to stay long. I’ll be back the day after tomorrow!” Connor gently shook his head and refused.
“Alright then!” Lena looked disappointed when Connor rejected her, but she didn’t continue to press him.
“We’ve already waited for so long. Why isn’t the bus moving?” Lena muttered as she looked at her phone.
“The departure time of the Porthampton bus station is fixed. Our bus should leave at 9:30…”
Connor replied in a low voice.
“So that’s how it is!”
Lena smiled and nodded. She then looked at Connor and continued, “Yana and 1 took the bus because we couldn’t get a train ticket. Previously, the two of us would take the train home…”
“Oh, 1 see!”
Connor nodded his head lightly and didn’t say anything.
At this moment, a burst of laughter suddenly came from the entrance of the car.
Four or five hooligans were chatting as they got on the bus.
When the ticket collector saw these men, he quickly said to them, “Please show me your tickets…”
“Who the f * ck are you going to ask for a ticket from? Do you know who owns this bus station?”
One of the men shouted after hearing the ticket collector’s words.
The ticket collector seemed to be frightened by the man’s imposing attitude. He hurriedly took two steps back, a puzzled expression on his face.
When the driver heard the argument at the door, he quickly turned around and said with a smile, “Cyrus, that’s Mr. Stewart and his friends. Mr. Stewart is the brother-in-law of the boss of Porthampton’s bus terminal. There’s no need to collect a ticket from him…”
“So it’s Mr. Stewart!”
When the ticket collector heard the driver’s words, his expression changed drastically. He hurriedly explained to the men, “Mr. Stewart, I’m really sorry. It’s my first day at work and I didn’t recognize you…”
“I’m fine…”
The yellow-haired man in the lead replied indifferently, then directly walked into the carriage.
After the so-called Mr. Stewart got into the car, he did not sit down for a long time. Instead, he kept looking for something in the car.
Very soon, Mr. Stewart turned his attention to Yana, and a smug smile appeared on his face.
In fact, is Mr. Stewart really wanted to go somewhere, he did not need to take the bus at all. He could just drive there directly.
However, Mr. Stewart would usually stroll around the Porthampton bus terminal when he had nothing to do. Then, he would look for some beautiful girls and use his identity as the brother-in-law of the bus terminal’s owner to hit on them with a high success rate. In the past two years, Mr. Stewart had hooked up with many beautiful girls.
Just now, Mr. Stewart and his friends had noticed Yana and were immediately attracted by her beauty. That was why they had gotten into the car just now.
It was obvious that Mr.Stewart was here for her.
After Mr. Stewart saw Yana, the smile on his face became even more wretched. He shouted at Connor, “Brat, go and find another seat to sit…”
Although Mr.Stewart was talking to Connor, he did not look at Connor at all. His small, wretched eyes were fixed on Yana, even though Yana’s face was full of disgust.
Connor turned his head and looked at Mr. Stewart as he asked expressionlessly, “Are you talking to me?”
“Nonsense, I’m not talking to you, I’m talking to a ghost!”
Mr. Stewart cursed at Connor with a gloomy face and then continued to shout, “Get to the back now. I’m not in the mood to talk nonsense with you, do you hear me?”
The passengers in the bus were also looking on quietly. After all, the bus driver had already said that Mr. Stewart was the brother-in-law of the bus terminal’s owner. They did not dare to provoke him.
“Young man, you’d better give up your seat to Mr. Stewart. There are still many seats at the back of the bus!”
The bus driver advised Connor out of kindness.
Connor sat on the spot and thought for a while. Then, he sighed softly and slowly stood up.
Yana’s eyes flashed with disappointment when she saw Connor standing up. Even Lena looked helpless. However, they also knew that it was very normal for Connor to stand up at this time.
After all, Connor and Yana did not know each other. There was no need for Connor to offend someone like Mr. Stewart just because of Yana, who was effectively a stranger.
“Haha, at least you know what’s good for you!”
When Mr. Stewart saw Connor stand up, he laughed happily.
However, Connor looked at Mr.. Stewart coldly and said expressionlessly, “I didn’t stand up to give way to you, but to make it easier for my friend to come out!”

chapters.title: Chapter 570: A Man of Steel
chapters.content:
Chapter 570: A Man of Steel
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
“Convenient for your friend to come out?”
After Kevin heard Connor’s words, he could not help but be stunned for a moment, and a puzzled expression appeared on his face.
“That’s right, he’s my friend!”
Connor replied expressionlessly.
“Your friend is…”
Kevin looked at Connor and was just about to speak when he suddenly noticed that someone behind him gently patted his shoulder.
Kevin turned around instinctively and saw Carlos standing behind him.
He sized Carlos up in disdain and asked coldly with a straight face, “Are you his friend?”
“Perhaps!”
Carlos replied calmly. In fact, Carlos had intended to say that he was Connor’s bodyguard, but after thinking about it, Connor did not want too many people to know his identity, so he could only say that he was his friend.
“What do you mean?”
Kevin sized up Carlos from head to toe. He did not take Carlos seriously when he saw that Carlos was not very strong.
Carlos ignored Kevin and turned to look at Connor as if he was asking for his opinion.
At this time, Connor had already returned to his seat and said casually, “Get these people out of the bus!”
He did not have any deep enmity with Kevin and the rest, so he did not want to make things too difficult for them for now.
“Did you hear that? As long as all of you get out of the bus now, I won’t do anything!” Carlos said to Kevin in a low voice with a straight face.
“Hahaha!” Kevin could not help but burst into laughter when he heard Carlos’s words. He then pointed at Connor and shouted, “Who the hell do you think you are? Do you think 1’11 get off the bus just because you say so?”
A trace of ruthlessness flashed across Carlos’s eyes. He did not waste any more words with Kevin and directly raised his fist to punch Kevin’s stomach.
Carlos was from the special forces, and he was the best among Connor’s bodyguards. Although he did not talk much usually, he was definitely the most ruthless in combat.
It could be said that Carlos had used all his strength in the punch just now. He was confident that he could send a fatty who weighed two hundred pounds flying with one punch, let alone an ordinary person like Kevin.
Kevin flew directly towards the front of the car with a scream and smashed into the car window.
When the hooligans who followed Kevin saw this scene, they were instantly dumbfounded.
They did not expect Carlos to be so powerful, and they did not expect him to be so unreasonable as to attack immediately.
“How dare you hit me?”
Kevin was sprawled on the ground and shouted with a pained expression.
“I’m warning you for the last time. Get out of here quickly, or you’ll regret it!”
Carlos stood where he was and said this to Kevin calmly.
Although there were many people around Kevin, most of them were hooligans. They could bully ordinary people normally, but they had no ability to resist Carlos, who was a special forces soldier.
Moreover, Kevin was not a fool. That punch just now almost knocked him out. He knew very well that Carlos’s skills were not something they could withstand.
Kevin lay on the ground and hesitated for a moment. Then, he shouted with a ferocious expression, “Alright, you’re amazing. Just you f * eking wait—You’ll regret this…”
After saying this, Kevin did not hesitate at all. He turned around and ran out of the bus.
As for Kevin’s lackeys, they were not fools. After seeing Kevin run away, they also ran out of the car.
Carlos sat beside Connor expressionlessly after Kevin and the others left.
Connor turned his head and glanced at him, saying indifferently, “You were a little too heavy-handed just now…”
“I’ll be more careful in the future!” Carlos explained nervously when he heard Connor’s voice.
Connor hesitated for a moment, but didn’t say anything. In fact, Connor did not want to bring Carlos and the others with him because they were different from ordinary people.
It was a small matter at first, but if Carlos were to make a move, it might become a big deal, and someone might even die.
Although these people could solve some problems for Connor, they would also bring some trouble to him.
After Kevin and the others got out of the car, the car instantly fell silent.
Lena and Yana sized up Connor and Carlos. They could tell that Carlos’s skills were not simple, and Connor gave off a mysterious feeling.
When the bus driver saw Kevin and the others get out of the car, he hurriedly shouted at Connor, “Young man, the person you just offended is the brother-in-law of the boss of Porthampton’s bus stations! I heard that he knows a lot of people in the higher echelons of society. If you beat him up today, he definitely won’t let it go. I think you should hurry up and get out of the bus. I’ll refund the fare to the two of you…”
Connor didn’t want to cause any more trouble, so he looked down at his phone.
However, if Connor got off now, he wouldn’t be able to reach Borealis City before 7 pm.
Therefore, Connor could only say lightly, “It’s fine. Just drive!” When the bus driver heard Connor’s words, he could not help but be stunned for a moment. A trace of helplessness flashed across his face.
However, he had already brought this up to Connor just now. Connor did not listen to him, so he had no choice but to start the car.
After the car started, the passengers in the car began to chat. No one paid attention to Connor at all. On the other hand, Yana and Lena were very interested in the two of them. However, Yana had a very cold personality. When she saw that Connor didn’t take the initiative to talk to her, she ignored him and turned her head to look at the scenery outside the window.
“Connor, who is this friend of yours? He seems very powerful!”
Lena noticed that Carlos was cold and didn’t talk much, so she didn’t ask him this question directly. Instead, she asked Connor softly.
“His name is Carlos Lane, and he is my friend. He was a special forces soldier before, and his skills are indeed amazing!” Connor explained with a smile.
“Hello, Carlos!”
Lena called out to Carlos with a smile.
“Yes!”
Carlos had fully displayed his iron and straight nature at this moment and acknowledged her without turning his head.
After hearing Carlos’s response, Connor’s expression went blank.
Connor had thought that his EQ.was already low enough, but he did not expect Carlos to have an even lower EQ than him.
Lena was taking the initiative to talk to him, and the only thing he could reply with was an “okay”?
Lena looked at Carlos awkwardly and didn’t know how to answer him..

chapters.title: Chapter 571:I Can Help You!
chapters.content:
Chapter 571:I Can Help You!
Translator: End less Fantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
“I’m sorry, my friend is a little introverted. Please don’t mind!” Connor looked at Lena and explained awkwardly.
“I’m fine…” Lena smiled at Connor and started chatting with him.
In fact, Yana was also very curious about Connor now. However, after seeing that Connor had no intention of talking to her, she would not take the initiative to talk to Connor. She turned and looked at the scenery outside the car window.
Connor and Lena chatted in the car.
Carlos and Yana, on the other hand, were the kind of people who didn’t like to talk.
Therefore, the two of them had been playing with their phones or looking at the scenery outside the car window. They did not say a word along the way.
Tsk tsk!
After driving for nearly an hour, the bus stopped by the road.
When Connor saw the bus stop, he subconsciously looked out of the window and found that there were several vans in the middle of the road.
When the people in the van saw the bus stop, they immediately opened the door.
Then, a dozen tattooed men walked out of the van with baseball bats, machetes, and other weapons.
And as they walked, they were shouting at the bus.
Connor realized that the man walking in front was none other than Mr. Stewart, Kevin Stewart, who had been kicked out of the car by Carlos.
It was obvious that these people were hired thugs by Kevin to take revenge on Connor and Carlos.
Kevin was the brother-in-law of the boss of the bus terminal, so he was very familiar with the route of the bus. It was very easy for him to stop Connor and Carlos on the way.
“Piece of sh*t who hit me just now, get down here now, or don’t blame me for being rude!”
Kevin waved the baseball bat in his hand and shouted arrogantly.
When Lena and Yana saw this, they were dumbfounded.
They did not expect to encounter such a thing.
Although Kevin was targeting Connor and Carlos, the cause of this incident was Yana.
Once Kevin dealt with Connor and Carlos, he would definitely not let Yana off.
“Yana, what should we do?” Lena was even more panicked. She grabbed Yana’s arm and shouted nervously.
“I… I don’t know either!” Yana gritted her teeth and replied in a low voice.
When the passengers in the car saw Kevin, their expressions immediately relaxed.
They knew that these people were probably here for Connor, everyone looked at Connor with pity.
These passengers hoped that Connor could get off the bus as soon as possible. After all, they had nothing to do with Connor and Carlos. They did not want to be implicated because of Connor.
Of course, they knew that Carlos was very skilled, so they dared not say it out loud even if they thought so.
After hesitating for a few seconds, the bus driver whispered to Connor, “Young man, you’re in big trouble this time. 1 advised you to get off the car earlier, but you refused to listen. Now…”
Connor glanced at the driver and didn’t say anything.
Carlos, on the other hand, was even calmer. In his opinion, the people outside were no match for him at all.
“Let me tell you, did you see the person behind Kevin? That person is Pete!”
The driver pointed at a tall and rough-looking young man behind him.
“Who is Pete?” Connor asked the driver softly.
“This Pete is a very famous gangster here. He seems to have a martial arts background and is very skilled. In the past few years, he has taken in many underlings. He is an existence that everyone in this area knows. Moreover, I heard that Pete once defeated more than ten strong men alone. If you offend such a person today, it will not end up well for you…” the driver explained.
“Won’t the police do anything?” Connor asked indifferently.
“The police?” The driver smiled bitterly and said, “Why don’t you take a look at this place? This is the wilderness. Even if you call the police now, it will take them at least half an hour to arrive. Half an hour is enough for them to take you away. Moreover, Pete has some background there. Ordinary people don’t dare to interfere in his matters!”
After the passengers in the car heard the driver’s words, they seemed to pity Connor even more.
Lena looked even more nervous.
“Young man, if you believe me, you should get out of the car and apologize to Mr. Stewart now. Then, you should compensate him. Maybe this can be resolved. Otherwise, it will be even more troublesome…”
The driver said to Connor kindly.
“That’s right, young man. You’d better get out of the car and apologize to Mr. Stewart!”
“It’s still not too late to apologize now…”
The passengers in the car also looked at Connor and advised him.
In fact, Connor knew very well that these people just wanted to get Connor out of the car. The rest had nothing to do with these people. They were not worried about Connor’s safety but about themselves.
Yana turned to look at Connor and said coldly, “Just now, the two of you were so impulsive and hit someone. Now you know that you’ve caused big trouble, right? Do you regret it?”
After Connor heard Yana’s words, a trace of helplessness flashed in his eyes.
This matter itself was caused by Yana. Connor also offended Kevin in order to help Yana.
But now that Connor was in danger, not only did Yana not step forward to help, but she was also making sarcastic remarks.
Connor was somewhat regretful now.
However, it was useless for him to regret now. Connor turned to look at Carlos, who gave him a reassuring look.
After understanding Carlos’s intention, Connor stood up without any hesitation.
When Lena saw Connor stand up, she quickly reached out and pulled him. Then, she shouted excitedly at Connor, “Connor, are you crazy? Are you really going?”
“They’ve already come looking for me. What can I do if I don’t go?” Connor asked calmly.
“But there are so many people on the other side. What if Kevin doesn’t accept your apology? No matter how good Carlos is at fighting, he cannot possibly defeat so many people. And those people are all armed!” Lena said anxiously.
“Don’t worry, they won’t dare to do anything to the two of us!” Connor smiled nonchalantly and was going to leave the car with Carlos.
“If you beg me now, I can help you solve this!” However, just as Connor was about to get out of the car, Yana suddenly shouted at Connor.
Connor was surprised to hear that. Then, without any hesitation, he stepped out of the car..

chapters.title: Chapter 572: Yana’s Backstory
chapters.content:
Chapter 572: Yana’s Backstory
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation  Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
After seeing Connor get off the car, Yana seemed angry.
She had never thought that Connor would be so arrogant, ignoring her advice.
So, she followed Carlos out of the car and said with a pout, “It is unexpected that this Connor actually does not know what is good for him. Today, 1 want to see how you are going to deal with these people…”
After saying this, Yana put away her phone.
It was obvious that Yana had some background.
Otherwise, she wouldn’t have said those words to Connor just now.
However, Connor’s attitude made Yana very angry, so she didn’t plan to continue helping Connor.
“Yana, how are you still saying things like that at times like this? Hurry up and think of a way!” Lena shouted at Yana anxiously after she saw Yana put her phone away.
“Wasn’t Connor very powerful just now? Since he’s so confident, I think he should be able to resolve this…” Yana turned to look at Lena and replied with a pout.
