“Gosh, can you not be angry here? Connor also provoked Kevin and those people because of you. Do you intend to leave him in the lurch? There are so many people outside. Even if Connor goes down and apologizes to them, they might not let him off…” Lena said with a frown.
Yana couldn’t help but hesitate before saying softly, “Then I’ll help him once…”
Yana knew very well in her heart that if it wasn’t for her, Connor would not have offended Mr. Stewart.
Therefore, even if Connor’s attitude was a little cold just now, she did not want to leave him in the lurch.
“Hurry up and make the call!” Lena shouted.
Yana took out her phone again. After hesitating, she made a call.
‘Beep, beep…’
After the phone rang twice, the other party picked up the call.
“Hello, who is this?” The voice of a middle-aged man came from the other end of the phone.
“Uncle Hubert, it’s me, Yana…” Yana hurriedly replied gently.
“Yana?”
After hearing this name, Titus was obviously stunned for a moment. Then, he said indifferently, “Oh, Yana. Why are you suddenly free to call me today? Did you run into some trouble?”
One could tell that even though Titus knew Yana’s identity, he was still very cold.
This meant that this person’s relationship with Yana was very ordinary.
“Uncle Hubert, my friend and 1 encountered some trouble on the way. There are two guys called Kevin and Pete. They stopped us on the way…” Yana explained softly.
After saying that, Yana could not help but turn to look outside and saw that Connor and Carlos had already walked up to Kevin.
“Pete? Which Pete?” Titus asked with a puzzled tone.
“There’s a person called Pete at the border of Porthampton and Borealis City. 1 don’t know who this Pete is either…” Yana replied helplessly.
“So it’s that kid Pete. I know who he is!”
The other party came to a realization and continued, “Yana, you can rest assured. I will help you resolve this…”
“Thank you, Uncle Hubert…”
Yana finally heaved a sigh of relief when she heard Uncle Hubert agree so readily.
“No need to thank me. Your sister told me before that if you have any trouble looking for me, I must do my best to help you!”
The other party replied indifferently and then hung up.
After hearing that the other party had hung up the phone, the smile on Yana’s face instantly disappeared. Then, she looked at her phone with a dazed expression. No one knew what she was thinking.
“Well?” Lena asked excitedly when she saw Yana put down her phone.
“Don’t worry, I’ve already taken care of it…” Yana replied softly.
“So why do you look a little unhappy?” Lena could tell that something was wrong with Yana, so she asked with a frown.
“No… It’s nothing…” Yana replied indifferently without explaining too much.
Yana wasn’t very familiar with Uncle Hubert. Uncle Hubert was only willing to help her because of Yana’s sister.
Originally, Yana didn’t plan to use this relationship. After all, this kind of relationship could only be used once.
However, Yana didn’t expect to waste this relationship because of Connor’s small slip-up.
The reason Uncle Hubert helped Yana was that he owed Yana’s sister a favor.
Now that Yana had called Uncle Hubert, it was equivalent to using her sister’s favor.
In the future, if she wanted to ask for help again, they would not be so happy.
Therefore, Yana was in a bad mood because she felt that she had wasted such a good relationship.
However, it was too late for Yana to regret now.
Therefore, she could only turn to Lena and say, “Lena, let’s get out of the car…”
“Won’t anything happen if we get out of the car now?” Lena asked in fear.
“It should be fine…” Yana had already finished her call with Uncle Hubert. She felt that the other party probably wouldn’t have the guts to do anything to her, so she stepped out of the car.
Lena hesitated before following Yana out of the car.
At this moment, Pete, Kevin, and the others had surrounded Connor and Carlos. They were all armed with weapons, and their expressions were fierce.
Meanwhile, Connor and Carlos were calm.
Carlos had fought with them before, these people were still a little afraid of Carlos, so they were not in a hurry to attack Carlos and Connor.
“Mr. McDonald, do you want me to get rid of these people?” Carlos asked Connor in a low voice.
“Talk to them first. Don’t be in a hurry to make a move!” Connor replied indifferently.
Connor was only going to Borealis City to attend Luke’s granddaughter’s birthday party. He didn’t want to cause any trouble.
If they fought later, it would delay Connor’s business, then the gains would not make up for the losses.
Carlos did not say anything after hearing Connor’s words. He stood quietly behind Connor..

chapters.title: Chapter 573: Kneel and Apologize to Me
chapters.content:
Chapter 573: Kneel and Apologize to Me
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
“Brat, it was the two of you who beat Mr. Stewart up just now, right?”
At this moment, the man called Pete walked up and shouted at Connor sinisterly.
After hearing Pete’s words, Connor’s face twisted in disdain. Then, he said indifferently, “That’s right, that person was beaten up by my friend…”
“Hah, since you guys hit Mr. Stewart, shouldn’t you give us an explanation?” Pete couldn’t help but sneer when he saw Connor agree so readily.
Although Pete knew that Pete was not an ordinary fighter, he was not afraid at all.
After all, they had so many people on their side, and they were all armed. No matter how powerful Pete was, he was no match for them.
“Explanation?”
Connor couldn’t help but laugh when he heard Pete’s words. Then, he said expressionlessly, “What explanation do you want?”
“I heard that Mr. Stewart only wanted to exchange seats with you. Your friend beat Mr. Stewart up to this state. We are all reasonable people, so I won’t make things difficult for you. According to the rules, shouldn’t you apologize to Mr. Stewart and pay some medical fees? Then, this will be considered over…”
After Pete saw that Connor was not rude, he was not in a hurry to order his men to attack Connor.
After all, it was better to avoid trouble. If it could be solved with money, it was best not to use knives and guns.
Moreover, Pete felt that Connor was not rude now because he was afraid, so he wanted to take this opportunity to blackmail Connor.
“Medical expenses?”
Connor couldn’t help but laugh when he heard this. Then, he turned and sized up Kevin. He realized that Kevin wasn’t injured at all, so he asked softly, “How much do you think is appropriate?”
Pete turned and glanced at Kevin as if asking for his opinion.
“You beat me up. I should get at least a million dollars!” Kevin shouted at the top of his lungs.
After Connor heard Kevin’s words, he was very speechless.
After all, Pete had only hit Kevin once in the car.
Kevin was demanding an exorbitant price of one million dollars. This was clearly extortion!
If Kevin only asked for 10, ooo or 20, 000, Connor might pay this sum of money to solve this problem as soon as possible.
After all, this money was nothing to Connor. Connor was not in the mood to waste time with these people.
But what Connor never expected was that Kevin actually asked for a million dollars the moment he opened his mouth!
“Isn’t one million a little too little?” Connor asked Kevin with a smile.
“What do you mean?” Kevin was stunned for a moment before looking at Connor and asking.
“You have such a noble body. How can one million be enough? I think you should get at least five million, don’t you think?” Connor said with a smile.
When Kevin and the others heard Connor’s offer, they were all stunned and puzzled.
They didn’t understand what Connor meant.
Usually, when encountering such a thing, most people would bargain, but Connor actually increased the price himself.
“What? You want to give me five million dollars?”
Kevin didn’t think Connor was mocking him at all. He was a little excited as he asked Connor with a grin.
“Are you f*cking stupid?”
Pete kicked Kevin speechlessly, then shouted at Connor with a straight face, “Brat, do you not wish to pay this sum of money? If you do not wish to pay this sum of money, we will not be nice…”
“I can only offer 500 dollars at most. If you can accept it, then take 500 dollars and get lost. If you can’t accept it, then forget it!” Connor said lightly.
“How dare you f*cking trick me? Everyone, attack!” Pete shouted at the top of his lungs.
When Pete’s underlings heard this, they picked up their weapons and rushed toward Connor and Pete.
“Be careful when you attack. Don’t kill anyone…” Connor reminded.
“I understand…”
Carlos nodded slightly and then rushed toward Pete and the others.
“Stop!”
However, just as the two sides were about to engage in a great battle, a delicate cry suddenly sounded from behind Connor.
When everyone heard this, they turned to look behind Connor and saw two beautiful women walking out of the car.
When Pete saw Yana, a hint of excitement flashed in his eyes. It couldn’t be helped that a girl like Yana was simply really beautiful. Any man who saw her would be captivated.
“Mr. Stewart, did you have a conflict with these two people because of this beautiful woman?”
Pete turned to look at Kevin and said with a smile.
“Yes…”
Kevin sized up Yana and nodded gently.
Yana walked to Pete’s side and asked, “You are Pete, right?”
“Yes, yes, pretty lady. What’s up?”
Pete replied with a smile while gulping.
“These two people are my friends. Let’s end this here today. I don’t want to make a big deal out of it…” Yana said to Pete expressionlessly.
As Yana already knew that Uncle Hubert was willing to help, she was very confident.
“Girl, if you sleep with us tonight, this will be over. What do you think?”
Pete’s underlings hurriedly shouted at Yana.
Lena’s pretty face was filled with shame and anger when she heard these people’s obscenities.
Yana seemed to be used to this kind of thing. She asked Pete softly, “Pete, what do you plan to do?”
Pete looked at Yana carefully and said lightly, “Girl, my bros were joking with you just now. Please don’t take it to heart!”
“What do you want?” Yana looked at Pete and asked coldly.
“All right, since the woman has asked for it herself, how about this? I’ll take a step back and ask this kid to apologize to Mr. Stewart. Then, he will pay just 50, 000 dollars for the medical fees.” Pete said lightly.
When Yana heard Pete’s words, she was overjoyed.
That was because 50,000 dollars was nothing to Yana. Moreover, she didn’t need Uncle Hubert’s help.
Therefore, she subconsciously looked at Connor, wanting him to hurry up and apologize to Kevin.
Connor looked at Pete and said expressionlessly, “I’ve already said that I only have 500 dollars and won’t give you a single cent more. Also, if this person kneels and apologizes to me, I won’t pursue this anymore!”
When everyone heard Connor, they were all shocked!

chapters.title: Chapter 574: Hubert Jordan of Borealis City!
chapters.content:
Chapter 574: Hubert Jordan of Borealis City!
Translator: End less Fantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
After everyone heard Connor, they were all dumbfounded.
Even Pete was shocked.
He looked at Connor curiously and asked coldly, “Kid, what did you say to me just now?”
“I said that if Mr. Stewart is willing to kneel and apologize to me, perhaps I will not pursue this. Do you understand what I mean?” Connor replied expressionlessly.
“Do you have a f*cking death wish?”
When Pete’s lackeys heard Connor’s words, they picked up the weapons in their hands and prepared to rush toward Connor.
Pete reached out to stop his underling, then rubbed his chin and narrowed his eyes at Connor. “Brat, 1 did not expect you to have such boldness. 1 originally planned to ask you to pay some money and not fuss about this with you. However, you do not know what is good for you. In that case, don’t blame me for being rough to you…”
“Pete, don’t waste your breath on this kid. Just get him!”
“That’s right. I think this kid needs to be taught a lesson. He’ll know how powerful we are after we beat him up…”
Pete’s lackeys rubbed their fists as if this had something to do with them.
In fact, a large part of the reason they were so angry was that they could hear from Connor’s tone that he was disdainful of Pete.
People who came out to mingle valued their reputation the most. If they were looked down on by others, they would not be able to hang around and be loud in the area in the future.
Pete stood before Connor calmly. He was confident that he could defeat those people in half a minute if they dared to attack him. Therefore, he did not look flustered at all.
Yana looked at Connor helplessly, not knowing what to say.
“Pete has already taken a step back. Why doesn’t Connor know what’s good for him? What was the point of showing off?” Yana could not help but sigh internally.
Yana’s good impression of Connor had plummeted. In her eyes, Connor was simply an egotistical person without any brains.
Even if Pete was skilled, he would not be a match for so many people.
Wasn’t Connor just looking for trouble by saying all these?
“Brat, 1 will give you one last chance. Are you going to apologize or not…”
Pete took a step forward and whispered to Connor.
“Then, 1’11 give you one last chance!” Connor didn’t wait for Pete to finish speaking before interrupting him.
“Alright, you’ve got guts. I hope you’ll have the same guts later!” Pete sneered, then turned to his lackeys and shouted, “Kill him!”
‘Whoosh!’
When Pete’s lackeys heard this, they were like wild beasts that had been released from their cages and rushed toward Connor.
“Yana, hurry up and save Connor!” Lena shouted at Yana nervously when she saw that Pete was really going to hit him.
Yana didn’t intend to care about Connor at all, but she had already called Uncle Hubert just now. Now, she couldn’t ignore him.
After all, she couldn’t waste the favor she owed him. Therefore, after hesitating, Yana gritted her teeth and stood up.
“Pete, what do you mean? Don’t tell me you don’t even want to show respect to my Uncle Hubert?” Yana shouted at Pete.
“Uncle Hubert?”
When Pete heard Yana’s words, he was stunned for a moment. Then, he asked with a straight face, “Who is Uncle Hubert?”
“Hubert Jordan from Borealis City!” Yana blurted out the name without thinking.
When Pete heard the name, his expression changed drastically. His lackeys immediately stopped what they were doing.
It was obvious that the name ‘Hubert Jordan’ had worked.
Connor subconsciously turned to look at Yana curiously.
Connor had somehow felt that Yana came from a certain background.
Otherwise, when Connor got off the car, Yana would never have said those things. However, Connor didn’t know who Hubert Jordan was.
Connor didn’t know what kind of person Hubert was, but Pete was very clear about it.
Although Hubert was not a particularly powerful person, he was still a local gangster with some influence. He had many brothers under him, and the power in his hands was naturally not something that a hooligan like Pete could compare to.
If Pete really offended Hubert because of today’s matter, it would also have a huge impact on him.
However, there was no evidence now. Pete would not believe that Yana really knew Hubert just because of what she said.
After all, there were many people who knew Hubert, but whether they knew him or not was a different matter.
“What’s your relationship with Hubert?” Pete hesitated and asked Yana.
Yana glanced at Pete and said softly, “Hubert is my uncle. I’ve already called him just now…”
“You think I’ll believe you just because you said you called him?!” Pete couldn’t help but laugh coldly. Then, he continued, “If you really know Hubert, I will not make things difficult for you. You just need to give Hubert a call and I will confirm it…”
After Yana heard Pete’s words, she became awkward.
She didn’t expect Pete to be so cautious. She wasn’t very close to Hubert.
It was only because Yana’s sister had once helped Hubert that he was willing to help.
Yana felt that if she called Hubert now, he would definitely be unhappy.
This kind of situation was also very understandable. After all, he had already promised to help solve this, but if she kept calling him to urge him, that would seem a little rude.
“I’ve already called Uncle Hubert just now. Uncle Hubert said that his people will be here soon…” After hesitating, Yana explained.
When Pete heard that Hubert’s men were coming, he was also shocked. He asked, “Are you sure Hubert’s men are coming?”
“I’m sure…” Yana nodded.
“All right, then I’ll wait here!” Pete replied expressionlessly. Then, he waved his hand, signaling his lackeys behind him not to make a move..

chapters.title: Chapter 575: The Two Men Stay
chapters.content:
Chapter 575: The Two Men Stay
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Pete was worried that Yana really knew Hubert.
If he offended Hubert because of this, he would really lose more than he would gain.
Therefore, he was not rushing to attack Connor. Instead, he stood and waited quietly.
Carlos stood beside Connor. After a moment of hesitation, he said to Connor softly, “Mr. McDonald, the birthday party is at seven o’clock. If we continue to waste time here, we might be a little delayed!”
Connor picked up his cell phone and took a look. He realized that it was only 12 PM. There should still be time.
“Wait for another half an hour. If no one comes after half an hour, you can take action immediately!”
Connor didn’t want to complicate matters. If Yana could resolve this, that would naturally be for the best.
However, if the other person couldn’t come for a while, Connor didn’t plan to waste any more time.
“Yes!” Carlos nodded slightly and started to observe Pete’s lackeys.
Carlos was a very professional bodyguard, so he had a plan when he attacked. He planned whom he would hit first, whom he would hit next, how long it would take to finish them all, and how much strength he would use to make those people lose their ability to fight but not kill them.
Bruno and Diana weren’t there. If they were here, even if there were fifty people, they would be able to take them down in a short time.
Time passed slowly. Pete and the others chatted while waiting quietly.
Yana walked to Connor with a helpless expression. She frowned and said to Connor, “Just now, they agreed to let you off as long as you’re willing to pay for the medical fees. Why did you still try to be brave?”
“I don’t have that much money!” Connor turned to look at Yana and replied calmly.
“If you don’t have that much money, 1 can give it to you. What good does it do to make things this difficult?”
After Yana heard Connor’s words, she seemed to be even more helpless.
“You didn’t say you would help me pay the money just now!” Connor said lightly.
“You…” Yana looked at Connor, frustrated. She didn’t know what to say now.
“Yana, there’s no point blaming Connor!” Lena stood beside Yana and advised her softly.
“If it wasn’t because Connor wanted to help me, offending Kevin, do you think I would have to worry about these?” Yana replied with a straight face, then returned to her original spot and waited for Hubert’s men to come over.
“Who is that Hubert Jordan you mentioned?” Connor asked Yana curiously.
“He’s just a gangster!” Carlos answered before Yana could say anything.
When Connor, Yana, Lena, and the others heard Carlos’s answer, they all turned to look in Carlos’s direction, puzzled.
“Who are you calling a gangster? If it weren’t for Uncle Hubert’s help today, none of us would have been able to leave…” Yana shouted at Carlos angrily.
“Even without this person’s help, Mr. McDonald and 1 can still leave!” Carlos said calmly.
“You… You’re just like Connor, you’re both crazy…” Looking at Carlos, Yana was so angry that she didn’t know what to say.
“Do you know that person?” Connor turned and asked Carlos.
“I’ve met Mr. Morgan a few times. Mr. Morgan said that this person is a local gangster…” Carlos replied faintly.
Connor looked at Carlos and smiled. He already knew what kind of person Hubert was.
Since Thomas could evaluate Hubert this way, it meant that Hubert was indeed not an influential big shot.
“Who are you talking about? He actually…” Yana seemed to be a little unconvinced as she turned around and questioned Carlos.
However, before she could finish her sentence, she saw a black Jaguar slowly driving over.
The Jaguar stopped right in the middle of the crowd.
A young man with blond hair walked out of the car and scolded coldly, “Pete, are you f*cking tired of living? You actually dare to touch Mr. Jordan’s people. Hurry up and let her go…”
When Pete saw the blond-haired man, he showed a disdainful expression and said indifferently, “Hehe, I thought Mr. Jordan would come personally. I didn’t expect it to be you!”
If Hubert had come personally, Pete would definitely be a little wary.
However, when Pete saw the blond-haired youth, he instantly relaxed.
This was because this blond-haired guy wasn’t Hubert’s subordinate. Like Pete, he was also a gangster in this area.
However, this blond-haired guy had a good relationship with Hubert, but if they were to compare, this blond-haired guy was not even as good as Pete.
Hubert didn’t come personally. Instead, he asked the blond guy to settle this on his behalf.
That meant that Yana and Hubert’s relationship wasn’t that good. Otherwise, why wouldn’t Hubert come personally?
Even if he couldn’t make it, he should at least call Pete and tell him to leave Yana alone.
Yana was naturally aware of this, so a trace of disappointment flashed in her eyes.
He wasn’t very familiar with Hubert, so it was expected that Hubert didn’t come personally.
“Pete, Mr. Jordan called me just now and said that you can’t touch these people, so you should know what to do, right? Don’t offend Mr. Jordan because of this…”
When the blond guy spoke to Pete, he sounded like he was testing the waters.
After all, the blond had only received a call from Hubert’s secretary, so he was not sure what Hubert’s attitude was.
However, if Pete’s attitude was very firm, the blond was not willing to get himself involved in this.
Pete was very smart. From the tone of the blond, he could tell that Hubert didn’t have to save Yana. He was just putting up a show for her.
However, the contradiction in today’s matter was not Yana in the first place. Yana had never offended Pete and the others.
Therefore, Pete did him a favor and said softly, “Since Mr. Jordan has said so, then 1 would just let it go. Take her with you!”
“At least you are sensible…” The blond guy smiled happily and told Yana and the others, “All right, let’s go!”
“Wait!” But at this moment, Pete suddenly shouted.
“What now? Are you going back on your word?” The yellow-haired guy turned to look at Pete and asked with a displeased expression.
“It’s not that I’m going back on my word. These two women know Mr. Jordan. It’s fine if you want to take them with you, but you have to let me keep these two men!” Pete pointed at Connor and Carlos and said expressionlessly.
Yana and Lena were stunned when they heard that..

chapters.title: Chapter 576: Get Jude Campbell to Come Here
chapters.content:
Chapter 576: Get Jude Campbell to Come Here
Translator: End less Fantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
When Yana and Lena heard Henrick’s words, they were confused.
The two of them had never expected Henrick to go so far.
At this moment, Hubert’s men had already arrived, but Henrick was still unwilling to let Connor and Carlos go.
Yana called Hubert not because of her own matters, but because she wanted to save Connor.
However, if she could not save Connor now, then wouldn’t her call be in vain?
“Yana, Connor and Carlos offended Kevin Stewart because of us. We can’t just stand by and watch them die, right?”
Lena exclaimed anxiously.
Meanwhile, Yana turned to look at the yellow-haired young man that Hubert Jordan had asked to come, as if she wanted to ask for his help.
The yellow-haired guy was not as strong as Henrick. Moreover, Hubert’s secretary called him this time, so he did not have much confidence.
When he saw Henrick let Yana and Lena go, he heaved a sigh of relief.
He knew that if he were to ask Henrick for Connor and Carlos, Henrick would definitely be very dissatisfied. The conflict between the two of them might even escalate.
“Benjamin, these two people beat up my brother. I’ve already given you face by agreeing to let you take these two women away, but you absolutely can’t take these two people away!”
Henrick looked up at the yellow-haired guy and said calmly.
Benjamin Wheeler knew very well what Henrick meant.
Therefore, he could only say to Yana with a helpless expression, “Miss Weaver, the order I received was to bring you with me. Mr. Jordan didn’t mention anything else, so I can’t get involved in other people’s matters, and I won’t meddle in other people’s business…”
“But…”
When Yana heard Benjamin’s words, her face was filled with despair.
“Since you didn’t come here to save Connor, why did you come here?”
Lena called out as well.
“If you want to save these two brats, that’s fine too. As long as you call Mr.
Jordan now. If he says that he wants to protect these two people, I can also take them away…”
Benjamin thought for a moment and said calmly.
Yana’s felt very conflicted.
Because Hubert didn’t come personally but asked this yellow-haired guy to come. This was enough to explain many things.
However, Yana did not want to see Connor and Carlos get into trouble because of her. After hesitating for a while, she said lightly, “Alright, I’ll call Uncle Jordan now…”
After saying that, Yana took out her phone and dialed Hubert’s number.
“Yana, what’s wrong?”
Hubert answered the call quickly and asked softly.
Yana hesitated for a moment, then told Hubert about her situation.
“Uncle Jordan, these two friends of mine offended Henrick and the others because of me. Can you help them?” Yana pleaded softly.
“Yana, your sister told me to protect you, but she didn’t ask me to protect your friends. You probably don’t understand Henrick’s personality. If I really piss him off, he might not even give me face. Do you understand what I mean?” Hubert said lightly.
H 11
After hearing Hubert’s words, Yana was stunned. Her face was filled with despair.
As long as one wasn’t a fool, one should be able to understand the meaning behind Hubert’s words.
Hubert obviously didn’t want to care about Connor’s matter.
Therefore, after taking a deep breath, Yana said in a low voice, “Uncle Jordan, I understand what you mean…”
“Okay!”
Hubert didn’t waste any time and hung up the phone.
After the call ended, Yana looked at Connor and Carlos in despair. At this moment, she was at her wit’s end.
“Yana, what did he say?”
Lena asked Yana anxiously.
“Hubert told me not to be a busybody…”
Yana replied indifferently, then said with a somewhat disappointed expression, “I don’t have much status in the Weaver Family. Hubert helped me this time because of my sister. This might be the difference between the direct line and the collateral line. When my sister went to Borealis, Hubert brought people to welcome her personally. He was also very respectful to my sister. However, whenever I call him, he always ignores me. Now, he’s even asking someone else to deal with this…”
“Then, what should we do? Yana, hurry up and think of something!”
Lena almost cried when she heard that.
“What can I do now? If not for my sister, Hubert might not even care about the two of us…”
Yana said helplessly.
Lena stood rooted to the ground, dumbfounded.
Because she knew that if Yana said that she had no way, then she really had no way.
‘We’re both from the Weaver Family, but the difference is so big!’
Yana couldn’t help but sigh as she thought to herself.
At this moment, she began to hesitate whether she should call her sister or not.
However, after hesitating for a moment, Yana quickly gave up on this idea.
This was because she knew that her sister would definitely not care about this matter. After all, Connor and Carlos had nothing to do with Yana.
If Yana was in danger, her sister might intervene. However, Yana was not in danger at all.
“So? What did Mr. Jordan say?”
In fact, Henrick already knew what was going on. After all, he could tell from Yana’s expression.
“What do we have to do for you to let my two friends go?”
Yana frowned and shouted.
“It’s very simple. Give me 500,000 dollars for the medical fees, and I’ll let them go!”
“Of course, if you can get Jude Campbell from Borealis City to come here, we can let you guys go…”
Henrick chuckled.
“Hahaha…”
Everyone burst into laughter when they heard what Henrick said.
This was because the Jude Campbell that Henrick had mentioned was the most powerful and wealthy heir in Borealis City.
The Campbell Family was one of the top families in Borealis City. Henrick was obviously deliberately making things difficult for Yana.
“Jude Campbell?”
When Yana heard this name, a strange look flashed in her eyes.
Even Lena’s gaze was a little off.

chapters.title: Chapter 577: Do You Know Mr. Luke Phillips?
chapters.content:
Chapter 577: Do You Know Mr. Luke Phillips?
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Yana and Lena knew Jude Campbell very well.
Yana also had Jude’s number in her phone. She had met him a few times before.
However, she would not call Jude even if she was in danger, let alone Connor and Carlos.
“Do you know Mr. Campbell?”
Henrick asked Yana provocatively.
Lena was stunned for a moment and stepped forward to speak.
However, Yana suddenly reached out to stop Lena and said in a low voice, “1 will never beg that person for help!”
Lena looked up at Yana and sighed helplessly. She swallowed her words.
“I don’t know this person…”
Yana whispered to Henrick.
“Since you don’t know him, then pay up! If you don’t have money, then get lost!”
Henrick said calmly.
“I don’t have that much money on me now. Let my friends go first. 1’11 transfer you the money when 1 go back.”
Yana said softly.
“Hehe, are you joking with me? If I were to release them now and you don’t give me the money later, where would 1 find the two of you? You have to give me money now, and it has to be in cash. Otherwise, I’ll break their legs right now…” Henrick shouted with his eyes wide open.
Actually, Henrick was just finding an excuse for himself when he said that he wanted money.
Who would have 500,000 dollars in cash in the middle of nowhere?
Therefore, his real goal was to get revenge for Kevin by taking action against Connor and Carlos.
At this moment, even if Yana could really fork out 500,000 dollars, Henrick would definitely be able to find another excuse to make a move!
The passengers in the bus were also watching the commotion. They thought that this matter would end here when Hubert’s men arrived.
However, no one had expected such an outcome.
Yana stood rooted to the ground with a helpless expression on her face. At this moment, she did not know what to do.
“Mr. McDonald, can I make a move now?”
Carlos asked Connor softly.
“No…”
Connor said in a low voice. Then, he stepped forward and asked Henrick, “I don’t know this Mr. Campbell you’re talking about, but 1 know someone else in Borealis City.”
“Other than Mr. Campbell, we won’t give face to anyone!”
Kevin’s eyes widened as he shouted at Connor.
“Are you sure?”
Connor asked indifferently.
Kevin was about to speak.
However, Henrick, who was beside Kevin, reached out to stop him. Then, he smiled and asked Connor, “Who do you know in Borealis City?”
Henrick had always been a cautious person. Just now, he saw that Connor was very calm, as if he was not afraid at all.
This meant that Connor might have some background, so he was prepared to find out about Connor’s background first before taking action. This way, he could ensure that nothing would go wrong.
Everyone looked at Connor with disdain. In their opinion, Yana had already mentioned Hubert Jordan, but it was useless.
And this Connor looked like a poor student. How could he know any big shots?
Yana turned her head and looked at Connor. She was also very unconvinced. She simply did not believe that Connor could know a person who was even more powerful than Hubert!
If Connor really had such ability, why didn’t he say it before?
“Do you know Luke Phillips?”
Connor felt that since Luke could hold his granddaughter’s birthday party in Borealis City, it meant that Luke had some status in here.
“Who is Luke Phillips?”
Kevin shouted with a disdainful expression.
“That’s right. Who is this person you’re talking about? Luke Phillips? Why have
I never heard of this name before?”
The others followed suit.
It was as if no one knew Luke.
Henrick’s expression changed drastically. He stepped forward and asked
Connor in a low voice, “Are you talking about Luke Phillips, the boss of Borealis City’s Harlem’s Gold?”
Luke had a lot of casinos. Not only did he open a Harlem’s Gold in Porthampton, but he also opened another one in Borealis City.
However, the casino in Borealis City was much smaller than that in Porthampton. However, the casino was still very famous in Borealis City.
Henrick was a gambler himself and often went to the casino to play. Naturally, he had heard about the boss of Harlem’s Gold.
“That’s right, it’s the boss of Harlem’s Gold, Luke Phillips!”
Connor looked at everyone and nodded gently.
When everyone heard Connor’s words, they were all stunned.
The smile on Kevin’s face froze.
If you mentioned the name Luke Phillips, not many people would have heard of him.
After all, these people were all hooligans, so they naturally had no contact with Luke. However, if you mentioned Harlem’s Gold’s boss, then they would know who it was!
Henrick looked at Connor from head to toe, then looked at Connor in disbelief and asked, “You actually know the boss of Harlem’s Gold?”
“Henrick, this kid must be bragging. How could he know such a big shot?”
“That’s right. Who is the boss of Harlem’s Gold? How could he know him? This kid must have heard of the name of the boss of Harlem’s Gold. Now, he’s trying to scare us. We’re not fools!”
Henrick’s lackeys stood up and shouted.
Henrick was also very confused. What kind of big shot was Luke?
How could Connor know such a person?
Yana was also very shocked at this time. She couldn’t help but turn to look at
Connor, then asked him softly, “You know Luke Phillips?”
“Who is Luke Phillips?”
Lena had never heard of Luke before. She frowned and asked curiously.
Yana quickly explained Luke’s identity to Lena.
After listening to Yana’s explanation, Lena’s eyes widened in disbelief as she stared at Connor.
Lena never thought that Connor would know such a powerful person!
“Kid, do you really know Mr. Phillips? Do you know the consequences of lying to me?”
Henrick stared at Connor and asked.
Connor ignored Henrick and took out his phone from his pocket. He called Luke.
Lena looked at Connor expectantly. She knew that if Connor really knew Luke, then today’s matter would be easy to handle..

chapters.title: Chapter 578: He’s Your Ancestor!
chapters.content:
Chapter 578: He’s Your Ancestor!
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Ring! Ring!
After the phone rang twice, Luke immediately answered the call.
“Mr. McDonald, are you already in Borealis City?”
Luke exclaimed after picking up Connor’s call.
“Not yet. I ran into some trouble on the way. A person called Henrick Janson is refusing to let me go…”
Connor said lightly.
“Henrick Janson?”
Luke was stunned when he heard the name, and then he quickly said, “Is it that Henrick Janson from Borealis City?”
“That’s right…”
Connor nodded lightly.
“Bastard! Does he want to die? How dare he do that to you!”
Luke shouted angrily, then continued, “Mr. McDonald, don’t worry. I’ll call
Henrick right now. I’ll definitely settle this matter!”
“Okay!”
Connor nodded lightly and hung up the phone.
In fact, Connor could have asked Carlos to take action, but there were so many people on the other side. Although Carlos was very skilled, Connor was worried that he would be injured.
Also, if someone called the police, Connor might have to go to the police station to make a statement.
Although Connor was very rich now, it was not to the point where he could ignore the law. At that time, it would only make things more troublesome.
Therefore, Connor felt that it was the best option for Luke to solve this matter.
After Connor put down the phone, everyone looked at each other.
No one knew if Connor had called Luke Phillips just now, and there was no way to confirm that Connor really knew Luke.
“Kid, do you really think that we will believe you just because you made a phone call?”
Henrick wasn’t a fool. He stepped forward and snorted at Connor.
Connor looked at Henrick indifferently and didn’t say anything.
Because Connor was not afraid even if Henrick’s men attacked him now. After all, Carlos was standing beside him.
“Connor, do you really know Luke Phillips? If you don’t know him, just tell me. 1’11 call my sister now. Maybe there’s a chance to remedy this situation…”
Yana didn’t believe that Connor knew Luke, so she frowned and shouted at Connor.
“Of course, I know Luke!”
Connor replied indifferently.
“Henrick, I think this kid is just stalling for time. Let’s not talk nonsense with him and just beat him up!”
Kevin stood beside Henrick and shouted impatiently.
Henrick hesitated for a moment before waving at his lackeys behind him.
When everyone saw Henrick’s gesture, they did not hesitate at all and rushed towards Connor.
Ring! Ring!
However, just as Carlos was about to make his move, Henrick’s phone suddenly rang.
Henrick thought of what Connor had said before, so he quickly asked his underlings to stop. Then, he took out his phone and took a look. When he saw that it was an unfamiliar number, he was at ease. Then, he picked up the phone and shouted loudly, “Who is it?”
Henrick felt that even if Connor really knew Luke, Luke would get someone else to contact him. After all, a big shot like Luke would never call him personally.
Therefore, when he saw that it was an unfamiliar number, he did not expect it to be Luke.
“Henrick Janson? I’m Luke Phillips!”
However, the other party’s next sentence scared Henrick silly.
“Mr. Phillips? Is it really you?”
Henrick was just a hooligan. He had no contact with people like Luke.
Henrick did not know Luke at all. He had only heard of the name Luke Phillips.
“1 got your phone number from your boss. Mr. McDonald is my guest. Why are you holding him?”
Luke asked coldly.
“Are you really Mr. Phillips?”
Henrick seemed to be a little confused at this time. After all, he felt that even if Connor really knew Luke, Luke would not have called him personally!
Therefore, Henrick still felt that it was impossible. He felt that the person who was on the phone was not Luke. It was just an actor that Connor had hired.
“Since you don’t believe me, I’ll get your boss to call you now!”
Luke was also very anxious at this moment. He was worried that Henrick would really anger Connor.
It would be troublesome if Connor did not come to the birthday party, so he quickly hung up the phone.
Henrick looked at his phone, and he became nervous.
Kevin seemed to have noticed that something was wrong. He stepped forward and asked Henrick softly, “Henrick, what’s wrong?”
“It’s… It’s nothing…”
Henrick waved his hand gently. He didn’t tell Kevin that Luke had called him personally. After all, he hadn’t confirmed Luke’s identity yet.
Therefore, Henrick felt that if the other party was really Luke, then his boss would call him very soon.
Connor was very calm.
“Then, Henrick, are we still going to fight now?”
Kevin hesitated for a moment before asking.
“Don’t be anxious. Wait a little longer…”
Henrick replied softly.
Ring! Ring!
Henrick’s phone rang again after he finished speaking.
Henrick quickly took out his phone and looked at it. When he saw the name on the phone, he was stunned, and he became nervous.
Because there was one big word written on his phone: Boss.
Henrick suddenly raised his head and looked at Connor.
He answered the call in fear and trepidation, then stammered, “Bo… Boss, what’s going on?”
“Henrick, are you f*cking crazy? Do you know who you are holding?”
The other party cursed.
“Who?”
Henrick swallowed hard and asked with a desperate expression.
“He’s your ancestor. Hurry up and f*cking let your ancestor go, or you’re dead meat…”
The boss shouted.
“Alright, Boss, 1 understand…”
Henrick replied dejectedly. Then, he hung up the phone with a trembling voice and looked at Connor with a desperate expression.
When everyone saw the expression on Henrick’s face, they began to mutter to themselves.
“Ancestor…”
In the next second, Henrick shouted..

chapters.title: Chapter 579: Apologize to Mr. McDonald!
chapters.content:
Chapter 579: Apologize to Mr. McDonald!
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
“Ancestor…”
Henrick subconsciously exclaimed.
However, Henrick soon realized that he had said something wrong.
“Mr. McDonald, I’m really sorry. I…”
“Henrick, why are you wasting your breath with this kid? He’s just putting on an act here. Let’s just beat them up…”
At this moment, Kevin did not understand the current situation at all and shouted angrily at Henrick.
When Henrick heard Kevin’s words, he broke out in a cold sweat.
Without the slightest hesitation, he turned and slapped Kevin’s face ruthlessly.
After being slapped by Henrick, Kevin was completely stunned. He was very puzzled.
Everyone present also revealed puzzled expressions.
However, they suddenly remembered what Connor had said just now and could not help but raise their heads to look at Connor.
‘Does Connor really know Luke Phillips?’
At this moment, Yana began to have some doubts.
The way Henrick was acting was much too strange. He even called Connor his ancestor!
“What the f*ck are you still doing? Hurry up and kneel down and apologize to Mr. McDonald…”
Henrick turned and shouted coldly at Kevin.
After hearing Henrick’s words, Kevin became even more puzzled.
Bang!
Seeing that Kevin did not react, Henrick lifted his leg and kicked Kevin’s knee. Kevin knelt on the ground with a thud.
At this moment, Kevin finally realized the seriousness of the matter. If Connor didn’t have any background, then Henrick definitely wouldn’t be acting this way.
“Apologize to Mr. McDonald!”
Henrick shouted with his eyes wide open.
“Mr. McDonald, I’m sorry. I was blind just now and accidentally offended you. Please be magnanimous and let me off this time!”
Kevin knelt down and bowed down as he shouted at Connor.
At this moment, Henrick was trying to act subservient as he smiled at Connor and said, “Mr. McDonald, Kevin is just a low-class hooligan. Please don’t lower yourself to his level…”
Connor looked at Henrick and Kevin indifferently. He was very calm, and he did not say anything at all.
Carlos, on the other hand, walked up to Kevin and said to him softly, “Give me your hand!”
Kevin was stunned when he heard Carlos’s words. He seemed to be confused.
“Mr. McDonald’s friend asked you to stretch out your hand. Are you f*cking deaf?”
Henrick didn’t have the guts to offend Connor and Carlos anymore.
Kevin hesitated for a moment before reaching out his trembling right hand.
Crack!
A crisp sound rang out.
Carlos did not waste any time and stepped on Kevin’s right arm, breaking the bones in his arm instantly.
“Alih!” Kevin cried out in pain. He then hugged his right hand and started rolling on the ground. His expression was one of extreme pain.
When everyone saw this scene, they were all dumbfounded.
Yana and Lena looked at Carlos with fear in their hearts.
The two of them did not expect Carlos to be so ruthless!
“Your turn!”
Carlos said calmly to Henrick after he had dealt with Kevin.
“Sir…”
Henrick trembled and wanted to beg for mercy.
“If you dare to talk nonsense again, I’ll break your legs!”
Carlos said coldly to Henrick.
Henrick looked at Carlos with an unusually frightened expression.
He knew that Carlos was not joking with him, so Henrick extended his right hand after a moment of hesitation.
Carlos stomped on Henrick’s arm too!
When Connor saw this scene, he shook his head helplessly, then turned around and walked toward the bus.
Yana and Lena were stunned for a moment before they quickly followed Connor back into the bus.
“Is there anyone else who is not convinced?”
Carlos asked their lackeys with a cold expression after he had broken Kevin and Henrick’s arms.
The lackeys were all stunned on the spot, their eyes filled with fear. No one dared to speak at all.
“Today, 1 only broke one of your arms as a small lesson for you. Mr. McDonald is kind and doesn’t want to make things difficult for you. Otherwise, you might be crippled now. If you meet Mr. McDonald again in the future, remember to bow down to him!”
Carlos glanced at everyone present and said in a domineering tone before he turned around and returned to the car.
The crowd looked at Carlos’s retreating back, and there was endless fear and horror in their hearts.
At this moment, they finally understood what kind of existence they had just provoked.
If a bodyguard could be so domineering, then Connor was even more so.
Benjamin Wheeler, who Hubert Jordan had called over, looked at Henrick and Kevin sympathetically. He could not help but sigh softly, “If the two of you had let Connor go earlier, would all these have happened?”
After Connor, Carlos, Yana, and Lena returned to the bus, most of the people looked at Connor with awe.
Even the way Lena and Yana looked at Connor changed drastically.
Just now, Henrick and the others were extremely arrogant, not even giving Hubert any face.
However, after Connor made a phone call, Henrick actually knelt down and apologized. This was enough to show how terrifying Connor’s identity was!
However, Yana was born in a big family. Although her status was relatively low, not everyone could compare to her.
Therefore, at this moment, she was still a little unconvinced. She said softly, “So he knows this Luke Phillips guy. What’s the big deal? What’s so great about it? Any of the big shots that the Weaver Family knows are more powerful than Luke Phillips. It’s just that I don’t know these people…”
When Connor heard what Yana said, he couldn’t help but smile.
Connor knew that Yana was actually very kind at heart. It was just that because of her family environment, she liked to show off.
However, she didn’t have any ill intentions toward Connor. Otherwise, Yana wouldn’t have helped Connor just now.
“Carlos, why did you hit them so hard just now?”
Lena, on the other hand, was still worried about Carlos breaking Henrick and Kevin’s arms. She asked Carlos with a frown.
“These people offended Mr. McDonald, so this is already a light punishment. If Diana were here, they would probably all be dead!”
Carlos replied expressionlessly.
Connor shook his head helplessly when he heard Carlos’s words. He looked extremely helpless.
This was probably the reason why Connor did not want to bring Carlos and the others with him.
Carlos and the others were all professional bodyguards and killers. They never cared about the consequences when they attacked, which was hard for Connor to accept.
However, Connor knew that he also needed to adapt to this kind of thing.
After all, he was no longer an ordinary person, so Connor did not stop Carlos when he attacked..

chapters.title: Chapter 580: A Familiar Back
chapters.content:
Chapter 580: A Familiar Back
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
2 PM.
Connor and his group finally arrived at Borealis City.
Along the way, nothing else happened except for the change in the way the passengers looked at Connor and Carlos.
At first, Lena seemed nervous.
However, as time passed, Connor took the initiative to talk to Lena.
Lena slowly let go of the discontent in her heart and happily chatted with Connor.
When the bus stopped, Lena saw Connor’s reluctant face and invited him to visit Borealis City.
But because Connor still had to attend Luke’s granddaughter’s birthday party, he politely refused.
Yana looked at Connor from head to toe, then pouted and whispered to him, “Connor, I know that Carlos is good at fighting, but there are still many powerful people in Borealis City. You can’t afford to offend them. Even if you know Luke Phillips, it’s useless, so you’d better be careful, okay?”
“Thank you for the reminder…”
Connor knew that Yana had a sharp tongue but a soft heart, so he didn’t argue with her. After all, everyone was leaving soon.
Seeing that Connor seemed like a good guy, she hesitated for a moment and said softly, “If you really encounter any big trouble, don’t hit anyone. You can say my name and say that you know the Weaver Family. They should give me some face…”
When Yana said the last sentence, she was obviously not confident.
“There’s no one in this world that Mr. McDonald can’t afford to offend!”
Connor was going to thank her, but Carlos, who was standing beside him, replied in a domineering manner.
Connor looked at Carlos helplessly. He realized that Carlos was way too straightforward during this trip.
Even if no one in Borealis City could afford to offend Connor, there was no need to say it so directly, right?
“How are you bragging even more than Connor?”
Yana rolled her eyes helplessly at Carlos, then took out her phone and exchanged numbers with Connor.
A few minutes later, Yana and Lena parted ways with Connor and left in a car.
Carlos turned to look at Connor and said casually, “Mr. McDonald, Yana seems to be interested in you…”
“How do you know?”
Connor looked at Carlos helplessly. He did not expect Carlos to be able to sense things like this.
“My intuition!”
Carlos answered expressionlessly.
“Scram. What kind of intuition can a man like you have?”
Connor cursed speechlessly and then reached out to flag down a taxi.
It was only two o’clock in the afternoon, so Connor and Carlos didn’t go to the hotel that Luke mentioned right away. Instead, they took a taxi around Borealis City.
Connor had heard of Borealis City when he was studying at the Porthampton University.
However, Connor had never had the time to come over and play. This time, Connor could fulfill this wish.
Borealis City was next to Porthampton. The distance between the two cities wasn’t very far.
However, Borealis City was not as prosperous as Porthampton. After all, Porthampton was a new first-tier city, while Borealis City was just an ordinary second-tier city.
“I wonder why Luke is holding a birthday party for his granddaughter here…”
Connor could not help but mutter.
“Luke’s hometown is in Borealis City. He built the first Harlem’s Gold in Borealis City, that’s why he’s holding a birthday party here. In addition, many of Luke’s businesses are also in Borealis City. Most of the businesses in Porthampton are monopolized by your company, so Luke has no chance at all.”
Carlos turned to look at Connor and explained softly.
After hearing Carlos’s words, Connor’s eyes flashed with confusion. He said, “I didn’t expect you to know so much about the Phillips Family.”
“Before we set off, Mr. Morgan told me about these things!”
Carlos replied lightly.
“I see!”
Connor nodded thoughtfully at Carlos and did not ask any further.
6 PM.
Connor and Carlos were almost done with their shopping in Borealis City. They took a taxi to the hotel that Luke had told Connor about, the Harlem Hotel.
Like the Harlem’s Gold, the Harlem Hotel was also Luke’s property. It was also the only five-star hotel in Borealis City.
When Connor arrived at the entrance of Harlem Hotel, he found more than ten luxury cars parked in the hotel’s parking lot.
Any one of these luxury cars was worth millions.
It could be seen that Luke was very popular. Just because of his granddaughter’s birthday party, he was able to invite so many big bosses to attend.
Compared to these big bosses who attended the banquet, Connor was obviously a lot shabbier.
“I’ll go in myself. You can stay here!”
Connor turned to Carlos and said softly.
Harlem Hotel was Luke’s territory, so the security inside would be good, so Connor was not worried that someone would make a move here.
Besides, Connor felt that if he brought Carlos in, Luke and the others would feel that he was worried that was why he brought a bodyguard with him.
Besides, Carlos had always been reckless. It would be bad if he got into trouble.
Although Connor wasn’t afraid of trouble, he didn’t want to waste time on a small matter.
The most important thing now was to attend the banquet as soon as possible and then go back as soon as possible.
Carlos had always listened to Connor.
Therefore, he didn’t say much and nodded. “Then, I’ll wait for you outside the hotel…”
“No need. Go for a walk nearby and find a restaurant to eat something. It’s getting late.”
Connor whispered to Carlos.
“Alright!”
Carlos nodded and turned to leave.
After Carlos left, Connor was about to walk into the hotel.
However, at this moment, a white Bentley stopped at the entrance of the hotel.
A tall and beautiful woman walked out of the passenger seat under the escort of several bodyguards.
“This back looks so familiar! I think I’ve seen it somewhere before…”
Because Connor couldn’t see the beauty’s face, he couldn’t help but mutter softly..

chapters.title: Chapter 581: Why Are You Here?
chapters.content:
Chapter 581: Why Are You Here?
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Because Connor’s line of sight was blocked by the bodyguards, he couldn’t see the beauty’s face at all.
Moreover, the beauty was walking very fast. Despite wearing high-heeled shoes several centimeters tall, she disappeared from his sight in no time.
Connor stood at the entrance of the hotel, feeling certain that he had seen this woman somewhere before.
But for a moment, he couldn’t quite recall.
“Maybe 1 was mistaken…”
He couldn’t help but sigh and then stepped forward, walking directly into the Harlem Hotel.
As the only five-star hotel in Borealis City, the interior decoration of the Harlem Hotel was indeed luxurious.
Upon entering the hotel, the first thing that caught his eyes was a brilliantly lit lobby.
In front of the lobby was the reception desk, where two beautiful women dressed in cheongsams stood.
“Hello, sir. Are you here to attend Miss Phillips’s birthday party?”
One of the beautiful women smiled lightly and asked proactively.
“Yes, I’m here for the party…”
Connor nodded gently.
“Please follow me. The innermost hall is where Miss Phillips is hosting her birthday banquet!” The beautiful woman said with a smile.
“Thank you…”
He replied politely and then turned directly towards the hall mentioned by the beautiful woman.
After walking a few steps, he stopped in front of a grand door that looked extremely luxurious.
The door was tightly closed, but he could faintly hear music coming from inside.
On both sides of the door stood two waiters dressed in black suits. These waiters were professionally trained and appeared very professional.
Connor walked up and asked the two of them, “Hello, is this where Miss Phillips is hosting her birthday banquet?”
“Yes!”
One of the waiters spoke and then looked Connor up and down.
However, when they saw his shabby appearance, they directly blocked him, not allowing him to enter the hall.
After all, all the guests attending this birthday banquet were influential figures in Borealis City.
But Connor seemed very ordinary, so the waiters naturally doubted his identity.
And there was another crucial point: it was said that an important figure was coming from Porthampton today, and the security had to be tight. If any unauthorized individuals caused harm to the guests inside, even with Luke’s abilities, he would not be able to resolve the situation.
Therefore, for this birthday banquet, everyone had to present an invitation letter; otherwise, they wouldn’t be allowed in.
But the waiters might not know that the young man they stopped at this moment was the most important figure of all, as rumored!
“What do you mean?”
After being stopped by the waiters, Connor couldn’t help but pause, wearing a puzzled expression as he asked the waiter.
“Sir, please show your invitation letter…”
The waiter said calmly.
“Invitation letter?”
As soon as he heard the waiter’s words, he instantly became stunned, and a helpless expression appeared on his face.
Because when Luke invited him, it was just an oral agreement. He never mentioned anything about an invitation letter, so Connor didn’t have one.
“If you don’t have an invitation letter, you can’t go in.”
The waiter said indifferently after seeing Connor’s expression of difficulty.
“Luke personally called and invited me. Can’t I go in either?”
Connor said with a helpless tone to the waiter.
“If you were indeed invited by Mr. Luke, you can prove your identity by calling him now. If you can’t prove your identity, we cannot let you in!” The waiter said expressionlessly to him.
Connor deliberately took time off to come to Borealis City If he left just because he didn’t have an invitation letter, it would be quite embarrassing.
So after hesitating for a moment, he took out his phone and looked at the waiter, saying, “Okay, I’ll call Luke now…”
After saying this, he found Luke’s phone number and dialed it directly.
But what embarrassed him was that even after nearly a minute of dialing, Luke still hadn’t answered the call.
“Why isn’t he answering the phone?”
He looked at his phone and murmured helplessly.
The two waiters, witnessing this scene, showed a disdainful expression towards Connor. They both thought that he was just acting, as how could someone like Luke, a high-level boss, possibly know someone like Connor?
“Sir, if you can’t reach Mr. Luke for the time being, you can wait on the side without disturbing other guests.”
Although the waiters looked down on Connor, they still politely said to him.
“Fine.”
Connor nodded helplessly, put down his phone, and walked to the side, constantly calling Luke.
At the same time, Luke was entertaining guests in the hall.
He didn’t have his phone with him, so naturally, he couldn’t receive Connor’s call.
Connor stood at the entrance and waited for nearly ten minutes. Finally, he became impatient and whispered, “You invited me here, and 1 came. I called you, but you didn’t answer. These two people at the door won’t let me in. Then it’s not my fault. I better go back quickly so as not to delay tomorrow’s classes…”
Connor felt that he had done his best. He called Luke so many times, but Luke didn’t answer any of them. It wasn’t his fault.
So he was ready to turn around and leave.
But just as Connor was about to leave, a familiar figure suddenly appeared in front of him.
When he saw this woman wearing a white evening gown, tall and beautiful, he immediately froze in place, with a look of disbelief on his face.
Because he never expected to encounter her here!
“Connor, what are you doing here?”
The sexy beauty blinked her round eyes and asked him with a surprised expression.
“Well… um, 1 came to attend the birthday banquet…”
After a moment of stupefaction, Connor stuttered in his reply.
“You came to attend the birthday banquet?”
Upon hearing his words, the sexy beauty’s expression seemed even more shocked..

chapters.title: Chapter 582: Meeting Madison Again
chapters.content:
Chapter 582: Meeting Madison Again
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
“Right, is there a problem?”
Connor replied helplessly.
The beautiful woman standing in front of Connor was none other than Madison, the stunning woman who had confessed to Rachel in the past.
He never expected that the world could be so small.
Even though he had come to Borealis City, he still encountered an acquaintance, and it happened to be this beautiful woman!
Although he wasn’t very familiar with her, at this moment, as he looked at her slender legs and round buttocks, he couldn’t help but recall the things that happened between them in the private room before.
“Are you here for the birthday banquet too?”
Connor asked Madison softly.
“Nonsense, I…”
She was about to speak but hesitated for a moment. Then she changed her words and said, “Yes, I’m here for the birthday banquet.”
“Oh!”
He nodded and didn’t know what else to say.
She looked at him with a strange expression and continued, “Since you’re here for the birthday banquet too, why aren’t you going in?”
“I… urn…”
He looked at her, his face showing extreme embarrassment, not knowing how to explain to her.
Connor was worried that if Madison found out that he couldn’t enter because he didn’t have an invitation, she would definitely mock him.
“Miss Phillips, this person doesn’t have an invitation, so we didn’t let him in. But if he is your friend, he can enter…”
The waiter at the door, seeing Madison actively talking to Connor, showed obvious signs of nervousness and stammered an explanation.
“Connor, why are you attending a birthday banquet without an invitation?”
Upon hearing the waiter’s words, Madison’s expression clearly relaxed a lot, then she grabbed Connor and continued, “Are you planning to crash the party and have a free meal?”
“I’m not here for a free meal, 1 really came to attend the birthday banquet!”
Connor explained weakly.
“All, even if you’re here for a free meal, it doesn’t matter! Actually, 1 want to thank you. This time, let me bring you in!”
She flashed him a faint smile and then directly pulled him towards the hall.
The waiter, upon seeing Madison talking to Connor, didn’t dare to obstruct them and instead bowed deeply to them.
After entering the gate, he followed her through a magnificent corridor and entered the hall where the birthday banquet was held.
It must be said that this hall was very luxurious.
Bach’s symphony was playing inside, exquisite crystal chandeliers occasionally emitted a soft glow, and the soft carpet felt very comfortable to walk on.
Although Connor was now very wealthy, he hadn’t been to many upscale venues. At most, he had visited Immortal Lake Manor once before.
So he couldn’t help but look around.
Seeing his somewhat rustic appearance, Madison couldn’t help but smile faintly and asked him softly, “Is this your first time in a place like this?”
“I guess so!”
Connor felt that there was nothing embarrassing about this, so he nodded lightly.
“To be honest, I think this kind of banquet looks very high-class, but it’s quite boring!” she said softly to him.
Upon hearing her words, he couldn’t help but pause for a moment, then looked puzzled and asked, “Um, 1 saw the waiter at the door seemed to know you, do you have any relationship with the Phillipis family?”
“Are you stupid? My last name is Phillips, and I’m from Borealis City. Do you think 1 have any relationship with the Phillips family?”
Madison replied to Connor with a speechless expression.
Connor was worried that if he continued asking, it might make Madison suspicious.
At this moment, Connor didn’t want Madison to know his identity, because once she found out, she might tell Rachel, and things would become troublesome.
Moreover, since Madison’s last name was Phillips, it was normal for her to have some connection with the Phillips family.
By now, many people had already arrived in the hall. These people were basically influential figures in Borealis City, dressed in fashionable attire.
Compared to these people, Connor’s appearance seemed somewhat out of place.
In fact, he was feeling quite frustrated. He had specially chosen the best outfit to attend Luke’s granddaughter’s birthday banquet today.
The outfit he was wearing now cost several tens of thousands of dollars, which was considered very good in the eyes of ordinary people.
However, unfortunately, the people attending the banquet were all dressed in luxurious formal wear, and he was the only one in casual attire.
So Connor appeared somewhat out of place, even Madison was wearing an evening gown at this time.
The people in the hall held glasses of red wine and wore faint smiles on their faces.
Most of these people were considered successful individuals, so they were very conscious of their words and actions.
Even in such a crowded hall, there was no loud noise to be heard.
These people were taking advantage of this opportunity to expand their social circles.
In fact, Connor didn’t really like this kind of occasion. He felt that these people were too hypocritical. You couldn’t really meet any useful friends here, and everyone was just using each other.
“Connor, by the way, 1 have to thank you!”
At this moment, Madison suddenly whispered to Connor.
“Thank me?”
Upon hearing her words, he couldn’t help but pause for a moment, then asked somewhat puzzled, “Why do you want to thank me?”
“After you finished talking to me last time, I felt that what you said made a lot of sense. So I specifically went to see a psychologist, and the doctor said that I’m not actually a lesbian, 1 just didn’t have an accurate self-perception. If I cooperate with the treatment, 1 can recover to normal soon…”
Madison whispered to Connor.
“That’s great!”
Connor quickly replied.
He felt that if women like Madison really turned into lesbians, it would be a loss for the majority of male compatriots.
“If it wasn’t for you, 1 would never have thought of seeing a psychologist!”
Madison said with a smile.
“No need…”
Connor was about to speak, but suddenly noticed that Luke was walking out from the crowd.
When he saw Luke, he was dumbfounded.
Because he knew that once Luke saw him, he would definitely come over and talk, and then his identity would be exposed!

chapters.title: Chapter 583: Did You Prepare a Gift?
chapters.content:
Chapter 583: Did You Prepare a Gift?
Translator: End less Fantasy Translation                                 Editor: Endless Fantasy Translation
After Connor saw Luke approaching, his expression immediately became nervous.
He quickly turned his head and said to Madison beside him, “Um, I’m a bit hungry. It looks like there’s food over there. Why don’t we go and eat something first?”
“I knew you came here to mooch off the food…”
After hearing his words, Madison couldn’t help but roll her eyes at him.
But she didn’t say much and instead led him towards the dining car.
Luke didn’t even notice that Connor had already entered. He was just chatting with some old friends of his.
After reaching the the dining car, Connor directly picked up a piece of cake and started eating.
“How is it? Is it good?”
Madison smiled at Connor and asked.
“It’s pretty good…”
He absentmindedly replied, but his gaze was actually fixed on Luke’s direction.
At this moment, although Luke was chatting with his friends, he was actually searching for Connor in the hall.
He had already contacted the staff at the bus station earlier, and Connor had already arrived in Borealis City, but he hadn’t shown up yet.
In addition, when Luke changed clothes earlier, he forgot to take our his phone, so he was still very anxious at the moment.
He had already spread the news that Connor was coming to attend the birthday banquet, and many of the people present were not there to give face to Luke, but to Connor.
They came today just to witness the elegance of Mr. Connor from Porthampton.
But since he hadn’t appeared yer, Luke was starting to get nervous.
After chatting with his friends for a while, Luke casually found an excuse to leave and went to a corner of the hall with his bodyguards.
“Did you see Mr. Connor?” he asked his bodyguard in a low voice.
“I asked the security guards at the entrance just now, they said they didn’t see anyone named Mr. Connor, and I also looked around in the hall, but 1 didn’t find Mr. Connor…”1 the bodyguard replied in a low voice.
“Then where could he have gone?”
Luke’s eyes showed a hint of helplessness.
“Mr. Luke, if it’s really not possible, why don’t you call Mr. Connor now?” the bodyguard suggested softly.
“If I could make a call, why would 1 need you? My phone is in the changing room, so here’s what you can do. Go to rhe changing room and get my phone, I’ll call Mr. Connor!”
Luke said in a low voice.
“Okay!”
The bodyguard nodded and left immediately.
After seeing the bodyguard leave, Luke anxiously scanned the guests in the hall, his eyes filled with helplessness.
He knew that if Connor didn’t come today, he would lose face completely.
But what he probably didn’t know was that Connor had already been in the hall for a while.
It’s just that he was worried that Luke would recognize him, so he had been avoiding him.
In addition, Luke’s bodyguards were not very familiar with Connor, so they didn’t notice him either.
Connor and Madison were eating pastries and chatting.
After a brief interaction, he found that her personality was actually quite good, so his impression of her improved a lot.
However, Connor felt somewhat dissatisfied that such a high-end hotel only had pastries and sweets, not even a proper dish.
He originally thought that the birthday banquet was just about eating, so he didn’t eat anything before.
“Connor, try this pudding, it s delicious!”
She picked up a piece of pudding and handed it to him.
“I don’t want to eat anymore, I’m already tired of it…”
Without hesitation, he waved his hand and continued, “I don’t know what the Phillips family was thinking. With so many people here, they don’t even have a proper dish. It’s impossible to get full like this!”
“This is a birthday banquet, do you think they invited you here just to eat?” she replied helplessly to his comment.
“If I knew there was nothing to eat, I would have eaten before coming…” Connor said somewhat helplessly to Madison.
“You’re really something. Have you even considered who the attendees are at this banquet? Do you think they care about what they eat here?” She was truly speechless.
“What’s the point of holding a banquet if there’s no food?” He casually picked up a glass of red wine and took a small sip.
“By the way, you said you came to attend the birthday banquet. Did you prepare a gift for someone?” She saw that he was empty-handed and asked with a smile.
“A gift?” Connor was taken aback by the question and his eyes flashed with embarrassment because he hadn’t even thought about bringing a gift.
But he noticed that she also didn’t seem to have brought anything, so he asked directly, “Did you prepare a gift?”
“I don’t need to prepare a gift!” Madison replied with a smile.
“If you don’t need to prepare a gift, then I won’t either…” he replied without hesitation, then looked up at Madison and asked in confusion, “Wait a minute, why don’t you need to prepare a gift?”
“Because…” Madison was about to speak.
But at that moment, a graceful figure approached.
Connor instinctively looked up and saw two women in evening gowns, incredibly sexy, walking towards Madison’s location.
“Madison, why are you still here? The banquet is about to start, and you’re still in the mood to eat. Hurry up…”
One of the seductive-looking girls called out to Madison with an anxious tone.
Upon hearing this, Madison quickly covered her friend’s mouth with her hand and turned to Connor, saying, “Connor, um, 1 have something to do. Stay here for a while, okay?”
“Sure…’1 He thought that these two beauties were probably her friends, so he didn’t think much of it and simply nodded.
As she saw him nod, she directly grabbed her two friends and walked away.
“Madison, who is that guy? How come 1 haven’t seen him before?” the other friend turned back to look at Connor, her expression filled with confusion.
“He’s a friend I met in Porthampton….” Madison explained lightly and continued, “Have the clothes been delivered?”

chapters.title: Chapter 584: Luke’s Granddaughter
chapters.content:
Chapter 584: Luke’s Granddaughter
Translator: End less Fantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Madison led her two close friends and hurriedly walked towards the entrance.
One of the girls, with a helpless expression, shouted at Madison, “The people from the boutique have already delivered the clothes, and the makeup artist has been waiting inside! Today is your birthday, and we have been busy here. 1 really don’t understand what you’re thinking, running here to chat with a poor boy!”
Perhaps Connor hadn’t realized yet, but the granddaughter of Luke was none other than Madison!
She had initially intended to tease Connor, but she discovered that he truly didn’t know about her relationship with Luke.
Furthermore, she believed that he wasn’t here to attend her birthday party; he just wanted to come and have a free meal. However, she didn’t expose him.
After all, it was her birthday, and she knew very well whom she had invited.
“What poor boy? Connor is my friend!”
Upon hearing her friend’s words, Madison couldn’t help but mutter quietly.
“Alright, alright, 1 know he’s your friend!”
As they walked toward the backstage, her girlfriend said helplessly.
“I wonder how Connor will feel when he realizes later that I am the main character of this banquet…”
She couldn’t help but smile proudly, then followed her friend into the backstage to change clothes.
After all, she was the main character today, so she wanted to dress up nicely.
Moreover, Madison had heard from Luke that a very important guest would be coming today, and she was instructed to dress up well.
After she left, Connor still hadn’t connected Madison with being Luke’s granddaughter.
He had been standing in a corner of the hall, quietly observing the people inside.
On the other side, the bodyguard returned to Luke’s side after receiving his phone.
When Luke checked his phone, he found that there were dozens of missed calls, all from Connor!
Seeing so many missed calls, he was almost frightened. Without hesitation, he immediately called back.
“Sorry, the number you dialed is turned off!”
A mechanical prompt sounded from the phone.
“It’s over, Mr. Connor must have arrived in Borealis City, but couldn’t find the place, so he called me. Now he should have left…”
Looking at his phone, Luke exclaimed in despair.
In reality, Connor’s phone had simply shut down because of the numerous calls he received earlier.
“What should we do now, Mr. Luke?”
The bodyguard asked in a low voice with a furrowed brow.
“Mr. Connor called me half an hour ago, so he shouldn’t have left Borealis City yet. Hurry and send people to the train station, hotels, airport, and bus station to find him. Once you find him, immediately call me, understand?”
Luke knew that the birthday banquet was about to start, and he couldn’t leave.
Therefore, he could only send the bodyguard to look for Connor while he called Thomas on the phone, hoping Thomas could reach him.
However, unfortunately, Thomas couldn’t find him either.
Now Luke was completely desperate. He had thought that Connor’s arrival would be an opportunity for their Phillips family, but he never expected that it would turn into a disaster due to his own negligence.
It was a small matter that Connor didn’t come today. If he was angry because Luke didn’t answer his call, then things would be troublesome.
“If I had known earlier, I wouldn’t have gone to receive others. 1 would have just waited for Mr. Connor to come over.”
At this moment, Luke was regretting his carelessness. He felt his intestines turning green with remorse.
But he didn’t have time to dwell on it now. It was already 7 p.m., and soothing music filled the hall.
The lights in the hall gradually dimmed, and the doors slowly opened.
Everyone put down their food and took out the gifts they had prepared in advance. They gathered at the entrance of the hall, waiting for the protagonist of the evening to make an appearance.
Connor knew that he hadn’t prepared a gift, and his identity was quite special.
If people were to find out that the newly appointed chairman of the Empire World Corporation didn’t even prepare a gift, it would be embarrassing.
So he planned to make up for the gift later. He didn’t want to join in the excitement with these people now. He stood quietly in the corner by himself.
Accompanied by her two girlfriends, Madison entered the hall.
By now, she had changed into an extremely luxurious dress, making her look exceptionally glamorous.
Her perfect figure, coupled with her enchanting and seductive face, exuded endless charm and ultimate sexiness with every frown and smile.
Her presence even made the rich young ladies present seem a bit overshadowed.
At this moment, everyone’s attention was focused on Madison. They gathered around her, presenting gifts and offering birthday wishes.
All the people present were wealthy, and the gifts they brought were extremely expensive.
Various luxury items were presented one after another, dazzling the onlookers.
But what surprised Connor the most was that someone even gave a Ferrari sports car as a gift.
Squinting his eyes, he couldn’t help but marvel. All these gifts combined must be worth tens of millions, right?
It was a bit exaggerated to receive so many gifts just for a birthday celebration.
However, because there were too many people surrounding Madison and Connor was standing in a secluded spot, he had no way of seeing what Madison looked like.
He had no idea that Luke’s granddaughter was none other than Madison.
“Thank you, everyone, for your generosity!”
Madison wore a charming smile on her face as she began to chat with everyone.
Having become accustomed to such occasions, she treated each person with kindness, making them feel comfortable.
Five minutes later, all the gifts had been given out.
Next was the time for her to give a speech on stage. When Connor saw someone walking up to the podium, he instinctively glanced at the stage.
But when he saw that the person on stage was Madison, he was dumbfounded.
“Could it be so coincidental? Madison is actually Luke’s granddaughter?”
He couldn’t help but exclaim, his expression filled with disbelief.
“Good evening, everyone. Thank you very much for taking the time to attend my birthday banquet…”
While holding the microphone and speaking, Madison turned her head and looked in Connor’s direction, revealing a very proud smile.
It was at this moment that he finally realized he had been played by her!

chapters.title: Chapter 585: Let’s Go Dance!
chapters.content:
Chapter 585: Let’s Go Dance!
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Looking at the gorgeous beauty on the stage, Connor’s expression instantly turned to shock.
He never expected that Madison would turn out to be Luke’s granddaughter!
Just now, he thought that she was just a relative of the Phillips family, so he didn’t think much of it.
After all, he didn’t know much about Borealis City, nor did he know much about Luke.
Connor only knew that Luke made his fortune from running a casino business, and Thomas said that he was a decent person. So, there was no harm in getting to know him a little more. That’s why Connor came to attend Luke’s granddaughter’s birthday banquet.
But he never expected that Luke’s granddaughter would be Madison!
“No wonder Madison brought me in without saying a word! No wonder Madison kept asking if I came to attend the birthday banquet! No wonder those people in the hall all know Madison!” Connor couldn’t help but sigh in his heart.
At this moment, he finally realized that she was the host of this birthday banquet.
But Madison didn’t know that Connor was invited by Luke.
“So Madison was playing me all along?”
Connor looked at her, his expression filled with anger, not knowing what to do for a moment.
At this moment, she was holding a microphone, expressing her gratitude to the guests present.
He really wanted to rush up and clarify things with her because he felt extremely angry when he thought of the smile on her face just now.
But when he saw Luke standing beside Madison, he instantly dismissed the idea.
Connor knew that if he confronted Madison now, Luke would notice him, and she would also know his identity.
