Once she found out his identity, Rachel would know too.
At this moment, he didn’t want so many people to know his identity because explaining it would be very troublesome. So, in the end, he chose to hold back.
Connor was also worried that Luke would spot him in the crowd, so he intentionally found a corner to stand in, planning to wait until the birthday banquet was over before finding Madison to clarify things.
After her speech ended, it was time for dancing.
Soft music started playing in the hall.
The wealthy young men of Borealis City approached Madison one after another, seemingly wanting to invite her to dance.
But no matter who came to invite her, she rejected them all because she was currently looking for Connor in the hall.
Luke had been worried that Connor hadn’t come, so he didn’t pay much attention to Madison and was busy making a phone call.
After searching around the hall, she found him hiding in a corner. She playfully ran to him on high heels and said with a smile, “Connor, I’ve been looking for you for a long time, and here you are hiding!”
“Today is your birthday, right?”
Connor asked with a helpless expression.
“Yes!”
Madison nodded with a smile.
“Since it’s your birthday, why didn’t you tell me?”
Connor exclaimed angrily.
“Didn’t you say you came to attend the birthday banquet? I thought you knew it was my birthday! But then I realized you didn’t know it was my birthday at all. You came in just to eat for free. So, to save your face, I didn’t expose you. Why are you blaming me now?”
Madison shouted at Connor with a hint of displeasure.
He looked at her and felt helpless. He thought that what she said actually made sense. After all, he claimed to be attending the birthday banquet but didn’t even know whose birthday it was. That was indeed unacceptable.
However, he wasn’t unaware of whose birthday it was. He just didn’t know that Madison was Luke’s granddaughter.
But now he couldn’t explain all this to her because if he did, she would discover his true identity.
“Alright, don’t worry about it. We’re friends, and it’s normal for you to attend my birthday banquet. Let’s go dance together!”
Seeing Connor’s silence, Madison thought he was embarrassed after being exposed, so she quickly reached out and pulled him towards the dance floor.
“I can’t dance…”
After a moment of hesitation, he quietly replied to her.
“lean teach you!”
She said while pulling him.
“I really can’t dance. Why don’t you go dance with those who invited you earlier?”
Connor truly couldn’t dance, and he was also afraid that if he danced with Madison, Luke might notice him.
“I feel disgusted when I see those men, but I don’t feel disgusted when I look at you. So come and dance with me…”
Madison looked at Connor and said.
After hearing her words, he couldn’t help but pause for a moment, then with a stern face, he asked, “Wait, what do you mean by that? Are you saying I’m not a man?”
“Oh no, that’s not what I meant. Why are you so narrow-minded?”
She blushed and softly replied to him.
After seeing her reaction, Connor finally realized that Madison was a lesbian.
So he carefully surveyed the situation in the hall and noticed that Luke was not there. Moreover, many men and women were already dancing in the hall.
Thus, Connor could only reluctantly agree, “Okay then, I’ll dance with you for a while.”
“Great!”
Madison happily agreed and directly pulled him into the dance floor.
On the other hand, Luke was not in the hall.
Because he was not in the mood to stay any longer. After all, he had offended Connor and caused him to leave in anger.
For Luke, this was a huge matter!
To offend Connor in Davenport was no different from seeking death.
So, after the ball began, Luke went straight to the office of the Harlem’s Hotel.
“Have you found Mr. Connor?”
After entering the office, Luke anxiously asked his bodyguard.
“No, we searched the entire Borealis City, but we couldn’t find Mr. Connor…”
The bodyguard replied in a low voice.
“Useless!”
After hearing the bodyguard’s response, Luke’s expression turned furious, and he shouted angrily.

chapters.title: Chapter 586: Definitely Not a Simple Relationship
chapters.content:
Chapter 586: Definitely Not a Simple Relationship
Translator: End less Fantasy Translation Editor: End less Fantasy Translation
In the office.
When the bodyguards saw Luke’ s furious expression, they immediately knelt on the ground in fear.
Others might not understand Luke’s character, but these bodyguards had been with him for so many years, so they knew his temper very well.
“President Phillips, I… I think Mr. McDonald should have returned to Porthampton. We definitely won’t be able to find him in Borealis City…”
One of the bodyguards hesitated for a moment and stammered to Luke.
Luke couldn’t help but frown when he heard that. He then said in a low voice, “I spent so much effort to get to know Mr. McDonald. If he can be on good terms with our Phillips family, it will definitely be a great thing for us. This is an opportunity given to us family by the heavens. I definitely can’t let go of this opportunity../’
“Then what should we do now, President Phillips?”
The bodyguard hesitated for a moment before asking Luke in a low voice.
Luke rubbed his forehead and thought for a while, then said in a low voice, “Go and call Madison over now. I her to apologize to Mr. McDonald face to face…”
“This…”
When the bodyguards heard Luke’s words, they all looked helpless.
“I’m asking you to call Madison over now. Are you all deaf?”
Luke couldn’t help but shout when he saw that the bodyguards didn’t move.
“President Phillips, the banquet has already started, and there are many guests in the hall. Isn’t it a little inappropriate for you to take Miss Phillips away now?” the bodyguard said in a low voice.
“What’s wrong? Are the guests here today were more important than Mr. McDonald? As long as Mr. McDonald is not angry, so what if I offend these people?” Luke replied without thinking.
When the bodyguards heard Luke’s words, they were all dumbfounded. Their mouths were wide open, and their faces were filled with shock. Those who attended Madison’s birthday party today were all big shots in Borealis City. Among them, there were more than a dozen people with a net worth of more than 100 million dollars, and there were also many officials of Borealis City.
But now, Luke said that all these people combined were not more important than Mr. McDonald.
That was enough to prove how terrifying this so-called Mr. McDonald was!
“What are you all still standing there for? Hurry up and go!”
Luke couldn’t help but slap rhe table and shout in excitement when he saw the stunned faces of the bodyguards.
The bodyguards were stunned for a moment, then quickly turned around and ran out of the office.
At this moment, Connor and Madison were still dancing on the dance floor.
Madison actually liked dancing very much, but unfortunately, dancing required a partner. Moreover, she hated men very much, so she could not dance in public.
“I’m not lying to you. I really don’t knowhow to dance…” Connor whispered to Madison.
“It’s okay. I know you don’t knowhow to dance, but I can teach you…”
Madison calmly replied to Connor and then continued, “Put your left hand on my shoulder and your right hand around my waist…”
Connor was stunned for a moment and asked Madison in a low voice, “Isn’t this a little too intimate?”
“Why are you saying so much nonsense? I don’t even despise you, yet you actually despise me?”
Madison looked at Connor and couldn’t help but call out. Then, she directly placed Connor’s hand on her slender and soft waist. It felt good to the touch.
Facing such a great beauty, and with his hands even touching her delicate body, Connor’s heart inevitably sped up.
“Don’t let your imagination run wild. Just follow me and move. From the top…”
“Can you be more serious? You stepped on my foot…”
Madison saw that Connor was completely absentminded at this moment, and she called out to him with a sullen expression.
Connor also had a helpless look on his face as he whispered to Madison, “I told you long ago that I don’t know how to dance, bur you kept insisting that I dance with you…”
“It’s not about whether you knowhow to dance or not. It’s about your attitude…” Madison looked at Connor and snorted coldly. Then, she continued, “From now on, if you step on me once, I’ll pinch you in return. Do you hear me?”
“No, you only said that you wanted to dance just now. You didn’t say that you wanted to strangle anyone. If that’s the case, then I won’t dance with you…” Connor said, exasperated.
“I dare you to leave. If you dare, I’ll call the security guards to arrest you right now. I’ll let everyone know that you’re here to freeload. You don’t even have an invitation…” Madison threatened Connor fiercely.
After Connor heard Madison’s words, he was instantly speechless. He looked ar her helplessly and didn’t know what to say.
If Madison really called the security guards over, Connor’s identity would definitely be exposed.
Therefore, Connor had no choice but to study seriously.
It had to be said that Connor wasn’t actually terrible at dancing; when he got serious, he no longer stepped on Madison’s feet. The two of them became more and more skilled.
At this moment, many people in the hall were paying attention to Madison’s every move. However, when they saw Madison dancing with Connor, they all revealed puzzled expressions.
“Who is this guy? To actually be able to dance with Miss Phillips…”
“That’s right. Moreover, Miss Phillips seems to be very happy. The relationship between these two people is not simple!”
Madison had rejected so many people’s invitations just now, but now she was dancing with Connor. This indeed made people start to doubt Connor’s identity.
Of course, the people in the most disbelief were Madison’s best friends.
Not many people knew about Madison’s preferences. Most people thought that she had high standards, which was why she had never been in a relationship. After all, Madison was famous for being fair, rich, and beautiful in Borealis City. If her preferences were made known to the public, the Phillips family would also be greatly affected.
However, Madison’s best friend knew that Madison didn’t like men, and that Madison had even confessed to a lecturer at Porthampton University some time ago.
However, Madison was dancing with Connor at this time, which confused her best friends.
“Could it be that Madison does like men?’’
One of her best friends could not help but mutter softly.
“That’s right. Madison seemed to be chatting with this person just now. Their relationship must not be simple! ” another friend added.

chapters.title: Chapter 587: Mr. McDonald’s Power
chapters.content:
Chapter 587: Mr. McDonald’s Power
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
When they saw Connor and Madison dancing in the middle of the dance floor, everyone was stunned on the spot. Their expressions were abnormally shocked.
After all, Madison was the main character of this banquet, and her identity was quite special. Moreover, for so many years, she had never had any scandals with any man.
But now, she was dancing with a poor kid who came out of nowhere. Moreover, the two of them were talking and laughing, which made everyone even more suspicious of Connor’s identity.
Madison’s suitors were furious when they saw this scene.
A few minutes later, the music in the hall finally stopped.
Connor finally heaved a sigh of relief and quickly released his right hand from Madison’s waist.
In the eyes of others, dancing with Madison might be a very honorable thing.
However, it was not a good thing for Connor. In less than five minutes, Connor had been pinched by Madison more than ten times. Connor felt that his waist was about to be broken by this woman.
Madison looked at Connor with a faint smile. Just as she was about to open her mouth to speak, she suddenly saw a bodyguard running over anxiously.
Madison turned to look at the bodyguard and asked with a puzzled expression, “Lewis, why are you running so fast?”
Because this bodyguard had been with Luke for more than ten years, Madison was familiar with this him.
“Miss, President Phillips wants you to go over to him. He has something very important to tell you…”
The bodyguard turned to look at Connor while whispering to Madison.
Madison could tell that the bodyguard was in such a hurry, so it meant that something important must have happened.
Therefore, she turned to Connor and said, “Connor, I have something to do and will leave for a while. You can play here by yourself…”
“Right…”
Connor nodded lightly.
“Let’s go!”
Madison said to the bodyguard, then turned around and walked straight to Luke’s office.
Connor looked at Madison’s back as she left, and a trace of confusion flashed across his eyes.
At this time, Connor was worried that Luke had discovered him.
However, he felt that if that were the case, he would definitely come over to talk to Connor at once. He was thinking too much.
On the other side, Madison followed the bodyguard to Luke’s office.
“Grandpa, why did you call me over in such a hurry?”
After Madison entered the office, she walked directly to Luke and asked him with a smile.
“Madison, hurry up and change your clothes. I’ll take you to Porthampton to meet someone!”
Luke said anxiously.
“Change your clothes to meet someone?”
Madison was stunned when she heard Luke’s words. She was confused.
“Grandpa, it’s my birthday party today. Everyone’s still inside. How can I leave just like that?” she asked.
“I don’t have time to explain so much to you now. You’d better hurry up and change your clothes…” Luke replied anxiously.
“But there are still so many guests in the hall. If I leave now, what will those people think?”
Madison frowned, reluctant. After all, many of her friends had come over today, and they had just given her a birthday present. She had not even cut her birthday cake yet. It would be a little inappropriate for her to leave now!
“The person I’m bringing you to see is very important. I’ve already gotten someone to handle the banquet, so you don’t have to worry so much. Hurry up and change your clothes and follow me…” Luke said hurriedly.
“No matter how important that person is, can he be more important than these people?”
Madison rarely saw Luke so anxious, so she shouted in confusion.
“All the people here added together are nowhere near as important as this person!” Luke answered without thinking.
After hearing Luke’s words, Madison was stunned on the spot. She hesitated for a moment and asked in a low voice, “Grandpa, who is it? To actually make you value it so much…”
Luke looked up at Madison. He knew her character very well. If he didn’t explain this matter clearly, Madison would definitely not leave with him.
“Madison, I told you before that I wanted to introduce a very important guest to you. Do you still remember?” he asked in a low voice.
Madison thought for a moment and asked, “That was…Mr. McDonald from Porthampton?”
” That’ s right, it’ s Mr. McDonald!”
Luke nodded and continued, “Mr. McDonald should have come today, but because of my negligence, I left my phone in the changing room and didn’t receive a call from him. The security of our birthday banquet today is quite strict, and I didn’t give Mr. McDonald an invitation, so Mr. McDonald definitely couldn’t enter. Moreover, he didn’t contact me. I suspect Mr. McDonald went back to Porthampton in a fit of anger, so I’m going to bring you there to apologize to him personally…”
“Um, isn’t he just a rich young master? So what if he left? What’s the big deal?” Madison pouted and said impatiently.
“Madison, you don’t understand this Mr. McDonald. He is very special, and his background is not something we can imagine. Basically, every big enterprise in Davenport belongs to Mr. McDonald—and that’s just the scope within Davenport. Mr. /McDonald’s has even more businesses within the country and even across the globe. This kind of big shot is not someone our Phillips family can afford to offend. That’s why you have to apologize to him personally…” Luke said worriedly.
“This Mr. McDonald is so powerful?”
Madison couldn’t help but exclaim when she heard Luke’s words.
“Have you heard of Thomas /Morgan from Porthampton?” Luke whispered to Madison.
“I have…”
Madison nodded gently.
“What about Kyle Hayes?”
Luke continued to ask.
“I’ve also heard of him…”
Madison nodded again.
“Those two people are Mr. McDonald’s subordinates. Now you can understand how powerful Mr. McDonald is, right?”
When Madison heard this, she was stunned on the spot. The expression on her face was one of disbelief.
Madison had studied in Porthampton before, so she knew Thomas Morgan and Kyle Hayes very well.
Any one of these two people was enough to intimidate one party, and yet those two people were actually the subordinates of Mr. McDonald. It was amazing how terrifying Mr. McDonald was!

chapters.title: Chapter 588: You Have a Boyfriend?
chapters.content:
Chapter 588: You Have a Boyfriend?
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
After hearing Luke’s words, Madison was shocked.
She never thought Mr. McDonald’s identity would be so terrifying!
“But Grandpa, no matter how powerful Mr. McDonald is, we shouldn’t be like this, right? We didn’t do anything wrong in this matter, and there are so many people in the hall now. If we offend those people in the hall because of Mr. McDonald, wouldn’t it be a bit of a loss? It would be fine if Mr. McDonald forgives us in the end, but what if he doesn’t?”
At this moment, Madison had already realized the seriousness of the matter.
However, she still didn’t want to offend so many guests who came to celebrate her birthday for Mr. McDonald, whom she didn’t even know.
“We can’t think too much now. If Mr. McDonald can forgive us, that’s naturally the best. If Mr. McDonald is unwilling to forgive us, then we have no choice but to leave it to fate!” Luke said to Madison helplessly.
“Grandpa, I don’t think Mr. McDonald is a petty person. We don’t have to go over in such a hurry. We can wait until the banquet is over before going over!” Madison continued to persuade him.
Seeing that Madison didn’t seem to realize the seriousness of the problem, Luke said in a low voice, “Madison, there’s actually something that Grandpa hasn’t told you. Since things have already come to this, I’ll tell you the truth!”
“The truth?”
Madison couldn’t help but frown when she heard this. Then, she asked with a puzzled expression, “What do you mean?”
“Madison, I’ve met Mr. McDonald a few times. He is about the same age as you…” Luke said slowly.
“The same age?” Madison couldn’t help but exclaim. The expression on her face seemed to be even more shocked.
She had never thought Mr. McDonald would be so young!
“He might be a few years younger than you…” Luke continued,
“Grandpa, what are you trying to say?”
Madison frowned and asked in a low voice when she saw Luke’s strange expression.
“I want to introduce you to Mr. McDonald. If you can become a couple, that would be the best. If you can’t become a couple, you can be friends too…”
Luke directly said what was in his heart.
n 11
When Madison heard this, she was stunned on the spot. Her expression was very shocked.
In fact, Madison had already guessed that something was wrong, but she never thought that Luke would want to matchmake her and Mr. McDonald.
“Grandpa, are you kidding me?” Madison shouted.
“I’m not joking with you. I’m very serious about matchmaking you and Mr. McDonald.”
“Madison, it’s been so many years, but Grandpa has never asked you for anything. No matter what kind of request you have, Grandpa will try his best to satisfy you, but you must listen to me on this matter!”
Luke said to Madison seriously.
“Why?”
Madison opened her big, watery eyes and shouted excitedly.
“There are some things that I didn’t intend to tell you. But since things have already come to this, then I won’t hide anything from you.”
“Now, our Phillips family can be said to have enemies on all sides. Whether it’s in Porthampton or Borealis City, our position is in danger. Many big families are staring at us and want to annex our family.”
“To put it bluntly, it’s because the backing of our Phillips family is not strong enough. In this society, without connections, then no matter how much money you have, you’re still working for someone else! If our Phillips family doesn’t find a powerful backer in the next five years, then we’re as good as done for. Do you understand?”
Luke said to Madison with a serious expression.
Madison looked at Luke and kept silent for two seconds. Then she gritted her teeth and said in a low voice, “So, Grandpa, you want me to seduce Mr. McDonald and make him the Phillips family’s backer, right?”
“I’m not asking you to seduce Mr. McDonald. I just think that since you’re about the same age as him, it’d be great if you can be with him. Even if you can’t be a couple, you can be friends!” Luke said excitedly.
“Why should I be with a man I don’t even know?” Madison looked at Luke with an incredulous expression. She didn’t expect Luke to have such an outrageous idea.
“Madison, aren’t you from the Phillips family? Didn’t the Phillips family give you everything you have now? Now that we need you to make a small sacrifice, aren’t you willing?”
Luke also became agitated. He didn’t expect Madison to be so resistant.
However, Luke didn’t know that Madison didn’t like men, and she couldn’t be with a stranger.
“I’m a member of the Phillips family, but I’m not a tool! Why should I sacrifice my happiness for the Phillips family?” Madison shouted.
Luke was stunned for a moment and suddenly realized that he had gone overboard.
Therefore, he hurriedly explained to Madison, “Madison, Grandpa might have been a little agitated just now. I just wanted to tell you that if you can be with Mr. McDonald, it will be of great help to both you and the Phillips family. Even if you don’t want to be with him, it will be of great help if the two of you can become friends…”
“If I don’t sleep with Mr. McDonald, why would he want to be friends with me? And what right do I have to be his friend? Don’t you just want to sacrifice me to help the Phillips family?” Madison shouted.
“So what if you sacrifice yourself for the Phillips family?”
Luke widened his eyes and shouted, then continued, “I’m telling you, I’m not discussing this with you. I’m telling you that you have to get close to Mr. McDonald!”
“What if I don’t agree?” Madison replied unhappily.
“What right do you have to disagree?”
“I… I already have a boyfriend. I can’t be with Mr. McDonald!”
Madison suddenly remembered how Rachel had rejected her and shouted expressionlessly.
“You already have a boyfriend?”
Luke widened his eyes in disbelief.
He had never thought that Madison would already have a boyfriend!

chapters.title: Chapter 589: Premeditated
chapters.content:
Chapter 589: Premeditated
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
In fact, Luke knew Madison’s love life very well.
He knew that there were many suitors for Madison, and most of them were rich young masters from Beihai City.
Whether it was their family background or their looks, they could be considered top-notch existences.
However, Madison had never been in a relationship with anyone, nor had she liked anyone.
This was also the reason why Luke had always wanted to matchmake Madison and Connor.
This granddaughter of his had a good figure and appearance, and was usually very clean and self-disciplined. Connor’s background was heaven-defying and he had a calm personality. The two of them were very suitable to be together.
However, Luke never expected that Madison would say that she already had a boyfriend, which made him very surprised.
He hurriedly walked up to Madison and shouted with his eyes wide open, “Madison, are you kidding me? When did you get a boyfriend?”
“I’m not joking with you. I already have a boyfriend, so it’s impossible for me to be with Mr. McDonald…” Madison said with certainty.
“Impossible. I’ve investigated your friends. You don’t have a boyfriend at all. You’re lying to me!” Luke shouted excitedly.
“Grandpa, you’re actually spying on me?”
Madison’s eyes widened in disbelief when she heard Luke’s words.
After all, if Luke had really investigated Madison, it meant that Luke had already planned this.
“I just wanted to understand your situation…” Luke replied lightly, then continued, “Your reaction just now shows that you’re lying. You don’t have a boyfriend at all, right?”
“I have a boyfriend, and no one else knows about this except me!”Madison replied without thinking.
“Alright, since you’ve said so, then tell me who your boyfriend is. Where is he now?”
Luke looked at Madison from head to toe and asked coldly.
“This…”
Madison was dumbfounded when she heard this.
After all, she was just trying to deal with Luke. She didn’t have a boyfriend at all. But she didn’t expect Luke to be so serious.
“You have nothing to say?”
Luke sneered and continued, “Madison, you can’t lie to me. Hurry up and change your clothes. Let’s go to Porthampton now!”
“I really already have a boyfriend!” Madison shouted helplessly.
“Then tell me who your boyfriend is!” Luke said coldly.
“I… My boyfriend is in the banquet hall now. If you don’t believe me, I’ll bring him over now…” Madison said excitedly.
“Your boyfriend is in the hall? Are you telling the truth?”
Luke’s face changed instantly when he heard that.
“Of course I’m telling the truth…” Madison replied in a low voice, feeling a little guilty.
11 11
Luke looked at Madison from head to toe, then said in a low voice, “Alright, since you’ve said so, bring her over now and let me take a look…”
Madison stood rooted to the spot, her expression a little awkward.
After all, she was the one who made up all those words just now. She didn’t have a boyfriend!
At this moment, Madison was clearly at a loss.
“What are you waiting for? Didn’t you say that your boyfriend is inside? Then bring him here for me to see!” Luke shouted at Madison.
“Fine, just you wait!” Madison replied helplessly, then turned around and ran out of the office.
11 11
Luke looked at Madison’s back as she left, and a strange look flashed in his eyes.
Luke’s thoughts were very simple. If Madison didn’t have a boyfriend, it would be for the best.
However, if Madison really had a boyfriend, he could only use some special methods to deal with this matter.
After all, he had already made up his mind to let Madison and Connor be together no matter what.
“You guys go and follow Madison and see who she went to see.”
Luke hesitated for a moment, then turned his head and said to the bodyguard beside him.
“Alright!”
The bodyguard agreed and left.
On the other side.
Connor stood alone in the hall, eating in boredom.
He wanted to find an opportunity to say goodbye to Madison and then leave, but Madison did not come back.
However, at this moment.
Madison left Luke’s office and returned to the hall.
After returning to the hall, Madison looked at the guests in the hall with a helpless expression.
“Where am I going to find a boyfriend!”
Madison sighed helplessly.
At this moment, Madison realized that there seemed to be someone following her.
Madison quickly turned around and saw that it was Luke’s bodyguard.
“Did my grandfather ask you to follow me?” Madison turned around and asked the bodyguard.
“Yes!”
The bodyguard quickly agreed.
“Humph!”
Madison snorted and walked into the hall in her high heels.
Not far away, Connor saw that Madison had returned. He immediately walked towards Madison, wanting to tell her that he was ready to leave.
However, when Madison saw Connor, a strange look flashed across her eyes.
She hurriedly walked in front of Connor and then did something that made everyone feel incredulous.
Madison actually took the initiative to reach out and hold Connor’s arm. Her posture was extremely ambiguous.
Connor was shocked by Madison’s action and was about to speak.
“Don’t talk!”
Madison quickly reminded Connor, then hugged Connor’s arm tightly and shouted at Connor in a delicate voice, “Honey, where did you go just now?”
After Madison said this, she turned her head and glanced at Luke’s bodyguard.
The bodyguard quickly turned around and ran towards Luke’s office.
After Madison saw the bodyguard leave, she revealed a very proud smile.
The people in the hall all looked at Madison and Connor with a strange gaze.
“Miss Phillips is really together with this kid?”
“Who is this kid?”
“What right does he have to be with Miss Phillips?”
The guests in the hall began to discuss in low voices.
Connor looked at Madison with a dumbfounded expression and asked in a low voice, “What are you doing?”
Madison didn’t answer Connor’s question. “Follow me, I’ll bring you to see someone!”
“Meet someone?” Connor was stunned for a moment, then asked in a puzzled tone, “Who is it?”

chapters.title: Chapter 590: Connor, Are You Mr. McDonald?
chapters.content:
Chapter 590: Connor, Are You Mr. McDonald?
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
“You’ll know later!”
Madison turned her head to look at Connor and said with a playful expression.
Connor suddenly felt that something was wrong, so he quickly shook off Madison’s hand and said with a serious expression, “If you don’t tell me, I won’t go!”
“Oh come on, why are you so slow? If I tell you to follow me, just follow me. Won’t you know who you want to see when you get there?”
Madison’s big, watery eyes widened as she shouted excitedly at Connor.
“If you don’t tell me who you want to see, I won’t leave with you!” Connor replied with a very serious expression.
Madison looked at Connor helplessly and said lightly, “From now on, you will pretend to be my boyfriend. I want to bring you to meet my grandfather…”
“Pretending to be your boyfriend? And meet your grandfather?”
After Connor heard these two sentences, he was instantly dumbfounded, and his expression was abnormally shocked.
He had never thought that Madison would bring him to see her grandfather and even ask him to pretend to be her boyfriend.
The person Connor was most afraid of seeing now was probably Luke!
Luke was the only one who knew Connor’s identity. If Luke saw Connor, Connor’s identity would definitely be exposed!
“Why should I go see your grandfather? I’m not going…”
Connor refused without thinking, then turned around and prepared to leave.
“Connor, stop right there. If you dare to leave now, I will tell Rachel Wallace what you did to me in the private room that day. I’ll make everyone know who you are!” Madison said excitedly with her big watery eyes.
When Connor heard this, he instantly stopped in his tracks.
Then, he looked at Madison with a broken expression, not knowing what to say.
“…Why do I have to meet your grandfather?”Connor asked helplessly.
“There’s no ‘why.’ I need a boyfriend now, and you’re the only one who’s more suitable, so you have to pretend to be my boyfriend.”
After saying this, Madison dragged Connor directly to Luke’s office.
On the other side.
Luke frowned when he heard that Madison really had a boyfriend.
“Which family’s kid is so daring to lie to my granddaughter?” Luke shouted angrily.
“Looking at that boy, he doesn’t look like a young master from a big family. Instead, he looks like a poor boy!” the bodyguard replied respectfully.
“Poor kid?” Luke was stunned for a moment, then said coldly, “How can a poor boy be with my granddaughter?Is he tired of living?”
The bodyguard stood beside Luke and said nothing.
“After this kid leaves, no matter what the price is, you must make this person leave Madison. Do you understand what I mean?” Luke said coldly.
“Understood!” The bodyguard hurriedly nodded.
Even if it was a real rich heir, Luke would never let Madison be with him, much less a poor man.
“Creak!”
At this moment, the office door was suddenly pushed open from the outside.
Madison dragged Connor in from outside!
“Grandpa, didn’t you say that I lied to you? I brought my boyfriend over now…” Madison shouted loudly.
“Humph…”
Luke snorted and said without looking up, “Brat, you are quite bold…”
He looked up at Connor as he spoke.
When Luke saw Connor, he was stunned. His face was full of disbelief.
He felt like he was dreaming. The Mr. McDonald he had been looking for was standing in front of him?
And he even became his granddaughter’s boyfriend?
“Am I mistaken?”
Luke rubbed his eyes. After realizing that he was not mistaken, he quickly ran to Connor.
“M-Mr. McDonald?!”
Luke shouted excitedly at Connor. At this time, he was obviously too excited to speak.
Connor looked at Luke helplessly.
He had already guessed that Luke would have such a reaction when he saw him, but Madison had been threatening Connor, so he had no choice but to come.
Seeing Luke’s expression, Madison couldn’t help but be stunned for a moment, then quickly said, “Grandpa, what Mr. McDonald? This is my boyfriend, Connor!”
“Mr. McDonald is your boyfriend? That’s great!”
Luke was even more excited after hearing Madison’s words.
He hurriedly walked in front of Connor and said respectfully to Connor, “Mr. McDonald, I didn’t pick up your call previously. I thought you had already left. I didn’t expect you to not leave. Also, when did you and Madison meet? I called you over this time to introduce her to you, but I didn’t expect you to know Madison long ago, and to think you’re both in a relationship! That’s really great…”
Madison was confused when she heard Luke’s words. “Grandpa, what nonsense are you talking about?” she asked with a frown. This is my boyfriend, Connor, not Mr. McDonald…”
“Madison, this is the Mr. McDonald that I told you about before. I didn’t expect the two of you to know each other!” Luke said to Madison excitedly.
After hearing Luke’s words, Madison’s mouth was wide open, and her face was filled with shock.
She quickly turned her head to look at Connor, and then looked at Luke in front of her.
“Connor? Mr. McDonald?”
Madison seemed to have suddenly understood something and hurriedly asked Luke, “Grandpa, are you mistaken?”
“How could I be? I’ve met Mr. McDonald a few times, and I was the one who invited him to your birthday party, but I didn’t expect the two of you to know each other…”
Luke replied to Madison with a smile.
Madison only reacted after hearing this. It turned out that Connor was not joking when he said that he was here to attend the birthday party.
He didn’t come here to freeload, but was rather invited by her grandfather.
But what Madison couldn’t understand was that Connor was just an ordinary university student—when it came to the way he acted and dressed, he did not look like a rich heir with an amazing background!
“Could it be that Connor pretended to be a rich heir to deceive my grandfather?” Madison thought.
Then, she walked directly to Connor and asked, “Connor, are you Mr. McDonald??”

chapters.title: Chapter 591: To Sleep With You
chapters.content:
Chapter 591: To Sleep With You
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation | Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Connor looked at Madison, and he was disappointed.
“Connor, what’s going on? Why did my grandfather say that you are Mr. McDonald?” Seeing that Connor didn’t say anything, she couldn’t help but frown and ask Connor.
Connor hesitated and said, “I did know your grandfather before. I came here today because of your grandfather’s invitation, but I didn’t know you were Luke’s granddaughter!”
Connor no longer planned to continue hiding it. After all, things had come to this point, and there was no need to hide it.
“But…” Madison still couldn’t believe it.
She walked up to Connor and carefully sized him up. She seemed in disbelief as she really couldn’t understand why Connor suddenly became a rich heir with an influential background.
Moreover, Connor was not an ordinary rich heir. An existence that could make his grandfather so afraid was not an ordinary person.
T didn’t expect Connor to be Mr. McDonald. This is too magical…’ Madison couldn’t help but sigh in her heart. Then she turned to look at Luke helplessly. She didn’t know what to say.
Luke was very excited. He had originally planned to introduce Madison to Connor.
However, he did not expect that Madison’s boyfriend was Connor. This saved Luke much trouble.
“Mr. McDonald, please take a seat!” Luke said to Connor with a smile.
Connor hesitated, then followed Luke to the sofa and sat down.
At this moment, Madison’s face was filled with confusion. She still had not figured out what was going on.
Luke had a happy smile on his face. He thought that Connor and Madison were a couple, but in actual fact, she had nothing to do with Connor at all.
“Mr. McDonald, when did you meet Maddy?” Luke asked Connor softly after he sat down.
When Connor heard this, he couldn’t help but turn to look at Madison as if he didn’t know how to answer this question.
“I haven’t known Connor for long…” Madison hesitated for a moment and said indifferently.
“So, when did the two of you get together?” Luke continued to ask.
Madison took a deep breath and whispered to Luke, “Grandpa, let me tell you the truth. Connor is not my boyfriend at all. We have only known each other for a few days…”
“You two aren’t together?” Luke exclaimed.
“Of course not. 1 asked Connor to pretend to be my boyfriend to lie to you, but 1 didn’t expect you to know Connor…” Madison frowned and said helplessly.
“Why… Why did you lie to me?” Luke looked at Madison and sighed helplessly, not knowing what to say.
“Don’t you know why I lied to you?” Madison half-shouted.
“Uhm…”
Luke’s eyes flashed with embarrassment when he heard that. Then, he deliberately put on a straight face and scolded in a low voice, “Maddy, you’re going overboard now. You made Mr. McDonald lie for you. Hurry up and apologize to Mr. McDonald!”
“There’s no need…” Connor waved his hand lightly and said, “Madison and I are friends. There’s no need for that!”
II II
When Madison heard this, she looked at Connor indifferently and said nothing.
“That’s good! That’s good…”
Luke smiled, then turned to Connor and said softly, “Mr. McDonald, since there’s nothing else now, let’s return to the party. We haven’t cut the birthday cake yet…”
II II
Hearing this, Connor looked down at his phone and realized it was already past 9 PM.
He had come to the party and met Luke, so Connor didn’t plan to stay here longer.
“It’s getting late. 1 still have something to do tomorrow, so I’ll go back now!” Connor stood up and whispered to Luke.
When Luke heard this, he was surprised.
Although Luke really wanted Connor to attend the party, he did not dare to stop Connor from leaving.
Moreover, he did not need Connor to be present to help boost the Phillips Family’s reputation. He could feel that Connor and Madison’s relationship wasn’t ordinary.
“Mr. McDonald, do you want me to send someone to drive you back?” Luke asked Connor softly.
“It’s okay! My friend is still waiting for me!” Connor replied.
“All right then…” Luke quickly nodded, then turned to Madison and said, “Maddy, what are you still standing there for? Quickly send Mr. McDonald out!”
“Yes!” Madison pouted and replied, then turned to Connor and said, “Let’s go. I’ll send you out!”
“Okay!” Connor nodded at Madison, then followed her out of Luke’s office.
Luke didn’t go out with Madison and Connor. He wanted to create more opportunities for Connor and Madison to be alone.
It was a great thing for Luke that Madison knew Connor.
If Madison got together with Connor, that would be even better!
***
After Connor left the office with Madison, Madison turned to look at Connor and pouted. “I didn’t expect you to be a rich heir. Why didn’t I notice it before?”
“Are you mocking me?” Connor asked helplessly.
“Am I mocking you?” Madison was stunned momentarily, then hurriedly shook her head and looked at Connor. “I don’t have the guts. You’re a rich heir whom even my grandfather doesn’t dare offend. Even if you gave me nine lives, I wouldn’t dare to mock you!”
Although Madison said so, Connor could still feel that Madison was mocking him.
“By the way, why did you ask me to pretend to be your boyfriend just now?” Connor asked Madison softly as he walked.
“Why else? My grandfather wants me to sleep with you!” Madison said lightly.
When Connor heard this, he was stunned and speechless.
Connor did not expect Madison to be so straightforward. For a moment,
Connor did not know how to answer..

chapters.title: Chapter 592: An Encounter With Yana Weaver
chapters.content:
Chapter 592: An Encounter With Yana Weaver
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation | Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
After seeing Connor leave, Madison kept thinking about one thing.
Why would a rich heir like Connor hide his identity?
Wouldn’t it be a great honor to let everyone know he was rich?
This kind of thing might be very prestigious to Madison and the others.
However, to Connor, this kind of thing would only bring him endless trouble.
Reputation might be very important to ordinary people, but it was just a burden to Connor.
Although many people wanted to be rich heirs, Connor felt that he was happier when he was an ordinary person.
After all, Connor just didn’t have money. He wouldn’t be troubled by other things.
But now, the happiness that Connor obtained through money was far less than the worries.
After leaving Harlem Hotel, Connor took out his cell phone and wanted to call Carlos.
However, Connor suddenly realized that his phone had been switched off.
Therefore, Connor couldn’t contact Carlos for the time being. He could only stand at the hotel entrance and wait for Carlos to return.
An hour later.
Connor finally saw Carlos hobbling toward the entrance of the hotel.
“Mr. McDonald, why are you out here?” When Carlos saw Connor standing at the hotel entrance, he hurried to his side and asked him nervously.
“The party just ended, so here 1 am,” Connor replied indifferently.
“I see. I just went out for a meal. 1 didn’t expect you to come out so soon, Mr.
McDonald…” Carlos replied to Connor softly. He took out his phone to check the time and asked, “Mr. McDonald, are we going back now?”
“What time is it now?” Connor looked at the distant sky as he asked in a low voice.
“It’s already 10 PM!” Carlos answered hurriedly.
“It’s already so late. 1 didn’t expect to waste so much time just now…” A trace of helplessness flashed in Connor’s eyes.
Connor originally planned to go back tonight and then to school tomorrow. Rachel only gave him a day off.
However, judging from the current situation, Connor and Carlos probably could not go back now.
It was already past io PM. If Connor were going to take the bus home, it would be too late.
Therefore, they could only wait until tomorrow morning to leave.
Connor turned to Carlos and said, “It’s already so late. Let’s forget it. There shouldn’t be any buses at the bus station. Let’s find a hotel and stay for the night. We’ll take the bus back tomorrow morning.”
“Mr. McDonald, if anything urgent, I can get Mr. Morgan’s driver to pick us up…” Carlos said hurriedly.
“There’s no need. Let’s talk about it tomorrow morning…” Connor waved his hand without thinking.
“Alright!” Carlos nodded and said to Connor, “Mr. McDonald, our company runs a chain hotel nearby. Why don’t we stay there? It isn’t bad. Moreover, it’s run by our company. The security work there can be better…”
“Sure!” Connor nodded gently and followed Carlos to the hotel.
A few minutes later, Connor followed Carlos to a hotel called W Hotels.
As Carlos had claimed, the hotel was luxuriously decorated, and the ambiance was very nice.
After entering the hotel, Carlos asked Connor, “Mr. McDonald, what do you think of this hotel?”
“Great!” Connor nodded lightly.
In fact, Connor didn’t have high requirements for hotels. No matter where he stayed, it was the same for Connor.
Carlos walked straight to the front desk when he heard Connor’s words.
Since Carlos had been to Borealis City often, the hotel staff knew him. They were polite when they received Carlos and booked two presidential suites for Connor and Carlos.
However, Carlos did not reveal Connor’s identity to the hotel staff to prevent incidents.
However, when the hotel staff saw Carlos’s respectful attitude toward Connor, a hint of doubt flashed in their eyes.
Carlos was considered a very powerful figure on Thomas’ side.
Although he was not a senior executive of the company and did not hold any important positions, Thomas thought highly of Carlos, which was why the employees here respected him.
After booking the presidential suite, Connor and Carlos walked toward the room with the room card.
After a whole day, Connor was already exhausted. He just wanted to return to his room and rest for a while.
However, when Connor and Carlos walked out of the elevator, they suddenly saw a few men in black tugging at two girls. They seemed to be arguing about something.
Connor could vaguely hear the voices of these two girls. Connor felt that one of the voices seemed familiar, so he could not help but turn to take a look.
However, when Connor saw the two girls, he was instantly stunned.
“It’s her?” Connor could not help but sigh.
Carlos seemed to have seen the two girls, but he was rather calm, which had much to do with his personality.
Except for Connor, who was a little reserved, Carlos was always cold to everyone else.
After Connor saw the appearance of these two girls, he stopped in his tracks. Carlos knew what Connor meant, so he stopped as well.
At this moment, the girls being bothered by the men in black were none other than Yana and Lena, whom Connor had met on the bus this morning.
A strange look flashed in Carlos’s eyes. He turned to Connor and said, “Mr.
McDonald, those two girls seem to have encountered some trouble. Should we go over and help?”
Carlos was a man of few words, but he was quite good at reading people.
If it were anyone else, he would not have wanted to meddle in other people’s business.
However, Carlos could feel that Connor cared about the two girls. Moreover, Yana and Lena were very nice to Connor..

chapters.title: Chapter 593: Break My Legs?
chapters.content:
Chapter 593: Break My Legs?
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation | Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Connor hesitated when he heard Carlos’s words.
Then, he whispered to Carlos, “Don’t be in a hurry to make a move. Let’s see what’s going on first!”
“All right!” Carlos replied in a low voice, then walked straight to Yana and Lena.
When Connor and Carlos walked forward, they found that a man grabbed Yana by the arm, trying to get her into the elevator.
Yana looked angry, but she did not panic at all.
This meant that Yana must know this group of people. Otherwise, Yana would never be so calm.
Under normal circumstances, if a few men in black took a girl away, she would panic and even take the initiative to call for help from strangers.
However, Yana and Lena didn’t panic, and the other party’s target seemed only Yana.
They ignored Lena and didn’t grab her.
This meant that these people were probably here for Yana alone!
“How many times have I told you? I won’t go back with you.” At this moment, Yana suddenly shouted, her pretty face full of anger.
The man in black who was holding Yana looked helpless.
He couldn’t help but turn around and say to Yana, “Miss Weaver, I’m begging you. Can you not make things difficult for us? We’re just trying to make a living. Sir has already given us a death order. Sir will fire us if we don’t bring you back today!”
“If you don’t let go of me now, I’ll fire all of you when I get home!” Yana shouted angrily.
Connor could not help but glance at Carlos when he heard that, but he did not say anything.
Connor could tell Yana knew these men in black.
Moreover, these men must have received orders from someone else to catch Yana.
Connor felt that if this was the case, the most reasonable explanation was that Yana’s father had asked his bodyguards to bring Yana back.
According to Connor’s previous understanding of Yana, Yana’s family should be rich. Otherwise, Yana would not be so confident and arrogant.
But Connor couldn’t understand why Yana didn’t want to go home.
As Connor was thinking, the elevator had already arrived at the floor.
A few bodyguards dragged Yana into the elevator, but Yana was still struggling.
Carlos couldn’t help but glance at Connor and say softly, “Mr. McDonald, if we don’t act now, it might be too late!”
“Do it!” Connor thought for a moment and said indifferently.
“Yes!” Carlos nodded hurriedly and ran to Yana before Connor could finish his sentence.
“Hey! You, let go of her!” Carlos suddenly shouted.
When Yana’s bodyguard heard that, he could not help but look back at Carlos with a puzzled expression.
Yana and Lena had also noticed Carlos.
When the two of them saw Carlos, they were stunned and in disbelief.
“Carlos, why are you here?” Lena hesitated before she asked Carlos.
“Did you run into some trouble?” Carlos did not answer Lena’s question. Instead, he asked her a question.
“Trouble?”
Yana looked at Carlos and was stunned momentarily before quickly saying, “That’s right. I don’t want to go with these people, but they insist on taking me away. Hurry up and call security for me!”
“There’s no need to call security for this!” Carlos said expressionlessly.
“What do you mean by that?” Yana asked Carlos in confusion.
“Leave this to me!” Carlos looked at Yana and replied indifferently. Then, he shouted at the bodyguards in black, “Since Yana doesn’t want to go with you, quickly let go of her…”
The bodyguards looked disdainful when they heard Carlos’s words. They could not understand what Carlos was trying to do.
Being a hero saving a damsel in distress?
One of the leading bodyguards rubbed his nose and walked up to Carlos, shouting, “Who are you? Who do you think you are? Do we have to leave just because you told us to?”
Carlos glanced at the bodyguard indifferently and said nothing.
“Brat, I’m not in the mood to waste my time on you. Get lost, or I’ll break your legs!” Seeing that Carlos was silent, the bodyguard thought that he was scared and shouted at Carlos even more arrogantly.
“Break my legs? I haven’t heard this for a long time…” Carlos could not help but smile faintly when he heard the bodyguard’s threat.
“Carlos…” When Connor saw Carlos smile, he sensed something was wrong and was about to stop him.
However, it was too late. Carlos stepped forward and kicked the bodyguard’s stomach hard.
‘Thud!’ With a loud thud, the bodyguard was flung away before slamming into the elevator door.
“…” When Yana saw this, her eyes widened in disbelief.
After all, Yana knew her father’s bodyguards very well. They were all the top elites of the security company.
She did not expect Carlos to be so strong that he sent him flying with a kick.
Not to mention a burly bodyguard, even sending an ordinary person flying with a kick would require much strength!
“Who are Connor and Carlos?” Lena covered her mouth and exclaimed.
This was the second time they had seen Carlos attack.
Connor, on the other hand, was speechless. After all, he could have called the security guards to solve the problem today, but Carlos insisted on doing it himself.
Connor finally understood that Carlos was a fighting machine. He would not let things go until he hit someone.
“How dare you hit me?” The bodyguard kicked away by Carlos sat on the ground and shouted angrily.

chapters.title: Chapter 594: Reincarnation Of The God Of War
chapters.content:
Chapter 594: Reincarnation Of The God Of War
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation | Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Carlos had used up all his strength in that kick.
However, the bodyguard did not faint from the kick. This meant that this bodyguard was quite strong.
“Get lost, I don’t want to fightyou! You bunch of trash are no match for me!” Carlos shouted arrogantly at the bodyguards.
The bodyguards seemed to be even angrier after hearing Carlos’s words.
” Who the f*ck do you think you are? What right do you have to make us go? Do you really think you can be so rude just because you are good at fighting?”
One of the bodyguards shouted angrily and strode toward Carlos. The other bodyguards followed suit.
“Whoosh!”
In the blink of an eye, more than ten bodyguards rushed toward Carlos.
Carlos, on the other hand, was as calm as ever. He did not seem to be frightened by the bodyguards at all.
“Stop!” Yana saw that the two sides were about to fight and hurriedly shouted.
However, the bodyguards did not seem to hear Yana at all. They continued to walk toward Carlos.
Yana saw that the situation was about to escalate and quickly stepped forward, trying to protect Carlos.
However, at that moment, someone suddenly grabbed Yana.
Yana was stunned for a moment and couldn’t help but turn to take a look. Then, she exclaimed, “Connor, why are you here?”
“Carlos and I were planning to go back to Porthampton, but it is too late, and the buses aren’t going anymore. We thought of staying in the hotel for the night and going back tomorrow, but we didn’t expect to bump into you two the moment we walked into the hotel!”
“We are fated!” Lena was also excited when she saw Connor.
“Alt, now’s not the time to talk about this. Carlos is fighting with my bodyguard. Connor, let go of me!” Yana shouted at Connor anxiously when she saw that the bodyguards had surrounded Carlos.
“Didn’t Carlos tell you just now? Leave the rest to him…” Connor pulled Yana and said expressionlessly.
“How can he resolve it…” Yana stared at him and continued, “My father’s bodyguards are all very skilled. They were hired by my father from abroad, and they have all been professionally trained. I know Carlos is very skilled, but there are so many of them…” Yana shouted at Connor anxiously.
“You don’t have to worry about that. Since Carlos said he would resolve this, he definitely will. You don’t have to worry…” Connor replied to Yana calmly.
“But…” Yana opened her mouth and wanted to say something because she was really worried that Carlos would fight with the bodyguards.
However, before Yana could finish her sentence, the bodyguards swarmed up and rushed to Carlos.
“Smack!” Carlos reached out and grabbed the bodyguard who was rushing at the front. Then, he clenched his fist and punched his face hard.
The bodyguard did not even have time to react to what had happened before he fell to the ground with a thud. His body twitched twice before he fainted.
Seeing that, the rest of the bodyguards also rushed forward.
Carlos, on the other hand, was still as calm as ever when he saw the bodyguards rushing toward him.
After all, if Carlos could not even deal with the bodyguards, how could he protect Connor?
In less than half a minute, Carlos knocked out the bodyguards.
They all had a pained expression on their faces as they lay on the ground and twitched.
However, Carlos looked calm, as if nothing had happened.
The two girls, Yana and Lena, stared at Carlos. They were dumbfounded by what they saw and were shocked.
The two felt that everything they had seen just now was like a dream. It was too unreal.
Carlos was like the reincarnation of the God of War. He was able to finish off ten people at once. This couldn’t even happen in the movies!
However, they weren’t filming at the moment. Yana and Lena knew very well that everything that happened was real.
And many times, when you encounter these things in real life, the shock you feel in the movies is completely different.
Yana couldn’t help but turn to look at Connor. Then, she asked Connor tremblingly, “Conn… Connor, who is Carlos? Why is he so powerful?”
“Carlos is our boss’ bodyguard…”
Connor didn’t want Yana and Lena to know his identity, so he made something up.
“Your boss’ bodyguard?”
When Yana heard this, she was stunned. Her eyes revealed deep shock, and she could not hide the loss of composure.
“Who’s your boss?” she asked softly. “He must be very capable to find such a strong bodyguard!”
“Do you know Thomas Morgan?” Connor replied with a smile.
“Your boss is Thomas Morgan from Porthampton?”
After hearing Connor’s words, the disbelief on Yana’s face grew. After all, there were not many people in Davenport who did not know Thomas!
Even Lena looked at Connor in shock.
“What’s your relationship with Thomas?” Yana quickly asked Connor.
“What is my relationship with Thomas?” Connor couldn’t help but laugh when he heard this. Then, he said indifferently, “Carlos is the bodyguard, and I’m the driver. We’re here in Borealis City to do something…”
“No wonder you know someone like Luke Stewart. So you’re Thomas’ driver. Everything makes sense now…”
Yana looked at Connor with a relieved expression.
“What do you mean by ‘everything makes sense’?” Connor asked Yana in confusion.
“Nah… It’s nothing…” Yana shook her head gently and didn’t continue to talk to Connor.

chapters.title: Chapter 595: It’s My Grandfather
chapters.content:
Chapter 595: It’s My Grandfather
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation | Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Just as Yana and Lena were dumbfounded, the hotel security guard suddenly rushed out of the elevator.
However, when they saw that it was Carlos who was fighting, they calmed down instantly.
If it were anyone else who dared to cause trouble in the hotel, they would have been thrown out long ago.
“Mr. Lane, this… What’s going on?” The leading security guard seemed to know Carlos as he asked him respectfully.
Carlos knew that it was not up to him to decide, so he turned to look at Connor.
“Chase these people out!” Connor thought momentarily – these people were Yana’s father’s bodyguards. He didn’t need to make things too difficult for these people, so he would chase them out.
“All right… Yes!” The leading security guard replied respectfully and chased all the bodyguards into the elevator.
Yana and Lena now knew the relationship between Connor and Thomas, and the hotel was owned by Thomas.
Therefore, it was expected for these security guards to treat Connor with such respect.
A few minutes later, the bodyguards were all taken away by the security guards.
“Connor and Carlos, thank you for what happened just now!” Yana turned and whispered to Carlos and Connor.
“If you want to thank someone, thank Carlos. After all, this has nothing to do with me…” Connor smiled faintly.
“Carlos, thank you!” Yana hurriedly said to Carlos.
“All good!” Carlos replied coldly, then walked to Connor’s side and stopped talking.
Yana felt helpless when she saw Carlos’s cold attitude.
After hesitating, she looked at Connor and said, “Connor and Carlos, come to my room and hang out!”
“Sure!” Connor didn’t overthink it and nodded in agreement.
Carlos said to Connor softly, “Mr. McDonald, you can go over. I’m not going…”
Connor knew that Carlos didn’t like to interact with girls, and he was a man who wasn’t tempted by girls. He might be single for the rest of his life.
Therefore, he did not force Carlos. Instead, he followed Yana and Lena into the room.
Yana was a standard white, rich, and beautiful woman. She also booked a luxurious private room. The room was nice and had a warm ambiance.
“Connor, sit down!” Lena dragged Connor to the sofa and smiled at him.
“Sure.” Connor nodded and sat on the sofa.
Meanwhile, Lena and Yana started to ask Connor about his identity. After all, becoming the driver of a big shot like Thomas was a very impressive thing to Lena and Yana.
Connor started to deal with the two girls’ questions.
‘Ring, ring!’ Not long after the three of them sat down, Yana’s phone suddenly rang.
Connor couldn’t help but glance at Yana’s phone. The word ‘Dad’ was written on it. It was a call from Yana’s father.
Yana looked at her phone with a hint of helplessness in her eyes. Then, she whispered to Connor and Lena, “You two continue chatting. I’ll go take a call…”
After saying this, Yana turned around and ran into the bathroom alone.
Although Yana had already closed the door, Connor and Lena could still hear the argument inside. It was very intense.
Connor turned to look at Lena and said softly, “Wiry did those people want to capture Yana? And from what I hear, these people were probably Yana’s father’s bodyguards, right?”
“Sigh…” Lena looked at Connor and sighed helplessly. Then, she said solemnly, “Actually, Yana didn’t want me to tell anyone about this, but I don’t think I have to hide it from you. Yana had a conflict with her family and hadn’t been in a good mood, so she secretly ran away from home and came to Porthampton to look for me. I was on vacation a few days ago, and to prevent my family from finding out, we chose to take the bus home…”
“I see!” Connor nodded thoughtfully, then looked at Lena and asked, “Do you know what kind of conflict Yana had with her family?”
“I’ve also asked Yana about this, but Yana refused to tell me…” Lena shook her head lightly.
Connor looked at Lena helplessly and didn’t say anything else.
At this moment, Yana walked out of the bathroom with her phone.
Although Yana had washed her face, Connor and Lena could still tell that Yana must have cried just now. Her eyes were red.
” What are you two talking about?” Yana took a deep breath and pretended that nothing had happened.
“What did your father tell you?” Lena asked.
“Nah… He didn’t say anything!” Yana was stunned for a moment; then she shook her head nervously.
Lena stood up and walked over to Yana. She grabbed Yana and said, “Don’t lie to me. I can see that you must have cried just now. What exactly happened? I remember that your relationship with your father is great. How did things suddenly go south?”
II II
Yana hesitated and couldn’t help but turn to look at Connor.
“Oh well, Yana, Connor doesn’t understand your situation anyway. If there’s anything, say it. Maybe we can help you think of a way,” Lena said with a frown.
“Nothing much happened…” Yana didn’t seem to want to talk about it.
Lena’s eyes flashed with helplessness. She pulled Yana onto the sofa and said seriously, “Yana, do you still see me as a friend?”
“Of course, I do!” Yana did not hesitate at all when she said this and nodded heavily.
“Since you see me as a friend, you should not have any misgivings now. Just tell me what exactly is going on…” Lena said to Yana.
Yana looked at Lena and hesitated before saying in a low voice, “Actually, there’s no conflict between my father and me. It’s my grandfather!”

chapters.title: Chapter 596: Pushed Into The Fire Pit!
chapters.content:
Chapter 596: Pushed Into The Fire Pit!
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
“Your grandfather?”
Lena was confused.
“That’s right, my grandfather!”
Yana nodded gently and continued, “My grandfather has a total of three sons, but among the three sons, my father’s status is the lowest, so this has led to me not being valued at home!”
Connor glanced at Yana indifferently and didn’t say anything.
“You are both children of the Weaver Family, but the gap between you and the others is indeed a little too big…”
Lena nodded lightly.
“Some time ago, my grandfather suddenly said that he wanted me to marry someone!”
Yana whispered.
“Marry someone?”
When Lena heard this, she was shocked and looked at Yana in disbelief. She asked, “Then, did you agree?”
“Of course, I didn’t agree. At that time, I didn’t even know who the other party was!”
Yana replied helplessly, then continued, “If I had agreed, there would not be so many things happening now…
“I’ve never had a boyfriend in my life, and I don’t like that person either, so I rejected him. However, my grandfather didn’t give me a chance to discuss it at all and said that I had to marry that person!
My father’s business hasn’t improved for so many years. Moreover, he has been relying on my grandfather to survive all these years. Naturally, he didn’t dare to go against my grandfather’s wishes, so he agreed to this marriage. In the beginning, I even caused a ruckus at home and went on a hunger strike, but it didn’t have any effect because no one would consider my feelings at all. In the end, I really had no choice but to leave my home and come to Porthampton to look for you.”
Yana choked as she spoke intermittently.
When Connor heard Yana’s words, he felt very helpless.
Because Connor really couldn’t understand how there could be such a parent in this world who would force his daughter to marry someone she didn’t like.
But soon, Connor thought of Luke Phillips and Madison Phillips. It seemed that many rich people liked to use this method to solidify their status.
Girls like Yana were also very pitiful. They did not do anything wrong at all, but they did not have any chance or right to choose!
“Yana, I don’t think you need to be too sad. There must be a way to resolve this matter…”
Lena advised softly.
“What else can we do? I’m at my wits’ end now. You guys can’t help me resolve this. I know this might be my fate. I can’t run away from this. Although I can still run now, I’ll be captured by my father’s people very soon. I hate myself for not being as outstanding as my cousin. If it were my cousin, they definitely wouldn’t dare to do this!”
Yana whispered.
Lena looked helpless after hearing what Yana said.
She couldn’t help but sigh, then said in a low voice, “How could Uncle Weaver do this? He treats you quite well, but I didn’t expect him to do such a thing!” Yana turned to look at Lena and whispered, “Actually, you can’t blame my father for this. This was my grandfather’s decision. Even if my father had a hundred guts, he wouldn’t dare to go against my grandfather’s wishes.”
Lena knew that this was Yana’s family matter, so she couldn’t say anything. She asked Yana softly, “Yana, who is Uncle Weaver planning to marry you to?” “Do you know Terence Yates?” Yana replied indifferently.
“Terence Yates?”
Lena was shocked when she heard the name.
Connor turned to Lena and asked softly, “You know this person too?”
“In Borealis City, everyone knows Terence Yates?”
Lena shouted and continued, “Terence is the eldest son of the Yates Family in Borealis City. The Yates Family is considered a very famous family in Borealis City.
Terence’s father and Luke Phillips are both very famous entrepreneurs in Borealis City, but Terence isn’t a good person. He’s the kind of playboy who flirts with women.
I heard from my friend that Terence changes girlfriends every once in a while, and he usually dumps the girl after he’s done with her.
“I didn’t expect Uncle Weaver to actually want Yana to marry such a scumbag. Even I won’t want to!”
Lena seemed to understand Terence very well, and her tone was filled with anger.
It could be seen that Terence was indeed not a good person.
However, Connor only nodded and didn’t say anything.
After all, this was Yana’s own matter and had nothing to do with Connor. It would not be good for Connor to say too much at this time.
“Yana, if you don’t want to marry Terence, you can tell Uncle Weaver everything about him! I don’t think Uncle Weaver will make things difficult for you, right?”
“Sigh!”
When Yana heard this, she sighed helplessly.
Then, she bit her lips and whispered, “Actually, I’ve already told my father everything. I even specially asked someone to investigate Terence, but my father brushed it off. He said that all the information was fake. I know that my father and grandfather also know about Terence’s character, but there’s no other way. My grandfather wants me to marry Terence!”
“Why?”
Lena really couldn’t understand the Weaver Family’s decision.
“Because as long as I can marry Terence, it will be of great help to our Weaver Family. Although I don’t know what exactly is going on, I know that they all want me to marry Terence.”
Yana said helplessly.
“Is there no other way out?”
Lena shouted angrily when she found out that Yana was going to marry Terence.
“If there was a way, I would have thought of it long ago. Why would I have to hide? But no matter what I say, they won’t agree, so I can only hide for a day, but I know that they will catch me sooner or later!”
Yana said slowly.
When Connor heard all that, he looked very helpless.
He himself felt that Luke had gone too far by asking Madison to marry Connor!
However, he did not expect Yana’s parents to go even further. They were clearly trying to push their daughter into the fire pit!

chapters.title: Chapter 597: Pregnant With His Child
chapters.content:
Chapter 597: Pregnant With His Child
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation | Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Even though they knew that the other party was a playboy, they still wanted Yana to marry him.
Wasn’t this clearly pushing Yana into the fire pit?
“Yana, don’t be sad. We definitely have other ways!”
Lena patted Yana’s shoulder and turned to look at Connor with a strange look in her eyes.
She then said to Yana, “Yana, if your father finds out that you already have a boyfriend and you’re pregnant with his child, will Uncle Weaver let this forced marriage go?”
When Yana heard this, she could not help but be stunned for a moment.
“Lena, can you stop joking with me?” she said helplessly. “I don’t have a boyfriend and I’m not pregnant. Even if I tell them that, they definitely won’t believe me!”
“You don’t have a real boyfriend, but don’t you have a fake boyfriend?”
Lena quickly called out.
“Fake boyfriend?”
When Yana heard this, she seemed to be even more puzzled.
“That’s right, a fake boyfriend!”
Lena nodded and continued, “Yana, you can find someone to pretend to be your boyfriend, then bring him home and tell them that this person is your boyfriend. This way, Uncle Weaver won’t let you marry Terence!”
Yana looked at Lena and hesitated for a couple of seconds. She felt that Lena’s idea did make some sense, and she might really be able to fake her way through it.
However, she quickly rejected the idea and said with a helpless expression, “Where am I going to find someone to pretend to be my boyfriend? And even if 1 find someone, what good would it do?
“It’s not like you don’t know my grandfather. If I bring anyone back, he will definitely investigate this person’s identity thoroughly. At that time, he will know that I’m lying.”
“Can your grandfather investigate everyone?”
Lena smiled playfully and said, “Yana, I actually know someone who is very suitable to as a fake boyfriend, and I believe that no matter how capable your grandfather is, he won’t be able to find out the identity of this person!”
“Who is it?”
Yana’s eyes flashed with a strange look as she hurriedly asked.
Lena looked at Yana with a mysterious smile, then turned to Connor.
Connor realized that something was wrong when Lena turned to look at him. She was obviously going to use him as a shield again!
Connor had already helped Madison Phillips by pretending to be her boyfriend once, and now he actually had to help Yana as a shield. Connor really couldn’t understand what these women were thinking!
Why was there always someone who wanted him to be a fake boyfriend?
Were all the beauties in this society lacking in boyfriends?
“Uh…You two can talk about it. 1 have something else to do, so I’ll be leaving now!”
When Connor realized that something was wrong, he stood up and was about to leave.
After all, Connor had experienced enough of such things. He did not want to participate in other people’s affairs. He was not a fairy Godmother. It was impossible for him to help everyone!
Moreover, Connor had a lot of things to deal with, so he felt that leaving now was the best thing to do!
“Connor, stop right there!”
When Lena saw that Connor was about to leave, she reacted reached out to grab him.
Connor looked extremely helpless when Lena grabbed him.
He finally began to regret it. He should not have come to Yana’s room, nor should he have listened to their private matters.
Connor had never expected that he would actually be implicated in the end!
Connor smiled helplessly, then looked at Lena and said, “It’s getting late. I still have to take a bus tomorrow. You two can talk. I’m tired.”
“Connor, don’t even think about leaving!”
Lena grabbed Connor and turned to Yana. “Yana, 1 think that Connor is the right fit. How about asking him to pretend to be your boyfriend?”
When Yana heard this, a strange look appeared in her eyes. Then, she frowned and said, “Lena, are you kidding me? Why is Connor the right fit?”
“Yana, Connor is Thomas Morgan’s driver, which is a good identity. If you can bring Connor back and tell Uncle Weaver that Connor is your boyfriend, Uncle Weaver might really agree to the two of you being together. After all, Uncle Weaver wants you to marry Terence for the sake of Terence’s family. But if you can be with Connor, you can also get Thomas Morgan’s help. This is not a loss for your family. Moreover, Connor is about the same age as you. Also, he is also quite good-looking. If you bring him back, it will definitely not be a problem! Also…”
“But Connor is not my boyfriend. This matter will be exposed sooner or later!”
Before Lena could finish her sentence, Yana interrupted her helplessly.
“This isn’t a problem. You just need to wait until Terence has another girlfriend or is already married. Then, you can tell them that you broke up with Connor.”
“Anyway, you’re just pretending to be with Connor now. It’s not like you’re actually going to marry him. If you really can’t do it, just say that you’re pregnant. Uncle Weaver won’t ask you to marry Terence if he finds out about that. Even if he asks you to marry Terence still, Terence probably won’t marry you!”
Lena said hurriedly.
Yana fell silent after hearing what Lena had to say.
She blinked her big bright eyes and sized up Connor. She seemed to be hesitant. She did not know what to do now.
“Yana, why are you still hesitating?”
Lena shouted.
“I…”
Yana wasn’t able to say anything.
“You have no other option. If you hesitate any longer, you might really have to marry Terence in the end. Do you really want to marry someone like Terence?”
Lena shouted with her big watery eyes..

chapters.title: Chapter 598: Going to Yana’s House
chapters.content:
Chapter 598: Going to Yana’s House
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation | Editor. EndlessFantasy Translation
When Yana heard this, the expression on her face instantly changed.
If her dad wanted Yana to marry Terence, he might as well kill her!
Therefore, Yana turned her head to look at Connor and asked him softly,
“Connor, do you have a girlfriend?”
“I already have a girlfriend!”
Connor replied without thinking.
“It’s okay even if you have a girlfriend. 1 just want you to pretend to be Yana’s boyfriend. I’m not asking you to actually be her boyfriend. After this is over, you can do whatever you want. No one will care about you at all…”
However, just as Connor was about to refuse, Lena shouted,
After hearing Lena’s words, Connor looked even more helpless. He really didn’t want to get involved in this.
“I think…”
Connor opened his mouth to speak.
-I don’t want you to think. Did you hear what Yana said just now?”
“Yana’s father wants her to marry a scumbag. Now, only you can help her. Also,
it only takes a little bit of your time to change her fate. Saving a life is better than building a place of worship.”
Lena exclaimed.
Connor became even more helpless after hearing Lena’s words.
He frowned, not knowing what to say.
If Connor rejected them now, it would seem that he was cold-blooded and heartless. However, Connor really did not want to get involved in this matter.
“I still have to go back to school tomorrow. If you really want me to pretend to
be your boyfriend, then I can only meet your family tonight!”
Connor hesitated for a moment and said in a low voice.
In fact, Connor said this just to avoid it. After all, it was so late now, and he felt that Yana would definitely not bring him home.
“Sure, tonight it is. Anyway, this matter will be resolved sooner or later, so
Yana can go home earlier!”
However, what Connor did not expect was that Lena actually nodded and agreed.
Yana had no intention of rejecting Lena. It was obvious that she had agreed to
this.
Connor looked at the two girls and felt extremely helpless. He really didn’t
know what to say.
When Connor first saw Yana, he felt that something was wrong, but he didn’t expect that he would really encounter such a thing.
However, since things had already reached this point, Connor was too embarrassed to reject Yana.
Moreover, it was just pretending to be her boyfriend for one night. Connor felt that it would not cause any problems to him.
Therefore, he nodded and said, “Alright, if it can be settled tonight, then I can
help you!”
“That’s great.”
Lena couldn’t help but cheer. She quickly pulled Yana up and said to her, “Yana, why are you just standing there? Let’s bring Connor to your house!” “Connor, are you really okay with this? If you don’t want to go, you don’t have to. After all, this is my own business!”
Yana hesitated for a moment and whispered to Connor.
“Let’s go. Anyway, I don’t have anything to do now. If I can really help you, then I’ll be doing a good deed!”
Connor couldn’t reject Yana now, so he could only reply helplessly.
“Alright, then!”
Yana nodded gently and walked out of the room with Lena and Connor.
Connor was going to call Carlos Lane, but if he did, he wouldn’t be able to reveal Carlos’s identity.
Besides, Carlos’s identity was rather special, and he was always by Thomas Morgan’s side.
If Yana’s father recognized him, it would only be more troublesome, so Connor did not bring Carlos along.
After leaving the hotel, the three of them hailed a taxi and headed straight for
Yana’s house.
Half an hour later.
Connor, Yana, and Lena arrived at a villa complex in Borealis City.
Lena felt that she shouldn’t be there, so she didn’t enter the villa with Yana and Connor. Instead, she chose to stand at the entrance of the villa and wait quietly.
Although Connor didn’t know the real estate prices in Borealis City, this villa was definitely not cheap.
At this moment, Yana was very nervous, and her brows were tightly furrowed.
It was as if she was thinking about how to deal with her father and grandfather later.
In order to avoid awkwardness, Connor took the initiative to say to Yana, “1 didn’t expect your family to live in such a luxurious villa.”
“My family doesn’t have much money. This villa was given to my father by my grandfather. This entire villa area was built by my grandfather’s company!”
Yana replied calmly.
After hearing this, Connor smiled faintly and didn’t say anything else. Originally, Yana thought that Connor would be very surprised when he found out about her family situation. However, she did not expect Connor to only smile and not be surprised.
However, Yana figured that Connor was Thomas Morgan’s driver and had seen a lot of things, so it was normal for him to not be surprised.
However, she might not know that this villa was nothing in Connor’s eyes. Compared to Connor’s villa, this villa was like the difference between clouds and mud.
Just as Yana and Connor were about to enter the villa.
Yana suddenly stopped, then turned her head to look at Connor and said softly, “If you want to go back on your word now, it’s not too late!
“Since you’re already here, let’s go in and take a look!” Connor replied indifferently, then directly walked into the villa area. Yana’s family was indeed very rich, and the environment of the villa was also very good.
Although it couldn’t be compared with Connor’s villa, it was still very luxurious compared to ordinary villas.
At this moment, there was a security guard on duty at the entrance of the villa. When the security guard saw Yana, he was immediately shocked.
In the next second, the security guard took out his phone and made a call.
It was obvious that the security guard was calling Yana’s father..

chapters.title: Chapter 599: My Boyfriend, Connor McDonald!
chapters.content:
Chapter 599: My Boyfriend, Connor McDonald!
Please c0ntinue reading on ΒƟXN0VEL.ƇʘM
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation | Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
