“By the way, if you see my grandfather later, don’t be frightened by him.
“You have to be tough. If they don’t agree to us being together, I’ll say that I’m pregnant.”
Yana seemed to be worried that Connor would be frightened by her grandfather, so she reminded him very carefully.
When Connor heard that, a helpless smile appeared on his face.
He had only known Yana for less than a day, and their hands hadn’t even touched.
Now, he had actually made Yana pregnant? Connor found it funny just thinking about it.
Moreover, based on what Yana said just now and the environment of this villa, Connor could feel that Yana’s father and Yana’s grandfather were definitely not ordinary people.
These two people should not be so easy to deal with, but since they were already here, Connor did not think of backing out.
“My house is just ahead!”
As they were walking, Yana suddenly stopped and pointed at the European- style villa in front of them.
“Okay!”
Connor nodded thoughtfully and did not say anything more. Instead, he walked toward the villa.
At this moment, Connor was still very calm, but Yana was very nervous.
Because she didn’t know what would happen next.
Before the two of them could enter the villa, the door of the villa suddenly opened.
A middle-aged man ran out of the villa in a hurry. When the middle-aged man saw Yana, his face immediately revealed a hint of excitement.
The middle-aged man hurriedly pulled her by the arm and said, “Yana, you’re finally back. Do you know how worried your grandfather is?”
“Worried?”
When Yana heard this, she could not help but sneer. Then, she said with a disdainful expression, “I think he’s scared that I won’t marry Terence Yates!” “Yana, what are you saying? You’ve been missing for so long. Your grandfather is worried about you…”
“Do you think I’ll believe you? Those bodyguards have been following me all this time. Do you think I’ll be in any danger?”
Yana replied disdainfully.
When the middle-aged man heard this, he couldn’t help but laugh awkwardly. Then, he pulled Yana and said, “Alright, go in quickly. Your grandfather is still waiting for you inside!”
After saying this, the middle-aged man couldn’t help but turn to look at Connor.
When he saw Connor, his face revealed a puzzled expression. He couldn’t help but ask Yana, “Yana, who is this?”
“Dad, this is my boyfriend, Connor McDonald!”
Yana replied softly.
“Your boyfriend?”
When Yana’s father heard this, the expression on his face instantly changed.
He looked at Yana in disbelief and said, “Yana, are you kidding me? When did you get a boyfriend?”
“Connor and I have been together for a fewyears, and our relationship is very good. This is also the reason why I have never wanted to marry Terence…” Yana replied indifferently.
“Then, why didn’t you tell us about this?”
The middle-aged man shouted.
“Sowhat if I tell you? I know that you won’t agree to me being with Connor. Even if I tell you, it won’t change anything. But since things have already come to this, I don’t intend to hide it anymore. I want to be with Connor. I definitely won’t marry Terence!”
Yana was already in the zone. She said to her father with a firm expression.
When Yana’s father heard these words, he felt very helpless. He couldn’t help but size up Connor. He really didn’t know what to say.
Yana didn’t continue to speak. She turned to Connor and said, “Connor, this is my father, Jacob Weaver!”
“Hello, Uncle Weaver!”
Connor politely extended his right hand.
Jacob was not in the mood to pay attention to Connor at all. He did not even look at Connor. He directly said to Yana coldly, “Yana, why did you bring this person home? It’s not like you don’t know your grandfather’s temper. Hurry up and get this person out of here!”
“Why? It’s all because you have been forcing me. I really had no choice but to bring Connor home.
“I have to make it clear to grandfather that the person I love is Connor. I can only be with Connor. I won’t be with anyone else!”
Yana shouted with determination.
Connor turned his head and glanced at Yana helplessly.
This was because Connor realized that Yana’s acting skills were quite good. She was much better than those young people in the entertainment industry. Yana was actually able to immerse herself in the lie so easily. If it wasn’t for the people who knew the truth, they would really think that Connor was Yana’s boyfriend!
Jacob looked at Yana and sighed helplessly. Then, he said indifferently, “Forget it. I can’t interfere in your matters, and I don’t want to interfere. If your grandfather is okay with you not marrying Terence, you can marry whoever you want.”
After Jacob said this, he walked into the villa with his hands behind his back.
He knew very well in his heart that this matter was not something he could manage.
Connor and Yana stood where they were and looked at Jacob’s retreating back.
After hesitating for a moment, Connor whispered to Yana, “Do you really think it’s a good idea to do this?”
” Why not? When they asked me to marry Terence, they didn’t consider my feelings. Why should I consider their feelings now? I will never be with that playboy!”
Yana replied expressionlessly and then did something that Connor didn’t expect.
Yana grabbed Connor’s arm!
“Isn’t this a little inappropriate?”
Connor asked Yana helplessly.
“I’m not even complaining, so why would you complain about this?”
Yana pouted and replied to Connor.
When Connor heard Yana’s words, his face revealed a helpless expression, but he did not say anything.
Meanwhile, Yana walked straight into the villa in her high heels.

chapters.title: Chapter 600: Victor Weaver
chapters.content:
Chapter 600: Victor Weaver
Please c0ntinue reading on ΒƟXN0VEL.ƇʘM
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation | Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
A moment later.
Connor and Yana walked into the living room of the villa.
At this moment, a skinny old man was sitting on the sofa in the living room.
The old man had a short goatee and a pair of deep brown eyes. He looked very dignified.
Even though he did not say a word, his body gave off a dignified aura.
Yana’s father, Jacob, stood beside the old man and whispered something to him!
Yana hesitated for a moment, then turned to Connor and said, “Connor, this is my grandfather, Victor Weaver!”
“Victor Weaver?”
When Connor heard this name, he could not help but be stunned for a moment.
He felt like he had heard this name from somewhere before, but now that Yana was saying it out loud, Connor couldn’t remember who this person was.
“You remember what I told you just now, right?”
Yana asked Connor softly.
“Ido!”
Connor nodded without thinking.
“Okay!”
Yana replied in a low voice, then reached out and pulled Connor toward Victor.
“Grandpa…”
Yana opened her mouth and was about to speak when Victor suddenly raised his head and carefully sized up Connor. Then, he shouted expressionlessly, “Alright, stop acting in front of me. Let go of his hand!”
When Yana and Connor heard Victor’s words, they were instantly stunned.
“Grandpa, do you mean?”
Yana pretended not to know what was going on and asked Victor softly.
“Don’t you know what I mean?” Victor asked coldly.
“Grandpa, do you have a misunderstanding? This is my boyfriend, Connor McDonald…”
Yana opened her mouth as if she wanted to explain something, but Victor seemed even more upset right now.
He ignored Yana and said coldly to Connor, “Alright, young man, you better get out of here. This matter is not something you can be part of. I know that you are an actor hired by Yana. The two of you aren’t really together. If you get yourself killed because of such a small matter, then the gains will not make up for the losses!”
When Connor heard Victor’s words, he could not help but be stunned for a moment.
He had never expected that Yana would figure things out so quickly. Connor was indeed invited by Yana to help her put on an act.
However, what made Connor very unhappy was Victor’s attitude. Therefore, Connor didn’t leave. Instead, he walked to Victor and sat on the sofa opposite him without Victor’s consent.
When everyone saw Connor sitting on the sofa, their eyes widened in shock.
No one expected Connor to be so bold.
On the other hand, Connor had a faint smile on his face, as if he did not have the slightest fear because of Victor’s identity.
Yana looked at Connor with a surprised expression. She did not expect Connor to be so bold. Even the Weaver Family did not dare to be so impudent!
“Didn’t you hear me asking you to get out just now? Why are you still sitting here? Don’t tell me you prefer that I get someone to throw you out.”
Victor turned his head to look at Connor and shouted coldly at Connor.
“Is this how the Weaver Family treats its guests?”
Connor asked Victor expressionlessly.
“Guest?”
When Victor heard Connor’s words, he sneered disdainfully and said indifferently, “Are you considered a guest of our family? Do you think you are qualified?”
“Everyone who comes is a guest. Why am I not qualified?”
Connor replied calmly and then continued, “I know that you are Yana’s grandfather, but Yana and I are sincerely in love. I hope that you will not interfere in the matters between the two of us in the future. Also, Yana doesn’t like Terence Yates at all. I don’t want you to continue forcing Yana to marry him!”
When Connor looked at Victor, he did not reveal the slightest bit of timidity at all. On the contrary, he was abnormally calm!
Even Jacob could not help but tremble in fear when he saw this scene.
He didn’t think that the boy his daughter brought back would have such a powerful aura.
In the entire Borealis City, there were probably less than ten people who dared to speak to Victor like this.
Yana was still a little surprised just now, but she wasn’t that surprised anymore.
After all, Yana already knew Connor’s identity. He was Thomas Morgan’s driver, so he must have come into contact with many big shots.
That was why Connor was so calm when facing Victor.
Yana couldn’t help but be stunned when she heard Connor’s words. Then, she hurriedly added, “That’s right. Connor and I are together. I won’t marry anyone else except Connor. I hope you can fulfill our wishes!”
“Let the two of you have your way?”
When Victor heard this, he could not help but sneer.
“Grandpa, Connor and I are in a relationship. Can’t you fulfill our wishes?”
Yana exclaimed.
“What nonsense is this!”
Victor shouted angrily, then turned to look at Connor and asked, “Are you sure you’re not an actor hired by Yana?”
“I’m not an actor…”
Connor shook his head without any hesitation.
When Victor heard Connor’s answer, he was not surprised.
“Since you’re not an actor hired by Yana, I have a few questions to ask you!” ”
“Sure!”
Connor replied softly.
“What do you do for a living? How much do you earn in a month? Do you think you’re worthy of my granddaughter? I don’t care if the two of you are really together or not. If your conditions can’t meet my expectations, then I definitely won’t let you be together with my granddaughter…”
“Grandpa…”
Before Victor could finish speaking, Yana frowned and shouted.
Then, she continued, “Grandpa, I don’t look at these things in a relationship. I just like him as a person. Do you really want me to marry that pervert, Terence Yates?
” Who in Borealis City doesn’t know who Terence Yates is? A playboy like him only knows how to play with women all day long. I won’t be happy even if I marry him!”
Yana shouted.

chapters.title: Chapter 601: Financial Problem
chapters.content:
Chapter 601: Financial Problem
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation | Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Victor heard Yana words and a hint of helplessness appeared on his face.
At the same time, Connor happened to see the expression on Victor’s face, lie understood in his heart that there must be some hidden reason why Victor wanted Yana to marry Terence.
In this world, many things cannot be solved with money alone.
Often, even big shots like him was powerless.
There must be some undisclosed reason why Victor wanted Yana to marry Terence.
Connor hesitated for a moment and then softly said to Victor, “Mr. Weaver, do you have some undisclosed reason that makes you want to marry Yana to Terence?”
“This is our family’s affair, it has nothing to do with you as an outsider. You better leave now and never disturb our family and Yana again. I can assure you that I won’t trouble you!” Victor said expressionlessly to Connor.
“Mr. Weaver, if you are facing any trouble, you can tell me now. Perhaps 1 can help you solve it…” Connor said with a smile.
In the eyes of someone like Victor, many things might seem extremely difficult, but for Connor, they might be just a matter of a few words.
After hearing his words, Victor’s expression seemed even more disdainful, lie looked at Connor with a scornful gaze and said, “Who do you think you are? Even I can’t solve the problems, but you can? Are you joking with me?” “Grandfather, Connor is the driver of Thomas, the chairman of Emperor Group. Maybe he really has some ways to help,” Yana hurriedly said.
“You are the driver of Thomas?” Victor’s face showed a hint of astonishment after hearing Yana’s words.
He never expected that Connor would be Thomas’ driver!
“Mr. Weaver, if you have encountered any trouble, just tell me directly. If it’s something I can solve, I will definitely help you!” Connor didn’t answer Victor’s question directly but said expressionlessly.
Victor hesitated for a moment, then sighed lightly and helplessly said, “Yana, the reason 1 want you to marry Terence is because we have no choice. Our company encountered a major problem with a project some time ago, and now we need a large amount of funds to ease our financial situation. If we cannot secure this money within a month, our Weaver family’s company may face bankruptcy.”
“This company is the result of my entire life’s efforts, and what it means to me, you should understand very well. 1 have already talked to the Yates family, and as long as you can marry Terence, the Yates family will help me solve the financial crisis. Moreover, the Yates family itself is a well-known prominent family in Borealis City. Marrying into the Yates family will definitely be much better for you than marrying a poor guy like Connor!”
Victor said expressionlessly.
After hearing these words, Yana’s expression was filled with shock.
Although she had been forced by her family to marry Terence, she wasn’t clear about the reasons behind it.
“The Weaver family’s company is facing financial problems?” she said in disbelief, her expression filled with astonishment.
After all, she was just a nobody in the Weaver family, and she didn’t know much about the company’s internal affairs.
“Yes!”
Yana’s father, Jacob, nodded lightly and said expressionlessly, “In fact, as early as a year ago, our family’s company was already facing an economic crisis, with insufficient funds in the capital chain. However, your grandfather insisted on keeping it a secret and used funds from other companies to fill the gap. But unexpectedly, the gap has been growing and has reached a point where our Weaver family can no longer bear it. The only solution now is for you to marry Terrance. In that case, the Yates family will provide financial assistance, and our Weaver family can get through this difficult time.”
After hearing Jacob’s words, Yana stood still, her face filled with disbelief.
After all, if it was simply about marrying Terrance, Yana would definitely refuse.
But if it was because of the company’s problem that she had to marry Terrance, she might actually agree.
After all, that company was the result of their Weaver family’s efforts over the years. If it really went bankrupt, the future life of the Weaver family would be very difficult.
“Yana, for all these years, I haven’t valued you enough, and sometimes I haven’t treated you well. But no matter what, you are a member of our Weaver family. If you marry Terrance, it will not only benefit you greatly, but also bring great benefits to our Weaver family. So I hope you can consider it seriously, as a favor to your grandfather, okay?”
At this moment, Victor’s aura noticeably weakened.
“If our family’s company is facing bankruptcy, why didn’t you tell me before?” Yana shouted in confusion after hearing his words.
“Even if I had told you all this, what difference would it make?” Victor said with a sigh. “I initially thought that Terrance would prefer your cousin instead of you, so I was discussing this matter with your cousin. In the end, your cousin agreed to marry Terrance.”
“But what 1 didn’t expect was that Terrance actually didn’t like your cousin and instead liked you. So I started discussing this matter with your father. At first, your father also disagreed.”
“But as the situation in our company worsened, he had no choice but to agree. 1 know you must hate us for all this, but we really have no other choice!”
Victor explained in a low voice.
After listening to all these words, tears instantly welled up in Yana’s eyes.
At this moment, Yana didn’t know how to make a choice.
Marrying Terrance was something she definitely felt reluctant to do.
But if she didn’t marry him, the Weaver family would face the dilemma of ruin.
This was a difficult decision for anyone.
“How much money is needed to help the Weaver family’s finances?”
But just as Yana didn’t know what to say, Connor suddenly spoke up and asked..

chapters.title: Chapter 602:I Believe You!
chapters.content:
Chapter 602:I Believe You!
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation | Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
After hearing Connor’s words, Victor couldn’t help but turn his head and glanced at him.
But in the next second, he showed a hint of disdain on his face, and then with a scornful look, he said, “You’re just a driver for Thomas. Even if I tell you how much money, you definitely can’t come up with it!”
“You can tell me, in case I can really come up with this money, don’t be so absolute in your words…”
Connor replied with a smile.
“Hmph!”
Victor sneered disdainfully and said expressionlessly, “You are an ignorant kid. Even if I tell you the amount, it would probably scare you. Stop embarrassing yourself here and go do whatever you should be doing!”
Connor narrowed his eyes and looked at Victor with a calm expression on his face.
“Grandpa, how much money does our company really need?” Yana hesitated for a moment and asked Victor.
Victor took a deep breath and whispered, “Our company’s accountant did the calculations. We absolutely cannot fill this hole in our company without five billion in cash…”
“Five billion?”
After hearing this number, Yana was instantly stunned. The expression on her face was full of disbelief. She never thought that they would need so much money.
“Young man, didn’t you say you could come up with this money? Where is your money then?”
Victor asked Connor coldly.
“Dad, don’t joke with him. Even if it’s just five hundred thousand, I doubt he can come up with it!”
Jacob shouted expressionlessly.
“Mr. Wang, you seem to underestimate me. I can still come up with five hundred thousand in cash…”
Connor said with a smile.
After hearing Connor’s words, Yana’s face showed extreme frustration.
She couldn’t help but sigh inwardly, “What’s the point of joking at a time like this? Connor still has the mood to joke here…”
Victor and Jacob turned their heads to look at Connor, but they didn’t speak. After all, they didn’t have any hope in Connor in the first place.
However, at this moment, Connor suddenly stood up and calmly said to Victor, “It’s just five billion, right? I can help you solve this money issue. I’ll have the money transferred to you by tomorrow, but I have one condition. I won’t give you this money for free!”
Upon hearing Connor’s words, everyone present was stunned.
Victor couldn’t help but look up at Connor, and asked in a low voice, “What did you say just now?”
“I said I can give you five billion, but I have a condition!”
Connor repeated calmly.
” What kind of joke are you making? How can you possibly come up with five billion?”
Victor seemed to not believe that Connor had the ability, and said with a very disdainful expression.
“Whether I can come up with five billion or not is my own business. You just need to wait until tomorrow. If I send you the money, it means I can do it. If I don’t send the money tomorrow, then you can consider me a fraud. It shouldn’t be a loss for you either!”
Connor calmly replied, not wanting to waste any more words with Victor and the others.
Victor and Jacob glanced at each other.
“Then what was the condition you mentioned earlier?”
Victor hesitated for a moment before asking Connor softly.
“My conditions are very simple. I will provide you with 500 million in funds, but in return, I want 50% of the shares of the Weaver Corporation. This request shouldn’t be too unreasonable, right?” Connor replied calmly.
“You actually want 50% of the shares of the Weaver Corporation?” Victor exclaimed in shock.
“If I don’t come up with this 500 million in funds, your Weaver Corporation will go bankrupt within six months. But if I provide you with this 500 million, your Weaver Corporation can revive, and Yana won’t have to marry Terrance. Besides, all I want is 50% of your company’s shares. I won’t interfere with your company’s affairs. I’ll just wait for dividends at the end of each year,” Connor said calmly.
Victor hesitated for a moment and couldn’t help but look at Jacob.
In fact, Connor had always wanted to invest in some industries of his own. After all, all the assets he currently owned were left to him by Steven.
If he were to lose his inheritance eligibility, these things would be confiscated.
But if he used money to invest in Victor’s company and then put the shares under Yana’s name, this money would have no significant connection to him.
Even if he lost his inheritance eligibility in the future, he could still live a comfortable life.
Jacob looked at Connor up and down, then coldly said to Victor, “Dad, we can’t make hasty decisions now. How can someone like him come up with 500 million in cash?”
Clearly, Jacob, Yana’s father, did not believe in Connor’s capability.
In fact, it was not just him who didn’t believe in Connor. Any normal person would find it hard to believe what Connor had just said.
After all, it was a whopping 500 million in cash!
Even if an ordinary person worked their whole life, they might not earn even a fraction of that.
With an expressionless face, Yana walked behind Connor and reached out to pull him.
“Connor, what are you talking about?” she asked helplessly.
Today, Yana had only asked Connor to pretend to be her boyfriend, but now she had changed her mind!
She felt that if it was for the sake of the Weaver family, she was willing to sacrifice her happiness for the rest of her life.
Also, she knew that Connor was just bragging with those words. How could he possibly come up with 500 million?
He seemed relaxed now, but if he couldn’t come up with the money tomorrow, it would be even more troublesome for herself!
“I’m not talking nonsense…”
He turned his head and looked at her, speaking calmly.
Upon hearing Connor’s words, Yana felt even more convinced that Connor was lying.
So, she couldn’t help but say coldly, “Connor, why don’t you leave for now!”
Hedirectly turned his head and looked at Yana, his face expressionless, and asked, “You don’t believe me now?”
After hearing his words, she froze in place, her expression full of confusion.
Because she could feel that he didn’t seem to be joking with her right now. His facial expression and tone of speech were very confident!
But he was just a mere driver. How could he possibly come up with so much money?
She simply couldn’t believe it.
However, after hesitating for a moment, Yana gritted her teeth and said in a low voice to Connor, “I believe you!”

chapters.title: Chapter 603: I’ll Give You A Day Time
chapters.content:
Chapter 603: I’ll Give You A Day Time
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation | Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
“Since you believe in me, then there’s no problem. Tomorrow, I will have someone transfer the money to your account.” Connor said with a smile.
“Grandpa, I think Connor is not joking. Just give him a chance!” Yana turned to Victor and said.
Victor hesitated for two seconds while sitting on the sofa. He thought Connor’s words made sense. After all, even if Connor couldn’t come up with that much money, it wouldn’t cause any harm.
So Victor nodded and said, “Alright, I’ll give you one day. If you can transfer the money tomorrow, I won’t force Yana to marry Terrance, and I won’t interfere in your affairs anymore!”
“Okay, since you’ve said that, then I have no problem. I’ll take my leave now.” Connor replied casually, then turned around and walked towards the outside of the villa.
After hesitating for two seconds, Yana hurriedly followed Connor out of the villa.
Now, only Jacob and Victor remained in the villa.
Seeing Yana leave, Jacob quickly walked to Victor’s side and whispered, “Father, how can you believe what Connor said?”
“I think this Connor is just a swindler. How could he gather so much money in such a short time? Even the richest person in Borealis City wouldn’t be able to come up with such a large sum so easily, let alone him.”
“I know this kid is bragging, but if I don’t agree now, Yana won’t give up. It’s better for me to agree to them first. When this kid fails to produce the money tomorrow, she should give up too.” Victor said in a low voice.
“I see…”
Jacob nodded lightly and didn’t say anything further.
“But what if this kid can actually produce the money?” Jacob couldn’t help but ask.
“If he can really produce the money, that would be even better. I don’t like having too much contact with the Yates family myself. But I have no choice for now, so I have to do this.”
Victor sighed lightly.
Jacob hesitated for a moment and remained silent.
“Of course, we can’t put all our hopes on this kid. Tomorrow, Terrance will probably invite Yana for a meal. Tell her to attend the dinner.”
Victor added.
“I understand…”
Jacob nodded quickly in response.
On the other side, after Yana saw Connor off, Lana hurriedly approached and asked in an excited tone, “How did it go, Yana? Did your father and grandfather believe it?”
“My father and grandfather didn’t doubt Connor’s identity too much, but they still don’t agree with us being together, unless…”
After hesitating for a moment, Yana didn’t finish her sentence.
“Unless what?” Lana quickly asked.
“Forget it..”
Yana waved her hand lightly and then turned to Connor, asking in a low voice, “Connor, can you really gather that amount of money?”
“It seems you still don’t trust me.” Connor said with a smile.
“I don’t distrust you, I just have some concerns…” She hesitated for a moment and whispered to him.
Connor reached out and gently patted Yana’s shoulder, then said lightly, “Don’t worry, since I’ve already promised you, I can definitely come up with that money. Just wait for my good news tomorrow!”
“Alright then!”
Yana agreed, then hailed a taxi and softly said, “It’s getting late. You two should go back and rest.”
“Yana, is there really nothing wrong?” Lana seemed a little worried and asked with a furrowed brow.
“This is my home. How can there be anything wrong?” Yana smiled helplessly and opened the car door, sending Connor and Lana off.
After watching them leave, she couldn’t help but sigh and turned towards the direction of the villa.
At this point, it seemed that she could only place her hopes on Connor. If he could really come up with that money, it would be the best outcome.
But if he couldn’t produce the money, she had no other options.
A moment later, Yana returned to the villa.
Upon entering the villa, she noticed that Jaob had already left.
Only Victor sat alone on the sofa, watching TV.
“Grandfather, it’s so late. Wiry aren’t you going to bed?” Yana asked Victor in a somewhat fearful tone.
“So, that kid has left?” Victor turned his head and glanced at Yana, asking expressionlessly.
“Yes, Connor has already left!” Yana nodded lightly.
“Is he really your boyfriend?” Victor asked in a low voice.
“Of course he is!” Yana didn’t hesitate at all and replied directly.
Victor sighed helplessly and then said, “Well, tomorrow at noon, Terrance should invite you out for a meal. Dress up nicely and go out to have a meal with him, alright?”
Upon hearing his words, she was stunned in place, her expression filled with disbelief.
She couldn’t help but furrow her brow and exclaim, “Grandfather, didn’t you already agree to give Connor a chance? Didn’t he also say he would give you the money? Why are you still asking me to meet with Terrance?”
“Yana, I’ve already explained our family’s situation to you just now. If you don’t be with Terrance, our family could face the risk of bankruptcy at any time. As for your friend Connor, you don’t really believe he can come up with five billion, do you?”
“Five billion in cash is not a small sum. In the entire Oprana, there are only a few people who can come up with that money!”
Victor earnestly explained.
“But we’ve just agreed a moment ago. Why are you still asking me to meet with Terrance?” Yana furrowed her brow, looking puzzled.
“Wiry?”
“Do you think that Connor looks like a wealthy person? The reason he said all that earlier was just to save face. He doesn’t want to embarrass himself in front of you, so he said those things!”
“I doubt you’ll ever see him again tomorrow. He doesn’t have the face to meet you…”
Victor lit a cigarette, then looked at Yana and asked, “By the way, he’s probably not from here, right?”

chapters.title: Chapter 604: Acquiring the Weaver Corporation
chapters.content:
Chapter 604: Acquiring the Weaver Corporation
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation | Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
“No…”
Yana shook her head gently.
Victor continued, “I estimate that he will probably leave Borealis City tomorrow, so don’t have too much hope for him.”
“Of course, if this guy can really come up with the money tomorrow, that would naturally be the best outcome, but I think the probability of that is not very high…”
In his eyes, what Connor said just now was nothing more than a bluff.
After all, five billion is not the same as five hundred dollars. Not everyone can come up with that kind of money.
He could already imagine that as soon as Connor leaves the villa, he will immediately turn off his phone and leave Borealis City by car.
“I don’t think Connor is that kind of person…” Yana whispered.
“Connor isn’t that kind of person?”
Victor sneered and then asked indifferently, “How long have you known each other? Do you really understand him? What does his family do? Do you know all of this?”
“He is Thomas’s driver…” Yana replied softly.
“So what if he’s Thomas’ driver? Even if it’s Thomas himself, he may not be able to come up with that kind of money. I know all the wealthy people in Davenport, and there are only a few who would be willing to help me with this money. Even the banks are unwilling to lend us.”
“If Connor really has money, it means he’s not an idiot. How could he come up with that amount of money to buy 50% of Weaver Corporation’s shares? Our family’s company is not worth that price.”
Victor analyzed calmly.
After hearing these words, a look of despair appeared on Yana’s face.
Because she knew that if Connor didn’t come up with the money tomorrow, she would still be unable to escape the fate of marrying Terrance.
She had only known him for less than a day, and she didn’t know much about him.
She didn’t even know what his family did. She felt confused to put her hope on someone like him.
But for some reason, there was always a voice in Yana’s heart telling her that she could trust Connor.
“What’s wrong? Do you still have hope for Connor?” Victor asked her in a low voice.
She looked up at him but didn’t say anything.
“If you still have hope for Connor, then let me tell you the simplest way. Just give him a call. If his phone is not switched off, there might still be a glimmer of hope. But if his phone is off, then it means he has definitely run away!” Victor said in a low voice to Yana.
Yana took a deep breath and took out her phone.
Although she really wanted to call Connor to confirm, she didn’t have the courage because she was afraid that his phone would be switched off.
If he had indeed turned off his phone, then her last hope would be shattered. In that case, she would rather hold onto a thread of fantasy.
She didn’t have much hope for this matter to begin with.
She sighed softly and said expressionlessly, “Let it go.”
After saying this, Yana turned and left.
After parting ways with Yana, Connor took a taxi directly back to the hotel.
After entering the room, he took out his phone and dialed Thomas’s number.
Although he had money, he thought it would be better for Thomas to handle this kind of thing.
“Ring ring!”
After two rings, Thomas answered the phone and asked softly, “Mr. Connor, what’s the matter?”
“I need five billion funds to acquire a company…” Connor said straightforwardly without any nonsense.
“Five billion funds?”
After hearing this number, Thomas couldn’t help but pause, his expression showing great astonishment.
He quickly asked, “Mr. Connor, why do you suddenly need so much capital? Have you encountered any trouble?”
“I want to acquire a company’s shares. Just transfer the money tomorrow morning at 8 o’clock!” Connor replied expressionlessly.
“You want to acquire a company?”
Upon hearing this, Thomas was stunned.
“That’s right…”
Connor answered directly without hesitation.
After hearing his words, Thomas remained silent for two seconds.
He knew very well that Connor needed this money, and it definitely wasn’t for his own use.
After all, if Connor wanted to buy something, he could easily use his own bank card since his card had no limit.
This meant that Connor was preparing this money for someone else.
For Connor, this amount of money was insignificant, but Thomas was worried that he might be deceived.
So he continued, “Mr. Connor, can I ask you another question? Which company do you plan to acquire? I don’t mean anything else, I’m just worried that you might be deceived. If I investigate it for you, we can have a better understanding of the company’s situation!”
Although Thomas knew that Connor didn’t lack money, he also didn’t want him to spend it recklessly.
After all, in the future, Connor would be the one to manage the entire Empire World Corporation.
And Connor felt that Thomas had no malicious intent, plus there was no need to hide this matter.
So he said directly, “The company I want to acquire is Weaver Corporation in Borealis City. I’m planning to buy 50% of their shares for five billion!”
“Weaver Corporation in Borealis City?”
After hearing Connor’s words, Thomas couldn’t help but pause, a hint of doubt flashing in his eyes.
“Is the chairman of this Weaver Corporation named Victor?” Thomas asked further.
“Yes, it’s Victor!” Connor answered without hesitation.
“Oh, it’s Victor!”
Thomas replied with a smile, then continued, “I know Victor as well. We had dinner together before. But I heard that their Weaver Corporation has recently encountered some big troubles. He’s indeed in urgent need of money, but if we go to acquire his company now, we probably won’t need that much money. His company’s situation might be on the verge of bankruptcy at any time!”
At this moment, Thomas hadn’t figured out the situation yet. He thought that Connor needed this money for investment purposes.
Although Weaver Corporation was in Borealis City while Empire World Corporation’s business spanned the entire Davenport, Thomas still had a good understanding of the Wang family’s situation.
“I know that I don’t need that much money to acquire his company, but Victor’s granddaughter is my friend, so I want to help them!” Connor didn’t hide anything from Thomas and answered directly.

chapters.title: Chapter 605: Regency Club
chapters.content:
Chapter 605: Regency Club
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation | Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
“Oh, so that’s how it is!”
Thomas smiled faintly, finally understanding what was going on. He continued, “Mr. Connor, don’t worry. I will transfer the money to Victor tomorrow. Our company has had financial transactions with their company, and I know their account number.”
“That’s very kind of you!”
Connor nodded gently and continued to ask, “Earlier, I heard you mention that Weaver’s family seemed to have encountered some big trouble. 1 wonder what kind of trouble it is?”
“Well, the trouble they encountered isn’t too significant. From what I understand, it seems that the Yates family in Borealis City wanted to cause trouble with the Weaver family. They used their connections to create a significant financial problem for one of Weaver’s projects.”
“Furthermore, the Yates family prevented the other prominent families in Borealis City from helping Wang’s family. These people fear the power of the Yates family and naturally wouldn’t lend their money to Victor, which caused a rupture in Weaver Corporation financial chain!”
“Do you know why the Yates family wants to target Weaver family?”
Connor asked in a low voice.
“Well, I’m not entirely sure about that. After all, I haven’t been involved in such matters…”
Thomas chuckled.
After listening to his explanation, Connor instantly understood what was going on. It was simply that Terrance took a liking to Yana, but she didn’t want to marry him. So he came up with this plan.
First, he created financial problems for Weaver Corporation and then united the other families in Borealis City to deny lending money to Victor. This left Victor with only one option to save his family’s company, which was to let Yana marry Terrance.
At that time, the instigator of all this, the Yates family, would come forward to help Weaver family solve this big trouble.
“So, it was all a scheme orchestrated by the Yates family!”
Connor smiled playfully and then said in a low voice, “Alright then, if there’s nothing else, I’ll hang up now. Just remember to transfer the money to Victor tomorrow!”
“Alright, Mr. Connor…”
Thomas nodded gently, and just as Connor was about to hang up, Thomas suddenly remembered something and hurriedly asked, “Mr. Connor, Victor has been applying to join our Regency Club. However, the Yates family has been obstructing him. So, Victor hasn’t become a member of the club. If he has any connection with you, I can help him enter the Regency Club through a backdoor.”
“The Regency Club?”
Upon hearing these words, Connor was momentarily stunned, with a hint of confusion in his eyes.
He couldn’t help but ask in a low voice, “What is this Regency Club you’re talking about?”
“Mr. Connor, do you remember when you signed the inheritance contract, I gave you a membership card for the Regency Club?”
Thomas quickly asked.
“I vaguely remember…”
After hearing Thomas’s words, Connor suddenly recalled that Thomas did give him a membership card.
However, Connor had never visited that club.
“That membership card is for the Regency Club. Initially, it was called the Oprana Regency Club. The club was founded by the former chairman and a few of his friends. Now, the club has branches all over the country, with almost every city having an Regency Club!”
Thomas explained slowly.
“Nothing more than a club, is it really such a big deal for Victor to become a member?” Connor pondered for a moment and said softly.
“Mr. Connor, if that’s what you think, then you’re wrong!”
“If you think the Regency Club is just a profit-driven organization, you’re mistaken. It’s more like a symbol of status. Generally, only influential figures in our country can join the Regency Club. The membership requires a strict screening process. Victor’s status is far from qualifying to become a member of the Regency Club!”
Thomas quickly responded.
“What are the membership requirements then?”
Upon hearing Thomas’s words, Connor couldn’t help but look puzzled. He had no knowledge of the Regency Club at all. If it weren’t for Thomas mentioning it, Connor wouldn’t have known about the existence of this club.
“The requirements to join this club?”
Thomas paused for a moment.
“Yes!”
Connor nodded gently.
“The minimum requirement to join this club is to have a net worth of over a hundred billion and be a prominent figure with certain connections and background. Once you become a member of the Regency Club, no matter what troubles you encounter in the future, other club members will assist you.”
“Of course, if other members encounter trouble, you also need to lend a helping hand. This is the purpose of establishing the Regency Club. Additionally, members are required to pay an annual fee of tens of millions. For the wealthy individuals in Davenport, this amount is negligible, but the economic benefits that the Regency Club can bring to them are tremendous!”
Thomas paused for a moment, then continued, “The reason why the Yates family dares to confront the Wang family is because Victor is not a member of the Regency Club. That’s why they can act so recklessly. If Victor were a member of the Regency Club, even if the Yates family had the courage, they wouldn’t dare to bully the Weaver family!”
“I didn’t expect the Regency Club to have such great influence…”
Connor nodded gently.
“The Regency Club was founded by the former chairman himself. Its purpose is to facilitate communication and cooperation among the businessmen in our Davenport.”
“And the former chairman himself is one of the shareholders of the Regency Club. Now that you have inherited the shares from the former chairman, we have club staff in every city. In Porthampton, it is mainly managed by Kyle, while in Beihai City, a person named Jericho Watson is in charge.”
“If your relationship with the Weaver family is good, I can have Jericho agree to Victor’s membership application tomorrow.”
Thomas said in a low voice.
Holding his phone, Connor’s expression seemed hesitant.
“Once Victor becomes a member of Regency Club, if he encounters any trouble in the future, he can directly contact the club for assistance…”
Thomas thought that since Connor could help the Weaver family, it meant that Connor and Yanna’s relationship was definitely not ordinary. Issuing a membership card was not a big deal, so he might as well do a favor.
But after hearing Thomas’s words, he hesitated for two seconds.
He felt that it was a kind of fate to get to know Yana, and in the future, if the Weaver family encountered any trouble, Yana would definitely come to him for help.
After all, he had pretended to be Wang Yaxuan’s boyfriend before, and now he asked Thomas to transfer money. It was as good as revealing his identity.
So instead of letting the Weaver family trouble him, it would be better to directly help Victor. This way, he wouldn’t have to be bothered in the future.
Therefore, Connor simply said, “Alright, then let Victor become a member of the Regency Club tomorrow…”
“Alright, Mr. Connor!”
After hearing his words, Thomas quickly agreed.
“Thank you.”
Connor nodded gently, then hung up the phone..

chapters.title: Chapter 606: A Call from Connor
chapters.content:
Chapter 606: A Call from Connor
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation | Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
After hanging up the phone, Connor went to the bathroom to wash up, then lay on the bed and closed his eyes to rest.
After being tormented for an entire day, Connor was already extremely exhausted.
As for the matters of the Weaver family, in Connor’s eyes, it was not a big deal at all; as long as Thomas Morgan transferred the money over tomorrow and let Victor join the Regency Club, Connor would not need to care about the matter anymore…
The next day.
8 AM.
Yana was wearing a short striped shirt and a pair of black high heels as she gracefully walked out of the room.
It had to be said that Yana was indeed very charming at this moment. The striped shirt wrapped tightly around her full chest. She was wearing a pair of tight denim pants, which clung to her hips tightly. Her curves were beautiful and seductive.
Further down was a pair of slender and fair legs. She looked very sexy and charming.
It was no wonder that Terence had spent so much effort to get Yana.
Victor, who was originally sitting on the sofa and waiting anxiously, saw Yana, and a trace of relief flashed across his eyes.
He knew very well that the reason why Yana was dressed up so beautifully today was probably because she was preparing to go on a date with Terence. However, when Victor saw Yana’s slightly sad expression, he felt a little sorry for Yana.
After all, no matter who encountered such a thing, they would be unhappy.
But there was no other way. In order to save the Wang Corporation, Victor could only choose to sacrifice Yana.
Victor walked up to Yana and said softly to her, “Yana, I know that you’ve suffered in this matter. I’ll definitely try my best to compensate you in the future!”
“Compensate me?” After Yana heard this, she couldn’t help but laugh. Then, she said in a low voice, “Things have already come to this. What compensation do you have? I only hope that our Weaver family can recover as soon as possible…” “Grandfather knows that everything you’ve done is for our Weaver family…”
Victor nodded lightly.
Yana looked at Victor and hesitated for a moment before saying in a low voice, “Grandpa, I can agree to marry Terence, but 1 have one condition…”
“If you have any conditions, just say it. As long as it’s something that grandfather can do, I will definitely do my best…”
Victor said without even thinking.
“The first condition is that I hope my father can get 10% of our family’s shares. This is my parents’livelihood guarantee in the future!”
Jacob Weaver was not valued in the Weaver family, so Yana wanted to help her parents fight for something.
“No problem. I agree to this condition…”
Victor nodded.
“The second condition is that if I find out that Terence is cheating after I marry him, I will definitely choose to divorce him! At that time, 1 hope you won’t stop me!”
Yana’s tone was firm. This might be her bottom line.
When Victor heard this, he sighed helplessly and said in a low voice,” Yana, don’t worry. As long as our Weaver family can get through this period of time, I guarantee that Terence will never dare to bully you. If he really does something wrong to you, I will definitely back you up…”
“Alright, then I hope that grandfather will remember what you said today…” Yana said softly.
“Don’t worry, Grandpa definitely won’t lie to you!”
Victor replied very seriously.
After Yana saw that Victor had agreed to her conditions, she sighed softly and sat quietly on the sofa, waiting for Terence’s arrival.
At this moment, Yana no longer had any hope for Connor.
It was almost nine o’clock, but Connor still hadn’t called her. This was enough to prove that Connor might have already left Borealis City.
“Miss…”
At this moment, a bodyguard rushed into the villa and greeted Yana respectfully.
Yana looked up at the bodyguard and asked softly, “Is there anything?”
“Just now, Mr. Yates called and said that he had already asked the driver to pick you up. The driver is waiting outside now!” the bodyguard said in a low voice.
When Yana heard this, she couldn’t help but be stunned for a moment. Then, she turned her head and glanced at Victor.
“Yana, get in the car…” Victor waved his hand lightly.
Yana took a deep breath and walked out of the villa.
“Ding, ding, ding!”
However, at this moment, Yana’s phone suddenly rang.
Yana couldn’t help but be stunned when she heard the ringtone. Then, she quickly took out her phone from her bag.
When Yana saw the number on the phone, she was stunned on the spot. The expression on her face was very incredulous.
However, Victor did not notice the expression on Yana’s face. He could not help but ask Yana, “Yana, why aren’t you leaving?”
Yana looked at the phone in her hand, and her heart was filled with mixed feelings.
Because the person who called Yana was none other than Connor.
Yana did not expect Connor to call her at this time. She thought that he should have left Borealis City a long time ago!
But he had taken the initiative to contact her.
That meant that Connor might not have lied to her!
Yana’s breathing began to quicken. She hurriedly turned around and said to Victor, “Grandpa, Connor called me!”
“What did you say?”
After Victor heard Yana’s words, his expression began to turn shocked, and his eyes were filled with disbelief.
“This is Connor’s number. He actually called me…”
Yana repeated excitedly.
Victor frowned slightly. He did not expect Connor to take the initiative to contact Yana.
He even felt that Connor was definitely planning to lie to Yana or find an excuse to say that he couldn’t gather the money.
Thinking of this, Victor’s face revealed a disdainful smile.
He then said to Yana, “Since he called you, you should answer it. 1 want to see what this kid is up to today.”
Yana held her phone, her expression a little conflicted; she didn’t know if she should answer the call.
If she picked up the phone, she was worried that Connor would have an excuse to avoid this matter. In that case, her good impression of him would disappear.
Connor’s previous words had actually touched Yana.
But if she didn’t answer the call, Yana was worried that she would miss something important..

chapters.title: Chapter 607: I’ve Already Transferred the Money
chapters.content:
Chapter 607: I’ve Already Transferred the Money
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation | Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
After hesitating for a while, Yana finally chose to answer the call!
“Hello?”
She asked softly.
“Yana, I’ve already transferred the money. It should show up on your account in two hours! Tell your grandfather to take heed. Also, I’m preparing to return to Porthampton now. When I have time in the future, I will come to Borealis City to sign the share transfer contract with your grandfather.”
Connor had already left the hotel and followed Carlos Lane to the bus terminal by now.
You actually transferred the money over?”
After hearing Connor’s words, Yana shouted with an extremely shocked expression.
“I promised to help you back then, so I will definitely help you. Just ask your grandfather to look at the company’s account…” Connor said calmly.
“Connor, are you joking with me?”
Until now, Yana still couldn’t believe that Connor could actually take out this money!
“Are you joking?”
Connor couldn’t help but be stunned when he heard this. Then, he smiled and said, “It’s already like this, so why would I joke with you? What I said is true. I’ve already gotten someone to transfer the money. You don’t have to worry…” “But where did you get so much money?”
Yana asked softly.
”I’m already very rich!” Connor replied with a smile and then continued, “Alright, you don’t have to worry about these things. Just wait for the money to be collected…”
‘Alright…” Yana stuttered before hanging up.
After hanging up the phone, Yana’s expression was extremely shocked. At this time, she was completely bamboozled by Connor.
Last night, Yana actually still trusted Connor very much because she felt that his tone did not seem like he was joking.
However, when Yana heard what Victor said to her, she felt that she was really a little naive. It was impossible for Connor to take out so much money, so Yana dispelled her last hope for him.
However, she never expected that Connor would take the initiative to call and say that the money had been transferred. This made Yana a little unsure of what to do.
Victor did not know what Connor said on the phone at all. The expression on his face was very disdainful.
He looked at Yana and asked, “How is it?” Yana, is he looking for an excuse to tell you that he can’t take out the money? I told you long ago that Connor is a liar…”
“No… No, that’s not it, Grandpa…”
Yana hurriedly shouted, then said to Victor with a trembling voice, “Grandpa, Connor called me just now and said that he had already asked someone to transfer the money to our company’s account. However, because the amount of money is relatively large, it will take two hours for it to arrive. He didn’t say that he couldn’t take out the money…”
After Victor heard Yana’s words, he was instantly stunned on the spot. With an extremely shocked expression, he said, “Ya… Yana, are you kidding me? That kid actually transferred the money over?”
“Of course. Connor also said that he would come over to sign the contract with you when he has time in the future…”
Yana hurriedly nodded.
“No, this is impossible! How can this Connor have so much money? Did you find an excuse to lie to me because you didn’t want to go on a date with Terence?”
Victor asked in a low voice.
“Grandpa, things are already like this. Why should I lie to you? Moreover, Connor’s tone just now did not seem to be joking. He asked you to look at our company’s account…”
Yana shouted helplessly.
“This…”
Victor stood on the spot with a dumbfounded expression. For a moment, he actually did not know what to say. He had never thought that Connor would actually be able to take out this sum of money!
“Could it be that Connor is really a rich heir? Isn’t he Thomas Morgan’s driver? How can a small driver withdraw so much money? Or is he not Thomas Morgan’s driver at all?”
At this moment, Victor had many questions in his heart. However, these questions could only be answered after the money was transferred.
“Yana, we can’t completely trust this kid now. I’ll call the finance department now and ask them to look at whether the money has been transferred to the account…”
Victor tried his best to remain calm. Then, he took out his phone and called the company’s finance department.
“President Weaver, what’s wrong?” The finance department asked in a low voice.
“Pay attention to the company accounts now. See if our company has 500 million dollars in cash transferred over…” Victor held his phone and said in a low voice.
Okay, President Weaver,” the other party quickly replied.
Victor took a deep breath and slowly put down his phone.
“Grandpa, what should we do now?” Yana asked Victor excitedly.
After hearing Yana’s words, Victor frowned and said in a low voice, “How can I do anything? We can only wait for the money to come now and see whether
Connor was truthful in transferring the money over.”
Yana hesitated for a moment before sitting down on the sofa and waiting anxiously.
At this moment, the two of them were very nervous because they were not sure if Connor had really transferred the money. Before they saw the money actually show up in their accounts, anything could happen.
In Victor’s eyes, perhaps this phone call was just a joke from Connor.
The two of them sat on the sofa and waited for about ten minutes before the bodyguard walked into the hall again.
Then, he whispered to Victor and Yana, “President Weaver, Miss, Mr. Yates’s driver has been waiting outside for a long time. Mr. Yates is also constantly urging you to leave. Miss Weaver, when can you leave?”
Victor hesitated for a moment, then turned to look at Yana and said in a low voice, “Yana, why don’t you go out first? I’ll wait here. If there’s any news, I’ll call you immediately…”
“I don’t want to go. I want to wait here…” Yana replied without thinking.
If Connor could really fork out this sum of money, she wouldn’t want to go on a date with someone like Terence!
Victor also knew that everything was unknown now, so he did not dare to force Yana to go on a date with Terence.
Therefore, he said to the bodyguard with a helpless expression, “Well, you can ask Mr. Yates’s driver to go back first. Tell him that Yana is not feeling well and will come to pick her up in the afternoon…”
“Isn’t this a little inappropriate?”
When the bodyguard heard this, he said with a troubled expression.
“It’s fine. Just do as I say…”
Victor thought for a moment and waved his hand at the bodyguard.
The bodyguard did not say anything else and turned to leave.

chapters.title: Chapter 608: 500 Million Dollars Received!
chapters.content:
Chapter 608: 500 Million Dollars Received!
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation | Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
After the bodyguard left.
Yana and Victor sat in the hall and waited anxiously.
At this moment, Yana’s expression was very nervous, and her hands were
tightly clenched together.
Because she didn’t know if Connor’s phone call just now was a joke or if it really happened.
Time passed, but Victor’s phone did not respond.
Yana also began to panic. She asked Victor in a low voice, “Grandpa, do you think Connor can really take out 500 million dollars in cash?”
When Victor heard this, he couldn’t help but sigh. Then, he said expressionlessly, “If my guesses are correct, this kid definitely won’t take out so much money. Even if he really has that much money, he definitely won’t use it to buy 50% of our company’s shares. Because our company has become a hot potato now, many regulatory bodies have imposed restrictions on our company.”
In fact, Victor had already thought it through. Connor was just bluffing yesterday and did not have the ability to solve this matter at all.
He felt that if Connor was a smart person, he would have disappeared by today. However, no one expected him to actually contact Yana. This made Victor start to suspect that he had misunderstood Connor.
Victor suddenly turned his head and asked, “Yana, haven’t you been with Connor for two years? Then you should be very knowledgeable about his financial situation, right? Don’t you know in your heart whether he can take out so much money?”
“That…”
After Yana heard this, a hint of helplessness flashed across her eyes.
After all, Connor was not her boyfriend at all. She had only known Connor for a
day.
Other than knowing that Connor was Thomas Morgan’s driver, she knew nothing about him. She still had a glimmer of hope in her heart because she felt that his background was extraordinary. In addition, Carlos respected Connor very much, which made her suspect that Connor might not just be Thomas Morgan’s driver. Perhaps Connor had some other relationship with Thomas.
Since Connor dared to say such words, what if he was Thomas’s son?
If that was the case, then this matter might be much simpler.
However, Yana didn’t know how to answer Victor’s question. She didn’t dare to tell Victor the actual situation.
Because if Victor knew the truth, he would definitely be so angry that he would cough up blood.
“Yana, don’t you know Connor?” Victor couldn’t help but ask in a low voice when he saw that Yana hadn’t said anything.
“Actually, I’m not very sure either…”
Yana shook her head helplessly.
“You’re such a child.” Victor looked at Yana and sighed helplessly. For a moment, he didn’t know what to say. Now, he could only wait here.
In the blink of an eye, an hour passed.
However, the people at the company never called Victor, and he finally lost his patience. He stood up and said to Yana, “This Connor is a scammer. He didn’t transfer the money at all. There’s no way for it to take so long. I’ll call Terence nowand ask him to get someone to pick you up!”
“Grandpa, let’s wait a little longer!” Yana seemed to be unwilling to give up and shouted.
“It’s already so late. What’s there to wait for? Tell me!” Victor shouted without thinking.
When Yana heard this, she instinctively raised her head and looked at Victor. A trace of despair flashed across her eyes.
She opened her mouth to speak, but she did not know what reason she should use to convince Victor.
In the end, Yana could only shut her mouth and nod her head lightly. She said expressionlessly, “Grandpa, please call Terence!”
“Good!”
Victor agreed, then picked up the phone in the living room and prepared to call
Terence.
“Ding, ding, ding!”
However, at this moment, Victor’s phone suddenly rang.
When Victor saw the name on the phone, he couldn’t help but be stunned for a moment. Then, he hurriedly pressed the answer button and asked excitedly, “Has the money been transferred to the account?”
“That’s right, President Weaver. There was indeed a sum of 500 million dollars transferred to our company’s account just now!” the other party hurriedly replied.
When Victor heard this, he was instantly stunned on the spot. The expression on his face was very incredulous.
He was stunned for a moment before asking, “Are you sure that the money has been transferred to your account?”
“Yes, President Weaver, I’m sure the money has been transferred!” the finance department replied affirmatively.
When Victor heard this, his body trembled slightly and he almost fainted.
Victor held his phone and did not speak for a long time.
He never dreamed that Connor would be able to gather this sum of money!
Taking out 500 million in cash in one go meant that Connor was definitely not an ordinary person!
“Grandpa, what1 s wrong?1 ‘
Yana hurriedly stepped forward and asked when she saw his expression.
Victor slowly put down his phone and said to Yana with a trembling voice, “Yana, the company’s finance department called me just now…
“What did they say?” Yana asked excitedly.
“They said that the money has arrived, and that Connor really transferred the money over! Our Weaver family is finally saved!” Victor shouted excitedly.
“Connor actually transferred the money over?”
Yana looked at Victor with a shocked expression. She was so excited that she couldn’t speak.
She felt like she was dreaming. It was unbelievable!
“Could it be that Connor is really a rich heir? Otherwise, where could he have gotten so much money?” Yana could not help but think.
However, Victor was not in the mood to think about these questions. He hurriedly said in a low voice, “Yana, you have saved the Weaver family this time. I’m really sorry-I used to look down on that Connor guy, but I didn’t expect him to really be a rich heir!”
Yana sat on the sofa, her eyes filled with shock. She didn’t even know how to describe her feelings!
After all, she had been suspicious of Connor from the beginning. Back then, Yana had asked him to come over just to make him pretend to be her boyfriend. However, no one expected Connor to solve such a big problem!
Taking out 500 million in one go was definitely not something an ordinary person could do!

chapters.title: Chapter 609: Terence Yates’s Arrival
chapters.content:
Chapter 609: Terence Yates’s Arrival
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation | Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
“Yana, since the money has been transferred to my account, I have to return to the company immediately or the company will definitely be in chaos!”
After answering the call from the finance department, Victor only had one thought in his mind, which was to hurry back to the company and restart the project. Their company’s projects had been put on hold for a long time because of funding problems.
Now that he finally had money, what he wanted to do the most was to resume the projects as soon as possible and get the company up and running.
“Okay, Grandpa, hurry up!” Yana hurriedly replied.
Victor rushed out of the villa.
However, at this moment, the bodyguard outside the door suddenly ran in and shouted excitedly at Victor, “Mr. Weaver, Mr. Yates is here!”
When Victor heard this, his expression immediately darkened. He hurriedly asked, “Wiry is he here?”
“Just now, after the driver went back, he told Mr. Yates about Miss Weaver’s condition. After he found out, he hurriedly drove over…”
The bodyguard hurriedly replied.
“Then I will go and welcome Mr. Yates now…” Victor said in a low voice.
“Grandpa, hasn’t our family’s problem been solved? You also promised Connor that as long as he could take out this money, you wouldn’t let me marry Terence. Then why do you still want to see him now? I don’t want to see this person again…”
Yana shouted at Victor, her eyes watery.
Victor thought for a moment and said softly, “Yana, why are you so short-sighted? Our family’s problem has indeed been solved, but no matter what, the Yates family is still a big family in Borealis City. Even if you don’t want to marry Terence, I have to make things clear to him. I can’t let him misunderstand!”
Yana was stunned for a moment and asked, “Then you plan to go out and reject Terence, right?”
“That’s right. Now that our company’s financial problems have been solved, there’s no need for me to let you marry Terence, so I’m going to explain this matter to him in front of you!”
Victor nodded lightly.
When Yana heard this, a flash of excitement flashed across her eyes. She hurriedly said, “That’s great. Hurry up and let Terence in!”
Hearing Yana’s words, the bodyguard hurriedly turned around and left.
Not long after, a man in a white suit hurriedly ran into the hall under the lead of a bodyguard.
“Grandpa Weaver, I heard that Yana is sick, so I came over to take a look.” He shouted as he ran.
However, before he could finish his sentence, he saw Yana sitting on the sofa, dressed up in a youthful and beautiful manner.
When the man saw Yana, he was instantly dumbfounded. He did not understand what was going on.
After all, he had just received the news that Yana had suddenly fallen ill, so she couldn’t go on a date with him.
But looking at Yana’s current appearance, she didn’t look sick at all!
“Mr. Yates, you’re here?”
Victor walked up to Terence with a smile.
Terence was not in the mood to bother with Victor. He directly asked Yana, “Yana, didn’t they say you were sick? Why do you look like nothing has happened to you?”
Yana raised her head and glanced at Terence, then said with a cold expression, “Who told you that I was sick?”
“My driver said so…” Terence replied without thinking.
“I said I was sick because I didn’t want to go on a date with you. Actually, I’m not sick at all!”
Yana knew that she didn’t need to marry Terence anymore, so she was very direct and didn’t hold back at all.
“You don’t want to go on a date with me?”
When Terence heard this, a strange look flashed in his eyes. “Grandpa Weaver, what’s going on? Didn’t we already agree?” he asked Victor coldly. Our Yates family will help your Weaver family tide over this crisis, but the condition is that Yana must marry me. What does Yana mean by these words?”
“Mr. Yates, don’t be so agitated. Sit down first, let me explain things to you clearly…”
Victor laughed and replied, then directly pulled Terence to sit on the sofa.
At this time, Terence’s expression was very ugly. After all, he had been planning for so long to get Yana, including using all the connections in his family to cause problems for the Weaver family’s company. He also made the bosses in Borealis City unwilling to lend Victor money.
He had finally achieved his goal, but he had never expected that Yana would still be unwilling to marry him.
“Could it be that Yana is planning to watch the Weaver family fall apart? It shouldn’t be…”
Terence sighed in his heart.
Victor poured a glass of water for Terence.
However, Terence wasn’t in the mood to drink at this time. He frowned and asked, “Grandpa Weaver, what is going on?”
Victor smiled helplessly and said softly, “Mr. Yates, it’s actually like this. Yana did agree to marry you last night, but I never thought that our Weaver family would actually borrow money, so we don’t need your Yates family’s help now. As for the marriage between the two of you, Yana has always resisted it, so it naturally can’t be counted now…”
“You guys have already borrowed the money?”
Terence frowned.
“That’s right. We’ve already borrowed this money, and it hasn’t been long since we received it…” Yana said proudly.
“Impossible. Who in Davenport would dare to lend you money?”
Terence’s eyes flashed with anger as he shouted coldly.
“Terence, don’t think that our Weaver family is stupid. Isn’t the Yates family the reason why so many big bosses are unwilling to lend us money? Isn’t it because your Yates family is playing tricks behind our backs?”
“But no one is afraid of the Yates family, and the person who lent my grandfather money is my boyfriend, so I advise you to quickly dispel the idea of marrying me. I will never be with someone like you in my life!”
Yana shouted at Terence expressionlessly.
“Did your boyfriend lend you the money?”
After Terence heard this, he couldn’t help but sneer. Then, he said with a ferocious expression, “Oh Yana, I didn’t expect you to really find a rich boyfriend. I really didn’t expect this.”
During this period of time, Terence contacted all the billionaires in Davenport and used his family’s connections to stop them from lending money to the Weaver family.
This also led Victor to ask for help from the Yates family. Terence did not expect that someone else would still lend Victor money.
“What does it have to do with you whether I can find a boyfriend or not? I hope you won’t harass me again in the future. My relationship with my boyfriend is very good. The two of us will get married soon…”
Yana said coldly to Terence.
“Hahaha…”
After Terence heard Yana’s words, not only did he not get angry, he even laughed out loud.

chapters.title: Chapter 610: I’ll Give You Two Choices
chapters.content:
Chapter 610: I’ll Give You Two Choices
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
“What are you laughing at?”
Yana was stunned for a moment, a puzzled expression on her face.
“Yana, I think you are celebrating too early…” Terence replied with a playful tone.
When Yana heard this, she couldn’t help but be stunned for a moment. Then, she asked Terence with a puzzled expression, “What do you mean by that?” Alright, since things have already come to this, I won’t hide anything from you. If there’s anything I want to say, I’ll just tell you directly…”
Terence lit a cigarette arrogantly, then looked at Yana and said, “Yana, actually, I planned all of this myself. Whether it was the Weaver family’s company’s problems or the Weaver family’s inability to borrow money, I used the Yates family’s connections to get you to where you are today. But I don’t have any ill intentions. I only have one goal, and that is to marry you…”
After Yana and Victor heard Terence’s words, their expressions morphed into ones of anger. Although they had long guessed that this matter was definitely related to the Yates family, they had never expected Terence to admit it directly.
It was obvious that he did not think of the Weaver family at all!
You’re really too shameless…” Yana’s big, watery eyes widened as she shouted excitedly at Terence.
“Shameless?” Terence smiled disdainfully and said lightly, “How am I shameless? I just want to be with you. Is that wrong? As long as you can be with me, I’m willing to do anything!”
“Terence, just give up on this idea. Even if I have to die alone in this life, I will never be with you…” Yana shouted.
“Are you sure you won’t be with me?”
Terence couldn’t help but sneer. Then, he continued, “Yana, I really like you. No matter what, I must have you. Don’t think that your Weaver family will be safe after this crisis. If you don’t marry me, I’ll use my connections to deal with your Weaver family. At that time, you can think about which family has more connections at their disposal.”
At this moment, Terence had completely lost his mind. He threatened Yana with a ferocious expression.
Victor’s eyes also flashed with a trace of shock, because knew very well that if the Yates family really wanted to deal with him, then the Weaver family would not have any strength to fight back.
Therefore, the expression on his face became nervous.
“Terence, aren’t you going a little too far?”
Yana shouted excitedly.
“How am I going too far? Don’t forget that our Yates family and your Weaver family are competitors. Previously, I didn’t make a move on your Weaver family because of you, but if you marry someone else, then don’t blame me for being heartless!”
Terence continued, “The Yates family has more connections than your Weaver family, and we’re in a better financial standing. If we want to mess with your Weaver family, it’s simply a piece of cake. So now there’s only one choice left: that is to marry me, and your Weaver family will be safe forever.”
After Victor heard Terence’s words, his expression suddenly became ugly. He gritted his teeth and whispered, “Mr. Yates, our two families don’t seem to have any grudges between each other. Isn’t this a bit too much?”
I, Terence, have never considered whether I’m going overboard when I do things. I just want to tell everyone that only I, Terence Yates, can marry Yana. No one else can. Now, I just need to make a phone call, and I can destroy your Weaver family. I can play you to death, so you’d better think carefully before making a decision!”
At this time, Terence was completely deranged and shouted arrogantly.
Yana and Victor were stunned on the spot almost at the same time, and their expressions were extremely ugly.
The two of them knew Terence’s character very well. They also knew that he was not joking. He would definitely do what he said.
Terence turned his head and said to Yana, “By the way, Yana, didn’t you say you have a boyfriend? Then call your boyfriend over now. I want to see who has the guts to snatch my woman!”
After Yana heard Terence’s words, she was stunned on the spot, and her expression was very ugly.
She frowned and shouted, “Terence, this is between the two of us. What does it have to do with my boyfriend?”
“How is it unrelated? Since this kid dared to steal iny-MY-woman, then I’ll show him my power today!” Terence replied coldly, then continued, “By the way, isn’t the Weaver family’s capital also provided by this kid? Call him over now. I want to see which rich heir dares to make things difficult for our Yates family!”
At this time, Terence’s thoughts were very simple. He felt that the reason why Yana and Victor dared to cancel the engagement was because there was someone backing them up, and this person was Yana’s boyfriend.
Therefore, Terence felt that as long as he could get rid of this boyfriend, the next step would be much simpler.
“My boyfriend has already left Borealis City. If you want to see him, you can do so in the future, but not today…” Yana naturally didn’t want Connor to come over, so she replied to Terence expressionlessly.
“Not in Borealis City? I think he doesn’t dare to come and see me, right?”
After Terence heard this, he couldn’t help but sneer. Then, he said in a very arrogant tone, “I don’t care where this kid is now. I have to see him today. If I can’t see this person today, then I won’t leave!”
After saying this, Terence directly sat down on the sofa.
Yana looked at Terence with an expression of extreme despair. She never thought that Terence would be so shameless.
If it wasn’t for Connor’s help, Yana would have married such a person. The thought alone disgusted her.
Victor finally couldn’t hold it in anymore. He took a step forward and said coldly to Terence, “Mr. Yates, isn’t this a bit unreasonable?”
“Unreasonable?”
Terence smiled and then said expressionlessly, “President Wang, we have known each other for a long time. Isn’t it normal for me, Terence Yates, to be unreasonable? I think you’re old and losing your touch if you actually dare to reason with me. You’re really too funny…”
“You… You…”
Victor was so angry by Terence’s words that his entire body trembled, but he couldn’t say a word!
Terence was the heir of the Yates family. Victor naturally didn’t dare to do anything to Terence, so he could only endure it.
“There are only two options in front of you now. The first is for the three of us to sit here until that kid appears. The second is for you to call that kid and ask him to come and see me. Leave the rest to the two of us…”
Terence said arrogantly.

chapters.title: Chapter 611: Who The Hell Is That?
chapters.content:
Chapter 611: Who The Hell Is That?
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation | Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Upon hearing Terence’s words, Yana froze on the spot. For a moment, she didn’t know what to say.
Victor hesitated for a moment before he whispered to Yana, “Yana, if Terence doesn’t see Connor today, I reckon he won’t let this rest!”
“If it doesn’t work, you can give Connor a call. I also want to apologize to Connor in person. After all, Connor is also considered the Weaver Family’s benefactor…”
“But Connor already told me just now that he’s preparing to take a car back to Porthampton…” Yana helplessly replied to Victor.
“Porthampton isn’t very far from Borealis City. If you call him now and ask him to return, there should still be time…”
Victor hurriedly said, then added, “If it doesn’t work, I’ll get someone to pick him up now…”
Yana turned and glanced at Terence. She knew the only way now was to hurry up and get Connor to come over. Otherwise, Terence would not let this go.
Therefore, Yana sighed softly and left the villa with her phone.
After leaving the villa, Yana quickly took out her phone and dialed Connor’s number.
Yana was still very nervous.
‘Beep, beep…’
After the phone rang twice, Connor answered the call.
“Yana, is there a problem with the funds?” she asked softly.
Connor knew that Yana must be calling him because of money.
“No… No…” Yana hurriedly replied and continued, “Connor, the money you sent to my grandfather’s company has arrived. Thank you so much. I didn’t expect you to be so rich. You were able to gather this money in just one day…”
“It’s fine as long as you got the money. As for the contract, I’ll come to Borealis City to sign the contract with your grandfather when I have time in the future…” Connor said casually.
“Connor, thank you so much. We have only known each other for two days, and you have helped me so much…” Yana whispered.
“No need to be so polite. Since I said I would help you back then, I will help you. You should know now that I’m not bragging, right?” Connor replied with a smile.
“I should not have doubted you back then…” After Yana heard this, she said with a somewhat ashamed expression.
Then, she asked, “Connor, where did you get so much money? Are you a rich heir?”
“I’m not a rich heir…” Connor replied indifferently and continued,”My boss lent me this money…”
“I see!” Yana nodded thoughtfully.
“Since the money has already been transferred to your account, is there anything else?” Connor could feel that Yana had something to tell him, so he asked quickly.
“Connor, have you left Borealis City?” Yana asked.
“Carlos and I are at the bus terminal now, but we haven’t left yet…” Connor replied after thinking for a moment.
“Can you come to my house now? I’ve encountered some trouble here…” Yana said excitedly after knowing Connor had not left.
“You ran into some trouble?” When Connor heard this, he couldn’t help but be stunned momentarily. Then, he asked in a puzzled tone, “What kind of trouble did you run into?”
“Terence Yates, the man my grandfather asked me to marry yesterday, is now at my house and refusing to leave, lie insists on meeting you. 1 didn’t want you to meet him initially, but my grandfather doesn’t dare to offend Terence. If he doesn’t see you, he won’t leave easily. That’s why I’m calling you…” Yana said softly.
“Terence?” Connor was stunned when he heard the name, then softly said, “Alright then, I’ll go back now!”
After seeing Connor agree, Yana’s eyes flashed with a trace of surprise.
She originally thought Connor would reject her but did not expect Connor to agree so readily.
“Connor, are you coming over? If you don’t have time, it’s fine too…”After troubling Connor so many times, Yana felt a little embarrassed.
“It’s fine. I’ll help you to the end…”Connor said lightly.
“Thank you so much for that…” Yana said gratefully.
“There’s no need to be so polite. Since 1 said I will help you with this, I will help you to the end…” Connor replied with a smile and then hung up the phone.
After Yana put down her phone, she was filled with emotions.
When she first met Connor, Yana didn’t have a good impression of him.
