However, after two days of talking, Yana realized that Connor was a very good person. At the very least, he was thousands of times better than that shameless Terence.
‘I wonder if Connor has a girlfriend?’ Just as Yana was about to return to the villa, such a thought suddenly flashed through her mind.
Yana blushed. She hurriedly shook her head and mumbled, “Yana, what are you thinking? Have you fallen for Connor?”
After saying this, Yana calmed herself and returned to the villa.
After Terence saw Yana return, he smiled and asked Yana, “Yana, when will your boyfriend be here?”
“I’ve already called Connor McDonald just now. He’ll be here soon,” Yana said coldly.
“Connor McDonald?”
When Terence heard this name, he could not help but be stunned momentarily. A trace of confusion flashed in his eyes.
After all, Borealis City wasn’t very big, and the Yates Family was very powerful.
Therefore, Terence knew all the rich people in Borealis City or Porthampton.
However, he had never heard of Connor’s name!
‘Could he be a rich heir from elsewhere?’ Terence couldn’t help but wonder.
“Yana, where is your boyfriend from?”
Terence felt that if Yana’s boyfriend were a native of Davenport, then there would be no problem.
After all, the Yates Family was very powerful in Davenport. lie was not afraid of offending Connor.
However, if Connor was a rich heir from another place, things may be troublesome.
After all, although the Yates Family was powerful, they did not dare to offend just anyone in the country.
If Connor’s background were truly influential, then even the Yates Family must be careful.
“Connor is from Porthampton…” Yana answered directly.
“Porthampton?” After Terence heard this, he smiled disdainfully.
At this moment, he was relieved. Then, he said indifferently, “When did a rich heir with the surname McDonald appear in Davenport? Why don’t I know him?”
Being able to take out too million dollars in a day meant that Connor must be very rich.
“There are so many rich heirs in this world. Do you know all of them?” Yana didn’t spare Terence’s feelings at all and replied coldly.
Terence smiled faintly and said gloomily, “Then I’ll take a good look at who your boyfriend is today…”
After saying this, Terence sat in the living room and waited quietly..

chapters.title: Chapter 612: The Threat
chapters.content:
Chapter 612: The Threat
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation | Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Half an hour later, a taxi stopped at the entrance of the Weaver Family’s villa.
Connor and Carlos got out of the taxi.
“Mr. McDonald, do you want me to go in with you and teach that kid a lesson?” Carlos asked Connor fiercely.
If Carlos had not said that, Connor might have brought him in.
However, after Carlos said that, Connor felt that bringing Carlos in would only blow things up.
So he quickly said, “You don’t have to worry about today’s matter. You can stay outside and wait for me…”
“Alright…” Carlos answered. He stood at the entrance of the villa quietly without saying anything.
Connor walked into the villa alone.
“Connor…” After Yana saw Connor, she was very excited.
She hurriedly ran up and held Connor’s arm very intimately.
“Sorry, I’m late…” Connor said to Yana with a smile.
“It’s fine. I’m happy as long as you’re here…”
Yana smiled happily, then pointed at Terence and said, “Darling, this guy refuses to leave my place. Hurry up and help me chase him out!”
Yana deliberately pretended to be very intimate with Connor, making others think she and Connor were a couple.
However, when Terence saw Yana take the initiative to hold Connor’s arm, it was as if he had been electrocuted. A fit of unprecedented anger swept through his heart.
Terence had pursued Yana for many years but never touched her hand.
However, the woman he loved the most was being so intimate with another man now. How could Terence not be angry?
“You brat, quickly let go of her hand…” Terence glared at Connor and shouted angrily.
Connor’s eyes lit up at Terence as they filled with disdain. He turned to Yana and asked, “Who is he?”
“He’s the Terence I told you about. He’s been pestering me all this time. It’s annoying…” Yana hurriedly replied to Connor.
“So it’s him?” Connor smiled disdainfully and said to Terence, “Yana is my girlfriend. What we do has nothing to do with you!”
After saying this, Connor reached out and pulled Yana into his arms.
After Yana heard Connor’s domineering words, a trace of shyness flashed across her pretty face.
At this moment, the two were in a very intimate position. Yana was nestled in Connor’s arms, and she could feel the temperature of Connor’s body.
Connor sniffed the fragrance on Yana’s body and felt good.
This was the first time Yana was held in a man’s arms. An unprecedented feeling swept through her.
Yana gently looked up at Connor. No matter what, she was still a woman. Sometimes, she hoped that she could get the protection of a man.
Connor’s actions gave Yana a sense of security, making Yana feel very safe.
“I told you to let go of her hand. Are you deaf?”
Terence became even angrier after he saw Connor pull Yana into his arms.
“Terence, Connor is my boyfriend. We can do whatever we want. It has nothing to do with you! You can’t control us when we sleep together, much less hug each other!”
Yana couldn’t care less. After saying this, she kissed Connor’s face gently and looked at Terence proudly.
It was obvious that Yana’s current actions were deliberately provoking Terence.
Meanwhile, Victor stood at the side, helpless. He knew that this was between Terence and Connor. It had nothing to do with him.
If he were to participate in this, he would not be able to solve any problems. He could only watch as the two continued to quarrel.
Yana’s words had thoroughly infuriated Terence.
Terence suddenly stood up and walked up to Connor. He gritted his teeth and whispered to Connor, “Kid, I don’t care who you are. You’d better break up with Yana now. Otherwise, you’ll regret it. Anyone who offends me in Borealis City will not end well…”
“Anyone who offends you here will not end well?”
After Connor heard this, he smiled disdainfully, as if he didn’t take Terence’s words seriously.
After Victor heard Terence’s words, a trace of worry flashed in his eyes. He was very clear in his heart that Connor was not afraid of Terence, but the Weaver Family had to be afraid of Terence.
Even if the Weaver Family managed to tide through this crisis, Terence would definite to make things difficult for the Weaver Family.
If the Yates Family joined forces with other big families in Borealis City to deal with the Weaver Family, even if Connor helped them solve this, there would be endless problems in the future.
Victor took a deep breath. He felt that he had to deal with this properly today. Otherwise, there would be a lot of trouble in the future.
Although he didn’t want Yana to marry Terence now, he couldn’t afford to offend Terence.
However, Victor didn’t know what he could do. This was what Victor felt most helpless about.
“Sigh, Terence was already very angry before, but Connor and Yana still pretended to be intimate to provoke Terence.” Victor could not help but sigh softly and helplessly.
“It would be great if 1 could join the Regency Club. That way, we wouldn’t have to be threatened by Terence!”
The Yates Family could bully the Weaver Family so unscrupulously because Terence was a member of the Regency Club. He could use the resources of the Regency Club to deal with the Weaver Family.
If Victor were also a member of the Regency Club, things would be much simpler.
Previously, Victor had applied many times to join Regency Club.
However, the Yates Family had been playing tricks in the dark, and Victor was not qualified enough, so he could never join Regency Club.
“Kid, are you sure you won’t let go?” Terence asked Connor coldly.
“If I don’t let go, what will you do to me?” Connor replied with extreme disdain.
“Oh, i see! Great…” Terence coldly replied to Connor, then turned to Victor and said, “Mr. Weaver, I’m giving you two options. The first is to get them to break up immediately. I can guarantee that no one in Borealis City will dare to bully your family from today onward. The second option is to let Yana continue to be with this kid. However, I can’t guarantee what will happen in the future….”

chapters.title: Chapter 613: Sleep With Me
chapters.content:
Chapter 613: Sleep With Me
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation | Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Terence had originally planned to threaten Connor and make him retreat. However, he did not expect Connor not to retreat, much less provoke him. Since threatening Connor had no effect, Terence could only threaten Victor! After Victor heard Terence, he looked very helpless.
He quickly whispered, “Mr. Yates, with your status in the Yates Family, you can find any woman you want. You can find a better woman than Yana. Why do you have to go against the Weaver Family?”
It was obvious that Victor’s attitude was already somewhat soft.
When Yana saw Victor’s appearance, a trace of excitement flashed in her eyes. She opened her mouth, wanting to speak.
However, Victor quickly turned and glared at Yana, indicating that she kept quiet.
At this moment, Victor only had one thought: to try to resolve this in the simplest way possible.
There was no need to make a big deal out of this. As for what Terence had done to the Weaver Family, Victor didn’t have the mood to care about it.
He knew that the Weaver Family was no match for the Yates Family.
“You’re right. What kind of woman can’t I, Terence Yates, find? Why should I hang myself on this tree…” Terence replied with a smile.
“That’s right, Mr. Yates, if you have taken a fancy to any woman, I can help you settle it…” Victor saw the change in Terence’s attitude and quickly replied with a smile.
“Do I need your help?” Terence replied coldly and continued, “But I think what you said just now makes sense. I can not make Yana marry me, and I can also agree that they continue to be together. But if you want the Yates Family to let the Weaver Family go, I have a condition…”
Victor was stunned for a while before he asked Terence excitedly, “Mr. Yates, what conditions do you have? As long as the Weaver Family can do it, we will do it…”
“My condition is very simple. You let Yana sleep with me tonight. As long as she serves me well tonight, I guarantee the Yates Family will never bother the Weaver Family again!” Terence laughed wretchedly.
Everyone was stunned when they heard Terence’s suggestion.
They had never thought that Terence would make such an outrageous request.
One had to know that Terence’s proposed condition was ten times worse than Yana marrying him.
If Yana married Terence, she would at least have status.
But now, Terence wanted Yana to sleep with him for a night. This was simply a humiliation to Yana.
It was easy for a young man like Terence to get a woman.
After all, most women were materialistic. He could use his power or money to win a woman’s heart.
He could get her with a bit of money if it were a slightly snobbish girl. He would have to spend more money if it were a powerful girl.
Terence believed that no woman would not be tempted by money.
However, Yana was different. Terence had given Yana many things over the years.
But without exception, Yana never accepted any gifts.
However, not only did this not dispel Terence’s thoughts of pursuing Yana, but also aroused his desire to conquer her.
Terence believed that there was no woman in this world that he couldn’t handle.
If he couldn’t handle it, he hadn’t spent enough money!
He felt that no matter what, he had to get Yana into bed and make her submit to him. This was also why Terence pestered Yana and refused to let go.
After Victor heard Terence’s words, his expression suddenly turned ugly.
He could feel that Terence had no intention of settling this at all, and he didn’t give them any room to maneuver.
“Mr. Weaver, have you thought about it?” Terence asked Victor with a smile. “Mr. Yates, isn’t your request a bit too much?” Victor asked Terence helplessly. “Too much?” After Terence heard this, he couldn’t help but sneer. Then, he said coldly, “I don’t feel so. I think my request is quite reasonable…” After saying this, Terence looked at Victor and continued, “I’ll give you five seconds to consider. If you still can’t answer me after five seconds, don’t blame me for being mean!”
After hearing Terence’s words, Yana became nervous. She held Connor’s hand tightly and looked up at Connor.
When Connor saw how nervous Yana was, he subconsciously hugged Yana’s shoulders tightly and said softly, “Don’t worry. Nothing will happen with me around…”
After hearing Connor’s words of comfort, Yana was stunned. She didn’t know why an unprecedented sense of security emerged in her heart. Yana felt Connor wasn’t joking, so she faintly nodded at Connor.
Connor gently patted Yana’s head, smiled faintly, and didn’t say anything else. Terence, who was not far away, saw that they were still so intimate. He became even angrier. He glared and shouted, “Five!
“Four…
“Three…”
“Mr. Yates, can’t you reconsider? Do you have to blow this up?” Victor asked Terence nervously.
“You are the ones who want to blow this up…
“Two…
“One!” Terence reached out to pick up his phone to make a call.
However, at this moment, the doorbell rang.
Hearing the doorbell ring, everyone was surprised because they did not know whom they were expecting.
Victor heaved a sigh of relief and hurriedly shouted at the door, “Who is it?” “Mr. Weaver, someone wants to come in, but he didn’t reveal his identity…” the bodyguard hurriedly replied.
“Let him in…” Victor didn’t know who it was. He only said this to ease the awkwardness.

chapters.title: Chapter 614: Mr. Watson, Why Are You Here?
chapters.content:
Chapter 614: Mr. Watson, Why Are You Here?
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation | Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
“All right!” The bodyguard nodded gently, then turned around and opened the door.
A burly middle-aged man wearing gold-rimmed specs walked into the villa.
When Victor saw this middle-aged man, he could not help but be stunned momentarily, and a trace of doubt appeared on his face.
He did not know who this middle-aged man was, nor had he ever seen him before.
Terence hesitated for a moment before turning to look at the middle-aged man.
However, when Terence saw the middle-aged man, his eyes instantly widened in disbelief.
“Why… Why is he here? Terence couldn’t help but sigh in his heart. Then, without any hesitation, he walked to the middle-aged man.
Then, he bowed deeply and asked respectfully, “Mr. Watson, why are you here?”
After everyone heard Terence, they were all surprised.
They had never thought that Terence would know this middle-aged man.
Moreover, Terence had always been arrogant and despotic. They had never seen Terence treat anyone with such respect.
Victor and Yana were also puzzled.
Connor scanned Mr. Watson from head to toe. He was more or less puzzled because he didn’t know who Mr. Watson was.
Of course, Terence was the most confused.
The person who appeared at the Weaver Family villa was Jericho Watson, the person in charge of the Regency Club in Borealis City.
Connor, Yana, Victor, and the others had never been to the Regency Club, so they naturally didn’t know Jericho.
However, Terence was a member of the Regency Club. He had seen Jericho in person at an event before.
He also knew Jericho’s identity and status. He was an existence that even the Yates Family did not dare to offend!
However, Jericho rarely appeared in public. Even if it were some activities organized by the Regency Club, he would not often participate.
Terence had only met Jericho once at the Regency Club’s annual meeting.
Victor was also very surprised because he knew this middle-aged man’s identity was not ordinary. Otherwise, Terence would never talk to him like this.
However, Jericho’s attention was not on Terence, Victor, or the others. Instead, he looked at Connor nervously.
Jericho had met Carlos outside just now. Although he had never met Connor, he knew Carlos.
After a simple conversation with Carlos, Jericho discovered that his new boss, Connor McDonald, was in this villa. That was why Jericho was so nervous.
“Sir, may I know who you are?”
Victor hesitated momentarily before stepping forward and asking the middle- aged man nervously.
The middle-aged man looked at Victor with a faint smile and said casually, “Hello, Mr. Weaver. I’m Jericho Watson, the person in charge of Borealis City’s Regency Club.”
After Victor heard this, he was instantly stunned. He was very shocked. Even Yana was very surprised.
After Connor heard the name ‘Jericho Watson’, he also reacted to what was going on.
Last night, Thomas told Connor about the Regency Club. Jericho should be here today to give Victor a membership card.
Under normal circumstances, if someone joined the Regency Club, Jericho would not take the initiative to give them a membership card.
However, Victor was different. Jericho was very clear about the relationship between Victor and Connor.
Thomas had already explained this, so Jericho personally came forward.
However, Jericho did not expect his luck to be so good to meet Connor in Victor’s home.
Connor realized what was going on when he saw the excited expression on Jericho’s face.
After all, Thomas had already clearly explained this to Connor last night. He knew Jericho must have known his identity, so he would look at him like this.
Connor subconsciously gave Jericho a look.
Although Jericho had never seen Connor before, he had long heard of Connor’s deeds.
He knew that Connor liked to keep a low profile and did not like others to expose his identity.
Therefore, he hurriedly nodded, indicating that he would not expose Connor’s identity in front of everyone.
After Connor saw the look in Jericho’s eyes, he was relieved.
Jericho walked to Victor.
Victor was completely dumbfounded at this time because he didn’t understand why a big shot like Jericho would suddenly appear in his home.
Victor had often applied to join the Regency Club, but he had never been approved. Naturally, he could not get in touch with a figure like Jericho. At this time, Victor looked at Jericho with infinite nervousness and doubt.
However, after hesitating, he still took the initiative to extend his right hand and stuttered, “Mr. Wat…Watson, may I know why you’re here today?”
Under normal circumstances, Jericho would not initiate shaking hands with others.
However, he knew very well that Victor and Connor had an extraordinary relationship, so he gently shook Victor’s hand.
This action made Victor feel a little flattered and even more nervous.
Of course, the one who was the most nervous at this moment wasn’t Victor or Yana, but Terence, who was standing foolishly at the side.
Terence really couldn’t understand what was going on. Why would someone of Jericho’s level suddenly appear in the Weaver Family’s villa?
And he even shook hands with Victor?
He felt today’s matter was not as simple as he had imagined!
“Mr. Weaver, I heard you wanted to join our Regency Club. Is that true?” Jericho asked Victor expressionlessly.
Victor was stunned for a moment when he heard this. Then, he hurriedly nodded and said, “That’s right, Mr. Watson, yes…
“But because of my status, the Regency Club has never accepted my application. Of course, I know my situation very well. It’s my problem that I couldn’t join the Regency Club…” Victor looked at Jericho and added.

chapters.title: Chapter 615: Platinum Member Card
chapters.content:
Chapter 615: Platinum Member Card
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation | Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
“Mr. Weaver, you don’t have to belittle yourself. I looked at your information last night and found that you have long met the requirements for joining our club!
“It was not because your background was weak that you couldn’t join our club before. It was because someone was behind it. As for who was behind it, I won’t tell you!
“I came here today to give you the member card. From now on, you are a member of the Regency Club!” Jerico said calmly.
After Victor heard Jerico’s explanation, he inhaled sharply. The expression on his face was extremely shocked.
He had never thought he would pass the application of the Regency Club.
Moreover, it was the person in charge of the Regency Club who personally came to give him a member card. What kind of identity did he have to be to receive such treatment?
Victor felt that all of this was too unbelievable. It felt like he was dreaming.
Yana was also dumbfounded. She didn’t expect Jerico to come for this.
Terence was dumbfounded. He didn’t know what to say.
“Mr. Watson, are… Are you joking with me? Did I really pass the application?” Victor asked Jerico in disbelief.
Jerico smiled faintly after hearing this, then took a black member card from his briefcase and handed it to Victor.
“And this is?” Victor asked in a puzzled tone.
“This is the member card of the Regency Club. I’m the person in charge of the Regency Club. Why would I play such a prank with you?” Jerico asked with a smile.
Victor looked at the black member card in Jerico’s hand in disbelief.
He thought he was dreaming and couldn’t help but pinch himself, but the clear pain told him he wasn’t dreaming!
After Terence heard the conversation between Victor and Jerico, he was shocked too.
He couldn’t understand how Victor could have approved the application of the Regency Club. Even if it were approved, it wouldn’t be to the extent that the person in charge of the Regency Club, Jerico Watson, personally sent the member card to his door!
Even Terence’s father, the current head of the Yates Family, had never received such treatment!
Of course, this wasn’t what Terence was most worried about.
What Terence was most worried about was that if Victor joined the Regency Club and became a member of the Regency Club, Victor would also be protected by the Regency Club.
If that were the case, it would not be easy for the Yates Family to deal with the Weaver Family.
If the Yates Family couldn’t deal with the Weaver Family, then Terence couldn’t continue to threaten Victor and marry Yana to him. His plan would fall through.
The expression on Terence’s face began to turn ugly.
However, he suddenly realized that Victor had only just joined the Regency Club.
Under normal circumstances, the members who had just joined the Regency Club were all Bronze members.
Terence was now a Gold member, and his father was a Supreme member.
Although they were all members of the Regency Club, the treatment would be very different due to the different membership levels.
It was very easy for a Platinum Member to deal with a Bronze member.
Therefore, Terence’s worries were quickly dispelled.
Terence subconsciously glanced at the member card in Jerico’s hand.
However, his eyes widened in shock when he saw the member card.
Terence realized that the member card in Jerico’s hand was something he had never seen before.
This made Terence somewhat puzzled. The Yates Family had joined the Regency Club for three years.
In the beginning, Terence was only a Bronze member. Later, he was promoted to a Gold member.
His father was a Platinum member, so Terence had seen all three member cards.
However, the member card in Jerico’s hand was neither a Bronze nor a Gold or Diamond member card!
“Could the member card have changed?”
Terence couldn’t help but sigh softly. Then, he smiled and said to Victor, “Congratulations, Mr. Weaver, for becoming a member of the Regency Club…”
Victor turned and glanced at Terence. He said nothing because he wasn’t in the mood to deal with Terence.
After Terence saw Victor ignoring him, he looked at Jerico and asked him nervously, “Mr. Watson, there’s something I don’t understand.”
“What is it?” Jerico replied indifferently.
“I wonder what level Mr. Weaver’s member card is. Why have I never seen this member card before?” Terence asked with a smile.
When Jerico heard this, he turned and glanced at Terence indifferently. Then, he said expressionlessly, “This member card is the Platinum member card of our Regency Club. The highest level of membership in the Yates Family is a Diamond. Of course, you haven’t seen this member card before!”
After Terence heard this, his eyes instantly widened in shock.
He had never expected that Victor would become a member of the Regency Club and get the highest level of the club’s Platinum member card.
This was unbelievable!
“A Platinum member card? Mr. Watson, are you mistaken? How could he be qualified to get a Platinum member card?”
“I remember that less than five people in Borealis City can get a Platinum member card. Even my father is not qualified to get a Platinum member card.”
Terence was completely blinded by anger. He shouted at Jerico agitatedly.
After Jerico heard Terence’s words, he smiled faintly and said disdainfully, “It’s not your place to comment on how our Regency Club does things. The Yates Family doesn’t have the right to comment either…”
“Yes… I’m sorry, Mr. Watson. I lost my composure just now…”
After Terence realized he had said something wrong, he hurriedly bowed deeply to Jerico and said nervously.
Yana and Victor looked at the member card in Jerico’s hands, dumbfounded.
For a moment, they didn’t know what to say!

chapters.title: Chapter 616: Could It Be Connor?
chapters.content:
Chapter 616: Could It Be Connor?
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation | Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
At this moment, Terence’s eyes flashed with a trace of despair.
This was because he knew that if Victor really became a Platinum Member of the Regency Club, he would not be able to do anything about it.
Then, he would not be able to use his father’s identity to deal with the Weaver Family. On the contrary, the Weaver Family could use the Platinum Member identity to suppress the Yates Family.
In this way, the identities of the two families had undergone a world-shaking change.
Terence never dreamed that Victor would be able to obtain the Platinium
Member card of the Regency Club!
Thinking of this, Terence couldn’t help but turn to look at Connor.
He felt that everything started from Connor’s appearance. Could it be that Connor had something to do with the people from the Regency Club?
This thought suddenly flashed through Terence’s mind, but he quickly dismissed it.
Connor was so young. How could he have such power to make the people in the Regency Club listen to him?
The Regency Club was a terrifying existence. If Connor really had such ability, he would have made a move against the Yates Family long ago.
For a moment, the entire villa fell silent.
Everyone widened their eyes and looked at Jericho in a daze.
“Mr. Weaver, please accept this membership card!”
At this moment, Jericho suddenly said to Victor.
Victor was stunned for a moment, then turned to Yana and said, “Yana, quickly
pinch me…”
When Yana heard this, she could not help but be stunned for a moment. With a puzzled expression, she asked, “Grandpa, why would I pinch you?”
“Cut the crap. If I tell you to pinch me, just do it…”
Victor shouted.
Yana hesitated for a moment, then walked directly to Victor and gently pinched him.
“Why don’t I feel anything? Use more strength!”
Victor shouted in a low voice.
A hint of helplessness flashed across Yana’s eyes.
Although she did not understand what was going on, he still pinched Victor hard.
When Victor felt the pain, he confirmed that everything that was happening was real. He was not dreaming!
“I’m actually not dreaming?”
Victor shouted excitedly and quickly reached out to take the membership card
of the Regency Club.
After receiving the membership card, Victor looked at it very seriously. He was unusually excited.
At this moment, he did not know how to express his emotions at all. He did not expect to really get this membership card that he had dreamed of.
Jericho seemed very calm. After all, he had seen this situation many times. The Regency Club was very influential. Many bosses dreamed of becoming a member of the Regency Club.
Victor had applied for it many times, but he had never been approved. Now that he had suddenly been approved and obtained the highest level membership card of the Regency Club, he would definitely not be able to accept this fact for a while.
Victor gently stroked the golden membership card and took a deep breath. He said excitedly to Jericho, “Mr. Watson, thank you so much!”
“You deserve this. You don’t have to thank me…” Jericho replied indifferently.
Victor was not a fool. He knew the status he had.
He knew that if he could become a bronze member of the Regency Club, that would already be an achievement. However, he had actually become a Platinum Member of the Regency Club. Someone must have helped him behind the scenes. Otherwise, he would definitely not be qualified to become a Platinum Member.
Therefore, Victor hesitated for a moment and asked Jericho softly, “Mr.
Watson, there’s something I can’t figure out…”
“What is it?”
Jericho said directly.
“Actually, I know where I stand. If I could even be a bronze member of the Regency Club, that would already be an achievement, so how am I able to become a Platinum Member?”
Jericho smiled and continued, “You became a Platinum Member because you had the help of a benefactor!”
“A benefactor?”
Victor was stunned when he heard this.
Although Victor had many friends, because the Weaver Family was being targeted by the Yates Family recently, these people also kept a respectful distance from Victor.
Putting aside helping Victor become a Platinum Member of the Regency Club, Victor couldn’t even find someone to borrow money from!
Moreover, there was an even more important point, which was that the person who could make Victor suddenly become a Platinum Member must be very terrifying.
Victor really could not understand when he had met such a noble person!
“Could it be Connor?”
Victor hurriedly turned to look at Connor. He felt that if Connor was secretly helping, then everything could be explained clearly.
However, Victor felt that if Connor had really helped, it meant that Jericho and Connor know each other, right?
But looking at the current situation, Connor and Jericho didn’t seem to know each other. This made Victor even more curious about who this benefactor was! “Mr. Watson, I wonder who this person you’re talking about is?
Victor asked Jericho softly.
Jericho subconsciously looked at Connor when he heard this.
Connor shook his head at Jericho, signaling him not to continue. He didn’t want Victor, Yana, and the others to know too much about him.
“I can’t tell you who this benefactor is for the time being. You’ll know in the future. You just have to remember that someone is helping you…”
Jericho replied calmly.
“I understand…”
Seeing that Jericho didn’t want to tell him, so he naturally didn’t dare to continue asking. He hurriedly nodded.
“Mr. Weaver, I have something to attend to, so I’ll take my leave first. You guys go ahead!”
Jericho was afraid that if he stayed any longer, he would spill the beans and make Connor unhappy.
If he really offended Connor because of this, then it would be a loss. After saying this, Jericho turned and was ready to leave.
At this time, Victor really wanted Jericho to stay and buy him a meal.
After all, being able to get to know a big shot like Jericho was very beneficial to the Weaver Family.
However, Victor did not continue to ask Jericho to stay after seeing that he was determined to leave.
He knew in his heart that people like Jericho had always been a man of his word. If he said he was going to leave, he would definitely not stay for dinner.

chapters.title: Chapter 617: Removed from the Club
chapters.content:
Chapter 617: Removed from the Club
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation | Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Seeing this scene, Terence was completely stunned. He was extremely shocked.
Connor looked up at Terence and said expressionlessly,
“Mr. Yates, I heard that you are also a member of the Regency Club. Is that why you have the courage to go against with the Weaver Family?”
“Now that Grandpa Weaver is also a member of the Regency Club, your family can’t continue to go against the Weaver Family, right?”
When Terence heard this, he looked at Connor with some doubt.
Jericho, who was about to walk out of the villa, suddenly turned his head to look at Terence after hearing Connor’s words.
Jericho didn’t know that there was still a conflict between Terence and Connor. If Terence only had a conflict with the Weaver Family, then Jericho wouldn’t care much. After all, he had already done what he could.
But if there was a conflict between Connor and Terence, then things would be different.
Terence walked to Connor with a straight face, then shouted at Connor fiercely, “You’re right. Victor Weaver is also a member of the Regency Club, and his level is higher than mine. 1 have no way to go against the Weaver Family.
“But don’t forget, Victor is a member of the Regency Club, but you’re not. I can’t deal with the Weaver Family, but I have many ways to deal with you. If I want to kill a piece of trash like you, it’s easier than killing an ant…”
“Are you sure?”
Connor couldn’t help but laugh when he heard Terence’s words.
“Hmph, you’re already on the verge of death, and you’re still pretending to be calm?”
Terence said coldly to Connor.
When Jericho heard Terence’s words, a trace of anger flashed in his eyes, and then he walked directly to Terence.
“Mr. Watson, why are you back?”
When Terence saw Jericho, he couldn’t help but be stunned for a moment. He
asked with a puzzled expression.
“What did you just say?”
Jericho asked Terence expressionlessly.
“I…”
When Terence saw the anger on Jericho’s face, he couldn’t help but be stunned for a moment. A trace of nervousness flashed in his eyes.
Because he didn’t understand why Jericho would suddenly come back, nor did he know what Jericho wanted to do.
“Terence, do you know the rules of our Regency Club? Didn’t anyone tell you that you can’t use the Regency Club’s resources to deal with outsiders when you joined the club?”
Jericho coldly snorted.
Although the Regency Club did have such a rule, no one took it seriously.
Terence felt that the reason why Jericho was saying this was definitely because
he had said something wrong.
Therefore, he quickly said in a flattering tone, “Mr. Watson, 1 was just joking with this kid just now. I didn’t mean anything else at all…”
“You didn’t mean anything else?”
Jericho looked at Terence and sneered.
When Terence saw the smile on Jericho’s face, he seemed to be even more
fearful.
He stammered, “Mr… Mr. Watson, I really don’t intend to use the resources in my hands to deal with him…”
“Terence, don’t think that I don’t know about the dirty things you’ve done. When Victor applied to join our Regency Club, you were the one who used your connections to stop Victor from joining our Regency Club. I didn’t want to be too calculate with you on account of your father, but 1 didn’t expect you to be so ungrateful. You even plan to use your connections to deal with others. Then, don’t blame me for being rude…”
Jericho said expressionlessly.
“Mr. Watson, what do you mean by that?”
Terence whispered.
“From today onward, you and your father have been removed from the club and are not allowed to join the Regency Club for the rest of your life!”
Jericho said in a very serious tone.
When Terence heard Jericho’s words, he suddenly froze in place. He looked utterly devastated.
“Mr… Mr. Watson, are you kidding me?”
Terence asked Jericho excitedly.
Jericho smiled disdainfully and then said in a low voice, “Terence, do you think 1 would joke with you like this? 1 was going to give you a chance, but since you don’t know what’s good for you, don’t blame me for being rude. 1’11 inform all the members of the Regency Club about this. It’s also a wake-up call for the others!”
After saying this, Jericho turned around and was ready to leave.
Terence finally realized the seriousness of this matter.
If Terence and his father were removed from the Regency Club, the impact on the Yates Family would be terrifying.
After all, if they were removed from the club, it would be equivalent to offending the Regency Club. The members of the Regency Club would definitely not continue to work with them.
Moreover, if Jericho informed everyone about this matter, the effect would be very terrifying. It was very likely that the Yates Family would directly turn from one of the top families in Borealis City to a small family with no reputation. It might even be destroyed.
Terence never dreamed that just because of his anger, he would cause such a big trouble.
He quickly knelt on the ground and hugged Jericho’s thigh tightly. He shouted, “Mr. Watson, 1 was wrong. I beg you to give me another chance. Please don’t revoke our membership…”
Yana, Victor, and the others looked at Terence, who was kneeling on the ground, with shocked expressions on their faces.
No one had expected that Terence, who had been extremely arrogant before, would actually kneel at Jericho’s feet in such a sorry state.
“It’s too late to say anything now. You should quickly scram…” Jericho said to Terence expressionlessly.
“Mr. Watson, are you really going to be so ruthless? If you’re angry, you can revoke my membership, but I beg you, don’t revoke my father’s membership… Terence shouted.
“Hehe, who do you think you are? Why should I listen to your commands…” Jericho snorted and continued, “I’m not in the mood to talk nonsense with you now. If you don’t let go, I’ll put your family on the blacklist of our Regency Club.. It might be more terrifying than revoking your membership…

chapters.title: Chapter 618: A Reasonable Excuse
chapters.content:
Chapter 618: A Reasonable Excuse
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
When Terence heard Jericho’s words, he was instantly dumbfounded.
He unclasped his hands and watched Jericho walk out of the villa.
A moment later, Jericho disappeared from everyone’s sight.
Terence knelt on the ground, his eyes empty and lifeless.
Never in his dreams did he expect that today’s matter would turn out like this.
Victor became a Platinum Member of the Regency Club, but Terence and his father was removed from the club. Terence really couldn’t understand what was going on!
After all, the Yates Family had a good relationship with the people of the Regency Club. Moreover, the Yates Family had contributed a lot to the Regency Club. It was really unreasonable for them to have their membership revoked for no reason.
However, Terence probably wouldn’t have thought that the boss behind the Regency Club was standing right in front of them. All of this was because he had offended Connor.
Connor looked at Terence, who was kneeling on the ground, with a helpless expression.
In fact, Connor didn’t think of doing things so ruthlessly. He just wanted to scare Terence.
However, Jericho was actually really ruthless.
However, Connor felt that it was good to do this. In this way, Terence would definitely not dare to come and harass Yana in the future, and he would not come to find trouble with him.
Yana looked at Terence with disdain, then walked to Terence in her high heels and said proudly, “Terence, didn’t you want to marry me? Aren’t you preparing to deal with the Weaver Family? Now, I want to see how you plan to deal with the Weaver Family!”
At this moment, Yana spoke with confidence.
After all, Terence was a member of the Regency Club, and the Weaver Family was nothing.
But now, the identities of the two families had undergone a shocking reversal. Victor had suddenly become a Platinum Member of the Regency Club, while Terence had become an ordinary person. Therefore, Yana no longer had to worry about Terence’s revenge.
When Terence heard Yana’s words, he couldn’t help but look up at her.
He finally understood what it meant to lose everything. Today, not only did he fail to snatch Yana back from Connor’s hands, but he even lost his membership.
Right now, he was filled with regret. If Terence was given another chance to choose, he would never offend these people from the Weaver Family.
Victor also walked in front of Terence and said expressionlessly, “Mr Yates you’d better get up quickly. Don’t kneel here. Remember this in the future. ’ Young people shouldn’t be too arrogant!”
Even Victor had the guts to lecture Terence now. Victor’s attitude toward Terence had changed drastically.
Terence suddenly raised his head and looked at Victor. He opened his mouth and wanted to refute.
However, he suddenly remembered that he was no longer a member of the Regency Club, and neither was his father.
Victor was a Platinum Member of the Regency Club. If Victor wanted to deal with the Yates Family, the Yates Family would have no power to fight back Therefore, he knew that he could not offend Victor now.
“Grandpa Weaver, 1 was disrespectful. I hope that you can give me a chance and forgive me…”
I erence gritted his teeth and whispered to Victor.
When Victor heard Terence’s words, he smiled disdainfully and said coldly “I am different from the Yates Family. I am not as despicable as you. As long as your family doesn’t trouble my family in the future, my family will not deal with your family…”
Although Victor said this, he had already made plans to deal with the Yates Family.
After all, if the Weaver Family wanted to deal with the Yates Family, it would be a very simple matter. He had the qualifications to do so, so he had no reason not to use it.
When Terence heard Victor’s words, he foolishly thought that Victor really didn’t intend to deal with the Yates Family.
“Thank you, Grandpa Weaver! Thank you!”
“Alright, you should scram. Don’t harass Yana again. The Weaver Family doesn’t welcome you…”
Victor said to Terence expressionlessly with his hands behind his back.
When Terence heard this, he suddenly looked up at Victor, then gritted his teeth and said, “Grandpa Weaver, I still have something to tell you…”
“You still have something to tell me?”
When Victor heard this, he could not help but be stunned for a moment. Then he asked with a puzzled expression, “What is it?”
“Grandpa Weaver, I truly like Yana. I also sincerely want to marry Yana. I hope that I can continue to pursue Yana…” Terence said in a low voice.
When Victor heard this, he could not help but sneer.
However, he did not directly answer Terence’s question. Instead, he said lightly, “This is a matter between you youngsters. If Yana does not mind I will not say anything…”
In fact, anyone with a discerning eye could see that Terence was not sincere about Yana at all. He definitely had other motives for saying this.
When Yana heard this, she walked directly to Terence and shouted at him with her btg watery eyes, -Terence, you’re really shameless. How many times have 1 told you that I don’t like you? I will never many you m this life. 1 never want to see your face again.”
“Yana, I really like you. I beg you; can you give me another chance? ”
Terence said to Yana sincerely.
In fact, Terence had his own plans. He didn’t have to get Yana.
He just felt that today’s matter was all caused by Connor. He did not want to let Connor off just like that.
However, Connor was Yana’s boyfriend. If he dealt with Connor, the Weaver Family might interfere in this matter.
Therefore, he only had one purpose for saying these words, and that was to find a reasonable excuse to deal with Connor.
At this moment, Terence probably did not know that Connor was the existence that he really could not afford to offend!
He thought that Connor was just an ordinary rich guy. He felt that although he could not deal with the Weaver Family, it was still very easy to deal with Connor..

chapters.title: Chapter 619: Fulfilling the Promise
chapters.content:
Chapter 619: Fulfilling the Promise
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation | Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
However, Terence never dreamed that the reason the Weaver Family could join the Regency Club was entirely because of Connor’s phone call.
If he wanted to deal with Connor now, that was basically no different from courting death!
“I don’t care if you really like me or not. 1 don’t want to see you again. Don’t you understand?”
Yana frowned and shouted at Terence coldly.
However, Terence did not continue to pay attention to Yana. Instead, he raised his head and looked at Connor. He gritted his teeth and whispered to Connor, “Connor, if you’re a man, let’s have a fair competition. What do you think?”
When Connor heard Terence’s words, he smiled helplessly.
When Terence saw the smile on Connor’s face, he said with a disdainful expression, “Are you afraid?”
“What do I have to be afraid of? I just feel that your excuse is a little clumsy. If you want to take revenge on me, then take revenge on me. There’s no need to go round in a circle…”
Connor replied with a smile.
When Terence heard Connor’s words, he was instantly dumbfounded.
“Since you want to take revenge on me so much, I’ll give you a chance today. You can compete with me fairly if you want, and you can deal with me if you want. 1 won’t let the Weaver Family help me…”
Connor didn’t put Terence in his eyes at all, so he said with a disdainful expression.
“Alright, then it’s a deal between the two of us…”
Terence quickly nodded after seeing Connor agree so readily.
Seeing that Connor had actually agreed to Terence’s request, Yana hurriedly walked to Connor.
But before Yana could say anything, Connor turned his head and glanced at Yana indifferently. He said casually, “Don’t worry, he can’t do anything to me…” After Terence heard Connor’s words, he became even angrier,
He turned to look at Victor and said in a low voice, “Grandpa Weaver, you heard what this kid said, right? I hope that your family will not interfere in my matters with Connor in the future!”
Victor hesitated for a moment, then turned to look at Connor.
Connor nodded lightly, indicating that Victor should not be concerned about this matter.
When Victor saw Connor nod, he hurriedly smiled and said, “Sure. This is a matter between young people. I will naturally not interfere…”
“Alright…”
Seeing that Victor had agreed to his request, Terence was relieved.
He slowly stood up and pointed at Connor, “Kid, I know you’re from Porthampton. 1 also know your name. Just you wait. I’ll make you regret it sooner or later…”
Connor looked at Terence with disdain. He didn’t put a person like Terence in his eyes at all.
If Terence really angered Connor, Connor could destroy the Yates Family with just a phone call.
Therefore, Connor naturally had nothing to worry about.
“Grandpa Weaver, it’s getting late. I won’t disturb you anymore…”
After what happened, Terence naturally didn’t have the mood to continue staying here. He spoke expressionlessly, then turned around and walked out of the villa.
A moment later, Terence disappeared from the villa.
Victor walked up to Connor. “Connor, if this Terence dares to cause you trouble in the future, you can call me at any time. I’ll use my Weaver Family’s relationship with the Regency Club to help you.” He whispered to Connor.
When Connor heard Victor’s words, he seemed a little helpless.
He couldn’t help but sigh deep down. This Victor was really a two-faced person. He had just promised Terence that he wouldn’t interfere in the matter between the two of them. Now, he actually told Connor that he would help him.
If Terence heard Victor’s words, he would probably vomit blood on the spot.
“Don’t worry, Terence won’t dare to do anything to me!”
Connor replied indifferently, then turned to look at Yana and said softly, “Now that I’ve already transferred the money to your family, shouldn’t you fulfill your promise?”
Originally, Connor felt that the transfer of shares could be done at any time. There was no need to be so anxious.
However, since he was already back, he would do it together to avoid trouble in the future.
Connor had helped the Weaver Family a lot this time, but Connor would not give this money to the Weaver Family for nothing!
“Fulfill your promise?”
When Victor heard this, a trace of doubt flashed across his eyes.
But soon, he remembered that he had promised Connor that as long as Connor helped them get through this difficult time, he would give Connor 50% of the shares of the Weaver’s company.
If it was Victor from before, he would definitely not hesitate and agree to sign the contract with Connor.
After all, at that time, the Weaver Family’s company was on the verge of bankruptcy. Even the entire company might not be worth 500 million dollars.
However, things were different now. Victor had already become a Platinum Member of the Regency Club, so the value of the Weaver Corporation would definitely rise. In the future, it might easily break through to billions or even tens of billions.
If Connor used 500 million dollars to buy 50% of the Weaver Corporation’s shares, this deal would definitely not be worthwhile for Victor.
When Yana saw that Victor seemed to be hesitant, she quickly walked over and whispered to Victor, “Grandpa, are you going to go back on your word?”
Victor was stunned for a moment and could not help but raise his head to look at Connor.
He knew very well that today’s events were definitely not as simple as he had imagined.
Connor could easily take out 500 million in cash, and he had somehow become a Platinum Member of the Regency Club. He felt that these things might have something to do with Connor.
Therefore, he did not dare to go back on his word. He was worried that Connor might have been the reason he was able to join the Regency Club.
It meant that Connor was that benefactor. Going back on his word now was obviously offending this benefactor.
Victor hurriedly waved his hand at Yana and then said with a smile, “Yana, what nonsense are you talking about? Since I’ve already promised Connor, 1 definitely won’t go back on my word. You don’t have to worry. I’ll get my secretary to prepare the contract now. We can sign the contract at any time…”
When Yana heard Victor’s words, she heaved a sigh of relief.
Victor looked at Connor indifferently, then hurriedly took out his phone and dialed a number..

chapters.title: Chapter 620: Leaving Borealis City
chapters.content:
Chapter 620: Leaving Borealis City
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation | Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
When Connor heard Victor’s words, the worries in his heart were dispelled.
Just now, Connor was already prepared for the possibility that Victor would go back on his word.
If Victor went back on his word, then Connor would directly revoke Victor’s status as a Platinum Member.
Then, he would have Thomas Morgan acquire the Weaver Corporation and hand it over to Yana to manage.
Victor probably never dreamed that his small decision just now would change his life’s fate.
About ten minutes later, Victor’s secretary had already prepared the contract.
When Connor took the contract from Victor’s hands, he glanced at it briefly. After confirming that there were no problems, he directly handed the contract to Yana.
Then, he calmly said to Yana, “You can sign it now…”
“Me?”
When Yana heard Connor’s words, she was stunned. She was very puzzled.
“That’s right. I’m going to transfer 50% of the Weaver Corporation’s shares to you. From today onward, you’ll be the largest shareholder of the Weaver Corporation. I’m also going to let you manage the Weaver Corporation’s business…”
Connor replied calmly.
At this time, Connor had 50% of the Weaver Corporation’s shares, while Victor only owned 25% of the Weaver Corporation’s shares. The remaining shares were controlled by Victor’s other children.
Therefore, as long as Yana signed this contract, she would become the largest shareholder of the Weaver Corporation.
Hearing Connor’s words, Yana looked at Connor in disbelief.
She had never expected that Connor would be so generous as to transfer all of his shares to her.
As long as Yana signed the contract, 50% of the Weaver Corporation’s shares would be transferred to her.
This was no loss to the Weaver Family. After all, these shares would be transferred from Victor to Yana. The actual control of the Weaver Corporation was still in the hands of the Weaver Family.
“Connor, are you sure you want me to sign this contract? If I sign it, this 50% of the shares will be mine. If I don’t give it to you, you won’t be able to have any say…”
Yana said excitedly to Connor.
“Of course, I’m sure. However, I’m not really giving you these shares when 1 ask you to sign the contract. I’m just temporarily putting these shares in your hands. 1 hope you can help me manage these shares. When I need these shares, I’ll get them back. Of course, I’ll definitely give you some compensation then…”
Connor looked at Yana and explained.
Connor did this just to prevent himself from losing the right to inherit the inheritance in the future. If Connor signed this contract now, if Connor lost the right to inherit the inheritance, these shares would be taken back.
However, if Yana did not sign the contract, it meant that these shares had nothing to do with Connor.
At that time, Connor could completely rely on these shares to survive.
When Yana heard Connor’s words, she could not help but be stunned for a moment. Then, she raised her head and looked at Victor, not knowing what to do.
This was actually a good thing for Victor. After all, these shares were in Yana’s hands, and they were still in the hands of the Weaver Family.
If it was in Connor’s hands, it would really fall into the hands of outsiders. Therefore, Yana’s signature would definitely be much better than Connor’s signature.
Victor whispered to Yana, “Since Connor trusts you and wants you to sign, you can sign here…”
Yana looked at the contract in front of her and hesitated for a while. Then, she reached out and picked up the pen. She whispered to Connor, “If I sign this contract now, these shares will be mine. You won’t have a chance to go back on your word in the future. You know that, right?”
“I won’t go back on my word. I believe you!”
Connor said calmly to Yana.
Yana nodded after hearing Connor’s words, and then directly wrote her name on the contract.
Connor trusted Yana a great deal. He felt that Yana would definitely not betray him.
If he really encountered any trouble in the future, he could use Yana’s shares in the Weaver Family to live for the rest of his life. This could also be considered as leaving a way out for himself.
After signing the contract, Yana handed it to Victor.
Victor looked at the contract and wrote down his name without any hesitation.
After all, this outcome wasn’t too bad for Victor.
At this moment, Connor stood up slowly and said calmly, “Since you’ve already signed the contract, there’s nothing else for me to do. I’ll be leaving now. If you encounter any trouble, you can call me directly…”
After saying this, Connor directly walked out of the villa.
When Yana saw that Connor was about to leave, she seemed a little reluctant and hurriedly followed him out of the villa.
Victor sat quietly on the sofa. No one knew what he was thinking.
A moment later, Connor and Yana walked out of the villa.
Yana turned and glanced at Connor, then asked him softly, “Connor, do you want to stay in Borealis City for a few more days? I can bring you around…”
Obviously, Yana was trying to persuade Connor to stay.
Connor turned to look at Yana, then said indifferently, “It’s fine. I still have something to do in Porthampton, so I won’t stay any longer. If there’s a chance in the future, I’ll come find you…”
“Alright, then…”
Yana nodded as if she was a little disappointed, then sent Connor out of the villa.
After leaving the villa, Connor followed Carlos Lane to the bus station in a taxi.
Yana returned to the villa alone.
At this moment, Victor was sitting on the sofa with an extremely excited expression on his face.
After all, Connor not only solved the big problem that was the Yates Family, but also made him a Platinum Member of the Regency Club. This was simply great joy for Victor!
Of course, the most important point was that Connor did not take away the shares of the Weaver Corporation. Instead, he gave all of these shares to Yana. This was also a great thing for the Weaver Family.
When Victor saw that Yana had returned, he hurriedly stood up and said with a smile, “Yana, you have helped our family resolve a huge problem this time around…”

chapters.title: Chapter 621: Stand Outside!
chapters.content:
Chapter 621: Stand Outside!
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation | Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Yana looked at Victor helplessly.
At first, she only wanted Connor to pretend to be her boyfriend.
But she didn’t expect him to directly help her family solve such a big problem.
Now looking back, Yana still felt that all of this was somewhat unreal, as if she were dreaming.
“Yana, tell me the truth. Is Connor really your boyfriend?” Victor asked Yana softly.
Upon hearing this question, she couldn’t help but pause, her eyes filled with a hint of confusion.
She furrowed her brows and asked Victor, “Grandpa, why are you asking me this?”
“I just want to confirm if you and Connor are really together…” he explained softly.
She thought that all the problems had been resolved, and Terrance would definitely not dare to harass her anymore.
So she didn’t have to continue hiding the truth. She said softly, “Grandpa, actually, I have been lying to you. I’m not really in a romantic relationship with Connor. I’ve only known him for a few days. I brought him to our house just to make you give up on forcing me to marry Terrance. But I didn’t expect him to be so wealthy…”
“So basically, you’re not his girlfriend, right?” Victor asked, his expression somewhat disappointed, in a low voice.
“That’s right, I’m not Connor’s girlfriend. I’ve only known him for less than two days!” Yana nodded directly.
Upon hearing this, Victor couldn’t help but sigh lightly, then said expressionlessly, “Well, 1 already guessed that. You’re definitely not Connor’s girlfriend. After all, how could someone like him be with you?”
Upon hearing his words, a hint of embarrassment flashed across Yana’s face.
She couldn’t help but furrow her brows and asked, “Grandpa, what do you mean by that? Why is it impossible for Connor to be with me? Am 1 not good enough for him?”
“Of course, you are good enough for him, but I think his identity and background are not as simple as we imagine.”
“I’ve heard people from Porthampton say that there is a Mr. Connor in Porthampton, whose background is terrifying and far beyond what ordinary people can imagine!”
“Even figures like Thomas and Kyle are subordinates of this Mr. Connor. And it’s said that the Mr. Connor is young, probably around the same age as Connor!”
“Considering that they share the same surname, I think there’s a high possibility that he is that Mr. Connor from Porthampton…” Victor analyzed in a low voice.
Yana stood frozen in place after hearing his words, her expression filled with disbelief.
She couldn’t help but ask him, “Grandpa, are you saying that Connor is the Mr. Connor from Porthampton?”
Although she wasn’t very concerned about the matters of the Weaver family and was unaware of their situation, she had heard the name of Mr. Connor from Porthampton a few times. She knew how terrifying of a figure he was in Porthampton.
“Whether Connor is the Mr. Connor of Porthampton or not, 1 don’t know. It’s just my guess. But Yana, even if he is not the Mr. Connor of Porthampton, I think his background and identity are definitely not as simple as we think…” Victor said slowly.
“I also think the same. Connor is definitely not an ordinary person,” Yana added.
Victor looked up and down at her, then said expressionlessly, “Yana, although you are not currently together with Connor, if you two can be together in the future, it would be of great help to our family. I think you understand what I mean, right?”
Upon hearing these words from him, she was momentarily stunned. Then she furrowed her brow and said, “Grandfather, you don’t mean to actually make me be with Connor, do you?”
“Are you saying you don’t like him?” Victor directly asked in response.
“Well…” She hesitated and couldn’t help but pause. The expression on her face appeared somewhat helpless, unsure of how to answer the question.
“Yana, you don’t have to worry. I won’t force you to marry anyone anymore. I just wanted to tell you about this situation. If you like him, I will definitely support you being with him unconditionally. Of course, if you don’t like him, then consider my words unsaid. Take your time to think about these matters…” Victor calmly replied, then walked towards the bedroom.
She stood alone in place, her facial expression becoming conflicted. She wasn’t sure if she really liked him, and she was even more uncertain if he would accept her if she pursued him actively.
If he truly was the Mr. Connor of Porthampton, she felt that she wouldn’t be worthy of him.
“Forget it, why am I thinking so much? Connor would definitely not be with me. He’s so wealthy, he must already have a girlfriend…” Yana sighed helplessly, then turned back to her own room.
After leaving Yana’s house, Connor followed Carlos and took a taxi to the bus station in Borealis City. He then boarded the bus that afternoon and returned to Porthampton.
By the time he arrived in Porthampton, it was already past two in the afternoon.
He didn’t waste a single moment and headed straight to Porthampton University.
When he arrived at the classroom, he found Rachel giving a lecture inside.
She was dressed in a black professional skirt, with a tight-fitting blouse that perfectly showcased her seductive curves. The fullness of her chest gave off an irresistible feeling.
Rachel was always full of charm no matter when, and Connor had seen many beautiful women, but few could compare to her. She exuded an alluring aura that made it hard for anyone to resist.
He looked at the incredibly seductive Rachel at the front of the classroom, his expression filled with helplessness.
Because he originally thought he would be able to return to school on time, but he ended up being late.
Connor hesitated for a moment, then lightly knocked on the classroom door.
Upon hearing the knocking, Rachel turned her head and glanced coldly at him, then said in a chilly tone, “You can just stand outside…”
Upon hearing these words, his eyes flickered with helplessness, and he could only obediently stand outside the classroom door..

chapters.title: Chapter 622: Do You Know Joey Shaw?
chapters.content:
Chapter 622: Do You Know Joey Shaw?
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation | Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
After half an hour, the dismissal bell rang.
Hearing the bell, Connor’s mood started to become somewhat uneasy.
Because he knew that he had offended Rachel, this woman, and there would definitely be consequences.
Sure enough, not long after, she walked elegantly in high heels and approached him.
She glanced at Connor, then expressionless, said, “Connor, come with me…”
“Okay…”
He reluctantly agreed and followed her as they walked away.
Along the way, his eyes were fixed on her slender and fair legs.
There was no way around it. Rachel’s legs were simply too tempting!
A few minutes later, they arrived at the office.
Once inside the office, Rachel sat directly on the chair, crossing her long and fair legs, and asked Connor with a straight face, “Connor, if I’m not mistaken, I only gave you one day off. Why did you come back today?”
“Um…”
He scratched his head awkwardly and looked at her, saying, “Miss Rachel, I suddenly had an urgent matter this morning, so it took me some time…” “What urgent matter? Are you trying to deceive me?” she asked straightforwardly.
Upon hearing her words, his expression became helpless.
He quickly explained, “Teacher, how could I dare to deceive you? I just went to attend a friend’s birthday banquet! That’s all.”
“Attending a friend’s birthday banquet took you that long? It seems like your relationship with this friend is quite extraordinary?”
Rachel said with a smile.
After hearing her words, he hesitated for a moment, then playfully replied, “Teacher, actually, my relationship with this friend is just ordinary, but it’s very different from my relationship with you…”
“Very different from my relationship?”
Rachel’s expression became puzzled upon hearing this, then she furrowed her brows and asked Connor, “Whose birthday banquet did you attend?”
“Madison’s birthday banquet…”
Connor hesitated for a moment, but he had to bring up Madison, otherwise, he couldn’t explain the situation.
“Madison?”
Rachel’s expression became even more puzzled, then she sternly asked, “Why did you attend Madison’s birthday banquet? And why did she invite you to her birthday banquet?”
He didn’t know how to explain this to Rachel.
So he could only come up with an excuse and said, “I don’t know why Madison invited me to her birthday banquet. Anyway, she used this matter to threaten me. She said if 1 didn’t attend her birthday banquet, she would come to the school to harass you. And she didn’t want me to tell you about this. 1 had no choice but to ask for leave and attend her birthday banquet…”
Rachel glanced at him, seemingly not fully believing what he said, and asked softly, “Did Madison do anything to you?”
“Madison threatened me to keep my distance from you. I agreed, and then she let me go…” he answered directly.
She thought that his excuse was reasonable. She believed that Madison might have deceived him into attending her birthday banquet to threaten him.
So she nodded and continued to look at Connor, asking, “Did anything happen at the birthday banquet yesterday?”
“Nothing happened. Madison just threatened me to keep my distance from you. I was worried that her bodyguards would take action against me, so I agreed…”
Connor explained.
Rachel looked at Connor hesitantly for two seconds and asked softly, “Connor, are these words you said true?”
“Teacher, how could I dare to deceive you? If you don’t believe me, you can call Madison now and ask her if I attended her birthday party yesterday…”
Connor quickly replied.
Upon hearing this, Rachel picked up her phone.
However, after thinking for a while, she put the phone back down.
She felt that Connor wouldn’t lie to her at this moment and said softly to Connor, “Since that’s the case, you’ve helped me in a way. I won’t hold your absence against you today. You can do whatever you need to do…”
“Thank you, teacher, thank you, teacher…”
After Rachel let him go, Connor hurriedly smiled and thanked her before turning around to leave Rachel’s office.
But at that moment, Connor suddenly remembered that Rachel hadn’t answered his previous question.
So he turned back to Rachel and asked, “Teacher, do you actually know Joey Shaw or not?”
Connor had been puzzled by this question all along. He couldn’t understand why Joey had come to help him in the first place.
Connor thought about everyone around him but couldn’t find a suitable candidate.
Except for Rachel, whose background was somewhat mysterious, none of the others seemed to have this possibility.
After hearing Connor’s question, she couldn’t help but pause for a moment. She then said expressionlessly, “Does it matter to you whether I know Joey or not?”
Upon hearing her response, his expression became helpless.
He clearly understood that she was deliberately deceiving him, but she was his teacher, and he didn’t dare to do anything to her.
So he sighed helplessly, turned around, and left her office.
Seeing Connor leave, Rachel also let out a sigh. There seemed to be a conflicted expression on her face, but it was unclear what she was conflicted about.
After leaving her office, Connor kept pondering this question in his mind.
He couldn’t figure out who was the person that made Joey bring his troops to help him.
Without understanding this question, Connor couldn’t find peace of mind.
And the investigation by Thomas and Kyle didn’t yield any results.
“How can I make Rachel willingly admit her relationship with Joey?”
Connor couldn’t help but mutter to himself..

chapters.title: Chapter 623: Kidnapping Rachel
chapters.content:
Chapter 623: Kidnapping Rachel
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation | Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Connor walked aimlessly on the campus.
When suddenly, he came to a stop and a thought rose in his mind.
He suddenly remembered a person, and that person was none other than Carlos.
He felt that Carlos was very skilled. If he let Carlos kidnap Rachel and then ask Carlos to call Joey and say that she had been kidnapped, they could determine whether she knew Joey or not.
Although he felt that his method was somewhat despicable, at this moment he only had this one way to confirm whether Rachel really knew Joey.
Moreover, he believed that Carlos was highly skilled and it shouldn’t be difficult for him to kidnap her.
The most important thing was that Carlos was his subordinate, so he could ensure that Rachel would not be harmed.
Furthermore, he didn’t need to be directly involved in this matter, and she shouldn’t suspect any connection between him and the incident.
He was only doing this to confirm whether she really knew Joey!
And whether the person who helped him that day was Rachel or not.
Thinking of this, he took out his phone and dialed Carlos’s number!
“Ring ring!”
After a couple of rings, Carlos answered the phone and respectfully said, “Mr. Connor, is there something you need from me?”
“Carlos, come to the entrance of our school now. I have something to discuss with you…” Connor replied expressionlessly.
“Okay…”
Carlos agreed and hung up the phone.
Not long after, Connor arrived at the school gate.
At the same time, Carlos took a taxi and rushed over.
He hurriedly approached Connor and asked in a low voice, “Mr. Connor, what do you need from me?”
“Carlos, tonight I want you to help me kidnap someone. Can you do that?” Connor whispered to Carlos.
“Who do you want to kidnap?” Carlos didn’t even ask why Connor wanted to do this and asked with an expressionless face.
“This person is called Rachel, our class counselor…” After saying this, Connor took out his phone and opened Rachel’s Instagram.
Connor remembered that she had posted a selfie a few days ago, so there should be her photos on her Instagram.
Sure enough, he quickly found a photo of her and handed the phone to Carlos.
Carlos briefly glanced at Rachel’s photo and then whispered to Connor, “Mr. Connor, I have seen this woman. When she came to Porthampton, she was welcomed by Kyle. I met her once…”
“You know this woman?” Connor’s eyes flashed with surprise upon hearing this.
“How much do you know about her?” he continued to ask Carlos in a low voice.
Carlos hesitated for a moment after hearing this, then whispered, “Mr. Connor, based on my understanding, this woman seems to have an extraordinary background, but as for who she really is, I’m not very clear myself…”
“I want to kidnap her just because I’m curious about who she is…” Connor replied casually.
“I understand…”
Carlos nodded lightly and looked at him, asking, “So, Mr. Connor, what’s your plan?”
“When class is over this afternoon, you wait for her on the way to her dormitory. There’s a secluded path leading to the teachers’ dormitory that she passes by every day. You wait for her on that path. You can choose to drug and sedate her, but under no circumstances should you harm Rachel. Sheis just an ordinary woman, and dealing with her should be easy for you. Do you understand what I mean?” Connor whispered to Carlos.
“I understand…”
Carlos nodded and looked at him, asking, “So, Mr. Connor, once I have her tied up, where should I keep her?”
“You rent a room near the school and directly lock her up in a hotel room. But be sure not to harm this woman. I am kidnapping her just to confirm her identity, nothing more. Do you understand?”
Connor calmly looked at Carlos and said.
“Mr. Connor, rest assured, I know how to handle these things!”
Carlos replied with great confidence.
“That’s good…”
Connor nodded slightly and looked at Carlos, saying, “Now, you go and get ready. I will send you a message when it’s time to pick her up in the evening. We’ll get in touch then…”
“Okay…”
Carlos agreed and then turned and left.
He watched Carlos’s figure and had a helpless expression on his face.
After all, if there was any other way, he wouldn’t have resorted to this.
He believed that this was the only way to confirm the relationship between Rachel and Joey. If he didn’t figure out this matter, he would continue to feel uneasy.
After parting ways with Carlos, he returned to the classroom alone.
Dominic and Stephan rushed to his side when they saw him coming back, their expressions full of doubt. Dominic asked, “Connor, where were you yesterday? Why didn’t you come to class?”
Connor glanced lightly at Dominic and whispered, “I had something to take care of, so I didn’t come to class yesterday…”
“What happened?”
Dominic asked with some concern.
“It’s not a big deal, just attended a friend’s birthday banquet…”
Connor said casually.
“I see…”
Dominic nodded slightly and continued, “Did Rachel give you any trouble? Did she count you absent?”
“No, I already asked her for leave before…”
Connor said as he sat down at his own seat.
At this moment, he had no mood to entertain them because his mind was occupied with how to deal with Rachel tonight.
They also returned to their seats with Connor.
Dominic excitedly said to Connor, “Connor, I have good news to tell you…”
“What’s the matter?”
Connor asked, slightly stunned.
“You don’t know yet, right? Our school is hosting an art evening tonight, and all the students and teachers are supposed to attend. There will also be performances by the freshmen…”
Dominic grinned and happily informed Connor.

chapters.title: Chapter 624: Cultural Gala
chapters.content:
Chapter 624: Cultural Gala
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation | Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
“A cultural gala?”
Upon hearing Dominic’s words, Connor was momentarily puzzled, his expression seemingly filled with confusion.
“Yeah, every year at the start of the new semester, the university will organize a cultural gala for the freshmen!”
“Moreover, I heard that among the newcomers this year, there is a girl named Sabrina who is exceptionally beautiful. She is hailed as the new artistic beauty of our school, and many people are pursuing her. Tonight, she will also be performing on stage… I can finally see this goddess…”
Dominic exclaimed excitedly.
“Sabrina?”
Connor paused again upon hearing the name.
Suddenly, he remembered that Sadie’s close friend seemed to be named Sabrina, and she was also a freshman at Porthampton University.
“Could it be that the girl Dominic mentioned is Sadie’s friend? It can’t be such a coincidence, right?” Connor couldn’t help but thought inwardly.
Seeing that he remained silent, Dominic couldn’t help but cast a puzzled look at him and asked, “Connor, don’t tell me you don’t know who Sabrina is?”
“It shouldn’t be the case. Who in our school doesn’t know Sabrina!” At that moment, Stephan suddenly spoke up.
Connor glanced at him, shook his head helplessly, and calmly said, “I really don’t know this Sabrina…”
“I’m really impressed with you…”
Stephan looked at Connor speechlessly, not knowing what to say.
He said in a low voice, “Sabrina is a freshman in our school. She is not only beautiful but also comes from a wealthy family. Many senior students in our school are pursuing her, but she has never been in a relationship…”
“Now many people are curious about who she will ultimately be with.”
Dominic looked at Connor with a grin and continued, “Ah, it would be great if she could be with me…”
Upon hearing Dominic’s words, Connor’s eyes flashed with helplessness.
“You better stop daydreaming. I heard that Sabrina seems to be getting together with a guy named Shane. Not only is he handsome, but his family is also very wealthy. You don’t stand a chance at all…”
“The information I heard is that Sabrina only treats him as a regular friend and has no intention of being with him. I still have a good chance…”
Dominic retorted without hesitation.
“Even if Sabrina doesn’t be with Shane, she won’t be with you either. You should quickly get rid of this idea…” Stephan struck again.
“No, what do you mean, Stephan?”
Dominic’s emotions seemed a bit agitated as he shouted at Stephan.
“I don’t mean anything. I’m just telling you the facts…” Stephan said calmly.
Dominic and Stephan got into a heated argument about who Sabrina would end up with.
Upon hearing their conversation, Connor’s face showed a great deal of helplessness.
After hesitating for a moment, he asked Dominic softly, “Do you know when this cultural gala will take place?”
In fact, he didn’t really care about who Sabrina would end up with. He was only worried that this event would interfere with his plans with Carlos tonight.
Dominic thought for a moment, then spoke softly, ” If we follow the usual schedule, it should start after school in the afternoon. It will probably finish around seven or eight o’clock at the earliest…”
“Oh, I see.”
Connor nodded lightly and continued, “Will the teachers also have to attend this cultural gala?”
“They’re supposed to go…” Dominic nodded lightly.
After hearing his words, Connor immediately got up and walked outside with his phone.
Dominic and Stephen didn’t pay attention to him and continued discussing who Sabrina would end up with.
After leaving the classroom, Connor dialed Carlos’s phone and briefly told him about the cultural gala, informing Carlos when to make his move and asked him to update him on the situation.
After hanging up the phone, he returned to the classroom.
He noticed that Dominic and Stephen were still discussing Sabrina.
At this moment, he didn’t know if the Sabrina they were talking about was the same Sabrina he knew, so he didn’t join their discussion.
Time flew by, and the afternoon classes quickly ended.
After the dismissal bell rang, all the students started packing up their belongings and headed towards the location of the school auditorium.
Once inside the auditorium, the students took their seats at their respective class positions and waited quietly for the start of the art soiree.
Perhaps due to Sabrina’s presence, the students were highly anticipating this art soiree.
Since Rachel was Connor’s class advisor, she also came to the auditorium to watch the cultural gala.
Connor intentionally found a seat near her.
This way, he could observe her, and once he noticed that she was preparing to return to the dormitory, he would send a text message to Carlos to make his move.
Rachel turned her head and glanced coquettishly at Connor, not taking his actions to heart, but quietly playing with her phone.
6 p.m. in the evening.
The host of the gala stepped onto the stage and began their speech.
Because this gala was organized to welcome the freshmen, both the hosts and the performing students were freshmen.
There were four hosts in total, two males and two females.
The male hosts were handsome, while the female hosts were sexy and charming.
As soon as the four of them appeared on stage, they captured the attention of countless people, and the students below began whispering to each other.
One of the tall female hosts, dressed in a red tight skirt, held a microphone and smiled as she spoke a few official words, officially starting the cultural gala.
After the gala began, the freshmen started taking turns to perform on stage.
However, the students below weren’t particularly interested in these performances.
They were all waiting for Sabrina to appear since she was highly popular within Porthampton University.
In the blink of an eye, over an hour had passed.
