A male host walked onto the stage, picked up the microphone, and said loudly, “Are you all getting impatient? I know everyone, including me, is looking forward to the appearance of our freshman goddess Sabrina. So without further ado, let’s welcome Sabrina, a freshman from the Finance Department, to present a classical dance for everyone!”

chapters.title: Chapter 625: Meeting Sabrina Again
chapters.content:
Chapter 625: Meeting Sabrina Again
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation | Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Upon hearing the host’s words, the students in the audience burst into excitement, and applause filled the air.
After all, they had been waiting for a long time just to see Sabrina’s arrival.
After a moment, the applause slowly subsided.
The lights on the stage began to dim, and beautiful spotlights illuminated the stage one by one.
Under the spotlight, a tall and handsome man appeared in the center of the stage.
In the middle of the stage, there was a Steinway piano, and the man sat in front
of it, playing the piano with elegant movements.
Before long, a beautiful and melodious music began to play.
Dominic turned his head and glanced at Connor, then whispered to him, “This person is the freshman Shane I told you about. Shane has been pursuing
Sabrina…”
After hearing this, Connor nodded slightly and didn’t say much.
After all, he didn’t really care about who Sabrina would be with.
Just at that moment, a beam of light illuminated the stage again.
Sabrina appeared in everyone’s sight, wearing a beautiful dress.
Upon seeing her, the audience erupted in applause once again.
As Connor looked at her, a hint of surprise flashed in his eyes.
Because he realized that the Sabrina mentioned by Dominic and others seemed to be the same as Sadie’s best friend.
Connor was acquainted with Sabrina, so he could naturally recognize that this person was Sadie’s best friend.
With the sound of the piano, Sabrina’s body danced gracefully like a goddess, and the entire auditorium fell silent, captivated by her classical dance.
Everyone watched her performance with a serious expression. Her dance was beautiful, and even compared to professional dancers, she didn’t fall behind much.
Her stunning dance, combined with Shane’s brilliant piano performance, their collaboration was flawless, making it the most spectacular performance of this arts evening.
After a while, the lights slowly dimmed, and the auditorium erupted in enthusiastic applause.
Shane stood up slowly, walked directly to her, and reached out his right hand towards her.
Sabrina hesitated for a moment, then placed her small hand in his palm.
Upon seeing this scene, the students in the auditorium were dumbfounded, their expressions filled with shock.
In their eyes, Sabrina holding hands with Shane clearly indicated that they were together.
Dominic’s face showed a look of despair, and he gritted his teeth and shouted,
“Are they really together?”
As soon as Dominic finished speaking, Shane held Sabrina’s hand and walked to the center of the stage, then bowed to the audience. The applause from the audience became even more enthusiastic, and some people even started chanting that they were together.
Upon hearing the crowd’s cheers, a hint of displeasure flashed in Sabrina’s eyes.
However, she maintained a charming smile on her face, but gently withdrew her hand.
Seeing Sabrina retract her hand, Shane’s expression seemed a bit unhappy, but he didn’t show it.
After a while, the two of them walked off the stage.
With the end of Sabrina and Shane’s performance, the arts evening came to a close.
Some students had even started to leave early.
Dominic seems to still be immersed in Sabrina’s dance just now. He excitedly turned to Connor and said, ‘Connor, do you think Sabrina looks good?’
‘Quite good-looking…,’ Connor replied helplessly.
‘Of course! She is truly my goddess. Her figure and temperament are simply perfect. If I could find a girlfriend like her, I would be willing to live ten years less…,’ Dominic exclaimed with excitement.
Meanwhile, Spencer looked at Dominic disdainfully and said softly, ‘You better stop fantasizing here. Didn’t you see just now? Sabrina and Shane are already holding hands, which means they are together. You don’t stand a chance at all…’
After hearing Spencer’ words, Dominic’s expression seemed even more agitated.
He couldn’t help but shout in a low voice, ‘What do you know? Shane is obviously deliberately taking advantage of my goddess. How could my goddess be with someone like Shane? If Sabrina ends up with Connor, I can tolerate it, but if she ends up with Shane, I absolutely can t bear it…
‘You can rest assured that Sabrina will definitely not be interested in you. Stop daydreaming…,’ Spencer bluntly struckback.
Dominic and Spencer began a new round of dispute over Sabrina.
Connor looked at the two of them with a helpless expression on his face.
At that moment, he suddenly noticed that Rachel had stood up and was walking towards the exit of the auditorium.
It was obvious that she was planning to leave.
Connor knew it was time to ask Carlos to take action, so he quickly turned his head and said to Dominic and Spencer, ‘Alright, since the party is over, let s leave!’
Dominic and Spencer nodded in agreement upon hearing his words.
However, just at that moment, Dominic suddenly saw Sabrina and Shane walking towards their location.
‘Wait a minute…,’ Dominic shouted when he saw Sabrina approaching.
‘What’s wrong?’ Connor turned his head and glanced at Dominic, asking in confusion.
‘Don’t leave yet…,’ Dominic muttered softly and then excitedly said to Connor, ‘My goddess Sabrina is coming over, I want to say something to my goddess…’ Upon hearing Dominic’s words, Connor’s eyes flickered with helplessness. Instinctively, he looked up and saw that Sabrina and Shane were indeed walking towards them.
Shane was dressed in an elegant white suit, tall and handsome.
Sabrina was wearing a white evening gown, and the two of them looked very compatible when they walked together.
Wherever these two went, they became the center of attention, and people would always approach them willingly.
However, these two never paid any attention to other students and always talked with their heads down, as if they were very intimate.
If any uninformed onlookers saw them being so close, they would probably think that they were already together.”

chapters.title: Chapter 626: Intimate Contact
chapters.content:
Chapter 626: Intimate Contact
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation | Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Shane kept talking to Sabrina, and Sabrina would smile happily from time to time.
When Dominic saw this scene, the expression on his face became even angrier. He gritted his teeth and said in a low voice, “Could it be that Sabrina was really tricked by Shane?”
At this moment, Connor was not in the mood to care about these things. There was only one thought in his mind.
That was to quickly contact Carlos and ask him to make a move on Rachel.
“Hey, are you guys still leaving?”
Connor asked Dominic anxiously.
“Wait a minute, Sabrina will be here soon…” Dominic nervously replied to Connor.
After Connor heard this, he sighed helplessly and said in a low voice, “Then you can wait here. I’ll make a move first…”
After saying this, Connor turned around and left. However, just as he was about to turn around and leave, a very pleasant voice came from behind him.
“Connor…”
When Connor heard the voice, he was stunned for a moment. Then, he turned to look at Sabrina. After Sabrina confirmed that it was really Connor, her expression became even more excited and she ran towards him.
However, perhaps because she was in a hurry, Sabrina did not notice the chair in front of her, and she accidentally tripped on the chair and lost her balance. Her delicate body fell towards Connor.
“All…!”
Sabrina exclaimed.
When Connor saw Sabrina falling towards him, he instinctively caughther body and pulled her into his arms.
As she was nestled in Connor’s arms, he could clearly smell the faint fragrance on her body.
When everyone saw this scene, they were all stunned on the spot, their expressions extremely shocked.
Everyone’s mouth was wide open as they looked at Connor and Sabrina with their mouths agape.
Dominic and Spencer widened their eyes in shock. They had never expected that Connor would know Sabrina. Moreover, the two of them were even hugging each other.
Of course, the person who was the angriest was not Dominic, but Shane.
Connor looked at Sabrina who was in his arms and smiled bitterly. The expression on his face seemed a little bitter.
He was in a hurry to inform Carlos to make a move, but Connor did not expect Sabrina to fall into his arms at this moment.
Moreover, it was in front of so many people. Even if Connor wanted to explain himself now, he might not be able to explain it clearly.
Sabrina quickly adjusted her body and said to Connor with a nervous expression, “Connor, I didn’t expect you to be here…”
Yes, your dancing just now was not bad…”
Connor said to Sabrina with a smile.
“Thank you…”
Sabrina replied softly. She turned around and saw that many people were looking at her and Connor.
Sabrina was not a fool. She understood what these people were thinking.
Therefore, she hurriedly said to Connor, “Well then, I’ll be leaving first!”
“Yes!”
Connor nodded. Sabrina hesitated for a moment before leaving.
Shane sized Connor up and left as well.
One could tell that Shane’s expression was extremely ugly at this moment, as if he had been cuckolded.
After Sabrina left, the crowd started to whisper among themselves.
After all, Sabrina had just finished her performance with Shane. Many people had their attention on the two of them. Furthermore, Sabrina had many suitors around her. Everyone was discussing who she would be with.
But now, Sabrina had inexplicably thrown herself into Connor’s arms. This made people start to suspect the relationship between the both of them.
Connor was not in the mood to care about these things, however; all he could think about was to inform Carlos to attack Rachel.
Therefore, Connor quickly left the auditorium before everyone could react.
Meanwhile, Dominic and Spencer were still standing there in a daze. Their faces were filled with confusion, unable to understand what was going on.
After Connor left the auditorium, he walked straight to Rachel’s dormitory and dialed Carlos’s number.
“Ding, ding, ding!”
Carlos answered the call after two rings.
Connor glanced behind him. After making sure that no one was following him, he said, “Carlos, Rachel has already left the auditorium. She’ll probably reach the side path soon. Go and ambush her on the road now…”
“Mr. McDonald, I am already on the side road. As soon as I see Rachel, I will attack her…” Carlos replied in a low voice.
“Alright…”
Connor nodded his head gently and hung up the phone.
After putting down his phone, Connor took a deep breath. He knew very well that Carlos had always been very reliable. If he said that there would be no problem, then there should be no problem.
After calling Carlos, Connor slowed down his pace and walked toward the dormitory.
At this time, Connor did not want Rachel to know his existence because he did not want her to know that the person who kidnapped her was him.
Otherwise, if Rachel investigated this in the future, the matter would become very troublesome. When Connor was about to reach the dormitory, he suddenly stopped and narrowed his eyes to look at the road leading to the school dormitory.
However, Connor did not see Rachel, so a trace of doubt flashed across his eyes.
“Has Carlos already made his move?” Connor could not help but mutter. Then he took out his phone and dialed Carlos’s number.
“Have you seen Rachel?”
Connor frowned and asked.
“Mr. McDonald, I noticed that she didn’t go straight back to her dormitory after leaving the auditorium. Instead, she went to the supermarket to buy something. Let’s wait a little longer…” Carlos said in a low voice.
“Alright, I got it!”
Connor nodded and hung up the phone.
The both of them waited for about ten minutes before Rachel finally walked out of the supermarket with two shopping bags in her hands. She was walking towards the dormitory in a flirtatious manner.
One had to admit that the sight of her back was still very charming. Today,
Rachel was wearing a short skirt that accentuated buttocks. Her slender and fair thighs looked especially attractive under the dim light.
However, Connor was not in the mood to look at these things at this time. The expression on his face was very serious.

chapters.title: Chapter 627: The Unconscious Rachel
chapters.content:
Chapter 627: The Unconscious Rachel
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Connor knew very well that if Rachel knew that he had gotten someone to kidnap her, the consequences would be unimaginable.
Carlos had already disappeared. He must be hiding somewhere, waiting for Rachel to appear, so Connor focused all his attention on her.
Not long after, a figure suddenly dashed out from behind Rachel.
The figure did not say anything else and directly covered her mouth from behind.
“Dammit, be gentler…” Connor called out helplessly when he saw Carlos’s rough actions.
After struggling for a while, Rachel passed out and collapsed in Carlos’s arms.
Seeing that Carlos had succeeded, Connor became excited and almost hurried over, but decided against it after a moment of hesitation. If Rachel was not completely unconscious now and she ended up seeing him, then things would be troublesome.
Therefore, Connor chose to stand where he was in the end and signaled Carlos to take Rachel away.
After Carlos understood what Connor meant, he carried Rachel on his back and dialed Connor’s number.
Connor picked up the call and asked in a low voice, “Carlos, is Rachel completely unconscious now?”
“She should be out like a light. What should we do now?” Carlos asked in a low voice.
“Take her to the hotel. I’ll wait for the two of you at the entrance. Be careful not to be discovered by the school’s security…” Connor replied in a low voice.
“Understood!” Carlos replied in a low voice.
Connor got the location of the hotel from Carlos, then hung up the phone and walked toward the hotel.
He felt that if he showed up at this time, it was very likely that he would be filmed by the surveillance cameras.
If Rachel investigated this after the incident, she would definitely discover him.
Therefore, Connor did not meet up with Carlos, but instead walked to the hotel alone.
Since Carlos was carrying Rachel on his back, he was naturally much slower than Connor was, so by the time Connor arrived at the hotel, Carlos and Rachel had yet to come out of the campus.
Connor waited at the entrance of the hotel for about five minutes before Carlos finally appeared.
When Connor saw Carlos, he quickly ran up to him and asked him nervously, “Did anyone notice you?”
“Mr. McDonald, don’t worry. No one has discovered me…” Carlos replied with certainty.
“Alright…”
Connor nodded gently, then took Rachel from Carlos’s hands and carried her into the hotel.
Since Carlos had booked a room beforehand, the two of them did not waste any time and took the elevator straight there.
After entering the room, Connor placed Rachel on the bed and squinted at Rachel’s voluptuous figure. Just now when he was hugging Rachel, he could feel that Rachel had a very good figure. It felt very comfortable to hug her.
In addition, Rachel’s posture was very alluring. Her slender and fair legs were half-opened, and he couldn’t help but want to do more.
If he could conquer a beautiful woman like Rachel, it would definitely be an exciting thing.
However, Connor quickly woke up because he knew that he couldn’t do such a thing now. Not everyone could touch a woman like Rachel.
He’d kidnapped Rachel this time just to investigate the relationship between her and Joey Shaw. If he really did something to her, then wouldn’t he be worse than a beast?
“Mr. McDonald, I’ll wait outside. If there’s anything, just call me…” Carlos said to Connor calmly.
“Yes.”
Connor nodded slightly. Carlos then turned around and walked out of the room.
After Carlos left, Connor covered Rachel with a blanket and said softly, “Ms. Wallace, I really had no choice but to do this. I hope you won’t blame me when you wake up…”
After saying this, Connor took out his phone and found Joey Shaw’s number, ready to call him.
However, just as Connor took out his phone, he suddenly felt Rachel move on the bed. Connor quickly put down his phone and looked down at her.
Connor found that Rachel’s eyes were still tightly shut, and her body was limp on the bed. There was no sign of her waking up at all!
“Am I too nervous?” Connor could not help but mutter quietly. He looked at Rachel and hesitated for two seconds. A bold idea suddenly flashed through his mind.
He stood up and walked to Rachel’s side. Then, he stretched out his hand and gently nudged her.
Rachel didn’t react at all. She was still lying on the bed, motionless.
Connor felt that if Rachel was really pretending to be unconscious, he would definitely not be able to wake her up like this.
Therefore, Connor mustered up his courage and placed his right hand on Rachel’s shirt, gently unbuttoning the first button of the shirt.
After the button was unbuttoned, Rachel’s cleavage was directly exposed to Connor’s line of sight. Connor could not help but swallow.
Rachel’s eyes were still closed, and there were no signs of her waking up at all.
“Am I really seeing things?”
Connor hesitated for a moment, and a trace of doubt appeared on his face. Then, he unbuttoned the second button of her shirt.
When the second button was unbuttoned, Connor could even see Rachel’s black lace bra. The style was very sexy and charming.
Connor could not help but take a deep breath, and the expression on his face slowly shifted to one of nervousness.
Rachel was too alluring. Whether it was her figure or her appearance, she was perfect. With such a sexy beauty in front of you, and in a completely unconscious state, it would be a pity if you didn’t do something.
However, Connor was also afraid. He was afraid that if he really did something to Rachel, then the outcome for him would definitely be very miserable.
Therefore, after Connor unbuttoned Rachel’s two buttons, he saw that she still had no reaction, which meant that she must be completely unconscious and could not wake up at all.
Otherwise, with her kind of temperament, she would definitely wake up and slap him.
After confirming that Rachel was completely unconscious, Connor buttoned up her shirt again and called Carlos in from outside the room. Then, Connor planned to contact Joey Shaw..

chapters.title: Chapter 628: When Did You Wake Up?
chapters.content:
Chapter 628: When Did You Wake Up?
Translator: End less Fantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
“Mr. McDonald, do you have any orders?”
Carlos asked Connor in a low voice after he entered the room.
“Joey knows my phone number and my voice. If 1 call him, he will definitely find out that it’s me and my identity will be exposed,” Connor muttered. “So I want you to call Joey Shaw now and tell him that you kidnapped Rachel. Let’s see how he will react…”
Carlos nodded when he heard Connor’s words. Then, he took out his phone and dialed Joey’s number.
“Ding, ding, ding!”
The phone rang twice before Joey picked it up and asked in a low voice, “Who is it?”
“You don’t need to know who I am now. You only need to know that Rachel Wallace is in my hands. If you want her to live, prepare 5 million in cash for me immediately. After you prepare the money, I will tell you where we can make a deal…” Carlos said in a low voice.
“Rachel is in your hands?”
After Joey heard the word Rachel, his tone clearly became agitated.
“That’s right. Rachel is in my hands now. If you don’t believe me, I can take a few photos for you!” Carlos repeated softly.
“Young man, are you tired of living? How dare you kidnap Rachel? Do you know who she is?” Joey shouted angrily.
Carlos and Connor were stunned when they heard Joey’s words.
Sure enough, just as Connor thought, Joey did know Rachel. Moreover, from Joey’s tone, he seemed very angry about this matter. This was enough to prove that Rachel was very important to him.
After Connor heard what Joey said, he looked down at Rachel with an incredulous expression on his face.
He had never thought that the person who had helped him behind the scenes was actually her, nor did he expect her background to be so terrifying—a single phone call from her was enough to mobilize a big shot like Joey to help.
Although Connor already knew that Rachel was the person who helped him back then, this made Connor even more curious. Who exactly was Rachel? Why did it have such a large amount of energy?
However, just as Connor was still shocked by Rachel’s identity, he suddenly felt a chill on his back.
Connor was stunned for a moment before he hurriedly turned his head to look behind him.
Then, he was immediately stunned on the spot.
Rachel had actually woken up.
At this moment, she was holding a pistol in her hand.
The cold muzzle was aimed at Connor’s head. At this time, as long as Rachel gently pulled the trigger, the bullet would shoot through Connor’s head.
Connor looked at Rachel with a dull expression. For a moment, he actually did not know what to say. The expression on his face also began to become nervous.
Carlos was also stunned on the spot. He stammered to Rachel, “Put the gun down!”
“Put the gun down?”
Rachel could not help but smile faintly when he heard Carlos’s words. Then, she said to Carlos softly, “I know you’re skilled, but I advise you not to make a move. If you do anything, I’ll kill him!”
Carlos could tell that Rachel was very skilled in holding the gun, which meant that she might really shoot Connor.
Therefore, he hurriedly said to Rachel, “Don’t be rash. I won’t make a move…” “That’s good…” Rachel lightly smiled. After which, she softly said to Connor, “Little Connor, I helped you back then.And yet now you’re actually biting the hand that fed you and kidnapped me. I’m sad…”
“Ms. Wallace, when did you wake up?” Connor stammered as he asked Rachel.
“I’m not unconscious at all. I was just acting just now. I just wanted to see who kidnapped me and what they wanted to do to me…” Rachel replied indifferently. After Connor heard Rachel’s words, the expression on his face was unusually helpless. He had never thought that Rachel had been pretending to be unconscious all along, and that he had actually been played by her again.
On the other end of the phone, Joey shouted excitedly after hearing Rachel’s voice, “Ms. Wallace, are you alright?”
Because Joey’s voice was relatively loud, Connor and Rachel could also hear what he was saying.
Rachel extended her right hand to Carlos and said softly, “Give me the phone…” Carlos hesitated for a moment, then quickly passed his phone to Rachel.
Rachel took the phone and said softly, “Commander Shaw, you don’t have to worry. The person who kidnapped me is Connor McDonald. I’m no longer in danger…”
Rachel knew very well that if she didn’t explain things clearly to Joey now, it was very likely that Joey would directly get his subordinates to find her. At that time, it would not be good for anyone if the matter blew up.
“Ms. Wallace, are you really okay?”
Joey asked nervously.
“Don’t worry. If I say it’s fine, it’s fine…” Rachel replied indifferently.
“It’s good that you’re fine, but why did Connor kidnap you?” Joey asked in confusion.
“What else could it be? It’s all because he wants to know my identity. He called you just now to test you…” Rachel said softly.
“Did I say something wrong just now?” Joey asked helplessly.
“Not really. After all, you don’t know what’s going on either…Alright, I won’t talk to you anymore. I’ll hang up first!”
Rachel replied indifferently and then hung up the phone.
After hanging up, Rachel threw the phone in front of Carlos, who picked it up immediately.
“You can leave first. I have something to tell Connor…”
Rachel said to Carlos expressionlessly.
A hint of hesitation flashed across Carlos’s eyes when he heard that. He was worried that Connor would be in danger, so he did not want to leave.
“Don’t worry, I won’t hurt Connor…” Rachel said as she put away her weapon.
Carlos glanced at Connor worriedly. Connor winked at him, signaling not to worry.
Although his relationship with Rachel was somewhat complicated, they were definitely not enemies. If Rachel really wanted to deal with Connor, then she wouldn’t have asked Joey to calm down, so Connor also believed that Rachel wouldn’t hurt him..

chapters.title: Chapter 629: Rachel Wallace’s Secret
chapters.content:
Chapter 629: Rachel Wallace’s Secret
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation | Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
After understanding what Connor meant, Carlos turned around and left the room.
Rachel looked at Connor from head to toe and said with a smile, “Little Connor, 1 didn’t expect you to be so brave. You even dared to kidnap me. Do you know the consequences of kidnapping me?”
“I don’t know the consequences of kidnapping you. I just want to know if you were the one who helped me back then!”
Connor replied in a low voice.
“Don’t you know your own worth? How many people in the entirety of Davenport can get someone like Commander Shaw to personally come out and deal with someone’s business? If it weren’t for me, you would have been taken away by Stephanie Lee’s people long ago…”
Rachel expressionlessly replied to Connor.
After Connor saw Rachel admit this matter so calmly, the expression on his face seemed to be even more puzzled. He asked Rachel softly, “Then 1 don’t understand. How did you know that something happened to me? Also, why are you helping me? Who are you?”
Facing Connor’s series of questions, Rachel couldn’t help but smile. “First of all, I knew that you got into an accident because my men happened to see you at that hotel. At that time, you and Stephanie Lee were making such a big commotion. I just received the news, so I called Commander Shaw to help you.” “So that’s how it is!” Connor nodded lightly.
“As for why 1 wanted to help you, the reason is actually very simple…” Rachel said softly.
“What is the reason?” Connor asked excitedly.
“Because you’re Steven Lee’s heir and the new Chairman of the Empire World Corporation. I didn’t want you to lose the right to the inheritance, so 1 helped you. As for your question about who I am, I can’t answer it for the time being. However, you only need to remember that I’m not your enemy!”
When Connor heard Rachel’s words, the expression on his face seemed to be even more puzzled.
He could not help but ask in a low voice, “Who are you? Why can’t you tell me your identity?”
“Now is not the time. Even if i tell you some things, it won’t do you any good!” Rachel replied calmly.
After Connor heard Rachel’s words, he could not help but be stunned for a moment. Then, he shouted with a surprised expression, “You actually know that I’m Steven Lee’s successor?”
“Of course I know that you are Steven Lee’s successor. Not only do I know, but I also knew of it much earlier than you. Otherwise, I wouldn’t have come to Porthampton University to be a lecturer…”
Rachel could not help but roll her eyes at Connor.
Connor’s expression became even more incredulous when he heard Rachel’s words. He asked Rachel in shock, “You mean, before you came to the Porthampton University to be a lecturer, you already knew that 1 would become Steven Lee’s heir, right?”
Rachel looked at Connor and lightly nodded. “That’s right. 1 knew that, so 1 started to investigate your identity. After confirming that you wanted to study at Porthampton University, I followed you there…”
“How did you know?” Connor asked in confusion.
“This is a secret. I can’t tell you for the time being…”
Rachel replied softly.
“Then what’s your purpose in doing this?”
Connor continued to ask.
Rachel didn’t hide anything from Connor and said calmly, “For two years, I’ve been observing you. My goal is to wait for you to really inherit Steven Lee’s inheritance in the future.”
Connor was instantly overwhelmed by the favor. lie never thought that Rachel would come to Porthampton University as a lecturer because of him.
But hearing this, the expression on Connor’s face became even more puzzled. Moreover, just now Rachel said that she wanted to join forces with him. What did this mean?
At this moment, Connor had a lot of doubts in his heart.
“Did you get close to me for the inheritance in my hands?”
Connor asked Rachel softly.
“The inheritance?”
When Rachel heard this, she could not help but shake her head and smile faintly. Then, she said expressionlessly, “The inheritance in your hands is indeed very tempting, but it’s nothing to me because 1 don’t lack money at all!” “Then why are you observing me?”
“I have already told you just now: there are some things that I can’t tell you too clearly now because knowing these things won’t do you any good. You just need to remember that the two of us are friends, not enemies!” Rachel said to Connor in a very serious tone.
“How do 1 know if we’re friends or not?” Connor replied directly.
“Why are you being so silly? If we were enemies, why would I help you back then?”
Rachel looked at Connor with an unusually speechless expression.
“Who knows if you’re helping me to get my inheritance?” Connor said in a low voice.
Rachel looked at Connor and smiled helplessly. Then, she shook her head gently and said expressionlessly, “Since you don’t believe me, I’ll tell you. I have a grudge against the people of Rockefeller. Do you understand what I mean now?”
“You have a grudge against Rockefeller?”
After Connor heard this, he was stunned on the spot. The expression on his face was very unbelievable. He asked Rachel with a puzzled expression, “Then who are you?”
“I cannot tell you who 1 am now. When the time is right, I will naturally tell you everything. Also, 1 hope that you will not tell anyone about the matter between the two of us. Just pretend that this matter today never happened…”
Rachel paused for a moment, then looked at Connor and continued, “1 originally thought that when the time was right, I would tell you everything in detail, but I didn’t expect you to be so anxious. However, it’s fine to tell you everything clearly now. At the very least, you won’t have to harass me anymore!”
Connor looked at Rachel in front of him, the expression on his face somewhat helpless. For a moment, he actually did not know what to say.
Rachel saw that Connor wasn’t speaking and continued. “Little Connor, don’t tell anyone about what happened between the two of us. Don’t getThomas Morgan and Kyle Hayes to investigate my identity anymore because it’s impossible for them to find out with their methods.. As for what happened between you and me, 1 don’t want you to tell either of them about it either!”

chapters.title: Chapter 630: Don’t You Feel Uncomfortable?
chapters.content:
Chapter 630: Don’t You Feel Uncomfortable?
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation | Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Hearing Rachel’s words, Connor could not help but be stunned for a moment.”Why can’t I tell them about this? Are you hiding something from me?” he asked with a puzzled expression.”
“I’ve already said so much. What other conspiracy could I be hiding from you?” Rachel rolled her eyes at Connor and said indifferently, “Right now, I don’t trust anyone else except you!”
-Then why do you believe me? What makes you so sure that I’ll be your friend?” Connor frowned and asked Rachel.
“Little Connor, why do you have so many questions? Don’t forget that I’ve known you for two years. In that time, I’ve been observing you. I know your character very well, so I’m very confident that after I explain everything to you, you’ll definitely choose to cooperate with me!”
“Of course, if you don’t believe me now, it doesn’t matter. After all, now is not the time for the two of us to join forces,” Rachel helplessly said.
Connor looked at the expression on Rachel’s face, and his eyes appeared to be somewhat displeased.
In fact, he hated this feeling very much. However, he also understood Rachel’s personality. He also felt that since Rachel had known about his inheritance in advance, it meant that Rachel’s identity and background must be extraordinary. Otherwise, she would definitely not have known about it in advance.
Therefore, Connor sighed softly and did not continue to ask anything.
-just pretend that nothing happened. In the future, I will still be your lecturer, and you will still be my student!” Rachel said faintly after seeing Connor not respond.
Connor sized Rachel up and asked in a low voice, “Since you weren’t unconscious just now, why did you pretend to be unconscious?”
“It’s very simple. In fact, on the way back to the dormitory, I had already discovered Carlos’s existence, so I pretended to go to the supermarket to buy things. And his drugs were completely useless against me. I’ve been pretending to be unconscious because 1 wanted to see who was trying to kidnap me and why. But when I saw you, I knew you wouldn’t hurt me.
“That’s why I didn’t wake up because I was very curious about whether you kidnapped me just so you could sleep with me or for some other plans…” Rachel paused for a moment, then looked at Connor and continued, “Do you know how disappointed I was when you took off my clothes? 1 even started to doubt whether you’re a man or not…”
After Connor heard Rachel’s words, he was stunned on the spot. The expression on his face was one of exasperation, and he did not know what to say.
“I’m just joking with you. You don’t have to take it seriously. Do you remember what 1 said to you just now?” Rachel asked Connor softly.
“I do…” Connor nodded helplessly.
“Then good.”
Rachel smiled faintly and then unbuttoned her shirt in front of Connor.
When Connor saw Rachel’s actions, he couldn’t help but be stunned for a moment. His expression was very puzzled. He didn’t know what Rachel wanted to do.
Rachel’s back was facing Connor as she put her pistol into her shirt.
Only then did Connor know that Rachel had been hiding the pistol in her underwear.
“Doesn’t this woman feel uncomfortable?”
Connor looked at Rachel’s back, the expression on his face helpless.
After Rachel hid the pistol, she whispered to Connor, “Well then, I’m leaving!”
“Yes!”
Connor nodded lightly.
Rachel didn’t waste any time and walked out of the room.
Connor had wanted to make Rachel stay so he could ask her about the matter many more times, but in the end, he still endured this impulse.
After Rachel left, Carlos hurried to Connor’s side and said nervously, “Mr. McDonald, are you alright?”
“I’m fine…” Connor replied indifferently.
“Mr. McDonald, I’m really sorry. I didn’t expect this woman to be so powerful. My knockout powder didn’t have any effect on her at all…”
Carlos blamed himself.
“This matter is not your fault. I was too careless…
Connor glanced at Carlos and replied in a low voice.
“Then, Mr. McDonald, what should we do next?” Carlos asked.
“Everything is fine now, so you can go back first. Don’t tell anyone about what happened today, not even Thomas Morgan or Kyle Hayes,” Connor whispered. “Understood…” Carlos nodded quickly and said, “Mr. McDonald, if there’s nothing else, I’ll take my leave first!”
“Alright…”
Connor waved his hand at Carlos, who turned around and left the room. Meanwhile, Connor sat on the hotel bed alone with a helpless expression on his face.
Although Connor already knew that the person who helped him at the Phillips Family Manor was Rachel, what could he do even if he knew about this matter. Connor still hadn’t figured out Rachel’s true identity. As for her saying that she also had a grudge with Rockefeller, Connor had no way to confirm whether her words were true or false.
Even if Rachel said that she and Connor were friends, he couldn’t completely believe her words. Moreover, Rachel had started to plan these things out two years ago, which made Connor even more worried about what she wanted to do to him.
Although one question had been answered, more questions were placed in front of Connor.
If Connor could figure out Rachel’s true identity, then things would be better. But there was no other way even people like Thomas Morgan and Kyle Hayes couldn’t find out who she was.
If Connor relied on himself to investigate, it would definitely be futile.
He never expected that his beautiful lecturer would have such a terrifying background, nor did he expect her to have started planning everything out from two years ago!
Connor felt a chill run down his spine when he thought of this.
He even felt that the reason why Rachel took care of him so much before was very likely because she already knew Connor’s identity, so she was deliberately helping him.
Rachel’s actions made Connor’s hair stand on end. He felt that she was extremely terrifying, even more so than all the other women he knew..

chapters.title: Chapter 631: A Beautiful Girl Is Looking For You!
chapters.content:
Chapter 631: A Beautiful Girl Is Looking For You!
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation | Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
That night.
Connor didn’t go back to Royal Villas. Instead, he stayed in a hotel room for one night.
After all, the room was nice, and Carlos had paid for it. It would be a waste not to stay in it.
The next day, when Connor returned to the classroom, he found the students looking at him strangely.
No one had expected Connor to be able to get together with a goddess like Sabrina. It was unbelievable.
Especially Dominic and Spencer. When they saw Connor walk in, they quickly ran to Connor and squealed, “Connor, you must explain to me clearly what happened between you and Sabrina!”
After Connor heard Dominic’s words, he helplessly turned and looked at Dominic, saying, “Sabrina and I are just ordinary friends. She is best friends with a friend of mine. We met once at a gathering. We are not what you think at all…”
“So why did she suddenly hug you yesterday?” Dominic questioned Connor as if he was interrogating a criminal.
“Why was she hugging me?” After Connor heard this, he was stunned for a moment, and then he sighed as he said, “She didn’t hug me last night. She tripped on a chair. 1 just reached out to catch her…”
“So there’s nothing between you and Sabrina?” Dominic asked in a puzzled tone.
“No…” Connor didn’t even think twice as he shook his head.
“Connor, are you lying to me?” Dominic sized up Connor and asked in a low voice.
“Bro, why would I lie to you about such a small matter?” Connor asked helplessly.
“If you have nothing to do with each other, I won’t blame you!” Dominic grinned and continued, “Connor, what you did yesterday was quite satisfying. You didn’t see the expression on Shane’s face. He was so angry that he almost fainted. If that Sabrina is interested in you, I’m still very supportive of you getting together with her. After all, at the very least, it’s much better for you to be together with Sabrina than for Shane to be together with Sabrina…”
“Dominic, there’s really nothing between Sabrina and me. Please don’t spout nonsense anymore…” Connor replied helplessly.
What happened yesterday was exactly as Connor had explained. Sabrina had tripped over a chair and fell into his arms.
However, no one would believe him even if Connor wanted to explain this to others. Therefore, Connor naturally could not be bothered to explain it to others.
The students in the classroom looked at Connor as if they were very confused about what was happening.
After all, to them, Connor wasn’t extraordinary.
Moreover, Connor was a poor and lame delivery guy.
Although Connor was now delivering food and seemed to have become rich, it still could not change the students’ impression of Connor.
They could not understand why a cold and elegant goddess like Sabrina would like a guy like Connor.
Dominic looked at Connor and hesitated. Then, he whispered, “Oh right, Connor, I want to tell you something!”
“What is it?” Connor was stunned for a moment.
“So, there’s a third-year student named Harold Phillips in our school. This boy’s father seems to be an officer in the military. He has been training in the army and rarely comes to school. However, he has always liked Sabrina. He even said that he wanted to pursue Sabrina and that no one could snatch her away from him.
“Shane’s family background is also very powerful. That’s why Shane dared to pursue Sabrina openly. However, the others feared Harold’s identity and did not dare to compete with him…” Dominic said slowly.
“What does this have to do with me?” Connor was confused for a moment and asked Dominic with a puzzled expression.
“Bro, why are you putting an act with me? How can this not have anything to do with you? Now, everyone in our school thinks that you’re together with Sabrina. If Harold finds out about this, he will not let you off. You have to be careful…” Dominic told Connor nervously.
“Dominic, how many do you want me to repeat myself before you believe me? I’m not with Sabrina at all. Besides, I’m not worried that Harold will bother me. Don’t worry…”
At this moment, Connor did not take the person Dominic mentioned to heart. He responded helplessly.
Dominic looked at Connor despondently, but he didn’t say anything.
“Connor, a beautiful girl is looking for you!” A guy suddenly shouted at Connor.
Connor was surprised when he heard this. Then, he hurriedly turned to look outside the classroom and saw a calm girl standing at the classroom door.
This girl was none other than Sabrina’s best friend, Sadie.
After Connor saw Sadie, a strange look flashed in his eyes, and he seemed a little puzzled.
He couldn’t understand why Sadie had come to him.
The other students seemed to think that Sabrina had come to look for Connor, so they all turned to look outside the classroom.
However, when they saw Sadie, a hint of confusion flashed in their eyes.
After all, Sadie was not as famous as Sabrina at Porthampton University. Many people did not know Sadie.
Connor hesitated momentarily, then walked out of the classroom and asked Sadie softly, “What’s up?”
“Are you free now?” Sadie asked Connor coldly.
“Yes. What do you want…” Connor nodded lightly.
Sadie looked at the students in the classroom and said softly, “Come with me. I have something to tell you…” After saying this, Sadie turned around and left. Connor hesitated before following Sadie.
Connor looked at Sadie curiously.
He didn’t know why Sadie had suddenly come to find him or why she was looking for him..

chapters.title: Chapter 632: Stay Away From Sabrina
chapters.content:
Chapter 632: Stay Away From Sabrina
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation | Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
A few minutes later, Connor followed Sadie to a remote corner.
Sadie stopped and turned to Connor. “Connor, I came to look for you today because I have something very important to tell you…”
“What is it? Spill!” Connor replied indifferently.
“Connor, I hope you will stay away from Sabrina…” Sadie said to Connor seriously.
“You want me to stay away from Sabrina?” After Connor heard Sadie’s words, he was very puzzled.
He didn’t understand what Sadie meant.
“That’s right. I hope you won’t harass Sabrina anymore because Sabrina is a girl with ambitions. Her life is not something you can imagine. You don’t deserve her at all. No matter how I look at it, you don’t have the right to be with her. So I hope you won’t continue to pester her. Hurry up and leave Sabrina. This way, it’s good for both you and her…” Sadie looked at Connor solemnly.
After Connor heard Sadie’s words, a hint of helplessness flashed in his eyes. He was not with Sabrina at all.
It seemed that Sadie had misunderstood his relationship with Sabrina.
Of course, Sadie’s current attitude made Connor feel very uncomfortable.
So Connor asked Sadie coolly, “You’re here to warn me, right?”
“That’s right, I came here today to warn you!” Sadie replied arrogantly, then stepped forward and said to Connor disdainfully, “I’m very grateful to you for saving us that day. I’m grateful for this. I think Sabrina is with you because of her sympathy and gratitude. But feelings mean nothing. Sooner or later, she will understand that you’re not for her. Once that time comes, it won’t be good for you or her.”
Connor looked at Sadie, not knowing what to say.
Sadie continued, “Connor, I know your situation very well. I know that you are an orphan, and you work as a delivery guy to support yourself. You and Sabrina are too different. You are not from the same world and can’t make her happy. People like you don’t deserve to be with Sabrina. Do you understand what I mean?”
Connor couldn’t help but smile after hearing Sadie’s words.
“What are you smiling at? Did I say something wrong?” Seeing Connor’s disdainful expression, Sadie seemed a little unhappy.
“Sadie, 1 think you’re looking down on me a little too much. You don’t know me at all. How do you know that 1 can’t make Sabrina happy? Besides, this is between Sabrina and me. It has nothing to do with you. I hope you won’t bother me anymore. Do you understand what I mean?” Connor said to Sadie coldly.
After Sadie heard Connor’s words, she couldn’t help but be stunned momentarily and was in disbelief
She had never thought that Connor would be so unyielding.
Connor had been patient with Sadie because of Candace.
However, Sadie’s words made Connor very uncomfortable.
Even if Connor wasn’t with Sabrina, he still had to fight back against Sadie.
After saying this, Connor turned around and left without any hesitation.
Only Sadie was left standing there in shock.
She had never thought Connor would use such a tone to talk to her.
“Connor, no matter what you say now, it’s useless. You and Sabrina are not from the same world. You may be very confident in yourself now, but this is your opinion. You don’t deserve to be with Sabrina at all.
“I don’t know where your confidence comes from, but you’re not worthy of Sabrina now. I’ll stop you from being with Sabrina!”
After that, Sadie’s eyes flashed with determination.
***
Connor went back to the classroom alone after leaving Sadie behind.
When Dominic and Spencer saw that Connor had returned, they quickly surrounded Connor and began to gossip about the relationship between Sadie and Connor.
“Connor, is that girl your new girlfriend? Did she hear about you and Sabrina, so she came over to scold you?” Dominic grinned and asked Connor.
“Bro, what are you thinking about every day?” Connor replied to Dominic helplessly, then said in a low voice, “This girl is my friend. She’s best friends with Sabrina. She’s the reason 1 know Sabrina…”
“I see!” After Dominic heard Connor’s explanation, he nodded thoughtfully and did not continue to ask anything.
To Dominic, Connor should not be with Sabrina.
After all, Sabrina was considered a very famous girl at Porthampton University.
No matter who it was, they would feel proud to be with Sabrina.
If Connor was really together with Sabrina, Connor did not have to hide it.
The matter between Connor and Sabrina gradually calmed down in the next few days. Many people have forgotten about it.
Shane was still pursuing Sabrina crazily, but he had never caused trouble for Connor.
Shane had investigated Connor and found Connor was just a poor loser.
After that incident, Connor never looked for Sabrina again.
This meant that they were not together. Otherwise, Connor would have gone to look for Sabrina.
As for the Harold Dominic had reminded Connor about, he had naturally never appeared.
Therefore, Connor’s life gradually returned to normal.
It was as if nothing had happened on Rachel’s side. Rachel didn’t even take the initiative to look for Connor.
Connor naturally gave up on the idea of continuing to investigate Rachel. After all, Connor knew very well that it would be very difficult to find anything even if he investigated.
In the blink of an eye, it was the weekend again.
Connor began considering whether to go to Borealis City again to understand Weaver Corporation.
After all, Connor had left in a hurry. He had not properly understood their situation.
However, as Connor was thinking about these, his phone suddenly rang.
Connor looked at the name on the phone, ‘Madison’, and a trace of helplessness flashed in his eyes.
He couldn’t guess why Madison would contact him..

chapters.title: Chapter 633: An Invitation To The Auction
chapters.content:
Chapter 633: An Invitation To The Auction
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation | Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
When Connor saw that it was Madison calling, he could not help but hesitate.
But in the end, he still picked up the phone and asked softly, “What’s up?”
“Connor, are you free tomorrow night?” Madison asked directly.
“Tomorrow night?” Connor was surprised.
“Yes, there’s an auction tomorrow night. I want to invite you!” Madison replied.
“…” Connor hesitated, seemingly intending to refuse.
After all, Connor was not very interested in auctions.
“There will be many big shots coming to participate in this auction. Moreover, the venue will be in Porthampton. The main purpose is to help them expand their connections and network with each other. Of course, there will be many strange things appearing in this auction. If you are interested, you can come and participate…” Hearing that Connor did not speak, Madison continued.
“Well, I’m not very interested in auctions. Forget it,” Connor rejected politely.
First of all, Connor did not want to buy anything. As for expanding his social circle, this kind of thing was useless to Connor.
Therefore, Connor did not want to participate in this so-called auction.
“No, you have to come to this auction!” Madison said enthusiastically.
After hearing Madison’s words, Connor was stunned. Then, he asked, puzzled, “Why do I have to attend this auction?”
“There’s no reason. You have to participate…” Madison calmly replied to Connor.
“Girl, you should at least give me a reason to invite me to the auction, right?” Connor said helplessly.
“A reason?” After hearing this, Madison hesitated before saying, “Air, forget it. I’ll tell you the truth. It’s my grandfather who wants you to attend this auction. If you don’t come, my grandfather will blame me.”
“That’s why you want me to attend the auction, right?” Connor asked helplessly.
“That’s right. This is a mission that my grandfather arranged for me. If I can’t complete this mission, my grandfather will scold me…” Madison said pitifully.
“What will you do if I rejected the invite?” Connor hesitated before asking.
“If you reject my request, I’ll reveal your identity. By then, I’ll see what you can do…” Madison said with a smile.
“So go ahead!” Connor replied indifferently and then hung up the phone.
Now Rachel already knew Connor’s identity, so Connor wasn’t worried about Madison revealing his identity.
As for the auction that Madison mentioned, Connor was not interested at all. After all, he did not need anything now.
Moreover, to Connor, these so-called social auctions were a scam. Only those rich country bumpkins would participate.
Although Connor was very rich now, he had never considered attending an auction to squander.
After Madison saw Connor hang up on her phone, she suddenly became embarrassed and angry.
Her eyes widened as she pouted and scolded the phone, “Connor, you b*stard. Don’t think that I’ll be afraid of you just because you have some money! I wouldn’t have called you if it weren’t for my grandfather. Damn Connor, it’s up to you whether you want to come…” After saying this, Madison threw her phone to the side.
‘Ring, ring!’
Madison had just tossed her phone away when it rang again.
After hearing the phone’s ringtone, Madison was surprised. Then, she said smugly, “Humph, regretting, I see! Calling me and apologizing, right? I won’t give you that chance…”
After saying this, Madison turned around and walked into the bathroom. Then, she took off her clothes and began to take a shower.
Half an hour later, Madison exited the bathroom with a towel wrapped around her.
When Madison saw that her phone was still ringing non-stop, a smug smile appeared on her face. Then, she said lightly, “Forget it, forget it. Since you want to apologize to me sincerely, I’ll give you a chance…”
After saying this, Madison walked to the sofa and picked up her phone.
“What’s up? Going back on your words?” Madison did not even look at who was calling her and asked proudly.
“Going back on my words? What words?” However, it was not Connor’s voice on the other end of the phone, but Luke’s.
Madison was stunned when she heard Luke’s voice. She stuttered, “Grandpa, it’s you?”
“Who else could it be?” Luke replied.
“Grandpa, why are you calling me?” Madison asked despite knowing the answer.
“Uhm, Maddy, I might not be able to attend the auction in two days. I have to go abroad. When Mr. McDonald comes, you must treat him well. You can’t neglect him like last time, understand?” Luke advised.
After hearing Luke’s words, Madison was stunned, and a trace of helplessness flashed in her eyes.
Connor didn’t promise Madison that he would attend the auction.
“Maddy, you have informed Mr. McDonald about this, right?”
Luke asked softly when Madison didn’t speak.
“All, yes! I’ve informed him…” Madison replied instinctively.
“Good…” Luke was relieved to hear this, and then he said, “Maddy, Mr. McDonald is really very important to the Phillips Family, so you must have a good relationship with him. Although I don’t force you to marry Mr. McDonald now, it’s a good thing if you can marry him. If you can’t be together, you have to be friends. Do you understand what 1 mean?”
“All, Grandpa, 1 know. Save your breath. I’m going to take a shower now. Bye!” Madison replied helplessly and then ended the call.
After hanging up, Madison held her phone. She began to feel conflicted. For a moment, she did not know what to do.

chapters.title: Chapter 634: Madison’s Threats
chapters.content:
Chapter 634: Madison’s Threats
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation | Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Although Madison had publicly announced that she was gay, many people were still pursuing her.
No matter how amazing a man was, he would always think of ways to please Madison.
It was just that Madison wasn’t very interested in these men.
However, Connor’s appearance changed Madison’s view of men.
The first time the two met, they had extremely ambiguous physical contact, and Madison found that she didn’t seem to hate Connor that much.
Then, Madison discovered Connor’s identity, which made the relationship between Madison and Connor even more subtle.
“That damned Connor. He hung up on me and still hasn’t called me back…” Madison looked at her phone and gritted her teeth, looking very angry.
“Since you won’t call me, I’ll call you. No matter what, you have to come to this auction. Otherwise, how am I going to explain it to my grandfather?” Madison muttered softly, then took out her phone and dialed Connor’s number.
‘Ding!’
A cold female voice came through shortly after the phone rang. “Sorry, the number you have dialed is temporarily unavailable. Please try again later…” “Damn, Connor, how dare you hang up on me?” Madison snorted coldly and redialed Connor’s number.
Connor, who was in class, had already hung up on Madison several times.
However, he realized that Madison was still calling. In the end, Connor had no choice but to answer the phone and whispered, “Girl, what are you doing? I’m in class. Can you stop harassing me…”
“Class?” After hearing Connor’s words, Madison couldn’t help but be stunned. Then, she surprisedly asked, “You’re a student?”
“Girl, of course, I’m still a student. Do I look that old?” Connor replied helplessly and then continued, “What do you want? If you’re fine, I’m hanging up!”
“Hey, don’t hang up!” Seeing that Connor was about to hang up the phone again, Madison hurriedly called out and continued, “Connor, you must attend this auction tomorrow…”
“Girl, haven’t I already made things very clear to you? I’m not interested in this auction. Why are you so insistent about it?” Connor said helplessly.
“Because my grandfather gave me this mission. If I didn’t call you over, my grandfather would scold me. I will be scolded again…” Madison explained. “What does it have to do with me that you’re being scolded?” Connor replied.
“I was scolded because of you. How is it none of your business?” Madison said unreasonably.
“In any case, I do not have the time. I will not participate in this auction…” Connor replied indifferently and continued, “If there’s nothing else, I’ll hang up!”
“Connor, if you don’t come to this auction, I’ll go to your school now and tell everyone that you molested me in the private room that day. I want to see how you’ll behave then. If you still don’t come, I’ll call the police and say you raped me…” Madison said fiercely.
After hearing Madison’s words, Connor was stunned and helpless.
“Girl, I don’t think we have any enmity, right?” he asked in a low voice.
“You and I do not have any. However, if you do not participate in the auction, there will be…” Madison thought for a moment and replied indifferently.
“Why did you insist on sending me to that auction? Is it that important whether
I attend this auction or not?” Connor’s eyes widened as he spoke agitatedly.
After hearing Connor’s words, Dominic and Spencer turned to look at Connor. “Bro, what are you doing? We’re still in class…” Dominic shouted at Connor helplessly.
Connor turned to look at Madison and whispered, “Madison, what do you want? Believe it or not, I’ll call your grandfather right now…”
“If you dare to, I’ll go to your school right now and tell everyone that you raped me!” Madison said agitatedly.
“Phew…” Connor took a deep breath, frustrated, and he said in a low voice, “Girl, I really have to give in to you. I promise you that 1 will go to the auction, okay?”
“Really?” Madison asked in surprise when she heard Connor’s acceptance.
“Yes, really. I’m so done. Can you stop bothering me?” Connor said desperately.
“That’s really great…” Madison replied with a smile and then continued, “I’ll drive to pick you up tomorrow night?”
“It’s best if you don’t come and pick me up…” Connor refused and continued, “Just tell me the address. I’ll go there myself…”
Connor knew very well that a beautiful woman like Madison would be the center of attention no matter where she went.
If she came to school, she would attract much attention.
Moreover, gossip would spread throughout the school if Madison drove a luxury car.
The matter between Connor and Sabrina had already spread like wildfire. It would be even more difficult to explain if Madison were added to the mix. Therefore, Connor felt that it was better for him to go over alone.
“That’s fine too. I’ll tell the security personnel in advance. You have to say your name and you can go in!” Madison knew that Connor was joking with her, so she said happily.
“All right, I got it. I’m in class now. Don’t call me again!” Connor replied helplessly and then hung up the phone.
After the phone call, Dominic turned to look at Connor and then asked Connor in a puzzled tone, “Connor, who were you on the phone with just now?”
“A friend of mine asked me to go and hang out with her tomorrow night…” Connor said lightly.
“Is it a man or a woman?” Dominic asked curiously.
Hearing Dominic’s question, a trace of helplessness flashed in his eyes. He whispered, “Woman…”
“She hot?” Dominic became even more excited as he asked with a smile.
II?? II
Connor turned and looked at Dominic indifferently, not knowing what to say. “Can you bring me along?” Dominic continued after seeing that Connor was silent.
“You should go do what you need to do!” Connor turned to look at Dominic and said helplessly..

chapters.title: Chapter 635: Grand Hotel
chapters.content:
Chapter 635: Grand Hotel
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation | Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
The next day, at 7 PM.
After Connor left the school, he took a bus to Grand Hotel.
Grand Hotel was located in the suburbs of Porthampton. The environment was beautiful and quiet. Many rich people in Porthampton liked to spend money there.
Although Grand Hotel was located in the suburbs, it was a very high-end hotel in Porthampton.
Although this Grand Hotel looked like a hotel on the surface, it had many entertainment facilities.
Simply put, one could do anything for fun here.
As long as one had money, one could enjoy all kinds of services here.
When Connor arrived at Grand Hotel, luxury cars were parked in front of Grand
Hotel, most of which were luxury sports cars.
Even high-end cars like Mercedes-Benz and BMW looked shabby alongside these luxury cars.
At this moment, many luxury cars that Connor had never seen before appeared in the parking lot.
From this, the people attending today’s auction were rich people from
Porthampton.
This auction gave off an extremely high-end feeling. It was similar to Madison’s birthday party, except that all the people who attended Madison’s birthday party were from Borealis City.
The cars parked in front of Grand Hotel all had Porthampton license plates. Unexpectedly, Madison was right. Those who came to the auction today were indeed rich people from Porthampton.
Connor looked at the luxury cars in the parking lot and couldn’t help but sigh softly. Then, he walked toward the entrance of Grand Hotel.
A moment later, Connor arrived at the entrance of Grand Hotel.
At this moment, two uniformed men were standing at the door. Because Grand Hotel was open to the public, the security work was naturally not as strict as it was at Madison’s birthday party.
After Connor said that Madison invited him, the security guard let Connor in.
After entering the hotel, Connor found that the decoration inside Grand Hotel was very luxurious.
The grand hall was decorated with complicated and bright lights. It was like a high-end hotel.
Although there were many big hotels in Porthampton, very few were as good as Grand Hotel.
The auction was held at 8 PM, and it was only 7 PM, but the hotel lobby was already filled with all kinds of rich people.
No matter how these people dressed, they all gave off a noble and gorgeous feeling. One look and one could tell that they were so-called successful people. These people were chatting with each other in groups of three to five. After Connor entered the hall, he found he was a little out of place with these people. This was also why Connor had never liked attending such gatherings.
Connor walked around the hall and then came to a corner.
He was surprised to find many young people in the hall. These young people were about the same age as Connor. They probably relied on their parents to participate in the auction.
The adults had their social circles, and the young people naturally had their small circles.
Therefore, these people were all communicating with each other. Compared to these people, Connor was a little different.
This was because Connor wasn’t wearing a formal suit at this time, and he came in alone.
After Connor entered, he instantly attracted the attention of many people, but no one took the initiative to talk to him.
To them, people like Connor were not qualified to be in their circle.
Connor naturally didn’t care about these things. He saw the food in the corner of the hall, so he walked to the front of the dining cart and started eating.
The food at today’s party was delicious. Not only were there pastries but there were also staple foods.
Boston lobster, filet mignon, and all kinds of high-end food were delicately placed on the dining car.
However, very few people would come to eat these things. After all, most people came to this gathering to expand their social circle. No one came for food.
Connor had not eaten tonight and was a little hungry.
Therefore, he did not care about the strange looks of others and began to wine and dine.
There weren’t many people around the dining cart, so Connor was still very comfortable.
However, just as Connor burped and was about to pour himself a glass of red wine, he suddenly heard high heels clicking against the floor.
Immediately after, a familiar female voice sounded behind Connor.
“Connor, why are you here?”
After Connor heard this, a trace of surprise flashed in his eyes.
This voice was very special; Connor could tell it was Sabrina s.
Connor turned and looked at Sabrina. He smiled faintly and said helplessly,
“It’s you?”
“That’s right. I also did not expect to meet you here…” Sabrina walked quickly to Connor and said with a smile.
“I didn’t expect the two of us to be so fated to meet here…” Connor said softly. “That’s right, what a coincidence. Are you here to participate in the auction?
Sabrina blinked charmingly and asked gently.
“Yes…” Connor nodded lightly, then picked up a glass of red wine and drank it himself.
Sabrina hesitated. She could not help but remember what happened at the cultural gala that day. Her pretty face blushed, and she said softly, “Connor, I didn’t fall on purpose that day at the cultural gala…”
When Connor heard Sabrina’s words, he could not help but laugh. He said softly, “Don’t worry, I know you didn’t fall on purpose that day.
“Oh, good…” Sabrina quickly nodded and sized up Connor. She changed the topic and said, “I came here today with Sadie and the others. They told me many interesting things would be auctioned, so we came over to look. 1 didn’t expect to meet you here…”
Sabrina paused before continuing, “Are you going to attend the auction to purchase something? Or did you come with a friend?”
“How can he have the money to buy anything? I’m afraid he can’t even afford a bottle cap with his little money. There’s nothing so cheap in this auction…” Before Connor could answer Sabrina’s question, Sadie approached them and said disdainfully.
Connor looked up at the arrogant girl before him as a strange look flashing in his eyes..

chapters.title: Chapter 636: Sabrina’s Boyfriend?
chapters.content:
Chapter 636: Sabrina’s Boyfriend?
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation | Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
What Sadie said just now was indeed very excessive.
Connor had been tolerating Sadie, but she was acting more and more like a brat. He now had a very bad impression of her.
Connor hesitated for a moment, then said expressionlessly, “You’re right. I really can’t afford the things in the auction. I’m only here for the food and drink, but 1 didn’t expect the food in this hotel to be so good, especially the filet steak. It’s very delicious. Do you want to try it?”
When Sadie heard Connor’s words, a trace of anger flashed across her eyes.
She had never thought that Connor would be so shameless to say such things
so blatantly!
“Is the steak really delicious?”
Sabrina asked Connor softly.
“It’s pretty good. Do you want to try it?”
Connor smiled and replied.
“Sure, 1 haven’t had dinner yet…”
Sabrina replied with a smile. Then, she picked up her fork and started to eat
her filet.
Sadie, who was not far away, saw how intimate Connor and Sabrina were. A trace of anger flashed across her eyes.
She could not help but snort coldly, as if she was planning something.
At this moment, a few people in the crowd noticed Connor and Sabrina.
A few sexy beauties in evening gowns gathered together and looked at Connor and Sabrina.
One of them was slightly older and was wearing a black strapless evening gown. Her tall and sexy figure seemed to be even more obvious under the evening gown. It felt as if her entire body was emitting an irresistible temptation.
At this moment, a strange look flashed across the sexy beauty’s eyes.
“Who is that guy?”
One of the girls asked with a puzzled expression.
When the sexy beauty heard this, she couldn’t help but frown and say softly, “Is that guy Sabrina’s friend? Why didn’t she introduce him to us?”
-Look, Sabrina and that guy seem to be close with each other. Could he be her boyfriend?”
“No way. He looks rustic, and he dresses like a loser. Why would she like such a boy?”
A few girls started to discuss softly, as if they were very curious about the relationship between Connor and Sabrina.
These girls were very good friends with Sabrina, Sadie, and the others. They had known each other since they were young. However, they went to different universities, so it was difficult for them to get together.
Today was a good opportunity for everyone to gather together.
Therefore, when they saw how close Connor and Sabrina were, they were very puzzled.
Just as everyone was curious about the relationship between Connor and Sabrina, a beautiful woman in a white short skirt walked in front of everyone and said, “This guy isn’t her boyfriend. He’s just a poor kid. Back then, he had to make a living by delivering food outside the school…”
When everyone heard this, they all turned to look at the beauty with disbelief on their faces.
The person who spoke was none other than Yara, who had met Connor before. Yara didn’t have a good impression of Connor, so she naturally wanted to take this opportunity to humiliate him.
“Delivery?”
After hearing Yara’s words, everyone was in disbelief.
They all knew that Sabrina had always had high standards and had many outstanding suitors around her. However, they were all rejected by Sabrina. However, Sabrina was actually chatting happily with a poor delivery boy. This was indeed beyond everyone’s expectations.
“Yara, you can’t say such things!”
At this moment, the sexy beauty in a black evening gown walked up and said.
“Laila, I’m not talking nonsense. What I said just now is true. If you don’t believe me, you can go to the Porthampton University to ask around. That kid’s name is Connor. Anyone from Porthampton University knows him…”
Yara looked at the crowd and hurriedly explained.
When everyone heard Yara’s words, they were all stunned.
They really did not understand what was going on.
“Is Sabrina crazy? How could she fall in love with such a person?”
“That’s right. There are so many rich guys she’s rejected. Why is she with such a loser? Sabrina must be crazy…”
A few girls couldn’t help but start discussing softly.
“I don’t know what Sabrina is thinking either. She has actually fallen for such a poor kid. Also, she seems to have been deceived by that guy. She’s completely smitten by him. No matter what Sadie and I say, she won’t listen to us now…”
Yara said when she saw the expressions on everyone’s faces.
“Is this kid really Sabrina’s boyfriend?”
Everyone was shocked when they heard Yara’s words.
Sabrina’s standards had always been very high, even when compared to the
rich and beautiful women.
They were also curious about what kind of guy Sabrina would choose to be with in the end.
However, what surprised everyone was that Sabrina actually chose to be with such a loser. It was indeed unbelievable.
There were even a few girls who felt that it was a loss for Sabrina!
“Sabrina is such a good person. She can get any guys she wants. Why did she have to be with this loser? I really don’t understand what she’s thinking…”
One of the girls could not help but mutter softly.
“Sabrina is still too naive. She’s being deceived by such a poor loser. The two of them will definitely not have a good ending. The two of them are from different worlds!”
Another girl added.
After all, whether it was Sabrina or anyone else, they all came from well-to-do families.
Although they weren’t considered rich, they were definitely not from ordinary families. Therefore, it was normal for them to look down on Connor.
The sexy beauty called Laila hesitated for a moment before saying softly, “Sabrina is still young and immature. It’s actually very normal for her to fall in love with such a boy, but we can’t watch her be deceived like this.. If there’s a chance in the future, we must talk to Sabrina and persuade her!

chapters.title: Chapter 637: Harold Phillips
chapters.content:
Chapter 637: Harold Phillips
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation | Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
This girl, who everyone called Laila, was Laila Williams.
She was the big sister of the group of girls. These girls had always been very obedient to Laila.
When everyone heard Laila’s words, they followed suit and said, “That’s right, Laila. You have to persuade Sabrina. If she just enjoys herself with him in university, then it’s fine. But if they really get together, the two of them are from different worlds, so even if they really get married in the end, they won’t be happy…”
Laila looked at everyone and nodded slightly. Then, she narrowed her eyes and looked at Connor. No one knew what she was thinking.
Laila had already graduated from university and was working in her father’s company.
Back then, when she was in university, she had also met a guy. The boy’s family background was not very good. In order to be with this guy, Laila quarreled with her family for a long time before finally getting her family to agree to them getting married.
However, before they could get married, they broke up because of some problems.
Laila later found out that the guy just wanted her money and to sleep with her.
The guy tried his best to sleep with Laila, but she had always insisted on waiting until they got married.
Seeing Laila’s persistence, the boy decisively chose to give up and ran away with another girl.
Laila was also ridiculed by everyone for a long time because of this matter.
She felt that all men were like this, so she hated men very much now.
Of course, Connor did not know that he was being targeted. He was still chatting happily with Sabrina.
On the other side, at the entrance of the Grand Hotel.
A black Hummer SUV stopped at the entrance of the hotel.
A muscular young man in a white suit jumped out of the Hummer and turned to ask his companion, “Are you sure that Sabrina will come today?”
“Harold, don’t worry. I’ve already made a call to confirm it. Sabrina is in the hall now. There won’t be any problems…”
“Alright, let’s go in…”
The young man nodded and walked straight into the hotel.
There were quite a lot of people attending the auction today, but in the end, they were divided into two groups.
The people standing in the middle of the hall were some big shots in Porthampton. They came to the auction today to expand their social circle and look for opportunities for cooperation.
Sometimes, a huge business deal worth tens of millions was negotiated at such a gathering.
In the corner of the hall stood a large group of young men and women. Most of these young people had come with their parents to participate in the auction.
The reason why they came to this auction was just to broaden their horizons.
In the circle of young people, Sabrina and Sadie, two very beautiful girls, naturally attracted a lot of attention.
The girls there had many admirers, but Sadie and Sabrina were probably the ones with the highest number of admirers.
When the young people saw Sabrina and Sadie surrounding Connor, they all felt puzzled.
Because they really couldn’t understand who Connor was to be able to make two great beauties surround him at the same time.
“Who is that guy?”
“I don’t know. I’ve never seen him before. He’s probably not a local in Porthampton!”
“He’s definitely not a local. If he was a local, I would have definitely seen him before. But 1 can see that he seems to be very close to Sabrina.”
Everyone began to discuss in low voices.
However, at this time, some people recognized Connor. After all, Connor was studying at Porthampton University.
Many of the people attending the auction today were students from the Porthampton University.
“That guy is a student in Porthampton University. I heard that his family is quite poor…”
One of the boys said in a low voice.
“Bro, are you kidding me? If that guy’s family was really poor, why would Sabrina be with him?”
Another boy quickly retorted.
“I don’t know why she would like him, but a few days ago, at our school’s welcoming party, Sabrina hugged him in front of everyone…”
At this moment, a youth with a buzz cut said enviously.
“Are you two joking with me?”
“Why would I joke about this… Of course, I’m telling the truth. If you don’t believe me, you can go to our school and ask around. Anyone who attended the cultural gala knows about this…”
“Oh my God, is Sabrina crazy?”
“Why would she like such a person?”
“That’s right. That guy doesn’t look like a rich person. The clothes he’s wearing are just street goods…”
“I didn’t expect our Goddess Sabrina to be snatched away by this guy. This guy is really brave…”
At this moment, many of Sabrina’s admirers were furious when they found out that she was with Connor.
After all, they had been pursuing Sabrina for a long time, but they had never succeeded.
At this moment, Sabrina was actually taken by a poor kid who came out of nowhere. They must be very jealous!
“Don’t worry. If Harold finds out that Sabrina is with this kid, he will definitely not let this kid off. We’ll have a good show to watch then…”
One of the young men laughed.
“That’s right. It’s a pity that Harold isn’t here today. If Harold was here, then it would be an interesting night…”
They really wanted to watch a good show.
The Harold that everyone was talking about was actually the Harold that Dominic Turner had reminded Connor about back then. This Harold was also a member of the Phillips Family.
Harold Phillips relied on his relationship with the Phillips Family and had always been very arrogant and despotic.
Harold had once broken the legs of a guy who was pursuing Sabrina, and that guy had never appeared since then. Some even said that Harold had already killed that guy.
This matter quickly spread in the circle. From then on, even if many people secretly liked Sabrina, they did not dare to compete with Harold.
Because they knew very well that offending Harold meant disaster!

chapters.title: Chapter 638: Killing Two Birds with One Stone
chapters.content:
Chapter 638: Killing Two Birds with One Stone
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation1 Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Harold had always been ruthless and never cared about the consequences.
So, even though many people liked Sabrina, they did not dare to openly pursue her.
This was because they knew that if they pursued Sabrina, it would be equivalent to offending Harold.
Offending Harold in Davenport was basically no different from courting death! However, Shane Zimmerman was an exception. After all, his family background was very strong, so Shane was not afraid of Harold at all.
If Harold saw Shane and Sabrina together, he would be furious, but he would not dare to do anything to Shane.
After all, the two of them had already agreed to compete fairly.
Most of them felt that Sabrina would definitely choose between Harold and Shane.
However, no one had expected that another guy would actually appear at this time. The two of them would definitely not let Connor off easily.
At this moment, Shane was also at the auction, but he did not notice Connor and Sabrina.
He was following behind a dignified middle-aged man, smiling as he chatted with the bosses in the hall.
1 hese bosses might not be very powerful nationwide, but they were still very influential in a small place like Davenport.
The middle-aged man standing in front of Shane was none other than Shane’s father.
Shane’s father was a very famous entrepreneur in Davenport. He was taking the opportunity to introduce Shane to his business partner so that Shane could take over his business in the future.
At this moment, a man secretly ran to Shane’s side and gave him a look. When Shane saw the expression on the man’s face, he quickly turned and whispered to his father. Then, he walked up to the man and frowned. He said impatiently, “What do you want? Can’t you see that I’m busy right now?” “Shane, guess who I saw just now?”
The man asked Shane excitedly,
