“Cut the f*cking nonsense. If you have something to say, just say it!”
Shane replied impatiently.
“I saw that brat Connor just now…”
The man grinned and said.
“Connor?”
When Shane heard the man’s words, he was stunned for a moment. He was a little puzzled. He seemed to have forgotten who Connor was.
“Shane, have you forgotten?”
The man said helplessly when he saw Shane’s reaction.
“Who is Connor?”
Shane couldn’t help but ask in a low voice.
“Shane, how could you forget about Connor?”
The man shouted anxiously and continued, “Shane, this Connor is the guy who hugged Sabrina at the cultural gala!”
“Him?”
When Shane recalled who Connor was, a hint of anger flashed in his eyes.
Connor hugged Sabrina in front of so many people at the cultural gala.
This was something Shane could not get over.
“Why is that kid here?”
Shane asked expressionlessly.
“I don’t know. I saw Connor and Sabrina eating and chatting at the dining area
just now. The two of them looked very intimate…”
The man hurriedly replied.
When Shane heard this, he was stunned.
He could not help but frown and ask, “Are you sure? I’ve investigated that kid before. He’s just a poor loser delivering food. How could he attend an auction? He shouldn’t be qualified to participate in the auction!”
“I don’t know how he came in either. There are many company presidents who are not qualified to participate in this auction. I suspect that the kid might have sneaked in…”
The man analyzed in a low voice.
Shane nodded lightly and said expressionlessly, “That’s also possible, but what does it have to do with me if he’s here? My father is here now. If I find trouble with this kid, my father will definitely be very angry.”
After saying this, Shane turned around and was about to leave.
Although Shane liked Sabrina, he had always been a rational person. He knew that now was not the time to deal with Connor.
“Shane, wait a moment!”
When the man saw that Shane was about to leave, he quickly reached out and pulled Shane.
When Shane heard this, he could not help but be stunned. He turned to look at the guy and asked in a puzzled tone, “What is it?”
“Shane, I haven’t finished speaking. Why are you in such a hurry to leave?”
The man grinned and replied, then continued, “Shane, you do not need to personally deal with this Connor this time around…”
“Why not?”
When Shane heard this, he could not help but be stunned. Then, he asked the man with a puzzled expression, “What do you mean by that?”
Shane, if Harold knows that Sabrina and Connor are together, how will he react?” The man asked with a grin.
A strange look flashed across Shane’s eyes.
“Shane, I’ve already called Harold’s friend. 1 told him that Sabrina is at the
auction now. Harold will probably be here soon…”
The man paused for a moment before continuing, “If Harold comes over later and sees how intimate Sabrina is with this guy, based on Harold’s personality, he will definitely not let this kid off easily. When that time comes, we just need to watch the show…”
“Are you sure Harold will come?”
Shane asked in a low voice.
“Of course. Don’t you know Harold’s temper?”
The man said with a playful expression.
“Haha…”
When Shane heard the guy’s words, he immediately sneered and continued, “That’s pretty smart. Not only can we deal with that brat, but we also don’t need to do it ourselves…”
“I’ve grown smarter thanks to you, bro…”
The man smiled and continued, “Shane, everything I’ve done is so that you can successfully win Sabrina’s heart. If Connor and Harold fight, Sabrina will definitely not consider the two of them…”
“Don’t worry. If Sabrina really gives up on Connor and Harold because of this matter, I will definitely remember your contribution…”
Shane replied expressionlessly.
At this moment, the man suddenly looked at the entrance of the hotel.
Harold was leading two burly men into the hall aggressively..

chapters.title: Chapter 639 - Do You Have a Death Wish?
chapters.content:
Do You Have a Death Wish?
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation | Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
When the man saw Harold walk into the hall with his men, he quickly turned to Shane and said, “Shane, look, Harold’s men are coming!”
Shane slowly raised his head to take a look and realized that it was really Harold.
“This is going to be a good show!”
When Shane saw Harold enter, he could not help but sneer.
“Shane, should we go over and talk to Harold?”
The man hesitated for a moment before asking Shane softly.
Shane thought about it for a moment and said, “If we go over now, Harold will definitely find out that we’re using him. After all, Harold is not a fool. Let’s just pretend that nothing has happened and wait to watch the show…”
“That’s true. Shane, you’re way smarter than I am…”
The man grinned at Shane.
On the other side, Connor and Sabrina were discussing what was delicious.
Sadie Colt had been following behind the two of them the whole time, and she was getting impatient.
She wanted Sabrina to leave with her, but Sabrina refused to leave.
This gave Sadie a headache. She really could not understand what was so good about Connor that he could charm Sabrina to such an extent.
“Sabrina, the auction is about to start. Let’s go over!”
Sadie hesitated for a moment and whispered to Sabrina.
When Sabrina heard this, she took out her phone and said softly, “The auction has not started yet. I will stay with Connor for a while longer. There is no hurry…”
When Sadie heard Sabrina’s words, she froze on the spot. She looked helpless and did not know what to say.
“Connor, this dessert is not bad. Try it…”
Sabrina picked up a piece of dessert and placed it in front of Connor.
Not far away, Harold’s eyes flashed with anger when he saw how intimate Sabrina and Connor were.
He quickly rushed to Sabrina and whispered, “Sabrina…”
“Harold?”
When Sabrina saw Harold, she could not help but open her mouth. She became nervous.
Sabrina was not afraid of Harold, but she was worried that Harold would cause trouble for Connor.
“Sabrina, 1 have something to tell you. Come with me…”
At this moment, Harold did not have Connor and Sadie in his eyes. He spoke to Sabrina with a very serious expression.
When Sabrina heard Harold’s words, a hint of confusion flashed across her eyes. Then, she said softly, “Harold, what do you want to tell me? Can’t we talk here?”
“Here?”
When Harold heard this, he could not help but be stunned for a moment. Then, he simply glanced at Connor and Sadie, and then said in an arrogant tone, “What are you two still standing here for? I have something to say to Sabrina. You two go do what you should do!”
Sadie naturally knew Harold. She knew that Harold was not someone to be trifled with.
Therefore, Sadie hesitated for a moment before turning around and leaving.
However, Connor remained standing there.
When Sadie saw that Connor didn’t move, she reached out and pulled Connor. She asked him in a low voice, “Connor, what are you still standing there for? Let’s go!”
“Why should I leave?”
Connor said lightly.
“You…”
Sadie was stunned when she heard Connor’s words. She was very helpless.
She quickly stepped forward and whispered to Connor, “Do you know who this person is? This person is not someone you can afford to provoke. Hurry up and leave with me!”
“I don’t want to leave now!”
Connor said lightly.
After hearing Connor’s words, Harold instantly became angry.
He turned his head and sized up Connor, then asked Connor in a low voice, “Kid, you’re Connor, right?”
“You know me?”
Connor replied indifferently.
“Hehe, I’ve heard about you. You’re a delivery man, right? Why aren’t you delivering food now? Are you picking up food from the hotel?”
Harold said arrogantly to Connor.
“Hahaha…”
When everyone heard Harold’s words, they all laughed out loud, and their gazes toward Connor became extremely disdainful.
Sadie looked at Connor with a hint of helplessness in her eyes.
She really couldn’t understand why Connor wanted to stay here. Wasn’t he asking to be humiliated by staying here?
“Brat, 1 advise you to scram now, or 1 will make you wish you were dead. Do you understand what I mean?”
Harold said to Connor expressionlessly.
When Connor heard Harold’s words, he could not help but smile faintly. Then, he said with a disdainful expression, “You’ll make me wish I were dead?”
“Haha…”
Harold did not take Connor seriously at all because he felt that Connor could not pose any threat to him at all.
Therefore, he sneered and turned to Sabrina. “Sabrina, come with me. 1 don’t want to talk nonsense with this kid. I have something to tell you…”
After saying that, Harold reached out to grab Sabrina’s arm and wanted to leave with her.
When Sabrina saw that Harold was about to grab her, she quickly took two steps back and hid behind Connor. She stared at him with her big watery eyes and shouted, “Harold, what are you doing? Didn’t 1 tell you just now? If you have anything to say, just say it here!”
Harold’s eyes flashed with a hint of helplessness. He took a step forward toward Sabrina.
Connor stood in front of Harold and whispered to him, “Didn’t you hear what Sabrina said? She doesn’t want to leave with you.”
“Get lost!”
Harold’s eyes widened as he shouted at Connor with a furious expression.
“If I don’t get lost, what can you do to me?”
Connor looked at Harold coldly and said calmly.
“Motherf*cker…”
Harold shouted and pushed Connor away.
However, after Harold gave him a push, he realized that Connor was still standing still.
Connor was quite fit. At the very least, he was not inferior to Harold.
When Harold saw that Connor was still standing on the spot, he became even angrier.
“What the f*ck do you mean, kid?” he shouted with his eyes wide open.. “Do you have a death wish?”

chapters.title: Chapter 640 - A Terrifying Identity
chapters.content:
A Terrifying Identity
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Harold sized up Connor and said with an extremely cold expression, “Brat, do you know the consequences of offending me?”
At this moment, Harold did not take Connor seriously at all.
“What will happen if I offend you?”
When Connor heard this, his face revealed disdain.
Because he did not take Harold’s words to heart at all. He said expressionlessly, “I’m a little curious now. What will happen if I offend you?
When Sadie heard Connor’s words, she felt unusually helpless.
She really could not understand what Connor was thinking. He actually dared
to offend someone like Harold!
Wasn’t this clearly courting death?
When Harold heard Connor’s words, he could not help but reveal a playful
smile.
in his eyes, Connor’s words were like the funniest joke in the world.
Harold sized up Connor and asked in a playful tone, “Brat, do you know who 1
am?”
“Who cares?”
Connor glanced at Harold indifferently and asked with a disdainful expression. “If you don’t know who 1 am, then let me tell you. My name is Harold Phillips, and my father is Bob Phillips…
“When 1 was eight years old, I went to the Ivory Battlefront with my dad!
“I was sent to the military academy when 1 was 18 years old. I’ve already graduated. I’ve seen many people like you. You might not care about my identity now, but if you really anger me, your ending will be very miserable. So
I advise you to not go out of line. Don’t make me angry…
Harold said arrogantly to Connor.
Connor looked at Harold indifferently and did not speak.
“You don’t believe me?”
Seeing that Connor didn’t have any reaction after knowing his identity, a trace of confusion flashed across his eyes, and then he continued, “If you don’t believe me, you can ask everyone here. How many of them dare to offend me…” “You seem to be very confident in your identity. Did you think that I would be afraid of you if you reveal your identity?”
Connor asked Harold with a smile.
When Harold heard Connor’s words, he could not help but be stunned for a moment. Then, he shouted with a straight face, “Kid, I don’t want to talk nonsense with you now. Get lost, do you hear me?
“If I don’t get lost, what can you do to me?”
Connor continued to stand in front of Sabrina with a calm expression.
When Sabrina heard this, she looked up at Connor with a strange look in her
eyes.
Originally, Sabrina thought that Connor would obediently move aside after hearing Harold’s words.
After all, very few people dared to go against Harold after knowing his identity.
However, what Sabrina did not expect was that Connor actually did not put
Harold in his eyes at all.
Before Harold appeared, many people had already started paying attention to
Connor and Sabrina.
At this moment, when everyone saw the conflict between Connor and Harold, they gathered around and stared at them.
It was as if everyone in the hall was looking at Connor and Harold right now.
“Why is Harold here?”
“I didn’t expect Harold to really come. Harold has been pursuing Sabrina, yet this guy has such a close relationship with Sabrina. Harold will definitely not let this guy off…”
“But 1 don’t think that guy is afraid of Harold. This guy’s background is
definitely not simple!”
“There’s going to be a good show today. Someone actually dares to offend Harold. I think this guy definitely won’t be able to walk out of the hotel…
At this time, the young people in the hall surrounded Harold and Connor and started discussing in low voices.
“1 don’t know what this guy is thinking. He actually dares to offend someone like Harold. Does he have a death wish?”
“He definitely doesn’t know Harold’s identity. If he knew Harold’s identity, he wouldn’t dare to offend Harold even if he had a hundred guts…”
“Who’s this Harold you’re talking about?”
Some of the young people who had just joined the circle did not know Harold
and asked with a puzzled expression.
“You don’t even know Harold?”
When his companion heard this, he shouted in surprise.
“I don’t…”
The young man hurriedly shook his head.
“Harold is Bob Phillips’s son. His father is a very powerful figure. Moreover, Harold is not someone to be trifled with. Someone offended him in Borealis City before, but Harold broke both his legs. Harold was completely fine. Harold is Sabrina’s admirer, and he has always been competing with Shane. In Davenport, only Shane dares to compete with him for Sabrina. That’s no different from having a death wish…”
Some people who knew Harold’s identity introduced him very patiently.
When everyone heard Harold’s identity, their mouths were wide open, and they were extremely shocked.
They didn’t think that Harold’s identity would be so terrifying!
“Harold is not a kind person. This brat actually dares to offend Harold? We just have to wait and watch a good show…”
Sadie stood in place with a helpless expression. She never thought that Connor would be so ignorant.
Originally, Sadie did not want to be a busybody. After all, she had nothing to do with Connor.
However, when she thought of Connor’s relationship with her mother, she could not bear to see anything happen to Connor.
Therefore, after a moment of hesitation, Sadie stepped forward and said to Harold, “Harold, don’t forget that this is the Grand Hotel. If you dare to cause trouble here, the people from the hotel will definitely not let you off…”
When Harold heard this, he turned to look at Sadie with a surprised expression.
He didn’t expect Sadie to stand up for Connor.
“Harold, Sabrina already told you just now that she doesn’t want to go with you. Can’t you just say what you want to say to her right here?
Seeing that Harold did not respond, Sadie continued saying.
When Harold heard Sadie’s words, a disdainful smile appeared on his face.
He turned to look at Sadie and said expressionlessly, “Sadie, this is between me and Sabrina. It has nothing to do with you. Mind your own business. I’ll not cause you any trouble for the sake of Sabrina..

chapters.title: Chapter 641 - 641 Mr. Larry Is Here
chapters.content:
Chapter 641 Mr. Larry Is Here
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
“You… you…”
Upon hearing Harold’s words, Sadie’s expression immediately turned embarrassed and ashamed.
She didn’t expect Harold to be so disrespectful towards her.
She felt somewhat powerless at this moment.
Harold took a step forward and approached Connor. He then spoke in a low voice, saying, “Kid, let me tell you something. The last person who dared to talk to me like this is still lying in the hospital. So today, you must pay the price!”
However, Connor’s expression showed a disdainful smile as he calmly asked, “What kind of price do you want me to pay?”
“You’ll find out soon enough…”
As Harold spoke, he walked toward Connor, as if he could strike at any moment.
Upon seeing the situation, Sabrina quickly rushed to Connor’s side and shouted at Harold, “Harold, what do you think you’re doing?”
“Sabrina, this has nothing to do with you. Step aside quickly. I must teach this Ind a lesson…” Harold said.
“Connor is my friend, so his matters are my matters too!” she quickly replied.
“I’m telling you to step aside. Can’t you hear me?”
Harold’s expression grew even angrier upon seeing her bias towards Connor.
While Sabrina’s eyes showed a hint of fear, she still mustered the courage to stand in front of Connor.
“What’s going on here? Why are you all standing here?”
“Who has the audacity to cause trouble inside our Grand Hotel?”
At that moment, a middle-aged man walked out from the crowd, his expression stern as he shouted.
Upon seeing this middle-aged man, the crowd s expressions turned to shock.
“Oh my, Mr. Larry is here…”
“It seems like this situation has really escalated. Mr. Larry has personally come out…”
“Yes, under normal circumstances, Mr. Larry wouldn’t come. His presence indicates that Grand Hotel takes this matter very seriously…”
“Now we’ll finally have a good show…”
After seeing this middle-aged man, the crowd whispered among themselves.
Meanwhile, Laila, who was not far away, showed a hint of surprise in her eyes upon seeing the middle-aged man.
She then turned to the person beside her and said, “This person is Mr. Larry from Grand Hotel. They say his influence in Porthampton is no less than Thomas’s. If he has come, it means Grand Hotel attaches great importance to today’s auction…”
“I heard that an important VIP is supposed to arrive, which is why Grand Hotel is taking it so seriously. If that VIP sees this scene, it won’t leave a good impression!” the person next to Laila quickly added.
“Now that the situation has escalated to this point, I want to see how they’re going to handle it. It would be best if they kicked Connor out of the auction. He’s simply not qualified to participate…” Yana pouted.
Harold turned his head and glanced at the middle-aged man, then smiled and greeted him, “Mr. Larry, hello!”
“Oh, isn’t this Mr. Harold? Why are you here?” Mr. Larry, upon seeing Harold, responded respectfully.
“Mr. Larry, I came here today to attend the auction…”
Harold quickly explained.
Mr. Larry hesitated for a moment, then looked at Connor and asked in a soft voice, “So, what’s the matter here?”
Harold was momentarily stunned, about to speak.
However, at this moment, a man suddenly reached out and patted Harold. Then, he gave Harold a look.
Harold’s eyes flashed with a trace of confusion. He did not know what he meant.
I he man took a step forward and whispered to Mr. Larry,” Mr. Larry, I’m Mr. Harold’s friend. Today’s matter is like this. Mr. Harold suspected thai this kid didn’t have an invitation card and had snuck in, so he wanted this person to show his invitation card, but he refused to show it…”
“No invitation?”
Mr. Larry could not help but be stunned when he heard this.
“Yes, Mr. Larry. We all suspect that there’s something wrong with this kid. Since you’re here, you can interrogate him properly. I think he must have come in to steal something…”
After Mr. Larry heard these people’s words, he turned his head to look at Harold. He frowned and asked Harold, “Mr. Harold, is that what happened?” “That’s right, that’s what happened. This kid must have come in to steal something. I hope you can chase him out as soon as possible!”
Harold shouted without thinking.
When Mr. Larry heard Harold’s words, he could not help but be stunned.
Then he turned his head and glanced at Connor, noticing that Connor was dressed very casually. He respectfully said to Harold, “Mr. Harold, please rest assured, I will handle this matter now…”
‘Okay!” Harold replied with a smile.
Mr. Larry walked directly to Connor and softly asked, “Sir, could you please
show me the invitation?”
Upon hearing Mr. Larry’s words, Connor couldn’t help but pause. He was called by Madison over the phone today, and he didn’t have an invitation at all.
It seemed that Sabrina also noticed Connor’s unusual expression and began to doubt whether he really had an invitation.
If he didn’t have an invitation, he would definitely be kicked out by the hotel staff.
So she hurriedly ran up to Mr. Larry and said, “Mr. Larry, what do you mean?
Are you asking Connor to show the invitation based solely on their words? Why
don’t Harold and the others have to show their invitations?”
Upon hearing this, Mr. Larry smiled faintly and said expressionlessly, “Miss, I’m sorry. Mr. Harold is our hotel’s guest, and 1 know him personally, so there’s no need for him to show the invitation…”
Upon hearing these words, she was instantly stunned.
Mr. Larry glanced at Connor and continued, “But I have no impression of this gentleman, and I personally sent out all the invitations for this auction. I have never sent an invitation to this person, so it’s normal for me to doubt his identity…”
“This person is called Connor, just a poor student from Porthampton University. He even has to work part-time as a delivery person to earn money.
How could he be qualified to attend such an auction?”
Harold couldn’t help but shout without hesitation.
After hearing the words of these two individuals, Sabrina’s expression instantly became desperate.
She had been wondering how Connor managed to enter the auction, and now, after hearing Harold and Mr. Larry’s words, she didn’t know what to do..

chapters.title: Chapter 642 - 642 I Don’t Have An Invitation!
chapters.content:
Chapter 642 I Don’t Have An Invitation!
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation | Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Everyone invited to the auction hosted by the Grand Hotel are influential figures in the Davenport.
Only those who received an invitation are considered successful individuals with social status and economic strength.
So not anyone can enter.
Even Sabrina didn’t have the qualifications to enter. She only got in by riding on Sadie’s coattails.
Sadie’s father, Tony, originally had the qualifications to attend this auction, but due to his busy schedule, he couldn’t make it. However, he didn’t want to disrespect Grand Hotel, so he asked Sadie to attend in his place.
Sabrina came along with Sadie.
Once everyone learned the situation, they all wore disdainful smiles and looked at Connor with scornful eyes.
“I think this kid sneaked in…”
“Yeah, how could he possibly have an invitation?”
“Look at his appearance, he doesn’t look like a wealthy person. How could he have the qualifications to attend the auction?”
“This kid has gotten himself into big trouble today. The people from Grand Hotel are not easy to deal with!”
“If he can’t show an invitation now, the people from Grand Hotel won’t let him off easily…”
The crowd began whispering to each other.
Harold’s expression seemed even more triumphant because he had achieved his desired outcome.
Mr. Lenny wore a displeased expression on his face as well since if Connor really sneaked in, he would also face punishment for dereliction of duty.
With a cold expression, Mr. Lenny asked Connor, “Sir, please present your invitation immediately, otherwise, I will have security escort you out…”
Connor slowly looked up at Mr. Lenny and calmly said, “I don’t have an invitation…”
Upon hearing his words, everyone froze in their tracks, their expressions filled with shock.
They had already guessed that Connor didn’t have an invitation.
But no one expected him to actually admit it!
Harold’s expression seemed even more smug upon hearing his words.
The way he looked at him now was as if he were looking at a lamb waiting to be slaughtered.
With extreme disdain, he said, “See? I told you this kid sneaked in. How could someone like him have the qualifications to attend the Grand Hotel auction?”
Upon hearing Connor’s words, Sabrina’s mouth fell open in disbelief. She stared at the scene, her expression filled with helplessness.
She couldn’t understand why he would admit to it, even if he didn’t have an invitation!
By admitting it, he was putting himself in trouble.
Mr. Lenny also didn’t expect Connor to admit it so readily. Clenching his teeth, he asked Connor in a low voice, “Since you don’t have an invitation, how did you get in?”
At this point, Mr. Lenny already treated Connor as a thief since he was the front desk manager of Grand Hotel.
Someone had sneaked in without his knowledge.
If the hotel owner found out about this, he wouldn’t escape blame either.
Thinking about it, Mr. Lenny’s back began to sweat.
He couldn’t help but silently feel fortunate that they discovered it early, before any major incidents occurred. Otherwise, if something valuable went missing, it would be an unaffordable loss for him.
After all, everything at the auction was of priceless value. If anything went missing, it would be beyond his ability to compensate.
Shane squinted his eyes as he looked at Connor’s position, wearing a smug expression on his face.
He couldn’t help but sigh softly and said, “Connor, I’m really curious to see what you’re going to do now.”
“What else can he do? Just wait to be thrown out. This Connor really doesn’t know his place. He doesn’t belong in this circle to begin with. Even if he managed to get in, he’ll just be treated as a joke…”
One of the boys beside Shane chuckled.
On the other hand, Sadie looked at Connor with a hint of disappointment in her eyes.
She also didn’t expect that Connor really didn’t have an invitation, and now she didn’t know what to do.
Amongst the crowd, it seemed that only Sabrina was worried for Connor.
She walked up to him and whispered, “Connor, since you don’t have an invitation, how did you get in?”
Connor turned his head, glanced at Sabrina indifferently, and said in a low voice, “There’s no need for you all to get so worked up. 1 haven’t finished my words yet. It’s true that I don’t have an invitation, but 1 was invited by someone. If you don’t believe me, you can go ask the security guards at the entrance!”
“You were invited by someone?”
Upon hearing Connor’s words, Mr. Lenny’s eyes showed a hint of confusion.
After all, he was the one who personally sent out all the invitations, so he was very familiar with every guest present.
But there were indeed some guests who were invited without an invitation. These guests didn’t need one because their identities were highly respected.
Moreover, the people who could invite others to the auction were all core members of Grand Hotel, such as the owner or the owner’s son.
After hesitating for a moment, Mr. Lenny questioned Connor, “Are you sure you were invited by someone?”
“Yes!”
Connor nodded gently.
“There’s only one heir of the Grand Hotel. 1 don’t think you were invited by her, judging by your appearance.”
After hearing Mr. Lenny’s words, Connor couldn’t help but pause for a moment, his eyes showing a hint of confusion.
Because he still couldn’t figure out the relationship between Madison and Grand Hotel, he didn’t answer the question.
Seeing that Connor remained silent, Mr. Lenny hesitated for a moment, then turned to the bodyguard beside him and said, “Go to the security and ask who invited this person.”
Mr. Lenny was always very cautious in his actions. He was worried that if Connor was really invited by the hotel owner, it would cause trouble if he offended him.
So he decided to investigate the matter thoroughly first before making a decision.
The bodyguard next to Mr. Lenny was about to leave upon hearing his words.
But at that moment, Yana stepped forward from the crowd.
Wearing a cold expression, she shouted, “Mr. Lenny, I don’t think it’s necessary to ask the security guards because he wasn’t invited by anyone at all…”
Upon hearing her words, everyone turned their heads to look at Yana’s position..

chapters.title: Chapter 643 - 643 Add Fuel To Fire
chapters.content:
643 Add Fuel To Fire
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation | Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Mr. Lenny couldn’t help but pause after hearing Yana’s words.
He quickly turned around and asked her, “Yana, what do you mean by that?”
With a proud expression, Yana walked out from the crowd and approached Connor.
She glanced up and down at Connor, wearing a disdainful expression as she said, “Mr. Lenny, 1 know this person. His name is Connor, a student at Porthampton University. He used to work part-time at a bar. I don’t think someone like him qualifies to attend such a high-end auction, right?”
Upon hearing these words, the crowd instantly erupted in discussion.
“Connor is just a poor student. He doesn’t even have money to pay his tuition fees. How could he possibly know the owner of Grand Hotel?”
She continued speaking as she looked at the crowd.
Upon hearing her words, everyone present was stunned, their expressions filled with astonishment.
They never expected that he would be such a person!
At this point, Mr. Lenny had already come to a conclusion. Harold had previously suspected Connor, and now Yana had come forward to accuse him of his identity.
This undoubtedly meant that he must have sneaked in, there was no doubt about it!
After hesitating for a moment, Mr. Lenny asked Yana, “Yana, do you know why he sneaked in?”
Yana’s expression appeared somewhat disdainful upon hearing this question.
With a cold face, she said, “What else could it be? He must have come in to steal things…”
The crowd was even more shocked upon hearing Yana’s words.
Because they initially thought that Connor had sneaked in to meet Sabrina, so they never expected him to be an actual thief.
“How could he possibly know the boss of Grand Hotel? Even if they know each other, they wouldn’t invite him to attend such an auction, right? After all, anything presented at today’s auction is of priceless value. How could this he afford it?”
“Yeah, he must have come in to steal things. 1 never expected that Sabrina would actually have such a boyfriend. It’s really beyond imagination…”
At this moment, everyone’s gaze towards Connor became contemptuous.
If Connor had only sneaked in to meet Sabrina, they would had understand.
But he lied, claiming that he was invited, and now he had been exposed. This clearly showed a problem with his character.
Who could have imagined that Sabrina, who had always been lofty, would actually find such a boyfriend.
Connor narrowed his eyes as he looked at Yana, his expression full of amusement.
In fact, he knew very well that Yana said those words just to retaliate against him.
“Yana, are your words true?”
Mr. Lenny asked Yana, looking at her.
“Mr. Lenny, everything 1 said is true. If you don’t believe it, you can ask anyone here. Many people know this Connor…”
Yana said firmly.
“Yes, I can testify…”
At this moment, a young man walked out from the crowd.
Connor glanced at this person and a trace of confusion flashed in his eyes.
Because Connor realized that he didn’t know this person at all. He thought this person should also be a student at Porthampton University.
The young man turned his head and glanced at Sadie, then said, “I know this person is a student at Porthampton University. 1 have seen him at Porthampton University, and my friend Sadie has also told me that his family conditions are very difficult. So, Mr. Lenny, it’s best for you to investigate this matter…”
Upon hearing these words, Connor couldn’t help but turn his head and glance at Sadie.
At this moment, Connor finally understood that the young man who spoke up was actually Sadie’s friend, and their relationship seemed to be very good.
But Connor couldn’t understand why this young man, whom he didn’t know, would stab him in the back.
Sadie also looked at the young man, her eyes filled with a hint of confusion.
Because she couldn’t understand why this young man would join in the fun, as there shouldn’t be any conflict between him and Connor!
“Mr. Sheldon, are what you said true?”
Mr. Lenny asked the young man with great respect.
“Mr. Lenny, so many people are watching. Do you think I would lie to you?”
The young man replied indifferently.
Upon hearing these words, the crowd instantly erupted in discussion.
If someone else had said these words, they might not have been very convincing.
But if it was this young man speaking, most people would believe him.
Because this young man was none other than Sheldon Statton, the pursuer of Sadie!
The Statton family was quite famous in Porthampton, and Sheldon could be considered a rising star among the young generation of Porthampton. Many people knew him.
No one had expected that he would come forward and speak at this moment!
Even Harold showed a surprised expression because although he knew Sheldon, their relationship was quite ordinary.
He couldn’t understand why Sheldon would come forward to speak up for him.
Sadie also didn’t understand what Sheldon meant by this.
After hesitating for two seconds, she quickly walked up to Sheldon and frowned, asking him, “Sheldon, what are you talking about?”
“Sadie, didn’t you tell me about this Connor? I’m just speaking the truth, I don’t have any other intentions!” he said seriously.
She looked at him, her expression full of helplessness, not knowing what to say.
After hearing the conversation between them, Connor finally understood.
The person who stabbed him in the back was none other than Sheldon, Sadie’s pursuer.
Sheldon stood up at this moment to harm Connor, not to help Harold. He simply regarded Connor as his competitor.
So he thought that as long as he stood up and said a few words, he could completely ruin Connor’s reputation, which would be a good thing for him!
Connor squinted his eyes as he looked at Sheldon’s position, his expression extremely helpless.
Because he didn’t expect that he would unintentionally offend so many people..

chapters.title: Chapter 644 - 644 Who Told Connor to Get Lost?
chapters.content:
644 Who Told Connor to Get Lost?
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation | Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
After hearing Sheldon’s words, everyone became even more certain that Connor was indeed a thief.
Regardless, the Sutton family is very influential in Porthampton.
Many people present knew Sheldon, so they believed that he would not lie about such a small matter.
In their eyes, someone like him was not worth Sheldon lying for.
On the other hand, Sadie’s expression was full of confusion. She couldn’t understand why Connor had offended Sheldon and why Sheldon would stand up and accuse him at this moment.
Of course, she didn’t blame Sheldon in her heart.
After all, he was speaking the truth. If Connor hadn’t sneaked in, then there wouldn’t have been so much trouble, would there?
She glanced at Connor with a faint expression of helplessness on her face.
At this moment, she was helpless as well. She couldn’t help but sigh in her heart, “Let today be a lesson for you. Let you know the difference between you and Madison. You’re simply not worthy of being with her. Even if you have ambitions, they’re not something you can rely on or casually mention…”
Sadie was extremely disappointed with Connor at this moment. She even regretted speaking up for Connor just now. It was embarrassing to know a thief like Connor.
“Since Mr. Sheldon has spoken, there’s no need for me to ask anymore…”
Mr. Lenny laughed and shouted, then turned directly to the bodyguards behind him and said, “What are you all standing there for? Hurry up and grab this kid for me!”
“Swoosh!”
After hearing Mr. Lenny’s words, more than a dozen bodyguards rushed to Connor’s side.
“How dare you come to Grand Hotel to steal things? I see that you’re really tired of living. Capture this kid, take him to the security room, and then call the police to deal with him…”
Mr. Lenny shouted with wide eyes.
After hearing his words, everyone looked at Connor with a pitying look. They knew that his fate today would definitely be miserable.
And now, no one dared to stand up and speak for him anymore!
It goes without saying about Harold. Now, there was also Sheldon, not to mention Grand Hotel. Who would dare to provoke them?
Wasn’t that seeking death?
Yana looked at Connor with a smug expression on her face.
Sadie stood in place, her eyes coldly watching Connor, as if she was just waiting to see the excitement.
And Sabrina was so anxious that she was almost about to cry. Her expression was extremely helpless, not knowing what to do.
Harold saw that his goal had been achieved and picked up a glass of wine, enjoying it leisurely.
Just a few words from him could easily crush Connor under his feet. Such a person was not qualified to compete with him for Sabrina. So Harold’s expression was full of disdain.
As for Sabrina’s friends, the expressions on Laila and others’ faces were also helpless.
But they didn’t interfere because they thought that today’s incident was actually a good thing for Sabrina. It would allow her to see the gap between her and Connor clearly.
In their eyes, Connor and Sabrina shouldn’t be together in the first place, and even if they were together, it wouldn’t lead to anything good.
“Just take advantage of today’s incident to dispel Sabrina’s thoughts…”
Laila couldn’t help but sigh softly.
And after hesitating for a moment, Sabrina quickly ran to Mr. Lenny’s side and pleaded with him to spare Connor.
But faced with so much evidence, Mr. Lenny would definitely not let Connor off easily. Besides, he didn’t know Sabrina, so he wouldn’t give her any face.
“Enough, stop talking nonsense, get to it quickly!”
Mr. Lenny shouted with wide eyes.
“Wait a minute!”
Just at that moment, Harold, with an expressionless face, called out.
Mr. Lenny turned his head and glanced at Harold, smiling and asking, “Mr. Harold, do you have something else to say?”
“I have a few words to say to him…”
Harold said expressionlessly.
“Okay, Mr. Harold, go ahead and say whatever you want…”
Mr. Lenny nodded lightly.
And when Sabrina saw Mr. Lenny giving Harold face like that, she hesitated for a moment, then ran directly to Harold’s side, her expression full of excitement as she shouted, “Harold, I beg you, please spare Connor, okay?”
“Sabrina, this is between me and Connor, it has nothing to do with you. Don’t meddle in our business…”
Harold said indifferently.
“But…”
Sabrina was about to say something.
“Today, I must teach him a lesson!”
Harold replied expressionlessly, then walked directly to Connor’s side, looked him up and down, and his face was full of disdain.
“Kid, I’ve already told you just now, I’m not someone you can afford to offend. Now do you understand the difference between us?”
Harold asked Connor.
Connor glanced at him indifferently, without saying a word.
“Now, if I say a word, 1 can make you get lost. What can you do about it? Tell me!”
Seeing that he didn’t speak, Harold continued to shout.
“Hurry up and make this kid leave!”
“Yes, hurry up and kick him out. This kid must have come in to steal things!”
“Get out!”
“Get out!”
After hearing Harold’s words, everyone started shouting.
These people were all here to please Harold and Sheldon.
Meanwhile, Connor stood motionless, his face expressionless, his expression very calm, and no one knew what he was thinking in his heart.
In the eyes of others, his reaction at this moment was obviously a sign of surrender.
This indirectly indicated that he had indeed come in to steal things!
Sheldon, Shane, and others all revealed a smug smile. They never expected it would be so easy to deal with Connor.
“Stop the nonsense and hurry up to drive this kid out!”
Mr. Lenny impatiently waved his hand.
Upon hearing these words, the bodyguards immediately rushed toward Connor’s position.
“Who told Connor to get out just now!”
But just at that moment, a cold voice resounded.
After hearing this sentence, everyone was stunned in place, their faces full of confusion..

chapters.title: Chapter 645 - 645Madison’s Arrival
chapters.content:
645Madison’s Arrival
Translator EndlessFantasy Translation | Editor EndlessFantasy Translation
“Click, click, click!”
The sound of high heels tapping on the ground echoed.
Immediately after, a beautiful woman in a shoulder-baring short skirt appeared in everyone’s sight.
The woman had a tall figure, and the white skirt perfectly outlined her sexy curves.
Her fresh and refined face had light makeup, with bright and translucent eyes. Her sexy lips were coated with orange-red lipstick, and the short skirt hugged her alluring hip curves.
A pair of long and fair legs were fully exposed in the air, while her feet were adorned with black high heels.
The woman already had a tall figure, and with the high heels, she was nearly 1.8 meters tall.
Such height was enough to make many boys present feel inferior.
After seeing this beauty, many girls couldn’t help but widen their eyes, feeling a sense of self-consciousness.
The woman’s sharp gaze swept over everyone present, her eyes extremely cold, giving off a queen-like aura.
“Who is this woman?”
“Has she gone mad? It’s already this late, and she actually dares to step forward and speak for Connor!”
“This woman must be crazy! Doesn’t she know what consequences await for offending Harold and Sheldon?”
The crowd began to whisper quietly because in their eyes, stepping forward to speak for Connor at this moment was basically equivalent to seeking death. However, one of the girls recognized the identity of this woman and her face immediately changed.
She quickly whispered, “Are you all crazy? This beautiful woman is the young heir of the Phillips family. If Miss Madison hears what you’ve been saying, you’ll all be in big trouble…”
“The young heir of the Phillips family?”
After hearing this sentence, everyone was dumbfounded, their mouths agape, their expressions extremely shocked.
They never expected that the beautiful woman in front of them was actually the young heir of the Phillips family.
Even Mr. Lenny instinctively turned his head to look at Madison’s position.
When he saw Madison, he was instantly dumbfounded and hurriedly went up to her, saying, “Miss Madison, is it you?”
At this moment, he suddenly had a bad premonition.
He felt that today’s matter was definitely not as simple as he had imagined. After hearing his words, Madison coldly glanced at him but did not speak. Unable to hold back, Mr. Lenny took a deep breath and smiled as he asked Madison, “Miss Madison, why did you come here? If you had informed us in advance that you were coming, I would have gone out to greet you!”
“Are we acquainted?”
Madison turned her head and glanced at Mr. Lenny, asking in a cold tone.
You should know that Madison’s personality is actually very cold.
At this moment, she was still somewhat angry, and her pretty face became even colder.
Upon hearing Madison’s words, Mr. Lenny’s face turned pale, and his eyes revealed a complicated expression, unsure of how to respond.
Madison turned her head and coldly shouted at the bodyguards, “What are you people planning? Don’t you know that Mr. Connor is my friend? I went through so much trouble to invite him here, and now you want to drive him away. What do you mean by that?”
Upon hearing her words, everyone froze.
Mr. Lenny’s eyes flashed with fear, and his face turned ashen as he looked at Connor, his expression full of disbelief.
He never expected that Connor would know Madison and that he was a guest invited by her.
Logically speaking, with Madison s noble status, it should be impossible for her to know a poor kid like Connor.
Mr. Lenny stood still with a blank expression on his face, his expression unusually nervous. For a moment, he didn’t know what to do.
“Miss Madison, the thing… the thing is like this…”
Mr. Lenny quickly walked up to Madison and stammered, “Miss Madison, I didn’t know that he was brought here by you. If I had known that he knew you, even if you gave me ten thousand times the courage, I wouldn’t dare to drive ’ him away!”
Madison seemed as if she hadn’t heard Mr. Lenny’s words and directly walked up to Connor, apologizing with embarrassment, “Connor, I’m sorry for being late. Is everything okay with you?”
“It’s fine…”
Connor gently shook his head.
“I’m really sorry. I didn’t expect these people to mistake you for a thief!”
She looked apologetically at him.
After all, he was invited by her, and this kind of incident would definitely make her feel guilty.
Although Madison usually spoke to Connor casually without much concern, she was very aware of his terrifying identity. Even her own grandfather would try to please him in every possible way.
And now, he was being humiliated by a hotel manager and about to be kicked out.
Fortunately, she arrived just in time. If she had come a moment later and Connor had really been driven away, all the efforts Luke had made before would have been in vain. Madison shuddered at the thought.
Connor looked up at Mr. Lenny and, with an expressionless face, said to Madison, “It seems like this person has always had some opinions about me. I told him earlier that I was invited here, and it would have been clear if he asked the security at the entrance. But he insisted on believing that I sneaked in…”
Upon hearing his words, Mr. Lenny was instantly scared and broke out in a cold sweat.
He trembled as he looked at Connor, unsure of what to do.
“Mr. Lenny, you’re quite audacious. You dare to drive away a guest I invited…”
Madison shouted at Mr. Lenny in a cold voice.
“Miss Madison, it’s not what you think. You have to listen to my explanation!”
Mr. Lenny’s expression became highly agitated as he shouted at Madison.
Meanwhile, she glanced at him with disdain and coldly said, “It’s already this late, what else do you have to explain? I’m not in the mood to listen to your explanation now. I will make sure to clarify this incident with the hotel’s owner. Prepare to be fired…”
Upon hearing her words, his vision darkened, and he almost fainted on the spot.
He didn’t expect that she would directly fire him, and the cost of that was too great.
Mr. Lenny instinctively looked toward Harold’s position, seemingly hoping that he would help him out..

chapters.title: Chapter 646 - 646 Do You Know Who He Is?
chapters.content:
646 Do You Know Who He Is?
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation | Editor. EndlessFantasy Translation
After hearing Madison’s words, Mr. Larry’s expression suddenly became ugly. Now he could only hope that Harold would come forward to speak up for him.
After all, today’s incident was caused by him -if not for him, none of this would have happened.
Therefore, he could only place his hopes on Harold.
If even Harold was unwilling to help him, then today’s matter would probably
be troublesome.
However, Mr. Larry had never expected even Harold to be terrified.
From the moment Mr. Larry saw Madison, he had already realized that today’s matter was definitely not that simple.
When he saw Madison apologizing to Connor, he felt even more incredulous.
After all, Madison was Luke Phillips’s’s granddaughter!
According to seniority, Madison was older than Harold was, and thus had more authority than he did. Although Madison was Harold’s cousin, the difference in status between the two of them was very large.
Harold was just part of a side branch of the Phillips family. Madison was different; she was the granddaughter of Luke Phillips, the current head of the Phillips family in Borealis City.
When it came to status or other aspects, Harold could not be compared to Madison.
Although Harold’s father had a certain level of authority in the Ivory Battlefront, it was only because of Luke Phillips’s help that he had today’s achievements.
Harold could offend anyone, but he definitely did not have the guts to offend
Madison.
After Harold saw Mr. Larry’s gaze, he could not help but hesitate. But in the end, he still walked up to Madison and shouted helplessly, “Madison, you’re here?”
Madison was stunned when she heard him call her. Then, she turned to look at
Harold and asked with a puzzled expression, “Harold, why are you here?” “I suspected that this kid didn’t have an invitation just now, so 1 asked Mr.
Larry to chase him out…” Harold looked at Madison and explained softly.
When Madison heard Harold’s words, a trace of anger flashed across her eyes.
Then, she frowned and said, “So this mess is because of you!”
“It..might be a little related to me…” Harold nodded helplessly.
“That means that the person who offended Mr. McDonald is you, not Mr. Larry, right?” Madison asked softly.
“Madison, 1 did not offend him. 1 merely wanted to investigate the matter clearly…” Harold hurriedly said.
When Madison heard Harold’s words, she smiled disdainfully and said indifferently, “Oh, poor, sweet little Harold. We’ve known each other for so long. Don’t you think I know what kind of person you are? Do you think your words will make me believe you?”
Harold looked at Madison and could not help but open his mouth, but he could not say anything.
Madison looked at Harold and continued. “If you didn’t want to take revenge on Mr. McDonald, why would you use such a despicable method to deal with him?” When Harold heard Madison’s words, a trace of anger flashed across his eyes. “That’s right. I do want to take revenge on this kid, but that’s only because he stole my girlfriend. That’s why I deliberately made things difficult for him…” he said with a ferocious expression.
“He stole your girlfriend?” A trace of doubt flashed across Madison’s eyes when she heard this. Then, she frowned and asked, “Who is your girlfriend?” Sabrina was stunned for a moment. She quickly stepped forward and shouted, “Harold, can’t you be a little less shameless? Since when did I become your girlfriend?”
“Madison…”
Harold opened his mouth to refute her words, but Madison seemed to have figured out what was going on. She frowned and shouted coldly, “Harold, shut up. Haven’t you embarrassed yourself enough?”
When Harold heard this sentence, he was stunned on the spot. His expression was very helpless, and he did not know what to say.
Meanwhile, Madison looked at Harold in exasperation.
After hesitating for a moment, Harold whispered to her, “Madison, you won’t help an outsider for such a small matter, right?
“Outsider?” After Madison heard Harold’s words, she sneered disdainfully and asked in a low voice, “Harold, do you know who Connor is?”
Harold was stunned for a moment, and his expression was a little puzzled, as if he did not quite understand what Madison meant.
“Harold, you’ve really going too far now. 1 originally thought that if you went to the military camp for training, you would be able to restrain your personality, but 1 didn’t expect you to become even more unruly now. 1 understand Connor’s character very well. If you do not take the initiative to provoke him, he will definitely not find trouble with you…”
Madison looked at Harold and continued.
“Madison, what do you mean?” Harold asked with a frown.
“What 1 mean is very simple: after the auction ends, I will have a good talk with your father. 1 feel that there is a need for him to properly educate you…
Madison said lightly.
When Harold heard Madison’s words, he was stunned. His face was filled with fear. He didn’t expect Madison to heartlessly tell his father what had happened today.
If his father found out about this, Harold would definitely end up in a very miserable state.
“Madison, 1 beg you, please forgive me this time. 1 know 1 was wrong, okay?” Harold walked up to Madison and begged.
-If you offended someone else today, I might not care, but 1 didn’t expect you to dare to offend Connor. 1 think you’re really tired of living.”
“What will happen if you offend him?”
Harold frowned, and the expression on his face seemed to be even more puzzled.
“Forget it. There’s no point in telling you all this now. Fortunately, 1 came early today. If I had come a little later, you would have caused a huge disaster. Don’t waste your breath on me. I’ll explain this to your father clearly…” After saying this, Madison no longer paid attention to Harold. Instead, she turned to Connor and said, “Connor, the auction is about to begin. Let’s go and take a look!”
“Yes.”
Connor nodded his head gently and smiled at Sabrina.
Sabrina was also shocked. She did not know what was going on..

chapters.title: Chapter 647 - 647 Connor’s Background
chapters.content:
647 Connor’s Background
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation | Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
A moment later, Connor and Madison disappeared from everyone’s sight.
At this moment, only Mr. Larry, who had fainted, and Harold, who had an ugly expression on his face, were left behind.
In an instant, the entire hall fell into a deathly silence.
Everyone looked at Harold and did not dare to speak.
After a moment of silence, Harold suddenly picked up the wine glass on the table and smashed it on the ground. He shouted, “Madison, I didn’t expect you to help an outsider instead of me. You’re really something. To think that I even called you cousin… I’m not done with you today…”
Although Harold said that, he did not dare to do anything to Madison because he knew very well that she was an existence that he could not afford to offend in his life!
“Mr. Phillips, if you don’t have anything else, please leave…”
At this moment, another manager walked up to Harold and whispered to him. “What did you say?”
When Harold heard this, he suddenly looked up at the manager beside him.
“Mr. Phillips, this is Miss Phillips’s idea. Please don’t make things difficult for us…”
The manager explained in a low voice.
Harold looked at the manager and hesitated for two seconds. He knew very well that this manager must have been hired by Madison.
Moreover, at this moment, everyone looked at him as if they were looking at a fool.
If he continued to stay here, he would only be a joke.
Therefore, Harold frowned and shouted at the manager coldly, “No need for your nonsense, I’ll leave by myself!”
After saying this, Harold walked out of the hotel without looking back.
When everyone saw Harold leave, they were all stunned on the spot. Their expressions were extremely shocked.
No one had expected such an outcome. Originally, they thought that the person who was chased out should be Connor, but no one expected that the one who left would actually be Harold.
Not far away, Shane was looking at Harold’s back, and his expression changed drastically. It was as if he had not expected such an outcome.
Shane frowned and asked the person beside him, “How does this Connor know Madison?”
Shane’s companion didn’t seem to know Madison, so he asked softly, “Who is this Madison?”
Madison had always been very low-key, and she had just returned to the country not long ago. After returning to the country, she spent most of her time in Borealis City and rarely came to Porthampton.
This auction was being held in Porthampton, so it was normal for many people not to know Madison.
If it wasn’t for Connor, she wouldn’t have come to this auction at all.
“She is Luke Phillips’s granddaughter and Harold’s cousin…” Shane said expressionlessly.
When everyone heard this, their mouths immediately fell open. Their expressions were extremely incredulous, and they did not know what to say. Harold was only from a branch of the Phillips family, but he already had such great power. But in fact, his grandfather and Luke Phillips were only cousins. Harold was able to achieve what he had today because of Luke’s help.
But Madison was different; she was Luke’s granddaughter and might even inherit the Phillips family’s business in the future.
Therefore, compared to Madison, Harold’s status was more than a little bit different.
Everyone was shocked when they heard Shane’s words.
At this moment, Sheldon was also dumbfounded. He really could not understand how Connor would know someone like Madison.
“Shane, since Connor and Madison have such a good relationship, will he seek revenge on me for offending him just now?” The boy who had spoken up for Harold asked Shane with a terrified expression.
“He probably won’t seek revenge on you. I feel that this Connor doesn’t think of you at all…” Shane replied in a low voice.
At this moment, Shane was not considering these things at all. He’d originally only treated Connor as an ordinary person and did not think that Connor would bring much threat to him.
But now he realized that Connor was not a poor kid—he had a very close relationship with Madison, and Madison even seemed to respect him.
Connor was definitely not as simple as he thought.
“I originally thought that it would be very easy to deal with this Connor, but I didn’t expect him to have some background. No wonder he dared to openly compete with me and Harold for Sabrina…”
Shane sighed softly after a moment of silence.
On the other side, Sadie and the others were also in disbelief. They had never thought that things would turn out this way.
Wesley looked at Sabrina’s position as a strange look flashed across his eyes.
He suddenly felt that Sabrina’s boyfriend was not as simple as he looked!
“Who was that woman just now?”
“I don’t know, but she seems to be very powerful. Even Harold and the people from the Grand Hotel didn’t dare to offend her…”
“That’s not right. Didn’t they say that Connor is just a poor loser? How could he know such a powerful person?”
“Who is that woman?”
The girls around Wesley did not know Madison, so they started to discuss in low voices.
After Wesley heard everyone’s discussion, he hesitated for two seconds and said in a low voice, “That woman is Luke Phillips’s granddaughter, Madison…” When everyone heard Wesley’s words, their eyes widened in disbelief.
Although they didn’t know who Madison was, they knew very well how terrifying Luke Phillips was.
Luke Phillips was an influential figure in both Porthampton and Borealis.
“That woman is Luke Phillips’s granddaughter? Is Connor Madison’s friend?”
“It doesn’t seem to be as simple as a friend. Just now, Madison seemed to be very respectful to Connor. Could it be that he has a powerful background?” Everyone turned to look at Sabrina. The way they looked at her seemed to have changed drastically.
In the beginning, everyone thought that Sabrina had been deceived by Connor.
But now, they realized that she was the one that had not been deceived. On the contrary, she’d gotten a rich heir with a terrifying background—it was just that this rich heir was more low-key.
Sabrina seemed to have not recovered from her shock. Her expression was extremely dazed.
She had never thought that things would change so quickly.
A second ago, she was still worried that Connor would be in danger.
But in the next second, Connor slapped everyone in the face!

chapters.title: Chapter 648 - 648 Teaching Harold A Lesson
chapters.content:
648 Teaching Harold A Lesson
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation | Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
After Connor and Madison left the lobby, the hotel staff also came out to clean up the scene. After all, Harold had just smashed a wine glass. It would not be good if someone got cut on the shards.
Meanwhile, Sabrina was still in shock. She stood there dumbly as she stared at Connor’s back.
Sabrina still did not understand what was going on.
In everyone’s eyes, Connor was just a poor student. But now, he had suddenly become a big shot with a terrifying background.
Of course, Sabrina wasn’t the only one who was shocked. Many people present were also shocked.
No one had expected such an outcome.
“Connor, your trump card is the eldest daughter of the Phillips family, huh?”
Sadie couldn’t help but mutter in her heart. Then, she reached out and pulled Sabrina. She said softly, “Sabrina, what are you waiting for? Connor has already left. Let’s go too…”
When Sadie said this, her expression was very calm.
But in fact, her heart had already set off a storm. At this time, Sadie finally understood what Connor meant by what he said to her that day!
“I didn’t expect you to be so arrogant because you’re Madison’s friend.”
“You do indeed have a right to be arrogant since you have such a friend…”
“But why are you pretending to be poor? Are you trying to fool us?”
“How many secrets do you have that I don’t know?”
Sadie was starting to regret her decision to speak to Connor so decisively.
After all, for Connor to know a woman like Madison, it meant that Connor’s background was definitely not simple.
Sabrina turned to look at Sadie and asked her in a low voice, “If we leave now, will we not participate in the auction?”
“I have only come here today on behalf of my father. As for the auction, it is not something that we can participate in anyway—after all, the items that appear in this auction are all extremely expensive. Even if we fancy them, we will not be able to afford them. Not only that, after what happened just now, there’s no point in staying. It’s better to leave…” Sadie explained softly.
“Alright then…”
Actually, Sabrina was not in the mood to stay here anymore, so she nodded lightly and followed Sadie out of the hotel.
After a while, those who had offended Connor naturally did not have the mood to continue staying here to participate in the auction, so they turned around and walked out of the Grand Hotel.
Sheldon hesitated for a moment. Although he was very unwilling, he still left with Sadie, Sabrina, and the others.
After leaving the hotel, Sadie hesitated for a moment, then turned to Sheldon and asked softly, “Sheldon, is there any conflict between you and Connor?”
After Sheldon heard this, he shook his head gently and said in a low voice, “I do not have any conflict with him. I have merely heard some things about him from you. The two of us have not even met…”
“Since you have no conflict with him, why did you stand up for Harold and the others just now?” Sadie asked with a puzzled expression.
When Sheldon heard this, he could not help but be stunned.
However, he was not a fool. He definitely would not say his true thoughts.
Therefore, he couldn’t help but sigh. He said calmly, “1 didn’t think too much about it at that time. I was just impulsive, so I stood up to help Harold. However, I didn’t expect that the poor kid you mentioned would actually know a big shot like Madison…”
“Sheldon, what do you mean by that? Do you think I’m lying to you?” Sadie frowned and shouted at Sheldon.
“I didn’t say that you were lying to me. I was merely a little surprised…”
Sheldon said lightly.
Sadie looked at Sheldon coldly without saying a word and walked forward.
Sheldon followed behind her with a helpless expression. He had originally planned to take this opportunity to get rid of Connor, a potential competitor.
But at this moment, he realized that he had oversimplified the situation. It was clear that it was not so easy to get rid of Connor.
On the other side, Connor followed Madison into the auction venue and sat in the front row.
The auction venue was not very big, only about too square meters. Moreover, the seats in the back row were already full, leaving only a few empty seats in the front row.
This row was specially prepared for VIPs, and not just anyone could sit there.
Connor was able to sit in the first row because of Madison’s presence.
“Connor, my grandfather also has shares in the Grand Hotel, but I didn’t expect to encounter such a thing today. This Harold really doesn’t know what’s good for him if he dared to offend you…”
Madison said to Connor apologetically.
“Ma’am, can you come earlier if you want to invite me to any gatherings in the future? Do you know how awkward I felt just now?” Connor said to Madison speechlessly.
“Man, I still need to put on makeup, though? Besides, I said that I wanted to pick you up, but you wouldn’t let me. What could I have done?”
After Madison saw Connor talking to her like this, the expression on her face clearly relaxed a lot. Because if Connor had said this in a serious manner it meant that Connor must be very angry in his heart.
However, Connor’s attitude told Madison that he wasn’t angry about this.
After Connor heard Madison’s words, the expression on his face seemed a little helpless.
He was not in the mood to argue with Madison about these things.
Madison turned her head and looked at Connor up and down. Then, she asked curiously, “Oh right, Connor, Harold offended you just now, but are you going to seek revenge on him?”
“Do you think I’m such a petty person? Harold is just a clown in my eyes. There’s no need for me to waste my time on someone like him…” Connor said lightly.
“That’s good!”
Madison nodded gently and continued, “No matter what, Harold is also my cousin. If you wanted to teach him a lesson, it’d be a little difficult for me…”
Connor was stunned for a moment and asked Madison with a smile, “If I really wanted to teach Harold a lesson, what would you do?”

chapters.title: Chapter 649 - 649 The Auction Begins
chapters.content:
649 The Auction Begins
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
“You want to teach Harold a lesson?”
Madison was stunned when she heard this.
Then, she looked at Connor and said,” If you really want to teach Harold a lesson, then there’s nothing I can do. After all, even my grandfather is so afraid of you. I definitely won’t dare to stop you.”
“But I don’t think Harold meant to offend you. If something really happened to him, I would feel bad…”
“Don’t worry, I won’t argue with him since he’s your cousin!”
Connor turned to look at Madison and said calmly.
“Really?”
Madison asked Connor happily.
‘Of course it’s true. Why would I lie to you about such things?”
Connor replied helplessly.
After Madison heard Connor’s words, the expression on her face clearly became much happier.
She smiled at Connor and asked, -By the way, Connor, what’s your relationship with that girl?”
“Which girl?”
Connor was stunned for a moment and asked with a puzzled expression.
“It’s already like this. Why are you still pretending to be stupid? Don’t you know which girl I’m talking about? Don’t you know why Harold wants to deal with you?”
Madison pouted and said to Connor.
“You mean Sabrina?”
Connor was stunned for a moment and asked softly.
Yes, that tall and beautiful woman. Is she your girlfriend?”
Madison asked Connor softly.
“No…”
Connor thought for a moment and shook his head lightly.
“Why is Harold looking for trouble with you?”
Madison asked nosily.
“I haven’t known Sabrina for long. We’re just ordinary friends. As for why Harold is looking for trouble with me, I’m not sure either. Perhaps Harold has misunderstood our relationship…”
Connor said lightly.
When Madison heard this sentence, she couldn’t help but smile faintly. Then, she said softly, “Even if the two of you are not together now, you must be interested in Sabrina…”
“Boring…”
Connor shook his head without thinking.
“Tsk, who are you lying to!”
Madison replied with a pout.
Connor didn’t intend to continue chatting with Madison, so he took out his phone and opened Facebook.
Ten minutes later, the auction officially began.
A sexy beauty in a red short skirt walked onto the stage in high heels.
This beauty was very beautiful and had a very sexy figure.
When she appeared on the stage, she instantly attracted the attention of countless men.
“Good evening, distinguished guests. I’m the host of today’s auction, Shiya. I’m HoZl113 ^7 WelC °me eVeryone t0 Parti «pate in the auction of our Dingsheng
The beautiful host held the microphone and said a few simple greetings with the guests below the stage. Then, she began to introduce the rules of this auction.
Alright, let’s not waste any more time. Next, let’s bring in the first item for today’s auction: a blue and white porcelain vase from the Age of Clay!” “This vase is blue and white porcelain from the Age of Clay. Due to the short history of this period, there are very few blue and white porcelain items from that time. The ones that were preserved until now are even rarer. Therefore, the starting price is five million…”
The host placed the first item on a small stage specially used for exhibition After a simple display, she smiled and shouted at the guests below the stage. Connor wasn’t very interested in these porcelain, so he didn’t pay attention to the stage at all. He was still chatting with Yelena on his phone.
Recently, Yelena had been filming in Horizon, so she was very busy and rarely had time to chat with Connor.
“Stop playing around. The auction has begun…”
Madison reached out and patted Connor as she spoke softly to him.
“What does the auction have to do with me? Besides, I don’t have the money to buy anything…” Connor replied with a pout and then continued to play with his phone.
“Stop pretending with me. Don’t I know your situation? You’re the richest person in Davenport, and you’re actually telling me that you don’t have money If you don’t have money, then there won’t be any rich people in Davenport ” Madison said lightly.
“It’s true that I’m rich, but that doesn’t mean that I’m a fool. A broken porcelain actually costs five million dollars? 1 think these people are crazy for money…” After Connor said this, he looked up at Madison and asked with a puzzled expression, “That’s not right. You were the one who called me here today. You didn’t collude with the people at the auction because you knew I was rich, did you?”
“Do you think I’m swindling money from you?”
After Madison heard Connor’s words, the expression on her face seemed a little helpless. “Do you think I’ll lack your money?” she asked, exasperated. “I only called you over to complete the mission my grandfather gave me. Don’t think so much…”
“Then why do you keep reminding me that the auction has started? I’m only here to help you complete your mission. What does it have to do with you whether I buy anything or not?” Connor said lightly.
“Do you know how many people want to participate in this auction but are not qualified to enter? You really don’t know what’s good for you. Whether you buy anything or not has nothing to do with me anyway!” Madison pouted and scolded Connor helplessly.
After Connor heard Madison’s words, he smiled helplessly and continued to chat with Yelena.
“Ten million!”
At this moment, Madison suddenly shouted.
After Connor heard Madison’s words, he couldn’t help but raise his head to look at her. Then, he asked Madison with a puzzled expression, “Ma’am, are you crazy? How could you pay so much for such a broken vase? Is there something wrong with your brain?”
“What do you know? This vase is a blue and white porcelain vase from the Age of Clay. I sold the same one at Sotheby’s auction house before. At that time, the transaction price was 18 million. If 1 can buy it for 10 million, I can make 8 ’ million when I resell it. Do you understand?” Madison explained softly.
“This broken vase is actually that valuable?”
Connor was instantly speechless.
Madison looked at Connor and really didn’t know what to say. “Connor, this is an antique. Do you understand?”
“You seem to know a lot about them?”
Connor asked Madison curiously.
“I’m okay with them. When I was young, my grandfather and I often participated in various auctions, so I have a certain understanding of antiques Moreover, let me tell you that today’s auction will not only have antiques but also many magical treasures. Those treasures are really priceless!”
“Magical treasures?”
Connor couldn’t help but be stunned when he heard this.. Then, he asked curiously, “What land of treasures?”

chapters.title: Chapter 650 - 650 The Mysterious Red Bracelet
chapters.content:
650 The Mysterious Red Bracelet
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
“Even if you ask me now, I’m not very sure. The thing is that it’s very magical!”
Madison answered vaguely.
“Very magical? Are you lying to me?” Connor asked suspiciously.
“Why would I lie to you? In any case, you will definitely be surprised later. Some of these treasures can cure all diseases, increase one’s physical strength, extend one’s lifespan, and even allow one to travel through time and space.
They are very magical…”
Madison said to Connor with a smile.
-Cure all diseases, increase one’s physical strength, extend one’s lifespan, and travel through time and space, you say?” After Connor heard Madison’s words, he was instantly stunned on the spot, speechless.
He felt that the things Madison said seemed to only appear in fantasy novels.
“What’s wrong? You don’t believe me?”
Madison asked Connor, eyes wide.
“No, not at all…”
Connor gently shook his head, then smiled and asked Madison, “Have you ever seen such a magical treasure?”
“I have never seen one before…”
Madison shook her head gently.
Hearing Madison’s words, Connor’s expression became even more exasperated.
“If you haven’t even seen it yourself, what are you talking about?” he asked with a frown.
“But what if such a magical treasure appears today?”
Madison replied nervously.
“Then forget it. Your words have very little credibility…”
Connor replied, tired, then lowered his head and continued to play with his phone.
A few minutes later, the blue-and-white porcelain vase from the Age of Clay was auctioned off to a middle-aged woman for 15 million dollars.
Connor turned his head and looked at the woman, speechless, and couldn’t help but sigh inwardly. This world was really too rich…to think someone would actually spend so much money to buy a broken vase.
In the blink of an eye, more than half an hour had passed. In this half an hour, nearly a dozen antiques were auctioned off. Moreover, the prices of these antiques were not cheap. Any one of them was worth tens of millions.
Connor played with his phone while listening to the host’s explanation.
“Ding!”
At this moment, Madison’s phone suddenly rang.
Madison looked down at her phone and found that it was from Luke.
Madison looked at the word ‘Grandpa’ on the phone. After hesitating for a moment, she turned her head and whispered to Connor, “Connor, I’m going to
take a call…”
“Sure.”
Connor waved his hand lightly.
Madison took her phone and walked out of the hall.
Once she was outside, she pressed the answer button and said softly, “Grandpa, what’s the matter?”
“Is Mr. McDonald here for the auction?”
Luke asked in a low voice.
“He’s here…”
Madison replied helplessly.
“Then is Mr. McDonald interested in anything? If he is interested in something, you must help him bid for it and give it to him. It’s also an apology for what happened on your birthday, understand?”
Luke said slowly.
“Grandpa, Connor doesn’t seem to be interested in anything!
Madison replied helplessly.
“Mr. McDonald is not interested, can’t you be more proactive? Anyway, Mr. McDonald doesn’t need to spend money himself. It’s our gift to him. If he isn’t interested in anything, then we ll find a suitable antique to bid for and give it to Mr. McDonald. Do you understand what I mean?” Luke said in a low voice.
Madison was stunned for a moment and asked softly, “Any antique?
“That’s right, any antique is fine, but it’d be best if it’s something a little more expensive…” Luke replied.
“Alright, I understand!”
Madison nodded and continued, “Grandpa, is there anything else?
-No, you have to treat Mr. McDonald well, understand?” Luke seemed to be a little relieved that she’d understood her role so quickly.
“Grandpa, don’t worry. 1 will definitely entertain him well…” Madison replied helplessly. Then, she hung up the phone and turned around to walk into the hall.
A moment later, Madison returned to Connor’s side.
Madison noticed that Connor wasn’t playing with his phone at the moment. Instead, he was looking at the stage with a serious expression.
“Connor, what are you looking at?”
Madison was stunned for a moment and asked Connor softly.
“Look at the thing in the host’s hand…”
Connor pointed at the stage and said with a smile.
Madison was stunned for a moment. Then, she looked up at the host’s seat and saw that the host was holding a red garnet bracelet in her hand.
When Madison saw the garnet bracelet, she could not help but be stunned for a moment. Her expression was very puzzled.
Because this garnet bracelet looked very ordinary, there was nothing special about it. She could not understand why this garnet bracelet could attract
Connor’s attention.
“What about it?”
Madison asked Connor with a puzzled expression.
“There’s nothing special about this garnet bracelet, but I don’t know why so many people are competing for it. Do you know how much this garnet bracelet is being auctioned for?” Connor whispered to Madison.
“How much?”
Madison asked softly.
“50 million!”
Connor replied.
When Madison heard this, a trace of shock flashed across her eyes.
She had never expected that this garnet bracelet would be auctioned for such a high price!
“If this was just an ordinary garnet bracelet, it definitely wouldn’t be auctioned at such a high price. Therefore, this garnet bracelet is definitely not simple. Do you think this garnet bracelet is the magical treasure you mentioned?”
Connor asked Madison with a smile.
“The treasure that I’m talking about has only appeared in legends. How can it be so easy for the two of us to encounter it…”
Madison replied to Connor with a helpless expression, then continued to ask Connor, “I see that you’re quite interested in this garnet bracelet.”
“I’m not particularly interested. I’m just curious why so many people want it!” Connor said lightly.
Just as Connor and Madison were chatting, the price of the garnet bracelet had already risen to 55 million!
“Everyone, this garnet bracelet is the last treasure of this auction. If you are interested in this garnet bracelet, then hurry up and buy it. If you miss it today, you may not have the chance in the future!”
At this moment, the beautiful host smiled and shouted at everyone.
Madison couldn’t help but be stunned when she heard the host’s words.
“The last treasure?”
Madison’s eyes flashed with surprise. She suddenly remembered what Luke had told her just now.
Therefore, she didn’t even think twice before she stretched out her hand and shouted, “60 million!”

chapters.title: Chapter 651 - 651 I Bid Eighty Million!
chapters.content:
651 I Bid Eighty Million!
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation | Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Sixty million?
After hearing Madison’s words, Connor was shocked and very puzzled.
“Are you crazy?” Connor turned to look at Madison and asked her agitatedly.
“How am 1 crazy?” Madison glanced at Connor and asked nonchalantly.
“Didn’t you hear what 1 said to you just now? This garnet bracelet isn’t worth that much money at all. Why are you paying sixty million? Do you have money but nowhere to spend it?” Connor asked.
“What do you know? With so many people fighting for this garnet bracelet, there must be something special about this garnet bracelet. Moreover, I am not buying this garnet bracelet for myself…” Madison said lightly.
“Not for yourself? What do you mean?” Connor was surprised and asked Madison in confusion.
“Sigh…” Madison looked at Connor and sighed helplessly. Then, she said lightly, “My grandfather called me just now and asked me to bid for an antique to give to you. This is the last item. If I don’t bid now, 1 won’t have a chance, so I have to get this garnet bracelet…”
When Connor heard Madison’s explanation, he was instantly stunned and speechless.
“Girl, you bid for this garnet bracelet just for me?” he asked softly.
“Don’t be so narcissistic. If my grandfather hadn’t given me this mission, I wouldn’t spend money to buy this garnet bracelet!” Madison replied to Connor with a straight face.
