“No, if you’re that rich, can’t you just give me the money? Why would you buy this broken garnet bracelet?” Connor asked helplessly.
“Are you short of money?” Madison looked at Connor speechlessly and continued, “I’ve already made it very clear to you just now. I’m only doing this to complete the mission my grandfather gave me. This is not a matter of money at all. So cut the crap…”
“Ms. Phillips has bid sixty million. Is there anyone else who wants to raise the bid?” At this moment, the female host shouted.
“Sixty-one million…”
“Sixty-two million…”
“Sixty-three million…”
The guests in the hall raised the bid crazily as if they didn’t need money.
Connor looked at the emcee on the stage speechlessly.
Connor couldn’t understand why so many people wanted to buy such an ordinary garnet bracelet.
Could this garnet bracelet have some unknown secret?
After Madison saw the crazy bidding, she looked a little embarrassed.
However, she still gritted her teeth and shouted, “1 bid eighty million!”
“Woah…”
When everyone heard Madison’s words, their eyes widened as they turned to look at Madison incredulously.
They didn’t expect Madison to offer such a high price!
“Eighty million going once!”
“Eighty million going twice!”
“Eighty million thrice!”
The beautiful host shouted three times in a row. After ensuring no one else raised the bid, she shouted at Madison, “Congratulations, Ms. Phillips, for winning this garnet bracelet for eighty million…”
When everyone heard this, they all turned to look at Madison, extremely shocked.
Madison’s heart was also abnormally broken. She had initially planned to use twenty million to buy an antique for Connor, but she did not expect to spend eighty million.
However, Luke was wealthy and probably wouldn’t care about this money.
After Madison bought the last item, the auction ended.
Connor followed Madison to the front desk and paid the money. Then, she took the red garnet bracelet from the auctioneer.
After taking the garnet bracelet, Madison handed it to Connor. Then, she smiled and said, “This garnet bracelet is yours now…”
“Girl, you spent eighty million just to buy this garnet bracelet? Are you crazy?” Connor took the garnet bracelet and looked at it carefully, but he didn’t find anything special about it.
“Sigh, why are you so slow? I already told you just now that this is a mission given to me by my grandfather. If I don’t complete it, my grandfather will scold me again. Anyway, it was not your money…”
Madison couldn’t help but roll her eyes at Connor. Then, she pouted and said happily, “Alright, although there have been many twists and turns today, 1 have finally completed my mission. We can go back now…”
“We can finally return…” Connor replied indifferently, then walked out of the hotel.
As for the garnet bracelet that Madison won, Connor didn’t take it seriously at all.
He felt that this garnet bracelet was not worth this money at all. This was what the organizer was trying to fool those idiots with money, so Connor casually put it in his pocket.
A moment later, Connor followed Madison out of the hotel.
“If nothing else, I’ll take my leave,” Connor whispered to Madison.
“Do you want me to drive you back?” Madison asked softly.
“Nope, I’ll take a taxi back myself!” Connor waved his hand gently and hailed a taxi. He opened the door and got in.
Half an hour later, Connor returned to Royal Villas.
After washing up, Connor lay on the bed, about to rest.
But at this moment, his phone suddenly rang.
Connor turned to look at his phone and realized that it was Thomas calling.
Connor hesitated before picking up the phone.
“Hello, what’s up?” Connor asked after answering the call.
“Mr. McDonald, are you asleep?” Thomas asked softly.
“Not yet. What’s the matter?” Connor asked.
“Mr. McDonald, didn’t I tell you before that I want to find a master in martial arts for you? Do you still remember this?” Thomas asked with a smile.
“Find me a master?”
When Connor heard this, he could not help but be stunned momentarily, and a strange look flashed in his eyes.
“Yes, sir. The people of Rockefeller will attack you again. Although Carlos and the others can protect you, you should increase your skill. That way, even if you encounter the people of Rockefeller, you will have the ability to deal with them…” Thomas said slowly.
“Isn’t it a little too late for me to pick up martial arts now?” Connor asked helplessly..

chapters.title: Chapter 652 - 652 Earth-rank Martial Artist
chapters.content:
652 Earth-rank Martial Artist
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation | Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
“It’s not too late. The master I found for you is an expert who is quite reserved. He’s very famous in the ancient martial arts world of Oprana.
“If you’re free, I can ask him to meet you…” Thomas said slowly.
“What is ancient martial arts?” Connor asked after hearing this.
“Ancient martial arts is the cultivation method they practice. It’s normal for ordinary people not to know about the existence of ancient martial arts…” Thomas explained with a smile.
After Connor heard Thomas’s explanation, a trace of helplessness flashed in his eyes. He asked in a low voice, “Sounds like something out of a fantasy novel…”
“Haha…” Thomas chuckled lightly and continued, “Mr. McDonald, there are actually many people who study ancient martial arts in our country. These people who study ancient martial arts like to call themselves martial artists. Their combat strength is very terrifying. Any one of them can fight against a hundred people alone…”
“Martial artists?” Connor was surprised when he heard this.
“That’s right. Martial artists…” Thomas nodded slightly and continued, “And martial artists are divided into Heaven, Earth, Black, and Yellow rankings. Heaven-rank martial artists have long been extinct, and the master I found for you is an Earth-rank martial artist that is only second to Heaven-rank martial artists…”
“What is Carlos? Is he also a martial artist?” Connor thought for a moment and asked.
“Yes, Carlos is also a martial artist, but he is only a Yellow-rank martial artist…” Thomas replied.
After Connor heard this, a trace of shock flashed in his eyes as they filled with disbelief.
Carlos was only a Yellow-rank martial artist but already so powerful.
And the master that Thomas found for Connor was an Earth-rank martial artist. How terrifying was that?!
“Mr. McDonald, you’re usually in school, so it’s hard to know these people. Normally, you don’t know about martial artists.
“And we are not aiming to become masters like Earth-rank martial artists. You just need to be able to protect yourself when you encounter a hitman. If an Earth-rank martial artist tutors you, improving your physical fitness quickly shouldn’t be a problem!” Thomas said slowly.
Connor hesitated after hearing Thomas’ words.
He was not very interested in learning martial arts from a master.
However, he was still very curious about this Earth-rank martial artist. He was curious about what kind of person he was.
Therefore, after hesitating, Connor asked, “So, when can I meet this
Earth-rank martial artist?”
“He’s free tomorrow morning. If you want to see him, I can drive you there tomorrow morning…” Thomas hurriedly said.
“All right, then come and pick me up tomorrow morning!” Connor nodded lightly.
“All right, Mr. McDonald, if nothing else, I won’t disturb your rest…” Thomas replied calmly.
“Okay,” Connor agreed and then hung up the phone.
After hanging up, Connor put down his phone and lay on the bed to rest.
The next day, at 8 PM.
Connor’s phone rang on time.
When Connor saw that it was Thomas calling, he picked up the phone and answered the call. Then, he asked groggily, “What’s up?”
“Mr. McDonald, I’m already at your door…” Thomas whispered.
“All right, I’ll come to you now!” Connor hurriedly replied, hung up the phone, changed his clothes, and left Royal No. 1.
A moment later, Connor left the villa and entered Thomas’s Bentley.
“Mr. McDonald, I’ve already contacted Master Yarrell. Master Yarrell is waiting for us at home now!” Thomas said with a smile after seeing Connor.
“Master Yarrell?”
When Connor heard this name, he was surprised.
“That’s right. The master I found for you is called Jorge Yarrell. He was very famous in the ancient martial arts world of Oprana.
“But later on, for some unknown reason, Master Yarrell chose to retire from the martial world and live in seclusion in Porthampton. Moreover, Master Yarrell has never taken in a disciple for so many years. It’s said that his requirements for taking in disciples are very strict. Ordinary people usually don’t make the cut…” Thomas whispered to Connor.
“How can you be sure he will accept me as his disciple?” Connor hesitated before asking softly.
“I’m not too sure about this. Moreover, we don’t have to acknowledge him as our master. As long as we can get this Master Yarrell to give us some pointers, it will be fine. After all, we don’t want to become some powerful martial artist. We only need to be a little stronger than ordinary people…” Thomas said slowly.
“That’s true…” Connor looked at Thomas and nodded lightly.
Ten minutes later, Thomas arrived at the suburbs of Porthampton and stopped in front of a very old building.
“Mr. McDonald, we’ve arrived…” Thomas whispered to Connor.
“Okay, let’s go in and take a look!” Connor nodded and followed Thomas into the courtyard.
As soon as he entered the courtyard, Connor saw a classic landscape garden.
His eyes widened to admire the scenery before him. The trees were lush, the mist was misty, and the simple and elegant buildings blended into the natural landscape.
The rich ancient pavilions added some beauty to this ancient building.
“To invite Master Yarrell to Porthampton, I specially renovated these pavilions…” Thomas turned and said to Connor with a smile.
“You renovated these pavilions?” Connor asked in surprise.
“That’s right. It’s all because of the renovation of the house…” Thomas nodded lightly.
A moment later, Connor followed Thomas to a hall.
On the hall walls hung the works of the four famous artists of the Middle Ages. Giotto di Bondone, Simone Martini, Ambrogio Lorenzetti, Pietro Lorenzetti, and the stone inscriptions of Geoffrey Chaucer’s Canterbury Tales.
In the middle of the hall was an armchair of yellow Brazilian rosewood from the Middle Ages.
The Brazilian rosewood was the most expensive type of rosewood. Its price even exceeded that of red sandalwood. Ignoring its cultural value, this chair alone could easily be auctioned for tens of millions of dollars in the normal world.
At this moment, a sage-like old man was sitting on the armchair.
The old man was wearing a tunic suit and looked like an expert.
Connor narrowed his eyes and carefully sized up the old man before him.
He knew this old man was the Jorge Yarrell that Thomas had told him about.
“Master Yarrell, hello!” Thomas walked up to the old man and greeted him respectfully.
When the old man heard this, he slowly opened his eyes and looked at Thomas indifferently. Then, he asked Thomas softly, “Did you bring him?”
“Yes, this is Mr. McDonald!” Thomas replied.
When the old man heard this, he slowly looked up at Connor. Then, he shook his head and said, “This boy is weak. I can’t accept him…”
After Connor heard the old man’s words, he was instantly stunned and speechless..

chapters.title: Chapter 653 - 653 For The Money
chapters.content:
653 For The Money
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation | Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
“You said I’m too weak, and you can’t take me as your disciple?”
After Connor heard the old man’s words, he was very disappointed.
“That’s right. Your aptitude is too poor. I don’t want to ruin my reputation…” The old man looked at Connor and said calmly.
“No, what do you mean? Why is my aptitude bad?” Connor asked the old man, upset.
Connor had been working outside since he was young, and his physical fitness was quite good compared to his peers.
At this moment, the old man’s words made Connor very unhappy.
The old man glanced at Connor and said expressionlessly, “I said that you’re too weak, and your aptitude is indeed poor. You won’t understand some things even if I explain them to you…” After Connor heard the old man’s words, his facial expression twisted even more.
He turned to Thomas and asked, “Thomas, what does he mean?”
Thomas looked up at Connor, a trace of helplessness flashing in his eyes.
He knew that Jorge’s standards had always been very high. Ordinary people definitely wouldn’t have been accepted. It was normal for him to say that Connor’s aptitude was poor.
After all, Jorge was an Earth-rank martial artist!
Therefore, Thomas whispered to Connor, “Mr. McDonald, don’t be anxious. Let me talk to him…”
Connor looked at Thomas helplessly. He felt he did not know how to communicate with this old man.
“All right, you should talk to him. 1 don’t know how to communicate with him…” he said in a low voice.
“Good!” Thomas nodded gently and walked to the old man’s side. He smiled and said to the old man, “Master Yarrell, if you feel Mr. McDonald’s aptitude is poor, it doesn’t matter. After all, Mr. McDonald doesn’t necessarily have to acknowledge you as his master. If you teach Mr. McDonald a little, we will be very happy…”
When the old man heard this, he looked up at Connor and said expressionlessly, “Since I have promised you that 1 will take this kid as my disciple, I will do as 1 say. However, his aptitude is really too poor…”
After Thomas heard the old man’s words, he instantly understood what the old man meant. He hurriedly said, “Master Yarrell, why don’t you think about this? I’ll give you an additional fifty million on top of the price we originally agreed on. What do you think?”
When Connor heard this, he couldn’t help but be stunned momentarily. Then, he hurriedly walked up to Thomas and asked in a low voice, “No, you gave him money?”
“Mr. McDonald, a martial artist at Master Yarrell’s level has to charge a fee to a disciple…” Thomas explained calmly.
Connor looked at Thomas and didn’t know what to say. He sighed internally, thinking that this old man was probably a liar. He had never seen such an otherworldly expert. He needed money to take in a disciple. What was going on?
“Mr. McDonald, don’t worry. I will help you settle this…” Thomas said to Connor with a smile.
Connor glanced at Thomas and sighed helplessly, not knowing what to say. “Master Yarrell, what do you think of my suggestion?” Thomas stepped forward and asked the old man politely.
The old man turned and looked at Thomas indifferently. Then, he pursed his lips and said, “Mr. Morgan, do you think I’m the kind of person who loves money? I, Jorge Yarrell, have never taken in disciples because of money…” “Master Yarrell, you’re not that kind of person, but I’ve already told you about Mr. McDonald’s situation. Furthermore, you also have a conflict with Rockefeller. If you can train Mr. McDonald well, it would be a huge blow to Rockefeller, wouldn’t it?” Thomas said with a smile.
Connor was unusually puzzled. He really couldn’t understand what Thomas was thinking.
He had to give this person money to become his disciple?
Moreover, Jorge had some conflicts with the people from Rockefeller. Connor couldn’t help but be curious about Jorge’s identity.
Jorge looked at Thomas indifferently. After hesitating, he said softly, “Since you have already put it that way, I’ll just give it to you today out of respect. I will give this kid a chance by taking an additional fifty million…”
“All right, all right…” Thomas hurriedly nodded.
At this moment, Connor’s expression seemed to have collapsed even more. He really could not understand what was going on.
Thomas gave the old man an extra fifty million, and the old man seemed very unwilling.
The old man slowly stood up and walked to Connor. He looked at Connor from head to toe and said to Connor softly, “Brat, you are really too weak. If I were to accept you as my disciple, it would simply be destroying my reputation…” “What are you trying to say?” Connor asked the old man with a frustrated expression.
“Cough cough…”
The old man coughed softly, looked at Connor, and said, “On account of Mr. Morgan, I’ll give you a chance now. If you pass my test, I’ll take you in as my disciple. What do you think?”
After Connor heard this, he couldn’t help but look up at the old man and said expressionlessly, “Are you giving face to Thomas or the fifty million dollars?” “Hahaha…”
The old man laughed and didn’t argue with Connor. Then, he turned and shouted behind him, “Jabba, come out!”
After the old man said this, Connor was surprised. Then, he turned and looked behind the old man.
A few minutes later, a chimpanzee covered in black fur ran out of the courtyard.
After Connor saw the chimpanzee, he was shocked. He did not know what the old man meant.
The old man whispered to Connor, “This is Jabba. You two should get to know each other…”
“You want me to get to know a chimpanzee?” Connor asked the old man helplessly.
“Jabba has been with me for decades. I’ll give you a chance now. If you defeat Jabba, I will take you in as my disciple…” the old man said with a smile.
“You want me to fight a chimpanzee?” Connor asked the old man, puzzled.
“Don’t look at him just because he is a little chimpanzee. If you defeat him, I will accept you as my disciple…” the old man said indifferently.
At this moment, Connor felt that this old man was pulling his legs. He had spent so much money but wanted him to fight with a chimpanzee!
“Are you sure you want me to fight the chimpanzee?” Connor asked the old man softly.
“Of course…” the old man nodded.
“If I defeat it, you’ll take me as your disciple, right?” Connor looked at the old man and continued to ask.
“Yes!” The old man looked at Connor and nodded again..

chapters.title: Chapter 654 - 654 His Real Ability
chapters.content:
654 His Real Ability
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
After hearing the old man’s answer, Connor could not help but hesitate.
He felt that he had already spent the money. It would be too much of a loss if he left just like that.
All right, let’s do it then. I want to see what this chimpanzee can do…” Connor said.
Connor was still very confident in himself. He felt that dealing with a chimpanzee should not be too much of a problem.
After all, this chimpanzee was much smaller than a human and looked harmless.
“Jabba, be gentle. This kid’s physical fitness is very poor, but he’s very rich. Don’t kill him…” the old man said to the chimpanzee with a smile.
Jabba nodded obediently and rushed toward Connor.
The chimpanzee was very fast. In the blink of an eye, it was in front of Connor and used its fist to punch Connor’s stomach.
Connor did not even have the time to react to what was happening before he was lifted off the ground and fell heavily.
Connor clutched his stomach, his expression unusually pained.
He had not expected this chimpanzee to be so fast, and its strength was also shocking. This completely exceeded Connor’s concept of chimpanzees.
After the old man saw this, he was still very calm as if he had already expected this.
A hint of helplessness flashed in Thomas’ eyes.
“Do you still dare to underestimate Jabba now?” The old man looked at Connor lying on the floor, and asked with a smile.
At this moment, Connor was in so much pain that he could not speak. His face was pale.
When the old man saw Connor’s expression, he shook his head helplessly and said softly, “Looks like your physical fitness is worse than I imagined…” After Connor heard the old man’s words, he was disappointed but didn’t know how to refute them.
Jabba looked at Connor smugly. He kept drumming his chest as if he was showing off something.
A few minutes later, Connor got up with great difficulty, then shouted at the old man, his face ashamed, “What exactly is this chimpanzee? Why is he so strong?”
“Weren’t you very confident just now? Didn’t you think that you could defeat it? Do you regret it now?” The old man asked Connor with a smile.
“Regret? Of course, I regret it! I spent so much money, and you make me fight with a chimpanzee. What’s going on?” Connor shouted at the old man.
When the old man heard Connor’s question, a trace of disdain flashed in his eyes. He said coldly, “Are you afraid?”
“What do I have to be afraid of? I think you’re just a swindler. If I take you as my master, I won’t be able to learn anything. Thomas, let’s go…”
Although Connor had lost to this chimpanzee, Connor was still unconvinced.
Moreover, Connor felt that this old man was a liar and had no real ability, so he did not want to continue wasting time with him.
After Thomas heard Connor’s words, a trace of helplessness flashed in his eyes. He couldn’t help but whisper to Connor, “Mr. McDonald, are you not going to reconsider?”
What’s there to consider? Spending so much money to fight a mad chimpanzee? I’m not that lifeless. So what if I can defeat this chimpanzee?” Connor waved his hand annoyedly, then turned around and prepared to leave.
The old man looked at Connor, and a trace of disappointment flashed in his eyes.
“With your character, you want to take back Rockefeller? Steven Lee must be blind to have chosen you as his heir…”
When Connor heard this, he turned around and looked at the old man angrily. “What did you say?”
“1 say you are a coward. You can’t take over Rockefeller. You know very well how big the gap between you and the people of Rockefeller is. That’s why you don’t dare to face these things. You can’t even defeat a chimpanzee. What qualifications do you have to deal with the people of Rockefeller? 1 advise you to give up on the inheritance and do what you must. You can only be ordinary for the rest of your life…” The old man didn’t hold back at all when he spoke to Connor in disdain.
After Connor heard these words, a trace of anger flashed in his eyes.
He gritted his teeth and growled, “I’ve already made it very clear to you just now. 1 don’t want to take you as my master because I suspect you have no real ability. It’s not because I’m afraid of this chimpanzee. Just now, this chimpanzee attacked me unprepared. If I were prepared, I would be able to defeat it…”
“Are you suspecting that I don’t have any real ability?” After the old man heard Connor’s words, he sneered disdainfully and waved his right hand gently.
‘Bang!’ There was a loud bang.
Connor felt as if his body had been hit by a motorcycle. A sharp pain blossomed from his chest and his entire body was sent flying again, crashing heavily into the wall.
“Mr. McDonald!” When Thomas saw this, he shouted worriedly.
“Don’t worry. I only used less than io% of my strength just now. He will be
fine.” The old man looked at Thomas and explained.
After Connor fell to the ground, he struggled painfully. Then, he slowly stood up and looked at the old man sitting with an incredulous expression.
Now, Connor was at least fifty meters from the old man.
However, even with such a long distance, the old man could send Connor flying with just a wave of his hand.
How powerful was that?
Connor had only seen this in movies before.
Connor stood up with a pained expression. Then, he widened his eyes and asked the old man in disbelief, “How did you do that? How did you send me flying with one punch when we were so far apart?”
After the old man heard Connor’s question, he smiled faintly and expressionlessly said, “When you can defeat Jabba, I’ll tell you how I did it…” Connor stood there and hesitated. Then, he turned and said to Thomas, “Thomas, you may leave. 1’11 stay…” Connor wanted to leave, but not because he feared this chimpanzee.
It was because Connor had always been suspicious of this old man’s ability, but now, Connor had already seen this old man’s true ability.
He felt that if he were to be a disciple of the old man, he would be able to learn something, so he naturally had no intention of leaving.
“Mr. McDonald, have you decided to stay?” After Thomas heard Connor’s words, he asked Connor excitedly..

chapters.title: Chapter 655 - 655 Sabrina’s Invitation
chapters.content:
655 Sabrina’s Invitation
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation | Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
“Yes, I’ve already thought about it. This person is indeed quite capable!
“Moreover, our money can’t be wasted, so I want to stay and learn the move he used just now…” Connor replied without thinking.
“In that case, be safe, Mr. McDonald…” Thomas said to Connor worriedly.
“Don’t worry. I’ll be fine. I believe I can defeat a chimpanzee…” Connor calmly replied to Thomas.
“All right, Mr. McDonald. If you have anything you need, you can call me anytime…” Thomas looked at Connor and nodded. Then, he turned around and walked out of the courtyard.
After Thomas left, Connor looked at the chimpanzee named Jabba and shouted, “Silly Jabba, let’s continue. 1 don’t believe that I can’t defeat you today…” After hearing Connor’s words, Jabba immediately revealed a playful smile and rushed toward Connor again.
This time, Connor was prepared, so when he saw the chimpanzee charging at him, he stepped back and dodged the chimpanzee’s first punch.
After dodging this punch, Connor revealed a very smug expression.
“I’ve already said it. I was just not prepared just now. Could it be that I can’t defeat a silly chimpanzee like you…”
However, before Connor could finish his sentence, Jabba turned around and threw a punch at Connor for the second time.
‘Bang!’ There was a loud bang.
Connor’s body flew away once again.
The old man narrowed his eyes and looked at Connor extremely disdainfully.
In the blink of an eye, three days had passed.
Connor stayed in Jorge’s house for three whole days.
Connor also spent three days with the chimpanzee named Jabba.
Other than eating, drinking, and defecating, Connor had been thinking of ways to deal with this chimpanzee the rest of the time.
However, what Connor did not expect was that this chimpanzee’s speed and strength had far exceeded the range of ordinary people.
Not to mention defeating this chimpanzee, it would be very difficult for Connor even to touch it.
Jorge didn’t say anything to Connor from the beginning to the end. He just quietly watched Connor run around the yard with the chimpanzee.
Connor even felt that he was being played by this old man like a chimpanzee.
However, Connor did not give up because he could feel that this old man was very powerful. Otherwise, he could not send him flying from such a distance.
Connor was very curious about the old man’s secret, so he decided to defeat this chimpanzee no matter what.
Just like that, Connor went to school during the day and would come to Jorge’s house to fight with the chimpanzee at night.
A week passed quickly.
Initially, it was very difficult for Connor even to touch this chimpanzee.
However, Connor’s speed gradually increased as he fought with the chimpanzee a few more times.
He almost touched Jabba a few times, which made Connor more confident.
He felt that he would be able to defeat this chimpanzee sooner or later.
More importantly, Connor felt his body had been trained to a certain extent during the fight with Jabba.
Just by fighting Jabba every night, he felt his speed had increased significantly.
This was not a bad thing for Connor.
In the classroom, Dominic and Spencer looked at Connor, puzzled.
“Why are you two looking at me like that?” Connor asked Dominic.
“Connor, what have you been busy with recently?” Dominic asked Connor softly.
“I’m not busy with anything…” Connor replied. Connor had been listless during the day because he had to fight with Jabba at night.
“Since you’re not busy with anything, why do you disappear every day after school? Moreover, you come to class with bruises every day. Did you offend someone?” Dominic asked Connor with great concern.
“I didn’t offend anyone. It’s just that I’ve been fighting with others recently…” Connor replied indifferently.
“Fighting with others?”
Their expressions seemed even more puzzled after Dominic and Spencer heard Connor’s words.
“Whom are you fighting with?” they asked.
Connor hesitated, then said helplessly, “If I told you that I was fighting with a chimpanzee every night, would you believe me?”
After hearing Connor’s words, Dominic and Spencer couldn’t help but frown. They were extremely speechless.
Dominic rubbed his nose and said with disappointment, “If you don’t want to tell us, you don’t have to. Telling us that you fight with a chimpanzee every day? We aren’t fools. Who has the time to fight with a chimpanzee?”
After Connor heard Dominic’s words, he smiled helplessly.
In fact, sometimes, Connor also felt that he had been too stupid recently. He was wasting so much time on a chimpanzee.
However, at this moment, there was a sudden cry of surprise in the classroom.
Connor instinctively looked out the window and realized that it was Sabrina.
Sabrina walked to the classroom door shyly and said, “Connor, can you come out? I have something to tell you…”
When the students in the classroom heard Sabrina’s words, they started to discuss in hushed voices.
After the last cultural gala, some people guessed that Sabrina was already together with Connor.
Now that Sabrina had taken the initiative to look for Connor, it further confirmed their guesses.
Connor hesitated before walking out of the classroom and followed Sabrina to the end of the corridor.
“What’s up?” Connor asked Sabrina softly.
“It’s my birthday tonight. I’m throwing a birthday party. Can you come?” Sabrina’s pretty face blushed as she looked at Connor expectantly.
“Your birthday?” Connor was surprised.
“Yeap. Today is my birthday…” Sabrina nodded gently. Then, she looked at Connor and asked, “Are you free tonight?”
Seeing that Connor did not immediately agree to her invitation, she started to feel uneasy.
Originally, Connor was going to fight with Jabba tonight. However, he felt that since Sabrina had taken the initiative to look for him and he had a good relationship with her, he could take a day off.
Therefore, Connor hesitated before nodding and saying, “All right then, 1 will go to your birthday party tonight…”
“Really?” Sabrina squealed excitedly when Connor agreed..

chapters.title: Chapter 656 - 656 The Flattering Laila
chapters.content:
656 The Flattering Laila
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation | Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
“Of course it’s true. Where are you going to hold your birthday party?”
Connor asked with a smile.
“At my house. I’ll send you the location later…”
Sabrina replied happily.
“Okay!”
Connor nodded.
“If there’s nothing else, I’ll be leaving now…”
Sabrina hesitated for a moment before speaking to Connor softly.
“Okay!”
Sabrina winked at Connor, then turned around and left.
After Connor watched Sabrina leave, he returned to the classroom.
When Connor returned to the classroom, all the boys in the classroom looked at
him with envy.
In their eyes, it seemed like Connor had really gotten Sabrina.
Spencer ran to Connor’s side and asked with a smile, “Connor, are you really together with Sabrina?”
“We are just ordinary friends…”
Connor explained helplessly.
“That can’t be true. I saw her gaze when she looked at you. It was a little off…”
Spencer said enviously.
Connor glanced at Spencer with a helpless expression.
But he didn’t continue to explain because Connor knew that even if he explained now, they wouldn’t believe him.
In the blink of an eye, a day had passed.
After school, Connor received a Facebook message from Sabrina. He then took a taxi to Sabrina’s house.
When Connor got out of the car, he realized that Sabrina’s house was actually a villa.
Moreover, this villa did not look cheap.
Although it couldn’t be compared to Connor’s villa, it was still one of the top villas. Those who could live in such a villa were considered rich.
As Connor arrived rather late, Sabrina’s friends had already arrived.
As the main character of today’s banquet, Sabrina was already standing in front of her villa with a bright smile on her face as she welcomed the guests.
Sabrina’s outfit today was exceptionally sexy. She was wearing a white one- piece short skirt. Her tall figure looked especially charming under the short skirt. Her slender and fair legs were exposed without any reservation. She was also wearing a pair of black high heels. Her pretty face, coupled with her black curly hair, gave off an indescribable temptation.
When Connor saw Sabrina, he could not help but hesitate for a moment. Then, he walked toward Sabrina.
When Sabrina saw Connor, she immediately became excited. She hurriedly smiled and shouted, “Connor, you’re here!”
“Happy birthday, Sabrina…”
Connor said to Sabrina with a smile.
“Hurry up and come in…”
When Sabrina heard Connor’s words, she became even more radiant. She quickly pulled Connor into the living room.
After Connor entered the living room, Sabrina pulled him to the sofa. She then whispered to Connor, “Connor, I still have a few friends who haven’t arrived yet. Wait for me here!”
“Okay!”
Connor nodded and sat on the sofa.
He glanced around the living room and realized that Sadie Colt, Yara Xenos, and Laila Williams, who he had met at the auction, were all here.
However, there weren’t many guys. Including Connor, there were only five boys, including Sheldon Statton.
The rest of them were guys who were close to Sabrina. Although she had many suitors, he did not talk to them.
After Sabrina brought Connor into the villa, she went to the door to welcome
the guests.
“Why is he here?”
Yara couldn’t help but whisper when she saw Connor.
“Who?”
Sadie was stunned for a moment and asked in a puzzled tone.
“Who else? It’s that loser Connor…”
Yara said lightly.
When Sadie heard this, she couldn’t help but turn to look at the sofa.
When she saw Connor, the smile on her face instantly disappeared and her expression turned cold.
Sheldon was standing beside Sadie. A strange look flashed across his eyes, but he didn’t say anything.
After hesitating for a moment, Laila walked toward Connor in her high heels and said softly, “You must be the Connor that Sabrina often mentions, right?” When Connor heard Laila’s words, he could not help but look up at Laila.
Laila was the oldest among the girls and was already working in her father’s company.
At this moment, Laila was wearing a black short skirt with light makeup on her face. She had a noble aura and a very sexy figure. She looked sexy and had a hint of coldness.
“That’s right, I’m Connor…”
Connor nodded lightly.
“Hello, my name is Laila, a good friend of Sabrina’s…”
Laila took the initiative to greet Connor.
At this moment, Laila’s charming big eyes flickered, as if she was sending some flirtatious signs.
Not only did she take the initiative to chat with Connor, but she was also being very enthusiastic.
The reason why her attitude toward Connor had changed so much was because of what happened at the auction that day.
Laila was very interested in Connor’s identity, so she used her family connections to investigate his background.
Laila was shocked by what she found.
Laila realized that this Connor was the legendary Mr. McDonald, and all of the Williams Family’s assets were under Connor’s control.
To put it bluntly, Connor was the real boss of the Williams Family.
Today, when Laila saw Connor, she naturally had to use all her skills. She kept talking to Connor. If she could take the initiative to build a good relationship with Connor, then she would definitely benefit endlessly in the future!
When everyone saw how Laila was acting toward Connor, they were all dumbfounded. Their mouths were wide open, and they were extremely shocked.
Because they really couldn’t understand. Didn’t Laila look down on Connor before?
Why did it seem like she had changed into a different person now? He actually took the initiative to talk to Connor?
Seeing this, Yara became even angrier.
“What’s going on with Laila?” She couldn’t help but pout. “Can’t she be a little more reserved? Look at her now. She looks like she’s about to strip naked and stick herself onto Connor’s body. Does she also like Connor?”
When Sadie heard this, a strange look flashed across her eyes, but she didn t say anything.
After all, even if Connor really knew someone like Madison Phillips, Laila wouldn’t go so far as to curry favor with Connor.
This was indeed unbelievable!

chapters.title: Chapter 657 - 657Real or Fake Garnet Bracelet
chapters.content:
657Real or Fake Garnet Bracelet
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
At this moment, Sabrina returned to the villa.
Most of the guests who came to Sabrina’s birthday party had arrived.
Sabrina’s birthday party was not a big one. There were fewer than 20 people in the villa.
However, these 20 people were all Sabrina’s best friends!
When everyone saw that Sabrina had returned, they took out the gifts that they had prepared beforehand and walked toward Sabrina.
As Sabrina’s friends were all tall, rich, handsome, fair, and beautiful, the gifts they brought out were all expensive.
There were all kinds of branded bags, luxury perfumes, and diamond jewelry.
Sabrina smiled as she received gifts from them.
When Connor saw the gifts that these people had brought, he realized that it was Sabrina’s birthday today. He had come to Sabrina’s birthday party and had forgotten to prepare a birthday present for her.
“This is bad…”
A trace of embarrassment flashed across Connor’s face. For a moment, he didn’t know what to do.
He knew that if he went out to buy a birthday present now, it would definitely be too late.
Five minutes later, Sabrina finished collecting all the gifts.
Sadie noticed that Connor had been sitting on the sofa without moving, and a strange look flashed across her eyes.
She said to Connor with a disdainful expression, “Connor, why are you still sitting there? It’s Sabrina’s birthday. Since you’re here to attend the birthday party, you should have brought a gift, right?”
When Connor heard Sadie’s words, he was stunned, and he was feeling very helpless.
In fact, Sadie had already noticed that Connor did not prepare a birthday present.
That was why she said that. Her goal was to embarrass Connor.
“He probably doesn’t have the money to buy a birthday present.”
Yara pouted and shouted.
“If you don’t have money to buy a gift, why would you come to the birthday party? How can there be such a shameless person who doesn’t even bring a gift to a birthday party…”
The others also looked at Connor with disdain.
When Connor heard everyone’s mockery, he was stunned for a moment. He stood up and was about to explain to Sabrina.
“Actually, Connor has already prepared a gift for me. Moreover, he has already…”
Sabrina was stunned and was about to help Connor out.
But at this moment, Connor suddenly remembered that he was still wearing that garnet bracelet.
This garnet bracelet was bought by Madison Phillips as a gift to Connor.
However, Connor felt that this garnet bracelet was not worth much at all. This was used by the auction house to deceive people, so he did not take this garnet bracelet to heart.
Connor had been keeping it in his pocket for a long time. If it weren’t for what Sadie and the others said just now, Connor might have forgotten about this garnet bracelet.
After thinking for a moment, Connor reached out and touched his trouser pocket. The jade bracelet was still there, and it had not been broken by Jabba.
Connor was a little worried. He had been fighting with Jabba for the past few days. If it was broken by Jabba, then he would be in trouble.
Connor glanced at Sadie and said coldly, “Who told you that I didn’t prepare a birthday present?”
When Sadie heard Connor’s words, she couldn’t help but be stunned for a moment. Then, she frowned and asked Connor, “Did you prepare a gift?”
“Since I’m here to attend Sabrina’s birthday party, I definitely prepared a gift…”
Connor replied with a smile.
“Tsk, stop bragging. You look so poor. How could you have the money to prepare a gift? If you really have a gift, then take it out and let us all see it…”
At this moment, Yara also thought that Connor did not prepare a gift, so she shouted at Connor with disdain.
After Connor hesitated for a moment, he took out the garnet bracelet from his shirt and handed it to Sabrina.
Sabrina was stunned when she saw the garnet bracelet.
Actually, Sabrina thought that Connor did not prepare a birthday present for her.
After all, she had just informed Connor to attend the birthday party today. With such a tight schedule, it was normal for him not to prepare a gift for her.
However, when Sabrina saw the bracelet, she was very happy.
She hurriedly reached out to take the bracelet and asked Connor excitedly, “Connor, is this the birthday present you prepared for me?”
“That’s right. This garnet bracelet is for you…”
Connor nodded lightly.
Anyway, this jade bracelet was useless in Connor’s hands. He felt that girls would like this kind of stuff, so he gave this garnet bracelet to Sabrina.
“It’s a garnet bracelet. Also, it seems to be very valuable…”
“Connor is actually able to give such an expensive gift…”
“Yeah, I don’t think this garnet bracelet is cheap.”
When everyone saw the gift Connor took out, they all revealed shocked expressions.
After all, they did not expect Connor to give Sabrina such an expensive gift!
One must know that a high-quality garnets bracelet could cost hundreds of thousands or even millions. Even the cheapest garnet bracelet would cost more than a thousand dollars.
At this moment, the garnet bracelet that Connor gave Sabrina was of high quality. It was crystal clear and red. It must be expensive.
To them, Connor was not able to afford such an expensive gift!
Sabrina seemed to like the garnet bracelet that Connor had given to her. She kept caressing, and she was very happy.
However, when Sheldon saw the garnet bracelet, a strange look flashed across his eyes.
He quickly stepped forward and frowned as he said to Sabrina, “A garnet bracelet is extremely rare. I didn’t think Connor would give such a valuable gift…”
“Yeah, this garnet bracelet is so beautiful!”
Sabrina replied with a smile.
“But Sabrina, I don’t think this is a garnet bracelet!”
At this moment, a girl said softly.
“Not a garnet bracelet?”
When Sabrina heard this, she could not help but be stunned for a moment. A hint of confusion flashed across her eyes.
“Sabrina, I learned how to appraise gemstones from my grandfather when I was young. If you believe me, can you let me take a look?” The girl whispered to Sabrina.
When Sabrina heard this, she could not help but be stunned. Then, she passed the garnet bracelet to the girl.
After the girl took the jade bracelet, she observed it carefully before returning it to Sabrina.
“Trisha, what do you think about it?”
Sabrina asked the girl softly..

chapters.title: Chapter 658 - 658Are You Sure It’s Fake?
chapters.content:
658Are You Sure It’s Fake?
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
After hearing Sabrina’s words, everyone turned their attention to Trisha.
Trisha’s family was in the gem business, and her grandfather had taught her about gems since she was young.
Therefore, Trisha was very knowledgeable in appraising gemstones. Moreover, Trisha also studied gemstone appraisal in university.
Sabrina initially did not want to give the garnet bracelet to Trisha because she was worried that if Trisha said that it was fake, Connor would definitely be very embarrassed.
At this moment, Sabrina did not believe that the garnet bracelet was real. After all, she knew Connor’s situation very well.
She felt that Connor would never have the money to buy a real garnet bracelet for her.
A few minutes later, Trisha slowly put down the garnet bracelet in her hand. Then, she turned her head and winked at Sheldon, revealing a smug smile.
The reason why Trisha had taken the initiative to help Sabrina appraise the garnet bracelet was all because of Sheldon.
Sheldon wanted to know who Connor was. If this garnet bracelet was expensive, it meant that Connor’s identity was not simple.
However, if this garnet bracelet was fake, it meant that Connor was a poor loser. After all, if Connor was really rich, he would not have given Sabrina something cheap.
“Trisha, is this garnet bracelet real?”
Sadie asked Trisha.
Trisha smiled faintly and said to Sadie expressionlessly, “It’s not easy for me to tell whether this thing is real or not…”
“What does this mean?”
Sabrina’s eyes flashed with a trace of doubt as she asked with a puzzled expression.
“Because this garnet bracelet is not some a jade. It’s merely imitation jade…”
Trisha said coldly.
When everyone heard Trisha’s words, their eyes widened in shock.
“What is imitation jade?”
Sabrina blinked her big watery eyes and asked with a puzzled expression.
“Imitation jade is also called artificial jade. It has the appearance and luster of a natural jade. Although the material density of imitation jade is similar to that of natural jade, its hardness and anti-aging performance are very poor. If it were someone who didn’t know anything about jades, he wouldn’t be able to tell the difference. However, if it were us professionals, we would be able to tell what’s going on at a glance. It’s like antique forgery…”
Trisha looked at everyone and explained softly.
“Forgery?”
When Yara heard this, a smug smile appeared on her face. This was the result that Yara wanted to see.
“That means this bracelet is fake, right?”
“Yes, you can also see it that way. After all, this garnet bracelet is not real jade at all. It is just a replica. It is used to fool those who do not understand jade…” Trisha said expressionlessly.
When everyone heard Trisha’s words, they were all stunned.
They didn’t think that the garnet bracelet that Connor had given Sabrina was a high-quality imitation.
“Then, how much is this fake worth?”
Yara asked with a smile.
“Imitation jade isn’t very valuable. It’s no different from the jewelry you buy from roadside stalls. Basically, you can buy something much better than this one for one to two hundred dollars…”
Trisha threw Connor’s garnet bracelet onto the table and said with a disdainful expression.
“It’s actually fake?”
When everyone heard Trisha’s words, they were all dumbfounded. Their mouths were wide open, and they were extremely shocked.
Connor was also stunned, a trace of confusion flashing across his eyes.
After all, he did not know what was going on with this garnet bracelet.
Connor did not know how to explain after what Trisha said.
“This person is really shameless. He actually bought a fake for Sabrina…”
“Connor, I didn’t expect you to be such a person. You bought a fake bracelet and gave it to Sabrina just like that. How embarrassing.”
“That’s right. If you don’t have money, then don’t pretend. Just be honest and say that you don’t have money to buy a gift.”
“People like you are really disgusting. I’ve never seen anyone more disgusting than you!”
When everyone found out that the garnet bracelet that Connor gave Sabrina was fake, they all stepped forward to criticize Connor.
Connor stood there helplessly and explained with a pale expression, “This garnet bracelet was given to me by someone else. I did not know that it was fake…”
“What do you mean by someone gave it to you? Do you think we’re fools? You spent a few dollars on a fake bracelet, and now you’re actually looking for excuses?”
Yara naturally wouldn’t let go of such a good opportunity. She widened her foxlike eyes and shouted excitedly.
“Since you don’t have money, don’t pretend to be a rich guy. Don’t you feel ashamed that things have turned out this way?”
Sadie crossed her arms and said coldly to Connor.
For a moment, it seemed as if everyone had stepped forward to criticize Connor.
To these people, Connor was simply a big liar!
“What are you all doing? This is my birthday present. I’ve not said anything, yet you guys are throwing comments left and right.”
Sabrina could not stand it anymore. She frowned and shouted at the crowd.
“Sabrina, why are you still speaking up for Connor? Look at what he’s done!” Yara pouted and shouted.
“What has he done? So what if this garnet bracelet is fake? Connor didn’t say that this garnet bracelet is real. This is just a birthday present from him. No matter what birthday present it is, it’s a token of his appreciation. You don’t have to react in such a way…”
Sabrina widened her big watery eyes and shouted.
Everyone turned to look at Sabrina when they heard that.
They did not expect Sabrina to still speak up for Connor at a time like this.
Laila was the only one with a puzzled expression on her face because she already knew Connor’s true identity.
She felt that with Connor’s status, even if it was a real garnet bracelet, it should not mean anything to him. There was no need for Connor to buy a fake garnet bracelet for Sabrina!
“Trisha, are you sure it’s fake?”
Laila hesitated for a moment before asking Trisha softly.
Trisha turned her head and glanced at Laila, saying softly, “Laila, you know that I’ve been learning how to appraise gemstones from my grandfather. How could I make a mistake? If I can’t even distinguish between a real garnet bracelet and an imitation jade, then wouldn’t all my years of learning be in vain…”
“But…”
Laila opened her mouth to speak, but she did not want to reveal Connor’s identity in front of so many people.
However, if she did not reveal Connor’s true identity, then this matter could not be explained away..

chapters.title: Chapter 659 - Uninvited Guest
chapters.content:
Uninvited Guest
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation | Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
When everyone heard that the bracelet that Connor gave Sabrina was fake, they were all stunned. Their faces were filled with disbelief.
No one expected Connor to do such a thing!
Previously, many people had opinions about Connor, but Sabrina had a good relationship with him.
Moreover, it was Sabrina’s birthday, so no one dared to say anything when Sabrina invited Connor to the party.
However, when they found out that the gift Connor gave Sabrina was fake, they could not help but laugh at Connor.
Sheldon looked at Connor with a disdainful expression on his face. At this moment, he seemed to have found the answer he wanted.
Initially, Sheldon thought that Connor was hiding his identity, but now it seemed that Sheldon felt that his worries were unnecessary.
How could a loser who didn’t even have the money to buy a birthday present have any background?
’’If you don’t have money, you can buy something cheap for Sabrina. But why did you have to buy a fake for her? It’s good that we found out today.
Otherwise, it will be so embarrassing if she wears this bracelet!”
“That’s right. You’re so shameless, Connor…”
“Sabrina, why are you even friends with someone like this?”
Everyone did not hold back and began to mock Connor one after another.
Meanwhile, Connor remained seated in his original position, his expression extremely helpless. He didn’t know how to explain.
Sabrina’s expression turned ugly when she heard everyone mocking Connor.
After all, Sabrina was different from the other girls. Furthermore, she knew about Connor’s situation.
Therefore, even if he gave her a fake, she wouldn’t care because she knew that he was sincere about it.
“Alright, everyone, stop talking. No matter what Connor gives me, I will like it. So what if it’s an imitation jade? Connor is still in university and doesn’t have much money at all. How can he buy a real jade bracelet for me?”
Sabrina shouted angrily at the crowd.
When everyone heard Sabrina’s words, they were stunned. Their faces were filled with disbelief.
They had never expected that Sabrina would still speak up for Connor even at this point.
“Even if Connor doesn’t have money, he can’t take out a fake jade bracelet to cheat people, right?”
When Yara heard Sabrina’s words, she couldn’t help but pout and shout.
“Yara, you’re wrong. Connor didn’t say anything from the beginning to the end, and he didn’t say that this jade bracelet was real.”
As Laila knew Connor’s identity and background, she naturally had to stand up for him.
Laila had always been the big sister of this group of girls, so her words carried a lot of weight.
Although Yara didn’t know why Sabrina and Laila were so protective of Connor, when she heard their words, a trace of anger flashed in her eyes. However, she didn’t say anything else and sat on the sofa angrily.
At this moment, Sadie, Sheldon, and the others had cold expressions on their faces.
The two of them felt that even though Sabrina and Laila had spoken up for Connor, it did not matter. Anyway, the fact that Connor had given Sabrina the imitation jade was already set in stone. Sheldon’s goal had naturally been achieved.
In Sheldon’s eyes, even if Sabrina did not say anything, she would definitely have some misgivings.
In this case, the goal of humiliating Connor had been achieved.
To Sheldon, sometimes, there was no need to make things too clear. It would be meaningless if it was made clear.
“Sabrina, are all your friends here? The birthday party can start now, right?”
At this moment, a beautiful young woman in a nightgown came down from upstairs.
When everyone heard the beautiful young woman’s words, they all turned their heads to look at the stairs.
Connor naturally turned to look at the beautiful young woman. This beautiful young woman was around 40 years old and looked quite similar to Sabrina. She was wearing a cool black nightgown and her body and skin were well maintained. She gave off a feeling of charm.
When everyone saw the beautiful young woman, they all stood up and greeted her.
“Hello, Aunt Harper…”
“Aunt Harper!”
When the beautiful young woman heard these people’s greetings, she immediately revealed a happy smile and said softly, “Everyone is here today!”
After hesitating for a moment, Connor also called out to Aunt Harper.
He knew very well that the beautiful young woman who had appeared at this moment was Sabrina’s mother.
When Sabrina’s mother heard Connor’s words, she could not help but look at him with a hint of confusion in her eyes. Then, she asked Sabrina softly, “Sabrina, who is this?”
“Mom, this is Connor. I met him in university…”
Sabrina hurriedly explained.
“I see…”
Sabrina’s mother nodded her head gently. She then smiled at Connor and started to chat with the others.
A few minutes later, the door of the villa was pushed open from the outside. A young man walked into the villa.
When everyone saw this young man, their eyes widened.
This young man was none other than Harold Phillips, who had had some conflicts with Connor before.
“Why is he here?”
Sabrina could not help but turn to look at Connor. A hint of confusion flashed across her eyes.
Sabrina knew that Connor and Harold did not have a good relationship. The two of them even had some conflicts at the auction last time.
Therefore, Sabrina did not invite Harold this time. However, Harold still appeared at her house.
When Sabrina’s mother, Penelope Harper, saw Harold, she quickly walked up to him and started chatting with him.
It could be seen that the relationship between Sabrina’s mother and Harold, was quite good. The two of them chatted as they walked into the villa.
Only then did Sabrina realize that Harold must have been invited by her mother.
Thinking of this, Sabrina’s expression became a little nervous.
After all, Sabrina knew about the relationship between Connor and Harold. If something happened between the two of them, she really did not know how to explain it to her mother.
Sheldon, Sadie, and the others were very happy because they knew that there would be a good show soon..

chapters.title: Chapter 660 - Glass Emerald
chapters.content:
Glass Emerald
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
However, to everyone’s surprise, Harold did not take the initiative to find trouble with Connor this time.
This was not because Harold was afraid of Connor.
It was because today was Sabrina’s birthday, so Harold did not want to cause trouble.
Sabrina’s mother was also present. He did not want to leave a bad impression on her.
Although Harold already knew about the relationship between Connor and Madison Phillips, this did not mean that Harold was really afraid of Connor.
He felt that Connor could not pose any threat to him.
Harold walked into the villa. When he passed by Connor, he glanced at him with disdain.
However, he ignored Connor and walked straight to Sabrina.
Then, he took out an exquisitely wrapped gift box from his back and handed it to Sabrina. He smiled and said, “Happy birthday, Sabrina. Here’s your birthday present!”
Although Sabrina hated Harold, she did not dare to go overboard since her mother was present.
So she reached out to take the gift and casually placed it on the table.
It was obvious that Sabrina was not very interested in the gift that Harold had given her.
Although Sabrina was not interested in the present, everyone was curious about what Harold had given her.
As such, when they saw Sabrina put the gift that Harold had prepared on the table, they all said to her, “Sabrina, why don’t you open it and take a look…”
“That’s right, let’s see what gift Mr. Phillips has given you this year!”
“I remember that he gave Sabrina a BMW Mini last year. I wonder what he will give her this time…”
Sabrina could not help but hesitate for a moment when she heard what everyone said. Then, she picked up the gift box and opened it in front of everyone.
When the gift box was opened, everyone present was dumbfounded. They were very shocked.
Because there was an emerald bracelet in the gift box!
If it were any other gift, everyone might not be so surprised!
However, today’s situation was a little special because Connor had just given Sabrina an imitation jade.
At this moment, Harold actually gave Sabrina a jade bracelet.
It was obvious that their gifts were the same.
“I didn’t expect Mr. Phillips to give a jade bracelet to Sabrina too!”
Yara said with a smile.
“Too?”
When Harold heard Yara’s words, he could not help but be stunned for a moment. Then, he frowned and asked Yara, “Did someone else give a jade bracelet to Sabrina?”
“Yeah. Connor just gave a jade bracelet to Sabrina…”
Yara nodded happily.
When Harold heard Yara’s words, a strange look flashed across his eyes.
He didn’t expect that Connor’s gift would be the same as his.
“However, the jade bracelet that Connor gave is a worthless fake. It’s not something that your jade bracelet can compare to…”
At this moment, Yara looked at Harold and added.
Harold looked Yara and instantly understood what she meant.
He couldn’t help but snort and say, “You actually gave a fake to someone?
That’s ridiculous. This jade bracelet of mine was left behind by my grandmother. It’s said to be a glass emerald…”
“Glass emerald?”
When everyone heard this, they all revealed puzzled expressions, as if they did not know what it meant.
The only person who knew what was going on was Trisha, who had previously identified Connor’s piece of jade as fake.
Trisha’s eyes flashed with shock. She quickly walked to Sabrina and asked softly, “Sabrina, can I take a look?”
“Yes.”
Sabrina did not care what kind of jade it was, so she handed the bracelet to Trisha without hesitation.
Trisha took the jade bracelet and observed it carefully.
A hint of helplessness flashed across Sabrina’s eyes. She thought that the matter of Connor giving her the imitation jade was already over.
However, she did not expect that Harold would actually give her a jade bracelet. This pushed Connor to the cusp of the storm again.
Meanwhile, Connor stood beside Sabrina expressionlessly as if he did not care about this.
After all, Connor did not expect his jade bracelet to be fake. He felt that he could just give Sabrina another birthday present in the future. It was not a big deal.
Anyway, he had money now. No matter what Sabrina liked, Connor could buy it for her.
On the other side, after Trisha carefully observed Harold’s jade bracelet, she carefully put it down.
“Trisha, what do you think of the bracelet?”
Yara asked curiously. It felt as if the jade bracelet was not for Sabrina but for Yara.
Trisha glanced at Yara and said softly, “This jade bracelet is not ordinary. It’s a high-quality glass emerald. Be it color or clarity, it’s the best among the best…” “How much is it worth?”
It was obvious that Yara and the others did not understand what Trisha was saying.
Right now, she only cared about how much the jade bracelet that Harold had given Sabrina was worth!
After a moment of hesitation, Trisha said softly, “If I had to estimate, it would be at least a million dollars!”
“More than a million?”
When everyone heard Trisha’s words, they were all stunned. Their faces were filled with shock.
Even Sabrina’s mother, Penelope, was shocked!
No one had expected that the jade bracelet that Harold had given Sabrina would be so valuable!
Compared to the imitation jade that Connor had given Sabrina, it was like heaven and earth!
Harold’s expression was a little smug. He smiled and said, “Actually, it doesn’t matter how much this bracelet is worth. What’s important is my feelings for Sabrina!”
“That’s right. It doesn’t matter if the gift is expensive or not. It’s the thought that counts…”
Penelope was also very happy. She smiled and spoke.
“Sometimes, things like intentions are also valuable. Some people’s intentions are worth a hundred dollars, while others are worth a million dollars. The difference is still very big!”
At this moment, Yara suddenly exclaimed.
The people present weren’t fools. They naturally knew what Yara meant, so they all turned to look at Connor.
Meanwhile, Connor was still standing quietly on the spot, looking as if he was at ease.

chapters.title: Chapter 661 Corporate General Manager
chapters.content:
661  Corporate General Manager
"Alright, everyone, let's not just stand here. Let's go and cut the cake!"
After seeing the somewhat awkward expression on Connor's face, Sabrina quickly shouted.
"Yeah, let's go and cut the cake quickly..."
Penelope quickly followed and said, then turned and shouted towards the kitchen, "Aunt Willow, please bring out the cake I ordered..."
Upon hearing this, the housekeeper in Sabrina's home quickly brought out a large cake.
The cake had a total of five layers, each adorned with various fruits and candles.
After the cake was brought out, Penelope turned off the lights in the hall and lit the candles.
Seemingly forgetting what had just happened, everyone gathered around Sabrina and started singing the birthday song. She placed her hands in front of her chest, closed her eyes, and began making a wish.
But no one noticed that when she was making her wish, she slowly opened her eyes and looked towards Connor's direction.
No one knew what wish she made, but it definitely had something to do with him. Otherwise, she wouldn't have looked in his direction.
Soon, Sabrina finished making her wish.
After making her wish, she blew out all the candles in one breath, and then everyone started dividing the cake.
However, Sabrina's mother, Penelope, noticed something. After Sabrina finished cutting the first piece of cake, she unexpectedly handed it to Connor first.
This made Penelope feel a little puzzled because Sabrina's relationship with Connor's friends didn't seem to be very good. But she seemed to be quite interested in him.
Harold also seemed to notice this scene and a hint of anger flashed in his eyes.
But at that moment, the entrance gate of the villa was opened again, and a middle-aged man accompanied by several bodyguards entered the villa.
Sabrina instinctively turned her head to look at the entrance and her face instantly became excited.
She quickly walked up to the middle-aged man and happily exclaimed, "Dad, why are you here?"
Sabrina's father?
Upon hearing this, Connor couldn't help but turn his head and take a glance.
He found that the person who came in was a middle-aged man in a suit, who gave off an extremely refined and elegant vibe, like a respected professor.
But the middle-aged man was accompanied by several bodyguards, indicating that his identity was definitely not simple.
After all, not everyone goes out with bodyguards.
"Darling, I'm late today. Are you not angry?" the middle-aged man asked Sabrina with a smiling face.
"Of course, I'm not angry. Mom said you were still in Salem. I didn't expect you to come back..." Sabrina replied, clearly surprised by her father's presence.
"How could I not come home for my daughter's birthday? I specifically flew back by helicopter..." the middle-aged man said affectionately while looking at her.
Sabrina's friends also wore expressions of confusion upon hearing these words. They had known Sabrina for a long time, but had never seen her father. Some said that her father had already passed away, while others claimed that she was an illegitimate child and her father had abandoned her. There were various rumors.
Sabrina had never mentioned her father's situation to others.
The reason was very simple, her father was the CEO of an international company, so he often stayed abroad and rarely returned to the country. The number of times he met Sabrina was also very few.
As for why she didn't actively talk about her father with others, it was because she had been kidnapped when she was very young.
After all, with her father being so wealthy, there were naturally many kidnappers eyeing Sabrina.
Later, her mother had no choice but to bring her back to Porthampton to live. Coupled with Sabrina's father always being abroad, she managed to escape the attention of those kidnappers.
"Charles Ziegler!"
At that moment, Sheldon seemed to recognize Sabrina's father and muttered softly.
"Are you talking about the Mr. Charles?"
Upon hearing Sheldon's words, Laila's expression became extremely shocked, and she couldn't help but turn to him and ask.
"That's right, it's Mr. Charles. I saw him once at my grandfather's birthday banquet, but I never expected him to be Sabrina's father. It's really unbelievable..."
Sheldon nodded slightly.
Upon hearing these words from Sheldon, everyone was dumbfounded, their mouths wide open, their expressions extremely shocked.
After all, they had heard about Mr. Charles' story.
Back then, there were two tyrants in Porthampton. The first was Thomas under Steven's command, and the second was Charles!
Back then, Thomas and Charles were in competition, and the two of them could be said to have divided the whole world of Porthampton.
But in the end, it seemed that Charles lost to Thomas and could only leave Porthampton with his wife and daughter.
During his peak, Charles could definitely compete with Thomas. From this, one could see how powerful Charles was back then.
But in a place where there can only be one winner, Charles ultimately lost to Thomas.
He had no choice but to sell all his assets to Thomas and leave Porthampton.
However, even after leaving Porthampton, Charles still made a name for himself in Salem and was now the CEO of a large corporate.
"I heard that Charles is now the regional corporate general manager of a large corporate. I never expected him to be Sabrina's father..."
Sheldon exclaimed in astonishment, and his gaze towards Sabrina seemed to have undergone a great change as well.
After all, it was rumored that Charles had left with his wife and daughter, but no one knew that Charles, in order to protect his wife and daughter, had left alone and left his wife and daughter in Porthampton.
At this moment, everyone's gaze towards Sabrina also underwent a great change. After all, in their eyes, Sabrina was just a pretty face with a little money in her family.
But no one expected that her identity would be so powerful, that she was the daughter of the famous Charles Ziegler!
Even Harold himself was shocked, his face full of astonishment. It seemed that even Harold himself had not expected Sabrina's background to be so terrifying.
As for Connor, he squinted his eyes and looked at Charles's position, his expression very calm.
After all, Connor was different from the others. He had only known Sabrina for a short time and didn't know much about her, so he was definitely not as shocked as Sheldon and the others.

chapters.title: Chapter 662 Charles's Boss!
chapters.content:
662  Charles's Boss!
Charles's appearance shocked many people present.
Previously, many people didn't know Sabrina's father's true identity and thought that she was just an ordinary rich girl.
But now they knew that her identity was unexpectedly powerful!
"I can't believe that Sabrina's father is Charles. This is truly unbelievable..."
Yara exclaimed, covering her mouth.
"Yes, it's no wonder Harold has been pursuing Sabrina for so long and never dared to force her..."
Laila whispered.
It should be noted that everyone present knew Harold's temperament.
Whenever he set his sights on a woman, he would do everything possible to get her.
But when faced with Sabrina, Harold appeared very patient.
This indicates that he must have known about Sabrina's father's identity in advance; otherwise, he wouldn't have been so patient.
After a long time of not seeing each other, Charles and Sabrina exchanged greetings.
After their conversation, Charles walked to the front of the crowd, smiling, and said, "You must all be Sabrina's good friends. Due to work reasons, I have been living abroad for a long time and haven't spent much time with Sabrina. I'm grateful to all of you for taking care of her, so I want to express my thanks here..."
"Mr. Charles, you're too polite..."
Sheldon replied with a smile.
When Charles saw Sheldon, he couldn't help but pause for a moment and then asked softly, "Are you the grandchild of Deputy Mayor Sutton?"
"Yes, Mr. Charles, we met briefly at my grandfather's birthday banquet..."
Sheldon quickly nodded.
"Is your grandfather doing well recently?" Charles asked softly.
"Thank you for your concern, Mr. Charles. My grandfather has been in good health..."
Sheldon replied promptly.
"That's good..."
Charles nodded lightly and then looked towards Harold's position, engaging in a brief conversation with him.
It was evident that among the many people, Charles only knew Sheldon and Harold. He didn't recognize or show interest in the others.
"Come on, let's continue celebrating Sabrina's birthday..."
Charles cheerfully invited everyone and sat at the dining table. Sabrina naturally sat next to Charles.
"Harold, come and sit here..."
Charles gently waved to Harold, gesturing for him to sit next to Sabrina.
At this point, Charles's intentions were quite obvious. He clearly wanted to matchmake Harold and Sabrina.
Although everyone understood his intentions, no one dared to speak up.
Meanwhile, Connor sat alone in a corner of the dining table.
Although Charles had an impressive background, he had a very affable personality. He gave off a gentle and courteous vibe, and his way of speaking didn't resemble that of a powerful figure, but rather that of an ordinary person.
As a result, the others were no longer as nervous as before and chatted with him while eating.
Almost everyone present actively tried to please Charles, except for Connor, who kept his head down and focused on his meal.
Occasionally, Sabrina would glance at Connor, seemingly worried about him.
"Charles, how long do you plan to stay at home this time?"
Sabrina's mother, Penelope, asked Charles softly.
"I should be staying in Porthampton for a few more days this time…" he replied softly.
"Really?"
Sabrina shouted happily when she heard this.
"Well, I encountered some problems at work, so I need to stay in Porthampton for a while longer..."
Charles nodded gently.
Upon hearing this, Penelope's expression showed some concern, and she softly asked Charles, "Is there a problem with the company?"
"It's not a problem with the company..."
Charles shook his head lightly, then looked at everyone and said expressionlessly, "Actually, here's what happened. I've been assisting my boss in managing the company's business overseas. But recently, our company's chairman suddenly passed away, and now we have a new chairman, who is likely a relative of the former chairman. So, this time I came back specifically to meet the new chairman and discuss matters regarding the company..."
Upon hearing his words, everyone was stunned, and their expressions were filled with shock.
Because no one had expected that he had a boss behind him.
Although they had heard about the powerful figure behind him, they never imagined that he had been working for this influential person all along.
Upon hearing Charles's explanation, Connor's eyes flashed with doubt, unable to help but glance at Charles.
Because he felt that the situation Charles described was somewhat similar to his own!
Could it be that Charles was also affiliated with Steven?
But just now, many people said that Charles and Thomas were in competition!
"Oh, I see!"
Penelope nodded thoughtfully and continued, "The chairman you mentioned should be the same boss behind you and Thomas, right?"
Upon hearing Penelope's words, everyone was dumbfounded, their mouths hanging open, their expressions extremely shocked.
Charles actually shared a boss with Thomas?
Connor's expression was even more shocked because he had previously suspected whether Charles had any connection to Steven.
But now, upon hearing her words, Connor could be a hundred percent certain that Charles's boss was none other than Steven.
Connor was now Charles's boss!
He couldn't help but sigh inwardly, realizing how small the world was. He had inexplicably become the boss of Sabrina's father!
"Mr. Charles, weren't you in competition with Thomas? How can you have the same boss as him?"
Sheldon asked Charles with great confusion.
"Hahaha..."
Upon hearing Sheldon's question, Charles couldn't help but burst into laughter and calmly said, "Although Thomas and I are in competition, we both have the same boss..."
Upon hearing his words, everyone remained stunned in their tracks, their expressions filled with disbelief.
If this matter were to be known, it would surely cause a huge stir in Porthampton!
Moreover, what kind of terrifying figure could make both Thomas and Charles serve him?

chapters.title: Chapter 663 Could It Be Connor?
chapters.content:
663  Could It Be Connor?
Charles and Thomas, either of them, are both prominent figures.
Thomas was like a tyrant in Porthampton, and even in Davenport, there were few who can compare to him.
Some even say that Thomas was now the richest man in Davenport, with a background beyond imagination.
As for Charles, he was the CEO of a conglomerate company in Salem, with a net worth of over 10 billion!
Both of these people are actually working for someone else. Their boss must be powerful!
"In fact, both Thomas and I are working for Steven. If it weren't for him, neither Thomas nor I would be where we are today. In the eyes of many, Thomas and I are enemies, but we're not. We do have some competitive relationship, considering that we both work for Steven and our personalities are somewhat similar. It's inevitable to have conflicts and friction..."
Charles smiled and addressed the crowd.
After hearing his words, everyone was dumbfounded, their expressions filled with shock.
All eyes were fixed on him, clearly showing great interest in the relationship between him and Thomas.
"At that time, Steven noticed the conflict between Thomas and me, so he came up with a compromise. He let both of us run our own companies and compete for two years. Whoever had better performance would continue to stay in Porthampton, while the loser would have to leave for somewhere else..."
Charles paused for a moment and continued, "You probably know the rest. I lost to Thomas and left Porthampton. Before leaving, Steven provided me with a large sum of money and introduced me to some connections, allowing me to run an international financial company in Salem. That's how I got to where I am today..."
"But Dad, why didn't you tell me about all this before?" Sabrina asked, sounding puzzled.
"I felt embarrassed about losing to Thomas, so I never mentioned it to anyone. But now, both Thomas and I are at an age where we've come to understand certain things. Steven did what he did for our own good. If Thomas and I continued to work together, our conflicts would have only grown. After all, at that time, we were both young and arrogant, looking down on each other. But if we separated, both of us could have a better development. Now I understand his good intentions..."
"So that's how it is!"
After listening to Charles's explanation, everyone suddenly realized and understood the situation.
"Mr. Charles, who is the boss behind you and Thomas? They must be terrifying..." Harold asked with curiosity.
"Our boss is called Steven, but he has passed away now, and the new chairman should be someone named Connor, but I'm not sure of his full name. After all, I just returned to the country..." Charles replied calmly.
"Connor?" After hearing Charles's words, everyone couldn't help but be stunned. They were all very curious and wondering who he might be!
Yara glanced at Connor and playfully said, "Could that Connor be you?"
"Hahaha..."
After hearing Yana's words, everyone burst into laughter.
Clearly, these people knew that she was joking with Connor!
Among the people present, only Sabrina and Lilian didn't laugh.
Charles glanced at Connor indifferently and continued, "By the way, have you all heard of Kyle?"
Sheldon hurriedly said, "We have."
"Kyle, like me and Thomas, is also under the command of this Mr. Connor," Charles said casually.
"Oh my god, who exactly is this Mr. Connor? This is too terrifying..." The crowd couldn't help but take a sharp breath.
To be able to have Kyle, Charles, and Thomas all working for him, just how terrifying must the background of this Mr. Connor be they wondered.
These people couldn't even dare to imagine it now!
"I wonder how old this Mr. Connor is and if he has a girlfriend. If I could marry this Mr. Connor, I wouldn't have to worry about money for the rest of my life..." Yana said dreamily.
"Maybe this Mr. Connor is just a middle-aged bald man, and don't you already have a boyfriend now?" Sadie said with a hint of helplessness in her expression.
"If my boyfriend had half the abilities of Mr. Connor, I would have married him a long time ago. But unfortunately, he's just an ordinary second-generation rich, and compared to Mr. Connor, it's like heaven and earth..." Yana said indifferently.
Sadie sighed helplessly upon hearing this statement and didn't say much.
She couldn't help but sigh in her heart, "You fools, the Mr. Connor is sitting right in front of you, and you don't even know..."
12:29
At this moment, she had made up her mind that she absolutely couldn't reveal his identity.
The crowd began discussing the matter of the Mr. Connor, except for Lilian, who was staring straight at Connor.
She couldn't help but sigh in her heart, "You fools, the Mr. Connor is sitting right in front of you, and you don't even know..."
At this moment, she had made up her mind that she absolutely couldn't reveal his identity.
The more people who knew, the more competitors she would have.
Currently, no one knew the true identity of Connor, which was an extremely rare opportunity for Lilian!
With this in mind, Lilian's gaze towards Connor became even more fervent, and she even took the initiative to pick up food for him twice.
If it were the previous Connor, he might have been at a loss facing Lilian's attentiveness.
But now, he had experienced several women, so he naturally understood what Lilian meant. However, he had no particular thoughts about her.
Not only Lilian, but Sabrina as well.
An hour later, everyone finished their meal and then started playing games in the living room.
Sabrina's mother, Penelope, exchanged glances with Charles and then walked upstairs together.
"What's the matter?"
