After going upstairs, Charles asked Penelope in a puzzled tone.
"Charles, have you seen that boy named Connor?" Penelope furrowed her eyebrows and asked.
"I've seen him. What's wrong?" Charles asked softly.
"I feel like Sabrina seems to like this boy, but I think this boy's conditions are quite average. If you have time, go talk to him..." Penelope said in a low voice.

chapters.title: Chapter 664 What Is Your Relationship With My Daughter?
chapters.content:
664  What Is Your Relationship With My Daughter?
"I should talk to him?"
Upon hearing this, Charles immediately frowned, his expression clearly showing displeasure.
He couldn't help but furrow his brow and said, "What's there to talk about? Don't you know Sabrina's temper?"
"Of course, I know Sabrina's temper, but I'm afraid this girl will be deceived. Sabrina just started college, and it's the easiest time for boys to deceive her..."
Penelope hurriedly said.
Charles's expression seemed helpless, then he said lightly, "I didn't agree with you when you wanted to match Sabrina with Harold. Now you want me to talk to Connor. What do you want me to say?"
"What else can you say? Just say that you disagree with him being with Sabrina and let this guy give up..."
Penelope said straightforwardly.
Charles remained silent.
"If you don't want to go, then I'll go by myself. I'm worried that this guy isn't a good person. There are some things I must clarify with him face to face..."
Penelope continued.
"Forget it, I'll go talk to him. If this guy has any ambition, maybe I can give him a chance and help him behind the scenes. If you go, it will definitely be a blow to him, and it's easy to breed resentment..."
Charles sighed lightly.
"What's the point of helping? Don't act all righteous. Let me tell you, just say what you want to say. Don't give this guy any hope..."
Penelope hurriedly said.
"Alright, I understand..."
Charles replied impatiently, then turned and left.
...
Ten o'clock at night.
Sabrina's birthday banquet finally came to an end, and the people like Sheldon and Harold left the villa one after another.
Tonight, Harold did not actively provoke Connor, perhaps because Sabrina's parents were present, and he didn't dare to go too far.
After Harold and the others left the villa, Connor was also sent out of the villa by Sabrina.
After leaving the villa, Lilian took the initiative to find Connor. "Mr. Connor, do you have time tonight? Would you like me to drive you for a ride..."
As she spoke, she shook the BMW key in her hand in front of him.
Upon hearing her words, Connor couldn't help but be stunned. His expression seemed shocked.
"What did you just call me?"
Connor couldn't help but ask Lilian softly.
"I..."
Lilian looked at him, directly stunned in place, her expression seemed somewhat embarrassed.
Because she didn't expect that she had accidentally revealed it.
He took a step forward and walked directly in front of Lilian, carefully examining her, and asked in a cold tone, "You already know my identity, don't you?"
"I..."
Lilian opened her mouth to explain.
"So you deliberately tried to please me today. Not only did you speak up for me, but you also served me food, right?"
At this moment, his tone was very cold, and his expression was icy as he questioned Lilian.
When she called him 'Mr. Connor' earlier, it was obvious that she already knew his identity. Otherwise, she would never address him that way.
Lilian also knew that she couldn't hide it anymore, so she could only nod helplessly and then softly said to Connor, "Yes, Mr. Connor, I have indeed known your identity for a long time. I have no other intentions in getting close to you!"
Suddenly, he reached out and grabbed her chin, forcefully lifting her delicate face, and asked in a cold tone, "Apart from you, does anyone else know about my identity?"
"No... No one else..." Lilian, already frightened by Connor, quickly shook her head.
"I don't want anyone else to know about my identity, so you better keep your mouth shut, understand?" His tone was furious in order to make scare her.
"I... I understand..." She hesitated for a moment and nodded at him again.
"Also, I know what you're thinking, so it's best not to play tricks with me, or else you'll regret it, understand?" He continued, staring at her.
"Understood..." She nodded once again, in a daze.
"Get out of my face!" Connor waved his hand.
After seeing her leave, he sighed helplessly. With more and more people knowing his identity, it wasn't a good thing for him to keep it hidden.
After hesitating for a moment, he directly walked forward.
But just as he took a few steps, a black car stopped by the roadside.
A muscular man in black walked out of the car and approached Connor.
"Hello, our boss wants to talk to you..." The muscular man said to Connor in a low voice.
Connor glanced up and down at the muscular man. He knew that this man was Charles's bodyguard, so the boss must be Charles himself.
"Could it be that Charles has discovered my identity?" Connor couldn't help muttering, but he quickly dismissed the idea.
Because Charles and Connor had a superior-subordinate relationship, if Charles really knew Connor's identity, he wouldn't have sent a bodyguard to find him.
So Charles should be looking for him regarding Sabrina's matter.
"Alright." Connor looked at the bodyguard and agreed, then he walked forward alongside the bodyguard.
A few minutes later, he arrived next to a middle-aged man.
And this middle-aged man was none other than Sabrina's father.
"Mr. Charles, may I ask why you're looking for me?" Connor walked directly in front of Charles and asked expressionlessly.
Charles slowly turned his head and glanced at Connor, then calmly asked, "What is your relationship with my daughter?"
"I am just a regular friend of Sabrina..." Connor calmly replied.
"Just a regular friend?" After hearing this, Charles's eyes showed a hint of disappointment.
Originally, he thought that if Connor could be honest with him, he might give him a chance to be with Sabrina.
After all, Charles only had one daughter, Sabrina, and he didn't want her to marry someone she didn't like.
But he didn't expect Connor to be so weak, not even daring to admit this matter!

chapters.title: Chapter 665 I'll Give You A Chance
chapters.content:
665  I'll Give You A Chance
Charles couldn't help but glance at Connor with a disappointed expression on his face.
"Mr. Charles, did you call me here just to ask me this question?" Connor asked.
At that moment, Charles took a deep breath and said expressionlessly, "I called you here today not only for this matter. I wanted to tell you that from now on, I hope you can stay away from Sabrina..."
"Stay away from Sabrina?" Connor couldn't help but sneer upon hearing these words.
"You are simply not worthy of my daughter. So I hope you won't bother Sabrina anymore. Do you understand what I mean?" Charles showed no respect for Connor, his expression cold.
Connor looked Charles up and down, then asked without expression, "So, Mr. Charles, what kind of person do you think is worthy of your daughter? Someone like Harold, perhaps?"
"Harold?" Charles scoffed disdainfully upon hearing those words, then said lightly, "Harold is not worthy of my daughter yet. He is still under observation. And compared to him, you don't even have the qualifications for me to observe..."
"No qualifications for observation?" Connor smiled playfully.
"That's right. If Harold can rise to the rank of Major in the next five years, I might consider letting him be with my daughter. Otherwise, he doesn't have the qualifications to be with my daughter..." Charles spoke with an icy tone to Connor.
Although Charles's tone was cold, Connor could feel his confidence when he said these words.
"I didn't expect you to have such high expectations for Sabrina's boyfriend..." Connor said with a smile.
"It's not that my expectations are high, but I don't trust people like you with Sabrina. You don't have the ability to protect Sabrina for a lifetime. I will never let my daughter marry someone like you!" Charles's tone was gentle, but there was a hint of coldness in his words.
"What if your boss takes an interest in Sabrina? What would you do then?" Connor asked him with a playful tone.
Upon hearing his words, Charles couldn't help but pause for a moment, then said expressionlessly, "Are you talking about my boss?"
"Yes, didn't you say you have a boss? I think someone like him should have the ability to protect Sabrina, right? If he takes an interest in her, what would you do?" he asked softly.
Charles hesitated for a moment, then said in a low voice, "If my boss takes an interest in Sabrina, I will ask Sabrina for her opinion. After all, it's her own choice. If she agrees, I would be happy, but if she doesn't, I won't force her..."
Upon hearing his words, Connor couldn't help but smile lightly.
It must be said that Charles's words were quite satisfying to him.
"I think Mr. Charles, you may have misunderstood me. Sabrina and I are just ordinary friends. We are not together now, and we won't be in the future. So your concerns are unnecessary!" Connor calmly looked at Charles and said.
"Are you really just ordinary friends?," Charles looked at Connor with a puzzled expression, seeing that he didn't seem to be joking.
"Of course!"
He nodded gently and continued, "I've only known Sabrina for less than half a month, and I already have a girlfriend. So I have no other thoughts about Sabrina. I just treat her as my little sister..."
Seeing his sincere tone, Charles felt that he wouldn't lie to him.
So Charles nodded lightly and said calmly, "Since you put it that way, I will trust you this time. If you ever want to pursue my children, you can come to me. I'll give you a chance to start from the grassroots level in my company. If you can reach the level I expect within five years, I will agree to you being together!"
Charles himself came from an ordinary family background. It was through Steven's promotion that he reached his current position.
So when he saw Connor, it was like seeing his past self.
If he could have Connor by his side and if he was truly willing to make progress, even letting him inherit his position wouldn't be impossible. After all, Charles didn't have a son.
The words Charles spoke to Connor at this moment would be considered a heaven-sent opportunity in the eyes of an ordinary person.
At the very least, it could save an ordinary person twenty years of struggle!
"You want me to go abroad with you and work at your company?"
Connor was stunned for a moment and asked him softly.
"Yes, I know your conditions are average. If you want to be with my daughter, the only thing you lack is an opportunity. And now I'm giving you that opportunity, but the condition is that you have to leave Porthampton with me, and for the next five years, you cannot see Sabrina again!"
Charles looked at him and nodded gently.
"Sorry, I'm still studying now, I can't leave Porthampton!" Connor replied to him.
"I can help you with your studies..."
"Mr. Charles, do you have anything else to discuss? If not, I'll take my leave!"
Before Charles could speak, Connor directly spoke up.
"Are you sure you want to give up this opportunity?"
He asked Connor with a shocked expression after hearing his words.
"Yes, I don't need this opportunity. Sabrina and I are just ordinary friends, and I don't want to be with her either..."
Connor replied casually.
Charles looked at Connor without saying a word, feeling extremely shocked.
Because he never expected that Connor would actually reject him.
And after Connor saw his silence, he turned around and walked away into the distance.
Charles was left standing in place, his expression full of disbelief.
"Could it be that I was overthinking? Maybe Connor really doesn't like Sabrina?" he couldn't help but sigh softly.

chapters.title: Chapter 666 Phoenix Bracelet
chapters.content:
666  Phoenix Bracelet
After Connor left, Charles stood there alone with his mouth agape.
Connor's reply just now had really made Charles feel that it was somewhat unbelievable.
Because he felt that even if Connor didn't like Sabrina, he shouldn't reject the olive branch he had thrown to him!
For ordinary people, this condition was simply a good thing that fell from the sky!
"Connor, who gave you the confidence to be like this? You haven't even stepped into society yet, but you're already so arrogant. When you enter society in the future, you'll realize how stupid your current actions are. You might not know what I meant by what I said to you just now, but sooner or later, you'll regret it…" Charles thought.
At this moment, Charles's bodyguard walked up to him and whispered, "Director Zachman, this kid is too arrogant. Do you want me to help you teach him a lesson?"
"There's no need. He's just a poor student. There's no need to care too much about him…"
Charles replied indifferently and continued, "Let's go back as well…"
"Good!"
The bodyguard nodded lightly.
Actually, the bodyguard was also very confused. He could not understand why Connor would reject Charles's request.
This was a rare opportunity for many people!
A few minutes later, Charles returned home. At this moment, Sabrina and Penelope were tidying up the living room.
"Dad, what did you do outside just now?"
Sabrina greeted him happily when she saw him.
"I'm going out to get something…"
Charles smiled and replied to her. Then, he walked to Sabrina and asked her softly, "What are you two doing?"
"I'm helping Sabrina organize the gifts that her friends gave her…" Penelope replied with a smile.
After Charles heard this, he glanced at the gifts on the table and said with a smile, "I didn't expect my daughter to be so popular as to receive so many gifts!"
"Charles, take a quick look at this jade bracelet…"
Penelope picked up the green bracelet that Harold Phillips had given Sabrina and handed it to Charles.
Charles took the bracelet and looked at it carefully. He then said softly, "The quality of this jade bracelet is not bad—the gem looks to be top-notch. Its price should not be cheap either…"
"That's right. I heard that this bracelet is worth millions!"
Penelope hurriedly replied.
Charles glanced at Penelope and said softly, "I didn't expect Harold Phillips to be so attentive. Jade itself is very nourishing; if such a good gem is always worn on your body, it will also be very beneficial to your body…"
"Sabrina, hurry up and put it on!"
Penelope said to Sabrina with a smile.
"Since jade is so good, I'll let you wear it. I already have one bracelet…"
Sabrina replied softly.
"You already have one?"
A trace of confusion flashed across Penelope's eyes.
Sabrina hesitated for a moment before she took out the garnet bracelet that Connor had given her. She then said to Penelope softly, "Compared to that jade bracelet, I prefer this garnet bracelet…"
When Penelope saw the jade bracelet in Sabrina's hand, she could not help but be stunned for a moment. She then frowned and asked Sabrina, "Sabrina, why are you still wearing this bracelet? Wasn't this garnet bracelet a fake given to you by that poor kid? Hurry up and take it off. If others see this, won't we become a joke? They'll think that we can't afford real jade…"
"Mom, what poor kid? That's Connor!"
When Sabrina heard Penelope's words, her expression immediately became unhappy. She continued, "I don't care if this garnet bracelet is real or fake. I just like it more than Harold Phillips's jade bracelet…"
"We clearly have real jewelry. Why do you have to wear a fake one?"
Penelope asked in confusion.
"Oh, you won't understand even if I tell you. I just don't like this jade bracelet. I like the garnet one…" Sabrina shouted excitedly.
"No, you have to wear this jade bracelet today. Take off that garnet bracelet for me…"
As Penelope spoke, she reached out her hand to snatch the garnet bracelet from Sabrina.
Sabrina quickly took two steps back. She frowned and shouted, "I just like the garnet bracelet that Connor gave me, and I don't think there's much of a difference between these two gems. What difference does it make which one I wear?"
"Why are you so disobedient?"
"Sabrina, bring me the jade bracelet in your hand…"
However, at this moment, Charles suddenly shouted at Sabrina with a serious expression.
When Sabrina heard this, she was stunned for a moment. Then, she asked Charles with a puzzled expression, "What's wrong, Dad?"
"Show me that garnet bracelet…"
Charles repeated in a low voice.
"..."
Sabrina hesitated for a moment before she handed the garnet bracelet to Charles.
Charles quickly took the bracelet and observed it carefully.
When Penelope saw that there was something wrong with Charles's expression, she could not help but ask softly, "Charles, what are you looking at? This is just a fake gem. Why are you looking at it so seriously?"
"This is not a fake gem at all!" Charles called out expressionlessly and continued, "This garnet bracelet is the legendary Phoenix Bracelet. It's very famous in our country. However, because very few people know about this gem, it's normal for ordinary people to treat this as a fake gem…"
"Phoenix Bracelet?"
When Sabrina and Penelope heard Charles's words, they froze on the spot. They were confused.
"Dad, what is a Phoenix Bracelet?"
Sabrina hesitated for a moment before asking Charles softly.
"It's like this. Back then, a piece of garnet was discovered in the country of Marlon. The quality of the gem was exquisite. When it was discovered, there was a phoenix pattern on the raw stone, so it was called the Phoenix Gem. Later, this Phoenix Gem was auctioned for one billion dollars. After that, they hired the world's most famous designer to design several accessories out of the gem, such as pendants, bracelets, necklaces, and so on. This bracelet should be one of those accessories…"
Charles said excitedly.

chapters.title: Chapter 667 Jewelry Appraiser
chapters.content:
667  Jewelry Appraiser
When Sabrina and Penelope heard Charles's words, they were stunned on the spot. Their faces were filled with disbelief.
Because both of them felt that this garnet bracelet was just a fake and not worth much.
However, in Charles's mouth, it had become a priceless Phoenix Bracelet.
"Charles, do you mean that this garnet bracelet is very valuable?" Penelope could not help but hesitate for a moment before asking Charles softly.
"Yes. If I'm not wrong, this bracelet is definitely very expensive—the Phoenix Bracelet is made from unique red gem in the world. This garnet bracelet is a part of the Phoenix Gem. Although its price is not as terrifying as the Phoenix Gem itself, it is definitely not something that ordinary people can afford…"
Charles said expressionlessly.
"Charles, am I joking with us? Connor is a poor boy. How could he have the money to give Sabrina such an expensive gift?" Penelope asked with a doubtful tone.
"That's right, Connor shouldn't have that much money!" Sabrina added.
"I think your dad must have made a mistake. This is definitely a fake. It's not a Phoenix Bracelet at all. If it's really a Phoenix Bracelet, then why didn't Connor react at all when Sabrina's friends laughed at him at that time? He didn't stand up and refute their words either…"
Penelope had witnessed what had happened in the living room back then and said all this with certainty.
"Well, after all, Dad has never seen a Phoenix Bracelet before. It's normal for him to make a mistake!" Sabrina nodded in agreement.
However, Charles did not think that he had made a mistake. He said with certainty, "I've seen a necklace made of Phoenix Gem before. There's no way I could be wrong…"
"But Dad, I know Connor's family situation very well. He doesn't have so much money to buy such an expensive gift for me…" Sabrina said softly after a moment of hesitation.
"Now is not the time to discuss whether Connor has the money to buy this garnet bracelet. Instead, we have to figure out what's going on with this garnet bracelet and whether it's a real Phoenix Bracelet!" Charles took out his phone as he spoke and continued, "I know a very famous jewelry appraisal expert in Porthampton. I'll ask him to come over and appraise it now..."
"Yes, get someone to appraise it!" Penelope hurriedly nodded. At this moment, she did not believe that the garnet bracelet that Connor gave Sabrina was a Phoenix Bracelet. How could a poor kid who was still studying have so much money?
Charles hesitated for a moment before picking up his phone and making a call. He then briefly explained the purpose of his call.
Because of Charles's identity, the other party naturally did not dare to refuse.
About half an hour later, a white-haired old man arrived at Sabrina's house.
When Charles saw the old man, he quickly went up to him warmly and said with a smile, "Mr. Daniels, I'm really sorry for asking you to come over so late at night…"
"It's fine, Mr. Ziegler. I have nothing to do at home, so I came out for a walk…"
Mr. Daniels replied with a smile.
"Mr. Daniels, please come in!" Charles made an inviting gesture to Mr. Daniels.
Mr. Daniels walked up to Sabrina and exchanged some pleasantries with her.
"Mr. Daniels, I just want you to help me see if this garnet bracelet is really a Phoenix Bracelet!" Charles picked up the garnet bracelet that Connor had given to Sabrina and respectfully handed it to Mr. Daniels.
Mr. Daniels was a highly respected gem appraisal master in Porthampton. He was very knowledgeable in appraising jewelry. Therefore, his appraisal of the bracelet would carry a high level of credibility.
If even Mr. Daniels said that this garnet bracelet was the real Phoenix Bracelet, then there would be no problem. However, if he felt that it was fake, then there would be no room left for doubt in everyone's minds!
After Mr. Daniels took the garnet bracelet, he looked at it very carefully. Then, he turned to Charles and said, "Mr. Ziegler, this garnet bracelet is the real Phoenix Bracelet..."
"You identified it so quickly?" After Penelope heard Mr. Daniels's words, a trace of shock flashed across her eyes.
After all, in the eyes of ordinary people, appraising gemstones usually took a long time. But at this moment. Mr. Daniels was sure that this garnet bracelet was the real item in such a short time. It was indeed unbelievable.
"..."
Mr. Daniels could not help but turn his head and look at Penelope indifferently in the face of Penelope's doubt. Then, he said softly, "Madam Ziegler, I've already appraised this garnet bracelet once before, so I'm very sure that this bracelet is made from the Phoenix Gem…"
"You've already appraised it once?" When everyone heard this, their eyes widened in disbelief.
"Mr. Daniels, are you saying that you've already appraised this garnet bracelet?" Charles asked Mr. Daniels in shock.
"That's right. A few days ago, the people from the Grand Hotel invited me and a few other experts to help them appraise a batch of jewelry. Among them was this Phoenix Bracelet. At that time, I appraised it with many gemstone experts and confirmed that this garnet bracelet was a Phoenix Bracelet…"
Mr. Daniels said confidently.
When everyone heard Mr. Daniels's words, they finally realized that the garnet bracelet that Connor had given Sabrina was a real Phoenix Bracelet. However, what they did not understand was that since this garnet bracelet belonged to the Grand Hotel, why did Connor have it?
Could it be that Connor stole this garnet bracelet from the Grand Hotel?
Charles's eyes flashed with a strange light, and then he whispered to Mr. Daniels, "Mr. Daniels, do you know who the owner of this garnet bracelet is?" "I heard that this garnet bracelet was auctioned off to Miss Madison Phillips for 80 million that night, but I don't know why it appeared in your hands, Mr. Ziegler…"
Mr. Daniels replied indifferently.
After hearing Mr. Daniels's words, Charles could not help but take a deep breath. At this moment, he was certain that this garnet bracelet was stolen from Madison Phillips by Connor.
However, he didn't answer Mr. Daniels's question. Instead, he changed the topic and exchanged a few pleasantries with Mr. Daniels to brush off the matter.
Half an hour later, Charles sent Mr. Daniels out of the villa and returned home with an ugly expression.
Both Charles and Penelope had ugly expressions on their faces. Both of them thought that Connor had stolen this garnet bracelet from Madison Phillips!

chapters.title: Chapter 668: Madison Phillips’s Boyfriend
chapters.content:
Chapter 668: Madison Phillips’s Boyfriend
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation | Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
“I didn’t expect this Connor to be so poor and immoral as to steal someone else’s things!” Penelope gritted her teeth and whispered.
“That’s right. This Connor is really bold. He even dared to steal from the Phillips family, and such a precious treasure at that! If the Phillips family finds out, the consequences will be unimaginable…”
Charles could not help but sigh softly.
“Charles, it’s fortunate that you’re back today. If it were only the two of us at home, we definitely wouldn’t have been able to tell that there’s anything wrong with this garnet bracelet. How do you think we should handle this matter…?” Penelope asked Charles.
After Charles heard her words, he could not help but hesitate for a moment. Then, he said expressionlessly, “This garnet bracelet is so valuable, so the Phillips family will definitely find out that the garnet bracelet is missing. If they investigate, they will definitely find Connor. If Connor says that it’s in our daughter’s hands, how am I going to handle it?”
“Then what do you mean?”
Penelope was stunned for a moment and asked softly.
“What 1 mean is very simple: since we have already discovered that this garnet bracelet was stolen by Connor, and we have also found the owner of the garnet bracelet, why don’t we directly contact the Phillips family and explain the matter to them? As for how they deal with Connor, it has nothing to do with us…”
Charles took out his phone, about to contact Luke Phillips.
After all, Luke was a big shot in Porthampton. Even though Charles had not been in Porthampton for a long time and was not very familiar with Luke, it was not difficult to contact him.
When Sabrina saw that Charles was about to make a phone call, she looked a little nervous. She hurriedly took a step forward and ran to Charles. Then, she reached out and snatched Charles’s phone. She said excitedly, “Dad, what are you doing?”
“Sabrina, listen to me. The garnet bracelet that Connor gave you must have been stolen from the Phillips family. There’s no way Connor could afford such an expensive garnet bracelet…” Charles said to Sabrina with a serious expression.
“Dad, this might have been given to Connor by the Phillips family, and Connor in turn gave it to me…”
Sabrina shouted anxiously.
Charles was stunned when he heard Sabrina’s words. He frowned and looked at Sabrina. He said helplessly, “Sabrina, what are you on? Connor is just a poor student. Why would Miss Phillips give him such an expensive garnet bracelet? Are you out of your mind?”
“Dad, I’m really not…”
Sabrina took a deep breath and told Charles everything that happened at the auction house.
When Charles and Penelope heard Sabrina’s words, they were stunned on the spot. Their faces were filled with disbelief.
“Sabrina, is what you said true?”
Penelope asked Sabrina softly.
“Of course it’s true!”
Sabrina replied with a helpless expression before continuing, “That night, I was with Sadie. Sheldon, Harold, and the others were also present. Miss Phillips actually lost her temper at Harold because of Connor and even fired the manager of the Grand Hotel, so 1 think Madison’s relationship with Connor must be not simple.”
Charles and Penelope looked at Sabrina in shockin their eyes, Connor was just a poor kid. The two of them did not expect Connor to be able to know someone of Madison’s level.
“Sabrina, you can’t lie to us about this kind of thing!”
Charles was worried that Sabrina was lying because she wanted to protect Connor.
“Dad, I’m really not lying. If you don’t believe me, you can call Harold or Sadie…” Sabrina shouted helplessly.
Charles looked at Sabrina and hesitated for two seconds. He also felt that this matter was a little strange.
After all, it wouldn’t be easy for Connor to steal such a precious garnet bracelet. Also, if this bracelet was really stolen by Connor, why would he give it to Sabrina? Was he not afraid of being discovered?
Even if Connor wanted to please Sabrina, he would not do something so risky!
However, the only thing that Charles could not understand was why Madison would give such an expensive garnet bracelet to Connor. Connor had neither status nor background; he was not worthy of being fawned on by someone like Madison!
A bold idea suddenly popped into Charles’s head.
“Could it be that Madison has fallen in love with Connor?”
They were about the same age, and they were both young and vigorous. Although Connor didn’t have any background, his looks were decent and his figure was well-proportioned.
Madison, a rich girl, didn’t lack money at all, so when choosing a boyfriend, it made sense that she naturally wouldn’t put the other party’s financial strength first. Therefore, it was very likely that Madison was confused when she fell in love with Connor.
If Connor really was Madison’s boyfriend, then it would make sense that Connor had said that he did not like Sabrina and rejected her idea of promoting him.
Charles felt that this garnet bracelet was given to Connor by Madison, and then Connor in turn gave it to Sabrina.
“Sabrina, tell Dad the truth. What is your relationship with Connor?”
Charles asked Sabrina seriously.
When Sabrina heard Charles’s words, she could not help but be stunned. She frowned and asked Charles, “Dad, why are you asking me this question?” “Answer me, what is your relationship with Connor?” Charles repeated in a low voice.
“Connor and I have only known each other for less than half a month. The two of us are just ordinary friends…” Sabrina replied helplessly.
When Charles heard Sabrina’s words, he was even more certain of the answer in his heart.
“No wonder Connor was so arrogant to me just now. He even said that he already had a girlfriend. 1 didn’t expect him to be telling the truth. His girlfriend is probably Luke Phillips’s granddaughter!”
Charles could not help but sigh in his heart.
If Connor was really Madison’s boyfriend, then all the doubts would be revealed.
When Sabrina and Penelope saw the expression on Charles’s face, they were confused..

chapters.title: Chapter 669: Do You Have Any Powerful Techniques?
chapters.content:
Chapter 669: Do You Have Any Powerful Techniques?
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation | Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
“I didn’t expect that Connor’s backer would actually be the Phillips family. Looks like I’ve underestimated him!” Charles sighed softly as he sat on the sofa.
“Charles, what are you mumbling about?” Penelope asked Charles with a puzzled expression.
“There’s nothing wrong with the search.”
Charles waved his hand lightly.
“Then, Charles, what do you think we should do with this bracelet?”
Penelope asked with a frown.
II II
After Charles heard Penelope’s words, he could not help but look up at the blood-red bracelet in front of him. After hesitating for two seconds, he said softly, “I won’t contact the Phillips family for now…”
“That’s great…”
When Sabrina heard Charles’s words, she heaved a sigh of relief.
After all, Sabrina did not know if Connor had stolen the bracelet or if Madison had given it to him. As long as Charles did not contact the Phillips family, she was relieved.
When Charles saw the expression on Sabrina’s face, he said softly, “Sabrina, don’t celebrate just yet. 1 won’t call the Phillips family now, but it doesn’t mean that this matter has passed…”
Sabrina was stunned when she heard this and asked softly, “Then what do you mean by that, Dad?”
“From now on, don’t wear this bracelet anymore. Don’t let anyone know that this garnet bracelet is in your hands…” Charles said.
“Why?” Sabrina asked unhappily.
“Because we’re still not sure if this jade bracelet was given to Connor by Lin Min. In the next few days, I’ll get someone to investigate and see if the Phillips family is looking for this jade bracelet. If the Phillips family is looking for this jade bracelet, it means that this jade bracelet was stolen by Connor. I’ll take the initiative to return the jade bracelet to the Phillips family.”
Charles said slowly.
Sabrina looked at Charles helplessly. However, she did not know how to refute him, so she could only nod her head helplessly.
After Sabrina agreed, Charles stood up and walked towards the bedroom.
Penelope hesitated for a moment before leaving with Charles, leaving Sabrina alone in the living room.
At this moment, Sabrina’s expression was very conflicted because she did not know if she should tell Connor about this.
If Sabrina told Connor about this, she was worried that Connor did not steal the jade bracelet. If her family suspected Connor, it would make him sad.
If she made this call, it would show that she did not believe Connor either. At the same time, if she did not make this call, she would worry over whether or not Connor had really stolen the bracelet. Hence, Sabrina was very conflicted.
“What should I do?”
Sabrina held her phone tightly, not knowing what to do.
A few minutes later, Sabrina slowly put down her phone and said softly, “I don’t think Connor is the one who stole it. It’s better not to call him…”
After saying that, Sabrina put down her phone and returned to her bedroom.
While all that was happening, after Connor left Sabrina’s house, he did not return to the Mansion. Instead, he called a taxi and went to the courtyard where Jorge Yarrell was. It was almost eleven o’clock at night, and the courtyard was dark.
“That old man can’t be asleep yet, right?”
Connor couldn’t help but sigh and then continue to walk into the courtyard.
A few minutes later, Connor arrived in front of Jorge’s room. At this moment, the lights in the room were still on. This meant that Jorge hadn’t rested yet, so Connor reached out and knocked on the door lightly.
“Come in!”
Jorge’s voice sounded.
Connor hesitated for a moment before pushing open the door. After entering the room, Connor simply observed the interior.
The furniture in Jorge’s room were very simple: there was a table, a chair, and a small bed. There was a small statue on the table and a bookshelf in the corner. There were many yellowed books on the bookshelf.
At this moment, Jorge was sitting on a chair reading a book.
“Old man, it’s already so late, yet you’re still not asleep?” Connor asked Jorge with a smile.
“It’s so late. What are you doing here?” Jorge put down the book in his hand and turned to look at Connor.
Connor walked to the front of the bookshelf and casually picked up a book to flip through. Then, he said to Jorge in a casual tone, “Where’s Jabba? Call him out. I want to fight him…”
“Jabba is sleeping. Come back tomorrow!”
Jorge said calmly.
“Can’t you just wake him up?” Connor said helplessly.
“Jabba has a bad temper. If you wake him up now, he might attack you in a fit of anger. If he kills you, who will pay me?”
Jorge asked Connor softly.
Connor couldn’t help but be stunned when he heard Jorge’s words. The expression on his face was a little helpless. Connor had been fighting with Jabba for more than a month now, so he knew Jabba’s skills very well.
Although Jabba was just a small chimpanzee, his strength was terrifying and his speed was very fast. If he really provoked Jabba, the consequences would be unimaginable.
Therefore, after hesitating for a moment, Connor said softly, “In that case, forget it. I’ll come back tomorrow…”
After saying this, Connor turned around and planned to leave.
But when Connor reached the door, he suddenly stopped and turned back to look at Jorge. He laughed and said, “Old man, I heard from Thomas Morgan that you’re a very powerful ancient martial arts master. Is that true?”
“It’s just a title given to me by other people…” Jorge said calmly.
Connor returned to Jorge’s side and asked with a smile, “Does that mean you’re really an ancient martial arts master?”
Jorge looked at Connor indifferently and didn’t say anything.
“Old man, can you tell me what ancient martial arts are?”
Connor continued to ask.
“You need to experience ancient martial arts on your own—everyone has a different understanding of them. Not just that, as you are now, you’re unsuitable to cultivate your own brand of martial arts…” Jorge said calmly.
“But I’m fighting with Jabba every day now. When can 1 become a real martial artist?”
Connor called out helplessly, then looked at Jorge and continued, “Old man, do you have any powerful techniques? Can you teach me?”

chapters.title: Chapter 670: Seven-Star Big Dipper Fist
chapters.content:
Chapter 670: Seven-Star Big Dipper Fist
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Connor felt that if Jorge was really an ancient martial arts grandmaster, then he definitely would have many powerful techniques.
Moreover, he had been fighting Jabba for nearly a month, but he still felt that he had not improved at all.
If he could get Jorge to teach him some powerful cultivation techniques, then he would have no problem dealing with a few ordinary people.
When Jorge heard Connor’s words, he couldn’t help but turn to look at Connor. Then, he said expressionlessly, “I’ve said it before. I’ll take you as my disciple the moment you defeat Jabba…”
“Stinky old man, why are you so petty? I don’t know anything now. I fight with a stupid gorilla every day. Moreover, that gorilla is so strong. When can I defeat Jabba? If you teach me a few moves, won’t I be able to defeat Jabba?”
Connor shouted at Jorge helplessly.
“That’s why I said that your qualifications are poor…”
Jorge coldly replied to Connor.
Connor frowned and said with a helpless expression, “Well, as long as you teach me any cultivation technique now, I guarantee that I can defeat Jabba…”
“I will not teach you anything until you defeat Jabba!” Jorge said expressionlessly.
“If I don’t defeat Jabba, you won’t teach me, right?”
Connor asked excitedly.
Jorge nodded. “That’s right. I have always been a person with principles—”
“10 million. Can you teach me a few moves?”
Connor gritted his teeth and asked in a low voice.
“I’ve already made it very clear to you just now. I have my principles—”
“Is 20 million enough for you to give up your principles?”
Connor shouted, his heart aching.
“I can’t…”
Jorge looked at Connor and shook his head again.
“Alright, I won’t waste any more time with you. I’ll give you a fixed price of 50 million. Do you agree or not?” Connor shouted excitedly.
“Deal!”
Jorge saw that Connor was really going to leave and called out to him with a smile.
“You…”
Connor looked at the expression on Jorge’s face and was speechless. He didn’t expect this old man to be so greedy.
Jorge slowly stood up and walked to the front of the bookshelf. He casually took out a book and threw it in front of Connor. Then, he laughed and said, “This is a fist manual. You just need to learn the technique according to the instructions there. As long as you can learn one or two moves, it won’t be a problem for you to deal with a few ordinary people. If you can learn more than three moves, you’ll be more than a match for your average yellow-ranked fighter…”
“Are you sure?”
Connor looked at the fist manual in his hand doubtfully, and the expression on his face was very puzzled.
Compared to the other yellowed ancient books on the bookshelf, this book was very new, as if it had just been printed.
It was no wonder that Connor was puzzled to see such a brand new book on a bookshelf filled with ancient books.
As for Jorge’s words, Connor didn’t believe them at all. He was saying that Connor would be able to deal with the average yellow-ranked fighter?
Connor knew Carlos’s skills very well. He felt that he was still miles away from Carlos, which was not something that could be made up by a set of fist techniques.
“This fist technique is the one that I studied when I first entered the ancient martial arts world. It’s very powerful, but I don’t know how much you can comprehend. If there’s anything you don’t understand, you can ask me directly…” Jorge whispered to Connor.
“Old man, let me rip the bandaid off. If I learn this fist technique but still don’t improve, I won’t give you money!” Connor shouted at Jorge excitedly.
“You should at least try to learn it first…” Jorge replied impatiently.
“Do you have any empty rooms?”
Connor asked Jorge.
“What are you doing?”
Jorge was stunned.
“I’m going to give you so much money, so what’s wrong with me staying over for a bit? And if I encounter something I don’t understand, it’ll be convenient for me to ask you!” Connor said helplessly.
Jorge looked at Connor indifferently, a trace of surprise flashing in his eyes.He didn’t expect Connor to work so hard in order to practice martial arts.
And Connor really wanted to learn something from Jorge. Even if he couldn’t get to the Heaven Rank, at the very least, when he encountered danger, he would have the ability to escape, right?
“The west wing should still be empty. If you don’t mind, you can stay in the west wing…”
Jorge hesitated for a moment before speaking softly to Connor.
“Alright!”
Connor nodded lightly, then turned around and walked towards the west wing.
Upon pushing open the door to the west wing, Connor was instantly dumbfounded.
The environment in the west wing was too scary. Not only was the furniture tattered, but it was also covered in dust.
“This stinky old man cheated so much money from me. Can’t he find a nanny to clean up the room? What use does he have for so much money?”
Connor looked at the dusty room and sighed helplessly. Then, he picked up a mop and cleaned the room briefly.
Fortunately, Connor’s previous room environment was not very good. If it was a normal rich kid, he would probably have slammed the door and left.
After tidying up the room, Connor lay on the bed and took out the fist manual that Jorge gave him. He began to study it.
“Seven-Star Big Dipper Fist?”
When Connor saw the name of the fist technique, he couldn’t help but be stunned for a moment. The expression on his face was a little surprised.
“It sounds quite intimidating. I wonder if it’s powerful…”
Connor sighed lightly and then began to study it.
In the blink of an eye, a week had passed.
During this week, Connor went to school during the day and would come to Jorge’s house to train with Jabba at night.
Although Connor was still unable to touch Jabba, he could feel that his strength and reaction speed had increased by a lot, which was likely due to Jabba.
After the fight with Jabba, Connor would return to his room alone and begin to study the fist technique that Jorge had given him.
Connor’s aptitude was indeed a little poor; after all, he had never come into contact with ancient martial arts before. It was inevitable that it would be difficult for him to suddenly learn these things.
After a whole week, Connor had only learned the first two moves of the fist technique.
This was under Jorge’s guidance, too. If Connor had to study it himself, he probably wouldn’t be able to learn these two moves even if he had practiced for a whole month.
But what made Connor feel despair was that this fist technique had a total of 24 moves! He felt that he might not be able to finish learning it even in ten years..

chapters.title: Chapter 671: The Martial Arts Tournament
chapters.content:
Chapter 671: The Martial Arts Tournament
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation | Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
In the blink of an eye, half a month had passed.
During this half a month, Connor’s life was still considered peaceful.
During the day, he would go to school. At night, he w’ould return to Jorge’s house to learn ancient martial arts and fight with Jabba.
Other than that, there was nothing else.
“Ring, ring!”
Originally admiring Rachel’s black silk legs in the classroom, Connor suddenly heard a familiar ringtone.
Connor subconsciously touched his phone and confirmed that it was his phone that rang.
The students in the classroom naturally heard Connor’s ringtone and turned to look at him.
Connor’s expression was very awkward.
Rachel looked at Connor coldly and said expressionlessly, “Connor, get out!”
Rachel had always been strict about that. She never allowed anyone to play with their phones or sleep in class.
If Rachel found out, she would immediately chase them out.
Connor w’as naturally no exception.
Connor helplessly stood up and glanced at Rachel. He sighed internally.
Although Connor was very unconvinced, he still walked out of the classroom. After leaving the classroom, Connor took out his phone and realized it was Thomas calling, so he answered it directly.
“Mr. McDonald, can you talk now?” Thomas asked with a smile.
“I couldn’t just now, but now’ I can…” Connor replied helplessly, then continued, “Why did you call me?”
“Well, Mr. McDonald… Some time ago, I called back the general manager in charge of our company’s business in Southeast Asia because the person in charge will report to the former chairman every year. Previously, he had always reported to the former chairman. Now’ that the former chairman has passed aw’ay, it’s time for you to meet the people there…” Thomas said slowdy.
After Connor heard Thomas’s explanation, he was stunned.
He knew very well that the person in charge of Southeast Asia that Thomas was talking about should be Charles Ziegler, Sabrina’s father.
“Can’t I just talk to you?” Connor replied softly.
Connor didn’t want to meet Charles, nor did he want Charles to know his true identity.
“Uhm…” Thomas seemed a little helpless. He said in a low voice, “Mr. McDonald, I don’t have a good relationship with the person in charge of Southeast Asia. Back then, we had a little conflict. If you want him to report to me, I don’t think he’ll agree…”
Connor w’as surprised. He recalled the conflict betw’een Thomas and Charles.
“Mr. McDonald, the person in charge of Southeast Asia, Charles Ziegler, is very important. 1 think it’s best for you to meet him…” Thomas said again.
Connor held the phone, hesitated, and said lightly, “Alright then. In that case, I’ll meet him!”
Connor felt that it was not a big deal for him to meet Charles.
After the meeting, he only needed to remind Charles not to tell Sabrina about his identity.
If that w’ere the case, Charles would no longer make things difficult for him.
“So, Mr. McDonald, I’ll get someone to pick you up tomorrow?” Thomas hurriedly asked after Connor agreed.
“There’s no need to go through so much trouble. Just tell me the address, and I’ll go there directly…” Connor thought for a moment and said lightly.
“Mr. McDonald, you might not be able to go there yourself. You have to meet Charles in South Dakota…” Thomas said slowly.
“South Dakota?” Connor was stunned for a moment.
“That’s right, Mr. McDonald. The four cities, Davenport, South Dakota, San Francisco, and San Antonio, will hold an exchange meeting tomorrow. Many big shots w’ill be there, and there will be a martial arts competition. The outcome of this martial arts competition may affect many interests…” Thomas said slowly.
“Are you also going to participate in this martial arts tournament?” Connor was stunned for a moment before asking.
“I don’t have to participate in this martial arts tournament. After all, many companies in these four cities are under my control. Those who participate in the martial arts tournament are usually on missions in the underworld. People like me who do legal business won’t participate in the martial arts tournament. I’m just going to watch the show…” Thomas smiled, replied to Connor, and continued, “Davenport is sending with Kyle and Charles…”
“Why is Charles representing Davenport in this martial arts tournament?” Connor asked helplessly.
“Charles has no dealings with the gangs in the four cities, but he, Kyle, and 1 belong to the same company. Therefore, Kyle represents the interests of our company. The company’s interests will be affected if Kyle loses in the martial arts tournament. Charles has a quite skilled bodyguard, so every time there’s a martial arts tournament, Charles has to go and help…” Thomas explained patiently.
After hearing Thomas’s explanation, Connor came to a realization.
After all, very few people knew that Thomas, Kyle, and Charles were actually from the same company.
To prevent any accidents from happening to Kyle, it w’as normal for Charles to help.
“Mr. McDonald, if you have nothing else to do, I suggest you go over and look. After all, those who can participate in the martial arts tournament are all relatively famous martial artists in the four cities.” Thomas continued.
“All the participants are martial artists?” After Connor heard this, he instantly became interested.
“That’s right. Ordinary people don’t have the qualifications to participate in the martial arts tournament. Moreover, even if they did participate, those ordinary people have no chance of winning…” Thomas hurriedly said.
“All right then, get someone to pick me up tomorrow’ morning!” Connor knew that tomorrow was Saturday, and he had nothing to do.
Moreover, he had been practicing ancient martial arts recently and w’as very interested in martial arts, so he could take this opportunity to look.
“All right!” Thomas smiled and agreed, then hung up the phone..

chapters.title: Chapter 672: Heading To Lion City
chapters.content:
Chapter 672: Heading To Lion City
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation | Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Connor didn’t go to Jorge’s place that night as he was going to the martial arts tournament with Thomas and the others tomorrow.
Instead, he returned to Royal No. 1 and had a good night’s rest.
The next day, at 8 AM.
Connor washed up briefly, put on his clothes, and left the villa.
Connor had just left the villa when he saw Thomas’s white business car.
As many people were attending the martial arts tournament today, Thomas asked the driver to drive the Lincoln limousine.
After Connor got into the car, he found that the interior decoration was very luxurious, like a moving palace.
Thomas and Kyle were in the car. Of course, there was an unfamiliar face in the car. It was a middle-aged man with a scar on his face.
Thomas and Kyle’s bodyguards were sitting in other cars.
The white Lincoln limousine and five Mercedes-Benz G-Class drove straight toward San Diego.
San Diego was not very far from Davenport. It would take about three hours to get there.
Thomas and the others would have taken a helicopter if it were any further.
“Mr. McDonald, this is Cameron Larson. He is a very famous martial artist in Davenport!” Kyle pointed at the middle-aged man beside him and introduced
him to Connor.
“Hello, Mr. McDonald!” Cameron seemed to have known Connor’s identity long ago, so he spoke to Connor very respectfully.
Connor turned and looked at Cameron indifferently and said, “Hello!”
“Mr. McDonald, Mr. Larson has always been the representative of the martial arts world in Davenport. He is also representing Davenport in the martial arts tournament this time…” Kyle said to Connor with a smile.
“Between him and Carlos, who’s stronger?” Connor thought for a moment and asked.
“Of course, Carlos is better. I’m not on the same level as Carlos!” After Cameron heard Connor’s question, he hurriedly replied.
“Since Carlos is better than him, why didn’t Carlos join the martial arts tournament?” Connor seemed puzzled.
“Carlos is not someone I can invite. Carlos is Mr. McDonald’s bodyguard. He will only participate in the martial arts tournament if you ask him to. Without your order, he will not participate in a martial arts tournament of this level…” Kyle quickly replied to Connor.
“Will Carlos be going with us this time?” Connor asked Kyle.
“Mr. McDonald, Carlos didn’t follow you because we are protecting you this
time…” Thomas replied.
“Oh, I see…” Connor nodded lightly and didn’t say anything else.
Seeing that Connor didn’t say anything, they naturally quieted down.
Three hours later, the business car stopped at the entrance of a small town called Lion City.
“Mr. McDonald, we’ve arrived…” Thomas whispered to Connor.
“All right…” Connor nodded and got out of the car.
After getting off the car, Connor simply observed the surrounding environment and found that there were already many tourists in Lion City.
However, the environment in Lion City was very ordinary. It felt like it was a rural area stuck in the 1990s.
“Why is the martial arts tournament held in such a place?” Connor turned and asked Thomas.
“Because the people here are more fierce, and it’s located in a remote area of San Diego, no one cares. If it’s held in Porthampton, people will be supervising it.” Thomas looked at Connor and said with a smile.
“I see!” Connor nodded.
“There aren’t many tourists here usually. Only when the martial arts tournament is held will there be more tourists. The town’s residents can also take advantage of this opportunity to earn more money, so they are very happy to host this martial arts tournament. Many people depend on this martial arts tournament to survive…” Thomas looked at Connor and continued.
Connor and Thomas chatted as they walked into the town.
A moment later, everyone stopped in front of a magnificent hotel.
There were already several men in local clothes waiting at the door.
When they saw Kyle and Thomas, they quickly greeted them with a smile and greeted them respectfully, “Mr. Morgan and Mr. Hayes, you two are finally here…”
“Mr. McDonald, this is Sir Welsh. He is in charge of receiving guests…” Thomas turned and introduced him to Connor.
“What Sir Welsch? I’m just an errand boy. Just call me Mr. Welsch…”
After Sir Welsch heard Thomas’s introduction, he hurriedly corrected, then turned to Thomas and asked, “Mr. Morgan, who is this young man?”
“Mr. McDonald!” Thomas replied indifferently, but he did not explain too much. After all, he did not need to explain to such a person.
Sir Welsh was a very clever person, and he had a very good relationship with Lion City. He usually waited for the martial arts tournament to be held to get some benefits.
The hotel behind him was also prepared to receive big shots like Thomas and Kyle. As long as he could serve these big shots well, he would not be afraid of not earning money.
Holding a martial arts tournament with the guild leader could earn hundreds of millions. This number was still very shocking for the residents of the town.
Sir Welsh had seen all kinds of big shots over the years, so he knew how to read people’s expressions.
He could naturally tell that Connor’s status should be the highest among these people.
Even a CEO like Thomas was in awe of Connor. This was enough to prove how strong Connor’s background was!
Sir Welsh also took the initiative to chat with Connor, but Connor was very cold.
Therefore, Sir Welsh did not dare to get close to Connor anymore. He went back to receiving everyone at the hotel.
As soon as they entered the hotel, five or six beautiful women with great looks and sexy figures immediately greeted them. Accompanied by them was a refreshing fragrance.
Although these beautiful women were not as charming as those in the big city, they carried youthful beauty.
If it were a big shot who was used to ‘enjoying snacks’, he would be unable to walk when he saw these beautiful women.
Sir Welsh knew Connor’s identity and background were not simple, so he arranged for the most beautiful girl to be by Connor’s side and told the girl to take good care of Connor for the next two days.
Although he said she should ‘take care of him’, the girl understood what he meant.
Connor originally wanted to refuse, but Thomas, Kyle, and others persuaded Connor to keep the girl.
After all, he had just arrived and was unfamiliar with the place.
Even if Connor had no other thoughts, he could still use her as a tour guide.
Connor hesitated and felt what Thomas said made sense, so he kept the girl by his side..

chapters.title: Chapter 673: Let Me Serve You
chapters.content:
Chapter 673: Let Me Serve You
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation | Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
After entering the hotel, Connor and the others were brought into the suite prepared by Sir Welsh with five beautiful women.
However, just as Connor was about to enter the suite, he suddenly remembered that he had not met Charles Ziegler yet.
Therefore, he turned around and asked Thomas, “Why haven’t I seen the person in charge of Southeast Asia?”
“Mr. McDonald, Charles is probably not here yet. You can go to your room and rest for a while. I’ll tell you when Charles comes over later!” Thomas hurriedly replied to Connor.
“All right…” Connor nodded, turned around, and walked into the room.
The beautiful woman followed Connor into the room.
After entering the room, Connor turned to look at the woman who followed him. A trace of confusion flashed in his eyes as he asked, “Why did you come in?”
“Mr. McDonald, I am tasked to stay by your side and serve you well, so 1 can’t leave…” The woman replied to Connor in a low voice.
“I don’t need your service now!” Connor felt it was strange to have a woman by his side all the time, so he replied directly.
“Mr. McDonald, I beg you, please don’t chase me away. If you chase me away, I won’t be able to get a single cent. I’m still counting on this money to treat my mother’s illness…”
She hurriedly begged desperately because Connor was about to chase her away. After Connor heard the woman’s words, he could not help but size her up.
This woman was very beautiful. Her skin was fair, her legs were long, and her breasts were full. She looked young and attractive, sexy and not pretentious.
However, she was dressed in a somewhat shabbily. She was only wearing a thin white T-shirt and denim shorts.
Even though she was dressed shabbily, Connor could still see the woman’s well-developed figure, especially her pair of slender and fair legs, which looked especially attractive.
Connor could feel that she would be very beautiful if she dressed up properly. She would not be inferior to the beautiful women he knew.
“What’s your name?” Connor asked the beautiful girl.
“My name is Quinn Langford. Mr. McDonald, you can call me Quinn…” The woman did not dare to be negligent and hurriedly replied.
“Why are you working here? You should still be in school, right?” Connor asked Quinn in confusion.
Hearing Connor’s question, a trace of helplessness flashed in her eyes.
She hurriedly replied, “When 1 was in elementary school, my father died in a car accident. I had been relying on my mother since I was young. Later on, my mother fell ill, and my family had no income, so I dropped out of high school and worked as a waiter in a restaurant in the town. Later, Sir Welsh saw that I was beautiful and asked me to come over to entertain some important guests. As long as I could entertain the guests well, Sir Welsh would give me 100, 000 dollars. If I have this money, 1 can treat my mother’s illness…”
After Quinn said this, she looked up at Connor and continued, “Sir Welsh also told me that I must serve you well…”
Connor looked at Quinn and could not help but frown. He knew very well what Quinn meant.
However, Connor already had many women around him. He didn’t have any other thoughts about Quinn.
If Connor wanted to find a woman, it didn’t matter whether it was Yelena or Chloe; he only needed to make a phone call.
Although Quinn was also beautiful, Connor did not want to hurt this poor girl.
Connor felt that Quinn was just like him back then.
He knew that if he chased Quinn away now, Sir Welsh would send Quinn to someone else’s bed.
“Since we have met, it’s fate. Stay!” Connor whispered to Quinn.
“So… Mr. McDonald, do you need me to do anything? Do you want me to massage your shoulders?” Quinn blushed as she whispered to Connor.
“No. Why do you want to massage my shoulders in broad daylight?” Connor replied helplessly.
“Didn’t you ask me to stay because you wanted me to serve you? I don’t know how to do anything other than massaging shoulders!” Quinn looked at Connor and asked in confusion.
“I don’t have any other intentions for keeping you here. Just stay by my side. I won’t force you to do anything. Don’t worry…” Connor replied helplessly.
Hearing that, gratitude flashed in Quinn’s eyes. She asked Connor softly, “Mr. McDonald, are you serious?”
“Of course…” Connor nodded.
“So, Mr. McDonald, do you need me to do anything now?” Quinn asked Connor.
Hearing Quinn’s words, he couldn’t help but stand up and look outside. Then, he said softly, “We have nothing to do here. Accompany me to the town for a walk…”
“Yes, sir!” Quinn quickly agreed, then turned around and walked out of the room.
When Thomas, Kyle, and the others saw Connor going for a walk around the town, they also planned to follow Connor.
However, Connor felt that it would be too conspicuous if these people followed him.
Moreover, Connor was strolling around. In addition, there were security guards everywhere in the town, so Connor would be safe.
Therefore, he rejected Thomas and the others and left with Quinn alone.
When Sir Welsh saw Connor only brought Quinn, he was naturally very happy. He kept winking at Quinn, hinting very obviously.
Connor ignored Sir Welsh and led Quinn out of the hotel.
This was because the martial arts tournament held in the town was an annual battle between the big shots of various provinces.
Therefore, the martial arts tournament was still very exciting. Naturally, many tourists would come because of its fame.
The town also prepared many performances, including martial arts competitions, to earn more money. However, the martial arts competitions they organized were all battles between ordinary people.
The real competition between martial artists would be held tonight.
Connor left the hotel with Quinn.
However, as Connor left the hotel, he saw a large group of people walking toward him.
When Connor saw the middle-aged man walking in front, he was stunned..

chapters.title: Chapter 674: Meeting Charles Ziegler By Chance
chapters.content:
Chapter 674: Meeting Charles Ziegler By Chance
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation | Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Connor was just about to go out with Quinn when he saw a large group of people walking toward him.
These people looked tall and strong, and their bulging muscles seemed to be about to burst their clothes.
When Connor saw the middle-aged man walking in front, he was shocked.
This middle-aged man was none other than Sabrina’s father, Charles Ziegler!
Earlier, Connor asked Thomas why Charles wasn’t there. He didn’t expect to bump into Charles as soon as he left the hotel.
Charles seemed to have seen Connor as well when Charles saw Connor, a strange look flashed in his eyes.
Then, he walked up to Connor and frowned, asking him, “What are you doing here?”
“Mr. Ziegler, I…” Connor opened his mouth and was about to speak.
However, Charles didn’t seem to want to continue talking with Connor. He didn’t allow Connor to speak and said coldly, “Don’t cause trouble here. Come here and look for me later. I have something to ask you!”
It was obvious that Charles felt that Connor was here to watch the show.
He asked Connor to come to him because he wanted to ask Connor about the jade bracelet.
After Charles said this, he did not give Connor any chance to speak and walked into the hotel.
Connor looked at Charles helplessly and turned to leave.
“Mr. Ziegler, who is that kid?”
After entering the hotel, a middle-aged man beside Charles asked Charles with a smile.
“He’s just a friend of my daughter’s. Get your men to help me keep an eye on him. If he encounters any trouble, remember to help him…”
Although Charles treated Connor coldly, he was still very concerned about Connor.
Lion City had more tourists than usual, and there were often fights. He was worried that Connor would encounter some trouble.
“Got it…” The middle-aged man hurriedly nodded.
This middle-aged man was called Silas Suarez. He was a well-known gangster in Lion City. He usually colluded with Sir Welsh, but Silas had influence in Lion City.
Charles was not in a good mood because he had noticed Quinn beside Connor.
Connor’s relationship with Madison was unclear. In addition, his daughter seemed to have feelings for Connor. Now, Connor was walking with another girl out of nowhere in Lion City. Connor’s relationship with the opposite sex was indeed a little complicated.
Therefore, Charles’s impression of Connor naturally worsened.
“Charles, come over here!”
At this moment, Kyle and Thomas walked out of the room toward Charles.
Although Thomas and Charles didn’t have a good relationship, Kyle and Charles had been good friends for many years.
Otherwise, Charles wouldn’t have brought his men here to help Kyle force his way into the tournament.
“Kyle, it’s been a while!” Charles walked up to Kyle and hugged him.
“When the martial arts competition ends, we must have a drink…” Kyle also replied happily. Then, he whispered to Charles, “Go and say hello to Mr. Morgan!”
Charles heard Kyle’s words and couldn’t help but turn to look at Thomas, who was next to him. He then whispered, “Mr. Morgan, it’s been a while!”
“You still can’t let go of what happened back then?” Thomas asked Charles with a smile.
“The master has already changed. As servants, what else can we not let go of? I have long let go of what happened back then…”
Although Charles no longer hated Thomas, his tone was stiff when he said this.
“The former chairman did it for our own good back then!” Thomas patted Charles’s shoulder and said softly.
“I understand…” Charles nodded gently, then looked at Thomas and asked, “Where is Mr. McDonald? I’ll go meet Mr. McDonald. I haven’t seen the heir of the former chairman yet!”
“You came at a bad time. Mr. McDonald just left but will probably return soon!” Thomas replied with a smile.
“Then, I’ll wait…” Charles said calmly.
“There’s still some time before the start of the martial arts tournament. Why don’t we go for a drink?” Kyle was happy to see that Charles and Thomas had reconciled.
For so many years, he had been stuck between them. He had always been in a difficult position. Now, he could finally take a breather.
“I’ll get the kitchen to prepare the food now!” After Sir Welsh heard Kyle’s words, he quickly said and then turned around to order the staff in the hotel to prepare the banquet.
***
Meanwhile, Connor and Quinn were strolling around the town.
There were many tourists in Lion City, and most of them were couples or friends.
After all, the martial arts tournament was exciting and could attract many rich people to spend money.
Quinn hesitated before turning to look at Connor. She whispered to Connor, “Mr. McDonald, do you know those people just now?”
“I do…” Connor nodded lightly.
“What are they up to? They looked very scary…” Quinn asked curiously.
“They are just some big shots…” Connor replied indifferently.
“The big shots who can participate in the martial arts tournament are not good people. My friends told me only the mafia bosses would participate in the martial arts tournament. Moreover, these are all demons who eat people without mercy. The police can’t control them. Last time, I had a friend whose legs were broken because he looked at one of them too hard. He’s still at the hospital now…” Quinn looked at Connor carefully.
Connor turned to look at Quinn. After all, Quinn was just a poor child from a small town.
In the eyes of those big shots, these people were like ants.
Even if their legs were broken, they had no place to seek justice, so what Quinn said was very common.
“Mr. McDonald, I think you’re a good person…” Quinn saw that Connor didn’t say anything and continued to speak to him.
“How am I a good person?” Connor looked at Quinn and smiled faintly.
“I just think that you’re a good person. I heard from my friends that those big shots like to touch us and don’t treat us as humans at all, but you don’t!” Quinn hurriedly replied.

chapters.title: Chapter 675: An Old Acquaintance
chapters.content:
Chapter 675: An Old Acquaintance
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation | Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
After spending some time with Quinn, Connor realized that Quinn was a very simple girl.
The things in her mind were much simpler than those girls in the big city.
If it wasn’t for the fact that there were too many women around Connor, he might be interested in an innocent girl like Quinn.
But now, Connor no longer wanted to pursue other girls.
Just these few women by his side were enough to give Connor a headache.
Freya was currently overseas and had not contacted Connor.
However, if Freya returned to the country and Connor, Chloe, and she were to discover Yelena, he would not know how to explain these things to her.
“What’s going on up in front? Why is it so lively?” Connor saw that there seemed to be a large group of people gathered up ahead and asked Quinn curiously.
“Mr. McDonald, there’s an arena competition. The town has specially organized an arena competition during the day to earn money. The participants are all ordinary people, and their prize money is only to, ooo to 20, 000 dollars. The real martial arts competition will only take place at night. The martial arts competition is the most exciting. It’s all attended by experts. Basically, several people are killed every year…” Quinn quickly replied softly.
“I see!” Connor looked at Quinn and nodded.
“Yes. Moreover, there will be casualties even in the arena during the day. However, there is no other way. These people can only choose to risk their lives to earn money…” Quinn looked at Connor and sighed softly.
When Connor saw that Quinn’s expression seemed a little off, he couldn’t help but ask, “What’s wrong?”
“Nah… It’s nothing…” Quinn was stunned for a moment before she quickly shook her head.
Actually, Quinn was still a little sad because she hoped that she could be like normal people, study in school, go to university, and then find a good job after graduation.
Unfortunately, the heavens had no mercy on her.
Not only did her father pass away early, but her mother was also hospitalized.
All she could think of now was to raise money for her mother’s medical expenses. As long as she could cure her mother, she would be satisfied.
After Quinn calmed herself down, she continued to bring Connor around the town.
A few minutes later, Quinn brought Connor to a square.
At this moment, the square was already crowded with tourists, and an arena was in the middle of the square.
At this moment, two people were fighting to the death on the stage. One of them was burly and looked extremely strong. Moreover, his combat skills were quite exquisite. Although the person fighting with him was not weak, he was not his opponent.
The people below the arena were excited and kept shouting.
It was very lively.
Connor subconsciously glanced at the two people on the stage, a trace of disdain flashing in his eyes.
In fact, if Connor had seen the fight between these two people before, he would have felt very excited.
But at this moment, Connor looked at the two people on the stage and found their movements very slow. Connor felt that they were playing house.
Moreover, the strength of the punch was also very weak. It was nothing to Connor.
‘Why are these two people fighting like primary school students? He’s not even as stupid as Jabba…’ Connor could not help but sigh internally. Then, he turned around and was prepared to leave with Quinn.
“Connor?” However, a surprised voice sounded from afar as Connor was about to leave.
Connor subconsciously turned and saw a beautiful girl wearing sunglasses running toward him.
As the girl was wearing sunglasses, Connor did not recognize who she was.
A moment later, the girl walked quickly to Connor and smiled at him. “Connor, it is you!”
“Melissa?” Connor was stunned when he heard the girl’s voice and asked puzzledly.
“Yes, it’s me!” The girl shouted happily and took off her sunglasses, revealing a delicate and pretty face.
The girl was none other than Melissa Sachs, the president of the university’s zither club.
Previously, Connor and Melissa had a good relationship. Melissa was a kind girl who had always helped Connor.
However, ever since Melissa crashed into Connor’s sports car at the entrance of the Empire World Building last time…
Melissa had thought Connor had stolen the car, so her impression of Connor changed.
Initially, Melissa had planned to call the police to deal with Connor’s car theft.
However, Melissa did not call the police because she was worried that Connor might be unable to afford the compensation if the car was stolen.
Therefore, in the end, Melissa let Connor fend for himself.
Melissa didn’t expect that the police would not arrest Connor and that she would run into him here.
“Melissa, why are you here?” Connor asked.
“I came here with my friend. I heard that there will be a martial arts competition here tonight…” Melissa replied with a smile, then turned to look at Quinn, who was beside Connor. She was a little confused and asked, “Connor, is this your girlfriend?”
Melissa saw that although Quinn was dressed ordinarily, her skin was fair, and her bright eyes were very beautiful. She couldn’t help but feel pity for her.
Connor turned to look at Quinn and shook his head. “She’s not my girlfriend…”
Hearing that, she couldn’t help but lower her head shyly.
Seeing Quinn behaving like this, Melissa smiled subconsciously and gave Connor a knowing look.
“By the way, Connor, what did you do with that car?” Melissa suddenly recalled the sports car she had crashed into and couldn’t help but ask Connor softly. “The car?” Connor was stumped for a moment.
“Yeah, that Ferrari. Did you steal it?” Melissa asked Connor straightforwardly.
Hearing that, Connor finally understood what she meant by the car.
A hint of helplessness flashed in his eyes, and then he said indifferently, “Melissa, actually, that car belongs to my friend. That day, I happened to go and help my friend get his car, but I realized that you had scratched my friend’s car. I worried you would feel burdened, so I deliberately let you go first. I also explained it to you then, but you never believed me…”

chapters.title: Chapter 676: Underground Boxing Arena
chapters.content:
Chapter 676: Underground Boxing Arena
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation | Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Hearing Connor’s words, Melissa nodded thoughtfully.
It had been a while since the incident happened, and Melissa saw that Connor was fine.
So, she believed Connor when he said that the car belonged to his friend.
Connor didn’t want to waste time telling Melissa that the car was his.
After all, Melissa would never believe that Connor could afford such an expensive sports car, so he lied to her.
“Your friend didn’t make things difficult for you, right?”
Melissa asked Connor softly.
“I have a good relationship with my friend. Also, his family is very rich. The cost of repairing the car is nothing to him, so he naturally won’t hold it against me…”
Connor said indifferently.
“That’s good…”
When Melissa heard Connor’s words, she was obviously much more relaxed.
However, at this moment, Melissa’s friends who came with her also walked to her side.
Connor looked at these people briefly. There were three guys and two girls in total. They were all dressed very fashionably. They were obviously rich.
When the three guys saw Quinn, they were all stunned. After all, a natural beauty like Quinn was rare.
“Melissa, who are these two?”
At this moment, a guy asked Melissa with a smile.
The guy was about the same age as Connor. He was also very tall. He wore a Tissot watch and held a bunch of BMW keys. He was obviously the richest among these people.
Furthermore, Connor could feel that this guy liked Melissa, and the way he looked at Melissa was very different.
“This is my junior, Connor McDonald. This is my friend!”
Melissa turned around and explained.
“I see. Since we are all classmates, let’s go play together…”
The guy replied with a smile, but his eyes were fixed on Quinn.
It was obvious that this guy didn’t want to play with Connor, but with Quinn.
Quinn was here to serve Connor, so she naturally had to listen to Connor.
Connor wanted to reject Melissa’s invitation, but she insisted on bringing him along.
Because Melissa had misunderstood Connor before, she felt bad. In addition, she knew that he was poor, so she wanted to bring him along to have some fun.
Connor couldn’t persuade Melissa, so he had no choice but to agree.
Everyone walked directly toward the square. It was obvious that they were planning to watch the competition in the square.
After a while, Connor found out that the boy who wanted to pursue Melissa was called Jesse Wan. He was from San Diego. His family was in business and had a family property of tens of millions. He met Melissa through a friend.
Seeing that Melissa had a good figure and looked very sweet, so he naturally had the idea of pursuing her.
Among the three guys, there was a tall and fierce-looking boy called Barry Fox. He was a Taekwondo master and was probably very good at fighting.
Jesse was the one who arranged for these people to come to Lion City. Firstly, it was to get close to Melissa. Secondly, he wanted to curry favor with Barry.
However, Jesse had never expected that after inviting so many beauties, they would all say that they couldn’t make it. Only one of them came. Although she looked good, her figure was not good enough. Barry would definitely not like her.
But just as Jesse was thinking about how to find a beautiful partner for Barry, Quinn appeared.
Quinn’s figure and appearance were both very good. Even Jesse was a little tempted when he saw Quinn. That was why he took the initiative to ask Connor and Quinn to stay.
Seeing that Connor did not look like a rich person, he did not take Connor seriously at all.
“Barry, you’re the Taekwondo champion of San Diego. If you go up now, you can probably kill those people in an instant, right?”
Jesse suddenly asked Barry.
When Barry heard this, his face was filled with disdain. He said lightly, “They are my opponents. If I go up, I can take them all down in less than half a minute…”
Connor couldn’t help but look at Barry after hearing his words. Barry was very muscular, and his hands were covered with calluses. He was obviously a martial artist.
“Then, Barry, do you want to go up and give us an eye-opener?”
At this moment, another girl said with a smile.
“The people in this ring are all ordinary people. As a Taekwondo champion, if I go up there, wouldn’t I be bullying them? Moreover, the prize money for this arena competition is too low. It’s only 100,000 dollars. The prize money for any competition I participate in is ten times more than that…”
Barry said arrogantly.
“Ten times?”
When Quinn heard Barry’s words, a strange look flashed across her eyes.
Ten times of 100,000 was a million, and a million was a huge sum for a poor child like Quinn.
“You are the Taekwondo champion of San Diego. Of course, these people are nothing to you. But, Barry, we have nothing to do now. Why don’t you go up and give it a try?”
Jesse grinned and asked.
Barry turned to look at Jesse and said softly, “Since all of you are so curious, I will sign up and give it a try…”
“Alright!”
Jesse shouted happily and dragged Barry to the registration counter.
He had to admit that Barry was quite capable.
In less than five minutes, Barry defeated seven or eight people easily and received the 100,000 dollars.
When Quinn saw Barry getting money so quickly, her eyes flashed with envy.
