After all, if she could be as powerful as Barry, she wouldn’t have to worry about her mother’s medical expenses.
After Barry received the prize money, he returned to the group.
“Barry, you’re really amazing. Those people are not your match at all!”
Jesse grinned and said.
“These people are all weaklings. It’s boring. Is there anything more exciting?” Barry shouted arrogantly.
Quinn couldn’t help but whisper, “There’s an underground boxing arena ahead. The boxers there should be stronger…”

chapters.title: Chapter 677: Do You Think You’re Rich?
chapters.content:
Chapter 677: Do You Think You’re Rich?
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation | Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
“Underground boxing arena?
When everyone heard Quinn’s words, they could not help but be stunned.
“That’s right. Lion City has a very famous underground boxing arena, but you have to pay to enter. Also, the ticket is quite expensive, so few people know about it…”
Quinn was from Lion City, so she was very familiar with the situation there.
“That’s great. It’s boring to fight with these weaklings. Let’s go to the underground boxing arena…”
Jesse shouted happily.
“But the entrance ticket to the underground boxing arena costs 20,000 dollars each, and a good spot costs 50,000 dollars…”
Quinn reminded him carefully.
“What’s 20,000 dollars? Isn’t everyone out to have fun? I’ll pay for the tickets. You guys can go with me!”
Jesse replied casually and then led everyone toward the underground boxing arena.
Seeing Jesse being so generous, Quinn suddenly felt a little embarrassed.
After all, if all these people were to go there, the tickets alone would cost more than 100,000 dollars, and they were the cheapest tickets. If they were to go to a slightly better seat, it would cost hundreds of thousands!
In order to help her mother earn 100,000 dollars for her medical expenses, Quinn was willing to sell her body.
However, to someone like Jesse, 100,000 dollars was nothing.
When Connor saw that these people wanted to take him to the underground boxing arena, he was somewhat helpless.
After all, he was still about to go back and see Charles Ziegler, so he said indifferently, “Well, you guys can go ahead. I won’t be joining…”
“Connor, come with us. I heard that Lion City is very dangerous. What if you run into trouble? If you follow us, and with Barry protecting us, no one will dare to provoke you…”
Melissa saw that Connor was about to leave and quickly called out.
“If Mr. McDonald doesn’t want to go, I won’t go either…”
Quinn hurriedly said.
Seeing that Quinn was planning to leave with Connor, Jesse’s expression instantly turned ugly.
After all, if Connor wanted to leave, Jesse would not say anything.
Jesse didn’t like Connor to begin with, but if Quinn followed him, it would be a little troublesome.
How could Jesse let Quinn leave so easily?
So, he quickly said, “Connor, this place is indeed very dangerous. You should come with us!”
“That’s right, Connor. I haven’t thanked you for what happened last time. Besides, Jesse is treating us, so you don’t have to worry about money.”
The naive Melissa thought that Connor was worried about the tickets, so she quickly persuaded him.
Connor looked at Melissa helplessly and finally agreed.
Under Quinn’s lead, everyone arrived at the entrance of the underground arena.
At this moment, there were two thugs standing at the entrance of the underground boxing arena.
These two thugs were tall and strong, and their faces were extremely fierce, giving off a ferocious feeling.
After arriving at the entrance, Jesse did not waste any time and spent 300,000 dollars to buy six tickets that were closer to the front.
When Jesse was paying, he subconsciously turned to look at Quinn beside him.
When he saw the surprise in Quinn’s eyes, he was very smug.
Because he knew that girls like Quinn were the easiest to get into bed with. As long as they had money, everything would work.
After buying the tickets, everyone went straight to the underground boxing arena.
Connor observed the surrounding situation and saw that the underground boxing arena was quite big.
It could accommodate nearly 500 people, and it was already full. It meant that the boxing competition here was indeed very popular.
When Connor and the others arrived, the boxing match had yet to begin. There were a few beautiful women in sexy clothes stripteasing on the stage.
When Melissa saw the stripers on the stage, a strange look flashed across her eyes. Then, she pouted and said, “What is this place?”
“It’s just a performance…”
Jesse replied with a smile.
After that, everyone began to look for their seats and sat down.
Although the performance of the stripers on the stage was very attractive, few people were watching.
They were all discussing who would win.
One had to know that everyone who spent money to come to the underground boxing arena was here to get rich overnight.
Before each boxing match, there would be beautiful women in bunny costumes passing by the customers.
These bunny girls were holding a point-of-sale machine in their hands. They were responsible for registering and filling in the bets.
If you fancied a player, you could directly place a bet with the bunny girl.
Then, the bunny girl would give you a registration slip. After you won, you could directly take the registration slip to exchange for the prize money.
In a small place like this, at most tens of millions of dollars would flow out in one night.
However, if it was a large-scale underground boxing arena, it could easily earn more than a billion dollars in one night.
At this moment, a sexy beauty in a white bunny costume walked to Jesse’s side with a smile and asked Jesse softly, “Handsome, do you want to bet?”
Because Jesse was the one who had bought the tickets, the bunny girls knew that Jesse was rich. Naturally, they had to treat such a customer with special treatment.
Jesse stared at the bunny girl for a moment before turning to Barry and asking, “Barry, do you want to bet?”
“Sure…”
Barry agreed readily. He took out the 100,000 dollars he had just won and bet it on a boxer.
Jesse saw Barry placing his bet and placed a hundred thousand as well.
Melissa was not very interested in this kind of thing, so she did not place a bet.
The others weren’t as good as Barry and Jesse, but they still bid a few thousand.
And these players were the same players that Barry had bet on.
When Quinn saw how extravagant these people were, a strange look flashed across her eyes. No one knew what she was thinking.
“Connor, aren’t you going to bet?”
Jesse saw that Connor had been sitting there without saying anything. His expression was a little playful as he asked Connor with a smile.
“Nope…”
Connor shook his head without thinking.
After all, this amount of money was nothing to him. Connor would never waste money on such things.
If he really had the money, Connor felt that he might as well give it to Quinn.
One had to know that too ,000 dollars was enough to get Quinn out of her current predicament. It was far more meaningful than wasting it here!
“Connor, if you don’t have money, I can lend you some. You can return it to me when you win…”
Jesse said to Connor with a seemingly kind heart.
When Connor heard Jesse’s words, he couldn’t help but turn to look at Jesse, then said expressionlessly, “Do you think you’re rich?”

chapters.title: Chapter 678: A Tempting Condition
chapters.content:
Chapter 678: A Tempting Condition
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation | Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
When Jesse heard Connor’s words, his face turned dark.
After all, he was kind enough to lend money to Connor, but Connor was acting all high and mighty.
“I don’t know if I’m rich, but I’m definitely richer than you!”
Jesse hesitated for a moment before coldly replying to Connor.
Jesse was clearly angry.
Connor turned and glanced at Jesse indifferently, not saying anything.
When Jesse saw that Connor was quiet, he naturally did not continue to pay attention to Connor.
Instead, he turned to Quinn and said, “Hey beautiful, how about this? I’ll lend you 50,000 dollars. If you win, you can return it to me. If you lose, you don’t need to return the money. What do you think?”
It was obvious that Jesse’s offer to Quinn was very tempting.
After all, if Quinn lost, she wouldn’t have to bear any responsibility.
Quinn was obviously tempted, but seeing that Connor didn’t seem to want to talk to Jesse, she shook her head and whispered to Jesse, “No, thanks…”
When Jesse heard Quinn’s answer, he frowned, but he did not say anything else. A few minutes later, the competition was finally about to start.
Two men who were at least 1.9 meters tall walked onto the stage.
One of them was a professional kickboxing expert, and the other was an ordinary person, but he looked very strong.
Barry placed his bet on the ordinary person, but most of the audience chose to bet on the kickboxing expert.
After all, in the eyes of the ordinary audience, a kickboxing expert who had undergone professional training would definitely be more powerful than an ordinary person who had come from an unorthodox background.
The battle between the two of them was very exciting.
The kickboxing expert obviously had the upper hand. The audience below the stage would occasionally burst into screams.
Although Jesse had always acted like he was spending money like dirt, he was still a little nervous when he saw that the ordinary person was about to lose.
On one hand, Jesse was worried about his 100,000 dollars.
On the other hand, Jesse was worried that if Barry made the wrong bet, he would lose face.
“Barry, that person won’t lose, right?”
Jesse hesitated for a moment before asking Barry softly.
“No…”
Barry shook his head without thinking. He was calm and confident.
Jesse saw the confidence on Barry’s face and didn’t say anything else.
After a few minutes, the ordinary person who was originally at a disadvantage actually began to counterattack, and with just three punches, he directly took down the professional kickboxer.
When Jesse saw that he had won, he could not help but shout. He was very excited.
The others were also very happy. After all, they had all won.
Then, the second match began.
Everyone started to place their bets. This time, they chose to follow Barry.
One boxer after another came on stage, and the match became more and more exciting. Many of the spectators became excited.
The audience who won were naturally very happy, and those who lost were also anxious and red in the eyes. They were just short of betting their entire fortune. “Barry, you’re amazing! We won again!”
Jesse shouted excitedly.
“My luck is pretty good today,”
Barry was obviously more low-key than Jesse and the others. He replied indifferently with a hint of pride in his eyes.
No matter what, Barry was a professional Taekwondo athlete.
He could still see some of the tricks in it. Although he couldn’t guess correctly every time, the chances of winning were still very high.
Out of the five matches, Barry guessed four correctly.
Jesse and Melissa’s friends had won a lot of money because of Barry, and the way they looked at him had changed.
Even Quinn was a little tempted because she knew that the money these people had won was enough to treat her mother’s illness several times and send her to school.
Quinn came from a poor family, so it was normal for her to be tempted by this. When Jesse saw that the fire had been lighted, he turned to look at Connor and Quinn. Then, he asked with a smile, “Connor, Quinn, do you two want to bet?” “No…”
Connor shook his head without thinking. After all, this money was nothing to him.
Seeing Connor reject him, he smiled and looked at Quinn. He said softly,
Quinn, you saw it for yourself just now. Barry is so good at this. The few of us are making so much money right now. If you don’t have any money now, I can lend it to you. Wien you win, you can return the money to me. If you lose, I don’t need you to return it…”
When Quinn heard Jesse’s tempting conditions, she couldn’t help but hesitate for a moment before turning to look at Connor.
“If you want to bet, then bet. Don’t look at me!”
Connor said expressionlessly.
Quinn hesitated for a moment, then whispered to Jesse, “Alright then, lend me 2,000 dollars please…”
“2,000 dollars? I’ll just lend you 10,000 dollars…”
Jesse replied heroically and then placed a bet ofio ,ooo dollars on Quinn’s behalf.
When Quinn saw Jesse place his bet, she became nervous.
After all, if he lost, it would be troublesome.
Jesse and Barry looked at each other. They were both very excited. It was
obvious that they had finally achieved their goal.
Connor watched everything expressionlessly. He knew what Jesse and Barry wanted to do.
However, Connor felt that he hadn’t known Quinn for a long time, and some things were out of his control.
Connor had planned to ask Thomas Morgan to find a job for Quinn after the competition ended. Then, he would find a better hospital to treat her mother’s illness. After all, it was fate that they met.
However, if Quinn wanted to use her own efforts to raise her mother’s medical expenses, that was her own business. Connor couldn’t care less.
As expected, Quinn, Jesse, and the others won 10,000 dollars in the next round.
Quinn looked very happy as she thanked Jesse and Barry.
“Connor, are you sure you don’t want to play with us?”
After Jesse won the money, he asked Connor with a smug expression.

chapters.title: Chapter 679: The Martial Arts Tournament Begins
chapters.content:
Chapter 679: The Martial Arts Tournament Begins
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
“No…”
When Connor heard Jesse’s words, he rejected again.
A hint of confusion flashed across Jesse’s eyes, and he felt somewhat incredulous.
Jesse really couldn’t understand why Connor was still unwilling to bet when he had already set such conditions.
If it were anyone else, they would have already been unable to hold back and rushed to place their bets.
After all, who wouldn’t want a good thing that fell from the sky?
Thus, Jesse felt that there were only two possibilities for Connor not placing a bet.
The first was that Connor did not have any money on hand, but he was unwilling to borrow money from Jesse.
There was another possibility, which was that Connor did not care about this small amount of money at all.
“Connor, if you want to play, I can lend you money…”
Melissa hesitated for a moment and whispered to Connor.
Quinn turned to look at Melissa and said loudly, “Mr. McDonald is a rich big shot. It’s not because he doesn’t have money that he doesn’t want to play, it’s because he doesn’t care about this small amount of money at all!”
“Rich big shot?”
When everyone heard Quinn’s words, they could not help but be stunned for a moment. They frowned in disdain.
“This is the first time I’ve seen such a big shot…”
Jesse couldn’t help but mock softly, completely disregarding Quinn’s words.
Jesse felt that Connor couldn’t even afford a 20,000 dollars ticket. How could he be considered a rich big shot?
If Connor was really rich and Quinn was his girlfriend, why did Quinn borrow money from him instead of Connor?
However, Jesse saw that Quinn was very serious, so he did not continue to say anything.
For the next few matches, Quinn followed Jesse and the others in placing bets.
Barry’s accuracy was very high. He only lost once in six consecutive matches.
In less than two hours, Quinn had won nearly 50,000 dollars.
If it wasn’t for the fact that the boxing match had ended, Quinn would probably be able to earn money for her mother’s medical expenses in an afternoon.
But even so, Quinn was already very happy.
That was because the 50,000 dollars was equivalent to her annual salary, so she was very happy.
After leaving the underground boxing ring, they went straight to the town center of Lion City, where the martial arts tournament would be held tonight.
This was because those who could participate in the martial arts tournament were all big shots from various places.
Therefore, the real martial arts tournament was held at night, not during the day.
Also, if ordinary people wanted to enter and watch tonight’s martial arts tournament, they would naturally need to buy tickets.
The price of the ticket was extremely expensive for ordinary people, but it was nothing for Jesse, who had just won money.
Connor could go in directly. He only needed to call Thomas Morgan.
However, Jesse, Melissa, and the others insisted on buying tickets for Connor and Quinn. Connor had no choice but to follow them in.
After entering the town center, the first thing that came into view was a huge square.
The center of the square caved in, forming a narrow fighting arena.
Gamblers could sit on top of the arena and clearly see the life and death battle.
The fighting arena at the bottom of the square was surrounded by stone walls that were three meters tall. The stone walls were embossed with various huge animals. The entire fighting arena was like a huge shaft, making people feel like they were in the Colosseum of ancient Rome.
There were tables and chairs on the stairs around the fighting arena.
It was obvious that these were prepared for those big shots who came from afar, and the customers who paid to enter could only sit and watch from afar.
Connor followed Jesse, Melissa, and the others to their seats and sat down quietly, waiting for the start of the main event.
After waiting for about half an hour, a group of burly men in security uniforms walked in.
These muscular men were all tall and strong, and their faces were extremely fierce. Their bulging muscles were about to tear through their clothes.
On their waists, there were also weapons such as electric batons, which were obviously used to prevent accidents from happening.
After seeing these burly men come out, the entire fighting arena instantly fell silent.
“The big shots are about to appear…”
Jesse turned to look at Melissa and whispered to her.
When Melissa heard Jesse’s words, she became expectant.
The others around him also became excited.
Today was the day when all the big shots from all over the world gathered here.
Their goal was to divide their respective territories through the martial arts tournament.
Therefore, if anyone dared to cause trouble here, it was basically no different from courting death.
The audience members were discussing in low voices as they looked at the location of the fighting arena in anticipation.
A few minutes later, a group of people walked into the square.
“It’s here, it’s finally here…”
When everyone saw the people coming in from the front door of the fighting arena, they all got excited.
A large group of bosses walked into the front row of the fighting arena, chatting and laughing.
“That’s Jonathan Steele from San Diego…”
“That’s Yakov Chakin from San Francisco…”
“Oh my God, Jaxon Jacket from San Antonio is here too!”
“So many big shots are actually here?”
“Yeah, I didn’t expect to see so many big shots in the same day. This is really unbelievable…”
“It’s not easy for so many big shots to gather together!”
When everyone saw these big shots, they began to whisper among themselves, they were very excited.
At this moment, these people were a little envious, while some had fierce looks on their faces.
After all, these so-called big shots had done a lot of bad things over the years.
And those who were harmed by them could only be angry but did not dare to say anything.
After all, any one of these big shots could cover the sky with one hand. If anyone dared to offend them, it was basically no different from courting death.
“Why is there a woman there?”
At this moment, a beautiful woman in a white dress appeared in everyone’s sight.
When everyone present saw the beauty in the dress, they all revealed puzzled expressions because no one knew who this woman was!
“By the way, why hasn’t the big shot from Davenport appeared yet?”
At this moment, everyone realized that the big shots from San Diego, San Antonio and San Francisco were already gathered here. Only the big shots from Davenport had yet to appear.
However, the audience might not know that the two big shots of Davenport were frantically calling Connor.
After all, Connor was here as Thomas Morgan’s boss. He was the most important person in Davenport.
If Connor didn’t appear, Thomas wouldn’t dare to go on stage either!
“Have you contacted Mr. McDonald?”
Kyle Hayes asked Thomas anxiously.
“I called him just now, but no one picked up…”
Thomas replied helplessly.
“Same here…”
Kyle sighed helplessly, then looked at Thomas and asked, “What should we do now? We can’t keep everyone waiting here!”
Charles Ziegler hesitated for a moment after hearing Kyle’s words. Then, he said lightly, “Maybe we can head on in. Mr. McDonald might appear later!”

chapters.title: Chapter 680: Beauty in a Dress
chapters.content:
Chapter 680: Beauty in a Dress
Translator. EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
The martial arts tournament was about to begin, but Thomas, Kyle, and the others had yet to reach Connor.
This wasn’t Davenport. Thomas and the others couldn’t make the final decision.
If this continued on, then sooner or later it would cause public anger.
Although Thomas wasn’t afraid of these people, he didn’t want them to gossip about him.
So, in the end, Thomas could only helplessly follow Charles into the venue.
“The people from Davenport are here!”
Seeing Thomas and the others, the audience instantly became restless.
“Oh my God, why is Thomas Morgan here this time?”
“Yeah, why is Thomas Morgan here?”
When everyone saw Thomas walking in front, they were all dumbfounded.
Their mouths were wide open, and they were extremely shocked.
As the leader of Davenport, Thomas’s reputation was far from what the big shots in other places could compare to.
Whether it was his connections or his financial prowess, Thomas had completely crushed these people.
Thomas was not on the same level as these people at all.
In the past, only Kyle and Charles had attended the tournament. Thomas had never appeared.
But this time, Thomas actually came too. How could everyone not be surprised?
Even the big shots from other place could not help but suck in a breath of cold
air.
They didn’t understand why Thomas would appear here. If Thomas came to help Kyle in the martial arts tournament, things would be a little troublesome.
San Diego, Davenport, San Francisco and San Antonio were next to each other, so they had a certain level of connection.
At this moment, the big shots who appeared here were all gangsters, just like
Kyle.
However, there was still a gap between them and Thomas because they were all doing shady businesses. Naturally, they could not compare to Thomas in terms of connections.
Thomas was usually in charge of managing the business of the Empire World Corporation, so he would not participate in the matters of the dark side of the business world. Kyle was in charge of everything.
Thomas was very famous in Oprana. He might not be the number one person in Oprana, but he could be ranked in the top three.
If Thomas were to participate in this martial arts tournament, it would be obvious that he was bullying them.
It could be said that no matter how powerful these big shots were, they did not have the guts to offend Thomas.
However, they had the guts to offend Kyle because they didn’t know the relationship between Thomas and Kyle.
Thomas didn’t care about the surprised looks. He brought Kyle and Charles to their seats and sat down.
“Mr. Morgan, why did you come personally this time?”
Thomas had just sat down when a middle-aged man asked him with a smile.
“Don’t worry, I’m not here to participate in the martial arts tournament. I’m here to accompany my boss to watch the show.”
Thomas explained calmly.
“Your boss?”
When the other big shots heard Thomas’s words, they were all stunned.
In fact, they all knew that Thomas had a boss behind him, and it was said that this boss had a very terrifying background.
However, although these people knew, they had never seen Thomas’s boss. Therefore, when these people heard that Thomas’s boss would also be coming, they seemed to be even more shocked.
Thomas alone was enough for them to lookup to, let alone Thomas’s boss. Jonathan Steele, a big shot in San Diego, turned look at Thomas. Then, he smiled and asked Thomas, “Mr. Morgan, may I know where your boss is now?” “Mr. McDonald hasn’t arrived yet. He will probably arrive later…”
Thomas replied indifferently.
“I see. Since he’s your boss, Mr. Morgan, you must introduce me to him later!”
Jonathan said humbly.
Only Thomas and the boss behind him could make Jonathan speak so humbly.
“Haha, sure!”
Thomas agreed readily.
The other big shots also took the initiative to talk to Thomas. Their goal was very simple. They wanted to get to know the boss behind Thomas.
“Mr. Morgan, are you really not here for the martial arts tournament this time?”
At this moment, Yakov Chakin, the big boss of San Antonio, asked Thomas nervously.
Yakov said this very tactfully. In fact, he just wanted to ask if Thomas was here today to help Kyle.
If he came to help Kyle, it would be troublesome.
Yakov had some conflicts with Kyle recently, and he planned to resolve them at the martial arts tournament.
“You have your own way of dealing with the matters of the underworld. I will not interfere in the matters between you!”
Thomas replied expressionlessly.
“That’s good…”
When Yakov heard Thomas’s words, he finally heaved a sigh of relief.
After all, Thomas had already said it. If he still helped Kyle, it would be a little unreasonable.
From this point, it could be seen that Thomas was actually quite a principled person.
He alone could change the businesses of the four provinces, but Thomas did not do so.
Yakov couldn’t help but turn to look at the beauty in the dress beside him. This beauty was also the only woman among so many men present.
Although the beauty’s appearance was not stunning, it could be considered top-notch. Moreover, her temperament was very cold. She was wearing a white dress, giving people the feeling that she was a lady from ancient times.
“Is there no one left in the Tucker Family of San Antonio? They actually let a woman like you come…”
Yakov said to the beauty in the dress with a disdainful expression.
When the bodyguard behind the beauty heard Yakov’s words, he suddenly became angry, and he could not help but take a step forward.
However, the beauty reached out to stop the bodyguard and said calmly, “My grandfather has been ill recently, so he can’t come. I’m here on behalf of my grandfather…”
“I see!”
Yakov nodded with a smile. He didn’t say much, but there was a trace of disdain in his eyes.
At this moment, a staff member walked up to Thomas and whispered to him, “Mr. Morgan, since you’re not here to participate in the martial arts tournament, why don’t we let you be the referee of this martial arts tournament?”
“That’s a good idea! With Mr. Morgan as the referee, no one will be dissatisfied!”
Yakov hurriedly shouted.
The other big shots present also echoed.
When Thomas saw this scene, he could only nod helplessly and agree.

chapters.title: Chapter 681: Not My Match
chapters.content:
Chapter 681: Not My Match
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation | Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
At this moment, those big shots were all clamoring to let Thomas be the referee of this martial arts tournament.
Actually, they had their own selfish motives for doing so.
After all, Thomas and Kyle were from Davenport.
Thomas had promised them that he would not interfere with the martial arts tournament.
However, these big shots were still worried that if Thomas changed his mind at the last minute, it would be troublesome.
Among the big shots in the four provinces, Kyle was the strongest.
His existence affected the interests of many people.
Normally, these people wouldn’t have the courage to fight Kyle head-on because they weren’t as strong as him.
However, today’s martial arts tournament was their best opportunity.
As long as they could defeat Kyle in today’s martial arts tournament, they could make a request of him.
Moreover, the loser could not go back on his word after the match. He had to do as the winner asked.
Today was the last chance for the underworld bosses from other provinces to take revenge on Kyle. If they failed because of Thomas, they would have to wait until this time next year.
However, if they waited for another year, they would lose another year’s worth of money. Therefore, these big shots had already thought it through. They could not let Thomas participate in the martial arts tournament no matter what.
The best way to prevent Thomas from participating in the martial arts tournament was to let him be the referee.
Thomas naturally knew what these people were thinking. In the end, he could only helplessly agree and then walk onto the stage.
When the big shots of the four provinces saw Thomas walk onto the stage, they instantly burst into a round of applause. They were also very excited.
“Today is our annual martial arts tournament. All of you have gathered here for only one purpose, and that is to resolve the conflicts that have occurred on a daily basis through martial arts tournaments. Therefore, no matter what conflicts there are today, we will decide according to the outcome of the martial arts tournament. As for the rules of the martial arts tournament, I believe that all of you should be clearer than me, so I won’t waste any more time with you…”
Thomas paused for a moment and then continued, “Since everyone has given me face and allowed me to be the referee of this martial arts tournament, I will make my stance clear. Whatever happens today, we will settle it in the arena.
“After the arena competition ends, if anyone causes a dispute or reneges on their promise, that would be disrespecting people from my side. At that time, don’t blame me, a businessman, for participating in the matters of the underworld!”
Although Thomas’s tone was very gentle, it gave people a chilling feeling.
Everyone was silent, and no one dared to say another word.
“Alright, that’s all from me. The martial arts tournament begins now!”
Seeing that everyone was silent, Thomas then called out expressionlessly, then turned around and returned to his seat.
San Francisco was adjacent to Davenport, so Yakov Chakin from San Francisco often had conflicts with Kyle from Davenport.
However, because Yakov’s strength had never been as strong as Kyle, he could only watch helplessly as his territory was slowly being eaten up by Kyle.
Yakov had been enduring for so long because he was waiting for the martial arts tournament.
He wanted to use this opportunity to resolve the conflict between him and Kyle.
“Mr. Hayes, why don’t we let the experts from our two families take the lead first?”
Yakov asked Kyle with a smile after hesitating for a moment.
After hearing Yakov’s suggestion, Kyle smiled faintly.
He seemed to have already guessed that Yakov would take the initiative to challenge him, so he nodded and agreed.
When Yakov saw that Kyle had agreed, he turned to look at the dark-skinned, slightly thin man behind him.
The man didn’t waste any time and nodded at Yakov. Then, he walked straight to the ring and looked at Kyle provocatively.
Kyle sat on the chair with a very calm expression on his face, as if he didn’t care about this man at all.
“Mr. Larson, is there a problem?”
Kyle turned to look at Cameron Larson beside him and asked softly.
When Cameron heard this, he glanced at the man on the stage and said softly, “Mr. Hayes, this person is probably an expert in Muay Thai. His physical fitness is terrifying, but I don’t think he’s a match for me…”
“That’s good!”
Kyle was relieved when he heard Cameron’s words.
For so many years, Cameron had always represented Kyle in the martial arts tournament.
Although he was not invincible, he had won nine out of ten battles. Therefore, Kyle trusted Cameron very much.
Cameron leaped up and landed on the stage.
The first row of spectators was nearly two meters away from the arena.
Cameron was able to jump onto the stage with a casual jump. This was enough to prove how amazing Cameron’s martial arts were.
When everyone saw Cameron go up on stage, they instantly erupted into cheers.
After all, Cameron was an Oprana boxer, and the person Yakov invited was a Muay Thai expert, so the audience would definitely support the Oprana boxer.
“It has begun. It is finally about to begin…”
When Jesse Wan saw Cameron go up on stage, he shouted excitedly.
Connor narrowed his eyes and looked at Cameron and the Thai man.
But for some reason, Connor felt that the auras of these two people didn’t seem to be very strong.
When Jorge Yarrell was teaching Connor fist techniques, he mentioned that the easiest way to judge a person’s combat strength was to observe their aura.
Connor had also learned some methods of observing chi, but Connor felt that Cameron’s chi was not very strong.
‘Am I wrong?’
Connor thought to himself.
However, at this moment, Cameron cupped his fists at the Thai man and said with a smile, “Please!”
When the Thai man heard Cameron’s words, he did not hesitate at all and charged straight toward Cameron.
The Thai man was extremely fast. In less than two seconds, he had arrived in front of Cameron. Then, he raised his right hand and smashed it toward Cameron’s face.
“He’s so fast!”
“Yeah, this person is very fast!”
When everyone saw the man attack, their eyes widened in disbelief.
This was because such speed was already very heaven-defying in the eyes of an ordinary person.
Even Barry Fox, who was standing beside Connor, was shocked. He couldn’t help but whisper, “As expected of an expert who can participate in the martial arts tournament. He’s really powerful…”
“His speed is too slow…”
However, just as Barry said so, Connor whispered.

chapters.title: Chapter 682: A Battle Between Experts
chapters.content:
Chapter 682: A Battle Between Experts
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation | Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
This was because Connor had been fighting with Jabba recently.
Jabba’s speed was obviously more than ten times faster than this man.
Therefore, seeing the speed of this man’s attack, he clearly felt that he was much slower than Jabba.
The instant the Thai man made his move, Cameron had at least two seconds to react.
That was why Connor could not help but sigh. However, Connor had instinctively muttered those words out loud.
When Jesse, Melissa Sachs, and the others heard Connor’s words, they all turned to look at Connor. They frowned in disbelief.
“You’re saying that he is slow?”
Jesse frowned and asked Connor.
“I think he’s very fast. How is he slow?”
Melissa hurriedly added.
Barry’s eyes flashed with anger. After all, he literally just said that the man was very fast.
However, immediately after, Connor said that this man’s speed was slow. This was obviously a slap to his face!
If the man was really slow, Barry wouldn’t have said anything. But the man was really fast. Everyone could see it.
“Connor, are you blind? How is this considered slow? Why don’t you show us a faster speed?”
Jesse could tell that Barry was unhappy, so he mocked Connor.
“Some people just like to pretend that they know things they actually don’t know. He is obviously very fast, but they insist on saying that he is very slow. From the perspective of professional boxers.”
Barry said to Connor expressionlessly.
“That’s right. If you don’t understand what’s going on, keep it to yourself. Else the security guard will hear you and chase you out.”
A girl pouted and shouted at Connor with an impatient expression.
“Alright, stop talking and focus on the game!”
Seeing that so many people were mocking Connor, he must feel very embarrassed, so she hurriedly berated them.
After hearing Melissa’s words, everyone ignored Connor and continued to watch the match.
Cameron had been fighting with the Thai man for some time now.
However, the two of them did not use their full strength. They were both probing each other, wanting to see what the other party’s strength was.
But at this moment, the Thai man suddenly raised his fist and smashed it at Cameron’s head.
The Thai man’s punch was very powerful and fast. The sound of his whizzing fist could even be heard.
When the audience below the stage saw this scene, their eyes widened, and they could not help but break out in a cold sweat for Cameron.
Everyone could feel that if this punch landed on an ordinary person’s body, it would probably be smashed into pieces!
“He really does have some skills…”
When Cameron saw the Thai man’s punch, a hint of surprise flashed in his eyes. He quickly took two steps back and used his hands to block the attack.
Bang!
There was a loud bang.
The Thai man’s fist smashed into Cameron’s palm.
However, what no one expected was that after the punch landed on Cameron’s hand, Cameron actually stood still on the spot, while the Thai man took two steps back.
It could be seen from this punch that the Thai man was no match for Cameron.
After seeing the Thai man retreat, Cameron did not hesitate at all and immediately launched a fierce attack.
One punch after another was thrown at the Thai man!
Cameron’s attack speed and strength were much stronger than the Thai man. Even the ordinary people could see that the Thai man was at a disadvantage.
With just a single move, the fight reached a point of no return. This was a battle between experts.
The Thai man felt that Cameron’s fists were like iron hammers. Every punch hit his flesh.
Cameron’s strength was beyond the imagination of ordinary people. In less than half a minute, the Thai man felt his entire body go numb.
When Yakov saw this scene, his expression turned ugly. He could not help but sigh in his heart. ‘I can’t believe that after so many years, Cameron’s strength is still so terrifying…’
In the martial arts tournament these past few years, the experts Yakov had gathered from all over the world had all been defeated by Cameron. It was probably the same result this time around.
The Thai man’s face darkened. He could only hold on bitterly, hoping that Cameron would show some weakness and then counterattack.
As for the audience below the stage, their eyes were wide open, and they were extremely excited.
After all, one was a Thailand player, and the other was an Oprana player. At this moment, the audience was still supporting Cameron.
When Barry saw this, his eyes flashed with envy.
He could not help but sigh softly, “If only I could be as powerful as Mr. Larson…”
Although Barry was a professional boxer, he could tell that both Cameron and the Thai man were far stronger than him. He was no match for them.
If he were to put himself on the stage now, he might not even be able to last half a minute.
Therefore, Barry was very depressed.
However, Connor was very calm. In Connor’s eyes, these two people were not considered true experts. Compared to Jabba, be it speed or strength, there was a huge gap between them.
Previously, the only expert Connor had come into contact with was Carlos Lane. However, Connor realized that Jabba, that silly chimpanzee, was even more powerful than Carlos.
“I wonder if I can defeat these two now.”
Connor looked at Cameron and the Thai man on the stage and could not help but sigh softly to himself.
Bang!
At this moment, a loud sound suddenly came from the ring.
The Thai man, who had been struggling, was sent flying by Cameron’s punch.
The Thai man took five or six steps back and spat out a mouthful of blood.
When the audience saw this scene, they all cheered because they knew that the battle was over.

chapters.title: Chapter 683: A Loss of 100 Million
chapters.content:
Chapter 683: A Loss of 100 Million
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Thump, thump, thump…
After the Thai man was hit by Cameron’s fatal blow, he retreated a few steps before finally stopping.
He clutched his chest tightly and stared at Cameron with wide eyes.
At this moment, the Thai man could clearly feel the sharp pain coming from his chest.
He could not help but lower his head to take a look and realized that Cameron’s punch had actually made a dent in his chest.
When everyone saw the dent on the Thai man’s chest, they could not help but suck in a breath of cold air. They were extremely shocked.
They knew that Cameron’s punch had broken the Thai man’s ribs.
How much strength did he have to be able to break a person’s ribs with one punch?
“Do you still want to continue?”
Cameron was still very gentlemanly. He knew that the Thai man no longer had
the ability to continue fighting.
Therefore, he did not continue to attack and asked the Thai man expressionlessly.
After hearing Cameron’s words, the Thai man couldn’t help but hesitate for a couple of seconds. Then, he gritted his teeth and said in a low voice, “Mr. Larson is indeed powerful. I admit defeat!”
“Thank you!”
Cameron smiled and cupped his fists at the Thai man before turning around
and returning to Kyle’s side.
Kyle turned and looked at Yakov. At this time, Yakov looked livid.
“Mr. Chakin the Second, looks like you have lost again…”
Kyle whispered to Yakov.
“I know. If you have any requests, feel free to state them…”
Yakov gritted his teeth and whispered back to Kyle.
“Your nightclub in Hayward City of San Francisco will belong to me in the future. What say you?”
Kyle asked Yakov with a smile.
When Yakov heard Kyle’s words, his face darkened.
The nightclub in Hayward was very lucrative.
He could earn at least 30 to 40 million dollars a year. If he gave it to Kyle for free, it would be killing Yakov.
However, Yakov also knew the rules of the martial arts tournament. Moreover, Thomas was the referee this time. Even if he had ten thousand guts, he would not dare to disagree. Therefore, he could only grit his teeth and nod.
“You’re a really agreeable person, Mr. Chakin the Second!”
Kyle smiled faintly.
Yakov hesitated for a moment, then waved at his bodyguard.
The bodyguard quickly handed over the check that he had prepared in advance. Yakov took the check and wrote his name, then handed it to Kyle.
Kyle didn’t even look at it and had his secretary take the check.
This check was worth five million dollars, which was the remuneration for each competition.
The loser not only had to agree to a condition of the winner, but he also had to give the winner five million dollars as a reward.
The five million was nothing to Yakov, but it was the nightclub that really made his heart ache. Losing this nightclub would make Yakov lose a lot of money every year, and this loss was permanent.
Yakov had planned to take back a few places he had lost from Kyle through this martial arts tournament.
However, he did not expect that not only was he not able to get back the places he had lost previously, but he also lost another place. This was really a double loss!
Yakov turned to look at the bodyguard beside him, then gritted his teeth and asked in a low voice, “Where is Mr. Wheeler? Why isn’t he here yet?”
For today’s martial arts tournament, Yakov not only found a Thailand boxer, but also a martial artist.
Therefore, Yakov placed all his hopes on that martial artist.
“I haven’t been able to contact Mr. Wheeler. He was sleeping with two women in the hotel last night. I’m not sure if he’s awake now…”
The bodyguard replied helplessly.
“I’ve already lost to such a f*cking extent, yet he still has the mood to play with women. What the hell is he doing…”
Yakov gritted his teeth and shouted.
“Mr. Chakin the Second, don’tworry. Although Mr. Wheeler likes to play with women, he’s still very reliable. He promised us he’ll be here, so he will definitely be here!”
The bodyguard hesitated for a moment and said softly.
“I sure hope so…”
Yakov sighed helplessly. At this time, he was placing all his hopes on Mr. Wheeler.
Yakov had already lost the first match, so the rest of the big shots knew that Yakov’s man was already seriously injured.
At this moment, Yakov was now an easy target in the eyes of everyone.
Everyone began to challenge Yakov.
If Yakov did not accept the challenge, it would be too embarrassing. After all, so many people were watching.
Therefore, Yakov could only grit his teeth and agree, and then choose to have
his bodyguards take the challenge.
Even the Thai man was no match for Cameron, so Yakov’s bodyguards were definitely no match for them. Therefore, in the blink of an eye, Yakov lost five matches.
Yakov’s territory was also constantly being taken by others. In addition to the five million dollars lost in each round, in less than half an hour, Yakov had lost nearly 100 million dollars!
“Just you wait. When Mr. Wheeler comes, I will definitely win all these territories back…”
Yakov gritted his teeth and snorted.
After everyone had challenged Yakov at least once, they did not continue to challenge Yakov.
After all, everyone knew the principle of leaving a line open so that they could see each other again in the future.
The big shots who had conflicts with Kyle before also began to think about challenging him again.
After all, Kyle was the most powerful among these big shots. If they could defeat him once, they could get back a piece of land and turn the tables.
At this time, Yakov was already at the end of his rope. The businesses and territories in his hands were worthless. No one wanted to waste time on him.
“Grandpa Lexington, should we challenge Kyle?”
At this moment, the beautiful woman in the dress turned her head and asked the old man beside her.
“If we were to challenge Kyle, I’m confident that I can defeat Cameron. However, I’m worried that if we defeat Cameron, the expert who is with Charles Ziegler will retaliate. Cameron is not scary, but the man with Charles is a true martial artist. I’m worried that we’re not a match for him, so Miss, let’s not take this risk!”
The old man said calmly.
After hearing the old man’s words, the beauty in the dress nodded gently and did not say anything else.
Seeing that no one dared to stand up and challenge him after so long, Kyle took the initiative to challenge the other big shots.

chapters.title: Chapter 684: Do You Dare to Take a Bet?
chapters.content:
Chapter 684: Do You Dare to Take a Bet?
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation | Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
It is undeniable that Cameron’s strength was very terrifying.
In less than half an hour, Cameron had won five matches.
Kyle also got the territory he wanted from those big shots.
The biggest winner of this tournament was Kyle, and the biggest loser was Yakov.
After Kyle had gotten the territories he wanted, he stopped and did not let Cameron continue to compete.
After all, even a rabbit would bite when it was anxious.
Facing the big shots of the four provinces, it was better to leave them a way out.
At this moment, Kyle only needed to quietly wait for the martial arts tournament to end.
Yakov was absolutely fuming at this point. He frowned and asked the bodyguard beside him, “When will Mr. Wheeler be here? If he still doesn’t come, then I’ll lose miserably today…”
“I just called Mr. Wheeler, and he said that he’ll be here soon!”
The bodyguard hurriedly replied.
“Is what you said true?”
When Yakov heard the bodyguard’s words, he suddenly became excited.
He suddenly stood up and asked the bodyguard loudly, “Then when will he be here?”
“He should be here soon!”
The bodyguard was so scared that he hurriedly replied.
“That’s great. If Mr. Wheeler can be here, I can get back all the territories I’ve lost!”
A hint of excitement flashed across Yakov’s eyes.
At this time, a middle-aged man walked into the square with two sexy beauties in revealing clothes in his arms.
When Yakov saw the middle-aged man, he immediately became excited. He quickly ran to the middle-aged man’s face and shouted, “Mr. Wheeler, you’re finally here! I’m waiting for you to help me redeem myself…”
“The two seductresses you got for me are really something. Last night, the three of us had a good time until way past two in the morning, so we woke up a little late…”
The middle-aged man replied with a smile.
“Mr. Wheeler, you’re the one who gave us a good time…”
One of the beauties replied sweetly.
“Hahaha…”
The middle-aged man snickered and pinched the beauty’s waist.
When Yakov heard the middle-aged man’s words, his face darkened. Then, he asked the middle-aged man softly, “Then Mr. Wheeler, will it affect your performance tonight?”
“No, I can deal with these nobodies with one hand!”
Mr. Wheeler replied arrogantly. Then, he jumped onto the ring and looked down at the people below with his hands behind his back. He was very calm.
The Mr. Wheeler that Yakov found was called Benjamin Wheeler. He was one of the top ten martial artists in San Francisco and was said to be very skilled.
Yakov had done a great deal to invite Benjamin here. In the end, he only managed to invite Benjamin over at a cost of 50 million.
At this moment, Yakov was very excited.
Because he knew that as long as Benjamin was here, he would definitely be able to win back all the territories that he had just lost.
“I want to challenge Mr. Kyle Hayes…”
Yakov shouted at the top of his lungs.
At this moment, Yakov was obviously much more confident.
When Kyle heard Yakov’s words, he turned to look at Cameron and asked softly, “Mr. Larson, will it be okay?”
“This Benjamin Wheeler guy isn’t easy to deal with. I heard that he’s one of the top ten martial artists in San Francisco. As for whether I can beat him, I’ll have to go up and give it a try!”
Cameron replied calmly.
“Alright, just do your best. If you can’t win, admit defeat. Don’t get injured!”
Kyle knew that he still had Charles Ziegler’s help, so even if Cameron lost, it wouldn’t affect him too much.
“Got it!”
Cameron lightly nodded, then walked up to the arena.
Connor sat in the audience, looking expressionlessly at Benjamin on the stage.
Connor could feel that Benjamin’s aura was very strong, which meant that Benjamin’s combat strength was rather high.
“Barry, who do you think will win?”
At this moment, Jesse Wan turned his head and looked at Barry Fox.
“Is there a need to ask? Benjamin Wheeler is definitely not a match for Cameron Larson. I saw Cameron Larson’s attack clearly just now. No one can defeat him…”
Barry replied confidently.
When Connor heard Barry’s words, he couldn’t help but turn and look at Barry.
Barry seemed to have noticed Connor’s gaze, so he asked Connor softly, “What is it? Do you have a different opinion?”
“What opinions can he have? He doesn’t understand these things at all…” Jesse said with a disdainful expression.
When the others heard Jesse’s words, they also revealed disdainful smiles.
When Connor saw the smiles on their faces, he said indifferently, “Cameron isn’t Benjamin’s match!”
” What do you mean? Barry just said that Cameron will win, yet you’re saying that Cameron is no match for Benjamin. You’re deliberately singing the opposite tune, aren’t you?”
Jesse shouted at Connor with his eyes wide open.
Connor turned and looked at Jesse indifferently, then said softly, “He’s the one who asked me. I’m just telling it as it is. There’s no need for you to be so agitated…”
“Wiry you!”
Jesse was flabbergasted and didn’t know what to say.
He took a deep breath and shouted, “Alright, Connor, since you think that Benjamin Wheeler will win and we all think that Cameron Larson will win, then let’s make a bet. Do you dare to make this bet?”
What bet?”
Connor asked Jesse softly.
“If Cameron Larson wins, it’ll be your loss and you’ll have to give me 100,000 dollars. If Benjamin Wheeler wins, it’ll be my loss and I’ll give you 100,000 dollars. What say you?”
Jesse asked Connor with a smile.
Actually, Jesse said this to humiliate Connor.
Jesse felt that Connor did not have that much money and did not have the guts to gamble with him.
“Jesse, what are you doing?”
Melissa Sachs frowned and shouted at Jesse.
Because Melissa knew that Jesse was deliberately making things difficult for Connor.
“Melissa, I’m just playing with him. It’s fine…”
Jesse replied with a smile. Then, he asked Connor provocatively, “Are you scared?”
Connor looked at Jesse with a faint smile and said softly, “What’s there to be afraid of? Since you’re so rich, isn’t 100,000 a little too low a bet?”
“You think 100,000 is too low? How much do you want to bet?”
Jesse was stunned for a moment and asked Connor with a puzzled expression.
Connor slowly extended five fingers.
“Five hundred thousand?”
Jesse frowned and asked.
“Five million!”
Connor said calmly.

chapters.title: Chapter 685: We Admit Defeat!
chapters.content:
Chapter 685: We Admit Defeat!
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation | Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Five million?
When everyone heard Connor’s words, they were all stunned.
They didn’t think that Connor would suggest such an exorbitant amount just for this bet.
Although Jesse and the others were rich, they were not that rich.
Even the richest of all, who was Jesse, would find it difficult to take out five million at one go.
“Connor, what nonsense are you spouting?”
Melissa asked Connor in confusion.
“I’m not spouting nonsense. If we want to bet, we should go big. What’s the point of betting only 100,000 dollars…”
Connor whispered to Melissa.
Seeing that Connor didn’t seem to be joking, a trace of helplessness flashed across her eyes. She didn’t know what to say.
“Connor, are you crazy? You actually want to bet five million with me? Do you even have that much money?”
Jesse shouted at Connor with his eyes wide open.
“Since I said that I want to bet five million with you, then I definitely have that much to bet on!”
Connor replied indifferently.
“Why should I believe you?”
Jesse asked Connor.
“It’s up to you whether you believe it or not. Do you dare to bet with me?” Connor asked Jesse expressionlessly.
After hesitating for a moment, Jesse asked Connor softly, “Then what if you lose and don’t have that kind of money?”
“I’ll do whatever you want to me to do…”
Connor looked at Jesse and said.
Jesse felt that Connor did not seem to be joking with him at this moment, so he gritted his teeth and said in a low voice, “Alright, since you want to bet five million with me, I’ll gamble with you today!”
After all, the idea of betting with Connor was proposed by Jesse himself.
Jesse knew in his heart that Connor could not take out so much money, but he still chose to agree.
Jesse trusted Barry a great deal. He believed that Barry’s judgment would not be wrong!
Connor glanced at Jesse indifferently, then shifted his gaze to the arena.
When Benjamin saw Cameron walk onto the stage, he asked Cameron softly, “You are my opponent?”
“That’s right, I’m your opponent!”
Cameron lightly nodded.
“Let’s begin!”
Benjamin said calmly.
When Cameron heard Benjamin’s words, a trace of anger flashed in his eyes.
Because Cameron could feel that Benjamin was looking down on him.
No matter what, Cameron was considered one of the top experts in Davenport. He had never been looked down upon like this before.
Therefore, Cameron let out a furious roar and charged toward Benjamin.
Cameron raised his fist and punched toward Benjamin’s head. The power of Cameron’s punch was extremely shocking.
The audience present could feel that Cameron had used all his strength in this punch.
The Thai man who had fought with Cameron before had a strange look in his eyes when he saw this scene.
He could not help but sigh to himself. “If Cameron had used his full strength from the beginning, I might not have lasted even half a minute!”
But what they didn’t expect was that Benjamin, who was standing on the stage, had no intention of dodging at all.
“This Benjamin really isn’t afraid of death. Facing such a fierce punch, he’s actually choosing not to dodge. Is he planning to take this punch?”
When Kyle saw that Benjamin had no intention of dodging, a trace of shock flashed across his eyes. He was in disbelief.
After all, if it were an ordinary person, they would definitely try their best to dodge such a fierce punch.
However, Benjamin stood there without moving. This meant that Benjamin did not take Cameron’s punch seriously at all.
However, just as Cameron’s fist was about to hit Benjamin’s face, Benjamin suddenly raised his right hand and punched toward Cameron’s chest.
Benjamin’s punch was silent, but its speed and strength were shockingly fast.
Bang!
There was a loud bang.
Before Cameron’s fist could land on Benjamin’s face, Benjamin’s fist had already landed on Cameron’s chest.
After receiving Benjamin’s punch, Cameron was like a kite with a broken string. He was sent flying, and he crashed onto the stage.
A hint of disdain flashed across Benjamin’s eyes, but he had no intention of stopping. He continued to charge toward Cameron.
“We admit defeat!”
Kyle saw that something was wrong and stood up without hesitating.
Bang!
However, it was too late. Benjamin raised his right leg and kicked Cameron’s body.
Cameron was kicked off the stage by Benjamin.
Benjamin glanced indifferently at Cameron below the stage, then said expressionlessly, “With this measly ability of yours, even if there were ten more of you, you wouldn’t be a match for me!”
“Why you…”
When Cameron heard Benjamin’s words, he spat out a mouthful of blood and fainted.
When Kyle saw this scene, a trace of anger flashed in his eyes. He turned to Yakov and asked, “Yakov, what is this guy doing?”
“Mr. Hayes, I’m really sorry. Mr. Wheeler probably didn’t hear what you said just now. If he had heard it, he definitely wouldn’t have made a move!”
Yakov happily replied.
“He did it on purpose!”
Kyle shouted at the top of his lungs.
“If you think that he did it on purpose, Mr. Morgan can be the judge of that!”
Yakov chuckled.
Kyle turned and looked at Thomas with a helpless expression.
He knew in his heart that Cameron had already lost. Even if he wanted to argue about it, it would be meaningless.
Moreover, if he did this, it would make things difficult for Thomas.
Therefore, after hesitating for a moment, Kyle ran toward Cameron.
Everyone present was in shock. Cameron’s strength was already considered top-notch among these contestants.
But even he was defeated by Benjamin with one punch. This was indeed unbelievable.
Of course, the most shocked person was Jesse!
Jesse was absolutely furious because he didn’t expect Benjamin to actually defeat Cameron!

chapters.title: Chapter 686: A Blind Cat Encountering a Dead Mouse
chapters.content:
Chapter 686: A Blind Cat Encountering a Dead Mouse
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation | Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
After all, Jesse had made a bet with Connor. If Cameron lost, Jesse would have to give Connor five million.
Initially, Jesse had thought that Benjamin would not be able to defeat Cameron. However, he never expected Benjamin’s strength to be so terrifying.
Jesse stared at Barry and asked, “Barry, what’s going on?”
Barry looked a little embarrassed and said softly, “I might have misjudged just now…”
“Misjudged?”
After Jesse heard Barry’s words, his face broke down.
It was now that Barry was wrong. Jesse had lost five million!
At this moment, the way everyone looked at Connor had also changed. They suddenly realized that Connor wasn’t joking when he said that Benjamin could win, nor was he casually saying it.
It was because Connor could really see through some tricks. Otherwise, he wouldn’t have asked Jesse to bet five million.
“Mr. McDonald, how did you know that person would win?” Quinn looked at Connor in surprise.
Melissa was also curious and asked Connor softly, “That’s right. Connor, how did you tell?”
“It’s just a gut feeling!”
Connor faintly explained.
The way to observe Chi was very mysterious. When Connor first heard Jorge’s explanation, his first reaction was disbelief; he felt that Jorge was talking nonsense.
Moreover, Connor was not particularly familiar with the Chi Observation Technique. He had only encountered some tricks to the art, so if someone were to ask him to explain these things to others now, he would not be able to explain it clearly.
” What do you mean by gut feeling? I think you’re just like a blind cat that ran into a dead mouse!” Jesse shouted indignantly.
“No matter what, you lost just now…” Quinn’s face was red as she shouted at Jesse excitedly.
Quinn had always disliked Jesse and the others mocking Connor. Now that she saw Connor win five million from Jesse, she was very happy.
” I know I lost! “Jesse gritted his teeth and replied in a low voice.
After losing five million in one go, Jesse was not even in the mood to pick up girls anymore.
“Connor, give me your bank account number. I, Jesse Wan, am not someone who can’t afford to lose. It’s just five million dollars. It’s nothing to me…”
Jesse was a person who cared a lot about his reputation. Even though he was reluctant to part with the money, he still called out to Connor in a low voice.
Connor naturally did not hesitate and directly told Jesse his bank account number.
Connor must be in a good mood to have gotten five million dollars so easily.
Of course, this was the happiest thing that had happened to Connor thus far; what made him the happiest was that the Chi Observing Technique that Jorge had taught him was indeed very effective.
Connor could now completely judge a person’s strength through their aura.
This would also be convenient for Connor to dodge attacks in time when he encountered danger in the future.
After Yakov saw Benjamin win, he was in a good mood. He immediately took back the nightclub that he had lost to Kyle Hayes.
Meanwhile, Benjamin stood on the stage with a blank expression and shouted arrogantly, “Is there anyone else who wants to challenge me?”
The big shots below the stage were all expressionless at this moment. No one dared to speak.
After all, in their eyes, Cameron was already a very terrifying existence.
But now, Benjamin, who was even more powerful than Cameron, had turned up. Even if they had the courage of multiple lions, they would not dare to go up! Wouldn’t they be courting death if they went up at this time?
“What’s wrong? Were they all scared? If no one dares to come up, then I’ll directly choose someone!”
Benjamin shouted arrogantly.
Charles hesitated for a moment before turning to look at the old man behind him.
This old man was called Keith Sanders. He had been by Charles’s side for many years and was very skilled.
Charles had brought Keith over just to help Kyle Hayes.
Charles would only get Keith to take action if he encountered any special circumstances. Otherwise, Cameron would definitely be enough to handle most things.
But now, he had encountered that special situation: Kyle Hayes’s men had already lost, so Charles’s men had to help them.
Charles turned to look at the old man behind him and asked softly, “Uncle Sanders, are you confident?”
“The chances of winning aren’t high, but I’m willing to give it a try!”
Keith replied expressionlessly. Then, without any hesitation, he walked towards the arena with his hands behind his back.
At this moment, Keith, who was beside Charles, was almost 70 years old. However, he did not give off the feeling of a 70-year-old man and was instead very energetic.
When the audience saw Keith go on stage, they began to scream. Some even began to shout Keith’s name.
Many people knew Keith and knew that he was a very powerful expert. It was said that he had won 18 consecutive battles in the martial arts tournament. This was also the highest winning streak in this martial arts tournament.
However, when Cameron appeared, Keith did not make a move again.
As a result, now that Keith had appeared, everyone was naturally very excited.
However, Charles’s eyes were filled with worry. After all, Benjamin’s strength was indeed terrifying.
But for the sake of Davenport’s reputation and for the sake of keeping the Empire World Corporation’s interests from being harmed, Charles could only let Keith take action.
After Keith went on stage, he cupped his fists at Benjamin and said indifferently, “Hello, Master Wan!”
“I didn’t expect it to be Old Senior Sanders. I think it’s better for you not to mess around at your age. On the account that you’re also my elder, I won’t fight with you.”
Benjamin said to Keith with a smile.
“Although I’m a little old, I can still move around…”
Keith said calmly.
“Since old senior Sanders is so persistent, don’t blame me for being impolite…”
After Benjamin said this, he rushed towards Keith.
At this moment, Keith was not fighting for his reputation, but for Davenport and Charles.
When he saw Benjamin attack, his expression became much more serious.
Keith’s skills were much better than Cameron’s, and he quickly fought with Benjamin. The battle between the two of them instantly entered a white-hot stage.
The audience started to scream. Keith’s popularity was obviously much higher than Benjamin’s.

chapters.title: Chapter 687: Cornered
chapters.content:
Chapter 687: Cornered
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation | Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Even so, Keith, who was almost seventy years old, was still not Benjamin’s match.
In less than two minutes, Keith was sent flying by Benjamin’s punch.
After Keith regained his balance, a trace of shock flashed across his eyes.
He knew in his heart that he was indeed no match for Benjamin. Benjamin’s punch just now wasn’t even using his full strength, and he was already somewhat unable to withstand it.
If Benjamin used his full strength, he might die on the spot.
“Senior Sanders, you are not my match, and I don’t want you to die here. Why don’t you just admit defeat?”
Benjamin said to Keith expressionlessly.
Keith stood in front of Benjamin and could not help but hesitate for two seconds. Then, he said in a low voice, “I am indeed not your match, but now is not the time for me to admit defeat!”
When Charles heard Keith’s words, he could not help but sigh softly. Then, he said calmly, “Uncle Sanders, there’s no need to continue fighting. Let’s admit defeat!”
When Keith heard Charles’s words, he subconsciously turned his head to look at Charles. A hint of helplessness flashed across his eyes.
“Master Wheeler is really amazing!”
Yakov shouted excitedly after hearing Charles’s words.
Everyone looked at Yakov’s position, and their expressions were extremely incredulous.
This was because everyone had thought that Yakov would be the biggest loser in this martial arts tournament. However, no one had expected such a shocking reversal in the end. Yakov had actually managed to find an expert like Benjamin.
Since even Keith Sanders was not a match for Benjamin, the others were definitely unable to face him too.
For a moment, the entire square fell into a dead silence.
Kyle had always been the shadowy leader of the four provinces. Among so many people, Thomas Morgan was the only one who equaled him in power.
However, if Yakov continued to win like this, then the position of the top spot in the four provinces was likely to be changed, and this was what shocked everyone the most.
“President Hayes, sorry for winning again. This time, I want your territory in Rockford. Do you have any objections?” Yakov asked Kyle with a smile.
When Kyle heard Yakov’s words, he couldn’t help but look up at Yakov and said expressionlessly, “Since I’ve lost, the territory of Rockford is now yours!”
“You’re really straightforward, President Hayes!” Yakov couldn’t help but laugh when he heard Kyle’s words. Then, he continued, “I plan to challenge you again in the next round…”
“You..!”
Kyle’s face turned furious when he heard Yakov’s words. He’d never thought that Yakov would be so outrageous.
Yakov clearly knew that he had no one left to use, but he still wanted to continue challenging him.
This was clearly an act meant to exterminate his authority!
Yakov’s thoughts were very simple: Benjamin could be said to be invincible now, and no one else had the courage to go up on stage to challenge Benjamin, so Yakov himself had to pick someone.
As for the territories in the hands of other big shots, Yakov did not care at all.
Only the territories in Kyle’s hands were rich. Therefore, Yakov’s plan was to take advantage of this martial arts tournament to get some money from Kyle.
After the martial arts tournament ended, it would not be easy for him to attack Kyle’s territories.
There was less than half an hour left until the end of the martial arts tournament, and this time was enough for Yakov to get what he wanted from Kyle.
Kyle naturally knew what Yakov was thinking, but if he really let Yakov continue to challenge him like this, then he would become a lamb waiting to be slaughtered. He would have to give whatever Yakov asked him for.
“Yakov, I advise you not to go too far. You clearly know that I don’t have anyone I can use, yet you still want to challenge me?”
Kyle lowered his voice as if he wanted to threaten Yakov.
However, Yakov did not care about what Kyle said at all. He said expressionlessly, “President Morgan, all the people here seem to know that I don’t have anyone I can use anymore, but haven’t you been challenging me? Did I not say anything at that time? Why is it that you don’t want to admit it now that you’re on the other side, President Hayes?”
“Yakov, you…”
Kyle was so angry that he almost coughed up blood.
“The martial arts tournament in our four provinces has been established for many years. The purpose is to resolve our own conflicts and not cause more disputes. Since it’s a martial arts tournament now, we should act according to the rules of the martial arts tournament!” Yakov shouted excitedly at Kyle.
Kyle looked at Yakov without saying a word. He knew very well that Yakov had lost his mind at this point. Yakov was certain that Thomas Morgan would not dare to take revenge on him, which was why he wanted to take advantage of this opportunity to make a fortune from Kyle.
“President Morgan, you’re the referee of this martial arts tournament. It shouldn’t be considered a violation of the rules of the martial arts tournament if I challenge President Hayes now, right?”
Yakov turned his head and shouted at Thomas. After Thomas heard Yakov’s words, the expression on his face seemed a little helpless.
He knew that Yakov was planning to use him to kill Kyle!
However, this was Thomas’s first time participating in a martial arts tournament, so he did not know much about the rules of the tournament. Therefore, Thomas turned his head to look at the staff.
When the staff member saw Thomas’s plea for help, his expression was unusually helpless. He did not know what to say.
“Since today is the martial arts competition, then we’ll do it according to the rules. Don’t worry about offending anyone. Just tell me what the rules are…” Thomas said to the staff member when he saw the awkward expression on their faces.
After hearing Thomas’s words, the staff smiled awkwardly and said softly, “President Morgan, the martial arts tournament has been held for so many years, but this is actually the first time such a situation has happened…”
“No matter how many times it’s happened, just tell me if I broke the rules or not!” Yakov shouted with his eyes wide open.
“No…”
The staff member shook his head.
“Isn’t that enough!”
Yakov laughed proudly and asked Kyle in a provocative tone, “President Hayes, who do you plan to send in this time?”
Kyle looked at Yakov angrily.
This was because Keith and Cameron were both injured. Even if they came up, it would be useless.
However, if the two of them didn’t come up, Kyle would be left with no one!

chapters.title: Chapter 688: Testing Your Skills
chapters.content:
Chapter 688: Testing Your Skills
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation | Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Hearing Yakov’s words, Kyle fell into silence.
Connor squinted his eyes and looked at Kyle’s position. No one knew what he was thinking about.
Yakov’s smile seemed to become even brighter after he saw Kyle’s troubled expression. After all, Yakov had been oppressed by Kyle for so many years, and today, he was finally turning the tables and becoming a big shot himself. How could he not be happy?
Charles knew Kyle’s difficulties, so he couldn’t help but ask him softly, “Why don’t we let Uncle Sanders go up and try again?”
“Even if I let Uncle Sanders go up now, it probably won’t solve any problems. Uncle Sanders is a match for Benjamin. Benjamin was used by Yakov to deal with me in the martial arts tournament…” Kyle gritted his teeth and whispered.
If Kyle had received the news in advance, he would have been prepared, but he definitely couldn’t have anticipated Yakov being able to find such a master.
“President Hayes, if you really can’t find someone to fight, you should just admit defeat and save time!” Yakov said provocatively to Kyle.
“Admit defeat?” When Kyle heard Yakov’s words, he couldn’t help but sneer. Then, he said lightly, “In my dictionary, there is no such thing as admitting defeat!”
“Then who are you going to send in?”
Yakov asked with a faint smile.
After a moment of hesitation, Kyle turned to the bodyguards behind him and asked, “Which one of you is willing to go up and give it a try?”
Although the bodyguards behind Kyle were also very skilled, they were just ordinary people. There was a huge gap between them and experts like Cameron and Keith, let alone Benjamin.
Moreover, Benjamin was very ruthless. Once he went on stage, he would either die or be injured.
These people were just out to make a living, so they were naturally unwilling to take such a risk.
Therefore, the bodyguards were all stunned. They didn’t even dare to look at Kyle.
The audience fell into a dead silence. No one had expected that Kyle, the big boss of their society, would be forced into such a situation!
Thomas Morgan and Charles’s expressions were also extremely ugly, but they couldn’t help Kyle.
When Kyle saw that the bodyguards did not say anything, he could not help but sigh and said lightly, “Alright, since you’re not willing to go up, then let me do it myself!”
Charles and the others were stunned when they heard Kyle’s words.
No one expected Kyle to personally take action at this time!
However, Charles knew Kyle’s strength very well. If he was compared to an ordinary person, Kyle could be considered an expert. That said, compared to these real martial artists, Kyle had no way of fighting back at all!
“Kyle, calm down. What can you do if you go up now? Can you beat this Benjamin?” Charles frowned and said to Kyle.
“So what if I can’t beat him? Do you think I can just admit defeat?” Kyle whispered.
“But if you go up and something happens to you, what should I do?” Charles advised in a low voice.
When Kyle heard this, a hint of helplessness flashed across his eyes.
When Benjamin saw that Kyle wanted to go on stage personally, he mocked him arrogantly. “Hahaha, I didn’t expect Davenport to really have no one left that a big shot like President Hayes will have to appear personally!”
” Who told you that there’s no one left in Davenport? Let me fight you!”
However, at this moment, a voice suddenly came from the back row of the square.
Under everyone’s surprised gazes, Connor slowly stood up.
In an instant, all the audience turned their heads to look at Connor’s position. Connor instantly became the focus of everyone’s eyes.
Kyle and Thomas Morgan also saw Connor. They were both stunned on the spot. Their expressions were very unbelievable. They were so excited that they didn’t know what to say.
As for Jesse, he stared at Connor beside him, his face showing a look of utter despair.
He couldn’t help but curse in a low voice, “Connor, are you f * eking crazy? Why are you standing up? Is this a place where you can mess around?”
At this moment, many big shots did not dare to speak. Some of them even had stiff expressions.
But at this moment, Connor had actually stood up and said that he wanted to go up and try. This was simply unreasonable!
Jesse knew very well that any one of these big shots was an existence that shook the world!
If Connor really angered these big shots, then he would definitely not be able to get away with it. After all, Connor was brought in by him!
Thinking of this, Jesse felt a chill run down his spine.
At this moment, he only had one thought in his mind, and that was to leave this place as soon as possible.
Melissa was so scared that she didn’t know what to say. She really couldn’t understand why Connor had suddenly stood up!
“Connor, what nonsense are you talking about?” Melissa frowned and scolded in a low voice.
After Benjamin heard Connor’s words, he couldn’t help but turn his head and glare at Connor.
The audience around Connor seemed to be worried that they would be implicated by Connor, so they didn’t hesitate at all and ran into the distance.
If Benjamin mistakenly thought that one of them was the one who shouted, wouldn’t they become the scapegoat?
In the blink of an eye, the audience around Connor had all run away, especially Jesse and Barry who had run as far away as possible.
At this moment, only Melissa and Quinn were still standing beside Connor, receiving the gazes of everyone present.
Quinn reached out and tugged on Connor’s clothes, then said softly, “Mr. McDonald, you should sit down quickly. These people are big shots that we can’t afford to offend. If you do, they will kill you!”
“It’s fine. They don’t have the guts…”
Connor looked at Quinn and smiled faintly.
” Who do you think you are? Hurry up and sit down!”
Melissa was also very worried about Connor. She could not help but frown and shout at Connor.
“Don’t worry, I’ll be fine!”
Connor looked at the two girls beside him and smiled faintly. Then, he directly walked forward.
Quinn and Melissa were so anxious that they didn’t know what to say.
Connor walked towards the arena expressionlessly.
During this period of time, Connor had been fighting with Jabba, but he did not know how his skills were.
Today, he could take this opportunity to test his skills.

chapters.title: Chapter 689: Connor McDonald
chapters.content:
Chapter 689: Connor McDonald
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation | Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
When everyone saw Connor walking towards the arena, they took the initiative to make way for Connor.
The crowd dispersed like a tide.
Connor walked out of the crowd with an expressionless face.
At this moment, almost everyone was looking at Connor with a surprised gaze because they could not understand what he wanted to do!
Some of the kinder-hearted audience members could not bear to see Connor go up and die like this, so they could not help but remind him in a low voice, “Young man, you should hurry back. This is not something you can get involved in. Be careful not to get into a bloody disaster…”
“That’s right, young man. You’d better not be a busybody. Hurry up and go back…”
Everyone said to Connor.
After Connor heard these people’s words, he smiled calmly and revealed an indifferent expression.
He didn’t stop and instead continued to walk forward.
A moment later, Connor came to the front of the stage and then raised his head to look at Benjamin on the stage. The expression on his face was very calm.
The previous experts could jump onto the stage with a single leap, but Connor was different from them. Connor chose to walk up the stairs.
Connor’s speed wasn’t very fast, but he walked up step by step.
In the eyes of the audience, Connor didn’t look like an expert at all. Instead, he looked more like an 8o-year-old man.
Other experts would enter the arena in a particularly clean and neat manner, but Connor chose to enter the arena in such a way. From the impression alone, Connor had already lost.
Charles did not see the competitor’s face clearly before, but he felt that he looked familiar.
However, when he saw that the man who walked onto the stage was actually Connor, his expression instantly changed.
