Although Charles never liked Connor and did not want him to be with Sabrina, he was the person his daughter Sabrina liked. Naturally, he couldn’t just watch Connor die.
Even an expert like Keith Sanders was not a match for Benjamin. If Connor went up, what was the difference between that and courting death?
At that point, Charles did not care about his identity and rushed to Connor. He grabbed Connor and shouted in a low voice, “Connor, is this a place you can come to? Get out of here now!”
Although Charles’s words were very unpleasant, he was actually doing this for Connor’s own good. He felt that Connor had not realized the seriousness of the problem at all.
Connor turned his head and looked at Charles indifferently. He said with a very calm expression, “Didn’t this person just say that there’s no one in Davenport? I’ll go up and try…”
“Go up and try?!” After hearing Connor’s words, Charles immediately sneered. Then, he widened his eyes and shouted, “Do you know what this place is? Is this something you can go up and ‘give a try just because you want to?”
At this moment, Charles was so angry that he didn’t know what to say.
“Young man, it’s good to have ambition, but this isn’t a fight between you young people. Don’t think that you can show off just because you have some mediocre skills. Even if I’m not a match for Benjamin, you’ll be courting death if you go up!”‘ Keith also advised from the sidelines.
“Connor, hurry up and get down. I think Master Wheeler won’t lower himself to your level on account of me!” Charles winked at Connor as he spoke.
“Since President Ziegler knows this kid, I have to give him some face!”
Benjamin saw that Connor wasn’t very old and felt that he was just a young kid. He didn’t want to fight with a kid like Connor, so he followed Charles’s words and shouted.
“Hahaha…”
Yakov also laughed and said to Kyle, “President Hayes, looks like your Davenport really doesn’t have anyone left. Are you really letting this kid go up when he hasn’t even grown properly? What if Master Wheeler killed this kid?”
Kyle stared at Connor’s direction and hesitated for a moment before running towards the ring.
Thomas naturally followed Kyle into the arena!
When Yakov saw how excited Kyle and Thomas were, a strange look flashed across his eyes. He did not understand what was going on.
A few seconds later, Kyle and Thomas entered the ring.
Charles saw the two of them coming up, and a hint of helplessness flashed across his eyes. He whispered to Kyle, “Thomas, this kid is my daughter’s friend. I don’t know what’s wrong with him to dare come up here.”
“Charles, this is Mr. McDonald! He inherited the old Chairman’s inheritance!”
Kyle shouted excitedly.
“You… What did you say?”
Charles was stunned when he heard Kyle’s words.
He thought that he had just heard wrongly. Connor was actually the Mr. McDonald?
Kyle and Thomas were not in the mood to explain more to Charles. They quickly walked up to Connor and bowed to him in unison. “Mr. McDonald, you’re here!”
Kyle and Thomas’s actions instantly scared the audience, as well as the big shots sitting not far away.
Everyone’s mouth was wide open as they looked at the arena. Other than shock, there was still shock on their faces.
“What is it? This kid is Thomas Morgan’s boss, Mr. McDonald?”
One of the big shots jumped up from his chair in shock.
“How is that possible? Mr. McDonald is that young?”
“Yeah, Thomas Morgan’s boss is actually this person?”
After the shock, everyone’s expressions became puzzled again.
If he told these people that Connor was a super rich heir, they might believe him, but they couldn’t believe that Connor was Thomas Morgan’s boss!
Jesse, Melissa, and Barry were sitting in the audience seats. Their eyes were wide open as they stared at Connor, clear shock on their faces.
They really couldn’t understand what was going on!
“Who is this Connor, really?”
Jesse stuttered as he stared at the screen.
“Yeah, how could Connor know people like Thomas Morgan and Kyle Hayes?” Barry shouted.
At this moment, only Melissa and Quinn knew Connor beforehand, so Jesse and Barry turned to look at them.

chapters.title: Chapter 690:I Am Mr. McDonald!
chapters.content:
Chapter 690:I Am Mr. McDonald!
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation | Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
“I… I don’t know either!”
“I only know that Connor is an ordinary student and that his family doesn’t seem to be very well-off…” Scarlett stuttered.
When everyone heard this, they turned to look at Quinn.
Quinn hesitated for a moment and said softly, “1 just met Mr. McDonald today.
I’m not very clear about his situation, but Mr. McDonald came here with the two people on the stage!”
“He came with those two?!”
When Jesse, Barry and the others heard Quinn’s words, they turned their heads to look at the arena, their expressions even more incredulous.
To be able to come to this location with big shots like Thomas and Kyle was enough to prove how terrifying Connor’s real identity was.
“Just now, 1 heard Thomas say that his boss was called Mr. McDonald. Could it be that…Connor is Thomas’s boss?” Jesse said in a trembling voice, terrified.
Connor’s surname was McDonald, and obviously Mr. McDonald’s surname was McDonald as well. In addition to Thomas and Kyle’s attitude towards Connor, it seemed that there was only one answer.
“Mr. McDonald’s identity is indeed very noble. Those two people were also very polite to him!” Quinn nodded her head gently. She could tell that among these people, Connor’s status was definitely the highest.
“Connor is Thomas’s boss? No wonder the employees of the Empire World
Building were so afraid when they found out Connor’s identity that day. No wonder Connor said that the sports car was his. It turns out that Connor wasn’t lying to me. All of that was actually true!
Scarlett’s expression was also very shocked. If all these things were connected, then all the problems could be explained clearly.
“No wonder Connor didn’t care about the money we won in the underground arena. How could a person of his level be interested in this bit of money?
Barry sighed. Jesse’s expression was also very ugly because he had always been targeting Connor. Now that he knew Connor’s identity, how could he not be afraid?
If Connor wanted to take revenge on him, it would be as easy as lifting a finger!
Scarlett felt like she was dreaming. Although the truth was right in front of her, she still couldn’t associate Connor with a rich kid.
The big shots below the stage were also shocked because no one had expected Thomas’s boss to appear in such a way.
“Thomas, what’s going on?”
Charles asked Kyle in shock.
Others believed that Connor was the legendary Mr. McDonald, but Charles could not believe it.
Charles had previously investigated Connor’s background and did not find anything special about him. Connor was an orphan and was delivering food to support himself. How could such a person turn out to be his boss?
He felt that there must be something fishy about this matter!
Kyle turned his head and glanced at Charles, then whispered to Charles, “Charles, this is the new Chairman of the Empire World Corporation, Connor McDonald. This time, Mr. McDonald has come to meet you…”
Charles was stunned when he heard Kyle’s words. Though he was usually calm, he could not maintain his composure at this moment.
Originally, Charles thought that Connor, whom his daughter liked, was just a poor kid.
However, he never dreamed that Connor would actually become his boss.
Charles could not accept such a change. He did not know how to describe his feelings.
Charles stammered as he asked, “Connor, so you’re Mr. McDonald?”
“Yes, I am Mr. McDonald!”
Connor nodded lightly.
“Then why didn’t you tell me before?” Charles asked.
“You didn’t ask me before, and I didn’t know you were from my company!” Connor explained calmly.
Charles took a deep breath and tried to calm himself down. He finally understood what was going on.
“No wonder Connor rejected me when I extended an olive branch to him. No wonder Connor gave Sabrina such an expensive bracelet. It turns out that Connor was really my boss!” Charles could not help but lament.
He felt that everything that had happened before could be explained.
Kyle hesitated for a moment before asking, “Charles, do you know Mr. McDonald?”
“I guess so!” Charles nodded helplessly.
“Since we know each other, 1 shall not introduce you…
Kyle smiled faintly and looked at Connor. “Mr. McDonald, this is the person-in-charge of the Empire World Corporation’s Salem branch, President Charles Ziegler!”
“I know!”
Connor nodded lightly.
“Mr. McDonald, do you want to fight this person now?” Kyle asked Connor after a moment of hesitation.
“That’s right. Didn’t this person say that there’s no one left in Davenport? I’ll come up and give it a try…” Connor replied calmly.
“But Mr. McDonald, you’re just an ordinary person. This Benjamin is an expert martial artist. I’m worried that you’ll be in danger…” Kyle whispered.
“It’s okay. I’ve been learning ancient martial arts recently. When I saw these people fighting so enthusiastically just now, my hands were a little itchy, so I wanted to come up and give it a try…” Connor explained with a smile.
Kyle naturally knew that Connor had been learning ancient martial arts from Jorge Yarrell. However, he also knew that Connor had only learned it for less than a month, so he was still very worried.
He subconsciously looked at Thomas, as if he wanted to see what Thomas thought.
After Thomas hesitated for a moment, he asked Connor softly, “Mr. McDonald, this Benjamin is really dangerous. Are you confident in yourself?”
“1 think it should work!”
Connor thought for a moment, then looked at Thomas and nodded.
“Since Mr. McDonald thinks it’s possible, then let him give it a try. Let’s stop at a certain point and ensure that he won’t be in danger!” Thomas raised his head and said to Kyle and Charles.
After Yakov heard Thomas’s words, a strange look flashed across his eyes.
After all, Connor was Thomas’s boss. A big shot of this level was not someone Yakov could afford to provoke.
He didn’t even dare to provoke Thomas, let alone Mr. McDonald!
If Benjamin really did something to Connor, then things would be troublesome..

chapters.title: Chapter 691: Head-to-head
chapters.content:
Chapter 691: Head-to-head
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation | Editor. EndlessFantasy Translation
When Yakov heard Connor was about to go on stage, he suddenly became
nervous.
“Mr. Morgan, isn’t it a little inappropriate for you to let Mr. McDonald go on stage?” he hurriedly shouted.”
“How is it inappropriate?” Thomas asked Yakov softly.
“Mr. McDonald is your boss, but he doesn’t seem to have anything to do with Kyle, right? What right does he have to represent Kyle in the tournament?” Yakov looked at Thomas and said.
“Mr. McDonald is not only my boss, he is also Kyle’s boss. Do you think he is not qualified to participate in the tournament?” Thomas turned his head to look at Yakov and said to him calmly.
After Yakov heard Thomas’s words, he was stunned and in disbelief.
He had never thought that Thomas and Kyle had the same boss.
Moreover, their boss was Connor. One had to admit that Connor’s identity was too imposing. It was so strong that it was unbelievable.
Everyone present was also in shock. Everyone stared at Connor with widened eyes, extremely surprised!
Melissa, Jesse, and the others were so scared they couldn’t speak. They stood rooted to the ground, speechless. She did not know how to express her
feelings.
“Mr. Morgan, since Mr. McDonald’s identity is so noble, I’m worried that if 1 cause any trouble, I won’t be able to bear the responsibility!”
At this moment, Benjamin seemed to be in a difficult position as he couldn’t help but say softly.
“There are rules in the martial arts tournament. You don’t have to worry about anything. Since I am standing up here, I’m not worried about you hurting me.
Even if you hurt me, it’s a matter of the arena,” Connor said calmly to Benjamin.
Benjamin didn’t expect a big shot with such a strong background like Connor would have such boldness. He asked softly, “Mr. McDonald, are you serious?”
“Yes!” Connor nodded calmly.
“All right, since you said it’s okay, I won’t hold back!” Benjamin replied in a low voice.
“You three can leave!” Connor turned and said to Thomas, Kyle, and Charles.
After the three heard Connor’s order, a trace of helplessness flashed in their
eyes.
However, they did not dare to disobey Connor’s orders. They could only helplessly walk down the stage.
After Thomas and the other two left the arena, Benjamin cupped his fists at Connor, then directly rushed toward Connor.
Benjamin didn’t hold back when dealing with Connor this time. He used his full strength when he attacked. His speed and strength were extremely shocking.
When Kyle saw this, he was very worried.
He was now worried it would be troublesome if something happened to
Connor.
But at this moment, Connor suddenly waved his right hand and said coldly to Benjamin, “You’re too slow!”
The moment Connor spoke, something shifted in the air.
Connor gently turned his body to the side and dodged Benjamin’s punch.
When everyone saw this, they finally heaved a sigh of relief.
At this moment, they knew Connor was not joking when he entered the arena.
For Connor to be able to dodge Benjamin’s punch so easily meant Connor was indeed strong.
Even Benjamin was shocked because he didn’t expect Connor to be so fast. However, Benjamin might not know that Jabba, who usually fought with Connor, was much faster than him.
Jabba was ten times faster than Benjamin, and Connor could barely dodge one or two moves from Jabba.
Therefore, Benjamin’s speed was like slow motion in Connor’s eyes. It was very easy to dodge.
After the first attack was missed, Benjamin hurriedly launched a second round
of attacks at Connor.
But no matter how hard Benjamin tried, Connor could easily dodge Benjamin’s attacks.
When Thomas saw this, a trace of excitement flashed in his eyes. He whispered, “I didn’t expect Mr. McDonald to improve so quickly. It’s only been less than a month, but he’s already so powerful!”
“Yeah, I didn’t expect Mr. McDonald to be able to fight a martial artist like Benjamin!” Kyle was also shocked.
Charles, on the other hand, had mixed feelings. He narrowed his eyes and looked at Connor.
“But why has Mr. McDonald been hiding and not taking the initiative to attack?” At this moment, Keith, beside Charles, couldn’t help but mutter softly.
Connor had not made a single move from the start of the fight. He had been dodging Benjamin’s attacks the entire time.
Thomas also seemed to have noticed this, and a trace of doubt flashed in his eyes.
The reason Connor had not made a move was very simple. When Connor fought with Jabba, he had been playing the role of being beaten up.
However, he had never touched Jabba, so he only learned how to dodge but did not know how to attack.
“Mr. McDonald is very fast, but I don’t understand why Mr. McDonald doesn’t take the initiative to attack. Is Mr. McDonald provoking Benjamin?” Keith said again.
“Chaotic Palms!”
Benjamin, who had launched multiple attacks but had never been effective, seemed upset. He roared angrily.
“It’s the Chaotic Palms!”
“Mr. McDonald is in danger!”
A strange look flashed in Keith’s eyes as he could not help but exclaim.
“What is the Chaotic Palms?” Thomas was stunned and asked Keith in confusion.
“Chaotic Palms is Benjamin’s famous unique skill. The biggest feature of this palm technique is that it has many variations and is extremely fast. At this moment, Mr. McDonald has relied on his reaction speed to dodge Benjamin’s attacks, but he definitely can’t dodge Benjamin’s Chaotic Palms!” Keith looked at Thomas and explained.
“What should we do then?” Kyle looked anxious.
“If Benjamin’s palm lands on Mr. McDonald’s body, even if Mr. McDonald didn’t die, he would be heavily injured!” Keith said in a low voice.
When everyone heard this, they all turned to look at the arena.
At this moment, Connor, who was on the stage, seemed to have realized the danger of this move.
However, it was not easy for Connor to dodge this. If he did not dodge, it was very likely that he would be seriously injured.
“Since you can’t dodge, then let’s fight head-on. I hope you’re not lying to me!” Connor took a deep breath, quickly clenched his fist, and shouted, “Seven-Star Big Dipper Fist, first part, Dragon Roar!”
‘Bang!’ There was a loud bang.
Benjamin’s huge palm and Connor’s fist collided fiercely..

chapters.title: Chapter 692: Impressive Skills
chapters.content:
Chapter 692: Impressive Skills
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation | Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
When Connor’s Big Dipper Fist and Benjamin’s Chaotic Palms collided fiercely, everyone present was shocked.
Melissa and Quinn seemed to be worried about Connor, so they instinctively closed their eyes, not daring to see what happened next.
However, when they opened their eyes again, something unbelievable happened.
Connor was still standing on the stage, calm.
Everyone below the stage was also in shock.
Keith seemed to be in disbelief as he looked at Connor.
This was because when Benjamin fought with them previously, he had not used the Chaotic Palms at all. Chaotic Palms was not something Keith could withstand.
However, Connor was able to take it. From this point, one could see how impressive Connor’s strength was!
“How is this possible?”
Benjamin’s expression changed drastically because after his palm landed on Connor’s fist, Connor did not react at all. On the contrary, Benjamin himself was forced to take two steps back.
It was obvious that Benjamin didn’t gain any advantage this time.
As for Connor, he lowered his head and looked at his fist, a little excited.
Previously, Connor had never used the Seven-Star Big Dipper Fist. The reason was very simple.
That was because Connor felt that Jorge, that old man, was a little unreliable.
Connor had learned this set of fist techniques not long ago and only learned three parts.
lie didn’t know how powerful this set of fist techniques was. It would be troublesome if this set of fist techniques had no power.
But at this moment, Connor knew that this fist technique’s power was very powerful. Using it against a martial artist like Benjamin would not be a problem.
At this moment, Benjamin knew Connor’s skills weren’t simple. lie roared angrily, exerted strength in his legs, and instantly rushed toward Connor, lie suddenly raised his fist and smashed it fiercely toward Connor’s head. Benjamin’s punch was like lightning, frighteningly fast.
When the audience saw Benjamin’s punch, they inhaled sharply, extremely shocked.
This punch was terrifying. The audience near the arena’s front row could even hear the sound of the air exploding.
When Connor saw Benjamin rushing toward him, a playful smile appeared. He said softly, “Second part, Tiger’s Roar!”
After saying this, Connor smashed his fist down Benjamin’s head.
Connor’s punch might be very ordinary to ordinary people, and there was no aura to speak of.
However, Benjamin could feel how scary Connor’s punch was.
Benjamin felt like this punch was like a speeding truck heading straight for his head.
When Benjamin saw that the situation was not right, he hurriedly retracted his fist and retreated, narrowly dodging Connor’s punch.
However, Connor was not very familiar with this fist technique. He found that he had no way to retract his fist after he attacked.
Even though Benjamin dodged, Connor’s punch still smashed into the ground. ‘Boom!’
There was a loud sound.
Connor’s punch made a deep hole in the ground.
The audience exclaimed in surprise. Everyone stared at Connor with wide eyes, extremely shocked.
No one had expected Connor’s punch to be so terrifying.
“What fist technique is Mr. McDonald learning? It has such terrifying power!” Keith widened his eyes and looked at Connor, shocked.
Keith had lived for many years and seen many amazing fist techniques.
However, he felt these fist techniques could not be compared to Connor’s fist techniques.
Connor’s fist technique was really fierce!
“Mr. McDonald might win this battle!” Keith sighed softly.
Benjamin naturally also saw Connor’s true strength and was extremely shocked. For a moment, he didn’t know what to do.
However, Connor didn’t give Benjamin any chance to react. Since Connor had already finished the first two punches, he could test the power of the third punch.
“Third part, Crane’s Cry!” Connor cried, then rushed toward Benjamin.
After Benjamin realized that something was wrong, he hurriedly wanted to retreat.
However, Connor was too fast. In the blink of an eye, he stood before Benjamin.
“Bang!” There was a loud bang.
Connor’s fist landed on Benjamin’s back.
Benjamin let out a miserable cry, staggered two steps back, and fell to the ground.
Everyone’s eyes widened as they looked at Benjamin.
When they saw Benjamin’s appearance, they were all dumbfounded, mouths agape in utter shock.
Connor’s punch was truly astonishing. It broke Benjamin’s ribs.
If they hadn’t fought, no one would have thought this would be the result!
Connor defeated Benjamin with just three punches!
Although Benjamin had admitted defeat, they had seen Benjamin’s current state, so they probably had no room to fight back.
No one had expected Connor’s skills to be so terrifying!
After Connor finished his three punches, he did not intend to continue.
Instead, he looked indifferently at Benjamin and asked expressionlessly, “Do you still want to continue fighting?”
“Mr. McDonald, I admit defeat. I surrender!”
Benjamin had already been completely defeated by Connor. He no longer had that arrogant aura from before. He shouted at Connor with an extremely sorry expression.
After Connor heard Benjamin’s surrender, he couldn’t help but smile faintly.
Then, he looked at Yakov and asked, “Who was the one who said there is no one left in Davenport?”
In an instant, the entire place was deathly silent.
Everyone’s mouth was wide open, not daring to look at Connor.
Connor’s identity was already very impressive, and now he had portrayed such superb skills.
Even if these people were given nine lives, they would not dare to offend Connor!
If anyone offended Connor now, it was no different from asking for death. Thomas looked at Connor with a gratified expression.
This was the first time Thomas saw hope in Connor!
Thomas knew that Connor was no longer the timid and poor student from back then!

chapters.title: Chapter 693: Avoiding Disaster
chapters.content:
Chapter 693: Avoiding Disaster
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation | Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
In less than two minutes, Connor had defeated Benjamin.
Moreover, Connor’s performance just now also made the audience present flabbergasted.
Originally, everyone thought that Connor was going up to fight casually.
After all, Connor was Thomas’ boss, so Benjamin probably wouldn’t dare to do anything to him.
But no one expected Connor to really defeat Benjamin.
Furthermore, he had defeated Benjamin in a crushing manner!
Especially the Seven-star Big Dipper Fist that Connor used. To those so-called experts, it was terrifying.
They had been in the martial world for many years but had never seen such a valiant fist technique.
At this moment, many people widened their eyes and looked at this in a daze and utter shock.
Quinn covered her mouth and looked at Connor in disbelief.
Charles was also extremely shocked. He looked at Connor in the arena with a dull gaze and instantly recalled the conversation between him and Connor. Previously, Charles felt that Connor was too arrogant.
However, now that Charles knew Connor’s background and ability, he was relieved.
With such ability, even if Connor was a little arrogant, it was only expected!
“Looks like I underestimated Connor!” Charles could not help but mutter to himself.
Charles could not imagine how great Connor’s future achievements would be.
Previously, Charles had always looked down on Connor thoroughly. He even felt that Connor was not worthy of his daughter.
But now that he thought about it, his idea of ‘before’ was funny.
“It’s not that Connor isn’t worthy of Sabrina, but Sabrina isn’t worthy of Connor!” Charles sighed inwardly.
At this moment, Connor stood expressionlessly on the stage, extremely calm, as if defeating Benjamin did not give him any sense of accomplishment.
If it were an ordinary person, they would be very excited after defeating Benjamin. After all, this was a good opportunity to become famous worldwide! However, Connor did not care much about these things.
The only thing that surprised Connor was that the fist technique he had learned from Jorge was very powerful. Its lethality was high.
Moreover, this set of Seven-star Big Dipper Fist had thirty-size moves. At this moment, Connor had only learned three moves.
If Connor could learn all moves, how powerful would he be?
“Is there anyone else who wants to challenge Kyle?” At this moment, Connor asked the big shots below the stage again.
At this moment, these people were all dumbfounded and did not dare speak.
Connor expressionlessly glanced at the big shots below the stage, and those big shots hurriedly lowered their heads as if they dared not look straight into Connor’s eyes.
These big shots knew very well that whether it was their identity, background, or strength, they were no match for Connor. Offending Connor now was no different from courting death.
“Since no one wants to accept the challenge, I will go down…”
After Connor said this, he left the stage slowly.
At this moment, Yakov was sitting on a chair, his face abnormally pale.
He couldn’t help but hesitate, then softly greeted Connor, “Hello, Mr. McDonald!”
Connor glanced at Yakov indifferently, then asked Yakov expressionlessly, “How should I deal with you?”
Hearing that, Yakov was stunned for a moment. He began to tremble slightly as he paled.
“I’m giving you a chance now. How do you think I should handle this?” Connor looked at Yakov and repeated.
Yakov knew clearly in his heart how strong Connor was. Today, he had offended Connor. In the future, it would be very difficult for him to survive in the four cities.
Therefore, after Yakov hesitated, he whispered to Connor, “Mr. McDonald, I’m willing to give you twenty percent of my annual profits. I only ask that you let me off!”
Yakov could only spend money to avoid disaster now.
A single sentence from Connor could make him lose everything.
Therefore, even if he was reluctant to offer twenty percent of his profit, this was the best way he could think of.
They were shocked when the big shots below the stage heard Yakov’s words.
He offered Connor twenty percent of the profit in one breath.
Yakov had really suffered a great loss this time.
These people were secretly rejoicing. Fortunately, they did not offend Connor just now.
If they offended Connor, Yakov’s ending would be theirs.
Yakov was also very pained, but now he had no other way.
He knew he might not get a single cent if he didn’t offer this!
After Connor heard Yakov’s words, he couldn’t help but glance at Yakov.
“Mr. McDonald, twenty percent of the profits is not a small amount…” Thomas reminded Connor softly.
In Thomas’ eyes, it was better not to make a big deal of today’s matter.
Otherwise, things would become even more troublesome if Yakov were driven to desperation.
Therefore, Thomas felt it was already very good for Yakov to take out twenty percent of the profits.
After Connor heard Thomas’s suggestion, he looked at Thomas indifferently and said, “I think that twenty percent of the profit is indeed a little too little!” “It’s indeed a little too little?” After Thomas heard Connor’s words, he was instantly dumbfounded.
He had clearly said that twenty percent of the profit was already quite a lot, but it came from Connor’s mouth differently now.
Thomas opened his mouth, wanting to correct Connor.
However, Connor waved his hand at Thomas, then looked at Yakov and said, “You should have heard what Thomas said just now. Thomas said the twenty percent profit you took out is too little…” Yakov looked at Connor helplessly.
Yakov had heard what Thomas had said to Connor just now. Thomas had clearly said ‘a lot’.
However, even if Yakov knew that, he did not dare to say it out loud!
He hesitated momentarily before asking Connor softly, “So, Mr. McDonald, how much do you think is okay?”
“Fifty percent!” Connor replied indifferently.
When everyone heard Connor suggest that number, they were all dumbfounded.
No one expected Connor’s appetite to be so big!
He actually asked for fifty percent of the profits!

chapters.title: Chapter 694: How Should I Deal With You?
chapters.content:
Chapter 694: How Should I Deal With You?
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation | Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
After Yakov heard Connor’s words, he seemed upset.
Yakov could still accept it if it was only a twenty percent profit.
However, Connor asked for fifty percent of his profits. This was too much!
“Do you think I want too much?” Connor asked Yakov, seeing Yakov hadn’t said anything.
Yakov slowly looked up at Connor, then said helplessly, “Mr. McDonald, isn’t fifty percent a bit too much?”
“If you think it’s too much, it doesn’t matter. I can change your condition. I don’t want to see you in Oprana from today onwards,” Connor said to Yakov expressionlessly.
After everyone heard Connor’s words, they seemed even more shocked.
No one had expected Connor to be so ruthless. It was obvious that he wanted Yakov to disappear!
If Yakov left Oprana, other big shots would naturally annex his territory. By then, Yakov might really have nothing!
After Yakov heard Connor’s words, his face instantly turned pale.
He smiled bitterly and said to Connor, “All right, Mr. McDonald, I will give you fifty percent of my annual profits!”
After hearing Yakov’s words, the big shots were stunned. They were very shocked.
They had never expected that Yakov would agree.
Even Thomas did not expect this!
Moreover, Thomas could feel that Connor was very overbearing at this moment. He did not leave any leeway at all. This was also a good thing for Thomas.
Thomas felt Connor would only have a chance to deal with Rockefeller’s people if he did this.
Thomas wasn’t worried that Connor’s character would become increasingly irritable. Instead, he was worried that Connor would continue to be mediocre.
Seeing Yakov agree, Connor turned to Kyle and said, “I’ll leave the rest to you!” “Yes, Mr. McDonald!” Kyle looked at Connor and nodded gently, his face full of excitement.
In fact, even Kyle did not expect Connor to take fifty percent of the profits from Yakov.
This had a huge impact on Kyle.
Yakov had always been a competitor of Kyle. Now that Yakov had to give Connor fifty percent of the profits every year, it was equivalent to Yakov being Connor’s man. This way, Kyle would not have to be too wary of Yakov in the future.
After dealing with Yakov, Connor turned to look at the other big shots not far away.
“Mr. McDonald, I will listen to all your orders from today onward. No matter what orders you have, I will not say anything!” Jonathan from San Diego reacted very quickly. He hurriedly stepped forward and said to Connor.
“That’s right. We’ll do whatever you say in the future, Mr. McDonald!” The big shots from the other provinces also said to Connor.
“Mr. McDonald, Mr. McDonald…”
The big shots present seemed to have gone crazy as they shouted at Connor excitedly.
Connor already convinced these people.
Now, even if given nine lives, they would not dare to offend Connor!
When the audience in the square saw this, they sighed internally.
One had to know that any one of these big shots present could suppress a region!
But at this moment, these people were bowing to Connor. They could not believe what they were seeing.
These people knew very well that it wouldn’t be long before Connor’s name spread throughout Oprana.
After exchanging words with the big shots, Connor walked toward Quinn and the others.
When Melissa saw Connor walking over, she had mixed feelings. She didn’t know how to describe her feelings.
Jesse and Barry were even more terrified. They had wanted to run away.
However, they knew that Connor’s background was strong. Even if they escaped now, they would be caught in the future.
Therefore, they felt that since they couldn’t escape, they might as well wait for Connor here and apologize to him. Connor might have let them off on account of Melissa.
Barry wanted to kill Jesse. If Jesse hadn’t been instigating him, he wouldn’t have offended Connor or seduced Quinn.
Barry felt that Quinn was Connor’s woman, but who was Connor?
Connor was an existence that even an influential gangster like Yakov did not dare to provoke!
He was just an ordinary Taekwondo athlete!
Compared to normal people, Barry’s skills were still considered good.
However, compared to Connor, Barry had no way to fight back.
Jesse was also very fearful. His intestines were about to turn green with regret.
If he had known Connor had such an identity, even if Jesse was brave as a lion, he would not have dared to offend Connor!
Now, Jesse could only look at Melissa pitifully.
Jesse knew that only Melissa could help him now.
He knew that the relationship between Connor and Melissa was not ordinary. If Melissa could help him plead for mercy, he might have a chance of survival.
A moment later, Connor returned to Jesse and the others.
Connor was already looking like he was before, carrying the aura of an ordinary university student. No one could tell Connor could make so many gangster bosses bow to him.
“Connor, I…”
Jesse looked at Connor and opened his mouth to speak.
Connor looked coldly at Jesse and said expressionlessly, “Quinn isn’t my girlfriend, but you think she’s my girlfriend. You even have bad intentions toward Quinn and want to seduce her. This is disrespectful to me.”
After Quinn heard Connor’s words, doubt flashed in her eyes.
She had no idea that Jesse and the others wanted to seduce her.
When Jesse and Barry heard Connor’s words, their faces turned pale, and they kneeled, begging for mercy.
After Melissa saw this, she seemed a little helpless..

chapters.title: Chapter 695: Quinn’s Gratitude
chapters.content:
Chapter 695: Quinn’s Gratitude
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation | Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
“Connor, we know we were wrong. Please let us go!” Jesse kneeled, extremely nervous, as he begged Connor for mercy.
“That’s right, Mr. McDonald, we know we were wrong. If we had known your identity earlier, we wouldn’t have dared to do anything to Quinn!” Barry also kneeled and begged Connor for mercy.
Connor looked at Jesse and Barry without saying anything.
After a moment of hesitation, Melissa whispered to Connor, “Connor, Jesse and Barry are my friends. Can you let them go, please?”
Connor turned, looked at Melissa, and said playfully, “I can let them go, but I have a request!”
“Mr. McDonald, you have any requests? I’ll do anything as long as it’s within my capabilities!” Jesse shouted excitedly.
“My request is very simple. I hope you can control your mouth and not tell anyone about what you saw today. If anyone finds out about my identity, I will make you pay an even more painful price than now.”
Connor looked at Jesse, Barry, and Melissa expressionlessly.
“All right, yes…” Jesse nodded without thinking.
Melissa was a little confused and could not help but ask Connor, “Connor, why did you hide your identity?”
“Because I don’t want my life to be affected by this!” Connor replied indifferently, then turned to Quinn and said, “Let’s go!”
“All right!” Quinn quickly agreed and followed Connor out of the square.
After Connor and Quinn left, Jesse and Barry slowly stood up.
Even though Connor had already walked away, Jesse and Barry still stood there, not moving at all. They were nervous, as if they had not recovered from what had happened.
The change in Connor’s identity was too terrifying.
As soon as Jesse thought about what he had said to Connor, he started trembling uncontrollably.
Melissa really couldn’t understand what kind of person Connor was. Why did he have to play the role of a poor loser in school despite his influential background?
“Connor, who are you? What do you want?” Melissa couldn’t help but sigh internally.
Meanwhile, Connor was led by Quinn to the hotel.
Along the way, Quinn was very nervous, as if she had been frightened by what had happened at the martial arts tournament.
Connor turned to look at Quinn and asked her softly, “I heard that your mother is sick?”
Quinn was surprised. Then, she hurriedly nodded and said, “Yes, my mother fell ill a year ago, but because my family doesn’t have money, she has been relying on medicine. There’s no way to cure her completely…”
“How much does it cost to cure your mother’s illness?” Connor asked Quinn softly.
“too, 000 dollars…” Quinn hurriedly replied.
“Go to Thomas tomorrow and ask him to bring you and your mother to Porthampton. He will arrange the best hospital for your mother. That should be able to cure your mother’s illness…” Connor said slowly.
Quinn was stunned. She seemed a little awkward and said softly, “Mr. McDonald, my family doesn’t have that much money right now. I think I won’t go…”
“You don’t have to spend any money. Thomas will pay for your mother’s hospitalization and treatment fees.” Connor replied to Quinn with a smile.
Hearing that, Quinn instantly became excited.
She couldn’t help but cover her mouth as she looked at Connor in disbelief and said, “Mr. McDonald, do you mean you want to treat my mother for free?”
“Yes, it’s fate that we met. 100, 000 dollars may be a huge sum to you, but it’s nothing to me!” Connor replied indifferently.
In fact, Connor did not intoned to help Quinn even though she was indeed very pitiful.
However, Connor was not a great philanthropist. He couldn’t help everyone in trouble. Otherwise, Connor would not have to do anything else. Doing charity every day was enough to keep him busy.
However, when Quinn stopped him when Connor was preparing to enter the arena.
Connor could feel that Quinn sincerely cared about him. This made Connor feel a little touched, so Connor changed his mind and wanted to help Quinn.
After Quinn heard Connor’s offer, she was so excited that she kneeled before Connor. She cried as she said to Connor, “Mr. McDonald, you’re a kind person. I don’t even know how to thank you…”
“How will you thank me?” Connor looked at Quinn and smiled faintly. At this moment, he didn’t need Quinn to do anything.
Connor didn’t help Quinn because he wanted her to repay him.
“You don’t have to thank me. Just take it as me thanking you for taking good care of me today…” Connor said lightly.
“That won’t do, Mr. McDonald. Although I’m poor, I know the principle of not receiving a reward for nothing. If you don’t let me do something, I can’t accept your help. Otherwise, I won’t be at ease…” Quinn said stubbornly.
Although Quinn was poor, she still had a backbone. She would never accept Connor’s help for no reason.
“So, how do you plan to thank me?” Connor asked Quinn helplessly.
Quinn didn’t know what to say. Then, she said in a low voice, “Mr. McDonald, I can serve you…”
“Well, I already have a girlfriend. I’m not the kind of person…” Connor said helplessly to Quinn.
When Quinn heard Connor’s words, she immediately blushed. Then, she said softly, “Mr. McDonald, you might have misunderstood me. The service I’m talking about is not to sleep with you but to be your caretaker. I can take care of you…”
Quinn knew she had nothing to thank Connor with, so she could only choose to be Connor’s caretake to repay him.
“Well, I’m used to living alone and don’t need a caretaker!” Connor said to Quinn awkwardly.
“So, how should I repay you?”
Quinn blinked and asked, stumped..

chapters.title: Chapter 696: Charles Ziegler’s Visit
chapters.content:
Chapter 696: Charles Ziegler’s Visit
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation | Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Connor looked at Quinn who was kneeling in front of him with a helpless expression.
He could not help but hesitate for a moment before continuing, “Stand up. How am I supposed to talk to you while you’re kneeling on the ground…”
Upon hearing Connor’s words, she hurriedly stood up and looked at Connor with a very serious expression. “Mr. McDonald, if you don’t let me repay you, I won’t let you pay for my mother’s treatment. Please let me do something!” Connor knew that if he didn’t let Quinn do something, she would definitely not change her mind because this girl was too stubborn.
Connor hesitated for a couple of seconds before asking Quinn softly, “Quinn, how old are you this year?”
“Eighteen!”
Quinn quickly replied.
“Eighteen years old?”
Connor thought for a moment and then said,” You should still be in high school, right?”
“My friends who are the same age as me are all in their third year of high school. They’re about to take the college entrance examination, but I had to take care of my mother, so I dropped out of school in my first year of high school…”
Quinn said to Connor with a disappointed expression.
“How are your grades?”
Connor asked indifferently.
“My grades are not bad. My teacher said that if I work hard in my third year of high school, it shouldn’t be a problem for me to get into a first-tier university…”
Quinn replied.
“Your grades are so good. It would be a pity if you didn’t continue studying!” Connor sighed softly and continued, “How about this? I’ll get Thomas to make arrangements for you. After your mother recovers, you can go straight to the Porthampton University to study. I’ll also pay for your tuition fees…”
Quinn was stunned again after hearing Connor’s words. She seemed to be even more surprised.
Because Connor had just said that he wanted to treat her mother’s illness, and now he wanted to arrange for her to go to school. Quinn was so excited that she didn’t know what to say.
“Mr. McDonald, I don’t know how to thank you for helping my mother. And now you’re going to help me with my studies? I don’t know how to thank you!” Quinn exclaimed.
“As long as you go to the Porthampton University, you’ll be thanking me!” Connor whispered to Quinn.
Quinn looked at Connor and asked with a puzzled expression, “Mr. McDonald, what do you mean by that?”
“This is how I see it. Don’t you want to repay me? You can’t help me now, so I’m going to let you study in school for a while. After you finish university, I’ll arrange for you to work in Thomas’s company and help me manage my business. What do you think?”
Connor said to Quinn with a smile.
Quinn looked at Connor with gratitude. She didn’t know how to express her feelings.
Although Connor said that he wanted Quinn to repay him, he was actually helping Quinn.
Connor was giving Quinn a chance to change her fate.
If there was no Connor, Quinn might live in this small town for the rest of her life. If she was lucky, she could find someone she liked, get married, have children, and spend an ordinary life. If she was unlucky, she might become a plaything in the hands of the rich.
However, she was very lucky to meet Connor.
“Mr. McDonald, you’re such a good person. Why are you so good to me?”
Quinn asked Connor softly.
Actually, I’m doing this for myself. I need someone I can trust to help me manage the company, and you’re the person I trust!”
Connor calmly replied.
Quinn understood what he meant by that. She said in a serious tone, “Mr. McDonald, don’t worry. I definitely won’t let you down!”
“I believe you!”
Connor nodded lightly.
Quinn looked at Connor without saying anything.
Ten minutes later, Connor brought Quinn back to the hotel.
After arriving at the hotel, Connor first went to Thomas’s room and told him about Quinn.
This small matter was nothing to Thomas, so he agreed immediately.
After explaining these things to Thomas, Connor returned to his room alone.
Quinn returned home, wanting to share the good news with her mother.
After Connor returned to his room, he washed up and was ready to rest.
However, at this moment, there was a knock on the door.
When Connor heard the knocking on the door, he couldn’t help but be stunned for a moment. Then, he frowned and asked, “Who is it?”
“It’s me, Charles Ziegler!”
Charles’s voice sounded from outside the door.
When Connor heard Charles’s voice, he quickly sat up on the bed and asked softly, “Uncle Charles, is there something you need?”
“Mr. McDonald, I want to talk to you!”
Charles said calmly.
Connor hesitated for a moment, then walked to the door and opened it.
When Charles saw Connor, he asked softly, “Should I call you Mr. McDonald or Connor?”
“Call me whatever you prefer!”
Connor smiled faintly, then turned around and returned to his room.
Charles sighed softly and followed Connor into the room.
“Please sit!”
Connor pointed at the sofa beside him and said.
“No, thank you…”
Charles replied faintly, then looked at Connor and said, “I didn’t expect you to hide it so well. I thought that you were just an ordinary poor student, but I didn’t expect you to be my boss. Now that I think about it, it’s really ridiculous…”
“Ridiculous?”
Connor looked at Charles and asked, “Why do you think it’s ridiculous?”
“Connor, I’m warning you. Although I’m your subordinate, I’m speaking to you as Sabrina’s father. Personal and work matters don’t mix. Don’t think that I’ll be like the others, respectful to you after knowing your identity.”
Charles looked at Connor seriously.
“I know. Just say what you want to say. There’s no need to beat around the bush with me!”
Connor sat on the sofa and said calmly.
“Why did you deliberately hide your identity and get close to my daughter?”
Charles asked Connor.
“I hid my identity to get close to your daughter?”
Connor smiled helplessly when he heard Charles’s words.
“What’s that smile for? Do you think I don’t know? You pretended to be a poor student and deliberately approached my daughter. You must have some ulterior motive!”
Charles shouted after seeing Connor smile.

chapters.title: Chapter 697  A Kind Reminder
chapters.content:
Chapter 697  A Kind Reminder
"Since you're talking to me as Sabrina's father, I should call you Uncle Charles.
"So, Uncle Charles, I think you might have misunderstood me…"
Connor whispered to Charles.
"You don't have to tell me this now. Tell me, why did you deliberately get close to my daughter?"
Charles shouted angrily.
"I don't have any ulterior motives. I didn't mean to get close to your daughter. Before I inherited this inheritance, I was indeed a poor student.
"Not many people know about this inheritance, so if they don't know my identity, that's not peculiar. I don't want too many people to know my identity because this will affect my normal life!"
Connor said slowly.
"Then, what's going on between you and my daughter?"
Charles calmed down a little and asked Connor in a low voice.
"Sabrina and I are just ordinary friends. We've only known each other for less than half a month. Moreover, I already have a fiancée. The condition for me to inherit this inheritance is to be with my fiancée, so I won't have any thoughts about other women..."
Connor continued.
Charles looked at Connor and was stunned again. Then, he frowned and asked, "Did you just say that you already have a fiancée?"
"That's right!"
Connor nodded and continued, "If you don't believe me, you can ask Thomas Morgan now..."
Seeing that Connor didn't seem to be joking, Charles believed what Connor said. Then, he continued to ask, "You're not with my daughter?"
"Of course, not!"
Charles looked at Connor and hesitated for a moment before asking in a low voice, "Since you're not with my daughter, why did you give her such an expensive gift? Do you dare to say that you have no other thoughts about my daughter?"
Connor lightly shook his head.
"..."
Charles looked at Connor and hesitated for a moment before asking in a low voice, "Since you're not with my daughter, why did you give her such an expensive gift? Do you dare to say that you have no other thoughts about my daughter?"
"An expensive gift?"
Connor looked at Charles with a puzzled expression.
"The garnet bracelet you gave Sabrina on her birthday!"
Charles reminded Connor.
"Is that garnet bracelet very valuable?"
Connor frowned and asked helplessly.
"That bracelet is a Phoenix Bracelet. It's worth tens of millions."
Charles replied in a low voice.
"Phoenix Bracelet?"
A trace of helplessness flashed across Connor's eyes, and then he said softly, "Uncle Charles, you must have a misunderstanding. That garnet bracelet was actually given to me by Madison Phillips, but I didn't know that the bracelet was so valuable. I've always seen it as an ordinary bracelet…"
"Then, why did you give it to my daughter?"
Charles asked Connor.
"I forgot to prepare a birthday gift for Sabrina that day, so I gave the bracelet to her. However, her friends said that the bracelet I gave her was fake, so I didn't refute it because I didn't know the origin of the bracelet. If I really gave such an expensive bracelet to her on purpose, how could I not refute it when others said that the bracelet was fake?"
Connor said to Charles in a speechless tone.
"Is what you said true?"
Charles asked Connor in a low voice.
"Everything I'm saying now is true. I see Sabrina as my sister. I don't have any thoughts about her, not now and not in the future, so your worries are unnecessary!"
Connor said calmly.
"..."
Charles looked at Connor and hesitated for a couple of seconds. Then, he whispered to Connor, "If what you said is true, then I apologize. It's just a misunderstanding on my part!"
"It's okay. You're just concerned about your daughter. I can understand that!"
Connor said lightly.
"But I hope you can remember what I told you just now. If you really like my daughter, I can accept you pursuing her openly, but I can't accept you lying to her. Do you understand what I mean?"
Charles looked at Connor and continued.
"I understand!"
Connor nodded.
"Alright, as long as you don't hurt my daughter, I'll still be in charge of all the Salem region. But if you dare to hurt my daughter, I don't care who you are. Even if you're my boss, I'll make you pay!"
Charles said in a low voice.
Connor smiled helplessly when he heard Charles's words. Then, he said lightly, "I can promise you that I won't hurt your daughter, but I also hope that you won't tell Sabrina about me because I don't want too many people to know my identity."
"Alright!"
Charles immediately agreed.
"Also, I've just inherited the inheritance, so I don't know much about the company. So, you can just communicate with Thomas about the work situation in Salem..."
Connor looked at Charles and said softly.
"Mr. McDonald, there's something I want to remind you of…"
Charles looked at Connor and said in a low voice.
"What is it?"
Connor was stunned for a moment and asked in a puzzled tone.
"I know Thomas Morgan is your right-hand man now, but I think you should familiarize yourself with the company's business as soon as possible. After all, you're the boss of the company. There are some things that you have to do yourself. You can't trust anyone too much."
Charles looked at Connor and said earnestly.
"Are you worried that Thomas will harm me one day?"
Connor frowned and asked Charles.
"Although I had a conflict with Thomas Morgan, I know him very well. He won't do anything to let you down!"
Charles said calmly.
"Then, why are you telling me this?"
Connor asked in confusion.
"I'm just saying this to remind you not to trust anyone too much. It won't do you or our company any good!"
Charles paused for a moment before continuing, "You are still young and might not understand what I mean. However, you will understand what I mean sooner or later…"
Connor looked at Charles and said nothing.
Charles slowly stood up and said to Connor, "I'll be leaving now!"
"Alright!"
Connor nodded.
...

chapters.title: Chapter 698  Not Even Considered a Martial Artist
chapters.content:
Chapter 698  Not Even Considered a Martial Artist
After Charles left, Connor kept thinking about what Charles had said to him.
Actually, Connor felt that what Charles said was very reasonable.
Connor was now the Chairman of the Empire World Corporation, but sometimes he felt that he was too dependent on Thomas Morgan.
Thomas's status in the Empire World Corporation was definitely more important than Connor's.
Without Connor, the Empire World Corporation could still operate normally.
However, if the Empire World Corporation did not have Thomas, it would not be able to continue operating.
Kyle Hayes was the same.
The things that these two people controlled were all things that Connor could not control now.
Although Connor believed that these two people would not betray him, this was not a good thing for Connor.
If Thomas and Kyle changed their minds one day, they would definitely be able to replace Connor if they joined forces.
This situation was very dangerous for Connor.
Even if the probability of this happening was not high, it was definitely a potential danger.
What Charles said to Connor was not to sow discord between Connor and Thomas. He wanted Connor to realize the seriousness of this problem.
Now that Connor wanted to take back his power from Thomas, Thomas would definitely be very willing to cooperate with Connor.
However, if one day Thomas changed his mind and didn't want to give his power to Connor, then Connor would be in danger.
At this moment, Connor was like an emperor who had just ascended the throne. Because Connor was still young, many things needed to be handled by his ministers.
Thomas was a minister with military power.
Thomas might not have the intention to rebel now, but who could guarantee that Thomas would always be so loyal?
Charles's words were a reminder to Connor!
"Looks like it's time to get in touch with the company. If we delay this any further, the situation might not be within my control!"
Connor could not help but sigh softly. Then, he closed his eyes and began to rest.
...
The next day, at eight o'clock in the morning.
Connor left the town with Thomas, Kyle, Charles, and the others.
Quinn Langford could not be delayed because of her mother's illness.
Thomas had someone send Quinn and her mother to the Hudson Hospital of Porthampton overnight.
"Mr. McDonald, do you want to go back to the villa or go to school?"
After returning to Porthampton, Thomas asked Connor softly.
"Don't go to the villa or the school. Go straight to that old man's house!"
Connor thought for a moment and said lightly.
"The old man's house?"
When Thomas heard Connor's words, he could not help but be stunned for a moment. A trace of confusion flashed across his eyes.
"Go to Jorge Yarrell's house…"
Connor replied helplessly.
"Alright, I got it!"
Thomas quickly nodded.
After entering the courtyard, Connor immediately ran toward Jorge's room.
At this moment, Connor was still very excited. He wanted to share with Jorge what happened at the martial arts tournament last night.
Half an hour later, Thomas sent Connor to Jorge's old residence.
However, Kyle and Thomas didn't get off the car with Connor. Instead, they watched Connor walk into the courtyard alone.
After entering the courtyard, Connor immediately ran toward Jorge's room.
At this moment, Connor was still very excited. He wanted to share with Jorge what happened at the martial arts tournament last night.
As usual, Jorge was sitting on the armchair and basking in the sun. Jabba was obediently squatting beside Jorge.
When Jabba saw Connor, he bared his teeth at Connor, as if he was going to attack Connor at any moment.
"I'm not here to fight you today!"
Connor quickly waved his hand at Jabba, then quickly walked to Jorge's side and said with a smile, "Old man, are you sunbathing?"
"What made you so happy?"
Jorge didn't even open his eyes as he asked Connor casually.
"Old man, that Seven-Star Big Dipper Fist you taught me is really powerful. I participated in a martial arts tournament last night and defeated a person called Benjamin Wheeler with just three punches!"
Connor said happily.
"Benjamin Wheeler?"
When Jorge heard this name, he turned and looked at Connor indifferently.
"You know this person?"
Connor asked in confusion after seeing the expression on Jorge's face.
"I've met his master once…"
Jorge replied indifferently and continued, "Do you have to be so happy about defeating Benjamin Wheeler?"
"Do you know Benjamin Wheeler or not? He is very powerful. Even Cameron Larson and Keith Sanders are not his match. Also, Benjamin is one of the top ten experts in San Francisco. Of course, I'm happy to be able to defeat him!"
Connor said speechlessly.
"Keith Sanders, Cameron Larson, Benjamin Wheeler…"
When Jorge heard these names, he smiled disdainfully and said lightly, "The people you are talking about are not even considered martial artists. Even if you defeat them, there is nothing to show off about…"
"The three of them aren't even considered martial artists?"
When Connor heard this, he was in disbelief.
"The three of them are at most at the beginner level and can't be considered real martial artists. There are less than a hundred martial artists in the four provinces. I know all of them!"
Jorge continued.
"Is Carlos Lane a martial artist?"
Connor asked Jorge softly.
"Who is Carlos Lane?"
Jorge turned to look at Connor.
"Carlos is one of my bodyguards…"
Connor explained helplessly.
"I've never heard of this person you're talking about. If he's a martial artist from Davenport, I'll definitely know him!"
Jorge said softly.
"I see!"
Connor nodded lightly.
Connor was originally in a good mood when he came, but after hearing Jorge's words, his mood instantly turned bad.
Connor felt that Benjamin and the others were already very powerful, but what Connor didn't expect was that Benjamin wasn't even considered a martial artist.
"Old man, what kind of person can be considered a martial artist?"
Connor asked Jorge softly after a moment of hesitation.
"When you become my disciple, I'll tell you what kind of person can be considered a martial artist!"
Jorge said calmly.
When Connor heard this, he felt unusually helpless.
If he wanted to become Jorge's disciple, he had to defeat Jabba first. But with Connor's current level, it was impossible to defeat Jabba!

chapters.title: Chapter 699: Yelena Allen’s Current Situation
chapters.content:
Chapter 699: Yelena Allen’s Current Situation
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
After hearing Jorge’s words, Connor realized that Benjamin, Cameron, and the others weren’t even considered martial artists.
They were just ordinary people who were slightly more powerful. At most, they were at the level of martial artists who had just entered the threshold.
This also made Connor even more curious. What kind of person could be considered a true martial artist?
That night, Connor tried to use the Seven-Star Big Dipper Fist to deal with
Jabba.
However, Connor realized that Jabba and Benjamin were not on the same level at ah. Jabba’s speed was too fast, and Connor had no way of touching Jabba.
In the end, Connor was beaten up by Jabba again before returning to his room. After returning to his room, Connor lay on the bed alone. He took Jorge’s fist manual and began to study it seriously.
At this moment, Connor had only learned the first three moves of the Seven-Star Big Dipper Fist. Connor felt that if he could learn a few more moves, he would be able to use the Seven-Star Big Dipper Fist.
In the future, even if he encountered someone even more powerful, he would still have the strength to fight.
However, Connor found that his talent was indeed lacking. He could not understand a lot of the content on the fist manual.
“Forget it, I’ll ask the old man tomorrow!’’
Connor sighed helplessly, then threw the manual on the bed and took out his phone to play.
After turning on his phone, Connor opened Facebook. He realized that Yelena had not contacted him for a few days.
Under normal circumstances, Yelena would take the initiative to tell Connor about her situation after work every night.
However, Yelena did not take the initiative to contact Connor in the past few days, and he did not take the initiative to look for her because he was participating in the martial arts tournament.
Therefore, after Connor hesitated for a moment, he opened Yelena’s Facebook
and sent a message over.
“What are you doing?”
Connor waited for about five minutes after sending message, but Yelena did
not reply.
Connor was a little worried and called Yelena’s number.
Ring! Ring!
The phone rang for a long time before Yelena picked up.
“Hello?”
Yelena’s voice came from the other end of the phone, but Connor could hear that she sounded a little tired.
“What are you doing?”
Connor asked with a smile.
“I was just memorizing my lines and fell asleep while doing that…”
Yelena said indifferently.
When Connor heard Yelena’s voice, he couldn’t help but whisper, “Yelena, did something happen? Why do you sound like that?”
“Nothing happened. I’m just tired from memorizing my lines. I still have to
film later…”
Yelena quickly pretended to fine and said with a smile.
“Why are you still filming so late at night?”
After Connor heard Yelena’s words, a trace of doubt flashed across his eyes. ■■We’re filming a night scene tonight. Of course, we have to shoot it at night…” Yelena said gently.
“Oh, oh!”
Connor nodded lightly.
“By the way, Hubby, 1 should be done filming this movie in two weeks. By then,
I can go back to Porthampton. Did you miss me?”
Yelena was very happy when she said this.
“Of course, I miss you. After you finish filming this movie, I’ll help you find a few directors to make you famous…”
Connor said with a smile.
“Sigh, don’t joke with me here. What director do you know? You being able to take care of yourself is good enough…”
Yelena pouted and said.
“Haha!”
When Connor heard Yelena’s words, he smiled helplessly.
At this moment, Yelena still did not know Connor’s true identity, so she believed that he was joking.
“Hubby, I’m going to do my makeup now. Let’s talk later!”
Yelena suddenly said.
“Alright!”
When Connor heard Yelena’s words, he didn’t say anything else and hung up
the phone.
Although Connor felt that Yelena sounded a little off at the beginning, she sounded happier after that, so he didn’t think too much about it.
After hanging up the phone, he closed his eyes and went to rest.
On the other side, in Horizon.
After Yelena hung up the phone, she quickly tidied up her clothes and went to the makeup room of the production team.
“Yelena, you’re here. Hurry up and put on your makeup. It’s your turn to go on stage soon!”
When the makeup artist saw Yelena, she smiled and said.
“Okay, Wanda!”
Yelena quickly agreed, then walked to the mirror and sat down.
The makeup artist, Wanda, began to help Yelena with her makeup.
“Yelena, it’s not that I’m praising you, but your face is very exquisite, and you have an amazing figure. You’re much better than Florina Yacca. I don’t know what the director is thinking. He actually let her play the female lead while you play the second female lead. Sigh…”
Wanda said softly as she helped Yelena with her makeup.
When Yelena heard Wanda’s words, she couldn’t help but turn to look at Wanda. Then, she said lightly, “So what if I’m ten thousand times prettier than her? Some things are not as simple as you think. Before I entered the entertainment industry, I didn’t expect these things to be so complicated…” -What’s so complicated about this! Wasn’t it because Florina found a rich and powerful boyfriend? Actually, with your figure and appearance, isn’t it very easy for you to find a boyfriend who is richer and more powerful than her?” Wanda said with a pout.
When Yelena heard this, she smiled helplessly but did not say anything.
“Hello, Florina!”
“Florina, you’re so beautiful today!”
“Florina, why are you here?”
At this moment, there was a sudden commotion at the entrance of the dressing room.
The staff in the dressing room stood up and looked at the door.
Wanda and Yelena subconsciously looked at the door and saw a beautiful woman walking into the dressing room surrounded by a group of people.
The beautiful woman had a head full of curly golden hair and was wearing a black skirt. She was tall and sexy, and her beautiful legs were exposed to the air. She was wearing a pair of high heels, and her breasts were so full that they were about to burst through her shirt. Her pretty face had light makeup on, but even so, she was still very sexy and beautiful.
And this beauty was the female celebrity Florina Yacca that Wanda had just told Yelena about.
Florina debuted two years earlier than Yelena. In the past year, she had taken on a lot of film jobs, all of which were female leads.
Therefore, Florina had only debuted for two years and had become one of the most popular female celebrities in Oprana.
When Yelena saw Florina, she could not help but frown. She had rather complicated feelings..

chapters.title: Chapter 700: Florina Yacca’s Provocation
chapters.content:
Chapter 700: Florina Yacca’s Provocation
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation | Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Yelena had never gotten along with Florina Yacca, and there had been some conflicts between them.
Because the live broadcast platform had promised Yelena that she would play the female lead, but when she came to see the production team, she found that her role had been tampered with.
Moreover, she was informed by the director that she could not play the female lead and could only play the second female lead.
When Yelena heard the news, she was naturally very angry.
So, she went to the director to argue, but the director told her bluntly that Florina had already taken a fancy to the female lead.
Florina’s boyfriend had a very powerful background and was not someone Yelena could afford to provoke.
Therefore, Yelena could only act as the second female lead. Otherwise, she could return to Porthampton, and they would look for Yelena again when there were any female lead roles in the future.
However, Yelena cherished this opportunity very much. She knew that she could not afford to offend someone like Florina, so she could only agree helplessly in the end.
This was also the reason why Yelena was so listless when she was talking to Connor on the phone.
Yelena knew that Connor was just a poor student. He had no status or background. Even if she told him about these things, it would be useless. She could only silently endure these things.
However, Yelena was too naive. She thought that as long as she took a step back and gave the role of the first female lead to Florina, she would be able to play the second female lead in peace.
Moreover, Yelena had read the script before. The second female lead had a lot of scenes. As long as she played this role well, she might become popular in the future.
However, what Yelena did not expect was that Florina was very narrow-minded. People in the production team had been talking about why Yelena could not play the female lead when she was better looking and had a better figure than Florina.
When Florina heard these rumors, she was very angry. She felt that Yelena was behind it.
Therefore, Florina used her boyfriend’s relationship to seek out the producer and director. Not only did they delete a large part of Yelena’s scenes, but they also asked the costume team to prepare the ugliest clothes for Yelena. As a result, Yelena’s scenes were cut down by a lot, and many of her lines were deleted.
Therefore, even though Yelena was the second female lead, she did not have as many scenes as the third female lead.
Yelena had been in the production team for two months. Most of the time, she had been watching others film and had not filmed many scenes at all.
With Yelena’s personality, she would have gone to Florina for an explanation.
However, Yelena knew very well that Florina was not someone she could afford to provoke. If she really offended Florina, she might not even be able to act as the second female lead. Therefore, in the end, Yelena could only choose to swallow her anger and silently endure these things.
Before she joined the cast, Yelena was not aware of what the entertainment industry was truly like.
However, after coming into contact with these things, Yelena realized how complicated the entertainment industry was.
Tonight’s scene was Yelena’s highlight. There were many lines, so this was a good opportunity for her to show off.
Therefore, Yelena had specially prepared for an entire day just for this scene.
“Who said you could sit here?”
At this moment, Florina walked to Yelena’s side arrogantly and shouted at Yelena.
When the makeup artist, Wanda, heard Florina’s words, she could not help but be stunned for a moment. Then, she hurriedly said, “Miss Yacca, I asked Yelena to sit here because later…”
“Was I talking to you?”
Florina turned around and glared at Wanda.
When Wanda saw the expression on Florina’s face, a hint of helplessness flashed across her eyes.
She took a step back helplessly, not daring to speak.
“Are you deaf? Didn’t you hear me talking to you?”
Florina asked Yelena coldly.
Yelena frowned, then slowly stood up and whispered, “I’m sorry, I didn’t know this was your seat!”
“Get lost!”
Florina shouted.
After hearing Florina’s words, everyone turned to look at the two of them.
However, when they saw that Yelena was the one being scolded, they went back to what they were doing. This was because these people knew that Yelena and Florina did not have a good relationship. It was not the first time that Florina was deliberately causing trouble for Yelena.
The staff in the production team was already used to such situations.
Yelena stood up helplessly and prepared to leave.
“You must be blind. Don’t you know your own identity? How dare you sit on my seat? Shameless…”
Florina cursed viciously.
When Yelena heard Florina’s words, a trace of anger flashed across her eyes.
However, she knew that she could not afford to offend Florina. After taking a deep breath, Yelena gritted her teeth and walked away.
“Stop right there!”
But at this moment, Florina shouted again.
Yelena was stunned for a moment after hearing Florina’s words. Then, she asked Florina coldly, “Is there something else?”
“Go out and get me a glass of water!”
Florina shouted expressionlessly.
“Don’t you have an assistant?”
Yelena gritted her teeth and replied in a low voice.
“What’s wrong? I’m asking you to go out and get me a glass of water. Didn’t you hear me?”
Florina shouted fiercely.
Yelena looked at Florina and took a deep breath. Then, she said in a low voice, “Alright, I’ll get you some water!”
After saying this, Yelena turned around and walked toward the water dispenser.
A moment later, Yelena returned to Florina’s side with a glass of water and whispered to Florina, “Your water!”
Florina took the cup of water in disdain and took a sip. She then spat it on Yelena and turned to scold her, “Is there something wrong with your brain? This glass of water is cold. Don’t you know that I don’t drink cold water?”
“Why you…”
Yelena glared at Florina with her big, watery eyes. She was extremely angry.
“What are you talking about? Hurry up and get me a cup of hot water!”
Florina shouted at Yelena.
Yelena took a deep breath and walked to the water dispenser helplessly. Then, she poured Florina another cup of hot water.
Florina took the cup from Yelena’s hand and took a sip. Then, she threw the cup on the ground and shouted angrily, “Are you f*cking doing this on purpose? This cup of water is so hot. Do you want to burn me to death…”
Yelena was stunned when she heard Florina’s words.
Florina stood up and was about to attack Yelena.
“Miss Yacca, don’t be angry. I’ll get you a glass of water…”
When Wanda saw that something was wrong, she rushed to Yelena and stopped Florina. Then, she picked up another paper cup and poured Florina a glass of warm water.
Yelena stood rooted to the ground with a dull expression. She looked extremely aggrieved.
The surrounding people looked at Yelena as if they were watching a joke..

chapters.title: Chapter 701: The Scene Has Been Removed
chapters.content:
Chapter 701: The Scene Has Been Removed
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation | Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
After pouring Florina some water, Wanda dragged Yelena to the side and wanted to continue doing Yelena’s makeup.
“Wanda, come here. Help me with my makeup today!”
However, at this moment, Florina shouted once more.
“Miss Yacca, don’t joke with me. I’m not qualified to do your makeup? Don’t you have a professional makeup artist?”
Wanda looked at Florina and said helplessly.
“I want you to do my makeup for me today. Why? You don’t want to?”
Florina turned to look at Wanda and asked softly.
“It’s not that I don’t want to do it. I’m just worried that if you don’t look good, it will make you upset…”
Wanda said softly.
“It’s okay. Even if your makeup doesn’t look good, I won’t blame you. Come over here!”
Florina said calmly.
After hesitating for a moment, Wanda walked to Florina and began to put on Florina’s makeup.
Yelena knew that Wanda would take at most ten minutes to put on makeup. There was still more than half an hour before she appeared on camera, so she felt that there was still time. She did not want to have any conflict with people like Florina, so she did not say much and sat quietly in the corner.
Ten minutes later, Wanda was done with Florina’s makeup and was about to do Yelena’s makeup.
“What is this? It looks terrible! Remove my makeup and do it again. This is not what I want!”
But at that moment, Florina suddenly shouted.
Wanda was shocked when she heard Florina’s words. She hurriedly said, “Miss Yacca, I’ve only put on half of Yelena’s makeup. Why don’t I finish hers first? After all, Yelena’s about to film her scene. I’m worried that it will affect her filming…”
“No, you have to finish my makeup before you can leave. Do you want me to wait for you here? Who even is she? Why should I wait for hers to be done?”
Florina said rudely.
“But…”
Wanda still wanted to say something.
“There are no buts. I’m asking you to do my makeup now. Didn’t you hear me?”
Florina shouted with her big, watery eyes.
“Alright…”
Wanda agreed helplessly, then looked at Yelena apologetically and continued to help Florina with her makeup.
Yelena could no longer sit still because there were only less than ten minutes left before she started filming.
If Yelena waited until Wanda finished Florina’s makeup before doing her own makeup, it would definitely be too late.
Therefore, after hesitating for a moment, Yelena took a step forward and said to Florina helplessly, “Miss Yacca, if you want Wanda to do your makeup for you, can you ask your makeup artist to do mine for me?”
“Why do you need to put on makeup?”
Florina turned to look at Yelena and asked with a pout.
When Yelena heard Florina’s words, she was stunned for a moment. Then, she said in a low voice, “I’m about to film my scene. I’m worried that it will affect the filming…”
“Oh, right! Now that you mention it, I almost forgot to tell you. I removed your scene. I didn’t think there’s a need for that scene, so you don’t have to be anxious. Who knows when you will be filming your scenes…”
Florina said calmly.
When Yelena heard Florina’s words, she was stunned. She was in utter disbelief.
She asked Florina in disbelief, “What did you say?”
“I said that I’ve already removed your scene. Are you dumb or deaf?”
Florina said coldly.
“What right do you have to remove my scenes? I’m going to look for the director!”
Yelena finally couldn’t take it anymore. She glared at Florina and shouted.
“What’s the use of looking for the director? The director listens to me. If you’re not convinced, you can go to the producer. If you can convince the producer, then I don’t have any objections!”
Florina pouted.
Yelena was so angry that she didn’t know what to say.
After all, she had been preparing for this scene for three days, but she did not expect it to be canceled because of Florina1 .
Yelena’s eyes instantly turned red. She sobbed as she shouted at Florina, “Florina, why are you doing this to me? Why are you always targeting me? How have I offended you?
“It’s fine if you bully me. If you want me to get water for you, I’ll get water for you. If you want me to get lost, I’ll get lost. But now, you’re even going to the extent of removing my remaining scenes? What exactly do you want?”
“What do I want?”
Florina could not help but sneer when she heard Yelena’s words. Then, she said indifferently, “Actually, I don’t want anything. I just don’t like you. I just want to mess with you.”
“What…”
When Yelena heard Florina’s words, tears fell instantly. She gritted her teeth and walked out of the dressing room.
After leaving the dressing room, Yelena found a place with no one around and started crying.
At this moment Yelena only had one thought in her heart, and that was to call Connor and tell him about what she was going through.
But in the end, Yelena still endured this impulse because she knew that even if
she told Connor about what was happening, it would be useless!
If she couldn’t deal with someone like Florina, Connor definitely couldn’t do anything either. At that time, it would only make Connor anxious.
“Yelena, why are you here?”
At this moment, a middle-aged man walked to Yelena and asked her softly.
When Yelena heard the middle-aged man’s words, she suddenly looked up at him and quickly wiped the tears on her face. She said softly, “Mr. Coffin, you’re here?”
The middle-aged man who appeared in front of Yelena was none other than the executive director of the show.
“Um, I’m here to inform you that your scene tonight has been removed…”
Mr. Coffin said calmly.
“I already know that…”
Yelena replied helplessly.
When Mr. Coffin heard what Yelena said, he looked a little helpless. He asked her softly, “Did Florina tell you?”
“Yes!”
Yelena nodded gently.
“Then, are you crying because of this?”
Mr. Coffin continued to ask.
Not really. I just don’t understand how I’ve offended Florina. Why does she always make things difficult for me?”
Yelena frowned and asked Mr. Coffin.
When Mr. Coffin heard Yelena’s words, he sighed helplessly.
Then, he said calmly, “Yelena, you might not know this, but you’re not the only one who’s troubled by Florina because of her boyfriend’s background. I’ve been bullied by her too. For example, as long as the role is a good one, she would get it for her friends.. I don’t dare to offend Florina, so I can only do what she wants…”

chapters.title: Chapter 702: Cruise Party
chapters.content:
Chapter 702: Cruise Party
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
“I didn’t expect you to be in such a difficult position, Mr. Coffin!
Yelena looked up at Mr. Coffin and said softly.
“Sigh, I’m fine with it. I’ve been in the entertainment industry for so many
years, and I’ve seen all kinds of actresses!”
Mr. Coffin sighed and continued, “But in your case, it’s such a shame…
“A shame? What do you mean?”
Yelena asked in confusion.
“Yelena, with your looks and temperament, your future is definitely limitless. Moreover, you’re also an internet celebrity. You already have a fan base. If you’re lucky, it’s not impossible for you to become a big star. However, you’re missing an important condition to become a big star!”
Mr. Coffin said slowly.
“What condition?”
Yelena looked at Mr. Coffin and asked excitedly.
“You lack a reliable background. If you have a reliable background, you will definitely be able to get more resources, and you won’t have to be bullied by
Florina…”
Mr. Coffin whispered to Yelena.
Yelena knew very well what Mr. Coffin meant.
However, she smiled helplessly and did not say anything.
