“Yelena, actually, I’ve told you many times that the producer of our show is interested in you. He has always wanted to invite you out for a meal. If you have the time, I can help you arrange it…”
Mr. Coffin continued after seeing that Yelena was silent.
“Mr. Coffin, I’ve told you many times that I have a boyfriend. I won’t go out for dinner with another guy!”
Yelena shook her head and refused.
“Yelena, why are you so stubborn? As long as you spend a night with the producer, you’ll get whatever you want. You will have an easy time in the future. This producer has a lot of resources in his hands. As long as you can build a relationship with him, you’ll be famous. Do you know how many female celebrities want to contact this producer but don’t have the opportunity to do
so?”
Mr. Coffin advised helplessly.
“I won’t do anything to let my boyfriend down…”
Yelena shook her head gently.
“Who is your boyfriend?”
Mr. Coffin asked with a frown.
“He’s just an ordinary person…”
Yelena smiled faintly.
“Is it worth it sacrificing your future for this person? You’re an actress now. What can an ordinary person bring you? Can he help you in any way? Do you know what a great opportunity you have in front of you?”
Mr. Coffin said helplessly.
“Although my boyfriend is an ordinary person and he can’t help me much, I love him very much. I won’t do anything to let him down. You don’t have to
persuade me…”
Yelena said lightly.
“So you plan to continue on like this?”
Mr. Coffin asked with a frown.
“Even if I don’t have anything to film, I can go back and do something else with my boyfriend, but I won’t sell my body for fame and fortune!”
Yelena looked at Mr. Coffin and said coldly. Then, she turned around and walked away.
Mr. Coffin looked at Yelena’s back with a helpless expression.
He could not help but sigh softly. “Yelena, oh Yelena, you will definitely regret it in the future. The entertainment industry is not as simple as you think!”
In a classroom at the Porthampton University.
After experiencing the martial arts tournament, Connor knew that Jorge
Yarrell was legit.
Therefore, Connor would go to Jorge’s house to practice martial arts as soon as school was over. He would only rest after midnight.
During this period of time, Connor’s strength had increased tremendously, and his Seven-Star Big Dipper Fist had reached the fifth move.
Since Connor had been practicing martial arts at Jorge’s house after school, he spent most of his time in school sleeping.
Of course, Rachel Wallace’s class was an exception. Because Connor couldn’t afford to offend her.
“Connor, wake up. The next class is Miss Wallace’s class…”
Spencer reached out and gently pushed Connor, reminding him in a low voice. Connor opened his eyes in a daze and yawned heavily. He got up and was about to go wash his face in the toilet to wake himself up.
“Connor, wait!”
Spencer reached out to stop Connor.
“What’s wrong?”
Connor turned to look at Spencer and asked with a puzzled expression.
“Do you have anything on the day after tomorrow?”
Spencer asked Connor with a smile.
“The day after tomorrow?”
When Connor heard what Spencer said, he could not help but be stunned for a moment. Then, he asked softly, “Is there something you need?”
“Well, I’ve fallen in love with a girl, and I bought a few tickets for a cruise party from my friend. It just so happens that our class doesn’t have class that day. Why don’t we go on a cruise together?”
Spencer smiled and said,
“Hmm… You guys should go on ahead without me…”
Connor hesitated for a moment before rejecting him.
Right now, Connor was not very interested in this kind of thmg. All he could think about was martial arts.
-Don’t do this to me. I bought a total of six tickets. It’s you, me, Dominic, Cindy, and the girl I like. I’ve already arranged everything. I spent two thousand dollars to buy each ticket. If you don’t go, it’ll be a waste…”
Spencer exclaimed.
“Two thousand for a ticket and you bought six tickets. Isn’t that more than
10,000 dollars? Are you crazy?”
Connor asked the Spencer helplessly.
“There will be many celebrities attending this party, and there will be a lot of delicious food. Two thousand is considered cheap. If you don’t know anyone, you can’t even buy it for this amount!” Spencer looked at Connor and explained.
“Where did you get so much money?”
Connor asked.
“It’s my savings…”
Spencer grinned.
“You said that there are six people. Who do you plan to give the last ticket to?
Connor hesitated for a moment before asking Spencer.
“Dominic and I already have beautiful women accompanying us. I was afraid that you would be lonely, so I specially asked a beautiful woman to join us and accompany you.”
Spencer smiled and said,
Connor looked at Spencer helplessly, but he knew that Spencer had good intentions.
Therefore, after hesitating for a moment, he nodded and said, “Alright then, I’ll go with you the day after tomorrow!”
“Awesome!”
Spencer replied happily seeing that Connor had agreed..

chapters.title: Chapter 703: Alluring Beauty
chapters.content:
Chapter 703: Alluring Beauty
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Two days later.
Connor took a taxi and arrived at the school gate on time.
Meanwhile, Dominic Turner, Spencer and the other two were already waiting at the school gate. Today was the day they had agreed to attend the cruise party.
Actually, Connor was not very interested in this cruise party, but no matter what, it was all out of Spencer’s good intentions.
Besides, the tickets were not cheap. Spencer had saved up for a long time to buy them.
Connor did not want to disappoint Spencer, so he agreed.
Connor and the other two waited at the school gate for a while before Cindy Stone gracefully walked out of the nearby supermarket.
Today, Cindy was dressed fashionably. She was carrying the latest Gucci bag, giving off the impression of a city beauty.
Moreover, the clothes that Cindy was wearing now added up to tens of thousands of dollars. Scarlett Moore had bought them for Cindy.
Scarlett had drugged Connor before, but Cindy mistakenly thought that Connor was the one who had drugged Scarlett.
Therefore, Cindy had been wanting to go to the police after the incident. Scarlett was afraid that Cindy would blow things up, so she specially bought this set of clothes and a branded bag for Cindy. She even took the initiative to admit that it was not Connor who drugged her, but she herself who drugged Connor.
After Cindy accepted Scarlett’s gift, she promised to help Scarlett keep this secret. She also promised that she would never tell anyone about this matter in the future.
Of course, she would not take the initiative to find trouble with Connor.
This was also the reason why Cindy did not cause trouble for Connor after Scarlett drugged him.
Otherwise, with Cindy’s fiery personality, she would have definitely made a scene.
However, Cindy could not understand why Scarlett would drug Connor. Scarlett’s explanation was that she had indeed fallen in love with Connor! However, Cindy couldn’t understand why her cousin would fall in love with someone like Connor.
Scarlett naturally did not tell Cindy Connor’s real identity!
Seeing Connor again, Cindy she didn’t take the initiative to tell him about the drug incident.
However, she still looked at Connor with disgust because she felt that he must have used some kind of trick to charm her cousin into that state.
“Hey, Cindy.”
Dominic hurriedly ran to Cindy and called out with a smile.
When Cindy heard Dominic calling out to her, she turned and looked at him indifferently. She shouted impatiently, “Why are you guys so slow? I’ve already walked one whole round in the mall while waiting for you guys.”
“Cindy, we didn’t expect you to arrive so early…”
Dominic explained awkwardly.
“Alright, whatever! Let’s just go!”
Cindy rolled her eyes at Dominic, then turned around to leave.
If Cindy hadn’t heard that Dominic was going to take her to a very high-end cruise party, she wouldn’t have come today.
Cindy’s thoughts were very simple. Those who could attend this cruise party must be rich people.
If she was lucky enough to meet a rich guy at the party, she would not have to worry about money for the rest of her life.
To put it bluntly, Cindy had never wanted to be with Dominic.
To her, Dominic was just a bootlicker.
Spencer was filled with disgust when he saw how Cindy was treating Dominic. Spencer had told Dominic many times, but Dominic refused to listen to him. Spencer was no longer bothered.
“Cindy, there are still people who haven’t arrived yet. Let’s wait here for a while!”
Dominic whispered to Cindy.
“There are more people going? This is such a waste of time.”
Cindy pouted and shouted impatiently.
“If you want to wait, then shut up. If you don’t want to wait, then you can leave now!”
Spencer shouted expressionlessly.
When Cindy heard what Spencer said, she glared at him and shouted, “What does my conversation with Dominic have to do with you?”
“I bought the tickets for the cruise. Do I not have a say in this?”
Spencer said expressionlessly.
When Cindy heard what Spencer said, she froze on the spot.
“You bought the tickets for the cruise?” she asked softly.
“That’s right. I wanted to give your ticket to my friend, but Dominic said that he wanted to bring you along, so I agreed. My friend hasn’t arrived yet. If you have something urgent to do, you can leave now!”
Spencer said calmly.
When Cindy heard what he said, she froze on the spot with an awkward expression on her face.
She knew in her heart that Dominic would spoil her, but Spencer might not.
Therefore, even though she was very angry, she did not dare to say anything.
She could only stand where she was and wait quietly.
Connor turned and looked at Spencer. He smiled helplessly and did not say anything.
A few minutes later, a taxi stopped at the entrance of the Porthampton University.
The car door opened and two well-dressed girls got out.
One of the girls was wearing a strapless dress and a pair of black-rimmed glasses. She gave off a very gentle and elegant feeling. Her figure and looks could definitely be considered top-notch.
“Sarina, you’re here!”
Spencer called out excitedly when he saw the gentle beauty.
“Sorry, I’m late…”
The girl said apologetically.
Spencer quickly ran to the girl and introduced Connor and Dominic to her,
“Connor, Dominic, this is my girlfriend, Sarina Watts!”
“Hello, my name is Connor McDonald!”
Connor smiled and greeted Sarina.
“Hello, my name is Dominic Turner!”
Dominic also hurriedly greeted her.
“Hello, handsome guys!”
Sarina replied happily.
Cindy, on the other hand, stood at the side with a disdainful expression on her face. It seemed that she had no intention of talking to Sarina.
Spencer naturally didn’t introduce Cindy to Sarina.
At this moment, another girl walked out from behind Sarina.
The girl looked very sexy and beautiful.
She was wearing a short black skirt that was wrapped around her hips. Her chest was full and outlined a charming curve. Her exquisite and flirtatious face was lightly made up, and her sexy little mouth was covered with a charming lip line. The short skirt was tightly wrapped around her seductive buttocks, and her pair of slender and fair legs were exposed to the air. Her exquisite face coupled with her charming figure made her look exceptionally alluring.
Connor, Dominic, Spencer the others were all stunned when they saw this beauty..

chapters.title: Chapter 704 - 704- Two Unexpected Encounters
chapters.content:
Chapter 704- Two Unexpected Encounters
Translator EndlessFantasy Translation Editor EndlessFantasy Translation
“Sarina, who is this beauty?”
Spencer asked Sarina when he saw the beauty.
“Didn’t you ask me to bring a girl friend? Here she is!”
Sarina replied with a smile. She then walked to the beauty and introduced her to Spencer, “This beauty is my best friend, Yuliana Schneider!”
After hearing Sarina’s words, Spencer, Dominic and the other two turned to look at Connor.
Spencer had asked Sarina to bring a girl friend because he wanted to introduce her to Connor.
After all Spencer was with Sarina, and Dominic had Cindy. Only Connor was alone.
Spencer was worried that Connor would be bored alone, so he specifically told Sarina to bring a girl friend with her.
However, Dominic and Spencer didn’t expect the girl to be so beautiful.
“Hello!”
Yuliana greeted everyone.
“Hello, beautiful…”
Dominic grinned and continued, “My name is Dominic Turner, and this is Connor McDonald!”
When Yuliana heard Dominic’s words, she nodded lightly. Then, she looked at Connor, Dominic, and the others from head to toe. She frowned and said, “Are the three of you planning to wear this to the party?”
“What’s wrong with our clothes?”
Spencer was stunned as he looked at Yuliana, and he looked unhappy.
Although Yuliana was indeed very beautiful, Spencer didn’t expect her to be so materialistic. She was almost on par with Cindy.
She had just met them, yet she was already looking down on them.
Spencer instantly felt that Yuliana was not a good person.
“The three of them normally dress like losers. You’ll get used to it!”
Cindy seemed to have found her own kind, and she quickly pursed her lips and interjected.
“That’s not what I meant…”
Yuliana shook her head and said in a low voice, “The cruise party has a dress code for the guests. You guys seem to be dressed rather casually. It’ll be troublesome if you can’t get in…”
“Yuliana often attends such parties. What she said makes sense!”
Sarina hurriedly explained.
When Spencer heard Yuliana’s words, he quickly smacked himself on the head and said awkwardly, “My friend did tell me that I have to wear formal clothes to attend the party, but I forgot about it…”
“We have to wear formal attire to attend the party?”
Dominic said helplessly.
“This party is very high-end, so everyone has to wear formal clothes. Luckily, Yuliana reminded us. Otherwise, we might not have been able to enter…”
Spencer said apologetically after knowing that he had misunderstood Yuliana.
“Then, what should we do now?”
Sarina said with a frown.
The cruise party will only start at seven o’clock in the evening. It’s only two o’clock now. Why don’t we go buy a set of clothes first and then go to the party after that?”
Dominic looked at his phone and suggested softly.
“Yeah. After all, we don’t have formal attire!”
Spencer hurriedly replied.
“Connor, what do you think?”
Dominic turned and asked Connor.
“I’m fine with anything. You guys can do whatever you want…”
Connor said indifferently.
Actually, Dominic asked Connor because he was worried that Connor did not have the money to buy clothes.
After all, a suit of good quality would cost a few thousand dollars.
Although this was a lot of money, for Dominic and Spencer, who came from a good family, they could still afford it. He was just worried that Connor did not have money.
When Dominic heard what Connor said, he looked at Connor indifferently and did not say anything.
A few minutes later, Dominic, Connor, and the others hailed a taxi and rushed to the most famous shopping mall in Porthampton.
In Horizon.
Most of Yelena Allen’s scenes had been removed by Florina Yacca.
Therefore, Yelena had to find some other stuff to do there. When she had nothing to do, she would go and watch the senior actors act and learn from them.
However, Yelena knew very well that no matter how much she learned, it would be useless.
In the entertainment industry, if you didn’t have the resources and background, it would be impossible for you to stand firmly.
‘Alright, let’s end today’s filming here. Everyone, go to Miss Yacca’s birthday party tonight. Miss Yacca’s boyfriend has specially organized a cruise party for Miss Yacca’s birthday party and has invited all the actors in our production team to go…”
Mr. Coffin raised the loudspeaker in his hand and shouted to the production team with a smile.
When the actors in the production team heard Mr. Coffin’s words, they began to cheer one after another. They were very excited.
This was because these actors all knew that not everyone could attend such a posh gala. They could go because of Florina.
Yelena sighed softly, then packed her things and were ready to leave the set.
Yelena knew what her relationship with Florina was like, so Florina would definitely not invite her to her birthday party. If she stayed here, she would be laughed at by others, so she might as well leave as soon as possible.
Yelena took out her phone and looked at the time. She realized that it was only two o’clock in the afternoon. If she went back to Porthampton now, she would probably be back at eight o’clock in the evening.
Therefore, Yelena hesitated for a moment and was about to return to
Porthampton to find Connor. After all, she had not seen Connor for a long time.
“Mr. Coffin…”
Yelena walked to Mr. Coffin and called out softly.
“Yelena, what’s wrong?”
Mr. Coffin asked Yelena with a smile.
“I want to take half a day off. I want to go home…”
Yelena whispered.
“Take half a day off?”
Mr. Coffin was stunned for a moment, then asked in a very puzzled tone,
“Yelena, aren’t you going to Miss Yacca’s birthday party?”
“Florina didn’t invite me, did she?”
Yelena whispered.
“I know about the conflict between you and Miss Yacca, but Miss Yacca is not such a petty person. She invited everyone from our production team this time, including you. You should come with us…”
Mr. Coffin said casually.
“But…”
Yelena opened her mouth to speak.
There’s no buts. Let me tell you, many of the people attending the gala this time are the big shots of the entertainment industry. It won’t do you any harm to get to know these people. After all, you still have to survive in the entertainment industry in the future, right?
“And don’t you want to go back to Porthampton? This cruise party will also be held in Porthampton. After attending the party, I can give you a day off so that you can go home and have a good rest.”
Mr. Coffin said earnestly.
When Yelena heard Mr. Coffin’s words, a hint of hesitation flashed across her
eyes.

chapters.title: Chapter 705:1 Know You are Rich
chapters.content:
Chapter 705:1 Know You are Rich
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation | Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Yelena planned to take this opportunity to go back to Porthampton to spend time with Connor.
However, when she heard the director’s words, she began to hesitate.
The reason was very simple. Although Yelena could not accept the unspoken rules, she felt that she just lacked an opportunity.
If she attended the cruise party and a director took a liking to her, she might get a chance.
As for meeting Connor, the director had also said that as long as she attended this gala, he could give Yelena a day off. Then, she could also go and spend time with Connor.
However, there might not be a second chance to attend the gala.
Therefore, after hesitating for a moment, Yelena nodded at the director and said softly, “Alright, Mr. Coffin, I’ll go to this party with you!”
“Alright!”
Seeing that Yelena had agreed, Mr. Coffin smiled happily. Then, he sized up Yelena’s graceful figure and said softly, “Go and change into a nicer set of clothes now. Make sure you make yourself look more alluring. Then, get the makeup artist to put on some makeup for you. Make good use of this opportunity!”
“Alright, Mr. Coffin!”
Yelena nodded helplessly and turned to leave.
On the other side, Connor, Dominic, Spencer and the others didn’t have formal attire for the party, so they specially went to Mid Valley Mall. It was the most famous mall in Porthampton.
Mid Valley Mall was the most prosperous mall in Porthampton. There were many international brands in it.
Young people in Porthampton liked to shop here. Even though it was not a working day, the mall was still crowded.
After Connor and the others arrived at the mall, Dominic and Spencer decided to split up, perhaps to save time or to create a chance for Connor and Yuliana to be alone.
Spencer first brought Sarina into a specialty store, and Cindy and Dominic left as well.
In the end, only Connor and Yuliana were left.
Yuliana turned to look at Connor and said softly, “I’ll bring you to buy clothes…”
“Alright!”
Connor didn’t refuse and nodded.
Seeing that Connor had agreed, Yuliana started walking in her high heels. Connor followed behind her.
A few minutes later, Yuliana stopped in front of a Versace store.
“The clothes here should be pretty good…”
Yuliana turned and said to Connor.
When Connor heard Yuliana’s words, he couldn’t help but be stunned for a moment. Then, he frowned and said, “The clothes here are indeed good, but they are very expensive, right?”
Yuliana looked at Connor helplessly and said with a cheeky expression, “Alright, stop pretending in front of me. I know you don’t lack money…” “How do you know I don’t lack money?”
When Connor heard Yuliana’s words, he looked a little surprised.
He couldn’t help but think to himself, ‘Does Yuliana know me?’
“Where did you get those shoes you’re wearing now?”
Yuliana asked Connor softly.
Connor couldn’t help but be stunned when he heard Yuliana’s words. Then, he frowned and said, “This pair of shoes was given to me by someone…”
Connor was telling the truth. Chloe Lawson had indeed bought this pair of shoes for Connor.
“Then, do you know how much these shoes cost?”
Yuliana continued to ask.
“I don’t.”
Connor shook his head without thinking.
“Your shoes are limited edition from Hermes. They cost more than 80,000 dollars a pair, and you can’t buy them with money. Also, your pants, although they look very ordinary, they’re also an international brand. They’re not cheap either. They cost at least 20,000 dollars…”
Yuliana paused for a moment before continuing, “Since you can afford such expensive shoes and pants, it means that you must be very rich!”
Connor was shocked when he heard Yuliana’s words.
He didn’t expect that Chloe would buy him such expensive clothes.
“How do you know that my clothes are all from international brands?”
Connor hesitated for a moment before asking Yuliana softly.
“Ordinary people might not know what you’re wearing, but I know very well. Because my family is in the clothing business, I’m very familiar with these brands!”
Yuliana looked at Connor and said softly.
After hesitating for a moment, Connor continued, “Then have you ever considered that all my clothes might be fake? I bought them online…”
“Impossible. With my many years of experience, I won’t make a mistake like that.
“Moreover, the clothes you’re wearing are all from smaller brands. There’s no need for high-quality imitations at all. If people want high-quality imitations, they’ll definitely be high-quality imitations of popular brands. If you want to pretend to be a rich guy, you will buy some brands that ordinary people can recognize. There’s no need for you to buy these clothes at all…”
Yuliana denied that possibility without thinking.
When Connor heard Yuliana’s words, he was stunned.
He could feel that Yuliana was very smart, smarter than any other woman he knew.
“Alright, I know you’re not the kind of rich guy who likes to be in the limelight. I won’t expose you in front of your friends.”
Yuliana looked at Connor with a faint smile, then turned around and walked into the Versace store.
“Sir, Miss, do you need anything?”
The tall salesgirl saw Connor and Yuliana come in and quickly greeted them with a smile.
“My friend needs a suit. It’s for a party!”
Yuliana replied lightly.
“Alright, please come in…”
The beautiful saleswoman quickly replied and then led Connor and Yuliana into the store.
When Connor and Yuliana walked into the store, many customers turned to look at them.
Connor’s outfit was very ordinary. After all, most of the people were not Yuliana. They could not tell that Connor’s clothes were all international brands.
Although Connor’s looks were not bad, he was still a little immature. He gave people the feeling that he was an ordinary university student.
However, Yuliana was different. She was tall and sexy, had a cold and noble appearance, and had a very refined temperament.
Therefore, it was a stark contract between the two of them as they were standing together.
Yuliana didn’t care about their gazes and started picking out clothes for Connor.
Connor quietly followed behind Yuliana, not caring about the strange looks from others.

chapters.title: Chapter 706: Mr. Nikola Chakin
chapters.content:
Chapter 706: Mr. Nikola Chakin
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation | Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Yuliana had high standards when it came to aesthetics, and her family also was in the fashion business.
Therefore, Yuliana was very picky about clothes.
After strolling around the store for a while, she finally found a set of clothes that she thought didn’t look too bad.
She took the clothes and walked in front of Connor, then said softly, “I think this set of clothes suits you very well. Go in and try it on. See how it looks on you!”
“Yes…”
Connor agreed and then took the clothes into the fitting room.
In fact, Connor didn’t care much about clothes. Although many people liked to use clothes to judge a person’s financial situation, Connor felt that this kind of thing would expose himself too much.
However, Yuliana had already helped him pick out his clothes, so Connor decided to oblige her.
Yuliana had a sharp eye; after Connor put on the clothes that she had chosen, his temperament somehow felt like it had undergone a huge change.
It was as if in an instant, Connor had turned from a slovenly poor student into a handsome and rich heir.
Connor was actually very good-looking and had a good figure. It was just that he didn’t like to dress up properly. However, now that he had, he was even more handsome than many of the so-called rich heirs.
After Connor changed his clothes, he walked out of the fitting room.
But at this moment, he realized that Yuliana was chatting with a boy.
The boy looked very ordinary, but was dressed very fashionably. It was obvious that he was also a rich man.
“I didn’t expect such a coincidence. You’re actually going to the party on the Princess Cruise Ship? I’ll be going to that party tonight, too…” the man said to Yuliana with a smile.
Yuliana obviously didn’t know this guy. Her pretty face was filled with impatience.
When she saw Connor walk out of the fitting room, her eyes lit up and she said, “I’m sorry, my boyfriend is here…”
After saying this, Yuliana walked to Connor’s side and took the initiative to hold his arm in a very suggestive way.
Connor could even smell the faint fragrance on Yuliana’s body.
Connor was not a fool. He naturally knew what was going on.
When the man saw how intimate Yuliana and Connor were, a strange look flashed across his eyes.
However, he quickly covered up his expression and walked up to Connor. He said with a smile, “Hello, my name is Felix Griffin!”
Felix smiled when he talked to Connor, appearing to be very polite.
“Hello. I’m Connor McDonald!”
Seeing Felix being so polite, Connor also replied indifferently.
“Um, I just heard from your girlfriend that you guys will be attending the party on the Princess Cruise Ship tonight, right?” Felix asked Connor with a smile.
“That’s right…”
Connor nodded lightly.
“That’s great. I’ll go to the party too. Why don’t we go together? At that time, I can introduce you to some friends…”
As Felix spoke, he revealed his hand. It was a brand new diamond-encrusted watch from Rolex.
When Felix saw that Connor was not wearing a watch at all, a trace of disdain flashed across his eyes. After all, in the eyes of these so-called upper-class people, watches were always a symbol of a man’s status.
Connor turned his head to look at Yuliana, as if asking for her opinion.
“I don’t mind…” Yuliana said to Connor.
When Felix heard Yuliana say that, he thought that Yuliana had agreed, so he started chatting with Connor.
In just a few words, Felix revealed his situation to Yuliana and Connor.
Felix was the son of a wealthy businessman. His family was in the medical equipment business, and he lived in very good conditions.
Connor and Yuliana listened expressionlessly, but Connor was not very interested in Felix’s situation.
After all, Felix might not know what kind of big shot Connor was, and Connor was standing right in front of him.
No matter how rich Felix’s family was, it was absolutely impossible for them to be richer than Connor.
Yuliana was not interested in Felix at all because her family background was not bad. Felix’s little qualifications naturally could not move her.
Felix looked at Connor and Yuliana and continued. “Oh right, you guys might not know yet, right? This cruise party was specially organized by Nikola Chakin for his girlfriend’s birthday. There will be many big shots attending the party today…”
“Who is Nikola Chakin?” Yuliana asked with a puzzled expression.
“You don’t even know Nikola Chakin? He is the son of the number one brother in San Francisco, Yakov Chakin!” Felix quickly explained.
“Yakov Chakin?”
When Connor heard this name, he was stunned for a moment, and his expression became a little puzzled.
“Do you know Yakov Chakin?” Felix lasked.
“I don’t know him…”
Connor hurriedly shook his head. The reason why he was so surprised when he heard this name was because Connor didn’t know if the Yakov Chakin that Felix was talking about was the same Yakov Chakin that he met at the martial arts tournament.
If it was really that Yakov Chakin, he seemed to run into the man a lot.
“The two of you actually don’t even know Yakov Chakin…” Felix saw Connor and Yuliana’s reaction and was speechless. He continued, “You guys should know about Dreamcatcher Studios, right?”
“Dreamcatcher Studios?”
When Yuliana heard this name, her eyes lit up as if she was very familiar with this name.
Yuliana was pretty and had a good figure, so she had always wanted to become a big star. The company that Felix mentioned was one of the more famous film companies in the country, so Yuliana naturally knew about it.
Connor still had a puzzled look on his face. He did not know what Felix was talking about.
Felix saw Yuliana’s expression and knew that what he said had moved her.
He quickly said, “Let me tell you that Dreamcatcher Studios is owned by Nikola Chakin—Mr. Chakin Jr.. I have a very good relationship with Mr. Chakin Jr.., so when the time comes, I’ll introduce you to him. Get to know him…”

chapters.title: Chapter 707: A Chance to Change Their Lives
chapters.content:
Chapter 707: A Chance to Change Their Lives
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation | Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
“Do you really know the boss of Dreamcatcher Studios?”
Yuliana asked Felix in surprise.
“Of course I do. I’m very good friends with Mr. Chakin Jr. If I want to enter the entertainment industry, I just need to have a word with Mr. Chakin Jr…” Felix said with a smile.
After Yuliana heard this, she was obviously moved.
When Felix saw Yuliana’s expression, he smiled proudly. He knew that he had achieved his goal.
Although Yuliana looked cold on the surface, there was no girl who didn’t want to become a star. With such a good opportunity in front of her, Yuliana had no reason to reject it.
“It’s not easy to meet such a peerless beauty. I must seize this opportunity!” Felix could not help but think. It seemed that he did not take Connor, this fake boyfriend, seriously at all.
Felix felt that Connor was not a threat to him at all.
A few minutes later, Connor, Yuliana, and Felix met up with Dominic and Spencer and the rest.
When Dominic and Spencer and the others found out Felix’s identity, they were instantly dumbfounded. The expression on their faces was very shocked.
After all, they rarely came into contact with rich heirs like Felix.
Cindy also began to have her own thoughts. She did not care about Dominic’s feelings at all and took the initiative to chat with Felix.
However, Felix did not put Cindy in his eyes at all. When Cindy spoke to him, he only responded casually.
After all, compared to Yuliana, Cindy was not just a little bit inferior—while Yuliana could be said to be a top beauty that only appeared once in a hundred years, Cindy was at most an ordinary beauty.
Of course, a rich heir like Felix wouldn’t be moved by someone like Cindy.
Felix glanced at the time and shouted at Yuliana, Connor, and the others.
“Well, it’s getting late. Let’s head over!”
After hearing Felix’s words, everyone walked straight to the roadside, wanting to flag down a taxi.
Felix took out his car key and pressed it casually.
“Chirp chirp!” A red Porsche sports car rang twice. Felix walked to the front of the sports car and opened the door.
When Cindy saw this scene, her eyes began to sparkle. It was as if she wanted to strip and stick herself to Felix right now.
After Felix got into the car, he found that Connor and the others were still standing in the same place.
“Didn’t you drive here?” Felix could not help but ask.
“No…”
Yuliana replied lightly.
“My car can fit one more person. Yuliana, why don’t you get in?” Felix said with a smile.
After Yuliana heard Felix’s words, she shook her head and said softly, “Forget it. I’ll just take a car with my friends…”
“Alright then, I’ll wait for you on the Princess Cruise Ship!”
Felix seemed to be a little disappointed.
“Mr. Griffin, if she doesn’t want to sit, I’ll sit. I’ll go with you…”
Cindy shouted after Yuliana rejected her offer. Then, she ran toward Felix’s sports car.
However, before Cindy could reach the sports car, Felix started the car, stepped on the accelerator, and disappeared from everyone’s sight.
Cindy’s outstretched right hand froze in mid-air, and she stood rooted to the ground with an awkward expression.
The expression on Dominic’s face was also very ugly.
Spencer glasses reached out and patted Dominic’s shoulder gently, signaling him not to take it to heart. Dominic sighed helplessly. At this moment, he finally understood something: he and Cindy weren’t from the same world. No matter how good he was to her, it wouldn’t help.
A few minutes later, Connor and the others took a taxi to the Princess Cruise Ship.
After getting into the car, Dominic seemed to be in a bad mood.
Connor turned his head to look at Dominic and said in a low voice, “It’s alright, bro. It’s not worth it to be sad for such a woman…”
“That’s right, Brother Dominic. How many times have I told you? Cindy doesn’t like you at all. She just treats you like an ATM. Connor and I have already told you this many times, but you never took it to heart…”
Spencer whispered to Dominic.
“That’s right, this time I’ve finally seen it clearly. This Cindy isn’t worthy of me treating her so well!”
Dominic replied indifferently.
Spencer smiled and said, “It’s not too late for you to understand these things now…”
At this time, the road leading to the south dock of Porthampton had already begun to be blocked, which led to many private cars not being able to pass through and could only choose to take a detour.
Many private car owners didn’t like this situation, but they could do nothing about it. After all, there were many traffic police on the road, and they did not dare to break through.
“Why is the road suddenly closed off?”
“Did something happen up ahead?”
“The road wasn’t closed just now. Why so suddenly?”
Some drivers couldn’t help but start discussing among themselves.
“What else could it be? I heard that it’s because the Princess Cruise Ship is holding a birthday party. In order to allow the guests to attend the party safely, the road leading to the southeast pier was sealed. Only those who show their party tickets can enter…”
A young man said enviously.
“Oh my god, what kind of party is this? Why is it so prestigious?”
“What other party can it be? It must be a party for those rich heirs and young models. These things are very normal…”
“I heard that the person hosting this party is Yakov Chakin, the son of Mr.
Chakin the Second. He’s a big shot that we can’t afford to offend!”
“Even a big shot can’t do as he pleases, right? You saying that just because they’re going to hold a party, it means they can seal off the road?”
Some of the car owners shouted indignantly.
However, at this moment, several Ferrari sports cars sped away.
When the passers-by saw these Ferrari sports cars, their expressions were also very envious.
After all, who wouldn’t be envious of such a life?
All kinds of luxury cars began to appear on the streets. Any one of these sports cars was worth tens of millions. Moreover, these sports cars had all passed the security check and were confirmed to be cars going to the party.
Among these luxury cars, there was a white nanny van that was slowly moving forward.
Yelena Allen was sitting in the van and looking at the scenery outside.
At this moment, there were several actors in the van. These actors were not very famous.
Under normal circumstances, they wouldn’t be qualified to attend this cruise party. However, because these actors happened to be in the same production team as Florina Yacca, they were qualified to come.
At this moment, the actresses in the van looked very excited.
They knew that tonight was a very good opportunity. If they were lucky, they could even change their lives.

chapters.title: Chapter 708: Princess Cruise Ship
chapters.content:
Chapter 708: Princess Cruise Ship
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation | Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
In the nanny van, a group of actresses sat together and chatted.
“Florina is really amazing. She actually made everything so glamorous on her birthday to the point where she could even seal off the road. When can I be like Florina?”
An actress sighed with envy.
“Yeah, look at those cars that drove past just now. They’re all luxury cars. They’re really amazing…”
“We can only peek in. The gap between us and Florina is not just a small one. The main thing is that Florina’s boyfriend is very powerful!”
“If you ask me, it’s better for us women to marry well than to look good…” At this moment, an actress called out in a strange tone. When she spoke, she seemed to deliberately glance at Yelena.
At this moment, an actress asked Yelena with a smile. “By the way, Yelena, will your boyfriend come to this party?”
In fact, many people in the production team knew that Yelena had a boyfriend, but they had always been very disdainful of him.
After Yelena heard this, she slowly raised her head and looked at everyone.
“Why would Yelena’s boyfriend be here? As a cleaner?”
“Hahaha, I think the cruise ship probably doesn’t want him to be a cleaner, right? Isn’t Yelena’s boyfriend a poor loser?”
“It should be fine to be a cleaner. At most, they’ll just have to pay him less?”
Because Florina bullied Yelena a lot, the others naturally wanted to kick her when she was down.
Everyone began to laugh.
Yelena frowned as she looked at these people. Her expression was extremely angry. She simply could not accept others humiliating Connor like this.
However, no matter how angry Yelena was, what could she do? Yelena couldn’t possibly fall out with them because of these people’s jokes, right?
Moreover, what these people said was the truth. Connor was indeed a poor loser with no money or power.
So Yelena sighed helplessly and did not say anything. Instead, she narrowed her eyes and looked at the scenery outside the car window.
“We’ve arrived…”
At this moment, an actress suddenly shouted. When everyone heard this, they all turned their heads to look out of the car window.
At this moment, a giant cruise ship, the Princess Cruise Ship, was docked at the southeast pier.
The Princess Cruise Ship was a famous cruise ship in Oprana and even worldwide. Rich people liked to come here. It was modified from a recently retired warship. It was 280 meters long and 150 meters wide.
The lights on the cruise ship were bright, and the birds were singing and dancing.
The deck had been transformed into a sightseeing platform that could accommodate nearly 2,000 people. There were also more than a dozen restaurants and facilities such as a hot spring and an amusement park. It could be said to be extremely luxurious.
Of course, the most famous part of the Princess Cruise Ship was the banquet hall, which was nearly 2,000 square meters. This hall was where the birthday party was held tonight.
The ship was about ten stories tall, and the lights on the cruise ship were bright, giving people the feeling that it was a moving palace.
“Oh my god, this is too beautiful!”
“Yeah, I’ve never seen such a luxurious cruise ship in my life!”
“It’s too luxurious. When can 1 hold a birthday party here?”
“Let’s just think about it. It’s all because we’re lucky that we can attend this banquet…”
After the girls in the car saw the cruise ship, they began to discuss amongst themselves
“Hurry up and get out of the van!”
At this moment, Director Coffin shouted loudly. Then, he reached out to push open the van door and got out.
When everyone saw Director Coffin get out of the van, they followed suit. Yelena was the last to get out.
At this moment, all kinds of luxury sports cars were parked on the shore of the Southeast Pier.
From this, it could be seen that everyone attending the party today should be rich.
The actresses also started to look around, as if they were looking for their target for the night.
Under the director’s lead, everyone walked into the passageway.
At this moment, the people walking on the passageway were all wealthy people in bright clothes.
Moreover, these rich people were all accompanied by beautiful women. These beautiful women were all the best of the best, and their clothes were also very sexy and attractive.
Perhaps this was the life of a rich man!
The actresses who had never attended such a party before were all very excited.
They felt that this might be a good opportunity to change their fate.
At this moment, there was something that Yelena found unbelievable.
There were many beautiful women standing below the deck of the cruise ship.
These beauties were all on par with goddesses, and their clothes were also very sexy and flirtatious. People would willingly kneel for them. However, these so-called beauties did not care about their image at all—they were shouting crazily at the rich heirs on the cruise ship.
“Handsome, please, take me in!”
“Handsome, this is my room card. If you’re free tonight, you can come and play with me…”
“Handsome, do you have time?”
The beautiful woman’s expression was unusually excited, as if she wanted to send herself directly to the bed of those rich heirs.
The rich heirs seemed to be used to this situation. They ignored these women and walked into the cruise ship expressionlessly.
In order to prevent any trouble, the security guards at the bottom of the cruise ship rushed forward and chased these women away.
From this, it could be seen that the so-called high and mighty goddesses in the eyes of ordinary people actually had no dignity in the eyes of the rich.
These women were not well-off and did not have any background. Naturally, they did not have the opportunity to attend such a high-level party.
Therefore, they could only stand under the cruise ship, hoping that some rich heir would take a fancy to them.
Yelena looked at these beautiful women and shook her head helplessly. Then, she followed everyone into the cruise ship.
After entering the cruise ship, the actresses dispersed and began to search for tonight’s prey.
As it was only six in the evening, there were not many guests in the banquet hall.
“Yelena, I’ll introduce you to a very famous producer later…”
At this moment, Director Coffin walked to Yelena’s side and whispered to her.
When Yelena heard his words, she looked troubled. Then, she frowned and said, “Director Coffin, I appreciate your kindness, but I’ve already told you that I won’t accept those unspoken rules…”
“Don’t worry, I won’t harm you. Moreover, this producer is a woman, so she won’t take advantage of you. She’s always looking for a female lead for her next movie, but this producer has some unique tastes. I’ve introduced a few actresses to her before, but she hasn’t been very satisfied. I think you’re very suitable for this role, so I’ll bring you to meet this producer later…”
Director Coffin looked at Yelena and explained softly..

chapters.title: Chapter 709: A Fake Invitation Letter
chapters.content:
Chapter 709: A Fake Invitation Letter
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
“That producer is a woman?”
After Yelena heard what Director Coffin said, she looked a little surprised.
In fact, if she could get to know some big shots in the entertainment industry without selling her body, he would be very happy.
Yelena still hoped to communicate with the so-called big shots in the entertainment industry. After all, the more people you knew, the more opportunities you had.
But unfortunately, the producers and directors nowadays were all after the actresses’ bodies rather than their talent. If you want to build a relationship with them, you have to pay something.
That was why Yelena was very hesitant to contact those people.
“Don’t worry, the producer I introduced to you is a very professional producer. It’s precisely because of this that she has very high expectations for her actors. When the time comes, you have to perform well, understand?” Director Coffin said to Yelena with an extremely serious expression.
“Director Coffin, thank you so much!”
Yelena shouted excitedly at Director Coffin.
“You don’t have to thank me. I did it for myself!” Director Coffin replied indifferently and then continued, “This producer promised me that if I can help her find a suitable female lead, she will let me be the director of this movie. This movie is an international blockbuster with an investment of nearly 500 million dollars. Once you become the female lead of this movie, I guarantee that you will become famous.”
“Understood!”
Yelena hurriedly nodded.
“Alright, then you can stay here and get ready. I’ll go greet a few friends in the meantime. When the producer comes over, I’ll bring you to meet them…”
Director Coffin said to Yelena with a smile.
“Alright…Okay, thank you, Director Coffin!”
At this moment, Yelena was so excited that she did not know what to say. She could only nod her head non-stop.
Director Coffin looked at Yelena with a faint smile, then turned around and left.
Yelena stood there alone with a nervous expression on her face. She knew that this kind of opportunity was hard to come by.
On the other side, Connor Spencer Dominic, and the others also took a taxi to
the Southeast Pier.
When everyone saw the Princess Cruise Ship, they were all dumbfounded. Their mouths were wide open, and their expressions were extremely shocked.
They had never seen such a luxurious cruise ship before.
“This cruise ship probably costs a lot of money, right?” Dominic said with his
eyes wide open.
“The cost of this cruise ship is at least one billion dollars…” After Felix heard Dominic’s words, he replied indifferently, and the expression on his face was very proud.
“Oh wow, it’s so expensive!” Cindy covered her small mouth and shouted. She was so shocked that she didn’t know what to say.
“Alright, I’ll bring you in!”
Felix said arrogantly, and then directly walked toward the cruise ship.
When everyone went up to the deck, they found many beautiful women standing on the cruise ship.
These beautiful women were all tall and slender, with big breasts and slender waists. They were also dressed very sexily.
When these beauties saw Connor Dominic, and the others, they began to shout crazily, their expressions extremely excited.
Dominic and Spencer were shocked by these beautiful women. They asked Felix with a puzzled expression, “Mr. Griffin, what’s wrong with these women?” “These women are all models who aren’t qualified to enter the gala. They’re here to hook up with rich heirs. If the two of you are interested, you can bring them in and book a room with them tonight…”
Felix explained casually.
These beauties were not qualified to attend the party, so they could only buy tickets for the Princess Cruise Ship in advance and wait for the party to begin. After the guests entered, they would seduce the rich heirs who entered the party.
Although these beautiful women had good figures and appearances, any rational rich heirs would not fall for it, mainly because these models were no different from those foreign helpers. These rich heirs would never fancy such a
woman.
Spencer and Dominic were stunned when they heard Felix’s words. Then, they shook their heads. They were not fools; they knew that these women were not good people.
If they ever hooked up such a woman, they would never be able to get nd of her in the future.
Felix found that Connor was very calm at this time, as if he was not interested in these women at all. He did not even turn his head to look at them.
This made Felix feel somewhat incredulous. He felt that a country bumpkin like Connor would definitely be as excited as Dominic and Spencer when he saw these beautiful women. However, Connor was still so calm.
A few minutes later, Felix brought Connor, Yuliana and the others to the entrance of the banquet hall.
At this moment, there were two strong security guards standing at the entrance. All guests who wanted to enter the banquet hall had to show their invitation cards.
Spencer quickly took out his invitation card.
Because Felix had a good relationship with Nikola Chakin, he did not need to show his invitation card at all. He simply greeted the security guard and walked into the hall.
After seeing Felix enter, Spencer quickly took out the invitation letter and handed it to the security guard.
When the security guard saw the invitation letter in Spencer’s hand, a trace of disdain flashed across his eyes. Then, he said coldly, “I’m sorry, but your invitation is only for the ticket to the Princess Cruise Ship, not the ticket to the party. If you want to attend the party, you need to take out the invitation to the party!”
Spencer froze on the spot after hearing the security guard’s words. His expression was unusually awkward.
Yuliana, Sarina, and the others also felt a little embarrassed.
It was obvious that Spencer had been deceived.
The tickets he bought were not tickets to the party, but rather tickets to the cruise ship.
The tickets to the cruise ship were not worth much. Anyone could buy one for 500 dollars. However, the tickets to the party were different. They could not be bought even if you had money.
Spence’s face was red and he looked extremely embarrassed. He did not know what to do.
After all, everyone had bought clothes for the party and had gone through so much trouble, only for things to turn out like this.
At this moment, Yuliana and Sarina were still watching from the side! “Spencer, are you serious? You called all of us here just to see this cruise ship?” Cindy shouted with her big watery eyes.
“I…”
Spencer ‘expression was awkward. He did not know how to explain.
“If you can’t buy the tickets, just say it. Tell me, what’s the matter with you tricking all of us here?”
At this moment, Cindy was not polite at all. Her tone was extremely sharp and unkind, not giving Spencer any leeway at all..

chapters.title: Chapter 710: The Actress Celine Chalphy
chapters.content:
Chapter 710: The Actress Celine Chalphy
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation | Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Spencer had been cheated and bought a fake invitation, so he was already very depressed.
Now that Cindy had said that, his expression seemed to turn even uglier.
“Cindy, stop saying that. Spencer didn’t mean it!”
Dominic frowned and shouted at Cindy.
“How do I know if he did it on purpose?” Cindy replied with a pout.
“Alright, can you stop talking? So what if you can’t enter? Spencer bought these tickets with his own money. He was also cheated…”
At this moment, Dominic was getting more and more annoyed with Cindy. He really couldn’t understand why he had fallen for a woman like Cindy in the first place.
Spencer hesitated for a moment before taking out his phone and calling his friend. He then questioned his friend about the tickets.
“Spencer, are you crazy? Do you know what kind of big shots are attending the party today? They are all famous rich heirs and celebrities in Davenport. Every one of them has an amazing background. I can’t even get in myself, so how could I possibly get you an invitation to the party? And even if I really can get it, I wouldn’t sell it to you for 2,000 dollars!”
As soon as the call was connected, Spencer’s friend poured out his grievances.
Spencer froze on the spot after hearing what his friend said. His expression was extremely ugly, and he did not know what to say.
In fact, Connor did not understand before. Since the beauties on the cruise wanted to attend the party so much, why didn’t they spend money to buy tickets themselves? After all, a ticket that cost 2,000 dollars should not be considered a lot of money for those socialites, right?
But now, Connor finally understood that the 2,000 dollars Spencer spent on the tickets was just for the cruise ship, not for the party.
“Spencer, you don’t have to be too sad. Since you can’t enter, forget it. Let’s go back…”
Sarina whispered to Spencer.
II II
Spencer looked up at Sarina and said in a self-reproachful tone, “Sarina, I’m so sorry. I didn’t expect my friend to lie to me!”
“It’s okay. You were also deceived. I won’t blame you!”
Sarina replied with a smile, then continued, “Since we can’t attend the party, let’s go to the bar to play. It’s the same anyway!”
“That’s right, let’s go to the bar…”
Dominic also hurriedly shouted.
Spencer sighed helplessly and turned to leave.
Felix, who had already entered the banquet hall, naturally saw this scene.
However, he did not say anything. Instead, he waited for Spencer and the others to take the initiative to beg him.
In fact, Felix had been very curious before. Connor, Spencer, Dominic, and the other two did not look like rich heirs at all, so where could they have gotten the tickets for the party?
At this moment, Felix finally understood that these country bumpkins had been deceived!
However, Felix never expected that Connor and the others would turn around and leave instead of asking him for help.
Felix might not care if others left, but if Yuliana left, it would be a huge loss for him!
So Felix hurriedly shouted, “Why are you leaving?”
After hearing Felix’s words, Spencer looked back at Felix helplessly and said in a low voice, “Erm, Mr. Griffin, we don’t have tickets for the party. We’ll go back first…”
“If you don’t have tickets, you should’ve told me!” Felix replied casually, then shouted at the security guard at the door, “These people are all my friends. They came with me. It shouldn’t be a problem for me to bring them in, right?”
“No problem, no problem…”
The security guard was stunned for a moment after hearing Felix’s words. Then, he quickly shook his head and replied. He even took the initiative to make way for Connor, Spencer and the others.
When everyone saw this scene, they were all stunned on the spot, and their expressions were indescribably shocked.
Previously, they had more or less suspected that Felix was bragging to them, but now they finally understood that Felix was indeed a rich heir with an amazing background. Otherwise, it was absolutely impossible for him to have such strength.
At this moment, Cindy looked at Felix even more eagerly.
However, Felix had never looked Cindy in the eye even once. He only had eyes for Yuliana.
After Spencer thanked Felix, he led Connor and the others into the banquet hall.
After entering the banquet hall, Connor could clearly feel that the guests inside were very different from those outside.
Almost all the guests were dressed in formal attire. The men looked elegant, and the women had extraordinary temperaments. Whether it was the exquisite jewelry they wore or the makeup, they all gave off a graceful and luxurious feeling.
Moreover, Connor also saw several big stars who often appeared in television dramas.
Although Connor couldn’t name them all, he could still recognize them.
“Oh my god, there are so many celebrities here!” Cindy couldn’t help but exclaim in shock. Her expression was one of disbelief.
“Mr. Chakin Jr.’s girlfriend is from the entertainment industry, so there will definitely be a lot of celebrities here today!” Felix explained in a very casual tone, and then continued, “Um, I’ll go and see if Mr. Chakin Jr. has arrived. You guys wait here for a while and eat something…”
“Alright…”
Spencer hurriedly replied.
Felix smiled faintly, then turned around and left.
On the other side.
Yelena stood alone in the hall and waited for nearly half an hour.
Director Coffin finally rushed to Yelena’s side and said softly to her, “Yelena, come with me. President Lowe is here…”
“Alright!”
Yelena hurriedly nodded and followed Director Coffin to the private room at the back of the banquet hall.
The actress who was in the same production team as Yelena had a strange look in her eyes when she saw Director Coffin leave in a hurry with Yelena.
This actress was called Celine Chalphy, and she was the third female lead in Yelena’s current movie.
Celine had always been very jealous of Yelena, so she would sow discord between Yelena and Florina acca from time to time.
If Celine hadn’t been sowing discord between them, the relationship between Yelena and Florina wouldn’t have ended up like this.
After hesitating for a moment, Celine chose to follow behind Yelena and the director. She wanted to see what they were planning to do..

chapters.title: Chapter 711: A Once-in-a-lifetime Opportunity
chapters.content:
Chapter 711: A Once-in-a-lifetime Opportunity
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation | Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Celine sneakily followed behind Yelena and Mr. Coffin.
Yelena was too nervous, so she did not notice Celine behind her.
“Yelena, don’t be nervous when you see Ms. Lowe later. Your figure and appearance are very good in all aspects. As long as you perform normally, everything will go well!”
Mr. Coffin noticed Yelena was a little nervous, so he couldn’t help but remind her softly.
When Yelena heard Mr. Coffin’s assurance, she was surprised. Then, she nodded lightly and did not say anything else.
Following them, Celine naturally heard what Mr. Coffin and Yelena said.
She couldn’t help but frown. She wondered who this Ms. Lowe they were talking about was.
A few minutes later, Yelena followed Mr. Coffin to a private room.
The banquet hall’s private rooms were not airtight.
Therefore, Celine could see that the so-called Ms. Lowe sitting in the private room was a famous entertainment producer.
The producer was called Queens Lowe. When she was young, she was a famous actress in Hong Kong and Taiwan.
Her father was a wealthy businessman in Hong Kong with an influential family background.
After Queens left the entertainment industry, she did business for a few years before returning to the entertainment industry and setting up a production company.
Queens’s production company could be on par with Universal Pictures, MGM Pictures, and other large production companies.
As Queens was an actress, she was very clear about the unspoken rules in the entertainment industry. She hated those shady deals in the entertainment industry the most.
When Celine saw Queens, she was instantly stunned.
This was because any celebrity in the entertainment industry knew that Queens was preparing for an international movie. The male lead was an international superstar who had won an Oscar for Best Actor.
However, the female lead hadn’t been decided yet, so many female stars were eyeing this female lead. Whoever could be the female lead in this movie would become famous.
However, because Queens would never accept the unspoken rules, those female celebrities could only compete with their true abilities.
“Why did Mr. Coffin bring Yelena here to see Ms. Lowe?” Celine frowned and muttered. Then, she sneaked to the door and peeked through the crack.
Mr. Coffin had pushed Yelena to Queens’s side, and Yelena was very nervous.
Queens was a beautiful young woman with a good figure and skin. She was sitting on the sofa and playing with her phone.
Although Queens was already close to forty years old, her temperament was still very elegant, giving off an aura of superiority.
“Mr. Coffin, you’re here?” Queens asked expressionlessly as she slowly put down her phone after seeing Mr. Coffin.
“Ms. Lowe, this is the actress I told you about, Yelena Allen…”
Mr. Coffin respectfully introduced Yelena to Queens.
After Queens heard about Yelena’s story, she gently nodded. After which, she stood up and sized Yelena up. After which, she softly said, “Your looks and personality are not bad. You meet my requirements for the female lead. How old are you this year…”
“Twenty-two!” Yelena replied nervously.
“Just the right age…” Queens gently nodded. After which, she continued, “I just don’t know how good your acting is. I have very high expectations for actresses. Being just pretty is not enough…”
“Ms. Lowe, don’t worry about that. Yelena is now on my production team. Although it’s her first time acting, she’s very hardworking and likes to learn. There shouldn’t be too many problems with her acting skills…” Mr. Coffin hurriedly said after hearing Queens’s words.
“That’s good!” Queens nodded satisfactorily. She then looked at Yelena and continued to ask, “How good is your American English? Because our movie will be filmed in the U.S., although most of the lines are in Opranian English, there are still some lines in American English, so there are certain requirements for American English…”
“Mr. Lowe, I’ve already passed the TOEFL in English. There shouldn’t be any problems with normal conversations…” Yelena replied nervously.
“As long as you can communicate in American English normally, it’s all good. But you have to go abroad for nearly half a year when filming. Can you accept this?” Queens looked at Yelena and continued to ask.
Hearing that, Yelena was shocked and felt somewhat conflicted.
“Can’t do?” Queens frowned and asked.
“No… No…” Yelena felt this was a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity, so she would not give up.
Although she would need to go abroad for half a year and might not be able to see Connor, Yelena felt Connor should understand.
“Great. It’s set then!” Queens nodded again, then looked at Mr. Coffin and said softly, “The young lady you brought me this time is not bad. How about this? Bring her to my company in a few days. I’ll find someone to give her a closed audition. If she passes the audition, I’ll let her play the female lead…”
“All right… yes, Ms. Lowe…” When Mr. Coffin heard Queens’s words, he instantly gaped in surprise.
Mr. Coffin had not expected Queens to agree so quickly.
Since Queens had already said she wanted to audition for Yelena, this was probably set in stone.
II II
Yelena stood rooted to the ground, stunned.
Yelena never thought that happiness would come so quickly!
Although they still had to do a closed audition, Queens was willing to give Yelena a chance, which meant that this was all within her reach.
“Yelena, what are you still standing there for? Hurry up and thank Ms. Lowe!” Mr. Coffin said to Yelena in a low voice.
“Thank you, Ms. Lowe! Thank you, Ms. Lowe!” Yelena hurriedly bowed at Queens, excited.
“Don’t thank me yet. Wait until you pass the audition. My people are also very picky. You’re suitable on the surface, but they might not think you are. So you have to perform well, understand? Queens said gently.
“Yes, Ms. Lowe…” Yelena hurriedly replied.
Celine heard the conversation between Queens and Yelena outside the door, and she was shocked.
She never expected Yelena to get the closed audition so easily.
“If Yelena is really selected to take the female lead role in this movie, what will happen to Florina?” Celine couldn’t help but wonder. Then, she hurriedly walked toward the banquet hall..

chapters.title: Chapter 712: It’s Florina Yacca!
chapters.content:
Chapter 712: It’s Florina Yacca!
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Celine knew that Florina had been eyeing Queens’ film recently.
However, because Queens was different from other producers, Florina could not get the female lead role through her boyfriend.
Therefore, Florina did not know what to do now.
However, Florina attached great importance to this production because it was a co-production between Oprana and the United States, and the male lead was an international superstar.
Florina was just a popular celebrity in the country now. If she wanted to become an international superstar, she still lacked an opportunity, and this film was Florina’s best chance.
Florina had already announced in the entertainment industry that she wanted the female lead of this film.
If anyone dared to snatch it from her, they would go against her!
This also prevented many female celebrities who were suitable for this film from attending the audition. That was why Yelena got this rare opportunity. Otherwise, such a role would never have been given to Yelena.
“Yelena doesn’t know what’s good for her. She dares steal Florina’s role. I’ll go tell Florina now, and we’ll see how Florina will deal with you!” Celine snorted coldly and turned to leave.
Not long after Celine left, Yelena and Mr. Coffin left the private room.
“Mr. Coffin, thank you so much. If it weren’t for you, I wouldn’t have had such a good opportunity…” Yelena said excitedly to Mr. Coffin.
“I should be the one thanking you…” Mr. Coffin replied with a smile and then continued, “When we return to the production team, I’ll get the assistant director of our production team to train you to improve your acting skills. When the audition comes, do your best and get the role…”
“All right!” Yelena hurriedly nodded, excited.
“Let’s go. I’ll introduce a few more friends to you. You might be able to use them in the future…”
Mr. Coffin’s attitude toward Yelena had also seen a huge change. If Queens had not taken in Yelena, Mr. Coffin would not have introduced his friends to Yelena.
However, the situation was different now. If Yelena were really chosen by Queens to become the female lead of this movie, then her future would be limitless. By then, even he might have to curry favor with Yelena, so he had to take this opportunity to get into Yelena’s good books.
***
As the banquet hall was relatively large, Connor and the others were at the entrance, and Yelena had always been among the people in the entertainment industry, so the distance between them was relatively far.
In addition, there were many people in the banquet hall, so Connor naturally did not notice Yelena at the party, and Yelena did not notice Connor.
After Felix left, Dominic and Spencer became nervous.
After all, it was their first time attending such a party. They were afraid that they would offend someone they shouldn’t.
However, Connor was much calmer. He walked to the dining cart, reached out, picked up a glass, and started drinking.
Such a party was a good opportunity for the upper class to expand their social circle, but sometimes, it could not be expanded just because they wanted to.
If there were no wingmen to help introduce them, it would not be easy to get to know these people.
In addition, Spencer, Dominic, and the rest were dressed very ordinarily, so no one would take the initiative to talk to them.
“What are you all standing there for?” Connor laughed, asked his friends, and continued, “You don’t have to be so nervous. Relax a little…”
“Do you think this is your house? Relax? What if we offend someone?” After hearing Connor’s words, Cindy rolled her eyes at him.
“So what if we offended someone? No one knows me anyway…” Connor said casually.
“You…” Hearing that, Cindy didn’t know how to respond. She felt she had difficulty communicating with a country bumpkin like Connor.
At this moment, a burst of cheers suddenly sounded from the crowd. Everyone turned to look at the entrance of the hall.
A handsome man and a beautiful woman walked into the hall hand in hand.
The man was about twenty years old and wore a white suit. He looked very handsome and gave off a gentle and refined feeling.
The woman was wearing a tube top short skirt. She was tall and sexy. Under the short skirt were her beautiful legs. She wore a pair of high heels, and her breasts were so full that they were almost spilling off her top. She had light makeup on but was still very sexy and charming.
This woman’s beauty was considered stunning among so many female celebrities.
“It’s Florina Yacca!” Sarina couldn’t help but exclaim in shock. Her expression was one of disbelief.
“You know her?”
Spencer was stunned and asked in confusion.
“Bro, are you blind? That’s superstar, Florina Yacca! Don’t you remember that she acted in a movie some time ago? The movie that we went to watch…” Sarina explained softly.
“Ah, her!” Spencer was enlightened.
At this moment, the others recognized the beautiful woman as Florina Macca! Although Florina had only debuted in the past two years, she quickly captured the hearts of many otakus because of her sexy figure and charming looks. Florina was considered one of the hottest female celebrities in the Oprana entertainment industry.
“It is unexpected that she would be here…”
Yuliana couldn’t help but sigh.
Almost all the celebrities in the entertainment industry surrounded Florina and the man, taking the initiative to greet them.
Yelena, who was not far away, had a strange look in her eyes when she saw Florina, but she did not say anything.
“Florina, do you have time now? I have something to tell you…” Celine walked up to Florina and whispered to her.
“What’s up?” Florina was surprised and asked in confusion.
“It’s about the movie that you want to be in…” As people were around, Celine did not dare to speak too directly.
“Queens’ movie?” Florina asked softly.
“Yes!” Celine nodded.
Florina felt Celine would not joke with her, so she informed the man beside her of her leaving and left with Celine..

chapters.title: Chapter 713: Let’s Ruin Her
chapters.content:
Chapter 713: Let’s Ruin Her
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Florina followed Celine to a quiet corner.
“Celine, why are you in such a hurry?” Florina still had many guests to entertain, so she asked Celine impatiently.
“Florina, didn’t you tell me before that you’re very interested in the movie Ms. Lowe will produce?” Celine asked softly.
“Oh my god! The movie is a co-production between Oprana and the United States, and the male lead is an Oscar-winning actor. If 1 get the female lead role in that movie, I will become an international superstar in the blink of an eye. This is a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity. How can I not be interested?” Florina said calmly.
“Florina, but I heard that the female lead of that movie seems to have been decided…” Celine said mysteriously.
“What? Decided?” Florina was surprised.
She asked Celine curiously, “Who’s the female lead? Me?”
“Not you…” Celine shook her head lightly.
“Well then, who is it?” Florina asked with a frown.
“You know the female lead of that movie, Florina. She’s in the banquet hall right now,” Celine said softly.
“Are you talking about Yelena?” Florina reacted almost instantaneously.
“That’s right. It’s Yelena…” Celine hurriedly nodded.
“Are you kidding me? Queens’s movie is a blockbuster with an investment of 500 million dollars. Moreover, the male lead is an Oscar winner. Are the producer and director crazy? Why would they choose Yelena, who has no status or background? What kind of popularity could she bring? Other than being slightly prettier, what other skills does Yelena have?” Florina felt that Celine’s information was inaccurate, so she shook her head and said dismissively.
“Florina…” Celine hurriedly said.
“All right, Celine, say no more. I still have something to do over there. I’ll go and do that…” Florina waved at Celine and turned to leave.
“Florina, I’m really not kidding. I saw Yelena and Queens meet just now and heard their conversation. Ms. Lowe has already confirmed that Yelena will be the female lead and asked her to do a closed audition in two days. If you don’t believe me, you can go to the private room and take a look. Yelena is with Queens in the private room…” Celine shouted after Florina anxiously.
When Florina heard that, she could not help but stop in her tracks. Then, she looked at Celine and asked, “You said you saw Yelena and Queens meet just now?”
“That’s right. If I hadn’t seen it with my eyes, I wouldn’t have dared to spread rumors like that. This is not a small matter!” Celine hurriedly nodded.
“But why would Ms. Lowe choose an unknown actress like Yelena?” Florina frowned and muttered.
“Florina, are you out of your mind? The A-list female celebrities in the entertainment industry have already received the news that you will be the female lead of this movie, so they don’t dare to meet with Ms. Lowe. Since no A-list celebrities stepped up, they had to go for a newcomer. Moreover, the lineup of this movie is already very strong. Even if the female lead’s popularity is slightly lower, it won’t have a big impact!” Celine hurriedly explained.
“This damned Yelena, she dares snatch the female lead role from me. I think she has a death wish…”
Florina had always disliked Yelena, to begin with. In addition, she had prepared for this movie for a long time, but now she had given it all to Yelena on a platter. Florina felt very uncomfortable.
“Florina, what do you plan to do? Queens is not that easy to deal with…” Celine asked after seeing Florina’s expression.
“That old woman Queens is indeed not easy to deal with…”
Florina nodded gently and continued, “Although Queens is not easy to deal with, Yelena is extremely easy to deal with…”
“Florina, have you already thought of something?” Celine hurriedly asked Florina.
“It’s easy to deal with Yelena. I initially thought that after this movie, I would have nothing to do with Yelena. However, I didn’t expect her to take the initiative to present her neck to me at my door now. I won’t have mercy now…”
Florina’s eyes flashed with viciousness. She turned to Celine and asked, “Haven’t I always been nice to you?”
“Florina, you usually just left alone. Otherwise, I wouldn’t have shared such news with you…” Celine answered without thinking.
“Then, I need you to help me do something now…” Florina said softly.
“What is it?” Celine was a little puzzled.
Florina thought for a moment and told Celine about her plan.
After Celine heard Florina’s plan, she was very shocked.
She did not expect Florina to be so ruthless. She wanted to ruin Yelena’s reputation!
“Florina, isn’t that a bit too much?” Celine asked with a frown.
“What’s too much? I want Yelena to know how powerful I am…” Florina said calmly.
“But I’m worried that doing so will break the law…” Celine seemed hesitant.
“Breaking the law?” Florida immediately sneered and said indifferently, “Only we know about this. As long as we don’t say anything, who will know that we did this?”
“But…” Celine looked at Florina hesitantly.
“Celine, I have a movie I don’t have time for right now. The male lead of this movie is a popular young hunk in the entertainment industry. I can introduce you to him if you can help me do this. I guarantee that your net worth will increase tenfold after you finish filming this movie,” Florina said with a smile.
“Really?” When Celine heard this, she instantly became excited..

chapters.title: Chapter 714: The Difference Between The Rich And The Poor
chapters.content:
Chapter 714: The Difference Between The Rich And The Poor
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
One had to know that Celine was at most a third-tier or fourth-tier actress.
She had no status in the entertainment industry at all. The roles she usually received were all unimportant supporting actresses.
However, Florina had given her a chance to play the female lead.
Moreover, it was a collaboration with a popular young male idol in the country. How could Celine not be tempted?
“Of course! Why would I lie to you?
“You should also know that I have too many roles. It’s so much that I can’t be in all of them…” Florina said casually.
“All right, Florina. I’ll do it!” Celine agreed without thinking.
“You are really my good friend…” Hearing Celine’s agreement, Florida smiled happily. Then, she discussed the details of the plan with Celine and turned to leave.
After Florina left, Celine felt nervous and excited.
At this time, Yelena was chatting with a famous director that Mr. Coffin knew. She was so busy that she had no idea what Florina and Celine were discussing.
Connor and the others stood at the dinner table, eating and chatting.
“So this is what a gathering of rich people is like. It feels quite boring. There’s nothing fun about it…”
Dominic said while stuffing something into his mouth.
“Yeah, I don’t think it’s interesting either. Moreover, the things here aren’t very delicious…” Spencer said.
“What do you two know? Those big shots came here to network. Do you think everyone is like you? You only know how to eat when you’re here…” Cindy pursed her lips and said disdainfully.
“What network? These people look well-dressed, but they’re not good people at all. Why should I know them? Moreover, even if I wanted to know them, they might not want to know me…” Spencer said casually.
“This is the difference between you and the rich!” Cindy instantly felt like she was above everyone else.
“Rich or poor, aren’t we all human?” Connor looked at Cindy and said indifferently.
“Only a poor person like you would say such things. They are all words that you use to comfort yourself…” Cindy replied coldly.
Connor glanced at Cindy indifferently and didn’t say anything.
“Connor, try this cake. It’s very delicious…” Yuliana picked up a piece of cake and handed it to Connor.
Connor took the cake and tasted it. It was indeed very good.
“Yuliana? Quickly follow me to see Mr. Chakin. Mr. Chakin is waiting in the private room!”
At this moment, Felix suddenly ran to Yuliana and pulled her along.
Yuliana was surprised. Then, she turned to look at Felix and asked softly, “Just us?”
“Of course…” Felix nodded without thinking.
“What about my friend?” Hearing that, Juliana seemed a little uncomfortable.
“Yuliana, are you mad? Who is Mr. Chakin? Do you think just anyone can meet him? Moreover, I just said that you wanted to see him alone. If I bring all of you in, Mr. Chakin will be angry…” Felix said helplessly.
“But…” Yuliana opened her mouth to speak.
“There are no buts. Yuliana, you should know that Mr. Chakin owns Dreamcatcher Studios. If you can get to know Mr. Chakin, he will be of great help to you when you enter the entertainment industry in the future. This is a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity,” Felix said agitatedly.
Hearing that, Yuliana was moved.
After all, Yuliana’s dream was to become a celebrity. Although Yuliana’s family was very rich, she had no connections in the entertainment industry. Now was a good opportunity.
Yuliana wasn’t materialistic but didn’t want to let go of such an opportunity.
Yuliana looked at Connor with a conflicted expression.
Although Yuliana had only known Connor for less than a day, Yuliana had a good impression of Connor.
Connor was good-looking, rich, and low-key. He was a good boyfriend – material.
But now, there was a better opportunity in front of Yuliana. Yuliana felt that if she could get on the big ship of Mr. Chakin, it would greatly help her future.
“Yuliana, if you don’t want to go, I’ll go…” Cindy said excitedly to Yuliana.
“Yuliana, Mr. Chakin said he only wants to meet you alone. Hurry up and come with me!” Felix said anxiously, then dragged Yuliana away.
Yuliana looked at Connor apologetically before leaving with Felix.
Yuliana’s choice was very obvious.
She felt that since she had a better choice, there was no need to worry about Connor anymore. After all, everyone wanted to climb up the ladder.
