“Hah, Connor! Do you know the difference between a rich person and a poor person like you now?” Cindy taunted Connor after Yuliana left.
“Nope…” Connor lightly shook his head.
“The difference between you and a rich person is that a rich person can get the girl you like into bed with just a word!” Cindy pouted.
“…” Connor looked at Cindy coldly and didn’t say anything.
Spencer felt awkward. After all, he was the one who introduced Yuliana to Connor, so he looked at Connor apologetically.
“Connor, she’s just another woman. It’s no big deal. I’ll introduce you to a better one in the future. I have a cousin who’s pretty good-looking and hot. She matches you…” Spencer comforted Connor softly.
After hearing Spencer’s words, Connor smiled faintly and said softly, “It’s okay. I don’t really like Yuliana. You don’t have to comfort me.”
“You’re just going to die here. Your heart is probably going to break now, right?” Cindy pouted and mocked.
“Cindy Stone, can you stop?” Dominic frowned and scolded coldly..

chapters.title: Chapter 715: Hey Beautiful, Are You Free Tonight?
chapters.content:
Chapter 715: Hey Beautiful, Are You Free Tonight?
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
In the private room.
Felix walked in with Yuliana.
There were many people in the private room, and all of them were surrounding a handsome man. This man was the legendary Nikola Chakin.
Felix took a deep breath and walked up to Nikola. He said respectfully, “Mr. Chakin…”
When Nikola saw Felix enter, he looked up and said arrogantly, “I was wondering who it was. It’s you, Felix!”
“Yes, yes, yes, it’s me!” Felix hurriedly nodded and continued, “Mr. Chakin, I told you just now that I have a friend who wants to get to know you. You see…” “Bring her over…” Nikola did not even look at Felix as he replied coldly. Yuliana, who was standing behind Felix, was very regretful.
She could tell that Felix was not Nikola’s friend at all. The conversation between them did not feel like a conversation between friends. Felix was more like Nikola’s underling.
Felix had spent so much effort to get her here because he wanted to use her to please Nikola.
“Yuliana, what are you doing?” Felix frowned and scolded Yuliana, who was behind him.
Yuliana couldn’t help but take a deep breath after hearing Felix’s words.
No matter what, Nikola was a famous man.
Yuliana knew she couldn’t afford to offend this kind of person, so she didn’t dare to be stubborn. She quickly walked up to Nikola and whispered, “Hello, Mr. Chakin. My name is Yuliana…”
“Yuliana?” Nikola smiled faintly and sized up Yuliana.
Although there were many beautiful women in the room, Yuliana was definitely the most beautiful one.
She was the best of the best.
After Nikola sized up Yuliana, he seemed to be very satisfied. Then, he sighed softly, “I didn’t expect Felix to find such a beautiful person this time around…” When Yuliana heard Nikola’s words, a strange look flashed in her eyes.
“It’s a pity that I’m going to marry Florina soon. I will propose to Florina today, so I won’t touch other women.”
Nikola didn’t even bother to avoid Yuliana’s question. He asked his friend if he was interested in her directly.
Yuliana’s face instantly turned red. She never thought that she would be treated like a commodity.
As for Nikola’s friends, each had influential backgrounds.
One of the men, who looked about the same age as Nikola, chuckled and said, “Mr. Chakin, are you really going to let her go?”
“Mr. Salo, if you like her, then I will give her to you. Anyway, I only have Florina now. Florina is too crazy. I don’t have the energy to deal with other women…” Nikola said light-heartedly.
“Hahaha…” When Mr. Salo heard this, he couldn’t help but laugh out loud. Then, he stood up and walked to Yuliana, carefully sizing her up.
At this moment, this Mr. Salo was sizing up a commodity.
“Hey beautiful, are you free tonight? How about we find a place to have a good chat?” Mr. Salo asked Yuliana with a smile.
When Yuliana heard that, she instantly frowned with a disgusted expression.
Although Yuliana wanted to find a suitable benefactor, she didn’t want to sell her body like this.
Yuliana had had a few boyfriends before, but they never had any sexual relations. Yuliana was deliberately keeping them in suspense.
Yuliana knew very well how precious a woman’s virginity was.
If she could make good use of this first time, it would definitely bring her great returns.
At this moment, let alone this Mr. Salo, she would not even agree to Nikola.
The people in the room were all staring at Yuliana as if they were waiting for her answer.
“You might not know what Mr. Salo does for a living. Let me introduce you. Mr. Salo’s family owns a shopping mall. Many big shopping malls in Porthampton belong to Mr. Salo’s family. Moreover, his family has more than ten cinemas in Porthampton…” Nikola introduced Mr. Salo to Yuliana.
Yuliana didn’t seem to have any intention of changing her mind.
She subconsciously turned her head to look at Felix, as if she wanted Felix to help her out.
However, Yuliana probably didn’t know she couldn’t afford to offend these people in the private room.
Felix could not afford to offend these people. Felix was not on the same level as them at all.
Therefore, Felix could only hide in his shell and pretend he did not see anything.
Yuliana knew she couldn’t count on Felix anymore, so she took a deep breath and said softly, “I’m sorry, Mr. Salo. I have something to do tonight…”
Everyone was stunned when they heard Yuliana’s answer. No one expected Yuliana to reject Mr. Salo’s invitation.
If Mr. Salo wanted to get to know Yuliana, Yuliana would have agreed to it.
But now, Mr. Salo only wanted to sleep with her.
There was no way Yuliana would agree to it because she felt she would be no different from hookers.
The easier it was to get something, the less likely it was to be cherished.
Yuliana understood this very well.
“Lady, do you know how many people want this opportunity but can’t get it? Mr. Salo does not fall in love with a lady so easily…” At this moment, a middle-aged man chuckled.
This middle-aged man was the boss of a film company in the country. There were several big stars in the company. Although it was not as good as Nikola’s film company, it was still considered one of the top companies in the country. “That’s right, lady. You must cherish this opportunity!” The others followed suit.
Mr. Salo looked at Yuliana expressionlessly and very calmly.
He knew that Yuliana didn’t agree to his request because she wanted to keep him in suspense and was already used to this..

chapters.title: Chapter 716: An Interesting Woman
chapters.content:
Chapter 716: An Interesting Woman
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Inside the private room.
When Yuliana heard what Mr. Salo and the others said, it became awkward for her.
Yuliana knew that as long as she accepted Mr. Salo’s invitation, her future in the entertainment industry would be bright.
However, if she really slept with Mr. Salo, Yuliana would not be satisfied.
She felt that doing that was way too despicable. She would look down on herself.
“Beauty, there are plenty of beautiful women like you in the entertainment industry. You don’t know how many women are fighting to sleep with Mr. Salo!
“It’s your fortune to have such an opportunity now. You might not understand the entertainment industry, but we have our own rules. If you want to rely on others to climb up, then you have to give something. The more you give, the more you can get. If you don’t give at all, then you naturally won’t get anything…”
At this moment, a director said to Yuliana with a smile.
Although the director’s words were harsh, the people around him were calm.
This was because the director was telling the truth. This kind of thing was not rare in the entertainment industry. On the contrary, it was very common.
Although the celebrities in the entertainment industry looked glamorous on the surface, they were not like that at all.
In the entertainment industry, the ones standing at the bottom were always these celebrities.
Basically, as long as an actor was slightly famous, they had accepted all kinds of unspoken rules. These unspoken rules were not uncommon in the entertainment industry.
After hearing these words, Yuliana started to show some hesitation.
Yuliana knew that this was a rare opportunity. Although she had no way to get in touch with Nikola Chakin, this Mr. Salo was a good man. However, Yuliana knew that her body was her biggest bargaining chip!
Yuliana was still unwilling to give up her body just because of a few words.
“Since you arc unwilling, then forget it. You can come and look for me anytime in the future when you have thought things through…”
Mr. Salo, who was sitting on the sofa, had seen countless women. He naturally knew what Yuliana was thinking at this moment. How could a young master like him be stumped by Yuliana? Therefore, he called out to her expressionlessly.
Felix’s face darkened when he heard Mr. Salo’s words.
“Yuliana, what arc you thinking about?” he shouted at Yuliana. “This is a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity. Arc you really going to give it up?”
“I’m sorry, I’m really busy tonight!”
Yuliana took a deep breath and replied expressionlessly.
Mr. Salo had already said what he said. If she went back on her word now, it would be very embarrassing.
Therefore, she could only grit her teeth and reply to Felix. Then, she turned around and walked out of the private room.
“Yuliana…”
Felix shouted anxiously after Yuliana left.
However, Yuliana wasn’t tempted at all and continued to walk out of the place.
Seeing that she had really left, Mr. Salo couldn’t help but smile. He then reached out and touched his nose. With a playful expression, he said, “Hchc, this woman is quite interesting…”
“I didn’t expect that Mr. Salo would fail!”
Nikola turned his head to look at Mr. Salo and said with a smile.
“It’s just a woman. I don’t lack women by my side. Seeing that she’s still a virgin, I wanted to give her a chance. I didn’t expect her to be so ungrateful. Since she doesn’t know how to cherish this opportunity, then forget it…”
Mr. Salo said casually.
“That’s true. Some girls think that they can manipulate us just because they are beautiful. They don’t know that we can get as many women as we want…”
Nikola nodded lightly.
Hearing what Nikola said, Mr. Salo could not help but be stunned for a moment. Then, he laughed and said, “Mr. Chakin, I heard that you’re going to propose to Florina today.”
“That’s right…”
Nikola nodded lightly.
“Are you done fooling around? You’re actually thinking about getting married?”
Mr. Salo smiled faintly.
“Hahaha, it’s all Florina’s fault for urging me to marry her. I had no choice but to agree!”
Nikola said casually.
“I didn’t expect that Mr. Chakin would want to get married…”
Mr. Salo smiled faintly.
“You will also have such a day…”
Nikola stretched out his hand and gently patted Mr. Salo’s shoulder. Then, he continued, “It’s just that you haven’t met the woman who suits you yet…”
On the other side, Yuliana went to find Connor and the others after leaving the room.
“Yuliana, why are you back?”
Sarina Watts was surprised to see Yuliana come back. She asked Yuliana with a surprised expression.
“I only talked to Mr. Chakin for a bit…”
Yuliana wasn’t a fool. She wouldn’t tell anyone about what happened in the private room. It would be too embarrassing if she did.
“You came back after talking to him for a bit?”
After hearing Yuliana’s words, Cindy’s eyes flashed with shock.
“Yeah. What else could there be?”
Yuliana looked at Cindy expressionlessly.
Cindy smiled awkwardly and didn’t say anything.
“We don’t have much to do here. The party doesn’t start until eight o’clock. Why don’t we go out for a while? The cruise ship seems to have departed. We can go to the deck and take a look at the scenery…”
Sarina noticed that Yuliana seemed to be in a bad mood, so she quickly said with a smile.
“Alright, I’m also feeling bored. Let’s go out for a walk…”
Spencer quickly nodded and replied after hearing her suggestion.
When Connor saw that these people were planning to go out, he naturally did not object. He followed everyone out of the hall and then went to the deck of the cruise ship.
At this moment, the cruise ship had already sailed out of the southeast pier. As far as the eye could see, there was an endless sea.
The sea water in the distance looked like fish scales under the starlight. The scenery was very beautiful, making people feel relaxed and happy.
Connor and the others chatted while looking at the scenery on the sea.

chapters.title: Chapter 717: Proposing to Florina Yacca
chapters.content:
Chapter 717: Proposing to Florina Yacca
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Connor and the others were on the deck, admiring the beautiful scenery by the sea.
In less than five minutes, the party would officially begin.
However, before it started, the lights in the hall suddenly dimmed.
In an instant, the entire banquet hall fell into darkness!
“What happened?”
“Is there a blackout?”
When everyone saw that the lights had dimmed, they instantly fell into a panic.
Some of the more timid girls screamed on the spot.
Because they had no idea what was going on.
“How could there be a blackout? There’s a generator on the Princess Cruise Ship. There’s no way the power would go out!”
“Yeah, this is the first time I’ve heard of a power outage on the Princess Cruise Ship!”
Everyone began to discuss in low voices.
Bang!
At this moment, a dazzling light instantly lit up the entire hall.
Before anyone could react to what was going on, a pleasant music sounded.
Everyone turned to look at the entrance of the hall and saw a few violinists in suits walking into the hall.
Everyone’s eyes were attracted by these musicians, but they were a little puzzled, as if they didn’t understand what was going on.
The light in the hall slowly moved forward with the musicians. Finally, the musicians stopped in front of a woman.
This woman was none other than Florina Yacca!
Florina had already changed into a white dress. She looked stunning, like a princess about to get married. She was elegant and beautiful, dignified and not pretentious.
When the lights shone on Florina, everyone present understood what was going on.
After all, the main character of the party today was Florina’s boyfriend, Nikola Chakin.
As for the violinists, they stood on both sides of Florina and continued to play the violin.
With beautiful music and bright lights, Florina instantly became the focus of everyone’s eyes. Countless people looked at Florina with envious expressions.
How many women in this world could enjoy such noble treatment?
A few minutes later, Nikola walked out of the light wearing a white suit. He stopped in front of Florina.
Florina stared at Nikola with her big, watery eyes. At this moment, she seemed to have guessed what Nikola was going to do.
Nikola looked very handsome at the moment. When he walked in front of Florina, the girls in the hall immediately started screaming.
Nikola himself was very handsome. Coupled with his intimidating background, Nikola’s entire body was emitting waves of charm that made women scream.
There was no woman who could reject a man like Nikola. There were many women who were secretly in love with Nikola. However, they knew in their hearts that with their looks, they were not worthy of Nikola.
Nikola slowly walked up to Florina and took out a bouquet of roses from behind him.
There was a total of ninety-nine roses, and they looked exceptionally beautiful!
At this moment, the lights were on Nikola and Florina.
Nikola knelt on one knee in front of Florina and handed her the ninety-nine roses in his hand.
“Mr. Chakin, are you proposing to Florina?”
“This is too touching. If a boy proposes to me like this, I will definitely agree…”
“Yeah, this is really touching.”
“I’m so touched that I’m about to cry. Actually, we women don’t want much. We don’t care if you have money or not, nor do we care about things like a house or a car. As long as you treat us well with sincerity, that’s all we need. Too bad I can’t meet such a man. If I could meet such a man, I would definitely marry him without any regard for my own safety…”
In an instant, all the girls present were moved.
Some of the girls even started crying. It felt as if Nikola was proposing to them.
At this moment, what these girls were saying were really absurd.
They said that they didn’t like money, but if it was a poor loser who proposed to them with ninety-nine roses, they might still dislike it!
Therefore, the problem was not the roses at all, but the person holding the roses!
“Florina, will you marry me?”
Nikola asked Florina softly.
When Florina heard Nikola’s words, she was stunned. She was in disbelief.
Florina did not expect Nikola to propose to her today.
Florina covered her mouth, her face filled with shock. She was so excited that she did not know what to say.
Everyone present seemed to have realized what was going on. It turned out that after all this fuss, Nikola was planning to propose to Florina!
In an instant, all the women looked at Florina with envy.
After all, being proposed to by a man like Nikola was the ultimate dream of many women.
Some women even began to fantasize deep down. If Nikola was proposing to them at this moment, how good would that be?
Florina was naturally very touched. She took a deep breath and slowly took the bouquet of roses from Nikola’s hands. Then, she said softly, “Yes…”
When Nikola heard that, he revealed a very satisfied smile.
When everyone heard Florina say yes, they instantly burst into a round of applause. Everyone’s expressions were very excited.
At this moment, many of Florina’s friends were also touched by Florina. After all, Florina had worked hard for so long and was finally able to get together with Nikola.
If Florina really married Nikola, then Florina would be married into a wealthy family.
“Florina, can you smell this bouquet of roses?”
Nikola got up and asked Florina with a smile.
Hearing what Nikola was saying, Florina could not help but be stunned. Then, she slowly lifted the roses in her hand and placed them under her nose to smell it.
“Does it smell good?”
Nikola asked with a smile.
“It smells good…”
Florina quickly nodded.
In order to be able to marry Nikola, Florina had used all her skills to please Nikola.
At this moment, let alone a bouquet of roses placed in front of her, even a pile of cow shit would smell good to her.
After all, as long as she could marry Nikola, she would have no worries about food and clothing for the rest of her life.
However, when Florina saw the bouquet of roses in front of her, she was instantly stunned..

chapters.title: Chapter 718: Ten Carat Diamond Ring
chapters.content:
Chapter 718: Ten Carat Diamond Ring
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Florina stared at the bouquet of roses in front of her with her big, watery eyes. She was very excited.
“Is this the proposal ring?”
Florina looked at the ring inside the rose and asked Nikola in disbelief.
“Yes, try it on…”
Nikola laughed as he looked at Florina.
Florina reached out and took out a diamond ring from the roses.
When everyone saw Florina take out the diamond ring, they were all dumbfounded. Their mouths were wide open, and they were indescribably shocked.
This diamond ring was really huge. It was as big as ten carats.
Under the illumination of the lights, it was particularly dazzling.
“Oh my God, this diamond ring is huge…”
“I’ve never seen such a big diamond ring in my life!”
“This diamond ring is really huge. I wonder how much it costs?”
“At least tens of millions…”
“My God, it actually costs tens of millions? This is too terrifying. I reckon that only Mr. Chakin can fork out such a huge sum…”
Everyone looked at the diamond ring in Florina’s hand and began to discuss it in a low voice. Their faces were full of envy.
Which girl wouldn’t like a diamond ring like this?
“Florina, I bought this diamond ring from France for you. It’s as heavy as ten carats, and it’s made from the best diamonds in France. Only a ring like this can express my feelings for you. Only a ring like this can match the unique you…”
Nikola said to Florina affectionately.
Florina was indeed very capable. She was able to charm a playboy like Nikola to such an extent. This was not something that any woman could do.
“Darling, I’m so touched. I didn’t expect you to be so attentive!”
Florina whispered to Nikola.
“Yeah, I guess any woman would be touched!”
“Mr. Chakin is really heroic. He actually prepared such a grand proposal ceremony and even hid the diamond ring in the rose. It’s really touching…”
“Mr. Chakin is simply the most romantic man in the world. He even prepared such a big diamond ring. He must have spent a lot of money!”
“It would be great if I could find a man like Mr. Chakin. I would be willing to live ten years less…”
All the girls looked at Florina with envy.
Of course, they didn’t know what romance was. They didn’t care if this man was sincere or not. They only cared about the ten-carat diamond ring.
“Kiss…”
“Kiss…”
At this moment, someone started shouting.
Nikola slowly walked up to Florina and gently hugged her slender waist. He lowered his head and kissed her.
Snap!
Snap!
The audience in the hall took out their phones to record this touching scene.
A few seconds later, the lights lit up again, and everyone instantly cheered.
As the lights lit up again, the party officially began.
Florina hesitated for a moment before she walked up to Celine Chalphy. Then, she secretly handed Celine the diamond ring that Nikola had given her.
Celine glanced at Florina and said in a low voice, “Florina, this is…”
“I’ve changed my mind…”
Florina smiled, then leaned into Celine’s ear and whispered something to her.
After hearing what Florina said, Celine’s seemed to be even more shocked.
“As long as you do well, I will definitely not mistreat you in the future…”
Florina whispered to Celine.
Celine took a deep breath and said in a low voice, “Florina, don’t worry. I will definitely not disappoint you…”
After saying this, Celine directly walked toward Yelena.
When Florina saw Celine walk over, she smiled faintly and sighed. “You are just a little girl who appeared out of nowhere, and you actually want to fight with me. How ridiculous…”
Celine quickly walked to Yelena, then looked at Yelena from head to toe, and softly shouted at Yelena, “Yelena, did you bring lipstick? I want to touch up my makeup…”
At this moment, Yelena was chatting with a well-known director in the country.
When she heard Celine’s words, she couldn’t help but turn to look at Celine. Then, she said softly, “I didn’t bring lipstick. You can ask someone else!”
“You didn’t bring it, or you don’t want to lend it to me?”
Celine seemed to be a little unhappy as she shouted.
“I really didn’t…”
Yelena replied with a helpless expression.
11 II
When Celine heard Yelena’s words, she was instantly dumbfounded. She felt very awkward.
She didn’t expect Yelena to not bring her makeup bag, which ruined all of Celine’s plans.
However, Celine reacted very quickly. When she saw that her plan had failed, she walked straight to the director who was chatting with Yelena in her high heels and whispered a few words to the director.
When the director heard Celine’s words, his face changed instantly. He looked at Yelena and snorted coldly before turning around and leaving.
“Mr. Wool, why are you leaving?”
Yelena hurriedly called out after seeing the director leave.
The director did not even look at Yelena and walked away.
Yelena wasn’t a fool. She knew that it must be because Celine had said something to the director. Otherwise, why would he leave without even saying goodbye when Yelena was chatting with the director just now?
After the director had left, Yelena took a deep breath and turned to Celine. “What did you say to Mr. Wool?”
“What does what I said to Mr. Wool have to do with you? That’s between the two of us…”
Celine pursed her lips and said indifferently.
“Why you…”
When Yelena heard Celine’s words, she froze on the spot; she was extremely furious.
However, Yelena did not want to cause trouble right now, so she took a deep breath and turned around to leave.
Celine did not expect Yelena to be so patient. She hurriedly shouted, “Yelena, don’t you want to know what I said to that director just now?”
“What did you say?”
Yelena looked back at Celine and asked with a puzzled expression.
“I said you’re a b*tch who will sleep with anyone!”
Celine answered directly..

chapters.title: Chapter 719: A Trap
chapters.content:
Chapter 719: A Trap
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
“I said you’re a bitch!”
When Yelena heard what Celine said, she was instantly stunned. She was very shocked.
Because there was no grudge between Yelena and Celine.
However, Yelena really couldn’t understand why Celine would treat her like this. Was it because she didn’t lend her lipstick to Celine?
“Why are you doing this?”
Yelena asked Celine in confusion.
“There’s no need for a reason. I just don’t like you…”
Celine replied indifferently and then continued, “And you’re a real b*tch. I heard that your boyfriend is also a loser, a loser who delivers food!”
Florina’s initial plan was to make Celine deliberately provoke Yelena, and then the two of them would have a conflict.
Then, Florina would make use of Nikola’s power to kick Yelena off the cruise ship. Then, she would find the media to write some news about it. This way, Yelena would become a joke.
When Quentin Lowe was choosing actors, he always paid great attention to the reputation of the actors.
Therefore, Florina felt that after this commotion, Quentin would definitely not be able to let Yelena continue playing the female lead.
However, when Florina saw the diamond ring that Nikola had given her, she was shocked.
Florina instantly changed her mind. She felt that since she was going to do it, she might as well be ruthless and accuse Yelena of stealing her diamond ring.
If that was the case, not only would Yelena not be able to get the female lead role, but she would also not be able to survive in the entertainment industry in the future.
Celine planned to hide the diamond ring in Yelena’s makeup bag when she wasn’t paying attention.
However, she did not expect Yelena to not bring her makeup bag with her.
Celine could only use her old plan to provoke Yelena.
“What did you just say?”
When Yelena heard Celine insulting Connor McDonald, the expression on her face instantly changed.
Yelena simply couldn’t accept others insulting Connor like this.
“Didn’t you hear what I said just now? I said you’re a b*tch, and your boyfriend is a loser…”
Seeing that Yelena had been triggered and shouted proudly.
Smack!
Yelena did not hesitate at all. She raised her hand and slapped Celine’s face.
Celine took two steps back before she steadied herself. Then, she widened her watery eyes and looked very surprised.
“Celine, I’m warning you, don’t go too far!”
Yelena pointed at Celine and shouted.
“Stinky b*tch, you dare hit me? I’ll fight you to the death today!”
Celine shouted excitedly and then pounced on Yelena.
Celine rushed to Yelena and grabbed her.
However, Celine was almost ten centimeters shorter than Yelena, and Yelena had practiced Taekwondo before. Celine was not her match at all.
Yelena slapped Celine’s face again.
Celine took two steps back and fell to the ground.
“Help! Someone help me!”
After Celine fell to the ground, she sat on the ground and shouted loudly like a shrew.
When everyone heard Celine’s scream, they all turned to look at Celine.
When they saw the scene in front of them, everyone’s eyes widened, and they were extremely shocked.
They had never expected that someone would have the guts to cause trouble at the gala.
After all, this was Florina’s birthday party, and Nikola had just proposed to Florina. Yet, someone dared to cause trouble here. Wasn’t this clearly not giving Nikola face?
Moreover, these people were all so-called successful people, so they looked down on brawls.
For a moment, everyone looked at Yelena with disdain.
Yelena took a deep breath and turned to leave.
However, at this moment, a few strong men who looked like bodyguards rushed out and blocked Yelena’s way.
“You were the one who hit her just now, right?”
One of the bodyguards asked Yelena with widened eyes.
“That’s right, I was the one who hit her, but she scolded me first…”
Yelena replied expressionlessly.
“What happened? Who has the guts to cause trouble in my territory…”
At this moment, Nikola also noticed the situation. He brought Florina to Yelena and Celine’s side and shouted coldly with a frown.
“Mr. Chakin, these two people are causing trouble here. I will deal with them immediately…”
The bodyguard was so frightened that he quickly replied.
Nikola turned to look at Yelena, then at Celine, and said, “What are these two people doing? Why don’t I know these two people? Are they guests of the gala?”
When the bodyguard heard Nikola’s words, he was flabbergasted.
The bodyguard did not expect that Nikola had no idea who these two people were.
If Nikola didn’t know these two people, then it could only mean one thing. These two people had sneaked in.
“How did you two get in? Show me your invitation card…”
The bodyguard shouted expressionlessly.
When Yelena heard the bodyguard’s words, she was instantly dumbfounded. Her mouth was wide open, but she could not speak.
Because she came with Mr. Coffin, she did not have an invitation card.
Florina, on the other hand, looked at Yelena with a smug expression. She knew that she had achieved her goal.
‘Now we just have to wait and watch a good show…’
Florina thought to herself.
The guests present also had a puzzled expression on their faces.
“Did these two women really sneak in?”
“If they really sneaked in, it will be troublesome. Mr. Chakin will definitely not let the two of them off easily…”
“I really don’t know what these two women are thinking. They clearly sneaked in, yet they actually dare to cause trouble here…”
“These two people are definitely going to die today…”
Everyone began to discuss in low voices.
“I’m talking to the two of you. Are you mute? How did the two of you get in?
Hurry up and take out your invitation card…”
The bodyguard shouted when he saw that Yelena and Celine were silent.
Celine turned and looked at Florina.
“Hubby, this is Celine, my good friend…”
Florina walked to Celine and helped her up as she spoke to Nikola in a sweet voice..

chapters.title: Chapter 720: Throw Her Into the Sea
chapters.content:
Chapter 720: Throw Her Into the Sea
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
After hearing what Florina said, Nikola’s became a little angry.
He turned to look at Yelena and said, “You actually hit Florina’s friend. Damn it. Do you know this person?”
“This person?”
Florina looked at Yelena with a playful expression and said lightly, “Of course, I know her. She’s Yelena Allen. She’s in the same production team as me…”
When Yelena heard Florina’s words, a strange look flashed across her eyes.
She did not expect Florina to speak up for her.
“But hubby, I didn’t invite Yelena to the party. I don’t know how she got in…”
Florina helped Celine up as she spoke.
‘You b*tch, let’s see how you are going to fight me…’
Florina looked at Yelena, who was not far away, with a hint of sinister and smug in her eyes.
Yelena looked helpless, but she didn’t say anything.
Because Yelena had already guessed that Florina would not be so kind as to help her, she would definitely hit her when she was down.
In an instant, everyone’s eyes were focused on Yelena.
Yelena had sneaked in and even beat up Florina’s friend. Wasn’t this clearly courting death?
“This girl is really bold. Not only did she dare to sneak in, but she also dared to cause trouble here…”
“She’s simply courting death. She’s definitely going to die today…”
“Yeah, she actually dared to cause trouble at Mr. Chakin’s banquet. Does she want to die so badly? I really don’t know what this woman was thinking!” Everyone began to discuss in low voices.
Florina became even more smug. She had achieved her goal, so she would leave the rest to Nikola.
Nikola looked at Yelena coldly and said with a vicious expression, “Since you sneaked in and even beat up Florina’s friend, don’t blame me for being rude…”
II II
Yelena looked at Nikola with a hint of nervousness in her eyes because she knew how terrifying a person like Nikola was.
“Bodyguard, throw this woman off the ship and let her swim to shore by herself…”
Nikola shouted expressionlessly.
“Mr. Chakin, what if this woman doesn’t know how to swim?”
The bodyguard was stunned for a moment and asked softly.
“That’s her own business. It has nothing to do with me…”
Nikola replied indifferently.
“Alright, Mr. Chakin, I understand…”
The bodyguard nodded gently and walked toward Yelena.
When Yelena heard the conversation between the bodyguard and Nikola, she was so frightened that she took two steps back. She was also very frightened.
Because Yelena couldn’t swim. Even if Yelena could swim, she was just a woman.
Now that the cruise ship had sailed so far, it was impossible for her to swim ashore!
Yelena had not expected Nikola to be so ruthless as to throw her off the ship.
Yelena started to feel nervous. She quickly looked around, hoping that someone would stand up for her.
However, all the people who came to attend the party were rich heirs from Davenport or big shots in the entertainment industry.
If it were any other time, there would definitely be people who would be moved by Yelena’s figure and looks and stand up to plead for her.
However, the people Yelena had offended were Florina and Nikola.
With so many people present, no one dared to offend the two of them at all!
Therefore, at this moment, not only did no one step out to help Yelena, but they also looked at Yelena with a gloating expression. They felt that Yelena had brought this upon herself.
Yelena looked helplessly at the people around her. She felt as if the air around her had frozen. This feeling was really suffocating.
This was the first time Yelena felt how terrifying these people were!
“Wasn’t that woman very arrogant just now? Why is her face so pale now?”
“That’s right. I thought that she was a powerful big shot just now. She actually dared to cause trouble here. I didn’t expect her to just be a poor person who had sneaked in. It’s really absurd…”
“Since she sneaked in, then she should just stay out of trouble. Yet, she insisted on causing trouble here. Now that she’s caused such a huge commotion, she will probably die in the sea…”
“This person is really too arrogant. She has to be taught a lesson. Otherwise, who knows what trouble she might cause…”
Everyone looked at Yelena and pointed at her as they discussed softly.
“I’m sorry…”
At this moment, the bodyguard had already walked up to Yelena.
Yelena gasped and took two steps back.
However, there was a wall behind Yelena, so she had no way to retreat.
“Am I really going to die here?”
Although Yelena seemed calm, she was actually very scared.
She knew that everything that was happening was real. Since Nikola said that he was going to throw her off the ship, then these bodyguards would really throw her off.
Yelena had never thought that she would cause so much trouble just from slapping Celine.
Florina looked at Yelena with a smile. She could not wait to see Yelena being thrown into the sea.
Because as long as Yelena was thrown into the sea, then the female lead of Quentin Lowe’s movie would definitely be hers.
“Mr. Chakin, wait a moment!”
At this moment, Mr. Coffin suddenly rushed out from the crowd and shouted excitedly.
When Nikola saw Mr. Coffin, he couldn’t help but look at him. Then, he asked expressionlessly, “Who are you? What’s the matter?”
“Hubby, this is Mr. Coffin from our production team…”
Florina explained softly.
“I see!”
Nikola nodded his head gently. Then, he looked at Mr. Coffin and asked, “Is there something you need?”
“Mr. Chakin, I brought Yelena in. Can you not throw Yelena off the ship on my account…”
Mr. Coffin looked at Nikola nervously.
When Nikola heard Mr. Coffin’s words, he could not help but sneer. Then, he said indifferently, “Mr. Coffin, are you dumb? Who do you think you are? Why should I not do this on your account?”
When Mr. Coffin heard Nikola’s words, he was instantly dumbfounded. He stood rooted to the ground with a look of despair on his face..

chapters.title: Chapter 721: Queens Lowe’s Arrival
chapters.content:
Chapter 721: Queens Lowe’s Arrival
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Mr. Coffin did not have much status in the entertainment industry. Moreover, Florina’s movie was also his first movie.
Therefore, Nikola did not take Mr. Coffin seriously at all.
If it were any other time, Mr. Coffin would not have stepped forward to plead for Yelena.
No one would offend a big shot like Nikola for an unknown actress.
However, Mr. Coffin knew that Queens Lowe was very satisfied with Yelena. If Yelena could pass the test and become the female lead of Queens’s movie, Mr. Coffin could become the director of that movie, so Yelena was very important to Mr. Coffin now.
If Yelena was thrown off the cruise ship, then his collaboration with Queens would be ruined. That was why Mr. Coffin chose to stand up for her now.
“Mr. Chakin Jr., I beg you, please give Yelena a chance. Yelena knows that she’s done something wrong. Please give her a way out, okay?”
Mr. Coffin begged Nikola humbly.
Smack!
When Nikola heard Mr. Coffin’s words, he did not even think about it and slapped Mr. Coffin in the face. Then, he glared at him and shouted, “Didn’t you hear what I said just now?”
“Mr. Chakin Jr…”
Mr. Coffin covered his face with an extremely embarrassed expression. For a moment, he did not know what to do.
Nikola looked at Mr. Coffin coldly, then walked up to Yelena expressionlessly. He sized her up and said in a very cold tone, “Do you know what this place is?”
II II
Yelena looked at Nikola without saying anything.
At this moment, Yelena already realized what kind of danger she was in. She was also very afraid deep down. She was worried that she would really be thrown off the ship.
If she really died here, then she would never be able to see Connor again.
Initially, Yelena was thinking of having Connor be her agent after he graduated!
But now, all of her plans were for naught. Yelena knew that since Nikola dared to say such words, then Nikola might really do it.
“You b*tch, I’m asking you a question. Do you know what this place is?”
Nikola shouted at Yelena angrily when she did not respond.
“This is a cruise party…”
Yelena took a deep breath and replied in a low voice.
“That’s right, this is a cruise party, my party! Then let me ask you, what did you do just now?”
Nikola looked down at Yelena and continued to ask.
Yelena took a deep breath and looked at Nikola without saying anything.
“Since you don’t know, let me tell you. There are countless rich people and socialites here in this party, and there are also many producers and directors in the entertainment industry. Those who can come to the party are all my friends, but you, a b*tch, actually beat up a guest of the party. Is this a place where you can behave so atrociously? Tell me!”
Nikola stared at her and shouted at Yelena with an angry expression.
“That’s right. Mr. Chakin Jr. just proposed to Miss Yacca. It was such a romantic moment, but it’s all ruined because of you, you b*tch!”
“That’s right. This is simply a humiliation to Mr. Chakin Jr. and Miss Yacca…”
“She actually dared to cause trouble at Mr. Chakin Jr.’s proposal ceremony. She’s really shameless!”
“A grand banquet has been ruined by this woman just like that. She is really detestable. This kind of woman needs to be punished severely…”
“That’s right. If we don’t throw her into the sea today, that’s going easy on her!”
The so-called upper-class people present all stood on Nikola’s side and scolded Yelena.
When Mr. Coffin heard what these people said, he felt a little helpless.
If he continued to plead for Yelena, he might be implicated.
Therefore, after hesitating for a moment, Mr. Coffin silently retreated and looked at Yelena apologetically.
At this moment, Yelena had lost the last person who could speak up for her.
“Alright, stop talking nonsense. Hurry up and do it!”
Nikola seemed to be getting impatient. He frowned and shouted at the bodyguards in front of him.
Hearing Nikola’s words, the bodyguards walked toward Yelena again.
Nikola stood beside Florina and wrapped his arms around her slender waist with a smug smile on his face.
At this moment, Florina also revealed a proud smile on her face. She had finally gotten rid of this big problem in her life.
Therefore, she pretended to be intimate and placed her head on Nikola’s shoulder. Then, she looked at Yelena with a smug expression.
Celine Chalphy was also very happy at this moment because she did not expect things to go so well.
She had only gotten slapped twice by Yelena, and she could get the role of the female lead in a movie. This was much easier than sleeping with those directors and producers.
After all, those so-called directors were not so easy to serve.
If those directors had weird kinks, she would not have a good ending.
At this moment, Nikola’s bodyguards walked in front of Yelena, their expressions extremely fierce.
In front of these strong men, Yelena seemed particularly weak and pitiful.
Yelena’s beautiful eyes were filled with fear and despair. She did not know what to do.
“I’m sorry…”
One of the bodyguards shouted at Yelena expressionlessly. Then, he reached out to grab Yelena’s arm.
“Mr. Chakin Jr., what made you so angry?”
At this moment, a voice came from the crowd.
When everyone heard this voice, they all turned to look behind them.
A beautiful young woman with a cold temperament walked out of the crowd in high heels.
When everyone saw this beautiful young woman, they were all stunned, and they were in shock.
Nikola couldn’t help but turn to look at the beautiful young woman. He looked a little surprised, and Florina was even more surprised.
“Ms. Lowe, why… why are you here?”
Nikola was stunned for a moment before he stammered.
At this moment, the beautiful young woman who walked out of the crowd was none other than the producer, Queens Lowe, that Yelena had just met.
Yelena looked at Queens who walked out from the crowd with a face filled with surprise. She was also extremely shocked.
Because Yelena did not expect that Queens would stand up for her at this moment!

chapters.title: Chapter 722: Someone Stole the Diamond Ring
chapters.content:
Chapter 722: Someone Stole the Diamond Ring
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Although Queens was already close to 40 years old, but because she had been taking good care of herself, she gave off the feeling of a 20-year-old young lady.
Queens was dressed very sexily. Her long black hair cascaded down her shoulders like a waterfall. Her skin was smooth and delicate. She wore a silver necklace on her collarbone. The texture was intricate, and she looked extremely dazzling.
Dressed in a black professional dress, it accentuated her sexy and hot figure. Her slender and fair legs were exposed for all to see.
Queens was considered the best of the best. Even when compared to the female celebrities present, she was not inferior in any way.
When everyone saw her, they were all shocked.
Because Queens was very famous in the entertainment industry; basically, all the celebrities in the entertainment industry knew Queens.
They didn’t think that Queens would actually stand up for Yelena.
“Ms. Lowe, do you know this person?”
Nikola and Queens were considered acquaintances. In addition, he knew that Queens was not a woman to be trifled with, so Nikola was polite.
The reason why Queens chose to step forward was because she felt that Yelena was very suitable for her movie. If she didn’t manage to get Yelena on board, she might not be able to find such a suitable female lead again.
Therefore, for the sake of her film, Queens chose to stand up for Yelena.
“I know her. Mr. Chakin Jr., can you give me face and let her go today?”
Queens asked Nikola softly.
When Nikola heard Queens’s words, a weird look flashed across his eyes, and he seemed somewhat troubled.
When Florina saw what was happening, she was livid.
She thought that her plan was going to succeed, but she didn’t expect Queens disrupt all her plans.
However, Florina knew that she had made the right choice to deal with Yelena.
If it wasn’t because Queens wanted Yelena to be the female lead, then Queens wouldn’t have stood out to speak for Yelena.
“This damned b*tch Yelena…”
Florina’s eyes flashed with anger.
Queens walked over to Nikola and asked him softly, “Mr. Chakin Jr., you will let her go for my sake, right?”
“Ms. Lowe…”
Nikola took a deep breath and said in a low voice, “Ms. Lowe, what are you talking about? How can I not give you face? Since you know this woman, I’ll let her go for your sake.”
“Thank you…”
Queens smiled faintly when she heard Nikola’s words. She then walked toward Yelena in her high heels.
Florina didn’t think that Nikola would be so afraid of Queens.
She could have had Yelena killed, but Nikola actually let Yelena go just like that. Florina was furious.
“Ms. Lowe, thank you…”
Yelena did not expect that the person who saved her in the end would actually be Queens, so she said to Queens gratefully.
“You’re welcome. Come with me!”
Queens whispered to Yelena.
Yelena took a deep breath and was about to leave with Queens.
“Ah…”
But at that moment, Florina suddenly screamed.
When everyone heard Florina’s scream, they were all shocked and turned to look at Florina.
Nikola turned to look at Florina too. Then, he looked at her in confusion and asked, “Florina, what’s wrong?”
“Dear, something bad has happened. The… the diamond ring you gave me just now is gone…”
Florina was not willing to let Yelena go just like that, so after her first plan failed, she thought of a backup plan.
If she were to frame Yelena for stealing her diamond ring, then even if Queens wanted to speak up for Yelena, it would be useless.
After all, Yelena was a thief, and Queens would not protect a thief.
When everyone heard Florina’s words, they were all shocked.
No one expected someone to be so bold as to steal the engagement ring that Nikola had given Florina for the proposal.
The ring was priceless. It was worth at least tens of millions. If anyone dared to steal that ring, they must be insane!
“You lost your diamond ring?”
When Nikola heard Florina’s words, a trace of shock flashed across his eyes.
“Yes! My ring was clearly here just now, but someone must have stolen it. It’s gone…”
Florina was an actress, and she was very good at acting.
So she pretended to search carefully and said anxiously.
“Miss Yacca, have you forgotten where you left the ring?”
At this moment, a middle-aged man frowned and asked Florina.
When Florina heard the middle-aged man’s words, she seemed to become even more anxious.
She couldn’t help but pout and shout, “Are you kidding me? How could I have misplaced such an important thing? I was just wearing it. It must have been stolen by someone…”
Nikola’s face darkened when he saw how anxious Florina was.
He frowned and roared angrily, “Who the hell has the guts to steal from my engagement party?”
Everyone looked at Nikola.
“Who stole the ring? Hurry up and hand it over. I won’t f*cking make things difficult for you. Otherwise, if I catch you, I’ll definitely break your head myself…”
Nikola’s eyes widened as he shouted at the crowd angrily.
When everyone heard Nikola’s words, they lowered their heads one after another. No one dared to speak.
For a moment, the entire hall fell into a dead silence.
They knew that things had escalated.
Someone actually dared to steal the engagement ring that Nikola had given Florina. How bold was that!
At this moment, this matter was much more serious than the matter of Yelena hitting someone just now!
Just now, Nikola had given the ring to Florina in front of so many people. Not to mention how much the ring was worth, just the sentiment behind it could not be measured by money.
However, it had only be half an hour since Florina got the ring, and now it was gone.
If other people were to find out about this, wouldn’t it be humiliating for Nikola?

chapters.title: Chapter 723: Strip Off Her Clothes
chapters.content:
Chapter 723: Strip Off Her Clothes
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
On the Princess Cruise Ship.
Everyone thought that with Queens stepping out to save Yelena, this farce was considered over.
However, what they did not expect was that the diamond ring that Nikola had given Florina had been stolen.
In Nikola’s eyes, this was definitely a great humiliation. He simply could not accept such a thing.
“Are you all mute?”
Nikola shouted after seeing that everyone was silent.
Everyone looked at Nikola with a very serious expression on their faces.
They knew in their hearts that now was not the time to joke around. If they were to get into trouble, their lives would be in danger at any time.
“Since no one admits to stealing the ring, don’t blame me for what’s going to happen next…”
Nikola’s eyes widened as he shouted. Then, he continued, “All bodyguards, seal off the exit of the hall immediately. No one is allowed to leave. I want to see who has the guts to steal my engagement ring today…”
When the bodyguards heard Nikola’s words, they all ran toward the exit.
In an instant, the exit of the banquet hall was surrounded by more than a dozen bodyguards. No one could leave, and these bodyguards were all on standby.
“Mr. Chakin Jr., what should we do next?”
At this moment, the leading bodyguard walked up to Nikola and asked him softly.
“Everyone, I’m sorry. I hope everyone can cooperate with me. I want to search everyone!”
Nikola shouted at the crowd expressionlessly.
When everyone heard Nikola’s words, they frowned.
After all, these people were all so-called upper-class people. If they were really searched by these people, it would be very embarrassing.
However, these people knew that the ring was very important to Nikola. If anyone dared to stand up and go against Nikola, it would prove that they were guilty. Therefore, even if these people were unwilling, they could only silently accept it.
Florina looked at Celine Chalphy anxiously.
When Celine saw Florina’s gaze, she instantly understood what Florina meant.
She quickly stood up and said to Nikola, “Mr. Chakin Jr., you don’t need to search everyone. I know who stole the diamond ring…”
“You know who stole the diamond ring?”
When Nikola heard Celine’s words, he could not help but be stunned for a moment. He was a little shocked.
In fact, Nikola also felt that it would be too much to search everyone.
Not only would it waste a lot of time, but it would also offend a lot of people.
However, if Celine knew who stole the diamond ring, things would be much simpler.
“You said you know who stole the diamond ring. Then tell me now, who stole it?!”
Nikola’s eyes widened as he asked Celine.
When Celine heard Nikola’s words, she looked at everyone present.
When everyone saw Celine’s gaze, they were a little puzzled.
They couldn’t understand who had the guts to steal Nikola’s diamond ring!
“I really don’t know what this person is thinking. Of all things to steal, he actually stole Mr. Chakin Jr.’s diamond ring…”
“That’s right. That ring is someone else’s engagement ring. Even if you steal it, no matter who you sell it to, people will find out…”
“There must be something wrong with this person’s head. Otherwise, he definitely wouldn’t have done such a stupid thing…”
Everyone present began to discuss in low voices.
Celine’s gaze finally landed on Yelena. She then pointed at Yelena and shouted, “The person who stole Mr. Chakin Jr.’s ring is Yelena Allen!”
When everyone heard Celine’s words, they were all stunned.
Queens, who was standing beside Yelena, also subconsciously raised her head to look at Yelena. She looked shocked.
“Celine, what nonsense are you talking about? When did I steal Florina’s ring?”
Yelena shouted at Celine with her big, watery eyes.
Previously, Yelena and Celine had a conflict, so everyone did not really believe Celine.
A hint of disdain flashed across Celine’s eyes. Then, she pursed her lips and said, “What are you still denying it? Didn’t you hit me because I found out that you stole the ring?”
“You… You’re simply spouting nonsense…”
Yelena’s big watery eyes widened as she shouted at Yelena angrily.
The people present seemed to believe Celine’s words.
“Only a woman like her would do such a thing. After all, all of us here are people with principle. Only this woman is a nobody. Why would we even steal anything? It’s not like we need to do that. It must be her…”
“This b*tch must really be crazy. She even dares to steal Mr. Chakin Jr.’s engagement ring. I really don’t know what she’s thinking…”
“Yeah, this kind of woman is really disgusting!”
Everyone stood up and began to criticize Yelena.
A trace of helplessness flashed across Yelena’s eyes. Then, she frowned and said, “I don’t know what you’re talking about, but I really didn’t steal the ring…”
Queens turned her head and glanced indifferently at Yelena; she appeared somewhat puzzled.
She felt that things were definitely not that simple. Otherwise, Yelena would not have encountered trouble one after another!
‘Yelena must have offended someone!’
Queens’s eyes flashed with a trace of helplessness.
“If you hand over the ring now, I won’t lower myself to the level of a person like you for the sake of Ms. Lowe…”
Nikola took a deep breath and shouted at Yelena in a low voice.
When Yelena heard Nikola’s words, a trace of helplessness flashed across her eyes. She then frowned and said in a low voice, “I don’t know what you’re talking about. I’ve not even seen that ring before, and I’ve never stolen anything…”
“Why are you still denying it?!”
Nikola looked at Yelena and sneered.
“Mr. Chakin Jr., just strip her clothes off and you’ll know if she stole it.”
At this moment, a middle-aged man suddenly shouted..

chapters.title: Chapter 724: The Helpless Yelena Allen
chapters.content:
Chapter 724: The Helpless Yelena Allen
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
“That’s right, we should take off her clothes!”
“Take off all her clothes. The ring must be with her!”
“She won’t admit it unless we find it!”
At this moment, everyone seemed to have already determined that Yelena had stolen the ring, so they shouted angrily.
When Yelena heard these people’s words, she was instantly dumbfounded. She was very desperate.
“Celine, search her body now and see if the ring is on her!”
Florina knew that the engagement ring was definitely not with Yelena now, but in Celine’s hands.
So, she deliberately had Celine search Yelena, because in this way, Celine could secretly stuff the ring on Florina.
“The two of you, help me hold her…”
Celine shouted at the two bodyguards beside her.
When the bodyguards heard Celine’s order, they ran to Yelena and firmly restrained her.
Yelena was just a weak woman. Naturally, she could not be compared to the two burly bodyguards.
And at this moment, Queens was standing beside Yelena, and she looked extremely helpless.
Because this matter was beyond her control.
Celine walked up to Yelena and secretly reached into her clothes to take out the diamond ring that Florina had given her.
Celine’s actions were very subtle, so no one noticed at all.
However, Yelena noticed Celine’s action, but she didn’t know what Celine was doing.
At this moment Yelena was not very afraid because she knew that the ring was definitely not on her.
Celine held the ring tightly in her hand and pretended to feel around Yelena’s clothes. Then, she put her hand into Florina’s pocket and revealed a smug smile.
“Yelena, what is this?”
Celine took her hand out of Yelena’s pocket.
At this moment, Celine was holding a diamond ring in her hand.
And this diamond ring happened to be the proposal ring that Nikola had given Florina!
“What…”
Yelena looked at the diamond ring in Celine’s hand with an incredulous expression.
She would have never imagined that the ring would appear on her!
However, Yelena reacted fast. She suddenly thought of Celine’s previous action.
Therefore, she quickly realized that Celine and Florina were obviously working together to frame her.
“You put this diamond ring on me, didn’t you?”
Yelena took a deep breath and asked Celine in a low voice.
“Yelena, oh Yelena, are you out of your mind? I found this ring in your pocket. Why are you accusing me instead?”
Celine pouted and replied arrogantly.
“She really stole the ring!”
“This woman is really cunning. She stole Miss Yacca’s engagement ring and still refuses to admit it…”
“That’s right. What is this woman trying to do?”
“First, she sneaked into the party, then she has a conflict with a guest attending the party. Now, she stole Mr. Chakin Jr. and Miss Yacca’s engagement ring. She’s too despicable. Such a person should be beaten to death…”
“That’s right. This kind of woman should be beaten to death. She’s really despicable…”
In an instant, everyone present fell into an uproar.
Everyone’s face was filled with rage. It was as if the person who had lost the ring was not Nikola, but them.
“I was nowhere near Florina. There’s no way I stole her ring…”
When Yelena heard what everyone said, she shouted in response.
“How would I not know if you were anywhere near me?”
Florina pouted and shouted.
“I…”
Yelena opened her mouth, wanting to explain.
However, at this moment, Nikola stepped forward and slapped Yelena across the face.
Bang!
Yelena staggered back two steps and fell to the ground. She shouted with an aggrieved expression, “I really didn’t steal Florina’s ring…”
“How dare you still f*cking deny it? You’re so shameless. You even dare to steal my engagement ring…”
Nikola shouted.
“Yeah, this woman is really shameless. I didn’t expect her to steal my ring. I’m so angry…”
Florina called out sweetly to Nikola.
Nikola turned to look at Florina and said gently, “Darling, don’t be angry. I will definitely help you teach this b*tch a lesson today…”
“Okay!”
Florina quickly nodded and continued, “I finally understand now. That was why Yelena dared to attack Celine. She deliberately wanted to blow this matter up because she knew in her heart that as long as she made a huge deal out of this, we would definitely be very angry and chase her out. Then, she would be able to leave openly with this ring. Luckily, I discovered it in time. If she had left just like that, her plan would have succeeded…”
When everyone heard Florina’s words, they all sucked in a breath of cold air.
No one expected Yelena to be so scheming!
Queens looked helplessly at Yelena, before saying in a low voice, “Nikola and I are just acquaintances. I don’t care if you stole this ring or not. I can’t do anything about it now.”
Queens had already done everything she could, and now she had no other choice.
Therefore, she took two steps back and returned to the crowd.
Yelena thought that all her troubles were over, but she did not expect to fall into Florina and Celine’s trap.
“This woman is really too scheming…”
“A woman’s heart is really the most vicious!”
“If Mr. Chakin Jr. had really driven this person out just now, she could have left undetected. Her companions might be waiting for her outside now!”
“Yeah, it’s hard to imagine that all of this was planned by this woman. She must have an accomplice!”
Everyone looked at Yelena and began to discuss softly.
Nikola was also extremely angry. He gritted his teeth and whispered to Yelena, “I didn’t think that you would dare to mess with me. If it wasn’t for Florina discovering that the ring was missing, I would have chased you out just now.”
“I really didn’t steal the ring…”
Yelena sat on the ground and exclaimed helplessly..

chapters.title: Chapter 725: Chop Off Her Right Hand
chapters.content:
Chapter 725: Chop Off Her Right Hand
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Seeing that Yelena was still trying to deny it, Nikola was extremely angry.
This was because Nikola felt that this was very embarrassing. There was nothing more embarrassing than this.
Florina had always been a woman who understood men’s thoughts. She knew that Nikola was in a very bad mood at the moment.
Therefore, she whispered to Nikola, “Hubby, don’t be too angry. It’s all Yelena’s fault for being so cunning. If it weren’t for her being so cunning, we wouldn’t have been fooled…”
“I have to properly deal with this. Otherwise, if this gets out, it’s utterly humiliating!”
Nikola gritted his teeth and replied in a low voice.
“That’s right. This kind of person should be dealt with ruthlessly!”
Florina naturally wouldn’t let go of such a good opportunity to kick Yelena when she was down.
Nikola felt a little scared just thinking about it. If Florina hadn’t discovered it early, he might have been humiliated today.
Just now, if it wasn’t for Queens’s appearance, Nikola might have already thrown Yelena off the ship.
Yelena would have then run away with the diamond ring.
Even if Nikola searched all the guests in the hall, he wouldn’t be able to find this ring!
“Mr. Chakin Jr., how do you plan to deal with this woman?”
At this moment, the bodyguard leading the group frowned and asked Nikola in a low voice.
When Nikola heard the bodyguard’s words, his eyes revealed a hint of viciousness. Then, he shouted expressionlessly, “Cut off this woman’s right hand and throw it into the sea to feed the fish…”
“Alright…”
The bodyguard hurriedly nodded.
“Don’t make any mistakes. I want to see her die in the sea with my own eyes.
Do you understand what I mean?”
Nikola repeated coldly.
“I.. I understand…”
The bodyguard nodded again.
When the guests heard Nikola’s words, they became even more shocked.
They knew that Nikola had already set his mind on killing Yelena.
However, no one pitied Yelena at this moment because they all felt that she deserved this.
“This kind of woman should die…”
“That’s right. She asked for it. She actually dared to steal Mr. Chakin Jr.’s ring…”
“This is the first time I’ve met such a shameless woman. Hurry up and kill this woman…”
A few rich heirs who had a good relationship with Nikola began to pander to him. They were being very vicious.
Yelena sat helplessly on the ground; her face filled with despair.
Because she knew that even if she begged now, it would be useless. Moreover, no one would stand up and help her now!
The bodyguard took out a fruit knife and walked toward Yelena.
“Wait!”
But at this moment, Florina suddenly shouted.
“Baby, what’s wrong?”
Nikola turned to Florina and asked with a puzzled expression.
“No matter what, Yelena and I are acquaintances. Although what she did was wrong, but…”
“Baby, are you trying to help this b*tch?”
Nikola frowned and asked Florina.
“This woman dared to steal the diamond ring. I definitely won’t let her off. But I’m sure she has a family too, so I want to ask her if she has anything to say before she dies…”
Florina explained softly.
“Baby, why are you so kind…”
Nikola was once again moved by Florina’s fake kindness.
However, Florina did not pity Yelena at all. She just wanted to humiliate Yelena before she died.
Florina walked up to Yelena in her high heels.
In order not to let others hear what she said, she squatted in front of Yelena and said in a low voice, “Yelena, do you know the difference between us now?” “All of this was planned by you and Celine, right? You’re framing me, aren’t you?”
Yelena gritted her teeth and asked fiercely.
Florina blinked when she heard Yelena’s words. She did not deny it.
“Why are you targeting me? What did I do to deserve this…”
Yelena replied in a low voice.
“You shouldn’t have met Queens Lowe. You shouldn’t have been so beautiful. I’ve always hated women who are prettier than me.”
Florina said calmly.
Yelena was stunned when she heard Florina’s words. She was speechless.
Yelena had never imagined that Florina would do this to her for such reasons! “Alright, you’re about to die anyway. Do you have any last words to say? I guarantee that I’ll pass them on to your family…”
Florina asked Yelena softly.
“Family?”
When Yelena heard Florina’s words, she could not help but be stunned for a moment. A strange look flashed across her eyes.
“What’s wrong? Don’t you have anything to say?”
Florina continued to ask when Yelena did not respond.
“Please help me pass this message to my boyfriend. I can’t walk on this journey with him anymore…”
At this moment, the only person Yelena could not let go of was Connor.
Although she had only been together with Connor for less than three months, and the two of them had not seen each other since the last time they met.
But even so, Yelena still couldn’t let go of Connor!
Yelena had wanted to see Connor today. If she had gone to meet Connor, perhaps these things would not have happened.
“That loser boyfriend of yours?”
Florina smiled faintly, then slowly stood up and said, “Don’t worry, 1’11 get someone to convey this to your boyfriend…”
Yelena looked at Florina and took a deep breath without saying anything. “Alright, you can do it now…”
Florina shouted at the bodyguard expressionlessly.
After hearing Florina’s words, the bodyguard nodded slightly and picked up the fruit knife and walked toward Yelena.
Yelena lay quietly on the ground, looking at the ceiling in confusion. She was very desperate.
“Connor, 1 might not be able to see you again. I love you so much. Thank you for appearing in my life. No matter how others see you, I’ve always felt that you will definitely be very outstanding in the future. I hope that when I’m gone, you can live a better life…”
Yelena slowly closed her eyes. She recalled the past when she was with Connor and couldn’t help but smile.
The sharp fruit knife then slashed toward Yelena’s right hand..

chapters.title: Chapter 726: Stop!
chapters.content:
Chapter 726: Stop!
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Connor and the others were somewhat out of place in this party.
This was because they were not familiar with the people at the party, and there was no middleman to introduce them to anyone, even though Felix had brought Yuliana to Nikola Chakin’s side just now.
However, in the eyes of Nikola and the others, Yuliana was just a plaything.
Yuliana didn’t mind a rich boyfriend; after all, with her family’s current background, it would be very difficult for her to establish herself in the entertainment industry. Therefore, she had to find a strong backer.
Nikola Chakin and Mr. Salo were obviously good choices for Yuliana. However, they didn’t treat her as a girlfriend at all. Instead, they treated her as a slightly high-class prostitute.
No matter what, Yuliana was born in a wealthy family. She could not accept such humiliation.
Yuliana narrowed her eyes as she looked at the ocean in the distance, recalling what Mr. Salo and the others had said to her.
“I don’t know if my previous choice was right or wrong!” Yuliana couldn’t help but think.
“Is there something on your mind?” Connor asked.
“I guess so…”
Yuliana smiled at Connor.
“What’s on your mind? Want to tell me?” Connor said to Yuliana with a smile. “A woman’s thoughts can’t be said out loud!” Yuliana looked at Connor with a playful smile and then continued to stare at the sea.
Connor knew that Yuliana didn’t want to tell him, so he didn’t ask further.
Yuliana turned to look at the young man in front of her and sighed.
Previously, Yuliana felt that Connor was actually a good choice. However, he was too immature when compared to Mr. Chakin Jr. and Mr. Salo.
As he was right now, Connor might not even be as good as Felix! After all, Felix was qualified to bring them to such a party, but Connor did not have such connections. From this perspective, one could see the gap between Connor and those people.
At this moment, Spencer shouted at everyone. “It’s getting late. The party should start soon. Let’s go in and take a look!”
“Okay, let’s go, then.”
Connor also nodded.
Everyone turned around and walked towards the hall.
This time, the security guards standing at the door did not stop Connor and the others when they saw them.
When Connor and the others went out, the security guards had seen them.
However, when Connor and the others entered the hall, they were stunned on the spot. Their expressions were extremely shocked.
Connor and the others thought that the party had already started by not, but when they went in, they realized that was not the case at all. Instead, everyone was gathered together.
Dominic was stunned for a moment, then turned his head and asked Connor softly, “Did we miss something big?”
“We must have missed something…”
Connor nodded lightly.
“Sir, what’s going on?”
Spencer asked the middle-aged man beside him.
“A woman caused trouble at the party just now and even stole the engagement ring that Mr. Chakin Jr. gave to Miss Yacca . She was caught just now, so Mr. Chakin Jr. is planning to cut off that woman’s right hand…” the middle-aged man whispered to Spencer.
Spencer froze on the spot when he heard the middle-aged man’s words. His expression was extremely shocked. “Wow, this woman is too bold. She actually dared to steal Mr. Chakin Jr.’s engagement ring…”
Although Spencer and the others did not know Nikola Chakin, they knew how terrifying he was. Spencer did not expect someone to be so bold as to steal from Nikola of all people.
“That woman is quite beautiful. It’s just that her hands and feet are not clean. What a pity…” the middle-aged man said indifferently.
“Then I want to see just how beautiful she is. She actually dares to steal Mr. Chakin Jr.’s things…” Spencer was also watching the show. After all, Dominic and the others did not have any pity for thieves.
Dominic and Spencer and the others were like the other guests—they hated thieves very much. Connor wasn’t very interested in this kind of thing, but Dominic and the others were very curious about the beauty who stole the things, so they wanted to go over and watch the fun.
Connor had no choice but to followthem.
A few seconds later, Connor, Dominic and Spencer, and the others finally managed to squeeze to the front of the crowd.
When Dominic and Spencer saw the pitiful and helpless Yelena sitting on the ground, he could not help but be stunned.
“I didn’t expect this thief to be so beautiful…”
Dominic sighed in a low voice.
“That’s right. How could such a beautiful girl do such a thing? It’s really unbelievable…”
Spencer hurriedly replied.
“The more beautiful a girl is, the more she knows how to use her beauty. You can’t judge a book by its cover!”
Yuliana looked at Yelena who was sitting on the floor and couldn’t help but sigh.
“That’s right. I really didn’t expect such a beautiful woman to do such a thing…” Sarina said.
“What’s the use of being pretty if she actually dares to steal from Mr. Chakin Jr.? She’s practically asking for death!” Cindy crossed her arms and said coldly.
Although Spencer and the others thought that Yelena was indeed very beautiful, they did not have any pity for her.
On the contrary, they felt that this woman had brought this upon herself.
However, at this moment, Connor also squeezed out from the crowd.
When Connor saw Yelena lying on the ground, he was stunned. His expression was very shocked.
“This is…Yelena?”
Connor couldn’t believe his eyes. He quickly rubbed his eyes and looked at Yelena very carefully.
In the next second, Connor confirmed that the thief that everyone was talking about was none other than Yelena!
“Why is Yelena here?”
Connor sighed in disbelief.
Spencer Yuliana, and the others turned to look at Connor after hearing his words.
“Connor, do you know this thief?”
Dominic frowned and asked Connor.
As soon as Dominic finished speaking, the fruit knife in the bodyguard’s hand slashed at Yelena’s arm.
“Stop!”
Connor hurriedly shouted when he saw this scene.
After Connor shouted this sentence, everyone present was stunned for a moment, and then they looked at Connor’s position at the same time.
No one had expected that someone would dare to stand up for Yelena at this time!

chapters.title: Chapter 727: There’s No One I Can’t Offend!
chapters.content:
Chapter 727: There’s No One I Can’t Offend!
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
“Stop!”
Connor shouted angrily and then hurriedly ran forward.
Hearing Connor’s angry cry, the bodyguard’s hand trembled in fear. His knife tilted and directly cut the floor beside him.
Yelena looked at the bodyguards in disbelief.
“Could it be…Am I hearing things? Why did I hear Connor’s voice just now?
At this moment, Yelena was completely concerned about her own safety. She focused all her attention on the call to stop just now.
Yelena subconsciously turned her head to look at the crowd, and then saw
Connor standing in front of her.
When Yelena saw Connor, she was instantly dumbfounded, her expression shocked.
“Connor? Is it really you?” From the beginning to the end, Yelena had never shed a single tear. She had always retained the last trace of dignity in her heart.
But at this moment, when Yelena saw Connor, tears instantly flowed out of her
eyes.
Perhaps Yelena would only show her most vulnerable side in front of Connor!
After hearing Connor’s words, the people present looked at Connor’s position with shocked expressions.
“Who is this kid?”
“Is this kid crazy? At this time, he actually dares to stand up for the thief…
“There must be something wrong with this kid’s brain. He wants to be the hero and save the beauty!”
“Even a hero saving a damsel in distress has to have the ability to do so!”
Everyone looked at Connor and began to discuss softly.
Because these people did not know Connor, they did not take him seriously.
At this moment, Dominic and the others who were following Connor were all dumbfounded. They looked at Connor with a dull gaze, not knowing what to
do.
“Connor, are you crazy?” Spencer frowned and shouted.
“That’s right, Connor. What are you doing there? Do you know that you will implicate us?” Cindy’s eyes flashed with fear as she hurriedly shouted at
Connor.
Yuliana was probably the calmest person there because she knew that Connor wasn’t the kind of person who liked to be in the limelight. So she subconsciously turned to look at Connor, then frowned and asked, “Connor, don’t tell me you know that woman?”
“She is my woman!”
When Connor saw Yelena in this state, the expression on his face was unusually angry.
After inheriting Steven Lee’s inheritance, Connor had always been very low-key and never took the initiative to reveal his identity to others. Even now, there were not many people who knew Connor’s true identity.
But at this time, Connor was completely enraged. If he couldn’t even protect his own woman, then what was the use of this inheritance?
“She’s your woman?”
After hearing Connor’s words, Yuliana’s eyes flashed with confusion.
Dominic Spencer and the others did not seem to have realized what was going
on.
Connor did not give them any time to react at all and directly walked towards Yelena’s position.
Yelena looked at Connor walking towards her step by step. Her expression was unusually excited, but this excitement also flashed past and was replaced by worry.
Although Yelena was very touched that Connor had stood up for her, she was also worried that Connor would be implicated. If Connor was also implicated in this matter, not only would she not be able to survive, but she would also drag Connor into this mess. This was obviously not worth it.
Yelena didn’t want to see Connor get implicated.
At this moment, Nikola, Florina, and the others were also looking at Connor with puzzled expressions. They didn’t know what Connor was planning to do!
After Yelena finally thought to react, she hurriedly glared at Connor and shouted, “Connor, don’t come over!”
However, Connor did not seem to hear Yelena’s words and continued to walk towards Yelena.
“Connor, did you hear me? These people are not people you can provoke. Hurry
up and go back…”
Yelena sat on the ground and shouted excitedly.
Even when Nikola’s bodyguards wanted to make a move on Yelena, she had never been so agitated.
“Connor, come back quickly…”
Dominic Spencer and the others were also worried about Connor’s safety. They shouted excitedly at Connor.
However, Connor was still unmoved by these people’s words and walked directly to Yelena.
“Connor, why are you so stupid? I told you not to come over, why did you still come over? Do you know that you’ll be implicated by me if you do this…” Yelena shouted at Connor in despair.
Looking at Yelena’s current state, Connor felt as if countless sharp knives had stabbed into his heart.
Connor took a deep breath and pulled Yelena up from the ground, then pulled her into his arms.
Yelena had never thought that she would be able to hug Connor.
It all felt a little unreal.
“Sorry, I’m late…”
Connor hugged Yelena tightly and whispered to her.
After Yelena heard Connor’s words, the last bit of strength in her heart was completely shattered. She leaned into Connor’s arms and cried loudly. Although Yelena felt that Connor couldn’t change anything, she was already very satisfied that she could still find a shoulder to rely on.
Dominic, Spencer, and the others looked at Connor and Yelena in shock. Actually, Connor had told them before that he already had a girlfriend. However, Dominic and Spencer both thought that Connor was joking. It was at this time that they realized that Connor really had a girlfriend.
Florina looked at Connor and Yelena hugging each other with a puzzled expression on her face. She could not help but ask softly, “This boy is Yelena’s useless boyfriend, right? Why was this person here?
“That’s right. How can Yelena’s boyfriend be qualified to attend the cruise party?” Celine’s eyes also flashed with a trace of doubt.
However, Nikola seemed to have seen enough and could not help but laugh out loud. “Hahaha, what a hero saving the damsel in distress!”
Connor turned his head to look at Nikola and asked Yelena softly, “This is the person who bullied you just now, right?”
Yelena opened her mouth to speak. “Connor, listen to me. This person is Mr. Chakin Jr. You cannot afford to offend him…”
“There’s no one in this world that I can’t afford to offend!
Connor replied to Yelena coldly.
After Yelena heard Connor’s words, she was instantly stunned on the spot.

chapters.title: Chapter 728: What Did You Say Just Now?
chapters.content:
Chapter 728: What Did You Say Just Now?
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
“There’s no one in this world that you can’t offend?”
After Yelena heard Connor’s words, her expression was extremely shocked.
She didn’t know where Connor got the confidence to completely disregard a rich heir like Nikola Chakin.
After knowing the relationship between Yelena and Connor, Dominic and
Spencer naturally wouldn’t just watch Connor get into trouble.
After hesitating for a moment, they directly walked to Connor’s side. Yuliana and Sarina followed behind them.
At this moment, Cindy acted as if she didn’t know Connor and the others. She returned to the crowd and watched from afar. She didn’t want to be implicated by Connor and the others because of this matter.
When Connor saw Dominic and the others walking over, a strange look flashed across his eyes.
He didn’t expect them to stand up at this time. This made Connor feel very touched.
Nikola couldn’t help but frown after seeing Connor’s group. He asked with a cold expression, “Who are you people? Why don’t I know you? How did you get in?”
Dominic looked at Nikola and replied, “We came in with Mr. Griffin…”
At this moment, only Yuliana knew Nikola. Dominic, Spencer and Sarina did not know him.
“Mr. Griffin?”
After Nikola heard Dominic’s words, he couldn’t help but frown, a trace of confusion flashing in his eyes. “Are you talking about Felix Griffin?”
“That’s right, Mr. Felix Griffin!”
Dominic nodded again.
“Hahahaha…”
Nikola looked at Dominic and laughed out loud.
