The people present also followed suit.
When Dominic heard the laughter of these people, the expression on his face was somewhat puzzled. He did not know what these people were laughing about.
Nikola turned his head and waved at Felix as he asked softly, “Felix, did you bring these people here?”
After Felix heard Nikola’s words, he hurriedly ran towards Nikola. The expression on his face was very nervous.
When everyone saw Felix like this, they instantly understood why they laughed
so happily when Dominic had called Felix “Mr. Griffin.”
Felix was like a celibate in front of Nikola!
Previously, they had thought that Felix was a rich heir with an amazing background. However, it seemed that Felix was nothing in front of Nikola and the others.
Felix was also very nervous. He had never thought that he would actually cause such a huge trouble by bringing Connor and the others over.
“Mr. Chakin Jr., this is what happened. These people are Yuliana’s friends. 1 originally wanted to introduce Yuliana to you, so I brought them in…” Felix looked at Nikola and explained nervously.
“Is anyone allowed to enter my party?”
Nikola shouted expressionlessly.
“Mr. Chakin Jr., I know my mistake. I’ll chase these country bumpkins out of
the party now…”
Felix shouted at Nikola in a very nervous tone.
At this moment, Felix was very nervous. He was worried that if Connor and the others angered Nikola and then implicated him, things would be troublesome. Therefore, the best way now was to hurry up and make Connor and the others leave this place.
Felix’s family was indeed very rich. If compared with ordinary people, Felix could definitely be considered a top-notch rich heir. However, Felix’s father was just a little pebble under Yakov Chakin. Felix’s father was able to have today’s achievements entirely because of Yakov’s promoting him.
In order to please Nikola, Felix often went around looking for beautiful women. He had planned to introduce Yuliana to Nikola today, but he didn’t expect Nikola to suddenly say that he was getting married.
Felix already felt awkward when Yuliana rejected Mr. Salo. Now that Connor and the others had come out to cause trouble, Felix felt even more embarrassed.
“What are you guys still standing here for? Hurry up and get lost!” Felix shouted excitedly at Connor and the others.
After Dominic and the others heard Felix’s words, their expressions were very awkward because they did not expect things to turn out like this.
Felix saw that Connor and the others were standing where they were and had no intention of leaving at all. He shouted at Connor and the others with an excited expression. “Didn’t you hear me talking to you? This b*tch stole Mr. Chakin Jr.’s things. What are you still standing here for? Hurry up and get lost…”
II II
After hearing Felix’s words, Connor slowly let go of Yelena in his arms, then turned to Felix and asked, “What did you just say?”
“I said, this b*tch—”
Slap!
Before Felix could finish his words, Connor slapped him directly in the face.
Felix, who was originally extremely arrogant, was instantly sent flying by Connor’s slap.
The current Connor was not the same as before. His attack speed and core strength were both extremely shocking.
His slap just now could be considered to have used all his strength. In addition, Felix was not prepared at all. Therefore, his body rose and fell to the floor like a kite with a broken string. There was a look of pain on his face.
Everyone turned their heads to look at Felix, and their expressions were very incredulous.
They had never thought that Connor would actually be so terrifyingly strong to send Felix flying with just one slap.
After hesitating for a moment, everyone turned their heads to look at Connor again because no one had expected Connor to suddenly make a move. Even Dominic and Spencer, who knew Connor the best, were dumbfounded.
Because in their eyes, Connor had always been a person who would submit to adversity. Even if someone bullied him, he would not choose to fight back, but rather silently endure.
But at this time, Connor’s temper was actually pushed to such a limit that he directly sent Felix flying!
Dominic and Spencer and the other two looked at Connor in disbelief.
“Connor, when did you become so powerful?” Yelena could not help but exclaim, her eyes filled with shock.

chapters.title: Chapter 729: Apologize to Yelena on Your Knees!
chapters.content:
Chapter 729: Apologize to Yelena on Your Knees!
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
After seeing Connor send Felix flying with a slap, everyone present fell into shock.
Everyone’s mouths were wide open as they watched this scene in a daze. At this time, Yelena stood beside Connor, flabbergasted. However, Yelena wasn’t shocked because Connor hit someone, but rather because she didn’t expect him to be so powerful!
Previously, Connor had also hit someone because of Yelena, but at that time, Connor’s strength was definitely not as great as now.
Therefore, the reason why Yelena was so surprised at this time was because she did not know when Connor became so powerful.
Connor didn’t care about everyone’s shocked gazes at all. He directly walked to the side of the table, picked up a tissue, and slowly wiped his right hand. Then, he said expressionlessly, “Consider this slap a lesson. If you ever try such a thing again, I’ll make sure to take your worthless life…”
Florina, Nikola, and the others only reacted after hearing Connor’s words. “Is there something wrong with Yelena’s boyfriend? He actually dared to hit Felix Griffin…” Florina commented sweetly.
Nikola’s expression was unusually ugly.
After all, everyone knew that Felix was Nikola’s underling. And at this moment, Connor had slapped Felix in front of Nikola. This was clearly a slap to Nikola’s own face.
“I didn’t expect another fool to come and hit Felix Griffin in front of Nikola. Isn’t this asking for death?”
At this moment, everyone looked at Connor with shocked expressions.
“Looks like this brat still does not know who he has offended. If he were to know of Mr. Chakin Jr.’s identity, he would not dare to hit anyone even if he had balls of steel…”
“That’s right. It’s unexpected that there will be so many good shows to watch today…”
“The thief’s boyfriend is here too. We’re going to have a good show today…” Everyone looked at Connor’s position and began to discuss in low voices. Nikola’s expression was unusually ugly. He walked in front of Connor and asked in a low voice, “Do you know who the person you just sent flying was?” Connor didn’t answer Nikola’s question. Instead, he asked expressionlessly, “You were the one who hit my girlfriend just now, right?”
At this moment, Connor did not ask Yelena what was going on. He only knew that someone had bullied her!
Nikola and the others were shocked by Connor’s domineering aura. The expressions on their faces were very unbelievable. No one expected Connor to actually dare to speak to Nikola like this.
After Nikola heard Connor’s words, he could not help but be stunned.
However, Nikola wasn’t angry. Instead, he pointed at Yelena and asked Connor, “Kid, she’s your girlfriend?”
“That’s right!”
Connor nodded lightly.
“Interesting…”
Nikola nodded with a playful expression and continued, “Your girlfriend stole my ring just now. Since you’re her boyfriend and you want to be the hero to save the damsel in distress, I’ll give you a chance now. I won’t cut off her right hand, but I’ll cut off yours instead. Then, I’ll throw the two of you off the cruise ship. What do you think?”
It was obvious that Nikola was deliberately teasing Connor.
Because he felt that since Connor wanted to be the hero to save the damsel in distress, he would give him a chance to sec if he really had the guts.
“Honey, how can you let that thief go?” Florina asked Nikola sweetly.
After Nikola heard Florina’s words, he turned his head and whispered something to her.
After hearing Nikola’s words, Florina revealed a playful smile on her face. Then, she said gently, “Darling, why are you so mean? Can’t we just get rid of the two of them…”
“In any case, we have nothing to do. Just treat it as entertainment for everyone…” Nikola smiled faintly.
After Connor heard Nikola’s words, he slowly raised his head and looked at Nikola. Then, he said expressionlessly, “If you get on your knees and apologize to my girlfriend now, then slap yourself a hundred times, I can consider letting you go!”
After Connor finished speaking, everyone present fell into a deathly silence.
Everyone looked at Connor in disbelief.
When Connor said this, his expression was very calm and casual. It gave people the feeling that he was asking Nikola if he had eaten.
In addition to Connor’s domineering slap just now, everyone present was instantly stunned. Even Yelena had never seen Connor have such a domineering side.
One had to know that the person standing in front of Connor was not anyone else but Yakov Chakin’s son, Nikola.
Nikola looked at Connor, a trace of shock flashing in his eyes.
Nikola had always been arrogant and despotic because of his father’s background.
Nikola’s background was definitely not something that ordinary people could provoke. Not to mention those ordinary people, even the rich heirs present did not dare to provoke Nikola.
Those who came to attend the party were basically the rich heirs of Davenport. They came to attend the party because they wanted to give face to Nikola and Yakov Chakin.
Everyone was shocked.
They couldn’t understand where Connor got the courage to make Nikola kneel on the ground and apologize to Yelena.
Dominic Spencer and the others also looked at Connor in shock. Their expressions were extremely incredulous. They even thought that they had heard wrongly.
“What’s wrong with Connor today?” Dominic cried out helplessly.
“Yeah, is Connor crazy? Does he know what he’s doing?” Spencer could not help but shout.
“Does Connor not know who Nikola Chakin is?” Yuliana hesitated for a moment and frowned.
“We’re dead. He definitely doesn’t know! Wiry else would he dare say such words…”
A hint of despair flashed across Spencer ‘eyes.
However, at this moment, Florina’s laughter broke the silence. Her face was filled with mirth, and she was laughing so hard that her hair looked like it was about to come loose.
She said to Yelena with an extremely disdainful expression, “Yelena, I didn’t expect your useless boyfriend to be so humorous. Things have already gotten this point, but he can still make such a joke…”
After Yelena heard Florina’s words, a strange look flashed across her eyes.

chapters.title: Chapter 730: A Terrifying Power
chapters.content:
Chapter 730: A Terrifying Power
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
“Connor, what nonsense are you talking about?”
Spencer shouted excitedly, then ran straight to Connor and pulled him, “Connor, this person is the host of the banquet, Nikola, Mr. Chakin Jr.. If you offend him, you will definitely not have a good ending…”
“I don’t care who he is. As long as he dares to bully Yelena, I’ll make him pay the corresponding price!”
Connor said to Spencer expressionlessly.
“Mate, can you stop being silly? This kind of person is really not someone we can afford to provoke.” Dominic pulled Connor and shouted excitedly.
“That’s right, Connor. This matter has nothing to do with you. You’d better leave quickly!”
Yelena also frowned and shouted at Connor.
When Connor heard this, he turned to look at Yelena and said expressionlessly, “”You’re my girlfriend. How can I sit idly by when you’re being bullied?”
“Kid, I admire your courage, but unfortunately, you had to run into me today!” Nikola shouted at Connor and then said fiercely, “Do you know what happened to the person who spoke to me like that last time?”
“What happened?”
Connor couldn’t help but be stunned when he heard Nikola’s words. Then, he said indifferently, “I do not know what will happen to him. However, I know that if you do not kneel down and apologize now, your ending will be extremely miserable…”
“Hahaha…”
After Nikola heard Connor’s words, he immediately laughed out loud. Then, he looked at Connor and said, “You’re really interesting. Since you don’t know, I’ll tell you. The last person who talked to me like you is still lying in the hospital and will never get up again…”
II II
Everyone gasped when they heard Nikola’s words.
This was because these people knew that Nikola wasn’t joking. There was indeed someone who had offended Nikola and was promptly beaten into a vegetative state.
At that time, this matter was also causing an uproar in the circle of the rich heirs of Porthampton.
Ever since that incident, no one dared to offend Nikola.
Yuliana walked up to Connor and said to him in a low voice, “Connor, this person is Yakov Chakin’s son! Yakov is a very famous underground big shot in San Francisco, you better not offend this person! Let’s quickly leave!”
“I’ve already made myself very clear. Today, this person must kneel down and apologize to Yelena…” Connor said to Yuliana expressionlessly.
At this moment, Yuliana was so angry that she didn’t know what to say. She shouted at Connor excitedly. “Connor, who do you think you are? Are you a match for Nikola? Even if this person is a woman’s girlfriend, you shouldn’t have stood up. Do you know how stupid your actions are now?”
Florina frowned and said to Nikola, “Darling, you’d better not talk nonsense with them! Just cripple their legs and throw them off the ship…”
“I just think that this kid is quite interesting…”
Nikola replied indifferently. Then, he ordered the bodyguard, “Alright, don’t just stand there. Break their limbs and throw them off the boat. I’m not in the mood to talk nonsense with them…”
“Alright, Mr. Chakin Jr….”
After the bodyguards heard Nikola’s words, they nodded and walked towards Connor.
Glasses looked nervous when Spencer saw the bodyguards walking towards Connor.
He could not help but frown and say to Dominic, “Brother Xiong, quickly think of a way. If Connor’s legs are really broken and thrown off the ship, he’ll definitely die…”
“What can I do now?”
Dominic gritted his teeth and replied, his expression extremely ugly.
Nikola’s bodyguards were all tall and strong, and their faces were extremely fierce. Their bulging muscles almost tore through their clothes.
Furthermore, Nikola’s background was extremely terrifying. Dominic and the Spencer man were just ordinary students. There was nothing the two of them could do now!
Seeing the bodyguards walking towards Connor step by step, Yelena was so anxious that she was about to cry. She did not know what to do.
“Connor, why are you so silly? Why did you stand out…”
Yelena shouted at Connor anxiously.
Connor turned his head and looked at Yelena indifferently. His expression was very calm as he said, “Just stand behind me…”
II II
After Yelena heard Connor’s words, she could not help but be stunned for a moment. A trace of confusion flashed across her eyes.
At this moment, those bodyguards had already rushed in front of Connor.
One of the bodyguards stretched out his right hand and grabbed Connor’s arm.
“It’s over…”
When Dominic saw the bodyguards make a move, a trace of despair flashed across his face.
“Bang!”
However, the next second, Connor reached out and grabbed the bodyguard’s fist.
When everyone saw this scene, their mouths were agape again, and their expressions were extremely shocked.
No one expected Connor to be so strong that he could block the bodyguard’s fist.
When the bodyguard saw Connor clench his fist, his expression was a little surprised.
However, he did not take Connor seriously. He instinctively wanted to pull back his fist.
However, what the bodyguard did not expect was that Connor was very strong. At this moment, Connor’s hand was like an iron clamp, firmly gripping his hand. No matter how hard he tried, he could not pull his hand away.
When Nikola saw the bodyguard standing still, he looked a little unhappy. He couldn’t help but frown and shout, “What the f*ck are you guys still standing there for?” I told you to break this kid’s limbs. Didn’t you hear me?”
“Mr. Chakin Jr., this boy seems to be quite extraordinary…”
The bodyguard turned to look at Nikola and shouted helplessly.
“Extraordinary? And what do you mean?” Nikola was stunned.
“Bang!”
Before the bodyguard could answer Nikola’s question, he felt a very powerful force on his arm.
The force sent the bodyguard flying, slamming him into the wall.
When Nikola saw this scene, he was completely stunned. His eyes revealed deep shock. At this moment, Nikola finally understood what the bodyguard meant when he said that Connor was not simple!
At this moment, the remaining bodyguards also opened their mouths wide and looked at this scene in a daze. Their expressions were very shocked.
They never dreamed that Connor’s strength would actually be so great!

chapters.title: Chapter 731: Your Father Kneels When He Sees Me!
chapters.content:
Chapter 731: Your Father Kneels When He Sees Me!
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
“Hiss…”
Nikola couldn’t help but gasp when he saw Connor fling the bodyguard away.
He did not expect Connor’s skills to be so excellent!
The bodyguard was nearly 1.9 meters tall and weighed more than 180 pounds.
However, Connor had flung him away like nothing.
From this point, one could see how terrifying Connor was.
Nikola could not help but take a deep breath. Then, he narrowed his eyes and asked Connor, “No wonder you’re so arrogant. You’re quite capable. Who are you?”
Seeing that Connor’s extraordinary skills meant Connor might have some background.
Therefore, Nikola asked Connor cautiously.
“Who am I?”
Hearing Nikola’s question, Connor couldn’t help but rub his nose. Then, he said indifferently, “I’m someone your father has to kneel to!”
Hearing that, everyone instantly started talking.
But now, Connor claimed that Yakov would kneel when he saw him. Everyone thought Connor must have gone crazy or would not have said things.
“Bro, what are you doing?”Dominic and Spencer were also on the verge of tears; although Connor’s skills had shocked them, that didn’t mean he could casually provoke people like Yakov!
If not for the fact that Dominic and Spencer had a good relationship with Connor, they would have already run as far away as possible.
Florina stood beside Nikola. She could feel Nikola’s body trembling, and his expression was abnormally angry.
Nikola had never been so angry before. The guests present did not dare to imagine what would happen next!
“Connor, do you know what price you must pay for saying this?” Nikola gritted his teeth and growled.
“What?” Connor looked at Nikola and asked calmly.
“I initially intended to let you live. However, I did not expect you to be so ungrateful. In that case, don’t blame me for being rude…” Nikola shouted angrily.
“Does Connor have a death wish?”
Celine frowned as she looked at Connor, puzzled.
Sarina didn’t want anything to happen to Connor, so she turned to Yuliana and said, “Yuliana, quickly think of something. If this continues, Connor will die…” “I can’t afford to provoke a person like Nikola. I don’t have any other choice now…”
Yuliana had already given up on Connor because she knew that although her family was influential, she could not be compared to people like Nikola and Yakov.
Moreover, if Yuliana stood up for Connor, she might implicate her parents. Therefore, Yuliana would not choose to help Connor.
“Sunny, kill him. I want to see him die!” Nikola suddenly roared.
It was evident that Nikola was very angry.
Otherwise, he would not have wanted to kill Connor in front of so many people!
Although Nikola’s father, Yakov, was influential, he wasn’t so crazy to kill people casually.
Even if he wanted to kill someone, he would not do it in front of so many people.
But now, Nikola was consumed by anger.
He only had one thought now: to kill Connor in front of everyone. Only then could he make an example of others?
If Nikola didn’t teach Connor a lesson today, who would respect him in the future?
At this moment, a burly man nearly two meters tall with broad shoulders walked out from behind Nikola.
This burly man had a hideous scar on his face, and his murderous aura was particularly heavy. He walked with a majestic gait, like a fierce tiger descending a mountain…
This burly man was Nikola’s bodyguard, Sanchez Lang!
He was also a famous expert in San Francisco. Later, he was hired by Yakov with a large sum of money. He had been with Nikola since he was eight years old.
It was said that the scar on his face was left behind when he saved Nikola.
“It’s over. Mr. Chakin is angry this time around. He has asked Sanchez to do it…”
“That’s right. Sanchez has made a move. This brat is going to die today…”
“Of all the people he can provoke, why did he have to provoke Mr. Chakin? He is asking for it.”
When the crowd saw Sanchez walking out from behind Nikola, they began to discuss in low voices.
Yelena also realized something was wrong and quickly whispered, “Connor, this person seems very powerful. You must be careful…”
“Relax, this person is not my match…” Connor replied calmly.
Sanchez walked up to Connor and looked at him with disdain.
He was nearly two meters tall and wore loose clothes. However, even so, it could not hide his muscles.
At this moment, he had a ferocious expression, exuding an aura that made people tremble. Ordinary people would feel afraid when they looked at him.
On the other hand, Connor, who was more than 1.7 meters tall, looked particularly frail.
When the two of them stood together, it was obvious who the winner was.
“Brat, you should not have offended Mr. Chakin…” Sanchez looked at Connor and said expressionlessly. Then, he suddenly clenched his fist and brought it toward Connor’s face.
Sanchez’s fist was like a hammer, swinging fiercely toward Connor.
If this punch had landed on Connor’s body, he would have been killed.
When the people behind Connor saw Sanchez’s punch, their faces were filled with fear, and they hurriedly took a few steps back.
They were worried that Connor would be sent flying by Sanchez’s punch and hurt themselves.
“Connor, dodge!” Yelena shouted at Connor worriedly when she saw Sanchez’s punch coming at him.
When Connor heard that, he turned around and smiled at her, then said softly, “Relax, this person is not my match…”

chapters.title: Chapter 732: Arhat Boxing
chapters.content:
Chapter 732: Arhat Boxing
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
“This person is not your match.”
Hearing Connor’s claims, Yelena was stunned and puzzled.
Sanchez’s fist then made contact with Connor’s face.
Connor slowly raised his right hand.
‘Poof!’ There was a loud sound.
Connor blocked Sanchez’s punch with one hand.
Seeing Connor block his punch, Sanchez was extremely shocked!
Sanchez had packed all his strength into this punch. Ordinary people couldn’t block his punch.
However, this weak-looking young man had blocked Sanchez’s punch. This was indeed unbelievable.
Nikola, Florina, and the others were also shocked.
“No wonder Yelena’s good-for-nothing boyfriend dared to be so arrogant. It turns out that he has some skills!” Florina could not help but sigh softly.
“Although Connor looks skinny and weak, he’s strong. I reckon he’s also mighty in bed….”
In the crowd, a sexy young woman with a sexy figure and charming appearance exclaimed.
“Little sl*t, are you already wet? Do you want me to beg Mr. Chakin for mercy and let this brat serve you for a night before you die…”
“Forget it; this kid is dead for sure today!” The beautiful young woman waved her hand lightly.
Sanchez took two steps back and looked at Connor in surprise. Then, he said in a low voice, “No wonder you were so arrogant. You have some ability!”
After saying this, Sanchez could not help but gasp.
He felt as if he had hit an iron plate with his fist. Connor didn’t do anything, yet Sanchez’s fist was in pain.
“You are not my match…” Connor whispered back to Sanchez.
“Whether or not I am a match for you, we will only know after we have tried…” Sanchez expressionlessly replied to Connor, then continued, “It’s been long since I’ve met an opponent who can fight me!”
After saying this, Sanchez again rushed toward Connor.
“Arhat boxing?”
After Connor saw Sanchez’s posture, he was surprised. Then, he frowned and asked Sanchez.
“You know Arhat boxing?”
Surprise flashed in Sanchez’s eyes upon Connor’s question.
Although Connor didn’t know Arhat boxing, he had seen it in Jorge’s study.
However, Jorge said that Arhat boxing was weaker than Seven-Star Big Dipper Fist, so Connor didn’t practice this set of fist techniques.
However, Connor knew that the most prominent feature of Arhat boxing was its fierce fist wind and most of the first techniques required close combat.
If he couldn’t get close to his opponent, he wouldn’t be able to unleash the full power of this first technique.
Moreover, martial artists who cultivated Arhat boxing generally relied on the strength of their bodies to fight hard.
Some experts of Arhat boxing could break a big tree with one punch. This was the power of Arhat boxing.
“Subduing Tiger!” At this moment, Sanchez roared and attacked Connor.
“You’re too slow…” Connor replied indifferently, then turned around and dodged Sanchez’s attack.
After the first move failed, Sanchez launched the second and third rounds of attacks on Connor.
All kinds of Arhat boxing moves were used one after another, each one lethal.
Sanchez’s fists were like raindrops, raining down on Connor from all directions.
Should Connor get careless, he would be sent flying by Sanchez’s punch.
Standing beside Connor, Yelena could not help but cover her mouth with her hand in nervousness. She felt that her heart was about to jump into her throat.
She was worried that Connor would end up miserable if he did not dodge Sanchez’s attack!
However, Yelena realized that her worries were unnecessary because Connor could dodge Sanchez’s attacks with ease every time.
Everyone present was shocked.
No one had expected Connor to be so good that he could be on par with the famous Sanchez.
“Sanchez won’t lose to Connor, right?” Florina was worried at this moment. She frowned and asked Nikola.
“Impossible. Sanchez is now Master Wheeler’s disciple. His strength has improved greatly, so he definitely won’t lose to Connor. But I didn’t expect Connor to be so strong. No wonder he was so arrogant before….”
Nikola was still very confident in Sanchez’s strength.
“All right, it’s almost over!” Connor suddenly shouted at Sanchez.
After hearing Connor’s words, Sanchez was stunned.
“Seven-star Big Dipper Fist, first part, Dragon’s Roar!” Connor roared angrily and threw a punch.
‘Bang!’ A loud bang resounded!
Connor’s punch was swift. In the blink of an eye, it had made contact with Sanchez’s body.
Before Sanchez could react to what was happening, he was flung away before landing on the table in front of Nikola and the others.
“Ah…”
After he was defeated, the girls present were so frightened that they screamed.
However, after the scream, the hall fell into dead silence again.
Everyone’s eyes were wide open as they stood rooted to the ground with incredulity.
No one had expected Connor actually to defeat Sanchez!
Everyone thought it was unbelievable.
“How could Sanchez lose?”
“Yeah, how could Sanchez lose to Connor?”
There was only one question in everyone’s mind.
Meanwhile, Dominic, Spencer, and the others were staring at Connor with their mouths agape. Other than shock, there was also awe on their faces.
Dominic, Spencer, and Connor had been together for many years, but they did not know Connor had such powerful skills!
“When did Connor become so powerful?”
Dominic sighed in a low voice.
“Some time ago, Connor was often out of his mind. He told the two of us that he went to practice fighting. Could Connor have been learning martial arts all this time?” Spencer wondered aloud.
“No wonder Connor is so confident!” Yuliana sighed softly.
Yuliana finally understood where Connor’s confidence came from. With such terrifying skills, he would not bow to someone like Nikola.
Yelena stared at Connor, conflicted.
She realized that she knew too little about Connor!

chapters.title: Chapter 733: Nikola Gone Mad
chapters.content:
Chapter 733: Nikola Gone Mad
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Nikola was stunned when he saw Connor send Sanchez flying with a punch. He then ran toward Sanchez.
“Sunny, are you all right?”
The relationship between Nikola and Sanchez was not that of a boss and a subordinate. More often than not, they were friends.
Therefore, Nikola was still very angry.
“Mr. Chakin, Connor is indeed very powerful… Poof…”
Before Sanchez could finish his sentence, he spat a mouthful of blood.
At this moment, Sanchez felt like he had just been hit by a large truck. This kind of pain was not something that ordinary people could withstand.
“You should rest first. I will make this kid pay the price!” Nikola looked at Sanchez and whispered.
At this moment, Nikola’s expression was very ugly. He felt that Connor was provoking him now. If he didn’t teach Connor a lesson, wouldn’t he become a joke in the eyes of others?
“Grab your weapons and hack this kid to death!” Nikola roared.
‘Whoosh…’
When the bodyguards heard Nikola’s order, they grabbed weapons like steel pipes and machetes from behind and rushed toward Connor.
When the guests present saw this, they were abnormally shocked.
They did not expect Nikola’s bodyguards to bring weapons with them.
When Nikola saw this, he was a little smug.
He couldn’t help but sigh. “Connor, oh, Connor. You’re still a little inexperienced compared to me. So what if you’re powerful? Can you beat steel pipes with your fists? No matter how strong you are, can you beat more than a dozen armed bodyguards?”
When Dominic, Spencer, and the others saw this, a trace of fear flashed in their eyes, and they could not help but tremble slightly.
The guests in the hall all hid on the side, leaving only Connor and Yelena standing there alone.
Connor was still very calm.
One must know that Connor was used to fighting with that crazy gorilla Jabba. Therefore, Connor was already used to Jabba’s speed.
At this moment, although there were many bodyguards, all of them added together probably could not compare to Jabba, that crazy gorilla.
Connor didn’t intend to be timid facing the incoming bodyguards. On the contrary, he welcomed them.
In an instant, Connor and Nikola’s bodyguards started fighting.
Connor was very fast. Those bodyguards could not touch him at all. Moreover, Connor’s strength was great. Those bodyguards could not withstand it at all.
In less than three minutes, Connor had beaten up all the bodyguards.
All the bodyguards fell to the ground, hugging their heads tightly and howling non-stop.
Although Connor didn’t use too much strength, making these people temporarily lose their ability to fight wasn’t a problem.
In an instant, only Connor was left standing in the hall.
“Connor won?” Yuliana stared at Connor. She seemed to be in a daze.
She felt that all of this was too unbelievable!
Previously, Yuliana’s impression of Connor was that he was just a low-key rich heir. However, Yuliana never expected Connor’s skills to be so terrifying.
At this moment, Yuliana was even more curious about Connor’s identity. She was curious about who Connor was to have such terrifying skills.
The others also widened their eyes and looked at Connor in disbelief.
They felt that such a situation should only happen in the movies!
Nikola stood rooted to the ground with a dull gaze. Other than shock, there was also fear on his face. Nikola had not expected such a situation.
Florina stood beside Nikola with a shocked expression.
‘Thump thump thump…’ At this moment, the sound of footsteps could be heard.
Connor slowly walked up to Nikola.
When Nikola saw Connor walking over, a trace of fear flashed in his eyes.
He trembled as he shouted at Connor, “What… What are you doing? I’m telling you, I… I’m Yakov’s son. If you dare to touch me, I’ll make sure you end badly!”
“Do you still remember what I told you just now?” Connor asked Nikola expressionlessly.
“What…”
“If you have forgotten, then let me remind you. Kneel and apologize to Yelena, then slap yourself a hundred times. I will let you off on account of Yakov!” Connor said to Nikola expressionlessly.
After Connor finished speaking, everyone fell into a deathly silence.
Nikola’s expression was unusually ugly. He glared at Connor and shouted, “Aren’t you arrogant? Don’t think I’ll be afraid of you just because you defeated my bodyguards!”
“Well?” Connor asked softly.
“Let me tell you, no matter how good you are at fighting, you cannot walk out of this ship today…” Nikola shouted angrily at Connor.
“Whether or not I can leave this ship is not something you can decide…” Connor said to Nikola expressionlessly.
“Arc you sure?” Nikola sneered and pulled out a black pistol from his clothes. He then aimed it at Connor’s head.
When everyone saw Nikola take out his pistol, they gasped, and their faces were filled with shock.
No one expected Nikola to have a gun on him!
The current society was not the society of the past.
Ordinary people might not see a real pistol in their entire lives.
Moreover, the government had very strict control over guns.
Ordinary people couldn’t buy guns at all!
However, Nikola was holding a real gun in his hand. This was indeed very unbelievable.
“Do you recognize this?” Nikola coldly asked Connor.
“…” Connor looked at Nikola without saying anything.
“Weren’t you awesome? Aren’t you good at fighting? Now tell me, how will you get out of this ship?” Nikola shouted at Connor arrogantly.
Nikola didn’t plan to use the gun today. After all, it would give him a bad reputation.
However, he did not expect Connor to be so powerful. At this moment, he was forced to take out his gun..

chapters.title: Chapter 734 Yakov Arrives
chapters.content:
734  Yakov Arrives
On Princess Cruise Ship.
Three middle-aged men sat on the yacht and came to the deck.
These three middle-aged men were Nikola's father, Yakov, Benjamin, who had followed Yakov to the martial arts tournament and lost to Connor, and Cade, a big shot from San Francisco.
Today was the big day of Nikola and Florina's engagement; Yakov, as the father, naturally had to attend.
Moreover, Yakov had another purpose for coming over this time. He wanted to find a few young and beautiful female celebrities for Benjamin and Cade to enjoy.
After all, many beautiful female celebrities were at the cruise party this time.
"Mr. Chakin, your son is really generous. I heard that this Princess Cruise Ship is not cheap. I didn't expect Mr. Chakin Jr. to book it and invite so many celebrities over…" Cade said to Yakov with a smile.
"Mr. Lambert, don't worry. I've already asked Nikola to arrange for four popular young actresses in the country. You and Master Wu will each have two. There are rooms on this cruise ship. I hope you and Master Wu will enjoy yourselves…" Yakov chuckled.
"Mr. Chakin, you're too nice…" Cade hurriedly replied.
Yakov started his business as a smuggler. After earning some money, he began to accumulate his capital. Then, he bought a piece of land in San Francisco. Later, he developed it into a city that never sleeps in San Francisco. All the places in this city were under Yakov's control.
The reason Yakov was able to get that piece of land in that city back then had a lot to do with Cade.
Cade was the supervisor of a city in San Francisco. He used his position to collude with Yakov.
Even now, Yakov and Cade had a very close relationship.
Yakov could earn hundreds of millions of dollars in that city every year. This money had been supporting Yakov's business empire.
Moreover, after Yakov became rich, he opened his own film and television company to make it convenient for him to fool around with women.
And this film company was the famous Dreamcatcher Studios.
In the beginning, when Yakov set up Dreamcatcher Studios, it was just for him to fool around with female celebrities.
However, he never expected his company to grow bigger. In the end, it became one of the top film production companies in Oprana, and its market value had long exceeded ten billion.
Moreover, Dreamcatcher Studios had made dozens of celebrities famous over the years, including some international superstars.
Of course, this film company had another 'capital'.
The female celebrities in this film company were all chips Yakov used to win people's hearts. This was also very helpful to Yakov's career.
The most important reason Yakov brought Cade and Benjamin to Princess Cruise Ship today was that another piece of land in San Francisco was ready for bidding.
Yakov had been eyeing this piece of land for a long time, so he wanted to use his relationship with Cade to get this piece of land.
"Mr. Lambert, I heard that the land in the development zone is ready for bidding, right?" Yakov hesitated for a moment and asked Cade with a smile.
"That's right. We'll be preparing for the bidding in a few days…" Cade nodded lightly.
"So, what are my chances to get that piece of land?" Yakov asked with a smile.
"How big of a chance?" After Cade heard this, he couldn't help but smile faintly. Then, he said softly, "If you want to get this piece of land, it's quite simple…"
"How simple?" Yakov asked Cade excitedly.
"Well, I heard that you know Mr. McDonald from Porthampton?" Cade asked Yakov with a smile.
Yakov was stunned momentarily, then hurriedly said, "Mr. Lambert, to be exact, Mr. McDonald is already my boss now. I only want to take this land to help Mr. McDonald earn money…" Yakov said this to flatter himself and close his relationship with Connor.
But there was no problem with Yakov saying this. After all, Connor now controlled 50% of Yakov's profits.
In other words, no matter how much money Yakov earned, he had to give Connor 50%.
"If you want to get that piece of land, then introduce Mr. McDonald to me. I happen to have something to tell Mr. McDonald…" Cade said with a smile.
"Mr. Lambert, you want to know Mr. McDonald?" Benjamin was stunned for a moment and asked in a low voice.
"That's right. Mr. McDonald's background is not simple, and he's Thomas' boss. So, if I can get to know Mr. McDonald, it will be very helpful for my future career. So, Mr. Chakin, can you help me introduce Mr. McDonald, and I'll help you get that piece of land?" Cade said to Yakov with a smile.
After Yakov heard Cade's words, he could not help but be stunned momentarily. Then, he said softly, "Mr. Lambert, if you want to get to know Mr. McDonald, that's not a problem at all. When I'm free, I'll help you contact Mr. McDonald. However, if you want Mr. McDonald to help you with your career, I think it might be difficult..."
"Of course, I won't let Mr. McDonald help me for nothing. I have something Mr. McDonald is interested in…" Cade said lightly.
"What is it?" Yakov was stunned for a moment and asked curiously.
"As long as Mr. McDonald is willing to help me, I will betroth my two daughters to Mr. McDonald…" Cade said in a low voice.
After Yakov heard Cade's words, he suddenly turned and looked at Cade in disbelief.
Yakov never thought Cade would be so cruel. For his future, he was even willing to sacrifice his daughters.
Cade's two daughters were famous for their beauty in San Francisco.
More importantly, Cade's two daughters were identical twins. They looked the same.
To be able to get such a pair of sisters into bed was the dream of many men!
Therefore, Cade felt that Connor would be tempted if he offered his twin daughters to Connor.
"Although Mr. McDonald's background isn't simple, he's still a man!" Cade said to Yakov with a smile.

chapters.title: Chapter 735 Mr. McDonald, Why Are You Here?
chapters.content:
735  Mr. McDonald, Why Are You Here?
After hearing Cade's words, Yakov became a little hesitant.
He turned to Cade and said, "Mr. Lambert, I can only introduce you to Mr. McDonald now. As for the matter between you and Mr. McDonald, you can talk to him…"
"Mr. Chakin, as long as you can introduce me, I'll handle the rest myself…" Cade hurriedly nodded.
"All right, okay…" Seeing Cade agree, Yakov hurriedly smiled and nodded.
"Looking forward to our cooperation…" Cade was in a good mood.
"Haha, Mr. Lambert, let's go in quickly. I'll think of a way to deal with Mr. McDonald…" Yakov hurriedly led Cade and Benjamin into the hall.
At this moment, the hall was also in chaos.
No one expected Nikola to pull out a gun in front of so many people.
The black muzzle was aimed at Connor's head.
Connor looked at Nikola unmoved but very shocked.
Even Connor did not expect Nikola to have a gun in his hand.
Although Connor was very powerful, even if he was faced with more than ten bodyguards, he could still retreat unscathed.
However, no matter what, Connor was still a mortal. He couldn't dodge bullets.
At this moment, a strange thought suddenly flashed through Connor's mind.
'Jabba is so fast. I wonder if Jabba can dodge the bullets!'
On the other hand, Nikola was holding a gun and sizing up Connor. His expression was that of disdain as he said lightly, "Brat, weren't you very arrogant just now? Aren't you very good at fighting? Come on, attack me now. I want to see if you're stronger or if my gun is stronger today."
"Do you dare to pull the trigger?" Connor asked Nikola expressionlessly.
"Why wouldn't I? What can you do even if I kill you in front of everyone? I have plenty of money. I can find someone to take the blame and hide this. Now, all the guests in the hall are my people. No one can prove that I killed you!" Nikola said proudly to Connor.
"But the few of us can testify!" Dominic hesitated momentarily before mustering up his courage and shouting at Nikola.
After Nikola heard Dominic's words, he turned and looked at Dominic indifferently. Then, he said coldly, "Brat, aren't you too naive? Do you think I'll let you live?"
"…"
Dominic was instantly dumbfounded when he heard this.
Nikola didn't continue to pay attention to Dominic. Instead, he said to Connor with a playful expression, "Kid, let me tell you, if you play with me, you will only die!"
"However, today is the day I propose to Florina. I don't want anyone to die. As long as you kneel and apologize to me now and crawl between my legs, I will let you live."
Although Nikola had a gun, he didn't dare to kill Connor.
He only took out his gun to scare Connor.
"I'll still say the same thing. Kneel and apologize to my girlfriend now, then slap yourself a hundred times. On account of your father, I won't make things difficult for you!" Connor replied to Nikola expressionlessly.
"You still dare to be stubborn with me at a time like this? Do you think I won't shoot you?" Nikola's eyes widened as he shouted angrily.
"Do it then!" Connor said casually.
After Nikola heard Connor's taunting, he was instantly dumbfounded.
He had never expected that Connor was not afraid of his pistol at all!
They would have peed their pants in fear if it were anyone else.
However, at this moment, Connor could remain so calm. This indeed made Nikola feel somewhat inconceivable.
However, Nikola might have known that Connor had already seen through Nikola's intention to use the gun to scare him.
Nikola's right hand, which was holding the gun, was trembling slightly. This meant that Nikola was also very nervous. He did not dare to shoot at all!
At this moment, Nikola was caught in a dilemma.
Things would become very troublesome if he really shot and killed Connor now.
Although he said it casually, killing people was an extremely serious matter in Oprana.
But if Nikola didn't shoot, with so many people watching, how could Nikola gain respect in the future?
Therefore, Nikola was at a loss for what to do.
In an instant, the entire hall fell into a deathly silence.
Everyone was staring at Connor and Nikola.
"Who has the guts to cause trouble at my son's proposal ceremony?"
However, just as Nikola was in a dilemma, a voice suddenly came from the hall's entrance.
At this moment, Yakov, Cade, and Benjamin had just entered the hall.
When Yakov saw the scene in the hall, he immediately became angry.
After all, if someone caused trouble at the proposal ceremony, it would be equivalent to slapping Yakov in the face.
"It's over. Mr. Chakin Sr. is here…"
"It's over. It's over. Mr. Chakin Sr. brought Master Wheeler over. There's going to be a good show…"
After everyone saw Yakov, everyone was shocked.
The crowd retreated to both sides in unison. Yakov, Cade, and Benjamin walked out of the crowd.
When Yakov saw Connor, he instinctively froze, then hurriedly called out, "Mr. McDonald, you're here. Why are you here?"
"Mr. McDonald, you're here. When did you arrive?" Benjamin was stunned for a moment, then he asked as well.
When everyone heard Benjamin and Yakov's words, they were all stunned and very puzzled.
They had no idea who this 'Mr. McDonald' that Benjamin and Yakov were calling out to was!
There were many people at the party today and many people with the surname 'McDonald'.
However, no one with such a great reputation could make a big shot like Yakov to call him 'Mr. McDonald'.
After Connor heard Yakov and Benjamin calling out to him, he turned and looked at Yakov indifferently and calmly.
Although Connor knew that Nikola's father was called Yakov, he was not sure if this Yakov was the Yakov he knew.
But now, Connor could confirm that this Yakov was the Yakov he had met at the martial arts tournament!

chapters.title: Chapter 736 Apologize to Mr. McDonald!
chapters.content:
736  Apologize to Mr. McDonald!
When everyone heard Yakov's words, they were all stunned. They were very shocked.
Because they had no idea who the Mr. McDonald that Yakov was talking about was!
"Mr. Chakin the Second, the Mr. McDonald you mentioned... is it the Mr. McDonald from Porthampton?"
Now, in the upper circles of the four provinces, Connor's matter had already begun to spread.
Many people already knew that there was a Mr. McDonald in Porthampton. He was Kyle Hayes and Thomas Morgan's boss.
Therefore, many people had heard about Mr. McDonald. However, because Connor had been deliberately hiding his identity, most people have only heard of Mr. McDonald. They didn't know who Mr. McDonald was, nor did they know any specific information about him.
Except for a few people who had seen Connor before, very few people could recognize him.
For a moment, everyone was secretly guessing what was going on.
Cade was the first person to react. He quickly ran to Connor and took the initiative to extend his hand to Connor. He shouted excitedly at Connor, "Mr. McDonald, hello..."
When Connor saw Cade, a trace of doubt flashed in his eyes.
Because he did not know who the man in front of him was, so he did not pay attention to Cade.
When Cade saw that Connor had no intention of paying attention to him, he felt a little awkward. He hurriedly turned to look at Yakov who was beside him.
When Yakov saw the look in Cade's eyes, he quickly took a step forward and said to Connor in a very respectful tone, "Mr. McDonald, this is Mr. Cade Lambert from the San Francisco Bureau of Industry and Commerce. He is the deputy director and has always admired you and wanted to find an opportunity to get to know you. We didn't expect to meet you here today..."
"Yes, yes. Mr. McDonald, you can just call me Cade…"
Cade hurriedly shouted in a flattering manner.
When everyone heard Cade's words, they were very puzzled.
He was the deputy director of the San Francisco Bureau of Industry and Commerce, and now he was talking to Connor in such a flattering manner.
And how terrifying Connor's background was, these people present didn't even dare to think about it.
These people finally understood why Connor had the guts to go against Nikola just now.
Actually, they didn't know in their hearts that Connor was simply an unreachable big shot in Cade's eyes.
If Cade could curry favor with Connor, it would be a great thing for him.
Therefore, even if Cade were to kneel down and speak to Connor with such an attitude, Cade would not hesitate at all, let alone speak to Connor in such a way.
However, Cade's actions made everyone present open their mouths in disbelief.
However, the most shocked person was still Nikola!
Nikola looked at Yakov and Cade, and he was very puzzled.
He could not understand how a person like Connor could know his father. Also, why would Cade curry favor with Connor like this? This simply did not make sense!
Even his own father did not dare to offend a big brother like Cade.
However, at this moment, he actually took the initiative to curry favor with Connor. This was indeed somewhat incomprehensible.
Dominic Turner, Yuliana Schneider, Sarina Watts, and the others were all dumbfounded!
Of course, this wasn't the first time they were dumbfounded. Connor had been giving them surprises left and right!
Nikola really couldn't take it anymore.
After hesitating for two seconds, he walked directly to Yakov and said in a low voice, "Dad, what exactly is going on…"
Yakov was stunned for a moment after hearing Nikola's words. Then, he hurriedly pulled Nikola to Connor and said with a smile, "Mr. McDonald, I forgot to introduce you. This is my son, Nikola…"
"Haha…"
When Connor heard Yakov's words, he could not help but smile faintly.
Yakov turned to Nikola and said, "Nikola, this is the Mr. McDonald from Porthampton that I've told you about. Mr. McDonald is now considered the boss of our company. If it weren't for Mr. McDonald's care, our company would have gone bankrupt long ago. What are you still standing here for? Hurry up and greet Mr. McDonald…"
Yakov did not know what happened between Nikola and Connor just now, so he happily introduced Nikola to Connor.
"Connor? Mr. McDonald from Porthampton?"
"What…"
When Nikola heard Yakov's words, he was instantly stunned. After knowing Connor's true identity, everyone's mouth was wide open in shock.
After all, not many people knew the name Connor, but if they mentioned the young master of Porthampton, many people would know.
After all, Connor had caused quite a commotion in Porthampton recently. In addition, the people attending the party were all rich and noble. It was normal for them to know about Mr. McDonald.
"I didn't expect this Connor guy to be Mr. McDonald of Porthampton!"
"That's right. This is unbelievable. I heard that Mr. McDonald is Thomas Morgan and Kyle Hayes's boss…"
"Although I've always heard about Mr. McDonald, this is the first time I'm seeing him in person. I didn't expect the legendary Mr. McDonald to be so young!"
The crowd began to discuss in low voices, and everyone's eyes were focused on Connor alone.
"How... How is that possible?"
Nikola trembled as he shouted. Then, he pointed at Connor and shouted, "Dad, are you sure? How could this person be Mr. McDonald? He's clearly a poor kid…"
"What poor kid? This is Mr. McDonald. How could I be wrong? Hurry up and apologize to him!"
When Yakov heard Nikola's words, he immediately flew into a rage and slapped Nikola's face.
Nikola instantly sobered up after receiving this slap.
He stared at Connor with his eyes wide open, not daring to say a word.
Nikola had long heard about Mr. McDonald, but he did not expect that the Connor standing in front of him was actually the legendary Mr. McDonald!
Nikola thought that Connor was just a poor kid. He had a gun in his hand, so he was not afraid of Connor.
However, he did not expect Connor to suddenly become the young master of Porthampton!
He simply could not accept this fact!

chapters.title: Chapter 737: A Humiliating Method
chapters.content:
Chapter 737: A Humiliating Method
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Nikola thought that Connor was just a poor kid.
Therefore, from the beginning to the end, he did not take Connor seriously!
Even when Connor displayed astonishing skills, Nikola still did not think much of it.
After all, this was Nikola’s territory, and he relied on his father’s relationship. Even if he killed Connor in front of so many people, he definitely had a way to settle this matter!
But what Nikola never expected was that with Yakov’s appearance, Connor’s identity actually underwent an earth-shattering change!
It wasn’t just Nikola, Spencer, Dominic Turner Yuliana Schneider, Yelena Allen, and the others were all looking at Connor strangely.
Spencer, Dominic, Yelena, and the other two had interacted with Connor many times, so they knew Connor’s identity very well.
However, they really couldn’t understand why Connor had suddenly turned from a poor student who delivered food into an existence that made big shots like Yakov and Cade extremely afraid!
Recently, Yelena had been filming in the crew. She had been able to come into contact with many big shots. Naturally, she had heard some things about Mr. McDonald from Davenport.
However, Yelena had never thought that this legendary super rich guy was actually her boyfriend!
For a moment, Yelena seemed to be unable to accept this fact.
She felt that there must be something hidden about this matter!
Florina Yacca stood in the distance with a shocked expression on her face.
After all, she was very familiar with Mr. McDonald. How could she have known that Yelena’s good-for-nothing boyfriend was the legendary Mr. McDonald!
As for Celine Chalphy, who had framed Yelena previously, she was about to die of regret.
When Yakov saw that Nikola’s expression seemed a little off, he quickly understood what was going on.
“Nikola, what’s going on?” He hurriedly asked Nikola. “Did you offend Mr. McDonald just now?”
It could be seen that when Yakov said this, he was extremely angry.
After all, he had just escaped from Connor. If his son offended Connor, the consequences would be unimaginable!
When Nikola heard Yakov’s words, his face darkened. He lowered his head and did not say anything.
“Bastard!”
Seeing that Nikola did not respond, he knew that he had guessed correctly.
However, he still didn’t know what was going on. After hesitating for a moment, he slowly raised his head and looked at Connor. Then, he asked Connor in a low voice, “Mr. McDonald, what happened just now?”
“He bullied my girlfriend and threatened me with a gun. He wanted me to kneel down and apologize…”
Connor replied to Yakov with a very calm tone.
When Yakov heard this, he was so scared that his vision went black, and he almost fainted!
Even Yakov himself did not necessarily have the guts to speak to Connor like this!
Who was Connor?
There was no need to mention Connor’s background. Just Connor’s skills alone were already very terrifying.
Just based on this point, Connor was an existence that their Chakin Family could not afford to provoke.
Moreover, Thomas and Kyle were all Connor’s subordinates. If he offended Connor, how would Yakov survive in the future?
The more Yakov thought about it, the more afraid he became. He could not help but take two steps back and almost fell to the ground.
“Dad…”
When Nikola saw Yakov stumbling, he hurriedly stepped forward and reached out to support Nikola.
“Get lost…”
Yakov pushed Nikola to the side and then exclaimed, “Mr. McDonald, I’m really sorry. It’s all my son’s fault for being insensible. Can you please let my son off on my account…”
Connor glanced at Yakov indifferently and didn’t say anything.
Yakov did not even think about it as he raised his leg and kicked Nikola’s stomach. Then, he glared and shouted, “What the f*ck are you still doing? Hurry up and kneel down and apologize to Mr. McDonald!”
When everyone heard Yakov’s words, they sighed in their hearts!
Everyone thought that Connor would definitely not have a good ending after offending a person like Nikola.
However, no one had expected that things would end up like this!
If they hadn’t seen it with their own eyes, no one would have believed that Yakov would actually make Nikola kneel down and apologize to this very ordinary young man in front of him!
Yelena widened her big watery eyes, and she face seemed to be even more puzzled.
She could not understand what was going on!
And Yakov knew clearly in his heart just how terrifying an existence Connor was.
At this moment, he made Yakov kneel down and apologize to Connor. It was actually for Nikola’s own good!
After all, if Nikola really kneeled down, Connor might even let him off on account of Yakov.
However, Nikola could not accept such a humiliating apology!
Nikola had been pampered since he was young, and he was Yakov’s only son.
Therefore, he had never been bullied since he was young.
No matter who Nikola offended or how much trouble he caused, Yakov would always be there to clean up his mess.
After so many years, Nikola was already used to this kind of arrogance.
But at this moment, Yakov actually wanted Nikola to kneel down and apologize to Connor in front of so many people. He really could not accept it!
If there were only Nikola, Yakov, and Connor, Nikola might kneel down and apologize to Connor.
However, there were so many people watching.
This included Nikola’s underlings, Nikola’s friends, and celebrities in the entertainment industry.
Most importantly, Nikola’s fiancee, Florina, was also here!
With so many pairs of eyes watching, if Nikola really knelt down and apologized to Connor, wouldn’t he become a joke in the eyes of these people? How would he survive in the future?
Therefore, Nikola had already made up his mind. Even if he died here today, he would definitely not kneel down and apologize to Connor!
“I told you to kneel down and apologize to Mr. McDonald. Did you not hear me?”
Yakov shouted angrily when he saw Nikola standing still.
“I’m not apologizing!”
Nikola gritted his teeth and replied in a low voice..

chapters.title: Chapter 738: The Truth Comes Out
chapters.content:
Chapter 738: The Truth Comes Out
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
“Even if I die, I won’t apologize to this kid!”
Nikola’s eyes were red as he shouted.
When Yakov heard Nikola’s words, he could not help but frown. Then, he shouted in a low voice, “What did you just say?”
“1 said 1 won’t apologize!”
Nikola shouted at the top of his lungs and continued, “I didn’t do anything wrong in the first place. It’s all because his girlfriend stole my fiancee’s engagement ring today that I wanted to teach his fiancee a lesson. 1 don’t know what I did wrong here. Wiry should I apologize to this guy?”
“I didn’t steal your fiancee’s diamond ring…”
When Yelena heard Nikola’s words, she hurriedly shouted.
Yakov turned to look at Yelena, and then at Connor. He looked vexed.
He had finally figured out what was going on.
“Are you Mr. McDonald’s girlfriend?”
Yakov hesitated for a moment before he walked up to Yelena and asked her
with a very respectful expression.
“That’s right…”
Yelena raised her head and looked at Connor, then gently nodded.
“Miss, can you tell me what happened?”
Yakov hesitated for a moment before he looked at Yelena and asked.
Yelena took a deep breath, her expression exceptionally aggrieved.
Other people might not know what was going on with that diamond ring, but Yelena knew very well in her heart. She had never seen that engagement diamond ring before, but that diamond ring appeared on her. Moreover, Celine had insisted that she had stolen the ring, and the person who had searched her was also Celine!
If all these things were connected, it was definitely not a coincidence.
Yelena knew that Celine and Florina must have worked together to frame her, which was why things had unfolded to this point.
Therefore, Yelena turned to look at Celine and Florina!
When Florina saw Yelena’s gaze, she inevitably felt a little guilty, and her eyes became a little evasive.
After all, her plan was originally flawless. However, she didn’t think that Yelena’s boyfriend would have such a terrifying identity!
“It was the two of them who framed me. They deliberately placed the ring on me and wanted to frame me!”
Yelena pointed at Celine and Florina and said angrily.
When Yakov heard this, he quickly turned to look at Florina. Then, he asked Florina in a low voice, “Is that what happened?”
“Uncle… Uncle Yakov, you can’t listen to this woman’s nonsense. That’s my engagement ring. Why… why would I…”
Florina tried to explain.
“Shut up!”
Yakov shouted loudly, then continued, “If it was someone else who stole your ring, I might have believed it. But you’re saying that Mr. McDonald’s girlfriend stole your ring. Who is Mr. McDonald? How could Mr. McDonald’s girlfriend possibly steal your ring? Men, capture these two women and torture them until they tell the truth…”
At this moment, all Yakov wanted to do was figure out what was going on as soon as possible!
“Dad, what are you doing? Florina…”
Nikola hurriedly shouted.
“Shut up!”
Yakov was livid at this moment. He raised his leg and kicked Nikola to the ground.
Yakov’s bodyguards also rushed toward Florina and Celine.
Celine was one of Florina’s partner-in-crime. She knew how terrifying Yakov’s people were.
The moment Celine fell into Yakov’s hands, then the outcome would definitely be very miserable!
A trace of fear flashed across Florina’s eyes.
More than ten bodyguards surrounded the two girls.
Celine was just a little girl. She had never seen such a scene before.
So, at this moment, she was so scared that she sat on the ground. She hugged Yakov’s thigh and shouted, “Mr. Chakin the Second, this matter has nothing to do with me. I’ll tell you the truth. Please don’t hurt me…”
When Yakov heard Celine’s words, he hurriedly waved his hand at his bodyguards, then looked at Celine and said, “As long as you honestly tell me what happened today, I might let you off on the account that you took the initiative to confess…”
“Alright, alright…”
Celine hurriedly nodded, then looked at Yelena and said, “Actually, Florina threatened me to do what I did today. Florina asked me to have a conflict with Yelena and embarrass her in front of everyone. However, because of Mr. Lowe, Yelena escaped the disaster. Florina was not happy about it and asked me to frame Yelena. In fact, Yelena did not steal the ring. The ring had always been in my hands. I was forced to do everything. Mr. Chakin the Second, I beg you, please let me go!”
When everyone heard Celine’s words, their eyes widened in shock
No one had expected that Florina had orchestrated everything that had happened today.
“I didn’t expect Florina to be such a person!”
“That’s right, she’s really shameless. If it wasn’t for Yelena having a boyfriend like Mr. McDonald, she would have suffered for not reason!”
“Florina is too shameless…”
Everyone looked at Florina and began to discuss it in low voices.
At this moment, these people seemed to have changed 180 degrees.
The people who were mocking Florina now were the same people who had mocked Yelena back then!
Nikola could not accept this fact at all. He glared at Celine and shouted, “What the f*ck are you talking about? Why would Florina frame Yelena?”
“Because Florina wants to get the female lead role in Mr. Lowe’s new movie, but Mr. Lowe seems to like Yelena more, so Florina did all this!”
Celine answered without thinking.
Nikola was also dumbfounded when he heard Celine’s words. He stood there foolishly, not knowing how to retort.
The truth about Yelena stealing the ring had finally come to light!
Florina stood rooted to the ground; her face filled with despair.
She wanted to explain, but she did not know how to explain!

chapters.title: Chapter 739: Break His Leg!
chapters.content:
Chapter 739: Break His Leg!
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
After hearing Celine’s words, everyone present came to a realization.
It turned out that all of this was orchestrated by Florina!
At this moment, Florina was also feeling extremely desperate.
If she had known that this would happen, Florina would not have dared to frame Yelena even if she had a hundred guts!
Nikola stared at Florina with a dumbfounded expression.
He had never thought that Florina would have planned all of this.
If Florina had only framed an ordinary person, Nikola would not have said anything.
After all, he knew Florina’s character.
However, Florina’s target was not an ordinary person, but the girlfriend of Mr. McDonald from Porthampton.
Nikola hesitated for a moment, then a hint of viciousness flashed across his eyes.
At this moment, he could only choose to give up on his fiancee. After all, he could still find another fiancee. If he knelt down and apologized to Connor, then his life would be ruined!
Therefore, Nikola raised his head and looked at Connor. He said in a low voice, “Connor, I didn’t know anything about this. I didn’t know that Florina framed your girlfriend. There’s a huge misunderstanding here. It’s none of my business how you want to deal with Florina, but I don’t think I did anything wrong…”
When everyone heard what Nikola said, they became somewhat stunned.
They had never expected that Nikola would choose to give up on Florina!
Florina’s face was also filled with despair because even her fiance had abandoned her so heartlessly.
She stood rooted to the ground with a dull look in her eyes. She was extremely desperate!
Connor looked at Nikola indifferently and said coldly, “I asked you to kneel down and apologize to my girlfriend not because you mistakenly thought that my girlfriend stole the ring, but because you humiliated her just now…”
“I humiliated your girlfriend?”
Nikola frowned. He knew that Connor had no intention of letting him go.
“Are you sure you want me to apologize? I’ve already explained it to you very clearly. This matter has nothing to do with me. Why won’t you let me go? Connor, what do you want?”
Nikola shouted.
He felt that him handing Florina over to Connor was already his biggest concession.
However, he did not expect that Connor would still not budge at this time. Therefore, Nikola was feeling frustrated.
Everyone looked at Nikola, and their hearts were filled with disbelief.
No one had expected a big shot like Nikola to be forced to such a state.
“You bastard, shut up!”
At this moment, Yakov shouted at Nikola. He was extremely angry.
“Dad…”
Nikola couldn’t understand what was wrong with Yakov today. Why was he so afraid of Connor?
Nikola had no idea how terrifying Connor was.
“Mr. McDonald, how do you think we should handle this matter?”
Yakov took a deep breath and walked to Connor, asking Connor in a low voice.
“Your son said that he wanted to cut off my girlfriend’s right hand. I was going to give you face and let him kneel down and apologize to my girlfriend. But since he refuses to apologize, I’ll break one of his legs and treat it as a lesson for him…”
Connor replied to Yakov with a sneer, then turned around and sat on the sofa, squinting at Yakov.
Yakov was stunned when he heard Connor’s words.
Nikola also had a look of disbelief on his face. He shouted at Connor, “You actually want to break my leg?”
“I’m not the one who wants to break your leg…”
Connor gently shook his head, then pointed to Yakov and said, “It’s him!”
Nikola suddenly turned to look at Yakov.
“Bastard, I asked you to apologize to Mr. McDonald, but you didn’t apologize…”
Yakov gritted his teeth and roared in a low voice. Then, he turned and shouted at the bodyguard beside him, “Give me the gun…”
“Mr. Chakin the Second!”
The bodyguard hesitated for a moment, and he seemed to be a little troubled.
“Cut the crap. I told you to give me the gun. Didn’t you hear me?”
Yakov roared with his eyes wide open.
The bodyguard hesitated for a few seconds, then took out a black pistol from his waist and handed it to Yakov.
When everyone saw Yakov take the pistol, their eyes widened in disbelief.
No one would have thought that Yakov would actually be so ruthless, personally breaking his own son’s legs in order to please Connor!
A vicious tiger would not eat its cubs!
But at this moment, Yakov’s actions were clearly more vicious than a tiger!
Of course, what shocked everyone the most was Connor’s influence!
Connor merely said a sentence, but in Yakov’s eyes, it was like a royal edict. He did not resist in the slightest.
Such influence was way too terrifying!
Connor had not said a word from the beginning to the end, and he was unusually calm.
If it wasn’t for what Nikola said to Yelena, Connor wouldn’t be so angry!
To Connor, if someone humiliated him, he would not stoop to the other party’s level.
However, if someone dared to humiliate his woman, Connor would definitely not be able to tolerate it!
If he couldn’t even protect the woman beside him, then what could Connor do no matter how rich or powerful he was?
After Yakov took the pistol from the bodyguard, he directly walked toward Nikola.
Nikola could feel a trace of killing intent from Yakov’s eyes.
He knew in his heart that Yakov was not joking with him. Yakov might really break his leg!
“Dad… Dad, are you really going to break my leg?”
Nikola stammered.
“Mr. McDonald is right. If I don’t teach you a lesson, you won’t learn your lesson. Who knows what trouble you’ll cause in the future.”
Yakov slowly raised his pistol and said coldly.
“Dad, listen to me. I know I was wrong. I’ll kneel down and apologize to him now, okay? I know what I did wrong now…”
Nikola finally knew fear and shouted at the top of his lungs.
Yakov took a deep breath and aimed the gun at Nikola!
Bang!
There was a loud bang.
In an instant, the entire hall became deathly silent.
Everyone was stunned, looking at this scene in a daze. They were utterly shocked by what just happened..

chapters.title: Chapter 740: Withdraw from the Entertainment Industry
chapters.content:
Chapter 740: Withdraw from the Entertainment Industry
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Yakov had roamed the martial world for decades, and countless people had died at his hands.
Yakov was able to have his current status completely by relying on his own hands, killing a bloody path.
He was naturally very familiar with guns.
After Yakov pulled the trigger, the bullet hit Nikola’s knee.
Bang!
Nikola knelt on the ground and hugged his knees. He looked to be in great pain.
Fresh blood flowed down Nikola’s pants and dyed the ground red!
Nikola’s painful wails instantly resounded throughout the entire banquet hall.
Everyone’s eyes were wide open as they watched this scene in a daze. They were extremely shocked.
No one expected Yakov to actually shoot Nikola!
Yelena stared at Yakov and Nikola with her big, watery eyes. Her face was filled with shock and fear. This was the first time she had seen someone shoot!
Yelena felt that everything was like a dream. Whether it was Connor’s identity or Yakov’s shooting and breaking Nikola’s leg, everything seemed so unreal and unbelievable.
However, at this moment, Yakov walked in front of Nikola again with the pistol in his hand and raised his pistol.
Bang!
Another gunshot.
The bullet pierced Nikola’s thigh this time.
“Ah…”
After Nikola screamed, he fainted due to the intense pain.
When Florina saw this scene, her face turned extremely pale.
She suddenly felt her vision go black and then she fainted.
After all, if Yakov treated Nikola like this, Florina did not even dare to imagine how miserable her fate would be.
Celine was already kneeling on the ground and crying her eyes out. How could she have imagined that this matter would end up like this?
After Yakov had fired two shots at Nikola, he turned to look at Connor and asked Connor softly, “Mr. McDonald, do you think that’s enough?”
“That’s enough…”
Connor nodded lightly.
In fact, Connor was more or less surprised because he did not expect Yakov to be so vicious and merciless. He could even hurt his own son.
At this time, Yakov was already willing to pay any price in order to please Connor!
Yakov slowly put away the pistol, then turned to the bodyguard behind him and shouted, “What are you guys still standing there for? Hurry up and send him to the hospital…”
When the bodyguard heard Yakov’s words, he rushed to Nikola.
A few minutes later, Nikola was carried out of the hall by the bodyguards.
Everyone looked at the pool of bright red blood on the ground and could not help but suck in a breath of cold air. They were extremely terrified.
At this moment, all the rich celebrities present did not dare to look Connor in the eye.
Especially those who had mocked Connor before. At they were filled with regret. They were afraid that Connor would take revenge on them.
Dominic Turner and the others weren’t too afraid, but they were shocked.
This was because the two of them really could not understand when Connor had turned from a poor boy to a super-rich guy!
However, Dominic, Spencer the others had already had a premonition. After all, many unusual things had happened to Connor in school.
However, Connor explained to them that he had won the grand prize, so Spencer and Dominic did not think too much about it.
However, at this moment, they realized that Connor did not just win the lottery.
Yakov calmed himself down and walked to Connor. He looked at Connor respectfully and asked, “Mr. McDonald, how do you plan to deal with those two women?”
“I don’t want to see these two people again!”
Connor replied indifferently.
“I understand…”
Yakov hurriedly nodded and then signaled his bodyguards to take Celine and Florina away.
Florina, who had been unconscious, suddenly woke up after hearing Connor’s words.
She hurriedly crawled to Connor and hugged his thigh tightly. She shouted at Connor, “Mr. McDonald, I beg you, please let me go. As long as you let me go, I’ll do anything you want me to do…”
Florina felt that she was a beauty not less than Yelena. On the contrary, she was sexier and more charming than Yelena. Therefore, she was prepared to use her body to exchange for a chance to live.
But Connor didn’t pay any attention to her. He stood up and walked to Yelena’s side, then asked her softly, “How do you want to deal with this woman?”
When Yelena heard Connor’s words, she couldn’t help but be stunned for a moment. Then, she whispered to Connor, “Connor, just make her quit the entertainment industry. I don’t want to make a big deal out of this…” “Did you hear that?”
Connor turned his head and asked Florina.
“I heard that. I heard that…”
Florina quickly nodded and said to Yelena, “Yelena, thank you. Thank you…”
Yelena looked at Florina helplessly and said nothing.
No one had expected Florina, who was known as one of the four most popular actresses in the entertainment industry, to retire from the industry in such a way.
If it weren’t for Florina’s terrifying jealousy, she would never have ended up like this.
“Mr. McDonald, there are a few presidential suites on the top floor of the cruise ship. It’s getting late now. Why don’t you and your friend stay for the night?” Yakov whispered to Connor.
“Alright.”
Connor nodded gently and held Yelena’s hand. He walked to Dominic, Spencer and the others and said softly, “Let’s go!”
After saying this, Connor directly walked out of the hall.
Those people who were originally surrounding Connor instantly scattered.
Everyone looked at Connor, their faces filled with extreme fear.
Dominic, Spencer and the others were stunned for a moment before they followed Connor, Yelena and the others out of the hall.
Yuliana Schneider took a deep breath and followed Connor.
After Yakov had sent Connor, Yelena, Dominic, Spencer, and the others out of the hall, he specially arranged the most luxurious suite on the cruise ship for them.
After Yakov, Connor, and the others had left, everyone present fell into chaos.
They began to discuss what had happened today in low voices.
After all, no one had expected an engagement banquet to turn out like this..

chapters.title: Chapter 741: The Vicious Yakov Chakin
chapters.content:
Chapter 741: The Vicious Yakov Chakin
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
After Yakov had settled Connor and the others down, he returned to the hall again.
At this time, the guests in the hall had not yet dispersed. They seemed to be waiting for Yakov’s return.
After seeing Yakov appear, everyone began to become restless.
Yakov forced a smile and said in a low voice, “Ladies and gentlemen, I’m very grateful that you’re able to attend my son’s engagement banquet tonight. However, there was an accident at the banquet just now. My son accidentally broke his leg, and that has interrupted everyone’s night. I apologize to everyone here. The banquet will continue. I’ve prepared rooms for everyone for after the banquet. I hope everyone will enjoy themselves tonight!”
When everyone heard Yakov’s words, their eyes widened in shock.
Because everyone present had seen it, it was Yakov who had shot and broken Nikola’s leg!
But now, Yakov actually said that Nikola accidentally broke his leg. Wasn’t this clearly nonsense?
“Wally, help me host the party…”
Yakov turned and said to the young man behind him.
“Alright…”
The young man hurriedly nodded.
Yakov took a deep breath and walked out of the hall.
After Yakov had left, the guests present instantly began to discuss softly among themselves.
“I didn’t expect that the Mr. McDonald of Porthampton would actually be this guy-”
“That’s right, this Connor guy is really terrifying. We mustn’t provoke him in the future!”
“A person that even Mr. Chakin the Second doesn’t dare to offend. If we were to offend this Connor guy, who knows what horror awaits…”
Everyone began to whisper, their eyes filled with fear.
These people didn’t even dare to offend Yakov, how would they possibly have the guts to provoke Connor?
“What did Mr. Chakin the Second mean by that just now? He was clearly the one who shot and broke Mr. Chakin Jr.’s leg. Why did he still say…”
At this moment, a young man who had yet to figure out the situation shouted.
“Shut up!”
The middle-aged man beside the man hurriedly slapped him on the face. He looked angry.
After the man was slapped by the middle-aged man, he instantly became quiet and covered his face, not daring to speak.
“Isn’t Nikola’s lesson enough? There are some things you can’t just say out loud.”
The middle-aged man stared at the man and shouted, then continued, “Since Mr. Chakin the Second has already said so, it means that Mr. Chakin Jr. has no intention of dwelling further on this matter. He is also warning us not to spread this matter. Just now, Nikola broke his leg himself, it was not done by Mr. Chakin the Second.”
The man looked at the middle-aged man with a complicated expression.
They were clearly distorting the truth!
“Mr. Chakin the Second is a smart person. He knows that he is not a match for Mr. McDonald. Moreover, Nikola was the one who offended Connor first. If this matter is blown up, it will not benefit him at all. Therefore, he can only use this method to deal with this. Although Nikola has broken a leg, he is still alive. Moreover, this can appease Mr. McDonald’s anger. This outcome is not bad for Mr. Chakin the Second…”
At this moment, an old man in a suit could not help but analyze.
“Yeah. Since Mr. Chakin the Second was willing to do it, it means that this is an ideal outcome…”
The other middle-aged man also nodded.
“Let alone breaking Nikola’s legs today, he wouldn’t hesitate to kill Nikola. After all, Mr. Chakin the Second has so many mistresses and illegitimate children. So what if he crippled Nikola?”
“Nikola is way too arrogant. He uses his father’s name to do whatever he wants. Now, he’s finally forced to learn a lesson…”
“With Nikola’s style of doing things, I’ve long thought that something would happen to him!”
At this moment, the people present all changed their previous stance and began to criticize Yakov and Nikola.
It was as if in the eyes of these people, Nikola deserved this fate.
However, at this moment, these people’s speculations were rather on point.
Because after Yakov left the hall, the grief on his face instantly disappeared. On the contrary, he felt much more relaxed.
After all, if Yakov could resolve this matter satisfactorily, the huge stone that was weighing on him could finally be safely lifted.
As for whether Nikola was alive or dead, he did not care at all.
