Otherwise, under normal circumstances, Yakov would have rushed to the hospital to visit his son!
However, he didn’t do that!
“Mr. Chakin the Second, what do you plan to do next? Do you want me to find a few powerful martial artists? Mr. McDonald is still on the ship. Although Mr. McDonald’s skills are quite good, it’s easy to kill him…”
One of Yakov’s subordinates pretended to be smart and asked Yakov.
When Yakov heard this, he could not help but frown. Then, he turned and shouted at the bodyguard behind him, “Throw this person off the ship…”
“Yes, sir!”
When the other bodyguards heard Yakov’s words, they did not hesitate at all and directly threw the man who pretended to be smart off the boat.
Yakov narrowed his eyes as he looked at his underling who was struggling on the surface of the sea. A trace of viciousness flashed across his eyes, and then he shouted loudly, “He’s so f*cking brainless. He’s still thinking of taking revenge for that bastard at a time like this. If he hadn’t messed up his head because of some woman, how could such a big thing have happened today? It wasn’t easy for me to escape this calamity. It wouldn’t be a shame if he died…”
Yakov didn’t feel the slightest bit of heartache when he broke Nikola’s leg. On the contrary, he felt embarrassed.
Yakov had more than a dozen illegitimate children. Any one of them was a hundred times more outstanding than Nikola.
However, Nikola was born to Yakov’s wife, so he received the most attention.
Yakov had long been dissatisfied with Nikola. At this moment, he could use this opportunity to teach Nikola a good lesson.
He wanted Nikola to restrain himself in the future so that he wouldn’t cause any more trouble for him.
If a son was crippled, Yakov could still have more sons!
However, if he lost all his current businesses because of such a small matter, it would be even more unbearable than death itself.

chapters.title: Chapter 742: Who Are You?
chapters.content:
Chapter 742: Who Are You?
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Yakov stood alone on the deck, looking at the distant scenery with a cold expression. No one knew what he was thinking.
“Mr. Chakin the Second, you’re really heartless. You cripped your own son!”
At this moment, a voice sounded from behind Yakov.
Yakov slowly turned to look behind him, then said in a low voice, “Mr. Lambert, I’ve made a fool of myself today…”
“It’s fine…”
Cade Lambert gently waved his hand and continued, “I think that just breaking
Nikola’s leg won’t be enough to appease the anger in Mr. McDonald’s heart…” “Then, what do you think we should do to appease Mr. McDonald’s anger?” When Yakov heard Cade’s words, he could not help but be stunned for a moment and asked with a puzzled expression.
“Mr. Chakin the Second, how about this? I’ll ask my two daughters to come over now. Later, you can bring my two daughters with you to apologize to Mr. McDonald and offer my daughters to him. This is a good thing for both you and me.”
Cade said lightly.
Yakov was stunned when he heard Cade’s words. He was in disbelief.
He had never thought that Cade would be so anxious to sacrifice his daughters!
“Isn’t this a little inappropriate?”
Yakov replied in a low voice.
“No, now is the best time to give my two daughters to Mr. McDonald. As long as Mr. McDonald can accept our gifts, I will become Mr. McDonald’s father-in- law. Mr. McDonald will also owe you a favor. This is beneficial to both of us…” Cade said lightly.
“Alright, then I can help introduce you to him!”
Yakov hesitated for a moment before nodding.
“Hahaha…”
Cade couldn’t help but laugh out loud. Then, he took out his mobile phone and dialed a number.
Ring! Ring!
The phone rang twice, and the other party picked up the call.
“Yarrow, you and Yucca pack up and come to the Princess Cruise Ship. I’ll get someone to pick you up. Remember to dress prettily, you understand?” Cade said as he held the phone.
A few minutes later, Cade put down his phone and returned to Yakov’s side. He whispered to Yakov, “Yakov, my two daughters will be here soon. When the time comes, it’ll be up to you…”
“Will there be any problems? If Mr. McDonald is not satisfied with your two daughters, then it might get troublesome…”
Yakov asked worriedly.
“You don’t have to worry about that. My two daughters are twins. They are both top-notch beauties. They are about the same age as Mr. McDonald. I believe that Mr. McDonald will definitely be tempted when he sees my daughters…” Cade said with a smile.
“That’s good, that’s good…”
Yakov hurriedly nodded after hearing Cade’s words.
If other people heard the conversation between Yakov and Cade, they would definitely be very surprised.
After all, who would have thought that the dignified deputy director of the Bureau of Industry and Commerce and the famous Yakov Chakin would choose to sacrifice their son and daughters for Connor!
In the eyes of ordinary people, this was simply a fantasy!
On the other side, Connor followed Yelena back to the room.
At this moment, Yelena looked at Connor with an expression of disbelief on her face, as if she still reeling from the shock from before.
Connor gently patted Yelena’s head, then smiled and said, “I know you must have a lot of questions to ask me now, but my friends are waiting for me outside, so I’ll go meet them first and then come back to explain everything to you.”
“Alright…”
Yelena took a deep breath and nodded at Connor.
Connor looked at Yelena and smiled, then walked out of the room.
After leaving the room, Connor came to the room where Dominic Turner, Spencer and the others were.
Sure enough, Dominic, Spencer, Yuliana Schneider, Sarina Watts and the others were all gathered in the room.
When Cindy Stone found out about Connor’s identity, she seemed to be worried that Connor would take revenge on her, so she was no longer with them.
II II
When everyone saw Connor walk into the room, they all turned to look at Connor, shock written all over their faces.
“I know you must have a lot of questions to ask me now. If you have anything to ask, just ask!”
Connor said to Dominic, Spencer and the others with a smile.
However, Dominic, Spencer, Yuliana, and the others looked at Connor nervously. No one dared to say anything.
Seeing that everyone was silent, Connor smiled helplessly and then said indifferently, “You don’t have to look at me like that. We’re all friends. I won’t treat you like how I treated Nikola…”
When everyone heard Connor’s words, a strange look flashed across their eyes.
“Connor, can you tell me the truth? Who are you?”
Dominic hesitated for a moment before asking Connor in a low voice.
“Who am I?”
When Connor heard Dominic’s question, he couldn’t help but smile faintly, then continued, “Actually, I’m the Connor that you know…”
“Then, why is Yakov Chakin so afraid of you?”
Dominic looked at Connor and continued to ask.
“A few months ago, I suddenly received a phone call and inexplicably inherited a large amount of inheritance. This inheritance includes a lot of money and many listed companies. For example, Thomas Morgan and Kyle Hayes of Porthampton are now my subordinates. Although these things sound a little unbelievable, that’s what happened. I just inherited a large amount of inheritance…”
Connor explained to Dominic, Spencer and the others.
“What kind of inheritance is it that can make people like Thomas Morgan and Kyle Hayes work for you?”
Yuliana couldn’t help but exclaim.
“This inheritance was left behind by one of my grandfather’s younger cousins. As for the details, I’m not very sure, but all I know is that I’m very rich now. I’m so rich that I don’t even know how much I have…”
Connor said helplessly.
“Then, how did you become so strong?”
Spencer asked Connor.
“Remember how my face was all swollen and bruised a while back?”
Connor looked at Spencer and asked.
“Yeah, kind of…”
Spencer hurriedly nodded.
“That’s because I’ve been learning martial arts from an old man recently, so I was beaten black and blue. It’s also because of this period of training that my skills have become so good!”
Connor explained patiently.

chapters.title: Chapter 743: Beautiful Twin Girls
chapters.content:
Chapter 743: Beautiful Twin Girls
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Princess Cruise Ship, in a luxurious private room.
Connor spent a lot of time explaining his situation to Dominic and the others.
Even though Dominic, Spencer and the others felt that everything was unbelievable, they seemed to have accepted the truth very quickly.
“Connor, I didn’t expect you to be a hidden heir. Since you are so rich, you have to take care of us in the future…”
Spencer put his arm around Connor’s shoulder and said casually to Connor.
“That’s right, Connor. Since you’re so rich now, there will definitely be a lot of beautiful women casting flirtatious glances at you in the future. If there’s anyone you don’t like, just introduce them to me. I’m still single now anyway…”
Dominic also said to Connor with envy.
Yuliana stood rooted to the ground, feeling extremely regretful.
Because she clearly had the chance to go further with Connor just now, but she personally ruined this opportunity.
If she had been a little more proactive, she might have already had sex with him. At that time, Yuliana would have been able to reach the top in one move!
However, there was no medicine for regret in this world. It was too late for Yuliana to regret now.
“If you need my help in the future, just tell me. As long as I can help you, I will definitely help…”
Connor looked at Dominic, Spencer and the others with a faint smile, then continued, “But I also have something I need your help with!”
“Is there anything else you need our help with?”
When Dominic heard Connor’s words, he could not help but be stunned for a moment, and he seemed to be somewhat puzzled.
“Currently, there aren’t many people who know my true identity. I also don’t want too many people to know my true identity. So, I hope that you can help me keep this secret and not reveal my identity…”
Connor looked at Dominic, Spencer and the others and said softly.
Dominic, Spencer and the others seemed to understand Connor’s intentions after hearing that, so they quickly agreed.
Connor left the room after explaining to Dominic, Spencer and the others.
Dominic, Spencer and the others had their doubts solved. They were naturally very happy to have a rich friend like Connor.
So, after Connor left, they chatted for a bit and then went back to their rooms to rest.
Connor had just left Dominic and Spencer’s room when Yakov hurriedly walked toward Connor.
“Mr. McDonald, there you are…”
When Yakov saw Connor, he said to Connor with an excited expression.
When Connor heard Yakov’s words, he couldn’t help but be stunned for a moment. Then, he subconsciously turned around to take a look.
He realized that there were actually two beautiful women following behind Yakov!
One of the beauties was wearing a short skirt that was wrapped around her hips. She had light makeup on her face and had a noble aura. She had a slender waist, full breasts, and long, fair legs. Her figure was also very sexy. She looked sexy and had a hint of coldness.
The other beauty was even more youthful and beautiful. She was wearing a white dress, and her tall figure looked especially charming under the contrast of the short dress. Her slender and fair legs were exposed to the air without reservation. She was also wearing a pair of black high heels. Her pretty face and large, wavy black hair was indescribably tempting.
The two beauties looked very similar, but they were dressed differently.
At this moment, when the two beauties saw Connor, they seemed to be a little nervous. They kept sizing up Connor.
The two of them thought that they were going to serve a middle-aged greasy man today, but the two of them didn’t expect Connor to be so young!
“What is it?”
Connor shifted his gaze from the beauties to Yakov and asked Yakov softly.
After hesitating for a moment, Yakov knelt on the ground with a thud. Then, he gritted his teeth and said to Connor in a low voice, “Mr. McDonald, my son has offended you today. I’m here to apologize to you…”
“Apologize?”
When Connor heard Yakov’s words, he could not help but be stunned for a moment.
“That’s right, Mr. McDonald. Today, I’m here to apologize.”
Yakov looked at Connor and hurriedly nodded.
“Oh…”
Connor replied placidly and didn’t say anything more.
Yakov took a deep breath, then looked at Connor and continued, “Mr. McDonald, since Yelena is your girlfriend, don’t worry. From today onward, the Chakin family’s film company will vigorously promote Miss Yelena to fame. I guarantee that in less than half a year, Miss Yelena will become a hot star in Oprana…”
“You don’t have to worry about my girlfriend. I don’t think she’ll like this way of rising to fame either. As long as your son’s fiancee doesn’t cause trouble for my girlfriend…”
Connor said expressionlessly.
When Yakov heard Connor’s words, his face turned somewhat pale, and he seemed to be even more afraid.
He hurriedly whispered to Connor, “Mr. McDonald, what can I do to make you let me go?”
“I didn’t say I’m going to do anything to you…”
Connor looked at Yakov in front of him and smiled helplessly. Then, he said indifferently, “I have already made myself clear. Although your son has offended me, you have not offended me. This matter has nothing to do with you. Therefore, you don’t have to worry that I will do anything to you. Just do what you’re supposed to do…”
“That’s a relief…”
When Yakov heard Connor’s words, he finally heaved a sigh of relief, and he was clearly much more relaxed now.
“Is there anything else? If there’s nothing else, I’ll be heading back to my room now…”
Connor whispered to Yakov.
When Yakov heard Connor’s words, he couldn’t help but be stunned for a moment. Then, he hurriedly said to Connor, “Mr. McDonald, let me introduce you. These two are Cade Lambert’s daughters. Mr. Lambert knows that you might not be in a good mood today, so he specially asked his two daughters to spend some time with you…”
When Connor heard Yakov’s words, he seemed to be a little helpless.
At this moment, Connor finally realized that Yakov was not here to apologize to him, but to send him beautiful women!
When Yakov finished speaking, he glanced at Yarrow Lambert and Yucca Lambert who were standing behind him. Then, he turned around and was about to leave.

chapters.title: Chapter 744: You’re Rich, Right?
chapters.content:
Chapter 744: You’re Rich, Right?
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
When Yakov saw Yarrow and Yucca, he was extremely shocked.
He didn’t think that Cade’s daughters would be so beautiful. They were simply two perfect cannons!
Moreover, Yakov felt that Connor was currently at the age of hot-bloodedness, so he probably wouldn’t reject exquisite beauties like Yarrow and Yucca.
Therefore, the moment he turned around, he revealed a very proud smile.
“Yakov, take these two women away!”
Just when Yakov thought that his plan had succeeded, Connor suddenly opened his mouth and shouted.
When Yakov heard Connor’s words, the smile on his face instantly froze.
If it were any other man, he would definitely try his best to get them into bed after seeing how beautiful they were.
However, this honey trap had no effect on Connor.
After all, Yelena was on the ship now. It was impossible for Connor to have anything to do with another woman.
Also, Connor had a bad impression of women. He had always been on guard for some reason.
Yarrow and Yucca were the best of the best in terms of both their figures and looks.
Connor also wanted to sleep with them, but he would not really do anything with these two women.
Because Connor knew in his heart that if he really slept with these two women, it would be equivalent to boarding Yakov and Cade’s pirate ship. At that time, he would definitely be used by the two of them.
Connor didn’t lack women around him, so he naturally wouldn’t want to sleep with beautiful women just because he has seen them.
When Yakov heard Connor’s words, he was also extremely shocked.
He couldn’t help but turn to look at Connor, then said in a low voice, “Mr. McDonald, this is just Mr. Lambert’s way of showing sincerity. He doesn’t mean anything else by it…”
“Of course, there’s isn’t any hidden agenda here, but you’d better take the two of them with you!”
Connor waved his hand helplessly.
“Mr. McDonald, don’t worry. Yucca and Yarrow are still young and have never been touched by any other men. They are very pure and innocent…”
Yakov said to Connor with a smile.
When Yarrow and Yucca heard Yakov’s words, a hint of embarrassment flashed across their eyes, and their pretty faces blushed a little.
However, the two of them did not refute anything because their mission this time was to sleep with Connor, so the two of them had nothing to refute.
Connor also had a helpless expression as he said in a low voice, “That’s not what I meant. My girlfriend is still on the ship. I’m worried that my girlfriend will misunderstand if she sees this, so you should take them with you!”
A trace of disappointment flashed across Yakov’s eyes, and he said in a low voice, “Mr. McDonald, do you want me to make arrangements for later? It’s not easy to meet such beautiful twins…”
“No…”
Connor didn’t even think about it and directly rejected his offer.
“Then…Then, please get a good rest tonight…”
Yakov knew that Connor was indeed not interested in these two women. He sighed softly, then turned to look at Yarrow and Yucca, and then turned to leave.
Yarrow and Yucca couldn’t help but look at Connor from head to toe. They heaved a long sigh of relief in their hearts before leaving with Yakov.
On the other side.
Cade, who had been waiting anxiously outside the cruise ship, had a strange look in his eyes when he saw Yakov and the other two coming back out.
He quickly took a step forward and asked Yarrow and Yucca, “Why are the two of you here? Didn’t I ask you two to stay with Mr. McDonald?”
“It was Mr. McDonald who asked me to bring the two of them with me…”
Yakov replied helplessly.
“What?”
When Cade heard this, he was stunned.
“It seems that your honey trap is not very effective on Mr. McDonald. I told you long ago that Mr. McDonald is not so easy to bribe!”
Yakov whispered to Cade.
“How… How is this possible? Mr. McDonald was actually not interested in them?”
Cade subconsciously looked at his two daughters with an incredulous expression on his face.
He could not believe that there was a man in this world who was not interested in his two daughters.
Yarrow and Yucca had always been lethal weapons in Cade’s hands!
Yarrow and Yucca were the children of one of Cade’s mistresses. Seeing that the two of them were beautiful, he brought them home and carefully nurtured them.
Cade wanted to make the two of them into two peerless beauties, so the two sisters had suffered a lot over the years. They were forced by Cade to learn how to seduce men since they were young, which led to the current Yarrow and Yucca.
These two women were simply walking aphrodisiacs. Every frown and smile seemed to exude charm and endless temptation.
Furthermore, Cade was very protective of Yarrow and Yucca. The opportunity they had to interact with the opposite sex since they were young was very limited.
Even when they went to university, the two of them would still have bodyguards by their side.
As long as a man tried to approach the two of them, he would be chased away by Cade’s bodyguards.
Cade had always been very confident in his two daughters. He had always been looking for an opportunity to make the most of Yarrow and Yucca’s bodies!
At this moment, Connor was the best opportunity in Cade’s eyes!
But what Cade did not expect was that Connor actually rejected his good intentions.
In Cade’s eyes, this was simply impossible!
“Father…”
Yarrow called out to Cade softly, then continued, “This Mr. McDonald is different from other men…”
“How useless can you two be?! Follow me!”
Cade snorted coldly, turned around, and walked into the distance.
Yakov looked at the backs of Cade and the other two and sighed softly, then turned around and walked into the cruise ship.
After Yakov and the others left, Connor returned to Yelena’s room alone.
“Connor, you’re back?”
When Yelena saw Connor, she shouted excitedly and threw herself into Connor’s arms.
Connor held Yelena in his arms and said softly, “Yelena, I’ve actually been lying to you. I’m not some…”
“You’re rich, right?”
Before Connor could finish, Yelena suddenly looked at Connor and said.
After hearing Yelena’s words, Connor was stunned. Then, he said helplessly, “So, you’ve already guessed it?”
“Actually, I’ve always had this feeling, but I had no way to find out!”
Yelena lightly replied.

chapters.title: Chapter 745: A Lover’s Duty
chapters.content:
Chapter 745: A Lover’s Duty
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
In the presidential suite.
Connor looked at Yelena in his arms, and he was a little surprised.
He didn’t expect that Yelena would have already guessed his identity.
“Actually, when you won so much money at the casino, but you still looked indifferent, I knew you weren’t an ordinary person. If you were really an ordinary person, you definitely wouldn’t have been so calm. Even I would be a little surprised to see so much money…”
Yelena nestled in Connor’s arms and continued, “Later on, you lost all the money. Actually, you just didn’t want to expose your identity. Also, I wanted to share the money I’d won with you, but you didn’t want it. If you were an ordinary person, you would never have rejected that money. After all, it was enough to change your life.”
“That’s right…”
Connor nodded lightly.
“Were you also the rich man who helped me earn money on Tiktok?”
Yelena looked at Connor and continued to ask.
“Yeah!”
Connor nodded again.
“I didn’t expect to find a rich heir as my boyfriend. I’m so lucky…”
At this moment, Yelena had clearly calmed down a lot. She was back to being herself as she smiled at Connor.
“Do you want to hear my story?”
Connor hesitated for a moment before asking Yelena.
“Yes…”
Yelena hurriedly nodded.
Connor took a deep breath and then told Yelena everything about his inheritance.
When Yelena heard what he said, she was very surprised.
Because she felt that what happened to Connor was really unbelievable.
“Yelena, there’s actually something I haven’t told you!”
At this moment, Connor suddenly said to Yelena.
Yelena couldn’t help but be stunned when she heard what he said. She asked Connor with a puzzled expression, “What is it?”
“Actually, I already have a fiancee. When I inherited the inheritance back then, there was a condition in the contract, and that was that I have to marry my current fiancee…”
Connor thought about it for a long time and finally decided to tell Yelena about this because he knew he couldn’t hide it forever.
If II
When Yelena heard Connor’s words, she was instantly dumbfounded. She stared at Connor with her big watery eyes in disbelief.
“Are you saying that you already have a fiancee?”
Yelena bit her lips and asked Connor.
“That’s right…”
Connor nodded helplessly and continued, “I know that it is extremely unfair for me to tell you this now. If you want to leave me, I will respect your decision…” Yelena looked at Connor without saying anything.
“I’ve already told you everything about me…”
Connor looked at Yelena and wanted to speak, but Yelena threw herself into Connor’s arms and hugged him. Then, she gritted her teeth and said to Connor, “I didn’t despise you when you were poor. Now that you’re a rich guy, you want to dump me, huh? You, Connor, are my man. I will never let you go…”
“But I already have a fiancee. I can’t marry you!”
Connor said helplessly.
“Then, why didn’t you think about this when you slept with me?”
Yelena looked at Connor and questioned.
IIJ II
Connor did not know how to answer this question.
“You’ve already slept with me, and now you want to pull up your pants and leave? I won’t let you go, but I won’t make things difficult for you. Since I can’t marry you, I’ll be your lover. Anyway, you’re so rich, so it shouldn’t be a problem for you to keep me by your side, right?”
Yelena asked Connor with a smile.
Connor looked at Yelena with a trace of shock in his eyes. He was already mentally preparing himself for the worst. He thought that Yelena would leave in anger after finding out about everything.
However, he did not expect Yelena to react in such a way.
“You silly girl…”
Connor looked at Yelena dotingly.
“Don’t think too much. I’m your lover because you’re rich. There’s no other reason!”
Yelena whispered.
Connor knew that the reason Yelena said this was just to make him less embarrassed.
After all, no woman would be willing to be someone else’s lover.
As for Yelena saying that she did it for money, Connor knew that Yelena was not short of money at all. Moreover, she would not do anything to sell her body for money. Otherwise, she would not have chosen to be with Connor back then.
“Since you said that you’re willing to be my lover, shouldn’t you do your part as a lover?”
Connor stretched out his hand and gently patted Yelena’s seductive buttocks, smiling as he said to her.
“What do you mean?”
Yelena turned and looked at Connor with a tinge of shyness on her face.
“What do you think it means?”
When Connor saw how Yelena was looking at him, his desire was instantly ignited.
He picked up the beauty in his arms and the two of them kissed.
Connor did not choose to bring Yelena back to the bedroom. Instead, he placed her directly on the table.
Perhaps it was because Yelena had already slept with Connor, so this time, she was more open to his advances.
Yelena’s fair arms were tightly wrapped around Connor’s neck. She sat on the table and said to Connor with a charming look, “Hubby…”
When Connor heard Yelena’s words, he could no longer hold back.
At this moment, Yelena used all her strength to lift her high heels up into the air, swaying them along with their movements.
After an unknown period of time, Connor finally stopped.
Meanwhile, Yelena was lying on the table as if she was about to faint.
In Connor’s eyes, Yelena could only be described as flirtatious.
Of course, Yelena would only show this side of her to Connor.
Yelena looked at Connor, her face filled with happiness.
She really liked Connor. Regardless of whether Connor was an ordinary person or a rich guy, Yelena was willing to give everything to Connor.
Yelena was different from many women. When she met Connor, he was still a poor guy.
Therefore, even if Yelena knew Connor’s identity, her feelings for him would not change!

chapters.title: Chapter 746: Name a Price!
chapters.content:
Chapter 746: Name a Price!
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Yelena, this woman, only knew how to act coquettishly in front of Connor and would put on a small woman’s petite energy.
Not only did she know how to cater to Connor’s needs, but she also knew how to reject him.
Only such a woman could make a man truly crazy.
Connor and Yelena were in the living room first, then they went to the balcony and finally returned to the bedroom.
It wasn’t until two o’clock in the morning that the two of them stopped cuddled each other.
“Darling, let’s sleep…”
Connor gently patted Yelena’s white back and said softly.
“Hug me, please.”
Yelena lay in Connor’s arms and said coquettishly.
Connor turned his head to look at this flirtatious woman and couldn’t help but smile faintly. Then, he pulled Yelena into his arms.
No man would reject a woman like Yelena.
After an unknown period of time, Connor and Yelena finally fell asleep!
Connor did not go back with Dominic, Spencer and the rest because he had bumped into Yelena.
Instead, he accompanied Yelena on the Princess Cruise Ship for a few days. When Yelena was about to go for her audition, Connor returned to Porthampton alone.
Yelena’s audition was very successful, plus Quentin knew about the relationship between Yelena and Connor.
In order to please Connor, Quentin very easily let Yelena get this role.
However, what made Connor feel a little reluctant was that Yelena’s movie needed to be filmed in the US most of the time.
Therefore, after Yelena’s audition was successful, she had to follow the production team overseas. Connor estimated that he would not be able to see Yelena for a long time.
After returning to Porthampton, Connor immediately went to Jorge’s house.
After all, Connor had not come to fight with Jabba during this period of time. Connor was worried that the cultivation that he had painstakingly improved would be wasted because of this.
After the incident with Nikola Chakin, Connor deeply realized that no matter how terrifying a person’s background was or how rich they were, it was not as good as having real ability to protect oneself.
When Nikola’s bodyguards attacked Connor, if it wasn’t for his skills, he would have been thrown into the sea by Nikola’s bodyguards. If that had happened, then no matter how powerful Connor’s background was, he might not have survived.
Therefore, Connor felt that no matter what, it was still most important to increase his strength!
Connor had just walked into Jorge’s house when Jabba suddenly rushed towards him!
However, Jabba was not excited because he missed Connor. It was because he had not hit Connor for a while, and Jabba’s hands were a little itchy.
“This silly gorilla’s treating me like a human sandbag…”
Connor looked at Jabba, who was running towards him, and a hint of helplessness flashed across his eyes.
“Tsk…”
Jabba bared his teeth at Connor, then charged towards Connor at an astonishing speed. His fist swung towards Connor’s head.
Connor hurriedly dodged Jabba’s punch and then continued to evade him while looking for an opportunity to counterattack.
He was no longer the Connor from before. Although he was still not a match for Jabba, he would no longer be beaten up like a fool.
Now, Connor could perfectly dodge most of Jabba’s attacks. Sometimes, he could even find a chance to fight back.
However, Jabba’s reaction speed was very shocking. Even if Connor had the chance to counterattack, he could not really touch Jabba.
As for Jorge, he was still the same as before. He sat on the armchair and sunbathed. He didn’t care about Connor and Jabba’s situation at all!
Connor lasted for about half an hour in Jabba’s hands before he was sent flying by a punch!
After being sent flying by Jabba’s punch, Connor’s body smashed into the wall.
Connor felt as if his chest had been hit by a huge rock. It hurt!
Jabba did not seem to have any intention of letting Connor go. He rushed towards Connor excitedly.
“I’m not fighting anymore! I give!” Connor hurriedly waved at Jabba and struggled to stand up, exhaustion written all over his face. He couldn’t help but pout, You stupid gorilla… We’ve known each other for so long, yet you don’t know how to hold back. Are you trying to kill me?”
Jabba seemed to be able to understand Connor’s words. He grinned fiercely at Connor and returned to Jorge’s side.
Connor hesitated for a moment before walking over to Jorge.
Connor squatted beside Jorge, rubbing his chest as he asked with a helpless expression. “Old man, how long do you plan to let me fight this stupid gorilla?” “When you can defeat Jabba…”
Jorge said calmly.
“This silly gorilla’s skills are so abnormal. When can I defeat it? Moreover, you haven’t taught me anything during this period of time. I feel like I’ve been stagnant for a long time…”
Connor shouted speechlessly.
“Didn’t I already teach you the Seven Stars Big Dipper Fist?”
Jorge said calmly.
“Don’t mention the Seven Stars Big Dipper Fist to me. That lousy fist technique of yours is really too difficult to practice. Do you know how long I had to practice before I reached the fifth level? If I want to finish practicing this fist technique, I don’t know how many years it will take. By then, I might be in my seventies or eighties!” Connor pouted and shouted at Jorge helplessly.
“That’s why I said that your aptitude is poor. If your aptitude was a little better,
I reckon that you would have already learned it by now…”
Jorge’s tone was still very calm.
However, he did not know how much of a blow his words had dealt to Connor.
“Ah…”
Connor looked at Jorge and took a deep breath. Then, he whispered to Jorge, “Alright, old man, I’m not in the mood to talk nonsense with you here. I didn’t come here to become an ancient martial arts master. I just want to have the ability to protect myself when I encounter danger. So just name a price. How much for you to take me as your disciple? I’m really not in the mood to waste time with you here—”
“How much?”
After Jorge heard Connor’s words, he finally reacted. He quickly turned his head and looked at Connor.
Connor was speechless when he saw Jorge’s reaction.
He couldn’t help but curse inwardly, “Stinky old man, if I didn’t mention
money, you wouldn’t even talk to me properly, right?”

chapters.title: Chapter 747: Jorge Yarrell’s Mission
chapters.content:
Chapter 747: Jorge Yarrell’s Mission
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
“Stinky old man, you should know that I’m very rich.”
Connor looked at Jorge in front of him and said coldly, “But I don’t have time to play with you now. Just name a price. As long as I think the price is suitable, I’ll agree to it…”
“How much money can you give me?” Jorge chuckled as he asked Connor.
“Don’t look at me like that. It’s my misfortune to know you. I admit defeat now. Hurry up and say a number!”
Although Connor said so, he knew that Jorge was indeed capable. However, Connor felt that if he continued to fight with the stupid gorilla like this, he did not know how long it would take to learn even a little skill!
At this moment, Connor was obviously a little anxious. He wanted nothing more than to become Jorge’s disciple. This was the only way he could quickly increase his strength.
Jorge turned his head and looked at Connor, then said lightly, “I don’t lack money now…”
“Of course I know you don’t lack money. You’ve been getting a lot of money from Thomas Morgan and me recently, but you’re a greedy person. I know you won’t complain about having too much money…” Connor said casually.
“The thing I don’t like the most is money…”
Jorge looked at Connor and shook his head.
“So you don’t plan to take me as your disciple?” Connor frowned and asked.
“Not really…”
Jorge looked at Connor and smiled, then continued, “Since you’ve put it this way, I will give you a chance. I am currently lacking in some medicinal herbs. Go and help me collect these herbs first, then I’ll consider taking you in as my disciple…”
As Jorge spoke, he took out a piece of paper that he had prepared beforehand and handed it to Connor.
When Connor saw the note Jorge took out, he couldn’t help but be stunned for a moment. Then, he frowned and said, “Hold on, old man. Did you prepare this note long ago? You already knew that I was going to ask you, right?”
Jorge looked at Connor and smiled faintly. He didn’t say anything.
When Connor saw that Jorge didn’t say anything, he opened the note and took a look at its contents.
“A hundred-year-old reishi mushroom, northeastern wild ginseng, fleeceflower root, caterpillar fungus…”
Connor looked at the names of the medicinal herbs on the note, and the expression on his face grew more and more tired.
Although Connor had never seen these herbs with his own eyes, he had more or less heard of them on television or in movies. Furthermore, Connor was not a fool. He felt that since Jorge had asked him to collect these herbs specifically, they were definitely not cheap, or Jorge would’ve gone to get them himself.
“How much are these herbs?”
Connor frowned and asked Jorge.
“I have already lived in seclusion for many years. I am also not very sure how much these medicinal ingredients are worth…” Jorge replied calmly.
“Then where can I go to collect them?” Connor didn’t know much about medicinal herbs. Although he was very rich, he had to have a place to spend money.
But now, Connor did not know where to go to buy these medicinal herbs.
“I remember that there is a small town called Medicine Kings’ Valley in San Antonio. I went there once when I was cultivating. There is a large medicinal herb trading market there, and it will be the Medicine Kings’ Valley’s triennial Flora Festival in a while. By then, there should be more merchants selling medicinal herbs, so you can go to that place to take a look. You might even be able to get all the herbs in one shot…” Jorge said.
II II
After Connor heard Jorge’s words, he couldn’t help but be stunned. A trace of helplessness flashed in his eyes.
He couldn’t help but curse in his heart. “This old geezer has the gall to say that this wasn’t planned beforehand, but he even has a place in mind! Moreover, these medicinal ingredients are definitely not cheap. This old man is very smart. He knows that I don’t know much about medicinal ingredients and does not know how much they’re worth, which is why he asked me specifically to help him gather those. This smelly old man only knows how to take advantage of me…”
Although Connor knew what was going on, he still chose to agree. After all, he felt that the most important thing for him now was to learn martial arts. Even if he had to spend some money, Connor would accept it.
“As long as I help you buy all these herbs, you’ll take me as your disciple, right?” Connor asked Jorge.
At this time, Connor’s thoughts were very simple. He felt that there was no need for him to go to Medicine Kings’ Valley.
After all, Connor had so many people under him. As long as Connor handed this list of herbs to Thomas Morgan and asked him to collect these herbs, it would be fine. Thomas had a lot of connections at his disposal, so it should not be difficult to find these medicinal herbs in a short period of time. It would just cost a little more money.
However, what Connor did not lack the most now was money!
“Go to Medicine Kings’ Valley and gather all these herbs first. Then, ask the locals for a place called Precipice Cave. If I remember correctly, there should be a spiritual herb in the cave. That spiritual herb looks like this…”
After saying this, Jorge took out another piece of paper from his pocket and handed it to Connor.
Connor lowered his head and looked at the note Jorge handed over. There was indeed a herb drawn on it!
He was stunned for a moment and asked Jorge with a puzzled expression, “What kind of herb is this?”
“You do not need to care about what kind of herb this is. It is fine as long as you are able to find it…” Jorge replied lightly.
“No, old man, what do you want me to do? Collecting herbs and going to Precipice Cave, are you kidding me?” Connor shouted at Jorge helplessly.
“Do you think I’m in the mood to joke with you?” Jorge turned to look at Connor and continued, “As long as you can help me find all these medicinal ingredients, I can consider taking you in as my disciple…”
“Really?”
When Connor heard Jorge’s words, a hint of excitement flashed in his eyes.
“Really!”
Jorge nodded lightly.
“Alright, let’s make a deal. As long as I can help you find these medicinal herbs, you’ll take me in as your disciple, right?”
Connor shouted excitedly.
“Yes, as long as you are able to find these medicinal ingredients, I will take you in as my disciple. However, let me remind you that collecting medicinal ingredients is a small matter. After all, medicinal ingredients can be bought with money. However, Precipice Cave might be a little dangerous for you. You must be mentally prepared…” Jorge warned.
“I knew that you didn’t have good intentions, you old fart. If there was no danger, you would not have let me go…” Connor shouted at Jorge.
“Then are you going or not?” Jorge asked lightly.

chapters.title: Chapter 748: Returning to Porthampton University
chapters.content:
Chapter 748: Returning to Porthampton University
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
When Connor heard Jorge’s words, he could not help but hesitate for a moment.
Then, he gritted his teeth and said in a low voice, “I’ll go!”
Connor knew that if he wanted to become Jorge’s disciple, he would definitely have to pay something. If he continued to fight with this stupid gorilla, Connor did not know how long it would be dragged out.
Therefore, he might as well seize this opportunity and take a gamble.
“Are you sure you want to go?” Jorge’s eyes flashed with surprise.
“Yes!”
Connor nodded again.
“At least you still have some backbone!” Jorge smiled and continued, “The Flora Festival will be held in three days. You can go there when the time comes…”
“No problem, I got it!” Connor looked at Jorge and nodded his head. Then, he continued to ask, “Um, is there anything else? If there’s nothing else, I’ll take my leave first…”
Connor knew that he would not be able to come back in a day or two after going to the Medicine Kings’ Valley to handle some business, so he was prepared to go back to Porthampton University and ask for leave from Rachel Wallace.
Jorge looked at Connor and hesitated for a moment. Then, he reached out and took out a medicine bottle from his pocket. He handed it to Connor and said softly to Connor, “If you go to the Medicine Kings’ Valley and encounter any danger, take this pill. It might be able to save your life…”
“What is this?”
Connor looked at the medicine bottle in Jorge’s hand and asked in confusion.
“You don’t have to know what this is. You just have to remember that this thing can save your life, but if you don’t encounter anything life-threatening, don’t eat it casually, understand?”
Jorge said calmly to Connor.
A strange look flashed across Connor’s eyes. “Is this poison?”
“Hehe, if I wanted to harm you, would I have to poison you?” Jorge asked with a smile.
“That’s true. You’re so powerful. If you wanted to harm me, you would have done it long ago. Moreover, if I died, who would you scam money from?” Connor smiled and took the medicine bottle from Jorge’s hand. Then, he turned around and walked out of the courtyard.
Jorge narrowed his eyes and looked at Connor’s back. No one knew what he was thinking.
After Connor left Jorge’s house, he hailed a taxi and rushed towards Porthampton University.
After getting into the car, Connor took out his phone and dialed Thomas’s number.
Thomas answered the call quickly and asked respectfully, “Mr. McDonald, what’s the matter?”
“I might have to go to the Medicine Kings’ Valley in a few days. I’m telling you in advance in case you can’t find me if you have any problems…” Connor said softly.
Thomas was stunned for a moment before he asked in a low voice, “Mr. McDonald, are you planning to attend the Flora Festival?”
“You actually know about the festival?”
Connor sounded shocked.
“Our Empire World Corporation also has some pharmaceutical industries. Medicine Kings’ Valley is the most famous large-scale medicinal herb trading market in the country. Of course I know that place…” Thomas explained slowly.
“So that’s how it is!” Connor nodded lightly and said expressionlessly, “See, that old man Jorge asked me to collect some herbs for him. As long as I can find these herbs, Jorge will take me in as his disciple, so I have to go over there…” “Mr. McDonald, what medicinal ingredients do you need to collect? You can tell me directly. I can help you collect them…” Thomas hurriedly said.
“No need. There are some things that I need to do personally. My trip to the Medicine Kings’ Valley this time is not as simple as just collecting medicinal herbs…”
Connor said slowly.
“Alright then…” Thomas helplessly agreed and then continued to ask, “Mr. McDonald, the Medicine Kings’ Valley is quite far from Porthampton. How do you plan to get there?”
“Probably by train or bus!” Connor replied after thinking for a moment.
“That’s fine too…” After Thomas heard Connor’s words, he nodded gently and continued, “Then I’ll ask Carlos and Diana to follow you there. After all, there are many outsiders in Medicine Kings’ Valley, and they are all people whose backgrounds are unknown. If anything happens, Diana and the others will be able to protect you, Mr. McDonald…”
Although Thomas knew that Connor’s current skills were very powerful, he felt that it was more appropriate to let Carlos and Diana follow him just in case. “How about only Carlos follow me? Isn’t it a little inconvenient for Diana, a girl, to follow us two guys?” Connor frowned and replied.
“Mr. McDonald, you may not know this, but Diana has been in Medicine Kings’ Valley for a while, so she knows the situation there very well. If you bring her with you, she will definitely be of great help!” Thomas hurriedly said.
“In that case, get the two of them to go with me…” Connor helplessly agreed.
“Alright, Mr. McDonald, if there’s nothing else, I’ll hang up first. I’ll go and inform Carlos and Diana!” Thomas said slowly.
“Good!”
Connor nodded lightly and hung up the phone.
After hanging up the phone, Connor realized that he had already arrived at the school gate of the Porthampton University.
However, since Connor had been on the phone the whole time, the taxi driver didn’t rush him.
The taxi driver turned his head and said to Connor with a smile, “Young man, we have arrived…” “Thanks!”
Connor looked at the taxi driver and smiled faintly. Then, he pushed open the door and got out of the car.
Looking at the familiar campus, a hint of helplessness flashed across Connor’s eyes.
He didn’t know how he should explain this situation to Rachel.
After all, Connor did not ask for leave from Rachel when he went to participate in the martial arts tournament. Connor did not know how to explain this to her, either.
And now, he had to come back to ask for leave from Rachel. Connor felt a headache whenever he thought of this matter.
Connor walked into the campus.
However, he had only taken a few steps when he saw a large group of people gathered together as if they were looking at something.
After Connor saw this scene, he was curious as to what was happening, so he walked towards the crowd.
“Dominic and Spencer, why are you two here?”
At this moment, Connor suddenly saw two familiar figures. Spencer was dragging Dominic into the crowd.
When Dominic and Spencer heard Connor’s voice, they turned their heads to look at Connor!

chapters.title: Chapter 749: Rachel Wallace’s Packages
chapters.content:
Chapter 749: Rachel Wallace’s Packages
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Connor had just walked into the school when he saw a large group of students gathered together. Curious, he approached the group. However, when Connor got closer, he realized that Dominic and Spencer were also there!
When Spencer heard Connor’s voice, he could not help but turn around and look at Connor. Then, he shouted at Connor with a surprised expression, “Connor, you’re back already?”
Connor simply looked at the people in front of him and asked Spencer with a puzzled expression, “I just came back. What’s going on?
“I’m not too sure what’s going on either, but I heard that two beautiful women just transferred to our school. They’re all saying that these two women are very beautiful and hot so everyone came to see them…”
Spencer rubbed his nose and explained to Connor with a smile.
“Beautiful women?”
After hearing Spencer’s words, Connor’s expression was a little helpless. Then, he said lightly, “I thought something big had happened. It turns out that it’s just two beautiful women. What’s there to see…”
Connor wasn’t very interested in beautiful women now. He felt that it was more important to use the time to ask for leave from Rachel.
Therefore, Connor turned around and planned to leave.
“Connor, where are you going? Since you are already here, it would be a pity if you don’t go and take a look…”
When Dominic saw that Connor was about to leave, he hurriedly reached out and pulled Connor back, then squeezed into the crowd.
A few minutes later, Connor and Dominic finally squeezed their way to the front of the crowd.
“They really are two beauties!”
“She’s really too beautiful…”
“Could these two be internet celebrities? They’re too beautiful!”
“Since when did our school have such beautiful girls? If only I could find such a girlfriend…”
“You’d better stop daydreaming here. How could she possibly fall for you?
You’d better prepare more tissues at night…”
Everyone began to whisper among themselves.
When Dominic and Spencer saw the two beauties, their expressions were also very surprised.
Of course, the person who was the most shocked at this moment was not anyone else but Connor!
The two beautiful girls that were being watched by the crowd were none other than Yarrow and Yucca Lambert, whom Connor had met on the Princess cruise ship!
Yarrow was wearing a short red skirt that wrapped around her hips. Her figure was tall and sexy, and her beautiful legs were bare under the short skirt, making her look especially alluring.
Yucca, on the other hand, was wearing a long white dress with spaghetti straps. Her every movement exuded a noble aura.
In the eyes of ordinary people, these two girls could indeed be considered peerless beauties. It was normal for them to be surrounded by so many people.
However, what Connor couldn’t understand was why Yarrow and Yucca would suddenly appear in his school.
Cade Lambert had just failed to get the two sisters to seduce Connor. The two sisters suddenly showed up in Connor’s school.
It was difficult for Connor to not connect these two things together.
“These two girls are indeed quite beautiful. They can even compete with Connor’s girlfriend. Don’t you think so, Connor?”Spencer asked Connor with a smile.
However Spencer was stunned for a moment after he said that. Then, he subconsciously looked around.
“Where’s Connor?”
Spencer shouted in confusion.
“I don’t know. He seems to have left…”
Dominic stared at Yarrow and Yucca with a blank expression, not noticing when Connor had left.
When Connor saw Yarrow and Yucca, he was worried that they would recognize him. If that happened, Connor’s identity would also be exposed, which was why he snuck away before the two girls could discover him.
As for why Yarrow and Yucca came to Porthampton University, Connor didn’t really care.
Connor knew that their class only had one class today, so Rachel should be in the office.
Therefore, Connor came to Rachel’s office.
However, when Connor arrived at the office, he found that Rachel had already returned to the dormitory, so Connor had no choice but to go to her dormitory.
Because Connor had been helping Rachel move things to the dormitory, Connor could enter and leave the teacher’s quarters normally. Even the dormitory manager there already knew who he was.
“Connor, you haven’t been here recently. What have you been busy with?” The dormitory manager asked Connor with a smile as soon as she saw him.
“I’m not busy with anything…”
Connor smiled and replied, then continued to ask, “Aunt Wang, is Ms. Wallace in the dormitory now?”
-She should be. I just saw her go in…” Aunt Wang nodded gently.
“Auntie Wang, I have something to discuss with Ms. Wallace, so I’ll be going up first!”
After Connor said this, he was about to walk into the dormitory when Aunt
Wang stopped him.
“Connor, wait a moment. This belongs to your Ms. Wallace. Please help her move it up…”
The dormitory manager pointed at the express delivery packages on the ground.
Connor looked at the packages on the ground with a helpless expression. He didn’t expect Rachel to be such a good shopper—there were at least ten or twenty packages in front of him.
The dormitory manager thought that Connor was here to help move her things, so she asked Connor to move these things up.
However, Connor did not refuse. He picked up all the packages on the ground.
However, because Rachel had ordered way, way too many packages, Connor could only move a few of them at a time. He had to make a few trips back down. Connor placed all the packages in his hand in front of Rachel’s dormitory door, then sighed softly and said helplessly, “What did this woman buy? There are actually so many packages…”
Connor spent more than ten minutes moving all of Rachel’s packages up.
However, because he was moving too quickly, a package that was not very tightly wrapped fell and tore open.
Connor subconsciously bent down to pick up the express delivery.
However, when Connor picked up the parcel, he was stunned!
When he looked inside through the tear, he found that it was actually a very revealing lace bra!
Connor subconsciously took out the things inside, and then his heart could not help but start to beat faster.
This bra was too sexy, Connor had already begun to imagine how Rachel would look in this bra!
However, this wasn’t what shocked Connor the most. What shocked Connor the most was that there was actually a pink little thing in this express delivery!
After Connor saw this thing, he was instantly dumbfounded.
He could not help but mutter to himself, “Ms. Wallace…Ms. Wallace actually bought such a thing…
“Who’s outside?”
At this moment, Rachel seemed to have heard the commotion outside and shouted with a serious expression..

chapters.title: Chapter 750: Let Me Explain
chapters.content:
Chapter 750: Let Me Explain
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Although he had never seen such a thing in real life, Connor wasn’t ignorant of what this was. It was the same principle as him not knowing how to fly a helicopter, but knowing that a helicopter should not be up on a tree.
As a loser who had been single for many years, he naturally knew what the pink thing in the package was for.
“This is…a bullet?”
Connor looked at the thing in his hand and stammered.
He could actually understand why Rachel wanted to buy lingerie; after all, it was normal for girls to like sexy lingerie.
However, Connor did not know how to explain this little pink thing.
After all, in Connor’s eyes, a great beauty like Rachel should not lack boys at all, right?
Just as Connor was wondering why there was such a thing in Rachel’s packages, something even more unexpected happened. The door of Rachel’s dormitory was pushed open from the inside.
Rachel, who was dressed in a cool outfit, walked out in her high heels.
Connor was stunned for a moment before hastily putting the things in his hands into the packages.
However, Rachel had already come out, and she also saw Connor holding her underwear and that little pink thing.
“Connor, what are you doing here?”
After Rachel saw this scene, a trace of strangeness flashed across her eyes. Then, she asked Connor coldly.
“Uh…”
After Connor heard Rachel’s words, his expression became a little awkward. Then, he stuttered, “Then…Um, Ms. Wallace, you… Please don’t misunderstand. It’s not like that…”
“Who told you to open my package?”
Rachel looked at the underwear in Connor’s hand. Embarrassed and angry, she reached out and snatched the parcel from Connor’s hand.
But when Rachel saw the toy in Connor’s hand, her pretty face turned even more rosy!
“Ms. Wallace, please let me explain…”
Connor saw that Rachel seemed rather angry and opened his mouth to explain.
“Come in and talk. Don’t talk there!”
Rachel seemed to be worried that someone would see this scene, so she directly shouted at Connor coldly, then turned around and walked into the dormitory.
A trace of helplessness flashed in Connor’s eyes. Then, he followed behind Rachel and walked into the dormitory together.
Rachel was wearing a tight-fitting T-shirt today. Her jet-black hair was casually draped over her shoulders. Her perfect facial features were flawless even without any makeup. Every inch of her skin seemed to be hinting at the bias of a higher being while creating her. She was tall, voluptuous, and alluring. Her slender waist an alluring aura as she swayed. She was wearing a black miniskirt. The skirt was very short, as if it could wrap around her alluring buttocks. She was wearing a pair of high-heeled sandals on her exquisite little feet. She looked exceptionally sexy
After Connor entered the dormitory, he subconsciously looked at Rachel’s fair and delicate thighs.
Rachel’s legs seemed to have some kind of magic, firmly attracting Connor’s line of sight.
Connor felt that the most attractive part of Rachel was her beautiful legs. Connor couldn’t take his eyes off her.
The most attractive part of a woman in bed was not her chest or face, but rather her legs.
If he could be wrapped by Rachel’s beautiful legs, he could die content.
“Are my legs that good?”
Rachel licked her sexy red lips and asked Connor in a low voice.
After Connor heard Rachel’s words, he realized that he still had things to explain to Rachel.
Therefore, he quickly averted his gaze and looked at the underwear in Rachel’s hand and the pink thing. He stuttered, “Ms. Wallace, it’s not what you think. Let me explain…”
“Alright, explain yourself!”
Rachel glanced at Connor with a smile that was not a smile and replied in a low voice.
“Hah…”
Connor sighed helplessly and then slowly said, “Ms. Wallace, I came here today to explain to you why I didn’t come to class these past few days, but when I walked to the dormitory door, Aunt Wang said that these packages were all for you and asked me to help you bring them up…”
“And then?”
Rachel sized up Connor and asked Connor softly.
” I moved all the packages up, but because there were too many, I could only bring a few up at a time. I accidentally dropped one, and the things inside fell out. I wanted to put them back, but you saw it…” Connor said hurriedly.
“Is that really the case?”
“Ms. Wallace, even if I had the courage of a thousand lions, I wouldn’t dare to open your parcel without permission…” Connor said helplessly.
“You’re quite bold, and you’re a super rich heir. You know that I won’t dare to do anything to you, so what can’t you do?” Rachel looked at Connor indifferently.
After Connor heard Rachel’s words, the expression on his face crumbled even more. “Ms. Wallace, if I really wanted to open your package, I wouldn’t be doing it here, would I?”
Rachel looked at Connor and snorted. “Hmph, but didn’t you peek at me changing clothes in my room last time?”
“Uh…”
After Connor heard Rachel’s words, the expression on his face seemed to be even more speechless. He didn’t know how to answer her question.
“Am I right?” Rachel asked Connor softly.
“What do you mean by right? This was all a misunderstanding. I didn’t open your parcel at all. How did I know you would buy this kind of thing? It was all a coincidence!” Connor shouted.
Rachel looked at Connor indifferently. She felt that even if she continued to ask, it would be meaningless.
After all, even if Connor really opened the parcel on purpose, he would definitely not admit it.
However, what Rachel could not understand was why out of all the parcels he could’ve opened, it had to be this specific one!
Connor saw that Rachel was silent and shouted with a helpless expression. “Ms. Wallace, you have to believe me. I really didn’t open this package on purpose!”
“Alright, I believe you…”
Rachel looked at Connor and sighed softly.
“Really? You believe me so easily?”
Connor looked at Rachel, suspicion in his eyes.
“Nonsense. Even if I don’t believe you now, so what? Do you think I can kill you?” Rachel replied to Connor in a bad mood, a trace of helplessness flashing across her eyes.
“Ms. Wallace, why did you buy this kind of thing?”
Connor asked Rachel with a smile.
After Rachel heard Connor’s words, a trace of shame and anger flashed across her beautiful eyes..

chapters.title: Chapter 751: Following The Rules
chapters.content:
Chapter 751: Following The Rules
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Connor really couldn’t understand why a great beauty like Rachel would buy such a thing.
If she really had a need, she could just look for a man!
The men would queue for her attention.
So even if Rachel really had a need, there was no need to buy this kind of thing, right?
After Rachel heard Connor’s words, she looked somewhat ashamed and angry.
She hurriedly whispered to Connor, “This thing isn’t mine. I don’t know why it appeared in my express delivery!”
“It’s not yours?” Connor was skeptical. Then, he frowned and asked, “Are you sure you didn’t buy this?”
“Nonsense, of course, I’m sure. I bought it myself; how could I not know!” Rachel fiercely glared at Connor.
At this moment, Rachel was also very speechless. She did not know why this would suddenly appear in her express delivery.
And what made Rachel even more speechless was Connor seeing it!
If she had known this would happen, Rachel would have gone down to bring the package up instead of leaving it downstairs.
Rachel was wearing a short skirt today. It was difficult for her to carry so many packages alone, and it was also very inconvenient.
Therefore, she wanted to change her clothes before bringing the parcels up.
However, she did not expect Connor to come then and even bring her parcels up.
“So, didn’t you buy these?” Connor pointed at the lingerie in Rachel’s hand and asked Rachel softly.
“These… I bought this…” Rachel blushed as she nodded. After which, she continued, “But I didn’t buy that thing because I’ve never used it before…” “Hehe…” After Connor heard Rachel’s words, he could not help but smile faintly. Then, he said softly, “Nonsense. You bought this bra, which was placed in the same express delivery box. This means that you must have bought that thing too…”
“What…” After Rachel heard Connor’s words, she could not help but glare at Connor fiercely.
“Ms. Wallace, you don’t have to lie to me. This kind of thing is very normal. After all, everyone has that kind of need. It’s just that I didn’t expect a teacher to actually…”
Before Connor could finish his sentence, Rachel grabbed Connor’s ear and twisted it fiercely.
“Ah… Ah… Ms. Wallace, I was wrong. Please… Hurry up and let go…” Connor screamed and stammered.
“Do you still dare to spout nonsense?” Rachel glared at Connor and asked fiercely.
“No, I don’t! I didn’t see anything, okay?” Connor pleaded with Rachel with an aggrieved expression.
After Rachel heard Connor’s words, she slowly released her hand.
“Ms. Wallace, this kind of thing is really…” Connor rubbed his ears as he said to Rachel with a smile.
“If you dare to speak nonsense again, be sure I won’t be nice to you!” Rachel coldly said to Connor.
“I won’t say more! Mouth zipped…” Connor hurriedly waved his hand.
“Why are you here?” Rachel sorted out her emotions and asked Connor seriously.
“About that, Ms. Wallace, I want to take a leave of absence in two days. I have to do something…” Connor said to Rachel with a smile.
“All right, go ahead…” Rachel looked at Connor and lightly nodded.
“Uhm…” After Connor saw Rachel agree so readily, he was dumbfounded and shocked.
Connor did not expect Rachel to agree to give him the approval so easily.
“Ms. Wallace, did you just approve my leave?” Connor hesitated before asking Rachel softly.
“I didn’t promise to give you a break, but you’re so rich now, so I can’t control you. If you want to leave, leave. However, you haven’t attended class for the past few days. I’ve already treated it as skipping class. If you continue to skip class, I reckon it won’t be long before the school gives you demerits…” Rachel sized up Connor and said casually.
“What?”
After Connor heard that, he was completely stunned and in disbelief.
He did not expect Rachel to mark him for skipping classes these few days.
“I know you have money and background. With your connections, you shouldn’t be afraid even if the school punishes you. After all, even the chancellor of Porthampton University doesn’t dare to offend you easily. However, I’ve already spoken to him. If you continue skipping classes, the school will give you whatever punishment you deserve. Moreover, they won’t give you any special treatment because of your identity. If anything happens, I’ll bear the consequences…” Rachel looked at Connor and continued.
“Are you deliberately giving me a hard time?” Connor gritted his teeth and asked Rachel in a low voice.
Connor was not afraid of punishment, but he was afraid of Rachel.
After all, Rachel’s identity and background were very mysterious. Moreover, Rachel knew about the existence of Rockefeller.
Those who knew about Rockefeller were not ordinary people, so Connor did not dare to provoke Rachel easily.
Of course, Connor was so rich now that he could completely ignore the punishment of Porthampton University.
Even if he were expelled from school, it would not affect him much.
However, Connor had always treated himself as an ordinary person. He felt that no matter how rich he was, he had to get a graduation certificate from Porthampton University.
After all, Connor might not be able to get this inheritance.
Therefore, Connor did not want to change his life because of this. He still had to finish what he had to do.
This was also why Connor had been staying at Porthampton University to study. Otherwise, according to Connor’s current situation, he could not come to school. He could then spend some money to buy a diploma.
But Connor didn’t want to do that!
“Why am I targeting you? I’m just doing things according to the rules. We’re friends in private but don’t forget that you’re still my student. Isn’t it normal for students to be punished for skipping class?” Rachel said to Connor calmly. After Connor heard Rachel’s words, he could not help but grit his teeth.. Then, he pointed at the ‘thing’ on the table and said, “Didn’t I just see you buy these things? Why are you so petty? I’ve already told you I didn’t do it on purpose!”

chapters.title: Chapter 752: Pretend To Be My Admirer
chapters.content:
Chapter 752: Pretend To Be My Admirer
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
After Rachel heard Connor’s words, she immediately became embarrassed and angry.
She could not help but turn and shout at Connor, “I’ve already made it very clear to you just now. I didn’t buy this at all. Also, it has nothing to do with me dealing with your truancy. I’m your lecturer.”
“Fine. You didn’t buy that. Since we’re friends, give me two days off!”
Seeing that Rachel was a little angry, he hurriedly replied, smiling, “I really have something very important to do this time…”
“Although we’re friends, I’m still your lecturer in school. Whatever important things you have has nothing to do with me!” Rachel said to Connor seriously. “What if this has something to do with you?”
Connor hesitated before speaking to Rachel.
“Is it related to me?” Rachel was surprised when she heard Connor’s words. Then, she turned to look at Connor and asked, puzzled, “What docs it have to do with me?”
“The thing I’m taking leave to do this time has something to do with Rockefeller…” Connor looked at Rachel and said indifferently.
“It’s related to Rockefeller?”
A strange look flashed in Rachel’s eyes. Then, she asked in a puzzled tone, “What exactly are you going to do this time? If you’re going on a date with your girlfriend, I won’t give you a day off!”
“How… How did you know I recently went on a date with my girlfriend?” Connor asked in surprise.
“You caused such a huge commotion on the Princess Cruise Ship. Many people know about this, okay?” Rachel lightly rolled her eyes at Connor.
Connor was speechless because he realized he underestimated Rachel’s connections.
Although Rachel was just a lecturer at Porthampton University on the surface, even if Rachel didn’t leave the university, she could still find out what was going on outside through other channels.
“Phew…”
Connor took a deep breath, then looked at Rachel and said, “I didn’t ask for leave this time to go on a date. I’m going to help Jorge find some herbs…”
“What does this have to do with Rockefeller?” Rachel asked in confusion.
“If I can help Jorge gather these herbs, Jorge will agree to take me as his disciple. Once I become his disciple, I won’t have to worry about Rockefeller’s people killing me. You probably don’t want me to die in the hands of Rockefeller’s people before we can work together, right?” Connor said to Rachel with a smile.
Rachel sized up Connor and said calmly, “The matter you mentioned has nothing to do with dealing with Rockefeller. This is merely your private matter…”
“So you don’t want to give me a break? You just want to watch me get killed by Rockefeller’s men, don’t you? Aren’t you cruel?” Connor said.
“All right, stop the act. I can approve your leave, but I have a condition!” Rachel blinked and softly said to Connor.
“A condition?” Connor was stunned momentarily, then frowned and asked, “What’s the condition?”
Rachel looked at Connor and didn’t say anything. She was a little conflicted. Should she tell Connor about that?
Rachel was already twenty-eight this year, a woman’s prime age!
However, Rachel had many worries. She had never been in a relationship, so her family had always wanted to introduce her to men.
Put it bluntly; they wanted Rachel to go on a blind date.
To avoid the blind date arranged by her family, Rachel came to a small place like Porthampton and became a lecturer at Porthampton University!
However, even if Rachel hid in Porthampton, she still could not escape the fate of being urged to get married by her family.
Rachel’s grandfather introduced a boy from Porthampton to Rachel some time ago.
Rachel had been living with her grandfather since she was young.
Rachel’s grandfather also doted on her very much, so she did not want to make her grandfather angry.
However, she did not want to go on a blind date with this man, so Rachel had recently been troubled by this.
Rachel’s grandfather called her again two days ago, wanting her to meet that boy.
Moreover, Rachel’s grandfather was very determined. If Rachel continued to refuse, her grandfather might call her home. By then, things would be even more troublesome.
Therefore, Rachel had been troubled by this.
As for Rachel’s blind date, his name was Nate Taylor. He was the son of a big shot in Davenport and the son of an officer.
Nate was tall, good-looking, and had a good family background. His personality was also great. His future was limitless. He was the cream of the crop. Otherwise, he would never have caught Rachel’s grandfather’s attention.
But Rachel had no interest in Nate.
However, she didn’t dare to reject Nate, nor did she want to meet him.
Rachel knew that if she met Nate, it would give Nate hope. Rachel did not want Nate to have such an illusion.
Therefore, Rachel began to feel a little troubled. For a moment, she did not know what to do.
If Rachel didn’t meet Nate, his grandfather would be very angry.
After all, her grandfather was already old. Rachel did not want to make her grandfather angry because of this.
However, Rachel did not like Nate.
At this moment, Rachel was in a dilemma, not knowing how to choose!
After Connor saw the conflicted expression on Rachel’s face, he was even more curious about what Rachel would say to him.
“What exactly are your conditions?” Connor asked Rachel.
“Connor, can you pretend to be my admirer tomorrow night?” Rachel hesitated before gritting her teeth and asking Connor.
“What did you say?” After Connor heard Rachel’s request, he suddenly stood up and exclaimed..

chapters.title: Chapter 753: Dominic Was Beaten Up
chapters.content:
Chapter 753: Dominic Was Beaten Up
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Connor never dreamed that Rachel’s so-called condition was to get him to pretend to be her admirer!
This was not the first time Connor had done such a thing.
Rachel once used Connor as a shield, which even led to much trouble.
Fortunately, Connor had not been in school during this period, so Madison did not come to find trouble with Connor.
But now, Rachel wanted to use the same trick again, making Connor a shield.
Connor made up his mind. No matter what, he wouldn’t agree with Rachel this time. Otherwise, he might get into some trouble!
“I just asked you to pretend to be my admirer. Why are you overreacting?”
Rachel couldn’t help but roll her eyes at Connor as she spoke helplessly.
“No, but why me? Hasn’t Madison stopped pestering you?” Connor asked Rachel in confusion.
“This has nothing to do with Madison…” Rachel replied in a low voice.
“What’s going on then?” Connor asked Rachel, puzzled.
II II
Rachel turned and glanced at Connor. She frowned and said helplessly, “If I tell you about this, can you not tell anyone…”
“Don’t worry, I won’t…” Connor replied casually.
Rachel felt Connor had no reason to tell anyone, so she told Connor everything about her blind date with Nate.
After Connor heard Rachel’s story, he could not help but feel a little amused.
As he never thought that a high and mighty goddess like Rachel would be urged to get married.
However, Connor did not dare to say it out loud.
“Ms. Wallace, I think blind dates are very normal. Just go and meet him. If you like him, then get together. Isn’t that good?” Connor said with a smile.
“I know Nate. I don’t like him at all…” Rachel shook her head helplessly.
“Since you don’t like it, why don’t you reject him? You’re so powerful. It shouldn’t be difficult for you to reject him, right?” Connor looked at Rachel and continued.
“If I could reject him, I would have rejected him long ago. Why would I ask you for help? My grandfather arranged this blind date. If I don’t meet him, I must find a good reason to reject him. However, Nate is very good in all aspects. I can’t say I don’t like him because he’s handsome or has a good family background, right?”
It was rare for Rachel to act like a feeble woman with Connor. She held her cheeks with both hands and said very irritatedly.
“In that case, I guess I have no other choice…” Connor looked at Rachel and sighed softly. Then, he continued, “Ms. Wallace, is there anything else? If not, I’ll go back to class. It’s probably still a self-study period…”
After saying this, Connor turned around and walked out of the dormitory.
Connor could feel that things were getting increasingly weird. If he continued to stay here, nothing good would happen, so it was better to hurry up and leave.
“Connor, stop right there!” Rachel saw Connor leave and quickly shouted after him. “Do you still want to ask me to approve your leave?”
“Of course, I want to, but if you don’t want to approve it, I have no choice. I’ll take my leave now!” Connor said helplessly.
“You are not allowed to leave…” Rachel shouted and continued, “Didn’t you hear what I said just now? I want you to pretend to be my admirer and ruin this blind date. I can then reject Nate, and my grandfather will stop this…”
“I don’t want to!” Connor didn’t even think about it and shook his head to refuse.
“Why?” Rachel asked in confusion.
“There’s no reason. In any case, I don’t want to. I don’t think it’s good…” Connor said slowly.
“If you don’t want to help me, don’t ask me for a leave of absence in the future. I’ll make sure you never graduate…” Rachel looked at Connor and threatened.
“Ms. Wallace, we don’t have to do this, right?” Connor asked.
“Of course. If you help me this time, I can approve any leave you want in the future. Even if you don’t come to school, I won’t remember you skipping class. What do you think?” Rachel looked at Connor and asked softly.
“Ms. Wallace, this is a blatant abuse of your rights!” Connor shouted at Rachel helplessly.
“That’s right, I’m abusing my power. Do you have a problem?” Rachel blinked and asked calmly.
“You…” Connor looked at Rachel and was instantly speechless, not knowing what to say.
“What will happen if I don’t go?” Connor asked Rachel in a low voice.
“You can think about the consequences of offending me…” Rachel said indifferently.
A trace of helplessness flashed in Connor’s eyes, and then he asked in a low voice, “Then let’s make a deal. As long as I help you this time, you have to approve my leave of absence no matter what I do in the future…”
“Don’t worry, I am a person of my words!” Rachel gently nodded.
“All right, I’ll do it…” With Rachel’s coercion and temptation, Connor could only agree to Rachel’s request.
After all, Connor knew that if he didn’t agree to Rachel’s request, the outcome would be very miserable.
“Okay, let me tell you what you should do tomorrow night…” Rachel nodded in satisfaction after Connor agreed. Then, she told Connor her plan.
After Connor heard Rachel’s plan, he was unusually speechless. He couldn’t help but feel a little sad for Rachel’s blind date partner, Nate.
“Did you hear what I just said?” Rachel asked Connor softly.
“Don’t worry, I’ll remember everything. I’ll cooperate…” Connor replied to Rachel helplessly.
“Great!” Rachel smiled happily.
“Ding!” At this moment, Rachel’s phone suddenly rang.
Rachel took out her phone and glanced at it. She realized the student representative, Eunice Tanner, was calling, so she picked up the call.
“Ms. Wallace, bad news. Dominic was beaten up!” Eunice shouted anxiously.
Connor was stunned when he heard that..

chapters.title: Chapter 754:1 Will Avenge You!
chapters.content:
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Rachel’s face was filled with disbelief when she heard Eunice’s words.
She hurriedly said, “Eunice, calm down. Tell me what’s going on!”
“Ms. Wallace, I can’t explain this to you quickly. You’d better come to the gym quickly. You’ll know what’s going on when you’re here…” Eunice replied to Rachel anxiously.
Rachel hesitated before saying softly, “All right, Eunice, don’t worry. I’ll be right there!”
After saying this, Rachel hung up the phone and hurriedly walked out of the dormitory.
“Ms. Wallace, what’s wrong?” After Connor heard that Dominic was beaten up, he worried about Dominic and hurriedly asked Rachel.
“I don’t know exactly what happened. Eunice asked me to go to the gym…” Rachel answered as she walked off.
Connor followed Rachel to the gym.
A few minutes later, Connor and Rachel arrived at Porthampton University’s gym entrance.
A large group of students surrounded Dominic, and the doctors of the school clinic were bandaging Dominic.
“Dominic, are you all right?” Connor frowned and asked Dominic.
“It’s nothing. I just broke a bone…” Dominic looked at Connor and replied with a smile.
“Broke a bone?”
Hearing Dominic’s words, a strange look flashed in Rachel’s eyes. Then, she coldly questioned the physical education coach, “Mr. Jones, what’s happening? Why is my student injured in a physical education class? If you don’t explain this clearly, I’ll get the chancellor to come over now…”
The physical education coach was shocked. Everyone at Porthampton University knew Rachel’s temper.
It would be troublesome if this reached the chancellor’s ears.
Therefore, the PE coach hurriedly said to Rachel, “Ms. Wallace, please don’t be angry. We had a long jump test, and the freshmen were learning taekwondo. For some reason, Dominic verbally conflicted with the group of freshmen. In the end, they decided to spar with taekwondo rules, and Dominic was kicked and broke a rib!”
“Sparring in taekwondo? Could he break a rib with a kick? Were they sparring or trying to kill?” Rachel scolded angrily.
“Ms. Wallace, what do you mean by that? You don’t think I did it on purpose, do you?” A boy walked up to Rachel and shouted.
“Who are you?” Rachel frowned and asked the boy.
“My name is Quincy Warburton. I was the one who beat this brat up…”
Quincy looked at Rachel and replied arrogantly, then continued, “I had a simple spar with Dominic. I never wanted to hurt Dominic. My actions were also in accordance with the rules of taekwondo. It’s just that Dominic really can’t take a beating. I didn’t do it on purpose…”
When Quincy spoke, he deliberately put on an innocent expression.
“That’s right, Ms. Wallace. I can also prove this. There’s no problem with Quincy and Dominic’s fight…”
The freshman PE coach whispered to Rachel.
After Rachel heard these people’s explanation, she seemed very helpless.
Taekwondo was a compulsory course at Porthampton University. All freshmen had to learn taekwondo.
In junior year, one had to be promoted to a blue ribbon player, which would be recorded in their sports results.
