There was an unwritten rule at Porthampton University. If there was a conflict between two people, they could use taekwondo to solve the problem.
In that case, the school would not punish these two students.
The battle between Dominic and Quincy this time was also very simple.
Moreover, they were under the supervision of the PE coach. Quincy did not do anything against the rules. This was something that everyone could prove.
Rachel knew that since Quincy had already said so, no matter how influential she was, she could not make Quincy responsible.
Connor narrowed his eyes and looked at Quincy.
What surprised Connor was that he saw some familiar faces among the freshmen!
Tara, Sadie, and Sheldon were all students in this class!
But Sabrina was not around!
Connor vaguely felt that it was not a coincidence that Quincy beat Dominic up like this, so he walked to Spencer’s side and asked in a low voice, “Spencer, what’s going on?”
“Connor…” After Spencer heard Connor’s words, a hint of helplessness flashed in his eyes.
“Dominic’s injury is not as simple as an accidental injury. Tell me what exactly happened?” Connor frowned, seeing Spencer was silent.
“Sigh…” Spencer sighed helplessly and said in a low voice, “When we came to the physical education class to do our own thing, Dominic and I heard a few students mention your name. Dominic went over to listen curiously and realized they talked about how you were a rich heir who pretended to be poor and flirted with girls. They even mentioned that you gave a fake jade bracelet to a girl called Sabrina. In any case, their words were very unpleasant. You know Dominic’s character very well. He naturally wouldn’t pretend not to hear it. So he started arguing with those people…”
“And then?” Connor asked Spencer expressionlessly.
“Then, I pulled Dominic away. However, these freshmen did not intend to let Dominic go at all. On the contrary, they took the initiative to provoke Dominic. Dominic could not stand the humiliation and agreed to a spar. Then, he competed with that kid in taekwondo. In the end, Dominic was beaten up. The other party did it on purpose…”
Spencer paused before continuing, “That kid, Quincy, is very powerful. At the very least, he has a taekwondo black belt. He’s just pretending to be weak so he can beat up Dominic…”
“I see now!” Connor looked at Spencer and nodded gently.
“You two, please make way…” At this moment, the doctor shouted at Connor and Spencer as he wanted to carry Dominic out.
Connor looked at Dominic indifferently and asked Dominic softly, “Can you manage?”
“Yes!” When Dominic heard Connor’s question, he hurriedly nodded.
“All right. I will help you take revenge!” Connor whispered to Dominic..

chapters.title: Chapter 755: I'll Give You Two Choices
chapters.content:
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Rachel and the others saw a trace of confusion flash in their eyes after talking to Dominic.
“Connor, why are you still talking to Dominic? Hurry up and move aside. We have to send Dominic to the hospital…” Rachel frowned and said to Connor. Dominic looked up at Rachel and shook his head. “Ms. Wallace, I’m not hurrying to the hospital…”
Dominic knew what Connor wanted to do, so he was unwilling to leave just like that. He wanted to see Connor avenge him with his own eyes.
When Dominic, Spencer, and the others were on the cruise ship, they saw Connor fight.
Therefore, even if they knew that the other party was a black belt in taekwondo, they would not be a match for Connor.
The others didn’t know what Connor would do, and their expressions puzzled. Sheldon, Yara, and the others also looked at Connor with puzzled expressions. Connor walked up to Quincy and carefully sized him up. Then, he asked Quincy softly, “You were the one who broke my friend’s leg, right?”
“That’s right. It’s me. That brat is trash…” Quincy replied to Connor arrogantly. Quincy saw Connor’s scrawny appearance, so he did not take Connor seriously at all.
“All right, since you broke my friend’s leg, according to the rules of our school, can I challenge you now?” Connor asked expressionlessly.
When everyone heard Connor’s question, they instantly went into an uproar. Everyone’s expressions were filled with disbelief.
No one had expected Connor would take the initiative to challenge Quincy to stand up for Dominic!
“Connor, what are you doing?” Rachel frowned and asked Connor.
“Ms. Wallace, this has nothing to do with you. Since he can challenge Dominic,
I should be able to challenge him, too,” Connor replied indifferently.
Quincy looked at Connor disdainfully and then said coldly, “What’s the matter, kid? Are you planning to challenge me?”
“That’s right, I want to challenge you!” Connor nodded lightly.
A trace of hesitation flashed in Quincy’s eyes. He frowned and asked Connor, “Kid, what rank are you at in taekwondo?”
“A yellow belt?” Connor lightly replied.
“Hahaha…” When everyone heard Connor’s reply, they all burst into laughter.
The different colors of the belt reflected the level of taekwondo. The lowest level was the white belt, followed by the yellow belt, green belt, blue belt, red belt, and black belt.
Black belts were divided into nine levels!
The first to third rank was for novice blackbelts, the fourth to sixth rank was for high-level, and the seventh to ninth rank could only be awarded to outstanding people with high academic attainments and great contributions to the development of taekwondo.
“Is this Connor even awake? A mere taekwondo yellow belt, he dared to challenge Quincy, a fourth-rank black belt. Docs he have a death wish?” Yara said disdainfully and continued, “Even a girl like me has a green belt in taekwondo, but a guy like Connor only has a yellow belt. What a joke!” “Tee-hee, this Connor has always overestimated himself…” Sheldon could not help but sneer.
Connor’s classmates were also very angry about Dominic’s injury.
After all, they were all junior-year students and classmates. However, they were unwilling to be bullied by a group of first-year students.
However, these people knew that Quincy was very powerful. Ordinary students like them were not Quincy’s match, so they could only swallow their anger.
Connor stood up to avenge Dominic. The students of the Finance Faculty admired Connor’s courage, but they were also worried that Connor was not a match for Quincy.
If Connor lost to Quincy, their faculty would be greatly embarrassed today.
The student representative Eunice also seemed to be a little worried about Connor. She quickly approached Connor and whispered, “Connor, stop messing around. You can’t be Quincy’s match. Aren’t you looking for a beating by challenging him now?”
“That’s right, kid. You’re not my match. You’d better not challenge me. I do not want to waste time with trash like you!” Quincy shouted at Connor disdainfully. “If you don’t dare to accept my challenge, then apologize to my friend now!” Connor said to Quincy expressionlessly.
Quincy was stunned when he heard Connor’s words. Then, he angrily shouted at Connor, “No, kid, did you understand what I said just now? I don’t want to fight you because you’re too trash. It’s not that I don’t dare to accept your challenge. Is there something wrong with your brain?”
“Hl give you two choices now. Either accept my challenge or apologize to my friend!” Connor whispered to Quincy.
“Quincy, since Connor insists on challenging you, you should agree with him…” Sheldon, who was in the crowd, suddenly shouted.
Quincy turned to look at Sheldon, then said with a smile, “So you are Connor.
All right, since you want to challenge me, I will agree to it…”
The students present seemed to think that Connor was no match for Quincy. After all, Quincy was a fourth-rank black belt, while Connor was a yellow belt.
The difference between the two was huge. Connor had no chance of winning at all.
Even Rachel didn’t think Connor would win. After hesitating, she walked up to Connor and softly said, “Connor, I know you have a good relationship with Dominic. If you want to help Dominic take revenge, there is no need to do it yourself!”
Rachel didn’t know Connor’s skills, but she knew how influential Connor’s background was.
Therefore, she felt that if Connor wanted to deal with this Quincy, who didn’t know what was good for him, it could be done with just a phone call. There was no need for him to do it himself.
“It doesn’t matter. This kind of trash is not my match!” Connor turned to look at Rachel and said calmly.
Quincy could not help but be stunned when he heard Connor’s words. Then, he asked Connor in a very puzzled tone, “Kid, what did you say just now?”
“I said that trash like you are not my match!” Connor repeated indifferently. “I’m not your match?” Quincy pointed at his nose. He thought he had heard wrongly just now, but he did not expect Connor to say this.
He turned and shouted to Sheldon and the others, “Did you all hear what this kid said? This kid claims I’m not his match. A mere yellow belt is looking down on me, a black belt…”
When everyone heard Connor’s claim, they were also speechless. They could not understand where Connor got the courage to say this..

chapters.title: Chapter 756: Challenging Quincy Warburton
chapters.content:
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
“Is this kid crazy? He actually dares to say that Quincy Warburton is not his match…”
“This kid is probably crazy. He actually dares to offend Quincy Warburton!”
“Quincy Warburton is a fourth-rank black belt in Taekwondo. Who else would dare to say such a thing except for Mr. Sheldon Statton?”
“I really don’t know where this brat got his courage from. He actually dares to challenge Quincy Warburton. This is hilarious…”
The freshmen seemed to be very confident in Quincy’s strength and began to mock Connor.
Sadie Colt, Yara Xenos, and Sheldon also looked at Connor with disdain. The three of them felt that Connor was bragging.
Sadie looked at Connor from head to toe with a helpless expression.
She could not understand why Connor liked to brag so much. She felt that she knew Connor well. With Connor’s skills, it was impossible for him to be Quincy’s match.
However, Connor was her friend no matter what.
Therefore, she frowned and whispered to Connor, “Connor, Quincy didn’t mean to hurt your friend just now. You don’t have to do this. Just leave with your friend!”
Sadie wanted to give Connor a way out.
However, she did not expect Connor to act as if he did not hear her and still asked Quincy, “Are you going to accept my challenge or not?”
Seeing that Connor had ignored her, a trace of anger flashed in her eyes.
She didn’t say anything because she felt that people like Connor deserved to die.
“Alright, since you really want to challenge me, I’ll agree to it. Let’s go get changed!”
Quincy said to Connor expressionlessly.
According to the rules of the Porthampton University, both parties had to wear Taekwondo uniforms before the competition. This would show the strength of both parties and also distinguish the fights between students.
“You can go and change your clothes. I don’t need to…”
Connor replied indifferently.
“Connor’s poor, so it’s no surprise that he can’t afford a Taekwondo uniform…”
Yara couldn’t help but mock Connor.
After hearing Yara’s words, the freshmen began to laugh out loud. They all thought that what Yara said was hilarious.
Connor’s classmates felt awkward because they knew that Yara was not joking. Connor did not have the money to buy a Taekwondo uniform. After all, a set of clothes cost hundreds of dollars. Connor definitely could not bear to spend that amount of money.
Dominic and Spencer were furious when they heard the crowd’s laughter.
After all, the two of them knew Connor’s true identity, so they felt frustrated.
All these people who mocked Connor added together might not be as rich as one of Connor’s employees.
Dominic even had the urge to reveal Connor’s true identity, but in the end, he thought of what Connor had said to them and suppressed this impulse.
“Alright, since you don’t have any clothes, then forget it. Let’s get started. Anyway, there are lecturers present, and they can testify for the two of us!”
Quincy said to Connor.
“Alright!”
Connor nodded lightly and followed Quincy to the center of the arena. One of the lecturers was the referee.
Rachel looked at Connor with a puzzled expression. She felt that since Connor was so confident that he wanted to challenge Quincy, it meant that Connor might really have some ability.
Therefore, Rachel was more or less looking forward to it.
Sadie, Yara, and the others all felt that Connor was just pretending to be confident. Both of them felt that Connor could not defeat Quincy.
Dominic and Spencer were looking forward to it. They were waiting for Connor to teach Quincy a lesson!
“Connor is so rich, so skillful, so good, and also so low-key, I really don’t understand why he’s doing this.”
Dominic looked at Connor and could not help but sigh.
“Perhaps this is the difference between the two of us and Connor. If the two of us become so rich one day, perhaps the two of us will be able to understand why Connor would do this…”
Spencer thought for a moment and replied in a low voice.
“Hehe, that’s true. After all, we’re not standing in Connor’s position, so we definitely don’t know what he’s thinking!”
Dominic agreed with Spencer and nodded gently.
Just as Dominic and Spencer were talking, Connor and Quincy had already walked to the middle of the stage.
After Quincy went on stage, he did a simple warm-up and then performed a standard roundhouse kick.
Quincy’s movements were standard. Whether it was speed or strength, they were all rather shocking.
After all, Quincy was a black belt in Taekwondo. This was no joke.
When Connor’s classmates saw Quincy’s roundhouse kick, they seemed to be even more worried about Connor.
But Connor had a calm expression. After all, in his eyes, Quincy’s roundhouse kick was simply not worth mentioning.
Whether it was speed or strength, they were far inferior to the players from Lion City.
If it was Connor some time back, he would not be Quincy’s match.
But now, even if there were a hundred Quincy, they probably wouldn’t be a match for Connor alone.
At this moment, Connor seemed to be looking forward to becoming Jorge Yarrell’s disciple even more. After all, Jorge’s training for Connor was very effective.
Even if Connor hadn’t truly become Jorge’s disciple, he already had such terrifying strength. If he really became Jorge’s disciple, how terrifying would his strength be!
“Let’s go!”
Connor shouted at Quincy expressionlessly.
“Kid, since you want to die, then I’ll fulfill your wish!”
When Quincy heard Connor’s words, he immediately roared angrily and then rushed toward Connor.
If it was an ordinary person, they would definitely not be Quincy’s match.
This was because Quincy’s kick was very fast and powerful.
Before everyone could react, Quincy’s right foot was aimed at Connor.
Connor finally understood why Quincy was able to break Dominic’s ribs with a kick. The strength of this kick was very large, and breaking ribs was easy.
When the finance students saw the forceful move, they became nervous.
They felt that Connor’s outcome would definitely be the same as Dominic’s. He would be sent flying by Quincy.
Because at this moment, Connor was actually still standing on the spot, motionless, without any reaction at all.
In everyone’s eyes, he was obviously scared silly by Quincy’s speed!

chapters.title: Chapter 757: One Kill!
chapters.content:
Editor EndlessFantasy Translation
Connor saw Quincy’s menacing appearance, but he appeared very calm.
It gave people the feeling that Connor was scared silly by Quincy and did not have any reaction at all.
“Connor seems to be weaker than Dominic…”
“That’s right. Just now, Dominic could still exchange a few moves with Quincy.
Now, this guy is actually scared silly and is standing there without moving…”
“Sigh, if I had known earlier, I wouldn’t have let Connor go up and embarrass himself. What is he doing?”
When the students in Connor’s class saw Connor standing still, they were very helpless.
Some people were worried about Connor, while others felt that Connor was embarrassing himself right now. Anyway, there were all kinds of discussions.
Right at this moment, Quincy’s flying kick came directly toward Connor’s head.
Quincy was extremely strong. Even the students standing around could feel
how terrifying the strength of Quincy’s kick was.
Connor looked somewhat disdainful. His body leaned back slightly and easily
dodged Quincy’s kick.
Although Quincy’s kick was very fast in the eyes of ordinary students, it was
also very powerful.
However, in Connor’s eyes, Quincy’s kick was like slow motion. Whether it was speed or strength, it was not worth mentioning. Connor could face someone of Quincy’s level very easily.
Seeing that Connor easily dodged Quincy’s kick, everyone was very shocked.
Only now did they realize that Connor did have some ability.
The reason why Connor stood there without moving was because Connor was confident that he could dodge Quincy’s kick.
In fact, no one knew that the reason why Connor chose to dodge the kick at the last moment was because he had developed a habit of fighting Jabba!
The angle of Jabba’s attack had always been very tricky. Sometimes, Jabba was obviously aiming for Connor’s head, but in the end, it would change its direction and hit Connor’s stomach.
Therefore, until the last moment, Connor could not determine where the other party’s attack would land.
Of course, Connor’s method was also a test of his reaction speed.
If Connor’s reaction speed was a little slower, then it would be impossible for him to dodge the opponent’s attack.
“Connor really has some ability…”
Yara pouted and sighed.
“When did he become so powerful?”
Sadie was also shocked.
“It’s just that his reaction speed is a little faster. This doesn’t mean that he will be a match for Quincy!”
Sheldon was very calm because he himself could easily dodge Quincy’s attack just now.
Therefore, Sheldon was not too surprised that Connor was able to avoid
Quincy.
When the students in Connor’s class saw that Connor had dodged the kick, they instantly erupted into cheers and began to cheer for him.
“Brat, you actually do have some skills…”
Quincy looked at Connor and sneered. Then, he continued to attack Connor.
Connor was still very relaxed in facing Quincy’s attacks, dodging several of Quincy’s attacks in succession.
“Huff…”
Quincy exhaled loudly, and he seemed somewhat triggered.
At this moment, Quincy realized that Connor did have some ability. He was not Connor’s match at all. Moreover, those few attacks just now had also consumed a large amount of Quincy’s strength.
At this moment, Connor suddenly took a step forward and directly rushed toward Quincy.
When Quincy saw Connor rushing toward him, he seemed to be a little surprised. He took two steps back in a row, wanting to avoid Connor’s attack.
However, Quincy’s speed was not on the same level as Connor’s speed at all.
Connor raised his leg and kicked Quincy’s chest!
Bang!
There was a loud bang.
Quincy did not have the time to react at all. He was sent flying and then smashed onto the ground.
“Ah…”
Quincy clutched his chest and howled in pain.
When Quincy was sent flying, everyone could hear the crisp sound of bones breaking!
It was exactly the same as the scene where Dominic was sent flying by Quincy’s kick!
Obviously, Connor’s kick directly broke Quincy’s ribs!
However, at this moment, Quincy seemed to be in greater pain than Dominic.
“We won?”
All the students in Connor’s class widened their eyes in disbelief.
No one had expected that Connor, a Taekwondo yellow belt, could actuaUy defeat Quincy, a Taekwondo blackbelt. Moreover, he had ended the battle in such a crushing manner. Everyone did not know how to describe their current feelings.
Initially, most people thought that Connor would definitely be beaten by
Quincy. However, they never expected that the person who was beaten in the end would actually be Quincy.
Spencer, Dominic and the other guys were extremely excited.
“I thought that Quincy is very powerful. It turns out that he only has these two skills. How embarrassing…”
“That’s right. Let’s see if this Quincy still dares to be arrogant…”
Everyone began to discuss in low voices, and the way they looked at Connor had also changed.
Previously, Connor had always been very low-key in the class. Most of the students only knew that Connor went to deliver food, and his physical fitness might be better than ordinary students.
However, they never expected that Connor’s skills would actually be so good! Quincy was a fourth-rank black belt in Taekwondo. Everyone knew his strength.
For Connor to be able to defeat Quincy so easily, this was enough to prove how terrifying Connor’s strength was!
On the other side, Sheldon, Sadie, Yara, and the doctors from the school hospital all ran to Quincy’s side.
The school doctor hurriedly went forward to examine Quincy, then shook his head and said, “All of his ribs are fractured. He must be sent to the hospital immediately…”
“What? Connor actually broke all of Quincy’s ribs with a single kick?
Sadie was stunned, her face filled with disbelief. She never thought that Connor would be so strong.
“Why is Quincy so weak? He kept bragging to me about how strong he was. He couldn’t even defeat that poor loser, Connor. It’s really embarrassing!”
Yara didn’t know what Taekwondo was. In her eyes, it was a very embarrassing thing for Quincy to lose to Connor.
Sheldon hesitated for a moment before turning to look at Connor.
His face was gloomy as he shouted at Connor coldly, “Connor, it’s just a spar between classmates. Did you have to hit him so hard?

chapters.title: Chapter 758: Seventh-Rank Black Belt
chapters.content:
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
After hearing Sheldon’s words, everyone present was stunned.
Connor smiled helplessly, and he looked somewhat disdainful.
He did not expect Sheldon to have the nerve to say such words.
If it wasn’t because Quincy had broken one of Dominic’s ribs with a kick just now, why would Connor have kicked Quincy so hard?
At this moment, Connor was just returning a tooth for a tooth, an eye for an eye!
“Kid, what do you mean by that?”
“That’s right. When Quincy beat Dominic up, didn’t he also break his ribs with a kick?”
“When Quincy hit Dominic, why didn’t you say that he hit him too hard? Now that your classmate has been beaten up, you’re saying that Connor hit him too hard?”
“Aren’t you being a hypocrite?”
“The two physical education lecturers are here watching. Connor’s actions just now were completely in line with the rules of Taekwondo. It’s just that Quincy is too weak…”
“That’s right. It’s fine if your people beat up our people, but you can’t stand it when our people beat up your people, right?”
The students in Connor’s class had long disliked Sheldon and Quincy.
However, they were all afraid of Quincy’s terrifying skills, so they did not dare to say anything.
Now that Connor had defeated Quincy, the students in Connor’s class had more confidence to speak up.
Sheldon’s words also caused public anger. Everyone stood up and began to criticize Sheldon.
When Sheldon heard what these people said, he felt a little awkward.
Just now, he had only said that because he was emotional.
At this moment, Sheldon realized that he had said something wrong, so he hesitated for a moment before walking directly to Connor and whispering to him, “Since you are so strong, how about I challenge you?”
When Sadie heard Sheldon’s words, a trace of worry flashed across her eyes.
She quickly walked up to Sheldon and whispered to him, “Sheldon, let’s forget about today’s matter. Don’t continue to cause trouble…”
“Since Connor can stand up for his classmate, why can’t I stand up for my classmate?”
Sheldon had long disliked Connor, so he could use this opportunity to teach him a lesson.
Connor was indeed strong, but Sheldon felt that defeating Connor wouldn’t be a problem.
After all, Sheldon was not Quincy. Although both of them were black belts in Taekwondo, Quincy was only a fourth-rank black belt while Sheldon was a seventh – rank black belt.
The black belt was divided into nine ranks. The first rank was the weakest, while the ninth rank was the strongest.
First to third rank were the ranks of a novice black belt, and fourth to sixth were the ranks of a high level.
However, only those with high academic attainments or outstanding figures who had made significant contributions to the development of Taekwondo could be awarded with the seventh to ninth ranks.
One had to know that the Taekwondo black belt from the first to the sixth ranks were issued by the Oprana Taekwondo Association. The review rules were not very strict, and some people could even buy it with money.
The fact that Sheldon was able to advance to the seventh-rank black belt in Taekwondo was enough to prove how terrifying Sheldon’s strength was.
Sheldon could even be compared to professional athletes. He had even won a world-class competition before.
Therefore, Sheldon felt that there would be no problem for him to deal with Connor.
“Do you dare to accept my challenge?”
Sheldon took a step forward and asked Connor with a disdainful expression.
“You want to challenge me?”
Connor replied with narrowed eyes.
Connor knew that since Sheldon had the guts to stand up, it meant that Sheldon was indeed capable.
Otherwise, Connor had just defeated Quincy with one move, so normal people would definitely be able to sec that Connor had certain skills. As long as they dared to continue challenging Connor, they were definitely very confident in their own strength.
“That’s right, I want to challenge you!”
Sheldon nodded lightly.
“If you were to challenge me, you might end up like him…”
Connor turned to look at Quincy and said expressionlessly.
“Connor, stop bragging. Do you think you’re invincible just because you defeated Quincy? Sheldon is much stronger than Quincy…”
Yara shouted disdainfully after hearing Connor’s words.
“That’s right. This kid really thinks he’s a martial arts expert. Sheldon and Quincy are not on the same level…”
“He really doesn’t know the immensity of heaven and earth!”
It could be seen that Sheldon was very popular in their class. Many people stood up for Sheldon.
Sadie also looked helpless. She didn’t want to make a big deal out of it.
However, since things had come to this, she knew that neither Sheldon nor Connor would let this matter rest.
“Sheldon, you must teach this guy a lesson he’ll never forget. I want to see if he still dares to be arrogant…”
Yara pouted and shouted at Sheldon.
“Don’t worry, I won’t let Quincy get beaten up for nothing…”
Sheldon said to Yara expressionlessly.
The PE lecturer hesitated for a moment before walking up to Sheldon and whispering, “Sheldon, if you really want to fight with Connor, that’s fine. But this time, don’t hurt him. Otherwise, I won’t be able to explain it to the school!” “Don’t worry, sir. 1 know what to do!”
Sheldon nodded lightly.
In fact, Sheldon only wanted to teach Connor a lesson. As for whether Connor would be injured or not, it was not Sheldon’s concern.
“Alright, since you’re in such a hurry to die, I’ll accept your challenge!”
Connor looked at Sheldon and nodded lightly. Then, he walked straight to the center of the stage.
This time, Sheldon did not choose to change his clothes. Instead, he slowly walked to the opposite side of the stage.
Sheldon was tall and handsome.
When he appeared on the stage, he instantly attracted a large group of girls’ screams.
Even the girls in Connor’s class couldn’t help but reveal infatuated expressions when they saw Sheldon.
It couldn’t be helped. Sheldon was really handsome. No matter where he was, he would attract the attention of others.
Although Connor was also good-looking, compared to Sheldon, he was obviously a loser.
In the eyes of these students, Connor was inferior to Sheldon in terms of family background, looks, and temperament. This might be the reason why Sadie chose Sheldon over Connor.
“Let’s begin!”
At this moment, Connor suddenly shouted at Sheldon.
Sheldon’s eyes flashed with disdain..

chapters.title: Chapter 759: It's My Turn, Right?
chapters.content:
Chapter 759: It’s My Turn, Right?
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Rachel Wallace looked at Connor with excitement.
She could not help but sigh inwardly, ‘I didn’t expect Connor to improve so
quickly…’
Connor’s skill becoming more and more powerful was definitely a good thing
for Rachel.
After all, if Connor became stronger, in the future, he would be very useful in dealing with those people from Rockefeller.
At this moment, Rachel was also looking forward to the martial arts competition between Connor and Sheldon.
Rachel wanted to see how powerful Connor was.
At this moment, Sheldon looked at Connor and snorted coldly. Then, he
directly rushed toward Connor.
Sheldon’s movements were not only beautiful, but his strength and speed were also amazing.
Just as Sheldon was about to rush in front of Connor, he suddenly stopped and executed a cool roundhouse kick.
At this moment, Sheldon was like a divine dragon swinging its tail. His right leg brought with it a whistling gale as it smashed directly toward Connor’s face.
Connor could feel that Sheldon did have some real ability. Whether it was speed or strength, he had already reached the limit of ordinary people. He was not someone that Quincy could compare to at all.
Connor instantly became vigilant.
This was because Connor could feel that it was extremely dangerous for him to face Sheldon. If he was slightly careless, he might lose to Sheldon.
The strength that Sheldon was displaying at this moment was actually not the slightest bit weaker than Benjamin Wheeler and the others.
However, Sheldon’s combat experience was incomparable to Benjamin and the others.
If Sheldon was given a little more time, his strength would definitely be much more terrifying than it was now.
Although Sheldon and Connor had always been enemies, even if they were enemies, Connor secretly acknowledged Sheldon’s excellence.
He was handsome, had a good family background, and had terrifying skills.
Such a boy was simply a perfect existence!
However, Sheldon had only one flaw, and that was that he was a little petty.
Sheldon had always felt that Connor was pursuing Sadie and Sabrina Ziegler. If Connor failed to pursue Sabrina, then Connor would pursue Sadie.
Therefore, Sheldon treated Connor as his potential love rival. He was now prepared to use this opportunity to suppress his love rival.
When everyone saw Sheldon’s kick, they all revealed shocked expressions.
Some girls even began to scream.
“As expected of a seventh-rank black belt.”
One of the PE lecturers could not help but sigh inwardly.
Sheldon’s strength was so great that even if he were to look at the entire Davenport, not many people would be his match.
Sheldon could definitely be considered a young talent.
“I wonder how Connor is going to take this kick!”
Rachel could naturally see that Sheldon’s kick was very fierce, so she began to worry for Connor.
At this moment, Sheldon’s kick was about to land on Connor’s face.
Connor hurriedly raised his right hand and blocked in front of his head.
Bang!
There was a loud bang.
Sheldon’s kick landed on Connor’s hands.
Connor couldn’t fully brace himself against Sheldon’s kick, so he took two steps back before stabilizing himself.
“Sheldon is so dashing…”
“Yeah, he’s really dashing…”
When everyone saw Connor take two steps back, they instantly erupted into cheers. Thy were very excited.
Because to these people, Connor had to retreat, which meant that he was weaker than Sheldon.
However, Sheldon was in shock because he knew that he had used all his strength in that kick.
Sheldon knew better than anyone how powerful that kick was.
However, Connor was actually able to block his kick. Although Connor took two steps back, this did not mean that Connor’s strength was inferior to Sheldon s. Sheldon felt that if it were anyone else, they would have been defeated by his kick.
However, Connor was able to block his kick. That proved that Connor’s strength might be much more terrifying than his.
“He does have some ability…”
Connor sighed softly after stabilizing his body.
“Again!”
At this moment, Sheldon was not in the mood to talk nonsense with Connor.
As soon as he finished speaking, he followed up with a Divine Dragon Tail, fiercely kicking toward Connor’s body.
Connor placed his hands in front of his chest and continued to block Sheldon’s kick.
However, Sheldon did not seem to have any intention of giving up. He continued to attack Connor, sending out five or six kicks in an instant.
Connor retreated while resisting Sheldon’s attack.
Bang! Bang! Bang!
A series of loud collisions sounded in the stadium.
Everyone present was dumbfounded.
What shocked these people was that Sheldon could actually kick so many times in such a short period of time, and that Connor could still stand there in the face of Sheldon’s fierce attacks. These two points were somewhat shocking.
“Huff…”
Sheldon had kicked so many times in a row just now, so it was inevitable that he was a little tired.
Therefore, he did not continue to launch the next round of attacks on Connor. Instead, he stood on the spot and panted heavily.
Connor was still standing there with an expressionless face.
When everyone saw Connor retreat earlier, they all thought that Connor would definitely lose today. However, no one thought that he would actually be able to persist until now.
Even a fool could see that Sheldon’s attacks were nothing to Connor.
Therefore, those who supported Sheldon also fell silent. They stared at Connor and Sheldon without blinking.
“Sheldon won’t lose to this poor guy, right?”
Yara was also very confused at this moment. She frowned and asked Sadie who was beside her.
Sadie couldn’t help but be stunned when she heard Yara’s words. Then, she frowned and said, “I don’t think so. Sheldon is a seventh-rank black belt in Taekwondo. If Connor can defeat Sheldon, how powerful would Connor be? I don’t remember Connor learning Taekwondo at all…”
“But Sheldon kicked Connor so many times just now, yet Connor still looks so calm. Sheldon’s kick could even shatter a brick…”
Yara couldn’t help but whisper.
Sadie looked at Sheldon and Connor and couldn’t help but frown. She didn’t know if Sheldon could defeat Connor.
“Now it’s my turn, right?”
At this moment, Connor suddenly shouted at Sheldon..

chapters.title: Chapter 760: We Won!
chapters.content:
Chapter 760: We Won!
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
“Your turn?
When Sheldon heard Connor’s words, he could not help but be stunned for a moment. He was somewhat puzzled.
Connor then directly rushed toward Sheldon.
When everyone saw Connor make a move, they all revealed shocked expressions.
Because the speed and strength that Connor was displaying were extremely shocking; it gave off a feeling that he was even more terrifying than Sheldon.
“Sheldon, be careful!”
Sadie seemed to have realized that something was wrong and hurriedly shouted at Sheldon.
Connor really didn’t know Taekwondo. He had only studied Taekwondo for a period of time when he was studying at the Porthampton University.
Therefore, Connor did not make any fancy moves this time. It was just a high kick!
However, Connor’s speed and strength were extremely shocking. The moment Connor kicked out, the air seemed to explode, emitting waves of ear-piercing sounds. It was as if Connor’s kick could split everything in the world!
Sheldon could naturally feel the ferocity of Connor’s kick. He chose to use the same method and raised his hands in front of his chest.
Bang!
There was a loud bang.
Connor’s foot landed on Sheldon’s chest.
Thump, thump, thump…
Sheldon took two to three steps back before he stopped.
Sheldon ability was indeed above Quincy Warburton’s.
That was because Connor had used the same amount of strength to kick Quincy and break all his ribs.
However, Sheldon was still standing there!
From this point, one could see the difference in strength between Sheldon and Quincy.
Sheldon raised his head and looked at Connor with a surprised expression.
Because only he could feel how terrifying the power of Connor’s kick was. At this moment, Sheldon felt waves of pain coming from his arm.
However, Connor did not give Sheldon any chance to react and directly launched a second round of attacks!
Bang!
Another kick!
Sheldon retreated again!
“You really have some skills…”
When Connor saw Sheldon block his kick, a playful smile appeared on his face, and he continued to kick!
In an instant, Connor kicked Sheldon five times.
Sheldon was exhausted from dealing with Connor’s attacks, and his entire person appeared to be in a sorry state.
At this moment, he was also very shocked. He was shocked at what kind of monster Connor was to be able to kick so many times in such a short period of time.
Although Sheldon had also kicked Connor five or six times in a row, Sheldon’s first kick was the strongest. After that, his strength became weaker and weaker.
However, Connor was different. Not only did his strength not decrease, but it had even increased.
When Connor kicked the sixth time, Sheldon, who had been struggling, finally couldn’t hold on any longer.
Connor’s foot broke through Sheldon’s hands and smashed into his chest.
Sheldon was sent flying in an instant, and then he crashed heavily onto the ground.
For a moment, everyone’s mouths were wide open as they watched this scene in a daze. They were extremely shocked.
Because they had never thought that Sheldon would actually lose to Connor!
Sadie was stunned, and she was very shocked!
“Cough cough…”
At this moment, Sheldon coughed lightly and struggled to stand up.
However, Sheldon realized that he could not use any of his strength at all. “Didn’t we agree to stop before someone gets hurt? Connor, why did you have to be so ruthless?”
Sadie turned and shouted at Connor, then quickly ran to Sheldon.
The school doctor looked helpless. He rushed to Sheldon and did a simple examination of his condition.
“You are not seriously injured. You might have some cramps…”
After the school doctor had given Sheldon a simple checkup, he whispered.
When Sadie heard this, she felt much better.
She reached out and helped Sheldon up. Then, she turned and glared at Connor.
Then, she whispered to Sheldon, “Sheldon, let’s go…”
“I haven’t lost yet!”
Sheldon couldn’t accept that he would lose to someone like Connor. He instinctively pushed Sadie away and rushed toward Connor.
However, Sheldon had barely taken two steps when his body fell to the ground again.
Rachel looked at Sheldon helplessly and said coldly, “Everyone already agreed to stop at a certain point, and everyone here has seen you lose. There’s no need for you to persist anymore. Otherwise, you’ll only be more embarrassed!” When Sheldon heard Rachel’s words, he gritted his teeth and looked at her.
In fact, he also knew in his heart that he had already lost to Connor. It was just that Sheldon was a little unconvinced.
“Let’s go…”
Sheldon shouted at Sadie.
Sadie quickly helped Sheldon up and followed Yara and the others out of the stadium.
After seeing Sheldon and the others leave, Connor looked at the group of freshmen expressionlessly and asked indifferently, “Is there anyone else who is not convinced?”
The freshmen stood rooted to the ground, dumbfounded. They looked irritated, but no one dared to stand up and say anything.
After all, even Sheldon and Quincy had lost to Connor. They were definitely not Connor’s match.
“We won?”
At this moment, Eunice Tanner looked at Connor in disbelief. Her face was filled with shock.
“Yeah, we won. Let’s see if you still dare to be so arrogant!”
The students from the Finance Department also started shouting excitedly.
After all, they were bullied by a group of freshmen, so they naturally felt very uncomfortable.
However, Quincy’s skills were too terrifying, so they could only swallow their anger.
But now that Connor had defeated Sheldon and Quincy, it would be considered as the finance students venting their anger.
Connor certainly had a better reputation in the eyes of these students.
Spencer was naturally very happy. He smiled and said, “In order to celebrate Connor defeating these two people, I’m going to buy everyone a meal outside campus. All the expenses will be paid by Connor!”
“Alright…”
“That’s great. When did Connor become so generous?”
“Connor has always been very generous, okay? Last time, Connor even invited us to Brasserie Le Bernardin for a meal!”
The students from the Finance Department shouted excitedly.
Rachel smiled when she saw how happy the students were, but she didn’t say anything..

chapters.title: Chapter 761: Rachel Wallace's Date
chapters.content:
Chapter 761: Rachel Wallace’s Date
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Spencer knew that Connor was very rich now. It was nothing for him to treat his classmates to a meal.
Connor also knew Spencer’s good intentions, so he did not refuse.
Instead, he brought his classmates to Brasserie Le Bemardin again.
Because Mandy Hines, Brandon Guthrie, and the others had been targeting Connor, many students in the class hated Connor.
Connor did not have a good relationship with his classmates.
However, after this incident, the students’ impression of Connor had changed drastically.
These students felt that Connor was not bad looking and was very generous.
Most importantly, he was very strong.
The way they viewed Connor changed drastically. Many boys who had mocked
Connor before took the initiative to apologize to him. Some girls even winked at him.
Sometimes, Connor could not help but sigh in his heart.
If a person had money, he could indeed change a lot of things.
Money might not be able to buy everything in the world, but it could make fewer people hate you and more people respect you.
Moreover, having money could also attract more attention from the opposite sex, giving you more choices.
After Connor inherited the ten-trillion-dollar inheritance, his life had undergone a huge change.
Although sometimes, Connor was still like an ordinary person, confused and hesitant.
However, this was just the process of a poor person gradually becoming a rich person.
Dominic thought that since Connor was already so rich, he could do whatever he wanted and punish whoever he wanted!
However, this was not the case. An ordinary person suddenly obtaining a huge inheritance needed a long time to adapt to the change in his identity.
This was also the reason why Thomas Morgan had never been in a hurry to let Connor take over the company’s business.
Connor was gradually adapting to his new identity. He was also gradually learning how to use his wealth and power!
Connor returned to the Royal Villas alone after he finished his meal in Brasserie Le Bemardin.
Recently, Connor had been busy practicing martial arts, so he rarely came back to the Royal Villas.
Connor was about to go to the Medicine Kings’ Valley to look for medicinal herbs, so he no longer fought with Jabba. Instead, he was prepared to go home and rest for a few days.
After returning to the villa, Connor washed up and gave Yelena a call.
Now, everyone in the entertainment industry knew that Yelena’s boyfriend was Mr. McDonald of Porthampton. Therefore, Yelena’s status in the entertainment industry had risen. Ordinary people did not dare to provoke her.
Yelena was currently acting in an international blockbuster film co-produced by Oprana and the United States. As long as Yelena finished filming this film, she could become an international star.
Yelena was getting closer and closer to her dream, so Connor could feel that Yelena was in a good mood when she was chatting with him.
After knowing that Yelena was safe, Connor was relieved.
After hanging up the phone, he lay down on the bed to rest.
The next day, at eight o’clock in the morning.
After Connor woke up, he went straight to the Porthampton University. Connor had classes all day.
By the time the class ended, it was already past six in the evening.
After school, Rachel called Connor into her office and told him about her plan for tonight.
Tonight was the day Rachel would meet her blind date, Nate Taylor.
“Do you remember what I told you just now?”
Seeing that Connor seemed to be absent-minded, she could not help but ask him.
“Don’t worry, I remember everything…”
Connor replied helplessly.
“Alright, go back and change into a better set of clothes. Then, meet me at the Emperor’s Club at 8 pm!”
Rachel softly said to Connor.
“Where?”
When Connor heard Rachel’s words, he could not help but be stunned for a moment, and he appeared to be somewhat surprised.
“The Emperor’s Club. It’s a newly opened club in Porthampton. It seems to be quite famous. If you want to take a taxi, just tell the driver. They should all know where it is…”
Rachel looked at Connor and slowly said.
“Such a coincidence…”
Connor looked at Rachel and smiled faintly.
“Coincidence? How is it a coincidence?”
Rachel asked in confusion.
“It… It’s nothing. I’ll go get changed now…”
Connor replied indifferently, then turned around and walked out of Rachel’s office.
Connor did not expect that Rachel and Nate would meet at the Emperor’s Club! The Emperor’s Club was a new multi-functional entertainment club that Thomas had opened in Porthampton. When it first opened, Thomas invited Connor to attend the opening ceremony.
However, Connor did not want to show his face in public, so he refused. Later on, Thomas had someone send Connor a membership card for the Emperor’s Club so that he could bring his friends over to play when he had time.
However, Connor was not very interested in this kind of place, so he had never been to the Emperor’s Club.
However, what Connor found interesting was that Rachel and Nate were actually going to meet in his club. This was indeed quite a coincidence. After returning to the Royal Villas, Connor changed into a set of branded clothes according to Rachel’s request and was prepared to set off for the Emperor’s Club.
However, just as Connor was about to leave the house, he saw the membership card of the Emperor’s Club that he had casually thrown on the table. He couldn’t help but hesitate for a moment before putting the membership card into his pocket.
Connor felt that if he encountered any trouble later, this membership card might be useful.
After all, Connor was going there to cause trouble today.
On the other side, in front of the Emperor’s Club.
A young man in a white suit was waiting anxiously in front of the Emperor’s Club. This person was Rachel’s blind date, Nate Taylor.
It had been half an hour since Rachel and Nate agreed to meet.
“Why isn’t she here yet?”
Nate couldn’t help but mutter. Then, he took out his phone and was about to call Rachel.
The person who was late was Rachel. If it were any other woman, even if she was only half a minute late, Nate might have left long ago.
There were countless women who wanted to date Nate but didn’t have the chance!
However, just as Nate was about to call Rachel, a beautiful figure walked over to Nate..

chapters.title: Chapter 762: Can Sincerity Be Eaten?
chapters.content:
Chapter 762: Can Sincerity Be Eaten?
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
When Nate saw the beautiful figure, he became excited.
He hurriedly ran forward and said with a smile, “Miss Wallace, you’re here.”
“Mr. Taylor, I’m sorry I’m late…”
Rachel looked at Nate with a faint smile. When she said this, it did not sound like an apology.
Today, Rachel was dressed very sexily. She was wearing a tight-fitting short skirt. Her tall and voluptuous figure looked even more attractive under the contrast of the short skirt. Her entire body was emitting an irresistible temptation.
She had an exquisite oval face that was smooth and delicate. She had light makeup on, and her sexy red lips were covered with a light red lipstick. Her short skirt was wrapped around the seductive curves of her hips, and her slender and fair legs were exposed to the air. It was almost impossible to take one’s eyes off her.
When Nate saw Rachel, he was very excited. He quickly smiled and said, “Being late is a beauty’s right…”
“I can’t help it. There was traffic on the way to the here…”
Rachel whispered to Nate.
“Yeah, the traffic in Porthampton is really bad. There was traffic when I came too…”
Nate looked at Rachel with a faint smile and continued, “Miss Wallace, I’ve already booked a table at the Emperor’s Club. Let’s go in!”
“Wait a minute, my friend isn’t here yet!”
Rachel replied softly.
When Nate heard Rachel’s words, he couldn’t help but be stunned. He figured that Rachel must have brought her best friend over because she was shy.
Therefore, Nate pretended to be a gentleman and said with a smile, “Oh, you have a friend joining us. Then, let’s wait…”
“Yeah.”
Rachel looked at Nate and nodded lightly.
Nate knew that Rachel was here today to go on a blind date with him, but this was also the first time the two of them were meeting alone.
It was actually very normal for Rachel to bring her best friend along because she was shy.
Therefore, Nate didn’t think too much about it. Instead, he stood beside Rachel and waited quietly.
Nate looked at Rachel’s sexy figure, especially her two beautiful fair legs. The more he looked at her, the more he liked her.
Moreover, what attracted Nate the most was Rachel’s heaven-defying background. If Nate could get together with Rachel, it would definitely be of great help to Nate’s family.
Rachel took out her phone and glanced at it. Connor was not here yet, so she could not help but feel a little anxious.
She couldn’t help but sigh to herself. Connor would not stand her up, right?
If Connor didn’t come today, then all of Rachel’s plans might fail.
Nate turned to Rachel and said with a smile, “Miss Wallace, actually, you should know why I’m here. Although we haven’t met many times and don’t know each other very well, you should know my situation very well. If you think I’m an okay guy, can you give me a chance? We can try to get to know each other better. If everything goes well, we can take a step further. What do you think…”
It could be seen that Nate was still very polite when talking to Rachel.
Moreover, the words he was using and the way he put it made it feel as if he was very gentle.
Even though Rachel didn’t like Nate, she was more or less moved by Nate’s words.
When Rachel heard Nate’s words, she couldn’t help but turn to look at Nate. Then, she said lightly, “Mr. Taylor, I’ve known about your situation for a long time. I also know that you’re very outstanding. Otherwise, I wouldn’t have come to meet you today…”
When Nate heard Rachel’s words, a smug smile appeared on his face. Since Rachel put it that way, it meant that he still had a chance.
“But…”
However, at this moment, a trace of hesitation flashed across Rachel’s eyes, and she seemed to be very conflicted.
“Miss Wallace, do you still have any concerns about me? If you have any concerns, you can tell me. If you are dissatisfied with anything, I can change…”
Nate hurriedly said when he saw that something was wrong.
“No…”
Rachel gently shook her head.
“Was I a little abrupt?”
Nate asked.
“No…”
Rachel gently shook her head. After which, she said indifferently, “Mr. Taylor, I admit that you’re indeed very outstanding. No woman would not like a man like you, but…”
“But what?”
Nate began to become anxious. He said to Rachel excitedly, “Miss Wallace, you don’t have to hold back. If you have anything to say, you can just tell me…”
Nate was tickled by Rachel’s words. He really couldn’t understand what Rachel wanted to say to him.
“Sigh…”
Rachel turned and looked into the distance. After which, she took a deep breath and said in a low voice, “Mr. Taylor, I’ll be honest with you. Recently, there is someone who has been pursuing me and pestering me every day. I’m annoyed to death by this person…”
“Miss Wallace, you don’t have to worry about this. I’ll get someone to help you settle the person who is harassing you. 1 can settle it with a phone call…”
Nate took out his phone and asked Rachel, “Miss Wallace, what’s the name of the guy who is harassing you?”
Nate wasn’t bragging. With the Taylor family’s status in Porthampton, it was easy to get rid of a harasser around Rachel.
“Mr. Taylor, don’t be too hasty…”
Rachel hurriedly reached out to stop Nate, then said with a conflicted expression, “Mr. Taylor, my admirer is indeed very annoying. I used to hate him a lot, but as we started spending more time together, I felt that he truly likes me and treats me well. Although he’s not very handsome and doesn’t have much money, he’s really sincere…”
“Really sincere?”
Nate looked at Rachel and sneered.
In the eyes of a person like him, what was sincerity?
Could sincerity be eaten?

chapters.title: Chapter 763: A Different Kind of Rich Guy
chapters.content:
Chapter 763: A Different Kind of Rich Guy
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
In Nate’s eyes, Rachel’s admirer was no threat to him at all.
After all, Rachel had already said that this suitor had no money or background.
It was simply a fantasy to chase a goddess like Rachel just by relying on sincerity!
However, Nate still asked tentatively, “Then, what arc you saying, Miss Wallace? Are you really going to give that guy a chance?”
“Haha…”
Rachel faintly smiled. After which, she softly said, “Actually, 1 was really tempted a while ago. I planned to give this guy a chance, but my grandfather suddenly introduced me to an outstanding man like you and even asked me to go for a blind date with you. I don’t know what to do now…”
II II
Nate couldn’t help but frown when he heard this. Then, he said expressionlessly, “Miss Rachel, I don’t think you need to worry about this problem. You can let me compete fairly with the guy. It won’t be too late for you to consider your options then. I’m confident that I can defeat your admirer…”
Rachel turned to look at Nate and said with a smile, “Mr. Taylor, you’re quite confident, aren’t you?”
“Hehe, if I don’t even have this bit of confidence, what right do I have to be with you, Miss Wallace…”
Nate said proudly.
Rachel looked at Nate and was about to speak when she suddenly saw a taxi stop in front of the Emperor’s Club.
Bang!
The taxi door opened.
Connor walked out of the taxi with a bouquet of roses in his hand.
When Rachel saw Connor, she finally heaved a sigh of relief deep down.
She thought that Connor would stand her up, but now that he had appeared, Rachel naturally felt much more relaxed.
Connor held a bouquet of bright red roses and then walked toward Rachel like a fool.
In fact, Connor was still very resistant to this behavior because he felt that his behavior was really stupid!
However, this had all been arranged by Rachel in advance, so Connor could only do it according to her wishes.
When Rachel saw Connor, she pretended to be surprised and shouted in disbelief, “Connor, why…why are you here?”
“Rachel, I have actually been following you…”
Connor hesitated for a moment before pretending to be affectionate. He whispered to Rachel, “Rachel, you know that I truly like you. Although I shouldn’t be following you around like this, I really don’t have any other intentions. I just wanted to give you a surprise…”
“How is this a surprise!”
Rachel deliberately pretended to be angry and then shouted at Connor.
“I apologize if I scared you, but I really didn’t mean any harm…”
Connor said in a low voice.
Nate looked at Connor from head to toe with a disdainful expression.
He walked in front of Rachel and asked her in a low voice, “Miss Wallace, is this kid the admirer you mentioned?”
“That’s right, it’s him…”
Rachel gently nodded.
“Haha…”
Nate looked at Connor and smiled disdainfully.
When Rachel told Nate about Connor, he already felt that an admirer like Connor meant nothing. Now, he was even more certain.
Nate felt that Connor couldn’t be compared to him.
If Nate and Connor were placed in front of a woman at the same time, any normal woman would know who to choose.
After all, Nate was much better than Connor in every aspect.
Rachel turned to look at Connor and gave him a look.
A trace of helplessness flashed in Connor’s eyes, but he still shouted at Rachel, “Rachel, I like you. I really like you. I’m begging you, please give me a chance. I promise that I won’t let you down. I’ll treat you sincerely for the rest of my life…”
IIJ II
When Rachel heard Connor’s words, she pretended to look conflicted.
When Nate saw the conflicted look on Rachel’s face, he quickly pretended to be a gentleman and said with a smile, “Miss Wallace, if you’re not in a hurry, let’s go in and talk. It’s not like we can just stand here…”
Nate was not an ordinary person. He was not an ordinary rich guy.
He knew clearly in his heart that Connor was the person who was competing with him for Rachel.
If it were any other rich guy, they would probably have been furious and chased Connor away. Then, they would use their background to make Connor completely disappear from Rachel’s life.
This was the simplest and most direct method.
However, if Nate did this, it would probably bring some negative effects to him, which would make Rachel view him negatively.
Just because of Connor, if it affected his image in Rachel’s heart, it would not be worth it.
Therefore, Nate pretended to be magnanimous and invited Connor into the Emperor’s Club.
However, Nate didn’t really want to treat Connor to a meal. His purpose was to slap Connor in the face.
Nate was prepared to use some other methods to let Rachel see the gap between Connor and himself so that Connor could clearly see what kind of person he was competing with for Rachel.
Once Connor understood the gap between him and Nate, then Nate could indirectly get rid of his love rival.
This was the difference between Nate and other rich guys. Nate obviously knew how to use power tactics better than others.
When Rachel and Connor heard Nate’s words, they were stunned for a moment.
Because Nate’s performance was obviously not in Rachel’s plan.
Rachel originally thought that Nate would fly into a rage out of humiliation after seeing Connor.
Rachel could also use this opportunity to complain to her grandfather about how petty Nate was.
The matter between him and Nate would then be over.
However, Rachel never thought that Nate would be so generous. Not only did he not chase Connor away, but he even invited Connor in for dinner..

chapters.title: Chapter 764: Platinum Member Card
chapters.content:
Chapter 764: Platinum Member Card
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Connor looked helplessly at Rachel, not knowing what to do now.
Rachel took a deep breath, then turned to look at Connor and said to him softly, “Alright, since Mr. Taylor wants to invite us in for a meal, let’s go in…”
“Please come in…”
Nate said to Rachel and Connor with a smile.
Rachel looked at Nate helplessly, then followed him into the Emperor’s Club.
At this moment, Rachel was thinking about how to anger Nate later.
If Nate wasn’t angry, then her plan would be foiled.
It wasn’t easy for her to get Connor here. If the three of them finished this meal in a friendly manner, it would be way too embarrassing!
Connor was also very helpless.
He could only counter every move that would come his way. No matter what happened next, Connor just had to do as Rachel said.
“Mr. McDonald, you haven’t been here, right?”
Nate turned to look at Connor and asked with a smile.
When Connor heard Nate’s words, he couldn’t help but smile faintly. Then, like a country bumpkin, he curiously sized up the environment inside the Emperor’s Club and said softly, “Yes, this is my first time coming to a place like this…”
Connor wasn’t lying. Although the Emperor’s Club was opened by Thomas Morgan, it was Connor’s first time here.
“Haha…”
Nate looked at Connor and seemed pompous. He laughed and said, “This place is not open to just anyone. Only those who are truly wealthy can enter. Moreover, you can’t enter with just money alone. You have to be a member of this place to enter. Without a membership card, you can’t enter…”
Connor couldn’t help but be stunned when he heard Nate’s words. Then, he pretended to be ignorant and said softly, “Since you can bring us here, Mr. Taylor, it means that you’re a member here, right?”
“That’s right, I’m a platinum member here…”
Nate replied proudly.
“Oh, I see…”
Connor looked at Nate and nodded lightly but didn’t say anything.
Nate seemed to think that Connor didn’t understand what a platinum member of the Emperor’s Club meant.
So, he looked at Connor and continued, “The Emperor’s Club is different from other clubs. They use a membership system. Anyone who wants to become a member of the Emperor’s Club has to go through a strict screening process. Only when the Emperor’s Club has determined that you are qualified to become a member can you get a membership card. To put it simply, as long as you are a member of the Emperor’s Club, you are a big shot in Porthampton. Not only do you have to have wealth, but you also have to have power…”
“Oh, I see…”
Connor looked at Nate and nodded again. He was still very calm.
Seeing Connor’s reaction, a trace of doubt flashed across Nate’s eyes. He then added, “Although this membership card of mine is only an ordinary membership card, the annual membership fee is five million…”
Connor looked at Nate and did not say anything. This time, Connor was not even willing to say “oh, I see”.
Connor’s reaction shocked Nate because he thought that Connor would be very surprised after finding out about the cost of the Emperor’s Club membership card.
After all, a normal person would be shocked to hear what Nate had said. An annual membership fee of five million dollars was enough to shock people.
Rachel was very calm, which was very normal.
After all, Rachel’s background was even more terrifying than Nate’s.
However, what he couldn’t understand was why Connor was so calm at this moment. He was so calm that it was a little strange.
‘Is this Connor a fool?’
Nate could not help but sigh in his heart. Then, he led Connor and Rachel into the Emperor’s Club.
As Nate was a platinum member of the Emperor’s Club, there were dedicated waiters just for him.
The two waitresses were both wearing white dresses. Their tall and sexy figures looked even more attractive in the dresses. Their bodies were emitting irresistible temptation.
These waiters had been carefully selected, and each of them was a top-notch beauty.
However, compared to Rachel, these waiters were obviously much more ordinary.
After all, no matter what kind of woman she was, in front of a stunner like Rachel, she would appear somewhat dim and dull.
Connor and Rachel followed Nate through a long corridor, then passed through an imperial garden that was similar to an ancient imperial palace. Finally, they came to a building complex. This building complex was like an ancient imperial palace. It was very spectacular and beautiful.
“Thomas’s Emperor’s Club is quite good…”
Connor could not help but sigh to himself.
“Mr. McDonald, this is the private room for our platinum members. Every room is an individual private room, and it has the best service in Porthampton…”
Nate knew that it was Connor’s first time here, so he took the initiative to introduce the place to Connor.
One could tell that Nate was very confident and full of superiority.
“The Platinum members’ private rooms are already so classy. I wonder what the private rooms of members above platinum look like?”
Connor couldn’t help but sigh softly after hearing Nate’s words.
“Uh…”
When Nate heard Connor’s words, a trace of embarrassment flashed across his eyes.
As Nate was only a platinum member, he had never been to a private room for members above platinum, so he did not know what it was like there.
Connor couldn’t help but smile when he saw that Nate was quiet. He knew that his question was unnecessary.
The Emperor’s Club had such a strict system, so Nate probably hadn’t been to a higher-level member’s room.
A few minutes later, Connor and the others walked into a hall under the guidance of the waitresses.
“Sir, please show me your membership card…”
The lobby manager walked up to Nate in high heels and said to him with a smile.
Nate took out his platinum membership card and handed it to the front desk manager with a faint smile on his face.
The front desk manager placed Nate’s membership card on the card reader. Soon, Nate’s personal information was displayed on the computer..

chapters.title: Chapter 765: Meeting an Old Acquaintance Again
chapters.content:
Chapter 765: Meeting an Old Acquaintance Again
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
“Mr. Taylor, may I know what service you require?”
The front desk manager asked Nate respectfully.
“Please open a supreme private room for me…”
Nate said indifferently.
There were three types of private rooms in the Emperor’s Club, namely, the supreme private rooms, the luxurious private rooms, and the ordinary private rooms.
There was a total of five rooms under each category. The supreme room had the best service, while the ordinary rooms had the worst service. Of course, this was in comparison to each other.
“I’m sorry, Mr. Taylor. The supreme private rooms are already full. There are
no more supreme private rooms available…”
The front desk manager said helplessly.
“Since the supreme private rooms are no longer available, let’s go with the
luxurious private room…”
Nate had originally planned to book the best private room, but since they were not available, he could only choose a slightly inferior one.
“There aren’t any more luxurious private rooms available either…
The front desk manager looked at Nate with a helpless smile.
At this moment, the manager was wearing a black office lady’s uniform. The skirt that covered her hips perfectly showed off her graceful figure. Her slender and fair legs were covered with black stockings.
This front desk manager was obviously sexier and more charming than the waitressed who had welcomed Connor and the others before.
“Then, do you have any private rooms left?”
Nate looked helpless as he frowned and asked the manager.
The front desk manager glanced at the computer in front of her and said in a low voice, “Mr. Taylor, we only have one ordinary private room left. If you want
it, I can open it for you now…”
“Alright, let’s have an ordinary private room then…”
A hint of helplessness flashed across Nate’s eyes as he nodded lightly.
Although there was only one ordinary room left, it was still better than nothing.
Moreover, if there were no more private rooms, they would have no choice but to leave. It would be extremely embarrassing for Nate.
“Miss Carver, I want that ordinary private room…”
However, just as Nate finished speaking, a voice came from behind him.
Connor felt that this voice was somewhat familiar. He could not help but be stunned for a moment, then slowly turned around to take a look.
When Connor saw the person who spoke, a trace of helplessness flashed across his eyes. He did not expect to meet an acquaintance here.
Nate subconsciously turned around to take a look. He was also stunned, and his face darkened.
Connor could tell from Nate’s expression that he knew this person.
At this moment, only Rachel was puzzled because she did not know the person who spoke.
The person who spoke was none other than Harold Phillips, who had had many conflicts with Connor. He was also Sabrina Ziegler’s admirer.
Connor could not understand why it was so coincidental that Harold would actually appear at this place today.
At this moment, Harold was dressed in branded clothes, followed by a large group of handsome men and beautiful women. This group of people was all dressed very fashionably, and it was obvious that they were not ordinary people.
Today was Harold’s friend’s birthday. The Emperor’s Club was the most popular club in Porthampton, so many people wanted to come and see the place, so Harold brought his friends here.
When Harold saw Connor and Nate, a strange look flashed across his eyes. He did not expect his two enemies to be together.
Harold and Connor were fighting to the death because of Sabrina.
As for Harold and Nate, they had had some conflicts before. If it weren’t for the Taylor Family, Harold would have broken Nate’s legs long ago.
However, even if Harold did not have the chance to take revenge on Nate, he would mock Nate every time he saw him.
Nate felt that it was a little embarrassing to argue with Harold, so he didn’t really like to talk to Harold.
When Harold saw Nate and Connor together, he was naturally very angry. The words he shouted just now were obviously intentional.
When Harold passed by Connor, he turned and looked at Connor indifferently, disdain written on his face.
He ignored Connor and walked to the front desk manager. He said expressionlessly, “Miss Carver, I want the last private room…”
“Harold, what are you doing? I already asked for the private room. Didn’t you hear me?”
Nate took a deep breath and asked Harold in a low voice.
Rachel stood beside Connor and quietly watched. She was very calm.
At this moment, she was thinking about how to deal with Nate.
“I’m sorry, I didn’t hear you…”
Harold turned and glanced at Nate indifferently. Then, he took out his membership card and handed it to Miss Carver. He said with a smile, “Miss Carver, today is my friend’s birthday. Can you open the last private room for
me…”
“Alright, Mr. Phillips, please wait a moment…”
The front desk manager, who was wearing a sexy uniform, hurriedly nodded when he heard Harold’s words. Then, she reached out and took Harold’s membership card.
Connor clearly saw the membership card that Harold handed to Miss Carver. It was exactly the same as Nate’s membership card, which meant that they were both platinum members.
“Wait…”
Nate finally couldn’t hold it in anymore. He stood in front of Miss Carver and asked in a low voice, “Miss Carver, what are you doing? We were clearly the ones who arrived first. Why are you giving this person…”
It could be seen that Nate could no longer maintain his gentlemanly demeanor.
He was very angry.
“You guys arrived first?”
When Harold heard Nate’s words, he could not help but sneer. Then, he sized Nate up and said expressionlessly, “Nate, is this your first time at the Emperor’s Club? Does this place allow the first person to get a private room? Do you think this is a roadside stall? Do you think we have to stand here and queue up?”
“Hahaha…”
When everyone heard Harold’s words, they all began to laugh.
At this moment, Rachel could not help but size up Harold. A trace of displeasure flashed across her eyes.
Although Rachel didn’t like Nate very much, she was still with Nate and Connor. Harold humiliating Nate now was equivalent to humiliating Rachel.
A woman like Rachel would not allow anyone to humiliate her like this.
Since she was young, no one had ever dared to humiliate Rachel like this!
Connor looked at Harold expressionlessly and could not help but sneer deep down.
He had not seen this guy for so many days, but he was still so arrogant and didn’t care about anyone.
“Harold, what do you mean by that?”
Nate shouted at Harold with widened eyes..

chapters.title: Chapter 766:I Want That Private Room
chapters.content:
Chapter 766:I Want That Private Room
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
“I don’t have any meaning, I just want to tell you, the Emperor’s Club has always looked at one’s status! Speaking of which, I’m of a higher status than you, so this private room is mine!” Harold shouted at Nate arrogantly.
When Nate heard this, he couldn’t help but take a deep breath.
“Harold, what do you mean?” he asked in a low voice. You’re a platinum, so am I. How is your status somehow higher than mine? Tell me!”
Normally, Nate wouldn’t care about these things with Harold, but today’s situation was different.
First of all, Rachel was here. If Nate really gave in like this, he would lose face in Rachel’s eyes.
Secondly, his love rival, Connor, was also here.
Nate’s purpose in bringing Connor here was to use his own status as a platinum member to give Connor a good slap in the face and make Connor aware of the gap between them!
However, if Harold snatched Nate’s private room, then all of Nate’s efforts would be in vain. Therefore, Nate would not give in today no matter what.
“Haha…”
Harold looked at Nate and sneered. Then, he said expressionlessly, “Nate, you’re right. Our membership card levels are indeed the same, but you’re also from Porthampton. No matter what, you know the rules of Porthampton too.”
“You…” Nate looked at Harold speechlessly.
In fact, Nate’s background far surpassed Harold’s. However, he usually kept a low profile, which led Harold to have the illusion that Nate was not as good as him.
From the fact that Nate could go on a blind date with a woman like Rachel, it could be seen how terrifying the Taylor family’s background was.
“I’m not in the mood to talk nonsense with you now. Miss Carver, give the last private room to me. If these people want to eat, let them eat elsewhere…”
Harold said arrogantly to Miss Carver.
Harold was still in a good mood after snatching the private room from Nate. After all, he was killing two birds with one stone—he could slap Nate’s face and Connor’s face in one go.
When Miss Carver heard what Harold had said, she walked up to Nate and smiled at him. “Mr. Taylor, our Emperor Club has some private rooms that are also very good. You can bring your friends to the private rooms. I can guarantee that even if you go to the private rooms, you can enjoy the same service as platinum members…”
After Nate heard Miss Carver’s words, his expression was very ugly.
As for Connor and Rachel, they stood where they were and did not speak.
In fact, Connor had some understanding of the Emperor Club. According to Thomas Morgan’s personality, there would definitely be no difference in treatment between members of the same level.
If it was really as Harold said, Harold’s strength was stronger than Nate’s, then Harold should be able to obtain a higher level membership card.
No matter what, this private room should be reserved for Nate.
However, Connor could tell that there was something wrong with the way Harold looked at Miss Carver, so the two of them must know each other.
As for whether Miss Carver was Harold’s new lover, Connor did not know.
However, the two of them definitely had a relationship. At this moment, Miss Carver was abusing her authority and giving this private room to Harold.
Nate felt as if he had been slapped by someone. The expression on his face was extremely ugly. He stood there foolishly, but he didn’t know what to do.
Because the manager of the Emperor Club was on Harold’s side, he had no choice.
When Miss Carver saw that Nate did not speak, he directly opened the last private room for Harold. Then, he very respectfully handed Harold’s membership card to Harold and said softly, “Mr. Phillips, I’ve already booked your room. I hope you can have fun…”
“Thanks!”
Harold looked at Miss Carver and smiled.
“No need to thank me. This is what I should do…”
Miss Carver smiled ambiguously at Harold and then winked at him.
When Harold saw the look in Miss Carver’s eyes, he naturally understood what Miss Carver meant.
However, with Connor and the others present, Harold did not dare make things too obvious. He turned his head and shouted at his friends beside him, “Alright, brothers, let’s go in and eat…”
“Alright!”
When everyone heard Harold’s words, they shouted excitedly and turned around to walk towards the private room.
When Harold passed by Connor, he suddenly stopped and sized up Connor. Then, he said in a disdainful tone, “Do you think a poor person like you can come to such a place? It’s better for you to scram back to the canteen of the Porthampton University…”
“What do you mean?”
When Rachel heard Harold’s words, a trace of anger flashed across her eyes as she shouted with a displeased expression.
Harold turned his head and glanced at Rachel. Then, he was instantly stunned on the spot, as if he was stunned by Rachel’s appearance.
“Beauty, do you want to come in and eat with me?”
Harold asked Rachel with a smile.
Of course, Rachel would not give face to someone like Harold. She shouted very domineeringly, “Get lost!”
“Haha…”
After Harold heard Rachel’s words, he could not help but sneer. Then, he turned around and walked towards the private room.
“Wait a moment…”
However, at this moment, Connor seemed to have suddenly thought of something and called out to Harold.
When Harold heard Connor’s words, he could not help but be stunned for a moment. Then, he turned his head to look at Connor and asked with a disdainful expression, “You bumpkin, is there anything else?”
Connor ignored Harold. Instead, he walked up to Miss Carver and said calmly,
“I want that private room from earlier…”
Miss Carver looked at Connor and was stunned for a moment. The expression on her face was a little helpless, and then she said coldly with a straight face, “Sir, that private room has already been reserved by Mr. Phillips. You can only go to another private room now…”
“Didn’t you hear what I said just now? I want that private room!”
Connor said to Miss Carver.
“Connor, is there something wrong with your brain?”
Harold turned his head to look at Connor, then said in a disdainful tone, “Connor, who do you think you are? Do you know what this place is?”
“What is this place?”
Connor looked at Harold and asked indifferently..

chapters.title: Chapter 767: Connor's Membership Card
chapters.content:
Chapter 767: Connor’s Membership Card
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
“Let me tell you, this is the Emperor’s Club. Are you a member here? You don’t even have the right to enter the lowest level public private room here, let alone this platinum member’s private room! If Nate didn’t bring you in, you wouldn’t have the right to ever come here to eat in your lifetime, do you know that?”
Harold stared at Connor with a disdainful expression.
Nate looked at Connor helplessly. He couldn’t understand what was wrong with Connor to actually want that private room.
Even if he had already given up on this private room, what right did Connor have to want that private room?
At this time, only Rachel looked at Connor’s seat with a smile because she was the only one who knew Connor’s true identity and thus knew his relationship with the Emperor’s Club.
However, Rachel was not in the mood to care about this problem. All she could think about was how to deal with the blind date with Nate.
“And how do you know that I’m not qualified to eat here?”
ruiu 11W»» UV  1U1V»» L11UL * 111 11VL CjUUllllVU IV
Connor glanced at Harold indifferently and asked him calmly.
“Haha…”
When Harold heard Connor’s words, he could not help but sneer. Then, he sized up Connor and said expressionlessly, “Connor, do you think I don’t know if you have the qualifications to eat here? Do you want me to tell you that you gave Sabrina a fake garnet bracelet? You’re just a poor loser, so why are you pretending to be a rich kid? Tell me!”
Connor was not in the mood to pay attention to Harold. Instead, he turned his head and said to Miss Carver, “I want his private room just now. Do you understand what I mean?”
“Sir, if you continue to cause trouble like this, I’ll have to call security…”
Miss Carver said to Connor with a cold face and an unhappy expression.
“Call security?”Connor sneered and took out a membership card from his pocket. He said expressionlessly, “I’m telling you now that I want his private room. Do you understand what I mean?”
When Harold, Nate, and the others saw Connor take out a membership card, they were all stunned. Their expressions were very puzzled.
This was because the membership card that Connor had taken out was something that Harold and Nate had never seen before!
