“Connor, where did you get this student card? This isn’t your school. This is the Emperor’s Club. Do you think you can pretend to be a member just by taking out a card?”
Harold shouted at Connor with a disdainful expression.
Connor looked at Harold coldly and said in a low voice, “This card of mine is a membership card of the Emperor’s Club…”
“What kind of membership card is this? I’ve been working at the Emperor’s Club for a few months, but I’ve never seen this card before!”Miss Carver shouted at Connor with a disdainful expression.
“Have you never seen this membership card before?”
When Connor heard Miss Carver’s words, a hint of confusion flashed across his eyes.
“I’m sorry, I’ve never seen it before. I don’t think this membership card belongs to our Emperor’s Club. I’ve definitely seen all the membership cards of the Emperor’s Club. If you continue to cause trouble here, I’ll have to call security…”
Miss Carver replied to Connor impatiently.
“You can check if my card is a member card of the Emperor’s Club on the computer.” Connor said lightly.
“Sir, can you stop messing around? I didn’t want to kick you out because of Mr. Taylor, but if you continue to make a scene like this, I can only kick you out!”
Miss Carver frowned and said unhappily.
“Connor, don’t you think it’s embarrassing enough? Stop fooling around…”
Nate shouted at Connor with an ugly expression.
“Yeah, Connor, stop fooling around. At most, we can just change places to eat, right? How can you have a membership card?” Rachel hesitated for a moment before shouting as well. She even winked at Connor.
In fact, Rachel knew in her heart that Connor’s membership card was definitely real; after all, the entire Emperor’s Club belonged to Thomas Morgan, which meant that the club belonged to Connor as well.
But Rachel did not wish for Connor to expose his identity at this time!
Although Connor’s actions could severely slap Harold and Nate’s face, it was not conducive to Rachel’s plan. Rachel had asked Connor to come over today to ruin her blind date, not for him to come over and slap these people’s faces.
If Nate knew that Connor’s background was not simple, he might be even more afraid of Connor. At that time, Nate might not dare to offend Connor easily, which would make it even more difficult to ruin the date!
After Connor heard Rachel’s words, a trace of helplessness flashed across his eyes. He subconsciously took back his membership card.
Since Rachel didn’t let Connor expose his identity, then Connor could only choose to endure this anger now.
“Wait a moment…”
However, just as Connor was about to take back his membership card, Harold shouted at Connor expressionlessly.
Connor glanced at Harold indifferently and asked softly, “Is there something you needed?”
“Didn’t you say that this membership card is real? Miss Carver, please check if his membership card is real!” Harold shouted expressionlessly.
In fact, Harold’s goal was very obvious. If Connor really took back the membership card now, then this matter would be unclear. No one knew if Connor was bragging or not.
Therefore, he felt that it was necessary to verify whether Connor’s card was a membership card here. This way, Harold could go to Sabrina and mock Connor. “Mr. Phillips, how could this person have a membership card? He doesn’t have the qualifications at all…” Miss Carver said helplessly to Harold.
“We won’t know for sure until we test it, no?” Harold replied with a smile.
“Alright then…”
Miss Carver looked at Harold and nodded helplessly. Then, he walked up to Connor and said softly to Connor, “Give me your membership card. I’ll check if it belongs to our club…”
Connor turned his head to look at Rachel, then took out his membership card and handed it to Miss Carver with a helpless expression.
After Miss Carver took Connor’s membership card, she looked at it briefly with a disdainful expression on her face. Then, she walked to the computer in her high heels.

chapters.title: Chapter 768: Can I Cancel His Membership?
chapters.content:
Chapter 768: Can I Cancel His Membership?
Editor. EndlessFantasy Translation
Actually, Miss Carver could tell at a glance that Connor’s membership card should not be a membership card of the Emperor’s Club.
On membership cards, the word ‘Emperor’ would be printed on it, and the level of the membership card would also be printed. For example, Nate and Harold’s platinum membership cards would have the words “Emperor Platinum” printed on them!
However, Connor’s membership card was pure black with only one golden dragon printed on it. Other than this golden dragon, there were no other words or patterns.
That was why Miss Carver felt that the membership card that Connor took out did not belong to the club at all!
Regardless, Miss Carver placed Connor’s membership card on the card tester beside the computer.
“Beep!”
A crisp sound rang out.
Immediately after, a few large words appeared on the computer screen.
“Honorable member, welcome to the Emperor’s Club!”
When Miss Carver saw these words, she was instantly stunned on the spot. The expression on her face was very incredulous.
Miss Carver thought that he had made a mistake, so she quickly picked up Connor’s membership card with trembling hands and placed it on the card detector again. However, the content displayed was the same.
Miss Carver widened her eyes and could not help but gulp. Her expression was indescribably ugly.
“This… How is that possible?”
Miss Carver could not help but stutter.
She was the manager of the Emperor’s Club and knew the hierarchy of the club better than anyone else.
The membership system of the Emperor’s Club was very standard: it was divided into bronze, silver, gold, platinum and diamond membership levels!
In the eyes of ordinary people, diamond-level members were already at the highest level of membership. However, Miss Carver knew that there was another type of membership card that was even more powerful than diamond membership. That was the Supreme Level membership card!
However, the Emperor’s Club had only issued three such membership cards since it opened. Most people didn’t know that the Emperor’s Club had such membership cards.
One of the three Platinium Member cards was in the hands of Thomas Morgan, the boss of the Emperor’s Club, and one was in the hands of Kyle Hayes. The third one was in the hands of a mysterious person!
It was said that the person who had the third Platinium Member Card had a terrifying background. Many people guessed that the Supreme Member Card was in the hands of Thomas Morgan’s boss, Mr. McDonald of Porthampton.
“Miss Carver, this card can’t be fake, right?”
The attendant behind Miss Carver was also very curious at this time. He could not help but call out to her softly.
“Impossible…”
Miss Carver hurriedly shook her head. She knew that Connor’s membership card could not be fake.
This was because the system of the Emperor’s Club was very solid and was not something that ordinary people could crack. Moreover, no one dared to forge a membership card of the Emperor’s Club.
Connor had the Platinum Member card of the Emperor’s Club in his hand, and his surname was also McDonald. After connecting these pieces of information, Miss Carver instantly understood what was going on.
Her eyes immediately widened as she looked at Connor’s position in disbelief. The expression on her face was extremely shocked.
After Rachel saw the expression on Miss Carver’s face, a trace of helplessness flashed in her eyes because Rachel knew that Connor’s identity had been exposed.
“Miss Carver, is Connor’s membership card real?”
Harold did not notice the expression on Miss Carver’s face at all. He smiled and asked Miss Carver.
At this moment, Harold was still planning to wait for Miss Carver to tell him the result so that he could humiliate Connor in front of him.
Miss Carver ignored Harold.
At this time, how could she still be in the mood to care about Harold!
She quickly ran to Connor and said with a trembling voice, “M-Mr. McDonald, you… Please wait a moment, I’ll arrange the best private room for you immediately…”
“I want his private room!”
Connor pointed at Harold’s position and said expressionlessly.
“Alright, I’ll arrange it for you immediately…”
Miss Carver hurriedly nodded.
At this moment, Miss Carver was still very regretful because he had never taken Connor seriously before. Miss Carver had always thought that Connor was just a friend of Nate. If it was not for Nate bringing Connor here, Connor would not have the right to come to such a club to eat.
However, she never expected Connor to be a Platinium Member of the Emperor’s Club.
What was even more unbelievable was that this Connor was very likely to be Thomas Morgan’s boss, the legendary Mr. McDonald of Porthampton!
In front of Connor, what could Harold and Nate do?
After seeing Miss Carver’s reaction, everyone revealed a strange expression.
Nate and Harold stood rooted to the ground.
Only Rachel had a helpless expression on her face, not knowing what to do.
Once Connor’s identity was exposed, Rachel’s original plan fell through.
“Mr. McDonald, please wait a moment. I’ll arrange that private room for you
now…”
Miss Carver said to Connor respectfully.
“Alright…”
Connor nodded his head gently, then turned to Rachel and Nate and said, “Let’s go in.”
After saying this, Connor directly walked towards the private room.
Nate and Rachel followed behind Connor helplessly.
Initially, Nate had planned to use the Emperor’s Club to slap Connor in the face. However, he never dreamed that the person who would be slapped in the face would be himself!
Nate really couldn’t understand why Connor had a membership in the Emperor’s Club.
Moreover, from the reaction on Miss Carver’s face, it was enough to prove that Connor’s membership card level was far higher than Harold and himself.
At this moment, Nate realized that Connor was the one who was putting on an act, like a wolf in sheep’s clothing.
Connor’s identity was definitely not as simple as Rachel had said. How could an ordinary person have a membership card of the Emperor’s Club?
That said, Nate was also secretly rejoicing in his heart. Good thing that he did not offend Connor just now. Otherwise, things would have been troublesome.
“Miss Carver, what’s going on?”
Harold asked Miss Carver excitedly with a puzzled expression.
Miss Carver turned his head and glanced at Harold. Her expression was extremely helpless. She did not know how to explain it to him.
This time, Harold had caused Miss Carver a lot of trouble!
At this moment, Connor suddenly turned around and looked at her. He asked Miss Carver softly, “Miss Carver, can I cancel this person’s membership?” When Miss Carver heard Connor’s words, she could not help but be stunned. Harold was also stunned..

chapters.title: Chapter 769: Not an Ordinary Person
chapters.content:
Chapter 769: Not an Ordinary Person
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Harold had never expected that Connor would be so arrogant and actually want to cancel his membership.
In order to get a membership card for the Emperor’s Club, Harold had put in a lot of effort. In the end, he had to beg his own father and find a lot of connections to barely get such a platinum-level membership card.
Harold had always been proud of being a platinum-level member of the Emperor’s Club. But now, Connor actually said that he wanted to cancel his membership. Harold felt that this was simply a huge joke!
Harold might not know that the power that a platinum-level member had in the Emperor’s Club was beyond the imagination of ordinary people.
With the platinum-level member card, anything you ate in the Emperor’s Club was free, and on top of that, one could receive the highest level of hospitality. Connor was treated like an emperor here. Even if Connor liked the service staff here, as long as he said so, these staff members would undress immediately to meet Connor’s request.
Therefore, Connor was not joking when he said that he wanted to cancel Harold’s membership. He was very serious.
After hearing Connor’s words, Miss Carver couldn’t help but be stunned for a moment. Then,s he nodded and said, “Mr. McDonald, you do have the right to cancel this person’s membership!”
“Alright, then help me cancel it. This kind of person doesn’t deserve to spend money here!” Connor called out expressionlessly, then directly walked towards the private room.
“Oi, Connor, what do you mean?”
After Harold saw Connor leave, he shouted excitedly at Connor’s position.
However, Connor had no intention of paying any attention to Harold at all. He directly walked into the private room.
“No, Miss Carver, what did this kid mean by what he said just now? Who does he think he is? What right does he have to cancel my membership? Does he really think that this Emperor’s Club is owned by his family?”
Harold shouted excitedly at Miss Carver.
After Miss Carver heard Harold’s words, her expression seemed a little helpless. She could not help but think, “The Emperor’s Club might really be owned by Mr. McDonald!”
“Well, Miss Carver, you have to investigate this kid thoroughly. I’m telling you, I know this kid very well. A person like him can’t possibly be a member of the Emperor’s Club…” Harold shouted excitedly at Miss Carver.
When Miss Carver heard Harold’s words, a hint of helplessness flashed across her eyes. Then, she said softly, “Mr. Phillips, I’ve already checked carefully. There’s no problem with Mr. McDonald’s membership card…”
“How can a person like him have a membership card here?”
Harold’s expression was extremely shocked.
“Not only does Mr. McDonald have a membership card here, but his membership level is even higher than yours. That’s why I arranged that private room for Mr. McDonald…” Miss Carver explained calmly.
“What…?”
Harold took a deep breath and said in a low voice, “There must be something wrong here. A poor loser like Connor can’t have a membership card here. I have to find out what’s going on…”
Miss Carver looked at Harold helplessly. At this moment, she did not want to say anything more to Harold.
Seeing that Miss Carver did not speak, Harold frowned and said, “Alright, Miss Carver, I won’t hold it against you for today. Hurry up and arrange another private room for me. My friend is still waiting for her birthday…”
Miss Carver looked at Harold with a speechless expression and said softly, “Mr. Phillips, I’m really sorry. Your membership has been revoked, so you no longer have the right to eat at our Emperor’s Club!”
“What?”
After Harold heard Miss Carver’s words, he was completely dumbfounded. The expression on his face was very incredulous.
“Miss Carver, are you joking with me here? How could my membership be canceled? Could it be because of what Connor said just now?” Harold shouted excitedly with his eyes wide open.
“That’s right, it’s because of what Mr. McDonald said just now!” Miss Carver looked at Harold and nodded gently.
“How is that possible? Who does that Connor think he is? Why do you have to cancel my membership just because he said so?” Harold shouted with a puzzled look on his face, eyes wide.
“Mr. Phillips, your membership has indeed been canceled. From now on, you are no longer a member of the Emperor’s Club. If you are not satisfied with anything, you can talk to the boss.”
Miss Carver replied to Harold expressionlessly, then turned around and walked away.
Harold looked at Miss Carver’s departing back with an incredulous expression on his face.
Harold’s friends also looked at each other in confusion. They could not understand what was going on!
Initially, Harold thought that he could use this opportunity to slap Connor and Nate in the face.
However, what Harold never expected was that not only did he not manage to slap Connor in the face, he also lost his membership in the process.
This was simply a double loss!
However, what Harold could not understand the most was how Connor had gotten his membership card here. Why did Connor have such great authority to cancel his membership?
Other than shock, Harold was more confused.
On the other side, Connor, Rachel, and Nate walked into the private room.
Although it was only the most ordinary private room in the Emperor’s Club, the interior decorations was still very luxurious.
Nate calmed himself down and asked Connor with a smile, “Mr. McDonald, Miss Wallace, what would you like to eat?”
“I can eat anything…”
Connor replied indifferently.
“I’m fine with whatever,” Rachel said in a low voice.
“Haha, alright then. I’ll order then…”
Nate nodded gently, then picked up the menu and began to order.
A few minutes later, Nate finished ordering and asked Connor with a smile, “Mr. McDonald, what does your family do?”
“I’m an orphan and I’m studying at Porthampton University now…”
Connor replied expressionlessly.
After hearing Connor’s words, a trace of confusion flashed across Nate’s eyes. Then, he very politely chatted with Connor.
Connor’s show from just now had completely changed Nate’s opinion of him. He felt that Connor was definitely not an ordinary person.
Therefore, even if Nate had the courage of a thousand lions, he would not dare to offend Connor!

chapters.title: Chapter 770: Quickly Kiss Me!
chapters.content:
Chapter 770: Quickly Kiss Me!
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Just as Rachel thought, after Nate found out about Connor’s identity, his attitude towards Connor had changed drastically.
As a result, Nate had no intention of falling out with Connor!
However, if Nate didn’t turn hostile, Rachel’s plan would fall through. Therefore, Rachel had been thinking about how she should provoke Nate later. She knew that it was obviously impossible to anger Nate now. Since she couldn’t anger Nate, she could only choose to take the unconventional path. Rachel subconsciously turned her head to look at Connor, the expression on her face seemed a little hesitant.
But soon, her face hardened.
She felt that she had to clean up this matter today. If she didn’t, things would definitely be even more troublesome.
A few minutes later, the waiter began to bring their food.
Connor, Rachel, and Nate sat at the dining table, chatting as they ate. However, just as Connor was about to pick up the food, Rachel placed her small hand on his thigh.
After Connor saw Rachel’s action, the expression on his face appeared somewhat puzzled. He didn’t know what she wanted to do.
“Are you teasing me?”
Connor turned his head to look at Rachel, a trace of confusion flashing in his eyes.
Rachel blinked her eyes at Connor. After Connor understood what Rachel meant, he hurriedly lowered his head to look at his thigh.
At this time, Connor finally reacted. It turned out that Rachel was not teasing him, but writing on his thigh.
Rachel’s writing speed wasn’t very fast. After Connor managed to decipher the words she wrote down, he immediately froze on the spot, disbelief on his face. Because at this moment, Rachel actually wrote the words ‘Kiss me’ on Connor’s leg!
He stared at Rachel with his eyes wide open, the expression on his face extremely shocked! He did not know why Rachel would suddenly make such a request to him!
“What do you mean?”
Connor felt that Rachel, this woman, had always been very rational. She probably wouldn’t make such a request.
After all, Rachel was still his lecturer, so Connor instinctively thought that he must’ve misunderstood.
Rachel fiercely glared at Connor, then softly said to Nate, “Mr. Taylor, I suddenly feel like drinking. Why don’t you go out and order a bottle of red wine…”
“Alright, I’ll go now…” Nate looked at Rachel and nodded gently. Then, he stood up and walked out of the private room.
After Rachel saw Nate walk out of the room, he quickly turned his head and said to Connor, “When Nate comes back later, kiss me and confess to me, understand?”
“Ms. Wallace, are you crazy? Why should I kiss you?”
It turned out that he hadn’t misunderstood at all! Rachel really wanted him to kiss her!
“I don’t have time to explain so much to you now. Do whatever I tell you to do, do you hear me?” Rachel said anxiously to Connor.
“I…”
Connor was about to speak. However, at this moment, Nate walked into the private room. Connor could only shut his mouth.
“Miss Wallace, I’ve already ordered the wine. The waiter will serve it later…” Nate said to Rachel.
“Alright…”
Rachel gently nodded.
Connor looked at Rachel with a helpless expression. Although this was Rachel’s order, Connor still didn’t dare do such a thing.
In fact, under normal circumstances, a beautiful woman like Rachel would take the initiative to make such a request. Any normal man would not be able to find any reason to refuse. Who knew how many men wanted to get a kiss from a top-grade beauty like Rachel? This was simply a good thing that fell from the sky!
After Rachel saw that Connor did not move, she seemed to deliberately lean her body closer to him.
Rachel’s seductive aura instantly surged into Connor’s nostrils.
This kind of aura was very fatal to any man.
Her delicate facial features, alluring figure, and sexy red lips seemed to exude infinite tenderness and temptation.
Connor really could not understand why Rachel would make such a request to him.
At this moment, Connor’s mind was constantly struggling, not knowing what to do. If it was another woman in front of him at this time, Connor might not have any worries at all and directly kiss her.
However, the woman in front of Connor was Rachel!
It could be said that Rachel was the woman that Connor feared the most because her background was too terrifying.
Connor was really worried that if he kissed her, Rachel would find trouble with him in the future.
Just as Connor was wavering, Rachel placed her small hand on Connor’s leg. Her fair and slender fingers gently slid and wrote the words “Kiss me!” Connor’s eyes flashed with a trace of helplessness. He had already felt that Rachel calling him over would not be a good thing. Now, Connor’s guess had finally come true.
Rachel saw that Connor still didn’t have any reaction. She directly pinched him with her fingers and glared at him with her beautiful eyes. It was obvious that she was threatening Connor.
If Connor didn’t do as Rachel said, then she would probably continue to pinch him.
At this moment, Connor felt nothing but regret in his heart. He shouldn’t have agreed to Rachel’s request to pretend to be her pursuer.
If he didn’t agree to Rachel’s request, then there wouldn’t be so many things happening to him.
“I…”
Connor got up and tried to go to the toilet to avoid the situation, but Rachel immediately pinched Connor’s thigh again. Connor’s expression immediately became ugly as he subconsciously looked at Rachel.
Rachel had no intention of letting Connor go. Seeing that he still had no reaction, she continued to increase the strength in her hands.
“What is this woman trying to do!”
The expression on Connor’s face made him look like a broken man. He knew that if he didn’t do as Rachel said, then she would definitely not let him off. Moreover, if Connor didn’t do this, then Rachel’s promise to give him a holiday would be ruined.
“Hah…”
Connor took a deep breath and then turned his head to look at Rachel..

chapters.title: Chapter 771: An Effortless Favor
chapters.content:
Chapter 771: An Effortless Favor
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
After a fierce battle of thoughts, Connor finally decided to do as Rachel said.
Connor slowly turned to look at Rachel beside him. Then, when Nate wasn’t paying attention, he hugged Rachel. Then, he lowered his head and kissed Rachel’s delicate little mouth.
When Nate saw this, a trace of anger flashed in his eyes. He instinctively wanted to stand up.
However, Nate quickly calmed down.
Nate was not a fool. On the contrary, he was very smart.
He could see that Connor and Rachel were pretending. Their goal was to make him give up on Rachel.
Nate knew that he was no match for Connor, so he felt that he might as well do him a favor.
Nate’s family was something in Rachel’s grandfather’s eyes because Nate’s grandfather was a martial artist. The status of a martial artist was not something ordinary people could have.
If Nate’s grandfather weren’t a martial artist, he wouldn’t be qualified to meet Rachel.
Connor and Rachel kissed for almost half a minute before Rachel pushed Connor away forcefully. Then, she pretended to be embarrassed and angry. She stared at Connor and said, “Connor, are you crazy? What are you doing?”
“Rachel, I really like you. I beg you, can you be my girlfriend?” Connor said to Rachel very seriously.
After Rachel heard Connor’s words, she couldn’t help but be stunned. Then, she asked Connor with a pleasantly surprised face, “Are you really sincere? Will you treat me well for the rest of your life?”
“I will.” Connor nodded.
“But… My grandfather asked me to be with Mr. Taylor…”
Rachel looked like she wanted to say something but hesitated. She subconsciously turned to look at Nate.
Nate stood up slowly and said expressionlessly, “Ms. Wallace, since you and Mr. McDonald are in love, I won’t disturb you anymore. I’ll explain the situation to your grandfather. After all, feelings can’t be forced.”
Nate was a nice guy. He knew that he couldn’t get Rachel.
Since he couldn’t get it, he might as well give Connor some face. This way, everyone wouldn’t be embarrassed.
Nate could tell that Rachel was putting up an act with Connor.
However, he also understood Rachel’s character very well. Since Rachel was able to get Connor to kiss her to get rid of the marriage arranged by her grandfather, it was enough to prove how determined Rachel was.
Also, Rachel had always been very arrogant. Now that Rachel could let Connor kiss her, Connor’s position in Rachel’s heart wasn’t just anything.
If he continued to pester her, it would be meaningless.
After Rachel heard Nate’s words, she finally relaxed.
Although Rachel had paid a great price to make Nate let go, she felt it was worth it.
“Thank you for understanding me, Mr. Taylor…” Rachel whispered to Nate.
“No need to thank me. It’s also my honor to witness you find the person she loves with my own eyes…”
Nate smiled faintly and continued, “The dishes have been served. Let’s eat…”
“Yeap!” Connor nodded.
The meal lasted for about half an hour. Nate found an excuse and left.
After Rachel saw Nate leave, she couldn’t help but let out a long sigh of relief. Then, she stretched lazily and said to Connor with a smile, “This is finally settled. I’m so tired…”
Hearing that, Connor could not help but look up at Rachel. After which, he said softly, “Actually, if you want Nate to let go, there’s no need for me to kiss you, right?”
“I didn’t ask you to do this just to chase Nate away. After Nate leaves, he will tell my grandfather about what happened today. My grandfather would know that we are together then. If I don’t act more realistically, my grandfather will guess I’m acting!” Rachel looked at Connor and explained softly.
Connor understood what was going on after hearing Rachel’s words.
It turned out that Connor thought that Rachel wanted him to kiss her to act for Nate, but it was to act for Rachel’s grandfather.
Only by making Rachel’s grandfather give up could Rachel avoid the trouble of going on blind dates in the future.
“What’s wrong? I asked you to kiss me, and you’re not happy about it?” Rachel saw Connor’s reluctant look and asked him with a pout.
“…”
Connor was stunned when he heard Rachel’s words, then he said in a low voice, “It’s not that I’m not happy about it. I’m just worried that you will take revenge on me because of this in the future…”
“Don’t worry, I let you kiss me today. I won’t take revenge on you!” Rachel replied indifferently.
Connor looked at Rachel and asked curiously, “Ms. Wallace, what does your family do?”
“I can’t tell you what my family does now but don’t worry. When you want to deal with Rockefeller in the future, the Wallace Family will be your greatest helper…” Rachel indifferently replied to Connor.
“Since the Wallace Family is so powerful, why would your grandfather like Nate? I don’t think Nate’s background is very powerful.” Connor asked his next question.
“The Taylor Family that Nate is in is not as simple as you think. Nate is only very low-key for some reason. In addition, Nate’s grandfather helped my grandfather back then, so he is the benefactor of the Wallace Family…” Rachel looked at Connor and explained.

chapters.title: Chapter 772: The Second Attack
chapters.content:
Chapter 772: The Second Attack
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
After Connor heard what Rachel said, he nodded thoughtfully.
There were many people in this society who were like Nate.
For example, Nate and Harold. In the eyes of outsiders, Nate’s background was not as good as Harold’s. Naturally, he was not worthy of Rachel.
However, Nate’s Taylor Family was only very low-key because of some external reasons.
In addition, although Nate was in Porthampton, the main force of the Taylor Family was not in Porthampton.
This also made Nate’s background seem inferior to Harold’s.
However, if he angered Nate, it would be very easy for him to deal with Harold.
However, Nate was not willing to waste time on people like Harold. If the matter were blown up, it would significantly impact Nate’s reputation.
From the fact that Nate could take the initiative to cancel the blind date with Rachel, it could be seen that Nate was far more intelligent than Harold.
After inheriting Steven’s inheritance, Connor came into contact with many wealthy heirs. Many of them were rich heirs who were slightly famous in Porthampton.
However, there was still a big gap between these wealthy heirs and Nate, who was born into a big family.
Although many wealthy heirs were arrogant and domineering, they never cared about the consequences.
However, many wealthy heirs were still far more intelligent than average.
“All right, we’re almost done eating. Nate’s matter has also been resolved. I’m in a good mood today. Come and take a walk with me. I heard that the scenery in the Emperor’s Club is quite good. They rebuilt the scene of the imperial palace of the olden days…”
Rachel stretched her back and smiled at Connor.
“Since your matter has been resolved, what about my matter…” Connor asked Rachel with a smile.
“Let’s talk about your problem after you accompany me for a walk…” Rachel replied to Connor indifferently. Then, she took her bag and left the private room.
Connor looked at Rachel’s alluring back, and a trace of helplessness flashed in his eyes.
However, now that Connor had a favor to ask of others, he could only try his best to satisfy Rachel’s request. After all, they had already kissed, so what could going on a walk with Rachel count for?
A few minutes later, Connor followed Rachel into the elevator.
At this moment, there were only Connor and Rachel in the elevator. Connor could smell the faint fragrance on Rachel’s body.
Connor couldn’t help but recall kissing Rachel and the lingerie that Rachel bought previously. After connecting all these things, Connor felt his heart beat faster.
“What are you thinking about?” Rachel saw that Connor’s expression seemed slightly off, so she asked Connor with a faint smile.
“Uhm…” After Connor heard Rachel’s question, he was stunned. He was a little flustered as he said in a low voice, “I’m not thinking about anything…”
“Let me tell you, Connor. I asked you to kiss me in the private room just now because I wanted to put on an act for my grandfather. Don’t think about it the wrong way, understand?” Rachel pointed at Connor as she threatened fiercely.
“Don’t worry. I won’t think about it the wrong way. I have no interest in a woman like you…” Connor replied helplessly. However, when he said the last sentence, he was a little guilty and very speechless.
“Connor, what do you mean by that? What do you mean you’re not interested in a woman like me?” After Rachel heard Connor’s words, a trace of anger flashed in her eyes. She wanted to reason with Connor.
‘Clunk!’ However, as Rachel finished speaking, the elevator suddenly trembled violently and stopped operating.
Then, the lights in the elevator dimmed.
“Ah…” Rachel instinctively screamed.
Connor looked at Rachel beside him and smiled helplessly. Then, he said softly, “It’s just an elevator malfunction. Do you have to overreact?”
Rachel was stunned momentarily. Then she turned to look at Connor. She adjusted her emotions and said softly, “It was just an instinctive reaction. I’m a woman. Why can’t I be afraid…”
Connor looked at Rachel with a faint smile. Sometimes, Rachel, this woman was too domineering.
Therefore, to Connor, Rachel had always been an existence that feared nothing.
“What’s with Emperor’s Club? It hadn’t been long since it opened, and there is already a low-level mistake like an elevator accident?” Rachel subconsciously walked to Connor’s side and asked him in a low voice.
After Connor heard Rachel’s words, he was stunned. Rachel’s words also reminded Connor.
All the things in Emperor’s Club were done by Thomas alone. Connor was very clear about Thomas’s character. Thomas had always been very cautious. Moreover, Emperor’s Club had just opened not long ago, so Connor felt that the elevator in Emperor’s Club should not have such a low-level mistake.
At this moment, it was pitch black in the elevator. Rachel subconsciously took out her phone and lit up the surroundings.
“Could it be a blackout? It can’t be that the elevator is broken, right?” Rachel whispered to Connor.
Hearing that, doubt flashed in Connor’s eyes. Then, he said expressionlessly, “If there’s a blackout, that’s better. I’m worried that it’s not a blackout….”
“Are you saying this was not an accident, but someone did it intentionally?” Rachel was a brilliant woman. She instantly understood what Connor meant.
“Do you know why I want to learn martial arts from Jorge?” Connor asked Rachel in a low voice.
“Why?” Rachel asked softly.
“Some time ago, the people from Rockefeller found some hitmen to attack me, so I suspect this is the second time they are attempting an attack…” Connor replied to Rachel in a low voice.
A strange look flashed in Rachel’s eyes.
After hesitating, Connor walked to the elevator’s control panel and found the distress button. Then, he gently pressed it.
The security of the Emperor’s Club had always been excellent. Under normal circumstances, if someone pressed the distress button, they could contact the club staff directly and get someone to deal with the problem.
‘Beep, beep, beep…’ However, at this moment, a blind tone came from the communication channel!

chapters.title: Chapter 773: Rachel Being Shy
chapters.content:
Chapter 773: Rachel Being Shy
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
After Connor and Rachel heard that, their expressions became solemn.
Although Connor had pressed the button for help, there was still no response from the communication box.
Therefore, there were only two possibilities. The first possibility was that no one was in the control room.
However, the Emperor’s Club was still open for business, so there couldn’t be no one on duty.
There was also the fact that high-end places like the Emperor’s Club usually did not have a power outage.
Even if there were a power outage, the Emperor’s Club would have emergency measures.
Under normal circumstances, there should be a complete power generation system in the clubhouse’s basement.
Therefore, Connor ruled out the first possibility.
Then, there was only the second possibility. Someone first destroyed the communication between the elevator and the control room and then turned off the main gate of the elevator.
They wanted to trap Connor and Rachel in the elevator.
Connor glanced at his phone and found that there was no signal at all.
Therefore, he hurriedly turned to Rachel and asked, “Ms. Wallace, do you have a signal on your phone?”
Rachel glanced at her phone and shook her head at Connor helplessly.
Under normal circumstances, even if the elevator malfunctioned, there would still be a reception in the elevator.
At this moment, the elevator was broken. No one was in the control room, and there was no signal on the phone.
All of these meant that something was wrong.
Connor and Rachel being trapped in the elevator was not an accident.
“Looks like someone wants to attack the two of us. It is not safe to be with someone like you…”
Rachel turned to look at Connor and could not help but sigh softly.
“Ms. Wallace, don’t worry. I will protect you…” Connor said lightly.
“Nonsense! I’m a woman, and you’re a man. If you don’t protect me, who will?” Rachel couldn’t help but roll her eyes at Connor as she pouted.
“Uhm…”
Hearing that, a trace of helplessness flashed in Connor’s eyes. He did not know what to say.
“What should we do now?” Rachel asked Connor.
Hearing Rachel’s question, Connor was stumped. Then, he asked expressionlessly, “What do you think a normal person would do?”
“…”
Rachel hesitated, then slowly looked up at the top of the elevator and said, “Under normal circumstances, I think we can get out from the top. After all, we can’t wait here forever!”
“The hitman must have thought of this situation…” In a low voice, Connor replied to Rachel and continued, “The other party sabotaged the elevator on purpose to force us to panic. We would choose to go out from the top of the elevator. If I’m not wrong, the hitman should be waiting for us on the elevator now!”
Rachel sized Connor up and said, “What if the killer enters the elevator and attacks us?”
“No, the elevator is so dark. The killer will enter from the top if he enters the elevator. In that case, he will be in a very dangerous situation, so he doesn’t dare to enter the elevator rashly. The people in the Emperor’s Club are all my people. The killer cannot collude with the people in the Emperor’s Club. Once the club members discover a problem with the elevator, someone will come and deal with it.” Connor looked at Rachel and analyzed.
Rachel looked at Connor and was stunned for a moment. Then, she smiled and said, “I didn’t expect you to be quite smart…”
“I’ve always been quite smart…” Connor replied indifferently and continued, “Therefore, the best way for the two of us now is to respond to all changes without changing!”
“All right then. In any case, if there is any danger, you must protect me…” Rachel said absent-mindedly.
“Don’t worry. If anything happens, I’ll protect you!” Connor nodded lightly.
“That’s more like it…” Rachel said indifferently.
Connor turned and looked at Rachel, then said with a smile, “Ms. Wallace, since we have nothing to do, why don’t we chat?”
“Chat?” Rachel was stunned momentarily, then asked, “What do you want to talk about?”
“There’s actually something that I’ve always been curious about. You’re so pretty and come from such a good family, so you shouldn’t have problems finding a boyfriend, right?” Connor asked Rachel.
“That’s right. Many people are pursuing me…” Rachel looked at Connor and lightly nodded.
“I don’t understand. Why did you still buy that kind of thing?” Connor hesitated and asked the question that had been bothering him.
“What?” Rachel looked at Connor with a puzzled expression.
“Don’t play dumb with me. Don’t you know what I’m talking about? It’s the thing in your express delivery yesterday…” Connor replied helplessly.
Although the lights in the elevator were very dim, Connor could still see that Rachel’s face suddenly turned red after hearing his words.
Rachel stepped forward and shouted, “Connor, do you really think I bought that thing? Am I that kind of woman in your eyes?”
“I don’t think you bought it, but I don’t understand. Since you didn’t buy it, why did that thing appear in your parcel?” Connor replied in a low voice.
“You…” A trace of anger flashed in Rachel’s eyes. Then, she said loudly, “I didn’t buy that thing at all. It’s just that I often buy underwear in that lingerie store. The owner of the store had a surprise event at some point. He said it was to give back to his old customers. I’m a regular customer of that lingerie store, so he gave me a small gift. Although I knew that the lingerie store would give gifts, I didn’t expect it to be this kind of thing. Besides… for you to just happened to see it…”
Connor could see that when Rachel said this, her pretty face had already turned red to her ears, and her eyes were also very angry.
“Really?” Connor asked.
“Nonsense, of course, I’m telling the truth. Moreover, you said it just now. If I wanted to… There are a lot of handsome guys for me to pick from. Why would I buy that kind of thing…” Rachel gritted her teeth and whispered angrily to Connor.

chapters.title: Chapter 774: Why Are You More Cowardly Than Me?
chapters.content:
Chapter 774: Why Are You More Cowardly Than Me?
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Rachel had been conflicted for a long time because of the thing in the express delivery.
She could not understand why such a thing was in her express delivery.
However, after Rachel contacted the staff of the lingerie store, she found out what was going on.
Originally, Rachel was planning to find Connor to explain it properly, but Rachel felt that if she explained now, it would seem like she was trying to hide something.
Therefore, she did not take the initiative to explain anything to Connor.
“Haha…” After Connor listened to Rachel’s explanation, he looked at Rachel and smiled faintly, not saying anything.
“You still don’t believe me, do you?” Rachel saw Connor’s reaction and asked agitatedly.
“It’s not that I don’t believe you…” Connor replied helplessly.
“Since you believe me, why are you laughing? You know, this reaction shows you don’t believe me.”
Rachel took a deep breath, opened the Amazon app, and handed the phone to Connor, shouting, “If you don’t believe me, you can look at my Amazon order history…”
“There’s no signal here. What can I see…?” Connor said with a smile.
“You…” Rachel looked at Connor with a trace of helplessness in her eyes. She frowned and said loudly, “Since you put it this way, you don’t believe me…”
“I believe you. How can I not? After all, you’re my lecturer!” Connor said with a smile.
“…”
Rachel turned and glared at Connor, not wanting to continue talking to him.
At the same time, at the top of the elevator.
A man held his breath and looked at the elevator as if waiting for something.
Just as Connor had guessed, the man squatting at the top of the elevator was the one who stopped the elevator service. He was also an internationally famous hitman.
He first cut off the connection between the elevator and the control room, then ran to the elevator. After Connor entered the elevator, he switched off the power of the elevator.
This was not the first time the hitman had done something like this. His control of time was very precise.
He deliberately stuck the elevator between the fourth and fifth floors. This way, even if Connor wanted to open the elevator forcefully, he could not leave.
If Connor wanted to leave the elevator now, there was only one choice: to come out from the top.
But what the hitman never expected was that Connor and Rachel would be so calm.
After experiencing the elevator malfunction, they chatted in the elevator. They had no intention of leaving the elevator at all.
This made the hitman anxious!
But now, the hitman had another way: to cut the elevator rope and kill Connor in the elevator.
However, the hitman knew that the elevator in Emperor’s Club had a buffer device. Even if he broke the elevator rope now, he could not kill Connor.
Moreover, if he acted rashly, he would be in danger and might even be caught by the security guards.
That was why the hitman was so anxious now.
‘Thump thump thump…’ At this moment, hurried footsteps sounded.
A strange look flashed in his eyes when the hitman heard the footsteps.
He knew that it was probably the staff of Emperor’s Club who had come to repair the elevator after discovering it was malfunctioning.
The hitman hesitated before getting up and leaving the elevator’s top.
Not long after the hitman left, the maintenance staff walked into the control room, checked briefly, and restarted the elevator.
The lights in the elevator lit up.
Rachel and Connor heaved a sigh of relief when they saw the lights in the elevator turn on.
“Let’s go out…” Connor softly said to Rachel.
“Finally…” Rachel replied lightly and walked out of the elevator.
When Connor Rachel walked out of the elevator, the staff of Emperor’s Club was waiting anxiously outside.
When Miss Carver, who had received Connor before, saw Connor come out, a trace of excitement flashed in her eyes.
She hurriedly ran to Connor and greeted him excitedly, “Mr. McDonald, I’m so sorry. It was our clubhouse staff’s fault for trapping you in the elevator. I apologize on behalf of all the staff…”
“It’s okay. This has nothing to do with you!”
Connor looked at Miss Carver indifferently, then led Rachel out of Emperor’s Club.
After Connor and Rachel left Emperor’s Club, Rachel seemed to be in a very good mood. She couldn’t help but cheer, “I’m finally out of that damned elevator…”
After saying this, Rachel could not help but stretch and feel the fresh air outside.
Stretching her back, Rachel’s figure was exceptionally attractive. Her full chest, slender waist, round buttocks, and slender, fair legs gave off an irresistible charm.
Unfortunately, Rachel’s personality was too strong, and her identity and background were very mysterious, so Connor felt it was not good to be too close to this woman.
“Connor, what are you still standing there for? Let’s go for a walk…” Rachel turned to look at Connor and urged him.
Connor was surprised. He frowned and said, “You still have the mood to go for a walk? Don’t you know that some hitmen want to attack the two of us?”
“Didn’t you say you could protect me? With you protecting me, what do I have to be afraid of…” Rachel indifferently replied to Connor.
Hearing that, Connor was rendered speechless. Then, he said in a low voice, “Ms. Wallace, let’s go back to school quickly. That hitman is very likely to be hired by Rockefeller’s people. It’s very dangerous…”
“There’s no point in not going back!” Rachel lightly shook her head. After which, she looked at Connor and continued, “That hitman just failed. He definitely doesn’t have the guts to attack us again. Besides, even as a girl, I’m not afraid. Why are you less courageous than me?”
“…”
Connor looked at Rachel, not knowing what to say.
“Stop talking nonsense. Quickly follow me…” Rachel said as she dragged Connor with her.
Connor couldn’t do anything to Rachel. So he followed Rachel and walked into the distance.

chapters.title: Chapter 775: Rachel Wants A Kiss
chapters.content:
Chapter 775: Rachel Wants A Kiss
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Connor followed Rachel to a garden behind Emperor’s Club.
There weren’t many people in the garden, but the scenery was beautiful.
After all, those who could come to Emperor’s Club were here for dinner and socializing. Very few people would come to such a place to hang around.
After Rachel took two steps, she took a lollipop from her bag and started eating it.
After Connor saw Rachel eat the lollipop, he was a little shocked. Then, she asked softly, “Ms. Wallace, do you like lollipops?”
“Yeah, why not?” Rachel nodded.
“Why haven’t I seen you eating it at school?” Connor asked in confusion.
“Of course. I’m your lecturer in school. There are so many students looking at me. How can I eat this kind of thing?” Rachel somewhat helplessly rolled her eyes at Connor.
“Is there any more? Let me try it…” Connor said with a smile.
When Rachel heard Connor’s words, she was surprised. Then, she took out the lollipop in her mouth and handed it to Connor. She said softly, “Just this one. Do you want it or not…”
“Uhm…”
Seeing Rachel’s offer, Connor was stunned and very speechless.
“What’s with that expression? Do you think I’m dirty?” Rachel asked Connor.
“Well, I feel that…” Connor looked at Rachel and tried to explain.
“You just think I’m dirty. Why didn’t you think I was dirty when you kissed me?” Rachel asked Connor with a sad expression.
At this moment, Connor was very regretful. He regretted asking Rachel for a lollipop. They wouldn’t even be having this conversation right now if he hadn’t.
“Well, Ms. Wallace, I don’t think eating what you’ve eaten before is good for me. I think I won’t have it. You can have it for yourself…” Connor said to Rachel helplessly.
He felt that eating the lollipop that Rachel had eaten before was overreaching, so he rejected it.
“Humph…” Rachel looked at Connor and snorted coldly, then popped the lollipop back into her mouth.
A few minutes later, Rachel and Connor walked to a bench.
Rachel turned and said to Connor, “Let’s go and sit down.”
“It’s getting late. Why don’t we go back?” Connor vaguely felt that something was wrong, so he suggested that.
“What time is it now? Why are you in such a hurry to go back? Sit with me for a bit. It’s rare for me to be in such a good mood today…” Rachel said as she dragged Connor over and sat on the bench.
After hesitating, Connor could only sit beside Rachel.
Rachel gently stretched her back, then turned and softly asked, “Connor, how do you plan to deal with Rockefeller in the future?”
“I haven’t considered it yet…” Connor was stumped momentarily before he looked at Rachel and shook his head gently.
“What kind of situation is this? You still haven’t considered these questions…” Rachel said to Connor with a helpless expression.
“The information I have now is too little, so I haven’t thought about how to deal with those people from Rockefeller. I plan to think about these things after I become a martial artist…” Connor said lightly.
“Ah!” Rachel nodded. After which, she turned and carefully sized up Connor. She softly said, “Connor, I heard you’re quite lucky with women…”
“It’s all right…” Connor replied indifferently.
“How many girlfriends do you have now?” Rachel looked at Connor and continued to ask.
“Ms. Wallace, can we not talk about this?” Connor replied helplessly.
“Fine, then we won’t…” Rachel looked at Connor and snorted coldly. Then, she pouted and looked at the scenery in the distance.
Connor hesitated when he heard Rachel speak. He took out his phone and was ready to play a game.
When Rachel saw Connor take out his phone, she reached out and snatched it from Connor. She frowned and shouted, “Connor, I asked you to come out today so you could accompany me to relax, not play with your phone. I’m such a beautiful woman sitting beside you, and you still want to play with your phone.”
“Ms. Wallace, you’re just sitting there and not saying anything. I have nothing to do now, so what’s wrong with playing with my phone?” Connor asked helplessly.
“…”
Rachel was speechless for a moment. Then, she smiled and said, “You have nothing to do?”
“You’re sitting in a daze and not talking to me. What do you want me to do?” Connor asked with a frown.
Rachel looked at Connor and hesitated. Then, she smiled at Connor and said, “How about this? I’ll find something for you to do now. What do you think?”
“You want to find something for me to do?” Connor subconsciously looked at Rachel’s position.
Connor could see a trace of something weird in Rachel’s seductive gaze.
He could feel that Rachel’s expression was bizarre when she said this, but he didn’t know what it was.
“What is it?” Connor hesitated before asking Rachel.
Rachel was quick to answer Connor’s question. Instead, she looked at Connor with a faint smile and then took the initiative to move toward Connor.
Connor looked at Rachel, his eyes filled with puzzlement.
In the next second, Rachel raised her pretty face in his direction and slowly closed her eyes.
Connor was shocked by Rachel’s action.
Even a fool could see what Rachel’s action meant at this moment!
When a woman took the initiative to do this, she wanted the man to kiss her!
Connor stared at Rachel with his eyes widened and unusually shocked.
He really could not understand why Rachel would do this!
Rachel was too strange today!
“Could Ms. Wallace have fallen in love with me?” A bold idea suddenly flashed through Connor’s mind. This idea shocked Connor himself.
“That can’t be. How could a woman like Rachel like me? But why is she doing this if she doesn’t like me?” Connor looked at Rachel’s expression and was puzzled.

chapters.title: Chapter 776: The Hidden Killer
chapters.content:
Chapter 776: The Hidden Killer
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Seeing Rachel lift her face as if asking for a kiss, Connor was instantly dumbfounded.
He really could not understand what was going on!
Because Rachel was acting really odd today.
She had asked him to kiss her in the private room of the Emperor’s Club.
But that time, it was just an act. But now, there was no one here.
Rachel was actually doing such a strange thing again. It just did not make sense.
For a moment, Connor did not know what he should do.
If he really kissed her, Connor would still be a little afraid.
However, if he didn’t kiss her, Connor was worried that it would be awkward for Rachel.
Just as Connor was hesitating, Rachel suddenly opened her eyes. There was a trace of anger in her eyes as she asked him, “Connor, why didn’t you kiss me just now?”
“Why would I kiss you?”
Connor pretended not to know what was going on and whispered back to Rachel.
“Are you stupid? I closed my eyes just now to let you kiss me. Don’t you know that?”
Rachel fiercely glared at Connor.
“I don’t…”
Connor shook his head.
“So you know now, right? Kiss me now…”
Rachel closed her eyes as she spoke.
“Miss, stop fooling around. I’m your student. Why would I kiss you?”
Connor whispered to Rachel.
“So you don’t want to kiss me, right?”
Rachel asked Connor softly.
“It’s not that I don’t want to kiss you, but we’re not lovers. Why would I kiss you?”
Connor whispered.
At this moment, Connor was speaking from the bottom of his heart. After all, no man could resist the temptation of such a sexy beauty like Rachel. Naturally, Connor was the same.
He still couldn’t forget the feeling of kissing Rachel in the private room.
However, Connor felt that Rachel asking him to kiss her now was definitely not as simple as tempting him.
“Hmph, you barely passed my test!”
Rachel lightly rolled her eyes at Connor.
“Test?”
When Connor heard Rachel’s words, he could not help but be stunned for a moment. He was very puzzled.
“That’s right. That was my test for you just now…”
Rachel gently nodded.
“What test? Miss, what are you talking about?”
Connor frowned and asked Rachel.
“I just wanted to test you to see if you really like me. I’m very satisfied with your performance. Connor, I have to warn you, you must not have any feelings for me. Otherwise, both of us will be in great danger.”
Rachel looked at Connor with a very serious facial expression.
Connor looked at Rachel in confusion and asked, “Miss Wallace. When did I say that I like you?”
“You don’t like me now, but that doesn’t mean you won’t like me in the future. I’m just giving you a gentle reminder. You might not understand what I mean now, but you’ll understand sooner or later…”
Rachel replied indifferently. Then, she straightened her clothes and stood up. She said softly, “Alright, come back with me…”
Although Connor didn’t know what Rachel’s words meant, knowing that she wanted to go back, he finally let out a long sigh of relief. Then, he slowly stood up.
However, just as Connor was about to get up, he suddenly heard an ear-piercing wind sound.
Perhaps it was because he often fought with Jabba, Connor’s reaction speed was very fast. He could feel that something was flying toward him.
Although Connor didn’t know what was going on, his instincts told him that there was danger.
Connor subconsciously hugged Rachel’s soft waist, and then directly pushed her to the ground.
“Ah…”
Rachel called out instinctively.
In the next second, a sharp dagger flew past Connor’s arm.
Although Connor’s reaction speed was very fast, because he had to pounce toward Rachel, the dagger still cut his arm, and blood immediately flowed out.
After he felt the pain on his arm, he knew that he was right.
Therefore, he dragged Rachel and hid behind the bench.
Rachel was stunned for a moment, then she turned to look at Connor. Then, she noticed the wound on his arm.
“Connor, you’re bleeding…”
Rachel whispered to Connor.
“I’m fine. It’s just a scratch…”
Connor said placidly.
“…”
Rachel looked at him without saying anything.
Connor took a deep breath and then looked at the dagger on the ground.
Connor knew that he was not a match for the killer with his bare hands.
Therefore, he instinctively wanted to go over and pick up the dagger on the ground.
Rachel was also very calm, so calm that Connor felt that it was somewhat unbelievable.
If it was an ordinary woman, she would definitely be scared out of her wits in such a situation.
However, Rachel didn’t even look anxious. She stood quietly behind Connor, not saying a word.
However, Connor was not in the mood to care about that. He whispered to Rachel, “No matter what happens later, don’t move, you understand?”
Rachel couldn’t help but laugh when she heard Connor’s words.
“Why are you laughing…”
Connor looked at Rachel and was extremely speechless.
“Don’t worry, I won’t move…”
Rachel gently nodded.
Connor took a deep breath and wanted to pick up the dagger on the ground.
However, at this moment, a cold light flashed!
A sharp dagger flew toward Connor’s arm again.
Fortunately, Connor’s reaction speed was relatively fast as he withdrew his arm. Otherwise, the dagger might have pierced through his arm.
However, Connor could also determine the approximate location of the assassin from the direction the dagger flew from.
Connor became solemn. He could feel that this assassin was very powerful.
Connor was no match for this killer, not to mention that he had a burden by his side.
If Connor was alone, he could escape.
But if Connor ran away, then what about Rachel?
At this moment, Connor was in a very dangerous situation. For a moment, he did not know what to do!
And Rachel still had a nonchalant look as she smiled at him.

chapters.title: Chapter 777: Who Sent You?
chapters.content:
Chapter 777: Who Sent You?
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
When Connor saw the heartless smile on Rachel’s face, he felt very helpless.
He felt that at this moment, Rachel did not realize the seriousness of the problem at all. Otherwise, she would definitely not be in this state.
However, Connor was not in the mood to pay attention to Rachel now.
He took a deep breath and used the Chi Observation Technique that Jorge Yarrell had taught him to determine the assassin’s current location.
Jorge had taught Connor the Chi Observation Technique. Not only could it determine a person’s strength, but it could also determine the person’s location.
At this moment, the surroundings were pitch-black. Coupled with the problem of the angle, Connor could not see where the other party was at all.
Therefore, the method of observing chi was the most effective and useful method.
Connor could feel that the killer’s movement speed was not very fast.
However, he was slowly approaching where he and Rachel were, which meant that this killer was still very cautious.
Connor took a deep breath and focused his attention on the killer’s exact location.
Once the killer got close to Connor’s attack range, Connor would attack.
Five meters!
Three meters!
Two meters!
When Connor felt that the distance was about right, he directly exerted strength in his calves and rushed toward the assassin.
At this moment, Connor knew that he had to get rid of the assassin before he could react.
Otherwise, it would be impossible for Connor to take Rachel away from this place.
When Connor got up, he realized that the assassin was not strong. Instead, he was a little thin and weak, holding two daggers in his hands.
When the assassin saw Connor appear, he did not hesitate at all and directly threw out the daggers in his hands!
However, this assassin was way too confident in his own strength as the daggers were not both locked onto Connor; one was locked onto Rachel.
The information that the assassin had obtained stated that Connor was just an ordinary person.
Therefore, when he attacked, he treated Connor as an ordinary person.
But at this time, Connor’s speed had already far exceeded the range of ordinary people. The assassin’s first dagger naturally did not hit Connor.
However, the other dagger was locked onto Rachel.
When Rachel saw the dagger flying toward her, a strange look flashed across her eyes.
Connor cried out in his heart. He never thought that this assassin could lock onto two targets at the same time.
Therefore, Connor instantly gave up the best opportunity to defeat the assassin and turned around to pounce on Rachel.
Connor placed himself in front of Rachel.
The dagger hit Connor!
At this moment, Rachel was squatting beside the chair.
Because of the angle, although the assassin’s dagger was flying toward Rachel’s head, the angle of the dagger was too low.
Therefore, when Connor moved in front of Rachel, the dagger did not hit Connor’s vital points. Instead, it stabbed Connor’s thigh near his buttocks.
Connor couldn’t help but suck in a breath of cold air. His face turned pale, and blood slowly flowed down his pants.
When the killer saw this scene, he was a little shocked, and his eyes were filled with disbelief.
This assassin was considerably famous both locally and abroad. He was very skilled and liked to use throwing knives.
Over the years, countless people had died under his throwing knives.
The assassin had also investigated Connor in detail before. He felt that Connor was just an ordinary person, so it would be very easy for him to kill Connor.
However, the killer never expected Connor to be so terrifying and able to react so quickly.
Just now when the second dagger flew toward Rachel, Connor was actually able to react in such a short period of time. This was indeed somewhat inconceivable.
“Looks like I have underestimated you…”
The assassin looked at Connor and could not help but sigh softly.
However, there was no fear in the killer’s eyes. Instead, he was very calm.
Because he knew that Connor’s thigh was seriously injured. No matter how powerful Connor was, it didn’t matter.
If he wanted to kill Connor now, it would be a piece of cake!
“Kid, I didn’t expect you to be so powerful. But no matter how powerful you are, you must die here today. As long as you die, I will have completed my mission…”
The assassin looked at Connor’s position and revealed a very cruel smile.
Connor looked at the assassin coldly, then asked the assassin expressionlessly, “Who sent you here?”
“Does it have anything to do with you?”
The killer sneered.
Connor slowly moved his right leg. Although his right leg was injured, it did not affect his movement.
“I advise you not to move!”
When the assassin saw that Connor wanted to move, he shouted at Connor expressionlessly and continued, “I know that you have some skills, and your speed is also very fast. However, don’t forget that there is a woman behind you. If you dare to move again, I will kill the woman behind you…”
When Connor heard the killer’s words, he subconsciously turned to look at Rachel. He was very helpless.
If it wasn’t for Rachel, Connor would definitely have a way to get rid of this killer.
However, Rachel was still behind Connor. If Connor ran away, then she would definitely die.
“Your mission this time should be me. It has nothing to do with her, so I’ll stay. Can you let her go?”
Connor hesitated for a moment before shouting at the killer in a low voice.
The killer looked at Connor up and down and said expressionlessly, “Hehe, I did not expect you to be so loyal. This woman is indeed not my target. Her life and death have nothing to do with me. However, this woman has already seen my appearance. Moreover, she knows that I was the one who attacked you. Therefore, if this woman does not die, I will also be in great danger. I cannot agree to your request…”
Connor took a deep breath, then looked at the assassin and continued to ask, “Then, can you give me a quick death and tell me who sent you to kill me?”
“I have no comment on this either…”
The assassin looked at Connor and shook his head. Then, he said expressionlessly, “I am an assassin of an international organization. The missions I receive are all assigned to me by my superiors, so I only know who I have to kill, but I don’t know who wants to kill you!”

chapters.title: Chapter 778: In Danger
chapters.content:
Chapter 778: In Danger
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Connor looked at the killer in front of him, and a hint of helplessness flashed across his eyes.
Connor and Rachel were in a desperate situation.
Connor’s right leg was injured. Although it didn’t hurt his artery, it would still affect his movement speed.
Moreover, Connor still had to protect Rachel.
Therefore, even if he could escape from the hands of the killer, Rachel would still have to die.
In Connor’s eyes, Rachel was a woman without the strength to even tie up a chicken. There was no way he could leave her here and abandon her.
“Kid, I know you’re deliberately stalling for time, but I’ve already investigated. Your bodyguard isn’t around. No one can save you now, so you’d better know your place. That way, you can suffer less…”
The assassin smiled and said to Connor.
The killer knew Connor’s situation very well. He knew that Connor had a very powerful martial artist following him all the time. This was also the reason why the killer had never made a move on Connor. It was because the killer was worried that he was not a match for Connor’s bodyguard. Instead, doing so would alert the enemy.
However, it was different in the Emperor’s Club!
Carlos Lane thought that since the Emperor’s Club was Thomas Morgan’s club and everyone in it was Thomas’s men, no one would dare to lay a hand on Connor.
Naturally, Carlos did not follow them in.
The killer seized the opportunity when Carlos was not around to attack Connor.
Connor stretched out his hand and touched his clothes. He had the pill that Jorge Yarrell had given him.
Although Connor did not know what this medicinal pill was and what would happen if he ate it, Jorge had said that if Connor was in danger, he could take this pill. This would save his life.
This pill was originally meant to be used when Connor went to Medicine Kings’ Valley.
But at this time, Connor was already at his wits’ end.
He could only place all his hopes on this pill.
“Alright, kid, I won’t talk nonsense with you anymore. Go to hell!”
At this moment, the assassin looked at Connor and roared, then he slowly raised his right hand.
The assassin was holding a cold dagger in his hand. As long as the assassin gently waved his hand, Connor would die on the spot.
If Connor dodged, the person who would die would most likely be Rachel, who was behind Connor.
When Connor saw the assassin take out the dagger, he hurriedly took out the pill from his clothes and was about to throw it into his mouth.
However, the killer’s reaction speed was faster. When he saw Connor’s action, he hurriedly waved his hand and stabbed toward Connor’s neck.
Whoosh!
However, at this critical moment, another dagger flew out from behind Connor.
The two daggers collided, and the assassin’s dagger was sent flying.
However, the dagger that flew out from behind Connor did not stop at all. It flew directly toward the assassin.
Connor and the assassin didn’t even have time to react to what was going on!
The dagger stabbed into the killer’s chest with extreme precision, and blood gushed out.
The assassin did not expect a dagger to fly out from behind Connor, so he was extremely surprised.
The assassin stared at Connor with disbelief and shock.
The figure of a mature beauty was reflected in the killer’s pupils!
Connor stood there foolishly with an extremely shocked expression on his face. He had no idea what was going on!
It was not until Connor saw the killer fall to the ground that he subconsciously turned around to look behind him.
At this moment, there was a tall and mature beauty standing behind Connor. This beauty was none other than Rachel, who was behind Connor!
Connor stared at Rachel behind him with an incredulous expression.
“It’s been so long since I made a move. Fortunately, my cultivation hasn’t regressed!”
Rachel looked at Connor with a faint smile.
Connor looked at Rachel and could not help but gape.
After a long time, he stuttered and asked Rachel, “Did you kill this person?”
“That’s right, I killed him!”
Rachel gently nodded; her expression still very calm.
“You’re actually so strong? Are you also a martial artist?”
At this moment, Connor finally reacted. What exactly was going on? He widened his eyes and shouted.
“That’s right, I’m also a martial artist!”
Rachel gently nodded.
Connor stared at Rachel, not knowing how to describe his current mood.
Now, Connor knew that Rachel was also a martial artist. Moreover, through the way she killed the assassin, Connor could feel that she was definitely stronger than him.
“Since you’re a martial artist, why didn’t you tell me?”
Connor shouted excitedly with his eyes wide open.
“You didn’t ask me, did you?”
Rachel said placidly.
Connor looked at the expression on Rachel’s face and was unusually speechless. He didn’t even know what to say now.
If Connor had known earlier that Rachel was so capable, then he wouldn’t have rushed over to block the dagger for her.
He had never thought that Rachel, who looked weak on the surface, would actually have such terrifying skills. Moreover, she was also a martial artist.
At this moment, Connor finally understood why Rachel’s background was so terrifying!
Rachel was actually a martial artist!
“Since you’re so strong, why didn’t you tell me earlier? You even let me take the dagger for you. My thigh is still bleeding!”
Connor shouted at Rachel in despair.
“I wanted to dodge, but you were the one who wanted to block it for me. What could I have done?”
Rachel looked at Connor with a faint smile and then continued, “However, I also know from what happened just now that you are a very trustworthy ally. In such a dangerous situation, you were actually able to help me block that dagger. I’m very touched…”
Connor looked at Rachel and sighed. Then, he said helplessly, “Alright, I’m not in the mood to discuss this with you now. Now that you’ve killed this person, what are you going to do next?”
“This person was a professional assassin. Now that he died in your club, you should have a way to deal with this person, right?”
Rachel said with a smile.
When Connor heard Rachel’s words, he couldn’t help but be stunned. Then he took out his phone and dialed Kyle Hayes’s number.

chapters.title: Chapter 779: Who is Rachel Wallace?
chapters.content:
Chapter 779: Who is Rachel Wallace?
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Connor knew that Kyle was a gangster in Porthampton.
Therefore, it was the most appropriate for Kyle to deal with the corpse.
Connor briefly explained the situation to Kyle and then hung up the phone.
This was the Emperor’s Club, and the person who was going to handle the body was Kyle, so Connor felt that there wouldn’t be any big problems.
“What should we do next?”
Connor asked Rachel softly after the call.
Rachel looked at Connor indifferently and said expressionlessly, “This killer should have an accomplice outside. It won’t be long before his accomplice finds out that this person is dead. Sp, this place isn’t safe. Let’s leave for now…”
“Where to?”
Connor looked down at his thigh and asked helplessly.
“You can’t go to the hospital yet. There are too many people in the hospital. If the killer finds the hospital, both of us will be in danger. Also, you can’t go to your house. Since the other party was able to find this place, it means that they know where you live. So, you should come with me to my dormitory. My dormitory should be safer than your house…”
Rachel looked at Connor and analyzed softly.
“Then, what about my leg?”
Connor lowered his head and glanced at his thigh as he replied.
“You’re a man. Why are you so wishy-washy? What’s this small injury?”
Rachel couldn’t help but roll her eyes at Connor. Then, she walked forward in her high heels.
Connor looked at Rachel’s back with an extremely helpless expression on his face. He could not help but say in a low voice, “That’s easy for you to say. You’re not the one who’s injured. You can say whatever you want…”
Although Connor said so, he knew that what Rachel said was very reasonable. The safest place now was her dormitory.
Therefore, Connor could only choose to leave the Emperor’s Club with Rachel.
Half an hour later.
Connor dragged his injured leg and followed Rachel back to the Porthampton University. Then, he went to Rachel’s dormitory.
After entering the dorm, he sat on the sofa with a pained expression.
At this time, Connor’s leg and arm had been cut by daggers. Although Rachel helped Connor stop the bleeding in the taxi just now, he was still injured.
Even though the bleeding had stopped, Connor’s right leg was still in great pain.
Along the way, Connor had already scolded Rachel over a thousand times.
If not for Rachel, Connor would not have suffered such heavy injuries at all.
“Rest here for a while. I’ll go find some medicine for you…”
After entering the dormitory, Rachel left Connor there and then rummaged through the living room.
A few minutes later, Rachel found a small bottle and some bandages.
Connor’s arm was fine. It was just a simple cut, so it did not need to be bandaged. The most serious injury was Connor’s right leg.
The dagger had cut a few-centimeters-deep wound on Connor’s thigh. If it was not bandaged in time, it was very likely to worsen.
“Take off your pants…”
Rachel walked to Connor and said softly to him.
When Connor heard Rachel’s words, he could not help but be stunned for a moment. Then, he suddenly raised his head to look at Rachel and asked with a puzzled expression, “Miss, what did you say?”
“I said, take off your pants…”
Rachel sat beside Connor as she spoke.
“Um, Miss Wallace, isn’t it a bit inappropriate for us to do this? We’re alone, and you’re asking me to take off my pants as soon as we enter the place. I’m not the kind of person you think I am…”
Connor said helplessly to Rachel.
“Why are you talking so much nonsense? I asked you to take off your pants so that I can bandage your wound…”
Rachel rolled her eyes at Connor and threw the bandage on the sofa.
“Even if you want to bandage my wound, I don’t have to take off my pants, right?”
Connor was stunned for a moment and then said helplessly.
“Don’t you know where your wound is? If you don’t take off your pants, how can I dress your wound for you?”
Rachel replied impatiently.
Connor looked at Rachel, and he seemed to still be somewhat hesitant.
After all, there were only him and Rachel in this room.
If he were to take off his pants, that would make things look dubious.
Moreover, Connor had to take off his pants in front of Rachel. Connor would more or less be a little embarrassed.
Therefore, after hesitating for a moment, Connor continued, “Miss Wallace, I can dress the wound myself. You don’t have to help me…”
“Are you sure you can do it yourself?”
Rachel asked Connor softly.
“I’m sure!”
Connor nodded.
“Alright then. You dress the wound yourself. I’ll go take a shower…”
Seeing that Connor insisted on bandaging himself, she didn’t say anything.
She immediately agreed and turned around to walk toward the bathroom.
Seeing Rachel leave, he lowered his head to look at the medicine bottle in front of him. Then, he frowned and shouted, Miss Wallace, what medicine is this? Why haven’t I seen this kind of drug before? Is it poisonous?”
“…”
Rachel turned to look at Connor, then said with an unhappy expression, “Why are you talking so much nonsense? This is the Golden Healer passed down in our family. Ordinary people don’t even have the chance to use it. This small injury of yours will heal in less than two days. Don’t worry, it won’t harm you…”
After saying this, Rachel walked into the bathroom.
Connor looked at the medicine bottle on the table and could not help but hesitate.
He felt that he was injured today because he saved Rachel. As long as she had a conscience, she would not harm him.
In the end, he took off his pants and applied the ointment evenly on his wound.
Although Connor could clearly feel a stinging sensation when he first applied it, he could not help but feel the pain.
However, he soon felt a cooling sensation from the wound, and the pain from before had obviously eased a lot.
“Is this medicine really so magical?”
Connor could not help but sigh softly. Then, he took the bandage and bandaged his wound.
After bandaging the wound, Connor slowly stood up and moved around.
Connor could clearly feel that his wound was much better. The effect of Rachel’s Golden Healer was indeed very significant.
At this moment, a question appeared in Connor’s mind again.
Who was Rachel Wallace?
Regardless of whether it was Rachel’s skill or the bottle of Golden Healer medicine that Rachel gave Connor, it proved that Rachel’s background was definitely not as simple as he imagined!

chapters.title: Chapter 780: Get Off My Bed!
chapters.content:
Chapter 780: Get Off My Bed!
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Connor had always thought that Rachel was just a rich lady.
However, due to various reasons, Rachel could not tell Connor who she was.
However, after experiencing the events of today, Connor realized that Rachel’s identity and background were definitely not as simple as he thought.
Firstly, Rachel was a martial artist, and secondly, she could casually mobilize people like Joey Shaw.
The more Connor thought about it, the more he felt that something was wrong!
Connor subconsciously looked up at the bathroom.
At this moment, Rachel was taking a shower in the bathroom.
Through the semi-transparent matte glass in the bathroom, Connor could vaguely see Rachel’s sexy figure.
“I can only wait for Rachel to come out before asking her these questions…”
Connor could not help but mutter to himself. Then, he got up and strolled around Rachel’s house.
After tossing and turning for an entire day, Connor was clearly a little tired at this time.
Therefore, after hesitating for a moment, Connor lay down on Rachel’s bed.
Although this dormitory was allocated by the Porthampton University, Rachel had renovated it herself. After all, a young lady like her didn’t lack money!
Rachel’s bed was very comfortable, even more comfortable than Connor’s bed in his villa.
Moreover, the bed was emitting a mesmerizing fragrance, which was exactly the same as the smell on Rachel’s body.
Creak…
At this moment, Rachel came out of the bathroom after taking a shower.
Rachel was wearing a sexy nightgown. Her hair was still wet, and her slender and fair legs were exposed to the air without reservation. Her pair of pink jade feet were wearing a pair of slippers.
When Rachel saw Connor lying on her bed, she subconsciously screamed and rushed over, shouting at him, “Connor, why are you lying on my bed? Have you showered? Hurry up and get down…”
Rachel was a clean freak.
Rachel had also told Connor many times not to touch her bed.
When Rachel saw Connor lying on her bed like this, she was naturally very angry!
“Miss, there’s only one bed in the room, and I’m injured because of you. If I don’t lie here, where do you want me to lie?”
Connor lay on the bed and replied softly.
“You can lie down wherever you want. This has nothing to do with me. Me taking you in is good enough as it is. Hurry up and get up…”
Rachel pushed Connor hard. She seemed perturbed.
However, Connor lay on the bed without moving. He had already thought it through.
No matter what Rachel said today, he would not get off the bed.
“Are you going to get off or not?”
Rachel pushed Connor hard.
“No. My leg is already injured, yet you’re still treating me like this…”
