Connor replied indifferently.
“How can you be so shameless!”
Rachel shouted. Then, she sat beside Connor angrily, her eyes filled with anger.
Connor turned his head and glanced at Rachel, then asked softly, “Why did you stop?”
“I’m a little tired…”
Rachel said placidly.
Connor sized Rachel up and said softly, “Miss, can you tell me the truth? Who are you? Why are you so skilled?”
“Didn’t you already ask me this question? Also, I’ve already answered you long ago. I can’t tell you my identity now. Once you know my identity, it won’t do you any good. I didn’t want you to find out that I’m a martial artist, but now that you’ve found out, I won’t hide it from you anymore…”
Rachel replied coolly.
“But even if I know that you’re a martial artist, I still don’t know who you are. If I don’t even know who you are, how can we work together in the future?”
Connor frowned and said to Rachel.
“When the time is right, I will naturally tell you my identity. However, knowing too much now will not do you any good. So, no matter what, I will not tell you. If you want to investigate me, I advise you to stop wasting your energy because you will never be able to find out who I am!”
Rachel said calmly.
Connor took a deep breath and turned to look at the flirtatious Rachel beside him. He didn’t know what to say.
Connor knew that there were too many secrets when it came to Rachel. However, Connor had no way to get the info from her, so Connor was very annoyed.
Although Rachel didn’t do anything harmful to Connor, he felt that it was too dangerous to let a woman he didn’t know at all follow him.
Especially after finding out that Rachel was a martial artist, Connor wanted to know who she was even more.
At this moment, Connor did not even know if Rachel was a friend or an enemy!
“Connor, I’m a little hungry…”
But at this moment, Rachel suddenly turned and said to Connor.
“…”
When Connor heard Rachel’s words, he couldn’t help but be stunned. Then, he frowned and asked, “What did you say?”
“Didn’t you hear me when I said I was hungry?”
Rachel fiercely glared at Connor.
“No, Miss Wallace, I’m a patient now. What does it have to do with me if you’re hungry? Don’t tell me you want me to get you something to eat?”
Connor shouted at Rachel in despair.
“I don’t know how to make anything. Of course, you’re the one who’s going to get me something to eat. Hurry up and get me something to eat…”
Rachel stretched out her hand and gently pushed Connor.
“Didn’t we already eat at the Emperor’s Club?”
Connor said with frustration.
“I was thinking about how to solve the problem with Nate Taylor at that time, so I didn’t eat much. I’m hungry now. Hurry up and get me something to eat…”
Rachel softly said to Connor.
“I’m not going…”
Connor thought for a moment and shook his head.
If Rachel asked him to get off the bed now, it would not be so easy for him to get back on it later.
“Then, do you still want to take leave?”
Rachel asked Connor with her big watery eyes.
When Connor heard Rachel’s words, a trace of helplessness flashed across his eyes. Then, he frowned and said, “No, didn’t you already agree to my request for leave?”
“Let me ask you, do you still want to take leave?”
Rachel looked at Connor and continued to ask.
“Fine, you win!”
Connor gritted his teeth and whispered back to Rachel. Then, he got off the bed and walked toward the kitchen.

chapters.title: Chapter 781: Sleeping Together
chapters.content:
Chapter 781: Sleeping Together
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
After entering the kitchen, Connor opened the refrigerator and quickly glanced inside.
However, he discovered that Rachel’s refrigerator had absolutely nothing inside it.
Apart from instant noodles, there was nothing else.
If he were to go out and buy groceries at this moment, he would most likely encounter the assassins sent by Rockefeller.
Therefore, he had no choice but to cook a bowl of instant noodles for her.
Five minutes later, he walked out of the kitchen with a steaming bowl of instant noodles and softly said to Rachel, “Come out and eat…”
She hesitated for two seconds before walking out of the bedroom and sat on the couch to start eating.
Meanwhile, he took the opportunity and went straight back to the bedroom and laid down on the bed.
“How is it? Did I do a decent job with my cooking?” Connor asked her with a smile.
“It’s alright.” Rachel nodded gently.
In this world, there is a type of woman who appears elegant and beautiful in whatever she does, and Rachel was exactly that kind of woman.
Even while eating instant noodles, she maintained a graceful and elegant posture.
Perhaps out of boredom, she picked up the remote control and turned on the TV.
After randomly pressing a few buttons, she switched to a children’s channel, where Peppa Pig was playing.
Connor looked at the pink pigs on the TV with a helpless expression on his face.
He never expected that the usually dignified Rachel would actually enjoy watching such a program.
Initially, Connor was quite sleepy, but after Rachel’s antics, his drowsiness disappeared. He became curious and asked her, “Miss. Rachel, have you been in a relationship before?”
Upon hearing his question, she couldn’t help but turn her head to glance at him and replied expressionlessly, “I haven’t met a man who can make my heart flutter…”
“Oh, I see…” Connor nodded lightly and continued, “Well, you’re not young anymore, and I think you should find a boyfriend…”
“I don’t need you to mind my business. You better take care of your own affairs. Since Rockefeller has already targeted you, I don’t think this will be the last time. There will be more trouble coming your way. You were lucky to have me around; otherwise, you would have been in big trouble today…” Rachel turned her head, looked at Connor coldly, and said.
Connor was at a loss for words after hearing Rachel’s words.
If it weren’t for her, he probably wouldn’t have gotten hurt at all.
However, Connor knew that Rachel’s words made sense. He had to seize the opportunity to become Jorge’s disciple because he knew that by revealing his skills this time, the assassins sent by Rockefeller next time would be even more formidable.
On the other hand, after finishing her instant noodles, Rachel turned off the TV and walked to the bedside, looking at Connor, who was almost asleep, and sighed helplessly.
But in the end, she chose not to kick him out of bed and lay down beside him.
After a while, she turned off the lights in the room and closed her eyes, preparing to sleep.
At that moment, he subconsciously turned his head to look at Rachel beside him.
In reality, he wasn’t asleep at all; he was just pretending, fearing that she would kick him off the bed.
Perhaps because she trusted him a lot, and she also knew that he didn’t have the guts to do anything to her, she soon fell into a deep sleep.
After taking a deep breath, Connor couldn’t help but sigh in his heart. He never imagined that one day he would end up sleeping with this beautiful teacher from Porthampton University. It was simply unbelievable.
A moment later, Connor closed his eyes and quickly fell asleep.
The next day, at eight in the morning.
When he woke up, he found that she had already gotten up and was sitting on the sofa, eating breakfast.
“Miss, you’re awake?”
Connor smiled and greeted Rachel.
“Mhmm, go brush your teeth. I’ll leave first, or else it won’t look good if people see us together.” Rachel replied softly to Connor.
“Alright…”
Connor nodded slightly at Rachel’s words and didn’t say much.
“By the way, don’t tell anyone about staying overnight in my dorm last night, understood?”
Rachel reminded him in a soft voice.
“Don’t worry, I won’t tell anyone about it.” he replied helplessly.
“I’m just worried that you might blabber…”
Rachel glanced at Connor lightly and then changed into an exquisite tight skirt, wearing high heels, and gracefully left the dorm.
After Rachel left, Connor took out his phone and dialed Kyle’s number. He briefly inquired about the situation at the Emperor’s Club and was relieved to hear that he had already taken care of the assassin’s body.
After finishing breakfast, Connor planned to go to class. However, when he walked into the living room, he realized that Rachel hadn’t prepared breakfast for him at all!
About half an hour later, he left the dorm and arrived at the classroom.
Rachel seemed as if nothing had happened the previous night and continued to play the role of a goddess teacher in the school.
He couldn’t help but feel helpless as he looked at her on the podium.
If it weren’t for their recent encounters, he would have never imagined that Rachel, this woman, was actually a highly skilled martial artist.
He couldn’t understand why she would willingly work as a teacher in the school.
Could it be that Rachel came to Porthampton University solely because of him?
What was Rachel’s true purpose?
He was filled with doubts about her, but for now, he had no way of finding the answers.
…
In the blink of an eye, two days had passed.
Just as Rachel had said, miraculously, Connor’s leg injury had completely healed after using her miraculous healing medicine.
If he had gone to the hospital, it would have taken at least ten days or half a month for his leg to heal, if at all.
She also kept her promise and agreed to grant his request for leave.
He was now ready to set off for the Medicine Kings’ Valley to search for the medicinal materials mentioned by Jorge.

chapters.title: Chapter 782: Heading to the Medicine Kings’ Valley
chapters.content:
Chapter 782: Heading to the Medicine Kings’ Valley
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
On the second day, at eight o’clock in the morning, Connor, Carlos, and Diana took a bus and headed towards the location of the Medicine King’s Valley.
Although the name sounds like a place from a martial arts novel, it is actually just a small town.
Medicine King’s Valley is located in the coastal area of Davenport and is the largest medicinal herb trading market in the country.
Therefore, transportation to Medicine King’s Valley is very convenient. It only takes two hours to travel from Porthampton to there.
After Connor boarded the bus, he noticed that most of the people on the bus were old white-haired medicine practitioners with immortal temperament.
These old men were probably local traditional Chinese medicine doctors from the vicinity of Porthampton, intending to buy some medicinal herbs from Medicine King’s Valley.
The Flora Festival was about to begin, and there would be many precious medicinal herbs that are not usually seen.
These old medicine practitioners naturally didn’t want to miss such a good opportunity.
However, Connor also knew that these old men on the bus were just minor characters. After all, those famous medicine practitioners must have someone to pick them up and wouldn’t choose to travel by bus.
It was just that because of the incident at the Emperor’s Club last time, Connor became more cautious.
Although he had Carlos with him at the moment, he didn’t know what kind of assassins he would encounter next, so he thought it would be more convenient to take public transportation.
Diana, who was dressed in a sexy outfit, also followed Connor. In fact, he originally didn’t want to bring Diana with him.
After all, both he and Carlos were men, and it felt a bit strange to have a woman with them.
But Thomas told him that Diana was skilled and could protect his safety when necessary.
And more importantly, she was very knowledgeable about medicinal herbs and was familiar with the situation at Medicine King’s Valley.
If she accompanied him, she could also serve as a guide.
So in the end, he reluctantly agreed to bring Diana along.
But he realized that it was too conspicuous to have Diana, a woman, by his side because her dressing was too sexy and alluring.
Diana was wearing a black tight-fitting camisole that perfectly accentuated her graceful curves. Her ample bosom gave off a captivating sensation, and her slender waist emitted an irresistible allure as she swayed.
She wore a white hip-hugging skirt, barely covering the captivating curves of her buttocks, and a pair of ten-centimeter high heels on her feet, making her look extremely tempting.
When Diana appeared on the bus, everyone’s attention was drawn to her.
Connor looked at her and a hint of helplessness flashed in his eyes.
Because he had instructed her earlier to dress more casually this time, she Diana insisted that this was already her most ordinary attire, leaving him at a loss for words.
Soon, the bus started.
She turned her head and glanced at Connor, then whispered to him, “Mr. Connor, are you really going to that place called Precipice Cave?”
“Yes, Jorge instructed me that there are very important medicinal herbs in?Precipice Cave, so I definitely have to go…” He nodded lightly while looking at the scenery outside.
“But as far as I know, Precipice Cave is very dangerous…” Diana reminded Connor softly.
“If it wasn’t dangerous, Jorge wouldn’t let me go…” Connor said indifferently.
After hearing his resolute attitude, she sighed softly and didn’t say anything more.
Carlos has been sitting next to Connor, with a calm expression on his face.
“By the way, Diana, you are familiar with the situation at Medicine King’s Valley, right?”
Connor turned his head and glanced at Diana, asking her softly.
“Yes, I lived there for a while. If Mr. Connor wants to find any medicinal herbs, you can just tell me, I will definitely help you find them…” Diana said coquettishly to Connor.
“Okay…”
Connor looked at her and nodded gently, not saying anything more.
Meanwhile, Diana took out her phone and started playing with it.
…
In the blink of an eye, two hours had passed.
The bus that Connor was on finally arrived at Medicine King’s Valley. Although it was a small town, the area was quite large, comparable to a small city.
After Connor, Diana, and Carlos got off the bus, Connor could see many elderly people dressed in Tang suits or herbal medicine merchants coming and going in the town. These people were probably here to participate in the Flora Festival.
Diana turned her head and glanced at Connor, then asked him softly, “Mr. Connor, what kind of medicinal herbs do you need? I can inquire for you…”
“These are the medicinal herbs Jorge needs…”
Connor took out the piece of paper that Jorge had given him and handed it to Diana.
After receiving Connor’s note, she carefully looked at it and a hint of helplessness flashed in her eyes. She then said softly to Connor, “Jorge is really excessive. All the medicinal herbs listed here are rare and quite expensive…”
“How much do these medicinal herbs cost?”
Connor hesitated for a moment and couldn’t help but ask Diana.
After hearing his question, Diana paused for a moment and then said softly, “Mr. Connor, if you want to buy all these medicinal herbs, it would cost at least five billion…”
“Five billion?”
Upon hearing her words, Connor instantly froze in place, with an expression of extreme helplessness on his face.
Originally, he thought that these medicinal herbs would cost a few tens of millions at most, but he didn’t expect Jorge to be so ruthless. These few herbs alone would cost five billion!
“The medicinal herbs listed on this note are not particularly rare, but he requires them to be at least five hundred years old, which makes the price higher…”
She turned her head and explained to him.
“I understand…”
Connor nodded lightly and then continued to ask Diana, “Do you know where we can buy these medicinal herbs?”
“If it’s ordinary medicinal herbs, you can find them in any herbal medicine trading market around here. But if you want herbs that are over five hundred years old, only the old, well-established herbal medicine shops would have them. However, I can’t be one hundred percent sure. Mr. Connor, we can go and have a look…”
After thinking for a moment, Diana answered.
“Alright, since we’re already here, let’s go and take a look!”
Connor nodded gently towards Diana.

chapters.title: Chapter 783: The Medicinal Herbs Are Sold Out!
chapters.content:
Chapter 783: The Medicinal Herbs Are Sold Out!
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Connor knew that it would cost a lot of money to gather all the medicinal materials needed for Jorge.
However, he never expected that it would cost at least five billion dollars to gather all these medicinal materials!
But unfortunately, Connor, Diana, and Carlos had already come here. If they were to leave like this, they would feel reluctant.
So Connor secretly cursed Jorge in his heart several times, then turned to Diana and asked, “Where are those medicinal materials located?”
After hearing his question, Diana took a quick look around and whispered, “Mr. Connor, there should be a medicinal herb shop ahead that I know of. It’s an old and reputable store that has been around for hundreds of years. Let’s go there!”
“Okay!”
He nodded lightly and followed her into the town.
At this moment, he was secretly glad that he agreed to let Diana come along. If it were just him and Carlos, they wouldn’t have any understanding of the situation in the Medicine King’s Valley. They would have been clueless about how long it would take to find all the medicinal materials if they went from one shop to another.
But with her present, Connor’s task became much easier.
Diana was very knowledgeable about the situation in the Medicine King’s Valley.
Soon, she led Connor and Carlos to a building that had a quaint appearance.
“Mr. Connor, this is the largest medicinal herb shop in the Medicine King’s Valley. Although the herbal market in the country is vast with high demand, the real market for medicinal herbs is monopolized by a few medicinal herb families. Mr. Connor, you also own several pharmaceutical companies, but this herb shop is owned by one of the oldest medicinal herb families in the country, with a history of over a thousand years. They have a wide variety of herbs inside…” Diana explained to Connor.
“Okay…”
Connor nodded lightly and walked into the herb shop with Diana.
When the staff in the shop saw Diana enter, they were momentarily stunned, then respectfully exclaimed, “Miss Diana, why have you come? Please come inside quickly…”
“No need, I came here today to buy some medicinal herbs. Go and call the shopkeeper for me!”
Diana replied casually, as if she was familiar with the staff in the shop.
“Alright, Miss Diana, please wait a moment!”
The staff nodded in response to Diana’s words and then turned to walk into the shop.
“Mr. Connor, let’s sit and wait over there for a moment,” she said to Connor.
“Okay…”
He nodded lightly and turned to sit at a table, while Diana and Carlos stood behind him.
When the staff saw this scene, a hint of surprise flashed in their eyes. They quickly prepared some tea and respectfully poured a cup for Connor.
A few minutes later, footsteps could be heard.
An elderly man in suits walked up to Diana and spoke very respectfully, “Miss Diana, why didn’t you say hello to me when you came? If I had known you were coming, I would have been waiting at the door to greet you…”
“Mr. Webb, there’s no need to be so polite…”
Diana replied casually.
Connor looked somewhat surprised at Diana. He could tell from the way the old shopkeeper treated her that Diana indeed had some connections in the Medicine King’s Valley.
“Diana, what brings you here this time?”
Mr. Webb asked with a smile.
“I came here to accompany my boss to buy some medicinal herbs…”
Diana replied calmly.
“Your boss?”
After hearing Diana’s words, Mr. Webb couldn’t help but turn his head and cast a glance at Connor, with a hint of surprise in his eyes.
Because Diana held a high status in the Medicine King’s Valley, almost everyone in the major pharmacies knew her.
Back when Diana lived in the Medicine King’s Valley, she was known as the notorious ‘Little Witch’ and no one dared to offend her.
But now, Diana stood respectfully behind a young man, which proved just how powerful his background and identity were.
Therefore, Mr. Webb’s gaze towards Connor underwent a significant change.
After two seconds of silence, Mr. Webb respectfully asked Connor, “May I ask, sir, what medicinal materials do you need?”
Connor took out the list given to him by Jorge and placed it on the table, saying softly, “The medicinal materials I need are all listed on this note…”
“Alright, please wait a moment. Let me take a look!”
Mr. Webb responded respectfully and picked up the note from the table, examining it with a serious expression.
However, after a moment, his face dropped, and a hint of helplessness flashed in his eyes.
“Mr. Webb?”
Diana noticed that something seemed off with the old man’s expression and called out with a frown.
“Miss Diana, the medicinal materials your young master needs have already been sold out in our pharmacy. Not to mention the precious ones that are over five hundred years old, we don’t even have any medicinal materials over a hundred years old…”
Mr. Webb responded to Diana with a tone of helplessness.
“How is that possible?”
Diana’s eyes showed a hint of surprise. After all, this pharmacy was one of the largest in the Medicine King’s Valley. Although she didn’t expect them to have all the required medicinal materials, she thought they would at least have one or two.
But she never expected that this pharmacy couldn’t even provide a single medicinal material over a hundred years old, let alone those over five hundred years old.
“Mr. Webb, you really don’t have a single medicinal material?”
After hesitating for a moment, Diana asked the old man softly.
“Miss Diana, if we really had them, I would definitely sell them to you. Moreover, considering your relationship with our pharmacy, I couldn’t possibly deceive you…”
Mr. Webb smiled and said.
After hearing his words, Diana’s expression showed a hint of helplessness. She then turned to Connor and said, “Mr. Connor, since they don’t have them here, let’s go to other places and take a look!”
“Okay!”
Connor nodded lightly and stood up, ready to leave.
“Miss Diana!”
But at that moment, Mr. Webb suddenly called out to Diana.
Diana turned her head and asked softly, “Mr. Webb, is there something else?”
“I don’t think you need to go to other pharmacies…”
Mr. Webb said slowly.
Connor and Diana were stunned upon hearing Mr. Webb’s words, their faces expressing confusion.

chapters.title: Chapter 784: A Mixed-Blood Beauty
chapters.content:
Chapter 784: A Mixed-Blood Beauty
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
In the pharmacy.
Mr. Webb stood up and walked to Diana. He spoke softly to her, “Miss Diana, I think you don’t need to go to other pharmacies because they probably don’t have these medicinal ingredients…”
“Why?” she asked with a puzzled expression, frowning.
“Miss Diana, you may have come a bit late. Yesterday night, a group of people came here and bought all the medicinal ingredients over a hundred years old. So now, you can only find some ordinary medicinal ingredients here, and the ones with a slightly longer history have already been bought by them,” Mr. Webb explained calmly.
“They bought all the medicinal ingredients over a hundred years old? Who has that much money?” Diana couldn’t help but exclaim.
You see, the medicinal ingredients Connor wanted to buy were only a dozen types, and their value had already exceeded five billion. How much money would it take to buy all the medicinal ingredients in the Medicine King’s Valley that are over a hundred years old? It would be impossible without several billions!
“I’m not exactly sure who they are, but they indeed bought all the medicinal ingredients over a hundred years old in our Medicine King’s Valley. If we don’t have them here, other places won’t have them either,” Mr. Webb explained calmly.
“So, you mean to say that no matter which pharmacy I go to, I won’t be able to find the medicinal ingredients I want?” Connor hesitated for a moment and asked Mr. Webb.
Upon hearing his question, Mr. Webb hesitated for a moment and then said calmly, “Sir, if you want to buy all these medicinal ingredients, there is only one way now, which is to wait for the Medicinal Auction tomorrow…”
“The Medicinal Auction?” Connor was momentarily stunned upon hearing this.
“Yes, tomorrow is the official opening of the Flora Festival. At that time, we will hold a Medicinal Auction. The medicinal ingredients being auctioned there are from private collections and many of them are precious medicinal ingredients that are rare to come across in a hundred years. There will also be many wealthy people attending. If you go to that auction, you might be able to find the medicinal ingredients you need,” Mr. Webb answered.
Diana turned her head to look at Connor and whispered, “Mr. Connor, I have also heard about this auction. We can indeed try our luck there, maybe we can really find the medicinal ingredients you need…”
“When does this auction start?” Connor hesitated for a moment and asked softly.
“It should start at ten o’clock tomorrow morning, held at Medicine King’s Valley’s auction house,” Mr. Webb hurriedly replied.
“Okay, got it!” Connor nodded and turned directly to walk outside the pharmacy.
Connor knew that if he couldn’t gather these medicinal ingredients now, he would definitely not be able to gather them later. By that time, he wouldn’t know when he would have the chance to become Jorge’s disciple.
So, he thought it would be better to seize this opportunity and try his luck at the auction. Maybe he could find the medicinal ingredients he wanted there.
“This old man is really causing trouble…” he couldn’t help but sigh softly in his heart and walked straight towards the exit of the pharmacy.
After leaving the pharmacy, he still felt somewhat unwilling.
He couldn’t believe that someone could be so wealthy that they bought all the precious medicinal ingredients in the Medicine King’s Valley.
Therefore, Connor, Diana, and Carlos split up and went to different pharmacies to inquire, hoping to find the medicinal ingredients Connor needed.
If there was one, Connor would take it no matter how much it cost.
After Connor and Diana and Carlos separated, Connor wandered alone inside the Medicine King’s Valley.
“Spring Hall?”
Connor stopped in front of a pharmacy and hesitated for a moment, considering going inside to ask.
But before he could enter the pharmacy, a large group of people rushed out of it as if going crazy.
From their attire, Connor could tell that these people were likely staff members of the pharmacy. He instinctively looked back at his own back.
A white BMW sedan was parked at the entrance of the shop.
A burly man in a black suit quickly walked to the door of the BMW and bent down to open it.
After the car door opened, a pair of black high heels emerged from the car, followed by a pair of slender and fair legs.
A seductive and exquisitely beautiful woman walked out of the car slowly.
After the beauty got out of the car, she directly walked towards the direction of Huichuntang with confident steps.
Upon seeing this beauty, Connor couldn’t help but pause for a moment because she was incredibly sexy.
She was dressed in a tight black miniskirt, which made her particularly enticing. Her exquisitely enchanting face had a hint of makeup, and she seemed to have a mixed-race appearance.
The miniskirt hugged the curves of her full buttocks, and her long and fair legs were fully exposed to the air, leaving an unforgettable impression on anyone who laid eyes on her.
As soon as this beauty appeared, her aura was overwhelming, giving off the feeling of a queen.
Under the guidance of the Spring Hall’s staff, the mixed-race beauty passed by Connor.
However, she didn’t even glance at him as if he was inconsequential in her eyes.
He sighed helplessly and continued walking towards Spring Hall.
Perhaps because most of Connor’s attention was focused on this mixed-race beauty, he didn’t notice the steps beneath his feet at all.
Connor accidentally tripped on the steps, instantly losing his balance and falling forward.
But the mixed-race beauty happened to be in front of Connor at that moment. Connor instinctively shouted, “Watch out…”
But because the mixed-race beauty had her back turned to Connor, she had no idea what was happening.
When she heard Connor’s warning, she instinctively turned around to look in Connor’s direction.
The next second, Connor’s head heavily collided with her ample bosom, and a fragrance filled his nostrils.
Perhaps because Connor was relatively heavy, the mixed-race beauty took two steps back and fell to the ground.
The mixed-race beauty could even feel Connor’s breath, and this peculiar sensation made her feel extremely bashful.

chapters.title: Chapter 785: I Will Remember You!
chapters.content:
Chapter 785: I Will Remember You!
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
After seeing Connor knocking down the mixed-race beauty, all the bodyguards present were dumbfounded, showing expressions of shock.
“What are you idiots standing there for? Hurry up and pull this pervert away from me…”
The mixed-race beauty raised her fair leg and kept kicking Connor as she shouted.
Upon hearing the mixed-race beauty’s words, the bodyguards immediately snapped out of their daze and quickly ran to Connor’s side, pulling him away from the beauty.
After Connor was pulled away from the beauty, he quickly apologized, “I… I’m sorry, I didn’t mean to…”
With the support of a middle-aged bodyguard, the mixed-race beauty slowly stood up, staring coldly at Connor and said in a chilly tone, “How dare you take advantage of me, break his hands and feet, and throw him out of the Medicine King’s Valley…”
Upon hearing the mixed-race beauty’s words, Connor was stunned in place, his expression showing great shock.
Because he had already apologized to the woman just now, and he didn’t intentionally trip her. Moreover, he had warned her to be careful when he was falling, but she didn’t move out of the way, so what could he do?
He didn’t expect the temper of this beauty to be so volatile. Just because of this small incident, she wanted to break his hands and feet!
“Clang…”
Upon hearing the mixed-race beauty’s words, her bodyguards immediately strode toward him.
“I have already apologized to you just now, is it necessary for you to react this way? I really didn’t mean it just now…”
He helplessly shouted towards the mixed-race beauty’s direction.
The mixed-race beauty coldly glanced at Connor, seemingly ignoring his words.
In the next second, the bodyguards of the mixed-race beauty rushed to his side.
However, the mixed-race beauty had no intention of lingering and walked directly towards the Spring Hall.
But at this moment, one of the bodyguards flew towards the mixed-race beauty and slammed heavily into the door of the Spring Hall.
Seeing this scene, the mixed-race beauty instinctively turned her head and looked at Connor behind her.
She knew clearly that it was him who sent her bodyguard flying.
The mixed-race beauty couldn’t help but frown, her expression showing great disbelief.
Because she never expected that this seemingly weak young man in front of her would have such great strength, capable of directly sending her bodyguard flying.
But this mixed-race beauty didn’t know that although her bodyguards appeared strong, they were actually just ordinary people.
If they really fought with him, they wouldn’t stand a chance.
Upon witnessing his terrifying skills, all the other bodyguards were stunned in place, their expressions filled with shock.
Connor calmly glanced at the mixed-race beauty in front of him and said expressionlessly, “Miss, I admit that what I did just now was wrong, but I have already apologized to you, and I didn’t do it on purpose. If you continue to let your bodyguards attack me, then don’t blame me for being impolite…”
After hearing Connor’s words, the mixed-race beauty couldn’t help but stare at him angrily, her expression showing extreme anger.
Because she didn’t expect that even at this point, Connor would dare to threaten her.
So she turned her head and shouted to the middle-aged bodyguard beside her, “Uncle Ted, please teach this kid a lesson…”
“Miss, we came here for a purpose this time…”
The middle-aged man called Uncle Ted replied to the mixed-blood beauty with a helpless tone, then continued in a low voice, “Moreover, this young man’s skill is not simple. He should not be an ordinary person. It is best that we do not create any more trouble. The most important thing now is to gather the medicinal ingredients that we are looking for…”
“Uncle Ted, am I just going to let this kid go? This brat took advantage of me just now…”
The mixed-blood beauty said angrily.
“Miss, if you want to teach this kid a lesson, you can do it anytime. We don’t have to waste time on him. Moreover, if this matter blows up, it will also affect our plan this time. We have to prioritize things, don’t you think?”
The middle-aged man continued to persuade in a low voice.
The mixed-blood beauty turned her head and glared at Connor. Then, she asked with a cold expression, “What’s your name?”
“Connor!”
Connor replied directly.
“Alright, I’ll remember your name!”
Connor watched the back of the mixed-race beauty with a helpless smile and walked forward as well.
At six in the evening, Connor, Carlos, and Diana returned to the hotel that Thomas had previously booked for them.
From the expressions on the faces of Diana and Carlos, Connor could tell that they hadn’t gained anything either.
During the afternoon, Connor had also visited many herbal medicine stores, but the results were the same. All the precious medicinal herbs in the Medicine King’s Valley had been bought up.
“I wonder who has so much money to sweep away all the precious medicinal herbs of the Medicine King’s Valley in such a short time. You should know that the total value of these herbs is at least in the tens of billions…”
Diana said helplessly to Connor.
“Yeah, now there aren’t even any medicinal herbs that are over a hundred years old. What are these people buying so many medicinal herbs for?”
Carlos also replied helplessly.
“There’s no point in talking about this now. We can only wait for tomorrow morning’s auction and see if we can buy these medicinal herbs…”
Connor calmly replied to the two of them, then continued, “You two have been busy all day, you should go back and rest early!”
“Alright, Mr. Connor!”
Carlos and Diana nodded in agreement and then turned back to their respective rooms.
Connor also returned to his room, lay on the bed, closed his eyes, and rested. He planned to wait until the auction tomorrow to try his luck.
However, Connor knew that the hope for tomorrow’s auction was not very high. It was unlikely that he would be able to complete the task given to him by Jorge this time.
But fortunately, these medicinal herbs were not the most important ones. As long as Connor could obtain the herbs inside the Precipice Cave, it would be enough.
As for the other medicinal herbs, Connor could easily have Thomas collect them from elsewhere.

chapters.title: Chapter 786: Her Name Is Ruby Yandell?
chapters.content:
Chapter 786: Her Name Is Ruby Yandell?
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
The next day, at nine o’clock in the morning.
After Connor, Diana and Carlos left the hotel, they drove straight to the Medicine Kings’ Valley Auction.
The auction was held in a manor. Because today’s auction was Medicine Kings’ Valley’s annual auction, security was still very strict. There was a large group of security guards standing at the entrance of the manor. Any guests who wanted to enter the manor had to show an invitation card to them.
When Connor saw that the people who entered had invitation cards in their hands, he couldn’t help but be stunned for a moment. Then, he turned to Diana and Carlos and asked, “Do you two have invitations?”
“Mr. McDonald, I don’t need an invitation to go to such a place…” Diana replied in a low voice, and then she directly walked towards the entrance of the manor in her high heels.
One of the security guards saw Diana walking over and quickly reached out to stop her. He then whispered, “Miss, please show me your invitation. This is a private auction. If you don’t have an invitation, you can’t enter…”
“Go and tell Mr. Carter of your auction house that a beauty named Diana wants to enter…”
Diana said coldly to the security guard.
The security guard was stunned when he saw Diana’s confident expression. He then turned around and walked into the manor.
Meanwhile, Connor and Carlos stood not far away, watching Diana as they waited quietly.
Connor did not know the identities of his bodyguards, so he could not help but ask Carlos softly, “Carlos, who is Diana? Is she really that well-known here?”
“Mr. McDonald, I don’t know who Diana is, but I’ve heard from President Morgan that her medical skills are very good, and she has done a lot of research on herbs. As for who she is, I don’t know much. I only met her after I came to Porthampton. We don’t talk to each other a lot…” Carlos said to Connor in all seriousness.
Connor also knew that Carlos was a person who didn’t like to socialize, so it was normal that he didn’t know about Diana.
After about two minutes, a middle-aged man walked out of the manor and came to Diana. He said respectfully, “Miss Diana, you actually came over? These security guards don’t know you, so please don’t lower yourself to their level!”
“It’s okay. I’m here with my lord, you see. Mr. Carter, please remember to arrange a better seat for us later!”
Diana seemed to be very familiar with this middle-aged man and smiled.
“Your lord? The middle-aged man couldn’t help but be stunned when he heard Diana’s words. His expression was somewhat puzzled.
“That’s right. This is our lord, Mr. McDonald from Porthampton!”
Diana turned to look at Connor and introduced him.
The middle-aged man seemed to have heard about the matter of Mr. McDonald in Porthampton, so after knowing Connor’s identity, his expression immediately changed. He hurriedly ran to Connor and said to Connor in a very respectful tone, “Mr. McDonald, hello, I’m the person in charge of this auction, Waldo Chuke. I’ve long heard about you, Mr. McDonald. It’s an honor for us to have you attend our auction today!”
“Mr. Carter, you’re too polite. I just happened to be lacking some medicinal herbs now, so I came to the auction to take a look…” Connor replied calmly to Waldo.
“Mr. McDonald, you’ve come to the right place this time. We have all kinds of herbs here. I’ll arrange the best seat for you in a while.”
As Waldo spoke, he led Connor, Diana and Carlos into the manor.
After entering the manor, Waldo brought Connor and the others directly to the hall where the auction was held.
At this moment, there were already many people gathered in the hall. Moreover, all of these people gave off extraordinary auras. From the way they dressed, it could be seen that these people should be wealthy businessmen from all over the country. They were all prepared to buy some medicinal herbs that they needed at this auction.
After Waldo exchanged a few words with Connor, he went to receive the other guests.
Connor, Diana and Carlos found a random seat and sat down, then quietly waited for the auction to begin.
Many people took the initiative to greet Diana when they saw her. From this, it could be seen that Diana was indeed very important in Medicine Kings’ Valley. The tone these people used to speak to Diana was also very respectful.
Connor didn’t know these people, nor had he revealed his identity in Medicine Kings’ Valley, so these people were basically here for Diana, not for Connor.
“Miss Yandell is here…”
At this moment, a commotion suddenly came from the entrance of the auction house.
When everyone heard this, they turned to look at the door.
Connor subconsciously turned his head to look and saw a tall and charming beauty slowly walking into the hall under the crowd.
After Connor saw the beauty, he was stunned on the spot, and his expression was very incredulous.
This was because this beauty was none other than the woman that Connor had pounced on in front of Spring Hall yesterday afternoon.
This woman was very stunning and looked like she was of mixed descent, so she was very easy to recognize.
Connor could recognize that this beauty was the woman he met yesterday afternoon.
The woman was very arrogant. Even when faced with the flattery of those rich people, she chose to ignore them directly.
Meanwhile, the middle-aged man beside the woman kept socializing.
A moment later, the woman walked to the front of the auction and sat down elegantly.
She wasn’t very far from where Connor was. It was just that the woman did not notice Connor.
“Mr. McDonald, do you know Ruby Yandell?”
Diana noticed that Connor seemed to be staring at the woman, so she couldn’t help but ask Connor softly.
Connor turned to look at Diana and replied, “I met this woman yesterday afternoon, and we had a small conflict. Her name is Ruby Yandell, you say?”
“That’s right, Mr. McDonald. She is the famous Ruby Yandell. Her grandfather is a very famous businessman in Salem. According to my investigations, all the medicinal herbs in the Medicine Kings’ Valley seem to have been bought by this woman!”
Diana continued.

chapters.title: Chapter 787: I Bid Ten Million!
chapters.content:
Chapter 787: I Bid Ten Million!
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Connor was dumbfounded when he heard Diana’s words.
He couldn’t help but turn his head to look at Diana, then asked softly, “Are you saying that this woman has bought all the herbs in Medicine Kings’ Valley?”
“Yes…”
Diana looked at Connor and nodded before continuing, “I just asked some of my friends here. Most of the medicinal herbs in Medicine Kings’ Valley were bought by Ruby, but I’m not sure why she bought so many medicinal herbs…”
“This woman is actually that rich?”
Connor subconsciously looked at Ruby with a surprised expression.
Connor could feel that Ruby’s background was not simple, otherwise, she wouldn’t have brought so many bodyguards with her. Also, he felt that the middle-aged man beside Ruby was not an ordinary person.
His strength should be even more powerful than Connor!
“Of course Ruby is rich…” Diana replied to Connor before continuing, “Ruby’s family is the largest merchant family in Salem. The Yandell family mainly deals in international trade, oil and minerals. Ruby’s grandfather was once ranked very high on the list of the world’s billionaires. In terms of assets, not many people in Oprana can compare to the Yandell family. Therefore, it is very normal for Ruby to spend so much money to buy these herbs. That shouldn’t be a big deal for Ruby and the Yandell family!”
After hearing Diana’s words, Connor nodded thoughtfully.
Although Ruby’s family was indeed very rich, it wasn’t enough to surprise Connor.
After all, no matter how rich the Yandell family was, they couldn’t possibly be richer than Connor!
“Also, this Ruby Yandell is also a business genius. She is only twenty-five years old this year, but she has already taken over most of the Yandell Family’s businesses. She is also a model in Salem, with countless admirers and fans.”
Diana looked at Connor and continued to introduce Ruby.
“I didn’t expect Ruby to have so many identities…” Connor could not help but sigh softly.
“If not for the Yandell Family, Ruby wouldn’t have been able to buy all the herbs in Medicine Kings’ Valley in such a short period of time. These herbs can’t be bought just because you have money!”
Diana felt that this Ruby was very difficult to deal with, so she introduced her to Connor in detail. She wanted Connor to know what kind of person Ruby was.
“Why is she buying so many herbs?” Carlos suddenly frowned and asked Diana.
“I’m not sure about that. I’ve asked the shop owners, but they didn’t know why Ruby wanted to buy so many herbs!”
Diana looked at Carlos and shook her head.
Connor subconsciously turned to look at Ruby, his expression calm. Connor had arrived a little late, which was why Ruby had bought all the herbs in the Medicine Kings’ Valley.
However, this was an auction. The rules of the auction were that whoever paid the most money would be able to win.
Therefore, Connor wasn’t worried about Ruby bringing him any trouble. After all, if they were to compete in terms of wealth, there weren’t many people in the world who were richer than Connor!
If the herbs that Connor needed really appeared in this auction, then no matter how much money Connor needed to spend, he would buy it. After all, it was not easy for him to come to here, and Connor did not want to return empty-handed.
Just as Connor and Diana were chatting, the auction officially began.
A beautiful host in a long white dress walked onto the stage elegantly.
After a few simple greetings, the auction began.
Because this was Medicine Kings’ Valley’s annual auction, the rules were very strict.
All the medicinal herbs that could appear in the auction had all gone through layers of screening, so there was no problem with the quality of the medicinal herbs. It all depended on whether you had enough money in your hands.
After the auction began, Connor had been paying attention to the situation on the stage.
The first auction item was a hundred-year-old Reishi Mushroom. The starting price was two million.
After the host announced the starting bid, the wealthy businessmen present began to raise their placards to bid!
Although Connor also needed a Reishi Mushroom, it had to be at least 500 years old. Therefore, this Reishi Mushroom was not among Connor’s goals.
After a fierce competition, the price of the Reishi Mushroom was finally raised to six million.
Because most of the people present were medicinal herb merchants, they were very knowledgeable about the price of the herbs themselves.
The 100-year-old Reishi Mushroom was priced at around six million at most. If they continued to raise the price, there would not be much profit. That was why these people stopped bidding.
However, at this moment, Ruby suddenly called out a bid of 10 million!
Before this, Ruby had not made a bid, but it wasn’t because she wasn’t interested in this Reishi Mushroom. Instead, it was because she wanted to wait until the final price was out before making the final decision. This way, Ruby would be able to save a lot of time.
“This Ruby is really rich. The Reishi Mushroom on the market is worth six million, but she actually bid ten million. What is she trying to do?”
Diana couldn’t help but glance at Ruby and sigh.
“Looks like she really needs these medicinal herbs, or she wouldn’t be so generous!” Connor replied.
Diana sighed helplessly and didn’t say anything.
The following auctions were basically dedicated to Ruby. No matter what herbs the host brought out, as long as they were over a hundred years old, Ruby would buy them at twice the market price.
Most of the people present were medicinal herb merchants. They did not buy these medicinal herbs for themselves, but for the sake of selling them in the future.
Therefore, they couldn’t accept Ruby’s way of playing. Naturally, no one would dare to compete with her.
And Connor had never encountered the medicinal herbs he needed, so he had never made a move.
“The next medicinal herb we are going to auction is interesting. Our auction house has found many famous masters to appraise it, but no one can identify what this medicinal herb is. Therefore, we need to test everyone’s eyesight!”
The beautiful host looked at everyone and smiled faintly. Then, she reached out and lifted the red cloth on the table.

chapters.title: Chapter 788: A Truly Rich Man!
chapters.content:
Chapter 788: A Truly Rich Man!
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
After saying this, the host reached out and lifted the red cloth on the table.
Everyone’s eyes widened as they looked curiously at the items on the table.
At this moment, there was a fist-sized and completely black medicinal herb on the table.
This medicinal herb gave people the feeling that it was like a piece of charcoal. There was nothing magical about it at all.
“What is this?”
“Yeah, I’ve been in the medicinal herb business for so many years, but I’ve never seen this kind of medicinal herb before!”
“What is this thing?”
“Since even the people from the auction house do not know what this thing is, it is definitely impossible for us to see it with our naked eyes…”
When the medicinal herb merchants present saw this medicinal herb, their eyes widened in disbelief.
Connor knew nothing about herbs. If it wasn’t for the mission Jorge gave him, Connor wouldn’t have come to this place. Therefore, he was not very interested in this strange medicinal herb.
“The starting price of this medicinal herb is five million. If you are interested in this medicinal herb, you can try to bid!”
The emcee looked at the crowd with a smile and continued, “However, I have to add that because no one knows what this medicinal herb is, our auction house will not be responsible if this medicinal herb is auctioned off. Therefore, I hope that everyone will be careful!”
When the guests heard the host’s words, they were stunned on the spot. Their expressions were extremely shocked.
This was because they had never expected that the starting price of this strange medicinal herb would actually be five million.
No one would be so foolish as to spend five million to buy such a pitch-black herb.
Even if it was gambling, no one would gamble like this!
“Mr. McDonald, didn’t you want to buy a thousand year old wild ginseng?”
At this moment, Diana asked Connor softly.
When Connor heard Diana’s words, he couldn’t help but be stunned for a moment. Then, he frowned and asked, “What do you mean by that?”
“Mr. McDonald, if I’m not mistaken, the medicinal herb on the table should be a thousand-year-old wild ginseng. Although it looks black on the outside, I think the real thousand-year-old wild ginseng should be hidden inside that black charcoal. Because this wild ginseng is too old, it has formed a black fossil around it…” Diana said slowly.
“Are you sure this is a thousand year old wild ginseng?”
Connor couldn’t help but ask in a low voice.
“That’s right, I’m sure!”
Diana nodded.
“…”
Connor turned his head to look at Diana. He could tell that Diana was very serious when she spoke to him. It didn’t seem like she was joking with him.
The list Jorge gave Connor did indeed say that he wanted a thousand-year-old wild ginseng, so Connor was still very excited.
“Mr. McDonald, the price of a thousand-year-old wild ginseng is more than 50 million, and it’s something that can only be found by luck. These medicinal herb merchants probably don’t know what it is, so we can take advantage of it this time!”
Diana said happily to Connor.
“Alright, I understand…”
Connor looked at Diana and nodded lightly, then raised his hand and shouted, “I’ll pay five million!”
After everyone heard Connor’s words, they turned their heads to look at Connor’s position with shocked expressions on their faces.
Because they never dreamed that there would really be someone willing to pay so much money to buy this medicinal herb!
At this moment, in the eyes of these people, Connor was simply a fool with a lot of money.
Spending five million to buy such a black medicinal herb, this was simply a problem with his brain!
In an instant, the entire auction venue fell silent. It was as if no one wanted to compete with Connor at all.
Diana revealed a proud smile. If she could really spend five million to buy this thousand-year-old wild ginseng, it would be a good thing that fell from the sky!
When the host saw that no one spoke, he slowly shouted, “Five million, going once!”
“Eight million!”
At this moment, Ruby suddenly shouted.
When everyone heard Ruby’s words, they all turned their heads to look at Ruby’s position, their faces filled with shock.
“Ten million!”
Connor did not hesitate at all and directly increased the price.
Ruby glared at Connor with a furious expression.
She couldn’t help but curse in a low voice.” This bastard. He took advantage of me previously, and now he wants to snatch the medicinal herbs from me…”
In fact, Ruby had no idea what this herb was. However, she felt that since the auction house could start the bid at this price, it meant that this herb must have its value. Eight million was not a lot, so she was willing to take a gamble!
But now that Connor had offered 10 million, Ruby hesitated. She turned to the middle-aged man beside her and asked softly, “Uncle Cao, is there a need to raise the price?”
“Miss, this medicinal herb should not be an ordinary thing. If we can get it within 30 million, I think we can take a gamble!”
The middle-aged man beside Ruby replied in a low voice.
“Alright…”
Ruby nodded her head lightly, then shouted expressionlessly, “15 million!”
When the guests heard Ruby’s words, they were stunned. Their faces were filled with disbelief.
This was because they could not understand. This was clearly just an extremely ordinary medicinal herb, so why were Connor and Ruby offering such a high price?
If this medicinal herb was really just an ordinary piece of charcoal, wouldn’t that be a huge loss?
Ruby herself was very rich, so even if it was a loss, no one would feel sorry for her.
However, these people did not know Connor, nor did they know what Connor did for a living. They could not understand why Connor would pay so much money.
That said, everyone could feel that Connor should not be an ordinary person. He had a beautiful woman like Diana by his side, and the fact that he could take out so much money meant that his background was definitely not simple.
When Connor heard Ruby’s bid of 15 million, he immediately raised it to 20 million!
At this moment, the way everyone looked at Connor changed again.
These people had never seen anyone bid like this before. He actually added five million in one go!
Ruby’s face was filled with rage. She gritted her teeth and raised the bid to 30 million!
In an instant, everyone present fell silent.
At this moment, these people had finally seen what a truly rich person was!

chapters.title: Chapter 789: Thousand-Year-Old Wild Ginseng
chapters.content:
Chapter 789: Thousand-Year-Old Wild Ginseng
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
No one would have thought that the price of such an inconspicuous medicinal herb would increase by six times, becoming 30 million!
One had to know that 30 million was enough to buy any supreme-grade medicinal herb. If it were an ordinary person, this amount of money would be enough to let them live a carefree life.
As for Ruby, after she called out the price, she even looked at Connor with a provocative expression.
She was very confident in her price. She felt that Connor would not bid any higher to compete with her.
The middle-aged man beside Ruby turned his head and glanced at Ruby before speaking in a soft voice, “Miss, we’ve spent almost all the money we have on hand when we came out to purchase medicinal herbs this time. If the other party continues to raise the price, we’ll give up!”
“Alright, I got it!”
Ruby nodded lightly.
The Yandell family was indeed very rich, it wasn’t like the family belonged to Ruby alone.
Ruby had prepared nearly two billion dollars for this trip to the Medicine Kings’ Valley, and she had already spent most of it during this period of time.
She only had less than 100 million left, which was why the middle-aged man reminded her.
Connor looked at Ruby and said expressionlessly, “31 million!”
“You…”
Just when Ruby thought that Connor wouldn’t dare to continue bidding, Connor’s voice rang out once more.
Ruby looked at Connor’s position with a hint of anger in her eyes. After hesitating for two seconds, she shouted, “35 million!”
Obviously, Ruby was angry with Connor. She felt that Connor was provoking her.
Meanwhile, the middle-aged man looked at Ruby with a helpless expression.
“What is this Ruby trying to do? Why are you still raising the price at this time?”
Diana’s eyes flashed with a strange look, speechless.
“She’s angry with me!” Connor replied indifferently, then raised his hand and shouted, “50 million!”
When they heard the figure of 50 million, the crowd went into an uproar.
Even the host of this auction did not expect this medicinal herb to be auctioned for such a price.
At this moment, Connor gave these people the feeling that he was deliberately causing trouble. He actually increased the bid by 15 million in one go!
Ruby’s lips were trembling from Connor’s anger, but she had no intention of giving up. She opened her mouth and prepared to bid.
However, the middle-aged man beside Ruby hurriedly stretched out his hand to stop her. After that, he lightly shook his head at Ruby.
Ruby looked at the middle-aged man with a helpless expression. After hesitating for a moment, she didn’t continue bidding.
“…”
Seeing that Ruby didn’t continue to raise the bid, the host shouted, “50 million going once!”
“Going twice!”
“Going thrice!”
In the end, this medicinal herb was auctioned off by Connor for the price of 50 million.
“Does this bastard really have that much money?”
Ruby looked at Connor’s seat and frowned, muttering in displeasure.
On the other side, the host took the initiative to come in front of Connor and reminded him to pay the money.
After all, it was Connor’s first time bidding at an auction, so he did not record his own information at all. If Connor were to bid for this medicinal herb and run away immediately, that would be troublesome, so he followed along with the host and brought Diana and Carlos along.
Connor naturally did not participate in the following auction. After all, the next auction items should not have medicinal herbs that Connor was interested in.
Connor, Diana and Carlos followed the staff to the backstage of the auction and paid the money. When Diana received the herb, she carefully studied it in front of her, and a trace of excitement flashed across her eyes. She then whispered to Connor, “Mr. McDonald, this herb is indeed a thousand-year-old wild ginseng!”
“Is this what a thousand-year-old wild ginseng looks like?”
Connor asked in confusion.
“Mr. McDonald, don’t be fooled by its appearance…” Diana waved her hand and continued, “The real thousand-year-old wild ginseng should be in the middle of this piece of charcoal. If you agree, I can open it up for you to take a look now…”
“Then open it!” Connor nodded lightly. After all, this piece of charcoal did not have much value in Connor’s eyes.
After seeing that Connor had agreed, Diana took out some tools from her bag and began to knock on the charcoal-like surface of the medicinal herbs.
After about ten minutes, Diana finally cracked open the charcoal outside. A pale yellow wild ginseng appeared before Connor.
Connor stared at Diana with an expression of shock.
He never thought that Diana would be so powerful that she could see through the charcoal.
In fact, Connor didn’t have much hope. After all, even if Diana made a mistake, Connor wouldn’t blame her.
“How is it, Mr. McDonald? I didn’t lie to you, right?” Diana asked Connor with a smile.
“You’re really too amazing. You can even tell that this is the real deal…” Connor said in surprise.
“Of course. If it weren’t for that woman’s trouble, we could have bought this thousand-year-old wild ginseng for five million dollars. At that time, we would have made a huge profit. However, it’s a pity that we bought it for fifty million dollars in the end. It’s a bit of a loss…”
Diana felt angry whenever she thought of Ruby.
“It doesn’t matter as long as it’s a thousand year old wild ginseng!” Connor smiled faintly, then looked at Diana from head to toe and asked softly, “Diana, you seem to know a lot about herbs, huh?”
“That’s right. My grandfather is an alchemist. I’ve been living with my grandfather since I was young. The most important thing in alchemy is medicinal herbs, so it’s normal for me to understand their properties. Back then, I used to help my grandfather gather medicinal herbs…” Diana explained.
“Alchemist?”
Connor couldn’t help but be stunned when he heard Diana’s words. His expression was somewhat puzzled.
“That’s right, he’s an alchemist!”
Diana nodded.
“What a strange profession. I think I’ve only ever seen it in fantasy novels…”
Connor looked at Diana and smiled.
“Actually, there’s nothing strange about it. A few hundred years ago, alchemists were still very common. After all, technology was not developed at that time, and there were not so many pharmaceutical companies. If people wanted to see a doctor, they needed to eat pills…”
Diana smiled. “Moreover, medicinal pills can not only cure illnesses and heal injuries, but also strengthen the body. There are some more powerful medicinal pills that can also be used to increase the realm of martial artists. Nowadays, ordinary people will not eat medicinal pills at all, so naturally, they do not need alchemists. However, for martial artists, medicinal pills are still very precious. Only alchemists can maximize the use of these medicinal herbs!”

chapters.title: Chapter 790: You're Going to Precipice Cave, Right?
chapters.content:
Chapter 790: You’re Going to Precipice Cave, Right?
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
After hearing Diana’s words, Connor’s expression was particularly shocked.
He had never thought that there would be an alchemist in modern society!
In olden times, alchemists were still very common. After all, at that time, the field of medicine wasn’t very advanced yet. Therefore, if an ordinary person was sick or injured, they would choose to boil up some herbs or take pills to treat their ailments.
At that time, the main function of medicinal pills was still to treat illnesses and save lives. A small portion was also used to strengthen the body.
But Connor didn’t expect that a martial artist would also take medicinal pills!
Connor turned to look at Diana and asked softly, “Are there still many alchemists nowadays?”
“Not really, no…”
Diana shook her head and continued, “Actually, the profession of alchemist is about to disappear. After all, alchemy is a very complicated field to master. Moreover, ordinary people don’t need pills at all—only martial artists need pills. Alchemists who can refine pills that martial artists need are not common. Moreover, my grandfather stopped refining pills a long time ago…”
“I see…”
Connor looked at Diana and nodded, but didn’t say anything.
“Mr. McDonald, I think that Ruby Yandell’s purchase of so many precious herbs must have something to do with an alchemist. I suspect that Ruby Yandell must have met some powerful alchemist, which is why she bought so many precious herbs…”
Diana whispered to Connor.
“Alchemist?”
Connor’s eyes flashed with a trace of strangeness.
“Mr. McDonald, I also think that this possibility is very high. We martial artists still have a very high demand for medicinal pills. If any large family can have an alchemist and mass-produce medicinal pills, the value of any medicinal pill may be tens of millions. The cost of medicinal herbs is nothing in front of an alchemist…”
Carlos, who had always been quiet, said softly.
After Connor heard the conversation between the two, he instantly understood what was going on.
He then continued in a low voice, “You mean that Ruby Yandell somehow managed to get a powerful alchemist, which is why she’s buying so many herbs? You also think she wants to set up a production line so that alchemists can refine pills in large quantities and earn some benefits from it, right?”
“That’s right, Mr. McDonald, I think that’s what happened. Otherwise, Ruby Yandell wouldn’t have spent so much money on herbs!”
Diana nodded.
“I didn’t expect there to be such a way to earn money…”
Connor smiled faintly.
“The highest cost of refining a medicinal pill is only a few million, but the price of a medicinal pill is at least ten million. Therefore, the profit has directly increased by several times. If anyone can control this market, it is simply unimaginable…”
Carlos said to Connor.
“…”
After Connor heard this, a strange look flashed across his eyes.
If Connor could control this market, he would definitely be able to earn a lot of money.
There was just the small issue of Connor not knowing any alchemists at all, nor did he have this ability to refine pills!
Therefore, even if Connor had the heart to do this, no matter how envious he was, he could only be a fish out of water.
“Forget it. This matter has nothing to do with us. I’m here mainly to find the herbs that Jorge needs. Although I’m still missing a few herbs, I can ask Thomas Morgan to help me find those. The most important thing is the herb in the Precipice Cave…”
Connor said in a low voice.
When Diana heard Connor’s words, she was stunned for a moment before quickly saying, “Mr. McDonald, I asked the people here about the Precipice Cave, but they all said that it’s extremely dangerous…”
“If it wasn’t dangerous, Jorge wouldn’t have asked me to come!” Connor replied indifferently.
Diana looked at Connor and said softly, “Mr. McDonald, since you insist on going there, I won’t persuade you otherwise. However, I do know a person. He’s the only person in the valley who has been to the Precipice Cave and returned alive. He should know the exact location of the Precipice Cave, so if Mr. McDonald wants to go there, we can let that person lead the way. After all, if we have someone who knows the way, it will be much more convenient for us…”
“Alright, then get that person to lead the way…”
Connor nodded lightly.
“But…”
Diana looked up at Connor, her expression a little awkward.
“But what?”
Connor frowned and asked.
“However, this person’s personality is rather strange. If we want this person to lead the way, we might have to have a good chat with him…” Diana said slowly.
“Isn’t this kind of thing simple? If he doesn’t agree to lead the way for us, I’ll just beat him up…”
Carlos said expressionlessly.
“We can’t use force in this kind of thing. After all, he’s the only one in the entirety of Medicine Kings’ Valley who knows the location of the Precipice Cave. If we offend this person, then things will be troublesome. It’s better to have a good chat with him. If the other party has any requests, try your best to satisfy him…”
Connor whispered to Carlos.
Connor knew that Carlos had good intentions, but Carlos was too simple-minded and always liked to solve problems by force. In modern society, not every problem could be solved by force.
“Then, Mr. McDonald, shall I bring you to meet that person?” Diana asked Connor softly.
“Alright…”
Connor nodded his head lightly and then walked out of the manor.
After leaving the manor, Diana took Connor around Medicine Kings’ Valley and finally stopped in front of an ancient building. At this moment, the door of the building was open. Connor could clearly see a middle-aged man sitting in a rocking chair in the courtyard.
The middle-aged man looked a little ugly. He was wearing a black training suit, giving people the feeling that he was an otherworldly expert.
“Uncle Zhou…”
Diana walked into the courtyard and called out to the middle-aged man with a smile.
When the middle-aged man saw Diana enter, he couldn’t help but frown. He then laughed and said, “So it’s Miss Murphy. Come in quickly…”
Diana quickly turned her head to look at Connor, then brought him and Carlos towards the middle-aged man.
After arriving in front of the middle-aged man, Diana wanted to introduce Connor’s identity.
But before Diana could speak, the middle-aged man took the initiative to ask Connor, “You guys are going to Precipice Cave, right?”
After Connor heard the man’s words, he was instantly stunned on the spot. The expression on his face was very shocked. He couldn’t understand how the middle-aged man already knew why he was here!

chapters.title: Chapter 791: A Threat
chapters.content:
Chapter 791: A Threat
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
A strange look flashed in her eyes after Diana heard the middle-aged man’s words.
She could not help but turn to the middle-aged man and ask, “Uncle Timothy, how did you know we were going to the Precipice Cave?”
“Haha…”
The middle-aged man looked at Diana and smiled. He said softly, “Nine out of ten people who come to look for me, Timothy Jackman, are going to the Precipice Cave. You guys don’t have much interaction with me. If you suddenly come to my house to look for me, you must be going to the Precipice Cave…”
“That’s right. We want to go to the Precipice Cave. I wonder if you can lead the way for us…” Seeing Timothy’s straightforwardness, Connor didn’t waste any more time and went straight to the point.
Timothy looked at Connor indifferently and said, “Young man, if you want to go to the Precipice Cave, I advise you to consider it carefully. For so many years, the Precipice Cave has seen many dead bodies. Other than me, no one has come out alive, especially foreigners like you. I don’t know how many people have died there. Therefore, I advise you to give up on this idea. There’s no need to risk your lives for that little thing in the Precipice Cave…”
“You know the secret of the Precipice Cave?” Connor was stunned for a moment and asked Timothy.
“It is rumored that the Precipice Cave has an extremely precious medicinal herb. However, I don’t know if this rumor is true. Many people have died in the Precipice Cave because of this medicinal herb…” Timothy confirmed.
“Looks like there are indeed precious medicinal herbs in the Precipice Cave…” Connor nodded lightly.
“That place is perilous. You guys should not join in the fun…” Timothy whispered to Connor.
“What if I insist on going over to take a look?” Connor narrowed his eyes and asked Timothy.
“If you want to go, I can lead the way. However, I have to make things clear to you. I can only bring you to the entrance of the Precipice Cave. I will not follow you in….” Timothy said slowly.
“All right!” Connor nodded.
“There’s also a guide fee of one million dollars….” Timothy looked at Connor and continued.
“A million?”
After Diana heard this number, her mouth opened wide, and her expression was filled with incredulity.
She frowned and shouted, “Uncle Timothy, aren’t you asking for too much? We’re asking you to show us the way, not accompany us into the cave. You are asking for a million?”
“I earned this money with my life. Although I won’t accompany you, it doesn’t mean I won’t be in danger. Moreover, I’ve been paid this price for so many years. If you think it’s too expensive, find someone else to lead the way for you…” Timothy said firmly.
Diana looked at Timothy with a hint of helplessness in her eyes.
After all, only Timothy knew where the Precipice Cave was in the entire Medicine Kings’ Valley. If Timothy didn’t lead the way, it would take Connor, Diana, and Carlos a long time to find the Precipice Cave.
“All right, one million it is. As long as you can lead us to the Precipice Cave…” Connor hesitated before nodding.
Although it was indeed a little expensive, this amount of money was nothing to Connor.
“All right, when are you guys going to leave?” Seeing that Connor had agreed, his attitude immediately changed. He asked Connor with a smile.
“Wait!” However, at this moment, a woman’s voice came from outside the courtyard.
When everyone heard that, they subconsciously turned to look at the door.
Ruby brought her bodyguards into the courtyard.
After Connor saw Ruby, a strange look flashed in his eyes.
He could sense that Ruby was here for the Precipice Cave.
Ruby didn’t even look at Connor as she approached Timothy. She asked Timothy expressionlessly, “How much did these people give you now?”
“One million, what about it?” Timothy saw Ruby’s menacing look and hurriedly replied in a low voice.
“I’ll give you two million dollars. Take us there!” Ruby said to Timothy.
When Timothy heard Ruby’s words, he was stunned.
He subconsciously turned to look at Connor and the others, then whispered, “Everyone, I am sorry. Since this young lady’s bid is higher than yours, I will take them instead…”
Timothy was only leading the way for others to earn money. At this moment, Ruby was not someone to be trifled with. Moreover, Ruby’s offer was obviously higher. It was an extra million dollars. Timothy had no reason to reject it!
“I offer 2.1 million dollars!” Connor said to Timothy.
“What?” Hearing Connor’s words, Ruby couldn’t help but glare at him, then she gritted her teeth and shouted, “Are you deliberately going against me?”
“Are you deliberately going against me? Or am I deliberately going against you?” Connor asked expressionlessly, then continued, “We were the ones who came in first, and we’ve already agreed on the price. You were the one who suddenly came in and increased the price to snatch him from us.”
Connor had always disliked Ruby’s arrogant attitude, so he naturally wouldn’t be polite to her.
“I offer three million dollars!” Ruby stomped her feet in anger and shouted agitatedly.
“3.1 million!” Connor shouted indifferently.
“Four million…” Ruby had never been humiliated with money before. She had lost to Connor at the auction because of money.
Now, Connor wanted to use the money to humiliate her again. Naturally, Ruby was not going to let it go.
However, the middle-aged man beside Ruby put up his hand and stopped her. After that, he walked up to Connor and asked with a gentle expression, “How should I address you, young man?”
“Mr. McDonald!” Connor lightly replied.
“Ah, Mr. McDonald!” The middle-aged man smiled and continued, “Mr. McDonald, let me share a few words with you as a reminder…”
“…”
Connor looked at the middle-aged man and said nothing.
“In today’s society, you can’t do whatever you want just because you have money. Some things can’t be solved with money!” The middle-aged man chuckled.
Connor slowly looked up at the middle-aged man. He knew that the middle-aged man was threatening him.

chapters.title: Chapter 792: I Have One Condition
chapters.content:
Chapter 792: I Have One Condition
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
After Connor heard the middle-aged man’s threat, he showed no fear and even smirked.
“Since you said that there are some things in this world that money can’t solve, what else can you use to solve them?” he asked with a smile.
“Brat, I advise you to be sensible. The thing in the Precipice Cave is essential to us. If you insist on competing with us, don’t blame me for being rude…” The middle-aged man didn’t waste any more time talking to Connor and went straight to the point.
Connor and Ruby had some conflicts before, but because this middle-aged man didn’t want to cause trouble, he didn’t attack Connor.
However, it was different this time. Ruby was also here for the herbs in the Precipice Cave.
With Timothy leading the way, it would be easier for them to find the Precipice Cave.
That was why the middle-aged man threatened Connor. If he still didn’t know what was good for him, he didn’t mind using a more direct method to solve this problem.
Connor looked at the middle-aged man with a faint smile and asked softly, “Do you want to fight me?”
“I know you’re skilled, but to me, you’re nothing. Young man, don’t be too condescending. You’ll only harm yourself, so you’d better leave quickly!” The middle-aged man looked at Connor and said.
“If Mr. McDonald is not your match, then am I?”
Carlos did not hesitate when he heard the middle-aged man’s words. He walked straight to Connor.
The middle-aged man sized up Carlos with disdain in his eyes. He said coldly, “You want to try?”
“Let’s give it a try!” Carlos had always been a reckless person. He would not tolerate the middle-aged man’s provocation. Therefore, he dashed toward the middle-aged man without any hesitation.
“Ungrateful!” Ruby said with disdain after Carlos attacked.
In her eyes, Carlos’ behavior was simply suicidal.
Connor narrowed his eyes and looked at the middle-aged man. He knew that he had encountered a formidable opponent this time. Otherwise, the other party would not be so confident.
Meanwhile, Timothy looked at Connor and the others helplessly. At this moment, he did not care who would win.
He only cared about who gave him more money. He would lead the way for whoever gave him more money.
Carlos was so fast that he stood before the middle-aged man in no time. He raised his fist and punched the middle-aged man in the chest.
The middle-aged man stood there without moving. He had no intention of dodging at all.
Just as Carlos’ fist was about to hit his chest, the middle-aged man raised his right hand.
‘Thud!’
Carlos’s fist collided with the middle-aged man’s.
The middle-aged man stood still, but Carlos took a few steps back before finally steadying himself.
After Connor saw this, a trace of shock flashed in his eyes.
He did not expect the middle-aged man to be so powerful.
Jorge had said that Carlos could be considered a yellow-rank fighter, but this middle-aged man had the upper hand in the fight just now.
This meant that the middle-aged man was also a martial artist, and his strength was far above Carlos’.
Connor walked to Diana’s side and whispered to her.
After hearing Connor’s words, Diana nodded gently and walked toward Timothy.
On the other side, a strange look flashed in his eyes after Carlos steadied his body. Then, he strode forward to continue charging toward the middle-aged man.
“Carlos, stop!” But at this moment, Connor suddenly shouted.
Carlos quickly turned to look at Connor, a hint of confusion flashing in his eyes.
“You are not a match for this person. Let’s forget about it…” Connor looked at Carlos and explained.
Hearing Connor’s words, Ruby’s eyes flashed with disdain.
” Mr. McDonald, I…” Carlos seemed to be very unconvinced. He looked at Connor and wanted to speak.
“You don’t have to say anything…”
Connor waved his hand at Carlos, then walked to the middle-aged man and said expressionlessly, “I can give Timothy to you, but I have one condition!”
“What right do you have to negotiate with us now?” Ruby glared at him and asked in displeasure.
“I admit we are not your match, but don’t forget that Timothy is still in our hands. If you disagree with our conditions, I will fight to the death. At most, none of us can even dream of going to the Precipice Cave…” Connor said in a low voice.
When Ruby heard this, she immediately realized what was going on and quickly turned to look at Timothy.
Diana was holding a sharp knife in her hand and pressing it against Timothy’s neck.
Although Diana wasn’t a martial artist, her skills were far above those of ordinary people. It would be effortless for her to subdue Timothy.
“I advise you to listen to Mr. McDonald. Otherwise, I’ll kill this person now. None of us can go to the Precipice Cave then!” Diana said with a smile.
“Aren’t you afraid that we’ll kill the three of you?” Ruby shouted agitatedly.
“I don’t think you guys would dare. Although the three of us might not be a match for this person, it would take some effort to kill the three of us. Moreover, it would cost Timothy’s life. I believe you guys know how to choose wisely…” Connor said confidently.
“Haha…” When the middle-aged man heard Connor’s words, he couldn’t help but chuckle. Then, he said coldly, “You’re right. I don’t dare to attack you. If you have any conditions, name them!”
“I want to go to the Precipice Cave with you. Of course, I won’t follow you for nothing. We can bear half of this person’s expenses!” Connor calmly said to the middle-aged man.
“Why do you want to go to the Precipice Cave?” The middle-aged man narrowed his eyes and asked Connor coldly.
“We’re going there for the same reason you are going there…” Connor lightly replied.
“Hahaha…” The middle-aged man couldn’t help but laugh when he heard Connor’s words. Then, he said indifferently, “All right, I agree to your condition. We’ll gather here tomorrow morning and head to the Precipice Cave!”
“Uncle Ted!” Seeing the middle-aged man agree to Connor’s condition, Ruby shouted anxiously. “Why should we go to the Precipice Cave with this b*stard?”
