chapters.title: Chapter 793: Heading To The Precipice Cave
chapters.content:
Chapter 793: Heading To The Precipice Cave
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Ruby couldn’t understand why Uncle Ted would agree to Connor’s conditions. After all, those who went to the Precipice Cave were there for the medicinal herbs.
If they brought Connor and the others with them now, it would be equivalent to finding a time bomb for themselves.
After hearing Ruby’s question, Uncle Ted frowned and said in a low voice, “Miss, since we are all heading to the Precipice Cave, why don’t we become companions? We can take care of each other along the way…”
“Who wants to partner up with them?” Ruby replied unhappily as if she was very disdainful of Connor.
“Miss, please listen to me this time!” The middle-aged man said to Ruby seriously.
He knew he was stronger than Carlos, but if Connor and Diana attacked together, the middle-aged man would be heavily injured even if he won.
Therefore, rather than wasting time with Connor and the others, agreeing with Connor’s condition was better.
When Ruby saw the serious expression on Uncle Ted’s face, she couldn’t help but frown. Then, she said in a low voice, “All right then, I will not interfere in this…”
“You agreed to my conditions, right?” Connor looked at the middle-aged man and asked.
“Yeap…” The middle-aged man nodded lightly.
“When do you plan to leave?” Connor looked at the middle-aged man and asked.
“The sooner, the better…” The middle-aged man slowly replied.
“All right, we’ll set off at 7 AM tomorrow. We’ll still gather here, but I won’t let you take this person away…” Connor pointed at Timothy and said expressionlessly.
“Whatever you say!” the middle-aged man replied. He turned around and walked out of the courtyard without saying anything else. It was as if he was unafraid that Connor and the others would run away with Timothy.
Meanwhile, Ruby turned around and glared at Connor before leaving the courtyard.
“Mr. McDonald, if you hadn’t stopped me just now, I might have been able to defeat this person…” Carlos said to Connor with an unconvinced expression.
“So what if I’m defeated?” Connor said lightly.
“If I can defeat this person, we don’t have to go to the Precipice Cave with them. What if precious herbs are in the Precipice Cave, and they snatch them from us?” Carlos looked at Connor and continued asking.
“That is why I am telling you not to fight with him now. It will not be too late to wait until we reach the Precipice Cave and find the medicinal herbs. There is no need to waste your energy now. After all, we have come for the medicinal herbs this time around…” Connor said to Carlos.
“Mr. McDonald wants these people to lead the way before us. If we encounter any danger, these people will charge forward. We can save some effort if we get the medicinal herbs Mr. McDonald is looking for…” Diana explained to Carlos with a smile.
“I see…” Carlos only understood what was happening when he heard Diana’s explanation. So he quickly nodded.
Connor narrowed his eyes as he looked at the backs of Ruby and the others.
In fact, Connor knew that the middle-aged man agreed to his condition because he also thought so.
“Carlos, stay here and help me watch this person. I’ll go back with Diana first. We’ll come back to you tomorrow morning!” Connor was worried Timothy would run away overnight, so he deliberately left Carlos behind.
“Yes, Mr. McDonald!” Carlos nodded quickly after hearing Connor’s order.
Connor then followed Diana out of the courtyard.
***
Meanwhile…
After Ruby and the middle-aged man left Timothy’s courtyard, Ruby was confused.
She could not help but ask the middle-aged man, “Uncle Ted, I just don’t understand. Why do we have to bring those people with us? Can’t we go there ourselves?”
“Carlos is quite skilled. We happen to lack a scout. If they can help us scout, we can save much trouble….” The middle-aged man replied indifferently.
“Uncle Ted, you’re planning to let them be scapegoats!” Ruby smiled and continued, “What if these people snatch the medicinal herbs in the Precipice Cave from us when we reach it?”
“If they dare to snatch that herb from us, I’ll kill them!” When the middle-aged man said this, his expression was icy.
In his eyes, killing Connor and Carlos was as easy as killing a mouse.
***
The next day, at 7 AM.
Connor and Diana Murphy arrived at Timothy’s house again.
When Connor appeared, Ruby and the others were already waiting at the entrance.
Ruby was furious when she saw Connor and Diana walking over slowly.
She walked to Connor and shouted, “What’s wrong with you guys? Do you know how long we have been waiting for you here? Why don’t you have any sense of time?”
“Didn’t I tell you that we will meet at 7 AM? What does it have to do with me that you came early?” Connor glanced at Ruby and said expressionlessly.
After hearing Connor’s words, Ruby’s eyes flashed with anger. She shouted fiercely at Connor, “Are you still trying to defend yourself? It’s already 7:01, and you’re saying I’m early. I’ve never seen such a shameless person like you…”
Connor faintly smiled when he heard Ruby’s words. However, he didn’t continue to pay attention to her. Instead, he approached the middle-aged man and asked softly, “Can we set off now?”
“Yes.” The middle-aged man nodded, then pointed at a few off-road vehicles parked by the roadside and said, “The road conditions to the Precipice Cave are very bumpy, so I’ve prepared a few off-road vehicles. When the time comes, we’ll take the off-road vehicles!”
“All right…” Connor nodded.
A few minutes later, Connor and the others got into the off-road vehicle and drove toward the Precipice Cave.
Connor, Diana, and Carlos were in an SUV. There was a driver in the car, but Diana didn’t trust him, so she chased him out of the car and made Carlos drive.
Timothy sat in the SUV at the front and led the way.
Just like that, the people sat in the off-road vehicle and drove out of Medicine Kings’ Valley.

chapters.title: Chapter 794: Putting His Life On The Line For Love
chapters.content:
Chapter 794: Putting His Life On The Line For Love
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Along the way, Diana told Connor a lot about Ruby.
According to Diana’s understanding, Ruby was from the Yandell Family.
Moreover, her status in the Yandell Family was not low. She was a favorable competitor for the future head of the Yandell Family.
Ruby had been working so hard to develop this pill refining project so that she would have a better chance of competing for the position of family head in the future.
If Ruby couldn’t become the head of the Yandell Family in the future, then her final fate would be to marry a man she didn’t like because only then could she satisfy the needs of the Yandell Family.
Ruby wanted to escape this fate. Therefore, she had been working very hard since she was young. She wanted to prove that she was not inferior to any man in the Yandell Family.
Ruby had displayed an astonishing talent for business since she was very young.
In addition, the current head of the Yandell Family was also very fond of Ruby. Therefore, the probability of Ruby becoming the family head in the future was very high.
Unfortunately, Ruby was only a woman.
If a woman wanted to become the head of the Yandell Family, she had to work harder than the other heirs.
The middle-aged man with Ruby was called Ted Carlson and was very powerful.
But as for Ted’s background, Connor wasn’t evident, and Diana didn’t investigate.
With Timothy’s guidance, the convoy drove out of Medicine Kings’ Valley and headed toward the highway outside the Valley.
Diana played with her phone while Connor looked at the scenery outside the car window.
Medicine Kings’ Valley was located in a relatively remote area, so the scenery on the road was beautiful.
They drove for almost half an hour when Carlos suddenly stopped the car.
“Have we arrived?” Connor could not help but ask Carlos after he stopped the car.
“That can’t be…” Carlos shook his head slightly and continued, “I talked to Timothy yesterday. The Precipice Cave we’re going to isn’t in Davenport. It’ll take at least a day to get there by car, so we can’t have arrived so quickly…”
“Did something happen to the car in front?” Connor muttered softly, then pushed open the door and exited the car.
After getting out of the car, Connor saw several sports cars parked on the highway.
Next to the sports car, there were a few well-dressed men who were chatting with Ruby.
“What are these people doing?” Connor was stunned before he turned and asked Diana.
“These people are all rich heirs near Medicine Kings’ Valley. They must have received news that Ruby would pass by, so they waited for her here…” Diana explained softly.
“I didn’t expect Ruby to be so popular. She has suitors in such a place…” Connor could not help but sigh softly.
“Of course! Ruby’s family is wealthy, and she’s so beautiful. She’s very likely to inherit the position of the family head in the future. Many people have eyes on Ruby, but Ruby has never been in a relationship. She puts all her energy into her business. Right now, Ruby has seven or eight companies, some already listed on the stock market…” Diana looked at Connor and said slowly.
Hearing that, Connor’s eyes flashed with a trace of helplessness.
At this moment, Connor finally realized how big the gap between him and Ruby was.
Ruby’s age was similar to Connor’s, but compared to Connor’s achievements, Ruby was so far ahead.
Meanwhile.
When Ruby faced those rich kids, she was extremely arrogant. She crossed her arms and looked extremely cold, like a queen looking down on her subjects.
Ruby wasn’t interested in these rich kids, so she responded to them casually.
However, those rich kids weren’t angered by Ruby’s arrogance. On the contrary, they became even more enthusiastic. Each of them seemed excited. In their eyes, it was already their honor that Ruby would talk to them. They didn’t care about her attitude.
Ruby was already used to having these people fawning over her.
After all, Ruby had seen many suitors like him since she was young.
Ruby was a brilliant woman. When facing such suitors, she would not reject them directly. Instead, she would choose to get along with them as friends.
If that was the case, she could use these people eventually.
Among this group of wealthy heirs, the one with the highest status was the son of a deputy mayor named Westley Holland.
Westley walked up to Ruby and asked with a smile, “Ms. Yandell, where are you going this time?”
“We are going to the Precipice Cave…” Ruby didn’t hide anything and answered directly.
When Westley and the others heard Ruby’s words, they were stunned and in disbelief.
They had never expected Ruby to go to a dangerous place like the Precipice Cave.
“Ms. Yandell, the Precipice Cave is extremely dangerous. I suggest that you do not go there. Who knows how many people have died there during these few years…” Westley hesitated for a moment before reminding Ruby.
“It’s all right. I’m going there because it’s dangerous…” Ruby replied calmly. She looked at her phone and said softly, “Mr. Holland, it’s getting late. We have to set off, so I’ll take my leave first…”
“Ms. Yandell, do you know the exact location of the Precipice Cave?” Westley looked at Ruby and asked.
“Nope…” Ruby shook her head lightly, then looked at Timothy and said, “But this person knows where the Precipice Cave is!”
“Do you know where the Precipice Cave is?” Theo wasn’t as polite to Timothy as he was to Ruby. So he asked Timothy coldly.
“Yeap, I’m in charge of leading the way…”
Timothy knew Westley was the deputy mayor’s son and quickly replied respectfully.
“Where is the Precipice Cave? If it’s on the way, I can accompany you there…”
Westley was ready to risk his life accompanying Ruby to the Precipice Cave to win Ruby’s heart.
After Connor heard Westley’s offer, a trace of surprise flashed in his eyes. Then, he sighed internally. ‘I didn’t expect Westley to be so desperate. To win Ruby’s heart, he would even give up his life. He knows the Precipice Cave is extremely dangerous, but he still wants to follow!’

chapters.title: Chapter 795: Banquet
chapters.content:
Chapter 795: Banquet
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
If someone else had asked about the location of the Precipice Cave, Timothy would definitely not have told them.
After all, for so many years, Timothy had been relying on the information of the cave to earn money!
However, Timothy knew that Westley was not someone to be trifled with, and he also wanted to bring Ruby and the others to the Precipice Cave.
Therefore, he had nothing to hide now.
“Mr. Holland, the Precipice Cave is on Mount Dragon. However, I don’t know how to describe its exact location. After all, the roads on Mount Dragon are very complicated…”
Timothy replied softly after thinking for a moment.
“Mount Dragon?”
Westley smiled faintly, then turned to Ruby and said, “Miss Yandell, my house is near Mount Dragon. Why don’t I go with you? We can take care of each other…”
Ruby couldn’t help but hesitate after hearing Westley’s words.
She knew that Westley had some power in the Medicine Kings’ Valley. No matter what, Westley was the deputy mayor’s son. It would be much more convenient if Westley was by her side.
Therefore, Ruby turned to look at Ted, as if she wanted to see what Ted’s opinion was.
Ted looked at Ruby and nodded slightly but didn’t say anything.
“Alright then, you can go with us…”
Ruby said softly to Westley.
Seeing Ruby agree, Westley was a little excited. He quickly took out his phone and made a call.
Ten minutes later, four Mercedes-Benz G-Class appeared on the road and helped Ruby and the others clear the way.
That way, their speed increased significantly, saving them a lot of trouble. After all, with the jeep leading the way, ordinary cars would take the initiative to give way when they saw these luxury cars.
“I didn’t expect this group of rich guys to be so capable. They actually got four Mercedes-Benz G-Class to come over…”
Connor looked at the four Mercedes-Benz G-Class in front of the convoy and could not help but sigh softly.
“Mr. McDonald, Westley Holland has a very extraordinary background. It’s easy for him to call over a few Mercedes-Benzes!”
Diana Murphy turned to look at Connor and explained.
“Oh, I see…”
Connor nodded lightly and didn’t say anything.
Perhaps it was because there was a jeep leading the way ahead, the journey that originally took half a day took them less than two hours. They then arrived at a small county near Mount Dragon.
As the sky was already dark and the roads in Mount Dragon were very complicated, Timothy suggested that everyone rest in the county for the night and then enter the mountain at dawn the next day.
Ruby thought for a moment and agreed with Timothy’s suggestion.
When Westley found out that Ruby and the others were planning to stay in the county for a night, he booked a five-star hotel for them to stay in.
After everyone had checked into the hotel, Connor wanted to take a shower first and then get a good rest before setting off for Mount Dragon the next day.
However, just as Connor was about to rest, there was a knock on the door.
“Who is it?”
Connor asked softly.
“Mr. McDonald, I’m Ted Carlson. The county head found out that Miss Yandell was coming, so he has specially prepared a banquet in the banquet hall on the fifth floor. Therefore, I would like to invite you and your friends to attend. After all, you haven’t eaten tonight, right?”
Ted said politely.
When Connor heard Ted’s words, he couldn’t help but be stunned. He instinctively wanted to refuse, but he heard footsteps.
Ted didn’t give Connor a chance to refuse as he had already left.
After Ted left, Connor realized that he was indeed a little hungry, so he put on his clothes after hesitating for a while. Then, he called Diana and Carlos Lane out of their rooms.
A few minutes later, the three of them arrived at the banquet hall on the fifth floor.
At this moment, the banquet hall was already packed with people. All the famous people in the county, as well as rich heirs like Westley, were gathered around Ruby.
Ruby was dressed very beautifully today. She was wearing a short white dress. Her waist was slim, her breasts were full, and her legs were long and fair. With light makeup on her face, she looked both sexy and cold.
With such a beautiful face and a terrifying background, which man would not be moved by such a woman?
The reason why the county head was trying so hard to please Ruby was because he hoped that she would be in a good mood and invest in the county!
Although one or two hundred million was nothing to Ruby, to this small county, one or two hundred million was an extremely terrifying amount!
A moment later, everyone took their seats.
Ruby naturally sat on the main seat, while Ted sat beside her. The county head, Westley, and the others sat according to their status and background.
Connor, Diana and Carlos sat at a slightly more remote spot. After all, Connor was here to eat, and he didn’t care about anything else.
Soon, the waiter began to serve the dishes.
After the dishes were served, Connor did not waste any time. He picked up his cutlery and began to eat heartily.
Meanwhile, the guests around Ruby raised their cups and gave her a toast.
Ruby raised her glass and took a small sip of her drink. She did not touch the wine glass in front of her.
Connor was not in the mood to care about Ruby’s situation. He kept his head down and ate. He had to admit that the food in this hotel was very good.
“These people are really blind. A big shot like Mr. McDonald is right in front of them, but they didn’t even come over to toast him. Instead, they are just trying to please Ruby. This is ridiculous…”
Diana couldn’t help but whisper.
“They don’t know me. Isn’t that good? At least I can have a quiet meal…”
Connor said with a smile.
“…”
Diana turned to look at Connor, then whispered to him, “Mr. McDonald, I think you’re too low-key…”
“It’s not a bad thing to keep a low profile. At the very least, it can save us a lot of trouble. Alright, hurry up and eat.”
Connor looked at Diana and said.
“Alright…”
When Diana heard Connor’s words, she nodded helplessly.
On the other side, Ruby saw that Connor had been eating with his head lowered, and her face was filled with anger.
After hesitating for two seconds, she picked up the wine glass in front of her and walked toward Connor.
At this moment, Ruby actually had a smile on her face.
Everyone was stunned when they saw this scene. They had no idea what Ruby was trying to do.

chapters.title: Chapter 796: Vicious Woman!
chapters.content:
Chapter 796: Vicious Woman!
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Ruby held her wine glass and walked toward Connor.
She blinked her foxlike eyes, and the expression on her face was exceptionally seductive.
Ruby was wearing a white dress today, which was tightly wrapped around her chest, outlining her alluring curves.
From the start of the banquet until now, Ruby had never picked up her wine glass, nor had she taken a sip.
But at this moment, Ruby actually took the initiative to lift up her wine glass and stood up from her seat. This meant that Ruby was going to toast someone else.
When Westley saw this scene, a strange look flashed across his eyes.
He knew that since Ruby had taken the initiative to propose a toast, it meant that the person must have a deep relationship with Ruby.
A moment later, Ruby walked to Connor in her high heels and stopped.
Connor had been eating with his head lowered. He didn’t even notice Ruby walking in front of him, nor did he look up at her.
When Ruby realized that Connor was ignoring her, she was naturally furious.
However, she did not show it. Instead, she smiled at Connor and said, “Mr. McDonald, it is all thanks to you that we’re going to the Precipice Cave this time around. Therefore, this glass of wine is a toast to you…”
When Connor heard Ruby’s words, he was stunned. He then looked up at Ruby with a confused expression.
Connor didn’t know why Ruby was acting differently from how she acted before. At this moment, Ruby seemed to have changed into a different person. Also, Ruby said that it was all thanks to him that they were able to go to the Precipice Cave this time. However, Connor didn’t care whether Ruby could go or not. On the contrary, the two of them had always disliked each other!
Before Connor could react, Ruby had already finished the wine in her glass.
At this moment, the way everyone was looking at Connor had also changed greatly.
Ever since Ruby entered the banquet hall, she had not taken the initiative to drink with anyone.
Even if someone toasted her, Ruby would only take a sip of her drink.
However, Ruby actually took the initiative to toast Connor and even drank all the red wine in her glass. This was enough to prove how important Connor was to her.
At first, when these people saw Connor, they all felt that he was just an ordinary person, so they did not take him seriously.
However, after Ruby had finished drinking, everyone felt that Connor’s background was definitely not simple.
After drinking the wine, Ruby’s eyes flashed with a trace of pride. Then, she walked back to her seat in her high heels and looked at Connor. She knew that the show was about to begin.
At first, Connor didn’t understand what Ruby was trying to do, but when he saw the smug look in her eyes, he instantly understood what was going on.
At this moment, most of these rich guys were Ruby’s suitors. Ruby being all chummy with Connor would definitely cause those suitors to be jealous.
Ruby wanted to make her pursuers jealous of Connor, and then cause a conflict between Connor and these people. Then, she would just wait and watch the show.
‘This woman is really vicious!’
Connor could not help but sigh to himself.
As expected, after Ruby finished her toast.
The others present also gathered in front of Connor and began to take the initiative to toast him.
Ruby looked at Connor with a proud expression.
If Connor drank with these people one glass at a time, he would not be able to drink so much no matter how high his alcohol tolerance was.
However, if Connor didn’t drink it, it would mean that he didn’t give these people face. At that time, these people would definitely use this as a reason to find trouble with Connor.
After seeing the smug look in Ruby’s eyes, Connor’s face was filled with helplessness.
“Mr. McDonald, this glass of wine is my toast to you.”
At this moment, a young man raised the wine glass in his hand and downed the white wine in the glass.
After the young man had finished drinking, he subconsciously glanced at Connor’.
However, Connor did not react at all. He was still sitting quietly in his seat and eating, as if he did not take him seriously at all.
“Mr. McDonald, what do you mean by this?”
The young man frowned and asked Connor with an unhappy expression.
“I don’t know how to drink…”
Connor replied calmly.
Connor had already guessed Ruby’s true purpose, but he couldn’t actually drink with these people.
If Connor really drank with these people, he would have to drink at least two or three bottles of white wine.
Although Connor’s alcohol tolerance was not low, if he really drank two or three bottles of white wine, he would definitely not be able to get up tomorrow.
Tomorrow, they were going to Mount Dragon to look for the Precipice Cave. Connor did not want to delay that because of alcohol.
When everyone heard Connor’s words, they were all stunned, and they were very puzzled.
They did not expect Connor to be so disrespectful. He had already finished his glass of wine, but Connor actually said that he didn’t know how to drink.
If he didn’t know how to drink, why didn’t he just take a sip?
However, Connor’s asnwer indeed made people feel that it was somewhat inappropriate.
As for the young man who toasted Connor earlier, a trace of viciousness flashed across his eyes. He then said in a low voice, “It seems that I’m not worthy of your respect.”
After saying this, the young man returned to his seat.
At this moment, everyone looked at Connor with displeasure.
Ruby became even more smug because this was exactly what she wanted to see.
Westley sat on the spot and hesitated for two seconds. Then, he picked up his wine glass and said to Connor, “Mr. McDonald, let me toast you. You have to give me some face!”
When Westley said this, his face was filled with arrogance, and his tone was very arrogant.
After all, Westley was the son of the deputy mayor, so Westley felt that no matter how bold Connor was, he would definitely not dare to not give him face.
If he offended Westley, would that truly be a wise decision to make?
The others present seemed to think the same. They felt that Connor did not have the guts to reject Westley.
“I already said that I don’t drink. Didn’t you hear me?”
Connor turned and looked at Westley indifferently. His tone was cold as he spoke to Westley.
When everyone heard Connor’s words, they were all dumbfounded. Their mouths were wide open. No one had expected Connor to not even give Westley face.

chapters.title: Chapter 797: Heading to Mount Dragon
chapters.content:
Chapter 797: Heading to Mount Dragon
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
When Westley heard Connor’s words, his face darkened, and a hint of viciousness flashed across his eyes.
Westley did not expect that Connor would actually dare to speak to him like this!
It was obvious what Connor meant. He was obviously saying, “Who do you think you are, Westley Holland? I said I don’t drink, so I don’t drink!”
Westley felt like he had been slapped by Connor.
Connor’s words just now might have made him feel even more uncomfortable than slapping him in front of so many people.
Ruby quietly looked at Westley. She was curious about what Westley would do next!
“Brat, aren’t you a little too arrogant? You get such a rare chance of getting a toast from Mr. Holland, but you actually rejected him?”
One of the young men stood up and shouted at Connor.
Connor looked at the young man indifferently and said coldly, “I’ve already made it very clear just now. I don’t drink, but he still wants to propose a toast. That’s his problem!”
“What do you mean?”
Westley asked Connor in a low voice with a gloomy face.
“Nothing much…”
Connor calmly replied before turning to say to Diana and Carlos, “We’re almost done eating. Let’s go back!”
After saying this, Connor completely ignored Westley. Instead, he stood up and walked out of the hall.
Westley stood where he was and hesitated for a couple of seconds. Then, he threw the wine glass on the floor.
However, Connor still did not react and continued to walk out of the hall.
Everyone looked at Connor’s back, and a trace of helplessness flashed across their eyes.
Westley must be very angry at this moment. Offending Westley at Mount Dragon was not a good thing.
Ruby looked at Connor’s back as he left, and a look of surprise appeared on her face. She didn’t expect Connor to offend Westley.
Westley was the son of the deputy mayor. A person of this level was not someone that anyone could provoke.
Even though Ruby was extremely arrogant toward Westley, she didn’t dare to offend him.
Ruby couldn’t understand where Connor’s confidence came from. He actually dared to offend Westley.
But no matter what, Ruby had already achieved her goal, so she was still very happy.
“Miss, there’s actually no need for you to do this…”
Ted Carlson hesitated for a moment before speaking to Ruby.
“I just wanted to teach Connor a lesson. I didn’t expect Connor to have such a temper. He even dares to offend Westley…”
Ruby said calmly.
“I got someone to investigate Connor McDonald’s identity…”
Ted said in a low voice.
“Who is he?”
Ruby seemed to be very concerned about Connor’s identity as she hurriedly asked Ted.
“Based on the investigation, Connor is just an ordinary university student. There is nothing special about him…”
Ted replied.
“An ordinary university student actually dares to be so arrogant. He must really want to die…”
When Ruby found out about Connor’s identity, her eyes flashed with disdain.
“Miss, that’s oversimplifying things. If Connor is really just an ordinary university student, how could he have so much money? Moreover, the two people beside him are not ordinary people, so I feel that Connor is definitely not as simple as what we know. It’s just that with our current ability, we can’t investigate who he really is…”
Ted said slowly.
“Uncle, even you can’t find out who Connor is. Exactly how mysterious is Connor’?”
Ruby finally understood what Ted meant. A trace of shock flashed across her eyes.
“Forget it, now is not the time for this. As long as we can get the spiritual herb, everything else can be discussed later!”
Ted replied.
Ruby glanced at Ted but didn’t say anything.
…
The next day, at eight o’clock in the morning.
Connor, Ruby, and the others gathered at the entrance of the hotel. This time, Westley actually brought a few bodyguards with him.
Westley’s bodyguards seemed to be quite skilled. If they were to encounter any danger, they would be able to help. Therefore, Ruby allowed Westley to follow them.
When Westley saw Connor, a trace of anger flashed across his eyes.
However, he didn’t bother with Connor. Instead, he stayed beside Ruby and chatted with her.
Because the roads in Mount Dragon were very complicated, and many of them were muddy roads, it was impossible for cars to travel. Therefore, everyone could only walk into Mount Dragon.
Timothy Jackman walked at the front, while Ruby and the others followed closely behind him. Connor, Diana and Carlos were at the back.
Because the roads in Mount Dragon were very complicated, and Timothy had not been to Mount Dragon for a long time, they were moving rather slowly.
After an entire morning, they had only covered less than five kilometers.
Based on Timothy’s judgment, if they continued at this speed, they would need at least three days to find the Precipice Cave.
Of course, Connor was not satisfied with this speed, but he had no choice.
Ruby, Westley and the others were all young masters and ladies from wealthy families. Naturally, they couldn’t endure such hardships.
Therefore, the two of them had to rest for a while before they could continue walking.
In the blink of an eye, the sky began to darken.
Timothy felt that the situation in Mount Dragon was very complicated. If they were to travel at night, they might encounter some danger. Moreover, Ruby and the others could not take it anymore.
Therefore, everyone could only choose to rest where they were and wait until the sun rose the next morning before setting off.
Carlos had been in the special forces for a few years, so he was very experienced in surviving in the wild.
He knew that it was impossible to find the Precipice Cave even though they were already on Mount Dragon, so Carlos had prepared some food and tents beforehand.
As for Ruby, she had so many bodyguards with her and these bodyguards were all carrying heavy luggage, so they did not lack anything. They even brought some barbecue grills, seasonings, and other things.
Everyone first lit a bonfire and then began to set up tents.
Connor, Carlos, Diana, and the other two chose an empty space and set up their tents, about to get some rest for the night.
As for Ruby, after seeing the tents that Connor and the others had set up, her expression was filled with disdain. No one knew what she was thinking.

chapters.title: Chapter 798: What do You Mean by That?
chapters.content:
Chapter 798: What do You Mean by That?
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Carlos prepared two tents before they left.
One of them was prepared for Diana, and the other was prepared for Carlos and Connor.
When the Diana heard Carlos’s arrangement, she was very unconvinced.
She felt that it was not safe for a girl to sleep in a tent alone, so she insisted on having Carlos sleep in a tent by himself. She wanted to sleep in the same tent as Connor.
When Connor heard Diana’s words, he was extremely helpless, not knowing what to say.
“It’s so dangerous for a girl like me to sleep alone in a tent. I want to sleep with Mr. McDonald so that he can protect me…”
Diana said sweetly.
Carlos looked at Diana helplessly and said in a low voice, “If you think it’s dangerous, then sleep in the same tent as me. Let Mr. McDonald sleep alone…”
“Get lost. I don’t want to sleep with you! What if you take advantage of me?”
When the Diana heard Carlos words, she glared at him angrily.
When Connor heard the conversation between the two of them, he smiled faintly and did not say anything.
After all, Connor knew that Diana was just teasing him.
“Mr. McDonald, Miss Yandell is asking you to join her for dinner…”
At this moment, a bodyguard in a black suit ran toward Connor and whispered to him.
“Alright…”
Connor nodded his head lightly and said to Diana and Carlos, “Let’s go over and eat…”
“Mr. McDonald, I prepared some dry rations before we set off. Let’s just eat on our own.”
Carlos had never liked Ruby and the others, so he didn’t want to have dinner with them.
“We still don’t know when we will be able to find the Precipice Cave. Let’s go over and eat with them. Leave the dry rations for later…”
Connor knew what Carlos was thinking, but he didn’t think it was the time to be angry with Ruby and the others.
Before they found the Precipice Cave, Connor and the others had to conserve their strength.
If there was a conflict in the Precipice Cave, Connor only had three people, but Ruby had many bodyguards and Ted.
So, at this time, Connor did not dare to lower his guard at all.
A moment later, Connor, Carlos and Diana arrived next to Ruby and the others.
“Mr. McDonald, you’re here.”
Ted laughed and shouted at Connor.
“Mr. Carlson…”
Connor greeted Ted.
“Mr. McDonald, please sit. Let’s eat together…”
Ted said softly.
“Okay!”
Connor walked straight to Ted.
When Ruby saw Connor walking over, she couldn’t help but hesitate for a moment before turning to look at Westley.
When Westley saw Ruby’s gaze, he immediately understood what was going on. He shouted at Connor coldly, “I’m sorry, Mr. McDonald. We didn’t bring much when we left, especially roasted meat and fruits. It’s only enough for us…”
When Connor heard Westley’s words, he was instantly stunned. Then, he frowned and asked, “What do you mean by that?”
“Since we’re going into the mountain together, I definitely won’t let you guys go hungry. Why don’t we do this? There are some instant noodles over there. If you don’t mind, you can go and make instant noodles…”
Westley said as he pointed at the instant noodles not far away.
At this moment, Westley’s bodyguards were squatting on the ground eating instant noodles.
Westley was obviously humiliating Connor. After all, only his subordinates were eating instant noodles.
Ruby heard Westley’s words and smiled faintly, but she didn’t say anything.
Ted couldn’t help but sigh. In his opinion, Ruby and Westley’s were being too childish. There was no need to humiliate Connor like this.
If they really angered Connor, the two sides would fight, and it would affect their progress.
“You guys are eating and drinking good food here, yet you want us to eat instant noodles?”
Diana shouted at Westley with her big watery eyes.
When Westley heard Diana words, he couldn’t help but look at her from head to toe, and then whispered, “Beauty, if you want to eat roasted meat, you can come to our side. I can give you some roasted meat, but these two people can only eat instant noodles…”
“Get lost! No one wants your food!”
Diana glared at Westley; her face filled with anger.
“If you don’t want our food, then you can go on back…”
Westley sneered.
Diana tugged at Connor and said softly, “Mr. McDonald, let’s go. These people are clearly playing with us…”
“Of course, I know they are playing with us!”
Connor replied indifferently and then continued, “But even so, don’t we still have instant noodles to eat? These instant noodles shouldn’t be cheap either. Let’s eat more…”
After saying this, Connor walked straight to the pile of instant noodles and picked up three boxes of instant noodles before returning to Diana and Carlos.
Ruby, Westley, and the others were all stunned when they saw this. Their faces were filled with disbelief.
They did not expect that not only was Connor not angry, but he even gladly accepted it.
Even an ordinary person would not be able to accept such a situation, right?
Ted narrowed his eyes and looked at Connor with a surprised expression.
Connor knew that now was not the time to be angry with Ruby and Westley. After all, they were all here for the spiritual herbs, so it was important to maintain their strength.
Whether it was instant noodles or roasted meat, Connor felt that as long as he could fill his stomach, it would be fine.
Although Carlos had brought some rations, they would not last for more than a few days. Connor did not want to run out of rations before he reached the Precipice Cave.
By then, even if they found the spiritual herbs, Connor and Carlos wouldn’t have the strength to snatch them from Ruby and Ted.
“Mr. McDonald, what are you doing?”
Diana frowned and shouted at Connor.
“Let’s eat…”
Connor replied.
“Mr. McDonald, I still have some dry rations here. There’s no need for us to eat these people’s food…”
Carlos did not seem to understand Connor’s behavior and shouted at him in a low voice.
“I know you have dry rations in your hands, but don’t we have free instant noodles for us to eat? It won’t be too late for us to eat dry rations after we have finished eating these instant noodles in a few days’ time…”
Connor said to Carlos.

chapters.title: Chapter 799: Having Value
chapters.content:
Chapter 799: Having Value
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Carlos looked at the instant noodles in Connor’s hand with a helpless expression.
With Carlos’s personality, he definitely could not accept Westley’s humiliation.
However, since Connor insisted on eating it, Carlos could not say anything.
Ruby, Westley, and the others thought that Connor would choose not to eat the noodles. This way, not only would it consume their stamina, but it would also humiliate them.
But no one would have imagined that Connor actually didn’t care one bit.
When Westley saw Connor take the instant noodles with him, a strange look flashed across his eyes. Then, he said in a low voice, “I shouldn’t have offered them instant noodles. Why are they so happy about eating instant noodles…”
“Forget it. It’s just a few boxes of instant noodles. We don’t know when we will be able to reach the Precipice Cave. I want to see how many long they can eat instant noodles for…”
Ruby replied calmly.
Westley turned to look at Connor. A trace of disdain flashed across his eyes, but he did not say anything.
Connor and the others boiled some water and started eating instant noodles.
Ted saw Connor and the other two sitting there eating instant noodles with relish. He couldn’t help but sigh. He picked up the roasted meat in front of him and walked toward Connor.
Ruby was confused when she saw this. She quickly asked Ted in a low voice, “Uncle Carlson, what are you doing?”
“Miss, we don’t have any deep hatred with Mr. McDonald. There’s no need for you to do this…”
Ted said lightly.
“Uncle Carlson, don’t forget that these people are also here for the spiritual herbs in the Precipice Cave…”
Ruby hurriedly continued.
“Of course, I know that. There’s not only one kind of spiritual herb in the Precipice Cave, and we don’t know whether the spiritual herb that Mr. McDonald and the others are looking for is the same kind as the one we’re looking for. Even if it’s the same kind, it’s not too late to fight each other when we find it. What you’re doing now is completely meaningless. Moreover, the Precipice Cave is very dangerous. I’m sure that Mr. McDonald and the others will be able to help when the time comes…”
Ted said helplessly.
“What can those three good-for-nothings do?”
Ruby replied disdainfully, but she didn’t stop Ted.
Ted walked up to Connor and said with a smile, “Mr. McDonald, our Young Miss has always been like this. I hope you won’t lower yourself to the same level as her…”
“I won’t lower myself to the same level as a woman. Moreover, you’ve given us instant noodles. That’s more than enough…”
Connor replied lightly.
“Mr. McDonald, you really have a good attitude!”
Ted smiled faintly and placed a piece of roasted meat in front of Connor.
“You can take this piece of roasted meat back. I don’t need it…”
Connor looked at Ted and said expressionlessly.
“Mr. McDonald…”
Ted opened his mouth to speak.
“I already told you just now that you’ve provided us with instant noodles, and that’s good enough for us. We don’t need anything else.”
Connor said in a very serious tone.
Ted looked at Connor and sighed softly. He didn’t know what to do. He picked up the roasted meat and turned around to leave.
“I didn’t expect Ted Carlson to be so sensible…”
Diana sighed as she looked at Ted’s back.
“He merely thinks that there is value in having us on the same side…”
Connor said lightly.
“Value?”
Diana couldn’t help but be stunned when she heard this, and she was a little confused.
“That’s right. The Precipice Cave is full of danger. If the three of us can maintain our strength, we can help out when the time comes. However, if the three of us can’t even eat our fill, or if we are unwilling to help out, then it’s not a good thing for these people. Ted is obviously smarter than Ruby and Westley…”
Connor whispered to Diana.
“I see. It seems that these people are really sinister. If the three of us had no value, we would have been abandoned long ago!”
Diana couldn’t help but sigh.
“Hurry up and eat. After you’re done eating, go get a good rest. We have a long day ahead of us tomorrow…”
Connor replied expressionlessly, then picked up the instant noodles and ate them in big mouthfuls.
Carlos and Diana looked at Connor in surprise.
This was because the two of them realized that Connor was different from many rich guys. If it were other rich guys facing this situation, they would not be so calm and would definitely not eat instant noodles.
However, Connor was able to endure it. Perhaps this was the difference between him and Ruby and Westley.
After dinner, the three of them returned to their tents to rest.
Westley’s bodyguards were patrolling around the tent, so Connor and the others didn’t have to worry about their safety at night.
The next day, at seven o’clock in the morning.
After everyone had woken up, they washed up briefly and continued on their way.
Along the way, Ruby and Westley looked like they were on a vacation. Every hour they walked, they would have to rest for half an hour.
They took three days to complete a journey that would normally take two days.
Connor was not in a hurry, so he did not say anything.
In these three days, Ruby and Westley’s attitude toward Connor didn’t change, but they didn’t provoke him either.
Three days later.
Timothy Jackman stopped in front of a cave and said to Ruby, “Miss Yandell, the Precipice Cave is inside. This is where we part ways. You will have to rely on yourself for the rest of the journey…”
“Alright, I understand…”
Ruby replied casually and continued, “I’ve already gotten someone to transfer your fees to you…”
“Miss Yandell, the Precipice Cave is really dangerous. You should reconsider before entering. Many people have died in this cave…”
Timothy whispered to Ruby.
“We have many bodyguards with us. So what if there’s danger?”
Before Ruby could speak, Westley shouted.
Timothy looked at Westley helplessly and said, “Miss Yandell, Mr. Holland, since you insist on going in, so be it. If there’s nothing else, I’ll take my leave now!”

chapters.title: Chapter 800: Precipice Cave Entrance
chapters.content:
Chapter 800: Precipice Cave Entrance
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Hearing Timothy’s words, Ruby hesitated for a moment.
However, she felt that Timothy was no longer of any value to her.
So, she nodded and said softly, “Alright, then go to the bodyguards and get some dry food. Then, you can go back!”
“Alright!”
Timothy replied before hurriedly walking away in a panic.
After seeing Timothy leave, Ruby turned around and gave her bodyguard a look.
Seeing Ruby’s gaze, the bodyguard turned around and disappeared.
Although the bodyguard’s movements were very secretive, Connor still observed this detail. Connor vaguely felt that something was wrong.
Ruby wouldn’t let Timothy leave so easily.
However, Connor was not in the mood to care about these things. He narrowed his eyes and looked at the entrance of the Precipice Cave.
At this moment, everyone was standing in front of a cave. The cave was very large, and the entrance was about five meters high.
Even if all these people went in together, there shouldn’t be any problems.
“Uncle Carlson, are we going to go in now?”
Ruby turned and glanced at Ted before asking him in a soft voice.
“Since we’re already here, let’s go in and take a look. The bodyguards will walk in front…”
Ted shouted expressionlessly.
After hearing Ted’s words, the bodyguards became nervous.
However, they didn’t dare to disobey Ted Carlson, so they took out their weapons and walked into the cave.
Ted, Ruby, and the others followed behind the bodyguards, while Connor, Carlos and Diana followed behind them.
It was pitch black inside the cave, and nothing could be seen.
Fortunately, Ruby’s bodyguards had prepared lighting tools beforehand.
When the torchlights lit up, everyone could clearly see the situation inside the cave.
The cave was very spacious, and there were some footprints left behind by humans, which meant that someone had been here not long ago.
Everyone walked in trepidation for nearly an hour, but they still did not find the end of the cave.
“Did Timothy lie to us? Why do I feel like there’s no end to this cave?”
Westley realized that after walking for a long time, they still could not find anything. A trace of confusion flashed across his eyes as he frowned and muttered.
“Impossible, Timothy doesn’t have the guts to do that!”
Ruby replied and continued,”Timothy told me that I would only be able to see the entrance of the Precipice Cave after passing through this cave…”
“How long will this take?”
Westley seemed to be getting impatient.
“If you don’t want to go in, you can go back. No one asked you to follow me in!”
Ruby frowned and said to Westley with a displeased expression on her face.
Hearing Ruby’s words, Westley revealed an awkward smile and quickly explained, “Miss Yandell, look at what you’re saying. I’m here to protect you. How can I go back?”
“…”
Ruby glanced at Westley and continued walking without saying anything.
Connor, Diana, and Carlos followed behind Ruby and the others, observing their surroundings.
After walking for about an hour, everyone finally saw light in front of them!
This light gave everyone a boost.
After walking for so long, they were finally reaching the end!
When everyone knew that they were about to leave the cave, they quickened their pace and walked toward the light.
At this moment, Ruby’s face was filled with excitement because she knew that the Precipice Cave was right in front of them.
After walking for another ten minutes.
Everyone finally walked out of the cave. The dazzling light shone on their faces, and everyone subconsciously reached up to cover their eyes.
Connor squinted and observed the situation in front of him.
At this moment, they were in a valley. The terrain of the valley was dangerous. The undulating hills were overgrown with weeds and towering trees.
After passing through the overgrown hills, they came across a dense thicket. After coming out of the thicket, Connor and the others saw a cave.
There were two big words written above the cave.
Precipice Cave!
Ruby also saw the words ‘Precipice Cave’, and her eyes flashed with excitement.
She quickly turned around and said to Ted, “Uncle Carlson, we’ve finally found the Precipice Cave!”
“Looks like the rumors are true. The Precipice Cave really exists!”
Ted’s eyes flashed with excitement.
“Since we’ve found the cave, why are we still standing here? Let’s go in…”
Westley said with a smile. Then, he led his bodyguards into the cave.
“Wait!”
Seeing that Westley was about to enter the cave, Ted hurriedly shouted.
However, before he could finish speaking, a few bodyguards had already walked toward the entrance of the cave.
Swoosh…
In the next second, countless poisonous stingers flew out from the entrance.
“Dodge!”
Ted shouted and pushed Ruby down.
As for Connor, Diana, and Carlos, they were at the back, so they weren’t hit by the poisonous stingers.
However, the bodyguards who followed Westley here weren’t so lucky.
In an instant, five or six bodyguards fell to the ground and instantly vomited blood!
When everyone saw this scene, they were all dumbfounded. Their mouths were wide open, and they were extremely shocked.
Ruby looked at the bodyguards on the ground with numb hands and legs, and her delicate body couldn’t help but tremble.
Because Westley had bodyguards by his side to help him block the poisonous stingers, Westley had escaped disaster this time. However, Westley had long been so frightened that his legs went weak, and he sat on the ground with a plop.
Right before this happened, these people were still immersed in the excitement of finding the Precipice Cave. However, no one expected that so many people would die in front of the cave in the next second.
“No wonder those who came to the Precipice Cave have never returned…”
Connor looked at the corpses on the ground and could not help but sigh softly.
The stingers that had flown out were extremely fast, and the angles were very tricky.
If it were an ordinary person, there was no way for them to escape. Death was inevitable.
“Luckily, these people were ahead of us to scout the way. Otherwise, we might have been the ones who are dead!”
Diana turned to look at Connor and said softly.
‘That bastard Jorge Yarrell. He knew that this place was so dangerous, but he still asked me to come and find spiritual herbs for him. If I wasn’t lucky, I would be the one lying there now…’
Connor couldn’t help but curse Jorge in his heart.

chapters.title: Chapter 801: Someone Is Here!
chapters.content:
Chapter 801: Someone Is Here!
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
After experiencing the thrilling scene just now, the people present all showed fear on their faces.
Especially the bodies of these bodyguards, still lying in front of them, and their appearance is extremely miserable.
Although many people had warned them before that Precipice Cave is a very dangerous place.
But Ruby, Westley, and others didn’t take this matter to heart at all.
After all, they had so many bodyguards around them, and there was also a experts like Ted. They believed that even if they encountered any danger, Ted could handle it.
But no one expected that the danger would come so suddenly.
Before everyone could react to what was happening, those bodyguards had all fallen in a pool of blood.
Now everyone’s hearts were on edge, and they finally realized how dangerous Precipice Cave really was.
Ruby took a deep breath and slowly stood up, pretending to be calm, she asked Ted, “Uncle Ted, wha… what should we do now?”
Ted squinted his eyes and hesitated for two seconds as he looked towards the entrance of Precipice Cave. Then he said in a low voice, “I don’t know what to do now either. We have never been to Precipice Cave, and I’m not sure if there are still dangers inside!”
“Miss Ruby, how about… how about we go back? This place is just too dangerous!”
Westley trembled as he shouted at Ruby.
After seeing Westley’s appearance, a trace of disdain flashed in Ruby’s eyes. She then said, “The more dangerous it is here, the more precious the things hidden here. I have already found Precipice Cave. How can I leave now?”
“But what if there are more traps or dangers inside?”
Westley asked Ruby in a low voice.
She paused for a moment upon hearing his words, then turned directly to Connor, Carlos and Diana and shouted loudly, “You three go ahead and scout the way…”
“Hehe…”
Upon hearing Ruby’s words, Connor couldn’t help but sneer, and coldly said, “Now you remember the three of us?
“You better stop talking nonsense and go scout the way for me!”
At this moment, whoever died, Ruby would feel very heartbroken.
But three of them had no relationship with Ruby.
So she thought it was best to let Connor and the others scout the way ahead. Even if they encountered any danger later, it would be him and the others who died.
“I’m not going…”
Connor didn’t hesitate at all, he directly shook his head at Ruby.
She was stunned for a moment upon hearing his words, then she turned her head and looked at him, frowning, and asked, “What did you say?”
“I said I’m not going, didn’t you hear me?”
He replied indifferently, then continued, “There are dangers inside, the three of us going in would be a death sentence. I haven’t had enough of life yet…”
“Now it’s not your turn to speak. If you don’t go, do you believe I’ll kill you right now?”
Ruby’s expression was fierce, and she threatened Connor angrily.
“Kill me?”
Connor sneered and said, “If you have the ability, go ahead and try…”
Ruby turned to Ted.
But Ted’s eyes revealed a hint of helplessness. Although Ted’s strength was indeed superior to Carlos’s, it wouldn’t be easy for Ted to kill him if he really went all out. Moreover, Connor, Carlos and Diana were also skilled individuals. Even if they could win in a fight, they would have to pay a significant price.
Therefore, it wasn’t a wise choice for Ted to make a move against Connor and the others.
“Miss, it’s not the time for internal conflicts. Let’s think about how to enter Precipice Cave,” Ted said softly to Ruby.
“Let the three of them go ahead and scout the way. Then we can enter Precipice Cave,” Ruby shouted.
Ted’s expression showed a bit of helplessness. After all, nobody was foolish enough to walk in front, as it would be the most dangerous position. Therefore, Connor and the others couldn’t possibly go first.
“Or maybe I should go ahead and scout the way. You all keep a certain distance from me. If we really encounter any danger, I can find a way to evade it. Just make sure to protect yourselves…” Ted shouted expressionlessly.
“Uncle Ted, it’s so dangerous here…” Ruby frowned and shouted.
“I have the best skills here. It’s the safest for me to go first!” Ted replied lightly to Ruby and didn’t continue wasting words. He directly walked towards the entrance of the cave.
Ruby glared fiercely at Connor before following Ted’s steps.
Westley hesitated for two seconds and then gritted his teeth and followed them.
Connor remained motionless.
“Mr. Connor, aren’t we going with them?” Carlos asked Connor in a low voice.
“Let’s not rush. We can enter after they go in. Precipice Cave is very dangerous. If they want to enter, it won’t be that simple!” Connor replied casually to Carlos.
After hearing his words, Carlos nodded lightly and didn’t say anything more.
“This Ruby is truly malicious. She even wants us to go and die. Does she really take us for fools?” Diana sneered coldly, looking at Ruby’s back with a very displeased expression.
Connor turned his head and glanced at her without saying anything.
On the other side, Ted led Ruby and the others towards the position of Precipice Cave.
At this moment, fear and caution were evident on their faces, fearing that poisonous needles might suddenly fly out.
Ted was also very cautious at this time.
However, just as everyone was about to enter the cave, Ted suddenly waved his hand and stopped his footsteps.
Upon seeing him stop, everyone else also halted.
“Uncle Ted, what’s wrong?” Ruby hesitated for a moment and asked Ted softly.
“There are footsteps. Someone should be coming…” Ted whispered.
“Somebody is coming?” After hearing his words, everyone froze in place, their expressions filled with disbelief.
After all, they had gone through countless hardships to find Precipice Cave. How could someone else be here?
Everyone turned their heads to the location they had just come out of.
“Not from there. There are people inside Precipice Cave!” Ted whispered.
After hearing Ted’s words, everyone’s expressions seemed even more astonished.
“Thump, thump, thump…”
At that moment, the footsteps became even more distinct!

chapters.title: Chapter 802: Why Are You Here?
chapters.content:
Chapter 802: Why Are You Here?
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
As soon as the crowd heard the footsteps, their facial expressions immediately became tense. Ted held his breath, squinting his eyes and staring at the entrance of Precipice Cave.
“Who are you people? How dare you trespass into our Precipice Cave? It seems like you’re tired of living!” A sinister voice came from inside.
Upon hearing these words, Ted, Ruby, and the others looked towards the direction of Precipice Cave. They saw three people walking out from inside the cave.
When the people present saw these three individuals, they were stunned in their tracks, their expressions filled with astonishment. Among these three people was someone they all recognized—it was none other than Timothy, who had left not long ago.
“Timothy, what are you doing here?” Ruby stared at him with wide eyes, her expression filled with surprise.
“Miss Ruby, I apologize. Precipice Cave is a sacred place of my sect. My master instructed that anyone who intrudes here without permission must die!” Timothy’s demeanor had completely changed, and he shouted fiercely.
Upon hearing his words, Connor smiled helplessly. Finally, he understood what was going on. Timothy and the two middle-aged men behind him were working together. They used the rumors about Precipice Cave to attract outsiders to search for it. Timothy was the only one who knew the exact location of Precipice Cave, so he could profit from it.
After leading people to Precipice Cave, Timothy would kill the outsiders with the help of his accomplices, robbing them of their wealth and lives. The outsiders would be believed to have died in Precipice Cave, and the police wouldn’t investigate further. Timothy and his accomplices could continue to evade justice.
She hesitated for two seconds, then shouted at him in a low voice, “Timothy, so this was all part of your plan?”
“What do you mean by ‘my plan’?” Timothy sneered and continued, “You asked me to bring you here, and I did. Isn’t that what you wanted? But when I wanted to leave, you hired a bodyguard to kill me. That’s your mistake, isn’t it?”
“Where is my bodyguard?” Ruby quickly asked.
“I’ve already killed him…” Timothy licked his lips and said maliciously, “But you people are lucky. I prepared so many poison darts, yet none of them managed to kill you. If it were someone else, they would have died already. But even if you manage to survive, so what? You all are going to die today!”
“Timothy, do you know who I am? If you dare to touch me, I will make sure you suffer a horrible fate…” Ruby, still composed, coldly rebuked.
“Miss Ruby, of course, I know who you are. You are from the Yandell family…” Timothy chuckled lightly and continued, “But so what? I don’t know anything about the Yandell family, so don’t try to intimidate me with your status. I simply don’t care…”
Upon hearing these words, a flash of anger passed through Ruby’s eyes. She never expected Timothy to be so audacious and disregarding of her identity.
“My dad is the vice mayor of Thorpes. Mount Dragon falls within the jurisdiction of Thropes. If you dare to touch me, my dad will find you three!”
Westly stepped forward and shouted in a low voice.
“Hahaha…”
Upon hearing these words, Timothy burst into laughter and then said coldly, “Mr. Westley, I think you might be a bit too naive. Do you know where we are? This is Mount Dragon. If it weren’t for me leading all of you here, could you have found this place? If this were happening outside, maybe I wouldn’t dare to offend you, but here, I am the king. Even if I kill you, people outside would believe you died here accidentally in Precipice Cave, and they wouldn’t suspect me…”
After hearing Timothy’s words, everyone was stunned. He was right. In this deep mountain forest, even if they killed someone, no one would know it was the three of them.
That’s also why Timothy had been able to kill so many wealthy individuals over the years without being discovered.
Ruby came here mainly to search for spiritual herbs, so she didn’t want to waste time talking with Timothy and the others. She shouted in a low voice, “Timothy, are you blocking our way here just to ask for money? Just tell us how much you want. I don’t care about this amount!”
“I’m sorry, Miss Ruby, but I don’t care about your money either. The guiding fee you gave me earlier is enough for me…”
He replied indifferently, then continued, “Of course, Miss Ruby, you have a great figure. If you’re willing to accompany me for a few days, maybe I’ll let you live a little longer…”
“You!”
Upon hearing these words, Ruby’s eyes widened with anger. She had never been humiliated like this before.
“Let’s not waste time with them. These two women have great figures and are beautiful. Let’s kill these men first and then enjoy these two women.”
At that moment, Timothy’s younger brother, Patrick Jackman, shouted.
“Yeah, let’s attack!”
The third middle-aged man, Hayden Jackman, also joined in the shout.
“Alright, let’s do it!”
Timothy nodded and directly rushed toward Ruby’s position.
The bodyguards immediately protected Ruby when they saw the three approaching. But unfortunately, these bodyguards were just ordinary people, while Timothy and his companions were all martial artists. The bodyguards were no match for them.
In less than half a minute, seven or eight bodyguards were lying on the ground, while Timothy and his companions were unharmed.
Upon witnessing this scene, Ruby’s expression became tense. She never expected Timothy’s skills to be this good, so she quickly turned her head and looked at Ted
At that moment, Ted’s expression remained calm.
“Stop!”
Suddenly, Ted shouted.
Upon hearing his words, the bodyguards immediately stopped their actions and turned their heads towards Ted’s position.

chapters.title: Chapter 803: The Mysterious Old Man
chapters.content:
Chapter 803: The Mysterious Old Man
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
“Stop right there!”
Ted shouted at the bodyguard in front of him, then turned his head to glance at Timothy and the others.
He took a step forward and calmly said, “We came to this time to obtain a medicinal herb. Once we have it, we will leave. So I hope you three will step aside quickly, otherwise, don’t blame me for being impolite.”
“Not blame you for being impolite?”
Timothy sneered at Ted’s position and asked coldly, “What can you do if you’re impolite? I already said it earlier, this Precipice Cave is our territory. Anyone who comes here will die, no one can leave alive…”
Upon hearing his words, Westley’s eyes flashed with fear.
Because he never expected that such a trivial matter would endanger his own life.
Ruby, on the other hand, appeared visibly calmer when she saw Ted take action.
“Don’t go overboard!”
Ted coldly exclaimed, then he strode towards Timothy and the others.
Timothy and the others were surprised when they saw Ted rushing towards them, their eyes showing a hint of astonishment.
At that moment, the three of them clearly felt the terrifying skill of Ted, as his speed was astonishing.
After Ted reached Timothy, he raised his fist and smashed it directly towards Timothy’s chest.
Seeing him throwing a punch, Timothy instinctively raised his hands to protect his chest, as if he intended to block Ted’s attack with his arms.
“Boom!”
A loud bang.
Ted’s fist heavily struck his arm, and his body instantly flew backward.
Patrick and Hayden stared wide-eyed at Ted, their expressions filled with shock.
Because they never expected Ted’s skill to be so terrifying!
Among the three brothers of the Jackman family, Timothy had the best skills, but now he was sent flying by Ted’s punch. Now the three of them finally realized that something was not right.
“What are you two still standing there for? Hurry up and take action!”
At that moment, Timothy shouted loudly and rushed towards Ted’s position once again.
Patrick and Hayden didn’t dare to hesitate any longer and quickly followed Timothy’s footsteps.
Although the three of them were no match for Ted, their combined efforts could still pose a considerable threat to him.
In an instant, the four of them were entangled in a fight.
The bodyguards brought by Ruby were all ordinary people and couldn’t be of any help. It would be suicidal for them to join the fight now.
However, Ruby was worried that Ted would lose to Timothy and the others. After hesitating for a moment, she turned to Connor and the others and shouted, “Aren’t you a martial artists? Why are you just standing here? Hurry up and help!”
Upon hearing Ruby’s words, Connor’s expression seemed somewhat playful. He replied calmly, “These three are not Mr. Ted’s opponents. There’s no need for us to intervene…”
“But what if he loses?” Ruby shouted loudly.
“If he loses, it will not be too late for us to attack…”
Connor lightly replied.
Ruby heard Connor’s words and instantly froze in place, wearing an expression of helplessness on her face. She didn’t know what to say.
“Bang!”
At that moment, Timothy’s body was sent flying and heavily collided with the rock wall.
“Pfft..”
Timothy lay on the ground, spitting out a mouthful of blood, his face filled with agony.
Seeing this scene, Ruby’s expression appeared somewhat triumphant. She pouted and said to Connor, “It seems your plan has failed. These three people are no match for Uncle Ted. Don’t even think about benefiting from this situation…”
In Ruby’s view, Connor and the others were waiting for Ted and Timothy to be seriously injured before Connor would make his move.
He looked at her helplessly and didn’t know what to say.
A few minutes later, Patrick and Hayden also fell to the ground.
However, Ted remained unscathed, standing expressionless in place.
“Uncle Ted is so powerful!”
Ruby exclaimed excitedly.
Meanwhile, Carlos looked at Ted’s position and whispered to Connor, “Mr. Connor, something is wrong!”
“What’s wrong?”
Connor turned his head and glanced at Carlos, asking with some confusion.
“I sense an extremely powerful aura coming from inside the cave. It’s approaching our direction, and it feels terrifying!”
Carlos said slowly.
Upon hearing these words, Connor instinctively turned his head towards the cave’s location, squinting his eyes without saying anything.
Ted, after defeating Timothy and the others, also stood expressionless, seemingly aware of the aura inside the cave.
“Why are you all still standing there? Hurry up and tie these three people up for me…”
Ruby pointed at the position of Timothy and the others, her expression somewhat impatient.
Upon hearing Ruby’s command, her bodyguards did not hesitate at all. They directly walked towards the location of Timothy and the others.
When Timothy saw the bodyguards rushing over, he hurriedly shouted, “Master, when are you planning to come out? If you don’t come out soon, the three of us might die here…”
After hearing Timothy’s words, Connor finally understood.
Carlos mentioned earlier that there was a formidable aura inside the cave, and that aura should belong to Timothy’s master.
“Boom!”
“Boom!”
At that moment, sounds of footsteps came from inside the cave.
However, these footsteps gave the impression of ancient behemoths.
With every step taken by the people inside the cave, it caused a tremendous tremor.
The people present couldn’t help but show fear on their faces and subconsciously took a few steps back.
In their view, there should be a monstrous creature weighing thousands of kilograms inside the cave. Otherwise, it would be impossible to create such loud sounds.
Initially, Ruby thought that as long as she defeated Timothy and the others, she would be able to enter the Precipice Cave and obtain the medicinal herbs.
But she never expected that Timothy still had reinforcements who hadn’t come out.
At this moment, Westley was regretting his decision. How could he have anticipated that Precipice Cave would be so dangerous!
On the other hand, Connor narrowed his eyes and looked calmly at the entrance of Precipice Cave.
After a while, a stooped figure walked out of the cave.
However, to everyone’s surprise, what appeared before them was not a massive creature weighing thousands of kilograms but a frail old man who stood only about 1.65 meters tall!

chapters.title: Chapter 804: Massacre!
chapters.content:
Chapter 804: Massacre!
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
After seeing the old man, everyone’s expressions were filled with astonishment and their eyes were full of shock.
Because the old man who came out of the Precipice Cave was not the giant several meters tall that everyone had guessed. On the contrary, the old man was extremely thin and stooped, looking exceptionally old.
However, Connor could tell that the old man’s muscles were very strong. He felt like a steel sculpture, exuding extremely terrifying energy.
Although the old man didn’t appear very tall and had a small figure, every step he took left a deep footprint on the ground.
It’s important to note that they were on flat ground, and the soil on the ground was very solid.
For an ordinary person, intentionally leaving a footprint would be a very difficult task.
But at this moment, the old man could easily leave footprints with just a few steps, which proved how terrifying his strength was.
Carlos glanced at the old man lightly and whispered to Connor, “Mr. Connor, this person is extraordinary. If a fight breaks out later, you should protect yourself. I may not be able to take care of you then…”
“Understood!”
Connor nodded lightly.
Upon seeing the old man come out, Timothy and his two brothers showed extremely excited expressions on their faces. They hurriedly shouted, “Master, you finally came out! If you hadn’t come out, the three of us might have died…”
“You three useless fools!”
The old man furrowed his brows and reprimanded them.
Although Ted was also shocked by the powerful aura emanating from the old man, he pretended to remain calm and asked, “May I ask how I should address you, sir?”
“You don’t have the qualification to know my name. Anyone who intrudes into Precipice Cave will meet a dead end. None of you will leave here alive!”
The old man spoke in an extremely arrogant tone to Ted.
Upon hearing the old man’s words, a hint of helplessness flashed in Ted’s eyes. He then whispered, “Sir, I am not aware of the rules of Precipice Cave. Otherwise, I would take them and leave now. Can you spare us?”
Ted was not a fool. He could see that the old man in front of him was incredibly powerful.
Although the spiritual medicines in Precipice Cave were precious, what use were they if they couldn’t even save their lives?
Therefore, he had no hesitation at all and immediately decided to give up the spiritual medicines in Precipice Cave and find a way to leave with his people.
“I have already said that anyone who intrudes into Precipice Cave will die here!”
The old man looked at Ted with a disdainful gaze, then raised his fist and struck towards him.
Ted reacted swiftly and quickly dodged the punch from the old man.
However, the bodyguard standing behind Ted wasn’t as fortunate!
The old man’s fist directly pierced through the bodyguard’s chest!
“Spurt…”
The bodyguard spewed out a mouthful of blood and fell to the ground.
“Ah…”
Upon witnessing this scene, Ruby couldn’t help but scream in fear, her expression filled with extreme terror.
Although Ruby had witnessed some fights between martial artists before, she had never seen such a bloody scene!
This thin and bony old man was unexpectedly vicious in his actions. With just one strike, he wanted to tell everyone that he truly intends to kill them.
Even Connor’s expression becomes somewhat nervous.
This is the first time Connor has witnessed someone killing in front of him, and in such a simple and brutal manner.
“Miss, quickly hide in the back, this person is extremely dangerous…” Ted shouted loudly towards Ruby’s location.
Upon hearing Ted’s words, Ruby quickly turned around and ran towards a distance.
Meanwhile, Westley had long been frightened and had already hidden in a corner, trembling as he looked towards the old man’s location.
“Why are you all just standing there? Didn’t I prepare weapons for you before? Hurry up and help Uncle Ted!” Ruby exclaimed excitedly when she saw all the bodyguards remaining motionless in their positions.
After hearing Ruby’s words, the bodyguards finally reacted and took out their handguns from their pockets, aiming them at the old man’s location.
When Connor saw the bodyguards drawing their guns, his expression showed some surprise because he hadn’t expected Ruby’s people to have handguns!
“I advise you to behave, otherwise, we will open fire!” One of the bodyguards shouted arrogantly towards the old man’s location.
“What can you do with a gun?” The old man sneered disdainfully at the bodyguard, then strode forward and charged towards the bodyguard’s position.
The bodyguard hurriedly panicked and pulled the trigger.
But the old man easily dodged the bullets, then reached out and grabbed the bodyguard’s arm, throwing him away with a single motion.
“Bang!”
A loud noise.
In an instant, the bodyguard was thrown with such force that he became a bloody mess, blood gushing out.
The remaining bodyguards were all terrified and quickly aimed their guns at the old man’s location, intending to open fire.
This old man gave people the feeling of a ferocious beast, devoid of any emotions. He struck without mercy at the innocent bodyguards, leaving no room for escape, and the deaths of the bodyguards were extremely gruesome.
In an instant, everyone present was stunned, their faces filled with extreme fear.
In their eyes, this old man was like the Grim Reaper himself.
Diana had never experienced such a situation before.
After hesitating for a moment, she whispered to Connor, “Mr. Connor, this person is crazy. Shouldn’t we leave first?”
“No rush, let’s see how the situation develops…” he replied in a low voice.
Upon hearing his words, she paused for a moment, a hint of confusion flickering in her eyes, but she didn’t say anything more.
During the time she was speaking with Connor, several more bodyguards fell into pools of blood.
Ruby looked at the hellish scene before her, her expression filled with extreme horror.
She couldn’t understand the deep grudge between her people and this old man. How could this old man commit such heinous acts!?
Ted stood dumbfounded in his original spot. At this moment, he was also unsure of what to do.

chapters.title: Chapter 805: I Will Fight It Out With You
chapters.content:
Chapter 805: I Will Fight It Out With You
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
After seeing the scene in front of them, which resembled a hellish landscape, the onlookers all showed expressions of fear.
Some timid bodyguards were already preparing to escape.
Other bodyguards picked up their weapons and engaged in a desperate fight against the old man.
However, these bodyguards were just ordinary people. No matter how good their marksmanship was, they couldn’t possibly be a match for the old man.
Meanwhile, Timothy looked at the old man’s position with an expressionless face, a hint of satisfaction flashing in his eyes.
These people might not know that the old man had sought refuge in the Precipice Cave because of his cruel personality.
Over the years, the number of people who died at the hands of the old man had reached nearly ten thousand. Later, the old man had been chased by enemies, which led him to take shelter in the Precipice Cave.
Now, with so many people willingly coming to him, the old man naturally wouldn’t let go of such a good opportunity.
“These people are here to die…”
Timothy couldn’t help but sneer.
On the other hand, Ruby had been hiding behind Ted, observing the situation with the old man.
At this moment, a bodyguard ran quickly to Ruby’s side and exclaimed in an excited tone, “Miss Ruby, this person is a devil. It’s too dangerous for you to stay here. Let’s leave quickly!”
In less than ten minutes, most of the bodyguards that Ruby had brought were already dead.
Even those who survived among the bodyguards had lost limbs and were incapacitated.
If Ruby continued to stay here, it would be a dead end for her.
Moreover, the remaining bodyguards had given up the idea of further resistance.
Because they could feel that the old man in front of them was not someone they could defeat. If they stayed here, they would only be waiting for death.
“Miss… Miss Ruby, I… I think we should leave quickly. This old man is too terrifying…”
Westley, scared out of his wits, trembled as he shouted at Ruby.
For a rich second-generation like Westley, the few people led by Timothy were already frightening enough. And now, there was another bloodthirsty demon appearing. He had never seen such a terrifying person before, nor had he seen so many dead bodies. The scene at the entrance of the Precipice Cave was like a slaughterhouse, incredibly horrifying.
Westley hadn’t had enough of his good days yet. If it weren’t for Ruby, he would have run away long ago.
“I’m not leaving. I’ve finally found the Precipice Cave. I won’t leave without finding the spiritual herbs inside…”
Ruby stared at him with watery eyes, her expression extremely agitated as she shouted.
“Miss Ruby, do you realize what the situation is now? My bodyguards are mostly dead, and your bodyguards are also mostly dead. If you stay here, more people will die. Do you understand?”
Westley was left speechless after hearing Ruby’s words, not knowing what to say.
“The spiritual herbs inside the Precipice Cave are very important to me. If I can’t get the medicinal materials inside, all my efforts for these past few days will be in vain…” she shouted loudly.
And after hearing these words, he couldn’t help but inhale a breath of cold air and then frown, saying, “Miss Ruby, don’t you see what the situation is now? Most of my bodyguards are dead, and most of your bodyguards are dead. If you stay here, it will only make more people die. Don’t you understand?”
“These bodyguards are useless. I still have Uncle Ted. He can definitely defeat this person…”
Ruby shouted with a slightly crazed expression.
Westley looked at Ruby before him and didn’t know what to do for a moment.
If he continued to stay here, he would be in danger.
But if he left, he could never hold his head up in front of her again!
So he didn’t know what to do at the moment!
“It’s simply outrageous!”
Ted looked at the old man covered in blood, a hint of anger flashed in his eyes, and his body trembled slightly.
He couldn’t understand how this old man could be so inhumane.
The bodies lying on the ground were all living people!
Ted took a deep breath, clenched his fists tightly, and shouted in a low voice, “Even if I have to risk my life today, I will make sure justice is served for these people!”
These bodyguards had been with Ruby for many years and had always been very respectful to Ted. Naturally, there was some bond between him and these bodyguards.
At this moment, he looked at the bodyguards who had been with him day and night, falling one after another, and he naturally felt extremely angry.
“I’ll fight you…”
Ted roared, then charged directly toward the old man’s position.
The old man turned around abruptly when he saw Ted charging towards him.
Ted swung his right hand fiercely, and his palm directly slapped the old man’s chest.
“Bang!”
A loud noise.
Ted’s palm directly hit the old man’s chest.
