The old man seemed unaware of what had just happened, and his body flew backward. After retreating five or six steps in a row, the old man stomped his foot forcefully, his feet sinking into the ground, stabilizing his body.
After seeing this scene, the onlookers opened their mouths wide, dumbfounded, with expressions of extreme shock.
Because this was the first time the old man had been forced back.
“Uncle Ted is amazing! It seems that only he can defeat this person!”
Ruby’s expression became extremely excited after seeing this scene, as she finally saw a glimmer of hope in Ted.
However, Ted’s expression at this time was unpleasant because he had exerted all his strength in that palm strike. But it only made the old man retreat two steps, and the old man didn’t suffer any injuries.
From this, it could be seen how great the gap was between Ted and the old man.
The old man looked up and down at Ted, then indifferently, “Huh, I didn’t expect you to have some skills, kid…”
After saying these words, the old man charged directly toward Ted’s position, clenched his fist tightly, and smashed it towards Ted’s chest.
Ted quickly raised his hands to block his chest.
“Bang!”
A loud noise.
The old man’s punch heavily hit Ted’s arm, and Ted’s body instantly flew backward, crashing heavily into the rock wall.
Ted’s body smashed the wall full of rocks into a big hole and he spat out a mouthful of blood!
After seeing this scene, everyone inhaled a cold breath.
The little glimmer of hope that had just risen in their hearts was completely extinguished.

chapters.title: Chapter 806: Connor Makes a Move
chapters.content:
Chapter 806: Connor Makes a Move
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Everyone thought that Ted alone could save them, but no one expected Ted to cough up blood after being punched by the old man!
From this point, it could be seen how big the skill gap between Ted and the old man was!
The little hope that everyone was extinguished once again.
Ted turned his head and looked at Connor, then said to him in a low voice, “Mr. McDonald, if the practitioner beside you is willing to join hands with me, we might still have a chance of survival. However, if you continue to stand by and watch, all of us will die here…”
After hearing Ted’s words, Connor glanced at Carlos and asked him softly, “Carlos, are you willing to help?”
“Mr. McDonald, now is indeed the best time to join forces with them!” Carlos said in a low voice.
“Go ahead…”
Connor nodded lightly, and Carlos strode forward.
“Carlos, don’t show off. Don’t get hurt!”
Connor said to Carlos.
“Mr. McDonald, don’t worry, I understand!” Carlos nodded slightly, then sped up and rushed toward the old man.
Just as Carlos was about to reach the old man, Carlos threw out an abrupt punch. A powerful fist shot out like a cannonball and hit the old man’s back.
The old man staggered back two steps before stabilizing his body.
“There’s another one?”
The old man slowly turned his head to look at Carlos’s position, a hint of disdain flashing in his eyes.
Ted did not stay idle after Carlos attacked. He adjusted his body and rushed toward the old man.
The battle instantly entered a white-hot stage.
Although the old man’s strength was indeed terrifying, Ted and Carlos were both accomplished martial artists. Their combined strength was still very shocking.
For a moment, the old man was tied down by Ted and Carlos, and he had no chance to escape.
Carlos’s fist techniques were very fierce. Every punch was like a cannonball with astonishing power.
Ted, on the other hand, was the complete opposite in that he used internal strength to overcome brute force. His attacks did not seem powerful, but in fact, the damage to the old man was also very shocking!
Everyone looked excitedly at Ted and Carlos, silently cheering them on.
However, at this moment, Ted felt a sharp pain in his chest.
Because Ted had taken the old man’s punch just now, his internal organs were seriously injured. In addition, the battle just now was too intense, which caused Ted’s injuries to worsen.
When the old man saw Ted’s expression, a hint of viciousness flashed across his eyes.
Completely disregarding Carlos’s attacks from behind, he chose to attack Ted instead.
“Bang!”
Carlos’s fist landed heavily on the old man’s back.
The old man staggered back two steps, then calmed his breath. He lifted his leg and kicked at Ted’s chest.
“Crack!”
There was a loud thud.
The old man’s kick landed squarely on Ted’s chest.
Ted’s body was sent flying from the kick and then smashed onto the ground.
The old man’s kick had directly broken Ted’s ribs. Ted lay on the ground with a painful expression on his face. He spat out a mouthful of blood, which dyed his clothes red.
The old man had obviously taken Carlos’s punch on purpose so that he could have a chance to attack Ted.
Although Carlos’s punch had caused some damage to the old man, it was far from the old man’s kick to Ted.
Ted lay on the ground with a pained expression. At this moment, he felt as if his internal organs were shattered, and even breathing was difficult.
On the other side, Carlos was also under fire from the old because he was no longer being distracted by Ted. His body flew backward and crashed hard on the ground.
Carlos’s situation was slightly better than Ted’s!
Carlos struggled for a while and tried to stand up to continue the battle, but Connor called out, “Carlos, come back quickly. You’re no match for this person…”
Carlos turned to look at Connor when he heard what he said. He could not help but take a deep breath and stand still.
For a moment, everyone present was stunned on the spot, and the expressions on their faces were extremely desperate.
No one had expected that it would end up like this!
Ted and Carlos were the strongest among them, but they couldn’t even defeat the old man. It was unbelievable.
Moreover, Ted and Carlos were both severely injured. Ted was lying on the ground and could not stand up.
If the old man wanted to kill them, it would be a piece of cake.
Ruby stood in the same spot dumbly, not knowing what to do.
“Miss Yu, even Master Cao is not a match for this old man. If you continue to stay here, you will only die. You should quickly follow me…”
Westley had no feelings for these people at all.
At this moment, he only had one thought in his mind, and that was to leave this place as soon as possible.
Ruby couldn’t help but laugh bitterly when she heard Westley’s words.
She knew that if she left now, Ted would die.
All her previous efforts would have been in vain. Those bodyguards would have died in vain, and the medicinal herbs she had bought in Medicine King’s Valley would have been in vain.
However, if she continued to stay here, she would only die.
Once Ted fell, Ruby had lost her last support.
Ruby only had Westley by her side, but what could Westley do?
After hesitating for two seconds, Ruby turned around and prepared to leave.
However, at this moment, a figure walked past Ruby.
When Ruby saw this figure, she froze on the spot with a shocked expression.
After all, at this time, everyone wanted to escape. How could anyone take the initiative to walk towards that old man’s position?
Ruby subconsciously glanced at the person who just passed by her and was stunned. Her face was filled with disbelief.
Because the person who walked past Ruby was none other than Connor!
“Connor, where are you going?”
Ruby widened her big watery eyes and shouted excitedly.
“I’m going to kill someone!”
Connor replied.

chapters.title: Chapter 807: Who Are You?
chapters.content:
Chapter 807: Who Are You?
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
“You’re going to kill someone?”
Ruby was stunned when she heard Connor’s words. Her face was filled with disbelief. She didn’t know what Connor meant at all.
Wesley looked at Connor with a disdainful expression. “Is there something wrong with your brain? You’re still in the mood to show off at a time like this? Aren’t you just asking for death if you go over now?”
The bodyguards present looked at Connor as if they were looking at a fool. They could not understand Connor’s current behavior at all.
However, Connor did not care about their gazes and continued to walk towards the old man.
“What is this kid doing over there?”
Timothy looked at Connor with a hint of confusion in his eyes.
At this moment, most of the people were thinking about how to escape from here, but Connor actually had no intention of escaping at all. Instead, he took the initiative to walk towards the old man.
Diana’s expression was also very nervous. She clenched her fists tightly, not knowing what to do.
After all, Diana didn’t know Connor’s true strength, but she knew how terrifying this old man’s strength was. Even though Carlos and Ted had joined forces, they weren’t a match for this old man. If Connor went there alone, it would be no different from suicide.
On the other side, after the old man sent Ted flying, he had no intention of letting Ted go and directly walked toward him.
Ted’s face was full of despair because he couldn’t move at all. If the old man wanted to kill him, he could just move his finger and the deed would be done.
A trace of despair flashed across Ted’s eyes. Although he had always known that the Precipice Cave would be very dangerous, he had never thought that it would be so dangerous. He was very unwilling to die in the hands of this old man.
The old man walked to Ted and said to him expressionlessly, “I see that you are also a martial artist. I will give you the chance to say your last words!”
Ted took a deep breath and asked in a low voice, “Can you tell me who you are?”
“My name is Yulian Zachary!”
The old man replied calmly.
“You’re…Yulian Zachary?” Ted’s eyes flashed with shock, then he laughed and said, “I didn’t expect you to still be alive and that I would actually fall into your hands. How interesting!”
When everyone heard the old man’s words, they were all stunned. Their expressions were indescribably shocked.
Because the name Yulian Zachary was akin to thunder piercing their ears.
This was because Yulian was known as one of the top ten assassins in Oprana. He was very skilled and his way of doing things was extremely cruel. Back then, Yulian had killed countless people, including many famous businessmen and public figures. Even the police could not do anything about him.
However, later on, this Yulian mysteriously disappeared. Some people said that Yulian had long retired from the industry, while others said that he was dead.
Anyway, there were all kinds of theories.
But no one had expected that Yulian had been hiding out in the Precipice Cave all along.
At this moment, after everyone knew the true identity of this old man, the expressions on their faces became even more fearful.
Ted knew that he would not be able to escape death today. Yulian had always had a reputation for being ruthless. He would never let him off.
So, Ted turned to Ruby and shouted, “Miss Yandell, hurry up and run…”
Ruby was stunned when she heard Ted’s words.
Then, Yulian clenched his fist and punched Ted’s chest.
“Bang!”
There was a loud bang.
Yulian’s fist smashed into Ted’s chest.
Ted spurted out a mouthful of blood. His face was filled with pain.
“Uncle Ted…”
Seeing this, Ruby’s eyes turned red as she shouted excitedly.
“Miss Yandell, run!”
Ted shouted at Ruby weakly as if he had used up all his strength.
Ruby stood rooted to the ground, not knowing what to do.
At this moment, she was really unwilling to leave just like that. After all, Ted had been by her side for so many years. She didn’t want to abandon him just like that.
When Wesley saw Ruby standing there without moving, a helpless expression appeared on his face.
He gritted his teeth and whispered, “Miss Yandell, are you leaving or not?””
“I’m not leaving…”
Ruby shouted excitedly.
After hearing Ruby’s words, Wesley sighed helplessly and turned to run away.
Wesley wasn’t a fool. He knew that he would die if he stayed here. Therefore, he didn’t care about what Ruby thought of him. He wanted to live!
Previously, when Ted was around, these people more or less had some hope in their hearts.
But now, Ted was already in such a state. The last trace of hope in their hearts was destroyed.
Therefore, whether it was Wesley or the bodyguards, they all turned around and ran out.
Ruby stood rooted to the ground, not knowing what to do.
At this moment, only Ruby, Carlos, Ted, Diana, and the others were left standing in front of the Precipice Cave.
However, at this moment, Ruby suddenly remembered that there was one more person!
Ruby abruptly raised her head and looked in front of her, only to see Connor slowly walking towards Yulian.
“Connor, where are you going? If you go over now, you’ll die…”
Ruby shouted excitedly at Connor.
Connor continued to walk forward as if he hadn’t heard Ruby’s words.
Ted naturally saw Connor walking towards him! A trace of confusion flashed in his eyes. He really couldn’t understand why Connor would come over at this time.
“Is this kid here to die?”
Ted couldn’t help but think.
“Go to hell…”
Yulian growled, then raised his right hand and flung it at Ted’s head.
“Stop!”
At this moment, Connor suddenly shouted.
After Yulian heard Connor’s words, he slowly turned his head and looked at Connor’s position. He asked in a low voice, “Who are you?”
“The person who will end you!”
Connor said back to Yulian.
After Yulian heard Connor’s words, he could not help but be stunned for a moment. Then, he raised his head and laughed loudly. The expression on his face was extremely disdainful.

chapters.title: Chapter 808: A Life-Saving Pill
chapters.content:
Chapter 808: A Life-Saving Pill
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
“Hahaha…”
After Yulian heard Connor’s words, he immediately began to laugh loudly. The expression on his face was extremely disdainful.
After all, Connor looked weak and did not have any attack power at all, and Carlos and Ted had already lost to Yulian.
However, Connor actually said that he wanted to kill Yulian. Wasn’t this a joke? What was he doing?
“Mr. McDonald, this person is very dangerous. Don’t be rash…” Carlos turned to look at Connor and shouted at him excitedly.
“I’m not being impulsive. I’m here for the spiritual herbs in the Precipice Cave. Since I’ve already found the Precipice Cave, I have to take the spiritual herbs away…” Connor said expressionlessly.
“But he’s really strong…” Carlos continued to shout at Connor.
“So what?” Connor smiled faintly. Then, he reached into his clothes and took out the pill that Jorge had given him back then!
Jorge had told Connor before that if he encountered any danger, he could take this pill. It might even save Connor’s life!
Connor didn’t know what this pill was, nor did he know if Jorge was lying to him. But now, Connor knew that he definitely couldn’t escape from this situation because Timothy and his brothers were guarding the entrance.
Without Ted and Carlos, it would be difficult for Connor to defeat Timothy and the other two, let alone Yulian!
Therefore, Connor could only place all his hopes on the pill that Jorge gave him.
“I hope the old man wasn’t lying to me!”
Connor sighed softly and then directly threw the medicinal pill into his mouth.
The pill was very bitter, but Connor could not care so much about the taste now. He swallowed it in one gulp.
Yulian sized up Connor and said indifferently, “Kid, you aren’t a martial artist, right?”
“No…”
Connor lightly shook his head.
“You’re not even a martial artist, yet you actually want to kill me now? I think you really don’t know what’s good for you…” Yulian sneered and continued, “Since you want to die so much today, I’ll fulfill your wish!”
After saying this, Yulian directly rushed towards Connor.
“Mr. McDonald, quickly dodge!”
When Diana saw Yulian rushing towards Connor, panic flashed across her eyes as she shouted excitedly.
Connor was still standing there expressionlessly, like an old monk meditating.
Ruby looked helpless when she saw this. She really couldn’t understand why Connor didn’t choose to run away when he had the chance to. Instead, he took the initiative to go and die.
Carlos Ted, and the others also stared at Connor.
However, just as Yulian was about to reach Connor, Connor suddenly raised his right hand and fiercely struck Yulian’s body.
The punch did not seem to have any power at all and made it seem like Connor was making his final struggle.
Ruby looked at Connor speechlessly and said in a low voice, “I thought that Connor had the ability to stand up, but I didn’t expect him to go up and die for nothing!”
Everyone else present seemed to have the same thought at this moment because of Connor’s punch just now. When it came to strength or speed, they were incomparable to Yulian.
Everyone felt that Connor would definitely be sent flying by Yulian’s punch!
“Bang!”
Connor’s fist directly collided with Yulian’s fist.
However, everyone present couldn’t believe one thing: that Connor actually wasn’t sent flying by Yulian’s punch. On the contrary, he still stood on the spot without moving an inch.
“This…”
When Ruby saw this scene, she was stunned as well. Her face was filled with disbelief.
No one had expected that Connor would actually be able to block Yulian’s punch!
Not even Ted could accomplish such a feat!
“When did Mr. McDonald become so powerful?”
Carlos looked at Connor and could not help but sigh softly.
Connor was also very shocked in his heart at this time. He did not expect that the pill Jorge gave him would be so powerful.
After Connor ate this medicinal pill, he felt an inexplicable surge of strength in his body. Connor relied on this strength to block Yulian’s punch.
If it was the Connor from before, he would not have been able to block Yulian’s punch.
“How is that possible?”
Yulian’s eyes also flashed with a trace of shock, because when his fist collided with Connor’s fist, he could feel an unprecedented energy whistling towards his body.
The expression on Yulian’s face was no longer as calm as before because he realized that he seemed to have underestimated Connor.
Connor’s strength was far more terrifying than Ted’s and Carlos’s!
“Kid, you’re not a martial artist, so how did you do it just now?” Yulian took two steps back and shouted at Connor with an excited expression.
“What does killing you have to do with whether I’m a martial artist or not?” Connor looked at Yulian and sneered. Then, he directly rushed towards Yulian.
When Yulian saw Connor rushing over, he instinctively took a step back. However, Connor was far more agile than him!!
“Seven Stars Big Dipper Fist, First Stage, Dragon’s Roar!” Connor yelled.
Then, under everyone’s incredulous gazes, Connor smashed his fist straight into Yulian’s face. Yulian’s body was like a rock that had been thrown by someone as it flew backwards. His body ruthlessly smashed into a large tree before coming to a stop.
Everyone was instantly shocked. Their eyes widened as they watched this scene in a daze.
Westley, who was about to reach the entrance of the cave, stood there foolishly, not knowing how to describe his feelings.
No one had expected that Yulian, who was like the Grim Reaper in their eyes, would actually be sent flying by Connor’s punch at this moment!
Previously, Ted could only make Yulian take two steps back, but now Connor had sent Yulian flying with a single punch!
Ruby stood in the same spot, staring at Connor with her beautiful eyes.
She felt as if she was dreaming. Everything seemed so unreal!

chapters.title: Chapter 809: Still Think I Can't Kill You?
chapters.content:
Chapter 809: Still Think I Can’t Kill You?
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
In front of the Precipice Cave.
Yulian fell heavily onto the ground, kicking up a cloud of dust.
No one had expected that Connor would be able to send Yulian flying with a single punch.
In the eyes of everyone, Yulian was simply an invincible existence, to the point where even though Ted and Carlos had joined forces to fight him, they were still no match for him!
But no one had expected that Yulian would actually lose to Connor at this moment.
Connor was also very excited because the pill Jorge gave him was too magical.
After Connor ate this pill, he felt his body suddenly overflow with endless power. Moreover, Connor’s reaction speed had also been greatly improved. This was also the reason why Connor was able to send Yulian flying with a single punch.
Previously, Connor had never understood why alchemists were so important to martial artists! But at this moment, her finally understood. If he could give Connor more of these medicinal pills, then the increase in Connor’s strength would simply be unimaginable!
However, at this moment, Yulian slowly stood up and shouted at Connor fiercely. “Brat, I will definitely tear you into pieces today!”
At this moment, Yulian was also very shocked—he could feel that Connor was not a martial artist. However, the strength that Connor currently possessed far exceeded that of an average martial artist. This meant that Connor must have used some other method to increase his combat strength in such a short period of time.
When Connor heard Yulian’s words, he couldn’t help but smile faintly. Then, he said expressionlessly, “Looks like you’re still not convinced. Since you’re not convinced, then I’ll beat you until you’re convinced today!”
After saying this, Connor once again rushed towards Yulian, then raised his fist and punched towards Yulian’s chest.
“Bang!”
This was the second time Connor and Yulian fought.
But this time, Yulian did not underestimate his opponent. Instead, he was fully prepared!
Yulian stretched out his right hand and directly blocked Connor’s punch.
When Connor’s fist collided with Yulian’s palm, Yulian’s body instantly slid backwards. He only stopped after nearly four to five steps.
Yulian looked at Connor with an expression of disbelief on his face. He really could not understand why Connor’s strength was so terrifying!
When the punch met Yulian’s right hand, it felt like a hammer had smashed into his palm!
“What did this kid eat? Why did his strength become so terrifying?”
Yulian looked at Connor with an expression of disbelief. However, Connor didn’t give Yulian any time to think as he rushed towards Yulian again.
Yulian knew that the reason why Connor’s strength had become so great was definitely because Connor had taken the pill. If he waited until the effects of the pill passed, then Connor would once again become an ordinary person.
He felt that it wasn’t a wise choice for him to fight Connor head-on. On the contrary, he would easily lose to Connor. Therefore, Yulian planned to avoid him and wait until Connor’s medicinal effects wore off before attacking him.
Yulian hesitated for a moment before turning around and running out of the cave.
However, he did not expect Connor’s speed to be so shocking!
In the blink of an eye, Connor caught up and grabbed Yulian’s arm!
Yulian cried out in his heart, turning around to punch Connor’s head. However, Connor simply moved his body and dodged Yulian’s punch. Then, he turned his hand and punched Yulian’s stomach.
Yulian’s body was like an arrow shot by a bow as he was sent flying backwards and was ruthlessly smashed into the rock wall!
Yulian spat out a mouthful of blood. At this moment, he could feel that his internal organs seemed to have been shattered. All the bones in his body had been broken, and he could not move at all.
However, at this moment, Connor once again rushed in front of Yulian. Then, he raised his leg and kicked Yulian’s head.
Yulian’s body was sent flying once again, smashing heavily into a tree trunk. He rolled on the ground for a few meters before coming to a stop.
Everyone stared at Yulian with their eyes wide open. Their expressions were extremely incredulous.
After all, Yulian was still a devilish existence in their eyes, but he was like a dead dog in front of Connor.
Connor knew that Yulian had completely lost his ability to fight, and the strength in Connor’s body was also gradually disappearing. Therefore, Connor did not continue to attack Yulian.
He slowly walked up to Yulian. “Do you still think I can’t kill you now?” he asked Yulian with a cold expression.
Yulian looked at Connor with a terrified expression. He opened his mouth to speak, but he could not say anything at all.
At this moment, everyone looked at Connor as if the heavens had graced them with an earth-shattering revelation. Their expressions were also very shocked.
No one had expected that Yulian would actually lose to Connor in the end!
Back then, everyone knew that Carlos’s skills were amazing, and Connor was just a young master from a rich family in their eyes. No one took Connor seriously, but it was him who had saved everyone’s lives in the end!
If it wasn’t for Connor, these people might have all died in Yulian’s hands.
Ted looked at Connor and couldn’t help but let out a sigh of relief. His expression also became relaxed.
Just now, Ted thought that he would definitely die today, but he never expected that Connor would save him in the end!
“Mr. McDonald is really amazing!” Diana covered her mouth and shouted excitedly.
In fact, even Diana didn’t expect that Connor would be able to defeat Yulian. Her admiration for Connor grew even stronger.
“This… Who is this kid?”
Westley and the others looked at Connor and muttered in disbelief. Westley had never taken Connor seriously, but he never expected Connor to be so powerful!
If Westley had known that Connor was so powerful, then he would not have dared to offend Connor even if he had an endless well of courage!
Of course, the person with the most complicated expression was none other than Ruby!

chapters.title: Chapter 810: Who Do You Think You Are?
chapters.content:
Chapter 810: Who Do You Think You Are?
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Ruby felt like she was in a dream. Everything seemed so surreal.
She could not help but pinch herself, but the clear pain told her that she was not dreaming!
Earlier, Ruby had already lost all hope. She felt that she would definitely die in the hands of this Yulian today.
However, she never expected that the appearance of a single person would actually drag them from hell to heaven!
And this person was none other than the person that Ruby hated the most, Connor!
Ruby had always looked down on Connor. In her eyes, he was just an ordinary rich kid and was only so arrogant because his family was rich.
However, she never thought that Connor’s skills would be so good!
At this moment, Ruby’s emotions were extremely complicated. She didn’t even know how to describe how she was feeling!
Shock, doubt, confusion, surprise…Similar emotions kept surfacing in Ruby’s heart.
Ruby subconsciously raised her head and looked at Connor. She didn’t know how he could be so strong, nor could she understand how he managed to become so strong all of a sudden!
However, when Ruby saw the corpses of the bodyguards on the ground, she suddenly thought of Connor’s incredible fighting skills. Why didn’t he make a move to begin with?
If Connor had attacked from the beginning, his bodyguards wouldn’t have died, and Ted wouldn’t have been injured!
Therefore, Ruby’s face turned furious. She felt that Connor must have done this on purpose!
“This bastard!”
Ruby glared at Connor with her watery eyes and cursed.
At this moment, not only did she not have any intention of thanking Connor, but she also hated Connor even more in her heart.
As for Westley and the others, they stood there, not knowing what to do. The biggest threat, Yulian, had already been defeated by Connor and was heavily injured, so even if he woke up, he would probably be crippled for life, so he would not pose any threat to them!
However, an even greater threat had appeared in front of them!
And this threat was Connor!
After all, in the past few days, Westley had offended Connor quite a bit. Moreover, he often deliberately humiliated Connor.
Now, if Connor were to take revenge, then Westley and the others would very likely end up like Yulian. This was the most terrifying thing.
Therefore, Westley was stunned on the spot, not knowing what to do!
Ted took a deep breath, then took the initiative to stand up and walk to Connor. He said to Connor respectfully, “Mr. McDonald, thank you for saving my life today. I, Ted Carlson, owe you a huge favor. If you need me to do anything in the future, I will definitely repay you with my life—”
“Uncle Ted, what are you doing? Why are you thanking him?”
However, before Ted could finish his sentence, Ruby rushed to Ted in her high heels and shouted excitedly.
After hearing Ruby’s words, Ted’s eyes flashed with a trace of helplessness. He then turned to Ruby and said softly, “Miss Yandell, if it wasn’t for Mr. McDonald, we would all have died here. If I don’t thank Mr. McDonald, who should I thank?”
“This person did it on purpose!” Ruby’s eyes were filled with rage as she continued, “This person deliberately sent our people to their deaths first. Since he is so powerful, why didn’t he make a move at the first moment? If he had made a move immediately, my bodyguards wouldn’t have died, and you wouldn’t have been injured…”
When everyone heard Ruby’s words, they were all stunned and speechless.
No one expected Ruby to be so unreasonable!
“What are you talking about? Mr. McDonald saved you, and now you’re complaining that he was too late?” Diana shouted at Ruby in a very unhappy tone.
“He did it on purpose. He wanted Uncle Ted to go fight first and let my bodyguards die for nothing…”
Ruby shouted excitedly.
“I’ve realized that you’re really shameless. What does your people have to do with Mr. McDonald? He risked his life to save all of you, yet you are still pinning the blame on him! I think Mr. McDonald acted too early, personally—he could’ve waited until Yulian personally killed all of you before making a move!”
Diana didn’t hold back at all and scolded coldly.
“What did you say?”
Ruby was so angry that her entire body was trembling. She shouted, “You actually called me shameless just now?”
Ted seemed to be unable to stand Ruby’s pestering. He frowned and scolded in a low voice, “Miss Yandell, don’t say anymore. It’s already a great kindness for Mr. McDonald to save us today…”
Connor expressionlessly looked at Ruby, a trace of helplessness flashing in his eyes. He didn’t expect this woman to be so unreasonable!
The reason why Connor didn’t make a move before was because he didn’t know what effect the pill Jorge gave him would have. Connor was also not 100% sure that he would even be able to match up to Yulian even if he ate the pill!
It would be best if Carlos and Ted could defeat Yulian. In that case, Connor would not have to make a move.
However, since Carlos and Ted were already heavily injured, if Connor did not make a move, everyone would die!
That was why Connor took the risk to eat that pill!
However, in Ruby’s eyes, Connor was doing this on purpose. Connor didn’t know what to say.
Ruby didn’t listen to Ted at all. She walked up to Connor, pointed at him and shouted, “Connor, you have to take responsibility for the deaths of my bodyguards today. They all died because of you…”
“Your bodyguards died because of you. If you weren’t too greedy, these people wouldn’t have died at all!” Connor said lightly.
“If you didn’t wait til the last minute, how could my bodyguards have died?” Ruby shouted back.
Connor sneered. “Ruby, who do you think you are?”
“…”
Ruby looked at Connor and was stunned.
“In the eyes of others, you may be the young miss of the Yandell family, but in my eyes, you are nothing. You have nothing to do with me. I will attack whenever I want, and you have no right to question me. If you continue to talk nonsense, then I won’t hold back against you, either!” Connor said coldly to Ruby.
When Ruby heard Connor’s words, she was stunned on the spot, her face filled with shame and anger.
Ruby had never expected that Connor would not hold back at all.

chapters.title: Chapter 811: I Told You To Leave!
chapters.content:
Chapter 811: I Told You To Leave!
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
“Ms. Yandell, I think Mr. McDonald is right. It’s already a great kindness for Mr. McDonald to save us. It’s best if you don’t make a fuss…” Ted looked at Ruby and said helplessly.
Ruby looked up at Connor and took a deep breath.
She knew in her heart that there was no point in arguing with Connor about these things now. After all, her bodyguards were already dead.
“All right, I can let this go…” Ruby replied coldly, then looked at Connor and continued, “The three of you can leave now. The three of you are not welcome here!”
“We can leave now?”Connor looked at Ruby with a faint smile, then asked expressionlessly, “Do we have to leave just because you want us to? I was the one who defeated Yulian. It doesn’t seem to have anything to do with you, right?”
“It’s fine if you don’t leave, but you can’t snatch the things in the Precipice Cave from us!” Ruby looked at Connor and said.
Connor sized up Ruby helplessly, not knowing what to say.
Connor couldn’t understand where Ruby got her confidence from. She dared to say such words!
Now that Yulian was dead and Ruby asked Connor and the others to leave, why did they come here for?
Was it so Connor would defeat Yulian?
“From now on, all the medicinal herbs in the Precipice Cave belong to me. Mr. Ted, do you have any objections?” Connor turned to Ted and asked him expressionlessly.
“Mr. McDonald, you just defeated Yulian and saved my life. If you want the medicinal herbs in the Precipice Cave, I have no objections!” Ted answered without hesitation.
“Uncle Ted, what are you talking about? We spent so much effort to find the Precipice Cave. How can you give this person the medicinal herbs from the Precipice Cave?” Ruby turned to Ted and shouted frustratedly.
A trace of helplessness flashed in Ted’s eyes. He didn’t know what to say.
Ruby’s bodyguards were either dead or injured and had no strength to fight.
Ted was also heavily injured, and Carlos’s injuries were lighter than Ted’s. In addition, Connor and Diana were both skilled, so even if Ted and the others wanted to compete with Connor for the Precipice Cave, they could not do so!
Moreover, Connor had saved them just now, so no matter how he looked at it, Ted was too embarrassed to snatch the things in the Precipice Cave from Connor.
“Did you hear that? Mr. Ted has already agreed to give up the things in the Precipice Cave. Take your people and leave!” Connor looked at Ruby and said.
Ruby was so angry that her body trembled after hearing Connor’s words, her eyes filled with rage.
Ruby had always been a proud person at home. People would try their best to please her no matter what. No one dared to offend her.
However, Connor had offended Ruby time and time again. Moreover, Connor did not respect her at all. This was not the first time Connor had snatched something from Ruby!
Ruby had accepted this fact. After all, she had been busy just for the medicinal herbs in the Precipice Cave for so long.
At this moment, Connor wanted her to leave with just a single sentence. Ruby felt mistreated in her heart.
Therefore, she shouted at Connor, “We discovered the Precipice Cave together. If you don’t want to leave, it’s fine.”
“I’m sorry, but you don’t have the qualifications to split it equally with me…” Connor said lightly.
Ruby looked at Connor and was stunned once again. Her face was filled with shame and anger.
She could not help but shout, “Connor, what right do you have to be so controlling? Do you think that you are invincible just because you defeated Yulian? I am a member of the Yandell Family. Do you know what will happen to you if you offend me?”
“What will happen if I offend you?” Connor sneered and said, “I don’t know what will happen to me if I offend you, but I’m not in the mood to talk nonsense with you right now. Hurry up and get your men out of here, or don’t blame me for being rude!”
“What… What did you just say?” Ruby asked Connor in disbelief.
“I told you to get lost. Didn’t you hear me?” Connor repeated.
“You dare to ask me to scram? Connor, who do you think you are? Today, I…”
‘Slap!’ Diana didn’t even wait for Ruby to finish her sentence when she raised her hand and slapped Ruby.
Ruby fell to the ground after being slapped by Diana. She covered her face with her hands, her face filled with shock.
“Did you just hit me?” Ruby looked at Diana and shouted in shock.
“Mr. McDonald asked you to get lost. Didn’t you hear him?” Diana replied.
Ruby couldn’t believe that Diana dared to hit her in front of so many people.
No one had ever dared to hit her!
“Uncle Ted, kill this woman!” Ruby turned to Ted and shouted angrily.
A trace of helplessness flashed in Ted’s eyes. He turned to Connor and said, “Mr. McDonald, don’t be angry. Ms. Yandell was just confused for a moment. I’ll bring Ms. Yandell away from here now. Please don’t lower yourself to Ms. Yandell’s level…” After saying that, Ted ran to Ruby’s side and helped her.
“Uncle Ted, what are you doing? Didn’t you hear me asking you to kill that woman?” Ruby shouted as she struggled.
“Ms. Yandell, stop fooling around. It’s not like you haven’t seen Mr. McDonald’s skills. I’m seriously injured now, and I’m not their match at all,” Ted said helplessly, then dragged Ruby out of the cave.
After Westley saw Ted and Ruby leave, he didn’t hesitate and ran into the distance.
Meanwhile, the three Jackman brothers were also extremely terrified. Timothy hesitated before he hurriedly stood up and was prepared to sneak away when Connor wasn’t paying attention.
“Did I say you could go?” Connor suddenly shouted.
After Timothy heard Connor’s words, he froze helplessly.
He knew nothing good was coming out of this!

chapters.title: Chapter 812: Mission Completed
chapters.content:
Chapter 812: Mission Completed
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
“Mr. Mc… Mr. McDonald, Yulian ordered this. It has nothing to do with us. Please let us go…” Timothy turned around and looked at Connor as he spoke to Connor with a trembling voice.
“I don’t know if this has anything to do with the three of you, but I know you have attacked me just now. Therefore, you three can’t leave yet…” Connor replied to Timothy.
“Mr. McDonald, how do you plan to deal with us?” Timothy hesitated before asking Connor softly.
Timothy knew that Connor did not want to kill them. After all, if Connor wanted to kill them, he would have done so long ago. There was no need for him to waste his breath on them.
“You three should be very familiar with the situation in the Precipice Cave, right?” Connor asked indifferently.
“Yes, yes!” Timothy nodded without thinking.
“How about this? You three bring us into the Precipice Cave. After I find the medicinal herbs, I will let the three of you leave…” Connor said softly.
After Timothy heard Connor’s offer, he heaved a sigh of relief and said excitedly, “Sure, Mr. McDonald, I’ll take you there now!”
Although Yulian was already unconscious, Connor knew there might still be hidden weapons or the like inside the Precipice Cave.
Ruby and the others had left long ago, and there was no one to scout ahead for Connor. Connor was worried that there would be danger inside.
The Jackman brothers had lived in the Precipice Cave before, so they were very familiar with the situation inside the cave. Letting these three people lead the way for Connor was the best choice.
Timothy found a few flashlights from the bodyguards’ corpses a moment later and brought Connor and the others into the Precipice Cave.
Reality proved that Connor had made the right decision to let the three Jackman brothers lead the way. There were indeed many traps in this cave. If Timothy did not know the exact location of the traps, even a god would probably die there.
Connor, Diana, and Carlos followed Timothy for about an hour before finally stopping in front of a stone door.
“Mr. McDonald, what you’re looking for should be here…”
Timothy turned and glanced at Connor as he spoke softly to Connor.
“How do you know?” Connor asked indifferently.
“The Jackman Family has always guarded the herbs in the Precipice Cave for generations. Previously, it had always been my master, Yulian, guarding it. If my master dies, it will be my turn to guard it. After so many years, I don’t know how many people have come for the herbs in this cave. However, in the end, they have also lost their lives because of the herbs in this cave…” Timothy explained slowly.
“I injured your master, and now I will take away the treasure the Jackman Family protects. Don’t you feel angry toward me?” Connor was stunned for a moment before asking Timothy in confusion.
Timothy smiled helplessly when he heard Connor’s question. Then, he said, “Mr. McDonald, if you take away the thing in there, it will be a relief for me. For so many years we have been guarding this cave for generations, which has caused us to have no way to leave this place. If this thing is gone, then we can leave…”
“Have you never thought of stealing the things inside and selling them?” Connor continued to ask.
“Haha…” When Timothy heard Connor’s question, he smiled faintly. He then said expressionlessly, “Mr. McDonald, although I, Timothy Jackman, am not considered a gentleman, I have once sworn before my ancestors that even if I die of poverty and hunger, I will not betray my sect!”
“I didn’t expect you to have such will!” Connor replied with a smile.
“I know we are not your match, Mr. McDonald. Since you defeated my master just now, you can take the things in there. After all, my master is already injured so badly. Even if you don’t take them, others will come and snatch them anyway…” Timothy sighed softly, then walked to a stone, turning it with force.
‘Rumble…’ The stone door slowly rose.
Timothy led Connor, Diana, and Carlos into the cave.
After entering the cave, Connor found that there were no rare treasures in the cave. On the contrary, the inside was no different from the outside, except for three herbs growing in the innermost part of the cave.
Moreover, there was a large hole where the three herbs were located. Sunlight could shine into the cave through the hole.
Connor hurriedly took out the note that Jorge had given him. The medicinal herb drawn on the note was one of the three. As for the other two medicinal herbs, Connor had never seen them before.
“Mr. McDonald, these three herbs are the Red Sun Ginseng, the Soul-calling Grass, and the Vermilion Sparrow Flower!” Timothy whispered to Connor.
“Red Sun Ginseng, Soul-calling Grass, and Vermilion Sparrow Flower!” After Diana heard the names of these three herbs, she was stunned and in disbelief.
Connor turned to look at Diana and asked softly, “You know these three herbs?”
“I’ve seen it in books before, but it’s said that these three medicinal herbs are all passed down from generation to generation. They don’t exist on Earth at all. I didn’t expect these three medicinal herbs to exist here…” Diana said in disbelief.
“These medicinal herbs are just something that ordinary people can’t find. If you can find Elixir Mountain, medicinal herbs like these can be found everywhere!” Timothy replied calmly.
“Elixir Mountain exists?” Diana was stunned for a moment before she frowned and asked Timothy.
“Elixir Mountain naturally exists. These three medicinal ingredients were taken from Elixir Mountain…” Timothy nodded lightly.
“Mr. McDonald, it would be great if we could find Elixir Mountain…” Diana said excitedly to Connor.
Connor wasn’t in the mood to care about Elixir Mountain. After all, he only wanted to find the herb that Jorge mentioned.
Connor knew that the herb Jorge was looking for was the Soul-calling Grass. The Red Sun Ginseng and the Vermilion Sparrow Flower were useless to Connor.
However, Diana said that the two herbs were very expensive and rare, so after thinking about it, Connor didn’t hesitate to let her take them all.
After obtaining the medicinal herbs, Connor’s mission could have been completed.
He asked Timothy and the others to take them out of the Precipice Cave and then prepare to return to the Medicine Kings’ Valley.

chapters.title: Chapter 813: Ruby Is Here For You
chapters.content:
Chapter 813: Ruby Is Here For You
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
After Connor found three medicinal herbs in the Precipice Cave, he asked Diana to pluck them and pack them up.
After all, Connor had risked his life to find these three herbs.
Moreover, even if Connor left the herbs here, they would be snatched away by others then, so it was better for Connor to take them himself.
According to what Diana said, these three herbs were all priceless. More importantly, these rare herbs couldn’t be bought with money.
After knowing that these medicinal herbs were precious, Connor felt more or less at ease. After all, he had spent much effort finding these medicinal herbs. This should be considered a comfort to Connor.
Either way, Connor’s trip to Medicine Kings’ Valley was not in vain!
After obtaining the medicinal herbs, Connor did not plan to stay in the Precipice Cave for long. Thus, Connor had Timothy and the others guide them out of Mount Dragon.
Without Westley, Ruby, and the others holding them back, Connor and the others were very fast. It took them nearly three days to enter the mountain, but it only took them less than two days to leave.
When he returned to Medicine Kings’ Valley, it was already midnight.
Connor, Diana, and Carlos planned to rest for the night before returning to Porthampton the following day.
After nearly a week of torment, Connor was exhausted, so after returning to the hotel, Connor fell asleep.
When Connor woke the following day, it was already 10 AM.
As Connor had already gotten the herbs, Carlos and Diana didn’t want to wake him too early. After all, they were not in a hurry to go back.
After Connor woke up, he washed up briefly and went downstairs to eat something.
However, at this moment, there was a knock on the door.
“Who there?” Connor asked softly.
“Mr. McDonald, are you awake?” Diana asked.
Connor was surprised when he heard Diana’s voice. He then responded, “Yes. What’s up?”
“Mr. McDonald, that woman is here to look for you…”
“That woman? Which woman?” Connor asked, puzzled.
“It’s the young lady of the Yandell Family. She is probably here for the medicinal herb. She has been waiting for you in the restaurant downstairs for a long time. Do you want to meet her?” Diana asked slowly.
“Haha…” Connor chuckled faintly when he heard this and said, “All right, since she’s here, let’s meet. Ask her to wait downstairs…”
“All right!” Diana nodded and turned to leave.
Connor didn’t have any good feelings about Ruby. To him, Ruby was just a pretty face. She had no good qualities besides being pretty and having a good figure.
However, Connor didn’t need beautiful women so he wouldn’t fall for Ruby just because of her beauty.
Meanwhile, Ruby had been waiting in the restaurant for three hours.
Under normal circumstances, this young lady of the Yandell Family would have left long ago. However, Ruby was very calm this time. She just sat there and waited quietly.
Ruby already knew Connor’s true identity. She also knew how influential Connor’s background was and how powerful he was.
Therefore, Ruby knew that it would be impossible if she wanted to use any other method to get the medicinal herb from Connor.
However, those herbs were essential to Ruby. Therefore, with Ted’s persuasion, Ruby could only choose the most humble way: to lower her head to Connor and see if he would take the initiative to give up the herbs.
Ruby knew she had offended Connor quite a bit before, so it was almost impossible for her to get Connor to hand over the medicinal herbs. However, Ruby was still willing to put down her pride and give it a try!
This was also why Ruby was not angry after waiting for Connor for a long time.
Ruby was extremely regretful. If she had known that things would turn out like this, she would never have treated Connor like that.
However, it was already too late for Ruby to regret it!
“Mr. McDonald said he would be here in a while. Just wait here!” Diana walked up to Ruby and said expressionlessly.
Ruby hurriedly nodded after hearing that, not daring to say anything.
However, an hour had passed in the blink of an eye, but Connor still was not there.
Ruby was getting impatient. She frowned and said to Ted, “Uncle Ted, isn’t Connor going overboard? We’ve been waiting here for so long, but he isn’t here yet. What’s this?”
“Miss, you should wait a little longer. What Mr. McDonald is doing now is already considered good compared to what you did to Mr. McDonald before…” Ted replied helplessly.
Ruby was rendered speechless. She sighed and didn’t say anything.
A few minutes later, Connor came downstairs with Diana.
When Ted saw Connor, he quickly stood up.
Meanwhile, Ruby continued sitting with an unhappy expression.
Ted quickly reached out and pulled Ruby up, then laughed and called out to Connor,” Mr. McDonald, you’re here!”
“Yes…” Connor nodded, then turned to look at Ruby.
Ruby was dressed very sexily. She was wearing a tight black short skirt. Her waist was slim, her breasts were full, and her legs were slender and fair. She had light makeup on, making her look sexy and cold.
Ruby didn’t say anything after seeing Connor.
Ted politely greeted Connor, then took out a brocade box and handed it to Connor. He said with a smile, “Mr. McDonald, I’ve always wanted to find an opportunity to thank you for what happened in Precipice Cave. This is a 500-year-old wild ginseng. I hope you’ll accept it with a smile…”
“Mr. Carlson, you’re too generous…” Connor replied indifferently.
“Compared to your life-saving grace, this is nothing…” Ted hurriedly replied.

chapters.title: Chapter 814: To Save Someone!
chapters.content:
Chapter 814: To Save Someone!
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
500-year-old wild ginseng was worth at least a few million.
Ted was just a bodyguard of Ruby’s. He wasn’t a rich man.
At this moment, he was willing to take out a 500-year-old wild ginseng to repay Connor. He was just human.
At the very least, Ted was showing his human side, which meant that Ted was a grateful person.
On the other hand, Ruby stood there coldly. From this, one could see the difference between Ruby and Ted.
“Mr. Carlson, I have received your kind intentions. However, this medicinal ingredient is of no use to me. You should keep it for yourself…”
Seeing Ted’s polite attitude, Connor naturally wouldn’t disrespect Ted. However, he didn’t want the wild ginseng that Ted gave him.
“Mr. McDonald, I, Ted Carlson, have already remembered your kindness. If you ever need my help in the future, I’ll go through hell fire, even if I’d had to die…” Ted looked at Connor seriously.
“All right…” Connor nodded lightly, then ignored Ruby and sat quietly on the sofa.
Seeing Connor’s attitude, Ruby’s eyes flashed with a trace of helplessness. She took a deep breath and sat down opposite Connor.
Connor sized up Ruby and said expressionlessly, “Why are you here?”
Ruby calmed herself down and said, “Connor, I have come over this time to discuss purchasing the medicinal herbs from you…”
“You want to buy the herbs from me?” Connor could not help but smile faintly when he heard this.
“That’s right. Since the Precipice Cave’s medicinal herbs are all in your hands, I am prepared to pay to buy them from you. You can name the price. As long as it is within the range that our Yandell Family can afford, I will agree to it…”
Ruby’s thoughts were apparent, and her tone was neither servile nor overbearing. Her eyes were like torches, and it was obvious that she was trying to pressure Connor.
Connor sized Ruby up and asked, “Do you know who I am?”
“Mr. McDonald of Porthampton, Steven Lee’s heir!” Ruby had already investigated Connor’s true identity, so she answered directly.
“Since you know my true identity, do you think I’ll need more money? The Yandell Family’s money is nothing to me, so you may leave. I won’t sell a single herb to you!” Connor said.
After hearing Connor’s words, Ruby was stunned. She gritted her teeth and said, “Connor, I know you don’t lack money, but those herbs are very important to me. Why won’t you sell them to me?”
“What does it have to do with me? Besides, I don’t lack money, so I won’t sell them!” Connor replied expressionlessly, then turned to Ruby and asked, “Is there anything else? If not, I’ll take my leave…”
“You…” Ruby glared at Connor, her face filled with shame and anger.
“I remember Mr. Carlson once told me you can’t do whatever you want just because you have money. I know you’re rich, but no matter how rich you are, you can’t buy the herbs from me!”
After saying this, Connor stood up and was about to leave.
Ruby looked at Connor, leaving as a trace of despair flashed in her eyes.
Ruby knew that she could do nothing if Connor didn’t want to sell it.
“Mr. McDonald, please wait!” But at this moment, Ted suddenly shouted after him.
After hearing Ted’s call, Connor turned and glanced at Ted, then asked expressionlessly, “Yes, Mr. Carlson?”
“Mr. McDonald, I know that what Ms. Yandell did to you before was inappropriate, but Mr. McDonald, can you sell the Red Sun Ginseng to us for my sake? The Red Sun Ginseng is important to us. I can agree to any condition if you sell it!” Ted looked at Connor and said seriously.
Connor couldn’t help but frown when he heard Ted’s words. With a puzzled expression, he asked, “Mr. Carlson, is this herb really that important to you?”
“This concerns a person’s life. It’s very important!” Ted nodded slightly.
Connor knew Ted wouldn’t lie to him, so he asked, “Mr. Carlson, aren’t you collecting so many herbs just to refine pills?”
“Mr. McDonald, it’s true that we’re collecting herbs to refine pills, but we’re not refining pills to make money, but to save people!” Ted replied in a low voice.
“Uncle Ted, forget it since Connor doesn’t want to sell it. We’ll think of another way!” Ruby suddenly stood up and shouted.
“Ms. Yandell, there’s no other way. Let’s tell Mr. McDonald the truth. I think Mr. McDonald is a good person. If Mr. McDonald knows the truth, he might change his mind…” Ted whispered.
“Is he a good person?” Ruby looked at Connor and sneered. Then, she said expressionlessly, “If he is a good person, then there are no bad people in this world…”
Connor was not in the mood to deal with Ruby. Instead, he looked at Ted and asked, “Mr. Carlson, what are you hiding?”
“Mr. McDonald, this is what happened. Half a year ago, Ms. Yandell’s father was poisoned by someone and is still in a coma. Moreover, his condition is getting worse by the day. We have also hired many famous doctors to treat him, but they could not find out what kind of poison Mr. Yandell was poisoned with. However, we have not announced this news to the public to prevent some people from taking advantage of the situation and plotting against him. The outsiders don’t know that most of the Yandell Family’s business is managed by Ms. Yandell. Mr. Yandell has been unconscious for more than half a year…” Ted looked at Connor and explained slowly.
“I see!” Connor nodded. He finally understood what was going on.
“Then, we found a miracle doctor who said that if we could refine the Soul Revival Pill, we might be able to cure Mr. Yandell’s illness. So, we found an alchemist master who said that the most important ingredient for the Soul Revival Pill was the Red Sun Ginseng,” Ted hurriedly added.

chapters.title: Chapter 815: The Three Conditions!
chapters.content:
Chapter 815: The Three Conditions!
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
“Mr. McDonald, we are buying a large number of medicinal herbs in Medicine Kings’ Valley mainly to hide it from the eyes and ears of others. It makes everyone think we are here to mass produce pills, so we came here.
“However, we don’t need those herbs at all. The purpose of our visit is for the Red Sun Ginseng in the Precipice Cave. Of course, we can also give the herbs we bought to the alchemist as a fee for refining pills!” Ted looked at Connor and explained.
“I see!” Connor nodded and didn’t say anything.
“We originally thought that as long as we could find the Precipice Cave, we would be able to find the Red Sun Ginseng. However, we did not expect to encounter Yulian in the Precipice Cave. It was all thanks to your help, Mr. McDonald, that we were able to survive…” Ted paused momentarily and then continued, “Mr. McDonald, that Red Sun Ginseng is related to the life of Ms. Yandell’s father and the safety of the entire Yandell Family. Therefore, if that Red Sun Ginseng is useless to you, Mr. McDonald, can you sell it to us? We will agree to it no matter the price…” Connor squinted at Ted.
Only now did Connor understand why Ted, Ruby, and the others had gone through so much trouble just for the Red Sun Ginseng in the Precipice Cave.
However, they did not expect this Red Sun Ginseng to end up in Connor’s hands.
Therefore, they had to buy this Red Sun Ginseng from Connor.
Ruby didn’t want to tell anyone about this. After all, this was a secret of the Yandell Family.
If the enemy found out, the consequences would be unimaginable.
However, after Ted saw Connor’s firm attitude, he could only tell the truth.
After all, only by telling the truth would Connor soften his heart and perhaps change his mind.
Connor glanced at Ted. He knew that Ted wasn’t lying.
The Red Sun Ginseng could have been more helpful in Connor’s hands. He couldn’t stand Ruby, so he didn’t want to sell it to her.
However, since Ted said that this Red Sun Ginseng was related to a person’s life, Connor began to hesitate.
After all, Connor and Ruby’s father had no deep enmity. Connor would feel a little sorry if he were to kill someone just because he was angry.
“Connor, I have offended you before, but this Red Sun Ginseng is very important to my father. Can you sell it to me?” Ruby hesitated for a moment before asking Connor.
It was evident that the attitude of the proud Ruby had changed drastically.
“Since you want this Red Sun Ginseng to heal someone, I will consider selling it to you!” Connor thought for a moment and said softly.
“Mr. McDonald, don’t be rash. Who knows if these people are telling the truth? What if they just made up a story to deceive us?”
Seeing Connor agreeing, Diana frowned and spoke up.
Connor glanced at Ted and said expressionlessly, “I don’t think Mr. Carlson would lie to me…”
“Thank you for your trust, Mr. McDonald!” Ted said to Connor gratefully.
Connor knew that among the three herbs, only the Soul-Calling Grass was needed by Jorge. The other two herbs were useless to him, at least for now. So, Connor felt that since the Yandell Family needed the Red Sun Ginseng, he could sell it to Ruby.
After seeing Connor agree, Ruby’s eyes flashed with excitement. She quickly asked, “Connor, how much do you want for it?”
When Ruby asked this, her face was filled with confidence.
After all, the Yandell Family was a well-known wealthy family in Southeast Asia. Their assets had already reached hundreds of billions.
Therefore, to Ruby, money was just a number.
As long as Connor name a number, she would agree!
There was nothing more important than her father’s life.
“I’ve already told you just now. I don’t need money at all…” Connor replied.
After hearing Connor’s words, Ruby was shocked. She frowned and asked Connor, “Then what do you want?”
“I need you to agree to three conditions!” Connor thought for a moment and said.
“What conditions?” Ruby looked at Connor, puzzled.
Connor reached into his clothes and took the note Jorge had given him. Then, he said, “I came to the Medicine Kings’ Valley this time mainly to collect the herbs on this list, but because the herbs of the Medicine Kings’ Valley have all been bought by you, you have to help me collect all the herbs on this list within a day!”
Hearing Connor’s condition, she quickly lowered her head and looked at the paper Connor took out.
Although the herbs written on the note were very precious, Ruby had collected many herbs in the Medicine Kings’ Valley during this time. It was easy to gather the herbs that Connor needed.
“All right, I can agree to this condition. I will get someone to send the medicinal ingredients you need over in a while…” Ruby nodded.
“The second condition is that I need one billion in cash!” Connor spoke again.
“Pardon me?” Ruby was stunned when she heard Connor’s second condition. Her face was filled with disbelief.
After all, the medicinal herbs Connor needed just now were already worth close to 100 to 200 million dollars, and now Connor wanted one billion dollars in cash. This was daylight robbery!
Ruby had yet to take over all of the Yandell Family’s assets, so one billion was not a small amount to her.
Diana stood beside Connor and couldn’t help but sigh internally. Connor knew how to do business. This time, he would have spent quite a sum of money to collect the herbs. But now, Connor didn’t need to spend a single cent. He could collect all the herbs Jorge needed and even get a billion in cash. Not only did Connor not lose anything on this trip, but he could also earn much money.
Connor had learned all this from Jorge.
Connor knew Ruby needed more money, and she wanted this Red Sun Ginseng. Connor wouldn’t be nice to her about it.
“Isn’t one billion a little too much?” Ruby hesitated before asking Connor in a low voice.

chapters.title: Chapter 816: Daylight Robbery
chapters.content:
Chapter 816: Daylight Robbery
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
“Didn’t you say you can pay as much as I want?” Connor looked at Ruby with a playful smile before continuing, “I’m only willing to sell this at one billion dollars to you because of Mr. Carlson. If it weren’t for Mr. Carlson, I wouldn’t sell it to you even if you gave me ten billion.”
“…” Ruby looked at Connor and fell silent.
Although one billion dollars was shocking, Ruby was still willing to give it up compared to her father’s life.
Therefore, Ruby gritted her teeth and said, “Okay, one billion it is. I can give it to you, but I only have a little cash now. Can I transfer it to you?”
“Of course!” Connor nodded, then took out his bank card and placed it on the table.
Everyone looked at Connor, extremely shocked.
No one had expected Ruby to agree so readily.
Diana was very familiar with herbs. Although Red Sun Ginseng was precious, a single Red Sun Ginseng couldn’t be sold for one billion. No matter how wealthy a person was, they would not buy it at this price.
However, the Red Sun Ginseng could save Ruby’s father’s life. Thus, no matter how much Connor wanted, as long as Ruby could pay, she could only grit her teeth and agree.
Therefore, this deal was very cost-effective for Connor.
Before this, Diana was somewhat reluctant when she knew Connor would sell the Red Sun Ginseng.
But now, she felt that it was fortunate that Connor had sold it to Ruby. If it were someone else, selling it for such a price would be impossible.
Ted looked at Ruby helplessly.
Even if Ruby had treated Connor better, Connor would never have asked for such a price.
Ruby took a deep breath as she looked at Connor’s bank card. Then, she took out her phone and made a call.
A few minutes later, Ruby put down the phone and whispered to Connor, “I just finished talking to our company’s finance department on the phone. I’ll be able to transfer the money to you later. Can you give me the Red Sun Ginseng now?”
“I still have a third condition that I haven’t mentioned…”Connor glanced at Ruby and said expressionlessly.
Ruby’s eyes flashed with a trace of helplessness as she asked Connor hesitantly, “All right, what is it?”
“My third condition is that I want ten percent of the Yandell Family’s shares!”
After hearing Connor’s third condition, everyone gaped in shock.
No one had expected Connor to make such a request!
Previously, Connor said he wanted to take those herbs from Ruby and sell the Red Sun Ginseng for one billion. To ordinary people, these demands were already too much.
However, Ruby had no other choice. She needed the Red Sun Ginseng now, so she could only grit her teeth and agree.
However, no one expected Connor’s third condition to be ten percent of the Yandell Family’s shares!
“Connor, are you crazy?” After a short moment of shock, Ruby stood up and shouted at Connor.
Ruby’s suppressed emotions finally exploded. She felt that Connor had gone too far. He was bullying her!
Even Ted looked at Connor with a strange expression. He felt it was already good enough for Ruby to agree to the two conditions Connor proposed. However, no one would agree to the third condition!
“Ten percent of the Yandell Family’s shares. This is my third condition. If you agree, I can give you the Red Sun Ginseng now. But if you disagree, I will return the medicinal herbs and one billion in cash. Think about it carefully…” Connor said calmly.
“You’re crazy. You must be crazy!” Ruby shouted agitatedly, then continued, “Do you know what ten percent of our Yandell Family’s shares represent? Who do you think you are? Why should I give you ten percent of the shares?”
Ruby’s family was the most prominent in Southeast Asia. They had countless companies under them, and they were involved in all kinds of industries. Even if they were to estimate conservatively, the market value of the Yandell Family’s company was more than 100 billion!
If Connor obtained ten percent of the shares of the Yandell Family, it would be equivalent to getting tens of billions. This was why everyone felt Connor’s request was overboard.
After all, Ruby had already given Connor one billion in cash, and now Connor was asking for shares. This was literally daylight robbery.
“Connor, it’s impossible for me to agree to your condition. It would be best to find out what this ten percent share means. I advise you to change your condition!” Ruby growled at Connor.
“I won’t change my terms. I want ten percent of the shares. If you agree, I’ll give you the Red Sun Ginseng. If you disagree, you can leave now!” Connor sat firm and said calmly.
After hearing Connor’s threat, Ruby was stunned. Her chest trembled slightly, not knowing what to say. She never thought that Connor would be so determined.
Diana looked at Connor, her admiration for him was beyond words.
She felt that Connor was business-smart.
Not only did he get one billion in cash, but he also wanted ten percent of the Yandell Family’s shares.
If Ruby agreed, it would be unimaginable!
Most importantly, Connor’s attitude could not have been more firm, giving Ruby no room to bargain.
However, Diana was more or less worried. After all, if he angered Ruby, wouldn’t it be all for naught?
“Impossible. I won’t give you ten percent of the shares. Don’t even think about it…” Ruby looked at Connor and shook her head.
“Since you cannot accept the third condition, you can leave now…” Connor looked at Ruby and said.
“Connor, aren’t you going a little too far? How can you do business like this?” Ruby shouted at Connor.
“I’m sorry, but this is how I do business!” Connor smiled at Ruby.

chapters.title: Chapter 817: Going Back on Her Words
chapters.content:
Chapter 817: Going Back on Her Words
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
After hearing Connor’s words, Ruby’s expression immediately turned ugly.
She felt that his condition was too unreasonable.
After all, a ten percent stake in the Yandall family was worth several billion dollars.
She couldn’t possibly agree to his request.
However, Connor’s attitude was extremely firm, showing no intention of changing his mind or giving Ruby any room for negotiation.
This left her at a loss, standing dumbfounded in place.
If she were to give up ten percent of the Yandall family’s shares, she would definitely be very unwilling.
But if she didn’t give up these shares, Connor wouldn’t hand over the Red Sun Ginseng!
So at this moment, her expression was filled with distress, and she instinctively turned her head to look at Ted.
A hint of helplessness flashed across Ted’s eyes as he softly said to Connor, “Mr. Connor, isn’t ten percent of the shares a bit too much? After all, the entire Yandell family is not something that Miss Ruby alone can decide…”
“Do you think it’s too much?” Connor replied casually to Ted, then continued, “But have you considered that if I don’t give you the Red Sun Ginseng, then Miss Ruby’s father’s illness won’t improve. At that time, the potential losses to the Yandall family won’t be just ten percent of the shares, it could be even more. However, if you’re willing to give up that ten percent of the shares, not only can Miss Ruby’s father recover, but you can also slowly recoup what you’ve lost so far. So how do you plan to deal with this issue? Think it over and get back to me…”
After hearing his words, Ruby’s eyes flickered with a hint of surprise.
Because he was right, if her father couldn’t get better, the potential losses they would suffer wouldn’t be just ten percent of the shares, but much more.
And that ten percent of the shares could also save her father’s life.
So no matter how you looked at it, agreeing to Connor’s request was the best choice for her!
But even if she agreed to give up the Yandall family’s shares, she still felt very unwilling.
Especially when it came to giving them to someone like Connor, she was even more resentful!
“How have you thought it through?” Connor turned his head to Ruby and asked in a soft voice.
She took a deep breath and then replied in a low voice, “Connor, I can agree to your condition. I can give you ten percent of the Yandall family’s shares, but I don’t have the authority to do that now. I need to wait for my father’s recovery before I can give you those shares…”
“Alright!” Connor nodded lightly and then said to Diana, “Give them the Red Sun Ginseng…”
Diana hesitated for a moment, then quickly turned and headed upstairs.
A few minutes later, she brought out a medicine box containing the Red Sun Ginseng and handed it to Ruby.
After receiving the medicine box, Ruby opened it directly and let Ted carefully inspect it.
“Miss, this is indeed the Red Sun Ginseng!” Ted exclaimed excitedly to Ruby.
Upon hearing Ted’s words, a hint of excitement flashed in Ruby’s eyes.
After all the effort, Ruby finally obtained the Red Sun Ginseng!
“Connor, as long as my father gets better, I will have my father give you ten percent of the shares. As for the medicinal herbs you need, I will have them delivered to you soon,” she said to himwith a serious tone.
“Good!” Connor nodded gently.
“If there’s nothing else, I’ll leave now!” Her eyes flashed with a hint of surprise as she spoke softly to him.
He nodded again.
With that, she directly led Ted and the others towards the exit of the hotel.
…
After leaving the hotel, Ruby turned her head and said to a bodyguard behind her, “Later, have your men deliver all the medicinal herbs Connor requested to him…”
“Yes, Miss!” The bodyguard nodded hurriedly.
But after hesitating for a moment, he asked Ruby in a low voice, “Miss Ruby, are you really planning to give him ten percent of the shares?”
“Yes, Miss Ruby, I think you should discuss this matter with your family first!” Ted also advised in a low voice.
Upon hearing Ted and the bodyguard’s words, her eyes flashed with anger. She stared at them with watery eyes and shouted, “This Connor is really greedy! Not only did he take so many medicinal herbs from me, but he also took one billion in cash from me. And now he wants ten percent of the shares of our Yalland family. I think he’s gone mad!”
“What do you mean, Miss?” Ted hesitated for a moment and asked her in a low voice.
“What do I mean?” she sneered and said lightly, “Since Connor gave me the Red Sun Ginseng, I will give him what I promised according to the agreement. But as for that ten percent of the shares, he shouldn’t even dream of it. I absolutely won’t give it to him…”
“Miss, didn’t you just promise Mr. Connor? Are you planning to go back on your word now?” Ted’s face changed instantly upon hearing this and he hurriedly whispered.
“So what if I promised him? It was just a verbal agreement between Connor and me. This fool didn’t sign any contract with me, and there were no lawyers present. He doesn’t have any evidence to prove that I promised him. So even if I don’t give him that ten percent of the shares, he can’t do anything to me. Even if he takes me to court, I’m not afraid!” Ruby coldly laughed and continued, “As a businesswoman, I know that what I said to Connor earlier doesn’t hold any legal weight.”
Therefore, even if she decided to go back on her word, Connor wouldn’t have any means to hold her accountable.

chapters.title: Chapter 818: Connor’s Plan
chapters.content:
Chapter 818: Connor’s Plan
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Although Ruby is about the same age as Connor, she has already been in society for many years and has been working in her own family’s company for a long time.
When it comes to business matters, she more knowledgeable than anyone else.
Ruby did promise Connor earlier to give him 10% of the Yandell family’s shares.
However, that was just a verbal agreement and has no legal effect whatsoever.
There was also no video or audio evidence, so if Ruby refuses to acknowledge it, Connor has no way to enforce it.
She admits that he was indeed very capable, but what difference does it make?
He was ultimately just an ordinary person, so he cannot escape legal consequences.
Even if they go to court, she wasn’t afraid!
“Miss, don’t you think what we’re doing is not right?”
After hearing Ruby’s words, Ted’s eyes showed a hint of worry. He softly said to Ruby, “Miss Ruby, I think what we’re doing may not be appropriate…”
“What’s inappropriate?”
Ruby was puzzled for a moment and asked Ted with an uncomprehending tone.
“Miss, if you refuse to acknowledge it, I’m afraid Mr. Connor won’t easily give up!” Ted replied in a low voice.
Upon hearing this, Ruby’s expression seemed somewhat disdainful. She said lightly, “Even if he doesn’t give up, so what? That Connor is just an ordinary person. We’re in a society governed by the rule of law now. Everything requires evidence and legal interpretation. No matter how capable Connor is, can he surpass the law? I don’t believe he can do anything to me!”
“Ah…”
Ted sighed softly, not knowing what to say.
“After returning, I will discuss with my father. Even if we don’t give him 10% of the shares, we should offer Connor some compensation. This matter must be handled properly, or it might be a trouble in the future!”
After taking a deep breath, Ted walked briskly to catch up with Ruby’s pace.
She was still inexperienced in the world, so sometimes she doesn’t consider things from a comprehensive perspective like he does.
In Ruby’s eyes, Connor was just slightly more capable than others.
But Ted knew that if Connor can defeat Yulian, it meant his background and identity were definitely not simple. Provoking such a person was not a wise choice.
…
On the other side,
Diana looked somewhat helpless when she saw Ruby and the others leaving like this.
She couldn’t help frowning and said to Connor, “Mr. Connor, are you really just letting that woman, Ruby, go like this?”
“What else can I do? I can’t keep this woman by my side all the time…” he?replied casually.
“But if you let her take the spiritual medicine, what if she denies it later? What will we do then?”
Diana said worriedly.
“Denying it?”
When he heard this, he couldn’t help but smile faintly. Then he said, “According to Ruby’s personality, she would definitely deny it, but sometimes she won’t have a choice!”
Diana looked at him, her expression somewhat puzzled, and asked,”Mr. Connor, we haven’t signed any contract with Ruby. If she denies it, there’s nothing we can do about it!”
“You don’t have to worry about that. I will have a way to get back what Ruby owes me when the time comes!” he replied casually.
In fact, he had already made plans. He knew that the Yandell family, where Ruby belonged, was a wealthy business family in Salem.
Coincidentally, he also had some business in Salem, and the person in charge of managing those businesses was Sabrina’s father, Charles.
So when the time comes, if Ruby dares to deny it, Connor can completely leverage Charles’s power to deal with the Yandell family.
The Yandell family had always been Charles’s biggest competitor in Salem. If Ruby was sensible, she would willingly hand over ten percent of the shares, which would greatly help Charles expand his business in Salem. Moreover, Connor could also make Charles establish a strategic partnership with the Yandell family, which would be beneficial to both parties.
But if she wasn’t sensible, there will be no other way. Connor can only choose to let Charles swallow up the Yandell family.
In fact, Connor had discussed these matters with Charles. After learning about Ruby’s identity, Connor immediately called Charles and inquired about the situation with Ruby.
However, what he never expected was that the Yandell family’s company had a significant conflict with Charles’s company in Salem.
For so many years, Charles had been trying to deal with the Yandell family but had been unable to find a suitable opportunity.
And Ruby had no idea about Connor’s true identity or his relationship with Charles. That’s why she inadvertently revealed the fact that her father had been in a coma for many years.
This news should be advantageous for Charles.
At the very least, it would allow Charles to plunder the resources of the Yandell family while Ruby’s father was ill.
Moreover, Connor knew that Ruby had almost emptied the entire Yandell family to pay for her father’s medical treatment. And now, she had given Connor one billion in cash. The Yandell family’s financial situation would definitely face significant problems, which would provide a great opportunity for Charles.
Once Ruby’s father recovers, the position of the Yandell family would become very weak, and Charles would have much more initiative.

chapters.title: Chapter 819: No One Knows You Anyways
chapters.content:
Chapter 819: No One Knows You Anyways
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Although the three conditions proposed by Connor and Ruby may not seem related on the surface, they are all part of Connor’s plan to help Charles gain control over Salem’s business.
Connor himself did not expect to have some unexpected gains during his visit to the Medicine King’s Valley. While he originally came to collect some medicinal materials, he unexpectedly obtained some other rewards.
Once Ruby’s father’s illness truly improves, the Yandell family will have only two choices. The first option is to honestly hand over 10% of their shares.
Connor knew that her father currently only held less than 50% of the shares, and the rest were dispersed among other shareholders. Therefore, once Connor acquires this 10% of the shares, he will already become the second largest shareholder of the Yandell family. Furthermore, during this time, Charles can purchase some shares from other minority shareholders.
By then, Connor can quietly become the largest shareholder of the Yandell family.
He can then naturally help Charles resolve the biggest business rival in Salem.
Although the request of 10% may seem casual to others, it is a carefully calculated number by Connor.
Of course, Ruby has a second choice, which is to refuse to comply.
But at that time, Connor cannot be blamed for being ruthless.
He believed in Charles’s abilities. Before Ruby’s father’s illness improves, Charles will surely made thorough preparations.
Of course, he wouldn’t explain all these things to Diana and the others. It was better for Diana and the others to know less about the business.
The appearance of Ruby actually changed Connor’s perspective on many things. He realized that despite being around the same age as himself, Ruby can control such a large company like the Yandell family.
