On the other hand, even though Connor has inherited the family fortune for a long time, he has never been involved in the business. Connor feels that it is time for him to take over the company’s business and not rely on Thomas and others for everything.
Although she didn’t really intend to give him 10% of the shares, she did not break her promise regarding the two conditions Connor proposed earlier.
Not long after Ruby left, someone voluntarily sent the medicinal materials Connor needed, and the promised one billion in cash from Ruby also arrived.
After everything was settled, Connor naturally didn’t need to stay there anymore. He chose to take the train back to Porthampton with Diana and Carlos.
After returning to Porthampton, Connor asked Diana and Carlos to go back and rest, while he went to Jorge’s house alone with the medicinal materials.
Jorge was still the same as before, sitting alone in a rocking chair with his eyes closed, basking in the sun, while Jabba quietly squatted beside him.
He felt that Jorge was very different from the other warriors he imagined because, in Connor’s eyes, warriors should spend most of their time on cultivation. But Jorge was different. He was like those retired old men, sitting alone in a rocking chair basking in the sun during the day, going to bed early at night, and continuing to bask in the sun the next day. Connor had never seen Jorge practice!
Of course, now he no longer doubted Jorge’s skills because after experiencing these events, he believed that Jorge must have some abilities. He thought that if he could become Jorge’s disciple, he wouldn’t lose out.
“Mr. Jorge, I’ve brought you the medicinal materials you wanted…”
With a cheerful smile, Connor shouted towards Jorge’s direction.
Upon hearing his words, Jorge quickly turned his head, glanced at him lightly, and asked in a soft voice, “Did you find Precipice Cave?”
“Of course, I found the medicinal materials inside Precipice Cave for you as well…”
Connor nodded gently.
“Did you also meet Yulian?”
Jorge continued to ask.
“You actually know Yulian?”
A hint of confusion flashed in Connor’s eyes.
“Since I know where to find the Soul-calling Grass, naturally, I know about Yulian…”
Jorge replied softly.
“Yes, I did meet that Yulian, and I even defeated him before obtaining these medicinal materials!”
Connor nodded lightly.
“Is Yulian dead?”
Jorge asked in a soft voice.
“He’s not dead, but he’s disabled now. I guess he won’t be able to harm anyone anymore…”
Connor answered.
“I didn’t expect that after so many years, Yulian is still there. It’s indeed quite interesting. He has been up to no good for so many years. You have done a good thing by crippling him…”
Jorge chuckled lightly, then narrowed his eyes as if recalling something.
“No, old man, since you know so much about the situation in Precipice Cave, why don’t you go there yourself? Why did you ask me to go? Do you know how dangerous that Yulian is? I was lucky not to die there…”
Connor suddenly realized that something was amiss. He furrowed his brows and shouted at Jorge.
“Didn’t I give you the Gathering Spirit Pill? As long as you take it, even if there’s ten Yulians, they wouldn’t be a match for you…”
Jorge said lightly.
“It’s not about the pill. I don’t understand why, since you know so much about the situation in Precipice Cave, you don’t go there yourself. Why did you ask me to go? Don’t you know it’s risky? Are you trying to train me?”
Connor asked in a puzzled tone.
“Train you?”
Upon hearing this, Jorge sneered and said indifferently, “What is there for you to train?”
“Then why did you ask me to go?”
Connor pursued.
“I do know that the Soul-calling Grass is in Precipice Cave, and I know that Yulian has been guarding it all along. The reason I didn’t go myself is that I hate doing such things!”
Jorge replied calmly.
“Do you think it’s embarrassing?”
Connor asked, taken aback.
“Well, if I were to personally snatch the Soul-calling Grass, I might become the laughingstock of others. After all, someone at my level doing something like stealing someone else’s medicinal herb would be quite embarrassing…”
Jorge didn’t deny it, directly nodding and saying.
Connor looked at Jorge, instantly speechless. He stared with wide eyes and shouted, “Fine, you old scoundrel! If you think it’s embarrassing, then you make me go, right? Aren’t I embarrassing enough?”
“Well, nobody knows you, so what’s there for you to be embarrassed about?”
Jorge confidently retorted.
Upon hearing his words, Connor was instantly speechless, not knowing how to refute him.

chapters.title: Chapter 820: A Hero Saving a Damsel in distress!
chapters.content:
Chapter 820: A Hero Saving a Damsel in distress!
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Connor had never encountered someone as shameless as Jorge.
He realized that he couldn’t argue with someone like Jorge.
Moreover, he had already returned from the Medicine King’s Valley, so it didn’t make much sense to argue with him about these things.
“Old man, I have completed the task you entrusted to me. According to our initial agreement, shouldn’t you accept me as your disciple now?” Connor asked him.
“Put the medicinal herbs here and come back in a week,” Jorge said slowly.
“Why? Didn’t we agree on this before? As long as I help you find these medicinal herbs, you will accept me as your disciple. Are you trying to back out?” Connor asked helplessly.
Jorge always did things in an unconventional way, so he was somewhat worried.
“I promised you, and I will naturally fulfill my promise. But as for why I want you to come back in a week, I can’t tell you right now. But you will know in a week…” Jorge replied calmly.
“After that week, will you accept me as your disciple?” Connor asked softly.
“Yes.” Jorge nodded.
After seeing Jorge’s agreement, he didn’t continue to ask anything.
Because he knew that even if he asked, Jorge would never answer him, so it was better to wait for a week to pass. After all, a week was not too long.
“Alright, if there’s nothing else, I’ll go back first. I’ve been busy at the Medicine King’s Valley for so many days, and I need to rest…” Connor couldn’t help but yawn and turned to leave.
“Oh, by the way, do you have Red Sun Ginseng and Vermilion Sparrow Flower with you?” At that moment, Jorge suddenly asked.
“Red Sun Ginseng and Vermilion Sparrow Flower? I don’t know…” Connor paused for a moment, then shook his head directly.
“Enough with the act. In Precipice Cave, there are three types of medicinal herbs. Since you were able to find Soulcalling Grass, it means you definitely have Red Sun Ginseng and Vermilion Sparrow Flower as well. Leave them all!” Jorge said slowly.
When Connor heard this, an expression of helplessness appeared on his face, not knowing what to say.
He never expected that Jorge would be so knowledgeable about the situation in Precipice Cave.
Originally, he planned to keep the remaining Vermilion Sparrow Flower, hoping to sell it for some money in the future. But he didn’t expect that Jorge would even want the Vermilion Sparrow Flower.
“I already gave away the Red Sun Ginseng to someone else. Now I only have the Vermilion Sparrow Flower. Do you still want it?” He hesitated for a moment and asked Jorge helplessly.
“Yes,” Jorge didn’t hesitate at all and nodded directly.
“Why do you want everything? So, I went to the Medicine King’s Valley this time and didn’t gain anything? Old man, aren’t you going a bit too far?” Connor exclaimed with an excited tone.
“You must have earned quite a bit by selling the Red Sun Ginseng, so how can you say you didn’t gain anything…” Jorge answered indifferently.
“Uh…” Connor’s expression became even more speechless after hearing his words.
At that moment, he couldn’t help but wonder if Jorge had been secretly following him, otherwise, how would he know everything?
“The Vermilion Sparrow Flower is useless in your hands. It’s better to give it to me…”
Just then, Jorge spoke again.
Although reluctant, he ultimately handed it to him and left his house alone.
By the time Connor left Jorge’s house, it was already ten o’clock at night. The sky had long darkened, and due to the secluded location where Jorge lived, it was difficult to hail a taxi.
Having no other choice, he started walking towards the position of the Royal Villas while waiting to see if any taxis passed by.
When he was broke in the past, he couldn’t bear to spend money on a taxi, so he had gotten used to walking. A distance of five or six kilometers was nothing to him.
“Help! Help!”
But as he passed by a scenic lake, he suddenly heard a woman’s cry for help.
Instinctively, he thought someone had fallen into the lake, so he rushed towards the lake.
However, when he arrived at the lake, he found that no one had fallen into the water at all.
Instead, the plea for help seemed to be coming from the small forest next to the lake. Without hesitation, he ran straight towards the forest.
Upon entering the forest, he saw a creepy-looking man forcefully pinning down a scantily dressed beautiful woman on the ground.
He tightly covered the woman’s mouth with his right hand while his left hand was pulling at her clothes frantically.
The woman on the ground was disheveled, and Connor could faintly see her exposed figure.
“Damn, I love women dressed provocatively like you. Your chest is simply too big, and your thighs are so fair and tender. Today, I’ve hit the jackpot. Don’t be afraid, my beauty. As long as you cooperate with me, I promise to give you an unforgettable experience…”
The lecherous man was fully engrossed in his perverse desires, so he didn’t notice that Connor had already approached him from behind.
While the woman struggled and desperately called for help, her eyes were filled with despair.
“Stop!”
At that moment, Connor suddenly shouted.
Upon hearing Connor’s words, the lecherous man immediately turned his head towards his direction.
Without any hesitation, Connor lifted his leg and kicked the lecherous man’s buttocks with force. It should be noted that Connor’s strength was not something an ordinary person could match.
His kick sent the lecherous man flying.
The next second, the lecherous man heavily crashed onto the ground, emitting a painful howl.
The lecherous man struggled briefly while lying on the ground. He knew that Connor’s skills were extraordinary, and he was no match for him. Additionally, he was feeling guilty at the moment. Therefore, he got up and ran towards the front.
“Trying to run?”
Seeing that the lecherous man was attempting to escape, Connor quickened his pace, ready to catch up.
However, just then, the woman lying on the ground hurriedly shouted, “That man has a knife on him. Don’t chase him…”
Upon hearing the woman’s words, he couldn’t help but pause for a moment. He then stopped in his tracks and walked up to the woman, asking softly, “Are you okay?”
“I’m fine…” The woman quickly replied to Connor, then slowly stood up.

chapters.title: Chapter 821: A Beauty's Repay
chapters.content:
Chapter 821: A Beauty’s Repay
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
After the beauty saw the creepy man run away, she quickly stood up and looked at Connor with an excited expression.
As the beauty stood up, Connor finally had a clear view of the woman’s appearance in front of him.
It must be said that the woman standing in front of him at this moment was indeed very beautiful.
Although she should be a few years older than Connor, her delicate oval face was exceptionally charming.
Her lustrous black hair appeared somewhat messy, but it had a unique allure.
The beauty was wearing a white professional shirt and a black pencil skirt. Her tall and sexy figure, coupled with the pair of beautiful legs tightly wrapped in stockings under the skirt and the high heels she wore, made her attractive.
At this moment, he finally understood why the creepy man had targeted this woman. She was truly irresistible, and it was normal for that creepy man to lose control.
After quickly adjusting her clothes, the beauty expressed her gratitude to Connor, saying, “I really appreciate what you did today. If it weren’t for you, I might have been… by that person.”
As she spoke these words, her eyes instantly turned red, and tears welled up, as if she was still afraid.
“It’s alright. I just happened to pass by here. As a girl, it’s best not to go out alone late at night. It’s easy to encounter bad people…” he said softly to the woman.
“Well, I don’t know how to thank you. Please accept this money!” The beauty spoke while taking out some cash from her wallet and tried to hand it to him.
However, he directly refused the woman’s kind gesture and said in a deep voice, “I helped you not for the money. It’s late now, and this place is not safe. If you don’t have any other business, it’s better to leave here as soon as possible.”
“If you don’t accept this money, I won’t feel at ease. After all, you saved me…” The woman said earnestly to Connor.
“I don’t need money. You should keep it for yourself. Do you have anything else? If you don’t, then I’ll go first…” He rejected once again.
If it were the previous Connor, he would have accepted the money without any hesitation. But now, he didn’t need the money at all, so he naturally wouldn’t take it.
When the beauty saw that he seemed to be planning to leave, a trace of anxiety flashed in her eyes. She quickly reached out and grabbed him, then called out softly, “Wait!”
“What else do you need?” He turned his head to look at the woman, asking in confusion.
“Well, there’s something else I want to ask for your help with…” The woman said softly.
“What kind of help? Just tell me…” He hesitated for a moment and asked directly.
“Can you drive me home?” The woman asked him softly.
“What?” He was stunned after hearing the woman’s words, wearing a puzzled expression.
“Here’s the situation. I had a few drinks at the bar today, so I called a designated driver to take me home. But unexpectedly, the driver had ill intentions towards me. He said the car was broken and asked me to get out and follow him for inspection. Without much thought, I followed him down, and then he held a knife and forced me to come here…”
The woman hurriedly explained to Connor, pointing to a red Lamborghini not far away and said, “My car is parked on the side of the road. This place is a bit remote, and I’m afraid I won’t be able to find a taxi…”
Connor looked at the beauty in front of him and hesitated for a moment before speaking softly, “Alright, it’s quite dangerous for you to be alone here. Let me take you home…”
“Thank you so much. Don’t worry, I won’t let you help for nothing. I will definitely express my gratitude to you!”
After the beauty heard his agreement, her expression seemed even more excited, and she quickly called out to him.
“No need for thanks. Our meeting is a stroke of fate!” he replied with a smile and led the beauty towards the side of the road.
After a moment, Connor and the beauty got into the car and drove towards the location of the beauty’s home according to her guidance.
“Hello, my name is Nicole Cooper. What’s your name?”
After getting into the car, Nicole’s emotions stabilized a bit, and she took the initiative to ask Connor.
“I’m Connor…” he replied lightly while driving.
“I see that you’re young. Are you still in school?”
Nicole looked Connor up and down, asking softly.
“Yes, I’m currently studying at Porthampton University…”
Connor replied hastily.
“Oh!”
Nicole nodded lightly, then took the initiative to chat with Connor.
During the conversation, Connor learned that Nicole was the CEO of a listed company and came from a wealthy family. However, he didn’t know the specifics of what she did.
Actually, he had long known that Nicole’s family must be very well off because the price of her sports car was not cheap. People who could afford such a car must be wealthy.
Half an hour later, he dropped Nicole off at her home.
Nicole lived in a luxurious villa. Although it couldn’t compare to Connor’s villa, it was still considered very good in the eyes of ordinary people.
“Connor, do you want to come inside and sit for a while?”
After getting out of the car, she took the initiative to ask him.
“No need, it’s getting late, and I need to go back…”
He directly shook his head and refused.
“Alright then! Oh… wait, don’t leave yet. Wait here for me, I’ll be right out!”
She seemed to remember something and called out to him, then hurriedly ran towards the villa.
Connor watched Nicole’s figure and smiled helplessly. He knew that she probably went back to get money to thank him.
So he didn’t continue to wait there but turned around and left.
When she ran out of the villa with a stack of banknotes, she found that he had already left.
“Why did he leave?”
Nicole stood there with an puzzled expression, a hint of helplessness flashing in her eyes, muttering softly to herself.

chapters.title: Chapter 822: Are You Afraid That I Will Eat You Up?
chapters.content:
Chapter 822: Are You Afraid That I Will Eat You Up?
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
After leaving Nicole’s villa, Connor hailed a taxi and returned to Royal Villa alone.
Once he arrived home, he freshened up quickly and then lay down on the bed to rest. He didn’t care at all about what happened with Nicole.
The next day, when he woke up it was already ten o’clock in the morning.
He picked up his phone, briefly checked Facebook, and found no important messages.
So he went straight into the bathroom, freshened up quickly, and changed into a new set of clothes.
Connor hadn’t been to the school for almost half a month, and since he had nothing to do today, he decided to go and take a look.
After leaving the villa, he took a taxi directly to Porthampton University.
Since Connor had already informed Rachel beforehand that he didn’t need to take leave for anything, he had no worries about Rachel causing trouble for him.
When Connor arrived at university, he found that the students in his class were already seated and attending the class.
Fortunately, it wasn’t Rachel’s class, otherwise he would have to stand outside the classroom.
After hesitating for a moment, he slipped into the classroom unnoticed by the teacher.
When Dominic and Spencer saw Connor, they had an extremely excited expressions on their faces.
Dominic whispered to Connor, “What have you been doing these days? Why haven’t you attended classes?”
“What else could Connor have been doing? He must have been enjoying himself somewhere, or maybe he went to see his girlfriend. The life of rich people is beyond our imagination…”
Spencer teased him.
He smiled lightly and said softly, “I had some things to take care of these past few days, so I couldn’t attend classes…”
“What things?” Dominic asked curiously.
“Oh, even if I told you, you wouldn’t know. It’s better not to inquire…” he replied casually.
Upon hearing his words, a trace of helplessness flashed in Dominic’s eyes, but he didn’t continue to ask.
At this moment, Connor didn’t mention anything about Medicine King’s Valley to Dominic and Spencer. After all, even if they knew about it, it wouldn’t be of any use to them and wouldn’t benefit them.
Dominic and Spencer began telling Connor about the recent events happening in the school.
Most of the events were trivial matters and not important.
The only significant thing was that Sheldon’s gang had come to Connor’s class looking for him. It seemed they wanted to seek revenge for the incident at the gym. However, when they learned that he wasn’t at school, they left and never returned.
The class ended quickly.
After class, Connor sat in his seat and started playing with his phone, while Dominic and Spencer decided to go to the restroom to smoke.
Since he didn’t smoke, he didn’t go with them.
However, just a few minutes after Dominic and Spencer left, Dominic hurriedly ran back to Connor and excitedly said, “Connor, there’s a stunning beauty looking for you. Hurry and go out to see her…”
“A stunning beauty looking for me?”
Connor’s eyes showed a hint of confusion upon hearing Dominic’s words, as if he didn’t understand what he meant.
“Yes, there’s a stunning beauty outside the classroom saying she’s looking for you. You’ll know when you go out and see for yourself,” Dominic excitedly shouts.
Connor’s eyes showed a hint of confusion as he doesn’t know who could be looking for him.
After hesitating for two seconds, he walked out of the classroom.
Once outside the classroom, Connor noticed many male students gathered around a seductive beauty.
Although the figure of this beauty seemed familiar, he couldn’t recall who she is.
He approached the beauty directly, but when he saw her face, he instantly froze in place.
The beauty was none other than Nicole, the woman he rescued last night!
Today, Nicole was wearing a black tight mini-skirt that accentuates her seductive figure. Her slender, fair legs were wrapped in black stockings, and she was wearing high heels. Paired with her exquisite face and black wavy hair, she exudes an indescribable allure.
The male students outside the classroom can’t take their eyes off the alluring beauty in front of them.
When Nicole saw Connor coming out, a hint of excitement flashes in her eyes. She quickly waled towards him and smiles, saying, “Connor, I finally found you…”
“Why did you come to our school?” he asks, his expression filled with surprise.
Nicole glances at Dominic and the others, then whispers, “Connor, do you have time? Can we talk somewhere else?”
He understands that she probably found it inconvenient to speak with so many people around.
After a moment of consideration, he followed her as they walk outside the school.
Dominic and the others watched the backs of Connor and Nicole, their faces filled with envy.
“What do you think is the relationship between this beauty and Connor?” Dominic blinks and asks Spencer.
“I don’t know, but it seems their relationship isn’t simple,” Spencer calmly replies.
“It’s good to be rich. Connor always has beautiful women around him. When will I find a girlfriend like that?” Dominic says in a low voice.
“If you become as wealthy as Connor someday, beautiful women will definitely be by your side, maybe even more than Connor!” Spencer chuckles and then turns back to the classroom.
Meanwhile, after Connor and Nicole leave the school…
Connor glances at Nicole and softly asks, “Why did you come to our school? Do you have something to discuss?”
“Why did you suddenly leave last night?” Nicole looks at Connor and questions.
Upon hearing Nicole’s words, Connor smiles helplessly and calmly replies, “I was feeling a bit tired last night, and it was getting late, so I decided to go back home…”
“You’re afraid I’ll eat you up, huh?” Nicole playfully glares at Connor, unable to resist teasing him.
Connor smiles at Nicole without saying anything. Last night, due to the lighting, he couldn’t see her clearly.
But now, he realizes that Nicole seems even more beautiful and enticing than she did last night.
Connor didn’t expect that he inadvertently saved such a stunning beauty!

chapters.title: Chapter 823: To Offer Oneself in Marriage?
chapters.content:
Chapter 823: To Offer Oneself in Marriage?
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
“Last night, I had planned to give you some money as a way to repay you for saving me. I didn’t know how else to express my gratitude, and I thought as a student, you might need the money.”
“But I didn’t expect that you had already left, so today I came to Porthampton University to find out about you. I didn’t expect you to be quite well-known here. I quickly found the class you’re in…”
Nicole explained to Connor in a soft voice.
“So, that’s how it is…”
After hearing her words, he nodded lightly and continued to ask, looking at Nicole, “So, what brings you here to find me? Are you planning to give me money again?”
“No, since you don’t want my money, it means you don’t need it. So, I came today to invite you for a meal to express my gratitude…”
Nicole hurriedly said to Connor.
“Well…”
After hearing her words, his eyes flickered with a hint of hesitation.
“If you refuse to even have a meal with me, I will feel very guilty…” she continued speaking when she saw his silence.
“Fine then!”
Connor reluctantly agreed.
“Do you have time today?”
She asked him in a soft voice after he agreed.
He felt that if he didn’t go eat with her, she would continue to pester him.
So he reluctantly said, “I have time now, and I’m a bit hungry. Shall we go eat now?”
“Don’t you have class?”
Nicole blinked her foxy eyes and asked, puzzled.
“No, it doesn’t matter if I miss that class. Besides, since you’ve already come here, I can’t make you wait here. Let’s go eat first…”
He thought for a moment and said softly.
“Alright then, my car is parked by the roadside…”
Nicole nodded, then walked towards the roadside.
And he followed behind her.
After getting in the car, she drove with Connor to a famous Western restaurant in Porthampton.
“You’ve probably never been to a place like this for a meal, right?”
Nicole turned her head and asked Connor with a smile.
“No…”
Connor shook his head directly.
“Do you like eating Western food?” she continued asking him.
“I can eat anything…” he replied directly.
“Okay, let’s eat here then. I really like the food here…”
Nicole nodded and then pushed open the car door, walking towards the restaurant with her slender and fair legs.
After hesitating for a moment, he also walked into the restaurant following her.
Once inside the restaurant, Connor found that the environment was quite nice.
And since it was still early, there weren’t many customers.
But from the way these guests were dressed, Connor could tell that their families must be well-off.
“Having a meal here must cost quite a bit, right?” he asked Nicole softly.
“For you, it might be a lot, but for me, it’s nothing!” Nicole’s family was very wealthy, so when she spoke, she would intentionally or unintentionally reveal some information to him.
He knew that she didn’t need to show off anything to someone like him. After all, they had only known each other for a short time. It was probably a character trait she had developed since childhood, so he didn’t mind.
After entering the restaurant, she took out a membership card and handed it to the waiter.
Upon seeing the membership card, the waiter’s attitude instantly changed. Hurriedly, they led Nicole and Connor to a window-side elegant seat.
She gracefully sat down, placing her handbag on the table, while he chose to sit opposite her.
“This seat is reserved for me. I pay millions of membership fees to this restaurant every year, so no matter when, this seat is mine. I’ll have the restaurant staff arrange a membership card for you later. That way, if you want to treat someone to a meal, you can come here…” Nicole paused for a moment, then glanced at Connor and said with a smile, “If you bring those little girls from your school here, I think the chances of confessing your feelings would be much higher…”
“No need. The food in this restaurant is too expensive, I can’t afford it…” He declined with a smile.
“It’s alright. You can charge all your expenses here to my account in the future…” Nicole was expressing her gratitude to Connor, so she tried her best to thank him with various things.
“That’s not necessary…” He shook his head again and refused, “I don’t want anything…”
At this moment, she had no idea about his identity, and this amount of money was nothing to him.
And he had no intention of telling her about his identity.
When Nicole saw Connor rejecting her again, her expression seemed somewhat helpless.
She couldn’t help but sigh and said softly, “You’re really strange. I offer you money, but you don’t want it. I offer you a membership card for here, but you don’t want it either. So what do you want?”
“I don’t want anything…” Connor replied helplessly, then continued, “Yesterday evening, I just happened to help you. Any normal person would have intervened in that situation. So you don’t have to think about how to thank me…”
“That won’t do. If it weren’t for you, I might have been raped a long time ago. How can I not thank you?” she quickly said after hearing his words.
Connor looked at Nicole and didn’t know what to say. He simply said lightly, “Let’s order first!”
“Okay…” She pushed the menu in front of him and said softly, “You order…”
“It’s my first time in a place like this, and I don’t know what’s good. Why don’t you order?” Connor replied softly.
Nicole hesitated for a moment, then directly picked up the menu and started ordering without being polite.
A few minutes later, the waiter began serving the dishes.
Nicole looked at Connor up and down, then asked him, “Connor, do you have a girlfriend?”
Upon hearing her question, he suddenly froze in place, his expression showing extreme confusion.
He couldn’t help but secretly wonder if this woman wanted to offer herself in return since he didn’t want anything.

chapters.title: Chapter 824: Introduce A Girlfriend
chapters.content:
Chapter 824: Introduce A Girlfriend
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Actually, sometimes Connor felt very helpless deep inside.
Before inheriting the inheritance, he had very few female friends, and his luck with women was also very poor!
Most women looked down on him because he was poor.
It was a hard-won opportunity for Connor to find a girlfriend, but in the end, she left him for a rich heir because he was poor.
But when he became wealthy, he found that his luck with women suddenly improved. It reached a level that was beyond belief, and all sorts of women started appearing in his life.
But deep down, he only had genuine feelings for Freya and Yelena.
Even Chloe couldn’t be considered Connor’s true love because he was only with her to satisfy his physical needs.
He always tried his best not to have too much intimate contact with the opposite sex because he felt a sense of guilt in doing so.
If Nicole really intended to offer herself to him at this moment, Connor would definitely reject her without any hesitation.
“Why are you asking me this?” Connor asked Nicole softly.
“Don’t think too much. I don’t mean anything else. I just thought you are about the same age as my cousin, and she is currently single. If you think it’s suitable, I can introduce my cousin to you…” Nicole explained with a smile.
“No need…” Connor hastily replied.
“Why not? Let me tell you, my cousin is very beautiful and comes from a wealthy family. If you can pursue her, you won’t have to struggle for at least fifty years…” Nicole continued.
“I already have a girlfriend…” Connor said helplessly.
At this moment, he started to suspect her intentions. He felt that she was being overly enthusiastic towards him.
“What’s the problem with having a girlfriend?” She dismissed his words and continued, “Girlfriends can be changed. If you can be with my cousin, you won’t have to worry. She is an only child, and her family is very wealthy. Their money will become yours in the future…”
“I really don’t need it. I have a very good relationship with my girlfriend!” he said while eating.
“What’s the use of a good relationship? Not only is my cousin beautiful, but she also has a great figure. Let me give you her Facebook, and you can take a look at her pictures. You can contact each other first…” she said with a smile while sipping her wine.
Connor looked at Nicole’s expression of helplessness and didn’t know what to say.
“Wait a moment. Let me find a photo of my cousin for you…” Nicole took out her phone when she noticed Connor’s silence.
“What does your family do?” he asked, changing the topic.
Seeing Nicole taking out her phone, he quickly changed the topic deliberately. He felt that if they continued this conversation, she would definitely introduce her cousin to him, and he had no intention of going on a blind date.
Dealing with Freya and Yelena was already enough of a headache for Connor. If he added another cousin of Nicole’s, he would go crazy. So, even if the other party had good conditions, Connor wasn’t interested.
Nicole, after hearing Connor’s words, slowly put down her phone and then spoke, “My family is in business. Do you know the Cooper Group?”
“I don’t know…” Connor gently shook his head.
“The Cooper Group is my family’s business. I am currently the general manager of the Cooper Group. Our family business is quite complex, and it involves many industries. I don’t think you are familiar with them, but mainly we are involved in the construction industry…” she explained earnestly.
“I see!” Connor nodded lightly and didn’t say much.
“You’re trying to change the topic on me! Since you don’t want the money I offered and you don’t want me to introduce a girlfriend to you, how about this? After you graduate, come to our Cooper Group. I’ll arrange a better job for you, and you don’t need to worry about the benefits. It will definitely be much better than finding a job on your own…” Nicole said slowly.
“Let’s talk about it after I graduate…” He knew that she was determined to repay him, so if he continued to refuse, she might come up with some other way. It would be better to temporarily agree to her since he still had a year until graduation.
After a year, she probably would have forgotten about this matter.
“That works too. We can discuss it after you graduate…” Nicole nodded lightly and then smiled at Connor, “You should really consider my cousin. I think you’re a good person, and you’re decent-looking. If you’re with my cousin, it will definitely be better than those playboys she’s been with…”
“I really have a girlfriend…” Connor looked at Nicole helplessly.
She smiled faintly and didn’t respond to his words. Instead, she stood up and said to him, “I was so engrossed in chatting with you that my makeup got messed up. I’ll go to the restroom to touch it up…”
“Okay…” Connor nodded.
Nicole turned around and walked towards the restroom.
Meanwhile, he sat alone at his seat and started eating. Although the food at this restaurant was expensive, the dishes were indeed delicious. Even though he wasn’t a fan of Western cuisine, he found the taste enjoyable.
Connor subconsciously looked up at the seat opposite him. He actually thought Nicole was a pretty good girl, at least very kind-hearted.
She must have gathered some information about him when she came to Connor’s school, which is why she was so enthusiastic about introducing him to a girlfriend or a job.
In the eyes of some students at Porthampton University, Connor was just a poor loser who delivered takeout.
So he didn’t really resent Nicole for her words. After all, she treated him well despite knowing that his conditions weren’t great. That was already quite good.
In the blink of an eye, half an hour had passed.
Connor had finished eating. He subconsciously glanced at his phone.
At this moment, he realized that she still hadn’t returned!
“Why is it taking so long to go to the restroom?” He frowned and muttered softly.

chapters.title: Chapter 825: Nicole Was Kidnapped!
chapters.content:
Chapter 825: Nicole Was Kidnapped!
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Just now, Nicole told Connor that she was going to the restroom to touch up her makeup.
However, it had been exactly half an hour since Nicole left her seat. Wasn’t half an hour enough time for her to freshen up?
After thinking for a moment, he believed that she wouldn’t leave without saying anything.
After all, she left her bag here, and she didn’t take her phone with her.
If she really wanted to leave, she would have taken her phone and bag with her.
So he continued to wait in his seat for a few more minutes, but he still didn’t see Nicole return.
Suddenly, Connor felt that something was off. If Nicole had encountered an emergency and wanted to leave, she wouldn’t have left her belongings here, and she would have informed him beforehand, right?
At that moment, he suddenly remembered the assassins he had encountered with Rachel before and became alarmed.
Recently, Rockerfeller’s intentions to harm him had become increasingly clear, so he was worried that she might have been mistaken for his girlfriend and kidnapped by Rockerfeller’s assassins.
Thinking about this, he didn’t hesitate anymore and ran straight towards the restroom!
Perhaps because he had encountered assassins too many times before, he was extremely anxious now. He was worried that Nicole had really encountered the assassins.
After all, he didn’t want these innocent people to suffer any harm because of him.
A few seconds later, Connor hurriedly arrived at the restroom door.
But at that moment, he suddenly realized a very serious problem.
Nicole should be in the women’s restroom now, but as a male, he couldn’t enter!
After hesitating for a moment, he shouted at the top of his lungs, “Nicole, are you in there? Ruoning sister…”
After shouting twice, he realized that there was no response from the restroom at all.
Connor’s expression began to tense up.
So after hesitating for a moment, he directly walked toward the women’s restroom.
“Ah, you pervert! Get out quickly…”
As soon as Connor entered the restroom, he heard a scream.
He saw a girl in a white short skirt standing in front of the restroom mirror, applying makeup.
When she saw Connor coming in, she immediately became excited and yelled.
“Madam, please don’t shout…”
Connor looked at the girl with a helpless expression.
“You pervert, why did you come in? Get out of here…”
The girl quickly picked up her bag and threw it at Connor’s face.
Connor instinctively blocked it with his hand and then anxiously asked the girl, “Madam, did you see a woman come in here? She was wearing a black tight skirt, beautiful, and with a great figure…”
“Why should I tell you? You disgusting pervert! Get out quickly. If you don’t leave, I’ll call security…”
The girl shouted angrily at Connor.
“Madam, she is my friend. She said she was coming in to touch up her makeup, but she hasn’t come out yet. I’m worried that something happened to her. Did you see this person or not?”
Connor asked the girl with a frowning face.
Upon hearing his words, the girl’s expression noticeably calmed down.
She carefully looked at him and asked softly, “How do I know if what you’re saying is true?”
“If I really wanted to peep into the women’s restroom, would I come in so openly?”
Connor said to the girl and then continued to ask,”Did you see this girl or not?”
“I did see a woman wearing a black short skirt leaving just now when I entered…”
After hesitating for a moment, the girl whispered to Connor.
“Are you sure?” he asked with a frown.
“Definitely, because that woman was very beautiful and had a sexy figure, so I couldn’t help but take a few more glances when I entered…”
The girl nodded earnestly.
“When did you enter?” he continued to inquire.
“About ten minutes ago!”
The girl replied after thinking for a moment.
“Thank you!”
Connor exclaimed urgently and then turned around and ran towards the restroom exit.
If what the girl said was true, then Nicole must have left the restroom ten minutes ago.
But after leaving the restroom, Nicole didn’t return to her seat, which meant she definitely went somewhere else.
After leaving the restroom, he returned to his seat and reached out to take her phone and bag, then ran towards the exit of the restaurant.
Since she was a member of this restaurant, the meal was complimentary, so he didn’t need to pay, and the staff naturally didn’t stop him.
After leaving the restaurant, he stood on the roadside and observed the surroundings.
Fortunately, his reaction was quick, so Nicole hadn’t gone far yet.
He noticed that she was less than 200 meters away from him, slowly walking towards a parked Honda Accord!
At this moment, her body looked very stiff, and there were two middle-aged men following closely behind her.
So he knew that these two middle-aged men had taken control of her.
Many thoughts flashed through Connor’s mind. He didn’t know who these two men were or whether they were simply kidnapping Nicole or if they were assassins sent by Rockerfeller to threaten him!
Connor couldn’t confirm any of these things right now.
After taking a deep breath, he instinctively wanted to rush forward and save Nicole.
But he was also worried that these two men might have knives or guns. If he rushed in recklessly, not only would he not be able to save her, but he might also make her situation even more dangerous.
A few seconds later, Nicole and the two middle-aged men got into the Honda Accord.
Meanwhile, he found the Lamborghini car key in Nicole’s bag, then turned around and ran to the Lamborghini, opened the door, and got inside.
A moment later, the Honda Accord started slowly.
And Connor, driving the Lamborghini, closely followed behind the Honda Accord.
He knew that if these two men were ordinary kidnappers, the situation would be relatively simple.
But if they were Rockerfeller’s people, then things would be troublesome.
He was well aware of how difficult it was to deal with Rockerfeller’s people.
If Nicole was truly in danger because of him, he would feel extremely guilty.

chapters.title: Chapter 826: Were They Going to Have Their Way?
chapters.content:
Chapter 826: Were They Going to Have Their Way?
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Under normal circumstances, a person of Nicole’s status would bring a few bodyguards with her.
After all, Nicole was now the general manager of the Cooper Group and the granddaughter of the Chairman of the Cooper Group. In the future, the entire Cooper Group might fall into the hands of Nicole alone.
Nicole was a typical daughter of a rich family, so she would definitely be targeted by many people.
However, Nicole’s personality had always been very cold and aloof. She liked to be alone, so she had never hired a bodyguard.
If Nicole had a few bodyguards with her, there would not be such trouble today.
The speed of the Accord wasn’t very fast, and it was currently rush hour, so it wasn’t easy for Connor to be discovered by others following behind the car.
Connor originally planned to call Kyle Hayes Thomas Morgan, and the others, but Connor thought about it and decided not to. He felt that if he acted alone, the target would be smaller, and the kidnappers would not find him easily.
However, if Thomas Morgan Kyle Hayes, and the others attacked together, the commotion would definitely be very big. At that time, it would alert the enemy. Perhaps the kidnappers would act on impulse and attack Nicole directly.
Therefore, Connor didn’t contact anyone. Instead, he drove alone and followed behind the Audi Accord.
About half an hour later, the Accord drove out of Rivertown and headed toward the suburbs.
After reaching the suburbs, Connor deliberately slowed down the car.
Because there were fewer cars in the suburbs, if Connor followed too close, he would be easily discovered by the kidnappers.
After walking around the suburbs for a while, they arrived in front of a hotel.
The hotel looked a little shabby, and because it was located in a remote area, not many people came here.
Connor felt that since the kidnappers dared to bring Nicole here, it meant that this hotel definitely had nothing to do with the kidnappers. If the kidnappers really wanted to find a hotel related to him, they would not choose such a remote location.
After the Honda Accord stopped, the kidnappers pulled Nicole out of the car and walked into the hotel.
Connor parked the car by the side of the road. After seeing the kidnappers bring Nicole into the hotel, Connor took a deep breath and opened the car door to get out.
After getting off the car, Connor entered the hotel.
“Hello, sir. Do you need to book a room?”
After the receptionist saw Connor, she asked Connor with a smile.
“Okay, get me a suite!”
Connor replied indifferently.
“Our hotel has ordinary suites and business suites. Which one do you want?”
The receptionist asked with a smile.
“Um, did two men and a woman come in just now?”
Connor frowned and asked softly.
“That’s right, three guests did come in just now…”
The receptionist nodded gently.
“It’s like this. These three people are all my friends. You can just open my room next to theirs…”
Connor took out his ID card as he spoke.
The receptionist looked at Connor’s expression and said with some difficulty, “Sir, I’m sorry. You can contact your friend, but we can’t reveal the guest’s room information…”
“…”
After Connor heard the receptionist’s words, a trace of helplessness flashed across his eyes. Then, he directly took out a stack of banknotes and placed them on the table. “My phone is out of battery and I can’t contact my friend. Can you help me?”
“…”
The receptionist’s eyes lit up when she saw the money Connor took out.
She secretly put away the money and said lightly, “Your three friends are in room 606 now. I’ll get you room 607…”
“Thank you, thank you…”
Connor hurriedly replied.
A few minutes later, the receptionist booked a room for Connor.
Connor took the room card and walked straight to the sixth floor.
On the other side, the two kidnappers were still very vigilant after kidnapping Nicole.
Even though they had already arrived at the hotel, they still pointed daggers at Nicole’s waist, indicating for her to continue walking forward.
Nicole’s expression was also very nervous at this time. She asked the kidnapper in a low voice, “Who are you two? What are you trying to do?”
“Cut the crap. Do whatever I tell you to do now. If you continue to talk nonsense, I won’t be polite to you…” one of the kidnappers scolded coldly.
After Nicole heard the kidnapper’s words, a hint of helplessness flashed across her eyes.
At this moment, Nicole did not know what the two kidnappers were going to do to her. If it was a simple kidnapping, the two kidnappers should have taken her to a farther place, but the two of them actually brought her to such a hotel.
“Are they going to have their way with me?”
A strange look flashed across Nicole’s eyes, and the expression on her face became nervous.
A moment later, Nicole was brought to the door of Room 606 by the two kidnappers.
One of the kidnappers opened the door and ordered, “Go in…”
“What exactly do you want?” Nicole frowned and shouted coldly.
“Why are you talking so much? Believe it or not, I’ll stab you right now!” one of the kidnappers threatened with a cold voice. The expression on his face was very angry.
Nicole knew that the two kidnappers were emotionally unstable, so she did not dare to provoke them. She could only walk into the room as instructed.
After entering the room, the kidnapper with a buzz cut took out the rope that he had prepared in advance and tied Nicole’s legs and feet up.
When the two kidnappers tied Nicole up, they finally heaved a sigh of relief.
The two of them did not expect today’s operation to go so smoothly!
No matter what, Nicole was still the general manager of the Cooper Group. Her net worth was at least a billion dollars. It was not easy to kidnap such a big shot.
If it wasn’t for someone offering a very high price for them to do so, the two of them wouldn’t have dared to accept this mission!
Before the fight, the two of them were still very worried. However, after the fight, they’d realized that it was actually very easy to kidnap Nicole because there were no bodyguards around her.
Nicole lay on the bed with desperation on her face.
She did not know what the two of them wanted to do, and she also knew that no one knew that she had been kidnapped.

chapters.title: Chapter 827: Let Me Have A Good Time
chapters.content:
Chapter 827: Let Me Have A Good Time
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
In the hotel suite.
The expression on the other scar-faced kidnapper’s face relaxed when he saw that Nicole’s hands and feet were tied.
He lit a cigarette and sized up Nicole.
“What exactly do you want?”
Nicole frowned and shouted coldly.
“Hehe, you’ll know later…”
The buzz-cut kidnapper sneered, then turned to the scar-faced kidnapper and said, “Bro, you really don’t have to say it. Women from rich families are really different. Look at this figure and appearance. It’s really too attractive. Just one look and I want to do all sorts of things…”
“…”
The scar-faced kidnapper kept smoking silently and did not speak.
“Big Brother, I can’t help it anymore. Why don’t you let me have fun this once? If I can play with such a beautiful rich girl, I’ll accept it even if I die…” the buzz-cut kidnapper said anxiously.
When the scar-faced kidnapper heard the buzz-cut kidnapper’s words, a trace of anger flashed in his eyes.
He couldn’t help but glare and curse, “Are you f * cking crazy? How many times have I told you? The higher-ups have specifically instructed us not to touch this woman. If we touch her, we won’t get a single cent.”
“Hee hee, I was just joking…”
The buzz-cut kidnapper smiled awkwardly.
“After the two of us finish this job, we’ll have money. We can find all kinds of women. There’s no need to delay all that for a single woman…”
The scar-faced kidnapper continued.
“That’s true…”
The buzz cut kidnapper nodded and did not say anything else after that.
The scar-faced kidnapper took out his phone and looked at the time, as if he was waiting for something.
Meanwhile, Nicole was lying on the bed. When she heard the conversation between the two of them, her expression was obviously much calmer because she knew that she was not in danger for the time being.
At the same time, Connor had already arrived at the door of Room 606.
Connor put his ear to the door. Because the soundproofing effect of the room was not very good, Connor could clearly hear the conversation inside.
Upon hearing the conversation between the two, Connor could analyze that these two kidnappers should be professionals, and that there should be someone directing them. He also found out that Nicole should not be in any danger for the time being. Although he did not know why these two people wanted to kidnap her, Connor could vaguely feel that these two people weren’t one of Rockefeller’s people.
This was because the style of these two people was very different from the style of Rockefeller. Rockefeller had always looked down on Connor, so if their people really wanted to attack Connor, they would usually get an assassin to do it. They would never do something like kidnapping!
Connor could not understand why these two people had kidnapped Nicole.
After the scar-faced kidnapper finished smoking a cigarette, he stood up and walked to Nicole and said expressionlessly, “Miss Cooper, right?”
“What do you want?” Nicole asked coldly.
“Miss Cooper, you should know very well what the two of us want to do. The two of us are different from those ordinary kidnappers. We specialize in doing this kind of thing. To put it simply, if someone gives us money, we will help them do things. So I hope you can cooperate with us obediently…”
The scar-faced kidnapper said in a low voice.
“Cut the crap. What do you want?” Nicole shouted with a frown.
“The reason we kidnapped you this time is very simple. Someone wants to talk to you, so you’d better cooperate obediently. That way, everyone will be much more relaxed…”
“What exactly do you want? If you want money, I can give it to you. No matter how much you want, I can satisfy you!”
Nicole took a deep breath. The expression on her face was still relatively calm.
Nicole had been kidnapped once when she was young. It was her father who saved her with the money.
“We don’t need money…”
The scar-faced kidnapper shook his head gently.
“Who are you people?”
Nicole asked with a frown.
“My name is Wes, and this person is my younger brother Wesser. You should have heard of our names, right?”
The scar-faced kidnapper said with a smile.
“…”
After Nicole heard the scar-faced kidnapper’s words, she was stunned on the spot. The expression on her face was very incredulous.
Nicole had indeed heard of these two people’s names. Wes and Wesser were very famous assassins in Porthampton. These two people were ruthless and had done countless heartless things over the years. Basically, as long as they were paid, they were willing to do anything. Moreover, these two people were special forces soldiers. Although they were not martial artists, their skills were definitely above ordinary people.
For so many years, the police had been looking for these two people, but they had never caught them.
Nicole had also heard about Wes and Wesser from her friends, but she could not understand why these two people would kidnap her.
Wes hesitated for a moment before asking Nicole coldly, “Miss Cooper, if I remember correctly, you were eating with your friend in the restaurant just now, right?”
“Yes, I was having dinner with my friend…”
Nicole looked at the kidnapper and nodded gently.
“Then call your friend now and tell him that you have something urgent to attend to. Otherwise, he might call the police when he finds out that you haven’t returned for such a long time. Once he calls the police, we will be in trouble, and so will you…” Wes said slowly.
This was not the first time he had done something like this, so he was very aware of what should be done.
After Nicole heard his words, she remembered that Connor should be in the restaurant. If it was not for Wes’s reminder, Nicole would have forgotten about Connor.
Nicole hesitated for a moment and said in a low voice, “I’m not very familiar with that person. I don’t even have his cell phone number!”
“Miss Cooper, do you not have this person’s phone number, or do you not want to contact this person?” The scar-faced kidnapper asked coldly.
“Things are already like this. Is there a need for me to lie to you?”
Nicole shouted helplessly and continued, “And when I came out just now, I didn’t even bring my phone with me…”
“…”
The scar-faced kidnapper and the buzz-cut kidnapper looked at each other, but neither of them spoke.
“I’ve only known that person for less than two days. Even if I disappear, he won’t call the police,” Nicole spoke again.

chapters.title: Chapter 828: The Best Opportunity
chapters.content:
Chapter 828: The Best Opportunity
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
After the two kidnappers heard Nicole’s words, their expressions became relieved.
They felt that Nicole really did not have Connor’s contact information, and on top of that, she did not even have a phone with her at the moment.
If they let Nicole call Connor with her phone now, their identities would definitely be exposed.
Therefore, after hesitating for a moment, Wes whispered to Nicole, “Alright, since you don’t have that person’s contact information, forget it…”
After hearing this, Connor, who was outside the door, could not help but take a deep breath. He felt that there must be someone else behind these two kidnappers. If Connor continued to wait like this, the other party’s helpers might come over, so now was the best time for him to make a move.
Connor hesitated for a moment before knocking on the door.
“Knock, knock.”
Wes’s expression became cautious when he heard the sound of the door being knocked.
He winked at Wesser and said in a low voice, “Someone’s there. Go and see who it is.”
Wesser nodded slightly after hearing Wes’s words. However, Wesser still did not let down his guard. After all, this was not the first time they had done such a thing.
Wesser picked up the dagger on the table and slowly approached the door. Then, he frowned and shouted, “Who is it?”
After Connor heard Wesser’s voice, a trace of nervousness flashed across his eyes. He knew in his heart that if he spoke at this time, Wesser would definitely notice that something was wrong, so Connor held his breath and did not speak.
“Who is it?”
When Wesser saw that there was no response from outside the door, he hurriedly shouted and subconsciously reached out to open the door.
“Creak…”
After hearing the sound of the door opening, Connor immediately raised his leg to block the door, preventing Wesser from closing the door again.
When Wesser saw Connor’s foot, he suddenly realized that something was wrong. If it was someone from the hotel, they would never do this.
Wesser instinctively reached out to close the door. However, Connor did not give Wesser any chance. He reached out and grabbed Wesser’s arm, then pulled on it hard before raising his right leg and kicking Wesser’s stomach.
“Ah…”
Connor’s kick landed hard on Wesser’s stomach, and the kidnapper instantly let out a painful cry.
However, Wesser’s first reaction was not to retreat. Instead, he instinctively raised his right hand, which was holding a dagger, and stabbed at Connor’s head.
Connor’s reaction speed was very fast. He directly dodged the dagger that Wesser stabbed at him.
When Wesser saw that Connor had dodged his dagger, a hint of nervousness flashed in his eyes. It was only at this moment that Wesser realized that Connor’s skills were very good. He was not someone he could deal with alone.
Therefore, Wesser turned around and tried to call out to the person in the room!
However, Connor was not a fool. He knew that if these two people joined forces, he would definitely not be able to take them down.
Therefore, Connor did not hesitate at all. He took a step forward and grabbed Wesser’s neck, then slammed his head against the wall!
“Bang!”
There was a loud bang as Wesser’s head hit the wall hard. Without making any sound, he fell to the ground.
After dealing with Wesser, Connor bent down to pick up the dagger on the ground before walking into the room.
At this moment, Wes seemed to have realized that something was wrong.
After all, Wesser had gone out to open the door for such a long time and had still not returned. In addition, when Connor hit the wall with Wesser’s head, it made a muffled sound.
The expression on Wes’s face began to become nervous. He frowned and shouted, “Wesser, what happened?”
After Connor heard Wes’s words, he did not answer. Instead, he continued to walk into the room.
Wes suddenly got up and reached into his clothes to take out a black pistol.
When Nicole saw the pistol in Wes’s hand, a hint of nervousness flashed across her eyes.
Wes got up and slowly walked out of the room.
Connor, on the other hand, held the dagger and walked into the room step by step!
A few seconds later, Wes and the scar-faced man stopped in their tracks at the same time, and then their eyes met!
Wes used to be a special forces soldier. His skills and reaction speed were top-notch. If it weren’t for his real skills, Wes definitely wouldn’t have been caught by the police for so many years.
When Wes saw Connor, he did not hesitate at all. He raised his pistol and aimed it at Connor’s head.
“Kid, I advise you to put down the weapon in your hand. At such a short distance, you will definitely die if I pull the trigger…”
Wes pointed his pistol at Connor’s head and whispered to Connor.
“…”
Connor narrowed his eyes and looked at Wes without saying a word.
“A hundred secrets are a slip up…”
When Wes saw that Connor did not speak, he let out a long sigh. This was because Connor’s reaction at this time had already indicated that he had given up on resisting.
“Back then, when we were in the restaurant, the two of us had already discovered you. However, I thought that you were just an ordinary person. I didn’t expect you to be so bold as to actually dare to chase after us. We were careless…” Wes said coldly to Connor.
Nicole, who was lying on the bed, looked at Connor with an incredulous expression.
She did not expect Connor, who had only known her for less than two days, to risk his life to save her.
Although his actions made Nicole feel very touched, she still felt very helpless.
She felt that since Connor had already discovered her current location, he should have directly called the police! After all, Connor was just an ordinary person and did not have a gun. Wouldn’t he be begging for death just by coming here?
Nicole hesitated for a moment before she shouted, “This matter has nothing to do with my friend. Let go of him. No matter what you want me to do, I will cooperate with you…”
“I’m sorry, Miss Cooper. If your friend didn’t see us, I wouldn’t have attacked him. However, he has already seen my brother and my face. If I let him go now, it will harm me. Therefore, I can’t let this person go…” Wes replied coldly.
“…”
After Nicole heard Wes’s words, she was stunned on the spot. The expression on her face was extremely desperate.

chapters.title: Chapter 829: Do You Want to Die That Much?
chapters.content:
Chapter 829: Do You Want to Die That Much?
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
In the hotel suite.
Wes held the pistol and aimed it directly at Connor’s head.
Nicole knew that Wes did not intend to let Connor off at this time.
Originally, Nicole was not in any danger at all, but now, while she was not in danger, Connor was.
If Wes really pulled the trigger, Connor would definitely die!
“Why is Connor so reckless? Why didn’t he call the police? Is he seeking death by coming here at this time?”
Nicole looked at Conno and could not help but mutter to herself.
Connor had been squinting at Wes, and his expression was very calm.
“Brat, since you want to die, I will not be polite…”
At this moment, Wes shouted at Connor.
“…”
After Connor heard the words of the kidnapper, a trace of disdain flashed across his eyes. Then, he said indifferently, “Are you sure you can kill me?”
“Why can’t I?” Wes sneered.
“Look at what’s behind you.”
Connor said calmly.
“Brat, do you think I’m stupid? If I turn around now, won’t you attack me? I won’t be fooled…” Wes said coldly.
“Haha…”
Connor smiled but didn’t say anything.
Although Wes had said such a thing, he was still a little worried; after all, he was the only one in the room now. Wes subconsciously glanced at his side from the corner of his eye.
Connor grabbed the moment Wes was distracted and flicked his right hand without hesitation.
A cold light flashed as Wesser’s dagger flew directly towards Wes.
Before Wes could react, the dagger pierced through his arm.
Wes instinctively pulled the trigger. However, due to the powerful impact of the dagger, Wes’s pistol was no longer aimed at Connor’s head.
“Bang!”
The pistol let out a muffled sound.
However, the bullet did not hit Connor. Instead, it grazed past his arm.
Blood instantly flowed out, but Connor did not stop at all. He rushed in front of Wes and raised his leg to kick his head.
Wes was instantly sent flying and then slammed into the wall.
After Wes’s body hit the wall, he fainted.
Connor’s movements were very smooth. There was no sloppiness at all. At the time, his movements had resembled flowing water in a stream and looked very fluid!
Nicole lay on the bed and looked at Connor in disbelief. Her eyes were filled with shock.
She did not know how to describe her feelings now; she did not expect that the person who saved her today would be Conno, nor did she expect Connor’s skills to be so good!
At this moment, Nicole’s face was filled with shock. Nicole had lived in a wealthy family since she was young, so she had seen many powerful bodyguards.
However, Nicole had never seen such a powerful expert like Connor. She felt that Connor’s movements gave off the feeling that he was a martial arts expert. It was extremely domineering!
Nicole could only use this word to describe Connor’s performance just now.
“How can Connor’s skills be so good?” A trace of doubt flashed across Nicole’s eyes.
At this moment, after Connor confirmed that Wes had fainted, he walked directly to Nicole’s side and asked softly, “Nicole, are you alright?”
“I… I’m fine…”
Nicole was stunned for a moment before she quickly shook her head.
“That’s good…”
Connor spoke as he untied the rope on Nicole.
After the rope was untied, Nicole quickly rubbed her arm and looked at Connor up and down. She asked softly, “Connor, how can your skills be so good?”
“I learned some martial arts from someone when I was young…” Connor explained casually, then picked up the rope and walked to Wes and the Wesser, tying the two of them together.
After doing all this, Connor heaved a long sigh of relief and sat beside Nicole.
Although the process was a little thrilling, Connor had still successfully saved Nicole in the end!
Nicole was still a little shocked by the ordeal and asked Connor carefully, “Connor, what should we do next?”
“Don’t you want to know why these two people kidnapped you?” Connor asked directly.
“Of course I want to know…”
“Then let’s wake the two of them up and ask them about the matter…”
Connor replied indifferently.
At this time, Connor already felt that these two people kidnapping Nicole should have nothing to do with him. After all, Rockefeller had previously gotten two assassins to test Connor. If Rockefeller really wanted to make a move on Connor, they would definitely not hire such weak assassins.
“How do we wake them up?”
Nicole was stunned for a moment and looked at Connor with a puzzled expression.
“We’ll try using water.”
After thinking for a moment, Connor turned around and walked into the bathroom, where he got a basin of cold water and splashed it on Wes’s face.
Wes immediately opened his eyes and struggled instinctively. However, he realized that his hands and feet were already firmly tied, and he could not move at all.
Wes slowly looked at Connor and said coldly, “Heh, I didn’t expect you to be so skilled. I miscalculated today. What do you want to do? Hurry up and attack…”
Connor held Wes’s pistol and narrowed his eyes as he asked with a playful expression, “Do you think no one will find out if I kill you now?”
When Wes heard Connor’s words, he was obviously stunned for a moment. Then, he shouted in a low voice, “That’s right. If you kill me now, no one should find out, so quickly give me a quick death!”
“Do you want to die so badly?”
Connor asked indifferently.
When Wes heard Connor’s words, a hint of helplessness flashed across his eyes. Then, he said indifferently, “So what if I don’t want to die? Are you going to let me go?”
“Of course I can let you go. Not only can I let you go, but I can also give you a large sum of money…”
Connor said with a smile.
Wes and Nicole were stunned when they heard Connor’s words.

chapters.title: Chapter 830: Behind the Scenes
chapters.content:
Chapter 830: Behind the Scenes
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Wes stared at Connor with a puzzled expression.
Because Wes had no idea what Connor meant!
Connor smiled at Wes and said, “I know that the two of you are just doing things for others, so there is no need for me to kill the two of you. Killing the two of you won’t do me any good, right?”
Wes looked at Connor and took a deep breath. Then, he asked in a low voice, “Then what do you want?”
“It’s very simple. You only need to tell me the person behind you and I will let the two of you off…”
Connor said lightly.
When Wes heard Connor’s words, he sneered disdainfully and said in a low voice, “You want me to betray my employer?”
“That’s right. As long as you tell me who hired you, I’ll let you leave!”
Connor nodded lightly.
“I’m sorry, we’re professional assassins. There are rules in our line of work. No matter what, I won’t betray my employer!”
Wes looked at Connor and shook his head.
“But if you don’t tell me who hired you now, I’ll kill you. Is that okay?” Connor frowned.
“Young man, you might not understand the rules of our line of work. The biggest taboo in our line of work is to expose the identity of the employer. Once I betray the employer, my family will also suffer…”
Wes said in a low voice.
A hint of helplessness flashed across Nicole’s eyes.
In fact, Nicole had some understanding of such assassins.
She knew that these assassins had always been very professional. At this time, Connor would not be able to get anything out of the kidnapper’s mouth.
Connor turned to look at Nicole and asked Wes softly, “Do you know who you kidnapped?”
“Of course I know. She’s the general manager of the Cooper Group!” Wes replied.
“That’s right. This person is the general manager of the Cooper Group. The Cooper Group is still very famous in Porthampton. Now, as long as you tell us who your employer is, not only will Miss Cooper let you go, but she will also give you a large sum of money. She can even arrange for your family to go abroad. The money will be enough for you to live abroad for the rest of your life. So you’d better consider carefully whether you want to die here or cooperate with us…”
Connor said clearly.
When Wes heard Connor’s words, he subconsciously turned his head to look at Nicole’s and asked Nicole in a low voice, “Miss Cooper, is what this person said true?”
“Yes, of course.” Nicole nodded lightly without any hesitation.
Wes looked at Nicole and Connor with a hesitant expression.
Seeing that, Nicole added softly, “Since you can make a move on me, it means that you should know my situation very well. Sending your entire family abroad and giving you a large sum of money is not a difficult task for the Cooper family, so you can consider the conditions we have given you!”
Wes looked at Connor and hesitated for two seconds. Then, he asked in a low voice, “Can I have a cigarette?”
“I don’t smoke…”
Connor replied indifferently.
“There’s a cigarette in my clothes…”
When Connor heard this, a hint of helplessness flashed across his eyes. Then, he reached out and fumbled inside Wes’s clothes. He found a cigarette and a lighter, and then helped Wes light the cigarette.
After lighting up the cigarette, Wes took two puffs and began to smoke.
Meanwhile, Connor and Nicole had been waiting quietly. They were not in a hurry.
A few minutes later, Wes finally finished smoking.
“Can you tell me now?”
Connor asked Wes softly.
“Miss Cooper, the most important reason as to why the two of us were asked to kidnap you is to make the Cooper Group give up on Porthampton’s Metro Line 9 project…”
Wes said expressionlessly.
“You want me to give up on the Metro Line 9 project?”
A trace of shock flashed across Nicole’s eyes.
“That’s right.” Wes nodded lightly.
Nicole’s expression was very incredulous at this moment. She shouted at Wes, “Who is the person who asked you to do this?”
Wes looked up at Connor and asked in a low voice, “If I say it, will you really let me go?”
“Don’t worry, I’ve always kept my word!” Connor nodded lightly.
Wes knew that this was his last chance. If he didn’t cooperate with Connor now, Connor would definitely kill him. However, if he told him now, he might still have a chance to live.
“Miss Cooper, actually, we don’t have the right to contact the employer at all. We received the mission from someone else. This is also to protect the employer’s information…”
“You mean to say that you don’t know who attacked me?” Nicole narrowed her eyes and asked Wes softly.
“Normally, we wouldn’t know about it, but there was one time when I accidentally overheard a conversation between my boss and my employer…”
Wes paused for a moment before continuing, “I heard my boss calling someone called Miss Schroder…”
“Miss Schroder?”
When Nicole heard this, she was stunned on the spot. The expression on her face was very incredulous.
“Miss Cooper, this is all the information I know. I’ve already told you everything I know…”
Wes muttered.
Meanwhile, Nicole stood rooted to the ground in a daze. There was only shock in her eyes. At this moment, Nicole did not know how to describe her feelings.
“…”
Connor could tell from the expression on Nicole’s face that the Miss Schroder in question must be someone Nicole knew, otherwise she wouldn’t be so shocked.
“Miss Cooper?”
Wes shouted at Nicole nervously.
Nicole took a deep breath and said expressionlessly, “Alright, that’s all. You can go now. Tomorrow, go to our company and look for someone called Whitney Labelle. She will give you the money and send you and your family abroad…”
“Thank you, Miss Cooper!”
When Wes heard Nicole’s words, a hint of excitement flashed in his eyes. Then, he directly helped Wesser up and turned to run out of the room.

chapters.title: Chapter 831: Birdie Schroder
chapters.content:
Chapter 831: Birdie Schroder
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
After listening to the scar-faced kidnapper’s words, Connor could analyze that Nicole’s kidnapping had nothing to do with him.
This was because the person who had made a move on Nicole was Ms. Schroder. Moreover, the other party’s purpose in moving on Nicole was not to threaten Connor but to get the Porthampton subway line 9 project.
Therefore, after Connor heard the news, he was relieved.
As long as this had nothing to do with him, the guilt in his heart would be much less.
Connor was most worried that Nicole would be involved in his matters now.
After the scar-faced kidnapper left, Nicole was still sitting on the bed. She seemed very nervous.
Connor hesitated before walking to Nicole’s side. Then, he asked Nicole softly, “Nicole, do you already know who did this to you?”
“…”
Nicole turned to look at Connor and said expressionlessly, “Cooper Group is preparing to participate in the bidding for Porthampton’s subway line 9. Now, only the Labelle family, the Campbell family, and the Qualls family are competing with me. Since they want us to give up on this project, the other party must be from one of these three families…”
“Didn’t the kidnapper say that someone called Ms. Schroder attacked you?” Connor was puzzled.
None of the three families Nicole had mentioned had the surname, Schroder!
“…”
After Nicole heard Connor’s question, she smiled helplessly and said lightly, “I’ve heard of Ms. Schroder, but it’s far from enough only to know her now…”
“Who is this, Ms. Schroder?” Connor frowned and asked.
At this moment, Connor was also very curious about Ms. Schroder.
“I don’t know who this Ms. Schroder is either, but she controls many industries in Davenport. This person’s background is so strong that ordinary people can’t compete with her. Ms. Schroder’s identity is also very mysterious. Other than the core figures of the big families, no one knows who Ms. Schroder is or what she looks like…” Nicole looked at Connor and said slowly.
“Is there such a person?” Connor wondered aloud with a frown.
“That’s right. I think Ms. Schroder must have taken control of one of the Labelle, Campbell, and Qualls families. Then, she made a move on me for the sake of the subway line 9 project. However, I can’t deal with anyone whether it’s Ms. Schroder or any of the three families. Ms. Schroder is too powerful, and her identity is very mysterious. The remaining three families are similar to our Cooper family. I can’t deal with them without sufficient evidence!” Nicole continued.
Connor suddenly frowned as if he had thought of something. He asked Nicole softly, “Nicole, do you know Ms. Schroder’s full name?”
“Ms. Schroder’s full name?” Nicole was surprised before softly saying, “I think I heard my grandfather say that Ms. Schroder’s full name is Birdie Schroder. Her father is Warren Schroder. However, Warren has stopped showing his face in public in recent years. All the business matters are managed by Birdie….”
“…”
When Connor heard Nicole’s answer, he was instantly dumbfounded. He looked at Nicole in a daze and disbelief.
Earlier, Connor had felt that the name ‘Ms. Schroder’ sounded familiar, but he didn’t take it to heart.
However, what Nicole said next made Connor feel that something was wrong.
Connor inexplicably felt that Ms. Schroder’s style of doing things seemed very similar to the Rockefeller that Thomas had mentioned.
This was because the people of Rockefeller would never come out to do any business. They did not have any businesses in their hands. What they did was control the so-called prominent families and make them help them earn money.
This way, they could ensure that Rockefeller’s business empire would not fall!
When Connor heard the names ‘Birdie’ and ‘Warren’, he suddenly realized that this so-called Ms. Schroder was the person in charge of Davenport’s Rockefeller.
Connor was very familiar with the names Birdie and Warren because he knew his father’s last phone call before his death was to Warren Schroder.
Therefore, Connor felt that the person who killed his father must have some relationship with Rockefeller and Warren.
Connor had been secretly asking Thomas to investigate Birdie and Warren, but these two people were too protective of their identities. They could not find any information at all.
Thinking of these things, Connor could not help but laugh bitterly.
Connor was secretly glad that the people who kidnapped Nicole had nothing to do with Rockefeller.
However, he never expected that the mastermind behind these people was Rockefeller’s people!
Of course, this should be considered great news for Connor.
After all, he had finally found some clues about Birdie!
Connor felt that if he could seize this opportunity, he might be able to find out the cause of his parents’ death!
Seeing that Connor did not speak, she was curious. So, she asked Connor, puzzled, “Connor, do you know Birdie?”
“No. How could I possibly know such a person…” Connor shook his head without thinking.
“That’s true. Even I don’t know Birdie. How can a student like you know such a person…” Nicole nodded gently.
“…”
Connor hesitated, then asked, “Nicole, what’s going on with this subway project you were talking about just now? Why are there so many big families competing for this project?”
“This subway project is the subway line 9 project that Porthampton is planning. This subway line runs through all the prosperous areas of Porthampton. Once it is completed, you can get the management rights of this subway line. The profits are still huge, so basically, as long as there are companies with some influence, they are very interested in this project…” Nicole explained.
“I see!” Connor nodded.
“These big families in Porthampton have invested a lot of money and resources for this subway project. If they don’t get this subway project, it will be a huge loss to them. That is why, they are using such despicable methods to deal with me…” Nicole added.

chapters.title: Chapter 832: Assassination!
chapters.content:
Chapter 832: Assassination!
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
“If the other three families don’t get this subway project, their losses will be hefty, right?” Connor asked Nicole.
“Yes, according to my understanding, other than our Cooper Group, the remaining three families have invested much money and resources. However, in the end, only one person can win this project. Therefore, those who don’t get this project will suffer great loss…” Nicole said slowly.
“Is the risk that big?” Connor was a little surprised.
“The subway project is too tempting. Although the risk is a little high, the returns are also very high. Everyone is a businessman.” Nicole nodded.
“In that case, why didn’t the richest man in Davenport, Thomas Morgan, compete for this project?” Connor did not know much about the company’s situation, so there were some things that he did not know at all.
“You know Thomas Morgan?”
After Nicole heard Connor’s words, a trace of surprise flashed in her eyes.
“Thomas Morgan is the richest man in Davenport. Isn’t it normal for me to know him?” Connor replied.
“That’s true…”
Nicole nodded gently and continued, “Thomas recently got an oil project. The profit of this oil project is even bigger. It seems that he also snatched it from Birdie’s hands. Back then, only Thomas and another big family in Davenport could compete for the oil project. That big family should be Birdie’s people, but in the end, Thomas won the oil project…”
“I see!” Connor nodded lightly.
“Thomas has just gotten the oil project. He should be putting most of his energy into that project now. He doesn’t even bother to compete with us for this project. In addition, Thomas is a good person. He’s different from Birdie. Birdie doesn’t care about any project. As long as it can make money, she won’t let it go. However, Thomas usually gives us some soup when he eats meat. Therefore, Thomas’s reputation in Davenport is still very good. Basically, no matter who it is, they will respect him!” Nicole looked at Connor and continued.
