Connor narrowed his eyes and looked at Nicole because he had never expected to learn such an important fact from Nicole accidentally.
If Connor made good use of the subway project, it might be an opportunity to open the door to Rockefeller!
Recently, Connor had not only put his energy into learning martial arts but also thinking about how he should deal with those people from Rockefeller.
However, Rockefeller’s men had always been in the dark while Connor was out in the open.
It was not easy for Connor to deal with the people from Rockefeller, but Nicole’s words gave Connor hope.
“Connor, what are you thinking about?” Nicole asked Connor when she saw that he suddenly fell silent.
“There’s nothing wrong with the search.” Connor shook his head lightly and continued, “All right, let’s not stay here any longer. Let’s go back first…”
“All right…” Nicole nodded and quickly got up to leave the room with Connor.
A moment later, Connor followed Nicole to the entrance of the hotel.
Just as Connor was about to walk to the parking spot, Nicole suddenly shouted, “Connor, wait a moment…”
“What’s up?” Connor turned to look at Nicole, confused.
Nicole walked toward Connor and took a tissue to wipe the sweat off Connor’s forehead. She said softly, “Connor, I have to thank you for today. This is already the second time you have saved me…”
“It’s okay. We are friends…” Connor replied with a smile, then turned around and was about to continue walking toward the parking spot.
However, Connor suddenly saw a bright light flash across the building opposite the hotel. He subconsciously looked up at the rooftop.
He saw a young man holding a sniper rifle and aiming at Connor.
When Connor saw this, he was instantly dumbfounded and nervous.
“Be careful!” Connor shouted and turned around to hug Nicole.
Before Nicole could react to what was going on, she was forcefully pressed to the ground by Connor.
“Conn…” Nicole was shocked and was about to speak.
However, she heard a loud bang before she could finish her sentence.
A bullet hit the spot where Connor and Nicole were standing just now and shattered the hotel’s glass!
“Ah… Assassins…”
When the hotel’s receptionists saw this, they instantly burst into screams.
Nicole was dumbfounded because she did not expect that there would be people outside who would assassinate her!
However, there was something more important at this moment. It all happened too suddenly, so when Connor pounced on Nicole, Connor’s lips kissed Nicole’s sexy and seductive red lips. Waves of fragrance entered Connor’s nose.
‘It’s so soft and nice…’ This was the first thought in Connor’s mind.
Nicole’s body was very soft and nice.
Especially at this moment, their bodies were tightly pressed together.
However, Connor was not in the mood to enjoy these things because he knew that after the sniper missed his first shot, he would definitely shoot a second time.
Therefore, Connor hugged Nicole and rolled to the back of a big truck.
When the sniper in the opposite building saw Connor rolling behind the truck, a trace of anger flashed in his eyes. He immediately put away his weapon and quickly left the rooftop.
Nicole stared at Connor, who was hugging her tightly. She was very nervous.
Connor had been observing his surroundings. He was worried that the sniper would change his position and shoot from another place!

chapters.title: Chapter 833: Massaging Nicole?
chapters.content:
Chapter 833: Massaging Nicole?
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Connor knew the sniper fired at the opposite building was not with the person who kidnapped Nicole.
This was because the sniper’s shot was aimed at Connor, not Nicole.
Moreover, the scar-faced kidnapper kidnapped Nicole just to make her give up the subway project. There was no need to kill Nicole!
However, this sniper was different. This sniper was here to kill Connor!
If Connor had not discovered the sniper’s existence, he might have been a dead man now.
This meant that this sniper was likely the third hitman that Rockefeller had found!
“Connor…”
Just as Connor was thinking about these questions, Nicole, under him, could not breathe. She shouted with a red face.
“I’m sorry, I forgot about you…” Connor hurriedly stood up and apologized to Nicole.
“You don’t have to apologize to me. I’m the one who dragged you down. If it weren’t for you today, I might have died long ago…” Nicole whispered back to Connor.
In fact, Nicole was also very puzzled because she could not understand what had happened to her recently. Why was she encountering trouble one after another? Moreover, it was all when Connor was present.
“Get up quickly. We must leave this place quickly. Otherwise, someone will likely attack the two of us!” Connor was very familiar with Rockefeller’s assassins. These assassins were not comparable to the two kidnappers.
Moreover, there was Nicole beside Connor. If he encountered other hitmen, things would be even more troublesome.
Nicole hurriedly placed her hand in Connor’s hand.
Connor tried to pull Nicole up.
“Ah!” Nicole cried out in pain and sat on the ground again.
Seeing that, Connor was surprised. He asked softly, “What’s wrong?”
“I think I sprained my ankle…” Nicole frowned and said in pain.
Connor was stunned for a moment and looked down at Nicole’s ankle.
Nicole was wearing high heels today. Everything happened too fast, so Connor might have sprained her ankle when he pounced on Nicole.
Although Connor did not know medicine, he squatted and took a simple look.
Connor realized that Nicole’s ankle was red and swollen. It was very serious.
“I’ll bring you to the hospital to take a look…” Connor said in a low voice.
“All right…” Nicole nodded and then stood up.
However, after trying, she realized she could not stand up.
Connor knew that Nicole had sprained her ankle because of him, so after hesitating, he said directly, “Let me carry you…”
After saying this, Connor took a step forward and carried Nicole.
After Connor picked Nicole up, she smelled Connor’s scent, and her pretty face instantly turned red.
However, she didn’t say anything else. Instead, she recalled kissing Connor just now.
Of course, Connor was not in the mood to think about these.
After he picked up Nicole, he quickly ran toward the Lamborghini.
A few seconds later, Connor and Nicole got into the car.
After getting into the car, Connor’s expression was much more relaxed.
He hurriedly started the car and drove straight to the general hospital.
Nicole sat in the front passenger seat and could not help but turn to look at Connor beside her. Then, she asked Connor softly, “Connor, do you think I’m a nosy person?”
“A nosy person?” After Connor heard Nicole’s question, he was slightly puzzled and stumped for a moment.
He then laughed and asked, “Why do you ask that?”
“I planned to treat you to a meal today. However, I did not expect to encounter so many things. Fortunately, you appeared in time. Otherwise, I might have died long ago…” Nicole whispered.
“You can’t be blamed for these things. You didn’t want this to happen, either. From today on, you’d better be careful. It’s best to bring bodyguards with you when you go out!” Connor reminded her.
“Yeah, I should…” Nicole was stunned for a moment before she nodded.
Half an hour later, Connor brought Nicole to the general hospital and helped Nicole register.
After an hour, Nicole finally finished the examination. It was a slight fracture and muscle strain.
If this happened to a normal person, they would be prescribed medicine and go home to rest.
However, Nicole was a girl who had been spoiled since she was young. Therefore, she did not leave the hospital immediately. Instead, she chose to stay in the hospital for observation!
“Ms. Cooper, I’ve already applied the medicine for you. You can rest here for now. If there’s nothing else, you can leave…”
The doctor knew Nicole’s identity, so he was very polite.
“All right…” Nicole looked at the doctor and nodded.
“By the way, Ms. Cooper, you can also ask your boyfriend to give you a massage. Just follow the massage technique on the wall. It can promote the flow of blood clots…” the doctor reminded kindly.
“Boyfriend?” Connor and Nicole were surprised when they heard this.
Nicole wanted to explain, but the doctor had already left the ward.
After the doctor left, Connor and Nicole were left in the ward. The doctor’s comment and the two kissing earlier instantly made the atmosphere in the room awkward.
Connor subconsciously glanced at Nicole and then shifted his gaze to Nicole’s slender and fair legs.
Today, Nicole was wearing a miniskirt. Her slender and fair legs were tightly wrapped in stockings.
However, when applying the medicine just now, Nicole removed the stockings on her injured leg, revealing her fair legs. One leg was tightly wrapped in the stockings, while the other was exposed. Such a sight was very tempting to Connor.
Even though Connor had no thoughts about Nicole, he could not help but take a few more glances.
Nicole seemed to notice Connor staring at her legs and felt awkward.
To ease the awkwardness, she whispered, “Connor, didn’t the doctor ask you to give me a massage just now?”
“A massage?” Connor was surprised.

chapters.title: Chapter 834: The Alluring Voice
chapters.content:
Chapter 834: The Alluring Voice
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
When Connor heard Nicole’s words, he was stunned and a little awkward.
Connor felt that giving a massage was a little too intimate.
However, when Connor saw the swollen ankle of Nicole’s, his thoughts began to change.
In addition, Nicole’s beautiful legs were too alluring. One leg was wrapped in stockings, and one leg was fair and flawless. Just looking at it made people have the urge to stroke it.
Nicole looked at Connor without saying a word.
Now that there was such a good opportunity in front of Connor, if Connor said he was not tempted, he would definitely be lying!
However, Connor was worried that it might aggravate Nicole’s condition if he did it wrongly.
So Connor looked at her and said,” Well, I don’t really know how to massage. Why don’t I get a doctor to help you massage…”
“Didn’t the doctor say just now that you just have to look at the tutorial on the wall and just follow it? If you can help me rub away the blood clot on my ankle, I can go home…” Nicole replied to Connor after hesitating.
In fact, Nicole did not have any other intentions now. She did not want to stay in the hospital for too long. Nicole would find it very strange if she asked the doctor to give her a massage. After all, she did not know the doctor.
When Connor heard Nicole’s explanation, he was too embarrassed to continue refusing, so he reached out and grabbed Nicole’s ankle.
Although Nicole was mentally prepared, when Connor grabbed her calf, her pretty face still blushed a little. Previously, Nicole’s pretty face had been a little pale because of the pain in her ankle, but now she looked very cute.
Connor did not know much about massaging, so he followed the tutorial on the wall to find Nicole’s acupuncture points and gently massage them.
In the beginning, Connor was still not used to it. Moreover, he kept glancing at Nicole’s slender and fair legs, making the massage uncomfortable.
“Connor, can you focus?” Nicole looked at Connor and asked coquettishly.
“…”
Connor was taken by surprise when he heard Nicole’s words. He quickly focused his attention on Nicole’s ankle.
After a few minutes, Connor began to get better at it. In addition, Connor’s strength was relatively strong, so Nicole could feel her ankle was constantly hurting.
Nicole clenched her fists subconsciously and gritted her teeth.
“Uh…”
But at this moment, Nicole suddenly made a very alluring moan.
Hearing that, Connor was shocked for a bit. Then, he frowned and asked, “Was that too hard?”
“No…” Nicole shook her head and continued, “My ankle just hurts a little. You can continue…”
“Alright…” Connor nodded and continued to massage.
In the beginning, Nicole could barely control herself and not make any sound.
However, the further she went, the harder it was for Nicole to control her moans.
“Yes.
“Ah…
“Be gentle…”
Weird sounds kept coming out of Nicole’s mouth.
Connor looked at Nicole’s beautiful face, helplessly.
As Nicole’s voice was too alluring at this moment, it was easy for people to misunderstand.
Even the nurses outside the ward subconsciously looked into the ward when they heard the noise.
They wanted to see what was going on in the ward!
Connor tried his best to control himself from listening to those strange sounds.
After a few minutes, Connor was almost done with the massage.
“How are you feeling now?” he asked Nicole.
“I feel much better…”
Nicole blushed and nodded gently. In fact, Nicole did not want Connor to continue massaging because the sounds she made just now were too embarrassing.
“It’s fine as long as you feel it’s getting better…” Connor nodded and continued, “Are you planning to stay in the hospital for the night or go back now?”
“Let’s go back now. I’m quite afraid to be here alone…” Nicole thought for a moment and replied.
“All right, I’ll send you back. You shouldn’t be able to go back in your current state!” Connor nodded and reached out to carry Nicole.
After Connor picked Nicole up, she looked shy and opened her mouth to speak.
However, after Nicole hesitated, she did not say anything and let Connor carry her.
A moment later, Connor carried Nicole out of the hospital and drove to the villa where Nicole’s house was.
Nicole’s ankle was injured this time, and she could not walk. Therefore, Connor carried her into the villa.
The villa’s interior was luxuriously decorated, and it was obvious that Nicole was the only one living there. There were not many things, but it was exceptionally warm.
“My room is on the second floor…” After entering the villa, Nicole whispered to Connor.
“All right…” Connor nodded and carried Nicole up to the second floor to her bedroom.
Nicole’s bedroom was big, and the decoration was welcoming and romantic.
Especially the pink round bed in the middle. It was the dream of many women.
Connor realized that Nicole seemed to like pink very much. Many things in the room were pink.
Connor carefully placed Nicole on the bed and heaved a sigh of relief. He said softly, “Rest well. If there’s anything, you can call me…”
Connor had exchanged phone numbers with Nicole in the car because he was worried that Nicole would not be able to tell him immediately if she encountered any trouble.
“Connor, thank you so much for today…” Nicole lay on the bed and looked at Connor with gratitude.
“It’s fine. We’re both friends. You don’t have to be polite…” Connor replied to Nicole with a smile.
Although he had indeed experienced many things today, Connor had also heard about Birdie Schroder from Nicole, so it was worthwhile.
This news was essential to Connor, so Connor was somewhat grateful to Nicole.
“If there’s nothing else, I’ll leave now!” Connor said to Nicole with a smile.
“Sure…” Nicole hurriedly nodded and replied to Connor.
Connor then walked out of the room.
“Connor…” However, just as Connor was about to leave the room, Nicole suddenly called after him.

chapters.title: Chapter 835: I Need To Use The Toilet
chapters.content:
Chapter 835: I Need To Use The Toilet
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Hearing Nicole calling out to him, Connor was surprised.
He turned to look at Nicole and asked, puzzled, “Yes?”
Nicole bit her lip and looked at Connor. She seemed very shy and did not say anything.
When Connor saw the expression on Nicole’s face, he hurriedly continued to ask, “What’s wrong? Spill…”
“I…”
Nicole’s pretty face was flushed red as she stammered. She didn’t know what she should do.
“Do you want to drink water?” Connor asked softly.
“No…” Nicole shook her head.
“Are you afraid of being alone, so you want me to stay with you?” Connor probed again.
“I’ve already texted my best friend on Messenger. She’ll be here in a while…” Nicole said.
“That’s good. I was a little worried that your leg was injured. It would be inconvenient for you to ne here alone. I’m relieved you have a friend to take care of you…” Connor said with a smile.
“Yeah…” Nicole nodded.
“So, what’s up?” Connor was even more puzzled as he frowned and asked Nicole.
Nicole took a deep breath, then bit her sexy and seductive red lip before saying, “I…I need to use the toilet, but my friend can only reach here in half an hour at the earliest…”
Connor was shocked!
It was only then that he realized why Nicole had stopped him.
Nicole could not move her feet now; only Connor and Nicole were in this villa.
Nicole was a girl. She wanted to go to the toilet and seemed in a hurry, so Connor did not know what to do.
“Connor, quickly think of a way. What should we do?” Nicole nudged Connor softly.
“…”
Connor stood there and hesitated momentarily, then said helplessly, “If there is no other way, I’ll carry you to the bathroom.”
“Uhm…”
Nicole looked at Connor with a conflicted expression on her face.
Nicole also knew this was the best way, but if she let Connor carry her to the bathroom, wasn’t that too intimate? That was why Nicole was so conflicted.
Connor took a deep breath and said, “Nicole, there are only the two of us in the villa now. I’m the only one who can bring you to the bathroom. If you keep holding it in and don’t go, what if something happens?”
“…”
Nicole looked at Connor with a hint of hesitation in her eyes.
“All right, let me carry you to the bathroom!”
After saying this, Connor carried Nicole by the waist and walked toward the bathroom.
After entering the bathroom, Connor helped Nicole open the toilet lid.
Nicole, on the other hand, was holding the wall. She stood on her tiptoes and looked at Connor with a red face.
Nicole was still very shy at this moment because she had too many intimate interactions with Connor today.
“All right, you can leave now…” Nicole whispered to Connor.
“Call me if you need anything!” Connor replied indifferently, then turned around and walked out of the bathroom.
A moment later, Connor heard Nicole’s call. He quickly turned around and ran into the bathroom. Then, he carried Nicole out of the bathroom and placed her on the bed.
After all this, Connor sat on the sofa helplessly.
“Connor, I have nothing else I need. You can leave now…” Nicole whispered to Connor as she lay on the bed.
“I’d better stay a little longer. I’ll leave after your friend is here, just in case!” Connor sat on the sofa and replied.
“All right then…” Nicole nodded. Then, she subconsciously picked up the remote control on the bedside table and turned on the television.
Connor was also sitting on the sofa and watching a plotless youth romantic idol drama with Nicole.
Connor did not expect that a cold, beautiful woman like Nicole would like to watch such an idol drama that only young girls liked to watch.
Perhaps it was because the television was too dull, Connor turned to look at Nicole and asked, “Nicole, do you have a boyfriend?”
“I had a boyfriend when I was in university, but we broke up because of some things…” Nicole replied.
“What happened?” Connor asked casually.
Nicole turned her head and looked at Connor. The expression on her face was a little strange, but she did not say anything.
“…”
Connor knew that Nicole probably had some unspeakable reason and was unwilling to talk about her feelings, so Connor did not continue asking.
After a while, the atmosphere in the room became awkward.
Ten minutes later, a beautiful woman walked into Nicole’s villa.
Nicole’s villa had a password lock. This woman should be very close to Nicole. She did not need anyone to open the door to enter.
“Nicole, what happened? How did you sprain your ankle all of a sudden?” The woman shouted before she entered the villa. She looked very anxious.
After Connor heard the woman’s voice, he slowly stood up and said to Nicole, “That should be your friend. Since your friend is here, I’ll go home now!”
“All right…” Nicole looked at Connor and nodded.
Connor turned around and walked out of the bedroom. However, just as Connor pushed the door open, Nicole’s best friend bumped into Connor.
Connor took two steps back and sized up the woman. The woman was very beautiful and had a good figure. She wore a white spaghetti dress, revealing slender and fair legs. She was wearing a pair of black high heels.
“Who are you?” The woman looked up at Connor and asked in confusion.
“I’m Nicole’s friend!” Connor replied before walking out of the villa.
A strange look flashed in that woman’s eyes as she looked at Connor’s back. Then, she quickly walked to Nicole’s bed and asked anxiously, “Is your leg fine?”
“It’s okay. I just came back from the hospital. The doctor said I’ll be fine after a few days of rest, but I can’t get out of bed yet, so you have to stay with me at my place for the next two days…” Nicole replied.
“Good to know that you’re fine. I was so worried just now…” The woman patted her chest and heaved a long sigh of relief.

chapters.title: Chapter 836: The General Meeting of the Stockholders
chapters.content:
Chapter 836: The General Meeting of the Stockholders
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Inside the villa bedroom.
After Nicole’s best friend learned that her situation wasn’t very serious, she breathed a sigh of relief.
She casually threw her bag onto the sofa and sat down on the edge of the bed.
“Coincidentally, I don’t have much to do these days, so I’ll stay here with you. Your villa is so big and comfortable, I don’t want to leave!”
Her best friend said with a smile.
Nicole turned her head and smiled at her friend without saying a word.
“By the way, how did you sprain your foot? How did it become so serious?”
Her friend thought that it wouldn’t be possible to sprain it so badly just by walking normally.
“I was kidnapped today, luckily Connor saved me, otherwise I might have been dead by now…”
Nicole said softly.
“Kidnapped?”
Her friend, Lola, stood still after hearing this, her expression full of disbelief.
“Yes, it was because of the subway project, but now I’m not in danger anymore, so you don’t have to worry…”
Nicole said slowly.
Lola hesitated for a moment, then said playfully, “Nicole, who was that man just now? Is he your boyfriend?”
“What boyfriend? That person is Connor, we’re just ordinary friends. He saved me today. If it weren’t for him, you might not have seen me again…”
Nicole said softly.
“Come on, don’t play dumb with me. I know your personality well, Nicole. That man just came out of your bedroom. You always have cleanliness issues and it’s impossible for you to bring a member of the opposite sex into your bedroom. But today you actually let that person in, which means your relationship is definitely not simple…”
Lola said with a smile.
“My foot is sprained. I can’t walk right now. We were the only ones here just now. If he didn’t help me come in, how could I have entered?”
Nicole exclaimed helplessly.
“Then couldn’t you have waited for me in the living room downstairs?”
Lola replied indifferently, then continued, “Alright, stop pretending with me. If you let that man in, it means you don’t have any objections in your heart. So even if you two are not together, there must be some feelings…”
Lola said with a smile.
“Lola, why are you talking nonsense?”
Nicole blushed and shouted, then continued, “We’ve only known each other for less than two days. How could I have any feelings for him? Today, Connor saved me and I asked him to take me home. Isn’t that a normal thing?”
“Nicole, I’m not kidding. You’re already this old. These two years are the most precious time for us women. With your conditions, you can find someone of any type you want. Since you have feelings for that person, don’t hide it. It’s not a problem to develop something with him. I’ve known you for so many years, and it’s the first time I’ve seen you not object to a man. Besides, that person seems a bit young, but a relationship with a younger man can also be very good…”
Her best friend said with great curiosity.
“Oh, Lola, look at me now. Stop joking around, alright? I just met Connor a few days ago…”
Nicole’s expression was helpless as she shouted, then quickly covered her face with a blanket.
In fact, if it wasn’t for her best friend’s reminder, Nicole herself wouldn’t have realized that Connor had actually entered her bedroom, and just a moment ago, he even carried her to the bathroom.
She has a cleanliness obsession, especially when it comes to her bedroom, which is a kind of stubbornness that normal people can’t imagine.
The only person who can enter her bedroom should be her best friend.
“Could it be that I really like Connor? How is that possible? Nicole, when did you become so unrestrained…”
She couldn’t help but recall the ambiguous interactions she had with Connor today, and her pretty face seemed even more flushed.
…
On the other side, after leaving Nicole’s house, Connor didn’t choose to go straight home because he had something more important to do now.
It was already evening, past six o’clock, and he took out his phone and dialed Thomas’s number.
“Ring ring…”
After a couple of rings, Thomas answered the phone, speaking in a very respectful tone, “Mr. Connor, what can I do for you?”
“Mr. Thomas, I want to hold a shareholders’ meeting tomorrow morning at 8 o’clock. All employees above the manager level should attend, is that okay?”
Connor spoke softly.
“Mr. Connor, did you say you want to hold a shareholders’ meeting?”
Thomas asked with some surprise in his tone upon hearing Connor’s words.
“That’s right, a shareholders’ meeting!”
Connor nodded lightly.
Although the number of shareholders in Connor’s company was not large, as most of the shares were in the hands of Connor and Thomas, the company had been listed for many years and a portion of the shares had been diluted, so there were still some minority shareholders. These minority shareholders could earn billions or even tens of billions of yuan each year just from dividends.
“Alright, Mr. Connor, I will inform everyone right away!”
Thomas shouted excitedly, his tone full of enthusiasm. He didn’t even ask Connor why he wanted to hold a shareholders’ meeting.
Because Thomas knew that this move by Connor meant that he finally started to care about the affairs of the company, which was undoubtedly good news. Thomas had been silently waiting for Connor to take the initiative and show interest in these matters, so he didn’t ask Connor to do anything, as Thomas understood his position in relation to Connor.
Connor was the boss, and Thomas was his subordinate!
Even for Empire World Corporation, Thomas was obviously more important than Connor.
But Thomas, being a smart person, wouldn’t take advantage of these things and attempt to make him do anything.
“Aren’t you going to ask me what I want to do?”
Connor was taken aback for a moment, his tone puzzled.
“Mr. Connor, the company is yours, you can do whatever you want…”
Thomas said with a smile.
“Okay, then go and inform the shareholders of the company now!”
He smiled faintly and directly hung up the phone.
In fact, the reason he chose to hold a shareholders’ meeting was only one, and that was to take action on the Subway Line 9 project.
Of course, he could have discussed this matter separately with Thomas.
After all, the two of them could make decisions on such matters entirely, and Thomas would most likely cooperate with his ideas.
However, he chose to hold a shareholders’ meeting, and his purpose was very simple. He wanted everyone in the company to know that he, the so-called chairman, was not just a figurehead. He was ready to gradually get involved in the company’s business.
Connor wasn’t trying to seize power from Thomas, but to make the company’s people realize who the real boss was!

chapters.title: Chapter 837: Bumped Into A High School Classmate
chapters.content:
Chapter 837: Bumped Into A High School Classmate
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
The next day, at 8 o’clock in the morning.
Connor arrived alone at the headquarters of Empire World Corporation.
Empire World Corporation was a well-known presence throughout the country, serving as the headquarters for all of Steven’s business in the Davenport.
Thomas was the chairman of Empire World Corporation and also the general manager of the company.
For the employees of Empire World Corporation, today was a very significant day.
The reason being that the newly appointed chairman, Mr. Connor, was going to hold a shareholders’ meeting!
After inheriting Steven’s assets, Connor had limited involvement in the company, let alone holding a shareholders’ meeting.
He had never interfered in the company’s affairs before, but now as the new chairman, he was actually convening a shareholders’ meeting, which was indeed big news.
The employees inside the company started gossiping, speculating secretly about the purpose of Connor’s shareholders’ meeting.
Some people believed that he had fallen out with Thomas and wanted to seize power from him, or even fire him.
Others thought that he might be completely relinquishing control of the company’s business and preparing to hand it over to Thomas.
Rumors and speculations like these were rampant.
Although the employees in the company didn’t know the true purpose of Connor’s shareholders’ meeting, they worked overnight to prepare various documents, including the company’s financial records, quarterly reports, and the profit situation of each branch.
Even those who had already finished work were called back to the company by Thomas and worked tirelessly all night to ensure that all the materials were prepared.
The shareholders’ meeting was scheduled to start at 10 o’clock in the morning.
However, Connor arrived at the company at 8:30 am. At this time, the people in the company were actively preparing for their tasks. Even the security guards and receptionists who were usually responsible for receiving clients had been sent to clean and tidy up.
So no one noticed that he had entered the company, and no one stopped him.
Under normal circumstances, he would not have been able to enter Empire World Corporation’s building so easily.
Of course, the scene inside the company at that time was not arranged by Thomas. He only informed the company’s staff that the chairman might hold a shareholders’ meeting the next day and asked them to prepare.
The employees in the company obviously misunderstood Thomas’s intention, so they made every effort to clean the entire building, hoping to leave a good impression on this chairman who rarely visited the company.
Connor looked at the busy employees in the company, and his expression seemed somewhat helpless. He only wanted to hold a shareholders’ meeting, not create such a commotion. Many employees had not slept all night, and exhaustion was written all over their faces.
He knew that Thomas and others were probably not here yet, so he was bored and decided to stroll around the building.
After all this time, he had only been to the 38th floor of the Empire World Building, which was Thomas’s office. He had never been to any other place.
Connor walked to the front of the elevator and pressed the button, intending to go to the finance department on the 8th floor for a casual stroll.
“Ding!”
A few seconds later, the elevator doors opened.
He stepped into the elevator.
“Wait!”
Just at that moment, a soft voice called out.
Upon hearing the voice, he quickly pressed the door open button.
The previously closed elevator doors slowly opened, and a beautiful woman rushed into the elevator, holding a cup of coffee in one hand and her bag in the other, with a look of anxiety on her face.
“Thank you!”
After entering the elevator, the woman hurriedly turned to Connor and said.
Upon seeing this woman, Connor instantly froze in place, his expression extremely shocked.
The woman also looked surprised as she observed Connor’s expression!
The woman standing in front of Connor was incredibly beautiful. She wore a pair of black knee-high boots over tight jeans, a light blue and white blouse on top, with a blazer layered over it. Her long hair cascaded casually over her fragrant shoulders, and her charming face was lightly touched with makeup, exuding both sexiness and beauty in a dignified yet unaffected manner.
“Connor, what are you doing here?”
While Connor was sizing up the woman in front of him, she stared at him with her round eyes and asked.
“Quenna, it’s you!”
Connor looked at the woman in front of him and smiled helplessly.
“Yeah, it’s been a long time since we last saw each other. How did you end up in my company?”
The woman asked him with a puzzled expression.
Upon hearing the woman’s words, his expression appeared somewhat helpless, and for a moment, he didn’t know how to explain.
The woman standing in front of him was named Quenna Graham. She was Connor’s senior from high school and two years older than him. When Connor was in his first year of high school, Quenna was in her final year. They got to know each other because she was the cousin of one of Connor’s good friends from high school. Due to their mutual acquaintance, Connor and Quenna had met a few times.
They couldn’t really be considered friends, at most just acquaintances.
However, because they hadn’t seen each other for a long time, she was now showing such enthusiasm.
Connor knew that she had always been an excellent student, and she should have already graduated. It was not impossible for her to work at Empire World Corporation.
But Connor didn’t know how to explain all of this to Quenna!
If he directly told her that Empire World Corporation belonged to him, she would definitely not believe it, and he might have to explain further. So he planned to come up with a random excuse to brush off the matter!
“Connor, you came for an interview at our company today, right?”
But at that moment, Quenna unexpectedly found an excuse for Connor.
She knew that his family background had never been good. When they were in high school, he couldn’t even afford tuition fees and often worked part-time jobs.
So it was reasonable for his to come for an interview at Empire World Corporation.
“Oh, yeah, I came for an interview…”
Connor nodded without hesitation.
“Then you might not be able to have the interview today…”
Quenna pouted and said.

chapters.title: Chapter 838: A Fortune Turn Of Events
chapters.content:
Chapter 838: A Fortune Turn Of Events
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
There were several thousand employees at Empire World Corporation.
In such a large corporation, there was a significant turnover of personnel. Basically, there were interviews happening every day.
So Quenna thought it was very reasonable for Connor to come for an interview today.
“I can’t pass interview?”
After hearing Quenna’s words, Connor couldn’t help but pause for a moment, then looked at her and asked, “Why can’t I pass the interview?”
She looked up at him, then glanced around the elevator, making sure there were no other people inside, and whispered, “What else could it be? It’s because our company’s new chairman is holding a shareholders’ meeting today. This chairman rarely comes to our company, but for some reason, he suddenly decided to hold a shareholders’ meeting. So everyone in the company is working overtime for this meeting. Even the people in charge of personnel are extremely busy right now. How can they have the mood to interview you?”
After hearing her words, his eyes showed a hint of helplessness.
Quenna doesn’t know that the new chairman she mentioned was standing right in front of her now.
“Let me tell you, our company’s new chairman is a rich heir. It seems that he became the chairman because he inherited the legacy of the former chairman. But this person is a playboy, and he doesn’t care about the company’s affairs at all. Usually, everything is taken care of by Mr. Thomas. I don’t know what happened this time, he suddenly said there would be a shareholders’ meeting. And it’s so sudden. It really makes me mad. I was supposed to have a day off today, but I was called by a manager in our department…”
Quenna continued to complain as she looked at Connor.
“So that’s how it is…”
He nodded slightly after listening to her, then continued, “Since I can’t interview today, I’ll just leave…”
“Connor, don’t go!”
Seeing he was about to leave, she quickly reached out and stopped him.
“Didn’t you say no one would interview me? Why should I stay here then?” he asked her in an puzzled tone.
“Connor, you should know the strength of our Empire World Corporation, right?” she asked with a mysterious look on her face.
“I know…”
Connor nodded gently.
“Since you know the strength of our Empire World Corporation, it’s easy. Let me tell you, our company’s salary and benefits are among the best in the whole country. But the competition is also very fierce. Basically, out of every hundred people who come for an interview, it’s considered good if we can hire one. And most of them get in through connections. When I wanted to enter the Empire World Corporation, I had to use a lot of relationships and spend a lot of money…”
Quenna said to Connor.
“Quenna, what exactly do you mean?”
Connor asked Quenna with a puzzled expression.
“Oh, can’t you figure it out yourself?”
Quenna looked at Connor with a helpless look, then continued, “I just want to tell you that if you want to work in our company without money or background, there’s basically no hope. But luckily, you encountered me today, and I can help you…”
“You’ll help me?”
After hearing what Quenna said, Connor couldn’t help but pause for a moment. Then he smiled and asked, “Quenna, how do you plan to help me? Are you in charge of the interview?”
“I’m definitely not in charge of the interview. I work in the Secretariat Department…” she replied somewhat awkwardly, and continued, “You see, everyone in our company is so busy, and there’s definitely a lot of work that can’t be finished. I was called back mainly to help with printing documents and then put them in the meeting room. They might be needed when the shareholders have a meeting.”
“What does that have to do with my interview?” He looked at her with a puzzled look.
“Why are you so slow?” Quenna looked at Connor helplessly, then continued, “It’s 8:30 now, and the shareholders’ meeting starts at 10 o’clock. I have a lot of documents to print, and I might not be able to handle it myself. If you follow me and help, after I finish this task, I’ll speak a few good words for you to our department manager. If our department manager is happy, maybe they’ll directly hire you. Do you understand what I mean?”
“Um…” He was instantly stunned after hearing her words.
“Connor, you’re really lucky. This is a fortune turn of events, and you’re hesitating? You should know that someone like you without money or power can only enter our company through this kind of opportunity, you know?” she said to him with a smile.
“Quenna, if you want me to help you, just say it directly. Why go around in circles like this?” he said to her with a helpless tone.
Quenna’s expression on her face seemed a bit embarrassed. She stuck out her tongue and said, “You figured it out?”
“Even a fool could figure it out…” he said casually.
“Ah, it’s all because of that annoying chairman. He insisted on having a shareholders’ meeting. I originally thought I could sleep in today, but I was directly called by the manager with a phone call. There was some traffic on the way, so it took some time. If I go to print the documents by myself, I definitely won’t make it in time. So, Connor, please help me…” Quenna swayed Connor’s arm and said in a spoiled manner.
He looked at her with a helpless expression, then whispered, “Well, I don’t have anything else to do anyway, so I’ll go with you.”
“Connor, you’re really great. When you come to our company for an interview, I will definitely speak up for you. Don’t worry!” she exclaimed happily after seeing him agree.
“So where should we go to print the documents now?” he asked her softly.
“I’ll take you to the printing room. I work in the Secretariat Department, and most of my work is printing various documents…” she said with a pouting mouth, then grabbed Connor and left the elevator, entering the printing room.
The printing room in Empire World Corporation was very large, and at this time, there were many employees printing documents, their faces showing signs of tension.
Although there were more than a dozen printers in the printing room, at this time, every single one of them was in use.
Connor and Quenna waited for about ten minutes before they finally found a vacant printer.
She quickly plugged her USB drive into the computer and started printing the files.
She was in charge of printing, while he was responsible for binding the documents. The two of them were busy and efficient.

chapters.title: Chapter 839: Reprimand from the Stockholders
chapters.content:
Chapter 839: Reprimand from the Stockholders
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Half an hour later.
Connor and Quenna finally finished printing all the documents.
He looked at the pile of documents in front of him, his expression filled with astonishment.
Unable to resist, he looked at her and asked, “Do we really need so many documents for a shareholder meeting?”
“Generally, it’s not necessary, but our chairman didn’t inform us about the main content of this shareholder meeting, so we have to prepare all these documents just in case. Even if we don’t use them, we need to have them ready. If the chairman needs them and they’re not there, we might face penalties or even dismissal if any mistakes occur…”
She wiped the sweat from her forehead and explained in a soft voice.
“So strict?”
He furrowed his brow and asked.
“Yes, that’s the life of employees like us…”
She sighed helplessly and then said to him, “Alright, let’s move these documents to the conference room now and arrange them in order. Then, I can consider my task completed.”
It was only 9 o’clock in the morning, and there was less than an hour left until the shareholder meeting started.
And that time was already enough.
“Okay…”
Connor nodded lightly, preparing to pick up the documents.
“Ring ring…”
Just then, her phone suddenly rang.
After hearing the phone ring, she hurriedly put down the documents, took out her phone, and answered the call, saying softly, “Manager, I have finished printing the documents I was responsible for. I will now deliver them to the conference room…”
“Quenna, there’s another document I need you to print. I sent it to you on Facebook…”
The manager’s tone seemed urgent.
“What? Another document?”
Upon hearing this, a trace of excitement flashed in her eyes.
“Yes, I forgot to send it to you yesterday. Please print it out quickly. This document is very important!”
The manager said in a low voice.
“Alright…”
She checked the time, a hint of helplessness flashing in her eyes. She hung up the phone directly.
“What’s wrong?” he asked, seeing the unpleasant expression on her face.
“What else could it be? My manager just called and said there’s another document to print. It’s so annoying. Since there are so many documents, why didn’t they send them all at once? We have less than an hour left now. What if we can’t make it in time?”
Her expression grew anxious as she spoke, then she walked to the printer and started printing the document.
Ten minutes later, she and Connor finally finished printing all the documents and carried two stacks of A4 papers into the conference room.
“What should we do next?” Connor asked softly.
“Let’s quickly arrange these documents. There’s less than fifteen minutes left now. If the two of us work together, we should be able to finish in ten minutes…”
Quenna glanced at her phone, her tone anxious as she spoke to Connor.
“Okay…”
He nodded lightly and began to arrange the documents.
While arranging the files, he briefly glanced at them and realized that they were mostly financial reports of the company. However, these financial reports had almost nothing to do with the shareholder meeting he was going to hold.
If Connor had known earlier that things would turn out like this, he would have directly told Thomas what he wanted to do.
Like this, lower-level employees like Quenna wouldn’t have to be so busy.
“Mr. Carter, why did you come so early?”
“Mr. Quintin, you’re here early too!”
“This is our company’s newly appointed chairman’s first shareholder meeting. As small shareholders, of course, we have to come early. We can’t keep the chairman waiting, right?”
“Yeah, the junior chairman has been in charge of the company for a while now. There must be something important to discuss in this sudden shareholder meeting. Do you have any insider information, Mr. Carter?”
“I don’t have any insider information. Apart from Mr. Thomas, we haven’t met or talked to Mr. Connor. Where would I get insider information from…”
“…”
Just then, a burst of noise suddenly came from outside the conference room.
Accompanied by company staff, several middle-aged men walked towards the conference room while chatting.
“We’re done…”
Quenna glanced at the time. It was already 9:50 AM, and there were less than ten minutes left before the shareholder meeting started. Yet, the shareholders had already arrived.
After all, this was Connor’s first shareholder meeting, and the shareholders deliberately arrived early to leave a good impression on him.
If it were before, they would never have come early.
Her expression began to grow nervous because she knew that if the shareholders found out that her work wasn’t completed, they would be extremely angry.
Connor, unaware of the situation, continued arranging the documents.
“Connor…” she called out with a furrowed brow.
“Quenna, what’s wrong?”
Connor looked up at her, his expression showing some confusion.
“Stop arranging, someone’s here…” she said in a low voice.
“What does it have to do with us if someone’s here?”
He stopped his actions and looked at her, asking with a puzzled expression.
“Squeak…”
Just then, the conference room door was suddenly pushed open from the outside.
Several middle-aged men walked into the conference room.
“What are you two doing in the conference room? The shareholder meeting is about to start. Don’t you know?”
One of the middle-aged men, after seeing Connor and Quenna, furrowed his brow and asked with a puzzled tone.
Her eyes flashed with nervousness, and she opened her mouth to explain.
But when this middle-aged man saw the documents in his hands, he instantly understood what was going on.
He widened his eyes and shouted, “The shareholder meeting is about to start in less than ten minutes, and you two haven’t arranged the documents yet? What are you two doing?”
“Yeah, what are you two doing? The shareholder meeting is about to start, and you haven’t arranged the documents yet. Are you planning to quit?”
“When did our company hire such employees? The meeting is about to start, and they’re still here arranging documents. If the chairman sees this, what will happen?”
The expressions on the other shareholders’ faces also turned angry, and they began whispering in low voices.
Meanwhile, she stood dumbfounded in place, her expression filled with despair.

chapters.title: Chapter 840: Directly Fired?
chapters.content:
Chapter 840: Directly Fired?
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Originally, according to the normal circumstances, Connor and Quenna could have neatly arranged those documents.
Because it was still ten minutes before ten o’clock in the morning.
Although there were indeed quite a few documents, ten minutes would have been enough for them to arrange the documents properly.
However, what they never expected was that the shareholders attending the shareholders’ meeting would arrive so early.
Moreover, he could sense that these shareholders were extremely displeased with what she was doing at the moment.
But in fact, he knew that it wasn’t solely her fault.
After all, their secretary department assigned her alone to print so many documents, and they even added an additional file in the middle. This workload was simply impossible for her to complete.
Not to mention Quenna alone, even if he joined her, the two of them could only try to finish arranging the files before ten o’clock.
If it were just her alone, even if she worked herself to exhaustion, she wouldn’t be able to finish.
“I didn’t expect the shareholders in Thomas’s company to have limited capabilities but such an attitude…”
Connor couldn’t help but sigh in his heart.
He knew that most of the affairs of Empire World Corporation were managed by Thomas alone, and these shareholders would rarely come to the company apart from attending the shareholders’ meeting!
Meanwhile, Quenna stood foolishly in place, her face showing extreme nervousness because she didn’t know what these shareholders were planning to do next!
“Which department do you belong to?”
At this moment, a middle-aged man walked up to her and coldly asked her.
“The Secretary Department…” Quenna replied softly.
“Good, so this is how the people in the Secretary Department work, right? The meeting is about to start, and you haven’t even prepared the documents. I’m going to call your department manager right now and let him see how to handle this matter properly!”
The middle-aged man shouted with a stern face, then took out his phone and dialed a number.
…
Quenna stood in place, her expression filled with despair.
Because she never expected that these shareholders would be so temperamental, to the point of calling her manager directly.
“Hello, is this Miss Carver from the Secretary Department? I’m Clyde Zink. Come to the meeting room now, quickly…”
The middle-aged man shouted into the phone with a blank expression, then hung up directly.
After hearing these words from the middle-aged man, Quenna widened her eyes in an instant, her expression filled with fear.
Because she didn’t expect that the middle-aged man standing in front of her right now was actually Clyde!
Although she hadn’t been at the company for long, she had heard about Clyde’s position. It was said that he had a very good relationship with Thomas, and he held three percent of the shares of Empire World Corporation. He was known to have the worst temper among all the shareholders. If the employees were to know that Clyde was coming to the company, they would do everything possible to hide and avoid being seen by him.
He was extremely strict. There was a time when he directly fired a receptionist just because she didn’t wear the uniform provided by the company.
The receptionist was fired simply because she didn’t wear the uniform, and now Quenna had made such a big mistake. The consequences were self-evident.
Hence, her expression began to turn nervous. Back then, in order to work at the Empire World Corporation, she had to pull countless strings and spend a lot of money on her parents. If she was really fired because of this mistake, she would be very unwilling!
Meanwhile, he had been arranging the documents and had not said a word from the beginning to the end. At this moment, he wanted to see how Clyde planned to deal with Quenna.
“What are you still doing? Hurry up and arrange the documents. We’ll talk about this when your department manager comes over!”
Clyde shouted at Quenna expressionlessly.
She was stunned for a moment before she hurriedly continued to arrange the documents.
But it can be seen that her expression at this moment was extremely unpleasant, and she has already guessed what awaits her.
Five minutes later, Connor and Quenna arranged all the documents.
Quenna sighed helplessly and murmured, “If only I had come five minutes earlier…”
“Quenna, today’s incident is not your fault. It’s unfair for you to handle so much work alone. I can vouch for you!” Connor consoled Quenna in a soft voice.
Quenna looked at Connor with a helpless expression and said lightly, “What difference does it make even if you vouch for me? Mr. Clyde is not easy to deal with. He might just fire me directly…”
“Fire you directly?”
Connor was stunned for a moment upon hearing Quenna’s words, and then furrowed his brow and asked, “You haven’t done anything wrong, so why would they fire you just because of this? Don’t they have any sense of reason in their actions?”
“Reason?”
Quenna shook her head helplessly and whispered, “He is a shareholder of the company. How could he bother explaining things to us small employees? If he doesn’t like you, he can find any excuse to fire you, and there’s nothing you can do about it…”
“Does the company have such situations?”
Connor turned to Quenna, looking at her with concern, and asked softly.
“There are plenty of such situations. Although these shareholders don’t hold any positions in the company, they have a good relationship with Mr. Thomas. Mr. Thomas wouldn’t offend them over such trivial matters…”
Quenna said in a tone of despair.
“It seems I came at the right time. If I hadn’t come earlier, I would never have known that such a situation exists in the company!”
Connor sighed softly.
“What are you talking about, Connor?”
Quenna asked in a puzzled tone.
“It’s nothing…”
Connor shook his head gently.
Just then, a middle-aged man in a black suit rushed into the meeting room, panting, and asked Clyde, “Mr. Clyde, what’s wrong? Did something go wrong with the documents we prepared?”
“The documents are not the problem, but these two people are!”
Clyde replied expressionlessly.
“People are the problem?”
Miss Carver instinctively turned his head and glanced at Quenna, then asked in a puzzled tone, “Mr. Clyde, what’s going on?”
“The shareholders’ meeting is about to start, but these two employees from your department haven’t even prepared the documents for the meeting. Fortunately, Mr. Connor didn’t come early today. If he had seen these two people arranging the files here, what do you think would have happened?”
Clyde shouted angrily, his eyes wide open.

chapters.title: Chapter 841: The Helpless Quenna
chapters.content:
Chapter 841: The Helpless Quenna
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Miss Carver’s expression became tense after hearing Clyde’s words.
She stuttered and said to Clyde, “Mr. Clyde, this matter is indeed the responsibility of our secretary department. I admit that it was our negligence in work…”
“Negligence? Do you think everything will be fine just by saying it was negligence?”
Clyde stared with wide eyes and shouted, then continued, “Fortunately, Mr. Connor and Mr. Thomas haven’t arrived yet. If they were here, can you bear this responsibility? Are you telling me that you, as the manager of the secretary department, don’t want to work anymore?”
“Yes, Miss Carver, you have been an old employee of our company. How could you make such a mistake?”
“For such an important task, you entrusted it to these two people. What is going on? It’s the first time Mr. Connor is coming to our company for a shareholders’ meeting. If he sees this, he might think that our company doesn’t value this shareholders’ meeting enough!”
The other shareholders also stood up and started reprimanding Miss Carver in a cacophony of voices.
Miss Carver, however, kept her head down and remained silent.
After seeing this scene, Quenna naturally felt very guilty. She believed that all of this happened because of her. If it wasn’t for her being late, things would not have escalated like this.
“Alright, the shareholders’ meeting is about to start, and I’m not in the mood to waste time here with you all. How do you intend to handle Miss Carver?”
Clyde looked at the time and asked her expressionlessly.
After hearing this, Miss Carver couldn’t help but pause for a moment. She then looked up at Clyde and asked softly, “Mr. Clyde, what do you think is an appropriate way to handle it?”
“Just fire her directly. Our company doesn’t need employees like this!”
Clyde didn’t hesitate at all and shouted directly.
“That’s right, this kind of employee should never have been hired in the first place…”
The other shareholders also chimed in.
Upon hearing their words, Quenna’s expression turned extremely desperate. She stood still, feeling at a loss for what to do.
Although Quenna had a premonition about this, she never expected that Clyde and the others would actually want to fire her.
Miss Carver turned her head and glanced at Quenna, a hint of helplessness flashing in her eyes. He whispered, “Mr. Clyde, isn’t this punishment too severe?”
“Severe?,” Clyde sneered, then continued, “I don’t think it’s too severe. A large company should have the appearance of a large company. I believe our company has too many people like her, which has led to the current situation. Firing her today is also a warning to others. Our company will never tolerate idle or incompetent employees. Those without ability or a careless attitude must be eliminated…”
Miss Carver looked at Clyde in front of her, and her expression seemed somewhat conflicted.
She then spoke softly, “Mr. Clyde, in fact, Quenna’s work attitude is usually quite good…”
“Her work attitude is good? Then why couldn’t she handle this small matter properly?”
Clyde asked coldly.
“Yes, Miss Carver, this kind of person should be fired directly…”
“Our company doesn’t lack people, finding someone better than her is as easy as pie. There’s no need to keep this person!”
The other shareholders also shouted at Miss Carver.
Meanwhile, Quenna stood in despair, looking extremely helpless, unsure of what to do.
At this moment, it seemed that only Miss Carver was speaking up for Quenna. The rest of the people wanted to get rid of Quenna directly.
Miss Carver saw that the shareholders were so agitated and took a deep breath before speaking, “Gentlemen, please calm down. Here’s what happened, Quenna did make a mistake today, but we can’t solely blame her. It’s also my fault for not anticipating such a large number of documents. Assigning all this work to Quenna alone is also my negligence. If there has to be a punishment, then punish me instead!”
After hearing Miss Carver’s words, Clyde was stunned, his expression filled with disbelief.
Because they never expected Miss Carver to dare say such a thing!
Connor also looked at Miss Carver with a surprised expression. He didn’t expect Miss Carver to voluntarily take responsibility. This changed Connor’s perception of her.
Quenna, too, wore a look of disbelief. If there was a romantic relationship between Quenna and Miss Carver, she might not have been so shocked.
But they were not familiar with each other at all, and they had no personal connection. They were just in a regular superior-subordinate relationship.
“Miss Carver, are you trying to take responsibility on behalf of this person?”
Clyde squinted his eyes and asked her.
“This matter is originally my responsibility. Our secretary department is understaffed, and I let Quenna handle so much printing work alone. Mr. Clyde, if you really want to punish someone, then punish me!”
Miss Carver replied in a low voice.
She knew deep down that even if the shareholders punished him, at most, they would deduct some of his salary. They wouldn’t fire her. After all, she had been with the company for many years, and even Thomas would not agree to her dismissal over such a small matter.
Clyde looked her up and down, his face expressionless, and said, “Miss Carver, what do you mean by this?”
“Mr. Clyde, can you give me some face today? The young girl is having a hard time alone…”
Miss Carver said with a smile.
After hesitating for a moment, Clyde spoke in a low voice, “Miss Carver, you are found guilty of work negligence. Your salary will be deducted for one month. As for that woman, deduct her salary for six months, cancel her year-end bonus, and she will not be eligible for promotion for two years…”
“Thank you, Mr. Clyde! Thank you, Mr. Clyde!”
After hearing Clyde’s words, Miss Carver felt a huge weight lifted off his shoulders and quickly shouted in relief.
Quenna’s face was also filled with excitement. Although she had lost six months’ worth of salary, she had managed to keep her job, which was a stroke of luck amidst the misfortune.
“Quenna, why are you still standing there? Hurry up and thank Mr. Clyde!”
Miss Carver turned his head, glanced at Quenna, and frowned as he shouted at her.
Quenna couldn’t help but pause for a moment when she heard this, then quickly spoke up to Clyde, “Thank you…”
But before Quenna could finish her sentence, she suddenly felt someone tugging her.
Connor walked up to her, then, with an expressionless face, said, “He deducted six months’ worth of your salary, and you still have to thank him. Isn’t that a bit too much of punishment…”

chapters.title: Chapter 842: You Are Connor?
chapters.content:
Chapter 842: You Are Connor?
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
“You’re being a bit too bully, aren’t you?” Connor turned around, looking expressionless at Clyde.
Upon hearing his words, everyone present froze in place, their expressions filled with incredulity.
“Connor, what nonsense are you talking about here?” Quenne was dumbfounded upon hearing Connor’s words, shouting at him with a puzzled expression.
“I’m not talking nonsense…” he replied calmly, then continued, “Today, I can testify for you. The work you’ve done is not something that can be accomplished by one person, let alone three. Why should he withhold six months of your salary? There’s absolutely no reason for him to do that!”
She stared at him, her expression filled with despair.
Because just now, Quenne thought that even though she had six months of salary deducted, the matter was resolved satisfactorily.
Although having six months of salary deducted was painful for her, it was still better than being fired, especially when it was Miss Carver who fought for her.
But now, Connor’s words rendered all of Miss Carver’s efforts in vain.
“Who is this kid?” Miss Carver didn’t recognize Connor and asked Quenne with a furrowed brow.
Upon hearing her words, Quenne’s eyes flashed with helplessness. She then whispered, “This person came for an interview. We knew each other before, and I was afraid I couldn’t finish all the work, so I asked him to come and help…”
“Quenne, are you out of your mind? Why are you bringing stranger into the company? Take this person away now!” Miss Carver worried that Connor’s continued words would change Clyde and the others’ minds, so she shouted.
“Okay, I’ll take him away now…” Quenne nodded quickly, then reached out and pulled Connor, whispering to him, “Connor, I admit that I made a mistake in this matter. I accept the six months’ salary deduction. Come with me and don’t interfere anymore.”
“Whether they deduct your salary or not is not up to them…” Connor glanced at Quenne lightly, expressionless.
Upon hearing his words, the shareholders present began to mock and jeer, looking at him as if he were a madman.
Clyde hesitated for a moment, then walked directly in front of Connor, a playful expression on his face as he asked, “Kid, do you know who I am? When you said whether they deduct her salary or not is not up to me, then who has the final say? Are you the one who has the final say?”
“That’s right, I have the final say!” Connor nodded calmly.
“You think you’re someone important? Who gave you the right to speak on this matter?”
“Yeah, you’re not even an employee of our company. What qualifications do you have to speak?”
“What is this person here for? Is he here to cause trouble?”
“I think this person must have some issues with their brain…”
After hearing Connor’s words, everyone’s faces turned angry, and they stared at him and shouted.
Miss Carver also looked helpless and frowned as she said to Quenne, “Please take your friend out. Don’t let him speak nonsense. Do you really want to escalate this situation? Is that what makes you happy?”
“Connor, I’m begging you. Mr. Clyde has already shown mercy by not firing me. Please leave with me quickly. The shareholders’ meeting is about to start. If you keep causing trouble, and the chairman sees it, I’ll really be fired…”
She pleaded desperately while dragging him away.
Actually, as long as she wasn’t fired, she would accept anything Clyde asked of her.
But if Connor continued like this, she might truly be fired, and that would be troublesome.
After hearing her words, Connor calmly said, “Don’t worry, as long as I’m here, no one can fire you from this company.”
“Do you have a problem with your brain? This is Empire World Corporation, not a place where you can do whatever you want!”
Miss Carver couldn’t hold back anymore and angrily shouted at Connor.
“Kid, do you know that we are all shareholders of Empire World Corporation? If we want to fire someone, we can. Who do you think you are?”
“I really don’t understand what this guy is thinking. Doesn’t he find what he’s saying funny?”
The shareholders present started talking about him from their positions.
Connor calmly glanced at the crowd, his expression unchanged, and said, “You are shareholders of this company, does that give you the right to arbitrarily fire others? It seems like you don’t hold any positions within this company, right?”
“Whether or not we hold positions is our own business. What does it have to do with you?”
One of the shareholders, with an agitated expression, shouted at him.
“Everything related to Empire World Corporation is related to me!” he replied expressionlessly.
After hearing his words, everyone froze in place, their expressions filled with confusion.
Quenne stood beside Connor, feeling like she was going crazy.
She couldn’t understand why he had to step forward and say these things when the matter was about to be resolved. Did he want to be fired by the shareholders so badly just to make himself happy?
After a moment of confusion, Clyde’s face showed a hint of surprise.
He could sense that when Connor said those words, his tone was unusually calm.
This proved that Connor might not be an ordinary person; otherwise, he wouldn’t speak with such calmness.
So Clyde took a step forward and looked at Connor without expression, asking, “Who are you? Are you also a shareholder of Empire World Corporation?”
“That’s right, I am also a shareholder of Empire World Corporation!”
Connor nodded lightly.
After hearing his words, once again, everyone was stunned, their expressions even more shocked.
Because they never expected that this young man in front of them was also a shareholder of Empire World Corporation!
“What’s your name? If you’re a shareholder of Empire World Corporation, why have I never seen you before?”
Clyde furrowed his brow and asked him.
“My name is Connor, and it’s normal that you’ve never seen me!”
Connor looked at him calmly and replied.
Upon hearing his words, everyone was dumbfounded.
They stared at him with wide eyes, their expressions filled with disbelief.
“You… you are… Connor?”
After hearing his words, Clyde stammered as he asked Connor.

chapters.title: Chapter 843: No One Can Fire You!
chapters.content:
Chapter 843: No One Can Fire You!
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
“You are Connor?”
After hearing his words, all the shareholders present widened their eyes, their expressions filled with disbelief.
Quenne, standing next to Connor, also looked puzzled.
Because she knew that his real name was indeed Connor, but she had no idea that their company’s chairman was also named Connor.
So she couldn’t understand why these shareholders would be so surprised upon hearing Connor’s name.
After all, she was just a secretary, and it was normal for her not to know the chairman’s name.
“You’re called Connor?”
Clyde looked Connor up and down, his expression full of disbelief as he asked.
“Do you have any questions?”
Connor calmly replied.
“How is this possible? What a coincidence, you actually share the same name as our company’s chairman?”
Clyde murmured with a furrowed brow.
“Do you want to hear an even more interesting coincidence?”
Connor asked Clyde with a smile.
“What else is there?”
Clyde paused for a moment, furrowing his brow as he asked Connor.
“I am the chairman of Empire World Corporation!”
Connor replied calmly.
After hearing his words, Clyde immediately froze in place, his expression filled with astonishment.
The shareholders present also widened their eyes and looked at him with disbelief.
Although these people knew that the chairman of Empire World Corporation was indeed named Connor, they had never met him in person, so they had no idea what he looked like.
Now he was claiming to be the chairman of Empire World Corporation, how could they not be shocked?
Based on what they knew about Connor, they knew that he was not very old, possibly similar in age to the young man in front of them. In an instant, their gazes became strange.
“Could this kid really be the chairman?”
“How is that possible? The chairman should have come with Mr. Thomas, right?”
“But if this kid is an impostor, how could he know the chairman’s name?”
“This is just too coincidental…”
After hearing his words, the shareholders present began to whisper and discuss in low voices.
While others might not know who he was, Quenne was very familiar with his background.
She knew that Connor could never be the chairman of Empire World Corporation!
In her memory, he was just a poor boy who couldn’t even afford his tuition fees.
The difference between Connor and the chairman of Empire World Corporation was like night and day!
She simply couldn’t believe that he was really the chairman of Empire World Corporation.
“Connor, what nonsense are you spouting here? Can you please stop causing trouble?”
She furrowed her brow and shouted at him in an agitated manner.
At this moment, she couldn’t understand what he was trying to do. The matter was almost over today, but he had to stand up and cause trouble. Not only did he offend these shareholders, but now he was even pretending to be the chairman of Empire World Corporation. If he were exposed, it wouldn’t be as simple as Quenne being fired. Connor might even be taken away by the police for fraud.
“I’m not spouting nonsense. I am indeed the chairman of Empire World Corporation. I didn’t come here today for an interview; I came to hold the shareholders’ meeting!”
Connor turned his head and glanced at Quenne, speaking in a calm tone.
“Connor, I really have to hand it to you. Do you think I don’t know who you are?”
Quenne looked at Connor. She was so anxious that she did not know what to say.
“I…”
Connor was about to speak.
“Hurry up and come out with me…”
She didn’t want him to continue spouting nonsense, so she quickly covered his mouth with her hand and pulled him outside.
Upon witnessing this scene, the shareholders present were all stunned, their expressions filled with disbelief.
“Mr. Clyde, what’s going on with this kid? He can’t really be Mr. Connor, right?”
One of the middle-aged men approached Clyde and quietly asked him.
After hesitating for a moment, Clyde whispered, “Probably not. Quenne knows this kid’s background, that’s why she’s so nervous. If this kid really is the chairman, Quenne wouldn’t be this nervous…”
“But this kid shares the same name as Mr. Connor, and their ages are similar. Is it just a coincidence?”
The middle-aged man continued with a furrowed brow.
“Although this kid is not from our company, Mr. Connor’s name is not a secret. It’s possible that he knows Mr. Connor’s name! ”
Clyde analyzed expressionlessly and continued, “Let’s not panic. It’s already ten o’clock now, and the shareholders’ meeting is about to start. Mr. Thomas and Mr. Connor will come over soon, and then the truth will be revealed. If this kid is an imposter, we can just send him to the police station as a fraudster…”
“Alright…”
The shareholders around Clyde nodded one after another.
At this moment, he and the others didn’t want to continue arguing about Connor’s identity, as the truth about whether he was Mr. Connor or not would soon be revealed. If they were to argue with Connor now and he turned out to be the chairman, it might leave a bad impression on Connor. It was better to wait and see.
…
On the other side.
After dragging Connor to a corner, Quenne frowned and shouted, “Connor, do you want to ruin me? Do you think being fined six months’ salary is not enough for you? Do you have to get me fired for your satisfaction?”
“With me here, no one can fire you!” he calmly said to her.
Upon hearing these words, Quenne’s expression seemed even more speechless.
She stared and exclaimed, “Connor, who do you think you are? You don’t really consider yourself as the chairman of our company, do you?”
“I am indeed the chairman of your company!” he said expressionlessly.
“I can’t believe you. Can you please stop causing trouble? I’m begging you. If you continue like this, I will really be fired…”
She was at the edge of losing her mind.
Connor was about to speak, but at that moment, footsteps could be heard approaching.
Upon hearing the footsteps, everyone raised their heads and looked ahead.
They saw Thomas leading several shareholders walking directly towards the direction of the meeting room.

chapters.title: Chapter 844: Are You All Deaf?
chapters.content:
Chapter 844: Are You All Deaf?
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
When Clyde and the others saw Thomas approaching, a hint of excitement flashed in their eyes.
They quickly walked towards Thomas’s position.
“Sorry for keeping you all waiting. I had to handle some matters, so I arrived a bit late!”
Thomas faintly smiled and called out in a soft voice.
“Not late at all…”
Clyde quickly replied and then glanced at the people around Thomas.
He noticed that they were all familiar faces, all shareholders of the Empire World Corporation.
So after hesitating for a moment, Clyde asked Thomas in a low voice, “Mr. Thomas, didn’t Mr. Connor come with you?”
“Mr. Connor should have come by himself…”
Thomas replied calmly.
Upon hearing this, the expressions on the shareholders’ faces turned unpleasant.
“What’s wrong with all of you? Why do you have such strange expressions?”
Thomas, puzzled by the shareholders’ expressions, asked.
“Mr. Thomas, a person claimed to be the chairman of our Empire World Corporation just now, but we…”
Clyde stuttered.
Upon hearing this, Thomas’s eyes flickered with a hint of surprise, and he quickly furrowed his brows and asked, “Where is that person?”
“Over there…”
Clyde pointed to the location of Connor and Quenne.
Although Connor had his back to Thomas at the moment, Thomas could still recognize him at a glance.
“Mr. Connor came so early?”
Thomas murmured softly, then walked directly towards Connor.
The shareholders were stunned in their places. From Thomas’s reaction, they could sense that something seemed amiss.
“Connor, please, I beg you, leave here quickly. My parents spent a lot of money and effort to get me a job at the Empire World Corporation. If you cause a scene like this now, I might really be fired. I haven’t done anything to offend you before. Why are you doing this?” Quenne pleaded, pulling Connor’s arm, oblivious to the fact that Thomas and the others had already approached.
“I’ve told you, as long as I’m here, no one can fire you!”
Connor looked at her in front of him, his expression equally helpless.
At this moment, he was unsure how to explain to her.
“Mr. Clyde is a shareholder of the company. If he wants to fire me, he can. Don’t you know the situation in our company…”
Quenne said in a frustrated tone.
“I…”
Connor was about to say something when a stern voice suddenly sounded by Quenne’s ear.
Quenne couldn’t help but pause upon hearing the voice and quickly turned around to look. Then, she was dumbfounded.
Because the person standing beside her was none other than Thomas, the General Manager of the Empire World Corporation.
Thomas thought she didn’t recognize Connor’s identity and mistook him for a thief who had entered the company. That was why he spoke so seriously.
“Mr. Connor…”
Quenne timidly replied, her eyes filled with despair.
Because she had never expected that such a trivial matter would actually alarm someone of Thomas’s status.
“I asked you, what are you doing here?”
Thomas repeated the question, looking at Quenne with a stern gaze.
“I… I… I’m sorry, Mr. Thomas, I was wrong…”
Quenne was so frightened by Thomas that her words became incoherent, and she quickly bowed to him.
Upon seeing her state, Connor’s eyes flashed with a hint of helplessness. He then softly said, “Mr. Thomas, it seems like you have scared my friend…”
“Mr. Connor, is she your friend?”
Thomas turned his head to look at Connor and asked softly.
“Yes, she is my friend!”
Connor nodded gently.
“I apologize, Mr. Connor. I thought she was an employee who didn’t recognize you and wanted to drive you out!”
Thomas explained hurriedly to Connor.
“It’s fine…” he replied calmly.
Upon hearing Connor and Thomas’s conversation, Quenne, Clyde, and the others were all stunned in their places, wearing expressions of disbelief.
Everyone present could sense the respect in Thomas’s tone when he spoke to Connor, addressing him as ‘Mr. Connor’!
In the Emperor World Coperation, there was only one person who could be called “Mr. Connor,” and that person was Connor, the Chairman of the Emperor World Coperation.
“Connor, you…”
Quenne looked at Connor with a look of astonishment in her eyes.
“I told you, I am the Chairman of the Emperor World Coperation, but you never believed me!” he said tp her.
Quenne was instantly dumbfounded, her expression filled with shock.
Clyde and the other shareholders who had mocked Connor before were also frozen in place, staring wide-eyed at Connor’s position.
“Perhaps none of you know Mr. Connor, so let me introduce him to you. This is Connor, the Chairman of our company, Mr. Connor!”
Thomas seemed to have guessed what was going on when he saw the expressions on the shareholders’ faces.
So he walked to Connor’s side and introduced him expressionlessly.
Upon hearing Thomas’s words, everyone was dumbfounded, their mouths wide open, their expressions extremely shocked.
For a moment, the entire conference room fell into silence.
After hesitating for a moment, Clyde quickly ran to Connor’s front and excitedly shouted, “Mr. Connor, I’m really sorry! I didn’t recognize you earlier. Please don’t lower yourself to my level!”
Connor glanced at Clyde lightly, then asked him expressionlessly, “Quenne hasn’t done anything wrong today. I think your previous punishment towards her was too severe. Do you have any objections?”
“No objections, no objections, Mr. Connor. Whatever you say, I couldn’t possibly have any objections!”
Clyde quickly replied.
“Good, since you have no objections…”
Connor nodded slightly and continued, “From today onwards, I don’t want any of you shareholders to interfere in the company’s personnel matters. The company’s decisions regarding employees’ selection and punishment have nothing to do with you. You only need to focus on doing your own job, and you have no right to meddle in other matters. Understand?”
Upon hearing Connor’s words, everyone was stunned.
“Are you all deaf?”
Connor frowned and shouted.
“Understood, Mr. Connor!”
Clyde and the others quickly replied in a loud voice.

chapters.title: Chapter 845: Getting The Subway Project
chapters.content:
Chapter 845: Getting The Subway Project
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Connor heard the response from everyone and nodded in satisfaction.
He turned his head and looked at Thomas, then said, “Alright, we can start the meeting now!”
“Good!”
Thomas nodded quickly and led Connor and the others into the conference room.
The shareholders followed behind Connor, and their expressions were visibly nervous.
According to the information they had, he was just an idle rich heir who never cared about the company’s affairs.
But after interacting with him today, they were surprised to find that he was not like the rumors suggested.
Connor didn’t look like a rich heir at all; he was very low-key.
This made the shareholders start to worry about his intentions for convening the shareholders’ meeting!
