When Connor reached the door of the conference room, he suddenly stopped and turned his head to look at Quenna, who was still standing there foolishly, unable to recover from her shock.
“Quenna, come in and join the meeting!”
Connor called out to Quenna softly.
After hearing his words, she couldn’t help but pause for a moment. She asked in a puzzled tone, “You want me to come in for the meeting?”
“Yes!”
Connor nodded gently.
“Mr. Connor, this person is not a shareholder. Normally, she doesn’t have the qualification to attend the meeting!” a shareholder hesitantly reminded Connor.
After all, not everyone could attend a shareholders’ meeting. These meetings were often used to discuss crucial matters regarding the company’s future, which were considered top commercial secrets. Employees like Quenna naturally didn’t have the qualification to attend.
“Whether she has the qualification or not, I have the final say!”
He replied expressionlessly, then continued, “From now on, Quenna will serve as the assistant to the chairman and the chairman’s secretary. Shouldn’t she have the qualification now?”
The crowd looked at him in astonishment once again, and Quenna’s expression was even more shocked. She never expected that she would be promoted to the position of the chairman’s assistant.
Being the chairman’s assistant came with a salary and benefits comparable to that of a vice president. She was just a secretary, so this promotion was a huge opportunity for her!
“Mr. Connor, are you sure you want this person to be the chairman’s assistant?” Thomas hesitated for a moment and asked Connor softly.
“Yes, it’s her!”
Connor nodded gently, then continued, “Since I don’t come to the company often, I will entrust all my work to Quenna. She will convey everything to me.”
“Alright!”
Thomas knew that Connor was not joking, so he nodded directly and said, “Let’s start the meeting now, and after the meeting, I will have the HR department handle these matters!”
“Okay!”
Connor agreed, then walked into the conference room.
Quenna stood still, looking at Connor’s back in a daze. Her expression was filled with disbelief because it felt like she was dreaming.
Just not being fired today was already a stroke of luck for Quenna. But she never expected that not only would she not be fired, she would be promoted to the chairman’s assistant.
Quenna felt like she was in a dream. Everything seemed so unreal.
And Thomas turned his head and glanced at Quenna, saying softly, “Quenna, you are now the assistant to the chairman, so technically, you can come in and join the shareholders’ meeting with Mr. Connor!”
After hearing his words, she paused for a moment, then quickly nodded and said, “Okay, Mr. Thomas…”
A moment later, Connor, Thomas, Quenna, and others entered the conference room.
Connor took a seat at the head of the table, while Thomas sat beside him, and Quenna stood behind him.
Perhaps it was her first time attending such a meeting, so her expression was still very nervous. Her small hands tightly held onto her clothes, unsure of what she should do.
Meanwhile, Connor sat calmly in his chair, his expression very composed.
The shareholders took their seats in order. At this moment, their expressions were all very tense because they didn’t know the purpose of Connor convening the shareholders’ meeting. Everyone cautiously observed him.
Of course, among these shareholders, Clyde was the most nervous.
After all, Clyde had just offended him, and he worried that if Connor wanted to retaliate, he would be in trouble.
“Mr. Connor, all the shareholders have arrived. The shareholders’ meeting can begin!” Thomas turned his head and looked at Connor, speaking softly to him.
“Okay…”
He nodded, scanned everyone present and said expressionlessly, “This shareholders’ meeting is the first one held since I took over Emperor Corporation. However, you don’t need to worry. Mr. Thomas will continue to manage the company’s affairs. I won’t intervene in the company’s matters unless there are special circumstances. And the purpose of convening this shareholders’ meeting is very simple…”
Everyone looked at Connor, unsure of what he was going to say.
“I want Emperor Corporation to acquire the development project of Metro Line 9 in Porthampton at any cost!” he said slowly.
Upon hearing his words, all the shareholders present showed expressions of astonishment. Even Thomas subconsciously turned his head to look at him because Thomas didn’t expect that he had convened the shareholders’ meeting for the Metro Line 9 project.
“Mr. Connor, indeed, the profit from this project is very significant, but it might be a bit late for us to participate in the bidding process…”
A shareholder hesitated for a moment and said softly to Connor.
“I know that it might be a bit late for us to join now, so when I said ‘at any cost,’ I meant we must secure this project no matter what. I don’t care what methods you use or how much it costs, even if we lose money, we must secure this project. Do you understand what I mean?”
Connor looked at the serious expressions of everyone and said.
In an instant, all the shareholders present were dumbfounded. It was at this moment that they finally understood his true intention!
Even if it meant losing money, they had to secure the Metro Line 9 project!
These shareholders didn’t understand why Connor would make such a decision!

chapters.title: Chapter 846: Different Paths, Different Plans!
chapters.content:
Chapter 846: Different Paths, Different Plans!
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
For a company, no matter what project it was, it was all about profit.
If a project couldn’t be profitable, then there was no need to do it.
After all, investing in a project not only required a lot of manpower and material resources, but it also wasted a lot of time.
If he couldn’t get any benefits in the end, there was no need to do it.
However, Connor actually said that he had to win the Metro Line 9 project even if he had to lose money. This really shocked the shareholders in the company.
No one had expected that Connor, the newly appointed Chairman, would announce such a ridiculous decision at his first shareholders’ meeting.
What happened outside just now made the shareholders present feel that Connor was not as useless as the rumors said.
However, when Connor made this decision, the shareholders present realized that he was really an idiot—anyone with even half a brain would never make such a decision!
Even Quenna, who was standing behind Connor, had a puzzled look on her face. Although Quenna did not know much about business, she knew that business was all about making money.
If it didn’t make money and might even make a loss, then what was the use of winning this project?
One of the shareholders hesitated for a moment before reminding Connor softly, “Mr. McDonald, the situation of our company is like this. Some time ago, we just won an oil field development project. Now, most of our resources are focused on that project. As for this Metro Line 9 project, although the profits are indeed considerable, there is still a big gap compared to the oil field project…”
Although these shareholders did not have many shares in their hands, the company’s profits would still affect their interests.
Therefore, Connor’s method of winning the project at this time would not only hurt Connor’s interests, but also the interests of other shareholders. Therefore, they would definitely not agree to Connor’s actions.
“Mr. McDonald, the bidding for the Metro Line 9 project was released two months ago. Many big families in Porthampton have already made preparations for this project. If we compete for this project now, the manpower and material resources we need may be several times more than two months ago. We may not even be able to win this project to begin with, ” another shareholder added.
“That’s right, Mr. McDonald. You have to think it over carefully. Once we really take action on this project, those families in Porthampton will definitely think that our Empire World Corporation will have gone back on its word, ” Clyde added.
For a moment, it was as if everyone present was against Connor’s decision. They simply could not understand why Connor would make such a decision.
Thomas had been squinting at Connor. Before Connor made this decision, he did not discuss this matter with him, so he did not understand why Connor would do this.
At this moment, Connor looked at the shareholders present and asked expressionlessly, “Do you have any other opinions?”
“Mr. McDonald, I think we are putting all our energy into the oil field project. If we compete for the subway project, it might affect the oil field, so I don’t think this is a good choice!”
“That’s right, Mr. McDonald, this choice isn’t wise!” the other shareholders said.
After Connor heard these people’s words, he nodded lightly and said expressionlessly, “Well, I think you might have misunderstood me. I called this shareholders’ meeting today not to discuss this matter with you, but to inform you!”
“Wh…”
When everyone heard Connor’s words, they instantly went into an uproar!
Everyone turned their heads to look at Connor’s position, their faces filled with disbelief.
No one would have thought that Connor would be so overbearing as to call a meeting only to inform them of his decision.
“I’ve already said just now that I want to win this project at all costs. Even if I have to give up the benefits or even lose money, I want to win this project. Do you understand?” Connor said expressionlessly.
One of the shareholders finally couldn’t hold it in anymore and shouted excitedly, “Mr. McDonald, your idea is too ridiculous. Isn’t the purpose of starting a company to make money? What’s your purpose in doing this?”
“I don’t have any motives. I just want to do this. Do you have any objections?”
Connor looked at the shareholder and asked softly.
“Of course I have an opinion. I don’t agree with your decision!”
The shareholder replied excitedly.
“That’s right, I don’t agree either…”
“Mr. McDonald, what you’re doing is indeed a little inappropriate…”
The other shareholders also shouted.
Meanwhile, Thomas sat quietly on the spot and did not say a word from the beginning to the end.
“It seems that none of you agree with my decision, right?” Connor asked the shareholders with a smile.
“That’s right, we don’t agree!”
After hesitating for a moment, Clyde shouted at Connor in a low voice.
“What’s the point of not agreeing?”
Connor sneered and then said indifferently, “You might have forgotten that I, Connor McDonald, am the boss of the Empire World Corporation. I have 75% of the shares of this group, President Morgan has 15%, and the shares in your hands add up to only 10%. Tell me, do you have the right to disagree now?”
When the shareholders present heard Connor’s words, they were all dumbfounded.
They had never thought that Connor would actually be so overbearing in doing things. He did not give them any room for negotiation at all.
Clyde hesitated for a moment and shouted excitedly at Thomas, “President Morgan, please persuade Mr. McDonald. You can’t let him continue to make a fuss like this!”
“Mr. McDonald is right. He is the boss of this company. No matter what decision Mr. McDonald makes, we have no right to object!” Thomas said expressionlessly.
“This…”
When Clyde heard Thomas’s words, he was instantly dumbfounded. He stood rooted to the ground, not knowing what to do.
“This is simply nonsense!” A middle-aged man looked at Connor and shouted, then said expressionlessly, “Since Mr. McDonald insists on doing this, then we can’t work together. I might as well just quit!”
After the middle-aged man finished speaking, everyone present was stunned and turned to look at him.

chapters.title: Chapter 847: Withdrawing
chapters.content:
Chapter 847: Withdrawing
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
When the middle-aged man, Sean Quintin, finished speaking, everyone present fell into shock.
Everyone knew what Sean meant by that. He was preparing to withdraw his shares.
No matter what, these people were shareholders of the Empire World Corporation.
Even though they held very few shares (not even 10% of the total amount), some people might not even have 1% of the shares. However, the market value of the Empire World Corporation had already reached trillions, so even 1% of the shares were worth tens of billions!
These shareholders relied on these shares to receive dividends every year. It was estimated that they would receive hundreds of millions of dollars.
If they were in other industries, they would not be able to earn so much money even if they worked hard for their entire lives!
Connor’s current actions would obviously harm their current interests.
If he was allowed to continue fooling around like this, the market value of the Empire World Corporation would definitely drop a lot. At that time, the shares in the hands of these shareholders would definitely depreciate.
Therefore, Sean had the intention to withdraw his shares at this time. Withdrawing his shares now could be said to be the wisest choice.
“Mr. Quintin, are you planning to withdraw your shares?”
Thomas turned to look at Sean and asked softly.
“President Morgan, if it weren’t for the fact that I have no other choice, I wouldn’t have made such a decision either. However, there’s no other way. Mr. McDonald is stubborn and doesn’t listen to what we say at all, so I can only choose to withdraw my shares. At the very least, I can still get some money. If I continue to play with Mr. McDonald like this, I’m worried that I might not get a single cent in the end…” Sean replied in a deep voice.
“Mr. Quintin is right. Mr. McDonald, you can afford it, but we can’t. If you insist on doing this, then I’ll also choose to withdraw my shares!” another shareholder hurriedly added.
“I want to withdraw my shares too!”
“Me too!”
For a moment, all the shareholders present shouted to withdraw their shares.
Meanwhile, Connor sat expressionlessly on the spot, squinting at these people.
In fact, Connor had already guessed that this would be the outcome today. That was why Connor chose to discuss this matter at the shareholders ‘meeting instead of announcing it in front of the entire company.
The expression on Clyde’s face was somewhat helpless. He could not help but sigh, and then he softly shouted, “Everyone, calm down. I know that everyone doesn’t really want to withdraw their shares. They’re just forced to do so…”
“What’s there to be calm about? Unless Mr. McDonald can change his mind, I have to withdraw my shares today!”
“That’s right. Either we give up competing for Metro Line 9, or we withdraw our shares!”
The remaining shareholders also shouted.
In fact, these shareholders did not really want to withdraw their shares; after all, these shares were extremely important to them.
According to the current situation of the Empire World Corporation, these shares would only become more and more valuable. It was not a wise choice to give up these shares at this time.
The reason why they were saying this now was simply to use this method to force Connor to give up on competing for Metro Line 9.
Thomas’s expression also began to become conflicted.
These people held 10% of the shares of the Empire World Corporation. If they all withdrew their shares at the same time, they would have to prepare at least tens of billions of dollars in cash.
Although the Empire World Corporation was huge, suddenly taking out so much cash would have a huge impact on the Empire World Corporation. It was very likely to cause the corporation’s capital chain to break.
Moreover, if so many shareholders suddenly wanted to withdraw their shares, it would have a huge impact on the Empire World Corporation’s stock price.
Therefore, even if these shareholders did not hold many shares, the impact on the corporation was not something that these shares could measure.
Thomas did not understand what Connor meant, so he subconsciously looked at Connor’s position.
“Do you want to withdraw your shares?”
Connor looked at everyone and smiled faintly.
“That’s right. If Mr. McDonald doesn’t change your mind, we don’t have any other choice. We can only choose to withdraw our shares now…”
“We strongly disagree with Mr. McDonald’s actions. If you do this, it will bring a huge loss to the company!”
“I hope that Mr. McDonald can consider it carefully before making a decision…”
Everyone looked at Connor and said loudly.
Connor’s expression was somewhat disdainful as he said calmly, “Alright, whoever wants to withdraw their shares now, raise your hand and let me see!”
When the shareholders heard Connor’s words, they raised their hands without any hesitation.
For a moment, everyone except Clyde raised their hands.
When Connor saw that Clyde did not raise his hand, the expression on his face was a little surprised. He asked Clyde softly, “President Zink, didn’t you plan to withdraw your shares?”
“I…”
A hint of hesitation flashed across Clyde’s eyes before he whispered, “I won’t make any decision before President Morgan makes his stance clear…”
Thomas couldn’t help but hesitate for a moment when he heard this. Then, he said lightly, “Mr. McDonald’s opinion is my opinion. Since Mr. McDonald wants to do this project, I will support him unconditionally…”
“Since President Morgan has said so, then I also choose to support Mr. McDonald unconditionally!”
Clyde hurriedly shouted with a flattering expression.
Connor looked at Clyde and smiled faintly. Then, he asked the shareholders who wanted to withdraw their shares, “Do you still want to change your mind?”
When everyone heard Connor’s words, they looked at each other, but they didn’t seem to have any thoughts of changing their minds. They wanted to use this method to change Connor’s decision.
Thomas’s support for Connor was within the expectations of these people. After all, Thomas had not said a word before. Although Clyde had also chosen to support Connor, it did not have much of an impact. Therefore, the shareholders present felt that as long as they could join forces, they would definitely be able to threaten Connor.
“No one is going to change their minds, right?”
Connor called out expressionlessly, then said to Thomas, “President Morgan, go and prepare the contracts for these people now. Recover all the shares they hold according to the market value and transfer them to your name!”
“Mr. McDonald…”
Thomas never thought that Connor would use such a rough method to solve this problem. A strange look flashed across his eyes.
One had to know that the risk and price of Connor doing such a thing was still very terrifying!
“If the company’s funds are not enough, then transfer them from other companies. I have so many companies under me. If it really doesn’t work, I can sell one or two to fill this hole!” Connor said domineeringly to Thomas.
When everyone heard Connor’s words, they were instantly dumbfounded.
Only then did they realize that Connor really intended to buy the shares in their hands.

chapters.title: Chapter 848: The Domineering Connor
chapters.content:
Chapter 848: The Domineering Connor
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Originally, the shareholders of the Empire World Corporation thought that as long as they joined forces and threatened Connor by withdrawing their shares, they would be able to change Connor’s mind.
However, they never expected that Connor’s style of doing things would be so overbearing. He actually chose to withdraw the shares with money!
The shareholders were all dumbfounded. Each and every one of them stood rooted to the ground with their mouths agape, looking at Connor in a daze, not knowing what to do.
After all, when these people said that they wanted to withdraw their shares, they were only threatening Connor. No one really wanted to withdraw their shares.
However, Connor’s move directly left everyone hanging. If they really withdrew their shares, it would be a situation where both sides suffered.
Although these shareholders could get the money, from today onwards, they would have nothing to do with the Empire World Corporation. The conveniences and benefits that were received from the Imperial Group would also disappear. Their losses would definitely not be less than Connor’s!
At this moment, Connor wanted to use the most direct method to solve the most difficult problem.
Because while Connor lacked everything now, the only thing he did not lack was money. Even if he lost the money, Connor could still afford it.
However, the shareholders were different. If they really withdrew their shares, their losses would be unimaginable.
This was also why everyone looked so surprised.
Clyde stared at Connor and could not help but sigh in his heart. Connor’s style of doing things was really unfathomable.
Whether Connor wanted to compete for the subway project or withdraw the shares of these shareholders, it all seemed very absurd. However, all of this felt like it was within Connor’s control. It was as if he had already known that these things would happen before the shareholders’ meeting even began.
Clyde’s guess was not wrong. In fact, Connor had already expected that these shareholders might not agree, or that they might threaten him by withdrawing their shares.
However, Connor still chose to do so. The reason was very simple: he wanted to use this shareholders’ meeting to tell everyone who was the real owner of the Empire World Corporation!
Connor had two goals for this meeting. The first goal was to let everyone in the company win the subway project at all costs. The second goal was to let everyone in the company know that he, Connor McDonald, was the Chairman of this company and not just a decoration. There were some things that Connor could ignore or not ask about, but once he wanted to interfere, you could only choose to obey!
Perhaps this was Connor’s domineering side. This was also the change in his personality after experiencing so many things!
Previously, Connor’s character had always been very weak, but now he understood that weakness could not solve any problems at all.
Connor’s words made the shareholders present feel uneasy because they did not expect him to really agree to withdraw his shares.
“President Morgan, go and prepare the contract. Let’s settle this matter today!” Connor said to Thomas expressionlessly.
“Alright…”
Thomas quickly nodded and got up to leave.
“President Morgan, wait!”
But at this moment, a middle-aged man suddenly reached out and stopped Thomas.
Thomas looked at the middle-aged man and asked, “Is there something you need?”
“About that, President Morgan, I think I wasn’t thinking about it carefully just now. I won’t withdraw my shares. I support Mr. McDonald’s decision!”
The middle-aged man laughed nervously as he looked at Thomas.
“That’s right, I also support Mr. McDonald’s decision…”
“I’ll also support…”
Some of the shareholders who were not very firm in their stance immediately put down their hands and shouted at Thomas when they saw that Connor really intended to withdraw his shares.
In an instant, nearly half of the shareholders gave up on the idea of withdrawing their shares.
Connor looked at these people with a disdainful smile and sat quietly on the spot without saying a word.
The shareholder who had wanted to threaten Connor with withdrawing his shares earlier also withdrew his right hand awkwardly after seeing that so many people had given up. After all, everyone else had given up. There was no point in continuing!
Just like that, a dramatic scene happened.
The shareholders who were originally shouting to withdraw their shares changed their minds at the same time. They obediently put down their right hands and sat back down.
“Mr. McDonald, it seems that no one wants to withdraw their shares now…”
Thomas whispered to Connor.
After hearing this, Connor smiled faintly, then stood up and asked,”Weren’t you all crying and shouting that you wanted withdraw your shares previously? What’s happening now? Why don’t you want to withdraw your shares?”
Everyone looked at Connor, and their expressions were as awkward as they could be. No one dared to meet his gaze at all.
“Don’t think that I don’t know what you’re thinking. You’re just trying to use this method to threaten me and make me give up competing for the Metro Line 9 project. However, I am not as easy to deal with as you think. Although I don’t know how to manage a company, I know that this company belongs to me, so you have to listen to whatever I say. You’d better not play any tricks on me. If you can stay in this company well, then stay here obediently, and I will not give you anything less. If you don’t want to stay here anymore, you can leave at any time. I will also give you the money that you need. Do you understand what I mean?” Connor shouted loudly.
Everyone lowered their heads and did not dare to speak.
Quenna stood behind Connor. She seemed to be shocked by Connor’s domineering aura. Her expression was one of disbelief.
She felt that the Connor standing in front of her was very different from the Connor she knew!
If it wasn’t for what Connor had told her, she wouldn’t have believed that the person standing in front of her was the poor kid she knew back then!
In Quenna’s eyes, Connor was just a very ordinary poor student. Moreover, his personality was very easy-going and even a little weak. However, at this moment, Connor seemed to have changed into a different person. The aura e gave off had also changed greatly.
“What has Connor experienced in the past few years?”
Quenna could not help but sigh in her heart.
“Didn’t you hear me when I was talking to you?”
Connor asked coldly.
“Understood, Mr. McDonald!”
Everyone was shocked by Connor’s words and hurriedly replied.

chapters.title: Chapter 849: A Breakthrough!
chapters.content:
Chapter 849: A Breakthrough!
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
“Then I’m competing for the Metro Line 9 project now. Do you have any objections?”
Connor looked at everyone and continued to ask.
“No objections…”
“None…”
Everyone shook their heads without thinking.
“Alright, since none of you have any objections, then this matter is settled! From today onwards, I don’t care what price you have to pay or how much money you have to waste. Even if you end up losing money, you have to win the Metro Line 9 project over, understood?” Connor said as he looked at everyone.
“Yes, Mr. McDonald!” everyone hurriedly replied.
Clyde hesitated for a moment before asking Connor softly, “Mr. McDonald, what if we don’t get this project in the end?”
“I told you that we have to win this project at all costs, so the situation you mentioned won’t exist at all!” Connor calmly replied.
Clyde looked at Connor with a hint of helplessness in his eyes, but did not continue speaking.
“Alright, that’s all I have to say. If you have nothing else to say, then the meeting is over!” Connor said indifferently.
The shareholders in the meeting room were relieved when they heard Connor’s words. They quickly packed up their things and prepared to leave, not wanting to stay here for a second longer. In the eyes of these people, the newly appointed Chairman was not a rich heir who had nothing to do. On the contrary, they felt that Connor was more like a tyrant, and the kind of tyrant who did things without any reason at that.
The shareholders couldn’t take it at all!
A few minutes later, all the shareholders in the meeting room left.
At that moment, only Connor Thomas, and Quenna were left in the meeting room.
Thomas turned to Quenna and said, “You can leave first. I have something to say to Mr. McDonald in private…”
“Ah…Alright!”
Quenna quickly nodded when she heard what Thomas said. She then turned around and walked out of the meeting room.
After Quenna left, Thomas looked at Connor with a faint smile and said softly, “Mr. McDonald, your performance today really surprised me!”
“I just wanted to scare these shareholders. I know that in their eyes, I’m just an ignorant and incompetent rich kid. That’s why they’re so opposed to me competing for the Metro Line 9 project,” Connor replied with a smile.
“That’s good. At the very least, when you take over this company in the future, these shareholders will be more honest!” Thomas nodded.
“Don’t worry. I don’t have any intention of taking over the Empire World Corporation for the time being. You’ll still help me manage it in the future. There are many things in the company that I don’t know…” Connor explained.
“You can learn if you don’t understand, but no matter what, this is what the old Chairman left for you. I am just here to assist you in taking over these things. Once you can control the situation, I can step back safely…”
Thomas said slowly.
Connor couldn’t help but smile when he heard Thomas’s words. He said softly, “If you reach the age where you should retire, I will let you retire, but that will have to wait until I can take over Rockefeller. It’s impossible for you to retire now!”
“Hahaha…” When Thomas heard Connor’s words, he immediately laughed out loud.
In fact, Thomas was very pleased to see Connor like this today because he was waiting for Connor to take the initiative to manage the company. He had never wanted to force Connor to intervene in the company’s affairs because he felt that if he forced these things on him, it would bring a lot of pressure to him.
Moreover, the more he forced Connor, the more Connor might dislike these things.
“Alright, let’s get down to business. Aren’t you curious why I want to take action on this project?” Connor asked Thomas softly.
“Because of Rockefeller’s people, right?”
“That’s right, because of them!” Connor nodded lightly.
“Mr. McDonald, tell me about your current plan!”
Thomas asked.
Connor hesitated for a moment, then said in a serious tone, “I heard that you snatched the oil field project from Birdie Schroder some time ago. She suffered heavy losses because of that project. Is that true?”
“Yes…” Thomas nodded.
Connor narrowed his eyes and asked, “I heard that Birdie is putting all her energy into the subway project again. If we get the subway project, what will happen to her?”
“Birdie Schroder is just the person-in-charge of Rockefeller in Davenport. If two projects fail in a row, Rockefeller will suffer heavy losses, and Birdie will lose her position as person-in-charge…” Thomas said slowly.
“That’s right. If this project really threatens Birdie’s position as the person-in-charge, then she will definitely do her best to remedy the situation. The remedy is also very simple: either we give up the bid before the bidding results are out, or Birdie will think of a way to snatch the project away from us after we get the project…” Connor mused.
Thomas looked at Connor and said nothing.
“But no matter what choice Birdie makes, she will still need to contact the Empire World Corporation because we are her biggest enemies! And I only have one condition, which is for her to talk to me about this matter in person!” Connor said clearly.
Thomas took a deep breath and slowly said, “Mr. McDonald, you actually spent so much effort just to meet Birdie Schroder?”
“That’s right. As long as I can see her, I’ll know her true identity. In that case, we can find a breakthrough to deal with Rockefeller!”
Connor nodded lightly.
In fact, Connor had been thinking about how to deal with Rockefeller, but Rockefeller was so secretive to the point where he only knew the name and no the face of the person-in-charge of a region.
This also caused Rockefeller’s people to always be in the dark, while Connor’s werealways in the light.
If this continued, it would be impossible for Connor to deal with Rockefeller. He did not know who the enemy was, nor did he have any information about Rockefeller.
But at this moment, the Metro Line 9 project was the best breakthrough!

chapters.title: Chapter 850: More Exciting Than a Movie!
chapters.content:
Chapter 850: More Exciting Than a Movie!
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
In the conference room.
After Thomas heard Connor’s words, he nodded slightly and said in a low voice, “Mr. McDonald, I think your plan is feasible. Once we really get the Metro Line 9 project, I think Birdie will definitely not be able to sit still. After all, Birdie has just taken over the position of the person-in-charge from her father. However, Birdie has not had any achievements since she took over. Rockefeller might have been dissatisfied with Birdie for a long time…”
Connor smiled playfully when he heard Thomas’s words, then said softly, “I think that with your intelligence, you should have thought of this method long ago, right?”
“Yes…”
Thomas didn’t deny it. He looked at Connor and nodded.
“Since you’ve already thought of this method, why didn’t you implement it earlier?”
Connor asked Thomas in confusion.
“Although I can think of this method, I’m not the Chairman of the Empire World Corporation. I’m just an employee under you, Mr. McDonald. The purpose of my existence is to help you run this company well, not to deal with those people in Rockefeller. If I use this method to deal with Birdie, although the effect will be very significant, I will also have to pay a very high price. Therefore, I can’t make a decision on my own. Besides, I can’t force you to make such a decision!”
Thomas said slowly.
“I understand!”
Connor nodded thoughtfully. After hesitating for a moment, he asked softly, “Then do you think it will be difficult for our company to win this project?”
“It’s definitely difficult. After all, we’re already two months behind others. Moreover, there are many companies that want to compete for this project this time. Even if our company puts all our energy into this project, we might not be able to win this project 100%!”
Thomas looked at Connor and said.
After Connor heard Thomas’s words, a strange look flashed across his eyes.
He knew that since Thomas had said so, it meant that it would not be easy to win this project.
“Mr. McDonald, if we rely on these people in the company, the chances of winning this project might not be high. However, if Mr. McDonald takes action, the chances might be higher…”
Thomas hesitated for a moment before looking at Connor.
“What do you mean by that?”
Connor frowned and asked.
“Mr. McDonald, you might not know that Commander Shaw’s younger brother is the president of Porthampton’s subway company. You know Commander Shaw—if you can get him to help you say something, the effect will naturally be different. After all, the final decision of this project is made by the subway company. Once the subway company internally decides to give it to us, no matter how hard the others work, it will be in vain…”
Thomas said softly.
“Haha…”
After Connor heard this, his expression seemed a little helpless. Then, he said in a low voice, “Who knew that everything would come back to me even after going around in so many circles…”
There was no direct relationship between Connor and Joey Shaw.
The reason why Joey would help Connor was just to humor Rachel Wallace.
Therefore, if Connor wanted Joey to help, he had to go through Rachel. However, he didn’t want Rachel to know about this issue; as it was, he didn’t know if she was a friend or a foe. She had too many secrets.
Connor felt that Rachel was very dangerous, so unless it was absolutely necessary, Connor did not want her to participate in this matter at all.
Connor hesitated for a moment before speaking softly to Thomas. “How about this? You guys try your best to fight for this project first. If you can win this project in the end, that’s naturally the best outcome. If you really can’t, then I’ll think of other ways!”
“Alright!”
Thomas nodded lightly.
“If there’s nothing else, I’ll go back first!” Connor said.
“Mr. McDonald, let me send you off…”
Thomas quickly stood up and walked out of the company with Connor.
Meanwhile, Quenna had been waiting for Connor outside the meeting room. After all, everything that had happened today was too unbelievable for her.
She had so many questions she wanted to ask Connor.
When Quenna saw Connor and Thomas walking out of the meeting room, she quickly walked up to Connor.
However, because Thomas was still by Connor’s side, Quenna did not speak.
Connor turned his head to look at Quenna and said softly, “Quenna, it’s getting late. Why don’t I treat you to lunch?”
“…”
Quenna was stunned for a moment when she heard Connor’s words. Then, she hurriedly nodded and said, “Alright…”
Thomas was a smart man. He knew that Connor must have something to tell Quenna, so after sending Connor out of the company, he turned around and returned to the company.
Meanwhile, Connor and Quenna went to a random restaurant next to the company and got a private room.
Connor took the initiative to pass the menu to Quenna and said to her with a smile, “Quenna, feel free to order whatever you want!”
Quenna was not in the mood to order dishes now, however; all she could think about was Connor’s identity. She ended up ordering a few random dishes and sending the waiter away!
After the waiter left, Quenna looked up at Connor. She looked a little nervous.
She opened her mouth to speak, but she did not know how to say it. Quenna had a lot of questions she wanted to ask Connor, but now that she had the chance to ask these questions, she did not know how to ask him.
“Do you want to hear my story?”
Connor asked Quenna with a smile.
“…”
Quenna looked at Connor and was stunned for a moment. Then, she quickly nodded and said, “Yes…”
After hesitating for a moment, Connor briefly told Quenna about how he had inherited Steven Lee’s inheritance.
Of course, Connor had omitted many details.
There were some things that Connor couldn’t tell Quenna because knowing these things would not do her any good.
After Quenna heard Connor’s words, her expression was one of disbelief. She had never expected Connor to have experienced so much!
In Quenna’s eyes, Connor’s experiences were even more exciting than a movie!
..

chapters.title: Chapter 851: People Always Change!
chapters.content:
Chapter 851: People Always Change!
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
“You know why I became the chairman of the Empire World Corporation, right?” Connor looked at Quenna and asked with a smile.
“I know. It’s because you’re so lucky. You’re able to inherit such a large inheritance…” Quenna looked at Connor and said enviously.
Connor sighed helplessly and said indifferently, “You might think my life is good, but if you were in my shoes, you might realize that some things are not as good as you think. Being rich doesn’t mean that you don’t have any worries…”
“That’s true. I might not be able to understand the troubles of you rich people!” Quenna looked at Connor and nodded in agreement. She continued asking, “So why did you promote me as your assistant? I don’t think I can be the chairman’s assistant yet…”
“If I deem you capable, then you are!” Connor replied to Quenna calmly before continuing, “Actually, this job is relatively simple. You don’t have to feel any pressure. You only have to tell me what happened in the company. As for other things, you don’t have to worry…”
“Tell you what happened in the company?” When Quenna heard Connor’s words, she was surprised. A hint of confusion flashed in her eyes.
“That’s right!”
Connor nodded and continued, “Although I’m the company’s chairman now, I don’t know much about this company. Other than Thomas, no one in the company knows me, so please help me monitor these people’s every move in the company. No matter what happens in the company, you must report to me immediately.”
“In simple words, you want me to help you spy on the people in the company, right?” Quenna blinked and asked Connor softly.
“That’s right. That’s a way to see it…” Connor nodded.
Connor had promoted Quenna to the chairman’s assistant position because he wanted Quenna to help him monitor everyone in the company.
After all, it was impossible for Connor to always be at the office. There were many things in the company that Connor did not know. However, if Quenna could help him monitor these people in the company, Connor would be able to understand the situation in the company fast.
Of course, Connor could also learn about these situations from Thomas, but Connor felt that what Charles said to him was right. He should not rely too much on anyone now.
Even if Thomas and Kyle were strong, Connor could not rely too much on them.
Otherwise, if these two people joined hands to betray Connor one day, Connor might not even know what hit him.
One can’t have the heart to harm others, but one can’t be without the heart to guard against others!
Connor knew that, at the very least.
Therefore, Connor now planned to start gathering his spies in the company.
Connor and Quenna had known each other for a long time, so Connor knew Quenna very well. Quenna was also someone Connor could trust, so Connor felt that it was best for Quenna to do this.
“I understand what you mean!” Quenna looked at Connor and nodded gently.
“So, can you do this well?” Connor looked at Quenna and asked.
“I’ll do my best, but I’m worried that after they find out I’m your assistant, there are some things they won’t let me know!” Quenna whispered.
“Don’t worry. No one has the guts to do that. I’ve already told you that from now on, you’re qualified to participate no matter what meeting it is. Moreover, Mr. Morgan should also inform you of some important matters, and then you’ll inform me. If anyone deliberately hides anything from you, it means something fishy about that person…” Connor said slowly.
“Okay!” Quenna seemed to be relieved. She nodded at Connor.
“I know you’re new to this job and might not be used to it, but once you’re familiar with it, you should be able to relax a lot!” Connor comforted Quenna when he saw the anxiety on her face.
“Don’t worry. I’ll work hard!” Quenna nodded at Connor seriously. She then looked at Connor from head to toe as if she wanted to say something but hesitated.
“What do you want to say?” Connor asked Quenna softly.
Quenna looked at Connor and hesitated. Then, she said in a low voice, “Actually, it’s nothing. I feel that you have changed quite a lot. I thought you were just an ordinary high school student, but I didn’t expect you to have changed so much…”
“People always change!” Connor replied with a smile. He then looked at Quenna and continued, “Quenna, you don’t have to be so nervous and polite with me. To me, you’ll always be my Quenna. Just treat me like you did before. I’m still not used to you acting like this…”
Quenna smiled awkwardly when she heard that. Then, she adjusted her composure and asked softly, “Are you still in contact with Jaden?”
“It’s been a long time since we last contacted each other. After I went to university, I changed my phone number, so we lost contact…” Connor replied indifferently, and then a trace of helplessness flashed in his eyes.
In fact, Connor and Jaden were very close in high school.
However, after Connor and Mandy got together in university, Mandy never liked Jaden very much, so she forced Connor to cut off contact with Jaden.
Due to this, Connor had always felt that he owed Jaden.
Now that he thought about it, he had really given up everything for Mandy then.
However, in the end, Connor was heartlessly abandoned by Mandy because he had no money.
Sometimes, you can’t win a person’s heart just because you give everything.
To those people, your sacrifices are worthless.
“Should I tell Jaden that I saw you?” Quenna looked at Connor and asked.
“Of course. I haven’t seen Jaden for a long time and miss him a little…” Connor hurriedly replied, adding, “But Quenna, don’t tell Jaden my real identity…”
“Why?” Quenna blinked and asked in confusion.

chapters.title: Chapter 852: The Transfer Students
chapters.content:
Chapter 852: The Transfer Students
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
To Quenna, Connor had always been a poor boy who could not afford his tuition fees.
But now, Connor had turned from a poor kid to a super-rich heir.
Logically speaking, he should have no reason to hide his identity.
After all, no matter who it was, they would want to tell others they had money once they had money.
As the saying goes, the ones who have gone big do not go home.
However, Connor was the exact opposite. He wanted to hide his identity, making Quenna feel incredulous.
However, Quenna might not know this. If she were as rich as Connor, she would not care if others knew she was rich.
On the contrary, if everyone knew Connor’s identity, the attitude of the people around Connor would change!
“There’s no reason. I don’t want too many people to know my identity. I still feel it’s more comfortable for everyone to get along with me with a normal attitude…”
Connor looked at Quenna and explained calmly before continuing, “Just like how you interacted with me before, I felt very comfortable with it. But now, how you talk to me makes me very uncomfortable. But I know that it’s not because of you. After all, you already know my identity. You won’t be able to get along with me the way you did before…”
“I see!” Quenna looked at Connor and nodded.
“All right, let’s not talk about Jaden. Add me on Facebook. If you have anything in the future, you can send me a Facebook message. If you need my help, you can also send me a Facebook message!” Connor looked at Quenna and said.
Quenna was surprised when she heard Connor’s suggestion. Then, she quickly took out her iPhone and added Connor on Facebook.
Although Quenna was just an ordinary employee of the Empire World Corporation, her salary was very high. Moreover, Quenna’s family was well-off, so she always wore branded clothes.
However, when Quenna saw Connor take out an ordinary Android phone, a hint of confusion flashed in her eyes. She said softly, “Connor, you’re already so rich. Why don’t you buy a better phone?”
“This phone of mine is quite good. I just bought it not long ago. It’s quite user-friendly…” Connor replied with a smile.
“I don’t know what you rich people are thinking. You’re so low-key…”
Quenna looked at Connor and sighed helplessly. Then, she opened her Facebook QR code.
Connor opened Facebook, scanned Quenna’s QR code, and added her on Facebook.
After adding Quenna on Facebook, Connor started eating.
After a short chat, Quenna realized that although Connor was very domineering before the shareholders, he did not change at all when facing her. He was like an old friend whom she had not met for a long time. He chatted with Quenna about the past while eating.
Half an hour later, Connor and Quenna finished their meal.
Quenna returned to the office while Connor was about to return to Porthampton University to attend classes. After all, Connor had not returned to the university for a long time. Connor felt that if he did not go back soon, Rachel would make things difficult for him.
Connor stood by the road and hailed a taxi. Then, he returned to Porthampton University.
When Connor arrived at the school, he found that the class had commenced. Fortunately, this class was not Rachel’s class, so Connor sneaked into the classroom from the back door and ran to Dominic and Spencer.
When Dominic and Spencer saw Connor, a trace of surprise flashed in their eyes.
“Bro, you still come to class?” Dominic whispered to Connor.
“I had something to do these few days, so I didn’t come to class…” Connor said helplessly.
“I’m telling you, you’re finished. You haven’t come to class for so many days. Ms. Wallace will not let you off!” Dominic looked at Connor and continued.
“It’s fine. I’ve already asked for a leave of absence from her…” Connor said lightly.
“Who was the pretty girl who came to the classroom to look for you yesterday?” Spencer hesitated before asking Connor with a gossipy face.
“Just an ordinary friend…”
“Are they just ordinary friends?”
Dominic looked at Connor and gave a sly smile, the expression on his face was extremely wretched.
“We’re just ordinary friends. Can the two of you not be so gossipy…” Connor said helplessly.
“Actually, Connor, since you’re so rich, it’s normal for you to find a few girlfriends. After all, rich heirs like you all like to have multiple girlfriends. We can all understand this…” Dominic chuckled.
“What do you understand? You should focus on class!” Connor frowned and scolded.
“Did you know we have two transfer students now?” Dominic looked at Connor and continued.
“I don’t. What do the new transfer students have to do with me…” Connor retorted.
“Well, let’s see. These two transfer students are both really hot. They’re very beautiful. Every day, students come to our class to confess to these two girls, but these two girls didn’t come to class today. I don’t know where they went. You’ll know when you see these two. They’re so sexy…” Dominic grinned and said.
“…”
Connor looked at the helpless expression on Dominic’s face and didn’t say anything.
Seeing Connor saying nothing, Dominic took out his phone and started playing games.
Connor looked up at the lecturer on the podium. He realized that he had not come to class recently and had missed out on a lot.
However, Connor’s previous academic performance was very good. Basically, he could get a scholarship every year, so even if he missed some classes, it didn’t affect him much.
Although Connor had already inherited Steven Lee’s money and was very rich, he did not give up on his studies because he knew that no matter what, what was in his mind was the most important.
However, Connor did not have to be as strict with himself as before. He only needed to achieve the results of an average student. After all, he did not need the school’s scholarship to support himself, nor did he have to force himself like before.
In the blink of an eye, the class was over.
Connor couldn’t help but yawn. He got up and was about to go to the bathroom with Dominic and Spencer.
However, just as Connor stood up, he saw two beautiful women walking into the classroom.
When Connor saw the two women, he was stunned.

chapters.title: Chapter 853: You Know Each Other?
chapters.content:
Chapter 853: You Know Each Other?
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
The two women who walked into the classroom were dressed exceptionally beautifully.
One of them was wearing a short skirt that reached her butt. She was tall and sexy, and her two beautiful legs were exposed.
The other woman wore a tight black T-shirt tightly wrapped around her chest. She had light makeup, and her pretty face was paired with her black curly hair, making her tempting.
After Connor saw these two women, his face fell.
These two women were none other than the twin sisters Yucca and Yarrow that Cade wanted to give to Connor on the cruise ship.
Although Connor had rejected Cade then, Cade felt that Connor was embarrassed to accept it because Yelena was present.
To please Connor, Cade sent his two daughters to Porthampton University, where Connor was. He also used his connections to get his two daughters into Connor’s class.
One had to know that Cade’s identity was relatively special, so it was very easy to operate these things.
When Connor saw the two girls, he subconsciously turned his head, not wanting Yarrow and Yucca to see him.
“Connor, did you see that? Those two women are the new goddesses in our class. There are so many people pursuing them. Aren’t they gorgeous? I like the one in the short skirt. Those two beautiful legs are attractive…”
After Dominic saw Yarrow and Yucca, he gulped and said to Connor.
“…”
Connor turned around and ignored Dominic.
“Connor, why are you turning away? Quickly turn around and take a look. These two women are so attractive. How can there be such beautiful women? I can’t believe it…” When Dominic saw Connor turn his head away, he hurriedly reached out to pull Connor and spoke excitedly.
“All right, I f*cking saw them. Can you stop pulling me?” Connor frowned and scolded in a low voice.
Connor was worried that Yucca and Yarrow would discover him.
However, they had no choice. At this moment, Yarrow and Connor were still there.
They hurriedly walked toward him when they saw Connor, while Yucca followed behind Yarrow.
“It’s over, Connor. They heard what I said just now. They’re walking toward me. What should I do?”
When Dominic saw Yarrow and Yucca walking toward him, he thought that they were coming for him, so he looked a little nervous. He couldn’t help but tremble and didn’t know what to do for a moment.
“Well, hurry up and apologize to them!”
Connor knew he had already been exposed, so he planned to let Dominic help him block them first.
“I think you’re right. I should apologize!” Dominic hurriedly nodded. After hesitating, he rushed to Yarrow and whispered, “Hey, I did talk about the two of you just now, but I was just praising you. I didn’t say anything else. If the two of you think that I…”
“Move aside!” Yarrow didn’t even give Dominic a chance to finish his sentence. She immediately shouted at Dominic with a poker face.
When Dominic heard Yarrow’s order, he couldn’t help but be stunned. He then asked in a low voice,” Aren’t you two here for me?”
“Get out of the way! Yarrow pushed Dominic away and walked to Connor.
Connor was speechless. He looked like he was about to have a nervous breakdown. He was still determining what Yarrow and Yucca were going to do.
“Hello, Connor!” After that, Yarrow and Yucca bowed to Connor simultaneously and called out sweetly.
“F*ck…” Connor looked at the two women and was speechless. He originally wanted to greet them but did not expect them to do this!
The boys in the classroom looked at Connor with complicated expressions.
Shock, envy, confusion, jealousy…
In any case, all kinds of emotions were combined.
“What… What was going on? You know each other?” However, the one who was the most surprised was still Dominic. Dominic stuttered as he asked Connor.
Connor was somewhat helpless. He knew he couldn’t talk to Yarrow and Yucca in the classroom. Otherwise, his identity would very likely be known by the entire class!
Connor stood up and said to Yarrow and Yucca,” Uhm, you two, come out with me…”
“All right, Connor!” Yarrow and Yucca agreed.
Connor strode out of the classroom, leaving behind a dumbfounded Dominic and the other students.
After Connor disappeared completely, the students in the classroom gathered around Dominic and began to inquire about Connor’s relationship with Yarrow and Yucca.
After all, since these two goddesses transferred to their class, many people tried confessing to them, but they all failed.
Moreover, these two goddesses were very cold and aloof. They didn’t even talk to the students in the class.
However, Yarrow and Yucca’s attitude toward Connor was so respectful. This was indeed unbelievable.
“It’s good to be rich!”
At this moment, Dominic only had this thought because he knew Connor’s identity.
Therefore, he could vaguely guess what happened between Connor, Yarrow, and Yucca!
However, Dominic did not explain anything to the others in the class because he knew Connor did not like letting too many people know his true identity.
Meanwhile, Connor brought Yarrow and Yucca to the end of the corridor. He then sized up the two women and asked tiredly, “What are you two doing in my school? Didn’t I already make things clear to you guys back then?”
“Connor, our father asked us to come here. From today onward, you are our master, and we are your servants!” Yarrow looked at Connor and replied.
“What did you say?”
Connor was shocked when he heard this and asked in a puzzled tone.
“I said that from today onward, you are our master!” Yarrow repeated.
“Yo, can you stop fooling around? What era are we in now? What’s with this master and servant thing?”
Connor was utterly dumbfounded.

chapters.title: Chapter 854: The Heartless Cade
chapters.content:
Chapter 854: The Heartless Cade
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Connor looked at Yarrow and Yucca helplessly.
Connor felt it was very baffling hearing what Yarrow said.
Yarrow had called Connor their master. What era was this? How could there still be such a thing as a master and a servant?
Although Yarrow and Yucca were very beautiful, Connor had no special hobbies. Moreover, he had only met these two women twice.
Connor felt that he didn’t even know Yarrow and Yucca.
But now, Yarrow and Yucca were saying that Connor was their master. How could Connor not feel awkward?
If a normal man encountered two beautiful women talking like this, he would be very happy.
However, Connor was not a fool. He knew that these two women had some ulterior motive for contacting him.
“Tell me the truth. What’s your purpose in coming to Porthampton University?” Connor asked Yarrow with a frown after hesitating.
“Mr. McDonald, we really don’t have any other motive for getting close to you. We just want to serve you…” Yarrow explained to Connor very seriously.
“No, you are so beautiful. Why do the two of you have to cling to me? Didn’t I tell you that I’m not interested in the two of you at all? You two better leave this place quickly, okay? Don’t disturb me anymore…” Connor scolded Yarrow.
After Yarrow heard that, a hint of helplessness flashed in her eyes, she gently said to Connor, “Mr. McDonald, we don’t want to pester you like this. But we have someone to answer to…”
“What?” Connor asked, puzzled.
“We came to Porthampton University because our father arranged it. My father arranged for us to be by your side and instructed us to serve you well and treat you as our master,” Yarrow said in a low voice.
“Phew…”
When Connor heard that, a strange look flashed in his eyes, he then frowned and asked Yarrow, “Are you sure Cade is your biological father?”
“Yes!” Yarrow nodded and continued, “However, our mother is our father’s mistress. Therefore, our positions in the Lambert Family are very low. My father has been training us for so many years so that he could gift us to the people he thinks are valuable. This is our destiny. If we don’t follow my father’s will, our mother and we will be in danger.”
“Is Cade even human? He could even sell his daughters?” Connor looked at Yarrow and commented helplessly.
“My father has many mistresses and many illegitimate children. We are illegitimate daughters. Other than our looks and figures, we don’t have any advantages. If we want to survive in a big family like the Lambert Family, we can only take this path…” Yucca, who had been silent all this while, whispered to Connor.
“That’s right. From the moment we came to this world, our fates were sealed. Mr. McDonald, you’re about the same age as the two of us and very handsome. Most importantly, we don’t think you’re a bad person, so being your mistress is much better than being given to those old men by our father…” Yarrow hurriedly added.
“Uhm, although you two think I’m not bad, have you ever considered my feelings? I already have girlfriends and a fiancée overseas whom I don’t know when her return is. My love life is messy now. Every time I think of these women, I feel a headache. If I bring you two into my life right now, what am I?”
Seeing that Yarrow and Yucca had told him the truth, he couldn’t help but reveal his true feelings.
“Mr. McDonald, you don’t have to worry about this. We don’t need any status and won’t bring you any trouble. Just call us when you need us. We will be at your service at any time…” Yarrow blushed as she whispered to Connor.
“…” Connor was taken aback.
Yarrow’s words were indeed extremely alluring in the eyes of other men.
Yarrow and Yucca were perfect lovers. Not only were they good-looking, but their figures were also very hot. Most importantly, they were not clingy.
Cade should have known this, too, so he felt that no man could reject his two daughters!
However, Connor had no intention of finding a mistress at all. When he had sex with Chloe and Yelena, Connor already felt guilty toward Freya.
When Freya returned to the country, Connor still did not know how to explain it to Freya!
Connor would be in deeper trouble if Yarrow and Yucca were to be added to the mix.
“I understand what the two of you mean, but I’m not the kind of person you two think I am. I don’t intend to find mistresses, so you two should do what you should and stop disturbing my life, okay?” Connor said to Yarrow and Yucca solemnly.
“Mr. McDonald, we can’t leave…” Yucca’s eyes flashed with a trace of nervousness as she hurriedly said to Connor.
“Why not?” Connor frowned and asked.
“My father told me that we must become your women no matter the price. Otherwise, my father will stop giving my mother her living expenses. My mother is seriously ill now. Without my father’s support, we won’t be able to afford the high medical expenses…” Yucca said nervously.
“Is Cade so cruel?” Connor looked at Yucca and didn’t know what else to say.
He had never thought that Cade would be so crazy as not even to let his wife and daughter off.

chapters.title: Chapter 855: A Conspiracy
chapters.content:
Chapter 855: A Conspiracy
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
As the saying goes, even a vicious tiger would not eat its cubs!
However, Connor had never thought that Cade would be so vicious. He would not even let his wife and daughters off!
Sometimes, Connor really couldn’t understand the thoughts of these rich people.
Wasn’t earning money just so their family could live a better life?
However, these so-called rich people sacrificed their daughters’ happiness and their wife’s happiness for their interests. This practice was indeed somewhat incomprehensible.
“Mr. McDonald, my sister and I are just illegitimate daughters. Moreover, we have no status in the Lambert Family at all. There are countless illegitimate children like us, so it’s normal for my father to do this. When we were young, we saw many sisters given to others by our fathers as bits, so we have long been used to this situation…” Yarrow seemed to have read Connor’s mind and explained to him softly.
“Have you two ever thought of resisting?” Connor hesitated before asking.
“Resisting?”
Hearing that, Yarrow shook her head helplessly and said indifferently, “When we were young, an elder sister secretly fell in love with someone else. She didn’t want to follow my father’s arrangements and marry a rich heir from a big family. Later on, she even planned to elope, but my father’s people caught her in less than a month. Her boyfriend was missing. I think my father’s people killed him. Our elder sister was also forced to marry a fool. Ultimately, she seemed to have been tortured into a mental illness. How is she now? I’m not very sure either, so everyone in my family is terrified of my father. No one dares to disobey my father’s wishes…”
“…” After Connor heard Yarrow’s story, the expression on his face became a little strange.
Connor would never have thought that Cade would make such a vicious move.
“Mr. McDonald, we don’t want this to happen, but we have no choice. After all, this is our father’s order…” Yucca bit her lip and whispered to Connor.
Connor took a deep breath and said in a low voice, “How about this? You two give me Cade’s cell phone number. I’ll talk to your father about this personally…”
“No…” Yucca’s face was filled with fear as she hurriedly waved at Connor.
“Why not?” Connor frowned and asked.
“Mr. McDonald, my father doesn’t allow us to tell anyone about this. If you call my father now, he will be very angry…” Yucca looked at Connor and explained.
“How about this? Can’t I help you with your mother’s medical fees? You two can stop pestering me then…” Connor said in a low voice after hesitating.
“Mr. McDonald, can you help us for a lifetime? Moreover, if we leave you, we will also be given to someone else by our father. In the end, our fates will be the same…” Yarrow whispered.
“So you two will continue clinging to me?” A trace of helplessness flashed in Connor’s eyes as he frowned and asked.
“Mr. McDonald, we won’t keep pestering you. As long as you don’t chase us away…” Yarrow whispered.
After hearing Yarrow’s words, Connor hesitated before saying in a low voice,” Well, since you two want to stay by my side, then stay. But let me say this first. You must not tell anyone about my identity and our relationship. Do you understand what I mean?”
“Yes, we understand…”
Yarrow and Yucca hurriedly nodded when they heard Connor’s agreement. A hint of excitement flashed in their eyes.
“All right, I have nothing else to do since you two understand. Remember, don’t reveal my identity. Otherwise, I’ll call your fathers and ask you two to leave.” Connor seemed to be a little worried and added.
“Mr. McDonald, don’t worry. We will not tell anyone about your identity, nor will we tell anyone about our relationship…” Yarrow said very seriously.
Connor sighed softly and then walked toward the classroom.
Connor felt that Yarrow and Yucca had very pitiful lives.
Although the two looked glamorous on the surface, they were just tools in Cade’s hands.
They didn’t even have a chance to choose. Moreover, Connor felt that chasing these two girls away now would be equivalent to pushing them into hell.
That was why Connor was soft-hearted and kept these two girls around.
As for letting them be his lovers, Connor would not consider it at all. Even if these two girls were gorgeous, Connor would not have such thoughts.
***
Yarrow and Yucca had a strange look in their eyes when they saw Connor leave.
“Mr. McDonald seems a little difficult to deal with this time!” Yucca seemed to have changed into a different person. Her obedient and pitiful look disappeared instantly and was replaced by a cunning and smug look.
“So what? Didn’t he agree to keep us around?” Yarrow licked her lips and sneered. She then continued,” As long as Connor keeps us by his side, it means we still have a chance…”
“I originally thought that Connor would chase us away. I didn’t expect he would soften his heart in the end!” Yucca said lightly.
Yarrow took a deep breath and said coldly, “Father said that Connor is not ordinary. It might be a little difficult to deal with him. However, if we can get him to take the bait, we will not have to worry about money for the rest of our lives…”
“Connor is quite a good person. It’s just that his heart is too soft…” Yucca added thoughtfully.
“Connor is just an ordinary person. He’s still very different from those young men in the big families, so it’s normal for him to be soft-hearted sometimes!” Yarrow replied expressionlessly.
“But I suddenly feel like I can’t do this to him!” Yucca sighed,

chapters.title: Chapter 856: Jaden's Phone Call
chapters.content:
Chapter 856: Jaden’s Phone Call
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
“You can’t do it?”
After hearing Yarrow’s words, Yucca couldn’t help but pause for a moment. Then, with a cold expression, she said, “What’s so difficult about it? Both of us genuinely want to become his women, and we’re willing to sleep with him. He’s not losing out…”
“But…”
Yucca tried to say something.
“There’s no ‘but’!” Yarrow suddenly reprimanded and continued, “Yucca, don’t forget our purpose. If both of us can’t sleep with him, we won’t gain anything. Connor is our best opportunity, and we can’t miss it!”
Yucca sighed softly, then frowned and asked, “What’s your plan next, sister?”
“What else can we do? Let’s not approach Connor for now. During this time, he must be resistant to both of us. Let him get used to our presence, and then find a way to make us irresistible. I don’t believe that two beautiful women like us hanging around him every day won’t make him tempted. Once he’s interested, the rest will be easy!”
Yarrow said slowly.
“But I don’t think Connor will be easily seduced…”
After hesitating for a moment, Yucca whispered.
“There’s no man in the world who isn’t interested in beauty. Both of us are presenting ourselves to him. Why would he refuse? Unless he’s not a man, I can’t think of any reason!”
A flicker of determination flashed in Yarrow’s eyes.
“Hopefully, it’ll be like that…”
Yucca nodded gently and didn’t say anything more.
Seeing her silence, Yarrow took out her phone and dialed Cade’s number.
“Ring, ring…”
After two rings, Cade answered the call and asked softly, “Yarrow, how’s it going on your side?”
“Father, Mr. Connor has agreed to let the two of us stay by his side, but he doesn’t seem to have the intention of sleeping with us yet. He isn’t the type who’s easily seduced!”
Yarrow said softly.
“It’s okay. As long as Mr. Connor keeps both of you around, it’s a good sign. You two find a way to create opportunities to be alone with him, preferably in a hotel or his house. Dress more provocatively. I believe that any man wouldn’t be able to resist the temptation of the two of you…”
Cade said directly.
“I understand, Father!” Yarrow replied calmly.
“Alright, if there’s nothing else, I’ll hang up. We can’t rush this matter. Once we become anxious, it will make Mr. Connor suspicious…”
Cade continued.
“Okay!”
Yarrow nodded lightly and hung up the phone directly.
…
On the other side, after returning to the classroom, Connor was questioned by Dominic and Spencer.
After all, Yarrow and Yucca’s behavior in the classroom just now was a bit too exaggerated. Connor casually came up with an excuse, saying that Yarrow and Yucca’s father had business cooperation with him, which was why they called him Mr. Connor.
Dominic and Spencer already knew Connor’s identity, so they didn’t show much doubt about his explanation.
The afternoon classes quickly ended.
After school, Yarrow and Yucca did not continue to harass Connor. Instead, they got into a Mercedes-Benz and left the school.
Meanwhile, Connor had a casual meal with Dominic and Spencer at the school cafeteria. Perhaps because they knew Connor was wealthy, they didn’t hesitate to treat him as a free meal ticket, ordering whatever they liked.
He didn’t care about the money at all, and besides, they had treated him to meals before. So, he didn’t mind.
After finishing their meal, they returned to their dormitory, while Connor took a taxi to Jorge’s house.
During this period, he had been busy with other matters and hadn’t come to spar with Jabba. He was worried about his skills deteriorating, so he wanted to come and train with Jabba.
However, when Connor arrived at Jorge’s home, he found that the front gate was locked.
“He’s not at home? Where could an old man like him go?”
He stood at the doorstep, a hint of helplessness flashing in his eyes. He shouted a couple of times into the yard, but there was no response.
“Could he have run away after getting the medicinal herbs?”
He furrowed his brow and muttered to himself. He stood at the door for a while, but there was still no sign of any activity inside the house. he had no choice but to take a taxi back home.
…
After returning to the Royal Villa, he freshened up quickly and gave Thomas a call to get a brief understanding of the situation regarding Subway Line 9.
As Thomas had mentioned before, it was extremely difficult for Connor’s company to compete in this project due to entering the game late.
After the call with Thomas, Connor couldn’t help but feel a sense of helplessness in his eyes. He felt that if things didn’t work out, he would have to seek help from Rachel. It was his last resort, but he didn’t want to go to her unless it was absolutely necessary because that woman was too troublesome.
“Ring… Ring…”
Just as Connor was lying on his bed, preparing to sleep, his phone suddenly rang. He couldn’t help but pause when he heard the ringtone and then picked up the phone to take a look. It was an unfamiliar number.
After hesitating for a moment, Connor directly answered the call.
“Hello?”
“Connor, is that you?”
A voice full of excitement came from the other end of the phone.
“…”
Upon hearing this voice, Connor couldn’t help but pause, then asked softly, “Jaden?”
“Yeah, it’s me…”
Jaden replied happily, then shouted loudly, “I didn’t expect it to be you. My cousin just told me that she saw you interviewing at her company today. At first, I found it hard to believe, but it’s really you. What a coincidence!”
“Hehe, it is quite a coincidence…”
Connor replied with a smile.
Hearing his old classmate’s voice once again, Connor couldn’t help but feel a thousand emotions. After all, Jaden used to be Connor’s best friend. It’s just that they lost contact after the incident with Mandy, and they never got in touch again.
“What are you busy with now?”
Jaden asked cheerfully.
“What else can I be busy with? I’m busy going to school!”
Connor replied casually.
“Right, you should still be in university now. It’s been several years since we last met. I kind of miss you…”
Jaden said in his usual carefree manner.

chapters.title: Chapter 857: High School Classmate
chapters.content:
Chapter 857: High School Classmate
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Connor couldn’t help but smile lightly after hearing Jaden’s words.
It had been so many years, and Jaden still had the same carefree appearance as before.
In Connor’s impression, he was a righteous person with a straightforward personality, and he came from a well-off family.
His parents were both business owners, so their family could be considered middle class.
During high school, he was always eager to help Connor.
And he took the initiative to talk to Connor about their high school days.
But most of the time, it was him doing all the talking, while Connor quietly listened.
After inheriting Steven’s legacy, Connor discovered that his personality had undergone a significant change.
He could no longer speak recklessly as he did before. Now, he had become noticeably more silent and reserved compared to the past.
“Oh, by the way, Connor, are you still with Mandy?”
Jaden hesitated for a moment and asked softly.
“We broke up a long time ago…”
Connor slowly said.
“That’s good…”
Upon hearing this, Jaden shouted in relief and continued, “I always thought you should have broken up with Mandy. I never thought she was a good person. Her eyes changed when she saw someone wealthy. Ordinary people like us couldn’t handle a woman like her. I’m glad you broke up with her…”
“Yeah, I couldn’t handle that kind of woman…”
Connor replied with a smile and continued, “Do you have a girlfriend now?”
“No…”
Jaden sighed softly and continued, “But I have a girl I like now. I’ve been pursuing her for a while, but she hasn’t agreed to be with me…”
“Oh, I see!”
Connor nodded lightly, glanced at the time on his phone, and said softly, “The day after tomorrow is the weekend, and I don’t have classes. How about we meet up?”
“Sure…”
Upon hearing Connor’s words, Jaden immediately agreed and continued, “I heard that there’s a resort in Zalfari next to our Porthampton. They have hot springs and everything. How about we meet there?”
“Sounds good…”
Without hesitation, Connor readily agreed.
“Okay, it’s settled then. I’ll invite our high school classmates, especially those who had a good relationship with both of us. It’s been a long time since I saw them. Let’s have a reunion…”
Jaden enjoyed organizing gatherings, and he had a good relationship with his classmates during school. So he had the contact information of many high school classmates, but Connor did not.
“Alright, you call them out, and I’ll come to meet you guys…”
Connor said with a smile.
“No problem. We’ll keep in touch then…”
Jaden grinned and hung up the phone directly.
After hearing the dial tone from the other end of the phone, Connor sighed deeply and lay on the bed to rest alone.
…
In the blink of an eye, two days had passed.
After packing his luggage, Connor arrived at the bus station and boarded the bus from Porthampton to Zalfari.
Zalfari was located south of Porthampton. Although it was also a city at the municipal level, it was more like a small county town. Most of the people in Zalfari relied on the tourism industry for a living. The city had beautiful scenery, surrounded by mountains and waters, and there were many resorts. Additionally, Zalfari was close to Porthampton, so many people from Porthampton would visit Zalfari for leisure before the weekend.
The bus that Connor was on was also packed with people.
Fortunately, he arrived early, so he had a seat. If he had come later, he probably wouldn’t even have a seat and would have to stand.
Throughout the journey, he kept admiring the scenery outside the window.
After two hours, the bus arrived in Zalfari.
After getting off the bus, he prepared to take out his phone and call Jaden.
But at that moment, he saw several people running towards his location.
And leading the pack was Jaden, the dark-skinned and strong guy who was Connor’s closest friend back in high school.
As soon as Jaden approached, he punched Connor in the chest and loudly exclaimed, “Connor, it’s been so long since we last contacted. Finally, I see you, man!”
“Yeah, Connor, with so many of us, and you being the closest to Zalfari, how could you be the last to arrive? Are you ashamed of yourself?”
Another tall guy shouted along.
This guy was Tobias, the sports committee member in Connor’s class back then. Because their family backgrounds were similar and not very affluent, their relationship was very good.
These two could be considered Connor’s best friends from high school!
“Aren’t you supposed to bring your girlfriend along?”
After noticing that only Tobias and Jaden were present, Connor’s eyes showed a hint of confusion as he asked softly.
“The girls from our class have already arrived and are waiting at the restaurant. It’s too hot today, so I didn’t ask them to come and wait for you…”
Jaden replied with a smile.
“He’s worried his goddess will get a tan…”
Tobias grinned and teased.
“What do you know? It’s called cherishing and valuing beauty. People like you probably won’t be able to find a girlfriend!”
Jaden playfully patted Tobias on the shoulder and laughed.
“Alright, now that everyone is here, let’s not stay here any longer. Let’s hurry over…”
Connor didn’t expect everyone to arrive so quickly, so he felt a bit embarrassed and quickly said to Jaden.
“Let’s get on the car then!”
As Jaden spoke, he took out the car key from his pocket and lightly pressed it, causing a white BMW car’s headlights to illuminate.
“Wow, Jaden, you’re driving a BMW now…”
After seeing the BMW, Connor pretended to be surprised and said with a smile.
“What BMW? It’s a used car I bought from my friend, very cheap. It’s good enough for fooling around with girls, but if someone who knows about cars sees it, they’ll know it’s a worthless piece of junk…”
Jaden didn’t boast to Connor and casually said.
Upon hearing Jaden’s words, he smiled faintly, didn’t say much, and followed Jaden and the others onto the car.

chapters.title: Chapter 858: Roxanne Dwight
chapters.content:
Chapter 858: Roxanne Dwight
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Ten minutes later.
Jaden drove his BMW with Connor and Tobias, arriving in front of a very upscale hotel.
After getting out of the car, Connor briefly assessed the situation inside the hotel.
Having been to many high-end hotels before, he could immediately tell that this hotel must be expensive.
So he softly said to Jaden, “The expenses here must be quite high. How about we go somewhere else to eat…”
“It’s fine. We finally meet today, so we should have a good meal. Don’t worry, it’s my treat,” Jaden said casually.
Upon hearing his words, Connor couldn’t help but glance at him.
Although Connor knew that Jaden’s family was well-off, he wasn’t exactly a rich heir. A meal in such a hotel would cost at least several thousand dollars, which was not a small expense for a college student like Jaden.
Therefore, Connor began to consider secretly that after the meal, he would discreetly pay the bill when Jaden and the others weren’t paying attention.
After all, that amount of money meant nothing to him, and it felt a bit uncomfortable for him to let others treat him to a meal when they hadn’t been in contact for such a long time.
