“Connor, don’t worry. I have enough money for this. Relax!” Jaden reassured Connor with a smile when he noticed Connor’s silence. He thought Connor was worried about him.
“Okay, let’s eat here then,” Connor nodded lightly.
“Connor, let me tell you, I’ve made some friends in the university club. Those people are true second-generation rich. Each of them drives luxury cars worth millions. Mr. Nikola and I have the best relationship. Mr. Nikola even said he would do business with me in the future. Oh, by the way, his father is Mr. Yakov, Yakov Chakin. You should have heard of him, right?” Jaden said with a smile.
Connor paused for a moment upon hearing Jaden’s words, then furrowed his brow and asked, “Are you talking Nikola Chakin…”
“Exactly, it’s Nikola. Do you know him?” Jaden asked eagerly, his eyes flashing with excitement upon seeing that Connor knew Nikola.
“I don’t know…” Connor shook his head lightly and continued, “I’ve only heard about him from a friend. It seems that Nikola got into some trouble…”
“He did get into trouble, but I don’t know the details!” Jaden’s eyes flickered with a hint of curiosity as he smiled in response to Connor.
As Connor looked at Jaden’s silence, he realized that the Mr. Nikola mentioned by Jaden was clearly Nikola, the one whose leg was broken by Yakov himself on the cruise ship.
Connor knew that a large part of what Jaden was saying to him was bragging. He knew Nikola’s temper and personality very well, and he wouldn’t even spare a glance at someone like Jaden.
Moreover, if he really had a close relationship with Nikola, how could he not attend Nikola’s engagement ceremony? How could he not know that Nikola had become a crippled man now?
However, he didn’t expose Jaden because he knew that Jaden sometimes liked to brag, but he didn’t have any ill intentions. Who wouldn’t want to let their friends know how well they were doing outside? It was understandable.
“Alright, let’s stop chatting and go in,” Tobias cheerfully called out, then took the lead and walked into the hotel.
A moment later, Connor, Tobias, and Jaden arrived at the private room in the hotel, where three girls were already seated.
One of the girls was wearing a blue dress that reached her knees. She looked to be in her early twenties, tall and slender, with a natural and delicate oval face.
Beneath her short skirt were a pair of fair and slender legs, adorned with a pair of sneakers, giving off a youthful and beautiful vibe.
This girl’s name was Wilhelmina Warbucks. Back in high school, her relationship with Connor was relatively good, and she was one of the few girls in the class who didn’t look down on him.
There was another girl, sweet and elegant in appearance, wearing a pair of black-framed glasses and a denim skirt, with a faint smile on her face.
This girl was Yasmin Yale, the class monitor during Connor’s high school days. Although her relationship with Connor was average, it could still be considered cordial.
She had a good relationship with Tobias. During their high school days, rumors often circulated about the two of them being together.
As for whether they were actually together or not, Connor had no idea.
Then, there was the most beautiful girl, with a very sexy figure. She was wearing a white halter dress that perfectly showcased her alluring physique, captivating anyone who laid eyes on her.
Connor believed that this girl was the one Jaden liked.
“Connor, how dare you show your face here! It’s been so long since we last saw you. Why didn’t you keep in touch with us? Let’s see how I’ll deal with you today…” Wilhelmina rushed up to Connor as soon as she saw him, her watery eyes glaring at him.
Her personality had always been like this, similar to that of a boy. Even after such a long time without seeing each other, her character hadn’t changed.
Her personality was closely related to her family background. Her father was a police officer, so she had grown up in a police station. When she was young, she even learned self-defense techniques like taekwondo. Even boys couldn’t match up to her in high school.
“Connor took the initiative to contact us, didn’t he? Let him off the hook…” Jaden quickly reached out to stop Wilhelmina, then turned to Connor and said, “Connor, I won’t introduce you to Wilhelmina and Yasmin, we’re all old classmates. Let me introduce you to a new friend…”
After saying this, Jaden directly pulled Connor in front of the beautiful girl, then smiled and said to Connor, “This is my girlfriend, Roxanne Dwight! Roxanne, this is Connor I often mention to you, my best friend…”
Upon hearing Jaden’s words, Roxanne quickly gave Connor a faint smile and softly said, “Hello, Connor. Jaden often talks about you…”
“Hello, Roxanne”
Connor quickly replied, then took a quick look at Roxanne, but didn’t say anything more.
Although she appeared warm and friendly, Connor could sense that she was quite disdainful of him. However, she concealed it very well, and most people wouldn’t notice it.

chapters.title: Chapter 859: Yelena Is Your Girlfriend?
chapters.content:
Chapter 859: Yelena Is Your Girlfriend?
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Connor felt that Roxanne must have heard about himself from Jaden, so she treated him with such an attitude.
However, he felt that she was not as simple as she appeared on the surface.
Although she looked down on him in her heart, she didn’t show any contempt.
This shows that she was very calculating. With Jaden’s careless personality, he might not be able to handle this woman.
There were many women like this around Connor, so he feels that he was?very accurate in judging women. However, he didn’t say much because it was just the first meeting, and he couldn’t be sure if his judgment was completely accurate.
Moreover, even if it was accurate, these things had nothing to do with him.
After briefly chatting with the three girls, Connor found a seat and sat down.
It didn’t take long before the waiter started serving the dishes.
Perhaps because everyone hadn’t seen each other for a long time, the atmosphere in the private room was still very lively.
While eating and chatting, they reminisced about their high school days.
“Connor, what have you been busy with in college?”
At this moment, Wilhelmina felt that the current Connor seemed a bit different from before, so she asked him proactively.
“Not much, just attending classes and working part-time when I have free time…”
Connor replied briefly to Wilhelmina.
“Have you found a girlfriend?”
Wilhelmina continued to ask while looking at Connor.
“I have…”
Connor nodded lightly and couldn’t help sighing in his heart. Not only did he find a girlfriend, he even found a fiancée, and he still had two lovers.
Of course, Connor couldn’t say these words, and even if he did, these people probably wouldn’t believe him.
“Oh, I didn’t expect you to be so impressive, Connor. You actually found a girlfriend. Do you have a photo? Let me see…”
Upon hearing his words, Wilhelmina’s eyes flashed with surprise. She quickly walked up to Connor and eagerly said.
“I don’t have a photo…”
Connor said with a smile.
“It’s impossible. How can you not have a photo of your own girlfriend? Hurry up and show it to me…”
Wilhelmina pulled Connor and shouted.
After hearing her words, Connor’s expression on his face seemed helpless.
He knew that if he didn’t show the photo now, she would never give up.
So after hesitating for a moment, Connor took out his phone and casually flipped through the photo album.
Connor had never taken a photo with Freya, so there was naturally no photo of her on his phone. However, he found a picture of Yelena, so he handed the phone to Wilhelmina and whispered, “This is my girlfriend!”
Wilhelmina quickly took Connor’s phone and glanced at it. The expression on her face was very surprised. She couldn’t help but look at Connor and said, “Connor, you’re so impressive. You actually managed to get such a beautiful girlfriend…”
“Let me see, let me see…”
Jaden and Tobias also looked curious and snatched the phone from Wilhelmina’s hand. They looked at Connor with envy and said, “Connor, you really hid it well. You managed to win over such a beautiful girlfriend.”
“Yeah, she’s so beautiful, isn’t she?”
Tobias could not help but sigh. Then, he rubbed his nose and said with a puzzled expression,” But why does this girl look so familiar…”
“Ah, now that you mention it, it does seem somewhat familiar to me…”
Jaden exclaimed, then he looked Connor up and down, softly asking him, “Connor, what’s your girlfriend’s name? Do I know her?”
“It’s Yelena!”
Connor didn’t think much and answered directly.
After hearing his words, everyone was momentarily stunned.
“Well, well, Connor, you dare to play a trick on me…”
Wilhelmin reacted and directly punched him on the back, shouting angrily.
“Hahaha…”
Jaden and Tobias laughed along, even Yasmin, who had a cold personality, smiled lightly. Only Roxanne had no reaction at all, quietly eating as if she had no interest in this matter.
Seeing everyone laughing, Connor’s expression became somewhat puzzled, furrowing his brow he asked, “What are you all laughing about?”
“Connor, it’s already this late, and you’re still acting with us? If we didn’t know who Yelena is, we would almost believe it…”
Jaden laughed and replied.
“Yes, Connor, you’ve really changed. I thought Yelena was truly your girlfriend when I saw how serious you were…”
Wilhelmin also pouted and said.
Looking at everyone’s confused faces, he didn’t understand what they meant!
“Connor, Yelena is a famous internet celebrity with millions of fans. Moreover, She seems to have mentioned having a boyfriend a long time ago. You actually lied to us, saying she is your girlfriend. You’re treating us like fools, aren’t you?”
Wilhelmin continued speaking to Connor.
Hearing this, he couldn’t help but smile awkwardly. It was only at this moment that he realized what was going on.
He had forgotten that Yelena was an internet celebrity.
Yelena had five million followers so it was normal for Wilhelmin, Jaden, and Tobias to know her.
“Alright, let’s not tease Connor anymore…”
Jaden didn’t want him to feel embarrassed, so he quickly smiled and changed the subject, then he asked Tobias and Yasmin, “Class monitor, are you and Tobias together or not?”
“Jaden, are you looking for trouble?”
Upon hearing his words, Yasmin raised her chopsticks and was about to throw them at Jaden’s position.
“Yeah, Jaden, if you’re in the mood to care about our affairs, why don’t you tell us how you managed to deceive Roxanne…”
Tobias smiled and said to Jaden.
After hearing his words, Roxanne slowly raised her head, her expression somewhat strange, but she didn’t say anything.
“There’s nothing special about our affairs. We met normally, and then I pursued Roxanne…”
Jaden replied casually, then seemed unwilling to continue discussing this topic. He softly said to Connor, “Connor, come with me to the restroom…”
“Okay!”
Connor nodded gently and got up, following Jaden as they walked out of the private room together.

chapters.title: Chapter 860: Jaden's Problems
chapters.content:
Chapter 860: Jaden’s Problems
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
After leaving the private room, Connor and Jaden went straight to the restroom.
Once inside, Jaden skillfully took out a pack of cigarettes from his pocket and handed one to Connor.
“I don’t smoke…”
Connor shook his head gently as he looked at Jaden.
Jaden smiled and lit his cigarette, quietly taking a puff.
Connor glanced at him and asked softly, “When did you start smoking? I remember you didn’t smoke in high school…”
“I learned in college…”
He replied faintly, then spoke in a low voice, “Connor, actually I lied to you about something earlier…”
“What is it?”
Connor asked with a smile.
“In college, I did meet a group of wealthy second-generation individuals, and they were indeed very wealthy. However, I didn’t have a good relationship with them. I was just a lackey in their eyes. Later, I also met Nikola, but because I made a mistake, Nikola and his group beat me up, slapping me more than ten times in front of many people…”
Jaden whispered to Connor.
After hearing his words, Connor couldn’t help but pause for a moment, then turned to look at him.
He took a deep breath and smiled, saying, “Do you want to ask me why I didn’t fight back?”
Connor continued to look at Jaden without saying anything.
“Do you think I didn’t want to fight back? Actually, at that time, I did want to fight, but I couldn’t. I dared not fight back because I know who Nikola is and what his family does. If I fought back, he would definitely retaliate, and my family might get involved…”
Jaden said in a low voice.
“You shouldn’t have gotten involved with people like Nikola in the first place,” Connor said calmly.
“I was too young and didn’t understand these principles back then, but now I do…”
Jaden nodded slightly and continued, “You don’t have anything now, so just live your own life. But it’s different for me. What do you think of Roxanne?”
Connor looked at Jaden without speaking, unsure of how to evaluate Roxanne.
But he knew that it wouldn’t be easy for Jaden to control her.
“Roxanne is very materialistic and realistic. Her family background is also very good. Do you know the condition she gave me to be with her?”
Jaden didn’t wait for him to answer that question and continued speaking.
“I don’t know…”
Connor shook his head.
“The condition Roxanne gave me is that by the time she turns twenty-five, I need to have assets of over five million. You should know my family background. It’s impossible for me to have five million in assets before I’m twenty-five. So I can only choose to try and integrate into the circle of people like Nikola. Maybe if they’re happy, they’ll bring me some money, and then I might have hope. Otherwise, I won’t have any hope at all. But I was too naive in thinking about all this. I was really ridiculous…”
Jaden threw the cigarette butt on the ground and continued, “If I don’t meet Roxanne’s condition by the time I’m twenty-five, she will choose to break up with me. I used to look down on you when you were with a woman like Mandy. I thought she was just a woman, and it wouldn’t turn you into what you’ve become. But now I see how similar I am to the old you, and I’m even more miserable. I know exactly what kind of woman Roxanne is, but I can’t live without her…”
Connor reached out and patted his shoulder, then said softly, “I don’t know much about your situation, and I don’t want to judge. But I hope you can realize sooner that if something isn’t meant for you, it’s not meant for you. Roxanne is demanding five million from you now, and there may be more demands in the future. Will you be able to fulfill them all?”
Jaden took a deep breath and nodded gently, saying, “I understand what you mean…”
“By the way, I already took care of Nikola for you. I broke both his legs…”
Connor said expressionlessly.
Upon hearing his words, Jaden couldn’t help but pause for a moment, then looked at Connor and smiled lightly, saying, “Connor, it feels so much better when you say that. In my eyes, it’s just a joke.”
After all, who was Nikola? He was Yakov’s son!
And Connor was just an ordinary student. Even if Connor dared to hurt Nikola, Jaden would find it hard to believe.
So Jaden felt that Connor was only comforting himself by saying these things.
After hesitating for a moment, Connor decided not to explain anything.
Because once he started explaining, things would become very complicated.
So he simply said, “Jaden, I don’t think you and Roxanne are suitable for each other. It’s really not worth pushing yourself to such extremes for this woman…”
“Connor, do you remember how I advised you when you were with Mandy?”
Jaden asked with a smile.
Connor paused for a moment upon hearing Jaden’s words, then smiled lightly and said in a soft voice, “You’re right. Some things you can only see clearly and understand when you figure them out yourself. No matter what others say or advise, you can’t take it in. I hope you can realize it sooner…”
“I hope I’ll have that realization someday!”
Jaden nodded, then hugged Connor’s shoulder and continued, “I haven’t told anyone these things before. I told you today, but please don’t tell anyone else, alright?”
“Don’t worry, I won’t tell anyone…”
Connor smiled lightly.
“Okay then, let’s go back…”
Jaden said softly to Connor.
“Alright…”
Connor nodded gently, then followed Jaden as they walked out of the restroom.

chapters.title: Chapter 861: Meeting Sabrina
chapters.content:
Chapter 861: Meeting Sabrina
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
After returning to the private room, Connor and Jaden didn’t mention the incident that just happened. Instead, they went back to their seats and chatted with Wilhelmina, Tobias, and others while eating.
During their conversation, most of the topics were about their high school days and the things that happened in school. Connor wasn’t very interested in those matters, so he didn’t say a word from beginning to end, quietly listening.
After half an hour, they had almost finished eating.
“Jaden, what are your plans next?” Wilhelmina put down her chopsticks and asked Jaden softly.
Jaden took out his phone, checked the time, and said softly, “It’s not even noon yet. Let’s drive directly to the resort. There are many fun things to do there. We can stay at the resort for two nights and leave on Monday. How about that?”
“I have no problem. I don’t have classes on Monday anyway…” Wilhelmina nodded directly.
“I’m fine too…” Tobias said with a smile.
“What about you, Connor? Do you have any plans?” They were concerned about Connor’s schedule because previously Jaden had mentioned leaving the resort on Sunday, but now they planned to stay until Monday, so they were worried if it would be inconvenient for Connor.
“I’m fine too…” Connor said with a smile.
“Great, let’s go then!” Jaden shouted happily and led everyone towards the exit of the hotel.
Jaden and the others walked ahead, while Connor followed behind them.
“Connor…” But just as Connor was about to walk out of the hotel, he suddenly heard someone calling his name from behind.
Upon hearing these words, he couldn’t help but pause for a moment, then quickly turned around to take a look. It turned out to be Sabrina, Sadie, and Yara.
“Connor, it’s really you!” Sabrina’s eyes lit up with excitement when she saw Connor turn around. She quickly ran to his side.
She looked very beautiful, wearing a tight black miniskirt on her upper body. Her sexy figure appeared particularly charming under the skirt. Her long and fair legs were wrapped in black stockings, and she was wearing a pair of high heels. With her delicate face and black wavy curly hair, she exuded an indescribable allure.
Jaden, Tobias, Wilhelmina, and the others were all stunned when they saw Sabrina. Their expressions were filled with disbelief because they couldn’t understand when Connor had met such a beautiful goddess.
On the other hand, Sadie and Yara stood at a distance, looking at Connor with disdainful expressions, as if they had no intention of coming over to talk to him.
“Connor, how come you’re here? What a coincidence! I can’t believe I ran into you here…” Sabrina asked excitedly.
“I came with my friends. What about you? How come you’re here too?” Connor replied with a smile.
“I came with Sadie and the others…” Sabrina answered, her eyes showing a hint of surprise.
Actually, she had planned to invite him to come along, but Sadie and Yara disagreed with bringing him. So she didn’t invite him, but she didn’t expect to meet him here in the end.
“Connor, who is this beautiful girl? Why don’t you introduce her to us?” Jaden walked over to Connor and asked cheerfully.
Connor hesitated for a moment, then quickly introduced Sabrina to Jaden, Wilhelmina, and the others.
Since they were all young people still in school, it was easy for them to get along.
Sabrina glanced at Connor lightly and asked him softly, “Connor, are you guys planning to go to the hot springs resort?”
“Yes, are you also going there?” Jaden replied eagerly.
“Yes, we’re also going there!” She nodded quickly, then turned and glanced at Sadie and the others, whispering to Connor, “Since we’re all going to the resort, why don’t we go together…”
After hearing her words, Connor’s eyes flickered with hesitation.
But Jaden took the lead and said, “Sure, since we have such good fate, let’s go together…”
“Connor…”
Sabrina called out to Connor when she saw that he didn’t speak.
“Okay, since everyone is going to the resort, let’s go together!” Connor nodded gently.
“Then let me tell Sadie and the others…” Sabrina happily replied, then turned and ran to Sadie, Yara, and the others, telling them about the plan to go to the resort with Connor.
He could feel that Sadie was initially reluctant, but she reluctantly agreed later on.
“Sabrina, are you guys done yet?”
Just then, Harold, Sheldon, and the others walked into the hotel and called out to Sabrina and the others.
After Harold finished speaking, he subconsciously turned his head and glanced at Connor and the others standing at the door.
When Harold saw Connor, his eyes showed a hint of surprise, but he didn’t say anything.
After hesitating for a moment, Sabrina whispered to Harold, “Harold, Connor and the others are also going to the resort. Why don’t we go together?”
“Heh…”
After hearing these words, Harold couldn’t help but sneer, then said indifferently, “Sure, let’s go together…”
At this moment, he didn’t seem as arrogant and domineering as before, but his gaze towards Connor still carried a strong disdain.
After a brief discussion among Connor and the others, they prepared to go to the resort with Sabrina and the others.
As for Jaden, Tobias, and the others, they had no idea about the relationship between Connor and Harold, Sheldon. They simply considered these people as Connor’s friends and didn’t think much about it.
The group of people left the hotel in a grand manner.
Upon arriving at the hotel entrance, Harold took out his car key and walked to a Ferrari 911, opening the door.
Others also took out their car keys, opened the doors, and prepared to get in the cars.
When Jaden saw the luxury cars that Harold and Sheldon were driving, he was dumbfounded because any of those cars would cost over two million.
Even Roxanne’s eyes showed a hint of surprise because she didn’t expect Connor’s friends to be so wealthy.

chapters.title: Chapter 862: Not Even Friends
chapters.content:
Chapter 862: Not Even Friends
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
“I didn’t expect that this friend of yours, who looks quite ordinary, would actually know so many rich heirs…”
Roxanne, seeing Harold, Sheldon, and the others get into the car, had a shocked expression on her face. She couldn’t help but whisper to Jared.
Upon hearing this, Jared paused for a moment and furrowed his brows, asking, “Do you know these people?”
“Yes, I’ve seen them before at my best friend’s birthday party. The person named Harold is from the Phillips family, and the other one named Sheldon, his father seems to be the deputy mayor. All of these people are well-known rich heir in Porthampton. It’s not easy for your friend to know them…”
Roxanne had some knowledge about the situation in Porthampton.
In addition, Roxanne herself was quite materialistic, so she naturally understood the ways of rich heirs like Sheldon and Harold.
“I see!”
Jared nodded slightly after hearing Roxanne’s words but didn’t say much.
Harold, Sheldon, and the others came by car, and Jared himself had a BMW car. Wilhelmina was also driving a yellow Volkswagen sedan today. So Connor, Tobias, Roxanne, and Jared sat in Jared’s BMW, while Wilhelmina sat with Yasmin in the Volkswagen.
After everyone got in the cars, Harold, Sheldon, and the others directly drove towards the location of the hot spring resort.
Perhaps due to Sabrina’s influence, Harold and Sheldon didn’t provoke Connor this time or even talk to him. They seemed to completely ignore Connor and his group, treating them as if they were invisible.
But Connor felt it was fine this way, after all, Jared, Tobias, and the others were present, so he didn’t want to have conflicts with Harold, Sheldon, and their group.
“Have your friend arranged everything at the resort?”
Sheldon, sitting in the passenger seat, whispered to Harold who was driving.
“Don’t worry, my friend knows the owner of the resort, and their relationship is good. So everything there has already been arranged…”
Harold replied casually.
“That’s good. How do you plan to deal with Connor and his friends?”
Sheldon had been holding a grudge against Connor since they had a one-on-one fight at the school and lost face. He had been seeking an opportunity to get back at Connor.
It could be said that Sheldon’s hatred for him was no less than that of Harold.
“Heh, Connor…”
After hearing this, Harold couldn’t help but sneer and said indifferently, “I investigated Connor’s background recently and found that he’s quite interesting. His relationship with my cousin, Madison, is not ordinary…”
“Does that mean Connor is pursuing Sabrina while also pursuing your cousin?”
Sheldon was stunned for a moment, wearing an incredulous expression as he asked Harold.
“I’m not sure, but based on the information I gathered, Connor’s relationship with my cousin is definitely not just that of ordinary friends. But as for the exact nature of their relationship, I’m not very clear…”
Harold said casually.
Sheldon hesitated for a moment while looking at Harold, then whispered, “If Connor’s relationship with your cousin is really extraordinary, it might not be that simple to deal with him. We should discuss it carefully…”
“It’s alright. In a few days, my father will be promoted. By then I wouldn’t be afraid of Connor or the Phillips family!”
Harold said in a low voice.
Sheldon’s expression became somewhat solemn upon hearing Harold’s words, but he smiled and remained silent.
Because of their backgrounds, there was little difference between Harold and Sheldon. Harold’s father only managed to secure his position with the help of the Phillips family’s connections.
By that time, Harold would indeed be able to ignore the Phillips family’s influence and gradually widen the gap between himself and Sheldon and the others.
Furthermore, with the help of his father, Harold’s future path would undoubtedly be smooth sailing. However, Sheldon might not have it as easy.
Although Harold and Sheldon appeared to have a good relationship on the surface, they had always been secretly competing with each other.
“After we arrive at the resort, I’ll find an opportunity to teach Connor a lesson. I want him to realize the gap between him and me. I have no mood to waste time with someone like Connor!”
At this moment, Harold spoke again.
“Alright…”
Sheldon nodded lightly, without saying much.
As the other two rich heirs listened to Harold and Sheldon’s conversation, they couldn’t help but feel sorry for Connor in their hearts. They couldn’t understand how bold Connor was to offend Sheldon and Harold.
…
On the other side, in Jaden’s car.
Jaden, seemingly absent-minded, asked Connor while driving, “Connor, what’s your relationship with Sheldon, Harold, and the others?”
Upon hearing Jaden’s question, Roxanne couldn’t help but turn her head and glance at Connor, as if she was also curious about the relationship between Connor and these people.
Connor paused for a moment after hearing Jaden’s question, then softly said, “Actually, it’s nothing. I’m friends with Sabrina, and Sheldon, Harold, and the others are friends of Sabrina. But I can’t even be considered their friend…”
Roxanne’s expression appeared somewhat disappointed upon hearing his words. She immediately took out her phone and started playing with it, as if she wasn’t very interested in the upcoming conversation between him and Jaden.
Jaden nodded while looking at Connor and smiled, saying, “No wonder you suddenly know so many rich second-generation individuals. That’s how it is!”
“Even if I wanted to get to know them, those rich heirs wouldn’t pay attention to someone like me…”
Connor said lightly.
“That’s true…”
Jaden nodded and continued to ask Connor, “By the way, what’s your relationship with that beautiful girl? It seems like there’s a story between the two of you!”
“What story? Sabrina and I are just ordinary friends. Besides, I already have a girlfriend. Don’t think too much…”
Connor replied with a slightly helpless expression.
“Hehe…”
Jaden chuckled and then continued, “It would be great if you could become a couple with Yelena. I think she’s quite good…”
Connor looked at Jaden with a helpless shake of his head and didn’t say much.

chapters.title: Chapter 863: Teach a Person a Lesson?
chapters.content:
Chapter 863: Teach a Person a Lesson?
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
One hour later.
The group drove to the famous hot spring resort in Zalfari.
At the entrance of the resort, there were parked over a dozen luxury cars, and a large group of well-dressed young men were waiting while smoking.
“Oh my god, who are these people? They actually drove so many sports cars here, and each one is a limited edition…”
Roxanne unconsciously glanced out of the car window, her expression becoming incredulous.
After hearing her words, Jaden’s eyes flashed with a hint of helplessness, but he didn’t say much.
The reason why Jaden bought this BMW was all for Roxanne.
Because she felt that if her boyfriend didn’t even have a car, it would be too embarrassing.
Although Jaden’s family had some money, they only gave him a few hundred thousand and told him to buy any ordinary car.
But for the sake of face, she eventually persuaded him to buy a used BMW.
In the end, he could only do as she wished.
However, even after he bought the BMW, she was still not satisfied. She believed that truly wealthy people should drive cars like Ferraris and Rolls-Royces, not a used BMW.
Women like Roxanne were like Mandy back then.
Once the gate of desires is opened, there was no way to close it.
When Harold, Sheldon, and others saw the luxury cars at the entrance of the resort, they stopped their cars and got out, opening the doors and stepping out.
Seeing everyone getting out of the car, Jaden naturally stopped his car as well.
At this moment, Jaden’s and Wilhelmina’s cars, in front of these luxury cars, looked somewhat out of place.
Roxanne had been looking at those rich second-generation guys with an envious look from the beginning. Even though Jaden reminded her with his eyes twice, she still didn’t react.
After getting out of the car, Harold led Sheldon and walked towards the rich heirs.
One of the leading young men walked directly in front of Harold and enthusiastically shouted, “Mr. Harold, why did you just arrive? I’ve been waiting for you for half an hour…”
“Didn’t I tell you not to wait for me here?” Harold replied lightly.
“Damn, if Mr. Harold came in person, how could I not come out to greet you…” The young man replied loudly, then turned around and shouted to the people behind him, “Guys, this is the Mr. Harold I told you about. His father is General Phillips of Davenport…”
“General Phillips’s son?”
“That’s quite impressive…”
“Yeah, I didn’t expect us to actually know General Phillips’s son. We’ll have to walk with our heads held high from now on, right?”
The group started whispering among themselves when they saw Harold’s position.
At this moment, the gazes of these people looking at Harold were filled with shock, and the several beautiful women accompanying these rich second-generation guys also cast seductive eyes on Harold.
Harold was already very handsome, tall and well-built, and his background was also astonishing. Naturally, he could attract the attention of many beautiful women.
“It’s really General Phillips’s son, that’s impressive.” Even Roxanne couldn’t help but exclaim, then subconsciously turned her head to look at her boyfriend Jaden, her eyes flashing with a hint of helplessness.
Jaden had been staring at Harold’s position. Naturally, he didn’t notice Roxanne’s expression, but Connor did notice Roxanne’s gaze.
Connor knew deep down that women like Roxanne were only settling for someone like Jaden because they hadn’t found a more suitable candidate yet. Once Roxanne found a better match, she would undoubtedly abandon Jaden without hesitation.
Therefore, Connor was somewhat worried about Jaden. He feared that Jaden wouldn’t be able to handle the situation when the time came.
Upon hearing the young man’s words, Harold’s expression seemed somewhat helpless, and he murmured, “Didn’t I tell you not to spread such things? Whether my father can be promoted or not is still uncertain…”
“Ah, isn’t it just a matter of time before your father gets promoted? Once he’s promoted, who in Davenport would dare to provoke you? Besides, these people are my friends. Don’t worry, no one will spread rumors…”
The young man replied with a smile and then greeted Sheldon and introduced his friends to him.
Upon learning Sheldon’s identity, the expressions on everyone’s faces seemed even more astonished.
“Alright, let’s not stand here foolishly. Let’s go inside quickly…”
The young man cheerfully shouted at Sheldon, Harold, and the others.
“Okay…”
Harold nodded lightly and walked directly toward the resort.
On the other side, Sabrina voluntarily walked up to Connor and started chatting with him while leading Connor and the others into the resort.
Sabrina knew that if they entered with Harold and the others, Connor and his group wouldn’t have to pay for the entrance tickets.
After all, the entrance fee for this resort was not cheap, costing two thousand dollars per person.
Moreover, that was just the ticket price. If they wanted to enjoy other services in the resort, additional fees would apply. So Sabrina was being kind-hearted.
However, when Harold saw Connor getting close with Sabrina, he flashed a trace of anger in his eyes. Then he turned to the young man beside him and said, “After we arrive at the resort, I hope you can help me teach someone a lesson…”
“Teach someone a lesson?”
The young man couldn’t help but pause upon hearing this.
“Yes, there’s a kid who wants to steal my woman. I want you to give him a good lesson. Is there a problem?”
Harold asked in a low voice.
“Hehe, if it were something else, I might not be able to help you. But this matter, I don’t have a problem with it. Rest assured, I’ll take care of this little thing…”
The young man smiled and replied.
“That’s good…”
Harold nodded lightly.
After hesitating for a moment, the young man turned his head and took a look. He realized that Harold had brought quite a few beautiful women this time.
Whether it was Sabrina, Sadie, Yara, Roxanne, or Wilhelmina, each one of them could be considered a beauty.
So the young man asked Harold, “Which girl are you interested in?”
“The one in the white dress with the longest legs…”
Harold said casually.
“Hehe, she’s indeed not bad. Great figure and attractive appearance. I’m feeling a bit tempted just looking at her…”
The young man chuckled.
“Her dad is Charles Zieglar!”
Harold said expressionlessly.
Upon hearing this, the young man instantly froze in place.

chapters.title: Chapter 864: Mr. Leroy
chapters.content:
Chapter 864: Mr. Leroy
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
“Charles?”
Upon hearing Harold’s words, the young man froze in place, his expression filled with shock.
He stammered, “You’re not joking with me, right? You’re talking about Charles from Porthampton?”
“That’s right, it’s the same Charles who fought with Thomas to the death. Do you have the guts to pursue her?”
Harold turned his head and glanced at the young man, teasingly asking him.
The young man blinked at Harold, then awkwardly smiled and said, “Um… I think I may not be up to her standards. You’re probably the only one who can match her. I’d better give up…”
“Hehe…”
Harold chuckled lightly without saying much.
“So, the one standing beside Sabrina is your rival, right?”
After hesitating for a moment, the young man asked Harold in a soft voice.
“That’s right!”
He nodded without hesitation.
“Heh, I didn’t expect this guy to have some guts. He dares to snatch a woman from you. Who is he?”
The young man asked cautiously.
“He has no background, just an ordinary person!” Harold said casually.
“Well, then there’s no problem. Even if he has some skills, I don’t believe he has the courage to go against Leroy.”
A trace of ruthlessness flashed in the young man’s eyes, and he spoke softly.
“This guy has some skills, so you better be careful!”
Harold suddenly remembered the incident where Connor defeated Sheldon, so he reminded him in a low voice.
“Hehe, what can he do with just some skills?”
Upon hearing this, the young man sneered disdainfully, then continued, “Do you know who owns this resort?”
“Who?”
Harold asked.
“This resort belongs to Jaxon, the boss of San Antonio. It’s currently managed by Leroy, Jaxon’s son. After I found out you were coming, I directly contacted Leroy…”
The young man spoke with a proud tone.
“Jaxon’s son, Leroy?”
When Harold heard these words, a hint of astonishment flashed in his eyes.
“Yes, you should know who Jaxon is. He practically rules San Antonio. As long as things don’t go too far, people won’t easily offend Jaxon. My father has business cooperation with Jaxon, so I had the opportunity to meet Leroy…”
The young man paused for a moment, then looked at Harold and continued, “This resort belongs to Leroy, so even if Connor is skilled, what can he do? I don’t believe Connor has the guts to go against Leroy…”
“That’s good…”
After hearing the young man’s words, Harold nodded lightly.
“By the way, you should get to know Leroy. I believe he will take over his father’s business in the future, so it won’t hurt to have some contact with him!”
The young man reminded him in a low voice.
“I will probably be developing in the military district in the future, so I won’t have many chances to interact with Leroy. Besides, these people have dark backgrounds. It’s not good for me to get too close to them…”
Harold replied expressionlessly. Then, he turned to look at Sheldon beside him and said softly to him,”Sheldon, you can interact more with this Leroy. After all, the two of you will definitely have many opportunities to meet in the future. Although he is not from the same province as us, there is no harm in getting to know him!”
“Yes!”
Sheldon nodded his head gently and did not say anything.
A few minutes later, Connor, Jaden, and the others followed Harold, Sheldon, and the others into the resort.
This resort was very famous in the four provinces. It could be considered the most luxurious resort. It was surrounded by mountains and rivers, and the natural lake in the middle was especially well protected. Basically, one could see the bottom of the lake at a glance. It was crystal clear and very beautiful.
Therefore, there were still many guests who came to this resort to play, especially on weekends. The resort was basically full of people, and some people could not even book a hotel.
From this, one could see how profitable this resort was. Otherwise, a big boss like Jaxon would not have invested hundreds of millions to build such a resort.
A moment later, Connor and the others finally entered the resort.
After everyone entered the resort, they were instantly attracted by the scenery inside the resort. A few girls took out their phones and started taking selfies.
“Connor, I didn’t expect your friends to be so powerfil. We didn’t even need to buy tickets to come in. I heard that the tickets for this place are not cheap…”
Jaden walked up to Connor and said with a smile.
“Not only do you not need to buy tickets, but I also had Harold arrange rooms for all of you. Otherwise, you definitely wouldn’t be able to book any rooms…”
Sabrina turned her head and glanced at Jaden, smiling.
“Is that true?”
Jaden was surprised when he heard this and asked with a somewhat incredulous expression.
“Of course it’s true…”
She quickly nodded at Jaden.
“Then I have to thank you, Miss Sabrina, very much…”
Jaden, upon hearing her words, smiled happily.
“No need to thank me. You are all Connor’s friends, and that means you are my friends too…” she?said shyly to Jaden.
When he saw her appearance, he hesitated for a moment and continued to ask, “Miss Sabrina, what exactly is your relationship with Connor?”
“Connor and I are just friends!”
Sabrina quickly replied.
“Oh…”
Jaden nodded meaningfully and didn’t say much.
On the other side, as soon as the young man and Harold, Sheldon and others entered the resort, they saw a man walking towards them.
The man was wearing an Armani suit, a Rolex watch on his wrist, handsome and extraordinary in appearance, with a faint smile on his face.
When Penn, the young man beside Harold, saw this man, a hint of shock flashed in his eyes. He quickly walked up to him and nervously said, “Mr. Leroy, why did you come out?”
“Aren’t you the one who said these people are all your friends? I naturally have to give you some face…” Mr. Leroy?replied indifferently to Penn.
“Thank you, Mr. Leroy, thank you, Mr. Leroy…”
Penn’s eyes flashed with excitement, then he quickly turned to Harold and the others and said, “Mr. Harold, Mr. Sheldon, this is the Mr. Leroy that I just mentioned…”

chapters.title: Chapter 865: Can’t You Have A Little Ambition?
chapters.content:
Chapter 865: Can’t You Have A Little Ambition?
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
After hearing these words, Harold took the initiative to walk up to Leroy and greeted him.
Although Leroy was not very old, his attitude was extremely arrogant, giving off an air of dominance.
Among so many people, he was only interested in Sheldon and Harold. As for the others, he didn’t even bother to look at them.
So after exchanging a few words with Harold and Sheldon, he said expressionlessly, “Alright, let’s all go in!”
Originally, Jaden had planned to take this opportunity to get to know Leroy, who came from a wealthy family.
But he never expected that Leroy didn’t even pay attention to him, which made him feel a little disappointed.
When Roxanne saw these rich heirs, she couldn’t help but notice the gap between them and her boyfriend.
As a result, the way Roxanne looked at Jaden underwent a significant change.
As for the rest, they were not very interested in these rich heirs, so they had no intention of talking to them.
After entering the resort, everyone discovered that the scenery inside was indeed beautiful, giving a feeling of a beach as if they had arrived in a foreign land. The girls were naturally happy when they saw the scenery in the resort, as this was the perfect place for taking photos. Photos taken here would undoubtedly be very beautiful.
Penn took the initiative to introduce the situation inside the resort to everyone. The resort’s biggest attraction was the central freshwater lake and the primitive forest behind it. It was said that hunting services were also available in the primitive forest, but none of the people present were interested in hunting. Most of the girls preferred to go swimming or diving in the freshwater lake.
Moreover, the resort had more than a dozen water villas, each built on the surface of the lake, with walls made entirely of glass, giving the impression of transparent little islands.
These water villas could be considered the biggest highlight of the resort. Every year, there were a large number of tourists who came to these villas to take photos and check in.
Of course, the price to stay in such villas was very high.
The resort also provided a variety of free food for visitors, offering a wide range of delicious dishes!
This was also why the tickets for the resort were so expensive.
After listening to Penn’s explanation, everyone was shocked.
Because they never expected that in such a small resort, there would be such a diverse range of services, giving a very high-end feeling.
Especially for Tobias and the others, they were even more excited. After all, as ordinary people, they never had the opportunity to visit such places.
Connor, on the other hand, remained calm. Although the resort was luxurious, there was still a certain gap compared to Immortal Lake Manor, so he didn’t show too much excitement.
After briefly observing the environment inside the resort, Sheldon softly said to Leroy, “Mr. Leroy, you must have invested a lot of money in such a large resort, right?”
“My father initially invested five hundred million, and then he thought it was not enough, so he continued to invest another hundred million…”
Leroy replied casually.
“It seems that only Mr. Leroy can come up with so much money…”
Sheldon said with a smile.
“Haha, my father started this resort just for his retirement. It’s only temporarily open now because it’s basically impossible to make money relying on these tourists!”
Leroy said arrogantly.
Everyone’s expressions were filled with disbelief after hearing Leroy’s words.
Originally, everyone thought that the Jovi family established such a large resort to make money. After all, that would be the normal assumption.
But no one expected that their purpose for building this resort was simply for their own retirement.
Retiring in such a resort was the ultimate dream for many people!
So almost everyone looked at Leroy with envy in their eyes.
But Leroy didn’t pay much attention to the envious gazes from others. After all, he was already accustomed to being looked up to.
“Now I’m the one in charge of this resort. If you have any needs, just talk to the manager and mention my name…”
Leroy said casually to Harold and Sheldon.
“Mr. Leroy, you’re being too polite…”
Sheldon replied with a smile.
“No worries, we’re all friends. I have some other matters to attend to, so I won’t accompany you for now. I’ll treat you to dinner tonight!”
Leroy patted Sheldon’s shoulder and walked away.
As everyone watched Leroy’s figure, they were filled with mixed emotions.
Among all these people, only Leroy could be considered a true rich heir. He was around the same age as them, but he was already managing such a large resort on his own. Among the others, only Harold could be compared to him, while the rest were still students. The gap between them was evident.
As Sheldon looked at Leroy’s departing figure, a hint of surprise flashed in her eyes. This trip made Sheldon realize that there were many people in society who were far superior to him.
And yet, Sheldon was still focusing his attention on someone like Connor.
What could a person like Connor amount to?
Sheldon felt that he should broaden his perspective!
“Everyone, Leroy has already arranged your rooms. Please follow me!”
Just at that moment, a middle-aged manager in a black suit walked up to Harold and the others with a smile.
“Great!”
Harold nodded lightly and followed the manager to the guest room area.
Since Sabrina had already informed Harold about Connor and the others, Leroy naturally arranged rooms for them as well.
After knowing their room numbers, everyone took their keys and entered their rooms.
Jaden and Roxanne shared a room together.
“I didn’t expect the rooms here to be so luxurious…”
After entering the room, Jaden took a quick look at the environment inside.
He originally thought that these rooms would be basic and not very nice, considering they were staying for free.
But to Jaden’s surprise, the rooms were exceptionally clean and luxurious, comparable to five-star hotels.
“Luxurious? Can’t you have a little ambition, Jaden?”
Roxanne threw her bag onto the bed and gave Jaden a displeased glare. Her tone was filled with anger.

chapters.title: Chapter 866: Roxanne’s Plan
chapters.content:
Chapter 866: Roxanne’s Plan
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
After hearing Roxanne’s words, Jaden couldn’t help but be stunned for a moment. The expression on his face was a little puzzled.
“Roxanne, what’s wrong?” he asked in a low voice.
“What’s wrong?” Roxanne sneered, then looked at Jaden and shouted, “Jaden, are you really stupid, or are you pretending? Can’t you tell that the room we’re staying in now is the worst room in the entire resort?”
“The worst room?”
A strange look flashed across Jaden’s eyes.
Jaden had thought that the room was pretty good, but he didn’t expect Roxanne to be dissatisfied with it.
“I think the environment of this room is quite good. Moreover, we don’t have to spend money. It’s fine as long as we can stay in it…”
Jaden said in a low voice.
Jaden, are you so useless? You still don’t understand what I said to you just now, right?”
Roxanne shouted with a broken expression, then continued, “When we were assigning rooms just now, Harold, Sheldon and the others were all assigned villas. Even the few women who followed them here got to stay in villas, but we were just given a regular hotel suite.”
Penn Doyle had previously informed them that this resort did have ordinary suites and villas, and that those villas on the water were also the biggest highlight of this resort.
Roxanne, Jaden, and the others had come with Harold and Sheldon, but while everyone else got to stay in a villa and enjoy the best service, Roxanne, and Jagen were staying in the most ordinary suite. Roxanne felt very displeased.
If it weren’t for the fact that she knew that Harold and the others had moved into the villa, Roxanne wouldn’t have reacted so strongly. But now that she knew, she would definitely be unhappy.
After all, Roxanne felt that whether it was her figure or her appearance, she was not inferior to Sabrina, Sadie, and the others. So why was she the only one staying in such a small room and not in a big villa?
Roxanne thought about it for a long time and finally came to a conclusion. It was because she had a useless boyfriend!
Harold and Sheldon could talk and laugh with people like Leroy Jovi, but her boyfriend, Jaden, could not even speak properly.
Moreover, Leroy might not even know Jaden’s name. If not for Connor, they might not even be able to stay in such a room.
Perhaps this was the difference between people. Roxanne felt that she was not bad in all aspects. Why couldn’t she get a boyfriend like Harold and Sheldon? Why would she be with someone like Jaden?
The more Roxanne thought about it, the angrier she became. Naturally, she vented her anger on Jaden.
Jaden also felt very wronged at this moment, because he did not think so much just now.
Originally, Jaden had brought Roxanne to such an expensive resort to make her happy.
However, he never expected Roxanne to get angry before they even started the real fun.
“Roxanne, what do you want?” Jaden hesitated for a moment before asking Roxanne in a low voice.
“I don’t want anything. I just want you to work harder. Why can the others stay in a villa, but we only get this remote and dilapidated room?”
Roxanne replied to Jaden tactfully, but the meaning behind her words was very obvious.
Jaden hesitated for a moment before saying, “Roxanne, I’m going to get you a villa now, wait for me!”
“…”
Roxanne looked at Jaden without saying anything.
Jaden sighed softly and walked out of the room.
Roxanne looked at Jaden’s back with a strange look in her eyes.
At this moment, Roxanne had other thoughts in her heart. She felt that since she had been able to meet so many rich young masters on this trip with Jaden, it was a chance given to her by the heavens.
Needless to say, Harold and Sheldon were top-notch rich heirs. They would definitely not take a fancy to her.
Moreover, from the interactions just now, Roxanne could feel that those two people’s attention was not on her at all. She should not have any chance.
However, Penn Doyle was different. He probably didn’t have a girlfriend yet, and she noticed he would turn his head to look at her from time to time. This meant that Penn must have some feelings for her.
Penn’s background was naturally not as good as Harold and Sheldon, but it was many times better than Jaden’s!
Just from the fact that Penn knew Leroy Jovi, Harold, and Sheldon, who were top-notch rich heirs, it could be seen that Penn was not an ordinary person!
Roxanne felt that since Harold and Sheldon had no chance, she might as well give Penn a try. If she was lucky enough to seduce Penn, then she wouldn’t have been with Jaden for nothing. After all, Jaden had indirectly helped her.
Jaden, who had left the room, naturally did not know what Roxanne was thinking.
He went to the front desk of the hotel alone.
“Hello, sir. How can I help you?”
The receptionist asked Jaden with a smile.
“About that, I want to rent a villa on the water…”
Jaden looked at the price list behind him. The price of a water villa was 50,000 dollars per night, and he and Roxanne needed to stay for two days. That was a whole 100,000 dollars!
This sum of money was not a small amount for Jaden, but he could only grit his teeth and accept it for Roxanne’s sake.
“Sir, I’m really sorry. The villas on the water in our resort are already fully booked. There are no extra villas now. You can choose to leave your contact information. If there are rooms available, we will contact you as soon as possible…”
The beautiful receptionist glanced at the computer and whispered to Jaden.
“No, there’s no need…”
When Jaden heard the beautiful receptionist’s words, he heaved a long sigh of relief and quickly waved his hand to reject her.
In fact, Jaden did not want a water villa at all. The prices were too expensive. 50,000 for one night…he could do so much more with that kind of money.
Therefore, after knowing that there were no rooms, Jaden was still a little happy. This way, he would be able to give Roxanne an explanation, and he wouldn’t have to spend any more money.
As Jaden thought about these things, he returned to his room and took the initiative to tell Roxanne about the lack of rooms.
After Roxanne heard Jaden’s words, she couldn’t help but sneer. Then, she looked at Jaden with a disdainful expression and said, “Jaden, are there no more rooms, or did you not ask at all?”
Jaden looked at Roxanne and froze on the spot.
…

chapters.title: Chapter 867: Mr. Jovi’s Treat
chapters.content:
Chapter 867: Mr. Jovi’s Treat
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
“Roxanne, what do you mean by that?”
Jaden shouted at Roxanne with a straight face, then continued, “If you don’t believe me, you can go out and ask now. See if there’s a room. Do I have to lie to you about this?”
“Forget it. What’s the use of saying this now? If you were really capable, Mr. Jovi would have given you a room long ago. The villas in the resort are full every day, but why can Harold and Sheldon stay there yet you can’t?” Roxanne sat on the bed and ridiculed him with a frustrated expression.
After hearing Roxanne’s words, Jaden’s expression was a little helpless.
After taking a deep breath, he did not say anything else.
Jaden could not help but recall what Connor had said to him before. In fact, sometimes, Jaden himself could feel that he and Roxanne were not very suitable.
Jaden had no way of fulfilling Roxanne’s requests. However, he liked her. He didn’t think he would be able to break up with her now.
“Alright, don’t just stand there. Since there’s no villa, then forget it. It’ll only be for a few days anyway…” Roxanne said. Her thoughts were not focused on Jaden at all, but she did not want to make things too difficult for him.
When Jaden heard this, he couldn’t help but hesitate. Then he muttered, “Roxanne, don’t worry. Although I can’t let you live in a big villa now, I will let you live there sooner or later. Trust me…”
“…”
Roxanne looked at Jaden with disdain and did not say anything.
…
Meanwhile, in Connor and Tobias’s room.
After Connor entered the room, he did not feel that there was anything wrong with the room.
Connor and Tobias were staying in the same room. Both of them were lying on the bed and resting now.
“Connor, I didn’t expect you to be so prestigious as to bring us into the resort for free and also let us stay here for free…” Tobias said while lying on the bed.
“They only gave us rooms because of Sabrina. I’m not familiar with those rich heirs…” Connor hurriedly explained.
“It’s not bad for you to know a fair, rich, and beautiful woman like Sabrina, unlike me…”
Halfway through his sentence, Tobias seemed to have thought of something and asked Connor softly, “Connor, do you think Roxanne and Jaden are really suitable?”
“Not at all…”
Connor shook his head without any hesitation.
“Yeah, I don’t think they’re a good match either!” Jaden hurriedly nodded, then continued, “I think Roxanne is too materialistic. Jaden can’t satisfy her at all. It’s just that I’m too embarrassed to tell Jaden these things…”
“Actually, Jaden himself is also clearly aware about the things you said. However, sometimes, those who are personally involved in the matter are confused. It is useless for outsiders like us to say anything…” Connor said lightly.
“That’s true…”
Tobias nodded gently and continued, “Alright, let Jaden decide on his own. Let’s not worry about him for now. How have you been recently? Do you lack money? Don’t make things too difficult for yourself. I know your situation isn’t good. Although my family’s financial situation is also very ordinary, if you lack money, I can still give you 10,000 or 20,000 dollars…”
These words were from Tobias’s heart. In fact, Tobias had long wanted to tell Connor these things. However, there were many people present at that time, so Tobias could not tell him directly so as to save Connor from embarrassment.
When Connor heard Tobias’s words, he was naturally very touched in his heart. He hurriedly replied, “I don’t lack money now…”
“Really? Come on, what is our relationship? If you’re in trouble, don’t hesitate and just come to me, understand?” Tobias hurriedly said.
“Don’t worry, I really don’t lack money now. If I did, I would definitely tell you…” Connor said helplessly.
“That’s good…”
Tobias saw that Connor did not seem to be lying, so he was relieved and nodded gently. Then, he took the initiative to talk to Connor about his school affairs.
Tobias and Connor had not seen each other for a long time, so they naturally had a lot to talk about.
In the blink of an eye, an hour had passed.
“Ding!”
“Ding!”
At this moment, Connor’s phone suddenly rang.
When Connor heard the ringtone, he quickly took out his phone and saw that it was a call from Sabrina.
So Connor quickly picked up the phone and asked softly, “Sabrina, what’s the matter?”
“Connor, you and your friends should come to the resort hotel for a meal. Mr. Jovi seems to be treating us…”
Sabrina said with a smile.
After hearing this, Connor was stunned for a moment. Then, he frowned and said, “Mr. Jovi is probably just going to treat you guys, no? It seems to have nothing to do with us. It’s better for the us not to go over…”
At this moment, Connor did not want to have too much contact with Harold and Sheldon. He was worried that if Harold and Sheldon hurt Jaden, Tobias, and the others because of him, it would be troublesome.
“Connor, Mr. Jovi said that he wants to treat all of us to a meal. You don’t have to be so reserved. Quickly bring your friend over…” Sabrina quickly continued, “The hotels in this resort are not cheap, you know. If you eat elsewhere, won’t you have to spend money? Then why don’t you eat with us…”
“I’m just worried…”
Connor still wanted to turn the invitation down.
“Come on, what are you worried about? You’re my friend, so they definitely won’t say anything. Moreover, if you don’t come, Mr. Jovi might think that you’re trying to embarrass him…”
Sabrina interrupted Connor.
Connor knew that Sabrina had good intentions, so he naturally could not bear to keep refusing her invitation. He nodded and said, “Alright then. I will bring my friend over in a while…”
“Okay, I’ll wait for you at the entrance of the hotel!”
Sabrina sounded happy whenConnor agreed.
“Alright…”
Connor nodded lightly and hung up the phone.

chapters.title: Chapter 868: Throwing Herself Into His Arms
chapters.content:
Chapter 868: Throwing Herself Into His Arms
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
After seeing Connor hang up the phone, Tobias smiled and asked Connor, “Is Sabrina the girl who wants to invite you to dinner?”
“Not just me. It seems that they want to treat all of us to a meal…” Connor replied indifferently.
“Treat all of us? I didn’t expect this Sabrina girl to be so good. She’s much better than those so-called fair, rich, and beautiful women. Connor, you have to seize this opportunity. I’m telling you, it’s not easy to run into such a good girl!” Tobias said to Connor with a smile.
“How many times have I told you? I already have a girlfriend. You don’t have to worry…” Connor said helplessly.
“Hehe, alright, then I won’t worry about it. I’ll call Jaden and the others…”
Tobias smiled, then put on his clothes and walked out of the room.
Ten minutes later, Connor, Jaden, Tobias, Roxanne, Wilhelmina, and Yasmin arrived at the hotel that Sabrina mentioned.
The hotel where Leroy treated Harold, Sheldon, and the others to a meal was the most luxurious hotel in the entire resort.
Usually, those who could spend money in this hotel were not ordinary people.
Connor and his group arrived at the entrance of the hotel and found that Sabrina and Sadie were already waiting for them.
“Connor!”
Sabrina waved at Connor enthusiastically.
Sadie, on the other hand, was a little cold. She shouted with a straight face, “Alright, we were waiting for all of you. Hurry up and go in!”
After everyone heard Sadie’s words, their expressions were a little awkward, but no one said anything.
A few minutes later, Sabrina and Sadie brought Connor and the rest to the private room.
However, after entering the private room, Connor realized that everyone was not present at the moment—Leroy still wasn’t there.
Connor and the others casually got a seat and sat down. However, because the people brought by Harold and Sheldon did not know Connor and the others, naturally, no one took the initiative to talk to them.
On the contrary, the girls in the private room were chatting non-stop.
Somewere talking about how handsome and rich Leroy was, while others were talking about how beautiful their rooms were and how beautiful the scenery was. They could see the lake directly from their rooms.
Roxanne had only found out that the villa they lived in had a special nanny and swimming pool after hearing their conversations.
She recalled that the room she had gotten only had one bedroom and a pathetically small bathroom and became even angrier. She couldn’t help but glare at Jaden.
Jaden sat on the spot helplessly, not knowing what to do.
Wilhelmina and Yasmin also chatted softly, but they seemed to be very satisfied with their rooms. The two of them knew that since the room was free to stay in, it was already very good for a free room to have such facilities.
“Connor, accompany me to the bathroom for a bit…”
Jaden seemed to think that there was nothing wrong with waiting like this. Moreover, Roxanne was giving him a very strange glare, so he wanted to go to the toilet to smoke a cigarette.
“Alright…”
Connor nodded slightly. Then, he stood up and left the private room with Jaden.
After leaving the private room, Connor seemed to have noticed that there was something wrong with Jaden’s expression, so he took the initiative to ask, “Did something happen? Why do you look unhappy?”
“Actually, it’s nothing much. It’s just a small matter…” Jaden sighed softly and said indifferently.
“What small matter? Tell me…”
Connor looked at Jaden with a faint smile and said softly.
Jaden looked at Connor and hesitated for a moment. Then, he said in a low voice, “It’s actually not a big deal. It’s just that Roxanne is unhappy because everyone else is living in the villa while we’re living in a suite. Just now, when she heard those people talking about how good the environment in the villa is, she must be even more unhappy, so I came here to hide…”
“So that’s how it is!”
Connor looked at Jaden and nodded lightly.
“Connor, Roxanne is actually quite nice. Don’t misunderstand. Women like to compare themselves, so I think it’s normal for her to be unhappy. It’ll be fine once she’s calmed down…”
Jaden seemed to be worried that Connor would misunderstand, so he hurriedly explained the situation.
After Connor heard this, he nodded, but didn’t say anything.
In fact, it was very easy for Connor to open a villa on the water for Roxanne and Jaden. He just needed to give Jaxon Jackel a call. After all, Jaxon was the owner of this resort, and Connor had previously met Jaxon during the martial arts tournament.
However, Connor did not do so because he felt that Roxanne was not suitable for Jaden. If this small matter really caused the both of them to break up, then Connor felt that this was a good thing!
Seeing that Connor wasn’t going to speak, Jaden lit a cigarette and began to puff.
Meanwhile, in the private room, Roxanne was currently winking at Penn, and from time to time, she would even take the initiative to say a few words to him.
Penn saw Roxanne’s expression and naturally didn’t reject her. After all, Roxanne was quite good-looking and had a hot figure, and how many boys could resist such a beautiful woman throwing herself into his arms?
This was doubly so for a rich heir like Penn, who had played with countless women before. Therefore, in the face of such a situation, he naturally reacted this way.
However, Roxanne didn’t know that with her status, it was simply impossible to tie up a rich heir like Penn.
Not all rich heirs were brainless, especially Penn, who was an experienced lover. They knew better than ordinary people what a woman was thinking.
When Wilhelmina, Yasmin, and Tobias saw this scene, a strange look flashed across their eyes.
Wilhelmina, who had a straightforward personality, wanted to say something, but Tobias stopped her. Tobias felt that if Wilhelmina spoke up now, it might make Jaden even more embarrassed, so he might as well pretend that he did not see anything.
Wilhelmina took a deep breath. Her expression was a little helpless, but she didn’t say anything.
“Creak…”
At this moment, the door of the box was pushed open from the outside.
Leroy Jovi strode into the private room with his head held high.

chapters.title: Chapter 869: Thomas Morgan's Boss!
chapters.content:
Chapter 869: Thomas Morgan’s Boss!
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
When everyone saw Leroy enter, they all stood up and greeted him.
Out of all the people present, only Sadie, Sabrina, Harold, and Sheldon did not stand up.
After all, although their backgrounds might not be comparable to Leroy’s, they were still a cut above the others.
“Mr. Jovi, you’re here?”
“Yes, Mr. Jovi, you’re here!”
For a moment, everyone surrounded Leroy and started to take the initiative to chat with him.
After all, now that these people knew Leroy’s identity, it was definitely a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity to build a good relationship with such a rich heir!
Those girls all seemed to want to throw themselves at Leroy.
Even Roxanne wanted to get closer to Leroy. However, there were too many women around him now. Roxanne had no chance at all.
Wilhelmina, Yasmin, and Tobias were speechless when they saw this scene. They didn’t know what to say.
Although the three of them stood up, they were just being polite. They had no intention of fawning over Leroy.
“She’s really shameless. She wants to stick to a rich heir when she sees one… I really don’t know how Jared fell for her…”
Wilhelmina couldn’t help but mutter.
Tobias turned to look at Wilhelmina and said, “Alright, you’d better not say so much. Their matters have nothing to do with us. If Jared hears your words, he’ll be hurt…”
Wilhelmina looked helpless when she heard Tobias’s words, but she didn’t say anything else.
After all, this was Jared’s own business and had nothing to do with her.
Leroy smiled and said to everyone, “Everyone, please sit down. There’s no need to be so reserved. If you’re dissatisfied with our resort, feel free to say it out loud. You’re all friends of Mr. Phillips and Mr. Statton, so don’t be polite with me.”
“Mr. Jovi, you’re too polite!”
“How can we not be satisfied with such a good resort?”
“That’s right, Mr. Jovi, you’re too polite. We’re very satisfied with the environment here!”
After everyone heard Leroy’s words, they hurriedly responded with a smile.
Leroy did not seem to have any intention of continuing to pay attention to these people. Instead, he turned his head and looked indifferently at Harold’s position. He looked at Harold with a smile.
Among all the people present, it seemed that only Harold could make Leroy look up to him. Even Sheldon was slightly inferior.
After all, Harold’s father would soon become the Deputy Chief of War. If Leroy could build a good relationship with Harold, he would definitely benefit a lot.
After hearing Leroy’s words, Harold smiled faintly and said expressionlessly, “Mr. Jovi, your resort is indeed not bad. I like it very much…”
“As long as you don’t think there are any problems, Mr. Phillips…”
Leroy looked at Harold with a faint smile, then sat on the main seat.
Harold and Sheldon sat beside Leroy, followed by Sadie and Sabrina.
Everyone sat down according to their status. Tobias, Wilhelmina, Roxanne, and the others naturally sat at the serving seats, which were also the worst seats.
After Roxanne sat down, her expression was clearly displeased. She then turned to look at Penn.
Penn naturally understood what Roxanne meant. He couldn’t help but smile faintly, then take the initiative to make room for Roxanne.
Roxanne seemed to have already thought of how to break up with Jared. Therefore, she did not feel embarrassed at all and sat beside Penn without any hesitation.
When Tobias saw this scene, a trace of anger flashed across his eyes.
Tobias had never expected Roxanne to be so blatant.
What would Jared and Connor think if they came back and saw this scene?
However, because there were more people at the moment, and most of them were rich kids, Tobias naturally did not dare to say anything. He could only sit on the spot with a helpless expression.
After everyone was seated, the waiter began to serve the dishes.
Since it was Leroy’s treat, the dishes on the table naturally wouldn’t be bad.
Every dish here cost more than 1,000 dollars.
An ordinary person would probably only spend 1,000 dollars on an entire meal, but here, a single dish here might cost more than 1,000 dollars. This was the difference between a rich heir and an ordinary person.
Everyone chatted while eating. However, most of the conversations were related to the upper echelons of the people in charge of the various cities in the country.
Roxanne’s eyes lit up when she heard the contents of their conversation. Her face was filled with yearning.
If she were to be with Jared, she might never be able to come into contact with such big shots in her life.
Roxanne felt that only by interacting with these people could she truly step into the upper class. However, she could not see any future with people like Jared.
This made Roxanne even more determined to break up with him.
At this moment, a young man could not help but ask Leroy, “Mr. Jovi, I heard that a martial arts tournament was held in San Diego some time ago. Your father, Yakov Chakin, Jonathan Steele, Charles Ziegler, and other big shots all attended the tournament. Is that true?”
“I think I’ve heard about this too. It’s said that the boss behind Thomas from Davenport was also present in person. I just don’t know if this news is true!” Harold said expressionlessly.
After hearing this, Leroy nodded his head gently and said with a smile, “Mr. Phillips is quite well-informed…”
“Does that mean Thomas Morgan really has a boss behind him?”
A strange look flashed across Harold’s eyes as he asked that. After all, Thomas was already the richest man in Davenport. For so many years, everyone thought that his businesses were all his own.
They had never thought that Thomas Morgan would have a boss behind him.
So when everyone heard Leroy confirm this matter, a trace of surprise flashed across their eyes.
“The martial arts tournament that you mentioned is actually held every year mainly to solve some business problems in the cities. The big boss of Porthampton is Kyle Hayes, and Thomas himself is not a member of the underground businesses He is a serious businessman, so he went there to watch the show…”
Leroy paused for a moment before continuing, “My father and I went to the martial arts tournament. The boss of the richest man in Davenport, Thomas, also went there…”

chapters.title: Chapter 870: The Legendary Mr. McDonald
chapters.content:
Chapter 870: The Legendary Mr. McDonald
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
“Thomas Morgan’s boss, what kind of big shot is he?”
“Yeah, Thomas Morgan is already the richest man in Davenport. I didn’t expect him to have a boss behind him!”
“His boss is the richest man in Oprana, right?”
When everyone heard Leroy’s words, their jaws dropped and their faces were filled with shock.
Even Sadie’s eyes flashed with surprise.
“Haha…”
Leroy couldn’t help but smile after hearing what everyone said. Then, he continued, “You guys are underestimating Thomas Morgan’s boss. In fact, this person is not only Thomas’s boss, but also Kyle Hayes’s boss. Even Charles Ziegler, who is very famous in Porthampton, is also this person’s subordinate…”
“What?”
Everyone looked at Leroy, the expressions on their faces even more incredulous. Their eyes widened, and they did not know how to describe their feelings.
In the eyes of ordinary people, Thomas Morgan, Kyle Hayes, and Charles Ziegler were people that were difficult to reach.
Thomas Morgan was mainly a tycoon in the business world and had countless businesses all over Davenport. Kyle Hayes was the number one big boss in the underground world and had countless underlings. Everyone who saw him would have to call him Mr. Hayes. As for Charles Ziegler, he might be slightly inferior to the first two, but since Charles could be as famous as Thomas Morgan back then, this was enough to prove that Charles was not an ordinary person.
However, no one expected that there was a boss behind these three people!
How terrifying could this boss be?
Sheldon seemed to be unable to believe it, so he asked with a smile, “Mr. Jovi, are you joking with us?”
“Why would I joke with you? Everyone who participated in the tournament knows about this. You people weren’t qualified to participate, so it’s normal that you wouldn’t know about this inside story!” Leroy retorted expressionlessly.
“Hehe, that’s true!”
Sheldon’s expression was a little awkward. He nodded and did not say anything else.
Yara stared at Sabrina. She said to Sabrina in disbelief, “Sabrina, I didn’t expect your father and Thomas Morgan to have the same boss!”
“…”
When Sabrina heard this, she quickly looked up at Yara and said softly, “Well, I don’t know much about my father’s work either…”
Leroy subconsciously turned his head to look at Sabrina. He knew that Sabrina’s surname was Ziegler, so he asked, “Miss Ziegler, your father is Mr. Charles Ziegler?”
“Yes, he is!” Sabrina nodded.
“I’m really sorry. I actually didn’t recognize you before. My father and your father were very good friends. I often hear my father mention your father…”
Previously, Leroy had only been paying attention to Harold and Sheldon. He thought that Sabrina was just an ordinary rich lady. However, he did not expect Sabrina to be Charles Ziegler’s daughter. At this moment, Leroy looked at Sabrina differently.
Even those who did not know Sabrina were looking at her in shock.
No one had expected that this very normal-looking girl would have such a terrifying background.
Although Charles Ziegler was no longer in Porthampton, his influence was still terrifying.
Roxanne turned her head to look at Sabrina. She had thought that Sabrina was just like her, just a pretty face. However, she did not expect her to have such a powerful background.
Sheldon took the opportunity to introduce Sadie and Yara. Tony Colt was also a big shot in Porthampton, so his identity was obvious. Everyone also knew that Yara’s family also owned a company.
Meanwhile, Wilhelmina and the others had never expected that any of the people Connor knew would have an amazing background. Therefore, they were more or less surprised that Connor knew these people.
At this moment, Penn said to Leroy, “Mr. Jovi, since you’ve seen the boss of Thomas Morgan and Kyle Hayes, can you quickly tell us what this person does?”
“That’s right, Mr. Jovi. We’ve also heard about this person, but we do not know if this matter is true…”
The others followed suit.
After hearing everyone’s questions, a hint of hesitation flashed across Leroy’s eyes. However, he felt that Connor’s identity was not a secret anymore; back then, many people had seen Connor at the martial arts tournament, so everyone here should already know about him.
Moreover, he felt that these people present at the moment should not have much interaction with big shots like Mr. McDonald, so after hesitating for a moment, he said softly, “I don’t know much about Thomas Morgan’s boss. After all, I don’t have the right to interact with such a big shot. However, the big shots in the cities like to call this person Mr. McDonald. I don’t know much about this person. I don’t know who this Mr. McDonald is either. I only know that he is very good at fighting and has a very strong background. Otherwise, he wouldn’t have become Thomas Morgan’s boss…”
After everyone heard Leroy’s words, they could not help but feel a little disappointed.
They could only get one piece of information from Leroy’s words: that Thomas Morgan’s boss was called Mr. McDonald. The rest of the information was basically the same as not saying anything.
“Then Mr. Jovi, what does this Mr. McDonald look like? How old was he? Isn’t he handsome?” Yara asked Leroy curiously.
After all, in the eyes of these people, people like Thomas Morgan could already be considered as an unattainable existence.
However, the Mr. McDonald that Leroy was talking about was actually the boss of Thomas Morgan, Kyle Hayes and Charles Ziegler. This meant that Mr. McDonald must be even more terrifying than those three. They were naturally very curious about such a big shot.
Since they couldn’t get any other information about Connor, they could ask about his appearance and whatnot to satisfy their need to gossip!
Connor, who was outside the private room, did not know that these people were talking about him. Fortunately, Connor did not expose too much information about himself, or everyone in the room would know his identity by now.

chapters.title: Chapter 871: The Gap Between People
chapters.content:
Chapter 871: The Gap Between People
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
“Mr. McDonald’s appearance…”
After hearing Yara’s words, Leroy was stunned. Then, he said with a smile, “You might not believe it, but Mr. McDonald is probably about the same age as us. He might even be a little younger than me…”
“What?” Everyone stared at Leroy in disbelief.
Everyone present felt that the boss of Thomas and Kyle had to be at least thirty years old. It was just that he was called Mr. McDonald because of the way he addressed him.
However, no one expected that this so-called Mr. McDonald was about the same age as them.
For a moment, everyone began to wonder if something was wrong with their ears.
“You don’t have to be surprised. When I found out that Mr. McDonald was Thomas’ boss, it was also very unbelievable. But Mr. McDonald is indeed very young!” Leroy said slowly.
“Is Mr. McDonald handsome?” Yara hurriedly asked.
“With Mr. McDonald’s identity and background, you can completely ignore his appearance, but Mr. McDonald is indeed quite handsome, and Mr. McDonald is also very good at fighting.
