He’s just a bit low-key. If he were placed among ordinary people, you probably couldn’t tell that he’s Mr. McDonald!” Leroy said.
“Not only is he handsome, but he’s also very low-key. He’s simply a perfect man!” Yara shouted with an infatuated look.
“Mr. McDonald is so young, but he is the boss of Thomas and Kyle, and the others. Could he be a young man from a prominent family?” Sheldon frowned.
“It’s said that Mr. McDonald inherited a fortune, and the person who left it to Mr. McDonald should be the previous boss of Thomas and Kyle. As for the relationship between Mr. McDonald and this person, I’m not sure…” Leroy replied.
“I didn’t expect Thomas and Kyle to be from the same company.”
Harold took a sip of beer and said.
“Yeah, but what shocked me the most was Mr. McDonald. I didn’t expect Mr. McDonald to be about the same age as us. I didn’t expect him to have such great ability at a young age. This is too unbelievable…”
“This is not the craziest part. If Mr. McDonald is about our age now, how powerful will he be in the future? This is simply unimaginable!” Sheldon took a deep breath after hearing everyone’s words. Then, he said, “If Mr. McDonald is about the same age as us, then he is very powerful. After all, we have just entered university, and he already has such a big company. Even the big shots in our four provinces are respectful to Mr. McDonald. This gap is really big…” Roxanne looked at the expressions on everyone’s faces and was a little shocked.
Even Sheldon and Harold had a strange look in their eyes when they heard Leroy’s words. Although they could be considered outstanding among their peers, there was still a huge gap between them and the legendary Mr. McDonald.
Moreover, no matter how hard they tried, they might be unable to compensate for this gap.
However, they soon felt relieved. After all, they would never be able to catch up with such a gap in their lives. Therefore, they would not compare themselves too much with such people. They would only compare themselves with people with similar conditions.
Tobias, Wilhelmina, Yasmin, and the others had never heard of Connor’s story. However, they could tell from their reactions that this so-called Mr. McDonald was not ordinary. Otherwise, everyone’s reaction would not be so intense.
Tobias finally realized how big the gap between him and those so-called young men of the upper class was.
Even if they were sitting at the same table for dinner, sometimes they might not understand what they were saying. An ordinary person couldn’t blend into their circle.
In fact, Roxanne felt the same. Sometimes, she seemed so lowly and insignificant before these people!
Even Sabrina, Sadie, Yara, and the others had a decent family background. Other than her pretty face, she had nothing else.
Sometimes, the gap between people was already determined from birth.
‘It would be great if I could get to know someone like Mr. McDonald…’ Roxanne couldn’t help but lament internally.
She felt that it would be great if she could find a boyfriend like Connor. After all, Mr. McDonald was very famous in the four cities. No matter where she went in the future, people would look up to her. She didn’t know how many times better than people like Jaden. Even Penn couldn’t compare with Mr. McDonald.
“Don’t think that Mr. McDonald is just a rich heir. Mr. McDonald is also very powerful. On the day of the martial arts tournament, he defeated many experts. Many big shots in the four cities don’t dare to provoke Mr. McDonald. Even my father is under Mr. McDonald’s command…” Leroy added.
“Your father is also Mr. McDonald’s subordinate?” Penn was stunned for a moment and asked in disbelief.
“Not only my father but all the big shots in the four cities have already submitted to Mr. McDonald. Our Jovi family has to take out ten percent of our profits yearly to show our respect to Mr. McDonald…” Leroy didn’t feel that this was shameful and told everyone about it.
“Ten percent? Everyone was dumbfounded when they heard Leroy’s words and in disbelief.
“Mr. McDonald’s ability is not something you can imagine. Our family takes out ten percent of the profits every year,” Leroy added indifferently.
“Mr. Chakin Sr, must have heard of it!” Sheldon nodded.
“Mr. Chakin Sr. offended Mr. McDonald at the martial arts tournament. Mr. McDonald took away seventy percent of their family’s shares. Mr. Chakin didn’t even dare to say no…” Leroy said to the crowd expressionlessly.
Everyone present was once again dumbfounded when they heard this. They looked at Leroy in a daze, not knowing how to describe their feelings.
“So, if our family takes out ten percent of the profits every year, that’s simply…” Leroy was about to continue speaking when he saw the private room door being pushed open. Connor and Jade walked into the private room.
When Leroy saw Connor, he was instantly stunned.

chapters.title: Chapter 872: The Unbridled Roxanne
chapters.content:
Chapter 872: The Unbridled Roxanne
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Although Leroy did not know Connor’s exact identity, he had seen Connor before at the martial arts tournament.
Therefore, he naturally knew what Connor looked like.
When Connor appeared in the private room, Leroy was instantly dumbfounded.
Leroy was still here telling everyone about Connor but never thought Connor would be here.
Connor had met Leroy at the entrance of the resort.
However, at that time, Leroy focused on Harold and Sheldon. He did not notice the people behind him, so he naturally did not see Connor.
When Leroy saw Connor, he was instantly dumbfounded. He looked at Connor with a dull gaze, not knowing what to do.
Connor knew Leroy. After all, so many people were at the martial arts tournament that day. Connor couldn’t remember everyone.
However, Connor had some impression of Leroy’s father, Jaxon, but he had no impression of Leroy at all.
Leroy stared at Connor with his eyes wide open. He was so nervous that his brain short-circuited. He didn’t know what to say.
Connor naturally found his seat and turned to Wilhelmina, asking, “What are you guys talking about?”
“Connor, Mr. Campbell was telling us about Mr. McDonald of Davenport just now. Do you know Mr. McDonald of Davenport?” Wilhelmina said excitedly to Connor.
“I’m not sure…” Connor smiled helplessly and shook his head.
At this moment, Connor felt that since Leroy could talk about him in front of so many people and he had met Leroy before, Leroy probably didn’t recognize him. As long as Connor didn’t admit it, nobody would know he was the legendary Mr. McDonald of Davenport.
Leroy came to a realization. He quickly analyzed the conversation between Connor and Wilhelmina in his mind.
Connor was the Mr. McDonald of Davenport, but his friend didn’t know his identity. Moreover, Connor didn’t admit it, which meant he didn’t want to expose his identity.
Leroy himself was a brilliant person, so he understood this.
Therefore, Leroy hurriedly adjusted his emotions and smiled at Connor. He did not take the initiative to talk to Connor or expose Connor’s true identity.
“Since you don’t even know Mr. McDonald, let me tell you, Mr. McDonald is the boss of the richest man in Davenport, Thomas Morgan…” Wilhelmina continued.
“That’s right, Connor. My father’s boss is also Mr. McDonald. Moreover, Mr. McDonald is only in his twenties, about the same age as us. This person is amazing. I heard that he’s quite handsome. I think this person must be a business genius…” Sabrina quickly added.
“So what if he’s powerful? It has nothing to do with us. Moreover, some people are in the limelight now but might be lonely in the future…” Connor seemed a little embarrassed when he heard Sabrina’s words, so he replied in a very low-key manner.
After Sadie heard Connor’s words, a trace of speechlessness flashed in her eyes. She frowned and said, “Connor, if you don’t understand the situation, don’t spout nonsense. Be careful not to get into trouble…”
Sadie knew that Leroy had a special relationship with Mr. McDonald. Connor was cursing Mr. McDonald. Things would be troublesome if Leroy were unhappy and chased Connor out or got someone to beat him up.
No matter what, Connor had a good relationship with Sadie’s mother. Although Sadie didn’t like Connor, she didn’t want this to happen. She said this to remind Connor.
“That’s right. Do you know how many businesses Mr. McDonald has? If Mr. McDonald is lonely, who knows how many people will also be in trouble? If you are ignorant, then don’t talk too much. How embarrassing!” Yara frowned and scolded Connor.
“Haha…” Sheldon and Harold also thought that Connor was very ignorant, but they didn’t say anything. They just sneered.
When Jaden, Tobias, and the others heard Yara’s words, a trace of anger flashed in their eyes. They opened their mouths and were about to help Connor refute.
“Actually, I think Mr.… Connor is right. No one can say for sure about this thing…” Leroy suddenly spoke up for Connor.
At this moment, only Leroy knew Connor’s identity. Connor was humble, so it was not up to others to say anything. However, Leroy knew that Connor probably did not want to expose his identity, so he did not expose him.
After everyone heard Leroy’s words, they all looked at Connor coldly. No one continued to mock Connor.
Leroy had already spoken. If they continued to speak, wouldn’t they asking for it?
After Connor and Jaden sat down, everyone began discussing other topics.
However, Jaden’s expression was very ugly because he saw Roxanne and Penn sitting together when he came in.
However, Jaden knew that there were more people in the private room, so he did not say much.
However, Jaden never expected that Penn and Roxanne would be even more presumptuous when they saw him. They even started flirting in front of him.
It was already very humiliating for his girlfriend to flirt with another man in front of him.
But at this moment, Roxanne and Jaden were no longer just flirting.
Jaden felt that if he did not stop them, they would probably get a room together soon.
Therefore, he quickly took out his phone and sent Roxanne a Facebook, hoping that Roxanne would restrain herself.
However, Roxanne’s phone was always in her bag, so she couldn’t see the message at all.
Connor and the others naturally saw this but didn’t say anything. After all, this was a matter between Jaden and Roxanne, and outsiders couldn’t say anything.
“Roxanne, sit over here…” Jaden hesitated before he frowned and shouted at Roxanne.
Roxanne turned and glanced at Jaden indifferently. She pouted and said, “I’m fine sitting here. Why should I sit over there?”
At this moment, Roxanne had already decided to break up with Jaden after dinner and get together with Penn.
Therefore, she had no scruples now and did not care about Jaden at all.
“You!” Jaden didn’t expect Roxanne to answer him like that. He was so angry that he couldn’t say anything.

chapters.title: Chapter 873: Apologize To Jaden
chapters.content:
Chapter 873: Apologize To Jaden
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Inside the private room.
After everyone heard the conversation between Jaden and Roxanne, they all turned to look at Jaden and Roxanne.
“Roxanne, I told you to sit over here. Did you hear me?”
Perhaps it was because Roxanne’s words just now embarrassed Jaden, so he frowned and shouted coldly.
“Why should I? I’m fine sitting here. I don’t like it there!” Roxanne said coldly.
“Roxanne, aren’t you going a little too far? Jaden had already given you much wriggling space just now. Now that he wants you to go back to your seat, just go back. Do you have to make people say bad things to satisfy you?” Wilhelmina couldn’t stand it anymore. She frowned and chastised Roxanne.
“Who are you? What has it to do with you how I’m talking to Jaden? If you like that seat, why don’t you take it? What are you talking about here?” Roxanne turned to look at Wilhelmina and shouted in disdain.
“Why are you like this?” Wilhelmina stood up and pointed at Roxanne.
“…”
Jaden took a deep breath and stood up as well. Then, he walked up to Roxanne and grabbed her arm, shouting in a low voice, “Come with me…”
“Jaden, what are you doing? Hurry up and let go of me. Are you crazy?”
Roxanne naturally didn’t want to leave with Jaden, so she struggled with all her might. However, Roxanne was just a girl, so her strength was not comparable to Jaden’s. So, she turned to look at Penn.
Penn hesitated before slowly saying, “Bro, what are you doing? Everyone is here to eat. Since the beautiful lady Roxanne wants to sit beside me, let her sit beside me. Don’t worry. I will take good care of your girlfriend…”
At this moment, Penn’s words were very unpleasant. It was obvious that he was provoking Jaden.
Even Connor’s eyes flashed with a trace of strangeness.
Jaden was in a terrible mood. After all, his girlfriend humiliated him in front of many friends. Who could keep silent? In addition, Penn’s words were really unpleasant. It was obvious that he did not respect Jaden at all!
“Who the hell do you think you are? You don’t have the right to take care of my girlfriend. Get lost!” Jaden glared at him.
At this moment, Jaden was too agitated, so it was inevitable that he could not control his emotions.
“What the f*ck did you say? How dare you scold me?”
Penn had never respected Jaden before, so he dared to seduce Roxanne so brazenly.
With Jaden scolding him, he became even angrier.
One had to know that it was effortless for a young rich man like Penn to deal with an ordinary person like Jaden. Therefore, he did not hold back at all.
“So what if I scolded you?” Jaden shouted with his eyes widened.
‘Whoosh…’
The rich heirs with a good relationship with Penn stood up when they saw something was about to go down.
Even Harold and Sheldon stood up and looked at Jaden expressionlessly.
Tobias rushed behind Jaden while Connor stood quietly in place.
At this moment, everyone was extremely emotional. Jaden was agitated because Penn’s words were too unpleasant, and Penn was agitated because Jaden scolded him!
These people could start fighting anytime, but Penn had many people on his side, and they were all rich heirs. In addition, with Penn and Leroy’s relationship, If the two sides fought, Jaden and Tobias would be at a disadvantage!
“What are you doing? We are all friends. Please sit down!” Sabrina knew the relationship between Jaden and Connor. Naturally, she did not want to see these people fight, so she quickly stood up and tried to persuade them.
“Yeah, we were all fine earlier. Why did this happen? Everyone, sit down!” Sadie also frowned and shouted.
In fact, Sadie was still blaming Connor. After all, these people were Connor’s friends. If it weren’t for Connor, this wouldn’t have happened.
“Penn, can you calm down on my behalf and stop fooling around?”
Sabrina knew it was useless to persuade Jaden now, so she shouted at Penn.
Penn turned and glanced at Sabrina. Then, he said to Jaden expressionlessly, “Brat, you’re lucky today. Miss Ziegler is pleading for you. I’ll stop on behalf of Miss Ziegler. Apologize to me, and today’s matter will be over!”
When everyone heard Penn’s words, they turned to look at Jaden.
After a moment of hesitation, Tobias whispered to Jaden, “Jaden, apologize. We can’t afford to offend such a person. Don’t get into trouble because of this…”
Jaden had also calmed down. He knew that although he wasn’t at fault today, he had scolded Penn. If Penn didn’t let him off, then the matter would only get bigger and bigger. By then, Connor and Tobias might be implicated. Even Wilhelmina and Yasmin would be in danger.
Jaden took a deep breath and gritted his teeth for two seconds.
In the end, he still felt that it was better for him to apologize and settle this. After all, he really could not afford to provoke a rich man like Penn.
“Phew…”
Jaden took a deep breath and slowly raised his head to look at Penn as if he was going to apologize.
However, just as Jaden was about to speak, a figure suddenly stood before him and said very calmly, “There is indeed someone who needs to apologize today, but the person who should apologize is not Jaden, but this person!”
When everyone heard this, they all turned to look at the person speaking.
It was none other than Connor!
“What did you say?” Penn was stunned momentarily and asked Connor with a shocked expression.
“I said you have to apologize to my friend. You don’t understand human language, do you?” Connor replied indifferently.
Penn sized up Connor, the expression on his face extremely playful.
Not only was he not angry, he even laughed and said coldly, “You said you want me to apologize to him?”
“Is there a problem?” Connor asked softly.
“…”
Everyone looked at Connor, speechless. No one expected Connor to even dare say a word.
In the eyes of these rich heirs, Connor and the others were just ordinary people. It was impossible for Penn to apologize to people like them.

chapters.title: Chapter 874: The Change In Leroy
chapters.content:
Chapter 874: The Change In Leroy
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
After hearing Connor’s words, Harold and Sheldon began to snicker.
After all, both of them had conflicts with Connor. If Connor angered Penn today, it was in Leroy’s territory.
According to Penn and Leroy’s relationship, Leroy would not let Connor off!
By then, they could borrow Leroy’s hands to deal with Connor properly.
“Who do you think you are? Why should I…”
Before Penn could finish his sentence, Leroy slapped Penn’s face.
For a moment, everyone was stunned.
Even Harold, Sheldon, and the others were dumbfounded. They looked at Penn, dumbfounded.
Originally, they thought that Leroy might help Penn deal with Connor, but no one expected Leroy actually to hit Penn.
Penn covered his face and looked at Leroy in disbelief. He trembled and said, “Mr. Jovi, you…”
“Smack!” Leroy did not hesitate at all. He slapped him again and shouted angrily, “What now? Hurry up and apologize to him and get out of the room. I don’t want to see you again, you shameful thing…”
Connor didn’t know Leroy, but Leroy knew Connor.
Leroy knew about Connor’s identity and background. Not to mention his identity and background, Connor’s skills alone were not something ordinary people could handle.
Earlier, Leroy had been sitting on the spot without moving. He was waiting for Connor to make a move. If Connor didn’t care about this today, Leroy naturally wouldn’t care.
However, if Connor were to interfere, Leroy would not stand by and watch.
When everyone saw this, they were all dumbfounded.
No one expected Leroy to speak up for Connor, Jaden, and the others.
Even Jaden and Tobias could not understand what was going on.
However, Connor reacted. Leroy was Jaxon’s son, which meant that Leroy must have known his identity, which was why he did this.
Although Penn was puzzled, he did not dare to disobey Leroy’s orders. He nervously said to Jaden, “Bro, I have let you down just now. I know I was wrong. Don’t lower yourself to my level!”
Jaden looked at Penn and was extremely shocked.
Roxanne’s eyes widened as she looked at Leroy in shock.
“Bro, I saw what happened just now. Penn had indeed gone overboard. Don’t lower yourself to his level!” Leroy said to Jaden.
Everyone could not understand why Leroy was so polite to Jaden. Could it be because of Sabrina?
The relationship between Connor and Sabrina was not ordinary, and the relationship between Jaden and Connor was not, either. If it was because of Sabrina, then this could indeed be justified.
However, what they could not understand was why was Leroy so agitated.
Moreover, Penn’s identity and background were not simple. Leroy had beaten Penn up in front of so many people because of this. Was it really appropriate?
These questions lingered in everyone’s minds. Everyone’s hearts were filled with doubts and puzzlement.
Sabrina’s background was indeed not simple. However, Connor and Jaden were just ordinary people. They should not be so scary to Leroy!
“Mr. Jovi, you’re too nice. Actually…” Jaden instantly felt flattered and stuttered, not knowing what to say.
“Say no more, bro!” Leroy waved at Jaden, then looked at Penn and shouted, “What are you still doing here? Hurry up and get out…”
Penn was stunned, but he did not dare to say anything else. He hurriedly turned around and walked out of the private room.
Roxanne stood rooted to the ground, not knowing what to do.
“All right, everyone, don’t just stand there. This was indeed Penn’s fault. Now that Penn has already left, let’s continue eating!” Leroy laughed and said to the crowd.
After hesitating, everyone returned to their senses and sat back in their seats.
Roxanne could only helplessly return to Jaden’s side.
However, Jaden’s attitude toward Roxanne had also changed. He didn’t even look at Roxanne. Today’s incident allowed Jaden to see Roxanne’s true colours.
For some people, being nice was not enough.
Jaden felt that he had to thank Penn. If not for Penn, he might never have been able to see through these.
After Leroy saw that Connor did not say anything, he slowly sat back down.
However, no one noticed that Leroy’s back was already drenched.
After all, facing a big shot like Connor, he was worried that if he did something wrong and offended Connor, then his family might end up the same as the Chakin Family that Yakov was in.
There was also the news that Nikola’s legs had been broken by Yakov. Leroy had long heard of it, and he did not want to end up like Nikola.
After everyone took their seats, the atmosphere began to become awkward. Everyone’s conversation was not as natural as before.
However, the one who changed the most was still Leroy. He actually put aside his airs and took the initiative to toast Tobias, Jaden, and the others. This made these people somewhat at a loss.
After all, Leroy did not even look at them before, but now his attitude had changed so much.
Not only did he take the initiative to propose a toast, but he also spoke very politely.
Of course, when Leroy was toasting these people, he also took the initiative to toast Connor. Connor did not refuse.
Sadie, Sabrina, and the others looked at Leroy. They vaguely felt that something was wrong with today’s incident, but they did not know what the problem was.
When Leroy saw Connor, his expression changed instantly. Sadie suddenly remembered that all the changes in Leroy seemed to have started when Connor entered the private room. Before Connor entered the private room, Leroy did not even look at Tobias and the others!
“Could Connor and Leroy be related?” Sadie looked at Connor with a puzzled expression.
Sheldon, Harold, and the others seemed to have noticed this as well. They could see that Leroy was looking at Connor with a very strange gaze!

chapters.title: Chapter 875: I'm Looking For Mr. McDonald
chapters.content:
Chapter 875: I’m Looking For Mr. McDonald
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Leroy went through this meal as if he was treading on thin ice. After all, it was his first time eating with a big shot like Connor.
Leroy was even more nervous because he couldn’t expose Connor’s identity yet.
Therefore, Leroy was very cautious when eating, afraid he would say something wrong.
Perhaps it was because he was under too much psychological pressure, Leroy’s performance during the entire meal was very unnatural.
However, many people present were not fools. They could feel the change in Leroy, but they could not understand why Leroy was behaving that way.
Half an hour had passed in the blink of an eye, and the dinner was finally ending.
Leroy heaved a sigh of relief when he saw that everyone was almost done eating.
Originally, Leroy thought he was only hosting a few rich heirs today, but he did not expect to meet a big shot like Connor.
However, this was a rare opportunity for Leroy.
After all, being able to receive Connor personally was something that many people dreamed of.
After everyone finished eating, they left the private room one after another and walked toward the hotel.
Perhaps it was because of Roxanne’s matter that Jaden was in a terrible mood.
Therefore, after returning to the hotel, he booked another room and retired to a different room than Roxanne’s.
Everyone knew that Jaden would not be able to accept such a thing.
Although Leroy helped Jaden vent his anger, Jaden was still very angry.
Connor, Tobias, and the others did not say anything. After all, this was Jaden’s problem, so they returned to their rooms.
“Looks like this has dealt a huge blow to Jaden…”
After returning to his room, Tobias turned to look at Connor and sighed softly.
“No matter who it is, they will not be able to accept such a thing…”
Connor sat on the bed and replied expressionlessly. In fact, what happened to Jaden now was very similar to what Connor had experienced before.
Didn’t Mandy treat Connor the same back then?
However, Jaden’s luck was much better than Connor’s. No matter what, Connor still stood behind him to support him.
Back then, Connor had no one. He could only watch Mandy leave him; he was powerless.
“This Roxanne is something. She could have broken up with Jaden if she didn’t like him. Yet, she goes around seducing another man in front of Jaden. Like, why?” Tobias asked helplessly.
“Let’s not discuss other people’s problems. It won’t be nice if Jaden hears it!” Connor replied to Tobias indifferently.
“That’s true. Jaden usually cares about his reputation so much. Let’s pretend that this never happened. Don’t bring it up again in the future…”
Tobias nodded gently and then smiled at Connor. “Connor, I didn’t expect your friend, the great beauty Sabrina, to have such a reputation. If it wasn’t for her today, why would someone like Leroy speak up for Jaden?”
“…”
Connor was surprised when he heard Tobias’s comment. He knew that Tobias’s change in attitude toward Leroy meant he did not suspect him at all.
He felt that all of this was because of Sabrina. Leroy was doing all that on Sabrina’s behalf!
However, Connor felt that this was also good. In this case, he did not need to explain anything.
“I didn’t expect Leroy to do so much for Sabrina!” Connor said with a smile.
Sabrina seems to be interested in you. If you don’t have a girlfriend, consider Sabrina. Nothing is wrong with this girl’s family background, looks, or character. For ordinary people like us to be able to find such a girlfriend, we must’ve done something right in life,” Tobias said earnestly to Connor.
After Connor heard Tobias’s words, he seemed a little helpless. He indifferently said, “Bro, how often have I told you? I already have a girlfriend…”
“I know you already have a girlfriend, but you can also consider Ms. Ziegler!” Tobias said with a smile.
When Connor heard Tobias’s words, he smiled helplessly. He didn’t know what to say.
“All right, I’m done for the day. I’ll go take a shower first…” Tobias waved at Connor, then stood up and walked to the bathroom.
Connor looked at Tobias and sighed softly. Connor was very clear about Sabrina’s feelings for him.
Sabrina could be considered the best in every aspect. It was indeed Connor’s fortune to have a girlfriend like Sabrina.
However, Connor did not have any other thoughts about Sabrina. He felt that Freya was the most suitable woman for him.
As for Yelena and Chloe, those two women were just mistakes that Connor made on impulse. No matter what kind of women they were, they were not as important as Freya Phillips in Connor’s heart.
‘I wonder how Freya is doing overseas?’ He hadn’t heard from Freya for a long time. When was she planning to come back?
Connor could not help but sigh softly.
‘Bang bang bang…’
Just as Connor was thinking about that, someone knocked on the door.
Connor was surprised when he heard the knock on the door. He thought that Jaden was in a bad mood and came to look for him, so he walked to the door and opened it.
However, when Connor opened the door, he found that the person standing outside was a hotel staff.
“Hello, sir. I’m looking for Mr. Connor!” The waiter said very politely.
“Yes, that’s me. What’s the matter?” Connor replied indifferently.
“Mr. McDonald, someone is waiting for you downstairs. He said it’s inconvenient for him to come up personally, so he asked me to come over and inform you…” The waiter looked at Connor and said slowly.
After Connor heard the waiter’s words, he instantly understood what was happening.
The only person who knew his identity in this hotel was Leroy. Leroy was worried that his identity would be exposed if he came up, so he specially asked the waiter to come up and tell him.
“All right, got it!” Connor nodded lightly.
The waiter smiled at Connor, then turned around and left.
Connor hesitated, then informed Tobias, who was in the bathroom, and left the room.

chapters.title: Chapter 876: You're A Smart Man
chapters.content:
Chapter 876: You’re A Smart Man
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
After leaving the room, Connor went downstairs directly to the hotel entrance.
At that moment, there was indeed a person standing at the hotel entrance.
And that person was none other than Leroy!
“I didn’t expect Leroy to be quite thoughtful…”
Connor couldn’t help but exclaim inwardly.
Whether it was in the hotel’s private room or the action of Leroy sending the waiter to find Connor just now, it could be seen that he was an intelligent person.
After hesitating for a moment, Connor walked directly towards Leroy’s position.
Upon hearing the footsteps, Leroy quickly turned around and, upon seeing Connor, he hurriedly walked to his side, speaking in a tense tone, “Mr. Connor, you’ve come to our resort without notifying my father beforehand? If you had informed my father, this misunderstanding wouldn’t have happened…”
Connor could tell that Leroy’s expression at the moment was filled with fear.
“Do we know each other? I don’t think I’ve seen you before…”
Connor casually replied to Leroy.
“Mr. Connor, I followed my father to participate in the Four Provinces Martial Arts Competition. I always stood behind my father. You might not have noticed me, but I saw you…”
Leroy hurriedly explained.
“I see.”
Connor nodded lightly and continued to ask Leroy, “Did you have something to talk to me about?”
“I came here specifically to apologize to you. I was afraid of exposing your identity, so I didn’t dare to approach you earlier…”
Leroy replied in a low voice, then continued, “Mr. Connor, I was disrespectful before, and I hope you won’t hold it against me…”
“You didn’t recognize me before, and I didn’t intend for you to recognize me, so I won’t blame you!”
Connor replied softly, then looked at Leroy and asked expressionlessly, “By the way, since you already recognized me in the private room, why didn’t you reveal my identity?”
“I… I…”
Leroy wiped the sweat from his face with his hand, looking somewhat nervous.
“Just say whatever you want, no need to be nervous,” Connor said casually.
“Mr. Connor, to be honest, I was a bit nervous when I saw you at first, so I didn’t say anything. Later, I overheard the conversation between you and your friends. I realized that your friends didn’t know your identity, and since you didn’t inform my father when you came here, it meant that you didn’t want these people to know your identity. So I didn’t say anything, but I don’t know if what I did was right or wrong!”
Leroy explained slowly.
“It’s true that I didn’t want too many people to know my identity. You are a clever person, and in the future, when you take over the business of the Jovi family, it should thrive even more!”
At this moment, Connor had a favorable impression of Leroy. He thought that Leroy had more brains than many rich heirs.
“As long as you don’t blame me, that’s good!”
After realizing that he did the right thing, Leroy secretly felt relieved. If he had actually exposed Connor’s identity, things could have become troublesome.
“Alright, you don’t have to be so restrained with me. We are peers, and I think you have some intelligence. If you encounter any troubles in the future, you can come directly to me. Considering your decent performance this time, I will help you depending on the situation!”
Connor said to Leroy expressionlessly.
“Mr. Connor, are you… Are you serious about what you said?”
Leroy was completely astonished by the unexpected appreciation from Connor. His face showed an extremely excited expression.
“Remember what I just said. You are an intelligent person. If you take over the Jovi family in the future, your family’s business will definitely reach new heights. But the prerequisite is that you have to be obedient, understood?”
Connor reached out and patted Leroy’s shoulder, saying calmly.
“I understand, I understand…”
Leroy nodded eagerly with an excited tone.
In fact, Leroy had always wanted to please Connor. Being able to find a powerful backer like him meant that the Jovi family could expand their influence in San Antonio just like Kyle did, which would be a great opportunity for them.
Connor’s thoughts were also quite simple. San Antonio was still somewhat distant from Davenport so it was not realistic to expect Kyle to extend his power over San Antonio.
Therefore, he was deliberately trying to win over Leroy at this moment, hoping that the Jovi family, where Leroy belonged, could help him control the territory of San Antonio in the future.
Leroy was an intelligent person, and his style of doing things also made him feel comfortable. Thus, Leroy was the best choice for him in San Antonio.
Now, Yakov was in San Francisco, Kyle was in Davenport, and Leroy was in San Antonio. The only province left was San Diego.
So, he just needed to spend some time to have a good conversation with Jonathan in San Diego, it would be of great help to him in dealing with the Rockefeller people in the future.
Everything Connor was doing now was in preparation for his future confrontation with the Rockefellers.
“Mr. Connor, should I call my father now and ask him to come and meet you?”
After seeing that Connor remained silent, Leroy cautiously asked him.
“No need. I’m just staying here with my friends for a couple of days. I’ll be leaving the day after tomorrow. You don’t have to be so formal…” Connor said softly to Leroy.
“Alright, I understand.”
Leroy nodded quickly.
“If there’s nothing else, you can go back now,” Connor said softly to Leroy.
Leroy was taken aback for a moment when he heard Connor’s words, but then he hurriedly said to Connor, “By the way, Mr. Connor, I didn’t know your identity before. Otherwise, I wouldn’t have arranged for you to stay in this hotel. I’ll have our best villa prepared for you, and you can move in tomorrow…”
“It doesn’t have to be the best villa, an ordinary one will do,” Connor thought that the others should also enjoy themselves, so he did not refuse Leroy’s proposal.
“Alright, I understand…”
Leroy nodded quickly and then turned and left.
After seeing Leroy leave, Connor stood in place for a moment, hesitated for two seconds, and then shouted expressionlessly towards the distance, “Stop hiding, come out!”

chapters.title: Chapter 877: The Shocked Roxanne
chapters.content:
Chapter 877: The Shocked Roxanne
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Leroy’s face immediately lit up with a joyful smile after hearing what Connor said.
Finding a backer like Connor was a tremendous stroke of luck for the Jovi family.
Perhaps in the future, after taking over his father’s position, he could elevate the Jovi family to a higher level.
So, after leaving the hotel, he hurriedly made preparations for the villa.
The water villa area was currently fully booked, and Connor and his friends alone needed at least three villas. So Leroy was bound to offend some people.
But to please Connor, he believed that it was worth offending some people.
After he left, Connor did not rush to leave.
Because he knew that someone had been eavesdropping on his conversation with Leroy.
Although the person had hidden, he could still sense her presence.
Having learned the Chi Observation Technique from Jorge, even though he had only learned the basic, it was still very simple for him to perceive the presence of people around him.
Moreover, the other person was just an ordinary individual, not a warrior at all, so it was even easier to detect her presence.
“Come out, stop hiding. I’ve already noticed you…” he shouted expressionlessly in the distance.
After hesitating for a moment, the girl hiding around the corner eventually chose to come out.
And the girl who had been eavesdropping on Connor’s conversation with Leroy was none other than Roxanne!
At this moment, she was dressed very seductively, wearing a tight-fitting short skirt that accentuated her slender waist, ample chest, and long, fair legs. She had a light makeup on her face, giving off a seductive yet slightly cold aura.
She was already quite attractive, and her figure was also very appealing. Now, with this attire, it made it even more difficult for people to resist.
Due to a dispute at a dinner party, Roxanne and Jaden had fallen out, and Roxanne knew that there was no chance for her and Jaden to be together anymore.
So she planned to take advantage of this opportunity to flirt with a rich heir.
There were many wealthy young men in the resort, especially in the villa area, where almost everyone had a net worth of at least a billion.
So Roxanne specifically dressed in a seductive outfit and prepared to stroll around the villa area, hoping to meet a rich second generation who might be interested in her. Even if something happened between them, she wouldn’t refuse.
After all, she had long since lost her virginity, so going to bed with someone was no big deal to her.
However, after wandering around the villa area, she realized that those rich young men had no interest in her at all.
Moreover, most of them already had girlfriends, and those girlfriends were even more beautiful than herself.
So Roxanne could only return empty-handed in the end.
But as she was about to enter the hotel, she suddenly noticed two people chatting at the entrance, and one of them looked a lot like Leroy.
So Roxanne decided to have a chance encounter with Leroy and see if she had any opportunities.
But as she approached him, she realized that the person chatting with Leroy turned out to be Connor, the poor friend of Jaden.
This made Roxanne even more curious about why Connor was meeting Leroy and what they were talking about.
When Roxanne heard the conversation between them, she was completely shocked and quickly hid aside.
The more she listened to what they said, the more terrified she became.
At that moment, she realized that this unremarkable poor boy was actually the famous Mr. Connor from Porthampton!
Roxanne didn’t know how to describe her feelings. She had heard some things about Connor from Jaden before, but most of it was about his family’s poor conditions. She had no interest in such a poor boy, so naturally she didn’t care about him and showed cold indifference when she saw him. That’s why she was so surprised to learn about his terrifying background.
It was all just a disguise by Connor.
She approached him cautiously and looked him up and down, her tone filled with confusion as she asked, “Are you the legendary Mr. Connor?”
“You must have heard the conversation between Leroy and me just now, right?” Connor replied expressionlessly.
“I… I didn’t mean to…” Roxanne’s slender and fair legs trembled slightly as she stuttered.
He remained silent as he looked at Roxanne.
She stared at him with her beautiful eyes, feeling a mix of emotions. No matter how she looked at him, she couldn’t see that Connor was the legendary Mr. Connor.
At this moment, Connor dressed very casually. Although he had a decent appearance, his attire was too low-key, not distinguishing him from ordinary people.
On the other hand, the rich heirs like Harold and Sheldon, whether it was their temperament or attire, were extremely noble and clearly not ordinary people.
But now, this seemingly ordinary Connor in front of her turned out to be someone that even those people needed to look up to.
For Roxanne, it was hard to comprehend!
According to the information she had heard, there were only a few people who could be compared to Connor in the entire Four Provinces.
Leroy was utterly humble in front of Connor.
And now, this legendary figure appeared in Roxanne’s life in such a manner.
It was normal for an ordinary person like her to have trouble accepting this fact.
“I… I didn’t expect that you… you are Mr. Connor.” She hesitated for a moment and stuttered.
Connor glanced at Roxanne calmly and slowly said, “You think Jaden, a person like him, wouldn’t know someone like me, right?”
After hearing his words, she suddenly looked up at him, her eyes showing a hint of nervousness.
“Jaden is my friend. No matter what you think, you can’t harm him. Otherwise, you will regret it for the rest of your life. Do you understand what I mean?” Connor spoke again at that moment.
“I understand, I understand…” Roxanne quickly nodded.

chapters.title: Chapter 878: Who Is Connor?
chapters.content:
Chapter 878: Who Is Connor?
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Connor said all these to Roxanne just to remind her not to go overboard.
Regardless of whether she was willing to continue being with Jaden, it had nothing to do with him.
After all, this was a matter between Jaden and her, and he doesn’t want to get too involved.
However, Roxanne was a very intelligent woman, and she should know what choices to make now.
Connor knew that Jaden still has feelings for Roxanne, and as long as she can be a little more honest in the future, Jaden would definitely accept her.
Perhaps this was a common problem for most men. Once they truly liked a woman, as long as she changed her attitude, the man often chose to forgive her.
Connor has experienced such a situation before, so today he didn’t speak too harshly to Roxanne.
“I don’t want anyone else to know about what happened today!”
After taking two steps towards the hotel lobby, Connor suddenly stopped and turned to look at Roxanne’s position.
“Don’t worry, I definitely won’t…”
Before she could finish her sentence, she saw him walking towards the hotel lobby.
She stood foolishly in place, looking at his figure, and a firmness flashed in her eyes.
She thought that since Jaden and Connor was best friend, Jaden’s future was limitless and he couldn’t be compared to someone like Penn
Moreover, Jaden still had feelings for her. With all these conditions in place, she knew that Jaden was her best choice. She didn’t have to look for other rich heirs.
So in her heart, she made a silent determination that no matter what, she must marry Jaden.
Only by marrying Jaden could she rise up like a phoenix!
On the other hand, after Connor returned to the hotel, he found that Tobias had already finished showering and was lying on the bed resting.
Seeing Connor enter, he sat up straight and asked in a puzzled tone, “Connor, where did you go?”
“Just went to see a friend…”
Connor replied casually.
“A beautiful lady named Sabrina?”
Tobias asked curiously.
Connor smiled faintly at his words and didn’t say much.
After all, explaining too much to Tobias would be troublesome, so he simply let them imagine whatever they wanted.
The next morning at eight o’clock.
Connor and the others received a message about changing rooms. Connor, Tobias, Jaden and a few others moved to the villa area.
Moreover, the rooms they stayed in were on the same level as the villas of Sheldon and Harold.
Roxanne apologized to Jaden last night, but it seemed that he was still not appeased. Coupled with Roxanne’s actions that made him feel embarrassed in front of Connor and Tobias, he directly drove Roxanne away.
Roxanne also understood what he was thinking, so she didn’t continue to entangle with him. Instead, she chose to leave the resort and wait until he returned to school to have a proper conversation. By that time, his anger should have subsided, and it shouldn’t be difficult for her to reconcile with him.
“Connor, I didn’t expect your friend to have such face. He actually got us a villa. The environment here is so good!”
After moving into the villa, Wilhelmina seemed to be in a good mood. She took a selfie with her phone and smiled at Connor.
“It’s all because of Sabrina. Otherwise, how could we possibly live in such a nice room?” Tobias smiled and said to Wilhelmina.
“Yeah, Sabrina is really impressive. Not only is she beautiful, but she’s also so kind. Connor, you have to work hard and try to win over this wealthy and beautiful woman. Then the rest of us can enjoy your good fortune,” Wilhelmina nodded and said seriously to Connor.
Upon hearing Tobias, Wilhelmina, and others’ words, a trace of helplessness flashed in Connor’s eyes. He didn’t know how to explain to these people, so he simply didn’t explain anything.
Jaden looked around the villa’s interior and couldn’t help but sigh, “Perhaps this is the gap between ordinary people like us and the second generation of the wealthy. Just one word from them allows us to stay in the villa for free, but even if we have money, we can’t get in.”
Perhaps because of Roxanne’s situation, Connor could feel that he was still in a very bad mood.
“I believe that one day, you will also be able to bring us to live in such a mansion!” Connor reached out and gently patted his shoulder, smiling.
Upon hearing his words, Jaden couldn’t help but turn his head and give Connor a helpless look. His facial expression showed a hint of resignation, and he didn’t say much.
Jaden knew that Connor was trying to comfort him at this moment. Some things were impossible for him to achieve even if he worked hard all his life. Jaden had a clear understanding of his own abilities, but he didn’t have a clear understanding of his friends.
With Connor’s help, it would be very easy for Jaden to surpass Harold, Sheldon and others in the future and reach the same level as them.
…
On the other hand, Harold and Sheldon were shocked when they heard that Connor and the others had moved into the villa.
After all, they were not as easily fooled as Tobias. The incident where Leroy intervened and hit Penn had already made them very suspicious.
Tobias and the others might think it was because of Sabrina’s influence and Connor’s good relationship with her that Leroy would be so polite.
But they knew that although Sabrina had some power and her father, Charles, did have considerable influence, his power was always in Sutton, not in the country. Leroy would definitely not be so afraid of her. At most, he would just avoid offending her easily.
So there was absolutely no relationship between Connor and the others moving into the villa and Sabrina.
And Jaden, Tobias, and the others were just ordinary people. Leroy would never give them that kind of face.
Now there was only one person left, Connor.
“Harold, who exactly is this Connor? Mr. Leroy beat me up because of him, and afterward, he sternly warned me not to provoke Connor and his friends. And now Connor and his group have moved into the villa. What is going on?” Penn felt very frustrated at this moment.
If it was really because of the incident involving Harold that Penn had offended a well-connected rich heir, he would regret his action.

chapters.title: Chapter 879: Top-tier Rich Heir
chapters.content:
Chapter 879: Top-tier Rich Heir
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Originally, Penn had planned to teach Connor a lesson in order to please Harold.
But at this moment, Penn had already dismissed that idea from his mind.
Because he felt that Connor, Jaden, and the others definitely had identities that were not as simple as he had imagined.
Moreover, Leroy had just warned him not to provoke Connor and the others.
Although Leroy did not reveal the exact identities of Connor and the others, the fact that he attached so much importance to them meant that they were definitely not ordinary people.
At the thought of this, Harold couldn’t help but frown.
He knew that there was some relationship between Connor and Madison, but as for Connor’s other background, Harold had no idea!
“The reason why Mr. Leroy hit Penn during the meal just now and had such a big change in attitude later, I think it must be related to Connor. Mr. Leroy should know Connor!”
Sheldon analyzed in a low voice, frowning.
“How could Mr. Leroy know Connor?”
After hearing Sheldon’s words, Harold’s expression on his face seemed even more puzzled.
“You investigated Connor before, didn’t you find anything unusual?”
Sheldon asked in a low voice.
“I didn’t find anything unusual. I only know that Connor has a good relationship with my cousin Madison, and Luke seems to know Connor. As for other information, it’s useless…”
Harold said helplessly.
“I also investigated Connor’s time in high school, but at that time, he was just an ordinary person. His parents had died when he was in primary school, and he has survived till today by working hard. There is no background to speak of!”
Sheldon said with a furrowed brow.
“What kind of person is this Connor?”
Harold cursed irritably. He had never encountered such a difficult opponent before!
“Well, about this Connor’s identity, I don’t want to know, but if you want to teach him a lesson, don’t involve me. If you want to deal with Connor, go ahead, I have no intention of getting involved in this matter…”
After hearing the conversation between Sheldon and Harold, Penn’s expression was helpless as he spoke.
“Now it seems that Connor really knows Leroy. Even if Connor doesn’t know Leroy, there must be someone on their side who knows Leroy. So, dealing with Connor here would be disrespectful to Mr. Leroy. Let’s put this matter aside for now. Anyway, Connor is in Porthampton, and we will have plenty of opportunities to deal with him in the future…”
Sheldon’s mood was relatively calm as he looked at Harold in front of him and said softly.
After hearing Sheldon’s words, Harold’s expression on his face seemed somewhat helpless, and he said lightly, “I didn’t expect dealing with this Connor would be so troublesome. For now, we can only do this…”
Sheldon turned his head and glanced at Harold, then said lightly, “Harold, you don’t have to worry. Jovan Lambert will be back next week. I’ll let Jovan find out more about Connor’s identity. He has a broader network of connections than us and should be able to find out something…”
“Jovan is coming back?”
After hearing this, Harold’s eyes flashed with excitement.
“Yes, Jovan called me last night…”
Sheldon nodded lightly.
“Jovan Lambert?”
When Penn heard this name, his mouth instantly fell open. The expression on his face was extremely incredulous.
Jovan was a well-known playboy in the four provinces. Even in San Antonio, Penn had heard of his name. He could be said to be the top-tier rich heir in the four provinces, with a background that completely overshadowed Leroy. When Jovan had not left Davenport, countless playboys would tremble uncontrollably upon hearing his name.
However, later on, it seemed that he had killed someone and forcibly violated the girlfriend of that person, who happened to be a well-known rich second generation in the local area.
The incident caused a huge uproar in Davenport, and everyone thought that even with Jovan’s family background, there was no way to resolve this matter.
But no one had expected that he would eventually be sent abroad, and the matter was left unresolved.
If he returned to the country, who knows what kind of commotion would arise.
“If Jovan come back, then this matter would be much simpler…”
Harold said with a smile.
“Yes, when he comes back, Henny Kirby, Arthur Synder, and the others should also come. At that time, we can join forces to deal with Connor. It would be a piece of cake, wouldn’t it?”
Sheldon said slowly.
“That’s right. If all these people can come back, what can Connor do? Even if Connor has extraordinary abilities, it would still be a dead end in the end!”
Finally, a smile appeared on Harold’s face.
Penn looked at Harold and Sheldon, his expression completely overwhelmed.
Because whether it was Jovan, Henny, or Arthur, they were all famous playboys in Oprana. In the eyes of the entire Oprana, they could be considered top-tier rich heirs.
At this moment, Sheldon and Harold brought out all these people to deal with Connor!
In their view, as long as Jovan and the others took action, Connor’s fate would surely be extremely miserable!
Rich heirs were actually quite common.
In general, if a family had several million or tens of millions, in the eyes of ordinary people, they could be considered rich second generations.
And if a family had several billion, they would be considered top-tier rich second generations among the rich second generations.
Therefore, different families of rich second generations were also divided into several different levels.
Penn’s level was lower than Sheldon and Harold’s, while Sheldon and Harold’s level was lower than Leroy’s, and Leroy’s level was lower than Jovan and the others.
When Jovan and the others were in Davenport, they met Sheldon and Harold, and their relationships were very good. So if Harold were to speak up, Jovan, Arthur, Henny, and the others would definitely not stand by.
As long as these people joined forces, even in the whole of Oprana, there would hardly be anyone who could resist.
“Sheldon, go tell Sabrina and Sadie that we’ll go back tomorrow…”
After thinking for a moment, Harold said softly to Sheldon.
“Go back tomorrow? We haven’t had much fun yet. Why go back so early?”
Sheldon, upon hearing Harold’s words, had a puzzled expression on his face and asked with a tone of helplessness.
“I don’t want to see Connor now. Whenever I see him, I get annoyed. Let’s just go back early…”
Harold replied in a low voice.
“Alright!”
Sheldon looked at Harold, nodded helplessly, and then got up and walked towards the villa’s exit.

chapters.title: Chapter 880: There's Something I Didn't Tell You
chapters.content:
Chapter 880: There’s Something I Didn’t Tell You
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
On the other side.
At this moment, Connor naturally didn’t know that Harold and Sheldon were discussing how to deal with him.
He, along with Jaden, Tobias, Sabrina, and others, had a great time playing in the resort all day.
The entertainment facilities in this resort were very rich, so they didn’t return to their rooms until 10 o’clock at night.
Meanwhile, Sabrina went to the villa where Sadie and Yara were staying alone.
Because Sadie and Yara didn’t like Connor very much, they didn’t go out to play with him and the others.
Sheldon, Harold, and others were discussing how to deal with Connor in their room, so the two girls stayed in the room all day.
“What’s Harold up to? We finally came out to play, but we’re going back tomorrow. We didn’t go anywhere today. Isn’t that a waste of time?”
Yara received a message from Sheldon and was preparing to return to Porthampton tomorrow.
“Harold must have something important, that’s why he’s so anxious. We can come again next time!”
Sadie comforted lightly, but she seemed distracted.
“Hmph, I’m never coming out with you guys again. What’s the meaning of all this?”
Yara pouted and said unhappily.
“Yara, Sadie, what are you two talking about?”
At that moment, Sabrina walked up to them, smiling, and asked, “We didn’t talk about anything. Harold said we’re going back tomorrow morning, and we haven’t played anywhere yet. It’s such a waste of time.”
Yara replied helplessly.
“Going back tomorrow?”
After hearing this, Sabrina’s eyes flashed with surprise, then she hurriedly walked to Yara’s side and asked softly, “Why are you in such a hurry to go back?”
“I don’t know why, but he just said he wants to go back…”
Yara turned her head to look at Sabrina and said indifferently, “Sabrina, you’re not planning to stay here, right? Let me tell you, tomorrow you’re going back with us. I can’t leave you here to give that poor loser Connor a chance…”
“Yating, what nonsense are you talking about? Of course, I’m going back with you. After all, it’s a class reunion with Connor. It wouldn’t be right for me to stay here alone…”
Although Sabrina had the intention to stay, after hearing what Yara said, she felt embarrassed to stay.
“Oh, by the way, I made a deal with Connor. We were planning to go to Temple Of Spirits tomorrow, but it seems like we won’t be able to go now. I’m going to call Connor now!”
Sabrina took out her phone and was about to walk outside the villa.
“Sabrina, wait…”
Sadie called expressionlessly.
“Sadie, what’s the matter?”
She turned her head to look at Sabrina, her expression puzzled, and asked.
“I have something to ask you. Come with me!”
Sadie said in a serious tone, then walked directly towards her room.
She was stunned for a moment, then hurriedly followed Sadie into the room.
“Sadie, what’s the serious matter you want to ask me about?” Sabrina stood at the door, looking puzzled as she spoke to Sadie.
“Sabrina, do you know that Connor and the others have moved into the villa?” Sadie asked softly.
“I know.” Sabrina nodded gently.
“Did you arrange the villa for him and the others through Leroy?” Sadie continued to ask.
“How could I have such ability? How could I possibly know someone like Leroy?” Sabrina said helplessly.
“If it’s not related to you, then how do you explain the sudden change in Leroy’s attitude towards Connor and the others last night? How do you explain them moving into the villa today? These things are definitely not a coincidence. If it’s not related to you, then who is it related to?” Sadie’s tone seemed somewhat agitated as she exclaimed.
These questions had been bothering Sadie. She felt that these matters were definitely not as simple as she had thought.
If it was all because of her that Connor and the others received such treatment, Sadie could reluctantly accept it.
But now that these things had nothing to do with Sabrina, how could she explain them?
“Sadie, it seems like these things have nothing to do with us, right? Why are you suddenly asking about them?” She furrowed her brows and asked Sadie in a puzzled tone.
“Yes, these things indeed have nothing to do with us, but have you ever thought about the connection between these things and Connor? Could he be not as simple as we imagine? He might have been hiding his identity all along!” Sadie shouted with a hint of agitated in her voice.
“What does it have to do with him?” Sabrina’s eyes flashed with a hint of surprise, then she softly said to Sadie, “Sadie, there’s actually something I haven’t told you…”
“What is it?” Sadie paused for a moment, looking puzzled as she asked her.
“Do you remember this jade bracelet?” Sabrina took off the phoenix blood jade bracelet that Connor had given her from her wrist and asked softly.
“I don’t remember…” Sadie shook her head lightly.
“This jade bracelet was given to me by Connor. You all said it was fake, but my father had it appraised by experts, and it turned out to be a phoenix blood jade bracelet worth possibly over ten million…” Sabrina said slowly.
“Over ten million?” Sadie couldn’t help but gasp when she heard this.
You should know that this “over ten million” was still Sabrina’s modest estimation. In fact, the price of this jade bracelet was at least fifty million or more, and it wasn’t something you could buy even if you were rich.
“How could he give you such a valuable jade bracelet? Where did this jade bracelet come from? Did he steal it?” Sadie looked at her with a puzzled expression.
“It seems like this jade bracelet was also given to Connor by someone else, but if he could give me such a valuable item, I feel like he should also be someone extraordinary, right? And…” Sabrina hesitated.
“And what?” Sadie hurriedly asked.
“And my father told me that if I had to choose between Harold and Connor, I should choose Connor…” Sabrina said shyly.
“Why?” Sadie became even more puzzled at this point.
“I don’t know why, but my father said that one hundred Harold can’t compare to one Connor!” Sabrina whispered.
“One hundred Harold can’t compare… to one Connor?” Sadie was dumbfounded upon hearing this sentence.

chapters.title: Chapter 881: Sadie's Interrogation
chapters.content:
Chapter 881: Sadie’s Interrogation
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Sadie was well aware of the kind of person Sabrina’s father, Charles, was.
Even her own father, Tony, held Charles in high regard.
After all, Charles was a man who could rival Thomas!
But when Sadie heard Charles’s evaluation of Connor, her expression immediately turned extremely shocked.
“One hundred Harolds can’t compare to one Connor?”
The information implied in this sentence was too complex. Harold’s father was about to be promoted to the Deputy Chief of War, and Harold’s future was limitless.
Even now, he could be considered one of the successful rich heirs among others.
Although he couldn’t be called the top-tier among the rich heirs, not everyone could be compared to him.
Harold’s future path was likely to become smoother and smoother, but Connor was just a poor boy who made a living delivering takeout.
She couldn’t understand why Connor could be compared to Harold.
And where did Connor get the expensive Phoenix Blood Jade bracelet he gave to Sabrina?
A series of questions swirled in Sadie’s mind.
“Sabrina, do you know who this Connor really is?” Sadie hesitated for a moment before asking her softly.
Sabrina’s eyes flashed a hint of helplessness, and she whispered, “I asked my father the same question before, but he didn’t answer me at all. He just told me to try to get along well with Connor and didn’t say anything else…”
Sadie took a deep breath as she looked at Sabrina. She knew that if she wanted to understand what was really going on, there was only one way—to directly find Connor and ask him about it.
So Sadie stood up directly and walked towards the door of the room.
When Sabrina saw that Sadie seemed to be leaving, she quickly asked in a low voice, “Sadie, where are you going?”
“I’m going to find Connor and ask him something!” She didn’t conceal anything and replied in a low voice.
At this point, she couldn’t be at peace without clarifying this matter. They would be leaving tomorrow, and she didn’t know when they would have a chance to meet Connor again. Therefore, Sadie planned to find out the truth now.
Sabrina looked at Sadie’s back and a hint of confusion flashed in her eyes.
Because she couldn’t understand why Sadie suddenly became so interested in Connor. Previously, Sadie had always been indifferent towards Connor, but today’s Sadie was clearly acting unusual.
…
On the other side, inside the villa where Connor and Tobias lived.
Since Roxanne had left the resort, Jaden had nothing to do and had moved into Connor and Tobias’s villa.
At this moment, Connor, Tobias, and Jaden were playing Landlord while chatting. Jaden’s mood seemed to have improved a lot.
When Sadie entered the villa, she happened to see Connor sitting on the sofa playing cards. A hint of helplessness flashed in her eyes.
Because at this moment, both Jaden and Tobias had a somewhat ordinary appearance, and there was a significant gap between them and the identity Sadie had speculated.
But Sadie had no intention of leaving because she was now even more curious about Connor’s situation.
“Sadie, you’re here?”
Although Sadie had always been very cold towards Connor, Connor was very enthusiastic towards her.
But this wasn’t because Connor had feelings for Sadie, it was mainly because for Sadie’s mother, Candace’s sake.
Regardless, Candace treated him very well like he was her nephew and it deeply moved him.
“Connor, come out with me. I have something to tell you!”
Sadie spoke in a commanding tone, her voice icy cold.
Tobias and Jaden exchanged puzzled glances upon hearing her words.
Without asking further, Connor stood up and followed her outside the villa.
After leaving the villa, she found a bench and sat down.
Connor walked over and sat opposite Sadie, taking slow steps. He then softly asked, “Sadie, what’s the matter?”
“Connor, who are you really?”
Sadie coldly asked Connor.
“Who am I?”
Connor was puzzled by Sadie’s question.
“That’s right, who are you really?”
Sadie repeated in a low voice.
“I am who I am. Who else could I be?”
Connor replied with a smile.
“Connor, stop pretending. Your parents passed away when you were young, and you worked hard to support yourself through high school and middle school. I know this better than anyone else. My mother has mentioned you to me more than once, and at that time, I felt really sorry for you. But now you’re different…”
The more Sadie spoke, the colder her tone became, and the angrier her eyes grew.
“How am I different?”
Connor asked calmly.
“You gave Sabrina a jade bracelet worth millions. Tell me, where did that bracelet come from?”
“And yesterday at dinner, Leroy showed great respect for you. Today, he changed the villa for you, and your friends also moved into the villa. What’s going on?”
“And you’re not afraid of Sheldon and Harold’s provocation at all. What kind of relationship do you have with Madison? Why do you know someone like Madison?”
She stared at him, her tone filled with emotions.
He remained calm upon hearing these questions and didn’t rush to explain.
“Connor, you must explain all these things to me today!”
When Sadie saw that he didn’t speak, she aggressively demanded.
“I’m sorry, but I don’t think I have any obligation to explain these things to you. Do you have any other business?” he coldly replied.
“Connor, if you don’t explain these things to me today, I will call my mother now!”
Sadie directly reached out and stopped Connor, shouting loudly.
Upon hearing Sadie’s words, Connor couldn’t help but glance at her, then he calmly said with a blank expression, “Even if I tell you some things, you won’t believe them. What benefits do you gain from prying into all this?”
“You haven’t said anything yet. How do you know I won’t believe you?”
Sadie stubbornly exclaimed.

chapters.title: Chapter 882: You Are Mr. Connor?
chapters.content:
Chapter 882: You Are Mr. Connor?
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Connor looked at Sadie in front of him, his expression showing a hint of helplessness.
He knew it must have been Leroy’s unusual reaction earlier that made her curious.
After all, they were not foolish. Leroy seemed like a different person after seeing Connor, indicating that there must be something going on.
Tobias, Jaden and the others didn’t know about Sabrina’s background, so they thought everything might be related to her.
But Sadie was very clear about Sabrina. She knew that this matter had absolutely nothing to do with Sabrina.
That’s why Sadie was so eager to get to the bottom of this.
And Connor also knew that if she didn’t clarify the matter today, she would definitely not give up.
So he sighed helplessly and whispered to Sadie, “Well, since you want to know so much, I’ll tell you…”
Sadie looked at Connor with a determined gaze. It seemed that she had made up her mind to find out the truth no matter what.
“Actually, I am the Mr. Connor mentioned by Leroy…”
Connor said calmly.
“You are Mr. Connor?”
Sadie’s mouth opened wide in disbelief upon hearing Connor’s words. Her expression seemed incredibly incredulous.
“That’s right, I am the Mr. Connor you all have been discussing!”
“Thomas, Kyle and Charles are all under my command!”
“And I have many CEOs of listed companies under me. My net worth has long exceeded trillions of US dollars!”
“My company has a presence all over the world, in various industries!”
“A while ago, I defeated Benjamin in the martial arts competition in Lion City, so now the big shots of the four provinces listen to me!”
“Madison’s grandfather, Luke, knows my identity and introduced Madison to me on his own initiative!”
“The jade pendant I gave to Sabrina was also given to me by Madison. A few tens of millions is just a number for me. I don’t care about it at all!”
Connor spoke slowly to Sadie, his expression unusually calm.
“I am not only the richest man in Davenport, but also the richest man in Oprana. I can even say that I am the richest person in the world!”
“Now, do you have any more questions?”
After hearing Connor’s words, Sadie’s expression was not shocked at all. On the contrary, she seemed very indifferent, with a hint of coldness in her eyes.
“Are you now going to ask me why I became so rich?”
Connor asked Sadie in a cold voice.
“That’s enough, Connor!”
But Sadie suddenly shouted, her expression angry as she looked at Connor in front of her.
“Connor, I know you have always lived at the bottom of society, accumulating a lot of resentment in your heart. I really wanted to believe what you said, but…”
Sadie took a deep breath and continued, “But, your ability to brag is really too low. If you had made up any other identity, maybe I would have believed you today. But what you said is a bit too ridiculous!”
“Then who do you think is more ridiculous between the two of us?”
Connor looked at Sadie and said calmly.
“I feel like coming to see you today was a huge mistake. I don’t want to inquire about your affairs anymore because there isn’t a single truthful word in your mouth. But Connor, I want to tell you that no matter how you contact people like Madison and Leroy, they can never become your support!”
“Madison herself is a girl and she can’t possibly take over the Phillips family’s business in the future!”
“Leroy’s father, Jaxon, is a well-known figure in society. He might fall from grace at any time. When that happens, I hope you’ll still have the chance to talk to me, rather than my mother taking me to visit you in prison!”
“Lastly, I’m not saying all this because I care about you. Whether you go to jail or not has nothing to do with me. I’m only worried that my mother will be heartbroken because of you. You’re not worth my mother’s sadness!”
Sadie was a very intelligent. She believed that Connor meeting people like Leroy and Madison was definitely not a coincidence. But there must also be some things that ordinary people don’t know.
Sadie was worried that Connor might go astray, which was why she is so anxious to know about him.
But when she heard his response, she felt that he was treating her like a child. His words were unrealistic.
She’s worried that he would sink deeper into the lies and ultimately ruined his own life.
Of course, what Sadie was most concerned about is that Connor’s situation will affect her family.
Otherwise, she would never proactively say these things to him.
As Connor looked at Sadie in front of him, he took a deep breath and said lightly, “I’ve told you before, even if I say it, you won’t believe it. Ordinary people like you have no way of accepting these things. You’re the one who insisted on me telling you!”
“Alright, alright, Connor. I really don’t have the mood to listen to your nonsense anymore. I’ve said what I wanted to say. As for what you plan to do, that’s your business. But after I go back, I’ll try to keep my mother away from someone like you. I don’t want you to affect my family!”
Sadie waved her hand at Connor and then walked away into the distance.
At this moment, Sadie was also very angry. After all, she came to advise Connor with good intentions, but she didn’t expect him to talk nonsense like this. Sadie felt that she was being too redundant.
Just the thought of what Connor said made her laugh. Even if he’s bragging, it shouldn’t be to this extent, right?
“Mr. Connor?”
Sadie couldn’t help but sneer in her heart and said lightly, “You, a loser, dare to call yourself Mr. Connor. You’re truly beyond redemption. Although you were poor before, you weren’t delusional like this. I didn’t expect that in a few years, you would become like this!”
Connor looked at Sadie’s departing figure, a hint of helplessness flashed in his eyes. He shook his head gently and sighed, “Sometimes, even if I reveal my identity, what difference does it make? Who would believe that all of this is real? Ordinary people simply can’t understand these things. Even I find them unbelievable, let alone them!”
“Connor!”
But at that moment, Sadie, who had already walked nearly fifty meters away, suddenly turned around and shouted at Connor.
“Do you have anything else to say?”
Connor slowly raised his head and looked at Sadie, his expression puzzled as he asked.

chapters.title: Chapter 883: Who Would Be Willing to Be a Lapdog?
chapters.content:
Chapter 883: Who Would Be Willing to Be a Lapdog?
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
“Connor, the things you just said to me, I advise you not to tell anyone else, otherwise, everyone will think you’re crazy!”
Sadie said with a disgusted expression towards Connor.
He shook his head helplessly and didn’t say much.
“Also, I hope you stop provoking Sheldon and Harold!” she continued shouting at him.
“I don’t think I’ve ever provoked them, have I?” he replied casually.
“I just want to remind you not to antagonize them anymore. Although you now know people like Leroy and Madison, there will come a day when you will lose their protection. By then, you will be in trouble. Also, Harold has found someone to deal with you. Be careful!”
As Sadie said these words, her tone became noticeably gentler.
Regardless of her motives, she was doing it for his own good. Her words were meant to help him.
“I understand.”
He looked at her and nodded gently.
“And one last thing…”
Sadie frowned and then spoke in a low voice, “Although this matter has nothing to do with me, as Sabrina’s best friend, I feel obligated to advise you. You’re not worthy of her. I hope you stop bothering her.”
“Heh…”
Upon hearing her words, he couldn’t help but laugh helplessly, unsure of what to say.
It was at this moment that he realized Sadie was quite a thoughtful girl.
“Alright, I’ve said everything I wanted to say. As for what you want to do, it’s none of my business!”
Sadie coldly threw those words and walked ahead.
Connor watched her figure and sighed softly without saying anything.
Sadie returned to her villa.
“Sadie, how did your conversation with Connor go? Did you find out about his identity?”
When Sabrina saw Sadie come back, she hurriedly ran up to her, her tone anxious.
Sadie remembered the things Connor had told her and sighed helplessly, then said calmly, “Connor is just a crazy guy who likes to brag. I don’t need to waste my time on him…”
Sabrina looked at Sadie, her eyes showing a hint of confusion.
…
On the other side, Connor also returned to the villa.
“Connor, you’re back!”
Jaden greeted Connor with a smile when he saw him coming back.
“Yeah…”
Connor nodded gently.
“There’s a pool table upstairs. Let’s play a few rounds…”
Jaden’s mood had clearly improved, and he put his arm around Connor’s shoulder, saying cheerfully.
“Sure!”
Connor agreed and followed Jaden upstairs.
His pool skills were average, but perhaps due to his martial arts training, his accuracy and strength had greatly improved, making him much more precise when playing pool.
They played for about half an hour, and in the end, Jaden was miserably defeated.
“Let’s stop playing. When did you become so good at this?”
Jaden, feeling frustrated by Connor’s dominance, complained with a annoyed expression.
“I used to work part-time at a bar and would play with customers in my free time, so my skills improved…”
Connor explained with a smile.
“I knew it! Back in high school, you were no match for me. Now you’ve become so skilled…”
Jaden speaks while taking out two bottles of drinks from the refrigerator and throws one to Connor, then opens one for himself.
“Connor, I want to ask you something!”
Jaden walks up to him and speaks softly.
“Is it about Roxanne?” Connor asks calmly.
“How did you know?”
After hearing his question, Jaden froze in place, wearing an incredibly astonished expression on his face.
“Why else would you have something to ask me?”
Connor smiles.
“I actually wanted to ask you how you managed to forget about Mandy. What Roxanne did to me was indeed very excessive, but I genuinely like her. I can’t forget about her at all now, and I’m worried that when I go back to school, I won’t be able to resist her temptation and end up being with her…”
Jaden says with great distress.
“How did I forget about Mandy? Well, once I saw through the true nature of that woman, I just forgot about her…”
Connor looks at Jaden, hesitates for a moment, and then smiles wryly, “As for how I saw through her, you can’t see through Roxanne right now either. Even if you ask me, it won’t be of any use. Since you still have her in your heart, then continue to be with her. When you see through her, you’ll leave her on your own…”
When it comes to matters of the heart, Connor is not very clear, so he doesn’t know how to advise Jaden.
“But I’m worried that such a thing will happen again. When that time comes, if I see her leave with another man, I might not be able to bear it even more!”
Jaden says in a low voice.
“Don’t worry, Roxanne won’t leave with another man…”
Connor says with a cheerful smile.
“How do you know?”
Jaden’s expression appears somewhat puzzled.
“Because you are outstanding, and I believe that as long as Roxanne is smart enough, she won’t leave you…”
Connor casually responds.
Upon hearing Connor’s words, Jaden can’t help but laugh awkwardly, then scratches his head and says apologetically, “Connor, do you think I’m pathetic? Even though Roxanne has treated me this way, I might just be a lapdog in her eyes, but I still can’t forget her. I simply like her…”
“If it weren’t genuine love, who would be willing to be a lapdog?”
Connor takes a deep breath and says softly.
In fact, Connor understands Jaden’s current state of mind very well. It was the same with Connor and Mandy. Despite knowing that Mandy, that kind of woman, couldn’t be with him forever, Connor still chose to give everything he had selflessly.
No one can explain why!
However, Connor has long seen through these things, but Jaden still hasn’t.
Connor doesn’t forcefully advise him to break up with Roxanne because he believes it’s his own decision. The only thing Connor can do now is to ensure that Roxanne doesn’t harm him in the future.
As for other matters, Connor doesn’t want to meddle in them and can’t meddle in them!

chapters.title: Chapter 884: Laris Ancient Town
chapters.content:
Chapter 884: Laris Ancient Town
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
The next day, early morning.
Sabrina, Sadie, Harold, Sheldon, and others left the resort.
Connor took the initiative to accompany Sabrina to the car, while Harold and Sheldon ignored him.
They knew it wasn’t a wise choice to provoke him at the moment. They could wait until Jovan returned to Porthampton before dealing with him.
By then, regardless of his background, Harold and Sheldon wouldn’t be afraid of him.
After seeing off Sabrina, Connor, Jaden, Tobias, Wilhelmina, and Yasmin drove towards a famous temple near the resort.
The name of that temple was Temple Of Spirits.
Temple Of Spirits was located in Laris town, not far from the resort.
After about half an hour, Connor and the others arrived at Temple Of Spirits.
Temple Of Spirits was bustling with activity, as wealthy tourists who came to the resort would usually choose to visit here and pray to the gods, while also taking the opportunity to visit Laris Ancient Town.
Laris Ancient Town had a history of over a hundred years, and all the buildings inside retained their appearance from centuries ago.
Moreover, it was common for film crews to choose this place for shooting, so it was not unusual to encounter some popular celebrities in Temple Of Spirits.
That’s why everyone was interested in the temples at this moment.
Half an hour later, Jaden and Wilhelmina parked the car outside Laris Ancient Town and walked into the town on foot.
Since all the roads inside were paved with bluestones, vehicles were not allowed.
