Upon entering Laris Ancient Town, Connor immediately felt a strong ancient atmosphere enveloping him. Various ancient buildings appeared before their eyes, and they could even see graceful women in Hanfu shuttling back and forth on the streets, giving the feeling of traveling back in time.
“Jaden, what should we do first?”
Wilhelmina walked gracefully with her fair and slender legs and asked Jaden with a smiling face.
“First, let’s go to Temple Of Spirits to light incense and pray. After that, we can have a meal in Laris town and then go to the Laris Hot Spring to soak in the hot springs. We’ll return to the resort when it gets dark…”
Jaden thought for a moment and replied softly.
“The resort already has hot springs, right? Why do we need to come here to soak in the hot springs?”
Wilhelmina was momentarily puzzled and asked Jaden with a puzzled expression.
“Oh, don’t you know? The hot springs in the resort are artificial, and you can find them anywhere. But the hot springs in Laris town are different. They are natural and formed by nature. It is said that soaking in them brings good luck and enhances health. Since we’re already in Laris town, there’s no reason not to give it a try…”
Jaden said with a smile.
“I see…”
Wilhelmina nodded lightly and didn’t say anything more.
As they admired the scenery inside Laris town, the group eagerly walked towards Temple Of Spirits.
When they arrived at Temple Of Spirits, they found that it was already crowded with countless devout worshippers burning incense.
Although there were many tourists inside Temple Of Spirits, it didn’t feel chaotic at all. It had a sense of orderliness, and there was no noise at all, which was quite strange.
Connor and the others waited for almost half an hour before they finally finished offering incense.
And then they left the temple and planned to find a restaurant in Laris Town to have something to eat. In the afternoon, they would go to the Laris Hot Spring as Jaden mentioned and soak in the hot springs.
Following the address given to him by his friend in advance, Jaden searched for more than ten minutes inside Laris Ancient Town. Finally, he stopped in front of a restaurant that looked quaint and ancient. Then, with a smile, he said to Connor, “This restaurant is the one my friend recommended to me. It is said that the vegetarian food here is the most delicious. Many wealthy people come to this restaurant to have vegetarian meals. Let’s try it too!”
“Vegetarian food?”
Upon hearing Jaden’s words, Wilhelmina couldn’t help but pout her lips.
“You ate so much meat in the resort a few days ago. Aren’t you tired of it? I think vegetarian food is pretty good…”
Tobias said with a smile.
“Yeah, I also want to try it and have a change of taste…”
Yasmin nodded in agreement.
“Wilhelmina, let me tell you, the vegetarian food here is not ordinary vegetarian food. It tastes incredibly good, nothing like what you can find outside. We’re already in Laris Town, so naturally, we should try a proper vegetarian meal…”
Jaden whispered to Wilhelmina.
After hearing Jaden’s words, Wilhelmina’s eyes flashed with a hint of helplessness. She then nodded gently and said, “Fine, since you all want to have vegetarian food, let’s go in and give it a try!”
Seeing her agreement, Jaden quickly led everyone into the restaurant.
There weren’t many customers inside the restaurant at this time, and Connor and his group found a seat near the window.
“Take a look and see what you want to eat!”
Jaden directly handed the menu to Wilhelmina and Yasmin.
“I’m fine with anything…”
Yasmin had a very easygoing personality and smiled after glancing at the menu.
“The dishes here are quite expensive!”
However, Wilhelmina exclaimed softly after taking a quick look at the menu.
“This is a tourist attraction, so it’s normal for things to be a bit expensive!”
Connor said casually.
Upon hearing his words, Wilhelmina’s expression seemed somewhat shocked.
She looked up at Connor and then smiled brightly, saying, “Connor, that doesn’t sound like something you would say. I remember back when we were in high school, you even thought the food in our school cafeteria was expensive…”
“That was a long time ago. The current Connor is not the same as before!”
Tobias quickly explained on behalf of Connor.
“You’re right. I also feel that Connor has changed quite a bit. He’s different from before…”
Wilhelmina nodded lightly.
After hearing what everyone said, he faintly smiled and didn’t explain anything.
A few minutes later, she finished ordering the dishes.
As they chatted, they waited for the waiter to serve the food.
“Why does that woman look a bit familiar?”
Just then, Jaden suddenly looked puzzled and said, “Which woman?”
Tobias was momentarily confused and asked in a puzzled tone.
“The one sitting opposite us. I feel like I’ve seen her somewhere…”
Jaden spoke while looking towards the table across from them.
The others also looked over and saw a beautiful woman wearing sunglasses, bowing her head and playing with her phone.
In front of her were several dishes, but she hadn’t touched any of them.

chapters.title: Chapter 885: Meeting a Female Star
chapters.content:
Chapter 885: Meeting a Female Star
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
After hearing Jaden’s words, Connor also raised his head and glanced at the beautiful woman sitting across from him.
The woman wore a pair of large black sunglasses that almost covered half of her face, but they couldn’t hide her stunning beauty. Her delicate and fair face was revealed, and her slender swan-like neck looked even more beautiful against her coat.
Although Connor couldn’t see the woman’s appearance clearly, he could tell from her temperament that she was definitely a rare beauty.
At this moment, it seemed that the woman also noticed him and the others looking at her. Subconsciously, she turned to the side and continued playing with her phone, showing no intention of eating at all.
“I also feel that she looks a bit familiar…”
After hesitating for a moment, Tobias spoke softly.
“Hey, is there something wrong with you two? Why do you feel familiar when you see a beautiful woman? Haven’t you seen that she’s embarrassed? Let’s eat quickly…”
Wilhelmina frowned and exclaimed helplessly.
“Do you know who often comes to Laris Town besides tourists?”
Just then, Jaden whispered.
“Who?”
Tobias asked with a puzzled expression.
“Let me tell you, besides tourists, many film crews and celebrities also come to this place to shoot. This woman is still wearing sunglasses while eating, and her hat is always placed on the chair as if she’s afraid of being recognized. I think she might be a celebrity…”
Jaden turned his eyes and analyzed in a low voice.
“Stop making assumptions here. Which celebrity goes out without bodyguards? I think you’re just attracted to her beauty and want to ask for her Facebook…”
Wilhelmina pouted and said helplessly.
“Why does she wear sunglasses while eating then? Don’t you find it strange?”
Jaden seemed a bit unconvinced.
“Maybe she didn’t sleep well last night and has heavy dark circles, so she wore sunglasses. What’s so strange about that? Just eat your food…”
Wilhelmina said with great frustration.
A hint of helplessness flashed in Jaden’s eyes, but he didn’t say much, he just bowed his head and prepared to start eating.
On the other hand, Tobias seemed very interested in this woman. He had been observing her constantly and hesitated for a moment before taking out his phone, searching for a woman’s photo, and whispering to Jaden, “Does she look like this person?”
Jaden lowered his head and glanced at Tobias’s phone. The expression on his face looked shocked, and he excitedly said, “What do you mean ‘look like’? It’s obviously her!”
“Who are you talking about?”
Yasmin’s eyes flashed with curiosity as she frowned and asked.
“Who else could it be? This woman is definitely the top celebrity Tiffany Zamora! I’m absolutely sure. Her figure and appearance are exactly the same, and even her temperament is very similar…”
Jaden held Tobias’s phone and whispered in a low voice.
“Stop talking nonsense. She’s a top-tier female celebrity in our entertainment industry. They say she’s one of the four leading actresses and has reached the level of a film queen. Such a big celebrity wouldn’t come out alone without dozens of bodyguards. It doesn’t match her status!”
Wilhelmina said without hesitation.
“Maybe she just came out to have fun by herself. Do celebrities always have to bring bodyguards when they go out?”
Jaden directly refuted.
After all, the woman who appeared in front of them at this moment was so similar to Tiffany in the photo that it was hard not to associate the two.
“Alright, alright, even if she is Tiffany , it has nothing to do with us. Let’s just eat quickly…”
Connor smiled and persuaded.
“No, I want to get an autograph from Tiffany . I’m her loyal fan. If I miss this opportunity, I’ll regret it!”
Jaden exclaimed excitedly, then walked directly towards the woman’s location.
Wilhelmina looked at the expression on Jaden’s face and shook her head gently, not knowing what to say.
“Excuse me, are you Miss Tiffany ?”
Jaden walked up to the woman, his tone slightly nervous.
After hearing Jaden’s words, the woman slowly turned her head and gave Jaden a once-over.
“Um, please don’t be angry. I don’t want to take a photo with you. I’m your fan, and I just want to get your autograph…”
Jaden quickly explained.
Upon hearing this, the woman’s expression visibly relaxed. She slowly took off her sunglasses, revealing a beautiful face.
The woman appeared to be around twenty years old, wearing a tight-fitting T-shirt that accentuated her beautiful curves. Her ample chest gave off an enchanting allure, and her captivating eyes, delicate nose, and sensual lips with captivating lipstick completed her attractive appearance.
She wore a pair of light blue denim shorts on her lower body, showcasing her long and fair legs. Her feet were adorned with cute pink slippers. Overall, she exuded a sexy and playful vibe.
“You’re really Tiffany ?”
Jaden was dumbfounded upon seeing her appearance.
At this moment, the others were also dumbfounded. They all had their mouths wide open, wearing incredibly incredulous expressions on their faces.
They never expected to encounter the famous celebrity Tiffany in this small town!
Although Connor wasn’t particularly interested in celebrities in the entertainment industry, he still had some knowledge about Tiffany . She was currently a popular young actress in the entertainment industry, and her appearance fee was at least one million or more. Moreover, she had a staggering number of fans, far surpassing those small-time actresses like Florina.
Perhaps because Connor had some understanding of the entertainment industry and had come into contact with celebrities before, he remained relatively calm.
But the others couldn’t maintain their composure. They all rushed to Tiffany ‘s side.
“Miss Tiffany, can you give me an autograph?”
Jaden asked Tiffany excitedly.
“Of course, do you have a pen?”
Tiffany treated him and the others very amiably, smiling as she agreed.
“I’ll go borrow a pen right now…”
After hearing Tiffany ‘s response, Jaden realized that he didn’t have a pen with him. He quickly turned around and ran towards the waiter’s station.
A few minutes later, he borrowed a pen from the waiter and hurriedly returned to her side, handing her the pen.
“Where do you want me to sign?” she asked him softly.
“On my clothes, please. Right here on the shoulder…” he replied hastily.
Tiffany smiled and prepared to sign for Jaden.
But at that moment, a group of burly men in black suddenly barged into the restaurant.
Upon seeing this group of men, Tiffany’s expression became tense.

chapters.title: Chapter 886: Tiffany’s Troubles
chapters.content:
Chapter 886: Tiffany’s Troubles
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Seeing the group of men in black rushing into the restaurant, Tiffany’s expression clearly became flustered.
She hurriedly signed her name on Jaden’s clothes, then quickly picked up the cap and sunglasses on the table and said softly to Wilhelmina, Yasmin, and the others, “I’m sorry, I still have something to do. I’ll go first. Let’s meet again if we can!”
After saying this, Tiffany skillfully put on her cap and sunglasses, then turned around to leave.
The group of men in black walked toward Tiffany when they saw her.
The leader of the group was a bald man who said to Tiffany respectfully, “Miss Zamora, our boss wants to invite you over…”
“Didn’t I already tell you that I don’t know your boss? Please stop pestering me!” Tiffany scolded coldly.
“Miss Zamora, don’t joke with me. How can you not know our boss?”
The man laughed.
“Didn’t you hear me?”
Tiffany’s eyes flashed with anger. She was about to walk forward in her high heels, but the brawny man reached out and grabbed Tiffany’s arm. Tiffany began to struggle, but she was no match for him. After struggling for a while, the man managed to subdue her.
“What are you guys trying to do? How dare you touch a girl in broad daylight?”
Wilhelmina was born into a police family and had a fiery and straightforward personality since she was young. When she saw this situation, she naturally wouldn’t ignore it, so she directly shouted at them.
Connor, Tobias, and the other two boys also stood up.
Wilhelmina’s voice was loud, so when the customers in the restaurant heard her, they all turned to look at Tiffany.
When the bald man saw so many people staring at them, a hint of helplessness flashed across his face.
After all, they weren’t trying to kidnap Tiffany, so they were more or less nervous when they encountered such a situation.
“Please release her!” Tiffany shouted at the burly man coldly.
After hesitating for a moment, the burly man finally chose to let go of Tiffany and said helplessly, “Miss Zamora, can you not make things difficult for us? Our boss just wants to treat you to a meal…”
“I’ll tell you one last time. I don’t know your boss, and I won’t go eat with him!” Tiffany shouted expressionlessly.
Connor, Jaden, and Tobias stood behind her.
“Get out of here now, or I’ll call the police and say that you kidnapped me!” Wilhelmina took out her phone as she spoke.
These people just wanted to invite Tiffany to a meal. If the police were alerted because of this, it might be even more troublesome.
Therefore, the leader hesitated for a few seconds and then said in a low voice, “Alright, let’s go!”
After saying this, the burly man turned around and left without any hesitation. The others naturally followed after him.
Tiffany let out a long sigh of relief after seeing all the strong men leave.
“Miss Zamora, what were these people trying to do?” Jaden asked Tiffany softly after a moment of hesitation.
“I don’t know either. They have been pestering me for a while. However, I really have to thank you all for just now…” Tiffany said.
“It’s okay, it’s a small matter!”
Wilhelmina smiled happily and said in a low voice, “Miss Zamora, a famous celebrity like you should bring a few more bodyguards with you when you go out. You’re really in too much danger now…”
“I’ve been a little troubled recently and wanted to come out to relax. I didn’t want too many people to follow me, so I asked my bodyguards to take a break!”
Tiffany explained.
“So that’s how it is!” Wilhelmina nodded and continued, “Tiffany, I don’t think those people will let this go. They will probably still be waiting for you outside. Why don’t you wait for us so we can send you back after dinner? It’ll be safer that way. I saw that you didn’t eat anything just now, so you can eat with us…”
Wilhelmina was a very warm-hearted girl, so she took the initiative to invite Tiffany to dinner.
Tiffany subconsciously turned her head to look outside the restaurant and saw that those people were indeed waiting for her outside.
“Alright then. I’ve really troubled you guys today…”
Tiffany nodded slightly.
“There’s no trouble! As long as you take a photo with me later!”
Wilhelmina laughed.
“If it’s just a photo, then there’s no problem!” Tiffany nodded with a smile.
As they talked, they returned to the dining table. Because there was an empty seat next to Connor, Tiffany naturally sat beside him.
When Tiffany sat down, Connor could smell a fragrance coming off her. This fragrance had a hint of allure. It was probably a very expensive perfume, which was very different from the perfume used by ordinary girls.
Tiffany was wearing a tight-fitting T-shirt and a white windbreaker. However, the restaurant was still relatively warm. Tiffany probably didn’t want others to see that she was dressed so tightly.
But after a while, Tiffany seemed to feel a little hot, so she took off her windbreaker and placed it on the chair.
After Tiffany took off her windbreaker, her sexy and alluring figure was immediately exposed to Connor’s sight. Her exquisite face coupled with her black curly hair gave off an indescribable temptation.
Tiffany was indeed a big star. Every frown and smile emitted a seductive aura, which was very seductive.
Although Tiffany’s clothes looked very ordinary, they gave off a noble and elegant feeling on this woman. This was the most valuable thing about a female celebrity.
After Jaden, Tobias, Wilhelmina, and the others found out Tiffany’s true identity, they all became nervous. They had never had a meal with a celebrity before, so they were at a loss for what to do.
Only Connor had a calm expression and was eating quietly.
At this moment, he was really hungry.
Tiffany turned to look at Jaden and the others and said with a smile, “Why are you all looking at me? Hurry up and eat…”
“Tiffany, this is our first time eating with a big celebrity, so it’s inevitable that we’re a little nervous…”
Jaden said to Tiffany with a smile.

chapters.title: Chapter 887: Where Did Your Confidence Come From?
chapters.content:
Chapter 887: Where Did Your Confidence Come From?
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Tiffany smiled faintly after hearing Jaden’s words, then said softly,”” Celebrities are also celebrities. What are you guys nervous about? If you guys aren’t going to eat, then I’ll eat first…”
After saying this, Tiffany actually started eating, and her posture was especially elegant.
Yasmin and Wilhelmina looked at Tiffany with envy.
They both felt that she was too perfect. Whether it was her appearance or the temperament she exuded, she was so noble and elegant that it made people feel that she was out of reach.
Which woman wouldn’t want to be like Tiffany?
“Tiffany, did you come to Laris Town to pray?”
Jaden asked Tiffany curiously.
Tiffany nodded slightly. “Yes, I’ve encountered some troubles recently, so I wanted to come over and clear my mind. I heard that there are some hot springs nearby that seem to be very effective. I think I’ll give them a try…”
“Oh, you actually want to go to the hot springs? That’s great—we’re also preparing to go to the hot springs, so maybe we can go together later…”
Jaden shouted happily after hearing Tiffany’s words.
After hesitating for a moment, Tiffany did not refuse and nodded gently.
Although Tiffany was a big star, and it was reasonable to say that such a big star should not have any interactions with ordinary people, Tiffany was a very easygoing person. Though they had only known each other for a short while, they seemed to have become friends and chatted while eating.
Tiffany was originally from San Antonio, but recently, her career had not been very smooth.
The two endorsements that she had previously agreed on were inexplicably snatched away by someone in the end. Moreover, the two films that she had just finished filming could not be screened. This series of problems made Tiffany feel very stressed.
After all, the most important thing for a female celebrity was popularity. If her movies couldn’t even be released, then Tiffany might lose her popularity in the near future. It would still have a huge impact on her career.
After Tiffany returned to San Antonio, she had wanted to relax and then come to the Temple of Spirits to seek peace of mind.
However, she never expected that she would be taken in by a middle-aged tycoon. Not only was this middle-aged tycoon greasy, but he had also been married for many years. He had only seduced Tiffany for fun.
However, Tiffany was still considered a popular actress in Oprana. She would not bother with such a person.
Tiffany had a clear vision of where she wanted her career to go. She wanted to take advantage of her youth to film a few more movies so she could increase her popularity. Then, she would marry into a rich family. That way, her life would be complete.
Although Tiffany wouldn’t sell her body for fame and fortune, she wouldn’t mind getting a rich man to be her boyfriend during her years of fame.
Tiffany didn’t expect the middle-aged tycoon to be so persistent. She had already come to a small place like Laris Town, but his subordinates were still following her.
If it wasn’t for these people, Tiffany really wouldn’t know what to do.
Tiffany was a big star in the entertainment industry, so she usually came into contact with a lot of people. She was usually a very good judge of people.
Tiffany could feel that Connor’s family conditions should be okay, but probably not at the level of a rich heir. At most, they were probably a middle-class family.
After a short interaction, Tiffany discovered something strange.
That was Connor, who was sitting beside her!
Since Tiffany sat next to Connor, he had not taken the initiative to talk to her at all. He was very calm.
However, it was precisely this calm that made Tiffany feel a little incredulous.
One had to know that Tiffany was one of the four most popular actresses!
A normal person’s attitude towards Tiffany should be like Jaden and Tobias, who were at a loss. However, Connor had always been very calm.
“Could it be that this person doesn’t know me?”
A bold idea suddenly flashed through Tiffany’s mind. However, Tiffany quickly rejected this idea because she felt that if Connor really didn’t know her, her appearance and figure would be enough to attract him, but he had been eating all the time and didn’t even look at her.
This made Tiffany curious about Connor.
Tiffany could feel a trace of arrogance in Connor’s eyes. This arrogance was the kind of arrogance that was full of confidence, not the brainless arrogance of a rich heir.
Tiffany had come into contact with many big shots, but she had only seen such arrogance in the eyes of those big shots.
Connor was only in his early twenties, but he could do this. This was indeed unbelievable.
“Where did his confidence come from? Could it be that this boy was a young master from a big family?”
A bold idea flashed through Tiffany’s mind.
However, when Tiffany saw Connor’s attire, she quickly denied this idea and shook her head gently.
Tiffany felt that if Connor really had a powerful background, he wouldn’t be here and wouldn’t be dressed so plainly.
“Perhaps I’m thinking too much…”
Tiffany smiled faintly and stopped thinking about these things.
Half an hour later, everyone finished their meal and drove to the Laris Hot Springs in Laris Town.
Because there were many people who came to the hot spring every year, the hot springs were expanded into a holiday villa. The facilities inside were also very immaculate. Although it could not compare to Leroy Jovi’s holiday villa, the environment was still very good compared to ordinary villas.
The Laris Hot Springs were divided into high-grade open-air hot springs and ordinary open-air hot springs.
Ordinary outdoor hot springs were cheaper, but there were many people. Sometimes, the pool was full of people, and there was no place to stay.
This kind of hot spring was prepared for ordinary tourists.
However, the high-end outdoor hot springs were different and were very expensive. The entrance ticket cost 5,000 dollars. This price was not something that ordinary tourists could afford.
After all, most ordinary people’s monthly salary was only a few thousand dollars. They could not bear to spend this money on a hot spring.
Therefore, the environment in the high-grade hot spring was very good, and there were not many people.
Tiffany was a popular celebrity, so she naturally couldn’t go to an ordinary hot spring. Therefore, she took the initiative to help Connor, Tobias, Jaden, and the others buy tickets to the high-class hot spring. It was also to thank Connor and the others for helping her in the restaurant.
When Jaden and the others knew that Tiffany had taken the initiative to buy tickets for them, they were naturally very happy and did not refuse.
..

chapters.title: Chapter 888: Testing It Out
chapters.content:
Chapter 888: Testing It Out
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
After Connor and the others walked into the hot spring, they realized that there were not many people in the hot spring at this time.
Most of them were rich heirs or big-bellied CEOs with hot beauties in their arms.
“Alright, stop looking. Let’s go and change!”
Wilhelmina saw that Jaden had been staring at the beauty in the hot spring and called out helplessly.
“Who’s looking? I’m surveying the environment!” Jaden replied awkwardly, then followed Connor and the others into the locker room.
After entering the locker room, Connor took the initiative to buy swimming trunks for Jaden and Tobias. Connor was not very interested in soaking in the hot spring, so he bought a beach shirt for himself and prepared to wait for Jaden and Tobias outside.
Because boys changed faster, when Connor, Jaden, and Tobias came out, Tiffany, Wilhelmina, and Yasmin had not come out yet.
“Connor, your figure is quite good, isn’t it? Those are eight-pack abs…” Jaden commented.
“I’ve been delivering food all this time, man. I definitely can’t compare to rich heirs like you…”
Connor casually sat down on a beach chair while replying to Jaden indifferently.
In fact, Connor had always had a good figure. Whether it was his abdominal muscles or chest muscles, they were very developed. When he put on his clothes, he looked relatively thin, but when he took off his clothes, he was still very stylish.
This had something to do with Connor’s constant food deliveries, but it was more directly related to Connor’s martial arts practice.
“If only I had a figure like yours…”
Jaden looked at Connor and sighed with envy.
“You’ll be able to do it if you train more!” Connor said indifferently.
At this moment, Yasmin walked out of the changing room first.
Yasmin was wearing a conservative one-piece swimsuit, but her figure was still very good. Compared to ordinary girls, she could be considered a beauty.
“I didn’t expect our student representative’s figure to be so good. I always thought she was an air stewardess!”
Jaden muttered lowly, then turned to Tobias and said, “Toby, you will be blessed in the future…”
“Shut up…” Tobias cursed in frustration after hearing Jaden’s words.
At this moment, Wilhelmina walked out, wearing a pink bikini.
Wilhelmina was tall with a slender waist and long, fair legs. While wearing the bikini, her hot figure was bared to their gaze, and Tobias and Jaden were dumbfounded.
“I didn’t expect Wilhelmina’s figure to be so good…” Tobias stuttered with his eyes wide open.
“That’s right. It’s real nice…”
Jaden hurriedly followed up.
Wilhelmina’s figure was indeed not bad, but compared to Yelena and Chloe Lawson, she was still quite inferior, so Connor did not show too much surprise.
Tiffany was the last to appear. When she appeared in front of everyone, almost everyone turned to look at her with a shocked expression.
After all, Tiffany was a celebrity. The maintenance of her figure was not something that ordinary people could imagine.
Tiffany’s figure could be said to be the perfect body. It was as if every part of her body was perfect. Her slender legs, slender waist, and voluptuous figure were flawless.
In an instant, everyone around them turned to look at Tiffany.
Tiffany was wearing sunglasses, so they couldn’t see the expression on her face clearly. She took off her shoes and walked to the side of the hot spring. Then, she stuck out her foot to test the water temperature before entering the hot spring.
There were many high-class hot springs, but Tiffany’s aura was too strong, so no one dared to come over to her. Jaden, Tobias, and the others occupied another pool.
Connor didn’t like to soak in hot springs, so opted not to go with them. Instead, he sat on a recliner and rested.
A moment later, Tiffany stood up from the hot spring and put on the towel beside her.
After leaving the hot spring, Tiffany hesitated for two seconds, then walked to Connor’s side.
“Everyone’s at the hot springs. Why aren’t you going with them?” she asked.
“I’m not interested in soaking in hot springs…”
Connor replied indifferently.
“Oh, I see!”
Tiffany nodded slightly, then looked at Connor from head to toe and continued, “Connor, you look good and have a good figure, the way you dress is a little lacking. If you want to enter the entertainment industry, I can help you…”
“Enter the entertainment industry?” After hearing Tiffany’s words, Connor couldn’t help but be stunned for a moment. Then, he said with a smile, “I look ordinary, and I don’t know how to sing or act. Why would I want to enter the entertainment industry?”
“Who said that you have to be handsome and know how to sing and act to enter the industry? You’re still young—as long as you’re willing to learn, there’s still time for everything…” Tiffany said very seriously.
“Forget it. I’m not very interested in being a celebrity!”
Connor shook his head and refused her offer.
If Connor really wanted to be a celebrity, he would definitely have countless resources waiting for him. However, he was not interested in being a celebrity, nor did he want to get involved in the entertainment industry.
When Yelena wanted to become an actress, Connor had inwardly been a little opposed to the idea. However, becoming a celebrity had always been Yelena’s dream, so Connor did not stop her.
“Alright then!”
Tiffany looked at Connor and nodded slightly.
At this moment, Tiffany seemed to be even more curious about Connor’s identity. If Connor was really just an ordinary person, Tiffany felt that he would be very happy to accept this opportunity. However, he was very cold at this moment.
This meant that Connor probably didn’t like the opportunity she’d given him.
“I’m going back now. Please help me tell Jaden, Wilhelmina, and the others!” she said to Connor.
“Sure.”
Connor didn’t seem to have any intention of keeping her as he nodded.
Tiffany walked forward, but at this moment, the group of black-clothed men who harassed Tiffany came to the door again.
And this time, they were accompanied by a woman in her thirties.
When Tiffany saw the woman, she looked helpless. She frowned and shouted, “Petra, why are you here?”
“My dear Miss Zamora, are you trying to irritate me to death? I already told you that I had a dinner party today, so why did you still come out to play? And you’re even soaking in the hot spring here. What exactly do you want?”
The woman shouted with a depressed expression.

chapters.title: Chapter 889: We Know Max Coltman!
chapters.content:
Chapter 889: We Know Max Coltman!
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
The woman standing in front of Tiffany was about 30 years old.
At this moment, she was wearing a striped shirt that tightly wrapped around her full chest. She was wearing a pair of tight denim shorts that tightly stretched her hips, making her curves beautiful and seductive.
Connor could feel that this woman was Tiffany’s manager from the way she spoke to Tiffany.
“Petra, what’s going on?”
Tiffany frowned and asked Petra in a low voice.
Petra hesitated for a moment and whispered to Tiffany, “That boss specifically asked to see you. Now come with me…”
“I already told you that I’m not familiar with their boss. Why should I go over?”
Tiffany frowned and shouted stubbornly.
“Miss Zamora, I advise you to listen to your manager and come with us. If our boss really gets anxious from waiting, things will be troublesome…”
The bald man in the lead shouted impatiently.
After all, in his eyes, Tiffany was just an actress. It was indeed very rare for an actress to put on such airs.
“I’m not familiar with your boss…”
Tiffany didn’t seem to want to go over.
“You’d better stop fooling around with me. Mr. Jackel is here too. He’s waiting for you in the restaurant now…”
Tiffany’s manager, Petra, frowned and shouted helplessly.
“Mr. Jackal is here too?”
After Tiffany heard what the manager said, she was instantly stunned on the spot. The expression on her face was very incredulous.
In this place, you could provoke anyone, but not someone like Jaxon Jackel. Back then, a male celebrity had been slapped more than ten times by Jaxon in front of his fans because he had offended Jaxon. After that, the male actor apologized and was forced to grovel. In the end, he was lucky enough to survive.
Otherwise, Jaxon would not have let this male celebrity off so easily.
Therefore, Tiffany was very afraid of Jaxon.
“My lady, their boss is a big shot in San Antonio. He’s worth tens of billions and has an amazing background. When he heard that you were coming, he specially called his friends together because he wanted to meet you…”
The manager, Petra, looked at Tiffany and continued.
“Petra, I really…”
Tiffany’s expression still seemed hesitant.
“What do you mean? If you really make them angry, without even mentioning Jaxon, not even that boss will let you off easily. This kind of person is not someone we can offend…”
Petra shouted anxiously.
Tiffany was obviously wavering at this time. She frowned and asked Petra, “Petra, who is their boss?”
“Their boss is—”
Petra opened her mouth to speak, but was interrupted by a voice.
“Hello? What do you people want? Tiffany already said that she didn’t want to go over at all. Aren’t you guys going too far?”
Wilhelmina was born into a police family, and Tiffany was her idol. Therefore, when she saw this scene, she naturally stood up for Tiffany.
“…”
After hearing Wilhelmina’s words, the bald man turned his head and glared at her. “Little girl, there are some things that you cannot manage. I advise you not to be a busybody…”
“How am I being a busybody? Tiffany is my friend. Since she doesn’t want to go with you, none of you can take her away today…”
Wilhelmina walked up to Tiffany and shouted excitedly.
Jaden, Tobias, and the others also walked behind Wilhelmina.
Tiffany turned around and looked at the people in front of him. She was extremely touched.
She had never expected that these people would step forward to help her.
The leader of the men looked at Wilhelmina carefully and said, “The few of you, get lost now. Previously, we didn’t want to make a big deal out of this matter in the restaurant, so we didn’t make a move on the few of you. However, if you still meddle in other people’s business now, don’t blame me for not holding back…”
“Not holding back? What else can you do?”
Wilhelmina called out in disdain.
“What else?”
After hearing Wilhelmina’s words, the bald man couldn’t help but smile. He then said coldly, “Then I’ll show you what I can do today!”
“Thump thump thump…”
Hurried footsteps sounded from behind the man, and seven or eight burly men charged towards Wilhelmina and the others.
These brawny men were all tall and strong, and their faces were extremely fierce. One look and one could tell that they were not good people.
When Tobias and Jaden saw these burly men, they were instantly dumbfounded. The expressions on their faces also grew nervous.
No matter what, Tobias and Jaden were still students. They had never seen such a scene.
“Jaden…”
Wilhelmina seemed to be a little afraid at this moment. She couldn’t help but turn her head to look at Jaden.
“…”
Jaden took a deep breath and took a step forward to say to the bald man, “Brother, I know Mr. Coltman from San Antonio. Can you give me some face? If there’s anything, let’s talk it out…”
“Mr. Coltman?”
After hearing Jaden’s words, the bald man could not help but be stunned for a moment. The expression on his face was a little puzzled.
“That’s right, we know Mr. Coltman!”
Wilhelmina saw the change in the bald man’s expression and called out.
“What Mr. Coltman?”
The bald man asked Jaden in confusion.
“Mr. Coltman, Max Coltman!”
Jaden shouted without any hesitation.
At this time, the Mr. Coltman that Jaden was talking about was a very famous heir in Jaden’s school who usually had a good relationship with him. Jaden’s trip to Laris Town this time was also recommended by Max. He’d even told Jaden to mention his name if he encountered any trouble.
“F * ck, who is Max Coltman? Do any of you know Max?”
After hearing this name, the bald man’s expression was extremely disdainful. He could not help but turn around and shout at his lackeys behind him.

chapters.title: Chapter 890: Properly Discipline Her!
chapters.content:
Chapter 890: Properly Discipline Her!
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
San Antonio was vast and rich, and there were many rich heirs living there.
Therefore, when the bald man heard the name Max Coltman, his expression became cautious.
He seemed to be worried that this Max really had a terrifying background. It would not be good if he offended Max because of this matter.
The bald man turned around and looked at his underlings behind him. He frowned and shouted, “Do any of you know this Max Coltman?”
“He’s probably from the neighboring city, right? I’ve seen him twice before…”
One of the underlings probably knew Max, so he replied indifferently.
The bald man was stunned for a moment and asked in a puzzled tone, “What does his family do?”
“His family is in the printing business. His father is Micah Coltman!”
The lackey hurriedly replied.
“Haha…”
When the bald man heard this, a trace of disdain flashed across his eyes. Then, he shouted at Jaden, “I thought you would be able to find some powerful backer. I didn’t expect it to be a rich heir who just does printing. Let alone Max, even his father, Micah Coltman, wouldn’t dare to talk nonsense in front of me…”
“This…”
Jaden was stunned when he heard the bald man’s words. His expression was extremely awkward. He did not expect that Max would have so little influence. He originally thought that he could rely on Max to settle this matter!
“Alright, I am not in the mood to waste time with you. If you are more obedient, I can not touch you. If you do not know what’s good for you, don’t blame me for being rude…”
The bald man shouted at Wilhelmina and the others with a ferocious expression.
At this moment, Wilhelmina, Jaden, Tobias, Yasmin, and the others were all stunned on the spot. Their expressions were extremely ugly, and they did not know what to do.
The bald man’s eyes flashed with a hint of pride. He walked toward Tiffany and grabbed her slender and fair arm, trying to pull her out of the hot spring.
“What do you want?”
At this moment, Tiffany was only wearing a swimsuit and no clothes at all.
The bald man was obviously trying to take advantage of Tiffany.
Tiffany struggled instinctively.
“Miss Zamora, I’m not in the mood to waste time with you now. You’d better hurry up and leave with me…”
The bald man pulled Tiffany and shouted with a smile.
“Let go!”
Wilhelmina finally couldn’t take it anymore and rushed to the bald man.
“If I don’t let go, what can you do to me?”
The bald man sneered at Wilhelmina.
“Bastard!”
Wilhelmina’s eyes flashed with anger as she kicked his crotch.
“Bang!”
The bald man let out a blood-curdling scream before he was sent flying backward. He crashed into the hot spring, causing a large splash.
For a moment, everyone was stunned.
No one expected Wilhelmina to be so strong that she could send the bald man flying with a kick.
Wilhelmina had learned military boxing from her father since she was young. Moreover, she had just kicked the bald man’s vital point, so it was normal for her to easily kick him away.
After Tobias and Jaden saw this scene, a trace of helplessness flashed across their eyes. The two of them did not expect Wilhelmina to be so impulsive.
Connor couldn’t help but shake his head when he saw Wilhelmina’s attack.
Even though so many years had passed, her personality was still as fiery as ever.
Fortunately, Connor was here today. If he wasn’t here, then Wilhelmina’s kick might have caused big trouble.
Connor didn’t put these people in his eyes at all, so he let Wilhelmina and the others continue to make trouble.
“Big bro…”
“Big Bro, are you alright?”
When the bald man’s lackeys saw that he was kicked away by Wilhelmina, they quickly ran over to him and pulled him out of the hot spring.
This bald man was the cousin of their boss and had a very good relationship with him.
If the man was injured because of this, they would definitely die when they returned to headquarters.
Although Wilhelmina had indeed kicked the bald man in his vitals, he was lucky that he had thick skin and was not seriously injured.
The bald man wiped the water droplets off his face and shouted angrily. “How dare you f*cking kick me…”
“All of you get out of here, or I will beat all of you to a pulp today…”
Wilhelmina shouted angrily.
The bald man knew that Wilhelmina was indeed capable, so he turned his head and shouted at the thugs behind him, “What the f*ck are you all standing there for? Hurry up and capture this woman. I have to teach her a lesson tonight and let her know how powerful I am…”
Although Wilhelmina looked pure, her figure was extremely sexy.
Therefore, the bald man wanted to take Wilhelmina away and teach her a lesson.
“Thump thump thump…”
In an instant, seven or eight burly men charged toward Wilhelmina.
Wilhelmina saw these people rushing over, and a hint of nervousness flashed in her eyes.
Wilhelmina had learned military boxing from her father for a few years. If she were to face an ordinary person, shw might still be able to fight.
But at this moment, these thugs were all professionally trained. Wilhelmina would find it difficult to deal with one person, let alone so many people attacking at once.
Tiffany saw that something was wrong and hurriedly shouted. Her expression was very anxious. “What do you want? This matter today has nothing to do with them. All of you stop…!”
Tiffany knew that Wilhelmina had provoked these people so she could help her.
Now that Wilhelmina was in danger, Tiffany naturally would not sit idly by. However, these thugs had nothing to do with Tiffany, so they naturally wouldn’t listen to her.
“Petra, quickly think of a way to help!”
Tiffany quickly turned to look at Petra.
At this moment, Petra didn’t know what to do either. The boss behind the bald man had a very terrifying background. Very few people in San Antonio dared to provoke them. Now that Wilhelmina had offended these people, there was nothing she could do.
Jaden and Tobias were also very scared at this time, but they still stepped forward and stood in front of Wilhelmina. However, the two of them knew that they might not be as skilled as her.
“Bang!”
However, just as the burly men were about to reach Wilhelmina, a figure suddenly rushed out.

chapters.title: Chapter 891: They Are Not My Match!
chapters.content:
Chapter 891: They Are Not My Match!
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Just as the black-robed man was about to reach Wilhelmina and raise his fist to bring it down on her head…
A thin, weak figure rushed out, then raised his leg and kicked the burly man’s stomach.
“Ah…”
The brawny man screamed and flew aside.
Connor’s strength was too great. After the burly man’s body was flung away, he directly knocked into several people behind him.
Everyone present widened their eyes for a moment in complete disbelief.
Wilhelmina’s mouth was wide open as she looked at the person before her.
The person who had run before her was none other than Connor!
Wilhelmina, Jaden, Tobias, Yasmin, and the others knew Connor very well, but they didn’t know when Connor’s skills had become so good.
Tiffany’s eyes were also wide open as she looked at Connor. Her eyes were filled with disbelief.
She finally reacted. It turned out that the best among these people was Connor!
“Go back. Leave the rest to me!” Connor turned to look at Wilhelmina and said calmly.
“Connor…” Wilhelmina looked at Connor with hesitation.
“Don’t worry. They’re not my match!” Connor replied indifferently.
“…”
Wilhelmina was stunned for a moment before she hurriedly nodded at Connor.
Although they did not know how Connor’s skills had improved, they could feel Connor’s tone was very confident.
“We haven’t seen each other for a few years. Connor, how many secrets do you have?”
Jaden looked at Connor before him and could not help but sigh softly.
On the other side, the bald man was more or less shocked when he saw Connor send his subordinate flying with a kick. There was also a trace of fear in the eyes of those thugs. For a moment, they did not know what to do.
“Bro, this brat seems to know some martial arts…”
One of the lackeys hesitated before whispering to the bald man.
“What the f*ck are you afraid of? There are so many of us. Can’t we defeat this one guy?” The bald man in the lead widened his eyes and shouted.
“Bros, let’s attack together. I don’t believe this kid can defeat so many of us…”
One of the underlings shouted ferociously, then rushed toward Connor.
The rest of the thugs followed suit.
When Connor saw these people rushing over, a trace of disdain flashed in his eyes, and then he threw two punches in succession.
In an instant, the two thugs at the front were sent flying.
When Connor attacked just now, he did not use his full strength. Otherwise, Connor’s punch might have broken the ribs of these people.
For a moment, all the underlings present were dumbfounded.
They initially thought that Connor only knew some martial arts. With so many of them attacking together, they would be able to subdue this kid.
However, they never expected that they had no way to get close to Connor.
Even the bald man couldn’t help but look at Connor strangely. It was a competition to see who could beat this thin and weak-looking Connor who was so powerful.
“Connor, you’re so cool. When did you become so powerful?” Wilhelmina shouted excitedly.
Connor turned and looked at Wilhelmina without saying anything.
“Why are you all stunned? Didn’t you want to catch me? Didn’t you want to teach me a lesson? Why are you dumbfounded now? Come on, keep coming!” After Wilhelmina saw that Connor was so skilled, she relaxed. She shouted at the bald man provocatively.
When the bald man heard Wilhelmina’s provocation, a trace of anger flashed in his eyes. He glared at her and shouted,” All of you are a bunch of f*cking trash. There are so many of you, and you can’t even beat him?”
“Bro, this brat is powerful. We have no way of getting close to him…” One of the underlings said helplessly.
“You motherf*ckers have pig brains. Don’t you have weapons in your hands? Just grab your weapons and attack…” The bald man shouted angrily.
When the underlings heard the bald man’s words, they seemed hesitant.
After all, if it were just a fight, it would just be an ordinary fight. However, things might not be that simple if it was with weapons.
After all, there were so many of them attacking Connor alone. If they were not careful, they might kill Connor.
“What the f*ck are you all doing? Hurry up and kill this kid!” Seeing his lackeys hesitating, he shouted angrily.
They were all part-timers. They were worried that they might lose their jobs if they did not do what the bald man wanted.
“Bros, charge with me!”
One of the lackeys hesitated and felt this was the best opportunity for him to perform.
Therefore, without hesitation, he grabbed the machete behind him and rushed toward Connor.
When the other underlings saw someone rushing forward, they naturally did not dare to stay idle. They took out the things in their clothes one after another.
Some of these thugs held steel pipes, while others held machetes. They all rushed toward Connor.
For a moment, the scene suddenly became a little bleak.
The guests in the hot spring stood up and looked at Connor and the others curiously.
Wilhelmina was a little nervous as well. She hurriedly shouted, “Connor, you have to be careful!”
“Don’t worry, I’m fine…” Connor glanced at Wilhelmina and replied confidently.
After Wilhelmina heard Connor’s answer, she felt slightly more at ease but was still slightly worried about Connor. After all, the others had already taken out their weapons. Once they started fighting, no one knew what would happen.
Tiffany naturally did not want these people to continue fighting. She hurriedly shouted at Petra, “Petra, hurry up and think of a way. If this continues, someone will die!”
After hearing Tiffany’s words, a hint of helplessness flashed in Petra’s eyes. Then, she reached out and pulled Tiffany to the side. Then, she frowned and said, “Ms. Zamora, today’s matter has nothing to do with you. You’d better not be nosy…”

chapters.title: Chapter 892: Mr. Walters
chapters.content:
Chapter 892: Mr. Walters
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
“Petra, what nonsense are you talking about? I caused this, so how can it have nothing to do with me?” Tiffany asked angrily when hearing Petra’s words.
“My dear, haven’t you figured out the current situation? That bald man is Mr. Walters’s cousin, and Mr. Jackel is also here today. If you stand up for these people now, you are going against Mr. Walters and Mr. Jackel. Do you know what will happen if you offend these two people?” Petra said quickly.
“But I can’t just stand by and watch them die. This incident today was all caused by me. At most, I’ll apologize to them. I think they’ll be nice on my behalf…” Tiffany hurriedly replied.
“Honey, can you not best nosy? These people brought this upon themselves. We can’t afford to offend someone like Mr. Walters!” Petra grabbed Tiffany and shouted desperately.
“Mr. Walters?”
When Tiffany heard this name, she was surprised for a moment and a little puzzled. Then, she frowned and asked, “Petra, who is this Mr. Walters you’re talking about? Why haven’t I heard of him before?”
“Mr. Walters is a big boss in San Antonio with a net worth of over ten billion. I heard Mr. Walters has a good relationship with Mr. Jackel. No one in San Antonio dares to offend Mr. Walters. Mr. Walters invited you over to introduce you to Mr. Jackel, but I didn’t expect you to be so rude,” Petra said helplessly.
Tiffany’s expression changed when she heard what Petra said. She thought these people’s boss was just a rich heir, so she didn’t take them seriously.
However, she did not expect Mr. Walters to have such a terrifying background.
The celebrities in the entertainment industry were most afraid of people like Mr. Walters.
Whoever offended them would not have a good ending.
When Tiffany first entered the entertainment industry, she accidentally offended a big shot and was shelved for two years. In the end, she finally found a connection and obtained the big shot’s forgiveness. If this was really blown up today, it was very likely that Tiffany’s career would be ruined.
Therefore, no matter how famous a celebrity was in Oprana, they were most afraid of provoking such a VIP. Once such a person was furious, she could do anything.
Tiffany was apprehensive about Connor and the others. She knew Connor had attacked because of her, but she chose not to say anything.
To Tiffany, Connor and his friends were just strangers. It would not be worth it if she caused more trouble because of these strangers.
Seeing that Tiffany did not say anything, Petra heaved a sigh of relief and said, “I know these children have good hearts, but we have no choice. After this is over, we’ll make it up to them!”
“…”
Tiffany took a deep breath and didn’t say anything.
On the other side, all the thugs were already standing before Connor. The thug at the front held a machete and threw it at Connor’s head.
These people were very ruthless. They knew that people like Connor were not easy to deal with, so they tried to beat Connor to death.
The cold machete brought with it a whistling sound as it flew at Connor’s head.
If Connor did not dodge, he would be heavily injured even if he did not die!
“Connor!” Wilhelmina panicked when she saw that and quickly shouted at the top of her lungs.
As for Jaden and Tobias, they were already scared silly. Their gazes were dull as they looked at Connor, not knowing what to do.
After all, they were still students and had never experienced such a situation before!
Connor stood in place, his expression very calm.
In the eyes of ordinary people, this person’s attack speed was still very fast. He did not give Connor any time to prepare.
However, he was too slow for Connor.
Under everyone’s shocked gazes, Connor merely turned sideways and easily dodged the machete.
When the thug with the machete saw this, he was instantly dumbfounded. He stared at Connor incredulously.
He never thought that Connor’s reaction speed was so fast.
“Who is this kid? He’s moving too fast, isn’t he?”
The bald man stared at Connor and couldn’t help but inhale sharply in shock.
The onlookers were also in disbelief.
They felt that the scene just now was like a movie. Everything seemed so unreal, but now, such an unreal scene happened before them. How could they not be surprised?
Of course, the ones who were most surprised were Wilhelmina, Jaden, Tobias, and the others.
At this moment, Connor gave the three of them feeling like he had changed into a different person.
They had no way of believing that the man standing before them was the Connor they knew back then.
“You were lucky just now. I don’t believe that you can dodge it again…”
The thug shouted at Connor, his eyes bloodshot. Then, he waved his machete and rushed toward Connor again.
This time, the thug’s speed was faster than before, and his strength was greater. He did not believe that there was someone in this world who could react so quickly.
However, when the blade came down, the thug was dumbfounded again. He stood there with a dull gaze and an abnormally shocked expression.
Connor had easily dodged him.
“What kind of monster is this kid?” The thug looked at Connor and screamed.
Connor wasn’t in the mood to talk nonsense with him. He lifted his leg and kicked the thug’s stomach, sending him flying.
Everyone fell silent.

chapters.title: Chapter 893: Calling Mr. Jackel
chapters.content:
Chapter 893: Calling Mr. Jackel
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Originally, those thugs thought that as long as they attacked together, it would be effortless to beat Connor.
After all, they all had weapons, while Connor was alone and unarmed.
However, they never expected Connor to be so terrifying.
These people couldn’t even touch Connor!
Wilhelmina, Jaden, Tobias, and the others all had their mouths agape. They looked at Connor and didn’t know what to do.
Tiffany and her manager, Petra, were also shocked. They didn’t expect Connor to be so powerful.
When Tiffany was filming, she came into contact with some martial arts directors. Those martial arts directors were excellent, but compared to Connor, those people were like ants!
The speed at which Connor dodged the machete just now was not something ordinary people could imagine.
On the other side, the thugs who charged at Connor had almost been dealt with by Connor. They were all lying on the ground and wailing in pain.
Meanwhile, Connor stood calmly on the spot and looked at the bald man expressionlessly.
At this moment, the bald man was utterly dumbfounded. He looked at Connor foolishly, not knowing what to do.
Previously, this bald man thought that dealing with Connor should be easy.
However, he never expected that in the end, not only did he not teach Connor and the others a lesson, but he was also taught a lesson by Connor.
“Bro, our people are all down. What should we do now?”
At this moment, there was still one underling who had not fallen. He held a machete and asked the bald man while trembling.
A hint of panic flashed in the bald man’s eyes. Then, he stuttered, “What the f*ck can we do? Hurry up and call my cousin and ask him to come over with a gun. I don’t believe that there’s anyone in San Antonio that my cousin can’t deal with…”
“That’s right. We have to get Mr. Walters to bring people over now. We’re not a match for this kid at all!”
“That’s right. If Mr. Walters comes over, this kid will die…”
After the thugs knew they did not have to fight Connor, they hurriedly agreed excitedly.
In fact, these people did not want to fight a monster like Connor at all. They were not Connor’s match at all. Even if they fought, they would be beaten up.
“Kid, you do have some skills, but just you wait. I’ll call my cousin and get him to teach you a lesson…” The bald man stepped forward and shouted at Connor, his eyes bulging.
“Cousin?” Hearing the bald man’s words, a trace of disdain flashed in his eyes.
Although Connor didn’t know who this bald man’s cousin was, he wasn’t afraid of anyone. At most, he would reveal his identity. Connor didn’t believe anyone in San Antonio would dare to attack him unless the other party were Rockefeller’s people.
Connor looked indifferent, but there was a trace of fear in Petra’s eyes. She turned to Tiffany and said,” It’s over, it’s over. This has really blown up. They’re going to call Mr. Walters over. If Mr. Walters comes over, then this will be troublesome…”
“What do we do?” Tiffany replied in a low voice.
At this moment, Tiffany was still in shock from Connor. Tiffany could not understand why Connor was so good. Could Connor be a young man from a reclusive family?
Wilhelmina looked at the bald man with disdain and said coldly, “Even if you call your cousin over, he will still be beaten up by Connor…”
“Hah, just you wait. When my cousin comes over, let’s see if you still dare to be so arrogant…” the bald man replied softly.
Wilhelmina was a little nervous when she saw the bald man’s confidence.
After hesitating, she turned her head and said softly to Jaden, “Jaden, didn’t you say that you have a very powerful friend in San Antonio? Call him now and get them to come over and settle this. We’ll thank him properly later…”
A hint of helplessness flashed in Jaden’s eyes when he heard Wilhelmina’s words. He secretly sighed in his heart that he should not have bragged back then.
Max was indeed a rich heir, but his relationship with him was average. Moreover, from the bald man’s reaction just now, Max did not have much power in San Antonio, so Jaden did not know if Max could help him settle this.
However, after what Wilhelmina said, he took out his phone helplessly and called Max.
When the bald man saw that Jaden was about to call Max, a trace of disdain flashed in his eyes because he did not take Max seriously at all.
“Max, do you have time now? I ran into some trouble in San Antonio…” Jaden said in a low voice.
“What trouble? Didn’t I tell you? If you encounter any trouble, say my name…” the other party replied casually.
“Max, I told him your name, but the other party refused to let us go. If you have time, come over. I definitely won’t let you work for nothing…” Jaden begged humbly.
After all, Jaden had already said it. It would be embarrassing if he didn’t call him over.
“All right, where are you now? Send me the address. I’ll bring my men over now…” After hearing that there were benefits, Max quickly agreed.
A trace of excitement flashed in Jaden’s eyes, seeing that Max had agreed. He then hung up the phone and sent his address to Max.
“Well? Will he come?” Wilhelmina blinked and asked Jaden softly.
“Max said that he would come over in a while…” Jaden replied in a low voice.
“Good…” Wilhelmina let out a long sigh of relief.
Tiffany knew that the people called over by Jaden would not be of much use, so she turned and whispered to Petra, “Petra, why don’t you and I find Mr. Walters’s contact information? I’ll talk to Mr. Walters myself…”
“I don’t have Mr. Walters’s contact information!” Petra replied without thinking.
“Then, I’ll call Mr. Jackel now and ask him for help…” Tiffany’s eyes flashed with helplessness. He took out his phone and was about to call Jason.
“Girl, are you crazy? Is it worth calling Mr. Jackel because of such a small matter? What does it have to do with you whether these people live or die? Do you know what it means to make this call?” Petra exclaimed agitatedly.
“I…” Tiffany’s eyes flashed with a trace of helplessness. She did not know what to say.

chapters.title: Chapter 894: Tiffany's Regret
chapters.content:
Chapter 894: Tiffany’s Regret
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Recently, Tiffany’s career had not been very smooth.
Part of the reason was that the competition in the entertainment industry was too intense, but a large part was because of herself.
Tiffany could get to where she was today entirely because of her acting skills and good looks. She did not have any strong backing at all.
After all, one’s looks would gradually decrease with age.
As for acting skills, they were dispensable.
Therefore, the most essential thing in the entertainment industry was still the backstage.
If you had a strong background, even if you were average looking and had poor acting skills, you could still get many resources that ordinary people could not.
This was the same as Yelena back then. Florida bullied Yelena because she did not have a backer.
And Jaxon was a gangster, so he was naturally not a good person.
Jaxon had asked people to look for Tiffany several times. His goal was straightforward: he wanted to keep Tiffany as his mistress.
As long as Tiffany agreed, she could become an A-list female celebrity. Moreover, with her relationship with Jaxon, she could get many resources that she could not get before.
Tiffany was very disdainful of Jaxon’s request because she felt she would have done so long ago if she wanted to sell her body. There was no need to wait until now.
After Jaxon knew what Tiffany was thinking, he began to use his connections to deal with Tiffany.
If Tiffany were to throw away her celebrity halo, she would have no background at all. That was why Tiffany’s popularity was declining day by day.
If Tiffany took the initiative to contact Jaxon, it would mean that Tiffany had given in.
Once Tiffany compromised, it would be equivalent to all her previous efforts being in vain. That was why her manager, Petra, kept reminding Tiffany about it.
Hearing Petra’s words, Tiffany couldn’t help but turn to look at Connor and the others. She began to feel conflicted and didn’t know what to do for a moment.
Although Tiffany knew that she could solve everything with a phone call, once she made the call, it might mean the beginning of a nightmare for her.
Finding a strong backer could quickly help Tiffany out of her current predicament, but there were more long-term solutions. Once Jaxon got tired of her, Tiffany might not be comparable to those second-tier celebrities.
Tiffany didn’t agree to Jaxon’s request, not because she had a noble character, but because she didn’t want to become someone else’s plaything.
Once a female celebrity in the entertainment industry became a plaything in the hands of others, she was no different from a prostitute. No matter what she did, she had to bow to another. This was also the darkest part of the entertainment industry.
That was why Tiffany was so conflicted, not knowing what to do.
Was it worth it to make such a huge sacrifice just for a few people he was not familiar with?
Connor and the others had no idea what Tiffany was thinking.
Jaden was anxiously waiting for his reinforcements to arrive. Connor was sitting on the chair expressionlessly. Wilhelmina was still indifferent as if she did not realize the problem’s seriousness.
As for Tobias and Yasmin, they were ordinary people and had never experienced such a situation. Naturally, they did not know what to do.
***
Meanwhile.
San Antonio, in the Club Paradise.
At this moment, the clubhouse was brightly lit. More than ten middle-aged men surrounded a long table carved from red sandalwood.
These middle-aged men were all glamorous and had extraordinary auras. They chatted and laughed as they toasted.
These people could be considered VIPs of San Antonio. Any one of them was worth more than 100 million.
Club Paradise was also a place where VIPs gathered. Ordinary rich people didn’t even have the right to enter the club.
The Club Paradise’s owner was the head gangster of the mafia world, Jaxon Jackel.
Beside these bosses stood sexy and pretty bunny girls. If one looked closely, these bunny girls were all second and third-tier celebrities in the entertainment industry.
These celebrities were not qualified to dine with these big shots at all. They could only stand beside them and play the role of bunny girls, serving these bosses.
In the eyes of ordinary people, although these celebrities were not very famous, they were still existences that ordinary people could not touch. Their lives should be very glamorous, but who would have thought these celebrities would be so humble in front of these VIPs?
And among this group of big shots, the two people sitting in the main seat should have the highest status.
Both of them were in their fifties. One of them was wearing a black suit and looked elegant and easy-going. His standard square face had a faint smile, and his every move gave off a domineering aura. This was the aura formed by being in power for many years. Even if he didn’t speak, it was evident that this person’s background was definitely not simple.
This person was none other than Leroy’s father, Jaxon Jackel.
He was also the real boss of this clubhouse.
The other middle-aged man was older than Jaxon. He was wearing a Versace suit. He was fat and ugly. He had a fierce face and a big bald head. He gave people the feeling that he was a nouveau riche.
This person was the cousin of the bald man who had a conflict with Connor and the others. He was also a very famous boss in San Antonio, Herman Walters.
Herman had done many heartless things in San Antonio for so many years. The people in San Antonio hated and feared Herman. Very few people dared to provoke Herman.
“Mr. Jackel, I didn’t expect your Club Paradise to be doing so well. It’s really an eye-opener for me…” Herman said to Jaxon with a smile.
“As long as you are enjoying yourself…” Jaxon replied indifferently.
“I’m enjoying it, for sure. There are so many beautiful women entertaining me. What’s there to be unhappy about?” Herman laughed loudly, his expression extremely wretched.
Jaxon looked at Herman with disdain.
In fact, Jaxon was very disdainful of people like Herman. However, for the sake of his reputation, he would receive Herman so ceremoniously.
In terms of strength and status in San Antonio, Herman and Jaxon were on different levels.
Of course, there was another more important reason. Jaxon had heard that Tiffany would come today, so he was here for Tiffany.

chapters.title: Chapter 895: I Have Something To Ask Of You
chapters.content:
Chapter 895: I Have Something To Ask Of You
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
In Club Paradise.
Jaxon chatted with Herman and the others for about half an hour.
However, Jaxon realized that the seat beside him had always been empty. Tiffany had never appeared.
Therefore, Jaxon was more or less anxious, but he was too embarrassed to ask Herman what was going on, so he could only reply to Herman perfunctorily.
The reason Herman had dinner with Jaxon today was very simple. He had a favor to ask of Jaxon.
Herman had his eyes on a real estate development project some time ago, but with Herman’s current strength, he needed help to get this project.
That was why Herman thought of Jaxon. As long as Jaxon could help him, it would be easy for him to win this project.
However, Herman had nothing to convince Jaxon, so he finally focused on Tiffany.
Herman knew that Jaxon had always liked Tiffany very much. If he could help Jaxon get Tiffany, the rest of the matter would be smooth sailing.
This was also why Herman was so anxious to get the bald man and the others to bring Tiffany over.
However, after waiting half an hour, Herman still did not see Tiffany. Naturally, he was a little anxious.
Although Jaxon didn’t say anything, Herman could sense that Jaxon was getting impatient.
“Mr. Jackel, I heard you’ve been crazily expanding your territory recently!”
Herman hesitated before taking the initiative to find a topic and asked Jaxon with a smile.
“That’s because the bosses in San Antonio are giving in to Mr. McDonald. It has nothing to do with me!” Jaxon replied indifferently.
“Mr. McDonald?”
When Herman heard this name, he was shocked. A trace of confusion flashed in his eyes.
After all, someone of of Herman’s level wouldn’t be in contact with Mr. McDonald.
In addition, Herman was from San Antonio, so he didn’t know much about Connor.
“It’s Mr. McDonald from Davenport, the boss of Thomas Morgan and Kyle Hayes!” Jaxon explained.
“Thomas Morgan, the boss of Kyle Hayes?”
Although Jaxon had introduced Connor casually, just these few words were enough to shock everyone. This was enough to prove how strong Connor’s identity was.
Herman looked at Jaxon in disbelief.
“Mr. Jackel, you know Mr. McDonald?” At this moment, a middle-aged man asked excitedly.
“Yes, 10% of our company’s shares belong to Mr. McDonald. Mr. McDonald is considered a shareholder of our company now…” Jaxon lightly nodded.
Although Jaxon was calm when he said that, he was secretly very proud.
As for Jaxon’s offer to give Connor 10% of the shares, Connor didn’t know about it at all. Connor had never agreed to it either. This was a verbal agreement between Jaxon and Thomas.
Thomas saw that Jaxon had taken the initiative to express his goodwill and even offered 10% of the shares. This was considered very sincere. After all, Jaxon’s company’s annual profit was a huge figure. Although it was only 10%, the amount of money was not small.
Thomas had no reason to reject Jaxon’s kindness, so he accepted it gladly.
Jaxon wanted to give Thomas 10% of the shares to curry favor with Connor.
This way, he could use Connor’s name to expand his own power wantonly.
After the people of San Antonio discovered that Jaxon’s backer was Connor, they became even more afraid of Jaxon. Basically, no one dared to compete with Jaxon, which led to Jaxon’s business becoming more and more smooth.
“No, who is this Mr. McDonald you are talking about?” Herman still didn’t seem to understand what was going on. He asked everyone with a puzzled expression.
Those who knew Connor’s identity quickly explained it to Herman.
After Herman found out about Connor’s identity, he immediately became shocked. He stuttered, “Mr. Jackel, I didn’t expect you to know such a powerful backer!”
“What backer? I’m just working for Mr. McDonald…” Jaxon said in a very low-key manner.
“Not everyone is qualified to work for someone like Mr. McDonald!” A middle-aged man sighed softly.
“That’s right. Let alone taking out 10% of the shares. If Mr. McDonald likes me, I’m even willing to offer 50% of my shares!”
“Right? It’s just that Mr. McDonald doesn’t even care about insignificant people like us…”
The wealthy people present began to discuss in hushed voices while some began to flatter Jaxon.
On the other hand, Jaxon’s expression was filled with disdain. He knew what these people were thinking. They just wanted to use him to get to know Connor.
After hearing what these people said, Herman became even more curious about this Mr. McDonald.
However, Herman also knew that he needed more capital to meet Mr. McDonald, so he didn’t dare to take the initiative to tell Jaxon that he wanted to meet Mr. McDonald.
He felt that that would be enough as long as he could get that real estate project. He did not dare to ask for anything else.
“Mr. Walters, why did you ask me out today?”
At this moment, Jaxon finally couldn’t hold it in anymore and whispered to Herman.
“…”
Hearing Jaxon’s question, Herman couldn’t help but hesitate. Then, he chuckled and said, “Mr. Jackel, to be honest with you, I have something to ask you today. I’m interested in the real estate development project in Chicago in our province, but I don’t have any connections here, so I don’t know what to do. I wonder if you can help me connect the dots. After it’s done, I won’t forget you…”
“The real estate development project in Chicago?”
Jaxon pondered briefly and then said lightly, “Mr. Walters, many people are competing for this project, right?”
“That’s right. The competition is indeed very fierce. Otherwise, I wouldn’t have asked you for help, Mr. Jackel,” Herman hurriedly replied with a smile.
Jaxon looked at Herman and said nothing as if he was waiting for something.

chapters.title: Chapter 896: Are You that Big a Deal?
chapters.content:
Chapter 896: Are You that Big a Deal?
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Seeing Jaxon’s expression, Herman naturally knew what Jaxon meant.
He hurriedly smiled and said, “Mr. Jackel, I’ve already sent someone to invite Miss Zamora, but something must have happened. Miss Zamora hasn’t arrived yet, but don’t worry. I’ll make sure you see Miss Zamora today!”
“Haha…”
After hearing Herman’s words, Jaxon smiled playfully and said lightly, “Mr. Walters, there are indeed many competitors for the project you mentioned, but I have a good relationship with the president of that company, so all I need to do is say the word. As long as you can bring Tiffany Zamora here, you don’t have to worry about the rest…”
“Mr. Jackel, don’t worry. I’ll make sure to bring Miss Zamora here…”
After hearing Jaxon’s words, Herman’s became a little excited and hurriedly replied.
“Alright…”
Jaxon nodded and didn’t say anything else.
Jaxon had made it very clear that as long as Herman helped him settle Tiffany, Jaxon would help him settle this project.
Herman took out his phone and looked at it. He was unusually anxious, as if he was waiting for news from his subordinates. After all, they had left for quite some time, and they even brought his bodyguards with them. Logically speaking, everything should already be done!
However, they hadn’t returned till now. Herman was more or less worried that they might have encountered some trouble.
Ring!
At this moment, Herman’s phone suddenly rang.
Herman was stunned when he heard the phone ring. He then said to Jaxon, “Um, Mr. Jackel, I’m going to go take a call!”
“Go ahead…”
Jaxon said indifferently.
Herman took a deep breath and walked out of the room with his phone.
After leaving the private room, Herman quickly picked up the phone and shouted, “Joseph, what the hell are you doing? I told you to bring that b*tch Tiffany here. What the hell are you doing?”
“Herman, there is a problem here. I won’t be able to bring her over right now…”
Joseph Walters replied helplessly.
“A problem?”
After hearing this, Herman couldn’t help but frown. He was a little puzzled, and he hurriedly asked, “What problem? It’s just a girl. How difficult can it be?”
“Herman, we met a group of people in Laris town. One of them is especially strong. He beat up our bodyguards and refused to let us take Tiffany Zamora away. I have no other way to handle this, that’s why I called you. Why don’t you come over and deal with these people yourself…”
Joseph whispered.
“Who are they?”
Herman frowned and asked.
“It seems to be a group of students…”
Joseph said in a somewhat frustrated tone.
“Students?”
Herman was speechless when he heard this. He shouted angrily, “What the f*ck are you doing? You can’t even handle a few students? I really don’t know what to say about you…”
“Herman, these students are not ordinary students. One of them is really strong…”
Joseph stuttered.
“Alright, stop talking nonsense with me. I’ll go over and take a look myself!”
Herman shouted with a frown and then hung up the phone.
After hanging up the phone, Herman returned to the private room with a foul mood.
Jaxon turned and glanced at Herman before asking indifferently, “Mr. Walters what’s wrong with you? Why do you look so pale?”
“Mr. Jackel, my people encountered some problems when they tried to invite Miss Zamora here. I’ll go and deal with it now. Please wait for me!”
Herman replied in a low voice.
“They ran into some problems?”
Jaxon was stunned for a moment when he heard this. He then chuckled and said, “Anyway, we’re almost done eating. Rather than wait here, why not we go with you to see what’s going on?”
“Alright…”
Herman hurriedly nodded and led Jaxon and the others out of the private room.
…
On the other side, in the Laris Hot Spring.
Tiffany, Wilhelmina Warbucks, Yasmin Yale, and the other girls had changed into normal clothes. Seeing that there were more people around now, Tiffany put on her sunglasses and hat again and sat quietly in the rest area. She seemed to be hesitating whether she should help Connor and the other girls.
Meanwhile, Petra had been helping Tiffany make calls to see if she could find some friends in San Antonio to help. However, when they found out that the other party was Herman Walters, they all found excuses to decline.
Although Petra wanted to help Connor and the others, she couldn’t do anything.
Connor was still being sloppy, lying on the beach chair and quietly basking in the sun, as if all of this had nothing to do with him.
Tiffany subconsciously turned to look at Connor. She looked very helpless. She could not understand how Connor could still be so relaxed at a time like this. She did not know whether Connor was really fearless or heartless.
At this moment, a group of young men walked into the hot spring with swagger.
When Jaden Grant saw the man in the lead, a trace of excitement flashed across his eyes because this man was Max Coltman, the guy that Jaden had found to help him.
Initially, Jaden thought that Max would not come personally, but he did not expect Max to really come. He was rather touched by this.
He quickly ran to Max and whispered, “Max, you’re here. I’m really sorry to have to trouble you for this…”
“It’s okay. We’re all brothers. I definitely won’t ignore you if something happens to you…”
Max replied lightly. He then briefly sized up Wilhelmina, Tiffany, and the others. A strange look flashed across his eyes. He asked Jaden softly, “What exactly happened?”
“Max, my friend has a conflict with these people, so I asked you to come and help me resolve this matter…”
Jaden said slowly.
“I see. Don’t worry. As long as it’s in San Antonio, no matter who they are, they have to give me face. I’ll help you settle this matter today…”
Max said confidently.
After hearing Max’s words, Jaden felt much more relieved.
“Hey lackey, are you that big a deal?”
However, at this moment, the bald man who was leading the group shouted in a strange tone.

chapters.title: Chapter 897: An Existence That Can't Be Offended
chapters.content:
Chapter 897: An Existence That Can’t Be Offended
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
The guy that Jaden called over was called Max Coltman. His family was in the printing business. His father was known as the printing king of San Antonio
Max’s mother worked in an organization in San Antonio, so she had some background.
Max was not bragging when he said that everyone in San Antonio had to respect him.
After all, the Coltman Family had money and background. Normal people would not dare to provoke him.
However, because of his relationship with Herman, Joseph only had disdain for Max.
Max turned to look at Joseph and said lightly, “It’s you, Joseph Walters!”
“That’s right, it’s me. Your friends beat up my people…”
Joseph said casually.
Max was not afraid of Joseph, but he was afraid of Herman. After all, Herman had some power in San Antonio.
Even the Coltman Family did not dare to provoke a gangster like Herman.
“Joseph, were you bothering these ladies? Jaden is my buddy. Don’t go too far…”
Max frowned and shouted at Joseph.
