Max was very clear about what kind of person Joseph was. Although Tiffany was wearing sunglasses, she was definitely a very beautiful woman in terms of figure and temperament. Wilhelmina’s pair of slender legs could also be regarded as the best of the best. Even ordinary people would be tempted seeing these two women, let alone Joseph.
Therefore, Max thought that Joseph had molested Wilhelmina or Tiffany, which was why the two groups of people fought.
Max felt that things would be fine as long as they could talk things out.
Max hesitated for a moment, then walked directly to Joseph and said to Joseph flatteringly, “Joseph, these people are my friends. You can let them go today as a favor to me…”
“Who do you think you are? Why should I do you this favor?”
Joseph turned to look at Max and shouted disdainfully.
“Why you…”
Max never thought that Joseph would say such a thing to him. A trace of displeasure flashed in his eyes, and then he frowned and said, “So you’re not giving me any face, is that it?”
Max was not a nobody. Although he didn’t dare to provoke Herman, Joseph was nothing in his eyes. He was already trying to be nice to Joseph, but he didn’t expect Joseph to say that.
“Max, you better get lost. I’m not in the mood to deal with you…”
Joseph scolded Max impatiently.
At this time, there were so many people watching. After being scolded by Joseph, Max could no longer hold it in as he shouted, “Joseph, you asked for this!”
After saying this, Max rushed toward Joseph aggressively.
The people brought by Max also rushed over.
The bodyguards that Joseph brought all stood in front of Joseph. Although they didn’t dare to attack Connor, it didn’t mean that they were afraid of Max.
When Jaden saw that these people were going to fight again, he quickly stopped Max and said in a low voice, “Max, there are quite a lot of people on the other side. It’s best not to make a move…”
“Joseph, what do you mean by this? You have to make things clear today!”
Max took a deep breath and asked Joseph with his eyes wide open.
Joseph smiled faintly and said softly, “Max, do you know who these people have offended? You had better not meddle in other people’s business. If you don’t appreciate it, then I can’t do anything about it…”
“Who did they offend?”
Max was stunned for a moment and asked Joseph with a puzzled expression.
“It seems that you really don’t know what’s going on. Then, I’ll tell you. That woman was invited by my cousin, Herman, to dinner. Herman and Jaxon Jackel were all present, but these people stopped me from taking this woman with me. If you help these people now, you’ll be going against Herman and Mr. Jackel.”
“Your cousin Herman? Mr. Jackel?”
After hearing what Joseph said, Max’s expression changed instantly. He stood there stupidly and didn’t know what to do.
Joseph looked at Max with a proud face.
“You offended Herman Walters and Jaxon Jackel?”
Max turned to look at Jaden and asked in disbelief.
“We don’t even know who his cousin is…”
Jaden replied in a low voice.
“…”
Max looked at Jaden and was speechless. If it was just Joseph, Max would have offended him. After all, Joseph was not a big shot.
However, it was different if it were big shots like Herman and Jaxon. The Coltman Family could not afford to offend either of them. If they really got into trouble with Herman and Jaxon because of Jaden and the others, it would not do him any good.
“Jaden, are you trying to drag me down with you? Of all the people you could offend, why did you have to offend someone like Herman Walters…”
Max frowned and shouted helplessly.
“Who is Herman Walters?”
Jaden was stunned for a moment and asked Max with a puzzled expression.
“You don’t need to know what kind of person Herman Walters is. Anyway, you can’t afford to offend that kind of big shot, and neither can I…”
Max said in a low voice.
After hearing Max’s words, Jaden was instantly dumbfounded. He stood rooted to the ground, not knowing what to do.
He did not expect that even Max was not able to do anything about it.
Jaden thought that Max could handle this, but now, the last straw of hope in Jaden’s heart was gone.
“Jaden, it’s not that I’m being ungrateful, but I really can’t help you with this. If I help you, I might get into trouble myself. I can’t afford to offend someone like Herman Walters…”
Max whispered to Jaden.
“It’s alright, Max. I understand…”
Jaden finally realized the seriousness of this matter and replied helplessly.
Yasmin and the others looked at Jaden. Their faces were filled with despair. They did not know what to do.

chapters.title: Chapter 898: I Have No Right to Ask You to Apologize!
chapters.content:
Chapter 898: I Have No Right to Ask You to Apologize!
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Max looked at Jaden with a helpless expression.
He couldn’t help but hesitate for a couple of seconds before slowly saying, “Jaden, Herman Walters is really not someone we can provoke. If you believe me, you should apologize to Joseph Walters and then apologize to Herman Walters. You are all ordinary people. A big boss like Herman won’t make things too difficult for you. Maybe he will let you go…”
“Why should we apologize? We didn’t do anything wrong. They were the ones who wanted to take Tiffany with them…”
Wilhelmina pouted and shouted.
“Apologize for what?”
After hearing Wilhelmina’s words, a trace of helplessness flashed in Max’s eyes. He said coldly, “Let me tell you, people like Herman Walters are not people you can provoke. If you offend Herman, you won’t even know what killed you. All of your families combined might not even be able to compare to the money Herman earns in a year. What do you have to fight him with…”
“We didn’t do anything wrong. Why should we apologize? What does this have to do with how much money we have? Maybe I’ll just call the police. I don’t believe that there’s no way for us to reason this out…”
Wilhelmina pouted and shouted.
“That’s right, Wilhelmina is right. They should be the ones apologizing, not us…”
Connor said with a smile while eating an apple.
When Max heard Connor’s words, he seemed to be even more speechless.
He frowned and said, “Are you really stupid or are you pretending to be stupid? Herman Walters is a big boss in San Antonio. For insignificant people like you who have no background, even if you die in Herman’s hands, you won’t have anyone to complain to. Even if you want to call the police, do you think the police will care?”
“Is there no law in this place?”
Wilhelmina shouted excitedly.
“Law? In this place, Herman Walters and Jaxon Jackel are the law. People like them don’t care about these things at all. If you don’t apologize now, it’ll be too late to say anything later…”
Max said expressionlessly.
Jaden, Tobias Slater, and Yasmin were also a little nervous at this moment. They did not think that things would blow up to such an extent.
Tiffany sat there and hesitated for a couple of seconds. She whispered to Wilhelmina, “Wilhelmina, you were the one who started this whole thing. Why don’t you apologize first…”
Tiffany had already thought things through. Connor and the others were in trouble because of her, so she could not sit idly by.
Tiffany wanted Wilhelmina to apologize first, then she would plead with Jaxon to let Connor and the others go.
“Tiffany, we didn’t do anything wrong. Why should we apologize?”
Wilhelmina shouted.
A girl like Wilhelmina had always been very innocent. A mistake was a mistake, and what was right was right. She would not choose to compromise because of the other party’s identity and background.
“Wilhelmina, as long as you apologize now, nothing will happen. Otherwise, this matter will only escalate, and it won’t be good for anyone…”
Tiffany advised softly, then continued, “Don’t worry. As long as you apologize now, I’ll definitely plead for you when Herman Walters and the others come. I guarantee that you won’t be hurt in any way…”
“Then, I won’t apologize either!”
Wilhelmina said stubbornly.
“…”
Tiffany looked at Wilhelmina helplessly.
“Young lady, what Miss Zamora said just now is right. As long as you apologize to me now, I’ll forgive you for the sake of Miss Zamora. Otherwise, when my cousin, Mr. Jackel, and the others arrive, things won’t be so simple anymore. You’d better think about it carefully…”
Joseph said proudly.
“Beauty, just apologize. Don’t be so stubborn…”
Max also looked at Wilhelmina and said.
Wilhelmina stood rooted to the ground and gritted her teeth. She looked very wronged and didn’t know what to do.
“Wilhelmina…”
Jaden shouted with a frown.
“Jaden, why are you shouting at me? Don’t tell me you want me to apologize too?”
Wilhelmina’s big, watery eyes widened as she shouted.
Hearing Wilhelmina’s words, Jaden froze on the spot and didn’t say anything.
However, he was furious and clenched his fists tightly.
Jaden felt that he was really useless. He called for help, but in the end, not only did Max not help at all, but he even asked his friend to apologize.
An unprecedented sense of powerlessness surged in his heart.
Tobias, Yasmin, and the others had ugly expressions on their faces. They didn’t know what to do.
“I don’t want to apologize to him! I didn’t do anything wrong…”
After two seconds of silence, Wilhelmina shouted again.
“Since you don’t want to apologize, then don’t apologize. We didn’t do anything wrong, so why should we apologize?”
Connor said to Wilhelmina with a smile.
When Wilhelmina heard Connor’s words, she suddenly turned to look at Connor. She was in disbelief because Connor was the only person who supported Wilhelmina.
“I don’t know if you’re right or wrong, but in this society, being right doesn’t mean anything. It depends on who has a wide network and who has a strong background.”
Max shouted expressionlessly and continued, “If a person like Herman Walters wants to take you down, it will be as easy as crushing an ant. You people are flaunting your abilities for the sake of your dignity, but when the time comes, is it really worth it to lose your lives over your dignity?”
“Who is Herman Walters?”
Connor replied lightly.
Hearing Connor’s words, Max was instantly speechless. He turned and said to Jaden, “Jaden, is there something wrong with your friend’s head? I was kind enough to ask you to apologize. What kind of attitude is this?”
Jaden looked at Connor and said nothing.
Tiffany looked at Connor from head to toe. She felt that when Connor said these words, his tone was very confident, so confident that it was unbelievable.
Tiffany couldn’t understand where Connor’s confidence came from.
“Connor, maybe I should apologize.”
Wilhelmina seemed to be hesitant as she whispered to Connor.
When Connor heard that, he smiled faintly and then said expressionlessly, “Wilhelmina, remember, you’re my friend. So, from now on, regardless of whether you are right or wrong, you don’t have to apologize to anyone! Because these people have no right to ask you to apologize to them!”

chapters.title: Chapter 899: Even Worse Than a Dog!
chapters.content:
Chapter 899: Even Worse Than a Dog!
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
When everyone heard what Connor and Wilhelmina said, they were utterly shocked.
Although Connor’s words were indeed very touching, everyone knew that he only said these words because he was arrogant and ignorant.
Anyone with a bit of rationality would not say such words. After all, in their eyes, Connor was just a poor student.
No matter how powerful he was, he had no power to say such things.
Jaden, Tobias, and the others looked at Connor, and a trace of excitement flashed across their eyes.
Actually, what Connor said was exactly what they wanted to say, but they didn’t have the courage.
Joseph looked at Connor and sneered, then said with a smug expression, “Brat, it’s useless for you to be arrogant now. When my cousin comes later, I’ll see if you still dare to speak like this!”
“Your cousin is nothing in my eyes. If I tell him to kneel, he won’t dare to stand…”
Connor looked up at Joseph and said expressionlessly.
“If you tell my cousin to kneel, he won’t dare to stand?”
Joseph expression seemed to be even angrier after hearing this.
“Kid, who do you think you are? Do you know who Herman is? Do you think you are royalty? You will pay the price for your ignorance…”
Max looked at Connor and mocked him. He felt that Connor was being really ridiculous at this moment. There were not many people in the entire San Antonio who dared to go against Herman. Even the Coltman Family did not have the guts. How could Max not be angry when a poor student like Connor dared to say such words?
“You are the ones who are truly ignorant. In my eyes, people like Herman are worse than dogs. He doesn’t even have the right to be my dog…”
Connor looked at Max’s face, which was still very calm.
When everyone heard Connor’s words, they were all stunned. They were extremely shocked.
“You’re actually saying that my cousin doesn’t even have the right to be your dog? Kid, you’re dead meat today!”
Joseph shouted with his eyes wide open.
The bodyguards behind Joseph also picked up their weapons and looked at Connor with anger. If they didn’t know how terrifying Connor’s skills were, these people might have already started attacking.
Jaden, Tobias, and the others looked at Connor with worried expressions. They could not understand why Connor would say such a thing.
Wilhelmina was standing beside Connor with a shocked expression.
Even Tiffany couldn’t help but frown, because she felt that Connor was too ignorant to say these words at a time like this. It was obvious that he was provoking Joseph and the others. Now, even if Connor wanted to apologize, it would be too late.
Patra smiled disdainfully and said to Tiffany, “Miss Zamora, do you understand now? There must be something wrong with Connor. Luckily, you didn’t call Mr. Jackel just now. These people did save you, but they just wanted to show off in front of a big star like you. They don’t have any brains at all. If you can help them now, can you help them in the future?”
Tiffany couldn’t help but recall the scene where Wilhelmina attacked. She sighed helplessly.
Although Tiffany knew that Connor and the others had good intentions, she couldn’t understand their way of doing things.
“Miss Zamora, now that things have turned out this way, you can’t do anything even if you want to. In my opinion, you should just ignore them and let them fend for themselves…”
Petra looked at Tiffany and continued.
Tiffany took a deep breath, and a hint of disappointment flashed in his eyes.
She wanted to get Connor and the others to apologize, and then she would plead for them. However, now that things had turned out this way, even if she wanted to plead for mercy, Herman would probably not let Connor off. There was no need for her to be part of this anymore.
At this time, Connor was still sitting on the spot expressionlessly.
A series of footsteps suddenly came from outside.
When everyone heard this, they turned to look at the entrance.
A group of people walked in majestically. The ones walking at the front were none other than Jaxon Jackel and Herman Walters.
When Joseph saw Herman, he was particularly excited, and then he shouted, “Herman, you are finally here…”
“You guys are so dead. Herman is here…”
After hesitating for a moment, Max shouted at Jaden and the others in a low voice.
After hearing Max’s words, a trace of nervousness flashed across Jaden’s eyes.
However, Connor still had a calm expression on his face. He didn’t even look at Herman and the others.
“Which guy had the guts to actually dare to beat up my people? Which of you wants to die so badly?”
Herman shouted expressionlessly.
Joseph was stunned for a moment, then quickly pointed to Connor and shouted, “Herman, it was this brat who beat us up…”
When Herman heard Joseph’s words, he was filled with disdain. Then he walked to Connor and whispered to Connor, “You’re the one who beat up my people?”
“Yeap!”
Connor nodded lightly.
“Then, do you know who I am?”
Herman looked at Connor and continued to ask.
“A dog?”
Connor replied casually.
When everyone heard Connor’s words, they were once again stunned. Their mouths were wide open as they looked at this scene in shock.
No one had expected that even with Herman here personally, Connor would still have the guts to speak like this.
Tiffany looked at Connor, and she looked utterly dejected. She really couldn’t understand what Connor was thinking. He actually called Herman a dog in front of so many people!
“What?!”
Herman shouted angrily and reached for his waist.
People like Herman usually carried a gun with them.
When Herman saw Connor just now, he knew that Connor was just a student, so he didn’t plan to hurt him. He didn’t want to waste time on people like Connor.
However, he did not expect Connor to be so arrogant. He actually dared to call him a dog in front of so many people!
Herman definitely couldn’t take this lying down. He didn’t want to continue talking nonsense with Connor, so he was prepared to shoot and teach Connor a lesson.

chapters.title: Chapter 900: Kneel Down to Mr. McDonald
chapters.content:
Chapter 900: Kneel Down to Mr. McDonald
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
When Connor was done speaking, everyone present was stunned. They were extremely shocked.
Herman didn’t have any intention of wasting time. He was about to take out his gun.
However, before Herman could take out his gun, a figure rushed behind him and kicked his butt.
Herman was kicked into the hot spring. He struggled to stand up and shouted, “What the f*ck? Who did that?!”
“Herman, looks like you don’t want to live anymore…”
The person who kicked Herman into the hot spring was none other than Jaxon!
Everyone looked at Jaxon, and they became even more confused. They couldn’t understand why Jaxon had kicked Herman.
Tiffany looked at Jaxon with a puzzled expression. She did not know what was going on.
“Mr. Jackel, you’re…”
Herman looked at Jaxon with a hint of doubt in his eyes.
Jaxon ignored Herman and quickly walked to Connor. He said to Connor in a respectful tone, “Mr. McDonald, why are you here?”
Connor turned and glanced at Jaxon indifferently. With a casual expression, he said, “You know me?”
“I’m Jaxon Jackel!”
Jaxon hurriedly replied. His forehead was covered in sweat, and he was very nervous.
“What?”
“This person is actually Mr. McDonald?”
“Since Mr. Jackel said so, it must be…”
When the bosses who came over with Jaxon heard Jaxon’s words, their eyes flashed with a trace of shock. Then, they all ran to Connor and shouted excitedly, “Hello, Mr. McDonald!”
These bosses had just heard some things about Connor from Jaxon. Although these things were not very comprehensive, it was enough for them to understand how terrifying Connor’s background was. When these people saw Connor, they naturally did not dare to be negligent.
Everyone present looked at the big bosses who were famous in San Antonio. They were actually standing in front of Connor in such a respectful manner. They were utterly shocked.
“This is Mr. McDonald?”
Max, the guy that Jaden called over, was also a little dumbfounded. He had more or less heard about Connor, but he didn’t expect Connor to be Mr. McDonald.
Herman, who was standing in the hot spring, was even more confused because Jaxon had mentioned something about Mr. McDonald during dinner. Although he was curious about Connor, he knew that he was not qualified to know Mr. McDonald.
However, he didn’t expect to meet Mr. McDonald so soon.
Most importantly, his men had a conflict with Mr. McDonald!
In Herman’s eyes, this so-called Mr. McDonald was an extremely shrewd existence. Otherwise, it would be impossible for so many big shots to bow down to him!
However, this young man looked very ordinary at the moment. There seemed to be a huge gap between him and the legendary Mr. McDonald.
Herman thought about the conflict between his men and Mr. McDonald. He felt a chill run down his spine and didn’t know what to do.
Tiffany, Wilhelmina, and Jaden were even more confused.
They knew that Connor was just an ordinary person, but now he had inexplicably become some Mr. McDonald. Moreover, these big shots seemed to be very respectful to Connor. For a moment, they didn’t understand what was going on.
Although Tiffany was a big star, her activities were not in Davenport. Naturally, she did not know much about Connor.
Although the entertainment industry and the business industry had many interactions, it was normal for celebrities in the entertainment industry not to know about business matters.
Wilhelmina, Tobias, and Jaden were just ordinary university students. Although they had heard Leroy Jovi talk about Connor, Tobias, Yasmin, and Wilhelmina were not listening carefully at the time. Jaden was not there, so he did not know what was going on.
Joseph hesitated for a moment, then shouted at Herman, “Herman, what are you standing there for? Just now, it was this kid who beat up our people. He even called you a dog. Hurry up and teach this kid a lesson!”
Joseph didn’t know how much trouble he had caused this time. He wanted Herman to teach Connor a lesson?
However, Joseph’s words shook Herman out of his stupor. Herman quickly ran out of the hot spring and shouted, “Mr. McDonald, I was blind just now and didn’t recognize you. I hope you will forgive me!”
Connor looked at Herman coldly and didn’t say anything.
Herman was confused, not knowing what Connor meant.
He could only look at Jaxon helplessly, as if he wanted to ask Jaxon for help.
Jaxon hesitated for a moment before whispering to Herman, “What are you waiting for? Hurry up and kneel down and apologize to Mr. McDonald…”
“Kneel down and apologize to Mr. McDonald?”
After hearing Jaxon’s words, a strange look flashed across Herman’s eyes.
He hesitated for a couple of seconds, then with a bang, he knelt in front of Connor and stammered, “Mr. McDonald, I know my mistake now. I was blind just now and didn’t recognize you. I beg you, let me go!”
Everyone looked at Herman kneeling in front of Connor with a puzzled expression. No one expected Herman to kneel in front of Connor.
Tiffany covered her mouth, not knowing what to say.
“Does Connor have some shocking background?”
At this moment, the way Petra was looking at Connor seemed to have changed greatly. She could not help but sigh inwardly.
Connor looked at Herman indifferently and said expressionlessly, “I said that you were a dog before. Do you have any objections?”
“No objections. I have no objections!”
Herman shook his head at Connor without thinking.
“That’s good!”
Connor looked at Herman and nodded.
When everyone heard the conversation between Connor and Herman, their mouths were wide open in shock.
Who was Herman?
Connor called him a dog in front of so many people, but he actually did not dare to refute!
This scene was way too peculiar in everyone’s eyes!

chapters.title: Chapter 901: I Don’t Want to See This Person
chapters.content:
Chapter 901: I Don’t Want to See This Person
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
After witnessing this scene, everyone present was dumbfounded, their mouths hanging open in shock.
Of course, Joseph was shocked.
Originally, he thought that after Herman came over, he would definitely teach Connor a lesson.
But he never expected that things would turn out like this in the end.
A trace of confusion flashed in his eyes, and he immediately walked up to Herman and asked with a puzzled expression, “Cousin, what are you doing? Why aren’t you punishing this kid?”
At this point, Herman had already figured out what was going on, but Joseph hadn’t.
Herman didn’t even bother with Joseph. Instead, he respectfully turned to Connor and asked, “Mr. Connor, what do you think of today’s matter…”
“This person seems annoying…”
Connor turned his head slightly and looked at Joseph, calmly stating.
Herman took a deep breath and then whispered, “Mr. Connor, I understand your meaning. I promise you won’t see this person again in the future…”
After saying this, Herman turned directly to the bodyguards behind him and coldly shouted, “What are you all standing there for? Hurry up and take this person away. Mr. Connor doesn’t want to see him anymore…”
“Yes!”
All those bodyguards present belonged to Herman, and they did whatever Herman said.
Although they didn’t know what was going on, when they heard Herman’s command, they rushed towards Joseph’s position and lifted him up, heading towards the exit of the hot spring.
At this moment, Joseph still seemed to have no idea what was going on and shouted in excitement, “Cousin, are you confused? I am Joseph, your cousin. Why didn’t you punish him but let these people throw me out?”
“Cousin, what did I do wrong? Why don’t you go punish these people? I did everything according to your instructions…”
Joseph struggled like a madman.
And Herman couldn’t help but curse silently in his heart, but he didn’t dare to say a word. Cold sweat trickled down his back as he stood dumbfounded in place.
“Cousin, have you had too much to drink?”
Joseph still didn’t give up struggling and continued to shout at the top of his voice.
“Shut his mouth!”
Herman finally couldn’t help it and shouted with wide eyes.
One of the bodyguards immediately kicked Joseph in the stomach, causing him to scream in pain and obediently close his mouth.
“Joseph, it’s better for you to keep your mouth shut. This kid is not someone we can afford to provoke. If you really anger him, you won’t have a good outcome…”
Another bodyguard secretly whispered to Joseph.
“What background does he have?”
Joseph’s expression became agitated as he shouted.
The expressions on the faces of Joseph’s bodyguards all collapsed when they heard his words. They couldn’t understand whether Joseph was truly foolish or just pretending. The bodyguards had already figured out what was going on, but Joseph still hadn’t realized it!
After a while, Joseph was finally taken away by someone.
The scene instantly quieted down, and Jaxon, who knew Connor’s background the best, didn’t dare to move when Connor remained silent.
Herman knelt on the ground, not knowing what to do.
Jaden, Tiffany, Tobias, and others didn’t seem to understand what was going on.
The expression on Herman’s face also eased a lot, and he whispered to Connor, “Mr. Connor, do you have any other instructions?”
“Go apologize to my friend!”
Connor replied lightly.
Herman paused for a moment when he saw Connor’s response, but he didn’t think too much about it. He stood up and walked briskly to Jaden, Tobias, and the others, then sincerely apologized.
At this moment, Herman probably didn’t even know why he was apologizing.
After Herman finished apologizing, Connor saw it, threw the apple in his hand into the trash can, stretched lazily, and said, “Jaden, it’s getting late. Shouldn’t we go back?”
“Huh?”
Jaden still hadn’t figured out what was going on and exclaimed in confusion.
“What’s with the ‘huh’? Connor said we can go…”
Wilhelmina quickly reached out and pulled Jaden.
“We can go…”
After Jaden realized what was going on, he quickly nodded.
“Let’s go!”
Connor nodded lightly and walked directly toward the exit of the hot spring.
Although Jaden and the others were full of doubts, they didn’t dare to ask too much in front of so many people. They could only follow Connor and walk toward the exit of the hot spring.
Wilhelmina exchanged a few words with Tiffany and then followed them out of the hot spring.
Jaxon, Herman, and others stood bent over in place, respectfully watching Connor leave without daring to say a word.
A few minutes later, when everyone saw Connor and the others completely leave, they slowly straightened up.
The expression on Jaxon’s face was unusually tense. He wiped the sweat from his face and then turned to Herman and said, “Herman, you’re lucky today. Mr. Connor didn’t hold it against you too much…”
“Yeah, I didn’t expect Mr. Connor to let me off so easily. It’s all thanks to Mr. Jaxon’s reputation!”
Herman also had a feeling of escaping a disaster and stuttered.
“Last time, Yakov offended Mr. Connor, and Mr. Connor took away fifty percent of his shares. You’re really lucky today. Deal with your cousin properly!”
Jaxon said slowly.
“Mr. Jaxon, how do you suggest I deal with it?”
After hesitating for a moment, Herman whispered to Jaxon.
“Isn’t that obvious? Mr. Connor said he doesn’t want to see this person again. How can you make sure Mr. Connor doesn’t see him?”
Jaxon scolded with a frown.
“I… I understand!”
After hesitating for a moment, Herman nodded lightly at Jaxon.
After all, both Herman and Jaxon were involved in the underworld, so they knew exactly what to do in this situation.
After hesitating for a moment, Tiffany quickly walked up to Herman and Jaxon, looking nervous, and said, “Mr. Herman, Mr. Jaxon, today’s incident was caused by me. I’m sorry…”
Jaxon was taken aback for a moment, then whispered to Tiffany, “Miss Tiffany, do you know Mr. Connor?”
Upon hearing his words, Tiffany couldn’t help but pause for a moment, then whispered, “I know!”

chapters.title: Chapter 902: Mistaken Person
chapters.content:
Chapter 902: Mistaken Person
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
“Since you know Mr. Connor, why didn’t you tell me earlier? If you had told me earlier, wouldn’t everything have been fine?”
Jaxon said helplessly.
Jaxon felt that the reason Tiffany dared to reject him before was because she knew someone powerful like Connor.
Jaxon didn’t dare to provoke someone like Connor, so naturally, his thoughts about Tiffany vanished. He quickly continued, “Miss Tiffany, I know several famous directors. If there’s a chance in the future, I can introduce you to them…”
“Mr. Jaxon, are you going to introduce directors to me?”
After hearing his words, Tiffany looked shocked.
“Since you’re a friend of Mr. Connor, I will definitely take good care of you. I hope you can speak highly of me in front of Mr. Connor!”
Jaxon said with a smile.
“That’s right, Miss Tiffany, I also know a few producers. I can introduce them to you…”
Herman exclaimed excitedly.
The other bosses present didn’t miss this great opportunity either and shouted excitedly towards Tiffany.
Seeing this scene, Tiffany was instantly dumbfounded, her expression very incredulous.
She couldn’t understand why these people suddenly started to please her.
Petra, who was standing on the side, understood clearly that all of this must be related to Connor.
“Who exactly is Connor?”
She couldn’t help but sigh softly in her heart.
…
On the other side, Connor, Jaden, and others prepared to return to the resort after leaving the Laris Hot Springs.
After everyone got in the car, the atmosphere became somewhat awkward.
After all, the things that had just happened were quite unbelievable to them.
Wilhelmina was straightforward, so she turned her head and looked at Connor, softly asking, “Connor, what happened just now? Why were those people so afraid of you? Why did they kneel down and apologize to you?”
“Yeah, Connor, what’s the matter? What are you hiding from us?”
Jaden was also very puzzled and asked him in a low voice.
“Do you know why we stayed in the water villa at the resort?”
After hesitating for a moment, Connor asked softly.
“Isn’t it because of your friend, Sabrina?”
Jaden answered.
“It’s not because of her, it’s because of me!”
Connor said calmly.
“Because of you?”
After hearing this, everyone turned their heads to look at Connor, their expressions even more incredulous.
“Connor, are you Mr. Connor of Davenport? Are you a rich heir?”
Wilhelmina’s gaze at Connor seemed even stranger.
But he just smiled faintly and said softly, “Don’t assume too much. Don’t you know my situation? When I was in school, I couldn’t even afford tuition fees. How could I be a rich second generation?”
He didn’t reveal his true identity to her because he didn’t want to expose it in front of them. So he directly denied it.
“Then what’s the matter? Why are they so afraid of you? I’m really confused now…”
Tobias scratched his head and said in a puzzled tone.
“The truth is, although I’m not the Mr. Connor of Davenport, I look a bit like him, and my name is also Connor. So these people misunderstood me as him, and I didn’t deny it…”
Connor smiled and said.
“So that’s what happened!”
Wilhelmina, Jaden, and the others nodded lightly.
Although Connor’s statement was also very unbelievable, it was more believable than telling Jaden, Wilhelmina, and the others that he was actually Mr. Connor.
Wilhelmina and the others definitely couldn’t accept the fact that Connor was Mr. Connor of Davenport, because the gap between Connor and those super rich second-generation heirs was too big.
However, if he only looked like Mr. Connor, it would be much easier for them to accept it.
“In other words, the reason why they are so afraid of Connor is because they have mistaken you for Mr. Connor, right?”
Jaden hesitated for a moment and asked Connor softly.
“That’s right!”
Connor nodded lightly.
“Then Connor, aren’t you impersonating Mr. Connor? What if someone finds out that you’ve lost your way?”
Wilhelmina looked at him and asked worriedly.
“That’s right, Connor. You can hide it for a while but you can’t hide it forever. These people are not so easy to provoke. Once they discover that you are an imposter, they will definitely not let you off…”
Tobias added.
“Uh…”
After hearing their words, Connor’s eyes flickered with a hint of helplessness, and he calmly said, “Actually, I can’t be considered an imposter. I’ve never claimed to be Mr. Connor. It’s their misunderstanding. What does it have to do with me? Besides, even if they do find out, I might have already left San Antonio long ago. Where would they find me?”
“Well, that’s true. But just to be safe, we should leave here quickly. If they realize something’s wrong later, it could be troublesome!”
After thinking for a moment, Jaden said softly.
“I think Jaden is right. Although we managed to evade them this time, it doesn’t mean we can do it again next time. Let’s hurry and leave!”
Wilhelmina nodded in agreement.
Seeing that these people were so concerned about his safety, Connor didn’t say much.
“By the way, Connor, when did you become so formidable? You single-handedly dealt with so many bodyguards, and they couldn’t do anything to you. It’s truly incredible…”
Jaden suddenly turned his head and looked at him , asking curiously.
“I met an old man during my time in college, and he taught me everything I know!”
Connor answered with a smile.
“I see!”
Jaden nodded gently and didn’t say much.

chapters.title: Chapter 903: The Chance to Marry into a Wealthy Family
chapters.content:
Chapter 903: The Chance to Marry into a Wealthy Family
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
On the other side.
Jaxon and others, upon learning that Tiffany knew Connor, began to curry favor with Tiffany.
Because today he fought so many people for her, they felt that their relationship must be extraordinary.
So they regarded Tiffany as their opportunity to get close to Connor, and everyone actively tried to please her, introducing their connections in the entertainment industry to her without any cost.
Jaxon took the initiative to invite her to have a meal. Of course, this meal was quite different from the previous one.
Those bosses respected Tiffany very much, and she instantly felt flattered.
After all these years in the industry, she had never received such treatment!
In the eyes of these bosses in the entertainment industry, these female stars were no different from club hostesses. They didn’t really care about these stars and never truly respected them.
But this time, Tiffany finally experienced the feeling of being respected by these bosses.
Petra, on the other hand, was a very clever agent, and she knew that all these changes were because of Connor.
If it weren’t for their misunderstanding of the relationship between Tiffany and Connor, Tiffany would never have received such treatment.
So Petra deliberately mentioned how good the relationship between them was, both intentionally and unintentionally. The attitudes of those bosses towards her became even more enthusiastic.
It was after ten o’clock in the evening.
Tiffany finally returned to the hotel.
After entering the room, she kicked off her high heels to the side, then lay down on the bed, her expression showing extreme exhaustion.
When Petra saw this scene, a hint of helplessness flashed in her eyes, and she softly said, “Miss Tiffany, could you please pay attention to your image? Have you forgotten about your identity?”
“What identity? I’m just an ordinary person. I’ve been so exhausted today, and I didn’t expect things to turn out like this…” she replied faintly.
“No matter what, you still need to pay attention to your image. I have a feeling that this time you might become famous. The things those bosses promised you, if they can really be realized, no star in the entertainment industry can compare to you…”
Petra said happily.
Upon hearing her words, Tiffany couldn’t help but pause for a moment, then whispered, “Petra, are those people currying favor with me because of Connor?”
“If it weren’t for him, why would those people give you their resources for free!”
Petra couldn’t help but roll her eyes at Tiffany.
Upon hearing these words, Tiffany’s eyes showed a hint of surprise, then she whispered, “But Petra, Connor and I have only known each other for less than a day. We can’t even be considered friends, but you keep saying how good our relationship is. Aren’t you deceiving people?”
“Oh my, are you confused? How would anyone know if you know Mr. Connor? They won’t go find him and ask him that. It’s already good enough that I didn’t say you are his girlfriend…” Petra said slowly.
“But…”
Tiffany opened her mouth to speak.
” There’s no buts. You’ve only known Mr. Connor for less than a day, but I can tell that he is definitely interested in you. Otherwise, why would he help you? Don’t worry. This is an opportunity given to you by the heavens. It would be a waste if we don’t seize this opportunity…”
Petra quickly comforted again.
Tiffany blinked her watery eyes and then spoke in a puzzled tone, “Petra, do you know who this Connor really is? Why are so many big bosses so respectful to him? And after they found out that I know Connor, they all came to please me. I find it incredible!”
“I don’t really know who Connor is. He should be the heir of some prominent family in Oprana, right? It’s just that he keeps a low profile. If it weren’t for Jaxon knowing him, I would never have guessed that he is a second-generation wealthy person!”
Petra spoke slowly.
After all, she was just a small agent, and she had limited exposure to the business world. It was normal for her to be unaware of Connor’s background.
“But this Connor is too amazing. Even someone like Jaxon treats him with utmost respect, and Wang Hong even knelt down to apologize to him. It indicates that Connor’s identity and background are definitely not ordinary…”
Tiffany said slowly.
In her eyes, someone like Jaxon was already considered extremely powerful. But seeing how Jaxon treated Connor, she couldn’t even imagine how terrifying Connor’s background could be.
In her view, a family more terrifying than Jaxon would be considered a prominent presence in the entire Oprana. At the very least, they would rank among the top fifty.
Thinking of this, Tiffany and Petra exchanged glances, their expressions extremely complex.
“Miss Tiffany, you may have missed a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity this time!”
Petra hesitated for a moment and sighed softly.
“What kind of opportunity?”
Tiffany’s eyes showed a hint of confusion, and she furrowed her brow as she asked softly.
“Are you really stupid or just pretending to be? You missed a chance to marry into a wealthy family!”
Petra replied helplessly, then continued, “The family Connor belongs to is definitely not something we usually come into contact with, compared to those wealthy sons we know. He is still so young, yet he can make someone like Jaxon bow down to him. If he takes over his own family in the future and controls the family’s business, can you imagine how terrifying he would become?”
“If you can marry Connor, then no one in the entertainment industry can compete with you. Even the CEO of your company would have to treat you with utmost respect, do you know that?”
Upon hearing Petra’s words, a tinge of regret flashed in Tiffany’s eyes.
Connor had good looks, impressive skills, and, most importantly, an incredibly terrifying background. In Tiffany’s eyes, it was a perfect opportunity!
However, Connor was too low-key, and she never expected his background to be so astonishing. It was like a plot that could only be seen in a TV drama.
“If I missed it, then I missed it. If we’re not meant to be, no matter how hard I try, it won’t work…”
Tiffany couldn’t help but comfort herself softly.
“Miss Tiffany, don’t worry. Oprana is a big place. I believe we will definitely have a chance to meet Mr. Connor again. We can figure something out then. After all, Miss Tiffany, you’re so beautiful!”
Petra said with a smile.
“Beauty has an expiration date, you know? In a few more years, I might not be able to compete with those young and beautiful girls!”
Tiffany said with a somewhat helpless expression.

chapters.title: Chapter 904: Essence Cultivating Pill
chapters.content:
Chapter 904: Essence Cultivating Pill
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Jaden, Wilhelmina, Tobias and Yasmin believed Connor’s explanation after listening to it. They thought that Jaxon, Herman, and others treated Connor with such respect because they considered him as Mr. Connor from Davenport.
However, Jaden, Wilhelmina, and others also suspected that Connor was an impostor and would eventually be discovered by Jaxon and the others.
If Jaxon and the others were to find out, hisfate would certainly be miserable.
To be on the safe side, they decided not to return to the resort and planned to go back to their respective homes separately.
After parting ways with Jaden and the others, Connor took a bus directly back to Porthampton.
Upon returning, he didn’t choose to go home right away. Instead, he took a taxi to Jorge’s house.
It had been a whole week since Connor had delivered the medicinal herbs to Jorge, as agreed upon.
Connor knew that the incident at the resort had caused a lot of trouble for Jaden and the others. Fortunately, they eventually believed his explanation. Otherwise, if Jaden and the others found out about his identity, he wouldn’t know how to explain it to them.
When Connor arrived at Jorge’s house, it was already past eight o’clock in the evening, and the sky was getting dark.
He briefly glanced at the front door of Jorge’s house and noticed that it was open, indicating that Jorge should have already returned. So Connor walked directly into the courtyard.
Perhaps because it was getting late, Jorge and Jabba were not in the courtyard, but the lights were on in the room.
After hesitating for a moment, he walked up to the door and gently knocked.
“Come in!”
Jorge’s voice sounded.
Connor pushed open the door and walked straight into the room.
He saw Jorge sitting on a chair, reading a book. His expression was calm, as if he wasn’t surprised at all by Connor’s arrival.
“Old man, where have you been these past few days? I came to see you a couple of days ago, but you weren’t home…”
Connor walked up to him and said with a smile.
“I went to San Diego and met some old friends…”
Jorge didn’t hide anything from Connor and answered directly.
“You still have friends?”
Connor’s eyes showed a hint of surprise upon hearing his words.
Connor wasn’t joking when he said that. He was genuinely surprised because in all the time he had known Jorge, he had never seen anyone else come to visit him. Jorge gave Connor the feeling of being isolated from the world.
“Some friends I made when I was young, but we have lost contact over the years…”
He seemed unperturbed and answered calmly.
“Oh, I see!”
Connor nodded lightly and continued, “According to our previous agreement, I helped you find those medicinal herbs, and then you would take me as your disciple. You told me to come back to you after a week, and now a week has passed. Can you accept me as your disciple?”
Jorge turned his head and glanced at Connor, then asked with a serious expression, “Are you sure you want to be my disciple?”
“Of course!” he quickly nodded.
“Then why do you want to be my disciple?” Jorge continued to question him.
“Why else? I just want to learn something from you, for self-protection in the future…”
After thinking for a moment, Connor said slowly.
“But you have to think it through. Once you become my disciple, you may encounter some danger. Being Jorge’s disciple is not an easy task!”
Jorge said calmly.
“What do you mean by that?”
Connor frowned as he looked at Jorge, his expression showing some confusion.
“In the past, when I was your age, I traveled the rivers and lakes and made enemies with many martial artists. Those martial artists have been seeking opportunities to get their revenge on me. But now I have retired and they can’t find me. Even if they do, they are no match for me. However, if you become my disciple, these people might trouble you. Do you understand what I mean?”
Jorge said seriously, looking at Connor.
“Being your disciple is that dangerous?”
Connor seemed speechless, his expression showing disbelief.
“If you regret it now, there’s still time. As long as you don’t become my disciple, these people probably won’t bother you!”
Jorge added.
“Then why didn’t you explain all this to me when I was helping you find the medicinal herbs? What does all this mean now? Did you trick me?”
Connor stared, his eyes wide open, and shouted with great excitement.
“It wasn’t a waste…”
Jorge shook his head gently and continued, “And those medicinal herbs weren’t for me, but for yourself!”
“For myself?”
Connor looked at Jorge, a trace of confusion flashing in his eyes, and asked with a frown, “What do you mean by that?”
Jorge didn’t answer Connor’s question. Instead, he took out a medicine box and handed it to Connor.
“What is this?”
Connor took the medicine box, his expression puzzled, and asked Jorge.
A few days ago, I went to San Diego to find an alchemist. That alchemist was a friend I knew when I was young. You’re lucky, that old man is still alive. I had him refine the medicinal herbs you found into a pill…”
Jorge said slowly.
After hearing Jorge’s words, Connor paused for a moment, then quickly opened the medicine box and found a green pill inside.
The pill emitted a faint green light, giving a sense of wonder.
When Connor was searching for the medicinal herbs, Diana mentioned the alchemist and the pills, but this was the first time Connor had seen a real pill.
“What is the use of this pill?”
Connor asked Jorge, his tone filled with confusion.
“This pill is called the Essence Cultivating Pill. It can improve a person’s physique. Due to your previous malnutrition and excessive fatigue, you are not suitable for martial arts. But if you take this pill, your body will undergo significant improvement. By then, the quality of your body will be noticeably enhanced. Even if you don’t become my disciple, it will greatly benefit your combat power. Dealing with ordinary people or even low-level warrior shouldn’t be a problem…”
Jorge explained as he looked at Connor.

chapters.title: Chapter 905: Becoming a Disciple
chapters.content:
Chapter 905: Becoming a Disciple
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
After hearing Jorge’s words, Connor’s eyes flashed with a trace of surprise.
Subconsciously, he looked down at the pill in his hand and then asked with a puzzled expression, “Is this pill really so miraculous?”
“There are plenty of incredible things in this world, you just don’t know about them!” Jorge replied calmly.
After a moment of hesitation, Connor spoke in a deep voice, “Are you sure that taking this pill will make me stronger?”
“It’s not about making you stronger, but greatly improving your physical fitness,” corrected Jorge.
“How do I know if what you’re saying is true? What if this is a poisonous pill and you’re trying to deceive me?” Connor asked cautiously.
“Why would I deceive you?” the old man responded calmly.
“You have no reason to deceive me, but there are many people who want to kill me. I don’t know who is trustworthy and who isn’t…” Connor looked at the pill in his hand, his expression hesitant.
Although he believed that Jorge wouldn’t harm him, he had encountered too many assassins recently, and he couldn’t guarantee that Jorge was completely trustworthy.
Jorge said seriously, “If I really wanted to harm you, I could easily kill you now. Based on your current skills, it wouldn’t be difficult for me to do so…”
Hearing Jorge’s words, Connor raised his head abruptly and looked at him. He felt that what Jorge said made a lot of sense.
After all, he couldn’t even defeat Jabba at the moment, let alone Jorge himself. So, if Jorge really wanted to kill him, there was no need for such a big charade.
“I can give you a few days to think about it. Becoming my disciple will undoubtedly bring more dangers to your side. This pill itself is a gift from me. Whether you take it or not, it’s up to you. I won’t give you any advice. So, you can take the pill with you, go back, think it over, and then make a decision!” Jorge said softly after seeing Connor’s indecisiveness.
Standing in place for a couple of seconds, Connor felt that Jorge probably wouldn’t harm him. With the increasing dangers around him, the earlier he became Jorge’s disciple, the sooner his strength would improve.
And the next time he encountered the assassins sent by the Rockefeller Family, he wouldn’t be so embarrassed.
“I’ll take it!” Connor said quietly to Jorge.
“Have you made up your mind?” Jorge looked at Connor, calmly asking.
“I have!” Connor nodded lightly and then reached out to take the pill out of the box. He looked at Jorge and asked, “Can I just directly swallow it like this?”
“Yes!” Jorge nodded in response.
Connor couldn’t help but take a deep breath as he held the pill. His expression appeared somewhat nervous.
After all, he was just an ordinary person who didn’t even know about the existence of martial artists before he met Jorge. He had no knowledge of pills either.
Even though he now knew about the existence of pills, he had never taken one before. So, he still had some concerns in his mind.
“This won’t have any side effects, right?” Connor asked uncertainly.
Jorge shook his head and said helplessly, “I don’t know if this pill has any side effects. After all, I’ve never taken it before. But you can rest assured that taking this pill won’t kill you, at most, you’ll just have to endure some hardship.”
“Endure some hardship?” Connor paused for a moment, then furrowed his brows and asked, “What kind of hardship?”
“The main effect of this pill is to eliminate impurities in your body and improve your physical fitness. But if you want to improve your body, you’ll definitely have to endure some hardship…” Jorge explained patiently.
“Forget it, all this talking won’t make a difference now. I’ll know what’s going on once I take it, right?” Connor muttered softly, then picked up the pill and threw it into his mouth.
After throwing the pill into his mouth, he felt like he had just swallowed the most bitter medicine in the world. The bitterness was so intense that it made him want to spit it out immediately, but he managed to resist the urge and gritted his teeth, swallowing the pill directly.
After taking the pill, he moved his body briefly but didn’t notice any changes. He couldn’t help but furrow his brows and asked Jorge, “Old man, are you just fooling me? I don’t feel anything at all.”
“Do you think this is a TV drama? The pill needs at least half an hour to take effect once it enters your body, so don’t be impatient…” Jorge replied helplessly.
“Oh, I see!” Connor nodded lightly and looked at him, asking, “Alright, I’ve taken the pill and done everything you asked. Can I become your disciple now?”
“I already told you earlier, if you truly want to become my disciple, it might bring you some danger. Are you still sure you want to become my disciple?” Jorge looked at Connor and spoke slowly.
“Of course, I’m sure!” Connor nodded without hesitation, then continued, “I’ve put in so much effort, collected medicinal ingredients, and taken the pill, all because I want to become your disciple. Are you having second thoughts now?”
“I never said I’m having second thoughts. I just wanted to see if you really wanted to become my disciple!” Jorge said with a smile.
“Of course, I really want to become your disciple…” He said helplessly to Jorge.
“Alright then, since you really want to become my disciple, kneel down and pay respects!” Jorge said slowly.
“Kneel down?” He was taken aback after hearing Jorge’s words, then chuckled and said, “Uh, old man, we’re already so familiar with each other. Can we skip this kneeling part?”
“No, this is a tradition!” Jorge shook his head directly.
“What tradition? I’ve never heard of such a tradition before,” Connor furrowed his brows and asked.
“When a martial artist takes a master, they must perform the ritual of kneeling and paying respects…” Jorge said solemnly to Connor.

chapters.title: Chapter 906: Side Effects
chapters.content:
Chapter 906: Side Effects
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Upon hearing Jorge’s words, Connor’s expression was very helpless.
He had never thought that he would have to kneel before Jorge to become his disciple. Moreover, Connor saw that Jorge’s attitude was very firm. There was no room for negotiation at all.
Connor felt that since he had already done so many things, if he didn’t acknowledge a master just because of this small matter, then he’d be wasting all that effort and time.
Therefore, Connor hesitated for a long time and finally chose to compromise.
“Should I just kneel down?”
Connor asked Jorge helplessly.
“Kneel down, serve me tea, and acknowledge me as your master!”
Jorge said calmly.
“Why are you so demanding?” Connor’s eyes flashed with a hint of helplessness before he went to the table and reached out to pick up the teacup. He then walked in front of Jorge and shouted at him with a serious expression, “Master, please accept my bow!”
After saying this, Connor knelt in front of Jorge.
However, before Connor could bend his knees, his stomach suddenly rumbled, followed by waves of intense pain engulfing his body.
That feeling was like countless knives were scraping his flesh. This pain was simply indescribable. Connor could feel his heartbeat clearly getting faster and faster, clearly far above what was normal.
“Aaahhhh!”
Connor screamed and fell to the ground.
“Clink!”
The teacup in Connor’s hand smashed onto the ground. He’d fainted because he couldn’t bear the intense pain.
Jorge looked at the unconscious Connor from where he was. A strange look flashed in his eyes. He turned to Jabba and said, “Send him to his room. Give him water every two hours. Don’t give him food!”
After Jabba heard Jorge’s order, he quickly ran to Connor’s side. He carried Connor and ran towards the room in question.
“I didn’t expect the side effects of the Essence Cultivating Pill to be so great. I wonder if this kid can survive this…” Jorge couldn’t help but mutter softly when he saw Jabba carrying Connor away.
…
After an unknown period of time, Connor finally opened his eyes again.
After Connor opened his eyes, it was as if the entire world was spinning. His head was also in severe pain, and every part of his body was throbbing.
“Tsk tsk…”
When Jabba saw that Connor had woken up, he hurriedly bared his teeth at Connor.
Connor used all his strength to turn his head to look at Jabba. Connor wanted to open his mouth to speak, but at this moment, he could not say anything at all.
“…”
After Jabba glanced at Connor, he turned around and ran out of the room. A few seconds later, he returned, followed closely by Jorge.
Jorge sized up Connor and asked softly, “You’re awake?”
“Old man, what did you feed me? What’s wrong with me? Why can’t I move my body now?” Connor asked weakly.
“This is the side effect of the Essence Cultivating Pill that I told you about. The weaker the body, the greater the side effects of the pill. However, you are already fine now. As long as you survive this period of time, there will be no problem. Your body has already improved greatly after the Essence Cultivating Pill…”
Jorge said to Connor with a smile.
“Stop lying to me. You must have poisoned me. My body can’t move at all!” Connor gritted his teeth and shouted.
“Your body can’t move because you haven’t eaten for a month. That’s why you feel so weak…”
Jorge looked at Connor and said calmly.
“…”
Connor couldn’t help but be stunned when he heard Jorge’s words. He frowned and asked, “Wait a minute, how long have I not eaten?”
“If you count today, it’s been a whole month!” Jorge said calmly.
“Stinky old man, are you joking with me? A person would die if they didn’t eat for seven days!”
“Seven days?” Jorge laughed in disdain, then said lightly, “Ordinary people can endure for at least ten days without eating. However, martial artists like us can endure for a whole month even without eating or drinking. Your claim of seven days is simply nonsense…”
“Is that so…” Connor nodded thoughtfully, then a trace of shock flashed in his eyes. He shouted at Jorge, “Wait, hold on. You mean I’ve been unconscious for a whole month?”
“That’s right, it has indeed been a month since you ate the Essence Cultivating Pill!”
Jorge nodded.
Connor looked at Jorge, dumbfounded. He opened his mouth to say something, but didn’t know what to say.
He never expected that he had actually been unconscious for such a long time.
“No, I still have a lot of things to do. I can’t lie down like this forever. Hurry up and help me up!” Connor shouted at Jorge excitedly.
Jorge turned to look at Jabba and gave him a look.
Jabba walked to Connor’s side and helped him up from the bed.
Connor discovered that his body actually still couldn’t move. He couldn’t use any strength at all.
“When can I recover my strength?” Connor asked Jorge softly.
“I’ll go get some food for you now. You should be able to move after you’re done eating!”
Jorge replied calmly to Connor, then turned around and walked out of the room.
After Jorge left, Connor turned to look at Jabba and asked softly, “Have you been taking care of me all this time?”
Jabba bared his teeth and nodded.
“Thank you. When I recover my strength, I’ll buy a truckload of bananas for you to eat, and I’ll also get you two female mates.”
Connor asked with a smile.
Jabba bared his teeth at Connor, then turned around and ran out of the house.
After Jabba left, Connor sat by the bed alone and felt a little bored.
After hesitating for two seconds, he took out his phone from his clothes to see if there was any news.
However, a month had passed and his phone had long since run out of battery.
Therefore, Connor could only lie on the bed and stare at the ceiling in a daze.
Ten minutes later, Jabba brought Connor a bowl of porridge.
Connor already had recovered some strength, so he forced himself to finish the porridge and continued to lie on the bed to rest.

chapters.title: Chapter 907: Missed Calls
chapters.content:
Chapter 907: Missed Calls
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
After eating the porridge, Connor continued to lie in bed and rest for half an hour.
This half an hour was exceptionally long for Connor.
Because his phone was out of battery, he couldn’t do anything with it, so he could only stare at the ceiling in a daze.
Half an hour later, Connor felt that his body seemed to have recovered a little strength, so he tried to get off the bed and began to move bit by bit.
Perhaps it was because he had not exercised for too long, but Connor felt a little uncomfortable at the beginning. However, after walking around for a bit, Connor found that his body had really recovered to the point where he could at least walk normally.
After Connor realized that he had recovered, he simply greeted Jorge and walked out of the courtyard. He only had one thought now, and that was to find a place to charge his phone.
After leaving Jorge’s house, Connor realized that his body had completely returned to normal. He could even run without any problems, let alone walk normally.
And just like Jorge said, Connor could vaguely feel that his body had undergone a huge change. However, perhaps because Connor’s body was too weak now, the changes in his body were not very obvious.
After leaving Jorge’s house, Connor hailed a taxi and returned to the Mansion.
After reaching home, he quickly got a charger to charge his phone. While waiting for the phone to charge, Connor went to the bathroom to take a shower.
After a long time, his phone was finally at full battery.
After he turned on the phone again, countless notifications for text messages and missed calls popped up on his screen, and in an instant, Connor’s phone crashed.
Connor restarted his phone, then checked the missed calls and unread messages one by one.
Most of these calls were from Jaden, Tobias, and the others. After all, Connor had just offended Herman Walters and the others in the resort. Then, Connor had suddenly disappeared. It was difficult for people not to connect these things together.
Therefore, Connor called Jaden, Tobias, and the others first.
“Ding!”
After the phone rang twice, Jaden finally picked up the phone and shouted excitedly, “Connor, is it you?”
“It’s me…”
After Connor heard Jaden’s voice, he was very touched and replied in a low voice.
“Bro, what have you been doing for the past month? Why didn’t you pick up my calls? I’m buying a ticket at the train station to look for you in Porthampton. Did you encounter any danger?” Jaden asked anxiously.
“You don’t have to come to Porthampton. There’s nothing to do here. I lost my phone and only found it today…” Connor quickly said.
“You lost your phone?” After hearing Connor’s words, Jaden heaved a long sigh of relief.
“Yeah, so I couldn’t pick up your calls. Don’t worry, yeah? Also, tell Tobias and the others that I’m fine…”
Connor said slowly.
“F * ck, you almost scared us to death. We thought that Jaxon Jackel and the others had found out that you were impersonating Mr. McDonald. It’s good to hear that you’re fine. I’ll call Tobias and the others later and let them know!”
Jaden’s tone was obviously much more relaxed.
“Alright, if there’s nothing else, I’ll hang up first. I still have something to do here. When you’re free, come to Porthampton to look for me!”
Connor said slowly.
“Alright, alright…”
Jaden nodded and hung up.
After Jaden hung up the phone, Connor looked through his missed calls. They were from Rachel, Spencer, and Dominic.
However, they had only made one or two calls. There should be nothing urgent, so Connor did not call them back. On the other hand, Yelena had called Connor every day.
After all, Connor would chat with Yelena every day to ask about her recent situation. After not contacting Yelena for so long, she must be very anxious, so Connor called her again. However, due to the timezone differences, Yelena did not answer the phone, so Connor sent her a text message to tell him that he was fine and not to worry.
Then, there were also calls and text messages from Sadie and Sabrina.
Sadie and Sabrina’s text messages were similar. They were both reminding Connor to be careful of Harold Phillips and Sheldon Statton. It seemed that the two of them had found some helpers to deal with Connor.
However, Connor didn’t think highly of Harold and Sheldon at all. After all, no matter what kind of helpers these two people could find, they would definitely not be a match for him. These two people were just asking for trouble.
Of course, there were also some calls from Yarrow and Yucca Lambert, as well as Nicole Cooper, the beauty that Connor saved last time. However, Connor felt that these people should not have anything urgent to do with him, so he did not call them back.
What really worried Connor was Thomas Morgan’s and Quenna Graham’s phone calls.
Thomas had called Connor nearly 50 times. If it wasn’t for something important, Thomas would never have called him so many times.
Therefore, Connor immediately dialed Thomas’s number.
“Ding!”
After the phone rang twice, Thomas picked up the phone and asked softly, “Mr. McDonald, you’re already awake?”
After hearing Thomas’s words, Connor couldn’t help but be stunned for a moment. Then, he frowned and asked softly, “You knew about my situation?”
“I couldn’t get through to you a few days ago, so I went to Jorge’s place to ask about your condition. Then, I found out that you were unconscious…” Thomas explained slowly.
“So that’s how it is!”
Connor nodded lightly.
Thomas was a smart person. He also knew that Connor often went to Jorge’s place, so it was normal for him to look for Connor there.
“Alright, let’s get down to business. You called me so many times. Is there something important?” Connor asked in a low voice.
“Mr. McDonald, we might not have any hope for the Metro Line 9 project…”
Thomas didn’t waste any words.
Connor felt that Thomas was not joking. A trace of doubt flashed across his eyes as he frowned and asked, “What do you mean by ‘no hope’?”

chapters.title: Chapter 908: The Best Outcome
chapters.content:
Chapter 908: The Best Outcome
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
“Mr. McDonald, the situation is like this. After the board meeting, the Empire World Corporation put all their energy into the Metro Line 9 project. Originally, we only had a 10% chance of winning the Metro Line 9 project, but after putting our effort into the operations, the probability of us winning this project rose to 40%, which was far higher than Rockefeller’s…”
Thomas explained slowly.
“And then?”
“The people from Rockefeller seem to have discovered our intentions. They are also determined to win this subway project, so they have made a huge sacrifice. Just a few days ago, the people from Rockefeller met with the vice president of the subway administration and promised that if they can win this project, they will change the management rights of the subway project from five years to two years!” Thomas continued.
“Five years to two years… Is this Birdie Schroder crazy?”
Connor said in a low voice.
“Yes, if we can operate it for five years, then this project will definitely be profitable. However, if it becomes two years, then this project will at most not lose money. If we want to compete with Rockefeller for this project, we have to give up a larger portion of the profits. If we do that, then it won’t be meaningful for us to get this project…”
Connor didn’t know much about the company affairs, so he took the initiative to ask, “Why is it meaningless?
Thomas paused for a moment and then analyzed, “Mr. McDonald, are you trying to get this project to lure Birdie Schroder to meet you?”
“That’s right!”
Connor nodded lightly.
“Then, Mr. McDonald, if we want Birdie Schroder to take the initiative to meet you, it’s not just because you’ve won this project. It’s because we must have the strength to compete with Rockefeller while also winning this project. We have to make sure that Rockefeller won’t be able to win any projects in Porthampton in the future. Only then will Rockefeller realize the crisis and be forced to meet you…”
Thomas explained patiently.
“Alright…”
“Mr. McDonald, we have already invested a lot of energy into this subway project. If we continue to give up our interests, the company may face a huge crisis, and it won’t be one we can recover from in a short period of time. This means that we will lose the ability to compete with Rockefeller for other projects. At that time, not only will Rockefeller’s people not meet you, but this will also be a situation that benefits them. Their losses this time can be made up for in the future, but our company will be in a huge crisis because of the rupture of the economic chain. This is not a good idea!”
Thomas said in a serious tone.
Connor could not help but take a deep breath as he held his phone. The expression on his face was a complicated one.
Originally, Connor thought that as long as he won this project at any cost, the people of Rockefeller would not be able to sit still. However, after hearing Thomas’s words, Connor realized that the real way to make Rockefeller take the initiative to contact him was to make them lose the subway project and all subsequent projects. Only then would the people of Rockefeller be truly afraid.
The reason why Rockefeller’s people chose to give up on profits was obviously to force Connor to make a choice.
Otherwise, Connor would make a bigger concession to get the project, but this would cause Thomas’s company in Porthampton to enter an endless cycle of recouping costs.
Connor was indeed very rich, but once there was such a huge break in the capital chain, there was only so much they could do. Most importantly, the company would not be able to recover in a short period of time. Rockefeller’s people could take this opportunity to expand their power.
If Connor gave up on this project now, it would mean that all their efforts during this period of time would be in vain.
For a moment, Connor began to feel a little troubled. He was, after all, an ordinary person. The business world was like a battlefield. His way of dealing with these things was naturally not as good as those people from Rockefeller.
“Is there no other way?”
Connor asked in a low voice.
“Ways?”
Thomas hesitated for a moment before he said in a low voice, “Mr. McDonald, there is indeed a way, but this matter can only be handled by you…”
“What method? Just say it!”
Connor replied indifferently.
“Actually, this method is very simple. I mentioned it to you before. Commander Shaw’s younger brother is the general manager of our subway headquarters. If you can contact Commander Shaw and ask the general manager of the subway headquarters to give this project to us internally, then things will be much simpler…”
Thomas said slowly.
“This…”
After Connor heard Thomas’s words, a trace of helplessness flashed across his eyes. He did not know what to do.
After all, Connor and Joey did not have much of a relationship. The reason why Joey was able to help Connor back then was also because of Rachel Wallace.
Therefore, if Connor wanted to get to know Joey’s brother, he had to find Rachel, then contact Joey through Rachel and finally get into contact with Joey’s brother.
This was equivalent to going around in a very big circle.
Connor had always not wanted Rachel to participate in his matters, but he did not expect that things would still come back to this in the end.
Connor hesitated for a moment before asking in a low voice, “Other than this method, is there no other way?”
“No, this is the best solution I can think of at the moment. As long as you can find Commander Shaw, then with his relationship and the price difference of our offer, I think it should be no problem for us to win this project!”
Thomas said slowly.
“Alright, I got it!”
Connor replied expressionlessly and then hung up the phone.
After hanging up, Connor lay on the bed alone with a conflicted expression on his face.
He was conflicted about whether he should contact Rachel or not, and whether Rachel would help him!
After thinking for a while, Connor still looked up Rachel’s phone number and dialed it.
Connor knew that Rachel might be his last hope. If she could help, it would be the best outcome. If not, then there was nothing he could do. He had tried his best.

chapters.title: Chapter 909: Appointment With Rachel Wallace
chapters.content:
Chapter 909: Appointment With Rachel Wallace
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
“Ding!”
The phone rang twice before Rachel picked it up. She said coldly, “Who is it?”
“Ms. Wallace, I’m Connor!”
Connor replied with a smile.
“I know you’re Connor. So you do know how to call me? Although I promised you before that you wouldn’t have to ask for leave from me, what on Earth are you thinking by suddenly disappearing for so long?”
Rachel’s voice carried a trace of anger.
“Ms. Wallace, I ran into some trouble a while ago—I was in a coma for a month and only woke up today. After I woke up, I contacted you immediately…” Connor hurriedly explained.
“You were unconscious for a month?”
After Rachel heard Connor’s words, she could not help but be stunned for a moment. Then, she asked with a puzzled expression, “How did that happen?”
“What else could it be? I met an assassin…”
Connor casually lied.
“Is it one of Rockefeller’s people?”
At this moment, Rachel’s voice had clearly softened a lot, and she even sounded a little concerned.
“I’m not sure who it was exactly, but fortunately, I was lucky. When I was escaping, I accidentally hit my head, but I saved my life. Because I was worried that the killer would find me again, I haven’t contacted anyone during this period of time…”
Connor said all this nonsense with a straight face.
Rachel seemed to not believe Connor’s words and asked in a doubtful tone, “Really?”
“Of course it’s true. Why would I lie to you about such things?”
Connor hurriedly shouted and then continued, “Ms. Wallace, if you don’t believe me, let’s meet up. I’ll explain everything to you face to face.”
Connor felt that it was better to ask Rachel for help in person. His intentions might not be clear over the phone.
“Where are you now? I’ll go and find you!”
Rachel hesitated for a moment before asking softly.
“I’ve already been discharged from the hospital. Why don’t we meet somewhere else? It’s all thanks to you that I haven’t returned to school for so long. Otherwise, I would have been expelled long ago, so I’ll treat you to a meal to thank you for your care.”
Connor said with a smile.
“…”
On the other end of the phone, Rachel smiled disdainfully and then said lightly, “Alright, let’s meet at the western restaurant from before!”
“Alright!”
Connor hurriedly replied after Rachel agreed to his request. Then, he hung up the phone, changed into a new set of clothes, and ran out of the villa in a hurry.
After leaving the villa, Connor suddenly found that his body had completely recovered. Not only had he recovered, but he could also feel that his speed, strength, and agility had been greatly improved. It was quite a magical feeling.
“I didn’t expect that the medicinal pill that old man gave me to eat would actually have an effect!” Connor couldn’t help but think. Then, he flagged down a taxi and rushed to the western restaurant near the school.
As it was the weekend, Rachel chose to meet Connor at the restaurant.
When Connor arrived at the restaurant, he found that there were many students in the restaurant, and most of them were couples, giving people a very charming feeling.
After Connor entered the restaurant, he saw Rachel sitting by the window.
Today, Rachel was wearing a short black skirt. Her sexy figure looked especially charming under the short skirt. Her slender and fair legs were of moderate thickness. She was wearing black stockings and a pair of high heels. Her exquisite face and black curly hair gave off an indescribable temptation.
At this moment, Rachel was holding her cheek with one hand and holding her phone with the other, looking at the scenery outside the window.
Today, Rachel was more noble and elegant than usual, but less seductive.
Connor took a deep breath and then directly walked towards her.
After hearing the footsteps, Rachel turned her head and looked at Connor indifferently. Then, she asked softly, “Connor, didn’t you say that you were injured? Where are your wounds?”
“I suffered internal injuries, and the wounds weren’t really visible. I accidentally hit my head when I was escaping. Although it wasn’t a big deal, I fainted!”
Connor explained with a smile as he sat opposite Rachel.
“…”
Rachel sized up Connor. She was a very smart woman. She could naturally tell whether Connor was lying or not.
However, Rachel did not choose to expose Connor because she knew that there were some things that Connor would not tell her.
“Ms. Wallace, what do you want to eat today? Hurry up, it’s my treat today, so don’t hold back!”
Connor took the initiative to hand the menu to Rachel.
Rachel didn’t even look at the menu. “Alright, Connor, don’t put on an act with me. If you have anything to ask of me, just say it. I don’t like to beat around the bush!”
After Connor heard Rachel’s words, he couldn’t help but be stunned for a moment. Then, he asked with an awkward expression, “Ms. Wallace, how did you know that I have something to ask of you today?”
“Why else would you be so kind as to treat me to a meal? You can’t hide from me now…”
Rachel rolled her eyes at Connor.
“Haha…”
Connor couldn’t help but laugh awkwardly. Then, he said, “You’re really smart. Since you’ve already made it sound so ridiculous, then I won’t beat around the bush. I do have something to ask of you!”
“Tell me, what is it?”
Rachel said casually while playing with her phone.
“It’s like this…”
Connor told Rachel everything about the subway project.
After Rachel heard Connor’s story, she nodded thoughtfully and asked in a puzzled tone, “I understand what you mean. In order to deal with the people from Rockefeller, you want to take down this subway project, but I don’t understand how I can help you with this matter. I’m just a university lecturer. I don’t know anything about the business world!”
“Ms. Wallace, of course you can help me. Do you know who the boss of the subway is?”
Connor hurriedly said.
Rachel didn’t know much about the business world, so she frowned and asked, “Who is it?”
“Joey Shaw—Commander Shaw’s younger brother!” Connor replied.
After Rachel heard Connor’s words, she finally understood Connor’s true intentions and lightly smiled. “Oh, I see!”
“Yes, that’s the situation!”
Connor smiled and nodded.
“Then I’m sorry, I can’t help you!”
Rachel’s expression suddenly changed to a cold one.

chapters.title: Chapter 910: Rachel's Conditions
chapters.content:
Chapter 910: Rachel’s Conditions
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
After Connor heard Rachel’s words, he could not help but be stunned for a moment, and the expression on his face seemed somewhat puzzled.
“Aren’t you on good terms with Joey Shaw?” he asked hurriedly. You just need to help me with this matter. Why can’t you help me?”
“…”
Rachel looked at Connor indifferently. “I think you might have made a mistake. You’ve actually met Joey Shaw more times than I have. He only helped me because of the Wallace family. It has nothing to do with me personally. I already owe him a favor for his helping you last time. If I help you now, it will be equivalent to me owing his another favor, and I don’t like to owing people many favors. Do you understand what I mean?”
“I mean, you owe me one or two favors already. Just help me!”
Connor displayed his shameless spirit to the extreme and said with a smile.
“…”
After Rachel heard Connor’s words, she could not help but roll her eyes and directly stood up, wanting to leave.
“Ms. Wallace, this time, I’m doing this to deal with the people of Rockefeller. I also paid a lot already, okay? Didn’t you say that you would be my friend? Don’t you want to deal with Rockefeller too? Now is the best opportunity to deal with them. Are you really going to miss this opportunity?”
Connor shouted excitedly at Rachel.
“You call this dealing with Rockefeller?” Rachel looked at Connor and sneered. Then, she said indifferently, “Connor, I think you might have really oversimplified things. It wouldn’t be Rockefeller if they were so easy to deal with.”
“I know that the Schroder family is a small fry, but they can help me open the way to deal with Rockefeller. I don’t know anything about Rockefeller now, so I have to get this project and contact Birdie Schroder.”
Connor shouted at Rachel with a serious expression.
“…”
