When Rachel saw Connor suddenly become serious, a strange expression flashed across her eyes. She then said in a low voice, “You seem to have placed too much importance on this Birdie Schroder…”
Connor took a deep breath and said coldly to Rachel, ” I won’t hide it from you. The last phone call my father made before he died was to Birdie’s father, Warren Schroder. He was the previous person-in-charge of Rockefeller’s base in Porthampton. Therefore, I don’t just want to deal with Rockefeller, I also want to find out how my father died. Warren and Birdie Schroder are really important to me…”
Rachel looked at Connor and hesitated for two seconds. Then, she slowly sat down and said softly, “Your parents’ deaths are actually related to Warren Schroder?”
“I’m not sure if they’re related or not, but I think that since my father called Warren Schroder before he died, it means that my father must know him. There must be a lot of information that I don’t know. After so many years, I always thought that my parents died in a car accident, but now I’ve finally found some clues to uncover the cause of my parents’ deaths,” Connor said seriously.
“…”
Rachel hesitated for a second before saying softly, “I can help you with this matter, but I’ll also need your help with something!”
Connor didn’t expect Rachel to actually agree. He shouted with an excited expression, “What is it? Tell me, as long as I can help, I will definitely help you!”
“Next week, the Porthampton University will be holding a sports meet. The results of the sports meet are related to our lecturer’s final ratings. I know that your physical fitness is good…”
“Ms. Wallace, stop joking with me. Who are you? You’re the daughter of the Wallace family. Do you still care about these things?” Connor said helplessly to Rachel.
Connor knew that Rachel didn’t really want to be a lecturer at the Porthampton University for the rest of her life. She definitely had other motives for coming to Porthampton, so he felt that she shouldn’t care about these things!
“This has nothing to do with my identity. I’m a lecturer now, and I’m also very serious in anything I do. I love what I do, so I don’t want my final review to be worse than the others. Do you understand what I mean?”
Rachel replied seriously.
She was not joking at this time. She was indeed a very serious person. This had a lot to do with her living in a big family since she was young.
There were many children in the Wallace family, so there was naturally a lot of comparison between parents. Rachel had been the most outstanding one since she was young. Even if the final review would not have any impact on Rachel’s life, Rachel did not want to be worse than anyone else.
“Alright, I promise you that I will definitely help you get a good result. Don’t worry!”
Connor smiled and nodded.
“One more thing. Our school needs to invite some sponsors for this sports meet. Since you know so many people in Porthampton. It shouldn’t be difficult to invite some famous bosses, right?” Rachel slowly said.
It wasn’t Connor’s first time attending a sports meet, so he naturally knew what a sponsor was. In fact, he knew that the university relied on the connections of the students’ families to invite some well-known bosses to promote the sports meet. At the same time, the university could also promote these bosses. At that time, there would also be television reporters and media reporting on it. It was a good thing for the university.
Basically, as long as it was a sports meet, the students would do everything they could to use their family connections to invite some sponsors.
“You should know as many big bosses as I do, right?” Connor said with a frown.
“I know less than ten in Porthampton. Besides, I’m a lecturer, and you’re Thomas Morgan’s boss, the famous Mr. McDonald of Porthampton City. This shouldn’t be a problem for you, right?” Rachel said calmly.
“This…”
A strange look flashed across Connor’s eyes.
“What’s wrong? Can’t you do it? If you don’t think it’s possible, then just pretend that I didn’t say anything…” Rachel said.
“I mean, I can do it, but if I call all those bosses to our school, won’t all the students know my identity? I don’t want to expose myself…” Connor said slowly.
Finding a few bosses to be sponsors was nothing to Connor at all. However, he was just worried about the subsequent impact.

chapters.title: Chapter 911: Make Some Contribution
chapters.content:
Chapter 911: Make Some Contribution
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
“You just need to find some random VIPs. Those people don’t have to be very rich. Don’t bother with people like Thomas and Kyle.” Rachel paused for a moment. After which, she sized up Connor and said softly, “Actually, I asked you to find a sponsor to help you…”
“Help me?”
Hearing that, he could not help but smile. Then, he asked indifferently, “What are you helping me with? Help me expose my identity?”
“The last sponsorship of the Finance faculty was all found by Brandon. Now that Brandon has dropped out of school because of you, the students in the Finance faculty can’t find sponsors at all. You know how our students laughed at those classes that couldn’t find sponsors during the last sports meet. This time, the tables have turned. I reckon that when the time comes, the other classes will laugh at our students,” Rachel softly explained.
Connor looked at Rachel without saying anything.
Connor knew that what Rachel said was very likely to happen. Finding sponsors for the sports meet had long become an occasion for students of Porthampton University to compete with each other. It was a competition of who had the most connections and who had the most powerful background.
During the last sports meet, Brandon invited many famous local entrepreneurs. So the students of their class went around showing off and even almost had conflicts with the students of other classes. Therefore, Connor felt that if their class couldn’t find any sponsors this time, the other classes would take revenge.
“Connor, you’ll be spending less and less time at Porthampton University in the future. Just treat it as a contribution to our class!” Rachel slowly said.
“I didn’t expect you to care about these things!” Connor said to Rachel with a smile.
“I’ve said it before. No matter what I do, I have to do my best. I know what our students are thinking!” Rachel replied indifferently.
“All right, I’ll agree to your condition since you’ve said so. I’ll help our class find a sponsor, and you help me contact Joey. What do you think?” Connor asked softly.
“Deal!” Rachel nodded. Then, without hesitation, she stood up and walked out of the restaurant.
“Ms. Wallace, are you really not going to eat anything?” Seeing Rachel leaving, he hurriedly asked.
“I’m on a diet!” Rachel replied and then walked out of the restaurant.
After Rachel left, Connor couldn’t help but smile. He didn’t expect a wealthy lady like Rachel to care about the sports meet. It was indeed unbelievable.
Connor also knew that the two conditions that Rachel proposed were not considered conditions at all. To put it bluntly, Rachel was helping Connor for free this time, but she did not want Connor to feel that he owed her a favor, so she did this.
But no matter what, Connor had completed his task today. As long as Rachel agreed to help contact the middleman, the project of Subway line 9 was probably in the bag.
Connor took a deep breath, took out his phone, and dialed Thomas’s number.
“Hello, Mr. McDonald!” Thomas greeted politely after he picked up the call.
“I’ve already gotten someone to help me contact Joey’s younger brother. You don’t have to worry about this,” Connor said in a low voice.
“That’s great…” Hearing the good news, Thomas shouted excitedly.
“By the way, next Monday is our Porthampton University’s sports meet. Help me find a few similar entrepreneurs to be sponsors,” Connor said slowly.
“Mr. McDonald, do you want me to go over personally?”
After Thomas heard Connor’s order, he was stunned momentarily and asked softly.
“No. You’re too famous in Porthampton. If you go, you’ll probably scare these students to death. Just help me find a few people. Oh, right, tell them not to expose my identity,” Connor said softly.
“Mr. McDonald, don’t worry. You want to find a few sponsors but don’t want to expose your identity, right?” Thomas said with a smile.
“Yes, that’s what I mean!” Connor nodded.
“All right, I know what to do. Don’t worry. I’ll settle this for you!” Thomas said.
“All right, if there’s nothing else, ciao!”
“All right…”
After hanging up the phone, Connor gently stretched his body, paid for Rachel’s cup of coffee, turned around, and left the restaurant.
Now that everything had been settled, Connor relaxed a lot. He took a taxi home and prepared to have a good rest.
Although the side effects of the Essence Cultivating Pill had already disappeared, Connor still felt a little tired, so he prepared to adjust for some time.
..
After leaving the restaurant, Connor took a taxi back to Royal No. 1 and rested.
Connor’s body was still frail as he had been unconscious for too long. He slept until 8 AM the next day.
After Connor woke up, he took out his phone and glanced at it. He found that Rachel had called him, so he quickly called back.
“Ding, ding!” After the phone rang twice, Rachel picked up the call.
“Ms. Wallace, is there news from Joey?” Connor hurriedly asked with a smile after Rachel answered the call.
“Yes, I gave Joey a call last night. Joey has already agreed to arrange for you to meet his brother. The time is set for next Saturday…” Rachel said calmly.
“That’s great…” A trace of excitement flashed in his eyes as he exclaimed.
“Don’t be too happy yet. Joey only promised to arrange for you to meet his brother, but he didn’t say he would help you get the subway project,” Rachel slowly said.
“When the time comes, won’t it be a matter of your word?” Connor grinned.
“What…” Rachel was speechless when she heard Connor’s comment. She said in a low voice, “You’d better do what I told you to do first!”
“Don’t worry about this. I’ll help you make it happen!” Connor replied with a smile.
For Connor, as long as he could get the subway project, a burden would be lifted off his heart. Other things were trivial to Connor.

chapters.title: Chapter 912: The Sports Meet
chapters.content:
Chapter 912: The Sports Meet
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
After hanging up the phone, Connor washed up and had breakfast.
After breakfast, Connor didn’t look for Jorge. Instead, he decided to return to school.
After all, Connor had not been to school recently. He felt that he should go back to school to take a look. Otherwise, Dominic, Spencer, and the others would think Connor had dropped out of school.
After returning to school, Connor found that the students in the class seemed to be preparing for the sports meet. The podium on the field was being constructed, and the competition venue was planned.
Porthampton University’s sports meet was held once a year. It was second only to the school’s anniversary among all university activities. This year’s sports meet coincidentally coincided with the school’s anniversary, so the school attached great importance to this sports meet. This was also the reason Rachel asked Connor to help.
“Connor, you’re finally back for class. If you didn’t come back soon, Spencer and I were going to make a missing person report…” When Dominic and Spencer entered the classroom, they saw Connor playing with his phone.
“I had something to do a while ago, so I didn’t come to class…” Connor put down his phone and explained with a smile.
“I know rich heirs like you have many things to do, so I didn’t look for you. I was afraid of disturbing you…” Dominic grinned and replied.
Spencer walked to Connor’s side and asked mysteriously, “Connor, where have you been these past few days? Did you look for your girlfriend, Yelena? I’ve seen the news. Your girlfriend, Yelena, is currently filming a blockbuster overseas, and there seem to be many international superstars in this movie. If you go to your girlfriend next time, can you help me get a few autographs?”
“I had some personal matters to deal with, so I didn’t look for Yelena…” Connor replied helplessly.
“What private matters?” Spencer blinked and asked curiously.
Connor turned and looked at Spencer, not knowing how to answer.
“Connor, you’re so rich now. Can’t you bring Spencer and me out to see the world? Aren’t you being too mean? When you didn’t have money, we treated you to so many things!” Dominic said to Connor, sounding a little upset.
“That’s right, Connor. Don’t tell me you’ve forgotten about us just because you’re rich now?” Spencer said.
Connor looked at Dominic and Spencer helplessly. He said in a low voice, “I was dealing with some personal matters, not having fun. But don’t worry. If I’m out for fun, I’ll bring the two of you along.”
“That’s more like it!” Hearing Connor’s promise, Dominic smiled happily.
Connor, Dominic, and Spencer chatted briefly before the bell rang. Connor began seriously paying attention to the class while Dominic and Spencer slept and played with their phones.
Half a day passed quickly.
Connor’s class had classes in the morning and no classes in the afternoon. Therefore, after the morning class, all the students picked up their textbooks and returned to the dormitory. Connor also planned to go home.
“Please wait a moment!” But at this moment, Eunice suddenly stood up and shouted.
After hearing Eunice’s words, everyone looked up at Eunice, puzzled.
“I want to hold a class meeting. Can everyone spare a few minutes to cooperate with me?” Eunice asked politely.
When everyone heard Eunice’s words, they stopped what they were doing.
After all, as the student representative, Eunice was very popular in the class. Basically, all the students respected her.
“Thank you, everyone!” Seeing that all the students in the classroom had stopped leaving, she bowed slightly to the crowd and walked up to the podium.
“I asked everyone to stay on for a bit today because I want to discuss the sports meet with everyone!”
After Eunice walked up to the podium, she did not waste any time and went straight to the point.
“Eunice, what’s up with the sports meet?” The students in the classroom looked confused and asked Eunice in confusion.
“Well, I just learned from the sports committee that the students in our class aren’t enthusiastic about signing up. There are many events that no one is participating in, so I hope everyone can actively participate…” Eunice said softly.
“…”
When everyone heard Eunice’s explanation, they all lowered their heads, and no one spoke.
“You can get extra credits by participating in the sports meet, so students who usually have lower credits can use this sports meet to get more credits…” Eunice quickly added when nobody responded.
“Eunice, it’s not that we don’t want to participate. It’s just that we’re not good at those events…”
“That’s right. Even if we participate, we’ll only be embarrassing our class. We won’t be able to get any results!”
“Brandon and Harvey have always been the ones participating, but now both have dropped out of school…” The students in the classroom whispered.
Hearing the discussion, Eunice looked a little helpless. Then, she bit her lip and said softly, “It doesn’t matter even if you don’t win. As long as you participate, you will be rewarded with credits…”
When the students in the classroom heard that, they did not seem to react at all. After all, this was the school’s annual sports meet. All the students in the school would go to watch the competitions. Moreover, there would be a television station broadcasting it. How embarrassing would it be if they participated and got the last place?
“Are you two participating?”
Connor turned to look at Spencer and Dominic and asked softly.
“I’m participating in the 100-meter race, and Spencer is participating in the medicine ball throwing. However, neither of us is very good. As long as we don’t get the last place…” Dominic chuckled.
“You know how to throw medicine balls?” Connor turned and looked at Spencer. A trace of shock flashed in his eyes as he asked in disbelief.
“Can’t we just throw that thing around…” Spencer grinned and asked.
“I’m afraid Spencer might throw the medicine ball at the referee…” Dominic ridiculed.
“Please! I’ve trained before, okay? You’d better think about how you will run that hundred meters. Don’t fall on your face…” Spencer quickly retorted.

chapters.title: Chapter 913: Aren't You Going To Deliver Food?
chapters.content:
Chapter 913: Aren’t You Going To Deliver Food?
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Hearing their banter, Connor smiled and didn’t say anything.
In fact, sometimes, Connor preferred the school atmosphere. It was relaxing.
If it was really possible, Connor wanted to live like an ordinary person.
Before inheriting the inheritance, although Connor was very poor and his life was tough, at least he was happy then.
Although Connor had money, he could no longer be as happy as before.
Therefore, having money meant only some things. Having money did not necessarily mean being happy.
Standing on the podium, Eunice saw that the students in the classroom did not seem to have any intention of registering. A hint of helplessness flashed in her eyes.
She took out a form and said timidly, “Since no one is willing to participate, I won’t force everyone. However, according to our school’s rules, each boy and girl in a class must participate in seven events. This is the school’s rule…
“There are already seven girls participating in our class, but among the boys, only Dominic is in the 100-meter race, Spencer is in the medicine ball race, and Wes is in the high jump. There are still four events that have no one,” Eunice looked at everyone and said seriously.
“Eunice, those good at sports in our class have already dropped out. The remaining boys don’t know anything. How are we going to participate?” A skinny boy in the class said helplessly.
“That’s right. It’s not that we don’t want to participate, but we’ll still be the last even if we participate.”
“I heard that people from the television station are coming to the sports meet this time. I don’t want to embarrass myself in front of my relatives and friends…”
Everyone started speaking.
“Everyone, it’s just about participation. Nothing is embarrassing about it. Moreover, so many people signed up, but there’s only one first place,” Eunice said with a frown.
“Although there is only one person in the first place, there is also only one person in the last place. If we register, we will be in the last place…” A boy who usually liked to be sarcastic laughed and shouted.
“Hahaha…” Everyone started to laugh after hearing that.
Eunice looked at the students in the classroom helplessly. Previously, the school’s sports meet was organized by Harvey and Brandon. Back then, the students in the class were very enthusiastic, and everyone actively participated. But now that Brandon and Harvey were gone, the students in the class began to slack off.
For a moment, Eunice didn’t know what to do.
“If our class doesn’t have representatives for all fourteen events, then all the students will have their credits deducted!” Eunice said with a frown.
When everyone heard that, a strange look flashed in their eyes, especially some girls were even more worried.
However, most of the boys still had yet to change their minds. After all, they were either good at their studies and did not have to worry about their credits being deducted, or they were not good at their studies. Credits were of no use to them at all. It was enough as long as they could graduate.
However, a few girls in the class were already very good at their studies. They had even planned to compete for the national scholarship. If their credits were deducted because of this, their chance at the scholarship would be ruined.
However, no matter how anxious these girls were, they couldn’t do anything. After all, they couldn’t take the place of these boys to participate in the sports meet!
“If only Brandon and Harvey were still here. Back then, this wouldn’t have happened when they were here…”
“Yeah, the boys in our class are too weak, right? No one even went to the sports meet. It was too embarrassing!”
“Everyone usually brags about how great they are, but now they don’t even dare to participate in a sports meet. It’s too ridiculous!”
The girls in the classroom began to mock the boys.
“Everyone, quiet down!” When Eunice heard the mocking, she quickly frowned and shouted. She knew these words would only make the boys in the class lose interest in participating in the sports meet.
“…”
The girls in the class all shut up while the boys blushed, not knowing what to say.
Eunice adjusted her emotions and asked expressionlessly, “Are there any boys in our class who want to participate in the sports meet?”
Everyone lowered their heads and did not speak.
Eunice’s eyes flashed with a trace of helplessness, not knowing what to do.
“I’ll participate!” Just as Eunice was about to give up, someone suddenly spoke up in the classroom.
When everyone heard the voice, they all turned to look in the direction of the voice.
They were shocked and doubtful when they saw that the person who spoke was Connor.
Connor had never participated in the previous sports games because he had to use the time the sports games to work part-time or deliver food to earn money.
After all, he had much time to deliver food during the sports meet.
“Connor, are you going to the sports meet?” A boy asked Connor in surprise.
“Yes, I want to participate!” Connor nodded calmly.
“Connor, are you joking? Aren’t you going to deliver food?”
“Hahaha, that’s right, Connor. I remember that you have to deliver food during the sports meet every year?”
“This year’s sports event is so big. There will be many people ordering takeout. I think it’s better for you to deliver takeout…”
“Connor seems to have not delivered food for a long time…”
The boys in the class began to mock Connor because they were very disdainful of Connor’s behavior. After all, the other boys would not participate, and only he stood up. Wasn’t he deliberately embarrassing the other boys?
That was why the boys in the class mocked Connor like this.
“Oh, shut up. What does Connor’s delivery have to do with you?” After Dominic heard what everyone said, a trace of anger flashed in his eyes as he frowned and shouted.
“Dominic, what do you mean? Aren’t we telling the truth? Connor has never participated in a sports meet before. It would be embarrassing if he got the last place!”
“That’s right. Why don’t we encourage Connor to deliver more takeaways so he can save up for the tuition fees for next semester?” the boys in the class quickly retorted.

chapters.title: Chapter 914: Sign Me Up For Everything
chapters.content:
Chapter 914: Sign Me Up For Everything
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
When Dominic and Spencer heard what the boys said, a trace of anger flashed in their eyes.
At this moment, they wanted to tell them Connor’s true identity and then ruthlessly slap these people in the face.
Connor saw Dominic opening his mouth to speak and hurriedly reached out to stop Dominic, indicating that Dominic did not need to argue with these people.
Dominic took a deep breath and turned to look at Connor without saying anything, but he was still very clearly angry.
“Why are you people speaking so harshly? No matter what, Connor has the guts to participate in the sports meet. He’s much better than you, cowards. What right do you have to laugh at Connor?!”
“Connor, I have high hopes for you. If you participate, I will support you no matter your rank!”
“That’s right. I’ll be your cheerleader!”
“Connor is the most handsome!”
The female students in the classroom also shouted.
Hearing the encouragement from the girls, Connor smiled faintly and asked Eunice softly, “Eunice, what events can I participate in this sports meet?”
Eunice was stunned for a moment, then quickly looked down at the form in front of her and said, “The 200-meter sprint, the 800-meter long-distance run, the high jump, the long jump…”
“You just said that our class still lacks four events, right?” Connor asked Eunice softly.
“That’s right. There are still four more events to go. The school has stipulated that every class must participate in seven events…” Eunice nodded lightly.
“Well, it just so happens that you can help me sign up for these four events…” Connor said calmly.
“Are… Are you going to participate in all four events?”
Hearing that, she was instantly dumbfounded. She stood rooted to the ground with an incredulous expression on her face.
Eunice wasn’t the only one who had such a reaction. Everyone else in the class had the same reaction. Their mouths were wide open as they looked at the scene in shock.
It was already challenging for ordinary people to participate in one event. After all, these events consumed much physical strength. However, no one expected Connor to participate in four events at once!
“That’s right. Help me sign up for these four events!” Connor nodded lightly.
“Connor, are you kidding me? Are you going to participate in all four events?” Eunice looked at Connor doubtfully.
“Why would I joke with you? I want to participate in these four events. In this way, our class will have seven events!” Connor said lightly.
In fact, Connor didn’t sign up because he wanted to show off. On the contrary, he didn’t want to waste time on this. It was just that Connor had promised Rachel that he would help their class get a good result in the sports meet, so Connor had no choice but to participate in these four events.
“Can you participate in four events in one go, all on the same day?” Eunice was a little worried about Connor and asked him softly.
“No problem!” Connor replied indifferently.
“Haha…”
At this moment, a boy could not help but sneer and say disdainfully, “Then, there’s no problem. Wouldn’t it be fine if we forfeit?”
“That’s right. You can’t pretend like this. Our school has been around for many years, but I’ve never heard anyone participating in four events at once!”
“I think we won’t be able to find Connor by then. He might drop out of them last minute!”
The boys in the classroom were very unhappy with Connor’s actions and shouted one after another.
“So what if Connor drops out? We still support Connor!”
“That’s right. At least Connor has the guts to participate, unlike you people who only know how to compete with your mouths!” The girls in the classroom retorted one after another.
“I can’t do such a shameful thing. If I don’t have that ability, I won’t participate. I wouldn’t say I like to act tough like some people. I’ll know when I get slapped in the face…” The boy from before said sarcastically.
After Connor heard the boy’s words, he couldn’t help but smile faintly. Then, he said expressionlessly, “Don’t worry, since I’m going to participate, I’ll aim for good results. Although I can’t guarantee I’ll get first place, I won’t give up or get last place!”
“Connor, you’re so cool!”
“That’s right, Connor is really cool. I’ll wear a miniskirt to cheer for you…”
“Me too. I’ll wear whatever you want me to wear!”
A few charming girls in the classroom shouted excitedly at Connor.
The boys said disdainfully, “Hehe, it’s not easy to act tough. I’d like to see what results you can get!”
“…” Connor looked at the boys indifferently and didn’t say anything.
Eunice hesitated before asking Connor softly, “Connor, are you sure you want to participate in these four events?”
“Yes!” Connor nodded seriously.
Eunice hesitated before nodding lightly.
After Connor sat down, Dominic turned to look at Connor and asked Connor in a low voice, “Connor, are you crazy? Can you participate in so many events alone?”
“Yeah, all the boys in our class are waiting to see you make a fool of yourself. What if you can’t make it, or your results are terrible?” Spencer seemed to be a little worried about Connor as he asked Connor softly.
Connor smiled faintly after hearing their questions and said softly, “Don’t worry, I’ll have no problem participating in these four events alone!”
“Really?” Dominic looked at Connor with some worry in his eyes.
Even though Dominic and Spencer knew that Connor was very skilled, it did not mean that Connor could participate in so many events alone!
What Dominic and Spencer didn’t know was that Connor’s physical fitness was comparable to professional athletes. Therefore, it was no problem for Connor to participate in this sports meet. Connor wouldn’t have any pressure even if he participated in ten events, let alone four events.
“Since Connor is participating in four events alone, this is considered resolved. Let’s move on to the next problem…” Eunice announced.

chapters.title: Chapter 915: Eunice Feeling Helpless
chapters.content:
Chapter 915: Eunice Feeling Helpless
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
“Next problem?”
Hearing Eunice’s words, the students present were puzzled. They did not know what Eunice meant.
“Eunice, are there more problems?” A girl took the initiative to ask Eunice.
Eunice took a deep breath and said softly,” The second problem is related to the sports meet. Everyone should know that our school’s sports meet invites some local entrepreneurs to be sponsors every year. Moreover, the scale of this sports meet is relatively large, so the school has many requirements for sponsors…”
“There are requirements for sponsors too?” The students were puzzled.
“That’s right. Our school has stipulated that the sponsor’s net worth must be at least five million dollars and above. Moreover, they must have a certain degree of popularity in Porthampton. Our class has also found a few sponsors before, but those sponsors don’t meet the school’s requirements, so we have to trouble our students to find new sponsors…” Eunice said slowly.
The students revealed awkward expressions. For a moment, they did not know what to do.
It had to be known that the sponsors that the Finance faculty had found were all found through great efforts. However, they did not expect the school to have such high requirements for sponsors this time.
“Eunice, you must be joking with us. We spent much effort finding those sponsors, and now you’re saying those sponsors don’t meet the requirements. We can’t even invite qualified sponsors…”
“That’s right. Isn’t the school’s requirement too strict this time? Where will we find sponsors that are more than five million dollars?”
Everyone shouted.
After all, most students in the classroom were ordinary people, and they did not know many rich people. Moreover, they had spent much effort inviting those sponsors, but no one expected the school to be so strict with sponsors.
“This is the school’s rule. I don’t have a say in this!” Eunice said helplessly.
“Forget it, forget it. I’m not some rich heir anyway. I can’t find a sponsor…”
“If it’s some local small fish, I can still find them. However, if they’re worth more than five million dollars, I can’t find them…”
“That’s right. We’re not rich heirs. How would we know these rich people?”
Everyone began to discuss in low voices.
“If only Brandon were here. Brandon’s family is so rich. He would definitely be able to find a sponsor…”
“But Brandon has already dropped out of school. What’s the use of saying this!”
“That’s true. I guess, we won’t look for sponsors.”
“You make it sound so easy. If we can’t find a sponsor, the students from the other classes will laugh at our class…”
When Eunice heard the topic of discussion, a hint of helplessness flashed in her eyes. Then, she said, “Everyone, please be quiet!”
Everyone looked up at Eunice.
“I know finding a sponsor is tough, but this is the school’s rule. If we can’t find a sponsor, we’ll be laughed at by the other classes,” Eunice said.
The students in the classroom looked at Eunice and lowered their heads. No one said anything because this condition was a little difficult for them. Ordinary people like them had no way to find a suitable sponsor.
“Since no one is talking, I have an idea. I will provide everyone with a list later. All the students in our class will act separately. Everyone will look for suitable sponsors according to the address on the list and persuade these rich people to participate in our school’s sports meet.”
“Eunice, what kind of joke are you making? They are so busy. Who has the time to care about us?”
“That’s right, and why should we do these things?”
“I won’t be attending the event anyway. I’m already tired from class. I wanna go back and game!”
Everyone had objections.
Eunice looked helpless as she shouted anxiously, “Since you can’t get a sponsor and don’t want to go out with me to find one, what do you want? Are we just not going to have sponsors?”
“Eunice, it doesn’t seem to have anything to do with us whether we can find sponsors, right?”
“That’s right. You’re the student rep. You should do this. What does it have to do with us?”
“We’re not rich heirs. Where are we going to find sponsors?”
“Anyway, I won’t go. You’re the student rep, so you should be the one to solve it…”
Everyone said.
Eunice looked at the students in the classroom helplessly. She didn’t know what to do now.
These people’s words were also very unpleasant at this moment, so Eunice’s eyes were filled with tears. She bit her lip and tried to stop herself from crying.
Eunice felt that although their words were a little harsh, she was still the student rep and should resolve these things.
But Eunice needed help to solve these two problems. She wouldn’t have made these students stay for the meeting if she had a solution.
“Since no one is willing to look for sponsors, I’ll go out and look for them myself…” Eunice told the students with a choked voice.
“Eunice, I’ll go with you!” Dominic stood up and shouted.
“That’s right. I’ll go with you!” Spencer quickly said.
The students in the classroom turned to look at Dominic with disdain.
“All right…”
Seeing Dominic volunteer, Eunice was very touched. She quickly nodded and continued to ask, “Is there anyone else who wants to go with me?”
“You all don’t have to go…” However, at this moment, Connor suddenly shouted.
When everyone heard that, they all turned to look at Connor, puzzled.
“Connor, do you want to go alone?” Eunice hesitated before asking Connor.

chapters.title: Chapter 916: A Young and Beautiful Girl
chapters.content:
Chapter 916: A Young and Beautiful Girl
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
“Okay, leave this matter to me. You don’t have to worry!”
Connor said expressionlessly.
After hearing Connor’s words, Dominic and Spencer recalled that Connor was a rich guy now. He must know many big bosses, so it was absolutely easy for Connor to find sponsors.
Therefore, Dominic and Spencer looked at each other and chose to sit down.
The two of them knew Connor’s identity, but the other students in the classroom did not!
“Connor, are you saying that you can find sponsors yourself?”
Eunice looked at Connor with a hint of confusion.
“That’s right. Leave this matter to me. You don’t have to worry. I’ll find a sponsor!”
Connor nodded seriously.
“Connor, what are you talking about?”
At this moment, a boy shouted at Connor in disdain.
“Yeah, Connor. The school has stipulated that the sponsor’s net worth must be above five million. Do you know someone who can sponsor that much?”
“Of course, he does. He must know a lot of restaurant owners. Those bosses are quite rich!”
“Hahaha, that’s true!”
Everyone laughed at Connor.
“Shut it, guys.”
Dominic was somewhat angry, and then he continued, “Since Connor said that he can find a sponsor, then he definitely can…”
“That’s right, I also believe in Connor. If any of you can find a sponsor, then you can also offer to find one too.”
Spencer shouted.
“We can’t find a sponsor, and we won’t pretend that we can!”
The boy from before said sarcastically.
“Whether Connor is bluffing or not, you will know when the time comes!”
Dominic pursed his lips and replied. Then, he turned his head to look at Eunice and said in a serious tone, “Eunice, Connor will be able to find a sponsor. Let him do this!”
“…”
Eunice looked at Dominic and hesitated for a couple of seconds. Then, she asked Connor softly, “Connor, are you sure?”
“Yeap…”
Connor looked at Eunice and replied seriously.
“Alright, then!”
Eunice nodded and continued, “If that’s the case, these two matters have been resolved today. We’ll leave the sponsorship matter to Connor. We can end the meeting now…”
When the students in the class heard Eunice’s words, they began to pack their things and were ready to leave the classroom.
At this moment, most of the students felt that Connor was bragging just now, so they wanted to wait and see Connor make a fool of himself.
After hesitating for a moment, Eunice walked up to Connor and asked him softly, “Connor, are you serious about what you just said?”
“Of course, I’m serious!”
Connor smiled and nodded.
“But not only do you have to attend the sports meet, but you also have to find a sponsor. I’m a little worried that you won’t be able to handle it. If you face any difficulties, you can tell me now. You don’t have to act tough in front of me.”
Eunice whispered to Connor.
“Eunice, don’t worry. I can easily handle these two things!”
Connor replied softly.
Eunice looked at Connor with a worried expression.
“Eunice, don’t worry. Since Connor said that he can do it, then he will be able to do it. Don’t worry about him…”
Dominic said with a smile.
Eunice turned to look at Dominic, then said softly, “Alright then. Connor, if you face any problems, you can come see me. I will do my best to help you…”
“Alright!”
Connor nodded lightly.
“The three of you are going to participate in the sports meet. Do you want to go to the field to practice?”
Eunice was also participating in the women’s 800m relay, so she planned to practice with the others later. That was why she invited Connor, Dominic and Spencer.
“Alright, since I have nothing to do later, let’s go and practice together!”
Spencer smiled and said,
“Then, I’ll go too…”
Dominic hurriedly said.
“Connor, do you want to join us?”
Eunice thought for a moment and asked Connor softly.
“Sure, I don’t have anything to do now anyway. I’ll go with you guys to take a look!”
Connor nodded lightly.
Connor was not in a hurry to find Jorge Yarrell.
After all, Connor had just taken the Essence Cultivating Pill and his body had not fully recovered. If he was in a hurry to practice martial arts again, it would put a huge burden on his body.
Therefore, Connor planned to get a good rest for now and deal with the school sports meet and the subway project.
Connor followed Dominic, Eunice, and the others to the field. Perhaps it was because the sports meet was approaching, there were still many students on the field. Most of them were practicing for their own events.
Although Dominic and Spence were usually sloppy, they were still very serious in working on their tasks.
When they reached the field, one of them started running while the other started practicing shot put.
Eunice also joined her female classmates to practice jogging. In the end, Connor was left alone on the sports field.
The four events that Connor were taking part in were nothing to him. Of course, Connor wouldn’t practice. He just needed to take part in the sports meet and get a decent rank.
Connor strolled around the field alone for about half an hour. Finally, he stopped in front of a bench and sat on it. He played with his phone while waiting for Eunice, Dominic and Spencer.
Connor glanced at the field and saw a few girls practicing the high jump.
Among these girls, there was one girl who was exceptionally beautiful. Her youthful and beautiful face did not have any makeup on, giving off an especially refreshing feeling. Her long hair was like a waterfall, flowing down her shoulders, making her look extremely capable. She was wearing a white tank top and a pair of denim shorts. Her slender and fair legs were exposed to the air without reservation. She was wearing a pair of Nikes sneakers, giving off an extremely youthful and energetic feeling.
Perhaps because he was bored, Connor began to observe this girl.
…

chapters.title: Chapter 917: They Don't Have the Chance to Do That!
chapters.content:
Chapter 917: They Don’t Have the Chance to Do That!
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
On the field.
Connor was bored, so he sat on the bench and admired a few beauties who were practicing the high jump.
One of the beauties was very beautiful. Her high jump movements were also very elegant and skillful. She seemed to be a sports student.
Especially when the beautiful woman’s sexy long legs glided across the railing in a beautiful posture, it gave people the feeling that she was a fairy who had descended to the mortal world. She was very charming.
Connor was attracted by the beauty’s actions, so he was quietly admiring her.
However, after practicing for a while, the beauty seemed to be a little tired, so she sat on the chair to rest.
Connor could only look elsewhere.
“Lindsy, there’s a handsome guy who seems to be interested in you…”
As soon as the beauty sat down, her best friend beside her smiled and said.
“Who?”
The beautiful woman blinked her big watery eyes and replied casually.
“It’s that guy over there…”
Her best friend hurriedly pointed at Connor.
After hesitating for a moment, the beauty turned to look at Connor and said indifferently, “Stop fooling around. How do you know that he’s interested in me?”
“I’m not messing around with you. I can guarantee that the guy is interested in you because when you were practicing just now, he kept staring at you. Now that you’ve stopped, he stopped looking at you too…”
Her best friend hurriedly said.
When the beauty heard her best friend’s words, she turned and sized up Connor again. Then, she said indifferently, “Although this guy looks good, his outfit is a little old-fashioned. He’s not my type!”
“Why are you still so picky? You’re not young anymore. You’re already in your fourth year and are about to graduate. If you don’t get into a relationship, that won’t be right. That guy looks pretty good. You should take the initiative to get to know him. Maybe when the time comes you can have a relationship with a younger guy. Wouldn’t that leave a memorable university life experience for you?”
Her best friend looked at the beauty and said with a smile.
“Girl, look at yourself. You should be the one looking for a boyfriend. You really don’t have to worry about me…”
The beauty said helplessly.
“I’m not in a hurry. I’ve already had so many boyfriends. I’m worried about you. There are so many guys pursuing you, but you don’t like any of them. Are you planning to be single for the rest of your life?”
Her best friend said in a melancholic tone.
“What’s wrong with being single? Being single and free feel greats…”
The beauty smiled faintly and continued, “Alright, I’m going to continue training…”
“Fine. All you can think about is the high jump.”
Her best friend replied indifferently, then took out her phone and started playing with it.
Connor naturally didn’t know that they were talking about him, so when the beauty appeared again, he placed his attention on her.
However, Connor didn’t have any other intentions. He was just bored and wanted to find something to kill time.
The beauty seemed to have remembered what her best friend said. When she was training, she turned to look at Connor subconsciously, observing him.
Although her best friend’s words were just a joke, this beauty really took it seriously.
She was already in her fourth year of university and was a top student in the sports department of Porthampton University. Because of her long-term training, she had always maintained a very good figure. Coupled with her exquisite face, she naturally did not lack admirers.
However, the beauty had never had any feelings for these guys, so had she never had boyfriend in university.
She wanted to find a boyfriend too. After all, who wouldn’t want their university life to be one that is memorable?
Unfortunately, she had never met a suitable person before, so she had never been in a relationship.
However, when she saw Connor, he was actually interested. The only thing was that Connor’s clothes were a little old-fashioned. If he could dress himself up properly, he would definitely be a handsome guy.
“Lindsy Park, what are you thinking? This guy is so young. You’re about to graduate, yet here you are having such thoughts. You’d better hurry up and train!”
However, such a thought was just a fleeting thought. The beauty would not really want to get into a relationship with Connor.
So, she shook her head and dismissed the idea. Then, she focused all her attention on training.
About half an hour later, Lindsy was almost done with her training.
She packed up her things and was about to leave with her best friend.
“Lindsy, are you really not going to consider that guy? He’s still sitting there…”
Her best friend said to Lindsy with a smile.
“Shush now. He must be waiting for someone, and that person is not me. Besides, I’m about to graduate, so I don’t have the mood to think about these things at all. Even if we get together now, it won’t last long if I graduate and he’s still in school…”
Lindsy replied softly.
“Alright, then. I was just hoping that you don’t stay single for too long. Since you’re not very interested in that guy, then forget it!”
Her best friend smiled faintly and then walked out of the school with Lindsy.
Before Lindsy left, she turned to look at Connor. She secretly sighed to herself. If she had met this guy a year ago, she might have given this guy a chance. However, she would not consider these things now.
Not long after Lindsy and the others left, Dominic, Spencer and Eunice walked to Connor.
“Connor, why aren’t you training?”
Eunice asked Connor in confusion.
“I don’t need to train…”
Connor replied indifferently.
“But you’re participating in four events. If you don’t train, will you be able to handle it?”
Eunice asked Connor worriedly.
“Don’t worry, those four projects are nothing to me!”
Connor was very confident.
Dominic looked at Connor indifferently, then said to Connor softly, “Connor, you sure about this? Those gus in our class are all waiting to see you make a fool of yourself…”
“See me make a fool of myself?”
When Connor heard Dominic’s words, he smiled faintly, then stood up and put his arm around Dominic’s shoulder. “Don’t worry, they won’t have the chance to do that!”
..,

chapters.title: Chapter 918: The Harassment of a Rich Guy
chapters.content:
Chapter 918: The Harassment of a Rich Guy
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
When Eunice, Dominic and Spencer heard what Connor said, they shook their heads helplessly and did not say anything.
“You guys must hungry. Do you want me to buy you guys something to eat?”
Connor took the initiative to ask.
“No…”
Eunice didn’t know that Connor was a rich guy. She also didn’t know that this meal was nothing to him, so she instinctively wanted to refuse.
“Alright, as long as you’re buying!”
But before Eunice could say anything, Dominic shouted.
“That’s right. I have to eat a lot today. I’ll eat whatever is expensive…”
Spencer quickly said.
Eunice looked at Dominic and Spencer man with a puzzled expression.
Because from what she knew, Dominic and Spencer treated Connor very well.
Usually, the two of them would be the ones treating Connor to a meal. However, for some reason, Connor was treating them today.
“What do you guys want to eat?”
Connor asked.
“Let’s go to the best western restaurant next to our school. If you’re buying, I must eat the most expensive and best food out there!”
Dominic chuckled.
“That’s right, let’s go to that western restaurant!”
Spencer shouted.
“Alright then, let’s go to the western restaurant!”
Connor nodded his head lightly, then walked out of the school with Dominic and the others.
After hesitating for a moment, Eunice quickly ran to Connor’s side and whispered to him, “Connor, are you crazy? Do you know how expensive the food in that western restaurant is? If we go there for a meal, it will cost at least two to three thousand dollars…”
When Connor heard Eunice’s words, he couldn’t help but be stunned.
“And the two of you, don’t you know what situation Connor is in? It’s fine for him to buy you two a meal, but you’re going to such an expensive place. Two to three thousand dollars is his living expenses for three months!”
Eunice turned to look at Spencer and Dominic and scolded them fiercely.
“Eunice, Connor doesn’t lack money now. To him, this bit of money…”
Dominic seemed to have forgotten that Eunice didn’t know Connor’s identity and opened his mouth to explain.
Spencer quickly reached out to stop Dominic, then smiled and said, “Eunice, you might not know this, but Connor went out to work some time ago and earned tens of thousands of dollars, so he doesn’t lack money at all. Also, he promised the two of us that he would buy us a good meal, so you don’t have to worry…”
“Yes, yes! That’s what happened. Connor is a rich man now. It’s not too much to ask him to buy us a meal!”
Dominic hurriedly said.
“What kind of job can you do to earn so much money?”
Eunice was stunned for a moment and asked Connor with a surprised expression.
“It’s just a part-time job, but because I did well, the boss gave me a reward!”
Connor casually replied.
“Oh, okay!”
Eunice nodded at Connor doubtfully.
“Eunice, don’t you know what our relationship with Connor is like? Let’s go eat. You don’t have to worry about the cost!”
Dominic pulled Eunice and said with a smile.
Seeing that Connor didn’t seem to care about the money for the meal, after hesitating for a moment, Eunice followed Connor and the others out of the school.
Connor, Dominic, Spencer and Eunice were having casual conversations as they walked out of the school.
However, just as they reached the school gate, they suddenly discovered a large group of people surrounding the two girls. From the looks of it, they were teasing the girls like a bunch of hooligans.
The two girls looked very scared. They kept trying to break free from the guys, but the guys kept following them. It seemed that they didn’t want to let the two girls leave.
Connor took a look at the situation over there and saw luxury cars parked beside these guys. There were Lamborghini and Ferraris. These cars were not cheap. This meant that these guys were not hooligans, but rich guys.
It was actually very common for rich guys to come to the Porthampton University to hook up with female college students. After all, there were many beautiful women in the university, and there were often rich guys who would come to hook up with girls. Most of the female college students were inexperienced, so they would find it hard to resist the guys who were well dressed and had expensive-looking cars.
Some girls would choose to get a room with a rich guy, while some girls who were already well-off would naturally not sell their bodies for these things and would turn them down.
Under normal circumstances, if a girl refused, those rich guys would not pester her. After all, no one wanted to make such a big deal out of it.
However, there were not many situations like this where the other party would still chase after the girl.
Connor didn’t pay much attention to the situation over there and was about to leave.
However, when Connor passed by those people, he suddenly stopped subconsciously, and a strange look flashed across his eyes.
It was only then that Connor realized that the girl who was being pestered by those rich guys was actually the high-jump beauty that Connor saw on the sports field, and the girl beside the beauty was her best friend.
Although Connor did have a chance encounter with these two girls, he usually wouldn’t meddle in such matters. After all, he didn’t know what was going on with these people. If they were acquaintances or had some lovers’ quarrel, it would seem like he was a busybody if he were to interfere in their affairs.
Therefore, Connor merely took a glance and continued to walk forward.
“How outrageous. Are they actually harassing girls at the entrance of our school?”
Dominic was a relatively simple guy. Seeing this situation, he frowned and scolded in a low voice.
“Don’t be a busybody. What if it’s just a fight between a couple?”
Spencer said softly.
“That’s true. If they didn’t know each other, they probably wouldn’t go so far…”
When Dominic heard Spencer’s words, he nodded lightly and then walked away, intending to leave.
However, at this moment, the two girls seemed to be a little impatient with the pestering of these rich guys. Lindsy Park’s best friend finally couldn’t hold it in anymore and shouted, “Are you guys done? Lindsy has already made it very clear. If you continue to pester her, I’ll call the police!”
When Dominic heard the girl’s words, he suddenly turned around.

chapters.title: Chapter 919: Jovan Lambert
chapters.content:
Chapter 919: Jovan Lambert
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Connor, Dominic, Spencer, and Eunice were about to leave, but when Dominic heard that the girl was going to call the police, he suddenly felt that something was wrong.
So, he turned to look at Lindsy and her best friend.
“Call the police?”
One of the boys had a look of disdain in his eyes when he heard Lindsy’s best friend’s words. He said indifferently, “Miss, do you know who Mr. Lambert is? Is there any use in calling the police? If you want to call the police, you can call the police now. Let’s see if the police will do anything about this…”
“I don’t believe that you guys are above the law.”
A trace of anger flashed across Lindsy’s best friend’s eyes. She picked up her phone and was about to call the police.
“Tamia, forget it!”
But at this moment, Lindsy suddenly shouted.
When Tamia Wellman heard Lindsy’s words, a hint of confusion flashed across her eyes. She frowned and asked Lindsy, “Why?”
Lindsy seemed to know the identities of these people, so she felt a little awkward. After taking a deep breath, she lifted her head and said to the thin young man standing in the middle, “Jovan Lambert, I told you that I don’t like you. Don’t pester me anymore, okay?”
“Lindsy, it’s not easy for me to come back. Can’t you give me some face?”
Jovan replied with a smile.
“Why should I give you face? How many times have I told you? I don’t like you. I will never be with you. Just leave!”
Lindsy shouted angrily.
When Jovan heard Lindsy’s words, he grinned devilishly. He said lightly, “Alright, Lindsy. It’s fine if you really don’t want to be with me. I can promise not to pester you in the future, but you have to promise me something…”
“Promise you something?”
Lindsy looked at Jovan with a trace of confusion in her eyes, then frowned and asked in a low voice, “What is it?”
“As long as you get a room with me tonight and serve me well, I’ll definitely not pester you in the future!”
Jovan said with a smile.
Lindsy looked at Jovan with an expression of extreme shame and anger. She did not expect Jovan to say such shameless words.
“There’s no woman that Mr. Lambert can’t handle. It’s an honor that he has taken a fancy to you, so miss, you don’t have to pretend to be a pure and innocent girl here.”
A guy next to Jovan said.
“Have you no shame? Lindsy doesn’t like him, so how can you force her?”
Tamia couldn’t stand it anymore. She shouted at the top of her lungs with an angry expression.
“Hehe, miss, it doesn’t matter whether she likes it or not!”
One of the young men sneered.
Jovan had lost his patience. He frowned and asked Lindsy, “Lindsy, what’s your answer? Tell me straight!”
“My answer is no!”
Lindsy shouted without thinking.
“Alright, you girls are stubborn lasses. Brothers, take these two girls with us. I want to have a good chat with them about life…”
Jovan shouted confidently, then turned around and walked toward his Ferrari.
The rest of the guys rushed toward Lindsy and Tamia, grabbing their arms and trying to drag them into the car.
“Help! Someone, help!”
Tamia
When Dominic heard their cries for help, he finally couldn’t hold it in any longer. He rushed toward them and shouted, “What are you guys doing? Let go of the girls!”
Spencer the other two stood at the side, seemingly helpless.
In fact, Connor had long expected Dominic to have such a reaction. After all, Dominic was a very warm-hearted person. Dominic would definitely not sit idly by in such a situation.
When Jovan and the others heard Dominic’s words, they slowly turned to look at Dominic and asked in a disdainful tone, “Who are you, kid?”
“I’m a student at Porthampton University. What are you doing?”
Dominic replied with a glare.
“What does what we do here have to do with you? If you don’t want to die, get lost now…”
One of the guys pointed at Dominic and threatened.
“…”
After hearing the young man’s words, Dominic was a little angry, but he did not say anything because he really did not know what was going on.
So, he turned to Tamia and asked, “Were you the one who shouted for help just now?”
“Yes!”
Lindsy’s best friend, Tamia, hurriedly nodded.
“What’s going on?”
Dominic continued to ask.
“These people have been harassing my friend and trying to take her with them. My friend doesn’t want to, yet they wanted to drag the two of us into the car…”
Tamia hurriedly explained.
“I got it!”
Dominic lightly nodded, then looked at the guy and said, “The girls don’t even know you. What you’re doing now is considered kidnapping. I advise you to leave this place right now, or else I’ll call security!”
“Who the hell are you? I advise you not to meddle in other people’s business, do you hear me?”
The young man looked at Dominic and shouted arrogantly.
“I’m a student at the Porthampton University. These two are also students at the university. I’m not meddling in other people’s business…”
Seeing that there were not a lot of people on the other side, and they were still at the entrance of the Porthampton University, and many students had already surrounded them, Dominic felt that he was doing a righteous deed, so he was very brave when facing these guys.
Spencer, Connor, Eunice, and the others stood at the side. They did not speak, but Connor was ready to fight them at any time.
This was because these rich guys did not look like they were good people. They would definitely not let go just because Dominic told them to.
“Rammy, what’s the hold up?”
The real mastermind, Jovan, was already sitting in the car.
Seeing that the girls were still standing outside, he rolled down the window and shouted impatiently.

chapters.title: Chapter 920  Break His Legs!
chapters.content:
Chapter 920  Break His Legs!
At the entrance of the Porthampton University.
When Dominic heard someone shouting for help, he immediately went forward to help.
When Rammy heard Jovan's order, a hint of viciousness flashed in his eyes. He immediately walked forward and shouted at Dominic, "Brat, I advise you to mind your own business. This woman is someone Mr. Lambert's has taken a fancy to!"
"What's wrong with Mr. Lambert? As long as these two girls don't agree to it, even if the king comes, he wouldn't be able to take them away!"
Dominic shouted.
When Tamia heard Dominic's words, she was moved.
After all, under such circumstances, Dominic chose to stand up for the two of them. This was indeed very rare.
At this moment, more and more students had gathered around to watch, but none of them dared to stand out. Only Dominic did.
"Do you know what kind of person Mr. Lambert is? Are you f*cking crazy? Do you know the consequences of offending him?"
At this moment, another guy walked up and shouted arrogantly.
Previously, Jovan had encountered such a situation when he was seducing other girls. However, as long as Jovan's people mentioned the name Mr. Lambert, the other party would be scared out of their wits and apologize and beg for mercy.
However, they did not expect to meet such a hothead today. He did not give them any face at all.
Connor narrowed his eyes and looked at Jovan. He could feel that the other party was not afraid of Tamia calling the police. Moreover, he was still being so arrogant. This was enough to prove that the other party was very confident in Jovan's identity.
Even a young master like Harold Phillips and Sheldon Statton didn't have the courage to speak like this, so Jovan's identity and background were definitely one level higher than theirs.
Dominic was just an ordinary person. When encountering such a situation, he naturally wouldn't think too much about it. He stood in front of the two girls with no intention to move.
Connor looked at Dominic, and a trace of helplessness flashed across his eyes.
Although Dominic was very brave, he had a fatal flaw, which was that he was too impulsive. Some things could not be solved by force.
Connor was here today, so Dominic shouldn't be in any danger.
However, if it was the same situation and Connor was not here, Dominic would face a miserable outcome.
Although Connor didn't have any intention of blaming Dominic, he felt that he should find an opportunity to remind Dominic not to be so impulsive in the future. At the very least, he should see what was going on with the other party before making a decision.
"Brat, I'll ask you one last time, are you going to move or not?"
The young man named Rammy finally couldn't take it anymore, and he stepped forward and shouted at Dominic coldly.
"I've already made it very clear just now. If the two of them don't agree, none of you can take them away!"
Dominic shouted excitedly.
"Why the f*ck are you guys still talking to him? If he wants to be a hero and save the damsel in distress, then just break his legs!"
At this moment, Jovan, who was sitting in the car, stretched out his hand and lit a cigarette. He then shouted with an extremely ferocious expression.
Connor could feel that when Jovan said this sentence, his tone was very calm, as if he was talking about a very common trivial matter. This proved that it was not the first time Jovan had done such a thing. Otherwise, he would not speak so casually.
Jovan's men did not hesitate after hearing Jovan's words. They turned around and walked toward the trunk of the car. Then, they took out something like a steel pipe baseball bat from the trunk and rushed toward Dominic.
These people seemed professional and experienced. Without any hesitation, they raised the steel bats in their hands and were about to hit Dominic on the head.
Connor, who was standing behind Dominic, did not expect the other party to make a move so quickly.
He thought that these people would continue to pester him, but no one expected these people to take action so quickly.
Bang!
There was a loud bang!
One of the young men waved the steel bat in his hand and smashed Dominic's shoulder.
Dominic cried out in pain and took two steps back, almost falling to the ground.
In the next second, these people rushed toward Dominic again.
This was probably not the first time these people had done something like this. They were very efficient and did not hesitate. Their attacks were also very fierce. They were probably really aiming to break Dominic's legs.
After hesitating for a moment, Connor rushed in front of Dominic.
However, at this moment, one of the men waved the steel bat in his hand and smashed it down fiercely.
The steel pipe smashed down with a whistling sound.
"Be careful!"
When Lindsy saw Connor rush out, a hint of nervousness flashed across her eyes.
Because she knew that the guy who rushed up was the guy she saw on the sports field.
"Connor…"
When Eunice saw this scene, she instinctively shouted.
However, it was already too late. The other party was very fast.
Even if Connor had the chance to dodge, the steel bat in the young man's hand would definitely hit Dominic.
Therefore, Connor did not choose to dodge. Instead, he raised his arm.
Bang!
There was a loud bang!
The steel bat in the young man's hand smashed hard on Connor's arm.
When everyone saw this scene, their mouths were wide open as they looked at this scene in a daze. After all, that was a real steel bat!
Just the thought of a steel bat smashing into a person's arm was terrifying.
However, what everyone did not expect was that Connor was actually standing on the spot without any reaction. Even Connor himself was somewhat shocked.
After all, he was not Superman or Iron Man. On the contrary, he was just an ordinary person.
If this steel bat had hit Connor's arm in the past, even if his arm was not broken, he would definitely have been in pain.
But at this moment, Connor realized that he barely felt a thing.
The young man with the steel bat seemed to be frightened by this scene. His eyes were filled with shock as he looked at Connor in disbelief.
...

chapters.title: Chapter 921: I Said Get Lost!
chapters.content:
Chapter 921: I Said Get Lost!
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Everyone present didn’t expect what happened next. The young man’s steel pipe smashed onto Connor’s arm.
To everyone’s surprise, Connor didn’t react at all, and his expression on his face looked relaxed.
He slowly raised his head and glanced at the young man, a hint of playfulness flashing in his eyes.
At that moment, he suddenly realized what Jorge had said before. If he were to consume the Essence Cultivating Pill even if he didn’t become Jorge’s disciple, his physical fitness would be far beyond ordinary people’s imagination.
At the time, he didn’t take Jorge’s words too seriously because he didn’t know if what Jorge said was true.
But now he felt that Jorge didn’t seem to deceive him. Although his strength and speed had greatly improved when he fought Jabba earlier, he wouldn’t be able to withstand such a heavy blow. However, after being ruthlessly struck by the steel pipe on his arm, he felt nothing at all. This was undoubtedly the effect of the Essence Cultivating Pill.
Connor was also shocked in his heart.
But at this moment, another boy took advantage of Connor’s distraction and rushed towards him.
Connor’s eyes flashed with a hint of surprise, but he didn’t hesitate at all. He raised his leg and kicked the boy hard in the stomach.
The boy, who was still immersed in the shock from earlier, didn’t react at all. After letting out a scream, he flew backward.
“Bang!”
A loud noise!
The boy crashed heavily onto the floor, leaving a deep pit.
After seeing his kick, everyone’s expressions turned shocked.
The boy who was kicked appeared to be big and strong, weighing over two hundred catties for sure.
But with just one kick, Connor sent the boy flying. How much strength did it take?
Under normal circumstances, it would be remarkable for two people of similar weight to kick each other, let alone kicking the opponent away. Yet, he not only kicked him away but also created a deep pit in the floor.
Lindsy covered her mouth, looking at Connor with an equally astonished expression.
“It seems like my strength has also improved!” he couldn’t help but muttered softly.
Now he finally understood the effect of the pill.
The pill was indeed a good thing, as it caused a qualitative leap in his body.
Meanwhile, the other people brought by Jovan were dumbfounded after witnessing the power of Connor’s kick. They stood still in shock, their expressions filled with fear and amazement.
They realized that he was no ordinary person from the kick he just delivered.
So these people all took a step back, aware of the gap in strength between themselves and him. They were momentarily stunned, their expressions filled with extreme shock.
After seeing everyone’s stunned reaction, Connor subconsciously turned his head and glanced at Dominic, whispering, “Dominic, are you alright?”
“I’m fine, I’m fine…” Dominic replied while gritting his teeth, feeling the pain. He shook his head at Connor.
Dominic’s body couldn’t be compared to Connor’s. He had just taken a solid blow and must be in a lot of pain.
“Are you okay?” Lindsy looked at Connor, assessing him with concern.
“I’m fine,” he calmly replied.
On the other side, as Jovan, who was sitting in the car, noticed that something was amiss, he took off his sunglasses, pushed open the car door, and walked out boldly, shouting, “What the hell are you guys doing? How can you not even handle such a small matter?”
“Mr. Jovan, this guy is really skilled. He kicked Rammy and sent him flying with just one kick!”
After one of the boys realized what happened, he quickly ran to Jovan and stammered.
“You bunch of useless idiots! There are so many of you with weapons, yet you can’t handle a student. What else can you do?” Jovan’s eyes showed a hint of disdain. He then walked up to Connor, assessed him from head to toe, and asked in a low voice, “Kid, was it you who hit my guy earlier?”
“Yes, it’s me,” Connor nodded lightly, looking at Jovan.
“Heh, not bad. You’ve got guts, daring to hit my people. Do you know who I am?” Jovan arrogantly yelled at Connor.
“Who are you?” he calmly asked, glancing at Jovan.
“I’m Jovan…” Jovan said expressionlessly.
“I don’t know you!” Connor shook his head without hesitation.
Upon hearing his words, Jovan visibly paused, a trace of embarrassment flashed in his eyes. He then whispered, “It’s normal for a poor student like you not to know me. I suggest you find out, then come talk to me!”
“No need,” Connor said calmly.
“Heh heh, kid, I advise you not to be too arrogant. Apologize to my friend now, then get lost. I won’t lower myself to your level. But if you continue to be ignorant and ruin my mood for women, don’t blame me for not being polite. Got it?” Jovan shouted in a very arrogant tone.
Connor glanced up and down at Jovan, then said expressionlessly, “If you get lost now, I might let it slide.”
After hearing Connor’s words, Jovan’s face showed a surprised expression. He then asked Connor with a puzzled tone, “Wait, kid, what did you just say to me?”
“I said, get lost!” Connor repeated flatly.
“You’ve got some nerve, you dare to make me…”
Smack!
Before he could finish his sentence, Connor slapped him across the face.
Jovan’s body instantly flew backward and crashed hard onto the ground.
Upon witnessing this scene, Lindsy’s expression became extremely anxious.
After all, she was the only one present who knew Jovan’s true identity. She hadn’t expected Connor to have such a bad temper. Before Jovan could finish his sentence, Connor had already slapped him.
She became very worried about Connor, considering Jovan’s terrifying background.
Jovan’s friends, upon seeing this scene, all had tense expressions and quickly walked over to Jovan’s side.

chapters.title: Chapter 922: Why Did You Hit Jovan?
chapters.content:
Chapter 922: Why Did You Hit Jovan?
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
“Mr. Jovan!”
“Mr. Jovan, are you okay?”
Everyone ran up to Jovan and extended their hands to help him up.
Jovan was hit by Connor’s slap, feeling dizzy and his right cheek was swelling.
“You bastard, how dare you hit me? Let me tell you, you’re dead. I’m going to kill you!”
Jovan pointed at Connor and cursed fiercely.
Connor ignored him and instead walked towards him.
“What are you doing? What do you want?”
Jovan became visibly nervous when he saw Connor approaching, stuttering as he shouted at him.
“I told you to get lost, didn’t you hear me?”
Connor coldly said to Jovan.
“What’s your name? Tell me your name and I’ll leave now!”
Jovan wasn’t stupid. He knew that he and his group were no match for Connor alone.
If he continued to stay here, he would only get beaten up. So he planned to ask for Connor’s name, leave for now, and seek revenge on Connor when he had a chance in the future.
“Don’t…”
Lindsy worried that Connor would actually tell Jovan her name, which would make things even more complicated. So she instinctively shouted.
“I’m Connor!”
But before Lindsy could finish speaking, Connor calmly said his own name.
“Oh no!”
Lindsy’s eyes flashed with a hint of despair when she saw Connor telling Jovan his name.
“Connor?”
Jovan’s eyes showed a hint of familiarity upon hearing this name, but he couldn’t recall it immediately.
So he directly said to Connor, “Alright, I remember your name. You wait for me, this isn’t over between us, you wait!”
Connor glanced at Jovan indifferently without saying a word.
“I’ll make sure you die a horrible death!”
Jovan didn’t dare to stay longer, so he cursed angrily and ran towards the car with his people.
After everyone got into the car, they quickly disappeared from the entrance of Porthampton University.
“Mr. Jovan, what do you plan to do next?”
The man responsible for driving Jovan hesitated for a moment before quietly asking him.
“Shut up, you bunch of useless people! You can’t even handle such a small matter. What use do I have for all of you?”
Jovan stared with anger in his eyes and shouted.
“Mr. Jovan, as you just saw, that kid is not an ordinary person. He kicked Rammy away with just one kick. If he were an ordinary person, how could he have such great strength?”
The man explained quickly.
“He dared to hit me, and even made me leave in front of so many people. This matter is not over, I’m telling you, I, Jovan, have never suffered such a loss! ”
Jovan gritted his teeth and said in a low voice, “That kid just now, his name is Connor. Have any of you heard of him?”
“No…”
“Neither have I!”
Everyone shook their heads.
Jovan’s expression seemed even more puzzled when he saw everyone shaking their heads.
He furrowed his brows and murmured in a low voice, “Since none of you have heard of the name Connor, why do I feel like it sounds familiar?”
“I think I’ve heard it!”
Just at that moment, a boy sitting in the backseat of the car suddenly spoke up.
Jovan was taken aback and quickly turned his head to look at the man sitting behind him. He then whispered, “Where have you heard this name before? Who is Connor?”
“Mr. Jovan, last time in Sutton, Harold and the others mentioned this Connor to you. It seems like they had some conflicts with him,” the man hesitated and said.
“Yeah, that person Harold talked about was also named Connor!” Jovan exclaimed, then quickly took out his phone and dialed Harold’s number.
“Ring ring…”
After two rings, Harold answered the call, then smiled and said, “Jovan, what’s up?”
“I’m asking you, is that kid you asked me to deal with named Connor?” Jovan whispered.
“That’s right, his name is Connor, what’s the matter?” Harold replied.
“Is this Connor a student at Porthampton University?” Jovan continued to ask.
“Yes. Have you come to our school?” Harold’s tone seemed even more surprised.
“Alright, I got it!” Jovan felt extremely embarrassed about being slapped by Connor, so he didn’t want to continue the conversation with Harold and simply hung up the phone.
“Mr. Jovan, is it that person?” the young man behind Harold quickly asked.
“That’s right, it’s that kid!” Jovan gritted his teeth and nodded, then continued, “I never expected the world to be so small. Just now, Harold mentioned this kid to me, and I actually ran into him. Well, I’ll find an opportunity to settle the score with this Connor…”
“Mr. Jovan, how do you plan to deal with him?” the man in the backseat asked.
“This Connor seems to have some skills and seems to have some connection with the Phillips family, but I’m not sure about the specifics. Otherwise, Harold and the others wouldn’t have asked me to deal with him. But it doesn’t matter, after I investigate this kid’s true identity, I’ll deal with him,” Jovan said slowly.
…
On the other side, after Jovan’s people left, the expression on Lindsy’s friend Tamia’s face visibly relaxed.
She quickly walked up to Connor, Dominic, and the others, and with an excited tone, she said, “Thank you so much for what happened just now. If it weren’t for you, those people wouldn’t have let us off so easily!”
“We’re all classmates. We certainly wouldn’t just stand by and do nothing in the face of such a situation!” Dominic grinned.
“what’s your name?” Tamia hesitated for a moment and then softly asked Dominic.
“My name is Dominic, he is Connor, and this is Spencer!” Dominic quickly answered.
“Hello, I’m Tamia Wellman. Thanks to you guys just now. I didn’t expect you to be so capable…” Tamia said, looking at Connor with some intention, as she knew that Connor was the boy who was caught peeping at Lindsy on the playground.
“Lindsy, what are you still standing there for? Hurry up and come over to thank Connor and the others!” Tamia turned her head and shouted at Lindsy.
After hesitating for a moment, Lindsy walked directly to Connor and asked him in a low voice, “Why did you hit Jovan just now?”
Upon hearing her words, everyone froze.

chapters.title: Chapter 923: Getting Into Trouble
chapters.content:
Chapter 923: Getting Into Trouble
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
No one expected that Connor had just saved Lindsy and Tamia.
However, the first thing Lindsy said to him was not a word of gratitude. Instead, she questioned him, asking why he had resorted to violence against Jovan.
The atmosphere at the school gate became awkward in an instant.
“Lindsy, what are you saying? Connor and Dominic were only trying to help. If Connor hadn’t intervened, do you think those people would have let us go so easily?” Tamia’s expression showed confusion as she tried to explain.
Connor understood that Lindsy’s question was likely because she didn’t want him to get involved in physical altercations.
Maybe Lindsy and Jovan knew each other, and they were having some relationship issues. Their interference might have ruined something between them.
Connor looked at Lindsy with a helpless smile and said, “I didn’t know you were acquainted with Jovan. It seems like we’ve been meddling in other people’s business. Let’s go, Dominic.”
After saying this, he turned around and started walking ahead.
Dominic also realized what was going on and a hint of helplessness flashed in his eyes. He whispered, “When we heard your cry for help, we thought you really needed assistance. We didn’t expect our good intentions to cause trouble…”
Tamia stood in place, her expression showing confusion. After a moment of contemplation, she seemed to realize that something was amiss and hurriedly spoke to Lindsy, “Lindsy, if you really wanted to leave with Jovan, why didn’t you tell me? I wouldn’t have been so worried about you. What’s happening now? Connor and the others saved us with good intentions, yet we seem ungrateful. I really don’t know what to say to you…”
“What are you all talking about here?” Lindsy furrowed her brows and shouted, then she chased after Connor with her long, fair legs, shouting loudly, “Stop right there!”
“Do you need something else?” Connor turned his head, glanced at Lindsy, and asked softly.
“First of all, I’m not acquainted with those people, and I didn’t have any intention of leaving with them!” Lindsy shouted back at Connor.
“You don’t need to explain so much to me. Your matters have nothing to do with me,” Connor replied calmly.
“Secondly, I asked you why you hit Jovan not because I’m angry that you hit him, but because I’m worried that you will get into trouble!” She completely ignored his words and continued shouting at him.
“Get into trouble?” Connor paused for a moment, a hint of confusion appearing in his eyes.
“It seems you really don’t know who Jovan is…” Lindsy took a deep breath and said in a low voice, “Let me tell you, Jovan is not an ordinary rich second-generation. His father is Cade Lambert is the Deputy director of the Bureau of Industry and Commerce in San Franciso. He definitely won’t let it go easily. What will you do if he seeks revenge? If the situation escalates, you could be expelled from school. What will you do then?”
“Cade?” Connor couldn’t help but smile faintly after hearing Lindsy’s words. He shook his head, unsure of what to say.
Connor hadn’t expected that Jovan would turn out to be Cade’s son, making him the elder brother of Yucca and Yarrow.
