However, he could sense that this Jovan held a much higher position in the Luo family than them. Otherwise, Jovan wouldn’t be so arrogant.
Jovan was indeed born to Cade’s wife.
Connor’s guess was correct. Cade did have many illegitimate children, but only Jovan was the heir of the Lambert family. The other illegitimate children didn’t hold the same status as Jovan.
Upon hearing Lindsy’s words, Dominic and the others were dumbfounded, frozen in their tracks with expressions of disbelief on their faces.
They had never imagined that Jovan had such a prominent background, being the son of Cade.
After a moment, they finally understood why she had questioned Connor in such a manner.
She was clearly worried about him. She was concerned that the slap he gave Jovan could lead to fatal consequences.
Although Dominic and the others knew that Connor came from a wealthy family and had plenty of money, they also knew that no matter how wealthy he was, he couldn’t possibly go against someone like Cade.
The expressions on everyone’s faces turned grim.
“You saved me just now, and I’m grateful for that. But I’m also worried about you because of the slap you gave Jovan. Jovan won’t let it go easily, and he’s not someone we ordinary people can mess with!” Lindsy said with an anxious tone directed at Connor.
Upon hearing her words, he couldn’t help but smile and replied calmly, “If I dared to hit him, then I’m not afraid of his retaliation. You don’t need to worry about my matters; I can handle them myself!”
“But this whole thing started because of me. How can I not worry about you?” she asked him, furrowing her brows.
“And how does your worrying about me help now? Can you solve this problem for me?” He directly countered her question.
Lindsy froze upon hearing Connor’s response, her expression becoming awkward. She didn’t know how to answer his question.
Connor was right. Although Lindsy was genuinely worried about him, what good would her worrying do?
Lindsy came from a well-off family, and in the eyes of ordinary people, she could be considered a wealthy and beautiful woman, someone unattainable for most. But if placed in front of the Lambert family, her background was simply insignificant.
“If you can’t help me, then I’ll handle it myself,” Connor said calmly, looking at Lindsy.
“What can you do to solve it? You’re just an ordinary student. I really don’t want to involve you because of my problems!” Lindsy suddenly felt a sense of helplessness and self-blame as she spoke to Connor.
“I’ve already said it. If I dared to hit this person, then I’m not afraid of him retaliating against me!” Connor’s tone softened as he saw Lindsy feeling self-blame.
After hearing his words, she couldn’t help but raise her head and look at him, her expression helpless, not knowing what to do next.

chapters.title: Chapter 924: Send You Home
chapters.content:
Chapter 924: Send You Home
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
“Beauty, since Connor said he can solve this matter, I think he can definitely handle it. You don’t have to worry about him!”
Just then, Dominic suddenly came out with a smile and said to Lindsy.
She slowly looked up at Connor, feeling that he was only trying to show off in front of her.
If a normal person knew about Jovan’s identity, they would have been scared out of their wits.
She didn’t have the heart to expose him any further, so she didn’t say much.
But she had already started planning in her mind how she could help Connor get rid of Jovan’s clutches.
“Do you have any other business? If not, we’ll leave first!”
When Connor saw Lindsy’s silence, he softly asked her.
“Well, um, Connor, Dominic, you two just saved us. It’s also dinner time now, so how about the two of us treating you to a meal as a way of saying thank you?”
When Tamia saw Connor and the others about to leave, she quickly spoke up.
“No need…”
Connor instinctively intended to refuse.
“All right, we’re all going to have dinner anyway, but you don’t have to treat us. Connor will treat us since he’s wealthier. Let’s go together!”
Before Connor could say anything, Dominic excitedly agreed.
Connor glanced at Dominic and noticed that he seemed interested in Tamia.
Although her looks couldn’t compare to Lindsy who was beside him, she could still be considered a beauty.
Moreover, her personality matched well with Dominic, and Connor thought this girl was pretty good.
If he could really be with Tamia, he would have moved on from the shadow of Cindy
After understanding Dominic’s true intention, Connor naturally didn’t say much.
“This meal will definitely be our treat, right, Lindsy?”
Tamia asked Lindsy happily.
But Lindsy was still contemplating about Connor beating Jovan, so she hesitated for a moment and quickly nodded, saying, “That’s right, this whole thing started because of me, so I’ll treat you all!”
“Okay, let’s not discuss who pays while we haven’t finished eating yet. Let’s go and eat. I’m starving!”
Dominic shouted in a carefree manner, and then he walked ahead.
Connor and the others hurriedly followed.
Perhaps due to the larger group, Connor and his friends didn’t choose to eat Western food but went to a buffet.
During the meal, everyone reintroduced themselves.
Maybe because they were of similar age, Dominic, Tamia, and the others had a lot in common and the atmosphere during the meal was pleasant.
But Connor could tell that Lindsy was absent-minded the whole time, eating and playing with her phone, probably still worried about him fighting Jovan.
After finishing the buffet, everyone left the restaurant.
Dominic took the initiative to escort Tamia home, and Tamia gladly agreed.
Tamia was touched by Dominic’s action of helping her just now, so she had a high opinion of him.
As for Spencer and Eunice, they lived in the school dormitory, so they returned first.
In the end, only Connor and Lindsy were left.
After hesitating for a moment, Connor softly said to Lindsy, “Should I accompany you home? It’s not safe for a girl to go back alone, and we don’t know if Jovan and his gang will come looking for you!”
Upon hearing his words, her expression seemed somewhat helpless. She had been worried about his safety all along, and now he was concerned about her.
“Okay.”
Although she thought this way in her heart, she still nodded.
Connor hailed a taxi directly and got in with Lindsy.
Once inside the car, she told the taxi driver her home address, and the taxi headed towards her place.
They weren’t very familiar with each other, so neither of them initiated a conversation.
During the ride, she kept looking at the scenery outside the window, her thoughts unknown.
After about half an hour, the car stopped in front of a villa.
The villa wasn’t very large, but its location was good, indicating it was probably expensive.
He could sense that her family conditions were quite good.
“Connor, I’ve arrived home. Thank you so much for today!”
After getting off the car, she softly said to him.
“Don’t mention it. It’s nothing.”
He smiled and replied to Lindsy, then turned around intending to leave.
“Connor, can you wait for a moment?”
But at that moment, she suddenly called out to Connor.
Upon hearing her words, he couldn’t help but pause, then turned to look at her and asked, “Do you have something else?”
“Well, um, that guy Jovan is really difficult to deal with. You should be more careful. I… I will explain the situation to my parents and see if they can help you!”
After hearing her words, he couldn’t help but smile helplessly. He didn’t expect that she would still be concerned about this matter.
Actually, Connor thought that Lindsy was a very kind-hearted girl. If it were someone else, they would have already forgotten about this incident.
“Don’t worry, that Jovan won’t dare to touch me!”
Connor calmly reassured Lindsy.
Seeing that he was still so confident, her expression became even more helpless.
She couldn’t help but speak softly, “Connor, you’re underestimating the situation. I heard from my friend that Jovan has been acting recklessly all this time with the backing of his father’s connections. Last time, someone offended him and he directly broke the person’s leg. But no one could do anything about it, and in the end, Jovan only had to pay a small amount of money to settle the matter…”
“Heh, so what?”
Connor smiled faintly and calmly asked.
“I know you’re skilled, but Jovan is not someone we can provoke!”
Seeing that Connor was still nonchalant, Lindsy’s expression seemed even more anxious.

chapters.title: Chapter 925: Opening Ceremony of the School Sports Day
chapters.content:
Chapter 925: Opening Ceremony of the School Sports Day
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Connor saw the anxious look on Lindsy’s face, he smiled helplessly and asked her softly, “By the way, how did you meet Jovan?”
“I don’t know him. I just met him once when I attended a friend’s birthday party. He saw me and took the initiative to come and chat with me. After I found out about his identity, I politely interacted with him. But then he started harassing me like crazy. At first, I didn’t pay much attention to it, but he kept calling and texting me. I didn’t want to offend him, so I reluctantly dealt with him at first, but he became even more insane…”
Lindsy said with a helpless tone to Connor.
“Do you like him?”
After hesitating for a moment, he asked her softly.
“What kind of joke are you making? How could I possibly like someone like Jovan? I’ve heard things about him from my friends. He’s simply a jerk who often plays with others’ feelings…”
Lindsy cursed and continued, “Yesterday, Jovan called me and wanted to go out for a drink. I felt that if I continued to delay, he would become more and more unreasonable. So I clarified things with him and told him not to harass me anymore. Maybe my words offended him because he actually came to the school today to find me. If I hadn’t bumped into you guys, I wouldn’t know what to do!”
“Don’t worry about my situation. In your eyes, this Jovan might be difficult to deal with, but in my eyes, he’s nothing. If he harasses you again, just give me a call directly, and I’ll take care of him!”
Connor said calmly to Lindsy.
Upon hearing his words, her eyes flashed with a hint of helplessness.
At this moment, she couldn’t understand where he got the courage to say such things.
Jovan’s father, Cade, was a big shot in the Davenport. They couldn’t even imagine dealing with someone of his level.
Even if Jovan broke someone’s leg in the past, he could still walk away freely. What’s the difference between Connor opposing such a person and seeking death?
“It’s getting late, you should go back and rest!”
Just then, Connor said to her.
“We’ve already reached my doorstep. Why don’t you come in and sit for a while?”
She hesitated for a moment and invited him.
“Forget it, it’s late, and your parents must have come back. If I go in, your uncle and aunt will definitely misunderstand…”
After thinking for a moment, he shook his head and refused.
“Well then…”
Lindsy thought Connor made sense, so she didn’t continue to invite him up. Instead, she took out her phone and said softly to him, “Connor, give me your phone number…”
“Okay…”
He nodded and told her the number.
Lindsy called Connor immediately and instructed him, “Connor, this is my phone number. If someone bothers you, make sure to call me first, understood?”
“I understand…”
He looked at her and reluctantly agreed before turning and walking towards the roadside.
She watched his figure and her eyes were filled with worry.
Shaking her head, she also turned and left.
..
After Connor sent Lindsy home, he took a taxi back to Royal Villa.
In the eyes of Lindsy and the others, Jovan was possibly a terrifying presence.
But in Connor’s eyes, he was nothing at all. After all, even Jovan’s father, Cade, was not someone Connor cared about.
So he didn’t think much about it and simply lay on the bed and fell into a deep sleep.
The next morning at eight o’clock, he arrived at school again.
Since tomorrow was the opening ceremony of the school sports meet, all the classes in the school had suspended regular classes. The students participating in the competition were all training on the playground, while those who didn’t participate in any events began to prepare the field.
The school had prepared a designated area for each class, which served as their base camp.
He participated in four events alone, so he didn’t need to help set up the field. Instead, he trained with the other students who were also participating in the sports meet.
However, he wasn’t very interested in this kind of training. After all, his physical fitness was extremely powerful now. Even without training, it would be very easy for him to get in the top three.
Dominic and Spencer were different. Maybe it was because of what those people in the class said during the class meeting that stimulated them.
Originally, they participated in the school sports meet with the mentality of just having some fun. But now, both of them felt that it would be embarrassing if they really ended up in last place, so they started training desperately.
“Dominic, why isn’t Connor coming to training? He’s participating in so many events alone. Will he be okay tomorrow?”
Eunice seemed a bit worried about Connor’s situation and actively approached Dominic, whispering to him.
“I don’t know why he’s not coming…”
Dominic, who had just finished running a kilometer, replied breathlessly.
“To be honest, I don’t really care about his results. I’m just worried that if Connor really ends up in last place tomorrow, the students in our class will definitely make fun of him…”
Eunice said softly.
Dominic turned his head and glanced at Connor’s location. His expression seemed a bit worried, and for a moment, he didn’t know what to say.
“And there’s the matter of sponsors. Connor hasn’t gone to find any sponsors these past two days. Will he really be able to find suitable sponsors to come tomorrow?”
Eunice continued to ask, looking at Dominic.
Upon hearing Eunice’s words, Dominic couldn’t help but smile lightly and whispered, “I don’t know if Connor will end up in last place tomorrow, but when it comes to sponsors, it’s a piece of cake for him. You don’t need to worry about it!”
“How do you know?”
Eunice looked at Dominic, her expression showing some confusion.
“Well…”
Dominic realized that he might have said something wrong, so he quickly said, When Connor was working, he met many wealthy bosses. So, inviting them to participate in the sports meet is definitely not a problem…”
“Oh, I see!”
Eunice nodded gently with her innocent expression and didn’t say anything more.

chapters.title: Chapter 926: You Tired of Living?
chapters.content:
Chapter 926: You Tired of Living?
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Just as all the students were actively preparing for the school sports meet, Connor wandered aimlessly on the sports field.
In fact, Connor was very familiar with the environment of Porthampton University. The reason was very simple: Connor used to deliver takeout before, and many students in the school would choose to order takeout. Therefore, Connor would basically run around the school every day.
In the eyes of the other students, delivering food was a very laughable act. They felt that as a university student, no matter how poor they were, they would not go so far as to deliver food!
However, these students did not know that Connor could earn 2,000 dollars every month just by delivering food. This money was enough for an ordinary student’s living expenses.
Although the other students looked down on this job, Connor felt that he had earned this money through his own efforts, so there was nothing shameful about it. On the contrary, those students who could only rely on their parents to earn money and squandered it everywhere were the truly shameful and laughable ones.
In the entirety of Porthampton University, there were not many students who had the right to look down on Connor.
Connor could earn 2,000 dollars by delivering food during the day and another 1,000 dollars by working part-time in the bar after class at night. His monthly living expenses totaled to 3,000 dollars. However, because Connor spent most of this money on Mandy Hines, it also caused Connor to look very miserable.
If Connor did not spend money on Mandy, then he actually wouldn’t have been so poor.
After Connor strolled around the field, he suddenly realized that a few students in front of him had thrown their lunch boxes on the ground after eating breakfast.
Although Connor didn’t deliver food anymore, when he saw this behavior, he instinctively bent down to pick up the lunch box on the ground.
However, just as he picked up the lunch box, a voice came from behind him. “Connor, are you still delivering food? I thought you weren’t a deliveryman anymore…”
Connor slowly stood up after hearing this voice and then instinctively looked back.
At this moment, a group of young men and women were standing behind Connor. The one who spoke was a tall boy wearing glasses. The rest of the people also looked at Connor with disdain.
Connor looked at the boy from head to toe. He knew this boy. This boy was called Boris Caulfield. He was in the same department as Connor and was the student representative of the class next door.
Boris’s family background was not bad. He was also very handsome. On top of that, he was the vice-president of the school’s student council and was very famous in the school.
Boris would probably become the president of the student council when he reached his fourth year.
At that time, Boris had a very good relationship with Brandon Guthrie, so he naturally knew Connor. When Brandon bullied Connor, Boris had also joined him in humiliating him a lot.
However, after Brandon dropped out of school, and since Connor didn’t come to school much, Connor saw Boris a lot less.
Connor glanced at Boris indifferently, turned around, picked up the lunch box, and walked towards the trash can.
When Boris saw that Connor was about to leave, he hurriedly reached out his hand to stop Connor. Then, he asked in disdain, “Connor, I was talking to you just now. Did you not hear me?”
“Is there something you need?”
Connor casually threw the lunch box into the trash can.
“Ooh, you’re quite arrogant now, aren’t you? Do you think that with Brandon gone, no one can deal with you now?”
Boris had never expected that the usually weak Connor would be so defiant. Connor had actually used such a bored tone to talk to him, so the expression on Boris’s face was obviously a little angry.
The current Connor was no longer the Connor from before. If Connor had met Boris back then, he would definitely have thought of a way to avoid getting into any conflict with such a person.
However, things were different now. As Connor experienced more and more things, his personality had also undergone a huge change. Simply put, Connor had formed a kind of arrogance and hostility that had settled in his bones.
“I asked if you were looking for me? If there’s nothing else, get out of my way. I’m not in the mood to talk nonsense with people like you, do you hear me?” Connor warned Boris.
At this moment, Connor didn’t want to waste time on someone like Boris. However, if Boris continued to be so ignorant, Connor didn’t mind giving him some trouble.
After all, Connor didn’t even think highly of someone like Jovan Lambert. What could a mere Boris count for?
Before Boris could speak, a boy behind him shouted at Connor with his eyes wide open, “Whoa, Connor, you’re so awesome now. You actually dare to use such a tone to talk to Big Brother Bo. Are you tired of living?”
“Are you tired of living?”
When Connor heard the boy’s words, he could not help but sneer. Then, he said indifferently, “Who is tired of living? You might not have figured it out…”
“Stupid delivery guy. I’ll teach you a lesson today. Do you really think that Porthampton University is owned by your family?”
The expression on the boy’s face was obviously a little angry. He strode towards Connor. After all, in the eyes of Boris and the others, Connor was just a poor loser. They did not think of him as human at all, which was why they dared to attack Connor.
Meanwhile, Connor stood there expressionlessly. He had no intention of hiding at all.
After all, if Boris and the others really dared to make a move, Connor could use this opportunity to teach them a lesson and settle an old score with Boris.
Connor was not a vengeful person. On the contrary, after inheriting the inheritance, Connor did not think of taking revenge on anyone at all. Even though many people had bullied him before, Connor didn’t want to take revenge on them; he had better things to do than waste time on these people.
“Connor?”
However, just as Boris and the others were about to attack, a gentle voice came from behind Connor.
After hearing this voice, Connor could not help but be stunned for a moment. Then, he slowly turned around and took a look.
A tall, slender, and exquisite-looking beauty walked over. The beautiful woman was wearing a white dress. She had a slender waist, nice curves and long, fair legs. She had light makeup on her face, and she looked very alluring.
This cold beauty was none other than Lindsy Park!
Boris also subconsciously looked at Lindsy, his expression somewhat shocked.
After a moment of shock, he quickly ran to Lindsy’s side and said with a smile, “Lindsy, why are you here?”

chapters.title: Chapter 927: No One Dares to Do Anything to Me!
chapters.content:
Chapter 927: No One Dares to Do Anything to Me!
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Lindsy was also stunned when she saw Boris.
However, she quickly adjusted herself and asked Boris with a frown, “Boris, what are you doing here?”
“I didn’t do anything. I just met a friend and was talking to him a bit!” Boris hurriedly explained.
Connor looked at Boris indifferently, a trace of confusion flashing in his eyes.
He didn’t know why Boris knew Lindsy, or why Boris was so respectful to her.
“Oh, okay…”
Lindsy looked at Boris and nodded gently. Then, she walked to Connor’s side with her slender and fair legs and asked Connor softly, “Connor, then what are you doing here?”
“There were a few people who wanted to pick a fight with me just now…”
Connor replied indifferently.
When Lindsy heard Connor’s words, she instantly realized what was going on.
She turned to look at Boris and asked him coldly, “Boris, were you the one looking for trouble with Connor just now?”
“Lindsy, look at what you’re saying. Connor and I are friends. I was just looking for him to catch up with the old days. How is it called finding trouble with him…”
Boris quickly explained with a chuckle, then turned to Connor and asked, “Connor, is that true?”
“Didn’t you say that you wanted to teach me a lesson? Is this how you ‘talk with someone a bit’?” Connor replied indifferently.
“You…”
Boris looked at Connor, his expression abnormally broken. He gritted his teeth and did not know what to say.
After Lindsy heard Connor’s words, she turned her head and shouted at Boris. “Alright, Boris, that’s enough. I’m warning you not to find trouble with Connor again, do you hear me?”
“I understand…”
Boris replied in a low voice.
“Connor, let’s go!”
Lindsy didn’t want to waste time with someone like Boris, so she said this to Connor directly.
Connor glanced at Boris indifferently and did not say anything more. He followed Lindsy and walked forward.
Boris and the others looked at Connor’s back, and their expressions seemed to be very puzzled.
“Brother Bo, when did Connor get to know Lindsy?”
One of the boys asked in a low voice.
“I don’t know either. No wonder this kid dared to be so arrogant just now. It turns out that it’s because Lindsy is supporting him from behind. Just you wait. I’ll find an opportunity to teach this Connor a lesson. Otherwise, he won’t even know his place!”
Boris gritted his teeth and replied in a low voice.
…
On the other side, after Connor and Lindsy left, they walked straight to the high jump venue.
“Connor, what conflict do you have with Boris?”
Lindsy asked Connor softly.
“There’s no conflict. They just think that I’m easy to bully, so they want to pick on me!”
Connor replied indifferently.
“You? Easy to bully?”
Lindsy looked at Connor with a speechless expression. Saying that someone who dared to hit Jovan Lambert was easy to bully… Wasn’t this an international joke?
“I’m not a good person to bully now, but anyone could bully me before!” Connor replied softly.
Lindsy blinked her charming big eyes and asked Connor with a puzzled expression, “What do you mean?”
“There’s a student who does food deliveries in our school. No matter who sees this student, they will mock him. Anyone will bully him,” Connor explained.
“I’ve heard of this student you’re talking about. There seems to be a boy who sends food to our school…”
Lindsy nodded gently and continued, “But I don’t think anyone should laugh at this boy. After all, he’s self-reliant. Although it’s not good for a college student to deliver food, no matter what, he didn’t break the law. He’s working hard to study.”
When Connor heard Lindsy’s words, he could not help but be stunned for a moment. Then, he turned to look at Lindsy and said softly, “The boy I mentioned just now is me!”
“You?”
When Lindsy heard Connor’s words, she was instantly stunned. The expression on her face was one of disbelief. She said in a low voice, “That’s impossible. You don’t look like a delivery man!”
“I really don’t need to deliver food now, but I did need to rely on it to make a living in the past. You all have parents to take care of you, but I don’t, so I can only rely on my own efforts to survive. I usually have classes in school during the day, and as long as I have time, I will deliver food…”
Connor said slowly.
“I see…”
After Lindsy found out about Connor’s background, she suddenly felt a little pitiful for Connor.
“In the past, as long as those people saw me, they would come and bully me because they knew that I wouldn’t dare to fight back or talk back. But in fact, I tolerated it not because I was weak, but because I was worried that I would get into trouble. If things got out of hand, I might be punished by the school, I wouldn’t be able to get a scholarship, and I might even be expelled, so I could only endure it!”
Connor looked at Lindsy and continued.
Perhaps it was because Connor saw someone like Boris again that he recalled what had happened before.
“I didn’t expect that you had such a past. If you didn’t tell me about it, I really couldn’t imagine that you were such a person,” Lindsy said to Connor with a puzzled expression.
At this moment, Lindsy couldn’t understand. Since Connor dared to hit Jovan, why didn’t he dare to offend the most ordinary student in the school?
Moreover, Connor was calm after knowing Jovan’s identity, as if he didn’t think of Jovan as a threat at all.
“I’m no longer the same person as before. If you hadn’t appeared just now, Boris and the others might have been sent to the hospital long ago!”
Connor said calmly to Lindsy.
Lindsy looked at Connor’s expression and seemed to be even more puzzled. She frowned and asked in a low voice, “Aren’t you afraid of being expelled from school after hitting someone?”
“I don’t have to worry about these things now!” Connor smiled faintly.
“Why?”
“Because no one in the entire Porthampton University will dare do anything to me. No matter what I do, no one will dare stop me!”
Connor said with a smile.
..

chapters.title: Chapter 928: Fergus Long
chapters.content:
Chapter 928: Fergus Long
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Lindsy looked at Connor in front of her, her face full of shock and confusion. She could sense that Connor seemed to have many secrets.
However, she could not see through Connor. She did not know what he was thinking.
Connor seemed to be unwilling to continue talking about his own matters with Lindsy, however, so he asked, “How did you meet Boris? You’re not a junior-year student, are you?”
“I know Boris because we’re both members of the student council. Boris is now the vice president of the student council, and I’m the head of the publicity department of the council…” Lindsy explained.
“He’s the vice president of the student council, and you’re the head of the publicity department. Why is he so afraid of you?”
Connor was stunned for a moment and said in a puzzled tone.
“Boris isn’t actually afraid of me. He’s afraid of the president of the student council. After all, Boris wants to compete for the next president of the student council, and the opinion of the current president of the student council is very important. Our president of the student council has been chasing me, but I didn’t agree. Boris is probably worried that I’ll snitch on him, so he’s so afraid of me…”
Lindsy said to Connor softly.
“So that’s what happened!”
Connor nodded lightly. He did not say anything else.
“By the way, Zhang, didn’t you go to the student union?”
Lindsy hesitated for a moment before asking Connor.
“I didn’t have time before, but when I’m free, I’ll go deliver food!”
Connor said lightly.
“I see!”
Lindsy nodded gently, then turned to look at the training ground and said softly, “I’m going to graduate soon, and this might be the last time I’ll participate in our school’s sports meet. This time, I must break our school’s high jump record.”
“I feel that you have the strength to do so…”
Connor said with a smile.
“Of course. I’ve won the high jump championship three times in a row in my four years of university. It’s just that I haven’t broken the record yet. Alright, I’m not talking to you anymore. I have to go train!” Lindsy said to Connor with a smile.
“See you…”
Connor nodded lightly.
Lindsy hesitated for a moment before walking straight to the training ground and warming up.
Connor sat alone on the bench and watched Lindsy do her warmups.
Connor felt that he should cherish this opportunity to participate in the school sports meet. After all, he might return to school less and less in the future.
Lindsy began her training after she finished her warmups.
In the whole field, Lindsy was always the most eye-catching one because her high jump was very beautiful and pleasing to the eye.
Other than Connor, there were also many people watching Lindsy on the field.
About half an hour later, a black Mercedes-Benz suddenly drove over and stopped in front of the high jump field.
Connor was stunned when he saw the Mercedes-Benz. After all, Porthampton University did not allow students to drive their cars into the field.
But this person had driven straight in, which meant that this person was definitely not an ordinary student. Moreover, this Mercedes-Benz should be around one million dollars. If an ordinary university student could drive such a Mercedes-Benz, he could definitely be considered a rich heir.
Many students on the field seemed to know the owner of the Mercedes-Benz. They all walked towards the car.
Lindsy seemed to be planning to rest for a while, so she walked to Connor’s side with a drink.
“Connor, what are you doing sitting here?” Lindsy sat beside Connor very naturally, wiped the sweat off her face, and asked Connor softly.
“I don’t have anything to do, so I’m just here to watch you guys train…”
Connor lightly replied.
Lindsy turned her head and said to him shyly, “Why are you watching me jump? I’m a little embarrassed that you’re looking at me like that. I didn’t perform well today…”
“I think you were quite good, though…”
“What’s so good about it? I’ve hit the pole three times today!”
Lindsy replied with a pout.
At the same time, the door of the Mercedes-Benz was opened from the inside.
A handsome and charismatic boy in Armani casual clothes walked out of the car. After the boy got out of the car, many people took the initiative to greet him.
“This person is the president of our school’s student council, Fergus Long…” Lindsy whispered to Connor when she saw the boy.
“This boy is quite handsome and looks quite rich. He pursued you, so why didn’t you go out with him
Connor asked Lindsy in confusion.
“I just don’t have any feelings for him. This Fergus is indeed quite outstanding in all aspects, but I just don’t have any feelings for him.”
Lindsy said softly.
“Haha…”
Connor looked at Lindsy with a faint smile and did not say anything.
Just as Connor was speaking to Lindsy, Fergus had already walked over and called out softly to Lindsy. “Oh, Lindsy, you’re here. I’ve been looking for you…”
Lindsy raised her head and glanced at Fergus as she asked indifferently, “Are you here for training?”
“Yes, this is the last time we will participate in the school sports meet. I signed up for two events this time. One is the 100-meter race, and the other is the high jump!” Fergus said as if he was showing off.
“You participated in two events?”
When Lindsy heard Fergus’s words, a trace of shock flashed across her eyes. Her expression was also very incredulous. “You sure?”
Fergus nodded.
“Then can you handle it?”
Lindsy asked with a frown.
At this moment, a boy nearby said with a smile, “Fergus is so powerful that he will definitely be able to handle it…”
“That’s right. Fergus is very good at both the high jump and running. It would be a pity if he didn’t participate…”
“What’s the big deal about Fergus participating in two projects? I heard that someone from our school participated in four events…”
“Don’t spout nonsense here. Two projects is already the limit, okay? Wouldn’t it be exhausting if he participated in four events?”
“I’m not talking nonsense. That person seems to be junior year…”
Everyone began to discuss amongst themselves
..

chapters.title: Chapter 929: Just Because Others Can't Doesn't Mean I Can't!
chapters.content:
Chapter 929: Just Because Others Can’t Doesn’t Mean I Can’t!
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Porthampton University’s sports meet was only held for two days, and most of the track and field events would be held on the first day.
Ordinary people could participate in two competitions, so that was already considered very extraordinary.
After the first round, you still had to prepare for the next round. Most people simply didn’t have the physical strength to do so. For example, it was impossible for a person to finish a 1,000-meter run, then participate in the high jump, and finally do the 800-meter backstroke all in one go.
Of course, there was a situation where the person who participated in the competition did not want to win at all. No matter what kind of competition it was, such a person would only go through the motions. This behavior could still be explained.
Otherwise, it would be impossible to get good results in all four competitions.
“Alright, everyone, stop talking. Can the person you’re talking about compare to Fergus?”
At this moment, a girl stood up and continued, “Fergus participated in two events, and he was aiming for first place in both. Although that person participated in four events, he definitely came in last place…”
“Yes, that’s right. I think that person must have been asked to step up because no one from his class participated in the sports meet…”
“This kid is really amazing. He actually dares to participate in four competitions alone. If he gets the last place in all of them, he will be a celebrity in our school in the future!”
“Hahaha, that’s right. This person is too bold. If it were me, I would definitely not participate…”
Everyone laughed and started to discuss this mysterious person.
Connor sat beside Lindsy with a helpless expression.
These people might not know that the fool they were talking about was none other than Connor!
“…”
Lindsy smiled faintly when she heard what everyone said and did not say anything.
After all, Lindsy was a student of the physical education department. She knew that it was impossible for one person to participate in four events at the same time.
If she were to participate, she would basically be there to make up the numbers. It would be impossible for her to get a good ranking, so she did not refute anything.
Fergus saw Connor sitting next to Lindsy. The two of them were talking and laughing.
Therefore, he couldn’t help but frown and ask Lindsy softly, “Lindsy, who is this?”
“He is Connor McDonald, my friend!” Lindsy hurriedly explained.
“Connor McDonald?”
When Fergus heard this name, he couldn’t help but be stunned. Then, he said softly, “This name sounds familiar. Hello, my name is Fergus Long!”
“Hello!”
Connor looked at Fergus and nodded lightly, but his attitude was very cold.
After ordinary students found out about Fergus’s identity, they were usually very polite to him. After all, he was the president of the student council, a position which had quite a lot of power.
However, Connor was so cold when facing Fergus.
Not only did he not stand up to talk to Fergus, but he also practically ignored him. This made the surrounding students feel a little dissatisfied.
Fergus was naturally very unhappy in his heart, but he did not show it. Instead, he asked Connor softly, “Connor, you’re here to train, right? Are you also participating in the high jump?”
At this moment, Fergus asked Connor this question. He was actually asking if Connor was here to train or to accompany Lindsy.
“Connor is…”
Lindsy opened her mouth to speak.
“Yes, I’m participating in the high jump competition!”
Connor nodded lightly.
“That’s too much of a coincidence. I’m also participating in the high jump…”
The expression on Fergus’s face clearly eased up a lot because he felt that since Connor was also participating in the high jump, it meant that Connor did not come here specially to accompany Lindsy. This also meant that Connor and Lindsy might just be ordinary friends.
But at this moment, Connor spoke again.
“Not only am I participating in the high jump, but I’m also participating in the 100-meter sprint!”
Fergus looked at Connor and was stunned for a moment. He frowned and parroted, “The 100-meter sprint as well?”
“Other than the 100-meter spring, I’m also participating in the 800-meter race and long jump…” Connor added.
For a moment, everyone present was stunned on the spot, and the expressions on their faces was indescribable shock.
They had never expected that the fool who had participated in four events, whom they had been laughing at, would actually be standing beside them.
Even Lindsy had a look of disbelief on her face. Previously, Lindsy saw that Connor had not been training and was sitting on a chair to rest. She thought that Connor was here to hang out. She did not expect Connor to be participating in the sports meet.
However, Lindsy had never thought that Connor was the one who had participated in all four competitions!
For a moment, everyone present fell silent.
Lindsy hesitated for a moment before asking Connor softly. “Connor, are you joking?”
“I’m not joking. I’m the one who participated in four events!”
Connor replied to Lindsy, then turned to look at the students around him and said, “But I’m not going there to make up the numbers. I’m going there to get first place. I want to get first place in all four of these events…”
Everyone looked at Connor as if they were looking at a lunatic. Apart from confusion, there was shock on their faces. They couldn’t understand why Connor had the courage to say these words.
“Is there something wrong with this person’s brain?”
“That’s right. He’s participating in four events by himself, and he actually said that he wants to get first place in all of them. If he’s not an idiot, what is he?”
“There’s definitely something wrong with this person!”
“He might not even be able to get first place in one competition, let alone four! Now he dares to say that he wants to get first place in all of them. If he isn’t crazy, what is he?”
Everyone began to discuss in low voices.
Fergus stood beside Connor with an ugly expression on his face. Connor’s words just now were clearly a slap to his face!
After all, Fergus had just said that he had participated in two events, but Connor had said that he would participate in four events, and he wanted to get first place in all of them.
Wasn’t this a slap to his face? What was this?
Lindsy hesitated for a moment before asking Connor softly, “Connor, can you participate in four events alone?”
“Others can’t do it, but that doesn’t mean I can’t!”
Connor said lightly.
“Hehe, Connor is quite confident. Then let’s see each other at the school sports meet tomorrow. At that time, I want to see if you really have the ability you’re boasting about!”
Fergus said to Connor with a gloomy expression.
Connor turned his head and looked at Fergus without saying anything.

chapters.title: Chapter 930: The School Sports Meet Begins
chapters.content:
Chapter 930: The School Sports Meet Begins
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
“Ding, ding, ding!”
Just as everyone was shocked by Connor’s participation in the four competitions, Connor’s phone suddenly rang.
Connor picked up his phone and saw that it was Dominic calling. Therefore, he quickly picked up and asked calmly, “What’s wrong?”
“Connor, where are you? Spencer and I have finished training. Let’s go eat!” Dominic said.
“Alright, wait for me at the school gate!”
Connor nodded lightly.
“Alright…”
Dominic agreed and then hung up the phone.
“My friends have finished their training. I’m going to eat with them…”
Connor did not pay attention to the others. Instead, he turned his head and whispered to Lindsy.
“Alright…”
Lindsy nodded, after which Connor left.
“Lindsy, let’s go train together…”
After Fergus saw Connor leave, he took the initiative to invite Lindsy over for training. However, Lindsy ignored him and instead turned around and picked up her things. She shouted at Connor softly, “Connor, wait for me. I’ll go eat with you!”
Connor turned around and glanced at Lindsy. He stood where he was and waited for Lindsy to run over.
A moment later, Connor and Lindsy completely disappeared from everyone’s sight.
Fergus stood in place with an extremely ugly expression.
Because Connor’s actions earlier were clearly provoking him!
The others present were also dumbfounded. They really could not understand what Lindsy was thinking. She actually left a tall, rich, and handsome man like Fergus here and left with a poor kid who came out of nowhere.
This scene was really difficult for the onlookers to understand.
“Fergus, why don’t I accompany you to the training…”
At this moment, a girl walked to Fergus’s side and said to him very attentively.
“No need, you can practice by yourself. I still have something to do!”
Fergus had originally come to look for Lindsy. At this moment, Lindsy had already left, so he had no reason to continue staying here.
Therefore, Fergus turned around and walked into the Mercedes-Benz. Then, he started the car and disappeared from everyone’s sight.
Fergus took out his phone while driving the car and dialed Boris’s number.
“Ding!”
After the phone rang twice, Boris picked up the call.
“Brother Fei, why are you calling me?”
When Boris said this, his tone was obviously a little guilty.
Because he thought that Lindsy had complained to Fergus, and Fergus was about to blame him!
“Xiao Bo, help me investigate if there’s a person called Connor in your junior year year…”
Fergus gritted his teeth and said in a low voice.
“Connor?”
After hearing Fergus’s words, Boris could not help but be stunned for a moment. Then, he said with a smile, “Fergus are you talking about the Connor who was with Lindsy today?”
“You know him?”
Fergus was stunned for a moment and asked with a surprised expression.
“Of course I know him. This kid is from our Finance Department. I taught him a lesson back then…” Boris hurriedly said.
“Who is this kid? Let’s talk about it properly.
Fergus said coldly.
“Alright, alright…”
After Boris agreed, he quickly told Fergus everything about Connor.
“Alright, I got it!” After Fergus heard about Connor, a strange look flashed across his eyes, and he immediately hung up the phone.
“A poor kid who delivers food actually dares to fight with me…Just you wait!” Fergus muttered softly, then stepped on the accelerator and drove the car out of Porthampton University.
On the other side, Connor and Lindsy found Spencer and Dominic waiting at the school gate.
Moreover, Connor saw that Lindsy’s best friend, Tamia Wellman, was also there. Dominic must have invited her over.
Lindsy had treated them to a meal yesterday, so Connor was prepared to treat these people to a good meal.
He brought everyone to a western restaurant near the school.
Soon, everyone finished their meal and went back to their homes.
..
The next day, at seven o’clock in the morning.
When Connor arrived at the university, he found that the Porthampton University was especially lively today. There were people everywhere, and red flags were fluttering about in the breeze.
Many students had put up banners at the school gate and were holding large signboards welcoming the presidents of certain companies.
Most of these presidents were sponsors of the games.
The sports meet this time coincided with the anniversary of Porthampton University, so the scale of the sports meet this time was very large. Connor had already seen several reporters with cameras walking about. Of course, these reporters had been invited by the university.
The students and counselor who were in charge of receiving the guests were also standing at the school gate, waiting anxiously.
The itinerary for the sports meet was to hold the entrance ceremony at eight in the morning, during which each class would form a square team and shout slogans or raise some banners when passing by the podium. Next, the sports representative would speak, followed by the referee representative, and finally the leader would speak and announce the start of the sports meet.
After the sports meet began, the students of each class would go to their own base camps and watch the competition.
There were two big screens at the top of the field, which would play the games in real time. Because the field of the Porthampton University was relatively large, this was the only way to let everyone see the events.
On the first day of the sports meet, track and field events were mainly held, and the next day would see the swimming competition and the closing ceremony.
The scale of the sports meet’s second day could not be compared with today’s. Most of the highlights of the sports meet were put on today.
There were two tables at the entrance of Porthampton University. Two students from the student council sat in front of the tables and were responsible for registering every guest.
When Connor arrived at the school gate, he found that his students were also standing at the school gate. However, these people were not waiting for the sponsors to come. They were waiting for Connor.
Because the sponsorship matters were all handed over to Connor, the amount of sponsors Connor’s class could have today depended on his ability alone.
Of course, there were still many students in the class who came over just to watch the show. They all felt that it was impossible for Connor to find a sponsor today. Previously, Connor had been so arrogant at the class meeting. They naturally wanted to take this opportunity to humiliate Connor.
When Dominic saw Connor appear, he hurriedly ran to Connor’s side and asked anxiously, “Brother, you’re finally here. How are the sponsors going?”
..

chapters.title: Chapter 931: The Other Classes' Taunt
chapters.content:
Chapter 931: The Other Classes’ Taunt
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
After seeing Connor, all the students in the class ran to Connor and asked about the sponsor.
After all, many sponsors had already entered the venue, but Connor had not called anyone over. They were more or less anxious.
“The school sports meet starts at 8 PM. It’s only 7 PM now.”
Connor turned and said to the crowd with a smile.
“So you’re saying that you’ve settled the sponsorship?” Dominic hurriedly asked.
“It should be done!” Connor replied indifferently.
“Bro, what do you mean by it should be done? How many people did you invite? Also, when are they coming?” One of the male classmates asked Connor with a straight face.
“I don’t know when they will be here!” Connor said.
When everyone heard Connor’s response, they were dumbfounded. They looked at Connor and didn’t know what to say.
Even though Dominic and Spencer knew that Connor was a wealthy heir, they did not know his exact identity. They did not know how powerful Connor was, so they were very uncertain.
“Connor, you didn’t invite any sponsors, did you? If we don’t have any sponsors, our class will be embarrassed!” Another male student added.
“Yeah, Connor, since you couldn’t find a sponsor, why did you agree to do that?” A female student said with some dissatisfaction.
“Now, the students from the other classes are all waiting to see our class become a laughingstock. Connor, what were you thinking?”
The students began to question Connor.
Facing these students’ questions, Connor was very helpless. For a moment, he didn’t know how to answer.
Connor had told Thomas about this but had forgotten about it last night, so he didn’t call Thomas or ask him how many people he had managed to get.
“Connor, why aren’t you saying anything? Weren’t you loud during the class meeting? Why are you mute now?” A boy asked Connor in a strange tone.
“All right, cut the crap. If you guys are competent, why don’t you find sponsors? What kind of sarcastic remarks are you all making now?” Eunice shouted at the crowd frustratedly.
When everyone heard Eunice’s words, their expressions were very unconvinced.
“Eunice, I think what you said is wrong. Originally, our class planned to look for sponsors together, but Connor said he would do it alone, so we didn’t go out to look for sponsors!” a boy said.
“That’s right. Back then, Connor agreed to do this alone. Moreover, we were originally prepared to look for sponsors, but who would have thought Connor was overpromising?” The others hurriedly followed suit.
Under normal circumstances, when Porthampton University held a school sports meet, each class would compete in terms of its sponsors.
Usually, this was also an excellent time to show off the class’s connections.
In the previous school sports meet, Brandon alone invited many sponsors.
Therefore, the other students didn’t have to worry about this at all. However, now that Brandon was gone and there was no news from Connor, the students in the class felt that they were going to lose face.
“Ah, isn’t this Connor? What are you standing here for?” At this moment, Boris brought a few students from his class to Connor and asked with a smile.
“What does it have to do with you what I do here?” Connor glanced at Boris and replied expressionlessly.
“Connor, why are you being so arrogant? Do you think I won’t slap you right now?” Boris snarled after hearing Connor’s words.
After Boris received Fergus’s call yesterday, he inquired about Connor and Fergus. After knowing Connor had offended Fergus, he instantly felt relieved. Naturally, he did not have any reservations now.
“You can try!” Connor replied calmly.
“What…” Boris looked at Connor, and he seemed to become even angrier.
“Boris, there are so many lecturers here, and today is the school anniversary. Let’s ignore this kid. It’s not good for you if this blows up!” However, at this moment, a young man walked up to Boris and whispered to him.
When Boris heard the young man’s advice, he could not help but frown. Then, he looked at Connor and said, “Kid, just you wait. I’ll deal with you after the school sports meet ends…”
“…”
Connor looked at Boris without saying anything.
When the students in the class saw Boris taking the initiative to provoke Connor, none of them stood up for Connor.
After all, they were still angry at Connor for overpromising.
“Why haven’t any sponsors come to your class this time?”
At this moment, the student representative of another faculty asked Eunice and the others with a disdainful expression.
“That’s right. Isn’t the Finance faculty very arrogant? Didn’t you look down on the sponsors our Civil Engineering faculty found before?”
“Why is your Finance faculty so low-key this time?”
“Is it because Brandon dropped out of school, so you can’t find a sponsor?”
“Now you know what level your finance department is at, right? Without Brandon, the students in your class would be nothing. You had the face to laugh at us before. What a joke!”
The people who had offended Connor’s class during the sports meet did not intend to give up this excellent opportunity to hit them when they were down. They all stood up and mocked Connor’s class.
As for the students from the Finance faculty, their faces were ashen. They gritted their teeth and stood where they were, not knowing what to say.
Right now, their class had indeed not found a single sponsor, so now that the other classes were ridiculing them, they had no way to refute.
“Our Finance faculty’s Class 2 didn’t have a sponsor. It’s not because we couldn’t find a sponsor, but because some people were overpromising that they could handle the sponsor themselves, so we didn’t look for one…” At this moment, a boy couldn’t help but shout at the top of his lungs.
“Woah, who was being so loud? Claiming he could handle the sponsorships alone. Could it be Connor? Connor has indeed accumulated many connections after delivering food for so many years!” Boris said with a smile.
“Hahaha!” The other classes also began to laugh wildly.

chapters.title: Chapter 932: 500,000 Dollars In Sponsorship
chapters.content:
Chapter 932: 500,000 Dollars In Sponsorship
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
When everyone heard what Boris said, they began to laugh loudly.
“You guys guessed right. The person who told us that he could find a sponsor alone was Connor!” a boy glanced at Connor and said disdainfully.
“Yes, yes, it was Connor who said this back then. If it wasn’t for Connor bragging, how could our class not have a single sponsor…”
“That’s right, Connor. Don’t take on the porcelain work if you don’t have a diamond drill. Now everyone is waiting to see the joke of our class.”
“It’s fine if you’re shameless, but you can’t let your classmates be embarrassed along with you,” the other boys in the class also stood up and mocked Connor.
Obviously, these students could not stand the ridicule of the students from the other classes, so they vented all their anger on Connor.
When Eunice heard what everyone said, she was also very angry.
This was because she did not expect her classmates to be so mean. It was fine if they did not speak up for Connor then, but they joined the students from other classes to mock Connor. What was going on?
“The school sports meet has yet to start, right? How do you know I couldn’t get a sponsor?” However, at this moment, Connor suddenly spoke up.
When everyone heard Connor’s words, they were stunned. Then, a male student approached Connor and shouted, “Connor, it’s almost 7:30 PM. The school sports meet will officially start at 8 PM. The other classes have already had many sponsors attend this, but not a single sponsor has come for our class.”
“So what if their class has more sponsors?”
Connor smiled disdainfully and continued, “Even if they invite all the bosses in Porthampton, they won’t be as important as me alone!”
When Connor said this, he was still very confident. Connor had already thought it through. It would be best if Thomas invited some bosses over. If Thomas forgot about this, Connor would call Thomas and ask him to come over. If Thomas were there alone, the effect would be better than all the bosses present.
“Connor, what kind of situation is this? You still have the mood to brag here. I have to hand it to you!” One of the boys looked at Connor, speechless.
Even the students in the class looked at Connor with disdain. If Connor was a wealthy heir with some connections, others might believe him.
However, all the students in the class knew that Connor was just a poor loser. Although their attitude toward Connor had changed a little during this time, it still could not change the fact that Connor was a poor loser!
It was already a bad situation then, and Connor could still make such claims. Everyone felt that Connor was just being stubborn.
“Maybe Connor really can do that!”
However, at this moment, Boris suddenly opened his mouth and called out with a smile.
“Although Connor is a delivery gut, he might know many VIPs. It’s not time yet. Let’s wait for the school sports meet and see whom Connor has invited.”
The students from the other classes also followed suit.
The students in Connor’s class looked at Connor helplessly. To them, Connor was just bragging. He couldn’t get a sponsor at all.
At this moment, Eunice was more or less worried. If Connor didn’t invite a sponsor today, not only would Connor be laughed at by the other classes, but even the students from her own class would not let Connor off. By then, how would Connor stay at Porthampton University?
Therefore, Eunice couldn’t help but turn to look at Connor and ask him softly, “Connor, are you really okay?”
“Don’t worry. My sponsor should be here soon!” Connor replied to Eunice.
Dominic and Spencer looked at Connor, their eyes filled with worry and helplessness.
They knew Connor was a rich heir but needed to know more about Connor’s background.
They were even less confident that Connor could invite the sponsor over today.
***
In the blink of an eye, five minutes passed.
A BMW slowly stopped at the entrance of Porthampton University. When Boris saw the BMW, a trace of pride flashed in his eyes. Then, he hurriedly shouted, “Oh, my sponsor is here. I have to go welcome him!”
When Boris said this, he deliberately turned to look at Connor. Then, he ran to the front of the BMW and took the initiative to open the door.
A middle-aged man in a suit walked out of the BMW. He was wearing a Rolex watch. He was a successful boss.
“Uncle Frankie, I’m sorry to trouble you to come personally for such a small matter!” Boris hurriedly greeted the middle-aged man with a smile and said respectfully.
“Boris, what are you saying? What kind of relationship do I have with your father? Besides, it’s good that your school is holding a sports meet. It’s my honor to be able to come and participate…” The middle-aged man replied indifferently.
“Uncle Frankie, please come in quickly!” Boris hurriedly ran to the front and led the middle-aged man to the female student in charge of receiving them.
“Jubilee Construction Co., Ltd., Frankie Wilburg, Mr. Wilburg, is donating 10, 000 dollars to Porthampton University!”
After the middle-aged man entered Porthampton University, the staff receiving him at the school gate hurriedly picked up the loudspeaker and shouted through the broadcast.
Usually, sponsors who came to participate in the school sports meet would more or less sponsor some expenses. Rich people might sponsor a little more, 50, 000 or 100, 000. If the boss was a little stingy, he might sponsor 10,000 or 20,000.
Of course, there were many VIPs at Porthampton University.
The one with the highest sponsorship fee was a boss Fergus hired two years ago. He sponsored 500, 000 dollars.
Back then, this had caused quite a stir in the school.

chapters.title: Chapter 933: Fergus' Arrival
chapters.content:
Chapter 933: Fergus’ Arrival
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Basically, Fergus would invite some VIPs over for every school sports meet, and those VIPs were all individuals with a net worth of hundreds of millions.
The sponsorship fee from any of them could be more than ten times that of other classes.
Moreover, Fergus himself was very capable, and his family background was also very powerful.
Otherwise, Fergus wouldn’t have been able to become the president of the Student Union of Porthampton University.
Now that Fergus was about to graduate, and Boris wanted to compete for the next student council president, he would bring out some real VIPs for this school sports meet.
Therefore, he used all the connections in his family to make a big splash at the school sports meet.
The university campus was actually a small society. To stand out among the many candidates, one had to show outstanding strength and a deep network of connections.
The school sports meet was the best opportunity to reflect a person’s family background.
How many sponsors one could invite and how much sponsorship money these sponsors could fork out could reflect one’s family background. It would also give one bonus points during the election.
Some people might have few sponsors, but the sponsors might sponsor a huge amount.
Some people invited many sponsors, but the sponsorship might be smaller, but the overall number was still quite a lot.
Although the school sports meet hadn’t started yet, the students of each class had already begun to compete. This was also why the students in Connor’s class were so concerned that Connor hadn’t found a sponsor.
When Boris heard the voice coming from the campus broadcast, his expression was a little disdainful. He said indifferently, “I wonder how many projects Frankie has received from my dad in a year. Now, he only sponsors 10, 000 dollars. How stingy…”
“Now, now. Boris, they sponsored 10, 000 dollars. Some people can’t even get sponsors!”
The people in Boris’s class laughed.
“How can you compare me to Connor?”
Boris smiled faintly, then turned to the boy behind him and said, “Ask the girls in our class to arrange a seat at the back for Frankie. You’re too f*cking stingy…”
“Got it, Boris!” the boy was stunned for a moment before he hurriedly nodded.
After Connor’s students heard Boris’s words, they were very helpless.
After all, Boris had invited a VIP like Frankie, but he had arranged for Frankie to sit at the back. Meanwhile, their class did not even have a sponsor.
If Connor had invited Frankie, then the students in Connor’s class would have been so happy that they would have arranged Frankie in the best position.
As time passed, more and more sponsors gradually appeared, and the school gate became lively.
Many luxury cars stopped at the entrance of Porthampton University. One after another, middle-aged men in suits walked out of the luxury cars.
Most of these middle-aged men were well-known bosses in Porthampton. They were all worth over fifty million dollars and were all very famous.
“Juan Zimmer, the general manager of the Foreign Trade Company, sponsored 50, 000 dollars!”
“Victor Properties’ Chairman, Forster Knight, sponsored 80, 000 dollars!”
“CEO of Hanson Electronic, Billy Sabato, sponsored 100,000 dollars!”
“…”
Announcements like these went on.
However, as expected, these people were all sponsors invited by Boris. There were also a small number of sponsors invited by other classes. As for Connor, not a single sponsor appeared.
In less than five minutes, more than ten sponsors had arrived at Boris’s side, but Connor’s side was still very quiet. The staff in charge of receiving Boris’s class was already too busy, but those in Connor’s class were all standing on the spot in a daze. It was very awkward.
When Eunice saw this, she seemed a little helpless.
If Eunice had known Connor couldn’t find a sponsor, she would have looked for one. No matter what, as long as she could find one or two sponsors, it wouldn’t be so embarrassing!
Now, the entire school was watching. If their class had no sponsor when the school sports meet started, it would be very embarrassing!
At this moment, a black car slowly stopped at the school gate.
When everyone saw the car, a trace of disdain flashed in their eyes.
After all, there were too many luxury cars here today. The 200, 000 dollars car looked a little shabby.
A moment later, three people got out of the car.
When everyone saw these three people, they were stunned and very puzzled.
The young man who got out of the car was Fergus Long!
There were two middle-aged men beside Fergus. These two middle-aged men looked very low-key and did not seem to be VIPs.
“That’s not right. Every school sports meet is Fergus’ most glorious time. I remember that in the last school sports meet, Fergus invited many VIPs. Why is he so low-key this time?”
“Yes, and these two people look a little unfamiliar. They don’t seem to be VIPs!”
“Fergus might not care about these because he’s about to graduate…”
“I think that’s what happened. Fergus is about to graduate anyway, so he gave all the opportunities to Boris!”
When everyone saw the two middle-aged men beside Fergus, they began to discuss in low voices.
“Fergus!”
Boris was naturally very puzzled but still took the initiative to call out to Fergus. Fergus nodded lightly and did not say anything more. As he spoke, he led the two middle-aged men into the school.
However, when Fergus passed by Connor, he subconsciously turned to look at Connor and did not say anything.
“Mayor of Porthampton, Mr. Jaco has arrived!”
“Director of Porthampton’s Cultural Bureau, Mr. Jaffer has arrived!”
But then, the announcement came from the school.
After hearing these two announcements, everyone was shocked.
The students at the school gate were all dumbfounded. Their jaws dropped as they could not help but turn around to look at Fergus.
“Fergus invited the mayor and Mr. Jaffer?”
Boris stood rooted to the ground, dumbfounded. The expression on his face was one of disbelief.
“Isn’t Fergus amazing?” the other class student representative exclaimed.

chapters.title: Chapter 934: Another VIP
chapters.content:
Chapter 934: Another VIP
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
When these students saw that Fergus only brought two people over, they were more or less puzzled.
They thought that Fergus was about to graduate, so he wanted to leave the limelight for Boris!
However, no one expected that the two people Fergus brought would have such influential identities!
Although Mr. Jaco was only the deputy mayor of Porthampton, he was responsible for the promotion work in the city, not to mention the director of the Cultural Bureau.
Now that Porthampton University was holding a school sports meet, inviting these two people over was simply a pair of king bombs!
No matter what kind of sponsors the others invited, they could not be compared to Fergus because they were not on the same level.
Although the two people Fergus invited seemed very low-key, their identities were strong.
Fergus had invited dozens of sponsors for the school sports meet last year. Each of them was worth more than ten million dollars, and their sponsorship was ridiculously huge.
This proved how strong Fergus’s connections in the business world were.
This year, Fergus was even more direct. He even invited Mr. Jaco and Mr. Jaffer of the Cultural Bureau. This was telling everyone that Fergus not only had connections in the business world but was also very influential in other places.
Not just anyone could invite people like Mr. Jaco and Mr. Jaffer from the Cultural Affairs Bureau!
Even the leaders of Porthampton University couldn’t do so!
Therefore, when the leaders of the school heard these two announcements from the broadcast, they ran out of their offices one after another, ready to welcome these two heavyweight guests.
The students at the school gate were also dumbfounded. They were gaping as they watched this with extreme shock!
No one expected Fergus to be so ruthless this time!
Previously, Connor had said that no matter how many sponsors these people invited, they could not compare to the person Connor invited.
Connor hadn’t done it yet, but Fergus had.
The two people invited by Fergus are the VVIPs in Porthampton. No matter how many sponsors others invited, they could not compare.
“Fergus is really amazing…”
“Yeah, Fergus managed to invite Mr. Jaco and Mr. Jaffer this time. That’s amazing!”
“Fergus’s family background is indeed beyond our imagination. I originally thought that Fergus didn’t care about this school sports meet, so he casually found two people to attend. I didn’t expect these two people to be so influential!”
“Sigh, I wish I could be as good as Fergus!”
“If only I had half of Fergus’s ability!”
Everyone looked at the seats in the school with envious expressions because they knew that Fergus would be in the limelight again in this school sports meet.
Boris stood where he was, and he was naturally very envious.
After all, he had put in much effort for this school sports meet, but in the end, Fergus had stolen the limelight. He was naturally very unwilling, but even if he was unwilling, what could he do?
Boris knew that his family background was indeed not as good as Fergus’, and Fergus was not Boris’ competitor, so even if Fergus stole the limelight, it would only affect him a little.
“Connor, when will your sponsor come? Hurry up and let us see what kind of big shot your sponsor is. He dares claim that this person is better than all our sponsors. We have to get a good look!”
Boris saw that most of the sponsors he had invited had arrived, so he started to mock Connor when he had nothing to do.
“Boris, why are you in such a hurry? The school sports meet has yet to start, right? Connor’s sponsor will be here. The person Connor invited this time must be a powerful VIP. Otherwise, he wouldn’t be so late!”
The student representative of the other classes also followed up with a mocking remark.
The students in Connor’s class all had ugly expressions on their faces. They looked at Connor with abnormal anger because they all felt that Connor’s bragging had caused their class to be awkward.
“Connor, can you tell me the truth? Did you invite a sponsor or not?”
After Eunice heard everyone’s mockery, she was a little anxious. She frowned and asked Connor.
“…”
Connor turned to look at Eunice but didn’t say anything.
“Connor, if you couldn’t get a sponsor, just tell me directly. It’s okay. I’ll bring our students in now. We don’t have to stand here and be laughed at by others…”
Seeing that Connor didn’t say anything, and she already knew the answer, so she added.
“That’s right, Connor, just tell the truth! It’s fine if you’re used to embarrassing yourself, but now our classmates are standing here and embarrassing themselves with you!”
“If you haven’t found a sponsor, then just say it. It’ll save us the trouble of standing here and being laughed at!”
“I don’t know what this Connor is thinking. Does he like to be embarrassed so much?”
The students in the class also shouted at Connor.
“Wait. I need to make a call…” Connor took a deep breath and picked up his phone to call Thomas.
Connor did not blame Thomas. After all, Connor did not remind Thomas last night. Thomas had a lot of work to do, so it was normal for him to forget about it.
Therefore, Connor was prepared to call Thomas and ask him to come over.
Although Connor’s actions would expose his identity, it was too late. Thomas’ company was not far from Connor’s school, so if Thomas came alone, he should still be able to make it.
However, just as Connor took out his phone and was about to call Thomas, a white Lincoln limousine slowly stopped in front of the school gate. The license plate number of this car was five eights, which meant that the person in the car was a very influential person.
“Who invited this VVIP?”
“Regardless of who invited him, it probably isn’t Connor…”
“That’s right. It’s probably Boris, right?”
Everyone looked at the Lincoln limousine and started discussing in low voices.
“Boris, is this the VIP you invited?” The young man beside Boris asked.
“I think so. I asked my dad to contact some of his friends. I don’t know some of them either…” Boris hesitated for a moment before walking over.

chapters.title: Chapter 935: How Could Connor Know Such A Person?
chapters.content:
Chapter 935: How Could Connor Know Such A Person?
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
When Boris saw the Lincoln limousine stop, he could not help but hesitate before taking the initiative to walk over.
At this moment, a burly middle-aged man walked out of the Lincoln limousine.
“Hello, sir. May I know who you are?”
Boris looked at the middle-aged man and felt that he was a stranger. He didn’t look like his father’s friend, so he couldn’t help but hesitate and ask in a low voice.
“I’m Carter Yones, the CEO of the San Antonio Construction Group. I’m here to participate in your school’s sports meet…” The middle-aged man sized up Boris and said softly.
When the students heard Carter’s introduction, they were all surprised.
After all, the people present were all students of Porthampton University. They knew some of the local companies.
However, this middle-aged man said that he was from San Antonio. They did not know much about San Antonio.
On the other hand, Boris was in disbelief because Boris had heard of this construction group. It was said that the total market value of this group was tens of billions. It was considered a very famous large-scale group in the four cities.
However, Boris could not understand who could invite such a big shot over. Even Fergus wasn’t capable of that, right?
“Uhm, Mr. Yones, let me ask you something. Who invited you to participate in our school’s sports meet?” Boris asked Carter with a smile.
Carter turned and glanced at Boris, looking a little unhappy. Then, he frowned and asked, “What are you doing?”
“I…” Boris opened his mouth to explain.
“What about you? Hurry up and scram to the side. I don’t know you…” Carter looked at Boris and said impatiently. Then, he began to size up the people around the school.
Soon, Carter saw Connor standing at the side, ready to call Thomas.
Carter quickly took out his phone and looked at the photo on it. He was unusually excited.
He ran up to Connor and shouted as he ran, “Mr. McDo… Wait, Connor, I’ve finally found you…”
Thomas had told them that Connor didn’t like to expose his identity. He told these people to call him Connor when they saw him, not Mr. McDonald.
Carter had been too excited and had almost said something wrong.
When Connor saw the middle-aged man running toward him, a trace of doubt flashed in his eyes.
“Connor, I’m… here… I’m here to attend in your school sports meet!”
It was Carter’s first time meeting Connor. He knew Connor’s background’s influence, so he was still very nervous.
“You’re here to attend the school sports meet?”
Connor was stunned, but he instantly understood what was happening. So, he told the students in the class, “Someone, entertain Mr. Yones!”
For a moment, everyone present was very shocked.
Boris also stood in the same spot, his face full of disbelief.
No one expected Carter to be Connor’s sponsor!
Everyone thought Connor would be unable to invite a sponsor today, but no one expected Connor to invite a VIP who drove a Lincoln limousine. It felt like a dream.
Some gossipy students took out their phones and searched for the words ‘San Antonio Construction Group’ on Google.
However, they were all dumbfounded when they saw the search results on Google.
No one would have thought that Carter Yones, standing in front of Connor, was a VIP with a net worth of tens of billions!
“How does Connor know such a person?”
“This can’t be!”
“Isn’t Connor just a poor loser? How could he know such a VIP when he only delivers food?”
“That’s absolutely impossible. Mr. Yones is from San Antonio. Connor definitely doesn’t know who this person is!”
Everyone looked at Connor. Other than shock, there was also some doubt on their faces.
“I know what happened!”
However, at this moment, Boris suddenly sneered.
“What is it?” The person beside Boris hurriedly asked.
“Isn’t Connor bold? He dares to find an actor for this!”
Boris smiled proudly and continued, “This person claims he is the CEO of San Antonio Construction Group, but there is no photo of this person on the Internet. Moreover, San Antonio is so far away from Davenport. I think Connor just randomly found someone to impersonate the CEO of San Antonio Construction Group. After all, we don’t even know what the CEO of San Antonio Construction Group looks like!”
“But how do you explain the Lincoln?” A boy next to Boris hesitated before asking Boris softly.
“Are you f*cking stupid?” Boris frowned and cursed in a low voice.
“What?” The boy asked Boris, feeling very wronged.
“How do you know that this Lincoln limousine belongs to that person? Connor already knew how to find actors, but he doesn’t know how to rent a car?” Boris said in a low voice.
“That’s right. Connor is so bold. He dares to find an actor to pretend to be a sponsor. Isn’t Connor afraid of being discovered? How embarrassing would it be if someone found out?” The others chimed in.
“If Connor can’t find a sponsor, it’ll be even more embarrassing. He even claims this person is from San Antonio Construction Group. He’s sure that no one knows the boss of San Antonio Construction Group…” Boris analyzed methodically.
“Connor is despicable. I’ll go expose him now!” the boy next to Boris hissed angrily, then strode over to Connor.
“Can you f*cking calm down!”
Boris hurriedly reached out and tugged at the boy beside him. Then, he frowned and scolded coldly, “Are you brainless or pretending to be brainless? What are you going to say if you go there now?”
“I told you he was an imposter!” the boy replied stiffly.
“I have to hand it to you. You said that he’s a fake. Do you have any evidence? And what if this person is the CEO of San Antonio Construction Group? Can you afford to provoke such a VIP?” Boris asked in a low voice.
“What should I do now?” the boy scratched his head and asked, confused.

chapters.title: Chapter 936: A Bag of Money!
chapters.content:
Chapter 936: A Bag of Money!
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Boris couldn’t help but look at Carter, who was standing beside Connor, with a troubled expression on his face.
Although he felt that Carter was definitely a fake because there was no way Connor could have invited such a powerful person to be part of this.
However, Boris was rather smart. He was not in a hurry to expose Carter’s identity. Instead, he whispered to the guy beside him, “You don’t have to expose this person’s identity right now. Wait until Carter goes in and see how much he’s willing to sponsor. If Carter doesn’t sponsor a single cent, or if the amount is low, then it means that this person is definitely a fake. After all, he’s participating in the Porthampton University’s sports meet. He’s worth tens of billions, so he definitely won’t be too stingy…”
“What if he sponsors a huge amount?”
The guy was stunned for a moment before he asked in a low voice.
“Don’t worry, this person is just an actor hired by Connor. There’s no way he can fork out so much. After all, Connor is poor. He even paid for the car and an actor to be the sponsor.”
Boris said confidently.
“Boris, you’re so smart. I know what to do now!”
The guy looked at Boris and said with admiration.
Boris subconsciously turned to look at Connor, and he looked very proud.
At this moment, Boris was already imagining the scene where Connor’s act was exposed.
At that time, Boris would definitely mock Connor.
Boris was not the only one who had this thought. Everyone else present were thinking the same thing because they knew Connor’s identity very well. They felt that it was impossible for Connor to hire a big boss of this level. Therefore, the best explanation was that this person was very likely an actor hired by Connor.
Otherwise, if this Carter Yones was real, why would a big boss like him be so respectful to Connor?
What was even more unbelievable was that Connor’s attitude toward Carter was very cold.
If an ordinary person met a big boss of this level, they would definitely try their best to please him!
Boris was very respectful even when facing a boss like Frankie Wilburg, so Connor’s reaction was obviously unreasonable.
“What are you all standing there for? Hurry up and bring Mr. Yones in!”
When Connor said this, the students in the class seemed to have heard nothing. They were all stunned and did not move.
“Mr. Yones, this way please!”
