Eunice was the first to react. She quickly walked to Carter and whispered to him.
“Should I head in first?”
Carter asked Connor with a smile.
“Go on!”
Connor nodded lightly.
Carter followed Eunice and walked into the Porthampton University.
Meanwhile, Boris and the others stood there without any reaction, because they were all waiting to see how much sponsorship money Carter was prepared to offer.
“I didn’t expect this actor to have such good acting skills. He really looks like a big boss!”
Boris looked at Carter’s back and could not help but sigh softly.
A moment later, Eunice brought Carter to the registration area.
“Mr. Yones, please tell me your company’s name and your name. I’ll help you register!”
Eunice didn’t know if Carter was real or not, but she was still very respectful to him. After all, if Connor had found a sponsor with a very powerful background, Eunice naturally would not dare to be disrespectful.
Carter said the name of his company and his own name.
“Mr. Yones, the registration is complete, but I still have something to tell you…”
Eunice said hesitantly.
Carter was stunned for a moment before he said indifferently, “Young lady, if you have anything to say, just say it!”
“The sponsors who come to our school to participate in the sports meet will usually sponsor some funds. No matter how much money you sponsor, it will be considered your sponsorship to our school.”
Eunice whispered to Carter.
When Carter heard Eunice’s words, he couldn’t help but be stunned for a moment. Then, he said cheerfully, “Ah, I see. You don’t have to worry about that. I’ve already asked my driver to prepare the sponsorship money…”
“You’ve already prepared it?”
Eunice looked at Carter in shock. She didn’t expect Carter to already prepare the sponsorship money.
“Jerry, go get the sponsorship money!”
Carter turned and shouted at the driver in the Lincoln Limousine.
When Jerry heard that, he carried a bag and walked out of the car.
When Boris and the others saw the driver carrying a bag and walking out of the car, a trace of doubt flashed across their eyes. They seemed to be very puzzled.
“I didn’t expect the actor to be so serious. He even found a driver and brought a bag…”
Boris looked at the driver’s seat and muttered softly.
“Boris, this doesn’t seem right. Is this Carter Yones real?”
When the guy beside Boris saw the bag in the driver’s hand, a trace of doubt flashed across his eyes, and he frowned.
“Are you f*cking stupid? How could a poor guy like Connor know such a boss? There’s no way he’s the real Carter Yones! Just shut up!”
Boris was very frustrated now. He frowned and scolded in a low voice.
The guy scratched his head and did not dare to continue speaking.
A moment later, the driver ran to Carter’s side and said respectfully, “Mr. Yones, this is the sponsorship money you asked me to prepare…”
Carter reached out to take the black bag. Then, without any hesitation, he poured the contents of the bag onto the table.
Stack after stack of dollar bills were thrown onto the table.
Everyone was shocked. They looked at Carter in a daze.
The corners of Boris’s mouth twitched as if he had seen a ghost. For a moment, he did not know what to do.

chapters.title: Chapter 937: Breaking the Record
chapters.content:
Chapter 937: Breaking the Record
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Although most of the sponsors who came to participate in the school sports meet would choose to use electronic payment due to its convenience, there were still many sponsors who chose to pay in cash.
However, this was the first time these students had seen someone use this method to pay for the sponsorship fees. The cash was strewn all over the table.
This was the first time such a sponsor had appeared!
The students who were present thought that Carter was an actor that Connor had hired.
However, when they saw the cash on the table, they instantly dismissed the idea.
The reason was very simple. If Carter was really an actor hired by Connor, how would he have so much cash?
There were no exact numbers on the banknotes on the table, but it was definitely hundreds of thousands in cash!
Even if Connor was just trying to act tough, there was no way he could have forked out so much money!
For a moment, everyone present did not know how to describe their feelings.
No one had expected that this matter would actually have such a shocking reversal.
Connor had actually found a sponsor, and this sponsor was the president of a construction company. The sponsorship fee amount was also very terrifying.
It was as if at this moment, all the doubts that the students had about Connor had disappeared because of the appearance of this bag of cash.
“When did Connor get to know such a big shot?”
“I don’t know. No wonder Connor said that he could handle the sponsorship alone. It turns out that it’s true!”
“I thought that Connor was just bragging. I didn’t expect Connor to really do it!”
“That’s right, it doesn’t make sense. Isn’t Connor a poor kid? How does he know such a person?”
Everyone began to discuss in low voices.
Meanwhile, Boris stood there foolishly, not knowing what to do for a moment.
“Boris, the cash must be a prop. It can’t be real!”
The guy beside Boris hesitated for a moment before whispering to Boris.
“Are you f*cking stupid?”
Boris cursed in despair, then continued, “If it’s fake money, why would Connor take it out in front of so many people? He’s not that stupid!”
“So, you’re saying that the money is real?”
The guy blinked and asked with a puzzled expression.
After taking a deep breath, Boris was speechless. He didn’t know what to say. At this moment, Boris realized that he really couldn’t communicate with this guy.
Since he had already taken out the cash, it meant that Carter was the real deal.
What Boris couldn’t understand was how Connor knew a boss like Carter. This obviously didn’t make sense!
Connor looked at Carter, and he was speechless.
Because Connor had already instructed Thomas Morgan to keep a low profile.
However, Connor did not expect these people to be so ostentatious. They actually poured all the money on the table. What was going on?
Eunice looked at the pile of cash on the table in a daze. She stood there foolishly, not knowing what to do.
“Young lady, what are you waiting for? Is it not enough? Should I ask the driver to get another bag?”
Carter asked Eunice.
“No, no, no. It’s too much!”
Eunice shouted and hurriedly waved her hands.
“How is this too much? I prepared five million dollars, but Mr. Morgan told me…”
Carter paused for a moment, then suddenly realized that he might have said something he shouldn’t have, so he quickly said, “It’s okay. You guys can count and see if the amount is right.”
“Okay!”
The few students who were in charge of welcoming the guests at the school gate also recovered from their shock at this time. They hurriedly picked up the banknotes on the table and counted the amount of cash there.
“Mr. Yones, the total is one… One million, right… Am I right?”
After counting the bills, a student asked Carter with a trembling voice.
In fact, it was not surprising that this student was so nervous at this time. After all, this was the first time that the Porthampton University had encountered such a rich sponsor. The previous record for sponsorship fees was a boss invited by Fergus Long who sponsored 500,000 dollars.
However, that boss was Fergus’s uncle. Also, it was only when Fergus was running for the president of the student council that he took out so much money.
“That’s right, it’s a million!”
Carter said with a smile.
“Mr. Yones, this is too much. Do you want to take some back?”
Eunice whispered to Carter.
This was the first time someone was asking the sponsor to take some money back.
After all, under normal circumstances, most students would think that sponsors were stingy. It was really rare for someone like Carter to fork out a million dollars!
“This is not much at all. Hurry up and write it down so that I can go in!”
Carter said in frustration.
In the eyes of ordinary people, Carter forking out so much money was not worth it, but it was actually a ticket for Carter to meet Connor.
Many people in the four provinces wanted to get to know Mr. McDonald from Davenport, but they couldn’t get the chance even if they racked their brains.
Carter had a good relationship with Thomas Morgan. They were university classmates. He had called Thomas many times about meeting Connor.
However, Thomas knew Connor’s character. It was impossible for someone like Carter to meet him.
However, at this time, there was finally such an opportunity. Thomas had contacted Carter and asked him to prepare a sponsorship fee of one million dollars.
If an ordinary person wanted to meet Connor and get to know him, they might have to spend tens of millions or even give their daughter away, but they still would not have the chance!
Carter had only spent one million this time, and he was able to leave an impression on Connor. What a good deal!
Carter felt that he had gotten a huge advantage, while Eunice felt that this sum of money was too much.
However, Carter was determined to sponsor one million dollars. In the end, the students in charge of registration could only accept the money helplessly.
Eunice then brought Carter into the campus.
“Mr. Yones of San Antonio’s JPO Corporation has sponsored one million dollars in cash!”
When Carter walked into the school, the school’s broadcast suddenly sounded.
This sentence caused the students of the entire Porthampton University to boil with excitement.
This was because Carter’s sponsorship of one million dollars had broken Fergus’s record of 500,000 dollars!

chapters.title: Chapter 938: Only One Sponsor?
chapters.content:
Chapter 938: Only One Sponsor?
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
“Who invited this sponsor? He’s actually so rich?”
” I don’t know. I think he’s a president from San Antonio…”
“This boss is way too rich. He actually took out a million dollars as sponsorship fees. What can’t he do with so much money?”
“I heard that this person came with a bag of cash. He threw all the cash on the table, scaring those people silly…”
“It must be the relative of another rich guy in the school. Otherwise, why would he sponsor so much money?”
“Yeah. The last time, the president asked his uncle to come and sponsor 500,000 dollars. That was already shocking enough. I didn’t expect someone to sponsor a million dollars this time. How crazy is that…”
The students who had been busy on the field began to discuss softly after hearing the announcement.
Even the school’s higher ups had left their offices and ran toward the school gate.
After all, this boss had given a million dollars in sponsorship fees. The school’s higher ups would definitely welcome him personally!
Only Vice Mayor Yonah and Carter Yones could enjoy such treatment.
Fergus, who was chatting with his friends, had an incredulous expression on his face when he heard the broadcast.
He quickly walked to one of his friends and asked in a low voice, “Who invited Carter Yones?”
Other people might not know Carter, but Fergus knew a little about him!
“It’s a junior year student. I think his name is Connor or something!”
The friend thought for a moment and replied in a low voice.
“Connor?”
When Fergus heard this name, he was stunned for a moment, and he was a little shocked.
“How could Connor know someone like Carter Yones?”
Fergus could not help but ask in his heart.
…
At this time, Sadie Colt, Yara Xenos, Harold Phillips, Sheldon Statton, Sabrina Ziegler, and the others were not in school. They were not very interested in the school’s sports meet, so they had taken leave to go somewhere else to play. After all, Sheldon was the son of the mayor, so the school would not dare to not give him leave.
If these people were all present, then their energy would definitely be very shocking.
However, they were not very interested in the school sports meet. Harold and Sheldon were famous rich guys in Davenport. They did not bother to gain reputation through events like this.
Harold was the son of the deputy chief of war, and Sheldon was the son of the mayor.
This identity alone was enough.
Harold and Sheldon had very clear plans for their future, so they were not very concerned about the school’s matters. As for the title of the student council president, it was meaningless in their eyes.
To put it bluntly, Fergus was a rich guy, and so were Harold and Sheldon.
However, Fergus was nothing compared to Harold and Sheldon.
However, Harold and Sheldon were nothing compared to Jovan.
Those who had a few million dollars and those who had tens of millions were also considered rich. However, the difference between the two was still very large.
…
On the other side, Boris stood at the school gate. He was naturally very shocked.
However, after he had calmed down, he felt that even if Connor knew Carter, so what?
Perhaps they only met by chance, but it did not prove how wide Connor’s connections were.
Moreover, Boris had invited more than a dozen sponsors this time. The sponsorship fee alone was 1.5 million dollars. It was not something that Connor’s 1 million dollars could compare to.
Meanwhile, the students in Connor’s class seemed to be looking at Connor with less enmity. At the very least, they knew that Connor was not just bragging. He had indeed invited a rich sponsor and had even received a sponsorship fee of one million dollars.
When Brandon Guthrie was still around, he only managed to pull in 300,000 dollars in sponsorship fees, and it was a combination of more than ten sponsors.
Connor didn’t go back on his word. The students from the other classes naturally didn’t have the guts to continue mocking Connor and the others.
Eunice, Spencer, Dominic, and the others had been worried. If Connor really couldn’t find a sponsor, how embarrassing would that be?
But now that they saw Carter, they heaved a long sigh of relief.
It was already 7:50 pm., less than ten minutes before the opening of the school sports meet. Therefore, there were fewer and fewer people at the school gate. Most of the sponsors had already entered the school.
Boris felt that Connor had only invited this one sponsor today, so he said to Connor proudly, “Not bad, Connor. You didn’t deliver food for nothing for so many years. You actually managed to invite Mr. Carter Yones. Not bad. At the very least, it’s better than not being able to invite anyone…”
The students in Connor’s class seemed to be unhappy.
After all, Connor’s sponsor was probably more powerful than the ten sponsors from the other classes. He had given one million dollars for the sponsorship alone.
Although they were unhappy, they did not dare to offend Boris due to his status. They could only choose to swallow their anger.
“A delivery man will always be a delivery man. Don’t think that just because you know a rich boss, you can turn over a new leaf and become a rich guy. I don’t have time to play with you guys…”
Seeing that no one said anything, Boris smiled faintly. After mocking Connor, he turned around and planned to leave.
“Boris, what do you mean by that?”
When Dominic heard Boris’s words, a trace of anger flashed across his eyes.
At this moment, he finally couldn’t take it anymore. He took a step forward and shouted at Boris.
Boris slowly raised his head and looked at Dominic, then said lightly, “Don’t you understand what I mean? Connor is just a lowly delivery man. Him inviting one sponsor means nothing. Perhaps he was lucky to have gotten to know him. Can a sponsor really represent Connor’s connections?”
“That’s right. Connor only got one sponsor to come, but Boris called more than ten sponsors today. There’s no way to compare!”
Boris’s lackeys hurriedly shouted.
“Although Connor only got one sponsor to come, this sponsor offered a sponsorship fee of one million! Boris, you got so many sponsors to come, but none of them seem to be able to come up with a million dollars in sponsorship fees, right?”
Spencer said.
“You’re right. None of the sponsors I called over can take out a million dollars in sponsorship fees, but the sponsorship fees I pulled in this time have already exceeded 1.5 million dollars.”
Boris said confidently.
When everyone heard Boris’s words, they were all stunned. It was rather awkward for them because they could not refute him.
“Who told you that I only invited one sponsor this time?”
But at this moment, Connor suddenly spoke.

chapters.title: Chapter 939: Connor McDonald Invited Me Here!
chapters.content:
Chapter 939: Connor McDonald Invited Me Here!
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
After hearing Connor’s words, everyone turned to look at Connor with a very puzzled expression.
They couldn’t understand what Connor meant.
“Connor, do you mean that you have other sponsors who aren’t here yet?”
Eunice was stunned for a moment before she asked Connor softly.
“Of course…”
Connor nodded lightly.
Before Carter appeared, Connor didn’t know if Thomas had helped him find someone.
However, when Carter appeared, Connor knew that Thomas must have done as he had asked.
At that time, Connor told Thomas to get a few sponsors to come to Porthampton University.
With Thomas’s influence, it was absolutely impossible for him to only get Carter, so Connor felt that there had to be other sponsors who were not here yet.
Connor didn’t plan to reveal this matter. After all, Carter was already so high-profile. If there were a few more, then Connor’s identity might be exposed.
However, Boris and the others were too arrogant, so Connor could not help but say this in advance.
“Connor, can you stop bragging?”
Boris frowned and shouted at Connor, then continued, “You’re already so lucky to be able to invite Carter Yones. How could you have possibly invited other sponsors?”
“Yeah, if you really have other sponsors, why aren’t they here yet? The school sports meet is about to start, and besides Carter Yones, we didn’t see anyone else, right?”
Boris’s friend said.
However, just as Boris finished speaking, a black Rolls-Royce slowly stopped at the entrance of the Porthampton University.
When Boris saw the black Rolls-Royce, he could not help but be stunned for a moment. A trace of shock flashed across his eyes.
Although the person in the car had not stepped out yet, Boris could tell from the license plate number that the person sitting in the car was Lenny Steinfeld, the president of Davenport’s famous Petrochemical Corporation.
Lenny was considered the richest man in Davenport. However, things were quiet for him the past two years. At the peak of his glory, Lenny bought a car plate with a number ending with five nines. Therefore, as long as people in Davenport saw a Rolls-Royce with a number ending with five nines, they would know that it was Lenny’s car.
Sometimes, the truly rich no longer had much pursuit for cars, because even a luxury car worth tens of millions could not show their status.
When everyone saw the Rolls-Royce with a number ending with five nines, they knew that Lenny had arrived.
“Why is Lenny Steinfeld here?”
Boris was the first to react and couldn’t help but gasp.
When the boy beside Boris heard what he said, he could not help but be stunned. Then, he frowned and asked, “Boris, are you talking about Lenny Steinfeld from Porthampton?”
“Who else could it be?”
Boris was irritated. Then, he subconsciously turned to look at Connor and thought to himself, ‘Don’t tell me Lenny Steinfeld was invited by Connor. That’s impossible. How could Connor know such a person?’
Connor didn’t know who Thomas had invited for him, so he stood quietly and looked at the Rolls-Royce. He didn’t take the initiative to welcome them.
When the students in the class saw how calm Connor was, they felt that there was no connection between Lenny and Connor. Otherwise, Connor would definitely not be so calm.
Boris had been staring at Connor. He naturally noticed this, so he eased up a little.
A moment later, the door of the Rolls-Royce was pushed open, and an old man in his seventies walked out of the car in a white suit.
After the old man got off the car, he began to look around as if he was looking for something.
“Grandpa Steinfeld, why are you here?”
However, at this moment, a voice sounded from the crowd.
When everyone heard this voice, they turned and saw Fergus hurriedly walking out from the crowd.
When the students present heard Fergus’s words, they seemed to ease up as well. This was because Fergus was taking the initiative to talk to Lenny, which meant that Lenny was probably a sponsor invited by Fergus.
Fergus’s family had a very powerful background. It was very normal for them to be able to invite someone like Lenny.
“I didn’t expect Fergus to be so influential. Not only did he invite the vice mayor, but he even invited someone like Lenny Steinfeld!”
“Yeah, Fergus is really amazing…”
“What can a mere Carter Yones do? In front of a person like Lenny Steinfeld, he’s just a nobody…”
Everyone present began to discuss in low voices.
However, these people might not know that Lenny was not invited by Fergus.
When Fergus learned that Carter was here, he could not help but be curious, so he took the time to go to the school gate to take a look.
However, he did not expect to see Lenny coming out of the car just as he walked out of the school gate.
Fergus’s family had business dealings with Lenny. Fergus had seen Lenny a few times, so he took the initiative to greet him.
“Oh, Fergus?”
When Lenny saw Fergus, he smiled faintly and asked softly, “Fergus, how’s your grandfather doing?”
“Thanks to you, he is doing well!”
Fergus hurriedly replied with a smile.
“That’s good, that’s good…”
Lenny nodded lightly.
After hesitating for a moment, Fergus asked Lenny softly, “Grandpa Steinfeld, why are you here today?”
“Isn’t your school holding a sports meet? I’m here to participate in the sports meet…”
Lenny said lightly.
“Then, Grandpa Steinfeld, who invited you here?”
Fergus hesitated for a moment before asking Lenny.
At this moment, Fergus was also extremely puzzled. He could not understand who on earth had such a great influence to be able to invite someone like Lenny over.
“Connor McDonald invited me here!”
Lenny replied with a smile.

chapters.title: Chapter 940: Two Million Sponsorship
chapters.content:
Chapter 940: Two Million Sponsorship
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
“Connor McDonald invite you here?”
When everyone present heard Lenny’s words, their mouths were wide open. They looked at this scene in a daze, and they were extremely shocked.
When everyone saw Fergus go up to welcome him, they all thought that Fergus was the one who invited Lenny, so they did not think of Connor.
However, no one expected Lenny to be invited by Connor!
Fergus was dumbfounded!
Boris was dumbfounded!
Everyone present was dumbfounded!
Previously, it was already unbelievable that Connor was able to invite Carter Yones.
However, no one expected that Connor would actually invite Lenny here!
Carter was from San Antonio, so these students were not very clear about his status. However, they were very clear about Lenny’s status.
They really could not understand how a poor loser like Connor knew someone like Lenny!
For a moment, everyone present was in shock.
The smile on Fergus’s face froze. Boris also stared at Connor, not knowing what to do.
Dominic, Spencer, Eunice, and the others turned to look at Connor.
“Connor, did you invite this person?”
Dominic stuttered as he asked Connor.
“I guess so!”
Connor nodded helplessly.
“Connor, how do you know such a person?”
“That’s right. Connor usually keeps a low profile, but he actually knows so many big shots…”
“Maybe Connor is a low-key rich guy?”
“How is that possible? Connor has always been delivering food. I don’t believe that he’s a rich guy…”
“What do you know? The rich guys nowadays are all low-key. Connor might be one of those low-rich guys!”
The surrounding students began to discuss softly.
“Connor?”
Fergus returned to his senses and asked Lenny in a low voice, “Grandpa Steinfeld, are you mistaken?”
“How could I be wrong?”
Lenny replied indifferently.
“There are many people called Connor McDonald in our school. I wonder which Connor McDonald you’re talking about?”
At this moment, Fergus felt that there was another explanation to this. He simply could not accept that a big shot that even he could not invite was actually invited by Connor.
Although this was his last school sports meet, Fergus would never allow anyone to steal his limelight.
Fergus had specially invited vice mayor Yonah for this sports meet. However, if Connor invited Lenny and Carter, and Connor was known as a poor delivery man, it was a shocking turn of events. At that time, people might not be talking about Fergus inviting vice mayor Yonah, but Connor inviting two billionaires.
“You don’t have to worry about that. Although I’ve never met Connor McDonald before, I have his photo in my hand.”
Lenny said with a smile.
“Grandpa Steinfeld, where is the photo?”
Fergus hurriedly asked.
When Lenny heard this, he hurriedly handed his phone to Fergus.
When Fergus saw the person in the photo, he was instantly dumbfounded. His mouth was wide open, and he did not know what to do.
Because the person in the photo was really Connor!
Fergus instantly felt suffocated!
Moreover, there was an even more important point. Lenny had just said that he had never met Connor.
Since they had not even met, it meant that Connor and Lenny did not know each other at all. Lenny came today because someone behind Connor was helping to contact him. This also proved that Connor’s identity and background were unknown to ordinary students.
“Mr. Steinfeld, he seems to be Connor McDonald!”
The driver behind Lenny also noticed Connor standing in the crowd and said softly.
“It really is!”
A hint of excitement flashed in Lenny’s eyes. Then, he quickly walked to Connor and said to Connor with a smile, “Connor, I’m Lenny Steinfeld, the president of the Davenport Petrochemical Corporation. I was invited to participate in your school’s sports meet…”
“Alright!”
Connor looked at Lenny and nodded expressionlessly. Then, he said to the students behind him, “Bring Mr. Steinfeld in!”
“Alright…”
Eunice had yet to recover from Carter’s shock. Now that Lenny had arrived, she did not know how to describe her feelings.
Everyone looked at Connor with utter shock.
No one expected that the most shocking person in this school sports meet would be Connor, who usually looked very low-key.
It was because Connor was usually too low-key that these people present were so shocked.
“Boris, do you think this Lenny Steinfeld might be a fake?”
The guy beside Boris hesitated for a moment before asking Boris seriously.
“Get lost, you dumbass…”
Boris looked at the guy beside him and cursed with an unusually irritated expression.
On the other side, Eunice brought Lenny to the registration area and filled in his information.
Lenny did not need Eunice’s reminder at all. He took out a check worth two million and said softly, “This is the sponsorship fee!”
“Mr. Lenny Steinfeld, the president of Davenport Petrochemical Corporation, has sponsored the two million dollars for the sports meet!”
Following that, another voice came from the broadcast.
When the broadcast sounded, the students in the school fell into shock again!
No one had expected such big news to appear before the school sports meet even started.
First, Carter’s one million dollars, and now Lenny’s two million dollars. This was insane especially for ordinary students.
Eunice stood next to Lenny in a daze. Her expression was one of disbelief. For a moment, she did not know what to do.
Eunice really couldn’t understand how an ordinary student like Connor could invite so many big bosses!
Moreover, the sponsorship fees that these bosses took out were actually in the millions!
This was the first time something like this had happened in the Porthampton University!
Of course, the most shocked ones were the higher-ups in the school.
After all, these people had just settled down Carter, and now there was another Lenny, who had sponsored two million dollars.
The higher-ups of the school ran toward the school gate one after another, afraid that they would make Lenny upset.

chapters.title: Chapter 941: Rachel's Purpose
chapters.content:
Chapter 941: Rachel’s Purpose
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Actually, since Carter sponsored him with one million, Connor knew that he couldn’t hide his identity anymore.
After all, anyone with a bit of intelligence could see what was going on.
But he thought it was for the best, considering he had endured too much ridicule and humiliation in this school.
However, he saw this as an opportunity to make everyone realize how foolish they were to mock him initially!
Now he could finally hold his head high, and his friends wouldn’t have to suffer ridicule from others because of him.
As Rachel said, Connor would probably spend less time at school in the future, so he might as well use this opportunity to resolve his inner conflicts.
Fergus hesitated for two seconds, then walked over to Lenny and asked in a low voice, “Grandpa Lenny, how were you invited by Connor?”
Lenny glanced at Fergus. He was instructed by Thomas not to expose Connor’s identity.
Naturally, he wouldn’t reveal the truth but simply said, “Fergus, there are some things you shouldn’t inquire about…”
“I…”
After hearing Lenny’s words, Fergus’s expression appeared awkward. He stood there, unsure of what to do.
A moment later, Eunice walked into the school with Lenny, and the school leaders came out to greet them.
Rachel, the host of the sports event, was in the dressing room, unaware of what was happening outside.
She only heard that the vice mayor Yonah and several wealthy tycoons were invited to the school sports event.
Rachel didn’t know if the vice mayor Yonah was invited by Connor, but she was certain that the wealthy tycoons were.
“Connor, I hope you don’t blame me. Only by exposing your identity at Porthampton University that you won’t waste time here anymore. This way, you can focus on dealing with Rockefeller’s people!”
Rachel sighed lightly while applying makeup, not knowing what was happening outside.
In fact, when she initially asked him to find some wealthy sponsors, it wasn’t about saving face for his classmates.
Her true goal was to expose his identity. Once Connor’s identity was exposed, the students in the school would know that he was a rich heir, and Connor wouldn’t be able to stay in school anymore. Then, he might not have to wait until graduation to take over the company.
Connor had a lot of time now, but Rachel didn’t have as much time to spend with him here.
Meanwhile, at the entrance of Porthampton University…
When Lenny entered the school, the school sports event was about to begin.
There were less than five minutes left until the opening of the sports event, so everyone thought there wouldn’t be any more commotion from Connor’s side. They started packing up and preparing to return to school.
“Connor, do you have any more sponsors coming?”
One of Connor’s female classmates cautiously asked him.
Perhaps because Connor invited Lenny and Carter, both who were influential figures, the attitude of his classmates towards him had undergone a drastic change. They spoke to him with great respect.
“No, that’s it…”
Connor waved his hand without hesitation.
Although he knew that there would be more people coming, he didn’t want to bring in any more at this point.
It would be troublesome if things escalated.
Since most people were getting ready to leave, Connor naturally took this opportunity to return as well. Once the sports event started, no one would be able to come in even if they wanted to.
If everyone knew what he was thinking, they would definitely be very surprised.
After all, no matter who it was, they wouldn’t complain about finding too many sponsors. And now, Connor actually planned to reject those sponsors who took the initiative to send money. This was really unbelievable.
After Fergus, Boris, and the others knew that Connor did not have any more sponsors, they heaved a long sigh of relief. The expressions on their faces were obviously much more relaxed.
Although it was already unbelievable that Connor invited Lenny and Carter, they were just two rich people. Naturally, they could not outshine Fergus’s deputy mayor and the director of the Cultural Bureau.
This time, Connor was in the limelight, but compared to Fergus, he was still a little weaker.
Fergus’s thoughts at this time were actually very simple. As long as Connor did not completely suppress his limelight, it would be fine. If Connor really called a few more rich people over, then his limelight might really be stolen by Connor.
As for Boris, he was completely dumbfounded.
The two people Connor invited were a hundred times better than the ten people he invited. The sponsorship fees they gathered were not on the same level, so Boris’s expression was still a little ugly.
Connor started to pack up with his classmates and prepared to return to school as soon as possible to end everything.
However, just as he was about to turn around and return to school, a black Mercedes-Benz suddenly stopped at the school gate.
A middle-aged man hurriedly got out of the car and shouted, “I’m sorry, students. Do you know a person called Connor?”
Fergus, Boris, and the others had just walked into the school. However, after hearing this, the two of them turned around and looked at the middle-aged man at the same time.
“Yorick Stefan, Chairman of Wonder Cooperation?”
Fergus saw the middle-aged man and exclaimed in disbelief.
“Are you here as a sponsor for the school sports event?” one of Connor’s classmates whispered to Yorick.
“Yeah, I was invited by Connor!” Yorick quickly replied.
Upon hearing his words, Fergus felt a jolt in his heart, his expression turning extremely unpleasant.
As for Boris, his facial expression looked as if he had eaten something disgusting.
No one had expected that Connor would have more sponsors coming.
Connor turned his head and glanced at Yorick, sighing softly in his heart, realizing that he had been a step too slow.
Upon seeing Connor, Yorick hurriedly ran up to him, saying excitedly, “Connor, I’m really sorry. The road at the school gate was congested, so I arrived a bit late…”
“It’s… it’s okay…” Connor replied helplessly, inwardly sighing, “Just how many people did Thomas find for me that there’s already traffic outside.”

chapters.title: Chapter 942: Big Shots Gathering
chapters.content:
Chapter 942: Big Shots Gathering
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Connor might not know that Thomas had only managed to bring three sponsors for him this time.
Moreover, Thomas had requested these sponsors not to reveal Connor’s identity. They were not allowed to address him as Mr. Connor or discuss business matters. The sponsorship fee was also limited to one million.
However, these people didn’t know Connor at all. So Thomas gave them Connor’s photos to facilitate their search for him.
But what he didn’t expect was that this matter was leaked and spread among the upper class society in the four provinces.
Connor’s photos were shared widely, and many wealthy businessmen who had wanted to meet him now had the opportunity.
Naturally, these bosses didn’t want to miss this chance, so they drove to Porthampton University one after another.
Connor helplessly glanced at Yorick. He knew that these people came to give him face, so he had to let his classmates lead Yorick into the school.
Just like Lenny, Yorick had also sponsored two million.
But this was just the beginning.
Following that, a large group of middle-aged men in suits rushed to the entrance of Porthampton University.
Since the road at the entrance was completely blocked, these people had to run there.
“Starlightning Cable Corporation Chairman sponsors the school sports meet with 500,000!”
“Porthampton Canics Corporation General Manager sponsors the school sports meet with one million!”
“Webrews New Energy Corporation Chairman sponsors the school sports meet with two million!”
…
For a while, voices like these echoed throughout the campus.
At this moment, Porthampton University didn’t feel like it was hosting a sports meet. It resembled a large-scale bidding party instead.
The leaders of the university were naturally busy. They never expected that there would be so many wealthy sponsors this year, so they gathered at the school gate to welcome them.
The students of the university also knew that all these sponsors came because of one person.
And that person was Connor!
Almost twenty wealthy individuals from the four provinces entered Porthampton University.
The sponsorship fees they offered had already reached tens of millions. The leaders of the university were overjoyed, and their gazes towards Connor were like they were looking at the God of Wealth.
Fergus and Boris stood dumbfounded in place. They felt like they were dreaming, as everything seemed so unreal.
Even Fergus didn’t have such power before!
“Who is this Connor?”
Fergus gritted his teeth and murmured.
…
Boris was also helpless as he didn’t know what to do.
“Connor, on behalf of the school, I want to thank you!”
At that moment, the vice principal ran to Connor’s side, grabbed his hand, and exclaimed excitedly.
“It’s… it’s nothing. It’s something I should do…”
Connor looked at the vice principal in front of him, helplessly replying. He couldn’t help but sigh inwardly, “Money really can change many things.”
“Connor, I know there are still many sponsors waiting for you, but don’t worry. We will receive them one by one. I’ve already informed the host to delay the opening ceremony until nine o’clock. Please don’t worry!”
The vice principal knew that these bosses coming in would bring millions in sponsorship fees, so how could he miss such a great opportunity?
Meanwhile, Connor looked at the street in front of the school gate with a face full of helplessness, his expression on the verge of collapse.
He knew that the street at the entrance of Porthampton University had already been blocked by luxury cars. If this continued, the school’s sports meet wouldn’t be able to start today. It would take three days and nights just to accommodate all these people!
“Who exactly is this Connor?”
“Yeah, so many luxury cars are blocking our school gate…”
“It’s truly unbelievable. Could all these luxury cars be here for just one person, Connor?”
The students present wore puzzled expressions, unable to understand the situation.
“Principal, you handle the reception here. I’ll make a phone call…”
Connor whispered to the vice principal beside him.
“Sure, you go ahead. Don’t worry about this side; I’ll take care of it…”
The vice principal said with a smile.
A trace of helplessness flashed in Connor’s eyes, and he quickly walked to a secluded place, took out his phone, and dialed Thomas’s number.
“Ring, ring…”
After two rings, Thomas answered the call and softly asked, “Mr. Connor, is there something you need?”
“Thomas, what are you doing? I told you before to just bring a few people, but now all the wealthy individuals from our Eastern Jiang Province have come. They’ve completely blocked the street at our school gate…”
Connor exclaimed in a frustrated tone.
“How is that possible? I only invited three people that day, and I didn’t tell anyone else!”
Thomas replied in a low voice.
“Someone must have leaked the information. I don’t care what methods you use, but quickly bring back these people to me!”
Connor lowered his voice and shouted.
“Okay, I’ll go and bring back these people right away. Mr. Connor, you don’t need to worry!”
Thomas replied in a low voice.
“Also, you don’t need to blame them. After all, these people came here because of me. It wouldn’t be good to blame them. Tell them that I’ll invite them for a meal when there’s an opportunity. But this time, there are just too many people, and the impact is very bad. Let them all disperse!”
Connor said slowly.
“Alright, alright, it was my negligence. I’ll handle it right away!”
After saying this, Thomas hung up the phone directly.
Connor put down his phone and looked at the congested street in front of him. He couldn’t help but feel deeply moved.
At this moment, not only were there many luxury cars parked on the street, but also many people. Some bosses couldn’t wait and rushed out of their cars, walking towards the entrance of the school.
The students inside the school were naturally very curious and gathered at the school gate, witnessing this unprecedented grand scene.
After so many years, Porthampton University had encountered this situation for the first time. The school gate was actually blocked by luxury cars.
Some students directly picked up their phones and started recording videos to post online.

chapters.title: Chapter 943: Isn't Five Million Enough?
chapters.content:
Chapter 943: Isn’t Five Million Enough?
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
When the students of Porthampton University posted the video online, it instantly caused a great sensation.
The online users were also shocked by the scene.
“Who are these people? They have such a presence!”
“Yeah, they must be rich heirs to invite so many billionaires!”
“I think I saw a limited edition Rolls-Royce Phantom. It must be worth at least fifty million. They’re so wealthy!”
“I heard that a delivery student from Porthampton University invited these people…”
“Don’t be ridiculous, how can a delivery student have such influence?”
“They must be extraordinary students, probably low-key super-rich heir.”
“Oh, if only I could get to know this super-rich heir, I would definitely win them over.”
“With such a grand scene, I wonder if it will attract the attention of the police!”
“Do you know who those people sitting in the cars are? Even the police dare not provoke them casually.”
On the internet, netizens started a heated discussion.
Meanwhile, the protagonist of this incident, Connor, stood alone at a distance, observing the congested street as if waiting for Thomas to handle the matter.
But he knew that because there were so many bosses who had come, it would take some time for Thomas to handle it. For now, he could only wait quietly.
“Connor, who are you really?”
Just at that moment, a voice came from behind him.
He instinctively turned his head and was surprised to see it was Lindsy.
“Who am I?”
He looked at her and paused for a moment.
“Yes, who are you? How could you invite so many bosses? Weren’t you an orphan? Are you lying to me?”
She frowned and spoke.
At this moment, Lindsy seemed to have figured out why Connor had been so calm when he learned about Jovan’s identity. If all these people had come because of him, then how powerful was his influence?
Connor indeed had the capital to ignore Jovan!
“I didn’t lie to you. My parents really passed away a long time ago. As for why these people came, I’m not sure…”
Connor didn’t have the mood to explain these things to Lindsy now, so he just casually said a few words.
“These people came for you, and now you’re saying you don’t know why they came. Do you think I’m stupid?” she shouted at him in a low voice.
Connor slowly raised his head and looked at Lindsy expressionlessly. He said, “Actually, I’m a super-rich heir, and these people came to please me. Are you satisfied with this answer?”
“You…”
She stared at him in front of her and instantly fell silent. Her expression was speechless, not knowing what to say.
But he didn’t continue to say anything to her. He stood up slowly and walked forward.
It must be said that Thomas’s efficiency was quite fast. In less than five minutes, more than half of the cars changed direction and turned back.
However, there were still some stubborn bosses who chose to approach Connor.
One after another, prestigious bosses walked into the gate of Porthampton University.
Any one of these bosses was worth over a billion. The small bosses with less than a billion had no qualification to enter.
All these bosses came to greet Connor before entering the campus.
This indicated that these people had indeed come for him.
It seemed as if in that moment, Porthampton University had gathered all the wealthy people in Davenport. Surprisingly, their sponsorship fees were all the same, one million.
Although it was only one million, with so many people contributing, it amounted to nearly fifty million.
A total sponsorship of fifty million!
It was like a myth at Porthampton University!
The five hundred thousand sponsorship from Fergus seemed insignificant compared to Connor’s presence!
Everyone’s attention was focused on Connor alone, and their expressions were extremely complex.
Surprise, confusion, disbelief, jealousy, envy…
Various emotions converged.
No one could have imagined that a poor and ordinary person like him would suddenly transform into such a terrifyingly influential second-generation rich individual.
And at this moment, Connor seemed to have grown accustomed to this feeling. He stood there expressionless, as if he had calmly accepted everything. He knew deep down that he might not be able to stay at Porthampton University any longer.
It dawned on Connor that he had been deceived by Rachel. She wanted to make sure he couldn’t continue his stay at Porthampton University.
Boris looked at Connor’s position, and finally understood why he had been so arrogant before.
Meanwhile, Fergus’s body continued to tremble as he tried to reassure himself.
No matter what, Connor was just a delivery driver. Such a person had no qualifications to compete with him for Lindsy.
After nearly half an hour, the entrance of Porthampton University finally quieted down. Most of the wealthy individuals chose to leave, while those who stayed entered the campus.
“Oh, Connor, do you have any more sponsors coming?”
Principal Wanner walked up to Connor with a smile and asked.
“Isn’t fifty million in sponsorship enough?”
Connor knew exactly what Principal Wanner was thinking and responded coldly.
“It’s enough, it’s enough…”
He nodded hastily.
“If it’s enough, why are you still standing here? Hurry up and prepare for the opening ceremony!”
Connor said in a low voice.
“Alright, I’ll go prepare for the opening ceremony now…”
Principal Wanner nodded and turned towards the school.
Fergus, Boris, and the other students present knew that today’s spectacle had finally come to an end, so they also prepared to leave.
But at that moment, a black business car arrived at the entrance of Porthampton University.
Upon seeing the car, Connor’s expression became displeased.
He had already instructed Thomas not to let anyone else come, yet there were still ignorant people showing up. If this continued, when would the commotion end?
So Connor had made up his mind. Regardless of who came this time, they would be sent away. He wouldn’t allow this person to enter the campus.
The others stopped in their tracks when they saw the business car, their eyes filled with confusion.
After all, compared to the luxury cars, this business car seemed rather ordinary.

chapters.title: Chapter 944: Tiffany Arrives
chapters.content:
Chapter 944: Tiffany Arrives
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
After a while, the business sedan slowly stopped at the entrance of Porthampton University.
Connor walked directly towards the position of the sedan.
“Click!”
The door of the car opened, and a stylish beautiful woman was the first to step out of the car. She smiled at Connor and said, “Mr. Connor, long time no see!”
“You are…”
Connor looked at the beautiful woman in front of him and felt a sense of familiarity. He couldn’t help but pause for a moment.
“Connor, it’s me!”
Immediately after, a tall and sexy beauty walked out of the car. Although she was wearing sunglasses, he could tell from her voice that the woman who walked out of the car at this moment was the famous actress Tiffany that he had met at the resort.
At this moment, Tiffany wore a pair of black sunglasses on her face, a blue short dress, and her already tall and sexy figure seemed even more prominent under the dress. She exuded an irresistible charm all over her body. Her delicate and fair face was lightly made up, her eyes were captivating, the short skirt wrapped around her enticing hip curves, and her long and fair legs were exposed in the air. She wore a pair of red high-heeled shoes.
“Tiffany?”
Connor said in surprise.
“Yes, it’s me!”
Tiffany directly took off her sunglasses from her face.
Tiffany’s enchanting figure, charming face, and delicate skin gave a very attractive and sexy feeling. Especially with her exquisite oval face, she gave a very pleasing appearance.
When the students present saw Tiffany, they were all stunned in place, with expressions of disbelief on their faces.
“Is that the famous actress Tiffany?”
“Yeah, I didn’t expect Connor to be so powerful. He even invited the famous actress Tiffany. Who is this Connor?”
“Why didn’t we realize that Connor had such great abilities back then?”
The crowd began to whisper quietly.
As for Fergus and Boris, their expressions were extremely ugly!
In fact, after Tiffany and Connor separated, she had always regretted not seizing the rare opportunity of Connor. So she had been looking for news about him.
Yesterday, when she learned that his school was going to hold a sports event, she directly cancelled all her appointments and specially came to participate in his school sports event. She had only one goal, which was to leave a good impression on him.
During this period, Tiffany, claiming to be Connor’s friend, had gained numerous resources. Various big producers and directors had actively approached her, wanting her to appear in their movies.
She felt that she already enjoyed such treatment just by leveraging Connor’s name. If she could become Connor’s girlfriend, what would it feel like?
So at this moment, she had made up her mind to make a move on him.
Although she was older than him, she believed that she was superior to the young girls in terms of figure and appearance. Moreover, she was a big star herself, with such an aura surrounding her, so she should have some advantages.
“Why did you come here?”
Connor’s attitude towards Tiffany was not very enthusiastic. Instead, he asked her with some coldness.
“I came to participate in the sports meeting!”
Tiffany smiled and replied, “I have already talked to the leaders of your school. I’m going to perform for your school’s event for free!”
“That’s right, that’s right. Connor, I just received the news!”
Principal Wanner hurriedly walked to Connor’s side and said with a smile.
Connor looked at Tiffany’s expression and seemed somewhat helpless, but now that Tiffany had come, he had no way to refuse.
So he could only nod helplessly and whispered, “Since that’s the case, let’s go in quickly!”
The crowd looked at him, their expressions extremely puzzled.
Because they couldn’t understand why he would know such a big star like Tiffany, and why she treated him with such enthusiasm while he seemed indifferent, giving the impression that he was the big star and she was the fan.
Fergus stood at a distance, watching Connor, his face turning extremely red, as if he had been slapped.
Tiffany and those wealthy individuals all came for Connor. Who exactly was Connor?
Even the people who knew Connor before had a significantly changed attitude towards him. They felt that the young man standing in front of them now didn’t seem like the Connor they knew.
“Mr. Fergus, I don’t think it’s a big deal. No matter how many wealthy celebrities Connor brings, what difference does it make? After all, vice mayor Yonah is here this time, and the combined influence of all the people he brought is not as great as him!”
Boris whispered to Fergus.
“We have wealthy celebrities coming, but who knows if Connor knows any big shots in the political sphere!”
Another student beside Boris muttered in a low voice.
“Can’t you shut your mouth if you don’t know how to speak? Stop being a jinx here!”
Boris yelled angrily, glaring at him.
“Boris, I’m not making things up. It seems like someone is really coming…”
The student widened his eyes, looking at the street ahead, his expression filled with disbelief.
“Are you freaking crazy? No one is coming! Who would come?”
Boris shouted at the top of his lungs.
“Look at the license plate of that Toyota sedan. Isn’t it the person Connor invited?”
The student pointed to a Toyota sedan not far away, stuttering as he spoke.
At this moment, Fergus also squinted his eyes and looked at the Toyota sedan not far away, his gaze filled with confusion and puzzlement. He didn’t know who was inside the car or if it was really meant for Connor.
After a while, the Toyota sedan slowly stopped at the entrance of the school, and a middle-aged man stepped out of the car.
When Fergus saw this middle-aged man, he was dumbfounded, his mouth agape, unable to utter a word.
The surrounding students also seemed to have noticed this middle-aged man and turned their heads to look.
“How is this possible? What is going on? I must be dreaming. This can’t be real!”
Fergus shouted in an excited and agitated tone as if he had gone crazy.

chapters.title: Chapter 945: Who Is He?
chapters.content:
Chapter 945: Who Is He?
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
After seeing this middle-aged man, everyone was dumbfounded, mouths wide open, and their expressions were extremely shocked.
Although most people knew this middle-aged man, there were still some who didn’t recognize him.
Boris had never seen this middle-aged man before, so he turned his head and asked Fergus, “Fergus, who is this person? His car looks quite ordinary, so he shouldn’t be someone important, right?”
“This person is Cade Lambert, the Deputy director of the Bureau of Industry and Commerce in San Franciso. The person following him is Wellhem Wale, the Deputy director of the Bureau of Culture!” Fergus said through clenched teeth.
After hearing his words, Boris was instantly dumbfounded and didn’t know what to do.
“These two people can’t both be invited by Connor, right?” said a male student next to Boris, frowning.
Fergus remained silent, squinting his eyes. He wanted to see if Cade and Wellhem recognized Connor. If these two people didn’t know him, then it would be fine. But if they were really here for him, it would be big trouble.
After all, Fergus had only invited the Deputy Mayor and the Director of the Porthampton Bureau of Culture. But Connor had directly called people from the provincial level, which was a completely different level!
Under Fergus’s gaze, Cade and Wellhem walked straight towards Connor’s location.
When he saw this scene, he almost fainted because he felt that these two people might really be here for Connor.
As expected, Cade walked directly in front of Connor and smiled as he said, “Connor, we meet again!”
“Mr. Cade, you actually came too?” Connor was stunned for a moment and asked Cade in a low voice.
“Yes, with such a grand sports event at Porthampton University, I naturally had to come and have a look. Oh, let me introduce you. This is Wellhem, the Deputy director of the Bureau of Culture!” Cade said with a smile.
“Hello, Connor!” Wellhem quickly reached out his right hand to shake hands with Connor.
Seeing Wellhem taking the initiative to greet Connor, the people present already understood what was going on!
These two people were here for Connor!
Tiffany, Principal Wanner, and others around Connor were also shocked but quickly took the initiative to exchange greetings with Cade and the others.
This was the first time Porthampton University had encountered such heavyweight guests!
Due to the special status of Cade and Wellhem, the reception was cautious, and the conversations were only ordinary greetings. But even so, it revealed a lot of information.
Although Connor didn’t want Cade to appear, it was already too late. Connor had no choice but to follow the others and walk toward the school.
Fergus stood dumbfounded in place, looking at Connor’s back. At this moment, Fergus realized that he had lost, and he had lost completely!
The people Fergus had invited were nothing compared to the people Connor had invited!
“Who is this Connor anyway?” Boris muttered in confusion.
Lindsy stood at a distance, staring at Connor’s back, and all her doubts were resolved.
Connor indeed had the capital to disregard Jovan because even Jovan’s father treated him with such respect. So what could Jovan, a mere Jovan, be in Connor’s eyes?
Previously, Lindsy had been worried that he had offended Jovan and that Jovan would surely find a way to retaliate against him. But now she realized that her worries were unnecessary, and she understood why Connor had been so confident!
But what puzzled her now was who exactly he was.
Why could he invite so many big shots to come and participate in Porthampton University’s sports event?
Originally, everyone thought that Connor was just an ordinary delivery guy, and even Connor’s classmates like Boris and Fergus didn’t pay much attention to him. But now they realized how foolish their previous thoughts were!
Especially Eunice, she didn’t know how to describe her feelings anymore.
…
Connor followed Cade, Willhem and the others into the school, and the university sports event was about to begin.
Because of the sponsors Connor had invited, most of them were billionaires, so naturally, these people were arranged in the best seats. The sponsors invited by others were placed further back since the sponsor seats were limited.
This made Boris, Fergus, and others extremely angry because they had worked hard to invite sponsors, but now they had to make room for Connor’s sponsors. They felt very uncomfortable, but it was the school’s rule, and they had no choice but to accept it.
Moreover, there was another important point: the sponsors invited by Fergus and Boris were originally supposed to speak at the university sports event, but now all those opportunities were taken by Connor’s sponsors.
This caused dissatisfaction among those sponsors. Some even left angrily, and Boris and Fergus could do nothing about it. After all, the school didn’t care about them. What they truly cared about were the super-rich sponsors brought in by Connor.
At 9 o’clock in the morning.
The graceful figure of Rachel walked onto the central stage of the stadium.
She was wearing a red dress today, and her already well-proportioned figure looked even more enticing in the dress. She exuded an irresistible charm from head to toe.
She walked to the center of the stage, extended her fair and delicate hand, picked up the microphone on the host’s podium, and exuded a noble temperament with every move. Everyone in the audience focused their attention on her, completely ignoring the male co-host standing beside her.
Meanwhile, Connor squinted his eyes as he looked at Rachel’s position, his expression calm but filled with anger deep inside.
The reason was simple. He knew that all of this was Rachel’s doing. It was her who had asked him to find sponsors.
Connor trusted Thomas, so it was impossible for him to leak his whereabouts. The only person who knew about this was Rachel.
So the news about Connor needing sponsors must have been leaked by Rachel.
But he couldn’t understand why she would do such a thing. He planned to find an opportunity to clarify this matter!

chapters.title: Chapter 946: Let The Games Begin!
chapters.content:
Chapter 946: Let The Games Begin!
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
On the field.
Rachel stood in the center of the stage, exuding grace. She briefly introduced the big guests who were present. Of course, these guests had all been invited by Connor alone—all the other sponsors that were invited by others were not qualified to be introduced by Rachel.
After introducing the guests, it was time for the guest speeches.
Although the guests present were not prepared, they were already used to such an occasion.
Therefore, when they went on stage to give a speech, he also acted naturally.
After about half an hour, the guests had finished speaking, and the school sports meet had officially begun.
The students in the school also ran to their corresponding locations to prepare for the competitions.
Eunice Tanner hesitated for a moment before she walked over to Connor’s side and whispered to him, “Connor, you’re participating in a total of four events. Three of them will be held later on.”
Connor’s thoughts were interrupted by Eunice’s words. He turned his head and whispered, “There should be enough time to make it to all of them…”
“If you can’t make it in time, you can choose to give up. After all, you called over so many sponsors today. It shouldn’t matter even if you give up!” Eunice reminded Connor softly.
“Why give up? It’s just a few matches. It’s nothing to me!”
Connor smiled faintly. At this time, Connor did not seem to be in the mood to consider these questions at all. After all, his mind was filled with reasons as to why Rachel wanted to expose his identity. What was her goal?
“Since you don’t have any questions, that’s good…”
Eunice took a deep breath and nodded lightly.
At this moment, a voice suddenly sounded from the broadcast on the sports field.
“Students who are participating in the 100-meter sprint, please gather at Fielr No. 5!”
The 100-meter race was the most eye-catching event in the school sports meet because it was the quickest and most exciting event. Naturally, such an event had to be placed at the beginning of the school sports meet as the opening show.
“Connor, the match is about to start. I’ll take you to the venue!”
Eunice said to Connor.
“Sure!”
Connor nodded his head lightly and then walked directly towards Field No. 5.
Connor had always used this time to deliver food during the previous school sports meet, so he had never participated in it. Naturally, he was not very familiar with the general processes of the event. If it wasn’t for Eunice leading the way, Connor might not even have found the competition venue.
After arriving at the competition venue, Eunice helped Connor register with the student-in-charge, and then got Connor a number.
Under normal circumstances, students who came to participate in the 100-meter race would wear their preferred sportswear, shoes, and the like. After all, these things could allow you to perform at your best. The number issued by the school would be pasted on your back.
However, Connor was an exception. At this time, Connor was wearing a casual suit. He didn’t even have the most important nail shoes for sprinting, let alone professional sportswear. At this time, Connor was only wearing a pair of canvas shoes.
Therefore, when the other sprinting students saw Connor’s outfit, they all showed a puzzled expression. After all, it was the first time they saw someone appear in the 100-meter sprint like this.
However, these people also knew that Connor was in the talk of the school today. So many sponsors had been invited by Connor alone, which meant that Connor definitely had some background. These people did not dare to take the initiative to mock Connor.
If it was in the past, those students would have already thought of ways to mock Connor.
At this moment, a boy took the initiative to walk in front of Connor and said to Connor with a smile, “Connor, did you not prepare any sportswear and shoes?”
“No…”
Connor lightly shook his head.
When Eunice heard the boy’s words, a trace of nervousness flashed across her eyes. Only then did she realize that she had not prepared any sportswear for Connor.
“I still have a spare set over there. Why don’t you go see if they suit you? If they do, I can lend them to you!” the boy continued.
After all, Connor was now a celebrity in the school. It was normal for someone to take the initiative to curry favor with him.
“…”
Eunice quickly turned her head to look at the boy, a trace of gratitude flashing in her eyes. After all, if Connor really participated in the competition like this, it would be a little too funny.
However, before Eunice could agree, Connor shook his head and refused.
“No need. I think my current clothes are quite good!”
“Connor, you can’t change into sportswear, but you should at least change into nail shoes. After all, they can help you run faster…”
Eunice quickly reminded him softly.
“I’m already a fast runner…”
Connor looked at Eunice with a faint smile and rejected her again.
Eunice looked at Connor’s expression and felt helpless. However, she thought about how Connor had already called so many sponsors today. The students in the class did not dare to look down on Connor. So, even if Connor really got the last place later, it should not matter.
She did not continue to say anything after that
The others felt that Connor was only here to go through the motions and not to participate in the sports meet for the sake of ranking, so they did not continue to persuade Connor.
At this moment, a man in white sportswear walked onto the track.
When the man appeared, everyone gathered around him and took the initiative to chat with him.
On the school’s big screen, there was a close-up of this man, and in an instant, deafening cheers came from the field.
This man was none other than Fergus Long!
Although Connor had stolen Fergus’s limelight at the school gate just now, Fergus was still the president of Porthampton University’s student council. He was handsome and came from a wealthy family. He was also the champion of the 100-meter sprint in the past two years, so Fergus was very popular.
Fergus simply greeted everyone, then narrowed his eyes and looked at Connor. A strange look flashed across his eyes.
Fergus didn’t believe that Connor really was going to participate in all four events, but now that he saw Connor appear on the field, he knew that it was true.

chapters.title: Chapter 947: 100-Meter Sprint
chapters.content:
Chapter 947: 100-Meter Sprint
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
After Fergus stood in his position, he sized up Connor.
When he saw Connor wearing a set of casual clothes, he couldn’t help but sneer. He sighed in his heart. “He doesn’t even have proper sportswear. It seems that Connor is here to embarrass himself. I may not be as good as you in terms of connections, but no one can compare to me in track and field!”
It was normal for Fergus to think this way. After all, Fergus was very good at track and field events. Moreover, the 100-meter sprint and the high jump were the two events that Fergus was best at.
Therefore, Fergus was the most eye-catching one in every school sports meet. Whenever he appeared on the field, he would receive the most enthusiastic applause and cheers.
Just now, Connor had invited so many sponsors over. In terms of momentum, he could definitely crush Fergus. However, Fergus was confident that he could crush Connor in this competition. In this way, it could be considered a draw. Fergus did not feel particularly inferior to him.
On the other side, Eunice saw that Connor had nothing to do, so she took the initiative to introduce the rules of the 100-meter sprint to Connor.
The 100-meter sprint competition was actually very simple. More than 50 participating students were divided into five groups. Each group had about ten people. The top two would advance to the finals.
The finals would be held after the group stage. Therefore, the truly powerful students would not use their full strength in the group stage. They would try their best to conserve their strength as long as they could advance to the finals.
Most of the students were warming up, while Connor stood there expressionlessly. No one knew what he was thinking.
When Eunice saw Connor’s state, she was more or less worried.
In fact, Eunice did not have much hope for Connor. She felt that as long as Connor didn’t come in last, it would be fine. As for him advancing to the finals, that was simply something that she did not dare to think about.
The group matches were carried out by drawing lots, so no one knew what opponents they would encounter.
Soon after, the announcer announced the number of the first group participating in the sprint, and all the students were ready.
Two minutes later, the starting pistol was fired, and the first group match of the 100-meter sprint finally began. Deafening cheers instantly erupted from around the field.
After the first round of the group competition, the second round followed.
At this moment, the students in the school were watching the game through the big screen on the field. If there were many matches, the two big screens would be split into four and play all four matches simultaneously.
However, the 100-meter sprint was a single competition, so the content on the two big screens was the same.
The second group match was very eye-catching because Fergus was there.
Sure enough, when Fergus appeared in front of the camera, the field erupted into cheers again.
The match started very quickly, but it ended very quickly as well.
Fergus used his overwhelming strength to take first place without any suspense. Moreover, he won very easily, as if he had used less than half of his strength.
Tamia, who was sitting in the audience, turned her head to look at Lindsy and sighed softly. “Fergus seems to be even better than last year. He might even be able to break the school’s record of 10.08 seconds!”
“It’s definitely possible!”
Lindsy seemed to agree and nodded lightly.
Dominic, who was beside the two of them, shouted loudly. “I don’t care if Fergus can break the school record. What I care about now is whether Connor will get the last place…”
“Yeah, I hope Connor doesn’t come in last. Otherwise, all his acting at the school gate would be in vain…” Spencer quickly said.
“You don’t have to worry about that. Connor will definitely be the last. Look at all the running participants. Who else is wearing casual jeans apart from Connor? If Connor doesn’t come in last place, I’d find it very surprising. This is simply a joke…”
Lindsy didn’t hold back at all as she spoke directly.
Dominic and Spencer were helpless after hearing Tamia’s words. They took a deep breath and didn’t know how to retort.
Tamia seemed to have suddenly thought of something. She turned her head and asked Dominic softly, “By the way, Dominic, you two have known Connor for so long. Who is he? How did he manage to invite so many sponsors?”
When Lindsy heard this, a trace of curiosity flashed across her eyes as she hurriedly looked at Dominic.
“This…”
A trace of hesitation flashed in Dominic’s eyes. After all, Connor had specially instructed him not to expose his identity, so he did not know how to explain it.
“Actually, the two of us don’t know Connor very well. There are some things that he won’t tell us, so we don’t know who he is. If you’re curious, you can ask Connor yourself…” Spencer responded quickly.
“I’m not very close to Connor. He won’t tell me even if I ask him!” Tamia pouted and said lightly.
At this moment, Dominic suddenly interrupted this topic. “Connor’s match seems to be starting soon!”
Everyone looked up at the big screen and saw that Connor had already walked to the starting line and was waiting quietly.
Connor’s attire was a little too different from the other athletes around him. The Porthampton University had held so many sports events, but this was the first time they had seen someone dressed like this to participate in a sprinting competition. Therefore, the students in the school were inevitably a little surprised.
After these students knew Connor’s identity, they felt that Connor might be here to cause trouble, so they didn’t pay too much attention to it.
“Bang!”
At this moment, a gunshot sounded.
All the students on the track started running at the same time, trying their best to reach the finish line.
However, when Connor heard the gunshot, his first reaction was not to run, but to be slightly stunned.
After all, it was Connor’s first time participating in such a competition, so he didn’t know much about how things went.
Therefore, Connor was stunned for a moment before he began to rush forward.
When Dominic and Spencer and the others saw this scene, they all revealed helpless expressions.
“It’s over. This time, Connor will definitely be the last. He was already slower than the others, and now he’s so far behind. It would be strange if he isn’t in last place!”
Dominic shouted with a broken expression.
Dominic had just finished speaking when Lindsy suddenly spoke up.
“It seems… It doesn’t seem to be the case…”

chapters.title: Chapter 948: Shocking Speed
chapters.content:
Chapter 948: Shocking Speed
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Although this was the last group match of the 100-meter sprint, it still attracted the attention of many students because of Connor’s participation.
After all, Connor could be considered a celebrity in the school at this time; with just his own strength, he had managed to invite so many big sponsors. This was enough to prove how terrifying Connor’s connections were!
Therefore, everyone in the school was paying attention to Connor, not just Dominic, Spencer, Tamia, Lindsy, and the others.
They wanted to see if Connor was bluffing when he boasted that he would be able to take part in four competitions alone and get first place in all of them!
However, no one expected Connor to be startled for a moment when he started running, falling behind everyone by nearly a second.
This also caused everyone’s expectations of Connor to plummet. They felt that his words back then were just his attempts at bragging.
However, as a professional athlete, Lindsy could still see things that others couldn’t. Although Connor was nearly a second behind when he started, his running speed was not slow at all. He was following closely behind everyone!
In the blink of an eye, the other contestants had already covered the 50-meter distance!
Although Connor was still in last place, Lindsy could see that the distance between Connor and the first place had not changed at all and was maintained at a constant distance.
This also meant that Connor’s speed was probably the same as the one in first place. If Connor had not fallen behind when he started, he would definitely not be in last place
On the track, Connor was staring at the person running in front, choosing to follow at the same speed.
The reason he was doing this was actually very simple: he knew in his heart that his current body was no longer the body of a normal person. If Connor ran with all his might, his speed could even break the world record.
But if Connor really broke the world record, then this matter would definitely create a huge stir and affect his life.
Connor had invited so many sponsors over today that he could no longer stay in the class. If he broke another world record, Connor felt terrified just thinking about the consequences.
That was why Connor chose to race at the same speed as the first place in the group. He would choose to speed up at the last critical moment. In this way, Connor’s speed should be similar to the first place in the group.
As expected, when everyone thought that Connor was definitely the last one, he suddenly chose to speed up.
Connor’s speed was still very shocking, and he had already surpassed the eight players in front of him.
All of this was done in the blink of an eye. No one had expected Connor’s speed to be so shocking!
In less than two seconds, he had gone straight from last place to second place!
After eight consecutive contestants, Connor didn’t choose to overtake the first place. Instead, he gradually slowed down. In the end, Connor successfully advanced to the next round of the finals and got second place.
In an instant, the people who were originally watching the match all quieted down. They stared at Connor with doubt in their hearts. Even the students in Connor’s class were abnormally puzzled by this scene.
Dominic was stunned for a moment, then turned to Spencer and stuttered, “Connor… Connor actually advanced?”
“He did, but how did Connor do it? I remember that he was in last place. Why did he suddenly come in second place?” Spencer quickly said.
“That’s right. I also feel that it’s strange. Connor was in last place for quite a while. How did he suddenly surpass those people…”
Tamia also sighed.
Meanwhile, Lindsy sat quietly on the spot with an extremely surprised expression on her face. This was because Lindsy had already seen what was going on.
Lindsy could feel that Connor did not seem to have used his true strength just now. Connor’s true strength should be the speed when he surpassed the others. If Connor had been running at that speed the entire time, then his results would definitely be very terrifying!
The feeling that Lindsy got from the group match just now was like watching Connor race against a primary school student. At the beginning, Connor had been controlling his speed and following closely behind everyone. However, when he was about to reach the finish line, hesuddenly increased his speed and surpassed everyone in front of him!
This situation was really strange!
Lindsy could not figure out what was going on!
As for Connor, who had already advanced to the finals, his expression seemed to be very calm. He stood quietly on the spot and accepted the shocked gazes of everyone present.
“The first round of the 100-meter sprint group competition has ended. The contestants who have advanced to the final are contestant No. 8: Fergus Long, and contestant No. 27: Glenn Quimbly. And lastly, we have contestant number 88, Connor McDonald…”
At this moment, the announcer began to list the contestants who had advanced to the finals.
The order of the names was based on the results of the group competition. Although everyone did not go all out in the group competition, Fergus was still the fastest overall.
Fergus, who was warming up to participate in the finals, was stunned when he heard Connor’s name.
He subconsciously turned his head to look at Connor, who was not far away and realized that Connor’s number was 88. This meant that Connor had indeed advanced to the finals!
When Connor was participating in the group competition, Fergus had watched the first half of the competition. When he saw that Connor was one second slower, he felt extremely disdainful towards Connor. Moreover, Connor had been in last place for a while, so Fergus didn’t pay too much attention to him.
After all, he felt that Connor’s best result would end up as either second or third from the bottom. It should be impossible for him to advance to the finals.
Therefore, he didn’t pay too much attention to Connor. Instead, he went to the field and started warming up.
However, when Fergus discovered that Connor had actually advanced, he was naturally very shocked!
“Wasn’t Connor always in last place? How did he advance?”
Fergus could not help but mutter in his heart.
At this moment, the announcer spoke up again.
“Those who have advanced to the finals, please gather at the track. The 100-meter sprint finals are about to begin!”

chapters.title: Chapter 949: Finals!
chapters.content:
Chapter 949: Finals!
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
“Connor, you’re really amazing. I didn’t expect you to advance to the finals. How did you do it?”
Just as Connor was about to head to the field, Eunice suddenly ran to Connor’s side and shouted excitedly.
“I was just lucky earlier. It just so happened that my opponents were weaker…” Connor turned to look at Eunice and replied in a very low-key manner.
“What do you mean, ‘lucky’? I saw it just now. You were really fast! If you did not start a little slower, you might have advanced with the first place in the group just now. It seems that you weren’t bragging and are really quite powerful…”
At this moment, Eunice’s face was filled with excitement. After all, Connor’s performance was indeed very surprising.
Even if Connor ran last in the finals, it didn’t matter now!
“Haha…”
