When Connor heard Eunice’s words, he couldn’t help but smile lightly, but he didn’t say anything. He felt that it was better not to explain this kind of thing because the more he explained, the more troublesome it would be.
“Alright, Connor, I’ll take you to the field. You don’t have to be too nervous during the finals. As long as you can finish the race, it doesn’t matter even if you’re last!” Eunice said happily as she tugged at Connor.
“I’m not here for the last place today. Since I’m participating, I’ll definitely get first place!” Connor replied calmly.
If Connor had said that before, Eunice would definitely think that Connor was bragging. However, at this time, she no longer had such thoughts because she knew that Connor did have the skill to back his words up.
A moment later, Connor followed Eunice to the venue of the finals.
There were less than five minutes left before the finals would start, and everyone was warming up.
Because Eunice wasn’t a contestant, she naturally couldn’t stay by Connor’s side.
When Connor showe upd, the students in the school suddenly realized that Connor, who was wearing casual clothes and jeans, had really advanced to the finals!
This was the first time someone had appeared in the finals dressed like this!
“Connor, you can do it!”
“Connor, you’re the most handsome!”
When the girls in Connor’s class saw Connor appear, they also began to shout his name.
Connor turned his head to look at his class and found that everyone was staring at him. He seemed to have never experienced such a feeling before; after all, he was just a poor loser in the eyes of these students. No one paid attention to Connor at all, and no one would cheer for him from the bottom of their hearts.
However, Connor had clearly become the focus of everyone’s attention!
Fergus looked at Connor with an extremely complicated expression!
Previously, during the opening of the school sports meet, Connor had invited so many heavyweight guests to steal Fergus’s limelight.
And now that Connor had advanced to the finals, even more people were paying attention to him. It was then that Fergus secretly swore that he could not lose to Connor, no matter what!
Fergus felt that if he could break the school’s sprint record, the students in the school would pay attention to him.
“Contestants, please get ready on your respective tracks!”
At this moment, the referee’s voice sounded.
After hearing this, the participants in the finals headed to the starting line and prepared themselves.
Connor was still standing there quietly. His expression was very calm, forming a very sharp contrast with the nervousness on the faces of the other players.
It wasn’t difficult for Connor to win the finals. However, what he was thinking about now was how fast he should win the championship. He couldn’t run too fast, nor could he run too slowly.
In the end, Connor thought of a simple method, which was to do it like the group competition.
Fergus was definitely the fastest—he was the champion of three consecutive school sports games, so Connor only needed to follow behind Fergus and surpass him at the end. In this way, Connor would be able to win the championship, and his results would not be too shocking.
Otherwise, if Connor used too much strength and broke the world sprint record, things would be troublesome.
A few minutes later, the sprint finals finally began.
This time, Connor’s start was very smooth. Although he was still half a beat slower than the others, it was already much better than the group stage.
After the finals began, almost everyone’s attention was on Fergus and Connor.
After all, Fergus was the previous sprinting champion. This time, he was aiming to break the school record of 10.08 seconds. Naturally, many people were watching Fergus closely.
Of course, there were also some people who placed their attention on Connor.
It was unbelievable that Connor could advance to the finals. They all wanted to see what kind of result he could achieve in the end.
Fergus’s speed was indeed very fast—in the blink of an eye, he had pulled some distance away from the other contestants and was rushing straight to the finish line.
However, what everyone did not expect was that Connor was following closely behind Fergus in second place.
Fergus subconsciously turned his head to look at Connor behind him. He did not expect Connor’s speed to be so fast, so Fergus used all his strength to increase his speed, wanting to shake Connor off.
However, Fergus realized that even if he tried his best, he still could not shake off Connor.
Lindsy, Tamia, Dominic Spencer, and the others looked at the both of them with wide eyes. Their expressions were displaying their shock.
The students in Connor’s class did not expect such a scene.
Connor was actually able to match up to Fergus and was even following closely behind him. This kind of scene was something that no one had expected.
In the blink of an eye, they both covered fifty meters.
Fergus realized that he still could not shake off Connor. What was even more terrifying was that Fergus felt that his speed was obviously not as fast as before, but Connor’s speed did not decrease at all.
When he was less than ten meters away from the finish line, Connor knew that he could overtake Fergus then.
He suddenly increased his speed!
Fergus could naturally feel that Connor was using more of his strength, so he also suddenly increased his speed.
However, Fergus’s speed was not on the same level as Connor’s speed!
Connor easily surpassed Fergus and came in first place!

chapters.title: Chapter 950: What's Your Angle?
chapters.content:
Chapter 950: What’s Your Angle?
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
On the field of Porthampton University.
When the students saw that Connor had successfully surpassed Fergus, they were all dumbfounded. Their mouths were wide open in shock.
No one expected Connor to actually overtake Fergus.
Fergus looked at Connor’s back with an extremely ugly expression. However, he was powerless. No matter how hard Fergus tried, he could not catch up to Connor.
Finally, Connor crossed the finish line in first place.
The number on the timer froze at 10.03 seconds!
Connor’s results this time had broken the record that Porthampton University had maintained for many years.
When the students on the field heard the announcement, they instantly burst into deafening cheers.
Although many people felt that Connor’s results were unbelievable, most of them still admired Connor from the bottom of their hearts. No matter what, Connor had obtained such results under everyone’s gaze. There was no way to lie about these results.
Previously, many people had doubted Connor, but his results instantly broke everyone’s doubts.
Fergus looked at Connor’s back alone, his heart filled with endless confusion and anger. He felt that the cheers that Connor received should have belonged to him, but now, Connor had snatched them away.
On the other side, the students in Connor’s class surrounded Connor and began to cheer his name.
Connor’s face also revealed a happy smile. This might be the first time Connor was treated in such a way since he entered the Porthampton University.
At this moment, Eunice walked to Connor’s side and reminded him softly. “Connor, do you want to participate in the 800 meter race? If you don’t want to attend, you don’t have to…”
There was less than half an hour left before the 800m group competition began, if Connor still wanted to participate, he would have to report to the venue.
However, Connor had just broken the school’s 100-meter record, so Eunice felt that it would be fine if Connor did not participate in the 800-meter race.
“Connor, it’s best if you don’t go…”
“That’s right. You’re already the hero of our class now. There’s no need for you to participate in the 800-meter race!”
All the students in the class were also persuading Connor not to participate.
Connor hesitated for a moment before speaking softly to Eunice. “Since I’m already here, I’ll try it out!”
“Then can you do it? Your 100m sprint record is already so good. If you don’t do well in the 800-meter race, you might be laughed at…”
Eunice was very worried about Connor.
“It’s fine. I’m still full of energy. Don’t worry!”
Connor chuckled and then walked away.
Eunice hesitated for a moment before following him.
…
After Connor finished the 100m sprint, he went straight to the 800-meter race. Many people felt that Connor might have used up a lot of his stamina, so it was impossible for him to get a good result in the 800-meter race. Even Fergus felt that Connor might not even make it to the final.
However, no one expected Connor to not only enter the finals, but also break the school’s record again and win the 800-meter race.
After the 800-meter race, Connor was like a superhero in everyone’s eyes.
However, this was only the beginning. Connor then participated in the high jump and long jump!
In these two events, Connor restrained himself and did not break the school’s record, but he still won the championship!
This time, the Porthampton University’s sports meet was like Connor’s personal event. From the opening ceremony to the sports meet competitions, Connor’s performance was incredible in all fronts.
When it came to those who had previously looked down on and mocked Connor learned of this news, their hearts were even more shocked.
This sports meet made Connor’s name known to everyone in Porthampton University. People could be heard talking about Connor almost everywhere.
After the first day of the sports meet, Dominic, Spencer, Lindsy, and Tamia tried to look for Connor so they could celebrate outside the campus. However, the four of them found that Connor had disappeared. They didn’t know where he had gone.
Lindsy naturally had a lot of questions in her heart to ask Connor, but in the end, she gave up because she could not find Connor.
At this time, Connor had already arrived at Rachel’s dormitory alone and was quietly waiting for her to return.
Originally, Connor planned to question Rachel after the sports meet ended. However, he felt that there were too many students at the sports meet, so if his conversation with Rachel were to be overheard by others, it would be troublesome. He decided that it was better to talk about these things in Rachel’s dormitory.
Because Rachel never liked to lock the door, Connor easily entered the room.
Connor waited in the dormitory for about half an hour before Rachel, who was wearing a red dress, finally returned to the dormitory.
Rachel was the host of the school sports meet, so she had a lot of things to do. At this time, she also looked tired.
When Rachel entered the room and was about to take a good rest, she suddenly saw Connor sitting on the sofa. She couldn’t help but be stunned for a moment and then asked softly, “Connor, how did you get in?”
“You didn’t lock the door.”
“Oh.”
Rachel gently nodded, after which she smiled and said, “You were in the limelight at the school sports meet today. Are there many young girls pursuing you? Why didn’t you go on a date with those girls and instead come to my place?”
Connor was not in the mood to joke with Rachel, so he got straight to the point. “What do you think? What’s your angle?”
“What did I do to you?”
Rachel’s tone carried a trace of confusion in it.
“Alright, stop pretending with me. You were the one who asked me to help invite the sponsors over, but you leaked this to the school. What do you want?”
Connor seemed to be somewhat angry as he shouted at Rachel.
“How did you know that I leaked this news?”
Rachel asked Connor with a smile.
“Only Thomas Morgan, you and I know about this. Thomas wouldn’t leak this matter. I know Thomas’s character very well, so now you’re the only one left who could’ve leaked this information.”
Connor analyzed in a low voice.
Rachel looked at Connor in front of her and lightly smiled. “You’re right. I was the one who leaked this news!”
“Then why did you do it?”
Connor asked in confusion.

chapters.title: Chapter 951: Self-Preservation
chapters.content:
Chapter 951: Self-Preservation
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
In the dormitory.
After Connor heard Rachel’s answer, he was shocked.
Although Connor had always guessed that it was Rachel who leaked this news, Connor couldn’t understand why Rachel did this. It didn’t benefit Rachel at all!
“What is your purpose?” Connor sized Rachel up and asked her expressionlessly.
“I don’t have any motives. I want you to expose your identity because I don’t want you to stay at Porthampton University!” Rachel slowly said.
“Why?”
Connor seemed even more puzzled because he couldn’t understand what his decision to leave Porthampton University had to do with Rachel!
“You’re asking me why?” Rachel seemed somewhat helpless. Then, she said softly, “Why do you think? Connor, have you forgotten the most important thing for you now? Have you forgotten why I came to Porthampton University to wait for you?”
“…”
Connor looked at Rachel without saying anything.
“If you have forgotten, then let me tell you that I didn’t come to Porthampton University to be a lecturer. I just wanted to join hands with you to deal with those people in Rockefeller. I wasn’t worried before you inherited Steven Lee’s inheritance. After you inherited Steven Lee’s inheritance, I gave you some time to adapt. But now, I think the time is almost ripe. There’s no need for you to continue staying at Porthampton. You should do what you should do!” Rachel said to Connor seriously.
“What does it have to do with me being at Porthampton University?” Connor frowned and asked.
“You spend most of your time in school now. Tell me, where do you find the time to deal with Rockefeller?” Rachel took a deep breath and continued, “I know that if I persuade you to leave Porthampton University, you will resist it. So, I might as well use this school sports meet to make it impossible for you to stay in Porthampton…”
“So that I can’t stay?” Connor sneered.
“Now that your identity has been exposed, basically all the students in Porthampton University know that you’re not an ordinary person. In the future, you definitely won’t be able to continue to stay as an ordinary person, so your best choice now is to leave here and do what you should do!” Rachel said in a low voice.
“Who exactly are you? What is your motive?” The more Connor listened, the more he felt that something was wrong. He even suspected that Rachel was using him.
“It doesn’t matter who I am. You just have to remember that I’m not your enemy!” Rachel replied indifferently.
“How do I know you’re not my enemy? I’m now very suspicious of our purpose in contacting each other…” Connor said expressionlessly.
“If I wanted to harm you, would I help you contact Joey’s brother? If I wanted to harm you, I could have asked Joey not to help you back then…” Rachel looked at Connor and replied.
“Okay, since you brought this up, what about this? I won’t care about Joey’s brother anymore. You can bring Thomas to meet him tomorrow. If this project can be negotiated, I’ll consider cooperating with you. If this project can’t be negotiated, we’ll be ordinary friends in the future. I won’t choose to cooperate with someone I don’t trust…” Connor thought for a moment and said to Rachel solemnly.
“Do you think I’m trustworthy just because I helped you win this project?” Rachel lightly smiled and softly asked Connor.
“At the very least, you have helped me get some benefits. Moreover, this also hurt Rockefeller’s interests. This means that you can still be trusted for the time being!” Connor replied.
Rachel looked at Connor and didn’t say anything. In fact, Rachel also knew that what she had done before had already made Connor very dissatisfied. Connor was different from before. He would not be willing to be manipulated by others, nor did he want anyone to use him to do anything.
“All right, I promise you. I’ll bring Thomas to meet Joey’s brother tomorrow!” Rachel thought for a moment and nodded at Connor.
Connor took a deep breath after Rachel agreed. He didn’t say anything else and walked out of the dormitory.
In fact, Connor now knew why Rachel would reveal the sponsor’s matter. Rachel’s purpose was very simple. She just hoped Connor would leave school as soon as possible and put all his energy into the company. This way, Connor would have enough time to deal with Rockefeller.
But now, Connor still thought of leaving school, and Connor had not yet obtained his university graduation certificate.
Of course, Connor could put his name on the school and get his graduation certificate without coming to class.
However, the premise was that Connor was still the heir to this inheritance. Once Connor lost the qualification to inherit the inheritance, he would get nothing if he left the school. In the future, Connor would have a harder time in society.
To put it bluntly, after experiencing the Lee Family’s fight for the inheritance, Connor had always felt that this money did not wholly belong to him. He might lose everything he had one day!
Once he lost all of this, Connor would have nothing left.
Therefore, Connor had always thought of ways to leave some leeway for himself. If he lost his inheritance, he would not be unable to survive in this society.
Connor had lived at the bottom of society before, so he naturally knew how hard it was to live there.
Therefore, Connor wanted to be Jorge’s disciple and finish university. This was to prepare for his future in society.
Back then, Connor hid his identity and did not want the people around him to know he was a super wealthy heir. He was worried that if Freya knew his identity, he would lose the right to inherit the inheritance.
Connor hid his identity because he didn’t want to be looked at differently by the people around him when he lost his inheritance one day.
To put it bluntly, this was just a way for Connor to protect himself!
The fewer people who knew Connor’s identity now, the less impact it would have on his future life if he lost the right to inherit the inheritance.

chapters.title: Chapter 952: A Call From Priscilla Marcus
chapters.content:
Chapter 952: A Call From Priscilla Marcus
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
After leaving the dormitory, Connor took out his mobile phone and dialed Thomas’s number. Then, he told him about the meeting with Joey’s younger brother.
Originally, Connor had planned to meet Joey’s younger brother in person and chat with him about the subway project.
After all, Connor could be considered to have a favor to ask of others. If he did not appear, it would seem unreasonable.
But because he knew that Rachel was using him, Connor gave up on this idea.
He wanted Rachel to deal with this and see if Rachel really intended to cooperate with him.
After explaining this to Thomas, Connor took a taxi home alone.
Connor had been busy with the school sports meet for the whole day, so he felt a little tired when he got home. After a simple wash, he lay on his bed to rest.
Connor quickly fell asleep.
When Connor opened his eyes again, he realized that he had slept until 2 PM.
Thomas, Rachel, and Joey’s younger brother met at 10 AM, so Connor knew they should have finished their meeting by now.
So he hurriedly picked up his phone and found that there was indeed a missed call from Thomas. Connor hurriedly called back.
‘Ring, ring!’
After the phone rang twice, Thomas picked up the call.
“How did it go?” Connor asked directly.
“Mr. McDonald, don’t worry. The matter has been settled. Langston Shaw, the director of Davenport’s subway bureau, has agreed to give this project to us internally. He also promised to give us the management rights for five years…” Thomas said happily.
“It went so smoothly?” Hearing that, Connor was more or less surprised.
“Since Ms. Wallace has personally stepped up, Langston naturally has to give. Originally, I thought getting two years of management rights like Rockefeller would be very good, but I didn’t expect Ms. Wallace to be so hardcore and ask for five years of management rights. Although Langston was a little hesitant, he still agreed in the end!” Thomas said with a smile.
Hearing that, Connor was a little surprised. First of all, he expected things to go less smoothly. Secondly, he didn’t expect Rachel to really help him.
Rachel had offended Rockefeller but helped him win the subway project. From this point, it could be seen that Rachel was not Rockefeller’s person. If Rachel were Rockefeller’s person, she would definitely not do this.
Connor began to hesitate again. Was Rachel worthy of trust?
“What do you plan to do next?” Connor asked in a low voice.
“Mr. McDonald, since Langston has already agreed to give us the subway project internally, there’s no need for us to continue competing with the people from Rockefeller…” Thomas said slowly.
“So we can wait until the subway project starts bidding, right?” Connor asked.
“Mr. McDonald, didn’t you take this project to attract the attention of the person in charge of Rockefeller?” Thomas asked.
“Yeah, why?” Connor was curious.
“In that case, we could add fuel to the fire. I will hold a party in your name and invite all the big shots of Porthampton. Langston and the others will also attend,” Thomas said.
“In my name? Do I have to show my face too?” Connor frowned and asked.
“Of course, you have to show yourself…” Thomas replied.
“In that case, doesn’t that mean that the entire Porthampton will know my identity?” Connor was somewhat speechless.
After all, Connor’s identity was exposed at the Porthampton University, and he was already very distressed.
If Thomas did host the party in his name, then basically everyone in Porthampton would know Connor and that Connor was the richest guy in Northampton. Connor was still very resistant to this kind of thing.
Connor even suspected that Rachel had said something to Thomas. It was as if the two of them had colluded. One wanted him to expose his identity in school, and the other wanted him to expose his identity in city. He might not be able to stay in Porthampton in the future.
“This is just a suggestion. If we host this party, first of all, we can attract the attention of the people from Rockefeller. Secondly, we can send a message to the outside world that this project has been given to our company. Other companies will not compete with us.”
Thomas paused and continued, “Mr. McDonald, your goal is not to win this project but to use this project to threaten Birdie, the person in charge of Rockefeller in Porthampton, right?”
“Yes…” Connor nodded.
“But once the bidding is over, Birdie will completely lose her identity as the person in charge. Even if we win this project, we won’t be able to use this project to negotiate with Birdie…”
“But if we let everyone know that we have internally decided on this subway project before the bidding starts, Birdie will not be able to sit still and take the initiative to contact you. You can use this subway project to negotiate with her by then!” Thomas explained.
Hearing Thomas’ plan, Connor nodded thoughtfully.
Before the bidding ended, this project was Connor’s only bargaining chip. However, this project was no longer a bargaining chip that Connor could use once the bidding ended.
That was why Thomas wanted to use this method to spread the news.
“I understand what you mean. Let me think about it!” Connor said.
“All right!” Thomas quickly agreed and then hung up the phone.
After hanging up the phone, Connor weighed the pros and cons, thinking about what to do next.
However, Connor’s phone rang again.
Connor looked down at his phone. When he saw the name on the phone, he was surprised because the person who called him was Freya’s cousin, Priscilla Marcus.
Connor’s eyes flashed with excitement. It had been a long time since Priscilla had contacted him.
Now, Priscilla took the initiative to contact Connor. It was very likely that she had received some news from Freya.
Therefore, Connor hurriedly picked up his phone and answered the call.

chapters.title: Chapter 953: News Of Freya Phillips
chapters.content:
Chapter 953: News Of Freya Phillips
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Connor knew that Priscilla had a very good relationship with Freya. After Freya left the country, they lost contact with each other. Even Freya’s parents did not know what she was doing.
However, Freya had always been in contact with Priscilla. This was enough to prove how close Priscilla and Freya were.
Connor and Priscilla had little contact. In fact, there was no more contact.
Therefore, Connor felt there were only two possibilities for Priscilla to call him.
Either Priscilla encountered some trouble and needed Connor’s help, or there was some news from Freya.
That was why Connor couldn’t wait to answer the call.
“Priscilla, what’s up?” Connor asked softly.
“Connor, do you have time now? I want to meet you…” Priscilla didn’t waste any breath and went straight to the point.
“What’s wrong?” Connor could feel that there was something wrong with Priscilla’s tone and asked with a frown.
“It’s about Freya. I can’t explain it to you on the phone. Let’s meet and talk!” Priscilla replied.
When Connor heard the name ‘Freya’, his heart could not help but beat faster.
He knew that his guess was correct. Priscilla had called him because of Freya.
“Priscilla, where are you? I’ll go and find you now!” Connor hurriedly said.
“I’ll wait for you at the Starbucks on West Avenue. Let’s meet and talk!” Priscilla replied after thinking for a moment.
“Okay!” Connor agreed and hung up.
After hanging up the phone, Connor went to the bathroom to wash his face. Then, he changed into a new set of clothes and hurriedly left.
From Priscilla’s tone, Connor could tell that Freya must have encountered some problems. Priscilla’s tone was somber, and she did not explain the matter clearly over the phone. This was enough to prove how complicated the matter was.
About half an hour later, Connor called a taxi and arrived at the Starbucks on West Avenue. Then, he called Priscilla and found her location.
Today, Priscilla wore a short black skirt. Her figure was sexy, and her facial features were exquisite. However, there was a trace of anxiety and worry on her pretty face.
“Priscilla!” Connor called out to Priscilla.
Priscilla suddenly looked up at Connor. She hurriedly said, “Connor, you’re here! Hurry up and sit down!”
“Priscilla, what’s going on? What happened to Freya?” Connor walked up to Priscilla and asked anxiously.
Priscilla slowly raised her head and looked at Connor. Her beautiful eyes seemed to be filled with worry. She took a deep breath and said in a low voice, “Connor, I shouldn’t tell you about this because Freya told me before that no matter what happens, I can’t tell you about her. This is also why I haven’t picked up your calls after Freya left…”
“Priscilla, I understand what you’re saying. After all, there’s indeed a misunderstanding between Freya and me. But why did you call me out today?” Connor wasn’t interested in listening to Priscilla’s explanation and asked anxiously.
“…”
Priscilla looked at Connor and hesitated. Then she bit her lip and said, “Connor, I think Freya has gone missing!”
“Buzz!”
When Connor heard that, his entire body froze. His expression changed drastically as he asked agitatedly, “Priscilla, are…Are you kidding me? Why would Freya disappear?”
“I’m not kidding…” Priscilla shook her head helplessly and continued, “After Freya went abroad, she completely cut off contact with the Phillips family. Even Freya’s parents don’t know where she went. However, she would call me a few times a week to tell me about her situation so I could be at ease. However, it has been a month since Freya last called me.”
“…”
Connor looked at Priscilla, his eyes filled with shock and confusion.
“A few days ago, I went straight to where Freya lives, but I still couldn’t find her. I asked her school about her, and the school said that Freya hasn’t been to school for two months…”
Priscilla paused before continuing, “Connor, I have used all the methods I could think of to find Freya, but there are no results. I am forced to find you. I know that you know many people and have many connections. I hope you can help me find Freya!”
“Why are you only telling me this now?” Connor shouted at Priscilla.
“Freya told me not to tell you her whereabouts. I had no choice…” Priscilla replied guiltily.
When Connor saw how guilty Priscilla was, he couldn’t help but take a deep breath and didn’t say anything else.
“Priscilla, you don’t have to be too anxious. How about this? Give me Freya’s address. I’ll go there to look for her myself…” Connor said to Priscilla without any hesitation.
“Uhm…”
Priscilla looked at Connor’s expression and seemed to be hesitant. After all, Freya had emphasized that Connor could not know her location and contact information no matter what, so Priscilla did not know if she should tell Connor.
“Priscilla, seriously? Freya has been missing for so long. If we continue to delay, something might happen!” Connor knew what Priscilla was thinking, so he urged her anxiously.
“All right, then!”
Priscilla nodded helplessly, then took out her phone and sent Freya’s address and contact information to Connor.
“Priscilla, if there’s any news on your side, contact me immediately. If there’s any news on my side, I’ll tell you!”
After Connor got Freya’s address and contact information, he gave Priscilla a simple reminder before leaving the cafe.
Priscilla looked at Connor leave, her eyes filled with helplessness and self-blame.

chapters.title: Chapter 954: Thomas Morgan's Suggestion
chapters.content:
Chapter 954: Thomas Morgan’s Suggestion
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
After Connor got Freya’s address, he hurriedly ran out of Starbucks.
Connor knew that there were only four possibilities for Freya’s disappearance. The first possibility was that the Lee Family members were not willing to give up and had made a move on Freya.
The second possibility was that Rockefeller’s people planned to use Freya to threaten Connor.
The third possibility was that it was Freya herself. Perhaps she had a conflict with someone, but this probability was minimal. Freya had a good personality and would not have any conflicts with others.
Moreover, Freya lived in the safest place in the entire U.S.. Freya lived in the school, so nothing unexpected would happen.
Therefore, Connor felt that it was very likely that the Lee Family or Rockefeller’s people had made a move on Freya.
However, there was one last possibility, the most optimistic one. Freya had not gone missing, but she had not contacted Priscilla.
Thinking of this, Connor quickly took out his phone and dialed Thomas’s number.
Connor would ask Thomas to book a ticket to the U.S. for him and then tell Thomas that he was leaving.
‘Ring, ring!’
After the phone rang twice, Thomas picked up the call.
“Mr. McDonald, what’s up?” Thomas asked softly.
“Help me book a flight to the U.S. tonight, and then get our company’s person-in-charge in the U.S. to contact me. I have something to do there!” Connor said.
After Thomas heard Connor’s order, he was stunned momentarily. He said in a puzzled tone, “Mr. McDonald, why do you suddenly want to go to the U.S.?”
“Freya has gone missing…” Connor replied in a low voice.
“Ms…. Ms. Phillips is missing?” After Thomas heard this, he was very shocked.
“Yes, I suspect it might be the Lee Family or Rockefeller’s people who did this to Freya. However, no matter who did it, it should be directed at me. I have to go there myself…” Connor nodded.
“It is impossible that it is the Lee Family. Stephanie would tell me if it were the Lee Family who did it. She wouldn’t dare to hide anything…” Thomas denied.
“Then, it was Rockefeller’s men…” Connor gritted his teeth.
“Mr. McDonald, how long has Ms. Phillips been missing?” Thomas asked.
“Almost a month…” Connor replied.
“Mr. McDonald, if Rockefeller’s people wanted to use Ms. Phillips to threaten you, have you ever thought about why they didn’t contact you immediately and only received this news a month later?” Thomas was calmer than Connor, so he would consider things more comprehensively than Connor.
“What… What do you mean by that?” Connor hesitated.
“I don’t think Rockefeller would go against Ms. Phillips alone. After all, Ms. Phillips is of no use to Rockefeller. They must be targeting you, Mr. McDonald. But if they target you, why didn’t Rockefeller contact us?” Thomas paused and then continued, “I think it’s possible that Ms. Phillips doesn’t want to contact us anymore?”
“I can’t analyze anything now. I must hurry to the U.S. to see what’s happening!” Connor said in a low voice.
“Mr. McDonald, I suggest you not to leave now!” Thomas advised.
“Freya has already disappeared. Do I have to pretend that nothing has happened?” Connor shouted.
“Mr. McDonald, don’t be anxious. Let me finish…” Thomas hurriedly replied and then continued, “Here’s the situation now. I’ve already spread the news that you will hold a party. I’ve invited all the VIPs and rich people in Davenport. Birdie must have received the news too. We’ve worked so hard for so long. If you go to the U.S., all our efforts will be in vain…”
“Thomas, my fiancée is missing now. I don’t have the mood to think about these things at all. The things in the company can’t be compared to Freya,” Connor said agitatedly.
“All right, then, let’s not consider these things. Mr. McDonald, you don’t have a visa for the U.S.. Even if we used our connections, you will need at least a week to get a visa. You can only go there after a week…
“Secondly, you’re unfamiliar with the U.S.. What can you do even if you go there? You can’t find Ms. Phillips at all. Moreover, if Ms. Phillips isn’t in the U.S. at all, wouldn’t you have made a wasted trip there?” Thomas hurriedly added.
Hearing that, Connor calmed down.
He felt that what Thomas said made sense. He was unfamiliar with the U.S., so it would be useless even if he went there.
“So, what do you think we should do now?” Connor thought for a moment and asked in a low voice.
“Mr. McDonald, you can stay in Porthampton and attend the party. I will also find some connections to help you get a visa as soon as possible…” Thomas replied.
“So we can’t do anything for a week?” Connor asked anxiously.
“Our company also has a person-in-charge in the U.S., and this person-in-charge has a certain social status and influence there. I will contact the person-in-charge in there and ask him to help find Ms. Phillips. At the same time, I will also find out whom Ms. Phillips knows in the U.S. and see if I can find any clues,” Thomas said methodically.
“…”
Connor hesitated, then sighed helplessly and said dejectedly, “All right, we can only do this for now…”
“Mr. McDonald, you don’t have to worry too much. If it were really Rockefeller’s people who did this to Ms. Phillips, Rockefeller would not hurt her. After the party ends, Birdie will contact you as soon as possible. After all, the subway project is significant to her. She is one of Rockefeller’s people, so you can get information about Ms. Phillips from Birdie!” Thomas continued to comfort Connor.
“All right, makes sense!” Connor wasn’t in the mood to hear Thomas talk about these things. He hung up the phone after the perfunctory sentence.

chapters.title: Chapter 955: I'll Be His Lover
chapters.content:
Chapter 955: I’ll Be His Lover
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
After the phone call with Thomas, Connor’s mood became irritable.
After all, after waiting for such a long time, there was finally news of Freya. However, Connor did not expect that he would receive such news.
Freya’s whereabouts were unknown, and Connor could not do anything, so he was extremely anxious now.
The news about Connor’s identity at Porthampton University had already spread. There were many rumors everywhere, so Connor naturally couldn’t go to school for classes.
Of course, Connor also knew that Rachel had an extensive network. He also wanted to ask Rachel for help, but in the end, Connor gave up on this idea.
Therefore, three days had passed. Connor had been waiting for news from Thomas in the villa. However, there was no news in these three days, which made Connor even more frustrated.
In Connor’s eyes, nothing was more important than Freya’s whereabouts.
However, Connor didn’t know that the three days he had been hiding in the villa were the most lively three days in Porthampton because the party held in the name of Connor of Davenport was about to begin.
This was Connor’s first public appearance after inheriting Steven Lee’s inheritance.
Even though many people had heard about Connor, no one knew what he looked like or who he was.
This time, to attract Rockefeller’s attention, Thomas used Connor’s name to hold a party. He invited all the famous CEOs and tycoons of the four provinces.
The VIPs of the four major cities would attend, and they naturally came for Connor alone.
In an instant, many luxury cars drove over from various places in San Antonio, San Francisco, San Diego, and Davenport. All of these cars were filled with billionaires.
When Thomas first invited these rich people, he set the standard that their net worth must be at least one billion. Otherwise, they would not be qualified to attend the party.
When the ordinary people in Porthampton saw these luxury cars, they all looked puzzled because they couldn’t understand what kind of person could gather so many luxury cars here.
Although ordinary people didn’t know what was happening, they knew that something big would happen in Porthampton.
***
Connor, who was waiting for news from Freya at home, suddenly received a call from Thomas.
Connor thought Thomas had news about her, so he was excited and quickly picked up the call.
However, when he picked up the call, he realized it wasn’t about Freya. Instead, he was asking Connor to prepare for tonight’s party.
Connor was not in the mood to attend such a party at all. He instinctively wanted to refuse.
However, Thomas persuaded him nicely. After all, this was the best opportunity to make Rockefeller’s people surface. If he missed it, it would be impossible to find such an opportunity. Therefore, Connor could only helplessly agree.
After the phone call with Thomas, Connor washed up and left the villa alone.
This was the first time Connor had left the villa after knowing that Freya had gone missing.
About half an hour later, Connor took a taxi to the hotel where the party was held. This hotel was naturally a five-star hotel under Connor’s company.
When Connor saw the luxury cars parked in the parking lot in front of the hotel, he was a little surprised because he didn’t expect his influence to be so terrifying. Nearly a thousand parking spaces were filled with luxury cars.
This meant that more than a thousand people would be attending the party today!
To gather so many rich people in one go, Connor was probably the only one who could manage that in the four cities. Even Thomas did not have such an influence.
After hesitating, Connor got out of the car and was about to walk to the hotel.
However, after taking two steps, Connor suddenly stopped and narrowed his eyes to look at a spot not far away.
A few fashionably dressed men and women got out of a Mercedes-Benz.
These fashionable men and women were Sabrina, Sadie, Yara, Harold, and Sheldon.
Connor never thought that they would come to the party. After all, Connor had not seen these people since the last time they parted at the resort.
Connor stood quietly in the distance and sized up Sabrina and the rest. After hesitating, he did not walk over. Instead, he chose to wait for them to enter the hotel before entering.
Although Sabrina, Sadie, and the others had already arrived, Connor did not give up the idea of attending the party. After all, the incident of the school sports meet had already spread throughout the school. Connor was not afraid of exposing his identity.
“I didn’t expect Connor to have such influence…”
After leaving the car, Yara saw the luxury cars in the parking lot and the shocking license plate numbers. She was amazed. She had never seen such a scene.
“Yeah, I didn’t expect Connor to be so powerful!”Sadie said.
Sabrina looked at the two of them indifferently and did not say anything.
“Connor is the boss of Thomas and Kyle. He is the number one person in Davenport. Moreover, today is his first time appearing in public. It is said it is for a subway project, so those rich VIPs in the four cities will pay respect!” Sheldon looked at Sadie and said.
“I see!” Sadie nodded. She couldn’t help but recall Connor claiming to be Connor McDonald at the resort.
“This is ridiculous. What was Connor thinking? How dare he say that he is Connor McDonald of Davenport? If Connor really has such great ability, I’ll be his lover!” Sadie couldn’t help but sigh internally.
Sadie, what are you thinking about?” Sabrina seemed to notice that Sadie’s expression was a little off and could not help but ask softly.
“No… It’s nothing…” Sadie was stunned for a moment, then quickly shook her head.
“My friend is coming out to pick us up. Let’s go!” Sheldon suddenly shouted.
“Okay!” Everyone nodded when they heard this and then walked toward the hotel entrance.

chapters.title: Chapter 956: Encounter with Nicole Cooper
chapters.content:
Chapter 956: Encounter with Nicole Cooper
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Sheldon, Harold, Sadie, Sabrina and the rest had just reached the entrance of the hotel when they saw a man running out in a hurry.
When the man saw Harold and Sheldon, he hurriedly called out softly, “Mr. Phiillips, you’re finally here. I’ve been waiting for you for a long time. Let’s go in!”
“Willard, thanks for helping out!”
Sheldon looked at the man and smiled faintly.
The man in front of everyone was Willard Ferguson, and Willard’s father was the general manager of this hotel.
Sheldon had a good relationship with Willard, so he contacted Willard and wanted to enter the party through the back door.
Logically speaking, whether it was Sheldon, Harold, or Sabrina, their families were all qualified to attend this party. However, only the elders in their family were qualified to attend, while juniors like Sheldon and Harold were not qualified to attend the party.
Willard exchanged a simple greeting with Harold and Sheldon, then said with an awkward expression, “Mr. Phiillips, there’s something I have to tell the two of you…”
“What is it?”
Sheldon was stunned for a moment and asked in a puzzled tone.
“I put in a lot of effort to get my dad to allow you to enter the party, but you don’t have an invitation, so you can’t go through the main entrance. We have to enter through the staff passageway. As long as we enter the hall of the party, no one will ask about your identity…”
Willard explained apologetically.
“Isn’t it just a party? Is there a need to be so strict?”
Harold seemed to be a little dissatisfied. After all, his current status was not low. He was still very dissatisfied about having to use the back door.
“Mr. Phiillips, there are a lot of bosses attending this banquet. Basically, all the famous bosses from the four provinces are here. Any one of them is worth tens of billions…”
Willard replied with a helpless expression, then continued, “Previously, Mr. Morgan set the standard where those with a net worth of less than one billion dollars are not qualified to enter. However, our hotel lobby can only accommodate a max of 1,000 people. There are just too many people, so the standard has been set at 10 billion dollars minimum. It’s already a miracle you guys are able to enter. Many people beg my father but aren’t able to get in still.”
“More than ten billion?”
Yara couldn’t help but take a deep breath when she heard that. She was extremely shocked.
Yara’s family had at most one billion in assets. If what Willard said was true, then Yara’s parents were not qualified to enter.
From this, it could be seen how terrifying the level of the party today was. This was a circle that ordinary people might not be able to fit into even if they worked hard for ten lifetimes.
After hearing Willard’s explanation, Harold did not say anything else.
“Let’s go in!”
Sheldon said.
“Alright, follow me this way…”
Willard nodded and led Sheldon and the others to the staff passage.
A moment later, Sabrina, Sheldon, Harold, Sadie, and the rest entered the hotel lobby. At this moment, the lobby was already filled with people. Each of these people had an extraordinary bearing and gave off the feeling that they were not ordinary people.
These people had also formed small circles and were chatting with one another. The content of the conversations was all about business matters.
After all, this kind of party was the best opportunity for the bosses to expand their social circle.
When Sheldon, Harold, and the others saw this scene, they were naturally very envious.
However, they knew that it would take a long time for them to integrate into this circle because they did not even have the right to talk to these people. Even their parents were just the most ordinary existences in front of these people.
Everyone scanned the environment in the hall, then walked to the dining table in the corner and talked while they ate.
In fact, they came here today mainly to broaden their horizons and see who the so-called Davenport’s Mr. McDonald was. Therefore, even if they couldn’t be part of the party, it didn’t matter.
…
On the other side, when Connor saw Sheldon, Harold, and the others enter the hotel, he was also about to walk into the hotel.
“Connor?”
But at this moment, a voice suddenly sounded from behind Connor.
When Connor heard this voice, he could not help but be stunned for a moment. Then, he hurriedly turned around and realized that it was the beautiful president that Connor had saved back then, Nicole Cooper.
At this moment, Nicole had just come out of her car. When she saw Connor turn around, she seemed to be even more surprised. She did not expect to bump into Connor here, so she hurriedly walked toward Connor in her high heels.
Nicole was dressed very beautifully today. She was wearing a short white dress. Her tall figure looked especially charming under the short dress. Her slender and fair legs were exposed to the air without reservation. She was also wearing a pair of black high heels. Her pretty face and her black curly hair gave people indescribable temptation.
When Connor saw Nicole, he was somewhat surprised. He could not understand why Nicole would be here.
However, on second thought, the main purpose of holding this party today was to let everyone know that Connor was going to win the subway project. Nicole was a competitor for this project, so it was normal for her to come to the party today.
“Nicole, long time no see!”
Connor said to Nicole with a smile.
“Yeah, I haven’t seen you for such a long time. What have you been busy with recently?”
Nicole asked happily.
“I’m not busy with anything. I’m mainly attending classes in school…”
Connor replied perfunctorily. Then, he sized up Nicole and asked softly, “Nicole, is your leg all healed?”
“Yeah…”
Nicole nodded and continued, “You’re not here to attend the party, are you?”
“Uh…”
Connor was stunned for a moment, then nodded and said, “Yes, I’m here to attend the party!”
“That’s great. I’m a little bored being here alone. Let’s go in together!”
Nicole took the initiative to tug at Connor.
Connor looked at Nicole helplessly and did not say anything. He followed Nicole directly to the hotel entrance.
However, when Connor arrived at the entrance of the hotel, he suddenly realized a very serious problem.
He did not have an invitation!

chapters.title: Chapter 957: Gathering of Big Shots
chapters.content:
Chapter 957: Gathering of Big Shots
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Today’s party was the grandest party in Davenport.
Basically, as long as they came to attend the party, they were all famous figures in the four provinces. At the very least, they had to be worth more than ten billion dollars to be qualified to enter.
Therefore, the security of the hotel was also very good. No matter who it was, they had to rely on an invitation to enter.
This was also the reason why Willard chose to bring Sheldon, Harold, and the others through the staff passage!
If some random people snuck in, it would be troublesome. Even Thomas and the others could not bear such a responsibility.
After Connor followed Nicole to the entrance of the hotel, he suddenly realized that he did not have an invitation!
After all, Connor was the owner of this hotel and the most important person in this party. These bosses were all here for Connor alone. When Connor was on the phone with Thomas, he didn’t think that he needed an invitation to enter.
After all, no one would need to prepare an invitation letter to attend his own party!
Of course, Connor was an exception.
Because the hotel staff did not know Connor, so Connor could not enter the hotel with his face alone like Thomas and the others.
Naturally, Nicole had received the invitation letter. Therefore, Nicole walked to the staff and elegantly took out the invitation letter from her bag.
The staff member carefully checked Nicole’s invitation letter. After confirming that there were no problems, he said respectfully, “Miss Cooper, welcome!”
“Thank you!”
Nicole nodded gently and walked into the hotel.
However, after Nicole had taken two steps, she realized that Connor did not follow her. So, she turned to look at Connor and realized that he was still standing there, as if he had no intention of coming in at all.
“Connor, you coming?”
Nicole asked Connor softly.
“Nicole, why don’t you go in first? I’ll wait a little longer…”
Connor did not want to explain anything to Nicole now. After all, as long as Nicole left, Connor would call Thomas, and the hotel staff would respectfully invite him in.
Nicole was a very smart woman. She had already guessed that Connor was standing there and not coming in because he did not have an invitation.
When Nicole heard Connor say that he was here to attend the party, she was a little surprised. After all, other than Nicole, who was the president of a company competing for the subway project, all the people who came to the party today were famous rich bosses in the four provinces. Connor was just an ordinary person. It was impossible for him to be invited.
Nicole felt that Connor must be here to take a look see. That was why he told her that he was here to attend the party.
However, Connor did not expect that he would need an invitation to enter.
Nicole had become the president of a listed company at a young age. She had a very high IQ and EQ, so she did not choose to expose Connor.
“This person is my assistant. I can bring him in, right?”
Nicole turned and asked the staff member softly.
For the convenience of the bosses who came to attend the party, the invitation letter specifically stated that the guests were allowed to bring an assistant or secretary. Nicole naturally knew this.
“Of course, you just need to register his name…”
The staff member hurriedly nodded.
“Connor, come in with me!”
Nicole hurriedly waved at Connor.
When Connor heard Nicole’s words, he smiled helplessly and did not say anything. He walked to Nicole’s side and told the staff his name.
When the staff member heard the name Connor McDonald, he was stunned for a moment, but he did not say anything. He registered and then looked at Connor and said, “Mr. McDonald, you can go in now!”
Nicole looked at Connor with a faint smile, then walked toward the hall.
“Today’s party is not ordinary. It’s a party organized by a big shot in Davenport. Not just anyone can come and participate…”
Nicole said to Connor in passing.
“Oh, I see!”
Connor nodded lightly and did not say anything.
At this moment, Nicole might not know that the big shot she was talking about was actually Connor.
When Nicole saw Connor’s reaction, she figured that he was feeling a little awkward, so she did not say anything else and brought Connor into the hall.
At this moment, the hall was filled with people and celebrities. Those rich people who often appeared on television were all gathered here with warm smiles on their faces. They were chatting in groups of three to five, and the atmosphere was quite lively.
“The host of this party is Thomas Morgan’s boss. His boss seems to be holding this party because of the subway project. I’m also the boss of the bidding company for the subway project, so I’m qualified to attend this party.”
Nicole took the initiative to speak to Connor again after seeing that he had not spoken.
“There are indeed many rich people at this party today…”
Connor wasn’t in the mood to chat. After all, all he could think about was Freya Phillips, so he just gave a perfunctory reply.
“Well, Connor, I have a few friends over there. I’m going to go and greet them. You go on ahead and have a good time. If anyone asks about your identity, just say that you’re my driver…”
Seeing that Connor had no intention of chatting with her, Nicole decided to leave him to himself.
“Okay!”
Connor looked at Nicole and nodded.
After Nicole hesitated for a moment, she walked away gracefully in her high heels.
After Nicole had left, Connor stood alone in the corner and watched the crowd coming and going. He was thinking about Freya.
At the same time, in another corner of the hall, a few young people were chatting.
These young people were among the few rich younger generations in the hall, because no big family would choose to let their juniors attend such an important party.
Among these young people were Sheldon, Harold, Jovan Lambert, who had some conflicts with Connor, and an unfamiliar young man.
This young man was also Harold’s best friend. His name was Henny Kirby.
Henny was also a well-known playboy. His character was similar to Jovan’s. They were not good people.
…

chapters.title: Chapter 958: What Kind of Background Does Connor Have?
chapters.content:
Chapter 958: What Kind of Background Does Connor Have?
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
In the four provinces, there were actually four young masters with the most terrifying backgrounds. These four young masters were the top second-generation heirs in the four provinces.
These four young masters included the eldest, Arthur Synder, the second, Henny Kirby, and the third, Jovan Lambert.
Among them, Arthur, Henny, and Jovan all had official backgrounds. They were the three most famous second-generation young masters of officials in the four provinces.
The three of them were actually very different from Leroy Jovi. After all, Leroy’s father, Jaxon Jackel, was from the underworld and had a shady background.
Therefore, no matter how rich Leroy was, he could not be compared to Arthur and the other two.
Among these three people, Arthur’s background was the most terrifying.
Because the Synder Family was extremely powerful, Arthur’s grandfather had great influence even in the core of the country.
When Arthur’s father was in Davenport, he brought Arthur to live in Davenport for a period of time. Later, because Arthur’s father was promoted, Arthur left Davenport.
Henny’s father was the head of San Antonio. He held real power and had amazing power.
Jovan’s father was Cade Lambert, the deputy director of the San Francisco Bureau of Industry and Commerce.
Therefore, when these three people were together, even a rich guy with a net worth of tens of billions could not be compared to them.
Even a rich second-generation heir like Sheldon could not integrate into their circle.
Of the four young masters, the last one was the fourth, Harold Phillips.
When Harold first met Arthur, Henny, and the others, their family backgrounds were actually ordinary. They basically relied on the Phillips Family’s connections.
However, because Harold had a very good relationship with Arthur and listened to Arthur, he was able to step into this circle.
Now that Harold was the son of the deputy chief of war of Davenport, he also had a great background, so he finally had another foot in the door.
After Harold, Henny, and Jovan met, they naturally talked about Connor. After all, Harold and Jovan had conflicts, so the three young masters began to plan how to take revenge on Connor.
When Sabrina heard what Harold and the others said, her face was filled with worry and helplessness.
She could not understand why these people had to find trouble with Connor. After all, Connor was so insignificant to them.
Hence, after hesitating for a moment, Sabrina turned around and left. She started to stroll around the hall.
However, Sabrina had only taken two steps when she saw a familiar figure.
When Sabrina saw this figure, she was extremely shocked because this figure looked very similar to the person she was most worried about.
Hence, after a moment of hesitation, Sabrina walked over.
When Sabrina saw Connor, she was stunned. Her expression was one of disbelief.
She covered her mouth and shouted at Connor in a low voice, “Connor, why are you here?”
When Connor heard Sabrina’s voice, he subconsciously turned around and looked at her. He smiled and said, “What a coincidence! Sabrina, you’re here too!”
At this moment, Connor was still very calm. After all, he had already seen Sabrina, Sheldon, and the rest enter. Hence, he was not as surprised as Sabrina.
“Connor, are you here to attend the party too?”
Sabrina asked Connor doubtfully.
At this moment, Sabrina felt that Connor would not appear at such an event!
“Yeah, are you here to attend the party too?”
Connor asked.
Sabrina could not help but take a deep breath. She sighed in her heart. What she was afraid of really happened!
Jovan and Harold were discussing how to deal with Connor.
And Connor actually took the initiative to deliver himself to them!
If Connor were to be seen by those people, then Jovan and Harold would definitely not let Connor off.
Hence, Sabrina became anxious. She quickly said to Connor, “Connor, you’d better leave this place right now!”
“Leave this place?”
When Connor heard Sabrina’s words, he could not help but be stunned for a moment. He then smiled and asked, “Why should I leave this place?”
“Connor, Harold and Jovan are all here. If they see you, they will definitely take revenge on you.”
Sabrina explained anxiously.
Connor looked at Sabrina and smiled faintly. Then, he reached out and patted Sabrina’s head. He said softly, “People like Harold and Jovan are nothing in my eyes. You don’t have to worry about me!”
At this moment, Connor knew that he could no longer hide his identity. Once the party started, his identity would be known by everyone. Hence, Connor did not hide anything from Sabrina and spoke very directly.
Sabrina’s eyes were filled with helplessness. At this moment, Sabrina could not understand where Connor got the courage to say such words.
“Connor, I’m telling you the truth. You…”
Sabrina seemed to want to persuade Connor to leave this place.
“Sabrina, the desserts over there are quite good. Let’s go over and try some!”
Connor was not in the mood to explain his identity to Sabrina. Once the party started, all the problems would be solved.
Hence, Connor dragged Sabrina and walked toward the desserts.
At this moment, Sabrina was about to have a breakdown. She did not know what to do.
On the other side, Sadie, Sheldon, and the others naturally noticed Connor’s appearance at the party.
At this moment, they were very puzzled. They did not know how Connor came in.
However, they did not take the initiative to talk to Connor. Instead, they told Harold, Jovan, and the others about it.
When Jovan knew that Connor was also here, he was naturally very angry. After all, he could not forget about Connor slapping him. So, he walked over, wanting to mess with Connor, but he was stopped by Henry.
“Jovan, why are you in such a hurry? Those who are here today are all big shots. Since this kid is here, it means that he’s not a simple guy. We should figure out this kid’s identity before we make a move. Otherwise, it won’t be good if we really get into trouble…”
Henry pushed up his glasses and said in a low voice.
“Henry, what kind of background would this kid have? He’s just a poor loser!”
Jovan shouted.
“Jovan, Connor might really have some background we don’t know of…”
Harold hesitated for a moment before slowly saying.
“He has a background?”
Jovan was stunned for a moment, and he face seemed to be a little puzzled. Then he frowned and said, “What kind of background does Connor have?”

chapters.title: Chapter 959: Two Possibilities
chapters.content:
Chapter 959: Two Possibilities
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Harold looked at Connor and said in a low voice, “I’m not sure about Connor’s background, but when our school held the sports meet a few days ago, Connor invited a lot of sponsors, so if he’s really just a poor guy, he won’t know so many rich people!”
Although Harold, Sheldon, and the others weren’t around when the Porthampton University held the school sports meet, they had heard a little about what happened in the school.
Connor was now considered a celebrity in the Porthampton University. There were endless speculations about Connor’s identity.
Previously, when Harold was at the resort, he saw Leroy treated Connor and felt that it was rather odd. Then, there was the sports meet sponsorship, so Harold felt that something was off.
And now, Connor was here at such an event.
Harold, Sheldon, and the others were able to be here because they had entered through the back door. But Connor was actually here too.
All these things were connected together. Even if Harold was a fool, he would be able to realize that something was wrong.
“Didn’t we just invite a few sponsors? What’s so great about it?”
When Jovan heard Harold’s words, he looked extremely disdainful. He pursed his lips and replied.
“I wouldn’t be surprised if someone else had invited these sponsors. But, in the Porthampton University, every student knows that Connor is a poor loser. Now that this poor loser has such a powerful network, something just isn’t right…”
Harold analyzed in a low voice and then continued, “The requirements for today’s party are so high, but Connor was able to enter. There are only two possibilities!”
“What are the two possibilities?”
Jovan frowned and asked in confusion.
“Either Connor sneaked in, or Connor has some background!”
Harold said slowly.
“Harold, you sure you aren’t overthinking things?”
Jovan frowned slightly and said helplessly.
“I think what Harold said makes sense. Those who can attend this party are not ordinary people. It’s better for us to be more cautious!”
But at this moment, Henny also spoke up.
After hearing Henny’s words, Jovan’s eyes flashed with a trace of helplessness, and then he asked impatiently, “Then, what should we do now? He can’t just let this kid off like this, right?”
“It’s very simple. I’ll get my friend to investigate how Connor came in. If he sneaked in, then he’ll be in big trouble. We don’t need to do anything at all. Mr. Morgan will naturally help us teach him a lesson! If he didn’t sneak in, then we can also investigate Connor’s background. At that time, it won’t be too late for us to discuss how to deal with him!”
Harold had already thought about what to do and shared his idea.
When Henny heard this, he nodded gently and said in a low voice, “Harold is right. We can’t be careless. It’s better to investigate the matter clearly before dealing with this kid…”
“Then, go ask your friend!”
Jovan had a short temper and hurriedly shouted at Harold.
“Be patient!”
Harold replied softly, then walked to Sheldon. After a few exchanges with Sheldon, Sheldon began to look for Willard Ferguson.
After all, Willard’s father was the general manager of the hotel. It was very simple to find out how Connor came in.
A few minutes later, Willard returned.
When Connor entered the hotel, his registered identity was Nicole Cooper’s driver assistant, so Harold, Jovan, and the others figured that Nicole was behind Connor.
“Who is Nicole Cooper? Why haven’t I heard of her before?”
Henny asked in confusion.
“Nicole Cooper is the president of a listed company. I’ve seen her a few times before. She’s quite beautiful and has a very good figure…”
Jovan answered without thinking.
In fact, Jovan had pursued Nicole before. After all, Nicole was such a highly sought after lady. Jovan was very tempted.
However, because Nicole’s family was also considered a big family, Jovan did not continue to pester Nicole after being rejected.
“Does Nicole have any other background?”
Henny continued to ask.
“I don’t think so. Under normal circumstances, she wouldn’t be qualified to attend this party. It’s just that her company seems to have participated in the bidding for the subway project, so she’s qualified to be here!”
Willard seemed to be very afraid of Henny, so he replied respectfully.
“So? Are you both relieved now?”
Jovan asked Henny and Harold happily.
Henny didn’t say anything else after finding out that Connor had no other background.
Harold seemed to be a little solemn. It seemed reasonable that Connor knew Nicole and could invite so many sponsors. As for Cade Lambert’s appearance, it should be a coincidence. Harold did not think that Connor actually knew Cade. After all, Cade’s son, Jovan, was here.
However, Harold could not understand why Leroy was so afraid of Connor.
Nicole’s influence was not even comparable to Harold and Sheldon. Would Leroy be afraid of someone like Nicole?
Jovan did not give Harold the chance to continue speaking. He quickly walked toward Connor.
When Harold saw Jovan walking over, a trace of helplessness flashed in his eyes, but he did not say anything. After all, the person who was looking for trouble with Connor was not him.
When Sabrina saw Jovan walking toward them, she looked a little flustered. She had been worried that Jovan and the others would come and cause trouble for Connor. Jovan was surely up to no good.
“Connor, I want to go out and take a breather. Will you come with me…”
Sabrina knew that Connor would not leave even if she persuaded him to.
Therefore, she found a random excuse and wanted him to join her.
“Alright!”
Connor put down the pastry in his hand and nodded lightly.
“Let’s go!”
When Sabrina saw that Connor had agreed, she dragged him away without hesitation.
“Brat, stop right there!”
However, before Sabrina could bring Connor out of the hall, Jovan caught up and shouted at Connor.
When Sabrina heard this, a trace of despair flashed across her eyes. She did not know what to do.
…

chapters.title: Chapter 960: Jovan Lambert's Provocation
chapters.content:
Chapter 960: Jovan Lambert’s Provocation
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Originally, Connor wanted to go out with Sabrina to get some fresh air. However, before they could walk out of the hall, they heard Jovan shouting from behind.
So, Connor subconsciously stopped and turned to look at Jovan.
Jovan walked to Connor and looked at him from head to toe. Then he said coldly, “Brat, we meet again!”
Connor was somewhat confused as he asked in a low voice, “Do we know each other?”
“Why you…”
Jovan was speechless after hearing Connor’s words. He glared at Connor and didn’t know how to answer.
“Kid, don’t play dumb with me. Don’t you know me?”
Jovan pointed at Connor and shouted.
“I don’t!”
Connor shook his head without thinking.
At this time, Connor was not acting dumb, but he really did not remember Jovan.
“Last time at the Porthampton University, you ruined my plan. Now, you’re saying you don’t know me?”
Jovan reminded Connor.
Only then did Connor realize that the young man standing in front of him was the young man who had harassed Lindsy Park and was beaten up by him.
However, Connor had been thinking about Freya Phillips recently and had long forgotten about Lindsy and Jovan.
“Oh, it’s you? Do you need something?”
Connor was still very calm.
When Jovan saw Connor’s calm expression, a trace of doubt flashed in his eyes.
If it was a normal person who was questioned by him like this, they would have been so scared that they would not know what to do.
However, Connor appeared nonchalant. His attitude when talking to him was also very casual.
“I haven’t settled the score with you for what happened last time. Now, you actually dare to appear before me? Come out and have a chat with me!”
Jovan gritted his teeth and coldly said to Connor.
He knew that Connor’s skills were very good and he was not Connor’s match, so he planned to get Connor outside to deal with him.
“I don’t have time to talk nonsense with you!”
Connor said lightly.
“You don’t have time to talk nonsense with me? You’ll know if you have time when you follow me out!”
Jovan shouted at Connor.
“Jovan, what are you doing? Connor is my friend. Can you give me some face and not make things difficult for Connor?”
Sabrina stood in front of Connor and shouted at Jovan in a low voice.
“Give you face?”
When Jovan heard Sabrina’s words, he couldn’t help but sneer. Then, he said lightly, “Why should I give you face?”
“…”
Sabrina was dumbfounded. She didn’t know what to do. She didn’t expect Jovan to be so arrogant.
In fact, Jovan was not a fool. He knew that Sabrina was Charles Ziegler’s daughter. If it was in the past, Jovan might have given Sabrina some face.
However, ever since Connor ruined Jovan’s plan, Jovan hated Connor to the bone.
More importantly, since he would be able to get to know a big shot like Mr. McDonald soon, there was no need for him to put Sabrina in his eyes.
Jovan’s participation in the party this time was mainly arranged by Cade.
Seeing that the two sisters, Yarrow Lambert and Yucca Lambert, had not made any progress, he was very anxious to please Connor. After all, he was about to be transferred soon. He wanted to use his relationship with Connor to further improve.
Therefore, Cade wanted to introduce Jovan to Connor. After all, Jovan was about the same age as Connor. Moreover, Jovan had no other advantages except that he was good at playing. Therefore, Cade felt that Jovan might be able to improve the relationship between the Lambert Family and Connor.
To put it bluntly, Cade wanted Jovan to be Connor’s lackey.
Jovan was also very happy to have the chance to get to know a big shot like Mr. McDonald.
He felt that if he could get to know someone like Mr. McDonald in the future, not many people in the entire Oprana would dare to provoke him.
That was why Jovan did not put Sabrina in his eyes.
Sadie Colt, Yara Xenos, and the others also saw the situation here, so they all walked over to watch the show.
At this time, Sadie’s impression of Connor had plummeted, so she did not want to help Connor at all. She wanted to see Jovan teach Connor a lesson. Once Connor had suffered, he would not be so arrogant in the future.
“Jovan, what’s going on?”
Nicole hurried to Connor’s side and asked Jovan with a frown.
“Miss Cooper, I have a personal conflict with this kid. I want to go out and have a chat with him!”
Jovan turned and glanced at Nicole indifferently as he replied expressionlessly.
Nicole, on the other hand, looked helpless. She turned and looked at Connor. She could not understand how Connor had provoked someone like Jovan.
Nicole was also very clear about Jovan’s identity and background. She did not know about it now.
“Sabrina, let’s go!”
At this moment, Connor suddenly shouted at Sabrina.
“Brat, did I say that you could go?”
Seeing that Connor was about to leave, Jovan hurriedly shouted.
At this time, Jovan felt that Connor wanted to leave because he was afraid.
“What does it have to do with you whether I leave or not?”
Connor replied with a somewhat angry expression. Then, before Jovan could react, he continued, “I’m not in a good mood right now. I advise you not to provoke me. Otherwise, if you really provoke me, I won’t let you off even if your father kneels down and begs me.”
After Connor had finished speaking, everyone present was dumbfounded.
Even Sabrina, Nicole, and the rest could not help but gasp. They did not know what to do.
Sadie’s face was filled with despair. She didn’t expect Connor to be so arrogant.
How many people here didn’t know who Jovan’s father was?
Humiliating Jovan was one thing, now Connor was even bringing Cade into the picture. He was obviously provoking Jovan!
Nicole stood in place and looked at Connor. She was both worried and helpless. Things were already bad as it was. At this time, Connor’s words had undoubtedly offended Jovan!
If the matter blew up, even Nicole would not be able to save Connor.
When Harold saw this scene, a smug look flashed across his eyes because this was the result he wanted to see.
At this time, Harold knew that he did not need to do anything. He only needed to watch the show. Based on Jovan’s character, this matter would definitely not end here today.

chapters.title: Chapter 961: I'm Just Saying the Truth
chapters.content:
Chapter 961: I’m Just Saying the Truth
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
After Jovan heard Connor’s words, his expression was also very unbelievable.
He never expected Connor to have such audacity, daring to humiliate his father in front of so many people.
Almost everyone present knew Jovan’s father, Cade, and very few would dare to offend him!
In the Davenport, offending Cade was practically seeking death!
“You dare to humiliate my father?” Jovan shouted angrily at Connor, his eyes wide open.
“This is not humiliation; I’m just stating the facts,” Connor replied calmly, looking at him with a calm expression, seemingly unaffected by his anger.
The others present also looked at Connor with puzzled expressions.
They couldn’t understand where his confidence came from!
“Connor, just because you know Nicole, don’t think I won’t hurt you. Based on what you just said, not even a deity can save you!” Jovan pointed at Connor, shouting loudly.
“Is that so?” Connor smirked upon hearing Jovan’s words and coldly replied, “Well, I already said it earlier. What do you plan to do to me?”
Nicole nervously looked at Connor, feeling extremely helpless.
She never expected Connor to cause her so much trouble, and she couldn’t understand why he insisted on being so stubborn. If he had just softened a little, Jovan wouldn’t be so furious.
Nicole couldn’t comprehend his intentions at all!
“What do I plan to do to you?” Jovan hesitated after hearing his words, then said, “Connor, it seems you truly don’t know who I am. Earlier, I thought you had some background that made you fearless of me. But now I know that you have no idea what consequences await you for offending me!”
“What consequences?” Connor countered directly.
“Today, I’ll show you the consequences of offending me!” Jovan exclaimed with excitement.
Upon hearing Jovan’s words, Sadie, Sabrina and the others were stunned, their faces filled with fear.
They knew this matter would escalate today, as Jovan was preparing to take action.
Although Nicole couldn’t afford to provoke someone like Jovan, she couldn’t just stand by and watch Connor get into trouble.
So she quickly stood in front of Connor and said to Jovan, “Mr. Jovan, don’t forget what day it is today. This is Mr. Connor’s party. If you dare to cause trouble here, can you bear the responsibility?”
“Mr. Connor’s party?” Jovan hesitated, suddenly realizing the occasion. If he caused trouble here, it would be equivalent to offending Mr. Connor.
Jovan didn’t care about the others, but Mr. Connor was someone he couldn’t afford to offend, no matter how courageous he was!
He also knew that Mr. Connor was someone even his father had to please.
But he didn’t know that at this moment, Mr. Connor was standing right in front of him.
“So what if I offend Mr. Connor? I’ll personally apologize to him in the future. But today, I won’t let this kid off!”
Although Jovan had already given up on the idea of continuing to deal with Connor, he still refused to let it go. After all, if he really stopped because of Nicole’s words, it would be too embarrassing.
And Nicole also knew that he was trying to find a way out for himself, so he said, “Mr. Jovan, how about we let Connor apologize to you now, and we can consider this matter resolved?”
Jovan hesitated for a moment, then turned to look at Henny behind him.
Henny nodded directly. He also felt that causing trouble at Mr. Connor’s party was not a wise choice. Moreover, they already knew Connor’s identity, so it would be very simple to deal with him in the future.
Now all they needed was for him to apologize and give Jovan a way out, and this matter could come to an end.
“Kid, apologize to me now, and I’ll let you go today!” Although Jovan felt extremely unwilling in his heart, since Henny had already nodded, he could only grit his teeth and shout at Connor.
Connor’s mood was already not good because he was worried about Freya’s situation. Being provoked by Jovan at this moment made his mood even worse.
And he also knew that after attending this party, his identity would be exposed.
By that time, he wouldn’t need to hide his identity anymore, so he had no concerns right now.
“If you kneel down and apologize to me now, I’ll let the earlier incident slide for the sake of your father’s face,” Connor said coldly to Jovan.
Upon hearing his words, Jovan’s expression instantly became furious.
He never expected that he had already planned to let Connor off, but Connor still dared to ask him for an apology, and he even wanted him to kneel down and apologize!
Everyone present showed expressions of shock and confusion!
Nicole and Sabrina were even more devastated. After all, this was a hard-won opportunity for Nicole, but Connor’s words not only failed to seize the opportunity but also escalated the conflict directly.
Sadie looked at him with a disappointed expression. She couldn’t understand what was going on in his mind.
She also couldn’t understand where his courage came from to say such words.
Did Connor think he was invincible just because he knew Nicole?
Sadie felt that even if Connor could escape this disaster today, his future wouldn’t be promising. His character was too arrogant and domineering, and his background couldn’t support his current attitude.
Having pride as a young person is a good thing, but being too arrogant is not.
A real man knows how to adapt to circumstances and can bend when necessary to achieve great things.
But at this moment, Connor only knew how to be conceited!
If he really had such qualifications, Sadie thought it wouldn’t be a problem. But unfortunately, he didn’t have the qualifications to offend Jovan at all.
“Connor is really looking down on everyone. Maybe he just wants to show off in front of Sabrina, but he doesn’t realize the great price he has to pay for it!”
Sadie felt that the reason Connor acted this way was simply to show off in front of Sabrina.
But in the eyes of others, his behavior was extremely foolish!

chapters.title: Chapter 962: Are You Worthy of Fighting Me?
chapters.content:
Chapter 962: Are You Worthy of Fighting Me?
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
After Connor finished speaking, everyone present looked at him with a strange gaze.
As Connor faced the puzzled and perplexed looks from the crowd, his expression remained calm.
Because in his eyes, Jovan was nothing more than an ant-like existence.
He only needed a single phrase to trap Jovan in an irredeemable situation, where he would never have a chance to turn the tables in his lifetime!
Jovan didn’t realize the seriousness of the situation or how terrifying the person standing in front of him was!
So, in the face of Connor’s successive provocations, Jovan finally couldn’t hold back. He took a step forward, intending to attack Connor.
Harold thought that if Jovan started a fight now, it would surely implicate him.
He didn’t want to offend the legendary Mr. Connor, so he quickly held onto Jovan and whispered, “Jovan, calm down. If you dare to act now, it’s equivalent to offending Mr. Connor…”
