“My father knows Mr. Connor. After I deal with this kid, I’ll explain to him!”
Jovan shouted.
Upon hearing Jovan’s words, Connor smiled helplessly and secretly sighed that he had only met Cade once, so they couldn’t be considered acquaintances at all.
“Even if Uncle Cade knows Mr. Connor, if you act now, it will definitely cause big trouble. Moreover, this kid Connor is not ordinary. If a real fight breaks out, you won’t necessarily gain any advantage!”
Harold hurriedly continued.
“So what do you think we should do?”
Jovan thought Harold’s words made some sense, so after a moment’s hesitation, he asked.
After hesitating for a moment, Harold whispered to Connor, “Connor, if you really have the ability, come out and fight me now. If I win, you apologize to Mr. Jovan. If I lose, I apologize to you. How about it?”
Harold’s skills were known in Sutton, so he had the confidence to say such words.
“What are you? Are you even worthy of a one-on-one with me?”
Connor replied directly, his expression extremely disdainful.
In fact, he wasn’t bragging. Even if Harold, an ordinary person, had impressive skills, he would still not be Connor’s opponent, and he had no interest in fighting someone like Harold.
“If you think Harold alone isn’t enough, then add me to the mix. The two of us against you. What do you think?”
Jovan hurriedly shouted.
“Even the two of you are not enough!”
Connor shook his head again.
“If the two of them are still not enough, then add me as well!”
Henny, seeing Harold and Jovan’s stance, as the eldest brother, he naturally couldn’t stand by and watch. Even though he had no conflict with Connor, he still stood up.
After witnessing this scene, the onlookers were full of emotions.
They felt that although Connor didn’t have any impressive background or skills, he was quite good at offending people. He had directly offended the four most famous young masters of the four provinces. Fortunately, Arthur wasn’t present; otherwise, Connor would have offended all five of them!
Nicole was completely going crazy. She never expected him to be so ignorant.
“Connor, the three of us together against you, don’t you think it’s enough?” Jovan asked smugly.
He remained silent, looking at Jovan.
“What are you doing here?” However, at that moment, a reprimanding voice suddenly sounded.
Everyone turned their heads to see a middle-aged man in a suit walking towards them. It was Deckard Fanton, the general manager of the hotel.
Recognizing Deckard, Jovan hesitated for a moment before whispering to him, “Uncle Deckard, I’m just resolving a minor conflict here…”
Deckard glanced at Connor instinctively. Since he had never met Connor before, he didn’t recognize him. In a cold voice, he said to Jovan, “Mr. Jovan, the evening party is about to begin. Mr. Thomas and Mr. Connor could arrive at any moment. If they see this scene, your father won’t be able to save you. So, if there’s any conflict, wait until after the party to resolve it. Otherwise, don’t blame me for not giving you face!”
Deckard ‘s tone was firm, leaving no room for negotiation.
Jovan understood the meaning behind Deckard ‘s words, so he took a deep breath and said coldly to Connor, “Fine, consider yourself lucky today, kid. I’ll have plenty of opportunities to settle the score with you in the future…”
After saying these words, Jovan turned and left.
Harold glanced lightly at Connor. He believed Connor was already a dead man. Jovan would never let him go. The end of the evening party would be Connor’s deadline. With a cold laugh, Harold followed Jovan and left.
At this point, some guests had already started to enter the hotel entrance. Knowing that Mr. Connor would soon appear, the crowd didn’t continue focusing on Connor. Instead, they chose to wait at the entrance for the arrival of Thomas and Mr. Connor.
Nicole knew Jovan wouldn’t let Connor off easily, so she quickly told Connor not to cause any more trouble and hurriedly headed to the restroom.
In the restroom, Nicole planned to make a call to contact her family and see if there was any way to save Connor. Although she knew that dealing with Jovan would be extremely difficult, she didn’t want to give up on Connor easily. After all, Connor had saved her life.
Meanwhile, Sadie and Sabrina approached Connor. Sadie gave Connor a disdainful look and said in a sarcastic tone, “Connor, you’re becoming more and more impressive. You even dare to disregard Harold, Jovan, and Henny…”
“Yeah, Connor’s skills are really growing…” Yara chimed in, also showing her contempt.
Connor turned his head and looked at Sadie and Yara without saying a word.
Sabrina’s expression was filled with worry, and she quickly said to Connor, “Connor, you should really think about how to handle this situation. I’ve heard that Jovan, Henny, and the others are not good people. Anyone who provokes them doesn’t end up well…”
“The ones who should be worried are Jovan and the others, not me!” he replied calmly.
Sadie looked at Connor, her expression somewhat speechless, unsure of what to say.

chapters.title: Chapter 963: The Gala Begins!
chapters.content:
Chapter 963: The Gala Begins!
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
After Jovan and the others left, Connor didn’t care about what had just happened at all.
After all, someone like Jovan wasn’t worth Connor’s energy.
Soon, Thomas, Kyle, Charles, Cade, and other big shots walked into the hall.
Connor noticed that there was also a dignified middle-aged man accompanying Thomas. The middle-aged man bore some resemblance to Joey and should be Joey’s younger brother, Langston, who was also the most important figure in this event.
However, Connor didn’t see anyone from the Rockefeller family, or it could be said that Birdie wouldn’t personally attend such an occasion.
But all of this was no longer important because as long as Birdie received this message, Connor’s purpose would be achieved.
When most of the guests had arrived, Thomas directly instructed the hotel staff to open the doors to the hall.
Everyone followed Thomas, Kyle, and others into another hall.
It was only at this moment that Connor realized that the hall they had been in earlier was just a waiting hall. The actual party was taking place in the hall inside.
The interior hall was decorated much better than the exterior hall, and the banquet was already set up inside.
The staff began arranging the seating according to the guests’ status. The closer the position, the more prestigious the status, and the farther back, the lower the status.
After about ten minutes, most people had found their seats.
Sadie, Sabrina, Yara, and others came in through Fan Wei’s connections. They didn’t originally have seats, but Nicole saw that Connor knew Sadie, Sabrina, and others, so she arranged for them to sit beside her.
Nicole’s own seat was actually quite far back, but for Sadie, Yara, and others, having a seat was already good enough.
They didn’t dare to be picky in such a situation.
However, Sheldon and Harold were seated in a very prominent position because of Jovan’s relationship. After all, Jovan and Henny had terrifying backgrounds.
Harold behaved very naturally from start to finish because he had a good relationship with Jovan. It was only natural for him to sit beside Jovan.
Sheldon, on the other hand, was somewhat overwhelmed. He whispered to Jovan, “Thank you so much for arranging me in such a prominent position…”
Sheldon’s father was just a deputy mayor in a remote city, and he didn’t even have the qualifications to attend such an event. But now Sheldon could sit in the front three rows, and he was definitely very excited.
“It’s nothing. You’re Harold’s friend, so you’re my friend too,” Jovan seemed to still be recovering from what happened with Connor earlier and replied in a low voice.
“That Connor is really arrogant. I really don’t know where he gets the courage…” Sheldon knew what Jovan was thinking, so he quickly chimed in.
“Hmph…” Jovan snorted coldly and continued, “If it wasn’t for Deckard ruining my good time, I would definitely teach Connor a lesson. Even if he has a powerful background, it won’t matter…”
“Calm down. Now that we’ve figured out Connor’s identity, as long as we wait until the banquet is over, wouldn’t it be easy for us to deal with this kid?”
Henny noticed that Jovan’s voice was a little loud, so he reminded him softly.
Jovan took a deep breath and did not continue.
“I heard that Uncle Cade has a good relationship with Mr. Connor. Have you met Mr. Connor?”
At this moment, Harold was curious about who Mr. Connor really was. However, he noticed that the main seat at the table where Thomas, Cade, and others were sitting remained empty, indicating that Mr. Connor hadn’t arrived yet.
“I haven’t met this Mr. Connor either, but my father said that he would introduce me to Mr. Connor today…” Jovan said casually.
Upon hearing Jovan’s words, Sheldon, Harold, Henny, and the others naturally felt extremely envious. After all, they had witnessed the power and influence of Mr. Connor today. If Jovan could really get to know him, it would be like reaching the sky in one step.
Jovan himself was also very proud and continued, “Don’t worry, when we meet Mr. Connor later, I will definitely bring all of you along. I’ll introduce you to him, at least leaving him with some impression of you, right?”
“Well, thank you so much.” Sheldon gratefully exclaimed.
On the other hand, Harold and Henny felt somewhat disappointed. Among the four heirs of the provinces, the one with the most terrifying background and strength was Arthur, as the Synder family had already reached the core of power in Oprana. Next was Henny, and Jovan came after.
Harold, due to his father’s promotion, was on par with Jovan.
But if he got to know Mr. Connor, his network and connections might surpass those of Henny and Harold. That was the reason for their disappointment.
Sheldon, on the other hand, was not on the same level as Jovan, so he didn’t have such thoughts.
On the other side, Deckard approached Thomas after seeing that Mr. Connor hadn’t appeared yet. He asked softly, “Mr. Thomas, when is Mr. Connor coming? When do you think it’s suitable to start the event?”
“Mr. Connor is already here. If most of the guests have arrived, then let’s start!” Thomas replied.
“He’s already here?” Deckard’s eyes flashed with surprise.
Upon hearing this, everyone else also looked at Thomas with puzzled expressions.
After hesitating for a moment, Thomas stood up and walked to the stage at the front.
Everyone knew that when Thomas stepped onto the stage, it meant that the event was about to begin, so they all quieted down.
Thomas took the microphone from the host’s hand and briefly greeted the guests. Then, he turned his gaze to Connor, who was not far away.
Connor nodded slightly, indicating that Thomas could proceed.
Thomas smiled faintly and said softly, “Thank you all for taking the time to come here. I know that you didn’t come for me, but to meet our company’s CEO, Mr. Connor. And Mr. Connor is here among us today, so please welcome him to the stage to say a few words!”

chapters.title: Chapter 964: Connor Is Mr. Connor!
chapters.content:
Chapter 964: Connor Is Mr. Connor!
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
After Thomas finished speaking, the crowd immediately became restless!
These billionaires had gathered here for the sole purpose of meeting Connor in person, right?
At this moment, the mysterious Mr. Connor was finally going to appear, and these people were undoubtedly very excited.
“Who is this Mr. Connor exactly?”
“Yeah, Mr. Connor has already entered, why didn’t I see him?”
“I wonder if this Mr. Connor is really as young as others say…”
The crowd clapped and whispered among themselves.
Some even began to look around, wanting to catch a glimpse of this Mr. Connor.
Even Sheldon, Harold, Jovan, Sabrina, and others became filled with anticipation.
“I wonder if this Mr. Connor is handsome or not?”
Yara said with an infatuated look on her face.
Meanwhile, Connor took a deep breath. He knew that there were certain things he had to face sooner or later.
Moreover, with Freya’s whereabouts unknown, Connor had to seize the opportunity to meet Birdie and find Freya.
So Connor slowly stood up.
Upon seeing him stand up, Sadie was taken aback and then frowned, saying, “Connor, you’re not really thinking of yourself as the Mr. Connor, are you? Sit down quickly, now is not the time for your jokes! We don’t want to be embarrassed because of you!”
Connor had previously told Sadie that he was the Mr. Connor, but she didn’t take it seriously at all, which was why she said such words.
“Yeah, Connor, stop fooling around and sit down quickly!”
Nicole scolded angrily.
After all, with so many big shots present, it would be troublesome if Connor caused any misunderstanding.
“The Mr. Connor that Thomas mentioned is me!”
Connor ignored Sadie and explained to Nicole.
“You…”
She looked at him and was about to speak, but he didn’t continue wasting words. He simply walked slowly towards the stage.
“What are you doing, Connor?”
Nicole anxiously called out.
“Oh no, is Connor out of his mind? It’s not the time for him to mess around!”
Yara also shouted with watery eyes.
She wasn’t worried about Connor’s safety; she just didn’t want to be involved because of him.
Meanwhile, in an agitated tone, Sabrina wanted to call Connor back, but it seemed like he didn’t hear anything and continued walking forward.
“Connor!”
Sadie couldn’t bear it anymore and gritted her teeth as she shouted.
She felt extremely regretful because she felt that she had humiliated him just now, and he couldn’t bear to lose face, so he did this.
But it was too late for regrets now, Connor was still moving forward.
A few seconds later, the applause stopped, but the legendary Mr. Connor still hadn’t appeared.
At that moment, a man who looked similar to a waiter appeared in everyone’s sight.
Moreover, this man was gradually walking towards Thomas’s position.
“Why did Connor go over there?”
Harold muttered when he saw Connor.
Jovan instinctively paused for a moment and then disdainfully said, “Does he have a problem? It’s already this time and he dares to act recklessly. Does he think he has too much time to live?!”
Sheldon sneered and sighed in his heart.”Connor, ah, Connor, I think you’re really crazy. You still dare to make such a joke at a time like this? You’re simply courting death.”
At this moment, Connor had already walked down the stage and was about to walk up to the stage.
Previously, the security guards thought that Connor had something else to do, so they came over. However, when they saw that Connor was about to go on stage, they rushed over to stop him.
“Stop!”
But at this moment, Thomas suddenly shouted.
The security guards were stunned.
Thomas ran in front of Connor and greeted him softly, “Mr. Connor, you’re here!”
After Thomas said this, the entire banquet hall fell silent.
At that moment, the bosses present at the scene realized that the seemingly ordinary young man was actually the Mr. Connor they had been waiting for.
Kyle, Cade, and others stood up and shouted “Mr. Connor” one after another upon seeing Connor.
The simultaneous speech of these big shots confirmed Connor’s identity as Mr. Connor.
Jovan was dumbfounded, standing frozen in place, his expression filled with disbelief.
He couldn’t understand what was happening!
Meanwhile, Connor remained calm as he faced Thomas and the others, slowly walking up to the stage under the incredulous gazes of the crowd.
Sadie looked at Connor’s figure and felt like she was dreaming!
She felt that Connor’s figure at this moment was so unfamiliar yet so familiar.
Could it be that Connor was really the legendary Mr. Connor?
Sadie couldn’t believe this fact at all.
However, at this moment, this fact was undeniably real and presented right before her eyes.
The expressions on the faces of those who had never seen Connor were also filled with disbelief.
Because they never expected that the seemingly ordinary man in front of them was actually the legendary Mr. Connor!
But they didn’t dare say a word. After all, Thomas, Kyle, and others had already come forward to confirm Connor’s identity. They had no right to question it.
No matter how much Connor looked like an ordinary person, it couldn’t change the fact that he was Thomas, Kyle, and others’ boss. It couldn’t change the fact that Connor stood at the pinnacle of the Four Provinces, and apart from Rockefeller, no one in the Four Provinces dared to oppose Connor, Mr. Connor.
And there were very few people who knew about Rockefeller’s existence, so everyone thought that Connor was the number one person in the Four Provinces, and he was also the most outstanding existence in the Four Provinces!
Connor had achieved such a position at such a young age. If given a few more years, it was unimaginable what he could accomplish!
Sabrina stared with wide eyes, looking at Connor on the stage, her expression filled with shock.
“So Connor is Mr. Connor!”
Sabrina sighed softly.
Everything that had happened before suddenly made sense to Sabrina. Her worries about Connor vanished into thin air.
Now she understood why Connor had such an imposing manner, disregarding everyone.
It was all because Connor had the capital to do so!
“Connor, why didn’t you tell me earlier? If you had told me earlier, I wouldn’t have been so worried about you!”
Sabrina suddenly smiled with great happiness.

chapters.title: Chapter 965: Mixed Feelings
chapters.content:
Chapter 965: Mixed Feelings
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
After knowing that Connor is Mr. Connor, Sabrina smiled happily.
But Sadie, Yara, and others couldn’t find any reason to smile.
Yara’s mouth trembled uncontrollably. She seemed to have something to say but couldn’t find the words.
After all, in Yara’s eyes, Connor and Mr. Connor were not people from the same world. They could never be connected.
After all, one was a poor deliveryman struggling to make a living, while the other was a super-rich second generation known in the four provinces. How could they possibly be connected?
But the fact was right in front of her. Two unrelated individuals were now miraculously intertwined.
Apart from shock, fear appeared on her face.
After all, she had humiliated Connor more than once in the past!
If he were to seek revenge now, Yara would have no way out. That’s why her expression was extremely ugly.
Nicole stood still in a daze. She found everything unbelievable.
She never expected that it would end up like this. Nicole felt a mix of joy and astonishment in her heart, but also a sense of helplessness.
Jovan, Sheldon, Harold, Henny, and others gasped in disbelief. They opened their mouths but couldn’t say a word.
The atmosphere at the scene was extremely eerie, so eerie that it felt terrifying.
“How could this kid be Mr. Connor? This can’t be true. Am I dreaming?” Jovan shouted incredulously after two seconds of silence.
“Luo, you’re not dreaming. It’s all true!” Sheldon said helplessly, gritting his teeth.
“You’re lying. This Connor must be fake. He can’t be Mr. Connor, absolutely not…” But Jovan, as if going crazy, shouted with a ferocious expression.
Sheldon didn’t say much when he saw Jovan like this because he himself was in a precarious situation.
Harold, with a pale face, looked at Connor’s position and felt a surge of shock and terror in his heart!
Connor’s identity was finally exposed, but this was a result that Harold couldn’t accept.
Harold had always believed that Connor had a hidden background, but he had never found it. However, this time, Harold finally learned about Connor’s background!
“Connor, I never thought your schemes were so deep. You’ve hidden it for such a long time. You’re really impressive!” Harold couldn’t help but smile bitterly. Then he muttered to himself, “Connor, I admit that you’ve won this time. I didn’t expect you to be so patient. But what does that matter?”
“I may have lost now, but it doesn’t mean I’ll lose to you for the rest of my life. My abilities are not something you can compare to. One day, I will make you look up to me!”
When Henny heard Harold’s words, he couldn’t help but smile and then shook his head gently. “The current Connor is already so terrifying. In the future, he will probably surpass us even more. Even Arthur might not be his match!”
Henny referred to Arthur as one of the Four Heirs.
“It’s over. Everything is over!” Jovan said with a bitter smile.
Even Henny felt that Connor was stronger than Arthue. What qualifications does Jovan have to compete with Connor?
He had originally thought of relying on Mr. Connor to achieve rapid success, but he didn’t realize that he had already offended Mr. Connor unknowingly.
…
On the other side, Connor took the microphone from Thomas’s hand and glanced at everyone present.
Connor’s gaze was extremely dominant, as if no one could hold his gaze.
“First of all, I would like to thank all of you for giving me face and taking the time to attend my party. Some of you may have seen me before, but most of you probably haven’t. So let me introduce myself. I am Connor, the chairman of Empire World Corporation, and the Mr. Connor you often hear about!”
Connor spoke calmly to the crowd.
In an instant, applause thundered.
However, Jovan and the others did not applaud because they probably didn’t even catch what Connor was saying.
Next, following Thomas’s prompt, Connor casually said some polite words.
After finishing the pleasantries, Connor went straight to the point and looked at everyone, saying, “I called you all here today for one thing only, and that is for the company to participate in the bidding for the Metro Line 9 project…”
After hearing Connor’s words, the crowd began to whisper among themselves.
Some people, who had already heard the news, stayed in their place without saying a word.
“I believe that competition between companies is a common occurrence. The law of the jungle will never change in society. Competition brings development. Empire World Corporation competes with other companies bidding for the subway project, but I hope this competition remains normal and within limits!”
“The Metro Line 9 project itself is a project that benefits the people, so regardless of who wins the project, they must do their best to bring some benefits to the public!”
With a calm expression, Connor finished his speech and handed the microphone to Thomas before stepping down from the stage.
“Now, let’s invite Mr. Langston Shaw, the chairman of the Davenport Metro Corporation, to say a few words!”
Thomas shouted loudly.
Langston cooperatively walked onto the stage and began his speech.
His words were actually very simple. He basically told everyone that the bidding for this project was completely fair and hoped that capable companies would participate in the bidding.
The bosses present were not fools either. Langston appearing at Connor’s party and saying such things made it clear what it meant.
Langston was telling everyone that the project had already been decided, so others should not waste their efforts in bidding!
Nicole looked at Langston on the stage and seemed to suddenly understand something.
She thought that Connor was dealing with Birdie, but it was just her speculation without any evidence.
As for Sadie, Sabrina and others, they didn’t understand much about business matters, so they had no idea what Connor and Langston’s speeches meant. They were still shocked by the fact that Connor was Mr. Connor.
After Langston finished his speech, the party officially began.
The business tycoons who met Connor for the first time rushed to him and actively raised their glasses in a toast.
When Sheldon, Harold and others saw this scene, their hearts were filled with mixed feelings!

chapters.title: Chapter 966: Birdie Schroder's Arrival
chapters.content:
Chapter 966: Birdie Schroder’s Arrival
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Porthampton International Airport.
A Boeing airbus slowly landed on the ground of Porthampton airport.
When the cabin door opened, a woman in beautiful clothes walked out of the plane accompanied by her secretary. Then, she walked out of the airport in high heels.
The beautiful woman was dressed very nicely. She had thick makeup on her face and her clothes were very revealing. She wore a spaghetti t-shirt and a short skirt. Her long and straight legs were wrapped in a pair of black stockings.
She looked extremely pleasing to the eye.
Although this woman was dressed very ordinarily, she looked extremely sexy. Moreover, this woman’s clothes were all high-end international brands. Even an ordinary pair of stockings might cost thousands of dollars.
When this beautiful woman appeared in the airport lobby, she instantly became the focus of everyone’s attention. Even the flight attendants with graceful figures paled in comparison to this woman.
She had a slender figure and was naturally charming. Even her casual movements carried a trace of seduction, making people fall deeply into her grasp and be unable to extricate themselves.
Moreover, this beauty’s eyes were extremely arrogant, giving people a feeling of supremacy. It was as if these ordinary people in the airport could not attract her attention at all.
A moment later, the beautiful woman followed the secretary to the airport exit. A middle-aged man quickly walked up to her.
“Miss Schroder, the car is here!” the middle-aged man said respectfully.
The beautiful woman looked at the middle-aged man indifferently and walked straight to the parking lot without any hesitation.
This beauty was none other than Birdie Schroder, the person in charge of Rockefeller’s branch in Porthampton. She was also the breakthrough that Connor had tried his best to find. The middle-aged man was the head of the Lee Family in Porthampton, Tobey Lee!
Tobey was actually the one who sent the assassins to kidnap Nicole Cooper.
Tobey and Birdie walked into a black Mercedes-Benz. Tobey sat in the front passenger seat, while Birdie and the secretary sat in the back.
“How’s the situation on Thomas Morgan’s side?”
Birdie asked Tobey casually while looking at her phone.
“The party has already started. Thomas Morgan’s boss, Connor, has also appeared. Langston Shaw also made a speech at the party. He obviously wants to tell everyone that he’s preparing to give this project to Thomas Morgan and the others!” Tobey replied with a worried expression.
“I originally thought that Connor was just an ordinary person who lucked into Steven Lee’s inheritance. I didn’t expect him to have the ability to settle the matter with Langston Shaw so quickly!”
Although Birdie’s expression was very calm when she said this, she was actually very angry in her heart.
Tobey hesitated for a moment before turning his head and asking Birdie softly, “Miss Schroder, it’s almost impossible for us to win this project now. What do you plan to do next?”
Birdie’s eyes flashed with a strange look. Then, she stretched out her hand and gently rubbed her temples before saying in a low voice, “I originally thought that we could easily win this project, but I didn’t expect Connor to appear in the end. It’s really a headache…”
“That’s right. I didn’t expect Connor to have such ability. I thought he was just an ignorant rich heir!”
Tobey hurriedly added.
“We were too careless this time. The higher-ups of Rockefeller were already very dissatisfied with me when the oil project failed last time. If the subway project fails again this time, they will definitely take this opportunity to replace me!” Birdie said worriedly.
Hearing this, Tobey’s expression changed drastically as he stammered, “Then…Then what do you plan to do, Miss Schroder?”
Tobey was Birdie’s lackey. If Birdie was replaced, Tobey would definitely suffer as well.
Birdie narrowed her eyes and said in a low voice, “The easiest way now is to meet Connor and talk to him about the subway project…”
“Can we make Connor give this project to us just by meeting him?” Tobey asked in confusion.
“Connor’s attention is not on this project at all. His real goal is to lure me out. Otherwise, he wouldn’t have held a party at this time to let everyone know that this subway project is his!”
Birdie was very smart and immediately guessed Connor’s true intentions.
Tobey also suddenly came to a realization and hurriedly asked loudly, “Could it be that Connor wants to deal with Rockefeller?”
“That should be the case. Otherwise, there’s no way to explain his operations. Even if Connor gets the subway project now, he should be losing money, so I think this explanation is the most reasonable!”
Birdie nodded lightly.
Tobey hesitated for a moment before asking, “Then, Miss Schroder, what will you do?”
“As long as I can keep my current position, it doesn’t matter even if I have to pay something. Get your people to contact Connor. I want to find an opportunity to meet him personally!”
Although Birdie had already guessed Connor’s true intentions, this was the only path she could take.
She didn’t care if Connor really wanted to deal with Rockefeller. She only cared if she could keep her position as the person in charge.
“You want to meet Connor personally?”
Tobey seemed to be a little surprised. He hurriedly continued, “Why don’t I go meet Connor and have a chat? After all…”
“You don’t have enough weight behind you, and Connor won’t be interested in you. Since he wants to negotiate, then let’s show some sincerity,” Birdie interrupted.
Tobey knew that although Birdie looked calm, she was actually very frustrated. Therefore, he did not dare to say anything more. He could only nod and answer, “Alright, I’ll get someone to arrange it now…”
Birdie took a deep breath and squinted at the scenery outside the window.
A large organization like Rockefeller had extremely strict rules and regulations, and there was no humanity to speak of.
As long as one could bring benefits to Rockefeller, then no matter what their character was, they could survive in Rockefeller.
And those who couldn’t bring benefits to Rockefeller would eventually be abandoned.
As the person-in-charge of the Rockefeller branch in Davenport, Birdie was actually under a lot of pressure. However, after she took over the position, she had not achieved any good results. The higher-ups of Rockefeller had long been very dissatisfied with Birdie, so she had to win this subway project, no matter what.
This project was Birdie’s last chance to keep her position.
As for why Birdie valued this position so much, it was because the benefits and power that this position brought to her were definitely the most important.
However, Birdie also had some unknown reasons.
..

chapters.title: Chapter 967: A Small, Insignificant Presence
chapters.content:
Chapter 967: A Small, Insignificant Presence
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Inside the hotel, the party continued.
The big shots of the business world present all came to Connor’s side with wine glasses and toasted him one after another.
The reason why these people came to this party was actually mainly for Connor. They didn’t care about the subway project at all. They just wanted to meet Connor.
Connor’s alcohol tolerance was not very good. If he continued to drink like this, he would definitely lose his memory of the night.
After Thomas saw this scene, he quietly reminded Connor that he could replace the wine with tea.
Therefore, Connor picked up the teacup and responded to them one by one. Those business big shots were not dissatisfied with this situation at all. On the contrary, they were all very happy.
Sadie, Sheldon, Harold, and the others saw Connor being surrounded by a group of rich people, all of them trying to flatter him. They found the scene somewhat unbelievable and were somewhat unable to accept it.
“Mr. Jovan, Mr. Lambert is calling for you…”
At this moment, Cade Lambert’s secretary walked to Jovan’s side and whispered to Jovan.
Jovan didn’t know what was going on, but he didn’t dare to ignore the call. He quickly got up and left with Cade’s secretary.
A few minutes later, Sadie, Sheldon, and the others saw Cade walking toward Connor with Jovan.
“Mr. McDonald, we meet again!” Cade shouted happily at Connor.
“Hello, Mr. Lambert!”
Connor turned his head to look at Cade and replied indifferently.
“Mr. McDonald, let me introduce you. This is my son, Jovan…”
Cade didn’t feel Jovan’s standoffishness as he dragged Jovan to Connor while talking.
Connor turned his head and looked at Jovan, then said casually, “We know each other!”
“You know him?”
Cade’s expression seemed a little puzzled.
“That’s right!”
Connor nodded.
Jovan looked at Connor, face full of fear and his body trembling, not knowing how to deal with this situation.
Cade was not stupid. He knew his son’s character better than anyone else.
Therefore, he knew that Jovan must have offended Connor. Otherwise, Connor would never have such an attitude.
Originally, Cade wanted Jovan to suck up to Connor and be his lackey.
However, he didn’t expect that everything would be ruined in Jovan’s hands. His expression was extremely angry when he turned his head and glared at Jovan.
Jovan was so frightened by Cade’s gaze that his entire body trembled. For a moment, he did not know what to do.
“Mr. McDonald, let me toast you!”
Cade respectfully raised his glass to Connor.
But Connor did not even look at Cade. His attitude was very cold.
When he saw that, the expression on Cade’s face became even more nervous. However, because there were more people around, he did not dare to say anything more. He could only finish the wine in his glass, then turn around and leave with Jovan.
When Sheldon saw this scene, his heart was filled with worry and fear.
He was very afraid that Connor would take revenge on him, but after a while, Sheldon realized that Connor had no intention of responding to him at all.
This made Sheldon even angrier because he finally understood that Connor had never taken him seriously.
In Connor’s eyes, he was just a small, insignificant presence.
Even so, Sheldon knew that he couldn’t do anything to Connor because the gap between the two of them was too terrifying.
This kind of gap could not be made up by simple hard work.
Harold’s expression was also very angry, but Harold did not have the slightest intention of giving up on Connor. This was because he felt that even if Connor had such achievements now, so what? Sooner or later, he would trample Connor under his feet!
Of course, this was just Harold’s wishful thinking. At this time, he might not know that Connor’s background was not as simple as just being Thomas Morgan’s boss.
The power behind Connor was not something that an ordinary person like Harold could imagine.
Half an hour later, almost all the bosses present had finished toasting Connor. Connor returned to Nicole and the others.
“Connor, you’re actually Mr. McDonald?”
When Sabrina saw Connor coming over, she hurriedly called out to him.
“I’m sorry. I couldn’t tell you my true identity for some reasons!” Connor knew that Sabrina and Nicole were probably the only ones who were worried about him, so he took the initiative to explain things to them.
“It’s okay, Connor. There must’ve been some difficulties if you couldn’t tell me about it…” Sabrina replied sensibly.
Connor smiled faintly and patted Sabrina’s head without saying anything.
When the rich people around saw how intimate Connor and Sabrina were, they were naturally envious. They thought that Charles Ziegler was really something to actually introduce his daughter to Connor in advance. If they had known about this earlier, they would definitely not have missed such an opportunity.
Cade’s face was filled with anger. He was already very angry when Yarrow and Yucca failed previously. Now that Jovan had offended Connor, Cade felt that getting close to Connor in the future would definitely be more difficult than ascending to the heavens.
After chatting with Sabrina for a while, Connor turned to look at Nicole and said, “Nicole, I’m really sorry for not telling you my true identity earlier…”
“No… It’s okay…” Nicole looked at Connor and smiled bitterly. At this moment, she did not seem to know what to say.
“Nicole, I heard that your company also deals in construction materials, right?” Connor asked.
“Yeah, why?” Nicole replied in confusion.
“Although I snatched this subway project from you, I can guarantee you that no matter which company gets this project in the end, they will buy building materials from your company!”
Connor said directly.
“Connor, do you mean it?”
Nicole shouted excitedly when she heard this.
In fact, Nicole did not have much of a chance to get this subway project. After all, she could not deal with the people in Rockefeller at all.
However, if Connor agreed to buy building materials from her company, it would be a great thing for her company. This way, not only could they make up for the previous losses, but their company could also make a fortune.

chapters.title: Chapter 968: Revenge
chapters.content:
Chapter 968: Revenge
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
“Connor, are you kidding me?”
Nicole looked at Connor in disbelief and asked.
“Of course not!”
Connor replied with a smile. He was only doing this to compensate Nicole.
“Thank you so much!”
Nicole said happily.
Connor didn’t continue to speak, but turned his gaze to Sadie and Yara.
When Yara realized that Connor was looking at her, she quickly lowered her head and did not dare to look at Connor directly. Because she had offended Connor many times before, she was very worried that Connor would come to take revenge on her.
But in fact, Connor didn’t have the intention to pay attention to Yara at all. This kind of woman wasn’t worthy of his time.
Connor turned his gaze to Sadie.
Sadie watched Connor fall into silence. At this moment, her pretty face had a very complicated expression. There was doubt and confusion, but most of it was shock and regret.
She was shocked that Connor had suddenly become Mr. McDonald!
She regretted not grasping the opportunity back then and not building a good relationship with Connor.
Originally, she could have been the first to get the moon. Once she took the initiative to express her goodwill to Connor, she might be able to be with Connor. However, she chose Sheldon.
Sheldon was like the earth when compared to Connor, who was like the sky!
“Actually, I already told you before that I am Mr. McDonald, but you treated me as a joke. Do you still think that what I said back then was funny?”
Connor asked Sadie softly.
“…”
Sadie’s pretty face blushed, and she felt a little ashamed for a moment.
“I told you, the one who is truly laughable is not me, but you. Do you understand now?”
Connor looked at Sadie and continued.
“Connor, so what if you are Mr. McDonald?”
Sadie shouted at Connor as if she was unwilling to give up.
“So what?”
Connor sneered and said in a low voice, “If your dad finds out about my identity, he will beg me to be with you.”
“You!” Anger flashed across Sadie’s eyes.
“But don’t worry, I’m not interested in you!” After saying this, Connor turned around and walked into the distance.
Previously, Connor did not want to expose his identity, so he had suppressed a lot of emotions towards Sadie. Now, his emotions were finally released.
Sadie looked at Connor’s back and felt endless regret.
At this moment, she recalled what had happened before and realized how stupid and ridiculous she had been.
“How did Connor suddenly become Mr. McDonald? Wasn’t he just a delivery man? Sadie, didn’t you say that you knew him very well?”
Yara asked Sadie softly after seeing Connor leave.
Sadie stood rooted to the ground and didn’t say anything. This was because the blow to her was too great.
“Sadie, when did Connor tell you that he was Mr. McDonald? Why didn’t you tell us?”
Yara continued to ask Sadie when she saw that she didn’t say anything.
“At that time, I merely felt that Connor was bragging. I did not expect that all of this was actually true…”
Sadie smiled bitterly and explained to Yara.
Yara looked helpless, not knowing what to say.
Jovan, Sheldon, Harold, and the others also had a heavy atmosphere hanging over them. Everyone had seen the conflict between Jovan and Connor, so now many people were gloating. They felt that Connor would definitely not let Jovan go.
“I didn’t expect Connor to be that Mr. McDonald…”
Henny could not help but sigh softly.
“So what if he’s Mr. McDonald? I don’t believe that he has the guts to do anything to me. The matter between us is not over…”
Jovan did not show any timidity for the sake of his wounded pride. However, he was already so scared that he didn’t know what to do.
Henny felt helpless when he heard Jovan’s words. He couldn’t help but try to persuade him. “Jovan, this Mr. McDonald is not simple. I advise you not to provoke him!”
“So this matter is over just like that?”
Jovan said with his eyes wide open.
“So what if it is? Are you planning to go against Mr. McDonald? Anyway, I don’t intend to interfere in this matter. I still have something to do, so I’ll take my leave first…”
Henny felt that if he continued to get involved in these matters, he would definitely not end up well, so after saying this, he turned around and left.
“Henny…”
Jovan saw Henny leave and shouted anxiously.
Jovan had some confidence with Henny around, but now that even Henny was afraid, he was even more timid.
At this moment, a middle-aged man walked up to Jovan and said softly, “Mr. Jovan, Mr. Lambert is calling for you!”
Jovan was dumbfounded when he heard this. He knew that Cade must have known what was going on and was ready to find him to punish him. But at this time, so many people were watching. If he didn’t dare to go over, it would be too embarrassing.
Therefore, Jovan hesitated for two seconds before he stood up and left with the middle-aged man.
After Sheldon saw Jovan leave, he took a deep breath and whispered to Harold, “Is there anything wrong with Jovan?”
“Connor definitely won’t let Jovan go, but I think no matter what, Jovan is Cade’s son, so Connor probably won’t do anything to him!”
Harold expressionlessly analyzed.
“Jovan will be fine, but will Connor take revenge on us?”
Sheldon continued to ask.
“I don’t think so. If Connor wanted to take revenge, we would have done so long ago, but he never made a move!”
Harold shook his head and added, “Connor might not thought highly of us from the beginning…”
After Sheldon heard Harold’s words, he could not help but laugh bitterly. Then, he slowly stood up and said, “Since Connor doesn’t think highly of us, then what are the two of us still doing here? Let’s hurry up and leave!”
“Connor, I will surpass you one day!” Harold took a deep breath, then stood up and left with Sheldon.
On the other side, after Jovan was taken away by the middle-aged man, he took the elevator directly to the top floor of the hotel.
Jovan was still very nervous because he didn’t know what was waiting for him.

chapters.title: Chapter 969: Miss Phillips Was Not Found
chapters.content:
Chapter 969: Miss Phillips Was Not Found
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Jovan followed the middle-aged man to the top floor of the hotel.
There weren’t many people on the top floor; only Connor, Thomas, Kyle, Cade, and the others were there.
Any one of these people could be considered one of the best in Porthampton.
However, at this moment, these people were all standing behind Connor. Only Connor was sitting on the sofa.
From this point, one could see how terrifying Connor’s identity was!
After Jovan saw Cade, his expression was extremely ugly. He knew in his heart that today’s matter was definitely not as simple as he imagined.
After hesitating for a moment, he slowly walked to Cade’s side and asked in a low voice, “Dad, why did you call me over?”
Cade gritted his teeth and asked in a low voice, “Did you offend Mr. McDonald?”
“I… I didn’t know he was Mr. McDonald…” Jovan knew that he had already known the truth, so he didn’t try to lie.
Cade didn’t even think about it and slapped Jovan’s face. Then, he shouted with a cold face, “Are you f * cking tired of living? How dare you offend Mr. McDonald? Do you know that you might as well be asking for death?”
After Jovan was slapped by Cade, his expression was abnormally angry. He gritted his teeth and stood in place, looking at Connor, but had no intention of resisting; At this time, he had already realized the seriousness of the situation.
“Why are you still standing there? Hurry up and apologize to Mr. McDonald!” Cade shouted angrily when he saw Jovan standing still.
Jovan hesitated for a moment, then slowly walked in front of Connor and said in a low voice, “Connor, it was all my fault. I’m sorry!”
Connor looked up at Jovan and said expressionlessly, “Do you still want to fight me one-on-one now? Do you still want to deal with me?”
“I…”
Jovan didn’t know how to answer.
“Kneel down and apologize to Mr. McDonald!”
At this moment, Cade shouted at Jovan again. Jovan was instantly dumbfounded after hearing Cade’s words. He hurriedly turned his head to look at Cade, as if he didn’t quite understand what Cade meant.
Cade saw that Jovan didn’t respond and continued to shout loudly. “I told you to get on your knees and apologize to Mr. McDonald. Didn’t you hear me?”
“Why should I kneel down and apologize to him? I’ve already apologized just now…”
Jovan felt that apologizing to Connor was already the biggest concession, but if he had to kneel down and apologize, he simply couldn’t do it.
“Cut the crap. If I tell you to kneel, then kneel!”
Cade couldn’t care less now. After all, even if he had the guts to do so, he would never dare to offend Connor!
Therefore, he lifted his leg and kicked Jovan’s butt.
“Thud!”
Jovan lost his balance and fell to his knees.
Connor sat on the sofa and looked at Jovan expressionlessly.
“Apologize!”
Cade glared at him and shouted angrily.
Jovan looked at Connor with a complicated expression. He had never thought that he would kneel in front of Connor one day. This had dealt a heavy blow to his self-esteem.
But now that things had come to this, Jovan knew that if he didn’t kneel down and apologize to Connor, he would definitely die in the end.
“I’m sorry!”
Jovan gritted his teeth and shouted at Connor with a ferocious expression.
Connor didn’t want to waste time on Jovan, so he directly said to him, “From today onwards, I don’t want to see this person anymore. Do you understand what I mean?”
“I… I understand…”
Jovan took a deep breath and nodded at Connor.
“Then get lost!”
Connor waved his hand lightly.
Cade was relieved after hearing Connor’s words. After all, this result was already very good for him, so he did not hesitate at all. He hurriedly bowed to Connor and then dragged Jovan away.
Connor sat quietly on the sofa and looked at Jovan’s retreating back. He smiled helplessly, then turned to look at Thomas and asked softly, “Do you think the people in Rockefeller have received the news?”
“They should have. After all, the scale of this gala is so large, so they must have noticed it!” Thomas replied.
“It’s good that they noticed!”
Connor nodded gently, then looked at Thomas and continued to ask, “Is there any news about my fiancée?”
“I’ve basically used all the connections I can make use of, but I still haven’t found Miss Phillips. I don’t think Miss Phillips is in any danger now because there haven’t been any murders in the area where she is located…”
Thomas said.
“Hu…”
Connor took a deep breath, and the expression on his face seemed to be somewhat solemn.
Connor had a clear understanding of Thomas’s connections. Since even Thomas could not find out Freya’s whereabouts, it meant that Freya’s disappearance had something to do with Rockefeller, or Thomas would have found out something by now.
“I’ll leave the matter of the gala to you. If there’s any news from my fiancée, you must inform me immediately!”
At this moment, Connor’s mind was no longer on this banquet. When he heard that there was still no news of Freya, his mood naturally became even heavier. He stood up and prepared to leave.
“Mr. McDonald, let me send you back!” Kyle quickly said to Connor.
“No need. You can stay here to receive the guests at the party!”
Connor directly waved his hand and refused.
“Alright…” Kyle nodded slightly and didn’t leave with Connor.
Connor left the hotel alone in the elevator.
However, just as Connor walked out of the hotel, he saw a black Mercedes-Benz driving towards him.
Connor’s eyes flashed with a trace of doubt when he saw the Mercedes-Benz.
Soon, the Mercedes-Benz stopped in front of Connor. A middle-aged man came out of the car and said respectfully to Connor, “Hello, Mr. McDonald!”
Connor sized up the middle-aged man in front of him. His expression was very vigilant because he did not know this middle-aged man.

chapters.title: Chapter 970: Birdie Schroder’s Invitation
chapters.content:
Chapter 970: Birdie Schroder’s Invitation
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Connor looked at the middle-aged man walking towards him with a vigilant expression.
After all, Connor was holding a party today and had exposed his identity in front of so many people. Basically, anyone with even some status would know about Connor’s identity.
It would be troublesome if the other party wanted to take revenge on him or kidnap him.
Therefore, Connor kept his guard up. He was observing the middle-aged man’s every move.
If the other party dared to act rashly, Connor could guarantee that he would be controlled at the first moment.
However, after observing for a while, Connor found that this man shouldn’t be a bad person. This was because the man’s behavior when approaching Connor was very natural. Moreover, the man didn’t have any other helpers behind him and was approaching him alone.
Therefore, Connor relaxed a little.
A moment later, the middle-aged man walked in front of Connor and asked respectfully, “Excuse me, you should be Mr. McDonald, right?”
“I am. Who are you?” Connor replied indifferently.
“Mr. McDonald, I’m Tobey, the chairman of the Lee Group in Porthampton!”
The middle-aged man explained with a smile.
“Tobey?”
When Connor heard this name, a trace of doubt flashed across his eyes. He had never heard of this name before.
After seeing Connor’s reaction, Tobey acted very naturally and said with a smile, “Mr. McDonald, it’s fine if you don’t know me, but you must have heard of Miss Birdie Schroder, yes?”
“Birdie?”
The expression on Connor’s face was somewhat shocked.
Although Connor and Thomas Morgan had already expected that after this party, Rockefeller would definitely come to find them as soon as possible.
After all, there were less than two days left until the auction began. Birdie did not dare to delay.
However, Connor never expected Birdie’s reaction to be so fast.
He had just finished his party, and Birdie had already sent someone to look for him.
After hesitating for a moment, Connor sized up Tobey and asked indifferently, “Is there anything you want from me?”
“Mr. McDonald, Miss Schroder wants to meet you. Do you have time now?”
Tobey replied.
“…”
Connor hesitated for two seconds, then nodded and said, “I have time!”
“This way please!”
Tobey took the initiative to lead the way after seeing Connor agree. He brought Connor to the door of a Mercedes-Benz.
Connor didn’t waste any words and walked inside.
After getting into the car, the driver started the car and drove ahead.
Tobey sat in the front passenger seat and didn’t say a word. Connor sat alone in the back seat and played with his phone.
Connor originally planned to call Thomas Morgan and tell him about the situation on his side. However, after thinking for a moment, he felt that he should not be in any danger. If Birdie wanted to deal with him, she could have done it directly. There was no need to .
Moreover, it seemed meaningless to inform Thomas Morgan and the others about this matter, so Connor did not make this call in the end.
Connor felt that since Birdie was so anxious to meet him, it meant that she must be very anxious. In this case, he should be able to take the lead when he negotiated with Birdie later.
About half an hour later, the Mercedes-Benz stopped in front of a clubhouse.
Connor squinted at the name of the club and could not help but mutter, “Bright Moon Club?”
This club was very famous in Porthampton. Before Connor had gotten the inheritance, he had heard of this club. It was said that many rich people in Porthampton, especially men, liked to come to this club to play.
“Mr. McDonald, please come in!”
After Tobey got out of the car, he took the initiative to open the door for Connor and then whispered to Connor.
Connor stepped out of the car and followed Tobey into the clubhouse.
Walking into the clubhouse, the first thing that greeted Connor’s eyes was a huge classical landscape painting. Moreover, the architectural style of the clubhouse was all built in a similar way as ancient palace architecture. It gave people the feeling that they had come to a real, glorious palace.
Even if they didn’t come here to spend money, it would definitely be a world-class tourist attraction if they treated it as one.
However, Connor knew that the people who came to this place did not just come to see the scenery.
“Mr. McDonald, there’s a party at your place today, so there’s less than half of the guests in the clubhouse. Normally, there would be a lot of guests!”
Tobey said to Connor with a smile.
“I’ve heard about the Bright Moon Club!”
Connor replied indifferently.
“Haha…”
Tobey smiled faintly and continued to walk towards the front of the clubhouse.
Along the way, Connor saw many beautiful waitresses with exquisite looks and graceful figures. These waitresses were dressed very provocatively, and any one of them could be a goddess-level existence!
Moreover, Connor also found that the deeper he went, the higher the quality of the beauties. Connor could not help but take a few more glances.
Connor finally understood why this Bright Moon Club was so famous.
A few minutes later, Connor followed Tobey to a private room.
“Mr. McDonald, Miss Schroder is already waiting for you in the private room. Please come in!”
Tobey suddenly stopped and whispered to Connor.
After Connor heard Tobey’s words, his expression seemed to be a little hesitant because he didn’t know if he should go in or not.
However, Connor felt that since he had already come, if he did not go in now, it would really be too embarrassing.
Therefore, after taking a deep breath, he directly walked into the private room.
After entering the private room, Connor found a very pretty woman sitting inside.
The woman had light makeup on and looked charming. She was wearing a tight black T-shirt that perfectly outlined her curves. Her waist was slender, and she was wearing a short skirt that revealed her two slender and fair legs. She was also wearing a pair of red high heels, making her look exceptionally sexy and charming.
At this time, Birdie was sitting on the sofa, looking at the laptop in front of her. Her expression was unusually serious, as if she did not realize that Connor had already entered the room.
Tobey hesitated for a moment before saying, “Miss Schroder, Mr. McDonald is here!”
After Birdie heard Tobey’s words, she slowly raised her head and looked at Connor. Then, she stood up and said to Connor with a smile, “Hello, Mr. McDonald!”

chapters.title: Chapter 971: I Want You to Serve Me
chapters.content:
Chapter 971: I Want You to Serve Me
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
When Birdie saw Connor come in, she hurriedly walked up to him in her high heels.
Then, she bowed slightly to Connor, revealing a mesmerizing scene. He smiled and said, “Mr. McDonald is indeed as young and handsome as the rumors say…”
“Miss Schroder, you’re also very beautiful…”
Connor replied indifferently.
“Hurry up and sit down!”
Birdie extended her fair finger and pointed at the tea table.
Connor didn’t think too much about it and sat on the sofa. Birdie chose to sit opposite Connor.
Tobey tactfully left.
Connor carefully sized up Birdie in front of him. He was still very surprised.
He didn’t expect the person in charge of Rockefeller in Porthampton City to be so young and beautiful.
Birdie picked up the teapot and poured a cup of tea for Connor. She said softly, “Mr. McDonald, do you like to drink tea?”
“I can drink anything…”
Connor replied indifferently.
“How about you try this?”
Birdie gave Connor a seductive smile and made an inviting gesture.
Connor hesitated for a moment before picking up the teacup and taking a sip. Then, he said expressionlessly, “I can’t taste anything!”
When Birdie heard what Connor said, a hint of helplessness flashed in her eyes.
After all, this cup of tea was Darjeeling tea from the famous Jentown. Ordinary people might not have the chance to drink this in their lifetime, but here he was saying that it was tasteless. Birdie must be very speechless.
However, Connor was not lying because this cup of tea really did not taste like anything to him.
Sometimes, Connor really didn’t understand what those rich people were thinking. Whether it was red wine or famous tea, there was no difference in Connor’s eyes.
To put it bluntly, whether it was a ten-dollar red wine or a hundred-thousand-dollar red wine, there was no difference in Connor’s eyes.
The same was true for tea leaves.
Connor felt that this might be the difference between him and those rich people!
Connor was actually not very interested in this kind of stuff.
On the contrary, he was very interested in the lady in front of him, because Connor felt that there was something very strange about this woman.
That was the look in Birdie’s eyes!
Birdie’s eyes looked pure and clear. There was not the slightest impurity in them. It was as if a fairy had descended to the mortal world.
However, this kind of gaze was obviously abnormal in Connor’s eyes. Because in today’s society, no woman could have such clean eyes, especially a woman like Birdie.
That was why Connor felt that Birdie was not a simple woman. The look in her eyes must be a disguise. The cleaner her eyes were, the more complicated her heart was.
“Mr. McDonald, let me introduce myself. My name is Birdie Schroder, the owner of this Bright Moon Club!”
Birdie said to Connor.
“You’re actually the boss of Bright Moon Club? Amazing!”
Connor said lightly.
“Mr. McDonald, I can give you a Platinum Member card of our club later. With this membership card, you can have any woman in our club serve you!”
Birdie smiled at Connor.
“Any woman?”
Connor asked after being stunned for a moment.
“That’s right, as long as it’s a woman from our place!”
Birdie nodded lightly, her expression somewhat proud, because she felt that no man could resist such temptation.
Connor smiled playfully and said, “Then, I want you to serve me, is that okay?”
When Birdie heard Connor’s words, a trace of anger flashed across her eyes because no one had dared to say such words to her!
However, knowing that she had a favor to ask of Connor, she did not reveal her anger. Instead, she said indifferently, “I’m sorry, I’m not included!”
“That’s a pity!”
Connor looked at Birdie’s long and fair legs and couldn’t help but sigh. Then, he continued, “I’m not interested in other women, so I don’t want your membership card. Let’s talk about something serious!”
“Something serious?”
Birdie was stunned.
“What other identity do you have?”
Connor asked Birdie.
“I’m the person in charge of Rockefeller in Porthampton!”
Seeing Connor being so direct, she didn’t waste time and told him who she was.
“Then, why did you ask me to come here today?”
Connor looked at Birdie and asked.
“Mr. McDonald, since you’re already being so straightforward, I won’t waste any more time with you. I called you over today to talk to you about the subway project…”
Birdie went straight to the point.
“…”
Connor looked at Birdie without saying anything.
“You’re really good. In less than two weeks, you’ve already won this project. I really admire you!”
Seeing that Connor didn’t say anything, she continued.
“The bidding hasn’t even started yet. How do you know that I’ve already won this project?”
Connor asked indifferently.
“Mr. McDonald, don’t beat around the bush with me. You should know better than me whether you have won this project or not. Also, there’s no need to beat around the bush with you. This project is very important to me, so I hope that Mr. McDonald can give this project to me!”
Birdie said to Connor.
“Haha…”
After hearing Birdie’s words, Connor couldn’t help but sneer. Then, he said indifferently, “Miss Schroder, we’ve only known each other for less than half an hour. Now, you want to take this project away with just a few words. Does that make sense to you?”
“Mr. McDonald, didn’t you take this project to lure me out? Now that I’m sitting in front of you, you can ask for anything you want. As long as it’s within my ability, I’ll agree to it!”
Birdie looked at Connor and said seriously.
Connor didn’t think that Birdie would have already seen through his intentions and was somewhat surprised.
Therefore, after hesitating for a moment, Connor continued, “Alright, if that’s the case, I won’t beat around the bush with you either. I do have a few things that I want you to do. As long as you can do these things well, I can give you the project!”
“A few things?”
Birdie’s eyes flashed with a trace of helplessness. She secretly felt that Connor was rather greedy.
However, she still nodded and said, “Alright, tell me what they are!”

chapters.title: Chapter 972: Three Things
chapters.content:
Chapter 972: Three Things
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Seeing that Birdie had agreed so readily, Connor was somewhat shocked.
However, he could tell from Birdie’s reaction that she really valued this project. Otherwise, she wouldn’t have agreed so readily.
“First of all, I need you to help me investigate the cause of my parents’ death!”
Connor thought for a moment and said to Birdie expressionlessly.
“The cause of your parents’ death?”
Birdie looked at Connor’s face with confusion. She didn’t expect Connor to make such a request.
“My father’s name is Dawson McDonald, and my mother’s name is Sharon Lee. When I was in elementary school, the two of them left this world in an accident. At first, I thought that my parents’ deaths were just a coincidence, but later I found out that my parents’ deaths weren’t a coincidence.”
Connor explained in a low voice.
This was the first time Connor had told an outsider about his parents. This memory had always been sealed in Connor’s mind, and he rarely mentioned it to others.
Birdie looked at Connor with a puzzled expression. She frowned and said, “Mr. McDonald, you are now considered the number one person in the four provinces. The connections you have are not something that a nobody like me, the person-in-charge of Rockefeller, can compare to!
“What I don’t understand is, why don’t you investigate this matter yourself?”
Connor slowly raised his head and looked at Birdie after hearing her words.
He could tell from Birdie’s reaction that she did not seem to know about his parents’ death. Otherwise, Birdie must have really outstanding acting skills.
Since things had already reached this stage, there was no need to hide anything.
So, he answered, “Your connections are indeed not as good as mine, but only you can investigate the cause of my parents’ death!”
“Why?”
Birdie looked at Connor and was even more confused.
“Because my father called your father before he died. At that time, your father was the person-in-charge of Rockefeller in Porthampton. Soe, I think that the death of my parents must have something to do with Rockefeller or your father.”
Connor replied.
“I see!”
Birdie’s eyes flashed with a strange look.
She had never thought that her father would be related to the death of Connor’s parents.
“Can this be done?”
Connor asked Birdie expressionlessly.
“Mr. McDonald, aren’t you afraid that my father killed your father and I’ll make up an excuse to brush you off?”
Birdie said slowly.
“You can’t lie to me. I just need to investigate to know if you’re lying to me!”
Connor said confidently.
“…”
Birdie looked at Connor and hesitated for a couple of seconds, then nodded lightly and said, “Alright, since you trust me so much, I’ll help you ask about this matter when I get back…”
“Alright, let’s talk about the second thing!”
Connor said.
Birdie didn’t say anything, quietly waiting for Connor to speak.
“The second matter is actually very simple. I hope you can help me investigate if a woman named Freya Phillips is being controlled by your people!”
Connor said.
“And this person is…”
Birdie did not seem to know who Freya was, and she was somewhat puzzled.
“Freya Phillips is my fiancée. She is studying in the U.S., but I suddenly can’t get hold of her, and I can’t find any news about her. I’m worried that your people from Rockefeller have done something to my fiancée, so I hope you can help me investigate this matter!”
Connor said slowly.
“I can only try my best to help you inquire about this matter, but I can’t guarantee that I can find this person. After all, I’m just the person-in-charge of Porthampton. There are many things that I can’t gain access to!”
Birdie said tactfully.
Connor smiled faintly when he heard Birdie’s words, then said softly, “Miss Schroder, I’m not discussing this with you right now. I need you to find out if Freya was kidnapped by people from Rockefeller. The only answer you can give me is yes or no. I don’t want to hear any uncertain answers!”
“Haha…”
Birdie looked at Connor with a faint smile, then nodded and said, “I understand. Once these two things are done, can you give me the subway project?”
“There’s a third thing!”
Connor said.
When Birdie heard that there was a third thing, she became a little helpless. She secretly felt that Connor was really pushing his luck. He was asking her to do so many things as soon as he opened his mouth.
Birdie didn’t plan to do what Connor wanted. She felt that she just needed to create an answer. Connor probably won’t be able to tell if her answer was true or not.
“What’s the third thing?”
Birdie asked Connor.
“The third thing is, from now on, you have to cooperate with me. No matter if there is any news or movement from Rockefeller, you have to inform me immediately. Or if I need you to do something, you have to cooperate with me immediately!”
Connor said lightly.
Birdie was stunned. Her expression was one of disbelief.
Birdie never thought that Connor would be so bold. Although Connor said that he wanted to cooperate, he actually wanted Birdie to be a spy for Connor.
Birdie couldn’t understand where Connor got the courage to make such a request!
The first two tasks were not too difficult for Birdie, but the third task was obviously impossible for her, because she knew how terrifying Rockefeller was. If she betrayed Rockefeller, her whole family would suffer!
“Mr. McDonald, I can’t do this. I can’t betray Rockefeller!”
Birdie shook her head and said.
“You can do it!”
Connor replied indifferently.
“Mr. McDonald, what makes you say that?”
Birdie was stunned for a moment and asked Connor with a puzzled expression.
…

chapters.title: Chapter 973: You Have No Right To Choose!
chapters.content:
Chapter 973: You Have No Right To Choose!
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Bright Moon Club.
After hearing Connor’s three conditions, Birdie could accept the first two, but she could not accept that Connor wanted her to be a mole.
In Birdie’s eyes, Rockefeller was very terrifying. If she really betrayed Rockefeller, the consequences would be unimaginable.
“Birdie, if I’m not wrong, your current situation in Rockefeller isn’t very good. Your current position is on the verge of collapse, right?”
Connor asked Birdie softly.
“…”
Birdie looked at Connor and said nothing.
For a large organization like Rockefeller, there was no humanity at all.
As long as you could create value for Rockefeller, then you were a useful person.
If you couldn’t create value for Rockefeller, Rockefeller would mercilessly kick you out.
Therefore, not to mention Birdie, even those who were a few levels higher than Birdie were not able to secure their positions.
“Also, you’ve offended a lot of people in the past few years, which is why you’re so anxious to keep your position. If you lose your current position, those people you’ve offended will definitely take revenge on you. Without the protection of Rockefeller, your family probably won’t last long!”
Connor continued to analyze.
“Mr. McDonald, what are you trying to say?”
Birdie frowned and asked Connor.
“What I want to say is, since Miss Schroder is so worried every day, why not you come to me? I can give you everything that Rockefeller can give you, even double it. I can also protect the safety of your family, as long as you listen to me!”
Connor said with a smile as he drank his tea.
“…”
Birdie looked at Connor and instantly fell into deep thought.
At this moment, Birdie realized that she was too naive. She had also underestimated Connor.
She thought that Connor was just a rich guy who had nothing to do and had no ability to speak of at all. Therefore, Birdie did not really take Connor seriously from the beginning to the end. Birdie even felt that Connor was not qualified to be her opponent.
However, she did not expect Connor to not see her as an opponent. Connor really wanted to deal with the entire Rockefeller, not just her.
“Mr. McDonald, I can fulfill your first two conditions, but I really can’t fulfill your third condition. I can’t betray Rockefeller!”
Birdie replied in a low voice after thinking for a moment.
“Miss Schroder, you don’t have the right to choose now!”
Connor said.
“Why?”
Birdie was somewhat puzzled.
Connor took out his phone from his clothes and gently pressed the pause button.
“You actually recorded this conversation?”
Birdie looked at Connor’s phone and instantly realized what was going on. She shouted in shock.
“That’s right, Miss Schroder. I’ve already recorded our entire conversation just now!”
Connor nodded and continued, “I just need to delete the last thing and send the first part of the conversation to Rockefeller. Rockefeller should have the ability to verify the authenticity of the recording. At that time, whether you agree or not, Rockefeller will think that you have betrayed them. At that time, you might not even have the chance to explain yourself…”
“How can you be so shameless?”
Birdie shouted excitedly at Connor.
At this moment, Birdie finally understood why Connor was so confident in telling her these things. It turned out that Connor had planned all of this.
Connor’s real purpose was to sow discord between Birdie and Rockefeller. In the end, Birdie had no other choice but to cooperate with Connor.
“If we’re talking about being shameless, I think I’m not even worth mentioning compared to the people on Rockefeller’s side!”
Connor put away his phone as he spoke, then continued, “Miss Schroder, can you consider the three conditions I just proposed?”
“I don’t have a choice now, right?”
Birdie smiled bitterly and said helplessly.
“So, Miss Schroder, do you agree?”
Connor asked with a smile.
“I can only agree to your conditions now, but…”
Before Birdie could finish her sentence, her fair hand suddenly grabbed the teapot in front of her. Then, without any hesitation, she smashed it toward Connor’s head.
Even Connor didn’t expect Birdie’s movements to be so fast. Moreover, the power that erupted in that instant was also very shocking. This meant that Birdie was definitely not an ordinary person.
Birdie’s unexpected attack would have been impossible for an ordinary person to react in time. Moreover, the teapot itself was made of iron and was very heavy. Once it hit a person’s head, the person would be severely injured if not dead.
However, Connor’s speed was faster than Birdie’s. Connor turned to the side and dodged the incoming teapot.
Birdie was shocked by Connor’s quick reaction, but she quickly calmed down.
After all, Birdie had hired some assassins to assassinate Connor, but he had survived in the end. Therefore, Birdie had some understanding of Connor’s skills. This was also why Birdie did not choose to send someone to deal with Connor this time but chose to meet Connor himself.
After Connor dodged the teapot, he didn’t stop and kicked the table in front of him.
The table flew toward Birdie.
Birdie instantly stood up and dodged to the side like a bolt of lightning.
Bang!
The table smashed heavily against the wall of the private room and shattered instantly.
Connor looked at Birdie and was extremely shocked.
He couldn’t help but be relieved that he had learned martial arts from Jorge Yarrell. Otherwise, Connor would be dead when encountering such a situation.
But what made Connor feel even more incredulous was that Birdie was actually so powerful.
It was hard for him to imagine that Birdie’s delicate body actually contained such terrifying energy.
“Mr. McDonald, is this how you plan to deal with me?”
Birdie asked Connor sweetly.
“I’ve already given you a chance, but you didn’t know how to cherish it!”
Connor whispered back to Birdie, then continued to rush toward Birdie.

chapters.title: Chapter 974: Help Me Kill Someone
chapters.content:
Chapter 974: Help Me Kill Someone
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Connor knew that Birdie had some skills, so he did not dare to be arrogant at this time. He rushed toward Birdie.
Connor’s fist brought along a whistling sound of wind as it directly smashed toward Birdie’s chest.
When Birdie saw Connor making a move, she exerted strength in her legs, and her entire body bent into a very shocking arc.
Immediately after, Connor saw Birdie’s slender and fair legs draw a beautiful arc in the air. Birdie’s high heels kicked Connor’s chest fiercely, and he took a few steps back to stabilize himself.
Connor subconsciously looked down at his chest and saw that there was a wound on his chest, and blood was slowly flowing out.
Connor looked at Birdie in disbelief. At this moment, Connor finally understood why Birdie had the guts to attack him. It turned out that Birdie’s skills were actually so terrifying.
If not for the fact that Connor had already taken the Essence Cultivating Pill, Connor would not be a match for Birdie at all.
At this moment, Birdie rushed toward Connor in her high heels again.
However, perhaps because Birdie’s speed was too fast, ordinary high heels could not withstand such a fast movement at all. Therefore, Birdie’s high heels suddenly tilted, and the heel broke.
“Ah!”
Birdie let out a soft cry instinctively. She leaned forward and lost her balance.
However, at this moment, Connor suddenly rushed over.
At this moment, Connor naturally did not have the mood to be gentle with a woman. He seized this opportunity to raise his leg and kick in Birdie’s position.
Birdie had sprained her ankle, so it was impossible for her to dodge Connor’s kick. As a result, she flew out as if she had been hit by a car.
Connor reached out and grabbed Birdie’s ankle, then threw her hard onto the ground.
After falling to the ground, Birdie’s first reaction was to stand up.
However, Connor saw through Birdie’s intentions. He naturally wouldn’t let Birdie succeed, so he suddenly pressed down on Birdie’s body.
Birdie was kicked by Connor and then fell to the ground. She was already dizzy. Now that Connor was pressing down on her, Birdie seemed to be in even more pain.
Birdie struggled for a moment, as if she was about to stand up, but Connor reached out and grabbed Birdie’s neck, then whispered, “If you dare to move now, I’ll break your neck!”
“…”
Birdie looked up at Connor and took a deep breath without saying anything.
At this moment, Birdie knew that Connor already had the intention to kill her. If she continued to resist, Connor might really kill her.
Seeing that Birdie didn’t continue to struggle, he let out a long sigh of relief. He knew that Birdie’s skills were very abnormal. If Birdie’s high heels didn’t break today, it wouldn’t have been so easy for him to defeat her.
Birdie’s eyes were filled with regret. She thought that it would not be difficult for her to deal with Connor, but in the end, everything was ruined by a pair of high heels. She was naturally very upset.
Connor’s body was pressed against Birdie’s body. At this moment, he could feel the softness and sexiness of her delicate body, as well as the faint fragrance of her body.
However, Connor was not in the mood to feel these things. After taking a deep breath, he whispered to Birdie, “Miss Schroder, there are only two options in front of you now. The first is to cooperate with me. When I take down Rockefeller, you will still be the person in charge of Rockefeller in Porthampton. The second is to not cooperate with me.”
“Mr. McDonald, you didn’t win fair and square this time!”
Birdie seemed to be trying to provoke Connor.
“So what if I didn’t?”
However, Connor did not fall for it at all. He sneered in response.
Seeing that he didn’t fall for it, she became a little helpless. Then, she stared at him, and no one knew what she was thinking.
“You don’t have to think about stalling for time. If a third person enters this private room, I will kill you off!”
Connor whispered to Birdie.
Birdie looked at him and took a deep breath. Then, she said in a low voice, “I can work with you!”
“You sure?”
Connor couldn’t help but be stunned when he heard her words. He asked with a surprised expression.
“I don’t have any other choice now, do I?”
Birdie smiled helplessly and continued, “But if you want me to cooperate with you, I have a condition. As long as you agree to this condition, I will cooperate with you!”
“What condition?”
Connor looked at her and asked.
“Can you get up?”
Birdie was a little breathless from Connor’s pressure on her, so she asked Connor shyly.
When Connor heard her words, he couldn’t help but smile. Then, he said softly, “I’m sorry, I can’t get up yet. After all, you’re too dangerous. What if I let you go and you attack me?”
When Birdie heard his words, she couldn’t help but mock, “I didn’t expect the dignified Mr. McDonald of Porthampton to be so timid…”
“Alright, stop talking nonsense. Just tell me what your conditions are!”
Connor whispered to Birdie.
“I want you to help me kill someone!”
Birdie said expressionlessly.
“Kill someone?”
Connor looked at Birdie, and he seemed to be a little surprised. Then he said lightly, “You’re so skilled, and you’re the person in charge of Porthampton. If you want to kill someone, you don’t need me to do it, right?”
“The person I’m talking about has a very terrifying background. I can’t deal with any of his bodyguards, so it’s impossible to kill him just like that. I have to kill him when he is left with nothing!”
Birdie looked at Connor and said slowly.
“Who do you want to kill?”
Connor hesitated for a moment before asking Birdie.
“Chester Yandell, the head of the Yandell Family in Salem!”
Birdie looked at Connor and replied.

chapters.title: Chapter 975: The Past
chapters.content:
Chapter 975: The Past
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
“Yandell Family’s head, Chester Yandell?”
When Connor heard Birdie’s words, a strange look flashed across his eyes, because he felt that this name was somewhat familiar.
“What’s the relationship between Chester Yandell and Ruby Yandell?”
Connor suddenly remembered that the rich and beautiful woman he met in Medicine Kings’ Valley seemed to be a member of the Yandell Family in Salem. That was why Connor felt that this Chester Yandell was somewhat familiar, so he hurriedly asked Birdie.
“You know Ruby Yandell? What’s your relationship with her?”
Birdie looked at Connor’s shocked expression and asked him in confusion.
“I’ve only met Ruby a few times, but she owes me money!”
Connor said slowly.
“I see, Chester is Ruby’s father!”
Birdie only revealed the relationship between Chester and Ruby seeing that they Connor and Ruby didn’t really know each other.
