“Then, why do you want to kill Chester Yandell?”
Connor looked at Birdie and asked.
“…”
Birdie hesitated for a moment, then said in a low voice, “This is my private matter and has nothing to do with you. You only need to tell me if it’s possible!”
“I can’t help you kill someone for no reason. I have to know your reason before I can consider whether I should agree to it or not!”
Connor said flatly.
Birdie took a deep breath and said slowly, “Actually, I’m not the person in charge of Rockefeller in Porthampton. The one who is truly qualified to sit in my current position is my brother…”
“You have a brother?”
Connor’s eyes flashed with a trace of surprise.
“Yeah, I have a brother. My brother was supposed to replace me and become the person in charge of Rockefeller in Porthampton. However, five years ago, my brother offended Chester’s son when he went to Salem on holiday. He is Ruby’s brother, Zeno Yandell. My brother taught Zeno a lesson. Zeno couldn’t swallow this anger and found a killer to kill my brother in the hotel room!”
When Birdie was talking about this matter, there was no expression on her face at all. It was as if she was talking about a very ordinary matter.
However, Connor was extremely shocked. He didn’t expect Birdie to have such a story.
“After Zeno killed my brother, Chester learned of this matter and used his connections to find a scapegoat to take the blame. So, Zeno is still at large now, while my brother was killed without any justice for his death. It has been five years!”
Birdie looked at Connor and continued.
“The Yandell Family is just a wealthy family. It shouldn’t be difficult for you to deal with them, right?”
Connor wasn’t sure whether Birdie was telling the truth.
“Just a wealthy family?”
When Birdie heard Connor’s words, she couldn’t help but laugh bitterly. Then, she said indifferently, “Looks like you really don’t know the true identity of the Yandell Family!”
“Does the Yandell Family have any other identities?”
Connor was stunned for a moment and asked in a puzzled tone.
“Although the Yandell Family is just an ordinary big family on the surface, Chester is actually the person in charge of Rockefeller in Salem, and our Schroder Family is only the person in charge of a small Porthampton. How can our family deal with the Yandell Family?”
Birdie looked at Connor and said helplessly.
When Connor heard Birdie’s words, he was even more surprised.
Because Connor didn’t think that the Yandell Family was actually Rockefeller’s people!
Back then, Connor naively thought that the Yandell Family was just an ordinary family that ran their own business. He even had the intention of taking over the Yandell Family shares from Ruby.
But now that Connor thought about it, he realized that he was too naive. A mere Yandell Family was just a shell for Chester to hide his identity, and Chester’s real identity was indeed the person in charge of Rockefeller in Salem.
“After my father found out about my brother’s death, he was also very helpless because he couldn’t do anything at all. So, my father could only choose to swallow his anger. My father can swallow his anger, but I can’t!”
Birdie paused for a moment, then looked at Connor and continued, “So now, I have become the person in charge of Porthampton. My goal is to strengthen myself step by step. I want to surpass Chester, then make the Yandell Family lose everything, and finally avenge my brother!”
“Aren’t you afraid of being discovered by Rockefeller’s people?”
Connor asked doubtfully.
“So what if they do? The people of Rockefeller have always looked at benefits and not right or wrong. As long as it can bring benefits to the organization, no one would care even if I wanted to deal with the four kings of Rockefeller. For those who are able to stand firm in Rockefeller, none of them are innocent people. None of them got to where they are without stepping over others and killing people.”
Birdie said disdainfully.
“What a strange organization!”
Connor could not help but smile helplessly.
“But it has been a few years, and Chester most likely knows my real goal, so he has been using his connections to suppress me. He wants to make sure I can’t threaten him. My position in Rockefeller is becoming more and more peripheral. If I can’t get this subway project, the people above may consider removing my position as the person in charge. Once I lose this position, it will be even more difficult to deal with Chester!”
Birdie looked at Connor and continued to explain.
Connor finally understood why Birdie was so insistent on getting this subway project. It turned out that Birdie did not want to make money, nor did she want status and power. She just wanted to use Rockefeller to deal with Chester and avenge her brother.
“Now that my story is over, I joined Rockefeller to get my revenge. I have no attachment to Rockefeller, so as long as you promise to help me take revenge, I can work with you!”
Birdie continued after seeing that Connor was quiet.
“How do I know if what you said is true or false?”
Connor hesitated for a moment before asking Birdie.
“Back then, Zeno killing my brother caused a stir in the city. Your connections are so wide, as long as you casually inquire, you can investigate whether this matter I said is true or not!”
Birdie answered seriously.
Connor looked at Birdie, and he felt conflicted. He seemed to not know if he should agree to Birdie’s request or not.

chapters.title: Chapter 976: Do You Know Dawson McDonald??
chapters.content:
Chapter 976: Do You Know Dawson McDonald??
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Connor had not anticipated that Birdie became the person in charge of Rockefeller for the sole purpose of avenging her own brother.
He knew how dangerous she was.
So he currently had no way to determine whether what she had just said was true or false.
However, he knew that it was unlikely that she was lying about Zeno killing her brother because she knew about his abilities. If it were a lie, Connor could easily investigate and find out.
“Mr. Connor, I can help you with the first two things, but as for the third thing you mentioned, I can agree to it as long as you can help me seek revenge!” Birdie said, adding, “After all, I joined Rockefeller solely to avenge my brother. Whether I work for you or Rockefeller, it doesn’t make any difference to me as long as I can get revenge!”
“Alright, I can agree to this condition. Once the time is right, I will naturally help you seek revenge. But the prerequisite is that you must provide me with some valuable information. I won’t help you until I completely trust you!” Connor said to Birdie, his expression emotionless.
“Mr. Connor, you don’t need to worry about that. Since I’m going to cooperate with you, I will definitely show my sincerity!” She nodded lightly and then hesitated before whispering, “Mr. Connor, can you get off me now?”
During their conversation just now, he had been pressing down on her, causing her breath to become somewhat rapid, and her cheeks to blush.
After a moment of hesitation, Connor slowly stood up.
After seeing him rise, she had no intention of continuing to attack him, but simply moved her body a bit. After all, being pressed down by him for so long had made her body somewhat numb.
“While I have agreed to your condition, it doesn’t mean that I completely trust you. I will still keep the recording of our conversation. If I find out that you betray me, I will immediately hand over the recording to people from Rockefeller!” Connor reminded Birdie in a low voice.
“Mr. Connor, you can rest assured that I will never betray you as long as you can help me seek revenge!” she said seriously to him.
“That’s good. You should investigate the two things we discussed thoroughly. Once you have results, you can contact me directly by phone!” After saying this, Connor gave his phone number to Birdie and then turned around to leave the private room.
Connor knew that this place belonged to Birdie, and he didn’t know if she had any other motives. Therefore, he didn’t plan to stay here any longer.
As Connor left, Birdie stood there, watching his back, her expression somewhat helpless.
At that moment, she certainly didn’t want to let him leave like that, but she was helpless because she knew that it wasn’t easy to keep him. Moreover, if she made a big fuss about it, it might attract the attention of people from Rockefeller, which would be even more detrimental.
As for whether she really wanted to cooperate with him, no one could be sure.
After he left, she also decided to leave Bright Moon Club and drove alone to the front of a villa.
This villa was Birdie’s family home. After her parents retired, they had been living there.
Due to work reasons, she usually lived alone outside and rarely went home.
After getting off the car, she walked directly into the villa.
At that moment, an elegant middle-aged man was sitting on the sofa, watching a sports game. The expression on his face gradually changed as he followed the progress of the game, showing a serious look.
“Dad!”
Birdie called out to the middle-aged man on the sofa.
This middle-aged man was Warren, the former head of Rockefeller Corporation in Porthampton.. Warren later resigned because he became disillusioned after the death of his son. He had originally planned to resign and live a normal life with his wife and daughter, as the money he had earned from Rockefeller over the years was enough for them to live comfortably for several lifetimes. However, Birdie couldn’t let go of her hatred.
In the end, Warren couldn’t resist his daughter’s persistence and helped her become the new head of Rockefeller.
“Birdie, how come you have time to come home today?”
Warren, upon seeing Birdie, had a somewhat surprised expression on his face and quickly stood up to ask.
“Dad, there’s something I want to talk to you about!”
Birdie said to Warren with a very serious tone.
Seeing the serious expression on her face, Warren knew that something important must have happened and said softly, “Let’s go to the study and talk!”
“Okay!”
Birdie nodded lightly and walked directly towards the study.
A while later, Birdie followed Warren into the study.
Warren made tea himself and asked softly, “Is there a problem with the subway project? I heard that Thomas’ boss seems to have secured the project. Is that true?”
Although Warren had retired for a long time, he was still very knowledgeable about the outside world.
“I met Connor, the boss of Thomas, today!”
Birdie said in a low voice.
“You met him?”
A hint of shock flashed in Warren’s eyes, and he quickly said, “Birdie, have you gone crazy? Don’t you know the relationship between Rockefeller and Thomas? You met their boss at this time. If the people from Rockefeller find out, you’ll get into big trouble, and your identity will be exposed. How could you personally meet him?”
“The subway project is very important to me. If I don’t meet Connor, my position as the head may be at risk!”
Birdie replied helplessly.
Warren also looked helpless and shook his head, asking in a low voice, “What did you and him talk about during the meeting?”
“Dad, do you know someone named Dawson McDonald?”
Birdie asked directly.
Upon hearing Birdie’s words, Warren couldn’t help but tremble, and the tea that was supposed to pour into the cup spilled all over the table.

chapters.title: Chapter 977: Classmate
chapters.content:
Chapter 977: Classmate
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
In the study room.
After hearing the name Dawson McDonald, Warren’s expression underwent a significant change.
Birdie could also feel the change in her father’s face.
This confirmed Connor’s speculation. Warren indeed knew Dawson, and there seemed to be some connection between Dawson’s death and Warren.
“Dad, you know Dawson?”
Birdie asked Warren excitedly.
“Why are you suddenly asking about this person?”
Warren’s expression became serious, and he furrowed his brow as he asked Birdie.
After taking a deep breath, Birdie calmly said, “Connor, the boss of Thomas, promised to help me with three tasks. If I can complete them, he will give me the subway project. One of the tasks is to inquire about Dawson from you.”
“What is the relationship between this Connor and Dawson?”
Warren asked urgently.
“Connor is Dawson’s son. He said his parents passed away when he was in elementary school, but his father called you before he died. So, he wants to investigate the true cause of his parents’ death!”
Birdie had no reason to hide anything from her father and answered directly.
“Connor is Dawson’s son?”
Warren asked incredulously.
“That’s right!”
Birdie nodded.
“Connor is also Thomas’ boss, which means Connor is Steven’s successor, right?”
Warren continued to ask.
“Yes!”
Birdie nodded again.
Warren looked at Birdie in front of him, remained silent for two seconds, and then couldn’t help but burst into laughter, sighing softly, “How could there be such a coincidence in the world? There can’t be such a lucky thing…”
“Dad, what are you talking about?”
Seeing his reaction, Birdie’s expression became even more puzzled, not understanding the meaning behind Warren’s words.
“It’s nothing…”
He shook his head gently.
“So, Dad, do you really know Dawson ?”
Birdie asked him.
He took a deep breath, took a sip of tea, and calmly said, “Dawson and I were college classmates, and we had a very good relationship. After graduating from college, we both joined the same company…”
“The same company?”
Birdie looked at Warren with an incredulous expression and said softly, “Dad, if you had such a good relationship with Dawson , why have I never heard you mention this person? And which company are you talking about?”
“After graduation, Dawson and I both worked at Rockefeller. Later, I became the head of Rockefeller in Porthampton, and Dawson became the head of Dexas!”
Warren replied softly and then continued, “The reason I never mentioned Dawson to you is that after his death, Rockefeller forbade anyone from mentioning his name!”
“Connor’s father is also affiliated with Rockefeller? And after Dawson’s death, Rockefeller actually blocked the news? Could his death be related to Rockefeller?”
In just a few minutes, she connected all these events together.
“I don’t know if his death is related to Rockefeller, and I don’t know how he died. But he did call me before he died. He originally planned to bring his wife to Porthampton to meet me, but unexpectedly, he died on the way!”
Warren’s tone sounded a little sad.
Birdie stared at him with an expression of shock. She had never thought that her father and Connor’s father would have such a connection.
“Has Connor made any other requests of you?” asked Warren as he continued to gaze at Birdie.
She hesitated for a moment, then recounted the conversation she had with Connor in the private room.
After hearing her words, Warren couldn’t help but smile faintly and sighed softly. “I never expected Dawson’s son to become Steven’s successor. It’s truly interesting!”
“Father, do you think I should work with Connor or not?” Birdie asked Warren, her voice filled with confusion.
“You should.” Warren nodded gently and continued, “If you want to seek revenge with your own strength, it would be almost impossible. After all, Chester’s power is terrifying. He has been suppressing you for so many years, and you have had no chance for revenge. If you cooperate with Connor, there might be a glimmer of opportunity.”
“I understand,” Birdie seemed to strongly agree with Warren’s words.
“As for your relationship with Dawson, there’s no need to hide it. His father’s death has nothing to do with me. Since you want to work with Connor, you should show some sincerity. If you hide this information from him now and he finds out later, it will only make him feel deceived.”
After thinking for a moment, Warren continued, “By the way, you can also tell Connor that if he really wants to investigate his parents’ death, he can ask his grandfather. His grandfather should have a better understanding of the past secrets than I do.”
“Okay,” Birdie nodded again and said, “Now, I still need to investigate the whereabouts of Connor’s fiancée. Connor suspects that she was kidnapped by Rockefeller’s people…”
“You don’t need to investigate that. I’ll make a phone call to my friend in the US. But I don’t think Rockefeller would do such a thing…” Warren spoke slowly.
“Why?” Birdie asked with a puzzled frown.
“Because if this was indeed done by Rockefeller’s people, they would have contacted Connor immediately and used his fiancée to threaten him. But it has been a while now, and there has been no activity from Rockefeller’s side. That suggests the person is not in Rockefeller’s hands!”
Warren replied calmly and took out his phone to make a call.
A few minutes later, Warren hung up the phone and looked up at Birdie. “You can tell Connor that his fiancée is not in Rockefeller’s hands!”
“Is this information accurate?” Birdie asked, surprised by the sudden revelation.
“It’s definitely accurate. I just spoke with Rockefeller’s representative in the US. There’s no reason for him to lie to me,” Warren replied earnestly.

chapters.title: Chapter 978: Returning to the Old Home
chapters.content:
Chapter 978: Returning to the Old Home
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
The next day, at 8 o’clock in the morning.
Connor, who was still in the midst of his dreams, was suddenly awakened by the sound of his phone ringing.
Rubbing his sleepy eyes, he picked up the phone and answered the call.
“Mr. Connor, hello!”
The voice of Birdie came through.
Upon hearing her enticing voice, he instantly became more awake and quickly asked, “Miss Birdie, do you have any news over there?”
“That’s right!”
Birdie replied nonchalantly.
Connor’s expression seemed even more excited upon hearing Birdie’s response. He continued to ask, “So, is my fiancée kidnapped by Rockefeller’s people?”
“No, your fiancée’s situation has nothing to do with Rockefeller!”
Birdie answered directly.
“Nothing at all?”
After hearing Birdie’s answer, Connor’s expression appeared somewhat strange.
At this moment, he didn’t know whether he should be happy or unhappy.
If Freya was not in the hands of Rockefeller, it was undoubtedly a good thing, but what troubled him was that he had no clue where she was. He didn’t even know whether she was alive or dead.
“What about the death of my parents?”
After hesitating for a moment, he continued to ask.
“Mr. Connor, your father Dawson was a close friend of my father Warren. Your father did call my father before he passed away, but your father’s death has nothing to do with my father. And also…”
Birdie seemed somewhat hesitant as she spoke.
“What else?”
Connor urgently inquired.
“Also, your father was the representative of Rockefeller in Dexas before he died!”
Birdie finally decided to tell Connor the truth.
Upon hearing her words, he was instantly dumbfounded. He sat on the bed, stunned, with an expression of disbelief on his face.
He never expected that his own father was also affiliated with Rockefeller. This news was like a bolt from the blue for Connor.
“By the way, Mr. Connor, my father mentioned that if you want to investigate the true cause of your parents’ death, you can ask your grandfather. He might know what happened back then!”
Birdie continued.
“My grandfather?”
After hearing her words, he couldn’t help but pause. The image of an old man appeared in his mind, and he smiled bitterly without saying a word.
“Mr. Connor, I’ve already investigated the first two matters for you. As for the subway project, can you consider giving it to us?”
Birdie, who was no longer concerned about what Connor was thinking, asked directly.
“Don’t worry, I will inform Thomas to cancel the bidding for the subway project. Your company should be able to get the project then!”
Connor replied absentmindedly.
“Thank you, Mr. Connor!”
Birdie let out a long sigh of relief and continued, “As for the third matter you mentioned, my father also believes that working with you is the best plan. So, as long as you can help me get rid of Chester, I can assist you in dealing with Rockefeller’s people!”
“No problem. When I need you, I will contact you!”
Connor, who was currently not in the mood to care about these matters, replied casually before hanging up the phone directly.
The phone call between Birdie and him contained too much information that he couldn’t digest in a short period of time.
Firs there was Freya’s matter. Thomas and the others had basically used all their connections, but they still could not find about her whereabouts. Connor suspected that it might be Rockefellar’s people who did it.
However, Birdie said that this matter wasn’t done by Rockefeller’s people, which means that Freya might have encountered an unfortunate incident.
Thinking about this, Connor’s mood became even worse.
As for how his parents died, he didn’t get a definite answer from Birdie.
But what surprised him was that his father turned out to be associated with Rockefeller, and his grandfather knew what happened back then.
However, he had never heard his grandfather mention this matter. The entire McDonald family believed that Connor’s parents died in an accident.
He had no positive feelings towards his grandfather at all because it was his own grandfather, Maverick McDonald, who drove Connor out of the McDonald family.
In fact, when Connor’s parents were still alive, Maverick treated Connor very well. Among all the children in the McDonald family, he was undoubtedly the most favored by Maverick. Perhaps this had a lot to do with Connor’s parents being in charge of Rockefeller in Dexas. But regardless, Maverick’s care for Connor came from the bottom of his heart.
But what he didn’t expect was that after his parents passed away, Maverick seemed to have changed completely and directly drove him out of the McDonald family.
Moreover, all these years had passed, and he never contacted Connor, not even a phone call.
Connor even felt that he might have already forgotten that he had a grandson named Connor.
Sometimes, he couldn’t understand why. After all, he was Maverick’s own grandson. Why would Maverick be so heartless?
If it weren’t for Birdie mentioning that Maverick might know the cause of his parents’ death, Connor would never want to recall those things he experienced in the McDonald family.
The things he went through at Porthampton University were already miserable enough, but compared to what he experienced in the McDonald family, he felt that it was simply too painful to mention.
He didn’t want to think about what the McDonald family did to him back then in his entire life.
Connor took a deep breath and muttered softly, “Some things need to be faced eventually…”
Although he didn’t want to return to the McDonald family now, he had no choice but to go back and clarify things since Maverick might be the only clue to investigate his parents’ death. Even if he didn’t want to face the people in the McDonald family, he could only choose to go back and find out the truth.
With that in mind, he took out his phone and dialed Thomas’ number. He informed him about giving the subway project to Birdie and briefly mentioned that he planned to return to his hometown.
Thomas understood what Connor wanted to do and didn’t waste any words, directly agreeing.
After hanging up the phone, Connor started his journey, preparing to go back to the McDonald family and take a look.

chapters.title: Chapter 979: Arriving at Dexas!
chapters.content:
Chapter 979: Arriving at Dexas!
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Originally, Connor had planned to return to Dexas alone, but Thomas was worried about his safety, so he arranged for Carlos to accompany Connor.
Although the current Connor is no longer the same as before, he felt that having Carlos by his side would provide an extra layer of security. Therefore, he did not refuse in the end.
Connor’s hometown was in Dexas, which, like Porthampton, was under Davenport
However, it took at least half a day to travel from Porthampton to Dexas, so Connor and Carlos chose to take a train back, which would save a lot of time.
Sitting in the train compartment, Connor looked at the fleeting scenery outside the window, feeling a mix of emotions.
Years ago, Connor arrived in Porthampton alone by train and started his new life.
Six years had passed, and everything had changed in the blink of an eye.
Connor had thought that he would never be able to return to Dexas again because the place held too many painful memories for him.
But he never expected that he would eventually come back.
If there were something in Dexas worth cherishing for Connor, it would be the people from the Sassman family.
the Sassman family had a longstanding friendship with the McDonald family. Connor’s father, Dawson, and Hugo from the Sassman family were very good friends. So when Connor was young, he often went to the Sassman family to play. Connor was very close friends with Jerrico and Wynona, Hugo’s son and daughter.
But later, due to the death of Connor’s parents, he came to Porthampton alone, and he lost contact with Jerrico and Wynona.
“I wonder how Uncle Hugo and Jerrico are doing now…”
When Connor thought of the people from the Sassman family, his furrowed brow finally relaxed, and he sighed softly.
“After arriving in Dexas, I should go and see Uncle Hugo and the others. Otherwise, I might not have a chance to see them in the future!”
Connor had originally planned to go directly to the McDonald family in Dexas to clarify the past events. However, now that he remembered the Sassman family, he decided to visit them first.
After all, the current Connor was not the same as before, and if the Sassman family needed any help now, Connor would definitely be there to assist them.
In the blink of an eye, half a day had passed.
After Connor and Carlos got off the train, Connor stood in front of the station, looking at the bustling streets, feeling a whirlwind of emotions. He never expected that he would truly return to Dexas.
“Mr. Connor, it’s getting late. Shall we go to the hotel and rest for the night?”
Carlos said softly to Connor.
“No need, I want to see my friends. You go back to the hotel and rest!”
Connor turned his head and glanced at Carlos, speaking softly.
“Alright then!”
Carlos nodded slightly and didn’t insist. He chose to leave directly.
On the other hand, Connor hailed a taxi and found the villa where the Sassman family used to live based on his memory.
But when he arrived at the villa where the Sassman family lived, he discovered they had already moved. Helplessly, Connor called Thomas because Connor also had company in Dexas. So there was no problem for Thomas to help Connor find the whereabouts of the Sassman family.
Soon, Connor obtained the current location of the Sassman family from Thomas.
It was already six o’clock in the afternoon, and the sky was gradually getting dark. However, Connor chose not to go back to the hotel and instead found the villa where the Sassman family currently resided.
When Connor saw the new villa of the Sassman family, the anxiety in his heart finally subsided.
Initially, he thought the Sassman family had moved because something had happened at home. However, after seeing the grandeur of the new villa, Connor felt relieved. It was evident that the Sassman family had been doing well in recent years.
After a moment of hesitation, he walked directly towards the villa and gently pressed the doorbell.
“Ding dong…”
“Ding dong…”
After ringing for a while, a middle-aged woman who looked like a nanny came out and gave Connor a cautious look. Frowning, she asked, “Who are you?”
“I would like to see Uncle Hugo…”
Connor replied with a smile.
“Are you here to see Mr. Hugo? He’s not home right now. Come back tomorrow!”
The nanny replied curtly and was about to close the door.
“Auntie, can I know when Uncle Hugo will be back? If he’s not at home, are Jerrico and Wynona here?”
Connor stopped the nanny and asked anxiously.
After seeing that he seemed to be familiar with the Sassman family’s situation, the nanny thought he might not be a bad person, so she spoke up, “Mr. Jerrico has been sick lately and has been in the hospital. Mr. and Mrs. Sassman haven’t been home for two months. If you really want to see them, go to the hospital!”
“Jerrico is sick?”
Upon hearing the nanny’s words, Connor’s eyes widened, and his face showed surprise.
“Oh…”
The nanny sighed softly and continued, “He has been sick for a while. Who exactly are you?”
“What kind of illness?”
He asked the nanny urgently.
“I’m not sure about Mr. Jerrico’s specific illness…”
The nanny replied helplessly.
“Do you know which hospital he’s in now?”
Connor continued to ask the nanny.
After hesitating for a moment, the nanny took out a pen from inside the house, wrote down the hospital where Jerrico was currently staying on a piece of paper, and handed it to him.
“Thank you!”
Connor glanced briefly at the note and then turned around and left.
Originally, he thought he would be able to meet Jerrico, Wynona, and the others, and he was in a good mood. However, upon hearing this news, his facial expression began to complicate.
Connor knew that since the Sassman family hadn’t returned for such a long time, Jerrico’s condition must be very serious; otherwise, the Sassman family wouldn’t have stayed at the hospital all this time.
But he couldn’t understand why Jerrico, who was perfectly fine, would fall ill.
With these doubts in mind, Connor hailed a taxi and hurried to the hospital where Jerrico was currently admitted.

chapters.title: Chapter 980: You’ll Deal With This Matter?
chapters.content:
Chapter 980: You’ll Deal With This Matter?
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Jerrico’s hospital was not very far from the Sassman family’s villa.
So, it took Connor less than ten minutes to arrive at the hospital where Jerrico was.
After arriving at the hospital, he walked directly towards the VIP ward where Jerrico was.
At that moment, Hugo and Jerrico’s mother were sitting quietly by the bedside, accompanying Jerrico.
Jerrico was lying alone on the bed, with tubes inserted all over his body, as if his life could only be sustained by these medications.
Seeing him in this state, Connor felt uneasy because he couldn’t understand why he had become like this out of nowhere.
If it were the old Connor, he wouldn’t inquire about anything when encountering such a situation because he knew he wouldn’t be able to do anything even if he found out what happened. After all, the former Connor couldn’t even solve his own livelihood issues and had no ability to take care of others.
But the current Connor was no longer the Connor of the past!
He lightly knocked on the door. When Hugo heard the knocking, he instinctively got up and walked to the door, then opened it.
“Connor?”
After opening the door, Hugo instantly froze in place, his expression filled with disbelief.
Hugo seemed surprised that he would show up. He asked, “Connor, when did you come back?”
“Uncle Hugo, I just came back today. I went to your house earlier but didn’t find anyone. The nanny told me you were all here!”
Connor replied expressionlessly.
“I see!”
Hugo nodded slightly and continued, “Then come in quickly!”
“Okay…”
Connor didn’t say much and walked directly into the ward. He greeted Jerrico’s mother and then sat down on a chair, looking at Jerrico lying on the bed.
For a while, the atmosphere in the ward became eerie.
Connor silently watched Jerrico, without saying a word or asking what had happened.
Although Connor hadn’t been in contact with Jerrico for a long time, his feelings for Jerrico had never changed. Seeing his best friend suddenly become like this, Connor naturally felt uneasy.
As time passed, Connor finally stood up and said to Hugo, “Uncle Hugo, can you come out for a moment? I have something to tell you…”
After hearing Connor’s words, Hugo couldn’t help but hesitate for a moment. Then he hurriedly nodded and said, “Alright!”
After saying that, Connor directly walked towards the exit of the ward, and Hugo hurriedly followed his pace.
After leaving the ward, Hugo walked to the end of the corridor, lit a cigarette, took a deep drag, and asked Connor in a low voice, “Connor, what do you want to tell me? Have you encountered any difficulties in life? If you’re in trouble, just tell me. I’ll do my best to help you!”
Hugo thought that his sudden return to Dexas and voluntarily coming to see him meant that he must have encountered some difficulties.
Hugo knew that he had been through a lot over the years, and even for the sake of Connor’s father, he would do his best to help.
“Uncle Hugo, Jerrico shouldn’t have become like this just because of an illness, right?”
Connor asked Hugo expressionlessly.
“What do you mean?”
He was taken aback for a moment and asked with a puzzled expression.
“Jerrico had many wounds on his body, and there were large areas of burns on his skin. This indicated that he didn’t become like this due to an illness but because of something else!” Connor analyzed calmly.
Hugo looked at Connor in front of him, feeling somewhat shocked.
Because he could sense that the Connor standing in front of him now was significantly different from the previous Connor.
“You’re right, Jerrico became like this because of a car accident. His brain is damaged, and we don’t know when he will wake up. It’s fortunate that he’s still alive!” Hugo saw that Connor had already guessed everything, so he didn’t hide anything and said directly.
“Was it done intentionally by someone?” Connor continued to ask Hugo.
“How do you know?” He was dumbfounded as he never expecting him to figure out that someone deliberately wanted to kill Jerrico.
“Just a guess.” Connor furrowed his brow and asked in a low voice, “Who is so heartless and wants to harm Jerrico?”
“Connor, there are some things you don’t understand, so it’s better not to know. I’m already very happy that you came to see Jerrico!” Hugo seemed to be evading the question and said to Connor in a low voice.
“Do you already know who did it, Uncle Hugo?” He squinted his eyes and asked Hugo.
“Even if I know who did it to Jerrico, what can I do? Their power is not something I can handle. So it’s better not to dwell on certain things…” Hugo answered helplessly.
“Uncle Hugo, who did it, tell me their name. I will help you deal with this matter. I will seek justice for Jerrico no matter what!” Connor exclaimed excitedly.
“You’ll deal with this matter?” Hugo couldn’t help but smile helplessly when he heard Connor’s words. Then he said lightly, “Connor, you’re thinking too simplistically. You’re just an ordinary student, and there are some things you can’t solve. It’s getting late, so you should go back quickly!”
Hugo didn’t know his true identity at the moment, which was why he reacted that way. But when Hugo heard him say those words, he was still deeply moved.
After all, Jerrico had been in trouble for such a long time, and many of his friends had come to visit him, but no one dared to speak such words.
Connor looked at Hugo in front of him and couldn’t help but furrow his brow, but he didn’t continue to inquire further.
Because he knew that even if he continued to ask, Hugo wouldn’t reveal the identity of the culprit.
But just because Hugo didn’t say it didn’t mean Connor couldn’t investigate it.
At present, he only needed to make a phone call to Thomas, and all the information about Jerrico could be uncovered.

chapters.title: Chapter 981: Freya's Phone Call
chapters.content:
Chapter 981: Freya’s Phone Call
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
In the corridor.
When Connor asked about Jerrico, Hugo didn’t seem to want to talk about it.
Therefore, Connor decided to be tactful and did not continue to press him for information. Instead, he began to talk about other things.
During the conversation, Connor learned that the Sassman family had undergone a huge change in the few years he had left Dexas.
The Sassman family was now one of the top families in Dexas. Most of the five-star hotels in Dexas were under their banner.
Basically, if one were to mention a luxury hotel in Dexas, one would think of the Sassman family. However, no one expected that two months ago, the future heir of the Sassman family, Jerrico, would suddenly encounter a car accident and become like this.
Hugo was not in the mood to manage the company’s affairs at this time. He stayed in the hospital every day, hoping that his son would wake up.
Of course, Hugo knew who had done this to his son. However, he was afraid of the other party’s power and could not produce any real evidence to directly point to them, so he could only keep quiet and treat it as an accident.
No one expected that the Sassman family, who looked extremely glorious in the eyes of outsiders, would encounter an unprecedented disaster at this moment.
Connor suddenly realized that Wynona had not appeared, so he asked curiously, “Uncle Sassman, where’s Wynona?”
“Wynona is getting married tomorrow, so she’s preparing for the wedding now!” Hugo answered.
“Married?”
After hearing Hugo’s words, Connor’s expression was unusually puzzled. He frowned and asked, “She’s getting married?”
Under normal circumstances, Connor would definitely be very happy. After all, he had always treated Wynona as his biological sister. Wynona’s marriage was also a very important matter to him.
However, what puzzled Connor was that Wynona was getting married at a time when Jerrico was already in such a terrible state. This was really unbelievable.
“Uncle Sassman, where is Wynona’s wedding? I’ll also go over and give her my well-wishes…”
Connor asked Hugo softly.
“Connor, you’d better not go to Wynona’s wedding!” Hugo whispered.
“Why?”
“There’s no why. If I tell you not to go, you won’t go. Not only you can’t go, but everyone in our family won’t go, either!” Hugo said to Connor impatiently.
At this moment, Hugo’s reaction further confirmed Connor’s guess. Connor felt that something must have happened to the Sassman family to cause Jerrico to encounter this car accident.
There must be a secret behind Wynona’s marriage, but now that Hugo was unwilling to say anything, Connor could only investigate these things himself.
Connor looked at Hugo in front of him, and his heart ached because he felt that Hugo looked much older than before.
Hugo felt that his attitude toward Connor was a little too much, so he patted Connor’s shoulder and said softly, “Connor, you’re a good child, but there are some things that I really can’t tell you. If you have any difficulties, you can tell me.”
“Uncle Sassman, I’m fine!”
Connor gently shook his head, then looked at the time and continued, “It’s getting late, so I won’t disturb you anymore. I’ll go back first!”
“Let me send you off…” Hugo hurriedly said.
“No need!”
Connor stopped Hugo and left the hospital alone.
…
After leaving the hospital, Connor called Carlos and asked for the location of his hotel. Then, he took a taxi to the hotel.
After entering the hotel, Carlos helped Connor check in.
Connor lay on the big bed in the hotel alone with mixed feelings in his heart.
He did not expect to encounter such a thing as soon as he returned to Dexas.
The Sassman family must have encountered some big trouble, otherwise Hugo wouldn’t be so helpless.
Connor naturally wouldn’t sit idly by. After hesitating for a moment, Connor took out his phone and dialed Thomas Morgan’s number.
After the phone rang twice, Thomas picked up the call.
“Mr. McDonald, what’s the matter?” Thomas asked softly.
“You’re not going to bed yet, are you?”
Connor asked. At this moment, he didn’t really want to call Thomas lest he impose on him; after all, it was already so late. Although Thomas was his subordinate, he had troubled Thomas too many times. Connor felt a little apologetic.
However, Connor was worried that if he called Thomas tomorrow, it might be too late, so he finally ended up calling anyway.
“Not yet. Mr. McDonald, if you have anything to say, just say it!” Thomas replied with a smile.
After hearing Thomas’s words, Connor took a deep breath and said in a low voice, “I need you to help me investigate Hugo Sassman. His son suddenly got into a car accident some time ago. I believe someone must have deliberately set it up.”
“Alright, I got it!”
Thomas didn’t waste any time and agreed immediately.
“Thank you for your hard work!” Connor said gratefully.
“It’s nothing. Mr. McDonald, please wait for my call!” Thomas replied softly and then hung up the phone.
Connor took a deep breath, then turned off his phone and closed his eyes to rest.
“Ding!”
However, just as Connor closed his eyes, his phone rang again.
Connor casually picked up his phone and glanced at it. It was actually a call from Priscilla.
A trace of excitement flashed across Connor’s eyes as he hurriedly picked up the phone.
“Priscilla, did you find Freya?”
Connor knew that Priscilla must have called him because of Freya. That was why she asked him this question.
“Not yet, but I just received a call…”
Priscilla whispered.
“A phone call?”
Connor was stunned for a moment, then asked with a puzzled expression, “What call?”
“It was an unknown number, but after I picked up the call, the other party did not say a word. I called Freya’s name for a long time, but the other party did not respond to me. However, I have a feeling that the person who called me should be Freya!”
Priscilla said slowly.
After hearing Priscilla’s words, Connor’s expression became even more excited.
If it was really Freya who called Priscilla, it meant that Freya was still alive and hadn’t been harmed.
..

chapters.title: Chapter 982: A Heartless Woman
chapters.content:
Chapter 982: A Heartless Woman
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
“Priscilla, quickly tell me that phone number. I’ll get someone to locate it!”
Connor shouted excitedly.
“Before I called you, I already tried getting someone to locate it, but that number has been switched off. I couldn’t locate it at all!” Priscilla said helplessly.
“Is that so…”
Connor’s originally excited expression instantly dimmed. He thought that he could find Freya through this number, but at this moment, Connor’s plan fell through.
“Connor, I’m calling you to tell you that Freya is definitely still alive and should have returned to the country, so I think you should let your people focus on looking for Freya within the country!” Priscilla said softly.
“Priscilla, I understand. Don’t worry, I’ll get my people to focus on the country. If there’s any news, I’ll call you!”
Connor said helplessly.
“Alright!” Priscilla simply replied and then continued, “If there’s nothing else, I’ll hang up first!”
“Yes!”
Connor nodded lightly and hung up the phone. After hanging up, he lay on the bed again and closed his eyes to rest.
Initially, Connor thought that he could find Freya through this phone call, so he was in a good mood. However, all his plans had failed, and Connor did not know what to do for a moment.
Freya’s whereabouts were unknown, his parents’ deaths were still confusing, and the matter of the Sassman family was now on Connor’s shoulders. For a moment, Connor felt like he couldn’t breathe with all these troubles.
After an unknown amount of time, Connor finally fell asleep with these questions still in his mind.
..
The next day, at six o’clock in the morning.
Connor woke up and waited for Thomas’s reply.
After all, today was Wynona’s wedding day, so Connor wanted to find out what had happened at the Sassman family’s side before deciding if he should attend Wynona’s wedding.
“Ding!”
After waiting for almost half an hour, Connor finally received a call from Thomas.
“Mr. McDonald, I’ve almost finished investigating the Sassman family.” Thomas got straight to the point.
“What exactly happened?” Connor hurriedly asked.
“Mr. McDonald, the Sassman family is now the hotel tycoon of Dexas. 80% of the hotel businesses in Dexas have been monopolized by the Sassman family. Your friend, Jerrico, should have been the future heir of the Sassman family, but some time ago, Jerrico married a woman named Nadine Marcus, and the person who tried to murder Jerrico is very likely to be her!” Thomas reported.
“Jerrico’s wife wants to murder Jerrico?”
A trace of shock flashed across Connor’s eyes.
“That’s right. According to the information I have, Nadine’s family has always wanted to annex the Sassman family’s hotels, but the Sassman family refused. In the end, the Marcus family used a honey trap on Jerrico in the form of Nadine. She seduced Jerrico, whom then ignored Hugo Sassman’s opposition to the marriage and registered his marriage with Nadine!” Thomas explained patiently.
“Then why would she want to killJerrico?”
Connor still wanted to understand what was going on.
“If Jerrico dies, then the Sassman family’s business will fall into the hands of the Sassman family’s daughter-in-law, Nadine. In this way, the Marcus family can annex the Sassman family’s hotels without spending a single cent!”
Thomas paused for a moment and then continued, “According to my understanding, the Marcus family has some weight behind the name, so the Sassman family can’t beat the Marcus family at all!”
Connor frowned. “What exactly does the Marcus family do?”
“The Marcus family seems to have started from the black market business, but they have been involved in the real estate business for the past few years, so they can be considered to have cleared their name. However, in the end, the Marcus family is not a proper businessman. Their style of doing things is definitely more than a little dirty!” Thomas said slowly.
“Doesn’t the Sassman family still have a daughter? The Sassman family could let their daughter take over these businesses!”
Connor said with a frown.
“The daughter of the Sassman family is going to marry Nadine’s cousin. In this case, no matter who inherits the Sassman family’s business, these things will fall into the hands of the Marcus family!”
Thomas paused for a moment and then continued, “According to the information I received, after Jerrico’s accident, Nadine directly threatened Hugo to marry his daughter to his cousin, Kenny Marcus, or Wynona would end up like Jerrico. In order to protect his daughter, Hugo could only marry Wynona to Kenny, but…”
“But what?” Connor hurriedly asked.
“But this Kenny is mentally handicapped and is also slightly mentally ill!”
Thomas said slowly.
After hearing Thomas’s words, Connor instantly fell silent.
At this moment, Connor had already figured out what exactly happened to the Sassman family.
In order to deal with the Sassman family, the Marcus family did not hesitate to let Nadine seduce Jerrico. After the two of them got married, Nadine would kill Jerrico and force Wynona to marry her cousin.
In this case, Hugo would have no one to inherit the family property. He could only watch as the family property fell into the hands of the Marcus family.
Of course, Hugo could also choose to let an outsider inherit the property, or directly donate all of his hotels to a third party.
However, Wynona was still in the hands of the Marcus family. Hugo could not disobey the Marcus family for his daughter.
After figuring out the ins and outs of the matter, Connor couldn’t help but sigh in his heart. This woman named Nadine was really as vicious as a snake. She could even be so merciless as to try killing her own husband!
Of course, Connor was not in the mood to care about these things. After all, Jerrico was already like this, and he could not change anything.
However, Connor couldn’t accept that Nadine wanted Wynona to marry someone like her cousin. He couldn’t allow such a thing to happen.
Connor knew that today was the wedding day of Wynona and Kenny. He hurriedly said to the phone, “Thomas, Wynona might be holding a wedding today. Help me find the hotel where they’re holding their wedding now!”
“Alright!” Thomas agreed and hung up the phone.
A few minutes later, Connor received a text message from Thomas. It was the location of the hotel where Wynona’s wedding was held.
After Connor saw the message, he changed into a new set of clothes and rushed to the hotel with Carlos.
No matter what, Connor would not watch Wynona get married like this.

chapters.title: Chapter 983: Attending the Wedding
chapters.content:
Chapter 983: Attending the Wedding
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
10 AM.
Connor and Carlos arrived at the hotel where Wynona’s wedding was held.
At this moment, the entrance of the hotel was very lively. There were all kinds of luxury cars parked there. Any one of them was a top-notch sports car worth tens of millions.
Basically, anyone from the upper class of Dexas was invited to the wedding.
Therefore, these people were dressed very fashionably. One look and one could tell that they were not ordinary people.
At the entrance of the hotel, there was a photo of the couple. However, the woman in the photo had a cold expression on her face, while the man was smiling happily.
Connor narrowed his eyes as he looked at the photo at the entrance of the hotel. His eyes were filled with killing intent.
Wynona’s younger brother, Jerrico, was still lying in the hospital, and it was unknown whether he was dead or alive. The Marcus family was trying to marry Wynona to a fool at this time. This was simply trying to humiliate the Sassman family!
Even Connor, an outsider, could not stand such a thing happening.
Connor took a deep breath and walked straight into the hotel.
Because today was the day of the wedding, there were many people coming and going. Connor did not need to show an invitation card to enter the hall.
Carlos Lane did not follow Connor in. Instead, he chose to wait outside for Connor to come out.
At this moment, the hall was even livelier than the outside. The so-called upper echelons were exchanging greetings with each other. There were warm smiles on their faces, giving off an extremely amiable feeling.
Connor looked around and found that Wynona, Nadine, and the others hadn’t come out yet, so he found a random seat and sat down. He narrowed his eyes and observed the people in the hall.
A few minutes later, a girl in a spaghetti strap dress walked up to Connor.
When the girl saw Connor, she couldn’t help but be stunned for a moment. A strange look flashed across her eyes. Then, she ran to Connor’s side in her high heels and whispered, “Hey, do you have time now?”
“Do you have time?”
When Connor heard the girl’s words, he was also stunned for a moment. A trace of confusion flashed across his eyes.
At this moment, Connor finally saw the girl’s appearance clearly. The girl’s appearance was very beautiful. She had a standard oval face and a pair of bright eyes. She was wearing a white spinning dress with spaghetti straps. Her sexy figure was faintly discernible under the dress, and she was very attractive.
Although the girl was very beautiful, Connor knew too many beautiful women now. He had long been immune to beautiful women. It was impossible for him to be distracted when he saw a beautiful woman like before.
The girl who appeared in front of Connor was called Jennifer Goodwin. She was trying to get rid of a rich heir, so when she saw Connor just now, she wanted Connor to pretend to be her boyfriend.
“I need you to do me a favor now…” Jennifer replied hurriedly, then walked straight to Connor’s side, as if she wanted to grab his arm.
When Connor saw the girl’s actions, he hurriedly took two steps back and asked Jennifer expressionlessly, “What do you want?”
This was not the first time Connor had been someone else’s shield. Connor was very disgusted by this kind of thing because every time he helped, he would bring trouble to himself. In addition, Connor was not in a good mood now, so he instinctively rejected Jennifer.
When Jennifer saw Connor avoid her, she was a little angry. Then, she raised her head and glared at him before saying arrogantly, “I need you to do me a favor now. Why are you hiding? I let you take advantage of me, and you’re not happy?”
Perhaps it was because Connor had experienced this kind of thing many times, so Connor knew what Jennifer wanted to do. “I already have a girlfriend. Go find someone else!” he replied bluntly.
“You…”
When Jennifer heard Connor’s words, she was instantly dumbfounded, an incredulous expression on her faces. After all, Jennifer was a famous beauty in Dexas and was surrounded by countless suitors. No matter what kind of man saw Jennifer, he would be tempted.
However, Jennifer had never been in a relationship.
If it were any other man, he would have helped Jennifer even if he had to risk his life. Therefore, in Jennifer’s eyes, no man could reject her request.
But Connor actually rejected her.
This made Jennifer’s expression very ugly. She frowned and shouted at Connor, “Do you know what kind of person I am? I gave you a chance to help me once, but you’re still making excuses here. You really don’t know what’s good for you!”
As Jennifer spoke, she sized up Connor in front of her. For some reason, she felt that the boy in front of her looked familiar, but she could not remember where she had seen him before.
Connor glanced at Jennifer indifferently. He was not in the mood to talk nonsense with a woman like Jennifer, nor did he want to cause any more trouble, so he turned around and prepared to leave.
When Jennifer saw that Connor was about to leave, the expression on her face seemed to become even angrier. She had never been ignored by a man like this in her entire life!
Therefore, she hurriedly ran to Connor and raised her pretty face as she shouted angrily, “Aren’t you a little too ignorant? It’s your blessing that I asked you to help, but you actually have this attitude towards me. You have to pretend to be my boyfriend today, or I won’t let you leave…”
“Didn’t you hear what I said just now? I don’t have time to deal with you. Go find someone else!” Connor frowned and rebuked.
“No, you…”
Jennifer looked at Connor and was about to speak, but at this moment, a few boys surrounded Jennifer. One of the boys in a suit smiled at Jennifer and said, “Jenny, why are you running so fast? How long has it been since we last met? Why don’t you come with me for a drink or two?”
“This annoying man!”
When Jennifer saw the boy in the lead, her expression was a little angry. Then, she hugged Connor’s arm and whispered to Connor, “Pretend to be my boyfriend now and help me get rid of these people.”
“…”
Connor looked at the girl beside him with a broken face because he really couldn’t understand why he kept encountering such things.
Connor opened his mouth and was about to refuse.
“I said, I’m—”
“Jenny, who is this person?”
However, before Connor could finish speaking, a voice called out from behind her.
When the young man in the lead saw Jennifer holding Connor’s arm, his expression instantly changed. He asked Jennifer in a low voice, “Jenny, what’s going on?”

chapters.title: Chapter 984: Do We Know Each Other?
chapters.content:
Chapter 984: Do We Know Each Other?
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Jennifer held Connor’s arm and said provocatively, “He’s my boyfriend!”
Collis hesitated for a moment and asked Connor in disbelief.
“Are you really her boyfriend?”
“I’m not…”
Connor did not hesitate at all. He shook off Jennifer’s hand and turned to leave.
Jennifer bit her red lips and stood rooted to the ground. The expression on her face was very angry. She never thought that she would be so insignificant in front of Connor that he wouldn’t even help with such a small matter.
Moreover, many people around her heard Connor’s words. She felt that she had lost all her pride at this point.
Jennifer was extremely angry, but she was not in the mood to deal with Connor. She had to get rid of Collis first.
After Collis figured out what was going on, he smiled and said, “Jenny, this kid doesn’t seem to be cooperating with you!”
“Collis, I told you just now that I don’t want to go drinking with you. Can you stop pestering me?” Jennifer looked at the man in front of her in a bad mood and scolded him coldly.
“Jenny, I’ve liked you for so long. Can’t you just give me a chance?”
At this moment, Collis was completely shameless and refused to let go of Jennifer.
“You like me?” Jennifer sneered and continued, “Collis, do you think I don’t know what your true feelings are? You just want to play with me. Do you think I don’t know what you’re thinking? If it wasn’t because of your father, I wouldn’t even bother talking with you. I didn’t say anything too serious because I wanted to preserve your pride a little, but can’t you be a little less shameless? Are you only going to feel better once I insult you?”
Jennifer was still angry at Connor for rejecting her, so she could only vent her anger on Collis. Naturally, her words were very unpleasant.
After being scolded by Jennifer, Collis’s expression immediately changed. He glared at Jennifer and shouted. “You dare insult me?”
“Why wouldn’t I? Who do you think you are? A lazy heir like you who is just waiting to die should go out and deceive those little girls. You actually want to lie to me? You’re still far from it. If you don’t want to be insulted, then get lost. I don’t want to see you!”
Jennifer’s temper flared up as she shouted at Collis.
After hearing Jennifer’s words, Collis finally could not hold it in any longer. He rushed to Jennifer and raised his right hand to slap her face.
However, just as Collis’s hand was about to slap her face, a hand suddenly reached out from Jennifer’s hand and grabbed his wrist tightly.
Collis raised his head abruptly and saw that the person behind Jennifer was none other than Connor.
Jennifer was also in disbelief because she did not expect Connor to come back.
Connor didn’t want to be a busybody, but when he saw that Collis was about to hit someone, he had no choice but to do it.
“Brat, what is the meaning of this?”
Collis frowned.
“Although I’m not this girl’s boyfriend, isn’t it a little inappropriate for a man like you to hit a girl in front of so many people?” Connor asked expressionlessly.
When Collis heard Connor’s words, he could not help but be stunned for a moment. Then, he said with a ferocious expression, “Who do you think you are? Hurry up and let go of me now, or I’ll make you suffer…”
“…”
Connor glanced at Collis indifferently, then slowly released his wrist.
When Collis saw Connor loosen his grip, he revealed a smug smile, thinking that Connor had let go because he knew his place.
“Kid, this matter today has nothing to do with you. Get lost!”
Collis shouted arrogantly at Connor.
“…”
Connor stood still.
“What the hell are you guys doing? You dare to meddle in my business? I must teach you a lesson today!”
“Connor!” Collis shouted at his friend excitedly when he saw that Connor had not left.
After hearing Collis’s words, all of Collis’s friends looked helpless, but no one chose to make a move.
“What are you all doing? Didn’t you fucking hear me when I told you to do it?”
Collis shouted excitedly when he saw that his friends did not make a move.
One of the young men walked to Collis’s side and reminded him in a low voice, “Collis, remember that today is Kenny’s wedding day. If we cause trouble here, the Marcus family will definitely not let us off…”
After hearing the young man’s words, Collis finally realized what was going on. He also knew that it was not a wise choice to cause trouble in the Marcus family’s territory.
Therefore, after adjusting his mood, he said coldly to Connor, “Kid, you’re lucky today. What’s your name?”
“Connor McDonald!”
Connor glanced at Collis and replied calmly.
When Jennifer heard the name Connor McDonald, she turned around and looked at Connor with an incredulous expression.
“Alright, your name is Connor, right? Just you wait. This isn’t over between the two of us today. I’ll settle the score with you when the time comes!”
Collis shouted at Connor excitedly before leaving with his men.
After Connor saw Collis and the others leave, a trace of helplessness flashed across his eyes. He simply did not want to bother with people like Collis, so he planned to turn around and leave.
“Wait a moment!”
After Jennifer collected her thoughts, she hurriedly shouted at Connor.
Connor slowly turned his head to look at her. He asked softly, “Is there anything else?”
“What did you say your name was?” Jennifer asked in confusion.
“Connor McDonald!”
“It’s really you… I was wondering why you looked so familiar. After so many years, I couldn’t even recognize you…” Jennifer said happily.
When Connor heard Jennifer’s words, his expression seemed to become even more puzzled. He frowned and asked, “Do we know each other?”
“You actually don’t even recognize me…”
Jennifer looked at Connor and pouted slightly, as if she was a little angry.
“I… I don’t have any recollection…”
Connor scratched his head and said helplessly.

chapters.title: Chapter 985: Wynona Appears
chapters.content:
Chapter 985: Wynona Appears
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
“It’s me, Jennifer Goodwin!”
Jennifer shouted excitedly at Connor.
“You’re Jennifer?”
Connor looked at the girl in front of him and was instantly dumbfounded, an expression of disbelief on his face.
Although Connor could not tell who this girl was just by looking at her appearance, he was still very familiar with the name Jennifer Goodwin.
Jennifer was Connor’s primary school classmate. At that time, Connor was still living in Dexas, and his parents had not passed away yet. That was probably the happiest time for Connor.
Jennifer was Connor’s primary school deskmate, and the two of them often went to school together. However, after Jennifer’s family emigrated abroad, Connor never heard from her again.
“Do you want to go now?” Jennifer asked Connor with a smile.
“I didn’t expect to meet you here. It’s been more than ten years since we last met, right?” Connor said to Jennifer in surprise.
“That’s right. I haven’t seen you since my family migrated!”
Jennifer nodded gently.
Connor hesitated for a moment and asked Jennifer softly. “Aren’t you living abroad now?”
“I’ve been back in the country for two years. My father’s business is now in Dexas, so our family moved back…” Jennifer explained.
“So that’s how it is!”
Connor nodded thoughtfully.
“By the way, what have you been busy with all these years? Why did they say that you were dead when I went to your house to look for you after I returned?”
Jennifer asked Connor softly.
“In their eyes, I might be dead…” Connor smiled helplessly and continued, “I’ve been attending university in Porthampton and rarely come back. I came back this time because of some personal matters!”
Jennifer blinked and asked in a strange tone, “Are you here to attend Wynona Sassman’s wedding?”
Jennifer and Wynona knew each other, so she naturally knew the relationship between Connor and Wynona.
“No, I came back because of something else. Coincidentally, Wynona’s wedding is being held today, so I came over to take a look…”
Connor replied.
“Oh, oh!”
Jennifer nodded, then slowly raised her head to look at Connor and said in a low voice, “Connor, do you know?”
“Know what?”
Connor asked with a puzzled expression when he saw Jennifer’s hesitant expression.
“Actually, it’s nothing much. I won’t say anything…”
Jennifer waved her small hand and said casually.
“You’re talking about how Wynona is going to marry a handicapped man, right?” Connor asked indifferently.
“You already know about this?”
Jennifer looked at Connor with a hint of surprise in her eyes.
“This doesn’t seem to be a secret!” Connor smiled faintly.
“You can still laugh? Wynona is so good-looking and talented, but now she has to marry a fool. I feel that it’s not worth it for her. I even heard that Wynona almost tried to take her own life several times because of this, but the Marcus family seems to have been threatening her with Jerrico’s life. In the end, she had no choice but to agree…”
Jennifer whispered to Connor, then blinked and continued, “Did you know that Jerrico was involved in a car accident?”
“Yes…”
Connor nodded lightly.
“I think Nadine Marcus is definitely involved in this. That woman is not a good person!” Jennifer continued.
After hearing Jennifer’s words, Connor realized that what the Marcus family had done to the Sassman family was not a secret at all. Since Jennifer knew so much, it meant that everyone else in Dexas should know as well.
However, Hugo Sassman was worried that the Marcus family would do something even more outrageous, so he could only choose to endure and not resist.
When Jennifer saw that Connor did not say anything, she could not help but sigh in her heart. She originally thought that Connor would be very shocked and angry after knowing these things.
However, Connor’s expression was very calm at this moment, which made Jennifer feel a little disappointed. She gave the matter a bit of thought and realized that this was actually a very normal thing. After all, so many years had passed, and many things had happened to Connor. Connor could not be like a child forever.
Jennifer felt that the Connor standing in front of her now might not be the Connor she knew back then. This made Jennifer feel a little disappointed.
In the blink of an eye, half an hour passed.
Almost all the guests had arrived. At this moment, the entire hall was filled with guests, and everyone was waiting for the bride and groom to appear.
However, Connor realized that all the people who had come were invited by the Marcus family, and no one from the Sassman family was here. At this time, the Sassman family seemed to have no choice but to use this method to oppose the marriage.
Soon, the emcee walked onto the stage and announced the official start of the wedding.
Kenny and Wynona walked onto the stage with a group of people surrounding them.
Connor narrowed his eyes as he looked at Wynona. He was filled with emotions. It had been so many years since they last met, but Wynona was still as beautiful as ever.
When in a wedding dress, Wynona stunned everyone present.
However, Connor could see a trace of despair in Wynona’s eyes. She was moving her body like a zombie.
Soon, Kenny and Wynona walked onto the stage.
The gorgeous lights shone on the two of them. Connor’s cold gaze stared at Wynona’s position, and his body kept trembling.
If Connor had not returned to Dexas, he would not have known that the Sassman family was suffering from these things.
However, the Sassman family was still very lucky. He hadn’t returned too late—at the very least, he could save Wynona from the Marcus family.
Connor looked at the groom. Kenny was a fat man who weighed nearly 200 pounds. His IQ was only that of a five-year-old child, but he had violent tendencies and liked to hit people.
As for Wynona, she was a famous beauty in the city. Not only was she pretty, but she also had an extraordinary aura.
Before the Sassman family met with any mishaps, countless people were secretly in love with Wynona. However, when these people found out that Wynona was going to marry Kenny, they chose to turn a blind eye to it and became cowards.
After all, the Marcus family was one of the top families in Dexas. Anyone who offended them would be courting death.
At this moment, countless people below the stage were envious of that drooling fool. They even felt that they might not even be as good as a fool if even someone like him could still marry such a top-notch woman as his wife!

chapters.title: Chapter 986: Who Would be Willing to Marry a Fool?
chapters.content:
Chapter 986: Who Would be Willing to Marry a Fool?
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
“Kenny has such a good life. He is actually able to marry a top-notch beauty like Wynona Sassman…”
“That’s right. This is simply a gift from heaven. How good would it be if Wynona was given to me!”
“There is no need to be anxious. Kenny is a fool. Wynona won’t be able to hold back soon enough. She will then find other men. Then, we’ll have a chance…”
“Bro, are you crazy? Kenny is a fool, but the Marcus Family is not a fool. What kind of person is his cousin, Nadine Marcus? If you dare to touch Wynona, you’ll be dead meat…”
“What do you know? Actually, Kenny’s father has already taken a fancy to Wynona. She’s taking a concubine for his father…”
A few guys gathered below the stage started discussing in low voices.
When Jennifer heard their conversation, a trace of anger flashed across her eyes. She turned and glared at those people.
The guys chose to ignore Jennifer and continued to discuss in low voices.
The wedding had already begun.
The beautiful emcee held the microphone and asked Kenny with a smile, “Mr. Kenny Marcus, may I ask if you are willing to marry Miss Wynona Sassman?”
“…”
Kenny was fiddling with the toy in his hand and was not paying attention to the emcee at all. Even when the others urged Kenny from behind, Kenny still did not react.
However, when a beautiful woman in a red dress appeared in Kenny’s line of sight, Kenny instantly became obedient.
He hurriedly nodded and stammered, “I… I’m willing…”
The emcee smiled and turned to look at Wynona. He asked her softly, “Miss Wynona Sassman, are you willing to marry Mr. Kenny Marcus?”
After hearing the emcee’s question, Wynona fell silent. She kept her head lowered, not knowing how to answer.
When the beauty in the dress saw that Wynona was silent, she looked a little angry. Then, she looked at the bridesmaid beside Wynona.
When the bridesmaid saw the gaze of the beauty in the dress, she instantly reacted and said in a low voice, “Miss Sassman, are you going to go back on your word now?”
Wynona’s delicate body trembled slightly. Then, she hurriedly said, “I am…”
“She’s not willing!”
Before Wynona could finish speaking, a voice came from below the stage.
When everyone heard this voice, they were all stunned. They were in shock.
No one had expected that someone would be so bold as to cause trouble at the Marcus Family’s wedding.
Wynona, who was standing on the stage, subconsciously looked down when she heard this. Then, she locked her gaze on Connor.
“Connor McDonald?”
Wynona didn’t know that Connor had already returned. When she saw Connor, she was surprised.
Jennifer, who was standing beside Connor, was even more shocked. She was the closest to Connor, so she could naturally hear that it was him who shouted just now.
“Connor, are you crazy?”
Jennifer turned to look at Connor and shouted.
“I’m not crazy…”
Connor replied indifferently and continued, “Wynona doesn’t want to marry this fool!”
“Of course, not one would be willing to marry a fool. But why did you have to point that out?”
Jennifer widened her watery eyes and shouted exasperatedly.
“Since she’s not willing, why would she say yes?”
Connor replied indifferently, then walked straight to the stage.
“Connor, what are you doing?”
When Jennifer saw Connor walking toward the stage, she hurriedly reached out and pulled him back.
However, Connor was very strong. Jennifer could not hold him back at all.
In an instant, everyone’s attention was focused on Connor. No one could understand what he was doing. Even the emcee on the stage was dumbfounded.
“Who is this kid?”
“Is this kid crazy? He actually came here to cause trouble. Isn’t he courting death?”
“That’s right. This is the Marcus Family’s wedding. What’s the difference between causing trouble here and courting death?”
“This person must be Wynona Sassman’s suitor. He can’t accept her marrying Kenny!”
Everyone looked at Connor and began to discuss.
Collis Lowery, who had a conflict with Connor before, naturally recognized that the person walking up the stage was Connor.
He couldn’t help but laugh coldly. Then, he sighed in his heart. ‘Looks like there’s no need for me to take action this time around. Someone will help me teach Connor a lesson…’
On the stage, Wynona also reacted to what was going on. She hurriedly shook her head at Connor, indicating that Connor should not continue walking forward.
However, Connor acted as if he did not see anything and continued to walk up the stage.
The Marcus Family’s faces began to turn ugly. They did not expect someone to be so bold as to come here and cause trouble.
“Holden, go and take a look at what is going on…”
Nadine Marcus, the beauty in a dress, whispered to the man beside her.
“Okay!”
Holden Marcus nodded and then walked toward Connor in large strides. He asked Connor in a low voice, “Sir, what do you want?”
“Get lost!”
Connor did not like the Marcus Family, so he scolded Holden coldly.
“Sir, today is my brother’s wedding. Isn’t it a little inappropriate for you to ask me to get lost? Also, I don’t recognize you. May I ask who invited you?”
Now that there were so many people watching, Holden did not dare to go overboard. He suppressed the anger in his heart and asked Connor in a low voice.
“Isn’t this person Connor McDonald?”
However, at this moment, a guy suddenly shouted.
Connor slowly turned to look at the guy. This guy was none other than Connor’s uncle’s son, Connor’s cousin, Bradley McDonald!
When Bradley saw Connor turn around, he was even more certain that it was Connor. He hurriedly ran out of the crowd and shouted at Connor, “Connor, what are you doing here? Come with me now…”
The reason why Bradley was acting this way was not because he cared about Connor, but because he didn’t want to affect the relationship between the McDonald Family and the Marcus Family because of Connor.
When Holden found out that Connor was from the McDonald family, he was obviously much more at ease.
…

chapters.title: Chapter 987: Do What I Say While I'm Being Nice!
chapters.content:
Chapter 987: Do What I Say While I’m Being Nice!
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Although Dexas could not compare to Porthampton, it was definitely ranked in the top three in Davenport.
The Marcus Family’s influence in Dexas was terrifying. Basically, as long as it was a slightly famous family in Dexas, the Marcus Family would have connections with it.
Connor’s family gradually declined due to the death of his parents. Now, they could only be considered a small family in Dexas.
Seeing that Connor was so arrogant and dared to cause trouble in such an occasion, Holden thought that Connor’s background was terrifying. However, Bradley’s appearance shattered Holden’s doubts. If Connor was a member of the McDonald Family, then he would have nothing to worry about when dealing with Connor.
Bradley looked at Connor and was very puzzled. After all, Connor had never returned after being chased out of the McDonald Family.
At this moment, Connor had suddenly returned to Dexas. Bradley was in disbelief.
However, Bradley was not in the mood to care about why Connor came back. He just wanted to hurry up and get rid of Connor. If Connor really made a big deal out of this, their McDonald Family might also suffer.
“Connor, is this a place you can mess around in? Come with me now!”
Bradley shouted at Connor like an elder scolding a junior.
“Who do you think you are? Get lost!”
Connor didn’t have a good impression of Bradley and said coldly.
“You… You actually dare to tell me to get lost?
“Connor, do you think you’re all that now? How dare you scold me? Do you think that I can’t deal with you just because you’ve been studying elsewhere for a few years?”
Bradley shouted with his eyes wide open.
After Connor’s parents passed away, Bradley often bullied Connor and humiliated him. In Bradley’s eyes, Connor was trash.
At this moment, Bradley was scolded by a trash like Connor, so he naturally felt very angry.
“So, this kid is the child who was chased out by the McDonald Family?”
“I didn’t expect this person to be that trash from the McDonald Family!”
“Why is he back? Isn’t this kid already dead?”
“He didn’t die. He’s been delivering food outside to make a living…”
When everyone heard Bradley’s words, they instantly remembered Connor.
After all, the incident where Connor was chased out of Dexas by the McDonald Family had caused quite a stir in the city. Many people knew about it.
Holden looked at Connor and sneered. At this moment, he seemed to be even less concerned about Connor.
Connor glanced at Bradley and said coldly, “I told you to get lost, did you hear me? This has nothing to do with you!”
“Connor, are you trying to piss me off? Do what I say while I’m being nice!”
Bradley shouted with his eyes wide open, and then he reached out to attack Connor.
Connor looked at Bradley, and a trace of helplessness flashed across his eyes. Then, without any hesitation, he turned and slapped Bradley’s face.
Smack!
A crisp sound rang out.
Before Bradley could react, he was sent flying by Connor’s slap.
When everyone saw this scene, they were all stunned. Their mouths were wide open.
Because no one expected Connor to be so bold, actually daring to hit someone in front of so many people.
Connor didn’t use his full strength in this slap, but it was still no problem for him to deal with an ordinary person like Bradley.
Bradley was sent flying by Connor’s slap. He smashed onto the table, and he fainted.
The hall instantly fell into a deathly silence.
On the stage, Wynona seemed to have been frightened by Connor. She stared at Connor with her big, watery eyes. Her beautiful eyes were filled with shock. She really couldn’t understand why Connor had suddenly become so bold.
In Wynona’s impression, Connor was the most afraid of the McDonald Family.
But at this moment, Connor seemed to have changed into a different person. He even dared to hit his cousin, Bradley.
Wynona might not know that the current Connor was no longer the same guy from before.
Jennifer covered her mouth, and her eyes widened like copper bells.
Previously, when Jennifer saw that Connor was very indifferent about Wynona marrying Kenny, she was more or less disappointed. However, she did not expect that Connor’s indifference at that time was just a preparation for his current outburst.
However, Jennifer felt that it was not a wise choice for Connor to cause trouble at the Marcus Family’s wedding. If this matter blew up, Connor might be in big trouble.
When Holden saw that Bradley was sent flying with a slap, a smug smile appeared on his face.
Because he didn’t have a reason to attack Connor, and now he finally had one!
Therefore, Holden rushed to Connor and shouted at him, “Who exactly are you? What do you want?”
“Don’t you know what I want to do?”
Connor looked at Holden and asked coldly.
“First, you caused trouble at the Marcus Family’s wedding, and now you’ve injured our family’s honored guest. I don’t care who you are, you must pay the price!”
Although Holden’s words sounded righteous and awe-inspiring, he was just finding an excuse for himself to deal with Connor.
“Pay the price?”
Connor looked at Holden and could not help but sneer.
The Marcus Family had always been domineering. At this moment, Holden had already figured out Connor’s true identity. He naturally did not have any scruples in his heart and was about to attack Connor.
When Connor saw Holden who was about to attack him, a trace of disdain flashed in his eyes.
Holden’s skills might be considered pretty good compared to ordinary people, but compared to Connor, it was simply nothing!
Bang!
Connor lifted his leg and kicked Holden’s knee.
“Ah!”
Immediately after, Holden let out a miserable cry.
Before everyone could figure out what was going on, Holden knelt in front of Connor in pain.
“I told you to get lost just now because I was giving you a chance. Since you don’t know how to cherish it, then you can’t blame me!”
Connor looked at Holden who was kneeling in front of him. His tone was extremely cold, but everyone could hear a trace of killing intent.
The entire hall instantly fell silent. Everyone could only hear Holden’s painful wails.
…

chapters.title: Chapter 988: Getting Into Trouble?
chapters.content:
Chapter 988: Getting Into Trouble?
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
No one expected Connor’s skills to be so terrifying. He broke Holden’s right leg with a single move.
For a moment, everyone’s gaze was on Connor.
