“Is this person really the trash who was chased away by the McDonald Family back then?”
“That’s right, isn’t this kid too bold? He even dared to hit Holden Marcus. He must want to die!”
“This kid might be something. He’s so powerful and doesn’t even put the Marcus Family in his eyes. He shouldn’t be an ordinary person!”
Everyone looked at Connor and began to discuss softly.
Wynona and Jennifer looked at Connor with worried expressions.
Jennifer felt that since Connor had hit Holden, the Marcus Family would definitely not let him go.
Wynona was very confused. She felt that the Connor who had appeared at the wedding did not seem to be the Connor she knew.
Whether it was his style of doing things or the feeling he gave people, the current Connor was very different from the previous Connor.
When the beautiful woman in the dress standing beside the stage saw this scene, she could not help but frown. She was now curious about Connor’s true identity. She saw an unprecedented temperament on Connor. This temperament seemed to be above everyone else.
On the other hand, Connor was very calm, as if no matter what the people around him said, it had nothing to do with him.
“Mr. Holden, are you alright?”
At this moment, a middle-aged man rushed to Holden’s side and exclaimed.
Holden’s leg had been broken by Connor’s kick earlier, and he was already in so much pain that he could not speak.
When the middle-aged man saw how badly Holden was beaten by Connor, he became even angrier. He glared at Connor and scolded, “Brat, aren’t you being a little too arrogant? Do you know who he is? You actually dare to hit him…”
“Then, do you know who I am?”
Connor looked at the middle-aged man in front of him with an extremely disdainful expression and asked coldly.
When the middle-aged man heard Connor’s words, he seemed to be a little dumbfounded and was speechless for a moment.
Connor smiled faintly and said in a threatening tone, “I advise you not to meddle in other people’s business. Be careful not to get into trouble!”
When everyone heard Connor’s words, their eyes widened, and they were in disbelief.
This was because the middle-aged man standing in front of Connor was not an ordinary person. He was Chandler Weatherby, the number one boss of Dexas’s underworld. He had been working with the Marcus Family for many years, which was why the middle-aged man was so anxious when Holden was beaten up by Connor.
Chandler had been in Dexas for so many years and had killed countless people. Basically, anyone who offended Chandler in Dexas would not have a good ending.
Therefore, many people were terrified of people like Chandler. Regardless of how rich or powerful someone was, if he were to provoke someone like Chandler, he might not even be able to keep his life!
Not only did Connor offend the Marcus Family, but he also wanted to offend Chandler. It was obvious that he did not plan to leave Dexas alive!
“Get into trouble?”
Chandler couldn’t help but frown when he heard Connor’s words.
No matter what, Chandler was considered one of the top bosses in Dexas. When he heard Connor’s words, not only was he not afraid, but he also sneered.
“Chandler, please help me kill this kid. As long as you help me kill this kid, I owe you big time!”
Holden endured the pain in his leg and shouted with a ferocious expression.
When Chandler heard Holden’s words, he turned to look at Holden and said indifferently, “Mr. Holden, leave this matter to me…”
Holden stared at Connor with his eyes wide open. At this moment, in Holden’s eyes, Connor was clearly already a dead man.
“Brat, you broke Mr. Holden’s leg today. You must give the Marcus Family an explanation!”
Chandler walked up to Connor and said calmly.
“What’s your name?”
Connor asked Chandler softly.
“Chandler Weatherby!”
Chandler replied without hesitation.
Connor smiled faintly and said calmly, “If you help me break his other leg now, I will let you go…”
Chandler looked at Connor and was dumbfounded. He couldn’t understand what Connor meant.
He was clearly standing up for Holden now, yet Connor actually wanted him to break Holden’s legs. Was he confused?
“Kid, do you still not understand the situation?”
Chandler frowned and asked Connor.
“It’s not that I don’t know what’s going on. You’re the one who doesn’t know what’s going on!”
Connor smiled, then walked over to Chandler and whispered a few words into his ear.
After hearing Connor’s words, Chandler’s eyes flashed with shock. He looked at Connor in disbelief.
“How… How can I be sure if what you said is true or not?”
Chandler stuttered as he asked Connor.
Connor took out his phone and dialed Kyle Hayes’s number.
“Mr. McDonald, how can I help you?”
Kyle asked respectfully after answering the phone.
“Chandler Weatherby wants to confirm if I really know you!”
Connor replied and handed his phone to Chandler.
Chandler looked at Connor and hesitated for two seconds. Then, he took the phone with trembling hands.
After taking the phone, Chandler asked carefully, “Hello, may I know who you are?”
“Chandler, it’s me!”
Kyle said.
Chandler was stunned when he heard the voice of Kyle Hayes. His face was filled with disbelief.
Connor was not lying to him. Connor actually knew Kyle Hayes!
“Chandler, you’re quite bold now, huh? Do you know who Mr. McDonald is? You dare to offend him? Are you tired of living?”
Kyle naturally knew what had happened, so he didn’t hold back and scolded coldly.
…

chapters.title: Chapter 989: Nadine Marcus
chapters.content:
Chapter 989: Nadine Marcus
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
When Chandler heard what Kyle said, he was stunned. His face was filled with fear.
“Kyle, I… I know, don’t worry… I know what to do…”
Chandler said carefully as he held Connor’s phone.
The people present couldn’t hear what Kyle was saying on the other end of the line, but they could tell from Chandler’s expression that he was very afraid.
Connor stood in his original spot, his expression unusually calm.
Connor knew that Kyle was no longer just the big brother of the underworld in Porthampton. Basically, no one in the four provinces dared to go against Kyle. Therefore, when dealing with people like Chandler, finding Kyle was the simplest and most effective way.
Connor had come today for Wynona. He didn’t want to waste time on someone like Chandler. Since it could be resolved with a phone call, Connor felt that there was no need for him to fight someone like Chandler.
A few minutes later, Chandler hung up the phone with trepidation. Then, he respectfully returned the phone to Connor.
“Mr… Mr. McDonald, I was blind just now. Please… Please don’t lower yourself to my level…”
Chandler stuttered.
When the people in the hall heard what Chandler said to Connor, they instantly fell into a state of agitation. They were in disbelief.
No one had expected Chandler’s attitude toward Connor to change so drastically.
Even the way the Marcus Family looked at Connor had changed greatly. They could not understand what was going on.
Why did Chandler apologize to Connor after he made a phone call?
Meanwhile, the beauty in the dress standing beside the stage narrowed her eyes as she looked at Connor. At this moment, she had already confirmed that her judgment was correct. Connor was indeed not an ordinary person. Otherwise, Chandler would not be acting this way all of a sudden.
“Do you still remember what I told you just now?”
Connor asked Chandler expressionlessly.
Chandler suddenly raised his head and looked at Connor. He looked a little awkward.
After hesitating for a couple of seconds, he whispered to Connor, “Yes!”
“Since you remember, then do it!”
Connor said calmly to Chandler.
Chandler took a deep breath, then slowly turned around and walked toward Holden.
At this moment, Holden also realized that something was wrong. A trace of fear flashed across his eyes as he shouted at Chandler, “Chandler, what are you doing? Are you really going to listen to this kid?”
“Mr. Holden, I’m sorry!”
Chandler now knew Connor’s true identity. In Chandler’s eyes, the small Marcus Family was nothing compared to Connor. Therefore, it did not matter if he offended the Marcus Family because of Connor.
“Chandler, what kind of drug did this kid put on you? Why are you listening to him?”
At this moment, Holden didn’t seem to understand what was going on. He shouted at Chandler with a terrified expression.
Chandler acted as if he hadn’t heard Holden’s words. He took out a pistol from his clothes and aimed it at Holden.
When the guests in the hall saw Chandler take out his gun, they were even more dumbfounded.
They really couldn’t understand what was going on. Why did Chandler seem to have changed into a different person after answering a phone call?
Jennifer and Wynona looked at Connor in shock.
At this moment, the two of them suddenly realized that Connor did not seem to be the same Connor from before. He definitely had some terrifying background that caused Chandler to change 180 degrees.
However, even if the two of them racked their brains, they could not figure out what background Connor had!
“Mr. Weatherby, are you planning to make an enemy of the Marcus Family?”
However, just as Chandler was about to shoot at Holden’s other thigh, a cold voice rang out in the hall.
Everyone turned to look after hearing the voice.
A sexy beauty in a dress walked out from beside the stage in high heels.
When Wynona saw this woman, a trace of anger flashed across her eyes. This woman was the culprit who caused the Sassman Family to be destroyed. She was Jerico Sassman’s wife, Nadine Marcus!
In Wynona’s eyes, Nadine was like a demon. She had never seen such a vicious woman.
Connor also slowly looked at Nadine. He knew that this woman was the person he was looking for today.
When Chandler saw Nadine come out, he seemed to be a little conflicted. He subconsciously turned his head to look at Connor.
“Shot him!”
Connor didn’t give a woman like Nadine any face at all. He said coldly.
“…”
Chandler didn’t dare to go against Connor’s wishes, so he gritted his teeth and pulled the trigger.
Bang!
There was a loud bang.
The bullet pierced through Holden’s thigh with extreme precision.
After Holden wailed, he fainted due to the intense pain.
When Nadine saw this scene, a trace of anger flashed across her eyes. She walked to Connor in her high heels and asked him coldly, “Who exactly are you? Today is a joyous day for the Marcus Family. First, you injured our honored guest, and now you broke my brother’s legs. What do you want? Do you really think that the Marcus Family is easy to bully?”
“Are you Jerico’s wife?”
Connor asked indifferently.
“…”
When Nadine heard Jerico’s name, her delicate body trembled, and a strange look flashed across her beautiful eyes.
The reason Nadine dared to deal with Sassman Family in this way was because she had already figured out all the details of the Sassman Family. She only chose to act after confirming that the Sassman Family had no other background.
However, she did not expect to walk down the wrong path still. Things had already reached this stage, yet there was still someone who was here to help the Sassman Family.
Moreover, Nadine could feel that Connor, who was standing in front of her, was not an ordinary person.
“That’s right, I’m Jerico Sassman’s wife. What about it?”
Nadine took a deep breath to calm herself down and replied with a cold expression.
…

chapters.title: Chapter 990: Can't Even Say A Word
chapters.content:
Chapter 990: Can’t Even Say A Word
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Connor looked at Nadine from head to toe and revealed a smug smile on his face.
Nadine was indeed quite beautiful. Her figure and appearance could be considered top-notch.
Nadine’s clothes were also very revealing. The hem of the dress was wrapped around her hips, revealing her sexy and beautiful legs.
Every move of hers exuded an extreme charm, giving off an allure that tempted all men.
No wonder Jerico was fascinated by such a woman!
However, Connor was already numb to beautiful women. He was very clear that the woman standing in front of him was a devil-like existence.
“I’m Jerico and Wynona’s friend. I’m taking Wynona with me today!”
Connor whispered to Nadine.
“Wynona is my brother’s fiancée. What right do you have to take her away?”
Nadine asked Connor.
“Your brother’s fiancée?”
Connor smiled disdainfully and then said indifferently, “Wynona doesn’t want to marry your brother, so the wedding is off!”
“Do you think it’s off just because you say it is?”
Nadine asked arrogantly.
“That’s right. If I say it’s off, then it’s off!”
“Haha…”
Nadine looked at Connor and couldn’t help but sneer. Then, she said indifferently, “Marriage is not something an outsider like you can decide. You have to ask Miss Sassman if she agrees to it or not!”
After saying this, Nadine turned to look at Wynona with a threatening expression.
As for Wynona, she stood there foolishly, not knowing what to do.
Connor was able to stand up for her, so she was naturally very touched, but she was more worried than touched.
Now, the fate of everyone in the Sassman Family was in the hands of the Marcus Family. If she did not marry Kenny Marcus today, everyone in the Sassman Family might be in danger.
Connor could save her now, but in the end, he could not save her forever.
Moreover, Wynona didn’t want to implicate Connor because of these things, so she stood where she was and didn’t know how to answer this question.
Connor knew what Wynona was worried about, so he didn’t give her any chance to speak. He walked to Wynona and whispered to her, “Wynona, since you don’t want to marry such a person, then don’t force yourself!”
“Connor, there are some things that you don’t know…”
Wynona hurriedly explained.
“I know very well about the matters of the Sassman Family. Trust me and leave with me!”
Connor said firmly to Wynona.
When Wynona saw Connor’s determined gaze, she subconsciously froze on the spot. Her expression was filled with embarrassment. At this moment, she seemed to not know what to do.
Chandler looked at Wynona and could not help but sigh to himself. The Marcus Family might have gotten into big trouble this time. Who would have thought that the Sassman Family, who was already at the end of their rope, would actually know such a big shot like Connor? A disaster was upon Dexas.
“Wynona, let’s go!”
Connor reached out and grabbed Wynona’s soft arm. He turned around and was prepared to leave.
“What right do you have to take Miss Sassman with you?”
At this moment, another middle-aged man stood up and shouted at Connor with an extremely angry expression.
“If I want to take her with me, I will take her with me. I don’t need a reason to do it!”
Connor coldly replied to the middle-aged man.
The middle-aged man couldn’t help but be stunned when he heard Connor’s words. Then, he gritted his teeth and said in a low voice, “Don’t think that the Marcus Family is so easy to bully. The Marcus Family will not let you off for breaking Holden’s legs!”
“Not let me off?”
Connor couldn’t help but sneer. Then, he said expressionlessly, “The Marcus Family has no right to do that!”
“Who exactly are you? What do you want?”
Nadine finally couldn’t take it anymore and shouted with an extremely angry expression.
“Tell her who I am!”
Connor turned and glanced at Chandler as he spoke indifferently.
When Chandler heard Connor’s words, he walked over to Nadine and whispered something to her.
When Nadine found out Connor’s true identity, she was so scared that she took two steps back and looked at him in disbelief.
She never thought that Connor’s background would be so terrifying!
“How is that possible?”
Nadine whispered.
She had lived with Jerico for more than a year, but she had never heard Jerico mention Connor. She did not know that Jerico knew such a big shot.
Connor’s appearance had disrupted all of Nadine’s plans.
Could this be the trump card of the Sassman Family?”
A strange look flashed across Nadine’s eyes.
“Jerico’s life and death are unknown, and the Marcus Family is still in the mood to hold a wedding here. It seems that Jerico was really harmed by you!”
Connor said to Nadine expressionlessly.
When Nadine heard Connor’s words, her face turned pale. She quickly retorted, “What nonsense! Jerico ended up like this because of the car accident. What does it have to do with me? Do you have any evidence?”
Although everyone in Dexas knew that Nadine had definitely harmed Jerico, this was a matter between the Sassman Family and the Marcus Family. Most people were just watching the show. No one would meddle in other people’s business, and no one would offend the Marcus Family over such a small matter.
“Do you still need evidence for this kind of thing?”
Connor replied indifferently and then continued, “I’m here today for two things. The first is to take Wynona with me. The second is to tell you that I’ll give you a week. If Jerico doesn’t wake up in a week’s time, I’ll make everyone in the Marcus Family disappear from Dexas. Do you understand what I mean?”
When everyone heard Connor’s words, they were very puzzled.
Because they really couldn’t understand what kind of background Connor had to actually dare to say such words!
Nadine, on the other hand, stood in place and looked at Connor. Others might not know what Connor’s background was, but Nadine knew very well in her heart.
She knew that she might really be in big trouble this time.
“Of course, if you want to deal with me within this week, you can use all your resources to deal with me.”
Connor looked at Nadine and continued.
Nadine looked at Connor in despair. For a moment, she seemed to be scared speechless by Connor’s aura.
Who would have thought that the Marcus Family’s eldest daughter, Nadine, who was all-powerful in Dexas, could not even say a word in front of Connor!

chapters.title: Chapter 991: A Terrifying Change
chapters.content:
Chapter 991: A Terrifying Change
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Connor saw Nadine standing still and not speaking. He couldn’t help but sneer and then held Wynona’s small hand, walking towards the outside of the hotel.
She closely followed behind Connor, her mind blank at the moment.
She had no idea why she had to do this, so she could only numbly follow Connor out of the lobby.
After hesitating for a moment, Jennifer also followed Connor out of the lobby.
Chandler took a deep breath and walked to Nadine’s side, then whispered to her, “Miss Llyod, you can find out who Mr. Connor is with just a casual inquiry. He is not someone we can afford to provoke, so I advise you to think of a solution quickly. Maybe you can still save the Llyod family once!”
Nadine glanced at Chandler, smiled bitterly, and remained silent.
Nadine could never have imagined that she would soon be able to take over all of Lloyd’s family properties. But at this critical moment, one person’s appearance changed everything.
In the previous second, Nadine was still complacent about the success of her plan, but in the next second, she fell into an abyss.
The people in the hall were confused and had no idea what was happening.
Connor took away the bride of the Lloyd family in front of so many people, and even broke Holden’s legs. And they just let him leave like that?
Nadine didn’t even try to stop him!
Such a scene was incredibly bizarre.
Many people even speculated in their hearts whether this was a deliberate arrangement by the Llyod family!
But they didn’t know that Nadine didn’t choose not to stop Connor, but she simply didn’t dare to stop him.
For Llyod’s family, Connor giving them a week’s time was already a stroke of luck in their misfortune.
Nadine watched as he disappeared, unable to help but bite her lip, her expression extremely complicated.
“Miss Nadine, what should we do now?”
At that moment, a middle-aged man walked up to Nadine’s side and asked her in a low voice.
“Ah…”
Nadine took a deep breath, quickly adjusted her emotions, and then said coldly, “I’m sorry, everyone. There has been a slight accident today, and the wedding may not be able to proceed as planned. We will have to reschedule it, and I will inform you all of the specific time later!”
The crowd looked at Nadine’s position, feeling extremely puzzled.
In fact, she was just speaking without any basis. So many people witnessed him taking away Wynona.
The bride had been taken away, and yet they were rescheduling the wedding. How was that possible?
Although everyone knew it in their hearts, no one dared to say it. Connor dared to offend the Llyod family, but they didn’t dare.
“And also, I don’t want more people to know about what happened today. If I find out who leaked the information, don’t blame me for being cruel!”
At that moment, Nadine threatened the crowd again.
Today’s events were a great humiliation for the Llyod family, and there was nothing more embarrassing than what happened today.
So Nadine had to keep the news sealed and deal with other matters.
The people present lowered their heads and remained silent.
After seeing that no one spoke, Nadine took another deep breath and then said faintly, “Please leave, everyone!”
Upon hearing these words, everyone felt a sense of relief and turned to leave the lobby.
Nadine stood alone in place, her expression unusually complex.
It was unclear how much time passed before she slowly turned and walked forward.
At this moment, she had only one thought, which was to hurry home and discuss with the head of the Llyod family how to deal with Connor.
Although she officially managed all of the Llyod family’s businesses and held the power, in reality, the one who truly called the shots in the Llyod family was her grandfather, the head of the Llyod family.
All the means to deal with the Sassman family were instructed by Nadine’s grandfather.
She was nothing more than a puppet displayed in front of everyone.
With such a significant event happening now, if they didn’t handle it well, it could bring disaster upon the Llyod family. So she felt it necessary to discuss this matter with her grandfather and see if they could come up with a good solution.
If Connor were just an ordinary second-generation wealthy person, she wouldn’t be so anxious today.
But unfortunately, Connor’s identity was terrifying to the point that she couldn’t even imagine. This matter clearly exceeded her scope of handling, and she felt extremely helpless.
…
On the other side, Connor, Wynona, Jennifer and the others had just walked out of the hotel when Chandler caught up with them.
“Mr. Connor, I was truly at fault for what happened in the hotel just now. It’s entirely my fault for not recognizing you. Can you give me another chance and not judge me based on today’s events?” Chandler ran up to Connor, his expression extremely humble.
Chandler was just a small underworld boss in Dexas. In that small place, he could do whatever he pleased. But if he looked at the entire Davenport, he didn’t even have the qualification to compete with Kyle. After all, Kyle was the true boss of Davenport, and the two were not on the same level at all.
And Connor was Kyle’s boss, so Chandler was naturally terrified of Connor.
“I said that as long as you break one of Holden’s legs, I won’t hold today’s incident against you. Now, get lost!” Connor glanced lightly at Chandler and calmly said.
“Thank you, Mr. Connor, thank you, Mr. Connor!” After hearing Connor’s words, Chandler naturally felt extremely excited. He quickly shouted at Connor a couple of times and then hurriedly turned and left in a fluster.
Wynona and Jennifer watched Connor, their eyes filled with doubt and astonishment. Both of them couldn’t understand who Connor really was and why he had undergone such terrifying changes in just a few years since they last met.
Connor had offended people like Chandler and Nadine today!
He had broken Holden’s legs, and the people from the Llyod family didn’t even have the courage to stop him.
And Chandler’s attitude towards Connor was even more peculiar.
Everything seemed so mysterious!

chapters.title: Chapter 992: Leave Dexas?
chapters.content:
Chapter 992: Leave Dexas?
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Wynona saw Chandler leaving and couldn’t help but express her doubts. She asked Connor in a soft voice, “Connor, what’s going on?”
“What’s going on?” Connor asked calmly.
“Don’t play dumb with me. Why did you break Holden’s legs? And do you know what consequences you’ll face by offending the Llyod family?” Wynona asked with great concern.
“If I didn’t break his legs, would the people from the Llyod family let me take you away?” He directly retorted.
“But what can you achieve by taking me away now? Do you know how terrifying the Llyod family is? Some things cannot be solved just by running away!” Wynona said with an agitated tone.
“Don’t worry, now that I’m back, I will handle this matter properly before leaving. Wynona, you don’t have to worry. With me around, no one dares to bully you!” he said with great confidence.
She was stunned for a moment after hearing Connor’s words. She furrowed her brow with a puzzled expression and asked, “Connor, who are you really? Why do those people seem so afraid of you?”
“I am who I am!” He looked at her and smiled faintly. At this moment, he didn’t want to explain too much because it would be troublesome if he clarified his true identity.
“Don’t joke with me. Who are you, really?” Wynona shouted at Connor, seemingly angry.
“Wynona, you don’t need to worry about who I am. Just remember, as long as I’m here, no one will dare to bully you. And I will help you seek revenge for Jerrico. If he can’t wake up, I will make those people pay a hundredfold!” Connor said to Wynona with a smile.
However, Wynona looked up at Connor, her expression helpless, and said, “But…”
“There’s no ‘but.’ Let’s go!” He didn’t give her a chance to continue speaking. He directly hailed a taxi and pulled her, preparing to get in.
At that moment, Connor suddenly noticed Jennifer standing aside and asked, “Jennifer, we’re planning to go to the hospital to see Jerrico. Are you coming?”
“I’m not going. You guys go!” She seemed to need some time to digest what had happened today. Besides, she was not really friends with Wynona or Jerrico; at most, they were just acquaintances. So she didn’t choose to go with them.
“Then contact me when you have time!” Connor smiled at Jennifer and then took Wynona into the taxi.
Throughout the journey, Wynona kept trying various ways to ask Connor why he did what he did and why the people from the Llyod family were so afraid of him.
However, he kept evading her questions and didn’t reveal his true identity to her because he felt that even if she knew who he really was, it wouldn’t make much of a difference.
Half an hour later, they arrived at the entrance of the hospital and walked into the ward where Jerrico was.
At this time, Hugo and Hugo’s wife were still in the ward. Perhaps due to worrying about their daughter, the two of them hadn’t slept all night and looked extremely tired.
But when Connor and Wynona appeared in front of them, both elderly people widened their eyes, their expressions filled with disbelief.
“Am I hallucinating?”
Hugo rubbed his eyes and shouted in disbelief.
“Hugo, why do I feel like I saw our daughter?”
Hugo’s wife also shouted along.
Upon hearing these words from Hugo and his wife, Wynona’s eyes instantly turned red, and she choked out, “Mom, Dad, Connor saved me!”
“Is it really you, Wynona?”
Only after hearing her voice did Hugo realize that what he was seeing was not an illusion but something that truly existed.
“It’s me!”
She nodded quickly.
“Wynona, what exactly is going on?”
Hugo asked with a puzzled expression.
She took a deep breath and recounted everything that had happened to Hugo and his wife.
After learning the whole story, he felt a mixture of joy and astonishment.
Of course, he didn’t want to see his daughter marry someone like Kenny, but because of the threats from the Llyod family, he had no choice but to agree.
Seeing that she hadn’t married him, he naturally felt very happy.
But when he learned that Connor had broken Holden’s legs and directly took Wynona away in front of so many people, his heart was filled with worry and fear.
He knew better than anyone what kind of person Nadine was.
Connor’s reckless actions today would surely incur the crazy retaliation of the Llyod family, and he himself might also be implicated.
Hugo felt that Connor’s actions today not only failed to solve the problem but also created more problems.
However, Hugo also knew that Connor had good intentions, so he didn’t want to blame him. Instead, he advised him softly, “Connor, I am very happy that you were able to rescue Wynona today. Actually, I also disagree with this marriage, but I didn’t have the courage to rescue Wynona!”
“Uncle Hugo, you and my father are best friends, and Jerrico and I are also best friends. When something happened to your family, of course, I wouldn’t stand by!”
Connor replied calmly.
“I am already very happy that you have such concern, but that woman Nadine is not someone you can deal with. Today, you broke Holden’s leg, and they will definitely not let you go. Listen to my advice, leave Dexas now. As long as you leave here, the Llyod family won’t have any way to deal with you…”
Hugo continued to advise Connor as he looked at him.
“Leave Dexas City?”
Connor looked at Hugo in surprise, then asked softly, “Uncle Hugo, if I leave now, what will happen to you?”
“We don’t need you to worry about our affairs. You better leave quickly!”
Hugo didn’t expect that at this time, Connor still had the mood to care about him. He replied with a helpless expression.
“Uncle Hugo, I won’t leave until this matter is resolved!”
Connor said to Hugo with a serious tone.
Upon hearing his words, Hugo was once again stunned, and his facial expression seemed somewhat puzzled.

chapters.title: Chapter 993: If I Don't Care, Who Would!
chapters.content:
Chapter 993: If I Don’t Care, Who Would!
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Connor knew that Hugo was also acting in his best interest, so he wanted him to leave.
However, with the situation caused by Connor today, if he were to leave now, the blame would definitely fall on the Sassman family.
In that case, he would be responsible for harming the entire Sassman family. He wouldn’t choose to leave at this moment.
Hugo didn’t know Connor’s true identity. He believed that if Connor stayed in Dexas, it would be a dead end. He firmly said, “Connor, if you still consider me your uncle, then listen to me and leave here as soon as possible. You don’t need to worry about our Sassman family’s affairs!”
“Who will take care of it then?”
Connor directly asked Hugo.
Hugo instinctively paused when he saw Connor’s question.
“If I don’t take care of this matter, will Jerrico have to stay in the hospital forever? Will Wynona have to marry that fool Kenny? Will all of your Sassman family’s assets end up in the hands of that woman, Nadine?”
Connor asked expressionlessly.
After hearing Connor’s words, Hugo couldn’t help but smile bitterly and said softly, “Connor, I understand your intentions, but even if you want to handle these matters, can you really handle them? Not to mention you, even your McDonald family can’t handle these matters!”
“The McDonald family is the McDonald family, and I am myself!”
Connor interrupted Hugo.
“You’re still too young…”
Hugo sighed helplessly.
“Uncle Hugo, don’t think that I brought Wynona out of the hotel today just because of a momentary impulse. Since I’ve done this, I am confident that I can handle the upcoming matters as well. You don’t need to worry about anything else. Just take care of Jerrico here!”
Connor calmly said to Hugo.
“Can you handle the remaining matters?”
Hugo’s expression remained helpless as he said, “Connor, you have no idea how terrifying the Llyod family is. You can’t deal with them at all!”
“Uncle Hugo, if you don’t let me get involved in this matter, what will be the final result?”
Connor softly asked Hugo.
“What will be the result?”
Hugo hesitated for a moment.
“Will all of the Sassman family’s assets be taken over by the Llyod family? Will Wynona have to marry someone like Kenny?”
Connor asked directly.
Hugo looked at Connor without speaking, silently accepting Connor’s answer.
“In that case, even if I get involved in this matter, it shouldn’t bring worse consequences to you, right? If I can’t handle this matter, the Llyod family can’t just kill all of you, right?”
Connor continued.
“But once you get involved, this matter will implicate you. The Llyod family may spare a few of us, but they will definitely not spare you!”
Hugo knew that Connor was right. The Sassman family was already in dire straits and there was no worse outcome than the current situation.
However, Hugo didn’t want to involve the innocent Connor in these matters.
“Whether the Llyod family spares me or not, that’s my own business. Uncle Hugo, you don’t need to worry. Leave the rest to me!”
Connor smiled faintly and continued,”I still have something else to deal with, so I won’t disturb you guys for now. You four haven’t seen each other for a long time, right? Now we can gather together!”
“Connor, listen to me…”
Hugo seemed to want to persuade Connor to give up the idea of dealing with the Llyod family.
However, Connor didn’t give him a chance to speak at all. He turned around and walked out of the ward.
Hugo looked at his back, his eyes full of helplessness. At this time, he did not know what to do.
He couldn’t understand where Connor got the courage to go against the Llyod family.
“Father, do you think Connor can really help us get through this crisis?”
Wynona hesitated for a moment before softly asking Hugo, “Connor is just being reckless and impulsive with his words. But he has no idea about the Llyod family’s power. The fact that you and him were able to safely leave the hotel today is already fortunate amidst misfortune!”
Hugo said dejectedly.
“But I feel like Chandler seems to be afraid of Connor!”
Wynona frowned slightly.
“Chandler is nothing more than a small-time thug. He doesn’t have any significant influence. If he’s afraid of Connor, it might be because he actually has some connections. But if he thinks he can take on the Llyod family relying on those connections, he’s being naive!”
Hugo believed that Connor’s daring claim to confront the Llyod family in front of him meant that Connor was more than just a student. He probably had some influential connections to make such statements.
However, Hugo thought that Connor’s connections were insignificant compared to the people from the Llyod family. If dealing with the Llyod family were that easy, Hugo wouldn’t have ended up in such a predicament.
“So, what should we do now?”
The expression on Wynona’s face seemed even more worried as she hurriedly asked Hugo.
“I’ve already said what needs to be said. If Connor remains obstinate, then there’s nothing more I can do. We can only pray for a miracle!”
Hugo looked back at Wynona and sighed helplessly.
“A miracle?”
Wynona was stunned for a moment, then couldn’t help but smile bitterly. She whispered, “I never thought our Sassman family would end up like this. If it weren’t for Connor’s appearance, I might have already been married to Kenny by now.”
Hugo glanced at Wynona with a tinge of guilt. He felt utterly useless, with his son being harmed like this and his daughter being forced to marry a fool, yet he couldn’t do anything about it.
At this moment, Hugo could only place all his hopes on Connor alone, hoping that he could bring them a miracle.
After leaving the hospital, Connor didn’t rush to confront the Llyod family or return to the McDonald family. Instead, he went back to the hotel alone.
Connor planned to visit the McDonald family tomorrow. As for the matter with the Llyod family, he didn’t even consider it.
Because dealing with a small family like the Llyod family was as easy as flipping his hand for him!

chapters.title: Chapter 994: One Wrong Move, and You Lose Everything
chapters.content:
Chapter 994: One Wrong Move, and You Lose Everything
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Dexas.
After Connor caused a scene at the wedding, all the guests left the hotel.
Holden and Bradley were unconscious and were immediately taken to the hospital.
Because the Llyod family felt that today’s incident was too embarrassing, they used their connections to seal off all the information.
So no one knew who was responsible for the state Holden and Bradley were in, not even the McDonald family members knew the specifics.
Although the news was blocked, Connor’s appearance was like a thorn in Nadine’s heart. She felt infinite worry and fear, so she immediately returned to the old mansion of the Llyod family, preparing to discuss countermeasures with the head of the family, Hanson.
When she arrived in front of Hanson’s door, she found an elderly man dressed in black suit practicing calligraphy at the desk.
The old man was thin but exuded an extremely domineering aura.
This person was Hanson, the head of the Llyod family, who ruled over Dexas with an iron fist.
Under normal circumstances, Nadine would never dare to disturb Hanson at such a time. However, due to the urgency of Connor’s situation, she had to gather her courage and enter the old man’s room.
“Nadine, you’re back? Is the wedding of Kenny and Wynona going smoothly?” Without even looking at Nadine, Hanson continued to practice calligraphy and asked slowly.
“Grandfather, something terrible has happened!” Nadine exclaimed excitedly.
“What’s the matter? Why are you so flustered…” Hanson seemed dissatisfied with Nadine’s reaction and frowned, speaking softly.
“Grandfather, someone took Wynona away from the wedding, and they also broke Holden’s legs…” Nadine quickly said.
When Hanson heard this, his face immediately changed, and he turned to Nadine and asked, “Who has the audacity to cause trouble at our Llyod family’s wedding?”
You should know that everything the Llyod family did to the Sassman family was part of Hanson’s plan, so he was naturally well-informed about external affairs.
Nadine married Jerrico and then killed him meanwhile Liu Kai married Wynona.
Only by doing so could the Llyod family completely control the entire Sassman family. If any mistakes occurred in this process, all their previous efforts would be in vain. Therefore, Hanson was very annoyed by someone disrupting the wedding.
As for Holden’s broken legs, Hanson didn’t pay any attention to it at all.
“It’s someone named Connor!” Nadine quickly replied.
“The name sounds somewhat unfamiliar. Is he Wynona’s boyfriend?” Hanson put down the brush in his hand, washed his hands, and asked calmly.
“No, this Connor is from Porthampton, and I heard from Chandler that Connor is also the boss of Kyle, with a terrifying background!” Nadine explained.
“The boss of Kyle?” Hanson’s expression changed drastically upon hearing Nadine’s words. He quickly walked up to Nadine and asked in a low voice, “Are you sure this Connor is Kyle’s boss?”
“I’m sure. Chandler should have no reason to deceive me!” Nadine nodded gently.
“That’s troublesome!” Hanson was calm and composed just a second ago, but now he started to panic.
Nadine noticed that he seemed a bit off and quickly asked, “Grandfather, what’s wrong with you?”
“Do you know about Mr. Connor from Davenport?” he asked.
“I’ve heard of him…”
After all, it had only been two or three days since Connor’s party, so the name of Mr. Connor from Davenport had already spread throughout the entire province. Almost everyone knew about him.
It was normal for her to have heard about Mr. Connor.
“I heard that Kyle’s boss is this Mr. Connor from Davenport!” Henson said in a low voice.
Nadine looked at Henson in front of her and was instantly dumbfounded. She stuttered, “Grandfather, are you… are you saying that Connor is Mr. Connor from Davenport?”
“I’ll make a phone call to confirm…” Henson wasn’t completely certain about his guess, so he took out his phone and dialed the number of a CEO who had attended the party. He carefully inquired about all the details concerning Connor.
In the end, he hung up the phone with a look of despair and stared blankly at the spot where Nadine was standing.
Meanwhile, she had already been scared to the point of sitting on the ground. The description the CEO gave about Mr. Connor matched Connor perfectly.
Initially, she thought that getting on the wrong side of Kyle’s boss was already a huge trouble, but she never expected Connor’s background to be more than just Kyle’s boss.
He turned out to be Mr. Connor from Davenport!
The name “Mr. Connor from Davenport” carried tremendous weight in the four major provinces. The Llyod family didn’t even have the qualification to attend Connor’s party, so how could they possibly deal with someone like Connor?
“Grandfather, I had no idea that the Sassman family could even know such a powerful figure like Mr. Connor,” Nadine shouted in despair.
“A careless move leads to total defeat! I didn’t expect that the Sassman family still had such a hidden card!” Henson sighed helplessly, then slumped into the chair, completely losing his previous confident demeanor. His eyes seemed dimmer as well.
Henson had thought that he had planned everything perfectly, and the Sassman family’s industries were already within his grasp. But he never imagined encountering such a huge trouble at this moment.
In front of Connor, their Llyod family was like ants. If he really decided to take action against them, they wouldn’t even have a chance to fight back.
“Grandfather, please think of a solution quickly. What should we do next?”
Henson took a deep breath and asked in a low voice, “Has Mr. Connor said anything else to you?”
“He said that if Jerrico doesn’t wake up within a week, he will make everyone in our Llyod family disappear from Dexas!” she quickly replied.
“This Mr. Connor is truly domineering!” He forced a bitter smile and said with some helplessness, “But he indeed has the power to be domineering!”

chapters.title: Chapter 995: The McDonald Family
chapters.content:
Chapter 995: The McDonald Family
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
In the study of the Llyod family.
The atmosphere began to take on a strange tone.
Neither Henson nor Nadine could have imagined that the Sassman family still had such a trump card.
Even Henson, who was always cunning and crafty, appeared helpless in the face of Connor’s influence.
He kept his eyes closed the whole time, with his thoughts unknown.
“Grandfather, why don’t we hire some assassins to get rid of Connor directly? Regardless, this is Dexas, our territory…”
A hint of viciousness flashed in Nadine’s eyes, as she whispered to Henson.
“Have you lost your mind?”
Henson exclaimed with excitement, then continued, “Do you know who Mr. Connor is? Even if you offer a billion, there’s no guarantee anyone would take on this job!”
“And besides, do you think Mr. Connor would go out without bodyguards? I heard that Mr. Connor is extremely skilled. Last time, he single-handedly defeated everyone in the Four Provinces Martial Arts Tournament. It’s harder to kill someone like him than to reach the heavens…”
Nadine looked at Henson in front of her, despairing once again, unsure of what to do.
They had no chance of winning in terms of connections or wealth. Moreover, his skills were so extraordinary that Nadine couldn’t find any way to deal with him.
“You go now and inform the hospital. Hurry up and give Jerrico the medication for recovery!”
Henson suddenly spoke, addressing Nadine.
Poor Hugo probably still had no idea that the people at the hospital had already been bribed by the Llyod family. So now, all the drugs Jerrico was being given were poisonous, keeping him in a coma.
If he had received the best treatment at that time, he might have already woken up.
But the Llyod family was too malicious; they had no intention of letting him wake up. On the contrary, they wanted him to remain in a coma forever.
“Grandfather, isn’t it a bit too late for the medication now?”
Nadine furrowed her brow and said.
“I’ll invite an expert from the US later. We must make sure Jerrico wakes up within a week. Otherwise, our Llyod family is truly finished!”
Henson said in a low voice.
Nadine looked at Henson, not knowing what to say. At this moment, the two of them were truly digging their own graves.
Originally, Jerrico could have already woken up, but the two of them had bribed the hospital to keep Jerrico drugged. Now, it wouldn’t be so easy to wake him up.
“By the way, investigate Connor’s current whereabouts for me. I’ll find an opportunity to personally apologize to Mr. Connor!”
After thinking for a moment, Henson continued speaking to Nadine.
“Connor probably won’t accept our apology now!”
Nadine said in a low voice.
“Connor definitely won’t accept our apology now. I want to apologize to Mr. Connor just to show the attitude of our Llyod family. We can’t take over Sassman family’s assets anymore. The best result is to save our own lives!” Henson’s voice trembled as he spoke.
Nadine looked at Henson with a wretched smile, not knowing what to say.
No one could have anticipated that they would end up in such a situation. After planning so hard, they not only gained nothing, but also risked their lives. It was truly not worth it!
..
The next day, at eight in the morning.
Connor woke up from his sleep and instinctively glanced at his phone, only to find no news about Freya.
He took a deep breath and stretched lazily before walking into the bathroom.
Half an hour later, he changed into new clothes and left the room.
Carlos had been waiting outside his room all night. He sat on a chair by Connor’s door.
“You’re awake, Mr. Connor?” Carlos called out as he saw Connor come out.
“All night without rest, huh?” Connor asked casually.
“I did rest for a few hours…” Carlos scratched his head and answered with a smile.
“I’ll give you the day off today. I’m planning to visit the McDonald family. You don’t have to follow me, just relax in the hotel!” Connor said to him, feeling somewhat embarrassed.
“Do you really not need me to come along, Mr. Connor?” Carlos asked softly, concerned about his safety.
“I’m going there to take care of some personal matters. Although I don’t have a good relationship with the McDonald family, they shouldn’t harm me in any way. Don’t worry!” He patted Carlos’s shoulder and smiled.
“Alright then!” Carlos understood, so he didn’t say anything further.
And so, Connor left the hotel alone.
After leaving the hotel, he hailed a taxi and told the driver where he wanted to go.
And that place was somewhere he never wanted to return to in his entire life.
The McDonald family’s villa held too many memories for Connor—some joyful, others painful. It could be said that the happiest and most agonizing days of his life were spent in that villa.
Now, he understood why the McDonald family treated him the way they did back then.
It was out of fear.
After all, all the wealth of the McDonald family had been created by Connor’s father. They believed that if he remained with the family, they would lose everything. So they tried every possible means to drive him out of the McDonald family.
Thinking about what the McDonald family did back then, he found it somewhat laughable. They chose to give up on family ties for a mere sum of money. Did they ever consider that without his father, they would have been an ordinary family in Dexas?
Ten minutes later, the taxi stopped at the entrance of the McDonald family’s villa.
The villa had likely been renovated and still appeared very luxurious.
He knew that the current McDonald family was no longer the same as before.
When he left the McDonald family, McDonald Corporation had a market value of over five billion, but in just a few years, the company’s market value had evaporated by 80 percent.
The McDonald family had gone from being a prominent family in Dexas to an obscure and insignificant one.
Of course, all of this had a lot to do with Connor’s father’s death.
He stood alone at the entrance of the villa, recalling the various incidents that had happened before.
Although he didn’t want to face those people from the McDonald family, there were certain things he had to confront sooner or later.

chapters.title: Chapter 996: I'm Not Here for Money!
chapters.content:
Chapter 996: I’m Not Here for Money!
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
At the entrance of the villa.
Connor stood alone outside the villa, took a deep breath, and then walked up to the door.
Connor’s grandfather, Maverick McDonald, had three sons and two daughters. Connor’s father passed away a few years ago, and Connor’s grandmother had passed away a long time ago due to illness.
Therefore, only Connor’s eldest uncle, third uncle, and eldest aunt and second aunt were left by Maverick’s side. These people were all working in the McDonald Corporation now. Maverick had retired for a long time, so the position of the Chairman of the McDonald Corporation fell into the hands of Connor’s eldest uncle, Huxley.
Basically, the McDonald Corporation was under the control of Huxley alone. Connor’s third uncle, Huxley McDonald, was a typical hedonistic son. He did nothing serious except eating, drinking, and having fun every day. As long as he could get money from the McDonald family, he didn’t care who became the Chairman of the company.
Therefore, Connor’s relationship with Huxley was the worst. Back then, Huxley’s son, Bradley, was also the person who liked to bully Connor the most. This was also the reason why Connor had slapped Bradley in the hotel yesterday.
Connor walked to the door of the villa. After hesitating for a while, he reached out and gently pressed the doorbell.
“Ding dong…”
The doorbell rang.
“Who is it?”
A nanny shouted from inside the villa.
Connor stood outside the door and remained silent.
The housekeeper quickly ran to the door and opened it.
However, when the nanny saw Connor, her expression was a little puzzled. Then, she frowned and asked Connor, “May I ask who you are?”
“I am the master of this house!” Connor replied. Then, ignoring the nanny, he directly pushed open the door and walked into the villa.
The nanny saw Connor suddenly barge into the villa and hurriedly shouted, “What’s wrong with you? What are you trying to do? I didn’t let you in!”
Connor ignored the nanny and looked around the villa. He realized that after so many years, the living room had changed. Everything was new.
The nanny tugged at Connor’s clothes and shouted excitedly, “Who exactly are you? Hurry up and get out! Do you know what place this is?”
“Wilma, what happened?”
However, at this moment, a beautiful young woman in white spaghetti strap pajamas walked out of the dining room after hearing the nanny’s shout. She seemed to be a little annoyed.
When this woman saw Connor, the bowl and chopsticks in her hand fell to the ground. She was stunned on the spot, an incredulous expression on her face.
Connor looked at the beautiful woman and said, “Long time no see!”
The beautiful woman who appeared in front of Connor was none other than Connor’s aunt, Regina McDonald.
Regina should be in her early thirties this year, but she seemed to have never gotten married, so she had been living in the McDonald family’s villa.
“…Connor, why are you back?”
Regina looked at Connor, her expression shocked as she stuttered.
“Do you have to be so afraid? Don’t worry, I didn’t come back for the McDonald family’s stinking money!”
Connor replied to Regina indifferently, then directly walked towards the restaurant.
Today was Sunday. According to the rules of the McDonald family, all the members of the McDonald family had to have breakfast in the old mansion of the McDonald family, regardless of gender or age.
Therefore, all the members of the McDonald family were here today, including Harland and his family members. However, Huxley and his family members were nowhere to be seen.
Connor knew that Bradley should still be in the hospital, which was why he wasn’t here.
After seeing Connor, those people of the McDonald family had the same expression as Regina. Everyone was dumbfounded. They sat in the same place and looked at Connor’s seat. No one expected Connor to come back.
“Connor, who let you in?”
Connor’s third uncle, Harland, was the first to react. He stood up and shouted at Connor with widened eyes.
“Can’t I go back to my home?”
Connor replied indifferently.
“Your home?”
Connor’s eldest aunt, Rita, could not help but sneer. Then, she said with an extremely disdainful expression, “Connor, I haven’t seen you for a few years. You actually dare to say that this is your home? You were chased out by our McDonald family so long ago. How dare you still have the face to come back?”
“That’s right. Connor, did you come back because you couldn’t survive outside?”
Harland’s wife shouted sharply and then continued, “If you really can’t continue to mix, I still have some money here. You can take it and spend it first. No matter what, we’re still relatives!”
After saying this, Harland’s wife took out a stack of cash from her wallet and threw it on the ground.
Connor looked at the cash on the ground and couldn’t help but sneer. It seemed that after so many years, these people of the McDonald family were still the same as before. There was no change at all.
Back then, Connor was forced to leave the McDonald family because he could not withstand the ridicule of these people.
However, when Connor heard their mockery again, he no longer had that feeling from before. To put it bluntly, their words could no longer hurt Connor.
“Connor, what are you still standing there for? Hurry up and take the money and get lost. Don’t let me see you again!” Harland shouted at Connor in frustration.
“I’m not here for money!” Connor calmly replied to Harland.
“Not here for money?”
After Harland heard Connor’s words, he couldn’t help but be stunned. Then he laughed disdainfully and teased, “That’s true. I heard that you often deliver food at school to make a living. You shouldn’t be short of money now. Then what are you doing back here this time?”
“Where is Maverick McDonald?”
Connor asked.
Harland’s expression suddenly changed. He swung his right hand and threw the chopsticks in his hand at Connor.
Connor easily dodged the flying chopsticks and stood quietly on the spot.
“Is Maverick McDonald a name you can say? He’s your grandfather. Do you have any manners? How dare you call your grandfather by his name…”
Harland scolded Connor with an angry expression.
“My grandfather?”
Connor sneered and said, “Do you think he’s worthy of my respect?”

chapters.title: Chapter 997: A Better Life than You Lot!
chapters.content:
Chapter 997: A Better Life than You Lot!
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
When Connor appeared in the McDonald family’s villa again, the McDonald family members were still the same as before. Everyone immediately started to mock him.
“Kid, what did you just say?”
After Harland heard Connor’s words, his expression was a little angry. He stood up and walked in front of Connor.
“I said that Maverick is not qualified to be my grandfather!” Connor repeated.
“I think you need to be taught a lesson!”
Harland rolled up his sleeves and was about to attack Connor.
As for the others present, it was as if they did not see anything. Their expressions were very cold. They wanted Harland to throw Connor out of the villa as soon as possible.
“I’m giving you one last chance now. Are you going to leave or not?”
Harland asked Connor with his eyes wide open.
Connor was no longer the same as before. Therefore, when he was facing Harland’s threat, his expression was still very calm, without the slightest hint of nervousness.
“As long as you dare to touch me today, I will break your legs and hands and make you a real useless lout!” he declared.
“You little…How dare you threaten me? I want to see how capable you are today. How dare you say such a thing!”
Harland shouted at the top of his voice, then raised his right hand and was about to slap Connor’s face.
Connor stood on the spot without any intention of dodging.
“Stop!”
Just as Harland’s right hand was about to slap Connor’s face, a voice sounded.
Everyone turned their heads to look at the entrance of the villa and found that Connor’s uncle, Huxley, had returned.
The person Harland was most afraid of now was Huxley, so after hearing Huxley’s scolding, he stopped and whispered to Connor, “Consider yourself lucky today…”
When Connor heard this, he could not help but smile faintly. He secretly sighed in his heart and wondered who was the lucky one between the two of them.
Huxley quickly walked in front of Connor and pretended to be enthusiastic. He asked Connor with a fake smile, “Connor, when did you come back? I haven’t seen you for a few years and you’ve already grown so big. Why didn’t you tell me that you’re coming back?”
“Why should I tell you? I’m telling you so that you can prepare to deal with me in advance, right?”
Connor felt that Huxley’s feigned enthusiasm was extremely disgusting. Back then, Huxley was the one who planned for Connor to be chased out of the McDonald family. Among so many McDonald family members, Connor probably hated Huxley the most. Therefore, he did not hold anything back when he spoke to Huxley.
“Uh…”
Huxley did not expect Connor to be so direct. He was instantly stunned.
“Alright, stop pretending to be a good person to me. I know very well what kind of person you are!” Connor continued.
“Connor, what are you saying?”
Huxley’s expression was a little ugly as he frowned.
“Big brother, this is considered a nice thing to say. Just now, this brat actually said that he wanted to break my hands and legs. I feel that this brat might not have been able to survive outside and so came home to find trouble…” Harland said with his eyes wide open.
“Don’t worry, I have a better life than you lot!” Connor calmly replied to Harland.
“I can’t be bothered to talk nonsense with you. Get out of here, or I won’t be polite!” Harland shouted at Connor.
“This villa was bought by my father. I’m the real owner of this villa, so you should be the ones who get out, not me!” Connor retorted.
“Are you f * cking tired of living? If I don’t teach you a lesson today, you won’t even know who you are!”
Harland shouted and rushed towards Connor.
“What are you guys doing so early in the morning?”
But at this moment, an old man’s voice suddenly came from upstairs.
An old man walked down the stairs with a walking stick. Everyone fell silent when they saw the old man.
This old man was Maverick McDonald, Connor’s grandfather.
Connor subconsciously turned his head to look at Maverick. After not seeing him for so many years, Maverick seemed to have aged a lot.
“Dad, Connor is back! He came here to cause trouble…” Harland shouted at Maverick.
“Shut up!”
Maverick frowned and scolded.
Harland immediately shut his mouth.
Maverick slowly walked to Connor’s side and sized him up. He said coldly, “Since you’re back, sit down and eat first. We’ll talk about whatever you want after eating!”
Connor hesitated for a moment, but he didn’t hesitate as he sat on the chair.
The others also went to their seats and sat down.
After Maverick sat down, he glanced at the people in the room and asked lightly, “Why aren’t Bradley and Cecilia here?”
“Dad, Bradley was beaten up when he attended the Marcus family’s wedding yesterday. He only woke up at two in the morning last night. He probably won’t arrive until later…”
Huxley hurriedly explained.
Maverick’s favorite child was Bradley, so he shouted excitedly, “Who is so bold as to hit Bradley? Do they think so little of the McDonald family?!”
Huxley frowned and replied, “I don’t know the exact identity of the person. Bradley didn’t want to say anything. The Marcus family also sealed the news. It seems that the one who was injured wasn’t only Bradley, but also the Marcus family…”
The Marcus family had already kept everything private, so Bradley naturally did not have the courage to say what happened that day.
“Call Bradley now and tell him to hurry over. I want to know what’s going on!” Maverick said with a frown.
“He and Cecilia should be here soon!”
Huxley said in a low voice.
“Alright then!”
Maverick nodded lightly and didn’t say anything else.
Maverick and Huxley might not know that the person who beat Bradley up was actually sitting in front of them.
Connor didn’t say anything after hearing the conversation between these people. He just ate quietly.
Perhaps because of Connor’s existence, the others were not in the mood to eat. Only Connor ate with relish.
At this moment, the atmosphere in the dining room was extremely strange.
Even Maverick couldn’t help but look at Connor. He didn’t know why Connor had suddenly returned.

chapters.title: Chapter 998: A Bolt from The Blue
chapters.content:
Chapter 998: A Bolt from The Blue
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Because of Connor’s sudden appearance, the atmosphere in the restaurant began to become strange.
Everyone was staring at Connor, whether intentionally or unintentionally. They were not in the mood to eat.
After all, Connor hadn’t come back for so many years. These people didn’t know why he suddenly came back, but they were worried that Connor might have really come for the McDonald Corporation.
The McDonald Corporation was founded by Connor’s father. Logically speaking, Connor was actually the real heir.
However, in order to prevent the McDonald Corporation from being monopolized by Connor, the McDonald family forcefully chased Connor out of the family. Then, they let Maverick take over the McDonald Corporation before handing it over to Huxley.
Basically, everyone in the McDonald family had a tacit understanding of this matter. Each of them had also obtained their own benefits because of this matter.
But in the end, this McDonald Corporation still belonged to Connor!
If Connor were to go through legal means, then everything they had now would vanish into thin air.
This was also why the McDonald family was so nervous when they saw Connor and were so anxious to chase him away.
Because Maverick was present, the others did not dare to say anything and could only look at Huxley.
At this moment, Huxley was a little nervous. After hesitating for two seconds, he turned his head and asked Connor softly, “Connor, did you suddenly come back because you encountered some trouble outside? If you encounter any trouble, just tell me directly. As long as I can help, I will definitely help you…”
“Nephew?”
After Connor heard Huxley’s words, he couldn’t help but sneer. Then, he said indifferently, “Huxley, you don’t have to pretend to be nice to me at this point. You and I both know what you did to me back then. You’re just worried that I’ll come back and snatch the family business from you, so you’re pretending to be a good person with me.”
Huxley looked at Connor with an awkward expression. The other members of the McDonald family were puzzled.
Because in their impression, Connor had always had a weak character. However, Connor’s return this time gave people the feeling that he was a different person. The way he spoke and the way he carried himself had completely changed.
If it wasn’t for the fact that Connor’s appearance hadn’t changed at all, these people really wouldn’t have believed that the person sitting in front of them at this moment was the silly kid who was chased out of the McDonald family by them back then.
Maverick was still very calm at this time. He felt that it was normal for Connor’s personality to change after wandering alone for so many years. Moreover, Connor’s relationship with the McDonald family was not very good, so he should be venting the hatred in his heart by saying this.
Harland had a straightforward temper. He couldn’t stand Connor’s sarcasm at all and shouted at Connor with an unhappy expression. “Little brat, what exactly do you want? Don’t beat around the bush with us. Are you short of money or something?”
When Connor heard Harland’s words, he couldn’t help but be stunned. He slowly looked up and asked, “Harland, which one of us is short of money?”
“You… What do you mean by that?”
After Harland heard Connor’s words, he replied with a guilty conscience.
Connor narrowed his eyes with a mocking smile. “Half a year ago, you lost nearly 200 million in the Aomiya casino and owed them more than 100 million in gambling debts. How much money have you paid off?”
At this moment, Connor’s tone was very natural, as if he was talking about an insignificant matter. However, in the eyes of the McDonald family, his words were like a bolt from the blue.
When the McDonald family heard Connor’s words, their mouths instantly dropped, and they turned their heads to look at Harland. It was obvious that they did not know about this.
Harland’s expression changed drastically, and a cold sweat broke out on his forehead.
Only his wife knew that he owed 100 million dollars in gambling debt. No one else knew about it at all. Harland really couldn’t understand how Connor knew about this.
However, Harland might not know Connor’s true identity. It was very easy for Connor to investigate the background of the McDonald family.
Connor originally wanted Thomas to help him investigate Maverick, wanting to find some clues about his parents ‘accidental death. However, Connor did not expect Thomas to not find any valuable clues at all, but instead find all the dirt on the McDonald family.
Since the McDonald family was still so rude and mean, he naturally did not give them any face. He had no qualms in exposing Harland’s gambling debt of nearly 100 million dollars.
Harland suddenly stood up and shouted at Connor with an angry expression, “What nonsense are you talking about? Since when did I owe a hundred million dollars in gambling debt?”
At this moment, he seemed to be planning to scare Connor with his aura so that Connor would not continue to spout nonsense.
“The owner of the Grand Luck Casino in Aomiya is called Kendrick Yank. You know better than me whether you owe money or not. Moreover, the interest on this money has already reached 180 million. You can’t repay this money at all, so you chose to transfer 20% of the shares of the McDonald Corporation in your hands to Kendrick,” Connor said calmly.
This time, Harland was completely dumbfounded. He didn’t expect Connor to know that he had already transferred the shares. Harland really couldn’t understand how Connor knew about these things.
Connor took a sip of tea and asked Harland with a smile, “Although the McDonald Corporation is no longer as good as it was a few years ago, it should at least have a market value of 1.5 billion, right? 20% of the shares is nearly 300 million. Isn’t it a little too much of a loss to give it away like this?”
Harland was instantly stunned. He didn’t even know how to answer Connor’s words.
The other members of the McDonald family were also dumbfounded. They looked at Harland as if they were waiting for an explanation from him.
After all, the McDonald Corporation did not belong to just one person, but to the entire McDonald family.
But Harland had directly transferred the shares without anyone’s consent. It was very likely to have a huge impact on the McDonald Corporation.
The individual that would be the most impacted by this decision was probably Harland’s eldest brother, Huxley. After all, once the McDonald Corporation had an outsider as a shareholder, Huxley would lose total control of the corporation.

chapters.title: Chapter 999: To Destroy Someone, Expose Their Secrets
chapters.content:
Chapter 999: To Destroy Someone, Expose Their Secrets
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
“Harland, did you really transfer the shares?”
Huxley asked Harland coldly.
After Harland heard Huxley’s words, his face turned pale.
He quickly stood up and shouted, “Big Brother, don’t listen to this kid’s nonsense. How can I transfer my shares to an outsider?”
“Is it true that you owe money?”
Huxley continued to ask.
“This…”
Harland’s expression was a little awkward. After taking a deep breath, he said loudly, “Brother, I admit that I do owe money, but I really didn’t transfer my shares. Even if you gave me ten thousand guts, I wouldn’t dare to do that. If you don’t believe me, the two of us can go and check the company’s shares…”
Huxley was the Chairman of the McDonald Corporation. If there was really a change in the shares, Huxley would definitely know at the first moment.
Therefore, Huxley still believed what Harland said.
“Connor, I think you might have heard some rumors outside. Your third uncle, he…”
Huxley turned his head and wanted to explain to Connor.
“You don’t have to explain to me. Harland and Yuan Yongguang signed a secret agreement. Although these shares are still Huxley’s on the surface, as long as Yuan Yongguang takes out this agreement, he can transfer the shares at any time. Harland was worried that you would find out, so he signed this agreement!”
Connor said with a smile.
Harland looked at Connor and instantly broke down because he didn’t expect Connor to know these things.
After all, these things were told to Thomas Morgan by Yuan Yongguang himself. Connor naturally knew the details of the matter like the back of his hand.
“Harland, what’s going on?”
Huxley finally couldn’t take it anymore and shouted at Harland.
Harland was speechless. He didn’t know how to refute Connor’s words.
“Big Brother, don’t listen to this brat’s nonsense here. He’s just a poor student. How could he know these things? He made all of this up. He just wants to sow discord between us!”
Harland’s wife, Liliana Hurst, saw that Harland seemed to be unable to hold on any longer, so she quickly stood up and shouted.
Huxley hesitated for a moment. He felt that what Liliana said made sense. He turned to Connor and asked him softly, “Connor, where did you hear this news from?”
“It has nothing to do with you where I heard it. Anyway, what I said is true!”
Connor replied indifferently.
“Is what you said true?”
Liliana looked at Connor’s seat and couldn’t help but sneer. Then, she said disdainfully, “You’re just a delivery man, what do you know? What evidence do you have to prove that what you said is true?”
“Evidence?”
Connor looked at Liliana with a faint smile and said slowly, “Liliana, I don’t have any evidence of Harland’s transfer of the contract, but I can show you the evidence of you having an affair with your driver!”
“..”
After everyone heard Connor’s words, they once again fell into a state of shock.
Even Harland, who had lost his soul just now, suddenly raised his head and looked at Connor.
Liliana had an affair with Harland’s driver?
This news was really too explosive!
Maverick’s body could not help but tremble slightly. Then, he looked at Connor’s position. He knew that Connor was taking revenge on these people from the McDonald family!
“You… What did you just say?”
Liliana widened her eyes and asked Connor in exasperation.
“Didn’t you hear what I said just now?”
Connor replied with a smile and then continued, “You’ve been having an affair with your driver for some time, right? You haven’t been discovered for such a long time. I have to say that your secrecy is quite good!”
“Stop talking nonsense. When did I have an affair with the driver? Do you believe that I’ll call the police now?”
Naturally, Liliana would not admit it. She shouted excitedly.
“If you want to make this matter known to everyone, then you can call the police. Anyway, I don’t care!”
Connor smiled.
“Connor, didn’t you say that you have evidence? Then show me your evidence, or I’ll sue you for slandering my wife!”
Harland gritted his teeth and shouted at Connor.
“You won’t cry until you’re in the grave, will you?” Connor said helplessly. Then, he took out his phone and found a photo of Liliana and his driver in bed.
“The evidence is here. If you think the photos are not enough, I have a video here too!”
Connor placed his phone on the table and said calmly.
Harland did not hesitate at all. He quickly picked up Connor’s phone and confirmed that the people in the photo were Liliana and their driver.
Harland’s eyes flashed with a murderous look. He never thought that his wife would have an affair with the driver behind his back. Moreover, everyone in the McDonald family was watching. Harland was utterly embarrassed today.
Seeing the evidence, Liliana was also very flustered. She stammered to Harland, “Harland, you…Don’t listen to this person’s nonsense. Nowadays, things like photos and videos can be synthesized. I really didn’t do anything to let you down. You have to believe me!”
“Haha…”
Connor didn’t expect Liliana to refuse to admit it even at this point.
He smiled and said, “That’s right. The photos and videos can indeed be faked, but the DNA can’t be faked, right?” If you still don’t believe me, take Harland’s youngest daughter for a paternity test. I think everything will be revealed then!”
Liliana saw Connor sitting on the chair. Harland’s youngest daughter was not Harland’s. She knew it better than anyone else.
If Harland really took his youngest daughter for a paternity test, then no matter how she tried to explain herself, it would be useless.
When the others saw Liliana’s reaction, they immediately understood what was going on.
What Connor was doing now was simply destroying them by exposing their dirtiest secrets!
“You b * tch, I’m so good to you, but you’re fooling around behind my back!”
Harland shouted and rushed toward Liliana.
“Sit down!”
Maverick suddenly shouted.

chapters.title: Chapter 1000: Everyone’s Secrets
chapters.content:
Chapter 1000: Everyone’s Secrets
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Harland was stunned when he heard Maverick’s scolding.
He could feel that Maverick was already a little angry at this moment, but he did not dare to continue being impudent. After all, he still had the issue of shares that had not been resolved!
Liliana was sitting on the ground with a dull look in her eyes. At this time, she had completely lost her previous arrogant appearance because she knew that everything about her had been destroyed.
“Connor, is there anything else?”
Connor’s aunt, Rita, couldn’t take it anymore because she didn’t know what kind of dirt would be exposed if Connor continued talking. She planned to make Connor leave this place as soon as possible. To that end, she was willing to give Connor a large sum of money.
“Are you in such a hurry to let me continue?” Connor looked at Rita with a playful smile and then said lightly, “Alright then, let’s talk about you!”
“My business?”
Rita was stunned because she knew that her hunch was right. Connor was not here for Harland alone.
Those who offended Connor in the past would not be able to escape today.
“Yeah, Rita, you seem to have been using your position for so many years to secretly outsource the McDonald Corporation’s projects to a company called Dragon City Construction, right? Moreover, you’ve leaked the business secrets of the McDonald Corporation many times. Isn’t that true?” Connor said casually.
After everyone heard Connor’s words, they weren’t too taken aback. First of all, Rita’s leaking of the company’s trade secrets was nothing compared to Harland’s matters. Also, though Rita used her position to outsource her business to other companies, it was not a big deal. Huxley had always turned a blind eye to such situations.
“Connor, this is our business. You don’t have to worry about it!” Huxley muttered.
“Your business
Connor sneered and then said indifferently, “You really have the nerve to say this, but I’m not done yet!”
“Then what do you want to say?” Rita frowned and asked Connor.
“What I want to say is, Rita, you should still have dealt with the matter of your ex-husband’s murder, right?”
Connor asked with a smile.
This time, the McDonald family members were shocked again.
They had no idea that Rita was the murderer of her ex-husband.
Rita was indeed married and had a child. However, her ex-husband was killed five years ago, and the murderer had not been found yet.
However, no one knew that the person who killed her ex-husband was Rita herself.
“Back then, you hired an assassin to kill your ex-husband, but you didn’t expect that this assassin would use this matter to threaten you. The boss of Dragon City Construction that I mentioned just now was the assassin that you hired back then. Now, the police only need to find him and investigate casually, and everything will be revealed!”
Connor smiled.
Rita was stunned. She looked at Connor in despair.
At this moment, she looked at Connor as if she was looking at a demon!
This secret had been hidden in Rita’s heart for many years and had never been told to anyone. However, she didn’t expect Connor to reveal the secret that she was most unwilling to reveal, and with such a relaxed tone at that.
The people of the McDonald family looked at Rita with ulterior motives. No one expected Rita to be a murderer.
“Don’t you have anything to say?”
Connor asked Rita slowly.
Rita looked at Connor and wanted to retort, but she was worried that she would anger Connor. If the police found out about this, Rita’s life would be ruined.
“Connor, no matter what, we’re family. There’s no need for you to be so heartless, right?”
Connor’s aunt, Regina, couldn’t stand it anymore. She frowned and shouted at Connor.
“Family?” After Connor heard these three words, he could not help but sneer. Then, he said indifferently, “Why are you now only saying that we’re family? Why didn’t you think about this when you chased me out?”
“We did do some overboard things to you before, but…”
Regina seemed to want to explain something to Connor.
“You don’t have to say any more…” Connor felt disgusted by Regina’s hypocrisy, so he interrupted her and continued, “You should be considered a good person among these people in the McDonald family. You’re nothing more than a mistress. However, I advise you to be careful. The other party’s wife is not to be trifled with. If the other party’s wife finds out about you, you won’t have a good ending…”
Regina was dumbfounded. She didn’t expect Connor to know that she was someone else’s mistress.
At this moment, Connor had revealed all the secrets of Harland, Liliana, Regina, and Rita in front of everyone. Any one of these secrets could cause the McDonald family to fall into a huge disaster.
And Connor had actually said it all in one breath. The McDonald family naturally had a breakdown.
However, what they could not understand was that Connor was just an ordinary university student. How did he know about these things?
Maverick had been quietly looking at Connor all this while. No one knew what he was thinking.
“Connor, what do you want? You came back this time to destroy my McDonald family before you’re satisfied, right?”
Huxley shouted at Connor angrily.
Connor turned his head and looked at Huxley, then he said with a smile, “We’ve finished talking about the others. Now, we can finally talk about you!”
“I… Me? What about me?”
Huxley was stunned for a moment and asked in a puzzled tone.
“When I left the city, the McDonald Corporation had a market value of 5 billion. Now, there’s less than 1.5 billion left. Isn’t all of this because of your poor management?”
Connor asked with a smile.
“I admit that my business talent is not as good as your father’s. I’m indeed responsible for the McDonald Corporation’s current state!”
Huxley replied in a low voice.
“Haha…”
Connor smiled disdainfully and then said lightly, “Alright, stop pretending. If it weren’t for the fact that you’ve been secretly embezzling the funds of the McDonald Corporation, the market value of the McDonald Corporation might have already exceeded 10 billion!”

chapters.title: Chapter 1001: Tear Off Your Lips!
chapters.content:
Chapter 1001: Tear Off Your Lips!
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
“I embezzled the McDonald Corporation’s funds?”
Huxley was shocked when he heard Connor’s words.
