However, his face was filled with disbelief.
“In just a few years, you transferred more than half of the McDonald Corporation’s funds to your son’s overseas account. If I’m not wrong, you’re going to bankrupt the McDonald Corporation next. Then, you have an excuse to migrate, am I right?”
Connor hit the nail on the head.
“Nonsense!”
Huxley widened his eyes and shouted, “I’m the Chairman of the McDonald Corporation. I have 30% of the McDonald Corporation’s shares. Why would I want the McDonald Corporation to go bankrupt?”
After the death of Connor’s father, the McDonald Family divided the shares of the McDonald Corporation.
Huxley and Bradley had 30% of the shares, Harland McDonald had 20%, Regina McDonald and Rita McDonald each had 15%, and Maverick McDonald still had 20%.
Therefore, the other members of the McDonald Family felt that what Connor said was not true. They felt that Huxley did not have to do this.
“You just said that you have 30% of the shares of the McDonald Corporation. However, if you transfer the funds of the McDonald Corporation overseas, you will be able to control 100% of the shares. To put it simply, you just don’t want to divide the McDonald Corporation with the other members of the McDonald Family. Your real purpose is to occupy the entire McDonald Corporation for yourself.”
Connor said lightly.
“Little bastard, what nonsense are you talking about? I don’t have such thoughts at all…”
Hearing Connor speak his true thoughts, Huxley suddenly became angry, and he shouted at the top of his voice.
“You don’t have to be so riled up. Just let all the shareholders of the McDonald Corporation hold a shareholders’ meeting and investigate the direction of the McDonald Corporation’s funds!”
Connor said lightly.
Harland, Regina, and Rita also felt that what Connor said was true. After all, what Connor said about them was true. He was probably not wrong about Huxley either.
This matter involved the interests of the three of them. The three of them would definitely not pretend that they had not heard anything.
“Huxley, I think we should hold a shareholders’ meeting!”
Harland whispered to Huxley.
“Do you not trust me?”
Huxley whispered to Harland.
“Huxley, I’m asking you to hold a shareholders’ meeting because I trust you. After all, only a shareholders’ meeting can prove your innocence…”
Harland said lightly.
Huxley frowned and didn’t say anything because he knew that once the shareholders’ meeting was held, he would be unable to defend himself. He would definitely be jailed for embezzling the company’s funds.
Huxley never thought that Connor’s appearance would have such a terrifying impact on him.
If the things that Connor said today were to spread out, the McDonald Family would definitely end up as a broken family.
For a moment, everyone present fell into silence. Everyone lowered their heads and did not dare to speak.
They probably never dreamed that they would actually be forced into such a state by Connor.
“Are you done?”
Maverick slowly looked up at Connor and asked.
“Almost!”
Connor nodded.
“Alright, tell me why you came back this time. What you said just now is all about our family. Whether it’s true or not has nothing to do with you!”
Maverick said calmly.
“Alright, I want…”
Connor was about to speak when he suddenly heard footsteps coming from outside the door.
Everyone turned to look at the door and saw Huxley’s wife walking in with Bradley.
When Bradley saw Connor sitting at the dining table, he was stunned for a moment. Then, his expression changed, and he rushed over. Then, he shouted, “How dare you come back? I’ll definitely teach you a lesson today…”
“Wasn’t the slap from before enough?”
Connor slowly turned to look at Bradley and asked coldly.
“…”
When Bradley heard Connor’s words, he immediately stopped in his tracks and looked at Connor with fear in his eyes.
At this time, Bradley realized that he was not Connor’s opponent at all. If he attacked Connor now, he would definitely be sent flying by Connor’s slap.
“Bradley, what’s going on?”
Huxley felt that something was wrong. He frowned and asked Bradley.
Bradley took a deep breath. Previously, because the Marcus Family had stopped the news from spreading, Bradley did not dare to tell anyone about this.
However, seeing Connor appear here, he had nothing to worry about. He shouted, “Grandpa, at the Marcus Family’s wedding banquet yesterday, it was Connor who slapped me!”
“What? It was Connor, that bastard, who hit you?”
Huxley’s wife wasn’t here just now, so she didn’t know what had happened, so she was still treating Connor with a poor attitude. She shouted at the top of her voice.
“That’s right, it was Connor who hit me!”
Bradley hurriedly nodded.
“Connor, you bastard, what right do you have to hit my son? I’m going to go all out with you today!”
Huxley’s wife seemed to have gone crazy as she rushed toward Connor with her claws bared.
“Calm down!”
Huxley knew that the current Connor was no longer the same Connor from before. Once his wife beat Connor up, Connor would reveal all their secrets, and things would be even more troublesome.
“Why are you stopping me? Didn’t you hear what Bradley said? Why are you still protecting this motherless bastard? Back then, his parents were killed by him. He’s a jinx…”
Huxley’s wife shouted crazily.
“What did you just say about me?”
Connor’s expression changed when he heard this. He asked Huxley’s wife coldly.
“I said you’re a jinx. Your parents…”
Before Huxley’s wife could figure out what was going on, she opened her mouth and cursed.
Smack!
Connor didn’t hesitate at all and slapped Huxley’s wife, Cecilia Pewter.
In an instant, the entire villa fell silent.
Cecilia was sent flying by Connor’s slap, blood flowing out from the corner of her mouth.
She probably did not think that Connor would be so bold now. Not only did he dare to hit Bradley, but he even dared to hit her.
“You can badmouth me, but if you dare to mention my parents again, I’ll tear off your lips!”
Connor said to Cecilia with a cold expression on his face.
…

chapters.title: Chapter 1002: Let Him Die on His Own
chapters.content:
Chapter 1002: Let Him Die on His Own
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Huxley’s wife, Cecilia, was stunned after being slapped by Connor.
She stood rooted to the ground and looked at Connor in disbelief.
She had never thought that Connor, who had always swallowed his anger, would actually be so bold now.
“Huxley, are you just going to stand there and watch him do this to me?”
Cecilia hesitated for a moment before shouting at Huxley.
“Can you stop?”
Huxley did not choose to help Cecilia this time. Instead, he frowned and scolded Cecilia coldly.
After all, the McDonald Family was already in a mess. Connor alone had the dirt on everyone in the McDonald Family. If this information was spread out, the entire McDonald Family would collapse. How could he be in the mood to deal with Cecilia now?
Cecilia covered her face with a puzzled expression. She really couldn’t understand what was going on today.
She was beaten up by someone, but the McDonald Family did not care!
Huxley sighed helplessly, then walked in front of Bradley and asked Bradley in a low voice, “Why did Connor hit you?”
“…”
Bradley was stunned for a moment, then he quickly said, “Yesterday, the Marcus Family had a wedding ceremony. I don’t know what happened to Connor, but he actually caused trouble in the hotel and wanted to take Wynona Sassman with him. I was worried that this would affect our McDonald Family, so I wanted to take Connor with me. However, not only did Connor not appreciate it, he even slapped me…”
“Connor actually went to the Marcus Family’s wedding banquet to cause trouble?”
Maverick finally couldn’t sit still after hearing this. He stood up abruptly and shouted with an incredulous expression.
Just now, Connor had revealed so much dirt about the McDonald Family, but Maverick did not react in such a way. After all, that was the McDonald Family’s internal matter. It could be handled behind closed doors.
However, if Connor really offended the Marcus Family, then the situation was different.
The Marcus Family was not someone that the McDonald Family could afford to provoke. If the Marcus Family was really angered, the McDonald Family might be destroyed.
“That’s right. Not only did Connor cause a ruckus at the wedding banquet, but he also broke Holden Marcus’s legs and took Wynona Sassman with him. The Marcus Family stopped the news from spreading, so outsiders don’t know about this!”
Bradley hurriedly replied and then continued, “Connor is in big trouble this time. The Marcus Family will definitely not let Connor off!”
When the McDonald Family heard Bradley’s words, they all started fretting.
At this time, they had already thrown those things that Connor said to the back of their minds.
Because they all knew that the most important thing now was to solve the matter of Connor offending the Marcus Family. The rest could be solved later.
“Connor, are you crazy? Why did you go to the Marcus Family’s wedding banquet to cause trouble?”
Huxley shouted at Connor.
“That’s right. Connor, do you know how much trouble you will bring to the McDonald Family by doing this? If you want to die, no one will stop you, but don’t drag us down!”
Harland also shouted loudly.
“What happened at the Marcus Family wedding banquet is my business. It has nothing to do with any of you, right?”
Connor replied calmly.
“How can you say that it has nothing to do with us? Although you’ve already left our McDonald Family, you’re still a member of the McDonald Family no matter what. Your actions represent the McDonald Family!”
Rita pointed at Connor and shouted.
“It has already happened. There’s nothing I can do now!”
Connor said indifferently.
“What did I tell you? This brat is a jinx. Wherever he goes, there will be trouble!”
Cecilia obviously did not remember the fact that Connor had just slapped her as she shouted.
“Alright, stop arguing!”
Maverick frowned and shouted. Then, he walked up to Connor and asked in a low voice, “You really broke Holden’s legs?”
“Yes!”
Connor nodded.
“Did you take Wynona Sassman with you?”
Maverick continued to ask.
“Yes!”
Connor nodded again.
“How can you be so muddle-headed!”
Maverick shouted in despair and then continued, “I can ignore it no matter how much trouble you cause in the McDonald Family. After all, we were the ones who chased you away. I can understand that you have resentment toward us, but why did you offend the Marcus Family? Is the Marcus Family someone you can offend?”
“What are you trying to say?”
Connor asked Maverick softly.
“Come with me to the Marcus Family’s house to apologize now and see if this matter can be solved amicably!”
Maverick answered.
“Apologize?”
Connor looked at Maverick and couldn’t help but smile. Then, he said lightly, ” The ones who should be apologizing are the Marcus Family. Nadine Marcus almost killed Jerico Sassman, and she even wanted to marry Wynona off to a fool. I only broke Holden’s leg. That’s already letting them off easy…”
“Why you…”
Maverick was so angry that he didn’t know what to say. He really couldn’t understand where Connor got the courage to speak so arrogantly.
“Whether it’s for the McDonald Family or for yourself, you can only apologize now. If you apologize now, you might still have a chance to live. Otherwise, you definitely won’t be able to leave Dexas!”
Huxley also threw everything else to the back of his mind and shouted at Connor in a low voice.
“You want me to apologize to the Marcus Family? They don’t deserve it!”
Connor didn’t waste any time and responded.
After hearing Connor’s words, the McDonald Family was instantly speechless. They really could not understand where Connor got the courage to say such words. They also could not understand why Connor was so stubborn and refused to apologize to the Marcus Family.
“Dad, hurry up and think of a way!”
Regina shouted at Maverick anxiously.
She did not want to be implicated by Connor’s actions.
“Since Connor is unwilling to apologize, we might as well give Connor to the Marcus Family and explain our relationship with Connor clearly. The Marcus Family can deal with Connor however they want. Anyway, Connor is so capable, so he shouldn’t be afraid of the Marcus Family!”
Harland said directly.
What he meant was very obvious. He wanted to hand Connor over to the Marcus Family and let him fend for himself.
The other members of the McDonald Family also seemed to think that Harland’s words made sense. They all looked at Maverick and waited for Maverick’s reply.
…

chapters.title: Chapter 1003: Henson Marcus is Here
chapters.content:
Chapter 1003: Henson Marcus is Here
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Hearing Harland’s words, everyone in the McDonald Family looked at Maverick as if they were waiting for Maverick’s reply.
As long as Maverick nodded, the McDonald Family would send Connor to the Marcus Family without hesitation.
In this way, they would be able to completely get rid of Connor, who was making them worried.
Connor subconsciously looked at Maverick. He wanted to see what Maverick would choose.
“We can’t hand Connor over to the Marcus Family!”
At this moment, Maverick suddenly said.
Everyone was stunned when they heard Maverick’s words.
“Dad, what are you talking about? Why can’t we hand Connor over to the Marcus Family? Now, handing Connor over to the Marcus Family is our best option…”
Harland didn’t understand what Maverick meant and shouted excitedly.
“Connor has caused such a huge trouble this time. Even if we hand Connor over to the Marcus Family, the Marcus Family will not let this matter rest…”
Maverick replied lightly.
Everyone looked at Maverick with puzzled expressions because they could feel that Maverick was obviously protecting Connor.
The relationship between Connor and Maverick had always been strange. Before Connor’s parents died, Maverick treated Connor very well. However, after Connor’s parents passed away, Maverick seemed to have changed into a different person and chased Connor out of the McDonald Family.
Therefore, Connor had always wondered if Maverick really had something he couldn’t disclose.
“Connor isn’t willing to apologize now, and Dad, you’re also unwilling to hand Connor over to the Marcus Family. What should we do now? He can’t just wait here for the Marcus Family to take revenge, right?”
Harland asked anxiously.
Maverick hesitated for a moment, then turned and said to Connor, “Connor, leave Dexas as soon as possible and never come back for the rest of your life. I’ll handle the rest!”
“Dad!”
Seeing that Maverick was actually planning to let Connor go, Harland quickly shouted excitedly.
“Shut up!”
Maverick frowned and scolded, then asked Connor, “Did you hear what I just said?”
“I still have things to deal with. I can’t leave yet!”
Connor sat on the chair and replied calmly.
“Is there anything more important than this? Do you know how terrifying the Marcus Family is?”
Maverick looked at Connor and shouted helplessly.
“In your eyes, the Marcus Family may be very scary, but in my eyes, they are nothing at all. You don’t have to worry about me.”
Connor said casually.
Harland looked at Connor and whispered, “Dad, this kid doesn’t know what’s good for him. If you ask me, we should just ignore this kid. Let him do whatever he wants. Anyway, it has nothing to do with us…”
“Yeah, Dad, as long as we cut ties with Connor, if the Marcus Family wants to take revenge, they can take revenge on Connor alone. This matter has nothing to do with us!”
Rita quickly said.
Maverick stood there with a helpless expression on his face. He didn’t know what to do for a moment. He didn’t expect Connor to cause so much trouble right after returning to Dexas.
Ding dong…
However, at this moment, the doorbell suddenly rang.
The nanny hurriedly ran over to open the door, and a large group of people walked into the villa.
“Is Maverick home?”
The old man in the lead laughed and shouted.
When the McDonald Family heard this, they were all dumbfounded.
This was because the people who had appeared at the McDonald Family’s villa were none other than the Marcus Family’s head, Henson Marcus, and his group.
The sexy and beautiful Nadine Marcus followed behind Henson nervously.
Basically, as long as it was someone who had a say in the Marcus Family, they had all appeared in the McDonald Family’s villa. It was obvious that they were here to punish them!
Maverick couldn’t help but laugh bitterly. He didn’t expect the Marcus Family to act so quickly.
“Mr. Marcus, why… why are you here?”
Maverick naturally didn’t dare to be negligent. He hurriedly ran out and asked Henson respectfully.
“Maverick, I wonder if your grandson Connor McDonald is here?”
Henson didn’t question him as everyone expected. Instead, he replied very politely.
“…”
Seeing that Henson really was here to look for Connor, his heart naturally skipped a beat. For a moment, he didn’t know what to do.
“Connor is here!”
Harland shouted at the top of his lungs.
At this moment, Harland only had one thought in his mind, and that was to quickly hand Connor over to the Marcus Family. This way, he could avoid being implicated.
“That’s great…”
Henson’s eyes flashed with excitement when he heard Harland’s words.
He had been looking for Connor all day. He had been to all the hotels in Dexas, but he still could not find Connor.
Later on, when Henson found out that Connor was Maverick’s grandson, he immediately brought the Marcus Family members to the McDonald Family.
“Mr. Marcus, Connor’s ruckus at the wedding yesterday has nothing to do with the McDonald Family. Connor has left the McDonald Family a few years ago. If you want to punish him, you can just take Connor away. Our McDonald Family won’t have any complaints!”
Harland smiled at Henson.
Henson glanced at Harland indifferently and ignored him. Instead, he strode toward the dining room.
When Harland saw Henson walk toward Connor, he was a little smug because he felt that he could just wait and watch the show.
Maverick was nervous because he didn’t know how the Marcus Family planned to deal with Connor. But looking at the situation now, with so many people from the Marcus Family here, it meant that the Marcus Family attached great importance to this matter.
Henson walked up to Connor with an extremely respectful expression.
Connor had been sitting on the chair the entire time. He didn’t even look up at him.
Bradley couldn’t help but sneer when he saw this scene. He felt that the more arrogant Connor was now, the more miserable he would be later.
Henson walked toward Connor and couldn’t help but take a deep breath. Then, he respectfully said to Connor, “Mr. McDonald, good day to you. I am the head of the Marcus Family, Henson Marcus!”
…

chapters.title: Chapter 1004: Kneel Until Jerico Sassman Awakens!
chapters.content:
Chapter 1004: Kneel Until Jerico Sassman Awakens!
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
When the McDonald Family members heard Henson’s words, they were all dumbfounded. Their mouths were wide open, and they were extremely shocked.
No one expected Henson to speak to Connor in such a polite tone!
Even Maverick was puzzled. He could tell from Henson’s tone that he wasn’t here for revenge.
Harland and Huxley were very familiar with the Marcus Family’s style of doing things. At this moment, Henson’s actions left them somewhat confused.
Connor slowly raised his head and glanced at Henson, then said indifferently, “I broke Holden Marcus’s legs. Are you upset about that?”
“Of course not!”
Henson hurriedly shook his head and continued, “It’s all Holden’s fault for not recognizing and offending Mr. McDonald. Mr. McDonald, the Marcus Family is grateful that you can spare Holden’s life!”
When the McDonald Family heard Henson’s words, their expressions became even more shocked. Their eyes widened. They really couldn’t understand why Henson would speak to Connor like this!
Not only did Henson not deal with Connor as they had imagined, but he was even speaking to Connor in a humble tone. This scene deeply stimulated everyone’s nerves. They could already feel that things weren’t as simple as they had imagined.
“Since you’re not here to take revenge on me, why are you here?”
Connor asked Henson expressionlessly.
“Mr. McDonald, I came here today to apologize to you!”
Henson replied softly.
Everyone was even more confused now!
Not only did Henson not come over to cause trouble for Connor, but he even came over to apologize to Connor.
Connor broke Holden’s legs, and Henson took the initiative to apologize. What kind of plot was this?!
“Apologize?”
Connor could not help but be stunned for a moment.
He thought that the Marcus Family would choose to fight one last time, but Connor did not expect that the Marcus Family, who ruled Dexas with their own hands, would actually be so spineless and take the initiative to admit defeat.
“That’s right. Mr. McDonald, we didn’t know about your relationship with Jerico Sassman. If we had known, we definitely wouldn’t have dared to do anything to the Sassman Family!”
Henson humbly explained before continuing, “Mr. McDonald, don’t worry. We won’t cause trouble for the Sassman Family anymore. I’ll also ask my granddaughter, Nadine, to divorce Jerico. The engagement between Wynona Sassman and Kenny will naturally be annulled.”
Huxley, Harland, Maverick, and the others didn’t know how to describe their feelings. After all, they knew how long the Marcus Family had planned to take over the Sassman Family’s business.
But now, the Marcus Family actually gave up everything because of Connor’s appearance. This was really unbelievable.
The McDonald Family began to secretly guess that Connor’s identity might not be as simple as they thought. Otherwise, the Marcus Family would not have such an attitude.
However, the McDonald Family members couldn’t figure out what other identity Connor had that they didn’t know about that could make Henson so afraid.
“Isn’t it a little too late for you to apologize now?”
Connor turned and glanced at Henson, then asked Henson softly.
“Uh…”
A strange look flashed across Henson’s eyes.
“Jerico is still lying in the hospital. You came over to apologize to me, and you want me to let your Marcus Family off? Isn’t this a little too ridiculous?”
Connor looked at Henson and continued to ask.
“Mr. McDonald, we’ve already promised that we won’t hurt the Sassman Family again. Moreover, my grandfather has personally come to apologize to you. What else do you want?”
Nadine couldn’t stand it anymore. She stepped forward and shouted at Connor with her big watery eyes.
“Shut up, you have no right to speak here!”
Henson turned and scolded Nadine coldly.
Nadine took a deep breath and bit her lips. She stood there and didn’t say anything.
After hesitating for two seconds, Henson did something that no one expected!
Thud!
Henson actually knelt down in front of Connor.
Everyone from the McDonald Family was instantly in an uproar, shock written on their faces.
The Marcus Family members were also puzzled.
“Grandpa, what are you doing?”
Nadine hurriedly shouted at Henson.
“Kneel down!”
Henson shouted at Nadine in a low voice.
“Grandpa, I…”
Nadine didn’t seem to be willing to kneel down. She opened her mouth to speak.
“Cut the crap. If I tell you to kneel, then kneel!”
Henson gritted his teeth and shouted.
Nadine stood beside Henson and hesitated for two seconds. She took a deep breath, then bent her knees slightly and knelt in front of Connor.
When the McDonald Family members saw Henson and Nadine kneel before Connor, they were shocked and terrified.
They were all afraid of Connor’s background. He was able to make people like Nadine and Henson kneel down and apologize.
“Mr. McDonald, please give the Marcus Family a chance for the sake of this old thing!”
Henson’s voice trembled as he spoke to Connor.
Connor glanced at Henson indifferently and said coldly, “I’ve already made it very clear. If Jerico doesn’t wake up within a week, the Marcus Family will no longer exist in Dexas!”
“Mr. McDonald, I’ve already contacted the specialists in the the U.S., but it’s a long journey. The fastest the specialist can arrive is tomorrow. One week is really too short. Can you give me a few more days?”
Henson pleaded with a trembling voice.
“Connor, don’t go too far!”
Although Maverick did not understand the situation, he could guess what was going on. He was afraid that Connor would go too far today and the Marcus Family would get desperate.
“Alright, then I’ll give you another week!”
Connor said slowly.
When Henson heard Connor’s words, the expression on his face clearly eased up quite a bit. He hurriedly shouted, “Thank you, Mr. McDonald, thank you!”
“Don’t be in such a hurry to thank me. I also have a request!”
Connor said lightly.
“Mr. McDonald, if you have any requests, please feel free to ask me. As long as it’s within the Marcus Family’s means, we will definitely do our best to do it!”
Henson hurriedly said.
“…”
Connor slowly turned to look at Nadine, then said with a cold expression, “The reason why Jerico has ended up like this is all because of this woman. From now on, she will kneel in front of Jerico’s ward and pray for him. When Jerico wakes up, then she can get up!”

chapters.title: Chapter 1005: Is Your Face More Important Or Is Your Life More Important?
chapters.content:
Chapter 1005: Is Your Face More Important Or Is Your Life More Important?
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
“You actually want me to kneel in front of the ward until Jerico wakes up?
“Are you crazy? Do you think you can do whatever you want just because you’re Mr. McDonald?”
Nadine shouted angrily after hearing Connor’s words.
“I’m sorry, but I can do whatever I want!”
Connor replied domineeringly.
“Why should I kneel there?”
Nadine shouted, somewhat unconvinced.
“You’re Jerico’s wife. It shouldn’t be weird for you to kneel there and pray for Jerico now!”
Connor said lightly.
“I won’t do it!”
Nadine couldn’t accept such an insult, so she shouted with her eyes wide open.
Connor smiled indifferently and said, “Alright, since you won’t do it, then you have the original one week left.”
“Mr. McDonald, you…”
Henson opened his mouth, wanting to say something.
“You have no right to bargain with me. I’m giving you an extra week because you came to apologize to me. If you continue to talk nonsense, believe it or not, I’ll make your family disappear from the world tomorrow.”
Connor couldn’t be bothered to waste his breath on Henson and said coldly.
“…”
Henson was frightened by Connor’s aura. After a moment of shock, he said in a low voice, “Mr. McDonald, we’ll do our best to fulfill your request. I’ll get Nadine to kneel at the door of the ward and pray for Jerico!”
“Get lost!”
Connor waved his hand at Henson.
Henson knew that he wasn’t Connor’s match, and he had no other choice. He looked coldly at Nadine and slowly stood up. Then, he turned around and walked out of the villa.
Nadine hurriedly stood up and followed Henson.
“Mr. Marcus, let me send you off!”
When Maverick McDonald saw that Henson was about to leave, he hurriedly took the initiative to shout.
“Maverick, it’s alright…”
Henson gently waved his hand, then slowly walked away.
The McDonald Family members watched Henson and the others leave with extremely complicated expressions.
They thought that Henson would directly take revenge on Connor, but no one expected that it would end up like this.
Everyone from the McDonald Family was instantly dumbfounded. The way they looked at Connor now was no longer the same as before.
They also finally understood why Connor knew their matters like the back of his hand.
At this moment, they realized that the Connor standing in front of them was not the Connor they knew back then.
Connor was still sitting quietly on his spot as if nothing had happened. There was no change in his expression.
After all, Connor had no intention of hiding his identity from the McDonald Family when he came back this time. Therefore, even if they found out that Connor’s background was not simple, he had nothing to worry about.
The McDonald Family was afraid and regretful at this time. If they had known that Connor had such a terrifying background earlier, they would not have dared to treat Connor like this!
From the moment Connor entered the family, they should have tried their best to curry favor with him. The McDonald Family might even be able to use Connor’s power to become the number one family in Dexas.
However, it was obvious that they had missed this great opportunity.
Who would have thought that Connor, who had nothing back then, would actually become an existence that could make someone like Henson Marcus kneel down in just a few short years!
…
On the other side.
After Nadine and Henson left the McDonald Family’s villa, they took a car and rushed to the hospital where Jerico was.
“Grandpa, do you really want me to kneel in the hospital?”
Nadine asked Henson nervously.
“Other than doing as Connor McDonald says, is there any other way for our family to survive?”
Henson replied softly.
“But if other people find out about this, what dignity will our family have left?”
Nadine felt that it was too embarrassing for her to kneel in the hospital, so she exclaimed unwillingly.
“Is your face more important or your life more important?”
Henson asked with a frown.
“…”
Nadine lowered her head and didn’t answer the question. She never thought that she would end up like this.
Soon, the car arrived at the entrance of the hospital. Henson stepped out of the car, and Nadine followed after two minutes of hesitation.
Although Jerico had been lying in the hospital bed for a long time, the funny thing was that this was the first time Jerico’s wife, Nadine, was here at Jerico’s hospital.
Henson brought Nadine to the door of Jerico’s ward. At this time, Hugo Sassman, Wynona Sassman, and the others were accompanying Jerico. Jerico was lying unconscious on the hospital bed.
Henson took a deep breath, then gently knocked on the door.
Hugo subconsciously turned to look at the door when he heard the knock.
But when he saw Henson and Nadine, his expression changed instantly.
Hugo felt that Henson was here for Wynona.
Wynona was also nervous, and her face instantly turned pale. Her hands were tightly gripping the corner of her clothes, not knowing what to do.
“Dad, they must be here for what happened yesterday, right?”
Wynona whispered to Hugo.
“No matter what they are here for, we have to face it. I hope Connor is fine now!”
Hugo took a deep breath, then stood up and walked to Henson. He said in a low voice, “Mr. Marcus, why are you here today?”
“Hugo, Jerico has been sick for so long, and I just received the news today.”
Henson grabbed Hugo’s hand and said excitedly.
When Wynona heard Henson’s words, she couldn’t help but feel disgusted. How could the Marcus Family not know about this?
“Mr. Marcus, if you have anything to say, just say it!”
Hugo was naturally not in the mood to be polite with Henson. After all, everyone in Dexas knew about the Marcus Family’s intentions. There was no need for Hugo to continue acting with him.
“Hugo, I know that there was a misunderstanding between our families, but now that the misunderstanding has been resolved, I’ve invited the most famous specialist in the U.S.. It won’t be long before Jerico wakes up…”
Henson looked at Hugo and continued.
“Haha…”
After hearing Henson’s words, Hugo couldn’t help but sneer. Then, he said lightly, “Is the Marcus Family so kind? I’ll already be grateful as long as you don’t harm my son. Don’t pretend to be kind and merciful.”
“…”
When Henson heard Hugo’s words, he looked embarrassed and didn’t know what to do.

chapters.title: Chapter 1006: Could It Be Because of Connor?
chapters.content:
Chapter 1006: Could It Be Because of Connor?
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
After hearing what Hugo said to Henson, Nadine’s expression appeared angry.
If it weren’t for Connor, how could Henson speak so subserviently to someone like Hugo?
In the past, the Llyod family would have already destroyed the Sassman family upon hearing Hugo’s words.
But now the situation is different. With Connor as a strong support for the Sassman family, Henson wouldn’t dare to lay a hand on them even if he had the courage.
“Mr. Henson, I’m not in the mood to talk about other things with you now. I know you came here today because of yesterday’s incident with Wynona fleeing the wedding. I arranged everything, and I hope you won’t trouble Connor and Wynona. Whatever means you have, direct them at me!”
It was evident that Hugo was now taking the initiative to protect Connor and Wynona.
After hearing Hugo’s words, Henson finally understood that the people from the Sassman family still didn’t know Connor’s true identity. Connor was not a trump card for the Sassman family; it was all just a coincidence.
“Hugo, you’re overthinking it. I didn’t know before that Wynona didn’t want to marry Kenny. Since Wynona doesn’t want to marry, let’s call off the marriage with Kenny!”
Henson said indifferently.
Hugo’s expression didn’t show any happiness upon hearing Henson’s words. On the contrary, his face became even more serious because he felt that Henson would surely have other ways to deal with them.
“And also, the doctor I invited is very famous internationally. If you’re not reassured, you can supervise the whole process. I have no other intentions now; I just hope Jerrico can wake up soon…”
Henson continued, looking at Hugo.
Hugo was completely dumbfounded after hearing Henson’s words. He couldn’t understand how Henson suddenly became so kind-hearted. It was completely against the way the Llyod family usually acted!
“Mr. Henson, what do you mean exactly?”
Hugo couldn’t bear it anymore and asked him with an agitated expression.
“From now on, our Llyod family and your Sassman family will have no further involvement. After Jerrico wakes up, I will arrange a divorce between Nadine and him. As for the misunderstandings before, let’s consider them all cleared!”
Henson said calmly.
After hearing his words, Hugo looked at him with a perplexed expression.
He simply couldn’t believe that Henson would let him go so easily.
“Nadine is to blame for Jerrico’s condition. So until he wakes up, she will kneel in front of the door and pray for him. I hope you can let go of the grudge between us.” Henson continued.
When Nadine heard his words, she couldn’t help but take a deep breath and finally gritted her teeth and walked to the door of the ward, then knelt directly on the ground.
Hugo and Wynona were immediately stunned in place and disbelief filled their faces.
They couldn’t understand what the Llyod family was up to. First, they invited a doctor over, and now they made Nadine kneel before Jerrico.
Hugo even felt like the Llyod family was really coming to apologize.
“Henson, what exactly do you want to do?”
Hugo couldn’t take it anymore and shouted at Henson in an excited tone.
“What do I want to do? I’ve already made it clear just now!”
Henson replied faintly, then turned his head to look at Nadine and said in a low voice, “Until Jerrico wakes up, you can’t stand up. Do you understand what I mean?”
She was stunned for a moment, then nodded her head while gritting her teeth.
“Hugo, it’s getting late. I won’t bother you anymore. I’ll inform you as soon as the specialist arrives!”
Henson turned his head to Hugo and said, then walked away from the ward.
Hugo, Wynona, and the others stood in place, their expressions extremely puzzled.
At this point, they seemed to be completely bewildered by Henson’s actions, unable to understand what he was trying to do.
“Dad, what… what is going on?”
Wynona hesitated for a moment and asked Hugo in a puzzled tone.
“I don’t know what’s going on now…”
Hugo shook his head lightly.
Wynona subconsciously glanced at Nadine kneeling outside the door and whispered, “Dad, is it possible that the Llyod family really has no intention of dealing with us anymore? I feel like based on Nadine’s character, she wouldn’t willingly kneel there, right?”
“This is really too strange…”
Hugo took a deep breath and suddenly seemed to remember something. He looked up at Wynona and said excitedly, “Could all of this have something to do with Connor?”
“Seems like that’s the only possibility, right?”
Wynona replied in a low voice, then continued, “Yesterday, Connor said he would handle these matters. The Llyod family came to apologize now, could it really be because of Connor?”
“Could it be that Connor has some background that we don’t know about?”
Hugo couldn’t help muttering in a low voice.
After hearing Hugo’s words, Wynona suddenly realized and quickly said, “Dad, actually, yesterday at the hotel, I felt something was off…”
“What was off?”
Hugo quickly asked.
“Do you know Chandler?”
“Do you mean that influential figure?” Hugo didn’t know Chandler personally, but he had heard some things about him.
“Yes, that person. He had a very good relationship with the Llyod family. When Connor was about to break Holden’s legs yesterday, Chandler originally intended to help the Llyod family. But after he received a phone call, he stood on Connor’s side and even helped Connor break Holden’s other leg. Also, Nadine seemed to be very afraid of Connor. When Connor took me away, the Llyod family didn’t dare to stop him…”
After a pause, Wynona continued, “And as soon as Connor and I left the hotel, Chandler quickly caught up and apologized to Connor. I find all of these things very strange…”
“Why didn’t you tell me about it yesterday?”
Hugo exclaimed with some exasperation.
“I was too nervous yesterday, so I forgot about these things…”
Wynona whispered.
“Connor’s background must be extraordinary, otherwise, why would the Llyod family come to apologize…”
Hugo exclaimed in an excited tone. At this moment, he finally understood the meaning behind Connor’s words last night.

chapters.title: Chapter 1007: Miracle!
chapters.content:
Chapter 1007: Miracle!
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
In the hospital ward.
Wynona briefly told Hugo about what happened at the wedding banquet.
After listening to her account, he became even more certain in his heart that Connor must have some unknown background, which is why he dared to make a move against the Llyod family.
But what puzzled him was, what kind of background could Connor have that would make the Llyod family so fearful?
“Dad, I remember Chandler always calling Connor ‘Mr. Connor.’ I found that strange at the time because Connor isn’t some rich second-generation. Why would Chandler address him like that?”
At that moment, Wynona spoke up again to Hugo.
“You mean… Mr. Connor?”
After hearing Wynona’s words, Hugo froze, his voice trembling as he said, “Could it be that such a coincidence exists in this world?”
“What do you mean?”
She blinked her eyes, seemingly confused.
“A while ago, I heard that there is a person named Mr. Connor in Porthampton. It is said that this Mr. Connor possesses astonishing power and is unparalleled even among the four major provinces. Could it be that Connor is this legendary Mr. Connor?”
Hugo exclaimed with excitement, shouting at Wynona.
“Well…”
A flicker of surprise crossed Wynona’s face, then she whispered, “It seems like Connor has indeed been studying in Porthampton…”
Upon hearing this, he turned his head directly to her and said in an excited tone, “If Connor is really that Mr. Connor from Porthampton, then everything now makes sense. Chandler’s reaction and the Llyod family coming to apologize, it all falls within reason…”
“But Connor is just an ordinary college student, right? How could he become Porthampton’s Mr. Connor?”
She still seemed unable to accept this, muttering softly.
“We haven’t seen Connor in so long. Who knows what he has experienced during this time…”
Hugo sighed softly and continued, “But regardless, Connor should indeed be the Mr. Connor of Porthampton. It seems that the heavens have taken pity on our Sassman family. I thought our Sassman family had reached a dead end, but unexpectedly, Connor has emerged. Now, neither you nor Jerrico will be manipulated by the Llyod family anymore. This is truly wonderful. I must thank Connor properly!”
“The situation is not confirmed yet. We can’t be sure if Connor is indeed the Mr. Connor. Let’s observe the situation before making any conclusions!”
Jerrico’s mother couldn’t help but remind Hugo in a soft voice.
“You’re right!”
He nodded in agreement and continued, “I will contact my friends in Porthampton now and see if I can find someone who knows Mr. Connor to confirm Connor’s identity. If Connor is really Mr. Connor, then our Sassman family has encountered a benefactor!”
“Yesterday, Dad, you said that unless Connor could bring us a miracle, our family would not be able to overcome this hurdle. But I didn’t expect that Connor would actually bring us a miracle…”
At this moment, Wynona also seemed very happy, smiling as she spoke to Hugo.
“Yes, I didn’t expect that Connor would really bring us a miracle. I’ll make a call now to gather some information!”
Feeling the weight that had been pressing on his heart finally lifting, Hugo couldn’t help but breathe a sigh of relief. He then walked towards the ward door, holding his phone.
..
On the other side, inside Zhang’s villa.
After Henson and Nadine left, the expressions of everyone in the McDonald family towards Connor underwent a tremendous change.
Everything happened so suddenly that no one knew what was going on!
Even Bradley didn’t dare to meet Connor’s gaze because he knew that Connor was not someone he could provoke at this moment!
“Why are you all staring at me like that? Take a seat, everyone. I have something to tell you.”
Seeing everyone standing there staring at him, Connor couldn’t help but smile lightly and calmly called out.
After hearing his words, everyone remained motionless, without any reaction at all.
“Connor, can you tell us why you came back for what reason?”
Maverick hesitated for a moment and asked Connor.
“I didn’t originally come back to compete for the McDonald family’s assets, but since all of you are so guarded against me, well then, I want a fifty percent stake in McDonald Corporation. Any objections?”
Connor said with a smile.
“You want fifty percent of the shares?”
After hearing his words, Harland couldn’t help but shout and continued, “Why should we give you fifty percent of the shares? Who do you think you are?”
“Why should we?”
Connor smiled faintly, then coldly said to Harland, “Because I’m stronger than you in terms of ability, I have a more impressive background than you, both in terms of social connections and financial strength. Moreover, McDonald Corporation itself belongs to my father. Taking away fifty percent of the shares is a perfectly normal thing for me to do, isn’t it?”
“What kind of background do you have, you brat?”
Harland shouted as if he was somewhat unconvinced.
“If I have the ability to make Henson kneel before me, then I definitely have the ability to make you kneel before me too!”
Connor looked at him and said calmly.
“Alright, if you really have that ability, then show it to me…”
Harland was about to say something else.
“Shut up!”
Maverick suddenly frowned and shouted.
Harland quickly turned his head to look at Maverick, his eyes filled with confusion.
“What Connor said is correct. This McDonald Corporation was indeed established by his father, and it’s perfectly normal for Connor to take fifty percent of the shares. So, I agree to give Connor fifty percent of the shares!”
Maverick spoke softly as he looked at the people in the McDonald family.
After he finished speaking, it instantly caused dissatisfaction among all the members of the McDonald family.
“Dad, what are you saying? Why should we give Connor shares from our family?”
“Yeah, Connor has long had no relationship with our McDonald family. Why should we give him shares?”
“I disagree…”
Everyone spoke up, shouting at Maverick.
“Shut your mouths!”
Maverick shouted, glaring at them, and continued, “I have made my decision on this matter. If any of you disagree, then get out of here!”

chapters.title: Chapter 1008: What Did You Went Through?
chapters.content:
Chapter 1008: What Did You Went Through?
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
The McDonald family members stood still and their faces showing extremely complex expressions when they heard Maverick’s words.
They couldn’t understand why Maverick agreed to give Connor fifty percent of the shares.
However, they didn’t dare to defy his intentions, so in the end, they could only reluctantly accept.
“Have you discussed it?”
Connor looked at the crowd and asked.
“There’s no need to discuss such matters. I alone can make the decision…”
Maverick looked at him and said.
“That’s good!”
Connor nodded lightly and continued, “Since I now hold fifty percent of McDonald Corporation’s shares, I am the chairman of McDonald Corporation. From now on, none of the McDonald family members can hold any position in McDonald Corporation. However, I will distribute dividends to you annually based on your shares!”
After hearing his words, the crowd once again froze. No one had expected him to be so ruthless, planning to dismiss everyone.
“Do you have any objections?”
Connor asked with a slow tone.
“No objections!”
At this point, Maverick realized that the current Connor was no longer the same person as before. Even the Llyod family didn’t dare to go against Connor, so he naturally couldn’t oppose him. He could only agree to whatever Connor said.
Although the other members of the McDonald family were very resentful, they were helpless. After all, Maverick had already agreed, and whatever they said wouldn’t make a difference.
“Connor, can you handle such a big company on your own?”
Huxley asked Connor after realizing that his position as the chairman was not secure.
“You don’t have to worry about that…”
Connor replied expressionlessly, then continued, “You know how much money you embezzled from the company. You should be well aware. I’ll give you one month to repay all that money. If you can’t pay it back, I will sue you directly with a lawyer. Do you understand?”
“…”
Huxley looked at Connor in front of him and couldn’t help but pause, then gritted his teeth and said in a low voice, “I understand…”
“Good.”
Connor nodded lightly and then turned to look at Harland, saying softly, “And you, you also have one month to repay the money you owe Kendrick Yank. If you can’t pay it back, I can help you, but McDonald Corporation will have no relationship with you. Do you understand?”
“Connor, you…”
Harland suddenly stood up.
“What? Do you still have any objections?”
Connor looked at Harland and asked calmly.
“Sit down!”
Maverick said in a low voice.
Harland took a deep breath and finally gritted his teeth, sitting back in his chair.
No one had expected that Connor, who had been driven out of the McDonald family in the past, would now be overwhelming the entire McDonald family.
For a while, everyone in the McDonald family lowered their heads, unsure of what to say.
They never expected this to be the outcome.
In fact, he originally had no intention of taking back these things from the McDonald family members. After all, these things were simply insignificant to him. He had countless companies worth billions under his name. A small McDonald Corporation meant nothing to him.
His actions were just meant to teach the McDonald family members a lesson.
Maverick looked at Connor and took a deep breath before saying in a low voice, “Connor, now that you have obtained fifty percent of McDonald Corporation’s shares, do you have any other matters?”
“Of course!” Connor nodded lightly and stood up, saying, “I have something else I want to discuss with you separately.”
Maverick hesitated for a moment and then nodded gently, saying, “Alright, let’s go to the study and talk.”
Connor directly headed towards the location of Maverick’s study. Although the McDonald family’s mansion had undergone significant changes, Connor had lived here for several years, so he was still very familiar with the study’s location.
A few minutes later, Connor followed Maverick into the study.
Harland turned his head and glanced at Huxley, then whispered, “We need to come up with a solution. We can’t just watch Connor take away the company like this, can we?”
“Come up with a solution?” Huxley couldn’t help but let out a cold laugh upon hearing these words. He then whispered, “If I had a solution, would I just watch Connor take away fifty percent of the company’s shares? The current Connor is no longer the same person as before. Our father agreed to his demands to protect us. If he really wants to deal with us, our McDonald family won’t even have a chance to react…”
“Connor has such great capabilities?” Harland blinked his eyes, asking with a puzzled expression.
“How many people in Dexas can make Henson kneel and apologize? You tell me,” Huxley replied coldly.
Upon hearing this, Harland couldn’t help but take a sharp breath and was momentarily at a loss for what to do.
“Connor didn’t take over the entire McDonald Corporation, so he has already given us face. What we need to do now is to quickly clean up our own mess…” Huxley continued.
“Ah…” Harland sighed helplessly upon hearing Huxley’s words, his eyes filled with resignation.
…
On the other side, after Connor arrived at the study with Maverick.
He directly sat on the chair, while Maverick took a seat across from him.
“If you have anything to say, just say it.” Maverick took the initiative to speak to Connor.
“What really happened to my parents back then?” Connor didn’t waste any time and asked directly.
Upon hearing his question, Maverick’s eyebrows twitched slightly, a hint of surprise flickering in his eyes. He then spoke in a low voice, “Weren’t your parents killed in a car accident?”
“My parents didn’t die in a car accident; they were murdered. You should be the only person who knows the truth. I don’t want to waste time with you. Tell me the truth about what happened back then. I can guarantee that none of your McDonald family members will face any trouble. But if you dare to deceive me, I will make each and every one of your family members disappear, one by one…” Connor calmly threatened.
“Connor, what have you went through all these years?” Maverick, feeling increasingly unfamiliar with Connor, couldn’t help but ask in a low voice.
“What I’ve went through has nothing to do with you. Just answer my question quickly,” he replied with extreme coldness.
After all, ever since Maverick kicked him out of the McDonald family, Connor felt that he no longer had any relatives in this world. That’s why he spoke so ruthlessly to Maverick.

chapters.title: Chapter 1009: Father's Past
chapters.content:
Chapter 1009: Father’s Past
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Maverick didn’t seem to anticipate that Connor would undergo such a drastic change after leaving the McDonald family.
At this moment, Connor felt extremely unfamiliar. Both his tone of speech and his approach to doing things were different from before.
He knew that something must have happened to Connor for him to become like this.
He wanted to ask Connor directly about what he had experienced, but Connor remained resistant and showed no intention of answering the question. He decided not to push further.
“How did my parents really die?” Connor, seeing Maverick’s silence, furrowed his brows and asked in a low voice.
Maverick raised his head slowly, glanced at him, and said with a composed expression, “Connor, let me advise you. Knowing too much about what happened in the past won’t do you any good. Some things have already happened, and no matter what we do now, we can’t change them. So it’s better for you not to inquire further…”
“This matter is related to the deaths of my parents. How can I pretend it never happened?” Connor gritted his teeth and exclaimed coldly.
He detested Maverick’s attitude the most. Regardless of the circumstances, Maverick was still Dawson’s father. However, he couldn’t understand why Maverick was so indifferent to his own son’s death.
“Even if you know, what can you do? Can you change anything?” Maverick continued.
“Maybe I couldn’t change anything before, but now I’m not the same person I was back then,” he replied calmly.
Maverick took a deep breath and said softly, “Fine, since you’re so eager to know what happened back then, I’ll tell you…”
Connor looked at Maverick, waiting silently for him to speak.
“We need to start with your father’s past,” Maverick began.
“My father’s past?” Connor frowned slightly, his expression showing confusion.
“Yes, actually, your father is not my biological son. He was just an adopted child!” Maverick nodded.
When Connor heard these words from him, his expression was filled with disbelief.
Although the McDonald family treated Connor poorly, he had never doubted his own blood relationship. He thought the reason why the McDonald family treated him this way was simply because they wanted to divide the McDonlad Corporation among themselves.
But he never imagined that he truly had no relation to the McDonald family!
This meant that he was actually an orphan, with no real family in this world.
Connor stared at Maverick, his expression filled with shock.
He never expected that he wasn’t really part of the McDonald family!
“Are you telling the truth?” Connor asked coldly.
“At this point, I have no reason to lie to you,” Maverick replied calmly, then continued, “I promised your father to keep this secret for a lifetime. But since you’re so eager to know what happened back then, I can only tell you the truth…”
“What happened then?” Connor hurriedly asked.
“I actually had another second son who had a very good relationship with your father. But my second son passed away due to an illness. Then your father suddenly approached me and told me he needed an identity, a clean identity. He wanted to live in this world using the identity of my second son.”
He paused for a moment and continued, “At that time, I didn’t know what your father meant exactly, but he presented a very tempting condition. He promised to change the fate of everyone in the McDonald family. And at that time, I was just a small factory owner, and the factory was not doing well, on the verge of bankruptcy. Faced with your father’s offer, I had no way to refuse!”
Connor looked at Maverick’s face in front of him, shocked by his expression. He never imagined that his father and Maverick had such a history.
“In the end, I chose to conceal the news of my second son’s death and, with everyone from the McDonald family, followed your father to Dexas to start a new life,” Maverick said slowly.
“Do the other members of the McDonald family know about this?” Connor quickly asked.
“Yes, Huxley, Harland and the others are aware of it,” Maverick nodded gently.
Connor finally understood why the McDonald family treated him so poorly. It turned out that everyone knew he wasn’t a part of the family except for himself.
“After arriving in Dexas, your father indeed fulfilled his promise. Within a few short years, he established the McDonlad Corporation, and the development speed of the company was astonishing. Our lives changed along with it. At that time, the McDonlad Corporation was prominent in Dexas, and your father met your mother and then you…”
Maverick looked at Connor and said earnestly.
“And then?” Connor felt that something was amiss and asked excitedly.
“I was curious about your father’s true identity, so I tried every means to find out, but I had no success. However, a few months before your father had an accident, he suddenly found me and voluntarily revealed his secret to me…”
Maverick said in a low voice.
Connor looked at Maverick, waiting silently for him to continue.
“Your father told me that the reason he was able to build the McDonlad Corporation so big was because he worked for an organization called Rockefeller. This Rockefeller organization is massive, on a scale that ordinary people can’t imagine!”
Maverick paused for a moment and continued, “Your father was the head of Rockefeller in Dexas. But Rockefeller has a rule that all leaders must conceal their identities and not let outsiders know about Rockefeller’s existence.”
Upon hearing his words, Connor’s expression remained calm. After all, he already knew that his father was associated with Rockefeller, so there was no need for surprise. He was curious about what would happen next.

chapters.title: Chapter 1010: Two Reason
chapters.content:
Chapter 1010: Two Reason
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
“Are you saying that my father intentionally approached you, pretending to be your second son, in order to conceal his identity, and then established the McDonald Corporatio to further conceal his identity?”
Connor narrowed his eyes and asked Maverick in a low voice.
“That’s right. Everything your father did was actually to conceal his identity!”
Maverick nodded slightly.
“Then why did my father tell you all these things?”
Connor hesitated for a moment and looked at Maverick, pressing for an answer.
“Your father told me these things because he said he might get a promotion opportunity. The people at Rockefeller have decided to promote him from being in charge of Dexasto being in charge of Orilon. Your father seemed to have been waiting for this opportunity, so he wanted to discuss with me about taking the McDonald family and leaving Dexas for Newtown in Orilon…”
Maverick spoke slowly.
“Newton?”
Connor’s eyes flickered with a hint of surprise.
“I know that our McDonald family has everything we have now thanks to your father’s efforts. Once we leave your father, we will have nothing. So I can only choose to agree!”
Hetook a deep breath and continued, “And your father also told me that this promotion might not go smoothly because there are many people at Rockefeller eyeing his position. He is likely to face danger!”
Connor was well aware of Rockefeller now. From what Birdie had mentioned, he could sense that infighting was common among the people within Rockefeller.
There was no room for sentiment in Rockefeller, and everyone relied on their abilities. As long as you could create value for Rockefeller, the people above wouldn’t care about the means you used.
So he felt that his father must have realized that other competitors were preparing to take action against him, which was why he took the initiative to tell Maverick about these things.
“At that time, I didn’t think much about it. But I didn’t expect that two months later, your parents would have a car accident. When I heard about your parents’ accident, I knew it wasn’t an accident. It was likely the work of your father’s competitors…”
Maverick looked at him and continued to speak.
Connor stared at him without saying a word.
“I have already explained the situation between our McDonald family and your father clearly. You should know that without your father, our McDonald family is nothing. So when your father encountered trouble, we could only remain silent. I know that the people we can’t afford to provoke are the same people you can’t afford to provoke…”
After finishing his words, Maverick slowly walked up to Connor, bowed deeply, and said in a low voice, “Connor, I have always felt guilty about your father’s death, but please forgive my selfishness. I really can’t risk the lives of everyone in the McDonald family for the sake of avenging your father…”
“Then why didn’t you tell me all this earlier?” he asked Maverick with some confusion.
Even if it were our McDonald family, there was nothing we could do about it. I told you all this, but what could you do? You were just a child at that time…”
Maverick replied in a low voice, then continued, “The reason I have the courage to tell you all this now is because I believe you are capable of facing your parents’ situation. If you weren’t capable of dealing with these things, I wouldn’t have told you…”
“Why did you kick me out of the McDonald family back then?”
Connor asked Maverick, pursuing an answer.
Maverick hesitated for a moment upon hearing his words, then spoke in a low voice, “The reason I kicked you out of the McDonald family had two factors.”
Connor looked at Maverick without saying a word.
“The first reason is that your father had instructed me beforehand that if anything happened to him, I could choose not to avenge him, but I must protect you.”
“At that time, I was worried that the person who killed your father might trace his identity back to our McDonald family and come after you. So I decided to kick you out of the family, hoping that it would make it difficult for them to find you.”
“I haven’t contacted you all these years because I was afraid they would find you.”
Maverick earnestly explained to Connor.
“I see…”
It was only now that Connor realized he had misunderstood Maverick all these years.
“Indeed, my judgment was correct. Shortly after you left Dexas, everyone in our McDonald family was being monitored. They must have been trying to find clues about you. Though Rockefeller is terrifying, finding you amidst the vast population wouldn’t have been an easy task, especially since their attention was focused on Dexas, while you had already gone to Porthampton…”
Maverick looked at Connor with a helpless smile and continued, “Although it was cruel to drive you away from the McDonald family back then, in the end, you managed to survive…”
Connor couldn’t help but sigh, then he continued to ask Maverick, “You mentioned earlier that there were two reasons why you kicked me out of the McDonald family. What is the other reason?”
“The other reason is that I was worried you would bring trouble to our McDonald family and that you might take control of the McDonald Corporation’s assets. I know the personalities of Huxley and Harland very well. I even feared that they might harm you. So at that time, I could only choose to let you leave the McDonald family. It was the best option…”
Maverick explained slowly as he looked at Connor.
Having listened to his words, Connor finally understood what had happened back then.
At this moment, his resentment towards the McDonald family seemed to have diminished a lot. Although the actions of the McDonald family were extremely selfish, considering there was no blood relation between them and Connor, it was somewhat understandable for them to act in their own self-interest.
Moreover, he finally understood why Maverick’s attitude towards him had changed so drastically.
Maverick’s actions back then not only protected the interests of the McDonald family but also ensured his safety. It could be considered the best choice. He no longer had any intention to blame Maverick further.

chapters.title: Chapter 1011: The Person-in-Charge of Orilon
chapters.content:
Chapter 1011: The Person-in-Charge of Orilon
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
In the study room.
After Maverick told Connor everything that happened back then, he heaved a long sigh of relief.
After all, for so many years, this secret had always been pressing on his heart. Now that he had told Connor everything, he felt much more relaxed.
“Connor, your father is the great benefactor of our McDonald family. Without your father, McDonald family would never have such an achievement today. What the other members of the McDonald family did to you was indeed a bit excessive.”
Maverick stood up and bowed to Connor again.
Connor glanced at Maverick and said expressionlessly, “You don’t have to apologize to me. Since I’m not related to the McDonald family by blood, I can understand what you’ve done.”
“…”
Maverick looked at him and did not say anything. Perhaps it was because he did not know how to answer.
“Don’t worry. Although I’ve taken away 50% of the McDonald Corporation’s shares now, the profits that your McDonald family will receive in a few years will definitely be on the same par as now!” Connor continued.
After Maverick heard Connor’s words, he suddenly looked up at Connor with an expression of disbelief. He stuttered, “Connor, have you forgiven us?”
“Forgiven you?”
After Connor heard Maverick’s words, he couldn’t help but sneer. “Your McDonald family did so many things to me back then. How could I forgive you? I’m only doing this to fulfill my father’s promise to you. Since my father promised you that your McDonald family would not have to worry about money for generations, I will fulfill this promise…”
Maverick looked at Connor in front of him with an awkward expression. He smiled bitterly as if he didn’t know what to say.
Connor slowly stood up and said expressionlessly, “No matter what, I still have to thank you for telling me about what happened back then…”
After saying these words, Connor seemed to be preparing to leave, but Maverick quickly stood up and shouted, “Connor, although I have never fulfilled my duty as a grandfather all these years and you are not related to me by blood, I have watched you grow up. I really treat you as my biological grandson…”
When Connor heard Maverick’s words, his body couldn’t help but tremble slightly as he stopped in his tracks.
“I want to tell you one last thing: the other party is really not as simple as you think. I know that you are no longer the same as before, but no matter what, you have to be careful!” Maverick said to Connor with a trembling voice.
After Connor heard Maverick’s words, his expression became a little strange. Then, he slowly said, “You should clean up the McDonald family’s mess first. Although I will guarantee that your McDonald family will live a rich life for generations, some things aren’t for me to decide alone!”
“Don’t worry, I’ll definitely take care of the McDonald family’s matters!”
Maverick nodded lightly.
After seeing Maverick like this, Connor felt a little pity for him, but he took a deep breath and walked out of the study without saying anything.
When Connor left the study room, he found that those people from the McDonald family had already left. They should have gone to deal with their own matters.
“I didn’t expect that I wouldn’t actually be a member of the McDonald family!”
Connor helplessly shook his head and smiled bitterly. Then, he slowly walked out of the McDonald family’s villa.
After leaving the villa, Connor took a taxi back to the hotel he was staying in. Then, he lay on the bed alone and recalled what Maverick had said to him today.
Connor was sure that Maverick was telling the truth. At this point, Maverick had no reason to lie to him. Besides, Maverick’s eldest son was called Huxley, and his third son was called Harland. Both their names started with H, so why was only Connor’s father called Dawson? This was obviously illogical.
Therefore, Connor and the McDonald family should really not be related by blood. Moreover, Connor could choose to do a paternity test, so Maverick should not lie about this kind of thing.
What Connor was thinking about was who his father really was.
Also, did Connor still have any relatives alive?
This question was obviously a little complicated for Connor. After all, Maverick had very little information about Connor’s father. Moreover, not many people knew about this matter. Even if he wanted to investigate, he could not find out easily.
There was a more important question. Who was the person who killed his parents?
Connor’s father was killed because he was about to be promoted to the person-in-charge of Rockefeller’s Orilon branch. In other words, the other party must have attacked Connor’s father for the position of person-in-charge. Therefore, the current person-in-charge of Orilon was the most suspicious.
Connor took out his phone and dialed Birdie’s number.
“Ding!”
After the phone rang twice, Birdie answered the call and asked softly, “Mr. McDonald, what’s the matter?”
Connor was not in the mood to beat around the bush with Birdie. “Miss Schroder, do you know who is in charge of Rockefeller in Orilon?”
“The person in charge of Orilon’s branch?”
When Birdie heard this, he could not help but be stunned for a moment, then said softly, “Mr. McDonald, the persons-in-charge of Rockefeller are not allowed to contact each other individually, so I don’t know much about the one in charge of Orilon…”
“Alright then…”
Connor replied helplessly.
Birdie hesitated for a moment before asking softly, “Mr. McDonald, why are you asking about this?”
“That person might be related to my parents’ death!” Connor said in a low voice.
“I see!” Birdie was silent for a moment, then slowly said, “Mr. McDonald, although I can’t tell you who the person in charge of Orilon is, give me some time. I might be able to help you find some clues…”
“Really?”
Connor shouted excitedly after hearing Birdie’s words.
“Of course, I’m a real woman. Since I’ve chosen to cooperate with you, I’ll definitely do my best to help you…”
Birdie smiled faintly.
..

chapters.title: Chapter 1012: Jennifer's Invitation
chapters.content:
Chapter 1012: Jennifer’s Invitation
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
After hearing that Birdie didn’t know who was the person in charge of Rockefeller in Orilon, Connor began to suspect that Birdie was deliberately hiding it from him.
However, when he heard that Birdie was going to help him investigate this person, the doubts in his heart were instantly dispelled.
“Then I will wait for your news…”
Connor said softly.
“Good!”
Birdie didn’t waste any time and simply replied to Connor before hanging up.
Connor put down his phone and lay on the bed alone, recalling what Maverick had said to him today.
He was thinking about how he should deal with the person in charge of Orilon.
Connor knew that even if the person in charge of Orilon didn’t directly kill his parents, his parents’ deaths were definitely related to this person.
Birdie was very efficient in her information gathering—Connor only waited for about two hours before he received another call from Birdie.
When Connor heard the ringtone of his phone, he hurriedly picked up the phone and answered the call. Then, he asked in an urgent tone, “Miss Schroder, do you have any news?”
” That’s right, Mr. McDonald. I’ve already found out that the person in charge of Orilon is called Yaakov Ward…” Birdie said.
“Yaakov Ward?” When Connor heard this name, he couldn’t help but be stunned for a moment. Then, he continued to ask, “Do you have any other clues?”
“About that…”
After Birdie heard Connor’s words, her expression was a little helpless. She said lightly, “Mr. McDonald, I’m just the person in charge of a small branch in Porthampton. It’s basically impossible for me to find the specifics of the person in charge of Orilon…”
Connor thought for a moment and asked softly, “Is there any other way to find out more about Yaakov?”
“…”
Birdie hesitated for a moment, then slowly said, “Mr. McDonald, I have another way…”
“What is it?”
“You can contact the person-in-charge of Newtown. I think that person must know about Yaakov Ward. I can provide you with the information of the person-in-charge of Newtown’s branch if you want…”
Birdie said slowly.
Connor thought for a moment and replied in a low voice, “Alright, give me that person’s information…”
“Alright, I’ll send it to you now!”
Birdie hung up after saying that.
Connor knew that Rockefeller was a very secretive organization. It was incredibly difficult to get in touch with them unless you were in a superior-subordinate relationship with someone in the organization.
The branch in Porthampton, where Birdie was located, should be managed by the person in charge of Davenport.
Birdie knew the identity of the person in charge of Davenport, but she did not know the identity of the person in charge of Orilon.
The simplest and most direct way for Connor was to find the person in charge of Newtown first, and then get the information about the person in charge of Orilon from there.
A few minutes later, Connor received a document from Birdie.
The contents of the document were very detailed. It recorded all the information of the person-in-charge in Newtown.
The person in charge of Rockefeller in Newtown was a man named Percy Juve. He was around 30 years old and looked like a normal man. To the public, he was the owner of a large supermarket chain.
After Connor received this information, it was much easier for him to find this man.
Connor now felt that it was a very wise choice for him to cooperate with Birdie because the information that she provided him could save him a lot of time. Otherwise, it would take him a long time to find the person in charge of Newtown.
“Ding!”
Just as Connor was thinking about what he should do next, his phone suddenly rang.
Connor was stunned for a moment when he heard the ringtone of his phone. Then, he picked up his phone and took a look. He realized that it was Jennifer Goodwin calling him.
Before Connor and Jennifer parted ways at the Marcus family’s wedding ceremony, they exchanged phone numbers.
Connor looked at the name on the screen and hesitated for a moment. Then, he pressed the answer button and asked with a smile, “Lady Jennifer, why did you call me?”
“Of course, I called you because I have something to tell you…”
Jennifer replied indifferently and did not continue. She seemed to be a little hesitant.
“If you have anything to say, just tell me. There’s no need to be so polite. What’s the relationship between the two of us?” Connor said with a smile.
“Alright then, I’ll tell you. My friend is holding a party today. Can you go with me?” Jennifer said weakly.
“Why do I have to attend your friend’s party? I don’t even know them…”
Connor said lightly.
“There are a few annoying people at this gathering. I’m worried that they will come and harass me when they drink too much, so you can protect me if you follow me there…”
Jennifer explained helplessly, then continued, “But don’t worry. It’s really just a simple meal this time. I won’t ask you to pretend to be my boyfriend. Don’t worry…”
Whether it was her figure or her appearance, Jennifer could be said to be the best of the best. She was an outstanding presence in the entirety of Dexas.
Therefore, there were naturally many pursuers around her. Most of these pursuers were rich heirs, so Jennifer did not dare to make a big deal out of it. She could only try her best to avoid these pursuers.
However, she could not avoid this gathering. She knew that Connor’s background was not simple. If she could bring Connor over, she should be able to intimidate those pursuers.
After Connor understood what Jennifer meant, he smiled faintly and said softly, “Alright, since that’s the case, I’ll follow you to take a look…”
Seeing that Connor had agreed, Jennifer looked a little excited and asked in disbelief, “Really?”
“Yes, really…”
Connor nodded lightly.
Originally, Jennifer had called Connor on a whim, but she never expected him to actually say yes. She originally thought that Connor would not agree to accompany her.
Jennifer had another reason for bringing Connor to the party. She felt that if she could bring a handsome man like him along, her friends would definitely be very envious of her. After all, Connor’s background, strength, figure, and looks were all very good.

chapters.title: Chapter 1013: The Beauty, Yalini Zahn
chapters.content:
Chapter 1013: The Beauty, Yalini Zahn
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
After hearing that Connor had agreed to attend the party, Jennifer smiled with satisfaction.
She hurriedly told Connor the time and place of the gathering and then hung up the phone.
Connor put down his phone and smiled helplessly. Then, he continued to think about how he should deal with Yaakov Ward and Percy Juve.
As for Jennifer’s gathering, Connor did not take it to heart at all; after all, Connor did not need to hide his identity in Dexas. If anyone dared to provoke him, he could just slap them away.
As more and more people knew Connor’s identity, he did not have to be as timid as before.
…
At six o’clock in the evening.
Connor took a taxi alone and arrived at the gathering location that Jennifer had told him about. It was a five-star hotel in Dexas.
Connor had just gotten out of the taxi when he found a black Mercedes-Benz parked at the entrance of the restaurant. The price of this Mercedes-Benz was around one million dollars. Those who could afford this car should be pretty well off.
A handsome young man in a black suit got out of the Mercedes-Benz. The young man looked like a senior executive working in a big company. The presence he gave off was definitely not something that ordinary white-collar workers could compare to.
Beside the young man was a beautiful woman. She was dressed in gorgeous clothes and had long, silky black hair. She was wearing the latest Gucci high heels. The woman was very tall and her makeup skills were very good, so she looked very seductive.
The two of them chatted as they walked towards the entrance of the restaurant.
When the beauty saw Connor, she could not help but be stunned for a moment. A strange look flashed across her eyes, but she did not say anything.
“Honey, what’s wrong?”
The young man in the suit could not help but ask softly when he saw the strange expression on the beautiful woman’s face.
“Nothing. I saw a person who looked a little familiar just now. I must have mistaken it!” the beauty explained.
“Then do you want to go up and say something?” the young man said indifferently.
“There’s no need. I must’ve been mistaken. Moreover, I’m not very familiar with this person…”
The beautiful woman shook her head gently and walked into the restaurant. The young man didn’t say anything else and followed her into the restaurant.
Connor happened to be following behind the two of them. When the beautiful woman saw Connor walk into the restaurant, a strange look flashed across her eyes again. Then, she could not help but think, “Is there really such a coincidence in this world? I must be wrong. How can a person like that appear here…”
“Ding dong…”
At this moment, the elevator arrived on the first floor, and the elevator door slowly opened.
Connor followed the couple into the elevator.
When the beauty saw that Connor seemed to be getting off on the same floor as them, her expression seemed to be even more puzzled. However, she still did not choose to take the initiative to talk to Connor because she was not sure if Connor was the person she knew.
Soon, the elevator arrived at the floor where the party room was located.
The young man and the beautiful woman walked out of the elevator first, and Connor followed behind them.
The beauty hesitated for a moment, then whispered to the young man beside her, “This person seems to be here to attend our gathering…”
“He’s probably your classmate’s boyfriend. This person is about the same age as us…” the young man replied indifferently.
“That’s true!”
The beautiful woman nodded thoughtfully and did not say anything else. However, her mind was still surrounded by that terrifying thought.
A moment later, Connor finally arrived at the door of the private room where the party was held.
At this moment, Jennifer was standing at the door of the private room anxiously, waiting for Connor.
Jennifer was indeed one of the top beauties in Dexas. Today, she was dressed very beautifully in a white dress. The hollowed-out design made Jennifer’s sexy figure faintly visible. She had light makeup on her face, and she looked pure and charming.
Jennifer’s appearance made the beauty that Connor had met outside the restaurant seem dim in comparison.
When Jennifer saw Connor appear, a hint of excitement flashed across her eyes. She walked towards him in her high heels.
However, before Jennifer could walk to Connor’s side, the beauty took the initiative to mock Jennifer, “Oh me oh my, isn’t that the great beauty Jennifer? You came to the party today? We haven’t seen each other for a long time!”
“It’s definitely been a long time…”
Jennifer glanced at the beauty indifferently and replied with a cold expression.
