“Did you come alone today? Did you bring your boyfriend over?” the woman continued to ask.
Jennifer ignored her and walked to Connor’s side in her high heels. She deliberately held Connor’s arm and said with a smile, “Connor, you’re here? Let’s go in quickly…”
When the beauty saw Jennifer take the initiative to hold Connor’s arm, a strange look flashed across her beautiful eyes. Then, she hurriedly asked, “Jennifer, is this your boyfriend?”
“He’s not my boyfriend. He’s just a friend of mine!” Jennifer replied indifferently.
The beauty in front of Jennifer was named Yalini Zahn. The Zahn family and the Goodwin family had a lot of business dealings, so Yalini and Jennifer had known each other since they were very young. Moreover, both of them were beautiful, so they would definitely compete with each other.
However, since she was young, Jennifer had always been better than Yalini. Be it in terms of figure, appearance, or background, Yalini was inferior to Jennifer. This made Yalini increasingly dislike Jennifer.
After Jennifer left Dexas, Yalini more or less let go of the jealousy in her heart.
However, Yalini found out that Jennifer had returned to the country some time ago.
She had always wanted to find an opportunity to mock Jennifer.
This was because the current Yalini was no longer the Yalini of the past!
The young man beside Yalini was the manager of a listed company with an annual salary of more than a million dollars. Moreover, his future was limitless, so Yalini wanted to lord her boyfriend over Jennifer.
When Yalini saw Connor just now, she felt that he looked a little familiar. She wondered if he was the person she had heard her friend talk about.
However, when she found out that Connor was Jennifer’s friend, she was instantly relieved because she felt that Jennifer would definitely not know such a big shot.

chapters.title: Chapter 1014: A Battle of Words
chapters.content:
Chapter 1014: A Battle of Words
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Yalini and Jennifer had not seen each other for a long time. Therefore, when the two of them met again, it was inevitable that they would be at loggerheads.
Connor turned to look at Jennifer. He knew that Jennifer had called him over not just to get rid of the harassment of her pursuers—she must’ve also been worried that people like Yalini would mock her. After all, girls were vain.
Connor was not overly disgusted by Jennifer’s thoughts because he knew that Jennifer did not have any ill intentions.
Yalini chatted briefly with Jennifer before bringing her boyfriend into the private room.
After seeing Yalini leave, Jennifer let go of Connor’s hand and said with a pout, “This Yalini is really annoying. She likes to compare herself with me in literally every aspect. If it wasn’t for my friend, I wouldn’t have bothered to attend such a gathering…”
“You get used to it…” Connor said calmly.
“Get used to it?”
When Jennifer heard Connor’s words, she could not help but be stunned for a moment. The expression on her face was obviously a little puzzled.
Connor did not explain much to Jennifer. She might not know that he might have experienced more things than her, so he was already used to such a situation. He didn’t care about what others said.
Now, the scheming between ordinary people was really too ridiculous in Connor’s eyes. If he had the time to fight such unimportant battles, he might as well use that time to improve himself.
“Let’s go in, too!”
Jennifer said softly when she saw that he did not say anything.
“Alright…”
Connor nodded and followed Jennifer to the private room.
At this moment, there were already many people in the private room, and most of them were famous rich heirs in Dexas.
Jennifer’s family was very well-off, so the worst friends around Jennifer were corporate executives. Ordinary people had no way of integrating into this circle.
When everyone saw Jennifer enter, they surrounded her.
However, Yalini was very dissatisfied when she saw this scene because Jennifer had been more popular than her since she was young. She really could not understand why those people liked to curry favor with Jennifer so much.
“Long time no see, Lady Goodwin. You’re really getting more and more beautiful…”
“Yeah, Lady Goodwin, you said you’ve been back for a while, right? Why didn’t they contact us?”
“The great Lady Goodwin might have forgotten about us a long time ago, right?”
Everyone surrounded Jennifer.
“How could I forget about you? I haven’t been back in Oprana for long and haven’t adapted to it yet, so I haven’t had time to contact you.”
Jennifer hurriedly explained with a smile.
At this moment, a girl called out, “Why would the great Lady Goodwin have the time to contact you? She should be busy dating, right?”
“Lady Goodwin, you have a boyfriend?”
Many of the rich heirs present had a crush on Jennifer, so when they heard this, their expressions instantly changed and they all turned their attention to Connor.
However, what puzzled everyone was that Connor, who was standing beside her, wasn’t particularly good-looking. Moreover, he did not look like a rich person from his clothes. At most, he was an ordinary handsome man.
They really could not understand how Connor could get Jennifer’s favor.
“Jennifer, is this your friend? Why didn’t you introduce him to everyone?”
At this moment, a tall boy walked up to Jennifer and asked her in a low voice.
Jennifer turned to look at Connor and whispered to him, “This person’s name is Walton Morales. He’s the son of the deputy mayor of Dexas. His family has some power…”
“Oh, okay!”
Connor nodded slightly. He did not say anything; after all, the son of a deputy mayor was nothing to Connor.
“Mr. Morales, this is my friend Connor!” Jennifer introduced.
“Friend?”
When Walton heard this, he couldn’t help but smile and ask softly, “Are you just friends? Or boyfriend and girlfriend?”
“We’re just ordinary friends…” Jennifer hurriedly replied and continued, “Connor and I have known each other since we were very young…”
Walton sized up Connor and asked him provocatively. “What are you doing now, Mr. McDonald?”
“I’m still studying at Porthampton University!” Connor lightly replied.
Not far away, when Yalini heard the word “Porthampton,” a strange expression flashed across her face again. She subconsciously bit her lip.
“He’s still a student!”
Walton laughed disdainfully and continued, “You don’t look young anymore. If you can’t find a job after graduation, you can ask Jennifer to contact me. I know a few friends in Porthampton, so I can help you find a better job when the time comes…”
Although Walton said this very casually, everyone could feel that Walton was obviously humiliating Connor.
Jennifer’s eyes couldn’t help but flash with a strange look. After all, she had personally seen Connor break Holden Marcus’s legs that day. Walton was nothing when compared to Holden, let alone Connor.
She was worried that Connor might get angry. If he did, then things might be troublesome.
“Sure, I’ll contact you after I graduate!”
However, Jennifer did not expect Connor to not be angry at all. Instead, he replied very calmly.
Connor simply wasn’t in the mood to argue with someone like Walton. As long as Walton didn’t go too far or push Connor past his limit, Connor wouldn’t argue with him.
Jennifer subconsciously turned her head to look at Connor with a very surprised expression.
She did not expect Connor to be so easy to talk to. At this moment, Connor was like a different person from the Connor at the Marcus family’s wedding banquet.
On the other hand, Walton was speechless. He felt that Connor in front of him didn’t seem to understand his words and had taken his mockery seriously.
At this moment, Walton gave up on mocking Connor. In his eyes, Connor was not worth mocking.

chapters.title: Chapter 1015: Travio Corporation
chapters.content:
Chapter 1015: Travio Corporation
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Perhaps it was because Connor had given in, so the following gathering was relatively smooth.
Everyone ate and chatted. Everyone felt that Connor and Jennifer were just ordinary friends. No one saw Connor as their rival in love.
However, just when Connor thought that the party would end soon, Yalini’s boyfriend, Julian Haddon, suddenly raised his glass and said to Connor with a faint smile, “Connor, since it’s our first time meeting, do you want to have a drink?”
Connor hesitated for a moment, then smiled and said, “Alright, let’s drink!”
After saying this, Connor picked up his wine glass and took a sip.
The others present also took the initiative to persuade Connor to drink.
After seeing so many people toast Connor, Jennifer could not help but worry about him.
However, because Connor had taken the Essence Cultivating Pill, his body had already undergone earth-shattering changes. Therefore, this little bit of wine had no effect on Connor at all, and he could down alcohol as easily as drinking water. In less than ten minutes, all the boys present could not hold on.
Even Walton, who could drink a lot, looked at Connor with a very different expression. He couldn’t help but say, “Connor is really good at drinking!”
“That’s right. Connor can drink too much. How impressive…”
The other boys followed suit in praising Connor.
However, Julian looked a little embarrassed. He had planned to embarrass Connor by forcing him to drink, but he didn’t expect Connor to have such a high tolerance to alcohol. If he continued to drink, Connor might not be the one who would be embarrassed.
Therefore, Julian gave up on drinking with Connor.
After everyone finished drinking, they began to chat again. However, the content of the conversation was basically flattery.
Of course, the most powerful person in the room was still Walton. He was the son of the mayor, and his family had a listed company. Even putting aside his personal skills, Walton would definitely be able to kill everyone present.
Everyone was already familiar with Walton’s identity. Walton and his old friends were too lazy to show off these things, so discussion instead turned to the topic of Yalini’s husband.
At this moment, a seductively dressed woman asked, “Yalini, I heard that your husband is a department manager of a listed company in Newtown. Is that true?”
After hearing the woman’s words, Connor raised his head and glanced at Julian.
He didn’t expect Yalini’s boyfriend to be working in Newtown. At this time, Connor was investigating his own matter in Newtown, so he was naturally curious.
The woman who spoke had the best relationship with Yalini, so her words were obviously giving Yalini a chance to show off.
Yalini smiled knowingly. She naturally would not let go of such a good opportunity. She said, “That’s right. My husband is now working at Travio Corporation. He’s the general manager of the finance department!”
After Yalini said that, everybody looked at Julian in surprise.
Julian looked calm.
“Julian, you work at Travio Corporation?”
Walton asked in a low voice, surprised.
“That’s right!” Julian nodded slightly.
“I heard that Travio Corporation is one of the top 500 companies in the world. To be able to work in such a company and be the general manager of the finance department, you definitely have a bright future!” Walton chuckled.
“Yeah, Travio Corporation is involved in a lot of industries now. I didn’t expect Yalini’s boyfriend to be so powerful…”
“Not just anyone can be the general manager of the finance department. I reckon that in a few more years, he can be promoted to the vice president of the group, right?”
Everyone began to discuss among themselves.
At this moment, the way they looked at Julian had also undergone a great change.
First of all, it was not easy to enter the Travio Corporation. Even if you had money, you might not be able to enter.
The scale of Travio Corporation was even larger than Connor’s Empire World Corporation. Although the strength of the two groups was naturally on par, Travio Corporation was a multinational corporation, so it was more famous. Meanwhile, the Empire World Corporation had always been very low-key and only operated only around the Davenport area, so its influence was not as good as the Travio Corporation.
Julian was only about 30 years old. He was able to reach his current position at such a young age and was also the manager of the finance department. He was indeed worthy of everyone’s admiration.
After Yalini heard what everyone said, she was naturally very happy because she could finally lord over Jennifer.
“Isn’t he just a small finance manager? What’s there to show off…”
Jennifer said with a pout.
“Haha…”
Connor smiled faintly when he heard Jennifer’s words and did not say anything else.
At this moment, a sexy young woman raised her glass and shouted at Julian in a sweet voice, “Julian, let me toast you…”
“Alright…”
Julian hurriedly nodded, then stood up and drank a glass of wine with the beautiful woman.
“Julian, my boyfriend has always wanted to work at Travio Corporation. Can you help me see if there’s a suitable position?”
the beautiful young woman said with a smile after drinking with Julian.
At this moment, the beautiful young woman’s boyfriend was standing beside her. His expression seemed a little awkward, but he did not say anything.
“You’re Yalini’s friend, so of course I’ll do you a favor and take a look. If there’s really a suitable position, I’ll let you know immediately…” Julian said.
“Thank you, then…”
After hearing Julian’s words, the smile on the young woman’s face became even brighter.
After that, the others came over to toast Julian. Some girls even looked like they wanted to kidnap him. Yalini wasn’t angry about this. On the contrary, she was very proud of it, because this was what she wanted to see.
Jennifer, on the other hand, was speechless. She could not understand why a mere finance manager was so important.
At this moment, Walton suddenly asked, “Julian, I heard that something big happened in Travio Corporation some time ago. Have you heard about it?”
Julian was stunned for a second after hearing what Walton said. Then, he narrowed his eyes and said, “Walton, you know about that too?”

chapters.title: Chapter 1016: The New President
chapters.content:
Chapter 1016: The New President
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Hearing the conversation between Julian and Walton, everyone was stunned. They all looked confused.
Walton had told Julian that something big had happened in Travio Corporation, but they hadn’t heard anything about it.
“Our family’s company also has some cooperation with Travio Corporation, but not much, so I know very little. Why don’t you tell us what’s going on, Julian?”
The reason why Walton mentioned it was because he was very curious about it, and he wanted to see if Julian was really working in Travio Corporation.
If Julian really worked in Travio Corporation and held a high position, he would know what he was talking about.
Julian looked at Walton and hesitated for a while, then said slowly, “Actually, I shouldn’t tell outsiders about this, but it’s already in the past. Moreover, you’re all Yalini’s friends, so I’ll tell you…”
“What exactly is it?”
“Yeah, I didn’t hear anything about something happening to Travio Corporation.”
Hearing Julian’s words, the others became more curious and started to discuss in low voices.
“Actually, it’s not a big deal to you guys. It’s just that the president of Travio Corporation has changed. The previous president was sued for embezzling company funds and is still in prison. Then, a new president came out of nowhere…”
Julian said casually.
“Seriously?”
“The president of Travio Corporation has changed?”
Everyone revealed surprised expressions again, as if they were very surprised by this news.
“The Travio Corporation has blocked this news internally, so it’s outsiders don’t know about it. However, this is old news, so there’s nothing wrong with me telling you now…”
Julian looked at them and explained again.
“Looks like the rumors I heard back then were true…”
Walton said in a low voice.
“Hehe, Walton, you’re quite well-informed!”
Julian smiled proudly.
“Julian, I wonder who the new president of Travio Corporation is? How’s your relationship with this president?”
Walton asked with a smile.
“Walton, why do you want to know information about the president?”
Julian paused for a second and asked vigilantly.
“…”
Walton hesitated for a moment, then slowly said, “Julian, since we’re on this topic, I’ll just be frank with you. My family’s company has a project, and we wanted to cooperate with the Travio Corporation, but the previous president didn’t agree to it. Can you introduce us to the new president of your corporation?”
Walton felt that these people were his friends, so he didn’t hide anything.
“Well…”
Julian seemed to be in a dilemma. Frowning, he said blandly, “Walton, it’s not that I don’t want to help you with this matter. The newly appointed president is not someone to be trifled with. His background is very strong, and he’s from the U.S.. He doesn’t care about anyone. If I introduce you to him, I might not be able to keep my job…”
“I can understand that…”
Walton understood the principle of stopping at a certain point, so he hurriedly replied.
“Too bad we didn’t each other before this. If you had known me earlier, I would have discussed it with the old president. Maybe there would have been some hope, but I don’t dare to provoke this new president!”
Julian looked at Walton and added.
“Just now, you said that the new president of Travio Corporation was transferred from the U.S.. Does that mean that he’s American.?”
Since Julian didn’t want to introduce him to the president, Walton had to think of other ways. Therefore, he tried to get some information about the new president of Travio Corporation from Julian.
“No. She’s from Oprana, and she’s a beautiful woman at that. She’s about the same age as us and quite beautiful, but she doesn’t have a good temper. She relied on the support of the head office and fired many people not long after she took office. Now, everyone in our Travio Corporation is in danger!”
Perhaps Julian had drunk a lot just now, so he started complaining while he was still drunk.
“Beauty? She’s about the same age as us?”
Walton seemed to be even more puzzled.
“Yes, she’s quite good-looking…”
Julian nodded slightly.
“Could she be the daughter of one of the shareholders of Travio Corporation’s head office?”
Walton asked curiously.
“Impossible…”
Julian shook his head and continued, “If you say that she’s the mistress of one of the shareholders, I think that’s possible, but it’s definitely not a daughter…”
“How do you know that?”
Seeing that Julian was getting more and more excited, Walton quickly seized the opportunity to ask.
“The new president of Travio Corporation is called Freya Phillips. There are only a few shareholders in the main company, and there’s no one with the surname Phillips. So, she’s definitely not the daughter of one of our shareholders…”
Julian said casually.
Clack!
After hearing Julian’s words, Connor dropped his chopsticks on the ground. He was stunned, and he was in shock.
“I see…”
After finding out the name of the new president of Travio Corporation, Walton had achieved his goal, so he replied with a smile.
Julian seemed to have realized that he had said too much, so he didn’t continue talking about it and was ready to change the topic.
“What did you say the name of the president of Travio Corporation was?”
At this moment, Connor suddenly stood up and asked Julian coldly.
“…”
Julian raised his head and glanced at Connor, then asked Connor with a smile, “Why are you asking about this?”
“Cut the crap. Let me ask you, what’s the name of the new president of Travio Corporation?”
Connor didn’t have the mood to talk nonsense with Julian, so he asked coldly.
“Hey, what are you doing? Is there something wrong with you?”
Seeing that Connor seemed to be acting a bit odd, so she hurriedly stood up and shouted at him.
“Connor, what’s wrong?”
Jennifer also felt that something was wrong. She hurriedly walked to Connor’s side and asked in a low voice.
However, Connor did not seem to hear Jennifer’s words. He asked Julian in a low voice, “Tell me, what’s the name of the president of Travio Corporation?”
…

chapters.title: Chapter 1017: Porthampton's Connor McDonald!
chapters.content:
Chapter 1017: Porthampton’s Connor McDonald!
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
After hearing Connor’s question, Julian looked a little impatient.
He couldn’t help but frown. “What does the name of the president of Travio Corporation have to do with you? Is there something wrong with your head…”
Julian had obviously sobered up, because he knew that the higher-ups had instructed him not to expose the identity of the new president to the public.
Just now, Julian had said a little too much to Walton to show off.
Julian came back to his senses and was prepared to go to the bathroom to calm down.
“Stop!”
When Connor saw that Julian was about to leave, he reached out to stop him and said coldly, “You haven’t answered my question just now…”
“Is there something wrong with you? What does the name of our Travio Corporation’s president have to do with you? Do you know her or something?”
Julian shouted at Connor with his eyes wide open.
Connor glanced at Julian blandly. He knew that Julian might not tell him the truth if he didn’t show his true colors.
Therefore, he grabbed Julian’s arm and said coldly, “I’m not in the mood to waste time with you now. Answer whatever I ask you. If you dare to talk nonsense again, I’ll break your arm right now…”
“Did you f*cking drink too much…”
Julian shouted at the top of his voice.
“Connor, what are you doing? Isn’t this a little too much?”
Seeing that the situation was not quite right, Walton hurriedly stood up and berated Connor.
After all, Julian was the manager of the finance department of Travio Corporation, and he was of great value to Walton. Therefore, Walton was obviously siding with Julian.
However, Connor didn’t pay attention to Walton at all. Instead, he asked Julian expressionlessly, “Hurry up and answer me. What’s the name of the new president of Travio Corporation?”
“Why the f*ck should I tell you? Hurry up and let go of me…”
Julian shouted at the top of his voice.
“I’ve tried to be nice, but you asked for it.”
Connor’s face turned cold. Then, he twisted Julian’s arm hard.
“Ah…”
Julian screamed in pain, and his face turned ugly.
In an instant, everyone was dumbfounded.
No one had expected Connor to be so bold as to break Julian’s arm in front of so many people.
Of course, Connor didn’t use his full strength, so he only dislocated Julian’s arm.
“What are you doing? Are you crazy?”
Yalini couldn’t stand it anymore and rushed toward Connor.
Walton was also furious. He rushed in front of Connor and reached out to tug at Connor’s clothes, shouting, “What are you trying to do? Did you come here to cause trouble?”
Connor turned and coldly looked at Walton, then said in a low voice, “I advise you not to meddle in other people’s business. This matter has nothing to do with you!”
“I’m meddling?”
Walton was somewhat annoyed, and then he said coldly, “I organized this party today, and Julian is my friend. You broke Julian’s arm, and you’re saying that I’m meddling in your business? You’d better let go of Julian now, or I won’t be nice to you!”
“If you want to get involved in this matter, then I advise you to call your father first and ask him if he dares to offend me!”
Connor’s voice was extremely cold as he spoke to Walton.
“Who… Who are you?”
Walton was stunned for a moment and asked Connor in confusion.
“Porthampton’s Connor McDonald!”
Connor said in a low voice.
“Connor McDonald from Porthampton?”
When Walton heard this, he couldn’t help but be stunned for a moment. Then, he revealed a puzzled expression, as if he didn’t know who Connor was.
“You not knowing me is normal. You’ll know when you call your father…”
Connor said lightly.
“Are you Mr. Connor McDonald from Porthampton?”
At this moment, Yalini finally voiced out.
Yalini had a friend who attended Connor’s banquet in Porthampton and secretly took a photo of Connor. Yalini happened to have seen Connor’s photo once.
Therefore, when Yalini saw Connor just now, she felt that he looked familiar. She felt that Connor was a little similar to Mr. McDonald of Porthampton. However, she felt that a big shot like Mr. McDonald would not appear here, so she thought that she was overthinking it.
After that, when Yalini heard that Connor was studying at the Porthampton University, she doubted her guess even more.
It wasn’t until Connor said those words to Walton that Yalini was certain that her guess was correct.
Connor was Mr. Connor McDonald from Porthampton!
“That’s right, I’m Mr. Connor McDonald from Porthampton. If any of you want to meddle in other people’s business today, you can call your family now and ask your elders if they have the guts to offend me!”
Connor said to everyone expressionlessly.
For a moment, everyone present was dumbfounded.
Everyone widened their eyes and looked at Connor in a daze. They were shocked.
No one expected the man Jennifer brought to have such a terrifying identity.
Even Jennifer was in disbelief. Although she knew that Connor might have some background, she did not expect his identity to be so terrifying.
“Connor is Mr. Connor McDonald?”
Jennifer’s big, watery eyes were filled with shock.
And the arrogant Walton was completely dumbfounded. He knew better than anyone how terrifying Porthampton City’s Mr. Connor McDonald was. Their family would never have the guts to offend someone like Connor.
“How do we know if what you said is true?”
Walton shouted at Connor.
“If you think that I’m fake, then you can make your move…”
Connor replied indifferently.
Walton looked at Connor and hesitated for a long time. In the end, he chose to stand where he was and not help.
Because Walton didn’t dare to confirm Connor’s identity at all. He was worried that if Connor was really the young master of Porthampton, he might bring disaster to the Morales Family. It was obviously not worth it to take such a risk just for Julian, whom he had just met, so Walton took out his phone and started to make a call.
The others naturally had the same thoughts. They would not meddle in other people’s business at all.
Jennifer believed Connor, but what she couldn’t understand was why he would suddenly attack Julian.
Also, what was the relationship between Connor and the president of the company?
Why did Connor suddenly become so riled up?
…

chapters.title: Chapter 1018: Broken Heart
chapters.content:
Chapter 1018: Broken Heart
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
After Connor revealed his identity, everyone present was dumbfounded. Their mouths were wide open, and they were extremely shocked.
Connor was not in the mood to entertain these people. Looking at Julian, who was in so much pain that his face was twisted, he said in a low voice, “I have no enmity with you, and I don’t want to treat you like this, so answer whatever I ask you now, do you hear me?”
“Yes…”
Julian had already given in completely. He didn’t dare to say anything else and hurriedly nodded at Connor.
“What’s the name of the president of Travio Corporation?”
Connor asked in a low voice.
“Freya… Freya Phillips…”
Julian stammered.
“How long has she been in your company?”
Connor continued to ask.
“Almost three months!”
Julian recalled for a while and replied.
Connor couldn’t help but take a deep breath. Whether it was the name or the time of her return to Oprana, it matched Freya Phillips. Connor was now sure that the president of Travio Corporation mentioned by Julian was his fiancée, Freya.
However, to be cautious, Connor looked at Julian and continued, “Find me a photo of the president of Travio Corporation now…”
“Uh…”
After hearing Connor’s words, Julian looked troubled.
“Don’t waste time with me!”
Connor scolded coldly.
“I have one in my phone. You can look for it yourself…”
Julian shouted hurriedly.
Without any hesitation, Connor took out the phone from Julian’s clothes. He opened the photo album and saw that there were many photos of girls Julian had secretly taken. One of them happened to be a photo of Freya Phillips in a meeting. Although it was only a side profile, Connor was 100% sure that the person in the photo was her.
For a moment, Connor felt his mind go blank.
He had never expected that he would discover Freya’s whereabouts just because he was here to attend a gathering of Jennifer’s friends.
Connor knew that Freya had not gone missing at all. She just wanted to hide.
However, Connor did not know why Freya was hiding.
Now, Connor could only find Freya to find out why!
Connor threw Julian’s phone to him without thinking, then walked out of the room.
Jennifer hesitated for a moment before she hurriedly followed Connor and ran out of the private room.
After Connor had left, the crowd gathered around Julian and asked him if he was alright.
At this time, Walton finally ended his phone call and looked at the door with his mouth agape. There was endless regret and self-blame in his heart because he now knew that Connor was indeed the young master of Porthampton.
Walton felt that he had missed a great opportunity. If he had known Connor’s identity earlier, he would have kissed up to Connor.
Yalini, on the other hand, looked desperate. She thought that it was already good enough for her to have a boyfriend like Julian, who could completely crush Jennifer.
However, she did not expect that the ordinary person Jennifer brought was actually the legendary Mr. Connor McDonald of Porthampton.
Julian was nothing compared to Connor.
…
On the other side, Connor ran out of the restaurant in a hurry and reached out to flag down a taxi.
However, just as Connor was about to enter the car, Jennifer grabbed him and said to him while panting, “Connor, where are you going? I’ll drive you…”
“To the airport…”
Connor replied without thinking.
He did not have any other thoughts in his mind. He wanted to see Freya as soon as possible. Only then would he be at ease.
He also wanted to find Freya and ask her about everything.
“Alright…”
Jennifer did not ask any more questions and nodded. Then, she led Connor toward the parking lot.
A moment later, Connor and Jennifer got into the car.
Jennifer sized up Connor as she was driving, and then she couldn’t help but ask, “Connor, are you really Mr. McDonald from Porthampton?”
“Yes!”
Connor didn’t have any intention of hiding it and nodded.
“No wonder you are so bold. You actually dared to cause trouble at the Marcus Family’s wedding…”
Jennifer smiled and continued, “I didn’t expect you to have changed so much in just a few years. You’ve actually become the Mr. McDonald who is respected by countless people in the four provinces. You’re really amazing…”
“It’s a little complicated. I’m not in the mood to explain it to you now. I’ll explain it to you when I have the chance in the future!”
Connor knew what Jennifer wanted to say, so he replied in a low voice.
“Then, what’s your relationship with that Freya Phillips?”
Jennifer gathered her courage and asked Connor.
“She’s my girlfriend, but she has disappeared for a long time. I didn’t expect her to be in Newtown…”
Connor replied.
When Jennifer heard Connor’s words, a trace of disappointment flashed across her eyes. Then, she said softly, “I didn’t expect you to have a girlfriend. I thought you were single…”
“She’s my fiancée!”
Connor did not understand what Jennifer meant and added.
“But Connor, if you leave now, what will happen to Wynona and the others? What if the loyd Family finds out that you’ve left and attacks Wynona and the others?”
Jennifer did not want to continue talking about Freya with Connor, so she said to Connor with a worried tone.
“I forgot about Wynona and the others. Let’s go to the hospital first!”
Connor hurriedly said.
Connor was too excited just now, so he did not consider the situation on the Sassman Family’s side at all. Fortunately, Jennifer reminded him.
“Okay!”
Jennifer nodded gently, then changed direction and drove toward the hospital.
About half an hour later, the car stopped at the entrance of the hospital.
“Connor, you should go up by yourself. I will wait for you here…”
Jennifer said softly to Connor.
“Why don’t you go back first? I can go to the airport alone!”
Connor hurriedly said.
“It’s fine. I don’t have anything to do now anyway. I’ll wait for you here. You can give me your ID card, and I’ll book a plane ticket to Newtown for you!”
Jennifer looked at Connor and said.
“Alright, thank you!”
When Connor heard Jennifer’s words, he hurriedly took out his ID card and handed it to Jennifer. Then, he ran into the hospital.
Jennifer sat alone in the car and looked at Connor’s back as he left. She could not help but pout and sigh. “Looks like my heart has been broken…”
…

chapters.title: Chapter 1019: Heading to Newtown
chapters.content:
Chapter 1019: Heading to Newtown
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
After Connor walked into the hospital, he went straight to the ward where Jerico Sassman was.
At this time, everyone in the Sassman Family was accompanying Jerico in the ward. Although Jerico had not woken up, Connor could feel that Hugo Sassman and his wife’s mood seemed to have improved a lot.
Nadine Marcus was sitting in front of the ward. After all, she had been kneeling for half a day, and her legs were already numb.
When Nadine saw Connor appear in the corridor, she seemed to be shocked and quickly got up and knelt down.
Connor wasn’t in the mood to pay attention to Nadine and walked straight into the ward.
“Connor, why are you here?”
When Wynona saw Connor, a trace of surprise flashed across her eyes.
“Wynona, Uncle Hugo, I suddenly have something urgent to attend to. I might have to leave Dexas for a few days…”
Connor said directly.
“You’re leaving?”
Wynona asked in surprise.
“Yes…”
Connor nodded and continued, “But don’t worry. I’ll get someone else to come and settle the matter between your family and the Marcus Family. If Jerico doesn’t wake up in two weeks, I’ll help you get an explanation from the Marcus Family…”
“Connor, you don’t have to worry about this. As long as the Marcus Family does not bother the Sassman Family any longer, I’m already satisfied…”
Hugo hurriedly said to Connor.
“No, there has to be an explanation for Jerico. After I’m done with my matters, I’ll come back to see you!”
Connor said firmly.
Hugo looked at Connor and hesitated for a couple of seconds. He asked Connor in a low voice, “Connor, tell me the truth. Who are you?”
“Uncle Hugo, I’m now the president of the Empire World Corporation. People outside like to call me Mr. McDonald!”
Connor said directly.
“You’re really Mr. McDonald from Porthampton?”
Hugo looked at Connor with excitement. He didn’t expect his guess to be right. Connor was really Mr. McDonald.
“Connor, how did you suddenly become Mr. McDonald?”
Wynona asked with a puzzled expression.
“It’s a long story. I’ll talk to you guys again when I have the chance in the future!”
Connor said helplessly.
“Alright, if you have something to do, go ahead and do it. We’ll talk next time…”
Hugo knew that something important must have happened to Connor. Otherwise, Connor wouldn’t be in such a state, so he quickly nodded and replied.
“Then, I’ll be heading off now. If there’s anything, call me!”
After saying this, Connor turned around and walked out of the ward.
But when Connor passed by Nadine, he suddenly stopped and whispered to her, “Even though I have to leave Dexas, but my people will still be here. So, I advise you not to play any tricks. Otherwise, your Marcus Family will die even more miserably…”
“No, no, I won’t dare…”
Nadine hurriedly shook her head at Connor.
Connor took a deep breath and walked out of the hospital.
After leaving the hospital, Connor got into Jennifer’s car.
“I’ve booked a flight for you to fly to Newtown in two hours, but Newtown is a little far from here. You’ll only arrive tomorrow morning. I also bought you some food just now…”
Jennifer said softly when she saw Connor.
“Thank you!”
Connor looked at the bread on the passenger seat and replied gratefully.
“What are you thanking me for? We’ve known each other for so long. You’re now the young master of Porthampton. I’ll need you to take care of me in the future…”
Jennifer said casually.
“Don’t worry. If you need my help with anything, just say the word…”
Connor was indeed very grateful to Jennifer. After all, if Jennifer had not asked Connor to attend this gathering, Connor might not have known Freya’s whereabouts.
“Alright, I’ll remember what you said. Don’t complain that I’m too troublesome when the time comes!”
Jennifer smiled cutely and continued driving.
Connor took out his phone and dialed Carlos Lane’s number.
When the call went through, Connor told Carlos that he was leaving Dexas. He also told Carlos to take good care of the Sassman Family and to contact him if anything happened in Dexas.
Connor then hung up.
Connor knew that Carlos was a very reliable person, so he did not need to worry about Dexas for the time being.
Now, Connor only needed to go to Newtown to find Freya.
“Connor, how long have you been with your fiancée?”
Jennifer suddenly asked Connor.
“The two of us haven’t been together for long…”
Connor replied in a low voice.
The time he spent with Freya was probably less than a month. After that incident with the Lee Family, Freya left the country.
“You seem to care about her a lot!”
Jennifer continued.
“She is the most important woman in my life!”
Connor replied seriously.
“Oh, I see…”
Jennifer looked at Connor and nodded slightly. She did not say anything else.
Half an hour later, Connor finally arrived at Dexas Airport.
“Goodbye…”
Jennifer sat in the car and waved at Connor.
“I will be back!”
Connor looked at Jennifer and smiled, then turned around and walked into the airport.
After entering the airport, Connor took out his ticket and waited quietly in the lobby.
The waiting time in the hall seemed so long. Every second felt like an hour.
However, when Connor thought about how he would be able to see Freya soon, he couldn’t suppress the excitement in his heart.
However, in addition to this excitement, it was also filled with many complicated emotions.
He had no idea what had happened to Freya.
At this moment, Connor suddenly remembered that he hadn’t told Priscilla Marcus about this.
So, he quickly took out his phone, found Priscilla’s number, and dialed it.
“Hello?”
Priscilla quickly picked up the phone, but her tone sounded a little tired.
“Priscilla, I might have found Freya…”
Connor said.
“Really? Where is she?”
When Priscilla heard Connor’s words, she instantly became excited.
“She should be in Newtown now. We can talk about the details when we meet. I’m going to board the plane soon. I think I’ll be able to reach Newtown tomorrow morning…”
Connor said in a low voice.
“Alright, I’ll go book my plane tickets now. Let’s meet in Newtown!”
When Priscilla knew that Connor had found Freya, she was naturally very happy and hurriedly replied to Connor.
“Okay!”
Connor then hung up.
…

chapters.title: Chapter 1020: An Enthusiastic Beauty
chapters.content:
Chapter 1020: An Enthusiastic Beauty
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
After ending the call with Priscilla, Connor turned off his phone and waited quietly.
Perhaps it was because he was about to meet Freya, Connor felt very complicated.
Perhaps it was because it was late at night, there were not many people in the airport. At this time, the departure hall looked empty.
Connor waited for almost half an hour before he finally heard the airport announcement.
Connor took the ticket to the boarding gate and followed the flight attendant’s instructions to enter the first-class cabin.
Because Jennifer had booked the ticket, Connor did not know that he was in first class.
As Connor had no money last time, he had not been on a plane many times, not to mention the first-class cabin that only rich people could afford.
After entering the first-class cabin, Connor finally understood why rich people liked to spend so much money to sit in the first-class cabin. It was because it was much more comfortable than the economy class. Moreover, there were special flight attendants to serve you, which made people feel very comfortable.
Although Connor could be said to be the richest person in Oprana now, his life hadn’t changed much. His thoughts seemed to be stuck in the past when he had no money.
“Sir, this is your seat!”
The flight attendant in uniform and heavy makeup revealed an alluring smile at Connor and said softly.
“Thank you…”
Connor replied and then walked toward his seat.
At this moment, there were two people sitting opposite Connor. They looked like a young couple. The boy looked a little older than Connor, giving off the feeling of a business elite. He was wearing a well-ironed suit and looked very refined. At this moment, he was playing with his phone and did not realize that Connor had walked over.
The girl next to the man was dressed very fashionably. Her exquisite face was covered by sunglasses. Her long hair fell over her shoulders, and her figure was very tall. Her breasts were extremely attractive, and she was wearing denim shorts. Her slender and fair legs stretched directly to the middle of the aisle, blocking Connor’s way.
After hesitating for a moment, Connor whispered to the girl, “Hello, can you move legs?”
When the girl heard Connor’s words, she slowly raised her head and looked at Connor. Then, she revealed a very sweet smile and said softly, “Alright…”
After saying this, the beauty retracted her long legs.
Connor didn’t think too much about it and walked to his seat and sat down.
After Connor sat down, he began to enjoy the scenery outside the window. The beauty in sunglasses opposite Connor would look at him from time to time. Connor naturally noticed the beauty’s actions, but he didn’t take it to heart.
Soon, the plane began to move.
In fact, Connor had never liked to take a plane. He didn’t like to take a plane because he felt that tickets were too expensive. He didn’t need to waste the money.
Later, Connor did not like to take the plane because he felt that it was not very safe.
Although the accident rate of planes was lower than that of ordinary vehicles, once an accident happened, the chances of survival were very low.
Connor still had a lot of things to do. He did not want to die so soon.
Moreover, those people from Rockefeller were too terrifying. No one was sure if Rockefeller would install a bomb on Connor’s plane. If they really did, Connor would not be able to escape death.
Connor was admiring the scenery outside the window while thinking about what he should say to Freya after seeing her. He also wanted to know what had happened to her and why she had suddenly returned to the country without contacting anyone.
Just as Connor was thinking about these questions, a sweet voice suddenly sounded in his ear, “Hello, handsome!”
When Connor heard this voice, he slowly turned and realized that the person who was talking to him was none other than the beauty in sunglasses opposite him.
At this moment, the beautiful woman’s long legs were exposed to Connor’s line of sight without reservation. They were extremely eye-catching and emitted waves of alluring luster.
When the young man beside the beauty saw that the beauty had taken the initiative to talk to Connor, he seemed to be a little unhappy.
However, he did not say anything and continued to fiddle with his phone.
“Hello!”
Although Connor was not in a good mood and did not want to talk to this beauty, she had taken the initiative to talk to him, so Connor replied softly out of politeness.
“My name is Salma Thompson, and I’m from Newtown. Are you also from Newtown?”
Although Connor’s tone was very cold, the beauty opposite him didn’t seem to care at all. As she spoke, she took off her sunglasses and revealed her beautiful face.
“No, I’m from Porthampton!”
Connor lightly shook his head.
Salma smiled, then moved her head closer to Connor and said with a smile, “Then, why are you going to Newtown? Are you traveling?”
It was obvious that Salma was doing this on purpose. At this moment, her lips were very close to Connor’s ear, and he could even clearly feel the fragrance of her breath.
Connor felt that the beauty opposite him seemed to be a little too enthusiastic toward him. This was obviously a little odd. Connor could not help but become a little vigilant.
“No. I’m going there to do something…”
Connor looked at Salma and replied indifferently.
“Is that so…”
Salma still had no intention of letting Connor go. She nodded lightly and subconsciously moved her body as if she was planning to sit beside Connor.
When Connor saw this scene, he felt helpless because he didn’t know what Salma was going to do. He also didn’t know why Salma was being so enthusiastic. He even suspected that Salma knew his identity. Otherwise, she wouldn’t be so charming toward someone like him.
‘Is it because she quarreled with her boyfriend that she’s so enthusiastic toward me?’
Connor couldn’t help but tur to look at the young man beside Salma as he sighed in his heart.
“Salma!”
Sure enough, at this moment.
The young man finally couldn’t take it anymore and shouted at Salma with a frown.
When Connor saw this scene, he was extremely speechless. He could not help but sigh. He was not going to be someone else’s shield again, right?
…

chapters.title: Chapter 1021: Not a Couple?
chapters.content:
Chapter 1021: Not a Couple?
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Actually, sometimes Connor didn’t know whether his luck was good or bad.
After inheriting Steven’s inheritance, he clearly felt that his luck with women had improved significantly. There were more and more beautiful women appearing around him.
If this had happened before, he would definitely be overjoyed.
But now, he already had Freya, Yelena, and Chloe. Just with these three women, he was already having a hard time dealing with the terrifying psychological pressure.
So he didn’t dare to approach other women anymore, afraid that he wouldn’t be able to control himself and invite more romantic debts.
However, he discovered that the more he tried to control himself, the more beautiful women appeared around him.
Moreover, what made him even more frustrated was that these beautiful women either intended to use him as a shield or wanted him to pretend to be their boyfriend. He was clearly disgusted with this situation.
After hearing the young man’s words, Salma didn’t stop at all. Instead, she directly sat beside Connor.
“Sal, what are you doing sitting there?”
The young man frowned and asked Salma.
“Zayn, where I sit doesn’t concern you. I’ve always told you not to follow me, but you insist on following me. Now that I’m sitting here, do you still have to control it? If you can’t stand it, you should just close your eyes…” she replied in a cold and indifferent tone.
Upon hearing these words, Zayn’s expression became somewhat awkward. He lowered his head without saying anything, but his eyes showed clear displeasure towards Connor.
“Aren’t these two not a couple?”
Connor vaguely felt that something was not right, so he couldn’t help but mutter to himself.
“Oh, by the way, Zayn, we’re not that close. Don’t call me Sal. I’m not used to it!”
At this moment, Salma continued to speak to Zayn.
He took a deep breath, gritted his teeth, and remained silent.
Seeing his silence, A satisfied smile appeared on her face. She turned her head directly to Connor and asked with a bright smile, “Hey handsome, you look young. Are you still studying now?”
“Yeah, I’m still in college…”
Connor nodded lightly.
“Where do you study?”
Salma hurriedly asked.
“Porthampton University!”
Connor answered helplessly.
“Oh, what a coincidence. I’m currently a senior at Newtown University. It would have been great if you were studying at Newtown University…”
Salma’s tone sounded somewhat disappointed.
Connor smiled at her words and didn’t say much.
Salma didn’t mind and continued to chat with Connor. Zayn, who was sitting across from them, could only watch with an angry expression on his face but didn’t dare to say anything.
As Connor was constantly thinking about Freya’s situation, he didn’t have much interest in chatting with Salma. Most of the time, she was the one talking, and he quietly listened, occasionally replying one or two sentences.
During their conversation, Connor learned that Salma and Zayn were actually not a couple.
Zayn had always been pursuing Salma, and with Salma’s family also being very supportive of their relationship, Salma was made extremely annoyed by Zayn.
Originally, she came to Davenport alone to avoid him, but unexpectedly, he still managed to find her. She had no choice but to reluctantly choose to go back.
The reason why she was chatting so warmly with Connor was not because she was interested in him, but because she wanted to provoke Zayn and make him give up pursuing her sooner.
However, she realized that she had underestimated his tolerance. No matter how intimate she acted with Connor, he showed no signs of anger, which left her speechless.
Time passed quickly…
In the blink of an eye, two hours had passed.
It was now past 2 AM, and she was getting tired of chatting with Connor, so she rested her little head on his shoulder and closed her eyes to take a rest.
He knew that she was intentionally doing this, and although he felt helpless, he didn’t refuse her.
Zayn, on the other hand, seemed extremely angry when he looked at Connor, but he didn’t dare to get angry because he knew that if he did, Salma would have an excuse to get rid of him.
“Sal is my woman. She’s just trying to provoke me by doing this. You’d better know your boundaries, otherwise, I’ll make you suffer…”
Zayn whispered a threat to Connor after seeing that Salma had fallen asleep.
Connor, however, just smiled faintly and completely ignored his words, continuing to look out the window at the scenery.
Zayn didn’t expect that he would dare to ignore him. A trace of cruelty flashed in his eyes, but he soon closed his eyes to rest.
In the blink of an eye, three hours had passed.
The sky was finally starting to brighten up. Connor checked the time and realized it was almost 6 AM. He estimated that there was less than half an hour left before they could reach Newtown. Connor’s excitement began to rise.
At this moment, Salma also woke up, then she gently stretched and yawned, and her ample bosom looked exceptionally enticing due to the angle.
With sleepy eyes, she rubbed her eyes and turned her head to glance at Connor. She noticed that he seemed to have been awake all along, and her expression showed some guilt because she thought he might not have been able to rest because she had been leaning on his shoulder.
“Connor, have you not slept at all?”
Salma asked Connor softly.
“No…”
He shook his head lightly.
Upon hearing his words, her expression seemed even more embarrassed. She quickly apologized, “I’m really sorry. I slept so soundly last night that I forgot I was leaning on your shoulder…”
“It’s okay. Even if you didn’t lean on my shoulder, I still wouldn’t be able to sleep!”
He smiled faintly at her.
Upon hearing Connor’s words, Salma felt that Connor was probably saying that to avoid making her feel embarrassed, so her fondness for him instantly increased.
A few minutes later, Connor could feel that the plane had begun its descent, indicating that they would soon arrive in Newtown.

chapters.title: Chapter 1022: Meeting up with Priscilla
chapters.content:
Chapter 1022: Meeting up with Priscilla
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
The plane taxied for some time and finally landed smoothly.
The passengers in their seats began to gather their belongings and prepare to disembark.
Since Connor, Salma, and others were in the first-class cabin, they were the first to leave the plane.
After arriving on the ground, they were then taken to the airport lobby by a private car.
After a series of commotion, Connor, Salma, and Zayn finally arrived at the airport exit.
“Connor, my home is in Newtown. Shall we exchange contact information? If you encounter any trouble in Newtown in the future, feel free to call me…”
Salma said warmly to Connor.
“Okay…”
He nodded gently and took out his phone to exchange contact information with her.
After exchanging contact information, she reluctantly left.
Connor saw Salma and Zayn get into a Rolls-Royce with the license plate ending in four sixes, indicating that Salma’s family must be very wealthy. Otherwise, they wouldn’t have such a luxury car for transportation.
Once they got in the car, Zayn instinctively turned his head and glanced at Connor, whispering, “Sal, I think you shouldn’t get too close to this ordinary person. I don’t think he’s a good person!”
“What’s wrong with an ordinary person?”
She couldn’t help but give him a disdainful look and continued, “In front of me, aren’t you also an ordinary person? The Fergerson family is just a small family. What do you have to be proud of? Are ordinary people not worthy of being friends? Can’t I be friends with ordinary people?”
Zayn was rendered speechless by Salma’s words and didn’t know how to respond.
Salma was right. There was indeed a huge difference in power between the Fergerson fmaily and the Thompson family. That’s why he was so determined to pursue her, despite her numerous rejections. He knew that if he could really win over a girl like Salma, it would bring immense benefits to his own family.
“Zayn, don’t think I don’t know what you’re thinking. I think Connor is quite good. Although he doesn’t talk much, he’s reliable and much better than you. So you’d better behave…”
Salma turned her head, glanced at Zayn, and continued speaking.
“Sal, you’re misunderstanding me!” he hurriedly said with insincerity.
“Misunderstanding? Do you know why I exchanged numbers with Connor just now?”
He was taken aback by her words and remained silent for a moment.
“I did it because I was worried you would harm Connor. If you dare to lay a hand on him, I will immediately tell my grandfather about what happened between us…”
Salma continued.
“Zayn, you really think too much!”
He never expected that she would consider everything so comprehensively.
Meanwhile, she looked at him with a speechless expression. She couldn’t understand why her grandfather liked Zayn, a hypocritical gentleman. If it weren’t for her grandfather, she would have long gotten rid of him and wouldn’t need to resort to such tricks to strike up a conversation with Connor!
..
On the other side, Connor, after seeing them leave, didn’t choose to leave the airport immediately. Instead, he squinted his eyes and looked at the tall buildings of Newtown.
The economic development of Newtown was on par with Porthampton, or even surpassed it. There were even more wealthy people in Newtown than in Porthampton.
Although it was only six o’clock in the morning, the area in front of the airport was already bustling with heavy traffic and bustling crowds, creating a lively scene.
At this moment, Connor realized that if he wanted to investigate the cause of his parents’ death, he must first find Percy, the person in charge of Rockefeller in Newtown, and then obtain Yaakov’s information.
Coincidentally, Freya was also in Newtown at the moment, and Connor felt that everything was just too coincidental.
He even started to think that this might not be just a coincidence.
He couldn’t help but take a deep breath and took out his phone, dialing Priscilla’s number.
“Ring…”
After two rings, Priscilla answered the call.
“I’ve arrived in Newtown. How much longer do you need?”
Connor asked directly.
“I just got off the plane. Wait for me, I’ll be there soon…”
Priscilla replied.
“Okay…”
Connor nodded and hung up the phone directly.
He waited for nearly ten minutes before he saw her, dressed in a cool outfit, coming out of the airport with a Hermes suitcase.
Priscilla’s attire today is still very attractive. She was wearing a black hip-hugging skirt, light makeup on her face, exuding nobility and sexiness. She looked both sexy and a bit aloof.
When people saw Priscilla coming out, they turned their heads to look at her.
Her pretty face showed a trace of exhaustion, probably because she didn’t rest last night.
“Priscilla…”
Connor waved to her.
Upon seeing him, she quickly walked towards him, dragging her suitcase.
Connor took the initiative to take the suitcase and said softly, “You brought clothes with you?”
“I don’t know how long it will take to find Feier in Newtown, so I brought some clothes and cosmetics…”
Priscilla explained in a low voice.
After all, Priscilla was a girl, and girls, unlike boys, always carry spare clothes and cosmetics wherever they go.
“Let’s go find Freya now, shall we?”
Connor didn’t feel like chatting with Priscilla at the moment and said directly.
“Do you already know where she is?”
Priscilla asked with surprise when she looked at Connor’s expression.
“More or less!”
Connor nodded, then hailed a taxi and said to Priscilla, “Let’s get in the car first. I’ll tell you what’s going on later on the way!”
Priscilla looked at Connor in a daze for a moment, then nodded and said, “Okay!”
A few minutes later, Connor and Priscilla got into the taxi.
“Driver, go to Travio Corporation Headquarters!”
Connor said softly to the taxi driver.
“Okay…”
The taxi driver smiled and replied, then drove straight ahead.

chapters.title: Chapter 1023: I'm Looking for Your Boss
chapters.content:
Chapter 1023: I’m Looking for Your Boss
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Looking across the entire Oprana, Travio Corporation can be considered one of the top conglomerates, and it is well-known in Newtown.
The headquarters of Travio Corporation can be regarded as a landmark in Newtown.
Almost every taxi driver in Newtown knows the location of Travio Corporation headquarters.
Priscilla had also heard of it, so when she heard that Connor wanted to go there, a trace of doubt flashed in her eyes as she asked, “Connor, what are we going to do at Travio Corporation?”
“Freya is now the president of Travio Corporation. I think we can find her at the headquarters!” Connor explained softly.
Upon hearing his words, she instantly froze in place. She stared at Connor with watery eyes, her expression full of incredulity.
“Connor, are you joking with me? Freya is now the president of Travio Corporation?” Priscilla stuttered.
“When I first heard this news, I was just as shocked as you, but now it’s a fact. Freya is indeed the president of Travio Corporation!” Connor replied softly.
“This… What’s going on?” Priscilla looked at Connor, seemingly unable to believe it, furrowing her brows.
After thinking for a moment, he recounted everything that happened last night to her.
After hearing his words, her expression seemed even more shocked.
Because she felt that everything was too out of the world and sounded like a lie.
“Connor, are you mistaken? It should be someone with the same name, right? How could Freya be the president of Travio Corporation?” Priscilla still couldn’t believe it as she questioned Connor.
If it was said that Freya worked at Travio Corporation, she might believe it, but to say that Freya became the president of Travio Corporation was something she couldn’t fathom.
After all, Travio Corporation was one of the top 500 companies in the world and an international enterprise. It was already an extremely difficult task for an ordinary person to enter Travio Corporation, let alone become the CEO of the company.
“The time Freya disappeared coincides with the time the president of Travio Corporation took office. Their names are the same, and they are about the same age. The most important thing is that I saw a photo of the president of Travio Corporation. Although it was just a profile, I can be a hundred percent sure that it’s Freya!” Connor explained in a low voice.
“Well…” Priscilla was momentarily speechless.
“And even if it’s a mistake, it doesn’t matter. We won’t lose anything…” Connor looked at Priscilla and continued.
“Well, that’s true…” Priscilla thought Connor’s words made sense, so she nodded without saying anything else.
“You must be tired from not resting last night, right? Why don’t you go back to the hotel and take a rest for a while…” Connor suggested softly to Priscilla.
“No need, I can’t sleep now…” Priscilla waved her hand and continued, “I thought you didn’t care much about Freya’s disappearance, but it turns out you are even more anxious than me…”
“Freya is my fiancée. How could I not be worried?” Connor said calmly.
“Then have you figured out how to explain your relationship with that influencer Yelena?” Priscilla looked at Connor and asked directly.
“This…”
Connor looked at her, and in an instant, he was dumbfounded. He didn’t know how to answer the question because he hadn’t thought that far ahead.
“I’ve known Freya since we were kids, and I understand her personality very well. She can’t tolerate anything. So, you better sort out your relationship with Yelena first. Otherwise, she will never forgive you!”
Priscilla’s intentions were good. She was afraid that Freya would be heartbroken if she found out about Yelena, so she reminded him at this moment.
“Priscilla, don’t worry. I will handle these things properly!”
“That’s good!”
Priscilla smiled faintly after hearing his words and didn’t say anything more.
A few minutes later, the taxi driver stopped the car in front of the Travio Corporation headquarters building.
After Connor and Priscilla got off the car, they briefly observed the situation of the Travio Corporation building.
Travio Corporation was indeed a large company on par with the Empire World Corporation. The scale of the building was not inferior to that of the Empire World Corporation, and it looked magnificent with people coming and going inside.
Although it was only 8 o’clock in the morning, Travio Corporation’s employees had already arrived for work.
Connor turned his head and glanced at Priscilla, then whispered to her, “Let’s go in!”
“Okay…”
Priscilla nodded at Connor and directly followed him into the building, stepping on her high heels.
The security system was very strict, and almost everyone entering or leaving needed to use an identity card.
Connor and Priscilla didn’t have identity cards, so naturally, they couldn’t get in.
When the receptionist saw them wanting to enter, she hurriedly approached them and asked, “Sir, may I ask what business you have?”
“I’m here to find someone…”
Connor replied casually.
“Sir, may I ask who you want to find? Do you have an appointment?”
The receptionist smiled and asked.
“I’m looking for Travio Corporation’s CEO, Freya, without an appointment!”
Connor answered.
As soon as the receptionist heard that he wanted to see Freya, her expression instantly changed. She quickly said, “Sir, I’m sorry, but if you don’t have an appointment, you can’t meet the CEO. So please make an appointment first and come back when you have one!”
“Do I need an appointment to see my fiancée?”
Connor frowned slightly.
“Fiancée?”
The receptionist’s expression flashed with a hint of surprise when she saw Connor’s face. She thought Connor might be causing trouble, so she said coldly, “Sir, no matter who you are, if you want to see the CEO, you need to make an appointment in advance!”
“Then go tell your boss that Connor is here!”
Connor said impatiently.
“The CEO is not in the company right now…”
The receptionist said calmly.
“Then go find someone in your company who has the authority to make decisions. Tell them that the Chairman of the Empire World Corporation in Porthampton has arrived!”
Connor said helplessly.
“The Chairman of the Empire World Corporation in Porthampton?”
The receptionist was stunned upon hearing Connor’s words.

chapters.title: Chapter 1024: Benson Sharp
chapters.content:
Chapter 1024: Benson Sharp
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
No matter whether it was Empire World Corporation or Travio Corporation, they were both well-known companies in the country.
So even if there was no business relationship between Empire World Corporation and Travio Corporation, the people from Travio Corporation were aware of the existence of Empire World Corporation.
The receptionist’s expression appeared somewhat puzzled after learning Connor’s identity because she couldn’t believe that he could be the chairman of Empire World Corporation.
But she didn’t dare to neglect and quickly said, “Sir, please wait a moment. I will notify the manager right away!”
“Alright!”
Connor nodded gently and then led Freya to the waiting area, where they sat on the sofa and waited.
The receptionist hurried back to the front desk and began making a phone call to the manager.
After waiting for about five minutes, a tall middle-aged man in a suit walked out of the elevator.
The receptionist quickly ran to the middle-aged man and whispered a few words in his ear, occasionally glancing towards Connor’s direction.
The middle-aged man took a deep breath as he looked at Connor. He had seen Connor’s photo, so he could naturally confirm Connor’s identity.
“Mr. Connor, hello!”
The middle-aged man walked confidently towards Connor and greeted him politely.
“Hello!”
Connor turned his head and glanced at the middle-aged man, calmly replying.
“Mr. Connor, I am Benson Sharp, the deputy manager of Travio Corporation. May I ask what brings you here personally?” Benson spoke with a very respectful tone and was extremely cautious.
Because Benson knew how terrifying Connor’s identity was, he couldn’t afford to show any negligence.
“I want to see your CEO, Freya!”
Connor answered directly.
“Well…”
Upon hearing Connor’s words, Benson’s eyes showed a hint of difficulty.
“I am Freya’s fiancé. She has been missing for a long time, and I must see her now!”
Connor had no intention of wasting time with Benson, speaking directly and to the point.
“Mr. Connor, could we talk somewhere else?”
Benson noticed that many people in the company were watching Connor, so he planned to find a place where no one was around.
“Okay!”
Connor nodded and stood up from the sofa.
Benson took the initiative to lead the way, while Priscilla followed closely behind Connor.
After Connor, Benson, and the others had left, the employees in the company began whispering among themselves.
“That person is actually the chairman of Empire World Corporation?”
“Yes, he looks so young…”
“Moreover, he just said he is Freya’s fiancé. Why haven’t I heard that she has a fiancé?”
“He must be pretending. How can the chairman of Empire World Corporation be so young…”
The employees present had not seen his photo, so it was normal for them not to know his true identity.
Meanwhile, Connor and Priscilla followed Benson to an office. Benson courteously poured a cup of tea for Connor and spoke softly, “Mr. Connor, when you mentioned being Freya’s fiancé…”
“That’s right!”
Connor nodded and pointed at Priscilla, saying, “She is Freya’s cousin and can testify for me…”
“I see!”
A strange look flashed across Benson’s eyes, and then he slowly said, “Mr. Connor, as a person of your stature, there’s no need for you to deceive me. Unfortunately, Miss Freya went on a business trip yesterday and is not in the company right now.”
“Business trip?”
Connor exclaimed, then quickly said, “Benson, are you lying to me? How is it that as soon as I arrive, she goes on a business trip?”
“Mr. Connor, please watch your words. Although I’m not from the Four Provinces, who doesn’t know who you are, Mr. Connor? I wouldn’t dare to deceive anyone, especially not you. Miss Freya indeed went on a business trip yesterday. If you don’t believe me, you can go to Miss Freya’s office now and see for yourself. Or you can ask other employees in the company to verify what I’m saying.”
Benson hurriedly explained.
“Then take me to Freya’s office now!”
Connor finally found Freya’s whereabouts with great difficulty, and he was unwilling to leave just like that. So he stood up directly and said to Benson.
“Alright, I’ll take you there now…”
Benson nodded and then led Connor towards Freya’s office.
The style of Travio Corporation was similar to that of Empire World Corporation, and the president’s office was also on the top floor, occupying an entire building.
“Mr. Connor, I don’t have the authority to enter because this is Miss Freya’s office, but you should be able to see that she is indeed not in the company!”
Benson whispered to Connor while standing in front of the window.
“Since you can’t go in, I should be able to go in, right?”
Connor asked Benson.
“You are Miss Freya’s fiancé, of course!”
Benson nodded helplessly.
Connor glanced lightly at Benson and then walked directly into Freya’s office. After hesitating for a moment, Priscilla followed Connor.
Freya’s office looked empty and very desolate.
And at this moment, there was no one inside the office.
“Connor, look!”
At this moment, Priscilla suddenly pointed to a photo on the desk.
Connor was stunned for a moment, then quickly looked at the spot pointed by Priscilla and found a selfie of Freya.
“Could it be that Feier is really the general manager of Travio Corporation? What… What’s going on?”
Priscilla couldn’t help but cover her mouth in astonishment, her expression showing how shocked she was.
When Connor had previously talked to Priscilla about these matters, she couldn’t fully believe it.
Because she thought Freya shouldn’t have any connection with such a large company like Travio Corporation!
But now, after seeing her photo, Priscilla realized that everything he had said was actually true. Freya was indeed the general manager of Travio Corporation!
“Yriscilla, let’s go!”
After finding out that Freya was truly not in the company, Connor’s expression appeared somewhat disappointed.
After hesitating for a moment, she followed him and left Freya’s office together.
“Mr. Connor, you can see that I didn’t deceive you, right? Miss Freya really went on a business trip. If she were in the company, how could I possibly not let you see her!”
After seeing Connor coming out, Benson hurriedly approached with a smile on his face.

chapters.title: Chapter 1025: A New Identity
chapters.content:
Chapter 1025: A New Identity
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Under the Travio Corporation.
“Connor, what are your plans now?” Priscilla turned her head and asked Connor softly.
“I have some other things to take care of in Newtown. I plan to stay there for a while. Once I handle those matters, I will go find Freya,” Connor replied after thinking for a moment.
Many people in Porthampton now knew about his identity, including the students at Porthampton University. He felt that if he continued to stay in Porthampton, he would encounter various troubles. Moreover, with what happened to Freya, he needed to find Percy.
So, he thought it would be a good choice to stay in Newtown for some time.
“Priscilla, don’t you have work to do? Maybe you should go back first, and I’ll let you know once I find Freya!” Connor turned his head and said to Priscilla.
“I took two days off, and I didn’t get much sleep last night. I’m a bit tired now. I’ll rest at the hotel and then go back.” Priscilla said wearily to Connor.
“That’s fine…” Connor nodded and continued, “Priscilla, do you want to eat something?”
“No, I’m not hungry.” She shook her head. She had no appetite at the moment, so she declined his offer.
“Then let’s go straight to the hotel!” He said as he hailed a taxi.
Half an hour later, Connor found a Shangri-La hotel near the Travio Corporation and booked two rooms.
Priscilla had been through a hectic night and was exhausted, so she went straight to bed and fell asleep as soon as she arrived at the hotel.
Connor, on the other hand, lay on the bed, tossing and turning, unable to sleep.
Too many things had happened recently, and his mind was in a state of confusion.
What worried him the most was Freya’s situation. He didn’t know what was going on with her and couldn’t understand why she had secretly returned to the country.
The more he thought, the more troubled he felt. Finally, he got up and walked into the bathroom for a shower.
After the shower, he felt much more awake. He realized that Freya couldn’t come back in a short period, and even if she did, he still needed to stay in Newtown. After all, he hadn’t fully investigated his parents’ matter.
Therefore, he believed that since he had to stay in Newtown, he needed to find an identity for himself.
Because whether he was going to find Freya or get close to the people from Rockefeller, he couldn’t reveal his true identity. If Rockefeller’s people found out that he was in Newtown, it wouldn’t be easy for him to contact Percy and Yaakov
“What identity should I choose?” Connor murmured softly, suddenly remembering Salma, whom he had met on the plane.
“Rachel is so eager to expose my identity just to prevent me from continuing my studies at the school, so she can take over the company quickly…” Connor sighed softly and then smiled, “If she doesn’t want me to study, then I won’t. Anyway, I still need to get my university degree first. Who knows if I’ll still have that money in the future…”
After some contemplation, Connor thought that since he couldn’t continue at Porthampton University, it would be better to transfer to Newtown University directly.
In this way, not only could he continue to study, but he could also find a very suitable identity for himself. He did not have to worry about being discovered by those people in Rockefeller.
With that in mind, Connor sat up directly from the bed and dialed Thomas’s phone number on his mobile phone.
“Ring… ring…”
After two rings, Thomas answered the call.
“Mr. Connor, have you arrived in Newtown now?”
Thomas seemed to have been waiting for his call, so he asked directly after answering the phone.
“Yes, I’m already in Newtown, but I have some things to take care of now. I might not go back to Porthampton for a while. I’ll leave it to you over there!” Connor said softly.
“What’s the hurry?”
After hesitating for a moment, Thomas asked with some confusion.
“My fiancée is in Newtown , and I believe the clues to my parents’ murder should also be in Newtown too!”
Connor didn’t have any defenses against Thomas, so he said directly.
“I understand…”
Thomas nodded slightly and continued, “Since you have something to take care of, you can stay in Newtown with peace of mind. Kyle and I will handle things in Porthampton, so there shouldn’t be any problems!”
“I trust both of you very much!”
Connor replied with a smile and continued, “But now there are a few things I need you to do…”
“Mr. Connor, go ahead!”
Thomas quickly responded.
“The first thing is that I want to transfer to another university. I want to transfer from Porthampton University to Newtown University!”
Connor said slowly.
In fact, transferring universities was a very difficult thing. After all, universities were different from high schools, and each university was essentially independent. While students from the same school could transfer to other majors, transferring to another university was quite rare.
However, this was not a big deal for Thomas. Connor believed that Thomas should be able to handle it.
“Okay, I will contact Porthampton University and Newtown University about it!”
Thomas readily agreed.
“And the second thing is that I need all the information about Travio Corporation. Please try your best to find it for me. I want any information related to Travio Corporation…”
Connor believed that there must be something suspicious about Travio Corporation where Freya was, so he wanted to investigate Travio Corporation first.
“No problem…”
“And also, please arrange an apartment and a car for me. It would be best if they are close to Newtown University. The apartment and the car don’t need to be too luxurious. I can manage on my own!”
After thinking for a moment, Connor added.
“I have noted down all these things you mentioned, Mr. Connor. Do you have any other matters?”
Thomas asked slowly.
“For now, that’s all. If there’s anything else, I’ll contact you later…”
Connor said lightly.
“Alright!”
Thomas agreed and directly hung up the phone.
After hanging up the phone, he let out a long sigh of relief and then closed his eyes to rest.
He hadn’t slept at all throughout the night, so he was clearly tired. After closing his eyes, he fell asleep directly.

chapters.title: Chapter 1026: Priscilla Is From the Marcus Family?
chapters.content:
Chapter 1026: Priscilla Is From the Marcus Family?
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
The next day, at eight o’clock in the morning.
Connor got up on time and went into the bathroom to wash up.
After washing up, Connor took out his phone and dialed Priscilla’s number.
“Priscilla, are you up?”
“I just woke up…”
Priscilla replied in a sleepy tone. It was obvious that she was woken up by Connor’s call.
“Um, you haven’t had breakfast yet, right? Let’s go out and eat something!” Connor said in embarrassment.
“Sure, wait for me. I’ll come out after putting on my makeup…”
Priscilla yawned.
“Alright!”
Connor nodded and hung up.
Connor thought that it wouldn’t take too long for Priscilla to put her makeup on, so he did not stay in his room. Instead, he went to the hotel lobby to wait.
However, Connor waited for half an hour, and Priscilla still hadn’t come down.
At this moment, Connor realized how stupid his decision was.
In the end, he even suspected that she’d fallen asleep again, so he prepared to go upstairs to see what was going on.
However, before Connor could enter the elevator, the tall and sexy Priscilla walked out.
When Priscilla saw Connor, she was very surprised.
“Connor, you’ve already here? I went to your room to look for you just now…”
“I thought you wouldn’t take that long to get ready, so I didn’t stay in the room…”
Connor looked at Priscilla speechlessly.
“I’m sorry, I took a shower…”
Priscilla finally realized what was going on. She hurriedly smiled at Connor and said, “As an apology, I’ll treat you today, okay?”
“Forget it. The money for the meal is nothing to me, but it’s a sum of money to you. I’ll treat you!” Connor replied indifferently.
“That’s true…”
Priscilla smiled, but didn’t say anything.
Connor and Priscilla chatted as they walked out of the hotel. Then, they hailed a taxi and went to a random restaurant in Newtown.
Connor was not very interested in the typical breakfasts served around here, so he opted to go to a noodle store instead.
There were many people in the restaurant. Connor originally planned to go to a private room, but all the private rooms were booked, so he had to sit at a table near a window.
After Priscilla and Connor sat down, they ordered their food before the two of them started chatting.
Actually, Connor and Priscilla hadn’t met many times, so they didn’t know each other very well.
If not for Freya, the two of them might not have had any interactions at all.
The waiter served their food very quickly. In less than five minutes, their food had arrived.
Connor and Priscilla chatted while eating.
“Priscilla, what are you doing now?” Connor asked.
“I’m helping Freya manage her cosmetics company now. I used to work in Memphis…”
Priscilla’s eating posture was very elegant and pleasant to the eye.
“Then is your family from Memphis?”
Connor continued to ask.
“It should be!”
Priscilla nodded and continued, “My mother is from the Phillips Estate, and my father is from Dexas. When I was very young, my father went to Memphis to work. He has also set up a company now. It isn’t big, but the profits are good. When I was young, my parents were busy with the company’s business, so I ended up living in the Phillips Estate before going to Memphis later on…”
“Hold on—Priscilla, did you just say that your father is from Dexas?”
Connor asked Priscilla in surprise.
“Yeah, why?”
Priscilla blinked.
“It’s nothing. My hometown is actually in Dexas…”
