Connor replied softly.
Priscilla’s hometown was in Dexas, and her surname was Marcus. That was why Connor’s reaction was so intense.
He had a vague feeling that Priscilla might be related to the Marcus family in Dexas.
“Your hometown is also in Dexas?” Priscilla shouted in surprise and then continued, “Then, the two of us must’ve been fated to meet. I’ve never been to Dexas because my father left after I was born, and he never came back…”
Connor thought for a moment and asked in a low voice, “Priscilla, do you know Henson Marcus?”
“I don’t really know him, but I’ve heard my father mention that Henson Marcus is my grandfather’s older brother. Logically speaking, I should address him as Uncle Henson…” Priscilla replied casually.
“Uh…”
When Connor heard Priscilla’s words, he was instantly dumbfounded.
He realized that his guess was right. Priscilla was actually related to the Marcus family in Dexas.
However, Connor was glad that Priscilla’s father had not contacted the Marcus family for a long time. If her father had always been involved with the Marcus family, it was impossible for Priscilla not to know about such a huge incident.
But no matter what, Connor felt that since the Marcus family had a relationship with Priscilla, he couldn’t be too ruthless for Priscilla’s sake.
“Connor, do you also know the Marcus family?”
Priscilla asked softly.
“Not really…” Connor gently shook his head and then took the initiative to tell Priscilla about Jerrico.
Priscilla was shocked when she found out what the Marcus family had done. Her face was filled with anger.
“I didn’t expect Nadine to become like this. I’ve seen her a few times when I was young, ” she said in a low voice.
“Priscilla, Jerrico is my very good friend. I took the initiative to tell you about this because I wanted to ask you if you would have any objections if I were to deal with the Marcus family,” Connor said softly.
“…”
After hearing Connor’s words, Priscilla couldn’t help but be stunned for a moment. Then, she said softly, “If you want to deal with the Marcus family, that’s your business. I have nothing to do with them anymore. Moreover, our family has long had no connection with the Marcus family in Dexas…”
“That’s good…”
Connor was relieved to see that Priscilla’s reaction was calm.
“But Connor, I think that although the Marcus family has gone overboard with what they have done to the Sassman family, you’d better not kill them all off…” Priscilla said.
“Why?” Connor asked in confusion.

chapters.title: Chapter 1027: Mr. Thompson
chapters.content:
Chapter 1027: Mr. Thompson
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
“I admit that what the Marcus family did was indeed a little too much. But if you kill them off, then what’s the difference between you and the Marcus family? And when will the cycle of revenge end? I feel that as long as we can help the Sassman family solve the problem, it will be enough!”
Priscilla looked at Connor with a very serious expression and then added, “Of course, I’m not saying this from the Marcus family’s point of view. I’m just saying it from an outsider’s point of view…”
“I understand what you mean!”
Connor nodded lightly and did not continue.
Priscilla saw that Connor didn’t say anything, so she didn’t continue chatting either and instead quietly ate her food.
While eating, Connor could feel that there were many guys in the restaurant staring at Priscilla.
She was dressed very sexily today and was wearing a short black one-piece dress. Her waist was slim, and her legs were slender and fair. She had light makeup on her face, making her look sexy and standoffish.
No matter where she went, such beauty would attract attention, whether wanted or not.
However, Connor could also feel that those men treated him as Priscilla’s boyfriend. Some of them looked envious, while others were puzzled.
Obviously, most people felt that an ordinary person like Connor was not worthy of her.
Connor had never liked to eat with beautiful women because whenever he ate with a beautiful woman, he had to face the strange gazes of strangers.
Sometimes, Connor wondered if he was really that unappealing
Although Connor didn’t dare to say that he was super handsome, he was still very good-looking compared to ordinary people. Surely there was no need for these people to look at him like that, right?
However, after experiencing this kind of thing many times, Connor naturally didn’t care so much. He had been eating seriously.
Half an hour later, Connor and Priscilla were almost done eating. After paying the bill, Connor left the restaurant with Priscilla and prepared to take a taxi back to the hotel.
While Connor and Priscilla were waiting for a taxi, a group of people walked out of the restaurant.
When the young man in the lead saw Priscilla, his expression became a little wretched. He then smiled and asked Priscilla, “Pretty gal, where are you going? Let me drive you there!”
After saying this, the young man took out his car key from his pocket and pressed it gently. A red Ferrari sports car lit up.
“No need, I’ll go back with my friend!”
Priscilla had already encountered this kind of flirting countless times, so she was very relaxed in this situation.
“It’s not easy for you to take a taxi at this hour. You’d better come with me!”
The young man seemed slightly drunk, and he reached out to pull Priscilla along.
Priscilla looked at the young man in front of her with a disgusted expression. She said coldly, “I already said that I’m going back with my friend. Didn’t you hear me?”
“Ooh, you’re quite feisty…”
The young man sneered and shouted at Priscilla, “Do you know who I am?”
“Who you are has nothing to do with me!”
Priscilla replied coldly.
“Tell this woman who I am?”
The young man shouted proudly at the crowd behind him.
“Let me tell you, this is the heir to the Thompson Corporation. If you’re sensible, leave with Mr. Thompson now, or you’ll regret it…”
The people behind Mr. Thompson shouted at Priscilla.
After Priscilla heard these people’s words, her expression became even more disgusted and she subconsciously took two steps back.
“Why are you pretending to be so cold? I’m in a good mood today. As long as you come with me, I can give you anything you want!”
Mr. Thompson shouted at Priscilla drunkenly.
“You’re sick…”
Priscilla’s eyes flashed with disgust. She turned to Connor and said, “Connor, let’s go!”
“Yes!”
Connor nodded lightly and turned around to leave with Priscilla.
When the young man saw that Priscilla was not humoring him at all, his expression became even more agitated. He reached out to grab Priscilla.
However, Connor’s reaction was very fast. He grabbed the young man’s wrist and squeezed it.
“Ah…”
The young man screamed, his face filled with pain as he shouted at Connor, “Ow, ow! Let go of me, quickly!”
“Let me warn you now: I don’t want to waste time with people like you, so quickly take your people and get lost. Otherwise, don’t blame me for being rude to you!” Connor coldly said to the young man.
“You… You let go of me, I’ll go, I’ll go…”
The young man felt as if his arm was about to be torn off. He shouted at Connor with an excited expression.
Connor hesitated for a moment, then let go of the young man’s arm.
The young man knew that Connor should have some skill in martial arts, so he did not dare to continue provoking him. He said with a cold face, “Don’t let me see you again. If I see you again, watch how I deal with you!”
“…”
Connor looked at the young man without saying anything.
After seeing that Connor didn’t say anything, the young man turned to look at his friend, then turned around and ran towards the Ferrari.
After seeing the young man leave, Connor asked, “Priscilla, are you alright?”
“I’m fine…”
Priscilla shook her head and continued, “Thank you so much for what happened just now…”
“There’s no need to be so polite. If it wasn’t because I didn’t want to expose my identity, those guys would have been sent flying by my slap earlier…” Connor said lightly.
Priscilla couldn’t help but laugh when she heard Connor’s words. Then, she said indifferently, “You’re so good at bragging. I believe that you’re rich, but there were so many of them just now. If they really fought, you would definitely be at a disadvantage by yourself…”
“Do you believe that all of them combined aren’t a match for me?” Connor asked.
“Keep bragging. Only a fool would believe you!”
Priscilla was just an ordinary person. She felt that situations in which one person fought against a group of people would only appear on television. Therefore, she would not believe Connor’s words at all.
“If you don’t believe me, then forget it…”
Connor smiled faintly, then reached out to flag down a taxi and walked straight in.

chapters.title: Chapter 1028: The Peninsula Club
chapters.content:
Chapter 1028: The Peninsula Club
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
After returning to the hotel, Connor and Priscilla went back to their rooms to rest.
Although Connor slept last night, he fell asleep again not long after returning to his room.
At 3 pm, Connor sent Priscilla to the airport.
Freya probably wouldn’t be back anytime soon, so Priscilla had nothing to do here alone. Connor felt that it was better to let her go back first.
After Priscilla boarded the plane, Connor walked to the hotel alone.
As he walked through this completely unfamiliar city, he felt that everything was so fresh and unfamiliar.
He thought that this was how he must’ve felt when he first came to Porthampton, except that he had nothing at that time.
But now, Connor already had something that ordinary people would pursue for their entire lives—things difficult to obtain.
Wealth, power, status.
Ordinary people worked hard for their entire lives just for these few things.
However, now that Connor had everything, he felt that he was not as confident as before. Previously, when he had nothing, Connor felt that his life had already fallen to rock bottom, so even if things could get worse, it couldn’t get that bad.
As a result, Connor was fearless at that time. However, Connor might not have the courage to start all over again now because he knew that if he took a wrong step, he might fall into the abyss.
“Ding!”
Just as Connor was about to reach the hotel, his phone suddenly rang.
Connor quickly took out his phone and answered the call. Then, he said softly, “President Morgan, have you settled everything?”
“Mr. McDonald, please don’t call me President Morgan. I’m not used to it!” Thomas said with a smile.
“Isn’t that what everyone calls you? You’re used to others calling you President Morgan, but not me?” Connor said lightly.
“They are them, and you are you!” was the response.
Connor blinked. “…Alright, let’s get down to business first. How’s progress on the thing I asked you to do?”
“There’s some trouble with the transfer…” Thomas answered.
“What trouble did you encounter?”
Connor thought that transferring schools would be a simple matter, but he didn’t think that it would be troublesome.
“Mr. McDonald, if you want to apply for a transfer, it will take a long time to complete the procedures—at least three to four months. I thought it would take too long, so I discussed this with the principal of the Porthampton University and arranged for you to be an exchange student…”
Thomas said slowly.
“Exchange student?”
Connor could not help but be stunned when he heard this.
“That’s right…” Thomas nodded slightly and continued, ” Mr. McDonald, you are still a student of the Porthampton University. However, you can attend classes at Newtown University as an exchange student. You can leave whenever you want. In the end, the graduation certificate you receive will be from Porthampton University. It won’t affect you at all…”
“I didn’t know this was even an option,” Connor said in surprise after hearing Thomas’s words.
“Hehe, of course. There’s nothing in this world that can’t be solved with money. If there’s something that can’t be solved, it might be because you don’t have enough money!” Thomas said with a smile.
“That makes sense…”
Connor nodded and continued to ask, “Then when can I report to Newtown University?”
“The procedures will be done in two days, so you can head over then,” Thomas replied.
“Alright, thank you for your hard work. What about the other two things?”
“I’ve also settled the other two matters. I just called the general manager of the Empire World Corporation’s Newtown branch. He has already booked a private room in the hotel. You can meet him and talk to him about the rest…” Thomas said slowly.
“Alright, then send me the location of the restaurant. I’ll go over and look for him later!”
Connor knew that Empire World Corporation had a lot in common with Rockefeller Consortium. This was probably because both Rockefeller and Empire World Corporation were established by Steven Lee.
The Empire World Corporation had branches all over the country. Different people in charge were responsible for different areas. They did not interfere with each other, but they could cooperate. These people were all managed by Thomas Morgan.
It could be said that in the Empire World Corporation, Thomas was the person standing at the top of the pyramid, but Connor was the owner of this pyramid.
Rockefeller also had a similar management model, but the identity of the people in Rockefeller was usually concealed, while the Empire World Corporation could freely show their faces to the public.
The advantage of Rockefeller’s management model was that once they encountered any trouble, the people above Rockefeller would not be implicated. Therefore, Rockefeller ran some shady businesses all over the world, some even involving firearms.
As for the Empire World Corporation, they could only do some formal business. At most, they could only get in touch with the shadier areas of business
If anything happened to the Empire World Corporation, Connor and Thomas would be greatly impacted.
“By the way, Mr. McDonald, if you encounter any problems in Newtown in the future, you can directly contact the general manager of Newtown. He will help you deal with it!” Thomas added.
“Are you not going to care about me anymore?”
Connor asked with a smile.
“You can order me to do things in Porthampton, but you can look for him for things in Newtown. After all, he is more familiar with the situation in Newtown than I am. Even if you want me to help you, I’d still have to contact him in the end…” Thomas explained.
“Alright, I understand!”
Connor nodded lightly and hung up the phone.
After hanging up the phone, Connor received a message from Thomas.
Then, Connor went to a place called the Peninsula Club based on Thomas’s information.
Connor simply observed the situation outside the Peninsula Club. He could feel that this club was a very formal club. Although there were not many people coming in and out, they were all dressed very well. Connor obviously did not fit in with the others.
At this moment, a waiter walked up to Connor and asked, “May I know what you need?”
Because the Peninsula Club was a membership club, and there were very few members to begin with, the waiter could tell that Connor was not a member at a glance.
“I’m here to look for someone!”
Connor replied softly.

chapters.title: Chapter 1029: The Head is Actually a Woman?
chapters.content:
Chapter 1029: The Head is Actually a Woman?
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
“Looking for someone?”
When the waiter heard Connor’s words, he could not help but be stunned.
“That’s right. We agreed to meet in the Heaven-tier private room…”
Connor said according to the information Thomas had given him.
After the waiter heard Connor’s words, the expression on his face immediately became respectful, and he hurriedly stammered, “Then…Then this way please…”
“Right!”
Connor nodded and then walked into a private room under the guidance of the waiter.
Connor hesitated for a moment before he reached out and gently knocked on the door of the private room.
“Please come in!” a pleasant voice said.
“It’s actually a woman?”
Connor could not help but frown slightly when he heard this voice. The expression on his face seemed to be a little puzzled.
However, Connor did not think too much about it and walked straight into the private room.
After entering, Connor found that there was only one person in the private room, and it was a tall and beautiful woman!
The beauty was dressed in a tight black short dress. Her tall figure looked especially charming when accentuated by the dress. Her slender and fair legs were well-rounded out, and she wore black stockings and a pair of high heels. Her exquisite face and black curly hair were incredibly tempting.
The beauty seemed to know Connor and took the initiative to say to him, “Hello, Mr. McDonald!”
“Are you the person in charge of the Newtown branch?”
Connor frowned and asked with a puzzled expression.
“That’s right, Mr. McDonald. I’m Reena Satchwell, the general manager of the Empire World Corporation’s Newtown Branch!”
The beautiful woman smiled and replied to Connor.
“It really is a woman…”
Connor looked at Reena in front of him and couldn’t help but mutter.
“Mr. McDonald, do you think that women can’t be general managers?”
Reena looked at Connor and joked.
“No, no, I’m a little surprised!”
Connor hurriedly waved his hand.
“Mr. McDonald, I’m really sorry for asking you to come see me on our first meeting…” Reena said.
“It’s alright. There’s no need to be so reserved with me!” Connor smiled warmly and replied indifferently.
“As long as you don’t mind, Mr. McDonald. President Morgan should have told you everything, right? In the future, you can contact me if you need anything in Newtown. I’ll do my best to help…”
Reena continued.
“Alright…”
Connor nodded lightly.
“Mr. McDonald, please take a seat. This is Percy Juve’s information. Please take a look…”
Reena took out a document and handed it to Connor. Connor hesitated for a moment before taking it. Then, he looked at Percy’s information very carefully.
The information on Percy was very complete, but it didn’t seem to be of much help to Connor in getting in touch with the man himself. If Connor wanted to get in touch with Percy, he had to find a suitable opportunity, just like how Connor got in touch with Birdie Schroder.
A few minutes later, Connor slowly put down the documents in his hand and looked up at Reena.
At this moment, Reena seemed to be staring at Connor. The mature aura she gave off was very attractive.
Logically speaking, Connor had seen many beautiful women, but he felt that no woman’s temperament could compare to Reena’s.
Reena’s eyes were very seductive, but this kind of charm was different from the kind of women who frequented romantic places. Her charm was natural, and it was a charm that was inadvertently revealed, not faked.
In this world, there was a type of woman that would look good in anything they wore, and Reena was one such woman.
At this moment, Reena was dressed very prettily. She could be said to be the perfect embodiment of what it meant to be mature and alluring.
Reena’s facial features were unbelievably exquisite. She also had light makeup on her face. She was the kind of woman that you would feel more and more charming the more you looked at her. This was very different from the kind of woman who would look stunning at first glance.
Even though Connor had seen so many beautiful women, he would still admit in his heart that Reena was a rare beauty.
However, Connor wouldn’t fall for Reena, because he didn’t want to do anything to let Freya down.
“Mr. McDonald, what are you looking at?”
Reena asked.
“Nothing, I just think you’re too beautiful!” Connor said lightly.
Reena couldn’t help but be stunned when she heard Connor’s words.
After all, she had heard too many such praises since she was young. However, when she heard Connor’s words, she had a strange feeling in her heart. But she supposed this might have a lot to do with Connor’s identity.
“Mr. McDonald, you’re my boss. This is the first time I’ve seen a boss compliment an employee…”
Although Reena was a little surprised, she still acted very professionally.
“This is not a compliment. I am speaking the truth. I have seen many beautiful women, but I have never seen someone as elegant as you…” Connor said very seriously.
Reena knew that the reason why Connor could say these words so honestly was because he might not have any feelings for her. If he had any feelings for her, he would definitely not be so honest.
“No matter how elegant I am, so what? I’m already thirty years old this year. I can’t compare to those little girls…” Reena said.
Connor looked at her with a surprised expression. She was older than he’d thought..
Reena’s skin was very smooth and delicate, and her face was also very flawless. There was no way to tell that she was a woman in her thirties. Moreover, Reena’s figure was also very well maintained. Her waist was slender, and her red lips were like the red glow of fire. When she walked, her soft waist gently twisted, giving people a very seductive feeling. Moreover, this was not Reena pretending to be flirtatious. This was a very natural display.
“If you didn’t say it, I wouldn’t be able to tell that you’re already thirty years old…”
Connor said with a smile.
“It’s normal that you can’t see it now. You’ll be able to feel it in two years. We women age very quickly…”
Reena said softly.
Connor hesitated for a moment before asking, “Do you have a boyfriend?”

chapters.title: Chapter 1030: Let's Get to Business
chapters.content:
Chapter 1030: Let’s Get to Business
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
“Boyfriend?”
After Reena heard Connor’s words, she couldn’t help but smile charmingly.
She walked gracefully in front of Connor in her high heels and asked Connor in a low voice, “Mr. McDonald, why are you still concerned about my personal problems? If I didn’t have a boyfriend, would you consider pursuing me?”
“Uh…”
After Connor heard Reena’s words, his expression became a little awkward. He hurriedly said, “Um, don’t misunderstand, President Satchwell. I was just asking casually!”
Reena pretended to be disappointed and said softly, “I don’t have a boyfriend yet. I’ve always spent my time on work. I don’t have the chance to find a boyfriend at all…”
“President Satchwell, you’re so pretty. It shouldn’t be difficult for you to find a boyfriend.” Connor said with a smile.
“Of course it’s easy to find a boyfriend, but it’s not easy to find a man as outstanding as you, Mr. McDonald…”
Reena said to Connor with an exceptionally alluring expression.
Connor looked at Reena in front of him with a helpless expression. He suspected that this woman was hinting at something.
Furthermore, Connor knew that a woman of Reena’s level was very different from the girls in school. She wasn’t easy to deal with, so Connor didn’t continue to chat with her.
“President Satchwell, let’s get to business!”
Connor said.
“Mr. McDonald, please continue!”
Reena looked at Connor seriously.
“First of all, this information about Percy Juve. Although the content of the information is very detailed, I don’t need it. I need evidence against him that will allow me to control him. So, your focus should be on investigating Percy Juve,” Connor said in a serious tone.
Although Connor and Reena had spoken as if they were ordinary friends, Connor’s tone now was that of a superior to a subordinate.
Connor had always been grateful to Thomas and Kyle Hayes because he felt that if it weren’t for these two people, he might have lost the qualifications to the inheritance. Therefore, Connor treated Thomas and Kyle like friends and spoke very politely.
But now, when facing Reena, Connor would not act like before.
“Okay, Mr. McDonald, I understand what you mean. I will do as you say!” Reena hurriedly nodded, and the expression on her face clearly became much more serious.
“There’s one more thing I want to tell you. I don’t want anyone to know my identity, so you have to keep it a secret!”
“You mean you don’t want others to know that you’ve already arrived in Newtown?”
Reena was very smart and immediately understood Connor’s true motive.
“That’s right, that’s what I meant!”
Connor nodded slowly.
“Alright, I understand!” Reena agreed.
“Then there’s nothing important to do next. I asked Thomas Morgan to help me prepare a house and a car. How’s the preparations going?” Connor asked.
“The car and house are ready. Mr. McDonald, if you have time now, I can bring you over to take a look…” Reena hurriedly replied.
“Then let’s go!”
Connor didn’t want to continue chatting with Reena in the room, so he stood up and walked out.
After seeing Connor leave so happily, Reena’s eyes flashed with a strange look, and she was secretly surprised.
Since he had left so quickly, it meant that Connor was indeed not interested in her. This made Reena a little curious. She couldn’t understand what kind of man Connor was to not be interested in her at all.
In Reena’s eyes, all men were animals that thought with their lower bodies. In front of her, no man could control himself. Even Thomas Morgan might not be unmoved.
Connor’s behavior made Reena think that he really didn’t have any feelings for her.
…
A few minutes later.
Connor followed Reena out of the Peninsula Club and arrived at a parking lot.
After arriving at the parking lot, Reena walked gracefully to a Mercedes-Benz and said, “Mr. McDonald, this is the car I prepared for you…”
When Connor saw the Mercedes-Benz, a hint of helplessness flashed across his eyes.
Thomas Morgan had told Reena that Connor only needed an ordinary car that was not too flashy. That was why Reena had chosen this Mercedes-Benz.
Although this car was a Mercedes-Benz, it was the cheapest model being sold—the price was around 300,000 dollars. It was not considered a particularly expensive luxury car.
Perhaps in the eyes of someone like Reena, such a car was already very ordinary. If it was any more ordinary, it would be impossible to drive it.
Moreover, Connor’s identity was also a factor. No matter how low-key Connor was, he couldn’t drive a car that cost more than 100,000 dollars, right?
Reena patted the car with her small hand and asked Connor with a smile, “Mr. McDonald, what do you think of this car?”
“The car is quite good…”
Connor’s expression was a little helpless. He couldn’t help but sigh inwardly. If he really drove this car to Newtown University, even if he didn’t expose his identity, he would be treated as a rich kid. After all, if a university student could afford such a car, the family must be very well-off.
“Mr. McDonald, are you not satisfied?”
Reena saw that Connor’s expression was a little off and couldn’t help but ask him softly.
“No, I just feel that this car is a little too expensive…” Connor replied indifferently.
“This car is expensive? It costs less than 300,000…”
Reena exclaimed in surprise.
“300,000 dollars might not be much to us, but to an ordinary person, it is not a small amount…” Connor replied indifferently.
“Then, Mr. McDonald, can I help you find a new car?”
Reena said softly to Connor after a moment of hesitation.
“No need. I’ll settle the car myself. Let’s go and look at the house!”
Connor replied indifferently.
“Alright!”
Reena quickly nodded and took out her car keys to open the door.
Connor didn’t hesitate as he chose to sit in the front passenger seat. Reena, on the other hand, sat in the driver’s seat and started driving.

chapters.title: Chapter 1031: Is This Car Yours?
chapters.content:
Chapter 1031: Is This Car Yours?
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
After seeing the Mercedes-Benz that Reena had chosen for him, Connor didn’t have much hope for the house that Reena had chosen.
He knew that with Reena’s personality, the house was definitely not an ordinary one.
As expected, not long after.
Reena brought Connor to the entrance of a luxurious residential area. She then turned to Connor and said, “Mr. McDonald, we’ve arrived…”
Connor opened the car door and got out to observe the situation in the neighborhood.
The neighborhood was very beautiful, and it was not far from Newtown University, so Connor felt that the houses in this neighborhood should not be cheap.
Connor felt glad that this neighborhood was not a villa area, but an ordinary neighborhood. It was rather reasonable.
“Mr. McDonald, what do you think of this place?”
Reena whispered to Connor.
“It’s pretty good…”
Connor nodded and continued, “Let’s go in and take a look…”
“Okay!”
Reena heaved a sigh of relief seeing that Connor seemed fine with the place. She quickly took out the house key and led him into the neighborhood.
Connor followed Reena to the house. The decoration of the house was very good. It was in the simple style of Northern Europe and was spotless. Whether it was household appliances or daily necessities, everything was complete.
Connor knew that Newtown University would prepare a dormitory for him, but he felt that it was not very convenient to live in the dormitory. Moreover, he had to go out quite often.
Therefore, Connor felt that he needed to have a house outside campus. If there was nothing to do, he could stay in the dormitory. If there were any special circumstances, he could stay outside.
“This house is quite good. Thank you!”
Connor whispered to Reena.
“This is what I should do. You don’t have to thank me…”
Reena hurriedly replied, then took the initiative to say, “Where is your luggage, Mr. McDonald? Do you want me to get someone to move it over for you?”
“No, I didn’t bring any luggage…”
Connor lightly shook his head.
“Alright, then…”
Reena nodded and continued, “Mr. McDonald, do you have any other instructions? If you don’t, then I’ll be heading back now. You can get used to the new place.”
“Alright, then you can go back first. I have your contact information. I’ll call you if I need anything!”
Connor looked at Reena and said.
“Alright!”
Reena agreed and turned around to walk out of the room.
A few minutes later, Reena left the room.
Connor sat on the sofa and let out a long sigh of relief.
No matter what, he now had a place to stay in Newtown.
After resting for a while, Connor observed the environment in the room.
This room was a very standard three-bedroom and one-living room, with a total area of about 100 square meters. Based on the price of houses in Newtown, it should be worth two to three million dollars. It was obviously a waste for Connor to live in such a big house alone.
However, a house was different from a car. A car could be changed at any time.
However, it would be very troublesome and time-consuming to move houses.
In addition, this house was indeed very close to Newtown University, so Connor planned to live here for the time being.
However, Connor felt that it was necessary to change the Mercedes-Benz.
The reason why Connor asked Thomas Morgan to prepare a car was because he had a lot of things to do in Newtown. It would be very inconvenient to take a taxi all the time.
However, Connor still felt that the Mercedes-Benz was a little too ostentatious. He felt that he should change to a more ordinary car.
Thinking of this, Connor picked up his car keys and left the neighborhood, ready to go to the 4S shop to look at cars.
It was Connor’s first time in this neighborhood, so he wasn’t very familiar with the area. He took about ten minutes to find the spot where Reena parked the car.
However, when Connor saw his Mercedes-Benz, he couldn’t help but be stunned. There were several girls surrounding his Mercedes-Benz. Some of the girls were on their phones, and they looked very anxious.
When Connor saw this scene, he was very puzzled.
Although his Mercedes-Benz could be considered a good car and its price was not cheap for ordinary people, it was not a luxury car after all. Moreover, it was very common on the streets. It should not have attracted so much attention!
Moreover, Connor also realized that the people surrounding his car were all beautiful women. All of them were dressed very sexily and beautifully. Any one of them was a goddess-level existence.
Connor felt that something was wrong.
After hesitating for a moment, he walked to his car.
“Who is it? Why is the car parked here?”
When Connor walked closer, he heard what these girls were talking about.
Connor subconsciously looked at his own car and realized that Reena had not paid attention when she parked her car. She had parked her car directly in front of another car. If that was the case, the car inside wasn’t able to drive out.
Moreover, Connor’s Mercedes-Benz was a new car, so there was naturally no contact information on it.
Now that the car inside couldn’t move, the owner must be very anxious.
“So, it’s blocking someone else’s car…”
Connor smiled helplessly, then walked to them and said softly, “I’m sorry, please make way…”
When the beautiful women who were originally surrounding Connor’s car heard him, they all turned to look at Connor.
One of the long-legged beauties asked him with an unhappy expression, “Who are you?”
“I’m the owner of this car…”
Connor pointed at the Mercedes-Benz in front of him and said with an awkward expression.
In an instant, all the beautiful women surrounding the Mercedes-Benz turned to look at Connor.
“This car is actually yours?”
When these beauties heard him, they all rushed toward him and surrounded him.
Being surrounded by so many beauties, Connor instantly felt a little nervous.
Moreover, they were at the entrance of the neighborhood. There were many people there, so there were many people watching the show.

chapters.title: Chapter 1032: Unrelenting
chapters.content:
Chapter 1032: Unrelenting
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
After being surrounded by this group of beauties, Connor felt somewhat helpless.
One of the beautiful women in a short skirt walked up to Connor and asked angrily, “Kid, did you just say that this car is yours?”
“Yeah, why?”
Connor looked at the beauty in front of him and replied helplessly.
“Do you know that your car is blocking my friend’s car?”
The short-skirt beauty shouted.
“That’s right. Why are you so inconsiderate? Why did you park the car here…”
“Do you know how important today is to June? Aren’t you deliberately making things difficult for June by parking your car here?”
The other beauties also began to criticize Connor.
When Connor heard what they said, he seemed to be even more puzzled.
Although it was indeed wrong for Reena to park her car here, these people didn’t have to be so angry, right?
Moreover, Connor had just arrived at this neighborhood and had stayed there for less than two hours. Even if he had caused them to be delayed, what big impact would it have?
“Alright, that’s enough…”
At this moment, a voice rang out from the crowd.
When Connor heard this voice, he subconsciously turned and saw a very beautiful girl.
The girl had light makeup on her face, and her facial features were exquisite and alluring. Her wavy hair fell over her shoulders, revealing her fair and slender neck. She was wearing a white skin-tight short skirt with a black waist band in the middle, which made her slender and soft waist even sexier. She was also wearing a pair of high heels. Her exquisite face matched with her curly black hair, giving off an indescribable temptation.
“June, why aren’t you saying anything? If this person didn’t park his car here today, how would you have missed the interview? We have to teach this person a lesson!”
The beautiful girl in the short skirt who questioned Connor earlier said huffily.
“I’m just unlucky. Forget it. It’s just an interview. If I miss it, so be it. Perhaps this is fate!”
The girl called June had a very calm expression on her face as she said helplessly.
“June, you can’t always be so kind…”
“Yeah, you spent so much effort on this interview, and now you missed it because of this bastard. Why should we let this person go?”
June’s close friends were shouting indignantly.
For a moment, everyone looked at Connor with anger.
Connor was on the verge of a mental breakdown. He had never thought that he would encounter such a thing after just two days in Newtown.
More importantly, this matter had nothing to do with Connor.
Reena was the one who parked the car. Connor had never thought that it would block someone else’s car!
“Bastard, what are you looking at? If you don’t apologize to June today, don’t even think about leaving. I’m telling you…”
The beautiful woman in the short skirt shouted at Connor angrily.
Connor took a deep breath and said in a low voice, “Erm, please calm down. I still don’t know what’s going on…”
“What else could it be…”
The short-skirt beauty opened her mouth to speak.
“Katherine, don’t make a fuss. This really has nothing to do with him. I’m the one who’s unlucky…”
At this moment, June hurriedly reached out and tugged at her friend, as if she did not want her friend to continue speaking.
“If it weren’t for this person blocking your car, how could you have missed the interview? Don’t stop me!”
Katherine, the beauty in a short skirt, replied angrily.
“What exactly is going on? Can you explain it to me…”
Connor also said.
“This is what happened. This is my friend June. The car inside belongs to her!”
The girl pointed at the black sedan that was blocked by Connor’s Mercedes.
“And then?”
Connor asked indifferently.
“June was supposed to go to Travio Corporation for an interview at five o’clock. June has been preparing for this job interview for nearly half a year, but because you blocked her car and there were no taxis nearby, she missed the interview. Now tell me what to do about this matter.”
The short-skirt beauty shouted at Connor.
Connor finally understood what was going on after hearing the words of the beauty in a short skirt.
In fact, the matter was very simple. Connor’s car blocked the beauty’s car, and the beauty had not found a taxi yet. In a hurry, she called her friend over to think of a way. In the end, she still missed the interview.
“I see…”
Connor nodded lightly.
“I’m sorry. You can’t be blamed for everything that happened today. My friends are so riled up because they are anxious.”
At this moment, June took the initiative to apologize to Connor and said helplessly.
“We can’t let this person go. Everything happened because of him!”
However, the beauty in the short skirt was still unwilling to let go and blocked Connor’s way.
Connor knew that he was not entirely to blame for today’s incident. Even if his car had blocked June’s car, they could have taken a taxi or called a taxi online. However, they were just waiting here the whole time. The other party was obviously responsible too.
However, it was meaningless for Connor to say this to them now. If Connor could not give the other party a satisfactory explanation, these people would definitely vent their anger on him.
“Alright, I understand what you mean. To put it simply, my car affected your interview and caused you to miss an opportunity, right?”
Connor looked at the beauty in front of him and asked.
“It’s not like that. This matter…”
June quickly waved her hand.
Meanwhile, the girl in the short skirt reached out and tugged at June. She shouted arrogantly at Connor, “That’s right, that’s what happened. Do you know how rare the interview opportunity for Travio Corporation is? Most people aren’t able to get such an opportunity even if they tried their best!”
“I don’t know how rare it is to get an interview with Travio Corporation…”
Connor shook his head lightly and continued, “But I know that today’s incident happened all because of my car. Then, I’ll give her this car as a gift to make up for her loss today. What do you think?”
…

chapters.title: Chapter 1033: Giving Someone a Car Just Like That!
chapters.content:
Chapter 1033: Giving Someone a Car Just Like That!
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
“You want to give this car to June?”
The beauties who were surrounding Connor were all stunned on the spot after hearing what he said. They were indescribably shocked!
Because they never expected Connor to be so generous!
In fact, they surrounded Connor only because they wanted to talk to him. As long as he apologized properly, this matter would be over.
Although Connor’s car had indeed blocked June’s car, it was hard to tell who was right and who was wrong in such a situation. They couldn’t possibly ask Connor to compensate, right?
However, these people never expected Connor to be so generous. He actually wanted to give the car to June.
“Kid, are you playing with us here?”
The short-skirt beauty shouted at him.
“How am I playing with you?”
Connor replied helplessly.
“You just said that you want to give the car to June. If you’re not playing with us, what are you doing?”
The short skirt beauty shouted.
“I’m not playing with you. What I said is true. Don’t you want me to apologize? I’ll apologize to you now!”
Connor said lightly.
“Is this car yours?”
“That’s right, are you really planning to give it to June?”
“Did you steal this car?”
June’s other friends were also confused. After all, this was the first time they had encountered something like this. Compensating someone with a car just because they blocked their car? Moreover, it was a Mercedes-Benz that cost more than 300,000 dollars. No one would believe this.
Connor didn’t bother to explain to everyone. He threw the Mercedes-Benz car keys to the beauty June and said calmly, “Don’t worry, I didn’t steal this car. If you want to handle the transfer procedures, you can contact me at any time!”
June subconsciously took the car keys to the Mercedes-Benz and looked at Connor in disbelief. She was shocked because she could not believe that he was really planning to give her the car.
In an instant, everyone present fell silent.
Even the people who were watching the show were dumbfounded. They did not know what was going on.
Connor didn’t hesitate and walked forward.
“June, that person really gave you his Mercedes-Benz?”
The short-skirt beauty asked June in disbelief.
“Katherine, I told you not to make a fuss, but you just didn’t listen. Now, things have gotten out of hand.”
June shouted speechlessly before running to Connor.
“I’m really sorry about what happened just now. My friend was just joking with you. She doesn’t mean any harm. Please don’t take it seriously. You should take the car keys back…”
When June caught up to Connor, she said anxiously to him.
Connor glanced at the beauty in front of him. He could feel that this girl was indeed very kind. Moreover, Connor had indeed delayed her today and caused her to miss the interview. In addition, Connor did not intend to take the Mercedes-Benz in the first place, so he gave it to June as compensation.
“Take the car. You don’t have to worry about it. I didn’t want this car in the first place, and don’t worry, the car is mine. When you have time, come to Building No. 2 to look for me.”
Connor said calmly to June.
“Your car is so expensive. How can I accept it?”
When June realized that Connor was not joking, she became even more anxious.
“Isn’t this interview very important to you? Moreover, it’s an interview at Travio Corporation. You should have put in a lot of effort, right? This compensation shouldn’t be much. You should just accept it!”
Connor looked at June and continued.
“But…”
June opened her mouth to speak.
“Alright, there’s no need for so many buts. Since I’ve already said that I’m giving this car to you, I’ll definitely give it to you.”
Connor interrupted June and hailed a taxi.
Perhaps it was because Connor was lucky, he had just walked to the side of the road, and he was already able to hail a taxi. June waited at the entrance of the neighborhood for a full hour but did not see a single taxi.
June stood rooted to the ground, her eyes glazed over as she watched Connor get into the taxi. She was still very confused.
Because she felt that what she had just experienced was like a dream. Everything seemed so unreal.
“Young man, where are you going?”
After Connor got into the taxi, the taxi driver turned and looked at Connor, asking with a smile.
“Please take me to the nearest 4S shop.”
Connor replied indifferently.
“Young man, there are many 4S shops nearby. If you want to buy a car, you can tell me what brand you want to buy first.”
The taxi driver said with a smile.
“It doesn’t matter what brand it is. The most important thing is that the car has to be affordable…”
Connor said lightly.
“Oh, I understand what you mean. This is the first time I’ve seen someone buy a car this way…”
The taxi driver smiled and started the car.
Meanwhile, June stood where she was and watched Connor leave in the taxi. She was speechless and could only turn around and return to the Mercedes-Benz.
When June’s friends saw that she had returned, they all gathered around her.
“June, did that person really give you the car?”
The beauty in the short skirt asked June softly.
“I wanted to return the car keys to him, but he just didn’t want them. He’s already left in a taxi…”
June replied helplessly.
“Really? This is a Mercedes-Benz, but this person was actually so generous. He gave the Mercedes-Benz to you just like that?”
The beauty in the short skirt shouted in disbelief, then turned to June and said, “June, your luck is too good. Although you lost the chance to interview, if this person really gave you the car, you’re not at a loss!”
“Yeah, this is a Mercedes-Benz. It should cost at least a few hundred thousand!”
“June, it seems like today is really a blessing in disguise for you to encounter such a good thing!”
June’s friends were also envious. After all, they had never even heard of such a thing before, let alone run into it.
“I’m not certain if this car is his…”
At this moment, the beauty in the short skirt suddenly exclaimed.

chapters.title: Chapter 1034: I Want This One!
chapters.content:
Chapter 1034: I Want This One!
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
“That’s right. That person gave it so easily just now. Who knows if he stole the car?”
“Maybe this car key is fake. He’s playing with us!”
“I also think it should be fake. I don’t believe that someone would be so rich to give away a car that costs hundreds of thousands just like that!”
The short skirt beauty’s words triggered everyone to react.
“June, hurry up and try it. See if this car key is real!”
The short skirt beauty was curious whether Connor had really given the Mercedes-Benz to June, so she shouted anxiously.
“I don’t plan to take this car. So what if it’s real or not?”
June was only thinking about how to return the car to Connor, so whether the car was real or not was not that important to her.
“Even if you don’t want this car, there’s no harm trying to see if this car key is real, right?”
As she spoke, she snatched the car keys from June’s hands and pressed the button gently.
Beep, beep!
The Mercedes-Benz’s headlights instantly lit up.
For a moment, everyone present was stunned. They all looked at the Mercedes-Benz in a daze.
Initially, they all thought that Connor had given June a fake car key, which was why he was so straightforward. However, no one expected the car key to be real!
“June, you’ve hit the jackpot. How are you going to thank me?”
The short-skirt beauty asked June excitedly.
“What are you thanking me for? I already said that I won’t take this car. I can’t accept this car for no reason…”
June snatched the car keys from the woman in the short skirt. Meanwhile, June’s friends gathered around the Mercedes-Benz, sizing up the interior of the car curiously.
They really couldn’t understand how rich a person could be so generous to give away a Mercedes-Benz without even blinking.
June stood where she was with a curious expression on her face. She was curious about who Connor was.
…
On the other side, after Connor left the neighborhood, he took a taxi to a Toyota 4S store.
After entering the 4S shop, Connor saw that there were a lot of people who were here to look at cars. Moreover, Connor was relatively young, so it was obvious that he was not the kind of person who was here to buy a car. Therefore, the sales staff did not take the initiative to welcome Connor.
Connor didn’t know much about cars, so he walked to the front desk and asked softly, “Hello, do you have any sales staff who is available? I want to buy a car…”
“Um, wait a minute. I’ll get you a salesperson!”
The beautiful receptionist spoke to Connor in a polite tone. After replying softly, she took out the walkie-talkie and shouted twice.
However, because it was the weekend, there were many people here, so no one responded for a long time.
After hesitating for a moment, the receptionist said softly to Connor, “Sir, the salespeople in our shop are busy right now. Why don’t I bring you over to take a look? I can give you a brief introduction first…”
“Alright!”
Connor nodded.
“Sir, may I ask what price range you’re looking at?”
The receptionist asked Connor with a smile.
“About a hundred thousand dollars. The more ordinary the better…”
Connor lightly replied.
“Then, what do you think of this car?”
The receptionist walked to a Toyota and asked softly.
“It’s alright…”
Connor nodded.
“Then let me give you a brief introduction of this car. This car is a Toyota Corolla model. It was just released in November this year. Whether it’s in terms of appearance, configuration, or power, it’s much better than the old Corolla…”
“Do you have a car available now?”
Connor interrupted the introduction of the beautiful receptionist.
“Now?”
The receptionist was stunned.
“Yes, if I pay now, can I drive the car away?”
Connor asked.
“Let me check for you…”
After hesitating for a moment, the receptionist quickly took out her phone to check. Then, she looked at Connor and said, “Sir, this car is available now. Are you planning to…”
“How much is it?”
Connor asked indifferently.
“If you’re taking everything as is, it’s one hundred twenty thousand dollars…”
The beautiful receptionist said in confusion.
“Alright, take my card!”
Connor did not hesitate at all. He took out his bank card and handed it to the beautiful receptionist.
“Sir, don’t… don’t you want to try this car?”
For a moment, the beautiful receptionist was completely dumbfounded. She stammered as she asked Connor.
She had never thought that she would meet such a customer. Anyone who came here to buy a car would compare them and try them out first.
No matter how rich they were, they would bargain with the salesperson.
However, there were too few customers like Connor who asked for the price and then wanted to buy the car just like that. Even if there were, they were really rich people. The luxury cars they bought were all those that cost millions.
However, Connor bought an ordinary family car.
“There’s no need to try it. It’s fine as long as I can drive it!”
A hundred thousand twenty dollars was nothing to Connor, so he did not want to waste time.
“Then, do you want to look at other cars?”
The receptionist looked at Connor and continued to ask.
“No, I want this one!”
Connor waved at the beautiful receptionist.
After hesitating for a moment, the receptionist walked into the office and found the manager of the 4S shop.
The manager of the 4S shop confirmed with Connor several times before helping Connor with the car purchase procedures.
About an hour later, Connor drove the car out of the 4S shop.
At this time, Connor was very satisfied with this car. After all, this car was very ordinary. Even if it was placed on the street, no one would look at it twice. It was very suitable for Connor’s needs.
To Connor, who was truly rich, it didn’t matter whether it was a car or a house. In fact, it wasn’t that important anymore because he didn’t need to tell others that he had money through these things. On the contrary, Connor didn’t want others to know that he had money.
After a whole day, Connor finally returned home.
After returning home, Connor received a call from Thomas Morgan.
“Mr. McDonald, I’ve already helped you with the transfer procedures. You can just go to Newtown University and report in…”
Thomas whispered.
“Didn’t you say that it would take two days?”
Connor couldn’t help but be stunned when he heard that. He asked in surprise.
“Although the procedures will take two days, you can report in at any time…”
Thomas said with a smile.
“Alright then, thank you!”
Connor simply replied and then hung up.

chapters.title: Chapter 1035: Newtown University
chapters.content:
Chapter 1035: Newtown University
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Connor had nothing to do in Newtown City. Freya Phillips had not returned, and there was no news from Percy Juve.
Therefore, Connor planned to go to Newtown University to take a look and settle the admission procedures.
Newtown University wasn’t very far from Connor’s home, so he chose to walk there.
After arriving at Newtown University, Connor realize that it looked even bigger than the Porthampton University. It was school time, so he could see all kinds of cars shuttling through the streets of Newtown University campus. Of course, these cars also included some luxury cars.
Newtown University and Porthampton University were two of the top universities in Oprana. Basically, as long as a student could enter such a university, his academic performance would be very good.
However, Newtown University was very different from the Porthampton University.
There were very few students who could enter the Porthampton University through connections. Even if they could enter, they were usually from very powerful families. Under normal circumstances, they would enter by relying on their results.
Therefore, even a student like Fergus Long had outstanding grades.
However, Newtown University was different. Newtown University was a famous aristocratic school. As long as one’s family was rich, one could send their children there. This caused the reputation of Newtown University to gradually widen the gap between Newtown University and the Porthampton University.
Currently, the number of students who got into Newtown University by relying on their background was basically the same as the number of students who got into Newtown University by relying on their results. This also led to the students of Newtown University being divided into two camps, the students from rich families and the students with good results.
Connor looked at the strange yet familiar scenery in the school and couldn’t help but smile. He knew that he was about to start his new life in this school.
According to the information Thomas told Connor yesterday, Connor went directly to the Academic Affairs Office of Newtown University and found the head of program who was in charge of Connor’s year.
This head was called Jonah Crosby. He was about 40 years old and wore a pair of gold-rimmed glasses. He was slightly bald and gave off the same feeling as many heads in schools. He looked a little wretched.
Although Jonah didn’t know Connor’s true identity, he also knew that Connor was a student that wasn’t to be trifled with. Otherwise, he definitely wouldn’t have been able to enter Newtown University so easily.
Therefore, Jonah was very polite to Connor. He took the initiative to introduce Connor to the school. Then, he took Connor around the school and arranged a dormitory for Connor.
Of course, the dormitory that Jonah arranged for Connor was definitely the dormitory of the rich students in the school. It was a four-person dorm with a very good environment. Everyone had their own independent room. However, because it was class time, Connor did not see his roommates.
After arranging the dormitory, Jonah brought Connor to the counselor’s office in charge of Connor’s class.
Connor’s counselor at Newtown University was a man. Connor, who was used to seeing beautiful girls like Rachel Wallace, seemed to be a little uncomfortable with this man as his counselor.
Connor felt that if the counselor was a woman, and a beautiful one at that, it would be very helpful to improve the class’s learning initiative.
However, Connor knew that he wouldn’t stay in Newtown for too long, so he didn’t bother about these things.
The counselor took advantage of the time after class to bring Connor to the classroom.
At this time, the students in the classroom had not left. After entering the classroom, Connor simply observed the environment inside. There were about 50 people in the classroom, half male and half female.
“Um, if I could take up a little of everyone’s time, I’d like to introduce a new student to everyone!”
The counselor slammed the table hard and shouted.
At this moment, the students in the classroom suddenly saw Connor standing on the podium. They all turned their attention to Connor, and some girls started discussing in low voices.
After all, Connor was quite good-looking, so some girls were obviously more interested in him.
“This is Connor McDonald. He is an exchange student from the Porthampton University. In the following period of time, he will be studying with our class.”
The counselor shouted again,
The students in the classroom started clapping.
Connor was very helpless. After saying a few words, he found a seat near the window and sat down.
The students in the classroom seemed to feel that Connor was not easy to get along with, so no one took the initiative to talk to him. He could have some peace.
Soon, the bell rang.
Connor looked at the unfamiliar lecturer and his unfamiliar classmates. In fact, he was still a little uncomfortable in his heart. He could not help but recall that woman, Rachel Wallace.
If it wasn’t for Rachel, Connor wouldn’t even need to come to Newtown University.
However, in this unfamiliar environment, Connor felt that there were many benefits.
At the very least, he could relax a lot because no one knew Connor’s identity. He could do whatever he wanted.
In the blink of an eye, the morning class was finally over.
When Connor heard the bell for the end of class, he stretched his back and was about to leave the classroom.
“Hey, man! Wait up!”
However, just as Connor was about to leave, a voice suddenly came from behind him.
Connor subconsciously looked back and saw three people standing behind him.
One of the guys was handsome and wore a set of branded clothes. He smiled at Connor and said enthusiastically, “Your name is Connor McDonald, right?”
“Yes!”
Connor nodded.
“Um, my name is Justin Spielberg. They are Brooks Hunt and Joel Gibson.”
The handsome boy took the initiative to introduce the two people beside him to Connor.
“Hello, do you need something?”
Connor asked indifferently.
“From now on, the four of us will be in the same dormitory. The counselor told me about your situation just now. We were worried that you might not be familiar with the school, so we just wanted to bring you around campus!”
Justin said to Connor with a smile.
“Yeah, I’m sure it isn’t fun being all alone, right?”
Brooks hurriedly said.
Connor was also a little surprised when he heard what they said. He never thought that his three roommates would take the initiative to look for him, and they were so enthusiastic about it too.

chapters.title: Chapter 1036: Luna Maxwell
chapters.content:
Chapter 1036: Luna Maxwell
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Connor faced the enthusiastic invitation from Justin, Brooks, and Joel, feeling somewhat surprised.
After all, back in Porthampton University, he didn’t receive this kind of treatment.
At that time, almost all the classmates in the class would reject him if they saw him.
Of course, Spencer, Dominic and Eunice were exceptions.
“If you feel inconvenient and want to wander around by yourself…”
Justin continued after seeing Connor’s silence.
“No, today is our first meeting. Let me treat you to a meal!”
After seeing his roommates’ enthusiasm, Connor naturally felt reluctant to refuse, so he invited them proactively.
“This is our territory. How can we let you treat us to a meal? Let me treat you!”
Seeing that Connor appeared indifferent, Justin knew he was being friendly by saying that, so his impression of him improved.
“Yes, since you just arrived today, of course, we should treat you to a meal. Don’t be polite…”
Brooks quickly chimed in.
Connor understood that since these three could live in the same dorm as him, it meant they were all wealthy second-generation students who had money to spend. Connor didn’t say much about it.
A few minutes later, Justin, Brooks, and Joel took Connor to the best restaurant in Newtown University.
The food in this restaurant was very expensive, and even Justin and the others didn’t come here often. They only came today because they wanted to treat Connor.
Justin, Brooks, and Joel were ordinary wealthy second-generation students, with their families having tens of millions of dollars. So, their monthly living expenses were not high, and they couldn’t afford to be as extravagant as Harold and Jovan, who were rich second-generation students.
After a short period of contact, Connor got to know Justin, Brooks, and Joel a little bit.
Justin’s family was involved in the mineral business. It was said that they owned mines in their hometown and had several mining companies.
Of course, having a mine was already impressive for an ordinary person.
But for truly wealthy people, Justin’s family could only be considered ordinary.
Brooks’s family ran a factory that mainly produced auto parts. The factory had a considerable scale, so they had some money.
Although Brooks was a bit chubby, he was the most talkative among them.
The last one, Joel, spoke the least. Connor didn’t know what his family did, but he could sense that Joel was more sophisticated than Justin and Brooks. His demeanor was quite different from that of ordinary wealthy second-generation students, indicating that Joel’s background was definitely not simple.
Since Connor was about the same age as the three of them, they had plenty of common topics, and the four of them quickly hit it off.
He looked at the three people in front of him and felt quite happy. After all, with these three friends, he wouldn’t feel so lonely in Newtown.
While having the meal, Connor didn’t speak much. Most of the time, he listened to Justin and Brooks introducing the situation in their class. These two knew a lot about all the students in the class, including what each student’s family did and even the measurements of the female students. He couldn’t help but wonder how they knew all this information.
The meal quickly came to an end, and while Connor went to the restroom, he discreetly paid the bill.
The meal cost him over four thousand dollars.
Four people had a meal that cost over four thousand dollars. For ordinary students, it might already be a month’s living expenses. The consumption level of this restaurant is indeed astonishing.
Justin originally intended to treat, but upon learning that Connor had secretly paid the bill, he would definitely complain to Connor, but in his heart, his fondness for Connor increased significantly.
Of course, it wasn’t because he treated them.
It was because Justin felt that Connor’s actions represented that he truly considered them as friends.
After finishing their meal, Connor and the other three returned to the classroom to attend class.
Connor chose to sit with Justin and the others.
“Connor, did you see that person?”
Just then, Justin suddenly spoke up and asked Connor.
After hearing Justin’s question, Connor couldn’t help but pause for a moment, then looked up at the boy sitting in front of them.
He was very handsome and had a good physique. Connor could feel that many girls in the class were looking at him with infatuated eyes. Obviously, this boy should be the heartthrob of their class.
“What’s wrong with this boy?”
Connor quietly asked Justin.
“Let me tell you, this boy is called Wyane Jablon. Not only is he good-looking, but he also comes from a wealthy family. And what’s freaking annoying is that this kid is also doing well academically. Half of the girls in our class have a secret crush on him, and the other half are pursuing him…”
Justin said with envy and jealousy.
“That’s impressive!”
Connor faintly smiled upon hearing Justin’s words.
However, he didn’t really care about these things. After all, these students in the class didn’t have much to do with Connor. He came to Newtown for something more important.
“Yeah, Wyane not only comes from a wealthy family but also plays basketball very well. I really wonder how he looks so good…”
Brooks hurriedly added and continued, “If I could be half as handsome as Wyane, I wouldn’t have to worry about finding a girlfriend. Why is life so unfair?”
“Finding a girlfriend shouldn’t be difficult for you. I think you’re better than Wyane!”
Connor comforted him.
“Connor, your skills at comforting people are really poor. I wouldn’t even believe that sentence if I heard it myself…”
Brooks’s expression seemed even more frustrated after hearing Connor’s words.
“Hahaha…”
Justin and Joel laughed heartily at Connor’s comment.
“Connor, look at that girl…”
Just then, Brooks suddenly reached out and pulled Connor.
Connor turned his head to look at the entrance of the classroom once again.
There, a tall and exquisite girl walked in.
She was wearing a Chanel miniskirt, her jet-black hair was tied up high, revealing a charming neck. Her slender and fair legs were exposed in the air, and she was wearing a pair of high heels, looking exceptionally sexy.
“That girl is our class’s beauty, Luna Maxwell…”
Brooks excitedly said to Connor.

chapters.title: Chapter 1037: The Three Beauties
chapters.content:
Chapter 1037: The Three Beauties
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Connor carefully took a look at Luna.
Luna indeed had a good appearance and could be considered a rare beauty.
However, among all the beautiful women that Connor knew, she could only be considered average.
In terms of temperament and figure, she couldn’t be considered top-notch.
So his reaction at this moment was normal. He just said lightly, “She is indeed quite beautiful…”
“I’m telling you, this Luna is extraordinary. Her father is the chairman of the Maxwell Corporation, and they are very wealthy. Moreover, Luna herself is a well-known model in our city. She has appeared in several movies, although they are not big productions. But in the future, she will definitely enter the entertainment industry. We can only look at such a goddess, but never have any other thoughts…”
Brooks continued speaking while looking at Connor.
“I didn’t say I have any thoughts, did I?”
Connor helplessly looked at Brooks and said.
“Oh, I’m just worried that you might act impulsively. Wyane has been pursuing Luna all along. If you dare to have any thoughts about her, you’ll be in big trouble!”
Brooks said with a smile.
“Why would I be in trouble?”
Connor asked curiously.
“Wyane is the class monitor of our class. If you offend him, no one in our class will dare to talk to you, and the girls will definitely dislike you. Think about how you’re going to stay in this class in the future!”
Justin said slowly.
“So that’s how it is!”
Connor nodded lightly as he looked at Justin and didn’t say much.
At this moment, his thoughts were very simple. He came to Newtown University just to hide himself, and he didn’t have any other intentions. As long as no one actively provokes him, he wouldn’t provoke others either.
Moreover, his personality was relatively mild, so he believed that he wouldn’t have any conflicts with people like Wyane.
As for Luna, he wasn’t interested in her at all.
Compared to Freya, let alone Yelena and Chloe, Luna’s temperament and appearance were far from being on the same level. Therefore, he had no thoughts about her at all.
Next, Justin and Brooks continued to introduce other students in the class to Connor, while Joel remained silent and focused on listening to the lecture.
In the blink of an eye, the afternoon passed.
Justin and Brooks basically introduced all the students in the class to Connor.
Connor had a somewhat understanding of the class situation.
“Connor, you treated us to lunch today. I feel a bit guilty about it, so I reserved a private room in the bar next to our school. Let’s go to the bar later!”
By now, Justin had become more familiar with him, and he casually draped his arm around Connor’s shoulder and said.
“A bar?”
Before Connor could speak, Brooks shouted loudly and continued, “Is there any beauty in the bar? Wouldn’t it be boring for us three guys to go to the bar and drink?”
“Oh, you don’t trust my plan? I already asked my girlfriend to invite the girls from their dormitory. They are all beauties, and you guys can enjoy yourselves later!”
Justin said with a grin.
“That’s great…”
Brooks happily exclaimed.
Seeing the enthusiasm of his three roommates, Connor naturally didn’t want to spoil the atmosphere, so he agreed.
Ten minutes later, Justin brought Connor, Brooks, and the others to a bar next to Newtown University.
This bar was called Kevin’s Bar. It was the most famous bar near Newtown University.
Basically, all the students of Newtown University had come to this bar before.
Connor and the others had just arrived at the entrance of the bar when they saw a girl in a short skirt shouting at Justin, “I’m here!”
When he saw the girl, he hurriedly ran to the girl’s side and directly reached out to pull the girl into his arms.
The girl had already met Brooks and Joel before, so there was no need to introduce them.
Therefore, Justin took the initiative to say to the girl,” This is our new roommate, Connor. I formed this party today to welcome him…”
“Hello, my name is Kaira Lindley, Justin’s girlfriend!”
Kaira hurriedly blinked her eyes at Connor and greeted him warmly.
“Hello!”
Connor smiled and replied.
“Kaira, I heard that you brought all the beautiful girls from your dormitory today. Is it true?”
Brook asked Kaira excitedly.
“Of course! Let me tell you, the girls I brought this time are the most beautiful in our class, and they are all my good friends. You guys have to make an effort…”
Kaira said with a smile.
“I knew you were the best, Kaira. Don’t worry, I will definitely make an effort!”
Brook grinned.
“Alright then, my friends are waiting inside. Let’s go in quickly!” she shouted while holding Justin’s hand.
Connor followed Kaira, Justin, and the others into the bar. The interior of the bar was very upscale, and there were many people.
This time, Justin directly reserved a VIP room with a minimum consumption of eight thousand eight. This VIP room was considered the best spot in the entire bar.
Soon, Connor and the others saw the three girls that Kaira had brought.
Kaira wasn’t exaggerating. These three girls she brought were indeed very good-looking, both in appearance and temperament. They had delicate makeup on their faces and were dressed in a fashionable manner.
Among them, one girl was exceptionally beautiful. She wore a black shirt, and her slender and fair neck was exposed in the air. Against the backdrop of the shirt, her fair skin was even more apparent. The fullness and prominence of her chest outlined a captivating curve, as if it could break free from the constraints of her clothes at any moment. She wore a black skirt on the lower half, which wrapped around her well-rounded buttocks, and her long and fair legs were of moderate thickness, making it impossible to forget at first glance.
The other two girls were also considered top-level beauties. If a few more years passed, they could be compared to those female celebrities in the entertainment industry.
After seeing these three girls, Brook almost drooled.
Connor, on the other hand, remained calm. He was already used to seeing beautiful women.
Seeing Brook’s reaction, Kaira couldn’t help but smile faintly and took the initiative to introduce him to these three friends.
The first one was named Ruth Copeland. Compared to the other three girls, Ruth’s appearance might be slightly inferior, but her figure was excellent. Her full chest was extremely tempting, and her voice trembled slightly when she spoke. She would definitely be very alluring to those men who valued physique.
As for the second girl, her name was Sia Jennings. She wore a pair of gold-rimmed glasses and gave off a very gentle and quiet impression.
As for the last girl, she was also the most beautiful among the group. Her name was Sonia Dobson.

chapters.title: Chapter 1038: Connor, Do You Have a Girlfriend?
chapters.content:
Chapter 1038: Connor, Do You Have a Girlfriend?
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Sonia’s temperament was extremely noble and enchanting, and whether it was her figure or appearance, she could be considered top-notch.
Even Justin couldn’t help but be stunned when he saw her. A hint of surprise flickered in his eyes.
He quickly turned his head and whispered to Connor, “Connor, I think Sonia is pretty good. How about I talk to my girlfriend and introduce her to you?”
“Why don’t you introduce her to me?” Brook said somewhat reluctantly.
“Big brother, please take a look in the mirror when you have the time. Do you think someone like Sonia would be interested in you? I think Ruth is more suitable for you…” Justin said with a smile.
Brook paused for a moment after hearing Justin’s words, then asked with a puzzled expression, “Why is Ruth more suitable for me?”
“I think she is easier to handle. Didn’t you say you’ve never had a girlfriend before? You should try someone with a lower difficulty level first. If you go for someone like Sonia right away, aren’t you asking for trouble?” Justin analyzed seriously.
“You have a point!” Brook nodded at Justin.
“By the way, Joel, you take care of Sia. I think you two are a good match…” Justin turned to Joel and said.
Joel seemed genuinely interested in Sia, so he didn’t object.
“Connor, you’re in charge of Sonia. I know she’s not easy to handle, but give it a try!” Justin grinned at Connor.
“I already…” Connor actually wanted to tell Justin that he already had a girlfriend, and he wasn’t interested in Sonia either.
“Sonia already has a boyfriend, and he’s the son of a very powerful big boss. They say her boyfriend’s family has a lot of influence in Newtown. Connor, forget it, don’t get yourself into trouble!” However, at that moment, Kaira suddenly spoke up.
Justin’s expression became speechless when he heard her words. He frowned and said, “Since Sonia already has a boyfriend, why did you bring her here?”
“You told me to bring all the girls from the dormitory, and I called the other two. Sonia is there too, should I not call her?” Kaira said with a pout, looking very annoyed.
Justin looked at Connor with embarrassment, then whispered, “Connor, don’t worry, I’ll help you find someone good next time. You can just leave it like this for now. I didn’t know Sonia already had a boyfriend…”
“It’s okay!” Connor replied calmly.
Since Sonia had a boyfriend, it would be easier for Connor. He didn’t want to be involved with other girls at the moment.
After arranging everything, Justin sat directly next to Ruth, and Joel started chatting with Sia. Connor and Sonia were left alone, so they sat together.
However, Sonia kept her head down and played with her phone, completely ignoring Connor.
Seeing that she was ignoring him, he also took out his phone and started playing.
When she saw his indifference, a hint of surprise flashed in her eyes, followed by a disdainful smile.
She felt that this was just a little trick of his. He pretended to be aloof at first and then would start actively engaging in conversation after a while. Sonia had seen this kind of routine too many times, and she felt that there was no real skill involved.
However, to her surprise, ten minutes passed, and he still didn’t pay attention to her.
She noticed that he hadn’t said a word since entering the bar, and he wasn’t interested in the scantily clad girls inside the bar either. He kept playing a game on his phone.
There weren’t many games on Connor’s phone because he didn’t have much time to play. So he could only play a match-three game. At first, he played smoothly, but unfortunately, Connor wasn’t very skilled, so he ended up spending money to buy power-ups.
This time, he finally experienced the joy of being wealthy. In less than ten minutes, he spent several thousand dollars on this match-three game.
Although Sonia didn’t like Connor and already had a boyfriend, she was still very angry at him for ignoring her.
She thought that he was humiliating her charm.
Since he didn’t initiate a conversation with her, she naturally wouldn’t start one either. So she picked up her phone and started playing too.
“Ruth, how many boyfriends have you had before?”
Just then, Justin suddenly smiled and asked Ruth.
Upon hearing Justin’s question, Ruth couldn’t help but pause for a moment, then replied calmly, “I’ve had three boyfriends before, but we broke up because our personalities didn’t match…”
“What about you, Sia?”
Justin asked Sia again.
“I… I had one, but we separated after entering university…”
When Sia said this, she subconsciously glanced at Joel. It seemed like she was also quite interested in him.
“And dear, how many have you had?”
Justin looked at Kaira and asked.
“You’re my first love…”
Kaira said straightforwardly.
“Is it true or not?”
Justin exclaimed in surprise.
“Nonsense, do I need to lie to you?”
Kaira gave Justin a light glare and continued, “How many girlfriends did you have before?”
“I don’t remember how many I had before, but that’s not important…”
Justin grinned and then hugged Kaira, saying, “I only have you now, and in the future, it’ll still be only you…”
“Why are you so cheesy?”
Kaira looked at Justin’s expression on his face and couldn’t help but feel speechless.
“I’m telling the truth…”
“Connor, do you have a girlfriend?”
Kaira ignored Justin and suddenly asked Connor.
In fact, Kaira didn’t ask Connor this question randomly. She noticed that he had been playing with his phone and ignoring Sonia. She felt that something was off.
Sonia was such a beautiful girl, and especially in this kind of environment, any normal man should have approached her on his own.
But Connor remained so calm, which meant either he didn’t like women, or he already had a girlfriend.

chapters.title: Chapter 1039: I Have a Fiancée
chapters.content:
Chapter 1039: I Have a Fiancée
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
When the crowd heard Kaira’s words, they all turned their heads to look at Connor’s position.
But he was engrossed in playing the game and didn’t hear her words at all.
“Connor, stop playing. Kaira is asking if you have a girlfriend!”
Justin shouted at Connor helplessly.
In fact, it was Justin’s first time seeing someone come to the bar and still play mobile games the whole time.
Even if Sonia had a boyfriend, Connor should still take the initiative to get to know her!
Facing a goddess like Sonia, Justin felt that even if he couldn’t have a romantic relationship with her, being a backup plan would be acceptable!
“Girlfriend?”
Connor was taken aback.
“Yeah, do you have a girlfriend?”
Kaira looked at him and asked.
And Sonia couldn’t help but glance at Connor, her expression seeming somewhat curious.
“I don’t have a girlfriend…”
Connor shook his head lightly and continued, “But I have a fiancée.”
“What?”
After hearing his words, everyone was stunned. Their faces showed an extremely shocked expression. They hadn’t expected that he already had a fiancée.
“Connor, are you telling the truth?”
Justin asked him with surprise.
“Of course, I am telling the truth!”
Connor smiled and nodded.
“Then, who is your fiancée?”
“Is your fiancée from Newtown?”
“Do you have a photo of your fiancée? Can we see it?”
Everyone started bombarding him with questions.
“My fiancée’s name is Freya. She is currently in Newtown, but she is not a student at our school. She’s already working…”
Connor answered casually.
“Freya?”
After hearing this name, everyone wore puzzled expressions, but they didn’t say much.
Because they had never heard of this name before, and after knowing that Connor had a fiancée, Sonia’s expression seemed to relax a bit.
Because she felt that since he already had a fiancée, it was understandable for him to treat her that way.
