Next, everyone started talking about other topics, while he continued playing the game on his phone.
In the blink of an eye, two hours had passed.
Seeing that it was getting late, everyone started preparing to go back to the school.
Instead of going back to the dormitory with Justin and the others, Connor hailed a taxi and went back to the house Reena had arranged for him.
…
After Kaira, Sonia, and the others returned to the dormitory, they started discussing what had happened at the bar.
“Kaira, you’re so thoughtless! You actually introced me to that fat guy, Brook. He’s so fat that if we were together, he would squash me to death!”
Ruth seemed dissatisfied with Brook, so she started complaining.
“I heard that Brook’s family runs a factory, and he’s well off. If you could be with him, you wouldn’t have to worry about money in the future…”
Kaira said casually while removing her makeup.
Upon hearing this, Ruth couldn’t help but pause for a moment and quickly asked, “Is that true?”
“Of course, it’s true. I’ve already investigated. Otherwise, why would I introce it to you?” Kaira quickly said.
After hearing these words, Ruth’s expression on her face started to soften, and she pursed her lips, saying, “So what if Brook is wealthy? He still falls far behind Justin. Justin is the real wealthy person, and he’s handsome too. Kaira, you must seize this opportunity. It would be a pity if someone else snatched him away…”
“If he’s mine, he won’t be able to run away. If he’s not mine, it doesn’t matter even if he runs away…”
Kaira pretended to have a nonchalant attitude, then turned her head and looked in Sia’s direction, whispering, “Sia, what do you think of Joel?”
“He’s good. Although Joel doesn’t talk much, he’s honest and reliable…”
Sia had a very favorable impression of Joel and nodded lightly in response.
“That’s good…”
Kaira smiled and didn’t say anything.
In fact, in the eyes of girls like Kaira and Ruth, what’s the use of being honest? Honesty can’t put food on the table!
“Kaira, who is this Connor?”
Just then, Sonia, who had always been aloof, unexpectedly took the initiative to ask Kaira about Connor.
The other three girls in the dormitory were stunned when they heard Sonia’s question. Their expressions were full of disbelief because it was the first time they saw Sonia actively inquiring about a guy.
“Connor is an exchange student. He should be from Porthampton, but I’m not sure about his specific occupation…”
Kaira replied.
“Oh…”
Sonia lightly nodded and didn’t say anything further.
“Sonia, why are you suddenly interested in asking about Connor?”
After hesitating for a moment, Kaira whispered to Sonia.
“It’s nothing. I just feel like he is a bit strange, so I was curious to ask…”
Sonia replied casually.
“Ah…”
Kaira nodded and didn’t say anything.
“Ring ring…”
Just then, Sonia’s phone suddenly rang.
Sonia glanced at the number on her phone, walked out of the dormitory while holding the phone, and answered the call.
After Ruth saw her leave, a hint of surprise flashed in her eyes. She then whispered to Kaira, “Sonia seems a bit off today!”
“Yeah, after being together for so long, it’s the first time I’ve seen her actively asking about a guy,” Kaira quickly responded, understanding the meaning behind Ruth’s words.
“Kaira, do you think she has developed feelings for Connor?” Ruth hesitated and whispered to Kaira.
“What nonsense are you talking about?” Kaira quickly retorted, then continued, “Let me tell you, Sonia’s boyfriend has a terrifying background. It seems like he’s on a path to officialdom, with a limitless future. Although Connor looks decent, in terms of strength and background, he can’t compare to Sonia’s current boyfriend, no matter what…”
“Well, that’s true. Sonia is so lucky to have found such an impressive boyfriend,” Ruth said with envy.
“Actually, I think when it comes to finding a boyfriend, you should follow your feelings!” Sia suddenly spoke up.
“What can feelings count for in the face of true strength?” Ruth couldn’t help but sigh.

chapters.title: Chapter 1040: The New Lecturer
chapters.content:
Chapter 1040: The New Lecturer
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
After returning home, Connor immediately took out his phone and dialed Reena’s number.
“Mr. Connor…”
Reena quickly answered the phone.
“Ms. Reena, I hope I didn’t disturb you by calling this late?”
Connor heard a hint of tiredness in her voice. He suddenly realized it was already midnight and hurriedly asked.
“No, not at all, Mr. Connor. Is there something you need?”
She adjusted her state and asked softly.
“I just wanted to ask you how the investigation into Percy’s matter is going.” he replied in a soft voice.
“I haven’t made much progress on my end…”
Reena answered somewhat embarrassedly.
“It’s okay. Just continue your investigation and don’t let me disturb your rest!”
Connor said lightly.
“Okay!”
After she agreed, she hung up the phone directly.
He slowly put down his phone. He seemed to have anticipated this outcome. After all, Percy was the person in charge of Rockefeller in Newtown, with a similar rank to Birdie.
Without the information provided by her, it would have been very difficult for Connor to find Percy, let alone discover his weaknesses.
Originally, Connor planned to ask for Birdie’s help, but she directly refused his request. If she investigated Percy, it would likely raise his suspicions. By then, not only would he know Connor’s intentions, but Birdie might also be implicated.
Connor thought Birdie’s words made some sense, so he gave up on the idea.
Now, he could only place his hopes on Reena. However, he knew that she wouldn’t be able to gather evidence that could threaten Percy in a short period.
But he didn’t have anything else to do at the moment, so he could afford to wait.
…
In the blink of an eye, a week had passed.
There was no news from Percy, and Freya had not returned to the country yet.
During this week, Connor had spent most of his time at Newtown University. He was gradually adapting to life in Newtown.
This week was a rare time for Connor to rest. After all, there had been too many events before, and his nerves had been constantly on edge.
Now he could finally relax a bit.
After all, there had been significant progress regarding both Freya’s whereabouts and the cause of his parents’ death. He was no longer as anxious as before.
Of course, he didn’t give up on practicing martial arts during this week. He set aside some time each day to practice the martial arts techniques given to him by Jorge.
With the remarkable improvement in his physical fitness, his mastery of the martial arts techniques was also increasing.
Once he had fully learned this set of techniques, he could go to Jorge to learn other things.
As for Connor’s life at school, it was quite peaceful. Besides attending classes, he would hang out with Justin, Brook, and others.
After a week of effort, Brook finally managed to get together with Ruth as he had hoped.
Although Joel and Sia were not officially together yet, their relationship had become very close. It was only a matter of time before they crossed that final barrier.
So Connor has been quite relaxed recently. The students in the class are not very interested in a normal student like him, except for one or two girls who want to get to know him. Nothing else significant has happened.
However, the appearance of a person once again disrupted his originally peaceful life.
…
Inside the classroom.
The first class in the morning was an English class, but it puzzled the students in the class that the English teacher, who usually arrived early, was late this time.
For a while, the students in the class started discussing.
Some said the English teacher was sick, while others said the English teacher took leave.
Wyane was the class monitor, so after hesitating for a moment, he decided to go and ask the counselor what was going on.
But before he could leave the classroom, the counselor hurriedly entered and said to the students in the classroom, “Let me tell you something. Our English teacher can’t continue teaching us for some special reasons. From now on, all our English classes will be taught by Miss Rachel!”
“We’re changing English teachers?”
“Why is this happening so suddenly? We didn’t hear anything about changing teachers before, right?”
The students in the classroom began to whisper.
“Miss Rachel?”
After hearing the counselor’s words, Connor instantly showed a surprised expression and suddenly had a bad premonition.
“Tap, tap, tap…”
Then came the sound of high heels tapping on the floor.
Upon hearing the familiar footsteps, Connor’s heartbeat noticeably accelerated.
A few seconds later, a sexy beauty wearing a tight skirt and high heels walked into the classroom.
The beauty wore a black tight skirt with a pure white shirt on top. Her ample chest was extremely enticing, and her legs wrapped in stockings were stepping on high heels. Her charming face had light makeup, but even so, she was incredibly sexy and captivating.
When the students in the classroom saw this beauty, their eyes widened instantly.
Justin and Brook, on the other hand, stared intently at the front of the classroom, their expressions filled with disbelief.
“Justin, pinch me. I must be dreaming, right?”
Brook turned his head and looked at Justin, stuttering as he asked.
“You pinch me first…”
Justin replied, staring straight ahead.
“The new English teacher in our class is actually a beautiful woman? And she’s so sexy!”
Brook whispered.
“Yeah, I must be dreaming…”
Justin hurriedly said.
“This is our new English teacher, Miss Rachel!”
Just then, the counselor spoke again.
“Hello, from now on, I will be teaching your English class. My name is Rachel!”
Following that, the sexy beauty in the tight skirt smiled and addressed the students in the classroom.
Yes, the woman appearing on the podium at that moment was none other than Rachel!
Connor looked at the sexy and enchanting Rachel in front of him, and his expression was extremely overwhelmed.
Unable to control himself, he clenched his teeth and whispered, “Why did this woman come to Newtown?”

chapters.title: Chapter 1041: What Do You Want?
chapters.content:
Chapter 1041: What Do You Want?
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Regardless of whether it was her figure or appearance, Rachel was the best among the best.
Therefore, when Rachel appeared in the classroom, it instantly caused a commotion.
The students in the class widened their eyes and stared at the podium.
Everyone looked at Rachel with their mouths agape. After all, having such a beautiful lecturer was the dream of every university student.
With a beautiful woman like Rachel as a lecturer, even if he couldn’t touch her, it seemed to be a very happy thing to be able to look at her in class every day.
Rachel stood on the podium and introduced herself briefly.
After Rachel finished her introduction, the students in the classroom instantly erupted into deafening applause.
It was as if everyone was welcoming the arrival of this beautiful lecturer.
Only Connor sat on the spot alone because he still hadn’t gotten over the shock of seeing Rachel.
At this moment, Connor felt that this woman was like a lingering ghost!
“Connor, what are you daydreaming about? Although the new English lecturer is very beautiful, you don’t have to be dumbfounded!”
Justin saw that Connor had been sitting there foolishly and shouted at him.
Connor took a deep breath after hearing Justin’s words and did not say anything.
At this moment, no one could understand his current mood.
Rachel, who was on the podium, seemed to have also looked at Connor’s position and then showed a very familiar smile to Connor.
“…”
Connor instantly collapsed when he saw Rachel’s smile. The expression on his face was extremely embarrassed.
“Connor and Brooks, did you see that? The new English lecturer in our class seems to be smiling at me. Did you two see that?”
Justin stammered as she shouted at Connor and Brooks.
“…”
Connor looked at Justin’s silly and helpless expression. He didn’t know what to say.
At this moment, there were so many students in the classroom, but only Connor knew how terrifying Rachel was.
After Rachel finished her self-introduction, she started the class. Although Rachel looked like a foreigner, her English level was actually very high. Even in the English Department of Porthampton University, she was one of the best. Therefore, when the students in the class heard Rachel’s fluent English, they were very shocked.
At this moment, Connor felt as if time had stopped. All he could think of now was to find Rachel and ask her about the matter after class.
He really wanted to know what Rachel wanted to do.
The class time passed very quickly.
After the bell rang, Rachel glanced at Connor indifferently and then walked out of the classroom gracefully in her high heels.
“Our English lecturer is too good-looking!” Justin said excitedly.
“Yeah, this is the first time I’ve seen such a beautiful lecturer. She’s even prettier than the school belle here…”
“I wonder if Ms. Wallace has a boyfriend?”
Everyone began to discuss in low voices.
After hesitating for a moment, Connor stood up and walked out of the classroom.
When Justin saw that Connor was about to leave, he quickly reached out and pulled Connor, then smiled and said, “Connor, where are you going?”
“I have something to do…”
At this time, Connor naturally would not tell Justin that he knew Rachel and that he was very familiar with her.
“Um, there’s a new bar in Newtown. My friend knows the owner of this bar, so I’m going to bring everyone to that bar tonight,” Justin said.
“Alright, send me the location. I’ll go over and look for you when the time comes…”
In fact, if it was any other time, Connor would definitely refuse. After all, Connor wasn’t interested in going to bars at all. He couldn’t understand why young people nowadays liked to go to bars so much.
However, Connor’s mind was filled with the matter of Rachel’s presence. He only wanted to seize the time to figure out her purpose in coming to Newtown. That was why Connor agreed so readily.
“Alright, I’ll send you a friend request later!”
Justin saw that Connor seemed to be really anxious at this time, so he did not continue to pester Connor. After agreeing, he let go of Connor.
After Justin let go of Connor, Connor ran out of the classroom.
Justin stood where she was and looked at Connor’s back. The expression on her face was very puzzled.
This was because he could not understand what made Connor so anxious. In Justin’s impression, Connor had always been a very calm person.
After Connor ran out of the classroom, he found that Rachel had not gotten far, so he quickened his pace.
Rachel seemed to have noticed Connor who was catching up from behind. She couldn’t help but smile faintly and then stand in place waiting for Connor to catch up.
After Connor caught up to Rachel, he got straight to the point. “Why did you come to Newtown?”
Rachel turned her head to look at the surrounding students and said softly, “Do you think it’s appropriate to talk here?”
“…”
Connor was stunned for a moment, then he said directly, “Alright, let’s find a place where there’s no one to talk…”
Rachel looked at Connor indifferently and didn’t say anything. She continued to walk forward with her long and white legs.
A moment later, Connor followed Rachel to an office.
This office should be Rachel’s own. Connor knew Rachel’s connections and ability, so it was very normal for Newtown University to arrange such an office for her.
After Rachel entered the office, she poured herself a cup of coffee and leaned on the desk to look at Connor who was standing at the door.
Connor closed the door and asked Rachel, “Why did you come to Newtown? What do you want?”
“I should be the one asking you this question, right?”
Rachel replied indifferently before continuing, “Little Connor, you’re really mean. I helped you so much and finally got the subway project from Langston Shaw, but you handed it to Rockefeller’s people and then quietly ran off to Newtown. What do you mean?”
“Don’t you know why I came to Newtown?”
Connor said in a low voice.
“I’m not very sure…”
Rachel smiled and shook his head.
“If it wasn’t because of you, I wouldn’t have come to Newtown,” Connor said excitedly.

chapters.title: Chapter 1042: Rachel Wallace's Interrogation
chapters.content:
Chapter 1042: Rachel Wallace’s Interrogation
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
After Rachel heard Connor’s words, the expression on her face seemed to be even more unbelievable.
She couldn’t help but frown and ask, “Connor, sometimes, I really don’t understand what you want to do.”
Connor was stunned for a moment, then asked, “What?”
“You’re so rich now. It’s not too much to say that you’re the richest man in the world, but why do you have to waste your time at Porthampton University? Don’t you know that your real opponent is Rockefeller? They’re the only ones that can take away your wealth now. Why don’t you spend all your time dealing with them instead?”
Rachel shouted at Connor helplessly.
“Haha…”
After Connor heard Rachel’s words, he could not help but chuckle. Then, he said indifferently, “You’re finally willing to tell the truth now, right? You actually want to use me to deal with Rockefeller, right? You’ve always treated me as a tool to deal with them…”
“That’s right, that’s what I think!”
But what Connor did not expect was that Rachel actually did not deny this matter in the slightest, but instead nodded and admitted it.
“Why should I be used by you?” Connor shouted angrily.
“Because Rockfeller is your greatest enemy. If you want to truly inherit Steven Lee’s inheritance, then you must get rid of Rockfeller. Otherwise, no matter how rich you are, you will have to live your life in fear. Your friends and future wife will be threatened by Rockfeller. You’re free to disregard yourself, but you can’t disregard the safety of the people around you!”
Rachel continued, “You have a grudge against Rockefeller, and I have a grudge against Rockefeller, so I can use you to deal with Rockefeller!”
“…”
Connor was stunned by Rachel’s theory because he felt that what she said seemed to make sense. It was destined for him to deal with Rockefeller. Rachel might want to use Connor, but from a certain point of view, it wasn’t a big problem.
It was just that when Rachel personally said it like this, Connor still felt somewhat uncomfortable. Who liked being used by someone else?
Connor took a deep breath and asked Rachel in a low voice, “Why do you want to deal with Rockefeller?”
“That’s my own business. I told you about what happened between me and Rockefeller before. I can’t tell you the details now, but when the time is right, I will tell you!” Rachel replied.
“Then why did you come to Newtown?” Connor asked.
“I went to Porthampton University to get close to you, and now I’m here in Newtown to get close to you. I have to know your every move!” Rachel slowly said.
Connor looked at Rachel in front of him, and his eye twitched. He said in a low voice, “Hey, uh…Ms. Wallace? What did I do to offend you? Why do you have to pester me like this?”
“I’m not pestering you. I’ll be of great help to you if I stay by your side!”
At this moment, Rachel’s expression seemed to have calmed down quite a bit as she smiled faintly at Connor.
“Even if you were in Newtown, I would never follow your plan to deal with Rockefeller. I have something I want to do now, and I will follow my plan step by step!” Connor said with a frown.
“Do you want to finish university now?”
Rachel sneered at Connor. In fact, she couldn’t understand why Connor had to complete his university education.
“That’s right!”
Connor nodded and continued, “I admit that what you said before was right. The money in my hands is indeed enough for me to live for ten lifetimes, but this money is actually not mine at all. It’s just temporarily placed in my hands. Also, everything I have now is the same. Rockefeller and the Lee Family will do everything they can to take these things from me…”
“Once I lose everything in the future, I’ll have to go back to my previous life. At that time, I’ll have nothing. If I give up on my studies, what will I use to survive?”
Rachel looked at Connor in front of her with an expression of shock. She didn’t expect him to have such thoughts.
“I’m different from you rich kids. My money fell from the sky, and I don’t know when it will disappear. You all have backers, but I have nothing. I’ve lived the lowest life in this society, so I don’t want to live like before!”
Connor took a deep breath and continued, “My plan is simple: I won’t give up everything I have now, but I don’t want to change the life that should have belonged to me because of all this. At the very least, when I lose everything, I can still survive in this society.”
“But from the moment you inherited Steven Lee’s inheritance, there’s no turning back. Once you lose these things, the Lee family and Rockefeller will definitely not let you off!”
Rachel said in a low voice.
“They have no intention of letting me go even now, but I’m still alive, aren’t I?” Connor said calmly.
Rachel looked at Connor in front of her, but did not know how to persuade him otherwise.
She took a deep breath and whispered, “Alright, since you want to finish your studies so much, I can respect your choice. I won’t interfere with your matters in the future, but I don’t understand why you chose to come to Newtown. Newtown isn’t within the scope of the four provinces.”
“…”
Connor looked at Rachel in front of him and didn’t speak. He didn’t know if Rachel was trustworthy, so he didn’t want to tell Rachel everything about him.
The longer Connor interacted with Rachel, the more he felt that she was terrifying.
Rachel seemed to see through Connor’s thoughts at a glance and softly said, “Connor, I know you don’t believe me, but don’t forget that I’ve never harmed you even after such a long time. On the contrary, I’ve helped you many times. I don’t have any other meaning in asking you this question.”
After Connor heard Rachel’s words, he could not help but slowly raise his head to look at Rachel. He did not know if he should tell Rachel the truth or not.

chapters.title: Chapter 1043: You Want to Stay at My House?
chapters.content:
Chapter 1043: You Want to Stay at My House?
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Connor knew that Rachel was a terrifying woman, but he didn’t know what she wanted to do.
But no matter what, Rachel had never harmed him.
“If you don’t want to tell me, that’s fine. But I have to tell you that my connections in Newtown far exceed Porthampton!” Rachel softly reminded Connor.
“I came to Newtown mainly for two things!” Connor suddenly said.
“What two things?”
“The first thing is that my fiancée is currently in Newtown. I don’t know why she suddenly returned to the country but didn’t tell anyone. I want to find her!” Connor said in a low voice.
At this moment, he did not tell Rachel that Freya Phillips was already the general manager of Travio Corporation because he was afraid that Rachel would investigate her.
“This matter is between you and your fiancée. It has nothing to do with me. I can’t help you with anything!” Rachel said indifferently.
“I don’t need your help with this matter…” Connor replied expressionlessly, then continued, “The second thing is that I found out the cause of my parents’ deaths. It’s very likely related to Yaakov Ward, the person-in-charge of Rockefeller in Orilon…”
There was no progress on Reena Satchwell’s end, and Freya had not returned. Although the previous week had been very peaceful, Connor was very anxious.
Connor knew that Reena’s ability was limited. If he waited for her to look for evidence against Percy Juve, he didn’t know how long it would take.
And what Rachel said just now had indeed moved Connor, which was a factor in why he ultimately decided to reveal his goals.
“Yaakov Ward?”
After Rachel heard Connor’s words, she couldn’t help but be stunned for a moment. Then, she said helplessly, “It’s very unlikely for you to be able to find the person in charge of Rockefeller’s Orilon branch. I’ve lived in Porthampton for so long, but I haven’t found out who’s the person in charge of Rockefeller’s Davenport branch!”
“I know…” Connor nodded and continued, “It will be very difficult to find Yaakov, so I plan to start with the person in charge of Newtown, Percy Juve. As long as I can control Percy, I can find Yaakov!”
“Do you have any information on this Percy Juve?” Rachel asked.
“Yes…”
Connor nodded.
“Since you have Percy’s information, it’s easy. Give me his information, and I’ll help you find out more about him!” Rachel said.
After Connor saw Rachel take the initiative, the expression on his face seemed to be even more hesitant.
Rachel seemed to always be able to see through what Connor was thinking, though. “Alright, stop acting with me. The reason why you took the initiative to tell me these things must be because you want my help. No one else in this world can help you except me. You’d better give me Percy’s information quickly!”
This was also a terrifying thing for Connor.
Although he didn’t know what Rachel wanted to do, he didn’t have any other choice.
Connor had no choice but to send Percy’s information to Rachel and then said coldly, “If I don’t investigate the cause of my parents’ death, I won’t leave Newtown. I won’t do anything according to your wishes!”
“I understand!”
Rachel gently nodded.
“Then when can you investigate?” Connor asked.
“I’m not sure when I’ll be able to find out.; after all, Percy is also one of Rockefeller’s people. It’s a little difficult to investigate, but I’ll do it as soon as possible!” Rachel replied while looking at Percy’s information.
“Alright then!”
Connor nodded helplessly and continued, “I don’t want anyone in Newtown to know my identity, so you’d better keep a low profile. Otherwise, I’ll never see you again in my life!”
“Relax, I will not expose your identity this time around…”
Rachel looked at Connor with a charming smile, which was exceptionally seductive.
After taking a deep breath, Connor turned around and prepared to leave.
However, at this moment, Rachel suddenly spoke.
“By the way, Connor, where is your home? Give me your house key too!”
Connor couldn’t help but be stunned when he heard Rachel’s words. Then, he said with a very puzzled expression, “Why do you want my house key?”
“See, the environment of the dormitory that Newtown University prepared for me is a little bad. I don’t like it very much, so I rented a house near Newtown University. I just renovated the house, and the smell inside is a little strong, so I want to stay at your house for a while…”
Rachel said casually as she used her fair fingers to scroll through the information on her phone.
“You… You want to stay at my house?”
After Connor heard Rachel’s words, he was instantly speechless, looking thunderstruck.
“Yes, but you don’t have to worry. I won’t stay for long. At most, it’ll be half a month!”
Rachel gently nodded.
“Isn’t it a little inappropriate for the two of us to live together?” Connor said with some difficulty.
“What’s inappropriate about it? I’m not sleeping on the same bed as you!” Rachel rolled her eyes at Connor and continued, “I came to Newtown because of you. If I don’t go to your house at this time, where would I go?”
“I didn’t ask you to come, though?” Connor shouted, somewhat on the verge of collapse.
“Connor, how can you be so heartless? I just arrived in Newtown and I’m even going to help you investigate Percy’s matter!” Rachel shouted angrily.
“I didn’t mean that. Didn’t you say that you have a lot of connections in Newtown? Why didn’t you ask someone else for help?”
“I’m familiar with those people. Moreover, I don’t like to ask others for help because of such a small matter…” Rachel said indifferently.
Connor still felt that it was strange for him to live with Rachel, so he refused without thinking. “But you can’t stay at my house, right? Why don’t I help you book a hotel room? You can stay in a hotel for a while!”
“It’s not safe in the hotel, and I don’t like the environment in them!”
Rachel shook her head.
Connor gritted his teeth. “So you’re saying that you have to stay at my house?”
“Yeah, it’s just for a few days. It won’t delay you!” Rachel said indifferently.
Connor looked at Rachel in front of him and did not know what to say.

chapters.title: Chapter 1044: Sonia's Intentions
chapters.content:
Chapter 1044: Sonia’s Intentions
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Although Connor did have an empty room at home, he felt that something would happen sooner or later if he lived with a woman like Rachel.
Moreover, he did not know when Freya would return. If Freya found out that he was living with Rachel, Connor would not be able to clear his name even if he jumped into a raging river!
Therefore, no matter how Rachel tried to persuade him otherwise, Connor would refuse.
“You can live anywhere you want as long as it’s not in my house. I won’t live with you!”
Connor threw these harsh words at Rachel, then turned around and walked out of her office.
Rachel looked at Connor’s back, an angry expression on her face. She gritted her teeth and whispered, “Connor, you’re not even willing to help with such a small matter. And to think that I’m so good to you. Just you wait!”
After Connor left Rachel’s office, he found that the sky had gradually darkened, and there were very few people in the school.
Connor planned to take a taxi back, but before he could walk out of the school, he received a call from Justin.
“What’s the matter?” Connor asked softly.
“Brother, we’re already at the bar. Why aren’t you here yet?”
Justin asked anxiously.
“O-Oh, right, I’ll be right there…” Connor hurriedly replied.
Because of Rachel’s sudden appearance, Connor had forgotten that he had promised Justin to go to his friend’s bar to support her.
“Alright, then hurry up and come over. Sonia and the others are already here,” Justin added.
“Got it…”
Connor agreed and then hung up.
After hanging up the phone, Connor walked out of the Porthampton University and hailed a taxi to the bar that Justin had told him about.
After getting out of the car, Connor realized that this hotel had indeed just opened for business not long ago because there were two flower baskets placed at the entrance of the bar.
At this moment, there were many luxury cars parked at the entrance of the bar, and there were many beautiful women dressed in sexy and fashionable clothes coming and going in and out.
These beauties were probably here to hook up with rich men, while those rich heirs were here to satisfy their own needs, so everyone took what they needed.
After hesitating for a moment, Connor took out his phone and dialed Justin’s number.
Soon after, Justin ran out of the bar and waved at Connor with a smile.
“Hey, bro, you’re finally here. I thought you weren’t coming!” Justin said as she hugged Connor’s shoulder.
“I ran into something just now, so I was delayed…” Connor vaguely explained.
“It’s fine. As long as you’re here. What do you think about this bar? Aren’t there a lot of beautiful women?” Justin spoke as he brought Connor into the bar.
“Not bad…” Connor replied perfunctorily. Actually, he really wasn’t interested in a place like a bar at all.
If not for Justin, he would not have come at all.
“Let me tell you, this bar seems to be owned by a gangster. My friend is the manager of this bar. All the drinks are 30% off today,” Justin said proudly to Connor.
“Hehe, alright!”
Connor nodded gently and followed Justin to Kaira and the others.
Kaira, Ruth, Sia, Sonia, and a few other girls had come today. Moreover, Connor could see that these girls had obviously dressed up carefully. Their faces were all decorated in exquisite makeup, and they were wearing clothes suitable for nightclubs.
A miniskirt paired with an off-shoulder T-shirt and high heels made them look more like a white-collar worker than a university student.
Among these girls, the most eye-catching one was none other than Sonia.
Today, she was wearing a strapless top that showcased her full chest. She was wearing a pair of tight denim shorts that stretched around her hips tightly. Her curves were beautiful and seductive. Further down was a pair of slender and straight legs. She was wearing a pair of high heels, making her look exceptionally sexy and seductive.
However, when they looked at the boys, only Justin and Joel were dressed normally. Brooks looked like a fat otaku, let alone Connor. Although Connor’s clothes were obviously much more expensive than before, they were not considered luxury goods and cost at most one or two thousand dollars. No one would look down on him, but no one would look up to him either.
These fashionable beauties formed a sharp contrast with Connor and the other boys who looked like losers. From time to time, some people would take the initiative to look at Connor and the others, wondering how these people got together.
“Alright, since everyone is here, let’s begin!”
Justin called out with a smile and then gave the waiter a look.
When the waiter saw Justin’s gaze, he instantly understood what he meant and began to serve the wine.
Perhaps it was because there was a 30% discount on drinks today, but Justin had ordered a lot of good wine.
Everyone started chatting and drinking.
Ruth and Brooks were already together, so the two of them naturally became lovey-dovey. Sia and Joel were also chatting while sharing a fruit plate.
Justin knew the manager of this bar, so he took the initiative to bring Kaira to his friend, preparing to introduce Kaira.
For a moment, everyone present seemed to have their own things to do.
However, only Connor and Sonia were still sitting on the sofa.
Connor sighed helplessly, then narrowed his eyes and looked at the handsome men and beautiful women on the dance floor.
But in fact, his mind at this time was focused on that woman, Rachel.
He was very confused on what to do—he didn’t know what Rachel’s motives were, nor did he know if she was really as reliable as she said.
When Sonia saw that Connor still had no intention of taking the initiative to talk to her, a hint of helplessness flashed across her eyes.
However, she felt that since Connor had a fiancée, it was understandable that he would not talk to her.
That said, she also had her own thoughts. She would not have come to Justin, Brooks, and the others ‘gatherings ordinarily, but this time, she agreed to join.
She had just broken up with her boyfriend, and though Connor’s attitude towards her was very cold, Sonia actually had the idea of taking the initiative to contact Connor.
After all, Connor was good-looking, and he looked well-off. Sonia felt that it was not impossible to give Connor a chance.
A girl like Sonia wouldn’t take the fact that he had a fiancée to heart; after all, the word “fiancée” meant that he was not married yet. Since he was not married, she was not considered a mistress!

chapters.title: Chapter 1045: I Came With My Boyfriend!
chapters.content:
Chapter 1045: I Came With My Boyfriend!
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
In the bar.
“I heard from Justin that you don’t seem to be from Newtown City?” Sonia asked after a moment of hesitation.
She felt that she should take the initiative.
With her beauty, as long as she took the initiative, there was no man she couldn’t take down.
“…”
After Connor heard Sonia’s words, he couldn’t help but look up at her and say, “I’m from Porthampton!”
“Do you really have a fiancée?”
Sonia asked.
“I have it…”
Connor nodded gently, then took out his phone and played Disguise, as if telling Sonia that he didn’t plan to continue chatting with her.
After Sonia saw Connor playing the game, her expression was unusually speechless. She didn’t know what to say.
After all, there was a beautiful woman right in front of him, but he didn’t know how to cherish this opportunity. Instead, he picked up his phone and started playing games. This was really disrespectful to Sonia.
In fact, Connor was doing this just to tell Sonia that he didn’t want to be intimate with other girls.
Originally, Sonia wanted to give Connor a chance, but she felt that he was too arrogant. Even her previous boyfriend wasn’t nearly this arrogant!
If Connor really had the right to be arrogant, Sonia wouldn’t think much of it. However, in Sonia’s eyes, Connor was just a middle-class guy. If not for his good looks, no one would have noticed him at all. What right did he have to be so arrogant in front of her?
Sonia was unhappy, and she picked up her glass and took a sip of wine. She got up and prepared to go to the dance floor, but at this moment, a young man walked up to Sonia and said with a smile, “Hello, beautiful!”
Sonia could be said to be the most eye-catching beauty in the entire bar. Other girls would pale in comparison to her, so many people had their eyes on her just now. However, because they didn’t know if she had come with her boyfriend or not, they were secretly observing her.
When they found out that Sonia and Connor weren’t boyfriend and girlfriend, they took the initiative to strike up a conversation.
“Hello!” Sonia nodded at the young man calmly.
The young man looked ordinary and was probably a few years older than Connor and the others. He was wearing an Armani suit and a Tissot watch on his wrist, giving off the impression that he was a successful person. There was still a big gap between him and students like Connor
The young man tidied his suit and asked Sonia with a smile, “Hey, beautiful, I just opened a few bottles of Lafite in the private room. Do you want to come with us for a few drinks?”
“Sorry, I came with my boyfriend!”
Sonia said without thinking.
After hearing Sonia’s words, Connor couldn’t help but frown. Although this wasn’t the first time he had been used as a shield, it was the first time Sonia had said that he was her boyfriend without even asking. Connor was naturally very unhappy, but for the sake of Justin and Kaira, Connor couldn’t do anything!
“Your boyfriend?”
The young man couldn’t help but be stunned for a moment after hearing Sonia’s words. Then he squinted his eyes and looked at Connor.
When the young man saw Connor, his expression was obviously disdainful. He seemed to think that Connor, as a college student, was not a threat to him, so he smiled and said, “Little brother, you look young. You should still be in school, right? Which school are you from?”
“We are from Newtown University!”
Before Connor could speak, Sonia took the initiative to answer.
“Newtown University?”
When the young man heard this, he could not help but sneer. Then, he said indifferently, “I know Mr. Quick from Newtown University. If you have the chance in the future, you can come to my company to work after you graduate. It just so happens that my company is short of people now…”
After Sonia heard this, she couldn’t help but turn her head and look at the young man. She was more or less surprised.
She didn’t expect this young man to be the boss of a company. This meant that this young man’s family background should be very good.
“There’s no need…”
Connor said without raising his head as he played the game.
“Hehe, little brother, since the two of us can get to know each other, it must be fate. Do you want to bring your girlfriend to my private room for a drink?” the young man continued.
“Not interested…” Connor did not raise his head from the beginning to the end, nor did he look at the young man at all as he focused on playing the game seriously.
“Brat, aren’t you being a little rude? It’s your honor for Mr. Coin to invit you over for a drink. What are you being so arrogant for?”
When the young man’s friend saw Connor being so arrogant, he was instantly unhappy and pointed at him.
After hearing this, Connor slowly raised his head and said to the young man, “Get lost!”
“…”
Sonia suddenly turned her head to look at Connor with a hint of surprise in her eyes. She didn’t expect Connor to be so arrogant.
“What did you say?”
The young man gritted his teeth and asked Connor.
“Hurry up and get lost, or I’ll break your legs!” Connor picked up his phone again and said casually while playing the game.
The young man was instantly enraged and shouted, “Brat, how dare you say that to me?”
“Connor, what happened?”
Brooks, who had been drinking with Ruth, stood up and asked Connor when he saw that something was wrong.
Joel also silently walked to Connor’s side.
The young man realized that Connor had a lot of people with him, but he only had one person with him. If there was any conflict, he would definitely be the one at a disadvantage.
“You guys think you’re so awesome, right? Just you wait!”
The young man shouted at the top of his lungs, then turned around and walked away.
After Sonia saw the young man leave, she frowned and said to Connor, “Why did you say that just now? What if that person really has some background to take revenge on you?”
“Isn’t that what you want?”
Connor looked down at his phone and said in an unusually calm tone.
“My intentions?”
Sonia was instantly stunned.

chapters.title: Chapter 1046: Bad Luck!
chapters.content:
Chapter 1046: Bad Luck!
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
“Don’t think that I don’t know what you’re thinking. I know all the tricks up your sleeve. I advise you to behave yourself. If you continue to play tricks with me, I’ll make things hard for you…”
Connor didn’t even look at Sonia when he said that.
“…”
Sonia stared at Connor with her big, watery eyes. She was unusually angry.
She probably didn’t know how many women Connor had seen and how many times he had been teased by them.
Connor could easily see through a woman’s mind, except for Rachel Wallace.
Sometimes, Connor felt that Rachel was not even a woman!
After that, it was relatively peaceful. Connor was playing with his phone, while Sonia sat beside Connor and drank quietly.
Sonia was becoming more and more curious about Connor, and she kept stealing looks at him.
Moreover, Sonia also found something she couldn’t believe. When Connor spent money to buy equipment, a message notification would often pop up.
The bank card that Connor was bound to was his own bank card. There was not much money in the card, only a few million.
Connor usually used this bank card for normal expenses. After all, if he used a black card, it would be too high-profile.
After all, as long as others saw the black card, everyone would know that Connor’s identity was definitely not simple.
Sonia also accidentally saw Connor’s bank balance. When she saw the string of numbers for the first time, she was dumbfounded.
She did not expect Connor to have so much money in his card.
Sonia thought that the lights in the bar were dim, so she was seeing things.
But then, Connor’s phone received another text message notification. After Sonia a few times, she could confirm that Connor’s card really had a few million dollars.
Sonia was a rich young lady. Her family was very rich, and she had seen many rich people.
However, basically, those rich young people relied on the money that their families gave them to live. It was normal for them to have tens of millions in their hands, such as Justin.
It would not be a problem for Justin to take out hundreds of thousands of dollars in one go, but it would be impossible for him to take out a million dollars in one go.
However, Sonia saw that Connor’s card had a few million dollars, which was rather odd.
If Connor was really just an ordinary guy, how could he put so much money in the card?
At this time, Sonia seemed to be even more curious about Connor’s identity.
“Who was the one who said that he wanted to break my brother’s legs?”
But at this moment, a man’s voice interrupted Sonia’s thoughts.
Sonia was stunned for a moment, then she suddenly looked up at the man in front of her. A trace of helplessness flashed through her eyes, and she said softly, “Zalden, why are you here?”
“Sonia, it’s you!”
The man named Zalden smiled in surprise when he saw Sonia.
This guy was Zalden Larkin. He was a rich guy in Newtown. His family had some capital. He was in the same high school as Sonia, so the two of them naturally knew each other.
“Yeah, Zalden, we haven’t seen each other for a long time…”
Sonia said softly.
“Yeah. I heard that you’re with a rich young guy. Looks like we can’t be friends no more!”
Zalden was obviously mocking Sonia.
Sonia felt a little awkward, and the smile on her face disappeared in an instant.
“Sonia, what happened just now?”
Zalden suddenly asked Sonia.
“Actually, it’s not a big deal. It’s just a joke my friend made…”
Sonia said lightly.
“Are you kidding me? Who would break someone’s leg as a joke?”
Zalden sneered and continued, “Let me tell you, your friend is going to be in big trouble this time. The person you offended just now is the friend of the owner of this bar, Mr. Guthrie. You should go with your friend and apologize to Mr. Guthrie. Maybe they will let you off on account of me…”
“Mr. Guthrie?”
Sonia couldn’t help but frown slightly; she was somewhat puzzled.
“Yeah, Mr. Guthrie. You don’t even know him?”
Zalden saw the expression on Sonia’s face, and a hint of helplessness flashed across his eyes.
“I don’t…”
Sonia shook her head.
“Do you know Peyton Ledger?”
Zalden continued.
“Peyton… I’ve heard of Mr. Ledger!”
Sonia was very surprised when she heard this name.
Peyton Ledger was very famous in the city. He was a very powerful big boss of the underworld and had many underlings.
Basically, more than half of the venues in Newtown were under the watch of Peyton’s people. Their influence was very terrifying.
“Let me remind you on the account that we are friends. Mr. Guthrie has a very good relationship with Mr. Ledger. Your friend has offended Mr. Guthrie’s friend just now, and Mr. Guthrie is very angry. If this matter is blown up, it will not benefit you at all. You should hurry up and bring your friend over to apologize. Then, this matter will be over…”
Zalden said expressionlessly.
Justin, who had just returned, had a strange look in his eyes when he heard Zalden’s words.
Although Zalden had gone around in circles, the main topic was still that the owner of the bar knew Peyton.
They couldn’t afford to offend someone like Peyton, and they naturally couldn’t afford to offend the owner of this bar.
Sonia’s expression also began to turn ugly. At this time, she realized that Connor might have provoked someone he shouldn’t have provoked.
Sonia was from Newtown, so she was naturally very clear about the situation in Newtown. If she really provoked someone at Peyton’s level because of this matter, she could not even begin to imagine the consequences.
Whether it was Zalden or the owner of this bar, Mr. Guthrie, Sonia didn’t care too much about them. But if it was someone like Peyton, it would be a bit troublesome.
If they offended someone like Peyton, even Sonia’s parents might suffer.
Sonia subconsciously turned to look at the instigator of this matter, Connor.
But when Sonia looked at Connor, she was instantly dumbfounded.
Because at this time, Connor was still playing with his phone with his head lowered, as if what they had just said had nothing to do with him.
Sonia couldn’t understand why he was so nonchalant!

chapters.title: Chapter 1047: Why Should I Apologize?
chapters.content:
Chapter 1047: Why Should I Apologize?
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
When Sonia found out that the person Connor had offended might have something to do with Peyton, she suddenly became nervous.
Because she didn’t have the guts to offend someone on Peyton’s level.
Once they really offended Peyton, then the outcome was simply unimaginable!
For a moment, Sonia didn’t know what to do.
She could only pin her hopes on Connor because she felt that he must have some background to be so arrogant just now. Otherwise, he definitely wouldn’t dare to be so arrogant.
Thinking of the balance in Connor’s bank card, Sonia felt that he should be able to handle this matter.
However, she never expected Connor to be unbothered by what Zalden had said.
This caused Sonia’s heart to feel despair.
Justin felt that something was wrong and hurriedly called his friend over.
Justin’s friend was the manager of the bar, so he naively thought that this friend of his would be able to help Connor and Sonia put in a good word.
However, when Justin’s friend heard about this, he also had a helpless expression. He said in a low voice, “Justin, you might not understand our bar owner’s personality. Your friend has offended our bar owner’s friend. I definitely can’t help you with this matter. Go and plead with Zalden now. Maybe he can help…”
Justin looked at his friend with a desperate expression.
However, he still braced himself and walked up to Zalden. Then, he whispered to Zalden, “Zalden, they are all my friends. If they have done something wrong, can you give me some face…”
Justin and Zalden had only met today. The two of them did not know each other at all before.
Zalden glanced at Justin indifferently and said with a helpless expression, “Bro, if I could help you with this matter, I would definitely help you. However, this brat is too arrogant. He even dared to scold Mr. Guthrie’s friend. I can’t help you…”
Justin knew that Mr. Guthrie was Peyton’s man, and a trace of embarrassment flashed across his eyes. He quickly took out a stack of banknotes from his wallet and secretly stuffed it into Zalden’s hands. He said in a low voice, “Zalden, can you say a few good words for me?”
When Zalden saw the money that Justin took out, a strange look flashed across his eyes. Then, he said indifferently, “Mr. Guthrie is not in a good mood today…”
“I’ll give you another 10,000 dollars after this is done. What say you?”
Justin instantly understood what Zalden meant and said directly.
“Haha…”
Zalden couldn’t help but laugh after hearing this. He then said softly, “Bro, although we have just met today, I think you are quite sensible. I will give you face. Ask your friend to apologize to Mr. Guthrie. After he apologizes, I guarantee that nothing will happen…”
Justin heaved a long sigh of relief when he heard Zalden’s words. Then, he hurriedly said to Connor, “Connor, why are you still on your phone? Hurry up and apologize to Mr. Guthrie!”
“Apologize?”
Connor looked at Justin and was stunned for a moment. Then, he asked in a puzzled tone, “Why should I apologize? What’s wrong?”
Connor’s attention was indeed on the game just now, so he didn’t hear what they were talking about at all.
When everyone heard Connor’s words, they instantly broke out in cold sweat. At this moment, everyone was anxious about Connor offending Mr. Guthrie, but Connor didn’t know what was going on.
Sonia looked at Connor with an expression of extreme speechlessness. At this moment, she didn’t know what to say.
“You have offended Mr. Guthrie’s friend just now. I have already arranged everything for you. You can just go over and apologize now…”
Justin hurriedly ran to Connor’s side and whispered to him.
“The person who was scared away by me just now?”
Connor asked absent-mindedly.
“Yes, yes, that person!”
Justin nodded.
“I didn’t do anything wrong. Why should I apologize?”
Connor said lightly.
“You…”
Justin looked at Connor’s expression was even more speechless. Then, he gritted his teeth and said in a low voice, “Connor, that person is Mr. Guthrie’s friend…”
“Whoever this Mr. Guthrie or Ms. Judy is, I don’t know them, and I didn’t do anything wrong, so I won’t apologize!”
Connor said in frustration.
He was not in the mood to care about those so-called rich young people. In Connor’s eyes, what these people were doing was really child’s play.
“You’re not going to apologize, are you?”
When Zalden heard Connor’s words, he was angry. Then, he said to Justin, “Bro, I have already given you a lot of face today. Since this friend of yours does not know what is good for him, don’t blame me…”
After saying that, Zalden turned around and was about to leave.
Justin hurriedly chased after him and said to Zalden, “Zalden, my friend doesn’t understand what’s going on. Wait for me, I’ll talk to him!”
“What else is there to say? This brat clearly doesn’t put Mr. Guthrie in his eyes!”
Zalden widened his eyes and shouted, then continued to say to Justin, “Bro, as someone who has been through this before, I’m telling you that if you interact too much with some people, it won’t do you any good. Not only will it harm you, but it will also drag you down in the future. This matter had nothing to do with you. Why do you have to offend Mr. Guthrie because of him? Mr. Guthrie has a good relationship with Mr. Ledger. Once this matter gets out of hand, you might not be able to stay in Newtown in the future…”
“…”
Justin was stunned when he heard Zalden’s words. He was very helpless.
Kaira Lindley hesitated for a moment before walking to Justin and saying softly to him, “Justin, I think what Zalden said is right. You’ve only known Connor for less than a month. Just now, you’ve already tried your best to help him fight for the chance to apologize, but he’s so insensible and doesn’t know how to cherish it. You shouldn’t be bothered by this anymore…”
“Connor is my friend. How can I not do something about it?”
Justin said in a low voice.
“But you’ve already tried your best. If you continue to help him, you will offend Mr. Guthrie. Look at how many rich young people in Newtown are here at the bar today. Aren’t they all here for the owner of this bar? Can you afford to offend such a person?”
Kaira said with a frown.
When Justin heard this, he felt conflicted.

chapters.title: Chapter 1048: Mr. Guthrie
chapters.content:
Chapter 1048: Mr. Guthrie
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
After Kaira got to know the rich young people in the bar today, she finally realized what it meant to be truly rich.
Any one of these people was worth more than 100 million dollars.
Therefore, Kaira felt that Justin should interact more with such people. On the contrary, for people like Connor, Justin should just have some fun with him and not have too close a relationship.
If Justin really encountered some big trouble, it was best for him to cut ties with Connor and not get into trouble.
Justin was naturally unwilling to give up on Connor. Although he had not known Connor for a long time, he felt that Connor was good person.
In addition, Justin was very loyal, so he did not want to sit idly by.
However, he was also worried that if Connor made the matter worse, he would also suffer.
For a moment, Justin did not know what to do.
On the other side, Sonia looked at Connor with a puzzled expression.
He could not help but frown and ask Connor, “Connor, what nonsense were you talking about just now? Justin is trying so hard to help you, but you refuse to apologize. What do you want?”
“I didn’t do anything wrong. Why should I apologize?”
Connor said lightly as he played with his phone.
“Where did your confidence come from? Let me tell you this, Mr. Guthrie has a very good relationship with Peyton Ledger, and Peyton Ledger is a famous big boss of the underworld in Newtown. If you offend such a person, your only outcome is death. Yet here you are playing on your phone. In a while, you might not even be alive anymore!”
Sonia shouted angrily with her big watery eyes.
“Oh…”
Connor nodded casually, still looking indifferent.
Sonia was completely speechless. At this moment, she was already really anxious, but Connor was still so indifferent. She even suspected that there was something wrong with Connor’s head.
However, Sonia probably didn’t know that Peyton was nothing in Connor’s eyes. Any big boss from the underworld from the four provinces was enough to kill Peyton.
However, Connor did not want to explain these things to these people. The reason why he was so calm now was because he knew that he would not be in any danger at all.
Sonia held her phone tightly. At this time, she had been thinking about whether she should call her ex-boyfriend. She knew that if she asked her ex-boyfriend for help, he would definitely not refuse. However, she did not want to show weakness in front of her ex-boyfriend because of such a small matter, so she was very conflicted.
The reason why Sonia was so concerned about this was because she knew that it was caused by her.
Once the matter blew up, she would definitely be implicated. She was now in the same boat as Connor.
Otherwise, Sonia wouldn’t have cared about Connor’s life!
Brooks Hunt naturally didn’t want to see anything happen to Connor. He wanted to persuade Connor, but he was stopped by Ruth Copeland. It was obvious that she was telling Brooks not to meddle in other people’s business.
However, Brooks was a straightforward guy. He pushed Ruth away and walked to Connor’s side. Then, he said in a low voice, “Connor, although I’m not from Newtown, I know that Peyton is very terrifying. I think you should apologize. If ordinary people like us really offend such a person, we will definitely suffer…”
“Yeah, Connor. Just listen to our advice. If you offend these people, you won’t be able to stay in Newtown anymore. Later, try to behave. I’ll think of a way to help you solve this problem. If you don’t go over and apologize, then things will get ugly…”
Justin hurriedly chimed in.
“Isn’t he just a rich young guy? Do you have to be so scared?”
Connor said indifferently.
Everyone looked at Connor with a helpless expression on their faces. They felt that he might have drunk too much, so he wanted to act tough in front of them.
However, the consequences of this were far too great!
Seeing that Connor refused to apologize no matter what, Brooks and Justin did not continue to persuade him.
Joel Gibson, on the other hand, had his phone in his hand the whole time. He seemed to be in a dilemma, as if he was about to make a call, but he hadn’t made up his mind.
Sonia had completely given up on Connor. Her thoughts were very simple, and that was to protect herself. As for whether something would happen to Connor or not, it had nothing to do with her.
On the other side, Zalden went to the office of the bar owner, Mr. Guthrie.
At this moment, Mr. Guthrie was chatting with his friend.
“Zalden, how’s the matter I asked you to handle going?”
Mr. Guthrie indifferently asked Zalden.
Zalden hurried over and told Mr. Guthrie what had happened.
When Mr. Guthrie found out what was going on, his face was filled with anger. Today was the first day of his bar’s opening, and there was actually someone causing trouble in his bar. Mr. Guthrie naturally couldn’t tolerate it.
Therefore, he called the security guards of the pub, and together they headed toward Connor and the others in a huffy manner.
Justin was the first to notice Mr. Guthrie bringing people over. He began to get nervous, and then he stuttered, “We’re dead meat. Things have gone out of control…”
Sonia looked at Mr. Guthrie with a face full of despair. At this time, she didn’t know what to do.
However, what everyone could not understand was that Connor was still playing with his phone.
They couldn’t understand where Connor’s courage came from.
He was still playing with his phone at a time like this!
“Who was the one who said that he wanted to break my friend’s legs?”
At this moment, the bar owner, Mr. Guthrie, suddenly shouted.
In an instant, the entire bar fell silent. Everyone turned their heads to look at Mr. Guthrie.
Zalden quickly pointed at Connor and whispered to Mr. Guthrie, “Mr. Guthrie, it’s that brat…”
Mr. Guthrie didn’t hesitate at all, leading his men to rush toward Connor. He then fiercely slammed the table in front of Connor and shouted, “Brat, you’re quite the arrogant one. My bar just opened today, and you actually want to break my friend’s…”
Mr. Guthrie hadn’t even finished speaking when Connor slowly raised his head to look at Mr. Guthrie.
And when Mr. Guthrie saw Connor’s face, he was instantly stunned, his face one of extreme shock.
…

chapters.title: Chapter 1049: An Old Acquaintance
chapters.content:
Chapter 1049: An Old Acquaintance
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
In the bar.
“Mr. Guthrie, this is my friend. He was just joking before. He had no intention of offending you. I will ask him to apologize to you now. Please don’t be angry…”
When Justin saw Mr. Guthrie, he quickly ran to Mr. Guthrie and took the initiative to plead for Connor.
“Connor, hurry up and apologize!”
Sonia knew that this might be Connor’s last chance.
However, after Connor raised his head and looked at Mr. Guthrie, he smiled disdainfully and continued to play with his phone.
Seeing that Connor didn’t pay attention to him, Mr. Guthrie’s back broke out in cold sweat. His legs went soft, and he actually knelt on the ground.
“Mr. Guthrie…”
Zalden and the others were stunned for a moment, then they quickly ran to Mr. Guthrie’s side and helped him up.
After Mr. Guthrie stood up with difficulty, he pushed aside the people beside him and walked to Connor’s side. Like a pug, he respectfully said, “Mr. McDonald, it’s… it’s you.”
When everyone heard Mr. Guthrie’s words, they were incomparably shocked.
However, what was even more shocking was that Connor actually ignored Mr. Guthrie and continued to play with his phone.
Mr. Guthrie didn’t dare to say anything and just stood there quietly.
The atmosphere in the bar suddenly became strange.
Everyone’s faces were filled with doubt and puzzlement. The originally aggressive Mr. Guthrie didn’t dare to speak after seeing Connor, and he even stood respectfully beside Connor.
Connor kept his head down and played his game.
As time passed, the atmosphere in the bar was unusually strange.
After about five minutes, Connor finally passed the level with the equipment he bought.
After passing the level, Connor put down his phone and stretched his back. He smiled and said to Mr. Guthrie, “The two of us are quite fated to actually meet here…”
“Indeed… We’re indeed quite fated…”
Mr. Guthrie replied in despair. He didn’t even know how to describe his feelings.
Never in his dreams would he have thought that he would run into Connor even though he had already moved to Newtown.
“Looks like the previous incident hasn’t taught you a lesson. You’re still so arrogant now!”
Connor continued.
“No, I won’t dare…”
Mr. Guthrie was so frightened by Connor’s words that his legs went soft, and he almost knelt in front of Connor again.
Seeing this so-called Mr. Guthrie being scared to this extent, he could only smile helplessly, not knowing what to do.
Connor felt that he and Mr. Guthrie were actually quite fated, because everything he was experiencing now seemed to have started from this person.
And this person was none other than Brandon Guthrie, who had snatched Mandy Hines from Connor!
Even Connor himself didn’t expect to meet an old acquaintance like Brandon in Newtown.
When Brandon found out who Connor really was, he chose to drop out of the Porthampton University and came to Newtown to stay with his relatives.
Brandon was just an ordinary rich younger generation. Naturally, he didn’t have as much power as Connor. It was absolutely impossible for him to drop out of Porthampton University and go to another school. Therefore, he relied on the living expenses given by his family to fool around in Newtown.
However, Brandon’s luck was still pretty good. After coming to Newtown for less than two months, he got to know Peyton Ledger, and then became Peyton’s lackey for a period of time. As Peyton’s power gradually expanded, Brandon also became a little famous in Newtown.
Some time ago, Brandon took out a few million from his family and opened this bar.
Peyton symbolically announced that this bar was opened by him and Brandon.
Brandon originally thought that he could finally stand firm in Newtown, but he did not expect that he would meet the person he was most unwilling to meet.
Brandon even wondered if Connor had deliberately come to Newtown to find trouble with him. Otherwise, he was all the way here in Newtown, so how was it that he would meet Connor here?
“Just now, I said that I wanted to break your friend’s legs. Do you have any objections?”
Connor asked Brandon with a smile.
“No, no…”
Brandon didn’t even think about it and quickly shook his head at Connor.
At this time, everyone could feel the abnormal fear on Brandon’s face, and his legs were constantly trembling.
Everyone couldn’t understand what was going on. Why did the arrogant Mr. Guthrie act like he had seen a ghost when he saw Connor?
Justin stood rooted to the ground with a stiff expression, not knowing what was going on.
Sonia’s eyes flashed with a trace of shock. She suddenly realized that they might have underestimated Connor’s identity. His background must be very shocking, otherwise Brandon would not be so afraid.
The others were all dumbfounded. They had no idea what was going on.
“You don’t have to be so nervous. What happened back then is already in the past. No matter what, the two of us can be considered old acquaintances. To be able to meet again in Newtown is like meeting an old friend in a foreign land. I won’t do anything to you…”
The current Connor no longer had any hatred toward Brandon, so he softly comforted Brandon.
“…”
When Brandon heard Connor’s words, he was in disbelief and couldn’t help but look at Connor.
“Alright, today is the opening day of your bar. You should go do what you have to do.”
Connor waved his hand gently at Brandon.
“I can go now?”
Brandon looked at Connor and couldn’t help swallowing his saliva as he asked in disbelief.
“Of course…”
Connor nodded.
Brandon instantly felt a sense of relief. Without any hesitation, he turned around and left with his men.
After seeing Brandon and the others leave, everyone revealed a puzzled expression, as if they couldn’t understand what was going on.
Just now, it was clearly Brandon who came to find trouble with Connor, but now it was more like Connor was looking for trouble with Brandon.
Mr. Guthrie, who was previously boasted by everyone to have a heaven-defying background, had actually become such a coward in front of Connor?
For a moment, everyone present felt that their brains weren’t able to comprehend what was going on.
After hesitating for a moment, Kaira could not help but turn to look at Connor. She asked him with a very puzzled expression, “Connor, what’s going on? Do you know the owner of this bar?”
“Yeah, Connor. What’s going on? I heard that Mr. Guthrie knows Peyton, so why was he so afraid of you just now?”
Justin also hurriedly asked Connor.
…

chapters.title: Chapter 1050: I'll Send You Back!
chapters.content:
Chapter 1050: I’ll Send You Back!
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Connor knew that Justin and the others would definitely be curious about his relationship with Brandon.
Therefore, he took the initiative to explain, “Actually, Brandon and I were both students of the Porthampton University before…”
“You were students from the Porthampton University?”
Justin said with a complicated expression.
“That’s right, and Brandon dropped out of school because of me. Although you all feel that he is quite powerful in Newtown, he is actually nothing in Porthampton. Otherwise, he wouldn’t have come to Newtown because he couldn’t survive in Porthampton…”
Connor said lightly.
After hearing Connor’s words, everyone seemed to understand what he meant.
The reason why Brandon left Porthampton was because he had offended Connor.
This meant that Connor had a conflict with Brandon before, which was why Brandon was so afraid of Connor just now.
“Connor, your family is actually so powerful?”
Justin said to Connor in surprise.
“It’s not very powerful. It’s just an ordinary small family…”
Connor said lightly.
“Being able to chase someone like Brandon out of Porthampton is already very impressive…”
Kaira said softly.
“That’s right, if it were me, I wouldn’t have such ability!”
Justin said.
When Connor heard everyone’s words, he smiled helplessly and did not say anything.
At this moment, everyone looked at Connor with a different gaze. Previously, they thought that Connor was just an ordinary person without any shocking background.
However, only now did they know that Connor’s family was actually so powerful. Connor was actually the one who kept the lowest profile.
They finally understood why he was so arrogant just now. It was because he was not acting tough. It was because Connor had the power to be so arrogant.
Sonia glanced at Connor faintly. Although Connor didn’t say clearly what his family did, to be able to drive a young master like Brandon out of Porthampton, his family was either a family of official standing or someone with a dark background. Otherwise, it would definitely not make Brandon so afraid.
However, Sonia felt that there was still a gap between Connor and her ex-boyfriend. If she had to choose, Sonia still felt that her ex-boyfriend was more powerful.
Although everyone’s impression of Connor had changed, they were not too shocked. After all, he was able to come to Newtown University as an exchange student. This was enough to prove that Connor’s family had some strength.
Moreover, because of what happened just now, Connor instantly became the focus of the bar. It was as if everyone treated Connor as a rich second generation with an amazing background. The beautiful women in the bar also took the initiative to approach Connor. These beautiful women were very attractive in terms of looks and figures. Ordinary men would definitely not be able to resist such temptation.
However, Connor was very calm when these beauties tried to hit on him. He had no intention of talking to them at all.
After he rejected many beauties one after another, those who had thoughts about Connor gave up.
Connor fell silent again.
After hesitating for a moment, Justin said to Connor in embarrassment, “Connor, this glass of wine is for you. I misunderstood you just now. I’m sorry…”
Actually, Justin said this because he wanted to apologize to Connor.
This was because when Kaira was persuading Justin, he had thought of giving up on Connor.
He really didn’t dare to go against people like Brandon and Peyton Ledger, but seeing that Connor was fine now, he was naturally very ashamed.
“It’s okay. We’ve only known each other for a few days. I don’t expect you to know me well!”
Connor didn’t mind these things at all and said with a smile.
In fact, Connor could feel that Justin was a good person. If it wasn’t for Kaira’s reminder, Justin would definitely stand on Connor’s side.
Therefore, it could be seen from this that a woman had a great influence on a man.
Kaira looked at Connor with an extremely awkward expression on her face. She did not know what to say.
“Connor, what does your family do?”
Brooks raised his wine glass and asked Connor with a smile.
When Connor heard Brooks’s words, he slowly raised his head and looked at Brooks. Then, he said indifferently, “My family runs some ordinary businesses…”
“Don’t lie to us. If your family runs ordinary businesses, why is Brandon Guthrie so afraid of you…”
Brooks replied casually, then continued to ask, “Connor, tell me the truth. Are your parents officials?”
“No…”
Connor lightly shook his head.
“Underworld bosses?”
Brooks continued to ask.
“My family really runs ordinary businesses…”
Connor said exasperatedly.
“Brooks, if Connor isn’t willing to tell you, don’t ask…”
Justin could naturally tell that Connor was somehow reluctant for some reason, so he called out softly.
“Alright, then…”
Brooks nodded helplessly and continued, “Connor, what does your fiancée look like? We’ve known each other for so long, but we haven’t seen your fiancée. When are you going to bring your fiancée over to meet us?”
“She’s not in Newtown right now. Let’s meet again in the future!”
Connor replied with a smile.
When Sonia heard Connor’s words, she subconsciously glanced at him. She suddenly had a strange feeling in her heart, but she didn’t say anything.
Everyone acted as if nothing had happened. They drank and chatted leisurely.
Of course, when Brandon found out that Connor hadn’t left, he sent a lot of good wine to Connor. Moreover, when Justin paid the bill, Brandon chose to pay for it, which was even more surprising.
After drinking, everyone planned to return to school.
Justin and Kaira naturally would not go to the dormitory. The two of them were going to stay in a hotel outside.
Brooks was also prepared to bring Ruth Copeland to the hotel for the night.
Joel was a more honest person. He did not choose to bring Sia Jennings to the hotel. The two of them were going to return to school.
For a moment, only Connor and Sonia were left.
Although Connor didn’t have a good impression of Sonia, there were only the two of them left.
Connor was also embarrassed to ignore her, so he took the initiative to say to Sonia, “Let me send you back!”
“If you don’t wish to send me back, don’t force yourself…”
Sonia’s lips curled into a smile, looking particularly charming under the dim light.
“No matter what, you’re Justin’s friend. I’d better send you back. Otherwise, I’ll feel guilty if you encounter any danger!”
Connor looked at Sonia and said calmly.
Sonia smiled and didn’t reject Connor.

chapters.title: Chapter 1051: Meeting Zayn Again
chapters.content:
Chapter 1051: Meeting Zayn Again
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Five minutes later, Connor and Sonia stood by the roadside, waiting for a car.
Sonia instinctively turned her head and glanced at Connor. She felt that the boy in front of her was incredibly mysterious because he held so many secrets.
“Is your identity not as simple as you claim?” she took the initiative to ask him.
“Does this question matter?” he replied expressionlessly, then continued, “My identity is just a friend of Justin. It seems to have nothing to do with you…”
“You…” She looked at him with a helpless expression on her face because she felt his words were somewhat offensive.
“I know what you’re thinking. If I had an amazing identity, maybe you would pursue me willingly. But if my identity isn’t as good as you expect, you might still give me a chance!” Connor paused for a moment, then continued, “But in fact, I have no interest in you at all because I already have a fiancée who surpasses you in both figure and appearance. So, you don’t have to waste your time on me. There are plenty of guys in Newtown who meet your requirements…”
“The more you say that, the more curious I am about your fiancée!” she couldn’t help but sneer.
“She is a woman you can never compare to in your lifetime!” he said bluntly.
“You…” she was speechless again.
After all, no matter what kind of woman, she didn’t want to admit that she was inferior to others.
But at this moment, a white BMW suddenly stopped in front of Connor.
The car door opened, and a young man got out of the car.
When Sonia saw this young man, her mouth couldn’t help but widen, and her expression appeared shocked.
“Zayn?” She recognized the young man who came out of the BMW at a glance.
And this young man was none other than the one Connor met on the plane, the pursuer of Salma.
Sonia had met Zayn when she attended a party with her boyfriend. Although he was very humble in front of Salma, the Fergerson family he belonged to also held significant influence in Newtown.
The Fergerson family’s assets had long exceeded one billion, and they were the largest automotive parts manufacturer in Newtown.
In Sonia’s eyes, someone like Zayn could be considered one of the top rich second generations in Newtown, even surpassing her ex-boyfriend.
At this moment, he got out of the car and approached Connor. After taking a glance at Connor, he whispered, “Why are you still in Newtown?”
“Zayn actually knows Connor? It seems that Connor’s identity is not simple!” Sonia couldn’t help but exclaim in her mind. Her facial expression was exceptionally nervous, and she couldn’t say a word.
“Why does it concern you whether I’m still in Newtown or not?” Connor calmly replied to Zayn.
“Kid, why are you so arrogant in front of me? Do you know who I am? If you don’t know, I advise you to find out. I’m sparing you any conflicts because of Salma’s face, but I hope you leave here soon. I don’t want to see you again!” Zayn listened to Salma’s words. He didn’t actively look for trouble with Connor.
And today, he just happened to encounter Connor by coincidence.
After threatening him, Zayn turned around and planned to leave.
“I advised you to first understand my identity. If you dare to speak to me with that tone again, I’ll break your leg!”
But in the instant Zayn turned around, Connor suddenly spoke up.
“What did you say?”
Zayn swiftly turned around, his expression filled with anger as he asked.
“I said if you dare to talk to me like that again, I’ll break your leg!”
Connor said calmly.
“You think that Salma’s protection makes you untouchable?!”
Zayn charged directly towards Connor, reaching out to grab his collar.
“Smack!”
Before he could grab Connor’s collar, Connor swiftly slapped him.
Zayn couldn’t even comprehend what had just happened as his body flew backward.
Sonia was shocked to see this scene, her expression filled with astonishment.
Because she hadn’t even fully processed the shock of Connor knowing Zayn, and Connor had already slapped Zayn away.
It should be noted that even in the entire Newtown, there were few people who dared to treat Zayn like this!
Connor, with a disdainful look, glanced at Zayn and coldly said, “I can’t be threatened by a small cat or dog like you. Today’s slap is a lesson for you. If there’s another time, I’ll break your leg directly!”
“You…”
Zayn lay on the ground, his expression incredibly furious. He seemed surprised by Connor’s audacity.
Clearly, Connor’s personality had undergone a significant change.
Although he still wanted to conceal his identity, it didn’t mean he would continue to endure as before.
Sometimes, he felt that the simplest and most direct way to deal with people like Zayn was to take action.
Of course, his attack on Zayn wasn’t a momentary impulse but a response to the expression on Sonia’s face when she saw Zayn.
He wanted to warn Sonia through this slap that she shouldn’t provoke him. It would be better for her to restrain herself in the future.
Connor wasn’t in the mood to waste time with women like Sonia.
And he didn’t pay any further attention to Zayn. Instead, he turned his head and softly said to Sonia, “Let’s go!”
She was stunned for a moment, then hurriedly followed Connor into the taxi.
“Connor, wait for me. I’ll kill you. I will definitely kill you!”
After seeing them get in the car and leave, Zayn’s expression turned extremely angry as he shouted, then dialed a phone number on his own phone.
“Xander, I need you to find me a few people now. I want to kill someone…”
Once the call was connected, Zayn shouted frantically.

chapters.title: Chapter 1052: How Did You Enter?
chapters.content:
Chapter 1052: How Did You Enter?
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
When Connor and Siona got into the taxi, she remained seated in her position, not saying a word.
After a while, she couldn’t help but turn her head and glance at Connor, her expression appearing very nervous.
She never expected that he would dare to hit someone like Zayn.
This was enough to prove just how terrifying his background was.
After all, in the entire Newtown, there were only a few people who dared to lay a hand on Zayn!
And Connor didn’t hesitate at all.
This scene was extremely shocking!
Although Brandon’s attitude towards Connor in the bar had already shocked her greatly.
But compared to Connor slapping Zayn, there was still a huge difference.
“Connor… Do you know that person from earlier?”
She still harbored a trace of hope in her heart and couldn’t help but softly ask him.
She thought that he might not have known Zayn’s identity, which was why he took action against him.
“I can’t really say that I know him…” he replied casually.
