After hearing Connor’s answer, Siona’s expression visibly eased, and she quickly said, “Connor, let me tell you, Zayn is from the Fergerson family in Newtown. The Fergerson family is a well-known prominent family in Newtown…”
“I don’t care who this Zayn is, and I don’t want to know what the Fergerson family is. No matter how powerful his background is, it won’t be more powerful than mine!”
Connor interrupted Siona’s words very directly.
She stared at him with disbelief.
She couldn’t understand where his confidence came from, to dare speak such words.
“By the way, about me hitting Zayn just now, don’t tell anyone, understood?”
Connor continued to say while looking at Siona.
Meanwhile, she stared at him in silence.
“If you dare to speak out about this, I guarantee you’ll have a miserable end!” he added.
“Can you tell me who you really are?”
Siona took a deep breath and asked Connor softly.
“Is it so important to you who I am?” he said indifferently.
“But…”
Siona seemed like she wanted to say something more.
“We’ve arrived at Newtown University. You can get off now…”
Connor didn’t give Siona a chance to speak and pointed to Newtown University outside the car window, expressionless.
After hesitating for two seconds, she took a deep breath, then reached out and pushed open the car door, walking away.
At this moment, she was filled with curiosity about Connor, but she also knew that he didn’t want to explain these things to her.
And someone like him was definitely not someone she could afford to offend, so Siona could only let go of her doubts and walked towards the direction of the dormitory on her own.
After seeing Siona get off the car, Connor sighed lightly, then told the taxi driver the address of his own home.
About half an hour later, the taxi arrived at the entrance of the residential area.
Upon entering the residential area, Connor noticed that his Mercedes-Benz was still parked in the parking space.
The Toyota sedan that had been blocked by Connor earlier was nowhere to be seen.
This indicates that although he gave the key to the girl named June, it seems that she didn’t choose to drive the car away.
Because for this week, the Mercedes-Benz has been parked in this parking space all the time.
And Connor never saw June again.
He didn’t think much about it and went straight into the community.
After all, a Mercedes-Benz worth hundreds of thousands of dollars was nothing to him, and he didn’t want to waste time on this matter.
A few minutes later, he finally returned to his own home and opened the door with the key.
At the moment the door opened, he instantly froze, a hint of shock flickering in his eyes.
Because at this moment, the lights inside his house were actually on.
And on the television, a very melodramatic youth idol drama was playing.
He stood dumbfounded at the door, subconsciously thinking that there might be a burglar in his house.
Because Connor vividly remembered that he had turned off the lights when he left, and since he moved into this house, he had never turned on the TV.
But what made him even more incredulous was that there were still some girl’s belongings placed in his house.
“Could it be?”
A bold idea suddenly flashed through Connor’s mind.
“Creak!”
However, at this moment, the bathroom door was suddenly pushed open.
“Connor, you’re back?”
An extremely familiar voice came from inside the bathroom.
Connor looked at the woman standing at the bathroom door with an incredulous expression on his face.
His premonition was correct. The person standing at the bathroom door was none other than Rachel!
She should have just finished bathing, wearing only a black lace nightgown, her dark hair casually draped over her shoulders.
A naturally beautiful face, smooth and delicate, like a ripe apple that makes people want to take a bite. The fullness of her chest was faintly visible, and her long and fair legs were exposed in the air. She was also wearing a pair of pink slippers on her feet, giving the impression of a blooming lotus, exceptionally charming.
If it were any other man, seeing Rachel, such a beauty, in such a state in his own home, would definitely be very excited.
But he couldn’t feel any excitement at the moment. On the contrary, his expression was still very distressed.
“How did you find my house? And how did you get in?”
Upon hearing his words, she couldn’t help but smile faintly, and then said softly, “Connor, have you forgotten who I am? Is it difficult for me to enter your house?”
He was stunned for a moment, then looked at Rachel and continued to ask, “Didn’t I tell you that you can’t stay in my house? How did you still come over?”
“I only know you in Newtown, if I don’t come to find you, who else should I go to?”
Rachel replied lightly to him, then sat directly on the sofa.
Connor quickly rushed to her side and said in a distressed tone, “Can you stop messing around? Isn’t it difficult for you to rent a house outside?”
“I’m just staying in your house for a few days, is it too much trouble for me to go out and rent a house?”
“Don’t worry, I won’t do anything to you. I’m just staying for a few days, not long!”
She crossed her legs and sat on the sofa, her tone alluring.

chapters.title: Chapter 1053: News About Freya
chapters.content:
Chapter 1053: News About Freya
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
“You won’t do anything to me?”
After hearing Rachel’s words, Connor couldn’t help but take a deep breath.
Then he sighed inwardly, “You won’t do anything to me, but I can’t guarantee that I won’t do anything to you, right?”
If she appeared dressed like this in another man’s house, they would have taken advantage of her a long time ago.
“No, no matter what, you can’t stay at my house. If you stay here, I’ll move out…”
Connor shouted at Rachel, feeling agitated.
“You can move out if you want, but I suggest you stay here!” she said casually.
“Why?” he asked after a moment of confusion.
“Because, according to the information I received, it seems that Rockefeller’s side already knows that you’re in Newtown, but they haven’t confirmed if the news is true. If you go out to live now, you might be discovered by Rockefeller’s people. Once they know you’re in Newtown, all your plans will be in vain…” she said with a smile.
“You…”
He was dumbfounded when he heard her words. The expression on his face was speechless, and for a while, he didn’t know what to do.
“Connor, I advise you to stay here honestly. Otherwise, if word gets out, things will become even more troublesome!” She continued.
“Then why can’t you go out and live? I didn’t agree to live with you. Why did you move in without permission?” he shouted in a frustrated manner.
“If you really want to drive me away, you can, but if you want me to help you investigate Percy’s matter, then forget it. You can investigate it yourself!”
Rachel threatened directly.
Connor looked at her and was instantly stunned in place.
Although her living in his house would indeed bring him some trouble.
But for now, news about Percy is definitely the most important.
If he waits for Reena’s investigation, who knows how long he’ll have to wait. Connor also has some understanding of Rachel’s abilities, so he thinks that if Rachel can help, it would definitely be the best choice.
“What have you decided?”
She asked him with a smiling face.
“Fine, if you want to live here, then stay. But it can’t be for too long, and you better hurry up and investigate Percy’s matter!”
He reluctantly agreed to her request to stay here.
“That’s about right…”
She smiled satisfactorily, then picked up the remote control and turned off the TV. She then walked gracefully towards her room.
He watched her figure and his eyes flashed with helplessness.
Although he had many rooms in his house, her presence still felt strange to him.
A few minutes later, he entered the bathroom.
After entering the bathroom, he realized that it was already filled with Rachel’s various cosmetics.
Connor couldn’t understand why a woman would have so many cosmetics.
He quickly took a shower and then returned to his room, preparing to rest.
After returning to his room, he lay on the bed alone, tossing and turning, unable to fall asleep for a long time.
He felt that she was indeed a bit strange.
He could never understand what she was thinking in her heart, nor did he know what she really wanted to do.
But he could feel that Rachel staying in his house at this moment was definitely not solely because his house wasn’t renovated. Rachel must have some other motive for moving in.
But no matter how long Connor thought, he still couldn’t figure out why Rachel decided to move in.
“Ring, Ring…”
Just then, Connor’s phone suddenly rang.
He picked up his phone and glanced at it. It turned out to be a call from Benson. Without hesitation, he quickly answered the call.
“Mr. Benson, do you have any news about my fiancée?”
Connor asked excitedly.
“Mr. Connor, I just received some information. Miss Freya will arrive at Newtown Airport tomorrow night!”
Benson said directly.
“Is it true?”
Connor shouted with great excitement.
“It should be true because the day after tomorrow morning, Travio Corporation will hold a board meeting. She is the president of Travio Corporation, and she will definitely attend this shareholders’ meeting…” he replied.
“Good, thank you. I will have someone transfer the money to you…”
Connor tried to suppress his excitement and said in a low voice.
“No need to thank me. I just helped a little…”
Benson happily laughed when he heard that Connor wanted to send money.
Without continuing to talk nonsense with Benson, Connor hung up the phone, then sent a text message to Thomas, asking him to transfer the money to Benson.
After finishing all this, he sat on the bed, his expression filled with excitement.
Because he had been waiting for so long, he finally managed to bring Freya back.
After hesitating for a moment, Connor directly dialed Priscilla’s phone number and informed her about bringing Freya home.
After learning this news, Priscilla immediately booked a flight for tomorrow morning and estimated that she would arrive in Newtown around two o’clock in the afternoon.
After finishing the call with her, he lay alone on the bed, recalling the scenes when he first met Freya and everything that happened afterward.
These events flashed through Connor’s mind like a slideshow, one after another.
HIs excitement at this moment was beyond words. He even thought about what he would say to her when he sees her tomorrow.
After an unknown amount of time, he slowly fell asleep with this excited mood.
The next day, at 7 o’clock in the morning.
He woke up early and took out his phone to check, but there was no new message.
At this time, Rachel had also woken up.
Since she didn’t have classes today, after finishing her morning exercise, Rachel specially bought two breakfasts and sat alone in the dining room to eat.
“Don’t you have to go to class today?”
She asked softly as she saw Connor coming out of the bedroom.
“I’m not going to class today. I have something to take care of!”
He replied with a very good mood, then picked up his car keys and planned to leave.
“Connor, I bought breakfast for you. Don’t you want to eat?”
Rachel called out hurriedly as she saw him about to leave.
“No need, I’m not eating…”
He hurriedly replied, then pushed open the door and ran out.

chapters.title: Chapter 1054: Reunion!
chapters.content:
Chapter 1054: Reunion!
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
After Connor left home, he drove his newly purchased car directly to Newtown Airport.
Although he knew that Freya would not arrive in Newtown until 8 p.m.
But after he learned the news of her return, he had no mood to do anything else.
So he decided to wait directly at the airport until she returned.
Connor parked his car in the parking lot and sat alone in the waiting hall, watching the crowds coming and going, feeling that time was passing very slowly.
“Ring… Ring…”
Just at that moment, his phone suddenly rang.
Connor picked up his phone and glanced at it. It was a call from Justin.
“Hello?”
Connor answered the phone directly.
“What time is it now? Why haven’t you come to class yet?”
Justin asked in a low voice.
“I have something today, so I won’t go… ”
Connor replied.
“Did you ask for leave?”
Justin continued to ask.
“I did…”
Connor had already communicated with the president of Newtown University through Thomas, so no one would bother him even if he didn’t go to class.
“That’s fine. Do you have any urgent matters? Do you need my help?”
Justin asked with great concern.
“No need, it’s just a personal matter. Don’t worry about me!”
Connor said lightly.
“Okay, if there’s nothing else, I’ll hang up!”
Justin replied hastily, and then hung up the phone directly.
After Connor saw the call end, he continued to sit in the hall and wait.
In the late afternoon, Priscilla got off the plane and found Connor in the waiting hall.
“Priscilla, you don’t have to come so early. You could have come tomorrow…”
Seeing her looking tired, he couldn’t help but say.
“It’s okay. I’m really worried about Freya’s situation now. It’s better to see her earlier to feel more at ease!”
Priscilla replied softly to Connor, then sat down next to him.
Looking at her, he couldn’t help but sigh in his heart. It seemed that in this world, only the both of them truly cared about Freya.
Even Freya’s parents might not know that their daughter had already returned to the country.
They sat in the waiting hall, waiting for the whole afternoon.
Connor looked at his phone and found that it was already past 7 p.m. Freya’s flight should be arriving in Newtown soon.
His originally calm mood became excited again, and Priscilla was also full of anticipation.
But what they both didn’t expect was that her flight was mysteriously delayed.
The flight that was supposed to arrive in Newtown at 8:10 p.m. was delayed to after 9 p.m.
They had no choice but to go to the airport’s restaurant to eat something and continue waiting.
At 9:30 p.m.
A flight from abroad to Newtown finally arrived safely at Newtown International Airport.
Connor and Priscilla eagerly looked forward, one after another, passengers walked out of the airport, but they didn’t see Freya’s figure.
His emotions became extremely complicated at this moment. He didn’t know if he was excited or nervous. Various emotions intertwined.
A few minutes later, the people in the airport passage began to decrease.
However, Connor and Priscilla still hadn’t seen Freya come out.
The expression on his face began to look somewhat worried. He was afraid that Freya had changed the time and returned.
“Connor, do you think that person is Freya?”
Just then, Priscilla suddenly spoke up and shouted at him.
Upon hearing her words, he immediately turned his head to look.
He saw a graceful woman slowly walking towards the airport exit.
When Connor saw this woman, he stood frozen in place, his expression filled with shock.
Although the woman was wearing sunglasses and a mask on her face, he could still tell that it was Freya!
Seeing Freya again, Connor felt as if he had been enchanted. He stood motionless with a stunned expression.
He watched as she gradually walked out of the airport.
At this point, her demeanor had undergone a significant change. She had light makeup on her face, wearing a black OL skirt and a brown windbreaker. The pencil skirt showcased her perfect figure, and her long, fair legs were fully exposed in the air, making her look exceptionally sexy.
With delicate features, a devilish figure, and a distant and imposing aura.
The present Freya seemed to have stepped out of a TV drama as a domineering female CEO, intimidating to behold.
By Freya’s side was another woman who appeared to be her assistant.
“Freya!”
After a brief moment of shock, Priscilla seemed unable to control her emotions and shouted loudly in the direction of Freya.
Upon hearing Priscilla’s words, Freya instinctively turned her head towards Priscilla’s position.
But to her surprise, the gaze with which Freya looked at her showed no excitement whatsoever.
On the contrary, Freya’s expression was remarkably calm, far from the reaction one would expect from a normal person seeing their best friend.
“What’s going on?”
Priscilla couldn’t help but mutter softly. In Freya’s gaze, she could only see indifference.
She couldn’t understand why Freya would react this way upon seeing her.
With a cold glance at Priscilla, she didn’t hesitate at all. She directly walked towards the airport exit, stepping on her high heels.
“Connor, it seems like Freya doesn’t recognize me anymore.”
Priscilla stammered as she spoke to Connor.
Upon hearing her words, Connor finally snapped out of his shock from seeing Freya.
He quickly said, “It’s impossible. Maybe we were too far away just now, and she didn’t see that it was you…”
“Perhaps,” Priscilla nodded.
However, at that moment, Freya had already walked out of the airport passageway.
Without any hesitation, he rushed towards her position.
“Freya!”
He ran up to her, his tone filled with excitement.
After seeing Connor, Freya instinctively stopped in her tracks and glanced at Connor.
However, the gaze with which she looked at Connor was just as indifferent as the one she gave Priscilla.

chapters.title: Chapter 1055: Don't You Know Me?
chapters.content:
Chapter 1055: Don’t You Know Me?
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Connor and Priscilla never expected that when they saw Freya again, it would be in such a scene!
Freya looked at them with eyes that made them feel like strangers.
Connor was now beginning to doubt if he had found the wrong person!
The woman standing in front of him might just have the same name and a similar appearance as Freya.
But he found it hard to believe that such a coincidence could occur; the chances were too low!
How could the expression in Freya’s eyes towards them be explained?
If she was pretending not to recognize them, her eyes wouldn’t be like that. Such eyes couldn’t be faked.
Moreover, he could sense a significant change in her demeanor compared to before.
“Do we know each other?” she calmly asked Connor.
“Don’t you recognize me?” he asked.
“I don’t recognize you…” She shook her head in confusion.
“Freya, don’t you really recognize Connor? He is your fiancé! Do you have any idea how long we’ve been searching for you?” Priscilla stepped forward, her tone equally excited.
Freya glanced at Priscilla, her expression still very perplexed. She furrowed her eyebrows and said, “Who are you?”
“I am Priscilla, your cousin. Don’t you even recognize me?” Priscilla shouted, feeling somewhat overwhelmed.
“I don’t know both of you, and I don’t have any cousin or fiancé. Are you sure you have mistaken me for someone else?” Freya shook her head, her expression puzzled.
“It’s impossible. How could we possibly be mistaken?” Priscilla couldn’t believe it. She went straight to Freya and reached out to grab her arm.
Freya retreated two steps with caution, and at the same time, her assistant, who had been waiting outside the airport, saw the scene and rushed towards Priscilla as if trying to stop her.
“Stop!” one of the bodyguards shouted coldly.
“You all step aside, or you’ll bear the consequences!” Connor said in a chilling tone to the bodyguards around Freya.
“Who are you?” the leading bodyguard, taken aback by his strong presence, frowned and asked.
“I am her fiancé,” Connor replied calmly.
“Miss Freya doesn’t have a fiancé. Arrest these two!” the head bodyguard shouted and rushed towards Connor.
“Priscilla, leave these people to me!” Connor said to Priscilla and charged towards the bodyguards.
Meanwhile, Priscilla pushed away Freya’s assistant and directly grabbed Freya’s arm, pulling up her sleeve.
And at that moment, they noticed a coin-sized wound on her fair wrist.
When Priscilla saw the wound, she froze in place. She was now one hundred percent sure that the person standing in front of her was Freya. This wound was from when they were little and went to play on the mountain. Freya accidentally fell and cut her wrist on a stone, leaving a scar that remained to this day.
At that time, Freya was afraid of being scolded by her parents, so she specifically asked Priscilla not to mention the incident to anyone.
Only Priscilla knew about the scar on Freya’s wrist, making it impossible for it to be faked.
On the other side, Connor easily dealt with Freya’s bodyguards.
Freya took advantage of the moment when Priscilla was stunned in place and pulled her arm back angrily, shouting, “Who are you two?”
“Freya, don’t you recognize me?” She looked at Freya and asked.
“I don’t know you, and I don’t have any cousin!” Freya shook her head with a wary expression.
“What about Connor? Don’t tell me you don’t recognize Connor either?” She pointed to Connor’s location, her voice filled with despair.
Freya instinctively glanced at Connor, her expression somewhat confused.
But in the end, she shook her head and said, “Sorry, I don’t have a fiancé, and I don’t have any impression of this person either.”
Both Connor and Priscilla were stunned in place almost at the same time. They couldn’t understand what was going on.
Why was Freya standing right in front of them, but she didn’t recognize either of them!
“I don’t know you two, and I don’t want to know who you are. I think you might have mistaken me for someone else, but I hope you both stop bothering me. Otherwise, I’ll call the police!” After seeing them still standing there, she continued, then she walked towards the exit of the airport on her high heels.
When Connor saw she about to leave, he seemed somewhat unwilling.
He quickly grabbed her and exclaimed, “Freya, look at me carefully, don’t you recognize me? I’m Connor…”
“Sorry, I really don’t recognize you. Please let go of me!” she said indifferently.
“You better think again. I’m your fiancé. How could you not recognize me?” He gritted his teeth and shouted.
“You better let go of me right now, or I’ll call the police!” she said coldly without any hesitation.
He tightly held onto her and refused to let go of his hand.
“Lulu, call the police!” Freya turned her head and shouted at her assistant beside her.
Upon hearing these words, the assistant immediately took out her phone to prepare for calling the police.
After seeing the expression on her face, Connor could confirm that she really seemed to have no recognition of him. It seemed pointless to persist in this way.
“No need to call the police. I’ll let go…” He took a deep breath, then slowly released his grip on her.
Freya glanced at him lightly and then walked away without looking back, heading towards the outside of the airport on her high heels.
Connor and Priscilla looked at the familiar yet unfamiliar figure of Freya, their eyes filled with endless confusion and disbelief.
Because they never expected that after finally finding Freya, it would end up like this.

chapters.title: Chapter 1056: The Terrifying Rachel Wallace!
chapters.content:
Chapter 1056: The Terrifying Rachel Wallace!
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Newtown.
In the airport lobby.
Freya walked out of the airport without looking back, while Connor and Priscilla stood there with puzzled expressions.
At this moment, the two of them could not understand what was going on.
“Connor, why doesn’t Freya recognize the two of us?” Priscilla asked with a desperate expression.
“I don’t know either…”
Connor lightly shook his head.
“I can confirm that the person just now was Freya! I don’t know why, but the way she looks at us is like…it’s like she doesn’t know us. What’s going on?” Priscilla whispered.
After hesitating for a moment, Connor said in a low voice, “Priscilla, do you think Freya might have lost her memory?”
“Memory loss?”
Priscilla looked at Connor with a surprised expression.
“That’s right, amnesia!” Connor nodded and continued, “Since you are certain that the two of us did not find the wrong person, but Freya does not remember us at all, it can only prove that she must have lost her memory…”
“Why would she lose her memory so suddenly?” Priscilla asked in confusion.
“I don’t know why either, but I know that her memory loss must have something to do with her becoming the general manager of Travio Corporation and her disappearance during this period of time…” Connor said softly.
Hearing Connor’s words, Priscilla’s face was filled with worry and anxiety. “Then what do you plan to do next?”
“I’ll go to Travio Corporation to look for her tomorrow…”
Connor’s tone was firm.
“She probably won’t see you again, right?” Priscilla said helplessly.
“She doesn’t want to see me, but I have a way to see her…” Connor replied expressionlessly, then continued, “Priscilla, you don’t have to worry too much. No matter what, the two of us have finally found Freya. Although she may not know the two of us now, we can be sure that she’s not in any danger, at least. As for the rest, we can take our time to deal with it.”
“Alright then…”
After Priscilla heard Connor’s words, her mood instantly improved.
She felt that Connor was right, even though the current outcome was somewhat different from what the two of them had expected.
But no matter what, it was good that Freya was fine.
…
Connor drove Priscilla to a five-star hotel in Newtown and then drove back home alone.
When he got home, he found Rachel sitting alone on the sofa watching TV.
Rachel turned her head to look at Connor and asked him softly, “Connor, what did you do today? Why are you back so late?”
When Connor heard Rachel’s words, he couldn’t help but be stunned for a moment. Then, he walked up to her and said in a very serious tone, “Can you help me with something?”
“Help you?”
Rachel’s eyes flashed with a trace of confusion, but she could see that Connor didn’t seem to be in a good mood at this time, and his tone was also very serious.
“What is it?” she asked softly.
“I need some shares in Travio Corporation. It doesn’t need too much. As long as I’m qualified to participate in the board meeting, it’ll be fine. However, time is a little tight. I need to get it done before eight o’clock tomorrow morning!”
Connor knew that it would not be easy for him to see Freya again. After all, he had beaten up her bodyguard, so the people around her would definitely be on guard.
Furthermore, Connor felt that if he went to look for Freya rashly, it would only make her even more vigilant.
Connor had heard from Benson Sharp that Freya had returned to attend the shareholders meeting. Since that was the case, Connor could attend the board meeting as a shareholder of the Travio Corporation. That way, he would be able to meet Freya.
Originally, Connor planned to get Thomas to solve this matter. However, after further consideration, he thought that since Thomas was based in Porthampton, his influence on Newtown was limited.
Moreover, the time was so tight that Thomas might not be able to settle it. That was why Connor thought of asking Rachel for help.
“Why are you suddenly interested in Travio Corporation?”
Rachel asked.
“You don’t have to know so much. Just tell me whether you want to help or not!” Connor said in a low voice.
“Connor, have you ever seen someone beg for help like you? If you really want me to help you, you have to tell me what happened before I can consider it!”
Rachel indifferently replied.
After taking a deep breath, Connor told Rachel everything about Freya.
After listening to Connor’s story, she roughly understood what was going on. She lightly said, “Actually, I shouldn’t be helping you with this matter. After all, it doesn’t seem to have much to do with Rockefeller. However, I’ll help you this once since you’re sincere towards Freya…”
“Really?” Connor did not expect Rachel to agree so readily.
“Yes, really. When have I ever lied to you?”
Rachel smiled, then picked up her phone and started making a call.
Connor sat beside Rachel nervously.
About half an hour later, Rachel put down the phone and said to Connor, “Alright, I’ve already helped you settle your matter…”
“That quickly?”
“You now have 3% of the shares of Travio Corporation’s Oprana branch. This amount of shares is not much, but it’s enough for you to attend their shareholders meeting. As for the share transfer contract and the transaction, you can deal with it when you have time…”
“…”
Connor looked at Rachel in front of him, incredibly shocked. He felt that this was really a little too unbelievable.
Originally, Connor thought that this matter would be very difficult to handle, but he never expected that Rachel could wipe her hands of the issue in less than half an hour.
Connor felt that this woman was really too mysterious!
Whether it was Porthampton or Newtown, Rachel’s power was so terrifying!
“Ms. Wallace, who are you?”
Connor asked in disbelief.
Rachel turned her head and glanced indifferently at Connor, after which she softly said, “You don’t need to know who I am yet. It won’t be too late for me to tell you when you’ve grown strong enough to deal with Rockefeller…”
Connor looked at Rachel and smiled helplessly. Then, he turned around and returned to his room.

chapters.title: Chapter 1057: Shareholders' General Meeting
chapters.content:
Chapter 1057: Shareholders’ General Meeting
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
After Freya left the airport, she took a car back home.
Freya was the new president of the Travio Corporation, so the place she lived in would definitely not be bad.
She lived alone in a two-story villa that was nearly 800 square meters.
The interior of the villa was also exceptionally luxurious.
After Freya reached home, she took off her high heels and walked into the bathroom barefooted.
Half an hour later, Freya walked out of the bathroom in a bathrobe. At this moment, her pretty face was flushed red and she looked exceptionally beautiful.
She sat on the balcony chair, poured herself a glass of red wine, and looked up at the scenery outside.
Freya swirled her glass of red wine absentmindedly, but her mind was still thinking about the scene of her meeting Connor at the airport.
“Why does that person look so familiar to me?”
Freya’s eyes flashed with a hint of doubt.
Although Freya had said that she didn’t know Connor and Priscilla at the airport, she had never heard of them before.
But in fact, when Freya saw Connor for the first time, she couldn’t help but feel like she’d seen him somewhere before, but she couldn’t remember who he was.
“Is that person really my fiancé?”
Freya couldn’t help but mutter under her breath. The expression on her face grew more and more doubtful.
However, she soon rejected this idea and said softly, “Impossible. If this person is really my fiancé, why didn’t I see him when I was hospitalized? How could he not know that I lost my memory? Besides, I’ve lived abroad since I was young. How could I have a fiancé in Oprana?”
After saying this, Freya turned around and picked up a document. She then read it carefully and did not continue thinking about Connor.
…
The next day, at six o’clock in the morning.
Connor woke up early in the morning. After washing up, he left home.
When Connor drove to Travio Corporation, it was already past seven in the morning.
At this moment, there were many luxury cars in the parking lot under the corporation building. After all, today was the shareholders’ meeting of the Travio Corporation. Any one of the shareholders of the Travio Corporation was worth more than 100 million dollars.
Therefore, when Connor drove the Toyota into the parking lot, he was immediately chased out by the security guards.
Because the parking lot was prepared for the shareholders, Connor was too lazy to argue with the security guard. He drove his car out of the parking lot and parked it at a random spot on the side of the road.
After parking the car, Connor went straight to the lobby on the first floor of Travio Corporation.
Benson Sharp knew that Connor had become a shareholder of Travio Corporation, so he was waiting anxiously for him.
When Benson saw Connor, he quickly greeted him with a smile and said respectfully, “Mr. McDonald, you’re finally here…”
At this moment, Benson looked at Connor as if he was looking at the God of Fortune. Previously, he had only provided Connor with Freya’s flight information, and Connor had then asked Thomas Morgan to transfer 20 million to Benson’s account.
This was equivalent to Benson’s salary for two years. How could he not be happy?
“Take me to the conference room!”
Connor said to Benson expressionlessly.
“Alright, alright…”
Benson quickly nodded and took Connor to the shareholders’ office.
At this moment, the office was already filled with people, all of them shareholders of Travio Corporation.
However, when they saw Connor, they all revealed puzzled expressions. After all, they did not know Connor.
Seeing this, Benson took the initiative to introduce Connor’s identity to the shareholders. When the shareholders found out that Connor had bought 3% of Travio Corporation’s shares, they were all shocked.
Although 3% of the shares did not sound like a lot, most of the shares of the Travio Corporation were actually controlled by the people at the Travio headquarters.
Most of these shareholders did not even have 1% of the shares, and it was already very impressive to have 5% of the shares.
Moreover, Connor was still so young, but he actually had so many shares. This meant that Connor’s background was definitely not simple.
For a moment, all the shareholders present took the initiative to curry favor with Connor.
Connor could only helplessly deal with these people.
Eight in the morning.
Freya walked into the meeting room with her assistant.
Today, Freya was wearing a black uniform. She looked very capable, and her aura was extraordinary.
When Freya appeared in the meeting room, almost everyone fell silent. They all knew that this woman was not to be trifled with!
Freya sat at the front and started the shareholders’ meeting.
However, Freya accidentally saw Connor sitting below. When Freya saw Connor, she was stunned for a moment, and her expression was very surprised.
She had never expected that Connor would be a shareholder of the Travio Corporation.
However, Freya quickly composed herself and did not continue thinking about it. Instead, she took out some documents and prepared for the meeting.
Connor spent most of his time staring at Freya during the shareholder meeting, completely ignoring what was being discussed.
Connor felt that Freya had indeed changed a lot. Whether it was her aura or some professional business judgment, Connor felt that the female CEO in front of him was not his fiancée.
Connor couldn’t understand what Freya had experienced to have such a huge change!
The shareholders’ meeting lasted for an entire morning. Connor finally waited until the meeting ended.
After the meeting ended, Freya left the meeting room.
Connor hurriedly stood up and followed her.
After Connor caught up to Freya, he asked her with a serious expression. “Freya, can we have a chat?”
Freya turned her head to look at Connor and said indifferently, “I don’t know you. If it’s about work, you can talk to my assistant. If it’s about personal matters, I don’t have time!”
“Freya, I know you don’t remember me now, but I hope you can give me some time to finish what I want to say. Aren’t you curious about what’s going on?”
Connor said excitedly.
“…”
Freya looked at him with a hint of hesitation in her eyes.
In fact, she was also very curious why Connor said that she was his fiancée and why she felt that she was so familiar.
“If you can give me some time, I promise to explain this matter to you clearly!”
Connor proclaimed.

chapters.title: Chapter 1058: You Might Have Mistaken Me For Someone Else!
chapters.content:
Chapter 1058: You Might Have Mistaken Me For Someone Else!
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Freya looked at Connor, and her expression grew hesitant.
Actually, she kept feeling as if she had seen Connor somewhere before.
After all, there was no way to lie about this sense of familiarity!
Freya saw that Connor’s tone was very sincere, and she couldn’t help but take a deep breath. Then, she whispered, “It’s noon break now. I can give you half an hour. There are many people here. Let’s talk in my office!”
“Alright…”
Connor hurriedly nodded after hearing Freya’s words.
Freya glanced at Connor indifferently before walking towards her office. Connor followed closely behind her.
A moment later, Connor and Freya arrived at the office.
Freya took the initiative to pour a cup of tea for Connor before sitting on the sofa. She asked Connor softly, “If you have anything to say now, you can tell me directly!”
“You really don’t remember me?”Connor asked Freya seriously.
“Not at all!”
Freya shook her head gently.
“What about Priscilla? Priscilla Marcus is your cousin. Don’t you know her?”Connor pressed.
“I’m sorry, I don’t have a cousin at all!”
Freya shook her head again.
“Then what do you remember now?”
Connor said helplessly.
“Why are you looking for me?”Freya seemed to be disgusted by Connor’s question and could not help but shout.
Connor also realized that his words were a little abrupt. After all, in Freya’s eyes, Connor was just a stranger. A stranger suddenly asking so many private questions was indeed a little creepy.
He took a deep breath and said in a low voice, “Since you don’t remember me now, and you don’t remember Priscilla either, then I’ll tell you a simple story about the two of us. Let’s see how much you can remember!”
“Then tell me.”
Freya was also curious about why Connor was so persistent in finding her, so she did not stop him.
Connor briefly organized his thoughts and then told Freya everything that had happened between them. Even when Freya chose to leave the country because of Connor’s deception, Connor did not hide anything.
This was because Connor felt that if Freya really did not recognize him because she had lost her memory, then these things were very likely to awaken her memories.
Freya was shocked when she heard what Connor said.
She vaguely felt that Connor was not lying. She could feel from Connor’s tone and expression that he was very serious.
Freya calmed herself down and said softly, “The story you told is very touching, but I think you might have mistaken me for someone else!”
“I didn’t get the wrong person. I’m 100% sure that you’re my fiancée!”
Connor replied directly.
Freya smiled helplessly, “You just said that I’m Philips Manor family. My father is Sean, and my mother is Laura Crawford, right?”
“That’s right!”Connor nodded lightly.
“But I’m not from the Philips Manor at all. I’ve lived in the U.S. since I was young. I’ve never been to the Phillips Family Estate you’re talking about. Also, my father’s name is Hatcher Phillips, and my mother’s name is Camila Yearwood. They’re not the two people you’re talking about…”
Freya said calmly.
When Connor heard Freya’s words, he was instantly dumbfounded. His expression was extremely incredulous.
“Is what you said true? Are you lying to me?”
Connor stuttered.
“Why would I lie to you about this? My mother is the vice president of the Travio Corporation’s main company, and my father has his own company in the U.S. That’s why I’m here in the Travio Corporation’s branch in Oprana, “Freya said seriously.
“That’s impossible…”Connor shouted excitedly.
“This is the truth!”
“That’s impossible. Your father is Sean. I’ve met your parents before!”
Connor called out once more before asking Freya, “Did someone tell you what you just said, or is it your real memory?”
“That’s…”
Freya looked at Connor with a hint of hesitation.
Seeing that, Connor hurriedly asked, “Someone else told you all this, right? You actually don’t remember who you are at all, right?”
Freya took a deep breath and said softly, “You’re right. A few months ago, I was in a car accident. When I woke up, I lost my memory. My mother told me all these things!”
“…”
Connor looked at Freya in front of him and could not help but laugh bitterly. At this moment, he finally understood what was going on.
It turned out that the reason why Freya had been missing for so long was because she had lost her memory in a car accident. Then, a group of people suddenly appeared and pretended to be Freya’s parents, creating a fake identity for her.
Because Freya had lost her memory, she could not remember what had happened back then. Naturally, she took those people’s words as the truth.
However, what Connor could not understand was what the other party’s intentions were.
The parents that Freya mentioned were all rich people. There was no reason to make up such an excuse to deceive Freya!
Connor could only think of one possibility, and that was that the person who deceived Freya was probably Rockefeller’s people.
They were obviously using this method to control Freya and Connor.
Thinking of this, Connor could not help but feel a chill in his heart.
An unprecedented fear engulfed him, but he tried his best to calm himself down.
“Freya, I think you’ve been deceived!”
“Deceived?”
Freya frowned slightly.
“That’s right, you were deceived. You’re not Hatcher Phillips’s daughter at all. Your father is Sean!”
Connor said firmly.
“Impossible, I think you’re the liar!”
Freya shook her head at Connor.

chapters.title: Chapter 1059: Blood Relationship
chapters.content:
Chapter 1059: Blood Relationship
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
“I’m not a liar! Why would I lie to you?”
When Connor heard Freya call him a liar, he immediately shouted excitedly.
“Why would you lie to me?”
“That’s right!”Connor nodded.
“Then tell me, why did my parents lie to me?”
Freya paused for a moment before continuing, “My father is a wealthy businessman in the the U.S., and my mother is the vice president of the Travio Corporation. They have no reason to lie to me. Moreover, when I woke up, the first people I saw were the two of them. Also, you keep saying that Sean is my father, so why hasn’t he contacted me?”
“This…”
Connor’s eyes flashed with a hint of helplessness. He did not know how to explain Freya’s current situation.
However, Connor had to wake Freya up. Otherwise, Freya would keep being manipulated by Rockefeller’s people.
“You’re my fiancée. In order to deal with me, they pretended to be your parents. It might be difficult for you to understand what I’m saying, but what I said is true!”Connor explained.
“Do you have any evidence?”Freya asked.
“I don’t have any evidence, but they’re definitely not your parents…”
Connor shook his head helplessly.
However, Freya’s words reminded Connor of something. He snapped his fingers. “Yes, evidence!”
“…”
Freya didn’t say anything.
“Freya, listen to me. There are two identities in front of you right now, right? One is what I said, and the other is what you think!”
Connor said.
“Yes!”
Freya nodded.
“Although I can’t prove that you’re my fiancée, and I can’t prove that everything I said is true, can Hatcher Phillips and the others prove that what they said is true?”Connor asked.
“Hm…”
Freya looked at Connor quietly.
“Then the only evidence that can prove your identity now is your blood relationship!”
Connor said excitedly.
“Blood?”
Freya looked at Connor strangely.
“That’s right. If I can prove that you’re Sean’s daughter, then does that mean that what I said is true? If you’re not his daughter, then it means that what Hatcher Phillips and the others said is true!”Connor continued.
“What you said seems to make sense…”
Freya bit her lip, her eyes starting to look lost.
“That’s easy. Come back to Porthampton with me now. As long as we find Sean and do a DNA test, everything will be revealed…”
Connor stood up and pulled Freya as he spoke.
“…”
Meanwhile, Freya sat on the spot without moving. She could not trust Connor fully, nor was she sure he was a good person.
Freya said cautiously, “I think the method you suggested is fine, but there’s no need for me to go there personally. You can ask Sean to come over and do a DNA test with me…”
“There’s no time. If Rockefeller’s people find out that I’m here for you, they will definitely try their best to stop this. I have to take you away now!”
Connor said anxiously.
“But…”
Freya opened her mouth to speak.
“No buts. Aren’t you curious about your background at all? Don’t you want to know who your biological parents are? If I’m not your fiancé, why would I spend so much time on you…”Connor shouted.
“Even if what you said is true, I can’t leave with you because I still have work to deal with!”
Freya shook her head lightly as she looked at Connor.
“Have you not figured out what is going on…”
Connor completely collapsed. After hesitating for a moment, he took out his phone and dialed Priscilla’s number. Then, he said, “Wait a moment, I want to show you something…”
Freya didn’t say anything.
“Hello, Connor, what’s wrong?”
Priscilla answered the call quickly and asked in a tired voice.
“Priscilla, help me find some photos of Freya and you now. Also, a family portrait of Freya’s family is fine. As long as it can prove her identity, it will be fine!”
Connor said quickly.
“Alright, I understand…”
Priscilla naturally understood what Connor meant. She immediately agreed and hung up.
Soon after, Connor received the photos from Priscilla.
There were many of them, but they were all related to Freya.
Connor passed his phone to Freya and whispered, “Now, take a look at these photos. Is that you?”
Freya hesitated for a moment before taking the phone and looking at it carefully.
A few seconds later, Freya’s gaze turned strange.
When she first started, Freya felt that the person in the photo was indeed her, but it could also be photoshopped. It could also be that the other party just looked a little like her.
However, Freya felt that the scenes in these photos were very familiar. They gave off the same sense of familiarity as Connor did.
Freya also began to doubt whether Connor’s words were true.
“You kept saying that you are Hatcher’s daughter. Then let me ask you, do you have a photo with him and his wife?”
Connor’s tone was still very confident because he felt that if the other party was really working with Rockefeller, then Freya definitely did not take a photo with him.
Connor’s words completely shocked Freya. Freya’s fair little hands started to tremble slightly. She suddenly realized that she had never seen a photo of her with Hatcher and Camila before.
“…”
Freya hesitated for two seconds. Then, she whispered, “I’ll go to Porthampton with you now!”
“Alright, then the two of us will set off now!”
After seeing Freya agree, Connor was very excited and hurriedly reached out to pull her away.
Freya subconsciously dodged and whispered, “I’m going to call my assistant and tell her…”
“Alright! You can make the call!”
Connor nodded again.
At this moment, Connor felt that since Freya had chosen to follow him to Porthampton, it meant that Freya had begun to believe in him.

chapters.title: Chapter 1060: Are We Being Followed?
chapters.content:
Chapter 1060: Are We Being Followed?
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
It was obvious that Freya was starting to doubt her own identity.
She felt that there were many things that she could not find a reasonable explanation for.
For example, Hatcher said that she had lived in the U.S. for nearly 20 years, but Freya realized that she had no friends there at all.
On the contrary, when she returned to Oprana, she ran into Connor and the others. Moreover, those photos could also explain some problems.
Also, although Freya had lost her memory, some habits would never change.
Moreover, Hatcher and Camila didn’t understand their own habits at all.
At first, Freya thought that it was because she had lost her memory that her personality had changed. She did not take these things to heart.
However, after hearing Connor’s words, Freya was completely awake.
Freya also wanted to go to Porthampton to confirm things and to find out what was going on.
Freya took out her phone and dialed her assistant’s number. She then told her assistant that she was leaving Newtown and told her about all the work she had to do.
While Freya was on the phone, Connor asked Priscilla to book two plane tickets for him.
After Freya finished handing over all her work, she whispered, “We can set off now…”
“Alright…”
Connor nodded and walked out of the office.
Freya looked at Connor’s back and felt a sense of familiarity. She quickly composed herself and said, “Wait for me outside!”
“Is there anything else?”
Connor was stunned for a moment before asking.
“I’ll change my clothes. Wait for me outside!”
Freya said softly.
“Ah…”
Connor nodded and walked out of the office.
A few minutes later, Freya changed into a set of casual clothes and walked out.
Connor could not help but be stunned.
At this moment, Freya was wearing a white slim-fit short skirt and a yellow shirt with spaghetti straps. Under the short skirt, her beautiful legs were wrapped in stockings, and she was wearing a pair of high heels. Her pretty face had light makeup on, but even so she was still very sexy and charming.
In Connor’s impression, this Freya was his fiancée, and that female CEO with an astonishing aura was not his fiancée at all.
“We can leave now…”
Freya whispered.
“Alright…Alright…”
Connor hurriedly nodded and walked out of Travio Building.
After Connor and Freya left the Travio Building, they got into Connor’s Toyota and drove towards the airport.
However, Connor did not know that not long after the two of them left, Freya’s assistant took out her phone and dialed an overseas number.
“President Phillips left with a boy. I don’t know where they went!”the assistant said carefully.
“What’s the boy’s name?”The other party hurriedly asked.
“He’s called Connor McDonald…”the assistant said softly after recalling Connor’s name.
“…”
When the other party heard the name “Connor McDonald, “he was obviously stunned for a moment. Then, he slowly said, “I understand…”
After saying this, the other party hung up the phone.
…
On the other side, Connor was driving towards Newtown Airport.
At this moment, Connor knew that Newtown was no longer safe. He had to bring Freya back to Porthampton as soon as possible.
Freya, on the other hand, had a puzzled look on her face as she asked Connor softly, “You are a shareholder of Travio Corporation, so you should be very rich. Why are you driving such a car?”
“I don’t want others to know my identity!”Connor hurriedly replied.
“Oh, I see…”
Freya nodded thoughtfully before continuing, “Am I really your fiancée?”
“Yes!”
Connor nodded and smiled, “When we first met, you didn’t know that I was very rich. At that time, you even had to give me 20,000 dollars a month for living expenses!”
“Really?”
Freya looked at Connor with surprise.
Actually, Freya had a good impression of Connor. She didn’t know where this good impression came from, but it was there.
This was also the reason why Freya chose to follow Connor in the end.
When Connor saw that Freya did not seem to remember any of this, he began to talk to her about what had happened between them.
When they talked about Freya choosing to go abroad because Connor had lied to her, Connor apologized very seriously and then explained in detail why he had done that back then.
At this moment, not only was Freya not angry, she seemed to agree with Connor’s words.
This was because Freya felt that Connor had only gotten together with her because of the engagement in the beginning. Later on, he really developed feelings for Freya, so it was understandable for Connor to hide these things.
After Connor heard Freya’s words, his mood instantly improved.
But immediately after, his expression turned serious. He then whispered, “Freya, the two of us are being followed…”
“What?”
Freya was stunned when she heard that.
“Look at the Mercedes-Benz behind us. Has it been following us?”Connor continued.
Freya quickly turned around and observed the car for a few minutes. She was sure that the black Mercedes-Benz had been following them closely.
“Could it just happen to be going the same way as us?”Freya said softly.
“We’ll know if it’s on the way. Sit tight!”
Connor replied indifferently.
Freya hurriedly adjusted her position when she heard Connor’s words. Connor suddenly sped up.
When Connor sped up, the Mercedes-Benz behind him also sped up.
Moreover, when Connor turned, the Mercedes-Benz also turned. It kept a fixed distance from Connor and the others, which meant that the car was indeed following them.
“They really seem to be following us. What should we do now?”
Freya asked Connor nervously.
“This is the city, and there are a lot of cars on the road. If I drive too fast, there’s a high chance of an accident, and it’ll also be easy to hit passersby. I’m driving to the suburbs now to see if I can get rid of these people…”
Connor said softly after hesitating for a moment.

chapters.title: Chapter 1061: No Way Out
chapters.content:
Chapter 1061: No Way Out
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
“Why do you need to shake them off? Can’t we just go straight to the airport?”
Freya asked with a puzzled expression.
“They know that we’re going to the airport, so they must have sent people to ambush us at the airport. The two of us can only drive back now, or board the plane somewhere else!”
Connor said in a low voice.
“Alright then, we’ll do as you say!”
Freya hurriedly nodded.
Connor narrowed his eyes and looked at the Mercedes-Benz behind him through the rearview mirror.
He secretly analyzed who the opponent was to himself.
After all, Connor had many enemies now. It was likely that they would come to find trouble with Connor.
Of course, it was also possible that Rockefeller’s people knew that Connor had taken Freya away and wanted to stop him.
“This Mercedes-Benz belongs to our company!”
But at this moment, Freya suddenly said to Connor.
“Your company’s car?”
Connor couldn’t help but take a deep breath after hearing Freya’s words. He then whispered, “Looks like someone doesn’t want me to take you away!”
“…”
Freya looked at Connor and didn’t say anything.
At this moment, Freya also felt that something was not right. If she was really Hatcher Phillips’s daughter, then there was no need for the people in the company to follow her.
The other party’s current actions were obviously stemming from a guilty conscience!
‘Is this person really my fiancé?’
Freya subconsciously turned and glanced at Connor. A strange look flashed across her eyes.
Connor naturally did not have the mood to pay attention to these things. All he was thinking about now was how to shake off these people.
A few minutes later, Freya realized that there were fewer and fewer cars on the road, and the buildings were also becoming sparse. This meant that the two of them were gradually moving away from the city.
“Freya, sit tight. I’m about to accelerate!”
Connor whispered to Freya.
“Alright…”
Freya was stunned for a moment before she hurriedly nodded.
Connor did not hesitate at all and stepped on the accelerator.
In an instant, the car was like a wild horse that had escaped from its reins, charging straight ahead.
The car sped along the road. Connor could feel that Freya, who was sitting in the front passenger seat, was still very nervous. However, she didn’t make any sound.
In fact, if Connor was alone, he would not have to worry at all. After all, he was extremely strong. It would not be a problem for him to deal with a few ordinary people.
However, Freya was still by Connor’s side. If he could not shake off these people, Freya might be in danger.
The speed of the car was constantly increasing, but Connor’s driving skills were average. He did not drive often, so the Mercedes-Benz behind him was constantly on his tail.
“We can’t seem to shake them off!”
Freya couldn’t help but whisper to Connor.
“It’s fine…”
Connor opened his mouth and was about to say something when he suddenly saw two vans rushing toward them.
It was obvious that the other party knew that Connor was coming here, so they asked the two vans to wait for him here.
Connor had no choice but to brake.
The car had been stopped in the middle of the road. There was a Mercedes-Benz behind it and two vans in front.
Connor and Freya were pincered by the three cars. A hint of helplessness flashed across Connor’s eyes.
“Connor, what should we do now?”
Freya’s eyes flashed with a hint of nervousness as she could not help but ask Connor softly.
“I don’t know.”
Connor replied in a low voice and then began to observe the surrounding environment.
“Connor, these people must be here for me. If you let me get out of the car and go back with them now, they won’t do anything to you!”
Freya said after a moment of hesitation.
“No way…”
Connor shook his head and continued, “Now that the other party already knows of my existence, if I let you go now, I won’t be able to see you again in the future. You will never be able to get back your memories.”
Freya looked at Connor, and for some reason, a hint of trust flashed across her heart.
At this moment, Freya felt that Connor was the person she trusted the most.
The door of a van opened, and a middle-aged man got out.
The middle-aged man was at least 1.9 meters tall. His shoulders were as broad as mountains, and his figure was very burly.
Moreover, Connor felt that this middle-aged man’s skills were very terrifying. He could tell from the way he walked.
More importantly, Connor knew that these people had guns in their hands. If he really fought with these people, he would definitely die.
After all, as the saying goes, no matter how good your martial arts skill is, you can be taken down with one shot!
No matter how good Connor’s skills were, it was absolutely impossible for him to be a match for a gun!
“The person in the car, let Miss Phillips get off the car. If not, don’t blame us for what happens next!”
At this moment, the middle-aged man suddenly shouted at Connor.
“That’s right. As long as you let Miss Phillips down now, we will let you go. Otherwise, you’ll die today!”
The other middle-aged man pointed his gun at Connor, as if he would shoot at any time.
This road was extremely desolate. There were no cars passing through at all.
This meant that the other party must have blocked the road. Otherwise, it would be impossible for there to be no cars for such a long time.
“Connor, let me go. I’ll go with these people…”
Freya hesitated for a moment before calling out to Connor.
“No!”
Connor directly shook his head and refused.
“Then, what do you plan to do now? There are at least six people in the three cars. Also, they have guns in their hands. If you continue to drag this out, you will definitely die…”
Freya shouted anxiously.
“We still have a chance…”
Connor said lightly.
“Chance?”
Freya was stunned for a moment before asking with a puzzled expression, “What chance?”
“See that road?”
Connor pointed at a small path not far away.
At this moment, there was a fish pond on Connor’s left hand side, and on the other side of the fish pond was a dirt road. This dirt road was obviously designed for people to pass through, so it was very narrow. It was basically the width of the car itself. Moreover, there was no guardrail on the side of the road. If one was not careful, they might fall into the fish pond with the car.
“Connor, are you crazy?”
Freya asked Connor in disbelief with her big, watery eyes.
“There’s no other way. This is the only way for us now. Roll down the window. If you really fall into the water, you can get out through the window…”
Connor whispered back to Freya.

chapters.title: Chapter 1062: Are You Concerned About Me?
chapters.content:
Chapter 1062: Are You Concerned About Me?
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
When Freya heard Connor’s words, her expression was one of disbelief.
“Connor, you’re going to get us both killed!” she shouted in a low voice.”
“You won’t die. I know how to swim. I can swim with you when the time comes!”
Connor replied in a low voice.
Freya was still a little worried about Connor’s risky actions. She could not help but say, “Connor, is there really no other way now?”
“Yeah…”
Connor shook his head helplessly and continued, “Be prepared!”
After saying this, Connor stepped on the accelerator and rushed toward the middle-aged man.
The middle-aged man was indeed an expert. When he saw Connor’s car rushing toward him, a strange look flashed across his eyes. Then, he suddenly flashed to the side and dodged Connor’s car.
Seeing the middle-aged man dodge, Connor immediately turned the steering wheel.
The car rushed toward the path beside the fishpond.
Freya seemed to be afraid, so she nervously closed her eyes. On the other hand, Connor was very serious.
Just as the car was about to rush into the fishpond, Connor pulled the handbrake and turned the steering wheel. Something unbelievable then happened. The right side of the car was lifted off the ground, while the left side was tightly pressed against the wall.
The car sped past the small road in a cool manner.
When Freya opened her eyes again, she realized that she and Connor were already safe.
Freya’s expression was one of disbelief as she stammered, “Connor, how did you do that?”
“I don’t know either. I did it based on how I felt!”
Connor replied indifferently.
In fact, Connor really didn’t know how he did it. He completely relied on luck because at that time, he didn’t have any other choice.
After rushing through the small road, the car arrived at another road and drove straight on crazily.
The people who had been following Connor were all stunned when they saw this scene. They didn’t expect him to be able to escape in such a way.
“Is this kid a professional racer?”
One of the men stuttered.
“Shut it! This kid must really want to die…”
The middle-aged man in the lead said in a low voice. Then, he took out his phone and dialed a number. He said expressionlessly, “That brat has escaped from my side. He should be heading in your direction. Think of a way to stop this brat…”
“Alright, I got it!”
The other party replied indifferently and hung up the phone.
“Let’s continue chasing him. This kid won’t be able to leave Newtown today!”
The middle-aged man put down his phone and shouted with a serious expression.
Everyone got into the car and chased after Connor.
It was obvious that the other party had already determined all of Connor’s routes, so they had arranged for someone to be on every path he could possibly take. This way, no matter where he escaped to, they could stop him.
This was not the first time these people had done such a thing. On the contrary, they were a very professional assassin team. All of them were martial artists, and each of them had amazing skills. Moreover, they had modern weapons, so they had never failed.
After Connor and Freya got rid of the other party, he was clearly much more relaxed. Freya still hadn’t recovered from what had just happened because she felt that what happened just now was way too dangerous.
“We should be safe now, right?”
Freya hesitated for a moment before asking Connor softly.
“Yeah…”
Connor nodded lightly.
“That’s good. I was almost scared to death just now. What you did was way too dangerous! You can’t do this again in the future…”
Freya complained worriedly.
“Are you concerned about me?”
Connor turned to look at Freya and asked softly.
“No… I’m in the car too, okay?”
Freya replied, seemingly not saying what she meant.
“Haha…”
Connor could not help but laugh when he heard Freya’s words. Then, he subconsciously looked up at the rearview mirror.
He was in disbelief as the two people he had shaken off were on their tails again.
Freya seemed to have noticed the people behind them as well, and she shouted in surprise, “How did these people catch up so quickly?”
“Their cars have all been modified. My car can be driving on a regular basis, but it’s too slow in comparison…”
Connor instantly realized what was going on.Update by n0vgo. co
After all, a family car worth more than 100,000 dollars could not be compared to a professionally modified car. At this time, Connor regretted driving this car.
He had no other choice but to continue driving straight on.
However, after driving for a while, Connor suddenly felt that something was wrong.
This was because he realized that there were mountain roads ahead. If the other party blocked the road ahead, he and Freya might really have nowhere to go.
Sure enough, after Connor had driven less than ten kilometers, two white vans stopped in the middle of the road.
Because the mountain road itself was very narrow, it could only allow two cars to pass at the same time.
However, at this moment, the two vans were in the middle of the road. Unless Connor could fly, he could not pass through.
Connor took a deep breath before turning to Freya and whispering, “Freya, I’ll get out of the car and deal with the people in front of us. You stay in the car and don’t move, you understand?”
“Can you deal with so many people alone?”
When Freya heard Connor’s words, a trace of shock flashed across her eyes as she asked in disbelief.
“Don’t worry, I should be able to deal with them!”
Connor said lightly.
“Alright, then…”
Freya hesitated for a moment before nodding her head gently. If Connor could not deal with these people, she could use her identity as the president of Travio Corporation to make these people let Connor off. Therefore, Connor’s life would not be in danger.
The car rushed straight toward the location of the van.
However, just as the car was about to hit the van, Connor suddenly stepped on the brakes, pushed open the door, and jumped out of the car.
After getting out of the van, Connor dashed toward the young man standing in front of the van at an astonishing speed.
Connor knew that the other party was a martial artist, so he didn’t hold back at all and ruthlessly punched the young man’s face.
Before the young man could react, he was sent flying.
When Freya, who was sitting in the car, saw this scene, she hurriedly covered her mouth and exclaimed, “Connor, are you alright?”

chapters.title: Chapter 1063: Hiding!
chapters.content:
Chapter 1063: Hiding!
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Although Connor had never fought with these people from Travio Corporation before, Connor could feel that these people were definitely professionals from their tracking skills.
Otherwise, they would never have made such a meticulous plan.
Freya sat in the front passenger seat, her big watery eyes filled with shock and confusion.
Because she did not expect that the seemingly weak and gentle Connor would actually have such terrifying combat strength!
After Connor sent the first young man flying, he immediately heaved a sigh of relief.
Although these people were professional killers, there was still a huge gap between them and the killers in Rockefeller.
That was because the people from Rockefeller were all martial artists. Any one of them had very shocking combat strength.
At this moment, the people Connor was facing were just some ordinary people. At most, they were a little stronger than ordinary people.
The people standing in front of the van were also shocked by Connor’s skills.
Each and every one of them stood rooted to the ground, dumbfounded. They had even forgotten to attack Connor.
Connor was not in the mood to waste time with these people, so he rushed toward the second young man, then raised his fist and smashed it at the young man’s head. The young man’s reaction speed was quite good. In his panic, he actually dodged Connor’s punch and then planned to counterattack.
Bang!
However, Connor did not give the young man a chance to attack at all. He raised his leg and kicked the young man’s stomach fiercely.
The young man’s body flew out in an instant and smashed into the car. Then, he fainted.
In less than half a minute, Connor had knocked down two people, and there were still three people left.
“He’s good. Let’s attack together!”
One of the young men shouted expressionlessly and then rushed toward Connor.
Seeing that these people were ready to gang up on Connor, Freya became nervous. Her gaze was fixed on Connor, who was standing outside the car.
In an instant, the three of them rushed in front of Connor.
It was actually very easy for Connor to deal with these three people. He didn’t need to use his full strength at all. He first easily dodged the young man’s fist, then grabbed the young man’s hair and pressed down hard.
Bang!
There was another loud bang.
The young man’s head smashed into the van’s windshield, causing it to explode. Freya, who was in the car, could not help but scream.
At the same time, outside the car, Connor had finished off the second young man almost at the same time.
All of this happened too suddenly. In front of Connor, the four strong men were like four primary school students. In less than two minutes, they had all been knocked out.
Freya felt that everything that she was seeing now was a little unreal. She felt that everything that she had encountered today was like a dream. From the words that Connor had said to her, she felt that everything was so unreal, and this scene was also very surreal.
Originally, there were only five people in the van. These five people thought that Connor was just an ordinary person, so they thought that it would not be difficult for the five of them to deal with him. However, no one expected Connor’s skills to be so terrifying.
At this moment, there was only a young man standing in front of the van. The young man was deeply shocked by Connor’s skills. He looked terrified, and his entire body kept trembling. He felt that Connor was a monster.
“…”
Connor looked at the young man indifferently. He originally planned to let the young man leave.
However, Connor changed his mind. If he let this young man go, his and Freya’s whereabouts would definitely be exposed.
So for safety reasons, Connor walked toward the young man.
“Don’t come near me!”
The young man shouted when he saw Connor walking toward him.
As for Connor, it was as if he did not hear the young man’s words and continued to walk toward him.
After all, at this moment, this young man couldn’t pose any threat to Connor.
“I told you not to come over!”
However, at this moment, the young man suddenly roared and took out a gun from his clothes. The black muzzle was aimed at Connor’s head.
When Connor saw the gun in the young man’s hand, he subconsciously stopped in his tracks.
After all, no matter how powerful Connor was, he was definitely not a match for a gun. If he really forced the young man into a corner, he might really shoot.
“Kid, I admit that I’m not your match, but I came here for Miss Phillips today. If you let her go now, I will let you go. Otherwise, don’t blame me for what’s going to happen next!”
When the young man saw that his gun had shocked Connor, he seemed to be less scared. He threatened Connor in a low voice.
“Look behind you!”
When Connor heard the young man’s words, he replied calmly.
“…”
The young man was stunned for a moment, but he did not turn around. Instead, he glanced behind him from the corner of his eye.
However, just as the young man was distracted, Connor seized the opportunity and rushed in front of the young man.
By the time the young man reacted, Connor was already right in front of him.
Connor’s fist landed directly on the young man’s face, and the young man was instantly sent flying.
Connor then raised his leg and kicked the young man’s head. Before the young man could react, he fainted.
Seeing that the young man had fainted, Connor didn’t have time to think too much. He turned around and ran to the car door. He reached out to open the car door and said to Freya, “Get out of the car!”
Freya was stunned for a moment before she got out of the car and asked him worriedly, “Connor, are… are you alright?”
“I’m alright. I’m sure there’s more of them. They will probably catch up soon. The two of us can’t stay here any longer. We have to hurry up and leave!”
Connor wasn’t in the mood to explain too much to Freya and said in a very serious tone.
“But the road ahead has already been blocked. How are the two of us going to leave this place?”
Freya looked at the mountain road ahead and said anxiously.
“We definitely can’t drive out of here. Our only way is to go into the mountain. When these people leave, we’ll return to Porthampton!”
Connor observed his surroundings. He felt that entering the mountain to hide was probably the best option.

chapters.title: Chapter 1064: It’s So Itchy!
chapters.content:
Chapter 1064: It’s So Itchy!
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Connor knew very well that the people from Travio Corporation were still nearby.
Therefore, he and Freya had to leave right away. Otherwise, once those people caught up, no matter how good Connor’s skills were, he would definitely not be their match.
Freya was now aware of the danger, so she did not hesitate at all and followed closely behind Connor in her high heels.
Freya looked at his back with complicated feelings.
She could feel that what he said before might be true.
Otherwise, why would the company be so nervous when Connor left with her and why would they hire so many people to chase after them?
Freya didn’t know how to describe her feelings. She felt that everything was like a dream.
The sky was already darkening. Connor and Freya had just walked for a short distance when Connor saw a car light not far away.
” Someone is catching up with us.”
Connor said to Freya with a serious expression.
“Connor, why don’t you hand me over to them? As long as I return with them, they will definitely not make things difficult for you…”
Freya said softly to Connor after hesitating for a moment.
“No, I have to bring you back to Porthampton!”
Connor replied without thinking.
“But I’m worried that you’ll encounter danger. Those people just now were all armed…”
Freya hurriedly said.
“…”
After hearing Freya’s words, Connor could not help but take a deep breath, and he became serious.
Although Connor’s skills were very good, if he encountered a hot weapon, no matter how good Connor’s skills were, it would be useless.
Previously, these people were careless and did not put him in their eyes. That was why Connor had the opportunity to take them all down.
However, if these people caught up and saw that their own had fallen, they would definitely guess that Connor’s skills were very good. It was very likely that they would shoot Connor. At that time, no matter how good Connor’s skills were, it would be useless.
Furthermore, he had Freya by his side.
Therefore, his only way out now was to walk into the mountain and think of a way to get rid of these people.
“Connor…”
At this moment, Freya opened her mouth to speak.
“President Phillips is here. Hurry up and chase after them!”
“Hurry…”
However, before Freya could say anything, a shout came from behind them.
“Hurry up and run…”
Knowing that these people had caught up, Connor did not hesitate at all. He grabbed Freya’s hand and quickly ran into the mountain.
Because of the urgency of the situation, Connor didn’t think too much about it.
However, when Freya’s hand was grabbed by Connor, a strange feeling suddenly arose in her heart.
For some reason, she felt that this felt very familiar, but she could not understand why it was so familiar.
As Connor was dragging Freya, her speed was obviously much faster.
Connor and Freya ran in the mountains for nearly half an hour. Because Freya was wearing high heels today, even with Connor holding her hand, it was still very strenuous for her.
“Ah…”
At this moment, Freya suddenly cried out.
Connor turned around and saw that Freya had fallen to the ground.
Perhaps it was because Connor was running too fast, Freya had a hard time keeping up. Moreover, Freya was wearing high heels today.
Due to her speed, and the fact that the mountain path was not easy to walk on, the heel of her high heels snapped, and Freya fell to the ground.
“Are you alright?”
Connor hurriedly helped Freya up and asked with a worried expression.
“My heel is broken. Why don’t you go on ahead? I’ll go back with them…”
Freya said helplessly to Connor.
“I can’t let you go back with them…”
Connor replied in a low voice and then began to observe the surrounding environment.
He knew in his heart that it was indeed not a solution to continue running like this.
After all, Freya’s stamina was limited. If she continued running, even if she didn’t sprain her ankle, she would definitely be caught by others.
“Let’s hide here!”
At this time, Connor suddenly found a hillside in front of him, and behind the hillside was a large patch of weeds. If someone was hiding inside, it would be difficult to find them.
“Are there bugs here?”
Freya looked at the spot Connor was pointing at, and she looked a little worried as she spoke softly.
“I don’t think so. Don’t worry!”
Connor replied indifferently, then dragged Freya and ran toward the bushes.
“Get down!”
Connor shouted in a low voice and then lay on the ground.
Freya didn’t want to go back with these people. She also wanted to know her identity. Therefore, even though she was very afraid, she still chose to lie down beside Connor.
Connor turned and glanced at Freya, then stared fixedly at the area in front of him.
Although their current position was very safe, Connor did not dare to relax at all, because once they were discovered, he had to react immediately.
A few minutes later, about five or six strong men rushed to the empty space in front of Connor and Freya.
“Where did they go?”
“Yeah. They were clearly here just now…”
“Don’t worry, they couldn’t have gone far. They should be nearby. Let’s look for them…”
After exchanging a few words, the few men split into groups of two and began to search for footprints.
However, when they saw that there were no footprints in front of them, and there were no traces of anyone having been there, they knew that Connor was hiding.
Connor did not expect these people’s tracking skills to be so good.
However, this was not what worried Connor the most. What worried him the most was that Freya had moved for some reason.
Fortunately, those brawny men did not pay attention to them. Otherwise, they would definitely discover Connor and Freya hiding here.
Seeing that Freya still wanted to move, Connor hurriedly held her hand tightly.
Freya, on the other hand, was looking at Connor with a strange expression. She bit her lips tightly, and she seemed to be in pain.
“…”
Connor looked at the expression on Freya’s face and felt even more puzzled.
“What’s wrong with you?”
Connor whispered to Freya.
“It’s so itchy…”
Freya replied softly with a flushed face.

chapters.title: Chapter 1065: The Solution
chapters.content:
Chapter 1065: The Solution
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
“Itchy?”
When Connor heard Freya’s words, he was instantly stunned. A hint of confusion flashed across his eyes.
Freya seemed a little shy because she felt that it was a little strange to say this.
However, when she got down on the ground just now, she did not notice that there were many ants on the ground.
These ants had all climbed onto her body, and an unbearable itch instantly engulfed Freya’s body.
Connor didn’t know what was going on, so after hesitating for a moment, he said in a low voice, “Hold on for a moment. They will leave very soon…”
“Alright…”
Freya looked at Connor and whispered back.
Connor didn’t continue to talk to Freya. Instead, he focused his attention on the people from the Travio Corporation. He realized that these people were searching very carefully. No matter which corner it was, they wouldn’t let it go easily.
If these people were given a little more time, they would definitely discover Freya and Connor’s location.
Therefore, Connor felt that he could not continue waiting here to be captured. After thinking for a moment, he suddenly turned to Freya and said, “Hide here and don’t move. I’ll go and lure these people away…”
When Freya heard Connor’s words, she did not seem to understand what was going on. He suddenly stood up and ran in the opposite direction of Freya.
