The people from Travio Corporation were instantly attracted by Connor and turned to look at him.
“It’s that brat! Capture him now…”
One of the young men reacted very quickly and shouted at the top of his lungs.
Everyone immediately gave up on the search. After confirming Connor’s position, they began to chase after him.
Connor knew that these people all had guns in their hands. Moreover, there were so many of them. If there was a head-on conflict, Connor’s chances of winning were not high. Therefore, he did not plan to fight these people right now. Instead, he began to lead these people around in the forest.
Connor’s speed was not something that the people from Travio Corporation could compare to. In less than ten minutes, Connor successfully shook off all these people.
After getting rid of these people, Connor returned to the spot where Freya was hiding.
However, when Connor saw Freya, he realized that she was squatting on the ground alone. Her hands were reaching into her clothes and scratching non-stop. She seemed to be in pain.
“What’s wrong with you?”
Connor hurriedly ran to Freya’s side and asked her softly.
“My body is itching everywhere. When I was lying on the ground just now, there must have been ants crawling on my body…”
Freya looked at Connor and explained helplessly.
After hearing Freya’s words, Connor finally understood what was going on. He also understood why she was acting this way. It was because of the ants.
Thinking of this, Connor couldn’t help but feel a little guilty.
He was the one who had made Freya hide in the grass. If not, those ants would not have climbed onto Freya’s body.
“Then, what should we do now?”
Connor looked at Freya’s discomfort and seemed a little anxious.
After all, there were so many ants crawling on her body. Connor felt terrified just thinking about it.
“I don’t know what to do either. I’ve already gotten rid of a lot of them just now, but there are still many ants on my body…”
Freya looked at Connor helplessly.
“…”
Connor looked at Freya and hesitated for two seconds. Then, he suddenly remembered that he had watched some man vs. wild documentaries and hurriedly said, “Ants are the most afraid of water. If only we can find water now…”
“Really?”
Freya asked in a puzzled tone.
“Yeah…”
Connor hurriedly nodded.
“But there’s no water here.”
Freya observed her surroundings and said in despair.
“This is a mountain. There must be a small stream or lake. Let’s go and look for it. This is the best option we have now…”
Connor said in a low voice.
Freya looked at Connor and said helplessly, “Alright then, this is the only thing we can do now…”
After saying that, Freya stood up and followed him.Upd@te by novg0.co
Connor was scouting ahead while Freya followed closely behind him.
However, the two of them had only walked less than 200 meters when Freya could not hold on any longer.
Because the heel of Freya’s high heels had broken, it was very inconvenient for her to walk. In addition, there were many ants on her body, so it was even more uncomfortable for her to walk.
Connor turned to look at Freya and asked softly, “What’s wrong?”
“My feet hurt a little.”
Freya whispered to Connor.
“Then, I’ll carry you!”
When Connor saw the pained expression on Freya’s face, he walked up to her and said softly.
“The road here is not easy to walk on. Are you sure you can carry me?”
Freya looked at Connor and asked softly.
“Yeah, I’m very strong…”
Connor looked at Freya and smiled faintly, speaking in a very casual tone.
Although Freya felt a little guilty, she knew that if she continued to stay here, she would be discovered by those people very soon.
More importantly, her body was very itchy now. If she did not hurry up and find a water source to get rid of the ants, she would definitely not be able to hold on for long.
“You’re so light. It shouldn’t take much effort for me to carry you. Hurry up and get up!”
Connor seemed to have noticed Freya’s concern as he smiled at her.
After hesitating for a couple of seconds, Freya finally chose to let Connor carry her and continue walking forward.
Perhaps it was because of the Essence Cultivating Pill, Connor’s strength was not something that ordinary people could compare to. Therefore, even if he carried Freya on his back and advanced through the rugged mountain road, it was not difficult for him.
Freya lay on Connor’s back and could not help but recall what had happened between her and him. She suddenly had a strange feeling.
Although she couldn’t remember if she knew him before, he gave her a familiar feeling. More importantly, everything Connor was doing now didn’t seem like something a bad person would do.
‘Is he really my fiancé?’
Freya could not help but think to herself.

chapters.title: Chapter 1066: Freya’s Doubts
chapters.content:
Chapter 1066: Freya’s Doubts
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Deep in the mountains.
Connor carried Freya on his back and walked for almost ten minutes.
Although ten minutes is not a long time, it was extremely difficult for her.
Because the ants on her body kept crawling around, and this feeling was unbearable for an ordinary person!
However, she was quite lucky. Not long after they walked, he actually discovered a lake.
Although the lake was not very large, it was enough to help her get rid of the ants on her body.
“Put me down quickly…”
After seeing the lake, Freya shouted eagerly at Connor as if she had seen the source of life.
He gently put her down, and she immediately jumped into the lake.
Once in the lake, she swam like a mermaid, gracefully and with great coordination.
Freya’s swimming skills were really good. She looked very elegant, and her movements were very coordinated.
Connor stood quietly on the shore, looking at her in the water, and a hint of trance flashed in his eyes.
The gentle moonlight shone on the lake, and she looked like a fairy in the water, enchanting and captivating.
But at that moment, she suddenly disappeared from Connor’s sight.
He instinctively became nervous and hurriedly shouted, “Freya…”
“Splash!”
After hearing Connor’s shout, she raised her head out of the water, shook her hair, and revealed her delicate and beautiful face.
He was instantly relief.
“Connor, it’s very comfortable swimming in here. Do you want to come down?” she asked him with a smiling face.
“Forget it…”
He replied lightly, then continued, “You should come out too. It’s not very hot now, and you might catch a cold…”
“Okay…”
After hearing his words, she nodded gently and slowly swam towards the shore.
After being immersed in the water for a long time, the ants on her body had already disappeared, but she forgot about a very important problem.
When she jumped into the water earlier, she was in such a hurry that she forgot to take off her clothes. Now her clothes were all wet.
While in the water, she might not have felt much, but as soon as she got out and the wind blew, she instantly felt a chill.
Feeling the chill, she hesitated for a moment and then asked him softly, “Connor, what should we do now?”
“Let’s go back to where we parked and see…”
He knew they couldn’t stay there for long, so he thought for a moment and replied softly.
“Okay…” After hearing his words, she nodded and said.
“Then let me carry you!”
Connor walked up to Freya proactively.
“No need, my feet don’t hurt that much anymore. I can walk by myself. Besides, my clothes are all wet. If you carry me, you’ll get wet too. Let me walk by myself!”
Freya shook her head and refused.
He thought what she said made sense, so he didn’t say anything more and held her hand to return the way they came.
After about half an hour, they arrived at the place where they parked before. But before he could reach the front of the car, he saw four or five people standing by the roadside, as if they were waiting for their return.
“It seems we can’t leave…”
Connor turned his head and glanced at Freya, his expression somewhat helpless.
“They haven’t left yet…”
A hint of despair flashed in her eyes.
“These people are all professional assassins. Anything we can think of, they can definitely think of it too. Moreover, they have guns. Even if I were to go back now, I wouldn’t stand a chance against them…”
He narrowed his eyes and analyzed in a low voice.
“So what do we do now?”
Freya paused for a moment, then asked Connor softly.
Connor briefly observed the surrounding environment and whispered to Freya, “The best option now is for the two of us to wait in the mountains for a night. If we don’t show up tonight, they will surely think we’ve escaped. So leaving tomorrow morning is the best course of action.”
She subconsciously looked up at Connor, her expression appearing somewhat strange.
But after hesitating for a moment, she decided not to say much.
Meanwhile, Connor, seeing that she remained silent, began to look around for a suitable place to rest.
A few minutes later, he found a towering tree.
In front of the tree was an open space, and it was conveniently covered by trees behind it. Unless someone was exceptionally attentive, they wouldn’t notice this spot.
“Let’s rest here for the night…”
He turned his head and glanced at Freya, whispering to her.
“Okay…”
She nodded and sat down on the ground.
Connor hesitated for a moment, then sat directly beside Freya and whispered, “I’m really sorry. If it weren’t for me bringing you out here, you wouldn’t have to suffer like this…”
“If what you said is true, even if I have to endure some suffering, I still want to find out what’s going on…” she said firmly.
“Don’t worry, everything I said is true…”
He nodded earnestly while looking at her.
Upon hearing his words, she hesitated for two seconds, then asked softly, “Connor, are you really my fiancé?”
“Absolutely!”
Connor nodded and continued, “You should know that I’m not short of money, nor am I lacking in women. If I weren’t your fiancé, why would I go through all this trouble and risk my life to bring you out? I have no reason to deceive you, alright?”
“Well, that’s true…”
Freya gently nodded while looking at Connor, then fell into silence.
Seeing that she didn’t speak, he didn’t let his guard down. He continued to observe the surrounding environment because he didn’t know when the people from Travio Corporation would show up. They couldn’t consider themselves one hundred percent safe yet.
“Connor, there’s something I want to ask you…”
But at that moment, Freya suddenly spoke up.
“What is it?”
He turned his head and glanced at her, asking softly.
“Since you’re my fiancé, how far have we progressed in our relationship?”
Freya asked shyly as if she was slightly embarrassed.

chapters.title: Chapter 1067: Change of Clothes!
chapters.content:
Chapter 1067: Change of Clothes!
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
“How far have we progressed?”
Upon hearing Freya’s words, Connor instantly froze in place, his expression filled with helplessness.
“Yes, because I don’t remember anything, but I believe the things you said are true. I just want to figure out what exactly our relationship is…” she said to him.
…
Connor examined Freya up and down, knowing that if he were to say they had already been intimate, it would be easy for him to make advances on her in the future.
But after a moment of hesitation, he chose not to lie and said with a serious expression, “Although you are my fiancée, we haven’t known each other for long. I’m not sure about your feelings for me, but I can assure you that nothing has happened between us, not even a kiss…”
“I’m your fiancée, and you haven’t even kissed me?” she exclaimed in surprise, visibly relieved.
Connor’s expression turned somewhat awkward, and he helplessly replied, “I wanted to kiss you, but you didn’t let me…”
She smiled at him without saying much.
Meanwhile, he continued to observe the surroundings after seeing that she remained silent.
A few minutes later, a cool breeze blew, significantly lowering the temperature around them.
Freya’s body began to tremble slightly.
After all, she had been soaking in the water for a long time, and her clothes were wet. Now, with the wind blowing, she would feel even colder.
“Connor, can we start a fire?”
Freya asked Connor in a weak voice, seemingly unable to hold on any longer.
“I don’t have a lighter, and if we start a fire now, we will definitely be discovered…”
Connor hurriedly replied.
Upon hearing his words, her expression appeared somewhat despairing. She curled up, trembling continuously, her face filled with pain.
After seeing Freya in this state, he finally realized the situation and quickly asked, “Are you feeling cold right now?”
“Yes…” She nodded gently.
Connor knew that he and Freya might have to wait until dawn here. If she continued like this, even if she didn’t freeze to death, she would likely get sick.
“Feier, how about you take off your clothes?”
Connor suggested to Freya.
“Take off my clothes?”
Freya hesitated for a moment upon hearing Connor’s words, then nervously asked, “What do you want to do?”
“Don’t worry, I don’t mean anything else…”
He quickly explained and continued, “Your clothes are completely soaked, and if you keep wearing them, you’ll only get colder…”
“I understand the reasoning, but I only have one piece of clothing. If I take it off, I’ll be naked…”
She blushed slightly, seemingly shy.
“You don’t have to be naked…”
As he spoke, Connor took off his own coat and handed it to her.
…
Upon seeing Connor handing over his coat, she couldn’t help but pause for a moment.
“I have an extra T-shirt inside, and as a guy, I can tolerate the cold better. So why not just wear my clothes for now…”
Connor smiled and said to Freya.
“Are you sure?”
After hearing Connor’s words, Freya hesitated for a few seconds before whispering.
“Don’t worry, I can handle the cold. If you keep wearing wet clothes like this, you won’t last until tomorrow morning…”
Connor nodded gently.
Freya knew that Connor was doing it for her own good, so after hesitating for two seconds, she still reached out and took Connor’s coat and whispered to him, “Connor, can you turn around? I want to change clothes…”
“Okay…”
Upon hearing her words, he nodded quickly and turned around directly.
After seeing him turn around, she couldn’t help but hesitate for two seconds before starting to take off her own clothes.
Connor faintly heard a rustling sound coming from behind, accompanied by the sound of clothes falling to the ground. At this moment, he felt the urge to turn around and take a look.
However, he knew that if he turned around now, it would definitely leave a bad impression on her, so he couldn’t resist this impulse in the end.
“Connor, I’ve changed my clothes. You can turn back now…”
Just at this moment, Freya suddenly spoke up.
Connor was stunned for a moment, then slowly turned around.
By now, she had already taken off all her clothes and was wearing only his coat. Her slender and fair legs were fully exposed in his line of sight.
After seeing her like this, he couldn’t help but be attracted by her charming figure, and he stood still in place.
And when she saw his expression, a blush flashed across her face, and she subconsciously tugged at her coat.
“You should hang the clothes up quickly. They should be dry by tomorrow…”
Connor said softly to Freya.
“Okay…”
She nodded gently, and with his help, she hung the clothes on the tree behind her.
After everything was done, they sat down in place to rest.
“Connor, do you think those people will leave tomorrow morning? What if they don’t leave? Do we still have to stay here?”
After putting on his clothes, she clearly felt much warmer and asked him softly.
“They probably won’t…”
Connor shook his head directly and continued, “As soon as it’s bright tomorrow, there will be more cars passing by. They are blatantly blocking the road, so someone will definitely call the police. Even if they have a hundred guts, they wouldn’t dare to stay there…”
“That’s good then…”
Freya nodded.
“When it’s morning tomorrow, I’ll have someone send a helicopter to pick the two of us up. Although they won’t wait at the exit, they know we’re heading to Porthampton, so they might be waiting for us there!”
Connor looked at Freya and continued.
“You can still call a helicopter?”
Freya’s expression seemed somewhat surprised.

chapters.title: Chapter 1068: Connor, Are You Cold?
chapters.content:
Chapter 1068: Connor, Are You Cold?
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Although helicopters, like this one, sound very common, in reality, very few people can afford to use them.
Even Freya, who is also wealthy, has never seen any boss using a helicopter.
“Don’t forget, I am the world’s richest unmarried man!” Connor turned his head and glanced at Freya, explaining with a smile.
“Why don’t you call a helicopter to pick us up then?” she asked, furrowing her brows and looking at him.
“My phone has no signal now, and this location is not very open. Even if we call a helicopter, there is no way for it to land. So we have to wait until tomorrow morning…” he explained.
Upon hearing his words, she was clearly taken aback. Then she asked him with a soft voice, “Connor, there’s actually something I don’t understand…”
“What is it?” He turned his head and looked at her, asking softly.
“Well, you told me before that if you want to inherit the inheritance, you must marry me, right?” she asked softly.
“Yes!” he nodded.
“Then I don’t understand. What does it have to do with me and the inheritance? Why do you have to marry me to inherit it?” Freya asked.
“I’ve also thought about this question, but I can’t figure out the connection between you and the inheritance. I think the only way to clarify this question is to ask Steven. Unfortunately, he is already dead…” Connor said helplessly.
“Well, Connor, if you could inherit the inheritance without marrying me, would you still come looking for me?” Freya continued to ask, looking at Connor.
“Yes!” He didn’t hesitate at all and nodded directly at her.
“But you’re already so wealthy. You must have no shortage of women around you, and it should be easy for you to find someone more beautiful than me…” Freya said with much confusion.
“But the person I love is you. Whether I can inherit this inheritance or not, I want to be with you. Even if I have to give up this inheritance to be with you right now, I would gladly do it…”
Connor looked at Freya in front of him, his expression serious.
After hearing his words, she couldn’t help but furrow her brows.
She didn’t say much, but for some reason, she suddenly felt a strange sense of touch in her heart.
Seeing her silence, he didn’t say anything more either. He sat down where he was and took a rest.
However, after some time passed, the temperature in the mountains began to drop.
After all, this was a deep mountain forest, where the wind was already very strong, and the temperature would be particularly low at night. She was only wearing a jacket, and her body started trembling again. Connor, on the other hand, also struggled to endure. He never expected the temperature at night to be this low.
“Connor, are you feeling cold too?”
She turned her head and glanced at him, asking softly.
“I’m okay…”
Connor replied softly.
“How about we move closer to each other? It might help us keep warm…”
After thinking for a moment, she suggested.
“Sure…”
Connor thought her idea was good, so he walked directly in front of her and leaned his back against hers.
A few minutes passed, and he realized that this method was not effective at all. Their backs touching each other didn’t provide much warmth, and her body seemed to tremble even more.
Realizing that she couldn’t hold on for much longer, he suddenly made a bold decision.
He turned around directly, opened his arms, and tightly embraced her delicate body.
Freya was startled by his move. Instinctively, she wanted to struggle, but as soon as she felt the warmth emanating from his body, she instantly gave up on the idea.
“Connor… Connor is my fiancé. We’re just hugging to keep warm. It shouldn’t be too excessive…”
She reassured herself in her mind.
With Freya in his arms, Connor couldn’t help but feel a myriad of emotions. After exerting so much effort, he had finally found Freya once again.
In his heart, there was a sense of regaining what was lost.
Because their bodies were pressed against each other, tightly embracing each other.
He could even feel the warm breath of her, which felt incredibly strange to him. What’s more important was that this might be the first time Connor had such an intimate contact with Freya.
Moreover, her delicate body brought about a peculiar feeling for Connor. She emitted an enticing fragrance, continuously stimulating his senses.
He was also a normal man who hadn’t been with a woman for a long time, so it was inevitable that he would struggle to control his emotions.
Although he had been trying his best to control himself, it was futile to hold such a gorgeous beauty like her in his arms. There wasn’t a man who could resist it.
“Connor, why don’t you tell me your story…”
After hesitating for a moment, she softly suggested to shift Connor’s attention.
She knew that if they continued like this, he would surely lose control.
So she planned to chat with him and divert his attention.
“Alright…”
He nodded gently and began to recall everything that had happened to him since he inherited the inheritance.
This time, he didn’t hide anything from her. Except for his relationship with Yelena and Chloe, he told her everything in detail.
She listened quietly, her expression serious.
She never expected that so many things would happen to him.

chapters.title: Chapter 1069: Arriving at Porthampton
chapters.content:
Chapter 1069: Arriving at Porthampton
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Freya’s method was very effective.
When Connor started talking with Freya, his attention instantly shifted away from her seductive figure.
After hearing his stories, she was also very shocked.
She felt that all of this was incredible. If it weren’t for experiencing so many things with Connor, she wouldn’t have been able to believe that what he said was true.
At this moment, she seemed to have developed a strange feeling towards him.
They didn’t know how long they had been talking, and she finally fell asleep, while he closed his eyes and rested.
Connor and Freya embraced each other and fell asleep under the big tree.
When Connor woke up again, he found that it was already bright outside, but Freya hadn’t woken up yet.
She clung to him like a sloth, tightly holding his neck with her weak and boneless arms, her beautiful legs wrapped around his waist, and her head buried in his chest.
He knew that it had been very cold last night, so she instinctively held onto him.
He never expected that the first time he and Freya embraced each other and fell asleep would be under such circumstances.
Connor observed the woman in front of him. Freya seemed perfect in every way, like the most exquisite piece of artwork in the world.
Perhaps due to fatigue from the previous night, she hadn’t woken up yet and had a contented smile on her face.
He didn’t want to disturb her, so he remained still and quietly admired the beauty before him.
After about half an hour, she finally woke up.
When he saw her move, he quickly closed his eyes and pretended to be asleep.
After waking up, she realized that she was nestled in his embrace, with her legs tightly wrapped around his waist. She felt a little shy.
She quickly stood up, checked her clothes, and found that they were already dry.
After hesitating for a moment, Freya picked up her clothes and walked to a corner to change.
However, the corner was not far from Connor, so he could clearly see the entire process of Freya changing clothes.
Seeing this enchanting scene, he couldn’t help but feel his breathing quicken.
But he didn’t dare to move, afraid of being discovered by her, thinking that he was still asleep.
A few minutes later, she finished changing into her clothes and stretched lazily under the sun.
Feeling extremely comfortable, she couldn’t help but let out a soft hum and returned to his side.
“You’re awake?”
Seeing her return, he asked with a smile.
“Yes…”
She nodded lightly and handed her jacket back to him.
Connor took the jacket and put it on.
“Connor, what should we do next?” she asked softly.
“We don’t have a signal here. Let’s find a place with a signal first, and then I’ll make a call to have a helicopter come and pick us up…”
After thinking for a moment, he whispered to her.
“Okay…”
He nodded in response.
He stood up and led her towards the exit of the forest.
After half an hour, they walked out of the forest, but their car was nowhere to be seen, and the people from Travio Corporation had probably already left.
After walking out of the forest, Connor realized that his phone had a signal, so he took out his phone and used the map to determine his current location. Then, he dialed Thomas’s number.
“Ring ring…”
After two rings, Thomas answered the phone.
“Mr. Connor, what can I do for you?” Thomas asked politely.
“Thomas, arrange a helicopter to come and pick me up. I’m currently trapped in the mountains and can’t get out. I’ll send you my location…” Connor said directly without wasting time.
“Okay, I’ll arrange it right away!” Thomas knew that he must have encountered some dangerous situation, or else he wouldn’t ask for a helicopter to pick him up. Without further ado, Thomas promised and hung up the phone.
After seeing Thomas hang up, he turned his head and glanced at Freya, whispering softly, “I’ve arranged for a helicopter to come and pick us up. It shouldn’t take long…”
“Mmm…” She nodded gently and didn’t say much.
Since there were still many cars on the road, they were relatively safe in their current location. Connor believed that even if the people from Travio Corporation were bold, they wouldn’t dare to make a move at this moment. If they were caught in the act, someone would definitely call the police.
After about twenty minutes, a helicopter arrived above the highway, instantly attracting a crowd of onlookers.
After all, it wasn’t an easy task to see a helicopter in real life.
With the help of Thomas’s men, they boarded the helicopter and flew directly towards Porthampton.
Although it was a helicopter, the interior was still very luxurious. They had a separate room, and there were even things like red wine.
Connor sat on the sofa, and his expression visibly relaxed. He knew that now he and Freya were truly safe.
…
About an hour later, the helicopter landed on the rooftop of the Empire World Building, where Thomas, Kyle, and others were already waiting.
When Connor and Freya walked out of the helicopter, they hurriedly approached them.
“Mr. Connor, Miss Freya!” they greeted them politely.
At this moment, Freya didn’t recognize Thomas and Kyle, so her expression showed some confusion.
“They are employees of my company. You’ve met them before, but you probably forgot now…” Connor naturally knew what Freya was puzzled about, so he explained.
“I see…” Freya nodded gently without saying much.
“Mr. Connor, what’s going on exactly?” Thomas walked up to Connor’s side, sounding a bit puzzled.
“It’s a bit complicated to explain this matter. I’ll tell you when we have the chance in the future…” Connor replied in a low voice, then continued, “Now, please prepare two rooms for me and also arrange two sets of clothes. I’m planning to visit the Phillips Estate…”
“Alright…” Thomas nodded and quickly agreed.

chapters.title: Chapter 1070: The Strange Phillips Family!
chapters.content:
Chapter 1070: The Strange Phillips Family!
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Thomas efficiency in handling matters has always been astonishing.
In less than twenty minutes, he helped Connor and Freya prepare two sets of clean clothes, and then prepared two rooms.
After they entered the room, they quickly freshened up and changed into new clothes.
When she saw the clothes prepared for her by Thomas, she was also amazed.
Because she found that these clothes happened to be the same model she wears.
From this point, it can be proven that Thomas indeed knows her and seems to be very familiar with her.
Although Freya and Connor had not known each other for long, from their interactions over the past two days, she became more certain that he was someone she definitely knew. Many details could prove this.
After they changed their clothes, they had no intention of resting in the hotel. After all, the thing they wanted to clarify the most at the moment was Freya’s identity.
Connor was worried that people from Travio Corporation would harm him in Porthampton, so he specifically asked Thomas to arrange a few bodyguards to follow him in cars. Connor and Freya sat in one of the cars.
Connor arrived first at the front gate of Sean’s villa.
“This is not the original home!”
After parking the car, Connor turned to Freya and said.
Upon hearing these words from him, she couldn’t help but pause for a moment, then she started to observe her surroundings.
The environment around her seemed strangely familiar.
After a few minutes, a hint of peculiarity flashed through her eyes.
“Do you have any recollection?”
Connor turned to Freya and asked.
“I seem to have some recollection. The surroundings here seem oddly familiar, as if you’ve been to this place before. But I don’t remember many details…” she softly spoke to him.
“That’s right…”
Seeing that she seemed to have some impression of this place, he instantly felt more at ease. He then opened the car door and got out.
After hesitating for a moment, she also got out of the car. Her facial expression seemed somewhat nervous because she didn’t know how to face the upcoming situation.
“Don’t be nervous…”
He comforted her softly, then took the initiative to hold her small hand and walked forward.
“Okay…”
She nodded slightly, looking at him, and didn’t say much.
A moment later, Connor led Freya to the front of the villa and gently pressed the doorbell.
“Ding dong…”
After two rings, the door was opened by someone.
But standing in front of Connor was not Sean or Laura, but a middle-aged woman that Connor had never seen before.
“May I ask who you’re looking for?”
The middle-aged woman glanced at Connor and Freya, then asked in a soft voice.
“Is Mr. Sean at home?”
Connor knew this person should be the housekeeper of Sean’s house, so he didn’t beat around the bush and directly asked.
“Mr. Sean is not at home. If you have any business, you can call him!”
After hearing Connor’s words, the expression on the housekeeper’s face visibly changed, and she replied coldly.
“In that case…”
Connor wanted to ask about Sean’s whereabouts, but the housekeeper didn’t give him a chance to speak and directly closed the door.
When Freya saw this scene, her expression appeared somewhat helpless. She turned her head and softly asked Connor, “Connor, what should we do now?”
He squinted his eyes and looked at the villa gate. Suddenly, he had a bad feeling, sensing that something was not right.
“Let’s go directly to Phillips Estate!”
After hesitating for two seconds, he spoke directly.
“Alright…”
She nodded gently.
Connor turned and walked towards the parking spot, with Freya closely following behind him.
Two hours later, Connor arrived at Phillips Estate by car and found the courtyard where the Phillips family resided based on his memory.
When Freya saw the courtyard of Phillips Estate, that familiar feeling resurfaced in her heart. After all, she had lived here for a long time, so her impression of this place was much deeper.
When Freya was abroad, everywhere she went felt unfamiliar, but now everything about Phillips Estate made her feel so familiar.
Connor brought Freya directly to the entrance of the courtyard and walked towards the house.
She remained closely behind his, her expression seeming very nervous.
However, before they could enter the house, several bodyguards rushed out and blocked the doorway.
One of the bodyguards approached Connor and shouted loudly, “Who are you two?”
“I’m here to find John…”
Connor replied in a low voice.
“I’m sorry, Mr. John has very important matters to attend to today, no visitors are allowed. Please leave!”
The leading bodyguard’s expression was cold as he shouted.
“I said I want to see John!”
Connor had gone through great difficulties to finally arrive at Phillips Estate, so he had no patience to waste words with these bodyguards. He stepped forward, intending to walk into the courtyard.
“I already said Mr. John is not seeing any visitors today. Can’t you understand?”
After seeing Connor still trying to enter, the bodyguard glared and shouted.
“Get lost…”
Connor calmly shouted at the bodyguard.
“Have you had enough of living?”
The bodyguard’s expression turned angry. He raised his fist and was about to strike Connor’s face.
“Bang!”
But before the bodyguard’s fist could hit Connor’s face, Connor lifted his leg and delivered a powerful kick directly to the bodyguard’s stomach.
“Ah…”
The bodyguard let out a miserable scream. Before he could understand what had happened, he was sent flying by the kick.
Upon seeing that Connor was causing trouble, the remaining bodyguards rushed forward.
“Clatter!”
At that moment, all the people Connor had brought out their pistols and aimed them at the bodyguards who were about to attack him.
Because he knew that the people from his company were armed, he had specifically instructed the bodyguards to carry guns as well, just in case.
It should be noted that John’s bodyguards were ordinary ones and had never encountered such a situation before.
So when they saw Connor’s people pulling out guns, they were instantly dumbfounded, their expressions filled with fear.
Without paying attention to the bodyguards, he swaggered into the courtyard.
After hesitating for a moment, Freya followed Connor into the courtyard.

chapters.title: Chapter 1071: Mass Memory Loss!
chapters.content:
Chapter 1071: Mass Memory Loss!
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
After Connor and Freya entered the villa, they found three people standing in the living room.
They were John Phillips, Sean, and Laura. At this moment, the three of them seemed to be discussing something.
After hearing that someone had come in, John slowly raised his head and glanced at Connor and Freya.
“Who are you two? Why did you barge into my villa?”
John shouted at Connor coldly.
Connor heard John’s words. He was stunned.
He could hear that John sounded as if he didn’t know him.
“Grandpa Phillips, don’t you recognize me?”
Connor was instantly a little dumbfounded as he asked in a puzzled tone.
“Young man, I don’t think the two of us have met before, right?”
John replied indifferently.
“What about Freya? Don’t you recognize Freya?”
Connor hurriedly pulled Freya in front of him and asked excitedly.
“I’m sorry, I don’t know this person…”
John shook his head again.
Freya looked at Connor with a puzzled expression because she knew from Connor that John was her grandfather. But if what Connor said was true, how could her grandfather not know her?
“Grandpa Phillips, are you joking with me? Freya is your granddaughter. How can you not know her?”
Connor looked at John and shouted excitedly.
“Young man, I don’t know a Freya. You must be mistaken!” John said calmly, his expression unusually calm.
“You…”
Connor looked at John and was instantly dumbfounded. He ran directly to Sean and Laura and said loudly, “Uncle Sean, Aunt Laura, don’t you two recognize me? Freya is your daughter. Don’t tell me you don’t recognize her?”
“Who’s your aunt?”
Laura rolled her eyes at Connor and continued, “I don’t know you, and I don’t have a daughter. Who are you? Why did you come to our house?”
Sean stood beside Laura and kept his eyes on Freya, but he didn’t say anything.
“Aunt Laura, can you stop joking? I’m Connor McDonald, we’ve met before. Freya is your daughter. Have you all forgotten?” Connor looked at Laura and shouted with a broken expression.
“I don’t have a daughter at all. I don’t know the two of you either. How many times do you want me to say it?” Laura shouted in frustration.
“…”
Connor stood there dumbly with a broken expression on his face. He had never expected that things would end up like this.
Originally, Connor thought that as long as he brought Freya to the Phillips family, all these things could be explained clearly.
However, what Connor did not expect was that not only did Freya lose her memory, the entire Phillips family had also lost their memories.
It was possible for a single person to lose their memories, but it was obviously not normal for a family to lose their memories.
Also, Connor could tell that Sean was looking at Freya strangely.
It was then that Connor realized the Phillips family was probably lying. They were obviously hiding Freya’s identity as a member of the Phillips family.
But why would they lie?
The only explanation Connor could find was that the Phillips family had been threatened by someone, so they were forced to pretend not to know Freya. The ones who threatened the Phillips family were likely also the people who pretended to be Freya’s parents.
Freya did not know who to believe at this point. She felt that Connor might have made a mistake. Otherwise, why would the Phillips family not recognize her?
At this moment, Sean finally spoke. “Kid, who are you? What do you want to do by coming to our house?”
“Yeah, what do you want? Our Phillips family doesn’t welcome you. Hurry up and leave, or we’ll call the police…”
Laura hurriedly shouted at Connor.
Connor stood there without saying anything.
Freya had no idea how complicated these things were. She walked up to Connor and said softly, “Connor, you must have made a mistake. Why don’t we leave first?”
“I have to get to the bottom of this today!”
Connor replied to Freya in a low voice before sitting down on the sofa.
Laura saw that not only was Connor not leaving, he was even sitting on their sofa. She was obviously a little anxious. She quickly walked up to Connor and shouted, “What’s wrong with you, kid? Didn’t you hear me asking you to get lost?”
Connor slowly raised his head and looked at Laura. Then, he said expressionlessly, “Since you don’t know me, I won’t hold back with you. If there’s anything, I’ll just say it directly…”
“You… What do you want to say?” John asked Connor with a puzzled expression.
“John Phillips, whether you admit it or not, you should know my identity. You also know my influence in Porthampton…”
Connor said slowly.
John pretended to be puzzled and frowned at Connor.”What are you talking about?”
“You know very well what I’m saying. I know that you’re pretending not to know me and don’t want to admit that Freya is your granddaughter for some reason. You must have been threatened or given an offer that you can’t refuse, so you’re putting on an act in front of me…” Connor said lightly.
“Nonsense…”
John opened his mouth and was about to retort, but Connor cut him off.
“But don’t forget who I am. If the other party can agree to your conditions, I can give you double or even higher. However, if you still don’t plan to tell me the truth, then I will make every last person in the Phillips family regret this for the rest of their lives. You know very well whether I have the ability or not…”
He threatened John in a very serious tone.
“…”
John was dumbfounded when he heard Connor’s words. He obviously didn’t know what to do.
“I’ll give you five minutes now. You can think about it carefully. If you tell the truth, I can also give you double what others promised you. However, if you continue to put on an act, I definitely have a way to make everyone in your Phillips family disappear completely within three days!” Connor continued.
“Aren’t you a little too arrogant?”
John shouted excitedly.
“This is Porthampton. I know that the other party might be very powerful, but Porthampton is my territory. You should think about which side to choose!”
Connor said calmly.

chapters.title: Chapter 1072: Freya Phillips’s Mother
chapters.content:
Chapter 1072: Freya Phillips’s Mother
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Connor knew very well that the other party obviously knew that Connor and Freya had already arrived in Porthampton. That was why they had threatened the Phillips family to deny their relationship with Freya.
They did this to trick Freya into thinking that she had nothing to do with Connor.
Connor knew that he couldn’t make John tell the truth in the normal way, so he didn’t hold back and started threatening him.
John was obviously putting on an act in front of Connor. He was well aware how terrifying Connor’s power was.
During this period of time, their Phillips family had benefited greatly from the fact that Freya was Connor’s fiancée.
If it wasn’t for the special circumstances, John wouldn’t have wanted to give up on Connor, his big backer!
However, after hearing Connor’s words, John realized the danger.
If a person like Connor wanted to deal with them, then their Phillips family simply did not have the ability to retaliate.
Moreover, Connor was right—This was Porthampton. Although the other party’s strength was very terrifying, it was beyond their reach!
For a moment, John’s expression began to become conflicted. He did not know what to do.
Sean and Laura also stood there without saying anything.
Time passed by slowly.
“Are you still not going to tell the truth?”
Connor suddenly asked John.
“…”
John said nothing.
“Since you don’t intend to tell the truth, then I have no choice. Contact me again when you change your mind. But before you tell the truth, be careful of the safety of your Phillips family!”
After saying this, Connor stood up and walked out of the villa.
Connor’s words had completely defeated John. Therefore, when Connor was about to turn around and leave, John suddenly shouted, “Wait a moment…”
Connor slowly turned his head to look at John and then said indifferently, “Are you ready to tell the truth now?”
“Hu…”
John took a deep breath, his eyes a little conflicted.
Freya stared at John because she knew that she would soon find out her identity.
“Dad…”
Sean called out with some resignation.
“I’m done, I’m done.”
John waved at Sean, then asked, “You want to hear the truth, don’t you?”
“Yes!”
Connor nodded lightly.
“Alright, I’ll tell…”
John was about to speak.
“Freya!”
However, just as John was about to tell the truth, a woman’s voice suddenly sounded outside the villa.
When Freya heard the voice, she was stunned. Sean, John, and Laura were also stunned.
Immediately after, the sound of high heels hitting the ground reached their ears.
Soon, a beautiful woman walked into the Phillips family’s villa with two bodyguards. The beautiful young woman was wearing a black short skirt that wrapped her hips. She was pretty and had good skin care. She looked to be around 30 years old.
But in fact, this beautiful young woman was Camila Yearwood, who had pretended to be Freya’s mother!
Camila’s aura was very shocking. Just by looking at her, one could tell that this woman was definitely not an ordinary person.
After Freya saw Camila, a trace of panic flashed in her eyes. She stuttered, “Mom, you…Why are you here?”
“Freya, what are you doing here with this person?”
Camila didn’t even look at Freya as she asked coldly.
“I…”
Freya wanted to say something, but she did not know how to explain herself.
“Are you suspecting that I’m not your mother?”
However, Camila was even more direct and asked angrily.
“I’m not suspecting. It’s Connor who said that I’m his fiancée, so I followed him here!”
Freya explained softly.
“You are Connor?”
Camila turned to Connor and asked expressionlessly.
“That’s right, I’m Connor!”
Connor nodded lightly.
“How ridiculous. You pretended to be my daughter’s fiancé and tricked my daughter into coming to Porthampton with you. What exactly is your motive?”
Camila didn’t seem to know Connor’s identity and spoke arrogantly.
“You know full well who’s the real liar here. Freya is not your daughter at all, but rather Sean’s daughter. She’s my fiancée. I can’t be wrong!”
Connor shouted with an expressionless face.
“Could it be that I’m wrong about my own daughter?”
Camila sneered.
“You know better than me what your goal is!” Connor said lightly.
“Haha…”
Camila smiled disdainfully, then turned to Freya and asked, “Freya, since you can appear here with this brat, it means that you also have such doubts in your heart, right?”
“Mom, I just lost my memory, so I don’t remember what happened before. I don’t know which of the two of you is telling the truth, but Connor isn’t a bad person. He should really know me…”
Freya explained.
“I understand. Since you’re also suspicious of this matter, I’ll give you an explanation today!”
Camila didn’t waste any time. She pointed at Laura and asked Connor, “You said that this woman is my daughter’s mother, and I’m a fake, right?”
“Yes…”
Connor nodded lightly.
“Alright, we’ll do a maternity test with Freya. We’ll know who her mother is then. What do you think of this method?”
Camila was a very strong woman. In just a few words, she had taken the initiative in her hands.
Connor looked at Camila with a hint of confusion in his eyes, because he never thought that she would have the courage to do a DNA test.
This was originally Connor’s last trump card, because there was no way to lie about a DNA test.
However, Connor soon realized that Camila might have tampered with the DNA test.
Camila seemed to have read Connor’s mind and said to him directly, “You don’t have to worry. You can choose the hospital to do the DNA test. I won’t interfere!”
“…”
Connor was even more shocked when he heard Camila’s words.
He had never expected Camila to be so confident that she would let Connor choose the place for the DNA test.

chapters.title: Chapter 1073: DNA Test!
chapters.content:
Chapter 1073: DNA Test!
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Although Connor didn’t know where Camila’s confidence came from, he was 100% sure that the person in front of him was Freya. Camila was definitely a fake.
Furthermore, if he didn’t clarify this matter today, it wouldn’t be easy for Connor to find Freya in the future.
“Are you sure you want me to choose the place for the DNA test?” Connor asked Camila expressionlessly.
“That’s right. You can choose the place, but it has to be a regular hospital!”
Camila nodded.
“Alright, I’ll make the call now!”
After Connor agreed, he took out his phone and dialed Thomas Morgan’s number. Then, he asked Thomas to find a proper hospital and get the results out as soon as possible.
At this moment, Freya looked at Camila, and her heart began to waver.
She felt that Camila might not be lying. Otherwise, she wouldn’t have taken the initiative to say that she wanted to do a DNA test, and she wouldn’t have let Connor choose the place for the test.
Freya didn’t know who she should trust, so she could only wait for the test results. Once the test results were out, everything would be revealed.
Thomas was very efficient. He went straight to the best appraisal hospital in Porthampton and got the results within two hours.
If Thomas hadn’t done it, the DNA test wouldn’t have been done so quickly.
After receiving Thomas’s call, Connor didn’t waste any time and brought Freya, Camila Sean, Laura, John, and the others to the hospital.
After entering the hospital, the doctor began to draw blood samples from them.
After the blood samples were taken, everyone began to wait anxiously.
Freya was extremely nervous and uneasy, and Connor did not seem as confident as before.
He felt that Camila was too confident, so confident that he felt the whole situation was a little strange.
Connor couldn’t understand where Camila’s confidence came from!
Connor even began to suspect that she was really Freya’s mother.
Time passed by, and two hours later, the results were finally out.
However, when Connor saw the results, he was dumbfounded. He couldn’t believe what he was seeing.
Freya also looked at Connor in shock.
This was because the test results showed that Camila was indeed Freya’s mother, while Laura and Freya were not related by blood at all.
For a moment, Connor did not know how to describe his feelings. He could not understand what was going on!
Connor had asked Thomas to find this hospital, so there would definitely be no problems with the results. Moreover, the whole process was carried out under Connor’s supervision, so there would be no mistakes. He could not understand what was going on.
“Did I really make a mistake? Is the person in front of me not Freya? How is that possible?”
Countless questions surrounded Connor’s mind.
Freya was also confused. She had not expected Connor to lie to her.
When faced with the results of the test, Freya could not continue to believe Connor.
After Camila took a look at the appraisal results, she threw the appraisal report aside and asked Connor coldly, “Do you have anything else to say?”
Connor slowly raised his head to look at Camila and asked in a low voice, “How did you do it?”
“How did you do it?”
Camila’s expression was a little disdainful, and then she said lightly, “Because Freya is my daughter. This is a fact that no one can change!”
After saying this, Camila ignored Connor and said to Freya, “Freya, how many times have I told you? You have to be careful. There are so many people watching you right now. You can’t just believe whatever others say. Fortunately, I discovered this in time, otherwise, you would have been deceived long ago…”
“Mom…”
When Freya saw the results, she was no longer confused.
She was now 100% sure that Camila was her mother and that she had nothing to do with Laura Sean, Connor, and the others.
However, Freya also knew that Connor had no reason to lie to her. Although she had the test results, Freya still felt that there were many things that could not be explained clearly.
“Come back with me!”
Camila didn’t want to listen to Freya’s explanation at all. She shouted expressionlessly and walked out of the hospital.
Freya hesitated for a moment, then turned to look at Connor and left with Camila.
Sean, John, and Laura also chose to leave the hospital together.
In the end, Connor was the only one left, standing alone on the spot.
Even at this time, Connor still could not figure out what was going on.
…
On the other side, after Camila and Freya left the hospital, they didn’t even look at Sean and the others and chose to get into the car.
Sean stood where he was and watched the car that Freya and Camila were in disappear from his sight. His gaze was extremely complicated.
“Mom, I’m sorry about this!”
Freya looked at Camila beside her and said guiltily.
“Freya, you’ve really gone too far this time!”
Camila replied lightly.
“Connor is not a bad person. I also do not remember what happened before. That is why I believed him…”Freya explained.
“Can you tell if he’s a bad person?” Camila replied coldly and continued, “This Connor must have his reasons for contacting you. If I hadn’t appeared in time today, would you have disowned me as your mother…”
“No…”
Freya shook her head without thinking and sighed softly, “How strange!”
“What’s strange?”
Camila asked lightly.
“I just find it a little strange. If I’ve really been living abroad all this time, why do I feel that this place is so familiar? Connor is also very familiar with this person. I seem to have been here before, and I seem to know Connor…”
Freya said slowly.
After Camila heard this, she looked a little flustered and hurriedly said, “That’s just because Connor gave you a psychological hint!”
“Maybe so!”
Freya nodded and did not say anything else.
“I think it’s a mistake to let you return to Oprana. Go back to the U.S. tomorrow. This place isn’t suitable for you…”
Camila said again.
“To the U.S.?”
Freya was stunned.

chapters.title: Chapter 1074: The Truth of the Matter
chapters.content:
Chapter 1074: The Truth of the Matter
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
After seeing the results of the test, Connor could be said to be at a loss for words.
After all, there was no evidence that was more convincing than a DNA test.
However, Connor couldn’t understand why Freya had suddenly turned into Camila’s daughter. Everything seemed so confusing.
He felt that there must be a bigger secret behind this matter.
After a moment of hesitation, Connor took out his phone and dialed Thomas’s number.
“Ding!”
After the phone rang twice, Thomas picked up the call.
“Thomas, is there any problem with the hospital you found for me? Could someone have done something to this place?”
Connor was not in the mood to chat with Thomas, so he asked the question straight off the bat.
“Mr. McDonald, you don’t have to worry about that. The hospital I picked for you is definitely fine…” Thomas hurriedly replied and then continued, “Moreover, the people in this hospital are all our employees. If outsiders want to do anything, it’s definitely impossible…”
“That’s strange. How did Camila suddenly become Freya’s mother? This doesn’t make sense!”
After Connor heard Thomas’s words, he seemed to be even more puzzled.
“Mr. McDonald, I think there must be something hidden about this matter. The best way for you to do this now is to ask the Phillips family so you can understand these things. Since the Phillips family can put on an act with Camila, it means that they should know some inside information…” Thomas suggested.
“…”
After hearing Thomas’s words, Connor couldn’t help but be stunned for a moment. Then, he said in a low voice, “I originally did not intend to make a move against the Phillips family. However, since things have already reached this stage, I can only use some special methods…”
“What methods?” Thomas was stunned for a moment and asked softly.
“I’ll give you three hours. No matter what price you have to pay, you have to control everyone in the Phillips family. This is the only way I can make them feel a sense of danger…” Connor said slowly.
“I understand…”
Thomas seemed to agree with Connor’s approach and answered immediately.
“Oh right, we have to be quick. We can’t let Camila notice, either. I’m worried that she might transfer the Phillips family away if she finds out that we attacked them…” Connor instructed again.
“Alright, Mr. McDonald, I understand…” This small matter was very simple to Thomas, so he replied confidently and then hung up the phone.
After putting down his phone, Connor left the hospital alone and began to walk aimlessly on the streets.
Connor still couldn’t believe that Camila was Freya’s mother. He didn’t know why she was doing this.
Moreover, Connor felt that Camila didn’t know Connor’s identity, either; he could see disdain in her eyes, but no hostility.
This meant that Camila’s brainwashing of Freya wasn’t aimed at Connor.
Of course, all of this was just conjecture. If he wanted to find out the truth, Connor had to have a good chat with the Phillips family.
The current Connor was no longer the same as before. His style of doing things was also very different now. Connor felt that only when the Phillips family realized that their lives were in danger would they cooperate with him obediently, or they wouldn’t dare betray Camila.
…
Thomas worked very efficiently; in less than two hours, he’d managed to bring the entire Phillips family under control.
Connor felt that Sean’s reaction was obviously different from John’s and Laura’s reactions, so Connor used Sean as a breakthrough point. The first person he went to see was also Sean.
Thomas asked someone to bring Sean directly to the headquarters of the Empire World Corporation. After all, this place was the safest and the least likely for them to be discovered.
When Sean saw Connor, he was very angry and shouted, “Connor, what are you planning to do? You’re kidnapping us now! Do you know that you’re breaking the law?”
Connor sat on the chair and said calmly, “Uncle Sean, I don’t have any other intentions. I just want to find out what’s going on with Freya. If you explain this matter to me clearly, I’ll let you go…”
“Freya is Camila’s daughter. You’ve already seen the results. I don’t have a daughter!” Sean shouted with his eyes wide open.
“Uncle Sean, can you stop acting in front of me? Freya lost her memory, but I didn’t. I know better than anyone whether Freya is your daughter or not. I just want to know what’s going on!” Connor said to Sean in frustration.
“I… I don’t know what you’re talking about…”
Sean’s expression was a little nervous as he stammered to Connor.
“You don’t know what’s going on?” After hearing Sean’s words, Connor couldn’t help but sneer. Then, he said indifferently, “You really don’t know what’s going on? I advise you to consider your words carefully before talking to me…”
After Connor finished speaking, Thomas took out a few photos and placed them in front of Sean.
When Sean saw these photos, he was dumbfounded. These photos were of the Phillips family being tied up, including John, Laura, and the others.
“What are you doing to my family?”
Sean’s expression became excited as he shouted at Connor.
“I’ve already made myself very clear. I just want to find out what happened to Freya. As long as you explain everything to me, everyone in your Phillips family will be fine. However, if you can’t, I can’t guarantee what will happen next…” Connor said expressionlessly.
After hearing Connor’s words, Sean’s eyes flashed with anger as he shouted, “Connor, you’re a lunatic…”
“You can call me whatever you want. However, I am willing to do anything for Freya. Therefore, you better not force my hand…” Connor said coldly.
Sean hesitated for two seconds. Then, he gritted his teeth and said, “As long as I tell you the truth, you’ll let us go, right?”
“Yes!”
Connor nodded.
“Freya is indeed Camila’s daughter!”
Sean said in a low voice.

chapters.title: Chapter 1075: Sean Phillips’s Request
chapters.content:
Chapter 1075: Sean Phillips’s Request
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
“Freya is Camila’s daughter?”
When Connor heard Sean’s words, he was stunned. His face was filled with shock.
Although there was already an appraisal result, Connor still felt that there was something wrong with this matter.
However, Sean’s own admission still shocked Connor.
But at this moment, Sean added, “To be exact, Freya is my and Camila’s daughter…”
“…”
Connor was dumbfounded again. He didn’t know how to describe his feelings.
“What exactly is going on?” Connor asked.
“Back then, Camila was my girlfriend. Before we got married, Camila gave birth to Freya. At that time, Camila was just an ordinary person, so my father didn’t agree to us being together. We could only secretly raise Freya. However, no one expected Camila to get a promotion at that time. The price of her promotion was to become the lover of the Chairman of Travio Corporation’s headquarters…”
Sean took a deep breath and continued, “Camila was a woman who would give up anything for money, so she chose to become the lover of the Chairman of Travio Corporation and abandoned Freya and me mercilessly. At that time, Freya was still young, not even a year old. She doesn’t remember these things at all…”
Connor looked at Sean in front of him, shock on his face.
He had never expected Freya’s mother to actually be Camila.
Sean continued. “After Camila left, I got together with Laura. She promised to keep this secret for me, so many people think that Freya is mine and Laura’s child, but she’s really not…”
Connor frowned. “Since Camila chose to abandon you and Freya, why is she doing this now?”
“Camila was the mistress of the Chairman of Travio Corporation for three years. Then, she used her own methods to successfully marry the chairman. Under her plan, the chairman was killed, and in the end, she successfully inherited Travio Corporation. Although Camila is now the vice president of Travio Corporation in name, she actually has the final say in the corporation’s affairs…”
Sean took a deep breath and continued, “Camila has been scheming for so many years. She has been circling around all kinds of men, so she’s also gotten rid of many children until it became hard to get pregnant again. As she grew older, she also yearned for a descendant to inherit her family business. In the end, she thought of Freya…”
“…”
Connor looked at Sean and didn’t say anything. He didn’t know what to say.
“Originally, Camila planned to return to Oprana and take Freya away, but she felt that if she told Freya everything, Freya would not be able to forgive herself. Moreover, Freya would never agree to live with her; after all, Freya would never give up on Laura and me, so Camila finally thought of a plan that was the best of both worlds!”
Sean said.
“So she planned a car accident, then performed an operation on Freya to make her lose her memory. Finally, she brainwashed Freya and made her think that she was Camila’s daughter, right?” Connor said directly.
“Yes…”
Sean nodded lightly.
Connor looked at Sean in front of him with mixed feelings because he did not expect the final result to be like this.
Although Camila’s actions were indeed unbelievable, it was the only reasonable explanation.
“Then you’re willing to give up Freya like this?”
Connor frowned and asked Sean.
“So what if I’m unwilling?”
Sean smiled bitterly and continued, “Camila now controls the entire Travio Corporation. Her power is terrifying to an extent that I can’t imagine. Moreover, she promised to let Freya inherit everything in the future and give our Phillips family a lot of benefits. If we don’t agree, then our Phillips family will be in danger, so the best choice was to cooperate with Camila…”
“..”
Connor narrowed his eyes and looked at Sean without saying anything.
“Camila had planned everything meticulously, but she forgot that Freya still had you as her fiancé…”
Sean sighed helplessly.
“Is what you said true?” Connor asked.
“It’s already come to this. Is there a need for me to keep lying to you?” Sean said helplessly.
Connor took a deep breath. At this moment, he did not know whether he should be happy or sad.
If what Sean said was true, then it meant that Camila had nothing to do with Rockefeller, and Freya was still very safe.
However, Freya might not be able to remember everything that had happened before. Connor also had no way to prove that he was Freya’s fiancé.
Because when faced with the results of the DNA test, Connor was powerless, no matter what he said.
“Connor, I’ve already told you everything I can. Can you let us go? We are all ordinary people. We really can’t defeat you and Camila…” Sean begged.
“Uncle Sean, you can go!”
Since Sean was forced to do this, Connor didn’t want to continue making things difficult for him.
Sean slowly stood up when he heard Connor’s words, but just as he was about to walk to the door, he suddenly stopped and said, “Connor, can I ask you for something?”
“What is it?” Connor asked.
“Freya basically has no way to recover her memories now, so I hope that you won’t tell her about these things. I don’t want her to know that I’ve lied to her for so many years, and I don’t want her to know that her mother is such a vicious woman. I don’t have any other requests now. I just want Freya to live happily…”
Sean begged Connor with a trembling voice.
Connor was stunned when he heard Sean’s words. After two seconds of silence, he said in a low voice, “Don’t worry, I will not tell Freya about this matter…”
“Really?” Sean looked at Connor in shock.
“I want Freya to live happily more than any of you!”
Connor said to Sean in a serious tone.
Sean nodded and walked out of the office.

chapters.title: Chapter 1076: Leaving Newtown
chapters.content:
Chapter 1076: Leaving Newtown
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
After Sean Phillips left, Connor sat on a chair alone and stared blankly at the scenery outside the window.
At this moment, Connor finally knew the whole truth.
However, Connor felt vexed. He knew that he could no longer help Freya recover her previous memories.
This was because once Connor told Freya about all of this, she might not be able to accept it. Even if Freya accepted everything, it would be very painful for her.
Moreover, Camila Yearwood might attack the Phillips Family. At that time, Connor could only let Freya live in pain every day. This was not what Connor wanted to see.
However, if he didn’t tell Freya about all of this, and if he didn’t get back her lost memories, he would be able to find out more.
What kind of identity would Connor have in Freya’s life in the future?
“No matter what, I can’t let her live in pain.”
Connor sighed softly, then took out his phone and called Priscilla Marcus.
“Connor, do you have news about Freya?”
Priscilla quickly answered the call and asked excitedly.
“Priscilla, things might be a little complicated…”
Connor said in a low voice.
“What’s wrong?”
Priscilla asked worriedly.
Priscilla was Freya’s best friend. If he didn’t explain these things to Priscilla, she would definitely be very worried.
Therefore, Connor told Priscilla everything without missing out any details.
After Priscilla found out the truth, she was shocked. She didn’t expect Freya to be Camila’s daughter.
“Then, what do you plan to do next?”
Priscilla asked.
“I don’t know what to do either. Let’s take it one step at a time!”
Connor replied indifferently.
“Alright, then. Although Freya doesn’t remember the two of us now, she has already returned home. This is also a good thing for the two of us, right?”
Priscilla said slowly.
“…”
When Connor heard Priscilla’s words, a strange look flashed across his eyes. He then hurriedly said, “Priscilla, I have something to do now, so I’ll talk to you later…”
“Alright…”
Priscilla quickly agreed.
After Connor hung up the phone, he ran out of the office like crazy and found Thomas Morgan. He asked Thomas, “Mr. Morgan, is the helicopter still here?”
“Yes, what’s wrong?”
Thomas was stunned for a moment and asked.
“Hurry up and get the helicopter to take me back to Newtown…”
Connor hurriedly shouted.
“Mr. McDonald, what’s so urgent?”
Thomas stood up and asked.
“It’s a very important matter. Hurry up and arrange it!”
Connor frowned and shouted.
“Alright…”
Thomas agreed and took out his phone to contact the helicopter pilot.
Ten minutes later, Connor boarded the helicopter.
After boarding the helicopter, Connor gave Benson Sharp a call and asked for Freya’s location.
Just now, Priscilla had warned Connor that if Camila found out that Connor was going to help Freya recover her memory, Camila would take Freya away. Connor might not be able to see Freya ever again. That was why he was so anxious to return to Newtown. He wanted to confirm whether Freya had really left.
At this moment, Connor was very anxious because he was worried that Freya had already left Oprana.
An hour later, the helicopter sent Connor to the entrance of Freya’s villa.
With the help of the pilot, Connor disembarked the helicopter using the rope ladder. Then, based on the information provided by Benson, he found Freya’s villa.
However, when Connor arrived at the door of the villa, he found that the door of the villa was locked.
Connor took out his phone and called Freya, but her phone was switched off.
Connor was filled with despair because he felt that Freya had left Newtown.
Previously, when Camila wanted to take Freya away, Connor’s mind was filled with the paternity test report, so he didn’t think of the possibility that Camila would take Freya away.
Connor sat alone at the entrance of the villa, feeling unusually desperate.
This was because he had not expected that after putting in so much effort to find Freya, this would be the end result.
At this moment, Connor could not accept this fact at all. For a moment, Connor did not even know what he should do.
Connor’s mind was blank!
As time passed, Connor sat in front of the villa in a daze, as if he was waiting for something.
In the blink of an eye, the sky gradually darkened.
Connor didn’t seem to want to continue waiting here, because he felt that if he continued to stay here, it would only be a waste of time.
He had to hurry up and find Freya. After all, Freya should not have gone far.
Connor stood up slowly and took out his phone to call Thomas.
“Connor?”
But at that moment, a voice sounded in Connor’s ear.
Connor subconsciously turned and saw that it was Freya.
At this moment, Freya was looking at him in shock.
“Connor, it really is you…”
Freya opened her mouth to speak.
However, Connor rushed to Freya and hugged her tightly. He shouted excitedly, “Freya, you’re still here? That’s great. You scared me to death. I thought that you had already left Newtown…”
“How did you know I was leaving Newtown?”
Freya asked Connor in surprise.
After hearing her words, Connor immediately let go of Freya and asked in surprise, “Are you really planning to leave Newtown?”
“My mom wants me to go to the U.S., but I didn’t want to. I prefer living here, so my mom went back to America alone. I just sent my mom to the airport…”
Freya looked at Connor and explained.
“As long as you don’t leave, everything is good…”
After Connor heard Freya’s words, he was relieved.
“Then, why are you looking for me?”
Freya looked at Connor and asked.
“It’s nothing. I just wanted to see if you had left. It’s good that you didn’t…”
Connor said happily to Freya.

chapters.title: Chapter 1077: Starting From Scratch!
chapters.content:
Chapter 1077: Starting From Scratch!
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
After hearing Connor’s words, Freya smiled faintly and said softly, “Are you that afraid that I’ll leave you?”
“Of course! You are my fiancée…”
Connor said subconsciously.
However, he did not finish his sentence.
He knew that no matter what he said, Freya would not believe him.
“If you want to leave Newtown in the future, can you tell me?”
Connor looked at Freya and asked.
“Okay!”
Freya could feel that Connor was concerned about her from the bottom of his heart, so she nodded very seriously.
“That’s good. If that’s the case, I’ll be leaving now!”
Knowing that Freya was still here, Connor was clearly in a much better mood. He chuckled as he spoke to Freya.
“Okay…”
Freya nodded lightly when she heard Connor’s words.
After hesitating for a moment, Connor turned around and was about to leave.
“Connor!”
But just as Connor had taken two steps, Freya suddenly called out.
Connor was stunned for a moment before turning to look at Freya and asking with a smile, “Yeah?”
“Connor, are you really my fiancé?”
Freya asked Connor seriously.
Connor looked at Freya and was stunned for a moment. Then, he said in a low voice, “Didn’t you see the paternity test today?”
“But that paternity test can only prove that I’m my mother’s daughter, it can’t prove that you’re not my fiancé. That’s why I want to hear your answer now…”
Freya smiled at Connor.
Connor took a deep breath and said expressionlessly, “Freya, I’m 100% sure that you’re my fiancée. If I were to lie to you, I would be killed by a car when I go out…”
“…”
Freya looked at Connor and hesitated for a moment. Then, she walked up to him and said softly to him, “Connor, you don’t have to swear. I believe you!”
When Connor heard Freya’s words, he couldn’t help but be stunned for a moment. He seemed surprised.
Because Connor didn’t know what Freya meant.
“Connor, although I don’t remember who you are. I feel like I know you. This familiar feeling is something that no one else has given me. So, I believe what you said…”
Freya paused for a moment before continuing, “However, I might not be able to continue being your fiancée…”
Connor looked at Freya and hesitated for a moment before saying in a low voice, “I can understand. After all, I have no way to prove that what I said is true…”
“You don’t need to prove that what you said is true. Anyway, let the past be the past…”
Freya said lightly.
“Alright, let bygones be bygones…”
Connor looked at Freya and nodded lightly before continuing, “It’s getting late. I’ll be leaving now…”
“Wait!”
Freya hurriedly stretched out her hand to grab Connor, then softly said, “Why are you in such a hurry to leave? I haven’t finished talking to you!”
“Do you have anything else to say?”
Connor looked at Freya and asked.
“Although I can’t be your fiancée in the future, I can be your girlfriend! The two of us can start from scratch. I want to know what kind of person you are!”
Freya said to Connor with a serious expression.
When Connor heard Freya’s words, he was completely stunned. He was as shocked as could be.
“Freya, are… are you being serious?”
Connor stammered as he asked Freya.
“Of course…”
Freya nodded lightly before continuing, “Although I don’t remember what happened in the past, I remember what is happening now. I saw what you did for me last night in the mountains. I believe that you really like me, so I’m willing to give you a chance!”
“…”
Connor looked at Freya. He was so excited that he didn’t know what to say.
At this moment, Connor clearly had a feeling of regaining what he had lost.
Connor was already in despair, but he did not expect Freya to be willing to give him another chance.
Seeing that Connor was standing there without saying anything, Freya smiled faintly. Then, she said softly, “Alright, it’s getting late. I’m going back to rest now. You should go back early too!”
“Alright…”
Connor hurriedly nodded.
Freya looked at Connor and smiled. Then, she strode into the villa with her long and fair legs.
Connor stood on the spot and looked at Freya’s back, unable to calm down for a long time.
Even though he had been working hard for so many days and did not let Freya know his identity, the outcome was not bad for Connor. After all, Freya had already begun to accept him deep down.
Connor felt that as long as he stayed in Freya’s life, she would remember what had happened before.
“Connor, why are you still here?”
At this moment, Freya suddenly turned and shouted at Connor.
“I’m leaving now…”
Connor looked at Freya and laughed foolishly. Then, he turned around and walked out of the villa complex.
After leaving the villa area, Connor was obviously in a much better mood. He hailed a taxi and was ready to go home.
Half an hour later, Connor returned home.
After entering the house, Connor saw Rachel Wallace lying on the sofa watching TV in her pajamas. She looked so serious that she didn’t even notice Connor’s return.
When Connor saw Rachel like this, he was somewhat helpless. He felt that he had to think of a way to make her move out. Otherwise, if Freya saw him living with a woman like Rachel, then Connor would not be able to clear his name even if he died!
“Miss Wallace, are you watching TV?”
Connor knew that Rachel was a woman who could be coaxed but not forced, so he walked to her and asked her with a smile.
Rachel casually turned to look at Connor, then said indifferently, “You’re back?”
“Yes, I’m back…”
Connor nodded lightly.
“What did you do yesterday? Why didn’t you come back home? Did you go out to look for women?”
Rachel looked at Connor and continued to ask.

chapters.title: Chapter 1078: The Girl Who
chapters.content:
Chapter 1078: The Girl Who
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
When Connor heard Rachel’s words, he could not help but be stunned for a moment, and he appeared somewhat speechless.
He frowned and said, “What are you talking about? Why would I look for any woman?”
“You’re so rich. Isn’t it easy for you to find a woman?”
Rachel said without hesitation.
“Do I look like that kind of person? I went to do something serious last night…”
Connor explained helplessly, then continued, “Um, can I discuss something with you?”
“There’s no need to discuss anything. The renovations for the house I rented will be done the day after tomorrow. When the time comes, you can help me move…”
Rachel didn’t even ask Connor what was going on and responded.
“Uh…”
When Connor heard Rachel’s words, he felt a little awkward. Then, he said with a smile, “How did you know I was going to talk about this?”
“How can I not know what you want to do?”
Rachel glanced at Connor with a hint of disdain in her tone.
“Well, actually, I don’t have the intention of chasing you away. But, since you’re in such a hurry to leave, I won’t keep you here. Anyway, don’t worry. I’ll definitely help you settle your move…”
Connor said to Rachel with a smile.
“…”
Rachel lightly rolled her eyes at Connor, then continued to ask, “By the way, how’s your investigation on Percy Juve going?”
“I haven’t gotten much info yet…”
Connor replied helplessly.
Rachel looked at Connor and became even more speechless. She frowned and said, “Then what have you been busy with recently?”
“Serious business…”
Connor replied with a smile and then continued, “Since you’re asking me this, have you found any clues?”
“Here…”
Rachel pointed to the folder on the coffee table.
Rachel slowly said.
“This method of yours is indeed quite good…”
Connor looked at Rachel and lightly nodded before continuing, “But the problem is that it’s not that easy for us to get in touch with Percy Juve…”
“I’ve already found out that Percy Juve goes to a casino in Australia every month. The two of us can go there to look for him!”
Rachel said casually.
“You even have info like that?”
Connor said with a surprised expression.
“Do you think I’m like you? You don’t do what you’re supposed to do!”
Rachel couldn’t help but roll her eyes at Connor. Then, she stood up and stretched before walking toward the bedroom.
Connor looked at Rachel’s back and was very curious about who she was. Even Reena Satchwell and Thomas Morgan couldn’t find out about these things, but Rachel could find out so easily. Now, Connor was more and more curious about Rachel’s identity.
A moment later, Rachel returned to the bedroom, and Connor also returned to the bedroom, then lay on the bed to rest.
After a few days of torment, Connor was already exhausted, so he fell asleep not long after lying on the bed.
…
The next day, at eight o’clock in the morning.
When Connor woke up, Rachel had already left.
After washing up, he arrived at Newtown University.
After arriving at the school, Connor realized that he was already late, so he did not enter the classroom. Instead, he walked around the school alone.
he felt that since that girl was being beaten up, there must be a reason for it. If he helped blindly, it would only cause trouble.
“Take off this b*tch’s clothes. I want her die of shame. Let’s see if she still dares to seduce men in the future…”
At this moment, a woman with big breasts in revealing clothes shouted at the top of her lungs.
“No, please don’t…”
The girl who was being beaten up quickly knelt down and begged when she heard this.

chapters.title: Chapter 1079: Anita Tolstoy
chapters.content:
Chapter 1079: Anita Tolstoy
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
When Connor heard this, a strange look flashed across his eyes.
This was because he felt that this girl had gone too far. It was nothing more than a conflict between students. There was no need to be so ruthless.
Not only did the surrounding people not step forward to stop them, but they even took out their phones to take a short video.
When Connor saw this scene, he appeared to be somewhat angry.
Although he didn’t want to meddle in other people’s business, the matter had already reached such a point. Connor felt that if he continued to sit idly by, what difference would there be between him and those people who were watching the show?
“Stop!”
After hesitating for a moment, Connor shouted at them.
After hearing Connor’s words, everyone turned to look at him, and a trace of surprise flashed across their eyes.
“Who are you?”
The big-breasted woman in the lead looked at Connor with disdain, then raised her face and asked him.
“Don’t you think you’re going a little overboard?”
Connor frowned and replied.
“Who do you think you are? What does this have to do with you? This matter is not something you can meddle in. Hurry up and get lost…”
The big-breasted woman shouted at Connor with an unusually irritated expression.
Connor looked at the big-breasted woman indifferently and walked directly to the girl. Then, he whispered to the girl, “Get up and follow me…”
“…”
