When the girl who was being beaten up heard Connor’s words, she suddenly raised her head and looked at Connor. Her eyes were filled with gratitude.
She had never thought that someone would step forward to save her at this time.
When the girl raised her head, Connor realized that the girl who was beaten up was actually quite good-looking. She should be quite beautiful if she wasn’t all haggard.
Connor didn’t think too much about it. He reached out and pulled the girl up, then he was about to leave with her.
The big-breasted woman did not seem to have any intention of letting this girl go. She blocked Connor’s way and pointed at him, scolding, “Stinky loser, who do you think you are? Hurry up and let go of her. I won’t hold this against you. Otherwise, I won’t be polite to you…”
“Get lost!”
Connor coldly looked at the big-breasted woman and said in a cold tone.
After hearing Connor’s words, the big-breasted woman was stunned for a moment. Then, she said with a surprised expression, “Kid, what did you say to me?”
“Didn’t you hear me telling you to get lost?”
Connor replied indifferently.
“How dare you tell me to get lost? Who do you think you are?”
When the big-breasted woman heard Connor’s words, she instantly became anxious and was about to slap Connor’s face.
Connor was a little irritated. Then, without thinking, he grabbed the big-breasted woman’s wrist and said coldly, “I’m telling you to get lost now, so get lost. I don’t want to fight a woman like you, do you hear me…”
“Ladies…”
The big-breasted woman was extremely embarrassed and angry at this moment. She shouted at the top of her voice.
When the big-breasted woman’s friends heard this, they immediately rushed over, wanting to make a move on Connor.
“Stop!”
However, at this moment, a middle-aged man’s voice sounded.
Everyone turned to look at the middle-aged man when they heard the voice.
Connor also turned around and saw that the middle-aged man in front of everyone was the dean of Newtown University.
When Connor first came to Newtown University, he had met this dean.
The middle-aged man knew very well that Connor was no ordinary person.
Even the principal of Newtown University had specially instructed him to treat this student well.
From this, it could be seen how terrifying Connor’s background was!
Therefore, when the middle-aged man saw Connor, a trace of nervousness flashed across his eyes.
When the big-breasted woman and the others saw the dean, they did not feel nervous at all because they knew that the middle-aged man would not dare to do anything to them.
“Anita Tolstoy, what are you doing here with your friends? Hurry up and go to class!”
The middle-aged man shouted at the big-breasted woman expressionlessly.
“Mr. Welch, what do you mean by this?”
The big-breasted woman, Anita, did not expect the middle-aged man to dare talk to her like this. She frowned and asked in a puzzled tone.
Anita usually relied on her father’s relationship to act tyrannically in school and commit all kinds of evil.
But even so, he didn’t dare to say anything because even if the principal came, he couldn’t do anything to her.
But today, for some reason, Mr. Welch actually lectured her as soon as he appeared.
“Don’t you understand what I mean? Hurry up and go to class. Don’t cause trouble here…”
Mr. Welch said with a frown.
Anita took a deep breath. She felt that there was something wrong with Mr. Welch today, so she turned to look at Connor and said in a low voice, “What’s your name?”
“Connor McDonald!”
Connor lightly replied.
“Alright, Connor McDonald, right? I’ll go to class now. Just you two wait. I’ll have plenty of opportunities to deal with you in the future…”
After saying this, Anita turned around and left with her group of friends.
After seeing Anita leave, Connor was prepared to walk forward.
Mr. Welch had originally planned to use this opportunity to curry favor with Connor.
However, Connor had already walked far away. Moreover, there were other students watching, so Mr. Welch did not choose to chase after him.
“What are you all standing here for? Hurry up and go to class…”
The students who had been watching the show dispersed after hearing Mr. Welch’s words.
Connor saw that it was almost time, so he planned to go back to class.
“Hey handsome, wait a moment!”
But at this moment, a voice suddenly came from behind Connor.
When Connor heard this voice, he turned around and realized that it was the girl he had saved just now.
“Yeah?”
Connor stopped in his tracks and turned to look at the girl. He asked the girl with a very cold expression.
“Thank you so much for just now. If not for you, I might have already…”
The girl hurriedly bowed to Connor and exclaimed.
“It’s just a small matter. You don’t have to take it to heart…”
Connor replied to the girl indifferently, then continued to walk forward.
…

chapters.title: Chapter 1080: I'm Looking for Someone
chapters.content:
Chapter 1080: I’m Looking for Someone
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
After Connor had finished speaking, he continued to walk toward the classroom.
However, after walking for a while, he realized that the girl was still following behind him.
Connor was a little puzzled. Then, he asked the girl softly, “Why are you still following me? Don’t you have to go to class?”
“I don’t have class today…”
The girl hurriedly replied.
“Are you feeling unwell? Do you want me to send you to the hospital…”
Connor hesitated for a moment before continuing to ask the girl.
“No, no…”
When the girl heard Connor’s words, she hurriedly waved her hand and whispered, “I don’t have the money to see a doctor…”
“Is there anything else?”
Connor asked in confusion.
“Your name is Connor McDonald, right?”
The girl looked at Connor and asked,
“Yes!”
Connor nodded lightly.
“My name is Sevyn Knox. Thank you so much for just now, but… I want to let you know that Anita and the others are not to be trifled with. Just now, you offended them because of me. They will definitely not let you off…”
Sevyn said to Connor guiltily.
“It’s fine. They won’t dare to do anything to me!”
Connor replied indifferently. Then, he couldn’t help but size up the girl and ask in confusion, “By the way, why did those girls hit you just now? How did you offend them?”
“…”
When Sevyn heard Connor’s words, she was somewhat helpless. Then, she said softly, “I’m in the same faculty as Anita. She likes a guy in our class, but that guy likes me. Anita thought that I was seducing that guy, so she brought some people to beat me up…”
“She beat you up just because of that?”
Connor was speechless when he heard Sevyn’s words.
“Anita’s family is very rich. She often does horrid things in school. It’s normal for her to beat people up!”
Sevyn said helplessly.
“Does she think she can hit people just because she has money?”
Connor said angrily. Then, he took out his phone and looked at Sevyn. “Take down my number. If someone like Anita finds trouble with you again, just call me…”
“That’s not necessary. I’m already very grateful that you helped me this time. If you help me again, they will definitely not let you off!”
Sevyn hurriedly said.
“Give me your phone!”
Connor ignored Sevyn’s words and extended his right hand.
“Connor…”
Sevyn looked at Connor and wanted to say something.
“Give your phone to me…”
Connor continued.
After a moment of hesitation, Sevyn took out her phone and handed it to Connor.
Connor saved his phone number in Sevyn’s address book and said lightly, “Alright, you don’t have to follow me anymore. If you encounter any trouble in the future, just call me!”
“But…”
Sevyn looked at Connor as if she still wanted to speak.
However, Connor didn’t give Sevyn a chance to continue speaking. He directly walked toward the teaching building.
Sevyn looked at Connor’s back with mixed feelings, her face full of worry.
…
On the other side, after Connor returned to the classroom, he had a simple chat with Brooks Hunt and Justin Spielberg.
The two of them were curious as to why Connor didn’t come to class yesterday.
Connor casually found an excuse to brush it off.
Because the next class was Rachel’s class, all the students in the class came over.
Especially the guys. Usually, they liked to sit at the back, but when it came to Rachel’s class, these people would fight to sit in front. Rachel had great charm after all.
Soon, Rachel, who was dressed exquisitely and beautifully, appeared in the classroom.
This was how Rachel was. No matter where she was, as long as she appeared, she would be able to amaze all the men.
Connor wasn’t that interested in Rachel because he knew better than anyone how terrifying she was.
Whoever married Rachel in the future would definitely not have a good life.
After Rachel walked up to the podium, she did not waste any time and started the class.
However, she had only started when a large group of girls appeared at the door of the classroom.
“Why is Anita Tolstoy here?”
When Justin saw the big-breasted woman leading the group, he was a little surprised. He could not help but mutter softly.
When Connor heard Anita’s name, he felt that it was somewhat familiar.
Therefore, he looked up and said to Justin, “She should be looking for me!”
“Looking for you?”
When Justin heard Connor’s words, he became even more shocked. Then, he turned and asked Connor, “Dude, don’t joke around here. Do you know Anita?”
“I don’t know her, but I have some conflicts with her!”
Connor replied indifferently,
“No way. When did you offend Anita? Let me tell you, this girl is not to be trifled with. Her father is especially rich, and her brother is in the underworld. Basically, it doesn’t end well if you offend her in our school…”
Justin said to Connor worriedly.
“It’s okay. If she dares to enter the classroom now, I guarantee that she won’t have a good ending…”
Connor said with a smile.
“What are you talking about?”
Justin looked at Connor and asked with some doubt.
“You will know later…”
Connor replied lightly and continued to play with his phone. He didn’t care about Anita at all because he knew that if she entered the classroom, she would end up in a very tragic situation.
“What are you guys doing?”
At this moment, Rachel also noticed Anita at the door. She frowned and asked unhappily.
Rachel hated people interrupting her class the most.
“I’m here to find someone…”
Anita didn’t put Rachel in her eyes at all. She replied indifferently and then led her people into the classroom.
“We’re having class now. You can find that person after class. Now, all of you get out!”
Perhaps it was because Rachel had just arrived at Newtown University, so she was restraining her anger. She didn’t get angry but called out in a low voice.
“What I do is none of your business. You can continue on with your class, and I’ll find who I’m looking for. Don’t waste my time.”
Anita didn’t give Rachel any face and replied coldly. Then, she saw Connor in the classroom and walked toward him.
“Get out!”
However, before Anita could reach Connor, Rachel stopped her and spat out the two words in an extremely cold tone.
“What did you say?”
When Anita heard Rachel’s words, she could not help but be stunned.

chapters.title: Chapter 1081: The Domineering Rachel
chapters.content:
Chapter 1081: The Domineering Rachel
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
After Anita heard Rachel asking her to get out, her expression was unusually angry.
After all, relying on her family connections, Anita had always been domineering at Newtown University, and no one dared to provoke her.
Even the principal would give her some face when he saw her.
But today, something strange happened. Just as Anita arrived at the school, she was defeated by Connor.
Now that she had finally found his classroom, she was scolded by Rachel.
As a wealthy girl like Anita, she couldn’t bear this humiliation.
Meanwhile, Connor sat in place, smiling and watching Rachel and Anita.
He had known Rachel for a while, and he knew her temperament very well.
Anyone who dared to disturb her class wouldn’t end up well, and that’s why he remained calm.
Because Connor knew that Anita couldn’t even approach him.
“What did you say just now?”
Anita stared, her expression extremely fierce.
“I told you to get out!”
Rachel, also enraged, replied coldly.
“Who do you think you are? How dare you tell me to get out, do you believe…”
Before she could finish her sentence, the students in the class saw Rachel raise her fair jade hand and slap Anita across the face.
“Smack!”
A crisp sound.
The whole classroom fell silent, and almost all the students stared in astonishment at Rachel, their expressions incredulous.
Because Rachel had not been at Newtown University for long, these students didn’t know much about her temperament. They thought she was just a bit cold and elegant.
But no one expected Rachel to be a hot head.
And the person she had just slapped was none other than Anita, the little witch of Newtown University!
“Miss Rachel is too ruthless!”
Justin looked at Rachel in astonishment.
“What is this…”
Connor smiled faintly. When Rachel was at Porthampton University, her temper was probably even fiercer. She had already become much more restrained now.
“How dare you hit me!”
Anita covered her face, her expression full of disbelief, and shouted at Rachel.
“I told you to get out, didn’t you hear me?”
Rachel repeated coldly.
“Do you know who I am? Do you know who my dad is? I’ll have the principal expel you right now, do you believe…”
Anita seemed to have gone crazy, shouting at Rachel at the top of her voice.
But Rachel’s eyes flashed with annoyance, and she raised her hand again, fiercely slapping Anita’s face without expression, saying, “I’m telling you to leave, didn’t you hear me?”
“I…”
Anita seemed to want to say something.
“Smack!”
Rachel didn’t waste time talking with her, and she backhanded another slap, then said expressionlessly, “Are you leaving or not?”
Anita covered her pretty face, her expression filled with shock and disbelief.
Because at this moment, she was completely stunned by Rachel. She had never seen such a fierce woman before.
The students in the classroom were also stunned in place, their expressions filled with astonishment.
They had no idea how to describe their feelings right now.
No one expected that Rachel, who appeared elegant and noble on the surface, would have such a hot temper.
The girls who had been with Anita, who used to help her bully those students without money or power, stood still by her side.
“You, as a teacher, dare to hit students. I’m going to the principal right now to get you fired!”
Anita knew that if she stayed here, she would definitely continue to get beaten, so she shouted and hurriedly ran out of the classroom.
Rachel watched Anita’s figure, her expression on her face was very calm, as if this matter was just a trivial matter to her.
After a moment, she and the others completely disappeared from the classroom.
Rachel glanced at Connor lightly, as if blaming him.
But she didn’t say much, instead, she picked up the textbook and said calmly, “Let’s continue the class!”
Only after hearing her words did everyone snap back to reality.
“Miss Rachel is so cool!”
Justin couldn’t help but sigh softly.
“Yeah, so handsome, full of momentum. It’s the first time I’ve seen Anita being beaten like this!”
Brook quickly chimed in.
“Hehe…”
Upon hearing Justin and Brook’s words, Connor couldn’t help but smile faintly, then secretly sighed in his heart, “Rachel has already restrained herself a lot this time. If it were at Porthampton University, Anita’s situation would probably be much worse…”
Rachel seemed as if nothing had happened, returning to her previous sexy and glamorous demeanor, quietly giving the lecture.
However, after a while, Anita, the principal of Newtown University, and the head teacher appeared at the classroom door once again.
When the students in the class saw Anita coming with the principal, they all felt a chill on behalf of Rachel.
“It’s over, it’s over. Anita actually brought the principal here…”
Justin’s expression seemed a bit panicked as she continued, “I heard that her father has an extraordinary relationship with the principal. The principal wouldn’t really dismiss Miss Rachel because of this, right…”
“After Miss Rachel beat her like that, she will definitely not let Miss Rachel off!”
Brook also shouted.
Joel took a deep breath, his expression also filled with worry.
At this moment, the students in the classroom all had the same thought, after all, a beautiful teacher like Rachel was hard to come by, so her popularity among the students was still very high. No one wanted Rachel to be dismissed because of this.
“Unless Wyane and Luna come out to plead for Miss Rachel, otherwise the principal will definitely dismiss Miss Rachel…”
Just at this moment, Justin spoke again.
Wyane and Luna’s backgrounds were also very terrifying, so if the two of them could speak up for Rachel, the problem wouldn’t be too serious.
“You can rest assured, no one dares to dismiss Rachel. They’ve come to apologize to Rachel…”
But just at this moment, Connor suddenly spoke up.

chapters.title: Chapter 1082: Apologize to Miss Rachel!
chapters.content:
Chapter 1082: Apologize to Miss Rachel!
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
“Came to apologize to Miss Rachel?”
Justin, Brook, and Joel were all stunned when they heard Connor’s words, their faces filled with confusion.
“Connor, do you know who Anita is? Anita’s father has a very close relationship with the principal. The principal will definitely protect Anita…”
Justin quickly retorted Connor.
“Yeah, Connor, you haven’t been at Newtown University for long, so you don’t know much about Anita…”
Brook chimed in as well.
“I don’t know much about this Anita, but I know Rachel very well…”
Connor smiled and replied to Brook and Justin.
“It’s impossible for Anita to apologize to Miss Rachel. After all, Miss Rachel just hit her!”
Justin still couldn’t believe what Connor said and shook his head directly.
“Whether she comes to apologize or not, you’ll find out soon enough…”
Connor replied calmly and didn’t say much more.
On the other side, the principal and the headmaster of Newtown University, accompanied by Anita, entered the classroom.
When Rachel saw these people coming in, a hint of annoyance flashed in her eyes.
“Miss Rachel, can you come out for a moment?”
The principal smiled and asked Rachel.
“My class isn’t over yet. Let’s talk after I finish.”
Rachel replied calmly.
Upon hearing her words, all the students in the classroom were dumbfounded. No one expected her to refuse even the principal’s face.
However, many students thought that she might have already guessed that she was about to be expelled, which was why she didn’t give face to the principal.
After hearing her response, surprisingly, the principal didn’t show any signs of anger. He smiled and said, “Alright, we’ll wait until you finish your class.”
After saying that, the principal walked out of the classroom with Anita and stood quietly at the classroom door, waiting.
Rachel continued her class, but the students in the classroom were no longer in the mood to listen.
They were worried about whether she would indeed be expelled by the school.
In the blink of an eye, the class ended in no time.
Rachel tidied up her lesson plan quickly and walked out of the classroom in high heels.
The students in the classroom focused their attention on her.
They knew that the principal, the headmaster, and Anita were all waiting outside the classroom.
They wanted to see whether the principal would actually expel her.
Since her conversation with the principal was not loud enough, the students in the classroom didn’t know what was said between them.
They could only see that the principal treated Rachel with utmost respect.
This scene was quite incredible.
Because the students of Newtown University had never seen their principal speak with such respectful tone to anyone before!
But even more surprisingly, the principal directly dragged Anita in front of Rachel.
Although her expression showed reluctance, she still bowed deeply and apologized to Rachel.
Rachel didn’t even glance at Anita and left gracefully.
The students in the classroom, after witnessing this scene, were all stunned in their places, their expressions filled with shock.
After all, just a moment ago, they were worried for Rachel, afraid that she would be expelled by the principal.
But no one expected that the result would turn out like this—Anita actually apologized to Rachel, just as Connor had said.
The other students managed to keep their composure, but Justin and Brook couldn’t stay calm.
The two of them widened their eyes and looked at Connor in disbelief.
“Connor, how did you… How did you know that Anita would apologize to Rachel?” Justin hesitated for two seconds and then stuttered as he asked Connor.
Upon hearing his question, Connor smiled faintly and said expressionlessly, “Don’t forget, I told you before that although I don’t know Anita well, I know Rachel very well!”
“What exactly is your relationship with Miss Rachel?” Justin hurriedly asked.
“Rachel is my teacher at Porthampton University. Now she has become much more restrained. If this happened at Porthampton University, Anita would have been expelled today!” Connor said calmly.
“Miss Rachel is so ruthless!” Justin couldn’t help but gasp.
Connor just smiled faintly and didn’t say much.
A few minutes later, Justin and Brook told the other students in the class what Connor had said, embellishing the details.
However, he had intentionally done this because he had always been resentful about the incident where Rachel had revealed his identity. That’s why he told Justin about these things. This way, the students in the class would also speculate about Rachel’s identity.
Connor intended to let her experience the distress he had gone through when his identity was exposed.
Sure enough, his method was very effective. Now there were many versions of speculation about Rachel in the class.
But regardless of which version, they all indicated that she was definitely not an ordinary person.
…
After the incident between Rachel and Anita was over.
Connor continued to finish the remaining classes and then prepared to invite Freya out for a meal.
After all, they had just established their relationship yesterday, so he felt that he had to strike while the iron was hot and cultivate their relationship well.
Connor took out his phone and dialed Freya’s number.
“Ring ring…”
After two rings, she answered the phone and asked softly, “Connor, is there something you need?”
“Freya, are you free tonight? Let’s go out for a meal,” he asked.
“Tonight?” She hesitated for a moment upon hearing Connor’s words.
“What’s wrong? Do you have something going on?” He noticed her hesitation.
“It’s not anything important, but I’m going out to a gathering with friends tonight. If you don’t mind, you can come along with us, and I can also introduce you to my friends…” Freya paused for a moment and continued, “If you mind, then forget it. I can make an excuse to cancel the gathering and go out to eat with you…”
“No need. Since you’ve made plans with your friends, it wouldn’t be good to cancel now. I’ll come with you to meet your friends!” Connor quickly said.
“That’s great! Come to Travio Corporation to pick me up at 6 p.m.!” Freya said happily.
“Alright!” Connor nodded and then hung up the phone.

chapters.title: Chapter 1083: Freya’s Friend
chapters.content:
Chapter 1083: Freya’s Friend
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Connor knew that Freya had actually returned to the country half a year ago.
During this half year, she must have also made many new friends.
And he could take this opportunity to get to know her life in the past half year.
Because they were going out to a gathering later, he went straight home to change into a new outfit.
This outfit was not cheap, and it was an international luxury brand, with a price of at least five digits.
After changing clothes, Connor left home.
But after going downstairs, he found that his Porsche was still parked there, as if no one had touched it.
“I wonder where that girl went…”
He sighed softly and didn’t think much about it. He hailed a taxi outside the residential area and headed to Travor Corporation.
After arriving at Travor Corporation, he took out his phone and dialed Freya’s number.
A few minutes later, Freya came out of the company wearing an office lady uniform.
She was tall and sexy, with a pair of beautiful legs wrapped in stockings under her skirt, and she was wearing high heels. Combined with her exquisite and pretty face, she looked exceptionally beautiful.
Although he had seen many beautiful women, in his eyes, she would always be the most delicate and beautiful woman he had ever seen.
When she saw him, she also felt a bright feeling.
After all, he had never been fond of dressing up before, but in fact, he had a very good appearance. A casual dress-up would definitely make him a handsome guy.
“I didn’t expect Connor to be quite handsome…”
Freya couldn’t help but exclaim in her heart, and then she smiled and said, “Connor, you’re here?”
“Yes!”
Connor nodded gently towards Freya.
“I made an appointment with my friends. Let’s wait for them at the company gate,” she said to him.
“Okay…”
Connor agreed and didn’t say much.
At this moment, he was very curious about the people she had met during the time she lost her memory.
A few minutes later, several luxury cars stopped at the entrance of Travor Corporation.
These cars were not the flashy sports cars that rich heirs drove. They were all low-key business cars, giving people a mature and steady feeling.
Several young people got out of these luxury cars and gathered around Freya, actively greeting her.
She responded warmly and introduced the identities of these people to Connor.
He noticed that these people could all be considered as the business elites of Newtown. They were not like Jovan, who was a rich heir. They were all carefully cultivated by various prominent families. Their personalities were very mature, and they had already begun to gradually take over their family businesses. It was estimated that they would inherit the family industries in a short time.
Connor understood that Freya was in contact with these people for the future development of Travor Corporation.
“Freya, who is this handsome guy? It seems like we haven’t seen him before!”
At this moment, a young man in a suit asked Freya.
After all, their circle was very high-end, and ordinary second-generation rich kids couldn’t even get in. So naturally, the others noticed Connor, who was new.
“This is my boyfriend, Connor!”
Freya had no intention of hiding anything and straightforwardly told everyone.
Upon hearing Freya’s words, the people present were all stunned, their expressions showing great surprise.
Of course, some people reacted quickly and proactively greeted Connor with a warm smile on their faces.
However, after experiencing so much, he naturally could tell that there was a hint of disdain in their eyes.
But now he simply didn’t care about these things.
Although he had dressed up today, the total value of his clothes wouldn’t exceed fifty thousand dollars.
For ordinary people, this was already very good.
But if placed in front of these true second-generation wealthy individuals, it wouldn’t count for much at all.
So Freya’s friends treated him as just an ordinary person.
Of course, these people looked down on Connor in their hearts, but they still wore warm smiles on their faces and behaved very warmly, making it feel like they truly treated him as a friend.
However, these people couldn’t understand what abilities Connor had that allowed him to pursue a goddess like Freya.
“I didn’t expect you to already have a boyfriend…”
At that moment, a young man smilingly said to Freya.
“I just got together with Connor yesterday…”
Freya explained calmly.
“Oh, I see!”
The young man nodded, then continued, “I wonder if Mr. Arthur will be sad when he finds out?”
“Yeah, Mr. Arthur pursued you for such a long time, and in the end, he was stopped by Connor. If Mr. Arthur finds out this news, he’ll definitely be very sad…”
Another young man chimed in.
Upon hearing the conversation between the two, Freya’s eyes flashed with a hint of surprise.
After seeing her expression seemed a bit off, Connor couldn’t help but ask her softly, “Arthur, who is this Mr. Arthur they’re talking about?”
“Arthur Synder, he’s from the Synder family in Newtown and has been pursuing me all this time!”
Freya replied nonchalantly.
“Arthur?”
After hearing this name, Connor couldn’t help but pause for a moment, and a hint of astonishment flashed in his eyes.
Because Connor suddenly remembered that among the Four Heirs who were on par with Harold, Jovan, and Henny, there seemed to be someone named Arthur.
And this person’s background also seemed quite remarkable.
But Connor never expected that things would turn out this coincidentally, and Arthur turned out to be Freya’s pursuer.
“Mr. Arthur’s car has arrived…”
Just then, a young man in a suit suddenly called out.
Upon hearing this sentence, everyone turned their heads to look.
They saw a Porsche with the license plate ending in five-eight slowly pulling up in front of them.
After the car door opened, a handsome man stepped out of the car, while a beautiful woman emerged from the passenger seat.

chapters.title: Chapter 1084: Hustlers Club
chapters.content:
Chapter 1084: Hustlers Club
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Connor knew that the young man who came out of the Porsche should be the eldest of the Four Heirs and the most astonishing one in terms of background, Arthur.
In the past, during the evening party in Porthampton, Harold, Jovan and Henny had all made their appearances.
However, Arthur was the only one who didn’t show up, so this was the first time they met, and Arthur didn’t know much about Connor’s identity.
He had a very handsome appearance and a mature and stable temperament that stood out significantly from the others.
This indicated that he must have already held a significant position in the Synder family, otherwise, he wouldn’t have such a demeanor.
Beside him was a beautiful woman, dressed very sexily and beautifully. She wore a lady’s watch priced at over a million on her wrist, and the bag she held was definitely not cheap. She looked like a genuine wealthy beauty.
The beautiful woman went directly to Freya’s side and happily exclaimed, “Freya, you finally found time to meet us!”
“I’ve been extremely busy with work lately…”
Freya looked at the beautiful woman in front of her and explained faintly, then turned to Connor and said, “Connor, this is Lara Tooks, my good friend!”
“Hello, I’m Connor!”
After hearing Freya’s words, Connor took the initiative to greet Lara.
Lara looked him up and down, then turned to Freya and asked, “Freya, what’s your relationship with Connor?”
“Connor is my boyfriend!”
Freya answered naturally.
“Your boyfriend?”
After hearing her words, she couldn’t help but cover her mouth in surprise, her expression very incredulous.
Meanwhile, Arthur, who was standing nearby, couldn’t help but glance at Connor, but his expression remained calm. He didn’t pay much attention to him and continued to chat with others with a smile on his face.
“Freya, how did you two get together? And what does Connor do?”
After learning about the relationship between Connor and Freya, Lara became naturally curious. She wondered why Freya would be with a seemingly ordinary guy like Connor, so she began asking a flurry of questions.
Freya felt very helpless inside and simply responded briefly.
“Alright, is everyone here?”
Just then, Arthur spoke up.
“We’re all here…”
Everyone quickly replied.
“Okay, Queta is waiting for us at Hustlers Club. Let’s go!”
Arthur said calmly.
Everyone’s expressions revealed surprise upon hearing Arthur’s words.
“Queta is back too?”
Lara directed her attention directly to Arthur, excitedly asking.
“Yes, she just returned. Let’s go!”
Arthur nodded, then walked towards his car.
Since Lara had a good relationship with Freya, she tactlessly chose to ride in the same car as Connor and Freya.
Another young man took the initiative to get into Arthur’s car.
Arthur drove ahead, leading the way, while the others followed behind.
It’s worth noting that this group of cars basically brought together all the top rich heirs in Newtown. Anyone who could integrate into this circle was definitely not an ordinary person.
In Arthur’s Porsche.
Sitting in the passenger seat was a young man named Samuel. His family was in the catering business and very wealthy. Moreover, Samuel had a very good relationship with Arthur.
“Let me remind you, that Connor is Freya’s boyfriend…”
Samuel whispered to Arthur.
“I know…”
Arthur nodded lightly.
“Aren’t you pursuing Freya? Don’t you care at all?”
After seeing his reaction, Samuel’s eyes flashed with a hint of confusion, and he asked, puzzled.
“Care?”
Upon hearing these words, Arthur couldn’t help but smile faintly and said expressionlessly, “This Connor is just an ordinary person, he can’t pose any threat to me at all. After some time, she will realize that she and Connor are not from the same world. So, there’s no need to care about these things!”
Perhaps this was the difference between Arthur and other rich heirs.
If it were any other second-generation wealthy individual, they would definitely try every means to suppress Connor and even threaten him to leave Freya.
But Arthur had no intention of getting involved in such matters at all.
Because he felt that Connor might not even have the qualifications to be his rival.
“You are still so confident!”
Samuel smiled lightly.
Arthur glanced at Samuel but didn’t say anything.
In fact, among these rich heirs, Samuel could be considered outstanding.
Currently, Samuel basically controlled the majority of the company’s business, and it was only natural for him to inherit the company in the future. Countless people looked up to Samuel.
However, the person Samuel truly admired and feared should be only Arthur.
Because Samuel was clear about how deep Arthur’s schemes were. Sometimes, when facing Arthur, Samuel didn’t feel like he was facing someone of the same age, but more like facing a commercial giant of his father’s generation.
In other words, Arthur had already created a significant gap between himself and these people.
After about half an hour, the car finally arrived at the Hustlers Club.
In Newtown, the Hustlers Club was not very famous. On the contrary, very few people knew about this place. But anyone who could enter this club was definitely not an ordinary person.
Led by Arthur, everyone walked directly into the club.
Connor briefly observed the environment inside the club. It was very tranquil, with no visible guests or waiters to receive them. The decoration style seemed to be designed in the colonial style, with white doors and wooden floors. Everything felt fresh and natural, giving a very intimate feeling.
Having been accustomed to the bustling life of a big city, coming to such a place indeed evoked a different kind of feeling.
At this moment, a beautiful woman dressed in a red cheongsam walked up to Arthur and smiled, saying, “Mr. Arthur, Miss Queta is waiting inside!”

chapters.title: Chapter 1085: Queta Zepeda
chapters.content:
Chapter 1085: Queta Zepeda
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Under the leadership of Arthur, everyone entered the Hustlers Club directly.
The interior decoration of the club was not much different from the outside, both reflecting the style of the Colonial era.
The waiter led everyone to a private room. Inside the room, there was a beautiful woman dressed in a sexy white cheongsam. Her appearance could be described as top-notch, giving off a very aloof vibe.
It was difficult to determine her actual age just by looking at her. If judging solely based on appearance, this woman was probably in her early twenties at most.
However, the aura she exuded and the impression she gave off were reminiscent of a thirty-year-old woman.
Connor took a quick glance at the woman and knew that she must be Queta, whom Arthur had mentioned earlier.
Moreover, Connor could sense that Queta held a very high position among these people, possibly even higher than Arthur.
So he was somewhat curious about Queta’s background and what made her earn the admiration of someone like Arthur.
“Queta, it’s been almost half a year since I last saw you!” Lara exclaimed while holding Queta’s arm, acting cute.
“I was abroad dealing with some business matters, so I didn’t have time to come back. I just returned today and met with all of you soon…” she gently explained, reaching out to touch Lara’s head.
“Queta, I heard that you closed a big deal overseas, is that true?” Samuel asked with a smile.
“It’s all right,” Queta replied with a faint smile, then gestured for everyone to sit down.
But when she saw Connor, a hint of surprise flashed in her eyes.
After all, it was their first meeting, but she could feel that Connor was not an ordinary person.
At the moment, he was also observing her. He felt that he had seen this woman somewhere before but couldn’t recall who she really was.
After everyone took their seats, she began to handle the tea set in front of her.
Queta’s tea artistry was excellent, her movements were smooth and graceful, giving a sense of elegance.
Although all the wealthy second-generation individuals present were business elites, they seemed somewhat restrained and nervous in front of Queta.
Even Arthur had a serious expression and no one dared to speak until Queta spoke.
Connor may not have known that the woman in front of him, Queta, was a powerful figure in Newtown, even throughout the entire Orilon. Many regarded her as a legend.
Because Queta’s company had connections and influence that could shake the entire Newtown, and she was the sole controller of Zepeda Corporation.
Just based on this, it was evident how formidable Queta was.
However, this was not the most terrifying aspect of heer. The most frightening thing about her was that she had no identifiable background.
Or one could say that her background was incredibly mysterious, to the point where no one could investigate who she really was.
At such a young age, Queta had become a renowned business queen in Newtown, commanding the respect of countless business tycoons. This alone showcased her terror.
Therefore, even Arthur held great respect for Queta, not daring to show the slightest hint of disrespect.
“Who is this gentleman?”
After a moment, Queta brewed the tea and proactively handed a cup to Connor.
Freya hurriedly explained, He is Connor, my boyfriend!”
“Oh, so you’re Freya’s boyfriend. You’re really lucky!” Queta faintly smiled and said, “Mr. Connor, please have some tea.”
“Thank you!” He nodded gently, picked up the teacup, and took a sip.
After receiving their teacups, everyone started to taste the tea.
“Queta, if I’m not mistaken, this tea should be yellow tea!” Arthur slowly put down his teacup and asked softly.
“That’s right!” Queta nodded lightly.
Knowing that this tea was yellow tea, everyone was naturally amazed. Yellow tea could be considered a top-grade tea, with a value of around 2,000 dollars per gram and in limited supply. Even wealthy people may not necessarily have the chance to drink it.
“Queta, your skill in tea art seems to have improved again!” Another young man said at that moment.
“Of course, her tea art is the best in our Newtown. Even my father speaks highly of her tea art!” Lara quickly added.
The others also began to flatter and praise Queta, except for Connor and Freya, who remained calm.
Connor wasn’t particularly interested in tea. In his eyes, all teas tasted the same, just like red wine.
He couldn’t understand why rich people liked to play around with such things. He couldn’t comprehend their behavior.
Meanwhile, Queta focused her attention on him. She thought he was dressed very plainly, but his demeanor was remarkably calm and natural. This surprised Queta.
After all, it was rare for someone to remain so composed and natural upon meeting her.
Therefore, she believed that either he had an astonishing background, which made him indifferent to everything, or he simply didn’t know his own identity, which explained his calmness.
She thought the latter possibility was more likely, as it was normal for Connor to be unaware of her identity.
Queta was even more curious about how Arthur would handle the relationship between Connor and Freya. After all, Arthur had long considered Freya as his possession.
After finishing the tea, the waiter began to serve the dishes.
The group started to chat about various topics, but their conversations were not about the usual leisure or women that ordinary wealthy kids often discussed.
They discussed business matters, specifically focused on the development of Newtown.
They engaged in lively discussions and occasionally shared information they possessed with others.
For example, they talked about real estate development projects and future city planning, topics that ordinary people would never come across.

chapters.title: Chapter 1086: Lara Tooks's Temptations!
chapters.content:
Chapter 1086: Lara Tooks’s Temptations!
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Before Connor met Queta and the others, he had never attended such a gathering.
He knew that most of the real rich heirs did not only know how to eat, drink, and play.
Furthermore, Connor finally understood why Freya, who had always been reserved, would know these people—It turned out that she was only contacting these people for the future development of the Travio Corporation and to expand her connections.
However, Freya might not know that Connor, who was sitting beside her, was the real boss among this group of people.
Freya did not need to waste so much effort.
Although she knew that Connor was very rich, she still did not know much about his true strength.
Connor did not talk to Freya about these things because he felt that managing and expanding the Travio Corporation was her goal. He might help Freya at an appropriate time, but he would not completely disrupt her plans. If that happened, Freya would lose her motivation and goal to fight.
After some interaction, Connor realized that Queta was still the center of this circle.
Arthur Synder and Freya were above the rest, while the rest were on equal footing.
While the others were exchanging information with each other, Freya and Arthur spoke very little.
This was because the two of them were no longer on the same level as these people.
Arthur would say a few words from time to time, but the information he revealed was often shocking. Meanwhile, Freya sat in her original seat and listened quietly. She did not say a word from the beginning to the end, nor did she express her opinion.
Connor looked at Freya beside him and suddenly felt that the gap between them seemed to be getting bigger and bigger.
A few years had passed, and Freya had changed greatly. However, Connor still seemed to be walking on the spot. Connor could not understand what everyone was saying at all.
At the right time, Queta would also reveal information that ordinary people could not obtain. Of course, the information she said was definitely very important. Ordinary people might not be able to obtain it even if they used all their connections.
After everyone heard about Queta’s information, they would commit it to memory.
This was because this was an opportunity that could only be encountered by chance.
However, in this private room, there were two people who seemed out of place: Connor and Lara Tooks.
Connor didn’t know much about the situation in Newtown, so he naturally couldn’t understand what these people were talking about. Meanwhile Lara didn’t even need to understand—she didn’t care about business at all.
Lara looked at the people in the private room. She was a little bored, so she focused her attention on Connor. Then, she leaned in front of him and asked him with a smile, “How is it? Do you not understand at all? It feels like there’s a difference between you and them, right?”
Lara was very close to Connor when she spoke. She was thinking about the fragrance when she spoke, thinking that it would occasionally enter Connor’s nose.
Connor subconsciously stepped back and said indifferently, “I don’t feel any difference!”
“You can’t even get a word in edgewise, yet you don’t even feel the difference. Are you stupid?” Lara said, stunned.
“What they say has nothing to do with me. There’s no need for me to understand…” Connor replied indifferently.
“What do you mean?”
Lara looked at Connor with a puzzled expression.
Connor hesitated for a moment, then said softly, “Why are they discussing these things so excitedly?”
“What else could it be? Of course it’s to earn money!” Lara said casually.
“I’m already very rich, and I don’t need to earn money, so it doesn’t affect me much if I don’t understand what they’re saying!” Connor said lightly.
At this moment, Connor wasn’t bragging. Why should he place so much attention on Newtown, which was such a small place?
In Connor’s eyes, the information these people were saying was really too childish. He had better things to focus on—such as Rockefeller.
“Why are you so good at bragging!”
Lara was instantly rendered speechless. A trace of disdain flashed across her eyes, and then she said, “Do you think you’re rich? Let me tell you, literally everyone here is richer than you. Besides, Queta is the business queen of Newtown. Isn’t she also discussing these things now? Are you richer than Queta?”
“Haha…”
Connor smiled, but didn’t say anything.
“…”
When Lara saw that Connor wasn’t going to say anything, she deliberately moved closer to his ear and whispered, “Since you’re so rich, why don’t you find a chance to show me how rich you are?”
Lara and Connor were talking in a very ambiguous manner, as if they were lovers flirting. In addition, Lara was dressed very scantily, which made it even easier for people to fantasize.
Connor knew that Lara was obviously seducing him on purpose. A trace of helplessness flashed across his eyes, but he ignored her.
When Lara saw that Connor wasn’t responding to her, her expression seemed a little unhappy. She turned her head and didn’t say anything.
Two hours passed.
Seeing that it was almost time for the gathering to end, everyone prepared to go back home.
Connor and Freya left the Hustlers Club first.
Connor drove Freya home and then returned home alone.
When he got home, Connor saw that Rachel was still watching TV on the sofa. Connor couldn’t help but remember what happened in school today. After hesitating for a moment, he walked straight to his bedroom.
“Connor, stop right there!”
But at this moment, Rachel suddenly shouted.
“Ms. Wallace, I’m a little sleepy. Let’s talk about it tomorrow!”
Connor replied helplessly, then hurriedly walked into the bedroom.
“I told you to stop!”
Rachel gritted his teeth and shouted coldly.
After Connor heard Rachel’s words, he could not help but take a deep breath. Then, he turned his head and asked Rachel with a smile, “Ms. Wallace, what’s the matter?”
“What happened with Anita Tolstoy?” Rachel asked Connor expressionlessly.
“I don’t know what’s wrong with that girl either…” Connor replied helplessly.
“Then why did she come to the classroom to look for you today? Did you deliberately ask her to come over when I was in class?” Rachel pressed.

chapters.title: Chapter 1087: Investigating A Person
chapters.content:
Chapter 1087: Investigating A Person
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
After Connor heard Rachel’s words, he was instantly rendered speechless.
He could not help but frown and said with a broken expression, “Ma’am, my brain is not working well. Why would I ask her to come and find me? There is indeed some conflict between Anita and me, but I don’t know why she would come for me during your class…”
After Rachel saw Connor’s reaction, her expression seemed to ease up a lot as she asked softly, “You really didn’t set this up on purpose?”
“Of course not…”
Connor lightly shook his head.
“…”
Rachel hesitated for a moment before saying indifferently, “Alright, I can temporarily believe that you didn’t deliberately set this up, but no matter what, today’s incident started because of you. If it weren’t for that, I wouldn’t have hit you, so you have to compensate me!”
“Compensate you?”
When Connor heard Rachel’s words, he could not help but be stunned for a moment. Then, he asked with a puzzled expression, “You were the one who hit me. It doesn’t seem to have anything to do with me. Why should I compensate you?”
“It’s fine if you don’t compensate me. I’ll get Anita to find trouble with you every day. I’ll see how you can bear to stay in Newtown University then!”
Rachel said calmly.
“Uh…”
After Connor heard Rachel’s words, he was immediately speechless. He asked with a broken expression, “Then how do you want me to make it up to you?”
Rachel thought for a moment. “I haven’t thought about how you should compensate me yet, but you just have to remember that you owe me onen now. When I need your help, you have to agree…”
“That…”
Connor’s expression was a little hesitant. Seeing this, Rachel raised her eyebrows and asked, “You don’t want to agree, do you?”
“I-I will, okay?” Connor said helplessly, then continued to ask, “When are you moving out? Can you not keep staying at my house…”
“Don’t worry, I’ll leave the day after tomorrow. You don’t have to chase me away!” Rachel indifferently replied to Connor.
After Connor heard her words, the expression on his face appeared somewhat helpless, but he didn’t say anything more. Instead, he walked toward his bedroom.
…
After Freya, Lara, Connor, and the others left, Arthur was not in a hurry to leave. Instead, he followed Queta to another private room.
Queta turned to look at Arthur and asked softly, “Arthur, is there anything else you needed?”
“Queta, what do you think of Connor?” Arthur asked very politely.
“I can’t see through him. You have to be careful!” Queta answered directly.
When Arthur heard this, he immediately frowned.
Previously, Arthur did not take Connor seriously at all because he felt that Connor might not even be qualified to be his opponent.
However, after the brief interaction just now, Arthur suddenly realized that there was something wrong with Connor. He found that he could not see through Connor at all.
When they were eating just now, Arthur realized that Connor was not interested in what they were discussing at all.
Such a situation was very rare—if it were any other ordinary person, they would definitely be very interested in what they were discussing.
That was why Arthur chose to leave last and ask Queta about her opinion of Connor.
When Arthur heard it, he was sure that his hunch was not without basis.
Even someone like Queta couldn’t see through Connor, which was enough to prove that Connor was an extraordinary person.
Arthur chatted with her briefly before leaving in a hurry.
When he was on his way home, Arthur made a phone call.
“Mr. Synder Jr., what can I do for you?” the other party asked very respectfully.
“Help me investigate someone now. His name is Connor McDonald, and he’s from Porthampton. I want to see all the information on this person by tomorrow morning…” Arthur instructed.
“Alright, I understand!”
The other party agreed and then hung up the phone.
After putting down the phone, Arthur heaved a long sigh of relief. “I didn’t think Connor would be this troublesome…”
…
The next day, at eight o’clock in the morning.
Newtown, inside a luxurious villa in Lakeside Villas.
Lakeside Villas was a luxurious high-end villa area built by the real estate company under Arthur’s mother. Even the cheapest villa here cost more than 50 million Oprana dollars.
In Newtown, a villa worth more than 50 million was very rare.
Lakeside Villas housed the most luxurious and expensive villa in Newtown, and this was where Arthur and his parents lived.
When Arthur woke up, he found a man sitting on the sofa in the living room waiting for him.
Arthur hurriedly walked toward the man.
When the man saw Arthur appear, he quickly stood up and said respectfully, ” Mr. Synder Jr., you’re awake?”
“Yes!” Arthur replied casually, then gently stretched and asked expressionlessly, “How’s the investigation going?”
“This is the information you requested on Connor McDonald!”
The man hurriedly handed the information to Arthur.
After Arthur took the information, he read it very seriously.
The man stood beside Arthur with a nervous expression. He could be considered an executive in the Synder Corporation, but his attitude towards Arthur was still very respectful.
He knew very well how terrifying Arthur was.
Basically, in the Synder Corporation, anyone who offended Arthur would not have a good ending.
Therefore, even if the man had the courage of ten men, he would not dare to offend Arthur.
After Arthur finished reading Connor’s information, a trace of doubt flashed across his eyes. Then, he frowned and asked the man, “This is all the information on Connor?”
“Yes, as long as it can be investigated, it’s all in here!” The man hurriedly nodded.
Arthur looked at the man, and the expression on his face seemed even more puzzled.
Because he did not expect that Connor’s information would be so ordinary.
Connor was just a poor kid. His parents died when he was very young. He had been working part-time at the Porthampton University, delivering food for a period of time. Later, he came to Newtown University as an exchange student.
This information couldn’t be any more ordinary, but what Arthur couldn’t understand was how someone like Connor could know Freya Phillips.
In Arthur’s eyes, people like Connor and Freya should be from two different worlds!
“How could a poor kid like Connor come into contact with Freya Phillips?”
Arthur could not help but mutter softly.

chapters.title: Chapter 1088: Connor is Mr. McDonald?
chapters.content:
Chapter 1088: Connor is Mr. McDonald?
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
“Who is this Connor McDonald?”
Arthur looked at the information in front of him with a puzzled expression.
He could vaguely feel that something was wrong, but he couldn’t tell what, and he felt very uncomfortable as a result.
The man hesitated for a moment and said softly to Arthur, “Mr. Synder Jr., I also heard something about this Connor!”
Arthur hurriedly looked up and asked excitedly, “What is it?”
“I heard that when Connor McDonald was studying in Porthampton, he came into conflict with Harold Phillips and Jovan Lambert. However, I’m not very sure about the specifics…” the man said slowly.
“Harold Phillips and Jovan Lambert?”
When Arthur heard the names of these two people, a trace of disdain flashed in his eyes.
Although Arthur, Harold, and Jovan were both known as the four rich heirs, the current Arthur was no longer someone that Harold and the others could compare to.
Harold was fine, but Arthur did not bother to contact Jovan at all. In his eyes, people like him were wastes of space that only ever ate, slept and fooled around. They would never amount to anything great, thus he had no use for them.
Harold was a little better; after all, Harold was destined to walk the path of the military in the future. He was still somewhat helpful to Arthur.
“I’ll give Harold a call later and ask him what’s going on!” Arthur said in a low voice after hesitating for a moment.
“Yes!”
The man nodded.
However, at this moment, footsteps came from upstairs, and a man in pajamas came down.
After Arthur saw the man, he hurriedly stood up and greeted him respectfully.
“Dad, you’re awake?”
“Arthur, hurry up and pack up. The two of us will go and see Mr. Canto…” Arthur’s father, Jeremiah Synder, said expressionlessly.
Arthur was a smart person. After hearing Jeremiah’s words, he realized that something was wrong and hurriedly asked, “Dad, is there something wrong with the open space in Yarnton?”
“Yes. Our company had already bid for that piece of land and was ready to handle the handover procedures, but now someone wants to compete with us for it. Moreover, just yesterday, Mr. Canto suddenly changed his mind and said that the procedures were insufficient for the handover,” Jeremiah said.
“This…”
When Arthur heard this, he was instantly stunned. The expression on his face was flustered.
“Dad, that piece of land is very important to us. If we can’t take that piece of land, our losses will be very terrifying…” he hurriedly said.
“Of course I know. Otherwise, I wouldn’t be in such a hurry!” Jeremiah said lightly.
“Who is this person? How dare he compete with us? Could it be a provincial real estate company?” Arthur hesitated for a moment before asking in a low voice.
“No…”
Jeremiah shook his head and continued, “This time, we’re competing with the Empire World Corporation!”
“The Empire World Corporation?” When Arthur heard this name, he couldn’t help but suck in a breath of cold air. Then, he said in a low voice, “That woman Reena Satchwell is not easy to deal with!”
“Reena is still alright. I’m mainly worried about Thomas Morgan and the boss behind the Empire World Corporation. If those people get involved, things will be troublesome…”
Jeremiah said in a low voice.
Arthur frowned and muttered, “That’s not right. There’s no conflict between our family and the Empire World Corporation at all, and we’ve always minded our own business. Why did they suddenly take action on this project? Could it be that Reena wants to make things difficult for the Synder family?”
“I don’t know what’s going on right now, but hurry up and change your clothes. We’ll know what’s going on when we see Mr. Canto.”
“If the Empire World Corporation really wants this piece of land, we can only compete with them…”
Jeremiah knew that Reena could only represent the Empire World Corporation’s branch company in Newtown, so he wasn’t afraid of her.
“Alright, I understand…”
Arthur nodded gently and prepared to go upstairs to change his clothes.
Jeremiah sat on the sofa and subconsciously glanced at the information on the table.
When Jeremiah saw Connor’s photo, he was instantly stunned. His voice trembled as he asked the man who provided Arthur with the information, “Where did you get this information?”
“Mr. Synder Jr. asked me to investigate this!” the man hurriedly replied.
“Dad, what’s wrong with this document?” Arthur asked.
“Why are you investigating this person?” Jeremiah asked excitedly.
“This person is Freya’s boyfriend even though I’ve been pursuing Freya all this time. I felt that there was something wrong with this person, so I decided to investigate him…” Arthur hurriedly explained.
“What’s the use of investigating this information? Do you think you can find out this person’s true identity? Even if you use all the power of our company, you might not be able to find out about him!”
Jeremiah smiled wearily.
“Dad, what do you mean?”
Arthur suddenly realized that something was wrong and frowned.
“This person is called Connor McDonald, but most people like to call him Mr. McDonald of Porthampton!” Jeremiah said in a low voice.
“Mr. McDonald of Porthampton?”
When Arthur heard this, he was stunned, an expression of disbelief on his face.
“Dad…Are you kidding me?” Arthur stuttered.
“Why would I joke with you about something like this…” Jeremiah paused for a moment before continuing, “This Connor is Mr. McDonald of Porthampton. I’ve seen a photo of him before. His identity and background are very mysterious. All I know now is that he’s Thomas Morgan’s boss and the Chairman of the Empire World Corporation…”
Arthur couldn’t help but tremble slightly. He had heard a lot about Mr. McDonald.
In Arthur’s eyes, Mr. McDonald was a legendary existence.
Arthur also knew that Mr. McDonald was about the same age as him, but he already had such terrifying achievements.
However, Arthur never expected that Connor was actually the Mr. McDonald!
This result made Arthur feel a little hopeless.

chapters.title: Chapter 1089: Strike First!
chapters.content:
Chapter 1089: Strike First!
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
“How can Connor be Mr. McDonald? Could there be a mistake?”
Arthur looked at the information in front of him, unable to calm down for a long time.
Originally, he thought that Connor was just an ordinary person.
However, he never dreamed that Connor’s background would be so terrifying.
Only now did he realize the difference in strength between him and Connor. This difference was simply like the difference between cloud and mud!
Arthur finally understood why Freya had chosen Connor over him.
Arthur felt that he had been nobler than many people since he was born, so there was a pride in his heart that ordinary people could not understand.
But now, this pride was directly trampled under Connor’s feet.
Last night, Arthur even deliberately talked loudly with the others in front of Connor.
His goal was to let Connor realize the gap between him and them.
But now that he thought about it, his actions were too laughable.
Yesterday, Connor had looked at them as if they were a joke. When he thought of this, Arthur felt a little embarrassed.
“Arthur, you just said that Connor is with Freya Phillips?” Jeremiah suddenly asked.
Arthur was stunned for a moment, then nodded gently. “That’s right…”
Jeremiah frowned and said expressionlessly, “It seems that the Empire World Corporation’s fight for the land with us this time is not unintentional. They’re targeting you—after all, you’re now considered Mr. McDonald’s love rival. It’s normal for Connor to do such an impulsive thing at such a young age!”
After Jeremiah said this, the expression on his face seemed to relax a lot.
This was because he felt that if Connor had really attacked the Synder family because of Freya, then this was not a big problem at all.
Although Freya was indeed an outstanding woman, Arthur had to marry her.
As long as Arthur gave up on Freya, all these problems would be solved.
Moreover, Connor actually did such a foolish thing for a woman. This showed that Connor’s mind was indeed immature.
“No!”
But at this moment, Arthur suddenly shook his head.
Jeremiah was stunned for a moment, then frowned and asked, “What’s wrong?”
“Connor only met me yesterday. How could he be so fast?” Arthur said directly.
“You just met yesterday?”
Jeremiah seemed to be a little dumbfounded.
“Dad, the person who attacked our family might not have anything to do with Freya. The Empire World Corporation is probably planning to annex our Song Group!”
Arthur was very perceptive and noticed Thomas Morgan’s true goal.
His analysis was indeed correct. Thomas and Reena planned to make a very risky move in order to help Connor investigate Percy Juve’s information as soon as possible. They planned to suppress the Synder Corporation and then annex it.
According to Thomas’s information, the Synder Corporation had a partnership with Percy Juve. At that time, Percy would definitely show up.
Because this idea was not particularly mature, and the matter of snatching the land was just a test, Thomas did not report it to Connor.
“The Empire World Corporation is trying to attack our Synder family?” Jeremiah couldn’t help but laugh out loud. Then, he said coldly, “I didn’t expect Connor’s appetite to be so big. He really doesn’t care about the Synder family at all!”
“Dad, I have a good idea now…” Arthur said slowly.
“What is it?”
Jeremiah asked after being stunned for a moment.
“Our family can join forces with Queta Zepeda and get rid of Connor before he makes a move on our Synder family!”
Arthur said in a low voice.
“…”
Jeremiah slowly raised his head and glanced at Arthur. Then, he frowned and asked, “Are you sure you can get Queta to join forces with you?”
“Of course. As long as I tell Queta Connor’s identity, Queta absolutely will be more nervous than anyone else. After all, although Connor’s current target is our Synder family, if we are defeated by Connor, then Queta will be his second target. Queta is very smart. She should know this better than anyone else!” Arthur said confidently.
“…”
Jeremiah hesitated for a moment before saying expressionlessly, “Alright, this matter can’t wait. I’ll go see Mr. Canto myself. You should hurry up and contact Queta to see what she thinks!”
“Good!”
After Arthur saw that Jeremiah had agreed, he took out his phone and dialed Queta’s number.
However, Arthur did not explain the actual situation over the phone. Instead, he asked to meet her at Hustlers Club.
After agreeing on the time, Arthur left the house in a hurry.
After Arthur knew Connor’s identity, he actually didn’t have any thoughts of giving up on Freya. On the contrary, he actually planned to make a move against Connor first. It had to be said that Arthur’s courage was indeed extraordinary.
If it was anyone else, they would have already apologized to Connor.
…
Soon, Arthur met up with Queta.
“Arthur, why are you in such a hurry to see me?”
Queta asked casually as she made tea for Arthur.
“Queta, I have already investigated Connor’s identity…” he said in a low voice.
“Then who is he?” Queta asked calmly.
Arthur was not in the mood to beat around the bush with her at this time, so he answered directly. “Connor is Mr. McDonald from Porthampton. He’s also the Chairman of the Empire World Corporation and Thomas Morgan’s boss!”
After Queta heard Arthur’s words, her wrist could not help but tremble. The tea spilled directly on the table, but she did not notice it at all.
When Arthur saw Queta’s reaction, he smiled smugly in his heart. After all, a terrifying figure like Connor had appeared in Newtown. Queta would definitely be worried about her position as the business queen, so her reaction was reasonable.
Queta composed herself and asked, “Are you sure?”
“Of course I’m sure!” Arthur nodded and continued, “Queta, although you’ve been overseas all this time, I think you should have heard about Connor before!”
“Indeed, I’ve heard a little. No wonder I couldn’t see through Connor yesterday. I didn’t expect his background to be so terrifying!”
Queta could not help but sigh.

chapters.title: Chapter 1090: A Mysterious Text Message
chapters.content:
Chapter 1090: A Mysterious Text Message
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
In Hustlers Club.
After Arthur told Queta Connor’s true identity, Queta was naturally extremely surprised.
Arthur went straight to the point. “Queta, you should know what kind of person Connor is. I don’t think it’s a coincidence that such a person suddenly came to Newtown and became Freya’s boyfriend…”
“Then why?”
“My father just received news that the Empire World Corporation has begun to interfere in the real estate business and wants to snatch a piece of land from our family. I think this is a signal that Connor is very likely to be preparing to deal with our Synder family!”
Arthur paused and observed Queta’s reaction. Then, he continued, “Queta, once our Synder family falls, who do you think Connor’s next target will be?”
“…”
Queta took a deep breath. However, she did not say anything because she already had an answer in her heart.
“If I’m not wrong, Connor’s real goal is to support Freya so she can become the new business queen of Newtown. Other companies in Newtown might be affected, and this impact will be fatal,” Arthur continued.
Queta finally couldn’t help but frown and ask, “What are you trying to do?”
“I won’t waste any more of your time. Simply put, I think we have to strike first and get rid of Connor before he makes a move on us. If we do that, we might still have a chance at survival. However, if we continue to sit and wait for death, then we will only die!” Arthur said firmly.
“What do you mean by getting rid of him?”
Queta slowly narrowed her eyes.
“Queta, you and I both know how terrifying Connor’s strength is. It’s definitely impossible for us to completely get rid of him, so I think the simplest and most direct way is to kill him!”
Killing intent flashed in Arthur’s eyes.
“…”
Queta could not help but fall silent.
“Queta, are you afraid?”
Arthur asked with a smile.
“What do I have to be afraid of? I just think that this method is a little too risky. After all, if the plan fails, our two families may fall into a state of eternal damnation!” Queta said softly.
“Queta, as long as we want to do this, there’s no possibility of failure. After all, Connor still doesn’t know that we’ve discovered his identity.”
In order to protect the interests of the Synder family and to get Freya, Arthur spared no effort in persuading Queta over to his side. Only with her participation could this plan be foolproof.
“I still feel that this idea of yours is a little too risky…” Queta said with a frown.
“I didn’t expect you to be so timid now, Queta…”
Arthur smiled faintly.
“How about this? Give me a day to think about it. I’ll give you a reply after I’ve thought about it…” Queta said, her head starting to ache.
“Alright, then I’ll wait for your reply!”
Arthur felt that he had already said what he needed to say. There was no point in continuing.
After he left, Queta fell into deep thought.
At this moment, she did not know what to choose. After all, there were too many things involved in this matter.
…
On the other side, Connor, who was still attending classes at Newtown University, had no idea that his identity had been exposed and that it had caused such a huge chain reaction.
To put it bluntly, this was just because of Reena and Thomas Morgan’s decision, causing Arthur to misunderstand Connor’s true motive.
He might not know that Connor only wanted to find Percy. Connor was not interested in small fries like the Synder family.
“Buzz buzz…”
Just as Connor was seriously attending class, his phone suddenly vibrated twice.
Connor took out his phone and glanced at it, only to see a text message.
The content of the text message was: ” See you tonight at 8 pm, Room 302, Hilton Hotel. I miss you!”
After Connor saw the text message, he couldn’t help but be stunned for a moment, then he turned off the phone.
He felt that this was probably a scam message or someone else’s prank, so he didn’t take it to heart.
But after a few minutes, Connor received a second message.
“Connor, if I don’t see you tonight, I’ll tell your fiancée everything about us!”
When Connor saw the second message, he was stunned on the spot.
This was because the message mentioned Connor’s name, and the other party knew of Freya’s existence. This meant that the message was really sent to him.
For a moment, Connor’s brain began to work rapidly.
He was wondering who sent him this message.
Besides, Connor knew about the Hilton Hotel. It was the only five-star hotel in Newtown.
If the other party was a scammer, it was impossible for them to go to such a high-class hotel. After all, the cost was a little high.
“Who is it?”
Connor could not help but mutter.
Connor first thought of Yelena, but he quickly denied this idea.
Yelena knew of Connor’s situation, and she also said that she only wanted to be Connor’s lover. In addition, Yelena had been filming something in the U.S., so this message was definitely not hers.
If it wasn’t Yelena, then the only person who had had sex with Connor was Chloe Lawson.
“Could it be that Chloe is the one that sent me a text message?”
Connor took a deep breath, the expression on his face extremely complicated. He had not contacted Chloe for a long time, so it was understandable that she would want to see him.
Connor hesitated for a moment before taking out his phone and dialing the number.
However, the other party’s phone was turned off.
“Looks like I can only wait until after class to take a look…”
Connor muttered softly, then began to anxiously wait.
At this moment, he was also very curious whether Chloe had come to look for him.
If it was really Chloe, Connor decided to explain the situation to her. After all, he didn’t want to have anything to do with any other woman now.

chapters.title: Chapter 1091: It’s You?
chapters.content:
Chapter 1091: It’s You?
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
After receiving these two messages, Connor became irritable.
Because he had no idea who the person who sent him the message was.
Originally, the afternoon classes were not very long, but for Connor, every second was so torturous!
Finally, the bell rang.
Connor rejected Justin and Brooks’s invitation for dinner. Instead, he left the school alone and hailed a taxi to rush straight to the Hilton Hotel.
8 PM.
...
Connor walked into the Hilton Hotel and found Room 302.
Connor stood at the door of the room and couldn’t help but hesitate for a couple of seconds. Then, he took a deep breath and knocked on the door.
Bang bang bang…
After Connor knocked on the door, he heard the sound of high heels hitting the ground from inside. This meant that the person in the room was a woman.
Connor started getting nervous.
A moment later, the door was opened from the inside.
However, when Connor saw the person in the room, he was instantly stunned. He was in disbelief.
“It’s you?”
Connor instinctively exclaimed.
“That’s right, it’s me!”
Lara Tooks smiled charmingly at Connor. Then, she reached out and pulled Connor into the room, locking the door at the same time.
Connor sized Lara up. Lara was dressed exceptionally sexily today. She was wearing a spaghetti top shirt, which made her chest look extremely alluring. She was wearing a short skirt that reached her hips. Her sexy figure was especially charming under the short skirt. Her slender and fair legs were of moderate thickness. She was wearing black stockings and a pair of high heels.
Her exquisite face paired with her curly black hair gave off an indescribable charm.
Even Connor couldn’t help but take a few more glances.
Connor admitted that a woman like Lara was indeed very charming.
However, Lara had called Connor to the hotel and appeared in such an outfit. This was obviously not normal!
Connor subconsciously observed the surrounding environment, then asked Lara softly, “You were the one who sent me a text message and asked me to come here? What do you want?”
“Why are you so fierce? What else could I have called you here for?”
Lara replied to Connor with a very charming gaze.
At this moment, Lara was looking at Connor with large gooey eyes. They were extremely alluring.
“Why are you looking for me? Are you going to tell me or not? If you don’t, I’ll leave!”
After saying this, Connor stood up and was prepared to leave.
However, just as Connor stood up, a fragrance suddenly assaulted him, followed by a soft and delicate body hugging him tightly.
Connor was shocked by Lara’s action.
What are you doing?
Connor pushed her away without thinking and shouted speechlessly.
“Connor, I like you. I really like you! I fell in love with you the first time I saw you. Don’t leave tonight. Stay with me, okay?”
Lara looked at Connor and said seriously.
“What’s wrong with you…”
When Connor saw Lara like this, he was dumbfounded. Then, he continued to walk out.
“You can’t leave…”
As Lara spoke, she rushed to the door and made a bold move.
She actually took off her spaghetti top, revealing her black lace bra.
“Connor, are you a man or not? I’ve already taken the initiative to offer myself to you, but you dare not even sleep with me. If you dare to leave today, I’ll call the police now and say that you raped me.”
Perhaps it was because of Connor’s repeated rejections, Lara felt a little embarrassed, so she took off her clothes to seduce him.
Connor looked at Lara’s chest and said expressionlessly, “Your little trick might be useful against other men, but it’s useless against me. Your breasts are too small. Hurry up and put on your clothes!”
“What did you say? How dare you say that my breasts are small?”
When Lara heard Connor’s words, she was about to break down.
“Yes, they are too small…”
Connor commented indifferently.
However, Connor was only provoking Lara. Lara’s figure was quite good.
“…”
Lara hesitated for a moment, then she smiled at Connor and said, “You haven’t even seen how big I am. How can you say that!”
After saying that. Lara deliberately puffed up her chest.
Connor was even more speechless. He frowned and said, “Alright, stop it. Ask the people in the bathroom to come out!”
“You…”
When Lara heard Connor’s words, she was instantly dumbfounded. She was very surprised.
“Connor, what… what are you talking about?”
Lara stuttered.
“Are you going to keep this up?”
Connor sneered and continued, “I told you just now that this trick of yours might have some effect if it were another man, but it’s nothing to me. There is a total of four people in the bathroom. As long as I make a move on you, these people will come out to take photos or beat me up.”
Lara looked at Connor with a nervous expression.
She knew that it was meaningless for her to continue acting like this.
“I didn’t expect you to be so smart. How did you know there was someone in the bathroom?” she asked coldly.
“I guessed it!”
Connor said lightly.
Actually, when Connor entered this room, he felt that something was off.
Therefore, Connor used the method of observing qi to observe the room. As expected, he found the breathing of four people in the bathroom.
However, Connor was not in the mood to explain so much to Lara. At this moment, Connor was more curious about Lara’s motive for doing this.
“Alright, come out!”
At this moment, Lara suddenly shouted.
Immediately after, four strong men rushed out of the bathroom and surrounded Connor.
“I didn’t expect you to be so accurate. There are indeed four people hiding in the bathroom!”
Lara looked at Connor and said.
Facing these four strong men, Connor was still very calm.
He asked Lara expressionlessly, “What’s your motive for doing this?”
“My motive?”
Lara smiled and continued, “It’s very simple. I just want to sleep with you!”
“Haha…”
Connor laughed disdainfully and then said indifferently, “If you want to sleep with me, you don’t need to have so many people here, right?”

chapters.title: Chapter 1092: I’m Going to Teach You a lesson
chapters.content:
Chapter 1092: I’m Going to Teach You a lesson
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Lara looked at Connor up and down, then smiled and said, “Alright, since you’re so straightforward, I won’t beat around the bush with you!
“Actually, my motive is very simple. I just want to take a few photos with you. If you were to cooperate, I would have let you kiss and hug me on account that you’re not bad looking!
“But if you’re tactless, I can only get someone to knock you out and take a photo of you…”
“Then, you planned to show these photos to Freya, right?”
Connor squinted and asked.
“That’s right. I didn’t expect you to be so smart…”
...
Lara looked at Connor and nodded.
“Haha…”
Connor sneered and continued, “What good does this do you?”
“Actually, I don’t gain anything. I just don’t like you.”
“Moreover, Arthur Synder has been pursuing Freya Phillips. If I get rid of you, I can get a lot of benefits from Arthur.”
Lara looked at Connor and explained.
“I understand now…”
Connor nodded and continued, “Since you’re Freya friend, I won’t argue with you about this matter today.”
“Connor, is there something wrong with your head? Are you letting me go or am I letting you go? You still don’t understand the situation, do you?”
After hearing Connor’s words, Lara shouted at him speechlessly.
“Do you think these four people are my match?”
Connor asked softly.
“Who do you think you are?”
Lara rolled her eyes at Connor. Then, as she put on her clothes, she shouted at the four burly men, “What are you guys still standing there for? Hurry up and beat him up…”
After hearing Lara’s order, the four burly men charged forward aggressively.
“Oh right, don’t ruin his face. I need to take photos with him later!”
At this moment, Lara suddenly shouted.
Bang!
However, just as Lara said this, she heard a loud bang.
“Ah…”
What followed was a scream.
Connor raised his leg and kicked the burly man in front of him.
