The burly man slammed into the wall, and he was in great pain.
When the other three brawny men saw this scene, they were dumbfounded.
Because Connor’s attack speed was really too fast, they could not even see what was going on.
“Uh…”
Lara’s expression was also a little shocked because she did not expect Connor to be so strong.
“What are you three still standing there for? Hurry up and attack together!”
Lara shouted.
The remaining three burly men did not think too much and rushed toward Connor.
These three brawny men were all ordinary people, so they had no chance of winning against Connor.
Under Lara’s surprised gaze, Connor used less than half a minute to beat the remaining three strong men.
At this moment, these four burly men were all lying on the ground, bowing down to Connor while begging him to let them go.
Lara was completely dumbfounded. She stood rooted to the ground with her mouth agape, not knowing what to do.
Connor knew that these four people were hired by Lara, so he did not make things difficult for them. He said calmly, “Don’t let me see the four of you again in the future. Otherwise, your ending will not be as simple as being beaten up…”
“Got it. We’re sorry…”
The four of them bowed down to Connor.
A trace of helplessness flashed across Connor’s eyes as he said coldly, “Alright, all of you can get lost now!”
After hearing Connor’s words, the four burly men heaved a long sigh of relief. Then, they turned around and planned to leave.
After hesitating for a moment, Lara decided to take this opportunity to leave with the four of them.
“Did I say you could leave?”
But at this moment, Connor’s voice sounded from behind Lara.
Lara’s delicate body trembled slightly, and then she subconsciously stopped and turned around to look at Connor. She hesitated for a moment and said in a low voice, “Connor, I was just joking with you just now. I really didn’t mean anything else.”
“Just joking with me?”
When Connor heard Lara’s words, a trace of coldness flashed across his eyes. This was because he hated this kind of thing the most.
Back then, Mandy Hines had used such photos to cause him and Freya to have a misunderstanding.
He did not expect Lara to actually use such a move. Therefore, Connor did not have any pity for Lara at all.
“How do you think we should deal with this matter today?”
Connor asked Lara coldly.
“How… How do you plan to deal with it? I can give you money!”
Lara stuttered.
“Money?”
When Connor heard Lara’s words, he smiled disdainfully and said indifferently, “Do I look like I need money? Why don’t I break one of your legs and teach you a lesson…”
After saying this, Connor stood up and walked toward Lara.
When Lara saw Connor walking over, she was completely dumbfounded. She sat on the ground, looking rather pitiful. She said to Connor in a delicate manner, “Connor, my mother is the director. My father’s company has a market value of more than 100 million. Moreover, I’m Freya’s friend. If you really break my legs, my parents will definitely not let you off…
“Please… Let me go!”
At this moment, Lara was also using both carrot and stick. On one hand, she threatened Connor with her parents, while on the other hand, she pretended to be pitiful, wanting him to feel sorry for her.
A girl like Lara was very beautiful to begin with. Moreover, at this moment, she was sitting on the ground. Her two slender and fair legs were exposed in front of Connor without reservation. It was unbearable to look at.
Connor looked at Lara and smiled. Then, he said indifferently, “Your mother is the director, and your father is the president of the company. Do you know who I am?”
“Who are you?”
Lara was stunned for a moment and asked in confusion.
“My name is Connor McDonald. People in Porthampton like to call me Mr. McDonald!”
Connor replied calmly.
“What did you say?”
Lara was stunned when she heard Connor’s words. Her face was filled with shock.
Although this was Newtown, Lara had heard some things about Mr. McDonald from her parents. Lara didn’t expect Connor to be Mr. McDonald.

chapters.title: Chapter 1093: Sleep With You?
chapters.content:
Chapter 1093: Sleep With You?
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
“You’re actually Mr. McDonald from Porthampton? How is that possible?”
Lara looked at Connor in disbelief. She could not believe this fact at all.
“Whether you believe it or not, I’m still the Mr. McDonald of Porthampton. I won’t let you off just because of your parents…”
Connor said calmly to Lara.
“How could you be Mr. McDonald?!”
Lara seemed a little desperate. At this moment, she was avoiding Connor’s eyes.
...
Lara knew very well how terrifying Mr. McDonald of Porthampton was.
If she really offended such a person, no matter how powerful her family background was, it was impossible to save her!
“You already know my identity, so you must pay the price for your actions today!”
Connor looked at Lara and said calmly.
“Connor, I was wrong. Please let me go. Can you let me go on account of Freya…”
Lara no longer dared to have any thoughts of resisting. She knelt on the ground and begged Connor.
Lara knew that with her family’s connections, she was not Connor’s match at all. Now, she could only use her relationship with Freya to beg Connor to let her go.
“If it wasn’t for Freya, I would have made you disappear from this world. However, since I can’t kill you, I’ll give you two choices now. One is to break your legs…”
“What is the second option?”
Lara did not want to become a cripple, so she hurriedly raised her head and shouted.
“The second option…”
Connor hesitated for a moment, then slowly said, “The second option is also very simple. Since you want to sleep with me so badly, I’ll give you this option now. As long as you sleep with me…”
“Sleep with you?”
Lara was stunned when she heard that.
She finally understood what it meant to shoot herself in the foot.
She originally planned to use this method to tease Connor, but she never expected that things would turn out like this in the end.
“There are two options in front of you now. It’s up to you to choose one of it…”
Connor said smugly.
Lara sat on the ground and hesitated for a long time. In the end, she said to Connor, “As long as I sleep with you, you’ll let me go, right?”
“Yes!”
Connor nodded lightly.
“Alright, I’ll sleep with you!”
Lara had made a decision.
Connor looked at Lara and didn’t say anything. He sized her up with a strange gaze.
Lara hesitated for a moment before she slowly stood up and took off her clothes, revealing her extremely hot figure.
At this moment, Connor suddenly stood up and walked toward Lara.
A hint of nervousness flashed across Lara’s eyes.
Although she looked sexy and unrestrained, Lara did not even have a boyfriend. It was her first time.
Therefore, she was very nervous at this moment.
“You don’t have to be so nervous. I’m not interested in a woman like you!”
Connor suddenly said to Lara.
Lara was stunned for a moment, then she suddenly looked at Connor.
In the next second, Connor walked out of the room without any hesitation.
Lara was left alone. She stood there foolishly, not knowing what to do.
…
On the other side, in Hustlers Club.
After a whole day of thinking, Queta Juve finally decided to cooperate with Arthur Synder.
This was because she found out that the Empire World Corporation was indeed going against the Synder Corporation, and the Synder Corporation would probably not be able to last until the end under the Empire World Corporation.
Once the Synder Corporation collapsed, Queta would also be greatly threatened. More importantly, Queta would completely lose Arthur as an ally.
Therefore, she felt that she might as well take this opportunity to attack Connor first.
Queta gave Arthur a call, and the two of them reached an agreement to cooperate. They also formulated a very detailed plan.
Connor had no idea that Arthur and Queta were already preparing to attack him.
His daily routine was to go to school during the day and go back to find Freya at night.
The two of them were like a couple in love. They ate and watched movies together to gradually develop their relationship.
This was probably the happiest period of time for Connor.
After that incident, Lara stopped creating problems.
As long as Connor appeared, she would not dare to appear.
Freya was also very curious about what was going on because she could not understand why Lara seemed to be so afraid of Connor.
In the blink of an eye, a week had passed.
Originally, Connor wanted to go out for a meal with Justin, Brooks, and a few other girls after school.
However, just as Connor walked to the entrance of the school, he saw Freya’s Maserati.
Connor immediately recognized that it was Freya’s car.
As expected, Freya walked up to Connor after seeing him exit the campus.
This was the first time Justin, Brooks, and the others were seeing Freya. Therefore, when they saw her, they were immediately stunned. They were stunned.
“Connor, who is this?”
Justin stammered as she asked Connor.
“This is my girlfriend, Freya Phillips!”
Connor introduced them briefly before introducing Justin, Brooks, and the others to Freya.
When Justin and the others heard Connor say that he had a girlfriend, they all thought that he was bragging.
However, they never expected Connor to really have a girlfriend, and she was so beautiful at that.
Sonia Dobson was naturally very surprised. At this moment, she finally understood why Connor was not interested in her.
“Connor, I didn’t expect your girlfriend to be so beautiful. I thought that you were just bragging!”
Justin gritted her teeth and said to Connor.
Connor smiled helplessly, then looked at Freya and asked, “Freya, why are you here?”
“Queta wants to invite us over for dinner today. She even asked me to invite you. I called you just now, but you didn’t pick up, so I came straight to you…”
Freya smiled at Connor.
“Oh, okay. Alright, then!”
Connor nodded, then turned around to explain to Justin, Brooks, and the others.
Justin and the others naturally did not say much and expressed their understanding.
Connor followed Freya into the Maserati and disappeared from everyone’s sight.

chapters.title: Chapter 1094: Queta Juve’s Invitation
chapters.content:
Chapter 1094: Queta Juve’s Invitation
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
After Connor and Freya left the school gate.
Justin sighed softly and then said, “I didn’t expect Connor to be so capable. How did he even get a girlfriend like that. Isn’t she way too beautiful?”
“Yeah, she’s so beautiful. The girls in our campus can’t compare!”
Brooks also hurriedly exclaimed.
When Sonia and the other girls heard Brooks’s words, they didn’t refute him. Instead, they nodded in agreement.
They all felt that Brooks was right. There was no girl in Newtown University who could be compared to Freya.
...
“She seems to be quite rich.”
At this moment, Sia Jennings said.
“The car she drives seems to be a Maserati. It costs millions! She should be quite rich!”
Sonia said enviously.
At this moment, Sonia was completely convinced that she had lost because she knew that Freya was superior to her in all aspects, be it in terms of temperament or looks.
It was not peculiar that Connor was not interested in her.
“Why does Connor have such a good life? He’s actually found such a fair, rich, and beautiful woman!”
Justin sighed with envy.
Sonia turned to look at Justin, but she didn’t say anything.
Because she knew that Connor’s identity was definitely not as simple as they thought. Connor had been deliberately hiding his identity.
“Alright, there’s no point in being envious. Let’s go eat. I’m starving!”
At this moment, Brooks said loudly.
“That’s right, this kind of thing is not something we can envy!”
Justin gently stretched his back and then walked forward.
…
On the other side, Connor and Freya got into the car and drove straight to Hustlers Club.
Connor sat in the front passenger seat and hesitated for a couple of seconds.
Then, he asked Freya softly, “Freya, did you say that Queta specifically asked you to ask me to join?”
“Yeah!”
Freya nodded lightly.
“I’ve only met her once, and we didn’t talk much. How does she still remember me?”
Connor said with some doubt.
“Yeah, I also find it strange. Queta has a very high standard for judging people. Only a few of us young people can get to know her. Many people go through a lot of trouble but can’t see her in person. But this time, she specially asked me to bring you along.”
“Hehe, maybe it’s because I’m quite handsome so she likes me!”
Connor said with a smile.
After hearing Connor’s words, Freya was somewhat speechless. She could not help but pout and say, “I didn’t know that you’re so narcissistic. Would Queta like someone who’s so narcissistic?”
“Are you jealous?”
Connor smiled and asked.
“I’m not…”
Freya hurriedly retorted, then turned to look at Connor, as if she wanted to say something but hesitated.
“Is there something you want to tell me?”
Connor hesitated for a moment before asking Freya softly.
“Connor, I have been encountering some strange things recently…”
Freya said to Connor.
“Strange things?”
After hearing Freya’s words, Connor couldn’t help but be stunned for a moment. Then, he frowned and asked, “What strange things?”
“Some things would occasionally appear in mind. Sometimes it’s photos, sometimes it’s videos. They flash by very quickly. I don’t know what they are exactly, but I can feel that these things are my memories. But, when I try my best to recall these things, my head hurts. I don’t know what’s going on either…”
Freya said slowly.
“…”
When Connor heard Freya’s words, he was instantly stunned.
This was because Connor knew that Freya’s memory was removed forcefully. This kind of damage was permanent and could not be recovered through normal means.
However, during the operation, they could not remove all of Freya’s memories.
This had also caused Freya’s memories to gradually awaken after she met Connor.
However, Freya was not able to remember all of this. She could only remember a very small part of it, and it would be accompanied by intense pain.
“Connor, do you think I’m getting my memories back?”
Freya asked Connor with a smile.
“Yeah, you might be…”
Connor looked at Freya and nodded lightly.
“It would be great if I could recover my memories. In that case, I would be able to remember you…”
Freya said happily.
When Connor heard Freya’s words, a strange look flashed across his eyes. He felt a little sad for some reason.
Actually, he had been hesitating whether he should tell Freya the truth.
However, at this moment, the car had already arrived at the entrance of Hustlers Club.
“Connor, we’ve arrived. Let’s head in!”
Freya’s voice interrupted Connor’s thoughts.
Connor was stunned for a moment and hurriedly said, “Alright, let’s go!”
A moment later, Connor followed Freya into the club.
After entering Hustlers Club, Connor suddenly felt that something was wrong.
The last time Connor came with Freya, there were very few people in Hustlers Club. It gave off a very cold feeling.
But today, there were many people in the club, and their auras were very complicated.
Connor used the Chi Observation Technique to observe the situation inside Hustlers Club, but he found nothing.
The reason was also very simple. Because Connor’s Chi Observation Technique was at the beginner level.
If the number of people was relatively small, Connor could observe how many people there were.
However, if there were too many people, then Connor would not be able to determine how many people were in Hustlers Club.
Freya seemed to have noticed that something was off with Connor. After hesitating for a couple of seconds, she asked Connor softly, “Connor, what’s wrong?”
“Nothing. I just feel that something is not quite right, but I don’t know what is wrong…”
Connor shook his head and explained.
“Oh!”
Freya nodded and brought Connor into the private room.
After entering the private room, Connor saw that Arthur and the others had already arrived and were chatting.
Arthur glanced at Connor indifferently but did not say anything.

chapters.title: Chapter 1095: Are You Planning to Kill Me?
chapters.content:
Chapter 1095: Are You Planning to Kill Me?
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Seeing Connor appear, all the people in the private room revealed a surprised expression.
After all, it was only by chance that Connor was able to come here last time.
But this time, Connor actually appeared here again.
This also meant that Queta might have already allowed Connor to integrate into their circle.
This made many people feel somewhat unconvinced. After all, they felt that Connor was not qualified to enter their circle.
Arthur was still drinking tea quietly, not even looking at Connor.
...
As for Queta, she had yet to appear.
Everyone didn’t know what was going on with Connor, so they naturally wouldn’t show it easily. They greeted Connor enthusiastically.
A few minutes later, Queta, who was wearing a white dress, finally appeared in everyone’s line of sight.
“Queta, you’re here.”
Freya took the initiative to greet her.
Meanwhile, Queta smiled faintly and gracefully walked in front of Connor. She whispered to him, “Mr. McDonald, I have something to tell you. Is it convenient for you now?”
“Sure!”
Connor didn’t say anything else and nodded.
Queta smiled and walked out of the room in her high heels.
Connor slowly stood up and left with Queta.
After Connor and Queta left, the people in the private room revealed an incredulous expression.
“Freya, who exactly is your boyfriend? He actually made Queta take him so seriously and even called him out alone…”
“Yeah, Queta has never treated anyone like this before. What does your boyfriend do?”
“Freya, this boyfriend of yours is really hiding his abilities. He’s more than meets the eye!”
Everyone began to ask Freya questions.
Meanwhile, Freya’s expression was one of confusion as she did not know what was going on.
Lara Tooks was the only one with a serious expression. After all, she had already confirmed that Connor was Mr. McDonald of Porthampton. It was only natural for the dignified Mr. McDonald to be treated like this by Queta.
“I don’t know what’s going on either…”
Freya replied with a helpless expression.
A trace of killing intent flashed in Arthur’s eyes because he knew what would happen next.
…
On the other side, Connor and Queta left the private room and walked straight into the inner courtyard of Hustlers Club.
The interior of the inner courtyard was of a colonial style, and the details were done very well. It gave people the feeling that they were really in the colonial era.
Connor might not know that he was the first outsider to appear in the inner courtyard of Hustlers Club.
Connor quietly followed behind Queta. She didn’t say a word.
At this moment, Queta was wearing a white dress. The dress had a slit at the thighs, revealing her alluring white legs as she walked, exuding infinite tenderness and charm. Such a woman was truly a peerless beauty, able to arouse the desire of men.
A few minutes later, Queta finally stopped and turned to look at Connor.
“Do you need to see me for something?”
Connor asked Queta softly.
“Hello, Mr. McDonald!”
Queta smiled faintly.
“You already know my identity?”
Connor asked expressionlessly.
“Of course, I didn’t expect you to be the famous Mr. McDonald.”
Queta smiled at Connor.
Seeing that Queta already knew his identity, Connor naturally had nothing to hide. He asked directly, “Lara told you, right?”
So far, Connor had only revealed his identity to Lara, and his purpose was actually very simple. He hoped that Lara would not come looking for trouble with him in the future. He did not want to do anything to Lara.
“I don’t know what method you used, but Lara is very afraid of you now. She definitely won’t betray you.”
Queta explained.
“I see…”
Connor looked at Queta and nodded. He didn’t say anything else.
“If Arthur didn’t tell me, I really wouldn’t have believed that you were actually Mr. McDonald. I didn’t expect that you would actually be Freya’s boyfriend. She probably doesn’t know your true identity now!”
Queta looked at Connor and continued.
“I’ve already told her, but she probably doesn’t understand what my identity means!”
Connor said lightly.
“Oh, I’m really envious of Freya for being able to find a boyfriend like you, Mr. McDonald!”
Queta sighed as she looked at Connor.
At this moment, Queta’s pair of beautiful eyes were fixed on Connor. Her every move was exuding endless charm.
In front of such a woman, Connor felt that no man would be able to control himself.
“Alright, since you already know my identity, I’m not in the mood to talk nonsense with you now. Why do you want to see me?”
Connor asked Queta expressionlessly.
When Queta heard Connor’s words, she couldn’t help but smile faintly. Then, she said softly, “Mr. McDonald, don’t be so anxious!”
Just as Queta finished speaking, a white-haired old man quickly walked up to her and whispered, “Miss, everything is ready. We can act at any time!”
“Alright…”
Queta nodded in satisfaction.
Connor narrowed his eyes and looked at Queta, guessing what she wanted to do.
Also, Connor could feel that the person standing behind Queta was not an ordinary person.
He was probably very skilled, but he was very respectful toward Queta, which was a little strange.
“Mr. McDonald, I know that you are a powerful existence in Porthampton. Unfortunately, this is Newtown, not Porthampton!”
At this moment, Queta’s eyes no longer had the charm from before. Instead, they were filled with killing intent.
“So what if this is Newtown and not Porthampton?”
Connor asked calmly.
“Mr. McDonald, you might not understand the current situation you’re in. Now, as long as I give the order, you will die tragically in this backyard!”
Queta said aggressively to Connor.
Connor was stunned for a moment, and a trace of disdain flashed across his eyes. Then, he asked Queta softly, “You plan to kill me?”

chapters.title: Chapter 1096: What Is Your Purpose?
chapters.content:
Chapter 1096: What Is Your Purpose?
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
“Are you planning to kill me?”
As soon as Connor finished speaking, he heard a commotion coming from the backyard.
Soon after, more than a dozen burly men in black suits appeared behind him.
These men were all muscular and exuded a strong sense of hostility, with fierce expressions on their faces.
They were all holding weapons like steel pipes and machetes in their hands.
Clearly, these were the assassins arranged by Queta, waiting for the moment when he would take the bait.
...
After seeing these assassins, Connor finally realized what was going on. It was obvious that she had already harbored murderous intent towards him.
“Do you think you can kill me with these few people?”
Connor turned his head and disdainfully assessed the assassins Queta had brought, saying expressionlessly.
“Are these people not enough?” she sneered.
“They probably aren’t!”
He shook his head lightly.
After using his aura observation technique to assess these people, Connor realized that although they had considerable strength, they were still nothing compared to him.
After all, these people were not martial artists, they were all ordinary individuals.
Although they held weapons, it would still be very difficult for them to defeat Connor.
However, when Queta saw his confidence, a hint of anger flashed in her eyes, and she whispered, “Connor, you are too arrogant. These people are carefully selected assassins, and you have no hope of leaving here alive. So I advise you to see the current situation clearly…”
“I already told you, these people are not enough!” he replied indifferently.
“Connor, are you too confident? Do you know how many experts die at the hands of these people every year? Do you think that so many people attacking you together won’t be your match?” she shouted at him in frustration.
“If I say they’re not enough, then they’re not enough…”
Connor stood still, his expression unusually calm.
“Alright, since you think these people are not enough, how about adding these three people to the mix?”
She smiled and clapped her hands lightly.
A few seconds later, three middle-aged men appeared behind her.
When Connor saw these three middle-aged men, his expression began to change subtly.
Because he could sense that these three individuals had abilities surpassing ordinary people.
But he wasn’t sure if they were true martial artists. He wasn’t quite clear about it.
“These three individuals are the highly skilled experts cultivated by my Zepeda family for many years. Even if you have tremendous abilities, today you won’t escape death!”
Queta looked at Connor with a confident smile, as if in her eyes, he was already a dead man.
“You’re so confident?”
Connor couldn’t help but sneer.
“If I didn’t make sufficient preparations, how could I dare to make a move against Mr. Connor?”
Queta continued speaking, looking at Connor.
“This incident was probably planned by you and Arthur, right? Just relying on you alone, it would be difficult to bring so many assassins here…”
Connor didn’t feel any panic or fear in the current situation, instead he calmly asked Queta.
“Now, discussing these things seems unimportant, right?”
Although Queta didn’t directly answer Connor’s question, the meaning behind her words was quite clear.
Arthur should also be involved in this matter.
“Since you’ve brought me here, can you tell me what your purpose is?” Connor looked at Queta in front of him, asking softly.
“My purpose is very simple. I just want to have a conversation with you, Mr. Connor,” she said softly, with a hint of charm in her eyes.
“A conversation?” He stared at her, his tone tinged with confusion.
“Yes, I just want to talk to you, Mr. Connor.” She nodded gently and continued, “Mr. Connor, I’m well aware of your power. Both your background and combat strength are terrifying. If I hadn’t prepared myself fully, how could I have the courage to speak to you like this?”
“Heh…” He chuckled coldly, then asked expressionlessly, “Since you want to talk to me, go ahead. What do you want to talk about?”
“Mr. Connor, you’re the chairman of Empire World Corporation. Although Empire World Corporation has subsidiaries in our Newtown, its scale is not large, and it maintains a non-interference relationship with other prominent families in our city. But this time, you personally came to Newtown. What is your purpose?” Queta asked directly.
After hearing her question, he finally understood why she was so nervous about his identity.
It was because she was worried that his sudden arrival in Newtown would threaten her interests.
“I think you might be overthinking…” Connor whispered to Queta.
“Overthinking?” Her eyes showed a hint of confusion.
“Yes, I came to Newtown this time solely for Freya. I have no intention of taking any action against the families in Newtown,” Connor explained calmly.
However, Queta sneered and said, “Mr. Connor, do you think I’m a three-year-old child? As a person of your stature, you have countless resources at your disposal. You can find any kind of woman you want. Do you think I’ll believe your explanation that you put so much effort into coming to Newtown and abandoning the business in Porthampton just for Freya?”
“Whether you believe it or not is your problem,” Connor looked at Queta and said calmly.
“I admit that Freya is indeed very beautiful and outstanding. But in Porthampton, I can find many women who are more beautiful than her, who are more enchanting and skilled in bed.”
“If Mr. Connor feels unsatisfied, I can also help you find some noble women. No matter what requirements you have, as long as you mention them, I can fulfill them…” Queta looked at Connor and said.
Connor remained silent as he looked at Queta.
In fact, he knew very well that her inability to believe him was normal.
After all, with his current status and background, no matter what kind of woman he wanted.
As long as he spoke up, these women would go crazy, take off their clothes, and climb onto his bed.
No one would believe that he appeared here because of Freya.

chapters.title: Chapter 1097: Two Choices!
chapters.content:
Chapter 1097: Two Choices!
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Connor came to Newtown wasn’t just for Freya’s sake.
He came here for another important matter, which was to find Percy.
However, he would absolutely not mention anything about Rockefeller because the fewer people who knew this secret, the better.
“Mr. Connor, since you came for Freya, why don’t we do this? I’ll try to persuade Feier to leave Newtown with you. As long as you can leave Newtown, I won’t kill you today!”
After he remained silent, Queta continued speaking.
Connor looked at her without saying a word.
...
Because he hadn’t found Percy yet, he naturally couldn’t leave Newtown.
“How about it? Can you still say that you came here because of Feier?”
A trace of disdain flashed in Queta’s eyes, and she continued, “In fact, I saw through your intentions long ago, Mr. Connor. You’re just using the excuse of looking for Freya to appear in our Newtown. Then, you would start dealing with the Synder Corporation, followed by me. In the end, your plan is to eliminate the several major families in Newtown, just like what you did in Porthampton. Am I wrong?”
“You’re thinking too much. If I really planned to do that, I could have let my subordinates handle these things. There was no need for me to come in person…” he said expressionlessly.
“Explaining these things to me now seems to be meaningless…”
She looked at Connor coldly, sneered, and continued, “Mr. Connor, now you only have two choices. The first choice is to leave with Freya. We can still be friends in the future. The second choice is to leave your life…”
After agreeing to cooperate with Arthur, she began to set up these things because she knew that within such a short period, Connor would never guess that she would take action against him.
As expected, her unexpected move had a crucial effect, and he was now in a very dangerous situation.
Queta knew that Arthur was clearly using her, but she couldn’t bear to let Connor’s Empire World Corporation end her like this, so she had no choice but to reluctantly cooperate with Arthur.
But no matter what, Queta felt that her plan for today was very successful.
“What if I insist on staying in Newtown?”
Connor asked Queta softly.
“If you insist on staying in Newtown, then don’t blame me for being impolite…”
She replied in a low voice, a hint of killing intent flashed in her eyes, and she said coldly, “Mr. Connor, I seem to have forgotten to remind you. I have prepared a great gift for you today!”
“A gift?”
Upon hearing her words, he couldn’t help but pause for a moment.
“Yes, a gift!”
She nodded lightly and waved her hand gently.
In the next second, two red laser dots directly aimed at Connor’s position and targeted his body.
Seeing these three red dots, he instantly froze in place, his expression extremely incredulous because he knew that these two red dots were the laser sights of two sniper rifles!
At this moment, these two sniper rifles were Queta’s final trump card.
Two sniper rifles were aimed directly at Connor’s head and heart. Now, if he dared to move, these two snipers would shoot and kill him.
“Mr. Connor, I know you are very skilled, so I specially brought two snipers here. I don’t believe your body can withstand the power of a sniper rifle!”
Queta looked at Connor in front of her and said with a smug tone.
Upon hearing her words, his eyes flashed with a hint of strangeness, squinting without saying a word.
If she had only prepared these assassins to deal with Connor, he believed that even if he couldn’t defeat everyone here, he would still have a chance to escape.
But if there were snipers present, he had no possibility of survival.
After all, his reaction speed and physical strength were no match for bullets.
Not to mention the sniper rifle with an astonishing rate of fire, even a handgun could easily kill Connor.
“Mr. Connor, I wonder if you still want to change your mind now?”
Queta asked Connor with a smile.
He bowed his head and remained silent, as if contemplating something in his mind.
She didn’t rush to ask him, but quietly waited.
Because she believed that he only had one way to go now, which was to leave Newtown, so she wasn’t in a hurry.
“Buzz…”
At this moment, Connor’s phone suddenly vibrated.
He instinctively took out his phone, glanced at it, and revealed a helpless and relieved smile.
She noticed that something was off with his smile and quickly asked him, “Are you in the mood to laugh now?”
“Whether you believe it or not, I never intended to harm you. And considering that we don’t have any deep-seated grievances, I’ll give you a chance now. As long as you kneel down and apologize, I might spare your life today!” he suddenly said.
“What did you say?”
Queta’s expression instantly changed upon hearing Connor’s words. She stared at him with watery eyes, looking extremely incredulous.
“I said, as long as you kneel down and apologize to me now, I can spare your life.” He repeated softly.
“Connor, I think you’re crazy. It’s already this late, yet you dare to spout nonsense in front of me. I think you won’t shed tears until you see the coffin…”
Queta yelled at Connor from her position, her expression filled with anger.
She had originally spared his life for the sake of Freya, she didn’t really want to kill him. After all, as long as she could drive him out of Newtown and control Freya, he wouldn’t dare to appear again. But she never expected that even at this moment, Connor would still dare to brazenly speak here.
“Fire!”
Queta didn’t intend to waste any more time talking to Connor and directly shouted with an expressionless face.
Upon hearing her words, his eyes flashed with nervousness.
“Bang!”
“Bang!”
The next second, two gunshots rang out.
When Queta heard the gunshots, a trace of satisfaction flashed in her eyes.

chapters.title: Chapter 1098: Back Up
chapters.content:
Chapter 1098: Back Up
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
For a moment, the entire backyard fell silent.
A hint of satisfaction flashed in Queta’s eyes as she slowly lifted her head to look at Connor’s position.
But when Queta saw Connor, she stood frozen in place, her expression on her face incredibly incredulous.
Because she had never expected to see Connor standing unharmed at that moment.
“Did I miss?” Her eyes showed a hint of confusion, but she knew deep down that this situation was impossible.
Because the snipers she had hired this time were all professionals, and in such close proximity, with two snipers firing simultaneously, it was impossible for the shot to miss.
...
“What’s going on?” she instinctively shouted.
Connor glanced at Queta, his face expressionless as he said, “Queta, you’re not the only one who brought backup!”
She paused for a moment after hearing his words, then furrowed her brows and asked, “Connor, what do you mean by that?”
“Bang! Bang!”
At that moment, two bodies were thrown down from the wall.
When she saw the two bodies, her face filled with shock and confusion, because she knew those two bodies were the snipers she had brought.
“How did you do this?” She instinctively took two steps back after seeing the sniper’s bodies, staring with wide eyes, and shouted at him in disbelief.
He looked at her with a faint smile, but did not answer her question.
Just then, two figures jumped down from the wall and quickly walked to Connor’s side, shouting in unison, “Mr. Connor!”
Connor turned his head and gave the two a faint look without saying a word.
“Who are these two people?” Queta, with an agitated expression, shouted.
“My bodyguards,” he replied casually.
Indeed, the two people who appeared by Connor’s side were none other than Diana and Carlos.
When Connor entered the Hustlers Club, he sensed that something was off.
He was worried that Queta might attack him, so he had sent a text message to Carlos in advance.
The conversation between Connor and Queta was merely to help Carlos and Diana buy time.
“What can you do even if you have help? The three of you can’t match these people!” Queta adjusted her emotions briefly and shouted with great excitement.
“I don’t need three, one is enough!” Connor replied casually, then turned to Diana and Carlos, saying, “You two don’t need to be here anymore. Keep an eye on Freya. I’m worried that Queta might do something to her out of desperation!”
With the snipers eliminated, Connor’s greatest threat had disappeared.
As for the remaining assassins, he didn’t care about them at all.
So the most important thing now was to protect Freya’s safety. If Queta used Freya as leverage against him, things would become troublesome.
“Yes!” Carlos nodded quickly upon hearing Connor’s words.
Diana handed two pills to Connor and whispered a few words to him.
Connor nodded lightly at her and didn’t say much.
Diana chose to leave with Carlos.
When Queta saw Diana and Carlos leave, and a hint of shock flashed in her eyes. She then said to Connor, “Connor, I didn’t expect you to be so confident. Do you think that without a sniper, I won’t be able to kill you today?”
“Of course!” He nodded without hesitation.
“Attack!” His confidence made her furious and she shouted directly.
In an instant, those assassins charged towards Connor’s position.
After all, she had already made it clear that anyone who killed him today would receive a million-dollar reward.
For these people, a million-dollar reward was enough to make them go all out!
However, these people might have underestimated his strength. At this moment, his speed and power were far beyond what these ordinary assassins could match.
With a swift kick, he disappeared from everyone’s sight in an instant.
Next, he appeared behind these people and swiftly kicked one assassin in the back.
He knew that these people had come to kill him, so naturally, he wouldn’t show any mercy and used all his strength in his attacks.
In the next second, the assassin’s body flew out, crashing heavily into the crowd.
In just an instant, countless people fell to the ground.
Seeing this scene, Queta’s expression showed some concern.
Because at this moment, she realized that Connor’s skills were truly as terrifying as the rumors!
If it wasn’t for her being extremely well-prepared today, killing Connor might not have been such a simple task.
“Everyone, attack together!” But at this moment, a middle-aged man shouted with widened eyes. He then grabbed the weapon in his hand and rushed towards Connor’s position.
The assassins also realized how terrifying his strength was, so instead of attacking one by one, they chose to attack him together.
In an instant, countless knives and steel pipes came crashing towards him from all directions.
But these people still underestimated his strength. Connor easily dodged their attacks and, in just a moment, sent all the attackers flying.
Seven or eight people were sent flying simultaneously, crashing to the ground and losing consciousness.
“What… what is happening?” Queta’s eyes widened again, and her expression was nothing but shock.
At this moment, she couldn’t believe what she was seeing. She couldn’t believe that everything in front of her was real.
These assassins were all carefully selected by Queta, and any one of them was an incredibly formidable fighter. Ten ordinary people would probably not be a match for any one of them.
But now, in front of Connor, these people seemed as weak as paper, easily defeated with a single blow.
Moreover, he didn’t perform any flashy moves. Just by evading and punching, he could unleash such great power.

chapters.title: Chapter 1099: Terrifying Strength
chapters.content:
Chapter 1099: Terrifying Strength
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Queta couldn’t believe her eyes.
She had never expected that everything she had just seen was actually real.
Perhaps because the sound of the fight in the backyard was too loud, coupled with Carlos and Diana choosing to open fire to eliminate the two snipers, Freya and the others who were originally in the private room heard the commotion.
“What was that sound just now?”
After realizing what happened, one of the young men quickly stood up and exclaimed excitedly.
“It sounded like gunshots…,” whispered one girl.
...
“That’s right, gunshots, and it seems like sniper rifles. I played around with this type of gun when I served in the army,” another young man shouted.
“And it seems like the sound of people fighting…”
Samuel couldn’t help but furrow his brows.
“How is it possible for someone to be shooting? You know this is the Hustlers Club! Who would have the audacity to shoot here?”
Instantly, everyone fell into panic, with tense expressions on their faces.
After all, they were all children of wealthy families and valued their lives more than anyone else.
“Could it be that Queta encountered some danger?”
Just then, a young man spoke up.
“Could it be that there’s an assassin trying to kill her?”
Samuel widened his eyes in an instant.
After all, her identity was quite special, and she had offended many people in the business world.
So, even if someone wanted to assassinate her at this moment, it would be a normal thing.
“Connor, Connor is still there!”
Freya suddenly realized and hurriedly got up, running towards the private room’s exit.
“Freya, calm down. There are assassins outside now. If you go out, won’t you be seeking death?”
Seeing Freya’s intention to go out, everyone hurriedly stopped her.
“Let me go! I need to go out and find Connor. Let me go!”
She struggled as if she had gone mad.
But no matter what, everyone refused to let go of Freya. After all, if she went out, the assassins would know that there were other people inside the private room.
So whether it was for her safety or their own safety, they couldn’t allow her to leave the private room.
Meanwhile, Arthur sat quietly in his seat, with an unusually calm expression on his face because he was the only one who knew what had actually happened outside.
He knew that since gunshots had already been fired, it meant that Queta and Connor had reached a deadlock.
In this situation, there was no way Connor could survive.
Once Connor died, the crisis facing the Synder family would be resolved, and there would be no one left to compete with him for Freya.
Of course, there was another even more important point.
That was, this matter had nothing to do with Arthur. Even if Thomas and others wanted to seek revenge in the future, they would retaliate against Queta, not the Synder family.
So Arthur believed that his plan to use her as a scapegoat was perfect.
“Connor, oh Connor, I admit you are incredibly formidable, but what’s the use? You’re the kind of person destined to end up losing miserably. Even if I don’t lay a hand on you today, someday you will perish at someone else’s hands!”
As Arthur played with his teacup, he sneered.
In his eyes, Connor’s most fatal weakness was his extreme foolishness.
…
On the other side, the battle between Connor and the assassins seemed to be reaching its climax.
Due to his incredible speed, the assassins couldn’t even get close to him and were all sent flying by his attacks.
Originally, there were more than a dozen assassins, but now only two remained with any fighting ability.
“Miss, be careful. This person might be a martial artist!” At that moment, an old man stood in front of Queta and anxiously warned her.
“A martial artist?” Her eyes showed a hint of astonishment upon hearing the old man’s words.
Although she was just an ordinary person, she had heard about martial artists before.
Deep down, she was well aware of how terrifying the power of a martial artist could be.
“How could Connor, being so young, possibly be a martial artist?” She stared with wide, watery eyes, expressing extreme incredulity.
“I couldn’t believe it myself earlier, but when facing so many assassins, Connor handled it with such ease that I believe his strength surpasses that of a martial artist…” The old man replied in a low voice, then continued, “If this person really is a martial artist, then today’s situation is troublesome!”
“Don’t we still have three experts?” Queta hastily said.
“Now we can only rely on those three experts…” the old man replied in a low voice.
At that moment, the three experts, whom she had paid a hefty price to hire, made their move.
The first one to charge forward was a middle-aged man who raised his fist and struck at Connor’s head.
When Connor saw this middle-aged man’s attack, his expression appeared somewhat disdainful, and he slowly threw a punch as well.
“Bang!”
A loud bang.
Connor’s fist forcefully collided with the middle-aged man’s fist.
The middle-aged man was instantly sent flying, crashing heavily onto the ground.
“Spurt…”
The middle-aged man spat out a mouthful of blood and then passed out.
Upon witnessing this scene, she was dumbfounded.
At that moment, regret started creeping into her heart because she hadn’t anticipated that Connor’s strength would be so terrifying.
Her companions were simply no match for him.
“Bang!”
At that moment, the second expert also fell to the ground.
Seeing this scene, she was consumed by despair.
Now, in the backyard, there were barely five people still standing, and each of them was a formidable figure responsible for countless lives lost.
However, their gazes toward him were filled with immense fear.
Because at that moment, they finally realized just how horrifying his strength truly was.
For a moment, the entire backyard fell into a deathly silence.
The assassins no longer dared to make a move against him because they knew very well that engaging him would only lead to certain death.
After all, in the face of an absolute difference in strength, no one wanted to take risks at this moment. If they were to truly perish by his hands, it would be a huge loss.

chapters.title: Chapter 1100: I’m Not Interested In You At All!
chapters.content:
Chapter 1100: I’m Not Interested In You At All!
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
And Connor’s expression was unusually calm, giving the impression that nothing had happened just now.
He took steps and walked towards Queta’s position.
At this moment, Queta was completely dumbfounded and couldn’t help but frown.
Then she forced out a bitter smile and whispered to Connor, “Mr. Connor, I…”
Connor seemed as if he hadn’t heard her words and continued walking forward.
Just at that moment, the bodyguard who had been with Queta for many years finally gathered up his courage and stepped forward, shouting at Connor, “Please stop right now and don’t approach Miss Queta!”
...
As the bodyguard spoke, his voice trembled and his face showed extreme fear because he knew how terrifying Connor was.
Connor glanced at the bodyguard indifferently, without wasting words, and directly raised his fist and struck the bodyguard’s chest.
“Bang!”
The bodyguard was instantly sent flying.
“Anyone else wants to stop me?”
After knocking down the bodyguard, he surveyed everyone present and asked calmly.
Upon hearing his words, everyone fell into a deathly silence, bowing their heads and not daring to speak.
They didn’t want to risk their lives because of her situation.
Seeing that no one spoke after his question, he continued walking towards Queta’s position.
At this moment, there was only one elderly man left by her side.
“Mr. Connor…”
Queta’s delicate body trembled slightly. She never expected that it would end up like this. She never expected that after carefully planning for such a long time, this would be the outcome.
At this moment, the look in her eyes when she looked at Connor was filled with fear and shock. She didn’t expect his power to be so terrifying.
“I wasn’t planning to lay a hand on you, but I didn’t expect you to be so ungrateful and attack me first!” he said expressionlessly to her.
Upon hearing Connor’s words, Queta’s body kept trembling.
She wanted to explain, but she didn’t know how to.
Sbe had investigated a lot about him, but most of the results said that he was just an unsuccessful second-generation rich kid. If it wasn’t for inheriting an inheritance, Connor would probably still be picking up trash at Porthampton University!
So she didn’t take him seriously.
But now, she realized that she had underestimated him, and maybe everyone had underestimated him.
Connor’s ability to become Mr. Connor in Porthampton and make the big shots from the four provinces bow down was not just because of inheriting wealth.
Although Queta was very cunning, sometimes schemes and tricks were nothing compared to absolute strength.
“Mr. Connor, we know we were wrong. As long as you spare Miss Queta today, we will agree to any conditions you propose. If you kill Miss Queta, the people of Newtown will definitely not let you off…”
The elderly man by Queta’s side anxiously shouted.
“What right do you have to negotiate with me?!”
Connor replied disdainfully, then slapped the elderly man’s face with his backhand.
The elderly man was instantly slapped away and fell unconscious on the ground.
After the elderly man fell unconscious, she was left alone.
She no longer had any qualifications to negotiate with Connor.
“Mr. Connor…”
No matter what, Queta was the business queen of Newtown. At this moment, she could still maintain a trace of calmness. Her voice was trembling as she shouted at Connor.
At this moment, she knew that she had no ability to resist anymore. Now she could only try every possible means to beg him to spare her.
“Since the moment I entered the Hustlers Club, I knew you might lay hands on me today. Your tricks are just too ridiculous in front of me…”
Connor looked at Queta expressionlessly and said.
“Mr. Connor, I now realize how ridiculous I am…”
She didn’t dare to argue back and quickly replied.
“Do you have any more cards to play? Show them now, or you may not have this chance…”
After saying this, Connor directly grabbed her neck, his face extremely cold.
“Mr. Connor, I beg you, please don’t kill me, I’m begging you…”
She shouted with a highly agitated expression towards him.
“Is this your last card?” he asked softly.
“Mr. Connor, killing me won’t benefit you in any way. You have no reason to kill me…”
She shouted in an exceptionally excited manner, then continued, “Mr. Connor, I control numerous businesses in Newtown. If you kill me now, countless people will be affected. At that time, both you and Freya will be in danger. I believe this is not what you want to see, right?”
“Are you threatening me?”
Connor sneered and gradually increased the pressure with his right hand.
“Mr. Connor, I dare not threaten you, but killing me truly has no benefits for you. You may not worry about revenge from my subordinates, but don’t forget, I’ve spent so many years in Newtown. I possess connections and resources that ordinary people can’t imagine. Even if you kill me now, you won’t be able to obtain these resources…”
Queta paused for a moment, then looked at Connor and continued to tempt him, “However, if you don’t kill me today, everything I have will be yours, even my body. You can dispose of me as you wish…”
After saying these words, she presented a seductive expression to him, exceptionally alluring.
Queta was already a very beautiful woman, and her figure was extremely hot. She wore a dress with a high slit, revealing two slender and fair legs, making her look particularly enticing.
Moreover, she was currently at the best age for a woman, coupled with her terrifying identity. All these things were enough to arouse the conqueror’s desire in a man’s heart.
Queta’s final trump card was actually her own body.
Because she believed that no man could resist such temptation.
“I have zero interest in you!”
However, at this moment, his words directly shattered all the illusions in her heart.

chapters.title: Chapter 1101: Queta’s Real Identity
chapters.content:
Chapter 1101: Queta’s Real Identity
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Queta had never thought that Connor would not be interested in her at all.
At this moment, she had used up all her trump cards.
Whether it was her body or the resources in her hands, they seemed to not be worth mentioning in front of Connor.
“Do you have anything else to say?”
Connor narrowed his eyes.
Queta took a deep breath and hurriedly said, “Mr. McDonald, if you really kill me today, how are you going to face Freya in the future? Freya would never be with a murderer…”
...
Connor sneered, then said disdainfully, “Who can prove that I killed you? I can say that someone wanted to assassinate you, and that I survived, but you died. It’s not like the dead can speak!”
After hearing Connor’s words, Queta was completely in despair, fear on her face. At this moment, she realized that Connor had already thought of everything.
At this moment, Connor could indeed fake the scene as if someone wanted to assassinate him.
“Mr. McDonald, I beg you, please let me go. I know I’m in the wrong…”
Queta had completely given up on her dignity at this point as she knelt in front of Connor and begged.
“As long as you let me go now, I’ll do whatever you want me to do. I beg you…” Queta continued to plead after seeing that Connor did not say anything.
“You want me to let you go?”
Connor asked Queta softly.
“That’s right, Mr. McDonald. As long as you let me go now, I can satisfy you no matter what you want me to do. I beg you…”
Queta hurriedly nodded.
Connor whispered to her, “I can give you a chance to live now, but you have to answer one question of mine!”
“Question?” Queta was stunned for a moment, then hurriedly nodded. “Mr. McDonald, if you have any questions, I will definitely tell you as long as I know…”
“Don’t worry, this question shouldn’t be very difficult for you. You can easily answer it!”
Connor paused for a moment and then asked coldly, “Who exactly are you? Who is backing you up?”
“…”
Queta was instantly dumbfounded. Her expression was abnormally surprised because she did not expect Connor to ask her this question.
Connor knew that Queta’s identity had always been very mysterious. Even Thomas Morgan could not find out who she was. However, Queta had become the business queen of Newtown in less than two years, and countless people had submitted to her.
This meant that there must be a terrifying force supporting Queta. Otherwise, Queta would never have been able to reach her current position.
“Mr. McDonald, I don’t have any background!” Queta replied after thinking for a moment.
“I originally wanted to give you a way out. However, since you don’t know what’s good for you, don’t blame me for being impolite…”
A trace of ruthlessness flashed across Connor’s eyes. Then, he gently exerted force with his right hand.
Queta stared at Connor with her big watery eyes. Her expression was very determined, as if she was determined not to reveal her identity.
However, as Connor’s strength increased, it became more and more clear that Queta was struggling. She began to thrash about and pull on Connor’s arm hard.
“If you regret it now and want to tell the truth, then nod your head!”
Connor whispered.
Queta nodded without hesitation.
Connor let go of her neck and said lightly, “I’m giving you one last chance to tell me who’s behind you. If you don’t tell me the truth, I’ll kill you!”
“…”
Queta couldn’t help but hesitate for a moment. Then, she said in a low voice, “My father’s name is Percy Juve. He has always been working for a company called Rockefeller. However, because Rockefeller’s nature is very special, my father can’t show his face. I’ve only gotten to where I am today with my father’s help for so many years. As for the other things, I really don’t know…”
“Haha…”
Connor looked at Queta in front of him and couldn’t help but sneer. He was sure that his guess was right.
Queta was actually related to Percy Juve.
When Connor first saw Queta, he felt that she looked familiar, but he didn’t know why. Later, Connor had accidentally seen Percy Juve’s information and found that he had a daughter named Queta Juve.
However, Queta had died fifteen years ago, and the only photo she had was of her when she was young.
Queta looked very similar to the girl in the photo, so Connor boldly thought that Queta could be Percy’s daughter. Percy had faked her death to protect his daughter.
At this moment, Queta had also admitted to this matter personally.
“Mr. McDonald, I’ve already told you my identity. Can you let me go…” Queta begged.
“Who else knows that you attacked me today?”
Connor squinted his eyes and asked.
“Only Arthur and I know!”
Queta replied.
“Where’s Percy Juve?” Connor asked.
“My father is still overseas and hasn’t returned yet, so I didn’t tell him about this!” Queta said.
Connor knew that Queta wasn’t lying. After all, once Percy Juve knew his identity, Rockefeller would definitely get the best assassin to come after him. He wouldn’t be able to survive so easily.
“Since you’re so honest, I can spare your life today, but I want you to listen to me from now on. Do whatever I tell you to do. Do you understand what I mean?”
Connor whispered.
“Understood…”
Queta hurriedly nodded. After all, as long as she could survive, Queta would do anything.
Connor smiled faintly. He knew that Queta had agreed too readily. If he let this person go now, she would definitely betray him in the future.
Besides, Connor had spared Queta’s life to deal with Percy Juve. Connor had no way to guarantee that Queta would listen to him, so he had made preparations beforehand.
Connor reached out and grabbed her chin.

chapters.title: Chapter 1102: Surrender!
chapters.content:
Chapter 1102: Surrender!
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
“Mr. McDonald, what are you doing?”
Queta’s eyes flashed with fear.
Connor didn’t answer her question. Instead, he took out the pill that Diana gave him and stuffed it into her mouth, forcing her to eat it.
“What did you feed me?”
Queta shouted at Connor with a terrified expression.
“I do not know what this medicinal pill is either. However, I know that you will be in extreme pain after eating this medicinal pill. I am not very knowledgeable about the extent of the pain…”
...
Connor replied indifferently.
“You lunatic, I’ve already told you the truth. Why do you still want to kill me?”
Queta screamed as she put her hand into her mouth, as if she wanted to vomit and spit out the pill.
“When did I say I wanted to kill you?”
Connor said softly.
“You don’t want to kill me, then you…”
Queta wanted to speak, but at this moment, a sharp pain instantly swept through her heart.
“Ahh!”
Queta couldn’t help but let out a scream. Then, she fell to the ground and writhed about. At this moment, Queta felt as if there were ten thousand ants gnawing at her body. Her heart felt as if it was being stabbed by a knife. This feeling was immeasurably more painful than being executed by a thousand cuts.
Queta’s expression was twisted in pain. Her hands kept scratching the ground. She wanted Connor to kill her right now.
Connor looked at Queta on the ground with an unusually calm expression. He didn’t say a word and just watched quietly.
Two minutes later, Queta had lost all her strength from the torture. She was paralyzed on the ground, her eyes empty, but the pain on her body did not lessen at all.
However, she no longer had the strength to move, nor could she make any sound.
Seeing that the effect was about the same, Connor walked directly to Queta and took out another pill and threw it into her mouth.
After taking the pill, Queta instantly felt the pain in her body disappear.
Queta stared at Connor, not understanding what he was trying to do.
“From today onwards, every half a month, you will experience the pain just now. The pain will last for a full twenty-four hours, and then your body will completely lose its function and you will die!”
Connor whispered.
After Queta heard Connor’s words, she instantly broke down and shouted, “You’re a demon!”
“But I have the antidote, you see. As long as you take the antidote before it acts up, you can avoid the pain. So from today onwards, as long as you are obedient, I will get someone to give you the antidote on time.”
Connor continued.
Only then did Queta realize Connor’s true intentions. Connor planned to control her forever. Her body could not help but tremble violently.
“Did you hear what I said to you just now?”
Connor asked expressionlessly.
“Y-Yes! I’ll do whatever you want me to do in the future!”
Queta did not dare to resist at all and hurriedly nodded at Connor.
Just a few minutes of pain was enough to torture Queta to the point that she wanted to die. If this continued for an entire day, Queta might as well just die!
No one had expected that the business queen of Newtown would become so humbled in front of Connor.
Queta felt that her life was in Connor’s hands. This was the greatest humiliation possible.
However, this feeling of being conquered by Connor made her feel a little excited and expectant. It was as if she enjoyed this feeling very much.
“Don’t tell anyone about what happened today. Also, I don’t want anyone to know about my identity, including your father. Do you understand?”
Connor said.
“Understood…” Queta hurriedly nodded.
“Also, when Percy Juve comes back, you have to inform me as soon as possible!”
Connor continued.
“I…Alright!”
Although Queta didn’t know why Connor was doing this, she still looked at him and nodded.
…
A few minutes later, Connor and Queta returned to the private room.
At this moment, Queta seemed to have returned to her business queen appearance. She had a faint smile on her face as she entered the private room while talking to Connor.
When everyone saw this scene, they all revealed surprised expressions.
After all, there was a huge commotion outside, but Queta and Connor acted as if nothing had happened.
What was even more unbelievable was that Queta’s attitude towards Connor seemed to have become even more respectful. She even seemed to be very cautious in selecting her words. The way she looked at Connor was also very strange.
They had never seen Queta look at anyone like that.
Freya hurriedly ran to Connor and Queta’s side and asked excitedly, “Connor, Queta, are you two okay? What happened just now? Why did I hear a gunshot?”
“Yeah, Queta, what happened just now?”
At this moment, the others were also very curious about what had happened just now and bombarded the two with questions.
Queta looked at everyone and smiled faintly. Then, she said softly, “Actually, nothing happened just now. It was just a few assassins after me. Fortunately, Mr. McDonald reacted quickly and saved me…”
When Freya heard Queta’s words, a strange look flashed across her eyes.
At this moment, she could clearly feel that something was wrong, but she did not continue asking.
Connor smiled, indicating that she did not need to worry.
As for the others, they naturally didn’t think too much about it. After knowing that Connor and Queta were fine, they didn’t ask any more questions.
However, Arthur was the only one who sat on the spot. The expression on his face was extremely incredulous!
According to his plan, the current Connor should be dead by now! After all, he had clearly heard the gunshot just now, but Connor was still standing there, and he seemed very calm. This was really unbelievable.
Arthur probably never dreamed that Queta had already completely submitted to Connor. She did not dare to disobey him.

chapters.title: Chapter 1103: You Dare to Hit Mr. Synder Jr.?
chapters.content:
Chapter 1103: You Dare to Hit Mr. Synder Jr.?
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
“Queta…”
Arthur hesitated for a moment before shouting, but Queta looked at him coldly and didn’t say anything.
Connor hesitated for a moment, then walked directly to Arthur and whispered, “Stand up!”
After Arthur heard Connor’s words, a trace of confusion flashed across his eyes. However, he still stood up slowly and asked with a smile, “Connor, what’s the matter?”
“Pa!”
Connor didn’t even think. He raised his right hand and slapped his face fiercely, directly sending Arthur flying.
...
For a moment, everyone was stunned.
No one expected that Connor would actually directly slap Arthur!
Arthur struggled on the ground and shouted at Connor with red eyes, “How dare you hit me? Are you tired of living?”
Arthur had been a proud person since he was young. When had he ever suffered such humiliation? And on top of that, it was in front of Freya.
Arthur naturally could not swallow this anger. At this moment, he wished he could kill Connor directly.
Connor didn’t waste his breath either. He walked directly to Arthur, then reached out and grabbed his collar. He whispered, “I advise you not to provoke me in the future. Otherwise, I’ll make you die a very ugly death!”
Arthur only reacted when he heard Connor’s words. At this time, Connor should have already known the truth of the matter.
Connor was not an ordinary person. He was an existence that had countless big shots in Porthampton submitting to him. If Connor was really bothered, it was not impossible for Connor to kill Arthur.
In an instant, an unprecedented fear swept through Arthur’s heart.
However, what made Arthur even more confused was how Connor survived today. Logically speaking, his plan with Queta could be considered perfect. Connor should not have any chance of surviving!
Arthur thought about how Connor was talking to Queta. He instantly thought that Connor might have already joined forces with her.
No one knew what was going on. Samuel rushed in front of Connor like a madman and shouted, “Connor, are you crazy? You actually dared to hit Mr. Synder Jr.. Are you tired of living?”
“That’s right Connor, do you know who Mr. Synder Jr. is? And you even hit him!” the others also shouted.
Connor didn’t want to kill anyone, so the slap he gave Arthur was just a warning.
The others felt that it was unbelievable. After all, as long as they offended Arthur, they would not have a good ending in the end.
After all, everyone present knew how vengeful Arthur was.
Freya didn’t know why Connor would hit someone, but she was very anxious. She knew that although Arthur looked gentle and refined, his methods were actually very cruel and he was very calculative.
If Arthur wanted to take revenge on Connor, the consequences would be unimaginable.
Therefore, Freya looked at Queta as if she wanted Queta to speak up for her.
After all, among so many people, only Queta could suppress Arthur.
Samuel grabbed Connor and shouted at him excitedly. “Connor, hurry up and apologize to Mr. Synder Jr.!”
“Samuel, shut up!”
But at this time, Queta scolded Samuel coldly.
When everyone heard her words, they were all stunned. They felt that everything that had happened was unbelievable. No one expected Queta to choose to speak up for Connor at this time, and it was under the situation where Arthur was beaten up by him!
“Is it because Connor saved Queta that she’s speaking up for him?” Samuel’s eyes were filled with doubt and confusion, but at this time, it seemed that this was the only explanation that made sense.
Queta walked up to Arthur in her high heels and said expressionlessly, “Get out now. I don’t want to see you again in my life!”
She’d only gotten into this mess because of Arthur, so Queta naturally hated Arthur very much in her heart. However, she could not show it too obviously.
After hearing her words, Arthur finally understood what was going on.
He took a deep breath, then gritted his teeth and fiercely asked, “Connor, I will definitely pay you back a hundredfold for today’s matter!”
“…”
Connor glanced at Arthur indifferently and did not have the intention to pay attention to him at all.
“From now on, I, Queta, and Arthur are irreconcilable enemies. If you want to stand on Arthur’s side, you can leave together now!”
At this moment, Queta shouted at everyone again.
After hearing her words, everyone looked at each other, but no one chose to leave.
After all, in front of Queta, Arthur was still weaker.
Queta walked to Connor’s side and said softly, “Mr. McDonald, do you want me to get someone to get rid of him?”
At this moment, Queta hated Arthur terribly. After all, if it weren’t for Arthur, she wouldn’t have ended up like this.
“No need. If I kill him, Freya might suspect me!”
Connor lightly shook his head.
At this moment, Connor and Queta were speaking very softly, so no one could hear their conversation.
However, the expressions on these people’s faces were very incredulous because they really couldn’t understand why her attitude towards Connor had changed so much.
Even Freya’s eyes were filled with confusion. After all, Connor and Queta had only met twice. Their current behavior was a little too intimate.
If it was just because Connor saved her life, then it wouldn’t be like this!
At this moment, Lara Tooks knew what was going on. After all, she was the only person who knew Connor’s background.

chapters.title: Chapter 1104: The Way to Recover Memory!
chapters.content:
Chapter 1104: The Way to Recover Memory!
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
A moment later, Connor and Freya left Hustlers Club.
After getting into the car, Freya looked at Connor. She then asked softly, “Connor, what happened today? Why did you hit Arthur? And why did Queta’s attitude towards you change so much? What happened between the two of you in the backyard?”
Connor couldn’t help but hesitate when he heard Freya’s words.
Then, he whispered, “Arthur hired an assassin today to kill Queta and me. But just now, I saved Queta. That’s why her attitude towards me changed so much!”
“What?”
When Freya heard Connor’s words, her eyes widened in disbelief.
...
She had never thought that the killer would be sent by Arthur.
“Arthur is actually so bold?” Freya shouted at Connor in disbelief.
“Arthur originally wanted to kill the two of us. This way, he could create the illusion that the two of us were killing each other, but he did not expect me to be prepared in advance, so his plan failed!” Connor said lightly.
Freya looked at Connor in disbelief.
However, she felt that Connor’s explanation was reasonable.
If that wasn’t the case, Freya really couldn’t understand why Queta’s attitude towards Connor would change so drastically. Also, why would Queta suddenly treat Arthur with such an attitude? The person she valued the most was probably Arthur.
In addition, she felt that Connor would not lie to her about this kind of thing, so she quickly believed his words.
Seeing that Freya did not continue to question him, Connor naturally relaxed a lot. After all, if Freya continued to ask, Connor’s best option would be to confess.
“Connor, I think it’s best for you to stay away from Queta and the others in the future. These people are very dangerous. I’m only getting in touch with them for the sake of my company. Moreover, with my mother’s relationship, Queta can’t do anything to me, but it might not be the case for you…”
Freya looked at Connor as if she was a little worried.
“I understand…” Connor nodded lightly.
“Then I’ll send you back!”
Freya seemed to be in a much better mood after seeing Connor agree. She prepared to start the car. However, at this moment, Freya’s expression changed. Then, her entire body began to tremble, and her face instantly turned much paler.
“Freya, what’s wrong?”
Connor sat beside Freya, and he could clearly see that something was wrong with her.
“Connor, my head hurts so much. It hurts so much…”
Freya clutched her head with a pained expression.
“Is it a headache?”
Connor could not help but be stunned when he heard this.
“That’s right, my head hurts…” Freya replied faintly before she collapsed onto the ground.
“Freya!”
When Connor saw that Freya had suddenly fainted, he instantly lost his composure.
He hurriedly checked on her, but did not find anything unusual.
Connor pushed open the car door and got out, intending to move her out of the driver seat before sending her to the hospital.
At this moment, Connor was still very anxious, and the expression on his face was also abnormally angry.
He knew that Freya’s current state had a lot to do with Camila Yearwood causing Freya to lose her memory.
“Camila Yearwood, if anything happens to Freya, I will never let you off!”
Connor roared in his heart. He then moved Freya out of the driver’s seat and placed her in the backseat of the car.
A few seconds later, Connor started the car.
Then, he took out his phone and dialed Reena’s number, asking her to arrange for the best neurologist to examine and treat Freya.
After arranging everything, Connor sped the entire way there, ignoring the traffic lights. The journey that would’ve taken half an hour took less than ten minutes.
Because Reena had already made the necessary arrangements at the hospital, when Connor carried Freya into the hospital, she was immediately brought to the examination room.
Connor stood outside the door of the inspection room with an unusually anxious expression on his face. Reena was also by Connor’s side, but she didn’t say or ask anything.
She knew about the relationship between Connor and Freya. She also knew that Connor was definitely in a bad mood.
About half an hour later, the doctor finally walked out of the examination room.
Connor hurriedly went up to him and asked the doctor excitedly, “Doctor, how’s my fiancee?”
“Mr. McDonald, you don’t have to worry. Miss Phillips is not in any danger for the time being. She is only unconscious. She will probably wake up in an hour!” the doctor replied.
After hearing the doctor’s words, Connor’s expression eased a lot. Then, he asked in a low voice, “Doctor, why did she suddenly faint? What’s going on?”
The doctor hesitated for a moment. Then, he said softly, “Mr. McDonald, it’s not convenient to talk here. Why don’t we talk in my office?”
“Alright.”
Connor nodded and followed the doctor into the office. After hesitating for a moment, Reena followed Connor in.
“Doctor, what’s going on?”
Connor asked the doctor anxiously.
The doctor looked at Connor up and down and said softly, “Mr. McDonald, I’m not sure if you know that your girlfriend has a portion of her memory damaged.”
“I know this…” Connor nodded.
“Since you know this situation, it’s easy to handle. I suspect that a part of Miss Phillips’s memory has been removed, but during the operation, the removed memory was not particularly complete. This also causes Miss Phillips to remember some things sometimes, but these memories will cause great damage to her brain. If it’s light, she might have a headache. If it’s serious, she might just faint!” The doctor said.
Connor was stunned when he heard the doctor’s words.
“Doctor, is there any way to cure my girlfriend’s condition?”
Connor hesitated for a moment before asking.
“If you want to completely cure your girlfriend, the most direct way is to let Miss Phillips recover her memory naturally. However, according with current medical developments, it is very easy to erase a person’s memory, but it is impossible to recover her memory. After all, there is no way to recover from this kind of trauma!”
The doctor said slowly.
“Is there no other way?”
Connor hurriedly asked.
The doctor thought for a moment and looked up at Connor. “Actually, there’s another way to treat the symptoms, but not the root cause…”
“What is it?”
Connor asked.

chapters.title: Chapter 1105: Soul Returning Pill
chapters.content:
Chapter 1105: Soul Returning Pill
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
“Mr. McDonald, we have to ask, ‘why did Miss Phillips suddenly regain her memory’? It’s mainly because during this period of time, she has came into contact with a large number of people and things from the past. This caused her brain to awaken a portion of her memories. If she did not awaken these memories for a long time, then Miss Phillips might not have such a situation. Her previous memories would have been completely erased, and she would be able to return to normal!” the doctor said slowly.
After hearing what the doctor said, Connor understood what the doctor meant.
“So, if I disappear from her life and the people she knew before don’t appear in her life, she won’t be in this situation, right?” he asked expressionlessly.
“Logically speaking, yes!” The doctor nodded gently.
Connor gritted his teeth. “If she continues like this, what will happen?”
“Worst case scenario, Miss Phillips is likely to become a vegetable. After all, her brain can’t accept such chaos for a long time!” the doctor replied in a serious tone.
...
After Connor heard the doctor’s words, his eyes were filled with despair. He had thought that he and Freya would never have to be separated again, but he had never expected such a situation to occur.
“Doctor, is there no other way?” Reena asked with a frown.
“Current technology is not enough to solve this problem, but there might be a way in a few years!”
The doctor shook his head gently.
Reena looked at the doctor and didn’t know what to say. After all, this doctor was the most authoritative neurologist in the country. If this person said that there was no way, then there might really be no way.
“I understand…” Connor replied to the doctor expressionlessly, then walked out of the office with a disappointed expression.
A few minutes later, Connor arrived at Freya’s ward.
“Connor!”
Freya had already woken up and hurriedly called out to Connor.
After Connor quickly adjusted his emotions, he walked into the ward and said with a smile, “Freya, you’re awake? You really scared me to death just now…”
“What happened to me just now?”
Freya asked in confusion.
“You fainted just now. I was the one who sent you to the hospital…”
Connor replied.
“What did the doctor say? Why did I faint?”
Freya asked. “The doctor said that you fainted because you overworked yourself, so you have to take care of your health in the future. You must not stay up late again…”
Connor made up an excuse.
“So that’s how it is. I’ve been staying up late a lot recently because of the company’s matters…”
Freya nodded before continuing, “Connor, do you know? I had a dream just now…”
“What dream?”
Connor asked absent-mindedly.
“I dreamt that you were really my fiancé, and my parents weren’t my current parents. They were the two people you brought me to see that day. Everyone in my family looked down on you, but later on, you shocked everyone. Although it was a little blurry, I really dreamed of everything you said in my dream…”
Freya said happily to Connor.
When Connor heard Freya’s words, his body could not help but tremble slightly. After all, this was not a dream, but something that really existed.
“Freya, the doctor said that you need to rest well. You should take a nap. Don’t let your imagination run wild!”
Connor patted Freya’s head and said softly.
“Alright then!”
Freya hesitated for a moment before closing her eyes and resting.
Connor took a deep breath and walked out of the ward.
After leaving the ward, Connor sat alone on the bench.
He knew very well that he was the reason why Freya had fainted. Furthermore, the longer Freya interacted with him, the worse her condition would become.
The best way now was for him to leave Freya.
However, Connor had spent so much effort to finally find Freya and get back together with her, but the situation had turned out like this.
He didn’t know what to choose.
At this moment, Carlos and Diana ran to Connor’s side and asked anxiously, “Mr. McDonald, is Miss Phillips alright?”
“It’s nothing!”
Connor lightly shook his head.
“Mr. McDonald, what happened to Miss Phillips? Why did she suddenly faint?” Diana frowned and asked.
Connor looked up at Diana, but didn’t say anything. He felt that even if he told Diana and the others about these things, it would be useless.
“Mr. McDonald, I know some very good doctors. My grandfather is an alchemist himself, so he keeps in touch with them. If you encounter any difficult problems, you can tell me,” Diana hurriedly explained to Connor.
