“That’s right, Mr. McDonald, Diana does know many powerful doctors. These doctors are not available to ordinary people!” Carlos added.
Connor slowly raised his head to look at Diana, then briefly explained Freya’s situation to her.
After learning about Freya’s situation, Diana immediately took out her phone and called her grandfather.
Connor didn’t have much hope for Diana. After all, he felt that even the best doctor in the country couldn’t solve this problem. What could Diana think of?
Half an hour later, Diana returned to Connor’s side and whispered, “Mr. McDonald, I’ve told my grandfather about Miss Phillips’s condition. My grandfather said that there’s only one way to cure Miss Phillips’s illness and help her recover her memory!”
As soon as he heard that, Connor stood up and asked excitedly, “What is it?”
“This method is actually very simple. Mr. McDonald, you only need to find someone who can refine the Soul Returning Pill and ask him to refine one for Miss Phillips…”
Diana smiled.
“A Soul Returning Pill?”
Connor’s eyes flashed with a trace of confusion.
“That’s right. The Soul Returning Pill is a legendary medicinal pill. It can allow a person who has lost their memory to regain them…” Diana explained to Connor.

chapters.title: Chapter 1106: How Much Money Do You Want?
chapters.content:
Chapter 1106: How Much Money Do You Want?
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
“Will it work on Freya?”
Connor asked excitedly.
“Of course. The effect of the Soul Returning Pill is very powerful. Not only can it help Miss Phillips recover her memories, but it can also repair the brain damage caused by the surgery!”
Diana said with certainty.
After hearing Diana’s words, Connor seemed to see hope again.
“Then, do you know who can concoct the Soul Returning Pill? Can your grandfather concoct it?”
...
“My grandfather can’t!”
Diana shook her head and continued, “The Soul Returning Pill is a legendary pill. Ordinary people can’t refine it at all. My grandfather is old now, and his cultivation isn’t strong enough, but I know someone who can refine this pill!”
“Who is it?”
Connor hurriedly asked.
“This person is your master, Jorge Yarrell!”
Diana smiled and continued, “Not only is Jorge an ancient martial arts expert, but he’s also a legendary alchemy grandmaster. In the entire country, no one can compare to his alchemy skills. So, if you have Jorge refine the Soul Returning Pill, there shouldn’t be any problems…”
“This damn old man is actually so powerful?”
The more Connor knew about Jorge, the more he felt that Jorge was a little unbelievable.
Not only was he skilled in martial arts, but he also knew alchemy.
However, after thinking about it, Connor felt that it was normal. After all, Jorge had given Connor an Essence Cultivating Pill that had changed Connor’s physical fitness. It even allowed him to go from an ordinary person to an entry-level martial artist.
“Okay, Diana, help me book a plane ticket to Porthampton for tonight. I’ll send Freya home first and then go find the old man…”
Connor thought about it for a moment and whispered to Diana.
“Mr. McDonald, do you want me to go back with you?”
Carlos Lane said to Connor.
“No. The two of you stay here to protect Freya. I’m worried that someone will attack her!”
Now that the situation in Newtown was uncertain, Connor felt that it was better to have Carlos and Diana protect Freya.
After all, Connor wasn’t very assured about leaving this matter to Reena Satchwell’s people.
“Alright, then!”
Carlos looked at Connor and nodded.
8 PM.
Connor sent Freya home and made up a random excuse, saying that he might have to leave Newtown for a period of time due to some matters.
Freya did not ask too much and nodded in agreement.
After seeing Freya home, Connor immediately hailed a taxi and headed to Newtown’s airport, preparing to rush back to Porthampton overnight.
Newtown was a few hundred kilometers away from Porthampton. Connor got off the plane at seven o’clock the next morning.
After getting off the plane, Connor didn’t choose to rest. Instead, he rushed straight to Jorge’s house.
After all, the most important thing now was to solve Freya’s problem.
When he passed by a supermarket, Connor specially bought some fruits and gifts.
After all, he had come here to ask for help, so Connor felt that it was not good to go empty-handed.
After entering Jorge’s courtyard, Connor saw that Jorge was still the same as before, sitting on a chair and basking in the sun.
As for Jabba, that silly chimpanzee, he sat quietly beside Jorge, scratching the lice on his body.
When Jabba saw Connor, he bared his teeth and pounced on him. He also snatched all the bananas in Connor’s fruit basket.
Connor wasn’t in the mood to care about Jabba. He walked to Jorge’s side and grinned. “Master, long time no see.”
“I didn’t think you’d still remember me,” Jorge said expressionlessly.
“Master, what are you saying? As the saying goes, a teacher for a day is a father for life. No matter what, you’re still my master. I was really busy some time ago and couldn’t find the time to come see you. Now that I finally have the time, I immediately came to see you…”
Connor looked at Jorge and smiled. Then, he took out all the gifts he had bought and said with a smile, “Master, look. This is black bean powder that I specially bought for you. It’s for your kidneys. There’s also this protein powder for your calcium. Oh right, there’s also this red date powder…”
“Alright, don’t bother with the gifts. If you have something to say, hurry up and say it. I’m not in the mood to listen to your nonsense!”
Jorge interrupted Connor helplessly.
Connor was a little helpless, and then he said with a smile, “Master, actually, I’m not here for anything big. I just want you to help me with a small favor!”
“…”
Jorge looked at Connor indifferently and didn’t say anything.
“It’s really just a small favor…”
Connor explained guiltily.
“What favor?”
Jorge asked.
“I want you to help me refine a Soul Returning Pill!”
Connor gritted his teeth.
“Leave. I can’t help you with this. Also, take all your gifts and fruits with you. I don’t need them…”
Jorge rejected without hesitation.
“Old man, don’t be so heartless. No matter what, I’m still your disciple. You’re not willing to help me with such a small favor?”
Connor said helplessly.
“This is not a small favor. The process of refining the Soul Returning Pill is very complicated and requires a lot of energy. I won’t help you!”
Jorge still shook his head and refused.
“So, you mean that you can refine the Soul Returning Pill, right?”
When Connor heard Jorge’s words, he was extremely excited. After all, what was important was that Jorge could refine the Resurrection Pill.
“I didn’t say that…”
Jorge shook his head.
“Alright, stop putting on an act. How much money do you want and what conditions do you have?”
Connor knew Jorge’s tricks. If he didn’t give Jorge some benefits, Jorge would definitely not help.
“I won’t help you no matter how much it costs!”
Jorge shook his head again.
“Old man, do you really have to be so heartless? This Soul Returning Pill will be used to save someone, and it’s related to my happiness for the rest of my life. Can’t you help me? As long as you help me this time, I’ll do whatever you want me to do in the future, okay?”
Connor exclaimed.
“What does your happiness for the rest of your life have to do with me? Anyway, I won’t help you. Go find someone else!”
Jorge said expressionlessly.

chapters.title: Chapter 1107: Celestial Flower Valley
chapters.content:
Chapter 1107: Celestial Flower Valley
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Connor looked at Jorge and couldn’t help but be stunned for a moment. Then, he gritted his teeth and said in a low voice.
“Alright, stinky old man. Since you’re so heartless, don’t blame me for being heartless too.
“From now on, I’ll stay here with you. As long as you don’t agree to my request, I’ll pester you every day and not let you have any peace. I’d like to see which one of us will surrender first…”
When Jorge heard Connor’s words, he looked at Connor helplessly and said in a low voice, “What do you want the Soul Returning Pill for?”
Seeing that Jorge was now more willing to talk, he quickly told Jorge everything about Freya.
When Jorge found out, he sighed softly, “Since you are doing this for your girlfriend, I’ll help you this time, albeit reluctantly. However, refining medicinal pills requires a fee…”
...
“How much?”
Connor asked helplessly.
“500 million!”
Jorge extended five fingers at Connor.
Connor looked at Jorge and was exasperated. His eyes widened as he shouted, “Old man, aren’t you being too cruel? You want me to pay 500 million for one medicinal pill?”
“If you think it’s expensive, then you can find someone else…”
Jorge looked at Connor and said calmly.
“We are master and disciple. Also, I’ve bought you so many gifts. Can you give me a discount…”
Connor said helplessly.
“No discounts!”
Jorge shook his head.
“How about 50 million?”
Connor asked Jorge.
“Then, you can stay here…”
Jorge said speechlessly.
“Fine, fine…”
Connor quickly reached out to stop Jorge, then gritted his teeth and said, “Alright, 500 million it is. As long as you are able to help me refine the medicinal pill…”
“Wait for me here!”
Seeing that Connor had agreed, Jorge stood up and walked into the house.
Connor looked at Jorge’s back, and his eyes were filled with anger.
Because in his eyes, Jorge was a person who only liked money. He didn’t have any feelings at all. No matter what, he would talk about money.
A few minutes later, Jorge handed Connor a piece of paper.
After Connor received the note, he looked at it very seriously. He realized that it was the same as the last time Jorge asked him to collect the ingredients for the Essence Cultivating Pill. The names of the herbs were all written on it.
But this time, there were even more types of medicinal herbs, and most of them were extremely rare medicinal herbs.
“What is this?”
Connor looked at the note in his hand and asked Jorge with a puzzled expression.
“These are the medicinal ingredients needed to refine the Soul Returning Pill. Go and gather all these medicinal ingredients before coming to me…”
Jorge whispered to Connor.
“Stinky old man, are you kidding me? All the herbs required are extremely precious thousand-year-old herbs. Where am I going to find them?”
Connor shouted at Jorge speechlessly.
After collecting medicinal herbs last time, Connor already knew how precious thousand-year-old medicinal herbs were. This kind of thing was not something that one could buy with money!
“There is also an address on the note. There is going to be a martial artist convention there. I will give you some pills that you can bring with you. When the time comes, you can take these pills to exchange for the herbs you need, but you can’t let others know about your relationship with me, and you can’t say that I gave those pills to you!”
Jorge passed a porcelain bottle to Connor as he spoke.
Connor opened the porcelain bottle and took a look. He saw that there were about 50 pills inside.
“You can exchange these medicinal pills for thousand-year-old medicinal herbs?”
Connor asked in confusion.
“Of course…”
Jorge nodded lightly and continued, “These medicinal pills of mine can allow martial artists to quickly increase their strength. Although thousand-year-old medicinal herbs are precious, martial artists have no way to absorb them. Therefore, compared to these medicinal pills, thousand-year-old medicinal herbs are completely worthless!”
“Then, why won’t you let me tell others about our relationship?”
Connor asked in confusion.
“If others find out that I have found a disciple with such a crappy aptitude like yours, it will be such an embarrassment!”
Jorge didn’t give Connor any face at all and said frankly.
After hearing Jorge’s words, Connor was instantly speechless. He looked at Jorge and really didn’t know what to say.
“Alright, then I’ll go there and try my luck. What if I can’t find all these medicinal herbs?”
Connor asked Jorge.
“If you can’t gather all these herbs at the martial artist convention, then go to the Celestial Flower Valley. You can find all the herbs you need there!”
Jorge replied.
“Where is Celestial Flower Valley?”
Connor was stunned for a moment and asked.
“I don’t know where the Celestial Flower Valley is either, but you can meet people from the Celestial Flower Valley at the convention. At that time, you can follow the people from the Celestial Flower Valley and find the Celestial Flower Valley…”
Jorge said slowly.
“You might as well not say anything…”
Connor looked at Jorge and was instantly speechless.
“By the way, how’s your practice of the Seven Star Big Dipper Fist?”
Jorge asked Connor.
“I’m already practicing the last move!”
Connor replied.
“Not bad. It seems that you haven’t stopped cultivating!”
Jorge nodded in satisfaction.
“Old man, actually, I’ve never understood the difference between martial artists and ordinary people. Is it just the difference in strength?”
Connor frowned and asked Jorge.
“Actually, martial artists are just like ordinary people. It’s just that martial artists can maximize the power in their bodies, and ordinary people can’t do that. However, once ordinary people become martial artists, they can also use the Chi in their bodies to increase their combat strength!”
Jorge explained slowly.
“Chi?”
Connor frowned and said in a low voice, “I’m also a martial artist now. Why can’t I use the Chi in my body?”
“That’s because you don’t know how to use Chi…”
Jorge passed a book to Connor as he spoke.
Connor took the book and glanced at it. On it were three words, Chi Manipulation Technique.
“What is this?”
Connor asked Jorge.
“This is the technique of using Chi. In the future, when you have time, you can follow the instructions on it to train the Chi in your body. When you are familiar with controlling your Chi, you can learn to store Chi!”
Jorge paused for a moment, then looked at Connor and continued, “Under normal circumstances, martial artists are divided into four ranks: heaven, earth, black, and yellow. In each rank, there are three levels: beginner, intermediate, and advanced. The Yellow rank beginner level is the weakest of all, and the amount of energy stored in the body is the least…”

chapters.title: Chapter 1108: Martial Artist Convention
chapters.content:
Chapter 1108: Martial Artist Convention
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
“I see!”
Connor nodded lightly, then looked at Jorge and asked, “They all say that you’re an ancient martial arts grandmaster. What’s your current level?”
“Those above black rank beginner level are masters, and those above masters are grandmasters!”
Jorge looked at Connor and replied.
“So you’re that powerful? Then, do you know what level I am now?”
Connor gritted his teeth and asked.
...
“I don’t. Although there’s Chi in your body now, because you don’t know how to use it, I can’t be sure what level you are in!”
Jorge shook his head lightly, then took out three pills and handed them to Connor. He said softly, “Just like last time, these three pills can raise your physical strength to black rank beginner level for a short period of time, lasting for about an hour. If you encounter any danger, use it again, it can save your life!”
“This is good stuff!”
Connor was very interested in the pill that Jorge had given him, so he accepted it with a smile.
Connor had used this kind of medicinal pill the last time. It was indeed very effective.
“Alright, I’ve already told you what you need to know. The martial artist convention isn’t a peaceful one. People die every year.”
Jorge looked at Connor and said.
“I got it. Thank you, old man!”
Connor looked at Jorge and smiled. Then, he turned around and walked out of the courtyard.
Jorge looked at Connor’s gradually disappearing back and sighed softly. He narrowed his eyes, and no one knew what he was thinking.
Originally, Connor wasn’t very interested in this kind of martial artist convention. After all, he had only taken Jorge as his master because he wanted to have the ability to protect himself. However, this time, it involved Freya. Therefore, even if Connor knew that there might be danger, he was prepared to go and take a look.
The martial artist convention was held in a place called Tayton, which was thousands of miles away from Porthampton.
Therefore, Connor knew nothing about the situation over there.
However, Thomas Morgan said that the Empire World Corporation also had a branch in Tayton. Thomas wanted the person in charge of Tayton to welcome Connor, but Connor refused.
After all, Connor was only going this time to collect medicinal herbs.
Connor felt that there was no need to alarm too many people. It was better to keep a low profile. Otherwise, he might encounter some danger.
The next day, at nine o’clock in the morning.
Connor finally arrived at Tayton and walked out of the airport alone.
Tayton’s economic development was very different from Porthampton. It didn’t look very prosperous, and it was hot.
Basically, sexy young ladies in skimpy clothes could be seen everywhere. For those people in Tayton, this was considered a benefit.
After walking out of the airport, Connor took out the note Jorge had given him.
However, Connor realized that the place Jorge had written was actually in a manor.
Connor asked several drivers, but no one knew the exact location of this manor. After all, this was a gathering between martial artists. It was not odd that ordinary people did not know about it.
Just as Connor was at a loss, he suddenly saw a middle-aged man pass by him.
Connor instantly felt that there was something wrong with this person’s aura, because it was absolutely impossible for an ordinary person to have such a powerful aura.
Therefore, Connor felt that this person was a martial artist. A martial artist here in Tayton and in a rush. This meant that the other party was very likely going to attend the martial artist convention.
After hesitating for a moment, Connor decided to follow behind this martial artist. This way, Connor could find the exact location of the convention.
After Connor made up his mind, he began to carefully follow behind the middle-aged man.
However, after walking less than 500 meters, the middle-aged man suddenly stopped and looked at Connor expressionlessly.
Connor appeared a little awkward. He pretended to know nothing and turned around to leave.
“Stop!”
But at this moment, the middle-aged man suddenly shouted at Connor.
Connor stopped helplessly and asked the middle-aged man with a smile, “Yes?”
“I should be the one asking you this!”
The middle-aged man coldly replied and then continued, “Why are you following me?”
“…”
Connor looked at the middle-aged man from head to toe and then said indifferently, “If I’m not wrong, you should also be a martial artist, right?”
“Are you a martial artist?”
The middle-aged man instantly understood what Connor meant and asked.
“I can’t be considered a martial artist, but I’m going to participate in the martial artist convention this time to gather some medicinal herbs. Although I know the location of the martial artist convention, I don’t know how to get there, that’s why I’ve been following you!”
Connor looked at the middle-aged man in front of him and explained.
“If you’re not a martial artist, why are you attending the martial artist convention?”
The middle-aged man replied and continued, “Don’t follow me anymore…”
“If you can bring me in, I can give you something as compensation!”
Seeing that the middle-aged man was about to leave, Connor hurriedly called out.
“Compensation?”
The middle-aged man couldn’t help but be stunned when he heard Connor’s words. Then, he looked at Connor up and down and said softly, “What can you give me?”
“Money!”
In Connor’s eyes, there was nothing that money couldn’t solve.
However, when the middle-aged man heard Connor’s words, he couldn’t help but laugh. Then, he said coldly, “Young man, you are really naive. We martial artists have never lacked money. If you have something like spirit pills, I might consider…”
“Spirit pills?”
When Connor heard the middle-aged man’s words, he instantly said, “I have pills!”
“Really?”
When the middle-aged man heard Connor’s words, the way he looked at Connor instantly changed.
Connor took out a pill from his clothes and handed it to the middle-aged man without thinking. Then, he said softly, “What do you think of this pill?”
When the middle-aged man received the pill, he hurriedly placed it in front of his nose and smelled it. Then, a trace of excitement flashed across his eyes as he looked at Connor and said, “Young man, this is a top-grade medicinal pill. Where did you get it from? How many of these medicinal pills do you have in your hands? Sell them to me. No matter how much it costs…”
“I’m sorry, I’m not short of money either. As long as you take me to the martial artist convention, I’ll give you a few more if I’m in a good mood…”
Connor said softly.

chapters.title: Chapter 1109: Old Acquaintance!
chapters.content:
Chapter 1109: Old Acquaintance!
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
“Alright, I’ll bring you there now…”
The middle-aged man looked at Connor, a trace of greed flashing in his eyes.
But very quickly, he concealed it and then took the initiative to lead the way for Connor.
At this moment, Connor knew that the pill Jorge gave him was actually so precious that it could make a martial artist listen to him.
In the process of interacting with him, Connor found out that this middle-aged man was called Louis Schooling and was born in a martial art aristocratic family.
However, as time passed, the Schooling Family had become a small family that was basically maintained by Louis alone.
...
Louis’s strength was at the yellow rank intermediate level, which was the weakest rank among martial artists.
He came here this time mainly to collect some medicinal pills so that it would be easier for him to increase his strength in the future.
The medicinal pill that Connor gave him just now happened to be the medicinal pill that Louis needed the most right now.
Connor actually did not know much about things like medicinal pills either.
Therefore, after Connor hesitated for a moment, he asked Louis, “The pill I gave you just now… is it very rare?”
“Of course, it is rare…”
Louis nodded and continued, “In this age of chaos, alchemists are on the verge of extinction. Basically, most of the pills are in the hands of martial art families. The pills that ordinary martial artists like us can get are only some of the lowest level pills. However, the pill you gave me is considered high-grade, so they are naturally very precious!”
“I see!”
Connor nodded lightly and didn’t say anything.
Actually, in this current society, the reason why medicinal pills were so precious was mainly because of two reasons.
The first reason was that it was the Age of Chaos. The spiritual energy of heaven and earth had gradually dried up, which led to the decreasing number of medicinal pills.
Moreover, most of the alchemists were controlled by those martial art aristocratic families. It was harder for ordinary people to obtain medicinal pills than to ascend to the heavens.
This was also why Jorge was so confident that his pills could help Connor exchange for the herbs he needed.
“That’s right, I heard that the Celestial Flower Valley and the Wess Family are coming this time around…”
Louis looked at Connor and continued.
“Celestial Flower Valley?”
When Connor heard Louis’s words, his interest was piqued.
“You probably don’t know yet, right? Celestial Flower Valley has the most medicinal herbs in Oprana. Most of the precious medicinal herbs come from Celestial Flower Valley, and the Wess Family is the largest alchemy family in Oprana. Basically, 90% of the pills come from the Wess Family. This time, with these two groups of people here, they will definitely take out a lot of pills…”
Louis said with a smile.
“I see!”
Connor looked at Louis and nodded lightly, but he did not say anything else.
Jorge had mentioned the Celestial Flower Valley to Connor before, so Connor knew that if he couldn’t find the herbs he needed at the martial artist convention, he could only place his hopes on the Celestial Flower Valley.
Half an hour later, Louis finally stopped in front of a manor. He turned and said to Connor, “Little brother, this is the place where the martial artist convention will be held…”
Connor subconsciously looked at the entrance of the manor and saw two strong men standing at the door.
These two muscular men should be martial artists.
This time, Connor would surely broaden his horizons in Tayton.
After all, when he was in Porthampton, Connor did not see many martial artists. However, he could see them almost everywhere here.
“Connor, this manor belongs to the Malone Family in Tayton. The Malone Family is the largest martial arts family in Tayton, and their family head is a martial arts expert. You must be careful.”
Louis seemed to be a little worried and could not help but remind Connor.
“Don’t worry, I’m just here to look for some medicinal herbs. I won’t cause trouble!”
Connor replied.
“Alright, then…”
Louis nodded gently. Then, he took out his invitation and handed it to the burly man at the door.
The burly man glanced at it indifferently and said expressionlessly, “Please come in!”
Louis smiled and walked into the manor.
Connor wanted to follow Louis in, but at this moment, the burly man stretched out his hand and stopped Connor. Then, he said to Connor expressionlessly, “I’m sorry, please show me your invitation letter…”
“This person is my friend. He came with me…”
Louis was stunned for a moment before he hurriedly explained to the guard.
“Your name is the only one written on the invitation letter. You can only enter by yourself.”
The guard did not seem to give Louis any face at all and replied coldly.
“Can you make an exception?”
Louis gritted his teeth and asked.
“Either you go in alone, or none of you go in!”
The guard did not waste any time and said directly.
“…”
Louis looked at Connor with a helpless expression, then turned around and walked into the manor.
Meanwhile, Connor stood there with a helpless expression on his face. He didn’t know what to do.
How could he have thought that he would need an invitation to participate in this so-called martial artist convention?
Jorge didn’t even tell him about this.
Helpless, Connor could only call Thomas Morgan. After all, Thomas had a wide network of connections and should be able to settle this matter.
Ring! Ring!
After the phone rang twice, Thomas picked up the call.
“Mr. Morgan, I’ve already found the location of the martial artist convention, but I need an invitation to enter this manor. Can you help me get an invitation…”
Connor said directly.
“Alright, I’ll call and ask!”
Thomas agreed happily and then hung up.
Connor then sighed helplessly. Then, he stood at the door and waited.
At this time, Connor did not know if Thomas could handle this matter. After all, Thomas was not a martial artist. There were some things that he could not do.
“Connor!”
However, just as Connor was getting impatient, a voice suddenly sounded in his ear.
Connor was stunned for a moment. Then, he instinctively looked up and froze on the spot.
He saw a tall and sexy beauty staring at him with her big watery eyes. She was in disbelief as well.
The beauty had light makeup on her face, and her facial features were exquisite and alluring. Her large wavy hair was casually draped over her shoulders, revealing her fair and slender neck.
She was wearing a black tight skirt, which made her slender and soft waist look even sexier. She was also wearing a pair of high heels. Her exquisite face matched with her slender and fair legs, giving off an indescribable temptation.
And this beauty was an old acquaintance that Connor had not seen for a long time.
Connor never thought that he would actually meet her in such a place!

chapters.title: Chapter 1110: Malone Family
chapters.content:
Chapter 1110: Malone Family
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
“What a small world!”
Connor looked at the beauty in front of him in shock.
He had never thought that he would meet her here!
“Connor, why are you here?”
The short skirt beauty looked at Connor and hesitated for a couple of seconds. Then, she ran to him and asked him with an incredulous expression.
“I’m here to participate in the martial artist convention…”
...
Connor explained helplessly. Then, he sized up the beauty and asked in confusion, “Why are you here?”
“Because this is my home!”
The beautiful woman said with a smile.
“This is your home?”
When Connor heard that, he was instantly dumbfounded. For a moment, he did not know what to say.
At this moment, another slightly younger girl sized up Connor and couldn’t help but ask softly, “Mina, who is this?”
“Quorra, this person is the Connor McDonald I told you about!”
The woman answered.
The person who appeared in front of Connor was none other than Mina, who had disappeared for a long time!
When Mina found out about Connor’s identity, she didn’t know how to face him, so she chose to leave Porthampton.
However, Connor had never expected that Mina would be from the Malone Family in Tayton.
It had been a long time since they last met, but Mina was still so sexy and beautiful.
Furthermore, Connor could feel that Mina seemed to have forgotten about that incident.
“So, you’re Connor. Mina has told me a lot about you!”
The little beauty beside Mina smiled warmly at Connor, then took the initiative to say, “Hello, Connor, my name is Quorra Gaboury!”
“Hello!”
Connor nodded and replied.
Mina looked at Connor and said softly, “Connor, there are many people here. Let’s go in and talk!”
“Alright…”
Connor nodded.
Mina knew that Connor probably didn’t have an invitation, that was why he was waiting here.
Then, she said to the guard, “Willy, this is my friend. I can bring him in, right?”
“Of course, Miss Malone!”
The guard hurriedly agreed.
Mina brought Connor into the manor.
“Mina, are you really from the Malone Family?”
After entering the manor, Connor was still in disbelief, so he frowned and asked Mina.
“I’m actually not considered a main member of the Malone Family. I’m just a side branch of the Malone Family. My grandfather and the head of the Malone Family are brothers!”
Mina explained softly before continuing, “Back then, I ran to Porthampton to avoid the blind date that my family introduced me to. Then, I became an online streamer. Later, I heard that my blind date got married, so I came back. I’m now working in a company that belongs to the Malone Family. Although I don’t earn as much as a streamer, it’s enough for me to live on…”
“I see!”
Connor nodded lightly.
Perhaps it was because they had not met for a long time, Mina told Connor all about herself.
In fact, Mina’s status in the Malone Family was still very low. She was only a small employee in the company now.
Moreover, she could be used as a matchmaking tool by the Malone Family at any time. However, Mina had already accepted all that. After all, there were some things that she could not change.
Mina had nothing to do these days, so she brought her friend Quorra to this manor to see what the martial artist convention was about.
Quorra had a good personality and was very friendly to Connor.
The three of them were about the same age, so they quickly started chatting.
However, just as Mina was about to ask about Connor’s recent situation, a very handsome man walked toward her.
Connor also subconsciously glanced at the guy. He had to admit that this guy was indeed very handsome and had a very good figure. He was even more dazzling than those celebrities on TV. Even Connor felt a little envious when he saw him.
When Mina saw the guy, she also revealed a smile. Then, she took the initiative to step forward and said with a smile, “Terry, you’re here?”
“Mina, you’re here too?”
The guy smiled and then looked at Connor. He asked with a puzzled expression, “And this is?”
“Terry, this is my friend Connor McDonald. He’s also here to participate in the martial artist convention!”
Mina hurriedly explained.
“He’s so young. How could he be a martial artist?”
A hint of helplessness flashed across the guy’s eyes before he continued, “You must have secretly brought him in…”
Mina smiled awkwardly but did not refute.
Originally, Connor thought that the guy would chase him out, but he did not expect the guy to extend his right hand to Connor very enthusiastically and say with a smile, “Hello, my name is Terry Malone!”
“Hello. I’m Connor McDonald!”
Connor replied.
“Mina, since this guy is your friend, then you should make the necessary arrangements. Tell the housekeeping department to arrange a better room for him in my name!”
Terry turned and said to Mina.
“Thank you, Terry!”
Mina said excitedly.
“Why are you still being polite to me? After you’ve made the arrangements for your friends, go and greet the family head. You can’t forget the rules, you understand?”
Terry reminded Mina again.
“I understand…”
Mina hurriedly nodded.
Terry looked at Connor and smiled. Then, he left.
After Terry left, Quorra said to Mina with a lovestruck look, “Mina, this cousin of yours is really handsome. He is really just like the rumors say…”
“Of course. Terry is the most outstanding one in the Malone Family. He’s not only a martial artist, but also a business elite. In the future, he will definitely inherit the Malone Family’s business!”
Mina replied softly, then said to Connor, “Connor, this person is my older cousin. He has an extremely high status in the family and is also the most promising one. Ever since I returned, Terry has been taking care of me. If not for him, I might have already married someone…”
“This cousin of yours is indeed rather outstanding!”
Connor commented expressionlessly.
Although Terry was very polite to Connor, he felt that there was something wrong with Terry’s gaze.
However, Connor could not tell what was wrong.

chapters.title: Chapter 1111: I Made It Myself!
chapters.content:
Chapter 1111: I Made It Myself!
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
“Okay, Connor, I’ll take you to the guest room!”
At that moment, Mina shouted at Connor.
Connor was taken aback for a moment, then nodded thoughtfully.
He never expected that things would turn out so coincidentally, encountering Mina whom he hadn’t seen in a long time.
Actually, he thought she was a very nice girl with a kind heart.
If it weren’t for Freya already occupying his heart.
...
And considering the misunderstandings that happened between him and Mina later on, he might have had something with her.
But now, he no longer had such thoughts.
Because in his heart, there was only Freya.
The thing he wanted to do the most now was to help Freya refine a Soul Returning Pill and help her regain her memory.
Due to Connor’s acquaintance with Mina, the staff at the guest room department quickly arranged a nice room for him, and he didn’t have to spend any money.
There were very few warriors in the entire Tayton who could enjoy such treatment.
And most of them had a close relationship with the Malone family or were prestigious warriors.
After arranging a room for Connor, she planned to go and greet the head of the Malone family.
Connor, on the other hand, returned to his room alone, preparing to rest for a while.
It was already past six in the afternoon, but the official start of the Warrior Conference would be tomorrow morning at ten.
So he planned to take a good rest because there were still many things he needed to take care of tomorrow.
First, he made a phone call to Freya, informing her that he had arrived in Tayton, and then chatted with her casually for a few moments.
After the call with Freya, he sat alone on the bed and took out the Chi Manipulation Technique book given to him by Jorge.
After a brief glance, he felt as if he had opened the door to a new world.
Because he realized that the reason why warriors were so powerful was not because they had any special qualities, but because they knew how to maximize their own strength.
According to Jorge, everyone has Chi within their bodies, some with stronger Chi and some with weaker Chi.
But most ordinary people don’t know how to use the Chi within their bodies, which is similar to many fantasy dramas Connor had watched.
The ancient martial arts he had encountered before were only superficial skills.
Because true ancient martial arts were all about controlling Chi.
The higher the realm of a warrior, the greater the Chi they could exert, and the more Chi they could store within their bodies.
After some hesitation, Connor felt that it was still early.
So he started to learn how to control the Chi within his body according to the methods in the Chi Manipulation Technique.
Currently, he was only at the beginner level of ancient martial arts, so as long as he could learn how to use and control the Chi within his body, it would be enough.
As for storing Chi, it was still a distant step for him.
He didn’t need to learn that now, and even if he did, he might not be able to understand it.
Following the methods in the Chi Manipulation Technique, Connor kept practicing and trying. In the blink of an eye, several hours had passed.
He looked at the sky outside, which was turning bright, and suddenly realized that it was already past four in the morning.
He took out his phone and glanced at it, discovering that Mina had called him several times, but he hadn’t heard the ringtone at all.
“It seems I was too focused during practice earlier, I didn’t even hear my phone ring!”
He sighed softly and then put away the breathing technique, lying down in bed to rest.
During the past few hours, he had gradually mastered the method of controlling his breath.
His learning speed was truly astonishing, thanks to the book on breathing techniques given to him by Jorge. It was also greatly influenced by Connor consuming the Essence Cultivating Pill. Otherwise, under normal circumstances, it would take an ordinary person several years to master the control of breath, and it could only be accomplished with the guidance of a martial artist.
…
The next day, in the morning around nine o’clock.
Because he slept late last night, Connor woke up slightly later than usual.
After waking up, he freshened up quickly and then left the room.
When he arrived at the square of the manor, he coincidentally ran into Louis, who had brought him here yesterday.
Louis had been thinking about the pill in Connor’s hand, so naturally, he was very excited to see Connor.
He hurriedly walked up to Connor and said with a smile, “How did you get in?”
“Well, I met a friend yesterday, and she brought me in…”
Connor casually replied while looking at Louis.
After hearing his words, Louis’s expression appeared somewhat awkward. He then said softly, “The Schooling family’s status has been declining year by year. It’s already become a mediocre small family. It’s already quite good for me to be able to participate in the martial artist exchange conference. So, yesterday, I really couldn’t bring you in…”
“It’s okay…”
Connor replied lightly to Louis because he could sense that Louis truly didn’t have the ability to do so.
Otherwise, he would have definitely brought Connor in.
After all, he still wanted to gain some benefits from him.
“Where did you obtain that pill?”
After hesitating for a moment, Louis asked Connor softly.
“I made it myself!”
Jorge had instructed Connor not to reveal their relationship. Connor felt that Jorge’s reminder wasn’t because he felt embarrassed, but for other reasons. So, he didn’t tell Louis the truth.
“You made it yourself?”
Louis was taken aback for a moment upon hearing Connor’s words. Then he helplessly said, “If you don’t want to tell me, you don’t have to, but there’s no need to lie. How could you, at such a young age, refine such excellent pills!”
Connor turned his head and glanced at Louis indifferently, without saying anything more because he didn’t want to dwell on this issue.
“How is this Warrior Conference arranged?”
After hesitating for a moment, Connor asked Louis softly.
After all, it was his first time participating in this so-called martial artist exchange conference, so he wasn’t very familiar with the specifics of the event. He didn’t even know where to go to exchange medicinal materials.

chapters.title: Chapter 1112: The World of Martial Artists
chapters.content:
Chapter 1112: The World of Martial Artists
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Louis couldn’t help but pause for a moment upon hearing Connor’s words.
Then he replied, “Well, it’s like this. The Warrior Conference is divided into two parts. The first three days are more free…”
“Everyone can communicate freely without any restrictions. So, most of the warriors who come to participate in this exchange conference take advantage of these days to trade things like medicinal herbs, elixirs, and some cultivation techniques. Then the next three days are dedicated to resolving personal grievances. The Malone family will step in to help mediate!”
“The Malone family is involved in these matters too?”
Connor’s eyes flashed with a hint of confusion upon hearing Louis’s words.
“Yes, of course. The Malone family has powerful martial artists, and they hold a high position in the martial world. Their mediation has proven to be quite effective!”
...
Louis nodded gently and continued, “Our world as warriors is different from the ordinary world. There are no laws here. It’s all about who has the strongest power and makes the final decisions. That’s why there are often cases of mutual killings among warriors, which eventually led to the establishment of this exchange conference!”
“Generally, if the Malone family can successfully mediate and satisfy both sides, a reconciliation can be achieved. But if someone disrespects the Malone family, the two parties will engage in a duel. Basically, someone dies here every year!”
“So, that’s how it is!”
Connor nodded thoughtfully. It was only now that he realized that the Malone family, to which Mina belonged, was not as simple as he had imagined. The Malone family must hold a significant position among the warriors.
However, he wasn’t particularly interested in personal grudges between warriors. He had come here to gather the medicinal herbs needed to refine the Reincarnation Pill. As for other matters, he had no interest at all.
“I came here mainly to collect some medicinal herbs. Can you take me to a place where I can trade medicinal herbs?”
After thinking for a moment, he softly asked Louis.
“Of course, I came here for elixirs as well. Just follow me. I know many people here, so it’ll save you a lot of trouble!”
Louis replied with a smile, and then he led Connor towards the main hall of the mansion.
A few minutes later, Connor finally arrived in the living room of the Warrior Conference with Louis.
At this moment, he truly witnessed the world of warriors. Originally, in his eyes, this group of people should be very rare.
But to his surprise, the hall was filled with so many warriors.
These warriors came from all over the country, and in fact, they didn’t look any different from ordinary people. Some were older, some were younger, and there were even several women among them. If these warriors were placed among ordinary people, it would be difficult to detect any difference. This experience truly broadened his horizons.
But what surprised him even more was that when these warriors gathered together, they weren’t discussing their own affairs as warriors. Instead, they were talking about how to make money or how their businesses were doing.
“Nowadays, most warriors don’t focus on martial arts anymore. Ordinary people usually use their abilities to create economic value. After all, sometimes it’s much easier for warriors to get things done than for ordinary people!”
Louis turned his head and sighed softly as he glanced at Connor.
“Do you also do business?”
Connor asked Louis.
“Heh, of course, but I only engage in small business. My company’s market value is only a few billion. It’s considered the lowest among these warriors…”
Louis replied to Connor helplessly.
After Connor heard his words, a trace of helplessness flashed in his eyes.
Because at this moment, he knew that the people gathered in the hall were not only warriors, but also a billionaire.
This also made him couldn’t help but sigh in his heart. When he inherited Steven’s inheritance, it seemed that rich people were becoming less valuable.
In the past, it was already very difficult for Connor to encounter a millionaire.
But now, billionaires and even multi-billionaires are basically everywhere.
“Louis, why did you come so late? I’ve been waiting for you all day. When should we go and have some fun? There’s a casino behind the mansion, the environment is nice, and there are also beautiful women…”
At this moment, a sleazy, greasy middle-aged man walked up to Louis and said with a smile.
“I came this time for the elixir. Let’s talk after I find it!”
Louis replied in a low voice.
“Alright…”
The middle-aged greasy man nodded, then instinctively glanced at Connor and asked in a puzzled tone, “Louis, who is this kid next to you? Is he from your family?”
Because Connor was young, the middle-aged man naturally didn’t associate him with a martial artist.
“This is Connor, my little brother. He came with me and wants to collect some medicinal materials!”
Louis quickly introduced Connor’s identity and then turned to Connor, saying, “Little brother, this is my friend, Salvador, also a martial artist!”
“Hello!”
Connor didn’t want to cause trouble this time, so he behaved very politely and greeted Salvador in a soft voice.
Salvador, on the other hand, seemed to be a bit familiar, walked directly in front of Connor, and then asked with a smile, “Where are you from?”
“I’m from Porthampton!”
Connor replied.
“Porthampton?”
After hearing the name of the place, Salvador couldn’t help but pause for a moment, then said softly, “I went to Porthampton recently. Do you know Kyle?”
“I’ve heard of him…”
Connor replied helplessly.
“I’m friends with Kyle. I also heard that there’s a very powerful figure in Porthampton, Kyle’s boss, someone called Mr. Connor. Do you know about him?”
Salvador continued to ask Connor.
“I don’t know…”
Connor looked at Salvador and shook his head with a sense of helplessness.
“Well, Porthampton is so big, it’s normal if you don’t know him…”
After seeing that Connor didn’t know Mr. Connor, Salvador instantly lost interest in him and began chatting with Louis about unrelated topics, such as gambling and where to find women.

chapters.title: Chapter 1113: Temira Yakes
chapters.content:
Chapter 1113: Temira Yakes
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Connor could tell that both Salvador and Louis were probably gamblers, otherwise Louis wouldn’t have ended up in such a miserable state.
At this Warrior Conference, Connor didn’t know anyone except Louis.
Moreover, the exchange meeting hadn’t officially started yet, and most people were just chatting.
So he had nothing to do and casually found a seat to sit down.
Taking advantage of this opportunity, Connor began to recall the cultivation method in the “Chi Manipulation Technique” and tried to control the Chi within his body.
After about an hour.
...
“The people from the Celestial Flower Valley and the Wes family are here…”
At that moment, a shout suddenly came from the crowd.
Upon hearing these words, everyone instantly stopped chatting and ran towards the entrance.
After all, these people had come for the Celestial Flower Valley and the Wes family. The Celestial Flower Valley had a lot of medicinal herbs, and the Wes family was skilled in alchemy, so both of them were of great help to the martial artists.
Connor wasn’t particularly interested in the Wes family because Jorge’s alchemy skills were even more impressive, and he didn’t need the Wes family’s help at all.
But he was very interested in the people from the Celestial Flower Valley, so he followed along to the entrance.
When he reached the entrance, he found that the first person to enter was none other than Mina’s cousin, Terry Malone.
Behind Terry were a man and a woman. The man was a bit older, around fifty years old, with a gentle and elegant appearance, giving off a fairy-like feeling.
The woman was quite young, about the same age as Connor. She wore a black dress and had a cold temperament, with a beautiful figure and face. Her eyes were also very strange. Connor had never seen such eyes before, giving off a poetic and picturesque feeling.
“That man is Mr. Wess from the Wes family. He’s an alchemist. If you need any pills, you can directly find him…”
Salvador smiled and said to Connor.
“Connor is here for medicinal herbs…”
Louis replied lightly, then pointed to the woman and said, “That woman is from the Celestial Flower Valley. She should be here on behalf of the Celestial Flower Valley. If you need any medicinal herbs, you can talk to her, but you’ll need to offer something of equal value in exchange…”
“Thank you!”
Connor nodded at Salvador and Louis.
At this moment, he finally saw the people from the Celestial Flower Valley.
Just then, Terry walked up to the crowd and said with a smile, “Thank you all, esteemed masters, for taking the time to attend this martial artist exchange conference organized by our Malone family. If there is any inadequate hospitality, I hope everyone can understand!”
“Terry is not simple!”
Salvador whispered in amazement after hearing Terry’s words.
Connor was also interested in Terry, so he asked softly, “Mr. Salvador, why do you say this person is not simple?”
“I heard that Terry has now taken control of most of the Malone family’s business. At less than thirty years old, he has taken over the Malone family. His future is limitless!” he replied casually.
Connor looked at Salvador and understood that he didn’t know much about Terry, so he didn’t say anything more.
And after a brief exchange of pleasantries with everyone, Terry spoke softly, “First of all, let me introduce this gentleman. He is Heath Wess, Mr. Wess from the Wess family. The Wess family is well-known to all of us in the country as a prestigious alchemy family. So, if anyone has any needs regarding elixirs, you can have a chat with Mr. Wess.”
“And this lady here is Miss Temira Yakes from the Celestial Flower Valley. I won’t go into much detail about the Celestial Flower Valley, as I believe most of you have heard of it. If anyone has any needs for medicinal herbs, you can approach Miss Temira.”
Upon hearing Terry’s words, the crowd gathered around Temira and Mr. Wess.
“Miss Temira, I need a century-old wood reishi mushrooms. I can exchange it with the elixirs I have in my hand…”
“Mr. Wess, I want to refine a Essence Cultivating Pill. What do you need in exchange?”
“Miss Temira, I wonder if you can provide me with a wild Anoectochilus…”
The martial artists present seemed like they had gone mad, eagerly vying for attention.
Meanwhile, Temira and Mr. Wess chose their trades based on what interested them the most.
Of course, not all the martial artists present came for Temira and Mr. Wess. Some wanted to sell their own items in exchange for what they needed. These individuals found an empty spot, displayed the items they wished to sell on the ground, and wrote down their desired items for trade, making it convenient for transactions.
Since this was the territory of the Malone family, the martial artists were cautious of their power and didn’t engage in any aggressive or thieving behavior. Everyone felt at ease.
Of course, the most sought-after items were elixirs. Almost every stall with elixirs was crowded, and the items offered for exchange were naturally rare and precious.
After hesitating for a moment, Connor followed suit like the others, found a random spot, and wrote a banner. He listed all the medicinal herbs that Ye Juechen needed on the banner and specifically mentioned the exchange using elixirs.
Some martial artists, finding that there were too many people around Mr. Wess and Temira, began strolling around the hall. Soon, someone noticed Connor’s banner.
Salvador was the first to approach Connor and asked with a surprised expression, “Do you have elixirs?”
“Yes…”
Connor nodded lightly.
“What kind of elixirs could you possibly have? Let me tell you, elixirs come in many varieties…”
Salvador believed that Connor, being young, couldn’t possess any good elixirs.
“Don’t worry, all my elixirs are top-grade. If you have the medicinal herbs I need, I can exchange them with you!”
Connor replied to Salvador.
Upon hearing this, he hesitated for a moment, then mysteriously took out a brocade box from his clothes and whispered to Connor, “Young man, I happen to have a thousand-year reishi mushrooms. I see that you also need it. How about you show me your elixirs? If I think they’re suitable, we can make the exchange. What do you think?”

chapters.title: Chapter 1114: Refuse To Sell
chapters.content:
Chapter 1114: Refuse To Sell
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
“Sure!”
Connor didn’t expect to come across the herb he needed so quickly.
Without any hesitation, he directly took out a pill and handed it to Salvador.
When the people around saw him taking out the pill, they all showed curious expressions.
Salvador took the pill with a mixture of belief and doubt, then brought it close to his nose and carefully sniffed it. Immediately, a shocked expression appeared on his face.
“Young man, where did you get this pill from?”
...
Salvador exclaimed with excitement towards Connor.
“The origin of this pill has nothing to do with you. Just say whether you want to exchange or not…” he replied calmly.
After hearing his words, Salvador hesitated for a moment and then hesitantly said, “Young man, this pill is indeed extraordinary, but I have never seen this kind of pill before. I don’t know its effects, so I can’t exchange with you. What if this pill is not what I need?”
“Yes, this pill looks promising, but nobody knows its specific effects!”
At this moment, everyone was curious about Connor’s pill, observing and wondering, but no one knew its true effects.
He felt helpless as well. After all, he himself wasn’t very clear about the effects of this pill.
He didn’t even know the name of this pill.
“If only I had asked the old man about it beforehand…” he couldn’t help but sigh in his heart.
At this time, more and more people gathered around Connor, all showing curiosity about his pill.
Temira and Mr. Wess also seemed curious about the situation here and walked directly toward Connor’s location.
When Mr. Wess saw the pill in Connor’s hand, a hint of surprise flashed in his eyes. He then said to Connor, “Young man, may I have a look at your pill?”
“Sure…” he replied indifferently.
Mr. Wess was an alchemist, so he naturally had a deep understanding of pills, far beyond ordinary people.
After receiving the pill, he carefully observed it and then brought it close to his nose to smell. His facial expression underwent a significant change.
“Young man, this is a top-grade pill!”
“A top-grade pill?”
After hearing his words, everyone was stunned in place, their expressions full of disbelief.
“Mr. Wess, are you joking?”
Salvador had never seen a genuine top-grade pill before, so his tone was skeptical when he asked Mr. Wess.
“As an alchemist, how could I possibly joke about this?”
Mr. Wess’s eyes showed a hint of displeasure in the face of Salvador’s doubt. He continued, “This pill should be a body-strengthening pill, greatly beneficial for enhancing a martial artist’s cultivation. Moreover, the alchemist’s skill is exceptional. This pill can definitely be considered a top-grade one!”
After he finished speaking, everyone present was in a state of shock.
They hadn’t expected Connor’s pill to be so astonishing. After all, top-grade pills were extremely rare. Even the alchemy families couldn’t guarantee their production.
“Young man, I’m willing to make an exchange with you. How about trading my reishi mushrooms for several pills?”
Salvador, upon learning that Connor’s pill was a top-grade one, naturally became extremely excited. He quickly shouted towards Connor.
Connor glanced at Salvador and calmly said, “Two pills in exchange.”
Upon hearing his words, Salvador’s expression seemed to show some difficulty.
After all, this was a thousand-year-old reishi mushrooms. Now that he could only exchange it for two medicinal pills, he was clearly at a disadvantage.
And Connor didn’t know how many pills would be appropriate for the exchange. He just casually mentioned a number.
“Can you give me one more?”
Salvador looked at Connor and asked.
“No…”
Connor didn’t hesitate at all and shook his head directly.
At this moment, he was clearly testing Salvador. Only then could he know the true value of his pills.
When he exchanges with others, he can make a better offer.
Although he had at least fifty of these pills, all given to him by Jorge.
Now he has realized the value of these pills. When facing ordinary people, money is definitely the most effective thing.
But when facing these martial artists, he feels that the pills are more useful.
So he plans to keep some pills for future use.
After hesitating for a few seconds, Salvador gritted his teeth and nodded, saying, “Alright, just two pills, deal!”
After speaking, Salvador took out his medicine box and handed it to Connor. After inspecting the medicine box, Connor turned to Mr. Wess and said, “Sir, could you please check if this reishi mushrooms is a thousand years old?”
Mr. Wess took the reishi mushrooms and carefully examined it, then nodded and said, “Yes, it is indeed a thousand-year-old wild reishi mushrooms…”
“Great!”
Connor nodded and then handed two pills to Salvador.
Salvador looked at the pills in his hand, his expression still very excited.
“Brother, how can I buy these pills? I can pay, how about five million for one?”
Just at that moment, a middle-aged man shouted at the top of his voice.
“Just now, Salvador used a thousand-year-old reishi mushrooms to exchange for two pills. That reishi mushrooms is worth at least twenty million, I’ll add another five million…”
“I’ll offer twenty million, I’ll take as many as you have!”
The crowd shouted at Connor with extremely excited expressions.
“No, I came here to exchange for medicinal materials. Without medicinal materials, no matter how much money you offer, I won’t exchange!”
Connor replied expressionlessly.
“What about fifty million?”
A man in a suit shouted at Connor with great excitement.
“No…”
Without hesitation, he shook his head directly.
After seeing his resolute attitude, a hint of helplessness flashed in the eyes of the crowd.
Because they could feel that he really didn’t lack money, and money couldn’t move him at all.
After a while, the people around him began to decrease.
After all, the medicinal materials required for refining the Soul Returning Pill were all top-grade medicinal materials.
And these martial artists didn’t have these medicinal materials at all, even though they were very eager for Connor’s pills.
But without the medicinal materials, it was all in vain, and in the end, they could only leave helplessly.

chapters.title: Chapter 1115: A Tempting Condition
chapters.content:
Chapter 1115: A Tempting Condition
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Although the people surrounding Connor gradually decreased, he still managed to collect a considerable amount of medicinal herbs.
After all, there were so many martial artists present, and even if many people couldn’t provide the herbs he needed.
But there were still a few individuals who could provide the herbs he needed.
He would then trade with them based on the value of the herbs they provided.
Of course, before each transaction, Connor would have Mr. Wess appraise them.
After all, in his eyes, all these medicinal herbs looked exactly the same, and he couldn’t tell their age.
...
In the blink of an eye, two hours had passed.
He took a brief look at the medicinal herbs in his hand. His harvest this morning was quite good.
He had already gathered most of the more than ten types of herbs required for the Soul Returning Pill, and now he only had three herbs left to find.
Of course, these three herbs were all extremely rare.
Especially the two-thousand-year-old reishi mushrooms, it shocked everyone.
After all, a thousand-year-old reishi mushrooms mushroom was already extremely rare, and a two-thousand-year-old one was unheard of.
All the martial artists knew how demanding Connor’s requirements were, and they couldn’t provide these herbs. Naturally, they didn’t pay any attention to him.
But he wasn’t in a hurry because he knew he still had two more days. He had already found most of the herbs on the first day, and he could slowly find the remaining three herbs.
“Young man, how did your herb collection go?”
At that moment, Mr. Wess walked up to Connor and asked with a smile.
“I’ve collected most of them, but I’m still missing three herbs…”
Connor replied with a smile.
After all, he had been bothering Mr. Wess to appraise the herbs, so he had a good attitude towards him.
“Let me see which three herbs you still need…”
Mr. Wess looked up at the banner in front of Connor and muttered softly, “Two-thousand-year-old flesh reishi mushrooms, one-thousand-year-old saussurea involucrata, and eight-hundred-year-old tuber fleeceflower…”
“Hahaha…”
After seeing the names of these herbs, Mr. Wess burst into laughter.
Connor looked somewhat puzzled and asked, “Why are you laughing?”
“Young man, I think you shouldn’t waste your time here. You should go back quickly!”
“Why?”
Connor asked in surprise.
“I’ll tell you, these three herbs you need are the best of the best. There are very few people in the whole Oprana who can provide these herbs, and even if they can, they wouldn’t be interested in your pill. So if you stay here, you’re just wasting your time…”
Mr. Wess said straightforwardly.
Upon hearing Mr. Wess’s words, Connor’s eyes flashed with helplessness.
Actually, he could also feel that these three herbs were indeed rare. No matter who saw them, they would think he was crazy.
Although his pills were excellent, they were only targeted at ordinary martial artists.
For ordinary martial artists, his pills were indeed very good, but they couldn’t provide the three herbs he needed.
And the martial artists who could provide these three herbs were not interested in his pills.
“I knew this old man wouldn’t be so kind…”
Connor couldn’t help but sigh inwardly.
“Young man, do you really want these three herbs?”
At that moment, Mr. Wess looked at Connor and asked.
“Of course…”
Connor nodded quickly.
And Mr. Wess hesitated for two seconds as he looked at Connor. Then, he softly said, “How about we make a deal?”
“A deal?” Connor paused when he heard Mr. Wess’s words, furrowed his brow, and asked, “What kind of deal?”
“It’s very simple. I can give you these three medicinal ingredients, but in return, you have to tell me the method of refining the pill…” Mr. Wess said with a smile.
Although Connor’s medicinal ingredients were indeed not enough to exchange for the ones he needed, it would be different if it involved the method of refining the pills. The Wess family, where Mr. Wess belonged, currently had no way to refine the kind of pill Connor had in his hands. However, once they mastered the method of refining pills, they could produce them in large quantities. At that time, the value of this pill would be immeasurable, far surpassing the medicinal ingredients Connor needed.
“Well…” Connor’s expression seemed hesitant.
“I know this pill wasn’t refined by you, but since the other party can give you so many pills, your relationship must be extraordinary. Little brother, you can discuss it with your family!” Mr. Wess continued speaking, seemingly aware of Connor’s hesitation.
“Young man, our Celestial Flower Valley also has the medicinal ingredients you need. If you’re willing, we can also make a trade with you. And it’s not just the medicinal ingredients you need right now; we can provide other medicinal ingredients as well, as long as you provide the method of pill refinement!” Mr. Wess said.
However, at that moment, a voice sounded in Connor’s ear.
After hearing this voice, Connor instinctively turned his head and saw that the speaker was none other than Temira from Celestial Flower Valley.
Upon hearing Temira’s words, Mr. Wess’s face instantly changed, and he stared at her, exclaiming, “Miss Temira, what do you mean by this? This young man has already agreed to trade with me. What are you trying to do?”
“Mr. Wess, it seems that Connor hasn’t agreed to your proposal, right?” Temira couldn’t help but sneer and continued, “We’re currently competing fairly. Whoever offers a higher price, Connor will cooperate with them!”
“Miss Temira, are you trying to provoke a conflict with my Wess family?” Mr. Wess shouted, his emotions running high.
“Mr. Wess, you’re taking it too seriously. I didn’t mean that!” Temira said with a smile.
As Connor looked at the two people in front of him, his expression was filled with helplessness because he didn’t know the method of pill refinement. Moreover, according to Jorge’s requirements, Connor couldn’t reveal their relationship, and Jorge definitely wouldn’t provide the method of pill refinement.
Therefore, no matter how tempting the conditions they offered, Connor had no way to agree.

chapters.title: Chapter 1116: Have You Thought It Over?
chapters.content:
Chapter 1116: Have You Thought It Over?
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Things like medicinal pills were still very important to martial artists.
Now that it was the Age of Chaos, there were fewer and fewer alchemists who could refine pills. Many ancient pill refining methods were gradually lost to time, so being able to obtain a new pill refining method was a valuable thing indeed
The reason why the Wess family had been able to prosper for so many years was because the Wess family had mastered many alchemy methods.
Although Celestial Flower Valley was famous for its medicinal herbs, it also had its own alchemists. It was just that Celestial Flower Valley would not sell pills to the outside world.
At this time, Master Wess and Temira seemed to have taken a fancy to the value of the pills in Connor’s hands. That was why the two of them immediately shed all pretenses of cordiality to obtain the alchemy method from Connor.
But the unfortunate thing was that Connor did not know the method to refine this kind of medicinal pill at all.
...
Terry, who was not far away, seemed to have noticed the situation here. A strange emotion flashed across his eyes.
He narrowed his eyes and looked at Connor. No one knew what he was thinking.
“Good sir, as long as you can give me the method to refine the pill, no matter what the condition is, as long as it’s within our Wess family’s ability, I’ll definitely agree to it!”
Master Wess shouted excitedly at Connor.
Temira didn’t want to be outdone. “Mr. McDonald, if you choose to cooperate with our Celestial Flower Valley, you can choose all the medicinal ingredients in our Celestial Flower Valley. Moreover, I can also open our Scripture Depository to you. There are many medical books and pill refinement techniques that cannot be found outside…”
After everyone heard Master Wess and Temira’s words, they all revealed excited expressions.
They never expected that the Wess family and Celestial Flower Valley would offer Connor such a shocking condition.
Such an opportunity was something that many people would not even dare to dream of, so those people present could not help but envy Connor in their hearts.
If the Celestial Flower Valley and the Wess family had offered them such conditions, they would have agreed without hesitation.
“So what do you think? Do you want to cooperate with me or Celestial Flower Valley?”
After Master Wess saw that Connor didn’t speak for a long time, the expression on his face seemed to be a little anxious. He asked excitedly.
A trace of helplessness flashed across Connor’s eyes. He wanted to open his mouth to reject the two people’s requests.
Connor knew very well that Jorge didn’t want to expose his identity. If Connor really exposed Jorge’s identity, Jorge wouldn’t help Connor refine the Soul Returning Pill in a moment of desperation. Then, even if Connor obtained these medicinal herbs, it would be useless!
However, at this moment, Terry walked in front of Connor and said calmly, “Connor, if you’re willing to give us the method to refine this pill, we can help you find these three herbs. I can also give you 3% of our shares. Lastly, I can promise that no matter what trouble you encounter in the future, we will help you solve it. What do you think of this condition?”
When everyone heard Terry’s words, they were all stunned on the spot, shock on their faces.
No one had expected Terry to offer Connor such generous conditions.
Even Temira and Master Wess were shocked.
The Malone family was the largest family in Tayton. Whether it was in the ancient martial arts world or the business world, they had influence that ordinary people could not imagine. What was even more terrifying was that the Malone family had many companies. The market value had long exceeded 10 billion, so Terry had immediately promised Connor billions.
At the most crucial moment, Terry actually said that no matter what trouble Connor encountered in the future, the Malone family would help solve it. This condition was really too tempting.
Everyone felt that Connor could no longer find any reason to reject Terry.
After Temira and Master Wess heard Terry’s conditions, they immediately revealed helpless expressions.
In their hearts, they clearly knew that the conditions were too tempting, and they had no way to match those conditions.
Therefore, the two of them could only look at Connor and wait for his choice.
Terry also knew what his conditions meant, so he was still very confident. He felt that as long as Connor wasn’t a fool, he would choose him.
“My apologies, I do not know the method to refine the medicinal pill…”
At this moment, Connor suddenly said.
“Connor, I know you didn’t refine these pills, but the relationship between the person who refined the pills and you is definitely not simple, so you can go back and discuss it with him!” Terry quickly said.
“There’s no need to discuss it. It’s impossible for him to agree!”
Connor shook his head helplessly and continued, “If you want to exchange those three medicinal herbs for these medicinal pills, I welcome it. However, if it’s any other condition, then forget it!”
After everyone heard Connor’s words, their expressions were extremely incredulous. This was because they had never expected Connor to reject Terry’s request. After all, such an opportunity was a once-in-a-century opportunity.
Even Master Wess and Temira were shocked.
Terry seemed to be a little unwilling to acquiesce, so he took a step forward and asked softly, “Connor, have you really thought it through?”
“Of course I’ve thought it through. You don’t have to waste your breath on this matter!” Connor replied indifferently.
Terry looked at Connor. Although there was no expression on his face, he was very angry inwardly. After all, this was the first time someone dared to reject him so directly. Terry would not allow this to happen.
However, he also knew that he couldn’t do anything to Connor now, so after hesitating for a moment, he smiled faintly and said softly, “Since you’ve already thought it through, I won’t say anything else. However, the thing I promised you just now has always been effective. If you ever change your mind, you can come and find me directly…”
“Alright…”
Connor nodded lightly.
Without any hesitation, Terry turned around and left.
Temira and Master Wess naturally felt very regretful. After all, Connor didn’t even agree to the Malone family’s conditions, so there was no need to mention their own conditions. As for the pills in Connor’s hands, they had no value to them at all. Therefore, after hesitating for a moment, they turned around and left.

chapters.title: Chapter 1117: A Kind Reminder
chapters.content:
Chapter 1117: A Kind Reminder
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Connor was not interested in the conditions that Terry had proposed.
After all, what Connor did not lack the most now was money. If he could use money to exchange for these three medicinal herbs, he was willing to take out a few billion!
Jorge had also told Connor that if he couldn’t collect the herbs here, he could go directly to the Celestial Flower Valley.
Now that Connor had found Temira of the Celestial Flower Valley, Connor only needed to follow her.
Therefore, Connor did not need to make a deal with them at all.
“It seems that the old man has already thought this would happen!”
...
Connor could not help but sigh softly.
“Young man…”
At this moment, a middle-aged man walked up to Connor and called out softly.
“What’s wrong?” Connor looked up at the middle-aged man and asked in confusion.
“I think you should hurry up and leave this place…”
The middle-aged man kindly said to him.
“Leave this place?” After Connor heard the middle-aged man’s words, he couldn’t help but be stunned for a moment. Then, he asked in a puzzled tone, “Why should I leave this place?”
“It’s like this. You might not know Terry Malone. But since you offended Terry today, he will definitely not let you off, so you’re in great danger now,” the middle-aged man said softly.
“Haha…”
Connor couldn’t help but laugh when he heard this. Then, he took out a pill from his clothes and handed it to the middle-aged man, saying softly, “Thank you for your reminder…”
The middle-aged man looked at Connor with an unusually excited gaze. He hurriedly took the medicinal pill, then turned around and left.
For the Malone family to be able to reach this point, they had to go through countless bloody storms to be able to stand firm today.
Therefore, all the warriors present knew the Malone family’s methods.
Connor was not a martial artist, and he held such a precious pill in his hands. The Malone family naturally would not let Connor off so easily.
Not far away, Louis looked at Connor and could not help but sigh softly. No one knew what he was thinking.
The afternoon passed quickly.
Connor still had not collected the last three medicinal herbs. After hesitating for a moment, Connor packed up his things and prepared to leave.
At this moment, all the martial artists present looked at Connor with a strange gaze. After all, they already knew what might happen next.
Connor naturally didn’t care about these things. After all, he had the pill Jorge gave him. After eating the pill, his strength would be comparable to a Mystic class fighter. He wasn’t afraid of these tricks.
Connor had just left the trading hall when he received a call from Mina.
“Hello?”
“Connor, where are you? Why didn’t I see you when I went to your room?” Mina asked anxiously.
“I’m at the manor’s main hall…”
Connor said with a smile.
“You scared me to death. I thought you were chased out or that something happened. Stand there and wait for me. I’ll go find you now!”
After knowing that Connor was fine, Mina heaved a long sigh of relief and hung up the phone.
Meanwhile, Connor put down his phone and waited quietly.
A few minutes later, Mina and Quorra rushed to Connor’s side.
“Connor, you almost scared Mina to death just now. The two of us thought that you were killed by these martial artists…”
Quorra shouted excitedly at Connor.
Connor smiled helplessly when he heard Quorra’s words. Then, he said lightly, “It’s not as evil as you say. Do they still dare to kill people casually?”
“Geez, you don’t know these martial artists. They are all very powerful. Killing people is also very normal to them!” Quorra said casually.
Mina raised her head and looked at Connor, then softly said, “Connor, you are not familiar with the situation in Tayton. These martial artists are really very dangerous. You must be careful…”
“I understand…”
Connor nodded gently. Because he knew that Mina was concerned about him, Connor didn’t say anything.
“Alright, are you hungry? Let’s go out and eat something!”
Mina asked.
“Alright…”
Connor nodded.
Although the manor also had its own restaurant, the food was not very delicious, so Mina planned for them to eat something outside the manor.
Connor naturally wouldn’t reject Mina’s good intentions, so he followed her and Quorra out of the manor.
“Connor, let me tell you, we saw two martial artists fighting today. Those two martial artists were really too powerful. It was like watching a martial arts drama…” Quorra said as she walked.
“Is that so?”
Connor asked with a smile.
When Quorra saw Connor’s calm reaction, a hint of helplessness flashed across her eyes. She pouted and said, “Forget it. You won’t know what happened even if I tell you this now. You will only understand these things after seeing them with your own eyes…”
Connor looked at Quorra with a faint smile and didn’t say anything.
Mina looked at Connor and said softly, “Connor, how long do you plan to stay here?”
“Probably until the end of the Martial Artist Convention…” Connor replied after thinking for a moment.
“You actually want to stay for so long?” Mina couldn’t help but exclaim when she heard Connor’s words.
A trace of helplessness flashed across Connor’s eyes, and then he said indifferently, “You don’t seem to want me to stay here!”
“I didn’t mean that. I just feel that it’s too dangerous here. If you encounter any trouble, don’t get into a conflict with these people. You have to call me immediately, understand?”
Mina said worriedly.
“I understand…”
Connor nodded lightly.
“Although I do not have much status in the Malone family, my relationship with Terry is still very good. If you encounter any trouble, I can ask him for help…”
Mina said.
Connor smiled helplessly. He could not help but sigh in his heart that his biggest problem now might be Terry.
“Mina, your cousin is really too handsome…”
Quorra suddenly sighed.
“Handsome, but so what? He already has a girlfriend…” Mina said helplessly.
“Sigh, it’s really a pity…”
Quorra sighed helplessly and didn’t say anything else.

chapters.title: Chapter 1118: Uninvited Guests
chapters.content:
Chapter 1118: Uninvited Guests
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
A few minutes later, Mina brought Connor to a restaurant.
Connor and Mina had not seen each other for more than half a year. In addition, Quorra had always been very talkative, so the three of them got along quite well.
Mina didn’t know why she suddenly felt like drinking, so she ordered a few bottles of beer. The three of them drank as they chatted.
During this period, Mina asked Connor about many things that had happened after she left Porthampton, which Connor just casually found some excuses to brush it off.
“I didn’t expect Connor to be the CeeM…”
Mina couldn’t help but sigh.
...
“Actually, I didn’t want to expose my identity back then, but when I saw you being bullied by others, I impulsively sent you so many bits. I didn’t expect that my account would be hacked later. Moreover, to get close to you, the hacker disguised himself as me. I explained it to you, but you didn’t believe me…” Connor said helplessly to Mina.
“At that time, you were so poor that you couldn’t even pay your rent. Moreover, you went out to work and study every day. How could I believe that you were a tycoon on the Internet who could spend millions?” Mina said speechlessly.
“Millions?”
Quorra was dumbfounded when she heard Mina’s words. Her face was filled with disbelief.
Although Quorra knew that Connor had given Mina a lot of bits, she never thought that Connor would have given Mina so much money.
“That’s right. Back then, Connor gave me a few million dollars!”
Mina nodded lightly.
