Quorra looked at Connor from head to toe, then asked him in disbelief, “Connor, you’re actually so rich?”
“I’m not particularly rich…” Connor replied indifferently.
“You’ve already tipped Mina so much money, yet you’re still saying that you’re not particularly rich?” Quorra shouted excitedly and continued, “Connor, why don’t I go livestream too? I’ll give you a personal stream so that when the time comes, you can also give me some bits. What kind of livestream do you like? Pure or sexy? I’m fine with either…”
“…”
Connor looked at Quorra helplessly, not knowing what to say.
“Quorra, don’t mess around…” Mina glared at Quorra and shouted.
“Come on, I was just joking with Connor. I didn’t really ask him to tip me…” Quorra hurriedly explained.
Mina raised her head and looked at Connor before asking him softly, “Connor, how are you doing with your fiancée now?”
“I came here this time for my fiancée. She’s lost her memory. As long as I can find those herbs, I can help her recover her memory!” Connor whispered to Mina.
“So that’s how it is!” Mina nodded, but didn’t say anything else.
Connor chatted with Quorra for a while. Seeing that it was almost time, Mina stood up and paid the bill before leading Connor and Quorra back to the manor.
In fact, Connor and the others were not very far from the manor. It was at most a ten-minute journey. However, because it was close to dawn, there were very few people on the road, which was strange.
Mina also sensed that something was wrong. She couldn’t help but whisper, “Quorra, don’t you feel that something is wrong today?”
Quorra frowned when she heard Mina’s words. She asked in a low voice, “What’s wrong?”
“I feel that this place is too quiet…”
Mina said softly.
Quorra hesitated for a moment, then nodded. “If you didn’t say it, I wouldn’t have realized that this place is really quiet. Usually, the two of us take this road, but it doesn’t seem to be so quiet. Moreover, there are especially few people today…”
“There should be someone waiting for me up ahead!” Connor suddenly said.
“Someone waiting for you?”
Mina couldn’t help but be stunned when she heard Connor’s words. The expression on her face was somewhat puzzled, as if she didn’t quite understand what Connor meant.
“That’s right, someone is waiting for me!”
Connor nodded lightly.
Because Connor had practiced the Chi Manipulation Art, he could now hear the aura within a radius of 100 meters. As long as there were martial artists around him, Connor could discover them. Even if the other party had a large number of people on their side, Connor could quickly detect the other party’s exact location.
“Who is it?”
Mina frowned and asked.
“You will know soon…” Connor replied indifferently.
At this moment, Connor’s expression was still calm because he knew that the person waiting for him was not very strong, so he should be able to handle it. Even if he couldn’t, Connor could use the pills that Jorge gave him.
“Connor, looks like you’ve discovered us!”
At this moment, a young man walked out from the forest by the roadside.
When Mina and Quorra saw this young man, they were surprised. They didn’t know where this young man came from.
Connor knew this young man because he had traded a medicinal herb with Connor before. Moreover, at that time, he was dissatisfied with Connor because Connor only bid for one medicinal pill, but in the end, he still traded with Connor.
“Your name is Yadiel Camidge, right?”
Connor asked the young man in a low voice.
“That’s right, I’m Yadiel Camidge!”
The young man nodded.
“You should not have come alone. Call out all your helpers. There is no need to hide…”
Connor said calmly.
“Haha…”
The young man couldn’t help but laugh out loud. Then, he shouted in a low voice, “Alright, all of you can come out. Connor has already discovered all of you…”
After Yadiel finished speaking, the three of them walked out of the forest.
Among these three people, one of them had also made a deal with Connor. As for the other two, Connor was even more familiar with them. One was Louis Schooling, and the other was Salvador Mabins.
When Mina saw these people, her expression was very puzzled.
She couldn’t help but turn her head to look at Connor and ask, “Connor, what’s going on?”
“If we fight later, the two of you must remember to stand behind me…”
Connor whispered to Mina.

chapters.title: Chapter 1119: Survival of The Fittest
chapters.content:
Chapter 1119: Survival of The Fittest
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
After Mina heard Connor’s words, she couldn’t help but be stunned for a moment. A strange expression flashed across her face.
At this moment, Mina realized what was going to happen next.
Quorra didn’t know what was going on. She pretended to be calm and asked Mina in a low voice, “Are these people trying to rob us?”
“It might not be as simple as robbing money…”
Mina said expressionlessly.
Quorra froze on the spot after hearing Mina’s words. She looked extremely nervous and could not help but tremble slightly. After all, she was just an ordinary girl and had never experienced such a thing. She did not know what would happen next.
...
However, Quorra could tell that Louis and the others were not good people when she saw their vicious expressions.
At this moment, Salvador shouted, “Connor, I don’t want to make things difficult for you, but the pills in your hands are too tempting for us. So if you hand over all of them, we might let you go!”
“That’s right. As long as you are willing to hand over the medicinal pills, nothing will happen. However, you have to return our medicinal ingredients as well…” Yadiel chimed in.
After Mina heard their words, she knew that Connor must’ve had some conflict with these people.
So after hesitating for two seconds, she shouted expressionlessly, “I’m a member of the Malone family. I don’t care what you want to do, and I don’t care what conflict you have with Connor. Now, all of you get lost. Otherwise, the Malone family will never let you off…”
At this moment, Mina could only use her identity as a Malone family member to scare Louis and the others.
However, after Louis heard Mina’s words, he did not show any fear at all. The others also had indifferent expressions.
“You don’t believe that I’m from the Malone family?”
Mina was stunned when she saw Louis and the others ‘reaction. She frowned and shouted.
“Haha…”
Louis laughed loudly and shouted at Mina, “Of course I know you’re from the Malone family. I know your situation very well. Your father is just a side branch of the Malone family. He doesn’t have any power in the family at all. Would we offend Terry Malone just because of you?”
After Mina heard Louis’s words, the expression on her face instantly changed, and her body could not help but tremble. After all, Mina felt that her biggest trump card was her identity as a member of the Malone family.
However, she did not expect Louis and the rest to know her identity so well.
“Moreover, even if we attack you, what can you do? This place is so remote that no one knows that we were the ones who did it. Little girl, don’t try to threaten us here. Since we dare to come here, we’re not afraid of you!” Salvador declared.
Mina looked at Louis, Salvador, and the others, completely dumbfounded. She knew that she could not scare these people at all.
Connor hesitated for a moment, then stepped forward and said expressionlessly, “Louis and Salvador, actually, the two of you don’t have to be like this. As long as you help me do something, I will give you a single pill less than you deserve…”
“Haha…”
Louis sneered and said in a low voice, “Connor, what are the pills you gave me enough for? Moreover, you’re not a martial artist at all, but you have such a precious top-grade medicinal pill on you. Now, I don’t know how many people have their eyes on you, but it’s just that they’re timid and don’t dare to make a move on you yet. Once the Martial Artist Convention is over, they will definitely make a move on you. Rather than waiting until then, it’s better for us to make the first move!”
After a moment of hesitation, Quorra opened her big watery eyes and shouted at Louis with an excited expression. “This is robbery, it’s illegal!”
“Hahaha…”
Louis burst into laughter when he heard Quorra’s words. Then, he looked at Quorra. “Little girl, in the world of us martial artists, there is no such thing as law. We follow the law of the jungle. Whoever has the strongest fist has the final say. I don’t care about the law or not…”
“You…”
After hearing Louis’s words, Quorra was completely speechless. She stood rooted to the ground, not knowing what to say.
“Connor, you and I can be considered acquaintances. I do not wish to make things difficult for you. As long as you hand over the medicinal pill, I can spare your life…” Louis said expressionlessly.
“What if I don’t?”
Connor asked indifferently.
“If you don’t hand over the medicinal pill, then don’t blame me for being impolite!” Louis shouted with his eyes wide open.
“Louis, why are you wasting your breath with this kid? Can’t we just kill him and snatch the medicinal pill? If we continue to drag this out, it will be troublesome once we are discovered…” Yadiel frowned and shouted with a frustrated expression.
“That’s right, hurry up and do it!”
At this moment, Salvador shouted as well, before looking at Mina with a wretched expression.
Mina saw that Salvador’s gaze was not quite right and hurriedly took two steps back, hiding behind Connor.
“Oh right, when you attack later, be careful. These two women are not bad looking, especially this eldest daughter of the Malone family. I want to enjoy them later…”
Salvador turned his head and said to Louis and the rest.
“…”
Quorra was dumbfounded by Salvador’s words, and her body trembled uncontrollably.
She stuttered as she asked Mina, “Mina, quickly think of something. What should we do?”
“I…”
Mina was also very afraid now. Although she knew that Connor’s skills were not bad, that was only when compared to ordinary people. If he were to face these martial artists, Connor probably would not even have the ability to retaliate!
After a moment of hesitation, Mina took out her phone and prepared to call Terry.
However, the moment Mina took out her phone, Yadiel’s eyes and hands moved quickly. With a flick of his right hand, a stone flew towards Mina’s phone.
“Pa!”
A crisp sound rang out.
The stone hit Mina’s phone with extreme precision, shattering it into pieces.
Mina looked at the broken phone in her hand with an expression of extreme despair. Her legs were trembling non-stop.
At this moment, Mina could not think of anyone else who could save them.

chapters.title: Chapter 1120: Fight!
chapters.content:
Chapter 1120: Fight!
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Connor sized up Louis and the rest. He knew that he was no match for them—after all, he had only just entered the sect and could not be considered a true martial artist.
Louis and the others might have already reached the middle stage of the golden class, or even higher.
“Hah…”
Connor took a deep breath and took out the pill Jorge gave him from his pocket.
“I hope the old man is not lying to me this time…” Connor sighed softly, then directly threw the medicinal pill into his mouth.
In the next second, Connor felt an extremely powerful force surge into his body. It was terrifying. Connor could even feel his heartbeat suddenly soar, and the speed of his blood flow also began to accelerate.
...
Connor took a moment to adjust to the effects before saying to Louis expressionlessly, “Louis, it’s not too late for you to regret it now!”
“Why do you spout so much nonsense? We have so many martial artists, how could we not defeat an ordinary person like you?”
Yadiel was already impatient. He shouted at Connor and flicked his hand without saying anything.
A cold light flashed, and a dagger shot towards Connor’s right leg.
If he didn’t consume this medicinal pill, Connor definitely wouldn’t have been able to dodge this dagger; after all, Yadiel was also a martial artist. His speed and strength were not something that ordinary people could compare to.
Compared to ordinary people, Connor might have a huge advantage in speed and strength, but in front of these martial artists, his advantages were completely gone.
However, Connor now had the speed and strength of a Black-rank, allowing him to easily dodge the dagger.
When Yadiel saw this, a trace of shock flashed across his eyes.
He thought that Connor was just an ordinary person. How could he possibly dodge his dagger?
Moreover, Yadiel had attacked very suddenly just now, and his speed was also very shocking.
Even Louis and the others might not be able to react in time, but Connor had actually dodged it directly. This made Yadiel feel like the situation was somewhat inconceivable.
A bad thought flashed across Louis’s mind as he frowned and shouted, “How did this kid dodge it?”
“It should be a coincidence!” Salvador replied casually before continuing, “Alright, let’s not be careless. Let’s attack together…”
“Alright…”
At this moment, Louis also had a bad feeling in his heart, so he did not dare to continue talking nonsense.
“It’s over, these people are going to attack Connor. Connor is definitely not a match for them. Mina, quickly think of a way!”
Quorra shouted excitedly.
Mina also looked helpless when she heard Quorra’s words. She frowned and said, “What can I do now? These people are all martial artists. Moreover, I can’t contact Terry now…”
Mina was more worried about Connor than anyone else. After all, she was a member of the Malone family, so she naturally knew how terrifying a martial artist was.
As an ordinary person, it was absolutely impossible for Connor to be a match for these martial artists.
“What should we do!” Quorra was on the verge of tears, but she couldn’t think of any way to survive.
Mina had never thought that she would encounter such a big problem when she met Connor again. If she had known this would happen, she would never have brought Connor into the manor.
But at this moment, Connor’s face was calm because he knew that these people were not his match at all.
At this moment, Salvador was the first to charge forward.
Like Connor, Salvador was learning fist techniques. However, Salvador’s fist technique was not on the same level as Connor’s fist technique. The Seven Star Big Dipper Fist was a top fist technique in the ancient martial arts world, while Salvador was only learning a very ordinary fist technique.
Although Salvador’s fist technique was ordinary, he had spent so many years painstakingly studying it, which resulted in his fist technique being extremely powerful.
Salvador’s body was like a bolt of lightning, directly charging towards Connor so quickly that the sound of thunder could be heard. Its power was extremely shocking.
When Louis saw Salvador’s punch, he could not help but think, “I didn’t expect Salvador’s fist technique to be so pure. Even I might not be able to take this punch!”
“That’s right, Salvador has improved a lot these few years!” The other middle-aged man, Lance, also nodded lightly.
In their eyes, Connor definitely wouldn’t be able to receive this punch from Salvador.
But at this moment, Connor suddenly roared, “Seven Stars Big Dipper Fist, Dragon Roar!”
After saying this, Connor suddenly punched out.
“Bang!”
Connor’s fist and Salvador’s fist collided fiercely.
In an instant, Salvador was completely dumbfounded, his expression one of utmost shock.
His fist had hit Connor’s, but Connor did not react at all. On the contrary, Salvador had suffered a very large impact. His entire arm seemed to have been broken, and he could not use any strength at all.
“What’s going on?”
Salvador looked at Connor in front of him, flabbergasted. He really couldn’t understand how Connor did it.
Louis and the rest were also dumbfounded. They looked at Connor and Salvador with shock on their faces.
Just as everyone was shocked, Connor raised his fist again and shouted in a low voice, “Tiger Roar!”
After Connor shouted this sentence, his fist smashed against Salvador’s chest.
Salvador was still in a state of shock earlier, so he did not have the time to react at all before Connor’s fist smashed into his chest.
“Ah…”
Salvador let out a miserable cry before he was sent flying backwards, smashing heavily onto the ground.
After Salvador landed on the ground, he spat out a mouthful of blood and fainted on the spot.
Connor’s punch had directly broken three of Salvador’s ribs. No matter how strong Salvador was, he was still a mortal. His ribs were broken, and it was already a blessing that he did not die on the spot.
“Connor is actually so powerful?”
When Lance saw this scene, he was instantly dumbfounded. His eyes widened, and he did not know how to describe his feelings.
When everyone saw Connor send Salvador flying with a single punch, they were all stunned on the spot, their expressions extremely incredulous.
“How can this Connor be so powerful?” Louis could not help but think.

chapters.title: Chapter 1121: Black Rank Martial Artist
chapters.content:
Chapter 1121: Black Rank Martial Artist
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Salvador and the others had similar strength.
Although they weren’t the strongest among the martial artists, and were still far from black, not everyone could deal with them.
But at this moment, Salvador actually couldn’t even take a single punch from Connor. One could imagine how great the difference in strength between these two people was!
“Louis, what exactly is going on?”
Lance finally realized that something was wrong. He glared at Louis with an angry expression.
“I don’t f*cking know what’s going on either…”
...
Louis replied exasperatedly.
If he knew that Connor’s strength was so terrifying, then even if he was given a hundred guts, he would not dare to make a move on Connor!
“This brat is quite capable. I will not interfere in this matter of yours…”
At this moment, Lance already had the intention to retreat. He turned around and was about to leave.
Seeing that Lance wanted to leave, Connor smiled cheekily. He smiled faintly and said, “It might be too late to leave now…”
After saying this, Connor rushed toward Lance.
When Lance sensed the aura in Connor’s body, his expression changed instantly. He hurriedly took two steps back and dodged Connor’s fist in an extremely dangerous way.
Although Connor’s punch did not hit Lance’s body, Lance could feel how powerful Connor’s punch was just based on Connor’s aura.
If it wasn’t for his quick reaction, he would have been sent flying by Connor’s punch just like Salvador.
Lance’s face was covered in sweat. Only now did he realize how terrifying the man in front of him was, and how stupid his decision to attack Connor was.
Connor’s strength far exceeded their imagination. Otherwise, Connor would definitely not have brought so many precious medicinal pills and appeared at the martial artist convention.
Mina and Quorra looked at Connor with the same shocked expression.
At this moment, the two of them finally realized just how terrifying Connor was.
“Connor is actually so powerful?”
Quorra turned to look at Mina and asked in surprise.
“I… I didn’t expect Connor to be so powerful…”
Mina stuttered before continuing, “Back in Porthampton, Connor seemed to be only slightly better than ordinary people. How did he become so powerful?”
“No wonder he was so confident just now. He’s also a martial artist!”
Quorra’s initially nervous mood seemed to have eased a little.
At this moment, another scream was heard.
Mina and Quorra quickly turned and saw that Connor had kicked Yadiel’s head. Yadiel was sent flying on the spot and smashed into the fence not far away.
The fence that was made of steel bars was actually dented by Yadiel’s body. From this, it could be seen how terrifying the power of Connor’s kick was.
“This…”
Mina looked at Yadiel with an expression of shock!
At this moment, Mina didn’t even know how to describe her feelings.
There were four people who came. Now, Connor had already dealt with two of them. Only Lance and Louis were left standing on the spot.
“Louis, you’ve really screwed me up this time!”
Lance shouted at Louis angrily.
“I didn’t expect this to happen!””
Louis stuttered.
Lance knew that he had no chance of escaping now, so after taking a deep breath, he rushed toward Connor.
But the result was the same. How could Lance be Connor’s match?
In less than half a minute, Lance was sent flying like Salvador and Yadiel before he fainted.
In an instant, it was as if the entire world had fallen silent.
In less than five minutes, the three martial artists that Louis had brought with him were all beaten down by Connor alone. Only Louis was left standing there, looking at Connor with fear in his eyes.
Quorra and Mina looked at Connor with incredulous expressions, as if they couldn’t believe what they were seeing.
When they were blocked by these people, Mina and Quorra thought that they would definitely die today.
But they never thought that it would actually end up like this. Connor had actually defeated all the martial artists alone.
The way Mina and Quorra looked at Connor also changed greatly. They felt like they were dreaming.
“Connor is actually so powerful. What’s going on?”
Mina’s thoughts were all over the place. She really didn’t expect Connor to be able to defeat so many people.
At this moment, Connor finally understood how terrifying a black rank was.
Connor thought that yellow rank was already terrifying enough, but it was nothing compared to a black rank.
Connor looked at Louis expressionlessly. After Louis hesitated for a moment, he knelt on the ground with a bang.
When Connor saw Louis kneel down, he couldn’t help but smile lightly.
“Mr. McDonald, I’m sorry. I shouldn’t have attacked you. Please let me go. I really am sorry. Please give me another chance! I’ll do whatever you want me to do. In the future, I’ll be a dog by your side…”
Louis spoke as he bowed down to Connor. He even knocked his head on the ground, causing his head to bleed.
But even so, he didn’t dare to stop.
He knew that this was the only way to stop Connor and make him let him go.
Otherwise, even if he did not die, he would be a cripple.
However, Connor did not have any reaction and continued to walk toward Louis.
Seeing that Connor was getting closer and closer to him, Louis seemed to become even more flustered.
He begged for mercy. “Connor, I really am sorry. Let me go please…”
“I gave you a chance, but you didn’t know how to cherish it. If it wasn’t for your greed, you wouldn’t have ended up in this state today…”
Connor said to Louis expressionlessly.

chapters.title: Chapter 1122: Killing Someone with a Borrowed Knife
chapters.content:
Chapter 1122: Killing Someone with a Borrowed Knife
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
“Yes, you’re right…”
Louis looked at Connor and hurriedly nodded. Then, he continued, “All of this happened because of my greed and Salvador’s instigation. If it wasn’t for Salvador, I wouldn’t have attacked you. I beg you, please let me go…”
“Let you go?”
Connor smiled faintly when he heard Louis’s words. Then, he waved his right hand lightly.
Smack!
A crisp sound rang out.
...
Connor’s slap landed on Louis’s face. Louis did not even have the time to react before he was sent flying and smashed onto the ground.
Although Connor had used all his strength in this slap, Louis was still a martial artist. He would definitely not die. At most, he would be crippled.
Mina and Quorra stood rooted to the ground, looking at everything in front of them.
The two of them did not expect that it would end up like this.
Four martial artists ganged up on Connor, and in the end, they were all beaten down by Connor. Mina felt that this was somewhat unbelievable.
However, at this moment, Connor was very calm, as if nothing had happened.
He just stood there quietly without saying a word.
What happened today has helped Connor understand one truth. That was, in the world of martial artists, there was simply no use of reason.
They pursued the principle of the strong preying on the weak, and whoever had the strongest fist had the final say.
“Connor, are you alright?”
At this moment, Mina walked to Connor and asked with a nervous expression.
“Yeah…”
Connor replied indifferently, before saying in a low voice, “Are the two of you okay?”
“Yeah…”
Mina hurriedly nodded.
“Then, let’s go back!”
Connor said lightly.
“Are we going to go back just like this?”
Mina was stunned for a moment, then pointed at Louis and the others and said, “What about these people? Will they take revenge on you when they wake up?”
“You don’t have to worry about that. If they dare to take revenge on me, their outcome will definitely be worse than now. Moreover, when they wake up, they should already be crippled. They’re not even comparable to ordinary people.”
Connor smiled faintly and then walked forward.
Mina and Quorra felt that this place was way too terrifying, so they followed Connor without hesitation.
Just as Connor, Mina, and the others left, they saw two people walking out of the forest.
However, one of them was Mina’s cousin, Terry Malone.
Terry looked at Louis and the others who had already fainted. A trace of anger flashed in his eyes, and he said in a low voice, “Connor is actually so powerful…”
“That’s right, we were too careless this time. Although Connor isn’t very old, his strength is very shocking. Based on my estimation, he should be at least black rank intermediate level!”
The old man beside Terry replied in a low voice.
“Black rank intermediate level?”
When Terry heard this, he was instantly stunned.
Because he never thought that Connor would be so terrifying, he was already a black rank at the intermediate level.
“Looks like this isn’t as simple as it looks. That’s why Connor dared to bring so many pills with him. He has some tricks up his sleeves. I want to report this matter to the family head and see what the family head plans to do!”
Terry whispered.
“What about these people?”
The old man asked Terry in a low voice.
“Kill them all and find a place to bury them…”
Terry said calmly.
When the old man heard this, he could not help but gasp, but he did not say anything.
Terry’s goal was actually very obvious. He wanted to get rid of Louis and the others, and then let everyone think that they were killed by Connor.
…
On the other side, in Temira Yakes’s room.
Someone knocked on the door.
Temira casually picked up a piece of clothing and draped it over her shoulders. Then, she reached out and opened the door.
“How did it go?”
Temira asked softly when she saw the man walking in.
“Miss, Louis and the rest are really too careless. Connor McDonald’s strength is extremely terrifying. They are simply unable to defeat Connor…”
The man said in a low voice.
“Louis and the other three are not Connor’s match?”
When Temira heard the man’s words, she was instantly stunned. She was indescribably shocked.
“Yes, he is really terrifying. His strength is definitely above black rank intermediate level. Louis and the rest are not Connor’s match at all…”
The man nodded slowly.
“How can he be so powerful?”
Temira was unusually shocked.
“I don’t know, but he is indeed not to be trifled with. I think it’s better not to make a move on him!”
The man said in a low voice.
Temira looked at the man and hesitated for a couple of seconds before asking softly, “How are Louis and Salvador?”
“Louis and Salvador are already dead…”
The man said helplessly.
“Dead?”
When Temira heard this, her eyes widened, and she shouted in surprise.
“Yes, they are all dead now, but they were not killed by Connor!”
“Terry killed them?”
Temira hesitated for a moment before asking in a low voice.
“Yes, Terry killed them!”
The man nodded.
“Terry is really ruthless!”
Temira couldn’t help but take a deep breath. Then, she narrowed her eyes and looked around. No one knew what she was thinking.
“Miss, since they have failed, I shall not disturb your rest…”
The man asked in a low voice.
“Okay, you can leave now!”
Temira waved her hand at the man.
The man turned around and left without any hesitation.
When Temira saw the man leave, she hesitated for a moment, then took out her phone and dialed a number.
Ring! Ring!
After the phone rang twice, the other party picked up the call.
“Master, I came across a strange pill at the martial artist convention today. Its effect is similar to the Body Tempering Pill of the Celestial Flower Valley, but it’s a hundred times stronger than the Body Tempering Pill refined by the Celestial Flower Valley. I remember you once told me that there is someone in Oprana who can refine this pill…”
Temira briefly explained the situation on her side.
A few minutes later, Temira hung up the phone with a shocked expression on her face.
“Could Connor be his descendant?”
Temira muttered to herself.

chapters.title: Chapter 1123: Let Mina Accompany You!
chapters.content:
Chapter 1123: Let Mina Accompany You!
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
On the other side, Mina followed Connor back to their living quarters.
However, Mina didn’t return to her room immediately, instead, she went to Connor’s room.
“Connor, when did you become so powerful?”
Mina asked Connor curiously.
“After you left Porthampton, I found a master. My master is a very powerful martial artist. His cultivation seems to have reached the heaven rank, which is why I could become so powerful…”
Connor didn’t hide anything from Mina and explained to her.
...
When Mina heard Connor’s words, she was stunned, her face filled with disbelief.
She couldn’t help but ask Connor, “Connor, you your master is a heaven rank martial artist?”
“Yeah, why?”
Connor asked softly.
“How is that possible?”
A strange look flashed across Mina’s eyes before she whispered, “I once heard Terry say that there are no more than five heaven rank martial artists in Oprana, and any one of them is a very terrifying existence. Even our family head is only an earth rank martial artist!”
“Then, I might be wrong. My master is probably an earth rank martial artist!”
Connor didn’t expect that a heaven rank martial artist would be so awesome, so he hurriedly changed his words.
“I see. No wonder you came to the martial artist convention!”
Mina looked at Connor and nodded gently. Then, she continued, “Connor, I know that you are very powerful, but you still have to be careful. After all, there are still many experts in this manor…”
“I know. If others do not provoke me, I will not provoke them. As long as I find all the medicinal ingredients I need, I will leave…”
Connor looked at Mina and nodded lightly.
“Okay…”
Mina nodded lightly.
“Alright, it’s getting late. You should go and rest early!”
Connor whispered to Mina.
“Okay…”
Mina nodded, then turned around and left Connor’s room.
After Mina left, Connor sat on the bed alone and picked up the Chi Manipulation Technique, then carefully studied it.
At this moment, Connor had already realized that if he could master the Chi Manipulation Technique, it would greatly increase his strength. Also, the pill that Jorge Yarrell gave Connor could last for about an hour and a half, so Connor had to control when he used it. If he encountered a more troublesome enemy or if the enemy chose to stall for time, Connor would still be in trouble.
“No matter what, the most important thing now is to increase my strength!”
Connor looked at the Chi Manipulation Technique in his hand and sighed softly.
After Mina left Connor’s room, she sat on the bed alone, thinking about something.
At this moment, Mina suddenly realized that the gap between her and Connor was getting bigger and bigger.
But at this moment, Mina’s phone suddenly rang.
The caller was none other than Mina’s grandfather.
…
The next day, at nine o’clock in the morning.
Connor once again came to the martial artist convention hall. However, when he appeared in the hall, he realized that the gazes of the martial artists present had undergone a huge change, as if they were very afraid of him.
At this moment, Connor had no idea that Louis, Salvador, and the others were already dead.
After all, Connor had no intention of killing them yesterday. He only wanted to teach Salvador and the others a lesson.
However, the news that these martial artists heard was that Connor had killed Salvador and the others. This caused many people to feel that Connor’s strength was extremely terrifying, so the way they looked at Connor was naturally filled with fear.
There were many people who wanted to do something to Connor yesterday.
But now, even if they had a hundred more guts, they wouldn’t dare to attack Connor.
After all, it was indeed not worth it to sacrifice one’s life for those few medicinal pills.
Connor found his seat and took out his banner.
At this moment, Connor only needed three kinds of medicinal herbs, so he was not very anxious.
However, just as Connor sat down, he saw a white-haired old man walking with Mina.
“Hello, Mr. McDonald…”
The white-haired old man greeted Connor very politely.
Mina stood behind Connor, her expression extremely nervous.
“Hello!”
Connor didn’t know what this old man wanted to do and replied indifferently.
“Mr. McDonald, my name is Aaron Malone, the second elder of the Malone Family!”
Aaron introduced himself with a smile.
Connor sized Aaron up, his expression a little confused. He frowned and asked, “Is there something you need?”
“Mr. McDonald, I didn’t know that you were coming. I’ve already gotten someone to prepare the best villa in our manor for you. You can move there at any time…”
Aaron said respectfully.
When Connor heard Aaron’s words, he could not help but be stunned for a moment. He knew that the Malone Family knew that he had defeated Louis and the others. That was why the Malone Family’s attitude toward him had changed so much.
Aaron, who was standing in front of Connor, had a very high status in the Malone Family. Moreover, he was a martial artist, so his authority was just below the Malone Family’s head.
At this moment, Aaron was clearly speaking on behalf of the Malone Family to Connor.
Connor looked at Mina with a confused expression.
Connor didn’t understand why Mina was with Aaron.
“Alright, I understand…”
Connor looked at Aaron and nodded.
When Aaron saw that Connor had agreed, a hint of pride flashed across his eyes. He then looked at Connor and continued, “Mr. McDonald, this is my niece, Mina. I heard that you and Mina know each other, so I specially brought Mina here for you…”
“Mina, what are you still standing there for? Hurry up and say something to Mr. McDonald!”
Aaron shouted at Mina expressionlessly.
Mina hesitated for a moment, her body trembling slightly.
At this moment, she felt extremely humiliated, but she did not dare to disobey Aaron. She walked up to Connor and whispered to him, “Hello, Mr. McDonald!”
“Mr. McDonald, you know Mina, and you came here alone. Why don’t you let Mina accompany you?”
Aaron smiled ambiguously at Connor as he spoke.

chapters.title: Chapter 1124: Your Lover
chapters.content:
Chapter 1124: Your Lover
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Although Aaron’s words were very tactful, Connor could get the underlying meaning.
When Mina heard Aaron’s words, she became even more embarrassed.
However, Mina had no other choice. Her parents worked in the Malone Family’s company, and her family was considerably insignificant in the Malone Family.
Her only use to the Malone Family was to please men.
Mina was very resistant to this, but she knew that if she didn’t do as Aaron said, then his parents and her grandfather would be implicated.
However, Mina had never thought that Aaron would give her to Connor.
...
At this moment, Mina didn’t know how to describe her feelings.
‘Are you trying to use a honey trap on me?’
Connor couldn’t help but sigh deep down and then looked at Mina indifferently.
Mina was indeed very beautiful. Her figure was also very good, and her entire body emitted an alluring aura.
Mina had obviously dressed up meticulously today. She was wearing a white dress, and her tall figure looked particularly charming under the contrast of the short dress. Her slender and fair legs were exposed to the air without reservation. She was also wearing a pair of black high heels, and her pretty face coupled with her black curly hair gave off an indescribable temptation.
No man could refuse such a woman.
The Malone Family was actually ‘giving’ Mina to Connor, which represented the Malone Family’s intentions.
Connor hesitated for a moment, then gently nodded and said, “Thank you!”
“Haha, then I’ll leave you to it!”
Aaron did not expect Connor to agree so readily. He laughed loudly before turning around and leaving.
Seeing Mina, the other martial artists present seemed to understand what the Malone Family meant, and their faces were filled with envy.
“The Malone Family sure knows how to get what they want. They are presenting such a beauty to him!”
“Yeah, the Malone Family is really generous. Mina is really beautiful. This Connor guy is really lucky…”
“Sigh, when will the Malone Family give me such a great beauty…”
The martial artists present began to discuss in low voices.
On the other side, Connor turned to look at Mina, a trace of helplessness flashing in his eyes.
Mina looked at Connor awkwardly.
“Where’s Quorra?”
Connor asked Mina softly.
“She was so scared last night that she couldn’t sleep. She only fell asleep at three in the morning…”
Mina replied softly.
“Oh…”
Connor lightly nodded, then smiled at Mina.
A hint of helplessness flashed in Mina’s eyes before she whispered, “Last night, when I returned to my room, I received a call from my grandfather. He said that the head of the Malone Family wants to give me to someone and told me that I have no choice but to obey. Otherwise, my parents and my grandfather would be implicated. I had no choice but to agree, but I didn’t expect the head of the Malone Family to give me to you…”
“I didn’t expect the Malone Family to actually use a honey trap on me…”
Connor looked at Mina and smiled helplessly.
When Mina heard Connor’s words, she couldn’t help but be stunned for a moment, then lightly said, “I doubt I’m considered a beauty in your eyes.”
“Hehe, of course you’re a beauty!”
Connor replied with a smile.
“Forget it. No matter what, the Malone Family has already given me to you, and you’ve agreed to it. I have to follow you for the next few days. If you don’t let me follow you, my parents will be fired by the company…”
Mina whispered to Connor.
“I didn’t say anything about chasing you away.”
Connor replied indifferently.
“Sigh…”
Mina sighed helplessly and said softly, “Connor, I know you don’t like me, and I know you have a fiancée, but I hope you can do me a favor!”
“What favor?”
Connor was stunned for a moment and asked.
“Can you tell the Malone Family that I’m your lover?”
Mina whispered.
Connor was stunned when he heard Mina’s words. He was flabbergasted because this was the first time he was encountering such a situation.
Previously, there were people who wanted to pretend to be Connor’s girlfriend, but this was the first time someone like Mina wanted to pretend to be his lover.
“Why though?”
Connor asked Mina in confusion.
“Connor, you might not know this, but ever since I returned to the Malone Family, I’ve been arranged to go on blind dates with all kinds of men every day. If it weren’t for Terry’s help, I might have already married a young master from a large family. However, those young masters aren’t good people. I don’t want to marry them…”
“And?”
Connor asked.
“My parents are from the side branch of the Malone Family. They don’t have any power or status in the family. The reason why I can live like this now is all because of the Malone Family’s care.
“That’s why my fate is to marry someone according to the Malone Family’s arrangement. I went to Porthampton to escape from this fate. During that time, my parents’ status in the Malone Family plummeted, and their life was very miserable…
“I wasn’t in touch with my family, so I naturally didn’t know that my parents were being suppressed by the Malone Family. Ever since I came back, I didn’t dare to leave.
“Now, the Malone Family is ready to give me to you. As long as you say that I’m your lover, the Malone Family won’t give me to anyone else. I can live the life I want. The only regret is that I can’t get married, but that doesn’t really bother me!”
Mina lowered her head and said helplessly to Connor.
Connor looked at Mina, who was standing in front of him. He finally understood why she wanted his help.
In fact, Mina’s fate was not a pretty one.
Although Mina was born into a large family, her pain was not something that ordinary people could understand.
Mina was a very kind girl. When Connor had no money, she did not once look down on him and often helped him. Now that Connor had the ability to change Mina’s fate, he didn’t mind helping her once.

chapters.title: Chapter 1125: Mina’s Interrogation
chapters.content:
Chapter 1125: Mina’s Interrogation
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
“It’s okay if you don’t want to…”
Seeing that Connor was silent, Mina thought that he wasn’t willing to help.
Therefore, she forced a smile and whispered to Connor.
“I can help you, but I can’t give you any status. After all, my fiancée and I have a good relationship. I don’t want to do anything to let her down!”
Connor hesitated for a moment before saying to Mina with a serious expression.
“…”
...
Mina’s eyes flashed with a strange light, then she smiled faintly and said to Connor, “I’m just asking you to help me lie. I don’t really want to be your lover…”
“That’s good, then…”
Connor nodded lightly.
Although Mina acted very naturally, Connor could still see a trace of sadness in her eyes.
After all, Mina had been given to Connor as a plaything by the Malone Family. She was also willing to be Connor’s lover, but he rejected her.
Mina found it hard to accept this. She felt that her pride had been trampled on.
However, she could not say anything more because she knew that Connor helping her out was good enough.
“Connor, if there was no misunderstanding between the two of us back then, do you think the two of us would have ended up together?”
Mina suddenly asked Connor.
After hearing Mina’s words, Connor couldn’t help but be stunned for a moment, then he smiled and said, “You’re undoubtedly a great person, and you’re very beautiful. Any man who sees you will be tempted, but I won’t like you. It’s not because you’re not good enough, but because I have another woman in my heart, so it’s impossible for the two of us to be together!”
“What if that woman doesn’t exist?”
Mina hurriedly asked.
“Then, I don’t know…”
Connor looked at Mina and smiled faintly.
“Alright, let’s take a look around Tayton…”
Mina put aside her feelings and smiled at Connor.
“…”
Connor simply glanced at the hall and saw that no one seemed to be interested in his pills, so he nodded and said, “Alright, since there’s nothing much to do here, let’s go out and take a walk…”
“Okay…”
Mina nodded lightly, then brought Connor out of the hall.
After Mina and Connor walked out of the hall, Terry and Aaron walked out from the corner.
“Grandpa Aaron, why did you give Mina to Connor?”
Terry seemed to have a special feeling for Mina as he asked Aaron angrily.
A hint of helplessness flashed across Aaron’s eyes as he whispered, “Connor is already so powerful at such a young age, and he even brought so many precious pills with him. This shows that this Connor’s background is not simple. I asked someone to investigate yesterday, but they didn’t find anything, so I feel that he is not someone ordinary. Before the family head makes an appearance, we can’t offend Connor!”
“But there was no need to give Mina to him, right?”
Terry gritted his teeth and shouted.
“If we don’t give Mina to him, how can we express the Malone family’s sincerity? Don’t think that I don’t know what you’ve done. If what you’ve done gets leaked out, our family will be in big trouble. You’d better handle the corpses of Louis Schooling and the others properly.”
Aaron whispered,
“You don’t have to worry about that. I’ve already taken care of everything that needs to be taken care of. No one will find out!”
Terry said expressionlessly.
“That’s good. What we have to do now is to be on Connor’s good side. Then, we’ll discuss how to deal with him when the family head returns.”
Aaron continued.
Terry took a deep breath and said in a low voice, “I know!”
Aaron hesitated for a moment before turning around and leaving.
Meanwhile, Terry stood on the spot, his face filled with anger.
After all, he had always treated Mina as his woman. Otherwise, he would not have stopped Mina from marrying those young masters in Tayton.
Terry felt that the time was not ripe yet. As long as he inherited the position of the family head, he would get Mina. At that time, no one would stop him from getting what he wanted.
However, he didn’t expect Aaron to give Mina to Connor.
This had ruined all of Terry’s plans. However, he had no choice now. After all, he did not dare to go against Aaron’s wishes.
…
On the other side, Connor followed Mina to the commercial center of Tayton and began to stroll around.
However, Connor was not in the mood to stroll around. After all, his mind was filled with Freya Phillips.
If Connor couldn’t find the remaining three herbs, he didn’t know what to do!
“Connor, Tiffany Zamora will be having a concert in Tayton tonight. Do you want to go and take a look?”
At this moment, Mina blinked her big watery eyes and said to Connor softly.
At this moment, Mina could feel that Connor wasn’t in a good mood, so she wanted to find something for him to do.
“Tiffany Zamora?”
When Connor heard this name, he couldn’t help but be stunned for a moment. Then, he said in a low voice, “This name sounds a little familiar!”
“Of course, it is. Tiffany is now a popular celebrity in the entertainment industry. Previously, Tiffany was not that popular. But, not long ago, Tiffany took on a few big dramas and has now become a big star in the country. Many people say that Tiffany is being supported by a very powerful big shot, which is why she is able to make it big…
“But I don’t think that’s the case. I still like Tiffany very much. She’s beautiful, and she’s a good singer…”
Mina seemed to be a fan of Tiffany, so she kept talking to Connor about Tiffany.
After listening to Mina’s words, Connor finally realized who this big star Tiffany was.
Back then, when Connor was at the resort, he saved a celebrity. That celebrity was Tiffany.
“You want to go see her?”
Connor wasn’t interested in idols, but he could feel that Mina was really interested, so he asked softly.
“It doesn’t matter if I go or not. It depends on whether you want to go or not!”
Mina replied.
“In any case, the two of us have nothing to do now. Let’s go and take a look…”
Connor laughed at Mina.
“Alright, I’ll get my friend to buy two tickets now. It’s very difficult to buy tickets for her concert, but I know a friend who has a way to buy them…”
Mina said happily to Connor.

chapters.title: Chapter 1126: Why Are You Here?
chapters.content:
Chapter 1126: Why Are You Here?
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
“Okay, then you handle it!”
Connor nodded lightly.
Mina took out her phone directly and called her friend, purchasing two concert tickets.
After buying the tickets, they took a taxi and headed towards the concert venue.
Upon arriving at the stadium where the concert was held, Connor realized just how terrifying Tiffany’s popularity was.
The entrance of the stadium was filled with people, stretching as far as the eye could see. Moreover, many more were continuously arriving.
...
“There are so many people!” he couldn’t help but sigh softly.
“Yeah, I didn’t expect there would be so many people…”
Mina exclaimed as well, then continued, “If you think it’s too crowded, we can go back now…”
“No need, since we’re here, let’s stay and have a look…” Connor replied casually.
Perhaps it was because Mina was extremely beautiful that she instantly caught the attention of countless people when she appeared at the stadium.
And when these people saw Connor next to Mina, they all wore expressions of confusion.
Because they couldn’t understand why Mina, a top beauty, would be with Connor, an ordinary guy.
As he looked at the crowd in front of him, a hint of helplessness flashed in his eyes. In fact, he didn’t really like crowded places like this.
After all, if any danger were to occur, he would have a hard time ensuring Mina’s safety.
Moreover, he noticed the presence of martial artists among the crowd. Although their numbers weren’t significant, there were indeed martial artists present.
Now that his ability to perceive aura was very strong, even among so many people, he could sense the presence of martial artists. However, he couldn’t determine their exact locations.
He also noticed many police officers moving around. After all, with so many fans coming over, there could be potential disturbances, so it was normal for the police to be present.
“I didn’t expect Tiffany’s popularity to be so high that even martial artists are coming to her concert…” he sighed softly.
He knew that due to the Warrior Conference, there were many martial artists in Newtown now.
Among these martial artists, some were fans of Tiffany. It was normal for them to come and watch the concert, so he didn’t think much of it.
“Connor, we can enter now…”
Just at that moment, Mina shouted towards Connor.
“Okay…”
After hearing her words, he nodded lightly and followed her towards the entrance of the concert.
Since there were a lot of people coming to watch the concert today, it would probably take two hours just to enter.
But she had bought VIP tickets, not only were the seats very close, but they could also enter early.
So they didn’t need to line up at all. After passing the security check, they entered the stadium.
Once inside the stadium, she found their seats and sat down directly.
The position where Connor and Mina were seated was actually quite good, close to the stage, and they could see the people on stage without needing the big screen.
“Wait for me here, I’ll go to the restroom!”
Connor said softly to Mina.
“Okay, go ahead!”
She nodded lightly as she watched Connor.
He hesitated for a moment, then walked directly towards the restroom.
A few minutes later, he arrived at the restroom.
Since there weren’t many audience members entering at the moment, there weren’t many people in the restroom either.
However, before he could enter the bathroom, he felt the aura of those martial artists from before. They were actually walking towards the bathroom.
Connor had just arrived at the restroom when the martial artists approached the restroom’s location. It was definitely not a coincidence. He recalled the encounter with Louis and others last night, instantly suspecting that these people were likely martial artists attending the martial arts exchange meeting. They had been following him all along, but he hadn’t noticed.
“So they came for me…”
He couldn’t help but sigh softly, and his expression began to tense.
After all, he only had two pills left in his hand, and he didn’t want to waste them.
But unfortunately, Mina was still present, so he couldn’t leave.
He hesitated for a moment, wanting to turn around and leave.
After all, the restroom location was relatively secluded, making it very suitable for those martial artists to take action against him.
However, if he went to a crowded place, those people wouldn’t be able to harm him.
After all, with so many people around, even if they had a hundred times more courage, they wouldn’t dare to lay a hand on Connor.
But just as he was about to turn around and leave, a woman suddenly walked towards him.
The woman was dressed in thick clothes, wore a pair of large sunglasses on her face, and had a duckbill cap on her head. Her features were completely hidden, and it was impossible to see what she looked like.
When the woman saw Connor, she instinctively paused for a moment, then exclaimed in surprise, “Mr. Connor what are you doing here?”
Upon hearing this voice, Connor instantly knew who the woman was.
“Tiffany?”
Connor asked tentatively.
“Yes. Mr. Connor, it’s really you!”
She hurriedly took off her sunglasses, her expression filled with excitement as she called out to Connor.
And he looked at her delicate and pretty face, his expression speechless.
Because he never expected to encounter Tiffany here.
And when she saw him again, her mood naturally became extremely excited.
After all, she knew very well that her achievements today were all thanks to Connor’s connections.
Because of the previous incident, many big shots in the entertainment industry believed that Connor had a close relationship with Tiffany.
These people tried their best to please him, so naturally, they also tried their best to please her.
While she never admitted it, she also never denied it.
So now, when she saw him, her expression was filled with indescribable excitement, along with a hint of nervousness.
She didn’t know if Connor was aware that she was using him in this matter.
“Isn’t today your concert? Why did you come to this side of the restroom?”
Connor looked Tiffany up and down, wearing a puzzled expression as he asked her.

chapters.title: Chapter 1127: Who Is That Woman?
chapters.content:
Chapter 1127: Who Is That Woman?
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
“Today’s concert is actually not my solo performance. There will be several new singers before me.”
“But the company didn’t make it clear to the audience that I will be the last one to appear, so there’s no rush…”
Tiffany explained to Connor.
“Oh, I see!”
Connor nodded lightly.
“That’s how the entertainment industry works. Established artists support newcomers, and the company uses my popularity to promote them. I have no choice since I’m still under contract with the company…”
...
She helplessly explained, then looked at him and said, “Mr. Connor, there seem to be many rumors about the two of us on the internet…”
“Rumors about us?”
Upon hearing her words, he couldn’t help but pause for a moment. His expression showed some confusion, and he asked softly, “What do you mean by that?”
After seeing his expression, she instantly understood that he hadn’t been paying attention to this matter.
So she quickly explained, “It’s like this, Mr. Connor. Last time, didn’t you help me at the resort? That’s why many people think I’m your girlfriend, and some even say that you’re supporting me…”
“Uh…”
Upon hearing her words, he was instantly speechless. He had just heard from Mina that Tiffany might have been supported by a wealthy person.
But he never expected that the wealthy person mentioned in the rumor would turn out to be himself.
“Mr. Connor, I didn’t mean anything else. I didn’t spread that news, so I hope you don’t misunderstand!”
Worried that Connor would misunderstand her, Tiffany hurriedly explained again.
“Don’t worry, I won’t misunderstand. Anyway, we don’t have any relationship, and as for what those netizens say, let them say whatever they want!” he replied expressionlessly.
At this moment, he could feel that those martial artists seemed to be getting closer to him and Tiffany.
“Mr. Connor, did you come here with Miss Wilhelmina and the others?”
After hesitating for a moment, she asked him in a low voice.
“No, I came with other friends!”
He answered while observing the surroundings.
The current location was quite secluded, and he felt that it might be the best place for the martial artists to make a move. So he was considering how to leave this place.
“Mr. Connor, did you come to my concert specifically? I never expected you to be here…” she exclaimed excitedly.
“Yeah, my friend is your fan and really likes you. She even wants your autograph. How about you meet my friend?”
He finally found an excuse to take her away and quickly said.
“Sure, since it’s a friend of Mr. Connor, I will definitely give face. I’ll go meet your friend now, and I can even arrange a better seat for your friend…”
Knowing that she had achieved her current success thanks to Connor’s help, she was very grateful to him. So she readily agreed to his small request.
Upon seeing Tiffany agreeing to leave, Connor also breathed a sigh of relief. Then he walked away with quick steps.
A few middle-aged men not far away had been keeping an eye on Connor and Tiffany.
They had originally planned to wait until the target was alone before taking action, but they didn’t expect that these two individuals would continue chatting. If the two of them were together, it could potentially affect their plan. Therefore, they decided to wait until Connor and Tiffany separated before making their move.
However, now they were still together, and they were walking towards the venue together.
If Connor and Tiffany were allowed to enter the venue, it wouldn’t be so simple for them to take action.
“Boss, what should we do?”
“Yeah, if we miss this opportunity, we won’t have such a good chance to act!”
The two young men whispered to the middle-aged man.
The middle-aged man hesitated for two seconds as he watched Connor and Tiffany’s figures, then clenched his teeth and said in a low voice, “No choice, we have to act now…”
After saying this, the middle-aged man directly took a step forward and rushed towards Connor and Tiffany’s position.
Naturally, he could sense that these people were approaching him at a very fast speed, so he instinctively turned around.
“Don’t move!”
But before he could make a move, he heard a roar.
And when the middle-aged man and the other two young men heard this, they all froze for a moment.
Immediately after, Connor saw a beautiful girl with a ponytail rushing out and charging directly towards the middle-aged man.
“It’s over, we’ve been discovered! You two, run first!”
The middle-aged man whispered.
The two young men hesitated for a moment, then turned around and ran towards a distance.
Since there was only one girl, she didn’t have the mood to chase after the other two young men and engaged in a fight with the middle-aged man.
Connor took a glance at the girl. She had a good appearance, wearing a white camisole on top and denim shorts below, with a pair of canvas shoes on her feet, looking very cool.
The girl’s movements were very fast and professional. The middle-aged man was not a true martial artist, he had just touched the threshold of martial arts.
But regardless, the middle-aged man’s strength was still very formidable. In just a few seconds, the girl found herself at a disadvantage.
“What are you looking at? Hurry up and take Miss Tiffany away!”
After noticing that Connor had been spectating all this time, the girl shouted with frustration.
Originally, he had intended to help, but after hearing the girl’s words, a hint of helplessness flashed in his eyes, and he directly took Tiffany and ran forward.
The girl knew that she wasn’t a match for the middle-aged man. After hesitating for a moment, she pulled out her handgun and fired two shots towards the middle-aged man’s position.
The girl’s handgun was equipped with a silencer, and coupled with the relatively secluded location and most of the audience still in the process of entering, not many people could hear the gunshots. Even if someone did hear them, they wouldn’t immediately associate them with gunfire.
Tiffany, upon hearing the gunshots, also showed a shocked expression.
Curiously, she turned to Connor and asked, “Mr. Connor, who was that woman just now? Why did she shoot?”
“Isn’t that woman your bodyguard?”
Connor asked in surprise.
“No, she isn’t…”
Tiffany quickly shook her head.
Upon hearing her words, he was instantly speechless.
He had initially thought that the woman was Tiffany’s bodyguard!
If she wasn’t Tiffany’s bodyguard, then why did she step forward and rescue Tiffany?

chapters.title: Chapter 1128: Ghost Shadows!
chapters.content:
Chapter 1128: Ghost Shadows!
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
However, Connor didn’t have time to think about these problems. He could only drag Tiffany and continue running forward.
But at that moment, two gunshots were heard again from the direction of the restroom.
Since there was little time earlier, the woman couldn’t aim properly, so both shots missed.
After successfully evading two shots, the middle-aged man showed no intention of escaping. Instead, he charged towards the woman’s position once again.
Knowing that the handgun had limited bullets, the middle-aged man realized that once the woman ran out of ammunition, he could overpower her.
Seeing the woman hesitate, she felt it was not a viable option. So, she turned and ran outside the restroom.
...
The middle-aged man smirked when he saw the woman attempting to escape and immediately pursued her.
A few seconds later, the woman reached Connor and Tiffany.
Surprised by the woman’s arrival, Tiffany’s face showed astonishment. He asked the woman in a puzzled tone, “Who are you exactly?”
At this moment, Tiffany’s face still showed fear. After all, it was his first encounter with such a situation.
Especially when the woman fired the gun, Connor could feel Tiffany trembling. He had no idea what was happening.
“Miss Tiffany, I am an undercover agent. Here’s the situation, the middle-aged man earlier is an assassin, and he came here to kidnap you. We received advance information and have been secretly protecting you. Hurry and leave this place with me. If the assassin catches up, you’ll be in danger…”
While pulling Tiffany forward, the woman explained anxiously.
“How can I trust you?” she hesitated and asked with a furrowed brow.
“This is my identification!” The woman helplessly presented her credentials.
Relieved after seeing the woman’s identification, Tiffany followed her forward.
Connor trailed behind the two, wearing an expression of frustration.
Because now he realized that the middle-aged man was not after him, but after Tiffany.
“It seems I misunderstood the situation…” he sighed helplessly.
“Why are you just standing there? Run!” The woman shouted in frustration when she noticed he was still lingering.
Startled by the girl’s words, he followed Tiffany and the woman, running ahead.
However, at that moment, the middle-aged man suddenly caught up and swiftly advanced towards Tiffany.
“Be careful, Miss Tiffany…” The woman pulled out her handgun upon seeing the middle-aged man closing in and pulled the trigger.
“Bang!”
A muffled sound.
The bullet missed again.
Although the bullet missed, it bought some time for Tiffany.
But the next second, the woman saw two more young assassins charging from another direction towards her.
And all of them were aiming for her location.
Distracted by her concern for Tiffany, the undercover agent glanced in the direction of the young assassins. It was evident that the middle-aged man had experience in such matters. He seized the moment the woman’s attention wavered and kicked her wrist.
“Bang!”
The middle-aged man kicked the gun out of the woman’s hand.
Losing her handgun, she lost her greatest reliance.
“It’s over…” The woman couldn’t help but sigh internally.
With the middle-aged man and two young assassins surrounding Tiffany, it seemed like a desperate situation. There was no escape.
A young assassin rushed towards Tiffany with rapid steps.
The woman was still some distance away from Tiffany, so even if she wanted to intervene, it was too late.
She looked at Tiffany with a desperate expression as she knew her mission had failed.
At that moment, there was only Connor by Tiffany’s side, and he certainly couldn’t stop that young man.
She was currently being held back by the middle-aged man. It would be a piece of cake for the young man to take Tiffany away.
But just as the young man was about to strike Tiffany, a hand suddenly reached out and grabbed his wrist.
“How is this possible?”
The girl stared with wide eyes at Connor’s position, her expression filled with shock.
Because the one holding the young man’s wrist was none other than Connor, who was by Tiffany’s side.
This young man was just an ordinary killer, and the middle-aged man had only just stepped into the realm of martial arts. So, the strength of these three individuals was inferior to Connor’s.
Even without taking any elixirs, he could easily deal with these three people.
“You…”
The young man’s eyes flashed a hint of anger.
“Boom!”
Connor directly punched the young man in the chest.
The young man let out a miserable cry and flew backward, crashing heavily into the wall, unconscious.
For a moment, everyone was dumbfounded.
The girl had already given up all hope, and the middle-aged man thought he had succeeded.
But no one expected that there was another assassin by Tiffany’s side.
The middle-aged man widened his eyes as he looked at Connor’s position.
At this moment, he could sense that Connor’s skill was extraordinary, and he might even surpass himself!
“Could this kid also be a martial artist? How is that possible?”
A hint of surprise flashed in the middle-aged man’s eyes as he shouted at Connor in a low voice, “Kid, I advise you not to meddle in this. We have decided to take this woman. If you dare to interfere, don’t blame us for not being polite. We are not someone you can provoke…”
“Why can’t I provoke you?”
Connor smiled and asked the middle-aged man.
“The three of us are all members of the Ghost Shadow. If you dare to hinder us, you will offend the Ghost Shadow, and we will definitely not let you go!”
The middle-aged man spoke with confidence.
“Ghost Shadow?”
Connor frowned slightly upon hearing the middle-aged man’s words, his expression filled with confusion.
“Don’t you even know about the Ghost Shadow?”
The middle-aged man asked with a speechless tone when he saw Connor’s expression.
“I don’t know…”
Connor shook his head directly.
Meanwhile, while the middle-aged man was talking to Connor, the girl bent down, attempting to pick up her handgun.
But the middle-aged man reacted quickly and kicked the handgun away.

chapters.title: Chapter 1129: Do You Know Who I Am?
chapters.content:
Chapter 1129: Do You Know Who I Am?
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
“Surprisingly, you didn’t even know about the Ghost Shadows…”
The middle-aged man looked at Connor with some helplessness.
“Do you know about the Ghost Shadows?” He glanced at her, his expression puzzled.
“I’m not very clear about it either…” She shook her head gently.
“The Ghost Shadows is a highly notorious assassin organization in the country. They specialize in assassination and kidnapping operations. So far, they have killed many people, using extremely cruel methods. It is rumored that no one is safe from the Ghost Shadows. Crossing paths with them leads to a dead end. But I didn’t expect them to involve the Ghost Shadows; it seems they’ve gone all out…” The undercover beauty seemed aware of the Ghost Shadows’ capabilities, so her tone was tense when she spoke.
Upon hearing these words, Connor’s expression became grave. He realized that he might have gotten himself into big trouble.
...
At the moment, his biggest concern was getting into trouble. After all, he already had enough trouble around him.
“She’s right. There’s no one the Ghost Shadows can’t kill in the country, and our organization has many skilled warriors. So, kid, I advise you to be sensible and leave here. We’ll eliminate this cop, and no one will know you helped us. Afterwards, I can even offer you some benefits. What do you think?” The middle-aged man knew that attacking Connor at this moment wasn’t a good choice, so he decided to threaten him instead.
Upon hearing these words from the middle-aged man, Tiffany and the undercover beauty’s expressions visibly grew tense.
After all, she had only met Connor twice and barely knew him. They had no idea how he would respond.
If he chose to leave just like that, it would be a dead end for Tiffany and the undercover beauty.
“Young man, what are you thinking? Consider it carefully. If you help me this time, you’ll be indebted to the Ghost Shadows, and in the future, if you ever need help, I’ll assist you…” The middle-aged man shouted, feeling pleased when he saw Connor didn’t immediately object.
“Tell me who wants to harm Tiffany?” Connor asked the middle-aged man expressionlessly.
“What… What did you say?” The middle-aged man couldn’t help but pause upon hearing Connor’s words.
“I said, tell me who wants to harm Tiffany!” Connor repeated calmly.
“What do you mean? Are you backing out of our cooperation?” The middle-aged man stared wide-eyed, his expression exceptionally agitated as he shouted at Connor.
“Do you know who I am?” Connor calmly asked.
“Who are you?” The middle-aged man furrowed his brows, somewhat perplexed.
“I’m Connor. If you haven’t heard this name, you can ask your boss from the Ghost Shadows about a person called Mr. Connor. Then come back and talk to me!” Connor stated with an emotionless face.
“Mr. Connor?” The middle-aged man’s eyes flashed with confusion as he looked at Connor.
But the next moment, the expression on the middle-aged man’s face underwent a huge change. He stuttered and asked Connor, “Y-You… You’re Mr. Connor from Porthampton?”
“That’s right, it’s me!” Connor nodded lightly.
The middle-aged man was originally an assassin himself, so he had a good understanding of the underworld. He had heard some things about Connor, given that even the leaders of the four major provinces had pledged allegiance to him.
No matter how powerful Ghost Shadows was, he absolutely did not have the guts to go against someone like Connor. Otherwise, the consequences would be unimaginable.
And Ghost Shadow’s headquarters is actually in Davenport, so they are even more wary of Connor’s influence.
“I’ve seen Mr. Connor’s photo, and he really looks like this person!”
At this moment, the young assassin stuttered and said to the middle-aged man.
After realizing it, the middle-aged man’s eyes flashed with a hint of fear. He quickly shouted at Connor, “Mr. Connor, I’m really sorry, we didn’t mean to offend you. We hope you won’t lower yourself to our level. We’ll leave now…”
The undercover beauty was dumbfounded when she heard the middle-aged man’s words. Her expression on her face was as shocked as it could be.
Because she knew very well how terrifying the members of Ghost Shadow were.
But now, just by mentioning a name, Connor, the middle-aged man’s attitude had changed so drastically. It was truly unbelievable.
“Who is Mr. Connor?”
The undercover beauty subconsciously glanced at Connor, her expression filled with puzzlement.
And Connor, seeing the middle-aged man’s reaction, knew that his guess was correct.
He had heard Kyle mention the organization Ghost Shadow before, but because it was a long time ago, he didn’t have a strong impression of it.
He had just remembered it suddenly, so he decided to intimidate this middle-aged man with his own name. If it worked, it would save him a lot of trouble.
The middle-aged man’s reaction to his words confirmed his speculation. Ghost Shadow’s members were indeed very wary of his power.
“What do you want to do to Tiffany?”
Connor asked the middle-aged man expressionlessly.
“Mr. Connor, here’s the thing. A few days ago, we received a mission to kidnap Miss Tiffany…”
The middle-aged man answered directly without any hesitation.
“I see…”
Connor nodded lightly.
The middle-aged man continued, “They said that as long as we could successfully kidnap Miss Tiffany, we would receive 50 million. If we were to kill Miss Tiffany, we would only get 20 million…”
Upon hearing the middle-aged man’s words, Tiffany couldn’t help but take a cold breath. Her expression instantly turned pale.
Because now she realized that the other party didn’t just want to kidnap her, they wanted to kill her.
She couldn’t understand who would be so ruthless and want to kill her like this.
Although she had conflicts with many people over the years, she didn’t have such deep hatred, right?
“Who wants to kill Tiffany?”
Connor continued to ask the middle-aged man in front of him.
“Mr. Connor, I can’t answer that question. We can’t reveal the identity of the other party…”
The middle-aged man said with a hesitant tone to Connor.
After a moment of hesitation, Connor spoke calmly, “Alright, here’s what we’ll do. You tell me the identity of the other party, and I’ll let the three of you go. What do you think?”
Connor knew that the simplest way to deal with these assassins was to negotiate with them.

chapters.title: Chapter 1130: The Mastermind
chapters.content:
Chapter 1130: The Mastermind
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
The middle-aged man looked up and down at Connor, then softly asked him, “Mr. Connor, do you keep your promises?”
“Of course I do…”
Connor nodded.
“A woman named Fia Solvick asked us to take action, and she provided all of Miss Tiffany’s itinerary to us…”
The middle-aged man quickly explained.
Upon hearing the name mentioned by the middle-aged man, Tiffany froze in place, her expression filled with astonishment.
...
Unable to contain herself, she shouted at the middle-aged man, “You’re talking nonsense! How could Fia harm me?”
“I don’t know why Miss Tiffany, but I have phone records of conversations with Miss Fia. If you don’t believe me, I can show you…”
The middle-aged man took out his phone while speaking.
Tiffany hesitated for a moment but eventually took the middle-aged man’s phone, lowering her head to take a look.
She discovered that the displayed phone number in the call records was indeed Fia’s.
For a moment, Tiffany seemed unable to accept this fact.
“Mr. Connor, I’ve said everything I needed to say. Can we leave now?”
The middle-aged man looked at Connor and softly asked.
“You can go!”
Connor nodded.
The undercover beauty officer, upon hearing Connor’s words, quickly exclaimed, “These people are Ghost Shadow’s killers. You can’t let them go…”
“I promised them that if they reveal the name of the employer, I will let them go. I can’t go back on my word, so I won’t take action against them now…”
He replied to the undercover beauty officer expressionlessly, then continued, “Of course, you’re a police officer, if you want to arrest them, I have no objections. Anyway, I won’t get involved in your affairs…”
He didn’t know this undercover beauty officer, and since he had already made a promise to the middle-aged man, he didn’t want to invite any trouble.
As long as Tiffany was safe, he wouldn’t concern himself with the remaining matters.
“Thank you, Mr. Connor!”
The middle-aged man expressed his gratitude towards Connor and shouted, then he turned and left with his men.
Seeing the middle-aged man leave, the undercover beauty officer stomped her feet in anger, glaring at Connor and shouted, “What’s wrong with you? These are murderers, and you’re letting them go just like that. You’re their accomplice, don’t you know?”
“I didn’t let them go, I just don’t want to get involved in this matter. If you’re capable, you can chase after them yourself!”
Connor replied with some dissatisfaction upon seeing the attitude of the undercover beauty officer towards him.
“What’s wrong with you?”
The undercover beauty officer instantly felt frustrated.
“I advise you not to forget, I saved your life today. If it weren’t for me, you would already be dead. I can do whatever I want, and you have no right to command me!”
Connor said in a low voice to the undercover beauty officer.
Upon hearing his words, the undercover beauty officer was completely dumbfounded.
She was well aware that if it weren’t for his intervention, she would have already died at the hands of the middle-aged man.
“I’ll remember you, just wait and see!”
The undercover beauty officer shouted at Connor, then turned and was about to leave.
However, after taking two steps, she suddenly turned back to look at Connor and angrily shouted, “My name is Yanira Lowson. You better not let me see you again!”
“Hehe…”
Connor looked at the beauty and smiled helplessly, not saying much.
After a while, the beauty finally left.
Meanwhile, he walked back to Tiffany’s side and asked softly, “Is everything okay with you?”
Upon hearing his words, she slowly looked up at him, then whispered, “Mr. Connor, I’m really grateful for your help today. If it weren’t for you, I might have died already…”
“It’s nothing, just a small favor,” he replied lightly.
“This is the second time you’ve saved me…” She smiled bitterly.
“By the way, who is Fia that the middle-aged man mentioned? Do you know her?” Connor curiously asked.
“Fia is my best friend and my closest confidante. We both work in the same company, although her popularity is not as high as mine…” she replied helplessly.
“Did something happen between the two of you before?” he asked with a momentary pause.
“We have a good relationship, and there haven’t been any conflicts between us before. I don’t understand why she wants to kill me now. I’ve been good to her, providing her with any resources that suit her. But I never expected that she would try to kill me. It’s true that you can’t judge a person by their appearance,” she said in a helpless tone.
Connor remained silent while looking at Tiffany.
“I’ve been so good to her, why would she turn against me? I really can’t understand why she would do this!” She expressed her distress.
“Alright, I’m not very familiar with the entertainment industry matters, so I won’t inquire further. What do you plan to do next? Do you want my help?” he asked her.
“No need, Mr. Connor. You’ve already helped me many times. I’ll handle the rest myself.” She gently shook her head.
“Alright then, just be careful. Your popularity is high now, so there will definitely be many people eyeing you. It’s better to have a few bodyguards around you…” he reminded in a soft voice.
“I know…” She nodded lightly while looking at Connor, then continued, “Mr. Connor, I’m really sorry. I’m not in the mood to meet your friends now. Can I invite both of you for dinner another time?”
“It’s okay, you should go back and rest. Don’t think too much about other things!” Connor helplessly replied, then took the initiative to escort Tiffany back to the backstage rest area.
After escorting Tiffany to the rest area, Connor returned to Mina’s side alone.
At this time, the concert had already started, but the fans in the stadium had no idea about the thrilling scene that had just taken place.
“Connor, where did you go just now? Why did you come back now?” Mina anxiously asked when she saw Connor return.
“I met a friend just now, so we chatted for a while…” Connor explained lightly to Mina.
“You have a friend in Tayton? Where is your friend? Should I go and meet them?” Mina seemed surprised.
“If I can meet you in Tayton, it means I can meet other people too…” Connor smiled and shifted his attention back to the stage.

chapters.title: Chapter 1131: You Know Tiffany Zamora?
chapters.content:
Chapter 1131: You Know Tiffany Zamora?
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
At this moment, the fans in the stadium were still very excited.
After all, they had come for Tiffany Zamora alone today. However, these people had waited for a full two hours, and Tiffany still had not appeared. The fans must be very dissatisfied.
“Tiffany! Tiffany!”
It was unknown who started it, but the fans in the stadium began to shout Tiffany’s name.
Mina’s eyes flashed with a trace of helplessness, she turned her head and whispered, “These people are really going overboard. They clearly said that it was Tiffany’s concert, but we waited for so long and didn’t see her at all. I’m so angry…”
Connor saw Mina’s angry look and couldn’t help but feel a little amused. Then he said softly, “You might not be able to see Tiffany today…”
...
Mina couldn’t help but be stunned when she heard Connor’s words. She asked with a puzzled expression, “Why?”
“Tiffany has a problem today, so she probably won’t come out! If you want to see Tiffany, you probably won’t be able to…”
Connor said lightly.
“How did you know? Are you kidding me?”
