Mina blinked and asked Connor.
“I’m not joking with you. The friend I just met is Tiffany. She told me personally…” Connor said calmly.
Since Mina already knew Connor’s identity, he didn’t need to hide anything.
“Stop bragging. You actually know Tiffany?” Although Mina didn’t doubt Connor’s strength, when she mentioned Tiffany to him, Connor was at a loss.
She felt that if Connor really knew Tiffany, he definitely wouldn’t have such a reaction. However, at this moment, because the fans were too excited, the organizers were afraid that there would be chaos, so they let the host walk onto the stage.
“Dear fans, I’m really sorry about today. Because Miss Zamora is not feeling well, she might not be able to go on stage. However, we have prepared an even more exciting program for you. I hope everyone can understand…”
After the host walked onto the stage, he humbly explained to the fans below the stage.
When the crowd heard the host’s words, they immediately exploded in outrage. After all, these people were all here for Tiffany, but now, they were told that she would not appear. They definitely could not accept this fact.
For a moment, everyone started shouting for a refund.
Mina looked at Connor in surprise, because the host’s words just proved that Connor wasn’t bragging.
“Connor, do you really know Tiffany?”
Mina asked Connor in disbelief.
“Of course I do. I was going to let you meet her, but I ran into some trouble. No worries, though—there will be another chance in the future…” Connor said to Mina with a smile.
Mina didn’t know how to describe her feelings.
She never thought that Connor would be so powerful as to personally know a big star like Tiffany.
Mina might not know that Tiffany was able to become popular again because of Connor. If it weren’t for the scandal between Tiffany and Connor, she might have remained a small celebrity in the entertainment industry.
Connor looked at the emotional fans and whispered to Mina, “These fans are likely to cause a ruckus later. Anyway, we can’t see Tiffany now. Why don’t the two of us leave first?”
Sometimes, Connor really couldn’t understand the behavior of these fans. Wasn’t she just a celebrity? Why were they so excited?
“Alright then!”
Mina knew that she would not be in the mood to stay here if she couldn’t see Tiffany, so she nodded gently and walked out of the stadium before the chaos broke out.
Connor and Mina had just left the stadium when the fans inside began to protest. Some even rushed up to the stage.
As a police officer, Yanira Lowson rushed into the stadium when she found out that someone was causing trouble in the stadium.
However, just as she entered the venue, Yanira and Connor met again.
Yanira glared at Connor, but ignored him. She chose to deal with the problem in the stadium.
Connor smiled helplessly as he left the gymnasium with Mina. Then, he hailed a taxi and prepared to return to the Malone family manor.
…
It was past nine in the evening when Mina and Connor returned to the Malone family’s manor. When Quorra saw them, she fixed them with an accusatory glare and asked them what they were doing.
Mina could only helplessly explain that they had gone to a concert, but something had happened midway, so they had come back early.
Quorra didn’t say anything else after she knew what happened.
Connor returned to his room and lay on his bed to rest. He knew that tomorrow was the last day of the Martial Artist Convention.
If Connor still couldn’t collect the last three herbs by tomorrow, then he only had one last choice, which was to follow Temira to the Celestial Flower Valley and snatch the herbs from them.
During this period of time, Connor had also learned some information about the valley from the other warriors.
Celestial Flower Valley had the most medicinal herbs in the country and also had many varieties of herbs that couldn’t be found elsewhere.
However, the valley was hidden in a mysterious area. Some people could spend several years looking for it but still be unable to find its location. In addition, the people of the Celestial Flower Valley rarely contacted the outside world, which made the valley even more mysterious.
If Connor wanted to find Celestial Flower Valley, he could only choose to follow Temira. After all, as long as she left Tayton, she would definitely return there.

chapters.title: Chapter 1132: Mr. Selman
chapters.content:
Chapter 1132: Mr. Selman
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
The next day, at eight o’clock in the morning.
Connor once again went to the Malone family villas. Then, as usual, he found his own stall and started to set up.
Today was the last day of the Martial Artist Gathering. He hoped that he could collect the last three medicinal herbs.
And those martial artists in the hall basically already knew Connor’s identity. Therefore, even if they didn’t have what he needed, they still came over to greet him very politely, to which Connor responded likewise.
Connor had just sat down for less than half an hour when a woman walked up to him.
“Mr. McDonald, do you think this is the thousand-year-old flame reishi mushroom that you need?!” an extremely cold voice said in Connor’s ears.
...
After hearing this voice, Connor slowly looked up and found that the person standing in front of him was none other than Temira of the Celestial Flower Valley.
Temira was wearing a long white dress today. Her tall figure looked especially attractive under the long dress, making people’s imaginations run wild.
At this moment, Temira was holding a brocade box in her hand. Inside the brocade box was exactly the thousand-year-old reishi mushroom that Connor needed.
After hearing Temira’s words, the surrounding martial artists all gathered around Temira.
After all, a thousand-year-old reishi mushroom mushroom was very rare. Moreover, it was a flame reishi mushroom, which made people even more curious.
“As expected of the Celestial Flower Valley, you can actually find the thousand-year-old flame reishi mushroom!”
“That’s right. I think that only the Celestial Flower Valley can grow thousand-year-old flame reishi mushrooms. There’s no way for it to grow elsewhere…”
Everyone started discussing in low voices.
Connor could not help but frown. He said coldly, “I have said that I will only exchange medicinal pills with you and will not tell you the pill refinement method. Therefore, it is best that you do not waste your energy here…”
“Mr. McDonald, you might have misunderstood. I’m not here to exchange medicinal pills with you. I want to give this flame reishi mushroom to you directly…”
Temira whispered.
“For me?”
Connor was stunned when he heard Temira’s words.
Everyone else present was also dumbfounded. The expression on their faces seemed to be of extreme shock. After all, the thousand-year-old flame reishi mushroom was extremely rare.
However, no one had expected Temira to be so generous as to directly give this thousand-year-old flame reishi mushroom to Connor.
Connor knew that Temira would never be so kind, so he asked, “Why are you giving it to me?”
“There’s no reason. Our Celestial Flower Valley just wants to hand it over as a friendly gesture, Mr. McDonald…” Temira smiled faintly.
“A friendly gesture?”
After Connor heard Temira’s words, he couldn’t help but sneer, and then lightly said, “I’m sorry, I don’t want to be friends with your Celestial Flower Valley. You should take it back!”
Connor wasn’t a fool. That day when Louis and Salvador attacked Connor, it had something to do with the Malone family, Temira, and the Wess family.
Therefore, Connor knew that Temira definitely did not simply want to befriend him. She must have some unspeakable secret. Connor definitely did not dare to use such a thousand-year-old reishi mushroom.
“You…”
Temira stared at Connor. She was shocked because she never thought that Connor would reject her.
It was the honor of many warriors to be acquainted with the Celestial Flower Valley. No one had ever dared to turn them down.
Therefore, when those martial artists present looked at Connor, they were naturally very shocked.
“Since Mr. McDonald doesn’t want it, then forget it…”
Although Temira was very angry, she didn’t show it. Instead, she said this in a cold tone and turned to leave.
After Temira left, everyone looked at Connor with a puzzled expression.
After all, Connor had offended too many people in these few days.
These martial artists really could not understand where Connor got the courage to go against these people.
After Temira left the hall, she returned to her room.
After entering the room, an old man raised his head and looked at the brocade box in Temira’s hand. Then, he frowned and asked, “That kid didn’t accept it?”
“No…”
Temira shook her head helplessly, then opened the brocade box and took out the tracking device.
Originally, Temira and the old man had planned to give this flame reishi mushroom to Connor.
This way, after Connor left Tayton, they could track Connor’s exact location and find the person who refined the pill.
After all, Temira knew that these medicinal pills were definitely not refined by Connor. They wanted to find the person who really refined the pills!
“Could it be that this kid discovered it?” the old man asked in a low voice.
“That shouldn’t be the case. Connor didn’t even look at this box. How could he know that there was a tracker inside?”
Temira replied in a low voice.
The old man hesitated for two seconds before saying in a low voice, “Since it didn’t work, I can only personally take action. After all, the secret recipe to refine this kind of medicinal pill is extremely precious. It can only be encountered by chance and not be sought after. We must not miss this opportunity…”
After Temira heard the old man’s words, a strange look flashed across her eyes. However, after hesitating for two seconds, she did not say anything.
…
Meanwhile, Connor was alone in the hall, setting up a stall for the entire morning.
However, Connor still did not receive the medicinal herbs he wanted, so he thought of leaving.
Since Temira of the Celestial Flower Valley could take out the thousand-year-old flame reishi mushroom, there must be other herbs in the valley.
Therefore, it was the simplest and most direct way to go to the Celestial Flower Valley to snatch the medicinal herbs.
Although this method was very risky, Connor was willing to risk it for Freya.
However, just as Connor was about to leave the hall, there was a sudden noise at the entrance of the hall.
Connor subconsciously looked up at the door and saw an old man walking into the hall.
“It’s Mr. Selman from the Celestial Flower Valley…”
“Oh my god, it is actually Mr. Selman…”
“Why is Mr. Selman here? Could it be for Connor?”
At this moment, many martial artists in the hall had already recognized the old man’s identity and shouted excitedly.
There were two people following behind Mr. Selman. One of them was Terry, and the other was Aaron Malone.
This so-called Mr. Selman had a very high status in the Celestial Flower Valley, so much so that even Terry’s attitude towards Mr. Selman was very respectful. The martial artists in the hall naturally did not need to be mentioned—they bowed to Mr. Selman one after another.

chapters.title: Chapter 1133: Empty Promise
chapters.content:
Chapter 1133: Empty Promise
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
However, Mr. Selman’s attitude was extremely arrogant. He did not even look at these people and directly walked towards Connor.
Very clearly, he was, just as everyone guessed, coming for Connor.
“Looks like Connor has really angered the Celestial Flower Valley this time around…”
“Exactly! Connor is too arrogant to offend the Celestial Flower Valley.”
“Now that even Mr. Selman is here, I feel that Connor will definitely die today. He will not have a good ending…”
Everyone looked at Connor and began to discuss softly.
...
Previously, Temira had taken the initiative to express her goodwill to Connor, but Connor had directly rejected her in front of so many people. From then on, Connor had already formed a grudge with the Celestial Flower Valley.
Soon enough, Mr. Selman walked in front of Connor and asked softly, “You should be Connor, right?”
“Is there something you need?”
Connor raised his head to look at Mr. Selman and asked in a very calm tone.
“I heard that you have a top-grade body tempering pill, right?”
Mr. Selman continued to ask.
“Yes, if you want it, you can exchange it with the herbs I need!”
Connor nodded lightly.
“Exchange?”
After Mr. Selman heard Connor’s words, he could not help but sneer. Then, he said expressionlessly, “Hehe, you’re really naive. The Body Tempering Pill belongs to our Celestial Flower Valley, so why should I trade with you?”
After Connor heard Mr. Selman’s words, a trace of strangeness flashed across his eyes.
He could feel that the other party had come with ill intentions, and that Mr. Selman was likely here to find trouble with him.
However, Connor did not show any anger. Instead, he raised his head and glanced at Mr. Selman. He asked calmly, “What do you mean?”
“Don’t you know what I mean? The Body Tempering Pill originally belonged to Celestial Flower Valley. In the entirety of Oprana, only the Valley Elder of Celestial Flower Valley can refine the Body Tempering Pill. However, some time ago, the Body Tempering Pill of Celestial Flower Valley was stolen, and now it’s appeared in your hands. Shouldn’t you explain what happened?” Mr. Selman shouted in a powerful voice.
“What?”
“Connor actually stole the Body Tempering Pill?”
“How is that possible? Connor is actually so bold!”
Everyone began to discuss in low voices.
At this moment, someone murmured, “Do you guys have no brains? How could Connor steal it? It was just an excuse that Celestial Flower Valley made up. If Connor really stole it, why didn’t Miss Yakes tell him about it when she first saw him? Why did she take the initiative to rope Connor in?”
“So it’s like that…Poor Connor. He’s really unlucky…”
After everyone understood what was going on, they all looked at Connor with pitiful eyes. They knew that the Celestial Flower Valley was just looking for an excuse to deal with Connor.
Connor smiled faintly. After all, this Body Tempering Pill was given to him by Jorge Yarrell. According to the old man’s personality, he would never steal from others—he’d snatch it them. So, Connor naturally understood what was going on.
“Mr. McDonald, we know that you didn’t steal the pill. If you can tell us who gave you the pill, the Celestial Flower Valley will reward you handsomely,” Mr. Selman continued after seeing that Connor did not speak.
“If I really tell you who that person is, you’ll probably piss your pants on the spot…” Connor said disdainfully.
When everyone heard Connor’s words, they immediately went into an uproar. After all, Connor was humiliating the Celestial Flower Valley elder!
The expression on Mr. Selman’s face was naturally very angry. He glared at Connor and shouted, “Little man, do you mean you don’t want to cooperate?”
“So what if I don’t cooperate with you?” Connor said indifferently.
“I originally planned to give you a chance to make up for your mistakes, but I didn’t expect you to be so ungrateful. In that case, don’t blame me for being rude. As long as you offend the people of our Celestial Flower Valley, you won’t have a good ending!” Mr. Selman shouted excitedly.
After everyone heard Mr. Selman’s words, they instantly fell into a deathly silence.
Everyone stood rooted to the ground, not daring to say a word.
They all knew how terrifying Mr. Selman was.
Terry, on the other hand, looked smug, as if he had no intention of caring about this matter at all.
Aaron Malone, who had previously flattered Connor and gifted Mina to him, now looked like he was watching a show. He would not offend the Celestial Flower Valley because of Connor.
However, the expression on Connor’s face was somewhat disdainful. He softly said to Mr. Selman, “Celestial Flower Valley is really overbearing. You don’t have any evidence and you say that I stole these pills. Are you going to kill me now?”
“I won’t kill you, but I have a hundred ways to make you tell me who stole the pill!”
Mr. Selman replied with a gloomy expression.
Connor was not in the mood to talk nonsense with him now, so he retorted, “Then try them!”
“You want to do it the hard way, I see!”
A trace of anger flashed across Mr. Selman’s eyes.
But at this moment, a woman’s voice came from the hall. “Mr. Selman, wait a moment!”
When everyone heard this voice, they turned their heads to look at the entrance of the hall.
Temira quickly walked toward Connor and said to him softly, “Mr. McDonald, I know that you have nothing to do with stealing the pills. Now, as long as you tell us the location of the person who stole the pills, our Celestial Flower Valley will definitely reward you heavily. Moreover, I can promise to let you join our Celestial Flower Valley. As for the medicinal herbs you want, I can also provide them to you. I hope you don’t make a mistake this time!”
It was obvious that Temira and Mr. Selman, one with a sour face and one with a sweet face, were trying to get Connor to reveal Jorge’s location and then obtain the refining method of the Body Tempering Pill from him.
As for the conditions that Temira had promised Connor, they were all empty promises. Once Connor lost his value, they would definitely get rid of him at the first possible moment.
The martial artists present looked at Connor with envious expressions on their faces.
The temptation of joining the Celestial Flower Valley was still very great for them. Countless people dreamed of joining the Valley, but unfortunately, they were not qualified at all.

chapters.title: Chapter 1134: Two Helpers
chapters.content:
Chapter 1134: Two Helpers
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
“She’s already offered such conditions, so what is Connor still hesitating about?”
“That’s right. If it were me, I would have agreed to Miss Yakes’s request long ago!”
“Ai, this Connor really doesn’t know what’s good for him. The Celestial Flower Valley has already offered such good conditions. If he still doesn’t agree, then there must be something wrong with his brain…”
Everyone began to discuss in low voices.
Temira saw that Connor did not speak for a long time and could not help but hesitate for a moment before asking Connor softly, “Mr. McDonald, have you thought about it?”
Connor was really too lazy to argue with Temira and this Mr. Selman, so he replied in a very cold tone. “Alright, stop acting with me. To put it bluntly, don’t you just want the secret recipe of the Body Tempering Pill? But let me tell you, it’s impossible for you to get that recipe, so you’d better get out of my sight. Otherwise, don’t blame me for being rude!”
...
After Mr. Selman saw that Connor wasn’t yielding at all, his expression became even angrier as he shouted, “Brat, you’re too arrogant!”
Temira also had a helpless look on her face. She didn’t know what to do at this point.
“Why are you so stubborn?”
Temira sighed helplessly.
“Kid, we gave you a chance just now, but since you don’t know how to cherish it, don’t blame us for being merciless. I’m going to drag you back to the Celestial Flower Valley now and ask you about the whereabouts of the pill thief!”
Mr. Selman’s eyes widened as he shouted at Connor with an abnormally angry expression.
“Do you think you can defeat me alone?” Connor sized up Mr. Selman from head to toe, the expression on his face extremely disdainful.
Mr. Selman had already heard about Connor dealing with Louis’s gang all by himself.
Although he was the Valley Elder, he wasn’t a very high level fighter—only a medium-level yellow rank.
Temira’s evaluation of Connor was that his strength was above a high-level yellow-rank, so Mr. Selman naturally wouldn’t be stupid enough to want to fight Connor alone.
“Connor, I know that your skills are extraordinary, but since I dare to stand in front of you, it proves that I have made sufficient preparations. Otherwise, why would I come?”
Mr. Selman declared.
“You have helpers?”
Connor frowned slightly.
“That’s right, I’m Mr. Selman’s helper!”
At this moment, an old voice came from the entrance of the hall.
Then, everyone heard heavy footsteps, and a skinny old man slowly walked into the hall.
When everyone saw this old man, they all revealed a strange expression.
Although the old man looked emaciated, Connor could clearly feel that the aura coming off the old man’s body was very powerful, and he seemed to be very strong.
Soon, someone in the crowd recognized the old man’s identity and hurriedly exclaimed, It’s Mr. Hogan!”
“Isn’t Mr. Hogan in seclusion? Why did he come out?”
“That’s right. I didn’t expect Mr. Hogan to actually come over…”
Everyone began to discuss in low voices.
“And me!”
Immediately after, another furious roar came from the entrance of the hall, and a tall, burly man rushed in.
When everyone saw this burly man, their expressions changed again.
“It’s Herbert Camidge?!”
“I didn’t expect Herbert to also come here…”
Everyone exclaimed in surprise.
In an instant, everyone looked at Connor with even more helplessness.
Hogan and Herbert were both high-level Yellow ranked martial artists, while Mr. Selman was a middle-level Yellow rank.
If the three of them attacked together, even a Black-rank wouldn’t be able to take it.
Therefore, Connor would definitely die today.
Temira looked at Connor, her eyes filled with helplessness. She thought, “Originally, I had intended to give you a chance to live, but I did not expect you to be so ungrateful. Now, I can’t do anything…”
In fact, Temira didn’t want to see this happen, but Connor was too arrogant, and thus she had no choice.
Connor sized up Hogan and Herbert with a hint of confusion in his eyes. He did not know when he had offended these two people.
At this moment, Herbert stepped forward and shouted at Connor.
“Are you the murderer who killed my brother?”
“Your brother?”
After Connor heard Herbert’s words, a trace of doubt flashed across his eyes, as if he did not understand what Herbert meant.
“That’s right. Did you kill my brother Yadiel Camidge?” Herbert repeated.
“Yadiel Camidge is dead?”
The expression on Connor’s face instantly changed.
“Kid, don’t play dumb with me. Didn’t you kill my brother? Why are you pretending to be innocent?” Herbert shouted excitedly at Connor.
Connor had just learned of Yadiel’s death, but he did not kill Yadiel, Louis, Salvador, and the others that night. Someone must have framed him.
Connor’s first reaction was that Terry had done this!
Therefore, Connor suddenly turned his head to look at Terry, while Terry looked at Connor proudly.
Connor instantly understood what was going on, but he really couldn’t understand. There was no grudge between him and Terry, so why would Terry frame him?
“Brat, my son Salvador was also killed by you, right?”
At this moment, Hogan stepped forward and shouted at Connor.
“…”
Connor looked at Hogan and hesitated for two seconds before saying expressionlessly, “Although I did fight Salvador, Yadiel, and the others that day, I didn’t kill them. Instead, I crippled their martial arts. Someone else killed them.”
Herbert was not in the mood to listen to Connor’s explanation. He shouted angrily, “Brat, things are already at this point, yet you still dare to lie. Do you think you’re worthy of being a martial artist?”
After Connor saw Herbert’s attitude, he knew that even if he tried to explain now, these people would probably not listen.
These two people were obviously being used by the Malone family and the Celestial Flower Valley.
Connor took a deep breath and looked at Hogan and Herbert. “Since you don’t want to listen to my explanation, I can’t do anything about it. Even if I killed Yadiel and Salvador, what can you do?”

chapters.title: Chapter 1135: The Best Choice
chapters.content:
Chapter 1135: The Best Choice
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
“So what?”
Hogan sneered and said coldly, “Then you’ll pay with blood!”
After saying this, Hogan raised his fist and smashed it towards Connor.
Connor was already prepared, however; he dodged Hogan’s fist, then took out a pill from his pocket and threw it into his mouth.
Connor knew that Hogan, Herbert, and Mr. Selman were all extremely powerful. If he did not consume the pill, he would have no chance of winning.
After eating the medicinal pill, Connor felt the strength in his body instantly soar.
...
Hogan didn’t give up after his punch missed. He took two steps forward and raised his fist again, smashing it towards Connor’s head with a deafening sound.
Hogan’s punch did not have any technique to speak of. It was completely based on the strength in his body. However, the power of this punch was indeed extremely shocking.
When the martial artists present saw this scene, they were instantly stunned on the spot, and the expressions on their faces were extremely shocked.
“Tiger Roar!” Connor growled, but he didn’t dodge. Instead, he punched Hogan.
“Bang!”
Connor’s fist collided with Hogan’s fist.
Connor took two steps back and steadied his body.
Meanwhile, Hogan was sent flying and smashed into the wall, creating a deep hole in it.
Previously, when everyone heard that Connor had defeated Salvador, Louis, Yadiel, Lance and the others, they all doubted Connor’s strength.
After all, Connor was still so young. He did not look like an expert.
One had to know that when they were Connor’s age, they did not even know what a martial artist was. However, after seeing this scene, they instantly knew that Connor’s strength was indeed very terrifying.
Temira narrowed her eyes and looked at Connor. At this moment, Temira seemed to have seen through Connor’s secret.
Because Temira had just discovered that Connor had consumed a medicinal pill before the battle.
After eating the medicinal pill, Connor’s strength suddenly soared.
But before Connor ate the medicinal pill, his strength was no different from ordinary martial artists at all.
On the other side, after Hogan slammed into the wall, he was completely fine. Instead, he stood up and shouted at Connor, “Brat, you are indeed powerful. No wonder my son died in your hands. Let’s continue!”
After saying this, Hogan once again rushed towards Connor.
When everyone saw that Hogan was about to attack Connor again, they took the initiative to make way for him.
After all, they knew that the strength of the two of them was extremely terrifying. No one wanted to be caught in th crossfire.
Connor narrowed his eyes as he looked at Hogan. He didn’t expect Hogan to be unharmed after being punched by him.
This meant that Hogan’s combat power was not on the same level as Salvador and the others.
At this moment, Hogan once again rushed in front of Connor and started fighting with him.
This time, he didn’t choose to fight head-on, but a few seconds later, Connor sent Hogan flying with another punch.
Hogan’s body was sent flying backwards, and he smashed into the wall again. This time, Hogan’s body smashed into the wall and created several cracks.
If not for the fact that the material of the house was better, it would have collapsed long ago.
When everyone saw this scene, their mouths were wide open, and their expressions were indescribably shocked.
No one had thought that Connor’s strength was actually already terrifying to such an extent.
A high level golden class fighter was so weak when compared to Connor, to the point where he couldn’t fight back at all. It was a one-sided battle!
“You want to capture me?” Connor sneered disdainfully.
After Mr. Selman heard Connor’s words, the expression on his face was very ugly.
Although Hogan wasn’t injured, he wouldn’t be able to last long in front of Connor. Furthermore, Hogan had no way to hurt Connor, so Mr. Selman felt that he might have underestimated Connor’s strength.
“Brat, don’t be too smug. Let me fight you!”
At this moment, Herbert suddenly shouted at Connor. After saying this, Herbert rushed towards Connor.
However, what everyone did not expect was that Herbert and Hogan were unable to injure Connor at all. On the contrary, the two of them were at a disadvantage.
“Who is this Connor?”
Mr. Selman stared at Connor with his eyes wide open, the expression on his face unusually panicked.
He had never thought that Herbert and Hogan would not be a match for Connor even if they joined forces.
“Bang!”
At this moment, Connor sent Hogan flying with a punch, followed by a kick on Herbert’s stomach.
Both of them were sent flying.
In an instant, the entire hall fell silent.
When Mr. Selman saw this, his expression twisted. Hogan and Herbert hurriedly retreated to Mr. Selman’s side.
“Mr. Selman, there’s something wrong with this kid. The two of us are not a match for him!”
Herbert whispered to Mr. Selman.
“Yeah, I didn’t expect that this kid’s strength would be so terrifying despite his young age. Moreover, his reaction speed is also very fast. The two of us are simply not a match for him!” Hogan said.
“…”
Mr. Selman’s expression was unusually ugly when he heard the two of them.
He hesitated for two seconds before turning his head to look at the location of Mr. Wess.
“Mr. Wess, don’t just stand by and watch. As long as we can subdue this kid today and find the method to refine the Body Tempering Pill, my Celestial Flower Valley is willing to cooperate with your Wess family. At that time, we can have a win-win situation.”
Mr. Selman shouted at Mr. Wess in a low voice.
“Hehe, now that you can’t beat him, you think of me?” Mr. Wess replied with a smile.
“Mr. Wess, with just yours and my strength, there’s absolutely no way to subdue this kid. Now, the best choice is for the two of us to cooperate!”
Mr. Selman said helplessly.
“…”
Mr. Wess sized up Connor and said softly, “Mr. McDonald, if you want to cooperate with the Wess family now, I can help you leave this place. However, you have to help us find the person who can refine the Body Tempering Pill. Otherwise, I can only choose to cooperate with the Celestial Flower Valley…”
It was obvious that Mr. Wess still hoped to monopolize the secret recipe of the Body Tempering Pill.
That was why he chose to discuss the matter of cooperation with Connor at this time.

chapters.title: Chapter 1136: What Other Trump Cards Could He Still Have?
chapters.content:
Chapter 1136: What Other Trump Cards Could He Still Have?
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
“I don’t need your help to leave this place!”
Connor said to Mr. Wess with a disdainful expression.
“Hehe, Mr. McDonald, I advise you to think it over carefully!”
“The people in the Celestial Flower Valley have always been ruthless. If you really fall into their hands, your life may end. Their methods of torture can make people wish they were dead…”
Mr. Wess looked at Connor and continued.
“Cut the crap. Since you want to cooperate with the Celestial Flower Valley, just come at me…”
...
Connor replied coldly.
“Sigh…”
Mr. Wess looked at Connor and sighed helplessly. Then, he slowly walked to Mr. Selman’s side, as if he was expressing his stance.
Connor hesitated for a moment before turning to look at Aaron and Terry. He asked softly, “What is the meaning of this?”
Aaron looked at Connor without saying anything.
Terry hesitated for a moment and then said in a low voice, “If you can help us find the method to refine the Body Tempering Pill, I can save you and help you find the herbs you need. As for the other things, I can’t give them to you now!”
“Haha…”
Connor looked at Terry and sneered. Then, he said indifferently, “I was planning to give Mina face and give your family a chance, but since you have chosen to do this, looks like it doesn’t matter anymore!”
Connor looked down at his phone and realized that half an hour had passed. There was still an hour left for the effect of the pill.
This one hour should be enough for Connor to deal with these people.
“Stop talking nonsense. Since you have already made your choice, then just make your move!”
Connor didn’t want to waste any more time, so he shouted expressionlessly.
When Herbert, Hogan, and Mr. Wess heard Connor’s words, they rushed toward Connor.
At this time, Mr. Selman’s expression was unusually smug. Although Herbert and Hogan couldn’t do anything to Connor just now, Mr. Wess was now here, and he himself was here as well.
Therefore, Connor would definitely die today. There was no chance of winning at all.
Temira looked at Connor with a helpless expression.
After all, she did not want to hurt Connor because she felt that he was innocent.
As long as Connor could tell them where he got the Body Tempering Pill, they would not make things difficult for him anymore. On the contrary, they could even give Connor some benefits.
However, Temira really couldn’t understand where Connor got his confidence from. Even in the face of so many experts, he was still unwilling to tell them the whereabouts of the Body Tempering Pill.
An ordinary man is innocent, but holding a treasure is a crime!
However, at this moment, Temira was more or less puzzled.
Because she couldn’t understand how Connor could remain so calm in the face of so many people working together.
If it were anyone else, they would have been captured long ago, right?
Now, there were two yellow rank advanced level martial artists and an unfathomable Mr. Wess attacking at the same time.
Even a black rank beginner level martial artist would have a headache facing this situation.
And Connor was still very young, so he definitely couldn’t be a black rank beginner level martial artist.
“Does Connor still have some kind of trump card?”
This thought suddenly flashed across Temira’s mind.
What she didn’t know was that Connor’s current strength was comparable to a black rank martial artist, and an intermediate level one at that. This was his biggest trump card.
At this moment, Connor was already fighting with Hogan, Herbert, and Mr. Wess.
The three of them had a tacit understanding. Hogan and Herbert were mainly responsible for harassing Connor and diverting his attention, while Mr. Wess was looking for an opportunity to attack Connor.
Mr. Wess took advantage of Connor’s attention on Herbert and Hogan to sneak attack Connor from behind and punch him in the back.
Connor was caught off guard and took Mr. Wess’s punch head-on. Then he took two steps back to stabilize his body.
When Mr. Selman saw this scene, he appeared to be a little excited. He said in a low voice, “It seems that teaming up with Mr. Wess was the right choice. Mr. Wess’s strength is indeed extraordinary!”
“Mr. Wess should be at least a yellow rank advanced level martial artist, right?”
Terry narrowed his eyes and sighed softly.
“Yes, Mr. Wess is indeed terrifying!”
Aaron nodded lightly.
“Then, I wonder who is more powerful, you or Mr. Wess?”
Terry asked softly after a moment of hesitation.
“I’m definitely not Mr. Wess’s match!”
Aaron answered before continuing, “Right now, in the entire Malone Family, the only one who can fight with Mr. Wess is the head of the family. After all, the head of the family is a black rank martial artist.”
“Black rank?!”
When Terry heard this, he could not help but gasp. Then, he said in a low voice, “I’ve never seen the head of the family fight in my entire life. I don’t know how terrifying a black rank is!”
“The strength of a black rank has long surpassed the range of ordinary people like us, and the ancient martial arts are gradually declining. There are fewer and fewer martial artists who can break through to the black rank, so there are fewer and fewer chances of you seeing him make a move!”
Aaron whispered,
“Yeah…”
Terry nodded gently and narrowed his eyes as he looked at Connor. A strange look flashed across his eyes.
“Connor is indeed quite strong. He actually has such terrifying combat strength at such a young age. Even I am a little envious!”
Terry looked at Connor and sighed.
After all, if he were in the same situation and Connor was in his place, Terry might have already lost.
“Connor’s strength is indeed terrifying. He can be considered a genius to have such strength at such a young age. It’s just a pity that he’s way too arrogant. He doesn’t know how to hide his strength and bide his time. If he chooses to cooperate with any of the three families now, he won’t have to end up like this!”
Aaron said slowly.
“I have this feeling that Connor has some trump card that he hasn’t shown us yet!”
Terry hesitated for a moment and then said softly.
“At this point, what other trump cards can Connor have?”
Aaron looked at Terry and smiled disdainfully.
Terry took a deep breath and said in a low voice, “I hope he doesn’t have any!”
Just as Aaron and Terry were talking, the battle between Connor, Herbert, Hogan, and the others had reached its climax.

chapters.title: Chapter 1137: A Sudden Increase in Strength!
chapters.content:
Chapter 1137: A Sudden Increase in Strength!
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Although Connor’s strength was already comparable to a black rank intermediate level martial artist.
However, because Connor’s combat experience was not very rich, he was quickly restrained by these three people.
The three of them had a clear strategy. Herbert and Hogan were in charge of harassing Connor and diverting his attention.
Meanwhile, Mr. Wess kept looking for opportunities to attack Connor.
Those martial artists present could all see that Connor was already at a disadvantage.
At this moment, the hall was in a mess. Countless tables and chairs had been smashed into pieces, and the walls were covered in cracks.
...
As for the martial artists who were initially standing in the hall to watch the show, they were afraid that they might be implicated, so they were all hiding outside the hall.
Mr. Selman of the Celestial Flower Valley looked at Connor with an extremely smug expression.
Because he knew that if this continued on, Connor definitely wouldn’t be able to hold on for long before he collapsed.
“I didn’t think it would be so difficult to deal with Connor…”
Mr. Selman could not help but sigh softly.
However, at this moment, Mr. Wess seized the opportunity and rushed in front of Connor.
He clenched his fist as if he was using all his strength to punch Connor in the stomach.
Bang!
There was a loud bang.
Before Connor could react to what was happening, his body flew out and smashed into the wall.
After Connor landed on the ground, he spat out a mouthful of blood.
When everyone saw this scene, they all felt that it was such a shame.
After all, they thought that Connor could create a miracle, but now it seemed that there was no miracle at all.
When Connor faced the two of them, he still had the strength to fight, and he could do it with ease.
But when facing three people, Connor had no chance of winning at all.
This was also the first time that Connor was sent flying. Everyone felt that from the moment Connor was knocked down by Mr. Wess, the outcome had already been decided.
Temira looked at Connor, feeling somewhat helpless. She sighed softly, “If you knew this would happen, you wouldn’t have done it in the first place!”
Mr. Selman revealed a smug smile. He stepped forward and shouted at Connor, “Connor, you should just admit defeat. It’s impossible for you to win…”
Thinking that Connor was already at such a state, Mr. Selman believed that Connor no longer had the ability to fight back.
The others naturally had the same thought. No one could understand why Connor insisted on not telling them where he got the Body Tempering Pill.
As long as Connor told them the origin of the Body Tempering Pill, the Wess Family, Celestial Flower Valley, or even the Malone Family wouldn’t make things difficult for him.
Although Connor was powerful, his strength was insignificant when facing the three big families.
“I can still fight. Why should I admit defeat?”
Connor slowly raised his head and glanced at Mr. Selman. His tone was extremely calm as he asked Mr. Selman.
“You’re already in such a state. Do you still think you have a chance of winning?”
Mr. Selman asked Connor in confusion.
“Of course, I still have a chance of winning!”
Connor looked at Mr. Selman and smiled. Then, he continued, “And I have you all to thank for that!”
Just now, after Connor was sent flying by Mr. Wess’s punch, he suddenly understood what the Chi Manipulation Technique meant by filling the seven tendons with Chi and recoiling.
When Connor was cultivating, he had no way to fill his seven tendons and eight meridians with his Chi. Therefore, Connor’s cultivation of the Chi Manipulation Technique was stuck.
Connor was going to ask Jorge Yarrell about this when he returned to Porhampton
However, when Connor was fighting Mr. Wess and the others, Connor suddenly understood that the Chi mentioned here wasn’t Connor’s Chi, but the enemy’s Chi.
Recoil surge meant that the attack of the opponent would recoil and convert into the power he needed, filling his seven tendons and eight meridians.
So Connor deliberately gave Mr. Wess a chance just now.
Reality proved that Connor’s guess was not wrong.
Not only did Mr. Wess’s punch not bring any real harm to Connor, but it also deepened Connor’s understanding of the Chi Manipulation Technique.
At this moment, Connor was also more adept at controlling the Chi in his body.
Connor then rushed toward Herbert.
This time, Connor’s speed seemed to be more than ten times faster than before.
In less than an instant, he had arrived in front of Herbert and punched him in the stomach.
“Ah…”
Herbert didn’t even have time to react to what had happened. After letting out a miserable cry, his entire body slammed into the wall. Then, he spat out a mouthful of blood and fainted.
When Mr. Selman saw this scene, he was completely dumbfounded. He stood rooted to the ground with a dumbfounded expression on his face.
Even though Connor had displayed extremely powerful strength in the battle with Herbert, Hogan, and Mr. Wess.
However, Herbert had always been able to persevere and had never been knocked unconscious by Connor.
But this time, Connor actually knocked Herbert out with a punch. This was really somewhat unbelievable.
Moreover, everyone could feel that Connor’s current strength was clearly greater than before.
Just as everyone was in shock, Connor rushed toward Mr. Wess again.
Mr. Wess’s reaction speed was very fast. He hurriedly took two steps back to dodge.
However, Hogan, who was standing beside Mr. Wess, didn’t react. When he saw Connor’s fist coming, he knew that it was impossible for him to dodge it.
Therefore, after Hogan hesitated for a while, he placed his hands in front of his chest, preparing to take Connor’s punch.
However, Hogan had underestimated Connor’s strength.
Connor’s fist smashed onto Hogan’s arm.
Crack!
Everyone could clearly hear the crisp sound of bones cracking.
“Ah…”
Following that was Hogan’s scream.
Hogan’s hands were broken by Connor’s punch. He fell to the ground and howled in pain.
For a moment, everyone was stunned.
No one had expected Connor’s strength to be so terrifying. He had actually defeated Hogan and Herbert in succession.
“What… What’s going on?”
Mr. Selman stared at Connor with his eyes wide open, extremely shocked.

chapters.title: Chapter 1138: Let You Go?
chapters.content:
Chapter 1138: Let You Go?
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Terry Malone’s eyes widened in disbelief.
He never thought that Connor, who was originally at a disadvantage, would actually turn the situation around in an instant.
Originally, the three of them were attacking Connor, but in an instant, Mr. Wess was the only one left.
Aaron Malone looked at Connor with an ugly expression.
It was because they realized that everyone had underestimated Connor’s strength.
Temira stood there foolishly. She was waiting for Connor to use his final trump card.
...
But at this time, she realized that Connor did not need any trump cards at all, because he was his final trump card.
“Mr. Selman, what should we do now?”
Temira asked Mr. Selman with a terrified expression.
“I… I don’t know what to do either!”
Mr. Selman stammered.
But at this moment, Connor had already rushed toward Mr. Wess.
Mr. Wess instinctively turned around and punched Connor in the chest.
Connor took two steps back and then charged at Mr. Wess again.
“Mr. Selman, do you still intend to stand there and watch the show?”
Mr. Wess shouted at Mr. Selman in a hurry.
Mr. Selman stood on the spot and hesitated for a couple of seconds. However, his next move surprised everyone.
Mr. Selman did not care about the safety of Temira, Mr. Wess, and the others at all. He turned around and ran into the distance.
No one had expected that the instigator of this matter would actually choose to escape.
Even Temira did not expect that Mr. Selman would actually choose to give up on the two of them.
Mr. Wess looked at the spot where Mr. Selman had disappeared from, and he was unusually angry and helpless.
It was because he now knew that Mr. Selman had no intention of making a move from the beginning to the end. He was just sitting back, waiting to reap the benefits!
At this time, Connor was already right in front of Mr. Wess. Then, he turned and slapped Mr. Wess in the face.
Mr. Wess screamed as he was flung aside. Then, he slammed into the wall and fainted.
For a moment, everyone present fell silent as they looked at Connor in a daze.
No one had expected that things would end up like this.
Hogan, Herbert, and Mr. Wess had joined forces, but they were not Connor’s match.
Meanwhile, Mr. Selman had already run off to God knows where.
Temira stood rooted to the ground, her face filled with fear. She was worried that Connor would attack her next.
However, Connor didn’t attack Temira. Instead, he looked at Terry and asked him expressionlessly, “Now, only the Malone Family is left, right? How does the Malone Family plan to resolve this matter?”
Terry did not expect such an outcome either. He stared at Connor with a dark face.
However, he did not dare to act rashly because he knew how terrifying Connor was.
Connor knew very well that this matter must have a lot to do with the Malone Family, so he naturally wouldn’t let these people off.
Meanwhile, Terry seemed to be completely dumbfounded. He did not know how to answer Connor’s question.
After hesitating for a moment, Aaron took a step forward and said, “Mr. McDonald, what happened before was indeed our family’s fault, but we don’t have any deep hatred for you. Can you let us go on account of Mina?”
“Let you go?”
After hearing Aaron’s words, Connor revealed a smug smile and said coldly, “Do you think I’m unaware of what the Malone Family has done? You killed Louis Schooling and the others, and you’re the mastermind behind everything that happened today. From the beginning to the end, it was the Malone Family’s scheme against me. Now, you’re actually saying that there is no deep hatred between the Malone Family and me. Do you think I’m a fool?”
Aaron stared at Connor with his eyes wide open. He didn’t know that Connor already knew that the Malone Family was behind all of this.
“I didn’t expect you to know everything…”
Aaron could not help but laugh bitterly.
At this moment, Terry still had a glimmer of hope in his heart.
He took a step forward and shouted, “Connor, don’t forget that this is Tayton. If you dare to attack the Malone Family, you will die!”
“Mr. Selman also said that death awaits me. Yet here I stand, alive and well.”
Connor replied expressionlessly.
“Terry, don’t waste your breath on this person. Since he wants to go against us, I’ll fight him to the death. I’ll cover you. Hurry up and find an opportunity to leave…”
Aaron whispered to Terry.
“Grandpa Aaron, you…”
Terry opened his mouth to speak.
However, Aaron did not give Terry a chance to speak. He gritted his teeth and rushed toward Connor.
“…”
When Connor saw that Aaron was about to make his move, he lowered his head to look at the time. There was still half an hour left before the pill’s effect would end. Connor felt that it shouldn’t be difficult to deal with Aaron within this half an hour.
“Stop!”
However, at this moment, a voice suddenly sounded.
When Aaron and Terry heard this voice, they were stunned almost at the same time.
The martial artists present were at a loss.
Connor did not care who was coming at this moment. He did not intend to let Aaron and Terry off.
Therefore, he rushed toward Aaron and raised his fist, ready to punch him.
However, at this moment, a figure appeared in front of Connor.
The other party’s speed was very fast. Connor did not even have the time to raise his head to see who was in front of him when he saw a large hand ruthlessly smack his chest.
Connor felt a sharp pain in his chest, and his entire body was thrown aside.
Connor’s body smashed into the crowd. At this moment, he felt as if he had been hit by a truck, and waves of pain rolled over his body.
If it wasn’t for the pill he had taken, giving him the strength of a black-rank, he would have been killed by this person.
Initially, everyone thought that the battle was over, but no one expected that the appearance of a stranger would change the situation once more.

chapters.title: Chapter 1139: Chi Receiving Pill
chapters.content:
Chapter 1139: Chi Receiving Pill
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Seeing this scene, everyone raised their heads and looked over.
The one who had sent Connor flying was a middle-aged man.
At this moment, he was wearing a white robe. He looked gentle and refined, but his eyes were exceptionally sharp.
If they hadn’t seen it with their own eyes, it would have been hard for anyone to believe that this refined middle-aged man in front of them actually possessed such terrifying strength.
Connor lay on the ground and adjusted the Chi in his body. Then, he slowly stood up and looked at the middle-aged man.
“Who is this person? He’s so powerful…”
...
“Yeah. He was actually able to send Connor flying with a single palm strike. That’s insane…”
“Could this person be…”
All the martial artists present looked at the middle-aged man with surprise.
In fact, some people had already guessed the identity of the middle-aged man. However, they felt that his age did not match the person in mind, so they did not think too much about it.
When Aaron and Terry saw the middle-aged man, they were extremely excited.
“Alexander!”
Aaron shouted excitedly.
“Grandpa Alexander, you’re here?”
Terry hurriedly said.
The middle-aged man looked at Terry and Aaron indifferently. He was still very calm.
For a moment, everyone present was in shock.
This was because they realized that they had guessed correctly. The middle-aged man who had appeared here was none other than the head of the Malone Family, Alexander Malone.
However, because Alexander practiced martial arts all year round, his appearance was similar to a middle-aged man in his forties or fifties. He even looked more than ten years younger than Aaron.
After so many years, Alexander had actually long left the mundane world and no longer showed his face in public. The family business had also been handed over to Terry, Aaron, and the others to manage.
Therefore, even if these martial artists did not know Alexander, it was not peculiar.
“He is a true black rank!”
Everyone looked at Alexander and shouted excitedly.
“Yeah, I didn’t expect that such a small matter would actually make Alexander show himself…”
“He’s really awesome…”
Everyone looked at Alexander, their eyes filled with shock.
After all, in the eyes of these martial artists, Alexander was simply a legendary figure.
They felt that if they could see Alexander attack once in their lifetime, they would have no regrets in their lives.
Even in the entire country, there weren’t many martial artists, but the number of black rank martial artists was even rarer.
Any one of them was an existence that could shake a region!
“Terry, Aaron, what you two have done today is an embarrassment to the Malone Family!””
Alexander could not help but berate them in a low voice.
“Grandpa…”
When Terry heard this, he instantly became nervous. A few drops of cold sweat appeared on his forehead as he opened his mouth to explain.
“Alexander, actually…”
Aaron also wanted to say something.
“You two don’t need to explain to me. Who are we? If we really want the Body Tempering Pill, we could have gone for it ourselves. But you two joined hands with the Celestial Flower Valley and the Wess Family. Wouldn’t it be a joke if this got out?”
Alexander continued to berate them.
When everyone heard Alexander’s words, they felt helpless.
This was because they did not expect Alexander to be angry because Terry did not ask him to help, and not because he wanted to take someone else’s stuff.
“I didn’t expect this Alexander to be even more shameless than Aaron, Terry, and the others…”
Connor could not help but sigh softly.
“Grandpa, I’m sorry. I wanted to inform you, but then I thought that Connor was just an ordinary person, so we didn’t need you to do it yourself.”
Terry heaved a long sigh of relief and hurriedly explained to Alexander.
“All of you are too careless. This brat is not as simple as you think…”
Alexander said expressionlessly.
“Alexander, I do not understand why his strength has suddenly become so powerful…”
Aaron asked with a frown.
“Haha…”
Alexander laughed faintly and sized up Connor. He said expressionlessly, “Your name is Connor McDonald, right?”
“That’s right!”
Connor nodded lightly.
“If you tell me the secret recipe of the Body Tempering Pill now, I can spare your life. This is your last chance. Don’t think I don’t know your little tricks.”
Alexander said to Connor expressionlessly.
“My little tricks?”
Connor could not help but be stunned when he heard this.
“You’re just a beginner martial artist who isn’t even at the yellow rank beginner level, but before the fight, you secretly took a Chi Receiving Pill, and your strength has increased for a short period of time. You can even reach the black rank, am I right?”
Alexander directly exposed Connor’s trump card.
When everyone heard Alexander’s words, they were all dumbfounded. They were shocked.
This was because they realized that Connor was able to defeat Hogan, Herbert and the others easily because he had consumed the Chi Receiving Pill!
The way everyone looked at Connor changed instantly.
They thought that Connor was an ancient martial arts genius, but no one expected this to be the truth.
Temira looked at Connor, and she was clearly much more at ease now.
After all, she had also seen Connor consume the medicinal pill before, but she did not understand what was going on.
“Grandpa, there really are Chi Receiving Pills in this world?”
Terry asked Alexander in surprise.
“When I was young, I once saw someone making a Chi Receiving Pill. But after so many years, I’m not sure if there’s anyone else in this world who can make a Chi Receiving Pill. However, the Chi on this person’s body is gradually decreasing as time drags on, which means that he must have taken a Chi Receiving Pill!”
Alexander replied calmly.
“Grandpa, if the person behind Connor can refine the Chi Receiving Pill and Body Tempering Pill, then if we find that person…”
Terry’s eyes flashed with excitement.
At this moment, Alexander seemed to be very interested in Connor’s Chi Receiving Pill.

chapters.title: Chapter 1140: Is He Not Afraid of Death?
chapters.content:
Chapter 1140: Is He Not Afraid of Death?
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Connor was stunned on the spot. This was the first time he had heard the name of the Chi Receiving Pill.
When Jorge Yarrell gave Connor the pill, he didn’t tell him what it was called.
However, Connor did not have the mood to think about these things at the moment because his biggest trump card had been discovered by Alexander, so Connor was currently in a very precarious situation.
“Connor, although the Chi Receiving Pill is powerful, it can only last for a limited time. As long as I stall you, you will die once the medicinal effect wears off!
“Therefore, I advise you to be sensible. In this way, not only can I spare your life, but I can also give you some benefits…”
Alexander said expressionlessly.
...
“You really talk too much! If you really want to know where I obtained these medicinal pills, then you have to defeat me first…”
Connor replied in a low voice. Then, he reached into his clothes and took out the last Chi Receiving Pill.
After all, the Chi in Connor’s body was about to disappear. He wanted to eat another Chi Receiving Pill to get through this crisis.
Alexander saw through Connor’s intention at a glance. He waved his right hand gently, and a stone hit Connor’s wrist.
The pill in Connor’s hand fell to the ground.
In an instant, the warriors present seemed to have gone crazy and started to fight for the Chi Receiving Pill.
After all, in their eyes, this pill was a life-saving treasure!
Connor watched helplessly as the pill was snatched away by those martial artists. He was extremely helpless because his last hope had been destroyed.
Alexander looked at Connor, and a hint of pride flashed across his eyes. He said expressionlessly, “Connor, let’s see what other cards you have up your sleeves this time…”
After saying this, Alexander rushed toward Connor.
Connor hesitated for a moment. He knew that this was his last chance.
Because there were still 10 minutes before the effect of the Chi Receiving Pill would completely disappear, Connor had to take advantage of this last chance to fight to the death.
Connor raised his fist and punched Alexander.
“Looks like you really don’t know the difference between us. Even if you have eaten the Chi Receiving Pill, you are definitely not my match…”
Alexander looked at Connor and sneered. Then, he easily dodged Connor’s punch.
When Connor saw that Alexander had dodged his punch, his expression seemed to be even more shocked. This was because Connor’s speed was very fast just now, but Alexander’s speed was obviously faster. It was so fast that it was unbelievable.
After Alexander easily dodged Connor’s attack, a trace of disdain flashed across his eyes.
After all, Connor only had the power of pills to have the Chi of a black rank martial artist.
Alexander, on the other hand, was a genuine black rank martial artist, so the difference in strength between the two was very obvious.
After Alexander dodged Connor’s punch, he struck Connor’s back with his palm.
Alexander’s palm seemed very casual and did not have much power to it, but it gave off an extremely terrifying feeling.
Bang!
There was a loud bang!
Alexander’s palm landed on Connor’s back.
“Eight Trigrams Palm?”
When everyone saw the move, they all sucked in a breath of cold air.
This was because these people could tell that this was Alexander’s famous technique, the Eight Trigrams Palm.
After Connor was hit by this palm, his body was sent flying, and he smashed into the ground, creating a huge pit.
Although Alexander’s palm did not seem to have much power, the martial artists present could feel how terrifying the power of this palm was from the deep pit.
“As expected of a black rank martial artist!”
“Yeah. When Connor was facing Herbert, Hogan, and the others, he was in an invincible state. However, when facing Alexander, he is nothing…”
“Sigh, Connor shouldn’t have provoked the Malone Family. The Malone Family has been famous for so many years. How could they be so easily provoked…”
When the martial artists present saw Connor lying on the ground motionlessly, a trace of helplessness flashed in their eyes.
“Actually, I don’t think he offended the Malone Family. It’s just that he should not have appeared in this place…”
At this moment, a martial artist sighed helplessly.
When everyone heard this martial artist’s words, a trace of helplessness flashed across their eyes, but no one chose to stand up and speak for Connor.
After all, in their eyes, the Malone Family was an extremely terrifying existence. No one would choose to offend the entire Malone Family because of Connor.
“It’s really terrifying…”
Temira stared at Connor with her big, watery eyes. She was unusually shocked.
Because now she finally felt the strength of a black rank martial artist, and how terrifying it was.
The combat strength that Connor displayed just now was already very shocking.
However, in front of Alexander, it was simply not worth mentioning.
However, at this moment, Connor, who had already fallen, slowly stood up. He looked at Alexander not far away expressionlessly.
When Alexander saw Connor stand up, a trace of shock flashed across his eyes. He sighed to himself. ‘This brat is so tenacious. He was struck by my palm earlier, yet he is still able to stand up…”
“Cough, cough…”
Connor coughed hard and said to Alexander in a low voice, “Continue…”
When everyone heard Connor’s words, they were in shock.
Connor was already in such a state, but he still wanted to continue fighting.
“You still want to continue?”
When Alexander heard Connor’s words, he looked a little surprised.
“Of course, I have to continue…”
Connor looked at Alexander and nodded calmly.
After hearing that Connor wanted to continue, everyone looked at Connor and didn’t know what to say.
They really couldn’t understand. It was obvious what the outcome was, why did Connor want to continue?
Was he not afraid of death?
Temira looked at Connor and hesitated for a couple of seconds. Then, she whispered to Connor, “Mr. McDonald, you only need to tell us where you got the Chi Receiving Pill and Body Tempering Pill, and the head of the Malone Family will let you go. There’s no need for you to…”
“Didn’t you hear me?”
Connor shouted in a low voice.
Temira looked at Connor and was instantly stunned. She was unusually puzzled.

chapters.title: Chapter 1141: I Am Yours
chapters.content:
Chapter 1141: I Am Yours
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
“Alright, since you want to die so badly, I’ll fulfill your wish!”
Alexander roared at Connor and then rushed toward Connor again.
Connor stood on the spot, somewhat absent-minded. He had yet to recover from the intense pain just now.
In the next second, Alexander was already rushing toward Connor.
Then, he stretched out his hand and punched Connor in the chest.
“Pfft…”
...
Connor spat out a mouthful of blood and flew backward.
Everyone looked at Connor and sighed.
After all, if it were them, they would have compromised long ago in the face of such a situation. It was impossible for them to hold on for so long.
Because they knew that if they continued to persist like this, there would only be death.
However, Connor persevered and did not change his mind.
Connor knelt on the ground and struggled for a while, then slowly stood up again.
When Alexander saw Connor stand up again, a strange emotion flashed across his eyes.
Putting aside Connor’s talent in ancient martial arts, just his perseverance was enough to make everyone admire him.
Terry Malone, on the other hand, looked at Connor with a smug expression because he knew that Connor might die in Alexander’s hands soon.
As long as Connor died, Mina would be his.
Alexander sized Connor up and said to him expressionlessly, “Brat, the effect of the pill has already completely disappeared. If you continue to persist, you will only die in my hands. If you take back what you said, I can still give you a chance…”
When everyone heard Alexander’s words, they all looked at Connor.
This was because they knew that once the effect of the pill disappeared, Connor would be an ordinary martial artist. It was impossible for him to withstand Alexander’s palm strike.
Terry looked at Connor with a hint of viciousness in his eyes. He could not wait to kill Connor now.
And Temira was worried, she originally intended to persuade Connor.
However, she did not say anything in the end. After all, if she stood up for Connor, it was very likely to arouse the suspicion of the Malone Family.
Now that the Malone Family was dissatisfied with the Celestial Flower Valley, she could not even protect herself.
“…”
When Connor heard Alexander’s words, he slowly raised his head and glanced at Alexander. Then, he said in a low voice, “I didn’t think that a black rank martial artist would be so weak…”
“What did you say?”
A trace of anger flashed across Alexander’s eyes as he glared at Connor and shouted.
“I said, black rank martial artists are nothing. If you really want to kill me, then do it now, why are you talking so much nonsense?”
Connor said weakly.
“…”
Alexander looked at Connor and hesitated for a couple of seconds. Then, he said in a low voice, “You really are ungrateful. I wanted to give you a chance. But, since that’s what you want, I will fulfill your wish…”
After saying that, Alexander walked toward Connor.
When everyone saw this scene, a hint of helplessness flashed across their eyes because they knew in their hearts that Alexander was planning to make a move on Connor.
“Miss Mina, you can’t go in now…”
However, at this moment, a commotion suddenly came from the door.
“Let me go, let me in…”
Mina shouted and pushed the bodyguards at the door away. She rushed into the hall anxiously.
When Terry saw Mina, a strange look flashed in his eyes. He ran to Mina and whispered, “Mina, what are you doing here?”
“Terry, I heard that Connor is in danger. Connor is my friend. I’ve known him for a long time. I know him very well. He’s definitely not a bad person. Terry, talk to Grandpa Alexander and beg him to let Connor off!”
Mina shouted at Terry anxiously.
At this moment, Mina probably had no idea that Terry was actually the culprit of this matter. He could not wait for Connor to die as soon as possible!
When Terry heard Mina’s words, he became a little angry. He whispered to Mina, “Mina, what’s wrong with you? Just now, Connor wanted to kill me.”
“Connor wanted to kill you?”
Mina was stunned when she heard that.
“That’s right. Everyone present can testify that Connor wanted to kill me earlier…”
Terry whispered.
“Impossible. Terry, there must be some misunderstanding here. I will go and explain to the Grandpa Alexander…”
Mina had just heard Quorra Gaboury say that Connor was surrounded by a large group of martial artists, but she didn’t know what exactly had happened.
Mina was worried about Connor’s safety, so she came to see what was going on.
However, when Mina arrived at the hall, she realized that the person who wanted to kill Connor was the Malone Family’s head.
Mina ran to Connor and Alexander and exclaimed, “Grandpa Alexander, Connor is my good friend. There must be some misunderstanding regarding this matter. Can you give Connor a chance…”
“I’ve already given him many chances, but he doesn’t know how to cherish them…”
Alexander replied in a low voice.
“Connor, what’s going on?”
Mina turned to look at Connor and asked with a puzzled expression.
“Mina, this has nothing to do with you. Quickly move aside…”
Connor said weakly to Mina.
“I’m your woman. How can this matter not have anything to do with me? I won’t move aside!”
Mina stood in front of Connor and shouted.
“Mina, do you want to hurt your parents?”
Terry shouted in a low voice.
Mina was stunned when she heard Terry’s words.
“Mina, this person has a very important secret. We have no intention of killing him. As long as he can tell us the method to refine the Body Tempering Pill, we will let him go. If you continue to stop us, Grandpa Alexander may get angry, and your parents will be implicated!”
Terry looked at Mina and continued.
Mina’s big watery eyes widened. She didn’t know what to do now.
“Connor, just tell them how you got those medicinal pills!”
Mina turned to look at Connor and shouted.
“I won’t tell them. If they want to kill me, then just do it!”
Connor replied expressionlessly.

chapters.title: Chapter 1142: The Last Trump Card!
chapters.content:
Chapter 1142: The Last Trump Card!
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
“Why…”
When Mina heard Connor’s words, she was exasperated.
She really couldn’t understand why Connor was so stubborn and refused to say where he got these medicinal pills.
“Mina, don’t try to persuade this person. He must not want to live anymore…”
Terry reached out and pulled Mina back to his side.
Mina looked at Connor, her eyes filled with despair.
...
Alexander walked up to Connor and sized him up. Then, he asked Connor expressionlessly, “I’m giving you one last chance. Are you going to tell me or not?”
“If you want to attack, then attack. Why are you talking so much nonsense?”
Connor replied in a low voice.
“Alright, then I’ll fulfill your wish today!”
Alexander sneered and slowly raised his right hand.
Connor took a deep breath and closed his eyes.
He had promised Jorge Yarrell that no matter what happened, he would not reveal the relationship between the two of them.
So even at this time, Connor didn’t want to tell the Malone Family where he got the Body Tempering Pill.
Everyone looked at Connor with helplessness in their eyes. They had already guessed what was going to happen next.
“Connor, why are you so stubborn? What will happen if you tell us?”
Mina looked at Connor and shouted angrily.
However, Connor did not seem to hear anything. He stood there expressionlessly, waiting for Alexander to make his move.
Alexander did not want to attack Connor, but he did not expect Connor to be so stubborn.
Moreover, there were so many people watching at this moment. If Alexander did not kill Connor now, how could he establish himself in Tayton in the future?
Therefore, Alexander decided to kill Connor in the end.
Since the Malone Family couldn’t get the Body Tempering Pill, no one else could get it either.
Alexander clenched his fist and smashed it toward Connor’s head.
Bang!
However, at this moment, a loud noise suddenly came from outside the hall.
Immediately after, a figure flew in from outside the hall and punched Alexander in the chest.
All of this happened very suddenly. It was simply in the blink of an eye. The martial artists present did not even see clearly what was going on.
The moment the fist came into contact with Alexander’s chest, he could feel an extremely powerful force filling his body. Alexander took two steps back before he stabilized his body.
“What a powerful force!”
A trace of shock flashed in Alexander’s eyes as he slowly raised his head to look at the person who had attacked him.
“You’re a woman?”
A hint of surprise flashed across Alexander’s eyes.
That’s right, the person who appeared in front of Alexander was a woman, and it was a very sexy woman.
The woman was wearing a black tight skirt. Her sexy figure was especially charming in the skirt. Her slender and fair legs were of moderate thickness. She looked sexy and cold.
When Connor saw this woman, he smiled faintly and said softly, “You are finally willing to come out…”
The woman turned and glared at Connor, then said coldly, “You made yourself look like this just to lure me out, right?”
“That’s right. I just wanted to see if you’d save me or not. I also wanted to see your true strength!”
Connor replied in a low voice.
“Then, what if I didn’t save you?”
The woman asked helplessly.
“Then, I’d have lost the bet…”
Connor grinned.
When the woman heard Connor’s words, she became even more speechless.
The woman who had appeared in front of Connor was none other than Rachel Wallace!
In fact, Connor had discovered that Rachel had been following him for some time now, but Connor did not know why she was following him.
That was why Connor deliberately provoked Alexander just now. His goal was to force Rachel to make a move.
Connor knew that Rachel’s skill was extraordinary, but he didn’t know if she was a martial artist or not, nor did he know how strong she really was.
However, Connor could feel that Rachel was even comparable to Alexander.
This meant that Rachel was actually a black rank martial artist.
At this time, Connor was more and more curious about the identity of Rachel. There were too many secrets hidden on Rachel.
“Who exactly are you?”
Alexander could naturally feel Rachel’s terrifying strength, so he asked her cautiously.
“This has nothing to do with you!”
Rachel replied indifferently and then rushed toward Alexander.
Rachel’s speed was very shocking. She rushed in front of Alexander almost in an instant. Then, she raised her fist and smashed it toward Alexander’s chest.
Bang!
There was a loud bang.
Rachel’s fist smashed into Alexander’s chest.
Alexander took a few steps back.
Immediately after, Rachel punched Alexander’s face again.
Before Alexander could react, he was sent flying like a kite with a broken string. He crashed into the wall and landed heavily on the ground.
In an instant, everyone’s attention was focused on Rachel, and they were in utter shock.
No one had expected Rachel to be so terrifyingly strong.
For a moment, the entire hall fell into dead silence.
No one had expected this beautiful woman who had suddenly appeared to have such heaven-defying strength.
“Is this your trump card?”
Temira looked at Connor and smiled bitterly.
Connor was very solemn, because the more terrifying Rachel’s strength was, the more he was worried about her identity.
This woman was way too mysterious.
On the other side, after Alexander was sent flying by Temira’s punch, he hurriedly stood up and looked at Rachel with an extremely angry expression. He shouted at her, “Who exactly are you?”
“Is it important who I am?”
Rachel replied indifferently.
“Alright, since you have delivered yourself to my doorstep, I will kill Connor and you today…”
A trace of anger flashed in Alexander’s eyes, and then he rushed toward Rachel.
“Kill me?”
When Rachel heard this, she could not help but sneer. Then, she said indifferently, “As if you are capable of doing that…”
After saying that, Rachel rushed toward Alexander.
Soon, Rachel and Alexander started fighting.
Everyone’s eyes were wide open as they watched the battle between the two. They were extremely excited.
Because they knew in their hearts that Rachel’s strength was definitely black rank or above.
To be able to see two black rank martial artists fight was very lucky for the martial artists present.
After all, not everyone could see such a scene.

chapters.title: Chapter 1143: Do You All Admit Defeat?
chapters.content:
Chapter 1143: Do You All Admit Defeat?
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Seeing this scene, everyone present revealed nervous expressions.
Connor was nervous too because he did not know if Rachel was Alexander’s match.
“You think you’re worthy of being a black rank martial artist?”
At this moment, Rachel said with a disdainful expression. Then, she reached out and grabbed Alexander’s thigh.
When Alexander realized that Rachel had grabbed his thigh, he immediately knew he was screwed.
In the next second, Rachel exerted force and flung Alexander away.
...
Boom!
There was a loud bang.
Alexander’s body slammed into the wall.
At this moment, Alexander was already an arrow at the end of its flight. After encountering such a violent impact, he felt as if his internal organs had been shattered. He felt a sweet taste in his throat and spat out a mouthful of blood.
When everyone saw this scene, they were indescribably shocked.
No one had expected such an ending.
No one expected Alexander to lose to Rachel.
Rachel rushed in front of Alexander, then raised her leg and kicked Alexander’s head.
Alexander flew a few meters in the air and then crashed heavily in front of everyone.
The martial artists present looked at Alexander, who was like a dead dog, and were instantly stunned on the spot. Their eyes revealed deep shock.
If they hadn’t seen it with their own eyes, they would never have dreamed that the head of the Malone Family would be beaten to such a state.
Rachel walked up to Alexander in her high heels and looked him up and down. Then, she asked Alexander softly, “Do you still want to kill me now?”
Alexander stared at Rachel with his eyes wide open. He was extremely frightened as he shouted, “Who… Who exactly are you?”
“I think I’ve already answered your question. Who I am has nothing to do with you, but remember, Connor is someone I have to protect. No one can hurt him, not even if you’re a black rank…”
Rachel replied indifferently.
When everyone heard this, they turned to look at Connor.
Only now did they realize how terrifying the background of this young man was.
“Do you admit defeat?”
Rachel asked Alexander.
Alexander raised his head and looked at Rachel. After frowning, he gritted his teeth and said in a low voice, “Yes…”
Alexander did not have a backbone like Connor. He knew very well that if he said anything wrong now, Rachel might kill him.
At this moment, Alexander hated Terry and Aaron to the bone. After all, if not for these two people, he would not have ended up like this today.
Of course, Alexander hated Connor even more now because he knew that all of this was caused by Connor.
Therefore, Alexander understood that there was hope where there was life. He was only admitting defeat now so that he could find a chance to take revenge in the future.
Terry and Aaron were completely dumbfounded at this moment. They stood on the spot with lifeless eyes, not knowing what to do.
The two of them did not expect the head of the Malone Family to admit defeat in front of so many people!
Rachel turned to look at Connor and asked him softly, “Connor, how do you plan to deal with this person?”
“Kill him!”
Connor replied without any hesitation.
One had to know that from the time Connor inherited the inheritance until now, no matter who it was, he had never had the intention to kill.
But this time, when Alexander pleaded for mercy, Connor did not show any mercy.
The reason was very simple. Connor knew that if he let Alexander off today, there would definitely be endless trouble in the future.
Not only would Connor be in danger, but the people around him would also be in danger.
Therefore, in order to eliminate the root of the problem, Connor only had one thought in his mind, and that was to kill Alexander off.
“Connor, you dare to kill me?”
When Alexander heard Connor’s words, a trace of anger flashed across his eyes. He shouted at Connor angrily.
“Why wouldn’t I dare to kill you?”
Connor replied indifferently.
“Do you know what kind of person I am? If you dare to kill me today, I promise…”
“Pfft!”
Before Alexander could finish speaking, Rachel took out a dagger and stabbed it into Alexander’s throat.
After Alexander struggled for a while, his body stopped moving lifelessly.
In an instant, everyone present fell silent.
Everyone’s eyes widened as they looked at Connor and Rachel. They were extremely shocked.
This was because no one had expected the two of them to be so bold as to kill Alexander in front of so many people.
Connor looked at Rachel, and an odd look flashed across his face.
Because Connor could feel that this was not the first time Rachel had killed someone. She was very skilled.
“How dare you kill the head of our family?!”
Aaron shouted and rushed toward Rachel.
Rachel raised his leg and kicked Aaron away. Then, he stabbed his dagger into Aaron’s chest.
Blood trickled from the corner of Aaron’s mouth. His body twitched a few times before he died.
In less than two minutes, Aaron and Alexander had both died at the hands of Rachel alone.
At this moment, the way everyone looked at Rachel was different from before.
Because they could feel that this woman was like the devil. If they were not careful, they might die in her hands.
The entire hall instantly fell into a deathly silence.
“Is there anyone in the Malone Family who refuses to admit defeat?”
At this moment, Connor asked the other members of the Malone Family.
At this moment, the Malone Family members were all scared out of their wits by Rachel. They were all stunned. They didn’t even dare to say a word.
“I’m asking you all a question!”
At this moment, Connor repeated again.
“We admit defeat…”
A white-haired old man walked out from the crowd and shouted.
“Grandpa Anthony, what are you talking about?”
Terry shouted angrily when he heard the old man’s words.
