The old man who spoke was Anthony Malone, the third elder in the Malone Family. His status was only second to Alexander and Aaron.
Now that Alexander and Aaron had been killed by Rachel, Anthony had the highest status in the Malone Family.

chapters.title: Chapter 1144: The Cruel Ancient Martial Arts World
chapters.content:
Chapter 1144: The Cruel Ancient Martial Arts World
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
“Don’t you know what I’m talking about?”
“If it wasn’t for your misdeeds, how could the Malone Family have fallen to this state? Do you want to destroy the Malone Family so that you can be happy?”
Anthony’s eyes widened as he shouted at Terry angrily.
When Terry heard this sentence, he was stunned. He opened his mouth but could not say a word.
He knew that the Malone Family had lost their biggest backer, Alexander. They had no right to continue fighting with Connor.
If they continued to fight, there would only be death.
...
Mina looked at Connor and couldn’t help but laugh bitterly. She also didn’t think that it would end up like this.
“Mr. McDonald, the Malone Family admits defeat. We won’t dare to go against you again!”
Anthony looked at Connor and whispered.
After hearing Anthony’s words, Connor slowly turned to look at the others in the hall and said expressionlessly, “Is there anyone else who has anything to say?”
When the martial artists present heard Connor’s words, they trembled in fear and lowered their heads, not daring to say a word.
“Why is not one saying anything?”
Connor asked indifferently.
“Mr. McDonald, we have nothing to say…”
“That’s right, Mr. McDonald.”
Everyone responded in fear.
At this time, everyone was not afraid of Connor. They were afraid of Rachel.
In the eyes of these people, Rachel was like the devil.
If they offended this woman, the consequences would be unimaginable!
Connor smiled disdainfully after hearing everyone’s words, then slowly raised his head to look at Temira Yakes before saying to Rachel softly, “I might not be able to hold on much longer, but you must not let this woman leave!”
Rachel looked at Connor with a hint of confusion in his eyes, not knowing what he meant by this.
However, before Rachel could ask, Connor spat out a mouthful of blood and fell into her arms.
“Connor!”
Mina saw that Connor had fainted and shouted.
“What are you waiting for? Hurry up and call the doctor!”
Rachel frowned and shouted.
The Malone Family did not dare to disobey Rachel’s order. They quickly took out their phones and made a call.
Rachel quickly checked Connor’s body, and she seemed a little helpless.
She realized that when Connor received Alexander’s last palm strike, the effect of the Chi Receiving Pill had already disappeared.
Connor used his body to resist Alexander’s palm.
“The fact that you’re still alive is a miracle!”
Rachel looked at Connor, and a trace of helplessness flashed across her eyes. She could not help but sigh softly.
…
Three days later.
Connor, who was originally unconscious, finally opened his eyes. The first person he saw after opening his eyes was Rachel.
“You’re awake?”
Rachel saw Connor open his eyes and asked him softly.
Connor shook his head and asked her, “How long have I been unconscious?”
“Three days…”
Rachel replied indifferently.
“That’s good…”
When Connor heard that, he heaved a long sigh of relief.
He was worried that if he was unconscious for too long, it might delay Freya Phillips’s recovery.
“What’s good about it? Do you know that if it wasn’t for Mr. Yarrell’s Life Revival Pill, you would not have been able to wake up?”
Rachel said helplessly.
“Mr. Yarrell?”
Connor couldn’t help but be stunned when he heard this name. Then, he hurriedly said, “The old man is here too?”
“What old man? That’s Jorge Yarrell, a famous heaven rank martial artist in Oprana. The pill you ate was taken from him by Thomas Morgan!”
Rachel replied helplessly. Then, she couldn’t help but sigh to herself. In the entire Oprana, only Connor dared to call Jorge an old man.
After all, Jorge had caused quite a bit of bloodshed in the Oprana ancient martial arts world.
Countless martial artists had died at Jorge’s hands.
Many people even felt that Jorge was a demon who killed without batting an eye.
Even Rachel was very nervous when facing Jorge, afraid of offending him.
But now, Jorge had become an old man in Connor’s mouth. Rachel really didn’t know what to say.
“Mister, my ass. He’s just a greedy old man. Other than taking advantage of me, he doesn’t know anything.”
“If he hadn’t asked me to come here, how could I have ended up like this…”
Connor stood up from the bed as he spoke. Then, he moved his body and said with a smile, “I must say though, the medicinal pill that the old man refined is indeed powerful. I am actually fine now…”
“You clearly knew that the effect of the Chi Receiving Pill had already disappeared, but you still chose to take on Alexander’s palm strike. What were you thinking?”
Rachel asked Connor in confusion.
“If I hadn’t been hit by Alexander’s palm, would you have shown yourself?”
Connor asked directly.
“Why does that matter?”
Rachel frowned and asked.
“…”
When Connor heard Rachel’s words, he was stunned for a moment. Then, he asked her with a very serious expression, “Rachel, who exactly are you?”
“I can’t tell you who I am yet…”
Rachel used the same words to answer Connor’s question.
“Then, why are you so powerful? Also, I can sense that this isn’t the first time you’ve killed someone…”
Connor continued.
“I come from an ancient martial arts family. My grandfather, father, and mother are all martial artists. That’s why I’m also a martial artist. It’s not my first time killing someone, but in the world of martial artists, killing is not a big deal. After all, there’s no victory or defeat in a battle between martial artists.”
Rachel replied.
And Connor was somewhat speechless by Rachel’s words.
Because he now also knew that the world of martial artists was indeed many times crueler than he had imagined.
“Oh right, I have something to tell you!”
Rachel said to Connor.
“What is it?”
Connor was stunned for a moment and asked.

chapters.title: Chapter 1145: What Benefits Do You Want?
chapters.content:
Chapter 1145: What Benefits Do You Want?
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
“If you really want to deal with Rockefeller, you must make good use of the power of a martial artist.
“Because not only does Rockefeller have a terrifying influence in the business world, they also have a great influence in the ancient martial arts world on a global scale. This is also the reason why I want to work with you!”
Rachel slowly said.
Connor raised his head and looked at Rachel. Then, he asked with a helpless expression, “Then, why can’t you tell me who you are?”
“Now is not the time!”
Rachel said indifferently.
...
“Then, when is the right time?”
Connor frowned and asked.
“When you can defeat me!”
Rachel replied after thinking for a moment.
“Uh…”
When Connor heard Rachel’s words, he was instantly stunned. He felt helpless, not knowing what to say.
“Alright, since you’re awake now, there’s no need for me to stay here. I’m going back to Newtown University…”
Rachel stood up and slowly stretched. Her ample chest was extremely alluring.
“Wait, you can’t leave yet…”
Connor hurriedly shouted seeing Rachel leave.
“Why?”
Rachel was stunned for a moment and asked Connor with a puzzled expression.
“The Malone Family has caused me to be in this state. I have to teach these people a lesson. Now, those people from the Malone Family aren’t afraid of me. They’re afraid of you, so you can leave after I’m done with them…”
Connor said to Rachel with a smile.
When Rachel heard Connor’s words, a trace of helplessness flashed across her eyes. Then, she frowned and said, “That doesn’t have anything to do with me!”
“Rachel, just help him to the end. Since you’re already here, you’re not in a hurry to go back, right?”
Connor looked at Rachel and said.
“…”
Rachel looked at Connor and hesitated for a couple of seconds, then asked Connor softly, “Then what benefits do I get from helping you?”
“What benefits do you want?”
Connor hurriedly replied.
“I haven’t thought about it yet. How about this? You can promise me one more thing. Including the one you owe me before, you owe me two things in total. When I need your help, I’ll naturally tell you.”
Rachel thought for a moment and softly said to Connor.
“Deal!”
Connor didn’t hesitate at all and nodded in agreement.
Half an hour later, Connor washed up and left his room to look for Mina.
In the three days that Connor was unconscious, Mina’s status in the Malone Family had changed drastically.
No matter who saw Mina, they couldn’t help but feel nervous because they knew about the relationship between Connor and Mina.
The Malone Family members who had always looked down on Mina were now extremely respectful to her.
Even many martial artists in Tayton took the initiative to visit Connor after they found out about him.
Of course, they had no way of seeing Connor.
For this, they could only try their best to please Mina.
At this moment, Mina naturally felt very uncomfortable facing such a situation. For a moment, she did not know how to face the Malone Family.
After all, the Malone Family members who were more senior than Mina were very respectful to Mina.
As for Rachel killing Alexander and Aaron, it did not affect Mina at all.
Because Mina had no feelings for these two people, and if it wasn’t for the two of them forcing Mina to get married, she would not have left the Malone Family, and her parents would not have been ostracized and humiliated.
Thus, Mina not only had no feelings for these two people, but she even had a trace of hatred.
Of course, Mina no longer had to worry about these things because no one dared to order her around anymore.
At this moment, Mina also had her own worries.
“Miss Mina, President Quintin of the Radiant Group is here!”
At this moment, a little girl ran to Mina’s side and called out softly.
When Mina heard the little girl’s words, she became somewhat helpless. She then softly said, “Alright, I understand…”
A few minutes later, Mina arrived at the living room.
“Miss Mina, you’re here?”
The middle-aged man who was waiting anxiously in the living room hurriedly stood up when he saw Mina enter and greeted her respectfully.
The middle-aged man sized up Mina, a hint of surprise flashing in his eyes.
“Mr. Quintin, I wonder why you’re here this time?”
Mina replied indifferently.
“Miss Mina, I heard that Mr. McDonald is still in the Malone Family’s manor. I wonder if it’s convenient for you to introduce him to me?”
The middle-aged man grinned at Mina.
“I’m sorry, Mr. Quintin. Mr. McDonald is still resting and can’t meet guests. You should come back in a few days!”
Mina said expressionlessly.
“Miss Mina, can you do me a favor?”
As Mr. Quintin spoke, he took out a check from his clothes and placed it on the table.
When Mina saw the check on the table, a hint of helplessness flashed across her eyes. Then, she frowned and said, “Mr. Quintin, do you know that I receive nearly a hundred of these checks every day? Can you ask those people if they have seen Mr. McDonald? When Mr. McDonald wakes up, I’ll tell him that you came. As for whether he wants to see you or not, that’s his business…”
“…”
When the middle-aged man, Mr. Quintin, heard Mina’s words, he felt a little awkward. Then, he said helplessly, “If that’s the case, then I will take my leave now. I’ll come back when Mr. McDonald wakes up…”
“Alright!”
Mina nodded lightly.
A moment later, Mr. Quintin left the Malone Family’s manor.
After Mina saw Mr. Quintin leave, a hint of helplessness flashed across her eyes. She gently rubbed her temples and turned around to leave.
But at this moment, Connor suddenly walked to Mina’s side.
When Mina saw Connor, she was stunned for a moment. Then, she exclaimed with a surprised expression, “Connor, you’re awake?”
“Yes, I just woke up…”
Connor looked at Mina and nodded lightly.
Mina looked at Connor and was so excited that she didn’t know what to say.
“Connor, are you alright?” she asked as she covered her mouth. How are you feeling?”
“I’m fine now. Don’t worry!”
Connor replied with a smile.
“That’s good…”
Mina heaved a long sigh of relief and continued, “Connor, you don’t know how worried I was for you these past few days. I was so afraid that you would never wake up…”

chapters.title: Chapter 1146: A Woman in Love
chapters.content:
Chapter 1146: A Woman in Love
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
“How can I not wake up…”
Connor smiled faintly and then continued to ask, “Did anything happen in the past few days?”
“Nothing happened. It’s just that many shop owners and martial artists came to look for you. They probably know that you have the refining method of the Body Tempering Pill, so they want to cooperate with you…” Mina whispered.
“Haha…”
Connor couldn’t help but laugh when he heard this. Then, he said softly, “I really don’t know what these people are thinking. I don’t even want to cooperate with the Wess family and the Celestial Flower Valley, so why would I possibly cooperate with them? What a fool’s dream…”
“Yeah, I don’t know what they’re thinking either. They even offered me a lot of benefits to introduce you to them, but I rejected them all. I know you definitely won’t meet with these people…” Mina said softly.
...
“Is that woman Temira still around?” Connor asked.
Mina hurriedly nodded. “She’s still here. I’ve already gotten someone to arrest her. She’s locked in the room now!”
“That’s good…”
Connor replied indifferently.
Mina slowly raised her head and softly said, “Connor, don’t you know that our Malone family has changed a lot recently?”
“Why did the change become so big?”
Connor asked.
“Now, everyone in the Malone family treats me as your woman, so their attitude towards me has changed greatly. Those who looked down on me before are now very respectful to me. Moreover, my parents’ statuses in the company have increased a lot; my father is now the vice president of the company. These changes were likely brought about by you…” Mina whispered.
“Isn’t that good?”
Connor said with a smile.
“It’s good, but the two of us have nothing to do with each other at all. I feel a little uneasy like this!”
Mina looked at Connor. She knew that Connor didn’t like her in that way at all.
Connor did all these things to her out of sympathy and pity, so she felt a little uneasy about the situation.
“You don’t have to overthink things. As long as I don’t say anything, they will think that you are my lover. In this way, no one will dare to ask you to do anything in the future. You can do whatever you want now. You don’t have to worry about what others think!”
Connor paused for a moment and then continued, “By the way, if you like someone else in the future, you can marry him directly. There’s no need to discuss it with me beforehand!”
“…”
Mina looked at Connor helplessly.
In fact, Mina really wanted to tell Connor that he was the person she really liked, and that he was the one she wanted to marry.
However, Mina also knew that the person Connor liked wasn’t her. She was not worthy of Connor at all.
“I might never fall in love with another man in my life!” Mina couldn’t help but think. She didn’t say anything out loud; at this moment, she didn’t have the courage to speak her mind.
“Oh right, I still have something to discuss with you…”
Connor spoke softly.
When Mina heard Connor’s words, she couldn’t help but be stunned for a moment. Then, she asked Connor softly, “What is it?”
“I want you to be the general manager of the Malone Corporation and help me manage the Malone family in the future. What do you think?”
“What?”
When Mina heard Connor’s words, her eyes widened in disbelief.
“I told you to be the general manager of the Malone Corporation!” Connor repeated indifferently. “Although I can’t do anything to them, I won’t let them off so easily. I’ll hold a meeting later where I’ll make you the general manager of the Malone Corporation, so you’ll be the head of the Malone family in the future. After all, you’re the only one I can trust in the entire Malone family…”
“But I’m worried that I don’t have the ability. I’ve never managed a company before, and will the Malone family even agree to this?” Mina asked worriedly.
“You don’t have to worry about that. They definitely won’t object. As for managing the company, I’ll find someone to help you so that you can learn how to handle the company’s matters as soon as possible…”
Connor said softly.
“But…”
Mina looked at Connor, her expression still somewhat hesitant.
“No buts. I believe you can do it well!” Connor said firmly.
Mina hesitated for two seconds before nodding and saying in a low voice, “Alright, since you believe in me, I’m willing to give it a try!”
“Good…” Connor continued, “Go and call everyone from the Malone family over now. I’ll tell them about this!”
“Alright!”
Mina nodded and left.
“This little girl seems to have special feelings for you!”
Mina had just left when Rachel walked to Connor’s side and said this to him with a smile.
After Connor heard Rachel’s words, he turned his head and looked at her. He said helplessly, “Of course I know about her feelings for me, but I only have one person in my heart now. I don’t have any thoughts about other women, so I can only hope that she can forget about me as soon as possible…”
“It’s so easy to forget someone…”
Rachel supported her cheek with her hand and sighed softly.
“…”
When Connor heard Rachel’s words, he could not help but be stunned for a moment. Then, he asked with a smile, “From what you said, it seems like you have someone you can’t forget too?”
“There’s no one I can’t forget. I just watch TV dramas and know that it’s very difficult for women who are in love to forget someone…” Rachel said indifferently.
“Haha…”
Connor smiled helplessly and did not say anything else.
Half an hour later, everyone from the Malone family gathered in the living room of the manor.
However, what Connor did not expect was that Terry would actually come over as well.
Connor looked at him indifferently and did not say anything; he did not want to waste time with this kind of person.
“Is everyone here?”
Connor turned to look at Mina and asked softly.
“They are already here…”
Mina hurriedly replied.
“Alright…”
Connor nodded and looked at the Malone family expressionlessly. “Since everyone is here, let me talk to you about compensation!”

chapters.title: Chapter 1147: The Controlling Party
chapters.content:
Chapter 1147: The Controlling Party
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
When the Malone family heard Connor’s words, they instantly understood what he meant.
They knew that Connor was planning to settle the score after the fall.
“Mr. McDonald, it’s indeed the Malone family’s fault. Just tell us what compensation you want. As long as it’s within our means, we’ll definitely do our best…”
Anthony Malone was a smart person. He knew that Connor would not let them off easily.
Therefore, the best way now was to give Connor some compensation and settle this matter.
With Alexander Malone dead, the Malone family might not even have the right to negotiate with Connor as they were right.
...
Therefore, no matter what Connor proposed, they could only choose to agree.
“Alright, since you’ve said so, I won’t beat around the bush. The compensation I want is very simple: from now on, your family and the Malone Corporation will give me 50% of the shares as compensation.”
Connor said calmly.
When the Malone family heard Connor’s words, they were all shocked. Some of them were furious, while others lowered their heads and didn’t dare to say a word.
“Fifty percent of the shares?” Terry sneered and shouted, “Connor, are you crazy? Why should we give you 50% of the shares?”
“You people can still sit here and listen to me, but Alexander Malone and Aaron Malone can’t hear me!” Connor replied directly.
Terry was instantly dumbfounded when he heard Connor’s words. He glared at Connor with an abnormally angry expression, but did not dare to say anything.
After all, Rachel Wallace, that female devil, was by Connor’s side at this time. If he angered Rachel, she might kill him.
“How is it? Do you think 50% of the shares are okay?”
Connor pressed when he saw that Terry was silent.
At this moment, a middle-aged man frowned and said slowly, “Mr. McDonald, 50% of the shares is a little too much!”
“Then make it 60%!”
Connor said after thinking for a moment.
After hearing Connor’s words, everyone looked up at Connor with an expression of extreme despair.
Because they had never seen such a domineering person like Connor. He did not plan to discuss it at all!
Connor narrowed his eyes and said softly, “I think you guys might not have figured out the situation yet. You guys don’t have the right to negotiate at all. Alexander Malone is already dead. You guys don’t even have the right to talk.”
Anthony took a deep breath. He understood that Connor’s words made sense. The Malone family had no right to negotiate with Connor.
“Mr. McDonald, we can agree to 50% of the shares…” Anthony said.
“It’s too late now. I said 60% just now!”
Connor interrupted.
Terry looked up at Connor furiously.
Anthony hesitated for a moment, then smiled helplessly and whispered, “Okay, Mr. McDonald, if you say 60%, then we’ll give you 60%, but I have a request…”
“What request? Just say it!”
Connor replied indifferently.
“Mr. McDonald, now that the head of the Malone family is dead, we have offended many enemies in the past, so there should be many people who are targeting us now. If we give these shares to you, can you guarantee the safety of the Malone family?” Anthony asked.
“Don’t worry about that. After all, the Malone family’s interests are also my interests, so I will protect your safety. As long as I, Connor, am here, no one will dare to touch the Malone family!” Connor replied.
“That’s good, that’s good…”
When Anthony heard Connor’s words, the expression on his face eased up a lot and he quickly nodded. After all, it was not a bad deal to give away 60% of the shares in exchange for the peace of the Malone family in the future.
If the Malone family did not find a new backer, then their assets would definitely be swallowed up by the big families in Tayton in a short period of time. If that happened, they would be left in a miserable state.
“Alright, since you have agreed to this matter, I will tell you about the second matter…” Connor said slowly.
“Mr. McDonald, please go ahead!” Anthony hurriedly said.
“Actually, the second thing is very simple. I’m going to give all 60% of my shares to Mina, so from now on, Mina will be the Chairman of the Malone Corporation and the head of the Malone family,” Connor said lightly.
“I disagree!”
Terry shouted excitedly.
After all, what Terry cared about the most now was the position of the head of the Malone family. He originally thought that once Alexander Malone died, he would immediately become the head of the Malone family.
After all, the family was leaderless now. Anthony didn’t care about business at all. Now was the best opportunity for Terry.
However, Terry had never expected that Connor would actually want Mina to be the head of the Malone family. He would definitely not agree at this moment.
Connor glanced at Terry and asked calmly, “Is there any use in you not agreeing?”
“…”
When Terry heard Connor’s words, he was instantly dumbfounded. He looked at Connor in a daze and did not say anything.
Connor said expressionlessly, “Now that 60% of the Malone family’s shares are in my hands, I made Mina the head of the Malone family. I didn’t call you here to discuss this matter with you, but to inform you of it. Understand?”
“Understood!”
The Malone family didn’t care who the head of the family was. They knew about the relationship between Mina and Connor, so they were mentally prepared for this news.
Terry was the only one who looked unusually enraged. He shouted, “Mina doesn’t have the ability to manage the company well!”
Mina looked at Terry with a nervous expression, but at this moment, Connor suddenly said, “So what if she doesn’t have the ability to manage the company well? Even if she loses the entire Malone Corporation, I don’t care…”
After Mina heard this, she was very touched.
“You…”
When Terry heard Connor’s words, he was instantly speechless.

chapters.title: Chapter 1148: Interrogating Temira
chapters.content:
Chapter 1148: Interrogating Temira
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
“Besides, I believe that Mina has the ability!” Connor emphasized again and then continued, ” Alright, I’ve finished my business. Next, I’ll let Mina talk about the personnel arrangements of the Malone Corporation…”
After saying this, Connor took the initiative to stand up and make way for her.
Mina hesitated for a moment before walking to the middle of the room and announcing the transfer of personnel.
Although she didn’t know how to manage a company, she knew the Malone family very well. She knew better than anyone who could be used and who couldn’t be used.
Connor didn’t care much about what happened next, so he left the living room with Rachel.
After walking out of the living room, Rachel turned her head to look at Connor and then said softly, “Alright, my mission is considered completed. Can I go back now?”
...
“I plan to go to the Celestial Flower Valley to look for some medicinal herbs. If you have nothing to do, why don’t you come with me?”
Connor said to Rachel with a smile.
“Who knows when you will find the Celestial Flower Valley? I’m not in the mood to accompany you to look for medicinal herbs. If I leave for too long, I might not be able to explain my absence to the school…” Rachel said indifferently.
“If you don’t want to go, then so be it. Why are you talking about school? Even if you don’t go to class for half a year, the principal won’t dare to do anything to you!” Connor said speechlessly.
“I’m just worried that my students will miss me…”
Rachel replied narcissistically. Then, she took out a porcelain bottle from her clothes and said softly, “This are the Chi Receiving Pills from Mr. Yarrell. There are a total of three pills. Use them sparingly…”
“Why is this old man so stingy? Every time he gives me a few Chi pellets, can’t he give me more?”
Connor took the porcelain bottle speechlessly.
“Refining the Chi Receiving Pill is not as simple as you think. Even Mr. Yarrell can only refine three at a time, and one pill takes more than half a month to refine. How many people can even dream of obtaining one?” Rachel said to Connor helplessly.
“Is this thing so precious?”
Connor asked Rachel in surprise.
“What do you think?”
Rachel could not help but roll her eyes. Then, she continued, “You should know that a single Body Tempering Pill is enough to make those martial artists go crazy. The value of the Chi Receiving Pill is a hundred times that of the Body Tempering Pill. Think about it yourself!”
After Connor heard Rachel’s words, he was extremely shocked. He really didn’t know that the Chi Receiving Pill was so precious.
“Alright, it’s getting late. I have to go back too!” Rachel gently waved at Connor, then turned around and walked out of the manor.
Connor looked at Rachel’s back and couldn’t help but hesitate for a moment before calling out softly, “Thank you for this!”
After Rachel heard his words, she turned her head and looked at Connor. She said with a surprised expression, “I didn’t expect you to actually say thank you…”
Connor looked at Rachel and smiled without saying anything.
A moment later, she disappeared from Connor’s sight.
Connor stood at the door of the living room and waited for a while. Mina had finally finished her meeting with the Malone family and walked out of the living room alone.
“How is it? Are these people cooperating?”
Connor asked softly.
“They must be uncomfortable, but most of them have accepted me as the Chairman. Some of them are not cooperative, though. I’ll give these people some time. If their thoughts still haven’t changed by then, I’ll get rid of them directly!” Mina said firmly to Connor.
“Yes…”
Connor nodded and continued, “I’ll get Thomas Morgan to bring an assistant over in a while. He’ll help you familiarize yourself with how to manage the company as soon as possible!”
“Alright!” Mina agreed.
“Alright, I’m almost done dealing with the matters here. Take me to see Temira!”
Connor said.
“Alright…”
After Mina heard Connor’s words, she quickly took the initiative to lead the way.
A moment later, they arrived at the door of a room. At this time, there were two bodyguards standing at the door.
“Open the door!” Mina said to the bodyguard.
“Yes, Miss Malone!”
The bodyguard agreed and did as she asked.
Connor walked into the room. At this time, Temira was sitting in front of the table reading a book.
After Temira saw Connor, she put down the book in her hand and shouted angrily, “Connor, what do you mean by letting these people lock me in this room?”
“When Louis and the others attacked me, you also participated in it, no?” Connor asked softly.
“…”
Temira didn’t say anything. It was obvious that she had tacitly agreed to this matter.
“Actually, just because of this matter, I could have killed you, but I didn’t. Do you know why?” Connor said softly.
“Why?” Temira asked in confusion.
“Because you are still useful to me…”
“Useful?”
Temira was stunned for a moment, then subconsciously stood up and asked Connor, “What exactly do you want?”
“You don’t have to be so nervous. I’m not interested in you. I just want you to take me to the Celestial Flower Valley because you have the herbs I need!”
Connor said expressionlessly.
“Are you planning to go to our Celestial Flower Valley to snatch out medicinal herbs?”
Temira instantly realized what was going on.
“That’s right…” Connor nodded lightly.
“Connor, you are too arrogant. What kind of place do you think our Celestial Flower Valley is? The Valley Elder’s strength is not inferior to Alexander Malone at all. If you go over, you’ll be asking for death!”
Temira shouted, eyes wide.
“You don’t have to worry about these things. What you need to do now is to bring me to the Celestial Flower Valley…” Connor said calmly.
“Haha…” Temira sneered when she heard Connor’s words, then said in a low voice, “I’m sorry. Our Celestial Flower Valley has a rule that we can’t bring outsiders to the Celestial Flower Valley. You should give up on this idea. Even if you kill me today, I won’t bring you there…”
“Kill you?”
Connor looked at Temira from head to toe, then said softly, “Temira, you’re so pretty. It would be a pity if I killed you. I have a hundred ways to make you wish you were dead.”
Temira suddenly stood up after hearing Connor’s words. She asked nervously, “You… What do you want?”
“You know very well what I want to do. If you don’t bring me to Celestial Flower Valley, then don’t blame me for being indecent to you.”
Connor said with a smile.

chapters.title: Chapter 1149: Northern Mountain City
chapters.content:
Chapter 1149: Northern Mountain City
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Temira knew very well that since Connor had dared to kill someone like Alexander Malone, it was very possible that he would do something to her that was worse than what a beast would do to her.
Therefore, Temira hesitated for two seconds before saying in a low voice, “Connor, I advise you not to go to the Celestial Flower Valley!”
“Why are you talking so much nonsense? Are you going to lead the way or not?”
Connor asked indifferently.
“If you insist on going, I can lead the way for you. However, you will die an extremely ugly death…” Temira said helplessly.
“Alright, then let’s go now!”
...
Connor said softly.
“Leave now? Don’t you want to stay with your little lover for a few more days?”
Temira knew that Connor should have just woken up, but she didn’t expect him to be in such a hurry to leave.
Under normal circumstances, Connor should have stayed in the Malone family for a few more days to enjoy himself since he had just obtained 60% of the Malone family’s shares.
However, Temira never thought that Connor would leave in such a hurry.
Even the Malone family found it unbelievable.
However, these people didn’t know that Connor didn’t care about this at all. He wasn’t in the mood to enjoy it now.All he could think was to hurry up and find the medicinal herbs to cure Freya’s illness.
After leaving the Malone family’s estate, Connot and Temira arrived at the airport in Tayton.
After arriving at the airport, Temira turned her head to look at Connor and asked him softly, “Where’s the woman who saved you?”
“She already left…”
Connor replied indifferently.
“She’s gone?”
After Temira heard Connor’s words, a trace of surprise flashed in her eyes, and then she said in a puzzled tone, “Are you planning to go to the Celestial Flower Valley alone?”
“That’s right!” Connor nodded lightly.
“Are you crazy? “I’m telling you, that woman might not even be a match for our Celestial Flower Valley Elder, yet you’re still planning to go there alone? Even if you take the Chi Receiving Pill, you’re still no match for our Valley Elder. What’s the difference between going there and going to your grave?”
Temira shouted at Connor.
Connor was stunned for a moment after hearing Temira’s words, then he said softly, “Shouldn’t these things be none of your business? You should be very happy if I die…”
“…”
A strange look flashed across Temira’s eyes. She then pursed her lips and said, “That’s right. What does your death have to do with me? It’s best if you die…”
“Haha…”
Connor smiled and didn’t say anything.
Temira hesitated for a moment, then continued, “Oh right, Connor, do you know how much money the Malone family has? Why don’t you take this opportunity to extort a sum of money? It’s really a pity for you to leave now…”
“I’ve already taken 60% of the Malone family’s shares!”
Connor replied.
“But you gave all those shares to your lover. You didn’t get anything at all, did you?”
“I’m not short of money, nor am I interested in it!” Connor explained.
“This is the first time I’ve heard someone say that they’re not interested in money…”
Temira smiled helplessly.
Connor turned his head to look at Temira, then said softly, “When you are truly rich, you will realize that money is the most useless thing in this world. There are many things that money can’t solve…”
“That’s true…” Temira nodded lightly and continued, “Even if you have money now, you will not be able to buy these medicinal ingredients that you need…By the way, why are you looking for them?”
“To save someone…”
Connor said lightly.
“Save who?”
Temira pressed.
Connor hesitated for a moment and was about to speak, but at this moment, his phone suddenly rang.
Connor picked up his phone and saw that it was a call from Freya.
“Hello?” Connor answered.
“Connor, why did you only pick up the phone now? I’ve been calling you for the past few days, but why did you turn off your phone?” Freya asked angrily.
“I lost my phone a few days ago, so I couldn’t receive your call. I only found it today…” Connor hurriedly lied.
After Temira heard Connor’s words, she couldn’t help but curl her lips slightly. The expression on her face was very disdainful.
“So that’s how it is!”
Freya believed Connor’s words and continued, “How are things going on your side? When do you plan to come back?”
“I’ve run into some trouble for the time being. It’ll probably take some time before I can settle it. I’ll go back after I’m done here…” Connor said softly.
“Alright then…”
Freya seemed to be a little disappointed as she agreed.
“How are things on your side?”
Connor asked.
“Everything is fine here…” Freya said softly.
“Does your head still hurt?”
“I don’t think I’ve felt sick for the past few days…” Freya said after a moment of hesitation.
“That’s good…”
Connor replied in a low voice. He knew that Freya wouldn’t fall ill because he wasn’t by her side now. Therefore, the doctor was right. She had become like this because of him.
Connor and Freya chatted for a while before hanging up.
Temira turned her head to look at Connor, then asked Connor softly, “Who were you talking to on the phone just now?”
“My fiancée…” Connor replied.
“Oh!” Temira was stunned for a moment before she continued, “You must be collecting these herbs for your fiancée, right?”
“Yes…”
Connor nodded.
“Then what illness does your fiancée have?” Temira asked curiously.
Connor had nothing to do at the moment, so he told Temira about Freya’s situation.
After Temira heard about Freya, a hint of helplessness flashed across her eyes.
At this moment, she suddenly felt that Connor was quite pitiful.
He only wanted to save his fiancée, but the people of the Celestial Flower Valley, Malone family, and Wess family tried their best to get the refining method of the Body Tempering Pill from Connor.
Now that she thought about it, Temira felt that what she had done back then was a little too much.
Connor didn’t continue to talk to Temira, but instead closed his eyes to rest.
Half an hour later, Connor and Temira boarded the plane and flew directly to Northern Mountain City, where the Celestial Flower Valley was located.
After boarding the plane, Connor closed his eyes and rested because he was too tired.
Temira didn’t have any intention of running away, so she sat quietly beside Connor.
About three hours later, Connor and Temira arrived at Northern Mountain City.

chapters.title: Chapter 1150: Indiscriminate Biting
chapters.content:
Chapter 1150: Indiscriminate Biting
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
According to Connor’s understanding, the Celestial Flower Valley was actually hidden in the mountains around Northern Mountain City.
However, there were so many mountains around Northern Mountain City that no one knew how many there were.
Therefore, without the help of someone from the Celestial Flower Valley itself, Connor would not have been able to find it.
Some residents of Northern Mountain City knew roughly where the Celestial Flower Valley was, but they did not know the exact location.
This was also the reason why Connor wanted Temira to lead the way for him. After all, she could accurately find the Valley, which could save him a lot of time.
After leaving the airport, Connor turned to look at Temira and asked softly, “How far are we from the Celestial Flower Valley now?”
...
“There’s still a long way to go. The two of us have to pass through Northern Mountain City first, then to a small county. Then, we’ll find the entrance to the forest near the small county. After we reach the forest, we might have to walk for another two to three days before we can find the Valley…”
Temira whispered.
“That far?”
Connor said, surprised at Temira’s words.
“Yeah. Do you think it’s that easy to find our Celestial Flower Valley?” Temira said helplessly.
“Then every time you want to come out, doesn’t it take a very long time?”
Connor asked.
“Of course. This is also why under normal circumstances, the people of our Celestial Flower Valley will not leave. This is also the reason why very few people know the exact location of our Celestial Flower Valley…”
Temira nodded.
“Alright, since the Celestial Flower Valley is so far away, the two of us should hurry up…”
Connor said softly.
“Hurrying on?”
After Temira heard Connor’s words, a trace of helplessness flashed across her eyes. She frowned and said, “Bro, it’s already ten o’clock at night. It’s so late and there’s no car. How are we going to rush? I’m a little tired, so I want to rest now…”
Connor took out his phone to look at the time. He found that it was indeed very late.
He personally didn’t mind the time, but if he exhausted Temira, it wouldn’t be worth it.
Therefore, Connor nodded and said, “Alright then, let’s find a hotel to rest for a while!”
“That’s more like it. When I’m done resting, I’ll do whatever you want me to do…”
Temira looked at Connor with a smile, then brought him to a hotel near the airport.
After entering the hotel, Connor chose to rest in order to maintain his strength.
Temira, who was in the next room, could actually take this opportunity to shake off Connor.
However, after thinking about it for a long time, Temira felt that Connor was actually very pitiful. Moreover, he really needed those medicinal herbs.
Therefore, she didn’t choose to run away in the end. Instead, she lay down on the bed and rested.
The next day, Connor and Temira woke up early.
Connor knew that if he wanted to find the Celestial Flower Valley, he had to go to a small town first—the mountain range where the Valley was located was near that town.
However, if they wanted to go to the town from their current location, they would need to change trains a few times.
Therefore, in order to save time, Connor asked the hotel manager to rent a car to him. After that, he thought that since he wasn’t very familiar with the road here, he asked the manager to find him a driver.
Because Connor was very rich, both the car and the driver were among the best the hotel had.
After everything was arranged, Connor and Temira got into the car.
The driver was very familiar with the road conditions in Northern Mountain Cty. After knowing where Connor and Temira wanted to go, he drove straight onto the highway.
After getting on the highway, Connor continued to close his eyes and rest.
After hesitating for a moment, Temira turned her head to look at him and said softly, “Connor, I have something to tell you…”
Connor was stunned for a moment and asked softly, “What is it?”
“Look, I actually feel that you’re quite pitiful. Moreover, it’s our Celestial Flower Valley’s fault for attacking you, so I’ve decided to help you this time…” Temira said softly.
“Help me?”
After hearing Temira’s words, Connor couldn’t help but be stunned for a moment. Then, he frowned and asked, “How do you plan to help me?”
“Hm. After we arrive at Celestial Flower Valley, you must not act rashly. I will find the Valley Elder and explain the situation to him. Then, I will persuade the Valley Elder to give you the medicinal herbs you need. Of course, the Valley Elder may also put forward some conditions of his own…” Temira said softly.
“There is no need to plead for mercy. If your Celestial Flower Valley is tactful, it will naturally be best if you directly give me the medicinal ingredients. If he does not give them to me, I can only snatch them…”
Connor said calmly.
“Are you crazy? Do you know that our Valley Elder is stronger than a Black-rank? That woman isn’t with you right now, and if you do anything, you’ll die!” Temira shouted at Connor helplessly.
“You don’t have to worry about this matter. I have my own ways…”
Connor said lightly.
“You…”
Temira was speechless when she saw Connor’s attitude. She turned to look at the scenery outside the window, not wanting to continue talking to him.
In Temira’s eyes, Connor was simply unreasonable.
Although his arrogance rendered her speechless, she thought that Connor’s current situation had a lot to do with her; after all, if it weren’t for the pact between the Celestial Flower Valley and the Malone family, none of this would have happened.
Therefore, after hesitating for a few seconds, Temira turned her head and whispered, “Connor, let me introduce you to the Celestial Flower Valley!”
Connor looked at Temira indifferently and then asked, “Why are you being so kind?”
“Why are you so ungrateful!” Temira pouted and said, “I admit that I used some despicable methods in order to obtain the Body Tempering Pill from you. However, I did not want to kill you. I only wanted that pill. Now that I know that you need these ingredients to save your fiancée, I want to give you some help. If you really do not need this help, just pretend that I never said anything…”
“Haha…”
Connor looked at Temira with a faint smile and then said expressionlessly, “Are you saying that you finally discovered your conscience now?”
“Excuse me? I have a conscience, unlike you who bites at everyone without discrimination…” Temira shouted indignantly.

chapters.title: Chapter 1151: Celestial Flower Valley’s Strength
chapters.content:
Chapter 1151: Celestial Flower Valley’s Strength
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
“If you really have a conscience, you wouldn’t use such despicable methods to deal with me,” Connor said in a low voice.
“…”
After hearing his words, Temira fell silent again.
She sighed softly and said, “Forget it, it’s up to you to think whatever you want. Right now, all I want is to do my best to help you. If you can listen, that’s great. If you can’t, then I can’t do anything about it.”
“What do you want to say? Just say it directly,” he replied indifferently to her.
“Let me tell you, the Celestial Celestial Celestial Flower Valley has existed for hundreds of years. During these years, we have focused all our energy on cultivating medicinal herbs. However, we also refine elixirs and have many powerful martial artists. It’s just that we don’t interact with people outside, which leads to outsiders not knowing much about us,” Temira said earnestly to Connor.
...
“And then?” Connor asked.
“The Celestial Celestial Celestial Flower Valley has at least twenty martial artists, and there are seven or eight high-level martial artists at the Yellow Stage or above. So if you forcefully enter the Celestial Celestial Flower Valley, there’s only one path for you in the end—death,” she continued speaking to him.
Upon hearing her words, he couldn’t help but pause, his expression showing some surprise. He then said softly, “Celestial Celestial Flower Valley actually has so many people?”
“Yes, the people of Celestial Celestial Flower Valley cannot leave on their own. Basically, they live their whole lives inside the valley. Coupled with our knowledge of alchemy, it naturally leads to an increase in martial artists.” She nodded and said.
“Why aren’t you a martial artist then?” he asked after a brief pause.
“I’m not a martial artist because I often need to leave Celestial Celestial Flower Valley. I handle most of the outside matters, so you can think of me as Celestial Celestial Flower Valley’s diplomat. Therefore, I cannot be a martial artist; otherwise, it would make the external forces more wary of the valley and bring unnecessary trouble,” she said softly.
“Oh…” Connor nodded and didn’t say much more.
She looked at him and continued, “Now you should know the strength of our Celestial Celestial Flower Valley, right? Don’t think that we only cultivate medicinal herbs. Over the years, countless people have targeted Celestial Celestial Flower Valley, and they have found us, but in the end, we drove them away. You won’t be an exception.”
“Regardless, this time I must obtain those three medicinal herbs!” Connor said firmly to Temira.
“I can help you get what you want…” Temira looked at Connor and said.
“No need…” Connor replied indifferently to Temira.
Upon hearing his words, she couldn’t help but pause, then furrowed her brow and asked, “Why? You can easily get those medicinal herbs now!”
He turned his head to glance at her and said expressionlessly, “I don’t really trust you, so I don’t need your help.”
“You…” She was speechless and looked at Connor in front of her, not knowing what to do.
She couldn’t understand why, after telling him about Celestial Celestial Flower Valley, he would still act this way.
Where did his confidence come from?
However, she also knew that perhaps it was because of the incident with the Malone family that Connor was now extremely wary of her. No matter what she said, he probably wouldn’t believe her anymore.
“If I really didn’t want to help you, I could have secretly run away yesterday…” She pouted and said to him.
“Maybe you deliberately brought me to the Celestial Flower Valley. After all, that way you can find a way to get the whereabouts of theBody Tempering Pill from me…”
Connor said calmly.
“Now that you already know, why did you still come with me?” Temira shouted at Connor, seeming a bit annoyed.
“I have my own plan,” he replied indifferently.
“Is your plan to go and get yourself killed?” she retorted coldly, then turned her head to look out the window, not continuing the conversation.
At this moment, Temira didn’t know what was happening to herself. She had been isolated from the world inside the Celestial Flower Valley for so many years, so her personality had always been very cold.
But when facing Connor, she found that she couldn’t control her emotions.
Right now, she wished she could just kill him, that bastard.
He didn’t pay attention to her and instead closed his eyes to rest.
The car was smoothly driving on the highway, and in the blink of an eye, three hours had passed.
“Mr. Connor, the service station is up ahead. Do you want to take a break?” The driver, who had been driving for three consecutive hours, was starting to feel tired, so he took the initiative to ask.
“Okay, I’m actually a bit hungry…” Before Connor could speak, Temira interjected.
Connor took out his phone and checked the time, realizing that it was indeed mealtime, so he didn’t say much.
A few minutes later, the car smoothly entered the service station.
After getting off the car, Temira glanced coldly at Connor, then walked straight toward the restaurant.
After hesitating for a moment, he followed her into the restaurant.
The car Connor was riding in cost at least two million, and there was even a dedicated driver accompanying him. Besides, there was Temira, a beauty, by his side.
So the waiters in the restaurant looked at him with strange eyes, considering him a rich heir.
This was the first time Connor had been stared at with such eyes, so he felt somewhat uncomfortable.
Temira was even more uncomfortable because she felt like the waiters in the restaurant already regarded her as Connor’s lover. This feeling made her very uncomfortable.
After hesitating for a moment, she turned around and left the restaurant, heading to a nearby store.
A while later, she walked out of the store.
But at this moment, she wore a big hat on her head and a pair of black sunglasses on her face, covering up a large part of her beautiful face.
Seeing her appearance, Connor’s expression seemed helpless, and he said softly, “You’re just assuming too much. These people are all staring at me, not you. You really think of yourself as a great beauty, huh?”

chapters.title: Chapter 1152: Two Rich Heir
chapters.content:
Chapter 1152: Two Rich Heir
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
“Am I not considered beautiful?”
After hearing Connor’s words, Temira’s eyes flashed with anger, and she shouted at him with an unpleasant expression.
“Not really…”
He didn’t hesitate at all and shook his head lightly at her.
Upon hearing his response, she didn’t know what to say. She muttered softly, “My charm lies in my temperament, you know nothing!”
“But you don’t have any charm either!”
...
He struck her with another blow.
At this point, she was completely speechless. She didn’t bother with him and walked straight into the restaurant.
Once inside the restaurant, he handed the menu to her and asked her to order.
Temira, of course, didn’t hold back and extended her fair little hand, ordering expensive dishes without considering his money.
Connor didn’t care at all. After all, it was just a meal, and it wouldn’t cost much.
After she finished ordering, she quietly waited for the food to be served.
The restaurant they came to with Temira and Connor was relatively expensive, so there weren’t many customers inside, and the serving speed was very fast.
Just as the waiter was serving the food, a convoy stopped directly at the entrance of the restaurant.
At the front of the convoy was a Maybach, followed by a line of Mercedes-Benz G-Class vehicles.
The people in the service station widened their eyes and showed expressions of astonishment upon seeing the convoy.
As the Maybach’s door opened, a man and a woman walked out of the car.
These two individuals were around the same age as Connor and Temira, in their early twenties.
Behind the Mercedes-Benz G-Class, there were seven or eight bodyguards who disembarked.
These bodyguards didn’t look like ordinary people. They had extremely sturdy physiques and sharp gazes, most likely all professional bodyguards who retired from special forces.
“Another rich heir…”
“Yeah, what’s happening today? Two rich heirs have shown up…”
“Now this is a real rich heir, alright? The previous one couldn’t compare at all…”
“That’s true. This Maybach alone costs at least several million!”
The people in the service station, upon seeing the young man and woman coming out of the Maybach, expressed their envy and said.
However, the young man and woman seemed accustomed to such situations and paid no attention to the curious gazes. They walked directly into the restaurant.
The bodyguards followed behind them, wearing serious expressions.
Once inside the restaurant, the young man coldly surveyed the situation inside.
Since there weren’t many people in the restaurant at the moment, the young man’s gaze fell directly on Temira.
Connor’s appearance was very ordinary, so he didn’t catch the young man’s attention, but Temira was different.
Although Connor had just said that she wasn’t good-looking, he was obviously joking.
Temira had a very charming temperament, which was probably greatly influenced by her long-term life in the Celestial Flower Valley. It made people feel mysterious and gentle, irresistibly drawing them closer.
Moreover, at this moment, she was wearing sunglasses and a hat, so her appearance couldn’t be seen.
Only her sexy and rosy little mouth was visible, making her look particularly attractive.
The young man seemed somewhat fascinated by Temira, and he was curious about her appearance.
The girl beside him, seeing this scene, seemed a bit dissatisfied and frowned, saying, “Brother, are you falling into your old habit again? We have important things to do, don’t waste time on women…”
“Um…”
After hearing the girl’s words, the young man’s expression appeared somewhat embarrassed, and he softly said, “I was just looking, nothing else…”
“Let’s hurry and order!”
The girl seemed to have no intention of saying anything more to the young man. She sat directly on a chair and picked up the menu to prepare her order.
Reluctantly, the young man glanced at Temira, unable to help but sigh. He didn’t say anything more and sat down directly.
The young man himself was a second-generation rich kid and naturally had some of the problems that second-generation rich kids would have. Moreover, Temira’s temperament was indeed very attractive. Not to mention a second-generation rich kid, even an ordinary person would want to see what Temira really looked like. However, the young man also knew that he had something very important to do at the moment, so he couldn’t waste time on Temira.
“What a pity. If it were any other time, I would definitely pursue this woman…”
The young man couldn’t help but mutter to himself, then began to eat.
“It seems like that rich kid is interested in you…”
Connor naturally noticed that the young man had been looking intentionally or unintentionally in their direction. He quickly understood what the young man meant.
When Temira heard his words, she turned her head and glanced at the young man, then said to Connor, “He’s much more handsome than you…”
He understood that she was retaliating against him with that remark, so he smiled helplessly and didn’t say much.
Temira naturally had no interest in that young man either. Although she didn’t go out often, she often encountered pursuers, so she was already accustomed to such situations.
It seemed that both sides had very important things to do, so there was no interaction between them.
Connor and Temira finished their meal first, then left directly.
When the young man saw Temira leaving with Connor, his expression appeared somewhat disappointed, but he didn’t say much.
“Bro, once we help Dad find the antidote, what kind of woman do you want to find?”
The girl naturally noticed the young man’s reluctance and quickly spoke up.
“I’m just curious about what this woman really looks like. I don’t have any other intentions!”
The young man explained as he looked at the girl.
“That would be for the best!”
The girl replied calmly and didn’t say much.
After Connor and Temira left the service station, they continued driving.
Along the way, he rested with his eyes closed.
Meanwhile, she had been staring at the scenery outside the window, contemplating who knows what in her heart.
Three hours later, the two of them arrived at the second service station.
Connor and the others took another break.
However, when Connor and the driver entered the restaurant with Temira, they discovered that the rich kid they had encountered at the previous service station had unexpectedly arrived at the restaurant ahead of them.
Upon seeing her again, the young man naturally felt very excited because he didn’t expect to encounter her again.

chapters.title: Chapter 1153: Traveling Together
chapters.content:
Chapter 1153: Traveling Together
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
The young man hesitated for a moment, then walked directly towards Connor and Temira. He smiled and said, “Well, it’s quite a coincidence to meet again.”
“We do have quite a fate to run into each other…”
Connor saw the young man approaching and being friendly, so he responded.
“Young man, where are you headed? Are you also going to Quay City?”
The young man asked Connor.
“That’s right, we’re going to Quay City!”
...
Connor nodded.
“We’re really meant to meet then. I’m also going to Quay City…”
The young man looked at Connor with excitement, then turned to Temira and said with a smile, “Is she your girlfriend?”
“I’m not his girlfriend! How could I possibly like someone like him!”
Temira quickly spoke up without hesitation.
“Oh, I’m sorry. I thought you two were a couple, going out together!”
The young man quickly explained, but there was a hint of smugness in his eyes. He then started chatting with Temira, completely ignoring Connor.
Facing this situation, Connor didn’t mind at all. After all, she had nothing to do with him.
And Connor knew that this young man came to strike up a conversation with Temira. As long as it didn’t interfere with Connor finding the Celestial Flower Valley, he had no intention of getting involved.
The girl who came out of the restroom with the young man, upon seeing that he was chatting with Temira, flashed a hint of helplessness in her eyes.
But she didn’t say much and just focused on eating.
Through the conversation between the young man and Temira, Connor learned that the young man’s name was Jameson Trent, and the girl was his sister, Maddison Trent.
Both of them came from families involved in international business and had very good conditions.
The Trent family could be considered a prominent family, with the Tang Corporation under its banner having a market value that had long exceeded billions.
But some time ago, Jameson’s father was poisoned and remained in a coma to this day.
During this time, the Trent family had sought many famous doctors to treat their father.
But unfortunately, these famous doctors were all helpless.
They didn’t even know what poison Jameson’s father had been afflicted with. Later, he happened to hear about the Celestial Flower Valley.
So he decided to bring his sister and search for a cure in the valley.
Although Jameson was a second-generation rich kid, he gave off a good impression. He spoke in a very friendly manner and showed no arrogance, nor any hostility towards Connor.
Connor had a favorable impression of Jameson, and Temira found him witty and humorous, so the two naturally started chatting.
“Connor, are you also going to Quay City to seek medicine?”
At that moment, Jameson suddenly asked Connor.
“I guess so!”
Connor nodded lightly.
“Do you know the specific location of the Celestial Flower Valley?”
Jameson’s eyes sparkled with excitement as he hurriedly asked Connor.
Although Jameson knew about the Celestial Flower Valley and that it could provide a cure for his father, the place was too mysterious, and outsiders had no way of determining its exact location.
He had also spent a lot of effort to learn that the the valley should be somewhere near Quay City.
But he didn’t know the exact location.
That’s why he asked Connor if he knew the specific location of the the valley.
“We’re not sure either!”
Before Connor could speak, Temira immediately cut in, as she didn’t want to reveal her identity.
“I see!”
After Jameson heard Temira’s words, his facial expression appeared somewhat disappointed, but he didn’t say much further.
“Brother, it’s getting late. We should go…”
Just at that moment, Jameson’s younger sister, Maddison, stood up directly and called out to Jameson.
He hesitated for a moment, then whispered to Connor, “Connor, since we’re both going to Quay City, why don’t we travel together? There’s still room in my car, and it would be good to have someone to accompany us on the way.”
Upon hearing his words, Connor couldn’t help but pause for a moment.
“Brother, what are you talking about here?”
After hearing Jameson’s words, Maddison’s eyes flashed with a hint of helplessness, and she quickly frowned and shouted.
“Maddison, Connor and Miss Temira are also going to find the Celestial Flower Valley. We can go together!”
Jameson explained.
“They are also going there?”
Upon hearing this, Maddison couldn’t help but pout, then continued, “I think these two people are definitely not good people. Maybe they’re scammers trying to deceive us. We better keep our distance from them!”
“Maddison, don’t talk nonsense!”
Jameson frowned and rebuked coldly, then turned to explain to Connor, “Connor, I apologize for that. My father has been unconscious, and my sister is a bit anxious and in a bad mood. She said something wrong. Please don’t mind!”
“It’s alright…”
After seeing his sincere apology, Connor didn’t say much.
In fact, rich second-generation like Jameson were quite rare. After all, most of them are pampered and have very arrogant personalities.
Even if Maddison had said something wrong just now, other rich second-generation would definitely not apologize in this manner.
But he was different from other rich second-generation. Not only did he apologize, but his attitude was also very sincere.
So both Connor and Temira accepted his apology.
“What kind of illness does your father have?”
Temira was originally from the Celestial Flower Valley, so she had some knowledge of medicine and took the initiative to ask Jameson.
Upon hearing her question, Jameson couldn’t help but sigh, then whispered, “My father is not sick, he was poisoned by someone. But as for what kind of poison it is, I’m not sure at the moment. Someone told me that as long as I find the Celestial Flower Valley and inform them about my father’s condition, they will give me an antidote. This antidote can cure many diseases. I don’t know if it’s true, but right now I have no other choice but to try my luck…”
“I see!”
Temira nodded gently, without saying much, but she knew that Jameson’s situation should be relatively easy to solve.

chapters.title: Chapter 1154: I Don’t Want to Trouble Them
chapters.content:
Chapter 1154: I Don’t Want to Trouble Them
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Because there was indeed a miraculous medicine called Hundred Herb Pill in the Celestial Flower Valley.
This medicine can remove most of the toxins from the human body.
However, it is only effective against common poisons. If it’s a special poison, even Hundred Herb Pill won’t have any effect.
But people outside may have some misunderstandings about Hundred Herb Pill and think it can cure any poison.
After understanding what Jameson was all about, Temira didn’t say much.
And Jameson felt that his sister’s words just now made some sense. After all, he knew nothing about Connor and Temira’s identities. It was indeed inappropriate to invite Connor so rashly.
...
If they were really bad people, things would be troublesome.
“BConnor, why are you going to Celestial Flower Valley?”
Jameson asked Connor softly.
“I’m going to Celestial Flower Valley to find some medicinal herbs…”
Connor had nothing to hide and answered directly.
“Oh…”
Jameson nodded lightly and continued to ask Connor, “Where are you from?”
“I’m from Porthampton,” he replied.
“Porthampton…”
Jameson was momentarily stunned, then smiled and said, “It seems we do have some fate. I just went there not long ago and even met the CEO of Empire World Corporation…”
“Thomas?”
Connor asked directly.
“You know Mr. Thomas?”
There was a hint of excitement in Jameson’s eyes.
“Of course, I do…”
Connor replied helplessly, but he didn’t reveal his own identity to Jameson because he thought it would be better if he didn’t know his identity.
After knowing that Connor knew Thomas, he became even more certain that Connor was not a bad person and had no ill intentions towards him. So he relaxed a lot when talking to Connor.
Jameson was a person who spoke without any airs, giving a very humorous and witty impression. It was very comfortable to be around him.
But his sister was different. She had a very arrogant personality and spoke in a domineering manner, often urging him not to waste time with Connor and the others, which made people feel very uncomfortable.
Although Jameson and Maddison were siblings, they had very different personalities, and Connor knew that the main reason was the difference in the education they received from a young age.
Jameson was destined to inherit the family’s assets in the future, so he had been groomed as the future heir of the Trent family since he was very young. He needed to be careful in all aspects, which also led to Jameson having a very amiable way of speaking and giving people a friendly impression. Such a person was more likely to expand his network and social circle.
Connor knew many rich second generations, but the only one who could be compared to Jameson was Arthur. The rest of the rich second generations couldn’t be compared to Jameson at all.
From this point, Connor could feel that the Trent family was really extraordinary.
As for Maddison, although she had a very exquisite appearance and a good figure, with a hint of light makeup on her face, wearing a white skirt, she could definitely be regarded as a beautiful and wealthy woman in the eyes of ordinary people.
But she exuded a strong aura of a rich kid. She probably hadn’t received a good education in this regard since she was young.
After all, Maddison was just a girl. She would definitely get married in the future.
So the Trent family wouldn’t waste too much time on Maddison. As long as she can grow up healthy, there shouldn’t be any problem.
Although this society has always advocated gender equality.
But in reality, many prominent families still place greater emphasis on nurturing boys and neglect girls’ education.
“Connor, we’re all going to Quay City. How about going together?”
After knowing that Connor and Temira were not bad people, Jameson took the initiative to invite them again.
When Maddison heard these words, her expression seemed unhappy.
Connor hesitated. He thought that if he traveled with Jameson, the journey would undoubtedly be more convenient, but there would also be many issues.
Moreover, he planned to directly snatch things in the Celestial Flower Valley this time, so he didn’t want to involve Jameson.
“It’s fine.”
Connor softly refused.
“Alright then…”
Jameson, seeing that Connor didn’t seem interested in traveling with him, had a hint of helplessness in his eyes but didn’t say much.
Maddison’s expression eased a lot when she saw his refusal.
Actually, Temira intended to go with Jameson and the others. After all, there wasn’t much to say between her and Connor. If she followed Jameson and the others, she would have a much easier time.
But after seeing Connor’s refusal, she naturally didn’t say much either.
A few minutes later, Connor and Temira finished resting, so they left the restaurant first.
“Jameson is quite nice…”
Temira whispered to Connor.
“He’s indeed good. If there’s a chance in the future, I can have my company collaborate with the Trent family. I think Jameson is more reliable…”
Connor looked at her and said calmly.
“Why don’t you go with them then?” she asked with some confusion.
“I don’t want to burden them,” he replied.
After hearing Connor’s words, Temira smiled helplessly and didn’t say much.
“Mr. Connor…”
However, at that moment, the driver suddenly rushed out of the car in a hurry.
“What’s wrong?”
Seeing the driver’s anxious appearance, Connor couldn’t help but furrow his brow and ask.
“Mr. Connor, it seems like there’s a problem with our car. I’m currently fixing it. Maybe you should go back and wait for a while!”
The driver helplessly explained to Connor.
“The car has a problem?”
Connor’s expression immediately turned grim upon hearing the driver’s words.
“Yes, the car was working fine earlier, but suddenly it wouldn’t start. I need to check what’s going on!”
The driver explained as he looked at Connor.
At that moment, Jameson, Maddison, and the others also walked out of the restaurant.
“Connor, why haven’t you left yet?”
Jameson approached and asked when he saw Connor talking to the driver.
“The car has some faults and may need repairs!”
Connor turned his head and glanced at Jameson, expressing helplessness.
“That’s perfect. Just come with us. There’s still room in my car. It’s getting dark, and who knows when it will be fixed? Delaying like this isn’t a good idea!”
Taking advantage of the opportunity, Jameson once again extended the invitation.
Connor didn’t want to waste any more time, so he turned his head to look at Temira, seemingly seeking her opinion.

chapters.title: Chapter 1155: How Much Is Too Much?
chapters.content:
Chapter 1155: How Much Is Too Much?
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
“I’m fine with anything…” Temira looked at Connor and said lightly.
“Since Miss Temira has said so, let’s get on the car quickly and try to reach Quay City early!” Jameson shouted enthusiastically at Connor.
After hesitating for a moment, Connor didn’t say much and directly followed him onto the car.
As for the driver, he stayed behind to repair the car. After the car was fixed, he would return directly.
After Connor, Temira, and the others got on the car, they continued driving towards Quay City.
But with their current progress, it was impossible to reach Quay City today. They could only rest for a night in Quay Rocks in front of Quay City and set off for Quay City the next day.
...
When the four of them arrived in Quay Rocks, it was already past one in the morning.
Connor noticed that Jameson had thoughtfully booked a room for him and Temira, and it was the best five-star hotel.
Although the money spent on staying in a hotel was nothing to Connor, Jameson’s gesture was very comforting. In the future, Connor only needed to mention it to Thomas, and the value created by Connor and Jameson might surpass that of this five-star hotel.
After resting for a night, the group set off early the next day to Quay City.
Along the way, Jameson was chatting with Temira and Connor.
Meanwhile, Maddison seemed indifferent from beginning to end, playing with her phone alone.
After two more days of rushing, the group finally arrived in Quay City.
Upon arriving in Quay City, Jameson didn’t know which way to go.
But he heard that there were many people in Quay City who knew the exact location of the Celestial Flower Valley. As long as you gave them some money, they would guide you.
So after settling Connor and Temira, Jameson began to look for a suitable guide in Quay City.
Originally, he didn’t have to go through this trouble since Temira knew the way. However, she didn’t want to reveal her identity, so she didn’t stop him from finding a guide.
The night quickly passed, and he finally found a suitable guide.
This guide had lived in Quay City for his whole life and had been making a living by guiding people.
After all, simply guiding someone once could earn tens of thousands of dollars, and it was an easy way to make money.
Many residents of Quay City even considered it a business.
But this business also had certain risks. After all, the situation in the mountains was very complicated, and there were often cases where guides lost their lives.
“Can this person really lead us to Celestial Flower Valley?” Maddison looked at the guide, Gordan, in front of her, her tone filled with doubt.
“Miss, you don’t need to worry about that. I go through this route almost every month, and I’m very familiar with the situation inside. I guarantee that I can lead you there. However, whether you can enter or not is your problem. I can’t guarantee…” Gordan said, smoking a cigarette and smiling at Maddison.
“You go through this route every month?” Maddison’s eyes flashed with surprise upon hearing his words.
“Yes, after all, everyone has their ups and downs in life. Wealthy people like you often come seeking medicine. But I have to remind you, out of ten people who enter, only one person actually gets the elixir. Most people come out empty-handed…”
Gordan said with a smile.
“So, does that mean someone really obtained the elixir?”
Jameson asked eagerly.
“Of course, someone did get the elixir. After all, the people from the Celestial Flower Valley also have to give some face to us guides. Otherwise, who would come seeking medicine!”
Gordan said softly.
“Do you know how to get these elixirs?”
Jameson asked Gordan while handing him some cash.
After seeing the cash Jameson took out, Gordan smiled faintly and said softly, “Based on my understanding, those who can obtain the elixirs usually offer some benefits to the people of Celestial Flower Valley. That’s how they can successfully get the elixirs. Those who are ignorant and go in empty-handed end up wasting their efforts…”
“Benefits?”
Upon hearing this, Jameson couldn’t help but smile faintly and said softly, “That’s easy then. This time, I’ve prepared a lot of cash and checks. I’ll just give them directly to the people from Celestial Flower Valley…”
Now, Jameson is willing to spend however much money it takes to save his father.
“Haha…”
But after hearing Jameson’s words, Gordan couldn’t help but burst into laughter.
“Why are you laughing?”
Jameson was puzzled and asked Gordan with an expression of confusion.
“I’m laughing because you are too naive…”
Gordan replied softly, then continued, “Let me tell you, money is not something that can sway the people of Celestial Flower Valley. They are not interested in money at all. You’d better put away that money quickly…”
“How is that possible?”
A hint of surprise flashed in Jameson’s eyes.
“Brother, don’t listen to this person’s nonsense. I can’t believe there are people in this world who don’t like money. The reason those people can’t move the people of Celestial Flower Valley is simply because the money they offer is not enough. As long as we offer enough money, I don’t believe those people won’t be tempted…”
Maddison pouted and said.
After hearing her words, Gordan’s eyes flashed with disdain. He then said calmly, “Miss, how much money do you think is considered ‘enough’?”
“Would one hundred million be enough? If not, then I’ll give them five hundred million…”
Maddison said confidently.
“Five hundred million?”
After hearing Maddison’s words, Gordan smirked disdainfully, then said calmly, “Just a year ago, I led a group of foreigners into the Celestial Flower Valley. Their mindset was the same as yours. Do you know how much money they prepared?”
“How much?”
Jameson seemed curious.
“They prepared a whopping five billion US dollars…”
Gordan held up five fingers in front of Jameson.
Upon hearing this amount, Jameson couldn’t help but gasp. After all, five billion US dollars is not a small sum, and even now, Jameson cannot come up with that much money.
“Those foreigners were full of confidence. They believed that with this amount of money, they would have more than enough to buy the elixirs!”
“But who could have imagined that the people from Celestial Flower Valley didn’t even spare them a glance and directly kicked them out. These people felt indignant and had conflicts with the people from Celestial Flower Valley, and in the end, they were beaten away…”
Gordan said calmly.

chapters.title: Chapter 1156: Arriving at Celestial Flower Valley
chapters.content:
Chapter 1156: Arriving at Celestial Flower Valley
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Jameson and Maddison stood frozen in place, their faces showing an indescribable shock upon hearing these words.
Because they never expected that even five hundred million dollars wouldn’t be able to impress the people of the Celestial Flower Valley.
And as for the money they had in their hands, it was even more insignificant.
Connor turned his head and glanced at Temira, noticing an unusually triumphant expression on her face.
After all, those people in the Celestial Flower Valley probably lived their whole lives there, rarely interacting with the outside world.
So money was probably the least important thing to them, and naturally, they weren’t interested in such things.
...
Jameson looked at Gordan’s position and felt a myriad of emotions.
He silently congratulated himself in his heart, grateful that he had asked in advance; otherwise, it would have been troublesome to enter rashly.
“So, Gordan, what should I bring in to make things easier?” Jameson asked.
Upon hearing his words, Gordan’s eyes showed a hint of surprise, followed by a hesitant expression.
Jameson understood what Gordan meant, but he didn’t dare to offend him at the moment, so he quickly took out some cash and handed it to Gordan again.
When Gordan saw the cash, his smile seemed even brighter.
He quickly smiled and said, “You’ve come to the right person this time. Based on my many years of experience in guiding, the people in the Celestial Flower Valley are indeed uninterested in money, but they are very interested in antique medicinal herbs and similar things. If you can find these items, they should accept them, and your chances of obtaining the medicine will also greatly increase…”
“Antique medicinal herbs?” Jameson’s eyes flashed with surprise upon hearing this, and he quickly turned to Connor and said, “Connor, can we wait here for another day? I’ll have my family send over some precious antique calligraphy or jade objects. I’ll also give you some…”
Connor’s eyes showed a hint of helplessness upon hearing Jameson’s words. After all, he didn’t want to waste time now.
But when he saw Jameson’s sincere expression, he couldn’t bear to refuse either.
So he nodded and said, “Alright, let’s stay for another day. I don’t need antique calligraphy or anything, so you don’t have to prepare it for me.”
“It’s alright, we have plenty of antiques at home!” Jameson replied with a smile, then took out his phone and made a call.
Temira helplessly glanced at Jameson and silently made up her mind to help him find the antidote.
He was quite efficient, and the next day, a large number of antique calligraphy, paintings, and medicinal jade objects were sent over by helicopter.
Under Gordan’s guidance, Jameson selected some rare antiques to bring along, and finally, they set off towards the Celestial Flower Valley.
The mountains near Quay City were very complex, and there were often fierce beasts in the area.
If it weren’t for Gordan’s guidance, it would probably be difficult to find the exact location of the Celestial Flower Valley and it would be easy to get lost inside.
However, Jameson had many bodyguards, all of whom were former special forces and familiar with outdoor conditions.
So with the guidance of the bodyguards and Gordan, they made the journey much easier.
“Aren’t you scared walking this kind of path as a girl?” Connor turned his head and glanced at Temira, asking softly.
