“I know a shortcut, and it’s very convenient. It could lead me directly to the Celestial Flower Valley. But now there are outsiders, so I can’t go…”
Temira replied lightly to Connor.
“So, that’s how it is!”
Connor nodded gently, not saying much.
“I can’t walk anymore. Let’s take a rest!”
At that moment, Maddison suddenly spoke out.
“Hold on a little longer. We can rest when it’s time to eat…”
This was already the third time Maddison said she wanted to rest, and Jameson expressed some dissatisfaction.
“No, I really can’t walk anymore…”
While speaking, she sat down on the ground, then reached out and rubbed her knee, pouting and saying, “What kind of place is this? Why is it so difficult to walk?”
Connor glanced down at Maddison’s high heels, a hint of helplessness flashed in his eyes.
He knew they were going on a mountain trail, yet Maddison still wore high heels. It was strange to expect an easy walk.
After a few minutes, she had rested enough and finally got up to continue walking ahead.
At the beginning, everyone took turns supporting her, but unfortunately, they were all ordinary people, and the mountain trail was indeed very difficult to traverse.
So, after a while, everyone’s strength began to waver.
The Celestial Flower Valley, which could have been reached in a day, ended up taking two days and two nights because of Maddison.
“Gentlemen, the entrance to the Celestial Flower Valley is just ahead, but we can’t go in yet. We have to see what the people inside think. If the gatekeeper is in a good mood, they will let us in, but if they’re not, we might not be able to enter!”
Gordan pointed at the cave in front of him and whispered to the group.
“What if we can’t get in?”
Jameson asked, seemingly worried.
“If we can’t get in, we’ll have to wait here until the people in the Celestial Flower Valley are in a better mood and let us in!”
Gordan said with a hint of helplessness.
“Okay!”
After hearing Gordan’s words, Jameson nodded helplessly and walked ahead.
Connor and the others followed closely behind Jameson.
After a while, they finally passed through the cave.
Once out of the cave, Connor noticed that it suddenly opened up ahead, revealing a huge ancient city in front of them.
It was at this moment that Connor finally understood that the so-called Celestial Flower Valley was just a city.
Moreover, this city was enormous, capable of accommodating tens of thousands of people.
“Is this your Celestial Flower Valley?”
Connor turned his head and glanced at Temira, softly asking her.
“This place can’t be considered the true Celestial Flower Valley. The true Celestial Flower Valley is further inside. Originally, we used to live in the valley, and the medicinal herbs were also grown there. But later, as more and more people came to the Celestial Flower Valley, the valley couldn’t accommodate so many people anymore, and it would also absorb the spiritual energy of the medicinal herbs. So, the valley master built this city, and now we all live inside this city…”
Temira explained as she looked at Connor.
“I see!”
Connor nodded and didn’t say much.

chapters.title: Chapter 1157: A Check for Five Hundred Thousand
chapters.content:
Chapter 1157: A Check for Five Hundred Thousand
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
“It’s so magnificent. I can’t believe such a place still exist!” Maddison exclaimed, her expression filled with astonishment.
“Yes, it’s like a paradise on earth!” Jameson also sighed in admiration.
“That place ahead is the Celestial Flower Valley. Usually, the gate is open, and we can enter with permission. But today, for some reason, it’s closed. There must be something going on,” Gordan explained to Jameson.
“Can we still go in now?” Jameson asked anxiously upon hearing Gordan’s words.
“I don’t know if we can enter now. Let me ask them what’s going on!” Gordan replied in a low voice.
“Who are you?” At that moment, a young man walked out from behind the city gate and emotionlessly asked.
...
Upon seeing the man, Temira instinctively lowered her head, not wanting him to see her face.
Meanwhile, Connor glanced at the man from head to toe and realized that he was no different from the boys outside. He was dressed in modern attire.
This indicated that although Celestial Flower Valley was hidden in this deep mountain forest, it was still closely connected to the outside world.
“Mr. Zus, it’s me!” Gordan hurriedly approached the man and said with a smile.
The man glanced at Gordan indifferently and said expressionlessly, “Oh, it’s you. I remember warning you that we are not receiving anyone recently due to some important matters in Celestial Flower Valley. Why did you still bring these people here?”
“Mr. Zus, these people offered a large sum of money, and they are in a hurry, so I brought them here…” Gordan quietly explained.
After hearing his words, a hint of helplessness flashed in the man’s eyes. He then asked flatly, “What about the items?”
“I brought them, I brought them…” Gordan nodded hastily, taking out a few cigarettes from his clothes and handing them to the man.
You see, the existence of guides not only facilitates those who want to find Celestial Flower Valley, but also benefits the people inside the valley. After all, there are many young people here who sometimes need things, so they can only be delivered through these guides. Cigarettes are the most common, and sometimes they even bring some contraceptives.
After seeing the cigarettes Gordan took out, the man’s expression seemed to soften a little. He glanced at Jameson, Maddison, and the others, and finally focused his gaze on Temira.
Since Temira was wearing a hat and sunglasses, the man didn’t recognize her. He just felt that she looked somewhat familiar. As for Connor, he was dressed very ordinary, while Jameson was clearly a wealthy person. So the man directly focused his attention on Jameson.
“Are you here to seek medicine?” the man asked Jameson expressionlessly.
“Yes, Mr. Zus, I am Jameson. This is my sister. My father is seriously ill, so I came here to seek medicine. I hope you can give us some convenience…” Jameson politely addressed the man.
“I’m not a master. The matter of seeking medicine has nothing to do with me. I’m only responsible for managing the comings and goings,” the man explained to Jameson in a casual tone.
The man looked at Jameson and casually explained, then continued, “We’ve had some incidents recently in the Celestial Flower Valley, so outsiders can’t enter. You’ve come at the wrong time. You should go back.”
After hearing the man’s words, Jameson’s eyes flashed with a hint of nervousness. After all, his father’s condition couldn’t wait any longer. He hurriedly said, “Master, the situation with my father is really dangerous. Could you please make an exception?”
“If you’re in a hurry, you can wait here. As for when you’ll be able to enter, I don’t know…”
The man said arrogantly.
After hesitating for a moment, Jameson directly took out a brocade box from his pocket and handed it to the man with a smile, saying softly, “Master, please let me in.”
The man accepted the brocade box, glanced at it, and said calmly, “I’m not very interested in these things. The master inside might like them…”
After saying that, the man returned the brocade box to Jameson.
After all, this man was not a disciple of the Celestial Flower Valley. He was only a registered disciple responsible for guarding the gate. He preferred money and similar things.
Jameson’s reaction was quick. He quickly took out a check worth five hundred thousand and handed it to the man.
The man smiled faintly when he saw the check and accepted it directly.
Jameson relaxed a little when he saw the man accept the money.
“You’ve indeed come at the wrong time. The elders inside the valley are all busy with something. But since you seem sensible, I’ll let you in first and find a place for you. But you should know that even if you enter now, there’s no guarantee anyone will pay attention to you because the elders simply don’t have the time. Do you understand what I mean?” The man said expressionlessly to Jameson.
Upon hearing the man’s words, Jameson couldn’t help but pause for a moment and then asked the man in a puzzled tone, “Master, what exactly has happened inside?”
“I don’t know the specifics, but I have to make it clear to you in advance that whether you can get the medicine or not has nothing to do with me. Do you understand?” The man said indifferently.
“I understand, I understand…” Jameson nodded quickly.
Connor, looking at the man’s position, knew that his matters must have reached the Celestial Flower Valley. The people there must be very nervous now, trying to find a way to deal with him.
Temira seemed to understand what was going on but didn’t say much.
After hesitating for a moment, the man walked directly to Gordan and handed him a note, saying expressionlessly, “Remember to bring these things next time you come.”
“Okay…” he replied with a smile and then looked up at Jameson.
Jameson quickly took out a check and handed it to him. He accepted the check with a smile and then turned around and left.
He had completed his mission, so there was no need to stay here any longer.
man said indifferently.
“I know, I know…”
Jameson hurriedly nodded.
Connor looked at the man’s position. He knew that his matter must have spread to the Celestial Flower Valley, so the people of the Celestial Flower Valley must be very nervous now and want to think of a way to deal with Connor.
Temira seemed to know what was going on, but she didn’t say anything.
The middle-aged man hesitated for a moment before he walked up to Gordan and handed him a piece of paper. He said expressionlessly,”Remember to bring these things when you come over next time…”
“Alright…”
Gordan replied with a smile and then looked up at Jameson.
Jameson quickly took out a check and handed it to Gordan. Gordan took the check with a smile and then turned around to leave.
He had completed his mission successfully, so there was no need for him to stay here.

chapters.title: Chapter 1158: Elder Helios
chapters.content:
Chapter 1158: Elder Helios
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
“You guys come with me…”
The man said expressionlessly to Jameson.
“Okay…”
Jameson nodded and followed the man into the Celestial Flower Valley.
“After you go in, you must not cause any trouble. If you offend the elders and get kicked out, I won’t be able to save you…”
Zus Trefford said while walking and instructing.
...
“Mr. Zus, don’t worry. We came here this time to seek medicine, not to cause trouble. After obtaining the medicine, we will leave.”
Jameson said nervously.
“That’s good…”
Zus nodded and led Connor and others into the city.
Upon entering the city, Connor found that all the buildings inside were in Colonial style, giving the feeling of traveling back in time.
But the people inside were dressed in modern clothing. They were all disciples of the Celestial Flower Valley, responsible for planting medicinal herbs. Only some truly gifted disciples could learn alchemy.
Temira’s status in the Celestial Flower Valley was not low, second only to the elders. Otherwise, they would not let her leave.
“Do you see that palace? That’s where the Valley Master resides. Now the Valley Master and the elders are discussing important matters. So you must not approach that place, or you will be expelled…”
Zus pointed to a palace not far away and reminded them in a low voice.
“Mr. Zus, what should we do if we want the Valley Master’s help in refining the elixir?”
After hesitating for a moment, Jameson asked Zus.
Upon hearing his question, Zus couldn’t help but sneer, and then said in a deep voice, “Don’t even dream about it. I’ve been in the Celestial Flower Valley for so long and have never seen the Valley Master take action. The Valley Master won’t pay any attention to you. It’s already good enough to have the elders help you…”
“I see…”
Jameson smiled awkwardly and didn’t say much.
“Alright, let me take you to where you’ll be staying!”
Zus said.
But at that moment, a middle-aged man walked over, followed by several others.
Along the way, anyone who saw the middle-aged man would come forward to greet him. It was clear that his identity was not simple.
When Zus saw the middle-aged man, his expression became somewhat nervous. He hurriedly stepped forward and said, “Elder Helios, why are you here!”
“This person is also an elder of our Celestial Flower Valley, but his position is very low, even lower than mine.”
“And this Elder Helios is responsible for receiving guests. He likes to show off in front of guests, and he has tarnished the reputation of our Celestial Flower Valley…”
Temira explained to Connor in a low voice when she saw the middle-aged man.
“Heh…”
Connor faintly smiled upon hearing Temira’s words and didn’t say much.
“Zus, why are you here?”
Elder Helios arrogantly asked Zus.
After hesitating for a moment, Zus pointed at Connor and the others and said, “Elder Helios, these people came to seek medicine. They are very…”
“Didn’t I tell you before not to bring outsiders in now? Why did you still bring them in? Are you trying to get kicked out of the Celestial Flower Valley?”
Elder Helios shouted angrily.
“Elder Helios, we are really in need of…”
Jameson saw that the situation was not right and hurriedly shouted at Elder Helios.
“What’s the use of being anxious? We have important matters to attend to in the Celestial Flower Valley. All the elders are in a meeting and have no mood to deal with all of you. If you’re willing to stay and wait, then wait. If you don’t want to wait, you can leave now!” he shouted, glaring.
“Elder, my father’s illness is very severe. If we don’t treat it in time, he might not make it. Can you please make an exception?” Jameson asked humbly.
“Make an exception?” After hearing this, Elder Helios couldn’t help but sneer and said in a low voice, “Look at all these people. They arrived before you, and they’re all waiting here. If I make an exception for you, what about them? Should I make exceptions for all of them too?”
Jameson knew very well that if he continued to wait, his father wouldn’t last much longer.
But he couldn’t wait any longer. So after hesitating for a moment, he reluctantly took out a check and wanted to hand it to him.
When Elder Helios saw Jameson’s check, his expression seemed even angrier, and he shouted, “What does this mean? Take your filthy money away. We don’t need these things in the Celestial Flower Valley!”
Jameson was stunned for a moment, then quickly took out a brocade box and whispered to Elder Helios, “Elder Helios, are you interested in this?”
As Jameson spoke, he handed the brocade box to Elder Helios in front of him.
After Elder Helios saw the brocade box Jameson took out, his expression also seemed curious.
After all, he didn’t know what was inside the brocade box.
After hesitating for a moment, he finally chose to open the brocade box.
When he saw that there was a jade pendant inside the box, a hint of excitement flashed in his eyes.
Because this jade pendant was from the Elizabethan era, it was valuable and extremely rare.
“Elder Helios, can you make an exception now?” Jameson asked with a smile.
Although he really wanted to accept this jade pendant, unfortunately, there were still many people around him watching.
If he really accepted the jade pendant like this, it would prove that he was easy to bribe with.
So he whispered, “We have important matters to attend to in the Celestial Flower Valley. The elders have no mood to deal with you all. But considering how anxious you are, I’ll give you a chance. You can kneel here and wait until the Valley Master sees that you’ve been kneeling here the whole time. Perhaps your sincerity will move him, and he might give you what you need…”
“Kneel here the whole time?” Jameson’s expression became hesitant after hearing Elder Helios’s words.
But in the end, he furrowed his brow and asked, “How long do I need to kneel here?”
“I’m not sure how long you need to kneel, but right now, the only thing you can do is kneel down and move the Valley Master. If you trust me, then kneel and wait for the Valley Master to come out. If you don’t trust me, then I can’t do anything!” he said expressionlessly.

chapters.title: Chapter 1159: I Am Connor!
chapters.content:
Chapter 1159: I Am Connor!
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
After hearing Elder Helios’s words, Jameson stood still and hesitated for two seconds.
Finally, Jameson didn’t hesitate anymore. He immediately knelt down on the ground, saying, “As long as you can cure my father’s illness, even if you ask me to kneel here for three days, I won’t complain!”
After saying this, he didn’t hesitate at all and directly knelt on the ground.
Seeing this scene, Elder Helios smiled playfully but didn’t say much.
In fact, all Jameson wanted was just a Hundred Herb Pill, which was not considered a precious elixir in the Celestial Flower Valley. Even Elder Helios could easily get it.
But Elder Helios’s current action was simply to humiliate Jameson and let everyone present understand what kind of person he was.
...
“He actually knelt down!”
“Yeah, I didn’t expect him to actually kneel. I wonder how long he’ll have to kneel!”
“Seems like he really has filial piety. That’s rare…”
People looked at Jameson’s position and began to whisper quietly.
As for Temira, she looked at Jameson with an angry expression on her face. She knew better than anyone that there was no such rule in the Celestial Flower Valley. Elder Helios was clearly making things difficult for him.
However, she didn’t want to expose her identity right now, so she didn’t say much.
“Since you have already taken something from someone else, yet you still act this way…”
Even the person who brought Connor and the others in, Zus, found Elder Helios’s behavior very disapproving.
After hesitating for a moment, Connor walked up to Jameson and said in a low voice, “Jameson, you should get up. This guy is clearly trying to humiliate you!”
Upon hearing Connor’s words, Jameson couldn’t help but hesitate for a moment and then asked in a puzzled tone, “Connor, what do you mean by this?”
“Kid, how dare you speak nonsense here?!” Elder Helios, upon hearing Connor’s words, became furious and shouted at him.
Connor gave him a cold glance and said with a grim expression, “He just wants a Hundred Herb Pill, which is not considered a precious elixir in your Celestial Flower Valley. You just accepted his gift, and now you’re making him kneel here. Isn’t this just embarrassing him to elevate yourself?”
Elder Helios felt a bit embarrassed after hearing his words. Those who could find the Celestial Flower Valley were all seeking help from the valley, so they naturally feared the people here.
He was the first one to dare to speak to them like this.
“Who are you? What does the Celestial Flower Valley’s rules have to do with you? How dare you talk back to me?!” Elder Helios shouted angrily, his face flushed.
The people around also thought that Elder Helios’s actions were inappropriate, but at this moment, no one dared to speak up, fearing they might be implicated.
“I didn’t expect the Celestial Flower Valley to have such a rule. Those who seek medicine not only need to pay bribes to the elders but also kneel here waiting for someone’s charity. It’s ridiculous!” Connor said with no expression on his face.
“You…”
Elder Helios was shaken by Connor’s words, and then he shouted loudly, “Who do you think you are? The Celestial Flower Valley only receives those sincerely seeking medicine. Yet, you insulted me in every way possible. I can tell the Valley Master about your situation. Don’t even think about taking anything from our Celestial Flower Valley!”
“You’ve got some serious issues, daring to insult Elder Helios like that. If it weren’t for Elder Helios’s magnanimity, you would have been kicked out by now…”
Just then, a young man, with a furious expression, shouted at Connor.
Maddison’s face also appeared disdainful as she sternly said, “My brother kneels here to seek medicine because Elder Helios gave him this opportunity. Don’t talk nonsense here. Can you bear the responsibility if it affects my brother’s chances of getting medicine?”
Maddison didn’t like Connor and Temira very much, so she took the opportunity to mock Connor and distance herself from him, making it clear that she wasn’t on his side.
“This guy is really over the line, even daring to defy the Elder of the Celestial Flower Valley!”
“Yeah, the Celestial Flower Valley is not like the outside world. Just because you have some background out there doesn’t mean you can act recklessly here!”
“Now he’s done for. He definitely won’t get the medicine, and I doubt he’ll ever have a chance to come here again…”
People looked at Connor and started whispering among themselves.
Meanwhile, Elder Helios had an extremely pleased expression on his face. He wanted everyone to understand the consequences of offending him.
Connor had no interest in dealing with these people and went straight to Jameson. He whispered, “Jameson, stand up. I have a way to get what you need.”
“I know he’s trying to assert his dominance, but I really need it…” Jameson replied, frowning.
“Don’t blame me for not warning you. If you dare to stand up now, you’ll never get any medicine from our Celestial Flower Valley!”
Elder Helios threatened Jameson.
Upon hearing his words, a hint of viciousness flashed across Connor’s face as he calmly said, “When did I tell you I came here to seek medicine?”
After hearing Connor’s words, everyone couldn’t help but pause. Most people who came to the Celestial Flower Valley were here to seek medicine. Why would anyone go through so much trouble to come here if not for that?
Even Elder Helios looked puzzled at Connor, furrowing his brows, and asked, “If you’re not here for medicine, then what are you here for?”
“I’m here to steal medicine!” Connor said with a faint smile.
“Steal medicine?”
Elder Helios’s expression seemed disdainful, then he shouted loudly, “You’re just being absurd! How dare you come to our Celestial Flower Valley to steal medicine? It seems like you’re asking for trouble…”
“Go inform your Valley Master that Connor is here!” Connor continued speaking.
“Connor?”
Upon hearing this name, Elder Helios’s expression instantly changed. He shouted, “You’re actually Connor?”
“Yes, I am Connor!”
He nodded lightly.
As for Temira, she looked at Connor with a completely shattered expression. She had never imagined that Connor would be so impulsive. He had just entered the Celestial Flower Valley, and he had already exposed his identity.
Jameson, who was still kneeling on the ground, also wore a puzzled expression. He couldn’t understand why Elder Helios’s expression would change so drastically just because Connor mentioned his name.

chapters.title: Chapter 1160: Voluntarily Came
chapters.content:
Chapter 1160: Voluntarily Came
On the other side, inside the Hall of the Celestial Flower Valley.
At this moment, all the elders of the Celestial Flower Valley had gathered together, engaging in intense discussions on how to deal with the matter of Connor.
Although Connor's strength couldn't threaten these people in the Celestial Flower Valley, Rachel, who was behind Connor posed a significant threat.
After all, Rachel was the one who personally killed Alexander.
This indicated that her strength was even more terrifying than that of a Profound Realm warrior.
Apart from the Valley Master, the strength of the other elders in the Celestial Flower Valley was below the Black-rank, making it impossible to fight with Rachel.
That was why the Celestial Flower Valley was so anxious.
Previously, Mr. Selman, whom Connor had encountered at the Malone family, was also present. He explained in great detail the situation at that time to everyone.
"I don't think this matter is so complicated. Although that woman is extremely terrifying, we also have many experts in the Celestial Flower Valley. If we join forces, we should have a chance of winning!"
At this moment, an elderly man with silver hair whispered.
"Third Elder, you're simplifying things too much. That woman doesn't even care about Alexander's life. She kills without hesitation. Even if all of us here join forces, we might not be her match. After all, sometimes it's not about the number of people; victory isn't guaranteed."
Another middle-aged man spoke.
"I agree. That woman's strength is so terrifying. We should plan this carefully."
"What other plans do we have now?"
The old man angrily shouted, then continued, "If it weren't for the Valley Master still in seclusion, we wouldn't have to go through all this trouble. We could just have the Valley Master deal with that woman directly."
"What if the Valley Master is not her match?"
At this moment, a beautiful young woman asked, frowning.
"What are you all suggesting then?"
The old man shouted loudly and continued, "Right now, Temira is still in Connor's hands. If we don't take action soon, she might be in danger, do you all realize that?"
"You only care about your disciple Temira. Even if we take action now, can we really save her?"
The beautiful young woman retorted directly.
"Fine, then tell me what we should do now?"
The old man asked, glaring.
"This matter was caused by Temira's mistake. If it weren't for her and Mr. Selman teaming up to deal with Connor, so many things wouldn't have happened. So I think it's better to downplay the issue. Since Connor wants medicinal herbs, why don't we just give him the herbs..."
Clearly, the young woman didn't advise continuing the fight against Connor.
"You're thinking too simply. All the medicinal herbs Connor wants are top-grade herbs. If we just give them to him like that, what will we do when we encounter other troubles? How will people outside view the Celestial Flower Valley if they learn about this?"
Elder Three said, becoming agitated.
"I agree. We cannot compromise on such matters!"
"I think we should directly get rid of Connor!"
"It's not that simple to get rid of him. If it were that simple, we wouldn't be sitting here discussing it for so long!"
For a while, the elders of the Celestial Flower Valley began to argue back and forth.
At this point, the people here were divided into two factions. One faction believed it would be better to take direct action against Connor, while the other faction believed it would be better to give Connor what he wanted and pacify the situation.
However, since the Valley Master was not present, no one could come to a conclusion even if they continued to argue.
"Alright, everyone, stop arguing…"
At this moment, an old man suddenly shouted.
After hearing the old man's roar, everyone looked at his position.
This elderly man was the Great Elder of the Celestial Flower Valley, and he held the highest position in the valley. At this moment, the Valley Master was not present, so everyone was bound to follow the his instructions.
Everyone became quiet for a moment.
"Elder, what do you mean?" Third Elder asked with a frown.
"I think this matter is actually quite simple. Connor kidnapped Temira, and we definitely cannot ignore it. However, it won't be easy to deal with him just with the people from our Celestial Flower Valley. After all, the woman by Connor's side is extremely powerful!"
The Great Elder paused for a moment, then continued, "As for involving the Valley Master, it's not appropriate. After all, the Valley Master hasn't left the Celestial Flower Valley for such a long time. If he suddenly shows up just for this small matter, it will definitely cause gossip!"
"Elder, what do you suggest then?" the beautiful woman asked anxiously.
"I have an idea. Why don't we find a Profound-rank martial artist to take care of Connor and that woman? This way, the situation will be much simpler," the Great Elder said with a smile.
"It's not easy to find a Profound-rank martial artist," the beautiful woman said with a furrowed brow.
"You don't need to worry about that. After all, our Celestial Flower Valley has so many elixirs, and over the years, I have also gotten to know quite a few Profound-rank martial artists. These people owe me a favor, so it shouldn't be a big problem to get them to take action!" the Great Elder said confidently.
"I think the Elder's plan is good. This way, we can be worry-free..."
"Yes, not only can we deal with Connor and the woman, but we also don't need to take action ourselves!"
"I agree with the Great Elder's plan!"
Everyone nodded in agreement.
The Great Elder smiled faintly and said softly, "Since everyone agrees with my opinion, go and contact the Profound-rank martial artists you know, and offer them a condition that satisfies them. Finally, we'll discuss when to take action against Connor!"
"Alright..."
Everyone quickly agreed and got up to leave.
After all, they had been discussing for a long time, and now they finally had a solution. These people finally breathed a sigh of relief.
But just as everyone was preparing to leave, a man rushed into the hall.
"Elder, something big has happened!"
The man shouted at the Great Elder.
"What's the matter?"
He was momentarily stunned by the man's words, and he asked with a puzzled expression.
"That Connor has come to our Celestial Flower Valley..."
The man stuttered.
"What?"
Upon hearing this, the Great Elder stood up abruptly, his face showing an incredulous expression.
The others present also showed shocked expressions because they had just discussed how to deal with Connor.
But now, he had actually come to them on his own initiative.

chapters.title: Chapter 1161: You Don't Have the Right!
chapters.content:
Chapter 1161: You Don't Have the Right!
"Great Elder, what does this Connor mean by coming over now?"
One of the middle-aged men frowned and asked the Great Elder.
"That's right. Is this Connor planning to fight against our Celestial Flower Valley alone?" the young woman said with a frown.
The Great Elder hesitated for a moment before asking the man in a low voice, "Did Connor come alone?"
When the man heard the Great Elder's words, he could not help but be stunned for a moment. Then, he slowly shook his head and said, "He didn't come alone. There seems to be a woman with him…"
"It's over…"
The expression on the Great Elder's face was one of despair.
At this moment, the Master had not come out yet. If Connor had really brought Rachel Wallace over, then their valley would not be a match for Connor and Rachel at all.
Everyone panicked.
"Great Elder, what should we do now?"
"Don't panic. At worst, we'll just give Connor what he needs, but only if that woman is with him. If she isn't, we'll get rid of Connor, then find someone to get rid of that woman!" the Great Elder said with a cold expression.
Everyone looked at the Great Elder with a helpless expression on their faces. They all knew in their hearts that Connor could not have come here on his own. Connor must have brought helpers for him to barge into the Celestial Flower Valley so arrogantly.
On the other side, after Mr. Helios found out Connor's true identity, a trace of fear flashed across his eyes. He stuttered, "Connor, you actually dare to come to our Celestial Flower Valley…"
"Why wouldn't I dare to come?" Connor replied indifferently.
Mr. Helios looked at Connor. "How did you find this place?"
"I brought him here!"
Temira knew that there was no point in continuing to hide anymore, so she took off her sunglasses and revealed her exquisite face.
Mr. Helios looked at Temira with an even more fearful expression. He stuttered, "Temira, you betrayed the Celestial Flower Valley. Don't you know that this person is our enemy? You actually brought him here…"
Temira looked at Mr. Helios and explained, "If I didn't bring him here, he would have killed me!"
"You…"
Mr. Helios looked at Temira with a furious expression, but he didn't know what to say.
Jameson and Maddison looked at Connor with a very puzzled expression. At this time, the two of them did not seem to understand what was going on.
Jameson hesitated for a moment and stuttered, "Connor, what's going on? Is Miss Yakes from the Celestial Flower Valley?"
"That's right, Temira is indeed from the Celestial Flower Valley. I forced her to bring me here because I have a personal grudge with the Celestial Flower Valley!"
Connor said calmly.
Jameson looked at Connor with a shocked expression.
At this moment, he finally understood what Connor meant when he said he was coming to the Celestial Flower Valley to deal with some private matters.
Maddison stared at Connor with her big watery eyes. Her face was filled with shock. She still had not figured out what was going on.
The Great Elder led the Celestial Flower Valley elders out of the palace. However, when he realized that Rachel Wallace was not with Connor, his expression instantly relaxed a lot; after all, the one who really scared the Great Elder was Rachel and not Connor.
"I didn't expect Connor to come alone. He really doesn't think highly of the Celestial Flower Valley!" the Third Elder could not help but think.
"Connor really underestimated our Celestial Flower Valley. But this is good—we can take this opportunity to get rid of Connor!" the Great Elder said in a low voice.
When the young woman heard the conversation between the two, her expression was a little helpless, but she did not say anything.
The third elder walked forward and shouted at Connor with an angry expression.
"Connor, how dare you trespass into our Celestial Flower Valley!"
"Am I not welcome here?"
"Stop talking nonsense…"
The Third Elder opened his mouth to refute Connor, but the Great Elder reached out and gently stopped him. "Third Elder, don't be rash…"
The Third Elder was stunned for a moment when he heard this, but did not say anything.
The Great Elder walked in front of Connor and said with a smile, "Mr. McDonald, may I know why you came all the way here this time?"
After Jameson heard the tone of the Great Elder and Connor, the expression on his face seemed to be even more unbelievable because he couldn't understand why the Great Elder would be so polite to Connor.
"..."
Connor looked at the Great Elder and said expressionlessly, "Your Celestial Flower Valley and the Malone family joined forces to frame me and tried to kill me. I'm here to settle the score with you!"
"Settle the score?" The Great Elder could not help but smile faintly when he heard this. Then, he said, "Then how do you plan to 'settle this score,' Mr. McDonald?"
"As long as your Celestial Flower Valley helps me find these three medicinal ingredients, I will not hold this matter against you. From then on, the Valley will have nothing to do with me…" Connor took out a note as he spoke.
The Great Elder looked at the note that Connor handed over, and a trace of helplessness flashed in his eyes. He said, "Mr. McDonald, I'm really sorry. our Celestial Flower Valley doesn't have the three medicinal ingredients you want…"
At this moment, the Great Elder didn't know if Rachel was really not by Connor's side, so he had already sent people to investigate. Only after confirming that Rachel didn't come with Connor would the Great Elder make a move on Connor.
"No?"
Connor couldn't help but sneer when he heard the Great Elder's words. Then, he said in a deep voice, "It is not up to you to decide whether or not there are any. I have to personally go and take a look before I know. Your medicinal ingredients should be located at the back of the mountain, right…"
"Connor, don't go too far. Let me tell you, our Celestial Flower Valley isn't a place where you can behave atrociously!" the Third Elder shouted excitedly.
It was then that Jameson and Maddison finally realized that Connor was here to cause trouble!
"Brother, who is this Connor?" Maddison asked Jameson anxiously.
"I don't know!" Jameson said helplessly.
"Then will Connor implicate the two of us? I told you to stay away from him back then, but you didn't listen. Now we're in big trouble, right?" Maddison muttered anxiously.
Jameson didn't know what to say.

chapters.title: Chapter 1162: Two Chi Receiving Pills!
chapters.content:
Chapter 1162: Two Chi Receiving Pills!
At this moment, a man went up to the Great Elder.
Then, he leaned in and whispered, "Great Elder, we have already investigated clearly. Connor did not bring that woman over. He came alone with Temira…"
The Great Elder couldn't believe that Connor had come alone, so he frowned and replied in a low voice, "How is that possible? Are you sure you didn't make a mistake?"
"I've already investigated the outskirts, but I can't find that woman. Moreover, the city gates are closed now, so no one can enter at all!" the man said seriously.
"Alright, I see."
The Great Elder nodded gently, and the man turned around and left.
The Great Elder raised his head and looked at Connor. He then whispered to Connor, "Mr. McDonald, I'm really sorry. Outsiders are not allowed to enter the back mountain of the Celestial Flower Valley…"
"Outsiders are not allowed to enter?"
When Connor heard this, he couldn't help but frown. Then, he said in a deep voice, "So you're saying that you don't plan to compensate me?"
"I have already said that our Celestial Flower Valley does not have the medicinal ingredients you are looking for…" the Great Elder chuckled.
"Great Elder, why are you wasting your breath on this brat? Since this brat has come looking for death, let's just attack him…"
The Third Elder shouted with his eyes wide open.
The Celestial Flower Valley warriors surrounded Connor as if to attack him at any time.
After Maddison saw this scene, her expression was a little frightened. She couldn't understand what kind of conflict that Connor and the Celestial Flower Valley would have that would cause such a big commotion.
Connor coldly looked at the warriors around him and said with a disdainful expression, "You want to defeat me with just you shrimp soldiers and crab generals? Dream on—it's better for your Master to come out!"
"There's no need for the Master to take care of you!" the Third Elder shouted disdainfully.
Temira saw that her master, the Third Elder, seemed to be planning to attack Connor, so she quickly stood up and shouted, "Master, things are not what you think…"
"Temira, you don't have to worry. We know that you were forced to bring him in. I will explain to the Master when the time comes, but we have to deal with this kid today…" the Third Elder replied in a low voice, then rushed towards Connor.
After Connor saw the Third Elder make a move, he directly reached out and threw a Chi Pill into his mouth before rushing towards the Third Elder.
When Temira saw Connor eat the Chi Receiving Pill, a trace of confusion flashed across her eyes. She muttered softly, "Why does he still have a Chi Receiving Pill in his hand? Didn't he already finish his Chi Receiving Pill? Could it be that the pill is his final trump card?"
At this moment, Connor had already rushed in front of the Third Elder.
"Bang!"
Connor's fist directly smashed into the Third Elder's fist, and the Third Elder was promptly sent flying.
When Maddison and Jameson saw this scene, they were shocked beyond words.
The two of them had never thought that Connor, who looked thin and weak on the surface, could actually erupt with such shocking strength.
When the Great Elder saw this, his expression was also a little surprised. He hurriedly shouted to the elders beside him, "Let's hurry up and do it. He's taken a Chi Receiving Pill, so we just need to drag it out until the effect wears off!"
"Right!"
Everyone agreed and then rushed towards Connor.
At this moment, these people thought that even if Connor had eaten a Chi pill, he was only a mystic class warrior. With so many of them against one person, it would be very easy to stall Connor.
As long as they waited for the medicinal effect of the pill to wear off, then Connor would be like a sitting duck.
For a moment, the elders of the Celestial Flower Valley all attacked and surrounded Connor, continuously restricting him.
When everyone saw this scene, they all broke out in cold sweat for Connor.
After all, in their eyes, it was very easy for so many people from the Celestial Flower Valley to deal with Connor alone.
Soon, Connor fell into a disadvantage under everyone's assault.
The Third Elder sneered. Then, he said disdainfully, "I thought that this Connor was very capable to dare barge into our Celestial Flower Valley alone. I didn't expect him to be just a boorish man. You will definitely die today…"
After saying this, the third elder directly punched Connor's chest.
Connor took two steps back and steadied his body.
After Temira saw this scene, his expression was a little nervous because he knew that Connor would definitely not be able to leave the Celestial Flower Valley today.
Even if Connor ate one pill, he was definitely not a match for these the Celestial Flower Valley elders.
"Connor, what other trump cards do you have?"
Temira thought.
However, at this moment, Connor suddenly looked at everyone and sneered. Then, he said indifferently, "You worthless bits of seafood want to stop me? It's really too laughable…"
After saying this, Connor reached out and took out another Chi pill from his clothes.
"Could it be that he's—"
After Temira saw Connor take out another Chi Receiving Pill, a trace of shock flashed across her eyes, and her expression was very incredulous.
Just as Temira was in shock, Connor directly threw the Chi Receiving Pill into his mouth.
When Temira saw him eat the second pill, she already knew what his trump card was.
Connor was planning to eat two of them at the same time. This way, the energy accumulated in his body would be even greater.
However, if that was the case, Connor's body would have to bear a greater burden—after all, after eating the Chi Receiving Pill, Connor's body would absorb a large amount of Qi.
However, as these auras circulated in Connor's veins, the pressure on his veins naturally increased.
Once Connor's meridians could not withstand such pressure, then Connor would very likely die because his meridians were completely broken.
The Great Elder seemed to have seen Connor eat the second pill, and his expression changed greatly. He stuttered, "Is this Connor crazy?"
In everyone's eyes, Connor's current behavior was clearly courting death!
However, Connor didn't care because he knew that he couldn't rely on anyone else for help!

chapters.title: Chapter 1163: Stop!
chapters.content:
Chapter 1163: Stop!
Now, Connor did not have any trump cards, so he could only rely on himself to get the last three medicinal herbs.
Now, the only way for Connor to fight against these the Celestial Flower Valley people was to eat a second chi receiving pill.
When the power of the second Chi pill burst out in Connor's body, Connor roared in pain. He could feel the blood flowing in his body at an astonishing speed, as if a ball of fire had been lit in his chest. It was an extremely painful feeling.
However, Connor didn't have time to care about the pain in his body. He rushed towards the third elder and raised his fist to smash the third elder's head.
Before the Third Elder could even react, his body was sent flying from the impact and then smashed onto the ground.
"How did Connor's strength suddenly become so great?"
After Maddison saw this scene, she could not help but open her mouth wide and exclaim in disbelief.
"I don't know what's going on either…" Jameson stuttered. He was completely shocked by the scene in front of him.
He felt that there was nothing in this world that was more shocking than what he had just seen.
After Connor sent the Third Elder flying, he did not stop at all. Instead, he charged at the other elders of the Celestial Flower Valley like a ferocious tiger.
In less than half a minute, Connor sent two more people flying.
These people were just ordinary martial artists. When faced with Connor at this time, they were simply unworthy.
At this moment, an elder who did not know the truth shouted in surprise. "How did he become so powerful?"
The Great Elder frowned and shouted at the other elders, "Everyone, be careful. Don't fight him head-on. Try to stall him."
When everyone heard this, they finally understood what was going on and hid far away.
Connor knew that there was a time limit to the use of the Chi Receiving Pill, so he started to attack like a crazed beast. Everyone who came into contact with him was sent flying.
"I didn't think that Connor would actually be able to withstand the effects of two Chi Receiving Pills. This is simply too unbelievable…" the Great Elder stuttered.
"So what if there are two Chi pills? Let me fight him!"
At this moment, a middle-aged man roared and rushed towards Connor. This middle-aged man was the strongest elder in the Celestial Flower Valley. He was already a Golden class master, only one step away from becoming a Mystic.
Therefore, he was still very confident in his own strength.
"Cross Punch!" The middle-aged man suddenly clenched his fist and drew forth the aura in his body. Then, like a fierce tiger, he directly attacked Connor.
When the Great Elder saw this scene, he could not help but think, "I didn't expect the Sixth Elder's 'Cross Punch' to have reached such a terrifying level. I just don't know if he can hurt Connor!"
"Don't worry, this punch of mine will definitely hurt him!" the Sixth Elder replied confidently.
Meanwhile, the other members of the Celestial Flower Valley were also very nervous. They were waiting for the Sixth Elder to send Connor flying with a punch so that they could subdue him.
In the next second, the Sixth Elder's fist had already reached Connor.
And Connor lightly made a move, and then something unbelievable happened.
He grabbed the Sixth Elder's fist.
"How is that possible?"
When the Sixth Elder saw that his fist was tightly held by Connor, his expression was extremely shocked and his expression was very unbelievable.
the Sixth Elder had used all his strength in that punch, and even a Mystic might not be able to take it easily.
However, no one had expected Connor to use such a method to directly receive the Sixth Elder's punch.
"Your strength is too weak…"
Connor looked at the Sixth Elder in front of him and sneered, then suddenly punched out.
"Bang!"
Connor's fist fiercely smashed onto the Sixth Elder's stomach.
"Ah…"
After the Sixth Elder screamed, he spat out a mouthful of blood and fainted.
For a moment, everyone present was stunned. They all stared at Connor with wide eyes, and their expressions were extremely shocked.
Everyone fell into a deathly silence. They looked at Connor as if they were looking at a demon.
No one had expected Connor's combat strength to be so powerful!
"This Connor is really too terrifying…"
"Yeah, he's simply inhuman…"
The Celestial Flower Valley people also stared at Connor, fear in their eyes. Even the Sixth Elder was so weak when compared to Connor, so they felt that if they went up now, it would be no different from courting death.
Temira looked at Connor. At this moment, her feelings were still very complicated. She didn't even know whether she should be happy or sad. Originally, Temira had naively thought that she could help Connor solve these problems, but now she realized that the Celestial Flower Valley people had no intention of letting Connor go.
At this moment, the young woman who had never suggested fighting Connor shouted at the Great Elder anxiously. "Great Elder, we are not a match for Connor at all. If we continue to fight, it will be no different from sending ourselves to death!"
When the Great Elder heard the young woman's words, a hint of helplessness flashed across his eyes. He slowly raised his head to look at the palace, as if he was expecting something.
Connor then walked towards the Great Elder.
The Great Elder frowned and stood where he was. He instinctively wanted to escape, but he knew that he couldn't run now; if he did, the Celestial Flower Valley would fall into complete chaos.
A moment later, Connor walked in front of the Great Elder and said expressionlessly, "Can you still find the three herbs I need?"
"I can't find them!" the Great Elder said firmly.
"Haha…"
Connor couldn't help but sneer when he heard the Great Elder's words. Then, he reached out and grabbed his neck. He said coldly, "What about now?"
"I still can't find it!" the Great Elder replied in a low voice.
"At least you have some backbone…"
Connor smiled disdainfully and then exerted force with his right hand.
"Stop!"
At this moment, an angry roar came from not far away.

chapters.title: Chapter 1164: You're Not Qualified!
chapters.content:
Chapter 1164: You're Not Qualified!
"So you're finally willing to come out…"
Connor smiled playfully and then let go of the Great Elder's neck.
The people from the Celestial Flower Valley turned their heads to look at the entrance of the palace.
At this moment, a man in his thirties wearing a white robe slowly walked towards Connor.
"Master!"
"Master!"
When the crowd saw this young man, they hurriedly called out to him.
The young man who appeared in front of everyone was the Master of the Celestial Flower Valley!
Connor looked at the young man with a surprised expression because he didn't expect the Celestial Flower Valley's Master to be so young.
Connor sized up the young man and asked expressionlessly, "You are the Master of the Celestial Flower Valley?"
"That's right!"
The Master nodded lightly. He then turned his head to look at the Third Elder and the Sixth Elder, whom had both been knocked unconscious by Connor, and said in a low voice, "Mr. McDonald, our Celestial Flower Valley has no enmity with you. There's no need for you to be so ruthless, right?"
"No enmity?"
After Connor heard this, he couldn't help but sneer. Then, he said in a low voice, "When your Celestial Flower Valley's people joined hands with the Malone family to kill me, you didn't seem to say that..."
The Master looked at Connor with a hint of helplessness in his eyes, then said in a low voice, "I wonder how you plan to resolve this matter, Mr. McDonald?"
"I have a very simple way to resolve it. As long as you give me the three medicinal herbs I need, I will leave!" Connor lightly replied.
"Haha…"
The Master smiled disdainfully. "I can only give you one of the medicinal herbs you want. If you can accept it, then the matter between us will be written off!"
"You have no right to bargain with me!" Connor said in a low voice.
"Excuse me?" A trace of anger flashed in the Master's eyes. Then, he said in a low voice, "Connor, I originally planned to give you some face, but I didn't expect you to be so ungrateful. Do you think that you're invincible just because you ate two Chi Receiving Pills? In that case, I'll let you see the power of the Celestial Flower Valley."
As soon as he finished speaking, an extremely powerful force erupted from the Master's body.
When everyone felt the powerful aura in the Celestial Flower Master's body, terrified expressions broke out on their faces.
"After so many years, you're the first person who dares to talk to me like this!" the Master shouted at Connor.
In the next second, the Master appeared in front of Connor. Then, he raised his hand and struck Connor's chest.
Connor realized that the Master was terrifyingly fast and hurriedly put his hands in front of his chest to block the attack.
"Bang!"
The Master's palm hit Connor's arm, pushing him back a full ten meters before he finally stopped.
When the Celestial Flower Valley people saw this scene, they instantly burst into cheers because they finally saw hope at this moment. Otherwise, they might have thought that Connor would not be able to win.
After Connor stabilized his body, he slowly raised his head and looked at the Master in front of him.
At this moment, Connor realized that he had underestimated the strength of this Master. Originally, Connor thought that the Master was roughly as strong as Aaron Malone.
However, after forcefully receiving the Master's blow just now, Connor realized that his strength might be even more terrifying than Aaron Malone.
The Master did not continue to attack Connor. Instead, he stopped and asked expressionlessly, "Connor, do you still think that I'm not qualified to negotiate with you?"
"You are still not qualified!" Connor replied in a low voice.
"Not qualified?"
The Master sneered. Then, he said indifferently, "Then how would I be considered to be qualified? Do I have to kill you?"
After saying this, the Master rushed towards Connor again.
Connor knew that he had no way out now, so he reached out and took out the third chi pill, then threw it into his mouth.
"Connor actually ate three Chi Receiving Pills?"
Not far away, Temira's eyes widened when she saw this scene, shock on her face.
Temira had never thought that Connor would be so crazy as to eat three Chi Receiving Pills.
Two of them had already caused a lot of pressure on Connor's body. Now that Connor had eaten three of them, the impact would be extremely terrifying!
But there was no other way. The current Connor had no way out at all now.
He knew very well that if he didn't eat the three pills, he would die, but if he didn't eat them, he would also die.
At the very least, he would give it his all.
Just as the Master was about to reach Connor, Connor's figure flashed and disappeared.
When the Master saw this scene, his expression was a little surprised; he didn't expect Connor to be so fast.
In the next second, Connor appeared behind the Master.
A strange look flashed in the Master's eyes. He quickly turned around and looked at Connor, but—
"Seven-Star Big Dipper Fist! Sky Splitter!"
"Die!" Connor roared angrily, raising his fist and smashing it hard on the Master's chest.
"Bang!"
Connor's fist slammed into the Master's chest with the force of a truck.
The Master's body was sent flying and slammed into the wall.
Temira stared at Connor with her big, watery eyes, shocked speechless.
She had never thought that Connor could actually send the Master flying with a single punch.
After Connor sent the Master flying with a punch, he did not stop at all. Before the Master could react, he rushed up and kicked the Master's stomach.
"Bang!"
The Master spat out a mouthful of blood, clearly in pain.
Connor looked at him in disdain and said coldly, "I just said that you don't have the qualifications. Do you have any objections?"
"I... I admit defeat…"
The Master had to use all his strength to slowly say these words.
After hearing this, everyone present revealed a shocked expression.
No one had expected the Master to admit defeat so quickly.

chapters.title: Chapter 1165: Side Effects
chapters.content:
Chapter 1165: Side Effects
At this moment, the Master could clearly feel the powerful aura in Connor's body.
Although he still had the strength to fight Connor, if he continued to fight, his chances of winning were very low.
Moreover, it was very likely that he would be crippled by Connor.
Therefore, his best choice now was to directly admit defeat. Perhaps Connor would let him go then.
"What did you say?"
Connor asked in a low voice.
"I said I admit defeat. I won't fight anymore…" the Master said weakly to Connor.
"Then hurry up and get someone to fetch the medicinal herbs!"
Connor said expressionlessly.
"Hurry up and take out the medicinal ingredients that Mr. McDonald needs…"
The Master did not dare to be negligent and hurriedly gave an order to the Great Elder.
"I…Understood…"
The Great Elder did not expect this outcome. He stammered in agreement and turned to leave.
"There's still half an hour left before the effect of the Chi Receiving Pill wears off. If I don't get the herbs within twenty minutes, I'll kill you and then use the remaining ten minutes to find the herbs I need!"
Connor whispered to the Master.
"Since I have already promised to give you the medicinal herbs, I will not lie to you!" the Master hurriedly replied.
Connor turned his head and looked at Jameson and Maddison, who were already scared out of their wits. Then, he continued, "Help me prepare two more Hundred-Herb Pills. My friend needs them!"
"Alright!"
The Master nodded again.
Connor expressionlessly looked at the Master, who was under his foot and did not continue to speak.
The Great Elder seemed to know that Connor could kill the Master at any time. No one could stop Connor now.
Therefore, he did not dare to delay. He hurriedly ran to the pharmacy to prepare the necessary ingredients.
Connor simply glanced at the things in Great Elder's hand. He believed that the Great Elder would not dare to play tricks with him at this time.
Therefore, he directly accepted the pile of medicinal herbs, then turned around and said to Jameson and Maddison, "Let's go!"
Jameson and Maddison were already scared out of their wits. When they heard that Connor wanted to leave, they hurriedly walked towards the exit of the Celestial Flower Valley.
Temira stood there and hesitated for a long time, but in the end, she chose to stay and did not leave with Connor and the others.
No one had expected Connor to really get the herbs he needed and leave in front of everyone from the Celestial Flower Valley.
After hesitating for a moment, the Great Elder ran to the Master's side and whispered into his ear, "Master, the effect of the Chi Receiving Pill is about to disappear. Should we wait for Connor's effect to wear off before we attack him?"
"There's no need…"
The Master replied indifferently.
"But if we let Connor leave like this, it will have a huge impact on our Celestial Flower Valley!" the Great Elder said worriedly.
"You don't have to worry about this. The current Connor is already a dead man. There's no need for us to be too calculative with a walking corpse," the Master said with narrowed eyes.
"A dead man?"
When the Great Elder heard the Master's words, he was stunned. He looked confused.
"The Chi Receiving Pill is indeed powerful. If he only ate one pill, it wouldn't have too much of an impact on him. However, Connor just ate three of them in one go, which was a huge burden on his body. Therefore, he might die on the way out of the deep forest. That's why I admitted defeat so easily just now. I don't want to fight with someone who doesn't even care about his own life!" the Master explained.
The Great Elder was stunned for a moment before he continued, "Are those three medicinal herbs really that important to him? He actually doesn't even want his life…"
Temira, who was not far away, was shocked when she heard this. She knew that Connor was collecting these three herbs to save his girlfriend.
Therefore, in Connor's eyes, his girlfriend seemed to be more important than his life.
Temira couldn't understand what kind of perfect woman could meet someone who loved her as much as Connor did.
Connor knew that the effect of the Chi Receiving Pill was about to disappear, so he had to hurry up and leave the Celestial Flower Valley with Jameson and Maddison.
Otherwise, if the Celestial Flower Valley caught up to them, all their previous efforts would be in vain.
Therefore, Connor was not in the mood to explain anything to Jameson and Maddison. He walked out of the Celestial Flower Valley directly.
At this time, Jameson and Maddison had yet to react to what had just happened. However, the two of them also knew that the current situation was very dangerous, so they followed closely behind Connor.
Although Connor walked very fast, after half an hour, the effect of the Chi pill completely disappeared.
Connor suddenly felt as if he was a pool that had been drained of water. His entire body instantly dried up and he fell to the ground.
Moreover, Connor realized that he actually could not use any strength at all.
"Connor, are you alright?"
Jameson asked Connor excitedly after seeing him fall.
"I'm fine. I just can't use my strength…"
Connor replied in a low voice and then continued, "Take out my phone and call Thomas Morgan. Tell him my location and ask him to come and pick me up…"
Connor knew that this was likely the side effects of using so many Chi Receiving Pills at once, so he could only pin all his hopes on Jameson.
"Alright, alright…"
Jameson agreed, then he quickly found his phone from Connor's clothes and dialed Thomas Morgan's number.
However, after the call went through, Jameson realized that there was no signal at their current location.
"It's over. There's no signal here!" Jameson shouted in despair.
At this time, the bodyguards that Jameson brought with him were worried that they would be implicated in the battle between Connor and the Celestial Flower Valley and had all run away. At this time, Jameson did not know where they were, and he did not know the way out.
For a moment, Jameson collapsed. He turned to look at Connor.
But at this moment, Connor had already completely fainted.
"What should we do?"
Jameson looked even more anxious after seeing Connor pass out.
Connor was the only one who remembered the way here, and Jameson couldn't remember the way back at all.

chapters.title: Chapter 1166: Betraying a Friend
chapters.content:
Chapter 1166: Betraying a Friend
"Jameson, what should we do now…"
At this moment, Maddison suddenly shouted at Jameson.
Jameson was stunned for a moment before he asked in a low voice, "Do you remember the way out?"
"I don't…"
Maddison replied helplessly and continued, "But I have a way out…"
"What is it?"
Jameson asked in confusion.
"Connor has a conflict with the people from the Celestial Flower Valley. He even beat those people from the Celestial Flower Valley to such a state. As long as we give him to the people from the Celestial Flower Valley, they will definitely send the two of us out…"
Maddison whispered.
"Maddison, what are you talking about?"
Jameson shouted angrily after hearing Maddison's words. Then, he shouted, "Connor is my friend. Just now, he helped us get the Hundred Herb Pill from the Celestial Flower Valley. Now you want to give Connor to the Celestial Flower Valley? We can't be so heartless!"
"Heartless?"
When Maddison heard this, she sneered disdainfully and said lightly, "Jameson, don't you think it's ridiculous to say this?"
"How is it ridiculous?"
Jameson was stunned for a moment and asked.
"Don't you know what's going on right now? Now that we're lost, we don't know how to get out. Also, Connor is unconscious. Even if we know the way out now, how will we be able to bring Connor out?"
Maddison said.
Jameson was stunned when he heard Maddison's words. Then, he said in a low voice, "No matter what, I won't abandon Connor. He didn't abandon the two of us just now!"
"Alright, since you don't plan to abandon Connor, then we'll just wait here to die!"
Maddison pouted and replied.
After hesitating for a moment, Jameson walked to Connor and carried him on his back.
Although Connor was in a seemingly unconscious state, he was actually still conscious. He just couldn't use any strength, so he couldn't open his eyes or speak. However, he could hear the conversation between Jameson and Maddison.
"Jameson, what are you doing?"
Maddison frowned and asked Jameson.
"I need to find a place with proper reception…"
Jameson replied in a low voice, then carried Connor and walked ahead.
Maddison looked at Jameson's back with a helpless expression.
At this moment, she could not understand why Jameson was so persistent.
The two of them had only known Connor for less than three days. Jameson could hand Connor over to the Celestial Flower Valley. This way, the two of them could live.
But Maddison did not know why Jameson was so insistent.
Just like that, Jameson carried Connor and wandered around the valley for more than an hour, but he still couldn't find a place with a signal or a way out.
At this moment, Jameson was already exhausted and in despair.
"Jameson, let's go back. If this continues, the two of us will die here…"
Maddison said to Jameson in desperation.
"I said that I won't give up on Connor. I can't betray my friends!"
Jameson whispered back.
"You…"
Maddison looked at Jameson, feeling extremely exasperated. She did not know what to say.
Thud... Thud...
At this moment, Jameson suddenly heard footsteps.
Hearing the footsteps, Jameson and Maddison's expressions changed because they knew that the Celestial Flower Valley people must have caught up to them.
If the two of them were caught by the Celestial Flower Valley, they would definitely die. The Celestial Flower Valley would definitely treat the two of them as Connor's accomplices.
"It's over. The people from the Celestial Flower Valley must have found us. We are doomed…"
Maddison said in despair.
"Shush! Squat down!"
Jameson frowned and scolded.
After hesitating for a moment, Maddison could only squat on the ground helplessly.
The footsteps were getting closer to them.
A few minutes later, a person walked to Jameson and Maddison.
When Jameson saw this person, a trace of excitement flashed across his eyes. He quickly stood up and shouted, "Miss Yakes, it's you!"
That's right, the person who had caught up with them was none other than Temira Yakes.
The Celestial Flower Valley Master was worried that Connor was not dead, so he sent people out to check on Connor and the others.
Temira was worried that Connor would be discovered by others, so she took the initiative and accepted this mission.
"Where's Connor?"
Temira asked hurriedly with a strange look in her eyes.
"Miss Yakes, you are..."
Jameson knew very well that Temira was from Celestial Flower Valley, so he didn't know why Temira was looking for Connor.
"You don't have to worry. I'm here to lead the way out. Without any help, you won't be able to find your way out..."
Temira naturally knew what Jameson was thinking, so she explained.
"Connor is here!"
Jameson hurriedly made way for him.
Temira walked to Connor. When she saw that Connor was unconscious, a trace of worry flashed across her eyes. Then, she whispered, "Connor is probably not able to withstand the side effects of the three Chi Receiving Pills. That's why he has fainted…"
"Connor won't be in any danger, right?"
Jameson asked worriedly.
"I'm not sure about that. After all, the Chi Receiving Pill is very rare. This is the first time I've seen someone take it. I don't know what will happen after taking three of them. I'll bring you out now, and then you can take Connor to Porthampton."
Temira said in a low voice.
"Alright…"
Jameson quickly nodded when he heard this and took the initiative to carry Connor on his back.
Maddison looked at Temira with dissatisfaction, but she did not dare to say anything. After all, their only hope of survival was Temira.
Temira brought Jameson around the valley and finally came to a cave entrance. She said softly, "All you have to do is pass through this cave, then you can leave. After that, you will be able to contact the people outside…"
"Okay, thank you, Miss Yakes!"
Jameson said gratefully to Temira.
"Is there any danger in this cave?"
Maddison seemed to not believe Temira, so she frowned and said.
When Temira heard this, she became a little angry. Then, she said in a low voice, "If you don't believe me, then you can wait for death here!"
After saying this, Temira left without looking back.

chapters.title: Chapter 1167: Leaving Celestial Flower Valley
chapters.content:
Chapter 1167: Leaving Celestial Flower Valley
Half an hour later.
Temira returned to the Celestial Flower Valley alone and went to the valley master's room.
"So? Did you find him?"
The valley master asked softly.
"Yes…"
Temira replied in a low voice.
"Did you kill him?"
The valley master continued to ask.
"No, I couldn't do it!"
Temira answered honestly.
"You let them go?"
The valley master was a little angry as he asked in a low voice.
"Yes…"
Temira hesitated for a moment before nodding.
Smack!
When the valley master heard Temira's words, he slapped Temira's face with a backhand. Then, he widened his eyes and shouted, "Temira, I trusted you and wanted to give you a chance to redeem yourself, but I didn't expect you to betray my trust. You've really disappointed me!"
"Valley Master, Connor is a pitiful person. He only wanted those medicinal ingredients to save his girlfriend…"
Temira tried to explain.
"I don't care what his reason is. He shouldn't have come to the Celestial Flower Valley to rob us. Yet, you let him go. Just look at yourself!"
The valley master looked at Temira and shouted with trembling lips.
When Temira heard the valley master's words, she could not help but frown. Then, she gritted her teeth and said, "I'm willing to accept any punishment!"
"Punishment?"
The valley master laughed coldly, then pinched Temira's chin and said coldly, "Do you think I won't dare to do anything to you just because I like you?"
"No…"
Temira hurriedly shook her head.
"From tomorrow onward, you'll be grounded for five years in the mountain. You can only come out after five years!"
The valley master shouted coldly.
When Temira heard the valley master's words, she could not help but tremble slightly.
However, she did not say anything else and turned to leave.
Five years!
To Temira, this was an extremely terrifying number.
After all, Temira was at her prime now. In five years' time, Temira might be thirty years old by then.
However, Temira had no regrets at the moment because she felt that she had done a good and the right thing.
...
On the other side, Jameson hesitated for a long time before finally choosing to believe Temira's words.
He felt that if Temira really wanted to harm them, she could have done that. There was no need to lie.
Therefore, he brought Connor into the cave.
Jameson walked in the cave for more than two hours and finally walked out of the valley.
After leaving the valley, he took out Connor's phone and dialed Thomas Morgan's number.
From then on, Connor's consciousness began to gradually blur. He could not remember anything that happened after that.
When Connor opened his eyes again, he realized that he was in Jorge Yarrell's house.
After Connor woke up, he moved his body and found that although he could move his limbs, he was very weak.
"You're awake?"
Jorge saw Connor open his eyes and asked him softly.
"Old man, you have really caused me to suffer this time…"
Connor said weakly to Jorge.
"It is not me who harmed you. It is you who harmed yourself. The Chi Receiving Pill is a divine medicine and also a poison. You will definitely not be able to withstand it after eating three Chi Receiving Pills in one go. Forget about you, even I might not be able to withstand such a powerful side effect…"
Jorge said calmly.
"How is my body now?"
Connor hurriedly asked.
"You don't have to worry about this. I have already connected all your meridians. Now that you are awake, it means that you are fine…"
Jorge looked at Connor and replied.
After knowing that he was fine, Connor relaxed a little. Then, he continued to ask, "How did I get here?"
"It was Thomas Morgan and two young people who sent you here!"
Jorge replied.
"What about Jameson and Maddison?"
Connor finally remembered that he was saved by Jameson, so he asked.
"They left after sending you here. As for where they went, I'm not very sure…"
Jorge said calmly.
Connor was still very grateful to Jameson because he heard the conversation between Jameson and Maddison.
Under such circumstances, it was reasonable for Maddison to give up on Connor. After all, the two of them had met Connor by chance. It would not be surprising for the two of them not to save Connor.
However, Jameson didn't choose to give up on Connor, which made Connor very touched. As for Temira's appearance later, Connor didn't expect it.
"Old man, you should have gotten the medicinal herbs, right?"
Connor was most concerned about the matter of the Soul Returning Pill.
"Yeah, I have already helped you refine the Soul Returning Pill!"
Jorge passed a porcelain bottle to Connor as he spoke.
When Connor saw the porcelain bottle, he seemed to be a little excited.
After all, he had taken such a huge risk just for this Soul Returning Pill. Now that he had obtained the Soul Returning Pill, Connor felt that everything he had done was worth it.
"Originally, I was planning to let you go out and gain experience by yourself this time. I wanted to let you experience what the real world of martial artists is like, but I didn't expect you to encounter so much trouble!"
Jorge looked at Connor with a hint of guilt in his eyes. After all, if he hadn't asked Connor to look for these herbs, Connor wouldn't have ended like this.
"It's fine. As long as I have the Soul Returning Pill, that's good enough. I didn't work for nothing!"
Connor grinned at Jorge.
He didn't blame Jorge at all. After all, if it wasn't for Jorge, Connor definitely wouldn't have gotten the Soul Returning Pill.
"Although your ancient martial arts talent is a little low, I can see a perseverance that I've never seen before in you. So, from now on, you can be considered my disciple…"
Jorge looked at Connor and continued.
"Old man, can you not act like you're at a disadvantage? I spent money to take you as my master…"
Connor shouted speechlessly.
"I won't accept some people even if they spend money…"
Jorge said proudly.
"That's because they didn't spend enough money!"
Connor retorted.
"Stop talking nonsense. Take this thing!"
After saying this, Jorge directly handed Connor a jade pendant.

chapters.title: Chapter 1168: Freya Phillips Has Left
chapters.content:
Chapter 1168: Freya Phillips Has Left
Connor took the jade pendant and looked at it carefully.
Then, he asked Jorge with a puzzled expression, "What is this? Is it worth anything?"
"You can't buy this jade pendant even if you have money!"
Jorge said softly.
"What kind of jade pendant can't be bought with money? You're not fooling me, are you?"
Connor said with a frown.
"This jade pendant is my personal possession. Everyone in the ancient martial arts world basically knows or has heard of this jade pendant. So, if you encounter any danger next time, just take out this jade pendant. I think most people will give me face…"
Connor was speechless when he heard Jorge's words. He pouted and said, "Here I was thinking that it's some sort of treasure. I didn't expect it to just be a jade pendant. Do you have any other treasures? I want something else…"
"No. I only have this one."
Jorge said.
Connor looked at Jorge and hesitated for a couple of seconds before saying helplessly, "Alright then, it's better to have it with me I guess…"
After saying that, Connor accepted the jade pendant. Then, he stood up and stretched. He looked at Jorge and asked, "Then, I can leave now, right?"
"Sure, but you'd better not fight with others during this period of time. After all, your tendons and vessels are still in the healing stage."
Jorge reminded Connor.
"Alright, I understand…"
Connor looked at Jorge and nodded lightly. Then, he didn't say anything else and walked out of the room.
After leaving Jorge's house, Connor was still very excited.
After all, he had finally obtained the Soul Returning Pill, so the most important thing for him now was to find Freya.
And this time, in order to find the Soul Returning Pill, Connor paid a very great price. Not only did he almost lose his life, but he also owed several favors.
Of course, Jorge, Thomas, Rachel Wallace, and the others' favors were manageable. After all, Connor would be able to meet them often in the future.
However, Connor didn't know how to repay Jameson and Temira because he didn't know when he could meet these people again.
Connor thought about these things as he reached out to hail a taxi. Then, he rushed to Porthampton Airport. He wanted to return to Newtown as soon as possible to find Freya Phillips.
In the taxi, Connor took out his phone and dialed Freya's number.
However, Freya's phone had been switched off. This made Connor suddenly have a bad feeling, so he kept urging the driver to drive faster.
Ten minutes later, Connor boarded the plane nervously.
5 PM.
Connor finally arrived at Newtown. After leaving the airport, he took a taxi to Freya's company.
During this period, Connor kept calling Freya, but no one picked up. This made Connor even more uneasy.
After he arrived at Travio Corporation, he ran straight to Freya's office.
Because many people already knew that Connor was Freya's boyfriend, no one dared to stop him.
Soon, Connor arrived at Freya's office.
However, when he arrived at her office, he realized that there was no one inside.
Connor's head buzzed. He suspected that Camila Yearwood had discovered something.
Connor hesitated for a moment before heading straight to Benson Sharp's office.
At this moment, Benson was flirting with his secretary. When he saw Connor come in, he was shocked. He quickly pushed the secretary away and asked Connor nervously, "Mr... Mr. McDonald, what's going on?"
Connor glanced at Benson's secretary and said expressionlessly, "Leave us!"
"Yes, Mr. McDonald!"
The secretary replied nervously, then hurriedly turned around and walked out of the office.
"Where's Freya?"
After the secretary left, Connor asked Benson.
"Mr. McDonald, Miss Phillips just went abroad today. There's a problem with a project in the U.S.. She had to go over and deal with it…"
Benson replied.
"The U.S.?"
Connor became even more nervous when he heard that. He then asked Benson, "Are you sure she went to the U.S. because there was a problem with a project?"
"Of course, I'm sure. I was the one who was following up on this project. I originally planned to go there myself, but Miss Phillips said that she hasn't seen her mother in a long time, so she went on behalf of me…"
Benson said confidently.
"..."
After knowing that Freya was going to meet Camila, Connor seemed to become even more nervous.
"Mr. McDonald, is there something you want to talk to her about?"
Thomas asked Connor softly after some hesitation.
"No…"
Connor replied in a low voice, then turned around and left Benson's office.
Thomas looked at Connor's back in confusion. He couldn't understand why Connor was so nervous.
After leaving Travio Corporation, Connor took out his phone and wanted Thomas to help him book a flight to the U.S.. Connor was still worried about leaving Freya alone in the United States. He was worried that if Camila didn't let Freya come back, it would be troublesome.
But before he could find Thomas's number, his phone rang.
When Connor saw that it was Freya calling, his eyes flashed with excitement, and he quickly picked up the phone.
"Connor, did you call me just now? I just got off the plane and didn't receive your call just now…"
Freya said softly.
"Freya, did you go to the U.S.?"
Connor asked.
"Yeah, there's a problem with the company's project, so I came over to deal with it…"
Freya replied.
Connor hesitated for a moment before saying, "Freya, are you safe in the U.S.?" Do you want me to go over and look for you?"
"Why would you do that? I came here to deal with the company's business. I'll go back after I'm done with work here. I won't have time to accompany you at all."
Freya felt that Connor must have missed her because he had not seen her for a long time, so she was very happy.
"Alright, then…"
Connor helplessly agreed.

chapters.title: Chapter 1169: Something Important
chapters.content:
Chapter 1169: Something Important
"Have you finished settling everything?"
Freya hesitated for a moment before asking softly.
"Yes, I've settled everything…"
Connor nodded and continued, "Freya, no matter what trouble you encounter in the U.S., you have to contact me immediately. Also, no matter what, you have to come back because I have something very, very important to tell you…"
"What is it? Can't you tell me now?"
Freya was stunned when she heard Connor's words and asked in confusion.
"It's something very important. I have to tell you face to face, so you have to come back, you understand?"
Connor emphasized.
"What exactly is going on? Why are you being so mysterious…"
Freya said with a smile.
