"It's something very important. I can't explain this to you clearly over the phone, so come back when you're done with the company's matters, okay?"
Connor said seriously.
"Alright, I got it. Don't worry, I'll definitely go back, and I'll go back as soon as possible, okay?"
Freya said helplessly.
"Alright…"
Connor felt slightly relieved after hearing Freya's words.
At this moment, Connor had to speak more seriously. Only then would Freya know that he was serious and not joking.
"Alright, I have to go settle some stuff!"
Freya said lightly.
"Okay!"
Connor nodded and hung up the phone.
After putting down his phone, Connor let out a long sigh. At this moment, he could feel that Freya sounded very relaxed. This meant that she did not leave because she had encountered some trouble, so he could temporarily rest assured.
Connor hailed a taxi and returned home.
After entering the neighborhood, Connor found that his Mercedes-Benz was still there. Moreover, it had not been moved for such a long time. The car was covered in dust.
"Does the girl really not want this Mercedes-Benz? Or did that girl meet with an accident?"
A thought suddenly flashed through Connor's mind.
However, Connor didn't even know the girl's name. He only knew that her friends called her June. He didn't know anything else.
Therefore, Connor had no way to find this girl at all. Moreover, he already had a lot on his plate. He was not in the mood to care about her at all.
Connor thought for a moment and went upstairs.
After going upstairs, he took out the key and opened the door.
But what Connor did not expect was that Rachel Wallace was actually still in his house.
When Connor saw Rachel, he was somewhat helpless. Then, he asked in a puzzled tone, "Why haven't you moved out yet?"
"Is this how you talk to your savior?"
Rachel lightly rolled her eyes at him. Then, as she ate some grapes, she casually said, "I've got some problems with my house. The renovation workers painted the walls red, but I like pink, so I have to repaint them. I have no choice but to live in your house…"
"Is there any difference between pink and red?"
Connor said helplessly.
"What's wrong? Do you really want to chase away your savior so badly?"
Rachel asked Connor.
"You are so powerful. I won't dare to chase you off. What if you kill me in anger?"
Connor said helplessly.
Even at this moment, Connor still couldn't associate the sexy beauty in front of him, who was wearing a lace nightdress, eating grapes and watching idol dramas, with the cold-blooded killer.
Connor felt that she was really good at disguising herself. She was like a lecturer in school, a sexy and hot lady at home, and at the critical moment, she was like a killer. It was very difficult to determine which one was her true personality.
"I heard that you are injured. What happened?"
Rachel sized up Connor and found that he seemed to be in good health, so she could not help but ask curiously.
After hesitating for a moment, Connor told her everything that he had encountered in the Celestial Flower Valley.
Rachel felt that Connor was too impulsive after hearing what he said. He shouldn't have eaten the three pills.
Connor did not say much about this matter. After all, at that time, Connor had no other choice.
After chatting with Rachel, Connor entered the bathroom and was prepared to take a shower and then get a good night's sleep.
After all, Connor had not had a good rest for such a long time.
However, when Connor took off his clothes, he realized that his body had many wounds.
These wounds were all left behind when he fought with those people from the Celestial Flower Valley. However, Connor had eaten the Chi Receiving Pill at that time, so he didn't care about all the wounds.
Connor looked at the wounds on his body and smiled helplessly. Then, he started to take a shower.
After taking a shower, Connor lay on the bed to rest.
The next day, when he opened his eyes, it was already noon.
He looked at his cell phone and realized that there were no classes on Saturday.
So, Connor walked out of the bedroom and saw that Rachel was still lying on the sofa watching the idol drama. She was unusually serious.
"Don't you have anything serious to do? Why are you lying on the sofa and watching dramas every day?"
Connor exclaimed speechlessly.
When Rachel heard Connor's words, she yawned lightly and said in a tired tone, "What should an assassin look like? Kill people every day? Also, I'm not an assassin. I'm just a martial artist…"
"Then, don't you need to practice?"
Connor asked.
"I'm already a black rank martial artist, and I rarely meet anyone below the black rank who is stronger than me. Even if I meet someone stronger than me, I can still escape, so I don't want to practice martial arts. I had been practicing since I was eight up to when I was twenty. I'm already sick of it…"
Rachel said indifferently.
"..."
Connor wanted to refute Rachel's words, but he didn't know what to say.
"What time is it now?"
At this moment, Rachel asked.
"It's almost noon…"
Connor replied.
"Oh my God, it's already twelve o'clock. This TV series is really addictive. I didn't sleep a wink. I have to go to bed. Otherwise, I'll have dark circles again tomorrow…"
Rachel shouted, then hurriedly ran into her bedroom.
Connor looked at Rachel's back, unusually speechless.
He really couldn't understand if the Rachel in front of him, the domineering female lecturer in the school, and the cold-blooded killer in the Malone Family were really the same person.
Connor even suspected that there were three Rachels in the world who appeared at different times.

chapters.title: Chapter 1170: I'll Do Anything!
chapters.content:
Chapter 1170: I'll Do Anything!
After Rachel left, Connor grabbed something to eat and sat on the sofa. Then, he took out his phone and dialed Queta Juve's number.
After all, Connor had not been in Newtown during this period of time, so he had not dealt with Queta.
He felt that he could take advantage of Freya's absence to get to the bottom of Percy Juve's matter.
Ring! Ring!
Queta picked up the call after the phone rang twice.
"Master!"
Queta called out softly.
"..."
When Connor heard Queta's words, he couldn't help but be stunned for a moment. Then, he frowned and asked, "What?"
"Master…"
Queta replied very naturally and then continued, "In the future, my life will be in your hands, Mr. McDonald, so you are my master, and I am your servant!"
"..."
Connor was speechless. He felt that this form of address was a little too strange.
However, Connor did not dwell too much on these things and asked, "I asked you to collect evidence of Percy's crime. How's it going?"
"I've already collected the evidence. Master, if you want them, you can come and get them anytime!"
Queta hurriedly replied.
"Alright, then let's meet at Hustlers Club!"
After hearing Queta's answer, Connor's eyes flashed with excitement as he said in a low voice.
"Alright! Master!"
Queta agreed and hung up.
"What era are you from? Master..."
After hanging up the phone, he mumbled helplessly. Then, he washed his face and rushed to Hustlers Club.
...
Half an hour later, Connor arrived at Hustlers Club and was led into the private room by a beautiful receptionist.
Today, Queta was dressed differently from her usual self. Before this, she had always dressed up in a gentle and innocent manner, and she liked to wear decent-looking dresses. However, today, Queta was wearing a black tight-fitting short dress. She had light makeup on her face, and her slender and fair legs were covered in black stockings. She was wearing a pair of high heels, and she looked exceptionally sexy.
When Queta saw Connor enter, she swayed her hips and walked to his side in a flirtatious manner. She then said softly, "Master, you're here."
"Can you not call me master?"
Connor asked Queta helplessly.
"Master, do you think this is a bad way to address you? If you don't think it's good, you can change it. I'll do anything you want..."
Queta whispered to Connor.
"Uh..."
Connor looked at Queta helplessly.
However, he couldn't think of a better name for the time being, so he changed the topic and said, "Alright, let's get down to business. Did you bring the evidence?"
"Yes…"
Queta nodded and handed a hard disk to Connor.
"All the evidence I've collected is in here. As long as I reveal everything, I can definitely arrest my father…"
When Queta said this, she was very calm. It was as if she did not care in the slightest that the person Connor wanted to get rid of was her father.
After all, her life was now in Connor's hands, so she had to do whatever he asked her to do. She had no choice at all.
After Connor took the hard drive, he sized up Queta and whispered to her, "You handed me the evidence of your father's crime just like that. Don't you feel sorry for me?"
Queta looked at Connor and was stunned for a moment. Then, she said with a helpless expression, "Master, my life is now in your hands. I don't seem to have any other choice, right?"
"Haha…"
Connor couldn't help but laugh when he heard Queta's words. He then whispered, "You are a smart person…"
"Master, you promised me before that as long as you get this evidence, you won't hurt my father. I hope you can keep your word!"
Queta was not a cold-blooded machine. In fact, she was very concerned about what he needed these things for, but she did not dare to ask.
"You don't have to worry about that. I've always kept my word. Since I promised you that I wouldn't hurt your father, I definitely won't hurt him…"
Connor looked at Queta calmly.
"Then, why are you collecting all this evidence, Master?"
Queta asked Connor with a puzzled expression.
"I'm collecting this evidence to control your father, just like how I'm controlling you now!"
Connor didn't hide anything from Queta and answered her question.
When Queta heard Connor's words, she was stunned. She was very shocked because she finally knew Connor's true purpose.
At this moment, Queta realized how stupid her decision to make a move against Connor under Arthur Synder's instigation was. Her decision could have harmed the entire Juve Family.
At this moment, Queta looked at Connor as if she was looking at a demon.
However, she did not dare to resist because she knew how terrifying the man in front of her was. If she resisted now, she would die.
"..."
Connor seemed to have seen the fear and worry in Queta's eyes, so he said softly, "You don't have to look at me like that. Although I want to use your father, I have no intention of harming him. I just want to find some people through him…"
"Master, whatever you want to do has nothing to do with me. As long as you don't hurt me and my father, I'll do anything you want…"
Queta hurriedly said after hearing Connor's words.
"Haha…"
Connor looked at Queta and smiled faintly. He didn't know if Queta's obedience in front of him was real or fake. Connor himself didn't care much about these questions. After all, as long as the evidence Queta gave him was real, it was fine.
In this case, Connor could use Percy to contact Yaakov Ward, the person in charge of Rockefeller in Zalfari province.
From the very beginning, Connor wanted to get in touch with Yaakov because he knew that Yaakov had a lot to do with the death of his parents.
Therefore, Connor could only find Yaakov to find out what had happened back then.
As for Percy and Queta, as long as they were obedient, Connor didn't intend to make things difficult for them.
Moreover, having Percy provide him with information on Rockefeller was also a good thing for Connor.

chapters.title: Chapter 1171: Japanese Cuisine
chapters.content:
Chapter 1171: Japanese Cuisine
"Mr. Connor, you probably haven't had lunch yet, right?"
"We have a new Japanese restaurant at our Hustlers Club. Would you like to taste it?"
After noticing that Connor hadn't said anything, Queta took the initiative to invite him.
"A Japanese restaurant?"
When Connor heard Queta's words, he couldn't help but pause for a moment, then shook his head and said, "I don't really like Japanese cuisine..."
"Mr. Connor, you will definitely like our Japanese cuisine here!"
Queta said with a smile.
Although he wasn't very interested in Japanese cuisine, he couldn't help but be curious about why she was so confident when he saw her confident smile.
So after hesitating for a moment, he said softly, "Well, since you say so, I'll go and take a look!"
"Mr. Connor, please follow me..."
Queta took the initiative to lead the way, her chest slightly trembling, and her soft waist exuded infinite charm, which was particularly tempting.
He knew that at this moment, she probably wouldn't dare to harm him. After all, if he were to die, she probably wouldn't live long either.
So he didn't hesitate and directly followed her out of the private room.
...
On the other side, inside the newly opened Japanese restaurant at Hustlers Club.
A sexy girl dressed in revealing clothes was led into a private room, her face filled with nervousness.
Because it was her first day at work here, she had no idea what would happen next.
"You can take off your clothes now..."
A Japanese beauty with a poor command of Mandarin ordered the girl.
Upon hearing these words, the girl couldn't help but furrow her brow, but after hesitating for two seconds, she still chose to slowly take off her clothes.
"Lie down here!"
The beautiful woman pointed to the stone table in front of her and said.
The girl took a deep breath and, following the beautiful woman's command, lay directly on the table.
At this moment, she could clearly feel the cold temperature coming from the table.
And when the surrounding waitresses saw the girl lying down, they started to busy themselves.
They took various kinds of food from the serving cart and adorned the girl's body with them, covering certain key areas.
The girl lay there with a numb expression, like a soulless corpse, without any expression.
A few minutes later, the girl's body was filled with all sorts of food.
After the waitresses finished their preparations, they all left the private room, leaving only the girl lying quietly on the table.
The expression on the girl's face was filled with despair. She really wanted to struggle and escape from this place, but in the end, she gave up on such thoughts.
After taking a deep breath, the girl slowly closed her eyes.
At this moment, fear filled her heart because she had no idea what would happen next.
She didn't know if the upcoming guests would lay hands on her, but she knew that even if they did, she couldn't move or make any sound.
From the moment the guests entered the private room, she no longer belonged to herself but to the guests.
And during the guests' meal, the girl had to maintain a smile at all times.
No matter what happened, she had to smile. That was the rule.
Just as the girl's emotions were about to collapse, an image of a middle-aged woman suddenly flashed in her mind.
Thinking of this middle-aged woman, the expression on the girl's face became more determined.
..
On the other side, in the newly opened Japanese restaurant at the Hustlers Club.
A seductively dressed girl was led into a private room, her face filled with nervousness.
It was her first day working here, and she had no idea what would happen next.
"You can take off your clothes now..."
A Japanese beauty with poor Chinese proficiency ordered the girl.
Upon hearing these words, the girl couldn't help but furrow her brow. After hesitating for two seconds, she slowly took off her clothes.
"Lie down here!"
The beauty pointed to the stone table in front of her.
The girl took a deep breath and obediently lay down on the table as commanded.
She could clearly feel the cold temperature emanating from the table.
Meanwhile, the surrounding waitresses became busy when they saw the girl lying down.
They took various accessories from the food trolley and adorned the girl's body, covering up certain key areas.
Expressionless, the girl lay there, like a soulless corpse, devoid of any emotions.
After a few minutes, the girl's body was filled with all sorts of food.
Once the waitresses finished their preparations, they left the private room, leaving the girl alone lying quietly on the table.
Despair filled the girl's expression as she desperately wanted to struggle and escape, but ultimately, she gave up on such thoughts.
Taking a deep breath, the girl slowly closed her eyes.
Fear overwhelmed her as she had no idea what would happen next.
She didn't know if the upcoming guests would touch her inappropriately, but she knew she couldn't move or make any sound even if they did.
From the moment the guests entered the private room, she no longer belonged to herself; she belonged to them.
And throughout the guests' meal, the girl had to maintain a constant smile.
Regardless of what happened, she had to smile. It was a rule.
Just as the girl's emotions were about to collapse, an image of a middle-aged woman flashed through her mind.
The thought of this middle-aged woman strengthened the girl's expression.
...
On the other side, under Queta's guidance, Connor walked through the long corridor of the Hustlers Club and entered a spacious garden.
The garden was built in the style of an ancient royal garden, with various buildings that looked extremely magnificent.
"I didn't expect your Hustlers Club to have such a hidden gem!"
He turned his head and glanced at her, speaking softly.
"Of course, this is actually the true essence of our Hustlers Club. Here, guests can enjoy everything they desire..."
She smiled as she spoke to Connor.
"Heh..."
He faintly smiled upon hearing these words but didn't say much. After all, he wasn't very interested in these things.
"Mr. Connor, the Japanese restaurant we just opened is right ahead..."
At that moment, she suddenly pointed not far away to a Japanese-style building and softly spoke to him.
"Let's go and take a look..." Connor replied calmly.
"Sure..."
She nodded lightly and led him directly toward the location of the restaurant.
Soon, they entered the restaurant.
Inside the restaurant, he noticed that all the buildings were in traditional Japanese style, and Eastern music was playing.
The restaurant staff were also all Japanese. From the moment you stepped into the restaurant, you would feel as if you had truly traveled to another country.
"The ambiance here is indeed quite good..."
He turned his head and glanced at her, speaking softly.
"The food here is even better!"
She smiled lightly.

chapters.title: Chapter 1172: Meeting June Again!
chapters.content:
Chapter 1172: Meeting June Again!
The expression on Connor's face seemed somewhat helpless, and he softly asked Queta, "Is this what you prepared for me?"
"Don't you like it, Mr. Connor?"
After she saw the calm expression on his face, a hint of confusion flashed in her eyes.
Because in her impression, no man should be able to resist such temptation!
"I'm sorry, I'm not very interested in this kind of thing. Don't try to please me like this in the future..."
He replied lightly to her, then turned around and intended to leave.
But just at that moment, the girl who was originally lying on the table seemed to find Connor's voice familiar, so she turned her head and glanced at his position.
And Connor, who was about to leave, instinctively turned his head to look at the girl's position.
When he saw the girl's face, he froze in place, his expression on his face was very astonished.
And when the girl saw him, her face instantly turned red, like a ripe red apple!
"It's her?"
His expression appeared somewhat surprised.
And when the girl saw him, tears streamed down her face.
She never expected that on her first day of work, she would actually encounter someone she knew.
Connor looked at the girl in front of him for two seconds, then rushed to her, took off his coat, and softly said to her, "Put on the clothes..."
The girl looked at him, her expression seemed a bit nervous, but she didn't dare to move.
Seeing that the girl didn't dare to move, he directly reached out and pulled her up, then draped his own coat over her.
At this moment, tears poured down the girl's face, and her once strong disguise completely collapsed.
"Mr. Connor, do you know this girl?"
Queta saw that something was wrong and quickly asked Connor.
"She's my friend..." he replied lightly.
And Queta herself was a very intelligent woman, so she naturally understood what was going on.
So she quickly shouted, "What are you all standing there for? Hurry up and take Mr. Connor's friend out!"
When the staff in the restaurant heard her words, they quickly escorted the girl out.
As Connor watched the girl's figure, he felt a lot of emotions in his heart.
Because this girl was none other than the girl he encountered in the residential area.
He still didn't know the girl's name. He only knew that her friends seemed to call her June.
Because he blocked the girl's car that day, he delayed her job interview.
So he directly gave his Mercedes-Benz to June, but it seemed that she never touched his car.
Even last night, when he returned home, the Mercedes-Benz was still parked there intact, as if it had never been touched.
However, he never expected that his second encounter with June would be in such a situation.
Half an hour later.
Connor, June, and Queta arrived at another restaurant in Hustlers Club.
June still looked very nervous when she looked at Connor, because she never dreamed that the person she unintentionally met would pull her out of this abyss.
She was very curious about his identity at this moment. She knew that Queta had a high position in the Hustlers Club, and the employees there were very respectful when they saw Queta. However, Queta always referred to Connor as "Mr. Connor".
"Could it be that Connor is the owner of the Hustlers Club?"
June looked at Connor while secretly wondering in her heart.
He looked up at her and asked without expression, "What's your name?"
"I'm June Santoni..."
The girl replied nervously.
"Oh..."
He nodded lightly.
He felt that she must have some hidden difficulties in coming here, so he said softly, "I remember you said you were going to interview at Travio Corporation. How did you end up here?"
"Well..."
Upon hearing his words, her eyes flickered with hesitation, unsure if she should tell him the whole truth.
"You don't have to worry. I am the owner of the Hustlers Club. Did someone from our club force you to come and work here?"
Queta asked June gently.
After all, she was well aware of the working style of the staff, so she thought it was likely that her employees had forced June to come.
"No, no... It's not like that..."
June hurriedly waved her hand upon hearing Queta's words, and whispered, "No one forced me at all. It was my own choice..."
"Your own choice?"
Connor's eyes showed a hint of confusion upon hearing June's words.
After all, in his eyes, unless there were some problems, no one would willingly engage in this kind of work.
"June, what's really going on? Don't worry, just tell me everything!"
He felt a connection with her, and he could sense that she probably didn't really want to do this job, so she must have some hidden difficulties.
Since they were able to meet again, it must be fate, so he felt that if he had the ability, he would be willing to help this girl.
"Well..."
Her face showed some hesitation, not knowing how to say it.
"You don't have to be afraid, little sister. Say whatever you want. No one can harm you now..."
Queta said softly to June.
After hearing her words, June remained silent for two seconds and then whispered, "Actually, it's like this. My mother fell ill some time ago, and the doctor said she needed surgery. But the surgical fee is nearly 300,000 dollars, which is a terrifying amount for our family. My father hasn't saved any money all these years, and it's impossible for our family to come up with this money directly..."
Connor looked at June without saying a word.
She continued, "I tried everything to gather this money, but unfortunately, I just graduated and haven't found a job yet. I can't come up with this amount of money. Later, when I was borrowing money from the bar owner I used to work for, the bar owner told me that he could offer me a job. As long as I passed the interview, I could get 500,000 dollars, and I would receive a monthly salary of 50,000 dollars afterward..."
"At that time, I was curious about what kind of job could offer me so much money. But deep down, I knew it couldn't be a good job. However, my mother couldn't wait anymore. The doctor had been urging my father to pay the surgical fee..."

chapters.title: Chapter 1173: An Insignificant Matter
chapters.content:
Chapter 1173: An Insignificant Matter
"So you came here to work, right?"
Upon hearing this, Connor finally understood the situation.
"Yes..."
June nodded and continued, "I was really desperate at that time, so I had no choice but to come here for an interview. But when I arrived, I realized that the job was like this..."
"But I really needed the money. If it weren't for this job, my mother might have died already. So in the end, I decided to attend the interview and was very lucky to get this job!"
"After passing the interview, the staff at Hustlers Club gave me a contract and a check. The amount on the check was exactly 500,000 dollars. But the condition was that I had to work here for five years. After five years, I would be too old for them, and they wouldn't need me anymore. I struggled for a long time, but in the end, I chose to accept the contract because it meant that my mother could live..."
As June reached this point, she was already in tears.
"No one forced me to do anything. It is all voluntary," June said earnestly to Connor.
"I remember I gave you a Mercedes-Benz before. Why didn't you choose to sell the car?" he asked her with some confusion.
"That car isn't mine. If I sell it, what should I do if you suddenly come back looking for me?" June replied directly. "Of course, I did considered selling the car, but I wanted to wait until I was truly desperate before doing so. Otherwise, I wouldn't sell the car."
"Oh, I see." He nodded gently.
At this point, he finally understood why she ended up here.
He felt that this girl was actually quite pitiful. She just wanted to save her mother's life, so she chose this kind of job.
"Do you still want to work here?" He hesitated for a moment and asked her softly.
"What's the use of wanting or not? I've already signed a five-year contract here. If I breach the contract, I'll have to pay a large sum of money, which I can't afford. So there's no way I can leave this place!" she replied, looking at himseriously.
"I am the owner here. If you want to leave, you can do so anytime, and I can terminate the contract for you without any compensation," Queta said directly to June, without any unnecessary words.
"Really?" June's eyes showed a hint of nervousness upon hearing Queta's words, and she quickly shouted, "Miss Queta, I'm really grateful for this..."
"June, no need to be so polite. Since you're a friend of Mr. Connor, you're also my friend," Queta said calmly.
"Mr. Connor?" June flashed a hint of confusion in her eyes upon hearing Queta's words, but she didn't say much.
Connor, on the other hand, lowered his head and started eating. After all the commotion, he was already feeling hungry.
After finishing the meal, he briefly discussed the situation with Queta regarding Percy's situation. After confirming that Percy might return to the casino in a while, Connor decided to personally go and talk to him when the time came.
After chatting with Queta, Connor took June and left the Hustlers Club. They hailed a taxi and headed straight to the hospital where June's mother was.
Once they were inside the taxi, June turned her head and looked at him. Her expression was filled with gratitude as she said, "Connor, I really appreciate what you did today. If it wasn't for running into you, I might never have been able to leave that place..."
"No need to thank me. It was just a small matter. You don't have to worry about it too much," he replied casually to her.
Perhaps in her eyes, this incident was a life-changing event. But to him, it was nothing more than an insignificant triviality.
Fifty thousand dollars was a negligible amount for Connor. He could easily spend that much on a single meal. However, for June, it was a astronomical figure that could crush a family.
Money may not be that important in the eyes of many people. But for the majority, money still holds significant importance.

chapters.title: Chapter 1174: What Is Your Relationship?
chapters.content:
Chapter 1174: What Is Your Relationship?
"Connor, I don't even know how to thank you..."
June looked at Connor and continues.
"Thank me?"
After hearing June's words, Connor can't help but smile faintly. He then said softly, "I have never said that I want you to thank me. It is fate that the two of us are able to meet. Since I am able to help you, I will definitely not stand by and do nothing..."
She turned to him then hesitated for two seconds before saying softly, "It is really unexpected that I am actually able to know someone like you. I am really too lucky..."
She meant it from the bottom of her heart because if she hadn't met Connor, things would turned out badly for her.
"You really don't have to worry too much about this matter..." He assured her.
She smiled bitterly and continued, "Connor, actually today is my first day at work, but I didn't expect to meet you on my first day at work..."
"First day at work?"
He can't help but be stunned when he heard this.
"Yeah, I've been training before I came from the US. Last night, I was very nervous because I didn't know what would happen next. I didn't know if those customers would touch me. I was even more worried if I would meet someone I know!"
June paused for a moment before continuing, "But I never dreamed that I would meet you on my first day at work. I'm so lucky..."
"Haha..."
He looked at her and smiled helplessly. Then, he says softly, "Then you are indeed quite lucky..."
"Yes!"
She nodded.
"By the way, how is your mother now?"
Connor hesitates for a moment before asking.
"My mother is fine now, and the operation was very successful. The doctor says that she can be discharged after a while..."
Speaking of her mother, June's face finally showed a touch of happiness, a smile. Every time she thought of going to work, it was extremely painful, but as long as she thought of her mother, the pain in her heart reduced a lot. She felt that everything she did was worth it.
"If you have time, spend more time with your mother!"
He said to her with envy.
Although June does not have money, she still had her family by her side.
At this moment, Connor does not know if he had any relatives in this world.
A moment later, the taxi stops at the entrance of the hospital.
"Connor, do you want to come with me to see my mother?"
June tookthe initiative to invite him.
"I won't go. I believe that you're telling the truth to me..." he replied with a smile.
He knew that even if he goes up now, June's mother will definitely thank him. Connor does not want to face such a situation, so he felt that it is better not to go up.
When she saw that he really had no intention of following her, she didn't insist on it.
"Connor, what is your relationship with Miss Queta? Why does she keep calling you Mr. Connor?"
At this moment, she suddenly asked curiously.
"What is my relationship with Queta?"
After hearing this sentence, Connor couldn't help but pause for a moment. Then he softly said, "Actually, we are just ordinary friends. She calling me 'Mr. Connor' is just a joke..."
"Oh, I see."
Upon hearing his words, she nodded lightly and didn't say much.
But she knew very well in her heart that the relationship between Connor and Queta was definitely not as simple as ordinary friends.
Because she could sense that Queta was very afraid of Connor, a fear that came from deep within. However, she also knew that he didn't want to talk about it with her at the moment, so she wisely didn't ask further.
"By the way, since you don't have a job now, do you want me to introduce you to a job?"
Just then, Connor suddenly spoke up.
"What kind of job is it?"
June asked excitedly.
"I don't know what job suits you right now. Here's a phone number, call this person tomorrow and I think she should be able to arrange a suitable job for you..."
Connor softly told June.
"Thank you so much, Connor!"
June said with great excitement.
"No need to thank me!"
Connor looked at June, gave a faint smile, and directly gave Reena's phone number to her.
After completing all of this, he hailed a taxi and left.
As June watched his figure, memories of what happened at the Hustlers Club involuntarily flashed through her mind.
Whenever she thought about her body, which had just been seen completely by him, she couldn't help but feel embarrassed.
After a while, June entered the hospital alone and found her mother's ward.
When she saw that her mother was in good condition, a relieved smile appeared on her face.
"What were you two talking about? You seem so happy chatting together?"
June walked into the ward and asked her father with a smiling face.
"June, your mom just told me that after she is discharged from the hospital, she wants to take the two of us out to have fun. She has been busy with work all these years and never had time to go out and have fun. Now we finally have time to relax!"
June's father said with a smiling face.
"That sounds great! Where do you want to go? It's up to you two to decide!"
June nodded eagerly.
"Oh, June, you're not getting any younger. It's time to think about your own lifelong matters..."
Just then, June's mother suddenly spoke up.
"Oh, I just graduated recently, there's no rush. I still want to spend more time with you both..."
The expression on her face seemed a bit helpless as she quickly replied.
"You should think more about yourself. Your mom is fine now, and we don't need you to worry about us!"
Her father said with a smile.
"Mom, Dad, I met a really kind person today!"
After hesitating for a moment, she suddenly spoke up.
"A kind person?"
June's father couldn't help but pause for a moment upon hearing this, then looked puzzled and asked, "What kind of person?"
"Mom, Dad, just remember that today is a very important day for our family. I really met a very kind person..."
She emphasized with a serious tone.
But her parents looked at June with somewhat puzzled expressions because they didn't know the exact meaning behind her words.
In order not to worry her parents too much, June didn't explain further and continued to emphasize that she had met a kind person today.
But as for the specific details, she didn't say anything.
..

chapters.title: Chapter 1175: The Number One School Belle
chapters.content:
Chapter 1175: The Number One School Belle
On the other side, Connor returned home alone.
After entering the house, he noticed that Rachel was already awake and sitting on the sofa, watching TV.
She was wearing a sexy lace nightgown, with her fair, long legs bent and placed on the sofa, looking especially alluring.
In this world, there is a type of woman who exudes elegance and sensuality no matter what she does, and she was clearly such a woman.
Perhaps because Rachel knew that Connor didn't have any improper thoughts about her, she dressed very casually at home, which caused him a great deal of anguish.
After all, for a woman as sexy as Rachel, any normal man would probably lose control and take advantage of her.
But for Rachel, Connor didn't dare to go too far, considering the power gap between them.
"Don't you have anything else to do? Why are you always watching TV every time I come home?" he asked her helplessly.
"What else do I have to do? I can only watch TV," she replied casually, then continued, "Actually, before I came to your house, I rarely watched TV. But I didn't expect the TV dramas to be so good, they're really interesting..."
"So, you never watched TV before?" he asked with a hint of confusion in his eyes, furrowing his brows.
"Yes, ever since I was little, I was required to learn martial arts and various other knowledge, so I never had time to do the things ordinary people do. Later, I came to Porthampton University and started learning how to be a teacher, so I basically didn't have time to do the things I wanted to do, naturally including watching TV..." Rachel replied calmly.
"What kind of person are you, exactly?" Connor couldn't help but furrow his brows, his expression filled with puzzlement.
"You can't know who I am now!" she replied directly.
"Forget it, it doesn't matter who you are. It has nothing to do with me, anyway!" he said in an extremely speechless tone.
"How is it not related to you? I came to Newtown for you, and my purpose is to help you deal with Rockefeller. We have been tied together since a long time ago. I won't leave until I help you reclaim Rockefeller. Only then can I do what I truly want to do!" Rachel suddenly said seriously to Connor.
Upon hearing her words, he couldn't help but pause for a moment, then furrowed his brows and said, "So, you mean if I don't reclaim Rockefeller, you won't leave?"
"Yes." She lightly nodded.
Upon hearing this, he was instantly rendered speechless. He didn't want her to keep following him like this.
"What did you go out for today?" she asked him softly.
"I collected evidence of Percy's crimes today. I plan to use that as leverage to threaten him in the near future. That way, I can get in touch with Yaakov..." Connor answered Rachel directly without any concealment.
"You actually obtained evidence of Percy's crimes?" Her eyes flashed with excitement upon hearing his words.
"Yes, don't think that I do nothing all day. In fact, I have a lot of things to do..." he said proudly.
"You finally started doing something legitimate!" She pouted and said.
"I've always been doing legitimate things, you know?" Connor replied helplessly, then continued, "Are you hungry? Do you want me to order takeout for you?"
"No need, I'm not hungry…"
Rachel replied lightly and then continued to watch the TV series seriously.
Connor sighed helplessly and silently lamented. Who could have imagined that the goddess teacher who captivated countless male students at Porthampton University and Newtown University would have such an appearance at home?
He shook his head and went straight back to the bedroom, then lay down on the bed to rest.
Since he didn't have anything to do at the moment, he could only wait for Freya to come back. So the next day, he didn't go out. Instead, he chose to rest at home for a day.
On the other hand, June contacted Reena immediately. After knowing that June was introduced by Connor, Reena naturally wouldn't neglect her. She was aware that June mainly studied business assistantship, so she arranged for June to be her secretary, with a monthly salary of fifty thousand dollars.
When June learned that she could earn fifty thousand dollars per month, she naturally felt very surprised and delighted. She was well aware that all of this was definitely because of Connor.
This made her even more curious about who Connor really was and why he had such a great influence.
After resting for a day, Connor's life gradually returned to normal.
Since he didn't have much to do recently, he returned to Newtown University and prepared to attend classes for a few days honestly.
Connor hadn't been back to the school for a long time, so when Justin, Brooks, and Joel saw him, they all showed shocked expressions.
"You actually came back? We thought you had already returned to Porthampton!" Justin shouted at Connor with great excitement.
"I had some matters to handle these past few days, so I didn't come to class..." Connor replied somewhat speechlessly.
"Handle matters? Don't tell me you went out to have fun with your beautiful girlfriend?" Brooks asked Connor with great envy.
"I went to do serious business..." Connor said, looking at Brooks with an expression of speechlessness.
"Connor, your girlfriend is really beautiful. How did you manage to win her over? Teach me too..." Justin grinned and said.
"Don't you already have a girlfriend?" Connor said somewhat helplessly.
"I've already broken up with Kaira. We have nothing to do with each other anymore!" he answered directly.
"Broke up?" Connor paused for a moment upon hearing this, then said with some confusion, "How did you two break up when everything seemed fine between you?"
"What else could it be? It's just because our personalities didn't match!" Justin replied indifferently, then continued, "Anyway, let's not talk about my stuff. You came back just in time today. Our university is holding a centennial celebration tonight, and there will be many senior female students from the third and fourth years performing on stage. I will finally get to see our Newtown University's school belle..."

chapters.title: Chapter 1176: Salma Thompson's Arrival!
chapters.content:
Chapter 1176: Salma Thompson's Arrival!
"What number one school belle?"
Connor asked curiously.
"Don't you know?"
Justin's expression was a little surprised. "Don't tell me you don't even know the number one beauty in our school?"
"Connor is an exchange student. It's normal for him to not know about our school's situation!" Brooks replied helplessly.
"That's true!" Justin nodded gently and continued, "Alright, since you don't know about the number one campus belle, let me introduce you. Newtown University has always had a number one campus belle, and she's the one that countless male students in Newtown University want. Her name is Salma Thompson!"
"Wait, what?"
When Connor heard this name, he was instantly stunned.
"Salma Thompson? You know her?"
Justin asked Connor.
"Uh..."
Connor looked at Justin, not knowing how to answer.
He knew very well that the girl he met on the plane was also called Salma Thompson.
Although Salma was very beautiful, Connor felt that she couldn't be considered the number one school belle, right?
Salma was inferior to even Rachel, let alone Freya.
"Is this woman very beautiful?"
Connor asked softly.
"She's definitely pretty, but she can't be considered the prettiest. She might be a little inferior to Ms. Wallace. The reason why she can become the number one school belle was that her grandfather was once the richest man in Orilon. Although he might not be the richest man now, her family is still really, really rich, so much so that ordinary people like us can't even imagine…" Justin hurriedly explained.
"So that's how it is!"
Connor nodded and didn't say anything.
"That's why there are so many boys in our school who are pursuing Salma. After all, whoever can win her heart will be at the peak of their lives. That's why Salma is known as our school's number one campus belle!"
"Unfortunately, I've never seen Salma. She didn't appear at the New Year's Eve party the last time, but this time, I've received reliable news that she will appear and perform!" Justin said with a smile.
"Isn't she just a girl? Do you have to be so excited?"
Connor said helplessly.
After Justin heard Connor's words, a trace of anger flashed in his eyes. He shouted, "Connor, it's easy for you to say that. You have such a beautiful girlfriend now, so of course you don't care, whereas I'm single…"
"Even if you're single for another 800 years, Salma won't be interested in you. You'd better face reality…" Brooks said rudely.
"What do you mean by that? What if Salma likes people like me?" Justin shouted, unconvinced.
"If she's blind, then maybe…" Brooks said with a smile.
"You…"
Justin looked at Brooks, speechless. The expression on his face was abnormally angry.
And just at this time, Rachel walked into the classroom. Maybe at this time, the students in the classroom were aware that Rachel was not easy to mess with, so the entire classroom was quiet.
Rachel seemed to have recovered her cold and elegant appearance as she began her lecture.
Connor looked at Rachel and couldn't help but feel a little amused. This woman had changed too much at home and in school.
…
The afternoon class ended quickly, and everyone finally arrived at the school anniversary party.
The school anniversary would be held in the school auditorium, and all the students would sit together according to their classes.
In the middle of the auditorium was a stage.
Connor originally did not plan to go to the school anniversary party. After all, he was not interested in such things at all.
However, Justin and Brooks kept pestering him to come with them, so in the end, Connor could only follow along.
The school anniversary party soon began. As the goddess teacher of Newtown University, Rachel naturally took on the role of host. After all, Rachel was so beautiful. It would be a pity if she did not become a host.
Rachel had been a host at the Porthampton University many times before, so she was able to handle such a situation with ease.
When Rachel appeared on the stage, the audience instantly erupted into cheers. It could be seen that Rachel was indeed very popular.
After Rachel said a few simple words of courtesy, the school anniversary party officially began.
The students all went on stage to perform. Some sang, some danced, and some even performed comedy sketches. The atmosphere was very lively.
In the blink of an eye, more than half of the time had passed. Rachel walked onto the stage flirtatiously and said, "Next up, let's invite our Literature Department's Salma Thompson to perform 'Coming Out of the Mountain'!"
"She's here, she's here! Our school's number one beauty has finally come out…"
Justin shouted excitedly when he heard this.
All the students present were holding their breaths and looking very excited. From this, one could see that Salma was indeed very popular.
And then, Salma slowly walked out in a short dress.
In an instant, the entire auditorium was in an uproar.
Connor looked at Salma on the stage. He knew that this person was the girl he met on the plane.
However, Connor never expected her to be so terrifyingly popular.
After that, soothing music started to play, and Salma's voice followed suit.
It had to be said that Salma's singing was indeed very pleasant. Although Connor didn't really like listening to music, he still listened to it seriously.
The male students below the stage couldn't hold it in anymore. They took out the flowers they had prepared in advance and began to throw them onto the stage.
In all of the performances prior, no one had given the performers anything, but when it came to Salma, people were trampling over themselves to give her flowers.
The stage was filled with flowers during the time of one song.
Countless girls looked at Salma with envy on their faces.
After all, who wouldn't want to be like Salma, being adored by all the boys?
After finishing the song, Salma walked off the stage. However, the students below seemed to be still shouting her name.
"Alright, you've seen your school belle. Can we leave now?" Connor asked Justin helplessly.
"She's so beautiful. She's the goddess of my dreams. I must woo her!"
Justin said in a daze.
"Alright, stop dreaming here…"
Brooks reached out and patted Justin's shoulder with a helpless expression.

chapters.title: Chapter 1177: I Came For You
chapters.content:
Chapter 1177: I Came For You
A few minutes later, Connor, Justin and Brooks left the auditorium and headed out to eat something. After all, they hadn't seen each other for so long, so Connor planned to treat the two of them to a meal.
However, just as Connor and the others walked to the school gate, a voice called out to him.
"Connor?"
When Connor heard this voice, he was stunned for a moment. Then, he turned around and realized that it was Salma standing behind him.
Justin and Brooks naturally saw Salma as well. The two of them were dumbfounded as they stared at Connor with disbelief on their faces.
Salma quickly ran to Connor's side and shouted excitedly, "Connor, it's really you?"
"It's been a while…"
Connor replied with a smile.
"That's right. It must really be fate for the two of us to meet again…" Salma said excitedly.
"This... What's going on?"
Justin and Brooks stared at Connor and Salma with their eyes wide open.
At this moment, the two of them couldn't think of any words to describe their feelings. They had never thought that Connor would know someone like Salma.
Salma didn't expect that she would meet Connor again one day. She sized him up and asked him softly, "Are you studying at Newtown University now?"
"Yes, I'm currently studying at Newtown University as an exchange student…"
Connor nodded lightly.
"That's great. We'll have many opportunities to meet in the future!" Salma shouted happily after hearing Connor's words.
"But why don't I think I've seen you at school…"
Connor whispered to Salma.
"I'm already in my fourth year and have to go out for an internship, so I don't come back to class often. It's normal that you can't see me…" Salma hurriedly said.
"Oh, I see…" Connor nodded lightly.
Salma hesitated for a moment before asking, "I went up on stage to sing just now. Did you see that?"
"Yes, I saw it. You sang quite well…" Connor said with a smile.
"Thank you for the compliment!"
Salma smiled sweetly at Connor.
Justin and Brooks were completely dumbfounded when they saw Connor. They really wanted to understand what was going on.
Moreover, from the way Salma spoke to Connor, the two of them could feel that they were close friends.
Who would have thought that Connor and Salma would be friends?
At this moment, a bodyguard in a black suit walked to Salma's side and whispered to her. "Miss, we should leave…"
After Salma heard the bodyguard's words, she seemed to be unhappy, but she did not say anything and asked Connor, "Connor, which class are you in?"
Connor told Salma about his class.
"I have something to do now, so I'll leave first. I'll come and look for you again when I have time…"
Salma smiled before turning around and leaving.
After Salma left, Justin and Brooks finally reacted.
"Connor, you actually know Salma?"
Justin's eyes widened in disbelief.
"I guess so!" Connor nodded and continued, "But we're not very familiar with each other…"
"From the way Salma is talking to you, it seems like the two of you have a very good relationship…" Brooks said.
Connor did not want to continue explaining this. He walked forward and said, "Let's go eat quickly. I'm hungry…"
"No, Connor, you have to explain to me clearly what happened between you and Salma today…"
Justin directly reached out to block Connor's path and asked Connor with an excited expression.
When Connor heard Justin's words, his expression was a little helpless. Then, he said, "Why should I explain this to you?"
"Just because Salma is my goddess!" Justin said excitedly.
"Alright then…"
Connor knew that if he did not explain the matter clearly now, Justin would definitely not stop.
Therefore, he briefly explained the process of how he met Salma to Justin. After all, this was not an important matter.
After Justin found out what was going on, he was also extremely envious.
After all, Connor had such a beautiful girlfriend like Freya Phillips, and he could get to know a rich young lady like Salma just by having a plane flight together. Justin was very jealous.
"Comparing myself to you is really infuriating. Connor, you actually know so many beautiful women. When will I be able to get to know such a beautiful woman…" Justin said enviously.
Connor didn't say much and instead brought Justin and Brooks to the restaurant.
…
The next day.
Connor arrived at the school for class. However, before the first period ended, he saw Salma arrive at the entrance of their classroom.
Salma had a uniquely cold temperament, which was something that ordinary girls couldn't put on.
Moreover, she was dressed very beautifully today. She was wearing a white one-piece skirt, and her tall figure appeared particularly when contrasted with the short skirt. Her slender and fair legs were exposed to the air without any reservation. She was also wearing a pair of black high heels, and her pretty face, coupled with her jet-black curly hair, was very alluring.
When she appeared at the classroom door, everyone's attention was on Salma. No one was in the mood to listen to the lecture.
And the lecturer for this class was not Rachel, so naturally, there was nothing deterring them from doing so.
Seeing that the students were all focused on the outside, the lecturer looked helpless.
"Why is Salma here?"
"That's right. Why is my goddess here? Is she here to look for me?"
"Stop dreaming, there should be someone in our class who knows her!"
"Who's so powerful as to know Salma and get her to come over personally…"
The students in the classroom began to discuss in low voices.
When the student representative Luna Maxwell saw Salma, a trace of doubt flashed across her eyes.
When Justin saw Salma, she instantly understood what was going on.
He turned to Connor, who was listening attentively, and said, "Connor, Salma should be here to look for you, right?"
"It should be!"
Connor replied indifferently while listening to the lecture. He didn't even look at Salma.

chapters.title: Chapter 1178: Are You Free Tonight?
chapters.content:
Chapter 1178: Are You Free Tonight?
Connor hadn't come to school for a long time. It wasn't long before he realized that he couldn't understand a lot of what the lecturer was talking about.
Therefore, Connor planned to take advantage of this period of time to make up for his lessons.
As for the matter of Salma coming over to look for him, he did not take it to heart at all.
After all, in Connor's eyes, Salma was a very important person, but she was just an ordinary girl, so Connor didn't take her seriously at all.
After Justin and Brooks saw that Connor could still be so calm, they also admired him inwardly. If a goddess like Salma was here to look for them, they would probably be grinning from ear to ear.
"Connor, it's amazing that you can find such a beautiful girlfriend and get to know Salma. Why don't I take you as my master? Can you teach me how to get along with girls?"
Justin grinned.
Connor smiled helplessly when he heard Justin's words. He didn't know what to say.
If Connor told Justin that he actually had a Twitch celebrity lover and that Rachel Wallace was living in his house, Justin would probably kneel down to Connor on the spot.
However, Connor did not do that. It would be tantamount to bringing trouble to himself if he did.
What Connor hated the most now was probably trouble. After all, it was rare for him to have such a comfortable life. He had to enjoy it properly.
Meanwhile, the students in the classroom had been resisting Salma for the entire class.
They were extremely curious. Who was Salma looking for?
However, the result shocked everyone.
When the bell rang, Connor walked out of the classroom and stood in front of Salma.
Upon seeing this scene, the students in the classroom suddenly realized that Salma was here to look for Connor.
"Who is this Connor?"
"That's right.. He actually knows Salma. It's really unbelievable…"
"This Connor is definitely not an ordinary person!"
The students in the classroom were shocked and started discussing in low voices.
Connor walked in front of Salma and asked softly, "Are you here to look for me today?"
"That's right. Who else could it be other than you?"
Salma smiled faintly.
"Then what's the matter?" Connor couldn't help but ask softly.
Salma hesitated for a moment before asking Connor, "Are you free tonight?"
"I'm free. What's up?"
"It's my birthday tonight, so I wanted to invite you to my birthday party..."
Salma said nervously.
"Your birthday party?" Connor only came to a realization after hearing Salma's words.
"You're not thinking of rejecting me, are you?" Salma became even more nervous when she saw that Connor didn't immediately agree.
"I didn't say I was going to reject you. Since it's your birthday party, I definitely have to go. But isn't it bad for your admirer, Zayn Fergerson, to see me?"
Connor said hesitantly.
"Why care about Zayn? I have nothing to do with him, and today is my birthday, not Zayn's. If you don't want to see Zayn, then I won't let him come…" Salma hurriedly said.
"No need. Just tell me the location. I'll go over tonight!" Connor said lightly.
"Okay, this is the invitation to the party. You can bring it there!" Salma hurriedly took out a gold-plated invitation letter and handed it to Connor.
"Alright, see you then!"
Connor accepted the invitation letter and then turned around to return to the classroom.
"Connor…"
Salma had originally planned to speak a little more with Connor, but after seeing him leave, a trace of disappointment flashed across her eyes.
She sighed and turned to leave.
After Connor returned to the classroom, Justin and Brooks naturally wanted to ask Salma why she was looking for Connor.
However, when the two of them knew that Salma had invited Connor to her birthday party, they were instantly dumbfounded.
"Do you want me to bring the two of you over tonight?"
Connor said after seeing the expressions on their faces.
"Forget it. Salma invited you, not the two of us. There'd be a problem with the two of us going over…"
Justin refused very sensibly.
When Connor saw that Justin and Brooks really didn't plan to come, he didn't say anything.
…
On the other side, Salma was in a very bad mood after separating from Connor. She felt that the reason why Connor treated her like this was definitely because of Zayn.
"This damn Zayn, why is he so shameless?"
Salma scolded fiercely. Then, she took out her phone and dialed Zayn's number.
"Salma, what's the matter?"
Zayn quickly picked up the phone and asked with a smile.
"Zayn, did you find trouble with Connor again?"
Salma coldly asked.
"I..."
Zayn was stunned.
"Zayn, you'd better tell me the truth!" Salma interrupted.
A hint of helplessness flashed across Zayn's eyes, and then he said in a low voice, "I did meet Connor a few days ago…"
"Didn't I warn you not to get close to Connor before? Why didn't you learn your lesson? Are you planning to make me ignore you for the rest of my life before you'll be happy?" Salma shouted angrily.
"Salma, are you mistaken? I did meet Connor that day, but I didn't do anything!" Zayn shouted nervously.
"I didn't call you to listen to you explain these things to me. I just wanted to tell you not to meddle in other people's business in the future. If you dare to approach Connor again, I will definitely not let you off…" Salma said coldly.
After hesitating for two seconds, Zayn said in a low voice, "Salma, don't be angry, I understand…"
"By the way, Connor will be coming to my birthday banquet tonight. Don't bully him at that time. If you do, I won't forgive you!" Salma angrily said before hanging up the phone.

chapters.title: Chapter 1179: Birthday Party
chapters.content:
Chapter 1179: Birthday Party
Meanwhile, in Zayn's house.
At this moment, Zayn was eating with his friends in a private room, accompanied by several sexy and hot beauties.
When Zayn ended the call with Salma, he was in a bad mood. He pushed the beauty in his arms to the side and said in a low voice, "It's that damn Connor again. Why hasn't he left Newtown yet?"
"Mr. Fergerson, what's wrong?" a young man asked with a smile when he saw that Zayn's expression was a little strange.
"What else could it be? It's that Connor that I told you about before. This kid is really bold. He's still in Newtown and even complained to Salma about me…" Zayn gritted his teeth.
"I thought it was something else. Isn't he just a poor kid from Porthampton?" The young man smiled disdainfully and continued, "Mr. Fergerson, why don't I help you teach this kid a lesson?"
The young man who spoke was called Leland Yount. His family was in the entertainment business, and Leland's father was also a famous figure in Newtown. It was said that he had some connections with the underworld, so it was very obvious what he meant.
Leland knew very well that Salma's grandfather liked Zayn very much, so the probability of Zayn marrying Salma in the future was very high.
At this moment, he was obviously preparing for a rainy day and building a good relationship with Zayn in advance. When Zayn really became the Trent family's son-in-law, he would also benefit endlessly.
Zayn naturally knew what Leland meant, but after hesitating for a moment, he said in a low voice, "Forget it. If I were to make a move on Connor now, Salma would definitely guess that I was the one who did it. When that time comes, Salma would really be angry, and things would be troublesome…"
"Mr. Fergerson, I didn't expect you to be so timid," a beautiful woman walked up and said with a smile.
"It's not that I'm timid. It's just that my relationship with Salma has just eased up a little. I don't want to make it so stiff…" Zayn explained.
Zayn had always been pursuing Salma, and this matter had already spread among the upper circles of Newtown.
Everyone even felt that it was only a matter of time before Zayn claimed her.
Leland looked at Zayn and blinked, then said, "Mr. Fergerson, there's no need for us to really do anything to Connor. We just need to embarrass him in front of Miss Thompson, right?"
"How can I embarrass him? Salma won't even allow me to get close to him…" Zayn said helplessly.
"Mr. Fergerson, you can't get close to Connor, but I can!" Leland sneered and continued, "Tonight is Miss Thompson's birthday party. If I let Connor embarrass himself in front of so many people, won't the rest be simple?"
"..."
Zayn hesitated for a moment before asking, "What do you plan to do?"
Leland looked at the beauty beside him and told Zayn about his plan.
Leland grinned. "Mr. Fergerson, what do you think of my idea?"
"Not bad, that's a good idea!"
Zayn nodded and continued, "I can not only clear my name, but also teach Connor a lesson. Tonight, we will follow your plan. After the matter is done, I will not mistreat you!"
"Mr. Fergerson, what are you saying? What kind of relationship do we have? I'm not helping you for this little benefit…" Leland said pretentiously.
Zayn turned to look at Leland, but he did not expose him.
He was not a fool. Leland must have some ulterior motive for being so attentive to him.
However, Zayn felt that since Leland had some brains, it wouldn't hurt to keep him around.
…
On the other side, Connor had no idea what Zayn and the others were planning.
After school, he went home to change his clothes and picked out a small gift. He then took a taxi to the hotel where Salma was holding her birthday party.
This hotel was owned by the Trent family. It was also a very famous hotel in Orilon.
When Connor got out of the car, he found all kinds of luxury cars driving into the hotel's parking lot. It was very rare for a guest to come by taxi like Connor.
"Rich people are really different—even their birthday parties are so grand. If I had known earlier, I would have driven my Mercedes-Benz out…" Connor couldn't help but think. Then, he walked into the hotel.
"Hello, sir!"
The receptionist greeted Connor politely.
"I'm here to attend Salma Thompson's birthday party…" Connor said.
When the receptionist heard Connor's words, a strange look flashed across her eyes, but she still said with a smile, "Sir, please show me your invitation!"
Connor directly handed the invitation letter to the receptionist. The expression on his face instantly changed. She hurriedly said, "Mr. McDonald, please come this way…"
"Alright!"
Connor nodded gently. Then, following the receptionist, he walked through a long corridor until a door appeared before him.
Connor knew that the birthday party should be held behind this door. Connor could even hear soothing music coming from inside.
At this time, there were two men in black standing on both sides of the door. They checked Connor's invitation letter and let him in.
After Connor entered the hall, he found that the decorations were indeed very luxurious. The gorgeous crystal chandelier, the pleasant music, and the white marble tiles were the very definition of luxurious.
Although Connor did not arrive very late, the hall was already packed with people.
Most of these people were from the upper class of Orilon. They were all wearing expensive clothes. They were in groups of three to five, whispering or drinking.
These people all had faint smiles on their faces, giving off an extremely amiable feeling.
After all, they were all well-known people in society, so they attached great importance to their every move and would not do anything out of line.

chapters.title: Chapter 1180: Conversation with Luna
chapters.content:
Chapter 1180: Conversation with Luna
At this moment, although there were many people in the hall, it was very quiet. No one here talked loudly.
Connor actually didn't like this kind of occasion very much. He even felt a little disgusted.
He felt that these people were all very fake, wearing a pleasant mask on their faces when they were all old monsters who ate people whole in private.
Moreover, Connor had also discovered something strange—the guests who were here all did not seem to be from Newtown.
This was because Reena, Queta Juve, Arthur Synder, and the others, all of whom Connor had met in Newtown, were not here.
Later on, Connor also realized that although the Trent family's influence in Orilon was terrifying, their influence in Newtown wasn't quite as extensive as their business was not in Newtown. Moreover, today was Salma's birthday party, so it was very normal for Reena, Queta, and the others not to attend.
Connor looked at these people in the hall and realized that he actually didn't know any of them.
Therefore, he went to the dining cart, picked up a piece of cake, and tasted it.
It had to be said that the pastries in this hotel tasted very good.
Connor hadn't eaten dinner, so he could take this opportunity to eat something.
"Connor?"
But just as Connor was eating, a sweet voice suddenly came from behind him.
Connor subconsciously turned around and saw that it was Luna Maxwell, the student representative of their class.
At this moment, Luna was standing behind him.
After Connor arrived at Newtown University, he rarely went to school.
Therefore, Connor only knew Justin and the others. Up until now, he'd never interacted with Luna at all. The two of them had not even spoken.
So when Connor saw Luna take the initiative to talk to him, he was still a little surprised. In his impression, Luna had always been very cold and aloof. She didn't like to talk to others in class.
Luna was wearing a black evening gown today, which made her look very tall. Her exquisite and beautiful face gave off a noble and cold aura, giving people the feeling that she was the daughter of a rich family.
Luna took the initiative to walk to Connor's side and said, "So Salma came to the class today to invite you here!"
"That's right…" Connor nodded lightly, then looked at Luna and asked, "Are you also here to attend the banquet?"
"Yes. My father and Salma's father are very good friends. We've known each other since we were young, but since my father isn't free today, I came here alone…"
Luna paused for a moment before continuing, "Originally, I felt a little bored when I came to attend this banquet, but I didn't expect to meet you here!"
"Haha, I'm also quite bored. I don't really like this kind of occasion, but Salma invited me, so I had no choice but to come…" Connor said with a smile.
Luna looked at Connor from head to toe and asked softly, "Connor, what's your relationship with Salma?"
"We're just friends!" Connor replied.
"Oh, I see…"
Luna nodded lightly and didn't say anything.
Connor saw that Luna seemed a little off and asked softly, "What's wrong?"
"Actually, it's nothing much. I just wanted to remind you that Salma has a suitor called Zayn Fergerson. That person is very dangerous, so you'd better be careful…" Luna whispered.
"It's okay. If Zayn dares to provoke me, I'll slap him away!"
Connor said lightly.
"Why are you so good at bragging?" Luna looked at Connor with a helpless smile and continued, "I thought you were quite mysterious and was actually curious about you. I didn't expect you to be such a braggart…"
"A goddess like you is actually curious about a poor loser like me?" Connor said with a smile.
"You're not a loser!"
Luna shook her head gently.
Connor was surprised at her words. "What do you mean?"
"I think you're different from the other boys in our class. There's a feeling in your eyes. It's strange, but it's like you don't care about anything. You must have some secret…"
Luna looked at Connor seriously.
"I didn't expect the student representative to be so observant…" Connor said with a smile.
"Of course. I usually have nothing to do, so I like to observe the students in our class..."
"I didn't expect you to have such a hobby!"
Connor's expression was a little curious, and then he continued, "I heard that you're a couple with Wyane Jablon from our class. Is that true?"
"Wyane has always been pursuing me, but I don't like him. Besides, I don't have any plans to date now. I'm planning to go into the entertainment industry in the future. I want to become a big star like Tiffany Zamora…"
Luna looked at Connor innocently.
"I know Tiffany Zamora. If there's a chance, I'll bring you to meet her." Connor said with a smile.
"Why are you so good at bragging? The mysterious image you have in my heart is now gone…" Luna pouted.
"So be it. I'm not very mysterious anyway!"
Connor smiled. He picked up a piece of cake and handed it to Luna. "Do you want to try it? It tastes quite good…"
"Alright!"
Luna quickly nodded.
After a short period of contact, Connor realized that Luna was actually quite a nice girl. It was very comfortable to get along with her, but her temperament gave people the illusion that she was difficult to get along with.
Connor also realized that Luna was actually very innocent. Her thoughts were also very simple, all childish thoughts that only little girls had.
This made Connor feel a little amused. The seemingly cold and arrogant Luna was actually a little girl deep inside.
At this moment, Leland and Zayn were staring at Connor.
"Mr. Fergerson, isn't this boy just an ordinary person? How does he know Juliano Maxwell's daughter?"
After Leland saw Luna, a strange look flashed across his eyes. He didn't want to offend someone like Juliano Maxwell.
"What are you afraid of?"
The expression on Zayn's face was a little disdainful. Then, he frowned and said, "I've already investigated them. Connor and Luna are classmates. Isn't it normal for them to talk when they meet?"
"I see!"
Leland let out a long sigh of relief when he heard this. Hhe then continued, "If that's the case, then I can rest assured…"
"Are you ready?"
Zayn narrowed his eyes and asked in a low voice.
"Mr. Fergerson, are you still worried about me doing things? I've already prepared everything on my side. As long as everyone is here, I'll immediately make my move. At that time, we'll just wait and watch a good show…" Leland said with a smile.
"That's good…"
Zayn nodded lightly, then narrowed his eyes and looked at Connor. His expression was very gloomy.

chapters.title: Chapter 1181: The Person Who Gives the Present
chapters.content:
Chapter 1181: The Person Who Gives the Present
Meanwhile, Connor and Luna chatted while eating.
At this moment, a melodious voice rang out. Tonight's main character, Salma Thompson, finally appeared.
Today, Salma was wearing a white evening gown with light makeup and a pair of exquisite earrings. She had a faint smile on her face and looked exceptionally sexy and beautiful.
For a moment, everyone's attention was focused on Salma.
After a short silence, everyone started clapping.
"Salma is so beautiful today!"
Luna couldn't help but sigh.
"She is indeed very beautiful…"
Connor nodded lightly.
"Are you tempted?"
Luna hurriedly asked.
"What's there to be tempted about? I already have a girlfriend…"
Connor said helplessly.
"Oh!"
Luna nodded and continued, "Only immature people would fall in love so young…"
"Luna, I've been an adult for a long time, okay? How is this counted as falling in love at a young age?"
Connor said exasperatedly.
"To me, any young love when one is still studying is considered puppy love…"
Luna said seriously.
Connor looked exceptionally speechless, not knowing what to say.
When Salma appeared, everyone immediately surrounded her and took out the presents they had prepared beforehand.
Connor knew that these presents were very expensive, whereas he had just bought a platinum necklace from a jewelry store.
Connor's present was obviously much shabbier compared to these people's presents.
The presents given by other people probably cost more than 100,000 dollars.
Salma was also very used to these kinds of situations. With a faint smile on her face, she began to have small talks with everyone.
Connor wasn't in a hurry to give Salma a present. He planned to wait until there were fewer people around Salma before going over.
However, at this moment, Zayn Fergerson walked to Salma and whispered to her, "Salma, happy birthday. This is a present for you!"
After saying that, Zayn took out an exquisite box and handed it to Salma.
After hesitating for a moment, Salma stretched out her hand and took the box.
"Salma, quickly open it and see what Mr. Fergerson has given you…"
Salma's best friend seemed to be very curious as she asked softly.
"Yeah, I wonder what Mr. Fergerson has given you!"
The others were also curious.
When Salma heard everyone's words, she was too embarrassed to reject them, so she opened the box in front of everyone.
There was a very beautiful watch in the box, and Salma's name was engraved on the face.
"It's a limited edition model from Patek Phillipe…"
"Oh my God, there are no more than ten of these watches in the world!"
"The price of this watch should be at least 10 million!"
"Even if you have money, you might be able to buy this watch. After all, there are only ten of them in the world. Mr. Fergerson must have gone through a lot to be able to get this watch…"
Everyone looked at Salma with envy.
However, Salma was very calm. She thanked him and then put the watch aside, as if she did not see it as a present worth tens of millions.
When Zayn saw the present that he had carefully selected being placed aside by Salma, his expression naturally turned ugly.
However, he did not dare to say anything. He could only frown and turn around to leave.
Ten minutes later, the number of people around Salma finally decreased by a lot.
After hesitating for a moment, Connor walked up to Salma and handed her the present he had prepared. He said softly, "Happy birthday. I was in a hurry, so I didn't choose any expensive presents for you. I hope you don't mind!"
"How could I possibly dislike your presents?"
Salma didn't expect Connor to prepare a present for her. She happily replied before taking the initiative to receive the present.
This time, there was no one urging her as Salma opened the box herself.
When the surrounding people saw that it was just a very ordinary platinum necklace in the box, they all revealed disdainful expressions.
After all, how could a rich young miss like Salma lack such things?
Moreover, Connor's present was really a little too shabby. Compared to the other people's presents, it was simply unbearable to look at!
However, Salma was extremely happy. She took off the crystal pendant on her neck and put on Connor's platinum necklace. She smiled at Connor and asked, "Connor, what do you think? Does it look good on me?"
As for the people around Salma, they were instantly speechless after seeing this scene. They were confused.
Salma did not even bother to look at the expensive present that Zayn had given her.
But now, Connor had given her an extremely ordinary platinum necklace, yet Salma was actually so happy.
This was something that they could not understand.
"It's very nice!"
Connor said with a smile.
Not far away, when Zayn saw this scene, he seemed to become even angrier, because it was obviously a slap in his face!
He had gone through so much just to buy this watch, yet Salma did not even look at it and threw it on the table.
Connor had just casually bought a platinum necklace, but she liked it so much. Zayn didn't know what to say.
In fact, in the eyes of a girl like Salma, she had never lacked anything since she was young. Some expensive watches and jewelry might be very precious in the eyes of ordinary girls, but in her eyes, it was no different from ordinary presents.
Salma did not care about what others gave her because she did not lack anything. She only cared about the person who gave her the present.
After Salma received Connor's present, she took the other presents and left with them. She probably wanted to put them away..
Zayn turned to look at Leland Yount and said softly, "When are you going to carry out your plan?"
"Mr. Fergerson, my people are already here..."
Leland could feel Zayn's anger, so he quickly replied in a nervous tone.
"Since your people have already arrived, what are you still doing here? Do we have to wait until the birthday party is over before he makes a move?"
Zayn shouted with a trembling voice.
"We'll get it done…"
Leland nodded and said something to the girl beside him.
After hesitating for a moment, the girl nodded gently and walked toward Connor.

chapters.title: Chapter 1182: The Plan Has Succeeded!
chapters.content:
Chapter 1182: The Plan Has Succeeded!
"Can the woman you've found do it? Why does she look a little nervous…"
Zayn looked at the girl's back with a puzzled expression.
"Mr. Fergerson, don't worry. This woman has been with me for more than half a year. There won't be any problems!
"This is also the first time she has done such a thing. So, it's not odd that she's a little nervous…"
Leland said confidently.
Zayn took a deep breath and didn't say anything.
This girl was called Qadira Silva, and she was a student at Newtown Academy of Art.
However, she met Leland by chance.
Leland took a fancy to Qadira, then he began to pursue her relentlessly.
However, Qadira already had a boyfriend at that time, so she rejected Leland several times.
In the end, Leland had no choice but to beat Qadira's boyfriend up. Then, he threatened Qadira's boyfriend to drug Qadira and send her to Leland's bed.
After the incident, Leland gave Qadira 100,000 dollars, but Qadira insisted on calling the police.
Leland then used Qadira's parents as a threat and promised Qadira that if she continued to be his mistress, he would get Qadira a good job in their family's company and give Qadira 100,000 dollars every month.
Qadira was born in an ordinary family. She knew that she couldn't win against someone like Leland. If she called the police, her parents might be implicated by her. Moreover, 100,000 dollars a month was not a small amount for her. In the end, Qadira had no choice but to become Leland's mistress.
Now, Qadira was an executive in Leland's family's company, and her annual salary was at least a million dollars.
In addition to the living expenses that Leland gave her every month, the money added up to a very considerable amount.
Therefore, Qadira had just one thought in mind. When Leland was tired of playing with her, she would leave Leland and find a random man to marry. That way, she could live a carefree life. As for this past, Qadira naturally would not mention it to anyone.
Qadira and Leland were in a state where they each took what they needed. Both of them could find what they needed from each other, so it did not matter whether it was fair or not.
Leland had just called Qadira and given her a very important task. As long as Qadira could complete this task, Leland promised to buy her a house in the city center.
She could get a house just by putting on a show, so it was very tempting to Qadira.
