Therefore, she agreed without any hesitation.
Although Qadira was Leland's mistress, she was just an ordinary person. Therefore, when facing this mission, she was still a little nervous.
A moment later, Qadira finally walked up to Connor.
At this moment, Qadira was less than five meters away from Connor. When she saw Connor, her heart started to beat faster, and she instinctively stopped.
Because she knew that what she was doing now was harming people, she began to feel a little conflicted.
Not far away, Zayn could not help but frown when he saw this scene. He said in a low voice, "Leland, why is that woman not moving?"
"I don't know…"
Leland was also very puzzled at this moment. He frowned and replied.
At this moment, Qadira seemed to have finally made up her mind. She knew that if she couldn't complete this mission, she would definitely end up in a very miserable state. Therefore, she had no way out at all.
Qadira once again walked toward Connor. However, perhaps because Qadira was too nervous, she did not notice the steps under her feet. She lost her balance and fell to the ground after letting out a delicate cry.
"F*ck, she is really useless!"
When Zayn saw this scene, he gritted his teeth and cursed. He was livid.
Leland's face also turned dark. After all, Qadira was about to reach Connor, but she fell before that could happen.
But at this moment, Zayn saw hope again.
When Connor saw Qadira fall, he walked to her side and helped her up. Then, he asked softly, "Are you alright?"
"I'm fine…"
Qadira was stunned for a moment before she replied softly.
"You must have sprained your ankle. Stand up and move around to see if you can walk!"
Connor looked at Qadira and continued.
When Qadira heard Connor's words, she could not help but be stunned.
She did not think that Connor would be so kind. It seemed that people have not been kind nor shown concern for her for a long time.
However, she was here to frame Connor. Qadira felt terrible about it, but she had no choice.
"I'm sorry…"
Qadira whispered to Connor.
"Sorry?"
Connor could not help but be stunned when he heard Qadira's words. A trace of confusion flashed across his eyes.
Qadira took advantage of the time when Connor was in a daze to unbutton her shirt and mess up her hair. She leaned into Connor's arms and shouted, "Don't touch me!"
When Connor heard Qadira's words, he was instantly dumbfounded. He was kind enough to help Qadira up, but he did not expect her to say that he was taking advantage of her.
"Miss, do you have a misunderstanding? I..."
Connor looked at Qadira and tried to explain.
"You pervert! What are you doing?!"
Qadira didn't listen to Connor's explanation at all and shouted.
The surrounding people all looked over, and they were very puzzled.
It was obvious that this was Leland's plan to humiliate Connor.
Zayn did not need to participate in this matter from the beginning to the end. Naturally, Zayn would not be suspected. Leland would also take this opportunity to teach Connor a lesson. If the Thompson Family found out that Connor had molested a woman at Salma's birthday party, their impression of Connor would plummet. In this case, Connor would never be able to get close to Salma again.
"Haha…"
Seeing that Leland's plan had succeeded, Zayn couldn't help but reveal a smug smile.
He sighed to himself, "Connor, oh, Connor, do you think you can win against me? I have ten thousand ways to play you to death!""

chapters.title: Chapter 1183: Did You See It With Your Own Eyes?
chapters.content:
Chapter 1183: Did You See It With Your Own Eyes?
Connor looked at Qadira and could not help but be stunned.
However, he quickly realized what was going on.
"Looks like someone wants to frame me!"
Connor sighed softly and then began to scan the entire hall.
In the end, Connor looked at Zayn because there were so many people in the hall, but Zayn was the only one who had a conflict with Connor.
Therefore, Connor knew that the person who wanted to frame him was Zayn.
Leland hurriedly ran to Connor and asked Qadira, "Honey, what's going on?"
"I accidentally fell just now, and this person came over to help me up. But... he molested me. He even pulled my clothes apart and touched my chest just now…"
Qadira exclaimed.
Connor looked at Qadira and shook his head lightly because this woman was terrible at acting.
If Connor had really molested Qadira just now, how could she possibly be so calm at this moment?
Although Qadira's acting was quite bad, Leland's acting was rather good.
He glared at Connor and shouted fiercely, "You actually dare to molest my girlfriend..."
At this moment, the surrounding people seemed to have heard the commotion here, so they all surrounded Connor.
The people present all considered themselves successful people, so even if they had done very dirty things in private, they still had to pretend to be upright at times like these.
They also felt disgusted by Connor's behavior of molesting a woman.
After all, even if he really wanted a woman, he could go find one. Why did he have to resort to molesting her?
Therefore, everyone looked at Connor with disdain.
"What evidence do you have to prove that I molested her?"
Connor asked Leland expressionlessly.
"Evidence?"
When Leland heard Connor's words, he couldn't help but be stunned for a moment. Then he pursed his lips and said, "Just look at my girlfriend. What evidence do you want? Do I have to see you molesting my girlfriend for it to be considered molesting?"
"Please make way, please make way!"
However, at this moment, a woman's voice sounded.
When Salma saw so many people surrounding them, she came over to see what was going on.
However, when she saw that it was Connor who was in trouble, she suddenly became nervous and hurriedly rushed out of the crowd.
"What's going on?"
Salma asked.
"Miss Thompson, this person took advantage of my girlfriend's fall and molested her…"
Leland shouted.
When Salma saw Leland, a hint of helplessness flashed across her eyes. She knew very well that Leland was not a good person.
Although Salma had not been in contact with Connor for a long time, Salma felt that Connor would not do such a thing. When she thought about the phone call she made to Zayn, Salma instantly understood what was going on. It was obvious that he was plotting to frame Connor again.
Salma took a deep breath and sized up Leland. She said to Leland expressionlessly, "Did you just say that Connor molested your girlfriend?"
"That's right, Connor molested my girlfriend!"
Leland hurriedly nodded.
"Alright, show me the evidence now. What evidence do you have to prove that Connor molested your girlfriend?"
Salma asked with her big watery eyes.
"I…"
A strange look flashed across Leland's eyes.
"Leland, don't forget that there are surveillance cameras in this hall. I can go and check the surveillance cameras now…"
Seeing that Leland seemed to look a little guilty, she hurriedly continued.
"There were so many people present just now. They should all be able to prove that Connor molested my girlfriend…"
Leland stuttered.
"Then tell me, who can prove it?"
Salma sneered and said in a disdainful tone.
"..."
For a moment, everyone present fell silent.
They all stood where they were and did not speak.
Although they had all heard Qadira shouting that Connor was molesting her, no one saw Connor really molesting Qadira.
Under such circumstances, no one dared to stand out and speak nonsense.
In an instant, Leland's expression turned ugly.
He looked at Zayn, as if he was seeking Zayn's help.
However, Zayn didn't dare to say anything because he didn't want Salma to know that he had something to do with this.
"I can prove it!"
Just as Leland was feeling hopeless, a voice rang out.
When everyone heard this voice, they turned and saw a girl walking out of the crowd in high heels.
When Connor saw this girl, he was instantly stunned. This girl was none other than Anita Tolstoy whom Connor had offended in school.
Anita looked at Connor with disdain, then said, "I can prove that Connor molested this woman just now!"
Luna Maxwell looked at Anita, and a hint of confusion flashed across her eyes. She knew that Connor and Anita had some conflict.
"Did you see it with your own eyes?"
Salma asked helplessly.
"Of course, I saw it with my own eyes. Connor molested this woman. When we were in school, Connor molested me! too"
Anita's words shocked everyone present once again.
Just now, they had some doubts about whether Anita was telling the truth. However, after Anita said that, everyone believed that she was telling the truth. After all, no one would joke about such a thing.
Salma looked at Anita and didn't know how to retort.
Seeing this scene, Zayn sneered. Connor really had many enemies!
Anita looked at Connor with a proud expression, as if she had won.
After the incident with Rachel Wallace, Anita tried her best to find Connor.
However, Connor seemed to have vanished from the face of the earth. No matter how she looked, she could not find him.
Anita had wanted to see what was going on, but she did not expect Connor to be here as well. Therefore, she would definitely not let go of such a good opportunity to hit him when he was down.
"I saw it too. I'm a witness!"
At this moment, a girl also stood up and said confidently.
This girl had a good relationship with Anita, so she was obviously helping Anita.

chapters.title: Chapter 1184: A Tooth for a Tooth
chapters.content:
Chapter 1184: A Tooth for a Tooth
"I saw it too…"
"I'm also a witness…"
In just a few moments, everyone started to accuse Connor.
Whether it was Leland's friends or Anita's friends, they all stood up and said that they saw Connor molesting Qadira.
Salma looked at these people with a helpless expression.
She didn't expect Connor to have offended so many people!
Connor stood there expressionlessly, as if all of this had nothing to do with him.
"..."
Salma didn't know what to do.
After all, so many people had come forward to say that Connor had molested Qadira. If she continued to speak up for him, it would be obvious that she was protecting him.
"Connor, did you really molest this person?"
Salma hesitated for a moment before asking Connor softly.
"Even if I say that I didn't molest this woman, will you believe me?"
Connor scoffed and said.
"I will…"
Salma hurriedly shouted.
"Even if you do, what good will that do?"
Connor smiled faintly and continued, "And even if I molested this woman, so what?"
Everyone looked at Connor in shock.
No one expected that Connor would actually still be so arrogant at a time like this.
"So what if I molested this woman?"
This sentence was obviously a slap to Leland's face!
However, this sentence also proved that Connor actually did not put people like Leland in his eyes from the very beginning.
'Did Connor really molest that woman?'
Luna's eyes flashed with a trace of doubt.
Meanwhile, Salma was staring at Connor with her big watery eyes, extremely speechless.
She really couldn't understand why Connor would say such a thing.
Connor was obviously admitting that he had indeed molested Qadira.
Now, even if Salma wanted to help Connor, she had no other way to do it.
"Alright, since you have already admitted to molesting my girlfriend, I want you to apologize to my girlfriend now…"
Leland shouted at Connor.
"Who is this person? He actually dared to molest a woman at the party. He's really detestable…"
"That's right, he's simply shameless. How did such a person get in?"
"I say, Leland is the only one who can tolerate today's incident. If it were me, I would have beaten him up long ago and made sure he kneels down and apologize!"
"That's right. What's the point of talking with such a hooligan? It's better to just deal with him…"
Everyone looked at Connor, and they seemed to be very riled up as they shouted at the top of their lungs.
"Did you hear what I said? I want you to apologize to my girlfriend now!"
Leland became even more arrogant when he saw that everyone was on his side. He took a step forward and shouted at Connor.
"If I don't apologize, what can you do to me?"
Connor looked at Leland from head to toe and asked disdainfully.
Arrogant!
At this moment, those people present could only use this word to describe Connor.
They really could not understand why he could still be so arrogant at this moment.
Anita looked at Connor with a smug expression. She knew that the more arrogant Connor was now, the more likely he would die.
"Why you…"
Leland stared at Connor with wide eyes. He did not expect Connor to be so arrogant.
Connor looked at Qadira indifferently and said softly, "Beauty, since you like being molested by me, why not come with me? I can give you whatever this person can give you."
When Leland heard Connor's words, his face turned even uglier.
He did not expect Connor to still be in the mood to tease his girlfriend.
"Are you crazy?"
Qadira shouted at Connor and hid behind Leland.
Leland took a step forward and gritted his teeth. "Connor, I'm giving you one last chance. Are you going to apologize or not?"
"I'm not going to apologize!"
Connor said lightly.
"Then, don't blame me for what's about to happen…"
Leland shouted and reached out to hit Connor.
When Connor saw that Leland was about to make a move, he had a look of disdain on his face. Then, he waved his right hand gently.
Smack!
Connor slapped Leland's face.
Leland took two steps back before regaining his balance. He looked at Connor in disbelief.
No one expected that Connor would actually dare to hit someone first!
Connor had molested Leland's girlfriend, and now he had hit Leland!
Connor was clearly here to cause trouble!
"Connor, what are you doing?"
Seeing that the matter was getting out of hand, Salma was exasperated. She couldn't understand what was going on.
"You actually hit me?"
Leland shouted at Connor.
"So what if I hit you?"
Connor replied indifferently and walked toward Leland.
When Zayn saw this scene, he finally could not hold back anymore.
He rushed in front of Connor and then shouted at Connor with an angry expression, "Connor, what exactly are you up to? First, you molested Leland's girlfriend, and now you're hitting him. Are you trying to cause trouble?"
Smack!
Before Zayn could finish speaking, Connor slapped Zayn's face and said indifferently, "Get lost. What does this have to do with you?"
For a moment, the entire hall fell silent.
Everyone looked at Connor as if he was a madman. No one knew what he was trying to do at this moment.
"Connor actually hit Zayn?"
Luna covered her mouth and exclaimed; her eyes were filled with shock.
"Connor, what are you doing? Stop making a scene…"
Salma seemed to have realized that things were getting out of hand, and she hurriedly rushed toward Connor as she exclaimed.
"These people are framing me and want me to apologize. I'm just returning the favor!"
Connor calmly replied to Salma. He walked towards Leland and grabbed his collar, asking in a low voice, "Do you still want me to apologize to your girlfriend?"
"F*ck you, you… you must apologize to my girlfriend today!"
Leland glared at him and shouted fiercely.
Smack!
Connor slapped Leland in the face and repeated, "Now, do you still want me to apologize to your girlfriend?"

chapters.title: Chapter 1185: Bennett Thompson
chapters.content:
Chapter 1185: Bennett Thompson
Leland took two steps back from Connor's slap and fell heavily to the ground.
At this moment, everyone present looked at Connor with disbelief.
No one had thought that Connor would actually be so bold.
Not only did he molest Leland's girlfriend, but he even hit Leland.
Moreover, Zayn, who had nothing to do with this matter, was also slapped by Connor.
Everyone felt that Connor was here to cause trouble today. He was being completely unreasonable.
Of course, everyone present knew who Leland and Zayn were.
They knew now that Connor had hit these two people, he definitely wouldn't be able to walk out of this hall.
As for Luna and Salma, they were extremely worried. They really couldn't understand where Connor got the courage to hit someone.
Although Salma had a terrifying background, Connor had really gone overboard this time.
Thus, Salma had no way to use the Thompson Family's power to help Connor.
Also, it was Salma's birthday party.
Connor's actions were undoubtedly a slap to the Thompson Family's face. The Thompson Family would definitely not let Connor off easily.
Although Luna was also very worried about Connor, she knew that she couldn't help him now.
After all, the Maxwell Family's ability was limited. Moreover, Luna and Connor were only classmates.
The Maxwell Family would never offend people like Leland and Zayn over such a small matter.
So now, these two girls knew that although Connor looked very impressive, the price he had to pay was also very high.
"An ordinary person is still an ordinary person after all. It's not like you can integrate into the upper class just by making a few friends. In the upper class, it's not like whoever has the strongest fist has the final say. If you deal with the problems of the upper class in the way of an ordinary person, you will only die a miserable death. Connor is really too impulsive…"
Luna looked at Connor's position and sighed helplessly, her voice carrying a trace of disappointment.
Luna originally had a good impression of Connor, but when she saw him hit Leland, she knew that she and Connor were not from the same world.
If she got too close to Connor, it was very likely that she would implicate the Maxwell Family.
"Connor, you're too arrogant. You molested Leland's girlfriend and didn't apologize. Now, you even hit Leland. What is the meaning of all this?"
Seeing that Leland had been beaten black and blue by Connor and could not speak, Zayn hurriedly took a step forward and glared at Connor angrily.
Connor turned and glanced at Zayn. He knew very well that today's incident was planned by Zayn and Leland in advance.
"That's right, I did molest his girlfriend, and I also hit him. What can you do to me?"
Connor felt that no matter how much he tried to explain to these people, it would be useless.
After all, there were so many people present. Even if Connor opened his mouth a hundred times, he would not be able to explain himself.
Anita stared at Connor with her eyes wide open. Her face was filled with shock. She really couldn't understand why Connor was so arrogant.
"So, you admit that you did molest Leland's girlfriend just now, right?"
Zayn whispered to Connor.
"I'm not in the mood to talk nonsense with you now!"
Connor replied indifferently and then walked straight to the door.
"Stop right there. If you don't explain this matter to me clearly today, you can't leave!"
Seeing that Connor was about to leave, Zayn stopped in front of Connor and yelled.
Connor looked at Zayn indifferently and asked expressionlessly, "What else do you want?"
"I..."
Zayn opened his mouth and was about to speak.
A wave of restlessness came from the crowd.
A middle-aged man and a few black-clothed bodyguards walked directly toward Connor, Zayn, Leland and the others.
"It's over…"
When Salma saw the middle-aged man leading the group, she was filled with despair.
This middle-aged man was none other than Salma's third uncle, who was also the hotel's general manager.
Salma's third uncle's appearance was obviously to help Zayn and the others deal with Connor!
Salma was very clear about her third uncle's character. If she allowed her third uncle to participate in this matter, Connor would definitely end up in a very miserable state.
Salma's third uncle was called Bennett Thompson. He was considered a rather famous figure in the Thompson Family and was a ruthless person.
All these years, Bennett was the one who did all the shameful things in the Thompson Family.
Therefore, Bennett was the most suitable person to deal with today's matter.
When the guests present saw Bennett, they all took the initiative to greet him and secretly pitied Connor. After all, if Bennett personally came forward, it might not be as simple as Connor apologizing to Leland and the others!
"Uncle Bennett, you're here."
Salma walked toward Bennett and said softly.
"Salma, I'm really sorry. I went to meet a friend just now, so I'm a little late. I didn't expect some guy to be here causing trouble for you. Don't worry, leave the rest to me…"
Bennett said to Salma with a smile.
When Salma heard Bennett's words, she was unusually helpless.
She knew that someone must have called Bennett, which was why he was here. Otherwise, Bennett wouldn't have shown up personally for such a small matter.
She didn't need to guess to know that the person was Zayn!
Sure enough, after Bennett finished speaking with Salma, he walked straight to Zayn.
Then, he smiled and asked Zayn, "Zayn, what's going on? Who is so daring to cause trouble at Salma's birthday party?"
"Uncle Bennett, someone molested Leland's girlfriend just now…"
Zayn pointed at Connor and said in a low voice.
"..."
When Bennett heard this, he turned and sized up Connor. Then, he said coldly, "You have quite the guts…"
"Uncle Bennett, today is Salma's birthday party. We didn't plan to blow this matter up, so we just wanted to have this guy apologize to Leland and let this matter pass.
"But I didn't expect this guy to not only refuse to apologize, but he even hit Leland. He even hit me just now. This guy simply doesn't put the Thompson Family in his eyes…"
Zayn looked at Bennett and continued to add.
"Alright, I get it now…"
Bennett nodded, his expression a little gloomy. Then, he directly walked toward Connor.

chapters.title: Chapter 1186: Attack!
chapters.content:
Chapter 1186: Attack!
"Kid, you've got some guts to come to our Thompson family's territory and cause trouble. What are you thinking?"
Bennett saw that Connor was dressed very casually, probably not from a wealthy family, so his tone towards Connor became disdainful.
Connor glanced at him calmly, then said expressionlessly, "This matter has nothing to do with your Thompson family. I advise you not to get involved!"
"You caused trouble in our Thompson family's hotel, and today is Salma's birthday party. How can you say this has nothing to do with us, the Thompson family?"
Bennett didn't expect Connor to be so arrogant, and his attitude made him even angrier.
"What are you planning to do now?"
Connor asked Bennett softly.
Bennett looked Connor up and down, then said quietly, "Today is Salma's birthday, and since you're Salma's friend, I'll be lenient for his sake. You just hit Leland, right?"
"Yes!"
Connor nodded lightly.
"Good, since you hit Leland, now let Leland hit you back, and then you apologize to him. As long as Leland agrees to forgive you, I won't make things difficult for you!"
Bennett said domineeringly while looking at Connor.
Upon hearing his words, Leland, not far away, showed a somewhat excited expression.
After all, Connor had slapped him so many times earlier, and his face had long been lost.
If he could get it back now, it would be a small redemption of his pride.
After hearing Bennett's words, Connor smiled lightly and walked straight ahead.
The people were confused by his actions because they didn't expect him to completely ignore Bennett's words and still intend to leave.
Bennett became angrier when he saw this and stepped forward to stop Connor. He stared at him and shouted, "What? You're not satisfied with my way of handling this?"
"I advise you to first understand my identity and then talk to me!"
Connor glanced at Bennett calmly and said in a calm tone.
"Your identity?"
Bennett looked at Connor with a hint of confusion in his eyes.
But he had no intention of explaining further and continued walking ahead.
"What are you all standing there for? Stop this kid for me!"
Bennett thought Connor was just trying to scare him, so he quickly shouted at the bodyguards behind him.
Upon hearing his words, the bodyguards quickly took action and stood in front of Connor, intending to confront him.
Upon seeing the bodyguards, Connor's eyes flashed with helplessness.
Originally, he just wanted to attend Salma's birthday party today, but he didn't expect to cause so much trouble.
And Salma regretted it now. If he had known that things would turn out like this, he wouldn't have invited Connor in the first place.
Of course, Salma also knew that Connor hadn't made any advances towards Leland's girlfriend. It was all a setup by Leland and Zayn. However, since Connor had admitted it in front of so many people, he knew that knowing the truth wouldn't solve anything.
"Uncle, Connor is my friend. I think there must be a misunderstanding. Otherwise, let's let Connor leave for now and deal with this later!"
Salma hesitated for a moment before walking in front of Bennett and speaking softly to him.
"Salma, there are so many people watching now, and Leland has been beaten by Connor like this. If we let Connor leave like this, what will these guests think of our Tang family?"
Bennett replied with great difficulty.
"But I think..."
Salma opened her mouth, wanting to help Connor speak.
"Xiaoyu, I have already given him a chance just now, considering that he is your friend. But this kid doesn't know how to appreciate it. I really have no other choice!"
Bennett added again.
After hearing Bennett's words, Salma's expression appeared somewhat helpless.
She knew in her heart that this matter was no longer a private matter between Connor and Leland. Connor's actions were clearly provoking the Tang family.
And Salma also knew very well that if it weren't for the sake of saving face for her, Bennett might have already broken Connor's legs and thrown him out. So it was impossible for her to make Bennett truly let Connor go.
"I know that this person is your friend. So how about this, let these people take Connor to my office, and then let Connor and Leland settle this matter privately. This way, it would be beneficial to both parties. What do you think?"
After hesitating for a moment, Bennett whispered to Salma.
"Okay."
Salma nodded helplessly.
He felt that the method Bennett just suggested was the best solution at this time.
"Take this kid to my office!"
Bennett, seeing Salma's agreement, directly shouted coldly at his bodyguards.
After hearing this, the bodyguards walked towards Connor's location, seemingly intending to take action against him.
When Connor saw these bodyguards approaching, a trace of helplessness flashed in his eyes, and he said softly, "I advise you not to touch me, or you will regret it..."
"Kid, why the hell are you so arrogant..."
One of the leading bodyguards stared at him and shouted.
But before he could finish his words, he raised his leg and kicked directly at the bodyguard's stomach.
"Bang!"
A loud noise.
The bodyguard's body flew out directly, and then slammed heavily into the table.
After seeing this scene, everyone present was dumbfounded, their mouths wide open, and their expressions extremely shocked.
They never expected that Connor would be so bold.
Not only did he dare to confront Leland and Zayn, but now he even dared to attack Bennett's bodyguards.
And just now, Connor's speed was extremely fast. Before everyone could react to what was happening, they saw that the bodyguard was sent flying.

chapters.title: Chapter 1187: The Trent Siblings
chapters.content:
Chapter 1187: The Trent Siblings
"What are you all standing there for? Come at him together!"
After witnessing this scene, Bennett's expression turned extremely angry as he shouted loudly.
The remaining bodyguards also saw the scene just now and could tell that Connor's skills were extraordinary.
So they didn't dare to be careless and rushed towards his position together.
For a moment, seven or eight bodyguards surrounded him.
Zayn and Leland were eagerly watching Connor's position. They thought he definitely wouldn't escape today. Even if his skills were impressive, he couldn't possibly be a match for so many bodyguards!
But a few seconds later, their mouths dropped open, and they were dumbfounded.
They saw that the seven or eight bodyguards were as fragile as paper. In the blink of an eye, they all fell to the ground, without any chance of retaliation.
These bodyguards, who seemed strong and robust, were nothing in front of the thin and weak Connor. In just a few seconds, they all fell to the ground.
Everyone was stunned in place, with an extremely shocked expression on their faces.
No one expected Connor's skills to be so terrifying.
Even Bennett's eyes showed a hint of surprise. After all, these bodyguards were all his people, and he knew their capabilities very well. But he never expected Connor to be so formidable.
Bennett stood there with an awkward expression, unsure of what to do.
Connor turned his head and glanced at Bennett indifferently, then said expressionlessly, "I told you earlier, your men can't stop me..."
"Kid, do you know that by doing this, you're making enemies with our entire Thompson family? Do you know the consequences of offending our Thompson family?" Bennett yelled angrily, his eyes wide open.
"The consequences of offending your Thompson family?" Connor heard these words, and his expression showed a disdainful smile. He spoke calmly, "What can a mere Thompson family amount to in front of me?"
After saying this, Connor intended to leave.
The crowd looked at his back with complex feelings, especially the last words he said, "What can a mere Thompson family amount to in front of me!"
In the eyes of many, this statement was incredibly arrogant.
After all, they were well aware of the terrifying power of the Thompson family.
But for some reason, people felt that Connor's words were not a joke.
Bennett stared at his back, his eyes filled with anger. He felt that Connor didn't consider the Thompson family worthy and saw it as an insult to his people.
"It seems that if I don't show you some colors, you won't know how formidable our Thompson family is!"
Bennett took a deep breath, then dialed a number on his phone.
He knew Connor had extraordinary skills, but the Thompson family couldn't be easily bullied. If seven or eight bodyguards were no match for Connor, what about twenty or thirty?
If twenty or thirty bodyguards couldn't defeat Connor, he would hire a martial artist even if it cost him money.
At this moment, he had a simple thought which was he must keep Connor at all costs. If Connor were to leave like this, it would be a blow to the face of the Thompson family.
Salma stood there, feeling at a loss about what to do.
Anita and Luna were also stunned by Connor's terrifying skills. Their eyes were filled with both shock and admiration.
But just as Bennett took out his phone, a young couple entered the hall while chatting.
A young man was dressed in a white suit and looked handsome and elegant. He gave off an air of wealth and privilege.
The young woman appeared to be around twenty years old. She wore a black ultra-short skirt that accentuated her tall and sexy figure. Her legs, wrapped in black stockings, were adorned with high heels. Her ample bosom threatened to burst out of her top, making her exceptionally seductive and captivating. Instantly, she attracted the attention of numerous men present.
Upon seeing these two individuals, Bennett's eyes flickered with excitement. He whispered, "Why did they come at this time? This is bad!"
After uttering these words, he quickly put down his phone and hurried towards the location of the young man and woman.
For the Thompson family, this young couple appearing in the hall could undoubtedly be considered VIPs among VIPs.
The young man was the heir of a powerful family, and recently, the Thompson family had been interested in collaborating with the young man's family for a project. That's why Bennett had invited the young man to attend Salma's birthday banquet, aiming to showcase the influential network of the Thompson family and establish a bond.
However, Bennett had been preoccupied with the matter of Connor all this time, so he had forgotten about the young man's presence.
If the young man were to find out that Connor had caused trouble here and had even left unharmed, it would undoubtedly leave a negative impression on him, potentially leading to the cancellation of their cooperation.
The consequences for the Thompson family would be terrifying.
Therefore, the expression on Bennett's face began to tense, and he hastily walked towards the young man, shouting loudly, "Mr. Trent, Miss Trent, you've arrived!"
Upon hearing Bennett's words, everyone present showed expressions of shock and turned their heads towards the location of the young man and woman.
"Are these two people from the Trent family in Chicago?"
"Most likely. I heard that the Thompson family has been in contact with the Trent family recently!"
"Could that young man be Jameson Trent, the person in charge of the Trent family?"
"Judging from Mr. Thompson's reaction, it's highly likely..."
The people present started whispering among themselves.
At the same time, Connor also noticed the arrival of the young man and woman in the hall. Upon seeing them, he could only smile helplessly.
These two individuals were none other than Jameson and Maddison, whom Connor had coincidentally met when he visited the Celestial Flower Valley.
Speaking of which, Connor had to thank Jameson. After all, it was Jameson who insisted on carrying him out of the Celestial Flower Valley when Connor was suffering from the backlash of the two Chi Receiving Pill. Without him, Connor might have already died.
So, Jameson could also be considered Connor's lifesaver.
Of course, Connor was also the lifesaver of Jameson's father.
If it weren't for him, they wouldn't have obtained the Hundred Herbs Pill so easily, and his father might have already passed away.

chapters.title: Chapter 1188: A Big Shot
chapters.content:
Chapter 1188: A Big Shot
Just at that moment, Bennett ran past Connor.
Then he cheerfully shouted at Jameson, "Mr. Trent, Miss Trent, you've arrived! Why didn't you give me a call in advance? I could have gone out to pick you up!"
Upon hearing Bennett's words, Connor knew that the Thompson family must be acquainted with Jameson.
And Jameson also saw Connor, so he didn't bother with Bennett at all. He pushed Bennett aside and quickly walked up to Connor, his expression filled with excitement. He exclaimed, "Connor, it's such a coincidence to see you here!"
"It is quite a coincidence..." Connor replied with a faint smile.
Everyone was stunned upon hearing the conversation between Jameson and Connor.
Bennett was also dumbfounded, his expression showing immense shock.
Because they never expected that Connor would know Jameson.
"Connor, I'm really grateful for what you did at the Celestial Flower Valley. If it weren't for you, my father might have died..." Jameson exclaimed excitedly to Connor.
"I should thank you too. If you hadn't sent me back to Porthampton, I might have died by now..." Connor replied with a smile.
"I only did some small things. Connor, you saved our Trent family's lives. I naturally won't forget your kindness!" Jameson hurriedly said.
In fact, after returning to Chicago, Jameson used all the connections of the Thompson family to investigate Connor's background. When he investigated, he found out that Connor was actually the heir of McDonald Family in Porthampton, a prestigious figure in the four provinces.
So now his attitude towards Connor was exceptionally respectful!
However, when Bennett saw Jameson's great respect for Connor, he was dumbfounded.
After all, he had some interactions with the Trent family before, and he was quite familiar with their situation, especially Jameson. Although Jameson appeared easygoing and didn't have much arrogance, deep down he was very proud. Even when facing the head of the Thompson family, he remained calm and composed.
But now, in the face of Connor, Jameson was showing such respect, which was something that left people feeling incredulous.
Salma and Luna were even more astonished. They knew about Jameson's identity, but they couldn't understand why Connor would know him.
"Are you here today for Salma's birthday party?" Connor asked Jameson softly.
"Yes, our family is currently in talks with the Thompson family about a project, so I came over..." Jameson quickly nodded.
"Salma is my friend!" Connor gently reminded him.
Upon hearing his words, Jameson's eyes flashed with surprise, then he quickly nodded and asked, "Connor, what do you mean?"
"Salma is facing some trouble now. There's someone she dislikes who has been pestering her. It's fine for you to cooperate with the Thompson family, but you need to solve her problem first. Do you understand what I mean?" Connor said casually.
Jameson hesitated for a moment upon hearing Connor's words, then quickly nodded and said, "Connor, rest assured, I'll take care of this matter..."
"Good!" Connor nodded gently, then continued, "When you have time, go to Porthampton and find Thomas to get some suitable projects for your family!"
"Connor, how can I accept this? The last time you saved my father…"
Jameson hurriedly added.
"We're friends. There's no need to be so polite with some things!"
Connor patted Jameson's shoulder and continued, "Alright, if there's nothing else, I'll leave first!"
"Alright. Let me send you off!"
Jameson quickly agreed and then took the initiative to send Connor out of the hall.
When Jameson and Maddison followed Connor out of the hall, everyone was dumbfounded. They stood rooted to the ground with shock on their faces.
Although Connor and Jameson didn't speak very loudly just now, everyone present heard it clearly!
At this moment, everyone realized that his identity might not be as simple as they thought!
..
After Jameson and Maddison saw Connor off at the hotel, they returned to the lobby.
Meanwhile, Bennett hurriedly walked up to Jameson and anxiously asked, "Mr. Trent, do you know that person?"
"Not only do I know him, but Connor is also the savior of our Trent family!" Jameson replied calmly. Then he turned his head, glanced at Bennett, and asked in a soft voice, "You don't have any conflicts with him, do you?"
"No... no..." Bennett quickly shook his head without hesitation.
"That's good. Don't blame me for not warning you. It's better if you don't offend someone like Connor. He's not someone you can afford to offend," Jameson reminded him in a low voice.
Upon hearing Jameson's words, Bennett hesitated for two seconds and nervously asked, "Mr. Trent, who exactly is this Connor?"
Jameson looked at Bennett calmly, then whispered Connor's identity in a voice only they could hear.
After learning Connor's true identity, Bennett froze in place. His eyes showed not only shock but also more shock. He didn't know how to describe his feelings now.
He couldn't have imagined that he had unintentionally offended such a prominent figure.
Beads of sweat instantly covered his forehead, and his body trembled incessantly. He didn't know what to do.
The people present all wore expressions of confusion. They couldn't understand what was happening.
Originally, everyone thought Connor wouldn't be able to leave the lobby today, but no one expected that he would leave so confidently.
Leland, with a swollen face, stood still. He wasn't a fool, and he could vaguely sense that Connor's identity wasn't as simple as Zayn had described.
If Connor were just an ordinary person, how could he possibly know someone like Jameson?
"Mr. Trent, I heard that someone has been bothering Miss Salma recently. I wonder if there's any truth to it?" Jameson spoke up again, asking Bennett.
Upon hearing Jameson's question, Bennett hesitated for a moment, then quickly looked up at Salma's location and asked in a low voice, "Salma, has anyone been bothering you recently?"
...
Salma hesitated for a moment, then without thinking, she pointed directly at the position of Zayn and said loudly, "Zayn has been pestering me all the time!"

chapters.title: Chapter 1189: Asking for Trouble!
chapters.content:
Chapter 1189: Asking for Trouble!
"Salma, you..."
Zayn suddenly looked up at Salma, his expression furious.
However, Salma was very clear in her heart that all of this was caused by Zayn.
If it weren't for his plot to frame Connor, none of these things would have happened. Therefore, she felt a strong disgust towards him at this moment.
"Understood."
Jameson looked at Salma and nodded gently, then turned to Bennett and said, "Mr. Bennett, I agree with the project you proposed to cooperate with my family, but I have one condition..."
"What condition?"
Bennett quickly asked.
"Just now, Connor specifically instructed me that someone has been bothering Miss Salma, and since Connor and Miss Salma are friends, I hope this person will no longer harass her in the future. Otherwise, we will not cooperate with your family..."
Jameson said expressionlessly.
After hearing his words, Zayn was stunned, standing in place dumbfounded, not knowing what to do.
Zayn never expected that Jameson would listen to Connor's words like this. This was enough to prove that the relationship between them was not as simple as they had imagined.
"Mr. Jameson, Salma and Zayn are friends, and my father also likes him very much..."
Bennett opened his mouth wanting to speak.
"Your father liking this person and Miss Salma liking this person seem to have nothing to do with each other!"
Jameson interrupted Bennett's words directly, then looked at Salma and asked, "Miss Salma, I want to hear your thoughts now!"
"I have no thoughts, I just don't want to see this person anymore, and I don't want this person to continue bothering me!"
Salma had long been unable to bear Zayn, and coupled with the incident just now, she was a little angry, so she spoke without any mercy.
"I understand!"
Jameson nodded gently, then turned to Bennett and said, "My meaning was clear just now. As long as the Thompson family can make this person stop bothering Miss Salma, then the Trent family can continue to cooperate with your family!"
Bennett looked at Jameson with a hesitant look in his eyes.
Zayn's expression became even more nervous when he heard Jameson's words because he knew that as long as Bennett nodded now, there would be no possibility between himself and Salma, and everything he had in Orilon would be gone.
After all, for such a long time, he had always been regarded as a prospective son-in-law of the Thompson family, so wherever he went, someone would give him face. But once he lost this relationship, he would just be an ordinary rich second-generation.
"Mr. Jameson, can you let me discuss this with my father?"
Bennett asked Jameson in a low voice after thinking for a moment.
"I need an answer today because I'm leaving tomorrow morning by plane. You can call your father now!"
Jameson said lightly.
Zayn couldn't help but take a step forward and whispered to Jameson, "Mr. Jameson, is there a conflict between us?"
"What conflict can there be between you and me?"
Jameson didn't even look at Zayn, his tone was unusually calm.
Zayn looked at Jameson with an extremely awkward expression. He did not know what to do.
Bennett also knew that Jameson was not joking at this time, so after hesitating for a few seconds, he said in a low voice, "Mr. Jameson, please wait a moment. I'll call my father now…"
"Alright, go ahead!"
Jameson nodded slightly.
Bennett hesitated for a moment, then took his phone and walked out of the hall.
Zayn stood dumbfounded in place, his expression unusually nervous.
He never expected that things would turn out like this in the end.
He was not a fool. On the contrary, his ability to win the favor of Salma's grandfather was precisely because he was a smart person.
So he could tell that the relationship between Connor and Jameson was definitely not as simple as he had imagined.
If they were just ordinary friends, then Jameson had no reason to listen to Connor's words so obediently.
At this moment, he finally realized that perhaps Connor was not an ordinary person at all. On the contrary, Connor might possess an unimaginable power!
And Leland, who had helped Zayn deal with Connor before, was also completely dumbfounded at this moment.
After all, the reason why Leland chose to help Zayn was entirely because he believed that Zayn might become the son-in-law of the Thompson family in the future.
But now, if Zayn was not allowed to get close to Salma anymore, then he would be nothing.
And what was even more terrifying was that Leland had offended Connor, who had an extraordinary relationship with Jameson today, and it could have a significant impact on the Yount family he was in.
So at this moment, he regretted it deeply. His thoughts were no longer about being slapped in front of so many people by Connor, but about how to deal with the upcoming situation.
While everyone was contemplating these issues, Salma's uncle, Bennett, finally finished the phone call and walked quickly to Jameson's side.
"Mr. Jameson, I just talked to my father on the phone. My father also agrees to your request. We won't let Zayn harass Salma anymore. Can our cooperation with the Trent family continue?"
Bennett said softly to Jameson.
After hearing Bennett's words, Jameson nodded satisfactorily and said lightly, "Bring the contract to me tomorrow!"
"Okay..."
Bennett nodded excitedly.
After all, this project with the Trent family was very important to their family. Once the cooperation succeeded, the benefits it would bring to their family would far surpass what Zayn, a small figure, could compare to.
Salma's grandfather's achievements to this day were enough to prove that he was a very intelligent person.
So he knew very well how to make the right choice in this matter.
Salma stood dumbfounded in place, her eyes filled with shock and nothing but shock.
Because she never expected that with just a few words, Connor had resolved such a big trouble for her.
At this moment, she also secretly speculated in her heart about Connor's true identity.
She could sense that Connor was definitely not as simple as she had imagined, otherwise Jameson wouldn't have been so obedient to him.
Zayn seemed unable to accept this result at all, his expression incredibly incredulous.

chapters.title: Chapter 1190: The Strange Rachel
chapters.content:
Chapter 1190: The Strange Rachel
"If there's nothing else, I'll leave now!" Jameson said lightly to Bennett, then he led Maddison and walked towards the hall.
"Mr. Jameson, let me see you off..."
As soon as Bennett saw Jameson about to leave, he hurriedly called out and took the initiative to send them out of the hall.
Zayn's expression was filled with despair as he watched Jameson's figure.
Even until now, he couldn't believe that everything he saw before his eyes was real.
A few minutes later, Bennett returned to the hall alone.
When Zayn saw Bennett, he quickly walked up to him and exclaimed excitedly, "Uncle Bennett, you're not really planning to cancel the engagement between me and Salma, are you?"
"Engagement?"
At this moment, Bennett, facing Zayn, seemed like a different person, sneering disdainfully and saying, "Zayn, you have the audacity to say such a thing? When did you and Salma establish an engagement?"
"Uncle Bennett, can you stop joking with me? Grandpa Thompson did say..."
Zayn seemed somewhat nervous and wanted to explain.
"What did my father say?"
Bennett interrupted his words directly and continued, "My father did say he could give you a chance to pursue Salma, but he never said anything about establishing an engagement..."
"No..."
Zayn opened his mouth to speak.
"No what? My father gave you so much time, yet you made no progress at all. I can see clearly that Salma doesn't have you in her heart. There will be no future between you and Salma, so don't bother her anymore..."
Bennett said coldly.
"Uncle Bennett, can you stop joking with me? I genuinely love her..."
Zayn shouted in extreme fury.
"When did I joke with you?"
Bennett snorted coldly, then shouted to everyone present, "From today on, Zayn has no relationship with the Thompson family. Anything Zayn does has nothing to do with our family..."
Everyone present was dumbfounded when they heard his words, their expressions filled with shock.
Because everyone thought that today's incident was a conflict between Connor and Leland.
But no one expected that in the end, it was Jameson's appearance that made Zayn the biggest victim.
Leland received several slaps from Connor, but compared to the losses suffered by Zayn, it was nothing!
After all, once Zayn lost the protection of the Thompson family, he would become just an ordinary rich second-generation, not even comparable to Leland!
If today's incident was like pushing Zayn into an abyss from which he could never recover.
At this moment, he realized how terrifying the person he had provoked was.
Luna stood still, her expression filled with shock.
At this moment, she finally understood how terrifying the power of her classmate Connor was!
What Connor did before was not just a momentary impulse but because he had enough confidence.
Zayn seemed unwilling to lose everything like this, so he quickly ran up to Salma and shouted excitedly, "Salma, things are definitely not what you think. Can you speak up for me?"
"Zayn, I've warned you before to stay away from Connor, but you never listened. Now, everything that happened is your own fault, and I can't save you!"
Salma said coldly before turning around and leaving.
..
And on the other side, after leaving the Thompson family hotel, Connor didn't pay any attention to what would happen next.
Because he felt that he had already explained things clearly enough, Jameson himself was a very intelligent person.
So Jameson should be very clear about how to handle the next steps.
But even before he reached home, he received a phone call from Jameson.
"Connor, I've taken care of the task you assigned to me. Zayn should no longer harass Salma in the future..."
Jameson said softly.
"Good, you've done me a favor!"
Connor replied casually.
"These are all trivial matters compared to the help you have given my family, it's just a drop in the ocean..."
Jameson hastily said.
"Let's not make a fuss about it. We're friends, no need to be so polite. Instead of giving those business opportunities to someone else, it's better to entrust them to someone I trust!"
Connor said directly.
Jameson hesitated for a moment and then said softly, "Connor, thank you!"
"You're being too polite."
Connor replied with a smile and promptly hung up the phone.
He didn't actually know many second-generation wealthy individuals, and most of them had conflicts. Jameson was the first second-generation wealthy friend he had made, and he thought Jameson was a really good person. So as long as he could help, he would certainly not refuse.
Jameson also knew in his heart that although Connor talked about cooperation, Empire World Corporation was on a completely different level from their Tang family. The collaboration between the two sides was simply Empire World Corporation assisting the Tang family. He understood this better than anyone else, so he secretly kept Connor's favor in his heart.
After hanging up the phone, Connor returned home alone.
But when he arrived home, he discovered that Rachel wasn't there.
He had been in contact with Rachel for a long time, and he felt that her life was actually quite monotonous. She would usually go to school during the day and then sit on the couch watching TV at night. She didn't have any friends and rarely went out.
But now, it was already past eight o'clock in the evening.
Connor found it strange that Rachel wasn't home and wondered if she had already moved out.
"Knock, knock, knock!"
Just then, a series of urgent knocks on the door resounded.
He was taken aback for a moment, then quickly walked to the door and opened it.

chapters.title: Chapter 1191: Ordinary Friends
chapters.content:
Chapter 1191: Ordinary Friends
After the door opened, Rachel's exquisite face appeared from behind it.
Originally, Connor thought that Rachel had finally moved away and felt a little happy.
But now, Connor was completely speechless once again.
Today, Rachel was dressed in a very unique manner. She was wearing a tight black short skirt, and her sexy figure looked particularly charming under the short skirt. She was wearing black stockings and a pair of high heels. Her exquisite face and black curly hair gave people an indescribable temptation.
Connor couldn't help but be stunned when he saw Rachel's outfit. His eyes went directly to her beautiful legs.
It couldn't be helped—Rachel's long legs were really too alluring.
However, when Connor thought of how Rachel had killed the Malone family head, he felt that this woman was as terrifying as a demon.
It had to be said that Rachel was the perfect combination of an angel and a devil.
Rachel seemed to have noticed that something was wrong with Connor's eyes and asked, "What, do I look good?"
"Cough cough…"
Connor coughed awkwardly and asked, "What are you doing? Why are you back so late?"
"What I do doesn't seem to be any of your business, right?" Rachel coldly replied to Connor. Then, she kicked off her high heels and ran to the sofa barefooted before sitting down and turning on the television.
Connor saw that Rachel did not seem to have any intention of talking to him, so he could only sigh helplessly and then continue to ask, "When are you planning to move out of my house?"
"Soon. It shouldn't be long…" Rachel said indifferently.
"Alright then!"
Connor nodded helplessly. Then, he turned around and prepared to return to the bedroom to rest.
"When do you plan to deal with Percy Juve? Have you almost forgotten about your serious matters now?" Rachel asked.
"Percy Juve hasn't returned yet. Even if I want to deal with him now, I can't find him. Let's wait a little longer!" Connor lightly replied.
"..."
Rachel turned her head and looked at Connor without saying anything. Instead, she turned back and continued watching TV with a serious expression.
Connor turned around and returned to his room to rest.
…
On the other side, inside the Thompson family's hotel.
After experiencing the incident with Zayn and Connor, Salma was not in the mood to hold a birthday party.
Therefore, she thought up a random excuse and left early.
When the customers saw that Salma had already left, they naturally had no intention of staying.
However, it would not take long for the news of today's incident to spread throughout the entirety of Orilon.
By that time, the entire upper class of the province would know of a person named Connor McDonald.
To be able to cause a scene at the Thompson family's birthday banquet and leave unscathed was enough for an ordinary person to brag about for the rest of their lives. What's more, Connor had an unclear relationship with Jameson Trent, which put his identity under a mysterious veil.
After Salma left the hotel, she immediately went to her grandfather's house.
Salma's grandfather, Frank Thompson, was definitely a legendary figure in Orilon. The Thompson family now controlled at least ten listed companies, and their assets had long exceeded ten billion.
However, Frank had always had a problem: he had never been able to find a suitable heir.
There were only two boys in the Thompson family's three generations, and Frank's eldest grandson was originally trained as an heir. He showed a good business mind at a young age. However, he'd killed someone because of a woman.
Frank's younger grandson was weak and sickly since he was young. Coupled with his poor brain, he could not inherit the Thompson family's business at all.
However, Frank did have many granddaughters. Among them, hiss favorite was probably Salma.
While he intended to let Salma inherit the Thompson family's business in the future, unfortunately, Salma was not very interested in these things.
Frank thus had no choice but to focus his attention on Zayn Fergerson. Back then, Zayn's grandfather was a benefactor to the Thompson family, so Frank planned to matchmake Zayn and Salma. This way, Zayn could inherit the family business as his grandson-in-law.
This was also the reason why Frank was still trying to matchmake Zayn and Salma even though the Fergerson Family was inferior to the Thompson family.
But today, Frank actually chose to give up on Zayn. This made Salma feel a little shocked.
Therefore, after she left the hotel, she went to his house immediately to ask him about it.
After entering the villa, Salma immediately saw Frank sitting on the sofa. She quickly walked over and called out, "Grandpa!"
"Is the birthday party over?" Frank asked indifferently.
"Yes, it's over…"
Salma nodded lightly.
"Since you don't have any feelings for Zayn, I won't make things difficult for you anymore. Zayn won't appear in your life in the future…"
Frank knew very well why Salma had come this time, so he did not waste any time and went straight to the point.
"Grandpa, have you really given up on Zayn?" Salma asked in disbelief.
"That's right, I've already given up!"
Frank lightly nodded and turned to look at Salma before continuing to ask, "What's your relationship with that Connor McDonald guy?"
"What is my relationship with Connor?" When Salma heard this sentence, a strange look flashed across her eyes.
"Salma, you don't have to hide anything from me. What is your relationship with this Connor? How much do you know about him?" Frank said slowly.
"..."
Salma stood on the spot and hesitated for two seconds before saying, "Grandpa, Connor and I are just ordinary friends. The two of us met on the plane…"
"If you were just ordinary friends, would he help you like this?"
Frank couldn't help but laugh.

chapters.title: Chapter 1192: The Thompson Family's Son-in-law!
chapters.content:
Chapter 1192: The Thompson Family's Son-in-law!
"Why would Connor help me?"
Salma asked in confusion.
"Do you know how much risk the Trent family will be taking on if they collaborate with us? Not only that, this collaboration has no benefits for the Trent family at all!"
"But Jameson Trent changed his mind because of Connor's words. This is enough to prove how much Connor cares about you. It also proves that the relationship between Connor and Jameson is not simple!"
Frank said slowly.
"This…"
Salma was stunned when she heard Frank's words.
"That's why I canceled the engagement between you and Zayn. It's because I think Connor is more suitable for you and that he probably also likes you," Frank continued.
"Grandpa, I think you might have misunderstood!"
Salma wanted to explain.
"Salma, don't worry. Grandfather has already lived for so many years, so I definitely won't be wrong about some things. This Connor guy definitely has feelings for you, so I hope that you can be together with him!" Frank said, not mincing his words.
"But what if Connor doesn't like me at all?"
Salma said with a frown.
"You haven't even tried yet. How do you know that Connor won't like you?"
Frank smiled faintly and continued, "Salma, Grandpa knows that you have a good impression of Connor. Moreover, Connor and Jameson have such a good relationship. This means that he is worthy of you. This time, I plan to help you get together with Connor!"
When Salma heard this, she smiled helplessly. "Grandpa, you're thinking too much. Connor doesn't like me at all!"
"If you don't take the initiative to explain things to Connor, how do you know that Connor doesn't like you?" Frank asked directly.
"Grandpa, are you planning to get me to confess to Connor?" Salma asked in surprise.
"I just hope that you can be together with him!"
Frank replied expressionlessly.
Salma looked at Frank in front of her with a speechless expression.
At this moment, she finally understood why Frank would give up on Zayn so readily.
This was because Connor was more suitable for the position of the Thompson family's son-in-law than Zayn was.
"Salma, you should also know that our Thompson family needs a capable heir now. Since you like Connor, I can give him a chance. However, whether you can seize this opportunity or not depends on your own ability. If you miss out on Connor, then you won't have any choice when I arrange a marriage for you in the future!"
At this moment, Frank spoke to Salma once again.
"Grandpa, so what if I like Connor? What if Connor doesn't like me?" Salma shouted helplessly.
"If this Connor really doesn't have any feelings for you, then why would he do these things for you? You have to believe my judgment. Connor definitely likes you!" Frank said confidently.
"Is that really true?"
When Salma heard Frank's words, a strange look flashed across her eyes.
It was obvious that Salma liked Connor, but she wasn't sure if he really liked her.
If she could really get together with him, then all of Salma's troubles would be easily solved.
At this moment, Salma was clearly at a loss.
Frank didn't say anything else and instead chose to leave.
…
The next day, at eight o'clock in the morning.
After Connor woke up, he washed up and went to Newtown University.
Because he woke up late, class had already started when he arrived.
However, the lecturers in the school were already used to Connor being late or sometimes not coming to school for a few days. Therefore, they didn't ask much and let Connor enter the classroom.
After Luna saw Connor, a strange look flashed in her eyes.
After experiencing Salma's birthday party yesterday, Luna already knew that Connor wasn't an ordinary person.
After she returned home, she asked her father about Connor's identity, but she didn't get anything.
This made Luna even more curious about what kind of person Connor was.
The morning passed quickly.
Connor's class only had classes this morning, so after the bell rang, everyone began to pack up and prepare to leave.
Just as Connor was packing his things and preparing to go back, Justin suddenly called out to Connor and said with a smile, "Connor, why don't we go for a meal later?"
When Connor heard Justin's words, he couldn't help but be stunned for a moment. Then, he nodded lightly and said, "Alright, you guys decide on the place. It's my treat today…"
"I was waiting for you to say that!"
Justin smiled happily when he saw Connor agree so readily.
Connor, Justin, and the others packed their things quickly, planning to find a random restaurant near the school to eat.
However, before Connor could walk out of the classroom, the class representative Wyane Jablon took the initiative to walk in front of Connor and asked him expressionlessly, "Connor, do you have time now? I have something to tell you…"
When Connor heard Wyane's words, he couldn't help but be stunned.
After all, it had been a long time since he came to Newtown University, but this was the first time Wyane took the initiative to talk to Connor.
Moreover, Connor looked at Wyane's expression. It seemed like he really had something important to tell him.
"Alright!"
Connor didn't think too much about it and simply nodded in agreement.
Wyane looked at Justin, Brooks, and Joel indifferently, then turned around and walked out of the classroom.
Connor followed him out of the classroom.
"Why's the class rep looking for Connor?" Justin asked Brooks with a puzzled expression.
"If you ask me, who should I ask?" Brooks replied helplessly, then continued, "Our class rep has always been a loner. He rarely takes the initiative to talk to others. I think he definitely has something to tell Connor this time…"
"Aren't you talking nonsense? I want to know why he's looking for Connor…"
Justin muttered.
"I don't know exactly what he's going to do, but it doesn't seem like anything good from the look in his eyes…" Brooks analyzed calmly.
Justin looked at the backs of Connor and Wyane, and a strange look flashed across his eyes. If he had to guess, he'd think that Connor had offended Wyane in some way.
..

chapters.title: Chapter 1193: Warning Me?
chapters.content:
Chapter 1193: Warning Me?
On the other side.
Wyane brought Connor to a remote corner.
Connor stopped.
"If you have anything to say, just say it!"
Wyane turned his head to look at Connor and asked, "You know Salma Thompson?"
"Yes, I do." Connor nodded.
However, he couldn't help but find it strange that Wyane would be looking for him because of Salma.
"What's your relationship with Salma?" Wyane asked.
"My relationship with Salma doesn't seem to have anything to do with you, right?"
Connor asked indifferently.
Wyane looked at Connor from head to toe, then said expressionlessly, "I don't want to waste my breath on you. I'm here to warn you to stay away from Salma in the future…"
"Why?"
Connor asked with a smile.
"Because Salma has already caught the eye of a rich heir. Furthermore, this rich heir has a very shocking background. Therefore, I advise you to stay away from Salma. Otherwise, you will die a very ugly death…"
Wyane said calmly.
"Are you talking about Zayn Fergerson?"
Connor asked Wyane.
"You actually know Zayn?" Wyane was stunned for a moment before he continued, "Since you know about Zayn, it means that your relationship with Salma is not simple. However, the person I'm talking about is not him. Zayn is nothing compared to the person I'm talking about. The person I'm talking about is not in Newtown nor in the country. He's currently overseas and will return to Oprana next year!"
"Thank you for your reminder!" Connor replied indifferently after knowing the purpose of Wyane looking for him. Then, he turned around and prepared to leave.
After all, no matter who the person Wyane was talking about was, Connor would not take it to heart.
When Wyane saw that Connor was about to leave, a strange look flashed across his eyes.
He didn't expect Connor to be so calm after hearing his words, as if he didn't take his words to heart. When he saw that Connor was going to leave just like that, he shouted, "Connor, what I said to you just now was not a reminder, but a warning!"
"A warning?"
Connor couldn't help but smile when he heard Wyane's words. He turned back and said expressionlessly, "Anyone who has warned me will not have a good ending, so I advise you to stay away from me!"
Connor could feel that Wyane was full of hostility when facing him, so Connor naturally did not hold back.
"You!"
Wyane's eyes flashed with anger.
Connor didn't bother with Wyane at all after that as he turned around and left.
"How ungrateful!"
Wyane snorted coldly and turned to leave.
…
A moment later, Connor returned to Justin, Brooks, and the others.
"Connor, what did the class rep want you for?"
Justin asked Connor curiously when he saw him return.
"It's not a big deal…"
Connor replied perfunctorily. After all, he did not want to involve Justin, Brooks, and the others in his matters.
Justin looked at Connor seriously and said, "Really? Why do I feel like something is wrong with Wyane today? If you have anything to tell me, I will definitely help you if I can…"
"Don't worry, it's really nothing serious. Now, let's go eat quickly. Have you guys thought of anything to eat?" Connor said, quickly changing the subject.
"I heard that there's a new barbecue restaurant next to our school. The taste seems pretty good, too. Do you want to try it?" Brooks suggested.
"Alright!"
Connor nodded without thinking.
Justin thought for a moment and said, "What's the point of just us guys going out for dinner? Why don't we call Ruth, Sonia, and the others!"
"Sure, I don't mind!" Connor said lightly.
"Then I'll call them!"
Seeing that Connor had agreed, Justin quickly took out his phone and dialed Sonia and the others.
A few minutes later, they arrived at the door of Connor's classroom.
Sonia was wearing a spaghetti strap skirt today, making her look very beautiful. In Newtown University, she could definitely be considered a goddess-level existence. Kaira and the others paled in comparison to her.
However, Connor realized that Kaira was also there, and she seemed to be very close to Justin.
Connor remembered that Justin had said that he had already broken up with Kaira, but from the looks of it, the two of them had probably gotten back together!
Connor didn't ask much about it. After seeing that everyone had arrived, he walked out of the school.
Sonia followed behind the crowd, looking at Connor's back with a troubled expression. After all, only she knew that Connor's identity was not simple. The rest of the people didn't know anything about Connor's identity.
Connor chatted with Justin and the others as they walked towards the school gate.
"Why are there so many people in front?"
At this moment, Kaira suddenly shouted.
After hearing Kaira's words, everyone looked up at the front and realized that there was indeed a large group of people gathered at the school gate.
"Something must have happened. Let's go and take a look!"
Justin naturally would not let go of such a good opportunity to watch the show, so he directly dragged Connor and the others over to the scene.
A moment later, Connor and the others arrived at the school gate. After spending a lot of effort, they finally squeezed to the front of the crowd.
When Connor saw the girl standing in the middle of the crowd, he was stunned.
This girl was none other than Salma Thompson!
Today, Salma was dressed very beautifully. She was wearing a white one-piece skirt, and her tall figure looked particularly charming when contrasted with the short skirt. Her slender and fair legs were exposed to the air without any reservation. She was also wearing a pair of black high heels. Her pretty face coupled with her jet-black curly hair gave off an indescribable allure.
"It's too beautiful. No wonder there are so many people surrounding it…"
After Justin saw Salma, she couldn't help but sigh in her heart.
After all, whether it was her figure, appearance, or family background, Salma could be considered the best of the best.
No matter where she went, she would attract the attention of countless men. It was normal for her to be surrounded by so many people.
At this moment, Salma seemed to be waiting for someone as she looked down at her phone from time to time.
Connor had a bad feeling about this.
He whispered to Justin and the others, "Come on, let's go eat!"
"Wait a little longer. Let's see what exactly is going on…" Justin replied directly.
"Yeah, there are so many people here. Something must be going on!"
Brooks didn't seem to have any intention of leaving, either.

chapters.title: Chapter 1194: Salma's Confession!
chapters.content:
Chapter 1194: Salma's Confession!
After Connor heard the two of them, the expression on his face turned rather tired.
He was worried that Salma might have come to find him today, so he didn't want to stay here any longer. After all, he had caused such a huge ruckus at Salma's birthday party yesterday, so he felt that it was better for him to leave first.
However, just as Connor was about to turn around, Salma took out her phone and dialed his number.
When Connor heard the ringtone of his phone, he felt that something was wrong. He hurriedly quickened his pace and tried to leave this place as soon as possible, but unfortunately, the school gate was already surrounded.
Just now, Connor and the others had spent a lot of effort to squeeze in, and getting back out wouldn't be easy.
On the other side, when Salma heard Connor's ringtone, she immediately turned her head to look at him. Then, she gracefully walked towards him in her high heels.
"Connor!"
Salma shouted.
When Connor heard Salma's words, a trace of helplessness flashed across his eyes. He slowly turned around and looked at Salma, asking with a smile, "Why are you here?"
"I'm here to look for you. Is it convenient for you now? I have something to tell you…" Salma asked Connor nervously.
When everyone heard Salma's words, they were all stunned. Their faces were filled with indescribable shock because no one had expected Salma to come here to look for Connor.
Salma was definitely considered a celebrity in Newtown University. This was the first time they had seen her take the initiative to look for a guy.
Therefore, the moment Salma finished speaking, almost everyone present turned their attention to Connor. Some people even began to whisper about who he was.
At this moment, Connor knew that the thing he was most worried about had finally happened. After hesitating for a moment, he whispered to Salma, "Um, why are you looking for me? I might have to go eat with my friend later!"
Connor felt that if he really left with Salma now, the students of Newtown University would definitely be even more curious about his relationship with Salma. Therefore, he might as well make things clear to Salma and let the students know that he was just an ordinary friend with her.
Salma hesitated for two seconds before saying in a serious tone, "...I'm not asking you to come over for anything else. I just wanted to tell you that I like you. Can you be my boyfriend?"
"EH?!"
After Salma finished speaking, almost all the students present were stunned.
For a moment, the entire world fell silent!
Meanwhile, Connor was completely dumbfounded as he looked at Salma in front of him.
He had never expected that Salma would look for him today to tell him about this matter.
Salma had thought about her situation for the entire night after the conversation with Frank yesterday. She was very aware about what Frank meant.
If she could not seize the opportunity with Connor now, the Thompson family would definitely marry her to someone else in the future.
Salma liked Connor to begin with, and marrying him was definitely ten thousand times better than marrying some stranger. Salma was unwilling to marry someone she didn't like.
Connor was her only chance. After thinking about it for a long time, Salma finally put down her pride and prepared to take the initiative to confess to Connor and fight for her own happiness.
However, Salma might not know how sensational her confession would be.
Originally, Salma had planned to tell Connor about this matter in private. However, after Connor had asked her to say it here, she felt that Connor would be too embarrassed to reject her in front of so many people. That was why she had said those words.
For a moment, all the students were dumbfounded.
No one expected Salma to take the initiative to confess to a boy!
Furthermore, it was at the school gate of Newtown University, in front of so many people!
This was really unacceptable!
Countless people widened their eyes as they looked at Connor and Salma, not knowing how to describe their feelings.
Justin, Brooks, and the others seemed to have seen a ghost. Their mouths were wide open as they stood on the spot. No one could understand their feelings at this moment.
Initially, they thought that Connor and Salma were just ordinary friends. However, no one expected Salma to take the initiative to confess to Connor.
Wyane was just passing by, but when he heard Salma's words, he couldn't help but stop and look at Connor. He didn't expect such a situation to happen.
Of course, Connor was the most shocked.
This was because Connor originally thought that Salma came to find him today to thank him for what he did last night. That was why he chose to let her say it here, but he never expected a confession from out of the blue.
This made the originally simple matter even more complicated.
"Who is this boy?"
"Yeah, why haven't I seen him in our school?"
"How did Salma fall in love with this guy? What was so good about this boy?"
"I really don't know what Salma is thinking. She abandoned so many rich heirs and actually fell in love with such an ordinary boy…"
"Yeah, I heard that there are quite a number of rich heirs in our Newtown University who are pursuing Salma!"
The students present immediately began to whisper. After all, this matter was too shocking.
It wouldn't be long before the news spread throughout the entire Newtown University and became the hottest news in the university.
The eldest daughter of the Thompson family, Salma, was an existence pursued by countless men. Now, she'd confessed to an extremely ordinary-looking boy.
This kind of plot seemed to only appear in television dramas!
"I really don't know what Salma is thinking."
"What's so good about this man?"
"That's right, Salma wouldn't be muddle-headed, right?"
On the other hand, the male students present were looking at Connor with envy and jealousy. This was because they felt that a person like Connor was not worthy of Salma.
However, they didn't think that a guy who could make Salma confess to him was an ordinary person.
If Connor's true identity was revealed, he would definitely turn all the rich heirs in Newtown into dregs.

chapters.title: Chapter 1195: Love At First Sight
chapters.content:
Chapter 1195: Love At First Sight
At this moment, Connor stood on the spot with a helpless expression. For a moment, he did not know what to do.
This was the first time Salma took the initiative to confess to a guy, even though she was still calm. But in fact, her heart was practically beating in her throat. Her hands were clenched tightly, and her palms were covered in sweat.
When she saw Connor not saying anything for a while, she asked, "Connor, are you willing to be my boyfriend?"
Connor sized up Salma before saying, "I'm sorry, I already have a girlfriend. I can't be with you!"
In an instant, everyone fell silent again.
Connor's words were even more shocking and unbelievable than Salma's confession to Connor.
Everyone felt that the scene before them was like a dream. It felt unreal.
"Connor, you're too awesome!"
Justin swallowed hard. He did not know how to describe his current feelings.
Salma took the initiative to confess to Connor, but was rejected by him.
No one could imagine what kind of plot this was!
What kind of person was Salma?
If Connor could get together with Salma, he would be able to save at least 50 years of hard work and obtain something that ordinary people would not be able to obtain even if they worked hard for their entire lives. Moreover, Salma looked like a goddess. No one could reject a woman like her!
"Is there something wrong with this kid's brain?"
"Yeah, he actually rejected Salma. What is he thinking?"
"There must be something wrong with this person's brain. Even if you have a girlfriend, you can just break up with her, right? I don't believe that there is a woman more perfect than Salma in this world!"
The crowd began to discuss again.
Salma did not seem to have expected such a situation. Her beautiful eyes were filled with tears as she whispered, "Connor, you already have a girlfriend, right?"
"Yes, I have a very good relationship with my girlfriend, so I can't abandon her and choose to be with you. However, I believe that you will definitely find someone more suitable for you in the future!" Connor whispered to Salma.
"But I just like you!"
Salma couldn't care less about reputation anymore as she shouted excitedly.
When Connor heard Salma's words, he felt rather distressed. He then said, "There are more people here. Let's talk somewhere else!"
"Fine!"
Salma hurriedly nodded, then opened the car door and got in.
Connor hesitated for a moment before following her into the car.
Soon, the two of them drove away from the school gate of Newtown University, leaving behind a large group of students who didn't know what was going on.
Kaira turned her head to look at Justin and asked with a very surprised expression, "What is going on?"
When Justin heard Kaira's words, his expression was a little helpless. "I don't know either…"
…
After Connor and Salma left Newtown University, they went into a decent-looking cafe and got a private room.
After entering the private room, Connor sorted out his emotions and whispered to Salma, "Salma, I feel that we haven't known each other for a very long time, and you don't know me very well either. So, there should be some other reason why you came to confess to me today, right?"
"..."
