When Salma heard Connor's words, she raised her head and looked at him with shock. She didn't expect Connor to be able to see through her other motives so quickly.
"If you have anything to say, just tell me directly!"
Connor saw that Salma was hesitant to speak, so she must really have something to hide.
Salma took a deep breath and said in a low voice, "Connor, I admit that I have other motives for wanting to be with you, but I really do like you!"
"Like me?"
After Connor heard Salma's words, he couldn't help but smile faintly. He then said, "You make it sound too simple. You don't know me at all. You don't even know who I am, but you say you like me. Don't you think that's a little too hasty?"
"Haven't you heard of love at first sight?"
Salma asked excitedly.
Connor couldn't help but laugh when he heard her words. He then said lightly, "I've heard of love at first sight, but I don't really believe in it. Since you don't want to talk about yourself, then you should first listen to what happened between me and my girlfriend!"
"..."
Salma was stunned for a moment. She then lightly nodded and said, "Alright, then tell me!"
Connor organized his thoughts and then told Salma about everything that had happened since he met Freya Phillips.
When Salma found out about the relationship between Connor and Freya, she realized that she might have oversimplified the situation in her head. Connor might not have any feelings for her.
"Since you don't like me, why are you still so good to me? Why do you still want Zayn to stay away from me?" Salma asked in confusion.
"Because we are friends!"
Connor replied indifferently.
"Friends?"
After Salma heard Connor's words, she was stunned, and a trace of helplessness flashed across her eyes.
At this moment, she finally understood that all of this was just her wishful thinking.
"I've finished talking about myself. Now it's your turn to tell me about yourself, right?" Connor asked.
Salma hesitated for two seconds before saying, "Connor, I admit that I do have a good impression of you, but the reason why I confessed to you so impulsively today is also because I don't want to keep being controlled by the people in my family."
"My grandfather promised me that as long as I can be with you, he won't continue to force me to marry someone else. You can also become the future heir of our Thompson family in the future…"
"I'm not very interested in the Thompson family's affairs. Or rather, the Thompson family's affairs are nothing to me at all!" Connor replied directly.

chapters.title: Chapter 1196: Make It Up to You?
chapters.content:
Chapter 1196: Make It Up to You?
Salma couldn't help but look at Connor after hearing his words.
She could feel that when Connor said this, he was very confident. He probably wasn't bragging.
"Us knowing each other is considered fate. So even if you're not with me, I can guarantee that the Thompson Family won't continue to force you to marry anyone. You can choose to be with someone you like…"
Connor continued after seeing that Salma was quiet.
"But the person I like is you!"
Salma raised her head and looked at Connor as she exclaimed.
"You're just acting on impulse now..."
Connor helplessly replied.
"..."
Salma looked at Connor and hesitated for a couple of seconds before saying with a serious expression, "I don't care what you're thinking now. It doesn't matter if you think that I'm being impulsive or that I'm using you. I know how I feel. I won't give up easily. It doesn't matter if you have a girlfriend now. The two of you aren't married anyway. I believe I still have a chance…"
"Why…"
Connor looked at Salma, who was standing in front of him, and was speechless. He didn't know what to say.
"Forget it, think whatever you want. I can't control your thoughts anyway, but I will never fall in love with you!"
Connor said helplessly.
"Even if you don't like me, it doesn't matter. In any case, I like you…"
Salma stubbornly replied.
"Do whatever you want. It's getting late. I have to go back now…"
Connor really did not want to continue arguing with Salma about this, so he stood up and was about to leave.
"You can't leave…"
Seeing that Connor was about to leave, Salma hurriedly reached out and pulled him back.
"Salma, I've already explained everything to you. Why can't I leave?"
Connor turned to look at Salma and replied with a helpless expression.
"You rejected me in front of so many people just now and made me lose face in front of them. You have to make it up to me today…"
Salma thought for a moment and found a random excuse.
"Make it up to you?"
Connor was stunned when he heard Salma's words. He then frowned and asked, "How do you want me to make it up to you?"
"..."
Salma looked at Connor and blinked before saying softly, "Go shopping with me later. Take it as your way of making up to me…"
"I'm not in the mood to go shopping with you. I still have a lot of things to deal with!"
Connor said with a frown.
"No, you have to go shopping with me today. Otherwise, I won't let you go…"
Salma grabbed Connor's arm and shouted.
Connor looked at Salma and hesitated for a couple of seconds before saying softly, "Alright, but only for a while…"
"Okay!"
Salma nodded happily seeing that Connor had agreed.
Although Connor did not want to go, he had no choice but to go shopping with Salma to prevent her from causing trouble.
...
Connor was with Salma at a commercial plaza in Newtown for an entire afternoon. After being a slave for her for an entire afternoon, he finally escaped from Salma's clutches and returned home.
However, just as Connor entered the elevator, a pair of fair hands blocked the elevator door.
Then, a beautiful figure came in.
Connor subconsciously sized up the beauty who entered the elevator. She had exquisite facial features and was dressed seductively. She was wearing a tight black strap that perfectly outlined her breasts. Below that was a denim skirt that revealed two slender and fair legs. She was also wearing a pair of red high heels. She looked really sexy and charming.
"Connor McDonald?"
The beautiful woman called out excitedly when she saw Connor.
"What a coincidence. Did you just get off work?"
Connor replied with a smile.
The beauty who appeared in the elevator was none other than June Santoni, the beautiful neighbor that Connor had saved in Hustlers Club.
When June saw Connor, she looked a little shy.
After all, back then, Connor had seen her body. Also, there were only the two of them in the elevator at this moment, that was why she was a little shy.
"Yeah, I just got off work…"
June looked at Connor and nodded.
"Right, you should be working at Reena Satchwell's place now, right? How do you feel about the work there? Are you used to it now?"
Connor hesitated for a moment before looking at June and asking.
"It's pretty good. Miss Satchwell treats me very well and pays me a very high salary. I'm now her assistant…"
June replied nervously. Then, she looked at Connor and continued, "Connor, I really don't know how to thank you. If it weren't for you introducing me to such a good job, I wouldn't have been able to find such a job…"
"There's no need to thank me for that. It's just a piece of cake for me. You don't have to take it to heart…"
Connor said with a smile.
June looked at Connor and hesitated for a couple of seconds. Then, she asked Connor softly, "Connor, there is actually something that I have always been curious about…"
"What is it?"
Connor asked indifferently.
"Who exactly are you? Why is Miss Satchwell so good to me? I feel that I don't deserve this salary at all..."
June looked at Connor and hesitated for a few seconds before asking him seriously.
After hearing June's words, Connor smiled faintly and said softly, "Reena is my employee. I am Reena's boss!"
"What?"
When June heard Connor's words, her eyes instantly widened, and she was extremely shocked!
Ding dong!
At this moment, the elevator door opened.
When Connor saw that he had arrived, he walked out and said softly, "I'm home. If you need anything in the future, you can come and see me or give me a call..."
"Alright…"
June looked at Connor and nodded absentmindedly.
At this moment, June seemed to have not recovered from her shock.
After Connor left, he took out his key and opened the door before entering the house.
After entering, Connor saw that Rachel Wallace was still sitting on the sofa and watching TV. Her expression was particularly serious.
"Have you eaten?"
Connor hesitated for a moment and asked Rachel softly.
"No eating; losing weight!"
Rachel replied indifferently. After which, she turned and sized up Connor before softly saying, "I didn't expect you to be so charming. Salma actually took the initiative to confess to you. I'm telling you, this has nothing to do with me…"

chapters.title: Chapter 1197: Percy Juve Returns
chapters.content:
Chapter 1197: Percy Juve Returns
"How did you know?"
Connor walked to Rachel and could not help but frown as he asked.
"Salma's confession to you has caused a storm in the city. It's not weird that I know about it, right?"
Rachel said indifferently.
"Since even you know, doesn't that mean everyone in school knows?"
Connor said helplessly.
"Of course, there are already many guys in our school who want to take revenge on you. So, I advise you not to go to school for the time being. Otherwise, you will be in great danger…"
Rachel said casually.
"Rachel, can you stop joking with me? If I can't stay in Newtown University anymore, it won't do you any good…"
Connor replied helplessly, then walked back to his room.
Salma's confession had indeed affected Connor greatly. Now, all the students in Newtown University knew about this matter. Moreover, Salma had so many admirers, so Connor was definitely the target of public criticism.
Therefore, Connor had already begun to secretly consider whether he should follow Rachel's suggestion to hide for a few days and wait until the storm had passed before going to school.
Ring!
At this moment, Connor's phone suddenly rang.
Connor took out his phone and saw that it was Queta Juve calling, so he quickly picked up the call.
"Hello?"
Connor said in a low voice.
"Master, my father will return to Newtown tomorrow night!"
Queta didn't waste any time and went straight to the point.
"You'll be back tomorrow night, right?"
Connor said excitedly.
After all, Connor had been waiting for such a long time for Percy Juve's news. Now that Percy was finally back, Connor finally had something to do.
"Yes, I just got off the phone with my father. Based on my father's habits, he will definitely go to the casino when he comes back. He will usually play for a night before going home to rest," Queta whispered.
"Alright. Send me the exact location of the casino and the time your father will be back!"
Connor nodded.
"Alright!"
Queta quickly agreed and hung up.
A moment later, Connor received a message from Queta.
"What are you so happy about?"
Seeing that Connor's expression was a little off, Rachel could not help but ask him softly.
"Percy Juve is finally back!"
Connor hurriedly said to Rachel.
"Really?"
When Rachel heard Connor's words, the she became somewhat excited.
After all, what Rachel really cared about was the people who dealt with Rockefeller. She didn't really care about Connor's private matters.
"Yeah. Queta told me herself!"
Connor replied in a low voice.
...
Rachel reached out to take Connor's phone, then looked at the message on it and turned to him. "After such a long time, you have finally done something serious…"
"What do you mean? I've always been doing serious things, okay?"
Connor replied exasperatedly, then continued, "I've been waiting for Percy Juve. But he has been overseas for quite some time, so I didn't have any way to get in touch with him..."
When Rachel heard what he said, she looked at him indifferently and said softly, "According to the information I have, Percy Juve is very careful. Even if we find his exact location now, it won't be easy for us to get in touch with him. After all, every time he goes to the casino, he will go to a special room."
"Uh…"
When Connor heard Rachel's words, he appeared to be somewhat unsure.
In fact, Connor had thought about this problem before. Although he now knew the casino that Percy was going to, there were many private rooms in that casino. It was not easy for Connor to find which private room Percy was in. If he searched one by one, it would easily alert the enemy.
Connor thought about it and finally looked at Rachel.
"Why are you looking at me?"
Rachel was stunned for a moment and asked him with a puzzled tone.
"I have an idea now, but I need your help…"
Connor said with a smile.
"What is it?"
Rachel glanced at Connor indifferently and asked expressionlessly.
"Actually, it's very simple. It's not easy for me to come into contact with Percy Juve, but it's very easy for you to come into contact with him. After all, he is a very lecherous person. The two of us can go to the casino and wait for him. Then, we find a way for him to notice you. This way, he would probably take the initiative to bring you to the private room. Then, the two of us can work together from the inside and outside. What do you think?"
Connor said with a smile.
"No…"
Rachel didn't even think about it and rejected Connor's idea.
"Why?"
Connor asked with a puzzled expression.
"There's no reason. I just don't want to do it…"
Rachel looked at Connor and said indifferently.
"You don't want to deal with Percy Juve anymore? And you don't want to deal with Rockefeller either?"
Connor asked Rachel in a righteous manner.
"You know so many beautiful girls. Can't you just find one of them to help you? Why must I do it?"
Rachel pouted and said with some dissatisfaction.
"Can the young girls I know be compared to you? Be it in terms of looks or figure, they can't be compared to you. Also, you're so good at martial arts, so you definitely won't be in any danger. However, the girls I knew are all ordinary people. What if something happens?"
Connor hurriedly explained.
"Are you saying that I'm prettier than all the girls you know?"
When Rachel heard Connor's words, she could not help but blink and ask Connor with a smile.
"Of course!"
Connor nodded without thinking and continued, "You're definitely the most beautiful and sexiest woman I've ever seen. As long as you make a move, there's no man you can't handle!"
"Then, who do you think is more beautiful, me or your fiancée?"
Rachel looked at Connor and continued to ask.
"Of course, you're the one who's more beautiful…"
Connor grinned and said to Rachel.
At this moment, in order to get Rachel to help him, he could only choose to lie against his will.
"Really?"
Rachel asked with a smile.
"Of course, it's true. You're the most beautiful one in my heart!"
Connor nodded seriously.
"Hmph, that's more like it. Then, I'll help you once!"
Rachel nodded in satisfaction after hearing his answer.
Seeing that Rachel had agreed, he quickly sat down on the sofa and began to tell her the details of his plan.
Percy was really too cautious, so Connor had to make full preparations before he could find Percy.
Otherwise, if this plan failed, it would not be easy to find Percy in the future.
At this moment, Connor had a lot of information on Percy. If Connor wanted to take down Percy, it would be a very simple matter.
But Connor didn't want to do that. His real goal was to negotiate with Percy and use these things to threaten him.
As such, Connor wanted to find an opportunity to negotiate with Percy alone.
...

chapters.title: Chapter 1198: Not Sexy Enough
chapters.content:
Chapter 1198: Not Sexy Enough
The next day.
Connor did not choose to go to school because of Salma. Instead, he waited at home for an entire day.
Rachel was a woman with strong mental fortitude. Although she knew that she had to deal with Percy today, she still chose to go to class as per usual.
Rachel finally returned home at five in the afternoon.
"When do you plan to go to the casino?"
After entering the hall, Rachel put down her bag and asked Connor softly.
"He should be arriving at the casino at eight o'clock tonight. We can just go there and wait…"
Connor took out his phone to look at the time and said calmly.
"Then, let's go!"
Rachel said indifferently.
When Connor heard Rachel's words, he sized her up and said softly, "Rachel, you look like a lecturer with your current attire. You don't look like someone who's going to the casino at all. Why don't you change your clothes..."
Rachel was wearing a short skirt. Although she looked very sexy and seductive, she did not look like someone who would go to the casino, so Connor was a little worried that Percy would find out.
"Why are you so nosy? With my figure and appearance, no matter what I wear, it's enough to make those men fall head over heels for me…"
Rachel said unhappily.
"Yes, yes, yes. You look good in anything. I'm just a little worried..."
Connor hurriedly replied.
Rachel looked at Connor indifferently, then walked into her room in her high heels.
A few minutes later, Rachel walked out of the room in a white sexy spaghetti strap dress and asked Connor softly, "Is it okay now?"
Connor sized Rachel up. Her sexy figure outlined a charming curve under the spaghetti strap dress. It was as if every part of her body was emitting a fatal temptation. Her figure was enough to maximize her charm!
"It looks good, but it's not sexy enough. Can you find a more revealing set of clothes?"
Connor thought for a moment and said softly.
"Aren't you going a little too far?"
Rachel shouted at Connor angrily.
"This is really important. There must not be any mistakes. Just take it as me asking you for a favor. Go and change into another set…"
Connor said as he pushed Rachel into the room.
After Rachel entered the room, she chose for more than ten minutes and finally chose a set of clothes that she thought was the sexiest. Then, she walked out of the room and looked at Connor. "Connor, this is as far as I'm willing to go. If you continue to spout nonsense, I'm not going with you…"
When Connor heard Rachel's words, he hurriedly raised his head and glanced at her.
At this moment, Rachel's dressing was indeed very sexy. She was wearing a black tube top that was tightly wrapped around her chest. Her beautiful collarbone was exposed to the air and trembled slightly with her graceful steps.
She was wearing a miniskirt, which was very short and barely covered her round buttocks. She was wearing a pair of red high heels, and 90% of her slender and fair legs were exposed to the air.
At this moment, Rachel was a good example of what was called an alluring stunner.
Connor had seen a lot of beautiful women. Be it Yelena Allen, Mina Malone, Salma Thompson or Tiffany Zamora, they could be considered top-notch beauties, but they were still inferior to Rachel.
In Connor's heart, Rachel's beauty could only be compared to Freya Phillips.
However, the two were not the same kind of beauty. Freya Phillips was as beautiful as a fairy, while Rachel was mature and alluring.
There was no way to compare the two.
"Why aren't you saying anything? Are you still not satisfied?"
Rachel saw Connor standing there without saying a word and couldn't help but ask.
"I'm very satisfied. This time, we will definitely be able to easily get what we want!"
Connor said excitedly to Rachel.
"Hmph, that's more like it!"
Rachel nodded lightly and then walked out in her high heels. Connor followed her.
Half an hour later, Connor drove to the location Queta had sent him.
But when they arrived, Connor was dumbfounded.
Connor realized that the location Queta sent him was not a casino at all, but a commercial building!
"This is the casino you mentioned?"
After Rachel got off the car, she looked around and asked Connor with a frown.
"This is the address Queta gave me!"
Connor replied helplessly.
"Don't tell me you were tricked by Queta? After all, she's Percy's daughter…"
At this moment, Rachel began to become vigilant. After all, she was not sure if this was a plan by Queta and Percy.
"I don't think so. How could Queta be so bold?"
Connor couldn't help but mutter. Then, he took out his phone and dialed Queta's number.
Ring!
After the phone rang twice, Queta picked up the call.
"Master, what's wrong?"
Queta asked respectfully.
"Queta, I'm already at the place you mentioned, but why don't I see the casino?"
Connor questioned in a low voice.
"Mr. McDonald, my people are already waiting for you at the entrance of the building. I was afraid that my father would see me, so I didn't go there. Once you find my people, they will bring you into the casino…"
Queta hurriedly explained.
"I see!"
Connor nodded and saw a man standing at the entrance of the building.
After Connor hung up the phone, he brought Rachel to the man.
When the man saw Connor, he looked at Connor carefully and said respectfully, "Are you Mr. McDonald?"
"Are you Queta's subordinate?"
Connor asked indifferently.
"That's right, Miss Juve asked me to wait for you here!"
The man hurriedly said.
"Alright, then bring us in!"
Connor said lightly.
"Mr. McDonald, this way please!"
The man took the initiative to lead the way for Connor and Rachel.
The man brought Connor and Rachel around the building for about five minutes. Finally, they entered an office and opened the secret door.
After entering the secret door, Connor realized that it was actually an elevator.
If not for the man leading the way, Connor and Rachel would not have been able to find this place at all.
"This casino is actually so hidden?"
Connor said with a frown.
"Mr. McDonald, most of the guests who come to this casino are famous big shots in the country. These people don't want to be discovered by others, and also it prevents assassins from sneaking in. That's why the casino is located at such a discreet place."
The man hurriedly explained.

chapters.title: Chapter 1199: Wild Rose with Thorns
chapters.content:
Chapter 1199: Wild Rose with Thorns
"I see!"
Connor looked at the man and nodded without saying anything.
After entering the elevator, Connor realized that there was no button at all. In other words, even if you found this elevator, you wouldn't be able to use it.
The man took out a card and scanned it on the elevator scanning pad. Then, the elevator began to rise rapidly.
"Mr. McDonald, this is the casino's membership card. Without this card, you won't be able to use the elevator. It also prevents some people from owing money and wanting to run away. The casino will block the card. That way, there's no way to leave the casino…"
The man turned to look at Connor and took the initiative to explain.
"Which floor is the casino on?"
Connor frowned and asked.
"The 68th floor which is also the top floor of this building!"
The man replied.
"I didn't expect this casino to be so mysterious…"
Connor said lightly.
"This casino is currently the largest casino in our country!"
The man added.
A few minutes later, the elevator finally stopped.
Ding dong!
The elevator doors slowly opened.
The moment the elevator door opened, Connor heard a deafening shout.
This kind of shouting formed a very sharp contrast with the silence outside the building.
There were also sighs, women's screams, poker, slot machines, and all kinds of machines.
These voices interweaved together, making it unusually noisy.
Countless gamblers were gathered in this place. Some people could become rich overnight, while others might be billionaires before they came in and became homeless when they left.
Connor was shocked by the lively scene in the casino. Although it was not Connor's first time in a casino, such a lively casino was still very shocking.
Of course, Connor knew that this place was also the grave of countless people.
If one were to sink into this place, they would fall into a bottomless abyss and never be able to get out again.
"Mr. McDonald, we're here!"
After entering the casino, the man took the initiative to hand the membership card to Connor, then turned around and left.
After the man left, he and Rachel strolled around the casino.
Although Connor couldn't believe it at first, this place was indeed a casino, and the area was very large. This casino was obviously much more professional and larger than the casinos Connor had been to before.
There were a lot of security guards in the casino. These security guards were obviously more professional than the security guards outside.
At this moment, they were staring at the customers at the gambling table. If they found out that someone was cheating, they would rush up and catch the person immediately.
However, this kind of situation usually wouldn't happen in this casino, because the customers who could come here to play were very different from the customers of the small casinos, be it their dressing or their temperament.
From this point, it could be seen that these guests were big shots with some status, so they would not do something like cheating.
"I didn't expect that Newtown would have such a big casino…"
Connor observed the surrounding environment and couldn't help but mutter softly.
"This should be the biggest casino in Orilon. Before I came to Orilon, I've heard of this casino, but I've never been here. After all, I'm not very interested in casinos…"
Rachel replied indifferently.
"How much do you think this casino can earn in a day?"
Connor turned and glanced at Rachel before asking softly.
"You can take a look at the chips in their hands…"
Rachel replied indifferently.
When Connor heard this, he immediately looked at the gambling table.
The chips in the hands of those gamblers all started at 10,000 dollars.
This also meant that just a hundred chips could be worth millions, not to mention that some people might have bigger chips in their hands.
"I wonder who the boss of this casino is. He's actually so powerful to have opened such a big casino..."
Connor could not help but sigh softly.
"If my information is correct, the boss of this casino is Yaakov Ward, the person in charge of Rockefeller in Orilon. No one else has the ability to open such a big casino…"
Rachel softly replied.
"Another Rockefeller?"
Connor was somewhat gloomy. At this moment, he finally understood how terrifying Rockefeller's strength was. Rockefeller's business seemed to have infiltrated into all walks of life. They had always been influencing the lives of ordinary people.
The guests who came here were all famous people in Orilon.
Therefore, the connections that Rockefeller had accumulated in this casino alone were quite terrifying.
"Do you know how terrifying Rockefeller is now?"
Rachel turned look at Connor and asked him softly.
"It is indeed quite terrifying…"
Connor replied in a low voice and then continued, "Alright, let's do as we have planned and split up…"
"Okay!"
Rachel gently nodded before turning around and leaving.
After Connor and Rachel parted ways, they exchanged some chips and pretended to be gamblers in the casino.
Rachel was not very interested in gambling, so she only exchanged 100,000 dollars in chips. Then, she found a table and quietly watched the gamblers crazily place their bets. She would throw out some chips from time to time.
Regardless of whether it was her looks or figure, Rachel could be considered the best of the best.
In addition, she was dressed very sexily today, which instantly attracted the attention of countless people. Many men took the initiative to talk to Rachel. However, without exception, regardless of whether they were rich second-generation heirs or even famous big shots in Orilon, anyone who tried to talk to her would be mercilessly rejected by her.
Rachel sat there quietly, giving people the feeling that she was like a wild rose with thorns.
It made one's heart itch, but they didn't know where to start.
After all, the boss of this casino had a terrifying background. No one dared to cause trouble here.
Moreover, they all knew that Rachel was able to enter this casino, which was enough to show that her identity and background were definitely not simple.
They came here to win money, not to find women.
Therefore, when they were rejected by Rachel, they did not pester her too much and chose to leave.

chapters.title: Chapter 1200: Hostess
chapters.content:
Chapter 1200: Hostess
In order to not attract the attention of others, Connor exchanged for thirty million in chips in the hall.
Such an amount was indeed not something that ordinary people could afford.
Connor exchanged thirty million chips in one go. He was already considered a very good customer in this casino.
Therefore, the lobby manager hurriedly arranged a very hot hostess for Connor.
The most basic job of a hostess in a casino was to be by the customer's side, to help serve drinks and cheer the person on.
If the customer was interested, he could take advantage of her. He could kiss or touch her.
However, if he wanted to go further, he would have to discuss it with the beauty.
If the beauty agreed, then you two can open a private room here. If the beauty did not agree, then the person could only endure it or get another hostess.
"How should I address you, sir?"
A charming and elegant beauty in a mini skirt walked to Connor and asked him softly.
Connor was initially not interested in this kind of hostess. After all, Connor did not come here to play with women today. He had serious matters to do.
However, if Connor sent this beauty away now, it might attract the attention of others, which would be even more disadvantageous.
"I'm McDonald!"
Connor looked at the beauty in front of him and replied indifferently.
The beauty standing in front of him at this moment was actually quite good in terms of appearance and figure. There was a natural seductive aura on her body.
If it were in Newtown University, she would definitely be the school belle. Her temperament, appearance, and figure were comparable to a beauty like Sonia Dobson.
"Hello, Mr. McDonald. I'm a staff member of the casino. If you have any questions, you can ask me at any time!"
The beautiful woman smiled and said to Connor.
When Connor heard the beautiful woman's words, he carefully sized up the beautiful woman and then asked softly, "What's your name?"
"You can just call me Trixie!"
The beauty replied softly.
No one would use their real name in such a job.
Therefore, Connor didn't say anything else after hearing the beautiful woman's answer.
"Then, what services can you provide me?"
At this moment, Connor pretended to be a normal gambler. He sized up Trixie with a playful expression and asked with a smile.
"Mr. McDonald, I can only accompany you as you play. As for other businesses, it's not within the range of my job scope. Of course, if you need something else, I can introduce my friends to you. They may accept some special requests!"
It seemed that this was not the first time Trixie had encountered such a situation, so she spoke very calmly and naturally.
After all, they were in this casino. If they didn't agree, no one would dare to force them.
"Hehe, are you trying to push away the business that's at your doorstep? Why don't you want to earn money?"
Connor asked Trixie with a smile.
"..."
When Trixie heard Connor's words, she could not help but frown. Then, she said softly, "I'm different from them. Although I'm here for money, there are some things I can do and some things I can't. I hope you can understand!"
"Well, aren't you an upright one?"
Connor said softly as he sized up Trixie.
"You can see it that way too!"
Trixie did not seem to want to talk too much about this with Connor. She replied softly and continued, "Mr. McDonald, if you're not satisfied with my service, I can help you get a replacement now!"
"If you keep doing this, can you earn money?"
Connor asked Trixie in confusion.
Trixie seemed to hesitate for a moment and couldn't help but say, "Mr. McDonald, most of the guests come here to gamble. If they really want to find a woman, they can go somewhere else."
"That's true!"
Connor nodded with a smile and then continued, "Then, bring me around the casino!"
"Mr. McDonald, don't you want some else?"
Trixie seemed to be a little surprised when she heard Connor's words. She asked Connor in disbelief.
"There's no need for that. I came here to gamble…"
Connor calmly replied and then walked ahead.
Trixie couldn't help but hesitate for a couple of seconds, then she hurriedly followed Connor.
"Mr. McDonald, what do you want to play today? Our casino can provide a lot of entertainment…"
Trixie took the initiative to ask Connor.
Connor was simply observing the surrounding environment. At this time, Rachel was at the entrance of the casino.
Therefore, as long as it was a guest who entered the casino, they would be able to see Rachel, this stunning beauty.
Connor hesitated for a moment before choosing a table on the left of Rachel.
This was because not only could he observe Rachel from this position, but he could also observe the entrance of the casino.
"Let's play this!"
Connor didn't even think and found a chair to sit down.
Trixie stood quietly beside Connor and patiently asked him if he wanted to drink anything, but Connor refused.
Although Connor had been hiding it from the beginning, Trixie still had some understanding of normal gamblers after having been a hostess for quite some time.
Therefore, Trixie could feel that Connor was a little different from the other customers, but she couldn't tell what the difference was.
Connor's temperament was rather strange.
Connor was at a rectangular gambling table. Everyone was shaking the dice to determine the winner.
As this method of gambling was relatively old, there were not many gamblers here. Most of the customers liked to play some of the more novel or popular gambling games.
Gambling methods such as shaking the dice to compare the number on the dice were really old. Moreover, there was no technical content to it. It was completely based on luck, so it was not very popular.
There were only three or four people around Connor who kept placing bets.

chapters.title: Chapter 1201: Addicted
chapters.content:
Chapter 1201: Addicted
Connor observed the state of these people and it was apparent that they must have lost money elsewhere, which was why they wanted to try their luck here.
He casually picked up a few chips and threw them directly onto the table.
After throwing the chips, he continued to observe the situation inside the casino.
At this moment, Connor gave the impression of being completely absent-minded, as if he didn't care about winning or losing.
Beside him, Trixie stood quietly, and she seemed even more curious in her heart because she could sense that he didn't seem to be here to gamble at all.
Amidst the sighs and screams of countless people, an hour quickly passed.
His luck was still quite good today. Just by rolling the dice, he won over a hundred thousand dollars.
He was also very generous and tipped Trixie nearly ten thousand dollars.
She hadn't done anything from beginning to end, just standing quietly beside Connor, yet she received over ten thousand dollars in tips, leaving the surrounding hostesses dumbfounded.
These people were extremely envious of her and secretly lamented why they didn't have such good luck to encounter such a wealthy client.
But after receiving this money, Trixie didn't feel too surprised because she thought Connor might be a rich heir from a prominent family. He was here just to kill time, so this amount of money meant nothing to him.
On the other hand, Rachel's expression at this moment was very unpleasant. She had a look of impatience when faced with people who approached her for conversation.
The reason was simple. She had just exchanged one hundred thousand dollars in chips at the casino, but in less than half an hour, she had already lost most of her chips.
Although she didn't particularly like gambling, she was a very strong-willed woman.
She was very serious about everything she did, and she couldn't accept the fact that she was inferior to others.
After understanding the rules of the game, Rachel felt that she could easily dominate other gamblers.
But she might not know that gambling is not purely based on skill; it mostly depends on luck.
When she saw that she had very few chips left, she got up and planned to exchange for more chips.
But just at that moment, a large group of people rushed in from the entrance of the casino.
Connor immediately focused his attention on these people.
However, what surprised him was that the person leading the group was not Percy, but rather the middle-aged man who had been silently following behind the group with sunglasses was Percy.
Connor understood that this should be his way of diversion.
After all, when so many people entered together, everyone would naturally pay attention to the middle-aged man in the front, and the others would be assumed to be his bodyguards, attracting no attention.
If he hadn't seen Percy's picture before, he wouldn't have recognized him among the crowd.
After entering the casino, Percy and his group briefly observed the environment inside and, once they confirmed there were no issues, continued walking forward.
At this moment, Rachel hadn't even noticed that Percy and his group had come in. Holding the newly exchanged chips, she elegantly walked toward the gambling table in her high heels.
Seeing this scene, Connor couldn't help but shake his head, feeling sorry for her unreliability. She had become so engrossed in playing that she had forgotten about the real purpose.
And Rachel happened to pass by Percy and his group, without even giving him a glance.
Because Percy was just a few steps away from Rachel, he immediately noticed this stunning beauty.
But he Percy didn't say anything and continued to follow the group towards the VIP area.
Upon seeing Percy entering the VIP area, Connor's expression showed a hint of helplessness, as he felt that his mission today might fail.
However, just as Percy was about to enter the VIP area, he suddenly stopped and turned around to look at Rachel, who was sitting at the gambling table, intensely focused on the poker game. He revealed a playful smile.
"Mr. Percy, should I go and bring that woman over?" one of Percy's bodyguards immediately understood his intention and whispered to him.
"No need to hurry, let's observe first," he calmly replied, then stepped into the VIP area.
On the other side, Connor's expression became even more helpless upon seeing him directly enter the VIP area.
He took out his phone and sent a text message to Rachel, intending to inform her that the mission had failed and they could leave now.
But after she glanced at the message, she directly replied with a "wait a little longer" and continued to focus on the gambling table.
Seeing that she showed no intention of leaving, Connor's expression became even more speechless.
Because he felt that Rachel was clearly addicted to gambling and had no intention of leaving at all.
"If I had known, I wouldn't have brought this woman along..." Connor couldn't help muttering in his heart, then collected his chips and said to Trixie, "Alright, let's go change to another table to play!"
"Okay!" Trixie quickly agreed and followed Connor as they left.
He felt that since today's mission had already failed, there was no need for him to continue sitting at the entrance waiting.
So he started strolling around the casino with Trixie. Whenever there was a gambling table he could participate in, he would go and play a few rounds.
But it seemed that his luck wasn't as good as when he rolled the dice. In less than ten minutes, he had lost more than half of his money.
However, what surprised Trixie was that after losing this money, he seemed completely unaffected, as if it had no connection to him whatsoever.
She had worked in the casino for quite some time and had seen all kinds of wealthy clients, no matter how rich they were.
But it was the first time she had encountered someone like Connor, who could lose millions and remain unfazed.
Moreover, he never stayed at a single gambling table for too long. After playing a few rounds, he would turn around and leave, regardless of whether he was winning or losing.
Furthermore, even after losing so much money, he would still give her a tip when he won.
She had never encountered a customer like this before.

chapters.title: Chapter 1202: Trixie's Story
chapters.content:
Chapter 1202: Trixie's Story
"Mr. Connor, I see that you're not having much luck today. Maybe you shouldn't play anymore..."
Trixie seemed somewhat reluctant as she quietly advised Connor.
After hearing her words, he couldn't help but smile faintly and replied softly, "If I don't play, then why don't you go and collect tips? Don't you want to earn money? Logically speaking, shouldn't people like you hope to see me continue playing?"
"I've already earned enough tips, and it's just that I feel you don't need to continue playing like this. These days, I've seen too many people like you who have lost everything here..."
Trixie whispered back.
Upon hearing her words, he couldn't help but size her up.
He could sense that the young girl standing in front of him had her own untold hardships, which was why she had come to work here.
Otherwise, she would never have spoken those words to him.
"Why did you come to work here?"
He hesitated for a moment and asked her softly.
"Why did I come to work here?"
Upon hearing his question, she couldn't help but pause for a moment, then said lightly, "Actually, many customers have asked me this question. The purpose of me working here is quite simple - it's just for money!"
"Are you in desperate need of money?"
He continued to ask.
"I am in desperate need of money!" she replied without any hesitation, nodding slightly.
"Why do you need money?" he asked.
"There are many reasons for needing money. After all, how many people in this world dare to say that they don't need money?"
Trixie looked at Connor and gave a faint smile, speaking in a calm tone.
Upon hearing her words, he became even more curious about the girl in front of him.
So he directly took out some chips, placed them in front of her, and said expressionlessly, "Since I have nothing else to do, tell me your story. As long as I find it fascinating, all these chips are yours..."
Upon seeing the chips that he took out, her expression appeared somewhat surprised. She then whispered, "Rich people are different. They spend so much money just to listen to a story?"
"Yes, even if I don't give them to you, I would have lost all these chips anyway. It's better to use them to listen to a story..." he replied with a smile.
"But aren't you worried that I might just come up with a story to deceive you? You should know that I've heard many heartbreaking stories here. My friends can easily come up with a dozen different life stories..."
While observing Connor, she spoke calmly.
"It's okay, as long as you make me feel touched by the story, then all this money is yours..." he said lightly.
She stared at him for two seconds, then said softly, "Alright, since you want to hear it, I'll tell you..."
Connor looked at Trixie in front of him without saying a word.
"Actually, before coming here, my family's conditions were quite good. My father ran an import-export company, and the company was doing well. Although we couldn't compare with the truly wealthy, it was already quite good compared to ordinary people."
"But just two years ago, my father came to this casino with his friends and fell into this abyss. At first, my father may have been able to control himself, but as he lost more and more money, he had no mood to manage the company's business. Moreover, he became deeply entangled in this casino. So, in less than half a year, my father squandered all of our family's assets and ended up with a huge gambling debt..."
Trixie looked at Connor in front of her and calmly said, "And so, to help my father repay those gambling debts, I came here to work, right? Your story doesn't seem very exciting! It's a bit cliché..."
After listening to her words, he couldn't help but smile faintly and said softly, "So you came here to work to help your father repay those debts? Your story doesn't seem very exciting! It's a bit cliché..."
She looked at him calmly and continued, "Because of the massive gambling debt, my father was eventually beaten into a vegetative state by the people from the casino. My mother couldn't bear to see them kill my father like that, so she started working to earn money. At first, my mother had to work three jobs a day, but the money she earned was not enough to repay the debts. Later, my mother became a hostess..."
"And then?" he asked, looking at her.
"At that time, I was still in school. When I found out that my mother had become a hostess, I couldn't accept that fact. I even didn't contact my mother for a long time until she fell seriously ill, and I learned the truth!" Trixie paused for a moment and continued, "When I found out that my mother did it to repay the debt, I approached the people from the casino and voluntarily started working here. I used all the money I earned to repay my father's debt because earning money here is the easiest way..."
Connor didn't say a word while looking at her.
She remained calm, looking expressionless at Connor, and asked, "What do you think of my story?"
"It's alright," he replied with a smile. Then he pushed the chips toward her and said softly, "Now all these chips are yours!"
"Thank you!" She didn't hesitate at all and reached out to take the chips he handed over.
Connor then stood up and walked forward. He didn't want to know if what Trixie said was true or not.
Because he felt it was unnecessary. He could sense that Trixie was hiding a secret, but whether that secret was the one she just mentioned, he wasn't sure.
In his eyes, Trixie was just a stranger.
After today, they might never meet again.
And he couldn't possibly have any intersection with her, so he didn't want to dwell too much on her matters.
On the other side, Percy's men had been observing Rachel for nearly ten minutes.
They noticed that Rachel had been sitting at the gambling table, focusing all her attention on the cards in her hands, and she didn't have any friends with her.
So they believed Rachel was still very safe and just an ordinary gambler.
After the bodyguard briefly described the situation to Percy, he seemed to think there was no problem. Therefore, he signaled his bodyguard to bring her over.

chapters.title: Chapter 1203: Beauty Trap
chapters.content:
Chapter 1203: Beauty Trap
Percy was capable enough to become the person in charge of Rockefeller in Newtown.
And he was always very careful in his work.
Although he liked gambling, he only went to this casino because it belonged to Rockefeller.
He liked women, but before he approached a woman, he would do everything possible to investigate her and make sure she posed no threat to him before making a move.
But today, Rachel was clearly an exception. He only observed her briefly and did not investigate her true identity.
Because at this moment, he was clearly infatuated with her, so he couldn't wait to investigate her information.
The bodyguard walked up to Rachel and asked in a low voice, "Hello, beautiful lady!"
Upon hearing the bodyguard's words, her eyes flashed with a hint of arrogance.
But her expression remained calm, and she didn't even glance at the bodyguard, casually saying, "What's the matter? Spit it out, don't bother me while I'm playing cards..."
"Miss, our boss would like to meet you. Are you available?" the bodyguard politely asked Rachel.
"Not available!"
Although she knew that the person was Percy's man, she didn't directly accept. On the contrary, she refused directly.
"Miss, here are five million chips. As long as you meet our boss, these chips will be yours!" The bodyguard knew that Rachel wouldn't be interested unless there was something sweet in it, so he directly placed the chips he had prepared in front of Rachel.
When she saw the chips presented by the bodyguard, her facial expression instantly changed.
After all, she was an award-winning actress, and she had no problem dealing with such situations.
"Are you sure you're giving me all these chips?" Rachel asked the bodyguard with a slightly excited expression.
"Of course!" The bodyguard lightly nodded as he looked at her.
"Alright, where is your boss? Take me to him!" Rachel pretended to be a money-oriented woman and directly collected the chips in front of her. Then she stood up, ready to follow the bodyguard.
Seeing her enthusiasm, the bodyguard couldn't help but inwardly sigh that she must be a materialistic woman with outstanding looks.
And such women were often the easiest to handle because all you needed to do was offer enough money to play with them as you pleased.
The bodyguard took the initiative and led Rachel towards the VIP area.
"What kind of person is your boss? How can he enter the VIP area..." Rachel asked the bodyguard with surprise after seeing him enter the VIP area.
Upon hearing her question, the bodyguard couldn't help but smile faintly and said softly, "Don't worry, you'll find out soon..."
"Alright, making it so mysterious..." she replied casually and continued to follow behind the bodyguard.
At the same time, Connor also saw Rachel following the bodyguard into the VIP area.
Rachel even glanced back at him and gave him a seductive look.
Seeing her entering the VIP area, he became excited.
Because he initially thought their plan had failed, but he never expected her to succeed.
However, what Rachel didn't expect was that in order to enter the VIP area, she would need to undergo a body search. All electronic devices had to be surrendered.
On the other hand, Connor and Rachel had planned that when she entered the private room where Percy was located and then send the room number to Connor, who would then enter.
But if Rachel had to surrender her phone, she wouldn't be able to contact Connor.
"Later, I might receive a call from a friend. Can I not surrender my phone?"
She hesitated for a moment, then whispered to the bodyguard.
"Sorry, miss, but we have rules in the casino. Any guest entering the VIP area must surrender their phone. If you have any unfinished business, you can take care of it before entering..."
The expressionless bodyguard replied to her.
Upon hearing the bodyguard's words, her eyes showed a hint of helplessness.
She took out her phone, walked aside, and sent a text message directly to Connor.
The content of the message was very simple.
"Wait for me outside!"
After sending the message, she deleted it and handed over her phone.
After handing over her phone, she followed the bodyguard into a private room.
Inside the private room were seven people, four men and three women.
Except for Percy, the other three men were accompanied by beautiful women.
She also noticed that the people in the private room were all influential figures in the province, with each of them possibly worth over billions.
Percy briefly chatted with Rachel, and in the end, he requested her to accompany him for the night at a price of twenty million.
Knowing that Connor couldn't enter under the current circumstances, Rachel could only wait until Percy took her to the hotel before taking action.
After some bargaining, she settled on a price of thirty million.
Spending thirty million just to sleep with a woman, only Percy could do such a thing.
She was very clever. Although she had been accompanying Percy, she didn't allow Percy to take advantage of her and maintained a distance.
And he felt that she was not a prostitute, and it was her first time doing such a thing, so naturally, she was a bit shy.
So he wasn't too impatient, especially since the price had already been negotiated.
It was still early now, and when they arrived at the hotel, he could do whatever he wanted.
...
On the other side, after receiving Rachel's message, Connor understood the situation.
So he casually made an excuse to separate from Tessa, then left the casino alone.
After leaving the casino, Connor directly called Queta and asked for Percy's license plate number.
Connor knew that since he couldn't enter the VIP area, and Rachel asked him to wait outside.
It was definitely planned for him to follow Percy's car to the hotel and then take action against Percy.
So after finding Percy's car, he hid in a corner and began to wait.
After about an hour, Rachel and Percy finally left the casino and walked directly towards Percy's car.
Rachel's ample bosom trembled slightly as she walked with a graceful posture, her enchanting figure exuding endless charm, coupled with her captivating face.
Any normal man would be tempted upon seeing her in such attire.

chapters.title: Chapter 1204: The Anxious Percy
chapters.content:
Chapter 1204: The Anxious Percy
"Mr. Percy, where are you planning to take me now?"
Rachel turned her head and looked at Percy with a seductive expression as she asked.
"To the hotel!"
Percy replied calmly and then glanced up and down at Rachel. After silently cursing her in his heart, he opened the car door and got in.
After hesitating for a moment, she followed him and got into the car as well.
A few minutes later, Percy and his companions started the car and drove towards the street ahead.
Meanwhile, Connor ran to the side of the road and hailed a taxi.
"Young man, where do you want to go?"
The taxi driver asked Connor with a smile as he got in the car.
"Driver, please follow the Bentley in front as closely as possible without being noticed!"
Connor pointed at Percy's car and said seriously to the taxi driver.
"Young man, are you a police officer?"
The taxi driver turned his head and looked at Connor, asking nervously.
"No, I'm not a police officer. My wife got into that car with a guy, and I want to see if she's cheating on me..."
Connor explained helplessly.
"Alright, I understand..."
The taxi driver showed a sympathetic expression and started the car.
"Young man, they're driving a Bentley. Even if you catch them, what can you do? I think you'd better give up quickly. You're not on the same level as them..."
The taxi driver turned his head and looked at Connor, advising him with a serious tone.
"I'm unwilling to give up just like that..."
Connor said helplessly.
"Ah, you young people nowadays..."
The taxi driver sighed helplessly as he looked at Connor, and then he didn't say anything more, driving quietly.
Usually, taxi drivers were experienced drivers, so their driving skills were unquestionable.
Moreover, taxis were very common, so Percy's people wouldn't notice that there was a taxi following them all along.
After about twenty minutes, Percy's car stopped in front of a Shangri-La hotel.
This hotel was definitely one of the most famous hotels.
Connor asked the taxi driver to stop the car by the roadside and got out alone.
Originally, he intended to pay the taxi fare, but the taxi driver refused to accept it when he saw how pitiful Connor looked.
In the end, Connor didn't say much because he didn't have the mood to argue with the taxi driver over such things. He simply walked towards the location of the hotel.
On the other side, Rachel followed Percy and went straight to the top floor of the Shangri-La hotel.
If Percy wanted to find a lover outside, he would definitely not bring her back home.
Because he worked for Rockefeller, he had to make sure his personal information wouldn't be exposed.
So at this moment, he used fake names when talking to Rachel.
"Darling, you are so tempting. Hurry up and take off your clothes. I can't wait any longer..."
After entering the room, Percy's true nature was completely revealed as he pounced directly towards Rachel's position.
But she easily dodged his attack and coquettishly said, "Mr. Percy, don't be so impatient. I haven't taken a bath yet..."
"It's already this late, why are you still taking a bath?"
Percy shouted excitedly at Rachel.
"Ah, I just want to take a bath. It's still early, and we have plenty of time. Why are you in such a hurry?" she said with a charming expression.
...
Percy looked her up and down, then lustfully said, "How about we take a bath together?"
"No, I'll feel embarrassed. Just wait for me here obediently. I'll come out soon..."
She quickly stopped him and then turned and entered the bathroom.
After seeing her enter the bathroom, he could only lie on the bed alone, boredly playing with his phone.
Meanwhile, in the bathroom, she turned on the shower to the maximum and took out her phone, sending the room number to Connor.
Connor, who had been waiting downstairs in the hotel, received Rachel's message and went straight upstairs.
A few minutes later, he arrived at the door of the suite where Rachel and Percy were. He sent a text message to Rachel.
After seeing the message, Rachel came out of the bathroom.
"Darling, why haven't you taken a bath yet?"
Percy looked puzzled when he saw Rachel come out, furrowing his brow and asking.
But she completely ignored Percy's words, directly walked toward the door, and opened it with her hand.
Upon seeing her open the door, Percy suddenly felt that something was wrong.
So he quickly took out his phone, wanting to make a call for help.
But she wouldn't give him that chance. With a gentle wave of her hand, she threw a lipstick directly at Percy's wrist.
Although it was just an ordinary lipstick, it had remarkable power in Rachel's hands.
The lipstick hit his wrist, and he felt as if he had been shot by a bullet, letting out a scream.
In the next second, Connor rushed into the room and kicked him in the chest.
Only now did Percy finally realize what was happening.
Rachel calmly closed the door, then sat on a chair without saying a word.
Connor firmly stepped on his chest with his foot, preventing him from moving.
It's important to note that Connor was a martial artist, and Rachel was a profound-rank martial artist.
While Percy was just an ordinary person, so he had no chance of resistance in this confined room.
Percy stared at Connor in front of him and asked in a low voice, "Who are you guys? Tell me, how much money do you want? I can give it to you now!"
He could sense Connor's extraordinary skills, and naturally, Rachel was not an ordinary person either. So he had no intention of resisting and instead voluntarily offered money to Connor.
"Hello, Mr. Percy!" Connor smiled and replied to Percy.
Upon hearing his words, Percy froze in place, his expression incredibly incredulous.
This indicated that Connor knew his identity.

chapters.title: Chapter 1205: The First Task
chapters.content:
Chapter 1205: The First Task
"Do you know who I am?"
Percy's expression showed some astonishment, and he asked Connor in a very incredulous tone.
"Of course, I know. You're the person in charge of Rockefeller in Newtown!"
Connor said calmly.
After hearing Connor's words, Percy's expression seemed even more nervous. He never expected that Connor would know that he was affiliated with Rockefeller.
If Connor came to him as the person in charge of Rockefeller, it meant that the situation was not as simple as he had imagined, and it was definitely not a problem that could be solved with money.
Percy instinctively glanced at Rachel's position and then frowned as he asked, "Who are you two? What do you want?"
"Mr. Percy, don't be so nervous. I'm not here to kill you!"
Connor chuckled and continued, "Let me introduce myself. My name is Connor. You should be familiar with that name, right?"
"Con... Connor?"
Upon hearing this name, Percy was dumbfounded, and his expression was filled with disbelief.
Because that name was too familiar to him.
After all, currently, Connor was possibly the biggest threat to Rockefeller.
Almost everyone in the upper echelons of Rockefeller knew the name Connor!
"That's right, I am Connor!"
Connor nodded gently while looking at Percy.
"What do you want from me?"
His gaze was evasive, unsure of Connor's intentions.
"First, let me show you something..."
As Connor spoke, he took out a document from his pocket and threw it in front of Percy.
After hesitating for a moment, he picked up the document in front of him.
As he looked at the contents of the document, his whole person was dumbfounded.
He stared at Connor with an expression of incredulity and asked, "Where did you get these things?"
This document contained all the evidence of Percy's crimes.
Although it was only a part of it, even this small portion was enough to ruin Percy!
If Connor were to hand over this document to the police, Percy would have to spend at least a dozen years behind bars.
"Where I got this document from has nothing to do with you. I have many more pieces of evidence like this. If I were to hand over all this evidence, do you know what fate awaits you better than me?"
Connor said with a smile, looking at Percy.
"What do you want to do? Are you planning to make me help you deal with Rockefeller?"
Percy asked Connor with great excitement.
"Help me deal with Rockefeller?"
After hearing Percy's words, Connor couldn't help but sneer and said casually, "Mr. Percy, you're just a small person in Newtown. If I wanted you to help me deal with Rockefeller, wouldn't that be too naive of me..."
"Then what do you want?"
Percy asked, taken aback.
"What I want is very simple. From now on, you do whatever I tell you to do. I need you to do what I want. Do you understand?"
Connor said with a smile, looking at Percy.
After hearing his words, Percy finally realized that Connor intended to use this evidence to threaten him.
"I won't betray Rockefeller!" he said firmly to Connor.
"Well then, let's see if Rockefeller's people will still help you once you're caught!"
Connor moved his foot aside and turned to walk out of the room.
Percy never expected that Connor would be so confident. He was afraid that Connor would really hand over the evidence to the police.
After all, if this document fell into the hands of the police, he would be left with no way out.
"Wait!" he hurriedly shouted.
Connor slowly turned his head and looked at Percy, then asked with a playful expression, "What's wrong? Have you changed your mind?"
"Connor, how much money do you need? I can pay to buy the evidence from you!"
Percy gritted his teeth and asked him in a low voice.
Upon hearing his words, Connor's expression on his face seemed somewhat disdainful. He then said lightly, "You should know what kind of person I am. Do you think I'm the kind of person who lacks money?"
"Then what do you want?" Percy shouted.
"I've already made it very clear just now. From now on, I'll have you do whatever I say!"
Connor said expressionlessly to him.
"If I'm discovered by Rockefeller's people that I betrayed them, then I'll be left with no way out!"
Percy gritted his teeth and shouted at Connor in a low voice.
"If I hand over all this evidence, do you think you can still survive?"
"If you agree to cooperate with me right now, there might still be a glimmer of hope for you. But if you don't agree, then you're left with no way out. Do you understand what I mean?"
Connor smiled and said to Percy.
He hesitated for two seconds as he looked at Connor in front of him, then asked in a low voice, "If I cooperate with you, what will I gain?"
"Gain?"
Connor couldn't help but smile helplessly when he heard this question. Then he said lightly, "Percy, haven't you figured out the situation yet? Do you think you still have the qualifications to negotiate terms with me?"
Percy instantly became speechless as he looked at Connor in front of him, sitting dumbfounded in place, not knowing what to do.
"Have you considered it?"
Connor looked at Percy up and down, smiled, and asked.
"It seems like I don't have any other choice now!"
Percy took a deep breath and replied to Connor in a low voice.
"Seems like you're a smart person, Mr. Percy..."
Connor smiled, then took Percy's phone and dialed his own number.
"I've noted down your phone number. When I need it, I'll call you. Don't change your number easily, you know?"
Connor said softly to Percy.
"Okay, I understand!"
Now that Percy's criminal evidence is in Connor's hands, he doesn't dare to resist at all and can only nod helplessly.
"Also, your first task is to find a way for me to meet Yaakov, the person in charge of Rockefeller in the Orilon!"
Connor calmly looked at Percy and said.

chapters.title: Chapter 1206: Do You Have a Boyfriend?
chapters.content:
Chapter 1206: Do You Have a Boyfriend?
Percy looked at Connor's expression, shocked. He said in a low voice, "Are you planning to use me to see Yaakov Ward?"
"That's right. Yaakov Ward's identity is too mysterious. I couldn't find any information about him, so I could only find him through you!"
Connor looked at Percy and said calmly.
"It is not that easy to meet with Yaakov Ward…"
Percy shook his head helplessly.
Connor was stunned for a moment and asked in a puzzled tone, "What do you mean?"
"Yaakov is a very mysterious person. Even I have never seen him before since he only contacts us through emails. I don't even have his contact information, so it's impossible for you to find him through me!" Percy said in a low voice.
After Connor heard Percy's words, a trace of surprise flashed across his eyes. He did not expect Yaakov to be even more careful than Percy was.
Although he was shocked, Connor also knew that Percy and Yaakov were both Rockefeller's men, so Percy definitely had a way to find Yaakov. "I don't care what methods you use, but I have to see Yaakov within a month. Otherwise, you can just wait to go to jail!"
"Connor, I really can't find Yaakov. You're threatening me!" Percy shouted angrily when he heard Connor's words.
"That's right. You only have one month!"
Connor said to Percy with a smile.
"You…"
Percy was completely speechless after hearing Connor's words. He looked at Connor with a dull gaze, not knowing what to do.
"Let's go!"
Connor said to Rachel.
Rachel looked at Percy indifferently, then stood up and followed Connor out of the room.
Percy sat on the bed alone. His expression was unusually angry, but he could do nothing about it.
All the evidence he had was now in Connor's hands.
Once Connor handed over the evidence, then he would really only have a dead end.
Therefore, Percy only had one choice now, and that was to follow Connor's request and do everything he could to help Connor meet Yaakov.
At this moment, the biggest doubt in Percy's heart was where Connor got the evidence!
He would never have thought that his daughter, Queta, was the one who had given the evidence to Connor.
…
After Connor and Rachel left the hotel, Rachel turned her head to look at Connor and then whispered to Connor, "Your attitude towards Percy was a little too strong just now. Aren't you afraid that Percy will jump out of desperation?"
"Desperate?"
After Connor heard this, he couldn't help but smile faintly. Then, he said, "Percy doesn't have the ability to do anything desperate. I have something on him, but he doesn't have anything on me. Therefore, he can only do everything he can to help me meet with Yaakov..."
Rachel hesitated for a moment before continuing. "But I feel that Percy wasn't lying just now. He might really not be able to see Yaakov…"
"Although he might not be able to meet with Yaakov now, I believe he definitely has a way to do it!" Connor replied.
"But what if Percy really can't see Yaakov?"
Rachel asked.
"Then we can only take it one step at a time. I can't overthink things now…" Connor said helplessly.
Rachel blinked, then said. "Alright, enough of that. I'm hungry. Treat me to a meal!"
"Alright, just tell me what you want to eat. It's my treat today…" Connor said with a smile.
"Oh my, why are you suddenly being so generous today?" Rachel asked in surprise.
"It's all thanks to you today. If you hadn't insisted on staying there, I might have left long ago. How did you know that Percy's people were observing you?" Connor asked Rachel curiously.
"From the moment Percy saw me, I knew that he was definitely very interested in me. However, he was worried that I had some ulterior motives, so he did not come to contact me immediately. Instead, he got someone to observe me for a period of time. Their little tricks are like child's play in front of me. You're the only one who couldn't see through them…"
Rachel explained indifferently.
After Connor heard Rachel's words, he couldn't help but admire her inwardly; after all, he hadn't noticed these details at all.
Connor was even more curious about who Rachel was now. He felt that Rachel seemed to be proficient in many skills that ordinary people could not master, not to mention that these skills were also very difficult for ordinary people to come into contact with.
"How is it? Do you admire me?" Rachel asked with a smile.
"What is there to admire about this kind of thing? You have the things you're good at, and I have the things I'm good at. There's nothing to admire…" Connor replied stubbornly.
"Then can you tell me what you're good at? Your skills and your academic results are definitely not as good as mine. After all, I'm your lecturer. Your looks are definitely not as good as mine either. You don't seem to be able to do anti-reconnaissance too…"
Rachel didn't hold back at all and attacked him very directly.
"I'm richer than you!"
Connor said to Rachel expressionlessly.
"What else do you have besides money?"
Rachel seemed to be somewhat unconvinced.
"I have a girlfriend. Do you have a boyfriend?" Connor continued.
"You…"
After Rachel heard Connor's words, she was instantly stunned on the spot, and the expression on her face was abnormally speechless.
"Is there anything else you want to say?"
Connor asked Rachel with a smile.
"I'm hungry. I want to eat hotpot!"
Rachel shouted, changing the topic.
"Alright, let's go eat hotpot then!"
Connor nodded and then reached out to flag down a taxi.
…
It was past one in the morning when the two of them finished their hotpot and then returned home.
After arriving home, Rachel lay on the sofa and watched TV while Connor went back to the bedroom to rest.
He had an important matter to attend to later in the day. What he needed to do now was to quietly wait for Percy to find Yaakov and then meet with him.
Connor picked up his phone and dialed Freya's number. After asking about the situation on her side, he hung up.
Ever since Freya went to the U.S, Connor would call her every night. This way, he could confirm that there was nothing wrong with her.
Otherwise, Connor would have been worried that Camila Yearwood might have left Freya in America.
..

chapters.title: Chapter 1207: The Mixed-Blooded Beauty
chapters.content:
Chapter 1207: The Mixed-Blooded Beauty
The next day, at eight o'clock in the morning.
Connor was woken up by the ringing of his phone.
When he picked it up, he saw that it was a call from Reena.
Connor answered the call in a daze and asked, "President Satchwell, what's wrong?"
"Mr. McDonald, are you free today? I'd like to meet up with you. I have something to tell you about work…" Reena said very politely.
"Alright, I'll go look for you at the company later!"
Connor agreed.
"Alright!"
After Reena heard Connor's words, she simply replied and hung up the phone.
After putting down his phone, Connor stretched his back and walked out of the bedroom.
As it was Saturday, Rachel didn't have to teach any classes. Instead, she slept in her room.
Connor simply washed up and changed into a clean set of clothes. Then, he took his car keys and left the house.
Because Connor had saved June Santoni at the Hustlers Club last time, she had returned Connor's Mercedes-Benz to him out of gratitude.
The last time he went to Porthampton, Connor's Honda had been completely scrapped. In addition, Connor knew that even if he gave this Mercedes-Benz to June, June might not be able to drive it, so in the end, Connor still accepted the car keys.
Connor didn't have any other cars to drive, so he could only drive this Mercedes-Benz to Reena's company.
However, Connor's luck today didn't seem to be very good; just as his car left the community, he saw a pink Ferrari sports car driving towards him at an amazing speed. The huge roar instantly resounded throughout the entire street.
"F * ck, do you want to die?"
When Connor saw the Ferrari rushing at him, his expression was a little angry. He hurriedly turned the steering wheel, trying to avoid the car, but the other party was coming at him too quickly.
"Bang!"
The Ferrari crashed into Connor's car.
However, the other party seemed to have stepped on the brakes one second before the collision. The impact was not particularly terrifying, but Connor's head hit the steering wheel hard.
Fortunately, Connor was a martial artist now. if it was an ordinary person, they would have fainted on the spot.
Connor pushed open the car door and shook his head, trying to wake himself up and check the car.
However, before Connor could see what was wrong with his car, he heard a crisp sound coming from the Ferrari.
"Hey, what's with you? Didn't you see that my car was already here? Why didn't you dodge? Do you even know how to drive?"
After Connor heard this, he was furious!
If the other party's attitude was better, Connor might not care about the repair fee of the car. After all, this money was nothing in Connor's eyes.
However, after Connor heard what the other party said, he was instantly furious. After all, Connor was driving normally just now, and the other party was driving against the traffic. This was obviously the other party's responsibility, but this guy actually had the nerve to complain first. Perhaps they might even ask Connor for repair fees next.
Therefore, Connor turned around and prepared to reason with the other party.
However, before Connor could speak, the Ferrari's door opened.
The first thing that caught Connor's eye was a pair of slender and fair legs that stepped out from the car. They were also wearing a pair of white high heels.
Although Connor hadn't seen the car owner's appearance clearly, he could tell that the car owner should be a woman just by looking at her legs. Moreover, it was very likely that she was a beautiful woman.
He immediately suppressed his desire to curse.
Then, a woman walked out of the car.
Her was very sexy, especially when she got out of the car just now, and she looked very attractive.
At this moment, Connor finally saw the woman's appearance clearly.
Not only was the woman's figure extremely hot, but her appearance was also extremely charming. Her exquisite face was like a work of art, and there was no flaw at all.
At this moment, the woman was wearing a spaghetti strap short skirt, revealing a large part of her skin. Her slender and fair legs were exposed to the air without reservation, and it looked like she wanted to be caressed!
Connor's guess was right. The owner of this Ferrari was really a woman, and a super beauty.
At this moment, Connor didn't know if his luck was good or bad. Just as he went out, his car was hit by someone, but the person who hit his car was actually a beautiful woman.
However, at this moment, the expression on this beautiful woman's face was abnormally angry.
She walked in front of Connor in her high heels and pointed at Connor as she shouted, "What's wrong with you? Why did you hit my car in the opposite direction just now? Do you know that I just bought this car?"
Connor looked down at his car and the Ferrari sports car. His expression was unusually helpless.
It was clearly the other party who went against the traffic and hit his car, but now he was saying that he was going against the traffic?
"What are you looking at? I'm talking to you, can you hear me? Why are you so rude?"
Seeing that Connor didn't say anything, the beautiful woman continued to walk forward and asked Connor with an imposing manner.
As the beautiful woman gradually approached Connor, Connor found that this woman was indeed very beautiful. Moreover, this woman seemed to be of mixed blood. Her exquisite facial features gave off a different kind of beauty.
Connor knew so many beauties, but it was the first time he had seen such a beautiful mixed-blood woman. She also seemed to be somewhat similar to the female lead of the TV series that Rachel had been watching recently.
"Do you have a driver's license?"
Connor asked the beautiful girl.
When the beauty heard Connor's words, she could not help but be stunned for a moment. Then, she hurriedly said, "What do you mean by that? I got my driver's license in the U.K. three years ago, okay?"
"Your driver's license is from the U.K?" Connor frowned.
"Yeah, why? The driver's license is universal. Why can't I drive in Oprana?" the beautiful woman asked.
"Of course, but you have to know that in the U.K., cars drive on the left, but in Oprana, cars drive on the right. So, the person who drove against the traffic just now was not me, but you!"
Connor finally understood why this beauty had bumped into him.
After all, the way to travel in the U.K. was different from that in Oprana.

chapters.title: Chapter 1208: Your Surname is Lee?
chapters.content:
Chapter 1208: Your Surname is Lee?
"I was driving in the opposite direction?"
The beautiful woman blinked her eyes, and a trace of doubt flashed across her eyes.
"You can observe the cars on the road. They're all driving on the right…" Connor replied with a helpless expression.
The beauty quickly turned her head to observe the cars on the street. She took out her phone and searched for something.
A few minutes later, the beautiful woman said to Connor in embarrassment, "I'm really sorry. I just returned to Oprana and picked up my car from the 4S shop today, so I forgot about driving on the right side of the road in Oprana. I was wondering why so many cars were driving on the wrong side of the road. I didn't expect it to be me who's in the wrong…"
"Now you know you were wrong, right?"
Connor said helplessly.
"I know, I know…" The beauty nodded.
"It's good that you know. If you go to other places in the future, you'd better know the traffic rules there. Otherwise, it'll be very dangerous for you to do this. Fortunately, you bumped into me today. If it were someone else, you would have gotten into big trouble…" Connor replied indifferently.
Connor wasn't trying to scare this beauty. He was very serious.
If Connor hadn't been in the car just now, but an ordinary person had been, even if he hadn't fainted, he would have suffered a concussion.
After the beauty realized that it was her mistake, her attitude was still very sincere. She hurriedly said to Connor, "I understand. I'll definitely be more careful next time!"
Connor planned to check the condition of the car. If the car could still be driven, Connor planned to drive it away.
However, at this moment, the beauty directly reached out to stop Connor and said, "Well, don't be in a hurry to leave. The two of us haven't talked about compensation yet!"
"Compensation?"
After Connor heard this, he looked at the beauty helplessly. "Miss, I've already explained it to you clearly just now. You were the one who hit my car against the traffic. It's already good enough that I'm not asking you for compensation now. If you continue to pester me like this, I'm going to call the police…"
At this moment, Connor did not intend to continue wasting time. He only wanted to seize the time to leave this place.
"No, no, that's what I meant. What I meant was that since I knocked your car into this state, I should give you some repair fees!" the beauty hurriedly said to Connor.
Connor only reacted after hearing what the beautiful girl said.
It turned out that he had misunderstood this beauty. She was planning to compensate him.
Connor smiled awkwardly, then walked to the front of his car and checked it briefly.
Although the front of the car was dented, the car itself was fine. Moreover, the car itself was not worth much. The maintenance fee would likely cost around only a few tens of thousands of dollars.
