Connor didn't care about the money at all, so he said to the beauty, "No need. My car itself is not very valuable. You should repair your car properly!"
The beauty's car was a Ferrari, and it would cost at least hundreds of thousands to repair it.
Therefore, Connor did not intend to continue to pursue this issue.
"How can that be!" The beauty hurriedly shook her head at Connor, then said with a very serious expression, "I was the one who hit your car just now, so I'll definitely pay for the repair fees. How much do you think it will cost to repair it? Just tell me directly!"
"I really don't need you to compensate me…"
Connor said helplessly.
"If you don't accept my compensation today, then don't leave. I'll call the police now and get them to come over and talk about the compensation…"
The beauty said as she took out her phone.
"No, wait, there's really no need."
Connor hurriedly stopped the beauty. After all, if they waited until the police arrived, who knew how long this matter would last? He was not in the mood to waste time here at all.
The beauty blinked. "Then how much do you think it will cost?"
"How about this? I don't know how much money I need to pay now, but I'll send the car to the 4S shop later and let the people in the shop estimate it," Connor said.
"Alright, I'll go with you now!" the beautiful woman hurriedly said.
"There's no need to go through so much trouble. I'll go by myself."
"Then add me on Facebook,"the woman suggested. "After you fix it, tell me the amount and I'll transfer it to you. How about that?"
"Sure!"
Connor nodded and took out his phone. Meanwhile, the beautiful woman added Connor on Facebook. After that, she whispered to Connor, "My name is Chelsea Lee. What's your name?"
"Your surname is Lee?"
After Connor heard this name, his expression seemed to be a little surprised.
"Yeah, why?"
The beauty asked with some doubt.
"It's nothing. My mother's surname is Lee too!" Connor replied indifferently and then continued, "My name is Connor McDonald!"
"Alright, I will remember your name…"
Chelsea nodded.
Connor didn't say anything else. He walked into the car, stepped on the accelerator, and disappeared from Chelsea's sight.
Chelsea stood quietly on the spot, as if she did not care about his Ferrari at all. On the contrary, she looked thoughtfully in the direction where Connor disappeared.
"If I had known earlier, I would have made up a fake name to lie to you. If I were to be discovered by you, it would not be fun…"
Chelsea mumbled to herself and then walked away in her high heels, not even looking at the Ferrari.
In her eyes, the Ferrari was no different from a pile of scrap metal.
In the eyes of ordinary people, a broken sports car could be repaired. However, in Chelsea's eyes, once a sports car broke down, it was worthless. It was better to throw it away and buy a new one.
About half an hour later, Connor drove his broken Mercedes-Benz to the Empire World Corporation's branch office in Newtown.
After entering the company, Connor briefly explained his identity to the receptionist.
After the receptionist learned that he was here to see Reena, her attitude immediately became respectful. She quickly brought him to the lounge and poured him a cup of coffee, then went to Reena's office to inform her that Connor had arrived.

chapters.title: Chapter 1209: Heavens Club
chapters.content:
Chapter 1209: Heavens Club
A few minutes later, Reena walked into the lounge with the receptionist from earlier.
"Hello, Mr. McDonald!"
After Reena saw Connor, she greeted him respectfully.
When the receptionist who had received Connor saw this scene, she was instantly dumbfounded. The expression on her face was very unbelievable.
She knew that Connor was here to see Reena and that he wasn't any ordinary person. However, she never expected Connor to be so terrifying—Not only did Reena have to come personally to receive him, but Reena also treated Connor very respectfully. This was something that the receptionist had never seen before.
Reena had never been so respectful to even Thomas Morgan, so the receptionist began to guess who Connor was to have such a terrifying influence.
"Didn't you say that you have something to tell me? What the hell is going on? Connor asked Reena.
"Mr. McDonald, it's not convenient for us to talk here. Let's talk somewhere else!" Reena replied.
"Good!"
Connor nodded his head lightly and followed Reena to the lounge.
After leaving the lounge, Connor happened to bump into June Santoni, so he took the initiative to greet June and said with a smile, "June!"
"Connor? Why are you here?"
June was dumbfounded when she saw Connor. Although Connor had said that he was Reena's boss, June had always thought that Connor was joking.
But at this moment, June realized that Connor hadn't been joking at all!
When Connor saw the surprised expression on June's face, he did not say anything.
After chatting with her for a while, Connor followed Reena to her office.
Meanwhile, the employees in the company all stared at June with strange gazes.
After all, June had suddenly joined the company and had even become Reena's secretary.
From this, it could be seen that June wasn't an ordinary person.
The employees were also secretly imagining what kind of background June must have to become Reena's secretary with just an ordinary university degree!
This position was the dream of countless people!
However, when everyone saw how respectful Reena was when she spoke to Connor, they were certain that Connor wasn't a normal person either. In addition, Connor had taken the initiative to greet June, which meant that they must have some kind of relationship that was unknown.
In an instant, all the employees in the company surrounded June and began to inquire about Connor's identity and the relationship between June and him.
"June, who is this Connor McDonald?"
"Yeah, June, do you know him?"
"I feel like this is the first time President Satchwell has received someone so respectfully. This Connor isn't very old. Could he be a rich heir from a big family?"
"But he doesn't look like a rich heir from the clothes he's wearing"
At this moment, there seemed to be nothing more attractive than Connor's identity to these women.
June looked at the expressions on everyone's faces and felt a little helpless. She said, "Actually, I don't know who Connor is either. I'm friends with him and was introduced to work here by Connor…"
At this moment, a female employee said, "Connor actually managed to get you to work here. Then the relationship between the two of you must not be simple!"
Although this sentence did not sound strange on the surface, it was easy to misunderstand when paired with the frivolous tone of the employee. June did not want others to misunderstand her, so she took a deep breath. "Connor and I are really just ordinary friends, but..."
"But what?"
The surrounding employees hurriedly asked June.
"But Connor told me that he's President Satchwell's boss. I always thought he was joking with me, so I didn't take it to heart..."
June explained in a low voice.
When everyone heard June's words, they were stunned on the spot. Their expressions were abnormally shocked.
"How is this possible?"
Everyone stared at June with disbelief on their faces.
They simply couldn't believe that Connor was Reena's boss at such a young age. After all, Reena was the head of the Empire World Corporation in Newtown. If Connor was really Reena's boss, then wouldn't that mean that Connor was the boss of the Empire World Corporation?
No one could believe that Connor was the boss of the Empire World Corporation at such a young age.
When June saw that everyone's reaction was exactly the same as her own, a hint of helplessness flashed across her eyes.
However, she didn't say anything else. Instead, she turned around and left. After all, June didn't want to tell these people so much, but she had no choice but to tell them regardless.
…
Meanwhile, in Reena's office.
After Connor entered the office, he sat on the sofa.
Reena took the initiative to pour a cup of tea for him.
Connor took a sip of tea and asked, "President Satchwell, why did you call me here this time?"
"Mr. McDonald, have you heard of the Heavens Club in Newtown?"
Reena asked Connor.
"No..."
Connor lightly shook his head.
"Heavens Club is the largest club in Newtown and is also the most famous one. The location of this club is very advantageous, and it has a service department for both high-end and ordinary people. Therefore, the annual profit of this club is very terrifying..." Reena said, introducing the club.
"And then?"
Connor was not very interested in clubs. Although clubs made money, Connor did not lack money at all.
"Mr. McDonald, the Heavens Club's normal business district is mainly responsible for receiving some ordinary people. These people are white-collar workers or ordinary second-generation heirs who have a certain amount of spending power in Newtown. These people basically recognize the Heavens Club very much. The Heavens Bar under the Heavens Club has already taken over 50% of the night clubbers in Newtown..." Reena continued.
After hearing Reena's words, Connor's eyes flashed with shock.
After all, being able to attract 50% of night clubbers with just one bar was a scary feat.

chapters.title: Chapter 1210: The Mysterious Boss
chapters.content:
Chapter 1210: The Mysterious Boss
"Although 50% is not a small amount, you should know that I came to Newtown to deal with Rockefeller, not to earn money!"
Connor did not intend to put his energy into opening a bar, so he replied indifferently.
"Mr. McDonald, I know why you came to Newtown, but besides Heavens Hotel and Heavens Bar, Heavens Club also has Heavens Commerce!"
Reena paused for a moment before continuing, "And Heavens Commerce is mainly responsible for dealing with the upper class of Newtown. Some are business elites, some are company presidents, and some are in power…"
After hearing Reena's words, Connor's expression began to change.
This was because he knew that she was telling him the importance of Heavens Commerce. Whoever could control Heavens Commerce would gain some important connections.
However, if Connor could make good use of these connections, it might be of great help to him in dealing with Rockefeller.
In addition, he had always wanted to do something of his own. He was not interested in earning money, but if this could help him deal with Rockefeller, then Connor was a little interested.
"A few days ago, I suddenly received news that the owner of Heavens Club seems to be planning to sell this club, including Heavens Bar, Heavens Commerce, and Heavens Hotel. I talked to Mr. Morgan yesterday, and he felt that this was a very good opportunity, so he asked me to discuss it with you and see what you think!"
Reena continued after seeing Connor's interest.
The Heavens Club was very large. Even if they wanted to buy it, the price would be astronomical.
Therefore, Thomas and Reena had no right to make the decision. This matter had to be approved by Connor.
This was also why Reena had invited Connor over.
"He actually wants to sell such a good place? Is there something wrong with this club?"
Connor frowned and asked Reena in confusion.
"From what I know, there is no problem with Heavens Club. It's just that the boss himself doesn't want to continue running this business!"
Reena replied.
"Then, how much would it cost to buy this club?"
Connor looked at Reena and asked.
"Mr. McDonald, there are many people in Orilon who have their eyes on Heavens Club. There are also many rich people outside of Orilon who have their eyes on this club. If you really want to get this club, it's not a matter of money, but connections. After all, it's not the same as purchasing an antique."
Reena explained..
"Connections?"
When Connor heard this, a trace of helplessness flashed across his eyes. Then, he said softly, "Then do we still have a good chance of buying this club?"
Connor was obviously testing Reena's network. After all, the people that Connor and Thomas Morgan knew in Newtown were very limited, so he could only count on Reena.
"Mr. McDonald, the Empire World Corporation has only been in Newtown for a short time. The connections I have accumulated are also very limited. If Heavens Club were in the four big provinces, it would not be a big problem. Unfortunately, this club is in Newtown. Our connections are definitely not comparable to those of the local big families…"
Reena replied tactfully.
"So you came to me to ask if I have any ideas?"
Connor frowned and asked Reena.
"Yes!"
Reena did not hide anything and nodded.
Connor looked at Reena and was rather helpless. After all, all of Connor's connections were left behind by Steven Lee. If even Thomas couldn't do anything, then Connor definitely couldn't do anything either.
"Mr. McDonald, Mr. Morgan said that we can start with the boss of Heavens Club!"
Reena said to Connor.
When Connor heard this, he asked in confusion, "Who is the boss of Heavens Club?"
"I don't know who the boss is. His identity is very mysterious."
Reena replied helplessly and continued, "For so many years, Heavens Club has always been managed by a woman named Vanessa Canfield. The boss of Heavens Club has never shown himself. I have been investigating the whole day, but I haven't found any news about the boss of Heavens Club!"
"Why is the boss of Heavens Club like the people of Rockefeller? They all like to hide their identity. Could he be one of Rockefeller's people?"
Connor said with a frown.
"No!"
Reena answered.
"How do you know he's not under Rockefeller?"
Seeing that Reena was so certain, and a trace of doubt flashed across Connor's eyes.
"Because according to the information I've gotten, Rockefeller is also very interested in Heavens Club. They're also looking for the boss of Heavens Club. If this club really belonged to Rockefeller, it would never be sold to anyone else."
Reena analyzed carefully.
"That's true. No one would sell their own stuff just to buy it back again. There's no need to go through all that trouble!"
Connor nodded and continued, "I'm indeed quite interested in Heavens Club, but since Thomas can't do anything about it, what can I do? Thomas knows better than I do how many connections I have..."
Reena slowly raised her head to look at Connor, then said softly, "Mr. Morgan told me that you have some connections that he doesn't have…"
"Rachel Wallace?"
When Connor heard this, the first person that came to mind was Rachel.
After all, among all the people Connor knew, it seemed that only Rachel was someone that Thomas did not have connections with. The rest were introduced to Connor by Thomas.
"I think so!"
Reena nodded lightly.
Connor smiled expressionlessly and cursed Thomas in his heart.
Thomas obviously had everything planned out. He knew that with his connections, it would not be easy to buy Heavens Club.
Therefore, he was prepared to let Connor talk to Rachel and see if she had any ideas.
After all, Rachel's connections might be even more terrifying than Connor and Thomas.

chapters.title: Chapter 1211: The simplest method
chapters.content:
Chapter 1211: The simplest method
"Alright, I understand what you're talking about. I'll talk to Rachel when I'm free and see if she has any ideas!"
Connor whispered to Reena.
"Alright!"
Reena nodded.
Now that they had reached an agreement, Connor didn't plan to stay here any longer. He stood up and wanted to leave.
Reena took the initiative to send Connor out of the company building.
After the two of them left the company, Connor saw his beat-up Mercedes and said to Reena, "Miss Satchwell, this car got hit. When you have time, get someone to repair it. Then, leave it here at the company. I'll come and get it whenever I need it!"
"Alright!"
Reena hurriedly nodded.
"Also, remember to send me the repair cost…"
Connor thought for a moment before continuing.
After all, Chelsea Lee had Connor's Facebook. Connor was worried that if Chelsea insisted on paying for the damage, he knew how much he would have to pay.
"Alright…"
Reena nodded again.
Connor walked to the roadside and stopped a taxi. He was ready to go home and talk to Rachel about Heavens Club.
An hour later, Connor returned home with a big bag of Rachel's favorite snacks.
At this time, Rachel was still sitting on the sofa watching TV.
Sometimes, Connor felt sorry for her. In this city, she didn't know anyone except him, and she didn't have any social activities. She would usually watch TV at home besides going to class.
"Miss Wallace…"
After hesitating for a moment, Connor walked to Rachel and then called out with a smile.
When Rachel heard him, she turned and looked at him indifferently. Then, she placed her attention on the snacks in Connor's hand and said with a pout, "You bought all these for me?"
"Yeah!"
Connor hurriedly nodded.
"You're trying to get on my good side for no reason. Don't tell me you have something to ask of me?"
Rachel saw through Connor's true purpose at a glance.
"What do you mean by that? We've known each other for so long, and you've saved me several times. What's wrong with me buying you some snacks?"
Connor pretended to be angry and shouted.
"Alright, stop putting on a show. If you have anything to say, just say it quickly! I'm not in the mood to waste my time with you right now…"
Rachel didn't want Connor to disturb her watching TV, so she quickly cut to the chase.
"Uh..."
Seeing that Rachel was being so direct, he felt a little awkward. Then, he said softly, "Actually, I have a small matter that I need your help with…"
"What is it?"
Rachel asked indifferently.
"I heard that there's a Heavens Club that is looking for a buyer, but I don't know who the boss is. Can you use your connections to help me investigate?"
Seeing that Rachel was being so direct, he didn't continue to talk nonsense and told her the truth.
"Will I get anything from this?"
Rachel asked indifferently.
"Of course, there are benefits. The people from Rockefeller are also very interested in this club because this club has accumulated so many years of connections. Whoever can get this club will be in control of this club's connections, which will be very helpful for us to deal with Rockefeller in the future."
Connor said excitedly.
Rachel turned and sized up Connor. She then said softly, "Alright, since this matter has something to do with Rockefeller, I'll help you ask around!"
"That's great…"
Seeing that Rachel had agreed, a trace of excitement flashed across his eyes.
Because he knew Rachel's power, as long as she agreed to help, he would definitely be able to find the boss behind Heavens Club.
But Connor never thought that there was actually something that Rachel couldn't handle in this world.
In the blink of an eye, three days had passed.
In these three days, Rachel didn't find anything at all. She couldn't even find out the name of the boss of Heavens Club.
Connor was in despair because he never thought that this matter would be so difficult to deal with.
"Rachel, you've eaten so many of my snacks, but you can't even handle such a small task..."
Connor looked at Rachel, who was sitting on the sofa and eating snacks leisurely, and shouted helplessly.
"I'm not God, I can't do everything. Isn't it just a club? Forget about it if you can't get it. Why are you so riled up?"
Rachel turned to look at Connor and said with a pout.
"What are you talking about? This club is very important, okay?"
Connor said helplessly.
"..."
Rachel hesitated for a moment, then said softly, "Actually, if you want to investigate who the boss behind the Heavens Club is, it's very simple. It just depends on whether you dare to do it or not…"
"You have a way?"
Connor was stunned for a moment and asked with a puzzled expression.
"Look at this…"
Rachel pointed to the photos on the coffee table.
Connor hesitated for a moment, then reached out and picked up the photos. He realized that they were all secretly taken of a woman.
This woman had a very sexy figure and a very charming appearance. She seemed to be really beautiful.
These photos were taken secretly, so the photos had not been edited in any way.
Yet, she looked like a natural beauty.
"Who is this woman?"
Connor asked Rachel in confusion.
"This woman is the general manager of Heavens Club, Vanessa Canfield. Based on my investigation, she has been working in Heavens Club for five to six years and has been the general manager since the beginning. So, her relationship with the boss of Heavens Club must not be simple. You only need to kidnap Vanessa Canfield and then you can get information about the boss of Heavens Club from her…"
Rachel said calmly.
"Kidnap?"
Connor was instantly dumbfounded when he heard this.
"Yes, this is the simplest and most direct way!"
Rachel nodded.
"Rachel, are you kidding me? Don't you know kidnapping is illegal?"
Connor said with a frown.
"I've already killed people, why would I be afraid of this?"
Rachel said indifferently.
"That's you, not me. I can't be in cahoots with you. Moreover, this matter has nothing to do with Vanessa Canfield. Why would I kidnap her?"
Connor felt that kidnapping was not a good thing, so he rejected it after thinking for a moment.
"How do you plan to deal with Rockefeller when you're so soft-hearted?"
Rachel pursed her lips and said indifferently.
"Dealing with Rockefeller doesn't mean that I have to do such a despicable thing!"
Connor said righteously.
"..."
Hearing Connor's words, Rachel glanced at him and didn't say anything.
Connor turned around and walked toward his room.

chapters.title: Chapter 1212: The Invitation from Chelsea Lee
chapters.content:
Chapter 1212: The Invitation from Chelsea Lee
Ring, ring, ring!
At this moment, Connor's phone suddenly rang.
Connor picked up his phone and glanced at it. He realized that it was an unfamiliar number, so he picked up the phone.
"Hello?"
"Mr. McDonald, I'm Chelsea Lee, the one who hit your car a while ago. Do you still remember me?"
A very pleasant voice sounded from the other end of the phone.
"Yeah…"
Connor nodded and replied.
It had been three days since Chelsea crashed into Connor's car.
Connor had been investigating Heavens Club recently, and Chelsea did not take the initiative to contact him, so he had long forgotten about it.
"Mr. McDonald, has your car been repaired?"
Chelsea continued to ask.
"I think so…"
Connor replied.
"Then, how much did you spend? I'll transfer the money to you…"
"Actually, it didn't cost much. Also, you didn't do it on purpose that day. Let's just forget about it."
Connor thought for a moment and said softly.
"I can't do that. It was my fault in the first place, so I must pay you back. Also, to express my apology, I want to buy you a meal. Why don't we meet and talk about it?"
Chelsea hurriedly said.
"A meal?"
Connor sounded hesitant.
"What's wrong? A beautiful lady like me has offered to buy you a meal, but you're rejecting me?"
Chelsea felt that he was a little hesitant and asked in a dissatisfied tone.
"No, no…"
Connor hurriedly replied and then continued, "Then, you can decide the time and place. I will look for you in a while…"
"Okay!"
Seeing saw that Connor had agreed, she hung up the phone.
After Connor hung up the phone, a strange look flashed across his eyes.
He always felt that Chelsea was a little strange, but he couldn't tell what was strange about her.
Chelsea didn't seem like an ordinary woman to Connor.
Just as Connor was wondering about these questions, he received a Facebook message from Chelsea. It was the location and time of the restaurant.
Connor didn't think too much about it. After saying goodbye to Rachel, he left the house.
After more than an hour, Connor arrived in front of an Italian restaurant.
The interior design of the restaurant was pretty good. Although it was not luxurious, it gave people a very comfortable feeling.
"Hello, sir. How many of you are there?"
The receptionist took the initiative to walk to Connor and asked with a smile.
"My friend should have arrived!"
Connor replied softly.
"Are you Miss Lee's friend?"
The receptionist asked.
"Yes!"
Connor nodded lightly.
"Then, this way please."
The receptionist hurriedly took the initiative to lead the way for Connor.
A few minutes later, Connor followed the receptionist into a private room.
At this time, Chelsea was already sitting in the private room. Today, she was wearing a white strapless dress, and her black hair was casually draped over her shoulders.
Unlike the Chelsea Connor saw last time, she looked very elegant and noble this time, and she even had a trace of dignity.
"Hi, Mr. McDonald."
Chelsea greeted Connor with a smile.
"Miss Lee, don't call me Mr. McDonald. Just call me Connor!"
Connor whispered to Chelsea.
"Alright, then I'll call you Connor!"
Chelsea nodded and gestured for Connor to sit down.
Connor sat directly opposite Chelsea. She was not in a hurry to talk to him. Instead, he picked up the tea set in front of her and began to fiddle with it.
Although Connor knew nothing about the art of tea, when he saw her fiddling with the tea set, he was lost in thought.
Her movements were very graceful, so it made him feel at ease.
Connor could feel that she was a person who liked drinking tea very much.
"Connor, do you usually drink tea?"
Chelsea asked Connor softly as he poured tea for him.
"No...
Connor shook his head without thinking and continued, "I think all tea tastes the same. I don't really like it…"
Chelsea smiled faintly when he heard Connor's words and did not say anything else.
Connor picked up the teacup and drank all the tea in one go.
"Tea should not be drunk like this. You have to slowly savor the fragrance within the tea. If you drink it like this, all tea will definitely taste the same…"
Chelsea whispered to Connor.
Connor hesitated for a moment, then picked up the teacup and took a sip according to Chelsea's method.
"What do you think?"
Chelsea looked at Connor.
"It's still the same…"
Connor said helplessly.
When Chelsea heard Connor's words, she revealed an unusually charming smile, causing Connor to be a little absent-minded.
Chelsea's smile was very gentle and charming. Connor felt that he had never seen such a gentle smile before.
A few minutes later, the waiter began to serve the dishes.
Chelsea and Connor chatted while eating.
Through the conversation, Connor found out that Chelsea was only five years older than him. However, when Chelsea was six years old, she went to the U.K. and lived there. She had just returned recently. As for more detailed questions, Connor did not ask, and Chelsea did not say anything.
The food in this Italian restaurant was very good, so Connor spent most of his energy on eating. Chelsea would take the initiative to chat with Connor.
In short, Connor was very happy with the meal.
"Connor, tell me your bank account number. I'll return the money to you!"
Seeing that Connor was almost done eating, so Chelsea took out her phone and wanted to transfer money to him.
Connor put down the chopsticks in his hand and said softly, "Actually, it only cost less than 10,000 dollars. You've already bought me a meal today, so we should forget about this money..."
"..."
Chelsea looked at Connor indifferently and said softly, "Alright then. If you need any help in the future, you can contact me. As long as I can help, I will definitely help you!"
Connor looked at her and smiled helplessly. He sighed, thinking that Chelsea could not help him at all. What he wanted to do most was to find the boss of Heavens Club, but even Rachel could not do anything about it. Chelsea had just returned from overseas. She definitely could not help him with this kind of thing.
Although that was what he was thinking, Connor still nodded and agreed.
Connor and Chelsea chatted casually for a while before leaving the restaurant together.
Seeing Connor had taken a taxi here, Chelsea wanted to send Connor back, but he refused.
Connor noticed that Chelsea was driving a Ferrari today, but it was not the Ferrari from that day.
Therefore, he knew that Chelsea was not a simple woman. She must be rich.

chapters.title: Chapter 1213: The Gala
chapters.content:
Chapter 1213: The Gala
At nine o'clock at night.
Connor returned home and prepared to discuss the matter of Heavens Club with Rachel.
But before Connor could speak, his phone rang again.
This time, it was a call from Reena.
"Miss Reena, what's the matter?" he answered the call and asked softly.
"Mr. Connor, I just received news that the owner of Heavens Club is planning to hold a party tomorrow evening at 6 o'clock, where she will announce the issue of transferring Heavens Club!" Reena said with a serious tone.
"Tomorrow? They're announcing it tomorrow?" His eyes flashed with surprise upon hearing this.
"I don't know the specifics, but it could be about discussing the transfer method of Heavens Club or directly announcing the transfer. Everything is still unknown!" she explained slowly.
"Is the information accurate?" he asked.
"Many people have received this news, so there shouldn't be any problem!" she replied.
"Okay, I got it!" He gave a brief response and hung up the phone.
At this moment, Connor's mood was extremely complex because he hadn't expected the owner of Heavens Club to appear so soon.
This also meant that he had no time to prepare at all.
"What's wrong?" Rachel turned her head and glanced at him, asking softly.
"Tomorrow evening at 6 o'clock, the owner of Heavens Club will hold a party. They might announce the issue of transferring the club!" he replied helplessly.
"Then it might be too late for you to kidnap Vanessa..." she said indifferently.
"When did I say I wanted to kidnap her!" he shouted in frustration.
"What do you plan to do next?" she asked casually.
"I don't know what to do now, but I think the transfer of Heavens Club is probably already settled. It doesn't have much to do with me..." he answered helplessly.
"Do you want to attend the party tomorrow evening?" Rachel continued asking.
"Of course, I have to attend! If the party is not directly announcing the results, maybe it will be done through bidding. If it's a real bidding, I have a good chance..." Connor quickly replied, then continued, "You're thinking too simply. Heavens Club is a money-making machine. If the owner is really after money, there's no need for her to transfer the club!"
"You're oversimplifying things. Heavens Club is a money-making machine. If the owner is really after money, she has no reason to transfer the club!" Rachel struck Connor with a merciless blow.
Upon hearing these words, his eyes flashed with helplessness. He lowered his voice and said, "Even if money can't solve it, I won't be able to get this club in the end. But I still want to go and see. As long as Rockefeller's people don't get the club, that's fine."
Rachel glanced at Connor lightly without saying anything more.
The news of the party hosted by the owner of Heavens Club spread throughout the city of Nanyuan in an instant. Almost all the well-known big bosses in the province received invitations. After all, they were all interested in this club, and it was the first time the owner of Heavens Club had appeared in public. Everyone was curious about who she was.
Some even began to speculate about who would eventually acquire Heavens Club.
Of course, the local big families in the province had the highest hopes, and among these families, one of them was likely associated with Rockefeller.
He was also very curious about who would end up with the club.
If it wasn't someone from Rockefeller, the impact on him would be minimal.
But if it was someone from Rockefeller, things could get complicated.
The next day, a little after four in the afternoon.
He changed into an expensive outfit and left home alone.
Considering it was a high-end party and he was representing the Empire World Corporation, Connor paid great attention to his appearance. If the transfer of the club really happened through bidding, he still had a lot of hope.
According to the information provided by Reena, the party was being held at Heavens Commerce under the Heavens Club.
Heavens Commerce itself was a well-known place, so he hailed a taxi and arrived at the location of Heavens Commerce.
The entrance of Heavens Commerce was still bustling today. Various luxury cars were parked at the door, and almost all the well-known bosses in the province had come to attend the party.
Standing at the entrance of Heavens Commerce were several hostesses dressed in red cheongsams. Their main job was to receive guests and guide them to their designated locations.
Since guests had different statuses, naturally, they would be directed to different places.
Before the party officially began, all the guests were required to wait in their respective restrooms.
At this time, there were also four burly bodyguards and a middle-aged man in a black suit standing at the entrance of Heavens Commerce.
All four bodyguards were martial artists, and their strength was not simple.
After getting out of the car, Connor briefly surveyed the surroundings and then realized an embarrassing situation.
That was, anyone entering Heavens Commerce voluntarily presented their invitation letter. After the middle-aged man checked it and confirmed that there were no issues, he allowed them to enter.
But he had no idea about the existence of an invitation letter. He couldn't understand why he never had an invitation letter whenever he attended such parties.
This was probably the difference between ordinary people and those so-called upper-class individuals.
Upper-class individuals followed rules no matter what they did. The invitation letter was like a symbol of status and also ensured that no unwanted people could sneak in.
However, he was just an ordinary person. It never occurred to him to think about these things.
He knew he couldn't enter without an invitation letter, so he took out his phone and dialed Reena's number, wanting to ask if she had an invitation letter.
But to his despair, she also didn't receive an invitation letter.
Upon knowing that even Reena didn't have an invitation letter, Connor became even angrier. After all, the Empire World Corporation was one of the top companies in the country, and they didn't even prepare an invitation letter for them. Yet, all the ordinary bosses had received one. Connor couldn't understand what the people from Heavens Commerce were thinking.
However, he quickly thought of a possibility—that it was the doing of someone from Rockefeller.
Rockefeller deliberately prevented his subordinates from attending the party.

chapters.title: Chapter 1214: Acquaintants
chapters.content:
Chapter 1214: Acquaintants
Connor observed his surroundings briefly and realized that since he couldn't enter through the main entrance, he had to choose another way to get in.
Since Rockefeller didn't want him to enter, he was determined to go in and find out what was going on.
Because there were too many people downstairs at Heavens Commerce, he knew that entering now would easily attract attention.
Wouldn't it be a huge joke for him, the rich heir of Porthampton, to climb over a wall to attend the party?!
If someone found out about this, he would truly become the laughingstock.
So he decided to wait until there were fewer people before climbing over the wall.
He found a secluded spot and waited quietly.
By now, he had already seen many familiar faces entering Heavens Commerce, including those he had met at Hustlers Club. Even Harold, Henny, Jovan, Sheldon, Sabrina, and other old friends from Porthampton had arrived, and they all had invitation letters in their hands.
But what surprised Connor even more was that Sonia walked into Heavens Club with a young man.
The young man should be her wealthy boyfriend.
Connor couldn't understand why these people had traveled so far to attend this party. Could it be that Harold and the others were also very interested in Heavens Club?
While he was contemplating these questions, a black Bentley slowly stopped at the entrance of Heavens Commerce.
When the car door opened, Queta, dressed in a black evening gown and high heels, stepped out of the car.
After all, she was the business queen of Newtown.
So when she arrived at the venue, countless people approached her and greeted her.
Queta spotted Connor standing in the corner at a glance. However, after seeing him, she didn't come over to talk to him or say much. She simply exchanged a few words with the crowd and then walked into Heavens Commerce accompanied by her secretary, stepping on high heels.
Just as she entered the building, a car parked at the entrance.
A familiar person walked out of the car, Arthur.
Arthur was wearing a white suit today, and with his handsome face and tall figure, he looked exceptionally charming.
After getting out of the car, he opened the back door.
A middle-aged man walked out of the car, and that man was none other than Arthur's father, Jeremiah Synder.
Connor knew very well that with such a lucrative piece of Heavens Club, the Synder family, as a prominent local family in Newtown, wouldn't miss this opportunity.
Jeremiah, accompanied by Arthur, walked into Heavens Commerce.
After that, more familiar faces gradually entered Heavens Commerce.
But what surprised Connor the most was that Salma also came along with Frank.
Connor never expected that the influence of this party would be so great. All the well-known bosses in the province had attended, but many of them were just there to watch the show and had no intention of competing for the club.
The ones who truly wanted to acquire the club were just those few big families.
Connor pondered silently. If he could help Queta or the Thompson family get the club, it would be a good choice for him. But if the Synder family got the club, things could become complicated.
Half an hour quickly passed.
At this point, less than half an hour remained until the official start of the party, and most of the guests had already arrived. There weren't many guests left.
After hesitating for a moment, he decided to climb over the back wall to enter Heavens Commerce.
He walked to the back wall of Heavens Commerce. Since everyone's attention was focused on the main entrance, there were hardly any people here.
The wall was about two meters high, making it impossible for an ordinary person to climb over. But for Connor, it was nothing.
Taking two steps back, he prepared to take a running start.
"Connor?"
But at that moment, a familiar voice sounded in Connor's ears.
Upon hearing this voice, he couldn't help but pause.
He felt that the voice was very familiar, but for a moment, he couldn't remember where he had heard it before.
Then, a faint fragrance wafted over.
Connor instinctively turned his head and saw the person standing in front of him—it was none other than Chelsea, whom he had dinner with yesterday.
She looked at him curiously and asked softly, "Connor, what are you doing here?"
He looked at her helplessly. He had been waiting for so long, afraid of running into someone he knew.
But he never expected that he would still run into an acquaintance in the end.
"Chelsea, what are you doing here?" he asked her somewhat helplessly.
She glanced around and said softly, "I just happened to pass by here. What about you?"
"I... I don't have anything to do. I'm just waiting for someone here!" Connor explained awkwardly.
He definitely wouldn't say that he came here to attend the party, but since he wasn't given an invitation letter, he could only climb over the wall.
Connor cared about his image, especially in front of a beautiful woman like Chelsea. If he told the truth, he would feel very embarrassed.
"You're waiting for a friend here?" She blinked her eyes and asked Connor softly.
"Yeah, my friend will be here soon. If you don't have anything to do, you should leave..."
Connor's mind was focused on one thought, which was to quickly make Chelsea leave. After all, the party would start in less than half an hour. If he was delayed because of Chelsea and missed the party, it would be a waste of his efforts today.
"We really have such a coincidence to meet here..."
Chelsea seemed not to understand Connor's intention and said with a smile.
"Yeah, it's indeed quite a coincidence..."
Connor nodded slightly while looking at Chelsea, and continued, "By the way, didn't you mention earlier that you had something to attend to? You should leave quickly. My friend will probably arrive soon..."
"I actually don't have anything to do. Where do you plan to go with your friend? How about taking me along?" Chelsea asked with a smiling face.
After hearing her words, he felt completely overwhelmed.
After all, he had important things to do today, and he wasn't in the mood to waste time with Chelsea here.

chapters.title: Chapter 1215: My Dress Is Torn
chapters.content:
Chapter 1215: My Dress Is Torn
"I just returned to the country not long ago, and I don't know many people."
"Now I have nothing to do, so why don't you take me along to have some fun? Where are you planning to go later?"
Chelsea softly asksed Connor.
"Well, Miss Chelsea, I actually have something important to do later, so it's not suitable for you to accompany me. How about another time? I can take you to have a good time in Newtown. What do you think?"
Connor said to Chelsea in a low voice.
"Why is it inconvenient for you to have me around?" she asks curiously.
After hearing her words, he felt like he was going crazy.
After all, the party was about to start, and if he couldn't get in, it would be impossible for him to enter again.
So Connor must seize the opportunity while there were still many people around and quietly sneak in.
He took a deep breath and then said in a low voice, "Miss Chelsea, let me be honest with you. I'm going to attend the party here, but I don't have an invitation, so I have to climb over the wall. As you can see, it's difficult for me to climb this high wall alone, let alone with you. So you better do your own thing!"
"You're going to attend the party?"
She looked at him and said loudly, "Let me tell you, I love attending parties, and I can even dance. I bet you need a dance partner for the party, right? Take me along. I'm so bored being alone..."
"What kind of dancing are you talking about?"
Connor exclaimed in frustration and continued, "I'm going to the party for a specific reason, not to dance. And you can't get in anyway..."
"Why can't I get in?"
Chelsea pouted and said, "Are you avoiding me? Are you afraid of being embarrassed if I accompany you?"
She pretended to look pitiful while speaking, charmingly asking Connor.
When he saw her behavior, he started to doubt whether the current Chelsea was the same person he met yesterday. Yesterday, she had an elegant and confident demeanor, but today she suddenly appeared so girlish.
"Women really know how to act!"
Connor can't help but exclaimed in his mind. He took out his phone to check the time. He knew that if he continued to waste time like this...
"Let me tell you the truth..."
Connor sighed helplessly and said, "Yes, I'm here to attend the party, but I don't have an invitation. So I have to climb over the wall. You saw it; it's difficult for me to climb over this high wall, let alone with you. So do whatever you want!"
"Climbing over the wall?"
Chelsea pauses for a moment and then shakes her head. "You must be a thief, right?"
"I'm not a thief; I'm just here to attend the party!" he replied with a furrowed brow.
"Then I'll climb over the wall with you. I've never climbed over a wall before, and I think it's exciting and interesting..." she said with a cheerful smile.
"What's so interesting about climbing over a wall?"
Connor frowned and exclaimed.
"Anything I haven't done before is interesting to me. Anyway, you must bring me in. If you don't, I'll report you to the authorities, and then let's see what you can do!"
She pouted and said softly.
"Have I offended you in any way? You crashed into my car earlier, and now you want me to bring you over the wall. What exactly do you want?"
Connor asks Chelsea, feeling extremely speechless.
"Hey, we have such a connection. Will you help me or not?"
Connor sighed helplessly and said in a low voice, "I can help you, but if anything happens, I won't take responsibility. I'm warning you!"
"That won't do. You must make sure I enter safely!" she saidwith a smile.
"You..."
Connor looks at Chelsea in disbelief, furrows his brow, and says, "Fine, don't waste any more time. Let me bring you in..."
After saying that, Connor helped Chelsea climb over the wall.
She practiced yoga regularly, so her body was quite flexible, and she easily climbs over the wall.
During the process of climbing over the wall, their bodies inevitably touch. He notices that her figure is quite remarkable!
After helping her over, he took a light leap and effortlessly jumps over.
After landing safely, he intended to take her and head towards the hall where the party was being held.
However, after taking a few steps, he noticed that Chelsea is still standing in the same spot and hasn't followed.
"Are you okay? Did you twist your ankle while climbing over the wall?"
Connor furrowed his brow and asked Chelsea.
"No..."
She shook her head.
"Then why aren't you coming? The party is about to start..." he said in a low voice.
"I accidentally tore my skirt just now, so I might not be able to walk..."
She said helplessly to Connor.
He instinctively glanced at her skirt and noticed a huge tear. Her fair and alluring legs were faintly visible.
"I told you not to come in, but you insisted on following me. Now I don't have time to deal with you. Just wait here, and after the party, I'll take you out..."
Connor said with a helpless tone.
"No, you can't leave now. What will I do if you leave?" she hurriedly shouted.
"Then I'll stay here; it won't solve the problem!" he said with a furrowed brow.
"I don't care. If you dare to leave, I'll report you, and then we'll both be kicked out..." She pouted and said softly to Connor.
"What exactly do you want?"
Connor asks Chelsea in complete exasperation.
After hesitating for a moment, she said softly to him, "I have a solution!"
"What solution?"
Connor asked anxiously.
"This venue is so big, there must be a women's changing room inside. Can't you go in there and steal a skirt for me?" she said with a smile.

chapters.title: Chapter 1216: Chance Meeting With Vanessa Canfield
chapters.content:
Chapter 1216: Chance Meeting With Vanessa Canfield
"You want me to steal clothes from the women's locker room?"
Connor shouted with an incredulous expression.
"This is the best method I can think of now. It won't delay your time, and it can also find clothes for me. As for what you want to do, that's your problem…" Chelsea whispered to Connor.
"I'm really impressed by you!"
Connor's expression seemed like one of a broken man. He turned around and walked into Heavens Commerce.
After entering the building, Connor asked the staff about the location of the changing room.
When Connor found the women's locker room, he was dumbfounded.
There were many people in the locker room, and there were a lot of people coming and going. If Connor went in like this, he would definitely be arrested on the spot and branded as a pervert.
Connor stood there, not knowing what to do.
"Hurry up and go over. President Canfield said that there's a very important guest today!"
"I understand…"
At this moment, the conversation between two waitresses entered Connor's ears.
Connor suddenly remembered that he had seen Vanessa Canfield's photo before—Vanessa was a very beautiful woman. Maybe she would have clothes in her office.
Moreover, Vanessa should be entertaining guests now, so it was impossible for her to return to the office.
So Connor decided to go there to try his luck.
Connor quickly found her office and found that it wasn't locked.
He gently knocked on the door. After confirming that there was no one inside, he sneaked into the office.
When Connor entered the office, he instantly smelled a faint fragrance. It was very tempting—-probably some kind of perfume.
Moreover, her office was decorated very lavishly. There was an oversized desk and a leather sofa in the office, and in front of the sofa was a coffee table.
Connor briefly observed the area and found a door in the corner.
He walked over and gently pushed open the door.
After entering the room, Connor found that it was actually a bedroom with a separate bathroom. There were all kinds of cosmetics on the dressing table in the bedroom.
"I didn't expect this Vanessa to be so dedicated to her job, living directly in the office!" Connor couldn't help but think. Then, he walked to the wardrobe.
Sure enough, there were many clothes in the wardrobe, and it seemed that Chelsea could wear them.
Connor took a deep breath and reached out to pick up a piece of clothing.
"Da da da…"
However, at this moment, the sound of high heels hitting the ground could be heard.
When Connor heard the footsteps, his expression instantly changed. He could feel the footsteps getting closer and closer, so he could only choose to hide in the closet.
At this moment, there were many clothes in the wardrobe, and they were all emitting a fragrance, which was abnormally alluring.
However, Connor was not in the mood to care about these things at all. He was worried that if he was discovered by others, it would be really embarrassing.
Connor didn't have an invitation card to begin with, so he'd snuck in to attend the party.
Now that he had appeared in Vanessa's office, he would definitely be treated as a thief if he was discovered.
At that time, even if Connor had a hundred mouths, he would not be able to explain himself clearly!
At this moment, Connor silently cursed Chelsea ten thousand times in his heart. If it weren't for this woman, he would have already arrived at the banquet venue.
A moment later, the footsteps got closer and closer. This person was actually walking directly towards the bedroom.
Connor could see through the gap in the wardrobe that the person walking over should be a woman.
And this woman was the general manager of the Heavens Club, Vanessa Canfield!
At this moment, Vanessa's expression was very ugly, the reason was very simple: she was entertaining guests at the party just now, but she'd accidentally gotten cake on herself.
No matter what, Vanessa was the main host of the party today. She was in charge of receiving most of the guests today, so she couldn't entertain them like this.
Fortunately, Vanessa's clothes were all in her office. She greeted the guests briefly, and then planned to come up to change her clothes.
However, when she entered the bedroom, Vanessa's eyes flashed with a trace of confusion.
Even though she didn't lock her door, she usually closed it.
However, when she came in just now, she realized that the bedroom door was open.
Vanessa felt that she might have forgotten to close it when she left, so she didn't think too much about it. After all, the security here was very strict. No one could enter her office at all.
However, Vanessa might have forgotten that all the security guards were downstairs today. There were no security guards upstairs at all.
Vanessa sat on the bed and gently rubbed her temples.
Although she could hold her liquor, there were too many customers today.
Hence, Vanessa had also drunk quite a bit of red wine just now. Now, it was inevitable that she had a headache, and her pretty face had a charming blush.
A moment later, Vanessa got up and walked to the wardrobe, ready to open it to find a new set of clothes.
And Connor saw Vanessa walking over, his heart screamed at him.
Because he knew that Vanessa might open the wardrobe now, Connor quickly hid behind a coat. This dress was very big, and it was summer now, so Connor felt that Vanessa should not take this dress.
Connor's body was already thin and weak, so the coat was just big enough to completely hide himself.
Connor held his breath, the expression on his face unusually nervous.
A few seconds later, Vanessa opened the closet door.
Connor could see Vanessa standing in front of him, but Vanessa didn't notice Connor in the closet.
Vanessa began to pick out her clothes seriously. After all, today's party was very important.
Therefore, Vanessa was very strict about her dressing.
Connor saw through the gap that the woman standing in front of him was the same Vanessa in the photo!
She seemed to be even more beautiful than in the photo, and her figure was even more sexy.
But what Connor couldn't understand was that Vanessa should be entertaining the guests downstairs!
Why did she suddenly return to the office to pick out clothes?

chapters.title: Chapter 1217: She Returned to Change Her Clothes
chapters.content:
Chapter 1217: She Returned to Change Her Clothes
Just as Connor was puzzled, he suddenly saw the stain on Vanessa's collar.
"Did this woman come back to change her clothes?"
Connor suddenly had such a thought, and then he was stunned on the spot.
If Vanessa was planning to change her clothes in the bedroom, wouldn't he see her?
It was not the first time Connor had encountered such a situation. This was the exact same scenario as the last time Rachel changed her clothes!
Connor's heartbeat was obviously accelerating.
A few seconds later, Connor heard the sound of clothes rubbing against each other.
Although Connor tried his best not to look, his eyes couldn't be controlled at all. In the end, he still placed his gaze on Vanessa.
Vanessa slowly took off her black evening dress, her fair skin instantly exposed to Connor's sight.
Vanessa's figure was very good, it could even be described as perfect.
Long and fair legs, voluptuous breasts, slender waist…
He felt that his entire body was exuding an irresistible temptation.
Moreover, Vanessa should be around 30 years old. This was obviously the best age for a woman, the perfect combination of maturity and youth.
Connor took a deep breath and tried his best to look away.
He had never thought that he would encounter such a good thing.
At first, he just wanted to steal some clothes, but he didn't expect to see a beautiful woman changing clothes.
Fortunately, Vanessa had decided not to change her bra, or else Connor might not be able to control himself!
A few seconds later, Vanessa put on a spaghetti strap dress.
Vanessa's figure was very nice, so when she put on the spaghetti strap dress, her graceful figure was immediately exposed.
With her fair skin, slender legs, and beautiful face, she looked extremely alluring!
Although Connor had seen so many beautiful women, probably only Rachel would be able to be like Vanessa, who exuded a charming temperament from head to toe!
Vanessa stood in front of the mirror and looked at herself carefully. After making sure that every part of her was perfect, she planned to turn around and leave.
However, just as Vanessa walked less than two meters away, Connor's phone suddenly rang.
Connor was dumbfounded.
"Who is it?"
After Vanessa heard the ringtone, she opened the closet without any hesitation.
Because the situation was urgent, Connor did not turn off his phone at all.
At this time, the person who called Connor was none other than Chelsea, who was waiting anxiously.
"Chelsea, oh Chelsea, you've really caused me trouble!"
Connor couldn't help but sigh in his heart. Then, he took the initiative to walk out of the closet.
"Why is it you?"
After Vanessa saw Connor, her eyes instantly widened, the expression on her face was very unbelievable.
"President Canfield, you…You know me?"
Connor asked Vanessa with a puzzled expression.
Of course, Vanessa didn't know Connor, but Vanessa had seen Connor's photo before.
"Who are you? What are you doing here?"
Vanessa suddenly realized that she had said something wrong, so she quickly changed her words and shouted at Connor.
"P-President Canfield, I'm a guest at the party. My name is Justin!"
Connor could only randomly make up a name on the spot. After all, he couldn't possibly say his real name for such an embarrassing matter!
"Justin?"
Vanessa couldn't help but sneer when she heard this name.
Because Vanessa already knew Connor's true identity, she also knew that he was lying. However, she did not expose his lie. Instead, she frowned and asked, "What are you doing here?"
"I was supposed to attend the party, but... I was lost just now, and I didn't know what happened, but I walked in here. Then, I heard someone come in. I was afraid that others would misunderstand, so I hid in the closet. But I really didn't do anything, and I didn't take anything…"
Even Connor himself did not believe the excuse that he was making up. However, he could not find any other excuse to explain why he would appear in this place.
"Did you just say that you've been hiding in this closet?"
Vanessa was stunned for a moment and frowned as she asked Connor.
"That's right. I've been here the entire time just now…"
Connor nodded lightly.
"..."
Vanessa looked at Connor. The expression on her face was unusually ashamed and angry.
Because she knew that she had changed her clothes here. If Connor had been here the whole time, then didn't that mean he was watching her?!
Thinking of this, the expression on Vanessa's face became very ugly.
"What do you want to do in my bedroom? I advise you to explain this matter clearly to me. Otherwise, I'll call the police and let them handle this matter!"
Connor looked at Vanessa in front of him, the expression on his face helpless.
He felt that he was really unlucky today. From the moment he met Chelsea, the bad luck had never stopped.
If not for Chelsea, none of this would have happened.
"Are you going to tell me or not?"
Vanessa frowned and asked Connor.
Connor took a deep breath. "President Canfield, actually, this is what happened. I came to attend the party with a friend of mine today, but my friend's dress was broken, so I planned to find a new dress for her. I really don't have any other intentions…"
"Are you here to steal a dress?"
Vanessa frowned slightly.
"I'm not stealing. I'm here to borrow one…" Connor explained helplessly.
He knew very well that Vanessa was very important to the Heavens Club.
At this time Connor didn't dare to offend Vanessa, because if he did, it would not be easy for him to compete for the Heavens Club.
Vanessa sized up Connor and asked, "How do I know if you're telling the truth?"
Connor took a deep breath and wanted to explain himself, but at this time, his phone rang again.
Vanessa directly reached out and snatched his phone. She felt that it should be a call from Connor's accomplice.
However, when she saw the number on the phone, she instantly realized who Connor had stolen the dress for.
"You can go!"
Vanessa directly returned the phone to Connor and whispered to Connor.
"Can I go now?"
Connor never thought that Vanessa's attitude would change so quickly. She just took a look at her phone and asked him to leave.

chapters.title: Chapter 1218: The Mysterious Chelsea Lee
chapters.content:
Chapter 1218: The Mysterious Chelsea Lee
"If you don't want to leave, I can call the police and ask them to take you away!"
Vanessa coldly replied to Connor.
"Thank you, President Canfield…" Although Connor didn't know why Vanessa would suddenly let him go, he couldn't care so much and directly walked towards the door.
"You can take this dress!"
At this moment, Vanessa suddenly took out a dress and handed it to Connor.
"President Canfield, you're really a living god! I thank you on behalf of my friend!"
Connor never thought that Vanessa would not only let him leave like this, but also give him a dress.
He took the dress and turned around to leave.
"Wait!"
But at this moment, Vanessa shouted again.
Connor was stunned for a moment, then turned his head to look at Vanessa and asked her, "President Canfield, is there anything else?"
"That…"
The expression on Vanessa's face was a little shy, and then she continued, "Did you see anything just now?"
"President Canfield, I was hiding behind your clothes just now. I didn't see anything." Connor hurriedly explained.
Vanessa looked at the clothes in the wardrobe and waved her hand at Connor with an annoyed expression.
Connor did not dare to stay any longer, so he picked up his dress and ran out.
Vanessa looked at Connor's back with a complicated expression. She secretly wondered if Connor had seen her when she changed her clothes.
Although Connor didn't admit it, Vanessa felt that he must've definitely seen something.
After all, this was a man's instinct. Even if an ordinary girl changed her clothes in front of a man, the man would probably take a few glances out of instinct.
But Vanessa also knew that Connor's identity was very special, she couldn't do anything to him.
"Hu…"
Vanessa took a deep breath, then tidied her clothes and walked out of the office.
After Connor left Vanessa's office, he found Chelsea, who was hiding in the bathroom, and handed her the dress.
A few minutes later, Chelsea changed into the dress and walked out of the bathroom.
"What took you so long?" Chelsea complained to Connor.
"Ma'am, did you know that I was almost caught just now? If it wasn't for you, how could I be in such a sorry state?" Connor shouted helplessly.
Of course, Connor couldn't tell anyone that he saw Vanessa changing clothes.
Chelsea smiled. He said, "Forget it. Since you found me a dress, I won't argue with you about this. Let's go to the party quickly!"
When Connor heard this, he subconsciously looked at his phone.
It had been ten minutes since the start of the party. Connor prayed in his heart that he hadn't missed anything.
A few minutes later, Connor entered the banquet hall. Although the party had already started, the boss of the Heavens Club hadn't shown up yet. Everyone was chatting in groups of three to five.
Vanessa was currently wearing a long dress with spaghetti straps, shuttling back and forth between the crowd. She kept chatting with these people, a sweet smile hanging on her face.
After Connor entered the hall, he saw Harold Phillips, Sheldon Statton and Jovan Lambert surrounding Arthur Synder as if they were talking about something.
Sabrina Ziegler and Sadie Colt were also chatting with the girls.
At this moment, there were a few dining cars in the corner of the hall. There were all kinds of pastries on the dining cars, but under normal circumstances, no one would come to eat these things.
Chelsea took a glass of red wine from the waiter and took a sip elegantly. "Connor, this party looks very high-class!" she exclaimed.
"Of course it is. All the big shots in Orilon are here…" Connor replied in a low voice.
Chelsea was stunned for a moment. "Then are you also a big shot?"
"A big shot?"
Connor couldn't help but be stunned when he heard this. Then, he continued, "These people are nothing in front of me!"
"You really know how to brag!"
Chelsea commented.
"Go play by yourself for now. I saw a friend, so I want to go and say hello to them!" Connor said in a low voice.
"Oh, okay!"
Chelsea nodded gently and walked away in her high heels.
Chelsea had just separated from Connor when a middle-aged man walked up to her and asked excitedly, "Miss Lee, why are you here?"
"Mr. Craft, we haven't seen each other since the last time we parted in the U.K, right?"
Chelsea replied indifferently.
"Yes, Miss Lee, I didn't expect you to come today!"
The middle-aged man looked at Chelsea with excitement and respect.
Chelsea said a few words to him, then went to the dining table and picked up a piece of cake. She quietly observed everyone in the hall.
At this moment, Chelsea no longer looked like a little woman. On the contrary, her temperament was abnormally elegant and noble.
…
After Connor and Chelsea parted, Connor went straight to Queta's side.
Queta understood what Connor meant and followed behind him.
A few minutes later, they went to a quiet spot.
"The Synder family is also interested in this club, right?" Connor asked.
"Yes, and according to my understanding, they have already found a lot of connections and raised a large sum of money. It seems that they are determined to get this club!" Queta answered directly.
"The Synder family actually has such great power?"
Connor asked in surprise.
He had some understanding of the Synder family's strength, which was why he felt that the Synder family did not have the strength to take down this club at all. After all, the Synder family was not as powerful as Queta's family was in terms of connections and financial strength.
"The Synder family must have received some help from some people. That's probably why they have such a big appetite. If we just rely on the Synder family, we can't do this at all!" Queta continued.
"They received help from others?"
Connor couldn't help but sneer when he heard Queta's words. He knew that the only people who could help the Synder family at this time were the people from Rockefeller.
"Is your father involved in this?" Connor whispered.
"No, my father said that Yaakov Ward is in charge of this matter. Rockefeller also values this club very much!"
Queta answered directly.

chapters.title: Chapter 1219: The Person Behind the Scenes
chapters.content:
Chapter 1219: The Person Behind the Scenes
"Yaakov Ward is behind this?"
After Connor heard Queta's words, a strange look flashed across his eyes.
Because he knew very well that if Yaakov War was really the one who was doing this, it meant that Locke's side must have attached great importance to the Heavens Club. Otherwise, they would never have sent Yaakov to do this.
Connor hesitated for a moment before asking again, "So the person behind the Synder family is Yaakov Ward?"
Queta nodded. "It's very possible. If it weren't for Yaakov's help, I really don't understand how the Synder family could raise so much money in such a short period of time!"
Connor took a deep breath. "Since this matter is related to Rockefeller and the Synder family, we can't let them get this club, no matter what!"
"Have you thought of a way to stop them?" Queta hurriedly asked.
"I don't have any good ideas for the time being. If the boss of the Heavens Club chooses to transfer the club to the Synder family, then I can only talk to the boss personally. If the soft way doesn't work, then I'll use force…" Connor replied in a low voice.
After Queta heard Connor's words, her expression became a little strange.
She was very aware of Connor's ability, so she also knew that his words were not a joke.
"If anything happens, let me know at any time!"
Connor was worried that if he continued to chat with Queta like this, he might be discovered, so after saying this, Connor planned to leave.
Queta hesitated for a moment before calling out to Connor. "By the way, about the matter between you and my father..."
"Don't worry, I've already reached an agreement with him. As long as your father listens to me obediently, I won't hurt him!" Connor replied in a low voice, then turned around and left.
Queta looked at Connor's back as he left. A strange look flashed across her eyes. She sighed helplessly, but did not say anything.
After Connor and Queta parted ways, he'd originally planned to meet up with Chelsea, but found that she wasn't in the hall.
Connor was worried that Chelsea would cause him some trouble, so he took out his phone to try calling her.
"Connor?"
But at this moment, a familiar voice called out from behind Connor.
Connor subconsciously turned his head and realized that the person who was talking to him was Sabrina, whom he had bumped into earlier.
At this moment, Sabrina, Sadie, and a few other girls that Connor didn't know were standing together. Sabrina looked at Connor in surprise.
After all, Sabrina already knew that Connor was Mr. McDonald of Porthampton. However, she could not understand why Connor would appear in Newtown.
"Sabrina, it's actually you!"
Connor said to Sabrina with a smile.
"That's right, big Connor. It is unexpected that I can actually meet you here…"
Sabrina shouted excitedly at Connor.
Sadie stood in place with a complicated expression on her face. She didn't even dare to say a word, and all kinds of emotions were intertwined in her heart.
Originally, Sadie thought that Connor would never appear in her life again, but she never thought that she would meet Connor again in Newtown.
When they were in Porthampton, Sadie had looked down on Connor. In Sadie's eyes, Connor was just a poor loser who was not worthy of her.
But later, Sadie found out that Connor was the Mr. McDonald of Porthampton, who was famous in the four provinces.
Sadie couldn't accept this change. Even after Connor left, she couldn't believe that all of this was true. However, as time passed, Sadie slowly began to accept that Connor was the young master of Porthampton.
At this moment, Sadie looked at Connor, her heart filled with endless regret.
Because she felt that she could have done something with Connor, but she personally ruined this opportunity.
Sadie did not choose to be with Sheldon because she had already met such an outstanding man like Connor.
It was obviously impossible for Sadie to go back to Sheldon.
Therefore, Sadie had always made up her mind to find a man who was better than Connor.
However, she might not know that it was not easy to find a man who was better than Connor.
"Connor, why are you in Newtown?"
Sabrina asked Connor happily.
"My fiancée is in Newtown, which is why I'm here!"
Connor knew Sabrina's feelings for him, but he only treated her as his younger sister. This was why he deliberately told her about Freya. His goal was to let Sabrina know that there was no ending between them.
This way, Sabrina could let go as soon as possible and find someone more suitable for her.
"Your fiancée?" When Sabrina heard this, she looked a little disappointed. She continued, "Connor, is your fiancée here today?"
"No, she's not!" Connor replied, then continued to ask, "Why did you come to Newtown?"
"I came here with Sadie and the others. We were originally here for a vacation, but when we heard that there was a party here, Harold Phillips got a few invitations and brought us in…" Sabrina replied absentmindedly.
"So that's how it is!"
Connor nodded with a smile and then continued, "Sabrina, I still have something to do over there. You guys play first. If you encounter any trouble, you can call me!"
"Alright…"
When Sabrina heard Connor's words, she looked even more disappointed. She nodded her head lightly and did not say anything.
The girls around Sabrina did not know Connor at all. After all, they were all from Newtown, not Porthampton.
"Sabrina, who was that person just now? He looks quite arrogant…"
One of the charming girls seemed to be dissatisfied with Connor's attitude just now, so she pouted and asked Sabrina.
When Sabrina heard the girl's words, she could not help but be stunned for a moment. Then, she quickly said, "Don't spout nonsense. Connor is very powerful…"
"Powerful?" When the woman heard this, she smiled disdainfully and said, "Why can't I see how powerful he is?"
"He's Mr. McDonald of Porthampton!" Sadie suddenly said.
When the girl next to Sabrina heard Sadie's words, she was stunned on the spot. Her face was filled with shock.
She stuttered and asked Sadie, "Sadie, are you kidding me? That person just now was Mr. McDonald of Porthampton?"
"Do you think I'm joking with you?"
Sadie replied expressionlessly.

chapters.title: Chapter 1220: You Want Me to Live off a Woman?
chapters.content:
Chapter 1220: You Want Me to Live off a Woman?
The girls present looked at Connor with incredulous expressions.
They had never expected that the ordinary-looking boy just now was actually the famous Mr. McDonald of Porthampton!
Sabrina looked at Connor's receding figure. There was clear disappointment in her eyes.
Because she could already feel that the distance between her and Connor was getting further and further, and this distance was something that nothing could make up for.
"Connor is not from the same world as us. So, we should let go of some things…"
Sadie said softly to Sabrina after a moment of hesitation.
"..."
Sabrina turned and glanced at Sadie. She took a deep breath and did not say anything.
The reason why Connor chose to leave suddenly was because he did not want to continue chatting with Sabrina and Sadie.
If they continued chatting like this, it would only make things more awkward for them. There was another important reason. He saw Chelsea Lee chatting with a beautiful young woman with a glass of red wine.
Connor knew that Chelsea had just returned to the country and was not qualified to attend this party at all. Therefore, he felt that Chelsea did not know that beautiful young woman. She just had nothing to do and was having small talk with those rich people.
However, he was worried that Chelsea would cause trouble for him, so he wanted to go over and warn her to stay away from these people.
If they were to find out that the two of them had climbed over the wall to get in, Connor might also be implicated.
However, before Connor could walk to where Chelsea was, he smelled a fragrance.
"Connor…"
Before Connor could react, a voice sounded behind him.
Connor turned around and saw Salma Thompson standing behind him.
"It's you. You're here too?"
Salma exclaimed when she saw Connor.
Meanwhile, Connor sized up Salma. She was wearing a black evening gown. Her originally fair skin looked even more translucent under the evening gown, giving off an exceptionally charming and sexy feeling.
Moreover, Salma was a tall girl. Now that she was wearing a pair of high heels, her height was almost the same as Connor.
"Yeah!"
Connor looked at Salma and lightly nodded before continuing, "Hehe, why are you here?"
"I didn't want to come, but my grandfather insisted on bringing me here. I had no choice but to follow. I didn't expect to meet you here…"
Salma paused for a moment before continuing, "Connor, are you here for Heavens Club?"
"That's right, I'm here for Heavens Club!"
Connor nodded lightly.
When Salma heard this sentence, her expression was filled with regret. She then said softly, "If that's the case, your chances are pretty low!"
"Why do you say so?"
Connor said softly.
"My grandfather told me that he's very interested in this Heavens Club, so no matter how much money he spends this time, he's going to take this club. So, your chances are low…"
Salma was not guarded against Connor, so she told him frankly.
Connor looked at Salma and smiled helplessly before continuing, "Isn't your family very rich? He's actually interested in such a club?"
"Do you really not understand or are you just pretending to not understand?
"There are so many people here, and most of them aren't here for money. They are all here for the connections of Heavens Club. Whoever takes gets Heavens Club will get the connections of this club!"
Salma said helplessly to Connor.
"I see…"
Connor nodded lightly.
Salma looked at Connor from head to toe. Although Salma knew that Connor's identity was not simple, she was not sure who he was.
Therefore, she kindly said to Connor, "Connor, let me tell you this, there are many people eyeing Heavens Club. My grandfather prepared three billion dollars this time just to take over this club, so if you don't have that much money, don't waste your time!"
"Three billion?"
Connor was instantly stunned when he heard Salma's words.
Although Connor was already rich enough to rival a country, and three billion was nothing to him at all, when he heard Salma say that the Thompson Family had prepared so much money to get Heavens Club, he was in disbelief.
After all, three billion was not a small amount.
When Salma saw how shocked Connor was, she smiled proudly and said, "You're shocked, aren't you? Do you know how rich our family is now?"
"Your family is indeed quite rich…"
Connor said helplessly to Salma.
However, Salma probably didn't know that the Thompson Family's assets were nothing compared to Connor's.
At this moment, Connor did not intend to continue discussing this topic with Salma, so he went along with what she said.
Salma hesitated for a moment before continuing, "Connor, actually, I have a way for you to get Heavens Club…"
"What way?"
Connor looked at Salma and asked.
"Actually, it's very simple. As long as you break up with your fiancée and be with me, not only will Heavens Club be yours, but all the assets of our family will also be yours. What do you think about that?"
Salma asked Connor with a smile.
"Aren't you just asking me to live off a woman?"
Connor said in a low voice.
"What's wrong with living off a woman? Some people can't even eat it if they want to!"
Salma pouted as she whispered to Connor.
Connor looked at Salma with a helpless expression.
This was because it was his first time hearing someone say that it was perfectly fine to live off a woman.
"So? Do you want to consider my suggestion?"
Salma asked Connor with a smile.
Connor looked at Salma with a helpless expression.
He really couldn't understand what was going on in her mind. She actually wanted him to marry into the Thompson Family.
If Connor were any other boy, he would not have rejected her.
After all, Salma was a top-notch beauty with such a terrifying family background. Whoever could marry a fair, rich, and beautiful woman like Salma would be blessed for generations to come. They would probably wake up laughing in their dreams.

chapters.title: Chapter 1221: A Charming Woman
chapters.content:
Chapter 1221: A Charming Woman
However, Connor was not interested in Salma. He only had Freya Phillips in his heart.
The things that Salma could offer were definitely very tempting if they were placed in front of ordinary people.
However, if it was in front of Connor, it was nothing at all.
After all, Connor was very rich. Even ten thousand Thompson Families could not compare to Connor alone.
As for Salma's appearance, although she was quite the looker, Connor had seen too many beautiful women. He was already numb to beautiful women.
"Connor, you'd better think it over quickly. If I change my mind one day and fall in love with someone else, you won't have this chance anymore. So, you better make a decision…"
Salma said with a smile.
"I'm sorry, I don't like you!"
Connor said expressionlessly.
"Why you…"
Salma was stunned when she heard his words. Her expression was one of disbelief.
Salma had always been the center of attention since she was young. She was an existence that was doted on by all kinds of boys, and no one would reject her.
It was not an exaggeration to say that with just one look from Salma, countless men would rush to her and fawn over her.
But including this time, Connor had already rejected Salma twice.
She had taken the initiative to confess twice since she was young, but she was rejected both times. For a moment, Salma was unable to accept it.
"Connor, you better not regret this!"
Salma shouted at Connor with her big watery eyes.
"What is there to regret…"
Connor replied indifferently.
"Why you…"
Salma looked at Connor as she was at the verge of breaking down. She stared at Connor with her big watery eyes, not knowing what to do.
"I have something to do now. See you!"
Connor whispered to Salma.
After saying this, Connor didn't give Salma any chance to ask him to stay as he walked toward Chelsea.
"Just you wait, Connor. Sooner or later, I'll make you regret it!"
Salma looked at Connor and shouted fiercely.
After separating from Salma, Connor went to Chelsea and winked at her.
Chelsea understood what Connor meant, so she excused herself from her conversation with a beautiful young woman and followed Connor to a corner.
"Is there something you want from me?"
Chelsea raised the red wine elegantly and asked Connor softly.
"Chelsea, do you know that woman just now?"
Connor asked Chelsea helplessly.
"I don't…"
Chelsea replied indifferently.
"Since you don't know her, why are you chatting with her?"
