When Connor heard Chelsea's words, he became even more devastated. Then, he continued, "Don't you know how the two of us came in? What if you expose yourself and others find out that we don't have invitations?"
"That woman took the initiative to talk to me. I didn't take the initiative to talk to her!"
Chelsea said as if he had been wronged.
"Either way, don't do it. From now on, you can't talk to anyone!
"If I find out that you're talking to someone else again, I'll kick you out. Do you hear me?"
Connor said in a very serious tone.
"But if I don't talk to anyone, what am I supposed to do?"
Chelsea blinked and asked Connor softly.
"Can't you just stay here obediently?"
Connor said helplessly.
"I came here to have fun. It's so boring for me to stand around and do nothing!"
Chelsea shouted unhappily.
When Connor heard Chelsea's words, he could not help but take a deep breath and then said in a low voice, "Do you see that food truck? Go there and eat some cake…"
"I don't want to eat cake…"
Chelsea shook her head.
"If you don't eat, we'll leave now!"
Connor gritted his teeth.
"No, the party's just getting started. I can't leave now…"
Chelsea said firmly.
Connor looked at Chelsea in exasperation. He really did not know what to say.
"Why do you keep watching me? I promise I won't cause you any trouble, and I won't let anyone find out that we climbed over the wall to get in. Even if they find out, I won't sell you out, okay?"
Chelsea looked at Connor and said.
Connor took a deep breath and said in a low voice, "You'd better not give me any trouble…"
"Don't worry, I'll definitely be obedient. Go do what you have to do!"
Chelsea replied irritably and pushed Connor away.
Connor hesitated for a moment before turning around and walking away.
Seeing that Connor had left, she continued to chat with others.
Connor looked at Chelsea, and his eyes were filled with despair.
At this moment, Connor saw the general manager of Heavens Club, Vanessa Canfield, walking onto the stage in high heels.
When Connor saw Vanessa go on stage, he put all his attention on her and didn't pay attention to Chelsea.
"Hello everyone, I am the general manager of Heavens Club, Vanessa Canfield!"
After Vanessa went on stage, she held the microphone and shouted softly.
When everyone heard her speak, they all quieted down and turned their heads to look at her.
At this moment, Vanessa was wearing a long dress with spaghetti straps. Her graceful figure could be seen at a glance. Coupled with her exquisite face, she instantly attracted the attention of countless people.
There were many men below the stage, all staring at her full chest and slender legs. However, these people could only look at her and did not dare to have any other thoughts.
After all, as long as it was a normal man, anyone who saw such a sexy and charming beauty would think about how exciting it would be if he could get her into bed!
Of course, the people present were only thinking about it in their hearts. They did not dare to take action at all.
After all, these people were all so-called successful people with countless beautiful women around them. They also knew very well that Vanessa was not someone they could easily touch. She was able to become the general manager of Heavens Club at such a young age, so she was definitely not a good person.
Moreover, the boss behind her was even more powerful, so no one dared to provoke Vanessa.
They knew that if they offended her, the consequences would be very miserable.

chapters.title: Chapter 1222: Encountering an Old Acquaintance!
chapters.content:
Chapter 1222: Encountering an Old Acquaintance!
Seeing that everyone had quieted down, Vanessa nodded gently at them.
In an instant, the hall was filled with a round of applause.
Vanessa smiled and said, "It's been 5 years since Heavens Club was founded. I've worked in this club for 5 years. I know that if it wasn't for the care of our distinguished guests, Heavens Club would never have reached its current position."
When everyone heard Vanessa's words, they clapped again.
Next, Vanessa went on to say some words of courtesy.
Vanessa was a very experienced woman. Even in the face of so many big shots from Orilon, she was still very calm and composed. There was also a kind smile on her face, as if she was no afraid of these people despite their identities.
Moreover, Vanessa seemed to have a naturally superior temperament, carrying with her a sense of dignity. No one would look down on Vanessa just because she was a woman.
"Vanessa's capability is definitely on par with Reena Satchwell and Queta Juve. She is a rare talent!"
Connor looked at Vanessa and couldn't help but analyze softly.
"Today, Heavens Club has invited all of you here. Firstly, we want to thank all of you for your support over the years. Secondly, due to various reasons, Heavens Club is preparing to transfer its ownership."
Vanessa looked at everyone and continued.
When everyone heard Vanessa's words, they all revealed excited expressions.
After all, they were all here for the Heavens Club. Now that Vanessa was finally talking about serious matters, how could they not be excited?
"Miss Canfield, how do you plan to transfer Heavens Club? Can you tell us so that we can be prepared!"
At this moment, a man in a suit shouted excitedly.
The man in the suit was the boss of a listed company. His net worth had already exceeded 10 billion, but at this time, when talking to Vanessa, he was still very polite.
"That's right, Miss Canfield. How do you plan to transfer the club?"
"Let's talk about it!"
"I heard that the Heavens Club's transfer method is to transfer it to whoever offers the highest price. Is that true?"
At this moment, another middle-aged man shouted.
After hearing everyone's questions, Vanessa smiled helplessly and said, "I know that everyone is anxious to know how our club will be transferred, but everyone knows that I'm just the general manager of Heavens Club. I'm not the owner of Heavens Club, so these things need to be personally explained to everyone by our boss…"
"The owner of Heavens Club?"
When everyone heard this, they revealed curious expressions.
After all, the boss of Heavens Club was very mysterious.
Heavens Club had been established for so many years, but the boss behind it had never appeared.
Even though Connor asked Rachel Wallace for help, she couldn't find out who the boss of Heavens Club was.
From this, one could see how mysterious the identity of the boss of Heavens Club was.
Of course, there was also a rumor that the owner of Heavens Club might be from Beverly Hills.
It was just that his identity was special, so he was hiding it.
Everyone had their own opinions on who the boss of Heavens Club was, but no one was 100% sure.
"Miss Canfield, where is the boss of your club? When is he coming?"
At this time, a more anxious young man frowned and asked Vanessa.
"That's right, Miss Canfield. Isn't the boss of Heavens Club way too mysterious? When will he be here?"
The others also shouted.
"Everyone, don't be anxious…"
Vanessa looked at everyone and laughed, then continued, "The boss of our club will be here soon, so I hope everyone can wait patiently…"
After everyone heard Vanessa's words, they were somewhat helpless, but no one dared to say anything.
After all, they didn't dare to offend Vanessa.
Moreover, what Vanessa meant was very obvious. That was, the boss of their club would definitely show himself today.
Everyone had already waited for such a long time, so they did not mind waiting a little longer.
"Who is the boss of Heavens Club? You sure like to keep people in suspense…"
Connor looked at Vanessa and couldn't help but sigh.
"Now, I announce that today's party has officially begun. I hope everyone can have fun."
"When everyone is done playing, the boss of our club will come out to talk to everyone about the transfer of the club…"
At this time, Vanessa shouted again.
Then, soothing music started playing in the hall.
The waiters began to serve all kinds of wine and delicacies and placed them on the table.
After waiting for so long, Connor was a little hungry.
Therefore, he walked to the dining table and casually found something to eat.
However, Connor was the only one at the dining table.
Because the others didn't seem to be interested in the food at all.
After all, everyone was here for the transfer of the club, not for food.
Arthur Synder, who was originally chatting with Harold Phillips, Jovan Lambert, and the others, saw Connor eating at a glance. A trace of ruthlessness flashed across his eyes, and then he walked to Connor's side.
"Mr. McDonald is the food here delicious?"
At this time, Arthur already had Rockefeller backing him up, so he did not put Connor in his eyes at all.
Although Connor was very influential in Porthampton, this was Newtown. Moreover, the Synder Family had Rockefeller as their backer, so he was not afraid of Connor at all.
"It's alright!"
Connor turned to look at Arthur and replied calmly.
"I didn't expect to meet an old acquaintance here!"
Harold also walked to Connor and said expressionlessly.
After Jovan's leg was broken by Connor, he had always been very afraid of Connor.
So, this time, Jovan had also learned to be smart and did not come over to provoke Connor.

chapters.title: Chapter 1223: Just a Puppet
chapters.content:
Chapter 1223: Just a Puppet
Upon seeing Harold approaching, Connor couldn't help but shake his head and said lightly, "I didn't expect you to have the guts to come and talk to me."
"Hehe, why wouldn't I dare to talk to you?" He looked at Connor and chuckled coldly, asking without expression.
"Are you not afraid of having your legs broken like Jovan?" Connor calmly said while eating.
"I am me. If you dare to touch me even once, I will make you regret coming into this world!" Harold said with a murderous tone.
"What a big talk. I think it's better for you to stay away from me." Connor said, expressionless.
"You..." Harold could feel that Connor's expression at that moment was extremely disdainful, so he wanted to say something.
"Harold, don't be impulsive!" Arthur quickly reached out to stop Harold. After all, they were at the party of the Heavens Club, and if Harold caused trouble here, not even Arthur could save him.
Furthermore, Arthur came here today to take over Heavens Club, so he didn't want any extra complications or trouble.
"Mr. Connor, are you also here for the transfer of Heavens Club?" Arthur smiled and asked Connor.
"Yes!" Connor nodded.
"Heavens Club is not something that just anyone can get. I see some people come here ostensibly for the transfer, but in reality, they just want to freeload and enjoy the food and drinks. When the time comes, they may not even be able to come up with the starting bid for Heavens Club..." Harold said with a strange tone.
Connor glanced at Harold, his expression somewhat helpless because he couldn't understand why Harold never learned his lesson. Connor had slapped Harold's face not just once or twice, yet Harold still tried to provoke him.
"What Harold said is not wrong. Heavens Club has attracted the interest of many powerful families. So if it's competed through auction, the starting bid will likely be astronomical, and ordinary people can't come up with that kind of money..." Arthur said with a smile.
"Mr. Arthur, I heard that the Synder family is also interested in Heavens Club. I wonder how much money you have prepared this time?" Sheldon walked up to Arthur's side and asked with a smile.
"Our family hasn't prepared a lot of funds, just 2 billion..." he replied calmly.
"2 billion?" After hearing his words, everyone was dumbfounded, their expressions incredibly incredulous.
Because they never expected that the Synder family would be so generous this time.
Connor looked at Arthur, Sheldon, and Harold in front of him. He understood that these three were obviously putting on a show in front of him.
And he was bored at the moment, so he quietly watched their performance.
After all, Sheldon, Harold, and Arthur didn't know that 200 million was nothing in Connor's eyes.
If it was a matter of wealth, even if they looked around the world, there might not be anyone richer than Connor.
Even though Rockefeller was very powerful, Rockefeller didn't belong to a single person.
And all of Steven's industries now belonged to him alone.
"Connor, are you also interested in Heavens Club? How much money have you prepared this time?" Sheldon turned his head and glanced at Connor, smiling as he asked.
"How much money have I prepared?" Connor couldn't help but pause for a moment after hearing Sheldon's words, then said lightly, "I haven't prepared much money!"
"How much is not much?" Harold asked.
"Five million..." Connor casually made up a number.
And after hearing his words, everyone was dumbfounded.
"Connor, are you joking with me? You actually only prepared five million?" Arthur asked with a surprised expression.
"It's just a small club. I think five million is enough!" Connor replied lightly.
"Connor, regardless of anything, you are still Mr. Connor of Porthampton. Don't you have Empire World Corporation? With several billion, you should be able to come up with that. You're simply joking with us by only preparing five million!" Arthur said in a loud voice, trying to humiliate Connor.
He wanted everyone present to know that Connor, as the owner of Empire World Corporation, was only prepared with five million and intended to take over Heavens Club.
And Harold also shouted, "Connor, are you really stupid or just pretending? Five million can't even buy a bar now. What are you thinking?"
"I'm not as rich as Mr. Arthur. Five million is not a small sum for me..." Connor saw that Arthur and Harold were enjoying the play, so he decided to continue with their act.
"You are truly amusing..." Arthur smiled helplessly at Connor and continued, "Actually, I heard a long time ago that you are nothing more than a puppet in Thomas' hands. Now, the one truly in charge of Empire World Corporation is him. At first, I was a bit skeptical, but now I believe it. A mere owner of Empire World Corporation can only come up with five million. You are truly laughable..."
Sheldon, Harold, and others looked at Connor's position, their expressions full of disdain.
Because they believed that he must be a puppet in Thomas's hands, and their fear of him naturally diminished.
Meanwhile, not far away, Jovan wore a helpless expression.
Others might not be clear about who Connor really was, but Jovan knew it very well.
Thomas's deep respect for Connor was deeply ingrained in his heart, so he understood that Connor was just deliberately playing with Arthur and Harold.
If Connor was truly just a puppet in Thomas's hands, then his father had no reason to fear Connor so much.
And Sadie, Sabrina, and others could naturally hear the conversation between Connor and Arthur.
Sabrina knew in her heart that Connor was not a puppet of Thomas, but Sadie found Arthur's words quite reasonable. She had always doubted Connor's identity transformation and couldn't believe that he had gone from a poor scavenger to a background-stunning super-rich second generation.
"So, it was all fake? Connor is just a puppet?" Sadie's expression seemed relieved, and her view of Connor had undergone a significant change.

chapters.title: Chapter 1224: The Thompson Family's Backup
chapters.content:
Chapter 1224: The Thompson Family's Backup
Those who were able to attend today's evening party were all influential figures in Orilon. Each of them had extraordinary means.
So when they heard what Arthur said, they looked down upon Connor in their hearts. They thought it was ridiculous for him to claim that he could acquire Heavens Club with just five million. It was nothing but a pipe dream.
However, these people were all cunning individuals. They certainly wouldn't discuss it openly like ordinary people. On the contrary, they acted as if they hadn't heard anything.
"Mr. Connor, I think it's impossible for you to acquire Heavens Club with just five million. But don't feel too sad. After all, the food here is delicious. You can eat more and then leave. That way, you won't have come here for nothing..." Arthur said with a smile.
Clearly, Arthur was intentionally humiliating Connor, and everyone understood the meaning behind his words.
"That's right, just treat it as expanding your horizons!" Harold grinned.
"Who said Connor can't acquire Heavens Club today?"
But at that moment, a cold and seductive voice resounded through the crowd.
Upon hearing this, Arthur couldn't help but pause for a moment and turned his head to look.
Salma gracefully walked up to Connor in her heels. After glancing at Arthur, she asked him softly, "Mr. Arthur, you said that Connor's five million is not enough to acquire Heavens Club. So tell me, how much money would be enough?"
Arthur looked at Salma in front of him, his expression somewhat puzzled. He couldn't understand why Salma chose to speak up for Connor at this moment.
After all, the Thompson family, to which Salma belonged, was quite powerful. Moreover, there had been ongoing cooperation between the Synder family and the Thompson family. Arthur didn't want to offend Salma in his heart. Everyone knew that the Thompson family regarded Salma as their future successor.
"Miss Salma, what do you mean by that?" Arthur asked Salma with a slightly awkward expression.
Salma had been by Frank's side all this time. When she saw Arthur and Harold humiliating Connor together, she felt extremely uncomfortable. After all, Salma genuinely liked him. Even though he had coldly rejected her advances several times, she still had the impulse to help him.
After receiving Frank's tacit approval, she stood up.
And Frank, who now knew Connor's identity, had her do this just to bring him closer to their side.
"My point is simple. Weren't you just mocking Connor earlier, saying that five million is insufficient to acquire Heavens Club? Well, now I want to ask you, what exactly would qualify?" Salma stood beside Connor and faced Arthur without expression.
Arthur took a deep breath and whispered, "Miss Salma, I didn't mean anything else. Connor only prepared five million to acquire this club, and I think it's a bit too little. That's why I believe he is not qualified to participate in the competition for Heavens Club!"
"I see!" Salma couldn't help but sneer, then said lightly, "Indeed, five million is not much..."
"Yes, five million is indeed a bit insufficient..." Arthur nodded lightly.
"But what if my family add thirty billion to it? I wonder if that would be enough?" The next sentence from Salma directly stunned everyone present.
No one had expected that the Thompson family would directly prepare thirty billion and even plan to help Connor acquire Heavens Club.
Everyone looked at Connor's position, unable to understand why he had gained the favor of Salma and the Thompson family.
Even Connor himself was perplexed. The five million was just something he casually mentioned. He had no intention of actually offering five million.
What he couldn't understand even more was why Salma chose to help him with so much money!
Could it be that she found her seduction ineffective and decided to use money to bribe him?
Arthur's expression also showed confusion. He took a step forward, furrowed his brow, and asked Salma, "Miss Salma, the affairs of the Thompson family shouldn't be decided by you, right?"
"The affairs of our my family are naturally not decided by me, but can't I still have some say?" At that moment, Frank stepped forward, expressionless, and said.
"This..." Arthur was instantly stunned.
"On behalf of our Thompson family, I declare that all the bidding funds participated by Mr. Connor will be provided by our family. Our family will also do our best to cooperate with Mr. Connor in acquiring Heavens Club!" Frank said calmly.
Everyone looked at Frank's position, their expressions extremely complex, and their moods exceptionally gloomy.
After all, they were well aware of the economic power of the Thompson family. If the Thompson family chose to help Connor and go all out, they would have no hope whatsoever.
In terms of wealth alone, there was no one in the entire Orlin who could compare to the Thompson family.
Sabrina looked at Connor's position and sighed inwardly, "No wonder Connor always avoided facing my feelings for him. It turns out he has found someone more suitable for him!"
Harold and Sheldon couldn't understand it either. They couldn't comprehend why Connor always had such good luck. Back in Porthampton, Kiki Yonder had helped him, and Minnie Sander had also assisted him. Now, in Newtown, it was even more unbelievable that he had gotten involved with the Thompson family's heir.
Harold thought that although Connor had a decent appearance, he wasn't an exceptionally handsome guy. Why did he have such good luck with women?
Sadie also couldn't understand any of this.
Chelsea stood in the distance, looking at Connor's position, and whispered, "I didn't expect that Connor would actually know people from the Thompson family. His luck is really good..."
"Connor, let's go!" Salma called out to Connor with an expressionless face, and she even took the initiative to link her arm with his.
After seeing them leave, the onlookers secretly speculated about their relationship.
Previously, everyone had looked down upon him, but if he was going to become the son-in-law of the Thompson family, the situation might be completely different.

chapters.title: Chapter 1225: The Club Owner
chapters.content:
Chapter 1225: The Club Owner
"When did I ever ask for your help?" Connor whispered to Salma as they moved to a distance.
"You never asked me to help," she calmly replied to him.
"Then why did you say those things in front of everyone? Your words could easily make others misunderstand our relationship, don't you realize that?" he said to her with a hint of helplessness.
She took a deep breath and whispered, "Connor, I am willingly offering money to help you now. Do you know how many people want this opportunity but can't get it?"
"I don't need your help right now!" he directly responded to her.
"You..." Salma looked at Connor in speechlessness and then said softly, "Don't you want to acquire Heavens Club?"
"Of course, I want to acquire Heavens Club, but I will do it my own way. The Thompson family can also participate in the competition. As long as the club doesn't end up in the hands of Arthur and the Synder family, that's all I care about," Connor said softly to Salma.
Salma couldn't help but turn her head and look at him for a moment before whispering, "Connor, do you dislike me that much?"
"I don't dislike you. On the contrary, I think you are a good person. But I already have a fiancee, and I don't want to do anything that would betray her. So no matter how much money you offer, I cannot be with you. I believe that one day you will find someone who suits you," he calmly explained to her.
She turned to him hesitatingly for two seconds, then whispered, "I never thought that I, Salma, would end up like this. I used to be the one rejecting others, but now it seems like others are always rejecting me. I'm really curious about who your fiancee is, someone who can earn such unwavering loyalty from you."
"My fiancee is the most perfect woman in this world," he said lightly.
"Alright then, let's just be friends from now on," she said proactively, knowing that she might truly have no hope anymore.
"Okay." He nodded gently.
"Do you still need my help in acquiring Heavens Club?" Salma asked Connor again, looking at him.
"No, I don't. As long as Heavens Club doesn't end up in the hands of Arthur, if the Thompson family needs my help, I can assist you," he said calmly.
"What can you do to help us?" she responded in a frustrated tone, then turned and walked back to Frank's side.
Connor sighed helplessly as he watched Salma's figure. He knew that his words earlier had been quite serious, but he felt it was better to be clear and not let Salma continue to misunderstand.
On the other side, after Salma returned to Frank's side, she said with a dejected expression, "Grandfather, I failed. Connor said he doesn't need our help!"
"Hehe..." Frank chuckled lightly upon hearing this, then with an expressionless face, he said, "A mere 30 billion isn't enough to move Mr. Connor of Porthampton. But my goal has been achieved, and you have completed your task..."
"Grandfather, what do you mean by that?" She paused, looking at him with a puzzled expression.
"Connor is Mr. Connor, the rich heir of Porthampton. His assets have long surpassed trillions and he would never be interested in the things our Thompson family has. The reason I had you do this was simply to build a good relationship between you and Connor. After all, if our Thompson family encounters any trouble in the future, Connor wouldn't just stand by, considering your face," Frank, the old fox, had been using Salma's feelings for Connor to win him over. He knew very well that Salma and their Thompson family were not on par with Connor.
"Connor's assets have surpassed trillions?" Salma was dumbfounded upon hearing Frank's words, her face showing shock.
"And that's just a conservative estimate. His overseas assets are even more terrifying," Frank sighed lightly.
Salma subconsciously looked towards Connor's position, her expression a mix of shock and astonishment.
Meanwhile, Vanessa stepped onto the stage, wearing high heels, when she felt the time was right.
"Ladies and gentlemen, how is everyone enjoying themselves? Are you satisfied with the hospitality of our club?" After stepping onto the stage, Vanessa smiled and asked the crowd.
"President Xia, please don't keep us in suspense. When will your club's owner appear?" "Yeah, President Xia, we've been waiting for so long just to see your boss. Is he coming today or not?" "Tell us about the club transfer already!"
The crowd seemed impatient, their voices filled with urgency as they questioned Vanessa.
Upon hearing the words of the crowd, Vanessa smiled faintly and said, "Don't be so impatient, everyone. In fact, our club's owner has already arrived a long time ago, and she has been observing all of you in secret..."
Vanessa's words were like a bolt from the blue, directly hitting the people present.
No one had expected that the owner of Heavens Club had already arrived and was among them.
People began to look around, trying to find the owner of the club among themselves.
Even Connor was curious about who the owner of this club could be. He looked around but couldn't find anyone who seemed like the owner.
"Alright, I won't keep you in suspense. Now, let's invite the owner of our Heavens Club to come on stage and talk about the club transfer!" Vanessa said with a beaming smile before stepping back behind the stage.
At this moment, everyone held their breath, their attention focused on the area below the stage.
Because they knew that the person walking up from below the stage at this moment should be the owner of Heavens Club.
"Why make such a big fuss about a club owner? Is it necessary to be so secretive?" Connor couldn't help but mutter in his heart.
But the next second, he froze in place.
He saw Chelsea, wearing delicate high heels, exuding charm as she walked out from the crowd.
His initial reaction was that she was coming towards him.
But the next second, Connor realized that she was actually heading directly towards the stage.

chapters.title: Chapter 1226: The Price of the Auction
chapters.content:
Chapter 1226: The Price of the Auction
"Chelsea is the owner of the Heavens Club? How is that possible?"
Connor stared at Chelsea, disbelief on his face.
He couldn't believe that she was the boss of the Heavens Club!
But when he saw Vanessa take the initiative to pass the microphone to Chelsea, he knew that he was not mistaken—It turned out that the beautiful woman who had been pestering him was really the boss of the Heavens Club.
Today, Chelsea was not dressed very formally. Her original short skirt was accidentally torn when she climbed over the wall, so Chelsea was wearing the mini skirt that Vanessa had given Connor. The skirt was very short, and her slender and fair legs were exposed to everyone's eyes. Especially under the light, they practically emitted an extremely attractive glow.
Chelsea had a very good figure and was very beautiful, so she could wear someone else's clothes perfectly.
Chelsea's sexy figure, coupled with her exquisite face, made her look very alluring and beautiful. It was as if every part of her body was crafted to attract the opposite sex.
Her facial features were young, her face was fair, her lips were rosy, and her eyes were charming.
It was almost impossible to find any flaws.
The guests present were all stunned by Chelsea's beauty. Even Vanessa paled in comparison to her.
Meanwhile, Connor stood rooted to the ground with a dumbfounded expression on his face.
He never expected Chelsea to be the boss of the Heavens Club!
At this moment, Connor only had one thought in his mind, and that was to rush in front of Chelsea and ask him why she had lied to him!
Chelsea was clearly the owner of the Heavens Club, so why did he climb over the wall with him? Wasn't he obviously playing with him?
At this time, Connor finally understood why Vanessa didn't pursue the matter of him stealing the clothes. Vanessa must've immediately recognized him when she saw him, and all of this was because Chelsea was the owner of the club. She must've known that Connor was stealing clothes for Chelsea.
Connor felt that he had been played by Chelsea from the beginning to the end!
The owner of the Heavens Club, whom Connor had tried so hard to find, had actually been by his side all along.
However, there was one thing that Connor could not understand. If Chelsea was really the boss of the Heavens Club, then she must have hit his car on purpose. She had also deliberately waited for him at the back wall. This meant that Chelsea was deliberately approaching him!
However, Connor did not understand. What was her purpose in getting close to him?
Could it be that she was here for his inheritance?
At this moment, the more Connor thought about it, the more he felt that something was wrong. He knew clearly that there must be some inside story about these things. Chelsea definitely had some motive behind her actions.
"I'm very sorry to have made everyone wait for so long!"
At this moment, Chelsea spoke to everyone.
Everyone seemed to be still in shock, and the beautiful women there were regaining their senses.
Chelsea smiled and continued, "Five years ago, I founded the Heavens Club. However, due to various reasons, I have been living abroad and had no way to return to the country. That's why I gave this club to Vanessa to manage, and this is also why I haven't shown my face in the past five years and no one knows me…"
Connor looked at Chelsea. He no longer believed a word this woman said because he felt that this woman was a real actor.
"Thank you very much for your support to our club for so many years. I also thank you very much for coming to tonight's party. Due to some special reasons, I don't plan to continue running this club. It's not that there's any problem with the club, but I do think we should find a more suitable owner for this club. As an irresponsible owner, I'm not qualified to continue running it. Therefore, the information you received before was correct. the Heavens Club is indeed going to be transferred…"
Chelsea continued.
"Then Miss Lee, how do you plan to transfer it?"
A middle-aged man asked excitedly.
"The transfer will be done through competitive bidding!" Chelsea replied indifferently and then continued, "But it will be different from other bids. I still have feelings for this club, so I don't want to transfer the club in the normal way. I think that if I do that, I might let down the efforts of all the employees who have been working for many years!"
"Then how do you want to transfer it?"
"I'll send everyone a tender document later. Anyone who wants to participate in the bidding can get a copy. What you need to do now is to write how much you're willing to pay for this club."
Chelsea looked at everyone calmly.
When everyone heard Chelsea's words, a hint of helplessness flashed across their eyes.
They knew that although Chelsea said that her bidding method was different from others, in the end, the one who had the most money would get the Heavens Club.
Arthur looked at Chelsea, but the expression on his face seemed a little proud.
After all, he had prepared well for this bid. Among so many people present, it seemed that only the Thompson family could compete with him.
At this moment, Chelsea continued. "I know very well that many people are interested in our club, so I've decided to make the bidders pay a price!"
When everyone heard Chelsea's words, their expressions were a little puzzled.
They didn't know what Chelsea meant by the price!
"Miss Lee, what price do you mean?"
Arthur asked.
After hearing Arthur's words, Chelsea smiled faintly and said softly, "This price is actually very simple. Once all bidders participate in the bidding, regardless of whether they win the bid or not, they must pay 10% of the bidding price!"
Everyone was shocked because they knew the value of the Heavens Club.
Even if it was 10% of the price, it was still a terrifying figure. Moreover, this money was very likely to be wasted.
This meant that the higher the bid, the greater the risk.

chapters.title: Chapter 1227: Five Billion Dollars
chapters.content:
Chapter 1227: Five Billion Dollars
"Also, this 10% bidding fee is not for me, but for the successful bidder! Therefore, before bidding, I hope that everyone can consider the risks clearly. No matter the final result, I will not return this money!" Chelsea explained.
The bosses present were all dumbfounded and began to discuss amongst their men in low voices.
After all, Chelsea's actions were obviously made to deliberately suppress the price of everyone's bid. In this case, when everyone bid, they would have to consider whether they could afford the consequences.
Arthur had prepared nearly two billion today. If he was surpassed by someone else, he would have to bear the loss of two hundred million dollars!
Although 200 million dollars was not a lot, it was a huge sum of money for the Synder family!
Everyone fell into silence.
They knew in their hearts that this kind of bidding would be very different from the usual bidding.
Under such rules, some people might plan to pay a lot of money, but they would be worried that they would fail, so they would lower the amount they were willing to give.
This way, it would give others a chance.
This also caused the outcome of this bidding to become somewhat unpredictable.
Connor looked at Chelsea on the stage. He could not understand why she was doing this.
At this moment, Chelsea asked the crowd again.
"Does everyone understand the rules?"
"I understand!" everyone hurriedly replied.
"Alright, if you want to participate in the bidding now, you can go to Vanessa to get the bidding document. I'll give everyone twenty minutes to consider!"
After saying that, Chelsea turned around and walked backstage.
After she left, the guests all ran to Vanessa and asked for the bidding document.
Connor originally thought that once Chelsea's rule was announced, many people would definitely give up bidding—After all, 10% of the bidding fee was not a small amount!
But what Connor didn't expect was that these people's enthusiasm didn't decrease at all. On the contrary, they all felt that this was an opportunity, so those who had already given up were actually prepared to participate in the bidding.
Connor was no longer interested in this bid. He wanted to find out why Chelsea had approached him.
Arthur took the bidding document from Vanessa's hands and then returned to Jeremiah Synder's side. He asked in a low voice, "Dad, how much should we write now?"
Arthur was also worried that if he really wrote 2 billion and lost to the Thompson family, he might lose 200 million in vain. This was not a small amount of money!
"I didn't expect the owner of the Heavens Club to be so smart to use such a method to attract more people to participate in the bidding!"
Jeremiah's expression was a little awkward. Then, he continued, "The Thompson family's bid should be around three billion now. We're giving away money for free by writing down two billion…"
Arthur hesitated for a moment before asking softly, "Then how about we write 3.5 billion?"
"Are you crazy? President Wilson only gave us two billion, so where do you plan to get the remaining 1.5 billion? And how can you guarantee that we will definitely win the bid in the end?" Jeremiah asked in a low voice.
"Then are we just going to give up like this?" Arthur said with a frown.
"Of course not!"
Jeremiah shook his head gently and said in a low voice, "Wait for me here. I'll call President Wilson..."
"Alright!"
Arthur nodded.
A few minutes later, Jeremiah returned to Arthur's side.
"Dad, what did President Wilson say?" Arthur hurriedly asked.
"President Wilson's meaning is very simple. He just told me that as long as we can get the Heavens Club within 5 billion, there will be no problem. However, if we don't get the Heavens Club in the end, we'll have to pay the 500 million bidding fee ourselves!" Jeremiah said with some hesitation.
"Dad, I think we can take a gamble. After all, President Wilson promised us that as long as we take down the Heavens Club, he will give us 20% of the shares. Moreover, the price of five billion is already very, very high. I don't think even the Thompson family can afford this money, so we still have a chance…"
Arthur said in a low voice.
"Although you say that, 500 million is not a small amount. I'm worried…"
Jeremiah said with a frown.
"Dad, this is the only chance for our Synder family to make a comeback. If we can really get the Heavens Club, I think everything will be worth it…" Arthur gritted his teeth and replied.
Jeremiah turned his head to look at Arthur and said in a low voice, "You're right. This is a chance for our Synder family to turn things around. It's worth gambling for with 500 million dollars…"
After saying this, Jeremiah directly wrote down five billion on the bidding document and signed his name.
As for the Thompson family, after they received the bidding document, Frank Thompson wrote down the number of three billion without any hesitation.
After all, a mere three billion dollars was nothing to the Thompson family.
If he won the bid in the end, that would be the best. If they didn't win the bid and lost 300 million, it was acceptable.
The Thompson family had always been rich, so they did not care about this bit of money.
The people present were also hoping to get lucky and wrote down the price in their hearts.
Meanwhile, Connor stood there without moving. He had no intention of participating in the bidding at all.
Vanessa glanced at Connor and gave her assistant a few simple instructions. Then, she picked up a bidding document and walked up to Connor.
Vanessa handed the bidding document to Connor and said respectfully, "Mr. McDonald, Miss Lee said that you're also very interested in our clubhouse, so she hopes that you can participate in the bidding!"
"You guys are just trying to get money from the hands of the giant. This Chelsea is not a good person!"
Connor replied helplessly.
"Mr. McDonald, you can interpret it however you want. If you don't want to participate in the bidding, that's fine too!" Vanessa said helplessly.
Connor hesitated for two seconds, then took the bidding document and immediately wrote down 100,000 on the bidding document.
After Vanessa saw the number Connor wrote down, a trace of helplessness flashed in her eyes.
She knew that Connor was just casually writing for fun.
Connor returned the bidding document to Vanessa and said fiercely, "Let me tell you, your boss Chelsea still owes me a repair fee. If I lose the bid, ask her for the 10% bidding fee. Don't come to me…"

chapters.title: Chapter 1228: Dance Partner
chapters.content:
Chapter 1228: Dance Partner
Vanessa looked at Connor with an expression of helplessness.
She couldn't believe that the man standing in front of her was the Mr. McDonald of Porthampton, who had more than a trillion dollars in assets.
Twenty minutes passed quickly, and all the bids had been submitted.
Chelsea appeared on the stage again and said in a deep voice, "Miss Canfield is currently leading some people to tabulate the bidding documents, so let's have a dance party first to adjust our mood!"
Everyone looked at Chelsea, their expressions somewhat speechless.
After all, in their eyes, the bidding was the most important thing. However, Chelsea still wanted to hold the party as usual.
Even though the majority of the people were slightly unhappy in their hearts, those young geniuses present were already eager to give it a try.
They knew that Chelsea was not a simple woman. If they could dance with her, they would get to know her. In that case, they might be able to get Chelsea's favor, and their coming here today would not have been in vain!
Therefore, many people were preparing to invite Chelsea to dance.
However, Connor suddenly remembered that Chelsea seemed to have been shouting to dance since he entered the hall. Moreover, she even said that he wanted to be Connor's dance partner!
"Is Chelsea going to dance with me?"
A bold idea suddenly flashed through Connor's mind.
As expected, Chelsea's gaze happened to fall on Connor.
Chelsea smiled faintly and walked towards him in her high heels.
Connor stood there foolishly, not knowing what to do.
At this moment, the crowd dispersed like a tide.
Everyone took the initiative to make way for Chelsea, and they were all looking forward to who Chelsea would choose as his dance partner.
At this moment, Arthur was standing in front of Connor. Arthur was definitely the most handsome and muscular one among all the young masters present. Moreover, Arthur was a good dancer. When he saw Chelsea walking towards him, his expression was unusually excited, and his heart began to beat faster.
He knew that Chelsea was definitely here for him.
This was because other than Arthur, no one else could enter Chelsea's eyes.
Arthur waited excitedly, as if he had already thought about how to accept Chelsea's invitation.
"Are you willing to be my dance partner?"
At this moment, Chelsea's voice sounded in Arthur's ear.
"It is my honor to be your dance partner…"
Arthur replied with some excitement and then stretched out his right hand.
However, in the next second, Chelsea pushed Arthur away and said with a pout, "I'm not talking to you!"
For a moment, Arthur was stunned on the spot, and the expression on his face was unusually ugly.
Nothing could be more humiliating than that!
Chelsea's voice was very loud, so everyone naturally heard it clearly.
If it wasn't for giving Arthur some dignity, these people would probably have laughed out loud long ago.
After Chelsea pushed Arthur away, she walked directly to Connor.
At this moment, Connor and Chelsea were very close. Connor could even smell the alluring aura on her body.
She walked up to Connor and asked him softly, "Connor, are you willing to be my dance partner?"
When everyone heard Chelsea's words, they were all surprised because they did not expect her to choose Connor as his dance partner.
The expression on Arthur's face became even uglier. If Chelsea had chosen someone else, Arthur might not be so embarrassed, but she just had to pick Connor out of everyone here!
"No, I don't know how to dance!"
However, no one expected Connor to directly reject Chelsea in front of so many people.
To be able to become Chelsea's dance partner was something that many people present dreamed of!
But at this moment, this opportunity was placed in front of Connor, and she actually rejected it like this.
Everyone was dumbfounded.
Even Arthur could not understand what was going on.
Chelsea did not get angry at Connor's rejection. Instead, she leaned her little head close to Connor's ear. Her sexy red lips opened and closed as she said softly, "Connor, this is my clubhouse. Isn't it a little inappropriate for you to reject me in front of so many people? I'll be very embarrassed if you do this…"
Connor hesitated for a moment before saying softly, "I can dance with you, but you have to tell me why you lied to me."
"I'll explain it to you when we dance…" Chelsea replied to Connor indifferently. Then, she grabbed Connor's hand and pulled him towards the dance floor.
No one expected that Chelsea would drag Connor away even after he'd rejected her.
Connor had no other choice. He knew that if he continued to reject her, it might make her very embarrassed, so he could only follow her to the dance floor.
The music started.
"I don't know how to dance…" Connor muttered.
"This thing is very simple. I'll teach you!"
As Chelsea spoke, she placed Connor's hand on her slender waist and her other hand on Connor's shoulder.
Connor looked helpless, but he could only cooperate with Chelsea and start to move his body gently.
Connor felt that dancing was not interesting at all. He did not know why so many rich people liked to do it. Could it be that they only wanted to take advantage of the social opportunities while dancing?
But no matter what, Chelsea's waist still felt good.
Not far away, Salma Thompson's expression was unusually furious when she saw Connor and Chelsea dancing.
She could not help but curse in a low voice, "This damned Connor. Why is he hooking up with Chelsea?"
Originally, Salma was also the target of those young geniuses who fought to be the first to invite her. However, Salma was currently in a very bad mood. As long as it was someone who came to invite her, they would be scolded away by Salma in the end.
In the middle of the dance floor, Connor whispered, "Now that I'm dancing with you, can you tell me why you lied to me?"
"You haven't learned how to dance yet. I'll tell you when you learn…"
"Why would I learn this when I have nothing better to do?"
"This is basic etiquette in high society. If you don't know how to dance, you'll be laughed at!" Chelsea said earnestly.

chapters.title: Chapter 1229: The Jealous Salma Thompson
chapters.content:
Chapter 1229: The Jealous Salma Thompson
"Laughed at?"
After hearing Chelsea's words, Connor couldn't help but laugh. Then, he said indifferently, "I've been laughed at many times. It doesn't matter if I'm laughed at once or twice!"
"You're so rich, but you've actually been laughed at?"
Chelsea asked Connor in confusion.
"How do you know I'm rich?"
Connor was stunned for a moment and asked in a low voice.
"Didn't you say it just now? I'm deliberately getting close to you. Since I'm deliberately getting close to you, I naturally know your situation very well…"
Chelsea did not hide anything and replied directly.
"Now, can you tell me why you approached me?"
Connor frowned and asked.
Chelsea looked at Connor and hesitated for a couple of seconds. Then, he said indifferently, "I approached you because of a feeling…"
"Feeling?"
When Connor heard Chelsea's words, he seemed to be a little puzzled. He secretly sighed deep down. Was Chelsea also interested in him?
If it was the Connor from before, he would definitely not think so.
After all, at that time, Connor was a poor loser. But now, Connor was different!
"That's right, it's because of a feeling!"
Chelsea nodded and continued, "Don't worry, I'm not a bad person, and I don't have any intention of harming you!"
"How do I know you won't harm me?"
Connor asked in a low voice.
"You will know soon!"
Chelsea said lightly.
At this moment, countless people's attention was on Connor and Chelsea.
The whispers between the two of them were seen as a romantic conversation between lovers.
Arthur was unusually angry. He could not understand what was going on. Connor was already together with Freya Phillips.
So why was he flirting with Chelsea now?
Sadie Colt, Sabrina Ziegler, and the rest could not figure out the relationship between Connor and Chelsea!
Connor's learning ability was pretty good. Coupled with Chelsea's patient guidance, he quickly learned how to dance, and his movements gradually became more fluid.
When the music ended.
Everyone present was probably giving Chelsea face, so they started clapping.
Connor was still very puzzled because he still did not understand what Chelsea wanted to do!
"Everyone, don't just stand there. Hurry up and dance together. After the ball ends, I'll announce the result of the bid to everyone…"
Chelsea smiled as he spoke to the crowd.
After hearing Chelsea's words, everyone invited their partners and began to dance.
Connor had no interest in dancing, so he turned around and wanted to find a quiet place to rest.
As the owner of Heavens Club, Chelsea not only had an amazing background, but she was also very beautiful.
Therefore, many people wanted to invite Chelsea to dance, but without exception, they were all rejected by Chelsea.
Arthur wanted to invite Chelsea to dance, but when he thought about the embarrassing incident that happened before, he gave up on the idea.
He knew that if he was rejected by Chelsea a second time, it would only make him more embarrassed.
There were so many women in the hall, and the most outstanding one was definitely Chelsea. The one after Chelsea would surely Salma Thompson.
However, because of the ambiguous relationship between Connor and Chelsea, Salma was in a very bad mood. No matter who invited her to dance, they would be rejected.
However, what made everyone even more confused was that after Salma had rejected so many young men, she actually walked toward Connor in her high heels.
At this moment, all the guys present were very envious of Connor.
This was because they could not understand what was so good about Connor that not only did he get Chelsea's favor, but even Salma was interested in him.
"Connor, come and dance with me!"
Salma coldly said to Connor.
"I don't like to dance, go find someone else!"
Connor had no interest in dancing at all, so he rejected her.
"If you don't like dancing, then why did you dance with Chelsea? If you can dance with Chelsea, why can't you dance with me?"
Salma shouted at Connor with jealousy.
When Connor heard Salma's words, a trace of helplessness flashed across his eyes.
"You must dance with me today!"
Salma didn't give Connor a chance to speak as she dragged him toward the dance floor.
Connor looked at Salma with a helpless expression.
However, with so many people watching, if Connor didn't give Salma face, she would definitely make a scene. Thus, Connor could only choose to compromise.
Everyone could not understand who Connor was and why he had such great charm.
At this moment, the two most beautiful women in the hall were actually fighting to dance with Connor. It was rather enviable!
"What's your relationship with Chelsea Lee?"
Salma asked Connor as she danced.
"There's nothing going on between us…"
Connor replied in a low voice.
"Nonsense. If there's nothing going on between the two of you, why would she dance with you?"
Salma asked fiercely.
"There's really nothing going on between the two of us. I've only known her for less than two days…"
Connor said with a frown.
"She wants to dance with you after knowing you for two days? Who would believe that! So many people here have invited Chelsea to dance, but she rejected them all. Only you got to dance with her. The relationship between the two of you must not be a simple one..."
Salma said as she stomped on Connor's foot with her high heels.
"What are you doing?"
Connor exclaimed.
"What is your relationship with Chelsea?"
Salma repeated softly.
"Salma, I've only known Chelsea for two days. I don't even know who she is. What kind of relationship can we have?"
Connor explained in a speechless manner.
Salma did not hesitate at all as she stomped on Connor's foot.
"Can you stop stepping on my feet…"
Connor looked at Salma and asked helplessly.
"I can't…"
Salma replied proudly.
At this moment, Connor finally understood that there were some women that he really couldn't afford to offend. For example, a woman like Salma.
Connor did not even know what his relationship with Chelsea was.
Moreover, Salma wasn't Connor's girlfriend. Connor didn't understand why Salma was jealous.
...

chapters.title: Chapter 1230: The Most Handsome Man
chapters.content:
Chapter 1230: The Most Handsome Man
The dance party lasted for nearly half an hour.
During this half an hour, everyone's mind was not on dancing at all.
They were most concerned about the transfer of the club.
Many people participated in the bidding, and they even filled in the price in their hearts.
They didn't know who would end up with the Heavens Club.
Moreover, they were all secretly praying that they would win the bid. Therefore, this ball was simply a torture for everyone.
Everyone hoped that the ball would end soon.
This was especially true for the father and son of the Synder Family. After all, the two of them had offered a very high price for the club, so they had taken the greatest risk.
If Arthur could get Heavens Club in the end, that would be fine.
However, if Arthur did not win the bid, then the Synder Family might be in big trouble.
Everyone was waiting anxiously, and the ball was finally coming to an end.
When everyone heard the music end, they became a little excited.
Because they knew that today's highlight was finally about to begin.
Vanessa Canfield who was wearing a long white dress and walked onto the stage gracefully. She then said softly, "I know that everyone is very nervous right now, so I'll cut to the chase. Now, let's welcome the boss of Heavens Club, Miss Chelsea Lee, to announce the transfer of Heavens Club!"
When everyone heard this, they began to applaud, feeling extremely nervous.
Chelsea slowly walked onto the stage and waved at the crowd.
For a moment, everyone fell silent.
Because they knew in their hearts that the most exciting moment was finally coming.
"As I've told you before, I have a deep affection for Heavens Club. Although I've never participated in the management of Heavens Club, this is my first company. It has a very special meaning to me. However, due to some special reasons, I have to transfer this club's ownership!"
Chelsea's voice was very pleasant to the ear and carried a hint of majesty.
At this moment, the hall was silent, as if the sound of a pin dropping could be heard.
"The reason why I haven't appeared until today is because I've been secretly observing everyone. I can tell that almost everyone who is here at the banquet is interested in our club. Everyone must also be interested in the commercial value of our club…"
Chelsea spoke again.
After hearing Chelsea's words, a strange look flashed across everyone's eyes.
Everyone began to recall if they had said anything bad about Heavens Club.
If Chelsea really heard them say something like that, not only would they not get Heavens Club, but it might also bring them some unnecessary trouble.
"However, it's actually my honor that you're interested in Heavens Club. It shows that Heavens Club is very valuable. Additionally, you're all businessmen. Of course, businessmen want to make money."
Chelsea continued.
Everyone looked at Chelsea and did not say anything.
"Just now, I took a quick look at your bidding price. I have to say that everyone here really values Heavens Club. The amounts I've seen have surprised me. If it weren't for the bids, I might not have known that my club was so valuable!"
Chelsea smiled faintly and continued, "Before the bid, I told you that you need to pay 10% of the bidding fee. I believe that everyone has already paid the required amount. I asked the staff to calculate the amount received, and the total came up to 1 billion and 30 million dollars."
When everyone heard what she said, they all revealed an incredulous expression. They were dumbfounded.
"That's a lot!"
"Yeah, I didn't expect the bidding fee to reach such a high amount…"
"Anyone who gets Heavens Club today will really be rich!"
"I wonder who is that lucky…"
Everyone began to discuss in low voices.
They were also unusually excited. After all, just this bidding fee alone was a huge sum!
Although most of the people present were worth tens of billions, when faced with this sum of money, it was still rather shocking.
"I've already told everyone that our club's bid this time will be very different from the usual bids. So I can tell everyone that the bid of the successful bidder is very special. Even I was shocked when I saw the price…"
Chelsea spoke again.
"The bid is very special?"
"Shocked?"
When everyone heard Chelsea's words, they became somewhat puzzled.
They didn't know what Chelsea meant.
Arthur was very smug because he felt that the bid he had placed was the most special one. The bid of five billion would definitely surprise Chelsea.
After all, the outside world's valuation of Heavens Club was only about three billion.
But Arthur bid five billion. How could this price not be shocking!
"Dad, it looks like we're going to win the bid this time!"
Arthur turned and said to Jeremiah Synder with a smile.
"I hope so!"
Jeremiah nodded lightly.
"Miss Lee, who won the bid?"
Everyone seemed to be eager to know the result as they asked Chelsea excitedly.
Chelsea smiled faintly and said softly, "Don't be so anxious. You can guess who won the bid. I'll give you two hints. The first hint is that this person's bid is very special; the second hint is that the bidder is the most handsome man in the lobby. I believe that this person has the ability to run Heavens Club well in the future!"
The most handsome man in the hall?
When everyone heard this, they all looked at Arthur at the same time.
After all, Arthur was indeed considered the most handsome among them in everyone's eyes.
Of course, Harold Phillips was also very handsome, but he did not participate in the bidding. Moreover, Harold was slightly inferior to Arthur.
In addition, Arthur had previously said that he wanted to take over Heavens Club, so the price he was willing to pay would definitely be very high. The special price was definitely in line with the hint.

chapters.title: Chapter 1231: Shady
chapters.content:
Chapter 1231: Shady
For a moment, almost everyone's attention was on Arthur.
Everyone thought that Arthur would be the winner today.
Connor McDonald also frowned and looked at Arthur. He was worried that the thing he did not want to see the most would happen.
After all, Arthur was backed by Rockefeller. If Rockefeller got the Heavens Club, it would have a huge impact on Connor.
However, Connor couldn't change anything now. After all, this club belonged to Chelsea, and he didn't have the final say.
"Miss Lee, who won the bid?"
At this moment, a middle-aged man asked Chelsea with a smile.
Chelsea did not answer his question. Instead, he turned to Vanessa and asked softly, "Vanessa, who do you think is the most handsome person here?"
Vanessa looked somewhat helpless. After all, she already had the answer in her heart.
However, if she answered this question, it would be equivalent to offending everyone present.
Therefore, Vanessa slowly turned her head to look at the middle-aged man beside her and said with a smile, "I'm a woman and short-sighted, so I think it's better that Mr. Jacobson answers this question. After all, Mr. Jacobson is a man. His answer should be a fair one…"
Mr. Jacobson, who was standing next to Vanessa, had a helpless expression on his face when he heard Vanessa's words. He knew that Vanessa was obviously throwing this hot potato to him.
However, Mr. Jacobson had no choice but to answer. After hesitating for a while, he smiled and said, "I'm a narcissist. I feel that none of the men present are as handsome as me!"
"Hahaha…"
When everyone heard Mr. Jacobson's words, they all laughed out loud because they all knew that Mr. Jacobson was joking.
When Mr. Jacobson saw that everyone was laughing, he felt much more at ease.
Connor looked at Mr. Jacobson and sighed in his heart. In fact, Heavens Club didn't only have Vanessa as a talent, but Mr. Jacobson's reaction ability was also very good.
"Miss Lee, don't keep us in suspense. Who is this person you're talking about?"
Everyone present was already impatient from all the waiting. They asked Chelsea excitedly.
When Chelsea heard this, he could not help but smile playfully. He pointed at Connor and said softly to everyone, "The person I'm talking about is him!"
Whoosh!
At that moment, everyone turned to look at Connor with an incredulous expression on their faces.
No one would have thought that the man Chelsea thought was the most handsome here was not Arthur, but Connor.
Everyone was indescribably surprised. They could not understand what was going on.
Arthur also stood rooted to the ground in a daze.
Vanessa already knew that this would be the result, so she was rather calm.
Arthur was unwilling to accept such an outcome, so he shouted at Chelsea, "Miss Lee, do you mean that Connor McDonald has won the bid?"
"That's right, Connor McDonald has won the bid!"
Chelsea looked at Arthur and nodded.
"Impossible…"
Arthur widened his eyes and shouted, then continued, "Miss Lee, how much did he bid? Why did he win the bid? It can't just be because you think he's handsome, right?"
"That's right, Miss Lee. We're all here to participate in the bidding. Shouldn't you tell us how much Connor bid? This way, we'll know what's going on!"
The others also shouted.
When Chelsea heard everyone's dissatisfaction, she became a little unhappy. Then, she said indifferently, "Connor's bid is 100,000 dollars!"
"..."
After hearing Chelsea's words, everyone present was instantly in an uproar. All of a sudden, everyone was dumbfounded.
Everyone looked at Chelsea with their mouths agape. They were filled with disbelief. No one had expected Connor's bid to be 100,000 dollars.
Even Connor himself was dumbfounded because that number was casually written by him. He had no intention of participating in the bid at all.
But now, Chelsea actually said that he had won the bid. Connor did not know what was going on.
"Miss Lee, don't joke with us. Connor won the bid with 100,000 dollars?"
Arthur suppressed the anger in his heart and asked Chelsea in a low voice.
"That's right, Connor won the bid with a price of 100,000 dollars!"
Chelsea nodded gently.
"Miss Lee, if you want to transfer the club directly to Connor, you can do it privately. There's no need to call all of us here and hold a bid. I'm sure all of us have offered more than 100,000 dollars, so why did he win the bid?"
Arthur couldn't control his emotions anymore. He gritted his teeth and shouted at Chelsea in a low voice.
"That's right, Miss Lee. We need an explanation!"
"My bid was 500 million dollars. Why didn't I win the bid instead? Did you get us to come to cheat us of our money?"
Everyone was extremely worked up.
If Arthur had won the bid at a very shocking price, everyone present might not have been unconvinced. After all, it was normal for someone to win the bid if he had offered more money than you.
But they really couldn't understand why Connor could win the bid with only 100,000.
Also, if Chelsea had already planned to transfer the club to Connor, why would she hold a bid? Why would she charge a 10% bidding fee?
For a moment, everyone present expressed their dissatisfaction with Chelsea's actions. No one was willing to take out the bidding fee for nothing.
At this moment, Chelsea was very calm. She said softly, "I've told you before the bidding auction that it will be different from the ordinary auctions that you've participated in. The rule here is not that whoever pays the most money will win the bid, but whoever pays the least money will win the bid."
"What…"
Everyone looked at Chelsea, their eyes filled with helplessness.
No one expected Chelsea's rule to be that whoever paid the least would get Heavens Club.
"Miss Lee, isn't this a little inappropriate? Connor must have known about your rule in advance, that's why he wrote down the number 100,000. This is shady!"
A middle-aged man shouted.

chapters.title: Chapter 1232: You Must Give a Proper Explanation
chapters.content:
Chapter 1232: You Must Give a Proper Explanation
"Sorry, no one knows my rules. This auction is done fairly and squarely!"
Chelsea replied coldly and continued, "Of course, if you think that there's something shady going on here and that I, Chelsea Lee, am deliberately scamming you of your money, that's fine too. You can leave now, and you don't have to pay the bidding fee!"
Everyone looked at Chelsea without saying anything.
"But if anyone dares to leave now, they will be going against me and Heavens Club. We'll see what happens in the future!"
Immediately after, Chelsea shouted in an unusually domineering manner.
For a moment, everyone was shocked by Chelsea's domineering aura.
They knew how terrifying Chelsea was.
If they offended Chelsea because of this, the price they would have to pay in the future would definitely be very high.
Arthur stood there foolishly, not daring to speak.
At this moment, no matter how unhappy these people were, they did not dare to express it because they did not have the courage to offend her.
Everyone knew that Chelsea had deliberately planned everything tonight, but they didn't dare to say anything.
At this time, Arthur finally understood what was going on. Chelsea had gathered so many people together not to hold a bidding auction. She had already thought about giving this club to Connor.
Chelsea called all these people here to let everyone in Orilon know about her relationship with Connor.
To put it bluntly, Chelsea was helping Connor.
However, Arthur wanted to know what the relationship between Chelsea and Connor was. Why would Chelsea stand up for Connor at the risk of offending the entire Orilon?
At this moment, Jeremiah Synder was in a foul mood.
Because he knew that his 500 million bid had been completely wasted.
"Connor McDonald, come on up!"
Chelsea smiled and waved at Connor.
At this time, Connor was still in a state of confusion because he did not understand what was going on. He did not know what Chelsea was trying to do!
Connor and Chelsea had only known each other for two days, but Chelsea actually wanted to transfer a club worth billions to Connor for 100,000 dollars. Connor felt that this matter was definitely not as simple as it seemed. Chelsea must have other motives.
At this moment, the others present looked at Connor with a puzzled expression.
"Who is this Connor McDonald?"
"Yeah, what's his relationship with Chelsea?"
"Is this guy Chelsea's boyfriend? How could Chelsea like such a person?"
"This guy's identity is definitely not simple. Chelsea must have some motive for giving this club to him…"
Everyone looked at Connor and began to discuss softly.
"Connor, what are you still standing there for? Hurry up and come up!"
Chelsea shouted at Connor with a smile.
"What is she trying to do?"
Connor was a little puzzled, and then he directly walked onto the stage.
When Chelsea saw Connor walk onto the stage, she pulled Connor in front of her. Connor could clearly smell the faint fragrance on Chelsea's body.
"Connor, I may not have the time to manage Heavens Club in the future. So, Heavens Club is yours now. You will be the boss of Heavens Club in the future. I hope you can manage this club well and bring Heavens Club to new heights..."
Chelsea said to Connor with a smile.
Connor looked at Chelsea and hesitated for two seconds before asking in a low voice, "Chelsea, what exactly do you want?"
"I don't want anything. You're already the boss of Heavens Club now. This club is yours…"
Chelsea said softly.
"No, I can't take your club!"
Connor shook his head without any hesitation.
"..."
When everyone heard Connor's words, they were all dumbfounded. They were extremely dumbfounded.
"Isn't this guy being too pretentious?"
" That's right. You got such a big club for 100,000 dollars, and now you're saying you don't want it…"
"What is he trying to do?"
Everyone looked at Connor and asked in confusion.
However, Connor wasn't putting on a show. He felt that this matter wasn't as simple as he thought.
Chelsea must have had her reasons for giving this club to him.
Previously, Connor had indeed wanted to get this club because of its connections.
However, after what Chelsea had done, Connor felt that things were a little too strange, so he did not dare to accept this club.
"What exactly do you want?"
Connor gritted his teeth and asked Chelsea in a low voice.
"I don't want anything. I just want to give this club to you. Just accept it. If you don't have the time to manage this club, it's fine. Anyway, Vanessa will help you manage it…"
Chelsea seemed to be begging Connor to accept Heavens Club.
Everyone's eyes widened, not knowing how to describe their current feelings.
After all, some people would pay five billion dollars and would still not be able to get Heavens Club.
But now, Chelsea was actually begging Connor to accept it. The difference was really too big.
Arthur stared at Connor with a complicated expression on his face.
"Connor, you've already filled in the bidding form just now, and you've won the bid. So, whether you agree to it or not, this club is now yours…"
Chelsea said with a serious face.
Connor took a deep breath and said in a low voice, "Chelsea, I know that you must have a motive for giving me this club. You must give me a proper explanation. Otherwise, I won't accept this club. Even if I accept it, I'll sell it…"
"I can explain it to you, but you have to sign the contract with me first…"
Chelsea said lightly.
"As long as I take over this club, you'll explain everything to me, right?"
Connor asked in a low voice.
"That's right. As long as you sign this contract, I'll tell you why I did it!"
Chelsea nodded seriously.
"Alright, I'll sign the contract!"
Connor agreed.
Seeing that Connor had agreed, a trace of pride flashed in her eyes. Then, she quickly turned and said to Vanessa, "Vanessa, bring me the contract. It's time to sign it…"
"Alright…"
Vanessa nodded, then turned around to prepare the contract.

chapters.title: Chapter 1233: Fiancée
chapters.content:
Chapter 1233: Fiancée
Actually, Vanessa had known long ago that Chelsea wanted to transfer the club to Connor, so the contracts were prepared in advance.
A few minutes later, she took out two copies of the contract and handed one to Connor and the other to Chelsea.
Although he hadn't figured out what was going on, he noticed that there was nothing else on the contract.
As long as he signed the contract, the club would be his.
After hesitating for a moment, he finally wrote his name on the contract.
Chelsea also signed her name, and they exchanged contracts.
Under the gaze of everyone, Connor became the new owner of Heavens Club.
At this moment, the expressions on everyone's faces were complex because no one had expected such an outcome.
Connor had become the biggest winner tonight. Not only did he acquire Heavens Club, but he also received a bidding fee of ten billion. This amount of money was enough for him to run Heavens Club for a very long time, even if the club didn't make a profit.
This stroke of luck made him even happier than winning the lottery!
After all, the lottery prize was only five million, but now he had received countless amounts of five million!
From the moment he signed the contract, he reached a height that was beyond the reach of ordinary people. It might take a lifetime of struggle for others to achieve what he had accomplished.
However, he didn't care about all these material possessions. He was already very wealthy. What he was concerned about now was why Chelsea did all this.
There's no such thing as a free lunch, and Chelsea must have her own purpose for giving all these things to Connor.
Seeing him sign the contract, she showed a satisfied smile and called out to everyone, "Alright, today's bidding for Heavens Club has come to a successful end. From now on, all matters regarding Heavens Club will be handled by Connor. I appreciate everyone's support for Heavens Club, and I hope you will continue to patronize our business. If I find that the business of our club is not doing well, I may have a good chat with all of you..."
"Chelsea, please rest assured that we will definitely support the business of Heavens Club!"
"Yes, we have already gotten used to coming here and will continue to come..."
"Absolutely, I will bring my friends here!"
Although some people were dissatisfied with Chelsea's actions, they still showed her face and voiced their support.
"Although I'm no longer the owner of Heavens Club, I am still a shareholder. I don't like to see any unpleasant things happen. If anything like that does happen, don't blame me for being impolite..." Chelsea continued speaking, warning the crowd.
It was evident that her words were a warning to everyone.
"Miss Chelsea, please rest assured, we will definitely not cause trouble here..."
"Yes, anyone who causes trouble here would have a problem with me. I would be the first to disapprove..."
"That's right, we wouldn't dare to offend Miss Chelsea..."
The crowd quickly responded, speaking loudly.
There was no other choice. Deep down, they all knew how terrifying her background was, so even if they were given ten thousand times the courage, they would never dare to offend her.
"Well then, thank you all for your support!" She smiled happily, then turned and walked off the stage.
From now on, Heavens Club was under Connor's sole authority, and his name would soon spread throughout the entire Orilon
Everyone present knew that he was definitely not an ordinary person, so they started actively toasting him and engaging in conversation.
"What's the relationship between Connor and Chelsea?" Harold walked up to Arthur and asked him in a low voice.
"How would I know?" Arthur coldly replied and continued, "I didn't expect Connor to be the biggest winner today. Who is this Connor, and why does he always have a problem with me?"
Harold looked at Arthur without saying anything.
Originally, Harold and the rest had wanted to take advantage of Arthur's influence and suppress Connor to avenge their past grievances in Porthampton.
But they never expected that even Arthur was dealt a heavy blow by Connor.
Now, they finally understood the gap between themselves and Connor.
As for Sabrina, she looked at Connor, who was conversing with the influential figures of Orilon, with a somewhat helpless expression. Then she turned to Sadie and said, "Sadie, let's go."
"Sabrina, I know you have feelings for Connor, but we and him are probably not from the same world. It would be better to let go of certain things sooner," Sadie hesitated for a moment and whispered to Sabrina.
"I understand..." Sabrina nodded and didn't say much, directly walking toward the exit of the hall.
Connor looked at Sabrina, who was leaving with Harold, Arthur, and others. He had initially planned to say a few words to her, but then he decided against it.
After all, he couldn't offer anything to Sabrina. If he spoke to her now, it would only give her false hope. So he thought it would be better not to say anything.
Meanwhile, Salma, with an extremely angry expression, looked at Connor's position.
She believed that the reason he had rejected her so many times was clearly because of Chelsea.
So Salma walked directly up to him and asked in a low voice, "Connor, is your fiancee Chelsea?"
Salma's voice wasn't particularly loud or soft, but everyone around heard it.
"What? Miss Chelsea is actually Connor's fiancee?"
"No wonder Miss Chelsea gave the club to Connor!"
"So that's how it is!"
For a moment, everyone began to quietly discuss.
Connor looked at Salma with a face of despair and directly pulled her to the side, whispering,"Can you stop fooling around? Chelsea really has nothing to do with me!"
"Do you think I'll believe you?"
Salma looked at Connor and rolled her eyes as she replied in disdain.
"Believe it or not, I really have nothing to do with Chelsea. My fiancée is called Freya Phillips!"
Connor replied impatiently, then turned around and left.
"Freya Phillips?"
When Salma heard this name, a strange look flashed across her eyes.

chapters.title: Chapter 1234: Chelsea's Identity
chapters.content:
Chapter 1234: Chelsea's Identity
And as soon as Arthur and Jeremiah left the club, they received a phone call.
Jeremiah looked at his phone, his expression grim. After hesitating for a few seconds, he answered the call.
"President Wilson..."
Jeremiah said in a low voice.
"How did things go?"
The other person asked calmly.
"President Wilson, Chelsea gave the club to Connor. They must have planned this in advance. That woman, Chelsea, is playing us!"
Jeremiah shouted through gritted teeth.
"Chelsea gave the club to Connor?"
The tone of the other person sounded somewhat puzzled, then they asked in a low voice, "How could Chelsea possibly know Connor? What is their relationship?"
"I don't know the relationship between them, but I can assure you that she definitely gave the club to him!" Jeremiah replied.
The other person remained silent for two seconds, then said in a low voice, "Alright, I understand."
"President Wilson, I lost five billion because of this bidding. Can you help me out with some money?"
Jeremiah asked anxiously as he saw the other person about to hang up the call.
"Didn't I make it clear to you just now? If you manage to acquire the club, I can give you shares and management rights since I provided the five billion. But if you fail to acquire the club, you'll have to bear the bidding fee yourself!"
The other person said indifferently.
"But, President Wilson, I didn't expect this to be Chelsea's trap!"
Jeremiah said helplessly.
After hearing these words from Jeremiah, the other person hesitated for two seconds, then said softly, "You definitely have to bear that loss. But since Chelsea transferred the club to Connor, I have a way for you to get back at them..."
"President Wilson, what's your plan?"
Jeremiah's face showed excitement upon hearing these words and he quickly asked.
"Chelsea has just handed over the club to Connor, and Connor's foundation is not stable. So we can take advantage of this opportunity to snatch all the business from Heavens Club. After all, the most important aspect of Heavens Club is its connections, not its profitability..."
The other person said calmly.
After hearing these words, Jeremiah couldn't help but inhale sharply, then said in a low voice, "President Wilson, what are you planning?"
"I've already set my sights on a club called Triumph Club. I plan to acquire that club and compete with Heavens Club..."
"President Wilson, acquiring this club should require a substantial amount of money, right?"
Jeremiah asked in a low voice.
"You don't need to worry about the money. You just need to handle the public appearance. I will take care of the funding. I want you to manage this Triumph Club Club. Within six months, I hope that all the members of Heavens Club will become members of our club. Do you understand what I mean?"
The other person's tone was very calm.
"President Wilson, I understand your meaning. I may not be a match for Chelsea, but I have no problem dealing with Connor. After all, Connor has no experience in managing a club!"
Jeremiah shouted excitedly.
He never expected that he would turn misfortune into an opportunity.
Although he had just lost five billion and had not acquired Heavens Club, it would still be acceptable for him to get a club of similar scale to Heavens Club.
"Alright, I will transfer the money to you tomorrow. When the time comes, you can go to the Triumph Club Club's owner and complete the handover procedures!"
