After saying this, the other person hung up the phone directly.
Jeremiah looked at his phone with an extremely excited expression. This phone call was definitely an opportunity for him.
...
On the other side, the guests at Heavens Club had already learned about the bidding result, so after exchanging pleasantries with Connor, they left.
After seeing the guests leave, Connor went directly to the office where Chelsea was.
She was sitting on the sofa, looking at her phone. Hearing his footsteps, she slowly put down her phone and asked softly, "Have they all left?"
"Yes..."
Connor nodded gently and sat directly across from Chelsea, his expression serious. He said to Chelsea, "Can you now explain to me the purpose of what you did?"
"Didn't I explain it to you before? I did it simply because of a certain feeling," she answered calmly.
"So, you have feelings for me?"
He furrowed his brow and asked her.
"Why are you so narcissistic? There are plenty of handsome guys pursuing me. I've seen all kinds of outstanding men. How could I possibly be interested in a little brat like you?" she replied helplessly.
"Then why did you give me the club? What is your intention?" he anxiously shouted at Chelsea.
"Just wait for me," she calmly replied to him, then stood up and walked towards the desk.
A few minutes later, she took out a photo and placed it in front of him. She said softly, "Look at this photo first."
He was stunned for a moment, then reached out and picked up the photo.
In the photo were two girls, and one of them was Chelsea. Although Chelsea in the photo was only seven or eight years old, Connor could still recognize her.
But when Connor saw the other woman in the photo, his whole body froze, his expression incredibly incredulous.
"Where did you get this photo? What is your relationship with that woman in the photo?"
Connor asked Chelsea excitedly.
"This photo was taken when I was eight years old. The other woman is my sister..."
Chelsea replied calmly.
"No, this is impossible. My mother told me that she has no relatives. You must be lying to me. This is absolutely impossible!"
Connor shouted at Chelsea with an agitated expression.
Chelsea didn't explain further. Instead, she took out another photo.
This photo had many people in it, but it also included Chelsea and the woman who had caused Connor's emotions to flare up.
"This is a family photo of our family. If you don't believe it, you can find someone to verify whether these photos are real or fake," she said softly.
"No, this is absolutely impossible. My mother told me that she has no relatives. You must be lying to me. This is absolutely impossible!"

chapters.title: Chapter 1235: I'm Your Aunt!
chapters.content:
Chapter 1235: I'm Your Aunt!
Chelsea couldn't help but take a deep breath when she saw Connor getting somewhat agitated. Then she spoke in a low voice, "Connor, I know it may be difficult for you to accept this right now, but I hope you can calm down and listen to everything I have to tell you. Then you'll understand why!"
He glanced up at her, although he still couldn't believe that she was his mother's sister.
But he tried to control his emotions as much as possible because he wanted to know what was going on.
"I am perfectly calm now, go ahead," he replied to her in a low voice.
Chelsea first poured a cup of tea for Connor, then spoke softly, "Actually, this is how it is. My name is Chelsea, and your mother's name is Sharon. We are sisters, but we don't have a blood relationship. I was adopted by your grandfather!"
"I don't have a grandfather, I am an orphan. I have no family left in this world!" he said expressionlessly.
"Well, my foster father's name is Harrison Lee. He is from the Beverly Hills, and he is also your mother's father!"
Chelsea paused for a moment, then continued, "I used to be the illegitimate daughter of a prominent figure in the Beverly Hills, and my mother was from the U.K. Due to my father's special status, he couldn't let anyone know about his illegitimate daughter. So, he had me fostered by the Lee family. It was during that time that I got to know your mother, and I treated her as my own sister..."
"And then?"
This time, Connor didn't refute Chelsea's words.
"But when I was eight years old, my identity was discovered by some of my father's enemies. To prevent them from finding me, my father sent me to England. I lived in U.K. for almost twenty years. Recently, my father passed away, so I returned to Oprana. Before, due to my father's status, I couldn't live in the country, but now I can..."
She seemed indifferent as she spoke about her father. It was as if she was telling a story about a stranger.
"So, what does all this have to do with me? What does it have to do with my mother?"
Connor furrowed his brow and asked her.
"When I was in the Lee family, I was always treated as an outsider. All the members of the Lee family didn't like me. They thought I would compete with them for the family's wealth. But only your mother took care of me. I always regarded your mother as my own sister!"
She paused for a moment, then continued, "But later, your mother fell in love with your father. Harrison didn't agree with their relationship because the Lee family is a prominent family in the Beverly Hills. They felt that your father was not worthy of your mother. In the end, your mother chose to elope with your father and cut ties with the Lee family..."
Connor stared at her, his expression filled with disbelief because he had no knowledge of these things.
"And the reason your mother told you that your grandfather had already passed away was because she didn't want you to have any connection with the Lee family!"
Chelsea continued to explain, looking at him.
"I still have relatives in this world?" he said with a surprised expression.
"They can't really be considered relatives, after all, the Lee family doesn't acknowledge your mother's identity, so naturally, they won't acknowledge yours either!" she said calmly.
Connor looked at Chelsea in front of him and was having a hard time accepting all this.
"Your mother did me a great favor, so I always remembered that favor. I also learned about your mother's death later, but at that time, I couldn't come back. I always felt guilty, so I wanted to make it up to you. That's why I intentionally got close to you, and I intended to give you this club!" she continued.
"But why have I never seen you before? I've never heard my mother mention you!"
He asked her.
"Your mother wouldn't mention any member of the Lee family because if the Lee family knew about your existence, they would see you as a threat to their wealth. It would be very dangerous for you!"
She explained and then continued, "And you have actually met me before..."
After saying this, Chelsea once again took out a photo.
In the photo, Chelsea looked to be about six or seven years old, and she was holding a boy in her arms.
"This is a photo taken on your one-month celebration. At that time, I was only six years old!"
Chelsea smiled as she spoke.
He looked at the photo in his hand, his facial expression filled with shock. He couldn't believe that it was true.
"How can you prove that what you're saying is true?" he asked in a low voice.
"Do I need to prove something like this? I'm giving you such a big club for free. That's the best proof!"
She blinked her eyes and continued, "If you don't believe what I'm saying, you can use your connections to investigate. I think you should be able to find out easily about the relationship between me and your mother..."
"I will investigate!" he said in a low voice.
"So, the reason I got close to you and handed over such a big club to you is simply because I am your aunt, whether you acknowledge it or not, I am your aunt!"
Chelsea said with a smile to Connor.
"I don't have an aunt like you!" he said with a disdainful expression.
"Why are you like this? I've already made it so clear to you. I am your aunt. Call me 'Aunt' already..."
Chelsea pulled his arm and shouted.
"I don't know if what you're saying is true or not. Let me investigate and find out the truth!"
He couldn't accept the fact that he had an aunt, so he replied with a serious expression.
"Alright then, no matter what, I am your aunt!"
She didn't continue to urge him and simply nodded gently.
"Do you know who killed my mother?"
After hesitating for a moment, he asked her in a low voice.
"I think it's very likely to be someone from the Rockefeller family!" she replied calmly.
"Do you know who my father is?" he quickly asked.
"I'm not too sure about that. Your father's identity is very mysterious. He's the person in charge of Rockefeller's area. If you want to know your father's true identity, you can only investigate through Rockefeller's people!"
Chelsea replied.

chapters.title: Chapter 1236: Two Months
chapters.content:
Chapter 1236: Two Months
Connor could not accept the fact that Chelsea was his aunt for the time being, but he had found out that she actually knew about Rockefeller and that his father was one of Rockefeller's men. This meant that Chelsea might really be his aunt.
Otherwise, how could she know about these things?
"Connor, I know that you have always wanted to deal with Rockefeller, so I gave you this club because it will be of great help to you!" Chelsea said.
"Thank you!"
Connor replied in a low voice, and then planned to continue asking about his parents.
However, at this moment, the office door was suddenly pushed open from the outside. Vanessa, who was wearing a dress and high heels, strode to Chelsea's side and said softly, "Miss Landon, were you looking for me?"
"Yes…"
Chelsea gently nodded, then pulled Vanessa to Connor and said with a smile, "Connor, this is Vanessa. I met her when I was studying abroad. She's now the general manager of the Heavens Club and has been managing it for many years. She's very experienced in club management, so if you have anything you don't understand, you can ask her…"
"Hello, Miss Canfield!" Connor took the initiative to extend his right hand to Vanessa.
Vanessa shook hands with Connor and subconsciously remembered what happened in the office. Her face blushed and she said softly, "Hello, Mr. McDonald!"
"Connor, Vanessa is a rare management talent. I plan to let her go to another company to be the general manager in the future. This way, I can relax a lot, so I'll give you two months to take over with Vanessa's help. After two months, Vanessa will follow me to another company…" Chelsea said.
Connor knew that Vanessa was a very capable woman. The fact that the Heavens Club could reach its current position had a lot to do with her, so Connor definitely didn't want Vanessa to leave. He couldn't find a more suitable person to come over.
However, Connor knew that he couldn't keep her around, and Chelsea had already given this club to him for nothing.
If he still wanted to keep Vanessa, then it was indeed a little too much.
"I understand…"
Connor nodded lightly.
"But you don't have to worry. I will give you two months. During these two months, Vanessa will still stay here!" Chelsea continued.
"Alright…"
Connor nodded, then looked at the time and said softly, "It's getting late. I'll go back first. If there's anything, I'll talk to Vanessa tomorrow!"
"Alright…" Vanessa nodded.
Connor took a deep breath, then turned around and walked out of the office.
After Chelsea saw Connor leave, she couldn't help but sigh. She turned his head and asked Vanessa, "What do you think of Connor?"
"I'm not sure…" Vanessa shook her head and continued, "Connor seems to like to hide himself very much. There are some things that I can't see through, but give me two months. I should be able to see clearly what kind of person he is by then!"
"I think Connor is not bad. He has a lot of potential, but his potential hasn't been stimulated yet!" Chelsea commented indifferently.
"I hope your decision is correct. I don't want to see the Heavens Club destroyed in Connor's hands!"
Vanessa was a little depressed. After all, no one's feelings could compare to her feelings for this club.
"Don't worry, I definitely won't miss when putting my faith in people!"
Chelsea smiled faintly.
…
On the other side, Connor took a taxi home after leaving the Heavens Club.
Rachel, who was sitting on the sofa watching TV, saw Connor come back and asked, "Have you already taken over the Heavens Club?"
After Connor heard Rachel's words, he could not help but be stunned for a moment and asked in a very surprised tone, "How did you know?"
"Who do you think I am? This news spread to me a while ago. Not only do I know that you've already taken this club, but I also know that the boss of this club gave it to you for free…"
Rachel said indifferently.
"I didn't expect you to be so well-informed…"
Connor replied in a low voice and then walked to Rachel's side.
Rachel sized up Connor and said softly, "You've already taken over the Heavens Club. Why don't you look very happy?"
"..."
Connor turned his head to look at Rachel, then said in a low voice, "I need you to help me investigate someone!"
"The owner of the Heavens Club, Chelsea Landon, right?"
Rachel asked directly.
"Can you read minds?"
Connor shouted with a puzzled expression. He couldn't understand why Rachel could always guess what he was going to do.
"More or less…"
Rachel smiled faintly and continued, "I've already investigated Chelsea's identity. Chelsea and your mother, Sharon Lee, are indeed from the Lee family, but Chelsea's real identity is the daughter of a very powerful big shot in Beverly Hills. This big shot's power can be close to the peak. As for who it is, you just need to search on the Internet to know. Chelsea has been living abroad because of his identity. He only returned to Oprana after this big shot passed away…"
"So you're saying that Chelsea is really my mother's sister?"
Connor said excitedly.
Rachel gently nodded. "That's one way of understanding it. Otherwise, why would Chelsea give you such a big clubhouse…"
"Chelsea is really my aunt?" After Connor heard this news, his expression was abnormally broken because he simply could not believe that this was true.
"Chelsea is indeed not a simple woman. Although she has always been living overseas, she actually has more than ten listed companies in Oprana. She has an excellent mind for business, and she is a top presence even in the world. Moreover, she has a lot of connections overseas. She even became a U.K. aristocrat and is even a good friend of the British royal family's princess. Any of these resumes is an existence that countless people look up to, but now, all of them are placed on one person. I'm starting to admire her!" Rachel continued.
"Chelsea is actually a U.K. aristocrat and is good friends with the princess?"
Connor was dumbfounded when he heard this, eyes wide with disbelief.
"That's right. I just found out about this…" Rachel nodded.

chapters.title: Chapter 1237: The Ledgers
chapters.content:
Chapter 1237: The Ledgers
"Now you know how terrifying Chelsea's background is, right?" Rachel smiled faintly and continued, "Your life is really too good. Not only did you get the inheritance of the world's richest man, but you also have an aunt like this. I really don't know how many people envy you!"
"What's there to be envious about? I still think it's better to be an ordinary person…" Connor said lightly.
"You really don't know how lucky you are!"
Rachel couldn't help but roll her eyes at Connor before continuing, "Chelsea has returned to the country now. His father has left her a very terrifying inheritance…"
"Is it a lot of money?"
Connor asked absent-mindedly.
"Money, money, money. Why is there only money in your mind?" Rachel said with a helpless tone.
"I mean, didn't you say that she has an inheritance?" Connor asked lightly.
"Is an inheritance restricted to money in your head? There are some things that money cannot compare to. Chelsea has more than ten listed companies in her hands, so she does not lack money at all. However, her father left her with countless connections, and these connections were the scariest thing about Chelsea!" Rachel said helplessly.
"Does Chelsea's father only have her?"
Connor frowned and asked Rachel.
"He also has a son, but his son died in a car accident back then, so Chelsea is the only inheritor of his legacy. Chelsea's father also let her live abroad to protect her from any harm!" Rachel said.
"I didn't expect you to investigate so thoroughly. Did you already know about my relationship with Chelsea?"
Connor asked with some doubt.
"I didn't know before Chelsea exposed her identity, but since Chelsea has already admitted that she is the boss of the Heavens Club, everything else was easy to investigate!" Rachel said calmly.
Connor looked at Rachel and did not continue to say anything. Now, Connor already knew Chelsea's true identity, but because these things happened too suddenly, Connor needed some time to digest.
…
The next day, at nine o'clock in the morning.
Connor took a taxi to the Heavens Club. He had an appointment with her at nine o'clock, where Vanessa planned to report the current situation of the club to Connor.
Connor knew that he was now the boss of this club, so he had the responsibility and obligation to understand these things.
This time, Connor came in as the boss. Naturally, he did not need to climb over the wall to enter. Instead, he swaggered into the lobby of the clubhouse.
When the uniformed receptionist saw Connor, she quickly took the initiative to welcome him. Then, she smiled and shouted at Connor, "Hello, Mr. McDonald!"
"Hello…" Connor replied indifferently and then continued, "I'm here to look for President Canfield. Take me to her office!"
"Alright!"
The receptionist hurriedly nodded and took the initiative to bring Connor upstairs.
Along the way, if any employees of the Heavens Club saw Connor, they would take the initiative to greet him with a smile on their faces.
However, as long as Connor left, these people would start discussing in low voices.
"Who is this Connor?"
"Yeah, why did Miss Lee give him the club?"
"That's right, it's unbelievable. Could this Connor really be Miss Lee's gigolo?"
"How is that possible? Our Miss Lee is so beautiful. What kind of man can't she find? Why would she go for someone like this..."
"I really don't know what Miss Lee is thinking!"
Although Connor couldn't hear what these people were saying, he knew that these people were still not convinced because they all felt that Connor might not be qualified to be the boss of the club. However, Connor had already thought of a countermeasure. It would be very simple to make these people treat him as the boss sincerely.
A few minutes later, Connor arrived at Vanessa's office.
Connor hesitated for a moment before gently knocking on the door.
"Please come in!"
Vanessa's pleasant voice rang out.
Connor directly pushed open the door and entered the office. This was already the second time Connor had entered this office. There was still a very attractive fragrance in the office. It should be the smell of Vanessa.
Looking at Vanessa in the office, Connor couldn't help but recall what happened in this office yesterday. His mind instantly recalled Vanessa's seductive body, and his heartbeat obviously accelerated.
"Mr. McDonald, you're here."
Vanessa saw Connor and quickly stood up. Today, Vanessa was wearing a black uniform. Her exquisite face and seductive figure under the uniform made her look sexy no matter what she wore.
Vanessa was like a ripe peach, exuding the unique charm of a mature woman, making people unable to stop themselves from looking at her.
Connor took a deep breath and tried to calm himself down.
"Mr. McDonald, please wait a moment. I'll go prepare the information…" Vanessa said softly.
"Alright…"
Connor nodded lightly.
A few minutes later, Vanessa returned to Connor's side with a tall stack of information, then whispered to Connor, "Mr. McDonald, these are all the ledgers of our club over the past three years. You can take a look!"
After Connor heard Vanessa's words, he couldn't help but look down at the ledger book in front of him, and then lightly said, "Since Chelsea trusts you so much, I will definitely trust you fully. As long as you think that there is no problem with these ledgers, then there is no problem. I don't need to look at them anymore..."
"Alright…Fine!"
Vanessa nodded lightly after hearing Connor's words, then continued, "Mr. McDonald, can I introduce you to our club?"
"Alright, go ahead!"
Connor nodded.
"Our club is made up of three parts. The first part is Heavens Bar. Heavens Bar is mainly responsible for receiving ordinary people," Vanessa started.
"I see!" Connor nodded. He wasn't very interested in this bar. Although the bar was very profitable, Connor wasn't short of money.
"The second part is the Heavens Club. This club mainly caters to middle-to-high-class people. There are many services available, and it runs on a membership system. If you want to become a member, you have to pay a membership fee of one million dollars!" Vanessa continued.

chapters.title: Chapter 1238: What Is This?
chapters.content:
Chapter 1238: What Is This?
"One million in membership fees."
When Connor heard this, his expression was a little surprised. After all, this money was not a small amount!
"Finally, we have Heavens Commerce…"
Vanessa paused for a moment before continuing, "Heavens Commerce is the most important part of our clubhouse because it mainly welcomes famous people in Orilon. It also uses a membership system, and the membership fee is 50 million dollars."
Connor knew that Heavens Commerce was the core of the Heavens Club, and it was also the network that the Heavens Club had accumulated over the years.
"Who usually reviews this memberships?" Connor asked.
"I do!" Vanessa replied.
"Oh, I see!" Connor nodded.
Vanessa got up and walked to the front of the safe, then keyed in a series of passwords, took out a document from inside, and handed it to Connor.
"What is this?"
Connor took the document and asked Vanessa in confusion.
"Mr. McDonald, this is all the membership information of our Heavens Commerce. Please take a look!" Vanessa said.
Connor opened the document and took a quick glance. He found that the contents of the document was very detailed, and there were many people involved. Some were business tycoons and some were government officials. Anyway, as long as they were powerful people in Orilon, they were basically members of Heavens Commerce.
"There's also this thing!"
Vanessa took out a hard drive and placed it in front of Connor.
"What is this?"
Connor looked at the hard disk with a puzzled expression.
"This hard disk contains erotic photos of our Heavens Commerce members and some trading videos. Although our club has promised to keep the information of our members completely confidential, Miss Landon still installed cameras in the private rooms for the convenience of controlling these people. They all feel that our club is the safest, so many unspeakable things are carried out here. Basically, all the members have something to use against us. If we want these people to do something, it's very simple!" Vanessa explained.
After Connor heard Vanessa's words, he was stunned. He never thought that Chelsea would be so ruthless.
Connor finally understood why everyone said that the Heavens Club had a lot of connections, and the so-called connections were all in this hard disk. If they got this hard disk, it would be equivalent to controlling half of Orilon.
"Good thing that this club has fallen into my hands. If it had fallen into Rockefeller's hands, it would have been troublesome…" Connor could not help but sigh in his heart.
At this moment, Connor finally understood the importance of the Heavens Club. He also understood why Yaakov Ward was willing to pay 5 billion dollars just to buy this club.
"Mr. McDonald, you are the owner of our club now. You can take these two things with you!"
Vanessa said.
"No need. I'll keep it with you for the time being. I don't need these things now!" Connor lightly replied.
"Alright then!" Vanessa nodded, then hesitated for a moment. "Mr. McDonald, there's something else I want to tell you…"
"What is it?"
Connor asked indifferently.
"Jeremiah Synder has already acquired Newtown's Triumph Club. He should be planning to open for business in a few days. I think Jeremiah is planning to use the Triumph Club to compete with us…" Vanessa said.
"Compete with us?"
After Connor heard Vanessa's words, he couldn't help but sneer and then said lightly, "What right does Jeremiah have to compete with me?"
"There should be someone else behind Jeremiah…"
Vanessa reminded Connor softly.
"Someone behind the scenes?" Connor smiled faintly and then said expressionlessly, "Since they want to compete, then let them compete…"
"Mr. McDonald, what are you planning to do?"
Vanessa looked at Connor, a trace of confusion flashing in her eyes.
"Of course we'll just have to compete with them!"
Connor smiled and continued, "Stabilize the internal structure of our club first, then inform the employees that they will all be getting a 50% pay raise. After that, inform Heavens Bar that from today onwards, the drinks will be 30% off, the beer will be free, and the membership fees of the Heavens Club will be reduced by half for seven days. As for Heavens Commerce, these people don't lack anything. Moreover, we have something on them, so we naturally don't have to worry about losing these customers..."
Vanessa frowned slightly. "Mr. McDonald, although you can deal a blow to the Synder family by doing this, the price we have to pay may be very high!"
"What kind of price?"
Connor asked.
"If that's the case, not only will our club not be able to earn money, but we'll end up losing money…" Vanessa frowned.
"Losing money is a small matter. The most important thing is for us to be able to keep our employees and customers. Didn't I get one billion dollars at the bidding meeting yesterday? Take this money and use it. If you run out, call me again and I'll get someone to transfer you the money…"
Connor said very domineeringly.
After all, Connor never hoped that this club could earn him much money. All he needed were the connections of this club.
"Mr. McDonald, have you really thought it through? If we were to pass this on, we might need a huge sum of money!" Vanessa exclaimed.
"You don't have to worry about the money. Just do as you like. I want to see the Synder family's clubhouse close down within two months. It doesn't matter how much money I need to make it happen…" Connor said calmly.
Vanessa couldn't help but take a deep breath. She didn't know where Connor's confidence came from, nor did she understand why Connor didn't care about money at all.
How could a businessman not care about money?
However, Vanessa might not know that the thing that Connor did not lack the most was money.
Money was nothing more than a number in Connor's eyes.
Besides, Connor wasn't just throwing money around casually. He was telling everyone in Orilon that the Heavens Club was not to be trifled with. Anyone who dared to provoke the Heavens Club would not have a good ending.
Connor could use money to smash anyone.
This was the one thing he had the utmost confidence in.

chapters.title: Chapter 1239: Benson Sharp's Phone Call
chapters.content:
Chapter 1239: Benson Sharp's Phone Call
Hearing Connor's words, Vanessa seemed to be worried about how he was doing things.
Therefore, she whispered to Connor, "Mr. McDonald, you might be taking a huge risk by doing this. Are you sure you want to do this?"
"I'm sure!"
Connor looked at her and nodded lightly.
Vanessa knew that Connor was the boss of this club now, so no matter what decision he made, she could not object to it. Even if she did not agree with his decision, she had no choice but to nod helplessly.
"Oh, Vanessa, are there any members of Rockefeller in our club? Or someone related to Rockefeller?"
Connor hesitated for a moment before asking Vanessa.
Vanessa looked at him and shook her head, then said in a low voice, "Mr. McDonald, the people from Rockefeller are very careful. It's impossible for them to become members of our club. Also, under normal circumstances, the people of Rockefeller rarely make an appearance on their own volition…"
"Alright, I got it!"
Connor thought that he could get some information about Rockefeller through Heavens Club, but now that he looked at it, he was really too naive.
Rockefeller was very strict about how they did things. They would never appear in a place like Heavens Club, and they would not leave any evidence for anyone. After all, if anything happened, it might involve the entire Rockefeller.
"If there's nothing else, I'll be leaving now. If there's any problem, just call me!"
Connor knew that Vanessa was done reporting to him about work, so he didn't plan to stay here any longer.
"Alright!"
Vanessa then quickly got up to send Connor out.
But just as Connor was walking to the door, he suddenly stopped and turned back to look at Vanessa, saying softly, "Vanessa, there's actually something I've always wanted to explain to you!"
"What is it?"
Vanessa was stunned for a moment and asked with a puzzled expression.
"It was Chelsea who gave me the idea to come to your office that day. I really didn't expect you to come back to change your clothes…"
Connor explained awkwardly.
Hearing Connor's words, her pretty face suddenly blushed a bit, and she looked at Connor helplessly, because she couldn't understand why he would suddenly mention this.
"I just wanted to assure you that I really didn't see anything that day. I was hiding behind the clothes the whole time, and my eyes were closed…"
Connor was obviously trying to cover it up and hurriedly said to Vanessa.
"I believe you. After all, I was still wearing my underwear at that time. Also, it doesn't matter to me…"
In order to not make herself too embarrassed, Vanessa could only pretend to be calm and reply in a low voice.
Connor smiled faintly after hearing her words, then said with his teeth bared, "That's a relief. I've been worried that you'd misunderstand me, so I wanted to explain it to you!"
Vanessa looked at Connor, feeling somewhat helpless.
She didn't know what to say. After all, how could something like this be explained in any way? It would have been better if he didn't bring this up. Now that he did, it became even more awkward for her.
"Well, since you're okay, that's good enough for me. I'll be leaving now!"
Connor looked at Vanessa and smiled, then walked out of the office.
Vanessa stood there alone and looked at Connor's back. She couldn't help but recall the scene in her bedroom, and her pretty face blushed again.
...
On the other side.
After Connor left Heavens Club, he wanted to go back to Newtown University to take a look.
Ever since Salma Thompson had confessed to Connor, he knew that the students in school would definitely ask him questions. Connor did not want to face these questions, so he did not attend classes at Newtown University.
It had been a week since this incident. Connor figured that those students would have forgotten about what happened, so he wanted to return to school.
After all, Connor still wanted to finish university.
However, before he could call a taxi, his phone rang.
Connor took out his phone and saw that it was Benson Sharp calling him.
Under normal circumstances, Benson would not call Connor unless something happened to Freya Phillips.
"Has Freya returned?"
A hint of excitement flashed across Connor's eyes, and then he hurriedly picked up the phone.
"Hi, Mr. Sharp."
Connor said with a smile.
"Hello, Mr. McDonald. Do you have time now?"
Benson asked seriously.
"Yeah. What's wrong?"
Connor felt that there was something wrong with Benson's tone, so he replied in a low voice.
"Mr. McDonald, there's a problem with Miss Phillips. I can't explain it over the phone. If you have time now, can you come to our company?"
Benson said softly.
"I'll go over now!"
Connor knew that something must have happened on Freya's end. Otherwise, Benson would never speak to him in such a tone. As such, he did not ask any further questions. He hung up the phone and reached out to hail a taxi.
Along the way, Connor had mixed feelings.
He did not know what had happened to Freya, but he had a bad feeling about it.
Recently, Connor had been paying attention to the situation at Heavens Club, so he did not pay attention to Freya.
Connor took out his phone and dialed Freya's number, but she had already turned off her phone.
The bad premonition he had became even stronger.
Connor had called Freya last night. She was still fine and told Connor that the matters in the U.S. had mostly been settled. She would probably be able to return to Oprana soon.
However, he couldn't contact Freya today. Everything happened too suddenly, catching Connor off guard.
Connor could only silently pray that Freya had not encountered any danger.
...

chapters.title: Chapter 1240: A Visit to the U.S.!
chapters.content:
Chapter 1240: A Visit to the U.S.!
Half an hour later, Connor arrived at Travio Corporation's office by taxi.
Benson was waiting anxiously for Connor downstairs. When he saw Connor get out of the car, he quickly walked to his side.
"Mr. Sharp, what exactly happened?"
Connor hurriedly asked after seeing Benson.
"Mr. McDonald, there are many people here. Let's talk in my office!"
Benson whispered to Connor.
When Connor saw that Benson looked a little nervous. he could feel that something big must have happened.
Therefore, Connor did not want to waste time. He walked into the Travio Corporation building.
A few minutes later, Connor followed Benson into the office.
Benson observed the situation outside with a tense expression. Then, he closed the office window and whispered to Connor, "Mr. McDonald, you must keep this a secret for me. This is a company secret. I'm the only one who knows about it now. If it gets out, I'll lose my job…"
"Don't worry. If you lose your job because of this, I'll find you a better job!"
Connor whispered to Benson.
Benson also had the same thought. He knew how powerful Connor was, so he risked being fired to tell Connor about it.
"Mr. Sharp, what happened? Why are you being so mysterious?"
Connor frowned and asked Benson.
Benson frowned and said in a low voice, "Mr. McDonald, I just received news that Miss Phillips has been transferred away by the headquarters. I think she has returned to the headquarters. In a few days, the new president of our branch company will be here. Something feels off, so I called you immediately..."
Benson took out a document and handed it to Connor.
Connor's eyes were filled with shock. He hurriedly picked up the document and took a closer look.
After going through the contents, it was clear that Freya was indeed going to be transferred to the headquarters.
This meant that Freya might not return home.
Then, he thought of his call to her just now. Freya's phone was currently switched off.
Connor knew that it was definitely Camila Yearwood's doing. Camila was still worried that Freya would regain her memory and leave her, so she wanted to take this opportunity to keep Freya by her side.
When Freya said that she was going to the U.S., Connor had already thought of this possibility.
However, Connor did not expect that this matter would actually happen the way he predicted.
"Mr. McDonald, very few people know about this, so you must keep it a secret for me!"
Benson said nervously.
"Don't worry, I'll get someone to transfer you a sum of money later. Just take it as compensation for your hard work!"
Connor was grateful to Benson. After all, if Benson hadn't told him, he might not have known what had happened.
"Phew!"
Connor took a deep breath and put down the document in his hand. He turned to Benson and asked, "Do you know where the Travio Corporation headquarters is?"
"In the U.S.!"
Benson said.
"I mean where exactly is it…"
Connor said helplessly.
"I'll send you the exact location later. I've never been to the headquarters either…"
Benson replied.
"Alright then!"
Connor looked at Benson and nodded. Then, he stood up and walked out of the office.
A moment later, Connor received an address from Benson. It was a location in New York in the U.S..
Connor knew very well that Freya was definitely held back in the U.S. by Camila, so there was only one thought in his mind, which was to go to the United States to find Freya and then have her eat the Soul Returning Pill. This way, Freya could regain her memories. As for how she would face her relationship with Camila, Connor had already thought about it for a long time.
Connor took out his phone and called Reena Satchwell, asking her to book a ticket to New York. He also told Reena that if anything happened at Heavens Club, as long as Reena could handle it, she could do what was necessary. There was no need to inform him at all.
After dealing with these matters, Connor took out his phone and called Rachel Wallace.
"Hello?"
Rachel quickly picked up the phone and said softly, "What is it? I'm in class!"
"I might not be going back for a while. I'm going to the U.S.!"
Connor said in a low voice.
"Okay!"
Rachel didn't waste any time and didn't ask Connor what he was going to do in the U.S.. She just replied with this sentence and hung up the phone.
Connor looked at his phone with a speechless expression. After all, he thought that Rachel would ask him why he was going to the U.S.!
But looking at it now, it was obviously Connor's own wishful thinking!
After making these calls, Reena sent a text message to Connor, telling him the flight time.
After Connor saw the text message, he immediately hailed a taxi and went to the airport.
Connor wasn't as nervous as before because he knew that Freya wasn't in any danger. Camila was Freya's biological mother, so Camila wouldn't do anything to her.
However, Connor was still worried. If Camila didn't agree to Freya's return, what should he do?
Also, Connor didn't know how Freya would deal with her relationship with Camila once she regained her memory. These questions lingered in Connor's mind, and he felt a little tired.
After more than half an hour, Connor finally arrived at the airport and waited for more than an hour before boarding the plane.
The U.S. was very far from Newtown, and it would take at least ten hours to get there. Fortunately, Reena had booked Connor a first-class seat, so it was quite comfortable.
In order to make time pass by faster, Connor went to sleep after boarding the plane.
Connor knew that once he reached the U.S., he would have a lot of things to do. It was very likely that he would not have time to rest.

chapters.title: Chapter 1241: Strife
chapters.content:
Chapter 1241: Strife
New York, the United States.
In an exceptionally high-end manor, there were a few luxurious villas.
This manor was one of the best in the entire U.S.. It covered an area of nearly 5,000 square meters and had a very large golf course and private swimming pool.
As long as you could think of something, it was here.
At this moment, a woman in a swimsuit was swimming in the pool.
The woman was about 40 years old, but she took good care of herself. Her figure was not out of shape at all, and her skin was very smooth and delicate.
If a woman of this age could still have such a figure and skin, it meant that this woman was very rich.
After all, it was very expensive for a woman to take care of herself.
Beside the swimming pool stood a beautiful woman in a white spaghetti strap dress.
Whether it was her figure or her appearance, this woman was the best of the best. However, such a top-notch beauty had a helpless expression on her face at this moment, and there was also a trace of anger.
The beautiful woman did not speak. She quietly waited for the beautiful older woman in the pool to come out.
A moment later, the beautiful older woman finally got out of the swimming pool. She took a towel from a bodyguard and gently wiped the water off her hair.
"Mom, what do you want?"
Freya stepped forward and shouted at Camila with a frown.
"Freya, the weather is pretty good today. Let's go play golf!"
The beautiful older woman draped a towel over her shoulders and asked Freya softly.
"I'm not in the mood to play golf with you right now!"
Freya exclaimed with a speechless expression before continuing, "Why did you hide my passport, my credit card and my phone? What do you want to do?"
"I'll return your credit card to you soon but forget about your passport and phone. It's useless for you to have these things now!"
Camila sipped her red wine elegantly as she spoke to Freya softly.
Freya was stunned when she heard Camila's words. She frowned and said, "Mom, are you kidding me? If I don't have a cell phone, how am I going to return to Oprana? Who would handle the company's business?"
"You don't have to worry about the company's matters. I've already informed the Oprana branch. You don't have to go back."
Camila said lightly.
"..."
Freya was stunned when she heard Camila's words. She then asked Camila in disbelief, "Mom, what do you mean by that?"
"It's very simple. From now on, I want you to stay by my side. I won't let you return to Oprana!"
Camila said softly.
"Why? Why can't I go back?"
Freya shouted in surprise.
"Why? Don't you know why? How many times have I told you to stay away from Connor, but you just don't listen? You keep wanting to be with him. A person like Connor isn't worthy of you. I've already arranged a blind date for you. I'll let the two of you meet soon…"
Camila said calmly.
"You arranged a blind date for me?"
Freya was stunned when she heard this. She then shouted, "When did I say that I want to go on a blind date? The person I like is Connor. I won't go on a blind date with anyone!"
"It is not up to you to decide!"
Camila replied coldly before continuing, "My worst decision back then was to let you return to Oprana. If you hadn't returned back then, none of this would have happened!"
"Can't I decide my own life?"
Freya looked at Camila and smiled helplessly.
"That's right. These things are not up to you. You are my daughter. I will definitely not allow you to be together with someone like Connor. It's best for you to forget this person as soon as possible. This way, it won't hurt too much…"
Camila said lightly.
"The person I like is Connor. I won't be with anyone else. Even if you're my mother, you can't change that!"
Freya bit her lip and stubbornly said to Camila.
"..."
Camila couldn't help but sneer when she heard Freya's words. She then whispered, "Freya, I'm your mother. I definitely won't hurt you. A person like Connor isn't worthy of you at all."
"You're just using me to satisfy your own ambitions. Why should I sacrifice my happiness for your ambitions?"
Freya couldn't take it anymore and shouted at Camila coldly.
"Why you!"
Camila stood up abruptly and glared at Freya.
A few seconds later, Camila calmed herself down and looked at Freya. "I don't care what you think. Your passport and your phone are with me. From now on, you can't leave this manor. You can only leave when you've calmed down, but you can forget about returning to Oprana for the rest of your life!"
"Why?!"
Freya shouted.
"Because I'm your mother!"
Camila looked at Freya and said calmly.
When Freya heard this, she broke down and shouted, "If you don't let me go back to Oprana, I'll go on a hunger strike. I'll starve myself to death…"
"Freya, don't be so childish. People can't starve themselves to death. Everything I'm doing now is for your own good. You might not understand now, but sooner or later, you will!"
Camila calmly replied to Freya, then stood up and walked into the villa.
Freya stood where she was and looked at Camila's back. She was livid as she walked out of the manor.
However, at this moment, a few tall bodyguards were blocking Freya's path.
Freya looked at the bodyguards in front of her and took a deep breath before asking softly, "What are you doing?"
"Miss, I hope you won't make things difficult for us. Miss Yearwood said that you can't leave this manor. It's our responsibility to ensure your safety!"
The bodyguard explained.
"Are you protecting me or keeping watch over me?"
Freya shouted at the bodyguard in despair.
...

chapters.title: Chapter 1242: I Want to Go in and Take Her by Force!
chapters.content:
Chapter 1242: I Want to Go in and Take Her by Force!
Ten hours later.
The plane finally arrived at the New York airport and landed on the runway.
Connor got off the plane alone and walked to the exit of the New York airport.
At this moment, countless people passed him by. These people were all foreigners from all over the world.
It was Connor's first time in New York, one of the most prosperous cities in the world.
Connor took a deep breath, then took out his phone and dialed a number.
"Hello, Mr. McDonald!"
The other party quickly picked up the phone and said respectfully.
"I've already landed!"
Connor said lightly.
"Alright, I'll go to you now!"
The other party hurriedly replied.
"Alright!"
Connor then hung up.
A few minutes later, an Oprana young man walked up to Connor and asked, "Excuse me, are you Mr. McDonald?"
"Yes!"
Connor sized up the young man and replied indifferently.
The young man looked ordinary and wore a black suit. He gave off the feeling of a white-collar worker who had just joined the workforce.
"Mr. McDonald, Mr. Morgan has already told me about your situation. I've booked a hotel for you. Are we going to eat now or the hotel to rest first?"
The young man looked at Connor and asked.
Steven Lee's businesses were spread all over the world, including New York.
Connor owned more than a dozen listed companies in New York, and the young man standing in front of Connor was the president of a listed company.
Originally, Thomas Morgan wanted the person in charge of the Empire World Corporation in New York see to Connor, but Connor was only here to deal with some private matters, so there was no need to make too much noise about it. If he let the person in charge of New York see to him, the presidents of other companies would probably have to meet Connor, which would only delay him further. Therefore, Connor asked Thomas to find someone else to see to him.
"Do you know this place?"
Connor handed his phone to the young man and asked expressionlessly.
"Charles Manor?"
When the young man saw the address on Connor's phone, he was a little surprised. Then, he said softly, "Mr. McDonald, this is a very famous manor in New York. The owner of this manor is the chairman of Travio Corporation!"
"That's right. This is the place I'm looking for!"
Connor said lightly.
"You're going to meet the chairman of Travio Corporation?"
The young man asked Connor in surprise.
"I guess so!"
Connor replied indifferently.
"Then, this way please."
Although the young man didn't know what Connor wanted to do, he didn't dare to ask. He quickly took Connor to a black Rolls-Royce.
Because Connor didn't want to make a big deal out of his visit, the young man didn't bring a driver or bodyguard when he came to pick Connor up. He followed Connor alone the whole time.
From their conversations, Connor learned that this young man was called Derrick Tempel, who was a few years older than Connor.
Previously, Derrick had been living in Oprana. As Derrick's father was Thomas Morgan's good friend, he had been working for the Empire World Corporation for many years. However, he chose to retire not long ago due to health reasons. Therefore, Thomas had Derrick become the president of a company under the Empire World Corporation.
Derrick could become the president of a listed company at such a young age partly because of his father and partly because he was very capable.
Connor knew very well that Freya was currently under Camila's control.
Connor didn't intend to explain anything to Camila. He wanted to use the simplest and most direct method to take Freya away.
After about one hour, Derrick parked the car at the gate of Charles Manor. He then turned around and whispered to Connor, "Mr. McDonald, we've arrived at Charles Manor. Do you want me to go down and talk to them?"
"There's no need for that!
Connor replied indifferently and then continued, "Wait for me here. No matter what happens, you can't leave, you understand?"
"Mr. McDonald, what are your plans?"
Derrick looked at Connor with confusion.
"I want to go in and get her, by force!"
Connor replied calmly before pushing open the door and getting off the car.
Derrick sat in the car and watched Connor's back with a confused look.
Although Derrick had not seen Connor before, he had heard a lot about him. In Derrick's eyes, Connor was nothing more than a rich guy with good luck. If he didn't inherit Steven Lee's inheritance, Connor was nothing.
Therefore, Derrick disliked Connor. He felt that Connor came to New York for a vacation.
Although Derrick disliked Connor, he knew that Connor's identity was not ordinary. Therefore, he had also prepared a lot of things for Connor.
However, Derrick had never imagined that Connor would not be interested in all that. The moment he got off the plane, he came to Charles Manor and said that he was going to take someone by force.
Derrick didn't know what Connor was going to do.
Additionally, Derrick could vaguely feel that Connor was not as he was described in the rumors. Although they had not known each other for a long time, Derrick felt that Connor was very mysterious.
"Mr. McDonald!"
Donder hurriedly shouted when he saw Connor walking towards Charles Manor.
"Yes?"
Connor turned around and threw a glance at Derrick as he asked him expressionlessly.
"Mr. McDonald, the chairman of Travio Corporation is not someone to mess with. Moreover, there are many bodyguards in this manor. If you really want to take someone by force, I can help you contact some local people, but if you go in alone, there... there might be danger…"
Derrick whispered after hesitating for a second.
"Danger?"
After hearing Derrick's words, Connor revealed a faint smile. He didn't say anything else as he continued to walk toward Charles Manor.
At this moment, Derrick was completely dumbfounded. He had not imagined that the legendary Mr. McDonald would be so valiant.
He had just arrived in New York, and he was already going to the famous Charles Manor to grab someone!
"What is he trying to do?"
A helpless look flashed across Derrick's eyes. After that, he took out his phone to call Thomas Morgan.
...

chapters.title: Chapter 1243: Breaking In
chapters.content:
Chapter 1243: Breaking In
After getting off the car, Connor walked briskly towards the entrance of Charles Manor.
The gates of the manor were open, but two burly bodyguards stood at the entrance.
"Who are you?"
The bodyguards, upon seeing Connor, asked in a low voice.
Connor looked up at the bodyguards and calmly said, "I want to see Freya..."
"You want to see Miss Freya?"
The bodyguards were visibly taken aback, then said in a low voice, "I'm sorry, Mrs. Yearwood has instructed that no one, regardless of who they are, can see Miss Freya. It's best for you to leave."
"Just because others can't see her doesn't mean I can't see her!"
Connor replied calmly to the bodyguards and continued walking towards the manor.
"Stop right there!"
The bodyguard, seeing that Connor intended to force his way in, hurriedly reached out to stop him.
But these two bodyguards were just ordinary people, and they were no match for him.
He swung his fist, landing a powerful blow to the bodyguard's stomach, and the bodyguard was instantly sent flying.
The other bodyguard didn't expect him to be so audacious, daring to take action inside Charles Manor. He tried to rush forward.
Connor lifted his leg and kicked the man in the stomach, sending him flying as well.
After dealing with the two bodyguards at the entrance, he continued walking towards the manor.
Meanwhile, Derrick, who was sitting in the car, was dumbfounded when he saw this scene. His expression was filled with disbelief.
Derrick never expected that Connor would actually come to snatch someone!
"Is Mr. Connor out of his mind?"
He muttered nervously, constantly dialing Thomas's phone.
But Thomas didn't answer the call.
Derrick's expression showed his increasing anxiety, not knowing what to do.
Meanwhile, the other bodyguards inside the manor, upon learning that someone had broken in at the entrance, rushed towards Connor's location.
However, these bodyguards were no match for him. They couldn't even withstand a single punch from him.
At the same time...
In Camila's room.
Freya was still arguing with Camila about why she couldn't return to Oprana.
"Freya, you may not understand me now, but you will understand in the future. So stop arguing with me. No matter what you say, I won't let you go back to Oprana..."
Her attitude remained resolute, furrowing her brows as she spoke to Freya.
Freya's expression showed anger as she stared at her mother and shouted with watery eyes, "Mom, whether I can go back or not is my own business. Why should you decide? Don't I have the right to choose who I like and who I want to be with?"
"No..." she said coldly.
Upon hearing Camila's words, Freya couldn't help but furrow her brows, her expression filled with helplessness.
At this moment, a young man rushed in, looking excited, and shouted at Camila, "Something major has happened, Miss!"
Camila turned her head, looking displeased, and asked coldly, "What happened? Why are you so flustered?"
"Someone has broken into our manor!"
The young man said in an excited tone.
"What audacity! Who dares to break into our Charles Manor? Are they tired of living?"
A flash of fierceness crossed Camila's eyes as she spoke, then she walked to the window.
"Who broke in?"
Freya was also curious and asked the young man in a soft voice.
"It's... an Opranian..."
The young man replied.
"An Opranian?"
Freya's face showed surprise upon hearing this, then without any hesitation, she walked quickly to the window.
When she saw Connor, who was fighting with the bodyguards, her whole person froze in place, her expression filled with disbelief as she said, "Why did Connor come? How did he know I'm here?"
"I didn't expect this Connor to be so audacious, daring to break into my manor. He's really asking for trouble!"
Camila stood up and said in a cold voice to the young man, "Go and inform the bodyguards in the manor. They must catch this person for me, alive. Understand?"
"Understood!"
The young man nodded.
"By the way, find two people to watch over Miss Freya for me!"
Camila turned her head and looked at Freya, speaking softly.
"Okay..."
The young man nodded again.
Freya's expression showed extreme anxiety. She didn't understand why Connor would come here, and she was very worried about his safety.
"Mom, I think there is some misunderstanding. Could you let me go out and explain to Connor?"
Freya shouted excitedly at Camila.
"What is there to explain?"
Camila sneered and continued, "I didn't expect this Connor to have the audacity to come here. But it's fine. I can take this opportunity to teach him a lesson and prevent him from having any intentions about you..."
Freya looked at Camila in front of her, her expression filled with despair.
Because she couldn't understand why Connor had been so impulsive, daring to come in alone. Wasn't he just asking for trouble?
On the other side, the bodyguards inside the manor, upon receiving Camila's orders, all rushed towards Connor's location!
In no time, Connor was surrounded by nearly twenty people.
Seeing so many bodyguards almost simultaneously surrounding Connor, Freya's face showed extreme nervousness. She didn't even have the courage to see what would happen next.
"Feier, don't worry, I won't hurt him. I just want to teach him a lesson!"
Camila reassured.

chapters.title: Chapter 1244: So What?
chapters.content:
Chapter 1244: So What?
Because Camila couldn't understand why Freya, who had only returned to the country for less than half a year, would develop such intense feelings for Connor.
Camila couldn't help but doubt in her heart whether Freya had already regained her memories.
"Freya..."
"Mom, have you changed your mind?"
Upon hearing her words, Freya's expression became extremely excited as she asked her.
"I haven't changed my mind. I'm just curious about your feelings for Connor. Have you regained your memories?"
She asked with a furrowed brow.
"Regain my memories?"
Freya looked at Camila and couldn't help but pause, then furrowed her brow and said softly, "Mom, what are you talking about? I haven't regained my memories!"
"Then what's the deal with your feelings for Connor?"
Camila asked with great confusion.
"I... I don't know, but I just feel a strong familiarity with Connor. Although I lost my previous memories, there has always been a voice in my mind telling me that Connor is the person I've been looking for, that Connor is my lover. And as I continued to interact with Connor, I realized that I have indeed fallen in love with him. This feeling is incredibly strange to me..."
She softly said to Camila.
Upon hearing her words, Camila's facial expression began to grow solemn.
She was very aware that although Freya had undergone surgery to remove all her previous memories, that operation was not infallible. Some deep memories would still remain in Freya's mind.
Freya was in a very dangerous situation now, and Camila felt that she must keep her away from Connor.
Otherwise, all the efforts put in over this long period of time would be in vain.
"Mom, please call those people back quickly. Connor is no match for them. What if they really end up killing Connor?"
Freya anxiously shouted at Camila.
"Freya, you don't need to worry about these matters. I will handle it," she calmly replied to Freya, and a hint of killing intent flashed in her eyes.
She felt that Connor was too dangerous, she couldn't let Connor continue to have contact with Freya.
And the best way to prevent all of this from happening was to get rid of him!
...
On the other side, Derrick saw the group of over twenty bodyguards surrounding him and became extremely nervous.
However, Connor had instructed him not to leave the car no matter what happened, so he didn't dare to rush out and save Connor.
After making a dozen phone calls to Thomas, he finally answered the call. He then spoke softly, "Derrick, has Mr. Connor arrived in New York?"
"Thomas, something big has happened..."
Derrick shouted loudly, then continued, "After Mr. Connor arrived in New York, he had me bring him to Charles Manor. Then he got into a fight with the security guards there. Mr. Connor wouldn't let me leave the car, and now I don't know what I should do!"
"If Mr. Connor doesn't want you to leave the car, then you should just wait in the car..."
Thomas calmly said.
"No, Thomas, Mr. Connor is in grave danger now!"
Derrick shouted anxiously.
"Don't worry, Mr. Connor won't be in any danger. Just do as he told you..."
Thomas calmly said.
"Thomas, are you joking? There are so many people..."
Derrick said with confusion.
"Don't worry, those people are no match for him!"
Thomas replied indifferently, then hung up the phone.
After seeing the call being disconnected, Derrick looked at Connor's location with a puzzled expression. He had no idea what he should do now!
Derrick couldn't understand why Thomas was so confident. He even doubted whether Thomas was intentionally setting a trap for Connor. Thomas knew that he was in danger but chose not to help him.
...
On the other side, all the bodyguards from Charles Manor rushed out and surrounded Connor.
He quickly glanced at the bodyguards in front of him. They were all ordinary people, not a single one was a martial artist.
Naturally, he didn't pay any attention to them.
"Kid, I advise you to surrender now..."
A middle-aged man shouted loudly at him.
Upon hearing these words, he sneered, then exerted his strength and charged into the crowd.
Soon, cries of agony filled the air.
One after another, the bodyguards were sent flying from the crowd. They hadn't even realized what was happening, only feeling darkness before being sent flying.
No one had expected his skills to be so formidable. In less than a minute, he had already knocked out over a dozen bodyguards.
Instantly, the sound of wailing echoed throughout Charles Manor.
Connor was anxious to see Freya, so he didn't hesitate at all and put all his strength into each strike.
If the bodyguards surrounding him were all martial artists, it wouldn't have been so easy for him. However, these people were just ordinary individuals, not martial artists, so they were powerless to stop Connor.
Not far away, Derrick watched everything happening at Charles Manor, completely dumbfounded. His expression was filled with shock, admiration, and disbelief. Derrick never imagined that Connor's skills would be so terrifying.
Over twenty bodyguards were like paper tigers in front of Connor.
"Who is this Mr. Connor?"
What Derrick witnessed at that moment felt like something that would only happen in a TV drama. It was too unreal, too unbelievable to accept.
"Bang!"
At that moment, Connor punched and sent the last bodyguard blocking his way flying.
In less than two minutes, all the bodyguards in Charles Manor had been defeated.
Derrick looked at Connor's location, his eyes filled with shock, admiration, and disbelief.
Connor didn't waste any more time on these people and continued walking towards the villa with determined steps.
"If you enter this villa today, you'll be an enemy of our Travio Corporation!"
A bodyguard shouted at him in a low voice.
"So what?"
He replied indifferently and continued walking towards the villa.

chapters.title: Chapter 1245: Freya's Choice
chapters.content:
Chapter 1245: Freya's Choice
At Charles Manor.
Camila seemed to have no regard for Connor because she believed that the bodyguards in the manor were all professionally trained.
And Connor was just an ordinary person, so even if he had great skills, he couldn't possibly be a match for those bodyguards.
At this moment, Freya kept pleading with Camila to spare Connor. She genuinely didn't want him to get hurt because of her.
But at this moment, the young man who had previously informed them rushed into Camila's room again.
"Miss Camila, that person is incredibly powerful. Our men couldn't stop him. He has already entered the villa!"
The young man, who had entered the villa, shouted excitedly at Camila.
Upon hearing these words, she froze, her expression filled with disbelief, and she asked the young man in a low voice, "What did you just say?"
"Our bodyguards are no match for that guy!"
The young man repeated in a hurry.
"How is that possible? So many of our people couldn't even handle Connor alone?"
Camila's expression showed surprise, and she walked directly to the window and glanced outside.
At this moment, all the bodyguards in the manor were lying on the ground, but he was nowhere to be seen.
"Who is this Connor? How can he be so powerful?"
Camila's eyes were filled with shock.
"Bang!"
Just then, a loud noise came from the entrance.
Connor kicked the door open.
And Freya instinctively turned her head to look.
He stood expressionless at the doorway.
"Connor!"
Freya shouted and rushed to him, hugging him tightly. Her expression was tense as she asked, "Connor, are you okay?"
"I'm fine." he replied calmly to her.
Camila, the chairman of a multinational corporation, remained calm despite Connor charging into the room.
She asked Connor softly, "What do you want to do?"
"I want to take Freya away," he replied with the same calmness.
Upon hearing his words, Camila couldn't help but smile lightly and said coldly, "What qualifies you to take away my daughter?"
"She is my fiancée," he replied indifferently and held Freya's hand, intending to walk out of the room.
"Connor, if you dare to take my daughter away today, I will make you regret it for the rest of your life. I, Camila, always keep my word!"
She finally showed some agitation and shouted loudly at Connor.
"You don't have the authority to threaten me!"
Connor turned his head, disdainfully replied to Camila, and continued walking forward.
"Freya, do you really intend to leave with this person? If you choose to leave with him, don't ever come back! You won't have me as your mother..."
Seeing that Connor wasn't afraid of her anymore, Camila started playing the emotional card with Freya.
Freya understood that she had to make a choice between Connor and Camila.
On one side was her mother, and on the other side was her fiancé whom she had known for less than half a year. Freya didn't know how to make her choice.
"Connor, can I trust you?"
She looked up at him, her tone serious as she asked.
"You can trust me."
Connor replied calmly.
"Okay, I'll go with you!"
Freya nodded gently and looked at Camila, saying, "Mom, I'm not your puppet. I have my own thoughts. I won't do whatever you tell me to do. I want to go back to my country, and I want to be with Connor. So, I'm leaving with him!"
After hearing her words, Camila was stunned, her expression filled with shock.
She never expected that in the choice between Connor and herself, Freya would choose Connor.
"Let's go!"
Connor softly said to Freya.
"Mom, I'm sorry..."
Freya left these words behind for Camila and prepared to leave with Connor.
Taking a deep breath, Camila hesitated for a long time. In the end, she chose to watch Connor take Freya away without resorting to using the gun she took out from her clothes.
Camila understood that Connor was right. If she killed him in front of Freya, her daughter might never forgive her. She had no way to continue using Freya for her own purposes.
So, she could only choose to watch helplessly as Connor took Freya away.
Connor took Freya and left Charles Manor, heading straight to the car where Derrick was.
"Mr. Connor, you're back?"
Derrick glanced at Freya and asked nervously.
"Yes, let's go to the hotel now."
Connor said calmly.
"Okay... Okay..."
Derrick stammered in reply and started the car.
When Connor had previously told Derrick that he was going to "steal someone," Derrick thought he was joking. But he didn't expect Connor to actually snatch a woman from Charles Manor.
At this moment, Freya hadn't figured out what was going on, so she was still shaken and had a tense expression on her face.
"Mr. Connor, there's been a car following us all along. Should I shake them off?"
Derrick whispered to Connor.
"No need."
Connor replied indifferently.
"Alright..."
Derrick nodded and continued driving.
After taking a deep breath, she turned her head towards Connor and asked, "Connor, what's going on?"
"I'll explain everything to you once we're at the hotel," he replied to her in a low voice.
"Okay..."
Freya fully trusted Connor. She knew that he would never harm her, no matter what he did.

chapters.title: Chapter 1246: Unconscious
chapters.content:
Chapter 1246: Unconscious
Half an hour later, Connor and Freya arrived at a five-star hotel.
This hotel was very famous, so the security was very strict. Connor was worried that Camila Yearwood's people would come looking for them.
He also knew that even if Camila's people came, he wouldn't be able to beat them.
Connor followed Freya into the room.
Freya sat on the sofa and asked, "Connor, what is going on? Why did my mother suddenly stop me from going back? Also, how did you know that I was trapped?"
After hesitating for a moment, Connor took out the Soul Returning Pill and said softly, "Freya, it might be difficult for you to understand what I'm trying to explain now. If you believe me, then eat this pill. After you do, you'll know why all of this is happening!"
Freya looked at the pill in Connor's hand, and a hint of confusion flashed across her eyes. She frowned and asked, "What is this?"
"As long as you eat this pill, you will be able to regain all your memories!" Connor said.
Freya blinked. "Really?"
"Really!" Connor nodded.
Freya smiled and teased, "Aren't you worried that I'll break up with you if I remember something bad about you after eating this pill?"
"If you really want to, then there's nothing I can do. However, these memories belong to you. I hope you can find them. I don't want you to be used by others!"
Connor looked at Freya with an unusually serious expression.
"..."
Freya took a deep breath and took the Soul Returning Pill. After hesitating for two seconds, she put the pill into her mouth.
In the next second, Freya's expression turned pained.
"Connor, my head hurts…"
Freya clutched her head tightly as countless images flooded into her mind.
Perhaps it was because there was too much information that Freya simply could not handle it.
When Connor saw this scene, he was stunned because he did not know what was going on.
"Freya, are you alright? Freya…!"
Connor shouted excitedly. However, Freya did not have any reaction. After crying out in pain, she collapsed onto the sofa and fell unconscious.
"Freya…Freya…!"
Connor shouted excitedly, but she did not react.
Connor found his phone in a panic and dialed Thomas's number.
Thomas quickly picked up the call. "Mr. McDonald, what's wrong?"
"Thomas, go to my master now and ask him what side effects there are after taking the Soul Returning Pill. Why did Freya faint after eating it?" Connor shouted anxiously.
"Alright, Mr. McDonald, I'll go and ask Master Yarrell now!"
Thomas agreed and hung up.
Connor stood by Freya's side with a worried expression.
He didn't know what was going on. He wasn't even sure if Freya would wake up.
Half an hour later, Feng's phone finally rang.
Connor quickly picked up the phone and asked excitedly, "President Fang, what's going on?"
"Mr. McDonald, you don't have to be so worried. Master Yarrell said that this is a normal situation. After all, Miss Phillips has recovered all her memories from more than 20 years ago. There is a large amount of information in these memories. A normal person's brain needs some time to digest them. Miss Phillips's brain should have reacted instinctively to stress, which is why she fainted..." Thomas explained.
"That means Freya is fine now, right?"
Connor's mood instantly improved after hearing Thomas's words.
"Yes, Miss Phillips is fine!" Thomas replied.
Connor took a deep breath and continued asking, "Then did my master say when Freya will wake up?"
"This depends on Miss Phillips's own physical fitness. Under normal circumstances, she will definitely wake up within five days, but there are also people who wake up in three days…" Thomas said.
Connor let out a long sigh and said in a low voice, "Oh, I get it now, sorry to trouble you!"
"Mr. McDonald, there's no need to be so polite…" Thomas said with a smile.
"I have no choice. I have troubled you too many times!" Connor replied indifferently and then continued, "Find me a few trustworthy bodyguards and have them guard the hotel 24/7. I'm worried that Camila might still attack Freya!"
"Alright!"
Thomas agreed and then hung up the phone.
After Connor put down his phone, he glanced at Freya, who was lying on the sofa. At this moment, Freya's expression was no longer as painfed as just now.
Connor took a deep breath. Although he did not know if what he did was right or wrong, Connor felt that those memories belonged to Freya, so she had the right to recover her memories.
Connor took off Freya's high heels and carried her into the bedroom.
Just like that, he sat quietly by the bed and waited for her to wake up.
The night passed quickly.
Connor didn't know when he fell asleep last night. When he woke up, it was already past ten in the morning.
Freya was still in a coma, but she would talk in her sleep from time to time. This proved that she was indeed fine.
Connor was relieved to know that she was fine.
Knock! Knock!
At this moment, there was a knock on the door.
Connor strode to the door and glanced outside through the peephole. After seeing that it was Derrick Tempel, he opened the door.
After the door was opened, Derrick said, "Mr. McDonald, someone wants to see you!"
Connor frowned and asked, "Who is it?"
"I don't know who she is either. She said that he must see you in person before she can say what's the matter…" Derrick answered.
"It's probably Camila Yearwood's people. No one else should know that I'm here…" Connor said indifferently.

chapters.title: Chapter 1247: Listen to My Story
chapters.content:
Chapter 1247: Listen to My Story
Connor hesitated for a moment, then said, "Has Thomas Morgan's bodyguards arrived?"
"Yes, they're here…"
Derrick nodded.
"Okay, go and discuss with the hotel manager now. Book the entire hotel for me, then get the bodyguards to guard the door. No one is allowed to come in. Leave two people at the door of this room. If anyone comes in, shoot them on sight," Connor said.
After hearing Connor's words, Derrick looked a bit surprised. "So you still don't want to see that person?"
"I'll see them after I'm done with these things!"
Connor replied to Derrick calmly.
"Alright!"
Although Derrick didn't understand why Connor did that, he didn't dare to say anything. He hurriedly followed Connor's orders.
Half an hour later, Derrick returned to Connor's room. "Mr. McDonald, I've done as you instructed. There's no one else in this hotel now. Everyone here is one of our bodyguards!"
"Good!" Connor nodded and continued, "If anything happens to my fiancée, I'll come for you first, understand?"
"I know, I know…" Derrick nodded.
"Take me to see that person now!"
Connor said lightly.
"Mr. McDonald, please come over here…"
Derrick hurriedly led the way for Connor.
A few minutes later, Connor saw that person.
This was not the first time Connor had seen this young man—he'd seen the man before at Charles Manor.
"Did Camila Yearwood ask you to come?" Connor asked.
The young man didn't waste any time and directly replied to Connor. "That's right, President Yearwood wants to meet you!"
"I don't have time. You can go!"
Connor said lightly.
"President Yearwood wants to talk to you about Miss Phillips!" the young man hurriedly said.
Connor turned his head and looked at the young man. After hesitating for two seconds, he said, "Where is she now? Bring me there!"
Connor knew that Camila was indeed Freya's biological mother, so he should explain some things to her. But no matter what, Connor would not allow Camila to continue using Freya like this.
The young man didn't say anything after Connor agreed. He stood up and led Connor out of the hotel.
Connor turned around and took a look at Derrick before saying lightly, "Take good care of my fiancée…"
"Yes, Mr. McDonald!"
Derrick hurriedly nodded.
Ten minutes later, Connor followed the young man to a cafe.
After entering the cafe, the young man brought Connor into the private room.
At this time, Camila was sitting in the private room quietly waiting for Connor. She was wearing a white women's suit, and her hair was tied up high. She gave people the feeling that she was a strong woman.
After Camila saw Connor, she said, "Please sit!"
Connor didn't say anything and sat directly across from Camila. He then asked, "What do you want to talk about?"
"I want to talk to you about my daughter!"
Camila said lightly.
"Talk about your daughter?"
Connor couldn't help but laugh when he heard this. Then, he said indifferently, "I think there's nothing more to talk about between the two of us. I won't let you continue to use Freya."
Camila gritted her teeth. "I won't agree to you being with my daughter!"
"You don't have the final say in this matter. Whether you agree or not has nothing to do with me. If you're only here to talk to me about this matter, then I'll leave!"
After saying this, Connor planned to get up and leave.
"There's 50 million here. Take this money and disappear!"
Camila took out a bank card and placed it on the table as she said coldly.
"Isn't your strategy a little too low? Moreover, you want to send me away with 50 million? Aren't you looking down on me?"
Connor said to Camila.
"I didn't expect you to be so greedy. Just name a number and I'll satisfy you!" Camila said.
"I'm sorry, I'm not short of money, nor am I interested in money!"
After Camila heard Connor's words, her expression became a little ugly. She frowned and said, "Not only will this harm you, but it will also harm Freya. Do you know that?"
"The person who really wants to harm her is you, not me!"
Connor said in a low voice.
"You are too naive!" Camila sneered and continued, "Do you want to hear my story?"
"Tell me then!"
Connor said lightly.
"My name is Camila Yearwood. The Yearwood family that I was from could be considered one of the top families in the country. The family's businesses extend all over the world. The influence of the Yearwood family is definitely not something you can imagine. The Travio Corporation that I'm currently in is just the tip of the iceberg of the Yearwood family," Camila said.
"Top ten?"
Connor couldn't help but sneer when he heard Camila's words.
Camila probably didn't know that Connor's assets were ten times the amount of the Yearwood family's assets.
However, he did not expose his identity at this time.
At this moment, Camila continued. "But the most powerful thing about our Yearwood family is not business, but ancient martial arts!"
"Ancient martial arts?"
When Connor heard Camila's words, he couldn't help but be stunned.
"Yes, our Yearwood family is an ancient martial arts family. At that time, we were also famous in Oprana. Although we have rarely participated in ancient martial arts matters in recent years, the influence of the Yearwood family still exists!" Camila continued.
"..."
Connor looked at Camila in front of him with a surprised expression. He didn't expect the Yearwood family to be part of an ancient martial arts world.
"My father was just a side branch of the Yearwood family, so I was not valued by them since I was young. There were even many people who laughed at me. I was not qualified to become a martial artist, so I could only work hard to make myself stand out. I relied on my own hard work to have today's achievements…"
Camila said as she sipped her coffee.

chapters.title: Chapter 1248: Marriage Agreement
chapters.content:
Chapter 1248: Marriage Agreement
"And then…?" Connor asked.
"That's the end. It's incredible that I can become the Chairman of Travio Corporation. So now I can only place all my hopes on Freya. I want her to participate in the competition to become the next head of the Yearwood family. Freya is my only hope!"
"I hope Freya can accomplish what I have never accomplished in my life. Do you understand what I mean?" Camila continued. "The Yearwood family's business empire is very large. If Freya really becomes the Yearwood family's head, then she can live a life without worry—a life that everyone envies!"
"But Freya doesn't seem to be very interested in these things!" Connor protested.
"Right now, Freya doesn't know anything. In the future, she will naturally understand my painstaking efforts!" Camila quickly refuted. "I have already used all my connections to pave the way for Freya. Now, many people in the Yearwood family will support me. Freya has a high probability of inheriting the Yearwood family's business, so I won't allow any accidents to happen now..."
"Since you want Freya to inherit the Yearwood family's business so much, why did you abandon Freya back then?"
Connor asked Camila with a puzzled expression.
"I abandoned Freya?"
Camila couldn't help but laugh. She then shook her head and said, "You're too naive. How can there be a mother in this world who's willing to abandon her child? I chose to leave to protect Sean Phillips and Freya!"
"Protect?" Connor couldn't help but be stunned when he heard Camila's words.
