"That's right, I'm protecting them!" Camila nodded gently and continued, "At that time, I was too much of a target. Many people in the Yearwood family had their eyes on me. They felt that I was a threat to their position, so they began to think of ways to deal with me!"
"If they had known that I had a child with Sean Phillips back then, they would definitely have killed Freya. I couldn't tell anyone about this, so I could only choose to leave quietly."
Camila explained.
"Then why are you looking for Freya now?"
Connor asked.
"Because I now have the ability to protect Freya. The Yearwood family no longer dares to deal with me. They are all afraid of me now!" Camila said confidently to Connor.
"I see!"
Connor nodded lightly.
"So you must separate from Freya now. Otherwise, you will be in danger. Freya and I will also be in danger!"
Camila hurriedly struck while the iron was hot.
"Didn't you already say that the Yearwood family is afraid of you? Then why was Freya still in danger?"
Connor asked in confusion.
"The Yearwood family is afraid of me because I arranged a marriage for Freya. The other party is the young master of an ancient martial arts family in Oprana. This person's future is limitless, and the Yearwood family doesn't dare to offend this big family. If Freya can be with this person, then it will be very easy for her to inherit the Yearwood family's business in the future!"
Camila paused for a moment before continuing, "But if Freya chooses to be with you now and is discovered by this big family, I will be in danger, Freya will also be in danger, and you will also be hunted down by this big family."
"The engagement can be canceled. I'm also engaged with Freya!"
Connor said calmly.
"The engagement between you and Freya doesn't count at all!" Camila shouted. She felt that Connor still didn't understand what she meant.
"Why doesn't my engagement count?"
Connor asked directly.
"Connor, you are seeking your own death now. Once that big family discovers your existence, they will definitely use all means to get rid of you. At that time, no one can save you. Even if that big family lets you go, the Yearwood family won't. You are just an ordinary person, after all!" Camila shouted excitedly.
"..."
Connor said nothing.
Camila saw that Connor didn't say anything and continued. "I originally didn't plan to tell you these things. After all, the less you know, the better. However, since you've already asked this much, I can only explain this matter to you clearly!"
"I know what you mean. In order to let Freya inherit the Yearwood family's business, you got a fiancé for her. If I get together with her, then those people will kill me."
Connor looked at Camila calmly.
"That's right, that's what I mean. You don't even realize how dangerous your situation is!" Camila hurriedly nodded.
"Does Freya know about this?" Connor asked.
"Freya doesn't know yet. I plan to tell her about this after she breaks up with you!" Camila replied.
"Since Freya doesn't know about this, then why did you set up a marriage agreement for her? You've explained so much, but aren't you treating Freya as your tool?" Connor shouted angrily at Camila and continued, "I've said it before. I won't allow anyone to use Freya. If Freya wants to be with me, then I won't let go!"
"You!"
Camila suddenly stood up and glared at Connor, her expression unusually angry.
"I forgot to tell you that the Yearwood family and the ancient martial arts families you mentioned are nothing in front of me. If they want to deal with me, I will fight with them at any time, but I will never give Freya to anyone!"
Connor then stood up and planned to leave.
"Connor, if you really have such ability, I can't wait for you to be with my daughter. But all of this is just your arrogance at work. You will pay the price for your arrogance sooner or later!"
Camila stood up and shouted.
"I'm arrogant, you say?" After hearing Camila's words, Connor couldn't help but sneer. Then he said lightly, "You're the one who's really arrogant, not me!"

chapters.title: Chapter 1249: Recovering Memories
chapters.content:
Chapter 1249: Recovering Memories
After hearing Camila's words, Connor finally understood what was going on.
Camila had left Freya and Sean Phillips to protect them. Now, she planned to let Freya inherit the Yearwood family's business and had arranged a fiancé for Freya without Freya's knowledge. This fiancé was likely from a big ancient martial arts family in Oprana.
If Freya continued to be with Connor, not only would he be in danger, but she as well. Camila's long-term plan would also fail.
However, Connor didn't take Camila's words to heart because he didn't have to be afraid of them at all!
…
After parting ways with Camila, Connor returned to the hotel.
As the hotel was filled with Connor's men, Freya was still very safe.
After entering the room, Connor looked at Freya, who was lying on the bed. He had been hesitating whether he should tell her about the things he'd learned when she woke up.
After hesitating for a few minutes, Connor decided to tell her about this and let her make a decision herself.
Just like that, three days passed quickly. However, Freya still did not show any signs of waking up.
Connor began to become nervous. What would he do if Freya really could not wake up?
Freya's eyes were tightly shut, but she would occasionally speak in her sleep. The name that was mentioned the most in her sleep was Connor.
Connor held Freya's hand tightly, praying silently in his heart.
"Connor?"
At this moment, Freya suddenly opened her eyes and called out softly.
Connor saw that Freya's expression was a little excited after she opened her eyes and hurriedly shouted, "Freya, you're awake?"
"Yes, my head hurts. Did I sleep for a long time?"
Freya tried her best to sit up straight, but she had been unconscious for too long and could not sit up at all.
Connor hurriedly helped her up and asked her with great concern, "Freya, how are you feeling now?"
"I feel like my head hurts. It's like I was in a dream. I've already remembered everything from before…" Freya recalled as she said softly.
"Do you remember who you are now?"
Connor asked excitedly.
"Of course I remember. My father is Sean Phillips, and my mother is Laura Crawford…" Freya said softly before turning to Connor. "I still remember that you're a big liar. Back then, it was because you lied to me that I came to the U.S.…"
"Uh..."
When Connor heard Freya's words, his expression turned awkward.
"..."
Freya blinked before saying softly, "You clearly knew that I was so angry back then, but you still dared to let me recover my memories. Aren't you afraid that I'll leave you?"
"Of course I'm afraid!" Connor replied in a low voice and then continued, "But I feel that these memories belong to you. No one can take them away. Besides, I don't want to see you being used by others…"
"..."
Freya didn't say anything.
Connor hesitated for a moment before asking Freya softly, "Then are you still angry with me?"
"Actually, I've never been angry with you. I left because I couldn't accept the fact that the inheritance was more important than me in your heart. I also couldn't accept the fact that the person I loved lied to me!"
Freya paused for a moment before continuing, "But I've forgiven you now because I know that you didn't lie to me on purpose. Also, when I lost my memory, what you did to me touched me. I know now that you're the one who really treats me well in this world. Even my parents would choose to give up on me for benefits…"
When Connor heard Freya's words, his expression became a little excited.
He had been very worried that Freya would not be able to forgive him. But now that she had actually forgiven him, Connor was naturally happy.
Freya frowned and said, "But Connor, there is still one thing that I do not understand…"
"What is it?" Connor asked.
"Since I'm not Camila's daughter, then what's with the paternity test? I remember that you chose that hospital. There shouldn't be any problems, right?"
Freya asked in confusion.
"Freya…"
Connor hesitated for a moment, then whispered, "I promised you that I wouldn't lie to you anymore. Although there are some things that you might not be able to accept now, I think I should tell you that you're actually Camila's daughter!"
"What do you mean?"
Freya asked with a puzzled expression as she widened her eyes.
"Camila is your mother and Sean Phillips is your father. You are not related to Laura Crawford by blood. Camila left you two to protect you and Sean Phillips!" Connor said in a low voice.
Freya looked at Connor with an expression of disbelief, shock in her eyes.
Although Freya had regained her memories, there were still some things that she did not know.
Connor did not plan to hide anything from Freya, so he told her everything he knew.
After more than an hour, Freya fell into a deep state of shock.
How could she have known of Camila? How could she have known her mother? How could she have known her family background? How could she have known everything was so complicated?
"No, I'm going to see Camila right now. I want to know everything!"
Freya shouted excitedly and struggled to stand up.
"Freya, calm down now…"
Connor whispered.
"Connor, how can I calm down now? I have to find Camila. I have to ask her why she used me. Also, since she is my mother, I have to make things clear to her. I, Freya Phillips, am not anyone's pawn, and the person I like is you," Freya shouted at Connor in a very serious tone.
"..."
Connor hesitated for a moment before saying in a low voice, "Then I'll go with you!"
Connor knew that Freya would have a lot of questions for Camila.
If she couldn't see Camila, she wouldn't be able to accept these things.
Therefore, Connor asked Derrick to drive him and Freya to Charles Manor.

chapters.title: Chapter 1250: A Chess Piece
chapters.content:
Chapter 1250: A Chess Piece
Half an hour later.
Connor and Freya successfully returned to Charles Manor.
Perhaps it was because of Connor's intrusion into Charles Manor. Although Camila did not call the police, she had expanded the size of her bodyguards. At this time, Charles Manor was already in a state of high alert.
Freya took a deep breath and walked into the manor.
At this moment, the bodyguards in the manor all knew Connor. They also knew how terrifying his skills were, so they did not dare to stop Connor and Freya. They could only watch as Freya and Connor entered the villa.
Camila was naturally very excited when she found out that Freya had returned. She ran to the living room of the villa in her pajamas and shouted happily, "Freya, have you thought things through? You're going to come back, right?"
"I have something to tell you!"
Freya said coldly to Camila.
When Camila saw Freya, whose expression seemed a little off, she frowned and asked, "Freya, what do you want to tell me?"
"Let's go to my room!"
Freya replied indifferently before turning to Connor and saying, "Connor, wait for me here!"
"Okay!"
Connor nodded gently and sat on the sofa.
Freya didn't say anything to Camila and walked straight to her room.
Camila hesitated for a moment before following Freya upstairs.
A moment later, Freya returned to her room and sat quietly on the sofa.
"Freya, what's wrong? Did Connor say something to you? Let me tell you this, Connor is a liar. No matter what he says, don't believe him, you understand me?"
Camila knew that something was off with Freya, so she quickly spoke to Freya.
"If I can't even trust Connor, then who else can I trust?"
Freya replied indifferently.
In actual fact, Freya was very sad. After all, she had just realized that she could not even trust her parents. The only person she could trust that could give her a sense of security was Connor.
"Freya, what do you mean by that?"
Camila was stunned for a moment and asked Freya with a puzzled expression.
"There's no point acting innocent anymore. My memories have returned, and I know what's going on!"
Freya said to Camila expressionlessly.
"Your memories have returned?"
A trace of shock flashed across Camila's eyes.
"My name is Freya Phillips. My father is Sean Phillips, and my mother is Laura Crawford. I was born in Porthampton and have lived there since I was young. Later, because of the conflict between Connor and me, I chose to come to the U.S. to study. However, under your arrangement, I got into a car accident. Then, you operated on me and forcefully removed my memories!"
Freya looked at Camila and continued.
Camila stared at Freya with an incredulous expression on her face. She couldn't understand how Freya had regained her memory. After all, the doctor said that once she underwent surgery, her memories would never be restored.
"No, that's impossible. You must be lying to me. You couldn't have recovered your memories. You're lying to me, right?"
Camila shouted at Freya.
"I have indeed recovered my memories. Whether you believe it or not has nothing to do with me. I already know everything. You were just using me from the beginning!"
Freya said calmly to Camila.
"Freya, I'm not lying to you. I'm really your mother. If you don't believe me, we can go for a maternity test now…"
Camila exclaimed.
After hearing Camila's words, Freya smiled helplessly and shook her head gently. "I don't think there's a need for the two of us to do a maternity test now. It doesn't matter if you're really my biological mother. You only want what's good for you. I'm merely a chess piece to you. You've only been using me from the beginning to the end. What right does a person like you have to be a mother?"
"Freya, it's not what you think…"
Camila shouted and continued, "Freya, I know that I was wrong to leave you back then, but I was only protecting you. If I hadn't left you back then, you and your father would have been in danger."
"What's the point of explaining these things to me now?"
Freya said coldly.
"I know you might not believe me now, but everything I'm telling you is true. I had no choice but to leave you!"
Camila shouted firmly and continued, "Do you think it was an easy decision to make? If I could have always been by your side, I would have stayed by your side the whole time. But at that time, the Yearwood Family did not agree to me being with your father. If they knew that I had a child with your father, they would have definitely done everything they could to get rid of you!"
Freya looked at Camila and took a deep breath. Then, she said expressionlessly, "Alright, I can believe that you had no choice but to leave me back then, but why are you in my life now? Also, why did you forcefully remove my memories? Are you telling me what you did was also for my own good?"
"Freya, you are my only child. I want to give you all the best things in the world. I have already paved the way for you. As long as you follow my plan, sooner or later, you will inherit the entire Yearwood Family's assets. You will then be an existence that countless people look up to."
Camila hurriedly said.
"These are things that you want, not what I want. You're really selfish. I feel ashamed to have a mother like you!"
Freya's words were like a sharp knife that pierced through Camila's heart.
Camila looked at Freya. She knew that all her plans had failed.
She thought that her plan was perfect, but she never thought that Connor's appearance would ruin everything.

chapters.title: Chapter 1251: An Even More Powerful Backer
chapters.content:
Chapter 1251: An Even More Powerful Backer
Now that Freya had regained her memories, she would definitely not be at Camila's mercy.
"In order to satisfy your own desires, you did not hesitate to sacrifice my happiness and even deprived me of my memories. I really can't believe that you're my mother. I'll never forgive you. I came to see you this time just to tell you that there's nothing between the two of us. I don't want you to continue being in my life!"
Although Camila had explained everything, Freya still could not forgive her.
After saying that, Freya stood up and was about to leave.
"Freya, you can't leave yet. You can't leave…"
Camila hurriedly reached out to stop Freya.
"Are you still planning to use me?"
Freya asked Camila expressionlessly.
"Freya, I know that you can't forgive me now. I admit that what I've done is way out of line, but you really can't leave now. If you leave, I'll be dead for sure…"
Camila shouted.
"What does your life and death have to do with me?"
Freya asked coldly.
"Freya, I know I'm not qualified to be a mother, but no matter what, I'm still your mother. I gave you your life. Can you really bear to see me die because of you?"
Camila pulled Freya and shouted excitedly.
"Die because of me?"
When Freya heard Camila's words, she couldn't help but be stunned for a moment. Then, she frowned and said, "Why would you die because of me?"
"Freya, can you sit down and let me finish?"
Camila exclaimed.
Freya hesitated for a moment before saying softly, "Just tell me. I'm not in the mood to waste time with you!"
"This is what happened. In order to let you inherit the Yearwood Family's property, I went to look for the Yearwood Family's head and asked him to arrange a marriage for you. The other party is the Washington Family. It is an ancient martial arts family in Oprana. The Washington family's strength is very terrifying. If you leave now, it will be equivalent to us breaking the contract. This will not only bring shame to the Yearwood Family, but it will also mean that I am done for. Both the Yearwood and the Washington Families will not let me go."
Camila shouted.
"How can I help you with this?"
Freya frowned and asked Camila.
"You just have to marry into the Washington Family. As long as you marry into the Washington Family, everything will be fine!"
Camila hurriedly said.
"Marry someone from the Washington Family?"
When Freya heard this, she couldn't help but be stunned for a moment before hurriedly saying, "I can't help you with this. I'm already engaged to Connor. The person I like is Connor."
"Are you really going to watch me get killed? I'm your mother. I gave you your life!"
Camila shouted.
Freya was stunned when she heard Camila's words.
Although Freya hated Camila, she was still her birth mother.
Freya couldn't just watch Camila die!
Camila was taking advantage of Freya's kindness.
Seeing that Freya was silent, Camila quickly said, "Freya, you need to think things through. Do you really think that you will be happy with Connor? The Yearwood Family won't let me go so easily, and they won't let you two go as well. Even your father might die in their hands. Are you really fine with everyone dying because of you? Even Connor will be hunted down by the Yearwood Family!"
Freya was stunned again after hearing Camila's words. She was a little conflicted.
"I will never marry into the Washington Family. Is there no other way other than marrying into the Washington Family?"
Freya was already hesitating. She frowned and asked Camila.
Camila took a deep breath and whispered, "There is one way. Unless you can find a more powerful backer that makes the Yearwood and Washington Families fear you, otherwise you can only choose to marry someone from the Washington Family!"
"An even more powerful backer?"
When Freya heard this, she was filled with despair. She did not know who she could ask for help.
"Freya, can you do this for me? Now, the lives of the Yearwood Family are in your hands!"
Camila looked at Freya and continued.
"..."
Freya was stunned. At this moment, she did not know what to do.
She knew what Camila meant. If she continued to be with Connor, then not only Camila, but Connor would also be in danger. She didn't want to see Connor in danger because of her.
"Since you know that doing this will bring you danger, why did you still do it?"
Freya shouted at Camila as if she was about to collapse.
"I didn't expect you to regain your memories either. I was just paving the way for your future!"
Camila said helplessly.
"Then, shouldn't you have discussed it with me before you did all these things? I've really never seen a mother as selfish as you!"
Freya shouted.
"Freya, you can scold me however you want now, but you cannot be with Connor…"
Camila looked at Freya and said.
"What right do you have to stop Freya from being with me?"
However, at this moment, a voice suddenly sounded.
Camila was stunned for a moment, then she turned to look at the door.
When Camila saw Connor, her eyes flashed with anger.
If not for Connor's appearance, things would definitely not have turned out like this.
"I'm talking to my daughter. Why are you interrupting?"
Camila turned and scolded coldly.
"Freya is my fiancée. I will not allow my fiancée to marry someone else!"
Connor replied indifferently. He then walked to Freya's side and said softly, "Freya, you don't need to worry. I will help you settle this matter…"
"You will help her?"
When Camila heard Connor's words, she couldn't help but sneer. Then, she said lightly, "You must be dreaming. Do you know how terrifying the Yearwood and Washington Families are? Don't think that you're all that just because you have that little bit of money. If these things can really be solved with money, I wouldn't have had to do this…"

chapters.title: Chapter 1252: Walking into the Trap
chapters.content:
Chapter 1252: Walking into the Trap
"That's right, Connor, the Yearwood Family is indeed terrifying!"
Freya said worriedly.
After all, Freya had been with Camila for more than half a year, so she had some understanding of the Yearwood Family's power.
"It doesn't matter!"
Connor replied indifferently and then continued, "Bring me to the Yearwood Family. I will personally talk to the Yearwood Family's patriarch and ask him to call off the engagement between Freya and the Washington Family!"
"Who do you think you are? If you ask the Yearwood Family patriarch to call it off, will he actually do it? If you go over now, you'll just be seeking death!"
Camila hurriedly said to Connor.
"Whether or not I'll be seeking death is my business. You just have to do as I say!"
Connor said to Camila expressionlessly.
Camila looked at Connor and hesitated. She knew that if Connor really followed her to the Yearwood Family, he would definitely die.
However, if Connor died, it would be a good thing for Camila.
After all, as long as Connor died, Freya would be able to marry into the Washington Family. This was killing two birds with one stone for Camila.
Since Freya would marry into the Washington Family and Camila could get rid of Connor, who was a huge threat to them, why not?
So, Camila looked at Connor from head to toe and said coldly, "You really want to go to the Yearwood Family with me?"
"Of course!"
Connor nodded.
"Connor, the Yearwood Family is an ancient martial arts aristocratic family. They have many ancient martial arts experts. If you go there, it will be very, very dangerous…"
Freya hurriedly said to Connor.
Connor looked at Freya indifferently and said softly, "For you, I will go there no matter how dangerous it is…"
Connor knew that the only way now was to make the Yearwood Family call off this engagement.
This way, the Yearwood Family wouldn't try to get back at Freya, and the Washington Family would also think that this was the Yearwood Family's choice, so they wouldn't try to get back at Freya. This was the best solution at the moment.
Camila looked at Connor and naturally had her own plans.
She thought for a moment and then said softly, "If you want the Yearwood Family to call off this engagement, it is definitely impossible. However, if you have certain capabilities that will allow the Yearwood Family to look at you in a different light, maybe they will change their mind. I know that you have some background, so how about this? In a few days, it will be the Yearwood Family patriarch's birthday celebration. At that time, I will bring you and Freya there."
Camila was obviously pretending to be a good person. Why would she help Connor put in a good word?
Now, she couldn't wait for the Yearwood Family to kill Connor.
"You can do whatever you want. Anyway, I will make the Yearwood Family call off this engagement!"
Connor replied to Camila.
"If that's the case, that would naturally be the best!"
Camila couldn't help but sneer in her heart.
"When will the birthday banquet be?"
Connor asked.
"In seven days, in Santon, Oprana!"
Camila hurriedly replied.
"Alright. When the time comes, I will bring Freya along…"
Connor said to Camila expressionlessly.
"Aren't you going to go with me?"
Camila was stunned for a moment and asked in a puzzled tone.
"I still have something to do before I go to see the Yearwood Family!"
Connor replied to Camila before turning to Freya and saying, "Freya, let's go!"
Freya was stunned for a moment and quickly said to Camila, "Can you return my phone and passport to me now?"
"Of course…"
Camila already had a plan on how to deal with Connor, so there was no point in keeping Freya's phone and passport. She turned around and walked to the cabinet to take out Freya's phone and passport, then returned them to her.
After Freya received these items, she immediately followed Connor out of the villa.
Camila looked at Connor's back with a murderous look in her eyes.
At this time, Camila felt that it was a good thing that Connor did not go to the Yearwood Family with her. At least she could go ahead and arrange everything. At that time, Connor would be under her control, and her plan could proceed as per normal.
"Connor, this is you walking into a trap. Just you wait!"
Camila couldn't help but sneer. Then, she took out her phone and started to make a call.
After Freya left Charles Manor with Connor, she asked him worriedly, "Connor, are you really going to see the Yearwood Family?"
"Of course, if I don't resolve this, I won't be at ease."
Connor said to Freya with a smile.
"But I'm really worried about you. I heard that the Yearwood Family is an ancient martial arts aristocratic family. They're all very powerful. What if they don't agree to let you be with me?"
Freya said with a frown.
"So what if it's an ancient martial arts aristocratic family?"
Connor smiled faintly and continued, "Don't forget, I'm the richest man in the world…"
"So what if you're the richest man in the world?"
Freya replied helplessly before continuing, "The world of martial artists doesn't care if you're the richest or not. In their eyes, strength is the most important thing…"
"I'm also a martial artist!"
Connor looked at Freya and said.
"You're also a martial artist?"
Freya's eyes flashed with shock when she heard Connor's words.
"That's right, I'm also a martial artist, so you don't have to worry about anything!"
Connor smiled.
"Then, where do you plan to go next?"
Freya looked at Connor and asked.
"This is my first time in New York. The two of us haven't been alone for so long. I plan to have some fun in New York for a few days…"
Connor said with a smile.
"How do you still have the mood to have fun?"
Freya was speechless when she heard Connor's words.
"I don't have to go to Santon just yet anyway. I can't do anything else now, so I might as well relax…"
Connor said lightly.
Although Freya was very worried about Connor, she knew that there was nothing they could do now, so she agreed to Connor's suggestion.
Freya had lived in New York for some time and was very familiar with how things worked around here.
Freya brought Connor around New York. This was also the first time Connor and Freya was traveling together.

chapters.title: Chapter 1253: I Will Avenge You!
chapters.content:
Chapter 1253: I Will Avenge You!
These past few days have been very happy for Connor and Freya.
After experiencing so many hardships, they could finally relax a bit.
However, Freya was still worried about the Yearwood family, so her expression showed some concern, while Connor seemed indifferent.
The Yearwood family was nothing in Connor's eyes.
First, she took him to Las Vegas, then they went to Washington, and finally they visited the Statue of Liberty.
These were all things that he had always wanted to do, but back then, he was just a poor guy, and at most, it was just wishful thinking that could never be realized.
But now, with his vast wealth of trillions, achieving these things was quite easy.
After traveling around the U.S., Connor and Freya directly flew back to Porthampton.
Now that she had regained her memories, she certainly had many friends who wanted to see her.
So, after returning to Porthampton, she separated from him.
Connor didn't stay long and went straight to Jorge's house.
Although he always appeared nonchalant, he knew that the Yearwood family and the Wang family were not to be taken lightly, so he had to be well-prepared.
When he arrived at Jorge's house, he saw Jorge writing, so he walked over.
"You can also write calligraphy?"
Connor asked Jorge with a smile.
Jorge turned his head and glanced at Connor, then asked softly, "How does my writing look?"
"It's alright. I don't understand calligraphy..."
He was clueless about calligraphy, so he replied directly.
"Hehe..."
Jorge gave a faint smile, then put away the brush on the table and asked Connor, "So, what brings you here this time?"
"How did you know I had something to discuss with you?" Connor asked with a puzzled expression.
"If you had nothing to discuss, why would you come to me?"
Jorge squinted his eyes and said lightly.
"Well, that's true!"
Connor nodded and continued, "I do have something this time, so I won't waste your time. Do you have any more Chi Receiving Pill? I need a few... "
"Chi Receiving Pill have significant side effects. You shouldn't take them unless it's absolutely necessary. You still have three pills left, which should be enough," Jorge said calmly.
"This time might not be enough. I'm up against a formidable opponent!" Connor said helplessly.
"Who is it?"
Jorge looked at Connor and asked.
"Do you know the Yearwood family in Santon?"
Connor asked softly.
"The Yearwood family?"
Jorge couldn't help but smile when he heard that, then said calmly, "The Yearwood family is quite a well-known ancient martial arts family in Oprana. Do you have a conflict with them?"
"It can't really be called a conflict..."
After hesitating for a moment, Connor explained Freya's situation to Jorge.
After hearing his words, Jorge calmly said, "The Yearwood family and the Washington family are indeed not easy to deal with. However, if you're going to meet the people from these two families, you don't need Chi Receiving Pill..."
"Why is that?"
Connor asked, puzzled.
"Do you remember the jade pendant I gave you last time?"
Jorge asked softly.
"I remember!"
Connor quickly took out the jade pendant and continued, "I've been carrying this jade pendant with me, but I've never used it or knew its purpose..."
"When you meet the people from the Yearwood family or the Wang family, show them this jade pendant, and they will recognize your identity. They shouldn't dare to continue troubling you."
Jorge said expressionlessly.
Upon hearing this, Connor's expression became somewhat puzzled, and he furrowed his brows as he asked, "Old man, are you joking with me? Is this jade pendant really that powerful?"
"We've known each other for so long. Have I ever lied to you?"
Jorge replied calmly, then continued, "This jade pendant is my personal belonging. Seeing it is like seeing me in person. The Yearwood family and the Wang family should give me some face. My disciple married into their Yearwood family, so it's also an honor for them..."
"You really know how to brag, huh? What if they completely ignore you? Then I'm as good as dead."
Connor said with a furrowed brow.
"If they ignore me, there's nothing I can do. But if they dare to harm my disciple, I will definitely help you seek revenge..."
Jorge said calmly to Connor.
Upon hearing Jorge's words, Connor was dumbfounded, and his expression showed disbelief as he said, "Can you please stop joking with my life? Even if you help me seek revenge, what good would it do if I'm already dead? Just give me some more Nascent Qi Pills; those are more practical..."
"Three Nascent Qi Pills are already your limit. If you continue to take them, your body won't be able to bear it, and it's very likely that your meridians will rupture and you'll die!"
Jorge said softly to Connor.
Upon hearing his words, Connor couldn't help but furrow his brows and then smiled as he said, "That's true. Then, do you have any other treasures?"
"I don't..."
Jorge shook his head directly and continued, "Your recent progress in ancient martial arts cultivation isn't significant. Have you not practiced for a long time?"
"I don't have time to practice now. There's so much going on every day!"
Connor replied helplessly.
"No matter when, ancient martial arts are your lifeline. So, no matter what happens, you can't neglect the cultivation of ancient martial arts. Money is just an external thing, but what you gain from practicing ancient martial arts is entirely yours!"
Jorge said seriously to Connor.
"I understand. Once I handle these matters, I will diligently practice!"
Connor replied awkwardly, then looked at Jorge and asked, "Do you lack anything recently? Do you want me to do something for you?"
"I lack money!"
Jorge said lightly.
"In that case, I'll take my leave..."
Connor waved his hand to Jorge, then walked straight toward the courtyard.

chapters.title: Chapter 1254: Betrayal
chapters.content:
Chapter 1254: Betrayal
After returning to Porthampton, Freya met with her old friends.
After all, she had been missing for a long time, and they were all concerned about her whereabouts.
After meeting with her friends, she hesitated for a long time, but in the end, she decided to bring Connor back to her family and meet with her relatives.
Although many things had happened during this time, she chose to forgive her family in the end.
Because she knew deep down that her family members were just puppets in the hands of Camila.
In Porthampton, the Phillips family could still be considered a big family, but in Camila's eyes, they were nothing worth mentioning.
When faced with Camila's threat, the Phillips family had no ability to resist.
Two days later.
Connor and Freya drove directly towards Santon.
Santon is located in Swindmore, not far from Davenport.
So, instead of taking a plane, they decided to drive there directly.
In the eyes of ordinary people, Santon was just a third-tier small city, not economically developed, and its geographical location wasn't great.
However, in the eyes of martial artists, Santon was quite famous because it had many ancient martial arts families. These big families usually kept a low profile, but upon closer investigation, one would discover that although they were just ordinary small families in Santon, the power behind them was astonishing.
These ancient martial arts families in Santon also controlled many companies, but outsiders were completely unaware of this.
After knowing that Connor was planning to go to Santon, Thomas prepared a Mercedes-Benz sports car for him.
The car was very comfortable and suitable for long trips.
Connor drove quietly, while Freya sat in the passenger seat.
The Mercedes-Benz was a convertible, and with the good weather today and the gentle breeze, the mood was particularly pleasant.
At this moment, she seemed to have forgotten about the matters concerning the Yearwood family. She hummed songs and looked at the scenery outside.
Connor subconsciously turned his head and glanced at Freya, then gave a faint smile.
"Why are you smiling at me like a fool?"
Freya turned her head and glared at Connor, asking softly.
"I feel like I'm dreaming right now. When you left Porthampton, I even thought I might never see you again in this lifetime..." he explained softly.
"Hmph, who told you to deceive me back then..."
Freya pouted and retorted.
"At the beginning, I didn't know you, and I wasn't familiar with you. Besides, the condition for inheriting the inheritance was that I couldn't let you know my identity, so I had no choice but to hide it from you..."
Connor explained helplessly.
Upon hearing Connor's words, Freya hesitated for a moment, then asked softly, "So, when did you start liking me?"
"When did I start liking you?"
Connor was momentarily stunned after hearing Freya's question, then smiled and said, "I don't know when I started liking you, but back then, when I was facing the Lee family, you knew that I lied to you, yet you still helped me. From that moment, I knew you were my wife. In my life, I will marry no one but you..."
"Who said I would marry you?"
She blushed and said with a shy face.
"Didn't you say that you wouldn't marry anyone else but me?"
He chuckled.
"I never said that!"
She immediately retorted without hesitation.
"But back then in America, I personally heard you say that to Camila..." he said with a smile.
"You heard it wrong. I never said that, and even if I did, it was just to deceive Camila. I haven't decided whether or not to marry you yet..."
She pouted and said.
"If you don't want to marry me, then why should I go to the Yearwood family? Let's just go back!" he said after thinking for a moment.
Upon hearing this, she hesitated for a moment, then said softly, "By the way, Connor, I heard from Lulu that during the time I was in the U.S., you got to know many beautiful girls. Did you do anything to betray me?"
Connor was stunned after hearing Freya's words, and his expression became somewhat nervous because he didn't expect her to bring up this matter.
"How could I possibly do anything to betray you..."
Although he didn't want to lie to Freya, he felt that there were some things he couldn't tell her. He knew her personality very well, and if she found out about his involvement with Yelena and Chloe, all his previous efforts would probably be in vain.
"You seem guilty..."
She looked at him and said.
"I'm not guilty. I never did anything to betray you!"
Hedirectly refuted without hesitation.
Upon hearing his words, she blinked her eyes, then said softly, "Actually, Connor, even if you did something to betray me, I wouldn't mind. After all, I left you for such a long time, and you're so wealthy. Even if you couldn't resist the temptations of those women, it's understandable..."
"Really?"
He felt excited upon hearing this and asked Freya.
"Okay, Connor! You said you didn't do anything to betray me, but why don't you tell me about the several women you found behind my back?"
Freya shouted loudly, her eyes watery.
He looked at her sitting next to him and was instantly speechless.
Now he realized that it was all a trap set by her.
"I really haven't done anything to betray you. If I truly liked another girl, why would I go through so much trouble to be with you?" he said helplessly.
"Freya, you are the only woman in my heart. You are the only person I truly want to marry..."
Connor continued speaking when he noticed that Freya remained silent.
"Connor..."
However, at that moment, Freya sat there motionless, her expression seemingly tense.
"Freya, you're not really angry, are you?"
Feeling that something was off with her, he hurriedly asked.

chapters.title: Chapter 1255: A Little Familiar
chapters.content:
Chapter 1255: A Little Familiar
"Freya, I swear to God, I really haven't done anything to betray you..."
Connor saw the unpleasant expression on Freya's face and explained nervously.
"Connor..."
Freya's voice trembled as she called out.
"Freya, what's wrong with you?"
He noticed that her expression was off and quickly asked.
"There's a bug on me..."
Her voice trembled as she spoke.
"A bug?"
He paused for a moment upon hearing that, then quickly looked down and saw a bug perched on her fair chest.
"Connor, please remove this bug quickly. I'm scared..."
She was terrified of bugs, and she was trembling, unable to move.
The car was driving fast earlier, and it was an open-top car, so it was normal for a bug to fly in.
"It's just a bug. Do you have to be so scared?" he replied with a smile and reached out to remove the bug.
However, at that moment, the bug seemed to sense his presence and directly crawled into her clothes.
Freya let out a scream upon seeing the bug crawl inside, and Connor also froze in place.
"Connor, what are you waiting for? Quickly get rid of the bug. It went into my clothes..."
She anxiously shouted at him.
He looked helpless and didn't know what to do.
After all, the bug had already crawled into her clothes, and if he wanted to remove it, he would have to reach into her chest from the front.
This action was a bit too much, and he hesitated.
"In that case, should I stop the car?"
He suggested while looking at Freya.
"Stopping the car is too dangerous. You... just help me remove it. I won't blame you..."
She blushed and said with embarrassment.
Upon hearing her words, his gaze showed a trace of nervousness.
"After all, you're my fiancé. Even if you take advantage of me a little, it's fine. Hurry up..."
She could only console herself with such thoughts.
He took a deep breath and slowly reached his hand into her chest.
He could even feel her bra at this moment. The sensation made his heart race, and the car also seemed to lose control.
"Connor, hurry!"
As he felt the warmth of her right hand, her expression also showed signs of nervousness, and her delicate body trembled slightly.
He clenched his teeth, directly grabbed the bug, and then took his hand out of her clothes, throwing the bug out of the car.
When the bug was thrown out by Connor, she finally breathed a sigh of relief, and her expression visibly relaxed.
However, when she recalled what had just happened and still felt very tense.
"Hey, look at those two, they're really exciting, playing around on the highway..."
At that moment, a girl's voice suddenly rang out.
Because Connor was driving an open-top car, and the other car was higher, the scene from earlier was clearly seen by them. Combined with Freya's scream, the people in the other car were likely to misunderstand.
"Young people nowadays know how to have fun, not afraid of dying on the road..."
The onlookers started to discuss.
Upon hearing the comments from the onlookers, Freya's eyes flashed with anger.
However, Connor turned his head and glanced at the car next to him.
It was an Audi with a special license plate, and at this moment, all the people in the car were young.
Although this Audi couldn't be considered a luxury car, the special license plate indicated that these people were quite powerful. From this, it could be inferred that they were not ordinary individuals.
Upon hearing the ridicule from these people, Connor felt very angry, so he turned his head to refute them.
But she reached out to stop him and whispered, "Don't pay attention to them. They're just looking for attention. If you respond to them now, they'll be even more excited. If you ignore them, they'll calm down..."
He hesitated after hearing her words.
He felt that what she said made sense, so he didn't say much, just closed the convertible roof, stepped on the gas pedal, and drove forward.
After he drove away, the young people in the Audi didn't continue to chase after him.
"That girl from earlier, why does she look familiar?"
At that moment, a sexy girl in a short skirt inside the Audi frowned and said.
"That girl earlier looked pretty good. I feel like I've seen her before!"
The guy sitting in the passenger seat smiled and replied.
There were a total of five people in the Audi at this time, two guys and three girls.
The guy driving was very handsome, giving off an idol-like aura. It seemed like he had walked out of a movie. The watch on his wrist was worth millions, a Patek Philippe, and his demeanor was very noble. He should be a second-generation rich.
The guy in the passenger seat was very muscular, wearing a sleeveless T-shirt. His developed muscles were on full display. Even if he wasn't a martial artist, he was probably someone who liked to work out.
In the back seat, there were three girls.
Among them, the most outstanding was the girl in the short skirt. Although she was wearing large sunglasses and her face couldn't be seen clearly, just judging from her figure, she was definitely a super beauty. Her slender and fair legs, as well as her exquisite face, easily made people fantasize.
The other two girls were also very beautiful, wearing international luxury brands. Their backgrounds were probably not simple either.

chapters.title: Chapter 1256: Cuckold
chapters.content:
Chapter 1256: Cuckold
"Bailey, do you know that girl just now?"
At this moment, a girl took the initiative to ask the beauty in a short skirt.
"Yeah, why haven't I seen this girl before? Who is she?"
The woman in the short skirt hesitated for a moment before saying softly, "I don't think I know that girl, but she looks a little familiar. I think I've seen her somewhere before…"
"Bailey, now that you mention it, I seem to have some impression of her. Why do I feel like I've seen this woman's photo somewhere before?" the boy in the passenger seat said softly.
At this moment, the driver suddenly said, "I remember now. I've definitely seen this girl before. She's Aunt Camila's daughter…"
"Aunt Camila's daughter?"
After hearing this, the expression on the short-skirt beauty's face instantly changed.
"That's right. Some time ago, Travio Corporation held a shareholders' meeting. My mother didn't have time to go, so I went in her stead. I've seen this girl with my own eyes. She's Aunt Camila's daughter, Freya…" the handsome driver said firmly.
The other two girls in the car did not seem to know Camila very well. They hurriedly asked, "Bailey, what are you two talking about?"
"..."
The short-skirt beauty, Bailey Banks, took a deep breath and said in a low voice, "I also think that this girl is Aunt Camila's daughter because I met Mr. Washington some time ago. Mr. Washington told me that he was already engaged. I was curious about who was so lucky to be able to get engaged to him, so I asked him about it. Mr. Washington showed me a photo of his fiancée and said that she was Aunt Yearwood's daughter…"
"It's impossible for the two of us to make a mistake at the same time…" the handsome driver, Wilbur Landon, said in a low voice. "Then this matter might be a little troublesome…" the short-skirt beauty frowned and said with a strange look in her eyes. "I didn't expect Mr. Washington's fiancée to actually fool around with another man behind Mr. Washington's back. This is cuckholdery!"
"That's right. If we didn't run into each other by chance, no one would have found out about this, right?" the short-skirt beauty replied indifferently.
"Bailey, Wilbur, what are you two talking about? Why am I a little confused? Who was this girl?"
At this moment, the other two girls were completely dumbfounded.
"That's right, why does this matter have anything to do with Mr. Washington? What exactly is going on? I'm a little confused…" another girl hurriedly asked.
After Wilbur heard the two girls 'words, a hint of helplessness flashed across his eyes.
Although these two girls could also be said to be rich heirs, there were also many types of rich heirs. These two girls only had some money in their families, but they did not have any real power in their hands. If it was not because these two girls had a very good relationship with the short-skirt girl, Bailey, Wilbur would not have had any interactions with these two girls at all.
Perhaps this was the rule among the rich. Sometimes, even though you had money, you couldn't integrate into the upper-class circle. After all, other than wealth, you also had to have something that could be used by others.
These two girls were basically the type with big breasts but no brains. It was basically impossible for them to integrate into Wilbur's circle.
Although Wilbur looked down on these two girls, he also understood the truth of the world. He turned his head to look at the two girls and then explained calmly, "Will Washington. You two should know him, right?"
"Of course I know him. Who doesn't know Mr. Washington?"
The two girls hurriedly nodded.
After all, Will's family was very famous in Oprana, and Will was the future heir of the Washington family. Therefore, Will was very famous among the rich heirs in Oprana.
"Some time ago, I heard that Mr. Washington was engaged with a woman. However, Mr. Washington had never admitted it personally, so you don't know what's going on!"
Wilbur looked at the two girls and continued.
"Mr. Washington has already made an engagement? When did this happen?"
"Who's so lucky?" the two girls asked hurriedly.
"Mr. Washington is engaged to the Yearwood family of Santon. After all, the Yearwood family can be considered a very famous ancient martial arts family, so the Yearwood family and the Washington family are considered to be of equal status. This matter was personally finalized by Mr. Yearwood Sr. and Mr. Washington Sr. However, before the matter is 100% confirmed, you may not receive the news. We also learned about this from Mr. Washington..." Wilbur continued to explain.
"I'm familiar with the Yearwood family, but who is that?" One of the girls asked hurriedly.
"This person is Aunt Camila's daughter, Freya. She's the girl we saw just now…"
Wilbur said in a low voice.
When the two girls heard Wilbur's words, they were both stunned. Their expressions were extremely incredulous.
At this moment, the two of them finally understood what was going on!
"Wilbur, don't spout nonsense. If Mr. Washington's fiancée is that girl, doesn't that mean that Mr. Washington's fiancée cheated on him?"
One of the girls shouted excitedly at Wilbur.
"I'm not talking nonsense. This woman shouldn't be even considered as Mr. Washington's fiancée. It's just that the two families have this idea, but the matter hasn't been confirmed yet. It's good that we found out early, or else this matter would be even more troublesome!" Wilbur frowned and said in a low voice.
When the two girls in the car heard Wilbur's words, they were stunned on the spot. Their expressions were very incredulous.
If they didn't know what was going on, they would just treat Freya as an ordinary person and wouldn't think too much about it. But now that they knew what was going on, the two of them realized the seriousness of the problem!
Mr. Washington's fiancée had actually done that kind of thing with a stranger in the car. If this news were to spread, both the Yearwood family and the Washington family would be disgraced because of this matter.
At that time, the Yearwood family's dignity would be completely lost! After all, the Yearwood and Washington Families were the top families in Oprana, so the impact of such an incident was still very terrifying.
After hesitating for a moment, Bailey said expressionlessly, "Wilbur, don't make this matter too serious. After all, Mr. Washington hasn't really gotten engaged to Freya yet, so it's not too late to find out about this…"

chapters.title: Chapter 1257: Fooling Around with an Outsider
chapters.content:
Chapter 1257: Fooling Around with an Outsider
It was obvious that Bailey was reminding Wilbur not to blow this matter up.
If it blew up, it would not benefit anyone.
"Although we didn't have a marriage agreement before, Mr. Washington called me yesterday. He said that he's also coming to Santon to propose marrying into the Yearwood family during the birthday banquet of the Yearwood family's head…" Wilbur said expressionlessly.
"What?"
When Bailey heard Wilbur's words, she was stunned. The expression on her face was shocked.
"Since Mr. Washington already has the intention to propose marriage, it means that Mr. Washington still places great importance on this matter…" Wilbur whispered as he drove.
"..."
Bailey did not speak this time.
"If that time comes, everything might be too late…" Wilbur added. After all, he had a very good relationship with Mr. Washington, so his expression was very ugly.
After hearing Wilbur's words, Bailey's expression was a little helpless. She did not know what to do.
After all, they had witnessed this matter with their own eyes. If they did not tell Mr. Washington, they might feel bad. However, if he told Mr. Washington about this, it might cause some unnecessary trouble.
"She actually dared to mess around behind Mr. Washington's back. I must tell Mr. Washington about this…"
Wilbur said expressionlessly. Then, he took out his phone and continued, "I'll call Mr. Washington right now and tell him about this. The Yearwood family has gone too far this time. They clearly know that Freya is not a good person, yet they still want her to marry Mr. Washington. Are they not afraid of the Washington family's revenge?"
"Wilbur, calm down first…" Bailey said with a frown.
When Wilbur heard Bailey's words, he could not help but sneer. Then, he said expressionlessly, "Bailey, things have already come to this. How can I calm down?"
"I don't think it's what you think…"
Bailey said with a frown.
"..."
Wilbur looked at Bailey indifferently, then turned to look at the young man beside him and said in a low voice, "Brother Hons, you have a good relationship with Mr. Washington. Mr. Washington keeps calling you brother. You won't ignore this matter, right?"
Brother Hons looked at Wilbur and took a deep breath. Then, he said in a low voice, "Since this matter is related to Mr. Washington and I happened to see it, I will naturally not sit idly by…"
After Bailey heard the conversation between the two people, her expression began to change because this Brother Hons was not an ordinary person.
Brother Hons's original name was Ted Hons. His father held an important position in the southeast war zone of Oprana, and his grandfather had an amazing background.
Moreover, this Brother Hons also wanted to develop his career with his father. His future was limitless, and he might even be able to reach a very high position. Such a terrifying background had also created Brother Hons's fearless personality. He did not consider the consequences at all.
Therefore, if he were to interfere in this matter, it would definitely escalate!
Moreover, Wilbur's family background was also very terrifying. If these two people joined forces, even in the entire Oprana, there might not be many people who could compete with them!
Freya had the protection of the Yearwood family, so she naturally wouldn't have any trouble.
However, Freya's boyfriend would probably end up in a very miserable state. After all, he had offended someone he should not have offended.
After hesitating for a moment, Bailey could not help but say softly, "Brother Hons and Wilbur, I think the two of you should calm down. There might be some misunderstanding here. No matter what, the Yearwood family is one of the top families in Oprana. If this Freya is really not a good person, she definitely wouldn't be introduced to Mr. Washington. We should investigate this matter clearly before informing Mr. Washington. Otherwise, if there is any misunderstanding, it will be troublesome…"
"Bailey, don't speak up for Freya. Didn't you hear me just now? Freya was shouting in the car, and the boy had already reached his hand into her clothes. Who would believe that there was nothing going on between the two of them?" one of the girls said with a frown.
"That's right. I also think that the relationship between the two of them is not simple…" the other girl hurriedly followed up.
"I have to give Mr. Washington a call now. I want to let him know about this. As for what he plans to do next, it has nothing to do with me…" Wilbur said expressionlessly.
When Bailey saw Wilbur's firm attitude, she looked a little helpless. She didn't know what to do now.
One of the girls couldn't help but snort coldly, then said expressionlessly, "This Freya really doesn't know what's good for her. It's already a blessing that she's been able to marry Mr. Washington, but now, she actually dares to fool around with another man, and so brazenly, too. She doesn't think of Mr. Washington in her eyes at all…"
Bailey hesitated for a moment and wanted to say something, but frowned and remained silent. After all, this matter had nothing to do with her. If she said too much now, she would be implicated in this matter. It was better not to say anything.
Furthermore, Bailey did not know Freya at all. Whatever happened to Freya had nothing to do with her.
After Wilbur took a deep breath, he took out his phone and dialed Mr. Washington's number.
"Beep, beep, beep…"
The phone rang for two seconds before Mr. Washington picked up the call.
Wilbur directly told Mr. Washington everything that he had just seen.
After hearing Wilbur's words, Mr. Washington didn't say anything more. Instead, he hung up the phone silently.
"I didn't expect to encounter such a thing when I came to Santon this time. We'll have a good show to watch next…"
Wilbur said expressionlessly after putting down his phone.
Bailey turned to look at Wilbur, her eyes filled with helplessness. At this moment, she already had a bad feeling in her heart. She felt that something might happen next.
At this moment, Wilbur suddenly reminded the two girls behind the car, "Right, only a few of us know about this, so don't spread it. If it gets out, you'll have to bear the consequences!"
The two girls hurriedly nodded. After all, this matter concerned Mr. Washington's dignity. Even if they had the courage of a thousand lions, they would not dare tell anyone!

chapters.title: Chapter 1258: Your Fiancé?
chapters.content:
Chapter 1258: Your Fiancé?
On the other side.
Connor and Freya drove for a few hours and finally arrived at Santon.
After arriving, Freya took out her phone and dialed Camila's number.
"Freya, are you already in Santon?" Camila asked happily after picking up the call.
Freya didn't have a good impression of Camila and replied coldly. "Connor and I have already arrived. Where are we going now?"
"Freya, I have something to do right now. You and Connor can just come straight to the Yearwood family manor. Then, go to the guest room department. They will arrange a place for you to stay..."
Camila told Freya the location of the Yearwood family Manor and hung up.
After Connor knew the location, he drove straight to the Yearwood family manor.
Half an hour later, Connor and Freya arrived at the location.
The Yearwood family was very famous in Santon, so the old mansion of the Yearwood family was a very large classical manor. The size of this manor was much more terrifying than Camila's manor; it covered an area of nearly tens of thousands of square meters!
To be able to own such a large piece of land in Santon was already a very impressive thing.
The buildings in this manor were all built according to the style of the Ming Dynasty. When you entered this manor, it was as if you had directly traveled to the Ming Dynasty, giving people a very wonderful feeling.
Moreover, the design of this manor was also unique. It was all designed by world-renowned designers and architects. It was said that it was a one-to-one restoration of an ancient garden—even the most ordinary guest room was comparable to a five-star hotel.
In the entire world, there were not many places that could compare to such a manor.
Although the Yearwood family had always been very low-key, after seeing this manor, Connor could vaguely feel that Camila was not lying.
The Yearwood family was indeed very powerful!
"Let's go in together…" Freya whispered.
"Alright…"
Connor nodded lightly and then directly walked into the manor.
Although Freya's expression was still very calm, she was actually extremely nervous. After all, this was her first time coming to the Yearwood family manor, and she didn't know what would happen next. She held Connor's hand tightly with her small hand, venting her emotions.
Connor noticed that Freya seemed a little nervous. He turned his head and smiled at her, saying softly, "There's no need to be so nervous. I'm here…"
"Yes..." Freya hurriedly nodded.
A few minutes later, Connor and Freya finally found the housekeeping department, but even though Freya told them Camila's name, the housekeepers told her that there were no rooms available.
Because the birthday banquet of the Yearwood family's patriarch was about to be held, the descendants of the Yearwood family had all returned from all over the world. Moreover, the Yearwood family had invited many outsiders this time, so even such a big manor was already fully occupied.
Although Camila's position in the Yearwood family was much higher than before, Camila was still not the core figure of the Yearwood family, so she was not particularly valued. The rooms that had previously been agreed upon were already occupied by someone else.
After realizing that there were no empty rooms, Freya turned to Connor and said softly, "Connor, looks like the two of us can only stay in a hotel outside…"
"It doesn't matter. I don't want to live here anyway…" Connor replied with a smile.
Freya was not familiar with the Yearwood family's situation at all, so she had no way to find someone to arrange a room. She could only choose to bring Connor to live outside.
Freya took out her phone and was about to call Camila to tell her that they were going to stay outside.
However, just as Freya took out her phone, a woman walked up to her.
She sized Freya up and asked softly, "You must be Camila's daughter, right?"
When Freya heard this, she couldn't help but look up at the beautiful woman.
She had met this woman before. This woman was Camila's cousin, Canela Yearwood. Camila and Canela had never been on good terms.
Back when Freya first returned to the country, she had met this woman. At that time, she had ridiculed Freya in a strange manner.
Connor couldn't help but glance at this woman. She looked to be around 40 years old. Her figure was sexy and she clearly took good care of herself, giving people a charming feeling.
At this moment, there was a middle-aged man beside this woman. This middle-aged man was probably her husband.
Canela frowned and asked, "The two of us have never met before. You're called Freya, right?"
"I've seen you before…" Freya nodded lightly.
"What are you standing here for? Is there no room to stay? Do you need me to arrange a room for you?" Canela said sarcastically.
"There's no need…"
Freya wasn't very interested in the Yearwood family, and she didn't want to say anything more to Canela, so she turned to Connor and said, "Connor, let's go!"
"Right…"
Connor nodded lightly.
When Canela saw that Freya was about to leave, she was a little angry and hurriedly shouted, "Freya, why are you so rude? Don't you know that I'm your aunt?"
"I don't know you!"
Freya replied directly.
"You—" When Canela heard this, she was stunned. She didn't think that Freya wouldn't bother with her at all.
Freya held Connor's hand and prepared to leave.
When Canela saw Freya and Connor holding hands, the expression on her face became even stranger. She hurriedly asked, "Stop right there. What's your relationship with this kid?"
"..."
When Freya heard this, she couldn't help but be stunned for a moment. Then, she said to Canela proudly, "I forgot to introduce you just now. This person is my fiancé, Connor!"
"Your fiancé?"
Canela stared at Freya in disbelief.
Even the man beside Canela was shocked.
This was because the two of them had already known that Freya and Mr. Washington were engaged.
This was the first time Freya had come to the Yearwood family, and she'd actually brought a fiancé back—and that wasn't Mr. Washington! This news was too shocking!

chapters.title: Chapter 1259: Yearwood Family Manor
chapters.content:
Chapter 1259: Yearwood Family Manor
Canela knew how big the impact of this matter was, so she hurriedly said, "Freya, although I don't have a good relationship with your mother, no matter what, I'm still your aunt. Usually, it doesn't matter if we bicker. However, you must not joke about this kind of thing…"
Freya looked at Canela and smiled, then said lightly, "Of course I won't joke with you about this. Connor is indeed my fiancé…"
"Are you really not joking?"
Canela frowned.
"Not at all…"
Freya shook her head.
"Then do you know that you're already engaged? Did you know the patriarch has already arranged an engagement for you?" Canela hurriedly asked Freya.
"Of course I know. I came here to solve this matter. I am not a member of your Yearwood family. It is my freedom to marry whoever I want. I will not listen to anyone's arrangements…"
Freya said calmly to Canela.
When Canela heard Freya's words, she was stunned. She took a deep breath and said in a low voice, " Freya, aren't you being a little too impulsive? That's the Washington family we're talking about. Furthermore, this matter was decided by the patriarch himself! You're in big trouble by doing this, let me tell you…"
"..."
Freya glanced at Canela and said softly, "This is my own business. It has nothing to do with you. Anyway, I'm leaving first!"
After saying this, Freya pulled Connor along and walked into the distance.
"Freya, have you really thought it through?" Canela hurriedly shouted when she saw Freya leaving.
However, Freya acted as if she did not hear anything and continued walking forward.
Canela looked at Freya's back with a playful expression. She whispered, "I didn't expect Camila's daughter to be so bold. She obviously doesn't think highly of the Yearwood and Washington families. This is going to be a good show. I want to see how Camila will deal with this…"
"This is someone else's matter. It has nothing to do with us. It's best if you don't get involved…" Canela's husband couldn't help but remind her softly.
"Shut your mouth. I'm a Yearwood family member, how can I not care about this?"
Canela scolded coldly and continued, "If I hadn't married you, I wouldn't have been suppressed by Camila for so many years."
The man looked a little embarrassed after hearing this. After all, he was the live-in son-in-law of the Yearwood family. His status in the Yearwood family was very low, so even if Canela said this to him, he did not dare to refute her words.
Meanwhile, Connor and Freya swaggered out of the Yearwood family's manor.
At this moment, the two of them were still in a somewhat ambiguous position. Although it was Freya's first time in the Yearwood family, many people knew who she was; after all, Camila suddenly had a daughter out of nowhere, so it naturally attracted a lot of attention.
But when they saw how intimate Freya and Connor were, they were all stunned.
The news of Freya and Mr. Washington's engagement had already spread, but now Freya was actually hugging a boy in the Yearwood family. This was obviously not appropriate!
The descendants of the Yearwood family were worried that Freya's actions might bring trouble to the Yearwood family, so they immediately found the elders of the Yearwood family to inform them of this matter!
It could be said that Connor and Freya's appearance in the Yearwood family had caused a disaster on the scale of a moderate earthquake.
However, this was only the beginning.
Connor and Freya were not in the mood to deal with these people. After leaving the Yearwood family Manor, they booked two rooms in the best hotel in Santon. After resting for a while, they began to play around; after all, Santon was considered a tourist city, so there were still many places to visit.
The two of them did not care about the reaction of the Yearwood family. They drove to various scenic spots to take photos.
Freya had been a little worried about these things before, but as she played around, she forgot all about them. She couldn't understand why Connor always gave her an inexplicable sense of security, though it was very subtle.
…
In the Yearwood family's manor.
Because Mr Yearwood Sr's birthday banquet was about to start tomorrow, the manor was unusually lively at this time. Everyone in the Yearwood family was nervous and busy.
For this birthday banquet, the Yearwood family had specially hired more than a dozen Michelin star chefs to cook, and the place where the birthday banquet was held was the Yearwood family's manor.
However, there was a small courtyard in the innermost part of the Yearwood family manor. At this time, the quiet atmosphere in the courtyard was in stark contrast to the bustling outside.
In the courtyard, there was an antique hall, and at this moment, there were many people sitting in the lobby while drinking tea and chatting.
In the middle of the hall sat a white-haired old man.
He had a faint smile on his face as he drank tea and chatted quietly with the guests.
This person was the patriarch of the Yearwood family, Grayson Yearwood!
Although Grayson was almost eighty years old, his mental state was still very good. He didn't look like an old man in his eighties at all. He looked at most sixty years old.
However, it was such an old man who supported the Yearwood family today.
If it weren't for this old man, the Yearwood family wouldn't have had such achievements.
Sitting beside Grayson were the more famous younger generations of the Yearwood family. These younger generations were now distributed all over the world, and each of them had great achievements. Even Camila was inferior to these people.
Tomorrow was Grayson's 85th birthday. At this time, many guests had come to the Yearwood family's manor.
If the guest wasn't a VIP, the third generation of the Yearwood family would be in charge of receiving them. Those with a slightly higher status were also received by the second generation of the Yearwood family.
The people whom Grayson would personally receive were definitely famous figures in Oprana. Any one of these people could be considered a figure that could influence Oprana's development.
Therefore, there were not many guests who could enter this courtyard at this time. There were only three or four elders, and the rest were all members of the Yearwood family.

chapters.title: Chapter 1260: The Washington Family's Appearance
chapters.content:
Chapter 1260: The Washington Family's Appearance
"Mr. Washington Sr. has arrived!"
At that moment, a shout suddenly came from outside.
When Grayson heard this, he quickly stood up and walked out of the hall.
"Grayson, long time no see!"
An old man in a suit laughed and exclaimed when he saw Grayson.
"Andre, I didn't expect you to come here personally. This is really an honor for the Yearwood Family!"
Grayson hurriedly replied and then continued, "Andre, please come in…"
"Alright…"
The old man in the suit smiled and nodded, then followed Grayson into the hall.
After everyone had taken their seats, Grayson took the initiative to pour a cup of tea for the old man in the suit and then said with a smile, "Andre, it has been quite a few years since the two of us last sat together and drank tea…"
At this time, the old man sitting opposite Grayson was none other than the current head of the Washington Family, Andre Washington.
Behind Andre stood a young man. The young man was handsome and had an extraordinary aura. One look and one could tell that he was not an ordinary person. However, the young man seemed to be in a foul mood.
Because he was Andre's grandson, Will Washington.
Will had just received a call from Wilbur Landon. Naturally, he was not in a good mood.
When Andre heard Grayson's words, he couldn't help but smile faintly. Then, he said softly, "That's right. It has indeed been a long time since the two of us met. After all, I no longer participate in the trivial matters of our family. I have handed them all to the younger generation to take care of. It's not easy for me to have some peace and quiet, so I've been rather reluctant to go anywhere…"
"Andre, it really is such an honor that you are here!"
Grayson said with a smile.
"How can I miss your birthday banquet? I'm planning to take this opportunity to meet our old friends too…"
Andre laughed and replied.
At this time, in the lobby, as long as it was someone who could be ranked in the Yearwood Family, they were all here.
However, when these people saw Grayson chatting with Andre, they didn't even dare to say a word. They were very nervous.
After all, Andre had a high status, and the Washington Family's business was comparable to the Yearwood Family's.
Even Grayson was polite to Andre.
The Washington Family that Andre belonged to was one of the top ancient martial arts aristocratic families in the entire Oprana. Even the Yearwood Family could not compare to them.
Moreover, the Washington Family was not only very accomplished in ancient martial arts, but the descendants of the Washington Family were also very outstanding. Whether it was in the business world, politics, or even the military, they all had good achievements.
Therefore, the Washington Family's status would definitely skyrocket in the future. They might even become the number one family in Oprana.
Therefore, it was a blessing for the Yearwood Family have a closer relationship with the Washington Family through this arranged marriage.
This was also the reason why Grayson had arranged a marriage for Freya.
What Grayson was worried about now was that once he passed away, the Yearwood Family would have no leader, so he wanted to find a suitable person to replace him.
Among the many second generations of the Yearwood Family, there were many outstanding people.
However, because these people were too proud and arrogant, they were not convinced by each other. No matter who inherited the position, it would be difficult to convince the masses.
This was also the case for the third generation.
However, if Freya could marry Will, then Freya would have the backing of the Washington Family. In addition, Camila was indeed very capable. It would be very easy for Freya to intimidate these people.
This was the reason why Grayson had chosen Freya.
"Leona, go get Grandpa Washington a cup of tea…"
At this moment, Grayson whispered to the girl behind him.
When the girl heard this, she hurriedly ran to Andre and bowed respectfully. She said softly, "Hello Grandpa Washington…"
Andre glanced at the girl indifferently. Although the girl's looks could not be compared to Freya's, she had the aura of a lady from a wealthy family. She was like a beauty who had walked out of an ancient movie. Moreover, her every frown and smile carried a hint of elegance. One look and one could tell that she was from a wealthy family.
This girl was Grayson's granddaughter, Leona Yearwood.
Initially, Andre wanted Will and Leona to be together. However, Will fell in love with Freya after seeing her photo and insisted on marrying Freya. In the end, Andre had no choice but to agree.
After Leona poured the cup tea, she turned around and returned to Grayson's side.
"Leona is really getting more and more beautiful. It's a pity that this grandson of mine is not fated to be with her. Otherwise, I rather that he marries Leona…"
Andre could not help but sigh softly.
"..."
Not far away, Camila was obviously feeling a little awkward when she heard Andre's words. A trace of helplessness flashed across her eyes, but she did not dare to say anything.
After all, Andre was indeed qualified to say this.
Leona was indeed the most suitable for Will. After all, Leona was the eldest daughter of the Yearwood Family. Freya was inferior to Leona.
"Let the young ones decide on their own matters…"
Grayson said to Andre with a smile.
"That's right. As elders, we can't interfere in the matters of the younger generation. My grandson doesn't have such good fortune!"
Andre nodded and said to Will, "Will, greet Grandpa Yearwood!"
"Hello, Grandpa Yearwood!"
Will hurriedly stepped forward and called out softly.
"You're indeed good looking and have great potential!"
Grayson nodded with satisfaction.
Andre hesitated for a moment before saying with a smile, "Grayson, I brought my grandson here today. I wonder if I can let him meet the daughter of the Yearwood Family. After all, the two are about to get engaged, and we haven't even met once. It's time for the two of them to get to know each other…"
"Actually, I have the same intention!"
Grayson hurriedly replied to Andre, then turned to look at Camila, who was not far away.
When Camila heard this, a trace of embarrassment flashed across her eyes.
"Camila, where is Freya? Call Freya and ask her to come over…"
Grayson said softly.
"Alright…"
Camila nodded and quickly took out her phone to call Freya.
However, at this moment, Connor was taking Freya on a sightseeing tour in Santon.
Freya's phone was in the hotel. She didn't bring it with her.

chapters.title: Chapter 1261: Shocking News
chapters.content:
Chapter 1261: Shocking News
Camila made a few calls in a row, but no one picked up. Her face grew darker with each call.
Grayson too had a weird look on his face.
"I've called Freya several times, but no one picked up…"
Camila said helplessly.
"Then, hurry up and get someone to look for her…"
Grayson said expressionlessly.
"I…"
When Camila heard this, she was put in an even more awkward position.
Although she knew that Freya had already arrived in Santon, she had not seen her and did not know where she was.
The Washington Family wanted to meet Freya. She was naturally very nervous. Coupled with the matter with Connor, it made her even more nervous.
Camila frowned and said softly, "I'm really sorry. Freya didn't come with me. She should be on the way. She will definitely be able to come tomorrow. Why don't we wait until tomorrow…"
When Grayson heard Camila's words, he couldn't help but frown slightly, but he didn't say anything.
However, he was clearly displeased. After all, Freya was not present for such an important matter. What was going on?
In fact, Grayson had originally planned to introduce his granddaughter, Leona Yearwood, to Andre's grandson. However, Camila had always requested for Freya to marry Andre's grandson.
Grayson knew what Camila was thinking. In addition, Grayson also felt that this would make the Yearwood Family's situation more stable, so he ended up sending the photos of both Leona and Freya to the Washington Family.
When Will saw the photos of the two girls, he immediately took a fancy to Freya.
Grayson felt that all of this might be God's will, so he did not continue to interfere.
Andre wasn't very satisfied with Freya's background. After all, Leona was obviously more outstanding. In order to match Freya's identity with Andre's grandson, Will, Grayson specially told Andre that he would cultivate Freya as the future heir of the Yearwood Family.
And Andre had also taken a fancy to that idea, so he agreed to this marriage.
Otherwise, based on Freya's background, she would never have the right to marry Will.
In this family arranged marriage, Grayson and Andre both had their own self-serving thoughts, and both sides were after their own interests.
Grayson knew that Camila was the most suitable person for the position of the family head, but if Camila inherited this position, it would obviously be difficult to convince the public. Camila's background was rather weak, and her contribution to the Yearwood Family was very small.
However, if Freya, the daughter-in-law of the Washington Family, became the family head, and Camila controlled Freya from behind the scenes, everything would be perfect.
As for Andre, he had his eyes on the power of the Yearwood Family. After all, as long as these two families combined, Will could reach achieve even greater status in the future.
"Andre, I'm really sorry. That child Freya is a little playful. She hasn't arrived yet…"
Grayson said helplessly to Andre.
Andre waved his hand and smiled faintly. "It's fine. Since she's not here, we'll meet her tomorrow. There's no hurry!"
Camila heaved a sigh of relief when she saw that Andre wasn't angry.
"Oh right, Andre, I heard that you…"
However, just as everyone thought that this topic was about to end, a beautiful young woman walked in and said, "Camila, why are you lying? Isn't your daughter back already?"
