After hearing the beautiful young woman's words, everyone turned their heads to look at the entrance of the hall.
Canela Yearwood walked in in her high heels.
"Canela, what nonsense are you spouting? Who let you in?"
Grayson could not help but frown and berate the woman.
"I have something important to tell you, so I came in…"
Canela hurriedly said.
"What's so important? Is it more important than me entertaining our guests?"
Grayson was already a little angry that Freya was not here. Now, Canela's sudden interruption made him even angrier.
"Please don't be angry. Let me tell you what's going on..."
Canela said lightly.
"What is it? Hurry up and tell me…"
Grayson frowned and replied.
"Actually, I saw Freya in the guest room department, but Camila said that Freya isn't here. Camila must have something to hide, right?"
Canela said without hesitation.
When Grayson heard Canela's words, his face darkened. Then, he frowned and scolded, "Don't spout nonsense here…"
"With so many distinguished guests here, how would I dare to spout nonsense? I really saw her daughter just now…"
Canela hurriedly replied.
"Impossible. If Freya were here, why wouldn't I know?"
Camila frowned and shouted.
"You really don't know? Or are you pretending not to know?"
Canela smiled faintly.
"Canela, what are you trying to say?"
Grayson asked coldly.
"Freya has indeed returned. Camila lied because she knows that Freya has brought a man with her this time…"
Canela shouted loudly,
"A man?"
When everyone heard Canela's words, they looked at each other in confusion.
"Not only did I see Freya just now, but I also saw a man beside her. The two of them seemed very close with each other, so I went to ask Freya about their relationship. Freya told me that the boy was her fiancé. I didn't expect it to be..."
Canela said lightly.
"..."
For a moment, everyone was stunned.
Canela's words were like a time bomb that exploded in the crowd.
Everyone was extremely surprised.
Grayson and Andre were relatively calm. After all, they had lived for nearly a hundred years and had seen all kinds of storms.
Therefore, after hearing Canela's words, the two of them were relatively calm.
However, Will's face darkened because he had already received Wilbur's call. He heard that Freya was with a man.
In the beginning, Will was still skeptical about it.
However, after hearing Canela's words, he knew that what Wilbur said was true.
However, because Andre was in front of him, he did not say anything.

chapters.title: Chapter 1262: Revenge
chapters.content:
Chapter 1262: Revenge
"Canela, is what you said true?"
Grayson took a sip of tea and asked Canela calmly.
"Yes. Many people saw Freya hugging that guy. If you don't believe me, you can ask them…"
Canela was obviously just here to watch the show.
Canela had been unhappy with Camila for a long time, so she naturally wanted to take this opportunity to kick her when she was down.
Back then, Canela had embezzled a large sum of money from the Yearwood Family because of gambling. Later, she was afraid that Grayson would find out, so she wanted to find Camila for help.
After all, at that time, Camila had already established the Travio Corporation and was very rich.
However, she did not expect that not only did Camila not help, but she also told Grayson about it.
Because of Camila's snitch, Canela's status in the Yearwood Family plummeted. She was even isolated by the family for several years. It was only recently that things eased up for her.
Canela had always been angry about this. Today, she finally found an opportunity to take revenge on Camila.
After hearing Canela's words, everyone knew that what she said was true. Therefore, their faces darkened. They did not know what to say.
Of course, some people knew that the relationship between Canela and Camila wasn't very good. It wasn't impossible for Canela to take this opportunity to deliberately frame Freya.
However, if Canela was really lying, then she had really taken this too far. After all, Andre and the others were still here.
Just as Grayson was thinking about what Canela said, a young man in his twenties hurriedly ran in.
When Grayson saw the young man, he couldn't help but frown and ask, "Jules, what's going on?"
The young man who appeared was called Jules Yearwood.
Jules was Grayson's eldest grandson, and his status in the Yearwood Family was considered very high.
Jules took a deep breath and then hurriedly said, "Grandpa, I saw Freya hugging a guy at the door just now. I was worried that something was wrong, so I came over to tell you…"
It was worth mentioning that if Freya became the family head in the future, the one who would be the most affected would probably be Jules.
After all, before Freya appeared, Jules was the most likely candidate to inherit the position of the family head.
Therefore, he would definitely strike a blow at Freya at a time like this and try to break the engagement between Freya and Will.
Otherwise, Jules wouldn't have said such a thing in front of so many people.
When Grayson heard Jules's words, the expression on his face instantly changed.
After all, if it was only Canela who said it, it might not have been true. But if both of them said it, it meant that it was the truth.
For a moment, everyone's eyes were on Camila.
In fact, these people could not understand why Freya was so bold. She actually dared to bring a man back to the Yearwood Family and even hugged him in front of so many people. Did Freya not know that she already had a marriage agreement with Will?
Everyone looked at Camila, and some people gloated, secretly thinking that Camila was done for this time.
After all, over the years, Camila had offended many people in the family because she was the chairman of Travio Corporation.
Some people were worried. After all, there were still some people in the Yearwood Family who had a good relationship with Camila.
Of course, the most important thing at this time was Grayson's reaction.
After all, if Grayson was really angry, the consequences would be unimaginable.
Camila didn't know what to do for a moment. She had originally planned to explain these things to Grayson in private.
However, when she returned to the Yearwood Family, she found that Grayson was busy entertaining guests every day, and she couldn't see him at all.
If Andre hadn't come today, Grayson would never have allowed Camila to be present, and she wouldn't have been able to see Grayson.
Grayson took a deep breath and said to Camila expressionlessly, "Camila, what's going on?"
Camila was a little helpless, and then she said softly, "That person is indeed Freya's fiancé…"
After hearing Camila's words, everyone seemed to be even more shocked.
They could not understand what was going on.
"What exactly is going on? You have to explain it to me now!"
Grayson said angrily.
Camila had no choice but to tell him everything that happened between Freya and Connor.
After listening to Camila's explanation, everyone realized that Freya was already engaged to Connor before she lost her memory. However, because Freya lost her memory, no one brought up this engagement. That was why Camila had allowed Freya to be engaged to Will.
However, Connor had suddenly found Freya. Furthermore, Freya had suddenly recovered her memories, so she was now with Connor again!
"What nonsense. Since you clearly know that Freya is engaged, why did you still propose for an engagement with Will?"
At this moment, an old man stood up and slammed the table, shouting angrily.
When Camila heard the old man's words, a trace of nervousness flashed across her eyes.
This old man was Camila's father.
Camila took a deep breath and whispered, "I didn't know that Freya was engaged to someone else. If I had known, I wouldn't have dared to hide it. By the time I found out, it was already too late…"
Camila's father sighed helplessly and said to Grayson, "Grayson, it's all my fault for not investigating this matter properly. If you want to punish me, then punish me…"
"Just look at what you're doing! When did I say I was going to punish you? There are just too many misunderstandings about this matter…"
Grayson frowned slightly and replied with a helpless expression.
After all, there were still so many guests present. Grayson couldn't really do anything to Camila and her father.
Camila's father was only saying this to protect his daughter.

chapters.title: Chapter 1263: Is He A Martial Artist Too?
chapters.content:
Chapter 1263: Is He A Martial Artist Too?
Grayson took a deep breath and turned to Andre, saying, "I'm really sorry about today. I didn't know about this matter before, and I never expected it to turn into such a joke."
"Today has indeed been embarrassing. It's my family's fault. If you want to cancel the engagement, I have no objections..."
"What are you saying? I've listened for a while and understand what happened. Freya had a previous engagement before losing her memory, and then, due to her amnesia, she entered into an engagement with our Washington family, right?"
Andre said calmly.
"That's the case..."
Grayson nodded.
"After all, she lost her memory and didn't know that she was already engaged. This matter shouldn't be entirely blamed on you. I don't think it's as serious as you made it out to be, to the point of canceling the engagement..."
Andre said with a smile.
"The more you say that, the more guilty I feel..."
Grayson hurriedly said.
"There's no need to feel guilty. I think we've been hasty in handling this matter. After all, who could have known that Freya had an engagement before her memory loss? But I don't think it's a big deal. After all, when Freya made the engagement with the other person, her parents weren't present, so it doesn't count..."
Andre continued.
Upon hearing his words, Grayson couldn't help but furrow his brows and softly asked Andre, "What do you mean by that, Wang brother?"
"My meaning is simple. I think since the matter has already happened, we should deal with it first. I brought my grandson here today with the intention of proposing to your Yearwood family. But now it seems that we can postpone this matter. I think we should first ask for Freya's opinion. After all, if we propose without considering the child's opinion, it would be inappropriate..."
Andre said calmly.
"Yes, yes..."
Grayson nodded.
"Then you can arrange for my grandson and Freya to meet, let them have a good conversation. After all, the Freya back then may not have encountered suitable people and might have been deceived by some sweet words, so it's understandable. But when she meets more outstanding people, she will surely know who she truly likes..."
Andre continued.
At this point, his intentions were clear. He didn't even care about Freya's engagement to Connor. On the contrary, he actively arranged for Freya to interact with Will, indicating his confidence in Will. He believed that Will could snatch Freya away from Connor's hands.
After hearing Grayson's words, the expressions on everyone's faces eased considerably.
Fortunately, Andre didn't excessively pursue this matter. If he had, even the Yearwood family would have trouble handling it!
"Hahaha..."
Upon hearing his words, Grayson couldn't help but burst into laughter and continued, "You're truly a skilled statesman. If it were someone else, I'm afraid they would have already turned hostile on the spot..."
"I think you're making a lot of sense. After all, Freya has been living in Porthampton all this time, with very limited contact with people. If she has a chance to interact with Wang Young Master, I think she will understand who is more outstanding..."
People from the Yearwood family also began to actively support Camila's remarks.
Will's expression visibly relaxed upon hearing these words. After all, these people were praising him, so naturally, he was very happy.
He also believed that Connor was just an ordinary person and didn't have the qualifications to compete with him.
One was a handsome and wealthy man, while the other was a poor loser.
No matter which woman they were placed in front of, they would undoubtedly choose Will without hesitation, not Connor.
After hearing Grayson and Andre's words, Camila's eyes flickered with astonishment.
Originally, she thought that once Grayson learned about this matter, he would take the most extreme measures to separate Connor and Freya.
But she never expected Grayson and Andre to be so calm, not taking this matter to heart at all. This was completely unlike Andre's style of doing things!
Andre's reaction was obviously giving face to the Yearwood family.
For Camila, this result was acceptable.
After all, as long as Freya married Will in the end, it wouldn't have any impact on her.
Grayson turned his head to glance at her, then softly asked her, "Who exactly is this Connor that you mentioned?"
"I'm not very clear about who Connor is, but I know that his martial arts skills are extremely formidable. Even twenty-something bodyguards in our house were no match for him. As for how he and Freya met, I haven't heard Freya mention it..." she hastily replied.
"Twenty-something bodyguards were no match for him?"
Upon hearing this, his expression showed some astonishment. Then he turned to Andre and said softly, "Such skill at such a young age. Could it be that Connor comes from a martial arts family?"
"It's impossible. If Connor truly comes from a martial arts family, they would naturally be aware of the strengths of our Yang and Wang families. Even if they gave him ten thousand times more courage, he would never dare to oppose us. Even if this Connor is reckless, his family wouldn't be reckless..."
Andre said confidently.
"I also think so. If this person really comes from a martial arts family, I would have heard of his name. But now, I have no impression of this Connor..."
Grayson nodded in agreement.
"You don't need to worry about this matter. When the time comes, let my grandson and Freya have some contact. Then we can let Freya make the choice. If in the end, Freya chooses Connor, then it means our Washington family is inferior, and there's nothing more to say. But if Freya chooses my grandson, then it's a win-win situation. So, we don't need to pay too much attention to this matter..."
Andre calmly said to Grayson.
"Yes, yes, we'll let them interact with each other when the time comes..."
Grayson hurriedly nodded and took a sip of tea with a smile.

chapters.title: Chapter 1264: The Gathering of the Youngsters
chapters.content:
Chapter 1264: The Gathering of the Youngsters
Everyone understood that despite Andre's words, if Freya really chose Connor, the Washington family wouldn't just let it go.
They might even directly confront him. In that case, his fate could be extremely tragic.
Canela stood foolishly in place, her expression filled with helplessness.
She originally thought that revealing this matter would cause a big commotion in the Yearwood family. But she never expected that no one seemed to care about this matter. Everyone had a nonchalant attitude.
Camila, on the other hand, took a deep breath, and her nervousness instantly eased a bit. She turned her head and looked at Canela's position, secretly planning that after this incident passed, she would definitely get back at Canela. After all, all of this was caused by Canela. If it wasn't for her, things wouldn't have escalated to this point.
While the Yearwood family discussed handling the matter, Connor and Freya had already wandered around Santon for a while. Santon was originally a tourist attraction, so there were many scenic spots, and one day was not enough to visit all of them. Freya and Connor agreed that after the banquet, they would continue to explore Santon.
However, at this moment, they had no idea that the Yearwood and Washington families were conspiring.
"Connor, it's getting late. Let's find a place to eat and then go back to rest..."
Freya took out her phone and checked the time, then said softly to Connor.
"Sure..."
He was also a bit tired from the sightseeing, so he nodded without any hesitation.
She didn't know much about the situation in Santon, so she opened the map on her phone to find a nearby restaurant. But at that moment, her phone suddenly rang.
When she saw the number on her phone, she couldn't help but pause for a moment and furrowed her brow. She said, "Why is Heathcote calling me?"
"Who is Heathcote?"
Connor turned to Freya and asked.
"Heathcote is also from the Yearwood family. He's Canela's cousin. I've met him a few times in the US. I think he's quite a nice person, one of the few people from the Yearwood family that I know..."
"Since you think he's a nice person, then answer the call and see what he wants..."
Connor said with a smile.
After hesitating for a moment, she decided to answer the call and asked, "Cousin, why are you calling me?"
Regardless of anything, Canela was still Freya's mother, so she addressed him as her cousin.
"Freya, where are you now?" he asked with a smile.
"I'm outside now. Do you need anything?" she replied.
"Freya, the younger generation of our Yearwood family is having a gathering at Wanxiang Hotel. We want to take this opportunity to get together since we're all usually busy and rarely have the chance to meet..." he explained.
"Oh..."
She wasn't very interested in this kind of thing, so she responded with an indifferent tone.
"Why don't you come over?"
Heathcote hesitated for a moment before suggesting.
Her expression showed a trace of hesitation upon hearing Heathcote's invitation. She then said softly, "I'm not very familiar with those people from the Yearwood family, except for you. I don't know anyone else. I think I won't go. There's nothing much going on anyway, so I'll hang up..."
"Don't be like that. Everyone wants to see you, especially since it's your first time coming to our Yearwood family. Wouldn't you give us some face and come over?"
He insisted.
After thinking for a moment, she hesitated again and said, "That's not very convenient for me now. I'm with my fiancé. Why don't I discuss it with him and see if he wants to go..."
"Oh, come on, there's nothing to discuss. Just bring your fiancé along. I'll send someone to pick you both up. Everyone is waiting for you. After all, we'll be interacting in the future, so come over as a favor..."
"Well..."
Seeing how insistent he was, she felt a bit embarrassed to keep refusing, so she said softly, "Then forget it. Let me discuss it with my fiancé, and I'll see if he wants to go..."
"Great! There's nothing to discuss. Just bring your fiancé with you..."
Heathcote said straightforwardly and then hung up the phone.
After seeing the call end, she put down her phone helplessly.
Connor saw that Freya's expression seemed a little off and asked softly, "What's wrong?"
"Heathcote just called and said that the younger generation of the Yearwood family is having a gathering at a hotel. They want to invite us over..."
Freya responded with a hint of helplessness.
"I thought it was something serious. Since they invited us, let's go and take a look..." he said casually.
"I felt these people must have no good intentions. We shouldn't go. What if they give you a hard time?"
She furrowed her brow as she spoke.
"Since they invited us so warmly, let's go and take a look. I want to see what tricks they can play..." he said with an indifferent expression.
"Aren't you afraid?"
She paused for a moment, then asked softly.
"What's there to be afraid of..."
He replied with a faint smile.
Not to mention the younger generation of the Yearwood family, even the elders and the entire Yearwood family, Connor didn't care about them, so he naturally had nothing to fear.
Upon hearing Connor's words, Freya couldn't help but pause for a moment, then blinked and asked, "So, are you saying we should go now?"
"Yes, since they invited us both, of course, we should go and see..."
He nodded gently.
After hearing his response, Freya's expression seemed somewhat helpless.
Because she was really worried, what if these people gave Connor a hard time? What should she do then?

chapters.title: Chapter 1265: Provoke
chapters.content:
Chapter 1265: Provoke
But when Freya saw Connor's confidence, she didn't say much and could only nod gently.
Connor noticed Freya's concern and said with a smile, "Don't worry, I came here to help you deal with these people from the Yearwood family. If I can't handle the younger generation of the Yearwood family, then I definitely won't be able to handle the elders. They are nothing more than ants in my eyes and can't do anything to me."
She glanced at him and pouted, "Why are you so good at boasting?"
"Heh heh..." He smiled faintly and didn't say anything.
Although she accused him of boasting, she had great confidence in him deep down. She didn't know why she trusted him so much, but she genuinely felt that this man could provide her with a sense of security.
Not long after, Heathcote sent the address of the gathering to Freya's phone, and Connor immediately drove to the location of the hotel.
The gathering place for the young generation of the Yearwood family was a famous and luxurious hotel in Santon. The hotel's decoration was exceptionally extravagant, giving people the feeling of being in a palace. The service staff, their attire, and even their demeanor and appearance were all top-notch.
As they entered the hotel, they immediately felt that it was not an ordinary place. It was beyond the reach of ordinary people, and only truly wealthy individuals could afford to consume here.
However, what they might not know is that this hotel was actually owned by the Yearwood family.
"Welcome..." The receptionist walked up to Connor with a smile.
"We are here to attend the gathering of the Yearwood family..." Freya replied softly.
As soon as the receptionist heard Freya's words, her expression immediately turned respectful. After all, those who could attend the gathering of the young generation of the Yearwood family were all prominent figures!
She quickly arranged a welcoming hostess to accompany Connor and Freya to the private room for the gathering.
Inside the private room, Connor saw that many people had already arrived. There were about fifty to sixty of them, sitting at different tables according to their status. Those with a more prestigious background occupied prominent positions, while the wealthy second-generation individuals sat in slightly more secluded corners.
Most of the people present were in their early twenties, looking spirited and exuding a different air of elegance. They were dressed in internationally renowned brands.
Connor knew that this gathering probably wasn't just for the Yearwood family elders but had attracted many well-known young heirs in Oprana.
It could be said that this gathering had gathered around fifty percent of the wealthy second-generation in Santon.
This alone showed the terrifying influence of the Yearwood family. If the Yearwood family were just an obscure small family, how could they attract so many wealthy individuals?
As Freya looked at these people, her expression seemed somewhat nervous, as she didn't know what would happen next.
On the other hand, Connor remained calm. He didn't consider these second-generation rich kids to be a threat at all.
He also knew that this gathering wouldn't be peaceful. If someone dared to provoke him, Connor didn't mind teaching them a lesson.
"Freya, you've come..."
At this moment, a young man approached Freya with enthusiasm and greeted her.
"Heathcote..." Freya nodded gently in response.
Since Heathcote's father was Camila's brother, Freya had some interactions with Heathcote , and her impression of him was quite good.
Originally, Connor intended to greet Heathcote as well, but he never expected Heathcote to ignore him completely. Instead, he pulled Freya and said, "Frerya, come with me. Let me introduce you to some new friends. They have all come to attend the celebration of our Yearwood family's Patriarch."
After saying that, Heathcote dragged her away, leaving Connor standing alone in place.
It was evident that Heathcote deliberately excluded Connor, but he just smiled faintly and didn't take it to heart. After all, he had experienced this kind of treatment countless times, and he didn't care much anymore.

chapters.title: Chapter 1266: Mr. Landon
chapters.content:
Chapter 1266: Mr. Landon
Heathcote dragged Freya into the crowd and said, "Freya, this man is from the Landon family from Beverly Hills…"
However, at this moment, the handsome young man interrupted Heathcote. "Heathcote, there is no need for you to introduce us. Actually, we have already met before…"
Heathcote looked at the young man with a hint of confusion in his eyes.
The handsome young man said with a smile, "Miss Phillips, we've met before. You remember, right?"
When Freya heard the young man's words, she could not help but be stunned.
She realized that she had never seen this young man before, but she had some impression of the people around him because they were the people she had met on the highway.
Freya had never expected that these people would also come to attend the Yearwood family's birthday banquet.
Heathcote did not seem to know what was going on and continued to introduce the identities of these people to Freya.
"Freya, this is Mr. Wilbur Landon from the Landon family in Beverly Hills. Let me tell you, Mr. Landon has a lot of esteem in the capital. As long as you say that you know Mr. Landon in the capital, no matter who it is, they will cater to you. You have to get to know Mr. Landon well in a while so that when you go to the capital in the future, Mr. Landon will take good care of you…"
At this moment, there were also many rich heirs from Santon present. When they found out Wilbur's true identity, they turned their heads to look at Wilbur, and their expressions were abnormally shocked.
They had never thought that this handsome young man would have such a terrifying background.
One had to know that the Landon family was indeed very influential in Beverly Hills. Therefore, many people were already secretly planning to curry favor with Wilbur later. Perhaps their connections would play a very crucial role in the future.
However, the expression on Freya's face was somewhat solemn. She felt that Wilbur was not a good person. The more terrifying Wilbur's background was, the more disadvantageous it was for Connor.
"Mr. Yearwood, please don't flatter me. I only wish I had such great ability. If others say that they are humoring me, please don't take it seriously…" Wilbur replied indifferently.
"Mr. Landon, don't be so humble…" Heathcote hurriedly said.
In fact, everyone present knew very well that Wilbur's words were nothing more than modesty.
Wilbur's family background was very terrifying. Even in the entirety of Oprana, there were not many people who dared to go against the Landon family.
Wilbur only smiled faintly and did not say anything else.
After Heathcote saw that Wilbur did not speak, he continued to introduce Freya to the beautiful woman wearing sunglasses, "Freya, this is Miss Bailey Banks from the Banks family in Oprana. I don't need to introduce the Banks family, right? The most famous investment company in Oprana belongs to the Banks family. Now, Miss Banks is the general manager of that company..."
"What is it? This person was actually the general manager of Bai Group Investment?"
"I didn't expect to see Miss Bailey Banks here…"
For a moment, the expressions on everyone's faces became even more shocked.
After all, Wilbur's identity had already shocked many people, but no one expected Bailey Banks's identity to be even more terrifying.
One had to know that the reputation of the Banks family's investments was very terrifying. Moreover, it was rumored that the general manager of the Banks family investment had an amazing business mind. However, no one expected that the girl wearing sunglasses at this moment was actually from the Banks family.
Not only was the Banks family very famous in the business world, but their patriarch also held a very important position. This was also why the Banks family's connections were so terrifying.
As for Bailey, she was the future heir of the Banks family. From this point, one could see how powerful Bailey was.
"We didn't come here in vain today. We were actually able to see Miss Banks..."
"Yes, both Mr. Landon and Miss Banks are here. I wonder if there are any other big shots who haven't appeared?"
"If we can build a good relationship with Miss Banks, wouldn't it be much easier to attract investors in the future?"
Everyone looked at Bailey and began to discuss again.
At this moment, they were still very interested in Bailey. They could not understand why she had such terrifying abilities at such a young age.
"Hello, Miss Phillips!"
Bailey's attitude was obviously much better than Wilbur's, and she took the initiative to greet Freya.
"Hello!" Freya replied politely.
Bailey smiled faintly and then turned her eyes to Connor.
However, when she saw Connor, a strange look flashed across her eyes.
She couldn't help but feel that he looked a little familiar. She should have seen Connor somewhere before, but she couldn't remember where at this moment.
"Who is this person?"
Bailey could not help but think.
At this moment, Heathcote introduced the young man beside Wilbur. "Freya, this is Ted Hons, also known as Brother Hons. Brother Hons is from the Hons family in Santon!"
Ted's body was very big and muscular, and his whole being was emitting a murderous aura.
When everyone heard what the Hons family in Santon said, they immediately knew who Ted was. After all, the reputation of the Hons family in Santon was too well-known.
However, because the Hons family's main forces were in the military, and all the people present were in the business world, they were not very interested in Ted.
Ted glanced at Freya indifferently, as if he wasn't very interested in her, so he ignored her.
Freya saw that Ted didn't say anything, so she didn't say anything either.
However, Connor could feel that Ted's aura was very different from ordinary people.
Although Ted wasn't a Warrior yet, he could become one with proper training.
Seeing that Ted was ignoring Freya, Heathcote's expression turned awkward. After a moment of hesitation, he brought Freya over to a different young man.
This young man could be said to have the most extraordinary temperament among all the young people present.
He was wearing a white suit. His gaze was calm, and his aura was extraordinary. His entire body emitted the aura of a superior. This feeling was not fake, but was rather the natural result of his status.
Connor sized up this youth. He had already guessed the identity of this person.

chapters.title: Chapter 1267: Does He Have the Right to Sit Here?
chapters.content:
Chapter 1267: Does He Have the Right to Sit Here?
Heathcote took a deep breath and said, "Freya, this is Mr. Will Washington!"
After everyone heard Heathcote's words, the expressions on their faces became even more shocked.
One had to know that when Heathcote introduced others, he would always mention the identity and background of this person.
However, when he introduced Will, he only mentioned Mr. Washington.
Because the name Will Washington was already shocking enough, there was no need to add any embellishments in front of it.
Just the name alone was enough to tell everyone who this young man was.
"This person is actually Will Washington?"
Freya was shocked.
Will looked at Freya expressionlessly and said, "You look even more beautiful than in the photo, Miss Phillips…"
When Freya heard this, her expression became a little nervous. She quickly took a step back and subconsciously looked at Connor.
When Will saw Freya looking at Connor, his expression turned extremely ugly, and his eyes flashed with killing intent.
"I didn't expect Mr. Washington to actually come over!"
"That's right. Today's gathering is really a gathering of dragons. Wilbur, Bailey, Ted, and Mr. Washington are actually here. There's going to be a good show today…"
"I think that these people are probably here for the boy behind Freya. This boy is really unlucky to have provoked these people…"
Everyone looked at Will and could not help but laugh and discuss amongst themselves.
At this moment, these people looked at Connor with endless pity in their eyes. They all felt that Connor was really overestimating himself to actually dare snatch Will's woman away. Wasn't he courting death?
The Yearwood family was also watching the show. They looked down on Connor from the bottom of their hearts, so they were waiting to see Connor make a fool of himself.
If Freya were to be with Will, although Freya would fight for the position of the family head, it would definitely be a good thing for the Yearwood family members who didn't have the chance to compete for the position of the family head. However, if Freya were to be with Connor, there would be no benefits for them at all. Therefore, at this moment, these people were naturally biased towards Will.
"Freya, quickly sit down. The waiter will serve the dishes in a while…"
After Heathcote introduced these people, he chuckled and called out to Freya.
"Alright…"
Freya nodded lightly.
Heathcote then turned to look at Connor. After hesitating for a moment, he said, "You should also sit down…"
In fact, Heathcote still sympathized with Connor because he felt that Connor might not be able to leave this restaurant today, so he took the initiative to let Connor sit down.
"Connor, let's sit here!"
Freya did not want to sit at the same table as Wilbur and Will, so she decided to drag Connor to sit at another table.
After Freya sat down, Connor planned to sit beside her, but just as he was about to sit down, Wilbur suddenly said, "Wait!"
After hearing Wilbur's words, Connor slowly raised his head and looked at Wilbur, but he did not say anything.
Everyone turned their heads to look at Wilbur. They did not know what he wanted to do.
Wilbur continued, "Miss Phillips is a member of the Yearwood family. I know this very well, so it's normal for her to sit here. But I don't know who this person is. Is he qualified to sit here?"
After everyone heard Wilbur's words, a strange look flashed across their eyes.
Although these people knew that Wilbur would definitely make things difficult for Connor, no one expected Wilbur to attack Connor in such a hurry.
Heathcote looked at Connor helplessly. He knew that he couldn't control this matter.
At this moment, Freya had already sat down. When she heard Wilbur's words, a hint of anger flashed in her eyes. Then, she said coldly to Wilbur, "This person is my fiancé, Connor. Since I have the right to sit here, then my fiancé naturally has the right to sit here as well!"
"Your fiancé?" When Wilbur heard this, he could not help but sneer. Then, he turned his head to look at Heathcote and asked coldly, "Is this person the son-in-law of your Yearwood family?"
Meanwhile, Heathcote stood there foolishly with an ugly expression on his face.
After all, from a normal perspective, Heathcote and Freya's relationship was very good, and both of them were members of the Yearwood family. Therefore, he should be speaking on Freya's side at this time. However, Connor seemed to have become the enemy of the entire Yearwood family. If Freya could be with Will, it would have a huge impact on the Yearwood family and could help the Yearwood family advance.
However, no one had expected that Connor would suddenly pop out at the moment.
Connor had disrupted the entire plan of the Yearwood family, so Heathcote was also very unhappy with Connor.
However, because of Freya, Heathcote couldn't speak too directly. He could only say, "I'm not very clear about this matter either."
"What do you mean you don't know? Is it true or not?"
Wilbur said expressionlessly.
However, at this moment, a girl who was about the same age as Freya said coldly, "Freya, when did you have a fiancé? Why didn't I know about this? Did the family head agree? Did your parents agree?"
Freya's expression turned ugly when she heard the girl's words.
She did not expect that the Yearwood family would ally with Wilbur to deal with her.
"That's right. Our Yearwood family is not some small, run-of-the-mill family. We have our own rules. Freya, since you are a member of our Yearwood family, you must follow these rules!" a young man shouted.
"I don't need the approval of the Yearwood family for my matters, nor do I have anything to do with the Yearwood family!" Freya retorted without hesitation.
"Don't tell me you don't even recognize your parents? Even your mother probably doesn't know about this, right? You actually said that Connor is your fiancé in front of so many people. Aren't you a little too disrespectful? It's okay if you don't respect yourself, but you can't casually break the rules of the Yearwood family and affect our reputation…" the young man shouted again.
However, the man who spoke at this time was none other than Jules Yearwood, who was also the person who reported to Grayson Yearwood.

chapters.title: Chapter 1268: You're Nothing to Me!
chapters.content:
Chapter 1268: You're Nothing to Me!
Jules Yearwood was the most outstanding one among the younger generations of the Yearwood family.
If not for Freya's appearance, Jules would have most likely inherited the position of the family head.
Jules was also very famous in the circle of the rich heirs in Oprana.
Because he was a very good person, he was very generous and had a wide network of connections. Basically, as long as someone knew Jules, they would regard him very highly. At this time, his words carried a lot of weight.
Meanwhile, the Yearwood family's juniors began to discuss amongst themselves in hushed tones. It was obvious that they were dissatisfied with Freya's behavior.
"I don't have self-respect?"
After hearing these people's words, Freya's expression turned extremely ugly. This was because these people's words were going too overboard.
Although Freya had already expected that the Yearwood family would make things difficult for Connor, she never thought that they would go so far.
Connor had just come in, and they were already planning to kick him out. Was it obvious that they were deliberately humiliating him?
If they really felt that Connor was not qualified to attend this banquet, then why did they ask her to bring him here just now?
Could it be that they just wanted to humiliate him in front of everyone?
At this moment, all the people in the hall were looking at Connor. They wanted to see how Freya's fiancé planned to deal with this situation.
"Alright, since some people don't belong here, then hurry up and get out!" Wilbur said expressionlessly.
Connor looked at Wilbur indifferently and said in a very calm tone, "Since when are you people in a position to gossip about the matters between Freya and myself?"
"What do you mean?" Jules asked Connor excitedly.
"Don't you understand?" Connor replied indifferently and then continued, "Isn't your Yearwood family insignificant? It's not up to you to judge the matters between me and my fiancée. If Freya wants to be with me, the two of us can be together. We don't need the consent of anyone in the Yearwood family because you are nothing in front of me!"
When everyone heard Connor's words, they were all stunned on the spot, and their expressions were abnormally shocked.
At this moment, Connor stood there quietly, his expression unusually calm.
It was as if Connor didn't think highly of the Yearwood family either.
After hearing Connor's words, the expressions of all the Yearwood family members changed.
He was blatantly humiliating the Yearwood family.
They felt that Connor was being too arrogant. When he said this, it was obvious that he did not even want to preserve the slightest bit of their dignity.
The expressions of Heathcote, Jules, and the others turned even uglier.
The Yearwood family had been famous in Oprana for so many years. When had they ever been humiliated like this? Not to mention that the one who humiliated the Yearwood family was Connor, who looked no different from an ordinary person!
Jules took a deep breath and then said, "Freya, I didn't expect your fiancé to be so arrogant as to humiliate the Yearwood family like this. I think this kid is really tired of living. If it wasn't for you, I would have broken his legs and thrown him out long ago…"
"That's right, isn't this kid too condescending? He even dared to humiliate the Yearwood family. He really didn't know what this kid was thinking. Did he really think that no one would dare to do anything to him just because he's with Freya?"
"This is really hilarious. I have never seen such an arrogant person. I will definitely tell the clan head about this…" Everyone from the Yearwood family shouted.
Meanwhile, Will sat quietly in his original position, sizing up Connor expressionlessly. He secretly thought that his competitor's ability was not great, but his tone was not small.
Even if it was him, he would not say such a thing in front of everyone in the Yearwood family.
Even in the entire Oprana, not many people would dare to say such a thing.
One had to know that even Andre Washington had to humor Grayson Yearwood.
Although the Yearwood family was not as powerful as the Washington family, their background was still very terrifying.
Connor looked at everyone present, and a trace of disdain flashed across his eyes. He did not continue to pay attention to these people, but instead reached out to pull a chair and prepared to sit down.
At this moment, Connor did not want to have too much conflict with these people. After all, if they really started fighting, Freya would definitely be in a very difficult position.
At this moment, he was only thinking about Freya. If it wasn't for her, Connor would have sent these people flying long ago. How could he still be in the mood to talk so much nonsense with them?
In Connor's eyes, these people were just a bunch of jumping clowns. They might not even know how terrifying the person standing in front of them was.
Will looked at Connor expressionlessly. He saw a different kind of confidence from him, but Will couldn't understand where his confidence came from.
"This Connor is quite interesting!" Will could not help but smile faintly.
However, just as Connor was about to sit down, Wilbur actually reached out his hand again to stop him.
Connor looked at Wilbur indifferently and asked coldly, "What is the meaning of this?"
"Don't you know what I mean? I think I've already made it very clear just now. You don't have the right to attend this banquet at all, and you don't have the right to sit here…" Wilbur said calmly.
Freya's expression was a little angry. She stood up and shouted at Wilbur, "What do you mean? I've already said that Connor is my fiancé. Isn't this clearly a deliberate attempt at provocation?"
"Provocation?"
When Wilbur heard this, his expression was obviously disdainful. He then said indifferently, "A person like him isn't worthy of being provoked by me. On account of the fact that you're a member of the Yearwood family, I won't hold it against you. Hurry up and get that kid out of here, or I'll call security…"
For a moment, everyone looked at Wilbur, their expressions abnormally nervous.
Everyone present knew that Wilbur was obviously provoking Connor on purpose.
If it was under normal circumstances, he would have been humiliated in front of his fiancée, which would be an unbearable thing for any regular man to go through. Therefore, everyone was observing Connor's reaction. They wanted to see how he would deal with this matter.

chapters.title: Chapter 1269: Broken Arm
chapters.content:
Chapter 1269: Broken Arm
At this moment, Heathcote's face turned dark.
He finally understood why Wilbur had insisted on calling Freya and Connor over.
It was obvious that these people had already planned it all out. Wilbur deliberately provoked Connor, and his goal was very simple, which was to make Connor make the first move.
Once Connor attacked, Ted would have a reason to attack as well. He might even cripple Connor.
At this moment, Heathcote was very worried about Connor. After all, he knew that Ted came from a military family and was very skilled. He had been the combat champion of the army for several years in a row.
If Ted attacked Connor, Connor would definitely end up in a miserable state.
In addition, Ted, Wilbur, and Will had terrifying backgrounds.
Even if Ted killed Connor today, it wouldn't affect them at all.
Ted was already prepared.
He had been keeping an eye on Conno. If Connor made a slight move, Ted would attack him immediately.
'Will, Wilbur, Ted, and Bailey are too powerful. Even the Yearwood Family doesn't dare to go against these four big families. How can a mere Connor be their opponent? Looks like he is really doomed this time…'
Heathcote could not help but sigh in his heart.
He had originally planned to help Connor out, but after thinking about it, he decided against it.
After all, he didn't know Connor very well. If Freya really married Will, it would be a good thing for the Yearwood Family.
Therefore, after hesitating for a moment, Heathcote still did not say anything.
At this time, Jules was also staring at Connor. He couldn't help but secretly guess in his heart what Connor planned to do next. He didn't know if Connor wanted to silently swallow this anger or just make a move.
Of course, Jules still hoped that Connor would make a move. After all, the other party was Wilbur. If Connor made a move, he might not be able to walk out of this hotel.
Jules was now waiting to watch a good show.
Will, on the other hand, had a calm expression on his face. From the beginning to the end, he was drinking quietly, as if this matter had nothing to do with him.
Bailey kept looking at Connor because the more she looked at him, the more familiar he looked, but she didn't know where she had seen him before.
After thinking for a moment, Bailey took out her phone and sent a message to someone.
After putting down her phone, Bailey couldn't help but think to herself, 'Is there really such a coincidence in this world?'
Connor sized up Wilbur and asked, "Ever since I entered this hotel, you've been trying to provoke me. Isn't your goal to make me attack you?"
"I told you; you're not qualified enough for me to provoke you. Get out of here!"
Wilbur did not expect Connor to see through his intentions. Although he was a little shocked, he still appeared very calm and replied to Connor calmly.
"Since you want me to make a move so badly, I'll fulfill your wish today!"
After saying this, Connor walked toward Wilbur.
"Connor, what are you doing?"
Freya was worried that if this matter blew up, it would not be good for Connor, so she hurriedly reached out to stop him.
"Freya, you don't have to worry about this!"
Connor replied to Freya indifferently before walking up to Wilbur.
Wilbur looked at Connor and smiled disdainfully.
"I hope you can still smile so happily later!"
Connor whispered to Wilbur.
Immediately after, Connor grabbed Wilbur's arm.
Ted had never expected Connor to be so fast.
In the next second, Connor exerted force and twisted gently.
Crack!
Everyone could hear the crisp sound of bones breaking.
Everyone froze on the spot.
Then, Wilbur screamed.
No one expected Connor's actions to be so fast. In just a few seconds, he had broken one of Wilbur's arms.
After all, that was an adult's arm!
However, in front of Connor, it was like a branch that could be easily broken.
Everyone widened their eyes, not knowing how to describe their current feelings.
Even Will did not expect that Connor would actually dare to attack Wilbur.
Will looked at Connor in disbelief.
Everyone else's mouths were wide open, not knowing how to describe their current feelings.
He was the eldest young master of the Landon Family in Beverly Hills!
Even if an ordinary person offended Wilbur, they might have their legs broken.
However, at this moment, Connor actually broke one of Wilbur's arms. This was really unacceptable. They felt that Connor must have gone crazy.
Heathcote's lips trembled slightly. From the moment Connor attacked, Heathcote had already realized that something was wrong with today's matter.
"It's over. Something big might really happen today…"
Jules looked at Connor and stammered.
Freya was extremely calm. She understood Connor's personality, so it was not peculiar that he attacked
However, Freya didn't feel any fear. The reason was very simple. Freya knew that Connor was helping her, and Connor's actions gave Freya a great sense of security.
Wilbur held his arm and knelt down on the ground. He let out a few screams in succession. The intense pain on his arm almost made him faint.
"How... How dare you hit me? Do you know who I am?"
Wilbur's eyes were red as he shouted at Connor with a ferocious expression.
Wilbur had never encountered such a thing before. Even in Beverly Hills, where rich second-generation heirs could be seen everywhere, no one dared to treat Wilbur like this.
But now, Connor had actually broken one of his arms. Wilbur was in shock. He also could not believe that all of this was true.
Ted looked at Connor with a serious expression.
He could feel that when Connor broke Wilbur's arm just now, he was very relaxed. It gave people the feeling that he was crushing an ant.
Human bones were considered very hard.
Even Ted couldn't break a person's arm so easily.
However, Connor could easily do it. This showed that Connor was terrifyingly strong.

chapters.title: Chapter 1270: Ted Hons Makes a Move
chapters.content:
Chapter 1270: Ted Hons Makes a Move
"Is Connor also a martial artist?"
Ted was confused.
However, just as he was hesitating, Connor had already walked in front of Wilbur.
No one expected that after Connor had broken Wilbur's arm, he still did not plan to stop at all. He was even prepared to continue attacking Wilbur.
"What... What are you doing?"
Wilbur finally understood what true fear was. He widened his eyes and asked Connor with a terrified expression.
"What am I doing?"
Connor smiled playfully when he heard this, then said coldly, "I want you to know the consequences of provoking me…"
After saying this, Connor did not give Wilbur any chance to react at all. He grabbed Wilbur's other arm and forcefully broke Wilbur's second arm.
"Ah…"
This time, Wilbur let out a cry of pain that sounded even more painful than before. He seemed to have gone crazy and began to roll on the ground non-stop. His face was distorted from the pain.
Everyone stood up and scurried to the side, then looked at Connor with a terrified expression.
They really couldn't understand why Connor would do such a thing.
"Is this person crazy?"
"That's Wilbur Landon!"
"Connor is simply courting death. I really don't know what he's thinking!"
Everyone started discussing in low voices.
After Connor broke Wilbur's arms, he continued to walk toward Wilbur.
Wilbur was extremely scared as he hurriedly began to retreat.
Heathcote knew that this matter could no longer be controlled. He hurriedly stood in front of Connor and shouted, "Connor, do you know what you are doing right now? Are you crazy? Do you know who Wilbur is?"
"I don't need to know who Wilbur is. Since he dares to provoke me, he will have to bear the consequences of provoking me…"
Connor said calmly.
"You... You're simply a lunatic! Do you know that you will implicate the entire Yearwood Family?"
Heathcote shouted.
"If you are worried about being implicated, you should not have asked me to come here. You should not have let this person provoke me either…"
Connor whispered to Heathcote.
When Heathcote heard Connor's words, he was stunned.
He really regretted asking Connor to come here. If he hadn't asked Connor to come, things wouldn't have turned out like this.
When Connor saw that Heathcote was not saying anything, he walked toward Wilbur.
"I'm from the Landon Family. Don't come near me. I won't let you off…"
Wilbur looked at Connor as if he was looking at the Grim Reaper and shouted frantically.
Connor ignored Wilbur and continued to approach him.
"Enough!"
When Ted saw that Connor was about to make a move, he quickly shouted.
However, Connor ignored Ted. He raised his right foot and stomped on Wilbur's thigh.
Crack!
Another crisp sound.
Connor's kick broke Wilbur's thigh.
Everyone was stunned once again. No one had expected him to be so ruthless. He was clearly not bothered by who the Landon Family was.
"You are really going too far!"
Ted rushed to Connor and shouted angrily.
"I'm going too far?"
Connor could not help but sneer.
"Aren't you?"
Ted gritted his teeth and continued, "Wilbur has no grudge with you, yet you are attacking him so ruthlessly. You've really gone too far…"
"So, you do know that he has no grudge against me?"
Connor smiled and continued, "Isn't this the result you wanted to see? From the moment I entered this room, Wilbur had been provoking me non-stop. You know your skills very well. As long as I make a move, you will make a move against me. If it weren't for my skills, I would be the one lying on the ground wailing right now, right?"
Ted was speechless. He asked Connor with a ferocious expression, "Your skills are extraordinary. Who are you? Are you also from an ancient martial art aristocratic family?"
"You don't need to know who I am. You just need to remember that you'd better not provoke me. Otherwise, you'll regret it…"
Connor said expressionlessly.
"Wilbur is my brother. Since you beat him up, I will have to avenge him!"
Ted shouted with his eyes wide open. Then, he raised his fist and smashed it at Connor's head.
The moment Ted made his move, everyone could feel how terrifying Ted's strength was. Ted's fist was like a hammer, directly smashing toward Connor's face.
"This punch can probably kill someone, right?"
When Heathcote saw this scene, he was extremely shocked.
"It's really terrifying…"
A trace of fear flashed in Jules Yearwood's eyes as he stuttered.
Freya stared at Connor with her big, watery eyes. She was also very nervous.
After all, she did not know how strong Connor was. If something really happened to him, what should she do?
"If you were a martial artist, you might be able to compete with me. Unfortunately, you're not!"
Connor looked at Ted and said calmly.
"You are too arrogant…"
Ted was furious when he heard Connor's words.
Connor waved his right hand and grabbed Ted's fist.
When Ted saw Connor clenching his fist tightly, he was shocked.
Because he never thought that Connor would actually be so strong, casually clenching his fist.
Ted instinctively raised his leg, wanting to kick Connor in the stomach.
However, before Ted could kick Connor, Connor slapped Ted across the face.
Ted's body was sent flying and smashed into the wall.
No one knew how strong Connor's slap was, but they saw Ted struggling on the ground and then passing out.
For a moment, everyone was stunned.
They stared at Connor with wide eyes, utterly shocked.
No one had expected such a situation to happen in the end!
Connor ignored Ted, who was unconscious, and walked straight to Wilbur.
"What else do you want?"
Wilbur shouted at Connor.

chapters.title: Chapter 1271: It's Indeed You!
chapters.content:
Chapter 1271: It's Indeed You!
Crack!
Connor raised his leg and broke Wilbur's other leg.
"Since you dare to provoke me, then I will let you know the consequences of provoking me. Today, I will only break your legs. If I see you again in the future, it won't end with just that!"
Connor said indifferently.
Wilbur looked at Connor and opened his mouth to speak. However, because of the intense pain in his legs, he fainted before he could say anything.
"Does anyone still think that I'm not qualified to sit here?"
Connor turned and asked everyone indifferently.
Everyone present was silent. No one dared to speak.
They felt that Connor was a lunatic. If they provoked him, they might end up like Wilbur.
"Security!"
Will Washington finally couldn't hold it in anymore and called out expressionlessly.
The security guards standing outside the door rushed into the hall after hearing Will's words.
However, when they saw the scene in front of them, they were all dumbfounded. They could not understand why Wilbur was beaten up to such a state.
"Catch him!"
Will shouted in a low voice.
When the security guards heard this, they hurriedly took out their weapons and rushed toward Connor.
But at this moment, Bailey's phone suddenly rang.
Bailey quickly opened her phone and took a look. At this moment, there was a photo on Bailey's phone.
The person in the photo was none other than Connor.
"It really is you!"
Bailey could not help but laugh bitterly.
When Connor held a party in Porthampton, Bailey's father also attended it. He even saw Connor and took a photo of him.
After returning home, Bailey's father showed this photo to the younger generation of the Banks Family and told them not to offend this person.
When Bailey saw Connor just now, she felt that he looked familiar.
Therefore, she contacted her father immediately and asked for Mr. McDonald's photo.
At this time, all the bodyguards had already rushed in front of Connor.
"Stop!"
Bailey shouted without hesitation.
When the security guards heard Bailey's words, they were all stunned. They were puzzled, and everyone present looked at Bailey.
Bailey stopping them made the security guards feel a little at a loss. They did not know what to do now.
Will asked Bailey expressionlessly, "Bailey, what are you doing? Why aren't you letting them get him?"
"That's right, Miss Banks, why are you protecting this guy?"
"This guy is too much. He actually beat Mr. Landon to such a state. We must let the guards teach him a lesson and let him know the consequences of beating someone up…"
Jules shouted angrily at Bailey.
"That's right, we must teach him a lesson…"
Everyone from the Yearwood Family also shouted.
After all, none of the Yearwood Family's people wanted to have anything to do with Connor, because Connor had gone overboard today. If they had anything to do with Connor, it might even implicate them.
For a moment, everyone began to blame Bailey. They didn't understand why Bailey would stand up for Connor at this time.
Heathcote also felt that what Connor had done today was too much. Moreover, this matter had happened at the gathering of the Yearwood Family's juniors. If they didn't capture Connor now and give the Landon Family an explanation, the matter might become even more complicated.
Although the Yearwood Family wasn't afraid of the Landon Family, they didn't want to get into trouble because of Connor.
Furthermore, Wilbur had someone like Will standing behind him, so they couldn't afford to offend him.
All the guards also looked at Bailey. They knew in their hearts that Bailey was not an ordinary person. Bailey must have her own reason when she asked them to stop. They were waiting for Bailey to explain this matter.
Bailey looked at everyone expressionlessly, then took off her sunglasses, revealing her charming face.
Bailey's appearance was very exquisite and beautiful. She gave people the feeling that she was the reincarnation of a fox demon. Her entire body emitted waves of charming aura.
At this moment, Connor was also looking at Bailey. He did not understand why this woman would stand up for him. After all, everyone wanted to use this chance to clear their relationship with him!
After hearing everyone's questions, Bailey became extremely disdainful. Then, she said coldly, "You people are really stupid…"
"Bailey, what in the world are you doing?"
Will asked unhappily.
"You all know what Ted is like. He has been learning martial arts from an instructor since he was young. Ted is not even Connor's opponent. Do you think these guards are Connor's match?"
Bailey asked everyone coldly.
For a moment, everyone present fell silent. They looked at Bailey and did not dare to speak.
"If you let these guards deal with Connor now, it's no different from sending yourselves to death. You're really too naive…"
Bailey continued.
"Even if we're not Connor's match, we can't just let him go like this, right?"
Jules gritted his teeth and shouted in a low voice.
"If you don't let Connor off, then what else do you plan to do? If Connor were just an ordinary person, would he still have dared to attack Wilbur?"
Bailey asked Jules.
Jules couldn't help but be stunned for a moment, then he frowned and said, "Miss Banks, what are you trying to say?"
"Do you know who Connor is?"
Bailey looked at everyone and asked indifferently.
"Who is he?"
When everyone heard Bailey's words, they were confused.
In their eyes, Connor was just an ordinary person. They didn't think that Connor had any special background.
"It seems that you really don't know who Connor is. Since you don't know, then I'll tell you. Connor is Mr. McDonald from Porthampton!"
Bailey said softly.
"Mr. McDonald from Porthampton?"
For a moment, everyone present was stunned.
After all, the name of Mr. McDonald of Porthampton was naturally well-known to them. He was an existence that shook the four provinces.
Even in Beverly Hills, many people had heard of Connor.
They all knew how terrifying Mr. McDonald was.

chapters.title: Chapter 1272: Identity Exposed
chapters.content:
Chapter 1272: Identity Exposed
"Connor is the Mr. McDonald of Porthampton?"
Heathcote and Jules looked at Connor, their faces filled with shock.
Because they could not believe what Bailey said.
Mr. McDonald's background was very terrifying. He was the boss of the Empire World Corporation!
Even people like Thomas Morgan and Kyle Hayes were Mr. McDonald's subordinates. Just from this point alone, one could see how terrifying Mr. McDonald's identity was.
If Connor was really the Mr. McDonald of Porthampton City, then things were about to get interesting.
"Miss Banks, is what you said true?"
Heathcote could not help but ask.
"Do you think I would joke around at a time like this?"
Bailey could not help but scoff.
Heathcote took a deep breath. At this moment, he could feel that Bailey was serious.
Although many people had heard of Connor's deeds, but because Connor had always been very low-key, he rarely appeared in public. This led to very few people who actually knew Connor.
Except for those who had attended Connor's party in Porthampton, the rest of the people had never seen Connor before. They had only heard of him.
However, the party that Connor held at that time was quite high-end. Those who could attend the party were all top figures in Oprana.
Although these people present were all rich second-generation heirs, they were not qualified to attend Connor's party at all. Even their elders were not qualified to attend.
It was not odd that these people did not to know Connor.
If it wasn't for Bailey's good memory today, realizing that Connor looked familiar, things might not have reached this point.
Will looked at Connor, and he became solemn.
He didn't expect Connor to have such an identity.
Of course, even if Connor was really Porthampton's Mr. McDonald, Will wouldn't be too afraid of Connor because of the Washington Family he was from.
However, Will's heart was filled with shock.
Originally, he thought that Connor was just an ordinary person. He only needed to move his finger and he could easily get rid of Connor.
However, he did not expect Connor to have such a terrifying background. This matter would not end so easily.
Bailey walked up to Connor and whispered, "I'm not mistaken am I, Mr. McDonald?"
Connor looked at Bailey indifferently and didn't answer Bailey's question. However, Connor's attitude showed that he had tacitly agreed to this fact.
Freya looked at Connor with a puzzled expression. Although she knew that Connor was the Mr. McDonald of Porthampton, she had always lived abroad and did not know much about Connor.
Freya couldn't understand why everyone looked at Connor so differently after knowing his identity.
"It seems that in just half a year, Connor has experienced a lot of things!"
Freya couldn't help but mutter in her heart.
In an instant, everyone looked at Connor in disbelief.
After all, they had heard too much about Connor. In their eyes, Connor was probably even more terrifying than Wilbur. Among all the people present, only Will could contend with him.
No one had expected such a legendary figure to appear in front of them in such a way.
If Bailey hadn't said this, then these people wouldn't have believed that Connor was Mr. McDonald from Porthampton.
Bailey's status was still very high, so she was naturally very credible. In addition, Connor had beaten Wilbur to such a state just now. If Bailey lied now, it would undoubtedly be going against the Landon Family.
Doing so would not benefit Bailey at all.
Therefore, everyone had already accepted the fact that Connor was Porthampton's Mr. McDonald.
Those guards seemed to know Connor's identity, so they looked very nervous. They were secretly glad that they didn't make a move just now. Otherwise, if they offended a big shot like Connor, they would probably get into real trouble.
Although Will's background was terrifying, Connor was not necessarily weaker than Will. This was obviously a struggle between the upper class. If small figures like them participated, they would only be cannon fodder. Therefore, the guards knew what was best for them and did not dare to attack.
Heathcote and Jules both looked at Connor in disbelief. They finally understood why Freya would openly bring Connor to the Yearwood Family.
They also understood why Connor dared to break Wilbur's legs today.
Previously, they thought that Connor was a madman, that was why he would do such a thing.
However, they now knew that Connor was not a lunatic. He did this because he had the capital to do so.
Connor did not take the small Landon Family seriously at all.
Heathcote thought of what Connor had said to them before. It seemed that everything was very logical.
After all, if Connor was really the Mr. McDonald of Porthampton, then he did have the capital to be arrogant.
For a moment, the atmosphere in the hall turned a little strange.
Everyone stood rooted to the ground, not daring to say a word.
After all, these people present were just some profligate young masters. If they did not have the protection of their families, they might not even be comparable to ordinary people.
In their eyes, people like Wilbur and Will were already very terrifying. However, Connor was clearly even more terrifying.
Because Connor was not the same as the rich second-generation heirs here. Connor had reached a position where even the elders in their family looked up to.
Moreover, Connor did not rely on his family background to get to this position.
They didn't know what Connor's background was. They only knew that Connor was terrifying.
Connor was only in his twenties, but he already had such achievements.
If Connor was given a few more years, then how terrifying would Connor be? These people simply didn't dare to imagine.
To put it simply, these people present might be considered good compared to ordinary people, but compared to Connor, it was simply heaven and earth.
No one wanted to offend someone like Connor.

chapters.title: Chapter 1273: Offending the Three Big Families
chapters.content:
Chapter 1273: Offending the Three Big Families
And at this moment, countless girls looked towards Freya's position.
Their eyes were filled with envy and jealousy because they couldn't understand why Freya was so lucky. Not only did she capture the attention of Will, but she also managed to get engaged to a big figure like Mr. Connor from Porthampton. This was something they could only dream of!
But all of this had happened to Freya alone.
Both Connor and Will were the most perfect choices in these girls' hearts.
"Mr. Connor's background is not simple. It's a matter between Mr. Connor and the Landon family. We outsiders should stay out of it..." Bailey continued speaking at this time.
"Yes, since this is a matter between Mr. Connor and the Landon family, I think we should not get involved..." Jules said nervously.
He was afraid of offending Connor now.
When Will learned about Connor's identity, he naturally felt shocked.
Moreover, he heard about Connor's remarkable martial arts skills. So, these bodyguards present were definitely not Connor's match. If he continued to provoke Connor, it would be an unwise choice. He didn't want to end up like Wilbur and become a crippled man.
He did not continue to let these bodyguards attack Connor but walked up to him and said in a low voice, "I didn't expect you to be Mr. Connor from Porthampton..."
"Now that you know my identity, get out of Santon quickly. I don't want to take action against you!" Connor said disdainfully to him.
"Whether I leave Santon or not is not for you to decide. But I do have something to remind you..." Will said with a smile, not intending to create any conflict with Connor.
"What is it?" Connor asked Will expressionlessly.
"Do you know who Wilbur is?"
"I already said it doesn't matter who he is. As long as he dares to provoke me, I will break his legs, just like you..." Connor said calmly.
"Mr. Connor, you're really confident!" Will smiled faintly and continued, "Since you don't know, let me introduce you in detail. Wilbur's father is one of the top ten richest men in Oprana, with assets worth billions. Wilbur's mother is the mayor of a provincial capital city. Although Wilbur's grandfather has retired, his influence is still terrifying. The Landon family is three generations of only one male heir, Wilbur. He will inherit all of the Landon family's assets in the future. But now, you have turned Wilbur into a cripple. You should consider how to explain it to the Landon family..."
After hearing Will's words, the expressions on the faces of those present seemed even more shocked.
Although they had known that Wilbur's background was terrifying, they didn't expect it to be so dreadful.
Such a family background was something that ordinary people could hardly reach even if they worked hard for ten generations!
At this moment, no matter how brave they were, they wouldn't dare to offend someone like Wilbur.
But after hearing Will's words, Connor's expression showed some disdain, and he said indifferently, "What can a mere Landon family do?"
Will looked at him and smiled, saying lightly, "You're right, a small Landon family is indeed nothing in front of you. But what if we add the Hons family to the equation?"
"The Hons family?" When the crowd heard this, they all turned to look at Ted, who was unconscious.
"Ted is now a Major in the army, and he is also the Deputy Captain of Oprana Special Force..." Will continued.
"Oprana Special Force?" When the crowd heard his words, the shock on their faces was even more evident.
Because the Special Force was very famous in Oprana. Although the team was not large, everyone who could enter the team was an elite among elites. This team was the most powerful special forces unit in Oprana. Anyone who emerged from this team had limitless future prospects. Moreover, Ted was now the Deputy Captain of the Special Force. It made people feel even more incredulous.
"And Ted's father is..." At this moment, Will continued to speak.
"What? Ted's background is too terrifying!"
"What do you guys know? I heard that Ted's father's identity is far more complicated than what you see on the surface..."
At this moment, the people present began to discuss in a hushed voice. The expressions on their faces were filled with excitement.
At this point, Ted's background had far exceeded their imagination.
Even the Washington family that Will was part of perhaps wouldn't dare to go against a family like Ted's. But Connor had just slapped Ted, who was from such a family.
At this moment, everyone looked at Connor with a worried look because they were well aware that his background and identity were indeed terrifying, but when compared to the Landon family and the Hons family, perhaps it wasn't as frightening. Furthermore, there was still Will!
The Washington family Will belonged to was a true big family, after all, it was an ancient martial family.
The Washington family had many high-level martial artists. Once they truly angered the Washington family, the joint action of these martial artists would be unstoppable, no matter how great Connor's abilities were!
Connor had offended three different families from three different domains today. If an ordinary person was in his place, they would probably be too scared to move.
At this moment, Freya was also very worried about him. She felt that if all these people joined forces against him, even with his immense skills, he might not be a match. And Bailey had been staring at Connor's position all along. Now, nobody knew what was going on in Bailey's mind. If the Bai family also got involved in this matter, it would make Connor's situation even more dangerous.
"Mr. Connor, do you understand what I mean now?" Will asked Connor with a smile.

chapters.title: Chapter 1274: Comparing Social Backgrounds
chapters.content:
Chapter 1274: Comparing Social Backgrounds
"I certainly understand what you mean. You want to tell me that I've already offended the Landon family, the Hons family, and now your Washington family too?" Connor replied expressionlessly, then coldly asked Will, "But even if I've offended all of you big families, so what?"
"You..." Will was stunned by Connor's words, his expression seemingly incredulous.
He hadn't expected that even at this point, Connor would still be so arrogant.
"After telling me so much and sharing the backgrounds of these two, you just want to compare backgrounds and make me aware of how dangerous my situation is, right? I'll give you time. You can bring all those people you just mentioned here, and I will deal with them one by one!" Connor said calmly as he stood up slowly. Then, he turned to look at the others present and said expressionlessly, "I know you must be very dissatisfied right now, but it's okay. If you have any means, feel free to use them. I'll be waiting for you!"
Everyone looked at him with shocked expressions.
Nobody had expected that he would not take Will's words to heart. Instead, he was provoking them even further.
"Freya, let's go!" Connor said expressionlessly.
"Okay..." She nodded quickly.
Connor directly held her hand and walked towards the exit of the hall.
The bodyguards who had been blocking the entrance saw Connor approaching and didn't make any attempt to stop him. Instead, they all made way for him.
They didn't dare to stop him now.
But just as he was about to leave the hall, he suddenly turned back to look at Will and said casually, "I forgot to remind you. You'd better stay away from my woman. Otherwise, Wilbur's current situation will be your fate!"
After saying this, he walked out of the hall.
The girls present looked at Connor's figure with admiration in their eyes because they felt that Connor was just too domineering.
Of course, Will's expression was quite unpleasant. After all, no one had ever threatened him like that before!
Until now, everyone had secretly doubted whether Connor was really Mr. Connor from Porthampton. But now, they were sure that Connor was indeed Mr. Connor; otherwise, he wouldn't be so audacious. He had broken Wilbur's legs and hands in front of so many people and even provoked the Lü family, the Hons family, and the Washington family. If it were an ordinary person, they would probably have died a thousand times already.
But at this moment, he could leave here unharmed, and no one dared to stop him.
Heathcote looked at Connor's disappearing figure with a helpless expression because he felt that Connor's actions just now were a bit too foolish.
Although Connor was Mr. Connor from Porthampton and had achieved so much at a young age, which was enough to make him ignore many people, he had just broken Wilbur's legs and hands and provoked so many people. This was clearly an act of not knowing the immensity of heaven and earth. No matter how terrifying Connor's background and identity were, he would definitely not be a match for these three big families.
Who else in the entire Oprana would dare to act this way?
"I wonder how Connor plans to deal with this situation at the banquet!" Heathcote couldn't help sighing in his heart.
As for Bailey, a peculiar expression flickered in her beautiful eyes. She had heard many things about Connor before but had never really seen him until today. She felt that Connor was indeed as rumored. If you didn't know he was Mr. Connor, you would think he was a lunatic. But once you knew his identity, you would find an unparalleled charm in him.
Bailey felt that Connor was different from all other men. He had a domineering aura that was hard to comprehend.
If it wasn't for the fact that Connor had already been engaged to Freya, Bailey might have been tempted to get close to Connor. But now she knew she had no chance.
A man who could make a woman like Bailey fall for him, how could he be an ordinary person?
"I wonder what plans Connor has to handle this situation. This matter seems to be getting more and more interesting!" Bailey smiled lightly.
Will, on the other hand, still seemed to be immersed in Connor's threat just now. He had never been threatened like this before, so naturally, he had never experienced such a feeling.
"Connor, Mr. Connor, quite interesting!" Will sneered, then turned to the people around him and shouted, "What are you all standing there for? Hurry up and take Mr. Wilbur to the hospital..."
"Yes..." After hearing Will's words, everyone quickly responded, carrying the unconscious Wilbur out.
...
After leaving the hotel with Freya, Connor turned his head and glanced at her, feeling somewhat guilty, and said, "Freya, I'm sorry. The things I did today may cause you some trouble..."
"Why are you apologizing to me? The one who should apologize is me..." she said, her expression full of remorse as she spoke to Connor.
After hearing her words, he was taken aback for a moment, then smiled and asked, "Why do you suddenly want to apologize to me?"
"Shouldn't I apologize? After all, this whole thing is because of me..."
"These things have nothing to do with you..." he replied calmly.
"How could they have nothing to do with me?" Freya directly asked, then continued, "I really regret it now. If I had known that these people were intentionally provoking and making things difficult for you, I wouldn't have brought you here. I didn't expect them to be so excessive. I don't understand why they would want to provoke you for no reason?"
"These people just don't take me seriously. They think I'm not qualified to compete with Will for you, so they planned to teach me a lesson and make me give up..." Connor explained as he looked at Freya.
"Now, things have turned out like this..." Freya couldn't help but sigh lightly.
"Now that they know my identity, I guess they won't come to provoke me again..." Connor said lightly.

chapters.title: Chapter 1275: A Powerful Background
chapters.content:
Chapter 1275: A Powerful Background
And after hearing this, Freya's expression still appeared somewhat worried.
She couldn't help but softly ask Connor, "Are you sure there won't be any consequences for what you did to Wilbur today? What if they seek revenge?"
"Rest assured, since I dare to do this, I'm not afraid of them coming after me. In my eyes, they're nothing more than insignificant people," he replied confidently.
However, her worried expression did not improve after hearing his reassurance. She furrowed her brows and said, "I know you're very capable, but these people are not easy to deal with. Maybe we should leave here and go back to Porthampton. After all, Porthampton is your territory, and once we're there, they won't dare to touch us."
