"Going back to Porthampton won't guarantee safety either," he replied in a low voice, shaking his head. "I came here to solve these troubles, so I'm not afraid of them coming after me. If we leave now, I might as well not have come at all. Since I'm here, I want them all to know you're mine, and no one can have any ill intentions towards you."
Connor's expression was serious as he spoke, and Freya, despite her worry, felt touched by his words.
After hesitating for a moment, she said softly, "Alright, since you're so confident, I'll stay by your side no matter what. Even if it comes down to it, we'll face everything together."
"Don't worry, we won't be that easily defeaTom," he said, reaching out to pat her head with a gentle smile.
Then, she suddenly asked, "Who said I'm your woman?"
"You," he replied nonchalantly.
"You shameless person! I haven't agreed to marry you yet," she exclaimed, her expression agitaTom.
"Even if you haven't agreed now, isn't it just a matter of time?" he replied with a smile.
"Just wait until you've actually married me!" She pouTom.
"Okay, after this is all over, I'll marry you," he said with a helpless smile before opening the car door and getting in.
Half an hour later, Connor and Freya returned to the hotel, freshened up briefly, and went to rest.
At this moment, Connor didn't even think much about the events of the day. He had planned everything in advance, and he didn't fear the likes of the Landon family, Washington family, or Hons family.
Meanwhile, on the other side, after being taken to the hospital, Wilbur's incident was immediately reported to Tom by Jules.
Hearing the news, Tom was so furious that he called all the senior members of the Yearwood family to the conference room.
Everyone was present except for Grayson. In the Yearwood family, if Grayson wasn't there, Tom's eldest son, Jules, would be the one with the final say.
"This is simply absurd! What does Connor think he's doing? Is he crazy?" Tom shouted angrily, his expression full of indignation.
Jules was extremely nervous, standing in place without daring to say a word.
Tom took a deep breath, pointed at Jules, and scolded him, "What should I say about you? You were clearly present at the scene, why didn't you stop Connor? How did you let this escalate into a fight? What infuriates me the most is that in front of so many people, Connor directly broke Wilbur's legs and arms. Why didn't any of you stop Connor?"
Tom couldn't understand. With so many people present, how could Wilbur have ended up like this?
"But, Dad, I also tried to stop him, but I couldn't. Connor is like a monster; he's incredibly strong," Jules replied helplessly.
"Worthless! All of you are utterly worthless!" Tom shouted in anger.
"Dad, this Connor's background isn't simple. Even if I could stop him, I wouldn't dare to," Jules said through gritted teeth.
"Connor's background is not simple? Who is he?" Tom asked, his brows furrowing.
"He is Connor, the rich heir of Porthampton. Even people like Thomas and Kyle are under his command. We really can't afford to offend him," Jules answered helplessly.
"What?"
Upon hearing this, everyone was stunned, and Tom's expression was incredulous.
He walked up to Jules, lowered his voice, and asked, "Did you just say this Connor is rich heir of Porthampton?"
"Yes, that's right. Even the influential figures like Thomas and Kyle are under his command. We really can't easily provoke him," Jules explained.
"He's the rich heir of Porthampton?" The crowd was in deep shock.
"We didn't expect that Connor had such a powerful background!"
"Yes, we had no idea he was the young master of Porthampton!"
"No wonder he dared to be so arrogant!"
The crowd began whispering among themselves, having heard about Connor's reputation and how formidable he was. But they had never imagined that this legendary young master of Porthampton was the same young man brought by Freya.
None of them could have foreseen how events would unfold to this extent!

chapters.title: Chapter 1276: Getting Into Big Trouble
chapters.content:
Chapter 1276: Getting Into Big Trouble
After knowing this news, everyone's impression of Connor began to change.
After all, if the Washington family was not involved, it was normal for Connor to want to marry Freya; Mr. McDonald of Porthampton was also very powerful and definitely worthy of Freya.
At this moment, an old man suddenly spoke. "No wonder Freya was so bold. She actually dared to bring that boy to our Yearwood family. So this boy is actually Porthampton's Mr. McDonald. Now I finally understand what's going on. Porthampton's Mr. McDonald is still very capable…"
"That's right. If this kid is really Mr. McDonald of Porthampton, then we really have to consider this carefully..."
The others quickly followed suit.
At this moment, a thin old man said calmly, "I think Mr. McDonald Porthampton is also worthy of our Yearwood family!"
Tom's expression was a little strange after hearing the old man's words. He frowned and asked, "I think that's a stretch. So what if Connor is Mr. McDonald of Porthampton?"
"Don't tell me you think Connor isn't worthy of our Yearwood family?" the old man asked.
"Now is not the time to discuss whether or not Connor is worthy of our Yearwood family. Don't forget that the Washington family is an ancient martial arts aristocratic family. Connor is nothing when compared to them. Moreover, his style of doing things is really too arrogant. If we marry Freya to him, I'm afraid it will cause big trouble for our Yearwood family in the future…"
Tom had a very good relationship with the Washington family, so he was speaking up for the Washington family, worried that the Yearwood family would suddenly change their mind.
When the old man who had spoken earlier heard this, he looked a little helpless and lowered his head without saying anything.
The old man had a good relationship with Camila's father. However, the old man's status in the Yearwood family was relatively low, so he didn't have any right to speak. Therefore, he didn't dare to say anything after hearing Tom's words. He could only shut his mouth obediently.
In the Yearwood family, it wasn't that the older one was, the higher the status. It was that the more one contributed, the higher of a status they would be at..
Tom controlled a lot of the Yearwood family's businesses, and his position was second only to the family head. The old man didn't contribute much to the Yearwood family, so even if Tom scolded him, he didn't dare to refute.
"I think Tom is right. Although Connor has some background and Mr. McDonald Porthampton is indeed very powerful, no matter what, he's still a little weaker than the Washington family..."
Everyone also began to take advantage of the situation.
"That's right. Moreover, Connor even beat Wilbur up to such a state. The Landon family will definitely not let this matter rest. If we get too close to Connor, we might even be implicated…"
"At that time, it would really be a loss to offend the Landon, Washington, and the Hons families because Connor. We should still side with the Washington family and the Landon family. I think this is the right choice…"
Everyone chimed in.
Tom nodded slightly, showing his satisfaction.
In the eyes of these people, no matter how powerful Connor was, he was still just one person. He still had no way to compete with the Washington, Landon, and Hons families.
Camila sat there without saying a word.
In fact, she was also very surprised. She did not expect Connor to do such a thing.
However, this was not what she cared about. What she really cared about was whether this matter would bring her some trouble. If it didn't bring her any trouble and she could take this opportunity to get rid of Connor, it would be a good thing.
"Alright, it's useless for us to discuss this now. Let's wait for the family head to come over and see what his opinion is!" Tom suddenly said.
At this time, Grayson had just entered the conference room.
After seeing Grayson, everyone seemed to have found their backbone and began to ask him for his opinion.
Grayson didn't say a word from the beginning to the end. No one knew what he was thinking at this time.
After Grayson sat down, Tom asked, "Patriarch, how do you think this matter should be handled?"
Grayson hesitated for a moment, then slowly turned his head to look at Jules's position. He said to Jules expressionlessly, "Tell me everything that happened today from the beginning to the end. There's no need to mix in your emotions. Just tell me what happened, understand?"
Jules did not dare to speak nonsense after hearing Grayson's words. He quickly told him everything that happened today from beginning to end.
Although Grayson reminded Jules not to bring his own emotions, in fact, Jules's words were more inclined to Will's side.
After all, his father, Tom, was on Will's side. He would definitely support his father.
After Jules narrated the whole incident, everyone felt that Connor's character was a bit too arrogant.
Actually, Wilbur had not done anything too overboard, but Connor had actually beaten him to such a state.
Moreover, Jules also recounted everything that Connor had said in detail. After listening to it, everyone became even angrier.
"Connor is too arrogant. He obviously doesn't think highly of our Yearwood family at all. He's just the boss of Porthampton now, and he doesn't have any big skills. If this kid is given a few more years, I guess he'll be looking forward to bullying us!"
An old man shouted angrily.
"That's right, Connor is too arrogant! How could there be such an arrogant person? I really don't know what he's thinking…"
Everyone began to discuss in low voices.
However, at this moment, Grayson suddenly looked up at Jules and asked him expressionlessly, "The Ted you mentioned just now should be Marshal Hons's son, right?"
"That's right, it's him…" Jules hurriedly nodded.
After Grayson heard this, he couldn't help but gasp, "This Hons family is not an ordinary family either; their power in the military is still very terrifying. Moreover, I heard that the Hons family and the Washington family have a very good relationship. Connor himself has offended the Landon family. This kid is in big trouble…"

chapters.title: Chapter 1277: Revenge
chapters.content:
Chapter 1277: Revenge
"Connor doesn't even care about these three families and our Yearwood family. Connor is too arrogant. Does he think that he can do whatever he wants just because he is the Mr. of Davenport?"
An old man could not help but shout coldly.
"I think since Connor dares to be so arrogant, he should have some trump card that he hasn't shown yet!"
At this moment, another person said in a low voice.
"What trump card could Connor have?"
Tom sneered and continued, "Even if Connor really has a trump card, it's useless now. I don't believe that he can deal with these three big families by himself!"
After hesitating for a few seconds, Grayson said, "Connor's style of doing things is indeed very arrogant, but I think that since he dares to be so arrogant, he should have the capital to be arrogant. Moreover, Connor has never had any direct conflict with our family. I think it's better to do this. If the Washington family, Landon family, and Hons family want to take revenge on Connor, our Yearwood family can ignore it and maintain a neutral attitude. In this way, no matter who wins in the end, it has nothing to do with us. If the Yearwood family were to participate in this matter, I think it would only make things more troublesome. No matter which side we offend, it would have a huge impact on us, so it's best for us to remain neutral…"
After everyone heard Grayson's words, they were all stunned, and the expressions on their faces was somewhat puzzled. They originally thought that Grayson would support the Washington family, but no one expected him to choose a neutral stance in the end.
However, such a neutral attitude was already very biased towards Connor's side. After all, if Grayson also stood on the side of the Washington family, then Connor would definitely die this time. However, Grayson did not choose to add insult to injury.
No one knew what Grayson was thinking, but he had already spoken, so they did not dare to say anything more. They could only nod helplessly in agreement.
Soon after, the Yearwood family left.
Tom went up to Grayson's side and asked, "Father, what are your plans?"
"Didn't I already say it just now? If we don't help anyone, it's none of our business!" Grayson replied lightly.
"But Connor is no match for these three big families. Why don't we take this opportunity to get on their good side?" Tom asked in confusion.
"Our Yearwood family has already reached a point where we can't move forward, so I don't want to take this risk. For now it seems that Connor will definitely lose, but in fact, I think that he likely still has something up his sleeve, otherwise he wouldn't be so arrogant. If these three big families lose to Connor, then our Yearwood family will also suffer," Grayson said expressionlessly.
Tom was very puzzled. He couldn't help but frown and say, "Dad, don't flatter Connor. What does Connor have to win?"
"In this world, there are two sides to everything. If Connor doesn't have the intention of winning, why would he come here? To die? The fact that he can have such achievements today shows that he isn't a fool, so just do as I say!" Grayson said to Tom.
"But…"
Tom looked at Grayson with a hint of excitement in his eyes. He opened his mouth and was about to speak, but Grayson had no intention of continuing the conversation as he simply walked away.
Tom just stood there, not knowing what to do.
…
At the same time, the incident that happened in the hotel had already spread throughout Santon.
Every member of the upper class in Santon had already heard about this matter.
After all, Wilbur had been carried out in a terrible state just now. Wilbur was very well-known, so many people knew about this.
Now, the entire upper class of Santon was very interested in Mr. McDonald of Porthampton. They really couldn't think of what kind of person could do such a thing.
Meanwhile, Wilbur had been sent to the best hospital in Santon by Will. After a series of examinations, the doctor had no choice but to announce that there was no way to treat him, so he had to transfer Wilbur to another hospital.
This was because their hospital's medical standards were simply unable to treat him.
In fact, this sentence was basically equivalent to a death sentence for Wilbur.
This hospital in Santon was very famous. If this hospital couldn't do anything about it, then they could only go abroad to try, but it wouldn't have a very good prognosis, either.
After all, Connor was too ruthless to break Wilbur's legs like that. There was no hope of recovery now.
When the Landon family heard the news, they rushed to Santon as soon as possible. They even said that they would kill Connor at all costs to avenge their son.
When this news spread, the entire Santon was in a state of shock.
Everyone was curious about what would happen next. After all, one was a very famous family in Beverly Hills, and the other was the Mr. McDonald of Porthampton City, who had just showed up at the scene. If the two really fought, it would definitely be very interesting.
The people in Zalfari were just waiting to watch the show.
In the hospital.
Wilbur's father, Niles Landon, looked at Wilbur in the ICU with a grave expression. At this moment, Wilbur's parents and relatives had all arrived, and Wilbur's mother was already sobbing. She really could not understand who her son had offended for him to get beaten up like this.
"Niles, hurry up and think of something…"
Wilbur's mother said as she sobbed.
Niles took a deep breath and said in a low voice, "What do you want me to do now? I've already contacted a doctor overseas, but the earliest we can do is tomorrow. We can't leave now…"
"Oh God, why are you doing this to us? What sin have we committed?"
Wilbur's mother burst into tears, her expression unusually pained.
Niles frowned and scolded, "Alright, things have already come to this. What's the use of crying now?"
At this moment, the doctor walked out of the intensive care unit.

chapters.title: Chapter 1278: I Won't Help Either Side
chapters.content:
Chapter 1278: I Won't Help Either Side
Niles hurried over and asked the doctor excitedly, "Doctor, how is my son now?"
When the doctor heard this, he shook his head helplessly and said, "Mister Landon, I'm really sorry, but we can't do anything. The other party was too ruthless. Mr. Landon's bones have all been shattered. There's almost no possibility of recovery now…"
"No possibility of recovery…What does that mean?" Niles asked nervously.
The doctor sighed helplessly and said in a low voice, "Mr. Landon will probably be confined to the bed in the future. Because both his legs and arms have been broken, he can't even sit in a wheelchair…"
After hearing this, Niles froze on the spot. He felt as if his vision had turned dark. He could not accept this outcome.
Wilbur's mother fainted on the spot.
The doctor looked at Niles and continued, "Mr. Landon, don't give up yet. If the conditions are favorable, you can also bring Mr. Landon overseas to some specialized doctors. However, I don't think there's much hope. Unless medical technology becomes more advanced in a few years, there might still be some hope. Now, the hope is very slim…"
Niles frowned, then gritted his teeth and said, "Doctor, I understand…"
The doctor looked at Niles and nodded slightly before turning and leaving.
Niles looked at the doctor's back with an unusually angry expression. "How can Connor be so ruthless? What deep hatred does my son have with him?"
After hesitating for a moment, Will walked to Niles's side and said in a low voice, "Uncle Niles, actually, I was also present at the time. I didn't stop Connor. I was also responsible for Wilbur becoming like this. Therefore, no matter what you want to do, our Washington family will not stand idly by. I want to help Wilbur take revenge…"
"Will, I'm already very satisfied that you're telling me this after sending my son to the hospital. However, this has nothing to do with you. That Connor was too arrogant. He doesn't even care about the Landon family…" Niles said through gritted teeth.
"That's right. I also reminded Connor of the consequences at that time, but he did not take my words seriously at all…" Will said, putting on an air of helplessness.
"Hmm…"
Niles took a deep breath and said in a low voice, "Our Landon family only has Wilbur as the sole heir. To think that Connor actually beat him into a cripple... No matter what, I will kill him personally and avenge my son…"
Will quickly took this opportunity to say, "Uncle Niles, don't worry. I've already contacted my family. Our family will send some martial artists over soon. If you need my help, just call me…"
"Your Washington family has already sent some martial artists over?"
Niles was shocked when he heard this.
"That's right, not only did Connor break Wilbur's legs, but he also provoked our Washington family over and over again, so we don't plan on letting him go. We've already sent a Mystic-rank over…" Will hurriedly said.
"Then I can rest assured. I must tear Connor into pieces, or else the hatred in my heart will never be resolved!" Niles said in a low voice.
"Uncle Niles, if there's nothing else, I'll take my leave first!" Will said.
Niles nodded. "Alright, you go first!"
Will hesitated for a moment before turning around and leaving.
He returned to his car. After he got in, the driver turned his head to look at Will, then asked, "Mr. Washington, where are we going now?"
"How's Ted doing?" Will asked in a low voice as he fiddled with his phone.
"Mr. Hons doesn't have any serious injuries now. He left after a simple checkup at the hospital. He also told me that Connor isn't a simple person and told you to be careful…" the driver replied.
"Connor is indeed not an ordinary person, but so what?" Will sneered and continued, "Connor has offended too many people this time. Even if I don't do anything, won't the Landon family do anything? Connor doesn't think highly of us at all. He will pay the price for his arrogance!"
"Yeah, the Landon family will definitely not let Connor off!" The driver nodded gently.
"By the way, what's the situation with Bailey?" Will asked again.
"This…"
The driver looked hesitant.
Will noticed his heitation, and his expression became a little angry. He frowned and said, "Don't hesitate here. If you have something to say, just say it directly…"
"Alright…" The driver nodded and said in a low voice, "After we left the restaurant, Miss Banks also left, but I think she doesn't really want to participate in this matter. She didn't even go to the hospital to see Mr. Landon..."
"What is Bailey doing?" When Will heard this, a trace of anger flashed across his eyes. Then, he took out his phone and dialed Bailey's number.
The driver looked at Will helplessly and did not say anything.
"Ding, ding, ding…"
After the phone rang a few times, Bailey finally picked up the phone and asked, "Mr. Washington, is there something you need?"
"Bailey, what do you mean by this?" Will asked directly.
"What do I mean?" When Bailey heard this, she couldn't help but be stunned for a moment. Then, she said in a playful tone, "Mr. Washington, what are you talking about?"
Will frowned and said in a low voice, "Let me ask you, what do you think about Connor's matter? Connor beat Wilbur up to this state. You're not planning to stand by and watch, are you?"
"This is a matter between Connor and the Landon family. It doesn't seem to have anything to do with me!" Bailey replied with a smile.
"You..."
Will was speechless when he heard Bailey's words.
"Mr. Washington, I know that you have a conflict with Connor. I also know that the Landon family and the Hons family have been used by you. However, just because they are stupid doesn't mean that I am also stupid. There doesn't seem to be any deep hatred between Mr. McDonald and me. If I were to get involved with the entire Banks family just because of this, it would really not be worth it. Therefore, I plan to just watch the show tomorrow. I won't help either side..."
Bailey continued.

chapters.title: Chapter 1279: Home Ground Power
chapters.content:
Chapter 1279: Home Ground Power
When Will heard what Bailey said, he was extremely angry.
However, at this moment, he could not find any reason for Bailey to help him.
"You said it yourself. You won't help either side, right?"
Will asked softly.
"That's right!"
Bailey nodded gently.
"I hope that you can keep your word…"
Will replied expressionlessly.
"Don't worry, I'll definitely do what I say!"
Bailey smiled faintly and hung up the phone.
Will let out a sigh of relief when he heard the beeping sound on the other end of the phone.
Although Bailey did not choose to stand on Will's side, this was already the best outcome for Will. After all, as long as Bailey did not interfere and ruin things for him, it was good enough for him.
"I thought that Connor was just an ordinary person. I didn't expect him to cause so much trouble. But this is good. I can take advantage of the birthday banquet to get rid of this big problem. Otherwise, when Connor grows even stronger in the future, I'm afraid it will be even more troublesome!"
Will looked at his phone and couldn't help but mutter.
At this moment, the driver turned to look at Will and asked Will softly, "Mr. Will, is Freya Phillips really that important to you?"
"Freya isn't important, of course. What I really value is the Yearwood Family's assets. I plan to use her to control all of the Yearwood Family's assets. Freya is just a woman; why would I waste so much energy on a woman?"
Will said calmly.
When the driver heard this, he couldn't help but frown and didn't say anything else.
...
The night passed quickly.
Initially, Grayson Yearwood's birthday banquet was very grand. Many famous Oprana figures were invited to attend, and then there was the matter between Connor and Wilbur Landon. This caused even more people to be curious about the final outcome of this birthday banquet.
Now, what everyone really cared about was not Grayson's birthday banquet, but the legendary battle between Mr. McDonald of Porthampton and Washington Family, Hons Family, and Landon family.
Of course, most people were still optimistic about the three families.
After all, these three families were extremely powerful in three different fields, and Connor was just a single person.
Even if Porthampton's Mr. McDonald was very famous in Porthampton, this was Santon.
After all, even one who was powerful could not suppress powerful entities in their home ground.
Therefore, everyone felt that Connor was doomed this time. If Connor was really smart enough, he should hurry up and leave Santon.
However, Connor had no intention of leaving at all.
If Connor had really planned to leave, he would not have come to Santon back then, and he would definitely not have attacked Wilbur.
The reason why Connor came today was to deal with everything.
Although the Yearwood Family was famous for their ancient martial arts, the financial resources controlled by the Yearwood Family were still very shocking. The number of companies under the Yearwood Family was also very terrifying. However, because the Yearwood Family was relatively low-key, there were not many people who really knew the Yearwood Family.
However, even though ordinary people didn't know the Yearwood Family, but the real upper-class people knew it very well.
This time, Mr. Yearwood Sr. was holding a banquet in the Yearwood Family manor, and nearly a thousand people came to attend the birthday banquet.
Just from this point alone, one could see how terrifying the Yearwood Family's strength was.
Although the Yearwood Family was well prepared, because of the limited space, there was no way to receive so many guests at the same time. This led to many guests entering the manor to present gifts and then leaving after meeting with him. Those who could really stay for dinner were the real big shots.
When Connor and Freya arrived at the Yearwood Family Manor, they found that the road in front of the Yearwood Family manor had been blocked. All kinds of luxury cars came and went. Any car could be a big boss with a net worth of more than 100 million.
Connor also saw many cars with special license plates among these cars. He couldn't help but lament that Grayson's network was indeed very wide.
When Connor and Freya appeared, many people turned their attention to Connor.
"This kid is Mr. McDonald from Porthampton?"
" It doesn't look like it! He should be Freya's driver!"
"Yeah, he looks quite ordinary. He doesn't look like Mr. McDonald from Porthampton at all..."
Everyone had heard a lot about Connor, so when they saw Connor, they felt that there was a huge difference between Connor and the legendary Mr. McDonald of Porthampton.
Connor didn't care about what others were talking about. He brought Freya directly to the entrance of the manor.
However, just as Freya was about to enter the manor, she suddenly stopped and looked at Connor. "Connor, are you sure about this?"
"Of course!"
Connor looked at Freya and nodded lightly.
"But I'm still very worried. These people are all waiting to deal with you now. Why don't we forget about it? Let's not go in and go back to Porthampton, okay?"
Freya said nervously to Connor.
Freya had not slept the entire night last night because she felt that what was going to happen today was really terrifying. If Connor entered this manor, it would basically be no different from sending himself to his death.
Although Freya had regained her memories, she did not know much about Connor's strength. She felt that even if Connor inherited a large amount of inheritance, so what?
The people on the other side were large families like the Washington Family, the Hons Family, and the Landon Family.
Even in the entire Oprana, there were not many people who dared to go against them!
"Don't worry. These people won't dare to do anything to me…"
Connor whispered to Freya.
"Sigh…"
Freya's eyes flashed with worry.
"What's wrong?"
Connor asked in confusion.
"Camila called me yesterday. She told me that you've narrowly escaped this time. Moreover, the Landon Family has made up their mind to avenge Wilbur. Even the Washington Family has invited an ancient martial arts master over. The Yearwood Family won't help anyone. If you go in now, you will definitely die. Camila told me to stay away from you…"
Freya hurriedly said to Connor.

chapters.title: Chapter 1280: I Believe You!
chapters.content:
Chapter 1280: I Believe You!
When Connor heard Freya's words, he could not help but laugh. Then, he said softly, "Since Camila Yearwood told you to stay away from me, why didn't you leave me?"
"I won't leave you. I want to always be by your side!"
Freya hurriedly said to Connor.
When Connor heard Freya's words, he couldn't help but smile. He then said softly, "You have to know that the current me is no longer the same as before. I will protect you. With me around, no one will hurt you…"
"I know that you have inherited the inheritance and are very rich, but I don't think there's a need for us to fight head-on with these people. We can return to Porthampton first and wait for the right time to make a move…"
Freya said to Connor with a worried expression.
"..."
When Connor saw how worried Freya was about him, he was somewhat touched. He reached out and pulled her into his arms, saying softly, "Freya, don't worry. I have my own plans. No matter who the other party is today, there is no way to stop the two of us from being together!"
When Freya heard Connor's words, she could not help but be stunned. Then, she slowly raised her head and looked at Connor, her eyes filled with gratitude.
At this moment, Freya knew very well that Connor was doing all this for her.
After hearing Connor's words, Freya felt extremely touched.
She knew in her heart that Connor did all this because of her.
Connor was willing to risk his life to come to the Yearwood Family manor just to get rid of the Yearwood Family.
Therefore, she could not find any reason to stop Connor from entering the manor.
"Alright, since you wish to enter, I will accompany you in…"
Freya said firmly to Connor.
"Don't worry, nothing will happen to the two of us. The Yearwood Family definitely won't dare to do anything to the two of us…"
Connor naturally knew what Freya was worried about, so he turned and comforted her.
"I believe you!"
Freya nodded seriously.
"What are you two still standing here for? Are you afraid to go in?"
At this moment, a woman's voice sounded from behind them.
Connor subconsciously looked back and realized that the person who spoke was none other than Canela Yearwood.
Connor had met Canela before, so he didn't have a good impression of her.
When Canela heard that Connor had broken both of Wilbur's legs, she was also very surprised. How could she have imagined that the seemingly submissive Connor would have such a bad temper? He had broken both of Wilbur's legs at one go.
However, Canela was still very happy because she knew that the bigger the matter was, the more Camila would not be able to end it. This was what she really wanted to see.
"Since you don't have the guts, you should quickly leave. I heard that the Landon Family is planning to deal with you…"
Seeing that Connor didn't say anything, Canela continued to speak sarcastically.
Connor looked at Canela coldly and said expressionlessly, "I advise you to shut your mouth. Otherwise, I will make you regret it for the rest of your life…"
When Canela heard this, fear flashed across her eyes.
This was because she knew that since Connor had said this, he would really dare to do so. After all, Connor dared to even beat up someone like Wilbur.
"Tsk…"
Canela glared fiercely at Connor, then didn't say anything else and walked into the manor.
After entering the manor, Canela turned to look at Connor, then cursed in her heart, "Go on and be arrogant. You'll suffer in a while…"
Connor held Freya's hand and followed her into the manor.
Jules Yearwood was currently standing at the door to receive the guests.
When Jules saw Connor, the expression on his face also changed slightly, but now he no longer dared to provoke Connor, because he knew Connor's background.
Even if Connor might not be a match for the three families today, he would not be stupid enough to offend Connor now.
Moreover, Grayson had already given the order that the Yearwood Family could not interfere in the matters between Connor and the three families. They could just watch the show quietly. In this way, no matter who won in the end, it would not have any impact on the Yearwood Family.
"Mr. McDonald and Miss Phillips, you're here."
At this time, Jules's attitude toward Connor had a 360-degree change. He took the initiative to step forward and asked with a smile.
After hearing Jules's words, Connor seemed a little surprised, because he didn't expect Jules's attitude to change so much.
"Mr. McDonald, Miss Phillips, please come in…"
Jules didn't care about Connor's attitude and spoke again.
"Alright!"
Connor nodded lightly.
Jules hurriedly brought Connor and Freya into the manor. As they were walking, he said to Connor, "Mr. McDonald, I'm sorry for not realizing who you were. I didn't recognize you and have offended you. I hope you can forgive me…"
Connor glanced at Jules indifferently and couldn't help but sigh to himself. Jules really was a fickle one. Before he knew his identity, he looked down on him in every possible way. Now that he knew his identity, it was as if he had changed into a different person.
"You're not worthy of my time!"
Connor said expressionlessly.
"..."
When Jules heard Connor's words, a trace of anger flashed in his eyes, because he didn't expect Connor to be so arrogant.
However, after hesitating for a moment, he still did not say anything.
Because he didn't want to offend Connor. He knew that someone would come to deal with Connor today.
Connor didn't have the intention to argue with Jules.
After all, in Connor's eyes, Jules was just a small character. There was no need to waste too much time on this kind of person.
"Mr. Connor McDonald of Porthampton and Miss Freya Phillips have arrived!"
Jules brought Connor and Freya into the manor and announced.
However, after he announced this, the guests in the manor instantly turned their gazes to Connor and Freya.
It was as if at this moment, Connor had become the focus of everyone's attention.
Among these people's gazes, some were filled with curiosity, and some were puzzled. However, most of them were feeling smug.
Because they were all here to watch the show today.

chapters.title: Chapter 1281: Puppet
chapters.content:
Chapter 1281: Puppet
Previously, not many people in Santon knew about Connor's matter. Only some really big shots had heard about it.
However, after Connor broke Wilbur's legs yesterday, Connor's name had spread throughout the entire Santon.
Whether it was the commoners or the upper-class people in Santon, they had already heard about this matter, so they were naturally very curious about Connor. They could not understand what kind of person he was to be so vicious and break the legs of the young master of the Landon Family in Beverly Hills.
Connor's style of doing things was way too arrogant, which also caused these people to be more curious about Connor's appearance.
However, when these people saw Connor, they were in disbelief.
"Is this person the legendary Mr. McDonald from Porthampton?"
"Really?"
"Why does this person look so ordinary?"
"Yeah, he looks no different from a university student. Is this person really Mr. McDonald?"
"I heard that this Mr. McDonald is an existence that has shaken the four provinces."
"I don't think that's possible. Perhaps this person is the scapegoat that Mr. McDonald found. After all, Mr. McDonald has gotten into big trouble this time, so I'm sure he doesn't dare to come personally. He's just randomly found someone to be the scapegoat…"
Connor had done a great deal of things, which also led to him being a decisive and charismatic big shot in the hearts of many people.
However, Connor's image was very different from the image of Mr. McDonald.
However, there were also many discussions about Connor's identity. Some people felt that Connor was definitely a young master born in a big family, while others felt that there must be someone else behind Connor. There were all kinds of rumors, but none of them were completely convincing.
"I heard that this Mr. McDonald is really something. Even people like Thomas Morgan and Kyle Hayes from Porthampton are his subordinates. They are already very famous in Oprana. To be able to make these big shots willing to be his subordinate, he must not be simple…"
An old man said softly,
"To be able to make Thomas Morgan and Kyle Hayes work so hard for him at such a young age, he must have some ability!"
Everyone hurriedly followed up.
"What do you know? I heard that this Mr. McDonald is just a puppet…"
At this moment, a voice interrupted everyone's discussion.
When everyone heard this, they turned to look at the middle-aged man.
"Mr. Sabin, what do you mean?"
"You should all know that Mr. McDonald is only in his twenties, right?"
The middle-aged man asked everyone expressionlessly.
"I've heard of him. Mr. McDonald from Porthampton doesn't seem to be very old…"
Everyone hurriedly nodded.
"Mr. McDonald is only in his early twenties. How capable can he be? Even a rich second-generation heir from a big family wouldn't have such capabilities. There must be someone else controlling Mr. McDonald behind him!"
The middle-aged man said confidently.
The middle-aged man was called Leonardo Sabin. The Leonardo Family was mainly in the business field, so he had a lot of connections and knew more than ordinary people.
"Mr. Sabin, you can't say such things casually. If you offend Mr. McDonald, you'll be in big trouble…"
A middle-aged man said to Leonardo with a smile.
Leonardo smiled and said, "If I didn't understand what's going on, would I have said anything? It's not like I want to die. According to the information I have, this Connor is actually a puppet on the surface, and there is a very powerful big shot behind him. This big shot is the boss of Thomas Morgan and Kyle Hayes…"
"Then, why would this big shot do this?"
Everyone asked in confusion.
"The reason is very simple. Because this big shot has a special identity, he can't show himself in person, so he found someone to replace him in public. To put it simply, there is such a person called Mr. McDonald, but it's definitely not the kid we're seeing now."
Leonardo answered directly.
Everyone nodded after hearing Leonardo's words.
Because they felt that Leonardo was very trustworthy.
If they were asked to believe that Connor was the real Mr. McDonald of Porthampton, it was rather impossible for them to accept it. However, Leonardo's explanation made sense.
"Then, was the conflict between this kid and Wilbur also Mr. McDonald's intention?"
Everyone hurriedly continued to ask.
"This matter shouldn't have anything to do with Mr. McDonald. This kid is young and arrogant, and he relied on Mr. McDonald to beat Wilbur up. Now, Mr. McDonald must have abandoned this kid!"
Leonardo analyzed.
"I see…"
Everyone sighed.
Originally, they thought that they would be able to see the battle between Mr. McDonald of Porthampton and the three big families. However, they did not expect Connor to actually be just a puppet, so they were not so curious about what was going to happen next.
After all, the three families only wanted to deal with an ordinary person. There was nothing to see.
Just as everyone was discussing this matter, Connor had already followed Freya to the Yearwood Family's main hall.
Today, Grayson Yearwood was wearing a black suit, and he sat in the middle of the hall, while the elders of the Yearwood Family sat below.
Perhaps because of Connor, Camila Yearwood was also in the lobby. However, if it was before, Camila would not be qualified to appear in this place.
Meanwhile, Leona Yearwood of the Yearwood Family had been standing quietly behind Grayson.
Leona's appearance was very delicate. She was wearing a long white dress, and her sexy figure was particularly attractive under the long dress.
When she knew that Connor was here, she had been staring at the door. She wanted to see who this Connor was.
However, when Leona saw Connor, a trace of disappointment flashed in her eyes.
This was because she felt that this so-called Mr. McDonald from Porthampton was too ordinary. There was still a huge gap between him and the Mr. McDonald from Porthampton that she had imagined.
In Leona's impression, Connor's appearance and temperament were not even as good as Will Washington's.
Leona had always been a girl with high standards. Even Will was not up to her standards, let alone Connor.

chapters.title: Chapter 1282: Not Worthy of the Yearwood Family
chapters.content:
Chapter 1282: Not Worthy of the Yearwood Family
After Freya entered the hall, she swept her gaze across the people present; she was a little nervous.
"Freya, hurry up and wish Grandpa Grayson happy birthday!"
Camila said anxiously to Freya.
"..."
Freya was stunned for a moment before she said indifferently, "Happy birthday Mr. Yearwood Sr.. May you live long and prosper."
It was obvious that Freya was very perfunctory.
Moreover, Freya had addressed Grayson as Mr. Yearwood Sr.. This meant that Freya did not see herself as a member of the Yearwood Family at all.
When the Yearwood Family heard Freya's words, their faces darkened.
"This is the first time I'm meeting you. It's normal for you to be a little nervous. Come over here and let me take a good look at you…"
Grayson was still being nice to Freya. He didn't feel angry at her perfunctory greeting at all. On the contrary, he was very amiable.
After all, if Freya really married Will in the future, then she would be considered a true member of the Yearwood Family. Moreover, she might even inherit the Yearwood Family's assets, so he naturally wouldn't make things too difficult for her.
After hearing Grayson's words, Freya did not go over. Instead, she turned and looked at Connor.
Grayson also looked at Connor and asked Freya expressionlessly, "Freya, who is this person beside you?"
When Freya heard this, she became a little nervous.
She couldn't help but frown. Then, she said to everyone expressionlessly, "This person is Connor. He is my fiancé…"
When Freya finished her sentence, everyone present was stunned. They were extremely shocked.
The bustling hall instantly quieted down.
Everyone turned their gazes to Connor. Even the guests outside were paying attention to the situation in the hall because they knew that the real show was about to begin.
Grayson took a deep breath, and he seemed a little unhappy. He said softly, "Freya, from what I remember, you aren't engaged, right? You can't casually use the term fiancé!"
"I'm engaged with Connor. He is my fiancé!"
Freya said to Grayson expressionlessly.
Grayson was somewhat helpless. He didn't know what to say.
Tom Yearwood hurriedly said to Freya, "Freya, what do you mean by that? When did you get engaged to this person? Some words are not something you can casually say!"
"I don't know you. So, it's not weird that you don't know I'm engaged."
Freya replied to Tom.
"Did the Yearwood Family approve of your engagement with this person? Did you get your mother's permission?"
Tom asked loudly.
"My mother is Laura Crawford, and my father is Sean Phillips. The two of them have already agreed to this marriage!"
Freya said calmly.
"What nonsense. Your mother is Camila Yearwood. Today is Mr. Yearwood Sr.'s birthday banquet. I don't want to see any unpleasant things happen, so chase this person out. Not everyone can attend the Yearwood Family's birthday banquet…"
When Freya heard this, she became a little angry, and she was about to speak.
However, Connor walked up to Freya and said calmly to Tom, "I think you might have misunderstood something…"
"What do you mean?"
Tom looked Connor up and down and asked with a frown.
"I didn't come here today to attend the birthday banquet but to inform everyone in the Yearwood Family that from now on, Freya has nothing to do with the Yearwood Family. No matter who she wants to marry, it's her freedom to do so. It's not up to you to decide. I hope that you won't disturb her anymore. Otherwise, don't blame me for being rude…"
Connor said calmly to Tom.
When everyone heard Connor's words, they were all stunned. They were extremely shocked. No one had expected Connor to be so direct.
Moreover, they could hear that Connor was obviously threatening the Yearwood Family.
Previously, the matter of Connor offending the three big families was already inconceivable.
However, they never thought that Connor would still dare to threaten the Yearwood Family.
Was Connor really not worried that the Yearwood Family and the three big families would join hands to deal with him?
"Where did this Connor get his confidence from?"
"That's right. He has clearly offended the three big families. Now, he should take the opportunity to curry favor with the Yearwood Family. I really don't know what he is thinking…"
"He might be a lunatic…"
Tom was also trembling with anger at Connor's words. He glared at Connor with an extremely angry expression.
After all, Tom had a very high status in the Yearwood Family, second only to the family head, Grayson.
No one had ever dared to talk to him like this, but Connor had contradicted him, making Tom feel very embarrassed.
Moreover, there were so many people watching!
"Brat, what do you mean?"
Tom gritted his teeth and shouted at Connor.
Connor sneered and said expressionlessly, "Don't you know what I mean? I have already made myself very clear just now. If you didn't hear me clearly, then it's a problem with your intelligence. I can't be bothered to talk nonsense with someone like you…"
Tom stared at Connor with a foul expression. He realized that Connor didn't seem to take him seriously at all. He spoke very frankly and didn't give him any face.
"No wonder this Connor dared to break Wilbur Landon's legs. He's really arrogant!"
Leona looked at Connor and couldn't help but sigh in her heart.
At this moment, Leona felt that Connor was quite interesting.
Tom took a deep breath. He knew that this was the birthday banquet of the Yearwood Family. If he was angry, it would only make him more embarrassed.
Thus, he turned to look at Freya and shouted, "Freya, is this really your fiancé? You've chosen such a fiancé? This person simply has no respect for his elders and has no manners. This kind of person is simply not worthy of the Yearwood Family…"

chapters.title: Chapter 1283: The Yearwood Family's Purpose
chapters.content:
Chapter 1283: The Yearwood Family's Purpose
Freya hurriedly turned her head to look at Connor, signaling him not to continue speaking.
After all, the Yearwood family had already made its stance clear regarding the matters between Connor and the three major families. They needed to maintain a neutral position.
But if Connor kept on going, he might anger the Yearwood family, leading them to join forces with the other three major families against him.
At that point, he might truly be left with no way out.
However, upon hearing Tom's words, Connor's expression became somewhat disdainful. He stepped forward, his face expressionless, and said, "What's so great about the Yearwood family? In my eyes, you are nothing..."
Tom's expression seemed even angrier after hearing this, and he shouted loudly at Connor, "How dare you insult our Yearwood family?"
"And what can you do about me insulting the Yearwood family?" Connor sneered, continuing, "You are merely a small Yearwood family, and you mean nothing in my eyes. What's the situation of your Yearwood family? Don't you know it yourselves? If it weren't for Grayson, the pinnacle-rank warrior, supporting your Yearwood family, you would have already become a second-rate small family long ago..."
"You..." Tom was left dumbfounded.
"In simpler terms, your Yearwood family's situation is bleak. Over the years, there has been no progress in martial arts among the descendants of the Yearwood family. Most of them are ordinary people, and you only have Grayson as a pinnacle-rank warrior. The reason why your Yearwood family holds its current position is due to the convenience brought by martial arts. However, once Grayson is no longer here, your Yearwood family will soon be assimilated by the other three major families. The truth is, your Yearwood family doesn't have any other foundation or background. That's your biggest, and most fatal, weakness. You rely too much on Grayson..."
Connor's expression remained cold and emotionless as he spoke.
The guests present were all surprised and had never expected Connor to speak like this.
"In fact, your Yearwood family has already realized this, which is why you have given up on martial arts and have been focusing on expanding your company's business in recent years. Your aim is to gain more influence in the business world. However, your Yearwood family entered this game too late and couldn't gain a foothold. Even if your Yearwood family has many companies, they are nothing more than superficial appearances. Once these companies lose Grayson's support, they can be easily swallowed by others..."
Connor paused for a moment and continued, "So, there's no need for your Yearwood family to act arrogantly in front of me. Compared to me, your Yearwood family is far, far inferior. Others might fear your Yearwood family, but in my eyes, your Yearwood family means nothing..."
"You..." Tom stared at Connor, his eyes filled with shock.
"What are you talking about? Don't you think what I said is right?" Connor asked expressionlessly.
"These are just nonsense!" The elders of the Yearwood family shouted at Connor.
"Whether it's nonsense or not, you know it better than me..." Connor said calmly.
He had obtained all this information from Qin Lan, who was also a pinnacle-rank warrior.
Moreover, Qin Lan's background was quite formidable, making it easy for her to gather this information.
After hearing this information, Connor understood why Grayson was so eager to have Freya marry Will.
In reality, Grayson was well aware of the current situation of the Yearwood family.
The Yearwood family needed to find a true backer to stabilize their position and avoid being swallowed up by other families.
Everything the Yearwood family had now was because of Grayson's status as a pinnacle-rank warrior. In the future, they would also need another pinnacle-rank warrior to support the Yearwood family.
If Grayson couldn't find a suitable backer before he died, the Yearwood family would be at the mercy of other major families once he was gone.
Over the years, the Yearwood family had offended too many forces, but they hadn't acted against the Yearwood family only because they were afraid of Grayson. However, once Grayson was gone, the Yearwood family would lose its last layer of protection.
Freya was also shocked, looking at Connor with astonishment. She didn't understand why Connor would say such things.
"Shut up!" Tom's expression was furious as he shouted at Connor.
"This person is too much! Quickly get him out of here..." All the Yearwood family members present had extremely changed expressions upon hearing Connor's words. After all, Connor's words were humiliating the Yearwood family in front of so many guests, and they couldn't tolerate it, especially when those words were true.
Indeed, Connor's words struck the hearts of all the Yearwood family members present.
Yet Grayson remained quiet throughout the entire ordeal, sitting there silently.
However, he was also very shocked. He had always looked down on Connor, thinking that Connor's strength was merely due to inheriting a large fortune.
But he had never expected that Connor could see through the current situation of the Yearwood family so easily.
All this information was confidential to the Yearwood family, only accessible to the top echelon, and unknown to the common Yearwood family members.
Indeed, although the Yearwood family was a martial arts family, they hadn't focused on martial arts training over the years.
Hence, apart from himself, no other pinnacle-rank warriors had emerged.
For a martial arts family, if they didn't have strong martial artists to support them, no matter how well their businesses were doing or how much profit their companies made, it would all be in vain.
Once Grayson passed away, the Yearwood family would not be able to sustain such a large family. Their final outcome would undoubtedly be to be swallowed up by other major families.
This was why Grayson was so eager to have Freya marry Will. The Washington family, where Will was from, was a genuine martial arts family with many pinnacle-rank warriors.
If Freya married Will, at least it could ensure that the Yearwood family's businesses would not be swallowed up by other major families in the next few years.
This was the best solution Grayson could come up with for now.

chapters.title: Chapter 1284: The Landon Family Appears
chapters.content:
Chapter 1284: The Landon Family Appears
But even if Grayson knew that Connor's words made sense, he wouldn't stand up to help him speak.
Because he knew that if he spoke now, it would be tantamount to indirectly admitting that what Connor said was true, which would have a significant impact on the Yearwood family's status.
"Do you all want to drive me out of here so urgently? Do you think what I said is wrong?" Connor couldn't help but sneer at the Yearwood family members and said lightly.
...
"Or is it because I hit the nail on the head, and you're afraid I'll reveal more of Yearwood family's secrets?" Connor continued, looking at the crowd.
Grayson looked at Connor's position, his expression showing surprise and confusion. He only just realized that Connor was not as simple as he had imagined.
Freya looked at Connor nervously, unsure of what to do. While she wasn't afraid of the Yearwood family members and didn't want to have anything to do with them in the future, she felt that provoking the Yearwood family at this moment was not a wise choice. After all, Grayson was still present, and the Yearwood family's power was terrifying. If the Yearwood family also decided to deal with Connor, things would become even more complicated.
"Kid, whether you're right or wrong, it has nothing to do with our Yearwood family, and it won't affect us. I wanted to drive you out for your own good. But since you don't know how to appreciate it, then just wait here. The Landon family's people are coming soon, and I want to see how you'll deal with them!" Tom said to Connor.
Connor replied disdainfully, "To my eyes, the Landon family worth less than your Yearwood family!"
Tom laughed softly after hearing his response and said, "Kid, I hope you'll be as arrogant in front of the Landon family..."
After saying this, Tom stopped paying attention to Connor and started entertaining other guests.
Grayson looked at Connor's position, his expression showing surprise and puzzlement. He couldn't figure out where Connor's confidence came from and who had informed him about Yearwood family's secrets.
Grayson had a faint feeling that Connor wasn't as simple as he initially thought. After all, not just anyone could expose the Yearwood family's vulnerabilities like that.
Suddenly, a commotion was heard from outside.
Everyone turned their heads towards the entrance of the hall, where a large group of people was coming in. The one at the forefront had a strong presence, but his expression was unpleasant.
"Mr. Niles, you're here?" Tom greeted the middle-aged man with a smile as he approached.
"Mr. Tom, long time no see!" Niles replied indifferently, then walked up to Grayson and said softly, "Today, I specially brought you a gift and hope you'll accept it."
After saying this, Niles waved his hand, and a group of black-clad bodyguards carried in a pure gold statue into the hall.
Seeing the statue, the crowd gasped, their expressions filled with astonishment. Although these people were wealthy, they had never seen such a large pure gold statue before.
"Mr. Niles is so thoughtful..." Grayson smiled faintly and replied softly.
Niles took a deep breath and continued, "Mr. Tom, today is your birthday, and I wasn't planning to handle this matter today. But my son was disabled last night, and I can't bear it any longer. I hope you can give me some time to deal with my private affairs."
"I feel sorry for what happened to Mr. Wilbur. Mr. Niles, take your time," Grayson said, accepting Niles's request.
Yearwood family members had a better impression of the Landon family after hearing Niles's words. After all, he came to give face to Grayson even though he came with a grievance.
As for Connor, he stood quietly, knowing well that Niles was here for him.
Indeed, Niles, after getting Grayson's approval, walked towards Connor's position with a purposeful stride. He then looked Connor up and down, and with an expressionless face, asked, "You're Connor, right?"
"Yes, I'm Connor," Connor calmly nodded.
"Let me introduce myself. I'm Niles, the father of Wilbur," Niles paused for a moment, then gritted his teeth and continued, "Yesterday, you crippled my son, Wilbur. Is that true?"
"Yes!" Connor didn't beat around the bush and nodded again.
"Alright, now that you've admitted it, good!" A trace of killing intent flashed in Niles's eyes. He then looked at Connor and asked, "I can't understand. What deep hatred do you have with my son that made you go to such extremes? He's now a cripple, and his life will be spent lying there. What did my Landon family do to offend you? Tell me!"

chapters.title: Chapter 1285: You Don't Know Me, Do You?
chapters.content:
Chapter 1285: You Don't Know Me, Do You?
"The Landon family haven't offended me, but Wilbur did!"
Connor replied calmly and continued, "Wilbur schemed to frame me and deliberately provoked me, but he and his companions were no match for me. I ended up breaking his legs and arms. My actions were merely a lesson for Wilbur."
"A lesson for Wilbur?" Neils's expression seemed even angrier upon hearing this. He gritted his teeth and shouted, "Since when is it your place to teach a lesson to someone from our Landon family?"
"If your son couldn't teach him a lesson properly, then I can help with that. I consider this as giving your Landon family some face!" Connor said expressionlessly.
"Are you saying you've given our Landon family face?" Neils smiled helplessly, then gritted his teeth and said in a low voice, "You've given our Landon family face while turning my son into this state. If you didn't give us face, would you have killed my son?"
"If you understand it that way, then there's no problem!" Connor nodded directly.
Upon hearing his words, everyone present showed astonishment. They thought he was being too arrogant.
"How could Connor dare to say such things?"
"I don't understand what he's thinking!"
"I think Connor is truly insane, utterly insane..."
Nobody could comprehend why Connor would say such things, especially when he had already crippled Wilbur. He even claimed to have shown mercy and said he was ready to kill Wilbur.
Neils was at a loss for words after Connor's response. He wore an embarrassed expression, not knowing how to reply. He was aware of Connor's involvement in the incident where Connor killed Miaomin. Hence, he knew that dealing with Connor was not going to be easy.
The others present also shook their heads helplessly because Connor's actions were incomprehensible. Even with his background, they believed he shouldn't be so arrogant. After all, the Landon family wasn't someone to be trifled with, especially since they were one of the top ten families in the capital.
Furthermore, Wilbur's mother and grandfather were prominent figures. If they really decided to deal with Connor, they could employ various means and forces, leaving Connor no room to maneuver. Even if they didn't kill Connor, he would undoubtedly pay a hefty price.
Hence, the others couldn't understand Connor's approach. They believed they wouldn't have handled the situation in the same way.
"Do you really look down on our Landon family? Do you think we can't do anything to you?" Neils asked Connor expressionlessly.
"Yes, I do look down on your Landon family. I've never taken your Landon family seriously," Connor calmly nodded.
Neils took a deep breath and coldly said, "Alright, let me tell you, today, it's not just our Landon family coming after you. If you think our Landon family isn't enough, add them to the equation and see what you'll do!"
Before Neils could finish his statement, a large group of people marched into the hall.
At the forefront was a middle-aged man in a suit, exuding an imposing aura, clearly not an ordinary person.
Seeing this man, everyone present showed astonishment.
"Isn't that someone from the Jones family? Why are they here?" "Exactly, I never expected the Landon family to invite someone from the Jones family. Could there be some connection between them?" "It shouldn't be. I heard the Jones family and the Landon family have always been competitors. Maybe it's because Connor also offended the Jones family that they're here?"
People started to discuss, not knowing the purpose of the Jones family's arrival. The Jones family was not a small clan either; they were one of the top ten families in the capital.
Connor couldn't figure out why the Jones family was involved in this matter. However, with so many people already trying to deal with him today, he didn't really care if there was one more.
After entering the hall, Chase, the head of the Jones family, ignored Connor and walked directly to Grayson, offering a simple greeting.
Grayson looked at Chase, his expression showing confusion as he couldn't understand why the Jones family was here.
After greeting Grayson, Chase walked up to Connor. He appraised Connor before saying softly, "You probably don't know me, do you?"

chapters.title: Chapter 1286: The Price of Being Foolish
chapters.content:
Chapter 1286: The Price of Being Foolish
"I don't know him…"
Connor didn't even want to think and just shook his head.
"It's normal that you don't know me, but you should know Alexander Malone from the Malone family, right?" Chase continued.
After Connor heard Chase's words, a strange look flashed across his eyes. He knew that Chase's appearance at this time was likely related to Alexander's death.
"Some time ago, you killed Alexander and took the Malone family's property for yourself. Is that true?" Chase asked.
Connor didn't answer.
At this moment, a young man walked out from behind Chase.
"Connor, are you going to be a coward now? Weren't you very arrogant back in the Malone family?"
This young man was none other than Terry Malone.
When everyone saw Terry, they knew that it was true, but they were very surprised.
Alexander was a Black-ranked fighter, and if he was really killed by Connor, then it meant that Connor's strength surpassed a Black-ranked fighter's.
"No wonder Connor dared to be so arrogant. He's a Black rank!"
"It's impossible for such a young Black-ranked fighter to be here, right?"
"How is it impossible? If he wasn't a Black rank, how could he be so arrogant?"
Everyone started discussing again.
Terry pointed at Connor and shouted, "It was Connor who let a woman kill the head of our Malone family. I'm here to settle the score with Connor today. That woman shouldn't be with you today, right? I want to see how you're going to walk out of here!"
When everyone heard this, they finally understood that Alexander was not killed by Connor. Instead, Connor had instructed someone else to kill him. Then, this could all be explained.
"Terry, I let you go last time. I didn't expect you to dare to come looking for me again this time. You really can't change!" Connor said to Terry.
"Who are you scolding?" When Terry heard Connor's words, his expression was a little angry. He took a step forward and was about to attack, but he was stopped by Chase.
"Alexander and Grandpa Aaron were kind to me back then, but you killed them ruthlessly. Therefore, I came here today to ask for an explanation from you…" Chase said.
When everyone heard this, they suddenly realized that there was a conflict between Connor and Chase.
For a moment, everyone felt that Connor might really be doomed this time. After all, the three families were already very troublesome to deal with, but now the Jones family had been added into the conflict, and the Yearwood family had not expressed their stance.
However, Connor had offended the Yearwood family just now. In this case, Connor alone had managed to offend five big families. These five big families were terrifying existences even in the entirety of Oprana. No matter how powerful Connor was, he was definitely not a match for the five of them combined!
Connor looked at Chase with disdain and said, "Are you really here to take revenge for Alexander?"
"Is there any other reason? Do you think I'd go after you for no reason? I'm not in the mood to waste my time on you…" At this moment, Chase was obviously acting righteously.
Connor smiled disdainfully and said indifferently, "It's been so long since the incident with the Malone family, and you're only thinking of taking revenge on me now. Isn't it a little too late?"
"I didn't know about this at that time. I only found out recently…" Chase hurriedly said.
"If you really want to avenge the head of the Malone family, why didn't you look for me when I was in the Malone family? Why didn't you come for me when I was in Newtown?"
Connor paused for a moment, and then without giving Chase a chance to speak, he said, "The only reason you're here is because someone else wants to deal with me, so you're trying to hop on the bandwagon. Moreover, you're not taking revenge for the Malone family's head—you just want to get these properties the Malone family owns. If I'm not wrong, you've already discussed this with Terry, right?"
After Chase heard Connor's words, his expression became a little awkward. He opened his mouth and shouted, "Stop spouting nonsense here…"
"You think you're very smart and that it's the best time to attack me now, but you don't know how stupid you are. You'll pay the price for your actions!" Connor declared.
Chase gritted his teeth and replied, "It's still not certain who will pay the price today!"
However, Connor didn't continue to pay attention to him. He said coldly, "You're nothing more than a clown. Don't embarrass yourself in front of me…"
"Alright, just you wait…"
Chase gritted his teeth as he said this. Then, he walked directly to Niles's side. Terry followed closely behind him.
Connor looked at Terry with a hint of helplessness in his eyes.
At this moment, Terry might not know that he had already been used as a chess piece.
Currently, the Malone family was doing well under Mina's management. Terry could also get a lot of things out of this arrangement, but he was too greedy and wanted to become the head of the Malone family, which was why he was cooperating with Chase.
However, Terry didn't know that if Chase got the Malone family, he might be chased out. At that time, he might end up a hundred times worse off than now.
Connor turned to Niles and asked, "Do you have any other helpers?"
"Connor, you don't have to worry. Our two families aren't the only two who want to deal with you!" Niles said.
"Hehe, then I'll wait. I want to see how many people you can call over today!" Connor replied with a smile.
"Mr. Andre Washington has arrived!"
At this moment, a shout came from nearby, and Andre and Will Washington entered the Yearwood family's manor.
When everyone knew that Andre and Will had arrived, they all turned their heads to look outside the lobby.
After all, they knew that Andre was the most important character in today's drama. The conflict between the Washington family and Connor was the most interesting.
Soon, Andre appeared before everyone.

chapters.title: Chapter 1287: Chapter 1287-Rejection
chapters.content:
Chapter 1287: Chapter 1287-Rejection
When Andre appeared, everyone took the initiative to greet him.
Andre was also very polite and replied to them with a smile.
A moment later, Andre brought Will into the hall.
However, everyone realized that there was another young man following behind Andre and Will. The young man was about 30 years old. His skin was dark and his figure was neither thin nor fat There was a hint of hostility in his eyes.
However, someone in the crowd seemed to recognize this young man and shouted with a very surprised expression.
"Why is this person here?"
When the person beside him heard this, he hurriedly asked, "Who is this person?"
"You don't even know Yonder Washington from the Washington family?" Leonardo Sabin asked disdainfully.
"Who is Yonder Washington?"
Everyone looked at Leonardo with a puzzled expression.
"Yonder is the youngest Black-ranked warrior in the Washington family. Although he rarely leaves the Washington family, as long as he does, it's definitely to help them get rid of some people. Back then, someone offended Will Washington, and Yonder killed the offender's entire family. Yonder is a Black rank, and with the protection of the Washington family, even if the police knew about this, they wouldn't be able to do anything…"
Leonardo seemed to know Yonder very well.
"I didn't expect Yonder to be so powerful."
After everyone heard Leonardo's words, they all looked incredulous.
"Yonder is also Will's personal bodyguard. I didn't expect that the Washington family would actually invite Yonder over this time. It seems that they really intend to make a move on Connor…" Leonardo continued.
At this moment, another old man said, "That's right. If it was a small matter, there's no way they'd bring Yonder out. If Yonder's here, it means that the Washington family intends to kill Connor this time around. I think that Connor will probably not be able to escape death today…"
When everyone heard this, they all looked at Connor, their eyes filled with helplessness.
"Connor is really too arrogant. All of this is his own fault…" Leonardo said.
On the other side, after Andre entered the lobby, he greeted Grayson first, then walked up to Connor and asked, "You are Connor, right?"
Connor glanced at Andre indifferently and did not say anything.
However, Andre did not feel angry because of Connor's arrogant attitude. Instead, he smiled and said, "I didn't expect the rumored Mr. McDonald of Porthampton City to be so young. It's amazing that you have such achievements at the age of twenty. Even if I haven't come out for a long time, I've heard a lot about you. How admirable..."
After Connor heard Andre's words, he smiled disdainfully and said, "If you have something to say, just say it. There's no need to beat around the bush. I don't like to listen to nonsense!"
When everyone heard Connor's words, they couldn't help but be stunned for a moment. Connor's words were clearly saying that Andre was talking nonsense.
But they thought about it and felt that it was normal; After all, Connor didn't even bother showing courtesy to the Yearwood family, so naturally he wouldn't bother showing respect to Andre.
"Hehe, you're really showing off your abilities. I'm old, so isn't it normal for me to say some nonsense?" Andre smiled faintly when he heard Connor's words. Then, he did not continue to pay attention to Connor. Instead, he slowly turned his head to look at Freya, who was beside Connor, and said, "You should be Freya Phillips, right?"
Freya nodded, but did not say anything.
Andre sized Freya up and said with a smile, "You're really a great beauty. No wonder my grandson likes you…"
Freya took a deep breath before saying, "I don't like your grandson. The engagement between your grandson and I was made without my consent, too…"
"I know about this!" Andre nodded lightly and continued, "I heard that you and Connor seem to be engaged, right?"
"Yes, Connor is my fiancé!" Freya nodded.
"It's okay. I can give you a chance to choose again. As long as you're willing to marry my grandson, all the businesses of the Washington family will be managed by you and Will in the future." Andre said with a smile.
After Andre finished speaking, everyone present looked surprised. After all, the Washington family had a huge business empire—even the Yearwood family couldn't compare to it. Moreover, the Washington family had many ancient martial arts masters, which led to their high status in Oprana.
If Freya nodded now, everything would belong to her, and she could also inherit the Yearwood family's business in the future. If all the businesses of these two big families were in the hands of Freya and Will, they would definitely be able to create a super powerful family. They would be the most powerful family in the world, and everyone else could never hope to compete with them.
In the eyes of these people, this was a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity. They really could not find any reason to reject it.
Camila, who was not far away, was also very excited because this was exactly what she wanted.
Right now, she wished she could just agree to it in place of Freya. However, she also knew that there were so many big shots present that she had no right to interrupt.
After a moment of hesitation, Freya said, "Connor is my fiancé. My relationship with Connor is very good, so I won't marry anyone other than him…"
"What?"
" Freya actually rejected it?"
"Is this Freya crazy too?"
"She actually rejected such a good opportunity?"
Everyone looked at Freya, and their expressions became even more shocked.
Camila looked at Freya anxiously, not knowing what to do.
Even Grayson couldn't understand why Freya would refuse.
"Young lady, the things you are thinking about now are really too short-sighted. I know that you have some feelings for Connor, but feelings can't represent everything. My grandson, Will, is the most outstanding presence in Oprana. If the two of you can be together, your future achievements will be very, very amazing. If you continue to be with Connor, you might be dragged down," Andre said earnestly.
At this moment, Will was also looking at Freya with a smile, as if he was waiting for her answer.

chapters.title: Chapter 1288: I Don't Need Any Trump Cards
chapters.content:
Chapter 1288: I Don't Need Any Trump Cards
Everyone's attention was focused on Freya. As long as she nodded, it was very likely that the entire structure of Oprana would change.
"Sorry, I don't like this person!" she said calmly.
However, Freya rejected him again.
"Have you really thought it through?" Andre asked with a frown.
Freya opened her mouth to speak, but at that moment, Connor suddenly walked up to her and said to Andre, "Didn't you hear what my fiancée said just now? Who does this grandson of yours think he is? He doesn't deserve to be with her at all. It's best if you don't embarrass yourself here…"
After Andre heard Connor's words, the expression on his face appeared a little awkward, and the smile on his lips instantly froze.
Andre had never thought that Connor would actually be so arrogant. He didn't leave any leeway in his words and completely ignored his status.
One had to know that for so many years, no one had ever dared to speak to Andre in such a tone.
Niles took advantage of this opportunity to rush forward and shout at Connor, "Why are you so rude? Do you know who Mr. Washington Sr is? How dare she speak to him like this?"
"That's right. Mr. Washington is highly respected, no matter where he is. How can a junior like you so casually rebuff him? Didn't your elders teach you how to respect the old and love the young?" Chase shouted.
"That's right. This person is too disrespectful. He actually dares to treat Mr. Washington Sr like this…"
"He actually wants to be together with Freya? That's simply a fool's dream…"
"Hurry up and chase this person out. This kind of person doesn't deserve to stand here…"
Andre was a very powerful man, so at this moment, there were definitely many people who wanted to curry favor with him. Thus, in an instant, countless people stood out and began to criticize Connor.
Connor just stood there quietly and listened to these people's words without any intention of refuting them.
Grayson looked at Connor indifferently. He didn't know how Connor planned to deal with this situation.
Leona's eyes were filled with curiosity. When she first saw Connor, she was still very disappointed because she felt that Connor was very different from the Mr. McDonald in her imagination.
However, Connor's arrogant performance just now made Leona feel that Connor was quite interesting. After all, no matter how powerful a person was, they would not be stupid enough to offend so many people at the same time.
However, Connor was still so calm when facing these people. This meant that he definitely had some trump card that he had not revealed. However, Leona couldn't figure out what Connor's trump card was.
Of course, there was another possibility: that Connor was a lunatic and did not care about the consequences at all!
However, Leona felt that that wasn't the case. If Connor was a lunatic, he wouldn't have such achievements today.
"I really don't know how Connor plans to end this matter today…"
Leona couldn't help but think.
After Andre heard everyone mocking Connor, his expression was very calm. He whispered to Connor, "Connor, I know that you can be proud of yourself for reaching this position at such a young age. It is normal for you to be arrogant. However, you should think carefully before you act arrogantly. After all, there are people far beyond your usual territory. This is not Porthampton or Davenport."
Andre's expression was very calm when he said this. However, everyone present knew that as long as he said this, it meant that he had already planned to make a move on Connor.
Behind Andre, Yonder was also ready to attack Connor on command.
Any ordinary person would probably be so scared that they did not know what to do. It was even possible that they would kneel down and apologize to Andre. After all, Andre represented the entire Washington family, and the Washington family had a lot of ancient martial arts experts at their disposal. Once the Washington family wanted to deal with someone, that person would be sentenced to death. There was no hope at all.
However, Connor's expression was extremely disdainful. In a playful tone, he said, "Pay the price? I don't know what price I have to pay, but I know that with your current level, you don't have the right to say such words to me…"
After Connor finished speaking, everyone's expressions changed again.
This time, they felt that Connor was truly going way beyond the line. He clearly had no idea how terrifying the Washington family's strength was at all.
Niles took a step forward and shouted, "Connor, I don't know where you got your courage from. I also don't know what kind of trump card you have that allows you to face us so confidently. However, I want to tell you that if we join forces to deal with you, you won't be able to leave this manor today even if you have great ability…"
"That's right. Do you really think that just because you have some background in Porthampton, you can be arrogant before Mr. Washington Sr?" Chase added.
