Everyone nodded after hearing this. Although they had heard a lot about Connor before, those things were just rumors. No one knew if these things were true or not. However, the strength of the Washington family and the Landon family was well known. Ordinary people would not dare to offend them.
Moreover, even if Connor could leave this place today, if these big families joined forces, they would definitely have a way to send Connor to prison. Once Connor entered prison, his fate would be even worse.
At this moment, Niles stepped forward and shouted, "Connor, it has already come to this, so quickly reveal your trump card. Let us see just what ability you have to actually dare to be so arrogant…"
When everyone heard Niles's words, their expressions seemed to be filled with anticipation. They were looking forward to how Connor would deal with this situation. They felt that Connor definitely had not come alone.
When Connor heard Niles's words, a disdainful smile appeared on his face, and he said indifferently, "I do not need any trump cards to deal with you people…"

chapters.title: Chapter 1289: A Lunatic's Delusions
chapters.content:
Chapter 1289: A Lunatic's Delusions
"Haha..."
Niles sneered and said in a low voice, "Don't think I don't know that you're only so arrogant because of Thomas Morgan and Kyle Hayes. But let me tell you: although Thomas and Kyle have great influence in Davenport, they have no influence here. If you place your hopes on these two people, you're simply dreaming. You're might as well be dead—"
"Who has the guts to say that our Mr. McDonald is dead?"
At this moment, a voice came from outside the hall.
When everyone heard this voice, they hurriedly turned their heads to look for the one who'd spoken. They knew that Connor's reinforcements were about to arrive.
A moment later, a group of strong bodyguards in black suits rushed into the lobby.
When these bodyguards saw Connor, they hurriedly bowed to him and shouted, "Hello, Mr. McDonald!"
Connor looked at the strong bodyguards in front of him, and his expression was a little helpless.
The next second, Kyle Hayes walked into the hall.
"Mr. McDonald, I'm sorry. I might've been a little late!" Kyle in a very respectful tone.
"It's not too late!" Connor replied indifferently.
When Niles saw Kyle, he could not help but sneer and say, "Kyle, don't you know that this is Santon? How dare you come here? Aren't you afraid that you won't be able to return?"
"If someone wants to make things difficult for Mr. McDonald, I'll go anywhere, even if it's a dragon's lair or a tiger's den!" Kyle replied.
At this moment, a middle-aged man walked out from behind Kyle.
When everyone saw this middle-aged man, their expressions were a little surprised. The middle-aged man was named Hansel Flores, a big shot in Zalfari. His influence was terrifying.
Hansel walked to Connor and said, "Hello, Mr. McDonald!"
"Hello!"
Connor looked at Hansel and nodded. It was obvious that Hansel was here for him.
"Hansel, what is the meaning of this?"
Niles asked Hansel.
"Nothing, really. Anyone going against Mr. McDonald today is also going against me. I, Hansel Flores, am not as capable as you big bosses, but I still have some say in Zalfari!"
Hansel and Kyle were good friends, if Connor remembered correctly. Yes, he'd heard Kyle mention Hansel's name before.
Therefore, Kyle must have asked for Hansel's help on behalf of Connor.
"It's just Hanse Floresl. Connor, is this all you have?"
Niles asked.
Connor looked at Niles and said nothing.
"If this is not enough, then count me in!"
At this moment, Thomas Morgan walked into the hall.
Thomas's appearance was obviously much more low-key than the others, but at this time, everyone noticed that there was also a person following behind Thomas. This person was none other than the second-in-command of Salistan, Grant Tanner.
When everyone saw Grant, their expressions changed.
They knew that Grant had a lot of influence in Salistan. If he stood on Connor's side today, then even the Washington family would not be able to do anything about it.
After all, a strong dragon would never be able to outwit a local snake!
Grant followed Thomas to Connor's side and said a few words to him.
"No wonder Connor can be so arrogant. I didn't expect him to know Grant Tanner!"
"That's right. Looks like there will be a good show to watch today. There are so many big shots here…"
"It seems that Connor's really not any ordinary guy!"
Everyone began to discuss.
Niles's expression was obviously much uglier. He had never thought that Connor actually had such a trump card that he had not shown.
After Niles saw Grant, he was naturally very worried.
After all, both Hansel and Grant chose to stand on Connor's side. It would not be easy for them to touch Connor today.
Niles subconsciously looked at Andre and Will. His expression was very calm, as if he did not care about these people at all.
Andre gave Grant a bright look and said with a smile, "I didn't expect Mr. Tanner to come here personally…"
When Grant heard Andre's words, he couldn't help but be stunned for a moment. Then, he hurriedly said, "Mr. Washington Sr, you're here too?"
"That's right. It's Brother Yearwood's birthday banquet, so of course I have to come personally…"
Andre nodded and continued, "Mr. Tanner, I have some conflicts with Connor, but you seem to know him?"
"That's right, I know Mr. McDonald!" Grant replied indifferently. His meaning was obvious.
"Haha…"
Andre laughed loudly and continued to ask, "Then I wonder how your relationship with Councilman Washington is, Mr. Tanner?"
When Grant heard this, a strange look flashed across his eyes. Then, he hurriedly said, "Mr. Camden, is Mr. Camden here today?"
"No…"
Andre shook his head lightly.
After Grant heard this, the expression on his face relaxed significantly.
But Andre immediately continued, "Although he hasn't arrived yet, he should be here soon. Let's wait a little longer!"
"Councilman Washington is actually coming?" When Grant heard this, he was completely stunned. The expression on his face was very incredulous.
"I just spoke to Councilman Washington on the phone yesterday. He should be coming over!" Andre said calmly.
A hint of helplessness flashed across Grant's eyes. He turned to look at Thomas with a worried expression.
If Andre had really invited this so-called Councilman Washington over, then Grant might not be able to speak up for Connor. After all, Grant was only a second-in-command, but Councilman Washington was the real boss. Simply put, Councilman Washington was Grant's immediate superior.
Therefore, even if Grant had the courage of a hundred lions, he would not dare to offend Councilman Washington!
After Niles heard the conversation between Andre and Grant, his heart instantly relaxed.
He had never expected Andre to have such a background as to invite Grant's immediate superior, Councilman Washington, over.
If that was the case, things would be interesting.

chapters.title: Chapter 1290: Definitely Defeated
chapters.content:
Chapter 1290: Definitely Defeated
Connor had just brought out reinforcements when Andre revealed an even bigger trump card, causing things to become even harder for Connor.
To these people, Connor's connections definitely could not be compared to Andre and these people.
However, Councilman Washington had not appeared yet, so no one knew what was going on.
Just as everyone was thinking about these questions, a middle-aged man in a black suit and gold-rimmed glasses walked in with a smile.
The middle-aged man looked very refined. He had a briefcase in his hand and looked like an ordinary office worker. It was difficult to see anything different about him.
However, when everyone saw the middle-aged man, they were very unbelievable. Even Tom's eyes flashed with a trace of shock.
This was because the middle-aged man who had appeared was none other than Councilman Washington's secretary.
After Councilman Washington's secretary came in, he did not talk to Grayson. Instead, he walked up to Andre and explained in a low voice.
"That's understandable!"
Andre gently nodded.
Even though Councilman Washington wasn't here personally, the presence of Councilman Washington's secretary could represent many things.
A trace of helplessness flashed in Grant's eyes. He looked at Thomas apologetically and said softly, "If Councilman Washington is involved in this matter, then I might not be able to do anything…"
Thomas took a deep breath and didn't say anything.
After all, Grant was just an ordinary friend of his. Grant came here today because of him.
However, it was impossible for Grant to offend Councilman Washington because of this.
"Hello, Mr. Lugo."
Tom led several elders of the Yearwood Family to the middle-aged man and said respectfully.
"Councilman Washington told me that today is Mr. Yearwood Sr.'s birthday banquet, so he specially asked me to come over to take a look..."
The middle-aged man replied with a smile, then walked to Grayson and said softly, "Mr. Yearwood Sr., my apologies. Councilman Washington has a very important meeting to attend and really doesn't have time, so he asked me to come in his place. I hope you don't mind. This is a present prepared by Councilman Washington for you!"
After saying this, the middle-aged man took out a painting.
The painting was personally drawn by Councilman Washington. Although it wasn't worth much, it was a rather big deal for him to have given a present.
"I didn't expect Councilman Washington to remember that today is my birthday banquet. I'm already very happy that Councilman Washington has me in mind."
Grayson naturally did not dare to be negligent. He quickly replied with a smile and then took the painting from Mr. Lugo's hand.
In fact, Mr. Lugo did not have any real power in his hands, but everyone knew that Mr. Lugo represented Councilman Washington.
As for Councilman Washington, he was the leader of Salistan. The power in his hands was not something that ordinary people could imagine. Even Grant could not compare to him. The reason why such a big shot was here was definitely not because of Grayson.
Because Grayson had only met with Councilman Washington a limited number of times. This meant that Councilman Washington was probably on Andre's side.
Sure enough, Mr. Lugo did not choose to sit down after speaking. Instead, he walked directly behind Andre to express his attitude.
When Niles and Chase saw this, they were very excited.
Because when Grant appeared just now, the two of them vaguely felt that something was not right.
However, when Mr. Lugo appeared, it instantly shattered their worries.
Even if Connor had a powerful background and invited many powerful big shots, so what?
It could be said that the entire Salistan was the territory of Councilman Washington.
In Salistan, no one could be compared to Councilman Washington.
No matter who you invited, it would be useless.
At this moment, Hansel's face turned dark.
The reason was very simple. Hansel himself was a member of the underworld. The person he was most afraid of offending was someone like Councilman Washington.
Now that Mr. Lugo had already appeared, if he continued to stay here, he would only get himself into trouble.
Kyle Hayes could force Hansel to help him deal with Andre. Even though Andre was the head of an ancient martial arts aristocratic family and had a lot of businesses, Hansel was not afraid of Andre.
However, if Hansel were to deal with people like Councilman Washington, he would be courting death.
Of course, Grant naturally thought so too. If his future was affected just because of this matter, it was really not worth it.
Therefore, Grant and Hansel looked at each other, as if they didn't want to get involved in this matter anymore because this matter was too complicated.
Everyone present also became a little excited, because they felt that today's match was really getting more and more exciting.
Connor's side had just gained some momentum when he was suppressed by Andre.
Initially, everyone thought that Connor would be able to leave easily with the protection of Hansel and Grant. After all, these two people were very powerful in Salistan. Even if Andre and the others wanted to touch Connor, they would definitely not do it in front of these two people.
After all, no one dared to cause trouble in other people's territory.
However, no one expected Councilman Washington's secretary to come over personally.
This made the two people Connor invited useless because they didn't dare to offend Councilman Washington.
As expected, after Grant hesitated for a moment, he took the initiative to say to Connor, "Mr. McDonald, I might not be able to do anything about this matter today. After all, Mr. Washington's people are here. It won't look good if I continue to stay here…"
"It's okay. I'm very grateful that you came. You can leave!"
Connor knew what Grant meant, so he nodded calmly.
When Hansel saw Grant leave, he hurriedly said that he had something to do and left in a hurry.
After seeing Hansel and Grant leave, everyone felt that Connor would definitely lose today.
However, Connor didn't seem to care. Not only did he not plan to leave, but he even asked Kyle to bring two chairs for Freya Phillips to sit on.

chapters.title: Chapter 1291: Chance to Turn the Tide
chapters.content:
Chapter 1291: Chance to Turn the Tide
Everyone looked at Connor and Freya with disdain.
He was about to die, yet he still dared to sit there so leisurely.
Grayson shook his head helplessly. He also felt that Connor had already lost his momentum.
Leona Yearwood had been sizing up Connor. The more she looked at him, the more she found him interesting.
Of course, the premise was that Connor could leave this place alive today.
If Connor lost in the end, then he would become a joke in everyone's eyes.
Will Washington looked at Connor disdainfully and said coldly, "Connor, looks like the two reinforcements that you invited are useless. Now, they have abandoned you…"
"These two people are not reinforcements that I invited…"
Connor said as he peeled an orange for Freya.
"Not your reinforcements? Then what other trump cards do you have up your sleeve? If you still have a trump card, I advise you to hurry up and show it. Otherwise, you won't have the chance to do so later…"
Will said to Connor with a smile.
Connor looked at Will indifferently and didn't say anything. Instead, he continued to peel oranges for Freya.
"Connor, if you don't give us an explanation, then don't blame us for being rude!"
Niles shouted at Connor with his eyes wide open.
Smack!
Connor threw the orange peel at Niles's face and said expressionlessly, "It's not your turn to speak now…"
"Why you..."
A trace of anger flashed across Niles's eyes.
"Mr. Landon, don't be angry. Give him another ten minutes to think it over…"
Andre said faintly to Niles.
Niles took a deep breath and said in a low voice, "Alright, Mr. Washington Sr.. I'll give this person ten minutes…"
In fact, Andre could have just attacked Connor, but because so many people were watching, he planned to make things even more perfect. He wanted everyone to think that Connor didn't know how to cherish the opportunity he had, which led to the Washington Family taking action.
To put it bluntly, Andre wasn't giving Connor a chance, but he just didn't want others to gossip about him.
"Things are getting really interesting…"
Leonardo Sabin couldn't help but mutter to himself. Then, he continued, "The Washington, Landon, and Yearwood Families and Mr. Lugo are all here. I wonder how Connor plans to break free. Anyway, this lineup is surely invincible in Salistan…"
"How will he be able to break free? Connor is currently waiting for death…"
A middle-aged man said indifferently.
"I think so too. If Connor really wants to ask for help, he can only ask someone with a more terrifying background to come here. But in the entire country, how many people can have such power?"
"Initially, I thought that Connor might still have a glimmer of hope since he invited two reinforcements. However, I didn't expect these two reinforcements to be rendered useless by Councilman Washington's secretary. This is really interesting…"
"I don't know about that. Connor still looks so confident. Maybe this kid really has something!"
Everyone started discussing.
"Mr. Sabin, do you think Connor still has a chance to turn the situation around today?"
At this moment, a middle-aged man asked Leonardo softly.
When Leonardo heard this, he couldn't help but sneer and say, "A chance to turn the tables?"
"That's right. Connor seems to be quite confident…"
"Don't joke around. Look at the situation right now. How could he still have a chance to turn the tables? The other party's lineup is way too terrifying. In our country, there are definitely no more than ten people who can compete with these big families. Moreover, these people all have shocking backgrounds. If Connor really has something to do with these people, Andre will definitely not touch him. Since Andre dares to go against Connor, it means that Connor has nothing to do with those people. Tell me, what will he use to turn the tables?"
"That's true. Looks like this Connor is really screwed this time…"
"Mr. Sabin's analysis does make some sense…"
Everyone nodded their heads gently. It was as if everyone felt that the fact that Andre was able to invite someone as powerful as Councilman Washington, Connor was done for. In Salistan, there was no one who could be compared to Councilman Washington. Therefore, it was even more difficult for Connor to turn the tables.
Moreover, there were the Landon and Washington families who had not made any moves. If these people joined forces, it was simply unimaginable. Connor simply had no chance of turning the tables.
The Yearwood Family members were also looking at Connor. They were all thinking the same thing deep down. They felt that Connor would die today.
Of course, some people who had a good relationship with Camila Yearwood were still very worried about Connor. However, these people's status in the Yearwood Family was very low. They had no right to speak at all.
Camila didn't care. After all, her real plan was to get rid of Connor.
However, Camila's father's expression was very ugly because he was really worried about Connor and Freya. He was even more worried that this matter would affect Camila.
"Looks like Connor is really done for…"
"Connor is really overestimating himself. He only knows Hansel Flores, Grant Tanner and some others, and he actually wants to compete with a big family like the Washington Family."
"That's right. This Freya is really something. She actually did such a stupid thing and brought back a person like Connor. Does she want to be played to death by the Washington Family?"
"Just now, Mr. Washington Sr. had already given Freya a chance, but she didn't take it. What can she do now?"
"I heard that Freya has been living outside with someone else. She has never been disciplined by her parents since she was young. She's definitely not a good person. She's the same as Connor…"
The Yearwood Family had always disliked Freya, so they would definitely kick her when she was down.
Camila's father's face turned dark when he heard these people's words. However, he didn't know what to do. After all, he didn't even have the courage to refute these people.
Moreover, these people did not care about keeping it down when saying these things. It was obvious that they were deliberately saying it for him to hear.
Camila relied on her own efforts to have someone status in the Yearwood Family. However, after this incident, Camila's status in the Yearwood Family would probably return to its original state.

chapters.title: Chapter 1292: The Show is About to Begin
chapters.content:
Chapter 1292: The Show is About to Begin
"Sigh... Connor is way too condescending. If he waited a few more years and worked hard to develop his own powers, he might even have the qualifications to fight the Washington Family. However, he's a little too impatient. Sometimes, it's not a good thing for young people to be too arrogant…"
At this moment, a white-haired old man suddenly spoke.
When everyone heard the old man's words, they all expressed their agreement.
Although they were all very disgusted with Connor, no matter what, they had also seen Connor's capabilities. It was just that the current Connor was a little too young. In terms of connections, he was ultimately not on the same level as the Washington Family.
However, if Connor was given some more time, the situation might be different.
Unfortunately, it was too late to say anything now. After all, things had already reached this point. Even if they felt sorry for Connor, there was nothing they could do.
"Connor, it's been five minutes. Aren't you going to show your trump card?"
Will asked Connor with a smile.
Connor looked up at Will expressionlessly and said, "I don't need any trump cards at all. If you want to make a move, you can do it now!"
Connor knew that the Washington Family's biggest guarantee was the person next to Will, but that person was a black-rank martial artist, and Connor could have the strength of a black-rank after taking two pills. If it didn't work, there was still a third pill.
Even if the three Chi Receiving Pill didn't work, Connor still had Jorge Yarrell's jade pendant.
Although Connor didn't know what the jade pendant was used for, he knew that since Jorge had given it to him, it would definitely be useful. Therefore, Connor was prepared to use this jade pendant last.
Therefore, Connor did not need anyone's help at all. These people could not do anything to Connor.
This was the reason why Connor was so calm.
"You're still so arrogant at a time like this. I gotta give it to you. You have some guts…"
Will laughed as he replied to Connor.
However, at this moment, a commotion suddenly broke out outside the lobby.
When everyone heard the noise, they turned their heads and saw a young man and woman walking in.
The man was very tall and had a determined expression on his face. The woman was very charming and had a very sexy figure. She was wearing a long white dress.
When everyone saw these two people, they immediately recognized them.
They were none other than Bailey Banks and Ted Hons.
"Aren't they Bailey Banks and Ted Hons?"
"Why are the two of them here? Do the two of them have some conflict with Connor?"
"Connor is really dead this time. Not only has he offended so many people, even Bailey and Ted are here to look for him…"
"Yeah, he's a goner for sure…"
Everyone started discussing in low voices.
Will looked at his watch and said in a low voice, "There are only three minutes left!"
"Are these the only people who are here this time?"
Connor naturally saw Bailey and Ted, but he didn't take it to heart. Instead, he slowly raised his head and asked Will.
When Will heard Connor's words, he couldn't help but be stunned for a moment. Then, he frowned and said, "What do you mean?"
"I remember telling you last night to use all your connection for me and call as many people as you can, yet these are the only people you've found?"
Connor faintly explained.
"Are these people not enough?"
Will asked Connor in confusion.
Connor couldn't help but laugh when he heard this. Then, he said expressionlessly, "It seems that I have overestimated the Washington Family. I gave you a night's time and you only managed to find these few people. Moreover, you want to rely on them to deal with me. You are simply too naive…"
"What do you mean? Do you think that we can't deal with you?"
Will stared at Connor and asked loudly.
"Of course, not…"
Connor lightly shook his head.
"Why you..."
When Will heard Connor's words, he was speechless. He could not help but laugh and said in a low voice, "Connor, you're about to die, but here you are acting all confident. I really admire you. There's only one minute left."
Grayson looked at Connor with a helpless expression, because everyone could see that Connor had no hope of turning the tables.
If Connor was smart, he would use this opportunity to apologize to these people and then discuss what to do next.
However, Connor still chose to be arrogant. It was as if he didn't put these people in his eyes at all. Connor's actions would only make these people hate him even more. At that time, they might be even more ruthless.
Even Leona frowned and looked at Connor with a very puzzled expression.
Although everyone present thought that Connor was definitely going to die today, she didn't know why, but she felt that he hasn't shown his trump card.
Leona felt that Connor was very likely to turn the tables under such circumstances.
Because Leona saw a kind of confidence that ordinary people didn't have on Connor's face.
However, Leona didn't know what Connor's trump card was. After all, there was nothing that could intimidate these big families.
Moreover, Councilman Washington's secretary was still here. She racked her brains but could not think of any answer that could resolve today's situation.
Freya was also very nervous at this moment. She was worried that something would really happen to Connor, so she could not help but reach out and tug at him, as if she wanted him to admit defeat.
However, Connor had been sitting on the chair expressionlessly the entire time, showing no intention of admitting defeat.
At this moment, Ted and Bailey finally walked into the hall.
There were more than a dozen people following behind Ted. These people had a strong aura, and it was obvious that they were from the army. Their combat strength was probably quite high.
Will's eyes flashed with excitement. He quickly walked to Ted and Bailey and said with a smile, "I thought that the two of you would not come today. If you didn't come, you would have missed another good show…"
When everyone heard Will's words, they became even more excited because the show was about to begin.
The current situation was not looking good at all for Connor. He was clearly somewhat unable to cope.
If Bailey and Ted were to join in, then Connor might really have no chance of winning.

chapters.title: Chapter 1293: Commander Shaw!
chapters.content:
Chapter 1293: Commander Shaw!
Freya couldn't help but take a deep breath, her expression showing nervousness.
She tightly held Connor's hand, as she had made up her mind to stand by his side no matter what happened today.
Even if it meant risking her life, she wouldn't betray Connor.
Upon seeing Freya's determined expression, Connor couldn't help but smile lightly and said softly, "Don't worry, with me here, there won't be any problems."
Freya glanced at Connor and said softly, "No matter what happens today, I won't leave you."
Connor smiled and remained silent.
Ted walked straight towards his position, without even glancing at Will.
Bailey had been accompanying Ted and also ignored Will.
Will's expression showed some confusion, and he felt that something was not right. He sensed that Bailey and Ted were not here for him but for Connor.
As expected, after Ted reached Connor, he bowed to Connor and shouted loudly, "Mr. Connor, I am here on orders from Commander Shaw!"
Everyone present was dumbfounded and wore incredibly astonished expressions.
They couldn't believe what they were seeing.
Ted wasn't here to cause trouble for Connor; instead, he came to protect him.
Also, Ted mentioned someone named Commander Shaw. No one knew who this Commander Shaw was.
"Commander Shaw ordered you to protect me?" Connor asked him calmly.
"Yes, I just received a call from Marshal Commander Shaw!" he replied loudly.
"I think I hit you yesterday." Connor said indifferently.
"It was all my fault. I apologies for being arrogant yesterday!" Ted continued.
"Heh..." Connor chuckled upon hearing this and didn't say anything further.
Andre's expression turned grim, and he wondered, "Who is this Commander Shaw?"
Tom also paused for a moment and asks, "Mr. Andre, who is this Commander Shaw?"
"The Commander of the Salem Battlefront, Joey Shaw!" Ted announched loudly.
At that moment, everyone present was dumbfounded, wearing expressions of disbelief as they look at Connor's position.
No one had expected that, at that very moment, the situation would undergo another transformation.
Connor actually knew Joey, the highest leader of the Salem Battlefront.
Although some of the people present are unaware of Joey's terrifying background, Councilman Washington was well aware of it, and his expression started to turn ugly.
And the people present began to quietly discuss the situation.
"I never thought Connor has such a strong backer..."
"Yeah, Joey isn't an ordinary person, right?"
"He must be formidable; otherwise, Andre wouldn't act this way..."
"Connor knows someone like Joey..."
Excitedly, Leonardo says.
"Leonardo, who is Joey?" someone asks.
"If you don't even know who Joey is, there's no need for me to introduce him to you further. All I can say is that he will rise to the highest position in the military region in the future. His future is limitless, and the Shaw family he belongs to is even more extraordinary. Throughout Oprana, no one can compare. Even someone like Councilman Washington wouldn't dare to offend Joey," Leonardo explains, giving everyone a clear understanding of Joey's power.
The situation in the hall went on another dramatic change.
In the eyes of everyone, Connor, who seemed to have no way out, unexpectedly revealed that he had Joey on his side.
Although many people present are unaware of how terrifying Joey's identity is, the fear he instilled in Andre and the Hons family proved that he holds significant influence.
Connor was well aware that Joey came to help him because of his relationship with Rachel.
Regardless of what Rachel's true intentions were in getting close to him, she always helped him at the most critical moments. This deeply moved him.
"Commander Shaw and my father have a good relationship. Yesterday, my father personally called me and explicitly told me to support Andre's actions!"
Just at that moment, Bailey suddenly spoke up.
Everyone was once again stunned upon hearing Bailey's words.
She walked over to Connor in high heels, and with her bright eyes, she looked straight at him.
It was evident that her actions represented her standing by Connor's side today.
Andre's expression turned uglier; he instinctively looked at his secretary, Mr. Lugo, and asked in a low voice, "Mr. Lugo, who is this Joey?"
"This Joey has an absolute influence in Oprana and ranks among the top three. He isn't easy to deal with," Li, the secretary, replies with a frown. He then continues, "I didn't expect that Joey would be interested in this matter. I have to call Chairman Washington and see what he thinks!"
After saying this, Mr. Lugo left directly.
Upon seeing this scene, everyone was shocked.
They all thought that Mr. Lugo had abandoned Andre.
Even Niles and others, who had thought victory was certain, are now bewildered. They never expected such a sudden turn of events.
Everyone was at a loss, unsure of what will happen next.
The Yearwood family's attitude has also undergone a significant change. Now, they can't underestimate Connor. They also know that since Connor dared to appear in this place, he indeed has some powerful connections.
"Camila, your son-in-law was impressive, overpowering the Wang family like that..."
"That's right, Camila, you found a great son-in-law!"
"Let me tell you, it is all because Camila is lucky. Even if Freya didn't marry into the Washington family, she still found such an excellent son-in-law..."
Now, it's as if they were different people, approaching Camila with flattery and compliments.
And she wore a shocked expression. She never imagined that Connor could turn the tide in such a situation.
The current situation is entirely different from what she had anticipated.
However, if Connor's strength can genuinely surpass the Washington family's, then even if Freya doesn't marry into the Washington family, having her marry Connor would be a good thing.
So, at that moment, a happy smile appeared on Camila's face.

chapters.title: Chapter 1294: The Last Trump Card
chapters.content:
Chapter 1294: The Last Trump Card
Niles couldn't sit still, so he hurriedly walked over to Andre's side and whispered, "Mr. Andre, what do we do now?"
"Wait for Mr. Lugo's reply!" Andre replied calmly and composedly.
As Andre finished speaking, Mr. Lugo rushed over in a fluster and whispered to Andre, "Mr. Andre, I apologize for the inconvenience. Councilman Washington said that since Joey wants to protect Connor, he won't say much. If there's nothing else, I'll take my leave..."
"Mr. Lugo..."
When Niles saw that Mr. Lugo was about to leave, he was dumbfounded and hurriedly called out.
Everyone present was shocked when they saw Mr. Lugo leave. They hadn't expected the situation to turn out this way.
Originally, they all thought that when Mr. Lugo appeared in the hall, the outcome was already decided. Connor was bound to die today because Councilman Washington was the most powerful figure in the southeastern province, and he couldn't break this situation.
However, nobody anticipated that he would bring out someone even more terrifying than Councilman Washington.
Though Joey didn't appear in person, from Mr. Lugo's words, they could tell that Joey's strength far surpassed Councilman Washington's.
"Who is this Joey?"
"Yeah, isn't Joey's power a bit too terrifying? Councilman Washington seems to be avoiding him."
"Didn't expect Connor to be more than an ordinary person. This show is getting more and more interesting!"
The people present started discussing, their expressions filled with excitement. Nothing was more thrilling than the current situation in their minds.
The Yearwood family's perception of Connor had drastically changed; they no longer saw him as a madman.
Freya fixed her beautiful eyes on Connor, her expression filled with incredulity. It seemed she didn't expect him to have such terrifying connections. She now understood why he was so confident before.
In Connor, she saw hope, thinking that he might help her break free from the Yearwood family.
"I didn't expect you actually had some hidden cards..."
Lu Lu, not far away, sighed inwardly as she observed Connor's position.
The situation had become even more intriguing than anyone could have imagined.
Everyone present was in deep shock, except for Andre, who remained calm.
"Mr. Andre, now that Mr. Lugo has left, what do we do?" Niles was genuinely anxious, his expression tense as he asked Andre.
"The matter isn't over yet, why are you panicking?" Andre replied calmly.
"Mr. Andre, do you still have some cards up your sleeve?" Niles took a deep breath and softly asked Andre.
"Right, Mr. Andre, do you have more cards?" Chase also hurriedly asked.
Andre glanced at them and didn't directly answer their questions.
In truth, their guesses were correct; Andre did have some cards left to play. He still had one last chance to turn the tide.
Of course, Andre knew that Connor's strength was truly formidable. Initially, he thought dealing with Connor would be a simple task, but now, he realized that suppressing Connor would require the appearance of that person.
However, Andre wasn't certain if that person would come today. If that person didn't appear, the best outcome he could achieve was a draw with Connor. But if that person did show up, the Wang family could still defeat Connor.
He never imagined that he would pin all his hopes on that person, who could be considered his final trump card. The problem was that using that person's power came at a cost, and Andre didn't want to waste this opportunity on Connor.
However, given the current situation, if they didn't use that person's power, they had no other options.
Andre turned his head and glanced at Yonder before saying in a low voice, "Go and make contact!"
"Mr. Andre, have you considered this carefully?" Yonder asked softly.
"I have considered it thoroughly..."
Andre nodded seriously.
"Alright!"
Yonder agreed and then turned to leave.
Meanwhile, the Yearwood family members didn't know what would happen next.
"Father, is there no chance of turning the tables today? It seems like Connor is about to crush the Wang family," Ted hesitated before whispering to Grayson.
Hearing this, Grayson couldn't help but shake his head and replied, "How could it end so easily? Don't forget, the true influence of the Wang family lies in the martial world, and they haven't exerted their strength in that area yet. This won't be over so quickly; just wait and see!"
"You're right; I almost forgot. The Washington family's true power lies in the martial world. They haven't shown their connections there yet..."
Upon hearing this, Ted's expression seemed to ease a little. He had been supporting Andre, and if Andre lost today, his future in the Yearwood family would be bleak.
So, he was naturally worried. However, after hearing these words from Grayson, he felt that the situation might not end so soon.
As the guests continued to observe, they found the whole spectacle incredibly captivating.
Leonardo stared with wide eyes at Connor's position, his expression not just shocked but even more shocked.
He felt Connor's influence was too terrifying, admitting that he had underestimated him before.
"Leonardo, weren't you quite certain earlier that no matter who came today, Connor wouldn't have a chance to turn the tables? But now, it seems that he has already done so, right?"
At that moment, a middle-aged man smiled and asked Leonardo.

chapters.title: Chapter 1295: Fifty-fifty Chance
chapters.content:
Chapter 1295: Fifty-fifty Chance
Leonardo felt a bit embarrassed upon hearing this and said softly, "Don't underestimate the Washington family; the matter isn't over yet!"
"Mr. Lugo has already left. Is there any chance of a turnaround in this situation?" the middle-aged man continued.
"Do you think Mr. Lugo is the Washington family's last card?" Leonardo retorted defensively.
"I think so!" the middle-aged man nodded lightly.
"Didn't you forget that the Washington family's true influence lies in the martial world? So far, they haven't used their connections in that realm. If they can suppress Connor in that aspect, then the outcome might still be uncertain. I'd say the current situation is at best a fifty-fifty chance..." Leonardo gritted his teeth and replied.
Clearly, Leonardo's thoughts were similar to Grayson's. They both believed that the Washington family couldn't be easily defeated.
After all, many people were watching, and if the Washington family really lost, the impact on them would be terrifying.
The middle-aged man smiled at Leonardo and said softly, "Mr. Leonardo, you seem very confident in the Washington family..."
"Of course, a prestigious family like the Wangs can't be trifled with. You all know how terrifying the influence of a martial family can be..." Leonardo replied hastily.
The middle-aged man touched his beard and said, "Since Mr. Leonardo is so confident, how about we make a bet..."
"A bet?" Leonardo hesitated for a moment upon hearing this and asked the man, "How do you want to bet with me?"
"I bet that Connor will win today, and you bet that the Washington family will win. The wager is five million. Do you dare to bet with me?" the middle-aged man said softly.
Leonardo looked at the man, frowned, and then gritted his teeth, "Alright, since you want to bet with me, I'll take the bet."
The middle-aged man lightly smiled and didn't say anything more.
Meanwhile, in the hall, Connor turned his head and looked at Will with a cold tone, "I gave you a day to prepare, but it seems you only managed to call a few people, and it seems they aren't very useful..."
Connor's tone was extremely arrogant at this moment.
Will's expression looked angry upon hearing Connor's words, but he didn't know how to respond.
Andre, on the other hand, smiled and said to Connor, "I didn't expect you to be truly remarkable, to actually know someone like Joey. This is something we didn't anticipate..."
At this moment, Andre's gaze towards Connor had also changed.
Previously, he had looked down on Connor, thinking he wasn't very capable. He believed dealing with Connor would be a simple matter, just a few words, and it would be done.
But now, he realized that Connor was not as simple as he had imagined. Moreover, Connor was only twenty years old. If given a few decades, his power would definitely surpass that of the Washington family. Andre had decided that no matter what, he had to strangle Connor in the cradle.
"There are many things you haven't thought of..." Connor calmly said, glancing at Andre.
"Yonder hasn't returned yet. I must seize this opportunity to buy more time by talking with Connor," Andre thought to himself.
"Even if you know Joey, so what? You broke Wilbur's legs. If the Landon family decides to pursue this, you should have been sent to jail. Even if you know Joey, you can't escape the law. The principle that a gentleman breaks the law just like a commoner is something you should understand. You can't avoid legal consequences just because of your relationship with Joey," Andre said in a low voice to Connor.
Upon hearing his words, the expressions of those present showed some surprise because they knew he was planning to use the law to deal with Connor.
"I did break Wilbur's legs, but I've already explained it. It was because he tried to set me up and provoke me intentionally. So, I acted against him. If he hadn't provoked me, I wouldn't have attacked him," Connor calmly retorted.
"Is there any evidence to support your words? Can anyone prove that what you said is true?" Andre coldly asked, continuing, "Moreover, even if what you say is true, it seems that Wilbur didn't harm you in any way. Instead, you broke his legs and hands. No matter what, you must take responsibility for this incident."
Upon hearing his words, everyone's expressions showed a trace of disdain. They were still comparing their connections, but Andre brought up this matter, which clearly showed he couldn't handle the situation.
However, no matter what, the fact remained that Connor broke Wilbur's legs and hands, and that couldn't be changed.
If Joey intervened in this matter, it would be tantamount to siding with Connor. At that time, the Washington family could easily use public opinion to create a terrifying impact on Joey.
In essence, Andre was using the pressure of public opinion to deal with Connor.
Connor touched his nose, looking disdainful, and said, "True, I did break Wilbur's legs, but so what?"
"Well then, let the police handle this matter!" Andre said coldly.
"I'm sorry, Mr. Andre, but the police can't handle this!" It was at that moment that Thomas suddenly spoke up.
"Why?" Andre looked at Thomas and asked.
"Because Mr. Connor is a martial artist. According to our country's regulations regarding martial artists, even if they violate the law, the police don't have the authority to intervene!" Thomas calmly explained.
Thomas's words were indeed true. Martial artists had terrifying strength, so the police wouldn't easily get involved in matters concerning them. The martial world had its own set of rules and regulations.
In simple terms, matters between martial artists had to be resolved according to the rules of the martial world.

chapters.title: Chapter 1296: Purple Cloud Sect
chapters.content:
Chapter 1296: Purple Cloud Sect
"Hahaha…"
Andre couldn't help but laugh because he was waiting for Thomas to say this.
"I'm really confused. I actually forgot that Mr. McDonald is a martial artist!"
Andre sized up Connor and said, "Since Mr. McDonald is a martial artist, I don't think it's possible to use the law to punish you. Then we can only deal with this matter according to the rules of the martial artist world. According to my understanding, martial artists can't attack ordinary people."
Everyone was stunned when they heard Andre's words.
They knew that Andre was planning to use their Washington family's influence in ancient martial arts to suppress Connor.
Thomas also knew that he had been fooled. He could not help but curse the old fox in his heart.
"The rules of the martial arts world?"
After Connor heard Andre's words, a trace of confusion flashed across his eyes.
"Then how do you think we should deal with this matter?"
Connor said lightly.
"It's very simple. Since you dared to break Wilbur Landon's legs, then you have to pay the same price. This is the outcome of a martial artist attacking an ordinary person!" Andre said.
"Haha..."
After Connor heard Andre's words, he couldn't help but smile faintly. Then, he said, "You guys don't seem to have the ability yet!"
"Of course we don't, but other people do!"
Andre had just finished speaking when a commotion suddenly came from outside the hall.
When everyone heard the commotion, they turned their heads to look at it.
A hunchbacked old man slowly walked towards the hall, Yonder walking beside him.
This old man was probably invited by Yonder at the request of Andre.
Grayson, who was still quietly watching the show, was shocked when he saw the old man, disbelief on his face. He stuttered, "The Washington family actually invited this person? Was it really worth it to pay such a huge price just to deal with Connor?"
Andre seemed to have seen this old man before as well. A smug smile appeared on his face because this person was Andre's final trump card.
"The person who can deal with you is finally here!" Andre said to Connor with a smile.
Connor also turned his head to look at the old man with a puzzled expression.
Grayson took the initiative to walk towards the old man and said respectfully, "Mr. Felton, why are you here?"
The hunchbacked old man glanced at Grayson indifferently and said, "I heard that today is your birthday banquet, so I came over to pay a visit. At the same time, I had a small matter to settle…"
After Grayson heard the old man's words, the expression on his face seemed a little helpless, because he knew that the small matter that the old man mentioned was likely about dealing with Connor.
Everyone looked at the old man with a puzzled expression because they did not know who he was.
Andre hurriedly ran to the old man and said respectfully, "Mr. Felton, you're here!"
"Yes…"
The old man looked at Andre and nodded.
"Mr. Felton?"
When everyone heard this address, their expressions seemed to be even more puzzled.
"Who is this Mr. Felton?"
"Yeah, from the looks of it, he's not an ordinary person, right?"
"Since Andre is speaking to him so respectfully, this Mr. Felton is definitely not an ordinary person!"
Everyone present began to discuss in low voices.
Leonardo looked at Mr. Felton and hesitated for two seconds. Then, he slapped his thigh and shouted excitedly, "Could this Mr. Felton be the Purple Cloud Sect's Third Elder, Beckett Felton?"
"An elder of the Purple Cloud Sect?"
When everyone heard this, they were all dumbfounded. Their expressions were extremely incredulous.
Although many of the people present were not ancient martial arts practitioners, these people knew the existence of the Purple Cloud Sect. They also knew that the Purple Cloud Sect was currently the largest ancient martial arts sect in Oprana.
Moreover, the Purple Cloud Sect had the right to manage the order of ancient martial arts.
One had to know that even in the entirety of Oprana, there were only three sects that had the power to manage the order of ancient martial arts. These three great sects restricted each other and jointly managed all the martial artists.
No one had expected the Washington family to invite such a big shot over. At this moment, the situation on the battlefield seemed to have undergone a very big change.
If Beckett attacked Connor, then what could Connor do even if he knew Joey Shaw?
"Today is really full of twists and turns!"
Leonardo shouted excitedly.
Moreover, Beckett was also an ancient martial arts expert. Therefore, it would be very easy for him to deal with Connor.
Beckett looked at Connor from head to toe and said coldly, "You should be the person who broke Wilbur Landon's legs, right?"
"That's right, it's me!"
Connor looked at Beckett in front of him. He did not show any fear at all. On the contrary, his expression was very calm.
"Very good. Since you admit to this matter, it's easy to handle!"
Beckett nodded lightly.
Connor said nothing.
"I'm an elder of the Purple Cloud Sect. Our Purple Cloud Sect has the authority to manage martial artists. As an ancient martial arts practitioner, you actually dared to attack ordinary people without permission and even broke their legs. Your methods are too cruel," Beckett said righteously to Connor.
In fact, Beckett was just thinking up an excuse to attack Connor.
Martial artists were used to seeing ordinary people attack them. Even the three major sects, which were responsible for managing martial artists, turned a blind eye to such things. However, ancient martial arts did have such a rule: martial artists could not attack ordinary people, so what Beckett said now wasn't technically wrong.
"What explanation do you want?"
Connor asked Beckett.
"It's very simple. Since you broke Wilbur Landon's legs, I'll break yours today as well. This way, I'll give the Landon family some closure!"
Beckett said calmly.
After everyone heard Beckett's words, a hint of helplessness flashed across their eyes.

chapters.title: Chapter 1297: Jorge Yarrell's Disciple
chapters.content:
Chapter 1297: Jorge Yarrell's Disciple
No one had expected that today's matter would turn out like this.
Originally, they thought that Connor might have escaped death, but in the end, he was actually still crushed by the Washington family.
It couldn't be helped; since the Washington family had already invited Beckett Felton over, then Connor might really have no chance to turn the tables against them.
Andre, Niles, and the others looked at Connor with unusually smug expressions because they also felt that this matter was finally coming to an end.
"Beat me into a cripple?" Connor looked at Beckett and sneered. Then, he said indifferently, "Do you have the ability?"
"Haha..."
Beckett smiled disdainfully and said in a low voice, "Kid, the reason you're so arrogant now is because you have three pills on your side. But I'm an Earth-ranked warrior. Even if you eat ten pills, you're still no match for me!"
"An Earth-ranked warrior?"
When everyone heard Beckett's words, they were in an uproar.
Everyone was incredulous. No one had expected Beckett to be an Earth-ranked warrior.
One had to know that in the eyes of these ordinary people, an Earth-class martial artist could already be considered an invincible existence.
Even Connor's eyes flashed with a trace of shock at this moment. He had never thought that the Washington family would actually get an Earth-ranked warrior to take action!
The strength of an Earth-ranked fighter was very terrifying, and the strongest opponent Connor had encountered so far was only a Black-rank fighter.
But comparing an Earth-ranked to a Black-rank was like comparing heaven and earth!
Beckett didn't want to waste time and asked him directly, "Connor, do you have anything else to say?"
Connor looked at Beckett without saying anything. At this moment, he was thinking of a countermeasure.
Everyone looked at Connor. They all felt that he might really not have a chance to turn the tables again.
Even Leona could feel that Connor's confidence had disappeared. This meant that he must have used up all his cards.
"Is this really the end?"
Leona couldn't help but wonder.
"Mr. Felton, even if you are an Earth-ranked warrior, I don't think you have the right to attack Mr. McDonald!"
However, at this moment, Thomas suddenly spoke to Beckett.
"Who are you?"
Beckett asked disdainfully. He did not know Thomas at all.
"Who I am is not important, but you have to know who Mr. McDonald is!" Thomas replied indifferently.
Beckett was stunned for a moment and asked, "Who is this kid?"
"Mr. McDonald is the disciple of your Purple Cloud Sect's leader, Jorge Yarrell. He is also Master Yarrell's only disciple. If you beat Mr. McDonald into a cripple, how are you going to explain it to Master Yarrell?" Thomas asked Beckett calmly.
"This person is the Sect Leader's disciple?"
After hearing Thomas's words, Beckett's expression was a little shocked as he shouted in disbelief.
Thomas nodded. "That's right, Mr. McDonald is Master Yarrell's disciple!"
Thomas's words were like a bomb thrown into the crowd. Everyone's expression was very shocked.
One had to know that the name Jorge Yarrell was like thunder piercing through one's ears!
Even those who didn't know much about Ancient Martial Arts had heard of Jorge's name!
If Connor was really Jorge's disciple, then today's matter would be interesting.
"How is that possible? Connor is actually Jorge Yarrell's disciple?"
Grayson stared at Connor with his eyes wide open. The expression on his face was filled with shock.
Because Grayson was also a martial artist, he naturally knew how terrifying Jorge Yarrell's influence was. If Connor was really Jorge's disciple, then just this identity alone was enough to crush the entire Washington family!
Will stared at Connor. He couldn't believe that this was true. After all, Connor was already outstanding enough to contend with the Washington family. But if Connor was somehow also Jorge Yarrell's disciple, then his background was a little too terrifying.
Connor was so young. Will could not believe that such a young person could have such a background.
"Impossible!"
At this moment, Andre suddenly shouted. Everyone looked at him.
"Master Yarrell has never taken in disciples before. Now, how could Connor become Master Yarrell's disciple? This is absolutely impossible!" Andre was also a little flustered. He was worried that what Thomas said was true, so his tone was unusually agitated.
"That's right, why didn't I hear that our sect Master has accepted a disciple? Our leader is in seclusion all year round. How can he have a disciple? You must be talking nonsense here!" Beckett also said to Thomas.
"Do you think I'd dare to say such things?"
Thomas replied to Beckett lightly.
Beckett hesitated for a moment before saying in a low voice, "Alright, since you said that this person is the disciple of the sect leader, then what evidence do you have to prove that what you said is true?"
"Of course we have evidence!" Thomas replied indifferently, then asked Connor, "Mr. McDonald, Master Yarrell should have given you an amethyst pendant. Do you have it with you?"
Connor nodded after hearing Thomas's words.
"Then quickly take out that amethyst pendant and show it to these people!" Thomas hurriedly continued.
Connor hesitated for a moment before taking out the pendant. At this moment, he didn't really know what the amethyst pendant was going to be used for.
Thomas took the pendant from Connor and said to Beckett, "Mr. Felton, since you are from the Purple Cloud Sect, I think you should know this amethyst pendant, right? You know what this amethyst pendant represents, right?"
"Is that…the Sect Leader's amethyst pendant?"
A trace of shock flashed across Beckett's eyes. Then, he quickly walked to Thomas and reached out to take the amethyst pendant.
Andre looked at Beckett, and his expression began to turn ugly. He could feel that something was not quite right.
Niles and Chase were also very nervous because they knew that if this amethyst pendant was real, it would be enough to prove the relationship between Connor and Jorge.
If Connor was really Jorge's disciple, then this matter would be troublesome.
Beckett examined the amethyst pendant carefully and said with trembling lips, "It really is the Sect Leader's amethyst pendant? Are you really the Sect Master's disciple?"

chapters.title: Chapter 1298: A Chimpanzee?
chapters.content:
Chapter 1298: A Chimpanzee?
One had to know that this amethyst pendant represented the identity of the sect leader of the Purple Cloud Sect.
If Jorge gave this amethyst pendant to Connor, it meant that Jorge was prepared to let Connor inherit the position of the Purple Cloud Sect's leader.
Beckett didn't know how to describe his feelings. He didn't expect that the person he had offended would be the future sect leader, and Jorge's disciple at that.
"Mr. McDonald is Master Yarrell's disciple…" Thomas said to Beckett.
"Mr. Felton!" Andre shouted.
Beckett looked at Andre in confusion.
"Mr. Felton, this is just a piece of amethyst. It doesn't mean anything. What if this amethyst just happened to be picked up by Connor?"
Andre shouted excitedly at Beckett.
After Beckett heard this, his expression seemed to calm down a little. Then, he said, "That's right. Although this amethyst pendant is real, it doesn't mean that this amethyst pendant was really given to Connor by the sect leader. It also doesn't mean that Connor and the sect leader really do have a master-disciple relationship."
After Thomas heard Beckett's words, he could not help but smile faintly. Then, he said, "Master Yarrell had long expected that this would be the case, so he specially asked me to bring a very important person over. After you see this person, you'll probably know if what I said is true!"
After saying this, Thomas took out his phone and dialed a number. Then, he said, "Come in!"
"Alright!"
The other party agreed and then hung up.
Everyone was looking forward to it because they didn't know who would be next.
"Does Connor still have any trump cards?"
"Did Master Yarrell come personally?"
"If Master Yarrell came personally, then that's really great. I've never seen Master Yarrell before!"
Everyone began to discuss in low voices.
Andre's expression was also very nervous because he did not know what would happen in the end!
A few seconds later, a large group of bodyguards walked in.
However, what everyone did not expect was for a chimpanzee to be leading this group of bodyguards.
The chimpanzee's expression was very proud as it walked into the hall like it owned the place.
For a moment, everyone was speechless. No one had expected Thomas to bring a chimpanzee in.
"Why is there a chimpanzee here?"
A hint of confusion flashed across Andre's eyes.
This scene was really too comical. A large group of bodyguards followed closely behind a chimpanzee. What was going on? Some people even laughed at the situation.
When the chimpanzee saw someone snickering, it actually made an angry expression.
This caused everyone to laugh out loud.
Of course, among the many people present, there was one person who couldn't laugh.
This person was, of course, Beckett!
When Beckett saw the chimpanzee, his expression was unusually ugly.
He knew in his heart that this chimpanzee was Jorge's pet. It had been by Jorge's side for so many years.
Seeing this chimpanzee was no different from seeing Jorge himself.
Beckett took a deep breath and ran straight to the chimpanzee. He did something that no one expected.
"I greet you, Deputy Sect Leader!"
Beckett actually knelt in front of the chimpanzee and shouted loudly.
For a moment, everyone was dumbfounded. No one expected him to kneel down in front of a chimpanzee.
Originally, the appearance of a chimpanzee had already made the scene very comical. However, what was even more comical was that someone like Beckett actually knelt in front of this chimpanzee and even called this chimpanzee the Deputy Sect Leader.
Almost everyone was dumbfounded.
Everyone's expressions froze. They knew very well that this matter was not as simple as they had imagined.
The chimpanzee that appeared in the hall was Jabba.
Jabba was also the Deputy Sect Leader of the Purple Cloud Sect.
The moment Jabba appeared, Beckett knew that Thomas wasn't lying. Connor was indeed Jorge's disciple.
Otherwise, Jabba would never have appeared in this place!
Jabba ignored Beckett. Instead, he ran towards Connor and stood beside him.
Connor reached out to touch him and looked at Beckett.
Beckett already knew Connor's identity, so he did not hesitate at all. He walked directly to Connor and shouted, "I, Beckett Felton of the Purple Cloud Sect, greet Sect Leader McDonald!"
Everyone was stunned.
At this moment, they finally understood that Connor was actually Jorge's disciple.
Connor's identity was already unbelievable to everyone, but when they saw Beckett kneeling in front of Connor, they were even more shocked!
Today's show seemed to be coming to an end!
Connor looked at Beckett indifferently and asked, "Beckett, didn't you want to cripple me just now?"
"Sect Leader McDonald, I was blind just now and didn't recognize your identity. I hope you won't lower yourself to my level!" Beckett said nervously to Connor.
"So you're not going to attack me?"
Connor asked Beckett.
"Of course not!"
Beckett quickly shook his head and continued, "Sect Leader McDonald, whoever goes against you is going against me, Beckett. I would rather die than have you go through a mountain of knives or a sea of fire!"
"Haha..."
Connor could not help but laugh when he heard Beckett's words. He did not expect Beckett to change his tune so quickly.
Just now, Beckett had wanted to cripple him, but now was saying he'd to go through a mountain of knives and a sea of fire for him!
"As long as you don't attack me…" Connor replied to Beckett with a calm expression.
"Of course now…"
Beckett shook his head without thinking.
Andre, who was not far away, had an extremely ugly expression on his face when he saw this scene. At this moment, he did not know what to say.
Beckett was obviously invited by him to deal with Connor, but now Beckett had actually become Connor's subordinate. Wasn't this shooting himself in the foot?
Will looked at Beckett, his expression unusually angry.
He had never expected that Beckett would choose to stand on Connor's side just because of a chimpanzee.

chapters.title: Chapter 1299: Turning Point
chapters.content:
Chapter 1299: Turning Point
However, Will might not know how terrifying this chimpanzee was to the Purple Cloud Sect.
Seeing this chimpanzee was no different from seeing Jorge Yarrell himself.
Thomas had originally planned to ask Jorge to come personally, but Tulin Lain had not asked about these things for many years, so naturally, he would not appear on this occasion. If Jorge really appeared, it would probably cause a huge earthquake in the ancient martial arts world.
Beckett was clearly the helper he had invited over, but now he was actually standing on Connor's side. What was going on?
Will was very angry, but no matter how angry he was, he did not dare to show it because he knew how terrifying Beckett's strength was. Even the Washington family did not dare to make an enemy of Beckett.
Andre had to be respectful. He did not dare to disobey Beckett at all.
Therefore, even if Beckett chose to stand on Connor's side, they had no choice.
Offending Beckett was equivalent to offending the Purple Cloud Sect. The Purple Cloud Sect was an existence that shook the entirety of Oprana. Unless the Washington family was really tired of living, they would never dare to go against these people, not even if they had ten thousand guts.
Beckett could be considered the Washington family's last trump card.
But no one expected this last trump card to become Connor's instead.
Will looked at Connor with a helpless expression. He had never thought much of Connor and had planned to use Wilbur Landon and the others to get rid of him.
However, he didn't expect Connor to be Mr. McDonald of Porthampton. However, even after knowing Connor's identity, Will still felt that victory was in his hands. After all, the Washington family's influence was still very large, and he had so many helpers by his side. It would be very easy to get rid of Connor. Even though Connor had found some helpers, Will did not think much of it.
But at this moment, Will was completely in despair.
Because once Beckett chose to stand on Connor's side, the Washington family would have no way to deal with Connor.
Niles and Chase's expressions were also very ugly. They did not expect such an outcome.
Everyone thought that Connor was going to die today, but a chimpanzee suddenly appeared and turned the situation around. The current situation was very unfavorable for them. They didn't have the courage to go against someone like Beckett Felton!
"Brother Landon, we've gotten into big trouble this time. Hurry up and think of what to do!" Chase said nervously to Niles.
After hearing this, Niles looked a little helpless. Then, he said, "Brother Washington, all my hopes are now placed on the Washington family. If the Washington family is unable to do anything, then I can't do anything either…"
"This…"
When Chase heard this, he was stunned. His expression was unusually speechless.
At this moment, the Yearwood family was even more helpless. Before, they had looked down on Connor, but now they knew how ridiculous their previous actions were.
Porthampton City's Mr. McDonald, Jorge's disciple, and the Purple Cloud Sect's Sect Leader McDonald…all these prestigious titles belonged to one person. Even the top families in Oprana would not be able to withstand the power of this person.
Originally, everyone in the Yearwood family thought that Connor was a small figure, so it would be very easy for them to get rid of him. However, they now knew that Connor's background was so terrifying that it was practically unbelievable.
Previously, there were still people who looked down on Connor, but now, if they still dared to look down on Connor, they would be extremely stupid.
And now, everyone understood why Connor could be so confident from the beginning to the end.
From the beginning, it was likely that Connor didn't even think much of everyone here at all. When everyone thought that Connor was an ant, he was actually a fierce tiger.
In Connor's eyes, these people were existences like ants!
"Oh no… our Yearwood family has offended a noble this time!"
At this moment, Tom felt like he was going to be sick with regret. He didn't know how to describe his feelings.
For a moment, everyone's gaze was on Connor alone. His expression was still very calm.
No one had expected that this ordinary-looking young man in front of them would actually have such terrifying power.
The relationship between Connor and Joey Shaw and the relationship between Connor and Jorge Yarrell felt like a huge mountain pressing down on everyone's hearts.
They really could not imagine how heaven-defying Connor's luck was to be able to obtain the favor of so many people at the same time.
Connor didn't care about their gazes at all as he quietly fed Jabba a banana.
Freya seemed to be very interested in Jabba as well. She smiled at Connor and asked, "Connor, why is this chimpanzee so powerful? Those people seem to be very afraid of him…"
"Of course Jabba is powerful. I was bullied by him many times back then…" Connor chuckled as he replied to Freya.
Camila looked at this scene and couldn't help but frown. She looked at Connor in disbelief.
How could she have expected things to turn out like this?
She had thought that Connor would definitely die today, but when she saw Ted Hons and Bailey Banks appear, Camila vaguely felt that things had turned around.
However, Beckett's appearance had completely shattered her hopes. What was even more unexpected was that Beckett would stand on Connor's side in the end.
This time, the Washington family had lost completely, and there was no way to turn the tables ever again. Even the Yearwood family had lost face because of this incident.
Camila didn't know how to describe her feelings. If she had known earlier that Connor had such great abilities, she wouldn't have treated him the way she had.
She felt nothing but regret now. But no matter how regretful she was, it was useless. After all, things had already reached this point. It was impossible for her to salvage her relationship with Connor.
Back then, when everyone knew that Freya had chosen Connor over Will, they had all thought that Freya was too stupid. But now, they knew that the smartest person was actually Freya. She had chosen Connor, someone that even the entire Washington family could not contend against.
How could Will Washington be compared to Connor McDonald?

chapters.title: Chapter 1300: Terrifying Influence
chapters.content:
Chapter 1300: Terrifying Influence
At this moment, Camila couldn't help but recall what Connor had said to her.
"Even the Washington and Yearwood Families are nothing but ants to me!"
When Camila heard Connor's words, she thought that Connor was young and arrogant, so he dared to say such arrogant words.
After all, even if Connor was the Mr. McDonald of Porthampton, he might not be able to suppress the Washington Family and the Yearwood Family.
However, if Connor was given a little more time and allowed to progress further.
Perhaps Connor could really look down on the two big families, but this would take time. She didn't believe that Connor had the capability to do so now.
However, she now understood that Connor did have the qualifications to say this. The Washington Family and the Yearwood Family were nothing to him.
After all, no matter how powerful these two families were, they definitely did not dare to go against the Purple Cloud Sect!
If these two families really offended the Purple Cloud Sect, they might be instantly destroyed by the Purple Cloud Sect. At that time, they might not even have the chance to ask for help.
This was the terrifying aspect of an ancient martial arts sect.
No matter how powerful the Yearwood and Washington Families are, they could not be compared to the Purple Cloud Sect. They were on completely different levels!
"Freya has really found a good son-in-law for the Yearwood Family. Connor is really amazing!"
At this moment, Camila's father shouted excitedly.
"Yeah. You have found a huge treasure this time…"
"You mustn't forget about us in the future!"
Everyone hurriedly said.
"Alright, alright…"
Camila's father replied with a smile.
After all, he had been in the Yearwood Family for so many years and had never had any status. He had no right to speak in the Yearwood Family and had never been respected by others.
He felt that he could hold his head high today. Once Connor married Freya, then as Freya's grandfather, his status in the Yearwood Family would definitely rise.
After hearing Camila's father's words, everyone looked very envious.
At this moment, no one dared to laugh at him, nor did anyone dare to look down on him.
Camila looked at her father helplessly. After all, her father still didn't know what was going on. Connor's impression of her was so bad that it couldn't get any worse. Why would Connor help them? No matter how terrifying Connor's background was, it wouldn't do them any good.
Leona was staring at Connor with her beautiful eyes. At this moment, her originally nervous mood finally relaxed.
From the beginning, she felt that Connor might not lose today, but later on, she began to worry about Connor because the Washington Family was really powerful.
However, the final outcome confirmed her guess!
Connor really didn't lose, and he won very beautifully!
This was simply a shocking comeback.
Meanwhile, Freya had been sitting quietly beside Connor. At this moment, she was feeling very complicated. She had not expected Connor to have such a terrifying background.
But no matter what, Freya knew that he wouldn't lose to the Washington Family today. This made her feel much better.
Freya had been very worried about Connor.
She was worried that if Connor was beaten into a cripple by the Washington Family, what would she do?
But now, she realized that her previous worries were unnecessary.
Connor's confidence was not faked, but because he really had the confidence to stand here.
Connor had the confidence to ignore those people from the Washington Family. From the beginning, Connor had never feared these people.
Leonardo and the others were also deeply shocked.
No one had expected such a situation.
Leonardo's eyes were fixed on Connor, and he seemed to have not recovered from the shock from before.
"Oh my God, how unbelievable…"
"That's right, Connor actually turned the tables? He is not only the Mr. McDonald of Porthampton but also Jorge Yarrell's disciple…"
"If Connor can become Jorge Yarrell's disciple, how terrifying will his future achievements be?"
"Connor is only in his twenties now. If Connor is given a few more years, there will probably not be anyone who can be his enemy in Oprana."
"This Mr. McDonald is really not an ordinary person. Otherwise, he wouldn't be here!"
The bosses present began to discuss in low voices.
After all, when everyone saw Beckett appear, they all thought that Connor would die today. However, no one expected things to develop so dramatically. Beckett actually stood on Connor's side.
Beckett was an Earth-rank martial artist, and even the Washington Family couldn't go against him.
The middle-aged man who had made a bet with Leonardo smiled and asked, "Mr. Sabin, who do you think will win the bet?"
Leonardo couldn't help but sigh when he heard the middle-aged man's words. He said with a helpless expression, "I have really misjudged the situation this time around. I really did not expect Connor to have such a background. However, I have lost wholeheartedly this time around. To be able to see such an exciting thing, even if I have to pay 10 million, I feel that it is worth it…"
The middle-aged man couldn't help but laugh when he heard Leonardo's words.
In fact, everyone knew that if Connor was really Jorge's disciple, then there was no doubt that he would lose.
Even if they invited the highest-ranking leader over, they wouldn't be able to do anything to Jorge.
After all, Jorge was the sect leader of the Purple Cloud Sect. His status in the ancient martial arts world was very high. If he really wanted to protect Connor, no one in Oprana would dare to touch Connor.
This was Jorge's terrifying influence!
"The show is finally over. How interesting!"
Leonardo took out a check and handed it to the middle-aged man.
The middle-aged man took the check and said with a smile, "Mr. Sabin, you don't have to be too anxious. After all, the real show has just begun. Just now, those people from the Washington Family made things difficult for Mr. McDonald. I don't think he will let these people off easily."
"What else do you want to bet with me?"
Leonardo was stunned for a moment and asked.

chapters.title: Chapter 1301: It's Over
chapters.content:
Chapter 1301: It's Over
"Let's bet on how Connor plans to deal with these people. What say you?"
The middle-aged man asked Leonardo with a smile.
When Leonardo heard the middle-aged man's words, he quickly shook his head and said softly, "I lost ten million to you just now, which means that my luck today is a little bad. I'd better not bet with you. Find someone else…"
The middle-aged man couldn't help but laugh when he heard this. He didn't say anything else.
At this moment, Connor slowly stood up and walked to Niles Landon's side. He said to Niles expressionlessly, "It's time to end the matter between the two of us…"
"How?"
Niles was stunned for a moment, then he stuttered and asked Connor.
"You asked me for an explanation just now. In that case, I will give you an explanation now…"
Connor said calmly.
Niles looked at Connor with an unusually nervous expression. He gritted his teeth and said, "Mr. McDonald, no matter what, you beat my son up to such a state. As a father, I want to seek justice for my son. Is there a problem with that?"
"Seek justice?"
Connor couldn't help but sneer when he heard this. Then, he said indifferently, "Back then, your son deliberately set me up and even wanted his people to cripple me. It was only because these people were inferior that I broke his arms and legs. Now, what justice do you want? Don't tell me that you'll only feel that it's fair if I'm crippled by your son?"
"That's not what I meant…"
Niles whispered.
"If that's not what you mean, what do you mean?"
Connor asked expressionlessly.
After hearing Connor's words, a trace of fear flashed across Niles's eyes. Then, he stuttered, "Mr. McDonald, it's a misunderstanding. My son didn't intend to hurt you. How could my son do such a thing to you? After all, there's no conflict between the two of you, right?"
"It's a misunderstanding?"
Connor couldn't help but sneer. Then, he turned to Ted Hons and said expressionlessly, "Explain to him. Did I misunderstand Wilbur Landon?"
"Alright, Mr. McDonald!"
Ted nodded and walked up to Niles. He said in a low voice, "Mr. McDonald is right. Back then, Wilbur had indeed planned it with me. He wanted to deliberately anger Mr. McDonald and make Mr. McDonald attack him. If that were to happen, I was supposed to attack Mr. McDonald and cripple him or kill him. However, no one expected Mr. McDonald to be so powerful. I was not Mr. McDonald's match at all, and that was why Wilbur…"
"What a bunch of nonsense!"
Niles shouted.
Ted glanced at Niles and said expressionlessly, "What I said is the truth. At that time, Bailey also heard the conversation between Wilbur and me. Bailey can also testify!"
"That's right, that's what happened!"
Bailey Banks nodded gently.
"No, that's impossible. Why would my son do this? What's his motive for doing this?"
Niles shouted at Ted.
Ted slowly raised his head to look at Will Washington, then said softly, "This was all Will Washington's idea!"
"Will Washington's idea?"
When everyone heard this, they quickly turned to look at Will.
Will was a little nervous. He hurriedly shouted at Ted, "Ted, don't spout nonsense!"
"I'm not spouting nonsense. Bailey can testify for me!"
Ted said lightly.
"Ted, you said this was Will's idea, so why did Will want to deal with Connor?"
Andre Washington stepped forward and asked.
"Will likes Freya and thinks that Mr. McDonald has stolen his woman. That's why he asked Wilbur and I to attack Connor. If that's the case, Connor will become a cripple and will not be able to compete with him for Freya…"
Ted said without hesitation.
"Ted, what nonsense are you talking about? When did I tell you about these things?"
Will shouted at Ted.
"You did say that!"
Bailey said expressionlessly.
If Ted was the only one who said this, it might not be convincing. However, if Bailey and Ted both said the same thing, it was enough to prove that Ted's words were true.
At that moment, everyone was looking at Will, and Will's face darkened.
Niles did not know what to do.
After all, Ted had already admitted to all that, and Bailey was also there to testify. There was no point in refuting him now!
"I didn't expect Wilbur Landon and Will Washington to be so despicable."
"That's right. How dare he have the nerve to accuse Connor…"
"They are really detestable. If it wasn't for Mr. McDonald's terrifying background, if it were anyone else, they would probably have been beaten into a cripple long ago…"
"Even if you rely on your family background, you can't do this, right?"
"Wilbur Landon actually did such a shameless thing. He's really despicable. I think that he deserves it. Mr. McDonald did nothing wrong!"
Everyone present was one-sided and began to criticize Niles.
Niles turned to look at Andre.
He realized that Andre was also in a foul mood. It would seem that they had no way out of this.
Although Andre knew what was going on, being criticized by so many people in front of him made him feel very uncomfortable. Moreover, he did not expect things to end up like this.
"Is there anything else you want to say? Do you still want me to give you an explanation?"
Connor asked Niles expressionlessly.
