After hesitating for a moment, Niles hurriedly bowed to Connor and said to Connor nervously, "It was all the Landon Family's fault. It's all my son's fault for offending you. He actually wanted to set you up and hurt you. He deserves what happened to him. I hope you can forgive me…"
Niles was a smart person. He knew that he had no other way out, so the best way was to beg for Connor's forgiveness.
Otherwise, if Connor also made a move on him, their loss would be even bigger.

chapters.title: Chapter 1302: The Greatest Humiliation
chapters.content:
Chapter 1302: The Greatest Humiliation
Connor looked at Niles expressionlessly without saying a word.
After all, things had already reached this point. Connor had no intention of letting these people off at all.
Furthermore, Connor had come here this time to deal with the relationship between Freya and the Yearwood Family. In fact, these people had taken the initiative to come to Connor to provide him with a good opportunity to establish his authority. Connor planned to let everyone know what kind of existence he was.
When facing some people, Connor might not go too far, but when facing people like Niles, he would not have the slightest pity.
Niles seemed to have sensed that Connor did not intend to let him go. He was not willing to sacrifice his life for such a small matter. After hesitating for a couple of seconds, he knelt in front of Connor and exclaimed, "Mr. McDonald, I was wrong. I hope that you can forgive me and let the Landon Family off this time…"
When everyone saw Niles kneeling in front of Connor, they could not help but take a deep breath. They were dumbstruck.
Even Leonardo's eyes flashed with a trace of shock. Then, he said in a low voice, "This is the famous Niles Landon. He's actually kneeling before someone?"
"Yeah, I thought that Niles would try to fight back. I didn't expect him to kneel down so quickly…"
Everyone found it hard to understand.
After all, Niles was the head of the Landon Family, and the Landon Family was one of the top ten families in Beverly Hills.
However, Niles was actually kneeling down in front of Connor in front of so many people. This scene was really shocking.
This meant that the entire Landon Family had lowered their heads to Connor.
If these people had not seen it with their own eyes, who would believe that Niles would kneel down to someone younger than him?
If this matter were to spread, who knew what kind of terrifying impact it would bring!
The Yearwood Family members all took a deep breath.
When they saw Niles kneeling in front of Connor, they truly understood how terrifying Connor was.
Even someone like Niles was kneeling. In Connor's eyes, they were just ants.
At that time, Connor looked down on the Yearwood Family. Everyone thought that Connor was overestimating himself. However, now they knew that the Yearwood Family was nothing in Connor's eyes.
Connor and Niles did not have any deep hatred for each other, so Connor felt that he had achieved his goal with Niles kneeling before him. At the very least, he could intimidate everyone in the Yearwood Family.
Therefore, Connor asked Niles softly, "Your son deliberately framed me and provoked me time and time again. I broke his legs so that he will remember this lesson forever."
Connor's tone was very calm, so calm that it made people feel a little scared.
When Niles heard Connor's words, he hurriedly shouted, "Mr. McDonald, this is all my son's fault. I admit it wholeheartedly. I have no complaints. I hope that Mr. McDonald can let me off this time…"
Niles knelt in front of Connor, his body trembling non-stop. When he said this, the anger in his heart was even more obvious.
After all, his son was beaten into a cripple, but he had to kneel down and beg for Connor's forgiveness. What was the logic in that?
This was simply the greatest humiliation of his life, and also the humiliation of the Landon Family!
However, he knew that he really had no other choice. The Washington Family could not even protect themselves. He did not have the right to negotiate with Connor at all, so now he could only beg Connor to forgive him.
Otherwise, with Connor's status, it would be very easy for him to uproot the Landon Family.
Once that time came, there might not even be a chance for regret.
Niles didn't want Connor to get rid of everyone in the Landon Family because of this matter.
Moreover, although Wilbur was now a cripple, he was still alive. Perhaps he could stand up again in the future when medical technology was more developed.
Moreover, Niles did not only have one son. He had other illegitimate children, so when the time came, he could let his illegitimate child inherit the Landon Family's business.
Niles felt that the current situation was not unacceptable.
Although it was a little embarrassing, as long as he was still alive, he was the head of the Landon Family. No matter how others ridiculed him, it was much better than losing his life now. Moreover, once this matter passed, people would eventually forget about it and not bring it up ever again.
Moreover, Niles had lost to someone like Connor, so he had nothing to be ashamed of.
After all, even the Washington Family was not Connor's match.
Freya seemed to be worried that Connor would not let Niles off. After all, she did not want Connor to make too many enemies, so she reached out and gently tugged at him.
Connor turned to look at Freya, then said to Niles expressionlessly, "I hope you can remember this lesson!"
"Mr. McDonald, I will remember this lesson. I won't do it again!"
Niles hurriedly shouted.
"Alright…"
Connor nodded his head lightly, then turned his head to look at Chase Jones. A hint of disdain flashed across his face.
When Chase saw Connor's gaze, his legs couldn't help but tremble. Then, he hurriedly shouted, "Mr. McDonald, I was wrong. Please let me go!"
After saying this, Chase did not even think about it and knelt in front of Connor. He exclaimed, "Mr. McDonald, I beg you, please let me go!"
At this moment, Chase was filled with regret. When he heard that the Washington Family and Landon Family wanted to make a move against Connor, he felt that this was a good opportunity, so he took the initiative to help the Landon Family.
That was why he had appeared here and planned to help the Landon Family deal with Connor. In fact, he planned to wait until Connor had been eliminated before he would openly take over the Malone Family's businesses.
As for saying that he wanted to avenge Alexander Malone, that was just an excuse. Chase and Alexander did not even know each other that well.
However, he never expected that things would turn out like this. Not only did he not get any benefits, but he even brought upon himself a fatal disaster!
"So, you know that you did something wrong?"
Connor looked at Chase and smiled.
"Yes…"
Chase hurriedly nodded.
"Which is?"
Connor asked indifferently.
"I shouldn't have tried to go after the Malone Family's assets. I know I was wrong to attack you, Mr. McDonald…"
Chase kept fanning himself as he spoke, then continued, "Mr. McDonald, I was wrong. I hope you can let me off. As long as you let me off now, I'm willing to do whatever you want me to do. I won't dare to offend you again. I beg you…"

chapters.title: Chapter 1303: Begging for Mercy
chapters.content:
Chapter 1303: Begging for Mercy
"Aren't you planning to seek revenge for Alexander?" Connor smiled and asked Chase.
Upon hearing his question, Chase couldn't help but pause for a moment, and then stuttered, "Mr. Connor, to be honest, Alexander is not my benefactor, and I didn't mean to seek revenge for him..."
Everyone's expressions showed helplessness upon hearing Chase's words. No one expected him to be so submissive in front of Connor and admit to everything.
Connor's eyes flashed with disdain, but he didn't continue to argue with Chase.
He was well aware that Chase was only seeking temporary gains, which led him to try and harm Connor.
But in truth, there was no deep hatred between them, and Connor had no intention of hating or killing Chase over this matter.
Chase had no backbone, and after this incident, he would probably tremble at the mere mention of Connor's name. Connor wasn't worried about any retaliation from Chase.
Instead, Connor turned his gaze to Terry.
Terry was now feeling dumbfounded. He had hoped that with Chase's support, he could reclaim his position as the head of the Malone family. But he never expected everything to turn out this way.
Terry stared at him, his face filled with anger. He felt that everything was because of Connor. If not for Connor, he would most likely still be the heir of the Malone family and inherit its assets.
Connor killing Alexander turned him into an insignificant figure in the Malone family.
If not for his terrifying skills, Terry might have considered hiring an assassin to deal with him.
But now he knew Connor's true identity - a closed-door disciple of Jorge. No assassin would dare to lay a finger on Connor!
Besides, he couldn't afford to pay much money for an assassin anyway.
"And you? Do you realize your mistake now?" Connor asked Terry expressionlessly.
Upon hearing Connor, Terry couldn't help but take a deep breath and said through gritted teeth, "I haven't made a mistake. It was you who killed our Malone family's head. I will never get along with you, and one day I will take revenge. Just wait and see..."
"Ignorant fool!" Connor's eyes flashed with disdain, and he continued, "Back then, when I was at the Malone family, I spared you once because of Mina's face. But I never expected you to be so ignorant and even try to harm me. This time, I won't forgive you..."
"What do you want to do?" Terry asked nervously.
Connor ignored Terry and turned directly to Beckett, saying, "Since this man doesn't know any better, break his legs and arms, and then throw him out..."
"Yes..." Beckett nodded and immediately went to Terry's side.
"Don't come near me! Do you know who I am? If you dare to touch me, I'll... Ah..." Before Terry could finish his words, a scream echoed.
A few seconds later, his legs and arms were broken, and he was thrown out.
Everything happened so suddenly that everyone present only heard a few screams from Terry before seeing him thrown out. No one expected Connor to be so ruthless, actually taking action against Terry.
The Yearwood family members immediately rushed Terry to the hospital, but it was probably too late. Beckett's attack was much harsher than Connor's.
Although Terry's status was insignificant in the eyes of these people, Connor breaking his legs was a warning to everyone present. They all understood that at this moment, Connor not only dared to take action against Terry but also against any of them.
The Yearwood family members' expressions turned tense at this moment. After all, they had offended Connor to some extent before, and they were genuinely worried about what would happen if Connor decided to retaliate against them.
Bailey stood behind Connor, her beautiful eyes fixed on his back, feeling extremely excited.
In her eyes, he was a true influential figure, decisive and without any hesitation.
She had heard many things about him before, but this was the first time she had seen him take action.
Leona's eyes also showed a hint of surprise. Over the years, she had encountered many outstanding young talents, but in her eyes, they couldn't compare to Connor. He exuded an aura of dominance that the others lacked.
"No wonder Freya fell for this man. He indeed possesses an irresistible charm!" Leona couldn't help but sigh in her heart.
Meanwhile, Niles and Chase knelt on the ground, their expressions filled with fear. They secretly felt fortunate that they had kneeled down to apologize to Connor earlier. If they hadn't, it might have been their legs broken by now.
Andre's body trembled slightly, and he subconsciously looked at Beckett.
However, Beckett ignored him. He also felt dissatisfied with him. If Andre hadn't called him here, he wouldn't have offended Connor. Fortunately, Thomas revealed Connor's identity; otherwise, he might have been in big trouble if he had truly attacked Connor.
Connor then looked calmly at Andre.
Upon seeing his gaze, Andre couldn't help but smile bitterly and said softly, "It seems like today our Washington family lost!"
The others couldn't help but feel sorrowful upon hearing Andre's words. Who could have imagined that the Washington family would be defeated by Connor in the end?
"Mr. Connor, I apologize for being ignorant. I hope you can spare my grandson, considering the somewhat intertwined relationship between our Washington family and the Purple Cloud Sect. I promise that the Washington family will never oppose you again..."

chapters.title: Chapter 1304: What More Do You Want?
chapters.content:
Chapter 1304: What More Do You Want?
When Andre said this, his lips kept trembling.
After all these years, Andre had never begged anyone so humbly.
He cared deeply about his reputation, but this incident had destroyed all the reputation he had accumulated in the first half of his life.
Grayson looked at Andre and felt helpless.
Andre was now approaching old age, while Connor was only twenty years old, even younger than Andre's grandson. Yet, Andre took the initiative to apologize to Connor, which was truly incredible.
"The Washington family is ultimately defeated!"
The people present sighed helplessly.
If they hadn't witnessed the whole process, no one would believe that the Washington family had truly lost to Connor!
"Grandfather, what are you doing? Why should we apologize to him? What is he compared to us?"
Will's eyes flashed with anger as he walked quickly to Andre's side and exclaimed loudly.
"Shut up..."
Andre coldly reprimanded, then said expressionlessly, "If it weren't for you, our Washington family wouldn't have offended Mr. Connor. Now, kneel down and apologize to Mr. Connor!"
"Grandfather, what are you saying?"
Upon hearing his words, Will was stunned, wearing an incredibly puzzled expression on his face.
"I'm telling you to kneel down and apologize to Mr. Connor. Didn't you hear me?" he replied without emotion.
"Why should I kneel down and apologize to this person? I won't kneel!" Will stubbornly shouted.
"Unfilial grandson! I order you to kneel down!" he raised his voice.
"I said I won't kneel, I did nothing wrong!" Will gritted his teeth.
"Fine, since you refuse to kneel, I'll kneel on your behalf to Mr. Connor!" Andre shouted and actually intended to kneel before Connor.
"Grandfather, what are you doing?"
He hurriedly reached out to stop Andre and whispered, "Why don't I kneel? Is that not enough?"
After saying this, he directly knelt in front of Connor, staring at him with a fierce expression. He wanted to remember this moment.
"Apologize!" Andre said in a low voice.
He took a deep breath and then said expressionlessly, "Connor, I was wrong..."
"Do you truly understand your mistakes?" Connor asked calmly.
"You..."
Will's expression turned exceptionally angry, but he still gritted his teeth and said, "I truly understand my mistakes. I hope you, as the bigger person, can let me go."
For a moment, everyone fell into silence. They all stared at him in astonishment.
No one had expected it to end this way. Will actually knelt down and apologized to Connor.
Connor, on the other hand, remained expressionless, as if he hadn't seen Will at all.
Will didn't dare to stand up as Connor didn't say anything. He continued to kneel there.
At this moment, his expression looked extremely ugly. No matter what, Will was known as a privileged young master, admired wherever he went. Yet, now he was kneeling in front of someone who had once been looked down upon by everyone. He even had thoughts of wanting to die.
But he knew he couldn't die because he still had to find a chance for revenge.
Andre seemed unable to bear it and walked over to Connor, then said softly, "Mr. Connor, my grandson has already understood his mistake. Can you let him stand up now?"
"Get up!" Connor said calmly.
Will heard this and quickly stood up.
Andre took a deep breath and then turned to the crowd, saying, "I'm really sorry for the trouble we caused today. I hope you can all forgive us."
After saying that, Andre prepared to leave with Will.
After all, the Washington family had already lost face today, and he didn't have the face to stay any longer.
"Have I allowed you to leave?"
But at that moment, Connor suddenly spoke up.
Andre was taken aback, turned to look at Connor, and asked with a puzzled tone, "Mr. Connor, do you have anything else to say?"
"If you want to leave with Will, you can, but you have to pay a price," Connor said calmly.
"What price?" Andre asked through gritted teeth.
"Connor, I already knelt down to you. What more do you want?" Will shouted angrily.
"Although you knelt down and apologized to me, it doesn't mean you can leave unscathed..." Connor replied emotionlessly, "Wilbur had both his hands and legs broken by me. As for you, I'll just break your legs, and then you can leave."
"Connor, do you know who I am? If you dare to touch me again today, you will regret it!" Will shouted furiously.
"Mr. Connor, we have already apologized. Isn't this going too far?" Andre also exclaimed in anger.
"Now I'm the one who has won. Breaking Will's legs is already quite merciful. But if today were reversed, what would you do to me? Would you simply kill me?" Connor narrowed his eyes and asked Andre.
Andre was at a loss for words upon hearing Connor's question.
Indeed, if Connor had lost today, his fate might have been much worse than just having his legs broken.
"Take action!" Connor said to Beckett.
"Yes!"
Beckett nodded and then stepped toward Will.
"Mr. Connor, please, don't do it! I beg you!" Andre hurriedly pleaded with Beckett.
However, Beckett acted as if he hadn't heard anything, and he directly kicked Will's thigh.
Soon after, Will let out a miserable cry and fell to the ground.
A few seconds later, Beckett returned to Connor's side.
Andre stared at Connor with a combination of anger and helplessness in his eyes.
But after a moment, Andre sighed softly and said in a low voice, "What a calamity..."
After saying that, he left the hall with the unconscious Will.
He knew that there was no point in staying any longer.
And thus, the play finally ended with his departure.
The final outcome surprised everyone.
After Andre left with Will, the people present were no longer in the mood to continue the celebration. They bid farewell to Grayson and started to leave.
After going through so much, Grayson was also not in the mood to continue the birthday banquet, so after a brief exchange of pleasantries with everyone, he began to see them off.
It was estimated that it wouldn't take long for the events of today at the Yearwood family mansion to spread throughout Salistan, or even the whole of Oprana.
By then, everyone would have a new impression of Connor, Mr. Connor.

chapters.title: Chapter 1305: A Missed Opportunity
chapters.content:
Chapter 1305: A Missed Opportunity
"Mr. Connor, we'll be leaving too!"
Thomas, Kyle, and others looked at Connor and said.
"You've both worked hard..."
Connor replied softly.
Thomas and Kyle smiled faintly and then left with Jabba.
Although Connor didn't say much, he was actually very grateful to these two. No matter when, they always appeared when he was in the most dangerous situations.
After a little over half an hour, only Connor and the Yearwood family members remained in the Yearwood family estate.
Grayson walked up to Camila excitedly and said, "Camila, your daughter has found a good husband for our Yearwood family this time!"
"It's just Freya's luck..."
Camila was also in shock at this moment and stammered in response.
"I owe you all this time. I never expected Connor's background to be so terrifying. If I had known, I wouldn't have treated Connor that way back then. Instead, I would have tried to please him..."
Grayson continued.
"Pleasing Connor?"
After hearing this, a hint of helplessness flashed in Camila's eyes.
After all, he didn't know that her relationship with Connor was also very bad. She was the one who looked down on Connor the most in the past, so she quickly said, "Please don't say that. Some things are not as you think. There were some misunderstandings between Connor and me..."
"No matter what, you are Connor's mother-in-law. What misunderstandings could there be between you two? I feel really guilty now. Things have turned out like this, and I don't know if it will affect the relationship between Freya and Connor..."
Now, Grayson's biggest concern was probably this matter. After all, Will and Andre had completely withdrawn from this competition, and they could only pin their hopes on Connor.
However, Connor's background was impressive enough for the Yearwood family to rely on.
"Well..."
Camila didn't know what to say to Grayson.
"Camila, this son-in-law of yours is not an ordinary person. If our Yearwood family can find such a powerful backer, maybe we can achieve even greater things in the future..."
Grayson didn't hide his thoughts and directly spoke to Camila.
Camila felt proud when she heard this, as having Grayson speak to her like this had always been something she dreamed of. Today, she finally achieved it.
But deep down, she was worried that her relationship with Connor might not be that good, and it wouldn't be easy to ask him to take care of the Yearwood family.
So she continued, "I haven't known Connor for very long. There are some things I can't speak about. You should let Freya handle it!"
After hearing this, he immediately understood Camila's meaning and quickly walked up to Freya with a smile and said, "Freya, I know you haven't lived in our Yearwood family for so many years, but no matter what, you have our Yearwood family's blood in you. So, can you talk to Mr. Connor for our sake and let him take care of our Yearwood family in the future!"
Freya heard Grayson's words and her eyes flashed with helplessness. Then, she subconsciously glanced at Connor.
"Say what you want to say!"
Connor said softly to Freya.
"Well..."
Freya nodded gently and then said expressionlessly, "Now you know I am part of the Yearwood family? When you used me, did you ever consider these things? When you all obstructed me from being with Connor, did you think about these things?"
"Freya, I was just confused back then..."
Grayson hurriedly said.
"It might be a little too late to realize it now!"
Freya said without expression and continued, "This time, I came here to tell all of you in the Yearwood family that I am Camila's daughter, but I do not consider Camila my mother. She has never fulfilled her responsibilities as a mother and has always tried to use me. I don't think someone like her deserves to be my mother!"
Camila's face looked extremely ugly upon hearing this, but she didn't dare to speak.
"Also, I don't have any feelings for your Yearwood family, and yet you have always tried to use me. First, you wanted me to marry Will to please the Wang family, and now you want to use me to please Connor. I, Freya, am not a tool, and the things you've done make me sick. So, from now on, I, Freya, have no relation to your Yearwood family, and I don't want anyone from your family to disturb my life anymore..."
After saying this, Freya felt much better. She turned to look at Connor.
Connor, on the other hand, looked at everyone coldly and said, "Freya is my fiancée. Did you all hear that?"
Everyone looked at Connor nervously, their expressions filled with unease.
"Are you all mute? Did you hear it clearly or not?"
Connor shouted in a low voice.
"We heard it clearly..."
Grayson nodded helplessly.
"If any of you from the Yearwood family dare to come and influence Freya's life again, don't blame me for not being polite!"
After saying this, Connor turned to Freya and said, "It's over now. We should leave."
"Yes..."
Freya nodded quickly.
Connor directly held Freya's hand and walked toward the exit of the estate.
The people from the Yearwood family looked at Connor and Freya's retreating figures, their expressions full of helplessness.
At this moment, they really wanted to keep Connor and Freya, as it was a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity for their Yearwood family. However, no one dared to speak now, as if they had shown Connor a little kindness back then, things would not have turned out like this.
As for Camila, her face was not only embarrassed but also grim. She had never expected Freya to be so heartless, not even giving her, her own biological mother, any face.
Grayson sighed lightly and said expressionlessly, "I originally thought that Camila was Freya's mother, and Freya might give our Yearwood family a chance for Camila's sake. But now it seems that it's a little too late. Our Yearwood family has missed a great opportunity..."
It could be heard that Grayson was filled with regret as he said these words.

chapters.title: Chapter 1306: There's Still a Turning Point
chapters.content:
Chapter 1306: There's Still a Turning Point
The Yearwood Family was also very helpless. Today, the Yearwood Family not only lost the Washington Family, but also offended Connor.
It was already a blessing in disguise that Connor was not taking revenge on them.
They actually hoped that Connor could protect the Yearwood Family, but that was simply a fool's dream.
For a moment, everyone fell into deep self-blame.
After all, what they did this time was really stupid. They had clearly encountered a great opportunity, but they had personally ruined it.
If this matter were to spread out, the entire Yearwood Family would become a joke in the eyes of others.
"Father, you don't have to be too sad. After all, no one expected Connor's background to be so terrifying. We can't be blamed for misjudging him…"
Tom Yearwood hesitated for a moment before whispering to Grayson.
When Grayson heard this, he became a little angry, and he shouted, "You actually have the nerve to say this. Are you all trash? The Yearwood Family has so many connections, yet we can't even investigate this matter clearly. How useless can you all be? No matter what price I have to pay, I must make Connor stay with me…"
When the crowd saw Grayson's anger, they became very nervous.
Everyone lowered their heads and did not dare to speak.
But at this time, Leona suddenly said, "Grandpa, although Connor is very powerful, so what? He won't take revenge on the Yearwood Family because of this. In the future, we will just mind our own business. Even without Connor, the Yearwood Family will still be the Yearwood Family. It won't affect us…"
When everyone heard Leona's words, they nodded in agreement.
They all felt that if the Yearwood Family could get Connor's help, it would naturally be the best. However, if Connor didn't intend to help the Yearwood Family, then it wouldn't have much of an impact on the Yearwood Family.
A hint of helplessness flashed across Grayson's eyes as he whispered, "Didn't you hear what Connor said to the us? Is the Yearwood Family still the same as before? I'm already eighty years old this year, and I only have a few years to live. Once I die, which one of you can support the entire Yearwood Family?"
Everyone fell silent.
"Once I pass away, our family will become the target of public criticism. In less than three years, we will become an unknown small family. The foundation that I have worked so hard to build will be taken by others. I am not willing to accept this…"
Grayson couldn't help but sigh, and then continued, "That's why I want Connor's help, because he can protect our family's business. Tell me what you're all good for? All you do is slack around and do nothing. If our family can find a descendant who can match one-tenth of Connor, I won't have to do this."
For a moment, everyone was speechless.
They didn't know how to answer this question.
They also knew in their hearts that they really did not have the ability to support the Yearwood Family. Moreover, the family had offended many enemies for so many years. Once Grayson died, the family would be in great danger.
"I'll go to Connor and kneel down to ask for forgiveness."
Tom shouted excitedly.
When everyone heard Tom's words, they felt terrible. After all, they were the ones who wanted to kick Connor out of the family, but now they were going to beg Connor to come back!
Nothing in this world could be more humiliating than this!
"Even if you kneel and beg for Connor to come back, he might not be able to come back!"
Grayson shook his head helplessly.
"He won't?"
Tom couldn't help but smile bitterly when he heard this. He looked extremely helpless.
Everyone in the family was dumbfounded when they heard Grayson's words. They looked extremely dejected.
Because at this moment, they realized how important Connor was to their family.
If they were simply told how important Connor was, the family wouldn't be able to understand.
However, after Grayson said these words, it was obvious that he was telling everyone in the Yearwood Family that Connor could replace Grayson's position in the future.
The current Yearwood Family was completely supported by Grayson alone. If the family did not have the protection of Grayson, then it might be no different from an ordinary small family. However, Grayson was now old, and it was impossible to protect the Yearwood Family like this forever.
Therefore, everything that Grayson had done before was nothing more than trying to find a new backer for the Yearwood Family. This new backer had already appeared and gave them a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity. Unfortunately, these people did not seize this opportunity.
No one had expected that the family would place their hopes on Connor and Freya Phillips. In the past, the Yearwood Family had looked down on Connor and Freya. Now, it could only be described as fate playing tricks on them.
"Father, what should we do now?"
Tom hesitated for a moment and asked Grayson nervously.
Grayson slowly raised his head and looked at Tom with a helpless expression on his face. He gently shook his head and said in a low voice, "I do not know what to do now. We have already missed the best opportunity. It is impossible for us to retain Connor now…"
When everyone heard Grayson's words, they seemed to be even more worried.
After all, this matter might affect the future fate of the Yearwood Family. How could they not take it to heart?
For a moment, everyone in the Yearwood Family lowered their heads. No one knew what they were thinking.
After all, from the very beginning, they had never expected such an outcome.
If they had known that this would happen, then even if they were given a hundred guts, they would definitely not dare to offend Connor!
"Actually, I think there's still a turning point for this!"
At this time, Leona, who had been standing beside Grayson, suddenly spoke.

chapters.title: Chapter 1307: The Curtain Falls
chapters.content:
Chapter 1307: The Curtain Falls
Hearing Leona's words, everyone turned their heads to look at her, and they seemed to be somewhat puzzled.
"Leona, do you have any good ideas?"
Tom asked excitedly.
Leona smiled faintly and said softly, "Actually, I don't think things are really as pessimistic as we think. Isn't everything Connor is doing now for Freya?"
"Freya?"
Tom's eyes flashed with a strange look.
"That's right. The most important person in this whole situation is actually Freya. I can feel that Connor likes Freya from the bottom of his heart. Moreover, everything he did was just so that Freya could be with him. This also proves that Freya is important to him. So, instead of putting all our energy on Connor, who we are not very familiar with, He might as well focus our energy on Freya!"
Leona said gently.
"That's right, the crux of the problem is indeed Freya, but she doesn't seem to be planning to forgive our family!"
Grayson said with a frown.
"That might be because our family is not sincere enough. If we show our full sincerity, we will definitely be able to move Freya. Once she agrees to help our family, the remaining problems will be solved easily…"
Leona looked at Grayson and said.
When Grayson heard this, he seemed to be even more helpless. He whispered, "It is not an easy task to get Freya to help our family. After all, we have offended her today…"
"Grandpa, we were indeed wrong in today's matter, but don't forget that no matter what, Freya is still a member of the Yearwood Family. The blood that flows in her body is also the blood of the Yearwood Family. Blood is thicker than water. As long as we show our sincerity, Freya won't keep holding onto this matter…"
Leona said gently.
After taking a deep breath, Grayson turned to look at Camila Yearwood. After all, Camila was Freya's biological mother. No one else could do this except Camila.
"Uncle, Freya and I have not known each other for a long time. Freya have always been living with her father. If Freya had not recovered her memories, it might have been easier. However, now that she has recovered her memories, even if I persuade her, it won't have much of an effect!"
Camila said in a very awkward manner.
"I know the situation on your side. I don't need you to persuade Freya to help our family now. In the future, you just need to have a good relationship with Freya and Connor!"
Grayson replied lightly.
"Alright!"
Camila nodded lightly.
"Camila, this is very important, so our family will support you unconditionally. As long as you can handle the relationship between the two of them, then you will be the hero of the Yearwood Family. In the future, the rise and fall of our family will all depend on you!"
Grayson added.
When Camila heard this, a trace of excitement flashed across her eyes. She hurriedly said, "Uncle, don't worry. I will definitely do my best to deal with my relationship with Freya and Connor!"
"Alright!"
Grayson gently nodded, then turned to Tom and said, "Go and find Connor and Freya's whereabouts now. After you've found them, tell me immediately. I'll personally apologize to Connor and Freya!"
"What?"
Everyone in the Yearwood Family was stunned after hearing Grayson's words, and they were in disbelief.
No one had expected Grayson to want to personally apologize to Connor and Freya.
"Father, leave this to us. You are the head of our family. It is inappropriate for you to personally apologize to the two juniors!"
Tom said to Grayson.
Grayson glanced at Tom indifferently and then said expressionlessly, "At this point, what is more important? The safety of our family or my dignity? Moreover, the things that Connor did to the Washington family today will probably spread throughout the entire city very soon. So, even if I go and apologize to Connor, it won't affect anything!"
Tom sighed softly and didn't say anything more.
Grayson looked at everyone and hesitated for a moment before continuing, "There's one more thing. From now on, Freya will be our Yearwood Family's future family head. In the future, when you see Freya, you must treat her with the courtesy of a family head. If anyone dares to be rude to her, don't blame me for being rude and expelling you from the Yearwood Family…"
"What?!"
Hearing Grayson's words, everyone looked even more shocked.
They did not expect Grayson to go to such extents just to please Connor and Freya. He had already announced that Freya would be the next head of the Yearwood Family.
Tom's face darkened. After all, he had planned to take this opportunity to have his son become the next family head, but now it seemed that this opportunity had been completely ruined.
"None of you are listening to me, are you?"
Everyone had their heads lowered and were very quiet. Grayson could not help but frown and berate them.
"We're listening…"
Everyone nodded without hesitation.
"Today's matter may very well affect the future fate of our family, so I hope that you can remember every word I say, otherwise there will be some consequences that you can't afford to bear!"
Grayson warned everyone again, then slowly stood up and said to Tom, "Now, hurry up and investigate where Freya and Connor are!"
"Yes, Father!"
Tom replied in a low voice.
Grayson took a deep breath and immediately turned around to leave.
Everyone looked at Grayson's back with a helpless expression on their faces. They couldn't help but sigh and leave.
With the end of the Yearwood Family's birthday banquet, what happened in the family's manor naturally spread throughout the entire city.
Although the Yearwood Family had been trying their best to control the spread of this news, there were too many people who attended the birthday banquet. This news was not something that could be controlled just because they wanted to.
Therefore, rumors about Connor's identity emerged one after another.

chapters.title: Chapter 1308: Going to the Night Market
chapters.content:
Chapter 1308: Going to the Night Market
"What? That Mr. McDonald from Davenport is actually the last disciple of the Purple Cloud Sect's sect leader?"
"It can't be, right? If that's the case, Connor's background is way too terrifying! I heard that the Purple Cloud Sect is a famous sect in the ancient martial arts world..."
"That's right. I thought that Connor is just an ignorant and incompetent rich second-generation heir. I didn't expect him to have such a terrifying background!"
"If it wasn't for his terrifying background, how could the Washington family have let things slide?"
"Looks like we have to be careful in the future. Don't provoke Connor!"
Similar conversations could be heard everywhere in Santon. Not only the so-called upper class received the news, but even some ordinary people had heard about it.
Although these people might not know how terrifying the Purple Cloud Sect was, they knew that Connor's influence was definitely not what they had imagined. Moreover, Connor was only about 20 years old. If he was given some time, how terrifying would his influence be?
After Connor and Freya left the Yearwood Family, they didn't have the mood to care about these things. Instead, they went around to enjoy themselves.
The Yearwood Family had always been a huge burden on Freya's heart. Now that this huge burden had finally been lifted, Freya was now at ease.
At this moment, Connor and Freya were just like an ordinary couple wandering around. This was something that Connor had always dreamed of.
After all, Connor had sacrificed a lot to wait for this day.
But when Connor saw Freya happily following him, he felt that it was all worth it.
In the blink of an eye, the sky gradually darkened.
"Connor, are you hungry?"
Freya tilted her head and asked Connor softly.
"I'm a little hungry…"
Connor returned with a smile.
"Then, let's go to the new night market in Santon. I heard that there are a lot of delicious food there!"
Freya said happily.
"Alright!"
Connor nodded in agreement.
...
It was past eight in the evening.
Connor and Freya took a taxi to a newly opened night market in Santon.
This night market was very large. It was a spacious commercial street with all kinds of small stalls on both sides. All the famous snacks in Santon could be found here.
After Connor and Freya got out of the car, they realized that the night market was already crowded with people. All kinds of people had appeared in the commercial street, and the street was very noisy.
"There are so many people here!"
Connor said helplessly to Freya.
"Yeah. I didn't expect such a crowd…"
Freya smiled as she replied. Then, she pulled Connor and said, "Let's go get something to eat. Otherwise, all the good food will be gone…"
"Aren't you trying to lose weight?"
Connor said with a smile.
"I'm in a good mood today, so I'm not going to keep to my diet…"
Freya smiled at Connor, then held his arm and walked into the night market.
Connor followed Freya through the night market, tasting all kinds of delicacies. At this moment, Freya was very much relaxed. She had tried all the things that she usually wanted to eat but never did because she was watching her figure.
About half an hour later, Connor and Freya found a bench to rest on.
"I'm so happy today. I haven't been so happy in a long time!"
Freya turned to look at Connor and said with a smile.
"I'm very happy too!"
Connor replied indifferently before pulling Freya into his embrace.
Freya rested her head on Connor's shoulder and whispered to him, "If only it could always be like this…"
"Don't worry, no one will disturb our lives in the future!"
Connor replied with a smile.
"..."
After hearing Connor's words, Freya slowly raised her head and looked at him. She seemed to be a little worried, but she did not say anything.
Connor saw the worry on Freya's face and was about to speak when he suddenly realized that a large group of people had entered the night market and started chasing away the tourists.
It could be seen that the tourists were somewhat unwilling, but in the end, they had no choice but to leave.
In less than a few minutes, 80% of the tourists in the night market had been driven away. Moreover, both sides of the night market had been cordoned off, indicating that tourists were not allowed to enter.
"Why are they chasing people away?"
Freya's eyes flashed with a hint of confusion as she frowned and asked Connor.
"Something must have happened!"
Connor replied indifferently.
"What are you two still standing there for? Hurry up and leave. Outsiders are not allowed to enter this area!"
At this moment, a middle-aged man shouted at Connor.
When Connor heard the middle-aged man's words, he seemed a little unhappy. He opened his mouth and was about to speak.
"Connor…"
Freya hurriedly stretched out her hand to stop him before saying in a low voice, "Connor, it's getting late. There's nothing for the two of us to do here. Let's go!"
Connor looked at Freya indifferently and did not say anything else. He turned around and left.
As Connor and Freya left rather late, there were already staff members coming in.
These people were holding cameras in their hands, and there was someone who looked like a director giving instructions from behind.
These people were very efficient. Before Connor and Freya even left the night market, the decorations were already up.
"They're actually filming a show here?"
When Freya realized what was going on, she exclaimed in surprise.
"Even if it's for a show, they can't just chase all the tourists away, right? At the very least, they have to inform people in advance. This program team is really overbearing!"
Connor said lightly.
"I guess you don't know this, but the show they're filming is the most popular reality show right now. I've even watched a few episodes before. It's very entertaining…"
Freya said excitedly to Connor.
When Connor heard Freya's words, he was somewhat helpless.
After all, Connor was not interested in entertainment programs at all. He felt that those things were all fake, so Connor had never watched them.

chapters.title: Chapter 1309: National Goddess
chapters.content:
Chapter 1309: National Goddess
"I didn't expect to be so lucky to be able to see the recording of this program…"
Freya shouted excitedly at Connor, then turned to him and said, "Connor, let's not leave just yet, okay? I want to see how their show is filmed!"
"Okay. Anyway, there's nothing much for the two of us to do when we go back!"
Connor lightly nodded.
"Yay! Let's find a better seat!"
Freya hurriedly dragged Connor to the side.
At this moment, Connor finally understood why those tourists would leave so obediently. It turned out that these people were waiting to watch the live recording of the celebrities. Moreover, some fanatical fans had received the news in advance and were holding up cards with the celebrities' names on them.
About ten minutes later, a male and female celebrity walked into the night market. Both of them had a faint smile on their faces as they kept greeting the fans around them.
The two of them looked very young. The guy was handsome, while the girl looked exquisite and beautiful. She also looked very sweet.
"These two people seem to be small celebrities who have just debuted. They're not very famous, but because they are recording this show, they've gained quite a number of fans!"
Freya turned to look at Connor and said softly to him.
"Oh...
Connor nodded expressionlessly and did not say anything. After all, he was really not interested in these things in the entertainment industry.
Following that, a few more celebrities entered the venue. These celebrities were not particularly famous. Freya had regained her memories. When she was living in Porthampton, she would watch idol dramas and whatnot, so she knew a little about the celebrities in the entertainment industry.
Therefore, no matter which celebrity appeared, Freya would introduce them to Connor. Connor was not bothered at all.
However, at this moment, a black nanny van slowly stopped by the roadside.
A woman wearing sunglasses got out of the car.
When the fans saw this woman, their eyes widened, and they were extremely excited.
It was obvious that the woman who had appeared here was the most popular celebrity.
When the woman in a white spaghetti skirt appeared, everyone started screaming. Some people even shouted the female celebrity's name.
Connor sized up the female celebrity. At this moment, the female celebrity was wearing a white spaghetti strap short skirt. The exquisite short skirt accentuated the woman's perfect figure very well. Her chest was full, her legs were slender, and her waist was slender and soft. The woman was wearing a pair of sunglasses. Although only half of her pretty face was exposed, her sexy red lips and exquisite chin were enough to prove how heaven-defying her appearance was.
It was obvious that this woman was the most popular among the celebrities.
Freya turned and glanced at Connor before saying softly to him, "This female celebrity's name is Yvette Wendell. She's a female celebrity who has just debuted in our country. It's said that Yvette's background is very terrifying. She has only debuted for less than a year and has already acted as the female lead in several movies. Also, the box office sales of the movies are all very good. Plus, Yvette is indeed very beautiful, so many people see her as the future National Goddess…"
"National Goddess?"
Connor couldn't help but smile when he heard Freya's words. He didn't say anything else.
"That's right. Even a superstar like Tiffany Zamora can't be compared to Yvette…"
Freya replied softly to Connor.
"I see."
Connor lightly nodded.
Connor was not able to know how popular Yvette was just based on Freya's description. However, if she was more popular than Tiffany, then Connor could imagine how amazing Yvette was.
After all, Tiffany could be considered the hottest female celebrity in the entertainment industry because of her relationship with Connor. It was indeed surprising that Yvette was even more popular than Tiffany.
"But I don't really like Yvette…"
At this moment, Freya spoke to Connor again.
When Connor heard Freya's words, he couldn't help but be stunned. Then, he smiled and asked, "Why don't you like Yvette?"
"I heard that Yvette has a very bad personality. Also, there are many rumors on the Internet that she has a rich sugar daddy. So, I don't have a good impression of her!"
Freya explained to Connor with a serious expression.
"I see!"
Connor smiled and nodded. Then, he took out his phone to look at the time and said softly,"Alright, it's getting late now. Besides, you don't like Yvette very much. Let's go back!"
"Okay!"
Freya nodded and turned around, intending to leave with Connor.
However, just as Connor and Freya were about to turn around and leave, a middle-aged man who looked like a director walked up to Connor.
He stretched out his hand to stop Connor, then smiled at Connor and said, "Young man, please wait a moment…"
When Connor heard the middle-aged man's words, he couldn't help but be stunned for a moment. Then, he asked with a puzzled expression, "Are you talking to me?"
"That's right, I'm talking to you!"
The middle-aged man nodded and continued, "Young man, you're in luck. Later on, our show might need a few passersby to interact with the guests. You have been selected, so come with me and let our makeup artist do your makeup. I'll also show you the script!"
"Interact with the guests?"
When Connor heard the middle-aged man's words, a trace of doubt flashed across his eyes.
Freya seemed to be a little surprised.
The people around Connor all looked at him with envy and jealousy.
After all, they were filming the most popular reality show in the country. The guests participating in the show would indeed interact with passersby. Who wouldn't want to be the one chosen?
This way, not only would they have the opportunity to appear on television, but they would also be able to get close to those so-called big stars. For the fans of those stars, it was definitely a once-in-a-lifetime chance.
"I'm sorry, I have something to do now. You guys should get someone else!"
However, Connor had no interest in this kind of stuff, so he rejected the guy.

chapters.title: Chapter 1310: Rejected You?
chapters.content:
Chapter 1310: Rejected You?
When everyone heard Connor's words, they were all stunned. They were incomparably shocked.
No one had expected that Connor would give up such a good opportunity.
"Director, if he has something to do, please let me do it!"
"Yeah, director. What about me?"
Everyone instantly started talking at the same time. Everyone started shouting at the middle-aged man.
The middle-aged man looked at Connor and felt a little awkward. He reached out to stop Connor and asked softly, "Young man, this opportunity doesn't come by often. Are you sure you don't want to do it?"
"Yes!"
Connor replied indifferently. Then, he pulled Freya's hand and continued walking forward.
"Young man, please wait for a moment!"
However, the middle-aged man still had no intention of letting Connor leave. He stopped Connor again.
Connor looked at the middle-aged man with a helpless expression. He frowned and asked, "What exactly do you want?"
"Young man, let me tell you the truth. You're a passerby that Miss Wendell has taken a fancy to. Just now, she specifically asked for you to interact with her…"
The middle-aged man frowned and said to Connor.
Actually, the middle-aged man was also feeling very troubled at the moment. This was because the female celebrity Yvette was very difficult to deal with. She would not take a fancy to ordinary passersby. In order to help Yvette find a suitable passerby to interact with, the production team had used a lot of effort. However, Yvette had never been very satisfied.
However, it would not do if they did not find a passerby for Yvette to interact with. Hence, the production team was having a headache over this matter.
Just now, the director had told Yvette about this. Yvette had no choice but to randomly pick someone from the crowd, and the person she had chosen happened to be Connor.
Actually, there was no particular reason in Yvette choosing Connor. She merely felt that Connor was rather good-looking and did not seem to be the annoying kind. Furthermore, it was a simple interaction. Hence, Yvette did not continue to make things difficult for the director.
When the director found out that Yvette had chosen to have Connor go through with it, he immediately ran to his side to discuss the matter. However, the director did not expect Connor to reject him outright.
That was why the director mentioned Yvette. It seemed like he wanted Connor to change his mind.
When everyone heard the words 'Miss Wendell', they became even more excited.
In the eyes of ordinary people, being able to appear on the show was a rare chance. Now, he could even interact with Yvette up close. This was an amazing opportunity!
So, everyone felt that Connor would not be able to find any excuse to turn down the offer.
"Young man, Miss Wendell has very high standards. You're lucky to be chosen by her. You'd better hurry up and go with me to put on your makeup. Otherwise, it'll be too late for you to change your mind if Miss Wendell gets anxious later!"
The director said to Connor proudly.
Connor glanced at the director and said expressionlessly, "Didn't you hear what I said just now?"
"What?"
The director looked at Connor and was stunned for a moment. Then, he asked with a puzzled expression, "What did you say?"
"I told you, I don't have time now, and I don't want to interact with anyone. Go find someone else!"
Connor calmly replied to the director, then turned to Freya and said, "Freya, let's go!"
"Okay!"
Freya knew Connor's identity very well, so it was very normal for him to not take these small celebrities to heart. It was also reasonable for Connor to reject her.
However, the people around the scene did not know who Connor was. They also could not understand what was going on!
No one expected that Connor would not change his mind even after the director had mentioned Yvette!
For a moment, almost everyone looked at Connor and Freya in disbelief.
The director was also stunned. He was in disbelief.
Yvette was one of the top celebrities in the country!
If it were any other ordinary person, they would probably wake up laughing in their dreams after being given the chance to interact with Yvette face-to-face. However, this young man so readily turned down such an opportunity.
"Young man, are you really not going to consider it?"
The director seemed a little unhappy about it and hurriedly shouted at Connor.
"Yes..."
Connor replied indifferently and then continued to walk forward.
The director stood rooted to the ground in a daze. There was nothing but helplessness in his eyes.
The surrounding passersby were also extremely shocked.
"Director, since this kid doesn't want to do it, then let me do it!"
"That's right, director. I'm a professional. I'll do whatever you want me to do. Please give me a chance!"
"Director, what do you think of me?"
When everyone saw Connor give up such a good opportunity, although they were very surprised, they did not forget to fight for this opportunity for themselves.
The director looked at the crowd with a helpless expression before turning around and walking to Yvette's side.
At this moment, Yvette was reading the script with a serious expression, as if she did not notice that the director had already walked to her side.
"Mr. Wackerman, how much longer until it starts? I have advertisements to film. Hurry up!"
Yvette said to the director expressionlessly.
Upon hearing Yvette's words, the director seemed a little helpless. He took a deep breath and whispered to Yvette, "Miss Wendell, there's a problem…"
"What is it?"
Yvette asked calmly.
"Didn't you take a fancy to a passerby just now and want him to be an interaction guest? I went to invite that passerby, but he rejected me!"
The director said carefully.
"Rejected you?"
Yvette subconsciously looked at the director beside her with a surprised expression.
After all, for an ordinary person, being able to show his face on television and interact with her was like a dream. It was impossible for anyone to reject it.
"Yeah. That brat really doesn't know what's good for him. He actually rejected me…"
The director said to Yvette with a nervous expression.
"Did you mention my name just now?"
Yvette asked the director in confusion.
"I did, but that person still wasn't interested. He left after rejecting me!"
The director replied helplessly.

chapters.title: Chapter 1311: What Do You Mean?
chapters.content:
Chapter 1311: What Do You Mean?
"Using my name didn't work? Does this person not know who I am?"
It was evident that Yvette found this situation somewhat unbelievable.
After all, she was now one of the top stars in Oprana. Wherever she went, she was like the center of attention, surrounded by fans. How could someone pass up the chance to interact with her?
"That guy probably doesn't know who you are, Miss Yvette," the director cautiously replied to Yvette, then continued, "Miss, it's getting late. Why don't we find someone else? We have so many fans here; there's no need to waste time on that guy."
Yvette hesitated for a moment, then threw the script on the table and pouted, "I don't believe it. There's actually someone who doesn't know me. Today, I must bring that guy back."
"Miss Yvette, you..."
The director was about to say something, but she ignored him completely. She stood up, wearing high heels, and walked towards the position of Connor and Freya.
Meanwhile, they were waiting by the roadside for a taxi since the streets near the night market were blocked, and taxis were scarce.
"Here comes a cab!" Connor suddenly saw a taxi approaching and waved his hand.
"Wait for a moment, you two!" But just as the taxi was about to stop, a woman's voice sounded from behind him.
Upon hearing this voice, he couldn't help but pause and turned around to find that it was Yvette, who had taken the initiative to approach him.
"Do you know this Yvette?" Freya felt a bit strange and asked Connor softly.
"I don't know her..." He shook his head.
"Why is she clinging to you then?" She continued to inquire.
"I'm curious about that too. I don't know her at all. If you hadn't mentioned her, I wouldn't have known she's a celebrity..." he replied with a helpless expression.
Freya glanced at Connor and could feel that he genuinely didn't recognize Yvette, so she didn't say anything more.
"Hello, I'm Yvette!" While Connor and Freya were talking, Yvette had already walked up to him, looking arrogant and said, "You don't know me?!"
"Is that so strange?" he asked casually.
"You..." Surprised by his response, she exclaimed.
"What's so strange about not knowing you?" he asked with indifference.
"You..." After hearing his words, she was speechless.
She directly took off her sunglasses, revealing a seductive and fair charming face.
It had to be said that this woman, Yvette, was indeed very attractive. Just this charming face alone can make countless men fall for her.
Especially those enchanting eyes, as if constantly exuding irresistible charm.
Now, it seemed that Yvette's rise to become the hottest female star in the entertainment industry within a short six months was not merely a coincidence.
In this era where looks matter, she indeed had the capital.
But as Freya pointed out, her personality was not very pleasant, giving off an air of arrogance.
Noticing Connor had been staring at her, Yvette's expression turned smug. She spoke disdainfully, "It's perfectly normal not to have heard of my name. But now, you should know who I am, right?"
Ignoring her, he opened the taxi door for her and said softly, "Freya, let's go."
"Yes!" Freya nodded quickly.
Connor chose to ignore Yvette completely and intended to get into the taxi.
"Hey, buddy, you dare to refuse Miss Yvette? Aren't you a bit disrespectful?" At this moment, a voice came from a distance.
Connor couldn't help but pause and saw a handsome guy walking towards them. This guy's name was Quinton Zackariah , and his family was in the foreign trade business. He had recently returned to Oprana after studying abroad and quickly became a popular young idol due to his wealthy background. Quinton had been pursuing Yvette, but she hadn't agreed to him, so now he seemed to be trying to stand up for her.
Quinton walked up to the taxi, handed some money to the driver, and said lightly, "You can go now!"
The taxi driver was delighted with the money, so without hesitation, he stepped on the gas and left.
"What do you mean?" Connor frowned and asked Quinton.
Quinton glanced at him without saying much. He then walked up to Yvette and said softly, "Miss Yvette, let me handle this. I promise to make this guy agree..."
She turned her head to look at him but remained silent.
Seeing her silence, Quinton smiled and walked up to Connor, saying softly, "Being noticed by Miss Yvette is your blessing. Giving up on this opportunity would be such a pity, don't you think?"
"What's the pity? I don't know this person. You should find someone else," Connor replied casually.

chapters.title: Chapter 1312: Be Understanding
chapters.content:
Chapter 1312: Be Understanding
Quinton heard Connor's words and couldn't help but smile, but he didn't get angry.
He glanced expressionlessly at Connor and said playfully, "Alright, name your price. No matter how much, I can satisfy you, as long as you cooperate with Yvette and record the program honestly!"
Quinton, a wealthy heir, had a very arrogant and domineering style of speaking and doing things. He believed that as long as he spent some money, he could resolve this matter and gain Yvette's favor by killing two birds with one stone.
"Any amount can satisfy me?" Connor smiled helplessly, looked Quinton up and down, and asked softly, "Do you think you're really rich?"
"Whether I have money or not is none of your business. Just know that I can meet your demands!" Quinton said arrogantly.
Connor sighed helplessly, shook his head, and said, "Remember, in this world, money doesn't solve everything, especially your little wealth means nothing to me!"
"You dare to try and bribe Connor with money, it's really ridiculous!" Freya seemed to dislike Quinton's approach and said with a stern face.
"You!" Quinton never expected them to insult him like this, and with Yvette watching, he felt humiliated. With a hint of anger in his eyes, he shouted to his bodyguards, "Stop these two for me!"
Rapidly, his bodyguards surrounded Connor and Freya.
Seeing the situation tense, Yvette realized she didn't want the situation to escalate. She had been upset by Connor's rejection earlier but didn't plan on blowing it out of proportion. If things turned violent, it would definitely make headlines the next day.
"Quinton, just forget about this. I'll find another random person," she quickly said to him.
"Miss Yvette, you don't have to worry about this. I'll handle it!" His anger seemed to grow stronger after hearing her words. He didn't want to appear weak in front of her, so he replied defiantly.
The director also looked anxious at this point. He knew Quinton's style very well. Once he got angry, the consequences would be unimaginable. A while back, Quinton even broke the leg of a male celebrity, but because of his powerful background, it was never exposed.
If this situation wasn't handled well today, the consequences would be disastrous.
Quinton walked up to Connor with extreme arrogance and said disdainfully, "I never thought you would be so arrogant. You have two choices now. First, obediently record the program with me. Second, get out of here and leave. You decide!"
"Do you know who I am?" Connor calmly asked Quinton, sizing him up.
"I don't give a damn who you are. You only have two options now, either record the program with me obediently or leave!" Quinton didn't care about Connor's identity at all. In his eyes, Connor was just showing off.
"Quinton, let it go today. There's no need to escalate things any further," Yvette said with a hint of helplessness in her eyes.
However, Quinton seemed even more motivated after hearing Yvette's words. Excited, he said, "Miss Yvette, I must give you an explanation today. You can just watch from the side!"
Everyone present felt helpless seeing the situation unfold, unsure of what to say.
"This guy really doesn't know what's good for him..."
"Yeah, he even dared to offend Quinton. I really can't fathom what he's thinking!"
"It looks like we're in for a show. I thought his luck was good, but now I'd rather not have that kind of luck!"
"You're right, it was a good thing, but now it has turned into this mess!"
At this moment, a white Mercedes suddenly sped toward Connor's location.
Behind the Mercedes were a dozen luxury cars.
The sudden appearance of these luxury cars immediately caught everyone's attention. After all, the prices of these cars were not insignificant, which was hard to believe.
Quinton's bodyguards all stopped in their tracks, looking towards the direction of the luxury car convoy.
Soon, all the luxury cars stopped beside Connor, their headlights illuminating the entire street.
With a loud thud, the car door opened, and a middle-aged man ran out frantically, speaking in an extremely excited voice, "Mr. Connor, Freya, I've finally found you two!"
For a moment, everyone on the scene was stunned, their expressions filled with shock.
They only now realized that their identities seemed to be far from simple.

chapters.title: Chapter 1313: Apologizing
chapters.content:
Chapter 1313: Apologizing
"You came?," Connor asked coldly, glancing at the middle-aged man in front of him with an expressionless face.
"I've come here to apologize specifically to you, Mr. Connor. My father has also come!" The middle-aged man stammered.
And there, standing before everyone, was none other than Tom from the Yearwood family.
Other elders from the Yearwood family also stepped out of their cars and stood in an orderly manner in front of Connor, with respectful expressions.
"It's actually someone from the Yearwood family?"
"Could it be that this young man has some connection with them?"
"I never thought this guy's background could be so terrifying. He actually knows people from the Yearwood family!"
"Indeed, it seems like today's affair has become quite interesting!"
The onlookers began to discuss in hushed voices, their expressions filled with amazement.
Looking at Tom, Quinton's eyes were filled with shock. He never expected that Connor would actually know someone from the Yearwood family. Quinton's own family, the Lawson family, had significant cooperation with the Yearwood family, and they relied heavily on the support of the Yearwood family. If not for them, the Lawson family wouldn't be where they were now.
Seeing Tom, Yvette was also surprised. She knew the terrifying strength of the Yearwood family. If Connor knew someone from the Yearwood family, it indicated that he had a formidable background.
At this moment, Grayson, accompanied by Leona, stepped out of the car and walked directly towards Connor. He respectfully bowed to Connor and said in a low voice, "Mr. Connor, our Yearwood family was indeed impolite before. I hope you can forgive us."
Everyone present was deeply shocked.
After all, everyone here was from Santon.
And anyone from Santon knew who Grayson was.
Grayson had a tremendous influence in Santon.
But this person, who had such high status and power, actually took the initiative to apologize to Connor, a young man in his early twenties!
Seeing this scene, everyone present was stunned, and their expressions revealed their astonishment.
They had never expected that this seemingly ordinary Connor would possess such terrifying power.
Connor remained calm at this moment. He glanced at Grayson indifferently and asked, "Do you have any other business with me?"
"Mr. Connor, I am organizing a banquet at our Yearwood family and hope that you can grace us with your presence. It's a way for me to express my apologies!" Grayson said politely.
Connor glanced at Grayson calmly and replied, "I don't think I have anything to talk about with your Yearwood family. I made myself clear before; there's no need to continue with the meal."
"Mr. Connor, our Yearwood family knows we were wrong. Please give us a chance!" Grayson pleaded anxiously.
As everyone watched his actions, they were even more shocked. They couldn't understand what was happening.
Yvette and Quinton stood dumbfounded, and it was only at this moment that they finally realized that Connor's previous words were not empty boasting. On the contrary, everything he said was true. Quinton was nothing in front of the Yearwood family, let alone a Connor who could make the entire Yearwood family come to apologize!
Quinton's expression turned nervous when he saw Connor's cold eyes. He was afraid that Connor might retaliate against him. After all, if Connor wanted to, it would be effortless for him to take revenge.
But in fact, Connor didn't even pay attention to him. He had no intention of wasting his time on someone like Quinton.
He just walked calmly into the car.
A few minutes later, the convoy disappeared from the street.
Everyone watched the convoy vanish and was left with their mouths wide open, expressions of shock on their faces.
Who would have thought that this seemingly ordinary Connor would have such an astonishing background?
After Connor completely left, Quinton finally heaved a sigh of relief. He hadn't expected Connor's background to be so terrifying. It felt like he had just been through a life-or-death experience. Fortunately, Connor didn't hold him accountable. If he had, he wouldn't have had an easy time.
Yvette, on the other hand, remained expressionless, seemingly unfazed.
"Do you know that Connor from earlier, Mr. Wackerman?" Yvette asked the director with a puzzled expression.
"I don't know..." The director shook his head hurriedly.

chapters.title: Chapter 1314: Real Intentions
chapters.content:
Chapter 1314: Real Intentions
"He seems to have a significant connection with the Yearwood family, and I heard them calling him Mr. Connor just now..."
Whispering to herself, Yvette's eyes lit up, and she quickly said, "I've been hearing the name Mr. Connor frequently recently. Who is he, exactly?"
"Could he be Mr. Connor from Porthampton?"
Trembling, Quinton exclaimed, his expression becoming even more worried.
"Who is Mr. Connor from Porthampton?" Yvette was puzzled and asked Quinton.
"Mr. Connor from Porthampton is the person who broke both of Wilbur's legs. Both the Landon and Washington families couldn't do anything to him!" Quinton said with great excitement.
At this moment, everyone present was once again deeply shocked.
After all, they were all people from Santon, and they had heard quite a lot about Connor in recent days. Whether it was the incident where he broke Wilbur's legs or the things he did at the Yearwood family banquet, all of Santon was talking about it. Even ordinary people had heard about his deeds.
The respect the Yearwood family showed Connor, calling him Mr. Connor, coupled with Connor's arrogant attitude, proved that he was most likely Mr. Connor from Porthampton.
Thinking of this, Quinton couldn't help but break out in cold sweat. Connor was the kind of person who dared to attack Wilbur!
If he had really started a fight with Connor just now, he wouldn't dare to think about the consequences.
Yvette stood expressionless in place, not knowing what she was thinking, but her eyes also revealed a trace of seriousness.
Connor's identity was too terrifying to the point of suffocating.
After Connor and Freya got into the Yearwood family's car, they drove toward the Yearwood family estate.
After about half an hour, they arrived at the Yearwood family estate.
However, this time, Connor and Freya's treatment upon returning to the Yearwood family was completely different from before. Previously, no one even received them, not to mention arranging accommodations for them.
But this time, they were surrounded by the high-level members of the Yearwood family as they entered the estate. Even the younger members of the Yearwood family couldn't approach, and Grayson always followed closely behind Connor, never daring to take a step forward. This clearly showed his attitude towards Connor.
Jules, Heathcote, and others stood far away, watching Connor slowly approach amidst the crowd's escort. Their hearts were full of mixed feelings.
After all, the Yearwood family used to look down on Connor in every way. But now, everyone's attitude toward him had undergone a complete transformation, and this change was clearly visible. Even Grayson had to follow closely behind him, not daring to take a single step further. If the Yearwood family had known it would be like this, even if they had ten thousand times the courage, they would never have dared to offend Connor.
A few minutes later, Connor and the Yearwood family members arrived at the banquet hall. In the center of the hall was a dining table, filled with various delicious dishes.
"Mr. Connor, please have a seat!" Grayson said, taking the initiative to lead Connor to the main seat.
Naturally, he didn't stand on ceremony. He calmly took his seat, and Freya hesitated for a moment before choosing to sit beside him.
After they were seated, the Yearwood family members found their positions according to their seniority.
"Mr. Connor, on behalf of the Yearwood family, I offer you a toast. We hope you can forgive our previous disrespect and let bygones be bygones!" Tom raised his glass, smiling at Connor.
Connor heard Tom's words but showed no intention of picking up his glass. Instead, he calmly replied, "Your Yearwood family has already apologized to me, so there's no need for another apology. If you have something to say, just say it!"
Tom didn't expect Connor to be so indifferent, and his expression became somewhat awkward. Nevertheless, he still raised his glass, finished his drink, and then sat back down.
"We have already discussed it in the Yearwood family. We plan to have Freya inherit the position of our family head. After I pass away, Freya will have the final say in the Yearwood family. What do you think, Mr. Connor?" Grayson asked cautiously.
"Family head?" Connor smiled faintly upon hearing Grayson's words and then looked at her, saying in a soft voice, "Whether Freya becomes the family head of your Yearwood family or not is your Yearwood family's business, and it seems to have nothing to do with me. You can ask her about her thoughts!"
"Sure..."
Grayson nodded quickly and then turned to look at Freya. He asked in a hushed voice, "Freya, what are your thoughts about this matter?"
"I'm not very interested in these things about your Yearwood family. I've already made myself very clear before. From now on, I have no relationship with the Yearwood family whatsoever. So, I won't stay with you!" she replied coldly without any hesitation.
After all, in the eyes of ordinary people, the position of the Yearwood family's head might be prestigious, but in her eyes, it was nothing special. She was not interested in it at all.
Upon hearing her words, Grayson's expression turned sour, and he stood there stupidly, not knowing what to do.
Connor turned his head to look at Grayson and said calmly, "You are so eager for Freya to become the head of your Yearwood family because you want to rely on my power to protect the Yearwood family after you're gone..."
Grayson looked at Connor, and his expression seemed somewhat awkward, but he did not refute it because that was indeed his true intention.
"If that's what you really want, then whether Freya becomes the head of your Yearwood family won't have much impact..." Connor continued.

chapters.title: Chapter 1315: A Deal
chapters.content:
Chapter 1315: A Deal
"Mr. Connor, what do you mean by 'sincerity'?" Grayson asked excitedly.
After all, Grayson's true purpose was to seek Connor's protection. Whether Freya became the head of the Yearwood family was not as important to him.
"If you offer fifty percent of your assets to Freya, then I can protect your Yearwood family," Connor said casually.
Upon hearing his words, all the members of the Yearwood family present were stunned. Their eyes showed shock and disbelief. Who would have thought that Connor would have such a huge appetite and directly ask for fifty percent of the Yearwood family's assets?
This fifty percent of the assets was far more valuable than the position of the Yearwood family head.
If Grayson agreed, it would mean that all members of the Yearwood family would lose half of their assets. This matter would affect everyone in the Yearwood family.
"Mr. Connor, isn't your request a bit too much? Fifty percent of the assets is not a small amount!" Tom exclaimed, feeling agitated.
"If it weren't for Freya's blood relationship with your Yearwood family, I wouldn't even ask for this fifty percent," Connor said calmly.
Inside the Yearwood family estate.
All the Yearwood family members present felt that Connor's demand was too excessive.
After all, fifty percent of the assets was like cutting off their flesh for the Yearwood family members.
Grayson's expression was also unpleasant at this moment. He hadn't expected Connor to be so ambitious.
He thought that by voluntarily giving up the position of the Yearwood family head, he had shown great sincerity. However, who could have imagined that Connor and Freya wouldn't care about these things at all.
"The conditions have been stated. Whether you agree or not is up to you. But I advise you to make a decision quickly, as I'm leaving Santon tomorrow. Once I leave, even if you change your mind, it'll be too late!" Connor said, seeing that no one from the Yearwood family spoke up.
"Mr. Connor, is there still room for negotiation in this matter?" Grayson looked at him and asked, his expression very troubled.
"Room for negotiation?" Connor couldn't help but smile at these words and replied indifferently, "I'm sorry, your family doesn't have the qualifications to negotiate with me!"
After saying this, Connor walked directly to Freya's side and said softly, "Freya, let's go!"
"Okay!" She nodded quickly and stood up, planning to leave with him.
Sitting in place, Grayson looked at Connor and Freya's retreating figures, his eyes showing a trace of strangeness. After a few seconds of silence, he called out in a low voice, "Mr. Connor, please wait a moment!"
He turned his head slowly and looked at Grayson, asking in a soft voice, "What else is there?"
"Mr. Connor, as long as our Yearwood family offers fifty percent of our assets, you will protect us?" Grayson asked through clenched teeth.
"Of course, I always keep my word!" Connor said calmly.
Grayson took a deep breath and then frowned, saying, "Alright, Mr. Connor, I can agree to your conditions. I'm willing to offer fifty percent of our Yearwood family's assets to you. I hope you can protect our Yearwood family..."
"Father!" Tom exclaimed excitedly upon hearing Grayson's words.
"Grayson!"
"Grayson, this is not advisable at all!"
"Yes, Grayson, please think it over!"
After all, this fifty percent of the assets would be taken from the hands of the Yearwood family members, so they naturally wouldn't be willing to give their assets to Connor.
For a moment, everyone's expressions became excited, and they shouted at Tom.
"But family head, fifty percent is too much..." said a middle-aged man, gritting his teeth.
"I've already made a decision. If any of you disagree, just step forward and leave the Yearwood family. I'll let you go!" he said directly.
Upon hearing his words, everyone was dumbfounded. They stood there stupidly, seemingly not knowing what to do.
"Is there anyone else who disagrees? Stand up now, and I'll give you the chance to leave!" He looked around at everyone and asked with a cold tone.
Although the Yearwood family members were dissatisfied with his decision, they knew that if they left the Yearwood family, they would have nothing. So they didn't have the courage to leave the family.
Seeing everyone quiet down, he walked up to Connor and said in a low voice, "Mr. Connor, no one disagrees now!"
"Go sign the contract with Freya then!" Connor said calmly.
"Sign the contract with Freya?" He looked at Connor in confusion, not understanding.
"In my eyes, the assets of your Yearwood family are nothing. I don't care about them. So I plan to give these assets to Freya. From now on, she will still manage the Yearwood family. When you pass away, if Freya is willing, she will take over the Yearwood family. If she's not willing, I'll choose a new family head for the Yearwood family," Connor said to Grayson.
"Alright..." Grayson quickly nodded after hearing Connor's words.

chapters.title: Chapter 1316: An Awkward Kiss
chapters.content:
Chapter 1316: An Awkward Kiss
