Tom looked at Grayson helplessly, although he still couldn't accept Grayson's decision.
However, he also knew that he could not change Grayson's mind now, so he could only turn around and leave.
After hesitating for a moment, Freya walked to Connor's side and asked, "Connor, are you really planning to give me these things from the Yearwood Family?"
"Of course, there's no you or me in our relationship."
Connor smiled as he replied.
Freya looked at Connor. She was extremely touched.
Although Freya didn't really care about these things, she still felt that Connor's actions warmed her heart.
A few minutes later, Tom prepared a contract.
Freya and Grayson signed the contract.
After the contract was signed, it meant that Freya was the biggest boss of the Yearwood Family. After all, Grayson only controlled 13% of the Yearwood Family's shares, but Freya herself controlled 50% of the shares.
After Freya signed the contract with Grayson, Connor and Freya did not stay at the Yearwood Family's house. Instead, they went straight back to the hotel.
After returning to the hotel, Connor and Freya started chatting in the room.
"Freya, what do you plan to do next?"
Connor asked Freya softly.
"I still can't accept these people from the Yearwood Family for now, and I don't plan to work in Travio Corporation anymore, so I plan to return to Porthampton. After all, that's the place I'm most familiar with!"
Freya said softly to Connor after hesitating for a moment.
"Back to Porthampton?"
A trace of disappointment flashed across Connor's eyes when he heard this because he thought that Freya would continue to stay in Newtown.
"Aren't you going back to Porthampton?"
Freya asked with a puzzled expression when she saw Connor's reaction.
"I still have some things to settle in Newtown. I haven't investigated the cause of my parents' death, so I'll probably stay in Newtown!"
Connor said in a low voice.
Freya looked at Connor and was stunned for a moment. Then, she smiled and said, "Then, it seems that the two of us are going to be in a long-distance relationship again!"
"Can you stay in Newtown with me?"
Connor looked at Freya and asked.
"Hmm…"
Freya's eyes flashed with hesitation.
Freya also wanted to stay by Connor's side, but she really didn't know what she could do in Newtown. Also, after all the things that had happened, Freya realized that there is a gap between her and Connor. She wanted to make up for this gap, so she planned to return to Porthampton to advance in her career.
"Since you want to go back to Porthampton, then go back!"
Seeing that Freya was hesitant, he the added on.
"Why did you suddenly change your mind?"
Freya was stunned for a moment and asked Connor with a puzzled expression.
"I've thought about it. Actually, it's quite dangerous for me to be in Newtown now. You should be safer in Porthampton. I can also have Leander and the others protect you. I can go back to see you after I've dealt with the situation in Newtown..."
Connor said softly to Freya after hesitating for a moment.
"Then, you must be careful while you're here!"
Freya glanced at Connor and said worriedly.
"Don't worry, I'll definitely be careful!"
Connor nodded and continued, "What are you going to do after returning to Porthampton? Do you need my help?"
"Of course not. I'm going to continue my cosmetics business. My goal is to create a luxury brand that belongs to Oprana. Not only cosmetics, but also bags, clothes, and jewelry…"
Freya said seriously.
"If you have me to help you, things might be much easier…"
Connor said with a smile.
"I don't need your help. I have to rely on my own efforts!"
Freya replied.
"Alright, if you run into any problems, you can tell me at any time!"
Connor said helplessly.
"Okay!"
Freya looked at Connor and nodded. Then, she took out her phone and said reluctantly, "Alright, it's getting late now. We have a plane to catch tomorrow. I'm going to go back and rest!"
"Okay!"
Connor nodded and stood up to send Freya out of the room.
A few seconds later, Freya followed Connor to the door.
However, at this moment, Freya suddenly stopped and turned around to look at Connor.
Connor was stunned for a moment, then asked in a puzzled tone, "What is it?"
"Connor, thank you!"
Freya said to Connor seriously.
Connor smiled helplessly and said softly, "You're my fiancée. You don't have to thank me, you know…"
Before Connor could finish speaking, Freya reached out and hugged him.
Freya's soft body was tightly pressed against Connor's chest. Before Connor could react, he felt his neck being hugged tightly by a pair of small hands. Following that, a pair of red and sexy lips were pressed tightly against his lips.
Her fragrance entered his nose.
Connor could clearly smell the faint fragrance on Freya's body, and his mind went blank.
Connor had never imagined that he would be forcefully kissed by Freya.
Freya kissed Connor awkwardly, and Connor began to respond. The two of them then started kissing.
It made Connor feel as if he had been electrocuted.
Seconds and minutes passed by. After an unknown amount of time, Freya finally raised her head slowly. Her beautiful face had a hint of an alluring blush, and her breath was like orchids. Her gentle breath hit Connor's face, and her towering breasts were pressed tightly against his chest.
For a moment, Connor seemed to be unable to control his emotions and instinctively wanted to continue.
However, Freya gently pushed Connor away and said shyly, "That's all for today. I'm not ready yet!"
When Connor heard Freya's words, he couldn't help but be stunned for a moment. Then, he said helplessly, "Okay!"
"You should rest early. Goodnight!"
Freya couldn't help but smile when she saw Connor's dejected look. She then turned around and walked out of Connor's room.
Connor watched Freya leave and smiled faintly. He then returned to his bedroom to get some rest.
...

chapters.title: Chapter 1317: Ungrateful Thing
chapters.content:
Chapter 1317: Ungrateful Thing
The next day, at eight o'clock in the morning.
Connor and Freya left the hotel and boarded a flight to Porthampton.
The plane arrived in Porthampton at around three o'clock in the afternoon.
Connor sent Freya off and boarded the flight to Newtown alone.
Although Connor didn't want to be separated from Freya now, after all, they were still building their relationship. However, Connor knew that he had more important things to do in Newtown, so he could only choose to return to Newtown alone.
When Connor returned to Newtown, it was already past midnight.
After Connor got off the plane, he took a taxi home.
However, just as Connor opened the door, he saw the extremely sexy Rachel Wallace still sitting on the sofa watching a TV series.
When Connor saw Rachel, he was exasperated He frowned and asked, "Why are you still here?"
When Rachel heard Connor's words, she turned around and looked at him, then said lightly, "There's a problem with the room I renovated again, so I can't move just yet!"
"What? Again?"
Connor looked at Rachel speechlessly. After all, this woman had already lived in his house for nearly half a year.
"That's right. I don't like the color of the newly renovated walls, so I changed it to another color!"
Rachel gently nodded.
Connor looked at Rachel and was speechless. He frowned and said, "Tell me the truth. You didn't actually rent a place outside, did you? Do you plan to live in my house forever?"
"I'm such a beautiful woman living in your house, yet you're still unhappy?"
Rachel turned and glanced at Connor as she spoke in a disdainful tone.
"This isn't a question of whether I'm happy or not. It's just that it's not appropriate for us to live together alone. Besides, I already have a girlfriend now. What if my girlfriend finds out?"
Connor shouted at Rachel exasperatedly.
"What are you worried about when your girlfriend isn't in Newtown? Besides, nothing has ever happened between us. Are you worried that you can't control yourself?"
Rachel smiled back at Connor.
"Why you..."
When Connor heard Rachel's words, he instantly became speechless. Then, he gritted his teeth and said, "I'll give you another half a month. If you still don't move out, I'll move out!"
Rachel glanced at Connor indifferently and did not say anything.
Connor then walked toward his room.
"Have you been very busy recently?"
Rachel turned to look at Connor and asked him softly.
"You already know the answer. Don't you know what I've been up to?"
Connor pursed his lips and replied, then walked into his room.
"You ungrateful thing!"
Rachel saw Connor return to his room and scolded him angrily. Then, she sat on the sofa and continued watching the TV series.
...
The next day, at eight o'clock in the morning.
When Connor woke up, he saw that Rachel had already left for class. He had to admit that Rachel was really something. Usually, she would watch TV until two or three in the morning, but she could get up at seven in the morning and then dress up to go to class. How unbelievable was that?
Connor went into the bathroom to wash up and then left the house.
After leaving home, Connor did not go to Newtown University because there was nothing important to do there. On the contrary, there were a lot of things waiting for Connor to deal with at Heavens Club.
Back then, when Connor obtained Heavens Club from Chelsea Lee, the biggest victims were Arthur Synder, Jeremiah Synder, and Yaakov Ward.
Therefore, Yaakov ordered Arthur and his son to acquire a club called Triumph Club. He wanted to take advantage of the fact that Connor had just taken over Heavens Club and that its foundation was not very stable. He wanted to compete with Connor.
Therefore, Connor had previously proposed to hold an opening ceremony to promote Heavens Club and suppress Arthur and his father.
Previously, because of Freya and the Yearwood Family, Connor had no time to care about the opening ceremony. Now that Freya's matter had been resolved, Connor planned to see Vanessa Canfield to discuss the opening ceremony.
At nine in the morning, Connor arrived at Heavens Club.
Although Heavens Club had a different boss now, the club's normal operations were not affected at all because of Vanessa's existence. It was still as lively as before.
"Hello, Mr. McDonald."
A tall beauty in a dress walked toward Connor and greeted him very politely.
"Hello!"
Connor nodded gently and followed the woman into Heavens Club.
"Miss Wardwell, has anything happened in our club recently?"
Although Connor had only met this tall beauty a few times, he knew that this woman was the lobby manager of Heavens Club. She was very capable, so Connor had some impression of this woman.
"Mr. McDonald, nothing has happened recently. After all, this is the Heavens Club. Even if the boss changes, no one dares to come and cause trouble…"
Miss Wardwell replied softly.
"That's good. Is Miss Canfield around? I have something to discuss with her…"
Connor asked Miss Wardwell.
"Miss Canfield should be in the office now. I'll get Miss Canfield for you…"
Miss Wardwell hurriedly said.
"There's no need to go through so much trouble. I'll go up and look for her myself."
Connor replied indifferently and then walked into the elevator.
A few minutes later, Connor took the elevator to the top floor of Heavens Club and found the general manager's office. After all, it was not the first time Connor came to see Vanessa, so he knew where the general manager's office was.
Connor hesitated for a moment before gently knocking on the door. After all, Vanessa lived in the office. It would be bad if it was as awkward as last time.
"Come in!"
Vanessa's sweet voice rang out.
Connor pushed open the door and entered the general manager's office. When he entered the office, Connor could clearly smell a faint fragrance. This fragrance was the same as the fragrance on Vanessa's body. As long as he smelled it once, he would remember it.
Today, Vanessa was wearing a white spaghetti strap short skirt. She was looking at her documents and didn't notice Connor coming in.
Connor didn't want to disturb Vanessa, but he stared at Vanessa's seductive figure in her short skirt.
There was no helping it, Vanessa was just too alluring. She was a seductive and sexy woman. Her entire body was emitting waves of seductive mature woman aura.

chapters.title: Chapter 1318: Opening Ceremony
chapters.content:
Chapter 1318: Opening Ceremony
"Mr. McDonald, you're here?"
At this time, Vanessa finally realized that the person who came in was Connor. She hurriedly stood up and said to Connor.
"Vanessa, I'm sorry. I've been busy with my own matters recently, so I didn't have time to come here!"
Connor awkwardly explained to Vanessa.
It couldn't be helped. Connor was really too competent as a hands-off manager. From the time he took over the club until now, Connor had only come twice. If it wasn't for Vanessa's existence, the club would have been closed down by now.
"It's okay. Nothing has happened in the club recently anyway!"
Vanessa looked at Connor and said lightly.
"That's good!"
Connor took the initiative to walk to Vanessa's side. The fragrance on Vanessa's body seemed to be even more intense now, making Connor somewhat restless.
"Mr. McDonald, do you have any orders for me?"
Vanessa poured a cup of tea for Connor and asked him softly.
"Didn't I tell you last time that I was going to hold an opening ceremony? How's your planning coming along?"
Connor asked Vanessa softly.
"Mr. McDonald, I've already prepared everything. I've also chosen the venue. You just need to set a date!"
Vanessa hurriedly said.
"That's great!"
Connor nodded with satisfaction. With Vanessa, it was actually very easy to do things because this woman would always do what was asked of her. Even though Connor hadn't brought this up for such a long time, Vanessa still went ahead and did what she was supposed to do.
Now Connor finally understood why even though Chelsea had already given Heavens Club to him, she still wanted to take Vanessa with her, because Vanessa was the real treasure.
"Mr. McDonald, there is something I want to remind you about!"
At this moment, Vanessa said.
"What is it?"
Connor was stunned for a moment and asked.
"The Triumph Club will be opening soon. Also, the two clubs are pretty similar, so there will definitely be a lot of people comparing the opening ceremonies of the two clubs. We will definitely have no problem with the level of extravagance because I have chosen the best restaurant in the entire city. I will try my best to find some friends who are close to me to come and support us. Only the guests who come to attend the opening ceremony are important. Only then can we have a very good publicity effect. At that time, it will be very helpful for our club to compete with Triumph Club in the future!"
Vanessa said in a very serious tone.
Connor lightly nodded and then said calmly, "I understand what you mean!"
After all, Heavens Club had a new boss, so the opening ceremony was very important. It might affect many things and even the future development of Heavens Club.
Under normal circumstances, some celebrities would be invited to attend the company's opening ceremony because it could highlight the strength of the company and also have a very good publicity effect.
"But Mr. McDonald, my connections are still limited. If we want to crush Triumph Club, you should think of a way to find some suitable people!"
Vanessa looked at Connor and said.
"I know. Who do you think is suitable?"
Connor looked at Vanessa and asked.
"Mr. McDonald, you don't have to worry about the media. I have some friends in this field, so I can handle this!"
Vanessa thought for a moment and said to Connor.
"Then, who else do we need now?"
Connor had never dealt with these matters before, so he didn't know who to look for.
"First of all, the most important thing is the people from the government. If there are people from that side, it will cause a great impact. Do you have any friends in this area?"
Vanessa reminded him softly.
"I haven't been in Newtown for a long time, so I don't know many people and my connections are limited…"
Connor replied helplessly.
"Hmm…"
Vanessa looked at Connor, feeling somewhat awkward, as if she didn't know what to say.
"But Vanessa, you don't have to worry. Although I don't know many people, I definitely have other ways to get these people, so just tell me who you think is suitable."
Connor said firmly to Vanessa.
"Alright, then…"
Vanessa nodded helplessly. After thinking for a moment, she said, "The opening ceremony of Heavens Club should be attended by people from the city level at the very least, so anyone above the mayoral level will be good enough!"
"City-level or higher?"
Connor hesitated for a moment and then recalled Rachel.
After all, Newtown wasn't Porthampton. Even Thomas Morgan wouldn't be able to do anything about it. However, Rachel was different. She had a lot of connections, so Connor wanted to ask her to help him. It shouldn't be a big problem to find someone above the city level.
Although Connor's relationship with Rachel was ordinary, she was still in his home, so he felt that he could think of a way to deal with it.
"Do you need anyone else?"
Connor looked at Vanessa and asked.
"Next should be business management…"
Vanessa paused for a moment before saying softly, "Mr. McDonald, you have a good relationship with Miss Thompson of the Thompson Family, right?"
"Yeah, we're friends!"
Connor lightly nodded.
"That's easy. You can invite the Thompson Family over. After all, the Thompson Family is very influential in the business world…"
Vanessa looked at Connor and said.
Connor also nodded lightly. After all, even if Salma Thompson didn't agree to his request, Connor could still ask Reena Satchwell to come or ask Thomas to help find some people. It shouldn't be a big problem.
"The people from the business world can be easily settled. Who else do you need?"
Connor looked at Vanessa and asked.
"If we can find a suitable celebrity to cut the ribbon, it will be even better!"
Vanessa hesitated for a moment before looking at Connor.
"Celebrity?"
Connor hesitated for a couple of seconds after hearing this, then looked at Vanessa and asked, "What do you think of Tiffany Zamora?"
"She has been very popular recently. She's a good choice, but I think there's someone more suitable than Tiffany!"
Vanessa said lightly.

chapters.title: Chapter 1319: Yvette Wendell?
chapters.content:
Chapter 1319: Yvette Wendell?
"There's actually someone more suitable than Tiffany? Who is it?"
Connor hurriedly asked.
"I think Yvette Wendell, who has just debuted recently but is very popular, should be more suitable. If you can invite Yvette over, it will have a great impact!"
Vanessa looked at Connor and said.
Yvette Wendell?
Connor froze on the spot when he heard the name. He had met Yvette once the day before yesterday. Most importantly, he did not seem to have left a good impression on Yvette!
Therefore, Connor was in an awkward position.
"Mr. McDonald, do you know Yvette Wendell?"
Vanessa was a very intelligent woman. She could tell that something was wrong with Connor after he heard Yvette's name. Hence, she asked Connor softly.
"We don't really know each other, but we did meet once before!"
Connor was somewhat helpless as he replied to Vanessa.
"I see!"
Vanessa gently nodded.
"Vanessa, why do you think Yvette is more suitable for the opening ceremony than Tiffany?"
Connor looked at Vanessa and asked.
"Well, Yvette is the most popular female celebrity right now. Her popularity is definitely enough to beat all the other female celebrities in seconds. Another more important reason is that Yvette has yet to participate in any commercial activities. If we can invite her, it will surely make a statement about us. It will definitely be big news. That's why I feel that Yvette's appearance will be far more effective than Tiffany's. Of course, If you can't get Yvette, you can get Tiffany to replace her!"
Vanessa explained seriously.
Connor looked at Vanessa and hesitated for a couple of seconds, then lightly said, "It would be better if Arthur Synder and the others weren't there. However, if we can't invite Yvette, but Arthur Synder can, then that won't do. I'll try my best. It'll be best if I can invite her. If I can't, I'll have to get Tiffany!"
"Alright!"
Vanessa looked at Connor and nodded.
Connor and Vanessa briefly talked about the details of the opening ceremony, and then Connor left Heavens Club.
After leaving Heavens Club, Connor began to think about how he should gather all the people that Vanessa had just mentioned.
First of all, the simplest person to get would definitely be someone from the business world. Because Connor and Salma Thompson had a good relationship, Salma would definitely help. Moreover, there was Thomas Morgan and Reena Satchwell. There was Queta Juve as a last resort too.
Of course, Connor wouldn't get Queta to do this unless he had no other choice. He didn't want too many people to know about his relationship with her.
As for the people from the government. Connor was going to ask Rachel Wallace for help. Connor felt that it would not be a big problem for her to settle this matter.
Therefore, the most difficult person to deal with at this moment was the celebrity, Yvette Wendell.
Connor had just offended Yvette a few days ago, and now he was actually going to beg her to do something for him. It would be really awkward.
Furthermore, even if Connor had never offended Yvette, she was rather strange. It was impossible for Yvette to attend such an opening ceremony. Hence, it would not be easy for Connor to invite her. However, Yvette's appearance would greatly boost their reputation. Therefore, Connor did not intend to give up this opportunity.
Connor planned to deal with those who were easy to get first, then leave Yvette for last. If he really could not invite Yvette, he could invite Tiffany to come. It would then give him a way out.
"Phew…"
Connor took a deep breath, then took out his phone and dialed Salma's number.
Ring, ring…
After the phone rang twice, Salma picked it up and said in a strange tone, "My, my, look who's calling?"
"Uh..."
When Connor heard Salma's words, a trace of embarrassment flashed across his eyes. He then said softly, "Um, do you have time now? Let's meet up."
"What? Are you regretting it now? You want to confess to me? I've changed my mind. There are so many good men in this world. Why should I pin all my hopes and dreams on you?"
Salma said angrily.
"I'm not going to confess. I have something important to tell you!"
Connor said helplessly.
"What is it?"
Salma was stunned.
"I really have something important to talk to you about. Do you have time to meet up? Let's meet and talk!"
Connor replied helplessly.
"Alright, then let's meet at the Japanese restaurant next to our school. I'm hungry right now!"
Salma didn't want to waste any more time talking on the phone and replied.
"Alright!"
Connor agreed and hung up the phone. He hailed a taxi and went to the Japanese restaurant next to Newtown University.
When Connor arrived at the Japanese restaurant, he realized that Salma had already arrived.
Today, Salma was dressed up very beautifully. Her white dress accentuated her perfect figure. Her face was exquisite, and her skin was fair.
If not for the fact that Connor already had Freya Phillips in his heart, he might have fallen for Salma.
"Connor, over here!"
Salma saw Connor walk in, so she hurriedly waved at him.
Connor walked to Salma's side and sat opposite her.
"Connor, the salmon here is very delicious. Do you want to try it?"
Salma asked Connor with a smile.
"No. I don't like salmon…"
Connor replied indifferently.
"Alright, then!"
Salma nodded helplessly and continued, "You were in such a hurry to meet me. What's going on? Just tell me!"
"..."
Connor looked at Salma and hesitated for a moment before saying softly, "Actually, it's quite simple. You know that I took over Heavens Club some time ago, right?"
"I know. I was there. I was going to ask you about your relationship with the boss of Heavens Club. Why did she give you Heavens Club?"
Salma asked Connor curiously.
"Chelsea Lee is my aunt!"
Connor replied helplessly.
"What?"
When Salma heard this, her beautiful eyes widened in shock. She had never expected Chelsea to be Connor's aunt.

chapters.title: Chapter 1320: The Maxwell Family's Backstory
chapters.content:
Chapter 1320: The Maxwell Family's Backstory
"I only found out about this after I took over Heavens Club, but I'm not sure if it's true!"
Connor looked at Salma and explained.
"No wonder Chelsea gave you Heavens Club. Chelsea is your aunt. This is unbelievable. I thought that she was your lover!"
Salma said in shock.
"Hello, what goes on in that head of yours? How could Chelsea be my lover!"
Connor said speechlessly.
When Salma found out about the true relationship between Connor and Chelsea, all the doubts in her heart were dispelled.
"Alright, then tell me, why did you want to see me?"
Salma looked at Connor and asked.
"Our club might be holding an opening ceremony next week, so I hope you can bring your grandfather to attend…"
Connor looked at Salma and said.
"That's why!"
When Salma heard Connor's words, she couldn't help but purse her lips and softly said, "I thought that you've changed your mind!"
"Uh..."
Connor looked at Salma with an awkward expression. He took a deep breath and asked, "So, what say you?"
"You saved me once, so I can help you with this, but I have one condition!"
Salma thought for a moment and said to Connor.
"What request?"
Connor hurriedly asked.
"I used to think that you rejected me because you had a relationship with Chelsea. Losing to Chelsea is a given, but since you are not in a relationship with her, I don't understand why you rejected me."
Salma asked Connor doubtfully.
"..."
Connor looked at Salma and hesitated for a couple of seconds before saying softly, "Actually, I already have a fiancée!"
"..."
Salma looked at Connor and hesitated for a couple of seconds before saying softly, "I'm really curious about who your fiancée is…"
"She is the most perfect woman in my eyes!"
Connor replied seriously.
"Alright, since you've already answered my question, I'll attend your opening ceremony!"
Salma did not say anything else and slowly got up to leave.
Connor looked at Salma's back view with a trace of helplessness in his eyes. He took a deep breath and left as well.
...
After leaving the Japanese restaurant, Connor looked at the time and figured that Rachel would have finished class by now, so he hailed a taxi back home.
When he got home, Connor found Rachel sitting on the sofa watching a TV series.
After hesitating for a moment, he walked to Rachel's side with a smile and asked softly, "Miss Wallace, you're back?"
Rachel slowly raised her head and looked at him. Then she pouted and said, "Are you planning to beg me for something again? What is it? Just tell me. I'm not in the mood to talk nonsense with you..."
"Uh..."
Connor was stunned for a moment, then asked with a puzzled expression, "Um, how did you know that I have something to ask of you?"
"If you don't have anything to ask of me, why would you talk to me like this? You're a practical guy. If you have anything to say, just say it!"
Rachel replied indifferently.
"Am I that kind of person?"
Connor looked at Rachel and smiled awkwardly.
"You know very well whether or not you are!"
Rachel pouted and said.
After hesitating for a moment, Connor sat beside Rachel and said softly, "Alright, since you've already said so, I won't beat around the bush with you. Heavens Club will be opening in a few days, but I need some people from the government to help me build its reputation. You know that my connections are limited, so can you help me?"
"Help?"
When Rachel heard Connor's words, she could not help but sneer. After which, she softly said, "You're Steven Lee's heir, the famous Mr. McDonald of Porthampton. Can't you handle such a small matter yourself?"
"I don't know many people in Newtown. I don't know as many people as you do…"
Connor said with a smile.
"I don't know many people in Newtown either, so I can't help you with this. You'd better find someone else!"
Rachel said indifferently.
"Don't joke around with me. I know how connected you are. It shouldn't be too much of a problem for you to help me find someone above the city level, right?"
Connor gritted his teeth.
"I came to Newtown because of you. I don't know many people here. I don't have to lie to you about this!"
Rachel helplessly explained to Connor.
"Well, this opening ceremony of mine is related to people from Rockefeller. Because the person behind Arthur Synder is Yaakov Ward. This is the best opportunity to find Yaakov!"
Connor looked at Rachel and said seriously.
"Even if this matter has something to do with the people in Rockefeller, I can't help you because I really don't know anyone in this field!"
Rachel looked at Connor and lightly shook her head.
"You really can't find anyone?"
Connor seemed to be unwilling to give up.
"Yes, I don't have to lie to you about this kind of thing. If you don't believe me, then there's nothing I can do!"
Rachel said helplessly.
"Alright then, I'll think of another way!"
Connor could feel that Rachel really had no other way. Otherwise, she wouldn't have spoken to him like this. Therefore, there was no point in continuing the conversation.
"Although I can't help you find a suitable person, I know someone who can help you!"
Just as Connor was about to turn around and enter him room, Rachel spoke again.
"Who is it?"
Connor hurriedly asked.
"Luna Maxwell from your class!"
Rachel replied.
"Luna?"
When Connor heard Rachel's words, a trace of confusion flashed across his eyes. Then, he frowned and said, "That's not right. Luna's family is in the business arena. I doubt that she has any contact with the higher-ups."
"Ordinary people might think that the Maxwell Family is doing business, but if the Maxwell Family doesn't have any background, how can they have such a big business…"
Rachel looked at Connor and said indifferently.
When Connor heard Rachel's words, he instantly understood what she meant.
He asked Rachel with an excited expression, "Are you saying that the Maxwell Family that Luna is from has some other background?"

chapters.title: Chapter 1321: Racing Track
chapters.content:
Chapter 1321: Racing Track
"That's for sure!" Rachel nodded gently and continued, "So, if you can handle Luna and get her uncle to attend your grand opening ceremony, the effect will definitely be much better than the people I found for you!"
"Is he that great?" Connor couldn't help but take a deep breath and looked very astonished.
He had always thought that Luna's family was in business, but he didn't know that her uncle had such great influence!
If he could really persuade Luna and invite her uncle, the effect would undoubtedly be excellent.
"Thank you for this information!" he exclaimed excitedly, then rushed into his room.
Inside the room, he intended to call Luna but realized he didn't have her contact information. He reluctantly dialed Justin's phone instead.
"Ring, ring..."
After two rings, Justin answered the phone.
"Connor, what have you been up to lately? Why haven't you come to school for classes?" Justin shouted with excitement.
"Well, I've been busy with other things lately. I'll explain to you when I have time. By the way, do you know Luna's phone number?" he asked directly.
"Yes, why do you need the class monitor's number?" Justin answered.
"Give me her number. I have something to talk to her about!" Connor replied in a low voice.
"Sure, wait a moment. I'll find it for you!" Justin said softly and then provided Connor with Luna's phone number.
After getting her number, he immediately called her.
But the phone rang for a long time, and there was no answer.
He checked the time and found that it was just past seven in the evening. She couldn't possibly be asleep yet, so he called her again.
Just as he was about to give up, she finally answered the call.
"Hello, who is this?" The voice from her side was very noisy, with a lot of background noise, as if she was in a club, but there was no music playing.
"Luna, it's Connor. I need to talk to you about something..." he said helplessly.
"What did you say?" she shouted loudly.
"I said I'm Connor, and I need to talk to you!" he repeated himself.
"Oh, you're Connor. Why did you suddenly call me?" she shouted.
"It's too noisy there. Where are you? I'll come to see you." He thought it would be better to discuss these matters in person.
"Alright, come to Hewbrew Street!" Luna shouted and then hung up the phone.
"Hewbrew Street?" Connor was a bit puzzled when he heard this place name, but he didn't think too much about it. He simply put on his clothes and walked out of the room.
"You're going out?" Rachel couldn't help but ask when she saw him coming out.
"Yes, I'm going to meet Luna and talk about something!" he replied briefly and then left the house.
Rachel looked at Connor's back and couldn't help but pout, whispering softly, "I didn't expect you to be so efficient in handling things..."
...
On the other side, after leaving the apartment, Connor hailed a taxi and told the driver to go to Hewbrew Street.
When the taxi driver heard him saying he was going to Hewbrew Street, he was surprised but didn't say much. He just quietly drove the car.
As Connor looked out of the window at the scenery, he thought about how to talk to Luna about the matter when they meet.
But half an hour later, he suddenly realized that something was wrong because the taxi had taken him up to the mountains.
"Driver, are we going to Hewbrew Street?" he asked the taxi driver cautiously.
"Yes, isn't that where you wanted to go? It's a must-pass road to Hewbrew Street..." the taxi driver replied calmly.
"We seem to have already reached the mountains. Is Hewbrew Street on the mountain?" he was a bit speechless.
"You see, the Hewbrew Street, of course, is in the mountains. It's a well-known street racing spot in Newtown. All the people who go there are rich second-generation guys driving sports cars. How could anyone take a taxi there? Hewbrew Street is like a holy land for street racing in Newtown. On Friday nights, many rich second-generation guys go there to race!" the taxi driver explained as he drove.
"Street racing?" He was stunned after hearing this, and his expression showed surprise.
"Could it be that Luna is going street racing?" A bold thought crossed Connor's mind.
After all, Luna said she was on Hewbrew Street, and just now, there was indeed a lot of noise on her side during the call. It didn't sound like she was on the mountain.
He found it hard to believe because, in his impression, Luna was a very gentle girl who wanted to join the entertainment industry. How could she have anything to do with street racing?
"Young man, we've arrived!" Just as he was feeling puzzled, the taxi driver turned to him and shouted.
"Alright..." He nodded and then took out his phone to pay the fare.

chapters.title: Chapter 1322: A Race
chapters.content:
Chapter 1322: A Race
The taxi driver received the fare and quietly told Connor, "Young man, the road ahead is blocked by some sports cars, so I won't go any further. You can just walk from here!"
"Alright, thanks!" Connor nodded and walked on.
After about ten minutes of walking, he saw a large group of people gathered together ahead, and numerous sports cars were parked quietly on the roadside. Any of these cars could be worth millions, and the deafening roar made one feel dizzy.
When Connor arrived at Hewbrew Street, he found two sports cars racing, and the scene was lively.
Connor couldn't connect this place with the gentle and innocent girl, Luna. So, he took out his phone, found Luna's number, and called her again.
"Ring, ring..."
The phone rang for a long time before she finally answered the call.
"Connor, have you arrived?" she shouted.
"Yes, I'm at Hewbrew Street now, but I see people racing here. I didn't see you!" he replied helplessly.
"If you see people racing, then that's right. I'm coming to find you," she said softly and hung up the phone.
A few minutes later, he finally saw her walking out from the crowd, accompanied by a tall and beautiful woman. However, the woman wore sunglasses, and Connor couldn't see her face clearly.
"Connor!" Luna waved to him and quickly ran over.
"When did you become interested in street racing?" he asked her helplessly.
"I'm not interested in street racing. I came here with my cousin today. I was curious about how they race, so I came to see the excitement..." she explained, then pointed to the beautiful woman beside her and introduced, "Connor, this is my cousin, Yerba Layton!"
After introducing her cousin, Luna said to Yerba, "Cousin, this is my good friend Connor!"
"Hello, handsome guy!" Yerba took off her sunglasses and smiled at Connor.
"Hello!" he replied and gave her a quick once-over.
Yerba was quite good-looking, not a top-tier beauty, but compared to ordinary people, she was close to the level of a goddess. Moreover, she had a very good figure. She wore a black camisole on her upper body, revealing her slender waist and high-rising bosom. On her lower body, she wore denim shorts, showing off her fair and slender legs, and she had a pair of canvas shoes on her feet.
She gave off a feeling of sexiness mixed with hotness, yet still youthful.
"My cousin really likes street racing. She comes here almost every week. So today, I came along to see the excitement!" Luna said with a smile.
"I see!" Connor nodded thoughtfully.
"Hey, handsome guy, can you race?" Yerba suddenly asked Connor.
"I can't..." He shook his head lightly.
"Don't be so modest. Let's have a race!" Yerba smiled.
"Let's forget it. I've never raced before..." He refused again.
"Come on, why are you so hesitant? Let's just have a simple race. Come on, try it with me..." She looked at him.
He took a glance at her and knew she wouldn't let him go, so he could only helplessly say, "If you want to race with me, that's fine, but I came here in a taxi, not in a car..."
"It's fine!" She threw the car key to him and said softly, "This is my car. You drive it, and I'll borrow another car. Wait for me!"
Connor looked at the Ferrari car key in his hand and smiled wryly, then turned around and got into the car.
After getting into the car, he could smell a pleasant fragrance, and there were several pairs of high heels on the passenger seat. Obviously, these were just taken off by her. She probably only wore canvas shoes while driving.
A few minutes later, she borrowed a Lamborghini from someone else.
Connor and Yerba drove to the starting point.
Originally, he had intended to come here to talk to Luna about her uncle's matter, but unexpectedly, he ended up street racing.
After a brief preparation, the beautiful woman referee standing in front of the cars waved the flag in her hand.
She rushed out almost immediately, while he, who had never raced before, obviously started much slower.
However, his driving skills were actually quite good, plus he was a martial artist, so his reaction speed was not something an ordinary person could match. Racing was a piece of cake for him.
Due to the slower start, he was always trailing behind, but surprisingly, he managed to keep up with her the whole time. No matter how hard she tried to leave him behind, he stayed right behind her.
Yerba was famous as a female racing driver in Newtown. Although her racing skills might not match those of professional drivers, she had no problem racing against ordinary enthusiasts.
But to her surprise, he managed to keep up with her all the way.
Moreover, he had the opportunity to overtake, but he never seemed interested in surpassing her.
"Is he letting me win?" Yerba couldn't help but wonder.
A few minutes later, she reached the finish line, and he followed closely behind.
Although she won in the end, she felt that he didn't really show his true abilities.
"Connor, you drove pretty well!" Luna ran up to him and said with a smile.
"It doesn't matter if I drove well; I still lost, didn't I?" he replied with a faint smile.
"My cousin is famous here as the 'Car Goddess.' It's not embarrassing to lose to her. She just beat several amateur drivers a while ago, and they couldn't match your driving skills!" Luna quickly explained.
Connor smiled but didn't say much.
Yerba had been sizing up him and didn't speak.

chapters.title: Chapter 1323: Dirty Tricks
chapters.content:
Chapter 1323: Dirty Tricks
"By the way, Connor, you came to see me for something, right? What is it?"
Luna softly asked Connor.
"I do have something to discuss with you. Is it convenient to talk here?" he asked.
"There's no inconvenience. Just say it. My cousin isn't a stranger!" she replied directly.
"Alright then!"
Connor nodded and looked at Luna. He said, "You should know about the news that I've taken over the Heavens Club, right?"
"I know." She nodded.
Upon seeing the subtle change in his expression, Yerba realized that he was the new owner of Heavens Club. She hadn't expected it since he seemed quite ordinary and young, not matching the rumors.
"In a while, I plan to hold a grand opening ceremony. I heard that your uncle is Blake Layton. Can you help me talk to him and invite him to be our guest of honor for the ribbon-cutting?"
Connor looked at Luna and asked.
"Well..." Luna's expression seemed somewhat helpless, and she turned to glance at Yerba before saying softly, "I think it might be more reliable if you ask my cousin for help..."
"Ask your cousin for help?"
Connor looked at Yerba, his eyes revealing a hint of confusion.
"Yes, my cousin is Blake's daughter!"
Luna explained helplessly.
"What?"
Connor was dumbfounded when he heard this. He hadn't expected Yerba to be Blake's daughter.
"Don't we look alike?" Yerba asked with some helplessness.
"It's not that, I just didn't think of it that way..." He realized his reaction was too intense and quickly explained.
"I heard what you said to Luna earlier. You want my father to attend your opening ceremony, right?" she asked.
"Yes!" He nodded quickly.
"Then, I advise you to give up on that idea. My father won't attend such entertainment events...," she replied directly.
"Is there really no other way? As long as I can get your father to attend my opening ceremony, I'm willing to agree to any conditions..." he asked.
"I don't have any way. My father won't attend, no matter who asks him. Even if I speak for you, it won't work because my father dislikes others meddling in his work. So, don't waste your time on my father. You can try finding another way or ask someone else..." she explained with a hint of resignation.
"Oh..."
Connor was at a loss for words, not knowing what to do next.
He hadn't expected her attitude to be so resolute.
"Yerba, long time no see! I heard you won several races just now!" a voice suddenly interrupted.
Just as Connor was about to continue speaking, a voice interrupted. He turned to see a blond youth walking towards Yerba and there was a large group of people behind him.
"Ferb, I won or lost doesn't seem to have anything to do with you, right?" Yerba said with a disdainful expression.
"Come on, Yerba, I just came to ask if you dare to race me..." Ferb Gray looked at her with a lewd expression and asked softly.
"You want to race me?" Her face showed a slight smile. Then she said, "Can you compete with me?"
"Whether I can or not, we won't know until we try!" Ferb said with a smile.
"I don't have the mood to waste time with you. Whatever you want to do, just do it!" she said with a frown.
"Race for one million. Do you dare to bet?" he asked herdirectly.
"What did you say?" She was astonished to hear Ferb's words. Her expression was incredulous.
After all, his racing skills were quite average and not comparable to her.
Yet now, he was suggesting a bet of one million, practically giving money away.
"We will only know once we try," he said with a sneer.
"Fine, I'll bet with you!" She wasted no time. She snatched the car keys from Connor's hand and said to Ferb, "Let's go!"
"Wait, my men are coming soon. Wait a bit!" he sneered.
"Your people haven't arrived yet?" Yerba's expression froze, looking surprised.
As Connor heard this, he realized that she seemed to have fallen into a trap.
"Yes, they will be here soon!" He nodded lightly.
"I'm not in a hurry to race with you. I'll find someone else to take my place for the race," he continued with a grin.
"How shameless can you be? It's obvious you're being deceitful!" Luna couldn't stand it and shouted at him.
"Being deceitful? Haha, little girl, do you not understand the rules here? It's allowed for someone to substitute for me in a race. If you're not satisfied, you can find someone to substitute for Yerba as well. But I haven't broken any rules. If you don't believe it, you can ask others!" Ferb said with disdain.
"Right, what Ferb said is correct!"
"We do allow substitutions here!"
"I wonder who Ferb found this time. I'm quite curious..."
As Yerba usually kept a low profile, nobody knew the extent of her powerful connections. Therefore, everyone sided with Ferb at the moment.
She stared at him with wide eyes, her expression full of anger.
However, she had no other choice now because he was right, he hadn't violated any rules.
"Ferb, don't you dare to race me yourself?" she asked with a furrowed brow.
"Of course not. I never said I would race you. I only said I wanted to bet with you, but I'll find someone else to race in my place," he replied with a smirk.
"How can you be so shameless? You're clearly resorting to dirty tricks!" Luna couldn't help but speak out, her voice filled with anger.
"If you dare not bet with me, just say so. I'll go find someone else!" he said with a smug smile.
"What... What are you doing?"
Yerba was in disbelief when she heard this, and her expression turned extremely angry.
At this moment, Connor realized that she had fallen into a trap and felt sorry for her.

chapters.title: Chapter 1324: The Hired Helper
chapters.content:
Chapter 1324: The Hired Helper
"Cousin, what should we do now?" Luna anxiously asked Yerba.
"Let's see who Ferb brought along," Yerba replied, still confident in her own driving skills. She remained calm and didn't say much.
Meanwhile, Ferb wore a smug expression, feeling that winning the bet would be a breeze.
A few minutes later, the roar of an engine echoed through the air.
Everyone turned to the entrance as a silver Pagani Zonda slowly approached.
Upon hearing the conversation between Ferb and Yerba, Connor realized that she had been deceived by Ferb's cunning plan.
Ferb had no intention of racing against Yerba himself; instead, he had invited a skilled driver to take his place. Though this violated the rules of street racing, the others were hesitant to confront Ferb due to his influential connections.
And these people at the scene probably had no idea about Yerba's identity. If they were to find out that she was Blake's daughter, even if they were bold, they still wouldn't dare to offend her.
She was usually very low-key and wouldn't voluntarily tell others that her father was Blake.
At this moment, Yerba was also unaware of who this expert that Ferb brought here is, so she was not anxious. After all, she was quite skilled in driving, and she believed she still had the ability to compete unless he has found an incredibly formidable expert.
The crowd began to wait silently.
The silver Pagani supercar doesn't keep everyone waiting for too long. It raced towards the spot where everyone was with incredible speed.
The car moved swiftly, giving the impression of a lightning bolt. Ordinary people can't even discern its true appearance; all they see was a fleeting blur.
However, the speed of this car was not as astonishing to Connor as it was to others. After all, he was no ordinary person but a martial artist. With his current abilities, he can easily capture the car's movements.
Yerba's face shows great concern because she can tell from the car's speed that it was no ordinary sports car, and its driver was undoubtedly a skilled expert.
In less than a few seconds, the car came to a stop right in front of the crowd.
Unlike other sports cars, when this one stops, it doesn't produce the slightest screeching sound of brakes. It feels unusually quiet, as if it appeared out of thin air in front of everyone's eyes.
Seeing this scene, Ferb's eyes gleamed with satisfaction.
"A limited-edition Pagani Zonda!"
Everyone observed the silver car in front of them, their eyes filled with shocked and disbelief.
"What is a Pagani Zonda?" Connor turned to Yerba and asksedin a hushed voice.
"The Pagani Zonda is a globally limited-edition supercar, with less than fifteen of them in the entire world. They say its performance reaches the pinnacle of sports cars, unmatched by any other. Moreover, to get this car, it's not just about having money; you also need exceptionally advanced driving skills. Otherwise, you won't qualify to own it…" she explained solemnly.
"According to that, the owner of this car should be a skilled driver!" he whispered.
"I can't be sure at the moment. Even though the car is exceptional, it doesn't mean the driver is also extraordinary. He might have borrowed the car," she said calmly.
"But even if it's borrowed, the person should still be quite skilled," he said slowly.
Yerba glanced helplessly at Connor, not knowing what to say.
Just then, the window of the Pagani Zonda rolls down, and the face of a young man appeared in front of everyone. The youth had a rather handsome appearance, with exceptionally determined eyes and a serious expression.
Recognizing him, she murmured with despair, "I didn't expect Ferb to bring him."
"Do you know him?" Connor asked, looking at her.
"This person is a legend in the racing world. His name is Waller Li, a legendary street racer. They say he's undefeated in a hundred races and is the most famous car god in our country. The Pagani Zonda indeed belongs to him," Yerba explained.
"A professional like that? He must be really skilled," Connor commented.
"I can't be certain at this moment. Even though the car is exceptional, it doesn't mean the driver is also extraordinary. He might have borrowed the car," she said.
"Even if he borrowed it, he must be someone with considerable skill," he said thoughtfully.
The window of the Pagani Zonda opened, and the crowd saw the face of Waller. Some newcomers to the racing circle were in awe of his cool appearance.
Yerba sighed with helplessness. She knew Ferb had planned to challenge her using Waller's expertise.
The others also noticed Waller's arrival, and some of them didn't recognize him.
"Who is this guy? He looks pretty cool!"
"Yeah, who is he? I haven't seen him before."
Some newcomers expressed their confusion.
"You guys don't even recognize Waller? You've embarrassed our street racing community!" one youth said with disdain.
"Waller?"
The crowd was shocked to hear the name, their expressions full of surprise.
"Mr. Wonder, are you joking with us? Is this really the renowned Waller?"
"Yeah, he's the car god. How could he come to our small place?"
Everyone expressed their disbelief.
"I've seen Waller once before, and I can guarantee this is him!" Mr. Wonder said confidently.

chapters.title: Chapter 1325: Substitute for You?
chapters.content:
Chapter 1325: Substitute for You?
And the other people present seemed to recognize this Waller. Many of them were enthusiasts in the racing circle, well aware of how terrifying Waller's skills were.
Moreover, they deeply admired Waller from the bottom of their hearts.
"Waller!"
"Waller!"
At once, everyone present began to shout Waller's name, their expressions filled with excitement.
Luna also knew how formidable Waller's skills were. A trace of worry flashed in her eyes as she asked Yerba in a hushed voice, "Sister, can you win against this person?"
...
Upon hearing this, Yerba couldn't help but shake her head and whispered, "Waller is the new generation car god, with excellent driving skills. I can't possibly match him!"
"If you can't even match him, what should we do?" Luna's expression turned nervous, standing still and not knowing what to do.
...
Yerba's expression became extremely serious without saying a word.
Although the ten million dollars might not be a huge sum for Yerba, her father was an honest official, and their family's wealth was limited. Coming up with such a large sum of money was not an easy task for her. Moreover, the most important thing was that Yerba refused to be played around like this.
After chatting briefly with Waller, Ferb proudly walked up to Yerba and grinned, "Yerba, do you plan to compete yourself or find someone else to take your place?"
"Ferb, you're shameless! How could you invite Waller here!" Yerba said in a low voice.
"D you realize what you're saying? It's my ability that allowed me to invite Waller here. If you're not convinced, you can find a skilled driver to come, I don't mind!" Ferb said indifferently.
"You..."
Yerba was rendered speechless, standing in place with a helpless expression.
"I'll give you a few more minutes. If you want to call someone else, you'd better hurry!" Ferb threw down these words arrogantly and then turned to leave.
At this moment, Ferb was very confident. He believed that no matter who Yerba called, they wouldn't stand a chance against Waller. After all, Waller had won a hundred consecutive races, and his abilities were evident.
...
"You despicable person, what's there to be so arrogant about!" The usually naive Luna couldn't stand it any longer and shouted at Ferb, pouting.
Ferb heard Luna's words, gave a faint smile, and didn't say much. He turned and left.
Yerba stood expressionless, hesitated for two seconds, then turned to Connor and asked, "Connor, how about you take my place in the competition?"
"I take your place?" Connor was stunned by her request.
Luna also looked puzzled and whispered, "Sister, it's too late for this. Connor didn't even surpass you just now, how could he be Waller's match!"
"Connor, I know you've been holding back your strength. You could have surpassed me just now, but you chose not to. So, I think your driving skills should be better than mine. Are you willing to help me?" she asked earnestly.
Normally, he wouldn't get involved in others' affairs, especially since he had just met Yerba less than an hour ago. But now, he was indebted to her as she was Blake's daughter.
After hesitating for a moment, he said softly, "I can help you, but I haven't raced before, so I can't guarantee a win."
"It's okay. I know I will lose if I go up. With you, there might still be a chance!" She knew his driving skills weren't weak and that he could at least compete on an equal footing with her, making him the best choice.
"Alright, since you put it that way, I'll help you this time." He nodded gently.
"Have you made up your mind? When can we start? If you're not up for it, just surrender, don't continue to embarrass yourself!" Just then, Ferb suddenly shouted at Yerba.
She took a deep breath, then pointed at Connor and shouted, "He will replace me in the competition!"
"What?" Ferb was instantly stunned when he heard her words, his expression filled with disbelief.
"Are you kidding me? You want this kid to replace you? Are you out of your mind?" he shouted loudly.
All the people present looked at Connor with strange gazes. After all, they had never seen Connor before, and they felt that Yerba's decision to have him compete was quite risky.
At that moment, Waller stepped out of his car and glanced at Connor, but he didn't say anything. His expression remained calm and composed. After all, no matter who it was today, he wouldn't take them seriously. He was the undefeated racing champion, and how could he possibly view Connor, an ordinary person, as a threat?
Waller's reason for being there was simple: money. He had borrowed five million from Ferb to buy the Pagani Zonda. So, as long as Waller won the competition, he wouldn't have to repay the five million.
"Ro Yuge, if you're afraid to compete, just forget about it. Why would you bring an ordinary person here to deceive us? Aren't you just giving me the money?" Ferb said with a sly smile, looking at Yerba.
"Today, the winner is not decided yet!" Yerba replied calmly, then handed the car key to Connor.
After stepping out of the car, Waller walked towards Connor, sized him up, and then said calmly, "Hello, I'm Waller!"
"Connor!" Connor replied.
"I'm here to participate in racing in Newtown for the first time. Are there any rules here?" Waller asked as he looked at Connor.
"This is also my first time here, so I'm not sure about the rules," Connor answered calmly.
"In that case, the rules of our competition are simple. Whoever reaches the finish line first wins, there are no other complicated rules!" Ferb quickly explained.
"Alright!" Waller nodded and then continued, "I heard that the Mountain Ring Road is quite famous for racing. How about we choose there as the route?"

chapters.title: Chapter 1326: The Competition Begins
chapters.content:
Chapter 1326: The Competition Begins
"Alright!"
Connor readily agreed.
Everyone was dumbfounded when they saw this. Their expressions were extremely incredulous.
The mountain road that Waller had mentioned was indeed very famous; all the racing enthusiasts in Newtown knew about it. The road conditions were very complicated, and the whole road was winding around a mountain. A few years ago, people would often go up to race, but the death rate was very high, with every five out of ten people dying.
Later, the highway bureau directly sealed off this road, and no one went up at all.
Waller, as the famous racing god, naturally wanted to challenge such a difficult road. However, Connor had no racing experience at all. No one expected Connor to agree.
"Connor, are you crazy?"
Yerba grabbed Connor's arm and shouted at him excitedly.
"What's wrong?"
Connor turned to look at Yerba and asked with a puzzled expression.
Yerba's big watery eyes widened.
"What do you mean? Do you know how dangerous that path is? Even people like us who specialize in racing don't dare to challenge that road. If you go there now, you'll die, do you know that?"
"That's right, Connor. I also heard that that road is very dangerous. I think you should tell them to go somewhere else!"
Luna also said.
"..."
Connor hesitated for two seconds after hearing Luna and Yerba's words. Then, he said, "If it was a normal route, I definitely wouldn't be a match for Waller. But if the road conditions are very complicated, then I might have a chance of winning!"
"It's only 10 million. There's no need for you to risk your life!"
Yerba frowned.
Connor couldn't help but laugh when he heard this. Then, he said coldly, "It might be 10 million to you, but it's not as simple as 10 million to me!"
After saying this, Connor directly said to Waller, "The mountain road will do!"
"Good!"
Waller nodded lightly.
When the crowd saw that Waller and Connor were really planning to run along the mountain path, they instantly erupted into a loud roar. After all, they had not seen anyone run along that path for a long time. This was a good opportunity for everyone to feast their eyes!
"By the way, I have a habit when I drive. I need a female companion to sit in the front passenger seat and help me observe the road conditions. You can also choose to bring someone with you!"
Waller said.
After hearing Waller's words, Connor subconsciously glanced at Waller's sports car. There was indeed a woman sitting in the front passenger seat. The woman looked very beautiful and gentle, and she was dressed very gently and elegantly.
Connor felt that if there was someone in the passenger seat to help him observe the road conditions, he could really put all his attention on driving.
Luna knew nothing about racing, so she definitely couldn't bring Luna up. Now, there was only one choice left, and that was Yerba.
"Are you okay?"
Connor asked Yerba.
After Yerba heard Connor's words, her expression was somewhat helpless. She said, "I don't have any problems, but are you sure you want to run this way? If you regret it now, it's still not too late!"
"I don't regret it!"
Connor said lightly.
One had to know that Connor's current reaction speed might be a hundred times faster than an ordinary person. Therefore, even if the car's speed reached its peak, in Connor's eyes, it was just walking speed.
Although the road around the mountain was complicated, it was definitely dangerous for a car to drive over at high speed.
However, if an ordinary person walked over, there would not be any problem.
This was also the reason why Connor insisted on choosing this path. This was an obvious advantage for Connor.
"Since there are no more problems, then get in the car!"
At this moment, Ferb suddenly shouted and started his car.
Waller's car followed closely behind Ferb. Yerba hesitated for a moment before she got into the car as well.
Yerba sat in the chauffeur's seat and hesitated for two seconds. Then she frowned and said, "Connor, I'm very serious about what I'm telling you. That road is really, really dangerous. You must be careful. It's okay if you lose, but don't let anything happen!"
"You don't have to worry about that. Anyway, even if I lose, I don't have to pay. I definitely put safety first!"
Connor replied with a smile.
After Yerba heard Connor's words, her expression was extremely helpless. She didn't know what to say.
Ten minutes later, everyone arrived at the legendary death route of Newtown—Ring Mountain Road.
After arriving at the destination, the crowd began to set up the scene.
A huge screen was set up at the start of the match, and the screen was divided into many smaller sections each showing a different part of the track. The track would be monitored by small drones so that everyone could clearly understand the situation of the competition.
Soon, Connor and Waller arrived at the starting point.
Everything was ready.
A hot beauty in a bikini walked straight to the starting point. Under the illumination of the lights, the beautiful woman's graceful figure could be seen at a glance.
"This kind of competition usually starts with underwear!" Yerba said.
"Underwear?"
When Connor heard this, he could not help but be stunned for a moment, and a trace of confusion flashed across his eyes.
"Ready!"
Just as Yerba was about to explain to Connor, the bikini beauty suddenly shouted and placed her right hand on the button of her bra.
"Begin!"
The next second, the bikini beauty unbuttoned her bra.
Connor had never seen such a scene before. He was stunned on the spot.
"Buzz!"
A huge explosion rang out..
Waller's car rushed out, but Connor was still stunned on the spot.
"Brother, it's starting. What are you looking at?"
Yerba shouted excitedly when she saw that Connor didn't have any reaction.
Connor stared at Yerba and asked, "Why did this woman take off her bra?"
"Is this the time for you to think about these things? The competition already started!" Yerba shouted with a broken expression.

chapters.title: Chapter 1327: Let's Talk About Cooperation
chapters.content:
Chapter 1327: Let's Talk About Cooperation
"I'm going…"
At this moment, Connor came back to his senses. Waller's car had already rushed out, so Connor quickly stepped on the accelerator.
Connor's car disappeared in an instant, and everyone's attention was focused on the big screen.
Waller was a famous racing god, so there was no problem with his driving skills. In addition, his car was a Pagani Zonda, while Connor was only driving a modified Ferrari. On top of that, Connor was obviously lagging behind when he started.
Although Connor had only been delayed for a second or two just now, these two seconds could create a lead of nearly a hundred meters.
Under normal circumstances, with such an obvious advantage, Connor had no hope.
However, everyone realized that Connor was driving with no regard for his life. No matter what curve it was, he would not slow down. More importantly, Connor could always pass through the curve in a thrilling manner.
As a result, Connor had already caught up to Waller's car by the time they were halfway through the track. He was only less than 20 meters away from Waller.
Yerba loved to race, but when she sat in the front passenger seat, even she felt a little scared. Connor's way of driving was too crazy. Normal people would not choose to drive like this.
Yerba hesitated for a moment before speaking, "Looks like you really didn't use your full strength when you were racing with me previously…"
"I was helping you maintain your reputation…"
Connor said lightly.
"You're quite good at being a person. According to the current situation, as long as you work harder, we'll probably be able to overtake Waller at the next bend…" Yerba said with an excited tone.
After hearing Yerba's words, Connor couldn't help but hesitate for a moment before saying, "Miss Layton, you should have seen my skills. Then shouldn't the two of us talk about cooperation?"
"Cooperation?"
After Yerba heard Connor's words, she couldn't help but be stunned for a moment. Then, she said with a puzzled expression, "You're planning to split the 10 million with me, right? Don't worry. If you win today, I won't take a single cent of this money. I'll give it all to you…"
"Money is useless to me. I don't lack money at all. I won't be moved even if you give me 100 million…" Connor said to Yerba with a smile.
Yerba was stunned for a moment, then asked with a puzzled expression, "Then what did you mean when you said you wanted to cooperate?"
"Miss Layton, have you forgotten why I came today?" Connor asked
Yerba understood what he meant and asked excitedly, "You want me to invite my father to attend the opening ceremony of your club, right?"
"Yes, that's it!" Connor nodded.
In fact, Connor had intentionally not mentioned this matter. His purpose was to wait until he was halfway through the race to discuss this matter with Yerba.
After all, car racing was so dangerous. Connor definitely wouldn't help Yerba for nothing in return.
Yerba shook her head and said, "That's a little wishful. You don't understand my father's personality. He definitely won't agree to attend your club's opening ceremony, so I advise you to give up on this idea. If you have other matters, I can help you…"
"I don't have anything else that I need your help with right now. There's only that one thing!" Connor replied indifferently.
"Then I might not be able to help you with this matter…"
Yerba shook her head.
"Alright then…"
Seeing Yerba's unyielding attitude, Connor's expression was a little unhappy. He immediately slowed down the car.
When Yerba saw the car slowing down, her expression changed instantly. She shouted at Connor, "Connor, what are you doing? Why did you slow down? Hurry up and catch up!"
Connor turned his head and looked at Yerba, then smiled. "Since you don't plan to help me now, why should I help you? It's quite dangerous ahead. It won't affect me if I lose, so safety is still more important, right?"
After Yerba heard Connor's words, she was instantly speechless. She widened her eyes and shouted, "Connor, how can you be so shameless? I really can't help you with this matter! If I could, I definitely would!"
"Then I can't drive fast now…" Connor said lightly.
"You..."
Yerba did not know what to say.
The people at the starting point were all staring at the screen in a daze. They were confused.
That was because Connor's speed was still very fast. It was possible for him to surpass Waller, but no one expected Connor to suddenly slow down again. Moreover, he had no intention of catching up at all. He had been driving slowly without any intention of rushing.
Luna also noticed that something was wrong. She frowned and muttered, "Is the car broken?"
These people might not know that Connor was currently bargaining with Yerba.
As Yerba watched Waller's car get further and further away, she became very anxious.
"Connor, I'll help you talk to my father about this, but I can't control whether my father goes or not!" Yerba said helplessly.
When Connor heard this, he couldn't help but laugh. Then, he said indifferently, "Alright, then I don't care if we can win today…"
"You..."
Yerba turned her head and looked at Connor. Her face was filled with anger, and she was cursing him in her heart.
Yerba felt that she had never met such a shameless person. But she had no choice. She didn't want to lose to someone like Ferb, so she could only grit her teeth and say, "As long as you win today, I'll make my father attend your opening ceremony, okay?"
"Are you sure?"
Connor asked Yerba with a smile.
"I'm sure. Can you stop talking so much nonsense? If you continue to delay like this, you really won't be able to catch up…" Yerba shouted.
"Don't worry. As long as you agree to my conditions, I will also agree to yours…"
Connor's expression became serious. After all, Blake Layton's appearance at the ceremony was very important.
After that, he didn't continue to be angry with Yerba. He stepped on the accelerator and chased after Waller again.
Soon, Connor caught up with Waller's Pagani Zonda, and the distance between the two cars was reduced again.

chapters.title: Chapter 1328: A Chance to Overtake
chapters.content:
Chapter 1328: A Chance to Overtake
"He actually caught up again?"
When Waller saw Connor's car, he couldn't help but take a deep breath. His expression was also very shocked.
"Looks like the other party is serious this time. You have to be serious too!"
The woman sitting in the front passenger seat said.
"Yes!"
Waller nodded, then focused all his attention on the car.
At this moment, Connor's car was very close to Waller's car, so it was very easy for Connor to overtake him.
"Hurry up!"
Yerba shouted excitedly at Connor.
"..."
Connor hesitated for a moment and was about to speed up when he suddenly realized Waller's car had swerved to the right, not giving Connor a chance to overtake him.
The mountain road was very narrow, and it was very difficult for Connor to overtake. Moreover, Waller was very experienced and kept changing the position of his car. This caused Connor to be unable to overtake directly. If Connor chose to overtake in such a dangerous situation, it was very likely that he would fall off the cliff.
"Why is this Waller so cunning?"
Yerba shouted excitedly when she saw what was happening.
"There's no choice. His skills are very good, so it's normal for him to not let us overtake him!" Connor said in a low voice.
Yerba hesitated for a moment before asking, "Then what do you plan to do now?"
"Wait for an opportunity!"
Connor replied.
"What chance do we have? The finish line is almost here. If you don't surpass him, we'll definitely lose!" Yerba frowned and shouted.
"Don't worry, there will definitely be a chance!"
Connor said lightly.
"It's all your fault. If it weren't for you bargaining with me just now, we wouldn't be in such a passive position now. There were clearly several opportunities to overtake previously, but they were all wasted by you!" Yerba shouted.
Connor ignored Yerba and continued to drive seriously.
At this moment, Connor's car was very close to Waller's car. It was almost as if the two cars were sticking to each other. Waller kept trying to shake him off, but couldn't no matter how hard he tried. Connor couldn't overtake him either. The two of them were in a stalemate.
However, because they were very close to the finish line, Waller's chances of winning were clearly higher.
Waller had always been in the lead, but this was actually a very big test for him. The road conditions here were very complicated, and it had been blocked off a long time ago, so the road had not been repaired for many years.
When the car was traveling at high speed, if there was a pit or a rock, his car would be sent flying. Thus, Waller not only needed to observe Connor behind him, but also the road, which increased the difficulty of the track.
Of course, a racer like Waller wouldn't have much of a problem dealing with such a situation. From the beginning until now, he had been driving very calmly, without the slightest hint of nervousness.
The beauty sitting on the front passenger seat wasn't a simple person either. She could still maintain a faint smile on her face under such circumstances and accurately tell Waller about the road ahead and the possible dangers ahead.
Waller's expression was very serious because he knew that he could not lose. If he lost, his reputation as an undefeated legend would be shattered. He was very unwilling for that to happen.
The finish line was very close, and Waller was already a little nervous.
"Waller, you met a very powerful person this time. He started slower than you and even slowed down in the middle. If not for this, you might have lost today!" The woman in the front passenger seat took the initiative to help Waller relieve the pressure.
"That's right. I didn't expect him to be so stubborn either. I underestimated him. But no matter what, I won't lose today…"
Waller replied in a low voice. Then he stepped on the accelerator, and the car seemed to go faster.
"Don't be so nervous. It's a one-way street ahead. Only one car is allowed to pass, so he doesn't have any chance!" the woman said.
"I know!"
Waller nodded lightly.
On the other side, Yerba's face was filled with anger.
Because she felt that she had lost too badly today. After all, Connor had so many opportunities to overtake, but they were all wasted. If he had not wasted those opportunities, she would have won!.
"It's a one-way street ahead. We don't have a chance to pass!" Yerba said dejectedly.
"Sit tight. I'll overtake after 50 meters!" Connor said lightly.
"Overtake after 50 meters?" Yerba couldn't help but be stunned when she heard Connor's words. Then, she hurriedly looked up and shouted, "Are you crazy? How do we get there?"
"Buzz!"
Connor didn't waste any words and instead increased his speed.
At this time, the situation was very complicated in Connor's car. Because it was all one-way roads, only one car could pass through. Moreover, it was a circular mountain road, so it was easier to make mistakes while controlling the car. Most importantly, this road was not only very narrow, but there were also no guardrails on both sides. As long as there was a slight mistake, the car would fall off the cliff.
This was also the reason why people had died here in the past—this road was too narrow.
In recent years, this road had always been sealed off, and ordinary people would definitely not dare to come up. Because this mountain road was very narrow, it was impossible to overtake unless you wanted to die.
However, there was always a way out. At this moment, Connor found an opportunity.
Further along that one-way street, there was a rock that wasn't very large. If Connor wanted to overtake, he could only choose to drive over this rock because this was the only extra road. If Connor couldn't overtake here, then he would definitely lose today.
Waller seemed to have noticed the situation in front of him. He felt that if he was in Connor's position, he would definitely choose this place to overtake.
This was the best and only opportunity to do so.
Although this opportunity seemed very crazy, he knew that Connor was a crazy person that would not let go of this opportunity.

chapters.title: Chapter 1329: A Madman!
chapters.content:
Chapter 1329: A Madman!
Waller's eyes flashed with determination as he stepped on the accelerator.
In an instant, the Pagani Zonda's speed reached a terrifying number. At the speed it was moving at, the car had been reduced to a blurry silhouette that couldn't be clearly seen.
The woman in the front passenger seat was shocked when she saw the expression on Waller's face. This was the first time she had seen him so serious.
There were two paths in front of him. After passing through these two paths, it would become a single path. As long as Waller charged through this path first, he would still be in the lead.
Under such a tense situation, Waller was going all out.
When Connor saw Waller's speed increase, his expression turned serious. He turned to Yerba and said, "You must sit tight, understand?"
"Yes…" Yerba hurriedly nodded.
Connor directly stepped on the accelerator and his car seemed to fly up. It rushed towards the slope in front of him at an amazing speed.
At this moment, the car was moving extremely fast, as if it had already exceeded the maximum speed that it could withstand. Therefore, the various fault lights of the car began to flash crazily. However, Connor was not in the mood to care about those things and continued to accelerate.
Although Yerba was a person who liked excitement, she had never experienced such a situation before. She felt that Connor was too crazy.
Yerba closed her eyes tightly, not daring to open them.
Both Connor and Waller's cars sped towards the slope at an astonishing speed. The first person to cross this road today would be the champion. This was something that both of them knew very well.
It had been a long time since Waller had been this crazy, and it had also been a long time since he had met an opponent like Connor. He felt as if he had regained the feeling he would get when racing back then.
Initially, Waller didn't think highly of Connor because he felt that an opponent like him was not worth mentioning, so Waller had intended to only do this half-heartedly.
However, he never expected that Connor's strength would actually be so terrifying.
In that split second, Waller suddenly saw a black shadow flash past.
That's right, Connor rushed up the slope.
At this moment, the two sports cars were driving side by side, so whoever cleared the road first would win.
"Does this person want to die?"
The woman in the passenger seat couldn't help but exclaim.
After Connor's car rushed up the slope, it did not have any intention of stopping. It continued to move forward.
What was even more unbelievable was that Connor's car was already sticking to the mountain wall. As the car drove at high speed, sparks flew everywhere. Even Yerba couldn't help but scream.
Although Yerba knew that it was very embarrassing, it was her instinctive reaction.
Connor's car and Waller's car passed through the slope at almost the same time. However, there was a huge problem now: only one car was allowed to pass through the road in front of them. This meant that one of the cars had to slow down, or both of them would crash into each other and the four people would die.
However, Connor had no intention of slowing down, and Waller naturally had no intention of slowing down either.
"F * ck, this lunatic!"
However, at the most crucial moment, Waller instinctively stepped on the brakes.
Connor's car successfully rushed onto that road.
"Is he really not afraid of death?"
Waller looked at the car in front of him with a shocked expression.
He really couldn't understand how Connor would refuse to slow down at all in such a dangerous situation.
"He's using his life to race!" the woman in the passenger seat said slowly.
After hearing this, Waller took a deep breath and said in a low voice, "This person is really too confident—so confident that it's terrifying. He should be glad that he met the current me. If he had met me who had just debuted, we would all have died today!"
When the woman heard this, she smiled faintly and did not say anything.
Yerba finally opened her eyes. When she saw that Connor had taken the lead, her expression was one of disbelief. She shouted excitedly at Connor, "We actually won? We actually won? This is unbelievable. How did you do it just now?"
"It's very simple. I just kept driving forward!"
Connor said lightly.
Actually, Connor was also betting on what Waller would choose.
