If Waller hadn't chosen to brake, all of them would have died.
But if Waller chose to brake, then Connor would win.
Of course, if Waller persisted until the end, Connor might also choose to brake. They had only one life, and no matter how bold a person was, they would never choose to play with their own life. Waller had just become famous, and his good days were coming. Therefore, Waller could not gamble with his life at this moment. Moreover, this match was not very important, so Waller did not need to take too much risk.
Obviously, Connor won the bet.
Indeed, Waller did not have the guts to gamble with him.
Although Connor was in the lead now, he did not let down his guard because he did not know what the road conditions were like in front of him. He needed to constantly observe the situation around him to prevent any accidents from happening.
Previously, Connor had been following behind Waller, so he only needed to follow him. However, it was different now. The pressure on Connor did not decrease at all.
When you fall behind, there's only one thought on your mind, and that was to overtake the person in front of you without regard for any obstacles or danger on the road. If the car in front of you could make it, then so could you!
However, it was completely different now; it was pitch-black in front of them. They had no idea what was in front of them, nor did they know if there was any danger ahead. Therefore, they had to be very, very focused.
Even Yerba, who was sitting in the front passenger seat, was nervous for Connor.
What was even more terrifying was that Waller had no intention of giving up; he was following closely behind Connor. Although there was no room for him to overtake Connor, it didn't mean he wouldn't get another opportunity later on.

chapters.title: Chapter 1330: A Loss
chapters.content:
Chapter 1330: A Loss
Connor had to admire Waller very much. After experiencing the situation just now, most people would definitely give up. There was no need to continue driving.
However, Waller had no intention of doing so. He continued to follow closely behind Connor, which he found unbelievable.
At this moment, Connor's hands were tightly holding the steering wheel, and his expression was extremely serious as he stared at the mountain road in front of him.
Yerba subconsciously glanced at Connor with a strange expression on her face. However, she quickly remembered that she had been threatened by Connor just now, so the strange expression in her eyes flashed away and was replaced by anger and hatred.
If Connor hadn't extorted Yerba today, she would have had a good impression of him. However, after that incident, Yerba's hatred towards Connor had increased tenfold.
Waller's luck was not as good as Connor's, however; the last path did not give Waller any chance to overtake at all, and a few seconds later, Connor finally saw the finish line.
Connor took a deep breath and stepped on the accelerator.
The car instantly sped away.
Yerba was once again frightened by the speed of the car. Her face was filled with fear as she shouted, "We've already won, why are you still driving so fast?"
"Creak!"
At this moment, Connor stepped on the brakes.
There were no fancy movements. It was just a very ordinary brake. After skidding for a few meters, the car stopped steadily at the finish line.
A few seconds later, Waller's car caught up.
Although it was only a few seconds, Waller had lost. He had lost completely and wholeheartedly.
After the car stopped, Yerba sat there dumbly without saying a word.
Connor turned to look at Yerba and asked with a puzzled expression, Are you okay?
"I…"
Yerba opened her mouth and was about to say something when she suddenly revealed an uncomfortable expression. She pushed open the car door and started retching.
Connor shook his head helplessly when he saw Yerba's expression. He couldn't help but mutter, "A racer actually has motion sickness?"
Connor was planning to go over and comfort Yerba, but Waller took the initiative to walk over with the woman in his car. He then extended his right hand and said, "You win!"
"You were very skilled!" Connor shook hands with Waller and replied with a smile.
It had to be said that Waller was a very good sport. If it was someone else in the same situation, they would have been so angry that they would have been speechless. They would definitely not take the initiative to talk to Connor.
However, Waller actually took the initiative to congratulate Connor. From this, it could be seen that he was not discouraged by today's events. Instead, it made him realize his own shortcomings.
Under normal circumstances, such opponents were the most terrifying.
"I've participated in many racing competitions, but I've never seen an opponent like you. You're the bravest and craziest racer I've ever seen, and your skills are incredible. There's a lot I can learn from you…" Waller said in a serious tone.
Connor couldn't help but smile when he heard Waller's words. He then said, "You're also very powerful. I think you'll definitely be able reach greater heights in the future!"
"Are you a professional racer?" Waller asked Connor curiously.
"No…"
Connor shook his head.
The woman beside Waller couldn't help but smile when she heard this. She then said, "It seems that the experts are really hidden among the people!"
"I can't be considered an expert!" Connor replied with a smile. Then, he sized up the woman.
Waller was a very humble person, but he was quite a crazy individual. This woman, on the other hand, was gentle and elegant. Their personalities could be said to be like fire and water, but they could complement each other.
When Waller was impulsive, someone could calm him down, so the two of them could be said to be a perfect match.
"No matter what, I lost today, and I lost wholeheartedly. I'll be leaving now!" Waller said.
"Right!" Connor nodded.
Waller left with the woman, while Connor walked to Yerba with a bottle of mineral water. He smiled and said, "Drink some water!"
Yerba turned her head to look at Connor, then reached out to take the water.
Connor knew that Yerba would feel awkward if he stayed there, so he returned to the car and waited.
A few minutes later, Yerba finally returned to the car.
Connor turned his head and looked at Yerba, then said with a smile, "I don't think you're suitable for racing. Who would vomit like this while racing?"
"You!"
When Yerba heard Connor's words, her expression became a little angry. She instinctively wanted to retort, but she did not have the strength to do so, so she could only shout fiercely, "You still have the nerve to talk? Why were you driving so fast just now? Although I like racing, I don't like risking my life. We were sure to win just now. If you couldn't stop the car, both of us would have died, do you understand?"
"Playing with this kind of person means risking your life. If you don't have the courage to risk your life, then don't compete!" Connor said calmly.
Yerba was stunned when she heard Connor's words. She frowned and asked Connor, "Have you really not raced before?"
"No…"
Connor lightly shook his head.
"But I think your driving skills are very skilled. Why don't I take you in as my disciple? I'll teach you how to race…"
Yerba asked Connor with a smile.
"Ma'am, you want to teach me how to race with your skills? I should be the one offering you…" Connor said helplessly.
"That's fine too. Teach me, then!" Yerba said with a smile.
"Haha..." Connor couldn't help but laugh when he heard Yerba's words. He finally understood that Yerba was planning to acknowledge him as her master.
"Do you want me to teach you how to race?" Connor asked.
"That's right. I plan to make myself suffer and let you teach me!" Yerba nodded.
Connor hesitated for a moment before saying, "How about this? You help me settle this matter first. As long as you help me settle this matter, I'll take you in as my disciple!"
"So it's a deal?"
Yerba hurriedly shouted.
"Of course…"
Connor lightly nodded.
Yerba hesitated for a moment before saying, "Then I have another request…"

chapters.title: Chapter 1331: Settling The Matter Via His Daughter
chapters.content:
Chapter 1331: Settling The Matter Via His Daughter
"What request?"
Connor asked.
"You can't tell anyone about me vomiting just now!" Yerba said with a serious expression.
"Haha..."
Connor smiled faintly after hearing this, then nodded and said, "Alright, don't worry. I won't tell anyone!"
"Then that's good!"
Yerba was relieved to see Connor agree. She closed her eyes and rested.
…
About ten minutes later, Connor drove back to the starting point.
Ferb didn't expect to lose, so he left Luna a check before leaving.
Today's incident was a huge blow to Waller, so he naturally left.
However, those rich heirs did not choose to leave. Instead, they stayed where they were and waited for Connor.
After all, Connor had defeated Waller. In addition to Connor's shocking performance just now, he had completely convinced everyone. Now, these people felt that Connor was the new God of Racing, the legend of the racing world.
"The God of Racing is back!"
"God of Racing!"
"God of Racing, you're so handsome!"
When Connor appeared in front of everyone in his sports car, everyone began to shout crazily.
Luna was also in disbelief, as if she had not recovered from the shock just now.
"Enjoy this moment!" Yerba turned to look at Connor and smiled.
After Connor stopped the car, his expression was a little shocked as he said helplessly, "Do these people have to be so crazy?"
"You don't know how much these rich heirs love racing!" Yerba said with a smile.
"God of Racing, you're so handsome. Do you have time tonight?"
At this moment, a beautiful woman dressed in very light clothes walked in front of Connor and shouted at him in a delicate voice.
After hearing the beautiful woman's words, Connor's expression became a little helpless. "I'm sorry, I'm not free tonight!"
"Then can I add you on Facebook? It'll be easier to contact you then…" the beauty said.
"No need. I still have something to do now, so I'll leave first!"
Connor replied hastily, then got off the car and walked down the mountain.
Yerba sat in the car and looked at Connor's back. Her expression was a little playful, but she didn't say anything.
Luna walked to Yerba's side and asked, "Cousin, are you alright?"
"Yeah, I'm peachy!" Yerba shook her head lightly.
"Connor is a lunatic. YWhen I was watching the broadcast just now, I was almost scared to death. It was really too terrifying," Luna said nervously.
"It's because he doesn't care about his life that he won today!" Yerba replied.
..
Meanwhile, Connor hailed a taxi and returned home after he left the mountain.
When he arrived home, it was already past 1 am, and Rachel was still watching TV.
"It's so late, yet you're still watching TV? Don't you have to go to class tomorrow?"
Connor was in a good mood after settling the matter with Blake Layton's. Rachel had been the one to point him to the way to deal with it, so Connor took the initiative to talk to her.
Rachel turned her head to look at Connor and asked, "Have you settled the matter with Luna Maxwell?"
"No." Connor lightly shook his head.
"Why are you so happy that you didn't settle Luna?"
Rachel said with some doubt.
"Although I didn't manage to settle Luna, I managed to settle the matter with Blake Layton's daughter!" Connor gritted his teeth.
"I didn't expect you to be so powerful. I heard that Blake's daughter isn't that easy to deal with…" Rachel said indifferently.
"Others are not easy to deal with, but that doesn't mean that I can't deal with them…"
Connor replied proudly, then turned around and walked into the bedroom.
..
The next day, at eight o'clock in the morning.
After Connor woke up, he washed up briefly and then went to Newtown University to attend classes.
After all, Connor had a lot of things to do recently, so he basically did not go to school. Connor had already settled the matters with Salma Thompson and Blake, so the last one left was Yvette Wendell, who was also the most difficult to settle.
However, it would not be easy to deal with Yvette. Hence, Connor decided to wait a little longer.
After returning to Newtown University, he was naturally questioned about his absence by Justin and the others. Connor casually found an excuse to explain it away.
A day passed quickly.
After school, Connor hailed a taxi to Heavens Club.
Perhaps it was because it was late at night, but there were still many guests in Heavens Club. Therefore, Vanessa Canfield wasn't in the office, but was receiving the guests outside.
Connor saw that Vanessa was busy and chose not to bother her. Instead, he casually found a seat and sat down.
Vanessa was dressed very beautifully today. She was wearing a tight black dress, revealing her fair and sexy collarbone. Her exquisite face had some light makeup on it, and her beautiful eyes were like stars. Her sexy lips were covered with light pink lip gloss, and the skirt outlined the curves of her body. Her slender legs were exposed, and she was wearing a pair of high heels. Her exquisite toes were painted with red nail polish.
Vanessa had always been so seductive. She had a unique mature aura.
Although Connor didn't have any thoughts about Vanessa, due to a man's instinct, he still put his eyes on Vanessa's beautiful legs.
This pair of beautiful legs seemed to have some kind of magic. Just one look at them would make people feel like they could not take their eyes away.
After some time, Vanessa finally noticed Connor.
Vanessa hurriedly walked to Connor's side in her high heels and asked in surprise, "Mr. McDonald, when did you arrive?"
"A few minutes ago!" Connor replied with a smile.
"Then let's go to the office and talk!"
Vanessa said.
"Right!"
Connor nodded lightly and followed Vanessa upstairs.
After going upstairs, Vanessa served Connor a cup of tea and asked, "Mr. McDonald, why do you want to see me?"
Connor took a sip of tea and asked, "Have you sent out the invitations?"
"They've all been sent out, but some people might not come even if they receive an invitation!" Vanessa replied.

chapters.title: Chapter 1332: An Invitation
chapters.content:
Chapter 1332: An Invitation
"I've already settled the business with the Thompson family and Blake Layton!" Connor said slowly.
"What?"
Vanessa was stunned when she heard Connor's words, disbelief on her face.
"Are you surprised?" Connor asked with a smile.
"Just now, Mr. McDonald, did you say you managed to invite Blake Layton over, right?"
Vanessa asked Connor, eyes wide.
"Yeah, I contacted Blake's daughter. There shouldn't be a big problem!" Connor said lightly.
After Vanessa heard Connor's words, she instantly fell into a deep shock.
It would be easier to manage the Thompson family. After all, Vanessa also knew that the relationship between Connor and the Thompson family was not simple, so it was expected for Connor to invite the Thompson family over.
However, Blake Layton was not so easy to deal with. Without mentioning Connor, not even Chelsea Lee might not be able to invite Blake over.
Blake was famous for his honesty in Orilon. He had no stains on his reputation. No one could find any evidence against him. Moreover, his personality was very strange; he never participated in any business activities. It was impossible to hire him.
"It's only been two days, yet you've already taken care of them, Mr. McDonald?" Vanessa asked in shock.
"Yes, both of them should be coming over when the time comes, so there's only Yvette Wendell left. I'm here today to understand the situation with her…" Connor said.
Vanessa couldn't help but be stunned after hearing Connor's words, then she quickly said, "Mr. McDonald, I've also gotten someone to contact Yvette's manager today, but they rejected me. Furthermore, no matter how much I increase the remuneration, they won't agree. I might really have no other choice!"
"Normal methods definitely won't work. I have to think of other methods…" Connor said in a low voice.
"Mr. McDonald, do you have any good ideas?"
"...Do you know where Yvette is now?" Connor asked.
"I'm not too sure about Yvette's schedule, but I know that she should be coming to Newtown City to do a program in three days. I should be able to meet her then…" Vanessa said.
"Alright, I understand. You don't have to worry about the rest. I'll meet Yvette personally in three days!" Connor declared.
"Alright!" Vanessa hurriedly nodded.
"Keep an eye on Yvette. Give me a call when she arrives in Newtown City!"
"No problem, Mr. McDonald!" Vanessa replied.
"Alright, if there's nothing else, I'll leave first."
Connor took the initiative to stand up and walk out of the office.
"Mr. McDonald, a few big clients of our club came today. Do you want to meet them?" Vanessa asked kindly.
"There's no need. With you around, I don't have to show up!"
Connor replied indifferently and then walked out of the office.
Vanessa stood at the same spot and looked at Connor's back with a faint smile, then sighed, "I didn't expect Mr. McDonald to be so powerful. He even managed to settle the matter with Blake Layton in such a short period of time…"
At this time, Vanessa seemed to have changed her impression of Connor. She felt that he might not be as simple as she thought.
A few minutes later, Vanessa took out her phone and dialed Chelsea Lee's number.
…
On the other side.
A black Audi slowly stopped at the entrance of the apartment. The Audi looked very ordinary. Even the license plate was a random number. It didn't give off a special feeling.
However, if anyone saw this car, they would definitely be shocked because this car belonged to Blake Layton from Orilon.
Blake was definitely a very special person in Orilon. He was born into poverty, but he had luck and talent that even officials with rich backgrounds could not have. In less than 20 years, he had managed to reach his current position.
Furthermore, Blake was a person who cherished his reputation very much; he had never done anything out of line. All he did was help his wife set up a company that made cleaning products. The company had all gone through the proper procedures, so Blake did not have any weaknesses that could be used against him at all. In addition, Blake's old leader had amazing power and had always protected him for so many years.
This also led to Blake's position in Orilon...
"Mr. Layton, I received an invitation today. Would you like to take a look?"
The chauffeur asked Blake after parking the car.
"Let me see…" Blake replied indifferently.
The chauffeur hurriedly handed over the invitation.
Blake glanced at it briefly and said with a cold expression, "What kind of place is Heavens Club?"
The famous club in Orilon is said to have changed its boss not long ago, so they plan to invite you to cut the ribbon during the opening ceremony!" the chauffeur hurriedly explained.
"Haha..."
Blake couldn't help but sneer when he heard this. Then, he said indifferently, "Looks like the owner of Heavens Club isn't a local from Orilon. He actually wants to invite me to attend such an event? Think of an excuse to turn them down. Don't send me such an invitation next time…"
"Understood!"
The chauffeur hurriedly nodded.
Blake pushed open the car door and walked into the building.
Blake's home was decorated very sparsely. It was a building that was allocated to him back then. The area was only about 100 square meters, and it had been there for a long time.
Over the years, Blake's wife had earned a lot of money from her company and owned a lot of properties in Newtown City. However, Blake had never moved out and had always lived here. The villa outside was occupied by Yerba alone.
Today, Blake's wife had gone on a business trip, and the nanny had returned to her hometown. Therefore, Blake was prepared to make something for himself. After all, Blake was born into poverty, so he was not picky about food. As long as it could fill his stomach, it would be fine.
However, when Blake returned home, he was instantly stunned; there were several dishes on the dining table. They were probably freshly made, considering how they were still steaming. These dishes were all his favorites, too.

chapters.title: Chapter 1333: Buttering Me Up for No Reason?
chapters.content:
Chapter 1333: Buttering Me Up for No Reason?
"Corrina, didn't you go back to your hometown?" Blake shouted in confusion.
"Oh, Dad, are you back?"
Yerba hurriedly replied when she heard Blake's voice.
After Blake heard Yerba's words, his expression became even more puzzled. He hurriedly walked into the kitchen and found that she was the one who was cooking.
"Dad, hurry up and wash your hands. I'll be done cooking soon..."
Yerba smiled sweetly.
"The sun must be rising from the west today. You actually came here to cook for me?"
Blake said with a smile.
Usually, Yerba wouldn't even stay at home for the sake of going racing at night.
But today, not only did she come back, but she also took the initiative to cook for him. This was obviously not normal.
Of course, Blake knew his daughter's personality, so he advised her, "Yerba, do you have something to ask of me? Do you want money to buy a car again? How many times have I told you that racing is too dangerous? You'd better not touch it…"
"Dad, I already rarely have the chance to come back. Do you have to make me angry?" Yerba frowned.
"Okay, okay. How would I dare to make you angry? I'll go wash my hands!"
Blake smiled helplessly, then turned around and walked into the bathroom.
After Blake left, Yerba's expression changed instantly. She frowned and said irritably, "That damned Connor. I shouldn't have let him race in my place back then. Otherwise, I wouldn't have to do so many things…"
At this moment, Yerba really did not know what to say to Blake. After all, after so many years, she had never begged Blake for anything before. However, she really wanted to learn how to race from Connor. In addition, Yerba had already promised Connor that she would do this, so she could only think of a way to make Blake agree.
However, Yerba knew Blake's character very well; he would never participate in commercial activities. Even if he did, he would only participate in activities that were beneficial to the common people. Connor's opening ceremony was just the opening ceremony of a clubhouse. Clubhouses themselves were not particularly beneficial to the common folk, so Blake would definitely not participate.
Yerba really did not know how to persuade her father.
Therefore, she had specially prepared a table full of dishes, planning to wait until Blake was happy before she talked about this matter.
However, Yerba knew that there was no point in doing so.
"If soft methods do not work, we can only use force…"
Yerba sighed helplessly, then scooped out the last dish and served it to the dining table.
It was a simple meal of four dishes and one soup, all of which were Blake's favorite dishes.
Blake looked at the dishes on the table and could not help but say, "Yerba, the two of us can't eat all these dishes. It's too wasteful of you to do this!"
"What's there to waste? These dishes are all your favorite. I'm in a good mood today, so I made a few extra!"
Yerba said with a smile.
"What made you so happy?" Blake asked with a smile.
"We'll talk about it later. Dad, hurry up and try my cooking," Yerba hurriedly said.
Blake knew that Yerba must have something to ask of him today, but he didn't call her out on it. Instead, he picked up a piece of pork rib with his chopsticks and tasted it.
"Dad, how does it taste?" Yerba asked Blake nervously.
"The taste is not bad, but it's still a little inferior to your mother's cooking. However, I think that in a few years, your cooking skills should be able to surpass your mother's…" Blake replied happily.
Although Blake had always been a dignified person outside, when he returned home, he relieved the burden on his body and became an ordinary father.
Blake doted on his daughter very much. He had held her in his hands since she was young.
Even though Blake knew that Yerba had been racing, he didn't stop her. He would occasionally advise her to keep herself safe, but he never outright stopped her.
"Really?" Yerba shouted excitedly after hearing Blake's words.
"Of course it's true. Why would I lie to you about such a small matter?"
Blake said with a smile.
"Dad, as long as you like it…"
Yerba shouted happily and continued, "Ah, I forgot about the wine. Wait for me!"
After saying these words, Yerba directly ran to the kitchen and took out a bottle of wine that Blake usually liked to drink. She smiled and said, "Dad, have another glass of wine…"
"Yerba, you know your mother doesn't let me drink…"
Blake's heart was naturally moved when she saw the wine, but she still refused after hesitating for a moment.
"Oh Dad, what are you afraid of? Besides, Mom isn't at home today. It's okay for you to drink less…" Yerba poured a glass of wine for Blake as she spoke.
Blake looked at the wine glass in front of him and couldn't help but hesitate for a moment. Then, he asked with a puzzled expression, "Yerba, what are you trying to do?"
"Nothing in particular," Yerba said.
"You cooked for me today and let me drink wine. This really doesn't suit your personality. What's wrong with you?" Blake asked in a puzzled tone.
"Dad, what do you mean by that? Can't I, as a daughter, cook for my father?" Yerba pouted.
Blake smiled helplessly. "Alright, stop pretending with me. If there's anything, hurry up and say it!"
"Dad, if you say that, then I'll be too sad. I just wanted to cook for you. Why do you think I have an ulterior motive?"
Yerba pretended to be angry.
"If you don't explain it to me today, I won't be able to eat this meal either. What if you cling to me after eating?"
Blake said with a smile.
"..."
Yerba's eyes flashed with a trace of helplessness, and then she said, "Dad, I actually have a small matter that I need your help with…"
"If it was just a small matter, you would not have prepared so many dishes. Quickly tell me what it is…"
Blake said helplessly.
"Have you received an invitation to the opening ceremony of the Heavens Club recently?" Yerba asked carefully.

chapters.title: Chapter 1334: Carrot And Stick Approach
chapters.content:
Chapter 1334: Carrot And Stick Approach
"The Heavens Club?"
When Blake heard this name, he immediately frowned and said, "My driver did show me an invitation today that was from the Heavens Club…"
"That's right!"
Yerba shouted excitedly.
When Blake saw how excited Yerba was, he knew that the matter that Yerba wanted him to do today was probably related to the Heavens Club. Therefore, he took the initiative to ask, "Yerba, what is it?"
Yerba took a deep breath and continued, "Dad, actually, the boss of the Heavens Club is my friend. He has a good relationship with me…"
Yerba didn't say it outright, but she said it very tactfully. However, the meaning behind Yerba's words couldn't be any more obvious: she was telling Blake that the owner of this club was a friend of hers, and she was asking him to go and attend the opening ceremony.
Blake was very smart. He immediately understood what Yerba meant and said with a smile, "I understand what is going on…"
"Dad, do you understand now?"
Yerba asked with a smile.
"You cooked so many dishes for me today and even tried to please me so much. You want me to agree to attend the opening ceremony of Heavens Club, right? There shouldn't be any problem with what I said, right?"
Blake said lightly.
"Dad, if you understand it this way, there's actually no problem…" Yerba smiled awkwardly and said, "Dad, my relationship with this person is actually quite good. If you have time, can you come over for a while? After all, I've already agreed. If you don't go, it'll be a little too embarrassing for me…"
"I haven't had a say in this, yet you've already agreed to it on my behalf? What if I don't want to go?" Blake asked Yerba.
"Dad, you're so good to me. Are you going to reject my small request? It's been so many years, but I don't think I've ever asked you for anything, right?" Yerba said pitifully.
Blake sized Yerba up and said, "Yerba, let's not talk about attending the opening ceremony first. I'm quite curious about something…"
"What is it?"
Yerba asked in confusion.
"You told me just now that you've never begged me for so many years. Moreover, you know my personality very well: as long as it's such a business event, I won't participate in any of it. So why did you agree to your friend's request this time? You should know better than me how I will handle this matter, right?" Blake asked Yerba calmly.
Yerba took a deep breath after hearing Blake's words. Then, she said in a low voice, "Dad, of course I know. Under normal circumstances, you definitely wouldn't agree, but this time it's really different…"
"How is it different? Tell me," Blake asked.
"Because I owe him a favor. I don't know how to help him. He was the one who took the initiative to look out for me this time, so I want to take this opportunity to return this favor…" Yerba said helplessly.
Blake could feel that something was not quite right with Yerba today, so he frowned and asked, "Who is this friend of yours? Are they not a woman?"
"No, they're not a woman. They're a man…"
Yerba said helplessly.
"A man?"
Blake's expression seemed to be even more shocked because he knew Yerba's personality very well. For so many years, she was very obedient in other aspects except for her love of racing. She had never had a boyfriend, but this time, she was actually begging him for a member of the opposite sex. This meant that this matter was definitely not simple!
Blake frowned. "Yerba, tell me, what is your relationship with this person?"
"We're just friends!"
Yerba hurriedly said.
"Impossible…"
Blake shook his head.
"Why?"
Yerba shouted, then continued, "We're really just ordinary friends. I can swear..."
"It's useless even if you swear. I know very well how attractive you are. All these years, other than asking me for help with buying a car, you've never asked me for help with anything else. Now, you're actually asking me for help because of an ordinary friend. Do you think I'll believe you?" Blake said directly.
Yerba's eyes flashed with a trace of helplessness. She then said, "Dad, I've already told you that I owe this person a favor. You have to go!"
"You can return the favor yourself. I won't go. Don't persuade me!" Blake refused.
"Dad, this is the only thing I've asked for your help with since I was born. Is that not enough?"
Yerba shouted angrily.
"No…"
Blake shook his head again.
"Alright, if you don't help me, then I'll go alone. When the time comes, I'll attend as your daughter. Besides, the effect is about the same…"
Yerba could only resort to force.
"Yerba, who is this friend of yours? Did someone get hold of something on you that caused you to be like this?"
Blake could clearly feel that something was wrong with his daughter, so he was very worried that Yerba was being threatened.
After all, Blake had reached his current position. He would definitely be surrounded by all kinds of threats, so he was already used to these methods. In addition, he was very honest and would not let anyone catch him.
However, his daughter was different. In addition, most of the people in the meeting were from the underworld. Even if they did some despicable things, it was very normal for them.
"Why would someone else have dirt on me?" Yerba replied helplessly, then continued, "Very few people know that I'm your daughter now. No one will threaten me at all!"
Blake had always asked Yerba to hide her identity because he was worried that she would be threatened and used by others. Therefore, other than her relatives, not even Yerba's best friends knew her identity.
"Then what's going on?" Blake frowned and asked in confusion.
"Dad, this friend of mine is called Connor McDonald…" Yerba tried to explain.

chapters.title: Chapter 1335: Vanessa's Phone Call
chapters.content:
Chapter 1335: Vanessa's Phone Call
"What did you say? What's your friend's name?"
When Blake heard Yerba's words, his expression instantly changed. He stared at Yerba and shouted excitedly.
Yerba was stunned for a moment and asked in a puzzled tone, "My friend is called Connor McDonald. Dad, do you know this person?"
"I don't really know him, but I've heard of this Connor McDonald. He's from Porthampton, right?" Blake replied expressionlessly.
After all, Connor had done too many earth-shattering things recently. Blake was very well-informed, so he had heard a lot of news about Connor. This was also the reason why he was so excited.
"Yeah, he's from Porthampton!" Yerba hurriedly nodded.
After Connor left yesterday, Yerba asked Luna about Connor's identity. However, Luna also didn't know much about him and only knew that he was from Porthampton. Other than that, Yerba didn't know much else.
"How did you get to know this Connor?" Blake asked Yerba expressionlessly.
"Dad, you know him?"
"Not personally, but I've heard that he is very dangerous!"
When Blake said this, his face was very solemn because he was worried that something had happened between Yerba and Connor. If that was really the case, then things would be troublesome.
"So that's how it is!"
Yerba nodded her head lightly, then said with a guilty conscience, "Actually, I'm not very familiar with Connor. Back then, Connor helped me once. If it wasn't for him, I might be in danger now. Therefore, I owe him a favor and plan to use this opportunity to return the favor…"
"What danger?"
Blake asked.
"I was just harassed by some hooligans. It's fine now…" Yerba said guiltily.
"Then why didn't you tell me about this?"
Blake asked in a low voice.
"I called you back then, but you didn't pick up. Later on, Connor saved me. I was fine. If I told you, it would only make you and Mom worry about me, so I didn't say anything…"
Yerba explained helplessly.
Blake was usually very busy with work, so it was very normal for him to not receive Yerba's call.
"Yerba, is what you said true?" Blake asked.
"…Of course it's true…"
Yerba said nervously.
"Then do you have any other feelings for this Connor?" Blake asked again.
After Yerba heard Blake's words, her expression was a little helpless. Then, she said, "Dad, are you kidding me? I haven't known Connor for a long time. I'm just trying to return a favor. It's not as complicated as you think…"
"..."
Blake sized Yerba up and took a deep breath. He felt that there was nothing wrong with what Yerba said. It was reasonable, if barely.
"Dad, don't think too much about it. I'm really just returning the favor. If you don't want to participate, then forget it. I'll go myself!" Yerba said to Blake.
"Since he saved you, this favor should indeed be returned. When the time comes, I will attend the opening ceremony…" Blake finally said.
"Really?"
Yerba didn't expect Blake to really agree.
"Of course it's true, but I hope what you told me is also true!" Blake replied indifferently, then lowered his head and took a sip of wine.
Yerba could feel that Blake wasn't too happy, but no matter what, it was already good enough that he'd agreed.
…
Three days later.
Since it was the weekend, Rachel didn't have to go to class. Connor was also preparing to go back to Porthampton to meet up with Freya; after all, he hadn't seen her since they parted ways last time.
But before Connor could leave the house, he received a call from Vanessa.
"Vanessa, did you need anything?"
Connor asked after picking up the phone.
"Mr. McDonald, I've just received news that Yvette Wendell will be arriving at Newtown at 2 p.m. today. She's going to record a program for tomorrow…" Vanessa said slowly.
"Is she arriving by plane or train?"
Connor hurriedly asked.
"By plane. The plane arrives at two o'clock in the afternoon!" Vanessa replied.
"Alright, I got it!"
Connor replied simply and then hung up the phone.
After hanging up, Connor hesitated for two seconds. He felt that it was more important to look for Yvette now; after all, the opening ceremony was about to begin. He could wait a little longer to visit Freya.
Therefore, Connor took out his phone to check the flight information. After he was told that Yvette would arrive at 2 pm, he walked over to the sofa and started watching TV with Rachel.
Rachel turned her head to look at Connor and asked, "Aren't you going to Porthampton today? Why aren't you leaving? Did you have a fight with your girlfriend?"
"No? Can't you trust that it's not such a negative thing?" A trace of helplessness flashed across Connor's eyes, and then he continued, "Anyway, I'm not going to Porthampton today. I have something else to do…"
"Then why aren't you leaving?"
Rachel continued to ask.
"Big sister, this is my home. What does it have to do with you whether I leave or not?" Connor asked, exasperated.
Rachel looked at Connor indifferently without saying anything.
Connor and Rachel watched soap operas at home for the whole morning. At around 1 pm, Connor drove to Porthampton Airport and waited quietly in the car.
He ended up waiting for almost half an hour before he finally saw a large group of people walking out of the airport. Connor knew that these people were probably passengers on the same flight as Yvette, so she was probably coming out soon.
Not long after, as expected, Connor saw Yvette walking out with sunglasses and a hat on. Although Yvette had concealed herself very well, Connor had been observing the situation over there all along, so he could still recognize that this woman was the female celebrity who had asked him to help her with the recording of the show at the night market.
Beside Yvette was a middle-aged woman. This middle-aged woman was probably Yvette's manager. Behind the two of them was their assistant, who was carrying a lot of things.
Connor knew very well that if he were to rush up and talk to Yvette now, it would definitely make people think that he was a fan.
Furthermore, as a popular celebrity, Yvette had a lot of fans.
Once her identity was exposed, she would definitely attract the attention of these fans. By then, Connor would no longer be able to talk to Yvette.

chapters.title: Chapter 1336: Failed Plan
chapters.content:
Chapter 1336: Failed Plan
Hence, Connor planned to follow Yvette to her hotel first, then find an opportunity to speak to her alone.
After all, Connor and Yvette had some conflicts as well. He had to resolve these conflicts with her first.
Just as Connor had expected, Yvette took a car to the entrance of a five-star hotel after leaving the airport.
Connor parked the car at the entrance of the hotel and waited quietly. About half an hour later, he felt that it was about time for him to go, so he walked into the hotel.
After entering the hotel, Connor took the initiative to chat with the front desk, preparing to ask for Yvette's room number. However, since this hotel was a five-star hotel, he definitely couldn't get any information from the desk in this way. In the end, Connor could only give Vanessa a call.
As the owner of this hotel was a member of the Heavens Club and was a very good friend of Vanessa, she was able to easily help Connor find out Yvette's room number. Furthermore, the staff even took the initiative to give Connor a room card.
Of course, if he could enter through normal means, Connor would not use this room card.
Connor quickly found Yvette's room and took a deep breath before gently knocking on the door.
At that moment, Yvette had just changed her clothes and was about to take a shower before resting. After all, she had been on a plane for a whole day and was already tired.
However, when she heard the knock on the door, Yvette instinctively thought that it might be her assistant. After all, other than her assistant and manager, no one else knew that she was staying in this room.
Hence, Yvette did not think too much about it. She picked up the towel and draped it over her body before walking to the door and opening it.
However, she had never expected that the person standing outside the door would actually be a man, and a familiar-looking man at that.
"Hello, Miss Wendell!"
Connor said with a smile.
Yvette could not help but be stunned when she heard Connor's words. She then said with a surprised expression, "Why are you here?"
Due to the previous incident, Yvette had a very deep impression of Connor. After that, Yvette even specially got someone to investigate Connor's identity, but could not find anything.
At this moment, Yvette was only wearing a white bath towel. Hence, a large area of her ample bosom was exposed, giving off an abnormally alluring feeling.
Connor couldn't help but lower his head to take a look. Then, he chuckled, "Miss Wendell, are you preparing to take a shower?"
Upon hearing Connor's words, Yvette realized that her clothes were a little too light. Hence, she hurriedly pulled them up and asked Connor coldly, "What are you doing here?"
However, Yvette did not realize that when she pulled the towel up, her beautiful legs were almost completely exposed.
Out of instinct, Connor could not help but lower his head to take a look.
When Yvette noticed that something was amiss with Connor's gaze, her pretty face instantly turned red and she shouted coldly, "Didn't you hear me talking to you? I'm asking you why you're here."
At this moment, Yvette was already a little angry because she could not understand why Connor would suddenly appear in front of her room.
Upon hearing Yvette's words, Connor realized that his actions were a little inappropriate. He was here to seek Yvette's help; if he offended her again, his plan to invite Yvette to be the guest of honor for the ribbon-cutting ceremony would definitely fall through. Hence, Connor chuckled. "Erm, Miss Wendell, I have something to tell you. It's not convenient to talk here, so do you mind if I step in?!"
"I'm sorry, it's not convenient for me now. You can go back!" Yvette said coldly.
"It's not that, Miss Wendell. I know that there's no conflict between the two of us. I'm here today to explain these things..." Connor said.
"I don't want to hear your explanation, nor do I need one."
Yvette rejected him once again.
Meanwhile, Connor looked at Yvette with a helpless expression. He did not care whether Yvette agreed or not as he walked straight into the room.
"Hello? Didn't you hear me talking to you just now? I don't welcome you here. Please leave!" Yvette shouted at Connor anxiously.
Upon hearing Yvette's words, a hint of helplessness flashed across Connor's eyes. He said, "Miss Wendell, I'm here today to talk to you about something serious!"
"I have nothing to say to you. Get out quickly!" Yvette shouted.
If this was before, Connor would definitely turn around and leave without hesitation. However, Connor had a favor to ask of someone, so he did not choose to leave. Instead, he sat down on the sofa.
"Are you going or not?"
Yvette shouted.
"I'm not leaving. Not until you hear me out…"
Connor shook his head.
Yvette did not know why Connor had come over today, so she was very nervous.
"If you don't leave now, I'll call the police..."
"Miss Wendell, can you let me finish first?"
Connor frowned helplessly.
"Alright, since you refuse to leave, don't blame me for being impolite…"
Yvette took a deep breath and picked up her phone on the table, preparing to call the police.
When Connor saw that Yvette was really going to call the police, he looked a little exasperated and shouted, "Miss Wendell, are you really going to call the police? You must be joking with me, right?"
Yvette was not in the mood to respond to Connor at all. Instead, she said with a cold expression, "Hello, a stranger has broken into my room. I'm worried that this person is up to no good. Can you send someone over to take him away?"
After saying this, Yvette told the other party her location.
"Miss Wendell, have you really called the police?"
Connor sat on the spot and asked Yvette helplessly.
"Continue waiting!"
Yvette replied coldly before striding into the bedroom.
Yvette was staying in the presidential suite, which had a bedroom and a living room.
A few minutes later, Yvette changed her clothes and stood at the door of the bedroom, looking at Connor.
"Miss Wendell, I admit that there was a misunderstanding between the two of us previously. What I did back then was indeed a little inappropriate. I…" Connor prepared to explain.
However, at this moment, there was a series of hurried knocks on the door.
"If you have any questions, you should explain them to them!" Yvette immediately interrupted Connor. She then put on her sunglasses and hat and walked to the door to open it.

chapters.title: Chapter 1337: Are You Still Going to Refuse?
chapters.content:
Chapter 1337: Are You Still Going to Refuse?
When the door opened, Connor was instantly dumbfounded.
Two police officers were walking over.
Connor had never expected Yvette to be so heartless as to call the police.
Previously, Connor felt that although there was a small conflict between him and Yvette, it should not be considered a major conflict, right?
But who would have thought that Yvette would be so heartless?
As Yvette was wearing a hat and sunglasses, the police officer did not recognize her. Yvette simply explained the situation. After listening to her story, the two police officers walked up to Connor and said in a serious tone, "Young man, you're trespassing. Come with us!"
"I'm in a hotel, and I didn't do anything!"
Connor explained helplessly to the police. "If you had done anything, you would have been handcuffed by now. Alright, come quietly. I'm not in the mood to talk nonsense with you," Another policeman said in a serious tone.
Connor looked at the two policemen in front of him. He knew that if he continued to make a scene, it would not do him any good, so Connor took the initiative to stand up and leave the room with the police.
Yvette, on the other hand, was looking at Connor with a smug expression. She had no intention of helping Connor explain himself at all.
A few seconds later, Connor left the room.
Meanwhile, Yvette picked up her cell phone and called her assistant, preparing to move to another room.
On the other side, Connor got into the police car after leaving the hotel with the police. He hesitated for a moment and asked the police officer, "Can I make a call now?"
The policeman turned his head to look at Connor with a cold expression, "Alright, if you want to make a call, then make it!"
Connor then took out his phone and called Reena Satchwell.
"Hello, Mr. McDonald. What's wrong?" Reena asked.
"I'm being taken away by two police officers now. Help me find some connections and get them to let me go!" Connor said awkwardly.
"...Okay, Mr. McDonald. Where were you taken to?" Reena hurriedly asked.
Connor simply asked the two police officers where they were from and told Reena the location.
Half an hour later, with an apology from the police station director, Connor directly left the police station.
At this moment, Connor finally understood the benefits of having money and power. If it was the previous, powerless Connor, he would probably have to stay there for two to three days before he could come out. However, now, Connor only needed to make a phone call, and he was even able to leave after the police station chief apologized.
After leaving the police station, Connor returned to the hotel and asked the receptionist about Yvette's new room.
After finding Yvette's room, Connor did not waste any time and immediately took out his room card to open the door.
At this moment, Yvette had already finished showering and was sitting on the sofa watching television.
When she saw Connor come in, her expression was extremely shocked. She could not help but shout, "Connor, how did you get in?"
"How I came in is none of your business!" Connor replied indifferently.
"That's not right. I clearly changed rooms. How did you find me? What do you want?"
Yvette's large, watery eyes widened as she shouted nervously.
She had already changed rooms and she had even checked the lock of the door. But not only did Connor manage to find her room, he even managed to enter it with ease. Yvette found it unbelievable.
"Miss Wendell, don't worry. I'm a human, not a ghost. No matter where you go in Newtown, I have a way to find you. So don't hide from me. Let me finish…" Connor said with a smile.
"Why are you pestering me?"
Yvette shouted at Connor in confusion.
"Miss Wendell, I'm here to ask you for a favor…"
Connor said directly.
"A favor?" Upon hearing Connor's words, Yvette could not help but laugh coldly. She then said indifferently, "You really have the nerve to say that. You didn't help me when I asked you to help me back then. Why should I help you now?"
"Miss Wendell, what happened that day was indeed a misunderstanding…"
Connor said helplessly.
"I don't care if it's a misunderstanding or not. You didn't help me back then, so I definitely won't help you now. Moreover, since you're so powerful, why do you still want my help?"
Yvette's expression relaxed significantly when she saw that Connor did not seem to have any intention of doing anything to her. She replied to Connor with disdain.
"Miss Wendell, I'm the boss of the Heavens Club. My club is going to hold an opening ceremony in two days, so I hope you can attend the ceremony and be the ribbon-cutting guest!" Connor in a very serious tone.
Yvette, on the other hand, was a little speechless. She snorted, "Are you kidding me? I've said it before, I won't help you no matter what…"
"If you help me this time, then the two of us will be friends in the future!" Connor in a very serious tone.
Upon hearing Connor's words, Yvette could not help but smile faintly. She then pursed her lips, "Who do you think you are? Why should I be friends with you? Is there any benefit for me to be friends with you?"
"Of course there are benefits!"
Connor nodded his head and continued, "Miss Wendell, you probably don't know my identity yet, right?"
"Your identity?"
Yvette looked at Connor with a hint of confusion in her eyes. She then said calmly, "I'm indeed a little curious. Who are you? Why is the Yearwood family so afraid of you?"
"My name is Connor McDonald, from Porthampton. People who know me like to call me Mr. McDonald!"
Connor sat on the sofa calmly.
"..."
Yvette was stunned when she heard Connor's words. Her face was filled with shock as she stammered, "You... Are you Mr. McDonald of Porthampton?"
"That's right, I'm Mr. McDonald Porthampton. So you should know what benefits there are to be friends with me now, right?"
Connor took a sip of water calmly.
"Isn't Tiffany Zamora your lover? I heard that you have a good relationship with her, so why didn't you ask her for help?" Yvette asked Connor in confusion.
"Tiffany Zamora's appearance won't be as effective as yours. I think you're the most suitable!" Connor said.
Upon hearing Connor's words, Yvette smiled faintly and said, "I understand!"
"So, are you still going to refuse?"
Connor asked.
"That's right, I still don't want to help you attend the ribbon-cutting ceremony!"
Yvette said bluntly.
Connor was stunned as he stared at Yvette, puzzled.

chapters.title: Chapter 1338: Beat This Guy Up For Me!
chapters.content:
Chapter 1338: Beat This Guy Up For Me!
"I'm not familiar with you, so even if you're Mr. McDonald, it has nothing to do with me. Also, I've never attended such events before," Yvette said to Connor seriously.
"..."
Connor looked at Yvette's expression helplessly. He'd initially thought that as long as he revealed his identity, Yvette would definitely not be able to reject him.
However, Connor had underestimated Yvette.
Her attitude was very firm.
"Then let me put it another way. If you have any conditions, you can just say it. As long as it's not too excessive, I'll try to satisfy you!" Connor said.
Yvette was very disdainful when she heard this. She said indifferently, "I know that you're Mr. McDonald of Porthampton, but I really don't know what I can get from you. Let's say you give me money. I'm earning a lot of money now—more than enough for me to spend—so I'm not interested in your money. I don't seem to lack fame, either, and I don't think I'm qualified to marry you. So no matter what, I won't attend your opening ceremony. Do you understand what I mean?"
Connor looked at the helpless expression on Yvette's face and said indifferently, "Miss Wendell, are you so confident that I can't help you?"
"That's right, I'm that confident!"
Yvette nodded.
"I know you don't lack money now, let alone fame. After all, you're the most popular female celebrity now. As for men, I definitely won't stand a chance. What you said makes sense…"
Connor paused for a moment and then continued, "But Miss Wendell, most of the people in this world are just mortals, and mortals can't avoid all kinds of problems. To put it simply, I don't believe that you don't have any troubles. I also don't believe that there's nothing you want to do now that you can't do it yourself…"
"Can you do what I can't?" Yvette asked.
"That's right. As long as you agree to attend the opening ceremony, I will try my best to fulfill your conditions, no matter what it is!"
Connor said with a serious expression.
Upon hearing this, Yvette could not help but purse her lips, "Do you think you're a god? Do you think you can do anything?"
"You can tell me what to do!"
Connor said with a smile.
"Alright, then I want a star now. Can you pluck one out of the sky for me?"
Connor looked at Yvette, who was standing in front of him. He was speechless and did not know what to do.
"If you can't do that, then try to resurrect my grandfather. You can choose between these two things!" Yvette said disdainfully.
"Miss Wendell, I don't think you're serious about talking to me about these things. I came over to talk to you sincerely, but you're not taking it seriously. How about this? My opening ceremony is still a few days away. You can consider it carefully. If you change your mind, you can contact me at any time!"
Connor slowly stood up and walked towards Yvette. He said, "I don't believe that you really don't have any worries. You can't lie to me…"
Yvette took a deep breath. The words she had said to Connor earlier were indeed out of spite because she had always been brooding over Connor's rejection of her.
However, did Yvette really not have any worries?
The answer was no!
Yvette's family background was very good. Even if Yvette did not become a celebrity, the money in her family was enough for her to live comfortably for the rest of her life.
Moreover, she was very rich and famous now, so she did not lack material things.
However, she also had her own worries.
"Wait a moment!"
Just as Connor was about to leave the room, Yvette suddenly called out.
Connor slowly stopped in his tracks and turned around. He smiled at Yvette and asked, "Miss Wendell, have you changed your mind?"
"Just now, you said that you could help me do anything, right?"
Yvette asked.
"As long as it's not picking stars, reviving your grandfather, or something illegal, I'll do my best to help you with the rest!" Connor said firmly.
"..."
Yvette sized up Connor from head to toe. She seemed to be hesitant because she did not know if she should reveal her troubles.
After all, if Yvette were to reveal her true identity, she would be in trouble if Connor told the reporters. However, Yvette also felt that since Connor was the young master of Porthampton, he would not do such a shameless thing.
"Miss Wendell, you don't have to worry about anything. I just want you to attend my opening ceremony. I don't have any other thoughts…"
Connor seemed to have noticed Yvette's hesitation, so he took the initiative to speak.
"I'm worried that you won't be able to do what I ask you to do!"
Yvette said to Connor.
"You can tell me what it is first…"
Connor said helplessly.
Actually, Connor's thoughts were very simple at this moment. He did not know what Yvette wanted him to do. However, Connor had already thought it through.
Anyway, he would get her to attend his opening ceremony first. After he found out what her request was, he would try his best to do it. However, if he really could not do it, Connor could only think of other ways to fulfill her.
In any case, the most important thing for Connor now was to get her to attend the opening ceremony.
"I do have something troubling me now. If you can help me solve it, I'll agree to attend the opening ceremony. If you can't solve it, then forget it…" Yvette said to Connor.
Connor looked at Yvette with a hint of helplessness in his eyes. He had not expected Yvette to actually ask him to handle this matter first. However, since he had already said so much, Connor could only brace himself and ask, "Alright, then, what do you want me to do?"
"I want you to beat someone up!"
Yvette said to Connor with a serious expression.
"Beat someone up?"
Connor was stunned when he heard this. A trace of confusion flashed across his eyes.
He had initially thought that Yvette must have something very troublesome for him to do. However, he never expected that Yvette's request would be so simple. She only wanted him to beat someone up.
One had to know that beating someone up was simply a piece of cake for Connor.

chapters.title: Chapter 1339: Yvette's Condition
chapters.content:
Chapter 1339: Yvette's Condition
Connor hesitated for a moment and asked in a puzzled tone, "Alright. Miss Wendell, who do you want me to beat up for you?"
"Do you know a person named Jace Sackmann?"
Yvette asked.
Jace Sackmann?
When Connor heard the name, a trace of hesitation flashed across his eyes. Then, he gently shook his head and said in a low voice, "I don't know this person…"
Yvette did not expect Connor not to know who Jace Sackmann was. "You can look him up on your phone…" she said helplessly.
Connor took out his mobile phone and searched for the name. He found that Jace Sackmann was also a celebrity, but he wasn't very popular because his acting skills were very bad. Basically, any movies or TV dramas he showed up in would be bad. However, this person's background was very terrifying—All the roles he'd gotten were male leads, and the female stars he worked with were all popular female stars.
Connor hesitated for a moment before asking Yvette, "Is this the person you want me to beat up?"
"That's right, it's this person!"
He hesitated for two seconds before saying, "Well, Miss Wendell, although I did promise to help you just now, I still have to ask. What's the conflict between you and Jace? Why do you want me to help you beat him up?"
"..."
Yvette sized up Connor from head to toe, then rolled her eyes, "Why do you have so many questions? I told you to hit him, so just hit him…"
"Then you have to give me a reason to beat him up, right? I can't just go and do that on a whim, right?" Connor said helplessly to Yvette.
"..."
Yvette could not help but be stunned when she heard Connor's words. She then said, "If I tell you the reason, you must keep it a secret…"
"Don't worry. I have a favor to ask of you, so I will not offend you no matter what…"
Connor nodded seriously.
Yvette felt that Connor did not seem to care much about these things in the entertainment industry. Connor did not even know who Jace was, so it did not matter if she told him about these things.
"The thing is, I came to Newtown not only to record a program, but also to attend a classmate's birthday party. I graduated from a film school, so most of my classmates are in the entertainment industry as actors, singers, and directors. At that time, many people in the entertainment industry will attend this birthday party, and Jace will also be there..."
Yvette said slowly.
"And then?"
"When Jace was in university, he kept trying to pursue me and often harassed me. Once, he even molested me when he was drunk..." Yvette said.
"Molested you?"
When Connor heard this, a trace of shock flashed across his eyes. Then, he hurriedly asked, "How did that happen?"
"He just hugged me after drinking too much and wanted to kiss me forcefully, but he was pulled away…" Yvette said helplessly.
"So that's how it is!"
Connor lightly nodded.
"So, I'm worried that he'll do something bad to me again at this birthday party. I'm going to bring you there. If he dares to touch me again, help me beat him up until he doesn't dare come near me again…" Yvette said excitedly to Connor.
Connor sized Yvette up and said indifferently, "Miss Wendell, according to my understanding, your family should have some background, so it shouldn't be difficult for you to deal with this person, right?"
"If Jace was really so easy to deal with, I wouldn't need to ask you for this favor. Jace's father has a good relationship with my father, and his father helped our family in the past. In addition, Jace's family has some powerful background, so ordinary people don't dare to provoke him," Yvette explained.
Connor hesitated for two seconds before asking, "Miss Wendell, who exactly is this Jace?"
"His father is the head of a certain department. His mother and grandfather are also higher-ups, but I'm not too sure what they do exactly…" Yvette replied.
"Uh..."
Upon hearing Yvette's words, Connor could not help but take a deep breath. His expression was somewhat exasperated.
Although Connor was not afraid of these people from the Sackmann family, he did not want to offend these people for no reason. After all, he had already offended enough people. It was not a good thing for him to have too many enemies.
Yvette saw that Connor was stunned and did not say anything. She looked at him with disdain, "What? Cat got your tongue after finding out Jace's identity? Weren't you very arrogant just now? Didn't you say that you could do anything? What I said shouldn't be too difficult for you, right?"
After hearing Yvette's words, Connor's expression turned somewhat helpless as he asked, "Then what do you plan to do?"
Although Connor knew that he would definitely get into trouble if he beat up Jace, he could only choose to take the risk in order to get Yvette to attend his opening ceremony.
"It's actually very simple. The birthday party will be held tomorrow night. At that time, you will come with me. Then, you will find an opportunity to anger Jace, or help me teach him a lesson as soon as he does something to me..." Yvette said fiercely to Connor.
After hearing Yvette's words, Connor could not help but hesitate for a moment before saying, "Miss Wendell, you should know that Jace is not an ordinary person. If I hit Jace, he will definitely not let it go in the future…"
"I can't care about that. Anyway, you said just now that you can help me settle anything. As long as you can help me settle this matter, I will attend the opening ceremony. You can think about whether this deal is suitable or not. If you don't think it's suitable, then forget it…"
"..."
Connor took a deep breath and asked Yvette, "Then how do you want me to attend the birthday party with you?"
"You can pose as my bodyguard, of course. That way, you have a reason to attack Jace…" Yvette said without thinking.
"..."
Connor shook his head gently. Then, he said in a low voice, "Miss Wendell, I think it might not be appropriate for me to be a bodyguard…"

chapters.title: Chapter 1340: Pretending to Be a Boyfriend
chapters.content:
Chapter 1340: Pretending to Be a Boyfriend
"It might not be a good idea to be a bodyguard?"
Yvette was stunned for a moment before she asked with a puzzled expression, "Why?"
"Ms. Wendell, think about it: if I really attack Jace Sackmann under the excuse of being your bodyguard, it won't solve your problem completely. When I'm not by your side in the future, Jace will definitely pester you again…"
Connor said to Yvette in a very serious tone.
Yvette could not help but be stunned when she heard Connor's words. She then nodded gently and said, "I think what you said makes sense. If you really hit him as my bodyguard, it won't solve the root of the problem. Do you have a better suggestion now?"
"How about this? I've always pretended to be someone else's boyfriend to help shield them from other people. I'll pretend to be your boyfriend this time too…" Connor said.
It was not the first time Connor had pretended to be someone else's boyfriend, so Connor was quite familiar with this kind of thing. He'd also been forced to pretend to be her boyfriend before, but this time, he was actually offering to do it again.
The reason was very simple. Connor wanted to deal with Yvette's request as soon as possible. Only after he had settled the matter would she attend Connor's opening ceremony.
Yvette was stunned when she heard Connor's words. "Are you really going to pretend to be my boyfriend?"
"Yes, I often pretend to be someone else's boyfriend. I'm very professional when it comes to this kind of thing!" Connor said to Yvette with a smile.
"No, I can't let you pretend to be my boyfriend…"
Yvette hesitated for two seconds before shaking her head and rejecting him.
"Why?"
Connor asked Yvette in confusion.
"Because the people who come to the party are all from the entertainment industry. If you act as my boyfriend, then they will all know that I have one."
Yvette said in a serious tone.
Connor smiled helplessly and continued, "First of all, if I hit Jace as your boyfriend, Jace will know that he has no hope and will definitely not pester you in the future. Also, other people in the entertainment industry who like you will not dare to pester you. I think this is the best way to solve your problems for the time being; after all, even if I help you deal with Jace now, it doesn't mean that it's a safeguard against other people in the future, right?"
After hearing Connor's words, Yvette could not help but slowly raise her head to look at him. She felt that Connor's words made sense.
"Ms. Wendell, you don't have to worry too much. I already have a girlfriend, so I won't pester you or do anything out of line. My goal is to help you solve your problem, and then you'll help me solve my problem!"
Connor said to Yvette with a smile.
A hint of helplessness flashed across Yvette's eyes. At this moment, she seemed to agree with Connor's suggestion. Although letting Connor pretend to be her boyfriend might let the artistes in the entertainment industry think that she had a boyfriend, there was a tacit understanding between artistes. They would not spread such a thing because once someone spread such secret news, they would be exposed.
Therefore, Yvette was not worried about the impact this incident would have on her acting career. Furthermore, it could solve many problems in the future.
"Are you sure you can help me solve these problems?"
Yvette asked in a serious tone.
"Don't worry, Ms. Wendell. I'll definitely help you solve this problem!"
Connor hurriedly nodded.
"Alright, come pick me up at the hotel tomorrow night!"
"Got it!" Connor agreed readily, then stood up and walked out of the room.
About ten minutes later, Connor parted ways with Yvette and hailed a taxi to head home.
In the taxi, Connor hesitated for a long time. He felt that he should call Thomas Morgan and ask about Jace's situation.
After a simple chat with Thomas, Connor knew that Jace's family did have some power, but it was not a big problem for him, so he could play to his heart's content. If the Sackmann family really intended to take revenge on Connor, Thomas could also help solve the problem.
After hearing Thomas's words, Connor felt a lot more relaxed. After all, in today's society, there was always someone better. You don't know when you will offend someone you shouldn't offend, so Connor felt that it was better to be careful.
The next day, at six o'clock in the evening, Connor arrived at Yvette's hotel and dialed her number.
"Ms. Wendell, I'm already downstairs at the hotel. When are you coming down?" Connor asked softly.
"Wait for me, I'll put on some makeup and come out," Yvette replied calmly before hanging up.
Connor thought that Yvette would be coming down very soon, so he did not enter the hotel. Instead, he stood at the entrance and waited quietly.
But what Connor never expected was that this wait would last for a full half an hour.
"F * ck, what is this Yvette doing?" Connor was getting impatient from waiting. He took out his phone and was about to call Yvette, but before he could make the call, the woman in question walked out of the hotel.
Yvette was currently wearing sunglasses and a hat. If Connor was not familiar with Yvette, it would have been difficult for him to recognize her.
"Hello? Why are you still wearing makeup when you're dressed like this? Even if you don't put on makeup, no one can see your face!"
Connor shouted at Yvette helplessly.
"When we go to the birthday party later, won't I have to take off my sunglasses and hat? Do you want me to meet them without makeup on?"
Yvette rolled her eyes and replied to Connor. She then took out a bunch of car keys and handed them to Connor, saying softly, "You drive!"
Connor didn't say anything else and opened the door to get into the car.
After getting into the car, Yvette took off her hat and sunglasses before heaving a long sigh of relief.
Connor couldn't help but turn to look at Yvette before saying softly, "I didn't expect celebrities like you to care about these things…"
"Although in the eyes of ordinary people, we are glamorous celebrities, in fact, our hardships are not something that others can understand. After all, my family's conditions are not bad and we don't have to rely on me to earn money at all. However, some celebrities may become outdated at any time. Once they become outdated, they may not even be as good as ordinary people!"
Yvette said calmly.

chapters.title: Chapter 1341: A Gathering of Celebrities
chapters.content:
Chapter 1341: A Gathering of Celebrities
"Nothing is easy in the adult world!"
Connor sighed softly.
Yvette smiled. She did not say anything and turned to look at the scenery outside the window.
Half an hour later, Connor parked the car in front of a high-end restaurant and followed Yvette inside.
As this restaurant was owned by a certain celebrity, the waiter was not too surprised when he saw Yvette enter. Instead, he took the initiative to say, "Ms. Wendell, are you here to attend the birthday party?"
"That's right…"
Yvette nodded gently.
"Then please come this way. Miss Zoer and the others are in the private room!"
the waiter said politely to Yvette.
"Good!"
Yvette nodded gently and followed the waiter to the private room.
A moment later, Yvette and Connor arrived in front of a private room. Connor strode into the room.
However, Yvette stretched out her hand to stop Connor.
Connor turned to look at Yvette and asked in confusion, "What's wrong?"
"Have you forgotten our relationship?" Yvette asked Connor helplessly.
"I'm your boyfriend. I won't forget. Don't worry!"
Connor replied with a smile.
"Since you know that he's my boyfriend, shouldn't the two of us be more intimate? I'll hold your arm and go in!"
After saying this, Yvette took Connor's arm. She was a professional actress and her acting skills were pretty good, so to her, this matter was no different from acting.
However, Connor wasn't quite used to it.
"The two of us have to be more intimate so that Jace will be jealous when he sees us. Then, he will take the initiative to find trouble with you, and then you can hit him..."
Yvette explained softly.
"Well, you can hold my arm, but don't take advantage of this opportunity to take advantage of me. I already have a fiancée, let me tell you!" Connor said to Yvette sternly.
Upon hearing Connor's words, Yvette's expression was extremely speechless. She pouted and shouted, "What are you thinking with that head of yours? Why would I take advantage of you? You was probably the one taking advantage of me…"
"I'm just reminding you!"
Connor replied indifferently.
"You talk too much. Hurry up and go in!"
Yvette said as she dragged Connor into the private room.
As Connor was very close to Yvette, he could clearly smell the faint fragrance on her body.
Although Connor had attended many upper-class gatherings before, it was his first time attending such a gathering in the entertainment industry.
Though he didn't really care about the entertainment industry, he had been watching idol dramas with Rachel recently, so he could more or less recognize some of the celebrities present. He realized that the people in the private room were all the most popular celebrities in the entertainment industry. Of course, there were also some ordinary people mixed in. They were probably the boyfriends and girlfriends of those celebrities.
Connor looked at these celebrities and could not help but think of Yelena Allen.
Ever since Yelena left the country, Connor and Yelena had barely contacted each other. Connor didn't know how she was doing overseas, but according to the time, Yelena's filming would only end in a year bare minimum.
Once Yelena returned to the country, Connor really didn't know how to deal with the relationship between them. After all, Connor only had Freya in his heart. He did not want to do anything to hurt Freya, but he also did not want to hurt Yelena. Now, Connor felt a headache whenever he thought about these problems.
Connor wasn't interested in celebrities, so when he entered the private room, his expression was still calm. However, the celebrities present weren't calm. Because it was Connor's first time appearing in this place, everyone's eyes were on him.
At this moment, a tall and charming girl walked gracefully towards Yvette and Connor in her high heels.
"Yvette, what took you so long? I've been waiting for you for half a day…"
Connor knew that this girl was called Kaitlyn Zoer. She was Yvette's best friend and was also a very famous female celebrity in the entertainment industry. Recently, she had appeared in several idol dramas and her popularity had soared.
Kaitlyn and Yvette were both from the same entertainment company. Furthermore, Yvette's mother had shares in this company, so it was said that Kaitlyn's career in the entertainment industry was smooth sailing thanks to Yvette's help. Although she was not as popular as Yvette, she could still be considered a true A-list celebrity.
Kaitlyn's appearance and temperament could not be compared to Yvette's. However, compared to the other celebrities in the entertainment industry, she was the kind that was more pleasing to the eye, and she didn't have a bad personality either; she had a strong personality and self-discipline, so she was a likable female celebrity.
"Kaitlyn, I'm really sorry. I was delayed by something just now…"
Yvette hurriedly explained.
"It's okay. I know you must be putting on makeup!" Kaitlyn joked with a smile. She then subconsciously turned to look at Connor with a hint of surprise in her eyes. She then asked Yvette softly, "Yvette, who is this handsome guy? I don't think I've seen him before. Hurry up and introduce him to us!"
"That's right, Ms. Wendell. This seems to be the first time you've brought a member of the opposite sex to a party, right?"
"Could this be Ms. Wendell's boyfriend?"
"That shouldn't be the case. This boy doesn't look to be that old yet, so he's probably Ms. Wendell's friend. He must be planning to develop his career in the entertainment industry, so she brought him here to introduce himself to us…"
"I think that's the case. Ms. Wendell has never had a boyfriend before!"
The other celebrities were also very curious about Connor's identity, so they all surrounded him, ready to ask what was going on.
Yvette was extremely popular in the entertainment industry. Furthermore, everyone knew that the entertainment company she was in was actually owned by her father, so ordinary celebrities like them did not dare to offend Yvette at all. On the contrary, they had to curry favor with her in every possible way. If they managed to build a good relationship with Yvette, they might benefit immensely.
Kaitlyn was originally just an ordinary little celebrity. Wasn't it all thanks to Yvette's care that she had achieved what she had today?
After a moment of hesitation, Yvette said softly to the crowd, "Since everyone is so curious, then let me introduce everyone to my boyfriend, Connor McDonald!"

chapters.title: Chapter 1342: Announcing Their Relationship
chapters.content:
Chapter 1342: Announcing Their Relationship
"Hello, everyone!"
Connor smiled at the crowd.
When everyone present heard Yvette's words, they were all stunned on the spot, shocked.
Although they had already guessed it in their hearts, they never expected Connor to really be Yvette's boyfriend.
"Ms. Wendell, are you joking with us?" a female celebrity shouted at Yvette in shock.
"That's right, Ms. Wendell. You can't joke around like this!"
The others quickly followed suit.
Most of these people were Yvette's university classmates. Yvette had been the goddess of the school when she was in university and had never dated anyone. After entering the entertainment industry, she was even more clean and had no scandals. This was also surprising—it was not easy to keep a clean reputation in the entertainment industry.
Furthermore, Yvette had countless suitors around her. All kinds of outstanding men appeared in front of Yvette, but without exception, Yvette rejected all of them.
There were even rumors in the entertainment industry that Yvette might not like men at all, further compounded by the fact that Yvette had never explained the situation herself.
However, no one had expected Yvette to bring a man over today. Furthermore, she had generously admitted to their relationship.
If this news were to spread, it would definitely cause a huge commotion on the Internet. Who knew how many fans would be sad?
Of course, Yvette had something to use against these celebrities. Hence, no one dared to take such a risk. They would all keep this secret. Furthermore, these people could not wait to curry favor with Yvette. How could they choose to offend Yvette at this time?
If they offended Yvette, the most they would do was expose her relationship. It would not affect her too much.
However, they might ruin their careers if they stopped.
Therefore, even if they were given ten thousand guts, they would not dare to tell anyone about this.
"I hope that everyone can keep the matter of me and Connor being together a secret. After all, I don't have any plans to announce my relationship in the short term…" Yvette said.
"Ms. Wendell, don't worry. Those who can attend the gathering today are all our own people. We definitely won't tell anyone…" a male celebrity hurriedly said with a smile.
"That's right, Ms. Wendell. We have our own rules in this industry. No one will break the rules. Don't worry!" The others quickly followed suit.
"It's just that your relationship was announced so suddenly, Ms. Wendell. We didn't receive any news at all!"
"That's right, Ms. Wendell. Aren't you a little too good at keeping this a secret?" everyone asked with a smile.
"Connor is a member of our circle, so it's normal for everyone not to know!" Yvette explained.
The crowd did not say anything. They knew that Jace was pursuing Yvette, so they did not dare to continue talking about it.
"Mr. McDonald, if you're Yvette's friend, then you're also my friend. You're very welcome to attend my birthday party!"
Kaitlyn was usually on the best terms with Yvette, so she was extremely shocked at this moment because she did not know when Yvette had gotten herself a boyfriend. However, Kaitlyn did not show her confusion. Instead, she extended her small hand towards Connor enthusiastically.
Connor simply shook hands with Kaitlyn and then said with a smile, "Happy birthday to you!"
"Thank you!"
Kaitlyn smiled sweetly and took the initiative to say, "Yvette, Mr. McDonald, please sit down!"
"Good!"
Yvette nodded and brought Connor to sit down.
