At this moment, Kaitlyn had been seriously sizing up Connor. Although Connor looked very low-key, she could tell that Connor's background was not simple.
The reason was very simple: if Connor wanted to pretend to be Yvette's boyfriend, Yvette must have specially instructed Connor to dress well, or it would be easy for him to be exposed as a fake.
Connor himself had a lot of good clothes. Back in Santon, Freya had helped Connor buy many sets of clothes, each costing up to hundreds of thousands of dollars.
However, Connor didn't usually like to wear these clothes because he felt that they were a little too high-profile.
However, Connor had chosen a set of decent clothes to complement Yvette's outfit today.
Kaitlyn felt that since Connor was able to wear such good clothes, it meant that Connor was definitely not an ordinary person. He must be the heir of a large family, or he would not have caught Yvette's eye.
If Kaitlyn could notice this, the other celebrities would naturally be able to as well. Furthermore, the mere fact that Connor was attending with Yvette meant that he was definitely not an ordinary person.
Just as Yvette was chatting with the other celebrities, some of the D-list and C-list female celebrities took the opportunity to chat with Connor. They all felt that there was no man who was not a playboy. If they could hook up with Connor, they would be willing to be a mistress!
Therefore, Connor had become a hot topic amongst the partygoers, but these people did not dare to make it too obvious because Yvette was still present. If she wasn't, these female celebrities would probably drag Connor to a hotel room.
However, Connor's attitude towards these people was unusually cold. After all, they did not know that Connor had seen too many beautiful women that he did not even take a fancy to them at this point. He wasn't even interested in Yvette, let alone them.
Just as Connor was surrounded by these beautiful women, the sound of footsteps came from the door again. A young man in a white suit walked in with a smile.
The young man was indeed very handsome, and his temperament was outstanding. He must have undergone professional training.
Connor had looked for this person's information before, so he could tell at a glance that this person was his target today, Jace Sackmann!
When Jace appeared, almost everyone's attention was on him.
Although Jace was not a big star in the entertainment industry, because of his terrifying background, these smaller celebrities would still try their best to please Jace.
For a moment, almost everyone stood up and took the initiative to greet Jace.
"Mr. Sackmann, you're here?"
"Mr. Sackmann, we have been waiting for you! You're finally here…"
Those female celebrities immediately gave up on Connor after seeing Jace.

chapters.title: Chapter 1343: A Cockfight
chapters.content:
Chapter 1343: A Cockfight
After all, Connor was already together with Yvette. The chances of them hooking up with Connor were not very high.
However, Jace was different; Jace was a very lecherous person, and this was a well-known fact in the entertainment industry. Basically, as long as a woman could sleep with Jace, then her future in the entertainment industry would become smooth sailing.
Jace couldn't make himself popular, but he had a way to make others popular.
This was also the reason why those female celebrities were so enthusiastic about him.
Although Jace was lecherous, he knew very clearly that he was just fooling around with those female celebrities in the entertainment industry. He didn't have any other thoughts at all when it came to them. If it was really time to get married, he would still choose a woman who was of equal status to him.
Yvette was the most suitable choice for Jace.
Yvette's family was well-to-do in the first place. Whether it was their social connections or financial strength, they were all very impressive. In addition, the Wendell family that Yvette belonged to was considered a family friend of the Sackmann family. If Jace could get together with Yvette, it would be of great help to him in the future, which was why Jace had been pursuing her so relentlessly.
Unfortunately, Yvette was not interested in him at all. Even so, Jace still did not choose to give up. Instead, he continued to pester her and used his family's connections to clear all the obstacles in front of him.
To put it bluntly, Jace felt that Yvette would definitely be with him in the future because she had no other choice.
The relationship between Jace and Kaitlyn could only be considered ordinary, but Kaitlyn did not have much background and did not dare to offend Jace, which was the only reason why he was invited to today's birthday party.
Jace knew that Yvette would definitely attend the birthday party, so he'd rushed over.
After exchanging a few words with the celebrities, Jace began to look for Yvette.
A moment later, Jace finally saw Yvette chatting with Connor.
Jace walked over happily. Yvette naturally noticed Jace and did something that Connor did not expect—she snuggled into Connor's embrace, then placed Connor's hand on her shoulder and continued to joke with him.
Connor was stunned for a moment, but he knew that it was probably because of Jace, so he didn't say anything.
Not far away, Jace was stunned when he saw this scene. He looked at Connor and Yvette in surprise. At this moment, his gaze was like a husband who had just returned from a business trip and saw his wife lying on the bed with another man.
Jace's eyes were filled with ferocity and anger!
"Mr. Sackmann, that person is Yvette's boyfriend…"
A male celebrity had a good relationship with Jace, so he took the initiative to speak up.
Yvette's boyfriend?"
After Jace heard the words, his expression grew even angrier. He gritted his teeth and whispered, "When did Yvette get a boyfriend?"
"I'm not too sure about that either. Yvette was the one who brought this kid over. Furthermore, Yvette even said that this person was her boyfriend in front of us…"
The young man explained.
"That's impossible. I've been keeping an eye on Yvette all this time. How could she get a boyfriend out of thin air?"
At this moment, Jace's heart was filled with doubts. He still could not believe that Connor was really Yvette's boyfriend.
"Is this kid tired of living? You actually dare to snatch my woman…"
Jace took a deep breath, then directly walked towards Connor and Yvette.
When Yvette saw the expression on Jace's face, she was a little smug because she knew that her plan had succeeded.
"Yvette…"
Jace walked up to Yvette and opened his mouth to speak.
"Jace, you're here?"
Yvette turned to look at Jace and asked lightly.
Jace was not in the mood to talk nonsense with Yvette. He pointed at Connor and asked, "Yvette, who is this person?"
"Let me introduce you. This is my boyfriend, Connor!"
Yvette said naturally to Jace.
"Your boyfriend?"
Jace sneered, then gritted his teeth and said, "Yvette, don't joke with me. When did you have a boyfriend? If you really had a boyfriend, would I not know?"
"Jace, what do you mean? Do I need your permission to have a boyfriend?" Yvette asked directly.
"Impossible, this guy is definitely not your boyfriend. Stop lying to me!"
"And why, Jace, would I lie to you about this? I've been with Connor for more than half a year, but I've never told anyone else, so it's normal that you don't know!"
Yvette said.
"You've been together for more than half a year?"
After hearing Yvette's words, a hint of helplessness flashed across Connor's eyes.
Yvette was truly a top-tier actress. Her acting skills were flawless.
If it wasn't because Connor knew what was going on, even he probably wouldn't be able to see any flaws.
After hearing that Connor had been with Yvette for more than half a year, Jace's expression was unusually angry because he felt that this was an insult to himself.
However, because there were many other people present, Jace didn't dare to say anything directly even if he was not satisfied. On the contrary, he regained his composure and then smiled at Connor, reaching out his right hand and said softly, "Hello, Mr. McDonald. I'm Yvette's friend, Jace Sackmann!"
It was obvious that Jace deliberately raised his voice when he said his name. He was probably reminding Connor of his identity.
But Connor didn't care. After all, Connor already knew who he was, so he shook hands with Jace.
"You don't look to be very old, Mr. McDonald. What are you doing now?"
Jace increased the strength of his hand as he spoke, and a trace of pride flashed in his eyes.
Although Jace liked to play with women, he was also very keen on exercising. He maintained a very good figure and had great strength in his hands. If he was an ordinary person, he would definitely suffer a loss in his hands.
Therefore, Jace wanted to use this method to give Connor a good show of strength and make Connor understand how powerful he was.
"I'm still in school…"
Connor lightly replied to Jace, then he felt the strength in his hands.

chapters.title: Chapter 1344: A Present
chapters.content:
Chapter 1344: A Present
Connor didn't expect Jace to make the first move against him, so his eyes flashed with a hint of interest.
If Jace was facing an ordinary person instead of Connor, then Jace's plan might have succeeded. Unfortunately, the person he met was Connor.
Although Connor looked thin and weak and did not have much strength, he was a martial artist.
The gap between a martial artist and an ordinary person was definitely not something that could be made up for through training.
In order to prevent Jace from reacting, Connor did not use force, but silently endured Jace's strength first. After all, Jace's strength was nothing to Connor. If Connor suddenly exerted force, he could definitely crush Jace's bones in an instant. However, Connor felt that it was not necessary to do so now. After all, they had just met. If Connor crushed Jace's hand, it would make people think that it was Connor's problem.
Seeing that Connor did not resist, Jace revealed a smug smile. He continued to increase his force on Connor and said with a smile, "Mr. McDonald, you're still studying? What does your family do?"
"My family runs a small business…"
Connor replied indifferently.
"I see."
Jace nodded thoughtfully.
In the next second, Connor suddenly began to slowly exert his strength.
However, when Jace felt Connor's strength, his eyes were filled with disdain because he felt that Connor was weak.
But just a few seconds later, the expression on Jace's face began to change. From the initial confidence to one of shock, and finally, it turned into a ferocious expression.
Because he realized that Connor was stronger than he thought. In fact, he was so strong that Jace was in disbelief. No matter how hard Jace tried, Connor did not budge. He began to struggle, but Connor still had no intention of letting go of Jace.
Yvette, who was standing at the side, naturally knew what was going on. She had a smug expression on her face as she felt that her asking Connor to come was the right decision.
A few seconds later, Jace finally couldn't stand the pain in his hand and screamed instinctively.
Everyone looked at Jace, and Connor let go of Jace's hand with a smile, then asked Jace softly, "Mr. Sackmann, what's wrong with you?"
"It... It's nothing. I accidentally twisted my ankle just now..."
Jace quickly explained to the crowd, then looked at Connor and said, "Mr. McDonald is really not an ordinary person. No wonder you're able to woo Yvette…"
"Haha..."
Connor looked at Jace and smiled but didn't say anything.
Because he had suffered a loss with Connor, Jace did not dare to continue making things difficult for Connor, so he turned around and left.
Yvette turned to look at Connor and said with a smile, "I didn't expect you to be so powerful. You made Jace suffer a loss just now…"
"This is nothing. Something better awaits!"
Connor replied calmly.
At this moment, most of the people attending Kaitlyn's birthday party had arrived, so Kaitlyn walked straight to the center of the private room.
Today, Kaitlyn was wearing a light blue evening gown. She looked very beautiful. Moreover, celebrities like her had undergone professional training. Her walking posture and temperament were very proper, giving people the feeling that there was a huge gap between her and ordinary people.
Although Kaitlyn's looks and figure were inferior to Yvette's in all aspects, she was definitely considered one of the top female celebrities in the entertainment industry. Her net worth was not low, and her looks and temperament were pretty good. Therefore, there were still many male celebrities who were interested in Kaitlyn.
Just now, Kaitlyn had also noticed the situation between Connor and Jace. Kaitlyn was Yvette's best friend. She naturally knew how much Yvette hated Jace, but for various reasons, she could not go too far when it came to dealing with Jace. This matter had always been Yvette's biggest worry. However, today, Yvette had brought her boyfriend here. With Jace's temperament, he would definitely make a move against Connor.
Kaitlyn didn't like people like Jace either, but she didn't have any background, so she didn't dare to offend Jace. She could only turn a blind eye.
"Thank you all for coming to my birthday party today..."
Kaitlyn said to everyone with a smile.
"Kaitlyn, happy birthday!"
Jace smiled and exclaimed, then took out the present he had prepared in advance and handed it over.
Jace gifted Kaitlyn a Bulgari watch. Everyone praised Jace for his generosity after seeing it. However, Jace only wanted to show off in front of Yvette.
Everyone also took out their presents and handed them to Kaitlyn. After all, these people were all celebrities, and their income was quite high, so the present they gave were not cheap.
All kinds of luxury goods appeared one after another, and Connor felt a little awkward. After all, he didn't prepare any present. Moreover, Connor didn't know Kaitlyn, so he didn't think about preparing a gift at all.
However, just as Connor was at a loss for what to do, Yvette suddenly reached out and tugged at Connor. She then brought Connor to Kaitlyn.
"Kaitlyn, happy birthday. This is the present Connor and I prepared for you!"
As Yvette spoke, she took out a car key and handed it to Kaitlyn.
When Kaitlyn saw the car keys, she became a little excited. She said in disbelief, "Yvette, why are you giving me such an expensive present?"
"I know you've always liked this car, so I asked Connor to buy one for you!"
Yvette replied calmly.
However, what Yvette meant was very obvious. She was trying to say that Connor had paid for the car. In that case, Connor would not have to feel awkward for not preparing a present.
"Thank you, Mr. McDonald!"
Kaitlyn said happily to Connor.
"You're welcome!"
Connor smiled faintly.
Jace, who was not far away, saw this scene. His eyes flashed with a trace of ruthlessness, and he began to think about how he would teach Connor a lesson later.
After everyone had given their presents, they sat down and waited for the waiter to serve the dishes.
These celebrity gatherings were very different from those of the rich. The rich usually liked to hold a cocktail party or something so that it was convenient for everyone to chat in private.
But this time, Kaitlyn had organized a dinner party. There was a total of six tables in the private room, and each table could accommodate five people. There was a total of thirty people.
Everyone was seated according to their status. Connor and Yvette naturally sat at the first table, and Jace was also at the same table.

chapters.title: Chapter 1345: Drinking
chapters.content:
Chapter 1345: Drinking
"Jeremy, let's go for a smoke..."
Jace said to the young man beside him expressionlessly.
"Okay!"
The young man hurriedly nodded and followed Jace out of the private room.
After leaving the private room, Jace took out a cigarette and handed it to Jeremy Cabrera. Then he said expressionlessly, "Jeremy, I heard that the reason why you were able to gain a foothold in the entertainment industry is because you have high alcohol tolerance."
"Well, not really…"
Jeremy did not understand what Jace meant, so he replied in a very low-key manner.
"Didn't you get all those advertisement jobs because of your ability to drink? Come on, now. There's no need to hide things from."
Jace pursed his lips and replied.
"Mr. Sackmann, what do you want to tell me? I'm a little confused…"
Jeremy asked Jace in confusion.
Jace turned and looked around. When he found that no one was eavesdropping, he said softly, "I'll give you a task now. When we drink later, you have to force Connor to drink to the point of being drunk senseless."
Jeremy was stunned when he heard Jace's words. He then said with a helpless expression, "Mr. Sackmann, it's fine if you want me to force someone else to drink, but that Connor guy isn't someone we can easily mess with. Moreover, he's Miss Wendell's boyfriend. How am I supposed to survive in the entertainment industry after offending her?"
"Does that mean it's okay to offend me?"
Jace looked at Jeremy and asked.
Jeremy was dumbfounded when he heard Jace's words. He stuttered, "Mr. Sackmann, I don't think I've ever offended you. Can you not make things difficult for me?"
"How am I making things difficult for you? I just took on a movie, and I'll be the male lead. The female lead is a popular celebrity in our country and the director is also a big shot. As long as you help me this time, I'll give this movie to you. By then, your popularity will definitely double. If Yvette dares to make things difficult for you in the future, just give me a call!"
Jace said to Jeremy in a very serious tone.
When Jeremy heard Jace's words, he was instantly stunned. He asked excitedly, "Mr. Sackmann, is what you said true?"
"Of course, why would I lie to you about this?"
Jace replied in frustration.
"..."
Jeremy looked at Jace and took a deep breath. Then he said in a low voice, "Mr. Sackmann, don't worry, I will definitely get the job done!"
"Alright, go on in!"
Jace patted Jeremy's shoulder and then took Jeremy into the private room.
After entering the private room, the waiter began to serve the dishes while Kaitlyn began to toast everyone.
At this time, Connor did not know about Jace and Jeremy's plan. He chatted with Yvette while eating.
The dishes here were very good and suited Connor's taste very well.
When Jace saw Connor and Yvette talking and laughing, he became even angrier, so he turned and glanced at Jeremy.
Jeremy realized that everyone was drinking red wine. Red wine was expensive, but one could not get drunk easily just from drinking red wine. The fastest way was to drink white wine and red wine together.
"Kaitlyn, it's your birthday today. It's such a happy occasion. Why did you only order red wine? Ask the waiter to bring two bottles of white wine!"
Jeremy said with a smile.
"White wine is not good for the body. It's better to drink red wine. Red wine can also help with skin care!"
Kaitlyn knew that Jeremy liked to drink, but she was worried that Jeremy would drink too much and cause trouble, so she frowned and replied.
"Kaitlyn, that's not right. White wine is still better…"
Jace said lightly.
"Yeah, red wine is boring. White wine is better!"
"I also think we should order some white wine!"
In order to get on Jace's good side, the male celebrities hurriedly began to shout.
Jace looked Connor up and down and asked with a smile, "Mr. McDonald, do you think white wine or red wine is better?"
"I'm fine with anything!"
Connor didn't like to drink, so he naturally didn't care about these things and replied indifferently.
Jace turned to look at Kaitlyn and said with a smile, "Kaitlyn, ask the waiter to serve a few bottles of white wine. When the time comes, we can choose to drink whichever we want. What do you think?"
"Alright…"
Kaitlyn nodded gently after hearing Jace's words. She couldn't find any reason to refuse.
Soon, the waiter brought a few bottles of white wine.
Jace poured himself a glass of wine, then raised his glass and said, "Well, all the guys here will drink some white wine. The girls can do whatever they want…"
"Alright…"
Everyone agreed and began to pour themselves a glass of white wine.
A glass of white wine was poured into Connor's glass, but he didn't really care about it. After all, he was a martial artist now. This bit of wine wouldn't have any effect on his body, so drinking wine was the same as drinking water in his eyes.
"Today is Kaitlyn's birthday, so the first glass of wine must be to congratulate Kaitlyn on her birthday…"
Jace raised his glass as he spoke.
Everyone also shouted in agreement.
Kaitlyn smiled and said, "Thank you, everyone!"
After saying this, everyone drank all the wine in their glasses.
Connor naturally also drank a glass of wine.
Yvette seemed to be a little worried about Connor, so she him Connor softly, "Are you okay?"
"I'm fine…"
Connor replied indifferently.
Yvette did not say anything else after seeing that Connor was fine after downing the glass of white wine.
However, Yvette did not know that this was just the beginning.
A few minutes later, seeing that things were going well, Jeremy directly raised his wine glass and said to Connor, "Mr. McDonald, you're Miss Wendell's boyfriend. This is the first time we're meeting. Miss Wendell has always taken great care of me."
When Connor heard Jeremy's words, he did not say anything else. He raised his glass and drank it.
"Mr. McDonald, your alcohol tolerance is quite high. Looks like I've met my match. How about the two of us have another drink?"
Jeremy said to Connor with a smile as he poured wine for Connor.
"Sure!"
Connor nodded lightly and then drank the wine in the glass again.

chapters.title: Chapter 1346: Turning From Defense to Offense
chapters.content:
Chapter 1346: Turning From Defense to Offense
"Mr. McDonald, you're so easy to get along with. Let's have another glass!"
After saying this, Jeremy poured another glass of wine for Connor.
When everyone saw this scene, they more or less understood what was going on.
Jeremy had just gone out with Jace. Now that he was back, he took the initiative to toast Connor. If it was one or two glasses, that was normal, but this time, Jeremy had already toasted three glasses of wine in a row. Something was obviously going on.
Jace looked at Connor with a smug face and thought to himself, 'Connor, you're really bold. How dare you touch my woman? After you get drunk, I'll deal with you and make sure you end up in the hospital.'
Jace did not plan to just make Connor drunk. He planned to make Connor drunk and then make him disappear completely.
The others present also knew that Jeremy had been bribed by Jace, which was why he was acting this way. Otherwise, even if Jeremy had 10,000 guts, he would never dare to do such a thing to Yvette's boyfriend!
Yvette looked worried when she saw Connor drinking with Jeremy.
Because Jeremy's alcohol tolerance was very high, if he really continued to drink like this, Connor would definitely end up in trouble. At that time, things would not end well.
However, Yvette could not understand why Connor did not reject Jeremy even though he knew that Jeremy was intentionally forcing him to drink.
On the contrary, every time Jeremy toasted, Connor would drink.
'What is Connor trying to do?'
The more Yvette thought about it, the more she felt that something was amiss.
"Mr. McDonald, I'm having such an awesome time. Let's have another glass…"
Jeremy raised his glass again after eating two mouthfuls of food.
Connor smiled faintly and raised his glass.
"Connor, you should stop drinking!"
Yvette couldn't help but exclaimed.
"It's fine. You don't have to worry about me!"
Connor replied indifferently and then drank the white wine in the glass again.
Jeremy looked at Connor's relaxed expression, and he was a little puzzled. He had drunk at least seven or eight glasses of wine with Connor, but Connor was still fine. He still looked perfectly fine. It was rather odd.
Yvette whispered to Connor, "Connor, what are you doing? Can't you see that he's deliberately making you drink?"
"Are you sure he's the one who's making me drink? What if I'm the one who's making him drink?"
Connor replied with a smile.
Yvette could not help but be taken aback when she heard Connor's words. She was a little confused as if she did not quite understand what Connor meant.
As time passed, Jeremy kept drinking with Connor. However, what Jeremy never expected was that Connor still looked perfectly fine. He, on the other hand, was getting drunk, but Connor still looked calm.
Everyone else was also thinking that Connor's alcohol tolerance was really terrifying. If it were anyone else, they would probably be dead drunk.
Jace, who was confident his plan would pan out, now had a solemn look on his face. He couldn't understand what was going on.
Although Jeremy already realized that Connor's alcohol tolerance was terrifying, he did not choose to retreat because the benefits that Jace had offered were too tempting. He did not want to give up such a good opportunity.
"This Connor guy must be faking it. I don't believe that he can drink so much…"
Jeremy took a deep breath and raised his wine glass again.
Connor did the same with a smile.
The two of them drank for nearly ten minutes.
Jeremy picked up the wine glass and said with a stutter, "Mr. McDonald, one... one more glass... Ahh..."
"Jeremy, are you crazy? You're already drunk. Why are you still drinking…"
Kaitlyn finally couldn't hold it in anymore. She widened her watery eyes and shouted at Jeremy.
"That's right, Jeremy. Stop drinking!"
The others followed suit.
"I'm fine. I've drunk less than 30%. of what Mr. McDonald has drunk. Let's continue..."
Jeremy stammered.
Connor raised his glass helplessly.
Jeremy gritted his teeth and was about to drink the wine in the glass. However, just as he was halfway through, Jeremy fell on the table with a bang.
When everyone saw this scene, they were instantly speechless.
"This trash!"
Jace gritted his teeth and cursed in a low voice.
When Connor saw Jeremy pass out, he revealed a helpless smile and said softly, "He could only take a few glasses of wine. Looks like I'll have to drink alone now…"
Jace was even angrier when he saw Connor being so arrogant.
If he had known that Connor's alcohol tolerance was so high, he would have found a few more people to do the job. However, it was obviously too late to regret now.
Connor slowly looked at Jace, then smiled and said, "Mr. Sackmann, Jeremy has already drunk a lot. Why don't the two of us drink a little?"
Jace couldn't help but be stunned when he heard this.
Everyone looked at Connor, and a trace of shock flashed across their eyes.
Because at this moment, they finally understood that Connor wasn't stupid, he was just acting dumb.
Connor was waiting to deal with Jace after Jeremy was drunk.
At this time, Jace was obviously in a difficult position. It would be too embarrassing if he said that he did not dare to drink. Moreover, he was the one who said that he wanted white wine.
However, if he did drink, he was worried that he would not be able to drink as much as Connor. At that time, he would pass out just like Jeremy.
So, he did not know what to do.
"Looks like Mr. Sackmann doesn't dare to drink with me. Forget it, then!"
Seeing that Jace was hesitant, Connor smiled lightly.
"Since Mr. McDonald is in such a good mood today, I'll drink with you…"
Jace naturally didn't want to lose face in front of these people, and he felt that although Connor was very good at drinking, Connor had already drunk so much wine just now. Even if he could drink, he probably wouldn't be able to hold on for long, so he had a great advantage in drinking with Connor now.
Just like that, Connor took the initiative to toast Jace one glass after another.
Jace, on the other hand, gritted his teeth and drank one glass after another.
At the beginning, Jace could still handle a few glasses, but not long after, Jace felt that his stomach was in turmoil, as if he would throw up at any time.
However, Connor still did not give up and continued to toast him.

chapters.title: Chapter 1347: Supreme Private Room
chapters.content:
Chapter 1347: Supreme Private Room
It was obvious that Connor intended to provoke Jace in this way, so that Jace would make the first move.
However, Jace did not make any moves because he was drunk senseless.
"Mr. Sackmann, can you still drink?"
Seeing that Jace seemed to be unable to stand still, Connor asked Jace with a smile.
"Of course, I can…"
Jace stuttered, and then his trembling right hand was about to pick up the wine glass.
But the moment Jace lowered his head, he finally couldn't control himself.
"Bleurgh…"
Jace threw up all the food and wine he had just eaten.
"Ah…"
When everyone saw this scene, they all stood up and screamed.
Yvette covered her eyes and hid behind Connor, feeling disgusted.
No one expected Jace to vomit, and he vomited in front of so many people. The female celebrities sitting next to Jace were the direct victims. They were splashed with wine.
If this were to get out, Jace would definitely become a joke in the entertainment industry.
After Jace suddenly vomited, he felt much more awake and quickly turned around to walk out of the private room.
Everyone then left the room.
"You're terrible, you know that!"
When Yvette and Connor walked out of the private room, she happily said to Connor.
"How am I terrible? I'm giving them a taste of their own medicine. They were planning to get me drunk, right? So I just played along…"
Connor said lightly.
"But how is it that you can drink so much without getting drunk? You drank so much white wine just now, and you're actually fine?"
Yvette asked Connor, seemingly puzzled.
"What could happen to me? I'll tell you a secret. Just now, they all drank white wine, but I drank mineral water, that's why they lost…"
Connor said with a smile.
Upon hearing Connor's words, Yvette couldn't help but burst into a charming smile. She was filled with happiness.
Ten minutes later, Jace came out of the bathroom again.
Because Jace had only drunk seven or eight glasses of wine just now, he did not drink much at all. It was just that his alcohol tolerance was rather low, so he felt a little nauseous.
At this time, Jace was already quite sober. He said to everyone, "Everyone, I'm sorry for ruining your mood today. I apologize to everyone, especially Kaitlyn. I really feel very sorry for ruining your birthday party like this…"
"It's alright…"
Kaitlyn replied expressionlessly. Jace had brought this upon himself today.
"I've already booked a new place. It's still early now, so I hope everyone won't be disappointed because of me."
Jace looked at everyone and asked.
"Alright!"
"Sounds good! We were going to change locations anyway!"
Everyone seemed to have forgotten about the fact that Jace had vomited all over the table and quickly replied.
Kaitlyn didn't say anything. Since Jace had already booked a place, she couldn't refuse.
So, just like that, everyone left the restaurant and drove to the new place.
About half an hour later, they arrived at a club.
"Let's go."
Yvette turned and glanced at Connor as she spoke softly to him.
"Alright…"
Connor nodded and then instinctively looked outside the window. He suddenly realized that the scenery outside the window seemed a little familiar.
So, Connor pushed open the door and got out of the car. When Connor got out of the car, he was dumbfounded. He was in disbelief because the place where everyone was at was actually Heavens Club.
Connor didn't think that these people would be so good at choosing a place. They had booked a new place at his Heavens Club.
"Heavens Club? Why does this name sound so familiar?"
Yvette muttered with a puzzled expression.
"It is indeed a little familiar…"
Connor replied helplessly.
"That's not right. Isn't your club called Heavens Club?"
Yvette said to Connor in disbelief.
"Yes, it's my club."
Connor said helplessly.
"I didn't expect your club to be so big."
Yvette asked in surprise.
"If my club was just a small ordinary club, why would I spend so much effort to invite your father to attend the opening ceremony…"
Connor said speechlessly.
"That's true…"
Yvette could not help but nod.
"I didn't expect Jace to bring us here. But this place is pretty good. At least it will be more convenient to deal with him later..."
Connor said with a smile.
"Then, you'd better not let these people know your true identity. Otherwise, Jace might be wary of you..."
Yvette reminded Connor softly.
"Don't worry. I am not that stupid…"
Connor smiled and looked at Yvette. "Um, you go on in. I'll go in later!"
"Alright…"
Yvette nodded and walked into Heavens Club in her high heels.
At this time, everyone was surrounding Jace. After all, many of them had never been to Heavens Club, so they were naturally curious about what was going on inside.
"Mr. Sackmann, your supreme VIP room has been prepared for you. Please come in!"
When the beautiful woman in the dress saw Jace, she quickly stepped forward and said with a smile.
When everyone heard the beautiful woman's words, their eyes suddenly widened, and they were in disbelief. They never thought that Jace would book the Supreme VIP room of Heavens Club. This private room was the most high-class private room in Heavens Club. It was said that the cost a night was nearly four to five hundred thousand dollars.
This amount of money was enough to buy a house in a small city.
"Mr. Sackmann, I heard that the Supreme VIP room here can only be reserved by Platinum members and above. Are you already a Platinum member?"
A male celebrity asked Jace in shock.
Jace smiled faintly when he heard the male celebrity's words. He did not deny it.
However, he didn't use his own membership card to book this private room. Instead, he used his father's membership card to book it.
If Jace was really a Platinum level member, then it was impossible that Jace was not here when Heavens Club changed its boss.
Everyone knew that Jace was now a Platinum member of Heavens Club. They began to flatter him, and they were very excited.
Jace, on the other hand, had been observing Yvette's expression the entire time. However, she looked rather nonchalant.
After all, Jace was a Platinum level member. The gap between him and Connor was way too big. They were not on the same level at all!

chapters.title: Chapter 1348: Can You Be More Serious!
chapters.content:
Chapter 1348: Can You Be More Serious!
A few minutes later, everyone entered the supreme private room.
Connor, who had been waiting outside, saw that it was almost time and followed them into the hall.
When the lobby manager saw Connor come in, she was shocked. She quickly walked up to him and asked Connor excitedly, "Mr. McDonald, why are you here?"
"I'm here with a few friends. You don't have to worry about me. Go do what you have to do."
Connor looked at the manager and replied indifferently. Then, he instructed, "By the way, don't call me Mr. McDonald when you see me later. Just pretend that you don't know me. Do you understand what I mean?"
"Yes, sir…"
The manager hurriedly nodded at Connor.
Connor didn't say anything after hearing the manager's words. He then walked upstairs.
A few minutes later, Connor was led by the waiter to the private room where Yvette and the others were.
This private room was the best one in Heavens Club. It was so spacious that it could even hold 100 people. Additionally, the decoration inside was extremely luxurious. There was a small stage at the front of the private room where people could sing. There were also a piano and other musical instrument. You could even see some wine accessories. Whatever you could think of, you could find them here.
Because Connor came in late, everyone had already started enjoying themselves.
Some people were singing, while others were playing games.
Jace was sitting on the sofa with an ugly expression on his face because he had embarrassed himself today. At this time, all he could think about was how to deal with Connor and how to make Connor embarrass himself.
Upon seeing Connor enter, Yvette hurriedly walked to his side and sat down on a sofa with him.
This scene seemed to stimulate Jace even more.
After hesitating for a moment, Kaitlyn walked up to the stage and waved at the crowd.
When everyone saw Kaitlyn go on stage, they stopped what they were doing. They didn't know what Kaitlyn was going to do.
"Firstly, I would like to thank Mr. Sackmann for arranging such an amazing place for us…"
Kaitlyn called out with a smile.
Jace smiled helplessly when he heard this. If he hadn't vomited, he wouldn't have spent so much money for this.
"It isn't easy for all of us to get together, so this time, we'll follow the rules from when we were in school. Everyone can go on stage and perform something. No one can skip the performance or perform more than one act."
Kaitlyn shouted at the crowd with a smile.
"Alright…"
"I want to dance later!"
Everyone knew that this was a good opportunity to show their abilities, so naturally, no one said no to it.
"Alright, since no one has any objections, I'll start first. Then, everyone can choose when to go on stage!"
Kaitlyn nodded and started singing.
Although Kaitlyn was an actress, she had always wanted to be a singer. It was just that it was easy to be an actress, but it was very difficult for a singer to become famous. Therefore, in the end, Kaitlyn did not choose to be a singer.
Kaitlyn's voice was very sweet, like the sound of nature. Compared to ordinary people, she was very outstanding.
However, compared to professional singers, she was just mediocre.
After the first song, everyone started clapping. Then, the second person went on stage to perform.
Yvette did not know Connor very well, so she asked, "What are you going to perform later?"
"Do I have to perform too?"
Connor was stunned when he heard Yvette's words.
"Everyone has to go up and perform. Of course, you have to go up too. Hurry up and think about what you're good at…"
Yvette replied helplessly.
"How can I perform anything? Maybe I can break a rock with my chest…"
Connor said with a smile.
"Can you be more serious!"
Yvette looked at Connor, not knowing what to say.
"I'm very serious. I don't have any talent. Why don't you give me some advice?"
Connor said with a smile.
"..."
Yvette looked at Connor and hesitated for a couple of seconds before saying softly, "If you really don't have anything to perform, then come sing with me!"
"Sing with you?"
Connor was stunned when he heard that. He then frowned and said, "I sing out of tune. Are you sure you want me to sing?"
"It's fine. When the time comes, just follow my lead and hum a few sentences. No one will laugh at you…"
Yvette said casually.
"Alright, then!"
Connor looked at Yvette and nodded helplessly.
After all, Connor was now Yvette's boyfriend in everyone's eyes. Furthermore, Yvette's background was extremely terrifying. Hence, ordinary people did not have the guts to mock him.
Yvette was actually not very interested in the performances on stage, so she said, "Connor, it's boring here. Let's go make cocktails!"
"You know how to make cocktails?"
When Connor heard what Yvette said, a hint of confusion flashed in his eyes.
"I've learned a little before, but I'm not very good at it."
Yvette replied softly before leading Connor to the cocktail making area.
Connor looked at the dazzling array of concocting materials, and he was a little shocked. He didn't expect Vanessa Canfield to be so meticulous and prepare these things in the private room. He had to admit that she was indeed very suitable to run Heavens Club. If it wasn't for Chelsea Lee's intention to take Vanessa with her, Connor would have kept Vanessa here no matter how much he had to pay her.
"I'll make you a glass first. Try it and see how it tastes!"
Yvette said with a smile.
Upon hearing Yvette's words, a hint of helplessness flashed across Connor's eyes. He said in a low voice, "Are you sure it's going to be drinkable?"
"What do you mean by that? Do you know how many people want to drink the cocktails I make? They don't have the chance, yet you still dare to question me…"
"As long as I don't end up with an upset stomach…"
Connor said speechlessly.
"Just you wait and see!"
Yvette replied calmly and began to make the cocktail seriously.

chapters.title: Chapter 1349: Kiss!
chapters.content:
Chapter 1349: Kiss!
Yvette must have studied making cocktails and was very familiar with them.
In less than a few minutes, Yvette had made a cocktail and handed it to Connor. She said softly, "Try it. What do you think?"
Connor hesitated for a moment before reaching out to take the wine glass. He smiled and said, "It seems to be quite good…"
"You can't just look at it. You have to taste it before you know…"
Yvette said softly.
"Alright!"
Connor replied with a smile and then took a small sip.
"So? How does it taste?"
Yvette asked Connor expectantly.
"It does seem pretty good, but I don't usually drink, so I'm not very sure how good it is…"
Connor commented very seriously.
"You don't know anything about cocktails. If it were any other professional, they would definitely be able to taste how good it is…"
Yvette pouted as she spoke, seemingly dissatisfied with Connor's evaluation.
"..."
Connor smiled faintly and didn't say anything.
"Connor, how about I teach you how to make a cocktail?"
At this moment, Yvette blinked and whispered to Connor.
"No, thanks. I am not interested…"
Connor thought for a moment and shook his head.
"Come on. It's really simple. We don't have anything better to do anyway. Let me teach you…"
Yvette tugged at Connor and began to teach him how to make some simple cocktails.
Although Connor was not very interested in such things, he had nothing to do now. Hence, he started learning from Yvette.
However, at this moment, a melodious piano sound rang out.
Connor only knew two musical instruments in his life. One was the piano, and the other was the guitar.
His mother taught him how to play the two musical instruments when she was still alive, so Connor was very sensitive to the sounds of these two instruments. Now, he rarely touched these two instruments. The reason was that whenever he heard the sound of the piano and the guitar, he would think of his mother.
Connor seemed to be attracted by the music and slowly turned to look at the stage.
He saw a young man playing the Ninth Symphony with a serious expression.
Connor could tell that this young man's level was very high, but he was not particularly serious when playing the song.
"You know how to appreciate the piano?"
Yvette could not help but ask Connor in surprise when she saw the change in his expression.
"A little, and I can tell that this person plays well…"
Connor replied indifferently.
"Of course. This person is a famous piano expert in our school. He even won the second place in a global piano competition…"
When Yvette said this, she had a strange look on her face. Then, she slowly lowered her head.
Meanwhile, Connor was completely focused on the piano and did not notice the change in Yvette's expression.
About half an hour later, everyone was almost done with their performance. Only Connor and Yvette were left.
"What song are you going to sing later?"
Connor asked Yvette softly.
"How about the song 'The Rest of My Life'?"
Yvette asked Connor after a moment of hesitation.
Connor could not help but be stunned when he heard Yvette's words. He then asked with a puzzled expression, "What song is that? Why haven't I heard of it before?"
"Why are you so old-fashioned? You've not heard of such a popular song? Forget it, when the time comes, you can just sing along with me. I'm choosing this song to provoke Jace. I think he won't be able to stand it when he hears this song. He will surely make a move against you. Then, you can beat him up as much as you like."
Yvette said fiercely to Connor.
After hearing Yvette's words, Connor felt very helpless. He did not know what to say.
If he didn't know what was going on, Connor would think that Jace had done something worse than molesting her. Otherwise, Yvette wouldn't hate him so much.
At this moment, Kaitlyn walked to Yvette's side in her high heels and said softly to Yvette, "Yvette, their performance is almost over. Now, only you and Connor are left. Do the two of you plan to perform something together or alone?"
"Connor and I are going to sing together. What do you think about that?"
Yvette replied with a smile.
"Alright, go on!"
Kaitlyn nodded.
Meanwhile, Yvette then held Connor's hand as they walked toward the stage.
Soon, the music started playing.
Yvette began to sing along with the music. Connor did not know how to sing this song at all, so he stood on the stage like a decoration.
The lyrics were unusually sweet and affectionate. Coupled with Yvette's acting skills, she kept looking at him affectionately. Everyone would feel that Yvette truly loved Connor.
However, who would have thought that Connor and Yvette had only known each other for less than three days? Furthermore, all of this was just an act by Yvette.
When Jace, who was sitting on the sofa, saw this scene, he was livid.
Jace had always regarded Yvette as his woman. It was only a matter of time before she got together with him.
But now, Connor appeared out of nowhere. Jace couldn't accept his beloved woman being affectionate with another man.
Previously, Jace was just suppressing his anger, but now, he obviously couldn't control it anymore. He felt that if he didn't make a move, the two of them would probably get married in a few days' time.
Just as Jace was furious, the music stopped.
"Kiss, kiss...!"
"Kiss, kiss, kiss!"
Everyone began to shout loudly.
Yvette's felt a little awkward hearing what everyone was saying. Although she was fine with holding Connor's hand being a little intimate with him, she was still in a dilemma.
However, Yvette merely treated these actions as an act because it was very normal when acting.
However, if they were to kiss, that would be rather impossible.
After all, Yvette had never acted in a kissing scene before.
Connor was at a loss as well. After all, he was not a professional actor. Although he was pretending to be Yvette's boyfriend, it did not mean that he had no bottom line.

chapters.title: Chapter 1350: A Competition
chapters.content:
Chapter 1350: A Competition
However, the crowd of people surrounding them was already surrounding Connor and Yvette.
If the two of them did not kiss, they would definitely not let it go.
"All of you, get lost!"
Just as Connor and Yvette were at a loss for what to do, Jace finally couldn't hold it in any longer and shouted.
Everyone was stunned when they heard Jace's words, and the entire hall fell silent.
Everyone turned to look at Jace. They were filled with doubt and confusion. They didn't know what Jace wanted to do.
Jace took a deep breath and rushed directly to Connor. He shouted at Connor with an angry expression, "You sure are daring! How dare you steal my woman? You must really want to mess with me!"
Jace had been controlling his emotions before, but at this moment, he obviously couldn't control it any longer.
However, Jace did not make a move because he knew that if he did, he would be the one who would suffer.
"Jace, what are you doing?"
Yvette hurriedly shouted at Jace.
Jace turned to look at Yvette and exclaimed, "Yvette, this has nothing to do with you. Don't worry about it…"
"What do you mean it has nothing to do with me? Besides, when did I become your woman?"
Yvette said angrily.
Connor also had a calm expression and asked indifferently, "Mr. Sackmann, what do you mean by your woman? Please help me understand."
"Don't play dumb with me. What exactly do you not understand? Everyone knows that I've been pursuing Yvette. She is my woman…"
Jace shouted.
After hearing Jace's words, Connor couldn't help but sneer, and then lightly said, "How interesting. You've taken a fancy to Yvette, so Yvette is your woman? If I fall for your mom, do you have to call me dad then?"
Everyone was stunned when they heard Connor's words. Anyone could tell that his words were a blatant provocation.
"What did you just say?"
Jace stared at Connor and asked.
"You should know very well what I said just now. Don't embarrass yourself here, do you hear me?"
Connor said with an expression.
"Kid, today is Kaitlyn's birthday. I don't want anything unpleasant to happen. Leave Yvette immediately. I can pretend that nothing happened. If you dare to continue pestering her, I won't hold back…"
Jace gritted his teeth and shouted at Connor.
"You won't hold back? What can you do to me?"
Connor asked Jace coldly.
"What can I do to you?"
Jace said expressionlessly.
"Jace Sackmann, what do you want? Me being with Connor has nothing to do with you."
Yvette's large, watery eyes widened as she shouted.
"Yvette, I said that this has nothing to do with you. Leave this to me. This guy is not worthy of you. I want him to leave…"
Jace whispered.
"Whether Connor is worthy of me or not has nothing to do with you. You're not anyone to me. I like Connor. I want to be with Connor, you understand me?"
Yvette said coldly.
"..."
Jace ignored Yvette and turned to look at Connor.
Seeing that the situation was turning ugly, Kaitlyn knew that something would definitely happen if it were to go on like this, so she tried to mediate the situation.
"Mr. Sackmann, it's my birthday today. Give me some face and stop arguing, okay?"
Kaitlyn knew that this was happening because Jace was looking for trouble, so she could only try to persuade Jace.
Furthermore, Connor had not done anything wrong from the beginning to the end. Hence, Kaitlyn could not possibly persuade Connor to break up with Yvette, right?
"That's right, Mr. Sackmann. Maybe you should take a step back…"
"Mr. Sackmann, it will be meaningless if you continue to cause trouble…"
Everyone knew what was going on today, so they could only persuade Jace to stop causing trouble.
Jace was still very angry after hearing everyone's words because he couldn't understand why these people weren't speaking up for him.
"All of you shut up. This is a grudge between me and this brat. If anyone steps forward and meddles in our business, don't blame me for being rude…"
Jace gritted his teeth and shouted at the crowd in a low voice.
When everyone heard Jace's words, they were all stunned. Their faces darkened, and no one dared to speak.
"Mr. Sackmann, if you continue to cause trouble like this, it will just make things worse…"
Kaitlyn looked at Jace and said.
Jace turned and looked at Kaitlyn. A trace of anger flashed in his eyes, as if he was very dissatisfied with Kaitlyn's words.
"Mr. Sackmann, it's Kaitlyn's birthday today. It's really not good to make a fuss like this. Why don't we do it according to the previous method?"
At this time, a man walked up to Jace and whispered to him.
When Jace heard the man's words, a strange look flashed across his eyes, and then he said with a smile, "You're right. Today is Kaitlyn's birthday. I don't want to create a scene. Let's do it according to the methods of the entertainment industry…"
The reason why Jace agreed so readily was not because he wanted to make peace, but because he knew that Connor was quite capable. If they really fought, then he would definitely suffer, so he planned to use other methods to deal with this matter.
"Kid, you don't have any problems with handling this matter according to the rules of the entertainment industry, right?"
Jace asked Connor provocatively.
Connor was confused when he heard Jace's words. He frowned and asked, "What are the rules of the entertainment industry?"
"..."
Yvette hesitated for a moment before she strode over to Connor's side and said softly to him, "Usually, if there is any conflict between us, we will choose to have a competition to resolve the problem…"
"What competition?"
Connor still did not understand what Yvette meant.
"The topic of the competition is randomly selected. After all, everyone is an artist. If they really fight, it won't look good. So, it is better to use this method. If anyone wins, they can make a request. The loser must agree to it…"
Yvette said softly to Connor.

chapters.title: Chapter 1351: The Biggest Weakness
chapters.content:
Chapter 1351: The Biggest Weakness
"That's quite interesting…"
Connor said with a smile.
"Since Jace is proposing this method, it means that he must have prepared in advance. It's better if you don't go along with it..."
Yvette reminded softly.
"First of all, I'm not from the entertainment industry. Secondly, if I lose, I definitely won't agree to his request. If that's the case, won't he be even angrier and might even attack me?"
Connor said with a smile.
"But..."
After hearing Connor's words, a hint of helplessness flashed across Yvette's eyes. She did not know what to say.
"Alright, I agree with your method…"
Connor said calmly.
Seeing that Connor had agreed to it, they were all stunned. They were very puzzled. They didn't understand why Connor would agree to Jace's proposal.
In the competition, Jace could choose to let others help him compete.
Jace had been in the entertainment circle for so many years. He has very terrifying connections, so it was absolutely impossible for Jace to lose such a competition. If Connor agreed now, he would be courting death.
"Connor, are you sure you want to do this?"
Kaitlyn seemed to be reminding Connor as she asked him softly.
"That's right. Since you have such a rule, we'll just follow your rules…"
Connor said calmly.
"Then, I will go and make some preparations…"
Kaitlyn replied helplessly, then turned around and left.
At this moment, everyone seemed to be looking at Connor with a helpless gaze. In their eyes, Connor agreeing now was simply asking for humiliation.
"Connor, you really shouldn't have agreed to Jace. He definitely won't compete with you personally, so no matter what, you will lose in the end…"
Yvette said helplessly to Connor.
Upon hearing Yvette's words, Connor smiled faintly and said softly, "What do you think Jace will ask for if he wins?"
"He will definitely ask you to leave me!"
Yvette answered without hesitation.
"But the two of us are not together, so even if I lose, it won't be a loss to us, right?"
Connor said with a smile.
"..."
Yvette stared at Connor, stunned.
"Moreover, even if I lose, I will not agree to his request. Then, he will definitely be even angrier. He might even attack me…"
Connor paused for a moment and then continued, "And if I win, I can beat him up openly. I'll have completed my mission, right?"
"It is impossible for you to win. But the method you have proposed is pretty good. Even if we lose, we will not lose anything…"
Yvette said with a smile.
A moment later, Kaitlyn finally prepared the contents of the competition. Because the contents of the competition were all prepared by Kaitlyn, it was considered fair.
Jace didn't care about these things at all, because no matter what the competition was, he would definitely win.
"Mr. Sackmann and Mr. McDonald, who will be the one drawing lots?"
Kaitlyn asked softly.
"He can do it…"
Jace said lightly.
When Connor heard this, he shrugged and walked to Kaitlyn. He then casually picked up a piece of paper.
When the note was opened up, everyone was stunned.
Because the content written on the note was actually the piano!
When Jace saw the word piano, he looked a little smug. There was a piano expert among these people, and this person had a very good relationship with Jace, so he would definitely let this person compete for him.
Sure enough, Jace walked up to the young man who played the piano and said a few simple words.
"I don't know how to play the piano. So, Evan will compete in my place!"
Jace said with a smile.
"Alright…"
Kaitlyn nodded helplessly and asked Connor, "Mr. McDonald, do you plan to compete personally or let someone else compete in your place?"
"I'll do it myself!"
Connor replied indifferently.
After all, Connor's piano level was not something that ordinary people could compare to, so he naturally would not choose to let others replace him.
Although Connor said that he didn't care about winning or losing this competition, since the piano was chosen, Connor wanted to win.
The reason was very simple. If Connor really won, then he could openly attack Jace without any reason.
"..."
When Kaitlyn heard Connor's words, a trace of confusion flashed across her eyes. However, she did not say anything because she felt that Connor might have already given up on himself.
"Then, who will go first?"
Kaitlyn asked softly.
"I'll go first!"
Evan Wiggins said expressionlessly.
"Alright…"
Kaitlyn nodded.
Evan turned and looked at Jace. Jace had promised him that as long as he won today, he would give him 20 million dollars. This amount of money was not a small sum for an actor like Evan who was not very famous. Therefore, Evan was very concerned about this competition. Moreover, he knew that Yvette had a fatal weakness.
Not long after, a very beautiful piano sound slowly sounded.
When everyone heard the piano piece, they were all stunned, and they were in disbelief.
Even Yvette was stunned, and her face darkened.
"Why is Evan so despicable? Isn't this rubbing salt on someone's wound?"
Kaitlyn exclaimed.
When Connor heard Kaitlyn's words, a trace of confusion flashed across his eyes. He could not help but ask softly, "What's wrong?"
"This song is Yvette's biggest weakness. Evan is obviously doing it on purpose…"
Kaitlyn said angrily.
"Her biggest weakness? What do you mean by that? How is this song Yvette's weakness?"
The more Connor listened, the more he felt that something was wrong. He frowned and asked in confusion.
"Looks like you really don't know what's going on…"
Kaitlyn took a deep breath and said coldly, "Do you know the name of this song?"
"I don't…"
Connor looked at Kaitlyn and shook his head gently.
"This song is called 'Yvette'!'"
Kaitlyn replied.

chapters.title: Chapter 1352: Definitely Lose?
chapters.content:
Chapter 1352: Definitely Lose?
"Yvette?"
When Connor heard this, he couldn't help but be stunned for a moment. Then, he said in a low voice, "Does this song have something to do with Yvette?"
"That's right. At that time, there was a guy in our class who had been pursuing Yvette. Yvette didn't really like him at first, but as she got to know him, she became a little interested in him. Although she didn't admit it, I could feel it. Later on, that guy even specially created this piano piece for Yvette and even confessed to her…"
Kaitlyn said to Connor very seriously.
"And then?"
Connor frowned and asked.
"However, Yvette was still unsure of her feelings for him, so she didn't accept him. That guy was later killed in a car accident while trying to save Yvette. This incident has always been a knot in Yvette's heart. Although very few outsiders know about this, everyone in our class knows about it…"
Kaitlyn said anxiously.
"I see!"
Connor nodded thoughtfully.
"Since Evan chose this song, Yvette will definitely vote for Evan later because this song is the most perfect song in Yvette's heart. The others will naturally choose to vote for Evan. After all, if even Yvette is not on your side, no one will be on your side. Therefore, you will definitely lose today…"
Kaitlyn said very seriously.
"Definitely lose?"
Connor couldn't help but smile when he heard this. He then said softly, "If it's some other competition, I might lose, but I won't lose when it comes to the piano."
Kaitlyn looked at Connor with a hint of confusion in her eyes because she could not understand where Connor's confidence came from.
Connor didn't continue talking to Kaitlyn, but listened quietly.
It had to be said that this piano piece was indeed well written. Connor could clearly feel the guy's love for Yvette.
Almost in an instant, everyone present fell into silence. No one made a sound at all, and they all listened quietly.
After an unknown period of time, the music finally began to end.
Yvette stood there expressionlessly. Her expression was a little dull as she looked at Evan. No one knew what she was thinking.
Jace looked at Yvette with a hint of pride in his eyes.
Jace naturally knew what this song meant to Yvette. He was even more aware of the relationship between Yvette and that guy. Yvette had rejected him all these years because of this guy. However, Jace never expected Yvette to choose another guy.
Evan did not want to choose this song, but Jace insisted on it. His goal was very simple. This song would not only remind Yvette of that guy, but it would also ensure his victory.
However, Jace did not expect that Yvette was actually not together with Connor. She did not have any feelings for Connor either. All of this was just an act.
"Connor, it's your turn now…"
Jace said proudly to Connor.
Connor smiled faintly after hearing Jace's words. He then strode toward Yvette and whispered to her, "Although some people have left you, they have actually become angels, protecting you from the heavens…"
"..."
Yvette looked at Connor without saying a word.
After taking a deep breath, Connor walked to the front of the piano and placed his hands on the keys.
When everyone saw Connor sitting in front of the piano, they could clearly feel that Connor's aura had changed. This change was the kind that could be seen with the naked eye.
"This person doesn't seem to be an ordinary person!"
Evan could not help but sigh.
Connor began to recall the bits and pieces of his experience with his mother in his mind. That time could be considered the happiest period of time for Connor.
A moment later, a soothing piano sound rang out.
When everyone heard this song, their eyes widened. They were very puzzled because none of them had heard this song before.
"What song is this?"
"Yeah, I don't think I've ever heard of it!"
"Did Connor compose this song himself?"
"I didn't expect Connor to actually write his own songs."
Everyone began to discuss in low voices.
"Shush all of you…"
Yvette frowned and berated.
Upon hearing Yvette's words, everyone shut their mouths obediently and listened quietly.
Although Connor's piano piece was not amazing, it was very beautiful. It could bring people's emotions into it, as if it was telling a story.
In the beginning, the crowd didn't think that Connor's song was very nice, but as time passed, everyone was immersed in the music.
Perhaps this was the greatest charm of piano music. It could easily stir up your emotions.
Yvette closed her eyes and listened quietly to Connor's piece. She could feel that the tune was extremely gentle, so gentle that it could gradually calm one's emotions.
Furthermore, Yvette knew that the song described a son's longing for his mother. The longing was so strong that it made one burst into tears.
As time passed, everyone present seemed to be immersed in the beautiful sound of the piano. Everyone's emotions changed according to the changes of the piano.
Because this song revealed an extremely strong sense of longing, and everyone present had someone they missed, this emotion was very easy to mobilize.
Evan stared at Connor. He was in utter shock. He did not expect Connor's piano skills to be so terrifying. Moreover, Connor's piece was amazing.
Yvette closed her eyes tightly as tears flowed uncontrollably.
After some time, the piano music finally stopped.
However, everyone present was still immersed in Connor's pleasant piano piece. The scene was abnormally quiet.
Jace was sitting on the sofa with a very puzzled expression on his face. He really couldn't understand why everyone had such a reaction right now. Moreover, he didn't hear anything special about Connor's piece just now.
"Mom, I miss you…"
Connor slowly opened his eyes and let out a long sigh.
This song was composed by Connor himself. Moreover, this song was all about his longing for his mother over the years. However, Connor had never played this song in front of anyone. This was the first time Connor had played this song.

chapters.title: Chapter 1353: Voting
chapters.content:
Chapter 1353: Voting
"What is the name of this piece?"
Yvette walked up to Connor and asked him softly.
"Yearning!"
Connor lightly replied.
"I like it a lot. After listening to your song, I feel that my mood has improved a lot…"
Yvette said to Connor in a serious tone.
Upon hearing Yvette's words, Connor smiled faintly and said softly, "Actually, all of us have someone we miss, and each of us will have regrets in our hearts. However, we can't just live in regret. We still have to move on, don't you think so?"
"Yes…"
Yvette nodded gently.
"As long as this song can make you feel better…"
Connor looked at Yvette and smiled faintly.
Just as Connor and Yvette were chatting, the others present seemed to have recovered from their stupor.
Kaitlyn took a deep breath, then took a step forward and said softly to everyone, "Now that Connor and Evan have finished playing the piano, everyone can place their votes…"
After hearing Kaitlyn's words, everyone turned to look at Jace.
Jace's face was unsightly, as if he was threatening everyone present.
At this moment, everyone knew that Connor's song was more pleasant to the ears and more attractive than Evan's.
However, because of Jace's existence, no one dared to say what they were thinking.
"I think that Connor's song is better…"
At this moment, Yvette spoke up.
When everyone heard Yvette's words, they were all stunned. They turned to look at Yvette with extremely shocked expressions.
This was because they all thought that Yvette would definitely choose Evan. However, no one expected Yvette to choose Connor.
Yvette's reason for choosing Connor was very simple. She felt that Connor's words were accurate. Everyone had their own regrets, but they could not always live in regret. They still had to look forward in life.
To Yvette, this was the beginning of a new step.
"How about the rest of you?"
Kaitlyn looked at the others and asked.
A few girls who were close to Yvette also stood up to vote for Connor.
Most of the remaining people seemed to be planning to forfeit their votes. They did not choose Connor, but they did not choose Evan either.
The outcome of this match had already been decided. Everyone just didn't dare to make a choice because of Jace.
"What are you all doing? You can vote now. Hurry up and vote!"
Jace's eyes widened as he shouted angrily.
After everyone heard Jace's words, there was still no reaction. No one knew what to do!
"There's no need to vote anymore!"
However, at this moment, Evan suddenly spoke.
"What do you mean?"
Jace asked in confusion.
Evan took a deep breath and walked to Connor. He said softly to Connor, "Mr. McDonald, your piece was very beautiful. I admit defeat!"
"Evan, are you crazy? Who told you to admit defeat? Is there something wrong with your brain?"
Jace went crazy when he heard Evan's words. He yelled angrily.
"Mr. Sackmann, so many people here can tell that my song is inferior to Mr. McDonald's song. They just don't dare to tell the truth. So, I don't want to continue embarrassing myself. I might as well admit defeat…"
Evan said seriously.
"Do you think you can admit defeat just because you said so?"
Jace gritted his teeth and shouted angrily.
"If you don't want me to admit defeat, then let's start voting. I'll vote for Mr. McDonald…"
After Evan said that, he turned around and walked out of the private room.
Jace stood there foolishly, his face dark and unsightly.
"Mr. Sackmann, do you think there's a need to vote?"
Kaitlyn asked Jace softly.
"..."
Jace hesitated for a couple of seconds, then took a deep breath and whispered, "Alright, since Evan admitted that he lost, I have nothing to say. I admit defeat…"
When everyone heard Jace's words, they all turned to look at Connor, because no one expected Connor to win.
No one expected that Jace would still lose to Connor even though Evan had helped him.
Jace did not expect such a situation. However, Evan had already admitted defeat. If Jace did not admit that he had lost, it would be way too shameless. Jace did not intend to go overboard.
Kaitlyn turned and looked at Connor. Then, she whispered to Connor, "Mr. McDonald, according to our previous rules, you've won the competition, so you can make a request to Mr. Sackmann now. As long as it's a doable request, Mr. Sackmann must agree to it."
When everyone heard Kaitlyn's words, they realized that the competition just now was not as simple as winning or losing. Connor could also make a request to Jace, and as long as this request was within the doable range, then Jace had no reason to refuse.
At this time, Jace was obviously shooting himself in the foot. He was the one who proposed the competition, and now he was the one who lost.
At this moment, the way everyone looked at Connor seemed to have changed again. Previously, these people thought that Connor was just a young master from a big family and that his background was not simple. However, after he finished playing the piano, everyone felt that Connor's attainments in the piano were extraordinary. This meant that Connor was definitely not an ordinary person.
"I did not expect Connor to be able to defeat Evan…"
"Yeah, who is this Connor? Why is he able to play the piano so well?"
"Connor is definitely not someone simple. Otherwise, Yvette wouldn't have gotten together with him…"
"That's right…"
Everyone began to discuss in low voices.
Some of the female celebrities looked at Connor with even stranger eyes, as if they were regretting that they had not found a boyfriend like Connor.
When Connor heard Kaitlyn's words, he couldn't help but hesitate for a moment. Then, he said softly, "Miss Zoer, according to what you said just now, does that mean that Mr. Sackmann has to agree to any request I raise now?"

chapters.title: Chapter 1354: Are You Crazy?
chapters.content:
Chapter 1354: Are You Crazy?
"That's right. As long as it's not against the law, the other party must agree to it!"
Kaitlyn nodded gently, then subconsciously looked at Jace and said softly, "Mr. Sackmann, that's how it works, right? This seems to be the rule in our circle."
Jace turned and looked at Kaitlyn with a somewhat angry expression on his face. However, there were so many people watching. If Jace didn't admit it, then he wouldn't be able to survive in the entertainment industry in the future, so he could only choose to tacitly agree to what Kaitlyn had just said.
"That's interesting. Any request, huh…"
Connor smiled faintly, then walked up to Jace. He looked at Jace up and down, then said softly, "Mr. Sackmann, you didn't expect me to win this time, did you?"
"Why you..."
Jace looked at Connor with a trace of anger in his eyes. At this time, he was already clenching his fists, as if he would attack Connor at any time.
However, Jace was very clear that he couldn't make a move on Connor now because this was Heavens Club. If he made a move, the people of Heavens Club would never let him go. Moreover, Connor was no simple person. If he fought with Connor, he would not win, so Jace finally chose to endure it.
At this time, Jace already had other ideas in his mind. He was ready to make Connor disappear so that he could remove the problem once and for all.
"That's right. I did not expect you to win today. It's all Evan's fault. If not for him, I would not have lost today…"
Jace adjusted his emotions, then frowned and said, "But don't worry. I am a person who takes his loses. What are your conditions? Just tell me. Don't waste everyone's time..."
"Mr. Sackmann, why are you in such a hurry?"
Connor looked at Jace with a faint smile and then said softly, "From what you said just now, you like Yvette, right?"
"That's right. I like Yvette. Everyone here should be aware of this. I've liked Yvette for a long time…"
Jace replied with a blank face. Then, a strange look flashed in his eyes. He frowned and asked, "You're not planning to make me leave Yvette, are you?"
"..."
Connor looked at Jace without saying anything.
"Connor, I won't leave Yvette. I really like Yvette, so you can't make such a request of me. Even if you did, I would never agree to it…"
Jace exclaimed.
Connor looked at Jace with a faint smile and then said softly, "Mr. Sackmann, you might be overthinking things!"
"Am I?"
Jace couldn't help but be stunned when he heard Connor's words.
"It has never been my intention for you to give up on Yvette…"
Connor smiled disdainfully.
Yvette subconsciously turned to look at Connor. She was a little puzzled, as if she did not quite understand what Connor meant by that.
"Yvette is my girlfriend. I know her very well. She would never do anything to let me down. Even if she doesn't like me anymore and decides to break up with me one day, she will never fall for someone like you. So, whether you give up or not, the outcome will be the same…"
Connor looked at Jace and said calmly.
When Jace heard Connor's words, he was instantly dumbfounded, and his face darkened.
No one was a fool. Almost everyone present could hear that Connor was obviously deliberately humiliating Jace.
Jace was so angry that he was trembling, but at this moment, he couldn't find any excuse to refute Connor.
It was not easy for Jace to woo Yvette.
Whenever Jace took a fancy to a woman, he would often use the simplest method, which was to use money. If it was a woman in the entertainment industry, he would choose to throw resources. This method was very simple, but it was also very practical.
After all, if it were any other ordinary woman, she would not be able to resist the temptation of money. Whether it was clothes, jewelry, or bags, they were all fatal temptations to ordinary girls.
As for the women in the entertainment industry, even though they did not lack money, they lacked resources!
As long as Jace could provide them with resources that they couldn't resist, they would be willing to be mistresses.
However, these things were not attractive to Yvette at all. This was because Yvette did not lack money or resources. Therefore, Jace could not offer anything that could move Yvette.
Plus, everyone knew what kind of person Jace was.
Therefore, under normal circumstances, Yvette would never be with someone like Jace.
Everyone knew this, but they didn't expect Connor to dare to say it out loud. This was obviously to offend Jace.
Jace stood there expressionlessly. There was nothing but anger on his face.
He had never seen such an arrogant person like Connor in his entire life. He could no longer bear it anymore.
"Connor, stop talking nonsense. What do you want?"
Jace gritted his teeth and shouted at Connor.
"That's right, Mr. McDonald. What request do you have?"
Kaitlyn also didn't want Connor to continue causing trouble. After all, if he continued to cause trouble, it wouldn't be good for anyone. Moreover, if he really angered Jace, who knew what Jace would do?
Connor turned and looked at Kaitlyn. He was more or less disappointed because he didn't expect Jace to be able to endure such humiliation.
"How about this? Actually, I don't lack anything. I remember you said that I'm not worthy of Yvette. Why not you shout three times in front of everyone 'I'm not worthy of Yvette Wendell. I, Jace Sackmann, am not worthy of Yvette!'"
Connor paused for a moment, then asked Jace provocatively, "Mr. Sackmann, this shouldn't be difficult, right?"
"Are you crazy?"
Jace shouted.
Everyone looked at Connor, and they were also very puzzled.
Because they didn't expect Connor to make such an excessive request. Wasn't it obvious that he wanted Jace to embarrass himself?

chapters.title: Chapter 1355: The Second Option
chapters.content:
Chapter 1355: The Second Option
"Mr. Sackmann, do you refuse to do it?"
Connor asked with a smile.
"Of course!"
Jace shouted without thinking.
"Haha..."
Connor seemed to have expected that Jace would not agree, so he continued, "It doesn't matter if you refuse to do it. I can give you a second option!"
"What option?"
Jace asked Connor.
"It's very simple. All you have to do is give me some money!"
Connor said lightly.
"Money?"
When everyone heard Connor's words, they seemed somewhat puzzled.
Because they all felt that people like Connor did not lack money, so it was rather odd that he was asking Jace for money.
"So, you want money from me?"
Jace looked at Connor and smiled. After all, in his eyes, as long as it could be solved with money, it was not a problem.
"Connor, how much do you want? Just tell me!"
Jace asked Connor confidently.
Connor hesitated for a moment, then slowly extended five fingers.
"You want five million, right?"
Jace seemed to be a little disdainful. Then he took out his mobile phone and said lightly, "I'll get someone to transfer the money to you now…"
"Not five million…"
Connor shook his head.
"You want 50 million?"
Jace was stunned for a moment.
Five million wasn't a lot of money for him, but if it was fifty million, he might have to consider it carefully. After all, fifty million wasn't a small amount for everyone here.
"If it's only 50 million, do I need to ask you for it?"
But at this moment, Connor spoke again.
Jace suddenly looked at Connor, and then asked in disbelief, "Are you planning to ask for 500 million?"
"You are indeed a smart person. I want 500 million!"
Connor nodded his head and continued, "Mr. Sackmann, for a rich person like you, this amount is nothing to you, right?"
Everyone looked at Connor in disbelief.
After all, 500 million was way too terrifying for them.
Although these people were all actors, not all actors were very rich. Their assets might only be a few hundred million at most. It was impossible for them to suddenly take out 500 million.
Jace couldn't afford that much money.
"Connor, that's too much. I do need to agree to one request of yours, but it doesn't mean that I need to do anything you request of me. You're asking for 500 million which is a big sum. Why should I give it to you?"
Jace shouted at Connor.
"That's right, Mr. McDonald. 500 million is a little too much…"
Kaitlyn also said to Connor.
Connor smiled faintly when he heard Kaitlyn's words. Then, he said with a playful expression, "Of course I know that 500 million is not a small amount, but didn't I give Mr. Sackmann two options? If he can't take out 500 million, he can just shout three times what I've requested. If he can save 500 million with three sentences, isn't that very worth it?"
Kaitlyn looked at Connor with a helpless expression on her face. She knew very well that Connor was deliberately humiliating Jace.
Jace looked at Connor up and down, then gritted his teeth and asked Connor in a low voice, "What if I refuse to choose either option?"
"If you don't choose either of them, you might not be able to leave this private room today…"
Connor said calmly.
"You dare to hit me?"
Jace was stunned for a moment and asked in surprise.
"You can give it a try and see if I dare."
Connor said coldly.
Jace looked at Connor expressionlessly. He could feel that Connor had never respected him from the very beginning. Moreover, Connor was very arrogant, so it meant that he definitely was not someone simple. Connor might really attack him.
As the saying goes, there is hope as long as there is life.
At this time, if Jace continued to quarrel with Connor, he would definitely be the one who suffered.
However, if Jace was asked to take out 500 million dollars, he really couldn't.
"Alright…"
Jace looked at Connor and took a deep breath. Then he gritted his teeth and shouted, "I'm not worthy of Yvette Wendell. I, Jace Sackmann, am not worthy of Yvette!"
When everyone heard Jace's words, they were instantly dumbfounded. They were extremely shocked.
No one had expected that Jace, who had always been arrogant and despotic, would end up like this.
If this matter were to spread out, no one would believe it at all.
