Even Yvette's big, watery eyes widened in disbelief. She felt that a person like Jace would not have said something that!
"Your voice is too soft…"
However, at this time, Connor looked at Jace and said.
Jace suddenly looked at Connor. After taking a deep breath, he shouted, "I'm not worthy of Yvette Wendell. I, Jace Sackmann, am not worthy of Yvette!"
"This volume is fine, but you don't sound very happy. Put some joy into it…"
Connor said with a smile.
Everyone looked at Connor speechlessly.
It was already a great humiliation for Jace to shout this sentence, yet Connor was being so ruthless. He even wanted Jace to shout the sentence happily. How could Jace be happy at this time?
"Connor McDonald, aren't you going too far?"
Jace glared at him and asked through gritted teeth.
"Mr. McDonald, that's enough…"
Kaitlyn hurriedly said.
Meanwhile, Connor turned to look at Yvette, seemingly asking for her opinion.
Yvette felt that Connor had already helped her vent her anger today and Jace would probably not pester her in the future. Therefore, she had achieved her goal, so there was no need to continue making a fuss. After all, if she continued to make a fuss, it would not be good for anyone.
Hence, Yvette nodded at Connor gently, indicating that he should stop here.
Connor glanced at Jace and said with a smile, "Alright then, that's it!"
"Phew…"
After Jace heard Connor's words, he also heaved a long sigh of relief. Then, he whispered,"You guys go ahead. I'm going to the bathroom…"
After saying this, Jace turned around and walked out of the private room.

chapters.title: Chapter 1356: Making Trouble
chapters.content:
Chapter 1356: Making Trouble
Everyone continued chatting as if nothing had happened.
However, at this time, these people's attitude toward Connor had changed greatly because they felt that he had offended Jace today, so Jace would not let Connor off easily. If they were to get close to Connor now, they might be implicated by him, so it was better to stay away from him.
Yvette was naturally very satisfied with Connor's actions just now. However, she was also a little worried. Hence, she walked to Connor and whispered to him, "Connor, you might have to be careful. I know Jace very well. You've utterly humiliated him, so he will definitely not let it go..."
"What can he do to me?"
Connor smiled faintly.
"What else? He might even find an assassin to deal with you. Once a person like Jace goes crazy, he can do anything. Let me tell you..."
Yvette said to Connor.
"Don't worry. Even if he finds an assassin, he can't do anything to me…"
Connor said lightly.
"How can you be so good at bragging? Those assassins all have guns…"
Yvette looked at Connor's nonchalant expression and said softly to him with a helpless expression.
"So what if they have guns?"
Connor sneered and continued, "Alright, let's not talk about this anymore. What do you think of my performance today?"
"Your performance today was pretty good. You played the piano well too…"
Yvette said after thinking for a moment.
"Since you think my performance is pretty good, can you attend my opening ceremony?"
Connor asked excitedly.
"I still have to consider that…"
Yvette said with a smile.
"I've already offended so many people for you. What else is there to consider? Are you even human?"
Connor looked at Yvette and shouted exasperatedly.
"I just need to consider it…"
Yvette pouted.
Connor looked at Yvette's helpless expression and did not know what to say.
On the other side, Jace went straight to the bathroom after leaving the private room.
"Connor, just you f*cking wait. If I don't kill you today, I'm not Jace Sackmann!"
Jace cursed in a low voice, then took out his mobile phone and dialed a number.
Ring, ring, ring…
After a few rings, the other party picked up the call.
"Mr. Sackmann, how can I help you?"
The other party asked softly.
"Dune, I need you to help me find a few assassins. I want to kill someone…
Jace whispered.
"Kill someone?"
Dune was stunned when he heard this.
Dune was a well-known big brother in Newtown. He had many underlings and naturally had a good relationship with Jace. In the past few years, he had helped Jace deal with some shameful things.
However, in most cases, Jace would ask Dune's men to beat someone up. It was already the limit for him to beat someone up and make them a cripple. He had never killed anyone before.
"That's right, I want to kill someone!"
Jace replied with a ferocious expression, then continued, "This person's background is not simple. Find a few reliable people for me…"
"..."
Dune hesitated for a moment, then said in a low voice, "Mr. Sackmann, if you want me to help you beat someone up, that's fine, but I have no experience in killing people. Is there a need to do this?"
"Don't ask so many questions. I must kill this person today. If you don't dare to do it, then help me contact an assassin."
Jace took a deep breath and shouted in a low voice.
"Mr. Sackmann, are you sure you want to get an assassin?"
Dune hesitated for a moment before asking.
"You don't f*cking understand human language, do you? Why are you talking so much nonsense?"
Jace shouted impatiently.
"Alright, Mr. Sackmann, I'll help you contact them now. As for the price, you can discuss it with the other party yourself. What do you think about that?"
Dune said softly.
"Alright…"
Jace replied in a low voice and then hung up the phone.
"Connor, just you wait. I will kill you today…"
Jace looked at his phone, his eyes filled with unrestrained anger.
At this moment, he was really forced into a corner by Connor.
Half an hour later.
Everyone felt that it was getting late, so they decided to go back.
After Kaitlyn exchanged a few simple greetings with everyone, she left the private room with them.
"Why isn't Mr. Sackmann back yet?"
However, at this moment, a young man shouted in confusion.
"Mr. Sackmann is not in a good mood today, so he must have left early!"
a female celebrity said softly.
"That's true. Mr. Sackmann must have left first. Let's go too!"
Everyone put on their sunglasses and hats as they were talking and were prepared to leave Heavens Club.
Connor and Yvette naturally followed the crowd out of the private room.
However, not long after they walked out of the private room, they saw a group of people in front of them. Something must have happened.
"What's going on in front?"
Kaitlyn said with a frown.
"It seems like someone is causing trouble…"
"Who is so bold to actually dare to cause trouble here…"
"Something's not right. Why is Mr. Sackmann standing there?"
Everyone soon discovered that Jace was involved in the conflict.
In front of Jace stood a young man. The young man seemed to be about the same age as Connor. At this time, he was wrestling with Jace, and he seemed rather riled up.
"Let's go over and take a look…"
Kaitlyn said with a frown and then walked over.
Everyone followed behind Kaitlyn.
If it wasn't because Jace was having a conflict with someone, Kaitlyn and the others would definitely not go over. However, since this matter was related to Jace, they had to go and take a look.
This was Connor's territory, so he naturally wanted to see who was so bold!
Connor looked at the young man who was fighting with Jace. He had a puzzled expression on his face.
Connor felt that this young man looked familiar, but he couldn't remember who he was.
Connor didn't know that this youth was called Wynn Thompson, Salma Thompson's cousin.

chapters.title: Chapter 1357: Punish Someone as a Warning to Another
chapters.content:
Chapter 1357: Punish Someone as a Warning to Another
Previously, Connor and Wynn had met at the Thompson Family's place, but at that time, Salma did not introduce Wynn to Connor.
The two of them had only met once, so Connor felt that Wynn was somewhat familiar, but he could not remember who this young man was.
Wynn was originally in a particularly happy mood today because he had confessed to the goddess he had been pursuing for many years, and the goddess had finally accepted Wynn.
In order to celebrate, Wynn borrowed Heavens Club's membership card from Salma and brought his friends and his girlfriend's best friend to celebrate.
Wynn's status in the Thompson Family could not be compared to Salma's. However, Wynn's relationship with Salma was very good. In Salma's eyes, Wynn was her biological younger brother.
In addition, there had always been some scandals between Salma and Connor, the boss of Heavens Club. Therefore, when the staff of Heavens Club knew that Wynn was using Salma's membership card, they naturally treated Wynn very respectfully. This also made Wynn very proud in front of his goddess. He even told others that the boss of Heavens Club was his future brother-in-law.
However, just as Wynn was having fun with his friends, his girlfriend was knocked down by a man. Not only did the man not apologize, but he also scolded his girlfriend for being blind.
Wynn couldn't stand it anymore. He went and slapped the man in the face. Then, this scene ensued.
In fact, although Wynn was a rich second-generation heir, he usually kept a very low profile. Moreover, he did not want to cause trouble in a place like Heavens Club.
However, things were different now. Thinking that the boss of the Heavens Club was his future brother-in-law, he felt that even if he beat someone up in Heavens Club, it shouldn't be a big problem to ask his sister for help.
After all, the boss of Heavens Club wouldn't do anything to him for his sister's sake.
The person who had just been slapped was none other than Jace.
At this time, Jace was also in a terrible mood. After all, he had suffered such humiliation in the hands of Connor. After he went out and made the phone call, he had been thinking about how to deal with Connor, so he was not paying attention to where he was walking. He accidentally bumped into a woman.
Normally, Jace would take the initiative to apologize. After all, he was also a public figure.
However, Jace was in a bad mood today, so he scolded the girl instead.
However, it was because of this that Wynn was angered.
Before Jace could react, Wynn directly went and slapped Jace in the face.
Jace had suffered a loss at Connor's hands, and he was slapped the moment he stepped out of the room. His mood went from bad to worse. He didn't even understand what was wrong with him today. Why was he so unlucky?
After Jace was slapped by Wynn, he naturally wouldn't let it go, so he didn't consider anything else and fought with Wynn.
Although Wynn was young, he had learned Taekwondo before, so it was not a problem for him to deal with Jace.
On the other hand, Jace's physical fitness was quite good because he often went to the gym to exercise. When the two of them were fighting, it was difficult to see who was better. Moreover, they were basically in a state of punching each other.
It was rare to see people fighting in a place like Heavens Club. After all, no matter who it was, they were very afraid of the power behind the boss of Heavens Club.
Therefore, when Jace and Wynn were fighting, many customers came out to watch the show.
Of course, most of them were just watching the show. No one was meddling at all.
They knew that the people from Heavens Club would come soon. By then, the two of them would not have a good ending.
"Now that Heavens Club has just changed its boss, these two people actually dare to cause trouble here."
"Yeah, I heard that the new boss of Heavens Club is not someone that should be trifled with either!"
"I reckon that they punish these two as a warning to everyone else…"
Everyone watched the commotion and discussed in low voices.
"These people are causing trouble in your place. Aren't you going to take care of them?"
Yvette turned to look at Connor and asked softly.
"Why? Someone is helping you beat up Jace. Isn't that good? It's a free show for us…"
Connor said lightly.
"..."
Yvette looked at Connor and smiled without saying a word.
Thud... Thud...
However, at this moment, a series of hurried footsteps could be heard.
Everyone turned and saw more than a dozen security guards rushing toward Jace and Wynn.
"Stop, what are you doing?"
The leader of the security guards shouted angrily.
Everyone turned to look at the security guard after hearing what the security captain said.
"Do the two of you know what this place is? This is Heavens Club. Get out of here immediately. If you have any conflicts, resolve them outside. Don't disturb others in the club!"
The security captain was very rude. This was the style of Heavens Club. Even though the boss had changed, he was still so arrogant.
After hearing the security captain's words, Jace realized that this was Heavens Club. He also wanted to deal with Connor today, so he didn't want to waste time with Wynn. He instinctively stopped what he was doing.
However, Wynn had no intention of stopping because of his relationship with Salma. Instead, he went and punched Jace in the head.
Jace fell to the ground with a thud and struggled to stand up.
"Apologize to my girlfriend right now, or else I won't let you off just like that!"
Wynn shouted at Jace arrogantly.
The security captain also stood in front of Wynn and shouted in a low voice, "Do you not understand what I just said? If there's any problem between the two of you, you can go out and resolve it on your own. If you dare to make a move again, do you believe that I'll break your legs and throw you out?"
When Wynn heard the security captain's words, a trace of disdain flashed across his eyes. Then, he looked at the security captain and asked, "Do you know who I am?"

chapters.title: Chapter 1358: Going Too Far!
chapters.content:
Chapter 1358: Going Too Far!
"I don't know who you are, but no matter who you are, you can't cause trouble here!"
The security captain said coldly.
"The owner of this club is my brother-in-law, and my sister is Salma Thompson!"
Wynn said with his eyes wide open.
When the security captain heard Wynn's words, a trace of shock flashed across his eyes. Then, he hurriedly asked, "Mr. McDonald is your brother-in-law?"
"Of course…"
Wynn said proudly.
The way the security captain looked at Wynn seemed to have changed because he knew that if Connor was really Wynn's brother-in-law, then what was happening might be a little troublesome. After all, he was the boss's relative, and he, the small security captain, didn't dare to stop him!
Everyone was shocked. After all, they never expected Wynn to have such a background. They finally understood why Wynn was so bold to cause trouble here.
Connor stood in the crowd, feeling unusually helpless.
First of all, Connor did not know Wynn at all. Moreover, even if he did, he was not Wynn's brother-in-law!
Of course, Connor also knew that if Wynn was really Salma's cousin, then Connor really had to give Wynn face today. After all, Connor had just asked for Salma's help a few days ago. If he were to deal with her cousin now, it would really be a little unreasonable.
"I didn't expect this person to actually have connections with you…"
Yvette said softly to Connor.
"What kind of connection does he have with me? I don't know this person at all, but I'm friends with his cousin. He's just using my relationship with his cousin to show off!"
Connor turned to look at Yvette and explained helplessly.
"I see!"
Yvette smiled faintly and did not say anything.
"But this kid is quite lucky. If he had a conflict with others, I might not let him go, but since he has a conflict with Jace, then I can turn a blind eye. I was still worried that I wouldn't have a chance to deal with Jace, and now someone is helping me!"
Connor continued.
At this time, Jace looked at Wynn, and the expression on his face began to change. He was very clear about how terrifying the strength of the boss behind Heavens Club was. If this young man was really the brother-in-law of the boss of Heavens Club, then he might be in big trouble, so Jace didn't know what to do for a moment.
Jace now blamed everything on Connor because he felt that if he had not met Connor, so many things would not have happened.
He was humiliated by Connor in the private room, and after leaving the private room, he offended the brother-in-law of the boss of Heavens Club. Today, Jace was unlucky.
On the other side, the security captain was a little worried about Wynn's identity, so he didn't dare to act rashly now. He could only get someone to inform Vanessa Canfield and let her deal with this matter personally.
When Wynn saw that the security captain did not respond, he seemed to become even more arrogant. He walked to Jace and shouted at Jace, "I'll give you a chance now. Apologize to my girlfriend immediately. Otherwise, don't even think about walking out of here today…"
"Do you know who I am?"
Jace was naturally unwilling to apologize to Wynn in front of so many people, so he gritted his teeth and replied.
"Of course, I f*cking know who you are. Aren't you just an actor? What's so great about that? Let me tell you this, if you don't apologize today, not only will I break your legs, but I'll also get a reporter to write about today's incident and publish it. I'll see how you'll be able to survive in the entertainment industry in the future…"
Wynn shouted loudly,
Jace was dumbfounded when he heard Wynn's words.
Because at this time, he remembered that Wynn was not from the entertainment industry. If this matter gets published, Jace's life might be ruined.
"Don't go too far…"
Jace said expressionlessly.
"Stop talking nonsense with me. Are you going to apologize now or not?"
Wynn asked at the top of his voice.
When Jace heard Wynn's words, a trace of embarrassment flashed across his eyes. He didn't know what to do.
If he were to apologize, how would he survive in the entertainment industry in the future?
However, if he didn't apologize, the consequences would be very terrifying.
Therefore, at this time, Jace was obviously in a difficult position. If he had known that this would be the case, he would have apologized to Wynn's girlfriend after bumping into her. He wouldn't have waited until the matter had blown up to such an extent.
"Mr. Sackmann, these people are not people we can afford to offend. Why don't you apologize?"
At this moment, a female celebrity stepped forward and said softly.
She was worried that this matter would blow up and implicate her, so she looked a little nervous.
Jace couldn't help but turn to look at the female celebrity.
"That's right, Mr. Sackmann, you should apologize!"
"Isn't it just an apology? It's not a big deal. Anyway, you were the one in the wrong first…"
At this time, everyone gathered around Jace and persuaded him to apologize.
Jace took a deep breath and shouted at Wynn with a ferocious expression, "I'm sorry. You happy now?"
Everyone was relieved after hearing Jace's words. After all, if Jace insisted on not apologizing today, then this matter would definitely become more and more serious. At that time, it might not be good for all of them.
Fortunately, Jace ended up apologizing.
Everyone felt that as long as Jace apologized, then this matter would be settled.
"You call that a f*cking apology?"
However, Wynn did not seem to be very satisfied with Jace's apology. He shouted with his eyes wide open.
When Jace said sorry just now, he was already very unwilling, but he didn't expect Wynn to still be unwilling to forgive him.
"I've already apologized. What else do you want?"
Jace's eyes widened as he shouted angrily.
"Although you said sorry just now, I can feel that you aren't happy about it, so I've changed my mind now. You have to kneel down and apologize to me."
Wynn shouted arrogantly.

chapters.title: Chapter 1359: I've Always Been Here
chapters.content:
Chapter 1359: I've Always Been Here
When everyone heard Wynn's words, their eyes immediately widened, and they were dumbfounded.
No one expected Wynn to ask Jace to do something like that.
Wasn't he clearly trying to blow this matter up?
Jace also understood that him taking a step back just now made him look weak in Wynn's eyes, so Wynn became even more insatiable.
If Jace had known Wynn would react like that, he would not have apologized.
At this moment, many people present had already recognized Wynn. They knew in their hearts that Wynn was a member of the Thompson Family. Moreover, the Thompson family had been very close to the boss of Heavens Club recently, so Wynn could already be considered a top second-generation heir in Newtown. Otherwise, he wouldn't be so arrogant.
Everyone also knew that Jace was not an ordinary person. His family was also very powerful.
Therefore, things were quite interesting. Everyone wanted to see who would have the last laugh between these two young man.
Jace thought that as long as he apologized things would end. He could then focus on dealing with Connor. However, he did not expect that Wynn would ask him to do something like that. He actually asked him to kneel and apologize.
If Jace really knelt down and apologized to Wynn today, then he would definitely become a joke in the eyes of others in the future. He would not be able to continue to mingle in the entertainment industry.
Therefore, Jace could not agree to such an excessive request.
"I advise you not to go too far…"
Jace whispered to Wynn.
"Hehe, that's exactly what I want to do. What can you do to me?"
Wynn said arrogantly.
"..."
Jace took a deep breath and said expressionlessly, "I know you have some background in Newtown, but the Sackmann Family is not to be trifled with. You want to play with me, right?"
When everyone heard Jace's words, they became nervous because they didn't expect things to turn out like this. If the two sides really fought, then they might all be implicated.
Kaitlyn felt very helpless. All she wanted was to celebrate her birthday, but who would have thought that so many things would happen?
"Are you really not going to do something?"
Yvette turned to look at Connor and asked softly.
"Why should I? Since the two of them want to fight, then let them fight. Why not have someone teach Jace a lesson for you?"
Connor said with a smile.
"But I'm worried that this matter will blow up…"
Yvette said nervously.
"Don't worry. With me around, this matter won't be a big deal…"
Connor replied indifferently.
"I hope so!"
Yvette looked at Connor and took a deep breath.
On the other side, Wynn didn't want to continue talking nonsense with Jace. He rushed toward Jace and raised his leg to kick Jace in the stomach.
Jace didn't know what was going on. He took two steps back to steady his body, then turned and shouted at the people behind him, "What are you all looking at? Kill this person!"
The male celebrities behind Jace usually had a good relationship with Jace, but at this time, no one dared to step forward.
The reason was very simple. They didn't want to get into unnecessary trouble because of Jace.
"F*ck, what a bunch of cowards…"
Seeing that no one was making a move, Jace seemed to become even angrier. He was about to rush forward.
"Stop!"
However, at this moment, a cold but very pleasant voice sounded from the crowd.
Everyone turned to look at the voice.
A few seconds later, a beautiful woman with a seductive figure walked out in high heels.
All the guests here knew this woman.
This woman was the general manager of Heavens Club, Vanessa Canfield.
Vanessa had a lot of power in Heavens Club. She might even be more powerful than the boss. After all, the boss of Heavens Club had never shown his face, but Vanessa was different. Vanessa would take care of everything, big or small.
Wynn turned to look at Vanessa. He also knew in his heart that Vanessa was not a woman to be trifled with. If he provoked Vanessa, even Connor would not be able to save him, so he did not continue attacking Jace.
Vanessa walked up to Wynn and Jace and asked with a cold expression, "What's going on between the two of you?"
"Hello, Miss Canfield!"
Wynn smiled and greeted Vanessa.
Vanessa looked at Wynn indifferently and didn't say anything.
Wynn continued, "Miss Canfield, my name is Wynn Thompson. Salma Thompson is my cousin. The owner of Heavens Club, Connor McDonald, is my brother-in-law. Just now, this person bumped into my girlfriend and even scolded her. So, I want to teach this person a lesson. I hope Miss Canfield can give me some face!"
"Mr. McDonald is your brother-in-law?"
Vanessa asked in confusion.
"Yes, Mr. McDonald is with my cousin. Isn't he considered my cousin-in-law then?"
Wynn gritted his teeth and said.
"..."
Vanessa didn't know much about Connor's love life, but she knew that Connor had a good relationship with Salma. Therefore, she didn't dare to act rashly. After all, she couldn't offend her boss's brother-in-law.
"Well, I'll call Mr. McDonald now and ask him how he plans to deal with this matter…"
Vanessa whispered to Wynn.
"Alright, no problem. You can make the call!"
Wynn said with a smile.
Vanessa looked at Wynn with a hint of helplessness in her eyes. She took out her phone and was about to call Connor.
"Vanessa, since Wynn wants an explanation, let him continue. You don't have to care about this matter!"
Connor knew that Vanessa was going to call him, so he didn't continue to hide. Instead, he stepped forward and shouted expressionlessly.
"..."
Vanessa couldn't help but be stunned when she heard Connor's words. She subconsciously turned to look at Connor and shouted in disbelief, "Mr. McDonald, you're here too?"
"Yes, I've always been here!"
Connor lightly nodded.
At this moment, everyone was deeply shocked.
Their eyes widened as they stared at Connor. Everyone was utterly shocked, especially Kaitlyn and the others.
They did not know how to describe their feelings.

chapters.title: Chapter 1360: Brother-in-Law?
chapters.content:
Chapter 1360: Brother-in-Law?
Jace also stared at Connor with a puzzled expression.
He did not understand what was going on.
Everyone knew that Connor's identity was definitely not simple. Otherwise, Yvette would never have gotten together with Connor.
However, no one expected Connor's identity to be so terrifying!
Most of these people were not from Newtown, but they knew Heavens Club very well. They knew how terrifying Heavens Club was and how powerful the boss of Heavens Club was.
However, no one expected the boss of Heavens Club to be Connor, who had been following them all this time.
Everyone looked at Connor in surprise. They didn't know how to describe their current feelings.
Previously, they didn't understand where Connor got the courage to offend Jace.
But now, they all understood what was going on.
Although Jace did have some background, his background was nothing in front of Connor.
"Connor is the boss of Heavens Club?"
"I didn't expect Yvette to really find a rich husband!"
"That's right. I thought that Connor was the one who got the bigger benefit from being with her. Now it seems that the two of them are actually a match of equal status!"
Everyone began to discuss in low voices.
Vanessa walked toward Connor and asked him respectfully, "Mr. McDonald, are you sure you don't want to interfere in this matter?"
"Yeah. We'll just stand at the side and watch the show. If they break anything, we'll get them to compensate us based on the original price…"
Connor said lightly.
"Alright, I got it!"
Vanessa nodded.
It was very obvious what Connor meant. He was protecting Wynn.
When Wynn saw Connor, his eyes were filled with excitement. He hurriedly shouted, "Brother-in-law, you're here?"
Connor was speechless when he heard Wynn's words. He and Salma were just ordinary friends. Now, Connor was helping Wynn to return a favor to Salma and also teach Jace a lesson. However, Wynn was saying that he was his brother-in-law. What was going on?
"Brother-in-law?"
A trace of doubt flashed across Kaitlyn's eyes when she heard Wynn's words.
This was because Yvette was Connor's girlfriend, and this guy called Connor brother-in-law. Didn't that mean that Yvette and Wynn were cousins?
Everyone also realized that something didn't seem right and looked at Yvette.
"Yvette, this person is actually your cousin? Why haven't I heard you mention about him before?"
"That's right, Miss Wendell. Your cousin is really amazing. He even dared to hit Jace!"
"I think it's a good move. I've disliked Jace for a long time."
Everyone started saying to Yvette.
"Miss Wendell, something is happening to your cousin, so why aren't you doing anything about it?"
At this moment, a young man asked Yvette.
A hint of helplessness flashed across Yvette's eyes. After all, Connor was only pretending to be her boyfriend. The two of them did not know each other very well. She did not even know who Wynn was.
"I don't know this person. He's not my cousin!"
Yvette took a deep breath and said helplessly.
"You don't know this person?"
When everyone heard Yvette's words, they were once again dumbfounded.
"Yvette, what nonsense are you talking about?"
Kaitlyn also shouted and continued, "Didn't this person call Connor 'brother-in-law'? If you are Connor's girlfriend, then he must be your cousin, right?"
"Maybe Connor doesn't only have Yvette as his girlfriend?"
At this moment, a young man said.
Everyone fell silent.
"Oh my God! No way! Connor is actually a scumbag? Miss Wendell must have been deceived by him…"
"That's right. Looks like men are really fickle being…"
"He's really detestable. He actually lied to Miss Wendell…"
The female celebrities behind Yvette were all extremely furious at this moment, as if they wanted to eat Connor alive.
However, they were all thinking about one thing. If Connor was really a gentleman, they would not stand a chance against a goddess like Yvette.
However, if Connor was not a good man, then things would be much simpler. Connor's background was so terrifying that they could even be his lover!
Therefore, these female celebrities were already thinking about how they were going to seduce Connor.
However, Kaitlyn, who was the closest to Yvette, had a puzzled expression on her face.
Based on Yvette's personality, if she were to find out that her boyfriend had an affair with another man, she would definitely be so angry that she would slap him.
Yvette had no tolerance for such things.
But at this moment, Yvette was very calm, so calm that it was unbelievable.
"Does Yvette already know that Connor has another woman? That's why she's so calm?"
Kaitlyn couldn't help but take a deep breath. Then, she hurriedly tugged at Yvette and said, "Yvette, come with me for a moment. I have something to tell you…"
Yvette was stunned when she heard Kaitlyn's words. She then followed Kaitlyn to the side and asked softly, "Kaitlyn, what do you want to tell me?"
"What's going on with Connor? Do you know that he has another woman?"
Kaitlyn asked.
"I don't."
Yvette shook her head helplessly.
"Then, why are you so calm right now?"
Kaitlyn asked.
"I…"
A hint of helplessness flashed across Yvette's eyes, as if she did not know how to explain this matter.
"Yvette, we've known each other for so long. Others might not know you, but I know you very well. You must have known that Connor has another woman outside. You willingly became Connor's lover, right?"
Kaitlyn asked seriously.
"..."
Yvette looked at Kaitlyn and took a deep breath. Then, she said with a helpless expression, "Forget it. I'll tell you the truth!"

chapters.title: Chapter 1361: You Can Get Lost Now
chapters.content:
Chapter 1361: You Can Get Lost Now
"What truth?"
Kaitlyn was a little puzzled.
"Actually, I've only known Connor for less than three days. Also, when I first met him, it was because I was filming a show."
"Connor is the boss of Heavens Club. Heavens Club will be opening in a few days. He wants me to attend the opening ceremony, so I asked him to pretend to be my boyfriend and teach Jace a lesson. As for whether Connor has a girlfriend or not, and who that young man is, I don't know anything..."
Yvette knew that she could not hide it anymore, so she told Kaitlyn the truth.
After hearing Yvette's words, Kaitlyn was extremely shocked. She widened her watery eyes and said, "Now I get it!"
"You also know that after so many years, I haven't gotten over what happened. It's impossible for me to like someone else!"
Yvette said softly.
"If you put it that way, then I understand what's going on. You almost scared me to death. I thought you've become someone else's mistress!"
Kaitlyn said helplessly.
"Don't you know me by now? Even if I'm single for the rest of my life, I definitely won't be someone else's mistress…"
Yvette rolled her eyes at Kaitlyn and continued, " Oh right, you have to keep this a secret for me. Because now everyone knows that I have a boyfriend, and my boyfriend is the boss of Heavens Club. So, those annoying pursuers can't pester me anymore…"
"Alright, I understand. I'll definitely keep it a secret for you!"
Kaitlyn nodded seriously.
On the other side, Wynn was extremely excited when he saw Connor. He rushed to Connor and shouted at the top of his voice, "Hello, Brother-in-Law!"
"Do we know each other?"
Connor asked Wynn speechlessly.
"Brother-in-Law, I've seen you before, but you've never seen me. Salma Thompson is my cousin…"
Wynn grinned.
"Well, your sister and I are just ordinary friends. I'm not your brother-in-law."
Connor said helplessly.
"Isn't that going to happen sooner or later? My cousin said that she won't marry anyone but you…"
Wynn shouted at the top of his lungs.
When Connor heard Wynn's words, he was extremely helpless.
He realized that this guy wasn't using his brain to speak. If Salma heard this, she would definitely tear his mouth apart.
"Brother-in-Law, let me introduce you. This is my girlfriend!"
Wynn pulled a beautiful girl to him and said with a smile.
"Hello, Brother-in-Law!"
The girl seemed to be a little nervous at this moment as she softly said.
"Hello!"
Connor was not in the mood to explain his relationship with Salma to these people, so he could only helplessly reply.
"Well, Brother-in-Law, how do you think I should handle this matter today?"
Wynn gritted his teeth and asked Connor.
"You can handle it however you want…"
Connor replied indifferently.
"Brother-in-Law, since you put it that way…"
Wynn smiled excitedly, then walked up to Jace and said coldly to him, "Brat, we should settle the problem between us now, right?"
"I already apologized to you…"
Jace said helplessly.
At this time, Jace was cursing deep down, because he couldn't believe that Connor was actually the boss of Heavens Club. But now, even if he didn't believe it, there was nothing he could do. Vanessa Canfield had already confirmed it personally. It seemed that it was useless for him to not believe it.
"Did you think an apology would do? Didn't I tell you just now that as long as you kneel down before me, I'll let you off? Otherwise, this matter won't end here!"
Wynn shouted at Jace arrogantly.
"Don't think that you can be arrogant just because Connor is backing you up. I'm from the Sackmann Family. You can go and ask around. If you really piss me off, I can assure you that things won't end well for you."
It was too embarrassing to kneel down and apologize. Jace would never kneel down even if he died, so he wanted to use his family background to threaten Wynn.
A trace of disdain flashed across Wynn's eyes. Then, he sneered, "Who do you think the Sackmann Family is? Even if your father comes today, you have to kneel down and apologize to me. Otherwise, I'll beat you until you apologize!"
"I'll f*cking fight it out with you…"
Jace finally couldn't take it anymore. He shouted at the top of his lungs and then rushed toward Wynn.
The two of them started fighting again.
However, these two people were equally powerful. In addition, Jace was really planning to fight with his life on the line, so for a moment, Jace actually had the upper hand.
"What are you all standing there for? Hit him!"
Wynn turned and shouted at his friends behind him.
Wynn's friends did not dare to make a move, so they turned to look at Connor.
Connor had no expression on his face, as if he had tacitly agreed to this matter.
Seeing that, they naturally didn't need to hold back anymore. They rushed toward Jace and began to punch and kick him.
At the beginning, Jace was able to struggle, but there were too many people on the opposite side. Jace then fell to the ground and started getting a barrage of kicks.
Ten minutes later, Connor felt that it was about time to stop, so he shouted, "That's enough…"
When everyone heard Connor's words, they stopped what they were doing.
Jace had been beaten black and blue and looked very pitiful.
Wynn walked up to Jace and grabbed Jace's hair. He glared at him and said fiercely, "Remember, don't let me see you again in the future. Otherwise, I'll beat you up every time I see you, understand?"
Jace had been completely beaten down. He didn't dare to resist at all. He knew that if he resisted, the outcome might be even worse.
So, Jace didn't say a word. He was going to get the assassin to get rid of Wynn after dealing with Connor.
'These two must die…'
Jace thought to himself.
Seeing that Jace was not saying anything, Wynn did not intend to continue to make things difficult for Jace. He then said in a low voice, "Alright, I'm not in the mood to waste time with you now. You can get lost…"
When Jace heard this, he did not hesitate at all and ran out.

chapters.title: Chapter 1362: The Two Hitmen
chapters.content:
Chapter 1362: The Two Hitmen
Wynn knew that today's matter was all because Connor gave him face.
Therefore, he hurriedly walked before Connor and said with a smile, "Conn…No, Mr. McDonald, thank you so much for today. How about I treat you to a drink?"
"There's no need…" Connor replied indifferently and continued, "You'd better keep a low profile when you're out. You won't be lucky all the time. Today, you met me in my clubhouse. If it were anywhere else, the outcome might be different..."
"Yes… yes…" Wynn hurriedly nodded at Connor.
Connor glanced at Wynn indifferently and did not say anything. Instead, he turned to Yvette and said, "Let's go!"
"Okay!" Yvette nodded and followed Connor out of Heavens Club.
Everyone looked at Connor and Yvette, feeling extremely puzzled. Wynn was not Yvette's brother, yet he addressed Connor by name. However, Yvette did not respond at all!
Hence, everyone felt there was only one possibility at this moment - Yvette was willing to be Connor's mistress!
Everyone felt this was even more unbelievable than when Jace Sackmann took the initiative to call himself a toad.
How could someone like Yvette be willing to be someone else's mistress?
However, at this moment, only Kaitlyn knew what was going on. However, Kaitlyn had no way to explain these things to others.
Furthermore, Yvette did not even mind being labeled a mistress, so she would definitely not meddle in other people's business.
***
On the other side, after Jace left Heavens Club, he returned to his car and took out some tissues to wipe his face.
"Ring, ring, ring…"
Jace's cell phone rang.
He quickly picked up the phone and asked softly, "Did Dune find him?"
"That's right. I'm the man!" the other party replied.
"Come to the parking lot of Heavens Club now. I'll wait for you here. I'm in a black Bentley!"
After Jace knew that the hitman was coming, he was excited and spoke quickly.
"All right, see you in three minutes!" the hitman replied indifferently and then hung up the phone.
Jace sat alone in the car and waited.
If it were a normal person, after knowing Connor's identity, they would definitely not dare to make a move on Connor. However, Jace had suffered too much humiliation today. He felt that all of this was because of Connor, so there was only one thought in his mind, and that was to kill Connor.
At this moment, the anger in his heart had completely made him lose his rationality.
Three minutes later, a white van slowly stopped beside the Bentley.
A middle-aged man briefly observed his surroundings. After making sure that there were no threats, he opened the door of the Bentley and sat in the back seat.
Jace turned to look at the middle-aged man and asked softly, "You're the person Dune found for me?"
"That's right, I'm him." The hitman nodded lightly.
A trace of doubt flashed in Jace's eyes, and then he frowned and said, "The person I want to kill is not simple. Are you sure you can do it yourself?"
"There's someone else in my car. It shouldn't be a big problem if it's just us!" he answered directly.
"Great then…"
After Jace knew that it was a two-people operation, he visibly relaxed. Then he continued to ask, "How much do you charge?"
"Two million each!" the middle-aged man replied.
"Two million?"
Jace couldn't help but smile when he heard the number. Then he said lightly, "How about this? I'll give the two of you five million if you can help me kill this person without being discovered."
The middle-aged man's face lit up because it was the first time he had met a client like Jace, who took the initiative to raise the price.
"Mr. Sachmann, don't worry. Since we've accepted your money, we'll definitely do a good job!" the middle-aged man said seriously.
"But I'm a little worried that you won't have enough. Money doesn't matter. The goal is that you have to help me kill Connor…" Jace said with a frown.
The middle-aged man smiled faintly when he heard Jace's words and said confidently, "Mr. Sachmann, my brother and I have been in this line of work for more than ten years. We have never lost a battle, so don't worry. Killing an ordinary person is easy for us…"
At this moment, the middle-aged man was not lying. He and his brother had indeed taken on many jobs and never failed or been caught by the police. It was obvious that this middle-aged man was not an ordinary person.
After Jace heard this, he was slightly relieved.
"Mr. Sachmann, do you have a photo of the target?" the middle-aged man asked.
"A photo?" Hearing this, Jace looked a little helpless, and then he said softly, "I just met that kid. From where would I get the photo?"
"If you don't have the photos, we don't know who to kill."
The middle-aged man was speechless.
"You don't have to worry about that. I know that person. Moreover, that person is in the clubhouse now. Let's wait here. When that person comes out, I'll tell you…" Jace said lightly.
"Mr. Sachmann, aren't you afraid of being seen?" the middle-aged man asked.
"He's already a dead man. What's there to be afraid of? I want to see you kill him with my own eyes. Otherwise, resolving the hatred in my heart won't be easy!" Jace gritted his teeth and said.
"All right then…"
The middle-aged man saw that Jace was so firm about it, so he couldn't say anything more. He could only nod helplessly.
"Mr. Sachmann, let's wait in my car. Your car is too attention-catching!" the middle-aged man reminded him kindly.
"All right, let's go to your car!"
Jace nodded gently and then followed the middle-aged man into another car.
A few minutes later, Connor and Yvette walked out of Heavens Club, chatting and laughing.
At this moment, Connor planned to drive Yvette back to the hotel before going home.
When Jace saw Connor, he acted like he had seen his father's murderer and shouted, "Did you two see that person? It's him. Go kill him now…"

chapters.title: Chapter 1363: Yvette's Past
chapters.content:
Chapter 1363: Yvette's Past
"Mr. Sachmann, this parking lot is full of cameras. Moreover, this is the territory of Heavens Club. Once we are discovered, we won't be able to escape…" The middle-aged man said helplessly.
"So, what do you plan to do?" Jace hurriedly asked agitatedly.
"I think the best way for us now is to follow them out of the parking lot and wait for the right time to make our move…" The middle-aged man said.
"That's fine too…"
Jace felt that what the middle-aged man said made sense, so he nodded in agreement and didn't say anything.
After Connor and Yvette got into the car, they drove straight to the hotel.
However, when they passed by a park, Yvette said, "It's still early, and I don't want to go home yet. I think the scenery over there is pretty. Let's go over and take a look!"
"It's so late at night. What is there to see?" Connor asked helplessly.
"Do you still want me to attend your opening ceremony?" Yvette asked with a pout.
"Fine, let's go and take a look…" Connor did not dare to offend Yvette now, so he could only agree helplessly.
A few minutes later.
Connor and Yvette alighted from the car and began to stroll along the path beside the lake in the park.
It was already past midnight, so no one was around the lake. It was very quiet. Yvette took off her sunglasses and hat.
"This place is great. I finally don't have to wear sunglasses anymore…" Yvette said happily to Connor.
"It must be tough for celebrities like you..." Connor said with a smile.
"Yeah, but I just like acting. I like being a celebrity!"
Yvette smiled and turned to look at Connor. She said with a serious expression, "I'm grateful for what you did today…"
"You don't have to thank me. I'm only doing this because I have a favor to ask of you. To put it bluntly, I am taking what I need. If you don't have any value to me, I won't help you." Connor said to Yvette solemnly.
"You don't have to be so direct. I will go to your opening ceremony. You helped me deal with Jace and allowed me to let go of my previous regrets," Yvette whispered to Connor.
"I used to be like you. Some things are hard to let go of, but life goes on. I can't live in the past forever!" Connor whispered back to Yaya.
"I think you have many ghosts in your past, right?" Yvette looked at Connor and asked.
"There's nothing much to say about my past, but I'm very curious about yours. I think you should tell yours to let go of the past and move forward!" Connor said with a smile.
"My past?"
A strange look flashed in Yvette's eyes as if she did not want to discuss this.
"Of course, it's okay if you don't want to tell me. After all, it's your freedom to tell me or not!" Connor looked at Yvette and continued.
Yvette took a deep breath and remained silent.
At the same time, a white van stopped not far away.
When Jace saw Connor and Yvette in the car, he was very agitated. He roared, "We finally found this adulterous couple!"
"Mr. Sachmann, what are you doing?"
The middle-aged man saw that Jace was about to leave the car and quickly reached out to stop him.
"What else can I do? Don't you know why I hired the two of you over?" Jace replied angrily and continued, "It wasn't easy to find these two people. I have to kill that Connor today…"
"Mr. Sachmann, I understand your feelings, but since you have already entrusted this to us, you must do it according to our plans..." The middle-aged man said in a low voice.
"Do it according to your plans?"
Jace was stunned for a moment, then asked in a puzzled tone, "What rules?"
"We will get out of the car now and check if there are any cameras or passers-by around. If we are sure that there are no cameras or passers-by, we can make our move…" The middle-aged man said calmly.
Hearing this, Jace couldn't help but hesitate. Then he smiled. "You professionals are still the most experienced. All right, you two go and check. I'll wait here!"
After hearing Jace's words, the middle-aged man exited the car and carefully checked the surroundings.
Meanwhile.
Connor took the initiative to ask about Yvette's history with that boy.
After hesitating, Yvette decided to tell Connor about it.
Yvette's romantic history was simple. It was just that the boy had been pursuing Yvette back then, but Yvette did not want to be with him for various reasons. In the end, when Yvette realized she had fallen in love with the boy, the boy died in a car accident.
The most crucial reason Yvette could not let go of this relationship was that it was all because of her. If it were not for her, that boy would never have died.
"He chose to sacrifice himself to save me. It was then, I realized how deep his love for me was…" Yvette said softly to Connor as tears streamed down her face.
"But you don't love him!" Connor said to Yvette seriously.
Yvette was surprised when she heard Connor's comment. She puzzledly asked, "What do you mean by that?"
"Well, your feelings for him are just of empathy and not love, but his feelings for you are romantic!" Connor explained.
"How do you know that I don't love him? You're not me. How do you know if I love him or not?" Yvette retorted.
"It's very simple. Love and liking are not the same thing. If you like someone, you will miss that person, but if you love someone, you will be willing to give up everything for him, even your life. Back then, you rejected him many times, and your heart has always hesitated. Otherwise, you definitely wouldn't have rejected him so many times…" Connor looked at Yvette and said.
Yvette was stunned when she heard that. She frowned and did not say anything.

chapters.title: Chapter 1364: The Revenge
chapters.content:
Chapter 1364: The Revenge
"The reason why you think of him like this now is very likely because you feel guilty. If you loved him back then, how could you have the heart to reject someone you loved?" Connor continued.
"What you said makes sense. Maybe I can't let go of these things because I feel guilty!" Yvette nodded thoughtfully and continued, "But now, all this is not that important anymore. Be it guilt or love, I plan to let go of this. I'm going to start my new life!"
"As long as you have the courage to let go of these things!" Connor said with a smile.
"All these years, I've never mentioned this to anyone. This is the first time you've heard me say these things. After I have said it out loud, I feel better!" Yvette looked at Connor and continued.
"Some things are better said than kept bottled up!" Connor replied.
"But these are all my secrets. Only we know about it now. You must not tell anyone, or I will not let you off!" Yvette threatened Connor.
"Don't worry. I will keep this private. I will help you keep this secret…" Connor said with a smile.
Yvette sized up Connor and said softly, "I think you play the piano very well. Have you learned it professionally?"
"No…" Connor shook his head lightly and continued, "I only learned the piano from my mother, but after my mother passed away, I never touched the piano again…"
"You haven't touched the piano for a long time, but you can still play it. It's unbelievable!" Yvette said to Connor in surprise.
"Although I haven't touched some things for a long time, I often think of them. For example, the song I played just now was composed for my mother, but this is my first time playing it. Only when I think of my mother will this song ring in my mind..." Connor said slowly.
"I like that song of yours…" Yvette replied softly before continuing, "Actually, I'm quite curious about your past because I think there is more to you than meets the eye…"
"That's right. The things I've experienced are not what you can imagine. However, I have too many stories. I might not be able to finish telling them today…" Connor replied with a smile.
"What's there to talk about? Anyway, I'm free now. You can tell me!" Yvette looked at Connor and said.
"Ma'am, you may have nothing to do, but I'm busy, okay?" Connor said helplessly.
"What are you busy with? Your girlfriend?" Yvette asked with a pout.
"How did you know I have a girlfriend?"
Upon hearing Yvette's words, Connor was surprised. A hint of confusion flashed in his eyes.
"When we first met, there was a girl next to you. If I'm not wrong, that girl is your girlfriend, right?" Yvette asked with a smile.
"She's not my girlfriend…" Connor looked at Yvette and shook his head.
"Not your girlfriend?"
Yvette was stunned and in disbelief.
"She's my fiancée!" Connor said softly.
"You have a fiancée? Tell me about your fiancée." Yvette said as she tugged at Connor.
"It's too late now. I'm a little sleepy. I'll tell you about her when I have time!" Connor said helplessly.
"Sigh. I don't know when the next time two of us will meet. You'd better tell me now…" Yvette said unyieldingly.
"It's okay. We should be able to meet soon. I'm going to hold an opening ceremony in a few days. I'll tell you when you come to my opening ceremony…" Connor said helplessly.
"Really?" Yvette asked.
"Of course, it's true. I've always been a man of my word…" Connor replied.
"All right, then, let's hurry back. I'm a little tired too!" Yvette looked at Connor and nodded gently.
After knowing that Yvette would finally let him off, Connor heaved a long sigh of relief. He then turned around and prepared to leave.
However, as Connor was about to turn around and leave, he saw Jace walking toward him and Yvette with two people.
Connor never thought that Jace would be so bold. He already knew that he was the boss of Heavens Club, but he still dared to come to him.
"Connor, what are you doing here?" Yvette asked in puzzlement.
"Jace is here..." Connor replied in a low voice.
"..." Yvette was stunned. Then, she hurriedly looked up and saw Jace walking toward Connor with two people.
"It's over. I said that Jace would not let it go. He must have found someone to take revenge on you now. You'd better leave quickly," Yvette urged Connor.
Connor turned and glanced at Yvette, saying indifferently, "If I leave now, you might be in danger, so I can't go now…"
"I don't believe he would dare to do anything to me!" Yvette hurriedly said.
"Jace has already embarrassed himself today. Now, he dares to bring people to take revenge on me. That means that he has lost his mind now. Who can be sure if he will not do something..." Connor said expressionlessly.
"But…" Yvette opened her mouth and was about to speak.
Jace and the others had already walked up to Connor.
Connor briefly observed the two people behind Jace. One of them was in his early thirties. He was burly and had a strong appearance. He exuded a strong murderous aura. The other person was short and was in his twenties. From their eyes, it could be seen that these two were hitmen.
However, Connor wasn't nervous at all. Although these two were killers, they weren't martial artists. They shouldn't have any problem dealing with ordinary people, but they couldn't deal with Connor.
"Connor, I did not expect you to be hiding here. I have finally found you…" Jace shouted at Connor with a smile.

chapters.title: Chapter 1365: The Plot Twist
chapters.content:
Chapter 1365: The Plot Twist
"Are you planning to take revenge on me?" Connor asked Jace calmly.
"That's right. I'm here to take revenge on you. Not only did you snatch my woman, but you also embarrassed me in front of everyone. I will not let you off…"Jace shouted angrily.
"Haha…" Connor looked at Jace and sneered, then asked playfully, "How do you plan to take revenge on me now?"
"Easy. I plan to kill you!" Jace gritted his teeth and shouted fiercely.
"Jace, are you crazy? Just because of such a small matter, you plan to kill Connor? Do you know who Connor is?" Yvette stared at Jace and shouted.
Hearing that, Jace couldn't help but sneer and said in a low voice, "Yvette, don't you know why I want to kill Connor? Isn't this all because of you?"
"What does it have to do with me?" Yvette asked helplessly.
"What does it have to do with you?" Jace sneered and said coldly, "You know very well in your heart. I've always liked you and always been sincere to you. However, you just had to be with this… Connor. Moreover, you even let Connor humiliate me. I won't allow you to be with another man. I'll make Connor pay the price today…"
"It's my freedom to like and be with whoever I want. Are you crazy?" Yvette shouted at Jace as if she was about to collapse.
Jace didn't intend to waste his breath on Yvette and said coldly, "All right, I don't want to waste time with you now. I'm here today to kill Connor. I advise you not to meddle in other people's business. I guarantee that no one will hurt you. However, if you interfere in other people's business, don't blame me for being mean…" Jace said this to scare Yvette.
After all, Yvette's family was still very powerful. If he killed Yvette, things would be very troublesome. Jace might also be arrested.
Moreover, Jace liked Yvette from the bottom of his heart, so he did not want to hurt her.
As for Connor, Jace had to kill him no matter the price.
"Jace, you're crazy. Do you know the consequences of doing this? Connor is the boss of Heavens Club. If you kill him today, your family will suffer…"
Although Yvette loathed Jace, the Wendell and Sachmann families had a good relationship. Hence, she could not bear to watch Jace walk down a path of no return. Of course, she did not wish for anything to happen to Connor.
"Are you trying to scare me?"
Jace smiled disdainfully and continued, "Let me tell you, we've already checked the surroundings. There isn't even a single surveillance camera, and there's no one else here. So even if I kill Connor, there's no one here to witness it. No one knows I killed Connor, so I naturally have nothing to worry about…"
"You…" Yvette was instantly dumbfounded when she heard Jace's words. She was also very shocked because she did not expect Jace to be so prepared.
This meant that Jace was planning to attack Connor now.
The two hitmen standing behind Jace also silently took out their weapons because they thought Connor was just ordinary. They did not intend to use guns. Instead, they chose to use the simplest fruit knife.
Fruit knives were very common, so even if someone found Connor's body, there was no way to start investigating the weapon.
However, if they used a gun, things would be much more complicated.
Connor seemed indifferent when he saw the two people taking fruit knives. Because now, Connor had nothing to worry about other than the other party using a gun.
Even if the other party had weapons, and there were two of them, they were not Connor's match.
This was the difference between ordinary people and martial artists.
"Mr. Sachmann, don't waste time with them…" The middle-aged man said to Jace expressionlessly.
Jace took a deep breath and shouted at Yvette, "Yvette, I'm giving you one last chance. If you still don't come over to me, I'll have to get rid of you too!"
Yvette stood in front of Connor with an unusually calm expression. It was as if she had no intention of leaving Connor at all.
"..."
Seeing Yvette standing on Connor's side even if she had to die, Jace became even angrier and shouted, "Kill Connor for me. Leave the woman alive…"
"Yes, sir!" After hearing Jace's words, the two hitmen rushed toward Connor.
Connor pulled Yvette behind him and took a pistol from his pocket, aiming it at the middle-aged man's head.
The middle-aged man was shocked when he saw Connor take out the pistol. He instantly froze and looked at Connor, surprised.
"How... Why does this person have a gun in his hand?"
The middle-aged man's eyes as he shouted in disbelief.
Jace and the other killer were also dumbfounded. They didn't seem to have thought that Connor would have a gun in his hand.
Connor knew that as he showed up in Newtown more often, more and more people knew his true identity. Therefore, Rockefeller's people must have heard about it.
Some time ago, Queta Juve had told Connor that Rockefeller might send assassins to kill Connor, all of whom were martial artists.
Although Connor was also a martial artist now, if faced with unpredictable situations, Connor still needed more of an advantage.
For safety reasons, Connor asked Queta to prepare a pistol for him.
After all, no matter how influential a martial artist was, they couldn't be a match for a pistol.
Since Connor returned to Newtown, he had always carried this pistol. However, he had never had the chance to use it. This was the first time Connor had taken out this gun.
The middle-aged man looked at the pistol in Connor's hand. He didn't know how to describe his feelings. He initially thought that today's mission was straightforward. It shouldn't be difficult to kill an ordinary person.
However, who would have thought such an ordinary person would have a gun?
These two hitmen usually liked to use knives when they carried out missions, so they did not bring guns at all.
In an instant, the situation changed drastically.

chapters.title: Chapter 1366: What Do You Want?
chapters.content:
Chapter 1366: What Do You Want?
Jace was stunned and didn't know what to do.
He had never thought that things would turn out this way.
Connor touched his nose and said with a playful expression, "I have no enmity with the two of you, so I don't want to attack the two of you…"
"What... What do you want?" The middle-aged man asked Connor in a low voice.
"Throw your weapons aside. I'm a little scared!" Connor said expressionlessly.
"..."
The middle-aged man looked at Connor carefully. He could feel that Connor's posture of holding the gun could be improved, which meant that Connor was still a novice. However, Connor's eyes were steadfast, which meant that Connor likely knew how to shoot.
In such a situation, the middle-aged man did not dare to gamble with his life.
Therefore, he threw the fruit knife aside.
"What about you?" Connor turned and asked the other hitman.
The short young man took a deep breath. He knew that his cousin had already given up, so there was no point in keeping his stand, so he threw the fruit knife out.
Jace's expression was hideous when he saw the two hitmen he had hired surrender so quickly.
He looked at Connor foolishly, not knowing what to do.
"Well, Connor, I think we might have a small misunderstanding today. I didn't want to kill you when I hired these two people. I only wanted to scare you. Just... Let me go!" Jace stammered and begged.
Connor couldn't help but sneer and lightly said, "Jace, weren't you very arrogant just now? Didn't you say you wanted to kill me? Why? Now you're afraid?"
"I was fooling around with you just now. How would I dare to kill you…" Jace whispered.
"You don't dare to kill me, but you hired two assassins?" Connor sneered and continued, "The three of you better behave yourself. I don't want to shoot. However, if you don't behave yourself, don't blame me for being mean…"
"What do you want?" The middle-aged man asked Connor in confusion.
"You will know what I want soon…" Connor replied calmly. Then, he took out his phone and dialed.
"Ring, ring, ring…"
Soon, the phone rang. The other party picked up the phone and asked respectfully, "Hello, Mr. McDonald!"
"Inspector Le, are you resting?" Connor asked with a smile.
"No, no, Mr. McDonald, if you have anything to say, just shoot…" The other party said very politely.
"Well, a few people tried to kill me just now…" Connor said with a smile.
When Inspector Lee heard this, he exclaimed, "Mr. McDonald, who has the guts to touch you? Where are you now? I'll go save you now!"
"You don't have to be so worried. I have these people under my control. You should hurry up and bring arrest. I owe you a favor. There are two professional hitmen here," Connor said lightly.
"Thank you, Mr. McDonald. Thank you! I didn't expect you to think of me for such a good opportunity. I'll go over now."
Hearing that, Inspector Lee was so excited he was speechless.
"I'm at Ring City Park now!"
After saying this, Connor hung up the phone.
The person who had spoken to Connor earlier was the police station's director, Clio Lee, who had sent Connor to the police station after Yvette had called the police.
After Clio knew Connor's identity, he immediately apologized to Connor and took the initiative to send Connor out of the police station. Moreover, Clio was a very good person. He left his phone number for Connor and told him he could call him now if there were anything needed handling.
After all, if there were some small matters to be dealt with by people like Clio, it would be much simpler than dealing with Thomas and the others.
After all, this was Newtown. There were many insignificant matters that Thomas could not do, so Connor accepted. Connor only wanted to give Clio some benefits, and Clio would probably be smiling like a flower.
When Connor saw these two hitmen, he thought about how to deal with them.
Who knew how many people they would kill if he let these two people go? Connor decided to kill these two people if he didn't let them go.
However, Connor had no grudges against these two people. If Connor hated hitmen, he would not be able to kill them. Moreover, he did not know how to deal with Jace.
Therefore, Connor felt that the simplest way now was to hand over these three to the police and let the police deal with them.
After the middle-aged man saw Connor make the call, his expression instantly changed because he knew Connor had called the police just now.
They had taken countless lives over the years. If they fell into the hands of the police, they would die.
If they resisted now, they might still have a chance of survival. However, if they waited here, they would die.
"We have already surrendered. Why did you call the police?" The middle-aged man seemed a little angry as he shouted at Connor.
"For so many years, you have done countless heartless things. Don't you know that? If I don't hand the two of you to the police, I'll go to hell!" Connor said coldly.
"You left me no choice…" The middle-aged man shouted with red eyes.
When the short youth heard the middle-aged man's words, he instantly understood what was happening. Therefore, he did not hesitate at all and rushed toward Connor.
It had to be said that the physical fitness of the two hitmen was very good. The short youth's speed was breakneck. Almost in the blink of an eye, he was before Connor.
"Connor, be careful!" Yvette shouted when she saw that the short young man was about to make a move.
Connor had never used a gun before. He only carried a gun with him for self-defense.
In addition, the lethality of a pistol was too great. If Connor killed these two hitmen, it would be difficult to explain to the police.
Therefore, Connor chose to not use a gun. Instead, he put down the gun and raised his leg to kick.

chapters.title: Chapter 1367: Counterattack
chapters.content:
Chapter 1367: Counterattack
"Poof!"
There was a loud bang.
Connor kicked the short youth's stomach.
The short young man did not seem to be able to react to what was going on. His vision went black, and his entire body was flung away.
"Thud!"
The short young man's body slammed into the railing beside the lake.
One could see Connor's kick's strength from the dent in the railing.
After struggling for a while, the short youth seemed to want to stand up, but he felt like he had been hit by a truck. He could not stand up at all.
The middle-aged man was also shocked by Connor's skill, but he had no choice but to survive. He raised his fist and smashed it towards Connor's face.
Connor dodged the middle-aged man's fist with unusual ease and then threw a punch at him.
"Thud!"
Connor's fist fiercely smashed into the middle-aged man's stomach.
The middle-aged man screamed and kneeled, hugging his stomach tightly. He was in a lot of pain.
The two hitmen were lying on the ground in less than two minutes. Moreover, they seemed to have completely lost the ability to escape.
Yvette stared at Connor, shocked.
Although she knew Connor had skills, she never thought Connor would be so powerful.
The two were professional hitmen!
However, before Connor, they were so weak!
Jace also looked incredulous at this time. He had planned to count on these two killers to get rid of Connor, but now he knew how stupid his original idea was. It was so stupid that even if he hired ten hitmen today, they might not be Connor's opponent, let alone two killers!
Jace looked at Connor with fear. He didn't know what to do now.
After dealing with the two hitmen, Connor ignored them and walked toward Jace.
Jace didn't know whether it was because of fear or something else, but he kneeled in front of Connor. Then he stuttered and shouted at Connor, "Connor, I… I know I was wrong. I beg you, let me go, I beg you..."
"Do you know your mistake now? Isn't it too late for you to be on your own now?" Connor asked with a smile.
"Connor, I'm from the Sachmann Family. Let me tell you, if you dare to touch me today, my family will definitely not let you off. You have to think carefully…" Jace shouted in despair.
After hearing Jace's threat, Connor couldn't help but sneer, and then lightly said, "Do you think I want to kill you?"
"What else?" Jace was stunned for a moment and asked.
"Don't worry, I won't kill you. The police will be here soon. I will hand you over to the police to deal with…" Connor said calmly.
"The police?"
A trace of fear flashed in Jace's eyes when he heard this.
Although Jace's life would not be in danger if Connor handed him over to the police, the matter of him hiring a murderer was also very serious. He might be ruined in this life, so he begged Connor desperately, "Connor, I beg you, don't hand me over to the police. If you hand me over to the police, my life will be over…"
"What were you thinking when you hired hitmen to kill me?" Connor replied expressionlessly.
Jace also knew Connor would not let him off, so he shouted at Yvette, "Yvette, we've known each other since we were young. I admit that it was my fault for pestering you before. I promise that I won't pester you anymore. Please let me go on account of my father. If I'm jailed, our family will be finished."
Yvette looked at Jace with a hint of hesitation in her eyes. Although Jace was very annoying, Yvette had never thought of making things so big.
It was already very good that Jace would not pester her in the future.
Hence, after a moment of hesitation, Yvette turned to Connor and said, "Connor, Jace isn't that bad. Why don't you let him go?"
"Yes, yes, Connor, there's actually no deep hatred between the two of us. I was really impulsive earlier. Let me go. I promise that I won't harass Yvette again in the future."
Jace kneeled as he begged Connor agitatedly.
Connor scanned Jace, then whispered, "All right, since Yvette has pleaded for you, I won't hand you over to the police. But remember, don't harass Yvette in the future. Otherwise, things won't be so forgotten this easily…"
"Don't worry. I definitely won't dare to do it again. I won't dare to do it again in the future…" Jace hurriedly shouted.
After hesitating, Connor directly kicked Jace between his legs.
"Ah!" Jace screamed, and his face was filled with pain.
"You better remember this. This is just a small lesson. If you dare to harass Yvette again, it won't be so simple. Do you understand?" Connor warned coldly.
"I understand, I understand. I guarantee that I won't dare to do it again…"
Jace's face was pale, and his voice trembled.
"Get lost…" Connor said lightly.
After Jace heard Connor's order, he felt like he just had a brush with death. Without any hesitation, he turned around and ran away.
After this incident, Jace probably wouldn't dare to find trouble with Connor anymore.
Because, in his eyes, Connor was a lunatic.
If Yvette had not pleaded for him today, Connor would probably have handed him over to the police.
After seeing Jace leave, Connor couldn't help but turn to look at Yvette. He said softly, "From today onward, Jace will not dare to harass you anymore. In the future, he will have to walk in a different direction when he sees you..."
"Thank you!" Yvette said to Connor seriously.
"What are you thanking me for?" Connor was stunned.
"Jace wanted to kill you, but I asked you to let him go…" Yvette replied softly before continuing, "I asked you to let him go not because I care about him but because I know the power of the Sachmann Family. If you give Jace to the police today, the Sachmann Family will find an opportunity to avenge you. It will also cause you trouble, so I think it's better to avoid it. As long as he doesn't continue to bug me in the future, I'm good..."

chapters.title: Chapter 1368: I'm Your Fan
chapters.content:
Chapter 1368: I'm Your Fan
"I understand what you mean…" Connor lightly nodded.
Connor didn't want to cause trouble. Although Connor wasn't afraid of trouble, avoiding it was better.
Yvette sized Connor up and said softly, "I didn't expect you to be so skilled!"
"If my skills were not good, would I have agreed to help you fight Jace?" Connor replied with a smile.
However, at this moment, the sound of sirens could be heard from afar.
Four or five police cars drove straight toward Connor.
After Clio exited the car, he ran to Connor and shouted, "Mr. McDonald, where is the criminal?"
Connor pointed at the two hitmen lying on the ground.
When Clio saw the two killers, he couldn't help but be stunned momentarily. Then, he excitedly said, "Mr. McDonald, you've done me a great favor this time!"
"What?" Connor asked.
"Mr. McDonald, these two hitmen have committed many crimes. We have long wanted to catch them, but these two people are very cunning. We have never been able to catch them. I didn't expect that they would fall into your hands. I don't know how to thank you, Mr. McDonald…"
Clio looked at Connor and exclaimed excitedly.
At this moment, he finally understood that Connor was his benefactor!
"This is just a small matter. I just happened to meet these two people…" Connor replied with a smile.
After hesitation, Clio asked Connor softly, "Mr. McDonald, should I investigate the people behind these two people?"
"There's no need for that. I already know who's behind the two. If you continue to investigate, you'll get into trouble instead, so take these two people away…" Connor said lightly.
"Mr. McDonald, you're very thoughtful!" Clio said in a low voice.
Connor hesitated before saying with a smile, "Inspector Lee, my club might be opening in a few days. Can you come over then?"
Clio couldn't help but laugh when he heard Connor's invite and said softly, "Mr. McDonald, it's not interesting for me to go over alone. How about this, I'll discuss it with my subordinates and try to bring more people to support you. What do you think?"
"That is naturally the best…" Connor said with a smile.
Clio subconsciously glanced at Yvette, who was beside Connor, and was stunned.
He had been so focused on Connor that he did not notice that the superstar Yvette was beside him.
After Clio and Connor exchanged a simple greeting, he planned to leave with the two hitmen.
After all, these two hitmen were also considered great treasures to Clio.
Once these two people could be arrested, it would definitely allow Clio to reach a higher level.
Therefore, Clio was still very grateful to Connor, because he knew in his heart that if it weren't for Connor, he would never be able to catch these two hitmen.
However, just as Clio was about to leave, he suddenly noticed Yvette standing beside Connor. He was surprised.
The famous female celebrity Yvette was with Connor.
Moreover, it was already midnight, and they were found together. This meant there might be something going on between them.
Clio instantly understood what was going on. He could not help but sigh that Connor was really amazing. He could even handle a big star like Yvette.
Clio was a loyal fan of Yvette, so he was naturally very excited when he saw Yvette. His body trembled slightly, and he stammered to Yvette, " You must be Miss Wendell, right?"
As everything had happened too suddenly, Yvette did not disguise herself at all. After hearing Clio's words, Yvette was also surprised before she said softly, "That's right, I'm Yvette…"
"Miss Wendell, I didn't expect to meet you here. I've always been your loyal fan. Can I have an autograph?" Clio asked excitedly.
"Of course…" Yvette replied with a smile.
Without hesitation, Clio took a pen and paper and handed them to Yvette.
Meanwhile, Yvette gave Clio an autograph.
The police officers who had followed Clio over also surrounded Yvette and asked for her autograph.
About ten minutes later, Clio left the scene with his men.
Yvette finally heaved a sigh of relief after seeing the policemen leave. She sighed softly and said, "It was really dangerous today. If it wasn't for your good combat skills, we might have been in danger…"
"Yes, you must be careful when you are alone in the future. I'm worried that people like Jace might take revenge on you!" Connor replied softly and continued, "I didn't expect you to have so many fans…"
"Of course…" Yvette replied proudly before continuing, "Are you my fan?"
"What do I have to do to be considered your fan?" Connor asked softly.
"It's very simple. Have you watched my TV series?" Yvette asked.
"I have, but I haven't seen much…" Connor said lightly.
"Then you're still not my fan…" Yvette said with a pout.
"It doesn't count. I don't idolize celebrities anyway. I'll send you back to the hotel!" Connor said with a smile.
"Humph!" Yvette could not help but harrumph coldly when she heard Connor's words. She then strode toward the parking lot.
Half an hour later, Connor sent Yvette back to the hotel before taking a taxi home.
When Connor arrived home, he found that Rachel was still awake.
"It's already so late. Why aren't you asleep?" Connor asked softly.
"I'm going to sleep later…" Rachel replied indifferently, then turned to look at Connor and asked softly, "How are the preparations for your opening ceremony going?"
"Almost all the preparations are ready. We're just waiting for the opening ceremony!" Connor replied.
"Oh, I heard that the Synder Family's opening ceremony is about to begin. I wonder if they will choose the same day as you…" Rachel softly reminded Connor.
After Connor heard Rachel's words, he was surprised. Then, he softly said, "Do you want to attend the opening ceremony?"
"My current identity is just a lecturer at Newtown University. It's meaningless for me to participate. Moreover, my identity is quite special. If someone recognizes me, it will cause me trouble."
Rachel shook her head and refused.
"Alright then…" Connor nodded helplessly. He also knew it was meaningless for Rachel to attend his opening ceremony, so he didn't force her.
Connor had already invited the Thompson Family, Blake Layton, and Yvette. The lineup of these three people was already very impressive enough.
Therefore, Connor did not have to worry about the ribbon-cutting guests at all. Now, Connor only needed to wait for the opening ceremony to happen.

chapters.title: Chapter 1369: Arthur Synder's Plan
chapters.content:
Chapter 1369: Arthur Synder's Plan
In a private club in Newtown.
Arthur sat on the sofa and gently swirled the red wine glass in his hand as if he was waiting for something.
A few minutes later, the private room door was pushed open from the outside. A man in a suit walked into the private room.
When Arthur saw this man, his expression was a little excited. Then, he hurriedly stood up and said excitedly, "Mr. Ward, you're finally here!"
When the man heard Arthur's greeting, he smiled faintly and said softly, "I'm really sorry. My family's business is really too busy. That's why I invited you out so late at night…"
"It's okay. Mr. Ward, your family's company is so big. It's normal for you to be busy with your business. Unlike an idle person like me who has time all the time…" Arthur's attitude toward this man was unusually respectful.
This man was a well-known entrepreneur in Orilon and was not a rich heir or from a prestigious family. It was only because he had an unclear relationship with the person in charge of Rockefeller in Orilon that he had a strong reputation.
The man was Tenner Ward, Yaakov's spokesperson in Orilon.
After all, Yaakov's identity was rather special. Most of the time, Yaakov could not show his face in public. It was always Tenner who appeared on his behalf.
Yaakov and Tenner shared the same surname, so many people thought they were blood-related. However, Tenner had never admitted it.
This time, the Synder Family cooperated with Yaakov to buy Triumph Club. Naturally, Yaakov had to assign someone to contact the Synder Family, and that person was Tenner.
