Arthur knew very well that Tenner's appearance would have the same effect as Yaakov's, so he was naturally very respectful to Tenner.
Otherwise, Arthur and Tenner were about the same age, and Arthur would definitely not be so humble.
"Mr. Ward, please take a seat!" Arthur said to Tenner with a smile.
Tenner sat down on the sofa, while Arthur took the initiative to pour a glass of red wine for Tenner and said softly, "Mr. Ward, I invited you out today to discuss the opening ceremony of our club with you…"
"How are your preparations for the opening ceremony?" Tenner asked softly.
"I'm almost done with the preparations for the opening ceremony. I've also decided to hold the opening ceremony opposite the hotel where Heavens Club's opening ceremony is held according to your wishes. It's also on the same day…" Arthur hurriedly said.
"That's good…" Tenner nodded lightly.
"But Mr. Ward, although the time and place of our club is the same as Heavens Club, Connor still has some influence in Newtown. If we only rely on the connections of the Synder Family, it will be difficult to compete with Connor. So I'm worried that the opening ceremony will not only not embarrass Connor, but also affect our business…" Arthur said very tactfully.
Actually, Tenner had already told Arthur about this plan. His goal was to let the rich in Orilon know about the connections of Triumph Club through this opening ceremony.
However, Arthur's family could not invite any important figures at all. Tenner had been on a business trip, so Arthur was very anxious. Seeing that the opening ceremony was getting closer and closer, he had no choice but to take the initiative to invite Tenner out and talk about this.
"Haha…"
Tenner couldn't help but smile when he heard Arthur's words. He said softly, "Mr. Synder should be worried about the guests for the opening ceremony, right?"
"That's right, it's a problem with the guests. After all, when the two families cut the ribbon simultaneously, which side has more people and more guests with stronger reputations!" Arthur hurriedly nodded and said.
"You don't have to worry about this. You just have to do what you should do…" Tenner said calmly.
Arthur hesitated when he saw how confident Tenner was. Then, he chuckled and said, "Mr. Ward, what are your plans? Please tell me the truth so I can be more at ease…"
"Haha…"
Tenner smiled and continued, "I've already sent out invitations. Basically, as long as it's a big shot in the business world of Orilon, they will probably receive an invitation. These people will probably come to attend our opening ceremony for the sake of Mr. Wilson. Even if some people don't attend our opening ceremony, they won't have the courage to attend Connor's opening ceremony..."
"All the big shots in the business world?" Arthur was dumbfounded when he heard what Tenner said. His expression was one of disbelief.
"I've invited anyone with more than 100 million net worth. As for those with a net worth of less than 100 million, it doesn't matter whether they come or not…" Tenner said calmly.
"That's great. Even in the entire Orilon, only Mr. Wilson has this influence!" Arthur was very excited as his voice rose.
Under normal circumstances, everyone would address Yaakov as Sir Ward, while Tenner would be addressed as Mr. Ward. This also represented the difference in status between the two.
To put it simply, Tenner was just a substitute for Yaakov, a spokesperson.
"Sir Ward really wants to see that not only do we have more people on our side than Connor's, but we also want to see that there's no one on Connor's side. People should be on our side…" Tenner said expressionlessly.
Yaakov's influence was terrifying. Although Connor had some connections, Yaakov still had the final say in Orilon.
To put it bluntly, Connor's connections in Orilon were all Vanessa Canfield, Chelsea Lee, and Reena Satchwell.
How could these three people compare to a big shot like Yaakov?
"That's great! If those people really come to our opening ceremony, but Connor doesn't have one guest, then everyone in Orilon will know what's happening!" Arthur exclaimed.

chapters.title: Chapter 1370: A Powerful Line-up
chapters.content:
Chapter 1370: A Powerful Line-up
Connor had already offended Arthur more than once or twice.
Therefore, Arthur hated Connor to the bone. Especially after Connor took over Heavens Club, Arthur's hatred for Connor peaked.
Connor snatched Freya and then Heavens Club from him.
No one would be able to accept this!
"Just inviting some big shots from the business world is far from enough…" Tenner spoke again.
When Arthur heard Tenner's words, he could not help but be stunned momentarily. Then, he asked softly, "Mr. Ward, did you invite someone else?"
"Of course. I've also contacted some friends in the media. These media are all well-known big media in the country. In addition, our television station in Orilon will also come to cover this." Tenner said with a smile.
Arthur looked at Tenner, his face filled with shock.
He didn't expect Tenner to be so meticulous. He didn't just want to slap Connor's face now, but also to let everyone know how embarrassing Connor would be after slapping his face!
"Mr. Wilson won't make a move easily. Once he makes a move, Connor will be consigned to eternal damnation!"
Tenner sneered and continued, "If Connor was just making trouble in Porthampton, Mr. Wilson might not have bothered with him. But since he came to Orilon, Mr. Wilson must use this opportunity to let Connor understand that Orilon is not Davenport."
"That's right. We must embarrass Connor and force him out of Orilon!" Arthur said happily.
"Oh right, I also got someone to invite a celebrity over…" Tenner said.
"Which celebrity?" Arthur quickly asked,
"Someone called Kaitlyn Zoe or something. I asked my subordinates to do this. I'm unclear about the details, but this Kaitlyn is not cheap. I guess she should be quite famous…" Tenner said casually.
"Mr. Ward, Kaitlyn is considered the most popular female celebrity recently. You invited Kaitlyn over? Aren't you being too generous" Arthur said in shock.
Arthur wasn't actually flattering him when he said this because he had long thought of inviting celebrities. That way, the effect would be better. However, he contacted many people, and all the A-list celebrities asked for more than ten million dollars. Moreover, only those A-list celebrities who weren't very popular agreed. Those who were famous wouldn't even come if one had money!
As for a popular A-list female celebrity like Kaitlyn, Arthur did not even dare to think about it.
"What is so tough to please about Kaitlyn?"
Tenner looked at Arthur with a disdainful smile before saying, "Actually, I was planning to invite Yvette over…"
"Yvette?" Arthur blinked as he became even more shocked. He said in disbelief, "Mr. Ward, I heard that Yvette has never participated in any commercial activities. How could you invite Yvette?"
"I've been rather busy recently, so I haven't put all my energy into these things. If I had the time, inviting Yvette would be very easy. Even if Yvette doesn't lack money, I can think of other ways!" Tenner chuckled.
Arthur could tell that Tenner was obviously bragging. After all, a celebrity like Yvette was not someone ordinary could invite. Besides, Yvette was not from Orilon. Tenner's influence in Orilon did not mean he had the same influence in the country.
"That's true. It's enough as long as we can get Kaitlyn Zoer. There's no need to waste time on Yvette!" Arthur said with a smile.
"I think so too!" Tenner nodded.
Arthur was still very happy. After all, as long as he thought about the opening ceremony, he would make a fuss about it, but there might not be anyone on Connor's side. He felt particularly comfortable.
Ever since Arthur got to know Connor, no matter what he did, he would be slapped in the face by Connor. However, this time, he finally had the chance to return the slap. How could he not be happy?
"Mr. Ward, I wonder if you have time to watch this good show?" Arthur asked Tenner softly.
After hearing Arthur's offer, Tenner shook his head helplessly and said expressionlessly, "I have to go abroad in a few days, so I'll leave the rest to you. I won't be joining in the fun..."
"All right, all right…" Arthur nodded and seemed to be even happier.
If Tenner showed up, he would definitely steal Arthur's limelight. However, if Tenner did not show up, Arthur would be the boss of Triumph Club. Naturally, all eyes would be on him.
"Oh, right, I've contacted the mayor of Newtown. When the time comes, remember to ask him if he's free. If he's free, he should be able to come over…" Tenner spoke again.
"The mayor is coming over?"
Arthur looked at Tenner and was so excited that he didn't know what to say.
Arthur had never expected Tenner to be so well-prepared this time. Not only did he have a big shot in the business world, but he also had celebrity reporters. In the end, he even invited the mayor over.
Such an impressive lineup, Arthur felt a shiver down his back just thinking about it!
"I just casually told him about this before. I didn't expect him to really agree, but the premise is that he has to be free on the day of our opening, so you have to contact the mayor then!" Tenner whispered to Arthur.
"All right, all right, I understand…"
Arthur hurriedly nodded and then said with a smile, "Mr. Ward, in Orilon, I think only you and Mr. Wilson have the influence to do so. The others really can't get the mayor to do this…"
"Hehe, everyone is being respectful toward Mr. Wilson. It has nothing to do with me…" Tenner said calmly.
Arthur hesitated, then said with a flattering expression, "Mr. Ward, I know that you're usually busy with work, so I specially prepared a little something for you today to relax!"

chapters.title: Chapter 1371: Something Happened to Justin Spielberg
chapters.content:
Chapter 1371: Something Happened to Justin Spielberg
"A little something? What is it?"
Tenner was surprised, completely puzzled.
Arthur stood up, clapped his hands, and shouted, "All right, you can come in!"
After Arthur said this, a group of beautiful, tall women in uniforms walked in.
Each of these women was a goddess, but their styles differed. Some were sexy and mature, while others were pure and cute.
"Mr. Ward, these are all students I found from Newtown University. Please take a look and see if there's anything you like. You can take them now…" Arthur gritted his teeth.
Tenner sized up the group of uniformed women and then pointed at two more sexy women. He said lightly, "These two look pretty good. Come with me later!"
"Mr. Ward, you really have good taste. These two girls are still young. You have to teach them well…" Arthur said with a smile.
"Mr. Synder, you're kind. If you work hard with Mr. Wilson, I guarantee your future will be limitless!" Tenner patted Arthur's shoulder before turning around and leaving the room.
Arthur stood where he was and looked at Tenner's back. His expression was unusually happy.
Arthur knew very well that Tenner did not have any major flaws. The only thing he liked was women, and he was the kind of woman who would want to try any type of woman. Therefore, Arthur had prepared these before meeting Tenner, with the goal of satisfying his preferences.
After all, as long as one could build a good relationship with Tenner, it was equivalent to building a good relationship with Yaakov.
***
On the other side, after Connor returned home, he chatted with Rachel before returning to his room to rest.
Recently, Connor had been busy with the opening ceremony, so he didn't have much rest. However, now that everything was settled, Connor could finally rest well.
There were only two days left until the opening ceremony.
When Connor woke up, it was already past ten the next morning.
Connor looked at his phone and realized that he had received a text from Yvette.
Yvette had already left Newtown. However, she would be there on time to attend the opening ceremony on the day of Connor's opening ceremony.
Connor briefly replied with the time and place, then walked into the bathroom to wash up.
About half an hour later, Connor arrived at Newtown University alone.
However, when Connor walked into the classroom, he realized that the atmosphere in the classroom seemed to be a little off. Everyone was discussing something nervously.
Connor glanced around the classroom and did not see Justin, Brooks, and Joel.
"Did the three of them skip class?" Connor's eyes flashed with a trace of doubt.
"Connor, you're here!" Luna suddenly shouted at Connor.
"Ah…" Connor nodded lightly, then asked puzzledly, "Luna, do you know where Justin and the other two went? Why didn't they come to class?"
One had to know that not all students had the same privileges as Connor.
Newtown University was very strict with students' attendance. If they skipped classes often, they might be expelled.
Therefore, under normal circumstances, no one would dare to skip class.
Connor saw that Justin and Joel were not in the classroom and vaguely felt something was wrong.
"Something seems to have happened to the three of them. They should have been taken away by the police now…" Luna said seriously to Connor.
"The police took him away?" Connor was stunned when he heard that and was in disbelief.
"That's what I heard…" Luna looked at Connor and nodded.
Connor took a deep breath and walked up to Luna. He asked excitedly, "Luna, what's going on?"
"I'm not sure what exactly happened, but I know the police took them away…" Luna said helplessly.
"Phew…" Connor took a deep breath, then turned around and left the classroom.
Now that Justin, Brooks, and Joel were not around, Connor could only look for Ruth or Sia to ask what was happening.
A few minutes later, Connor saw Ruth in her class.
At this moment, Ruth's expression seemed very worried as well, as if she was at a loss.
"Ruth, come with me. I have something to ask you!" Connor rushed into Ruth's classroom and said expressionlessly.
Hearing that, she seemed a little excited. Then, she hurriedly followed Connor out of the classroom.
"Connor, you're finally back. I'm about to die of anxiety. Something has happened to Brooks and the other two. Only you can save the three of them now…"
After walking out of the classroom, Ruth said to Connor.
"Don't be anxious now. Tell me in detail what exactly happened…" Connor asked in a low voice.
"It's all that b*tch Sonia's fault. If it weren't for that b*tch, Brooks and the other two wouldn't have been in trouble. Now that something has happened, that b*tch has gone into hiding. I'm so angry…" Ruth said angrily.
"This is related to Sonia? What exactly happened?" Connor frowned and asked.
"…"
Ruth took a deep breath and slowly said, "Well, some time ago, Sonia hooked up with a rich heir. You know that b*tch Sonia has always sought a rich heir. The people she knows are all from that circle, so she stopped contacting us for a long time. But then, for some reason, Sonia took the initiative to get together with us again. She even said she had broken up with that rich heir…"
"And then?" Connor frowned and asked.
"After school last night, a few of us danced at the bar. Sonia bumped into her rich ex-boyfriend. That man must have drunk too much, so he quarreled with Sonia. He said something about asking Sonia to pay up. If Sonia didn't pay up, she wouldn't let Sonia leave. Justin was also very angry at that time. She couldn't stand it anymore, so she advised her…"
Ruth paused momentarily and then continued, "However, not only did that rich heir embarrass Justin, but he even mocked Justin and said that Justin's father was a cripple..."

chapters.title: Chapter 1372: Framing My Friends
chapters.content:
Chapter 1372: Framing My Friends
Connor knew that Justin's father's legs were bad, but also because of the poor conditions. Overwork caused joint disease, so he walked a little awkwardly, but he was not crippled.
Justin had always disliked people saying his father was a cripple, so he rarely mentioned this.
This could also be said to be Justin's reverse scale.
"Connor, you know that Justin hates it when people call his father a cripple. In addition, he had a little too much to drink, and they started fighting!"
Ruth looked at Connor and said.
"This small matter shouldn't be enough to get the police involved, right?" Connor said with a frown.
"That's right. Justin and the others fought for less than half a minute before they were pulled away by the security guards. That rich heir was fine. I saw him walk out of the bar with my own eyes. However, last night, the police took Justin, Brooks, and Joel away. They also said the three had seriously injured that rich heir and even broke his arm. They might be sentenced to jail…" Ruth said anxiously.
"…" Connor looked at Ruth without saying anything.
At this moment, Connor seemed to have understood what was going on. It was obvious that the other party was relying on his background to frame Justin, Brooks, and Joel.
Usually, such matters could be resolved privately. After all, it was normal for young people to be reckless.
However, once someone called the police, the situation was different.
First of all, the rich heir claimed Justin broke his hand, so it could be a serious injury.
It would mean at least three years of jail time if he were seriously injured.
In addition, this rich heir used his background to manipulate things. It would likely bring jail time up to seven, eight, or even more than ten years.
Therefore, in today's society, if one acted on impulse, it was very likely to cause very big consequences.
Of course, this consequence also depended on whether one had connections. If one had connections, then things wouldn't be so complicated.
"Do you know where the police took the three of them?" Connor looked at Ruth and asked.
"I'm not too sure about that…" Ruth shook her head gently.
"All right, got it. I'll save the three of them. Don't worry!"
Connor whispered back to Ruth, then turned around and left.
After leaving Ruth, Connor took out his phone and dialed Clio's phone.
"Ring, ring, ring…"
Clio now regarded Connor as his great benefactor, so he quickly picked up the phone and asked respectfully, "Mr. McDonald, do you have any orders?"
"Inspector Lee, I have three friends whom your people took away. Help me find out where they are now and what happened!" Connor said quickly.
Connor was also very worried about the safety of Justin, Brooks, and Joel, so he still sounded very anxious.
"Mr. McDonald, what are the names of your three friends?" Clio hurriedly replied.
"Justin, Brooks, Joel!" Connor replied.
"Okay, Mr. McDonald, wait for my call!" Clio replied and then hung up.
After Connor put down his phone, he waited quietly.
About five minutes later, Connor received a call from Clio. He knew that Justin and the other two should now be in the city bureau.
Therefore, Connor didn't say much. He left Newtown University and took a taxi to the city bureau.
When Connor arrived at the station, he found that Clio was already standing at the door waiting for Connor.
After Connor saw Clio, he sighed inwardly. Clio was indeed a very good person.
"Inspector Lee, why are you here?" Connor asked despite knowing the answer.
"Mr. McDonald, you're not familiar with Newtown. Many people don't know you. I'm worried that it might be very troublesome for you to come alone, so I specially came over. When the time comes, I'll introduce you to the bureau chief of the municipal bureau. This way, it'll be much easier to get things done…" Clio whispered to Connor.
"Thank you!" Connor didn't say much and simply replied.
However, to Clio, he only wanted this thank you.
If he could make the legendary Mr. McDonald of Porthampton owe him a favor, he would definitely benefit a lot in the future.
"Mr. McDonald, let's go in quickly!" Clio immediately led Connor into the hall.
Due to Clio's company, Connor could easily meet the person in charge of Newtown, Teagan Howe.
"Hello, Mr. McDonald!"
Teagan must have learned Connor's identity from Clio, so he was very respectful to Connor. He took the initiative to stand up and walk to Connor, greeting enthusiastically.
"Hello, Chief Howe…" Connor replied indifferently.
"Mr. McDonald, I've heard about you before. Now that I've seen you today, you're a young hero…"
Teagan seemed to be planning to exchange pleasantries with Connor.
However, Connor was not in the mood to talk nonsense with Teagan. He said directly, "Chief Howe, I came here today for my three friends. Where are my friends now? What's going on?"
"Mr. McDonald, I just asked about the situation. Actually, this isn't big or small. It's just a small conflict between a few young people, but one of them is called Holden. He's not someone to be trifled with…" Teagan said slowly.
"How so?"
Connor frowned and asked.
"I heard that Holden's family has some background. This time, Holden went through the province's connections. Although Holden wasn't injured, he claimed your friend broke his arm. We had no choice but to arrest him according to the rules…" Teagan said in a low voice.
"So you're saying that Holden used his own connections to frame my friend, right?" Connor asked in a low voice.
"That's right, that's what happened!" Teagan nodded and continued, "Mr. McDonald, you know we are all running errands for others. Some things are not up to us to decide. We have to do whatever the higher-ups want us to do…"
"…"
Connor looked at Teagan and hesitated, then said expressionlessly, "All right, I roughly understand what happened. Where is my friends now? Take me to my friends…"
"Yes, Mr. McDonald, this way please…" Teagan hurriedly led Connor out of the office.

chapters.title: Chapter 1373: Aren't You Afraid of Offending Me?
chapters.content:
Chapter 1373: Aren't You Afraid of Offending Me?
A few minutes later, Connor finally saw Justin, Brooks, and Joel.
When Connor saw the trio, he was stunned.
According to Ruth, although both sides had fought, they had not fought, so no one should have been injured.
However, Justin and Joel looked exceptionally miserable. Their arms were bandaged, and their bodies had many bruises and wounds.
"Connor, why are you here?" Justin shouted excitedly when she saw Connor.
"Who did this?" Connor gritted his teeth and asked Justin.
"Connor, listen to me. This has nothing to do with you. Hurry and leave this place. I've already asked my family to find someone to deal with this. The lawyer will be here soon. Hurry up and leave..."
Justin knew about Holden's background. If Connor were involved in this, it would only implicate Connor. That was why he advised Connor to leave as soon as possible.
"Didn't Ruth say that the three of you weren't injured? What's going on?" Connor did not take Justin's words to heart and asked agitatedly.
"Connor, don't worry about this. Go do what you should do now!" Brooks added.
"That's right, Connor. We really don't have anything to do."
"Am I still your brother?" Connor asked in a low voice.
Justin, Brooks, and Joel were stunned when they heard Connor's words. They looked at Connor without saying anything.
"If the three of you still treat me as your brother, tell me what's going on!" Connor said expressionlessly.
"Connor, it's no good for you if you know…" Justin said helplessly.
"Cut the crap. What's going on?" Connor gritted his teeth and asked.
"…"
Justin looked at Connor and took a deep breath. Then, he roughly told Connor what had happened.
What happened was similar to what Ruth had told him. However, Holden brought people to Justin's dormitory last night and beat them up. Then, the police appeared!
After knowing what had happened, Connor was so angry that his entire body trembled. He felt that Holden had gone too far.
Holden had beaten Justin and the others up, but he still wanted to sue Justin, claiming that they had beaten him.
"Holden is simply unreasonable!" Connor took a deep breath and said coldly.
During this period, Connor had seen many rich heirs. Any one of them might have a more substantial background than Holden, but this was the first time Connor had seen someone bully others like him.
"Connor, don't worry about this. It's all my fault for provoking Holden. I implicated Joel and Brooks, but it's okay. I will scour my family connections and take all the blame myself. As long as Brooks and Joel are fine…" Justin said worriedly to Connor.
"Justin, what the f*ck are you talking about? Didn't we already discuss this? If anything happens, we'll shoulder it together!" Brooks shouted, his eyes widened.
"That's right. You can't shoulder Justin's matter alone…" Joel added.
"All right, you three don't have to argue with me here. This started because of me. Just do whatever I say. It's better for one person to be in trouble than for all three of us…" Justin shouted in frustration.
"…"
Connor looked at Justin and Joel without saying anything.
Justin raised her head and glanced at Connor, then said with a smile, "About that, Connor, if there's nothing else, you can go back first. You don't have to worry about this…"
"…"
Connor looked at Justin and still did not say anything.
"Mr. McDonald, Holden has connections in his family. Otherwise, he wouldn't dare to do this…" Teagan whispered to Connor.
"So what if it's related? Did he think he could be lawless just because he had connections?" Connor asked.
Teagan looked at Connor with embarrassment.
"If you want to compare connections with the background, I've never fucking lost in this aspect!"
Connor shouted angrily, then continued, "Since Holden wants to kill my friends, I'll take him out on a spin…"
"Mr. McDonald, what do you mean?" Clio asked nervously.
"Simple. Let go of my friend first…" Connor said expressionlessly.
"…"
A strange look flashed in Clio's eyes, and then he turned to look at Teagan.
After all, Justin's people were all in Teagan's hands, so this kind of thing still had to be decided by Teagan.
Teagan was a bit awkward. He took a deep breath and whispered to Connor, "Mr. McDonald, the higher-ups intend to arrest these three people. If I let them go now, I'm worried..."
"What are you worried about?" Connor asked.
"…"
Teagan looked at Connor without saying anything.
"Are you worried about offending someone you shouldn't?" Connor asked domineeringly.
Justin, Brooks, and Joel looked at Connor with shocked expressions.
They never thought Connor would have the guts to talk to Teagan like that. Although they knew Connor might have some background, they didn't know that Connor's background was so terrifying.
"Chief Howe, if you're worried about offending someone you shouldn't, aren't you worried about offending me?" Connor looked at Teagan and continued.
Teagan didn't know what to do. He took a deep breath and said in a low voice, "Mr. McDonald, you're making things difficult for me!"
"As long as you let my friends go now, if anyone dares to find trouble with you in the future, I'll help you deal with them!" Connor looked at Teagan and said lightly.
"Mr. McDonald, are you sure?" Teagan hurriedly said.
"Of course, I've said it; I'll bear all the consequences!" Connor said lightly.
"All right, I'll go and settle the procedures now…"
Teagan was relieved after hearing Connor's words. He turned around and was about to leave.
However, when Teagan turned around, a few young men walked in, talking and laughing.
Teagan was shocked when he saw the man in the lead. Then, he quickly turned and said to Connor, "Mr. McDonald, this is Holden!"

chapters.title: Chapter 1374: Getting Back Together
chapters.content:
Chapter 1374: Getting Back Together
Connor narrowed his eyes and looked at Holden without saying anything.
Justin, Brooks, and Joel's eyes were filled with anger, but they did not dare to say anything because they knew it would not benefit them if they made a big fuss.
But what Connor couldn't understand was that Sonia was also with Holden, and Holden had his arm around her shoulder.
At this moment, Sonia didn't seem as proud as before. There was a hint of worry on her delicate face.
Justin had told Connor that Sonia had already broken up with Holden, but Holden had been pestering Sonia, which was why Justin and the others had a conflict with Holden.
But now, it seemed that Sonia and Holden had made up.
Justin and the others had been beaten up like this because of Sonia, and they might even be imprisoned. Sonia had ignored Justin and the others and even appeared at the city bureau with Holden.
Connor's impression of Sonia had hit rock bottom.
Previously, Connor thought Sonia was a materialistic girl, but her character wasn't bad. However, Connor never thought that Sonia would be such a person.
"Mr. Matt, you're here?"
Teagan didn't want to offend Holden, so he took the initiative to talk to Holden.
"Chief Howe, where are the three people who beat me up last night? I want to see them…" Holden replied arrogantly.
"They're right here!" Teagan hurriedly said.
Holden glanced at Teagan and walked to Justin, Brooks, and Joel.
"How are the three of you doing inside?" Holden asked Justin with a smile.
Justin scanned Holden from head to toe, then turned her gaze to Sonia. She didn't seem to understand why Sonia was with Holden.
"Looks like you're doing quite well. I came here mainly to tell the three of you that Sonia has changed her mind, and we are back together…" Holden said with a smile.
Justin, Brooks, and Joel were all surprised and in disbelief.
"Sonia, what's going on?" Justin asked Sonia in disbelief.
"Justin, I'm sorry…" Sonia whispered back to Justin.
"Sonia, didn't you tell us you didn't want to be with this person? Why did you reconcile with him? What's going on? Are you playing with us?" Brooks shouted.
Holden scanned Brooks up and down, then smiled and said, "Damn fatty, don't tell me you still don't understand what's happening? I had a small conflict with Sonia before, but now that the conflict between Sonia and me has been resolved, we are back together again…"
"Impossible, this is impossible!"
Justin couldn't believe that what Holden said was true. He shouted agitatedly and asked Sonia, "Sonia, tell me the truth. Is that the case?"
"…"
Sonia looked at Justin, and a trace of hesitation flashed in her eyes.
"Sonia, say something. Is this true?" Justin shouted, his eyes widened.
"It's true. I've already gotten back together with Holden…" Sonia bit her lip and said in a low voice.
Connor looked at Sonia calmly and didn't say a word.
Justin, Brooks, and Joel were also in disbelief. They felt like they had been played like fools. If Sonia hadn't said that Holden had mistreated her, Justin wouldn't have helped her.
But in the end, they got back together.
Justin and the others did not know what to say.
"All right, I'm not in the mood to talk nonsense with you guys. Since I've already reconciled with Sonia, you guys are considered Sonia's friends, so I don't plan to continue making things difficult for the three of you. If the three of you apologize to me now, I won't pursue the three of you…" Holden said to Justin with a smile.
"You want me to apologize to you?" Justin's eyes widened as he shouted angrily.
"That's right. You three hit me. Aren't the three of you going to apologize? If you don't want to apologize, that's fine. You'll wait to hear from my lawyer!" Holden smiled and said,
"This is so f*cking funny. You were the one who beat the three of us up. You're fine, but now you want us to apologize to you?"
Justin was in a terrible mood because of Sonia's betrayal. He spoke angrily.
"Why?" Holden sneered and said disdainfully, "I'll tell you why now. Just because I'm richer than you and my family background is better than yours, you must apologize to me now. If you don't apologize, you'll be in prison for the rest of your life!"
"Justin, don't be rash. Hurry up and apologize. You can leave after you apologize!" Sonia said to Justin.
"Sonia is right. As long as you apologize now, you can leave. I only let the three of you go because of Sonia. If it weren't for Sonia, I wouldn't have let you go!" Holden said arrogantly.
"Justin, hurry up and apologize. You're not a match for Holden. There's no need to continue making a scene!" Sonia said worriedly.
"Why should I apologize?" Justin's eyes were filled with tears as he shouted with a trembling voice.
He was very reluctant but had no choice because he knew he could only leave this place if he apologized. If he didn't apologize, he wouldn't be able to leave.
"I'm not in the mood to talk nonsense with you. I'll give you one last chance. Are you going to apologize or not?" Holden asked Justin in frustration.
"You should be the one apologizing, right?" Connor suddenly said.
Holden turned to look at Connor and said disdainfully, "Who are you? Do you have the right to speak?"
"It doesn't matter who I am, but I know that you beat up my friend and framed him. You should be the one apologizing now!" Connor said calmly to Holden.

chapters.title: Chapter 1375: Breaking Bones
chapters.content:
Chapter 1375: Breaking Bones
"Ah, d*mn, you brat…" Holden said as he tried to stand up.
Sonia reached out to stop Holden, then whispered to Connor, "Connor, you don't know what's happening. Can you stop talking? As long as Justin and the others apologize, this will be over!"
"This will be over?" Connor looked at Sonia and sneered. Then he pointed at Justin and the others and shouted, "Take a good look at Justin and the other two. Now, you want them to apologize to be let go. How?"
"What do you know? Things are not as you think!" Sonia shouted.
"If it's not what I think it is, what else can it be? Is it because this person had some influential background that he can do as he pleased?" Connor stared at Sonia and asked.
"Connor, I beg you. Don't cause trouble…" Sonia bit her lip and said anxiously.
"I'm not causing trouble. There must be an explanation for today's matter!" Connor replied in a low voice.
"Who the f*ck do you think you are? You want an explanation from me?"
Holden was very unhappy when he heard Connor's words. He stood up and glared at Connor.
"Holden, don't be rash. Connor just said the wrong thing in a moment of confusion…" Sonia quickly stood up and tried to stop Holden.
"Get lost…" Holden pushed Sonia aside.
Holden was very strong, and Sonia was just a weak girl. Therefore, Holden had managed to shove her to the ground.
Sonia looked at Connor in extreme despair because she knew in her heart that all her previous efforts had been in vain because of Connor.
Holden walked up to Connor and scanned him. He then asked Connor in disdain, "Brat, are you the only one who wants an explanation from me?"
"You were the one who beat up Justin and the other two, right?" Connor asked expressionlessly.
"Yes, I beat up these three people. So what are you going to do?" Holden threatened with a pout.
"What am I going to do?" Connor sneered.
"Brat, I'm not afraid to tell you that not only did I beat up the three of them, I'm going to sue them now. I want them all to go to jail. No one can leave without eight to ten years of jail time. You think you're my match?" Holden pointed at Connor's nose and asked.
"Haha…" Connor looked at Holden and smiled. "I hope you are still so arrogant later!"
"What do you mean?" Holden blinked.
Connor ignored Holden and turned to Teagan. "What did this person's injury assessment say?"
"Right arm fracture…" Teagan replied.
"All right, since his right hand is fractured, I think he's fine now, why don't we just give him a fracture!"
Connor's expression was a little ugly. He reached out and grabbed Holden's arm.
"What... What are you doing?"
After being grabbed by Connor, Holden's expression was a little confused. He widened his eyes and said, "Do you know what this place is? How dare you attack me here?"
"Why do you talk so much nonsense!" Connor's eyes flashed with a trace of frustration, and then he exerted strength with both hands.
"Ah…" Then, Holden screamed and fell to the ground.
Everyone could hear the sound of bones breaking.
For a moment, everyone present was dumbfounded. They stood rooted to the ground with an incredulous expression on their faces.
No one expected Connor to dare break Holden's arm here, and it all happened so suddenly that even Teagan and Clio did not know what was happening.
Holden cradled his arm and lay on the ground, howling. His face was filled with pain.
"I'm done, I'm done, I'm done, I'm done, I'm done."
When Sonia saw this scene, her face was filled with despair because she didn't expect Connor to do that.
Connor's actions had completely ruined all her previous efforts.
Brooks and Joel looked at Connor in a daze, as if they didn't know what had happened.
"What are you all doing? He broke my arm just now. Didn't you see that? Hurry up and arrest him. I want to kill him…" Holden screamed at Teagan as he lay on the ground.
Teagan looked helpless. After all, it was Holden on one side and Connor on the other.
These two people were not to be trifled with. Teagan obviously didn't know who to help.
Therefore, Teagan and Clio pretended they didn't see anything at this time. When the other policemen saw that Teagan didn't react, they naturally didn't dare to be nosy.
"Previously, you accused my friend of breaking your right hand. Now that I have really broken your right hand, we'll call this even!" Connor looked at Holden with a faint smile, then continued to walk toward Holden.
"What else do you want to do? Do you know who I am? If you dare to touch me again, I'll definitely make you regret coming to this world. You better remember this!" Holden shouted at Connor.
"Are you threatening me?" Connor sneered.
Sonia knew Connor was planning to attack Holden, so she quickly stood before Connor and shouted, "Connor, do you know what you are doing? You've caused much trouble! Stop it now!"
"Get lost!" Connor hated Sonia very much. After all, the culprit of all this was this woman.
"I won't move away. You really can't hit him. Otherwise, Holden will definitely not let you off…" Sonia shouted.
"It is because of you that Justin and the other two are harmed. I don't want to talk to you now. Hurry up and get out of my way, or I'll beat you up too!" Connor said to Sonia coldly.
"What do you know?" Sonia's eyes widened as she shouted excitedly. Then she continued, "I know I caused this, but I agreed to get back together with Holden to save Justin and the other two. Holden has already promised me that he will let Justin and the others go as long as I can sleep with him. Now, Justin and the others only need to apologize, and this will be over. I'll deal with the trouble that I caused myself. If you really beat Holden up, I won't be able to save you…"
Sonia said with tears in her eyes.

chapters.title: Chapter 1376: We Meet Again
chapters.content:
Chapter 1376: We Meet Again
After all, she felt very wronged because she didn't want to get back together with Holden. She only wanted to save Justin, Brooks, and Joel.
Justin finally understood what was happening after hearing Sonia's words.
Connor glanced at Sonia and didn't say anything. He pushed Sonia away and walked up to Holden.
Holden looked at Connor's face and realized that Teagan and the others didn't stop Connor when he hit him. This meant that Connor might have quite some influence.
"Didn't you say that just now? As long as I have more money and background than you, I can do whatever I want!" Connor said to Holden.
"What do you want? Do you know who my cousin is? If you dare to touch me again…"
"Thud!" Before Holden could finish, Connor raised his right leg and stepped on Holden's knee.
"Ah…" Holden let out a series of squeals like a pig being slaughtered, his expression extremely ugly.
Connor's kick crushed Holden's knee. Holden would never be able to stand up again.
When Justin, Brooks, Joel, and the others saw this scene, they were very satisfied. However, they were more worried about Connor. After all, they knew that Holden was not someone to be trifled with.
Sonia sat on the ground. She had already agreed with Holden that as long as Holden released Justin and the others, she would sleep with Holden. However, she never expected Connor's appearance to disrupt all her plans.
Now that Connor had beaten Holden up, she had no other choice.
"Just wait. I'm going to kill you. Just you wait…" Holden shouted at Connor.
Connor looked at Holden and didn't say anything.
"What are you all doing? Hurry up and call my cousin and ask him to come over…" Holden turned around and shouted at his friends.
Meanwhile, the few friends that Holden brought with him were shocked by Connor's actions. They only reacted after hearing Holden's order and quickly took out their phones to make a call.
Connor didn't continue to attack Holden. Instead, he turned to Teagan and said, "Can you let my friend go now?"
"All right, all right…"
Teagan hurriedly nodded and signaled for Justin, Brooks, and Joel to be released.
After Justin came out, he hurriedly ran to Connor's side and said anxiously, "Connor, are you crazy? Why did you hit him? Do you know how much trouble this will cause you?"
"That's right, Connor, aren't you being too impulsive?" Brooks also frowned.
"It's fine. This person can't do anything to me. Don't worry!" Connor replied indifferently, asking, "Are the three of you okay?"
"We are fine. I'm just worried about you…" Justin said helplessly.
"What do I have to worry about? As long as you three are fine, let's go!"
After saying this, Connor looked at Sonia and said softly, "You should come with us!"
"You can't leave. All of you have to wait here. My cousin will be here soon…"
But at that moment, Holden, lying on the ground, shouted at the top of his lungs.
Connor smiled and said, "You called for reinforcements?"
"That's right. My cousin is about to arrive. None of you can leave…" Holden said intermittently.
"Haha…" Connor smiled disdainfully and said playfully, "All right, since you have called for reinforcements, I will wait here. I want to see just what kind of background you have behind you to be able to make you so arrogant…"
"Connor, Holden's cousin is really powerful. Why don't you guys leave…" Sonia seemed worried about Connor, so she couldn't help but gently advise him.
"It's okay, I'll wait here!" Connor replied indifferently.
Seeing that Connor didn't plan to leave, Teagan sighed a sigh of relief. His expression relaxed a lot.
After all, if Connor took Justin, Brooks, and the others away, and Holden's people started to investigate, he wouldn't be able to explain himself.
Justin, Brooks, and the others planned to persuade Connor to leave immediately. However, they also knew Connor's personality and temper. Connor definitely wouldn't leave now, so they didn't say anything. Instead, they sat quietly beside Connor and waited.
Everyone waited for almost ten minutes.
"Who broke my cousin's arms and legs?" A familiar voice rang out.
After hearing this voice, Connor instinctively looked at the door. When Connor saw the young man who walked in angrily, he couldn't help but smile. Then, he secretly sighed that he was fated with this person!
"Hey, I'm here. Hurry up and give me a hand."
Holden was on a stretcher. The medical staff had been waiting outside, but Holden was reluctant to leave. He insisted on waiting for his cousin to come.
"Holdy…"
The young man shouted angrily when he saw what had happened to Holden. Then, he ran to Holden's side.
After all, Holden was a well-known rich heir in Newtown. He liked to find virgin female college students in school and give them to the young man. Whenever Holden encountered trouble, the young man would solve it for him.
"Hey, why are you only here now?" When Holden saw the young man, he burst into tears.
"Just who beat my younger cousin to such a state? Hurry up and show yourself…" The young man gritted his teeth and shouted ferociously.
"I did!" Connor, who had been sitting quietly in the corner, slowly said.
"You…"
The young man turned and looked at Connor.
However, when he saw who the person was, he was stunned and stopped shouting abruptly. He was abnormally shocked, and there was a hint of fear on his face.
"It hasn't even been a day, and we've met again!" Connor said to the young man with a smile.
The young man seemed in disbelief. He hurriedly rubbed his eyes and then did something that no one present had expected.
The young man kneeled with a thud.
Of course, the young man didn't kneel because Connor wanted him to but because he was terrified of Connor.

chapters.title: Chapter 1377: Holden's Cousin
chapters.content:
Chapter 1377: Holden's Cousin
For a moment, almost everyone present was dumbfounded.
No one knew what was going on.
Everyone thought that Holden's cousin would not let Connor off easily. He might even send Connor to prison. By then, it would be a competition of who had the stronger relationship.
However, no one expected that after seeing Connor, Holden's cousin would kneel in front of Connor.
Everyone was in disbelief.
"Cousin, why are you kneeling?" Holden asked with a frown when he saw the young man kneeling.
"Shut the f*ck up!" The young man glared at him.
Holden looked at the young man's face and was even more confused.
After all, Holden had called the young man over to help him, but who would have thought that the young man would kneel?
Connor looked at the young man before him and couldn't help but smile. This young man was none other than Jace Sackmann, who had just escaped Connor's grasp last night.
Connor never thought it would be such a coincidence that Holden's cousin was Jace.
However, this was also a good thing for Connor. After all, Jace was now very clear about Connor's identity and background, so the rest of the things could be much simpler.
"Mr. Mc... Mr. McDonald, how…How is it you?" The young man kneeled and stammered as he asked Connor.
"What are you doing here? Surrendering?" Connor asked Jace softly.
"No, no. I heard that my cousin was beaten up, so I came over. But I didn't expect it to be you, Mr. McDonald. Mr. McDonald, I'm sorry. My cousin failed to recognize you. This is all my cousin's fault. I'll take him away now…" Jace said nervously to Connor.
Connor scanned Jace up and down, then said expressionlessly, "You don't seem to have figured out what's going on, and you already think that this is your cousin's fault?"
"No matter what, my cousin has offended you, Mr. McDonald. It's my cousin's fault…"
Jace knew very well how terrifying Connor was, so even if he had ten thousand guts, he would not dare to offend Connor.
"Well, this girl doesn't want to be with your cousin anymore, but your cousin has been pestering her. Then, my friend had a small conflict with your cousin, and your cousin wanted to put my friend in jail," Connor told Jace calmly.
After hearing Connor's words, Jace inhaled sharply and hurriedly said, "Mr. McDonald, I don't think there's anything wrong with what you've done. I know that this cousin of mine needs to be taught a lesson. Mr. McDonald, you've done the right thing…"
"Then will your cousin find trouble with my friend in the future?" Connor casually asked Jace.
"Mr. McDonald, what are you talking about? He would never dare to provoke your friend even if you gave him a hundred guts. I will teach him a lesson when I get back. Don't worry, Mr. McDonald…" Jace said respectfully.
"Since you understand, then I'll cut the crap. Hurry up and leave!" Connor whispered to Jace.
After Jace heard Connor's words, he did not hesitate and hurriedly shouted at the crowd, "What are you guys still standing there for? Hurry up and get Holden out of here…"
Lying on the stretcher, Holden didn't understand what was happening. He shouted, "Cousin, you haven't helped me teach this person a lesson. Why are you bringing me away?"
"Shut the f*ck up!"
Jace looked at Holden's face and thought that he would have gotten into trouble with Connor if Holden hadn't reacted so quickly today. Therefore, Jace didn't have any other thoughts. He had to leave this place as soon as possible and leave that demon called Connor.
Although Holden had no brain, he could feel something was wrong from Jace's expression, so he didn't say anything more and let everyone carry him into the ambulance.
A moment later, Jace left with Holden in a hurry.
The people present still did not seem to understand what was going on.
Sonia, in particular, couldn't believe what she had just seen.
After all, Holden had always told her that her cousin was not only a big shot, but his family background was also very powerful. However, today was the first time Sonia met Holden's cousin, and it turned out disappointing. Sonia was shocked.
Of course, Sonia also understood that all of them might have underestimated Connor's strength.
Clio and Teagan were also a little dumbfounded because they had only heard about how terrifying the influence of Davenport's Mr. McDonald was, but they had never seen it with their own eyes.
This time, the two finally understood how terrifying this so-called Davenport's Mr. McDonald was.
How many people could make Jace so afraid in this country?
"Chief Howe and Inspector Lee, I'm sorry to have disturbed the two of you today. If nothing else, I'll take my friends and leave…"
Connor walked to Teagan and Clio and said softly.
"Mr. McDonald, where are you going? Shall I get someone to send you there?" Teagan hurriedly offered.
"All right, send my friends to the hospital for a proper checkup first!" Connor nodded.
"All right, all right. I'll go and arrange it now…"
"Okay," Connor replied, then turned around and left.
At this moment, Justin, Brooks, and Joel seemed to stare at Connor. Now, the three of them were very doubtful.
Although the three knew that Connor's background was not simple and that he was probably a rich heir, they did not expect Connor's background to be so strong. Even someone like Teagan listened to Connor's orders.
A few minutes later, everyone entered the police car and drove straight to the hospital.
Teagan also helped Justin and the others contact Newton University and clarified everything. They had failed in their duties and arrested the wrong person. This would also prevent the university from punishing Justin and the other two because of this.

chapters.title: Chapter 1378: Who Are You?
chapters.content:
Chapter 1378: Who Are You?
After entering the hospital, Justin, Brooks, and Joel were thoroughly checked.
Brooks and Joel's condition was not bad. They only had some superficial injuries, but they had to stay in the hospital for a day to observe before returning to school.
Justin's right hand was fractured, but it was not particularly serious. He should be able to recover after some time.
Connor was relieved when he knew that the three of them were okay.
"Connor, I really have to thank you for today's matter. If it was not for you, I reckon that the best outcome would have been me going to prison…" Justin said very seriously to Connor.
"That's right, Connor. Thank you for today's matter. You're really so cool. I didn't expect you to be so powerful…" Brooks hurriedly added.
Sonia instinctively glanced at Connor. She was very grateful to Connor. After all, if it weren't for Connor, Sonia wouldn't have been able to escape from Holden's control.
"Why are you guys being so polite to me?" Connor said with a smile.
"Although we have a good relationship, we must thank you…" Justin smiled and replied. Then, she sized up Connor and solemnly asked, "Connor, who are you? Can you just let us know?"
Reveal his identity?
Connor couldn't help but smile when he heard Justin, Brooks, and the others' words. He was a little helpless because this was probably the question he had been asked the most so far.
Of course, this was also one of the questions Connor hated answering the most.
After all, Connor's identity was really complicated. It was not easy to explain these problems.
"Connor, we originally thought you were just an ordinary rich heir, so we didn't think much about it. But now, I feel you're not an ordinary rich heir…"
Justin said to Connor in a somber tone.
Connor looked at Justin, smiled, and asked playfully, "How do you know I'm just an ordinary rich heir?"
"Isn't that simple? The fact that those people could talk to you like that today means that you're not an ordinary person!" Justin replied to Connor and then continued, "Who is Holden? He wasn't injured, but he claimed his arm was broken, and the police had no choice but to believe him. Holden's background already made our family despair, let alone Holden's cousin."
"Yeah, but you beat up Holden today, and his cousin didn't dare to say anything. This means that you must be really influential, to the point that we can't even imagine it…" Brooks added.
"Haha…"
Connor looked at Justin and Brooks with a faint smile and said nothing.
Justin hesitated before continuing, "Actually, Connor, we don't have any other intentions when we ask about your identity. We're just curious. You don't have to worry that we'll pester you daily for help after discovering your identity…"
"Even if you ask me to help, I won't!" Connor joked before he continued, "If I explain my identity to you now, you might not know who I am. How about this? My club will open in a few days. I planned to give you membership cards. You should just come to the opening ceremony."
"Your club is about to open?" Justin was a little shocked.
"That's right. It's my clubhouse!" Connor nodded.
"What's the name of your club?" Justin asked in confusion.
"You'll know when the time comes!" Connor didn't answer this question directly. Instead, he slowly stood up and said, "All right, it's getting late. You three should have a good rest. I'll tell you when my club opens."
After saying this, Connor stood up and walked out of the ward.
Justin, Brooks, and Joel were puzzled. After all, the three of them had asked for a long time but had not gotten anything from him.
After Connor left the ward, he planned to go home.
However, just as Connor walked out of the hospital, he heard someone call after him.
Connor turned around and saw Sonia chasing after him.
"Connor, wait a moment!" Sonia shouted anxiously at Connor.
Connor looked at Sonia. He now knew that Sonia had gotten back together with Holden just to save Justin and the others, so he had already forgiven her.
"Is there anything?"
After Sonia walked up to Connor, Connor asked Sonia softly.
Sonia adjusted her breathing and whispered, "Connor, thank you for today!"
"What are you thanking me for?" Connor was surprised and asked.
"Today, you saved Justin and the others. Justin and the others got into trouble because of me, so I want to thank you. Also, thank you for letting me get rid of Holden. If it weren't for you, Holden might have ruined my life!" Sonia said seriously.
"I see!" Connor smiled faintly and said softly, "Actually, you don't have to be so nice. I'm only doing this because of Justin and the others!"
"No matter who you did this for, I must thank you!" Sonia hurriedly replied to Connor.
Connor looked at Sonia then asked in a puzzled tone, "I remember you had a boyfriend before. Why are you with someone like Holden again?"
"…"
Sonia looked at Connor without saying anything.
"It's fine if you don't want to answer these questions…" Connor said with a smile.
"Actually, all of this is because of you!" Sonia suddenly said to Connor.
"Because of me?"
Connor was a little shocked, then asked in confusion, "Don't pull my leg. What does your matter have to do with me?"
"You know very well in your heart that I have feelings for you…" Sonia whispered.
"I know you have a good impression of me, but I feel that your good impression of me is because of my background and my money, so I can't accept your good impression!"
Seeing that Sonia had explained everything, he didn't have to continue playing dumb.

chapters.title: Chapter 1379: A Materialistic Woman
chapters.content:
Chapter 1379: A Materialistic Woman
"That's right. I admit that I'm a materialistic woman. I also want to integrate into the so-called high society, but Connor, don't forget that when I first met you, I didn't know your identity," Sonia said expressionlessly.
"Did you have a good impression of me when you first met me?" Connor asked in surprise.
"Yes. I already had a good impression of you when I first met you. It's just that I hid it very well, so I didn't show it!"
Sonia nodded and then said with a yearning expression, "I used to be an innocent little girl. I yearned to have my one true love. I also hoped to meet someone who truly liked me, and I, him…
"But later on, I slowly realized that no matter what kind of love you have, it has to be built on a material foundation. Without a material foundation, everything is just a bubble that the wind can blow away at any time. This is also why I only choose someone rich and from a strong background when I choose a boyfriend. You can think I'm materialistic, but don't you men like beautiful women too? I don't think there's anything wrong with this…"
Connor nodded at Sonia, then said softly, "I don't think the word 'material' has any negative connotation. This is everyone's choice. Men can look at a woman's appearance and figure, and women can look at a man's background and status."
"That's right. That's why even if I had feelings for you then, I wouldn't show it because I couldn't be with an ordinary person. An ordinary person couldn't satisfy what I wanted. Even if we were together, we would still separate!" Sonia looked at Connor and continued.
"And then?" Connor asked.
"Later on, I slowly discovered the things that you were hiding. I began to regret it. I regretted not being able to grasp you, especially when I discovered you already had a fiancée. I regretted it even more. I may have missed out on the best choice!"
Sonia took a deep breath and continued, "So later, when I was looking for a boyfriend, I couldn't help but compare these people to you. I wanted to find someone better than you, but I couldn't find a suitable one, no matter how hard I tried. The truly outstanding rich heirs wouldn't treat me as their girlfriend. At most, they would play with me and dump me when they got tired of me. As for those ordinary rich heirs, I didn't like them anymore. These are the changes you brought to me!"
"And then you got to know Holden?" Connor asked.
"Yes, I met Holden later. Holden's family background is good, so I naively thought that Holden should have a stronger background than you. Moreover, Holden treated me well!" Sonia smiled bitterly and continued, "But later, I realized that Holden just wanted to sleep with me. When he was dating me, he often slept with other women. I couldn't accept it, so I broke up with him. Holden didn't want to let go because he felt he had spent much money on me, but he never got what he wanted…
"I returned everything that Holden gave me, but he still asked me for money. He even asked me for money for food. I used my living expenses to repay him, but he still refused to let me go," Sonia said with tears in her eyes.
Connor looked at Sonia, not knowing what to say. Some people might think that Sonia was suffering because she was too materialistic, but Connor understood that Sonia's conditions were not bad. She chose a rich heir as her boyfriend not for money but for her vanity.
She had been surrounded by suitors since she was young. How could she be willing to find a mediocre boyfriend in the future?
Some people might be materialistic for money, but Connor knew that Sonia wasn't.
Sonia did this to prove herself.
"Holden said that everything would be over as long as I gave him my virginity. But I didn't want to sell my body, so I started to avoid him, and then what happened last night happened!"
Sonia wiped the tears from her face and continued, "I had already agreed to Holden's request, but I didn't expect you to appear. I'm grateful that you saved me!"
Connor looked at Sonia hesitantly. Then he said expressionlessly, "Actually, I rejected you not because you were not outstanding enough but because I have already met the woman who made me feel that I am made for her for the rest of my life. You are very beautiful and brilliant. You don't have to prove your excellence to anyone. If you are willing to listen to my advice, I don't think you need to set your sights on those rich people. Sometimes, the ordinary people around you might be more suitable for you!"
"Are you saying that you think I'm outstanding?" Sonia asked Connor in surprise.
"You are the famous campus belle of Newtown University. Of course, I think you are very outstanding!" Connor replied with a smile.
Sonia smiled happily and whispered to Connor, "Although I don't know if what you said is true or false, no matter what, I'm already thrilled that you said these things!"
"As long as you're happy!" Connor lightly nodded.
"Don't worry. Since I can tell you these things, it means that I've completely let go of you now. I might not continue to dwell on these things in the future. I think I'll meet someone more suitable for me in the future, and you're just a passerby in my life!" Sonia said with a smile.
"I believe that you will meet the right person!" Connor said light-heartedly.
Sonia smiled at Connor, then turned around and left.
Connor looked at Sonia leaving and felt emotional. In fact, sometimes Connor felt that Sonia was very different from the materialistic girls Connor usually met.
At least to Connor, Sonia had no bad intentions.

chapters.title: Chapter 1380: Stealing the Spotlight
chapters.content:
Chapter 1380: Stealing the Spotlight
After dealing with the matters of Justin and others, Connor obediently attended classes at school for two days.
Now, the opening ceremony was finally about to begin.
Connor's first confrontation with Yaakov was also officially starting.
He knew clearly that there was only one way to deal with people like Rockefeller. He had to threaten their positions because only when they felt endangered would they expose their weaknesses. This way, he could find Yaakov.
Otherwise, it would be almost impossible for him to only rely on Queta or Percy to gather clues and find Yaakov.
Since he had promised Justin and others to attend the opening ceremony together, Brooks, Joel, and others naturally came along. Sonia, Kaira, Ruth, and Sia, the three girls, also followed.
Connor knew that once Justin and the others knew his true identity, Sonia, Kaira, and the others would surely find out. So, he might as well call them all together.
The girls were very excited to attend the opening ceremony of Connor's club. After all, they thought he was about the same age as them, but he could own a club. Attending the ceremony as friends of the boss was a matter of great face for them.
"Connor, don't worry, I'll definitely post several moments on my social media to get my friends to support your business!"
While touching up her makeup, Kaira said to Connor.
"Well, thank you in advance!"
Connor replied with a smile.
"You're welcome, we are classmates after all..."
Kaira said happily.
Connor just smiled faintly and didn't say much.
After all, the people Kaira knew were not really wealthy, and even if they were rich, it didn't necessarily qualify them to become members of Heavens Club.
Half an hour later, Connor brought Justin and the others to the front of the most famous five-star hotel in Newtown.
Connor saw that the hotel lobby was already set up, and the words "Heavens Club Opening Ceremony" were particularly prominent. Various colorful flags were fluttering in the wind, giving a lively atmosphere.
He was also clear that all these arrangements were probably made by Vanessa.
With Vanessa around, Connor didn't need to worry about anything. This was probably why Chelsea couldn't bear to part with her.
On the opposite side of Heavens Club's opening ceremony, there was another hotel with the words "Triumph Club Opening Ceremony" in front of it. The scene was equally bustling with many employees busy around.
Seeing this scene, Connor couldn't help but sigh in his heart. Vanessa's information was indeed very accurate.
Arthur did choose the same time and location as Heavens Club's opening ceremony, probably with the purpose of humiliating Connor.
"There might be a good show today..."
Connor couldn't help but think to himself.
"Why are there two clubs opening on the same day?"
"Yeah, what day is today? There are so many clubs opening at the same time?"
"These two clubs look luxurious. I wonder if they will affect Connor's club's opening ceremony."
Some girls seemed to be worried about Connor and started whispering to each other.
Justin also frowned and said, "Connor, why do I feel like these two clubs are targeting you?"
"No one can steal the limelight from my club's opening ceremony. Don't worry!"
Connor replied with great confidence, then continued, "We've arrived, let's get off!"
"Arrived?"
After hearing this, everyone looked puzzled.
Connor then opened the car door and stepped out.
Everyone followed suit and got out of the car.
"Connor, your club is also here?"
Justin asked as he looked at Connor.
"Yes, my club is right here..."
Connor nodded and pointed at the words "Heavens Club Opening Ceremony" in front of them, answering softly.
"You are the owner of Heavens Club?"
Justin and the others were extremely surprised when they heard Connor's words, and they exclaimed in disbelief.
"Yes, I am the owner of Heavens Club!"
Connor replied with a smile and continued, "You've been curious about my identity all this time, right? Now you should know who I am."
"Connor, are you kidding us? I heard that Heavens Club is the largest club in our Zhonghai Province, and it has been established for a long time. It's true that it recently changed ownership, but..."
Sonia had some understanding of Heavens Club, so she couldn't believe that Connor was the owner.
"The current owner of Heavens Club is me!"
Connor said calmly.
This was also the reason why Connor didn't want to directly explain his identity. He felt that some things would be hard for people to believe even if he said them, and he would need to waste a lot of energy to prove that they were true.
Instead, he brought Justin and the others here so that they could understand what was going on.
"Heavens Club is quite powerful, right?"
Kaira hesitated for a moment and asked in an puzzled tone.
"Heavens Club is the largest club in Orilon. It is said to have an annual turnover of over ten billion. The background of the current owner of Heavens Club is very terrifying. Anyone who wants to become a member of Heavens Club must be a real big shot. Otherwise, they don't even have the qualifications to enter..."
Sonia explained in a low voice.
"Did Connor just say he is the owner of Heavens Club?"
Kaira's eyes widened instantly.
"I find it unlikely. How could Connor, so young, become the owner of Heavens Club?"
Sonia shook her head lightly.
"But..."
Suddenly, Justin spoke up.
Sonia couldn't help but look at Justin with a puzzled expression and asked, "What do you mean by that?"
"Remember what happened yesterday. If Connor is really the owner of Heavens Club, then everything that happened yesterday seems to make sense..."
Justin said with a poker face.
Sonia looked at him and said nothing.
"Why are you all standing there? Come in quickly!"
Connor turned and shouted at Sonia, Justin, and others.
Although these people still weren't sure if Connor was the owner of Heavens Club, they chose to believe him and walked inside.
"Connor, your club is here?"
Justin asked him again.
"Yes, this is my club..."
He nodded and pointed to the words "Heavens Club Opening Ceremony" in front of them, saying softly.
"You are the owner of Heavens Club?"
Justin and the others were extremely surprised by Connor's words, and they exclaimed in disbelief.
"Yes, I am the owner of Heavens Club!"
He replied with a smile, then continued, "You've been curious about my identity all this time, right? Now you should know who I am."
"Connor, are you kidding us? I heard that Heavens Club is the largest club in Orilon, and it has been established for a long time. It's true that it recently changed ownership, but..."
Sonia had some understanding of Heavens Club, so she couldn't believe that Connor was the owner.
"The current owner of Heavens Club is me!"
Connor said calmly.
This was also the reason why Connor didn't want to directly explain his identity. He felt that some things would be hard for people to believe even if he said them, and he would need to waste a lot of energy to prove that they were true.
Instead, he brought Justin and the others here so that they could understand what was going on.
"Heavens Club is quite powerful, right?"
Kaira hesitated for a moment and asked in an puzzled tone.
"Heavens Club is the largest club in our Zhonghai Province. It is said to have an annual turnover of over ten billion. The background of the current owner of Heavens Club is very terrifying. Anyone who wants to become a member of Heavens Club must be a real big shot. Otherwise, they don't even have the qualifications to enter..."
Sonia explained in a low voice.
"Did Connor just say he is the owner of Heavens Club?"
Kaira's eyes widened instantly.
"I find it unlikely. How could Connor, so young, become the owner of Heavens Club?"
Sonia shook her head lightly.
"But..."
Suddenly, Justin spoke up.
Sonia couldn't help but look at Justin with a puzzled expression and asked, "What do you mean by that?"
"Remember what happened yesterday. If Connor is really the owner of Heavens Club, then everything that happened yesterday seems to make sense..."
Justin said with a poker face.
"..."
Sonia looked at Justin and said nothing.
"Why are you all standing there? Come in quickly!"
Connor turned and shouted at Sonia, Justin, and others.
Although these people still weren't sure if Connor was the owner of Heavens Club, they chose to believe him and walked inside.

chapters.title: Chapter 1381: Bad News
chapters.content:
Chapter 1381: Bad News
"Mr. Connor, you've come!"
"Hello, Mr. Connor!"
"Hello, Mr. Connor!"
Upon seeing Connor, the staff who had been preparing in the lobby came over to greet him. After all, they were all employees of Heavens Club, so they naturally knew Connor.
Seeing the respectful attitude of the staff towards Connor, Sonia and the others began to doubt their previous thoughts.
"Could it be true that he is really the owner of Heavens Club? How is this possible?"
Sonia felt increasingly surprised.
At that moment, Vanessa, dressed in a sexy uniform and high heels, walked gracefully in front of Connor.
She looked stunning today, and her alluring outfit perfectly outlined her enchanting figure. Her long and fair legs were wrapped in black stockings, and she wore black high heels. Her charisma and appearance instantly overshadowed Sonia and the others.
They felt insignificant as they stood before her.
Kaira even felt a bit inferior due to Vanessa's strong presence and intentionally took two steps back.
Sonia, on the other hand, looked at Vanessa with envy because she also wanted to become such a woman.
As for Justin, Brooks, Joel, and the others, they couldn't take their eyes off Vanessa. After all, her mature and sexy allure had an extraordinary appeal to them.
"Mr. Connor, you've come!"
Vanessa slightly bowed to Connor.
"Vanessa, thank you for your hard work!"
Connor replied lightly.
"It's nothing at all..."
Vanessa smiled and then subconsciously glanced at the people around him.
"These people are all my friends. Can you arrange something for them?"
Connor spoke up.
"Sure!"
Vanessa nodded quickly and said to her assistant, "These are all Mr. Connor's friends. Arrange a good spot for them!"
"Sure, Miss Vanessa!"
The female assistant nodded and then said to Justin and the others, "Please follow me!"
After hearing the assistant's words, Justin was momentarily stunned but still followed her to a distant location.
Not long after they left, Justin couldn't contain his curiosity and asked the assistant softly, "Miss, can I ask you something?"
"Feel free to ask!"
The assistant replied politely.
"Who is the owner of this Heavens Club?"
Justin said in a low voice.
"Isn't Mr. Connor the owner of Heavens Club? Aren't you all his friends?"
The assistant seemed surprised by his question.
Justin, Sonia, and the others were instantly stunned upon hearing the assistant's reply. Their expressions showed utter shock.
"We underestimated Connor!"
Sonia said softly.
"It's not that we underestimated him, it's just that Connor is really good at hiding. After this opening ceremony, I will have a good talk with him. Although I know he's not an ordinary rich second-generation, I didn't expect him to be this powerful!"
Brooks joked.
"Yeah, we should give him a good lesson later. He's so wealthy and yet pretends to act with us every day. If he doesn't explain this matter clearly, I won't consider him my friend anymore!"
Justin teased.
"But, we still have to acknowledge this friend of ours. After all, he's so wealthy, and we might benefit from knowing him in the future!"
Brooks said with a smile.
"You're right!"
Justin nodded.
While chatting, they arrived at the rest area since there was still plenty of time before the opening ceremony. Guests who arrived early would wait in the rest area.
Although Justin, Brooks, and the others were surprised to learn Connor's true identity, they were also happy. After all, they gained a powerful friend, and who wouldn't be happy about that?
Meanwhile, Connor chatted with Vanessa.
"Mr. Connor, I have some bad news. Do you want to hear it?"
Vanessa whispered to Connor.
"What bad news?"
Connor asked.
"It seems that Triumph Club has invited all the business big shots in the province. According to the information I have, almost every famous boss in the province has received their invitation!"
She frowned.
"It's not really bad news. I already guessed it before. They chose to hold the opening ceremony on the same day as us for this reason, right?" he replied calmly.
"But all these invitations were sent by Tenner Ward!"
Vanessa hurriedly said.
"Who is Tenner?"
Connor asked.
"Tenner is Yaakov's spokesperson in the province. He handles almost all public appearances on behalf of him, while Yaakov always stays behind the scenes!" she explained.
Upon hearing her explanation, he couldn't help but smile because everything was progressing so smoothly. Although he didn't directly lure Yaakovout this time, he managed to draw Tenner out, which was some progress.
"Is Tenner coming?"
He asked her.
"I'm not sure..."
She shook her head and said with an unhappy expression, "But now that all those business bigwigs have received the invitations, Tenner's influence is still quite frightening. Some of them may choose not to attend both ceremonies to avoid offending anyone. I've already received several calls from people declining to attend. I'm really worried that not many people will come to our side..."

chapters.title: Chapter 1382: Opened At The Same Time
chapters.content:
Chapter 1382: Opened At The Same Time
"Where are your friends?"
Connor asked.
"My friends are all useless. I'll be happy enough if they don't go to the other side. I don't expect them to attend our opening ceremony at all..."
Vanessa took a deep breath and continued, "I underestimated Yaakov's importance to Triumph Club. I didn't expect him to send Tenner. If I had known, I would have prepared in advance!"
"You don't need to blame yourself. You did everything you could. Didn't I invite the Thompson family and Blake? If they can come, the effect will be the same..."
Connor said calmly to Vanessa.
"Connor, I'm worried about this!" she exclamied anxiously.
"What do you mean?"
He was puzzled and asked.
"Connor, you may not understand Tenner's influence. I'm afraid that if Tenner contacts the people you invited, what should we do? If they choose not to come to avoid offending both sides, it will be very embarrassing for us!"
she said in a hurry.
Upon hearing her words, he smiled lightly and said softly, "I'm sure the people I invited will come, so don't worry!"
"But..."
Vanessa wanted to say something more.
However, Connor started walking toward the hotel's exit.
She hurriedly caught up and said to him, "Connor, I think maybe we can cancel today's opening ceremony!"
"No need to cancel!"
He said confidently.
Vanessa looked at Connor with a helpless expression because she couldn't understand where his confidence was coming from.
Canceling the opening ceremony would be the wisest choice now.
But since Connor was the club's owner, and he didn't plan to cancel, there was nothing Vanessa could do.
Just as Connor walked out of the hotel, he saw Arthur getting out of a car.
When Arthur saw Connor, he even pretended to be surprised and quickly walked up to Connor with a smile, saying, "Mr. Connor, what are you doing here?"
"My club's opening, of course I'm here!"
Connor said calmly.
"Your club's opening?"
Arthur seemed even more surprised and then said quickly, "Mr. Connor, we are so fated. I didn't expect your club's opening to be today as well. My club is also opening today, and the location is the same..."
"Indeed, it's quite a coincidence. My fiancée is Freya, and you happened to fall for my fiancée. But my fiancée doesn't even look at you. My club is Heavens Club, and you want to get Heavens Club, but in the end, not only did you not get it, but you also lost several billion. Now, even the opening location and time are the same. I wonder if your club will close its doors even before the opening ceremony because you can't gather enough guests for the ribbon-cutting..."
Connor smiled and asked Arthur.
"You..."
Upon hearing Connor's words, Arthur's eyes flickered with anger, but he didn't retort. Instead, he chose to leave directly.
"Just wait and see how you embarrass yourself!"
Arthur sneered in his heart.
Around nine o'clock.
The guests who received the invitations began to arrive at the hotel entrance one after another.
Connor stood with Vanessa, while Arthur stood with his secretary, waiting for the arrival of the guests.
A few minutes later, a black Mercedes slowly stopped by the roadside.
A middle-aged man in a suit got out of the car. He briefly observed the surroundings and then walked directly toward Arthur's position.
Seeing the middle-aged man approaching, Arthur's expression seemed somewhat excited, and he quickly smiled, saying, "Mr. Sun, you've come! Please come inside!"
After saying this, Arthur's secretary led Mr. Sun into the hotel.
Mr. Sun had also received two invitations, one from Vanessa and the other from Tenner. However, he didn't hesitate at all and directly chose Tenner.
After all, Vanessa could be offended, but Tenner was someone he couldn't afford to offend.
In the province, offending Tenner meant courting death, didn't it?
"I also sent an invitation to Mr. Sun, and he is also a member of our club!"
Vanessa seemed somewhat dissatisfied.
"It doesn't matter. He's just a small figure and not important!"
Connor comforted Vanessa softly.
However, just at that moment, another guest arrived.
And this guest was the same as the previous one, choosing to go to Arthur's side.
Arthur was also very happy and greeted the guest with a smile.

chapters.title: Chapter 1383: The Enemy's Enemy
chapters.content:
Chapter 1383: The Enemy's Enemy
Just under five minutes.
There were more than a dozen big shots by Arthur's, but there was not a single person on Connor's side.
This scene made Vanessa very worried because the opening ceremony was crucial for Heavens Club. If it failed today, it would definitely affect its future development.
However, Connor seemed indifferent, as if he didn't care about this matter at all, standing quietly.
"Mr. Arthur, sorry I'm a little late..."
Just at that moment, a voice that Connor found very familiar came from outside.
Connor subconsciously glanced and found it was Zayn.
