One could not help but say that Zayn really had no sense of self-preservation. At the birthday banquet of Salma, Connor had slapped him hard, but now he appeared again.
"Zayn, you're here! Please come inside!"
Arthur said with a smile.
As the saying goes, "The enemy of my enemy is my friend."
Zayn and Arthur both held deep grudges against Connor, so it was normal for them to ally with each other.
Zayn instinctively glanced at Connor's location and said with a slightly puzzled expression, "Oh, Mr. Connor, you're here too? Are you here for Mr. Arthur's opening ceremony as well?"
"Mr. Connor's club is also opening today..."
Arthur explained with a smirk.
"Today too?"
Zayn paused for a moment, then looked at the situation on Connor's side and said softly, "Mr. Connor, it seems like not many people are here on your side? It seems your popularity isn't that great?"
Zayn's remark was not without merit, as currently, there was not a single guest on Heavens Club's side; they were all employees of the club. On the other hand, Triumph Club had already received many guests, including several renowned bosses in the province.
So, if the two sides were compared, Connor's side would undoubtedly be much less lively.
Zayn knew that Connor might embarrass himself today, so he came over.
"Zayn, you're mistaken..."
But at that moment, Arthur suddenly spoke.
Zayn turned to look at Arthur with a hint of confusion in his eyes.
"Actually, quite a few people have come to Mr. Connor's side, and they are all students from Newtown University..."
Arthur said provocatively.
Vanessa, who had always been very cold, showed a subtle change in her expression upon hearing what Arthur and Zayn said. They were deliberately mocking Connor.
"Hahaha, since they couldn't invite guests, they brought a few students to make up the numbers. How interesting..."
Zayn burst into laughter, looking at Connor.
Vanessa couldn't hold back and stepped forward to say something.
However, Connor raised his hand to stop her and said with an expressionless face, "Are you tired of living?"
Zayn was stunned when he heard Connor's words, then asked in a puzzled tone, "What do you mean?"
"I said, are you tired of living?"
Connor repeated in a low voice, then continued, "Do you believe that I could break your legs and let you crawl away from here?"
Zayn seemed intimidated by his aura and blinked, not continuing to speak.
However, at that moment, several vans slowly arrived.
Upon seeing these vans, Arthur's smile seemed even brighter because they were labeled with the names of websites or television stations.
It was evident that these people were the media brought by Tenner.
Sure enough, after the journalists in the vans got off, they immediately started shooting the bustling scene inside Arthur's club, and they also took a few shots of Connor's situation.
Upon seeing the journalists, Vanessa's expression seemed displeased, and she couldn't help but whisper to Connor, "I didn't expect Arthur to invite journalists as well. This is bad..."
"Don't worry; it won't affect us!"
Connor said calmly.
Vanessa looked at Connor and couldn't help feeling helpless because she thought Connor probably didn't realize the importance of the media in today's society. In the current era, the speed of news spreading on the internet had surpassed traditional media.
However, Connor saw it as an opportunity for publicity since Arthur had brought many journalists.
Justin, Sonia, and others were bored waiting in the lounge, so they came out to watch the excitement.

chapters.title: Chapter 1384: As Long As You're Here
chapters.content:
Chapter 1384: As Long As You're Here
"There are so many people on the other side. How come Connor doesn't have anyone?"
Kaira's eyes showed a hint of confusion when she saw the difference in the number of people on both sides.
"Yeah, the difference is too obvious, and there are so many journalists too!"
Justin also chimed in.
"I think the other side deliberately chose to have the opening ceremony opposite Connor's..."
Sonia, who came from a business family and was also very intelligent, could tell that something was not quite right.
"If they did it on purpose, Connor would be embarrassed today, wouldn't he?"
Justin said anxiously.
"For now, it seems so..."
Sonia nodded lightly.
Worried expressions appeared on the faces of Justin, Brooks, and others. However, they were just ordinary wealthy heirs, and in this situation, they couldn't do much to help.
At this moment, a red Ferrari arrogantly stopped in between the two hotels.
Everyone's attention shifted to the Ferrari as soon as they saw it.
Even the journalists pointed their cameras at the car, waiting to capture the appearance of the owner.
Tenner even invited several popular online streamers to do a live broadcast, meaning that whatever happened next, it would be instantly seen by people online, creating a tremendous impact.
A few seconds later, the Ferrari came to a slow stop.
Then, the car door opened.
The first thing to come out of the car were a pair of slender and fair legs.
Seeing those beautiful legs, the male onlookers showed excited expressions because even without knowing the woman's face, they could tell from those legs that the person coming out of the car was an absolute beauty.
As expected, the owner of the Ferrari finally stepped out.
The woman had a tall and slender figure, a captivating delicate face, and was wearing a short black dress, complemented by ten-centimeter high heels.
Her figure was already tall and slender, and with those ten-centimeter high heels, she stood nearly 1.78 meters tall.
For a moment, everyone's attention was on this woman, and her entrance overshadowed all tBrookssses present. Especially her slender and fair legs and her prominent chest captured everyone's attention.
The journalists began to go crazy taking photos of her.
Seeing the woman, Connor couldn't help but smile faintly.
"Who is this woman?"
"Yeah, she's so beautiful..."
"She's probably a celebrity, right?"
The people present began to quietly discuss after seeing the beautiful woman.
"You guys don't even recognize Salma from the Thompson family?"
Just at that moment, a middle-aged man exclaimed in surprise.
"What? This woman is Salma from the Thompson family?"
"I didn't expect Arthur to invite even someone from the Thompson family!"
The expressions on their faces seemed even more astonished.
It was worth mentioning that all the people present at Triumph Club were just ordinary bosses who couldn't come into contact with such a prominent family like the Thompson family. So, it was entirely normal for them not to recognize Salma.
However, although they might not recognize Salma, they had heard of her name. They knew that Salma was highly valued by the Thompson family and was the designated heir to the Thompson family's future business. This meant that all of the Thompson family's industries would be inherited by Salma in the future. Therefore, anyone who could win Salma's heart would essentially win the entire Thompson family.
That's why she had such a reputation in the province.
With such a woman by your side, you could have an easy life for the next ten lifetimes. How could anyone not pay attention to her?
"Is she really my goddess?"
Upon seeing Salma, Justin couldn't help but shout excitedly.
"If she's your goddess, what does that make me?"
Kaira turned her head and coldly asked him.
Upon hearing her words, his expression looked somewhat embarrassed, and then he whispered, "I was just joking..."
"Logically speaking, Salma has a good relationship with Connor. She should be here for Connor's opening ceremony, right?"
Brooks frowned.
But Sonia turned her head to look at Brooks and gently shook her head, saying, "Not necessarily. Salma represents the entire Thompson family now. Although she has a good relationship with Connor, business matters are not decided based on personal feelings..."
"That makes sense..."
Brooks felt that Sonia's statement was quite reasonable and nodded lightly.
At this moment, Arthur was staring at Salma's position, his expression seemed tense. Although Arthur had also sent an invitation to the Thompson family, he didn't dare to be a hundred percent sure that Salma was really here for his opening ceremony.
If she was here for his opening ceremony, then Connor would definitely lose today, and there would be no chance of a comeback.
But if she was here for Connor's opening ceremony, then she alone would be enough to offset all the people on Arthur's side. That meant Arthur's advantage would be completely wiped out, and that was why Arthur was so nervous.
However, at this moment, she seemed to have made her choice.
Without even looking at Arthur, after all, she and Arthur weren't very familiar, and in addition, when Heavens Club was being transferred, Arthur had mocked Connor, which left a bad impression on Salma.
So Salma didn't even have the intention of greeting Arthur. Instead, she walked directly to Connor's side.
"Welcome, Miss Salma!"
Connor smiled and greeted Salma.
"My grandfather has something to attend to right now, so he might not be able to make it. I'm here on behalf of our Thompson family..." she replied with a smile.
"As long as you're here, that's enough..." he said softly.
Salma subconsciously looked at the situation on Connor's side and then smiled, "It seems that your situation is not very optimistic. If I hadn't come, it looks like you wouldn't have any guests..."
"But you alone are stronger than all the people in that room!"
Connor replied with a smile and introduced Vanessa to Salma.

chapters.title: Chapter 1385: The Superstar
chapters.content:
Chapter 1385: The Superstar
Vanessa politely ushered Salma into the hall.
At this moment, Vanessa's face had visibly lighten. After all, she knew that Salma alone was worth as much as all the people on Arthur's side combined, so things were finally looking better for Connor.
Her current goal was straightforward: just make sure that the opening ceremony today doesn't become too embarrassing.
Salma had met Justin and others before at Newtown University, so after entering the hall, she started chatting with them.
Before this, Justin and his friends thought that someone as popular and divine as Salma would be aloof and difficult to get along with. However, after a brief interaction, they found Salma to be very approachable.
Meanwhile, Arthur's expression was very unpleasant, and of course, the same could be said for Zayn.
Earlier, Zayn intended to say something to Salma when he saw her, but she didn't even spare him a glance.
"Salma's relationship with Connor is indeed not simple. So I think it's quite normal for her to attend the opening ceremony here," Zayn comforted Arthur in a low voice.
Upon hearing this, Arthur couldn't help but take a deep breath and muttered, "If it's just Salma, I wouldn't be worried..."
Arthur's thinking was straightforward. Although Salma represented the entire Tang family and had a great entrance effect, so what? Normally, at least three heavyweight guests were required for the ribbon-cutting ceremony. Right now, Connor only had Salma; it wouldn't be appropriate for just the two of them to cut the ribbon together. Thus, Connor would still be embarrassed.
However, just then, the sound of crisp high heels echoed in the hall.
Upon hearing this sound, everyone turned their heads to look.
A beautiful woman wearing sunglasses walked gracefully with her assistant.
Although the woman wore sunglasses, everyone could tell she was none other than Kaitlyn Zoer, the hottest female star in the entertainment industry today.
Recently, Kaitlyn had starred in several hit TV dramas, and her ratings were excellent. Combined with her frequent appearance on Twitter's trending topics, her popularity had soared among both young fans and middle-aged people who didn't watch TV often. Almost everyone had heard her name.
Originally, she hadn't planned to attend this opening ceremony, but her agent informed her that the offer from the other side was very generous. Merely attending this opening ceremony could secure her the remuneration for an entire drama series. So, she agreed without hesitation.
After all, not everyone was as wealthy as Yvette.
Kaitlyn was a star to earn money. She wouldn't let an opportunity to make money slip away, just like many ordinary people.
Meanwhile, Yvette, coming from a well-off family, was also the owner of her entertainment company. This allowed her to be more willful. If she didn't want to attend an event, she wouldn't, and nobody could force her.
Upon seeing Kaitlyn, Arthur's face lit up with delight.
After all, her appearance had an equally great effect. Especially for the journalists and online influencers, they immediately began taking photos of her.
She was very popular among young people, so her presence had a significant promotional effect.
After noticing the numerous journalists, she removed her sunglasses and started cooperating with them for photos. Of course, the journalists made sure to capture the words "Triumph Club Opening Ceremony" in the photos to let everyone know that Kaitlyn was attending this event.
Today, she wore a white dress, and her delicate face, light makeup, and her slender legs beneath the dress immediately captured everyone's attention.
"I can't believe we're meeting a big star here..."
"Yeah, I just watched one of her TV dramas a few days ago!"
"The other side really went all out, inviting Kaitlyn as well..."
Justin and his friends looked at Kaitlyn's position and began discussing quietly.
If Justin and his friends didn't know that she was attending the opening ceremony on the other side, they might have gone over to take pictures with her too, as they were fans of hers.
However, they couldn't go over there now, nor did they want to.
A few minutes later, seeing that the journalists had taken enough pictures, Arthur wore a proud smile on his face and quickly walked up to Kaitlyn. He greeted her with a smile, "Miss Kaitlyn, welcome to the Triumph Club's opening ceremony..."
"Mr. Arthur, congratulations!"
She replied with a smile.
Hearing this, Arthur's expression became even happier, and he hurriedly said, "Miss Kaitlyn, you must be tired from the flight this morning. Please go inside and rest. The ribbon-cutting ceremony will begin at ten o'clock!"
"Okay..."
She nodded gently.
"Let me show you inside..."
He took the initiative to lead Kaitlyn towards the hotel.
However, just as she was about to walk into the hotel, she suddenly stopped and turned her head to look at Connor.
Upon seeing him, her expression was full of surprise because she didn't know why Connor was here.
Although she knew that Connor and Yvette were a fake couple, she also knew that he had a very complicated background.
"Miss Kaitlyn, is something the matter?"
Arthur couldn't help but ask softly when he saw her standing still.
"Um, Mr. Arthur, I just spotted a friend. I'll go say a few words!"
Kaitlyn replied calmly, and then she walked directly towards Connor.
Vanessa was surprised to see Kaitlyn actively talking to Connor because she didn't expect that Kaitlyn would know Connor, let alone come up to talk to him.
Justin, Brooks, and others were equally surprised. They didn't think that Connor and Kaitlyn would know each other.

chapters.title: Chapter 1386: Turning Against Arthur
chapters.content:
Chapter 1386: Turning Against Arthur
Only Arthur's expression looked somewhat unpleasant.
Zayn stood in place, his face filled with confusion.
Because nobody expected that Kaitlyn actually knew Connor.
If Connor knew Kaitlyn, that would be entirely normal. After all, she was a big star, and many people knew her; that was perfectly normal.
But the fact that she knew him was an entirely different concept.
Suddenly, Arthur had a bad premonition.
"I'd love to attend Mr. Arthur's opening ceremony, but it seems like I wasn't invited," Connor replied with a smile.
Kaitlyn hesitated for a moment, and her expression became more puzzled.
Connor was dressed quite formally, which led her to think that he must be attending an important event today.
But Connor said he wasn't attending Arthur's opening ceremony, then why was he here?
She couldn't help but look up at the hotel behind him.
Seeing the words "Heavens Club Opening Ceremony," she instantly understood what was happening.
"Today, my Heavens Club is also having an opening ceremony," Connor explained.
"Mr. Connor, didn't your Heavens Club already open? Is this a new branch?" asked Kaitlyn, sounding innocent.
"It's not a branch; I recently took over this Heavens Club, so I plan to hold an opening ceremony and promote it properly," he replied with a smile.
"I see!" She now understood what was happening. Clearly, they were competing with each other!
Kaitlyn looked a bit troubled now. If she had known this was the situation, she wouldn't have attended Arthur's opening ceremony. Attending Arthur's event was equivalent to offending Connor, wasn't it?
However, since Kaitlyn had already signed a contract with Tenner's people, it was too late for her to regret now.
"Let me introduce you. This is Vanessa, the General Manager of our Heavens Club," Connor said softly.
Kaitlyn immediately extended her hand towards Vanessa and said with a smile, "Miss Vanessa, you're really beautiful. If you were to enter our entertainment industry, you'd surely become a sensation."
"Thank you for the compliment. I'm actually a fan of yours, Miss Kaitlyn. Can we take a picture later?" Vanessa politely replied.
"Of course!" Kaitlyn knew she had offended Connor's side by attending Arthur's opening ceremony, so she had to take this opportunity to make amends.
Kaitlyn proactively took a photo with Vanessa in a very intimate pose.
Seeing this scene, Justin and the others couldn't sit still and began asking Connor for a picture as well.
Kaitlyn knew that these people were Connor's friends, so she naturally had to give them face. She was completely accepting of anyone who wanted a picture.
Upon seeing this scene, Arthur's expression was exceptionally unsightly.
After all, Kaitlyn was the star they had invited. Now she had gone to Connor's side and was taking pictures with his people. What was going on?
Moreover, Kaitlyn was very warm and courteous with Connor's side, but quite indifferent towards Arthur's people. This made the guests on Arthur's side rather dissatisfied.
"Is Kaitlyn really attending the opening ceremony on the other side?" Zayn asked, frowning.
"While the contract specifies that Kaitlyn is attending our opening ceremony, it doesn't say she can't take photos with others. The ribbon-cutting ceremony hasn't started yet, so we can't control what Kaitlyn does," Arthur said helplessly.
"We should think of a way to get Kaitlyn back. She has been staying on Connor's side all this time, what's going on?" Zayn said with exasperation.
Arthur took a deep breath and walked directly towards Kaitlyn.
By now, she had finished taking photos with Justin and others. She spoke softly to Connor, "Mr. Connor, I'm really sorry. I didn't know you were also having an opening ceremony. I agreed to attend the other side's ribbon-cutting, so I owe you a favor. If you need anything in the future, feel free to contact me, I'll help you for free..."
"It's okay, you don't have to worry about such a small matter," Connor replied with a smile.
"As long as you don't mind..." Kaitlyn's expression seemed to relax a bit as she smiled.
"I definitely don't mind. After all, you didn't do it on purpose..." Connor replied softly.
After hesitating for a moment, Kaitlyn asked, "Mr. Connor, will Vette come to attend your opening ceremony today?"
Kaitlyn knew that Connor and Yvette had an unusual relationship, and she had mentioned to Yvette that she would come to Newtown. So, she asked out of curiosity.
"She should be coming," he replied helplessly.
Now he was also uncertain. The time for the ribbon-cutting was approaching, but there was still no news from Yvette. He had sent her a message earlier, but she hadn't replied. Connor worried that she might have stood him up.
However, he also felt that the likelihood of that happening was small. After all, Connor had risked his life to help Yvette with her troubles. If she stood him up, that would be unreasonable.
Upon hearing the conversation between Kaitlyn and Connor, Arthur's expression became increasingly complex.
Although Kaitlyn didn't directly mention Yvette's name, she used the term "Vette," which many people knew was a nickname for Yvette. So, it was perfectly normal for Kaitlyn to call her that.
"Does Kaitlyn mean that Yvette was invited by Connor? How can that be possible?" Arthur couldn't help but feel that something was not right.
After all, Yvette was extremely popular. Even in the entire entertainment industry, there were very few who could rival her popularity. Even the recently popular Tiffany was no match for Yvette. So, if someone could actually invite Yvette, the effect would undoubtedly be explosive.

chapters.title: Chapter 1387: Yvette Arrives
chapters.content:
Chapter 1387: Yvette Arrives
However, Arthur felt that there was no way Connor could have invited Yvette!
The reason for that was simple, because even Tenner couldn't do it, so Connor definitely couldn't.
Tenner had a lot of connections and financial resources but Yvette came from a prestigious family, so she wasn't lacking in money at all. Her management company was her own, and from her debut until now, she had never participated in any commercial activities or even endorsed any advertisements. Even if she did endorsements, they were all for public welfare.
So, Arthur believed that Connor simply couldn't have managed to invite Yvette. He must have misheard something earlier.
After taking a deep breath, Arthur walked over to Kaitlyn and said softly, "Miss Kaitlyn, there are a few gentlemen from our side who would like to meet you."
"Sure..."
Kaitlyn nodded gently, then waved at Connor, saying, "Mr. Connor, let's talk after the ribbon-cutting ceremony..."
"Okay!"
Connor nodded as he looked at her.
However, in the moment when she turned around, a white limousine slowly stopped by the side of the road.
An assistant-looking girl stepped out of the car briskly and opened the door.
As the door opened, a woman dressed in a black skirt gracefully stepped out of the car.
Upon seeing this woman, everyone's eyes widened, and their expressions turned incredibly incredulous.
"Yvette actually came?"
One of the reporters recognized Yvette at a glance and shouted loudly.
Upon hearing this, everyone turned to look at Yvette's direction and gasped in shock. Their expressions were extremely astonished.
At that moment, they could hardly believe their eyes.
Yvette had actually come to the opening ceremony?
"Oh my god! Is that really Yvette?"
"Am I dreaming? How could Yvette possibly be here?"
"Right, is Yvette just passing by, or is she here for the opening ceremony?"
"I think she's probably just passing by, right? Didn't they say Yvette never participates in any commercial activities? She definitely wouldn't come for the opening ceremony. So many bosses have invited her before, but she never agreed..."
"How can you not know this yourselves? Just because others can't do it doesn't mean Mr. Tenner can't do it!"
"That's true. I never expected that Mr. Tenner would have so much face. Not only did he invite a star like Kaitlyn, but also brought Yvette here. It's really unbelievable..."
"Don't you know who Mr. Tenner is? He's boss is Mr. Wilson, so it's normal for him to be able to invite Yvette..."
Whispers and discussions filled the air.
It seemed like everyone believed that Yvette must have come for the Triumph Club's opening ceremony, as Connor wouldn't have had the ability to invite her.
But Arthur's expression was incredibly unsightly. Only he knew what was really going on.
Yesterday, Tenner had indeed mentioned Yvette to him, but he had also said that he didn't have the time to invite her. Now that she had actually appeared, it could only mean that she was here for Connor's opening ceremony!
Combined with what Kaitlyn had said to Connor, Arthur's suspicion grew even stronger.
But he couldn't understand how Connor managed to invite Yvette!
This was something that even Tenner couldn't do, so how did Connor do it?
Just as everyone thought that Yvette should be coming to the Triumph Club, she unexpectedly walked straight towards Connor.
For a moment, everyone was stunned in their tracks.
Because none of them had anticipated that Yvette would actually come to attend Connor's opening ceremony.
Upon seeing her, Connor's mood naturally became extremely excited.
In any case, she had finally arrived.
Her presence completely turned the situation around for Connor.
The reporters present were like madmen, surrounding her and taking pictures. After all, news of Yvette attending a commercial event was even more sensational than any other news. No one would miss out on such a good opportunity.
Seeing Yvette, Kaitlyn was naturally thrilled. She walked up to Yvette and started chatting.
Vanessa looked at Connor strangely, then turned to him and asked, "Mr. Connor, you really managed to invite Miss Yvette?"
"Didn't I tell you before?"
Connor replied casually.
"I didn't take your words seriously at the time..."
At that moment, she hadn't taken his words seriously as she had thought he was joking. She never expected him to actually be this capable, to have successfully invited Yvette.
First was Salma, and now Yvette.
Just these two people were enough to make everyone feel extremely incredulous.
Justin, Brooks, Kaira, and the others were completely dumbfounded, standing in place and looking at Connor. They were filled with mixed emotions and astonishment.
After all, in their eyes, for Connor to know a celebrity of Kaitlyn's caliber was already incredibly unbelievable.
But they had never imagined that Connor not only knew Kaitlyn but also Yvette. Moreover, he had even invited Yvette to his own opening ceremony.
"Who exactly is Connor?"
Justin stared wide-eyed and stuttered.
After a brief chat with Kaitlyn, Yvette asked curiously, "Kaitlyn, are you also here for Mr. Connor's opening ceremony?"
At that moment, Yvette was still a bit angry because she felt that Connor hadn't properly invited Kaitlyn privately. Although she didn't mind this too much, she still thought Connor's behavior was a bit inappropriate.
"I'm not here for Mr. Connor's opening ceremony, but for the one across the street!"
Kaitlyn replied somewhat helplessly.
"They're also having an opening ceremony?"
Yvette looked up at Arthur's location and then turned to look at Connor.
By now, Yvette had already understood why Connor had invited her. It was because the two clubs were competing with each other.
"It's quite a coincidence. I didn't expect that both clubs would be opening at the same time!"
Yvette couldn't help but sigh softly in her heart.

chapters.title: Chapter 1388: Breach of Contract
chapters.content:
Chapter 1388: Breach of Contract
"It wasn't exactly at the same time. My side is ten minutes later than yours," Kaitlyn explained in a hushed voice.
Yvette quickly surveyed both situations and it was quite evident that there were many more people on the other side compared to Connor's.
"Connor, do you want me to help you?" Yvette asked him with a bright smile.
Upon hearing her words, his eyes flashed with confusion. He softly inquired, "How do you plan to help me?"
"It's simple!" Yvette replied nonchalantly. She then turned to Kaitlyn and said in a low voice, "Kaitlyn, since your ribbon-cutting starts at ten past ten, why don't you stay here with me to help Connor cut the ribbon? After we're done here, you can go over there. The distances are so close, the timing should work out..."
Arthur was taken aback upon hearing Yvette's words, surprised by her unexpected strategy.
"Isn't this a bit inappropriate, Yvette?" Kaitlyn voiced her reservations.
"What's inappropriate about it? You're here to participate in ribbon-cutting, and it doesn't say you can't do it for another company. You just need to do what you're supposed to do. I'm bored here alone, so you can keep me company," Yvette stated expressionlessly.
"Then, let me ask Mr. Arthur's opinion!" Kaitlyn suggested in a low voice.
"No need to ask. They have no reason to refuse. If they disagree, you can just cancel their event over there," Yvette asserted with an air of dominance.
"Yvette, canceling their event would result in a substantial breach of contract fine. I'd better discuss it with Mr. Arthur!" Kaitlyn spoke softly.
As Kaitlyn had signed a contract with Arthur's side, violating it would entail a hefty penalty. She couldn't afford such a large sum of money.
"Oh, come on. Let Connor cover that small amount for you!" At that moment, Yvette suddenly interjected.
Yvette was well aware that he was wealthy enough to easily cover such an amount.
Upon hearing her words, Connor nodded directly and said, "That's right, Miss Kaitlyn, you don't need to worry. If Mr. Arthur disagrees with you coming to our side for the ribbon-cutting, you can simply cancel, and no matter the amount, I'll cover it. Your appearance fee won't be affected either."
He was financially well-off, so any problem that money could solve was not a significant concern to him.
"Alright, I'll go talk to the people over there..." With newfound confidence from Connor's support, Kaitlyn walked confidently over to where Arthur was standing.
Arthur appraised Kaitlyn from head to toe, took a deep breath, and said in a low voice, "Miss Kaitlyn, the ribbon-cutting is about to begin. Let's go inside."
"Mr. Arthur, I apologize sincerely. Just now, Mr. Connor invited me to participate in their ribbon-cutting as well," she softly told him.
Upon hearing her words, he was momentarily stunned. He furrowed his brows and asked, "Miss Kaitlyn, what do you mean? Don't forget, we have a contract. Going to Connor's event would be a violation."
"I'm well aware of our contract, but it only stipulates that I attend your ribbon-cutting on time. It doesn't say I can't participate in another company's event. Your ribbon-cutting starts at ten past ten, while Mr. Connor's starts at ten. The venues are so close, there's plenty of time. So, after Connor's event concludes, I will come here for the ribbon-cutting," she stated matter-of-factly.
"That's not acceptable. You're a guest I invited. How can you go to the other side for ribbon-cutting?" His eyes widened and his tone growing agitated.
Hearing this, Kaitlyn's expression turned somewhat helpless. She murmured, "Mr. Arthur, if you truly disagree, then I have no choice but to breach the contract. I'll compensate you for any losses."
"You're breaching the contract?" Arthur exclaimed, taken aback.
"If you don't agree, I have no other options," she replied calmly.
"Do you even know how much you'll have to pay for breaking the contract?" He clenched his teeth and asked.
"Mr. Connor will cover that sum. I don't need to worry about it," she replied softly.
"You…" Arthur was left dumbfounded by Kaitlyn's response.
"Mr. Arthur, if Miss Kaitlyn is insistent on going to the other side, just let her. As long as it doesn't affect our event here," Zayn interjected suddenly.
"Mr. Zayn, what are you saying?" Arthur asked, visibly annoyed.
Zayn pulled Arthur aside and whispered, "Mr. Arthur, are you out of your mind? There are so many people watching. Miss Kaitlyn is willing to risk breaching the contract to go to Connor's side. What can you offer to make her stay?
"Are you suggesting that we should let her go to the other side?" Arthur gritted his teeth.
"She is determined to go to the other side now. If you agree, it will show you as magnanimous. Furthermore, she might still attend our opening ceremony afterward," Zayn analyzed.
"If you don't agree now, at most, you'll get some compensation. But everyone will know that Miss Kaitlyn is our guest. What do you think people will say when they don't see her during the ribbon-cutting?" Zayn pressed.
Arthur took a deep breath and remained silent.
"In short, Mr. Arthur, you're definitely losing face now. Do you want to lose a little face or a lot?" Zayn said expressionlessly.
Arthur finally grasped the situation. While he felt reluctant, he had no choice. With clenched teeth, he turned to Kaitlyn and said, "Fine, since Miss Zhao wishes to attend Zhang's event, go ahead. But don't let it delay our ribbon-cutting!"

chapters.title: Chapter 1389: Uninvited
chapters.content:
Chapter 1389: Uninvited
"Mr. Arthur, rest assured, I definitely won't cause any delays!" Kaitlyn replied with a beaming smile. She then strode towards Connor's Heavens Club in her high heels.
Seeing this scene, onlookers wore expressions of confusion. They couldn't fathom why Kaitlyn, who had been invited by Arthur, was now heading over to Connor's side.
The journalists seized the opportunity and surrounded Connor, not wanting to miss any moment.
It finally dawned on Arthur that he had inadvertently handed Connor an unexpected advantage by inviting so many reporters. His intention had been to humiliate Connor, but now he realized the tables had turned. He was the one being humiliated.
Despite Arthur hosting many prominent business figures, they were no match for Kaitlyn and Yvette in terms of prestige.
"Mr. Arthur, don't worry too much. Even though Kaitlyn went over there, she will come back later. Plus, we have more prominent guests here, so in terms of appearances, we have the upper hand," Zayn advised in a hushed tone.
Arthur's expression eased a bit upon hearing this, as he noticed that, though Connor had managed to bring in a few influential guests, the atmosphere on his side seemed subdued compared to the lively ambiance on his own.
As more guests arrived, all of them were headed towards Arthur's side.
"You're right. What can two female celebrities on Connor's side do? Anyone with eyes can see that our side is livelier," Arthur whispered.
"Exactly, Mr. Arthur. So, even if Kaitlyn goes there, what's the big deal?" Zayn chuckled.
"True," Arthur nodded slightly, then prepared to greet other guests.
However, at that moment, a black Bentley parked between the two clubs.
Arthur's excitement was evident upon seeing the black Bentley. He knew that someone significant must have been invited by Tenner. The choice of the vehicle was telling.
Standing at the entrance, Arthur eagerly awaited the Bentley's occupants.
After a few seconds, the car door opened slowly.
A man and a woman stepped out of the car.
The man wore a white suit, exuding charisma and handsomeness.
The woman was exceptionally beautiful, wearing a black strapless gown that exuded elegance and nobility.
"It's them?" Arthur hadn't yet recognized the duo, but Zayn called out in surprise.
Zayn was familiar with them, as they were instrumental in securing his release from the Trent family's grasp.
"Do you know them?" Arthur asked Zayn, puzzled.
"Jameson!" Zayn replied through gritted teeth.
"Jameson?" Arthur's expression turned to shock upon hearing the name. Although he didn't personally know Jameson, he had heard of the Trent family's power and influence.
"Why would he come here?" Arthur muttered.
"His relationship with Connor is good. It's normal for him to attend Connor's opening ceremony," Zayn explained expressionlessly.
"What are you saying? Jameson is here for Connor's opening ceremony?" Arthur's expression was one of disbelief and astonishment.
"Definitely," Zayn affirmed in a hushed tone.
As expected, Connor was also taken aback upon seeing Jameson. He had not notified Jameson beforehand, assuming he had his hands full with various matters. It was surprising to see Jameson in attendance.
Vanessa's gaze toward Connor became even more astonished. She was increasingly impressed by Connor's connections. Not only had he invited Salma and Yvette, but now he also had Jameson, a person of such high stature!
"Con, you're really inconsiderate," Jameson called out to Connor with a cheerful smile.
"Jame, you're here?" Connor responded, a bit embarrassed.
"You didn't even inform me about your club's opening. Were you afraid I'd come and freeload?" Jameson retorted with a grin, asking jokingly.
Upon hearing his words, the crowd realized that Connor hadn't invited Jameson but he had come of his own accord.
Observing the scene, Vanessa's expression grew even more astonished.
"I thought you had a lot on your plate, so I didn't bother to notify you," Connor explained.
"Then I decided to show up uninvited. So, am I welcome or not?" Jameson inquired.
"Of course, you're welcome. Please, come inside quickly..." Connor turned to Vanessa and introduced her briefly before asking her to escort Jameson into the hall.
Seeing Jameson, many of Arthur's prominent guests dashed towards Connor, eager to make his acquaintance. They hoped that connecting with Jameson could bring them significant benefits, considering the Trent family's vast business interests.
Arthur was baffled by the sudden turn of events. Before he could react, a large portion of his guests had flocked to
Connor's side, seeking favor with Jameson.
Arthur had initially believed he held an advantage due to the greater number of people on his side, creating a more lively atmosphere. However, with Jameson's arrival, the situation had changed dramatically.
As the media continued to report on the event, Connor was inadvertently receiving massive publicity.
Growing anxious, Arthur pulled out his phone and tried to call Tenner, hoping for a solution. However, all his attempts ended with a disconnected tone.
Amid his mounting frustration, another sports car pulled over at the roadside.
Stepping out in high heels, Yerba emerged from the car.

chapters.title: Chapter 1390: Blake Layton's Daughter!
chapters.content:
Chapter 1390: Blake Layton's Daughter!
Compared to the others, Yerba's appearance was much more low-key.
After all, there were so many people present at the moment, and not many people knew Yerba's true identity.
If these people knew that Yerba was Blake Layton's daughter, they would probably go crazy to please her.
Arthur's expression changed when he saw Yerba.
No one else knew who Yerba was, but he did.
"Why is Yerba here?" he shouted in despair.
"Who is this woman?"
Zayn saw that the expression on his face seemed a little off, so he quickly asked.
"This woman is Yerba, my junior high school classmate!" Arthur replied.
"You scared me to death. I thought it was some big shot. So it's your junior high school classmate."
Zayn said indifferently.
"You know nothing!"
Arthur shouted with his eyes wide open. Then, he gritted his teeth and said, "She is Blake's daughter!"
"What did you say?"
When Zayn heard this, he was stunned. The expression on his face was indescribable.
Arthur wasn't in the mood to talk to him, so he stepped forward to talk to Yerba.
However, she didn't even look at him and walked straight to Connor.
"It's over, it's over. Yerba actually came for Connor. If Blake comes today, we might really lose…"
Zayn said nervously.
"Impossible, absolutely impossible…"
Arthur shook his head and said in a low voice, Blake is my dad's classmate. My dad told me that Blake's personality is very strange. Under normal circumstances, he would only attend events that are truly beneficial to the people. Blake would never attend purely commercial events like this. I think Yerba came to support him because she has a good relationship with Connor. Don't worry…"
At this moment, Arthur felt that even if Connor was a god, he would not be able to invite someone like Blake.
"If it's like what you said, then it's better. After all, we have Mayor Lee here. When Mayor Lee comes over, then Connor and the others will be in vain!"
Zayn let out a long sigh and said in a low voice.
"I'm just worried that Mayor Lee won't have time to come. It would be great if he could come!"
Arthur said worriedly.
After all, Mayor Lee had a lot of things to do, so no one could be sure if he would come today!
On the other side, when Connor saw Yerba, he quickly walked up to her and asked with a smile, "You're here?"
"Yes!"
Yerba pouted and replied.
At this moment, she was still very angry. If it wasn't for him, she wouldn't have begged Blake.
Although Blake had already promised her that he would come, his attitude was not very good. Moreover, he had not spoken to Yerba for two to three days.
"Um, why didn't Mr. Blake come over?"
Connor asked Yerba with a smile.
After she heard his words, she glared at him and said through gritted teeth, "Do you know how much I've sacrificed to convince my father to come here?"
"Don't worry, once you forget about this, I will definitely not treat you unfairly. I promise to make you the best racer in the world!"
Connor said in a serious tone.
"Is what you said true?"
Yerba's expression seemed to have eased up a little as she asked Connor softly.
"How could I lie to you about this!" he said with a smile.
Actually, Connor wasn't joking. He had already contacted Jorge and asked him to refine a pill. This pill could improve a normal person's reaction speed.
The most important thing for a racer was reaction speed.
Therefore, as long as Yerba took this pill, her reaction speed would definitely be different from ordinary people. At that time, Yerba would definitely have no problem facing ordinary racers.
"If you dare to lie to me, I won't let you off!"
Yerba pouted and said to him.
"Don't worry, how would I dare to lie to you? When is your father coming over?"
he asked her anxiously.
"I just called my dad. He said that he's in a meeting right now and will probably only be able to come over later…"
Yerba said softly.
"Alright, as long as we can come over…"
Connor nodded happily.
"Oh right, there's something else I have to tell you in advance…"
Yerba looked at Connor and said.
"What is it?"
Connor asked.
"It's like this. My dad said that he has never participated in any commercial activities before. After all, with his position, it would not be good if word got out. Therefore, he will bring the Minister of Education here today because I told him that you will donate 100 Hope Primary Schools to the province. The cost of each primary school is 500,000 yuan. You just need to prepare 50 million yuan…"
Yerba looked at Connor and said.
"Alright, that's not a problem. I'll get someone to prepare the check now!"
Connor nodded his head lightly, then led Yerba into the hall.
"Vanessa, help me prepare a check for 50 million dollars now!"
Connor walked to Vanessa's side and said in a low voice.
"Alright…"
Vanessa didn't ask Connor what he wanted to do, she directly agreed and then started to make a call.
A few minutes later, her assistant sent over a check.
Vanessa turned her head to look at Connor, then asked Connor in a puzzled tone, "Mr. Connor, who was that girl just now?"
"Blake Layton's daughter!"
Connor lightly replied.
When she heard his words, she was instantly shocked by his powerful connections.
First, it was the Thompson family, then Yvette, Jameson, and now Blake's daughter.
Connor had actually invited all three of them!
Vanessa felt that even Chelsea wouldn't have such been able to invite such huge people.
She also found that he knew a lot of beautiful women, because at this time, other than Jameson, all of them were beautiful women.
"I didn't expect Mr. Connor's affinity with women to be so good!" she couldn't help but sigh in her heart.

chapters.title: Chapter 1391: Reversal
chapters.content:
Chapter 1391: Reversal
Meanwhile, on Arthur's side, people also began to rebel one after another. After all, at this point, these bosses realized how formidable Connor's background was.
They didn't want to offend Connor over such a trivial matter. Moreover, there were all these beautiful wome on his side, the kind that no amount of money could get them close to. Hence, quite a few bosses opted for Connor's side, enticed by these lovely ladies.
Originally, the situation was completely one-sided, but now, a mind-boggling reversal was taking place.
Watching his people leave one after another, Arthur's expression became increasingly anxious. He understood that if things continued this way, by the time the event started, they might not have anyone left on their side.
Arthur had initially planned to seize this opportunity to embarrass Connor and promote his Triumph Club. However, now all his plans were falling apart. He realized that today, escaping without being humiliated by Connor was already a good outcome. He had little hope of humiliating Connor himself.
Arthur kept dialing Tenner's phone, as his only hope for salvation lay with him.
"Hello?"
After many attempts, Tenner finally answered.
"Tenner, something big has happened!"
Arthur lowered his voice, speaking with an agitated tone.
"What's wrong, what big thing happened?"
Tenner's voice sounded puzzled.
"That little brat Connor is truly formidable. Not only did he bring people from the Thompson family, but he also managed to get Yvette, as well as Jameson and Blake Layton's daughter. There aren't many of us left on our side now. What should I do?"
Arthur urgently inquired.
"He managed to bring so many people?"
Tenner seemed taken aback, not expecting this turn of events.
"Yes, I didn't expect his connections to be so extensive..."
Arthur whispered.
"Well, don't worry. I just spoke with Mayor Lee. Mayor Lee confirmed he will come over today. Although Connor has Blake's daughter, Blake won't come in person. So, when Mayor Lee arrives, both sides will be evenly matched. We won't lose, you understand?"
Tenner calmly explained.
"I understand."
Arthur's tone seemed somewhat resigned.
"Alright then, just wait for Mayor Lee to arrive..."
Tenner said in a hushed voice.
"Got it!"
Arthur nodded and hung up the phone.
Arthur understood Tenner's message. Given the current situation, he couldn't hope to make Connor lose face at this opening ceremony. The best outcome now was for both sides to have roughly equal leverage, so that neither would lose face.
Mayor Lee was a government official, and his presence would have a substantial impact.
Even with Yvette and others on Connor's side, Arthur's side wouldn't be at a disadvantage once Mayor Lee arrived.
Waiting intently, Arthur kept his gaze fixed on the direction of the street, anticipating Mayor Lee's appearance.
"Mr. Arthur, who are you waiting for?"
Walking up to Arthur, Connor smiled and asked.
However, upon hearing Connor's question, Arthur took a deep breath and replied in a low voice, "I don't think who I'm waiting for has much to do with you."
"Hehe, I'm just curious to see who else will come to your side later..."
Connor casually remarked.
"You'll find out soon enough!"
With a somewhat resigned tone, Arthur responded.
Just then, a black Honda slowly pulled up.
"My person has arrived!"
Seeing the black Honda, Arthur's face lit up with excitement. Without hesitation, he quickly walked over to where the Honda had stopped.
The car came to a halt, and Arthur opened the door himself.
A middle-aged man in a suit stepped out of the car, smiling.
Seeing this man, Vanessa's expression turned astonished. She whispered to Connor, "This person should be Arthur's last card..."
"Who is this?"
Connor whispered back to Vanessa.
"This is Mayor Galuf Lee of Newtown."
Vanessa replied.
"Mayor Galuf Lee?"
Connor's eyes flickered with a hint of confusion.
It was known that Galuf's family background wasn't particularly impressive, bordering on ordinary. But when Galuf was a clerk at the Bureau of Industry and Commerce, he met Tenner during a dinner. Tenner was quite impressed with him, and he introduced Galuf to Yaakov.
From that point on, Galuf's path to success began.
In less than five years, Galuf transitioned from a lowly clerk to becoming the Mayor of Newtown, a progression that left many envious.
Of course, Galuf was well aware that all of this was due to Yaakov's support. Therefore, he never refused any of Yaakov's requests. He believed that as long as he followed Yaakov's guidance, he would have ample room for advancement. But once he severed ties with Yaakov, Galuf might become an ordinary person again, possibly even losing his current position.
Recently, Tenner had brought up this matter with Galuf, also mentioning that Yaakov held this club in high regard.
Galuf immediately agreed. Otherwise, under normal circumstances, why would he, as the Mayor, participate in a club's opening ceremony?
As Galuf entered everyone's line of sight, nearly everyone was stunned. Some bosses who had initially switched to Connor's side returned to Arthur's side.
As for these flip-flopping bosses, Connor paid them no mind. Their main role was to fill up the scene. Whether they stood with Connor or Arthur, their impact was minimal.
"Mayor Lee, greetings. I am Arthur, the General Manager of Triumph Club. We are truly honored to have you join us for our club's opening ceremony!"
Arthur said excitedly to Galuf.
Galuf smiled faintly upon hearing Arthur's words and replied in a soft voice, "The name Triumph Club is quite good, very impressive."
"Thank you for the compliment, Mayor Lee. Your presence at our opening ceremony is our honor. On behalf of all the staff at our club, I express our gratitude..."
Arthur's excitement was palpable.
After all, Galuf's appearance had saved Arthur from a precarious situation!

chapters.title: Chapter 1392: Frustration
chapters.content:
Chapter 1392: Frustration
"Hahaha, Mr. Arthur, you are too kind. A young and promising entrepreneur like you, I am very supportive of. I hope you can do meaningful things for the people in the future..."
Galuf said with a smile.
"Of course!"
Arthur nodded lightly and led Galuf into the hall.
At this moment, Arthur was really in the limelight. There were not many people who could invite someone like Galuf. But Arthur managed to do it and that showed his abilities.
Media reporters at the scene gathered around Galuf, beginning to interview him.
Seeing this scene, Arthur felt joyous. After all, if this interview were to be broadcasted, it would greatly enhance the publicity effect for the Triumph Club.
"How about it, Connor? Have you seen my trump card? Do you still have any left?"
Stepping forward, Arthur faced Connor with an arrogant expression.
"I underestimated you for sure, being able to invite the Mayor."
Connor said expressionlessly.
"Actually, it's more accurate to say that I underestimated you. Originally, I planned to take this opportunity to humiliate you, but I didn't expect you to also have some capabilities and invite many important figures. However, compared to me, you are still lacking a bit."
Arthur said in a low voice.
"How do you know that I'm only slightly lacking compared to you?"
Connor retorted with a smile.
"Are you still not clear about the current situation?"
Zayn asked Connor.
"It's actually you two who haven't grasped the situation, right?"
Connor sneered and continued, "My guests should have arrived as well..."
After saying this, Connor walked directly forward.
Arthur instinctively turned to look, only to see several cars with special license plates slowly stopping.
"Connor even managed to invite people from the provincial government?"
A shocked expression appeared on Arthur's face.
A few minutes later, several middle-aged individuals stepped out of the cars.
Seeing these middle-aged individuals, everyone widened their eyes, wearing expressions of disbelief.
Arthur was completely dumbfounded, unable to believe what he was seeing.
At the forefront was none other than Blake!
No one could have expected that he would actually appear!
All present were in disbelief, as the normally absent from business activities Blake had shown up!
Furthermore, he wasn't alone. Behind him were Teagan Howe, Clio Lee, and a middle-aged man with spectacles.
With this formidable lineup, everyone fell silent.
"I underestimated you. How could you invite people from the provincial level?"
Arthur exclaimed in shock.
At this moment, he found it difficult to understand the situation!
Even when Connor managed to invite Yvette before, Arthur found it hard to accept. He couldn't fathom how Connor could mobilize such powerful connections to invite her.
But Blake's appearance was even more baffling.
Tenner hadn't even considered inviting Blake, as he knew it was impossible. But despite all odds, Connor had succeeded.
"Who exactly is Connor?"
Arthur sighed in his heart.
He now felt like a fool. He felt a strong sense of frustration, realizing that he had grossly underestimated Connor. He had always been contemptuous of Connor, believing him to be a puppet, merely a puppet under Thomas. He even thought Connor wasn't worthy of being his opponent.
However, now Arthur realized that Connor might not be as simple as he had imagined.
The people Connor had invited today were all extraordinary. Even Yvette and Blake were people Tenner couldn't invite. Naturally, Thomas also couldn't invite them.
"Who else's connections can Connor use besides Thomas's?"
No matter how Arthur thought, he couldn't come up with a suitable answer.
Perhaps Connor himself believed that Blake's presence was due to Yerba, but that wasn't the case.
Ever since Connor arrived in Newtown, Blake had been paying attention to him.
Blake's reason for paying attention was simple.
He had reached his current position due to the attention of an old leader.
But few people knew why the old leader valued Blake so much.
The reason was simple which was Connor's father, Dawson, had introduced Blake to the old leader. It was this connection that had made the old leader pay extra attention to Blake.
His achievements were all because of Connor's father. That's why he was participating in Connor's opening ceremony.
These matters were in the past. Blake hadn't mentioned them to anyone, but it didn't mean he had forgotten.
Connor walked up to Blake and politely greeted, "Mr. Blake, greetings!"
"Hello!"
Blake replied calmly and introduced the people around him to Connor.
Vanessa watched Connor chatting with everyone, feeling deeply shocked.
She knew that Connor had managed to invite everyone he had promised.
Yvette and Blake appearing at the same opening ceremony was a shocking sight. Once this was publicized, the effect would be immense.
Justin, Brooks and the others now truly understood how formidable Connor's identity was. They realized their previous understanding of Connor was shallow—how could he be an ordinary person?
Some reporters were curious about Blake's appearance, so they began a brief interview. Blake took this opportunity to explain, not rejecting any questions.
"Mr. Blake, may I ask in what capacity you are attending the opening ceremony of the Heavens Club?"
A reporter asked directly.
"Naturally, I am attending in the capacity of my position."
Blake replied calmly.
"But since you are attending the opening ceremony, isn't this a bit inappropriate?"
The reporter continued.

chapters.title: Chapter 1393: The Head Boss
chapters.content:
Chapter 1393: The Head Boss
"Who told you that I came to attend the opening ceremony?"
Blake looked at the reporter and retorted.
Upon hearing Blake's response, the reporter's expression showed a hint of confusion. They whispered, "Today is the opening ceremony of the Heavens Club. Aren't you here to attend the opening ceremony?"
"Of course not!"
Blake shook his head lightly and continued with a smile, "Mr. Connor donated a hundred elementary schools for impoverished mountain areas in our province. I am here today to represent the province in expressing gratitude. Of course, if I happened to coincide with Mr. Connor's opening ceremony, it would be both courteous and reasonable for me to offer my congratulations!"
Upon hearing his explanation, everyone instantly understood the situation.
In fact, he was indeed attending the opening ceremony, and the so-called elementary schools were merely an excuse.
However, this excuse effectively shut the mouths of many.
Arthur glanced at Connor's position and frowned. He knew he had already lost, and lost completely. He had initially thought that with Galuf's appearance, he could turn the situation around, but he had never expected Connor to be so ruthless, actually managing to invite someone like Blake.
It was important to note that Blake's presence alone would overshadow all the other guests.
Moreover, it wasn't just Blake on Connor's side. There were also Jameson, Yvette, Kaitlyn, Salma, and others.
At this point, Arthur didn't even know who he could invite to salvage the situation.
Watching Connor happily conversing with Blake and the others, Arthur's expression turned ugly, and he felt a surge of anger.
He had thought he was in a winning position and could use this opportunity to humiliate Connor. But he could never have imagined that things would turn out like this.
Not only had he lost, but he had lost miserably.
Arthur realized that Connor had once again slapped him in the face.
The business owners who were supposed to attend his club's opening were now all gathered around Connor. The reporters he had invited were ignoring him entirely, focusing on helping Connor with publicity.
At this moment, Arthur realized that all his efforts had inadvertently contributed to Connor's success.
Once news of this event spread, his Triumph Club would undoubtedly become a laughingstock in everyone's eyes.
Zayn's expression was equally grim. He had come specifically to mock Connor, but he hadn't expected to end up in this situation.
Instead of witnessing Connor's humiliation, he himself had become a joke.
Zayn glanced at Arthur and then softly suggested, "Mr. Arthur, isn't it more important now to think of a solution? The opening ceremony is about to begin. We can't even manage to gather the ribbon-cutting guests."
Upon hearing his words, Arthur turned to look and found that there wasn't a single guest on his side. All those people he had invited had run over to Connor's side. They were currently apologizing to Connor, with some even saying that they had come to his event just to take a look and were attending Connor's opening ceremony today.
"These fickle people, just you wait..."
Arthur gritted his teeth and cursed under his breath.
"Mr. Arthur, what's the point of talking like this now? The urgent matter is to think of a solution!"
Zayn said in a helpless tone to Arthur.
Arthur furrowed his brows and coldly asked, "Then tell me, what solution do I have now?"
Initially, Arthur and Zayn had mocked Connor, thinking he wouldn't even be able to invite ribbon-cutting guests. But now they realized that it might not be Connor who couldn't invite such guests; it might actually be them.
"Why don't you call Mr. Tenner and ask if he has any solutions?"
Zayn urged anxiously.
"Mr. Tenner?"
Arthur couldn't help but let out a cold laugh, then said in a low voice, "Mr. Tenner has already helped me invite so many guests. It's just that Connor's lineup is too powerful. If I call Mr. Tenner now, won't I just be asking for a scolding? Tell me, how should I make that call..."
Zayn's expression was full of frustration. At this point, he had no idea what to do.
Initially, Zayn had planned to show off in front of Connor and impress Salma. But now, it seemed that all his plans had fallen apart.
However, the awkwardness wasn't limited to Arthur and Zayn. Mayor Galuf also felt extremely awkward.
Galuf's expression turned sour when he saw Blake appear. After all, Blake was essentially his superior.
Blake had come to attend Connor's opening ceremony, while Galuf had ended up on Arthur's side. This was practically a direct confrontation with Blake.
Although Galuf owed Tenner a favor, there were limits to how much he could help. If it went too far, he wouldn't agree.
He looked at the high-ranking officials on Connor's side, all chatting and laughing. Meanwhile, he was standing on Arthur's side. If these people were to remember this incident in the future, they would certainly treat him as a thorn in their side.
Even if he had a lot courage, he wouldn't dare to offend someone like Blake!
Furthermore, Blake had come for the sake of the Hope Elementary Schools, even if it was just an excuse. Nevertheless, it was a valid and honorable excuse.
However, Galuf didn't have such an excuse now. If others were to ask him about this situation, he wouldn't know how to respond.
After a moment of hesitation, Galuf walked up to Arthur and said in a low voice, "Arthur, now that they have invited someone of Blake's caliber, why didn't you inform me in advance? What do you mean by this?"
"Mayor Lee..."
Arthur could sense that Galuf was a bit angry and wanted to explain.
"Do you know how awkward my situation is right now? Are you planning to make me clash with Blake by standing on your side? Is that what you're trying to do?"
Galuf continued to scold Arthur.
"Mayor Lee, please don't misunderstand. I really didn't mean that..."
Arthur's expression seemed even more nervous when facing Galuf.
He realized that with the current state of his opening ceremony, if he also offended Galuf, he would be truly doomed.

chapters.title: Chapter 1394: A Joke in the Eyes of Others
chapters.content:
Chapter 1394: A Joke in the Eyes of Others
At this moment, Galuf blamed everything that had happened today on Arthur.
If it weren't for Arthur inviting him here, he wouldn't have ended up in this situation.
If these people were to hold a grudge against him in the future, things could get troublesome.
Zayn looked at Galuf hesitating for a couple of seconds and then said helplessly, "Mayor Lee, things are not what you think..."
"Not what I think? Then what else could it be?"
Galuf asked coldly.
"Mayor Lee, please think about it. If I had known that Connor had invited Blake, why would I choose to open on the same day as him? Wouldn't that be a dead end for me? Even if I'm not the brightest person, I wouldn't do something like this, would I?"
Arthur said with a helpless tone.
After hearing his explanation, Galuf's expression softened slightly, and he let out a sigh. He said in a low voice, "Tell me, what am I supposed to say about you? You didn't even investigate the identity and background of your competitor properly before inviting me. Now things have ended up like this, do you realize how embarrassing this is?"
"I thought this Connor was just an ordinary person..."
Arthur also spoke with a touch of grievance.
"If he were just an ordinary person, how could he have invited so many important figures? Do you even have a brain?" Galuf exclaimed with anger.
"Mayor Lee, please calm down. I admit I was wrong in this matter. Let's go inside."
Arthur said with a humble tone.
"Go inside?"
Galuf sneered and then said expressionlessly, "Why should I go inside now? Do you want me to go in and cut the ribbon for you?"
Arthur was left speechless by Galuf's response.
"I didn't expect Mr. Wei to find such a brainless partner. It seems your club won't last for long. You better take care of yourself!"
After leaving these words behind, Galuf walked directly toward Blake's position.
Arthur stood there dumbfounded, his expression growing uglier by the moment. He had never expected to not only embarrass himself but also irritate the Mayor of Nanyuan City.
In Newtown, offending Galuf was definitely not a good idea. His future prospects would be dim if he did so.
After separating from Arthur, he walked up to Blake and said with a smile, "Leader, I never expected to see you here."
Blake appeared surprised when he saw Galuf. He asked in a soft voice, "Galuf, why are you here? Are you also here for the opening ceremony?"
"I must admit, I am here for the opening ceremony, but it's on the opposite side, not Mr. Connor's!"
Galuf explained briefly, then continued, "It's all because of a friend of mine. He insisted that I come and make an appearance. Since I happened to be passing by, I decided to stop and take a look. I didn't expect to run into you, Leader. It's quite a coincidence..."
After hearing Galuf's explanation, Blake glanced at Arthur's location and said calmly, "Galuf, as the mayor of Newtown, you should consider not attending certain events. It would reflect poorly on you, especially considering your public status."
"I understand..."
Galuf nodded hastily and then said, "I'm actually planning to leave now..."
"Or, you could stay and have a meal with us."
Blake extended an invitation.
"Leader, I have another engagement. I won't stay for the meal. You all have your business to attend to!"
Galuf had no intention of staying in this place. He just wanted to leave as soon as possible.
"Very well, since you have other matters to attend to, go ahead. I won't keep you."
Blake nodded.
Seeing that Blake didn't seem to blame him, Galuf felt a sense of relief. He exchanged a few words with the people around and greeted Connor before quickly leaving.
After all, the situation here was becoming too complex. If he stayed any longer, he might only invite more trouble. So, a while later, Galuf left in his car.
Arthur stood expressionless in his place, his eyes filled with anger.
With all his guests gone, the scene was incredibly awkward.
Originally, Arthur had considered Galuf his last trump card. Little did he know that this trump card would turn out to be utterly useless.
Looking at the empty hall, Arthur was unsure whether to proceed with the opening ceremony at all.
Zayn walked up to Arthur and asked in a low voice, "Mr. Arthur, do you think it's still necessary to continue with the opening ceremony?"
"What do you think?"
Arthur replied in a low voice.
"I think, since the guests have all gone to the other side, perhaps we should just call it off for now."
Zayn replied helplessly and continued, "But don't worry, Mr. Arthur. We can reschedule and make better preparations next time. We'll strive to outshine Connor's opening ceremony..."
"Are you out of your mind?"
Arthur looked at Zayn with a hint of exasperation.
"What do you mean, Mr. Arthur?"
Zayn asked in a puzzled manner.
"You need to open your eyes and see who Connor has managed to invite. Do you think we can compete with his opening ceremony if we reschedule? Moreover, these guests were all arranged by Mr. Wei. Even if we reschedule, do you think Mr. Wei can still help us invite them? And even if he could, do you think they would still come?"
Arthur asked angrily.
Zayn looked even more helpless as he stood there, not knowing what to say.
"This opening ceremony must continue today..."
Arthur gritted his teeth.
"But Mr. Arthur, we don't have any guests left. How can we proceed?"
Zayn asked with a helpless expression.
"Even if we have no guests, we still have to continue. If I cancel the opening ceremony now, it will definitely become a laughingstock. We have to show some persistence."
Arthur said through clenched teeth.
Zayn looked at Arthur's expression and felt even more speechless. The reality was that, in their current situation, even if they continued with the opening ceremony, they had no guests. This would surely become a joke in the eyes of others.

chapters.title: Chapter 1395: Chelsea Lee Arrives
chapters.content:
Chapter 1395: Chelsea Lee Arrives
"Since we have no one, we can find some people to come..."
Arthur furrowed his brows and continued, "Do you have any friends?"
"Yes, but they are all ordinary people..."
Zayn replied.
"Whether they are ordinary people or not, just call your friends now. Anyone who is available and willing to come, ask them to join the opening ceremony. Even if we can't invite important guests, we need to gather enough people so that it won't be too embarrassing."
Arthur instructed Zayn.
"Alright, I'll call my friends right now..."
Zayn nodded helplessly and took out his phone to make calls.
Originally, Zayn had come today just to enjoy the spectacle, but things had turned out unexpectedly. Instead of witnessing an event, he found himself embarrassed alongside Arthur. However, since Arthur had promised to make him the general manager of the Triumph Club after its opening, he dared not offend Arthur and could only follow his orders.
Perhaps due to Blake's presence, Connor's side had become exceptionally lively. Many uninvited guests were also joining in.
For a while, Connor's side was bustling and lively.
On the other hand, Arthur's side remained incredibly quiet. Occasionally, a few young people entered and left, clearly not businessmen but merely adding to the numbers.
"Before, I was worried that we might not even have enough guests to cut the ribbon. It seems I was overly concerned," Vanessa said to Connor as she approached him.
"I still have many people who haven't arrived yet. If we include Reena, Thomas, and Kyle, I'm worried the hotel won't be able to accommodate them all!" Connor said with a smile.
"Just being able to invite these people is already satisfying for me!" Vanessa's perception of Connor had completely changed by now.
This event had also opened the eyes of Justin, Brooks, and others. They were beginning to understand what it truly meant to be wealthy. Being rich wasn't just about money; it was about the influence one held in society.
About half an hour later, Connor's side was becoming overcrowded, though more and more guests were still arriving.
Vanessa and Connor were both busy attending to their guests.
After calling almost every number in his phone, Arthur managed to round up about twenty people, all of whom were mostly there to join the crowd.
Among these twenty people, ten had come because they knew Yvette was on the other side. Without her, they probably wouldn't have come.
"Ring ring..."
At that moment, Connor's phone rang. He glanced at it and saw that it was a call from Chelsea.
"Hello?" he answered the call.
"Nephew, I am now downstairs at the club. Aren't you coming out to greet me?"
Her voice sounded playful.
"Who's your nephew?"
Connor replied helplessly and then hung up the phone directly.
Two beautiful women had arrived at the club's entrance.
One of them was wearing a black halter dress, revealing a sexy and slender figure. Her full chest was particularly eye-catching, her long legs were fair and slender, and her exquisite face was extremely alluring.
The other woman was dressed more modestly, wearing a light blue dress and white high heels. Her appearance was clean and elegant, exuding an air of nobility, resembling a beautiful lotus flower.
Two beautiful women, one mature and sexy, the other dignified and elegant, formed a striking contrast as they walked together. They were like a beautiful scenery, attracting the attention of countless men.
The two of them entered the hall chatting and laughing.
The staff quickly recognized one of the women as their former boss, Chelsea.
As for the other woman, they weren't quite sure. While they had all seen Chelsea at the previous party held by the Heavens Club, they had never seen this new woman before.
However, they could tell that the woman's background was not simple, as she appeared to be intimate with Chelsea. Clearly, she wasn't an ordinary person.
This prompted the onlookers to start whispering and speculating about the identity of the unfamiliar woman, but nobody could come up with a definite answer.
One thing was clear, though. None of the attendees had seen this woman before. Considering the crowd consisted of upper-class figures from Newtown, this suggested that the woman might not be a local resident.
Although Connor had hung up on Chelsea's call, he knew that dealing with her wouldn't be easy. He quickly went to the entrance of the hall.
"Nephew, I'm right here!"
Chelsea waved playfully at Connor.
Hearing this, Connor couldn't help but feel somewhat exasperated. He furrowed his brows and said, "I've already told you, I'm not your nephew..."
"If you're not my nephew, then whose nephew are you?"
Chelsea replied with a dismissive tone. Then, she turned to the woman beside her and said, "Yuna, this is Connor, the one I told you about!"
"Hello, Connor. I'm Yuna Winston!"
The elegant woman next to Chelsea proactively extended her hand to Connor.
"Hello, Yuna!"
"Why are you calling her by her name? You are my nephew, and she is my sister. You should call her 'auntie'..."
Chelsea seemed somewhat dissatisfied.
Hearing this, he was at a loss for words. If it weren't for her gifting the Heavens Club to him, he probably wouldn't have wanted to have anything to do with her at this point.

chapters.title: Chapter 1396: Speech on Stage
chapters.content:
Chapter 1396: Speech on Stage
"Chelsea, don't joke around. I'm not used to him calling me aunt. Just call me whatever you like !"
Yuna took the initiative to help Connor out.
"Alright then. Connor. You can call her whatever you want, but make sure you call me Aunt Chelsea…"
Chelsea replied expressionlessly, then asked Connor, "When will the ribbon-cutting ceremony begin? Are you going to invite me to be the guest at the ribbon-cutting ceremony?"
"It's about to start. Go and prepare!"
Connor replied.
"Alright, Yuna will also be a guest at the ribbon-cutting ceremony!"
Chelsea said.
"No problem…"
Connor hurriedly agreed.
He knew very clearly that although Chelsea did not directly reveal Yuna's identity, since she'd brought her over, it meant that Yuna was definitely not an ordinary person. Chelsea definitely had her own intentions for doing this.
As soon as Chelsea left, Vanessa walked to Connor's side and whispered, "Mr. McDonald, I'll check the ribbon-cutting process with you later. See if there's anything that needs to be modified!"
"Alright, go ahead!"
Connor nodded.
"It's almost time to show the guests to their seats. I arranged the seats according to the number of guests present, but because there are too many guests today, I added some more seats!"
Vanessa looked at the information in her hand and said softly.
"If it really doesn't work, let Arthur Synder's guests stand…" Connor said lightly.
When Vanessa heard Connor's words, she couldn't help but laugh, then softly said, "If we can get all the guests to sit down, we should try our best to arrange for them to sit down…"
"Alright, you can make the arrangements!"
Connor nodded.
"After all the guests are seated, the host will go on stage and give a speech to introduce the important guests. We won't introduce the unimportant guests..." Vanessa continued.
"Sure…"
"After the host has introduced the guests, it will be the leader's turn to give a speech. After the leader's speech, it will be Mr. McDonald's turn to give a speech…"
Vanessa said slowly.
After Connor heard Vanessa's words, he couldn't help but frown, then helplessly said, "I have to go on stage to give a speech?"
"Mr. McDonald, you are the boss of our Heavens Club. It's only natural that you have to go on stage and say something..." Vanessa said helplessly.
"Well, I don't really like such occasions. It's better if you take my place on stage to give a speech. I think you're more suitable. Besides, I didn't prepare anything beforehand, so I won't know what to say when I go up…"
Connor said helplessly.
After Vanessa heard Connor's words, she couldn't help but hesitate for a moment before saying softly, "Mr. McDonald, are you really not going to give a speech on stage?"
"Yes, you should go up!" Connor replied.
"Alright then…"
Vanessa nodded and continued, "After the speech, we will start cutting the ribbon!"
"Good!"
Vanessa glanced at Connor and didn't say anything more as she turned around and left.
…
9:30.
All the guests began to take their seats. Justin, Brooks, and the others were actually arranged to sit in the second row because of Connor.
The first row was filled with big shots like Blake Layton and Jameson Trent, so Justin and the others were very nervous. It was also their first time sitting so close to those so-called big shots.
The first person to speak on stage was definitely Blake. After all, no one could steal his limelight.
Blake did not say much because of his identity. He only exchanged a few pleasantries with everyone.
Then, Vanessa went on stage to give a speech.
Because Vanessa represented the entire Heavens Club, her speech was very important. However, it was not the first time Vanessa had faced such an occasion, so she acted very naturally. With a faint smile on her face, she walked elegantly onto the stage in her high heels.
After receiving the microphone, Vanessa's cold voice rang out.
"First of all, we would like to welcome all the distinguished guests to attend the opening ceremony of Heavens Club. Although the Heavens Club has been established for a long time, we have a new boss this time. The identity of the boss has changed, but the service tenet of the Heavens Club remains unchanged. We will serve society with 100% enthusiasm. I'm working hard to develop myself and also do something helpful to this society..."
At this time, all the reporters pointed their cameras at Vanessa's position, so Vanessa had to be extra careful when she spoke. After all, if she said something wrong on such an occasion, the impact would be very big.
Because of the need to stall for time, Vanessa stood on the stage alone and spoke for a full fifteen minutes. However, in these fifteen minutes, Vanessa did not say a word of nonsense. Everything she said was down-to-earth.
This also caused everyone to feel that these fifteen minutes passed very quickly. Even Blake was full of praise for Vanessa's speech, and the staff of the TV station also decided to broadcast Vanessa's speech word for word.
This was probably the biggest affirmation for Vanessa.
After Vanessa left the stage, her expression was unusually nervous.
Connor also took the initiative to help Vanessa to the sofa and said softly, "Vanessa, what you said just now was way too good…"
"What's good about it? You don't know how nervous I was just now…"
Vanessa helplessly rolled her eyes at Connor.
After all, if it wasn't because Connor didn't want to go up, then Vanessa wouldn't have talked for so long.
After Vanessa left the stage, Jameson Trent gave a speech as the business representative.
Jameson's speech was obviously more practical than Vanessa's speech. He briefly analyzed the future economic development of Orilon, all of which was effectively like gospel to those big bosses. Some even took out a pen and paper to jot down notes.
Blake seemed to be very interested in what Jameson had said. He even took the initiative to invite Jameson to his office so they could talk about it.
Therefore, everyone who was fortunate enough to attend Connor's opening ceremony today would benefit from something.
Jameson and Blake could collaborate, and others could also analyze which profitable projects they could undertake from Jameson's words. This was a good thing for everyone.

chapters.title: Chapter 1397: Repaying Gratitude
chapters.content:
Chapter 1397: Repaying Gratitude
After everyone gave their speeches, the ribbon-cutting ceremony began.
Connor's ribbon-cutting guests were very powerful, so the ribbon-cutting was also very successful.
After cutting the ribbon, the Internet celebrities invited by Arthur Synder began to take out their phones and take selfies of the event.
In an instant, the opening ceremony of Heavens Club became a hot topic on Twitter.
Many ordinary people didn't understand why a clubhouse would be trending on Twitter, but in less than half an hour, all the netizens in Oprana knew the Heavens Club's name.
One had to know that the best way to advertise something was via making it trend on Twitter.
In just half an hour, all the netizens knew about the existence of the Heavens Club. This was a feat only the internet could achieve.
Connor's ribbon-cutting ceremony was very successful, while Arthur's side seemed a little pitiful. Only Kaitlyn Zoer was the ribbon-cutting guest, and the rest were just there to fill in the numbers.
