Even the media couldn't be bothered to take photos. Even if they did take photos, they were just planning to write some articles to humiliate them.
After the ribbon-cutting ceremony, it was time for dinner.
The location of the dinner was on the second floor of the clubhouse.
Because Vanessa didn't expect Connor to invite so many people, the available seats were obviously not enough to hold everyone. If they added more seats at the last minute, it would cause the dinner to be delayed.
Time was very precious for people like Blake. Yvette was also planning to leave in the afternoon, so Connor did not drag things out. Instead, he asked those unimportant guests to leave immediately.
These people also understood what was going on. It was already good enough that Connor could keep them around when he opened the store.
In the end, there were only less than a hundred people left in the restaurant on the second floor.
There were a total of ten tables on the second floor, and the seats were naturally assigned according to one's status.
Blake and his gang naturally sat at the same table; after all, they were all together, so it was much more convenient for them to talk at a single table.
Chelsea, Yuna, Yvette, Kaitlyn, and the others sat at a table.
Chelsea was a strong woman herself, so she was naturally very experienced in speaking and handling matters. Furthermore, Chelsea knew that Yvette's background was not simple, so the two women instantly got together and even added each other on Facebook so that they could contact each other in the future.
Since Chelsea and Yvette had become friends, the two of them could be considered to be of equal status. There was no question of who was better than whom.
After all, if Chelsea was an ordinary person, Yvette would never get too close to her.
This was not because Yvette looked down on ordinary people. It was because once a celebrity became friends with an ordinary person, the ordinary person would have a lot of dirt on the celebrity. Some people with bad intentions would then spend money to get that dirt on the celebrity.
Even the smallest scrap of dirt was worth millions. This amount of money was not worth mentioning to a celebrity.
As a celebrity herself, Yvette would not betray her friends. However, for an ordinary person, a million dollars was a huge sum of money. It was impossible for an ordinary person to hold on to anything when offered that amount of money.
This was also the reason why celebrities did not become good friends with ordinary people. Not because they looked down on ordinary people, but because there were many risks that they could not bear.
Connor was the boss of Heavens Club, so he naturally followed Vanessa around to toast everyone.
Drinking was a piece of cake for Connor, so he didn't let Vanessa drink..
Vanessa seemed to be worried about Connor and asked him softly, "Mr. McDonald, are you okay drinking like this?"
"Don't worry, I'm fine!"
Connor replied with a smile.
Vanessa felt that Connor was protecting her at this time, so it was inevitable that her heart would be touched.
After Connor and Vanessa finished toasting, everyone seemed to have eaten already.
Chelsea walked up to Connor in her high heels and said softly to Connor, "Connor, come with me for a moment…"
"Alright…"
Connor agreed and followed Chelsea to a corner.
"Congratulations. The opening ceremony today was not bad and even exceeded my expectations. I did not expect you to be so popular…"
Chelsea said to Connor with a smile.
"It's alright. I just randomly called a few people over…" Connor laughed and replied, "Didn't you say that you were going to Beverly Hills? Why are you in Newtown?"
"I did come to Beverly Hills a few days ago, but I was worried about your opening ceremony, so I came back to take a look..."
Chelsea replied to Connor softly and then continued, "But now it seems that my worries are really unnecessary. Your opening ceremony is much better than I imagined. I didn't expect you to know someone like Blake Layton!"
"I also met him unintentionally…"
Connor replied indifferently.
"You met him by accident?" Chelsea was stunned for a moment, then said in a low voice, "That shouldn't be the case. Blake was able to get to where he is today all because of your father's help."
"You said Blake knew my father?"
Connor asked in surprise.
"Don't you know about this?"
Chelsea was also very surprised.
"No, I didn't…" Connor shook his head.
"It seems that Blake doesn't intend to tell you about this, but it doesn't matter. After all, Blake was indeed helped by your father, but the rest was mostly his own hard work. So you don't have to expect anything from him because of these things. Blake is a very straightforward person." Chelsea said.
"I understand what you mean…"
Connor said softly, then turned to Chelsea and asked, "Are you really my aunt?"
"Of course, if I'm not your aunt, why would I give you the Heavens Club?"
Chelsea seemed to be speechless.
"Who knows what you want to do…"
Connor could not completely believe that Chelsea was his aunt.
"Forget it. It might be a little difficult for you to accept this now, but slowly, you'll know that I'm really your aunt. I definitely won't harm you…"
Chelsea did not want to explain anything to Connor.
"Why did you call me over?"
Connor asked Chelsea softly.
"I'm preparing to set up a company in Beverly Hills. When the time comes, Wanqing might be the general manager, so you'd better find a suitable candidate to replace Wanqing as soon as possible. However, you must choose carefully. After all, the position of general manager is very important. Moreover, I suggest you find a woman—a beautiful one—because women are more suitable for this job…"
Chelsea said to Connor in a serious tone.

chapters.title: Chapter 1398: Salma's Trouble
chapters.content:
Chapter 1398: Salma's Trouble
After hesitating for a moment, Connor said with a helpless expression, "Then what if I can't find a suitable person?"
"That has nothing to do with me…"
Chelsea said lightly.
"It has nothing to do with you, you say."
When Connor heard Chelsea's words, he was instantly rendered speechless. The expression on his face was also very broken.
"Vanessa has been working in the Heavens Club for so long, and basically, many of the clients are protected by Vanessa alone. Now you suddenly want me to get someone to replace her, but how can I find someone so quickly? If the Heavens Club doesn't have Vanessa now, it won't be long before it closes…"
Connor shouted at Chelsea excitedly.
"I think I reminded you about this long ago. No matter what, you have to hurry up and find someone else. I will definitely not give Vanessa to you…"
Chelsea said to Connor with a smile.
Connor looked at Chelsea, not knowing what to say.
One had to know that the general manager of Heavens Club had very strict requirements. Not just anyone could take on the role.
First of all, the most important thing was that the general manager must be a woman. Because there were more male members in Heavens Club, only women could handle the relationship with these members. Vanessa was a good example.
Secondly, the woman had to be very experienced and have outstanding business skills. Otherwise, it would be difficult to manage such a big club.
Connor had a lot of strong women around him, but if he wanted someone who could replace Vanessa, it wouldn't be easy to find someone like that.
Reena Satchwell was the general manager of the Empire World Corporation's Newtown branch, so she didn't have the energy to manage the Heavens Club. Freya had to focus on Porthampton. And while Queta Juve had the skill, it was unrealistic for her to give up her business empire just to manage a small club.
"Can you give me more time?"
Connor asked helplessly when he saw Chelsea's firm attitude.
"Three months. I'll give you another three months!"
Chelsea said lightly.
"Alright, I got it!"
Connor nodded.
At this time, Connor had already begun to plan how to win over Vanessa. After all, Vanessa had worked in Heavens Club for so long, she must have some feelings for this club. Connor planned to use these three months to persuade Vanessa to stay in Heavens Club.
As for whether Chelsea agreed or not, Connor might not care so much.
"Oh right, there's something I want to tell you…" Chelsea said to Connor again.
Connor was stunned for a moment and asked, "What is it?"
"See, I might have to leave Newtown for Beverly Hills next week, so I might not be able to help you in the future…"
Chelsea said softly.
"I don't think I need your help even now…"
Connor replied bluntly.
"Then have you ever thought of going to Beverly Hills to develop your career?"
Chelsea hurriedly asked.
After Connor heard Chelsea's words, he could not help but be stunned for a moment. Then, he said with a troubled expression, " You should know very well that I don't lack money at all. What I want to do now is to investigate how my parents died. Yaakov Ward from Orilon is the best lead I have on the matter. Therefore, I don't plan to leave Newtown before I investigate these things..."
"No matter how your parents died back then, your greatest opponents in this life are those people from Rockefeller. I feel that if you go to Beverly Hills as soon as possible to develop your strength, it will be of great help to you in dealing with Rockefeller in the future…" Chelsea said seriously.
"I really can't think so much now…"
Connor shook his head.
Chelsea sighed softly. "Alright, since you don't have any intention of going to Beverly Hills to develop your career, I won't make things difficult for you. However, I want to remind you that you must prepare for a rainy day. No matter how you investigate, I think you will eventually look into Rockefeller. So even if you don't want to face it now, you will have to face a big problem like them sooner or later…"
"We'll talk about it when the time comes!"
Connor felt that there were enough things around him, so he simply did not have the ability to deal with anything extra.
After Chelsea heard Connor's words, she understood what Connor meant, so she did not continue to say anything.
The two of them continued to talk about the future development of Heavens Club before returning to the crowd.
At this time, everyone seemed to have eaten their fill, so they took the initiative to bid farewell to Connor.
Connor sent these people out of the clubhouse.
Justin, Brooks, Sonia, and the others also understood Connor's true identity, so they left the club.
In the blink of an eye, only Vanessa, the staff of Heavens Club, and Connor himself were left in the club.
Connor walked to Vanessa's side and said softly, "Vanessa, it's been hard on you today!"
"It's not hard. This is what I should do!" Vanessa lightly replied.
At this moment, Vanessa was obviously drunk. Her pretty face had a hint of redness like a ripe peach, making people have the urge to take a bite.
"Vanessa, it's getting late. Why don't I send you back?"
Connor now planned to get along with Vanessa and win her heart. If Vanessa didn't want to leave Heavens Club, Chelsea wouldn't be able to do anything about it.
"No need. I've already asked my driver to pick me up. I think he'll be here in a while. You'd better go back first!"
Vanessa rejected him directly.
Connor saw that Vanessa had already called the driver over, so he didn't continue to say anything.
Ten minutes later, Connor sent Vanessa to the car and was about to hail a taxi home.
However, at this moment, he realized that Salma had not left yet. Instead, she was standing beside his car as if she was arguing with someone.
Salma had left at the same time as Chelsea and Yvette. Logically speaking, they should have reached home by now, yet Salma was still here.
Connor felt that something was not right, so he walked over.
When he got closer, he realized that Zayn Ferguson was the one pestering Salma.
Furthermore, he had parked his car right in front of hers, preventing Salma from driving away.

chapters.title: Chapter 1399: Let Her Go!
chapters.content:
Chapter 1399: Let Her Go!
"Salma, I truly like you. You should know my feelings for you. I beg you, can you give me another chance?"
Zayn seemed to be drunk as he shouted at Salma.
When Salma heard Zayn's words, she had a helpless expression on her face. She frowned and said, "Zayn, don't you think that's disgusting?Do you like me or the money in my family?"
"Of course I like you…"
Zayn shouted excitedly.
"Your words are really disgusting. Hurry up and move away from me. I don't want to see you now!" Salma shouted.
"I'm not moving away. I have to make things clear to you today!"
Zayn shouted with his eyes wide open.
"What do you want to say? Tell me!"
"I know that you've always been unwilling to accept me. Isn't it because you have that Connor guy in your heart? I really don't understand. What's so good about him? He doesn't like you at all. Your affection is all one-sided. Why would you rather choose someone who doesn't love you than me?"
Zayn said excitedly.
"Who I like is my business. It has nothing to do with you…" Salma replied in a low voice.
"But Connor doesn't like you at all. He's just using you. When you're useful, he comes to you. When you're useless, he doesn't even bother with you."
Zayn said in confusion.
"I told you, this is my own business. It has nothing to do with you!"
Salma bit her lips.
It was obvious that Zayn's words had touched Salma's heart. Although Zayn's words were very overboard, they actually made sense.
"It has nothing to do with me?" Zayn couldn't help but sneer, then shouted, "Salma, when did you become like this? What happened to the past you? Do you know that you're being cheap now?"
"What did you say?"
When Salma heard Zayn's words, she could not help but be stunned for a moment. Her expression was one of disbelief.
Zayn pointed at Salma's nose and shouted.
"I said, you're being cheap. Connor doesn't like you at all, and he's always been using you, but you still stick to him. If this isn't being cheap, then what is it?"
Salma glared at him with an expression filled with anger. Tears flowed down her face.
She really wanted to refute Zayn's words, but she didn't know how.
This was because Salma knew very well that Zayn was right. She was the eldest daughter of the Tang family and had countless suitors around her. However, she fell in love with someone who did not like her at all. If this was not despicable, what was?
"How is it? You also think that what I said is right, right?"
Zayn sneered as he looked at Salma.
"..."
Salma took a deep breath and said with a displeased expression, "That's right, you're right to say that I'm a wimp. I admit that. Are you satisfied now?"
"Then Salma, can you give me another chance? I promise that I will cherish you more than that Connor. I am absolutely sincere to you. Can you give me another chance?"
Zayn shouted excitedly at Salma.
Salma looked at him with a disdainful smile and said, "Zayn, just now you laughed at me for being cheap, then what are you doing now? Aren't you being cheap?"
"You…"
Zayn was stunned.
"That's right, I admit that I like Connor, and I admit that I'm being cheap. However, no matter how cheap I am, I won't like you. People like you disgust me."
Salma shouted at Zayn with a cold expression before reaching out to open her car door.
Zayn seemed to have been provoked by Salma's words as a trace of anger flashed across his eyes. He stretched out his hand and grabbed Salma's arm. Then, he shouted with red eyes, "You damn b * tch, I've done so much for you, yet you're leaving just like that? No matter what, you have to leave with me today, whether dead or alive…"
It was obvious that the current Zayn had drunk too much and had no place to vent his frustration. Moreover, Salma's words had agitated him, so he was obviously a little crazy.
Meanwhile, Salma seemed to be frightened by Zayn's gaze as well. Her expression was filled with fear as she shouted, "Zayn, what are you doing? Are you crazy? Hurry up and let me go…"
"No! Go and get a room with me now…" Zayn shouted with red eyes.
"Hurry up and let go of me. If you don't, I'll shout for help!"
Salma shouted as she struggled.
"Go ahead and shout. Do you see anyone else here?"
Zayn sneered.
"..."
When Salma heard Zayn's words, she was completely flustered. She knew that Zayn had already lost his mind. He would never dare to act like this in broad daylight.
Zayn didn't intend to waste any more time on Salma and directly dragged her into the car.
"Let her go!"
But at this moment, a cold voice sounded behind him.
Zayn was stunned for a moment, then he subconsciously turned around to take a look.
"Is it you?"
When Zayn saw Connor, a trace of anger flashed across his eyes.
After all, the reason why Zayn had come to this point today was all because of Connor.
"Release Salma and scram!"
Connor ordered.
"Who the hell do you think you are? Do you think I have to get lost just because you say so?!" Zayn shouted excitedly.
"I'll say it one last time. Let go of Salma and scram!"
Connor repeated in a low voice.
"If I don't let go, can you…"
"Bang!"
Before Zayn could finish his sentence, Connor rushed up to him and kicked him in the stomach.
Connor did not use all his strength in that kick. If he had used his full strength, then even if he didn't kill Zayn in one blow, the impact would be enough to kick him into a cripple.
Zayn's body was sent flying and then smashed into the ground.

chapters.title: Chapter 1400: The Story of an Ex-Girlfriend?
chapters.content:
Chapter 1400: The Story of an Ex-Girlfriend?
Zayn felt as if his body had been hit by a train. His entire body was in pain.
He struggled to stand up, but he found that he couldn't at all.
Connor knew that Zayn no longer had the ability to resist, so he ignored him and asked Salma softly, "Are you alright?"
"I... I'm fine…"
Salma hurriedly nodded at Connor.
"It's good that you're fine. Get in the car!" Connor replied indifferently before opening the car door.
Salma hesitated for a moment before getting into the car.
"I'll f * cking kill you two!"
But at this moment, the already enraged Zayn suddenly shouted.
Connor felt that it was impossible for Zayn to stand up, so he ignored him.
However, he did not expect Zayn to really stand up and take out a fruit knife from somewhere.
He thrust the knife towards Connor's back.
Under normal circumstances, Connor could completely dodge the fruit knife. However, Salma was right in front of him. If Connor dodged now, the fruit knife would definitely stab Salm instead.
Thus, Connor did not choose to dodge immediately. Instead, he instinctively used his arm to help Salma block the attack.
"Ah…"
Salma screamed.
The fruit knife stabbed into Connor's arm. At the same time, Connor kicked Zayn away.
This time, he used all his strength.
Zayn was immediately knocked out cold.
"Connor, are you alright?"
Salma knew very well that Connor had helped her block the attack.
At this moment, fresh blood dyed Connor's clothes red.
However, Connor was a martial artist himself, so such a wound was nothing to him at all.
"I'm fine…" Connor whispered to Salma.
"Your clothes are stained red with blood, and you still say you're fine? Hurry up and get into the car with me. I'll take you to a nearby hospital to get your wound bandaged…"
Salma's face was filled with panic. She was just an ordinary girl and had never seen such a scene before, so she was already scared to tears.
Connor tore his clothes and wrapped it around the wound to stop the bleeding.
"Connor, hurry up and get in the car!" Salma shouted excitedly as she started her car.
Connor had no choice but to do as he was told.
After Salma saw Connor get into the car, she immediately stepped on the accelerator and drove towards the nearest hospital.
When Connor saw how anxious Salma was, he couldn't help but laugh and say, "I'm really fine. You don't have to be so nervous…"
"Your wound was so deep, so how can you possibly be fine? Zayn is a madman! I didn't expect him to have a knife with him!"
Salma said in a low voice as tears streamed down her face.
Connor hesitated for a moment before asking, "How do you plan to deal with Zayn?"
"What else can I do? When I get home, I'm going to tell my grandfather about this and ask him to take care of Zayn. Previously, I didn't want to go too far because he was really good to me, but I didn't expect Zayn to become like this!"
Salma bit her lips and replied.
Connor looked at Salma indifferently and didn't say anything.
After all, this was a matter between Salma and Zayn. It wouldn't be good if Connor interfered too much. Salma could handle it however she wanted!
Ten minutes later, Connor and Salma arrived at the hospital.
Fortunately, Connor had acted very quickly, so the wound was not very deep. There was no need for stitches at all, and he was discharged after having it properly bandaged.
Salma was relieved after knowing that Connor was fine.
…
Half an hour later.
Connor and Salma left the hospital.
"Connor, where do you live? Shall I send you home?" Salma asked.
"No need, I'll take a taxi back myself. What happened just now scared you quite a bit. You should go back and rest early!"
Connor replied with a smile.
".."
After hearing Connor's words, Salma couldn't help but hesitate for a moment before saying softly, "Is there really nothing wrong with you?"
"Of course not. Hurry up and go back!"
Connor said with a smile.
".."
Salma hesitated for a moment before saying in a low voice, "Thank you for…just now. If it wasn't because you had to protect me, you wouldn't have been injured…"
"It's okay. Why should you be thanking me? I'm the one who should be thanking you!" Connor hurriedly replied.
"Me?" When Salma heard this, she couldn't help but be stunned for a moment. Then, she asked with a puzzled expression, "Why are you thanking me?"
"Of course, I have to thank you for coming to my opening ceremony!"
Connor said softly.
Salma sized up Connor and whispered, "Connor, can I ask you a question?"
"What is it?"
Connor asked.
"Do you also think that I'm quite cheap? I clearly know that you don't like me at all, but I still like you…" Salma whispered.
"Does liking someone qualify you as being an easy woman?" Connor asked softly and then continued, "Do you want to hear the story between me and my ex-girlfriend?"
"The story between you and your ex-girlfriend?"
After Salma heard this, a hint of confusion flashed in her eyes.
"That's right. I think if you listen to my story, you'll know that what you're doing now is not cheap at all. What I did back then was really terrible!"
Connor smiled helplessly.
Salma blinked and said softly, "If you say so, I'm a little curious about your story!"
Although Connor was unwilling to recall the things that happened between him and Mandy Hines, in order to make Salma feel better, he still chose to tell her everything, from the time he met Mandy to the time he broke up with her.
In the beginning, Salma still couldn't believe that all these things had happened to Connor because she couldn't imagine that he could've gone through such things.
However, when she saw the expression on Connor's face, she felt that he was not lying.
..

chapters.title: Chapter 1401: Dealing with Connor
chapters.content:
Chapter 1401: Dealing with Connor
After Salma finished listening to Connor's story, her face was filled with shock.
"I didn't expect you to have such a past."
Salma shouted at Connor in surprise.
"That's right. At that time, I was the one who was really being cheap. Now, you're just in love with someone. Moreover, I think that if it's because you like someone, it's fine even if you're being cheap."
Connor said.
"Alright, after hearing about you, I feel that I'm quite normal. Although I do like you now, I'm also trying my best to give up on you. I don't want to hang myself on a tree…"
At this moment, Salma's mood was obviously much more relaxed.
Connor saw a smile appear on Salma's face once again, so he was no longer so worried about her.
"It's best if you think that way. Although I can't be with you, no matter what, we're friends. If you have anything, you can come to me at any time!"
Connor said to Salma with a smile.
"Who's your friend? I don't want to be friends with you!"
Salma pouted and replied.
"You just said that you like me, but now you don't even want to be my friend. Aren't you changing your tone too quickly?" Connor said speechlessly.
"Anyway, it's getting late, so I'm going home. Are you sure you don't need me to send you back?" Salma asked.
"No need. I think it should be easy to get a taxi here. I'll just call one over…"
Connor said lightly.
"Alright, then I'll leave first!"
Salma waved her hand at Connor before getting into her car and driving off.
Soon, Salma's car disappeared from Connor's sight.
Meanwhile, Connor reached out to hail a taxi and prepared to go home.
…
Meanwhile, in a high-end villa in Newtown.
Tenner sat on the sofa with an ugly expression on his face.
Arthur and Zayn were sitting opposite him. Their expressions were extremely nervous as they carefully looked at Tenner.
"Hm…"
Tenner took a deep breath and said with a ferocious expression, "Are you two trash? I got so many guests for the two of you, and I even invited Galuf Lee over, but the two of you actually messed up this matter? What are you two thinking?"
"Mr. Ward, you really can't blame the two of us for this. Who knew that Connor could actually invite people like Yvette Wendell and Blake Layton over? We've all underestimated him!" Arthur explained helplessly.
"What were you doing before? Didn't I ask you to investigate Connor's situation clearly? Couldn't you even find out about this news?"
Tenner's eyes widened as he shouted angrily.
"I really didn't know that he was so powerful. If I had known this, I wouldn't have chosen to have a ceremony on the same day as him!" Arthur said in a low voice.
Tenner looked at Arthur helplessly. He knew in his heart that he could not blame Arthur for this, after all, Connor's connections were too terrifying. It definitely wasn't an easy thing to deal with.
"And you, Zayn. What's wrong with you? We've already lost all our dignity, yet you still want to go at Connor with a knife. Do you even have a brain?"
Tenner asked with a helpless expression.
"Mr. Ward, I was really impulsive at that time. I wasn't thinking. You must save me!"
Zayn was finally sober now as he shouted at Tenner excitedly.
Tenner looked at Zayn and took a deep breath before saying in a low voice, "You want me to save you now? Tell me, how can I save you?"
"Mr. Ward, you know so many people. You must have a way to save me…"
Zayn said nervously.
"If you offended someone else, I might still have a way to save you. However, you've offended both the Thompson family and Connor now. I can't do anything about it…" Tenner said expressionlessly.
"Then what should I do now?"
Zayn asked in panic.
"What else can you do? Get out of Newtown and come back when everything blows over!"
Tenner replied.
"Alright, alright, I understand…"
Zayn hurriedly nodded, then turned around and left the living room.
After Zayn left, Tenner looked at Arthur helplessly and said, "No, where did you find this person? Is he completely brainless? The opening ceremony already ended, so what was he going after Connor for?"
"This person had a grudge with Connor before, so I kept him by my side. But I didn't expect him to do such a thing. He really doesn't have any brains!" Arthur replied with a helpless expression.
"Next time you look for someone, can you put in more effort?"
Tenner frowned.
"I'll definitely be more careful next time!"
Arthur quickly agreed. Then, he looked at Tenner and asked, "What does President Ward mean now?"
"President Ward is also very angry now. After all, President Ward has put in a lot of effort for the opening ceremony of this club. But I have also explained it for you. In the end, we underestimated Connor. It can't be entirely your responsibility!"
Tenner said expressionlessly.
After hesitating for a moment, Arthur asked again, "Then what's the plan next?"
"Although the opening ceremony was not successful, our clubhouse is a newly opened one, so it's not particularly embarrassing to make it look like this. Moreover, since we've already spent money to buy this clubhouse and the renovation is almost done, we can only keep it open…"
Tenner said.
"What about Connor?"
Arthur asked.
"Through this matter, President Ward can be considered to know Connor's approximate strength. Although this is Newtown, Connor does have some influence. Therefore, it is impossible to defeat Connor through normal methods. We can only think of other methods!"
Tenner said.
"What other method is that?"
Arthur asked.
"Although President Ward didn't say it explicitly, I think he was probably planning for us to make a move on Connor!"
Tenner said expressionlessly.
"Attack Connor?"
After hearing Tenner's words, a hint of excitement flashed across Arthur's eyes.

chapters.title: Chapter 1402: How to Flatter Women
chapters.content:
Chapter 1402: How to Flatter Women
"Mr. Ward, how do you plan to deal with Connor?"
Arthur asked Tenner excitedly.
Tenner said, "I heard that Connor is surprisingly skilled, so it might not be easy for us to deal with Connor. Therefore, we can only think of other methods…"
"Like what?" Arthur asked.
Tenner said expressionlessly, "I didn't have much contact with Connor before, so I don't know him very well. Do you know if he has any weaknesses?"
"Weaknesses?"
The expression on Arthur's face seemed a little puzzled, and then he said helplessly, "Actually, I don't know what Connor's weakness is!"
"What about his friends?"
Tenner asked.
"Connor doesn't seem to have any friends, but I know that he has a fiancée called Freya Phillips."
Arthur said in a low voice.
"Connor actually has a fiancée?" Tenner couldn't help but smile when he heard this. He then said expressionlessly, "In that case, this matter will be much easier to handle…"
"Mr. Ward, what do you mean?"
Arthur asked in confusion.
"Connor is very troublesome to deal with; his skills are very good, so ordinary killers may not be a match for him. However, we can choose to attack Connor's fiancée instead. As long as we control Connor's fiancée, it is equivalent to controlling Connor himself. At that time, won't things be much simpler?"
Tenner chuckled.
Arthur also smiled and said, "Mr. Ward, you have many ideas. I think this idea is not bad! When the time comes, I'll discuss it with you and see what we should do!"
Tenner said expressionlessly.
"Good!"
Arthur nodded in agreement and then continued, "If Mr. Ward has nothing else to say, I'll take my leave first!"
"Let's go!"
Tenner waved his hand at Arthur, then instructed, " Choose the general manager of the Triumph Clubhouse carefully. Don't find a brainless person like Zayn Ferguson again..."
"Mr. Ward, don't worry. I will definitely choose well this time!"
Arthur hurriedly said.
"Alright!"
Tenner waved his hand lightly.
…
On the other side, Connor took a taxi home.
Rachel saw the gauze on Connor's hand and asked in a puzzled tone, "Didn't you go to the opening ceremony today? Why are you injured?"
"I encountered a little trouble…"
Connor replied indifferently, then walked directly to Rachel's side and sat on the sofa.
"I heard that your opening ceremony today was quite successful?"
Rachel asked, turning to him.
"It's not bad, just so-so…" Connor replied, shrugging.
"Alright, stop pretending with me. The news of your club's opening has already spread on Twitter. Blake Layton, Yvette Wendell, and the others were all there.You practically showed your face to the entire nation's netizens this time…"
Rachel said indifferently.
"That's a small matter. I have a very important question to ask you now!"
Connor said.
"A very important question?"
After Rachel heard Connor's words, she couldn't help but be stunned. Then, she asked in confusion, "What important question?"
"How do you think I should please a woman?"
Connor asked.
"Please a woman?"
The expression on Rachel's face was even more puzzled. She could not help but ask, "You're already so rich, so isn't it easy for you to get a woman? There should be no need to please women, right? And I remember that you have a fiancée. Are you planning to cheat on her?"
"What cheating?" Connor replied with a helpless expression, then continued, "See, Chelsea plans to take Vanessa away, but my club can't do without Vanessa, so I plan to please Vanessa enough so that she'll stay back…"
The thing that gave Connor the biggest headache now was probably the matter with Vanessa; after all, the Heavens Club couldn't do without her.
"So that's how it is!"
Rachel gently nodded.
"Yeah, but I don't know how to please her. I'm worried that if I go too far, Vanessa might misunderstand that I like her. But if I do it too simply, I'm worried that Vanessa won't understand what I mean..."
Connor was very troubled about this. After all, when he was poor, those women looked down on him at all. Later on, when he was rich, those women took the initiative to seek him out. Therefore, Connor really did not know how to please a woman the authentic way.
"Isn't it easy for you to please a woman?" Rachel said.
"Simple? How is it simple?"
Connor hurriedly asked.
"Women are all emotional creatures. If you want to please a woman, the easiest and most direct way is to give her gifts. As long as you give her a good gift, the woman will understand your intentions…"
Rachel said indifferently.
"But Vanessa is very rich. What should I give her for her to understand?"
Connor said helplessly.
If it was any other ordinary girl, it would be very easy to give them a gift, but a woman like Vanessa didn't seem to lack anything.
"Oh, why are you so silly? It's not that you're giving her something she's lacking— If she lacked something, she would have bought it herself. You're giving her a gift to express your feelings," Rachel said.
"So that's how it is!"
Connor nodded thoughtfully, then looked at Rachel and asked again, "Then what reason do you think I should give her? I can't tell Vanessa, 'I want you to stay in this club, so I'm giving you a gift,' right?"
"Didn't your opening ceremony this time be quite successful? Can't you just say that it's a reward for her?"
Rachel replied.
After Connor heard Rachel's words, he could not help but laugh. Then, he said, "Looks like I have asked the right person. Your suggestion is very good…"
"You're too stupid. Any normal person would probably be able to think of these things!" Rachel said helplessly.
"..."
Connor looked at Rachel's expression and was speechless, but he didn't say anything. After all, Rachel had helped Connor a little this time.

chapters.title: Chapter 1403: Kidnapped?
chapters.content:
Chapter 1403: Kidnapped?
The next day, at eight o'clock in the morning.
Connor got up early and ran to Rachel's room door, knocking hard.
"Rachel, get up!" Connor shouted at the top of his lungs.
"I don't have class today. Don't bother me!"
Rachel shouted in a muffled voice.
"Well, I plan to buy Vanessa a gift today, but I don't know what to buy. Come with me…"
"Get lost, I want to sleep!"
"Don't worry, I won't let you help me for nothing. If you take anything you like, I'll pay for it!"
Connor said with a smile
When Rachel heard this, she was stunned for a moment. Then, she asked, "Is what you said true?"
"Of course, I always keep my word!" Connor replied.
"Alright, wait for me. I'll be right out!"
Rachel agreed happily.
Connor's expression was a little helpless. Then, he sat on the sofa and waited.
After half an hour, Connor followed Rachel to a shopping mall in Newtown.
After entering the mall, Rachel began to shop like there was no tomorrow, and everything she bought was from luxury stores.
In less than 20 minutes, Rachel had bought more than ten pieces of clothes and seven or eight branded bags for herself. The prices of these bags and dresses were not cheap. If it wasn't because Connor was really rich, he would probably die of heartache on the spot.
An hour later, Rachel finally finished shopping and helped Connor pick a few gifts for Vanessa.
"Lady, you bought so much for yourself and then bought this little thing for Vanessa. Isn't that a little inappropriate?"
At this moment, Connor obviously regretted letting Rachel come over because he had been busy for more than an hour and was buying things solely for her..
"What do you know? This is the first time you're giving Vanessa a gift, and it isn't suitable for me. You have to understand the principle of taking things step by step, so just give me these things this time. I'll accompany you the next time we come here…"
Rachel said as she tried on the latest bag.
"I definitely won't bring you here next time…"
Connor gritted his teeth and said,
"Are you planning to kill the donkey when you have no more use for it?" Rachel asked.
"It's mainly because you're too good at buying. I can't put so many things in my house!"
Connor said helplessly.
"It's okay. If you can't put them in your house. You can put them in my new house!"
Rachel replied indifferently and then said to the store attendant, "Please help me wrap it up!"
"Alright!"
The store attendant looked at Rachel as if he was looking at a god of fortune and agreed enthusiastically.
Rachel continued to shop.
"Big sister, we're almost done, right?"
Connor said helplessly.
"You're already so rich, why do you still feel bad about this little bit of money? I've helped you so many times. You should know that in your heart. What's wrong with me asking you to buy something for me now?" Rachel said indifferently.
".."
Connor looked at Rachel and did not know what to say.
Half an hour later, Rachel was finally done shopping. She walked into the taxi with a bunch of bags.
Connor took a taxi to Heavens Club.
When Connor arrived, it was already past 10 am, so Connor felt that Vanessa should have woken up by now.
Perhaps it was because of the opening ceremony yesterday, the Heavens Clubhouse was very busy today. It was already crowded before night time.
When the manager on duty saw Connor coming over, he hurriedly walked up to Connor and said with a smile, "Mr. McDonald, you're here?"
"Yes, I came for President Canfield!"
Connor replied.
"President Canfield should still be upstairs now. I'll help you call her!" the manager on duty replied.
"There's no need to go through so much trouble. I'll go up directly!"
Connor replied indifferently, then walked into the elevator.
A few minutes later, Connor arrived at Vanessa's office.
At this time, her office was half open, and the lights were still on.
In order to prevent the same thing from happening again, Connor knocked on the office door in advance, but even after knocking a few times, there was no response from inside. Connor had no choice but to push open the door and walk in.
After entering Vanessa's office, Connor smelled a very tempting fragrance. It was as if Connor would smell this fragrance every time he came in. It was very seductive, similar to the smell on Vanessa's body.
"President Canfield?"
Connor saw that there was no one in the office, so he called out, but no one responded.
"Is she out?"
Connor sighed, then sat on the sofa and began to wait quietly.
However, Connor waited for nearly ten minutes, but Vanessa still didn't come back. Connor took out his mobile phone and called her, only to find that she had turned off her phone.
The expression on Connor's face seemed a little helpless, and then he prepared to leave.
However, just as Connor was about to leave, he suddenly heard a very soft sound coming from the lounge.
His brow furrowed. He vaguely felt that there was probably someone in the lounge.
And just now, Connor had called Vanessa's name several times and no one responded, so this meant that Vanessa should not be in the lounge, otherwise there was no way she wouldn't come out for such a long time.
"Could it be a thief?"
Connor was shocked.
However, he quickly denied this idea because Connor knew that the security of Heavens Club was very tight. It was impossible for ordinary people to enter.
The reason why Connor was able to enter the office last time was because the Heavens Club was having a cocktail party. Most of the security guards were at the front, and there was no one in the office building.
"Could it be that Vanessa was kidnapped?"
A bold idea flashed through Connor's mind again.
Because Connor felt that Vanessa's phone was turned off, but there was a sound in the lounge, which meant that there must be someone there.
It was very likely that Vanessa was being kidnapped by someone, but Connor suddenly came in, so the other party could only bring Vanessa to the lounge first.
The more Connor thought about it, the more he felt that something was wrong. He directly walked to the door of the lounge.
Connor put his ear to the door. He could clearly hear that there was indeed movement in the lounge.
"Hu…"
Connor took a deep breath and gently pushed the door open.
The door wasn't locked, so he had no problem opening it.
However, the gap was too small. Connor could only see a limited area and could not see the full situation inside the lounge.
Connor was worried that Vanessa had really encountered some danger, so he mustered up the courage to open all the doors and then walk into the room.

chapters.title: Chapter 1404: Guilty Conscience
chapters.content:
Chapter 1404: Guilty Conscience
But when Connor really walked into the room, he was completely stunned, disbelief on his face.
Vanessa was not kidnapped at all.
On the contrary, Vanessa was actually sleeping soundly on the bed.
Of course, this was not what shocked Connor the most.
He was shocked that Vanessa was actually sleeping naked at this time, and the quilt that was supposed to be covering her body had been kicked aside.
This also meant that Vanessa appeared naked in Connor's line of sight. At this time, Vanessa seemed to be sleeping soundly, her eyes were closed, and her mouth was muttering something, as if she was very comfortable.
Connor looked at Vanessa's pure white and flawless delicate body, his entire person was dumbfounded, his breathing obviously somewhat accelerated.
Connor really couldn't understand how his luck could be so good. The last time, he'd accidentally saw Vanessa changing clothes, and this time he accidentally saw Vanessa sleeping while naked.
"Why isn't this woman wearing clothes when she sleeps?"
A trace of helplessness flashed across Connor's eyes. Then, he looked at her fair and flawless body and turned around to leave.
After all, if Connor was discovered by Vanessa, the two would be very embarrassed. Although Vanessa's body was very attractive, Connor prepared to leave.
But just as Connor was about to turn around, his right leg accidentally kicked the red wine bottle that Vanessa had placed on the ground.
"Clang!"
After the bottle of red wine fell, it made a loud sound.
Connor was dumbfounded.
Vanessa, who was sleeping soundly, opened her eyes when she heard the sound and saw Connor standing by the bed.
At this time, Vanessa was completely naked, and the blanket had already been kicked to her feet.
So when Vanessa saw Connor, her eyes were filled with shock and disbelief. She didn't know what kind of reaction she should make.
"M-Miss Vanessa…"
Connor awkwardly greeted.
It was then that Vanessa's brain finally caught up with the situation. She hurriedly grabbed the blanket at her feet, then hid herself under it.
Vanessa knew very clearly that Connor must have seen her in such an unflattering state, so in an instant, her pretty face blushed a little, and her entire person looked delicate and alluring.
"Connor, why are you in my room? What are you doing?"
Vanessa stared at Connor, her expression very ashamed and angry.
At this moment, Vanessa's face was so red that it seemed like she would start steaming at the ears..
"Vanessa, I really didn't do it on purpose. I came to look for you today for something, but I didn't expect..."
Connor wanted to explain himself, but Vanessa cut him off.
"Then why didn't you knock when you came in? Shouldn't you knock first?" Vanessa had no way to remain calm at this moment. The expression on her face was extremely shameful and angry as she shouted at Connor.
"I knocked, but no one answered me!"
Connor explained, feeling rather wronged.
"You... You…" Vanessa took a deep breath and said in a low voice, "Can you get out now?"
"Y-yes..."
Connor hurriedly nodded. Without any delay, he turned around and walked out of the lounge.
After Vanessa saw Connor leave, she tried to calm down her emotions and began to think about what had happened yesterday.
After the opening ceremony yesterday, Vanessa felt a little tired because she drank a little, so she planned to go back to the office to rest.
However, at this time, there was a document that needed Vanessa to review. Because of this, Vanessa was busy until three in the morning.
When Vanessa wanted to sleep, however, she realized that she couldn't!
As a result, she had no choice but to drink some red wine before going to bed.
This was also the reason why Connor had kicked the red wine bottle just now.
Vanessa usually didn't sleep naked, but because the air conditioner wasn't working yesterday and it was really late, Vanessa took off all her clothes.
As for the room door, it was not locked because she was too busy and had forgotten about it.
But the more she thought about it, still couldn't think of a reason as to why Connor would appear in her room.
After Connor left Vanessa's bedroom, he sat on the sofa alone with a very nervous expression on his face because he didn't know how to explain himself.
Connor took a deep breath and tried his best to calm himself down.
Today, Connor came over to please Vanessa. Though Chelsea wanted to take Vanessa away, Connor wanted to keep her around. But who would have thought that things would turn out like this? Connor hadn't even given the gift to her yet, and he'd already managed to bump into Vanessa sleeping naked. On top of that, he was caught by her.
Now that this had happened, it was already good enough that Vanessa didn't bother with Connor. It was practically impossible for him to persuade her to continue staying in Heavens Club.
The more Connor thought about it, the more exasperated he felt. He couldn't understand why he kept encountering such things.
Previously, when Connor saw Vanessa changing clothes, he could say that he didn't see anything, but just now, if Connor had said that he didn't see anything, Vanessa definitely wouldn't believe it.
Therefore, Connor felt that he should treat it as if nothing had happened and leave this place directly.
But if Connor really left now, then Vanessa would definitely misunderstand, and she would think he had a guilty conscience.
Therefore, Connor felt that he had to explain this matter clearly no matter what. If this matter was not explained clearly, it would only lead to more misunderstandings and trouble.
"Anyway, whether Vanessa believes it or not, I didn't do it on purpose today. I have to make it clear!" Connor muttered, then sat on the sofa and waited for Vanessa to come out.
About ten minutes later, Vanessa finally changed her clothes and walked out of the lounge.
Although Vanessa had already put on her clothes, she still felt naked when she saw Connor.
Connor couldn't help but recall the scene just now. It wasn't because Connor was lecherous; it was just a normal instinct. No matter how serious a man was, after experiencing such a thing, these things would naturally flash through his mind.
Connor was also a normal man.
He was not a saint, so this was also very normal.

chapters.title: Chapter 1405: I Saw Everything!
chapters.content:
Chapter 1405: I Saw Everything!
Connor stood up and said, "Vanessa, you're done, I see."
Vanessa tried her best to control her emotions and asked coldly, "Why are you still here?"
Connor took a deep breath and said, "Vanessa, I think I should explain this to you!"
"Explain?" Vanessa smiled disdainfully, then said lightly, "Are you going to tell me that you didn't see anything? That you didn't do it on purpose?"
"I…"
Connor opened his mouth to speak.
"What about you? This isn't the first time something like this has happened. The last time you saw me changing my clothes, you said you didn't do it on purpose. I believed you then. But this time, you suddenly ran into my room. How are you going to explain yourself?"
When Vanessa said these words, her body kept trembling, and the expression on her face was very angry. She felt that Connor must have done it on purpose. Otherwise, how could there be such a coincidence?
Connor took a deep breath and said in a low voice, "Vanessa, I know very well that you won't believe me if I explain these things to you now. However, no matter what, you have to let me speak. I've said everything I need to say. If you still think that I did it on purpose, then there's nothing I can do…"
"..."
Vanessa turned her head and looked at Connor. She found that Connor's expression was very serious, so she said coldly, "Alright, what do you want to explain now? Just say it!"
"First of all, I'm really sorry about what happened just now. I admit that I did see it, and I saw it very clearly!" Connor said.
"You…"
Vanessa glared at him, her expression unusually angry.
She didn't expect Connor to admit it so shamelessly.
"Vanessa, your figure is so alluring. It's impossible for me to not look. I can't control my eyes either!" Connor continued.
"Can you say something useful?"
Vanessa wasn't in the mood to listen to Connor praise her body.
"The reason why I came here today is because I feel that you've worked hard for the opening ceremony, so I specially got someone to buy you some gift. Although these things are nothing to you, they represent my sincere feelings!" Connor took out his gift as he spoke.
Now Connor was very grateful for Rachel's methods. After all, without this gift, Connor really wouldn't be able to explain himself properly.
"Just now, you said that I peeked on purpose. If I really did it on purpose, how could I know that you were sleeping naked in the lounge? It's already 11 in the morning," Connor continued.
"..."
Vanessa felt that Connor's words seemed to make sense, but she still frowned and said, "But why didn't you knock when you came in?"
"I knocked on the door, but no one answered me. If you don't believe me, go take a look at the surveillance camera!" Connor replied, then continued, "I knocked on the door when I came in, but no one answered me, so I entered first before realizing that you weren't in the office. I sat on the sofa alone and waited for you to come back and even called you. You can check the surveillance cameras for all these…"
Vanessa hesitated for a moment, then walked to her computer and pulled out the video footage.
After Vanessa finished watching the surveillance footage, she found that what Connor said was true. Connor had waited in the office for more than ten minutes.
Connor pointed at the image on the computer and said in a serious tone, "After that, I saw that you didn't come back, so I planned to leave. But at that moment, I heard a sound from your bedroom. I thought that you were in danger or had been kidnapped. You can see that I listened at the door for a long time before entering. Before that, I didn't go to your lounge…"
By now, Vanessa already knew that Connor didn't do it on purpose.
"I was worried that you were in danger, so I went straight in. Then, I saw you lying on the bed, so I planned to leave. However, I didn't expect to accidentally kick a wine bottle, and then you woke up!"
Connor paused for a moment and then continued, "Vanessa, I have already told you everything that I need to tell you. If you still think that I did it on purpose, then there is nothing I can do…"
Vanessa looked at Connor in front of her, the expression on her face was very ashamed, because she knew that she might have really wronged Connor.
"Vanessa, I admit that I did see something that I shouldn't have seen, but I really didn't do it on purpose. I explained these things to you only because I hope that you can forgive me. Of course, I know that even if you don't forgive me after such a thing happened, I have nothing to say!"
Connor said very seriously.
Vanessa took a deep breath and asked with a puzzled expression, "Are you telling the truth?"
"The truth is right here. If you don't believe me, there's nothing I can do. I'm not a god. How would I know that you woke up so late today?" Connor said, tired.
Vanessa asked nervously, "...What did you see just now?"
"I... I don't think I saw anything. I was a little nervous at that time…"
Connor stuttered.
"Did you really not see anything?"
Vanessa narrowed her eyes.
"Vanessa, I really didn't see anything. I was really too nervous at that time. I just wanted to leave as soon as possible…" Connor hurriedly said.
"You're lying. I can't forgive you!"
Vanessa said bluntly.
Vanessa was the general manager of Heavens Clubhouse; she had seen countless men here, so she was familiar with what men were thinking. Therefore, when Connor said that he didn't see anything, Vanessa definitely wouldn't believe it.
"Ah…"
After Connor saw Vanessa's attitude, his expression was somewhat helpless, and then he said in a low voice, "Fine, I admit it. I saw it just now!"
"You…"
After Vanessa heard this sentence, the expression on her face turned even more furious.
"Vanessa, in that situation just now, your figure was so good, so how could I not look? This isn't something I can control!" Connor explained helplessly. "Vanessa, I really didn't do it on purpose. Please forgive me!"

chapters.title: Chapter 1406: Cheryl Salmond
chapters.content:
Chapter 1406: Cheryl Salmond
"Forgive you?"
Vanessa laughed coldly, then said with an embarrassed and resentful expression, "How can I forgive you?"
"You can do whatever you want to me as long as you forgive me!" Connor hurriedly said.
Vanessa didn't know what to do. First of all, Connor really didn't do it on purpose; he'd been worried that she was in danger, so he'd entered the lounge. Now that this matter had already happened, even if she didn't forgive Connor, what could she do?
She couldn't just kill him or dig out his eyes, right?
Moreover, Vanessa still had to meet with Connor in the future, so she had no way to not forgive Connor.
"Vanessa, how do you think this should be handled?"
Connor asked Vanessa.
Vanessa hesitated for two seconds before saying in a low voice, "I hope that a third person knows about this. I also hope that you can forget about this matter and never mention it to me again, understand?"
"Don't worry, I'll definitely forget it. I definitely won't tell anyone!"
Connor hurriedly nodded.
"The second condition is that I don't want to see you for the next week. If I see you again, I'll resign immediately!" Vanessa continued.
"Alright, alright. I won't be in Newtown this week. I promise you won't be able to see me!"
Connor nodded again.
"Alright, then you can leave now!"
Vanessa waved at Connor helplessly.
When Connor heard this, he hurriedly walked out of the office. He'd originally planned to please Vanessa today, but no one would've thought that things would turn out like this in the end. He couldn't help but feel like the entire ordeal had ruined things.
Vanessa sat alone on the sofa, her face filled with shame and anger.
She couldn't figure out what was wrong with her recently. She had never encountered such a thing before, but it had happened twice recently, and with the same person, no less.
Vanessa suddenly saw the gift in Connor's hands, and a strange look flashed in her eyes. Then she suddenly stood up, wanting to say that she had gone too far just now.
However, Connor had already left.
Vanessa felt that Connor definitely didn't do it on purpose, but her attitude towards him just now was really not good.
"Will Connor be angry because of this?"
Vanessa sighed with worry.
…
Vanessa might not know, but Connor definitely wouldn't be angry because of these things. After all, Connor was trying to please her, so how could he be angry?
Since he'd promised Vanessa that he would not appear in front of her for the next week, Connor planned to go to Porthampton to avoid the limelight. After all, he had not seen Freya for a long time, and there was nothing to do in Newtown, so Connor decided to wait until Vanessa forgot about this matter before coming back.
Connor asked Reena to book a plane ticket for him, then took a taxi to Newtown's airport.
It was past two in the afternoon when Connor boarded the plane and found his seat.
Since Reena was the one who booked the ticket, it was definitely a first-class seat.
There weren't many passengers in the first-class cabin, so it was very comfortable.
After Connor sat down, he decided to close his eyes and rest. After all, it would take several hours to get from Newtown to Porthampton.
However, he had just closed his eyes when he smelled a faint fragrance.
He subconsciously opened his eyes and saw a girl walking over with a bag.
The girl looked very sexy. She had short wavy blonde hair, giving her a pure and lively feeling. She was very cute and had a good figure, and her legs were slender and long.
When Connor saw this girl, his expression was a little puzzled because he felt that this girl seemed a little familiar.
Just as Connor was staring at the girl, she noticed him.
"Connor McDonald?"
The girl shouted in surprise.
"And you are?"
When Connor saw the girl call out his name, his expression was a little puzzled.
"Don't you recognize me? I'm Cheryl Salmond!" the girl shouted happily.
"Cheryl Salmond?"
Connor's eyes flashed with a trace of surprise. He finally remembered who the girl in front of him was.
This girl was Cheryl Salmond, Connor's high school classmate.
Back then, Cheryl was sitting behind Connor, so she had a good relationship with him.
However, they didn't stay classmates for too long because Connor had offended a rich heir in school, so he had no choice but to transfer schools after that.
Ever since Connor transferred schools, he had never seen Cheryl again.
"It's been a while, but you're still the same…"
Cheryl smiled at Connor and continued, "You're doing quite well now. You're actually sitting in first class…"
Cheryl's family was well-off, so it was normal for her to sit in first class. However, when she was in high school, Cheryl knew that Connor's family wasn't very rich. That was why she was so surprised to see him in first class.
"Someone bought me a plane ticket…" Connor explained with a smile.
"So that's how it is!"
Cheryl nodded and continued, "Connor, what are you doing now?"
"I'm still studying!"
Connor replied.
"Why are you still studying? I've already started working..." Cheryl said in surprise.
"After I transferred schools, I didn't go straight to the second year. Instead, I had to retake my first year, so I graduated a little later than you guys…"
"I see!" Cheryl nodded. "Are you planning to go to Porthampton?"
"Yeah, I'm heading there!"
"That's great. I'm going to Porthampton too for a class reunion. All our classmates will be there. You haven't seen them for a long time, right? Why don't you go over too?" Cheryl asked happily.
When Connor heard Cheryl's words, he couldn't help but be stunned. Then, he said, "I'm not very familiar with the students in our class, so I think I won't go. You guys can have fun!"
"Don't. It's fate that we met today. Why don't you come with me? Besides, our class has many students who are asking about your situation. You should come over!" Cheryl invited warmly.

chapters.title: Chapter 1407: Class Reunion
chapters.content:
Chapter 1407: Class Reunion
Seeing Cheryl's enthusiasm, Connor couldn't help but hesitate for a moment before asking, "When does the class reunion start?"
"At 8 pm tonight, at the newly opened Hotel Magnifique in Porthampton!" Cheryl replied.
Connor hesitated for a moment before nodding.
"Alright then. If I have time today, I'll go with you…"
"That's great! I wanted to invite you over before, but you didn't contact our classmates, so I couldn't find you. Now we can all gather!" Cheryl said happily.
Connor felt that since he had nothing to do tonight, he might as well go and see how his classmates were doing.
During the entire flight, Cheryl was chatting with Connor, so time passed very quickly.
Connor and Cheryl separated after leaving the airport. Cheryl had other things to do, but Connor did not ask what they were.
He went to Jorge's house alone.
The pill that Connor had asked Jorge to refine for Yerba Layton was already done by now, so he planned to give it to her. After all, Yerba had helped Connor a lot during the opening ceremony, so he didn't want to go back on his word.
After getting the pill, Connor chatted with Jorge for a while and told him about his recent events. However, Jorge didn't seem to care about Connor's business and just reminded him not to forget about his ancient martial arts cultivation.
Connor felt very awkward after hearing Jorge's words because he had not put any effort into his ancient martial arts cultivation recently.
After Connor finished chatting with Jorge, he sparred with Jabba.
It had to be said that recently, Connor's skills had indeed regressed greatly.
"Looks like I'll have to train hard when I go back!" Connor sighed.
At six o'clock in the evening, Connor left Jorge's house and took a taxi to the Hotel Magnifique that Cheryl had mentioned.
Hotel Magnifique was definitely one of the top hotels in Porthampton, and it was a chain hotel. It was usually used to entertain some noble guests, and it had a system similar to the Heavens Club in that it also adopted a membership system. However, the membership requirements of Hotel Magnifique were completely different from those of the Heavens Club.
After all, there were very few people who could really come into contact with Heavens Club. In the eyes of ordinary people, being able to come to Hotel Magnifique for a meal was already very impressive.
Therefore, it was obviously the most suitable place to hold the class reunion. This way, it would be convenient for many people to show off.
At this moment, a few young people were standing in front of the Hotel Magnifique's gate and chatting. It was obvious that everyone was surrounding a young man in a white suit. This young man was probably the main character of this class reunion.
The young man was quite good-looking. He was very tall and had a very refined temperament. At this moment, he was joking with a few female students.
A few of his girlfriends also kept winking at the young man.
At this moment, Cheryl stepped out of the taxi in her high heels.
When the young man saw Cheryl, he quickly went up to her and said with a smile, "Cheryl, you're finally here!"
"I'm really sorry. I suddenly had something to do over there, so I came a little late…" Cheryl said to everyone.
"It's okay. It's all thanks to you, Cheryl. If it weren't for you, we wouldn't have been able to gather like this…"
"That's right. This class reunion was organized by her..."
Cheryl had been very popular when she was in school.
"Everyone is flattering me. Although I'm the organizer, Mitchell Chen's the one who's treating us tonight. If you want to thank anyone, thank him!"
Cheryl said as she looked at the young man in a white suit.
"So Mr. Chen's the one treating us?"
"I was wondering why you chose such a good hotel!"
"Isn't Mr. Chen too amazing? However, this hotel seems to require a membership card. Without a membership card, you can't enter..."
Everyone murmured amongst themselves.
After Mitchell heard everyone's words, his expression seemed a little smug. Then, he said with a smile, "You don't have to worry about that. I'm a member here, so once everyone arrives, just follow me in…"
After everyone heard Mitchell's words, their expressions changed again.
In the eyes of ordinary people like them, being able to get a Hotel Magnifique membership card was an extremely glorious thing in itself!
"Mr. Chen actually got a membership card for Hotel Magnifique?"
"Isn't he too powerful?"
"We really can't compare to Mr. Chen!"
The students present began to whisper among themselves.
Mitchell looked at everyone with a very satisfied expression.
In fact, Mitchell was not a member of Hotel Magnifique at all. Of course, he was not qualified to get a membership card of Hotel Magnifique. This membership card was borrowed from Mitchell's uncle.
Mitchell's uncle was now the financial director of a branch of the Empire World Corporation. He had some power. Mitchell was also interning in this branch because of his uncle.
One had to know that the Empire World Corporation was one of the top companies in Porthampton. No company could be compared to them.
Therefore, although Mitchell was only working in the branch company now, he could still make many people envious.
Moreover, Mitchell's uncle had some connections in the Empire World Corporation. As long as Mitchell did not make any big mistakes, he would definitely be able to gain a foothold in the Empire World Corporation in the future.
Once he had a firm foothold in a place like the Empire World Corporation, he wouldn't have to worry about food and clothing in the future. In Porthampton City, anyone who said that he was a manager of the Empire World Corporation would be looked up to no matter where he went.
This was the Empire World Corporation's greatest influence!
The reason why Mitchell went through so much trouble to choose this Hotel Magnifique for the gathering was to let everyone know that he was the most promising one among these students.
After all, there were many ordinary people among his classmates, so it was a very bragging matter for him to be able to work at the Empire World Corporation now.
When Mitchell heard the discussions of the crowd, the sense of superiority in his heart increased.
For these graduates from ordinary universities, it was already very impressive to be able to find a decent job. However, there were very few people like Mitchell who could directly enter the Empire World Corporation to work. Some people were even not qualified to participate in the interview process at all.

chapters.title: Chapter 1408: Strength
chapters.content:
Chapter 1408: Strength
This was also the reason why everyone was surrounding Mitchell.
They all knew that Mitchell's uncle was the director of the finance department of the Empire World Corporation's branch.
If she had a good relationship with Mitchell, she might be able to get an interview.
Although it was just an interview opportunity, it was already very rare for these people.
However, Mitchell's attention was not on them at all. His attention was on Cheryl alone.
Mitchell had always had a crush on Cheryl when he was in high school. He even confessed to her a few times, but she always rejected him in the end. After all, Cheryl's family background was pretty good to begin with. It was impossible for her to fall in love with someone like Mitchell.
Mitchell had met Cheryl in Porthampton a while ago. He realized that she seemed to be getting more and more beautiful, so wanted to pursue her. However, he had no choice but to stop when he found out that Cheryl already had a boyfriend, and that their relationship was very good.
Therefore, Mitchell began to use this method to pursue Cheryl.
Mitchelltian really thought that in today's society, the easiest way to win a girl's favor was to let her know his strength.
After all, no matter what kind of girl she was, it was impossible for her to reject a rich man. Although Mitchell could not be considered a real rich heir, he was still working in the Empire World Corporation. His future was limitless, so he felt that with his current conditions, Cheryl should not be able to reject him.
Mitchell had even thought about it. After today's class reunion, he would find an opportunity to ask Cheryl out and have a good chat with her.
Because everyone hadn't arrived yet, everyone stood at the door and started chatting.
Of course, now that everyone had graduated, most of the content of the conversations was about where they worked. Some students who had not found a job hoped to seek some help through these class gatherings.
Everyone had not seen each other for a long time, so the atmosphere of chatting was very good.
Mitchell said, "Cheryl, where are you working now?"
"I'm working in Memphis now…"
Cheryl replied with a smile.
"Is this a job arranged by your family?" Mitchell asked again.
"You could say that…"
Cheryl nodded lightly.
Mitchell knew that Cheryl's family background was very good. This was also why he had always wanted to pursue her.
"About that, I heard from my classmates some time ago that you already have a boyfriend. Is that true?" Mitchell asked again.
"It's true. We met in university…"
Cheryl replied indifferently.
"Does your boyfriend work in Memphis too?"
"He works in Newtown, actually!"
Cheryl didn't seem to want to talk about these things with Mitchell, so the tone of her voice was very distant.
"Then what does your boyfriend do?"
Mitchell asked expressionlessly.
When Cheryl heard this, she couldn't help but be stunned. Then, she said, "He's working at Innova Technologies now…"
"Innova Technologies?"
Mitchell couldn't help but sneer. Then, he said arrogantly, "That's really a coincidence. Our company has a partnership with this company, too. It's a small company that makes the internet…"
"Is that so? I don't know much about that company…"
Cheryl said casually.
"What can your boyfriend do if he works in a company like that? Why don't you get your boyfriend to contact me? I'll think of a way to arrange for him to work in the Empire World Corporation."
Mitchell said proudly.
Cheryl couldn't help but frown when she heard Mitchell's words. She looked helpless, as if she didn't want to hear what Mitchell had to say.
"No need. He's doing quite well in that company…"
Cheryl said lightly.
Seeing that Cheryl didn't say anything, Mitchell continued, "Cheryl, your family background is pretty good. I think you should have a more suitable candidate as a boyfriend. There's no need to waste time with your current boyfriend. You'll only be wasting your youth like this…"
When Cheryl heard Mitchell's words, a trace of anger flashed across her eyes. She turned around and said, "Mitchell, what do you mean?"
"Don't you know?"
Mitchell asked calmly.
"I'm sorry, I'm really not sure!" Cheryl replied with a frown.
"Since you want to pretend to be confused with me, then pretend that I have never said anything…" Mitchell said with a smile.
"What do you mean I want to pretend to be confused? My relationship with my boyfriend is very good, and my family's conditions are not bad either. Even if I don't have to do anything, it's enough for me to eat and drink without worrying about anything. So as long as my boyfriend treats me well, it's fine. I don't have any other opinions on the matter…" Cheryl shouted angrily.
When everyone heard Cheryl's words, they turned to look at the two of them.
Mitchell looked at Cheryl with a displeased expression, but he didn't say anything. After all, there were so many students looking at them now, so it wasn't like he could.
Cheryl wasn't in a good mood either because she really couldn't understand where Mitchell's sense of superiority came from. Mitchell was just an intern at the Empire World Corporation. He was not even a formal employee, but he was still acting so arrogantly. His words were very repulsive.
Cheryl couldn't help but think back to the time when she had met Connor. To be honest, she preferred to hang out with people like Connor because she felt that they were very honest. He would say whatever he wanted and would never show off to others, whether intentionally or not.
When they were on the plane, Cheryl had mentioned her boyfriend to Connor, but Connor had said that his boyfriend would have a good future and advised Cheryl to get along with him.
However, when it came to Mitchell, he said that his boyfriend was useless. No matter who it was, they would feel very uncomfortable when hearing someone criticize their significant other.
Moreover, Cheryl's boyfriend had shares in the company he worked for and was also the deputy general manager.
Cheryl kept a low profile, so she was unwilling to mention these things. However, Mitchell was just an intern, yet he was making irresponsible remarks.

chapters.title: Chapter 1409: The Contradiction
chapters.content:
Chapter 1409: The Contradiction
"Cheryl, it's been a long time since we last met. You look even more gorgeous now!"
At this moment, a girl in denim shorts shouted at Cheryl with a smile.
"Fiona, you're here?"
Cheryl replied happily when she saw the girl.
Cheryl was very popular in class, so she got along well with her classmates. Basically, no matter who came, they would take the initiative to talk to Cheryl first.
However, these students probably just graduated from university, so they were still in the process of looking for jobs.
After all, not everyone could find a job by relying on his family's connections like Mitchell.
However, when Mitchell looked at these people, although he had a smile on his face, he felt nothing but disdain because he felt that they were no longer on the same level as him. He looked down on these people from the bottom of his heart. If it was not for Cheryl's invitation, Mitchell would not even be willing to attend such a class reunion.
"Mitchell, I heard that you're working at the Empire World Corporation now. Is that true?"
At this moment, a girl in a short dress asked Mitchell excitedly.
Mitchell subconsciously glanced at the girl.
This girl was very fashionable and dressed very sexily. She had thick makeup on her face, and she didn't look like a college graduate. Instead, she looked more like a white-collar worker in her twenties.
When Mitchell saw the girl's long and fair legs and her full chest, he smiled faintly and said softly, "That's right, I'm working at the Empire World Corporation now…"
When the girl heard Mitchell's words, she looked a little envious and subconsciously moved closer to him.
This girl was called Hera Zouk. Her reputation in school was not very good. She often changed boyfriends and relied on her good looks to hook up with rich guys when she was in university.
When Mitchell saw Hera taking the initiative to talk to him, he felt very proud.
When he was in high school, Mitchell had heard about how flirtatious Hera was. However, Mitchell was just an average guy at that time. Hera would not like someone like him at all. If he had the chance to try it now, Mitchell would be very happy to at least make up for his previous regret.
Back when they were in school, only the real rich guys or hooligans were qualified to be with girls like Hera.
However, Mitchell was just playing with a girl like Hera. It was impossible for him to really marry such a woman.
"Mitchell, since you're so capable, can you help me get an interview at the Empire World Corporation?"
Hera asked Mitchell sweetly.
Mitchell smiled faintly and then said with a playful expression, "It's not that easy to get an interview with the Empire World Corporation…"
"Of course, I know that it's not easy. Otherwise, why would I come to you…"
Hera said coquettishly with an alluring expression.
Everyone was speechless when they saw Hera's flirtatious look, but no one dared to say anything.
"Mitchell, you're so capable. Can't you help me think of a way?"
Hera shook Mitchell's arm when she saw that he was keeping quiet.
"Hera, seeing that we're classmates, I'll help you this time, but I can't guarantee that it'll work."
Mitchell said helplessly.
When Hera heard Mitchell's words, she instantly understood what he meant. She quickly laughed and took out her phone. "Mitchell, let's add each other on Facebook. If there's anything, you can contact me…"
"Hehe, alright!"
Mitchell nodded, then took out his phone and added Hera on Facebook.
However, Cheryl wasn't in the mood to care about Mitchell at all. She had been checking the number of people attending the class reunion.
Cheryl realized that most of the people had already arrived, except for Connor.
When they got off the plane, Connor had promised Cheryl that he would come today, so Cheryl felt that he would not go back on his word.
"Cheryl, are they all here?"
At this moment, Hera seemed to be getting impatient from waiting. She frowned and asked Cheryl.
"Let's wait a little longer. Connor has not arrived yet…"
Cheryl whispered.
"Connor?"
When everyone heard this name, their mouths were wide open, and they were dumbfounded.
One of the girls who had a crush on Connor looked at Cheryl in surprise and asked, "Cheryl, are you talking about Connor McDonald who transferred after studying in our class for a year?"
"That's right, it's him!"
Cheryl nodded.
"Oh my God, it's been so long, but you're still in contact with Connor. That's really unbelievable…"
A guy said in surprise.
"Yeah. I've almost forgotten about this person. I wonder how Connor has been recently…"
"Actually, Connor is quite good. Too bad he transferred schools..."
Everyone began to discuss in low voices.
After all, these people were children from ordinary families, so Connor got along very well with them in class. Otherwise, Cheryl would not have taken the initiative to invite Connor to the class reunion.
"I remember that Connor transferred schools very suddenly back then. I just don't know why…"
At this moment, a guy said.
"What else could it be? Connor stole something and was too ashamed to stay in school, so he transferred schools!"
Although most of the students had a good impression of Connor, there was one person who did not have a good relationship with Connor. This person was none other than Mitchell.
The reason Mitchell didn't like Connor was because of Cheryl.
There was once Mitchell confessed to Cheryl in class, but Cheryl did not accept him. The two of them had an argument.
Connor couldn't stand it anymore, so he stood up and berated Mitchell.
At that time, although Mitchell was not considered outstanding in class, he was very arrogant. After being scolded by Connor, he felt embarrassed, so he called Connor an orphan.
Connor started fighting with Mitchell because of this. Mitchell was not Connor's match at all, so he was beaten up by Connor.
Mitchell had always kept this in mind because he felt that if Connor had not stepped out to cause trouble, he would have been with Cheryl long ago.
Mitchell had always wanted to find an opportunity to take revenge on Connor, but Connor suddenly transferred schools. Mitchell never saw Connor again.
However, he had heard a lot of news about Connor recently.

chapters.title: Chapter 1410: Mitchell Chen's Taunt
chapters.content:
Chapter 1410: Mitchell Chen's Taunt
Therefore, Mitchell was very happy when he knew that Connor would come to the class reunion today.
He felt that he could take this opportunity to humiliate Connor.
"Mitchell, what nonsense are you spouting?"
When Cheryl heard Mitchell's words, she said with a displeased expression.
"How am I spouting nonsense? Back then, Connor was expelled from school because he stole things. If you don't believe me, you can ask him personally when he's here!"
Mitchell pursed his lips and said.
"I didn't expect Connor to be a thief!"
"I really couldn't tell…"
"That's right. I thought that Connor was an honest person. I didn't expect him to be a thief. How unbelievable…"
The students in the class began to discuss in hushed voices.
"Well, it's getting late. Why don't you guys go in first? I'll wait for him here. I'll bring him in when he arrives…"
Mitchell said expressionlessly.
"Alright, then let's go in first. In any case, waiting here is a waste of time. I'm already a little tired from standing…"
Hera replied with a smile. Then, she walked into the hotel in her high heels.
