When everyone saw Hera walk in, they naturally did not intend to continue standing there waiting.
However, as soon as they entered the hotel, they were stopped by a few security guards.
"What are you doing?"
Hera looked at the security guard in front of her and asked with a puzzled expression.
"Miss, I'm sorry. Our hotel has a membership system, so please show me your membership card..."
One of the security guards explained with a smile.
"Do you need a membership card here?"
When Hera heard this, she looked very puzzled.
After all, Hera did not live in Porthampton now. It was normal for her to not know about the situation at Hotel Magnifique.
The security guard looked helpless as he said in a low voice, "Miss, our hotel has always adopted a membership system and only serves its members. If you're not a member of our hotel, you can't enter. Of course, you can also apply to become a member of our hotel now!"
"Who wants to become a member of your hotel? I'm just here to attend a class reunion..."
Hera pouted and shouted. She then turned to Cheryl and asked, "Cheryl, what's going on? Don't you know that you need a membership card to enter? Why did you decide to hold the reunion here?"
Hera felt as if she had been humiliated, and she was very angry.
Cheryl turned to look at Mitchell and whispered, "This place was chosen by Mitchell…"
After hearing this, everyone turned to look at Mitchell.
However, Mitchell seemed to be waiting for this opportunity. He smiled and took out his membership card from his clothes and handed it to the security guard.
"I'm a member of your hotel. They're all my classmates. What do you mean by not letting my classmates in now?"
When the security guard saw the membership card in Mitchell's hand, his expression instantly changed. He hurriedly said, "Sir, I'm really sorry. I didn't know you were a member here. Please come in…"
After hearing this, everyone entered the hotel.
After entering the hotel, Mitchell did not choose to wait for Connor outside. Instead, he brought everyone to the private room that had been booked in advance.
"I reserved this private room. Everyone can take a look at the menu first. If you want to eat anything later, let me know..."
Mitchell said to everyone with a smile.
The students in the class looked at Mitchell with even more envy.
After all, everyone had just graduated, but the gap between them and Mitchell was really big.
Cheryl looked at her phone and sent a message to Connor, asking when he would arrive.
Connor quickly replied, "I'll be there in ten minutes!"
When Cheryl knew that Connor was coming, she said to everyone, "You guys should rest here first. Connor is arriving soon. I'll go and get him…"
Perhaps it was because everyone felt that Connor was a thief, so their impression of Connor was not that good. No one took the initiative to go get Connor.
Cheryl turned around and was about to leave.
However, at this moment, Mitchell reached out to stop Cheryl and said softly, "Cheryl, you need a membership card to enter this place. If you don't have a membership card, you won't be able to bring Connor in, so I'll go…"
Cheryl couldn't help but be stunned when she heard Mitchell's words. Although she hated Mitchell a lot, she was still very surprised that Mitchell would offer to go get Connor.
"Yeah, this place needs a membership card. What if you and Connor can't enter? Let Mitchell go!"
"Cheryl, you'd better not go…"
The students in the class also advised her.
Cheryl looked at Mitchell and said softly, "Then I'll have to trouble you…"
"What's so troublesome about such a small matter? You guys just wait here!"
Mitchell looked at Cheryl with a faint smile and walked out of the private room.
When Cheryl saw Mitchell leave, she naturally didn't think too much about it. She sat down and chatted with the other students.
After Mitchell left the private room, he went straight to the entrance of the hotel. Then, he lit a cigarette and stood in front of the door while waiting.
A few minutes later, a taxi slowly stopped at the entrance of Hotel Magnifique.
Connor got out of the taxi.
When Mitchell saw Connor getting out of the taxi, a trace of disdain flashed across his eyes. He said in a low voice, "So many years have passed, but you're still so poor. It seems that the rumors about you picking up trash at the Porthampton University are true..."
After saying this, Mitchell did not choose to welcome Connor. Instead, he turned around and entered the hotel. Then, he started chatting with the young lady standing at the front desk.
The young lady at the front desk of Hotel Magnifique was quite good and had a good figure.
In fact, Mitchell did not want to bring Connor in at all. His idea was to deliberately humiliate Connor so that Connor could not enter because he did not have a membership card.
After Connor got out of the taxi, he observed the surrounding environment. After confirming that he had not come to the wrong place, he walked toward the hotel entrance.

chapters.title: Chapter 1411: Chance Encounter with Maya Phillips
chapters.content:
Chapter 1411: Chance Encounter with Maya Phillips
Actually, Connor was still a little surprised. The reason was very simple. He knew that the people who could attend the class reunion this time were ordinary people.
However, he didn't expect the class reunion to be held in such a luxurious hotel.
From what he remembered, if he wanted to have a meal in a hotel of this level, it would cost at least tens of thousands of dollars.
This sum of money was very extravagant for ordinary people, but if there were more people attending the class reunion, it was still acceptable to distribute it evenly.
However, Connor felt that under normal circumstances, it was impossible for a class reunion to have a dutch system. This was because there were often people who would fight to pay the bill in order to show that they were doing better than others.
Connor walked into the hotel.
The security guard at the entrance of the hotel reached out and stopped Connor. Then, he whispered to Connor, "Sir, please show me your membership card…"
When Connor heard the security guard's words, a trace of surprise flashed across his eyes. He asked with a puzzled expression, "You guys actually need a membership card?"
Connor knew that many clubs were now using the membership card system. This way, it could guarantee that the members would go to the clubs frequently after becoming members, and it could also prevent certain people from entering the club.
However, this was the first time Connor had encountered a hotel that required a membership card.
"Of course, our hotel has always adopted a membership system. You can't enter without a membership card!"
The security guard looked at Connor and explained.
"I see…"
Connor nodded lightly and did not say anything else. Instead, he turned around and walked out of the hotel.
Connor felt that since it was a class reunion today, there must be other students outside to welcome the students. Otherwise, even if he entered the hotel, he would not know which room they were in.
After Connor left the hotel, he quickly saw Mitchell chatting with the front desk receptionist.
Although Connor and Mitchell had not seen each other for a long time, Connor could still recognize this person at a glance. He was the person who had a conflict with him in class.
However, Mitchell seemed to be looking at Connor, and his eyes were filled with disdain and a trace of contempt.
The two of them looked at each other for a few seconds. Mitchell had no intention of coming out to welcome Connor. Instead, he chose to ignore Connor and turned to walk upstairs.
When Connor saw Mitchell doing that, he couldn't help but smile helplessly. He knew very well in his heart that he had a small conflict with Mitchell back then, and he even beat Mitchell up in front of everyone. Therefore, Mitchell must be taking this opportunity to take revenge on him.
If it was an ordinary person who encountered such a thing, they would definitely feel very uncomfortable. However, for Connor, such a thing could not anger him at all. It would not even cause Connor's emotions to change.
After experiencing so many things, Connor had long since become indifferent to these things. Moreover, the reason why Connor was here to attend the class reunion today was just to give Cheryl face.
Otherwise, Connor wouldn't have come to this class reunion.
Since Connor couldn't enter because he didn't have a membership card, he might as well just leave.
"Connor?"
However, just as Connor turned around and was about to leave, he suddenly realized that someone was calling him from behind.
Connor subconsciously turned around and realized that the girl who had appeared behind him was none other than Freya Phillips's cousin, Maya Phillips.
Maya was wearing a white dress today. She looked very fashionable and beautiful.
Connor had not seen Maya for a long time, so he had a very strange feeling when he saw her.
"Connor, it's really you?"
Maya exclaimed happily.
When Connor first met Freya, Maya had a very bad impression of Connor. She even tried to embarrass him.
However, as Maya and Connor continued to interact, Maya realized that Connor was not that annoying. Especially when Freya returned to Porthampton and told Maya everything that she had experienced during this period of time, Maya admired Connor even more. It was as if she really treated Connor as her cousin-in-law. Naturally, she approved of Connor and Freya being together.
Although Maya thought so, a girl like her would never express her true thoughts.
"I really didn't expect to meet you here. It has been a long time since we last saw each other…"
Connor said to Maya with a smile.
Maya walked toward Connor in her high heels. After sizing him up, she said softly, "You're the famous Mr. McDonald of Porthampton now. How would you have the time to meet a small fry like me?"
"You are still the same!"
Connor said lightly.
"Forget it. There's no point in teasing you now. Besides, I don't have the right to tease you!"
Seeing that Connor did not refute her, Maya seemed to find it a little boring, so she asked, "Connor, what are you doing here? Are you looking for my cousin?"
"I'm here to attend a class reunion, but I can't enter without a membership card..."
Connor looked at Maya and explained.
Maya couldn't help but laugh when she heard Connor's words. Then, she said softly, "I really didn't expect that there would be a place that you, Mr. McDonald, can't enter!"
"What are you doing here?"
Connor asked Maya.
"This is my family's hotel. So, it's not odd for me to be here, right?"
Maya replied.
"This is your family's hotel?"
Connor exclaimed.
"Yeah. This hotel is owned by my father. Let me bring you in…"
Maya said as she led Connor into the hotel.
"When did your dad open such a big hotel?"
Connor was still very surprised.
"It's all thanks to you, Mr. McDonald. Now, because of you, the Phillips Family's status has risen. People would take the initiative to send money to us for whatever we want to do. That's why my father opened this hotel. Now, the business is quite good…"
Maya paused for a moment, then turned to look at Connor and continued, "Luckily, I met you today. Otherwise, if those people in Porthampton found out that our hotel didn't allow the famous Mr. McDonald to enter, they would probably all boycott us…"

chapters.title: Chapter 1412: A Sharp Tongue, But a Soft Heart
chapters.content:
Chapter 1412: A Sharp Tongue, But a Soft Heart
After saying this, Maya took the initiative to bring Connor into the hotel.
When they arrived at the entrance of the hotel, Maya said to the security guards expressionlessly, "You guys are really bold. Didn't anyone show you Mr. McDonald's photo? How dare you stop Mr. McDonald from entering? Do you know that Connor is my cousin's boyfriend? Do you still want your job?"
When the security guards heard Maya's words, their eyes widened in disbelief.
They had never expected that this ordinary-looking young man in front of them was actually the famous Mr. McDonald in Porthampton.
"It's okay. It's not odd that they don't know me. Don't make things difficult for them…" Connor said with a smile.
"Alright, then. I'll give you face and not make things difficult for them…"
Maya said with a smile.
"Stop acting in front of me. Even if I ask you to punish them, you won't listen to me…"
Connor said helplessly.
Connor knew that Maya was a girl with a sharp tongue but a soft heart. She might have a sharp tongue, but she was not a cold-hearted person.
"Why do you have so much to say? You should hurry up and find your friend…"
After Maya was exposed by Connor, she waved at him awkwardly.
Connor smiled faintly. Then, he walked upstairs to the private room.
Maya looked at Connor's back and hesitated for a couple of seconds. A strange look flashed across her beautiful eyes, and she said softly, "That's not right. Why didn't I hear Freya say that Connor was coming over? Is he here secretly?"
She knew that Connor was not honest in Porthampton and knew many beautiful women, so she was worried that he might not be here to attend a class reunion.
Maya took out her phone and dialed Freya's number. Then, she asked softly, "Cousin, guess who I saw just now?"
"Who?"
Freya asked calmly.
"I saw Connor!"
Maya whispered.
"Stop joking with me, okay? Connor is in Newtown now. How could he be in Porthampton?"
Freya said with a helpless expression.
"I'm not joking. I really saw Connor!"
Maya replied anxiously before continuing, "Connor is here in our hotel, and he said that he was going to attend a reunion…"
"Connor is really in Porthampton?"
Freya was also filled with doubt.
"I just talked to him, so I can't be wrong. But since Connor is in Porthampton, why didn't he tell you?"
Maya could not help but mutter softly.
"Maybe it's because Connor has something else to do!"
Freya said calmly.
"What else could Connor have going on? He must be here to look for a mistress. Freya, don't worry. I'll go and see who Connor is meeting in Porthampton. I'll call you later…"
After saying this, Maya hung up the phone and quietly went up to the second floor.
On the other end of the phone, Freya was also feeling very helpless.
After all, Freya trusted Connor very much now. She knew that Connor would definitely not do anything to let her down. As for why he came to Porthampton, he definitely had his own reasons. Freya did not suspect anything.
Maya didn't understand these things. She was just helping to supervise Connor out of kindness, so Freya hesitated for a moment and didn't stop Maya.
At the same time, in the class reunion private room.
Cheryl Salmond waited for a long time, but Connor was nowhere in sight, so she could not sit still any longer.
At this moment, Mitchell happened to walk into the private room.
Cheryl stood up and asked Mitchell, "Where's Connor? He's still not here?"
"I don't think Connor will come today. I waited at the hotel entrance for a long time just now, but I didn't see him…"
Mitchell replied softly.
"How is that possible?"
Cheryl said with a puzzled tone.
"Why not? Connor was only in our class for a year. We don't have a close relationship with each another. Even if he doesn't come today, it's not weird…"
Mitchell said with a smile.
"Impossible. Connor just sent me a message saying that he's about to arrive. Connor promised me that he would come today, so he will definitely come over…"
Cheryl said firmly.
"Isn't it just Connor? So what if he comes or not? Isn't it good if he doesn't come? I was worried that he would steal something…"
Hera Zouk said sarcastically.
When Cheryl heard Hera's words, she became a little angry. She said expressionlessly, "Did Connor steal your things? Can you not spout nonsense? Wouldn't it be bad if he heard it?"
"I'm not talking nonsense. Didn't Mitchell say that Connor transferred schools because he stole things?"
Hera replied.
Cheryl was too lazy to deal with people like Hera. She took a deep breath, got up, and wanted to go outside to see if Connor had arrived.
However, at this moment, the door of the private room was suddenly pushed open from the outside. Connor walked into the private room.
When Mitchell saw Connor, he was in disbelief.
Because he remembered that Connor had already turned around and left. Moreover, Connor did not have a membership card for this hotel, so how did he come in?
"Connor, you are finally here. I thought that you weren't coming…"
When Cheryl saw Connor, she became a little excited, and she shouted happily at Connor.
Perhaps it was because of what Mitchell had said before, everyone's attitude toward Connor was rather cold.
"Don't you guys remember Connor?"
Cheryl couldn't help but ask softly when she saw that no one reacted.
"Oh, it's Connor?"
"Cheryl, if you didn't say anything, we really wouldn't have recognized Connor…"
"Connor, what's happened to you? Why didn't you contact us when you transferred?"
"That's right. It's been so long since we last met. You seem to have become more handsome…"
A few students who had a good relationship with Connor in the class shouted enthusiastically.
"When I transferred schools, I didn't have a cell phone, so I didn't contact everyone. I happened to bump into Cheryl today, so now I have the chance to meet everyone…"
Connor was very happy when he saw how enthusiastic these students were toward him. He replied with a smile.

chapters.title: Chapter 1413: Hundred-Thousand-Dollar Clothes
chapters.content:
Chapter 1413: Hundred-Thousand-Dollar Clothes
Connor could feel that these people were genuinely welcoming him.
Of course, Connor could also feel that some people had been staring at him with a strange gaze ever since he entered this private room.
Connor knew that this had something to do with Mitchell.
After all, these people had already graduated. They knew in their hearts who they should please and not offend. There was already a conflict between Mitchell and Connor, and Mitchell was also the one who had the best life among them. Therefore, some people were definitely prepared to stand on Mitchell's side in order to please Mitchell.
Connor was already used to such situations. The reason was very simple. No matter where they went, no matter what they encountered, these people would try their best to curry favor with the powerful. This was human instinct.
"Alright, Connor, come sit down!"
Cheryl said as she dragged Connor to sit beside her.
When everyone saw Connor sitting next to Cheryl, they frowned slightly. Mitchell's face darkened. After all, he wanted to sit next to Cheryl, but he didn't expect Connor to take his spot.
After Connor sat down, the students in the class began to size him up.
At this moment, Connor was wearing a set of casual clothes from an international brand. This set of clothes was bought by Freya. It was around 100,000 dollars. This set of clothes was considered Connor's simplest set of clothes. If Connor had nothing going on, he would not wear too high-profile clothes.
The reason was very simple. Connor felt that if his outfit was too high-profile, it would bring him some unnecessary trouble.
"Connor, how did you get here? Why were you late?"
At this moment, a girl asked Connor with a smile.
"There was a traffic jam on the way, so I was late. You should also know that the traffic in Porthampton has never been very good..."
Connor explained calmly.
When everyone heard Connor's words, they were all stunned.
"Connor, did you drive here? Did you buy a car?"
One of the girls asked in surprise.
After all, they were all fresh graduates, so it would be amazing if they could buy a car.
"I came here by taxi…"
Connor didn't think much of it and explained with a smile.
"A taxi?"
When the girl heard Connor's words, she looked at him with slight disdain, but she didn't say anything.
The way the other students looked at Connor seemed to have changed.
Just now, everyone thought that Connor had driven here, so they instinctively thought that Connor might be doing well now. However, they did not expect him to take a taxi.
"Then, it seems that among our classmates, only Mitchel has bought a car!"
Hera said sweetly.
At this moment, Hera was sitting next to Mitchell. The two of them were in a very ambiguous position. If it weren't for the fact that there were other students present, Hera would have already thrown herself into Mitchell's arms.
"That's right, Mitchell bought a BMW. We really can't compare to him!"
"Who can compare to buying a BMW right after graduation?"
Everyone chimed in.
Cheryl's eyes flashed with a hint of helplessness because she knew that Mitchell had indeed bought a car, but it was just a very ordinary BMW 3 series. It was at most 300,000 dollars. There was nothing worth showing off at all. Everyone said this just to please Mitchell.
"Cars are very cheap now. I think you should buy a car too, Connor. After all, a car is a man's pride. If you have a car, you can make people look up to you no matter where you go…"
Mitchell said to Connor with a smile.
"I'm not as rich as you. I can't afford it…"
Connor replied indifferently.
When everyone heard Connor's words, they looked at him with even more disdain.
After seeing the reactions of these students, Connor was very calm. After all, Connor had experienced such things too many times. He did not care about these people's reactions at all.
After all, the current Connor was not on the same level as these people at all. If Connor really revealed his identity, these people would probably think that Connor was a madman.
There were some things that Connor didn't want to explain. He also felt that there was no need to explain.
Cheryl looked at Connor with a strange expression. When Cheryl was chatting with Connor on the plane, she could feel that Connor had changed a lot. Since Connor was able to sit in first class, it meant that he must be doing well now. However, she could not understand why Connor did not react at all when these students were deliberately mocking him.
"Huh?"
At this moment, Hera suddenly saw the clothes Connor was wearing, and a trace of doubt flashed across her eyes.
"Hera, what's wrong?"
Mitchell turned to look at Hera and asked in confusion.
"Connor, the clothes you're wearing is Armani, right?"
Hera asked Connor in surprise.
"It should be!"
Connor was not very familiar with the brand of the clothes, so he replied indifferently.
"Is this real or fake? I saw this set of clothes in the Armani store. It cost more than 100,000 dollars!"
Hera covered her mouth and exclaimed.
"What? This set of clothes costs a hundreds of thousands?"
"Isn't that too expensive?"
When everyone heard Hera's words, they all revealed shocked expressions. Their attention was all on Connor.
"Connor can't even afford a car, so how can he afford a set of clothes that cost more than a hundred thousand dollars?"
Mitchell suddenly said.
When everyone heard this, they were all stunned for a moment, as if they also felt that what Mitchell said was very reasonable.
Connor couldn't even afford a car. How could he spend so much money on clothes?
"Connor, if your clothes are not fake, then you must have rented them from someone else, right? The rent shouldn't be cheap, right?"
Mitchell asked Connor with a smile.
Connor looked at Mitchell indifferently and did not say anything.
At this moment, Connor was not in the mood to explain to these people whether his clothes were real or fake. Connor felt that even if he explained, they would not believe him.

chapters.title: Chapter 1414: The Boss of Empire World Corporation
chapters.content:
Chapter 1414: The Boss of Empire World Corporation
For a moment, the students in the private room began to discuss in low voices.
"He must really like to act cool."
"Yeah, he actually wore a fake Armani to attend the class reunion…"
"We all know what kind of family we come from. There's no need to be all pretentious…"
"When I was in school, I thought that Connor was quite a good person, but I didn't expect him to end up like this!"
Everyone began to discuss in low voices.
Cheryl was also a little puzzled. She could not help but ask Connor softly, "Connor, is this set of clothes real or fake?"
"What do you think?"
Connor replied with a smile. He was very indifferent.
Although Cheryl also felt that Connor could not afford such expensive clothes, she felt that he was way too calm right now. It did not look like he was wearing fake clothes and was being exposed. Therefore, she vaguely felt that his clothes might be real. Otherwise, Connor would not be so calm.
Maya, who had been eavesdropping outside, was extremely angry when she heard everyone laughing at Connor. She really couldn't understand why he was being mocked by these people when he was already so rich.
Of course, Maya knew that Connor was really here to attend the class reunion.
Maya really wanted to rush in and tell those people Connor's identity, but she held back in the end because she felt that he must have a reason for doing so.
"Phew…"
Maya took a deep breath and took out her phone to call Freya.
"Maya, did you find anything?"
Freya hurriedly asked with a smile after picking up the call.
"Freya, Connor is really here for a class reunion…"
Maya replied helplessly.
"Then, it seems that Connor isn't doing anything wrong."
Freya said with a smile.
"I don't think so. These people have been mocking Connor, yet he isn't defending himself. I'm so angry..."
Maya said angrily.
"Connor just can't be bothered to explain to those people. After all, even if he explained to these people, they wouldn't believe it, so it's better not to explain!"
Freya understood Connor very well and said calmly.
"I feel a little unhappy about it. What right do those people have to laugh at Connor?"
Maya whispered.
"Alright, alright. You don't have to worry about Connor."
Freya advised softly.
Maya took a deep breath and said in a low voice, "Alright, I understand…"
After saying this, Maya hung up the phone and turned to look at the private room. She resisted the urge to rush in to stand up for Connor and turned around to leave in her high heels.
At this moment, the students in the private room were chatting happily.
However, most of the content of the chat was to flatter Mitchell. At this moment, Mitchell was extremely smug. He felt that it was worth it to spend tens of thousands of dollars to buy these students a meal here. Although Cheryl was still very cold to Mitchell, he was able to inadvertently get a sexy beauty like Hera. He did not waste his money this time.
"Do you know that Hotel Magnifique is owned by the Phillips Family of Porthampton? The Phillips Family is still very powerful now..."
"Yeah, I heard that too. It seems that the Phillips Family's backer is someone called Mr. McDonald. That Mr. McDonald is very amazing!"
"If it weren't for this Mr. McDonald, how could the Phillips Family have grown from a small family to one of the top families in Porthampton?"
A few of the guys probably knew something about Connor, so they started discussing excitedly.
When Connor heard these people's discussions, he was more or less surprised. He never thought that he would actually bring such a huge change to the Phillips Family. These things were things that Connor himself was not clear about.
"You guys might not know yet, right? Mr. McDonald is actually the boss of the Empire World Corporation!"
Mitchell suddenly said.
After hearing Mitchell's words, everyone turned to look at him.
"Mitchell, Mr. McDonald the boss of the Empire World Corporation?"
A guy asked in surprise.
"That's right. Mr. McDonald is the boss of the Empire World Corporation. Let me tell you, Mr. McDonald is a real big shot. Not to mention Porthampton, he's one of the top existences in the entire Davenport. In Davenport, if Mr. McDonald says yes, no one dares to say no…"
Mitchell said softly.
"Mitchell, since you work at the Empire World Corporation, you must know a lot about Mr. McDonald, right? Why don't you tell us about him…"
Everyone seemed to be very interested in Connor as they spoke to Mitchell excitedly.
When Mitchell heard everyone's words, he seemed a little proud. Then, he said with a smile, "Actually, I shouldn't tell you internal information like this, but we're all classmates, so I'll tell you…"
"Yeah, Mitchell. Hurry up and tell us…"
Everyone shouted excitedly.
Mitchell began to talk about Connor.
Connor had been sitting in the same place and listening quietly. However, Connor felt that something was wrong the more he listened. This was because most of the things that Mitchell said were made up. Moreover, he said that Connor was like a God, as if there was nothing that Connor could not do.
"I didn't expect that I would be such a person in the eyes of ordinary people…"
Connor could not help but sigh softly.
After all, Mitchell was just an intern at a branch of the Empire World Corporation. He wasn't even an intern at the headquarters, so how could Mitchell know about Connor? What he told everyone was just hearsay.
Although Mitchell's words were all made up, no one present could come into contact with these things at all, so naturally, there was no way to tell if it was true or false.
"Mitchell, since you're from the Empire World Corporation, have you seen this Mr. McDonald before?"
At this moment, a guy suddenly asked Mitchell.

chapters.title: Chapter 1415: Gold Membership Card
chapters.content:
Chapter 1415: Gold Membership Card
"I'm just an intern now. Of course, I haven't seen Mr. McDonald yet. But I believe that I'll definitely have a chance to see Mr. McDonald in the future!"
Mitchell said with a smile.
"That's true…"
The boy nodded and continued, "Although Mr. McDonald is very powerful, it's only because Mr. McDonald's background is better. We can't compare to people like Mr. McDonald…"
"Yeah, I think Mitchell is still the best. Mitchell relied on himself to achieve what he has today…"
Hera said sweetly.
When Cheryl heard Hera's words, a hint of helplessness flashed across her eyes. Mitchell was only an intern now. What kind of achievement could he have?
"Mitchell, I heard that the membership of Hotel Magnifique is very difficult to obtain. Ordinary people can't even get it even if they have money. The fact that you can be a member here means that you're really something!"
A guy said to Mitchell.
"Nah, not really…"
Mitchell said in a very low-key manner.
"By the way, I also heard that Hotel Magnifique's membership card is divided into several levels. I wonder what level your membership card is?"
Another guy asked Mitchell curiously.
"This is a gold membership card…"
Mitchell knew that these people could not tell the difference between a gold membership card and a silver membership card, so he replied indifferently.
However, Mitchell's uncle's membership card was only a silver membership card. After all, Mitchell's uncle was only a director of the finance department. It was impossible for him to get a gold membership card. Mitchell said this just to show off.
"Gold membership card?"
Everyone was stunned when they heard Mitchell's words. They were very surprised.
"Mitchell, I heard that the silver membership card here can be obtained by putting in money. You can get a silver membership card with a few hundred thousand dollars. However, if you want a gold membership card, you need to get an approval. Only people with real status can get a gold membership card…"
The guy said to Mitchell with a very surprised expression.
"As you said just now, this hotel was originally owned by the Phillips Family. Didn't the Phillips Family rely on our company's boss, Mr. McDonald, to get to where they are today? So, it's not difficult for me to get a gold membership card here!"
Mitchell looked at everyone and explained with a smile.
When everyone heard Mitchell's words, they seemed to be even more envious.
Only Cheryl and Connor looked at Mitchell with a strange expression.
After all, there were so many people present, and only the two of them could feel that Mitchell was bragging. As for the others, they did not understand what was going on at all, so they believed whatever Mitchell said.
"Mitchell is so capable now!"
Everyone sighed.
"That's right, Mitchell. You're really different now. Tell us how you got to this point…"
"That's right, Mitchell. Hurry up and tell us about it…"
Everyone began to flatter Mitchell.
"What's there to talk about?"
Mitchell looked at everyone and smiled faintly.
"Mitchell, tell everyone how you got into the Empire World Corporation."
Hera shook Mitchell's arm and said sweetly.
Mitchell looked at Hera with a speechless expression. After all, he was able to work at the Empire World Corporation because of his uncle. He couldn't tell these students that he had entered through connections, right?
"I don't think there's anything to say about my past, but I think Connor has experienced a lot over the years, right? Why don't we let Connor tell us about what he's been up to?"
Mitchell suddenly looked at Connor and said with a smile.
Connor couldn't help but be stunned when he heard Mitchell's words. Then, he slowly raised his head and looked at Mitchell. He didn't know what Mitchell meant.
Connor had indeed experienced a lot of things. However, if he really told them about these things, he might scare these people to death. Additionally, those things were too unbelievable in the eyes of these commoners. Even if Connor told them, nobody would believe him.
"Connor, can you share with us?"
Mitchell said with a faint smile.
Connor hesitated for a moment, then said expressionlessly, "There's nothing special about what happened to me. I spend most of my time in school. There's nothing much to talk about…"
"That's right, Connor is just an ordinary person. What's there to talk about?"
"Mitchell, let's talk about you!"
Everyone didn't want to hear about Connor's life, so they hurriedly followed up.
"Haha…"
When Mitchell heard Connor's words, he could not help but sneer. Then, he said indifferently, "Connor, how can that be considered ordinary?"
"Isn't it?"
Connor looked at Mitchell and asked softly.
"Of course, not. I heard that you're very famous in Porthampton University..."
Mitchell said slowly.
Connor looked at Mitchell without saying anything, but he had already guessed what Mitchell was going to say next.
If it was the previous Connor, he would definitely be very angry if Mitchell were to talk about his situation at Porthampton University. However, he had been through this plenty of times. If Mitchell wanted to tell the others, Connor wouldn't mind listening.
"What happened to Connor at Porthampton University?"
Everyone also felt that Mitchell's words had a hidden meaning and could not help but ask him softly.
"You guys actually don't know? Let me tell you, Connor is really famous in Porthampton University. Everyone in Porthampton University knows that Connor relies on delivering food to make a living in school..."
Mitchell said with a smile.
"What?"
When everyone heard Mitchell's words, they were all stunned. They were in disbelief.
"Mitchell, you can't joke around like this. We're all classmates."
Cheryl couldn't take it anymore and stood up to shout at Mitchell.
Seeing Cheryl defend Connor, Mitchell became even angrier. He whispered, "Cheryl, do you think I would joke like that? I have a friend who is a student at Porthampton University. He told me all these things..."

chapters.title: Chapter 1416: Precious Red Wine
chapters.content:
Chapter 1416: Precious Red Wine
"Connor, did you really deliver food when you were in Porthampton University?"
One of the girls in a short skirt asked Connor in disbelief.
Connor was very calm, and he did not refute anything because he wanted to see what Mitchell was going to say.
"Connor hasn't had it easy all these years. I heard that not only did he deliver food at Porthampton University, but he was also abandoned by his girlfriend. She even humiliated him in front of all the students…"
Mitchell looked at everyone and continued.
"Really?"
"I didn't know that Connor is actually in such a miserable state now."
"It's not true, right? No matter how miserable Connor was, he wouldn't go to the extent of delivering food!"
Everyone began to discuss in low voices.
Mitchell took out his phone and said with a smile, "I happen to have a video here. You can all take a look…"
When everyone heard Mitchell's words, they hurriedly picked up their phones.
At this moment, the video playing on the phone happened to be the scene of Mandy Hines breaking up with Connor.
This video had already spread throughout Porthampton University. Almost everyone saw it as a joke, so it was not hard for Mitchell to get his hands on this video.
However, Connor did not expect that Mitchell would still have this video in his hands after so long.
It was obvious what Mitchell had kept the video for so long. It was so that when he saw Connor in the future, he could humiliate Connor.
This video was now playing its role.
After hearing Mitchell's words just now, everyone felt that Mitchell might be joking. How could Connor rely on delivering food to make a living?
However, when everyone saw the video, they realized that Mitchell was telling the truth.
"Let me see…"
For a moment, everyone began to watch the video on Mitchell's phone. From time to time, they would laugh at him.
Cheryl was a little anxious at this moment. She frowned and said to Connor, "Connor, why aren't you explaining to everyone?"
"Explain what?"
Connor asked indifferently.
"What else? Explain to everyone what's going on in that video!"
Cheryl said helplessly.
"That video is real. What's there to explain?"
Connor replied indifferently.
When Cheryl heard Connor's words, she was stunned. She was shocked because she didn't expect the video to be real.
Initially, everyone thought that they were doing poorly. The gap between them and Mitchell was too big. However, when they saw how miserable Connor was, they instantly felt much better.
Everyone felt that no matter how miserable they were, it was absolutely impossible for them to be worse off than Connor, right?
Moreover, there were a few female classmates who had a crush on Connor. After seeing this video, they secretly sighed to themselves, thinking that they were lucky that they did not confess to Connor back then. Otherwise, they might have to deliver food with Connor now!
"I didn't expect Connor to be in such a difficult situation now."
"That's right. Connor, why didn't you contact us when you were in such a difficult situation?"
"Although we can't help much, we won't need you to deliver food!"
Everyone said to Connor hypocritically.
"It's all in the past. There is nothing more to say about it…"
Connor replied indifferently.
"The dishes have all been served, right? Let's eat…"
In order to help Connor, Cheryl snatched the phone back and gave it back to Mitchell.
Mitchell knew that he had achieved his goal, so he sneered and did not say anything else.
Everyone began to eat.
After waiting for such a long time, Connor was also a little hungry, so he began to lower his head and eat.
The other students took the initiative to toast Mitchell.
For a moment, almost everyone in the private room was hovering around Mitchell.
Seeing Connor eating with his head lowered, no one bothered him. They all felt that Connor was having a hard time and hadn't eaten such delicious food for a long time. It was normal for him to eat more.
At this moment, Hera had already made up her mind. No matter what, she had to hook up with Mitchell.
Although Hera had looked down on Mitchell when she was still in school, Mitchell was now working at the Empire World Corporation and had a membership card at Hotel Magnifique. He was the best among her classmates. If she could be with Mitchell, she would have found a suitable husband.
Hera was very smart. She knew that Mitchell and Connor had always been at odds with each other, so as long as she helped humiliate Connor now, it would definitely increase Mitchell's favorability toward her.
Therefore, Hera poured herself a glass of red wine and whispered to Connor, "Connor, don't just eat. I know you haven't been to such an expensive restaurant in a long time, but you have to drink some wine. Let me tell you, this bottle of red wine costs a few thousand dollars. Mitchell specially ordered it for us…"
"A few thousand?"
Connor could not help but sneer when he heard Hera's words.
Connor had even drunk a few million dollars' worth of red wine. What was a few thousand dollars' worth of red wine in his eyes?
"Yeah. Connor, hurry up and drink some. If you don't drink now, you might not be able to drink it in the future. The taste of this red wine that costs thousands of dollars is not something that ordinary red wine can compare to…"
Another female student hurriedly added.
Connor slowly raised his head and looked at the two girls in front of him. In fact, Connor knew very well that these two girls were obviously humiliating him on purpose.
However, Connor did not care about what these people were saying at all. After all, it was meaningless for Connor to argue with these people. Even if these people knew how rich Connor was now, so what?
Therefore, Connor smiled faintly, then raised his glass and drank the red wine in it.
When everyone saw Connor drinking, they became even more disdainful because they felt that he was simply a country bumpkin. Who would drink like this?
"Connor, how can you drink red wine like this? Why don't I teach you how to drink red wine?"
Hera said to Connor with a disdainful expression.
"Connor can drink however he wants. Today is our class reunion."
Cheryl couldn't stand it any longer and frowned.

chapters.title: Chapter 1417: Magnifique Palace
chapters.content:
Chapter 1417: Magnifique Palace
When Hera saw that Cheryl was a little angry, she couldn't help but sneer. Then, she said indifferently, "I'm doing this for Connor's sake. I'm just worried that he'll be laughed at if he goes out to drink like this with others in the future…"
"You know very well who is the one who is laughing at him. Stop putting on a show!"
Cheryl said coldly.
"Cheryl, what do you mean by that?"
Hera couldn't help but frown when she heard Cheryl's unpleasant words.
"Don't you know what I mean?"
Cheryl asked directly.
"Why you…"
Hera was trembling with anger.
"That's enough. It's a class reunion today. Everyone is having a good time. What are you two doing?"
Mitchell shouted expressionlessly.
Hera turned and glanced at Mitchell. She took a deep breath and did not say anything else. She walked to Mitchell's side and sat down.
Seeing Cheryl being so protective of Connor, Mitchell was naturally even more displeased. After taking a deep breath, he asked Connor with a smile, "Connor, you haven't graduated yet, right?"
"Yeah…"
Connor nodded as he ate.
"What are your plans after graduation?"
Mitchell continued to ask.
"I haven't considered these things yet!"
Connor replied.
"Connor, you're not young anymore, and it's time for you to work. How can you not consider these things? Are you planning to deliver food for the rest of your life?"
Mitchell said with a smile.
"Haha…"
Connor couldn't help but laugh coldly, and then said lightly, "What are you saying? Are you planning to find me a job?"
"Of course, I can do that. On the account that we're classmates, I can help you find a suitable job!"
Mitchell nodded.
When everyone heard Mitchell's words, they turned to look at him with shocked expressions.
After all, it was a good thing that Mitchell could help Connor find a job!
At this moment, the students in the private room were all thinking of getting Mitchell to help them find a job!
"What kind of job do you plan to find for me?"
Connor drank a mouthful of red wine and asked casually.
"I heard a few days ago that the Empire World Corporation needs a few cleaners. Why don't you give it a try? The job of a cleaner is relatively easy. Sweeping the floor, wiping the toilets and the like. You can get at least five to six thousand a month. It's definitely better than delivering food at school, don't you think so?"
Mitchell said with a smile.
Everyone burst into laughter when they heard Mitchell's words.
Initially, they thought that Mitchell really wanted to find a job for Connor, but they didn't expect him to be deliberately mocking Connor.
"Five to six thousand a month for a cleaner?"
Connor said with a smile.
"I mean it depends on where you work. Of course, as a cleaner in the Empire World Corporation, you can get that much…"
Mitchell replied.
"Connor, I advise that you cherish this opportunity. You don't have the ability or background. If Mitchell doesn't help you, you might not even be able to find a job as a cleaner."
Hera said with a smile.
Connor sneered and said indifferently, "I'm sorry. I don't like this job!"
"What do you mean by that? Isn't being a cleaner better than being a delivery boy?"
Hera pouted.
"Forget it. Since Connor wants to deliver food, then let him do it. I was thinking of helping you out as a classmate, but I didn't expect you to be so ungrateful. Then, there's nothing I can do..."
Mitchell said indifferently.
At this moment, everyone in the class could see that Mitchell and Hera were deliberately humiliating Connor. They had no intention of really introducing Connor to any jobs.
Cheryl looked at Connor with a puzzled expression. She really couldn't understand why Connor wasn't angry at all. It was as if Mitchell wasn't humiliating him at all, but someone else.
Cheryl might not be aware that these things were not worth mentioning to Connor. He had long been indifferent to such things.
However, at this moment, the waiter suddenly pushed open the door of the private room and walked in in high heels.
"Excuse me. We are here to serve the dishes!"
The waiter explained to everyone.
"Alright!"
Mitchell said lightly.
When the waiter heard this, she quickly brought the plate up and placed it in the middle of the table.
When Mitchell saw the plate, he was a little puzzled because he didn't remember ordering this dish at all.
The waiter gently opened the lid of the plate and said softly, "Everyone, please enjoy!"
The moment the lid was opened, everyone could smell an extremely tempting fragrance. Moreover, this fragrance instantly spread throughout the entire private room.
"What dish is this?"
Hera asked in confusion.
"This dish is the signature dish of our Hotel Magnifique. It's called Magnifique Palace!"
The waiter explained softly.
After listening to the waiter's introduction, everyone was a little puzzled, as if they had never heard of the name of this dish.
...
"What dish is this?"
"Yeah. It smells quite good…"
"This dish must be expensive, right?"
When everyone saw this sumptuous dish, they all revealed puzzled expressions. It seemed that no one knew this dish.
"Magnifique Palace is the most famous dish in our hotel. It's made by several diamond chefs of our hotel. It takes several days to make this dish. Some guests come to our hotel specially for this dish, but they may not have the chance to eat it. You are very lucky. This dish tastes exquisite. Please enjoy it!"
The waiter looked at everyone and explained softly.
"A few days to make a dish?"
"Then, I must really savor it…"
"That's right. It's all thanks to Mitchell. If not for him, how could we have the chance to taste such a dish?"
When everyone heard the waiter's words, they all revealed excited expressions.
The waiter looked at everyone with a faint smile, then turned around to leave.

chapters.title: Chapter 1418: The Wrong Dish was Served
chapters.content:
Chapter 1418: The Wrong Dish was Served
However, Mitchell's expression suddenly changed.
He suddenly remembered that he had indeed seen this dish when he was placing the order, and he had a very deep impression of it.
This was because this signature dish was very expensive. Just this dish alone cost 88,800 dollars.
He felt that it was just a class reunion today and there was no need to spend so much money, so he did not order this dish.
However, he could not understand why the waiter would serve this dish. He clearly remembered that he did not order this dish.
Mitchell was buying today. A meal would cost about 50,000 dollars. If this dish was included, it might be more than 100,000 dollars.
Mitchell could not afford that.
Moreover, Mitchell had only prepared 100,000 dollars today. He did not have enough to pay the bill.
"Wait a minute!"
The more Mitchell thought about it, the more he felt that something was wrong. He hurriedly shouted.
When the waiter heard Mitchell's words, she stopped in her tracks and revealed a sweet smile. She said softly, "Sir, is there anything else you need?"
"I'm sorry, we didn't order this dish, did we?"
At this moment, Mitchell could no longer care about his face because the price of this dish was way too expensive. It was far beyond what he could afford.
Although he could buy them a meal, he was not willing to lose so much money for no reason!
Moreover, he had achieved his goal today. Not only did he show off in front of his old classmates, but he also humiliated Connor. Therefore, Mitchell felt that there was no need for him to continue wasting money.
Besides, he couldn't take out that much money now.
"Sir, this Magnifique Palace was requested by our hotel's general manager. He said that there is a VIP in your private room, and this dish is for that VIP..."
The waiter said softly.
Everyone looked at Mitchell after hearing the waiter's words.
"Mitchell, I didn't expect you to be so influential. Even the general manager wants to add more dishes for you…"
Hera said to Mitchell with a smile.
"Impossible, I don't even know the general manager here. Also, this is my first time eating here. They must have made a mistake…"
Mitchell blurted out the truth in a hurry.
Everyone looked at Mitchell with some doubt. After all, only Mitchell had a membership card here. If this dish was not for Mitchell, who else could it be for?
"You must have served the wrong dish!"
Mitchell turned and said to the waiter.
"Sir, we didn't serve this dish by mistake. It's for your private room, but I'm not very sure about the specifics. If you didn't order this dish, you can go and tell our general manager. We're just responsible for serving the dishes!"
The waiter said calmly.
"This…"
A strange look flashed across Mitchell's eyes.
After the waiter was done speaking, she turned around and walked out of the private room.
Connor looked at the dish in front of him and understood what was going on.
Since Mitchell did not order this dish, it must be a gift from Maya Phillips.
After all, this hotel belonged to the Phillips Family, so it was not surprising that she would order this dish for him.
"This dish looks quite good. Let me try it…"
When Connor saw that everyone was staring at the dish, he smiled faintly. Then, he picked up his chopsticks and picked up a piece of meat before putting it in his mouth.
"Connor, you…"
Mitchell originally planned to stop Connor from eating, but before he could say anything, Connor had already taken a bite.
When Mitchell saw this scene, he was instantly stunned. He was also very speechless.
"Connor, why did you eat it?"
Mitchell shouted with his eyes wide open.
"Is this dish poisonous? Why can't I eat it?"
Connor replied with a smile, then looked at everyone and said, "This dish tastes really good. Everyone, don't just look at it. Hurry up and try it. Otherwise, it will get cold and not taste good..."
"Connor, are you crazy?"
Mitchell suddenly stood up and shouted at Connor with his eyes wide open.
Everyone originally wanted to try this dish, but after seeing Mitchell's reaction, they all stopped what they were doing and turned to look at Mitchell with a hint of confusion in their eyes.
"Mitchell, what do you mean by that?"
Cheryl asked Mitchell softly.
"What do I mean by this? You should ask Connor what he means by doing this I've already said that we didn't order this dish..."
Mitchell whispered.
"But the waiter said that this dish is for us..."
Cheryl replied softly.
"I don't know the general manager of Hotel Magnifique, so this dish is definitely not for us. You guys are not members here, so this dish definitely has nothing to do with you. Could this dish have been given to Connor by the general manager?"
Mitchell said coldly.
"Now that Connor has already taken a bite, what do you want to do? Do you still want to return the dish?"
Cheryl said with a frown.
Mitchell took a deep breath and said in a low voice, "Our private room didn't order this dish. The hotel served this dish to us without any reason. It's 100% a mistake, so they will come looking for us later. However, Connor has already taken a bite. If the hotel people come looking for him, Connor will bear the price of this dish himself. There's nothing I can do about it then..."
"..."
When everyone heard Mitchell's words, a hint of helplessness flashed across their eyes.
No one expected Mitchell to have the nerve to say such a thing.
"Connor is already in such a difficult situation. How can we let him bear the cost alone?"
A guy said softly.
"If you feel sorry for him, you can eat the dish too and bear the cost of this dish with Connor. But let me tell you this, this dish costs more than 80,000 dollars…"
Mitchell said lightly.
The guy was instantly dumbfounded when he heard the price. He did not seem to have expected this dish to be so expensive.
Cheryl couldn't help but frown when she understood what he meant.
When the others heard this, they more or less felt a little dissatisfied.
After all, it was a class reunion today. Even if the hotel really served the wrong dish, Connor should not be the only one to bear the cost for this dish. It was really unreasonable for Mitchell to be so anxious to cut ties with him.
Cheryl took a deep breath and said expressionlessly, "Don't worry, everyone. Hurry up and try this dish. Although this dish is a little expensive, it's nothing. Isn't it just 90,000 dollars? I'll pay for this dish. It's not a big deal..."

chapters.title: Chapter 1419: I Won't Take It to Heart
chapters.content:
Chapter 1419: I Won't Take It to Heart
"Cheryl, you..."
Mitchell turned and looked at Cheryl in disbelief.
"Today is a class reunion. It's most important for everyone to be happy. There's no need to make everyone unhappy over such a small matter!"
Cheryl said calmly to Mitchell.
"Cheryl is right. Today is a class reunion. Us having a good time is the most important thing…"
"Yeah, isn't it just a dish? There's no need to be so calculative…"
A few girls who had a good relationship with Cheryl said softly.
It was obvious that these people were deliberately saying this for Mitchell to hear.
"But I don't think Cheryl can pay for this dish alone..."
"That's right. Although this dish is expensive, there are so many of us here. If we split it equally, it will only cost a few thousand dollars at most. It's not a big deal…"
"That's right, that's right. It's not easy for us to gather together. So, of course we should eat something good. I think we should split the bill. No one lacks this bit of money…"
"That's right. I have long heard that this dish is very delicious. I have never had the chance to taste it. Today, I can finally try it…"
It was obvious that everyone was on Cheryl's side.
Moreover, they also despised Mitchell. After all, Mitchell was the best among these people. However, it was a little unreasonable for him to be calculative because of this dish.
Mitchell didn't expect everyone to say that. He seemed to feel even more awkward now. For a moment, no one paid attention to Mitchell and began to taste the dish.
The dish was indeed very delicious. Although it was a little expensive, it was indeed worth it.
Many people might not be able to eat this dish even if they were rich.
These people did not know that if it were not for Connor, they might not have been able to eat this dish ever.
Mitchell sat on the spot with an awkward expression on his face. He didn't know what to do.
He thought that after he had humiliated Connor, no one would speak up for Connor. However, these people were actually still on Connor's side.
Mitchell really couldn't understand how he was inferior to Connor. Why would Cheryl help Connor time and time again but never look at him in the eye?
About half an hour later, everyone was almost done eating, so they planned to leave the hotel and find a KTV for a karaoke session.
Because the last dish was more expensive, everyone followed Mitchell to pay the bill. However, no one expected that this dish was actually a gift from the hotel.
This made Mitchell even more speechless. If Mitchell hadn't said those words before, everyone would have thought that the hotel had given it to him.
However, looking at the situation now, this dish must have nothing to do with Mitchell. After all, if it was really a gift to Mitchell, he would not have said those words.
Since this dish was not for Mitchell, who was it for?
Everyone was very curious, but after asking the waiter, the waiter only said that it was instructed by the general manager, but she did not say who it was for.
After asking further, they did not get anything out of it, so they used the money they had gathered to pay the bill.
Mitchell had originally planned to foot the bill, but no one gave him the chance. The reason was very simple. What Mitchell said before had indicated that he was not willing to spend money to buy them a meal. Although those words were said to Connor, everyone felt that Mitchell was hinting at them, so it was better to just split the bill. That way, everyone would feel more at ease.
"Which bar are we going to later?"
After leaving the hotel, Cheryl asked everyone softly.
"Well, I've already booked a table for everyone at the Magnifique Bar. Everyone paid for the bill just now, so let me pay for our session at the bar…"
Mitchell felt that he had humiliated himself in the hotel just now, so he quickly responded.
"The Magnifique Bar?"
After hearing Mitchell's words, everyone revealed shocked expressions again.
"I heard that that bar is the best bar in Porthampton!"
Hera hurriedly said.
"That's right. the Magnifique Bar and Magnifique Hotel are actually properties of the Phillips Family. Since Mitchell has already booked a private room, let's go there!"
Another girl was also very excited when she heard that they were going to the Magnifique Bar. She hurriedly shouted.
Cheryl didn't want Mitchell to treat her, but everyone was very interested in this bar, so she didn't say anything.
Mitchell drove his BMW sedan and left with a few beautiful female classmates, while Cheryl and everyone else took a taxi there.
After getting into the car, Cheryl glanced at Connor and asked him softly, "Connor, are you alright?"
"Yeah, why?"
Connor replied with a smile.
"I forgot about the conflict between you and Mitchell. Otherwise, I wouldn't have asked you to come..."
Cheryl said guiltily.
"It's fine. The words they said can't hurt me at all. I won't take it to heart…"
Connor smiled faintly.
Cheryl hesitated for a moment before saying softly, "Actually, Connor, I can feel that you're not what they said at all, but I don't understand why you didn't refute."
"What's the point of refuting them?"
Connor replied with a smile and then continued, "What they said is also true. I did pick up trash at Porthampton University, but that was just to survive. My ex-girlfriend did dump me. Although Mitchell did not put it nicely, they are all true..."
"But that's not the case at all. Your clothes are real, and it's also true that you were sitting in first class. I don't believe that a poor delivery man can sit in first class and wear a limited-edition Armani!"
Cheryl quickly said.
"Yes, what you said is true, but I don't want to argue with them about these things because I think it's meaningless!"
Connor said.
"But it's so unfair!"
Cheryl said softly.
"When you are in my position one day, you will understand why I'm doing this. We should never stoop to another person's level!"
Connor said calmly.
"So, are you saying that you're of a higher level?"
Cheryl asked with a smile.
"I guess so!"
Connor replied.

chapters.title: Chapter 1420: Who Did You Say Your Fiancée Was?
chapters.content:
Chapter 1420: Who Did You Say Your Fiancée Was?
"You really know how to brag…"
Cheryl looked at Connor and couldn't help but purse her lips. She didn't say anything else.
A few minutes later, everyone arrived at the entrance of the Magnifique Bar.
Mitchell, Hera, and the others were waiting for them downstairs.
The Magnifique Bar was actually the same as Hotel Magnifique. They were both businesses of the Phillips Family, and they also had a membership system. One had to have a membership card to enter.
Mitchell had a membership card for Hotel Magnifique, so he could use it here.
After everyone entered the bar, their faces were filled with excitement.
After all, if it weren't for Mitchell, they wouldn't have had the chance to enter such a bar.
Connor could also feel that the business of this bar was indeed very good. Moreover, there were many luxury cars parked at the entrance, which meant that the people who came here to play were rich people.
"Isn't the decoration here way too luxurious?"
Hera sighed and took out her phone to take photos.
Mitchell turned to look at everyone and said softly, "This bar is now the best bar in Porthampton, but all of you have to be careful. Don't cause trouble in this bar. No matter what problem you encounter, tell me immediately. This bar won't tolerate people causing trouble..."
"I heard that some time ago, there was a rich guy who caused trouble here because of his family background. However, he got his legs broken."
A guy asked softly.
"I think I heard of that too!"
Mitchell nodded gently and continued, "Not only is that kid a rich second-generation heir, but his mother also seems to be an official. So, relying on his family's wealth and power, he didn't even give face to the bar manager and got into a fight with someone else. In the end, he got his legs broken…"
When everyone heard Mitchell's words, they were also very surprised. Hera, who had been gushing about the place, was now clearly much more low-key.
"You all know that this bar belongs to the Phillips Family, and the Phillips Family is related to Mr. McDonald, so no one in Porthampton dares to provoke the Phillips Family..."
Mitchell paused for a moment before continuing, "But you don't have to worry too much. As long as you don't cause trouble, no one will provoke you. Moreover, even if there's really a conflict, you can tell me. After all, I'm now an employee of the Empire World Corporation. The manager of the bar still has to give me some face…"
"You're still the best, Mitchell!"
"That's right. Mitchell has some power no matter where he goes…"
Everyone hurriedly began to flatter him.
Mitchell just wanted to show off.
Connor quietly followed behind everyone. He did not expect the Phillips Family to have developed to this extent.
When Connor first met Freya Phillips, the Phillips Family was just a small family. It was not considered a top-notch family. However, the current Phillips Family seemed to be a unique existence in the entire Porthampton.
"It seems that Thomas has been taking care of the Phillips Family recently!"
Connor sighed softly.
Mitchell had already booked a private room in advance, so everyone did not stay too long in the hall and went straight to the private room.
After entering the private room, Mitchell ordered a few bottles of wine that cost tens of thousands of dollars.
After all, Mitchell did not spend money at the hotel. He could only choose to spend money here to show off and regain some face for himself.
After the drinks had been served, everyone began to chat, and some girls began to sing.
Connor sat quietly in the corner and looked at these people. It wasn't because these people didn't want to have fun with him, but because Connor himself wasn't very interested in this kind of thing. It was as if such a lively environment had nothing to do with Connor.
"Connor, come over and play truth or dare with us!"
Cheryl tugged at Connor and said.
"You guys go ahead. I'll pass…"
Previously, Connor had played Truth or Dare with Justin Spielberg and the others. However, Connor was not very interested in this game, so he rejected her.
"You've got nothing to do anyway. Come on!"
Cheryl tugged at Connor and said.
Connor turned and looked at Cheryl. He did not continue to refuse and followed Cheryl to the crowd.
At the beginning, the bottle did not turn to Connor, so he was also quietly watching the show.
After playing a few rounds, it was finally Connor's turn.
"Connor, are you going to choose truth or dare?"
Cheryl asked Connor with a smile.
"Truth!"
Connor said lightly.
"Truth?"
Cheryl looked at Connor and smiled, then asked softly, "Connor, do you have a girlfriend now?"
"No…"
Connor shook his head lightly and continued, "But I already have a fiancée…"
"What?"
When everyone heard Connor's words, they all revealed surprised expressions and looked at him in disbelief.
"Connor, are you joking? You actually have a fiancée?"
Cheryl exclaimed in surprise.
"I'm not joking. I already have a fiancée!"
Connor said lightly.
"Then, who is your fiancée? Is she also from Porthampton?"
Cheryl asked curiously.
"This should be the second question, right?"
Connor said with a smile.
"Alright, alright. Let's continue then…"
Cheryl waved her hand and continued to spin the bottle.
The second time, the bottle was still pointed at Connor.
"Connor, can you answer my question now?"
Cheryl asked Connor softly.
"My fiancée is from Porthampton. The two of us have been together for more than a year..."
Connor replied.
"Then, what's your fiancée's name?"
Cheryl asked.
"My fiancée is Freya Phillips!"
Connor answered directly without thinking much.
"Pfft!"
Mitchell, who was eavesdropping, spat out the wine in his mouth when he heard Connor's words.
"Mitchell, what are you doing?"
Mitchell sprayed wine on Hera. She frowned and exclaimed.
"I'm sorry, I couldn't control myself just now!"
Mitchell explained awkwardly, then took out a tissue to wipe his mouth. He looked at Connor and asked, "Connor, who did you say your fiancée was?"
"Freya Phillips. What's wrong?"
Connor asked.
"Hahaha…"
Mitchell looked at Connor and laughed out loud. Then, he continued, "Connor, you're so funny. Do you know who Freya Phillips is?"

chapters.title: Chapter 1421: Drugging
chapters.content:
Chapter 1421: Drugging
"Who is Freya Phillips?"
Connor looked at Mitchell and asked with a playful expression.
"Let me tell you, the girlfriend of Mr. McDonald, the boss of the Empire World Corporation, is Freya Phillips. Freya Phillips is also from the Phillips Family in Porthampton. If it weren't for Freya Phillips and Mr. McDonald, the Phillips Family wouldn't be where they are today. Now you're saying that Freya Phillips is your girlfriend, you must be kidding me…"
Mitchell shouted at Connor.
Connor glanced at Mitchell and asked softly, "Then, do you know the name of the boss of the Empire World Corporation?"
"I…"
Mitchell looked a little awkward. He was just an intern at a branch of the Empire World Corporation, so he only knew that the boss was Mr. McDonald, but he didn't know the exact name.
"Mitchell, can you not cause trouble? The Freya Phillips that Connor is talking about might not be the Freya Phillips that you're talking about."
Cheryl pouted.
"If they have the same name, it isn't that peculiar. I am just worried that someone will cause trouble here from all that bragging…"
Mitchell said expressionlessly.
"Connor, is your fiancée really called Freya Phillips?"
Cheryl ignored Mitchell and asked Connor softly.
"It's true!"
Connor nodded.
"Then, why didn't you ask your fiancée to join us?"
Cheryl continued to ask.
"She's busy, so I didn't ask her to join!"
Connor explained.
"I see!"
Cheryl nodded without saying anything.
Mitchell was feeling rather bored, so he walked out of the private room.
After playing with Cheryl and the others for a while, Connor was bored with the game, so he said to Cheryl, "You guys continue playing. I'm going to go to the toilet!"
"Alright, go ahead!"
Cheryl replied.
Connor stood up and walked out of the private room.
A few minutes later, Connor finally found the bathroom, but before Connor could go in, he saw Mitchell whispering to a young man.
If it were anyone else, they might not be able to hear what the two of them were talking about. After all, the bar was very noisy, and the two of them were not very loud.
But Connor was a martial artist, so he could hear the conversation between these two people very clearly.
"Did you bring the things I asked you to get?"
Mitchell asked the young man in a low voice.
"Mitchell, don't worry. You know how I am when I handle things. I specially asked my friend to buy it this time. Don't worry about the effects. You definitely won't have a problem…"
the young man replied with a faint smile.
"Alright, thank you. Give it to me!"
Mitchell hurriedly said.
The young man briefly observed his surroundings. After making sure that there was no one nearby, he hurriedly took out a white pill from his clothes and handed it to Mitchell.
"This is it?"
When Mitchell saw the white pill, a trace of doubt flashed across his eyes.
"Mitchell, don't underestimate this thing. The effect is especially obvious. I've used it several times!"
The young man said while baring his teeth.
"This is my first time using this thing. How do I use it?"
Mitchell asked nervously.
"It's very easy to use. You just need to put this pill in the drink, and it will melt in a few seconds. Then, have her drink it. It will take about two to three hours for the effect to be seen. So, you have to take note of the time…"
The young man explained in a low voice.
"Alright, I understand…"
Mitchell nodded gently and turned around to leave.
"Mitchell, wait a moment!"
The young man quickly reached out to stop Mitchell and said in a low voice, "I have to remind you that you're not allowed to drug people in this bar, so you have to be careful. Don't let anyone find out. If anyone finds out, you'll be in big trouble…"
"Don't worry. I know what to do. No one will find out…"
Mitchell replied in a low voice, then took out a stack of cash from his wallet and handed it to the young man.
When the young man saw the cash, he immediately grinned and turned to leave.
Mitchell looked at the pill in his hand and revealed a smug smile. Then, he walked toward the private room.
Connor stood in the corner and looked at Mitchell with a strange look in his eyes. However, he did not expose Mitchell because Connor still did not know who Mitchell was planning to drug, so he wanted to observe first.
If Mitchell was going to drug someone Connor didn't know, then Connor wouldn't be a busybody.
However, if Mitchell planned to drug someone Connor knew, then Connor would definitely not sit idly by.
A few minutes later, Connor and Mitchell returned to the private room one after another.
Connor knew very well what Mitchell wanted to do, so he put all his attention on Mitchell. This way, Connor would be the first to notice Mitchell's actions.
After Mitchell returned to the private room, he did not seem to notice anything wrong. He began to chat with everyone. There was a smile on his face. He had no intention of drugging them.
After some time, Cheryl suddenly stood up and said to the girl beside her, "Fiona, let's go to the bathroom. I want to touch up my makeup…"
"Okay."
Fiona agreed, then got up and followed Cheryl out of the private room, chatting and laughing.
When Mitchell saw Cheryl leave, he had a strange look on his face. He reached out to pick up a glass and poured some wine into it. Then, he secretly threw the white pill into the glass.
When Connor saw this scene, he couldn't help but sneer. He guessed it right. Mitchell really planned to drug Cheryl.
Mitchell looked nervously at the glass in his hand. After all, it was his first time using this kind of thing, so he was feeling nervous.
A few seconds later, the pill completely dissolved in the wine. Mitchell's expression was a little smug as he secretly heaved a sigh of relief.
Connor had been observing Mitchell from afar. He knew that Mitchell was planning to drug Cheryl.
However, as the saying went, to catch a thief, one had to catch him in the act. If Connor went up to stop Mitchell now, he would definitely be seen as a fool. He planned to take action later.

chapters.title: Chapter 1422: You Can't Drink That!
chapters.content:
Chapter 1422: You Can't Drink That!
Cheryl and the girl returned to the private room a few minutes later.
Mitchell sat there and hesitated. Then, he walked up to Cheryl with a smile and said softly, "Cheryl, you're back!"
"Yes?"
Cheryl's impression of Mitchell had completely fallen to rock bottom because of the dish incident, so she replied coldly.
"Cheryl, we haven't seen each other for a long time. Let's have a drink!" Mitchell offered with a smile.
After Cheryl heard Mitchell's offer, she looked a little helpless. Then, she shook her head gently and said, "No, thanks. I don't really feel like drinking now. Moreover, we aren't very familiar with each other…"
"Cheryl, come on. Be nice. It's just a glass of wine. Moreover, the alcohol content of this wine is not very high…" Mitchell prompted softly.
"I said no…" Cheryl replied with a frown before turning around to leave.
"Mr. Chen, if she doesn't want to, I will…" Hera seized this opportunity and hurriedly ran to Mitchell's side, acting coquettishly.
"Who wants to drink with you?" Mitchell pushed Hera away unhappily. He had spent tens of thousands of dollars today to get Cheryl.
Therefore, no matter what, Mitchell would make Cheryl drink with him today!
Mitchell walked up to Cheryl with a glass of wine and said solemnly, "Cheryl, I used to like you. Are you not going to drink when I offer you a toast? Aren't you being a little rude?"
"..."
Cheryl looked at Mitchell helplessly. She didn't know what to say.
"Cheryl, why don't you just be nice?" The girl beside Cheryl also advised helplessly.
Everyone knew that Mitchell liked Cheryl back then.
Cheryl knew very well that Mitchell would pester her endlessly if she didn't drink today, so she reached out to take the glass and said softly, "I will only have one drink today. I drove here. I shouldn't drink too much!"
"All right, all right, just this one…" Mitchell hurriedly nodded.
The innocent Cheryl did not realize something was wrong with the glass of wine. Mitchell also took the initiative to finish the wine in his glass and stared at Cheryl nervously.
He knew his plan would succeed as long as Cheryl drank this glass of wine.
Wouldn't he be able to do whatever he wanted to her then?
Mitchell became even more excited to see that the woman he had been coveting for a long time had finally fallen into his hand.
Cheryl hesitated before raising her glass.
However, just as Cheryl was about to drink it, someone suddenly grabbed her wrist.
A hint of anger flashed in Mitchell's eyes as he looked up behind Cheryl.
The person who appeared at this moment was none other than Connor.
Cheryl's eyes flashed with a hint of confusion. She turned to look at Connor, not understanding what he meant.
"Connor, I'm drinking with Cheryl. What are you doing?" Mitchell was in a bad mood after Connor ruined his chances. So he spoke angrily.
"What do you think I'm doing?" Connor replied indifferently.
Hearing that, Mitchell seemed a little nervous. However, he believed he was cautious when spiking the drink and should have yet to be discovered. Moreover, the drug mixed well with the drink. The naked eye could not detect anything wrong with this glass of wine.
Therefore, Mitchell composed his emotions and asked Connor expressionlessly, "Connor, what do you mean? Are you deliberately causing trouble? What does drinking with Cheryl have to do with you?"
After Connor heard Mitchell's words, he couldn't help but sneer. Then, he said indifferently, "Of course, it has nothing to do with me when you drink with Cheryl. However, you spiked the drink, so it has something to do with me…"
"…"
When everyone heard that, they were all stunned and turned to look at Connor.
"Connor, what are you talking about?"
Cheryl asked Connor.
"Mitchell spiked the drink just now. You can't drink it…" Connor explained calmly.
"Mitchell spiked the drink?"
When Cheryl heard this, she was in disbelief because she did not expect Mitchell to do such a thing.
After all, they were all classmates. Who would have thought of spiking the drink?
"Connor, are you mistaken? I don't have any grudges against Mitchell. Why would he want to harm me?" Cheryl asked Connor doubtfully.
"He doesn't intend to harm you. He must have drugged you with something else!" Connor said lightly.
"Other drugs?" Cheryl looked at Connor and was utterly shocked.
Cheryl understood what Connor meant by the other drug.
At this moment, the surrounding students gathered around and began discussing in low voices.
However, most people still felt that Mitchell would not do such a thing. After all, they were all classmates, and they knew Mitchell's character.
"How could Mr. Chen roofie Cheryl?"
"That's right, Connor, you must have seen it wrongly!"
"Mr. Chen is not that kind of person!"
At this moment, a few people had already begun to speak up for Mitchell.
Mitchell stood there foolishly. Although there was no expression on his face, he was very shocked.
Mitchell couldn't understand how Connor knew he had spiked the drink.
'Could Connor have seen me doing it just now? That shouldn't be. The lights were so dim, and my actions were quite covert…' Mitchell kept thinking about the problem.
However, no matter what Mitchell thought, he could not think of a reasonable explanation.
"Connor, what do you mean by that?" Mitchell took a deep breath and asked Connor in a low voice.
"What do I mean? Don't you know that yourself?" Connor replied indifferently.
"What right do you have to accuse me of spiking Cheryl's drink?" Mitchell widened his eyes and shouted angrily.
"I saw with my eyes that you added something to the drink…" Connor replied indifferently.

chapters.title: Chapter 1423: No Evidence Needed!
chapters.content:
Chapter 1423: No Evidence Needed!
"Nonsense. This is blatant slander…" Mitchell shouted at the top of his lungs.
"You know best whether I've slandered you or not!" Connor was still very calm.
"…"
Mitchell hesitated, then said in a low voice, "All right, Connor, since you claim that I spiked the drink, can you show me the evidence? How can you prove that I spiked the drink?"
"That's right, Connor. You can't just accuse someone like that. Show me the evidence!"
"If you don't have evidence now, it's slander!"
"I think Connor is taking revenge on Mr. Chen because he said that his girlfriend dumped him…"
"Mitchell invited us to the bar to play, and you accuse Mitchell of spiking our drinks. You're simply unkind. Mitchell has no reason to drug Cheryl!"
The surrounding students who had a good relationship with Mitchell all spoke up for him.
For a moment, everyone seemed to be on Mitchell's side.
Connor did not bother with these people. He just sneered and took the wine glass from Cheryl's hand.
"You said you wanted evidence, right?" Connor asked Mitchell expressionlessly.
"That's right. Since you claim I spiked the drink, you must produce evidence!" Mitchell nodded.
Connor handed the wine glass to Mitchell and said coldly, "If you didn't, then drink this now!"
Mitchell was dumbfounded and awkward because he did not expect Connor to make him drink it.
Mitchell knew very well that he had spiked the drink. If he drank it now, it would be troublesome when the drug took effect.
By then, the surrounding students around them would know. He had something up his sleeve if he did not dare to drink it. Therefore, Mitchell was obviously in a difficult position.
