Cheryl was not a fool. When she saw Mitchell's expression, she knew what was going on.
'Mitchell spiked my drink? No wonder he keeps wanting me to drink it! Is he crazy?' Cheryl could not help but sigh internally
"Connor, what are you doing? Does Mr. Chen have to drink just because you asked him to?" However, Hera suddenly stood up and shouted at Connor with a frown.
"Mitchell knows best what I'm doing…" Connor replied in a low voice.
"Connor, there is indeed a conflict between us, but that was long ago. You don't have to slander me because of this, right? If you apologize, I can let this matter slide!" Mitchell glared at Connor and shouted.
"I should apologize to you?" Connor couldn't help but laugh coldly, and then said lightly, "Mitchell, there is indeed a conflict between us, but the person who really can't let it go is you, not me…"
"What do you mean?" Mitchell was stunned for a moment and asked Connor.
"Previously, in the private room, you humiliated me in various ways, but I let it go. After all, to me, you're nothing. You think your words might provoke me, but they sounded ridiculous. I won't take them to heart at all. Moreover, because we are classmates, I don't want to have any conflict with you at today's class reunion. However, not speaking up doesn't mean I'm afraid of you…"
Connor paused momentarily and continued, "What you're doing now is already too much. Cheryl is your classmate, but you do such a thing to her. It seems that you really inhumane!"
"What... What did I do?" Mitchell stuttered.
"You spiked her drink. I saw it with my own eyes. Since I saw this, I can't sit idly by…" Connor replied in a low voice.
Mitchell couldn't help but take a deep breath. He looked a little nervous. Then, he gritted his teeth and shouted at Connor, "Connor, aren't you going a little too far?"
"Are you going overboard, or am I?" Connor asked with a cold smile.
"Hah, fine. Since you claim you saw me drugging this glass of wine with your own eyes, what evidence do you have to prove that what you said is true? Show me the evidence now. I won't let you off if you can't show me the evidence today. Let me tell you that…" Mitchell's eyes widened as he shouted at Connor very angrily.
"I don't need to produce any evidence now. If you drink this now and nothing happens within three hours, you didn't spike it. If you don't dare to drink it, it means you did…" Connor said lightly.
Mitchell sneered and said in a low voice, "Connor, do I have to drink it just because you want me to? Who do you think you are?"
"That's right, Connor, you don't have any evidence at all. You are forcing Mitchell to drink this for no reason. You're just looking for trouble!" Hera hurriedly shouted.
In fact, the students present more or less knew that Mitchell must have spiked the drink. Otherwise, Mitchell would have just drunk it. Just drinking a glass of wine could prove him innocent. Why did he have to say so much nonsense?
However, because of Mitchell's identity, these people did not dare to provoke him. Therefore, they could only watch the show and did not dare to speak.
"I can't be bothered to talk nonsense with you now. Either drink this glass of wine now, or you apologize to Cheryl and get lost."
At this moment, Connor seemed to have changed into a different person as he told Mitchell coldly.
"Connor, don't be unreasonable here. Mr. Chen said he didn't spike the drink. What do you want?" At this moment, a boy with a good relationship with Mitchell stood up and shouted at Connor.
"How could Mitchell drug Cheryl? He's simply being unreasonable…"
"That's right, Connor. What nonsense are you talking about here? We're all classmates. There's no need for things to turn out like this. It's not good for anyone…"
"I also think that Mitchell would not do such a thing…"
"That's enough. Mitchell won't argue with you, so stop talking..."
More people stood up for Mitchell after one person took the lead.
These people's thoughts were very simple. They wanted to take this opportunity to curry favor with Mitchell.
At this moment, several male students were already standing behind Mitchell, speaking up for him. Their intentions were undeniable.

chapters.title: Chapter 1424: Who Is Stirring Trouble?
chapters.content:
Chapter 1424: Who Is Stirring Trouble?
"I've already made it very clear just now. Either he drinks this glass of wine or admits that he spiked Cheryl's drink and apologizes," Connor said expressionlessly.
No one had expected Connor to be so unyielding. They initially thought Connor would give in with so many people standing up for Mitchell.
However, Connor did not take these people seriously at all.
Mitchell finally couldn't take it anymore. He gritted his teeth and shouted at Connor, "Connor, I didn't want to talk nonsense with you previously because of my classmates, but you're forcing me. Do you think I'm easy to bully?"
"I don't have an opinion on how you interpret it. But no matter what, you must drink this today…" Connor said to Mitchell expressionlessly.
Mitchell sneered and said indifferently, "If I don't drink, what will you do to me?"
"Since you don't want to drink it, I will beat you up until you drink it…" Connor replied in a low voice, then took a step forward and planned to attack Mitchell.
"Connor, are you crazy? Do you know what this place is?"
"That's right, Connor can't just do anything he wants!"
"Connor, if you were to attack now, this would be blown out of proportion…"
Mitchell had previously told these people that no matter what, they could not cause trouble here, so when everyone saw Connor was about to make a move, they became very nervous.
They were worried that they might be implicated if Connor fought with Mitchell.
However, Connor did not seem to hear what everyone said and continued to walk closer to Mitchell.
When Cheryl saw Connor was about to make a move, a trace of nervousness flashed in her eyes. She quickly reached out to Connor and said anxiously, "Stop it. This is the Magnifique Bar. I heard those who cause trouble here do not end well. The owner of this bar is the Phillips Family. If you stir up trouble here, you will cause big trouble…"
"That's right. Connor, you should calm down. If there's anything, we can discuss it properly. Please don't do anything rash. This is different from some other small bars. If you do something rash, things will be troublesome…"
The students present also knew how powerful the owner of this bar was, so they all advised Connor not to make a move.
However, Connor ignored these people.
"Connor, if you want to do anything, we can go outside and talk it out. However, I advise you not to cause trouble here…" Mitchell shouted at Connor.
"Are you going to drink this or not?" Connor walked up to Mitchell and asked him expressionlessly.
"I... I won't…" Mitchell replied without thinking.
"Smack!" Connor slapped Mitchell's face.
For a moment, everyone was stunned. No one expected Connor to really make a move on Mitchell.
However, Connor did not use all his strength in this slap because he wanted Mitchell to admit that he had spiked the drink.
Mitchell stared at Connor in disbelief. He shouted ferociously, "Connor, how dare you hit me? Are you crazy?"
"I've already told you just now. Either drink this glass of wine or admit that you spiked the drink. Since you don't want to choose either, I shall do whatever I want…" Connor said lightly.
"I'll f*cking fight it out with you…" In school, Connor beat Mitchell up in front of the whole class.
He did not expect that he would be slapped by Connor again after they had graduated.
Mitchell felt that he was the best in the class. He could not tolerate such a thing, so he rushed toward Connor.
"You overestimate yourself!"
When Connor saw Mitchell rushing up to him, he was a little disdainful. Then, he raised his leg and kicked Mitchell's stomach.
Although Connor used little strength in this kick, Mitchell was still sent flying by Connor.
"What are you all doing there? Hurry up and beat him up! If anything happens today, I'll take responsibility!" Mitchell sat on the ground and shouted.
As for the male students who were on good terms with Mitchell, they all rushed toward Connor after hearing Mitchell's words.
To them, Connor was just an ordinary person. With so many of them, it was impossible for them not to be a match for Connor.
The surrounding female students also screamed. No one had expected today's class reunion to turn out like this.
"I beg you, please stop…" Cheryl stood before Connor and shouted agitatedly.
At this moment, Cheryl was protecting Connor because she felt Connor was no match for these people.
"Cheryl, move aside!" A male student pushed Cheryl aside and raised his fist to bring it down on Connor's face.
However, Connor's reaction was swift. He raised his leg and kicked the male student away.
After kicking the male student away, Connor once again rushed forward.
Something unbelievable happened. In less than half a minute, Connor knocked these male students down alone.
Mitchell sat on the ground and looked at Connor, terrified.
For a moment, the entire private room fell into silence.
"Connor, what are you doing?" Cheryl shouted. "We're all classmates. Don't make a scene anymore..."
"I'm not fooling around. He really spiked your drink…" Connor calmly replied to Mitchell and Cheryl. Then, he walked to Mitchell with the glass of wine and asked in a low voice, "Is it the 'you drink' or the 'you don't drink'?"
Mitchell stared at Connor with an indescribable fear on his face. He did not know what to do now.
Cheryl was also very nervous. Previously, everyone said that they could not cause trouble in this bar.
However, Connor had fought with the others. If the people in the bar knew about this, they would not let Connor off.
Mitchell was very clear about the effect of the drug he had used, so he refused to drink it no matter what.
"Who is causing trouble in the bar?" But at this moment, a voice came from outside the private room.
After some students saw Connor hit someone, they did not care about their friendship and ran outside to call for security. It seemed that they wanted to get rid of this matter.

chapters.title: Chapter 1425: Drink It All
chapters.content:
Chapter 1425: Drink It All
"Who called security?" Cheryl's eyes flashed with despair.
A few seconds later, security guards rushed into the private room, and they were unusually angry.
"Who did it?" the security guard shouted.
"I did…" Connor replied expressionlessly.
"Our bar does not allow any trouble. If there's anything, you can settle it outside. Please leave now!" the security guard ordered.
When Connor heard the security guard's order, a trace of disdain flashed in his eyes. Then, he walked up to Mitchell and asked him expressionlessly, "Are you drinking it or not?"
When Mitchell saw the security guard appear, he immediately turned and shouted at the security guard, "What are you guys looking at? Hurry up and chase this person out. He's deliberately looking for trouble with me…"
After Connor heard Mitchell's accusation, he didn't hesitate at all. He picked up the beer bottle and brought it down on Mitchell's head.
Mitchell instinctively dodged. The wine bottle smashed onto Mitchell's shoulder.
"Ah…"
Mitchell couldn't help but scream. He lay on the ground, filled with pain.
One had to know that a beer bottle was very hard. The blow just now could have broken Mitchell's bones.
When the bar security guards saw this, they were very shocked because they did not expect Connor to be so bold. The security guards were already there, but Connor actually attacked Mitchell.
One of the security guards rushed toward Connor and grabbed his arm, shouting in a low voice, "Didn't you hear what I just said? You can't cause trouble here. If you continue to cause trouble, don't blame us for being rough…"
"Let me go…" Connor said to the security guard expressionlessly.
"I can't. Come with us…" The security guard replied.
Connor wasn't in the mood to talk nonsense with this security guard. He turned around and raised his leg, kicking the security guard in the stomach.
The security guard did not even have time to react to what was going on. In an instant, he was sent flying and smashed onto the table.
The other two security guards did not expect Connor to be so arrogant. He even dared to hit a security guard. They rushed up without any hesitation.
Although the two security guards were skilled, they were just ordinary people. To Connor, they were not worth mentioning. In less than two seconds, the two security guards were all on the ground, moaning in pain.
At this moment, the students in the private room were wide-eyed and looked at Connor dumbfoundedly.
After all, Mitchell had humiliated Connor in every way possible when they were eating at the restaurant, but Connor had never refuted or been angry. However, Connor seemed to have changed into a different person here. Not only did he dare to beat up Mitchell, but he also beat up the security guard of this bar.
Even more surprising was that no one had expected Connor's skills to be so terrifying.
Although they knew that Connor was very good at fighting when they were in high school and that ordinary people couldn't beat him, they didn't expect him to be so good now.
Perhaps it was because Connor's commotion just now was too big, so many customers in the bar had already gathered at the private room door, wanting to see what was going on.
At this moment, everyone was very curious. Who on earth had the guts to cause trouble in this bar?
The people who could come to this bar were rich heirs or high-ranking officials. Therefore, they still felt very disdainful about Connor beating people up.
They felt that real upper-class people would never use such a method to deal with problems. Only ordinary people with no brains would beat people up and solve issues barbarically and rudely.
"Who is this person?"
"I've never seen this person."
"This person is too bold. He dares to cause trouble here. Does he have a death wish?"
"I've never seen this person before. I don't know him. I think this person must be crazy…"
"That's right. He dared to come to such a place to cause trouble. Isn't he asking for death?"
Everyone sized up Connor while discussing in disdain.
Cheryl saw things getting out of hand and quickly ran to Connor. He shouted at Connor, "Connor, I beg you. Don't cause trouble anymore…"
Connor ignored Cheryl and walked up to Mitchell with the glass of wine. Then, he asked Mitchell in a low voice, "I'm asking you one last time. Are you going to drink this or not?"
Mitchell was utterly dumbfounded.
Earlier, he saw Connor fight three security guards alone. Those three security guards did not even touch Connor's clothes. He felt that Connor was a monster.
Mitchell knew very well that if he did not drink this glass of wine, Connor would not let it go. By then, he would only continue to suffer, so he might as well drink this glass of wine. Therefore, Mitchell took a deep breath and said in a low voice, "I'd just drink it, right?"
Connor handed the glass to Mitchell.
Mitchell trembled as he took the glass and took a small sip.
"Drink it all…" Connor said expressionlessly.
Hearing this, he seemed a little helpless, but he did not dare to go against Connor's wishes. He could only grit his teeth and down all the wine in the glass.
Connor didn't say anything after seeing Mitchell drink the wine. Instead, he walked to Cheryl and said expressionlessly, "Let's go…"
"Alright…" Cheryl nodded lightly and followed Connor out of the private room.
When the students in the class saw that Connor was about to leave, they did not stop him, but no one followed him.
No one had expected such an outcome. It was a class reunion, but things had turned out like this.
However, Connor had just injured the security guard in the bar. The people in the bar would not let Connor off easily.
As expected, Connor and Cheryl had just left the private room when they saw more than a dozen burly men in security uniforms blocking the road ahead.
"Connor is really too impulsive. He dared to hit the security guards…"
"The people in the bar will definitely not let him off…"
"That's right. I really don't know what Connor is thinking. We're all classmates. Why must he make things so awkward?"
"I want to see what Connor plans to do next!"
"When I was eating in the hotel previously, I didn't see Connor with such a big temper. I don't understand why he suddenly became like this…"
The students began to discuss in low voices.

chapters.title: Chapter 1426: Mr. Wagstoff
chapters.content:
Chapter 1426: Mr. Wagstoff
Mitchell sat on the sofa in a daze. At this moment, his mind was filled with what had just happened.
He did not know when the drug would take effect, so he was extremely nervous.
Connor narrowed his eyes and looked at the security guards playfully. A trace of disdain flashed in his eyes, and he walked forward.
Cheryl followed Connor nervously. She knew that these security guards were probably here for Connor.
"Get out of the way…" Connor walked up to the security guards and shouted coldly.
One of the security guards scanned Connor up and down, then asked expressionlessly, "You were the one who hit him just now?"
"Yes!" Connor replied indifferently.
"Sir, I'm sorry. You injured the security guard in our bar just now, so you can't leave now…"
"Are you sure you don't want me to leave?" Connor frowned and asked the security guard.
"No matter who you are, you can't leave after beating someone up in the Magnifique Bar…"
However, at this moment, a tall and handsome young man walked out from behind the security guard.
"It's Mr. Wagstoff!"
"I didn't expect Mr. Wagstoff to come…"
"Hah, looks like this brat might be in trouble today…"
The customers in the bar seemed to know this young man as they discussed in low voices.
The young man walked up to Connor and said with a smile, "Hello, sir. I'm the manager of this bar. My name is Samson Wagstoff!"
"Is there something you need?" Connor looked at the young man and asked calmly.
"Of course, you injured someone in our place earlier. Now, please give us an explanation. Otherwise, we will not let you leave this place…"
Samson, in front of Connor, was very handsome. Moreover, there was a trace of murderous intent in his eyes. Connor could feel that although Samson was not a martial artist, he was not ordinary.
After hearing Samson's words, Connor was stunned. Then, he said expressionlessly, "What explanation do you want?"
Samson snorted coldly and said indifferently, "You beat up someone in our bar and even beat up our security guards, so you have to give me an explanation today. Otherwise, how will we continue to operate?"
At this moment, many guests surrounded Connor and Samson, but most were watching the show.
This was because they knew very well that Samson would not appear personally if it were a small matter. Since Samson had already appeared personally, the bar would not let Connor off easily today.
Even Mitchell was a little excited. Although he had just drunk that glass of wine, there were still two to three hours before the effects of the drug took effect, so he was not in a hurry.
And Connor would find walking out of this bar very difficult today.
He felt that if he could make Connor a cripple because of this, he would not drink this glass of wine for nothing. At most, when the drug took effect, he would find Hera to vent.
Thinking of this, Mitchell could not help but reveal a smug smile.
The students in the class were all watching the commotion. No one was willing to stand up for Connor.
After all, if he stood up for Connor at this time, wouldn't that be equivalent to offending Mitchell? Moreover, it would implicate him.
These students didn't know what was going on at all. They didn't know if Mitchell drugged Cheryl.
And even if Mitchell drugged Cheryl, this had nothing to do with them so that they wouldn't meddle in other people's business.
However, they felt a little unbelievable that Connor was still harmless. No matter how Mitchell ridiculed and humiliated Connor, Connor did not get angry. However, it was as if he had changed into a different person.
It was unbelievable.
Cheryl ran to Samson and said agitatedly, "This has nothing to do with Connor…"
"He just admitted that he hit someone…" Samson said calmly.
"This is what happened. Someone drugged my drink just now, and Connor happened to see it. That's why Connor hit me. If you want to pursue the matter, then come and pursue my responsibility…" Cheryl quickly said.
"Someone drugged your drink?" After Samson heard this, a trace of anger flashed in his eyes.
The Magnifique Bar clearly stated that such a situation was not allowed.
Drugging someone was even more detestable than beating them up!
"That's right. He was the one who tried to drug me…" Cheryl pointed at Mitchell and shouted.
Samson sized Cheryl up. He felt that Cheryl was not lying.
"Don't listen to their nonsense. I didn't spike her drink…" Mitchell hurriedly shouted.
Samson asked Cheryl, "What evidence do you have to prove that he drugged her?"
After Cheryl heard Samson's question, a hint of helplessness flashed in her eyes. She did not have any evidence. If she had evidence, Connor would not have made a move.
"You can go and take a look at the surveillance cameras in your bar…" Cheryl said helplessly.
"I'm sorry, but our bar doesn't have surveillance cameras…" Samson replied in a low voice.
"Umm…" Cheryl looked at Samson, not knowing what to say.
Samson approached Mitchell expressionlessly and asked, "Did you try to drug this lady just now? Don't you know that we don't allow drugs in our bar? Do you know that you're asking for death?"
After hearing Samson's words, Mitchell's expression was a little flustered. He stuttered, "Mr. Wagstoff, don't listen to these two people's nonsense. They're framing me. I'm a member of this bar. Even if I have the guts, I wouldn't dare to drug someone..."
"Would they accuse you for no reason?" Samson frowned.
"Connor has beef with me. He's just looking for trouble…" Mitchell's acting was very good. If Connor had not seen Mitchell spiking the drink with his own eyes, he might have believed Mitchell's words.

chapters.title: Chapter 1427: Ms. Phillips Is Here
chapters.content:
Chapter 1427: Ms. Phillips Is Here
Samson looked at Mitchell helplessly.
After all, Connor said that Mitchell had spiked the drink, but he could not produce any evidence.
Mitchell didn't admit to spiking the drink, so he didn't know what to do.
"Why don't the two of you come with me…" Samson said softly.
"Why should I go with you? I didn't put anything in the drink at all. Connor asked me to drink this glass of wine, and I already did. I'm fine now. This proves me right…" Mitchell hurriedly shouted.
"Did you drink that glass of wine just now?" Samson asked Mitchell with a puzzled expression.
"That's right. Everyone saw me drink that glass of wine just now, and I'm fine now. Doesn't this prove that I didn't spike it?" Mitchell shouted.
"Some drugs don't work immediately…" Connor said calmly.
Samson looked down at his phone and said softly, "Since he drank that glass of wine just now, why don't we all wait in this private room for two hours…
"If nothing happens to him, it means he didn't spike the drink. However, if something happens to him, it means he did. Let's discuss how to deal with this next…"
Everyone thought this was fair.
Mitchell was instantly dumbfounded. He could not help but tremble slightly, feeling nervous.
He knew that the drug would take effect in a few hours. By then, he could not explain himself, no matter how eloquent he was.
"I'm not in the mood to waste my time with you guys. If you want to know if he spiked the drink, wait here. I'm leaving!" After saying this, Connor walked away.
Samson did not expect Connor to dismiss him. He had already said so much, but Connor still wouldn't cooperate.
Samson took a step forward and stopped Connor. Then, he said unhappily, "I advise you to stay and wait for a while. It's the best for everyone!"
"What if I won't?" Connor asked indifferently.
"If you won't, I won't be nice…" Samson replied.
"And…?" Connor's eyes flashed with disdain.
Samson did not intend to waste time on Connor. He raised his fist and was about to smash Connor's face.
Connor was very fast. He turned sideways and easily dodged Samson's punch.
Seeing how fast Connor reacted, a hint of surprise flashed in his eyes.
Just as Samson was in shock, Connor raised his leg and kicked Samson's stomach. Samson was instantly sent flying before falling onto the ground.
Everyone's eyes widened.
No one expected Connor to send Samson flying with a kick.
After falling, Samson instinctively wanted to stand up, but he realized he did not have the strength to stand up. It was as if his internal organs had shifted out of their positions.
Only then did Samson realize how scary Connor was!
"No wonder you dare to be so arrogant. It looks like you really have some skills…"
Samson took a deep breath, then whispered to the security guards around him, "What are you all still standing there for? Quickly catch this person…"
When the security guards heard this, they did not hesitate at all and rushed toward Connor.
"Stop!"
However, just as the security guards were about to attack Connor, a cold and dignified voice spoke behind them.
When the security guards heard this, they were stunned. Then, they looked behind them, puzzled.
Everyone saw three gorgeous women walking slowly into the bar. Their figure, appearance, or temperament were the best of the best, especially the woman walking in the middle. Her figure was first-class, her appearance was amazing, and her aura was elegant. She moved like a noble.
"Why is Ms. Phillips here?" When Samson saw the three women, he looked nervous.
"Do you see that? The woman walking in the middle is the eldest daughter of the Phillips Family, Freya Phillips!"
"What? This woman is Freya?"
"Isn't she beautiful?"
"I heard that Freya is Mr. McDonald's girlfriend. The Phillips Family is where they are today because of Mr. McDonald…"
"That's right. I didn't expect such a small matter would alarm Ms. Phillips…"
Everyone present began to discuss in low voices.
Connor looked at the door and smiled helplessly. He did not expect Freya to come over.
Connor turned to look at Maya, who was beside Freya and instantly realized what was going on. After all, Connor had already met Maya at the hotel, so Maya must have told Freya that he had arrived in Porthampton.
Originally, Connor had wanted to surprise Freya, but now it seemed that all his plans had failed.
Everyone's attention was focused on Maya, Freya, and Priscilla. These three women were so beautiful that they were like fairies in the eyes of ordinary people. Moreover, the Phillips Family was considered the top family in Porthampton because of Connor. This caused many people to be curious about the three daughters of the Phillips Family.
However, among Freya, Maya, and Priscilla, Freya was probably the most eye-catching.
After all, Maya would often appear in this bar, but Freya rarely appeared here.
Mitchell looked nervously at Maya because he did not expect this to escalate so much so that Freya was alarmed.
Mitchell was currently an intern at the Empire World Corporation, and Freya was the girlfriend of the Empire World Corporation's boss. If Freya had a bad impression of him, it would significantly impact his future. Moreover, Mitchell was most worried about the glass of wine he had just drunk. If this went on, once the drug took effect, Mitchell would not be able to explain himself.

chapters.title: Chapter 1428: Connor Is My Man!
chapters.content:
Chapter 1428: Connor Is My Man!
Mitchell looked visibly upset.
He stared at Freya and the others, not knowing what to do.
The bar manager, Samson, was also confused. He did not know what was going on.
When Freya and the others appeared in the bar, they instantly attracted the attention of countless people. It was as if, instantly, everyone's eyes were on Freya, Maya, and Priscilla.
Samson hesitated before quickly walking up to Maya and said respectfully, "Ma'am, you're here."
"Yes…" Maya nodded lightly.
"Hello, Ms. Phillips!"
The number of times Samson met Freya was still very limited. However, Samson knew very well how influential Freya's background was, so he respectfully spoke to her.
Freya glanced at Samson indifferently and asked coldly, "What's going on?"
"Ms. Phillips, someone was causing trouble in the bar just now. Not only did they beat up our customers, but they also beat up the security guards…" Samson hurriedly explained.
When Freya heard Samson's words, she couldn't help but look up at Connor. One had to know that the person who understood Connor the most in this world was probably Freya. After all, the two had experienced so many things, so Freya knew very well that Connor wouldn't hit someone for no reason if it weren't for something reasonable.
"Do you know why he hit the customer?" Maya asked Samson with a smile.
"He claimed that someone drugged his friend's drink, but he can't produce any evidence now…"
Samson did not dare to hide anything at this moment and hurriedly said.
Hearing that, Mitchell seemed a little excited. He quickly ran to Freya and spoke nervously, "Hello, Ms. Phillips. This person is trying to slander me by claiming to attempt to drug his friend, but he has no evidence. Please don't listen to his nonsense…"
Freya glanced at Mitchell indifferently and said nothing.
"…"
Mitchell looked at Freya and hesitated before saying, "Ms. Phillips, I'm an intern at the Empire World Corporation. My uncle is Savion Chen!"
"Oh?"
When Freya heard that, she was surprised. Then, she said playfully, "You're an intern at the Empire World Corporation?"
"That's right. I'm an intern at the Empire World Corporation. Ms. Phillips, you have to believe me. I really didn't try to drug anyone!"
Mitchell thought that his words had an effect and quickly nodded.
"Do you know who he is?" Freya pointed at Connor.
"Who is he?"
When Mitchell heard this, he was surprised. Then, he frowned and said, "He is called Connor McDonald, my classmate…"
"I asked you if you know who he is," Freya repeated expressionlessly.
Mitchell sized up Freya with a puzzled expression. He frowned and said, "Ms. Phillips, I don't know what you mean by that…"
"If you don't know who he is, I'll tell you!"
Freya paused before walking elegantly to Connor. She took the initiative to hold Connor's arm and said with a smile, "Connor is my man!"
When everyone heard Freya's introduction, their jaws dropped, and they stood rooted to the ground in a daze. They were in disbelief.
At this moment, many people present knew who Freya was, so they knew who her man was!
"He is Mr. McDonald of Porthampton?"
Samson stared at Connor, wide-eyed and shocked. He seemed unable to find another word to describe his current mood.
Samson finally understood why Connor dared to be so arrogant previously. He even dared to beat up the security guards of their bar. If Connor was Mr. McDonald of Porthampton, everything could be explained.
"What? He is the Mr. McDonald of Porthampton?"
"He's Ms. Phillips' man…"
"This is too unbelievable!"
Most of the guests present had never seen Connor before, so when they heard the news, they were naturally shocked.
Of course, the ones who were most shocked were Connor's classmates.
After all, none of these people had expected Connor to be so influential. They had just mocked Connor in the restaurant, but no one had expected such a shocking revelation of Connor's identity.
"What is going on?" Cheryl stared at Connor. Her expression was one of disbelief.
Although Cheryl knew Connor's identity was not as simple as most students imagined, and Connor had previously said that his girlfriend was Freya, everyone thought it was a joke. No one thought Connor's girlfriend was the famous Freya Phillips.
"Connor's girlfriend is Freya?"
"Oh my god, am I dreaming? How could Connor find such a beautiful girlfriend?"
"Did you get the wrong person?"
The students in Connor's class began to discuss softly.
After all, in their eyes, Connor was just an ordinary poor loser. A woman like Freya could not possibly be with Connor.
"Mitchell said before that Freya's boyfriend is the legendary Mr. McDonald of Porthampton. Freya says that Connor is her boyfriend. Doesn't that mean that Connor is Mr. McDonald of Porthampton?" A male student suddenly said.
Everyone turned to look at the male student, shocked.
At this moment, they realized that the scariest thing wasn't the relationship between Freya and Connor, but that Connor was Porthampton Mr. McDonald. This was the most shocking thing.

chapters.title: Chapter 1429: You Can't Judge A Book By Its Cover
chapters.content:
Chapter 1429: You Can't Judge A Book By Its Cover
"Who is Connor?"
Cheryl stood rooted to the ground, her face filled with shock.
For a moment, the atmosphere in the bar suddenly became strange. Everyone's attention was on Connor alone.
When everyone discovered Connor's true identity, they were utterly shocked.
To them, this was unthinkable. Connor had transformed into the Mr. McDonald of Porthampton people looked up to.
If everyone knew Connor's identity was so terrifying, they wouldn't have the guts to laugh at Connor during dinner.
Of course, Mitchell's expression was still the ugliest among all the people present.
Mitchell had never expected Connor to be Freya's boyfriend. More importantly, if Connor was that famous man of Porthampton, then Connor was Mitchell's boss.
Therefore, Mitchell did not know what to say.
Of course, there were more important things.
Now, Mitchell was not in the mood to think about those things. He was thinking about what he should do when the drug took effect!
Mitchell was very clear about Samson's methods, so he could not help but fall to the ground.
He did not know what to do.
As everyone was shocked, Freya approached Connor and asked softly, "Why didn't you tell me you were coming?"
"I originally planned to surprise you, but when I flew back to Porthampton, I bumped into my old classmates. They happened to be having a class reunion in Porthampton, so I went to the class reunion first. I planned to look for you after the reunion…" Connor explained with a smile.
"I see!" Freya nodded lightly, then looked at Mitchell indifferently and said, "Just now, this person said he was from the Empire World Corporation. I didn't expect him not even to know his boss…"
"I'm often not in Porthampton. Apart from some of the real old employees of Empire World Corporation, it's normal for others not to know me!" Connor replied.
"That's true…" Freya nodded and continued, "How do you plan to deal with this person today?"
Connor hesitated, then walked up to Mitchell.
When Mitchell saw Connor walking over, he was scared silly. He shouted at Connor, "Connor…No, Mr. McDonald, I know I was wrong. Please forgive me. I beg you, let me go…"
When the students in the class saw this, they could only stand by helplessly. After all, no one expected it to end up like this. Mitchell, who had previously been disdainful of Connor, was now begging Connor so humbly.
"Do you know your mistake?" Connor couldn't help but smile faintly. Then, he asked expressionlessly, "I'm a little curious. Do you know what you did wrong?"
"I…" Mitchell looked at Connor awkwardly.
"Tell me, didn't you say you were wrong just now? Then tell me, what did you do wrong?" Connor asked softly.
"…."
Mitchell looked up at Connor and was silent for a few seconds. Then, he gritted his teeth and said, "I admit I spiked Cheryl's drink. I'm not human. I'm a beast. I shouldn't have tried to drug Cheryl!"
After Mitchell said this, everyone present, including Cheryl herself, was stunned.
After all, everyone believed in Mitchell before because they felt that since they were classmates and had known each other for so many years, Mitchell would never do such a thing.
However, they did not expect Mitchell to really try to drug Cheryl.
At this moment, Cheryl felt like she had just survived a disaster. After all, if it wasn't for Connor's hint, she might have already lost consciousness. Even a fool would know what would happen next.
"I didn't expect Mitchell to be such a person…"
"That's right. I didn't expect Mitchell to do such a despicable thing to his classmate. I thought he was good…"
"Yeah, that's right. You really can't judge a book by its cover. Fortunately, we met Connor today. Otherwise, Cheryl would be in danger!"
Perhaps because everyone already knew Connor's identity, the tone of these people's words had changed drastically. Everyone began to criticize Mitchell, except for Cheryl, who stood alone in the same place as if she could not accept this fact.
"Connor, I know my mistake. Please give me a chance. I beg you…"
Mitchell couldn't care less about his face now. He put down all his dignity and shouted excitedly at Connor.
Connor turned to look at Cheryl and said expressionlessly, "You tried to drug Cheryl, so you don't have to beg me. You can ask Cheryl if she wants to let you go."
Mitchell quickly turned to look at Cheryl. Then, he said, "Cheryl, I know I was wrong. I spiked your drink on impulse. I beg you, let me go. Don't hand me over to the people in the bar. Otherwise, they will cut off my hands…"
Cheryl looked at Mitchell with an embarrassed expression. At this moment, she was also furious at what Mitchell had done.
Although Mitchell had always been pursuing her, he had never done anything out of line. However, she never expected Mitchell to go overboard this time.
"Cheryl, can you let me go because we are classmates?" Mitchell asked Cheryl nervously.
Cheryl hesitated, then whispered, "Mitchell, I don't want to see you again in this lifetime!"
"Cheryl, are you letting me go?" Mitchell was surprised and asked Cheryl excitedly.
Cheryl looked at Mitchell without saying a word.
"Cheryl, thank you. you will never see me again. I will leave now…"
Mitchell stood up as he spoke, then ran out of the bar like a madman, afraid Connor and Cheryl would change their minds.

chapters.title: Chapter 1430: Mr. McDonald Is Cool!
chapters.content:
Chapter 1430: Mr. McDonald Is Cool!
When Connor saw Mitchell run out of the bar, he smiled helplessly.
However, he had no intention of stopping Mitchell. After all, in Connor's eyes, a person like Mitchell was not worth his time.
After Mitchell left, Cheryl looked at Connor and whispered, "Connor, thank you so much for today. If it was not because I met you, things might not have ended up like this…"
"It's okay. If you didn't ask me to come to the class reunion, I wouldn't have been able to help you. You have to be more careful with people like Mitchell in the future…" Connor replied with a smile.
Cheryl seemed helpless. She turned to look at Freya and asked Connor softly, "Connor, is Ms. Phillips really your girlfriend?"
"That's right. Didn't I tell you guys at the hotel before? You all just thought I was bragging…" Connor said lightly.
"Since Ms. Phillips is your girlfriend, then are you really the legendary Mr. McDonald of Porthampton?" Cheryl looked at Connor and asked.
"I am me. As for the Mr. McDonald of Porthampton that you mentioned, it's just a name that others call me because many people don't even know my real name…" Connor replied.
Even though Cheryl already knew about this, she was still shocked when she heard Connor admit it.
After all, Cheryl felt that the so-called Mr. McDonald of Porthampton would never appear in her life. However, she never expected the so-called Mr. McDonald to be an old classmate of hers.
The other students in the class looked at Connor with shining eyes. After all, these people were facing the same problem, which was the problem of finding a job.
If they could build a good relationship with Connor today, wouldn't it be easy for Connor to introduce them to the Empire World Corporation?
Therefore, at this moment, they thought they would find an opportunity to curry favor with Connor.
"Connor, I… I have something to do, so I'll have to cut our conversation short. I'll leave first…"
Perhaps because Cheryl could not get over what had happened before, she was still feeling complicated. There was only one thought in her mind: to leave this place as soon as possible.
"All right, do you want me to get someone to send you off?" Connor nodded and asked.
"There's no need. I'll go back with Lia…" Cheryl replied to Connor in a panic. Then, she dragged another girl and quickly walked toward the bar's entrance.
Seeing that Cheryl wanted to leave, Connor said nothing.
"I'm really sorry about what happened today. It's our bar's responsibility for what happened. To express our apology, all of your expenses today will be paid by Connor alone. I hope everyone can enjoy themselves!" Maya suddenly announced to the surrounding customers.
"Mr. McDonald is so cool!"
"Mr. McDonald is awesome…"
For a moment, everyone began to cheer.
Connor looked at Maya helplessly and asked softly, "Today's incident is clearly your bar's responsibility. Why do you want me to pay?"
"Because you have money! Anyway, you're so rich, so it doesn't matter. What's wrong with letting you pay for it?" Maya replied to Connor with a pout as if it was only natural.
Connor looked at Maya, speechless However, this bit of money was really nothing to Connor. In addition, these people had dispersed after hearing Maya's words, so Connor did not care about it.
Of course, although most guests had already left, Connor's classmates did not.
"Connor, I didn't expect you to be Mr. McDonald of Porthampton."
"That's right, Connor. I didn't expect you to be the one who is doing the best among our classmates…"
"Connor…"
For a moment, several students surrounded Connor and shouted excitedly at him.
"Are you all Connor's classmates?" Maya blinked and asked softly.
"That's right, we're all Connor's classmates!"
Hera, who had previously been making things difficult for Connor, seemed to have changed into a different person at this moment. She hurriedly replied to Maya.
When everyone heard Hera, they all revealed disdainful expressions.
After all, Hera had always helped Mitchell bully Connor. Now, she actually had the nerve to speak. If it were anyone else, they would have left long ago. Hera was shameless.
"Since you're all Connor's classmates, the Magnifique Bar will give each of you a membership card. You can go and look for Mr. Wagstoff to process that…" Maya said expressionlessly.
"…"
The students in the class were all stunned when they heard this.
How could they have thought that the membership card of the Magnifique Bar, which was so mighty and unreachable in the eyes of the public, could be given to them for free? This was an amazing opportunity. After all, people in Porthampton dreamed of obtaining this membership card.
"If you want to apply for a membership card, please come with me!" Samson laughed and shouted at the crowd.
When Connor's classmates heard this, they went crazy and ran toward Samson.
"Well? Shouldn't you be thanking me?" Maya asked Connor with a smile.
"Thank you…" Connor immediately replied without thinking. After all, Maya had really helped Connor a lot. Otherwise, if all these students surrounded Connor and wanted him to introduce them to work, Connor would really not know how to deal with these people.
"All right, it's not convenient to talk here. Let's go to the private room!" Freya suggested softly.
"Sure!" Connor nodded and followed Freya and the others into the private room.
After arriving at the private room, Connor began to chat with Freya and the others. However, most of the content of the chat was about Freya's time in the U.S.. It was about Priscilla's time with Freya.
Of course, Connor listened most of the time and rarely spoke.

chapters.title: Chapter 1431: A Man And A Woman
chapters.content:
Chapter 1431: A Man And A Woman
In the blink of an eye, it was already eleven o'clock at night.
Seeing that it was late, Freya suggested that she go back.
Connor planned to go home with Freya.
After Connor and Freya left the bar, they entered Freya's Mercedes-Benz.
"Where do you plan to go next? Shall I send you home first?"
Freya took the initiative to sit in the driver's seat and turned to ask Connor softly.
"I came to Porthampton because of you, and you plan to let me go home alone?" Connor asked with a smile.
"What do you plan to do? Go to a hotel room?" Freya asked back with a smile.
"Go to the hotel?" Connor was stunned. Then, he said helplessly, "We both have our own places. Why do we have to go to a hotel? Why waste that money? Either you bring me to your house, or you come with me to mine. It's up to you!"
Freya's face flushed red. She instantly understood what Connor meant.
"Have you decided? Are you going to mine or yours?" Connor asked Freya with a smile.
"Then let's go to mine. It has been long since anyone has lived in your house…" Freya said softly after a moment of hesitation.
"Are your parents home?" Connor asked with a smirk.
Freya turned and glared at Connor. She ignored him and started the car.
Connor was sitting in the front passenger seat nervously. Connor and Freya had been together for a long time, but they had never gone too far in physical intimacy. Therefore, Connor felt that this was a scarce opportunity.
After all, when a man and a woman were alone, and the two were a couple, even if something happened, it was very normal.
As for Freya, she knew what Connor was planning. If she hadn't experienced so many things, Freya would never have agreed to such a thing. After all, Freya was a very traditional woman. She couldn't accept having sex before marriage.
But now that Connor was her fiancé, furthermore, Freya had fallen in love with Connor, she was willing to give her most precious thing to Connor.
However, Freya was also very nervous at the moment. She was tightly gripping the steering wheel.
After some time, the car finally stopped.
"We're here…" Freya turned to look at Connor and said softly to him.
"We're here?" Connor pushed open the car door and got out to take a quick look at Freya's villa.
This villa was not the one that Freya used to live in. Perhaps because of the Yearwood Family, Freya no longer lived with Sean Phillips and his wife. She lived alone outside.
The villa was about 500 square meters in size. There was a small garden in front of it with some flowers and plants, making it seem fresh and elegant.
However, based on Freya's current status, living in such a villa was considered very low-key. After all, Freya was Connor's girlfriend. It was normal for her to live in the best villa in Porthampton.
"This villa doesn't suit you. Why don't you stay in Royal No. 1? I'm not always in Porthampton so that villa is empty…" Connor turned to look at Freya and suggested softly.
"Ah, I usually live alone. I don't need much space at all. Besides, I'm already used to living here. This place is also very close to my company. I don't want to move..."
Freya rejected him.
"But that place should be safer. After all, it's the best neighborhood in Porthampton…" Connor said after thinking for a moment.
"It's okay. Almost everyone in Porthampton knows that I'm your girlfriend now. Besides, Carlos Lane has been following me all this time, so no one will hurt me," Freya said helplessly.
"But I still think it's a pity that no one lives in my villa…" Connor replied.
"What's there to be regretful about? If you think it's a pity, then sell it. Anyway, I won't stay there. Only country bumpkins will go back to that place to live…" Freya replied with a smirk before dragging Connor into the villa.
A moment later, Connor and Freya entered the villa.
The villa's interior was very cozy, with many pink things. The curtains, sofa, and carpet were all pink. It was obvious that Freya liked pink very much.
"Connor, rest here for a while. I'll go in and change my clothes first…"
Freya was still dressed formally. Now that she was home, she had to change into something more comfortable.
"All right, go ahead!" Connor nodded.
Freya immediately strode toward the bedroom.
After entering the bedroom, Freya immediately picked up her pajamas and started changing.
However, when Freya changed into her pajamas and looked at herself in the mirror, she suddenly felt too proactive. After all, the pajamas were very sexy and revealing. If she were alone at home, there would be no problem. However, Connor was in the living room, and Freya felt it was not appropriate to dress like this.
Hence, after hesitating, Freya changed into a tight black T-shirt and denim shorts. She then stood in front of the mirror and looked at herself carefully.
Freya was satisfied with her outfit against her long and fair legs, slender arms, and pretty face.
A few minutes later, Freya walked out of the bedroom wearing pink slippers.
When Connor saw Freya, his eyes lit up.
Freya's figure was simply the best of the best. It was as if everything was so perfect and beautiful. Connor felt that being able to find such a girlfriend was simply a blessing.
Although Connor had recently seen many beautiful women, no matter how beautiful they were, they were not as attractive as Freya in Connor's eyes.
Perhaps beauty was in the eye of the beholder!
"Why are you looking at me like that?"
Freya noticed that Connor seemed to be staring at her and asked nervously.

chapters.title: Chapter 1432: You Cook?
chapters.content:
Chapter 1432: You Cook?
At Freya's place.
Connor was stunned by Freya's words. Then, he chuckled and said, "It's nothing. I thought you looked very good today, so I took a few more glances…"
"You're a sweet talker…"
Freya couldn't help but roll her eyes at Connor. She then sat on the sofa and said softly, "It's getting late. Shouldn't you go and rest?"
"Rest?" Connor repeated. Then, he smiled and said, "Where do you plan to let me sleep tonight?"
"Where else? Of course, you'll be sleeping in the guest room…" Freya said calmly.
"You're my fiancée. Why should I sleep in the guest room? I want to sleep with you!" Connor hurriedly said.
"Dream on. I won't let you sleep with me. Although you're my fiancé, we're not really married yet!" Freya said solemnly.
"Freya, can't you make an exception for this?" Connor looked at Freya and asked pitifully.
"Make an exception?" Freya said before continuing, "All right, seeing that you're so pitiful, I'll make an exception for you…"
"How?" Connor asked excitedly.
"You can sleep with me but only on the floor, not the bed. If you think the floor in my room is more comfortable, you can also go to my room!" Freya said with a smile.
"What…" Connor looked at Freya speechlessly and mumbled, "Then forget it. I'll see myself to the guest room!"
Freya did not expect Connor to give in so quickly. She could not help but frown and said nothing else.
Connor stood up and walked toward the bedroom.
"You're in the wrong room. That's my room!" Freya saw Connor enter her bedroom and hurriedly called out.
As for Connor, he acted as if he had not heard anything. He walked straight into the bedroom and lay down on Freya's bed.
Freya's bed was very comfortable and carried a faint pleasant fragrance.
"Connor, didn't you say you wanted to go to the guest room? Why are you lying on my bed?" Freya shouted at Connor angrily.
"I think this bed in your house is quite comfortable, so I plan to sleep on this bed tonight…" Connor replied with a smile.
"No, I want to sleep on the bed. Get off now!" Freya said as she dragged Connor off the bed.
However, Freya was too weak. It was impossible for her to move Connor. Therefore, no matter how much Freya tugged at him, Connor refused to get off the bed.
"Connor, what will it take for you to come down?" Freya finally gave up after a long time. She rubbed her slender hands and asked Connor in a delicate voice.
"What will it take?" Connor looked at Freya and repeated himself, chuckling, "How about this? I'll come down after you kiss me."
"Kiss you?" When Freya heard this, her expression became a little strange. She then pursed her lips and said, "Why are you dreaming? Why should I kiss you?"
"You're my fiancée. What's wrong with kissing me? Anyway, if you don't kiss me today, I won't get out of bed. It's up to you!" Connor said to Freya with a smile.
Freya looked helpless, but after hesitating, she still kissed him with her seductively sexy, red lips.
"Aren't you being a little too perfunctory?" Connor complained.
"Are you leaving or not? If not, I'll go to the guest room instead…" Freya huffed.
Connor didn't continue lying on the bed. Instead, he stood up and said softly, "I'm a little hungry…"
"You're hungry?" Freya looked at Connor, stunned. Then, she said helplessly, "Didn't you just attend the class reunion?"
"How much can I eat at a class reunion? Besides, who would attend a class reunion for the sake of eating? I took a half-day flight to see you. I'm already starving…" Connor said helplessly.
Freya looked at Connor and hesitated before saying softly, "Then I'll go make you something to eat now…"
"You know how to cook?" Connor was stunned and asked in surprise.
"What do you mean? My culinary skills are superb. I've been learning how to cook recently. Wait here, I'll show you my skills…" Freya said with a smile.
"Well then, I look forward to your cooking…" Connor said with a smile.
"Keep yourself occupied with the TV for a bit. I'll be done soon!" Freya switched on the television in the living room and walked into the kitchen.
Who would have thought that the popular girl, Freya Phillips of Porthampton, would cook in the kitchen? One had to know that to many, a goddess like Freya would not cook. She could totally get the nanny to do it.
Of course, such a situation was not very common. After all, very few people could make Freya cook.
Connor sat on the sofa alone and casually found a TV program to watch.
"Ah!" A scream suddenly came from the kitchen.
Connor hurriedly put down the remote control and ran into the kitchen.
"Freya, what's wrong?" Connor asked Freya nervously.
"I accidentally cut my finger just now…" Freya held her right hand with her left hand and said to Connor with a pained expression.
"Is the wound deep?" Connor hurriedly ran to Freya and examined her nervously. Fortunately, the wound was not very deep and only bled a little.
Connor took the initiative to wipe away the blood on Freya's finger. Then, he tugged at Freya and said, "I'll get you wrapped up!"
"…"
Freya was surprised by Connor's series of actions and followed him to the living room.
After entering the living room, Connor found a band-aid and helped Freya bandage her wound.
"Looks like I can only cook for myself now…" Connor said helplessly to Freya.
On the other hand, Freya seemed awkward. She had never thought her first time cooking for Connor would be like this.

chapters.title: Chapter 1433: Putting It On The Agenda
chapters.content:
Chapter 1433: Putting It On The Agenda
After bandaging Freya's wound, Connor went straight to the kitchen.
However, Connor was not very good at cooking. When he had no money, Connor usually chose instant noodles, so his cooking skills were amateur at best.
"What do you plan to do with these radishes?" Connor turned to look at Freya and asked softly.
"I originally planned to make you radish stewed beef brisket…" Freya walked to Connor's side and said indifferently.
Connor was very close to Freya, so he could smell the alluring fragrance on Freya's body.
"Stewed beef brisket with radish…" Connor's eyes flashed with a trace of embarrassment, and then he said with a slightly helpless expression, "I don't know how to cook the dish you mentioned…"
"I'll just instruct you from the side…" Freya said with a smile.
"All right…" Connor nodded gently and then began to cut the radish seriously.
Freya was standing beside Connor. Although Connor had been controlling himself, he could not help but glance at Freya beside him. Especially Freya's slender, fair, and straight legs. It was as if there was some magic, making it impossible to look away.
Although Freya's T-shirt wasn't revealing, her chest was exposed. This was an irresistible temptation for Connor, who hadn't touched a woman for a long time.
Connor suppressed the urge in his heart and turned to Freya. "Freya, you're so close. Aren't you afraid that I'll drag you into the bedroom?"
"Would you?" Freya replied fiercely.
After all, Freya understood Connor's personality very well. If Freya did not agree, Connor would not force her. Therefore, Freya was not worried at all.
Connor also felt that it was better to take things as they came. If he were too anxious, it would make Freya feel disgusted.
However, the current situation was also a test of Connor's resistance. Connor could only try his best to control himself from looking at Freya and put all his energy into cooking.
Although Connor had never cooked stewed beef brisket with radish before, he had a certain foundation. Coupled with Freya's instructions, Connor quickly finished preparing this dish.
Half an hour later, Connor brought the dishes to the dining table and smiled at Freya. "Hurry up and try my cooking!"
"I shall have a good taste of it…"
Freya looked at Connor and smiled sweetly. Then, she picked up her chopsticks to pick up a piece of beef.
"Well?" Connor asked expectantly.
"I didn't expect you to be so good at cooking. Although it can't be compared to mine, it's still very delicious…" Freya said with a smile.
"If I have the chance, I must try your cooking!" Connor said as he scooped a bowl of rice for Freya, then another for himself.
"Bon appétit…" Connor sat opposite Freya and said softly to her.
Freya had been on a diet recently and would not eat at all. However, she considered that Connor had made this dish today. If she did not eat it, Connor would probably be unhappy, so she took the bowl.
When Freya saw the big bowl of rice before her, she was instantly speechless. Smiling, she said, "Connor, I'm a girl who weighs less than 100 pounds. Why did you scoop so much rice for me?"
"I want you to eat more. Otherwise, you won't be able to do serious business later!" Connor replied while eating.
"Serious business?" Freya looked at Connor, puzzled. Then, she frowned and said, "What time is it now? What other serious business do you have?"
"I specially came back to Porthampton from Newtown this time. We have been together for such a long time. I think there are some things that should be put on the agenda…" Connor said with a smile.
When Freya heard what Connor had said, she was stunned. Then, she quickly realized what Connor was talking about.
After all, Freya and Connor were both adults. Moreover, they were alone in the room. It was obvious what was going to happen next.
This time, Freya did not refute Connor. Instead, she lowered her head and started eating.
Freya was still feeling very nervous. Although she was willing to give her most precious first time to Connor, it was still her first time, so she was still a little nervous.
The atmosphere began to become a little awkward.
Freya naturally wasn't in the mood to continue eating. She whispered to Connor, "I can't eat anymore…"
"Then, leave it. I will finish it later…" Connor replied casually.
Meanwhile, Freya sat and looked at Connor before her, saying softly, "Connor, I heard your clubhouse is already open for business, and the opening ceremony went well…"
"It's all right. It's mainly because of my friends' support…" Connor replied humbly. Then, he told Freya everything that had happened recently.
After all, Connor didn't need to hide anything from Freya.
In the blink of an eye, half an hour had passed.
Connor was finally full and even took the initiative to clean up the table.
Meanwhile, Freya remained seated albeit nervous.
A few minutes later, Connor and Freya sat on the sofa.
Freya focused on the television, while Connor was a little anxious. He knew that it was better for him to take the initiative.
Connor turned to look at Freya and asked with a smile, "Freya, you're dressed so beautifully today. Did you do it on purpose?"
"Why are you so narcissistic? I usually wear this at home. You don't think I'm wearing it for you on purpose, do you?" Freya explained with a flushed face.
Connor smiled faintly and pressed Freya's hands onto the sofa.
They were in a particularly questionable position. Freya could even hear Connor's breathing, so her heart was beating faster.
After all, no one could remain calm under such circumstances.

chapters.title: Chapter 1434: I'm Going to Take a Shower
chapters.content:
Chapter 1434: I'm Going to Take a Shower
"Connor, what... what are you doing?"
Freya, pressed down on the sofa by Connor, had an unusually nervous expression on her face, completely devoid of her usual unapproachable and aloof demeanor.
After all, no matter how distant and unapproachable she seemed on the outside, she was ultimately a woman. She would ultimately submit to a man.
"What do you think I'm doing?"
Connor replied with a cheerful smile.
"This isn't allowed..."
Freya struggled a bit and exclaimed with a soft voice.
"You're my fiancée, why wouldn't it be allowed?"
He smiled and shifted his gaze to her enticing legs.
Her slender, fair legs were particularly alluring.
Curious about the sensation of these long legs, Connor placed his right hand on her legs.
This was the first intimate contact between them.
As his right hand touched her long legs, she felt as though she had been electrified. After all, she had never had such intimate contact with the opposite sex from childhood to adulthood. This was the first time she had such a strange sensation.
"Connor, let go of me quickly!"
She instinctively shouted.
But he had no intention of letting go of such a good opportunity. He naturally didn't want to release his hold.
Of course, this situation couldn't entirely be blamed on him. After all, being in such close proximity with her, a stunning beauty, and knowing that she was his fiancée, even a normal man might struggle to control his emotions. So, his actions were quite normal in this regard.
Connor's right hand began to move upward, and Freya's resistance seemed to increase.
"Connor, let go of me!"
She forcefully pushed him away.
He quickly stopped his actions and asked her in a soft voice, "Don't you want to?"
"I..."
She looked at him, unsure of how to answer his question. The sensation from a moment ago had felt very strange, and now her body was completely weak. Despite this, she still instinctively wanted to refuse.
"I just feel that something's strange here..."
She whispered.
"Something's strange?"
He was taken aback for a moment and then smiled, saying, "Then let me take you to the bedroom..."
"No need, let me calm down for a moment. I'm really not ready yet. Could you give me some more time?"
She blushed, speaking softly to him.
She hadn't mentally prepared herself for this situation. After all, everything had happened so suddenly.
"Then give me a kiss again!"
His expression was helpless as he spoke to Freya.
"Alright!"
Thinking that he was giving up, she quickly agreed and leaned in to kiss his face.
But just at that moment, he reached out and pulled her into his arms. He then lowered his head and kissed her sensuous, rosy lips.
"Mmm..."
Freya instinctively struggled for a moment, but her strength was no match for Connor's.
So, he soon succeeded.
The two embraced in a kiss. At the beginning, her movements were still somewhat awkward, but soon she adapted to the sensation and even responded to his advances.
After a few minutes, he began to undress her.
"Connor, I'll take a shower first..."
At this point, she seemed to have prepared herself. She spoke softly to Connor.
"At a time like this, you still want to shower?" he said with exasperation.
"Why are you in such a hurry? I'll be quick..."
Freya directly pushed Connor away and then, with her bare feet, ran into the bathroom.
She had already mentally prepared herself for this and planned to clean herself up before offering herself to him.
Connor, however, was anxious, sitting on the sofa and waiting.
"Freya, hurry up!" he shouted toward the bathroom.
"Alright..." she chuckled softly in response.
After about twenty minutes, she finally emerged from the bathroom.
Now, she was draped in a white towel, her entire body was a vision of beauty, as enticing as a lotus emerging from water.
Connor, who had suppressed his emotions for so long, was finally releasing them. He rushed over to Freya, lifted her up, and carried her to the bedroom. Then, he passionately removed his own clothes and pounced on her.
However, just as he reached out to remove the towel from her body, she easily evaded him.
After all, Freya had been practicing yoga since she was young, and her body's flexibility was exceptional. She used her foot to push against his chest and softly said, "Connor, if you touch me today, you'll become my man. I don't care about what happened between you and other women before, but from the moment you remove my clothes, you can never betray me again. Do you understand what I mean?"
"I understand..."
Without hesitation, he nodded.
Clearly, Freya had some understanding of what had transpired between Connor and other women, but now she had decided not to dwell on those things anymore. After all, she was well aware of the numerous temptations around Connor, and she would soon be leaving the country.
Her words indicated that she was willing to forgive him for his past actions, but she wouldn't tolerate any more occurrences in the future.
"Come on..."
Freya's voice was gentle as she spoke, then she closed her eyes tightly.

chapters.title: Chapter 1435: I Won't Let You Succeed
chapters.content:
Chapter 1435: I Won't Let You Succeed
Inside the villa.
Both Connor and Freya were emotionally involved, as if everything was proceeding according to Connor's plan.
He was finally about to fulfill his initial dream – getting Freya was something he had yearned for.
But just as he was about to unbutton, something happened that he hadn't anticipated.
"Connor..."
Suddenly, she reached out and pushed him forcefully.
"What's wrong?"
He looked puzzled, furrowing his brows as he asked her.
"I think I saw a car entering my yard just now..."
Her tone was nervous as she shouted at him.
"Someone drove into your yard?"
His expression showed a hint of resignation upon hearing this. He then said in a low voice, "Don't joke around. It's already past one in the morning. No one would come now..."
Freya subconsciously glanced toward the bedroom window, seeming to find nothing unusual, and said softly, "Then, pull the curtains shut..."
"Alright..."
He nodded and quickly got out of bed to close the curtains.
"Ding dong... Ding dong!"
However, as he was about to get out of bed, the doorbell suddenly rang.
Upon hearing the doorbell, he froze in place. His expression was one of disbelief.
Because he never expected that at this moment, someone would actually come looking for Freya!
"Who's coming to find you at such hours?"
Connor turned his head and glanced at her, his tone filled with despair.
"I don't know either. Hurry and put on some clothes..."
At this point, she was also completely flustered. Her tone was urgent as she shouted at him.
He instinctively cast a glance at her enticing figure. Though he was reluctant, there was no choice. With the doorbell continuously ringing outside, he had to put on his clothes.
All of Freya's clothes were in the closet. Therefore, she had to get out of bed, rush to the closet, and shout at Connor, "Connor, you go answer the door. Buy me some time..."
"Fine..."
Connor's heart was still filled with despair. Even in this desperate situation, he had no choice. He put on his clothes and walked towards the villa's front door.
At this point, Connor only had one thought in his mind – the moment he opened the door, he would give the other person a good beating.
After all, he was about to achieve his goal, but it had been ruined by this unexpected arrival. How could Connor not be angry?
A few seconds later, Connor arrived at the door and reached out to open it.
However, as soon as Connor opened the door, he froze in place, his expression one of utter disbelief.
Because standing before him was none other than Freya's cousin, Maya.
Connor looked at her slightly triumphant face, and his expression was filled with astonishment.
"Connor, you haven't gone to bed yet?"
She asked with a smile.
Connor hesitated for a moment. He didn't want Maya's appearance to ruin his plans for the night. So, he dragged her outside and asked in a low voice, "Why are you here so late?"
"What are you doing?"
She didn't directly answer his question. Instead, she responded with a smile and a question of her own.
"It's none of your business what I'm doing. Freya and I were both planning to rest. If you have any sense, go back quickly..."
Connor shouted at Maya in a hushed voice.
"Haha, I guessed right..."
Seeing him so flustered, she laughed joyfully and continued, "I had actually already arrived home today. But then, I suddenly remembered that my cousin might not be safe with you. So, I came here to protect her. Were you planning to do something bad to my cousin just now?"
"You..."
Connor was rendered speechless by her words. He suddenly realized that she had deliberately done this.
"I am Freya's fiancé. What we do has nothing to do with you."
Connor's expression turned angry as he shouted at Maya.
"You said it yourself, you're her fiancé. You two aren't married yet. Moreover, you're a womanizer who has been fooling around with other women. So, I won't let you succeed. While I'm in Porthampton, I'll be staying at my cousin's house. You won't have any chance..."
Connor looked at Maya, at a loss for words.
"Maya, I know that there has been a small misunderstanding between us, but it's been a long time. Besides, you know how much I've sacrificed for your cousin. Is this really necessary?"
Connor spoke to Maya with a stern expression.
"But what does your womanizing behavior have to do with me? Have you explained things with Yelena? Have you explained things with Chloe?"
Maya confronted him aggressively.
"Well..."
He looked at her, his expression revealing surprise.
He hadn't expected her to be so well-informed about his affairs.
"If you haven't explained things with those women, then don't touch my cousin. What if you decide to abandon her later? You men are all the same. I have to protect my cousin!"
Maya continued to speak after seeing Connor left speechless.
"Big sister, what do you want in order to leave?"
Connor asked Maya helplessly.
"Stop dreaming. I won't leave no matter what. I won't let you succeed..."
Maya said with a smile.
"If you have any suggestions, just let me know. As long as it's within my capabilities, I'll satisfy you. Is that not enough?"
Through gritted teeth, Connor said softly.
"Connor, I advise you to be honest. This approach won't work on me. I'm not like other people. I'm not short of money, so you can't threaten me!"
After saying this, Maya directly pushed Connor away and walked into the villa.
Connor helplessly watched Maya's retreating figure. His mood was extremely frustrated because he didn't know what he had done to offend her.
"Cousin, where are you? Cousin, what are you doing?"
Maya shouted sweetly.

chapters.title: Chapter 1436: Visiting Jorge
chapters.content:
Chapter 1436: Visiting Jorge
After entering the villa, Maya started looking for Freya everywhere.
"Maya, why did you come?"
Freya emerged from the bedroom after changing her clothes, looking surprised at Maya.
She had just changed her clothes, her face was slightly flushed, and her bath towel was still visible in the bedroom. Maya was well aware of the situation.
"Cousin, did that jerk Connor bully you just now?"
Maya ran up to Freya, her expression agitated as she asked.
"Bully me?"
Freya was momentarily stunned by Maya's words, then embarrassedly smiled and said softly, "Maya, what nonsense are you talking about? How could Connor possibly bully me? We were both planning to rest..."
"Cousin, don't lie to me. Don't think I don't know. You two were definitely up to no good just now, right?"
Maya asked directly.
Freya was left speechless by Maya's question. Her expression showed extreme awkwardness.
"Did I guess right?"
Maya asked with a smile when she saw Freya's silence.
"Cousin, what brings you here so late?"
Freya asked, somewhat helpless.
"I don't have any specific reason. I was just worried that that big womanizer, Connor, might have done something to you. So, I'm here to protect you tonight. Let's go to sleep, Cousin!"
After saying this, Maya dragged Freya toward the bedroom.
With a helpless look at Connor, Freya followed Maya into the bedroom.
He was left standing alone, his expression one of utter frustration.
Maya smirked at him before leading Freya into the bedroom.
He understood that she probably had no intention of leaving today. He knew he had to wait and find the right opportunity.
The next morning, at eight o'clock.
Connor woke up to find Freya had already prepared breakfast.
While having breakfast, he kept stealing glances at Maya. He knew Maya was a student and wouldn't stay at home all the time. Once she left, he could finally do whatever he wanted.
"Cousin, I'm done. Can you take me to school?"
Maya put down her chopsticks and smiled at Freya.
"Sure, I'll drive you there!"
Freya nodded gently.
Connor's excitement grew. Once Maya was gone, he and Freya could finally be alone.
"Or I can drive her to school!"
After thinking for a moment, he suggested.
"No need. After I drop Maya off, I can head to the company..." she explained.
He was surprised by this. "You're going to work today?"
"Yes, our company is in talks with a few others about investments. I have to personally meet with them. If not for you, I wouldn't have chosen to work with foreigners. Once the domestic investment companies found out you're my boyfriend, they were eager to give money..." she explained in a hushed tone.
"You should've told me about needing funds. I can invest in your company!"
He quickly offered.
"My cousin doesn't need your dirty money. She wants to build this company on her own. If not for you, my cousin wouldn't have chosen to cooperate with foreigners. The domestic investment companies want to give money because they know you're her boyfriend. It's all about exchanging money for favors. I don't like that kind of collaboration. So, I found some foreign investment companies..."
Maya pouted.
"Isn't it good if someone gives you money?" he asked helplessly.
"There's no such thing as a free lunch. They're giving me money for a reason. Either they want to meet you or they want you to do something. Basically, they're using money to buy influence. I don't like that kind of cooperation. That's why I've chosen a few foreign investment companies..."
Freya explained softly.
"I see..."
Connor nodded, not saying much.
He understood that Freya didn't want to complicate things with him.
"Alright, it's getting late. Let's go, Cousin!"
Maya urged when she realized she was going to be late for school.
"Okay!"
Freya nodded and then said to Connor, "If you're bored at home, you can meet up with your friends and have a meal. I'll be back after meeting with the clients..."
"Alright, you go ahead!"
Although Connor wanted to keep Freya, he couldn't find a good reason, so he could only agree.
A little while later, Freya and Maya left.
Now, the empty villa was left with only Connor.
With nothing else to do, he tidied up the villa a bit and then took a taxi to Jorge's house.
...
Although it had been a while since he had visited Jorge, he found Jorge lazily lying on a chair, basking in the sun.
If not for all that had happened, he wouldn't have believed that the greedy old man in front of him was the same person who once dominated a whole area of Oprana with his martial prowess.
"Old man, how have you been lately?"
Connor approached with a smile.
"When you need me, you call me 'Master,' but when you don't need me, you call me 'old man'..."
Jorge slowly opened his eyes and looked at him.
"Isn't it more friendly to call you 'old man' when I feel like it?"
Connor grinned.
"Have you been practicing your martial arts?"
Jorge asked as he looked at Connor.
"Yes, I've been practicing. I've almost mastered the 'Seven-Star Big Dipper Fist' you gave me. I just can't seem to get the last move right. That's why I'm here to ask you today. I followed the instructions in the book, but I can't seem to achieve any effect. Why is that?"
Connor crouched down, playing with Jabba while asking his question.
"The final move of this martial art requires you to comprehend it during actual combat. Even if I guide you now, you won't be able to grasp it properly. Moreover, different people have different aptitudes, so the effect of comprehending the final move varies greatly..."
Jorge explained in his calm manner.

chapters.title: Chapter 1437: Chi Circulation Scroll
chapters.content:
Chapter 1437: Chi Circulation Scroll
Connor's expression became somewhat surprised upon hearing Jorge's words. He hadn't expected the 'Seven-Star Big Dipper Fist' to be so magical, capable of adapting to the user's individuality.
"It's a pity that there are so few martial artists nowadays. I can't find suitable opponents!"
Connor looked at Jorge with a touch of regret.
"You're encountering few martial artists now because you haven't fully entered the world of ancient martial arts. If one day you can truly experience the world of ancient martial arts, you'll realize that there are actually many martial artists in this world!"
Jorge's tone remained calm.
"That's true!"
Connor nodded in agreement.
In fact, Connor had thought about this. When he attended the ancient martial arts gathering, he encountered many martial artists. However, they seemed scarce when compared to the general population.
"Earlier, you mentioned that you've been practicing martial arts lately. How about sparring with Jabba? I want to see how much you've improved."
Jorge suggested, his voice calm.
"Start right away?"
Connor asked in a helpless tone.
"Is there a problem?"
Jorge countered.
Connor glanced at Jabba, sighed helplessly, and said softly, "Fine, since you want to see, let's give it a try!"
Upon hearing Connor's words, Jabba immediately pounced at him.
He wasn't prepared and was sent flying by Jabba's punch.
"What the heck, can't this gorilla follow any rules? I didn't say I was ready, why did it attack?"
He exclaimed with a bewildered expression.
Jabba grinned and bared its teeth at him before charging at him again.
This time, he was prepared and easily dodged Jabba's attack.
They engaged in a back-and-forth battle in the courtyard for almost half an hour. In the end, he was defeated by Jabba.
"Why is Jabba so abnormal? I couldn't beat him before, and now I'm still losing. What's going on?"
He looked puzzled and turned to Jorge for an explanation.
"During your sparring just now, Jabba was only using about thirty percent of its strength. In the past, it was probably using even less, around ten percent. This is why you could hold your ground against it for a few rounds but still end up losing."
Jorge explained calmly.
"Only thirty percent?"
Connor was dumbfounded by Jorge's words, his expression filled with disbelief.
"That's right, just thirty percent."
Jorge nodded gently.
"Jabba is actually this powerful? It only used thirty percent of its strength and yet it could defeat me like this?"
Connor looked at Jabba beside him, his eyes filled with astonishment. He hadn't expected Jabba's strength to be so terrifying.
"Jabba's strength is probably at the level of a Black-rank martial artist. So, there's still quite a gap between you and Jabba."
Jorge stated matter-of-factly.
"What level am I at now?"
Connor hurriedly asked.
