"Currently, you're probably at the mid-level of the Yellow Realm. You've made progress compared to before, but your improvement is still slow..."
Jorge's tone held a touch of disdain.
"Do you have any way to help me improve faster? You've managed to make Jabba so powerful!"
Connor asked eagerly.
Jorge glanced at Connor and then said softly, "There's no shortcut in cultivating. I can't help you right now..."
Connor looked at Jorge, realizing that Jorge probably had some method in mind but was unwilling to teach him at the moment.
"Now that you've finished practicing the 'Seven-Star Big Dipper Fist,' you can focus on practicing this 'Chi Circulation Scroll' next!"
While speaking, Jorge took out a manual and handed it to Connor.
Connor glanced at the manual and saw that it contained various techniques related to manipulating one's internal energy.
"A martial artist, besides having a different level of physical strength compared to regular people, also possesses the ability to control and utilize the energy within their body during combat. Every martial artist's Chi Circulation Scroll is different, but harnessing one's energy is the most critical aspect. Lower-level martial artists might rely on physical strength and reflexes, while powerful martial artists utilize their energy effectively in battle."
Jorge paused for a moment and continued, "This Chi Circulation Scroll' is the method I learned for manipulating energy. You can focus on learning how to control your energy next."
"Sure, I'll give it a try!"
Connor nodded.
"If you don't have anything else, you can leave now."
Jorge seemed to want Connor to leave and said straightforwardly.
"Um, there's one more thing I want to ask you..."
Connor spoke up.
"What is it?"
"I heard from people in Santon that you're the leader of some 'Purple Cloud Sect.' What exactly is this Purple Cloud Sect?"
Connor asked in a puzzled tone.
"The Purple Cloud Sect is simply the name of an ancient martial arts sect. My master was the previous leader, and after he passed away, I inherited his position."
Jorge explained.
"Since you're the leader of a sect, why aren't you staying in the Purple Cloud Sect? Don't you have any responsibilities?"
Connor continued to inquire.
"I'm not particularly interested in managing the sect. When I was young, I traveled around a lot. Now that I'm older, I've settled in Porthampton. Although the city is noisy, few people here know me. I don't want to be bothered by trivial matters."
Jorge paused for a moment and continued, "Currently, my senior brother is managing the Purple Cloud Sect. When I pass away, you'll be the one to inherit the position of the sect leader."
"Me?"
Connor was stunned by Jorge's words.
"Yes, that's the tradition of the Purple Cloud Sect. My master passed it to me, and I'll pass it to you after my time comes."
Jorge nodded at Connor.
"However, I'm not very interested in your Purple Cloud Sect, and I don't want to associate with the people in the ancient martial arts world. You should find someone else to pass on this position."
Connor immediately declined without hesitation.

chapters.title: Chapter 1438: The Three Great Sects
chapters.content:
Chapter 1438: The Three Great Sects
Jorge couldn't help but stroke his beard and then said softly, "I only have you as my disciple, so you're the only one who can inherit this position."
"Can't you go find another disciple?"
Connor asked with a somewhat exasperated expression.
"I never had the intention of taking on more disciples from the start. After all, if my disciples are all as foolish as you, it would become a joke in the world of ancient martial arts!"
Jorge disregarded Connor's feelings and calmly replied.
Connor's expression became even more speechless upon hearing this. Jorge was openly mocking him, and he couldn't find any reason to refute him.
"You don't need to worry too much about this. While you'll be the future leader of the Purple Cloud Sect, it doesn't mean you have to manage the sect. Just like me, you can delegate those responsibilities to others!"
Jorge looked up at him and calmly suggested.
"That's an option?" He seemed surprised.
"Of course. When you inherit my position in the future, you'll be the leader of the Purple Cloud Sect. At that time, you'll have the final say in the sect's matters, and you can manage it as you see fit." Jorge said calmly.
Connor's expression relaxed a bit upon hearing his words. After all, he had no interest in the Purple Cloud Sect or the affairs of the ancient martial arts world. He didn't want to become a sect leader.
"By the way, there's something else I want to remind you of..."
Jorge continued to speak.
"What is it?" he asked.
"Because of what happened in Santon last time, many people in the world of ancient martial arts now know that you're the future leader of the Purple Cloud Sect. This has its advantages, but also some disadvantages."
Jorge spoke slowly.
"What advantages?"
Connor asked, puzzled.
"Looking at the entire Oprana, the Purple Cloud Sect is one of the top sects. It also bears the responsibility of maintaining the order of ancient martial arts. So, in the eyes of martial artists, your status will be quite high. Even if someone's strength surpasses yours, they wouldn't easily offend you if they know you're the future leader of the Purple Cloud Sect..."
Jorge explained.
"That does sound like a good thing!"
Connor nodded, then continued, "What about the disadvantages you mentioned?"
"As I mentioned, there are four major sects responsible for maintaining the order of ancient martial arts in Oprana. Besides the Purple Cloud Sect, there are the Snow Moon Sect, Heavenly Sect, and the Profound Sect."
Jorge paused for a moment and continued, "While these four sects seem to have good relations on the surface, they've always been vying for power and scheming behind the scenes. There used to be seven major sects a hundred years ago, but now only four remain. The other three have been assimilated..."
Jorge looked at Connor.
Upon hearing this, he seemed to understand what Jorge was implying.
"Are you saying that these other three sects might come after me?"
Connor asked, his expression a mix of frustration and anger.
"There's a possibility. I'm telling you this so you'll be cautious around members of these three sects."
Jorge nodded at him.
"I knew you wouldn't have any good intentions!"
Connor suddenly stood up, his expression filled with anger as he yelled at Jorge.
"Because you needed my help, that's why I had the opportunity to scheme against you."
Jorge responded with a smile.
"I don't want to hear your explanations. I have no connection with your so-called Purple Cloud Sect, and I'm definitely not your future sect leader. Go find someone else for that role. I'm leaving!"
Connor didn't want to continue discussing this topic with Jorge. He walked out in frustration.
At this moment, Connor was deeply regretting coming to seek Jorge's guidance. If he hadn't come, he wouldn't have known about all these complications.
He already had enough troubles on his plate, and he didn't want to be distracted by these matters.
Jorge watched his departing figure with a smile. He understood that some things weren't as easy to avoid as Connor hoped. As he had said earlier, some things were destined from the very beginning.

chapters.title: Chapter 1439: Brothers Forever
chapters.content:
Chapter 1439: Brothers Forever
After leaving Jorge's place, Connor called Freya.
However, she didn't answer the call, probably because she was in a meeting.
Connor understood that his identity had brought significant pressure to Freya. This was also why she hoped to manage her company without relying on his connections. So, he didn't want to disturb her.
After some thought, he decided to call Dominic.
Connor didn't have many friends in Porthampton, and the only ones he could think of were Dominic and his friend with Spencer.
"Dom, what are you up to?"
Connor asked cheerfully after he answered the call.
"What special occasion is it today that you're actually calling me?"
Dominic responded with surprise.
"Well, look at how you're saying that. Can't I call you?"
Connor playfully retorted.
"I thought you had forgotten about me and Spencer..."
Dominic said in a slightly annoyed tone.
"I've been busy lately, and I've been in Newtown all this time. That's why I haven't been in touch with you guys. What are you and Spencer up to now? Want to meet up?"
Connor said somewhat apologetically.
"We're in class..."
Dominic replied.
"Alright, I got it. I'll come to the school to see you two now!"
Connor replied casually and then hung up the phone.
After ending the call, he hailed a taxi and headed toward Porthampton University.
Considering his limited number of friends, Dominic and his friend with Spencer were among the few he could think of. He had already decided that once Dominic and Spencer graduated, he would directly arrange for them to work at Empire World Corporation. With his support, they would surely achieve great success there.
If Dominic and Spencer hadn't met him, they might still be ordinary individuals.
Half an hour later, he arrived at Porthampton University in a taxi.
Since most students were still in class, there weren't many people on the campus grounds.
He looked around at the campus scenery, reflecting on his memories. He had experienced so much at this university, many of them painful. He chuckled at how he used to consider those events so significant, realizing now how trivial they were.
Money truly had the power to change many things, including his life. If Connor hadn't inherited Steven's fortune, he might still be looked down upon as a poor nobody.
If the university's principal knew Connor had returned, he would probably personally welcome him. After all, Connor's name was well-known throughout the city.
He strolled around the campus for about ten minutes until Dominic and his friend with Spencer finished their classes.
"Connor, you remember to visit us?"
Dominic rushed up to Connor, punched his chest playfully, and exclaimed with a smile, "I thought you forgot about us!"
"How could I forget you guys?"
Connor replied with a smile.
"Are you treating us to a meal?"
Dominic asked.
"Order whatever you want, I won't hold back."
Connor said generously.
"Great, we won't be polite then. You're not short on money these days, so we'll enjoy ourselves to the fullest!"
Spencer chimed in.
"There's a new Sichuan restaurant nearby. Their food is excellent. Let's give it a try!"
Dominic suggested.
"Sure!"
Connor agreed readily.
Spencer and Dominic treated Connor just as they used to. Their attitudes toward him hadn't changed much, as if they still saw him as the same old Connor.
Dominic draped an arm around Connor's shoulder, leading him out of the campus toward the suggested restaurant.
...
Meanwhile, at Porthampton Medical University's music room.
Inside the music room, there were only two people present. One was a beautiful girl in a spaghetti strap dress, delicate and fair-skinned, with a figure that was alluring.
Beside her sat a young man in a black suit, also very handsome with an extraordinary demeanor. He wore a gentle smile and gazed at the girl with an indulgent look.
The girl was none other than Maya.
Maya placed her violin on her shoulder, took a deep breath, turned to the young man, and whispered, "I'll give you one more chance..."
"Alright..."
The young man in the suit looked somewhat embarrassed and replied in a low voice.
Maya shook her head in disappointment at his response, then began to play her violin.
After a moment, the captivating sound of music filled the room.
However, not long after, Maya stopped playing, placing her violin aside with a helpless expression.
The young man also looked awkward, unsure of what to say.
"Maya, how's your collaboration with Juno going?"
Just then, an elderly woman entered the music room with a smile and asked Maya.
In a few days, Porthampton University, Porthampton Medical University, and Porthampton Institute of Technology would hold a joint school celebration. The three schools attached great importance to this event.
Porthampton Medical University had prepared several performances, and the most important one was Maya's violin performance.
Given Maya's exceptional musical talent, she had won a first prize in a national violin competition. However, performing a solo piece might seem too one-sided. Therefore, Porthampton Medical University had planned to pair her with a pianist for a violin and piano duet, which would create a better effect.
Maya had chosen the world-renowned piece 'Melody of the Night' for her performance.
What she hadn't expected was that, even with the whole school considered, they couldn't find a suitable pianist to pair with her.

chapters.title: Chapter 1440: The Right Person
chapters.content:
Chapter 1440: The Right Person
Melody of the Night was a renowned piece in the world of piano music.
Because the performance of this song was very difficult, and it was to performed with Maya, this increased the requirements for the collaborator.
That was why she was so angry now. There was no one in such a big school who could work with her.
Recently, she had collaborated with several people, but the results were not very good. The originally beautiful song gave off a very strange feeling. If it was just the anniversary celebration of the medical school, she might not be so serious. However, this year's anniversary celebration was attended by all the universities in Porthampton. If they were to embarrass themselves, the entire medical school would lose face.
"Could you leave for a moment?"
The teacher turned to the young man and said softly.
"Sure, Mr. Joudan."
The young man nodded and walked out of the music room in resignation.
After the young man left, Maya sat on the couch, pouted, and said, "Mr. Joudan, what kind of people are you finding for me? These people's piano skills are so poor that they can't achieve the effect I want..."
"Maya, don't worry. I'll help you find someone suitable."
Mr. Joudan also seemed quite helpless. He had originally planned for Maya's performance to be the grand finale. But things had turned out like this.
"It's only a few days away from the celebration. There's no time left!"
Maya sighed helplessly and continued, "Mr. Joudan, maybe we should just cancel this performance. I'm not in the right shape now, and even if I go on stage, I'll only embarrass our school. It's really not necessary..."
"But I've already submitted your performance for approval. It can't be canceled now..."
Mr. Joudan hurriedly explained.
"What should we do then?"
She looked at Mr. Joudan, feeling at a loss about what to do.
He hesitated for a moment and said softly, "Maya, don't worry. I'm trying to find suitable candidates for you. Meanwhile, think if you know any skilled pianists. If we really can't find anyone, we can still do a solo performance. Your skill is impeccable!"
"I guess that's the only option now..."
Seeing that he seemed reluctant to cancel the performance, she reluctantly agreed.
"Then practice by yourself for now. I'll find the right candidate for you!"
Mr. Joudan smiled at her, then turned and left the music room.
Taking a deep breath after Mr. Joudan left, Maya's delicate face was full of helplessness. She started to think about who among her acquaintances might play the piano well.
"Priscilla is pretty good at the piano. Maybe I can ask her to try!"
Maya suddenly remembered that Priscilla loved playing the piano. She quickly took out her phone and dialed Priscilla's number.
After a few rings, she answered the call.
"What's up, Maya?" Priscilla asked softly.
"Priscilla, I need a big favor..."
Maya pleaded.
"What favor do you need?" Priscilla asked, puzzled.
"Here's the situation, in three days, our city's three universities are holding a joint celebration. It's a triennial event, and our school attaches great importance to it. They want me to perform in a program."
Maya explained slowly.
"Isn't that a good thing? How can I help?" She was confused.
"I'm supposed to perform a violin and piano duet, but I haven't found the right pianist. Everyone from our school is so incompetent. They probably can't even play a complete 'Melody of the Night.' I remember you can play the piano. Maybe you could help me?"
Maya pleaded.
"Maya, you're kidding, right? I haven't played the piano for a long time. I might be even worse than your schoolmates now!"
Priscilla sounded helpless.
"Don't be modest, Priscilla. I know your skill. Even if you haven't played the piano for half a year, you're still much better than those fools from my school."
Maya insisted.
"If you wanted me to play a different piece, I might consider it, but 'Melody of the Night' is too difficult. I won't be able to play it well with my current level!"
Priscilla declined once more.
After hesitating for a moment, Maya whispered, "Priscilla, are you refusing to help me?"
"Maya, don't say that. I would definitely help you if I could, but honestly, I can't be of much help right now."
Priscilla laughed.
"Well..."
Maya reluctantly agreed, then continued, "Priscilla, you love playing the piano so much. Do you know anyone skilled in piano?"
"Skilled at the piano?"
She hesitated for a moment upon hearing the question. Then she chuckled and said, "Maya, I actually know a suitable candidate..."
"Who?"
Maya eagerly asked.
"I won't tell you. I'll contact him and bring him to you!"
Priscilla said with a smile.
"Priscilla, I love you so much! I'll be at our school today. When you're ready, just bring him to me!"
Maya exclaimed happily.
"Sure, wait for my call!"
Priscilla replied briefly and hung up the phone.
...
On the other side, Connor, who was having dinner with Dominic and Spencer, suddenly received a call from Priscilla.
Connor knew that she wouldn't call him without a reason, so he immediately answered the call.
"Priscilla, what's up?" he asked cheerfully.
"Connor, do you have some free time now? I need a favor." she said directly.
"I'm having dinner with my friends right now. Is it something urgent?"
He pondered for a moment before responding.
"It's not that urgent. Finish your meal and call me back. I'll pick you up later." she replied.
"Alright." he agreed and hung up the phone.

chapters.title: Chapter 1441: Perfect Cooperation
chapters.content:
Chapter 1441: Perfect Cooperation
About half an hour later, Connor, Dominic and Spencer finished their meal. As Dominic had to return to school for classes, they headed back to campus right away.
Considering Connor's plan to stay a few more days in Porthampton, he knew he could always catch up with them.
After they left, Connor dialed Priscilla's number on his phone.
"Hey, Priscilla, I'm done here. Should I come over to meet you?" he asked in a hushed tone.
"No need for you to come to me. I'll come pick you up!" she replied promptly.
"Alright then. I'm currently near Porthampton University!" Connor informed Priscilla of his location and hung up the call.
Around ten minutes later, she pulled up in her newly acquired white sports car in front of him. She called out, "Connor, get in!"
With a resigned expression, he opened the passenger door and got into the car.
She started the engine as soon as he was seated.
"Hey, Priscilla, where are you taking me?" Connor furrowed his brows, looking puzzled, and asked.
"You'll find out soon enough!" she replied, sidestepping his question.
"But seriously, where are we going?" He persisted, gazing at her.
"I can't tell you just yet. Don't worry, we'll get there soon enough!" She smiled.
Exasperated, Connor gave Priscilla a helpless look, realizing he probably wouldn't get any more answers.
About five minutes later, Priscilla's BMW entered the campus of the Medical School.
As Connor saw himself being led to Porthampton Medical School by Priscilla, his expression became even more perplexed. He had no clue why Priscilla had brought him here.
...
Meanwhile, inside a music room.
Maya was practicing the violin quietly on her own, but for some reason, she felt increasingly restless. After a while, she couldn't bear it any longer and decided to put down the violin and leave.
Just then, Mr. Joudan walked into the music room with a young man.
The young man was exceptionally handsome, exuding an air of uniqueness. A glance was enough to tell that he was no ordinary person.
Maya sized him up and recognized him as Chris Patell.
Chris wasn't just handsome and good-looking; he also excelled academically, always ranking at the top. He was skilled in both basketball and soccer. Furthermore, being the nephew of the Medical School's dean and the son of a well-known local businessman, his family background and personal circumstances were exceptional.
Due to his outstanding qualities, both in terms of his family background and personal attributes, Chris was highly popular within the school. Many girls admired him.
In the past, Chris had confessed his feelings to Maya, but she didn't share the same sentiment and had rejected him outright.
As for Freya, her popularity in school was beyond measure. Her striking beauty combined with the formidable influence of the Phillips family made her a magnet for secret admirers and pursuers. If the two of them were to perform together during the school celebration, it would undoubtedly become an enchanting tale.
She felt puzzled because while she knew Chris was athletically talented, she had never heard that he could play the piano.
"Mr. Joudan, is he the one you brought for me?" Maya turned to Mr. Joudan, her voice full of doubt.
"Yes, Chris just returned from the U.S. I called him over as soon as he landed. His piano skills are quite impressive. If you two collaborate, the effect will undoubtedly be remarkable..." Mr. Joudan explained with a cheerful smile.
Maya sized up Chris once more, her expression indifferent as she said, "Do you really know how to play the piano? If not, don't embarrass yourself. Do whatever suits you!"
Maya had always been straightforward in her speech and demeanor.
He didn't seem offended at all. He understood well enough that Maya's background was daunting. Even in the entire Porthampton, the last person one should provoke was someone from the Lin family.
He had his own motives for getting close to her. He was aware of the connection between Maya and Connor. If he managed to win her over, it would undoubtedly greatly assist him in the future. However, he also realized that pursuing her wasn't an easy task. She had always been doted on, and all kinds of men would fawn over her.
He had confessed his feelings to her several times before, but she had turned him down each time.
Originally, he had planned to stay carefree in the U.S. for some time. However, upon learning that she needed a partner for a collaboration, he had flown back to Oprana with the intention of seizing this opportunity.
He knew that if he managed to grasp this chance, he would likely have more opportunities to spend time alone with Maya in the future.
"Maya, Chris's piano skills are truly quite impressive. I think you two should give it a try!" Mr. Joudan suggested to Maya.
Maya hesitated for a moment, then said lightly, "Since you say so, Mr. Joudan, let's give it a try."
After uttering those words, Maya picked up her violin, while Chris took his seat at the piano.
Moments later, the melodious sound of the piano accompanied the violin, filling the room.
Maya hadn't held high hopes for this collaboration initially.
However, as time passed, her expression shifted from indifference to surprise. She hadn't expected his piano skills to be quite decent, at least far superior to the students she had encountered before.
With this realization, she started to take the collaboration more seriously.
A few minutes later, the music finally came to a gentle stop.
Mr. Joudan clapped excitedly and beamed at her, "Maya, your coordination was simply perfect!"
Upon hearing Mr. Joudan's words, a trace of astonishment flickered in Maya's eyes.

chapters.title: Chapter 1442: Why Did You Bring Connor?
chapters.content:
Chapter 1442: Why Did You Bring Connor?
Although the duet between Maya and Chris just now could be considered as one of Maya's best performances to date, for some reason, she felt that something was lacking.
Chris's piano skills were indeed impressive, surpassing those of ordinary students by a large margin. However, there was still a considerable gap between his performance and her expectations.
She was fully aware that she didn't have many options left. If even he wasn't suitable, she might end up performing solo. However, the nocturnal symphony required a duet to sound its best. A solo performance would inevitably feel somewhat thin.
Chris stood up and walked over to Maya. He softly asked, "Miss Maya, how do you think I played just now? Can we collaborate?"
"Your performance was decent, but some of the details weren't handled very well. You still need more practice," she responded, despite her dissatisfaction.
Although she wasn't satisfied, she had no other choice at the moment.
"Maya, are you planning to collaborate with Chris?" Mr. Joudan asked excitedly.
Maya's expression seemed somewhat helpless as she replied, "Given that none of the male students in our school play as well as Chris, I have no choice but to collaborate with him..."
"Alright, I'll head back now. You two work together and I'm sure you'll dazzle the audience!" Mr. Joudan said with a smile.
Seeing Mr. Joudan about to leave, she quickly spoke up, "Wait, sir. I contacted my friend just now, and she said she's bringing someone over. I want you to see that person's skill level."
"Why not just collaborate with Chris?" Mr. Joudan's patience seemed to be running thin.
"I'll make a call and check." She reluctantly pulled out her phone to call Priscilla.
Just as she was about to make the call, her phone suddenly rang. It was a call from Priscilla. She answered with an anxious tone, "Priscilla, have you arrived?"
"I'm already at your school. Where are you?" Priscilla replied with a smile.
"I'm in the music room right now. Let me come and pick you up," Maya quickly said.
"No need. I can find the music room. Just wait for me," Priscilla replied calmly before ending the call.
Putting her phone down, Maya turned to Mr. Joudan, saying, "Teacher, my friend is on her way..."
"Alright," Mr. Joudan nodded at Maya's words without saying much.
Chris's curiosity was piqued. He wondered who this friend of Maya's could be.
A few minutes later, they heard some movement outside the music room.
Everyone turned their heads toward the entrance.
First came Priscilla, followed by a seemingly ordinary young man. It was none other than Connor, who had been coaxed by Priscilla to come here.
"Priscilla, where's your friend? And why did you bring Connor here?" Maya walked quickly to Priscilla's side, puzzled.
Connor also appeared baffled. He furrowed his brows and asked Priscilla, "Priscilla, did you bring me here just to see her?"
He was still upset about what she had done last night, so he was probably the last person he wanted to see right now.
"Maya, the person I found for you is Connor!" Priscilla said with a cheerful smile.
"What?" Maya's eyes widened in disbelief, her expression showing extreme surprise.
"I know Connor's piano skills very well. He's definitely better than me by a lot. So, there's no problem for him to collaborate with you!" Priscilla explained with a smile.
Maya's expression now shifted to unhappiness. She furrowed her brows and said, "Priscilla, are you serious or just joking with me?"
"Come on, silly. Why would I lie to you?" Priscilla laughed gently.
"But no matter how I look at it, I don't think he can play the piano," Maya said, looking confused.
Chris shared the same sentiment. He believed that Connor couldn't pose any threat to him.
After hearing their conversation, Connor couldn't help but ask with a puzzled expression, "Priscilla, what are you two talking about? Why did you bring me here?"
He had no idea why Priscilla had brought him here.

chapters.title: Chapter 1443: How Would I Not Know How To Play The Piano?
chapters.content:
Chapter 1443: How Would I Not Know How To Play The Piano?
Priscilla turned to Connor and smiled as she explained, "Connor, here's what happened. Several universities in Porthampton are planning a joint campus celebration next week. Maya is preparing to perform a duet on violin and piano. She hasn't found a suitable partner for the performance yet, so I brought you here. I know your piano skills are excellent, and that's why I brought you..."
Connor looked at Priscilla with an expression of utter disbelief.
He couldn't fathom that Priscilla had gone through all this trouble just to ask for his help with Maya's performance.
"You want me to collaborate with her?" Connor asked incredulously.
"What's the problem? Is there an issue?" Priscilla playfully countered.
"Of course, there's a problem. I absolutely won't help her with this. You should find someone else!" he responded, still harboring resentment from the previous night's events. He had no intention of helping.
After saying this, he turned to leave.
However, this action left Chris, who was not far away, stunned. He had assumed that Connor was his competition, but he hadn't expected him to voluntarily back out. This sudden change caught Chris off guard.
Upon hearing his refusal, Maya's expression turned angry. After all, Chris was still present, and it was clear that his direct rejection hurt her feelings. She was not pleased with this situation.
"Connor, what do you mean by that? Why does it sound like I desperately want to collaborate with you?" Her eyes widened in anger as she yelled at him.
"But if you don't want to collaborate with me, why did you call me here?" he calmly questioned.
"Get this straight, Priscilla brought you here, not me. If I had known it was you, I would never have agreed. Collaborating with you would be embarrassing!" she retorted.
"In that case, it's better for me to leave. I have some things to attend to," he said, turning to walk away.
"Connor, don't go. Maya was just joking with you earlier," Priscilla quickly reached out to stop Connor.
"Whether she was joking or not, I really don't want to collaborate with her. It would affect my performance," Connor calmly stated.
"You..." Maya stared at Connor, her expression filled with anger. She couldn't believe how angry she felt. After all, there had been people who had cried and begged to collaborate with her before. She had rejected them because she didn't want to work with them. But now the situation had completely turned around – Connor was voluntarily refusing her, and she had never expected that.
"Who do you think you are? If there's nothing else, I'll leave!" he responded with a blank expression before turning to leave.
"This is so frustrating!" Maya stood in place, her delicate body trembling in anger.
Chris felt it was time for him to step in. He spoke up expressionlessly, "It's your choice whether you want to collaborate with Miss Maya or not, but were your words just now a bit too much?"
Upon hearing Chris's words, Connor paused for a moment, then glanced at him but chose not to respond. Instead, he turned to Maya with a grin and asked, "Is this kid your boyfriend?"
Chris's eyes also showed a hint of surprise. He hadn't expected Connor to completely ignore him. Throughout his life, no matter where he went, he was always someone highly valued. Whether it was because of his father's connections or his uncle's influence, he was accustomed to being treated like a star. But being ignored by Connor was something he hadn't experienced before, and it left him feeling quite uncomfortable.
"Kid, I was talking to you just now. Didn't you hear me?" Chris took a step forward, his expression still devoid of emotion, and yelled at Connor.
"Chris, this has nothing to do with you. You should mind your own business!" Maya knew that Chris didn't know about Connor's identity. She could afford to offend Connor, but if Chris did, things could get complicated.
"Miss Maya, this person is really rude..." Chris couldn't understand why Maya was defending Connor, but he also chose not to provoke the situation further.
"I think he's just showing off. I guess he can't play!" Maya pouted.
Her thoughts were focused on how she would mock Connor if he played poorly.
"What should I play then?" Connor walked over to the piano, grinning as he asked her.
"Melody of the Night," Maya replied with a dismissive tone.
"What's 'Melody of the Night'? I've never heard of it," Connor furrowed his brows.
She was left speechless. She couldn't believe he hadn't heard of the Melody of the Night.
"If you don't know the piece, you can play it based on the sheet music," Priscilla softly reminded him.
"I don't know how to read sheet music either," he replied helplessly.
Maya's expression became even more incredulous. She didn't know what to say – Connor couldn't even read sheet music!
"If you don't know how to play the piece, then you can try playing it based on the sheet music!"

chapters.title: Chapter 1444: Give It A Try
chapters.content:
Chapter 1444: Give It A Try
Maya had initially thought that Connor truly had some skills, given his confident demeanor.
However, Maya was utterly surprised when she discovered that Connor couldn't play the piece 'Melody of the Night' at all.
What made it even more baffling was that Connor not only couldn't play the piece but also couldn't read sheet music. Maya thought he was just causing trouble.
Although Connor could play the piano, it had been a long time since he had practiced.
Furthermore, he knew very few pieces, all taught to him by his mother. So, it was normal that he couldn't read sheet music.
Chris looked at Connor with disdain, clearly enjoying the spectacle. He believed Connor posed no threat, given his inability to even read sheet music. How could someone like that compete?
"Miss Maya, I don't think we need to waste our time here. If this person can't read sheet music, he won't be able to perform 'Melody of the Night' well," Chris stepped forward and whispered to Maya.
"Well, I think we don't need to waste time either." She agreed with a nod.
"Maya, Connor is actually quite skilled at the piano. It's normal for him not to read sheet music," Priscilla hurriedly defended.
"Priscilla, he can't even read sheet music. How can I believe you?" Maya's frustration was evident in her voice.
Upon hearing her words, Priscilla turned to look at Connor and softly asked, "Connor, should I teach you how to play this piece?"
"Is it too late to teach him now?" Chris interjected with a sarcastic tone.
"No need to teach me. Priscilla, you just need to play the piece once," Connor calmly stated.
"Just once?" She looked at Connor, her expression puzzled.
"Yes, just once." He nodded calmly.
It's worth noting that Connor was now a warrior. His memory and reflexes were beyond ordinary, and he only needed to listen to Priscilla play once to learn it.
This change was one of the biggest transformations that occurred after he became a warrior.
An ordinary person who became a warrior experiences significant improvements in physical attributes, reaction speed, and memory.
Priscilla hesitated for a moment, unsure of his intentions. However, she walked over to the piano and elegantly took a seat.
Melody of the Night was quite renowned in the world of piano music. Though not extremely challenging, it became much more difficult when performed as a duet with a violin.
The intertwining melodies demand great cooperation between the piano and violin players. They must synchronize their rhythms and adapt to each other's variations.
In other words, it's not only about playing well individually but also harmonizing with each other.
Hence, Maya struggled to find a suitable partner, given her high standards.
Though she usually appears carefree, she had high expectations. She had been learning the violin since childhood and had won numerous awards. However, this was her first time performing in front of a large audience.
As the piano's melody began to flow, everyone's attention focused on Priscilla.
Despite not having played the piano for a while, her skills remained intact.
The melodious piano notes of Melody of the Night filled the room, evoking emotions that seemed to radiate from the music itself. The shifting melodies seemed to influence the audience's moods.
Chris stared at Priscilla, his expression one of astonishment. He sensed that her piano skills were truly exceptional, surpassing his own.
Connor, however, kept his eyes closed, immersed in the music.
"Can he really understand this piano piece?" Maya glanced at Connor, her expression filled with doubt.
She had never seen someone learn a piano piece like this before—simply by listening.
A few minutes later, the piano's notes gradually faded away, and Connor opened his eyes.
"Connor, did you learn it?" Priscilla stood up and softly inquired.
"Yes," Connor nodded calmly.
"Are you serious?" Maya stared at him with wide eyes, finding it hard to believe.
"Do I have any reason to joke with you? If I say I've learned it, then I have," Connor replied emotionlessly.
"How is that possible? You've only heard the piece once. Are you sure you can play it?" She was still skeptical.
"Want to try it now?" he suggested.
"Try it?" Maya paused, then rolled her eyes and said, "Fine, let's give it a try. But I don't believe you've really learned it."
With that, she picked up her violin, and he walked over to the piano.
Everyone's attention was on him; they still couldn't believe he had truly mastered the piece in such a short time.

chapters.title: Chapter 1445: I Know Music!
chapters.content:
Chapter 1445: I Know Music!
Connor sat in front of the piano, took a deep breath, and placed his hands on the keys.
Before long, the music started to play, with the beautiful sound of the violin accompanying the rising piano melody.
At first, the audience didn't seem to have high expectations for the duet between Connor and Maya. Even Priscilla thought it was unlikely that he could learn this piece in such a short time.
But just a few seconds later, the expressions on everyone's faces began to change.
Even Maya's eyes showed a hint of astonishment, as she hadn't expected his piano skills to be so impressive. Not only did he truly learn the Melody of the Night, but also during the performance, she could feel her own emotions shifting. Her focus became exceptionally concentrated, as if she had completely immersed herself in the piece.
Mr. Joudan looked at Connor in shock. In this moment, he realized what a true musical genius was. Despite teaching music for so many years, he had never been so profoundly impressed before.
Clearly, the collaboration between Maya and Connor was far superior to her collaboration with Chris.
When Maya and Chris performed together before, their performances were good, but they still couldn't achieve the piano-dominated, violin-accompanied effect. It seemed more like an equal partnership.
But now, the situation had completely reversed. It was evident that from the very beginning, the piano held the leading role.
Chris stared at Connor in disbelief. He didn't know how to describe his feelings at the moment. Learning the piece in such a short time was already incredible, but who could have anticipated that the collaboration between Connor and Maya would be this stunning?
In recent times, she had found many duet partners, but this was the first time she had felt this way.
She believed that if she could truly collaborate with Connor, the result would be remarkable.
As everyone was immersed in the enchanting music, the piano suddenly stopped.
All eyes turned to him.
"Connor, why did you stop playing?"
Maya quickly turned her head towards him and asked, her tone somewhat irritated.
Upon hearing her question, Connor smiled faintly. Though he felt her violin playing was quite impressive, he didn't voice this. Instead, he calmly asked, "How did you think I played just now?"
"It was alright, I guess..."
Maya gave a somewhat insincere reply.
Connor chuckled softly. Then, he stood up and said, "I thought so. But I found your violin playing to be rather average. If we were to collaborate, it would greatly affect my performance. The reason I played with you just now was merely to show you that it's not my problem that I don't want to collaborate with you, it's yours..."
"What are you saying?"
Maya's eyes widened as she heard his words, her expression showing a mix of surprise and disbelief.
Because she hadn't expected him to say something like this.
After all, she was quite confident in her violin skills. She had been practicing since she was very young, and her teacher was a well-known violinist. Her violin skills were considered excellent, especially for a college student.
But now, he was saying her skills were only average.
Maya was taken aback, unable to formulate a response. Though she wanted to refute Connor, she couldn't find any valid arguments. His words had some truth – while technique was important, conveying emotions through music was equally crucial.
"Alright, I've said what needed to be said. I won't collaborate with you. Working with you would only hinder me!"
Connor intentionally struck a blow at Maya, then turned to leave the classroom.
Seeing his retreating figure, her expression turned sour. She had always been the one to criticize others, never on the receiving end. And the direct humiliation was making her increasingly furious.
"Connor, you jerk! You've gone too far!" she yelled and lunged at Connor.
He seemed surprised by her sudden attack. He hadn't expected her to physically confront him.
"Today, I'll teach you a lesson..." she shouted and attempted to reach for his face.
In theory, a girl like her shouldn't have been a match for him. Dealing with her physically would have been easy for him.
However, he couldn't actually lay a hand on Maya.
"Ah..."
In that moment, Connor, who had been planning to dodge Maya, saw her stumble over a chair leg and tumble towards him.
Seeing this, Priscilla also showed a surprised expression.

chapters.title: Chapter 1446: This Person Is Mr. McDonald?
chapters.content:
Chapter 1446: This Person Is Mr. McDonald?
He was still very far away from Maya at the moment.
Even if he wanted to reach out to support Maya now, it was probably too late.
Initially, Maya had planned to fight Connor to the death after being humiliated by him. However, because she was too anxious, she did not notice the chair at the side and tripped.
She screamed as she hurtled at Connor.
If Connor didn't reach out now, Maya would probably fall to the ground. Moreover, because Maya had been running very quickly just now, she would probably scratch her face if she fell.
Although the relationship between Connor and Maya had never been very good, Maya actually did not have any malicious intent towards Connor. If the incident last night hadn't happened, the relationship between Connor and Maya would have eased a lot.
So no matter what, Connor would definitely not watch Maya fall in front of him.
He reached out and grabbed her arm, supporting her.
However, Maya did not give up on attacking him after he steadied her. Instead, she continued to claw at Connor's arm.
Maya had gone completely crazy, and she was desperately trying to grab Connor's face.
Connor had no choice but to grab her hands so that she couldn't move.
Right now, Connor had no other choice but to control Maya first. If she continued to cause trouble, she would definitely scratch his face.
"Connor, let go of me…" Maya shouted.
"I can let go of you, but you have to promise me that you won't attack me again…"
Connor said with a serious expression.
"Hurry up and let go of me!"
Maya shouted excitedly.
"If you don't agree to my request, I won't let go!" Connor said with a smile.
Chris finally couldn't stand it anymore. He walked up to Connor and said coldly, "Let go of Miss Phillips immediately!"
"Chris, this matter has nothing to do with you. Go and stay where you are…"
Maya turned her head and glared at Chris. She knew very well that Chris could not afford to offend Connor.
"Miss Phillips, this person has gone too far. I can't sit idly by!" Chris replied in a serious tone.
Connor turned his head and glanced at Chris, then laughed and said, "Kid, I advise you to mind your own business. The matter between Maya and I really has nothing to do with you!" he said out of goodwill.
"I told you to let go of Miss Phillips, did you hear me?"
Chris took a step forward and shouted at Connor with an angry expression.
"Chris, don't be a busybody…"
Maya was speechless.
It would have been better if Maya hadn't said this. After saying this, Chris became even more excited and reached out to grab Connor's arm.
Connor easily dodged Chris's right hand and said with a smile, "Kid, do you know who I am?"
"Who are you?"
Chris was stunned for a moment, and his expression was a little puzzled.
"Chris, his name is Connor. He's my cousin's fiancé. He's not someone you can afford to provoke," Maya shouted helplessly.
"Your cousin's fiancé?"
Chris was stunned when he heard Maya's words. A hint of shock flashed across his eyes.
Who was Maya's cousin?
It was Porthampton's famous number one goddess, Freya Phillips!
And who was Freya's fiancé?
That was the Mr. McDonald of Porthampton, who had terrified countless big shots here!
Why did Chris choose to contact Maya in the first place? To use her connections to get in touch with Mr. McDonald!
Therefore, when Chris knew Connor's true identity, he was completely dumbfounded. He stuttered, "Miss Phillips, are you kidding me? This person is Mr. McDonald?"
"That's right, it's him!"
Maya nodded helplessly.
Chris was dumbfounded when he heard this. "I... Mr. McDonald, I... I didn't know it was you. I said the wrong thing just now. You...Please don't hold it against me. Please don't... Please don't lower yourself to my level…"
Chris seemed to have changed into a different person at this moment. He shouted at Connor with an excited expression.
After hearing Chris's words, Maya's expression was unusually helpless. She didn't know what to say.
Who would have thought that Chris would change so much? Moments ago, he was just about to stand up for Maya, but now it was as if he had changed into another person.
"I told you long ago that this matter is not something you can meddle in. Go do what you have to do!" Connor said.
"Alright, alright…"
After Chris heard Connor's words, he heaved a long sigh of relief and hurriedly said, "Mr. Jordan, Miss Phillips, I still have something to do. I'll leave first!"
After saying this, Chris turned around and ran out of the classroom.
Even if Chris had the courage of 1000 lions, he would never go against someone like Connor.
If he offended Connor in Porthampton, it would be no different from courting death.
"Maya, stop fooling around…"
Priscilla walked up to Maya and Connor and separated them.
"What Connor said just now was too much. He has to apologize to me!" Maya said angrily.
"Why should I apologize to you? Everything I said is the truth!" Connor replied indifferently.
"You…"
At this moment, Maya was already trembling with anger, and the expression on her face was also very broken.
"Connor, you cooperated very well with Maya just now. Can you treat it as giving me face? Just help her this once…"
Priscilla said.
"I can't help you with this. Cooperating with her will affect me!"
Connor refused without thinking and then walked away.
After all, Connor was not very interested in this school anniversary, so he naturally did not want to participate.
"Connor, you can't leave!"
Maya stood in front of Connor and shouted.
"What else do you want?"
Connor asked helplessly.
"You can either apologize to me now or perform with me. It's up to you!"
Maya said fiercely.

chapters.title: Chapter 1447: A Threat
chapters.content:
Chapter 1447: A Threat
"I won't choose either option!"
Connor replied expressionlessly and continued to walk forward.
"If you don't choose anything, I'll tell my cousin about you, Yelena Allen, and Chloe Lawson!" Maya shouted excitedly.
Connor froze on the spot when he heard Maya's words.
He had never thought that Maya would use such a thing to threaten him.
"Maya, there's no point in doing this!"
Connor said with a frown.
"And why isn't there?" Maya replied, then smiled and said, "I think it's quite interesting. Weren't you mocking me just now? You can continue to mock me. When I go back tonight, I want to see my cousin take care of you!"
"..."
A trace of helplessness flashed across Connor's eyes. He had not thought that Maya actually had something on him.
"Apologize or perform? You can choose for yourself!"
Maya said proudly.
Connor hesitated for a moment, then said, "If you really want me to help you, I can. However, I have a condition…"
"What conditions?"
Maya asked Connor.
"It's very simple, as long as you don't disturb me and Freya!"
Connor hurriedly said.
"You wish. I won't agree to your condition. Anyway, you either have to apologize to me or play with me, or I'll tell my cousin about what you did. I want to see how you plan to explain your situation to my cousin!"
Maya crossed her arms.
Connor was extremely regretful. If he had known this would happen, he would never have offended Maya to begin with.
"Priscilla, you brought me here today. Are you going to do anything about this?"
At this moment, Connor had no other way but to ask Priscilla for help.
Priscilla put on a helpless expression. "This is between you and Maya. It doesn't seem to have anything to do with me, right?"
"You…"
Only now did Connor realize that he had obviously been tricked by these two women.
When Maya saw Priscilla speaking up for her, her expression became even more smug.
"Connor, you scared away the boy just now. Now that Maya can't find a more suitable candidate, why don't you help her?" Priscilla said.
Connor looked at Maya helplessly and said, "If you want me to perform with you, that's fine too, but the way you play the violin must change…"
"Change?"
Maya could not help but be stunned when she heard this. Then, she asked Connor, "How should I change?"
"Forget all the playing techniques you've learned before. You don't even need to play according to the rhythm on the music score. You can judge the changes in your sound according to the changes in your mood. This way, you can more intuitively let people feel the emotions you want to express!"
Connor said in a serious tone.
Maya looked at Connor with a hint of doubt in her eyes. After all, what Connor said was very different from what she had learned before.
"If you still don't understand what I mean, then you can try it now. If you think what I said is effective, then do as I say. If you think what I said is useless, then you can continue to do it your way!" Connor added.
Although Maya was very unconvinced, she was still curious if Connor's method was really effective.
And so, Maya picked up her violin and started playing.
In the beginning, Maya was obviously not used to Connor's methods; after all, this method required her to abandon all the techniques she had learned before.
However, as Maya gradually adapted, she found that Connor's method was indeed very useful.
Even though Maya had misplayed a few parts, the effect was overall very good.
A moment later, Maya stopped what she was doing.
"How do you feel?"
Connor asked Maya with a smile.
Maya ignored him. "Priscilla, what do you think?"
"I think the effect is better than before, but you might need some time to get used to this method…" Priscilla said with a smile.
Maya turned her head and looked at Connor. Although she was very unconvinced, his suggestion was very useful, so she did not say anything more.
"Maya, are you planning to work with this Mr. McDonald?"
Mr. Jordan asked Maya.
"That's right. Chris was scared away by him. I don't have any other candidates now…"
Maya said stubbornly.
"Alright then. Since you have already found a suitable candidate, there is no need for me to help you find other candidates…"
Mr. Jordan smiled happily and continued, "Maya, your performance with Mr. McDonald is the first performance of our medical school. This performance is very important, so the two of you must perform well…"
"The first one to appear?"
Connor said in surprise.
"That's right. After the two of you finish performing, the principal of our Porthampton Medical School will go on stage to give a speech. Then, the other students will perform. Therefore, your performance is very, very important. The principal also values your performance very much. He has already asked me about you several times..."
Mr. Jordan nodded gently.
Connor turned to look at Maya and said with a smile, "Then it seems that you have to practice well for the few days…"
"What do you mean by that?"
Maya shouted indignantly.
"You know what I mean. I'm not under any pressure now. After all, I'm not a student of your Porthampton Medical School. Even if I screw up, it won't affect me. But you're different..." Connor said with a smile.
"You…"
Maya looked at Connor, her face filled with rage.
"Alright, it's getting late. I'll go back first. You stay here and practice well!"
Connor said with a smile.

chapters.title: Chapter 1448: Freya's Worries
chapters.content:
Chapter 1448: Freya's Worries
"If you leave, what should I do?"
Maya shouted.
"Isn't Priscilla here? What you lack now is not my cooperation, but your own problem. Therefore, even if I stay here, there is nothing I can do. You'd better practice your violin first!"
Connor replied indifferently, then turned around and left.
After leaving Porthampton Medical School, Connor hailed a taxi and returned to Freya's house.
In fact, Connor had deliberately left Maya and Priscilla there. After all, Maya was the biggest obstacle for Connor's plan to push Freya down. Now that Maya was practicing the violin in school, no one could affect Connor and Freya's alone time.
When Connor returned home, he realized that Freya had not returned yet, so he could only sit on the sofa and watch TV while waiting for her to return.
At five o'clock in the evening, Freya finally returned.
When Connor saw her, he hurriedly went up and asked with a smile, "Freya, you're back. How was the discussion with the investors today?"
"Not very good…"
Freya kicked off her high heels dejectedly.
"Those investors have no taste, right?"
Connor walked to Freya's side.
"Actually, it's not that they don't have good taste. The main thing is that our cosmetics aren't well-known internationally, and we don't have much competitiveness in the market. The market is already saturated with high-end and middle-end cosmetics!"
Freya sat on the sofa tiredly.
When Connor saw Freya like this, he couldn't help but feel a little heartache. He took the initiative to rub her shoulders and said, "Wifey, you don't have to be so tired at all. Wouldn't your problem be solved if I call Thomas Morgan now?"
"I haven't married you yet. Besides, I've said it before: I don't need your help. I want to do something on my own…" Freya said angrily.
"Alright, since you want to solve it yourself, I won't help you!"
Connor nodded helplessly and continued, "But I think your cosmetics company should focus on high-end cosmetics in Oprana. Otherwise, based on the current situation, it will be very difficult for your company's products to open up the market…"
"What do you mean by that?"
Freya was stunned when she heard Connor's words.
Connor stopped what he was doing and rested his head on Freya's thigh.
Freya was shocked by Connor's actions and hurriedly pushed his head away.
"If you want to hear my suggestion, then don't push me away…"
Connor said with a smile.
Freya's expression was a little helpless as she said, "Then lie down!"
After Connor saw that Freya had agreed, he hurriedly placed his head on her beautiful legs and smelled the faint fragrance on her body.
"What did you want to say just now?"
Freya asked anxiously.
"Actually, I think it's quite simple. Since the cosmetics market is already saturated, it's very difficult for your company's products to stand out. However, there's one kind of cosmetic that no one makes, and that's the most traditional cosmetics in Oprana..."
Connor paused for a moment and then continued, "So I think your company can develop in this direction and create the most authentic Oprana cosmetics by only using raw materials from Oprana. This way, you might be able to open up a new market and won't have to compete with those traditional big brands…"
"What you said seems to make sense. Why didn't I think of these things before?" Freya hurriedly said.
"Of course it makes sense. Our Oprana culture is extensive and profound. Even if we look at the world now, our culture is the best. Moreover, basically all the cosmetics are mostly from foreign brands, but there are very few brands in Oprana. Even if there are, they are all fake. A few years ago, most people worshipped foreign things, which led them to think that imported things are better. But it's different now!"
Connor spoke while gently stroking Freya's beautiful legs. At this moment, Freya was completely focused on what Connor was saying.
"Now, our people are slowly discovering that the things left behind by the older generation are actually the best. Therefore, although Opranian medicine is not as popular as Western medicine in the market, there are many people who like Opranian medicine because they feel that it is the least harmful to the body!"
Connor said this because he was now a martial artist, so he already knew the power of Opranian culture.
"You're right. When I lost my memory, even the best doctors in the U.S. couldn't do anything. They even said that I would never recover my memory in my life. However, you just gave me a pill, and I actually recovered my memory," Freya said excitedly.
"Of course, this is only one aspect. I heard from my friend that some people can develop a kind of cosmetic product. Not only does it not harm human skin, but it can also improve a person's skin to the greatest extent, helping one achieve beauty the natural way. Think about it: if such a cosmetic product is really available, it will definitely be very popular in the market. As long as your company monopolizes this technology, In the future, it would be very easy for you to become an international A-list celebrity. Moreover, we could also promote our Oprana culture at the same time!"
Connor said as he caressed Freya's beautiful legs.
It had to be said that they felt really good. He couldn't help but continue to reach inside.
Freya saw that Connor's movements were getting bigger and bigger, so she quickly reached out to stop him and frowned."Connor, I know that your idea is indeed very good, but it doesn't suit our company's current situation. Once we develop in this direction, it's naturally best if we can succeed, but once we fail, we might really lose everything!"
"What are you afraid of with me around?" Connor smiled before continuing, "You can do it according to my idea. When the time comes, we'll see the effect. If things turn out good, you can continue to do it, but if not, you can give up on this route."

chapters.title: Chapter 1449: Your Problem?
chapters.content:
Chapter 1449: Your Problem?
"I already said I don't need your help!"
Freya rolled her eyes at Connor.
"You're my fiancée. There's nothing wrong with me helping you…"
Connor said helplessly as he rested his head on her thigh.
"I just don't want you to help me. I want to resolve this matter myself…"
Freya replied as she thought about Connor's words.
"Then, just treat it as me saying all these things for nothing…" Connor said dejectedly.
"It's not a waste of time. I think your idea is indeed quite good. I'm going to discuss it with the shareholders tomorrow and test the investors' views. If there are no problems, I can give it a try!" Freya said with a smile.
"Don't worry, my method will definitely succeed!"
Connor laughed and replied, "Since your problem has been solved, shouldn't you help me solve my problem now?"
"Your problem?"
Freya couldn't help but be stunned when she heard his words.
She had been in the company for a whole day. At this moment, she was still wearing a short black skirt that wrapped around her hips, and her slender and fair legs were abnormally straight. Moreover, Connor had been harassing Freya non-stop just now, so he could not take it anymore.
"It's the thing that the two of us didn't finish last night!"
Connor whispered into Freya's ear.
"Why are you thinking about these things?"
When Freya heard his words, she could not help but blush. She seemed to give off an alluring aura.
When Connor saw Freya's shy look, he felt his control further slipping. He pushed Freya onto the sofa and kissed her tender red lips.
In the beginning, Freya might have struggled a little, but she quickly began to cooperate with Connor. The two of them hugged, kissed, and responded to each other.
Connor's right hand reached for the buttons on her shirt.
A few seconds later, he finally unbuttoned her jacket and shirt.
However, just as he was about to take off her clothes, the doorbell rang again.
When he heard the doorbell ring, Connor broke down.
Freya instantly snapped out of her daze. She hurriedly pushed Connor away and tidied up her clothes as she said, "Connor, Maya has returned…"
"That Maya, why does she always come back at this time?"
At this moment, Connor really wanted to kill someone.
"What are you still standing there for? Hurry up and open the door!"
Freya saw Connor sitting there motionlessly and shouted at him.
Connor took a deep breath and walked towards the villa's entrance. After opening the door, he realized that it was indeed Maya standing outside.
"Why aren't you practicing the violin in school? Why did you come back?"
Connor gritted his teeth and shouted angrily at Maya.
"My cousin should be off work by now, right? I was worried that you would do something bad to her. Moreover, Priscilla had also gone back. It was too boring for me to be alone in the music room, so I brought the violin back. I was going to practice at home so that if I did anything wrong, you could give me some pointers..."
Maya shook her violin at Connor as she spoke.
"Pointers my ass!" Connor could not help but curse in his heart, but he did not say anything. He could only watch Maya walk into the villa with tears in his eyes.
"Maya, you're back?"
Freya had also tidied up her clothes and was smiling as she called out to Maya.
"That's right, Freya. Next week is the joint anniversary celebration of the three major universities in Porthampton. I'm going to play a duet with Connor."
Maya sat beside with a smile.
"Connor, you're actually going to perform with Maya?"
Freya asked in surprise.
"She was the one who forced me to perform with her. Otherwise, I wouldn't have attended the joint school anniversary at all!" Connor said expressionlessly.
"What do you mean by I forced you to perform with me? If it wasn't because I couldn't find a suitable candidate, I wouldn't have chosen you!" Maya quickly retorted.
Freya smiled and said, "I did receive an invitation to the joint school anniversary today. I originally planned to reject it, but since the two of you are going to perform on stage, I'll definitely have to go and take a look…"
"That's great!"
Maya shouted happily.
"You two keep chatting. I'm going back to my room to rest!"
Connor felt a headache whenever he saw Maya, so he went straight back to his room after saying that.
Meanwhile, Maya started chatting with Freya.
..
In the blink of an eye, three days passed.
In these three days, Maya basically followed Freya every day, not giving Connor any chance at all.
Connor looked at Freya loitering in front of him every day, but he could not do anything to her. His heart was also very broken.
Connor finally had the time to come to Porthampton, but in the end, he did not do anything fun. Moreover, the problem was not that Freya was unwilling, but rather that her cousin was unwilling. Connor felt that he was really unlucky.
"Maya, I might not be able to attend the joint school anniversary today…" Freya said as she put on her makeup.
"Why?"
Maya took out a white dress from the closet and stood in front of the mirror to take a closer look. She looked very satisfied with herself.
"I'm flying to Europe today. A European investor is very interested in our company's traditional Oprana cosmetics. I think this is a very good opportunity, so I can't miss it!" Freya explained.
"Freya, are you leaving?"
After hearing this, Connor hurriedly ran into the room and asked excitedly.
"Ahh…"
Maya, who was about to change her clothes, screamed when she saw Connor rush in.
Connor instinctively glanced at Maya and realized that she had already unbuttoned her clothes, but had not taken them off yet.
"I'm sorry, I didn't know you were changing inside…" Connor said awkwardly.
"Get out, get out quickly!"
Maya screamed at the top of her lungs.
Connor could only helplessly turn around and walk out of Freya's bedroom. Then, he muttered, "As if anyone wants to look at you…"

chapters.title: Chapter 1450: The Celebration
chapters.content:
Chapter 1450: The Celebration
Connor waited in the living room for about half an hour before Freya and Maya finally came out of the bedroom.
"Freya, I just heard that you're going to Europe, right?"
Connor asked.
"Yeah, I told the company's executives about your idea a few days ago. They seem to think that your idea is feasible. A European investment company is very interested in our project and invited me to go to Europe to talk to them…" Freya said.
"But what will I do once you leave?
Connor asked helplessly.
"You've been separated from my cousin for so long, but haven't you been living well regardless? Why can't you live without her now?" Maya said sarcastically.
"Children shouldn't interrupt when adults are talking!" Connor frowned and scolded, then continued, "Freya, I came to Porthampton because of you. If you leave, what's the point of me staying here?"
"Then go back to the city. Didn't you say you were going back a few days ago?"
Freya said after thinking for a moment.
"I don't have anything to do when I go back now. Why don't I go to Europe with you?" Connor asked.
"No, if you go to Europe with my cousin, I'll go with you. I have to protect my cousin!"
Maya hurriedly shouted.
"..."
Connor turned his head and looked at Maya, his expression unusually speechless. He said in a low voice, "Alright, if you're willing to go, then go. I won't go…"
"Hmph, if you don't want to go, then I won't go either…"
Maya pouted.
"Freya, I'll send you to the airport. After I send you off, I'll attend the joint school anniversary!"
Connor knew that if he followed Freya to Europe, Maya would definitely go along to cause trouble. It was better not to go, so Connor gave up on this idea.
"Alright!"
Freya nodded happily after knowing that Connor was going to send her to the airport.
Maya, on the other hand, said with a puzzled expression, "Connor, are you planning to secretly go to Europe with my cousin? Let me tell you, if you dare to stand me up, I will definitely not let you off…"
Connor looked at Maya with a helpless expression, then directly brought Freya out of the villa.
As Maya needed to go to school in advance to prepare, she did not go to the airport with them.
At eight in the morning, Connor sent Freya onto the plane and had Carlos Lane and Diana Murphy follow Freya to Europe.
Carlos and Diana were basically Freya's personal bodyguards. After all, Connor was a martial artist and did not need their protection, but Freya had always been in Porthampton, so Connor was worried that someone would do something to her.
After leaving the airport, Connor drove Freya's car to the venue of the celebration.
This celebration wasn't just for one school, but was a joint celebration of three schools. The teachers and students of these three schools added up to at least tens of thousands of people, so ordinary places could not accommodate so many people.
Therefore, the joint anniversary celebration of each new year was usually held in the cultural square in front of the City Hall.
There would be a road closure at that time. Unauthorized people would not be able to enter. This would also ensure that the order at the scene could be maintained during the school anniversary.
Connor had already communicated with Maya before, and Freya's company had also received an invitation, so he arrived at the square very easily.
At this moment, many students had already entered the venue and were seated according to their school and class.
In order to hold this joint school anniversary, the three schools had used their special skills. The programs prepared and the invited guests were all of high quality.
After all, this school anniversary wasn't just a simple school anniversary. It also concerned the status of the three schools in Porthampton.
Originally, Porthampton University, Porthampton Medical School, and Porthampton Business School were on par. However, because many big bosses graduated from Porthampton Business School, and these big bosses would attend every joint anniversary celebration, many people thought that Porthampton Business School was stronger than Porthampton University and Porthampton Medical School.
To put it bluntly, this joint school anniversary was also an opportunity for the universities to compete with each other.
This was also why the leaders of these universities attached great importance to this joint school anniversary.
Of course, this time, the students of Porthampton University were very confident for one simple reason: everyone knew that Connor was a student at Porthampton University. Just this point alone was enough to crush the other two universities.
Unfortunately, Porthampton University did not invite Connor as a guest.
This was mainly because the leaders of Porthampton University did not have Connor's contact information at all; in the entire university, only Dominic and Spencer could contact Connor. However, the two of them would not look for Connor because of this matter because they knew that Connor had always been very resistant to this kind of public appearance.
After Connor parked the car, he found the location of Porthampton University. In order to prevent others from recognizing him, he specially wore a hat and sunglasses.
Because there were too many people at the scene, Connor spent a long time looking for Dominic and Spencer.
"Big brother, why are you here?"
Dominic asked Connor in surprise.
"That's right. If I had known that you would come, I would have given your phone number to the principal. The principal talked to me several times and asked me to contact you, but I rejected him every time…" Spencer quickly said.
" I didn't plan to participate at first, but Maya asked me to act in a show for her, so I came over…" Connor explained with a smile.
"So that's how it is. I can't even recognize you when you're dressed like this…" Dominic said.
"There's no other way. There are too many people in Porthampton who know me. Once those people know that I'm here, they will definitely pester me, so I needed a disguise..."
Connor replied casually and then briefly sized up the students in the class.
Most of these students had not changed at all.
Upon seeing these people, Connor couldn't help but recall what happened at Porthampton University.
A large number of these students had bullied Connor before, but now he was not in the mood to argue with these people about those things.
Connor was wearing sunglasses and a cap, hiding among the students of Porthampton University.
Because Connor himself was not outstanding, no one recognized him at all.
Dominic and Spencer and Connor started chatting.

chapters.title: Chapter 1451: Melody of the Night
chapters.content:
Chapter 1451: Melody of the Night
"Ding, ding, ding…"
Just as the school anniversary celebration was about to start, Connor's phone suddenly rang.
He took out his phone and saw that it was Maya calling, so he answered the call.
"Hello?"
"Connor, where are you? Have you arrived?" Maya asked anxiously.
"I'm already at the square and am chatting with my friends…"
Connor said with a smile.
"Bro, what time is it? You're still in the mood to chat with others? Hurry backstage and get ready!"
Maya shouted in a broken tone.
"What's there to prepare for?"
"The two of us are the first to perform on stage, so of course we have to prepare well. I'm in the dressing room backstage now," Maya said hurriedly.
"Alright, I got it. I'll go over now!"
Connor agreed and then hung up.
After hanging up the phone, Connor and Dominic went their separate ways and walked towards Porthampton Medical School.
Along the way, Connor met many people he knew from Porthampton University, but none of them recognized him.
"Connor?"
Just as Connor was about to find the dressing room of Porthampton Medical School, he suddenly heard someone calling his name behind him.
Connor instinctively turned his head back and realized that it was Lindsy Park.
In fact, Connor did not have much contact with Lindsy. It was just that Jovan Lambert had harassed her in the past, and Connor had helped to teach Jovan a lesson.
Although Connor felt that he had no interaction with Lindsy, Connor had left a very deep impression on her.
When Porthampton University held the sports meet, Connor had single-handedly invited the big shots of the entire Davenport Province. At that time, this matter had caused quite a stir in the University of Porthampton. Many people later found out that Connor was the legendary Mr. McDonald.
Lindsy was dressed very nicely today. She was wearing a black dress that wrapped around her hips, revealing a large area of fair skin on her chest. Her legs were long and straight, and she was wearing a pair of high heels.
Lindsy was already very tall, and her long legs were simply heaven-defying. After wearing high heels, she was even taller than Connor.
"It really is you?"
When Lindsy saw Connor turn around, she was sure that she had not mistaken him for someone else.
"Long time no see!"
Connor said with a smile.
"Why are you dressed like this?"
Lindsy asked in confusion.
"What else could it be? Now that the students of Porthampton University know that I'm Mr. McDonald, I'm afraid that these people will be too polite to me, so I dressed up a little!"
Connor explained helplessly.
"So it's like this…"
Lindsy smiled faintly and opened her mouth to speak.
At this moment, a girl shouted, "Lindsy, hurry up. We're going on stage…"
"Connor, I still have a show to put on. I won't talk to you anymore!" Lindsy said hurriedly.
"Alright, you can go!"
Connor lightly nodded.
Lindsy hesitated for a moment before turning around and leaving.
Connor promptly found Maya in the dressing room of Porthampton Medical School.
Initially, Maya had planned to ask the makeup artist to put some makeup on Connor, but Connor had insisted on wearing sunglasses and a cap to perform on stage or else he would not perform. In the end, Maya could only do as he asked.
Ten minutes later, the two hosts walked onto the stage.
The two hosts were a young man and a woman. The man was handsome and mysterious, while the woman was sexy and charming.
As the two hosts went on stage, the joint school anniversary officially began.
Connor looked at the two hosts on the stage and couldn't help but think of Rachel. If Rachel was still at Porthampton University, she would definitely be hosting alone.
This was because Rachel was too stunning. She could handle such an occasion by herself, and no man had the right to stand beside her.
"It's a pity that Ms. Wallace resigned, otherwise she would definitely be hosting!"
Maya had the same thoughts as Connor.
"You actually know Rachel?"
Connor said in surprise.
"What are you talking about? Who doesn't know that there's a top-notch beauty called Rachel Wallace in Porthampton University?"
Maya pouted and replied, then continued, "You don't know how many students your Porthampton University has recruited because of Rachel. However, after these students found out that she resigned, they all took the initiative to drop out..."
"I didn't expect Rachel's charm to be so terrifying!"
Connor couldn't help but frown as he spoke in surprise.
"Looks like you've underestimated the influence of a beautiful lecturer. Our school has also gotten a few very beautiful female teachers recently, but they definitely can't compare to Rachel!" Maya said.
Connor couldn't help but laugh when he heard this. He didn't expect these schools to use all kinds of methods to recruit students.
At this moment, the host suddenly shouted, "Next, let's invite the principals of Porthampton University, the Business School, and the Medical School to speak on stage!"
The three principals walked onto the stage at the same time and began to speak in order, but their speeches were basically useless. Most of the students weren't even listening. If they weren't waiting to watch the next program, these people wouldn't have been willing to participate in the joint school anniversary.
About half an hour later, the three headmasters finally finished their speeches.
At this moment, a large number of students had already begun to doze off, and the lecturers in the school pretended not to see this situation.
After all, it was already terrible enough that they managed to listen to one principal's speech. Now that three principals were speaking in succession, it was already good enough that these students did not collapse right then and there.
After the three principals finished speaking, the host walked onto the stage and said with a smile, "Next up, we would like to invite Maya from the Medical School to perform 'Melody of the Night'!"
Maya's popularity was terrifying; when everyone heard this name, they instantly erupted into cheers.
"Let's go!"
Connor said indifferently.
Meanwhile, Maya stood rooted to the spot, her expression a little nervous.

chapters.title: Chapter 1452: Yelena Returns
chapters.content:
Chapter 1452: Yelena Returns
Although Maya usually looked carefree, this was her first time performing in front of so many people, so she must be very nervous.
However, Connor was different. After all, he had experienced all kinds of storms during this period of time, so this kind of occasion was really nothing to him.
Of course, the most important thing was that Connor was wearing sunglasses and a hat today, so the students present couldn't recognize him. Even if they really messed up later, they wouldn't know that he was the person playing the piano.
"It's okay. Relax a little…"
Connor said with a smile.
Maya was speechless. "You are dressed like some kind of spy, so even if you mess up, it doesn't matter to you. If I screw up this time, it will be a huge embarrassment…"
"Then you don't plan to perform?"
Connor asked with a smile.
"..."
Maya glared fiercely at Connor, then took a deep breath and directly walked towards the stage.
Connor followed behind Maya.
Under everyone's expectant gazes, Maya brought Connor onto the stage.
When she appeared in everyone's line of sight, deafening cheers instantly erupted from the audience.
Maya could definitely be considered a goddess at Porthampton Medical School. Moreover, the Phillips family was now at the peak of their power in Porthampton, so Maya's popularity was very terrifying.
Connor and Maya bowed to the students below and walked to the piano.
Maya's expression was nervous. After calming down, she nodded at Connor gently, indicating that he could start.
The moving piano slowly played, followed by Maya's violin.
At this moment, Maya was completely following Connor's method. She'd directly abandoned all the techniques she had learned before and integrated all her emotions into the music.
