Although Connor and Maya's coordination had some flaws, it was perfect for those students who did not understand music at all. At this moment, the square with tens of thousands of people fell silent. They were all immersed in the music, quietly experiencing the emotions contained in the melody.
Maya seemed to be getting more and more confident, and she appeared more at ease.
At this moment, the music lecturer below the stage also nodded repeatedly, as if they were very satisfied with Connor and Maya's performance.
"This boy is good at playing the piano. Is he a student from your medical school?" The music professor from Porthampton University asked in confusion.
"No. I've never seen this person before…"
"This person is very talented in the piano. If he can come to our Porthampton University and train well, he will definitely have great achievements..." the professor replied.
"What do you mean by that? That the music lecturer in our medical school is not as good as your Porthampton University?"
"Haha, that's not what I meant either. I just feel that this boy is a little pitiful!"
The music professor of Porthampton University and the lecturer of the Medical School started discussing amongst themselves. Meanwhile, the students below the stage seemed to be very curious about Connor's identity. After all, they did not know who this piano player was!
"I didn't expect Connor to play the piano so well!"
Dominic said in surprise.
"That's right. Why didn't I know that he could play the piano…" Spencer muttered.
At this moment, a black van slowly stopped at the entrance of the square. The car window slowly rolled down. A beautiful woman wearing sunglasses looked thoughtfully at Connor on the stage and then revealed a very happy smile.
After some time, the music finally stopped.
All the students present were so engrossed in the music that they didn't even realize that the performance had ended.
"Thank you very much for bringing us 'Melody of the Night'!"
The host smiled at Connor and Maya.
Maya smiled faintly and brought Connor off the stage.
When Maya stepped off the stage, the students finally reacted and started clapping.
"How is it? The two of us cooperated well, right?"
Connor said with a smile.
"Well, it was fine…"
Maya replied with a pout.
Although Maya said that, she was actually very happy in her heart because she herself did not expect such a good performance. She knew that this performance was very successful.
After Connor and Maya exited the stage, they got a random seat and began to enjoy the programs of other schools.
Basically, every faculty in the three schools would perform, and the types of programs were varied. Some would do crosstalk, some would sing, and some would dance. Moreover, the quality of these programs was very good—After all, these were being performed on such an important occasion. Normally, such quality would never be seen at all.
In the blink of an eye, more than two hours had passed.
There was only half an hour left until the end of the school anniversary. However, Connor found that those students actually did not leave, as if they were all waiting for something.
At this moment, the host walked onto the stage and said excitedly, "I know very well that everyone should be like me, waiting for someone to appear. To be honest, I am also a fan of this goddess, so I won't waste my time. Next, let's invite Yelena Allen from Porthampton University to bring everyone a song called 'Thousand Year Love'!"
"Y-Yelena?"
Connor was stunned when he heard the host's words.
The students below the stage instantly opened their mouths wide, and the expressions on their faces were extremely excited.
"Yelena!"
"Yelena!"
Countless people were cheering for Yelena.
Connor stood there foolishly. Other than shock, there was only shock on his face. Connor had no idea that Yelena had returned to the country and even came to attend the school anniversary!
Maya turned to look at Connor. "Your little lover is coming soon. Are you very excited?" she asked in a strange tone.
"..."
Connor stared at the stage. At this moment, he still couldn't believe that Yelena had really come.
"Don't worry, I won't tell my cousin about this, but you have to tell Yelena. I don't want my cousin to be sad because of you in the future."
Maya continued.

chapters.title: Chapter 1453: The Person I Wanted to See
chapters.content:
Chapter 1453: The Person I Wanted to See
After Connor heard the name Yelena, the expression on his face instantly became somewhat helpless.
His relationship with Freya had just eased up, and Yelena had returned at this time.
If Freya were to find out about Yelena's existence, Connor really didn't know how to explain these things to her.
"Yelena!"
"Yelena!"
Everyone was shouting Yelena's name like crazy.
After all, she used to be a big internet celebrity with millions of fans. Moreover, she had even participated in the filming of an international blockbuster. Even if this movie had not been released yet, Yelena could definitely be considered an A-list celebrity.
When the movie was released, Yelena's popularity might be even higher.
It was now that Connor also understood why these students did not choose to leave; they were probably waiting for Yelena to appear.
After some time, Yelena finally walked onto the stage amidst the cheers of the crowd.
Connor stared at Yelena. Although he had not seen Yelena for a long time, he could still recognize that this woman was Yelena.
Today, Yelena was dressed very beautifully. She wore a loose white shirt and a pair of denim shorts. The shirt was very long and covered the denim shorts, revealing her slender and fair legs. She gave off an unusually sexy and beautiful feeling. There was a faint smile on her exquisite face and she was wearing a pair of black high heels.
Originally, Yelena's figure and appearance could already be considered the best among the best.
In addition to the training abroad, Yelena's temperament had also undergone earth-shaking changes.
He looked at Yelena on the stage with mixed feelings.
Maya turned her head to look at him, then pouted and said, "I didn't expect you to be so popular with women. I really don't understand why my cousin and Yelena like you. Is it because you're richer?"
Connor did not seem to hear Maya's words as he stared at Yelena.
Yelena smiled sweetly at the crowd below the stage and then waved her hand gently.
In an instant, everyone fell silent.
"I didn't expect that everyone would still remember me after I left for so long!"
Yelena said happily.
"Goddess Yelena, will you go back again? How's your filming going?"
"That's right, Goddess Yelena. Everyone misses you very much!"
Everyone shouted at the top of their lungs.
Yelena smiled and said softly, "It's like this. I haven't finished filming in the U.S., so I have to go back. I came back this time just to meet the person I wanted to see and also to attend the school anniversary…"
"See the person you want to see?"
When everyone heard Yelena's words, they could not help but reveal a puzzled expression.
"Goddess Yelena, who is the person you want to see?"
"Is it your family?"
"Goddess Yelena, you came back to see me, right?"
Everyone joked.
After Yelena heard these words, she smiled happily and said softly, "I came back this time to see my boyfriend!"
Goddess Yelena's boyfriend?"
"Could it be Mr. McDonald?"
"Is Goddess Yelena really with Mr. McDonald?"
"Isn't Mr. McDonald's girlfriend Freya Phillips?"
"Isn't it normal for Mr. McDonald to have a few women?"
Everyone began to discuss in low voices.
There were some rumors between Yelena and Connor, but at that time, everyone thought that Connor was just a poor loser and did not have the right to be with Yelena, so no one took it seriously.
After Yelena left the Porthampton University, Connor also left after exposing his identity, so everyone forgot about this matter.
After Yelena finished speaking, everyone began to guess who her boyfriend was!
Connor looked at Yelena. He knew very well that she must have come for him today.
But he didn't know how to deal with his relationship with her.
Yelena didn't say anything else and started singing after the music started.
Her singing was very pleasant to the ears, and everyone began to quietly appreciate it.
A few minutes later, the music slowly stopped.
Yelena bowed to the crowd and walked off the stage.
Connor took a deep breath when he saw Yelena walk off the stage. He then turned to Maya and said, "I have something to do. I'll leave first…"
When Maya heard his words, she couldn't help but hesitate for a moment before saying in a low voice, "Are you going to see Yelena?"
"Yes…"
Connor nodded.
"If you dare to do anything to my cousin, I will never let you off!"Maya said through gritted teeth.
Connor looked at Maya helplessly, then directly walked towards the exit of the square.
When he arrived at the exit of the square, he found Yelena already standing by the roadside waiting for him.
Under the illumination of the street lamps, she looked so charming and beautiful.
When Yelena saw him, her expression was also a little excited. Crystal tears flickered in her beautiful eyes. After all, she'd really missed him. At this moment, she finally saw the person she wanted to see the most.
Connor also stood in place and looked at Yelena under the streetlamp.
He really didn't want to hurt Yelena now, but he knew that if he couldn't handle these things well, he wouldn't be qualified to be with Freya.
He took a deep breath and walked towards Yelena.
Yelena couldn't control her emotions anymore. She ran towards Connor in her high heels and hugged him tightly.
Connor smelled the faint fragrance on Yelena's body, and a trace of hesitation flashed across his eyes. He was a little shaken again. He did not know how to open his mouth and tell Yelena about his matter.
"Why didn't you tell me you were back?"
Connor asked softly.
"I just wanted to give you a surprise! Are you surprised?"
Yelena replied happily and then said coquettishly, "I've finally seen you. Do you know that I've been thinking about you every minute and second during this period of time? Did you miss me?"
"I…"
Connor hesitated.
Yelena slowly raised her head and looked at Connor. It was as if she had observed something from his eyes. She instinctively let go of his arm and said softly, "Connor, what's wrong?"

chapters.title: Chapter 1454: We Don't Owe Each Other
chapters.content:
Chapter 1454: We Don't Owe Each Other
"Huff…"
Connor took a deep breath and said in a low voice, "Yelena, I have something to tell you!"
After Yelena heard his words, she could not help but be stunned.
She slowly raised her head and looked at Connor, as if she wanted to see something in his eyes.
"What a coincidence! You actually have something to tell me?"
Yelena let go of him and forced a smile.
Connor was stunned for a moment and asked.
"Do you have something to say to me too?"
"That's right. I came back this time because I have something to tell you…"
Yelena nodded gently.
"What do you want? You go first!"he asked.
"It's like this, Connor. I'm planning to set up an entertainment company so that it'll be easier for me to develop in the entertainment industry in the future. However, you also know that although I'm an internet celebrity, I don't have much money at all, so I want to ask you for some!"Yelena said softly.
"How much do you need?"
Connor asked without thinking.
"Actually, it's not that much. 50 million should be enough!"
Yelena's eyes flashed with a trace of strangeness, then she bit her lip and continued, "But don't you worry, I won't take this money for nothing, you give me this money, we two will have nothing to do with each other anymore, I won't disturb your life anymore, those things between you and me, I will also treat them all as a dream, absolutely no third person will know these things. So, what do you think?"
"Yelena, you…"
Connor stared at Yelena with wide eyes, shock on his face.
He didn't expect Yelena to end their relationship in such a way.
Moreover, he knew that Yelena did not lack money at all, so she did not really need the money. She was just using this excuse to make Connor feel at ease.
"I'm so rich now, and you're asking me for 50 million. Isn't that too little?"
Connor said in a low voice.
"I don't seem to be worth much, right? I still have some self-awareness!"At this moment, Yelena's voice was choking with sobs, and her eyes were slightly red. However, she still tried her best to control her emotions and not let herself cry.
Connor took a deep breath and said in a low voice, "Yelena, you're a good girl. I don't want to hold you back…"
"Alright, since I've already said so much, there's no need to pretend to be friendly with me. You slept with me on impulse, and now I'm relying on my body to get back the money I need. The two of us don't owe each other anything, and we each take what we need,"Yelena said expressionlessly.
"..."
Connor looked at Yelena in front of him. He knew in his heart that everything Yelena had said was to let him leave more confidently.
If Yelena didn't say such words, Connor might have been very determined, but after Yelena said these words, he found that he really couldn't continue to hurt her.
She'd flown all the way back from the U.S. to meet Connor, but what greeted her was actually such a result. This was unfair to Yelena.
In the end, this was probably his fault alone.
His mistake was that he should not have disturbed Yelena's life.
"Remember to transfer 50 million to my account!"Yelena said.
"I know!"
Connor gritted his teeth.
Yelena hesitated for a long time. Finally, she slowly said, "Connor, can I hug you one last time?"
"..."
Connor didn't say anything. Instead, he took the initiative to walk in front of Yelena and pulled her into his arms.
When Yelena was hugged by Connor, she finally could not control her emotions anymore. Tears flowed out of her eyes and her body trembled.
"Why are you always so sensible?"
Connor gritted his teeth and asked in a low voice.
"I originally thought that as long as I was a little sensible, I could always stay by your side, but I didn't expect that in the end, I didn't even have the qualifications to be your lover. I didn't want to be so sensible either, but if I'm not, then what? I just want to leave your life in a dignified way!"
After Yelena said this, she pushed Connor away and turned around to walk away.
Connor stood there with a dull look in his eyes. Although he didn't want Yelena to leave, there was a voice in his heart that told him that this was right.
He admitted that he was not a good man. However, if he really got to this position where he was surrounded by all kinds of beauties every day, how many people could be alone?
There were probably many people who couldn't do it, right?
He was only doing this to prevent Freya and Yelena from getting hurt.
The moment Yelena turned around, her tears fell like rain. She had never expected such an outcome.
Although Yelena had always known that Connor had a fiancée, she didn't care about these things at all. She wasn't even willing to fight for a high position—all she wanted to do was to stay by his side. Even if she was a mistress or a lover, as long as Connor still had her in his heart, it was enough.
However, Yelena had never expected that she had already lost the right to be a lover.
After some time, Connor saw Yelena's back disappear.
Meanwhile, Connor turned around helplessly and planned to head to the airport. After all, Freya was no longer in Porthampton. There was no point in him staying here any longer.
Connor walked along the road for nearly a few hundred meters. At this time, his mind kept recalling the scene of him meeting with Yelena.
"Beep beep…"
At this moment, a horn suddenly sounded behind Connor.
Connor turned around and saw Maya driving behind him.
"Are you done?"
Maya asked softly.
Connor ignored her.
"You made a mistake back then. Why do you make it seem like someone else offended you?"
Maya pouted, then continued, "But no matter what, you did quite well this time. At least you didn't become a scumbag. I won't tell my cousin about this. Don't worry…"
"..."
Connor still ignored Maya and continued walking forward.
"Hello? I'm talking to you! Didn't you hear me?"
Maya saw that Connor was silent and could not help but shout.

chapters.title: Chapter 1455: A Regular Kidnapper
chapters.content:
Chapter 1455: A Regular Kidnapper
"You little brat, go do what you should do…"
Connor scolded impatiently.
"You're the little brat. Do you want to go home now? Do you want me to drive you?"
Maya knew that Connor was in a bad mood, so she did not argue with him.
"Send me to the airport!"Connor said in a low voice after hesitating for a moment.
Connor knew that he had nothing else to do in Porthampton, so he asked Maya to drive him to the airport and bought a ticket to Newtown that night.
Connor had many things to do. If he couldn't get in touch with Yaakov Ward, who was the person-in-charge of Rockefeller in Orilon, he wouldn't be able to find out how his parents died.
Therefore, Connor still planned to deal with these things first, and then consider how to deal with Rockefeller's people.
"Ding, ding, ding…"
Just as Connor was waiting for the flight, his phone suddenly rang.
He realized that it was Thomas Morgan calling, so he picked up the phone.
"Mr. McDonald, I heard that you've returned to Porthampton?" Thomas asked anxiously.
"You're not well-informed, are you?"Connor replied, somewhat exasperated, then continued, "I've been back for a few days. I'm waiting for a flight now and ready to go back…"
"I just came back today. I've been out of town to inspect a project!"Thomas said with some embarrassment.
"The main reason I came back this time was to accompany Freya, nothing else. If you haven't seen her, then so be it!"Connor said with a smile.
"Mr. McDonald, it's good that you're fine..."
Thomas replied softly after hearing his words.
"By the way, contact Yelena's people and transfer 50 million to her account…Forget it, I'll give her 500 million…"
Connor said expressionlessly.
"Alright, I got it!"
Thomas agreed.
Connor took a deep breath and hung up the phone. He had no way to make it up to Yelena. All he could think of now was to give her more money.
Although Yelena might not be short of money at all, Connor could only do so much now.
Connor waited in the waiting room for almost a long time before finally boarding the plane.
He turned off his phone and closed his eyes to rest.
At around eight in the morning, Connor finally arrived at Newtown.
After getting off the plane, he immediately took out his phone and turned it on.
After turning on the phone, Connor realized that there were several calls from Freya. Connor knew that Freya must have something important to talk to him about, so he called her back.
"Freya, why did you call me so many times?"
Connor asked in a low voice.
"Connor, I ran into a group of kidnappers yesterday!"
Freya hurriedly said.
"Kidnappers?"When Connor heard this, a trace of shock flashed across his eyes, and then he hurriedly said, "Are you in danger now?"
"Don't worry. With Carlos and Diana around, I'll be fine. I just wanted to inform you…"Freya replied.
"It's good that you're fine!"
Connor let out a long sigh of relief when he heard Freya's words. Then, he asked again, "What's going on with these kidnappers you met?"
"I'm not too sure either, but these kidnappers were all foreigners!" Freya said softly.
"Well, pass the phone to Carlos. Let me talk to him…" Connor said in a low voice.
"Alright, wait a moment!"
Freya replied softly before passing the phone to Carlos.
Connor frowned and asked, "Carlos, what's going on with the kidnappers you've met?"
"Mr. McDonald, you don't have to worry too much. These kidnappers are probably ordinary kidnappers and not martial artists. I dealt with them easily..."
Carlos said slowly.
"Are you sure it's just an ordinary kidnapper?"
Connor asked.
"I should probably be able to confirm it. After all, if it was Rockefeller's people, they definitely wouldn't hire ordinary people to kidnap Miss Phillips!"
Carlos answered.
Connor's expression eased up a little after hearing Carlos's words. After all, what Connor was most worried about now was that Rockefeller's men had made a move on Freya.
If they were really Rockefeller's men, even Carlos would not be a match for them.
Connor thought for a moment. "Why don't I come find you now?"
"Mr. McDonald, Miss Phillips has already met with the investors. We originally planned to stay here for a few more days, but because of this matter, we're going back early…" Carlos said slowly.
"Alright then, you must protect Freya's safety!"
Connor instructed in a serious tone.
"Mr. McDonald, don't worry!"
Carlos said hurriedly.
Connor asked Carlos to return the phone to Freya, then said a few words to her.
Because Freya had already planned to return to Porthampton, it would be too late for Connor to go there in time, so he canceled the idea of going to Europe.
After ending the call with Freya, Connor hailed a taxi and returned home.
When he arrived home, it was past ten in the morning. Rachel should have gone to school by now, so Connor rested at home.
…
Meanwhile, in a private clubhouse in Newtown.
Tenner Ward sat on the sofa with a gloomy expression.
Arthur Synder sat opposite Tenner, looking a little nervous.
Tenner gritted his teeth. "What do you want me to say about you? I told you to find a few professional assassins to kidnap Freya Phillips, but in the end, you actually made things like this…"
"I didn't know that Freya would actually had a bodyguard by her side. Moreover, that bodyguard of hers was very powerful, which was why the plan failed…"
Arthur said helplessly.
"I originally planned to use this opportunity to deal with Connor. Now that all my plans have failed, Connor will definitely be on guard. What do you think we should do?" Tenner asked with a frown.
After hearing Tenner's words, a hint of helplessness flashed across Arthur's eyes. He took a deep breath and did not say anything.
He couldn't think of any solution now.
"Ding, ding, ding…"
However, at that moment, Tenner's phone rang.
Tenner picked up his phone and glanced at it, upon which the expression on his face changed instantly. He hurriedly picked up the call and said with an unusually respectful expression, "President Ward, did you need something?"
"Hurry over to my place now…"
The other party said in a low voice.
"Alright, I understand…"
Tenner quickly agreed and hung up.

chapters.title: Chapter 1456: Chieko
chapters.content:
Chapter 1456: Chieko
After returning home, Connor slept until four in the afternoon.
When Connor woke up, he found that Rachel had already returned.
At this moment, he was sitting on the sofa and watching television.
"You're back?"
Connor stretched and walked out of the bedroom, asking Rachel softly.
"Yes…"
Rachel lightly nodded. After which, she turned her head to look at Connor and asked indifferently, "Why did you go back to Porthampton these past few days?"
"What else could I have done? I just went back to spend some time with my fiancée for a few days. Then, I participated in the joint school anniversary held by the three universities in Porthampton and played a piano piece there…"
Connor walked to the fridge and opened it, looking for something to eat.
However, there was nothing in the fridge.
"There's nothing to eat in the house?" He asked Rachel exasperatedly.
"Doesn't seem like it," Rachel said indifferently.
"What about the snacks you usually eat?"
Connor asked again.
"I've already eaten them all. Do you want to go out and buy some for me now?"
After Connor heard Rachel's words, his expression was unusually exasperated. He pursed his lips and said, "I'm going out to eat. Do you want to come with me?"
"I'm not going. I'm on a diet!"
Rachel shook her head.
"Then I'll go by myself…"
After Connor said this, he pushed open the door and walked out.
After walking out of the neighborhood, Connor originally planned to call Justin and Brooks out, but they were still in class, so he could only go to a random noodle shop by himself.
After entering the noodle shop, Connor found that there were not many people inside, so he casually sat down on a chair.
The waiter walked to Connor with the menu and asked him with a smile, "What would you like to eat?"
Connor glanced at the menu and said calmly, "Just give me a bowl of beef noodles!"
"Okay, please wait a moment!"
The waiter agreed and turned to leave.
Connor took out his phone. Looking at the missed calls and messages, most of them were useless, so Connor put his phone aside.
A few minutes later, the waiter came back with a bowl of steaming beef noodles and said softly to Connor, "Your noodles are ready…"
"Thank you!"
Connor looked at the waiter and smiled. Then, he picked up his chopsticks and started eating.
Although Connor was very rich now, his living habits had not changed much.
He still liked to eat the things he used to like, and he still disliked the things he used to dislike.
Connor often came to this noodle shop at the entrance of the community. He liked the beef noodles here very much.
However, after eating two mouthfuls, Connor suddenly realized that there was something wrong with today's noodles. The taste seemed a little different from before.
"Waiter…"
Connor shouted out instinctively, but before he could finish, he felt a wave of dizziness in his head, as if the world was spinning.
Connor was sure that it was the problem with the noodles. Someone must have drugged them.
He immediately took out his phone and prepared to make a call.
At this time, Connor had no time to think about who to call. All he wanted to do was to spread the news of his poisoning.
However, the effect of the drug was very fast. Before Connor could take out his phone, he collapsed.
"Clang!"
His head smashed hard on the table. Connor did not know what happened next.
…
After an unknown period of time, Connor slowly opened his eyes.
The moment Connor opened his eyes, he felt as if his head had been smashed into pieces. Moreover, he did not know what had happened at all. He only remembered that he had eaten a bowl of noodles and then passed out.
It took Connor a long time to get used to his headache. Then, he simply observed his surroundings.
At this moment, Connor was in a room. The room was decorated in a faintly Japanese manner, and there was a big kanji calligraphy piece hanging on the wall.
The room was very good, but at this time, Connor was tightly bound by a very sturdy rope. He struggled for a while, but could not break free.
"Is anyone there?"
Connor shouted helplessly, but no one responded for a long time.
He knew that he had been kidnapped, but he was not sure who had kidnapped him.
"Creak…"
At this moment, the door was suddenly pushed open from the outside.
Connor looked up at the door and saw a mature woman with a nice figure walking in. She was wearing a black dress and a pair of high heels. Her figure was very nice. She had a standard S-shaped figure and her appearance was exquisite and charming. There was a hint of coldness in her eyes, and her long purple hair added a bit of charm to her beautiful face.
Although this woman's appearance could not be considered to be devastatingly beautiful, her face was constantly emitting waves of seduction. Moreover, her figure was also very hot. Her full chest and beautiful legs were emitting waves of fatal temptation. Any man who saw such a woman would have a kind of impulse.
However, Connor was not in the mood to care about these things. He kept recalling who this woman was in his mind, but no matter how he thought about it, he could not remember ever meeting this woman.
Behind the woman was a burly man. The man was probably over forty years old. He was tall and had a determined expression on his face.
Connor could feel that this brawny man was probably a martial artist with a rather high rank.
"Mr. McDonald, you are well!"
The woman took the initiative to walk in front of him and said softly to Connor.
"Who are you?"
Connor asked expressionlessly.
"My name is Chieko!"
the woman said lightly.
"Chieko?"
When Connor heard this name, he couldn't help but be stunned. He felt that this didn't seem to be an Opranian name.
"Mr. McDonald, you don't have to be curious. I'm Opranian, but my mother is Japanese, which is why I have this name."
Chieko seemed to have noticed his confusion and took the initiative to explain herself.

chapters.title: Chapter 1457: Cooperation?
chapters.content:
Chapter 1457: Cooperation?
Connor carefully sized up Chieko from the beginning to the end. In the end, he was sure that he really did not know this woman.
"I don't think I've ever met you before. Why did you kidnap me?"
Connor asked expressionlessly.
At this moment, his expression was relatively calm because he knew that if the other party really wanted to kill him, then they could have just attacked directly. There was no need to say so much nonsense, and they would not have kept him until now.
And Connor knew that this Chieko lady was probably not a member of Rockefeller. The people of Rockefeller had always been very ruthless, so if Connor had really fallen into the hands of those people, he would definitely be dead now.
"Mr. McDonald, I didn't mean to harm you by inviting you here in this way!" Chieko said.
"Didn't mean to harm me?" When Connor heard Chieko's words, he couldn't help but sneer. He then said expressionlessly, "If you really didn't mean to harm me, why did you kidnap me?"
"I was just worried that you'll run away, Mr. McDonald!"
Chieko explained.
Connor glanced at Chieko and said in a low voice, "Then can you let go of me now?"
"Of course!"
Chieko nodded and turned to look at the burly man beside her.
The brawny man walked in front of him and helped him untie the rope.
After the rope was untied, Connor stretched his body and asked, "Why did you kidnap me here?"
"I want to work with you, Mr. McDonald!"
Chieko replied.
"Cooperate?"
Connor smiled disdainfully when he heard this, and then said lightly, "I'm sorry, I don't know you well now, and I don't know who you are, so I won't work with you!"
"Mr. McDonald, I suggest you listen to me!"
Chieko frowned.
"If you really want to cooperate with me, you shouldn't have kidnapped me in this way. Since you chose this method, it means that you don't have any sincerity to cooperate at all!"
Connor interrupted her and promptly walked out of the room.
"Mr. McDonald, although I have already untied you, it doesn't mean that you can leave here now!" Chieko said calmly.
"Is that so?"
Connor asked in disdain.
"Indeed!"
Chieko didn't say anything, but the burly man who had helped Connor untie the ropes walked up to him and blocked his way.
It was obvious that this brawny man did not take Connor seriously. He felt that Connor was not a match for him.
Connor looked at the burly man up and down, then said with a disdainful expression, "Do you think you can stop me?"
"I think so, yes."
The middle-aged man nodded.
"Haha…"
Connor couldn't help but sneer when he heard this. Then, he said indifferently, "Looks like you guys didn't do your homework before you attacked me. Don't you know that I'm also a martial artist?"
"Of course I know that you are a martial artist, Mr. McDonald. However, there are also differences in strength between martial artists!"
Chieko shouted.
Connor turned to look at Chieko and nodded. "You're right. There are indeed strong and weak martial artists, but how do you know that this person is stronger than me?"
"We'll know if I'm strong or not after you try me!"
The brawny man was able to feel the disdain in his words, and the expression on his face was somewhat angry.
Chieko knew very well that if she didn't teach Connor a lesson, he wouldn't listen to her. Therefore, she didn't stop the burly man.
Seeing that Chieko did not say anything, the burly man rushed toward Connor.
Connor took a deep breath. Just as the burly man was about to rush in front of him, Connor turned his hand and punched his chest.
He was no longer the same as before—his control of the Seven Star Big Dipper Fist had also improved greatly, and the power of his punch was now comparable to a Black-rank's punch.
This was the freakiest aspect of the Seven Stars Big Dipper Fist.
Originally, the burly man thought that Connor was just an ordinary martial artist, so he did not take him seriously at all.
Naturally, he was not prepared for his punch.
"Bang!"
Connor's fist ruthlessly smashed into the burly man's chest. The man's body instantly flew out and then ruthlessly crashed into the wooden door.
For a moment, Chieko was stunned on the spot. Her face was filled with shock and disbelief because she did not expect his skills to be so terrifying.
The man who was sent flying by Connor was called Gael Harris. He came from the ancient martial arts world, and he was now a high-level Yellow-ranked warrior. He had been with Chieko for a long time, and Chieko knew Gael's strength very well.
However, Chieko never expected Gael to be so weak when faced with Connor.
Connor didn't expect his punch to have such terrifying power, either. Proudly, he turned to Chieko. "Are you planning to use this person to stop me?"
"Kid, you don't have to be arrogant. I was careless just now!"
At this moment, a furious roar suddenly came from outside the house, followed by the sound of hurried footsteps.
Gael quickly rushed into the room, his expression unusually angry as he stared at Connor with a ferocious gaze.
Connor looked at Gael indifferently, then said in a very calm tone, "You're not a match for me at all. I advise you not to humiliate yourself!"
"Me? Humiliate myself?"
When Gael heard his words, the expression on his face became even angrier because he had never been humiliated like this before.
After all, although a high level yellow class wasn't a strong fighter in his eyes—he had fought a Black-ranked fighter before—in real life, fighters were very rare, and people who could become a high level Yellow-rank were even rarer.
Therefore, Gael could not accept such humiliation.
Chieko looked at Connor with a helpless expression and sighed softly, "Can't we have a good chat? Why do we have to do it the hard way?"

chapters.title: Chapter 1458: Exchange of Blows
chapters.content:
Chapter 1458: Exchange of Blows
A martial artist's ranks were divided into four levels: Heaven, Earth, Black, and Yellow. These four levels were further divided into low, middle, high, and top tiers.
Gael himself was a high level yellow class warrior. No matter where he was, he was a very respected existence.
Therefore, Gael had never been humiliated like this before.
At this moment, Connor's words had deeply provoked Gael.
"Brat, I'll definitely kill you today!" Gael growled and then rushed towards Connor.
It could be seen that Gael was really serious at this moment. His speed and strength were extremely shocking, making him resemble a fierce tiger.
Any ordinary person standing in front of Gael would have been scared silly by now.
However, Connor knew that Gael's strength might be below his, so he was very calm. He didn't even have the intention to dodge.
Gael had been by Chieko's side for so many years and had always been addressed as Master Harris. He had never been humiliated like this before. Therefore, he had made up his mind to teach Connor a lesson and make him understand how powerful he was so that he wouldn't lose Chieko's trust in him.
By now, Gael had almost exhausted all his strength. His physical fitness was actually very terrifying. Even if he fought against martial artists of the same level, he would have a great advantage, so he was very confident in himself. After all, Connor was so young; there was absolutely no way he'd have any strength beyond a beginner martial artist.
In the blink of an eye, Gael had arrived in front of him. He raised his fist and smashed it fiercely towards Connor's head.
If the person standing in front of Gael was really an ordinary person, their skull would probably be smashed by his punch.
Meanwhile, Connor had a calm expression on his face as he slowly raised his right hand and grabbed Gael's wrist.
Gael's expression was one of surprise, and he quickly continued to exert his strength.
However, Gael discovered that no matter how much strength he exerted, his right hand did not move at all. From this point, one could see how terrifying Connor's strength was.
"Ah…"
Gael gritted his teeth and roared angrily, placing all the energy in his body on his right hand.
Because Connor was relatively close to Gael, Connor could clearly feel that Gael's heartbeat was very fast. The veins on his arms were also bulging. This was already the maximum limit that Gael's body could withstand.
Unfortunately, this bit of strength was too insignificant in his eyes.
No matter how much strength Gael exerted, Connor stood on the spot without moving at all.
Chieko stared at Connor, shock in her beautiful eyes. She really couldn't understand why he had such terrifying strength.
"I've already told you not to humiliate yourself…"
Connor wasn't in the mood to waste time with a person like Gael and promptly backhanded him.
"Bang!"
His fist directly smashed into Gael's chest.
Gael's body was sent flying, and then he smashed into the wall.
"Master Harris!"
Chieko couldn't help but cry out when she saw Gael being sent flying by his punch.
Gael originally intended to struggle to stand up, but the power of Connor's punch was too terrifying. Gael felt as if he had been hit by a truck just now. Now, his internal organs were aching faintly, and he could not use any strength at all.
"Miss, our information might be wrong. This person's strength is definitely above mine!"
Gael sat on the ground and looked at Chieko with a pained expression.
"..."
Chieko stared at Connor with a strange expression.
She had never thought that things would end up like this.
Connor had actually sent Gael flying with a single punch!
Chieko bit her lip. "Looks like we have underestimated you…"
Connor hesitated for a moment before walking toward her.
Chieko's expression was a little flustered, and her body began to tremble slightly. She knew very well that if Connor wanted to kill her, it would be very easy.
Her heart was filled with fear. She originally thought that Connor was just an ordinary martial artist, so it should not be a problem for Gael to deal with Connor alone. However, she did not expect his strength to be so terrifying.
A few seconds later, Connor stood in front of her.
Chieko couldn't help but take a deep breath, then pretended to be calm and asked Connor in a low voice, "What do you want?"
"I should be the one asking you this, right?"
Connor replied indifferently.
"Mr. McDonald, killing me won't do you any good!"
Chieko shouted.
Connor sneered and said indifferently, "I think you might have misunderstood. I have never thought of killing you, and I will not kill anyone…"
Although Connor was now a martial artist, his way of thinking was the same as ordinary people. He would not use his own strength to do something that violated the law. If he could not kill, Connor would try his best not to hurt others.
After Chieko knew that Connor wouldn't kill her, her expression became much calmer. She sized up Connor and asked in a low voice, "Since you don't plan to kill me, then what do you want?"
Connor walked to Chieko's side and casually picked up the teacup on the table. He poured himself a cup of tea and said with a smile, "Not killing you doesn't mean that I won't do anything to you. If I'm not wrong, you should have brought someone with you today!"
"..."
Chieko looked at Connor without saying anything.
His guess was right. The fact that Chieko had come into contact with Connor could not be known to too many people. Moreover, she was very confident in Gael's skills, so she did not bring anyone else with her.
If Connor really wanted to do something to her, she wouldn't be able to resist.

chapters.title: Chapter 1459: The Dullahan Family
chapters.content:
Chapter 1459: The Dullahan Family
Inside the house, Chieko sat on the spot. Her delicate body was trembling non-stop, and her expression was very nervous.
After all, she had only heard some rumors about the outside world, but she had never really come into contact with Connor. She didn't know his personality at this moment, nor did she know how Connor planned to deal with her.
Chieko was already a beautiful woman. Coupled with her nice figure and beautiful face, it was difficult for an average man not to have other desires.
Connor walked up to Chieko and gently pinched her chin.
Chieko was very smart. She knew that she couldn't resist because if she did, Connor might not do anything.
"You... What are you trying to do?"
She shouted at Connor nervously.
"You will answer every question I ask. If you dare to lie to me, I'll make you wish you were dead. Do you understand what I mean?"
Connor said calmly.
"..."
Chieko bit her lip and looked at Connor without saying anything.
At this moment, she felt that she had shot herself in the foot. She had originally wanted to kidnap Connor to use him, but she never expected things to turn out like this.
"Why did you kidnap me?"
Connor asked Chieko in a low voice.
"I... I wanted to cooperate with you!"
Chieko said expressionlessly.
"Cooperate?" Connor was stunned for a moment, and then asked indifferently, "How do you plan to cooperate?"
"I want to cooperate with you to deal with Yaakov Ward!"
Chieko replied.
"You want to cooperate with me to deal with Yaakov?"
When Connor heard her words, he was shocked. He didn't expect Chieko to be going against Yaakov Ward.
"What's your relationship with Yaakov Ward? Why do you want to deal with him?"
Connor was very calm. He couldn't believe Chieko just because of what she was saying.
"Yaakov is the murderer of my parents. I have an irreconcilable hatred for him in this life!"
Chieko gritted her teeth.
"..."
Connor looked at Chieko without saying anything.
"My father is Ian Dullahan, a member of the Dullahan family in Hondoria!"
Chieko continued after seeing that Connor didn't say anything.
"And then?"
"If you were in Hondoria, you would know about the Dullahan family. When I was young, the Dullahan family was one of the more famous families in Hondoria. My mother was a Japanese celebrity, Yoshiko Umi. My father and my mother fell in love at first sight. After they got married, they lived in Hondoria."
Chieko paused for a moment before continuing, "Originally, Yaakov and my father were considered good friends and business partners. However, because Yaakov drank too much and raped my mother, my father wanted to take revenge on him after finding out about this. However, Yaakov's power was too terrifying. At that time, our Dullahan family was not a match for him at all. In the end, not only did Yaakov kill my father, but he also took over all the Dullahan family's businesses!"
"..."
Connor looked at Chieko and hesitated for two seconds before saying expressionlessly, "How do I know if what you said is true or false?"
"If you don't believe me, you can go to Hondoria to investigate it. These things were not secrets at all," she said calmly.
Connor looked at Chieko and didn't say anything because he felt that what she said made sense. Connor only needed to investigate casually to find out if she was telling the truth.
"Mr. McDonald, I know that it's inappropriate to meet you in this way, but I had no other choice because I've always lived in the Dullahan family. Now, the Dullahan family is completely under Yaakov's thumb. Even my uncle listens to Yaakov's words and doesn't resist, so this was the only way I could contact you!" she explained.
"Even if what you said is true, even if you really have an irreconcilable hatred with Yaakov, it doesn't seem to have anything to do with me, right?"
Connor said expressionlessly.
"Mr. McDonald, don't you want to deal with Yaakov Ward?"
Chieko asked in surprise.
"Who told you that I wanted to deal with him?"
Connor asked with a smile while drinking tea.
"I came to Newtown because I heard that you were preparing to deal with the people of Rockefeller. Isn't that the case?"
Chieko was dumbfounded. After all, if Connor did not plan to deal with Yaakov, then he might be in trouble.
"Haha…"
Connor couldn't help but laugh when he heard this. Then, he said indifferently, "Looks like everyone already knows that I want to deal with Yaakov…"
"You are Mr. Steven Lee's heir, and Mr. Steven Lee's biggest enemy in his life is Rockefeller, so I think you will definitely make a move on Rockefeller!"
Her expression softened a little when she saw Connor admit it.
Connor smiled and said, "You're right, I do intend to deal with Rockefeller. I also want to deal with Yaakov…but I don't intend to join forces with you!"
"Why?"
Chieko asked in confusion.
"Because I don't trust you. I think I can deal with those people from Rockefeller by myself. I don't need anyone's help at all. Working with you won't make it easy to deal with Yaakov," Connor said calmly.
"Mr. McDonald, if you cooperate with me, it will only make it easier for you to deal with Yaakov!" Chieko shouted excitedly.
"Have you ever seen Yaakov?"
"No…" Chieko shook her head.
"Then do you know Yaakov?"
"I don't know him very well either…"
Connor smiled helplessly and then said lightly, "You don't know Yaakov, and you've never seen him. Then why should I cooperate with you? What can I get from you? What can you help me with? Is it because you're pretty? Do I have to help you just because your figure is a little nice?"
"..."
Chieko was rendered speechless by his words. After hesitating for two seconds, she said, "Mr. McDonald, I really can't do anything you say, but I can provide you with a very important piece of news!"

chapters.title: Chapter 1460: Yelena Was Kidnapped
chapters.content:
Chapter 1460: Yelena Was Kidnapped
"Very important news?"
After hearing her words, Connor couldn't help but be stunned for a moment. His expression was a little puzzled.
"What do you mean by that?"
Connor asked expressionlessly.
"As long as Mr. McDonald agrees to cooperate with me, I can tell you what this news is…"
Chieko said calmly.
Connor couldn't help but sneer. He stepped forward and grabbed her fair and slender neck. He said, "I think you might not understand the current situation. I'm not discussing anything with you. If you dare to continue talking nonsense, I can't guarantee that you'll ever walk out of this room safely!"
Facing his threat, Chieko's expression was a little strange. She said softly, "Mr. McDonald, if you really kill me now, you might regret it for the rest of your life!"
"Are you going to tell me or not?"
Connor wasn't in the mood to talk nonsense with Chieko. He gradually increased the strength in his hand.
Chieko could clearly feel that her breathing had become difficult, and her face was slightly red from suffocation. However, Connor did not seem to have any intention of letting her go. He continued to increase the strength in his hands.
"Stop, I…I'll tell you, okay?"
Chieko finally couldn't hold on any longer. She shouted at Connor with a pained expression.
After hearing her words, Connor slowly let go and said expressionlessly, "What exactly do you want to tell me?"
Chieko hesitated for a moment before taking out a photo and placing it on the table.
Connor looked down at the photo and froze on the spot.
The person in the photo was none other than Yelena!
In the photo, Yelena's mouth was stuffed with a sackcloth and her hands and feet were tied together. It was obvious that she had been kidnapped.
"Where did you get this photo?"
Connor asked excitedly.
"This was sent to me by my spy in the Dullahan family. Now, the Dullahan family has kidnapped this woman..."
Chieko replied.
"Why did the Dullahan family kidnap Yelena?"
Connor asked doubtfully.
"Isn't this simple? It must be to deal with you, Mr. McDonald!"
Chieko replied softly before continuing, "Mr. McDonald, I've already told you before that the entire Dullahan family is now under Yaakov's control. Therefore, it was probably Yaakov's intention for the Dullahan family to kidnap this woman…"
Connor looked at the photo in front of him and fell into deep thought.
Previously, Connor had thought that Yaakov and the others would only attack Freya and him. However, he never expected that Yaakov would already know about his relationship with Yelena.
The people that Freya had met in the U.K. were probably Yaakov's men. However, they did not expect Freya to be under Carlos's protection, so their plan failed.
However, when their plan failed, they did not choose to give up. Instead, they moved their target to Yelena.
In fact, if it wasn't because Yelena had met Connor, she might not be in danger.
"Where is Yelena now?"
Connor shouted excitedly at Chieko.
"According to the news from my spy in the Dullahan family, this woman should still be in the Dullahan family, but she might be taken somewhere else by Yaakov's people at any time. I contacted you as soon as I heard this news!" Chieko replied.
"How can I believe that what you said is true?"
Connor in a low voice.
"Mr. McDonald, do you think I still need to lie to you at a time like this?"
"..."
Connor stood there and hesitated for two seconds. Then, he stepped forward and grabbed her neck.
her face was filled with fear as she hurriedly shouted at Connor, "Mr. McDonald, I really didn't lie to you. What I said is all I know. I did all this because I wanted to cooperate with you!"
"I'll know if what you said is true or not!"
Connor replied expressionlessly, then took out a pill and threw it into her mouth.
Chieko expression became even more fearful. She wanted to spit out the pill.
However, Connor hit her neck hard, and Chieko instinctively swallowed the pill.
"What did you feed me? What do you want?"
Chieko shouted excitedly at Connor.
Although she only felt her body heating up, the inexplicable fear still made her heart tremble involuntarily.
"You don't have to be nervous. This medicine won't kill you immediately, but if you don't get the antidote from me in a month, you will die from the poison. So from now on, you will do whatever I tell you to do. If you dare to disobey my orders or do anything that is not beneficial to me, then don't even think about getting the antidote from me!"
Connor said to Chieko expressionlessly.
A trace of fear flashed across her beautiful eyes. She never thought that Connor would have such a poison.
However, Connor had only given her an ordinary Body Tempering Pill. It was very helpful to martial artists and could also strengthen the body of ordinary people.
There was no way he would carry poison with him.
He only did this to make Chieko behave herself.
"What I said just now is true. I just want to cooperate with you!"
Chieko shouted in fear.
"Whether what you said is true or not, we'll talk about it after I save Yelena. If I can save her safely, then you can live. If Yelena is in any danger, you'll die too!" Connor said lightly.
"Are you crazy? I wasn't the one who kidnapped Yelena. Why are you doing this to me?"
Chieko screamed in despair.
"How would I know what your relationship with the Dullahan family and Yaakov is? If you really didn't lie to me, then you naturally don't have anything to worry about!" Connor said calmly.
Chieko hesitated for a moment before asking Connor in a low voice, "If I'm not lying to you, would you really give me the antidote?"

chapters.title: Chapter 1461: Heading for Honduria
chapters.content:
Chapter 1461: Heading for Honduria
"Of course!"
Connor nodded.
Chieko looked at Connor in despair.
According to the information that Chieko had obtained, many people were under the impression that Connor was just an ordinary person that had only gotten Steven Lee's inheritance because he was lucky. If it weren't for the protection of Steven Lee's confidants, Connor would just be a rich heir with nothing to do.
That was why Chieko planned to use Connor to deal with Yaakov.
However, after interacting with Connor for a while, Chieko realized that she had underestimated him.
Connor was not a good-for-nothing lout—On the contrary, he was an extremely terrifying martial artist and was also a meticulous planner.
Not only did Chieko fail to make use of him, but she ended up being used by him instead.
However, when she thought about it, she realized that this might not be a bad thing; after all, as long as Connor could deal with Yaakov's people, Chieko would have achieved her goal regardless of the circumstances.
"Yelena is still in the Dullahan family, right?"
Connor asked Chieko softly.
"That's right!"
Chieko nodded and continued, "Yelena originally went to Hondoria to participate in a movie promotion, but she was kidnapped by the Dullahan family as soon as she got off the plane. Moreover, the Dullahan family has some influence in Hondoria, so they quickly blocked this from spreading to the news."
"Then do you think Yelena will be in danger if she's in the hands of the Dullahan family?"
Connor asked.
At this moment, Connor no longer needed to tell whether Chieko was telling the truth or not. After all, Chieko felt that her life was in his hands. She did not have the guts to lie.
"Probably not!" Chieko shook her head at Connor and continued, "The Dullahan family is just following Yaakov's orders. My uncle is now completely under Yaakov's control. The real purpose of Yaakov kidnapping Yelena is to deal with you, Mr. McDonald. Therefore, under normal circumstances, Yelena is a very good trump card in Yaakov's hands, so he won't hurt her!"
"If that's the case, then it's a little better…"
Connor let out a long sigh.
Iit was fine as long as Yelena was not in any danger.
Although Connor had completely broken up with Yelena, he would not watch her fall into danger because of him.
Therefore, Connor would not sit idly by!
Connor hesitated for a moment before taking out his phone and dialing Thomas Morgan's number.
After the call went through, he briefly told Thomas about the situation on his side and asked Thomas to book two tickets to Hondoria.
Connor didn't know much about the situation in Hondoria, so he planned to bring Chieko with him. It would be much more convenient.
Of course, Thomas didn't agree with Connor going to Hondoria alone. He wanted to help Connor find some helpers there.
However, Connor didn't want to alert the enemy. If Yaakov found out that Connor had gone to Hondoria, they might transfer Yelena to another place. By then, it would be more difficult for Connor to find her.
After Thomas persuaded Connor, he found that Connor would not change his mind, so he could only helplessly agree.
"I've already asked someone to book the plane tickets," Connor said to Chieko after he put down his phone.
Chieko couldn't help but be stunned when she heard his words. She frowned and said, "Mr. McDonald, are you planning to go to Hondoria alone?"
"Don't I still have you?"
Connor said indifferently.
"Mr. McDonald, don't joke around. Although the Dullahan family is not the same as before, they're still one of the top clans in Hondoria. If you go there so brazenly, you're just courting death!"
Chieko said excitedly.
"Courting death?"
Connor couldn't help but laugh coldly, and then said lightly, "If I were to bring a large group of helpers over, the Dullahan family would definitely be aware of it. It's just not convenient to bring too many people with me in this situation!"
"But…"
"There are no buts. I know what I should do. You just need to do as I say!"
Connor said expressionlessly.
Chieko really couldn't understand where his confidence came from, but she could feel that his attitude was very firm, so she didn't dare to say anything more. She took a deep breath and remained silent.
…
An hour later, Connor and Chieko arrived at the airport in a taxi.
After entering the venue, Connor realized that Chieko was too eye-catching, so much so that almost every other man would inevitably turn his head to stare at her. This made Connor feel a little uneasy; after all, he didn't know if Yaakov's men were in the airport.
Connor turned to look at Chieko. At this moment, she had already changed into an ordinary person's clothes. She was wearing a white cotton T-shirt and a pair of denim shorts, exposing her slender and fair legs. She was wearing a pair of high heels.
With her hot figure, exquisite face, and cold temperament, such a woman would naturally attract the attention of countless people at the airport.
"Your appearance is too eye-catching…"
Connor said to Chieko.
"I've already tried my best to dress up as ordinary as possible…"
Chieko seemed helpless as she replied to Connor softly.
"Come with me…"
Connor noticed that there was a shop selling sunglasses in the airport, so he brought Chieko in and randomly picked out two pairs of sunglasses for her.
After putting on the sunglasses, Connor realized that there was fewer strangers paying attention to the two of them.
Most of the people were focused on her beautiful legs, so no one noticed their appearances.
After waiting in the VIP lounge for nearly half an hour, Connor and Chieko finally boarded the plane.
Since Thomas had booked a first-class ticket, there were not many people in the cabin. Most of them were rich people, so no one paid attention to Connor and Chieko. Most of them were focused on their phones.
..

chapters.title: Chapter 1462: Enemy Territory
chapters.content:
Chapter 1462: Enemy Territory
The plane took off at five o'clock in the afternoon.
Hondoria was very far from Newtown, so it would take about five to six hours to get there.
Therefore, it was late at night when Connor and Chieko arrived.
Fortunately, Connor was not in a hurry because he knew that Yelena would not be in any danger for the time being.
After the plane took off, Connor took out the Chi Circulation Scroll that Jorge had given him and began to practice what was written in it.
Chieko was curious about what he was doing, but she didn't ask anything. She just closed her eyes and rested.
The Chi Circulation Scroll was actually a secret book that taught you how to use the aura in your body. If a martial artist could skillfully control the aura in their body and transform the aura around them into their own strength, it would be very terrifying for their combat strength.
Connor knew that he would definitely encounter a lot of trouble when he went to Hondoria to save Yelena. After all, it was Rockefeller's men who did it. It would not be easy to save Yelena.
Therefore, the only thing Connor could do now was to increase his strength as soon as possible. This way, his chances of saving Yelena would be higher.
Perhaps it was because Connor had taken the Essence Cultivating Pill, but his current talent was very shocking. The method to circulate Chi was divided into nine levels, and Connor only took a little more than an hour to finish learning the first level.
The first level of the Chi Circulation Scroll was mainly to teach martial artists how to control the aura in their bodies.
Not only could the aura in a martial artist's body strengthen an attack, but it could also help a martial artist play a defensive role in combat.
This was the first time Connor felt that the world of martial artists was actually so wonderful.
This aura was similar to the internal strength in martial arts novels.
After Connor learned how to use his aura, he could not help but mutter to himself, "I didn't expect the things in the novels to be true!"
…
On the other side.
Connor and Chieko had just boarded the plane when Tenner received a call from Arthur.
"President Ward, you guessed it right. Connor is already on the plane, and there's a woman beside him!"
Arthur said in a low voice.
"Did you see that woman's appearance clearly?"
Tenner hurriedly asked.
"I didn't see it clearly. The woman was wearing sunglasses, but her figure was very good!"
Arthur replied.
"It seems that Chieko is still harboring evil intentions. She's actually with Connor…"
Tenner could not help but laugh coldly.
"Who is Chieko?"
Arthur asked with some doubt.
"Chieko is a member of the Dullahan family!"
"Mr. Ward, what should we do now?" Arthur asked again.
"I'll call President Ward now and ask for his opinion!"
Tenner didn't know what to do either, so he hung up after replying in a low voice.
After Tenner hung up the phone, he called Yaakov and told him about how Connor and Chieko boarded the plane together.
"President Ward, should we change that woman?"
Tenner asked softly.
"No need. I've already made arrangements in Hondoria. If Connor dares to get off the plane, he won't be able to leave Hondoria!"
Yaakov said indifferently.
When Tenner heard Yaakov's words, he instantly understood what Yaakov meant. He chuckled and said, "President Ward, you're very brilliant!"
"I purposely placed that woman in Hondoria. The reason why Chieko got the news was all because of me. The purpose was to lure Connor to Hondoria. After all, Steven Lee's power and Jorge Yarrell's influence means nothing there. Therefore, Hondoria is the last place Connor should go in his life. Once Connor enters Hondoria, he will die!"
Yaakov said indifferently.
"President Ward, I understand what you mean. Then let's wait and see!"
Tenner replied with a smile before hanging up.
In fact, Yaakov had been preparing to deal with Connor for a long time. Connor was his biggest worry, but he was also Steven Lee's successor. Thomas Morgan had been secretly protecting Connor with the connections left behind by Steven. This, in addition to his relationship with Jorge Yarrell, also caused Yaakov to not make a move on Connor too hastily. If he failed, the consequences would be unimaginable.
However, things were different in Hondoria. Steven Lee and Jorge Yarrell had no influence in Hondoria.
Rockefeller's power in Hondoria was very terrifying. That was why Yaakov had kidnapped Yelena and left her there. He'd also made sure Chieko found out about this so she could pass the news to Connor.
In this case, Connor had to go to Hondoria to save Yelena.
As long as Connor entered Hondoria, it would be much easier for Yaakov to keep Connor there; after all, Connor's main forces were congregated in inland cities like Porthampton.
If he came to Hondoria, it would be equivalent to stepping into enemy territory alone.
…
When Connor and Chieko arrived at Hondoria, it was already past three in the morning.
After leaving the airport, Connor looked at the brightly lit streets. It was his first time in Hondoria. He felt very strange about everything here.
"This place is actually more prosperous than I imagined…" Connor could not help but sigh softly.
Chieko said softly, "Mr. McDonald, is this your first time in Hondoria?"
"Yes, it's my first time here. I've never been here before!"
Connor lightly nodded.
"If we can successfully save Miss Yelena, I can bring you around the place…"
Chieko said gently.
"I'm not in the mood to travel here. I'd better hurry up and do serious things!"
Connor said in a low voice.
"This place is still quite far from the Dullahan family's location. If we take a taxi, it will take at least half a day to get there. Moreover, most taxis are not willing to go to such a far place. Let's take a rest and wait until tomorrow morning to set off!" Chieko said.
"That's good. Besides, Yelena is not in any danger for the time being, so we're not in a hurry!"
Connor lightly nodded.
Chieko was very familiar with Hondoria because she had lived here since she was a child. She took Connor to a random hotel near the airport.

chapters.title: Chapter 1463: Two Female Students
chapters.content:
Chapter 1463: Two Female Students
The next day, at eight o'clock in the morning.
Connor and Chieko packed up and left the hotel.
According to Chieko's description, the Dullahan family's villa was not located in the most prosperous city center of Hondoria, but rather in a relatively remote mountainous area.
Back then, when the Dullahan family was at its most glorious, they bought the entire mountain and built a very luxurious hilltop villa. The Dullahan family still lived there until now.
There weren't many roads leading to the mountains.
They could either take a taxi or a bus, but taxi drivers were generally unwilling to go to the mountains because it took a long time to go back and forth. Moreover, the security there was not very good, so even if Connor offered a very high price, the taxi driver would still think that Connor was a liar, so he would not agree to go there at all.
In the end, Connor and Chieko had no choice but to go by bus.
After getting on the bus, Connor found that there were not many passengers there, so he found a seat by the window and sat down.
Chieko chose to sit beside him.
Generally speaking, buses did not have a fixed departure time. In order to earn more money, drivers would wait until the bus was full before departing.
Sometimes, they might even have to wait for a few hours before they could leave.
However, his luck was very good. Not long after they got on the bus, a large group of students came up. These students were all carrying drawing boards. They were probably going to sketch something in the mountains.
In an instant, these students filled most of the seats.
However, there were only two empty seats next to Chieko. The reason was simple: her aura was too cold. Ordinary university students didn't dare to sit beside her.
However, two girls were the last to get on the bus. There were no other seats on the bus, so the two girls could only choose to sit next to Chieko.
Connor had been closing his eyes the whole time, circulating his Chi in his body, so he didn't notice the two girls sitting beside him at all.
After seeing him, one of the beautiful girls, who was wearing black-framed glasses, took the initiative to say, "Hello!"
After Connor heard the girl's words, he slowly opened his eyes and smiled. "Hello!"
"My name is Jeanette Sacks. I'm a student from the Art Department of Hondoria University. We're going to sketch some things in the mountains this time."
Jeanette very friendly. After seeing that his attitude was not bad, she took the initiative to chat with Connor.
"My name is Connor McDonald!"
Connor replied indifferently.
"Is this beauty your girlfriend? She's so beautiful!"
Jeanette looked at Chieko with an envious expression.
"I'm not Mr. McDonald's girlfriend. I'm his secretary!"
Chieko made up an identity so that strangers wouldn't misunderstand their relationship.
"Secretary?"
When Jeanette heard her words, she couldn't help but be stunned for a moment. Then, she said with a surprised expression, "I didn't expect you to be a big boss. You actually brought such a beautiful secretary out. Are you the legendary rich heir from a big family?"
"I'm not a big boss. I just run a business on the side!"
Connor explained helplessly.
"So that's how it is!" Jeanette gently nodded.
"Jeannie, who are you talking to?"
At this moment, the girl beside Jeanette looked at Connor curiously.
Only then did Connor realize that there was a girl beside Jeanette. If Jeanette was placed among ordinary people, she would definitely be considered a beauty. At the very least, she would be considered to be above average. However, the girl beside Jeanette was a stunning beauty. In terms of looks, she even surpassed Chieko, though her figure could not be compared to Chieko.
The girl was wearing a long white dress. She had a delicate face and bright eyes that emitted waves of seduction. Moreover, this girl looked to be of mixed blood, giving off an abnormally seductive aura.
The girl didn't seem to show any strange emotions when she saw Connor. However, when she saw Chieko, a hint of surprise flashed across her eyes. However, since Chieko was wearing sunglasses, she didn't pay too much attention to it.
"Eugenia, this is Connor, a friend I just met…"
Jeanette hurriedly explained to the cold girl.
"Hello!"
The cold-looking girl said to Connor. Then, without giving Connor a chance to continue speaking, she turned her head to the side and started playing with her phone.
The expression on Jeanette's face was somewhat awkward as she hurriedly explained, "Connor, Eugenia is just like this. Please don't mind her. She doesn't like to talk to strangers…"
"It's alright…"
Connor replied calmly.
Jeanette took the initiative to introduce Connor to the girl. This cold beauty was called Eugenia Bander, and she was from the Bander family of Hondoria.
When Chieko found out that Eugenia was from the Bander family, her expression was a little surprised, and she subconsciously glanced at Eugenia.
This was because the Bander family could be considered a big family in Hondoria, especially in recent years. However, Chieko did not know Eugenia, which meant that her status in the Bander family was likely not very high.
Eugenia was very famous in the University of Honduria. She was the beauty of their art department.
One had to know that in the art department, where beauties were everywhere, one must be very beautiful to hold the title of the most beautiful.
Therefore, Eugenia had many pursuers around her. In addition to her family environment, which was not bad, her personality was a little arrogant.
However, there were too many beauties around Connor. Eugenia was nothing in his eyes. Even Chieko, who was beside Connor, was more attractive than she was—after all, her figure was the one that men could not resist.
Connor did not have any thoughts about Chieko, so Eugenia naturally did not catch his eye.
If he really had any improper thoughts about Chieko, he only needed one look to make the arrogant Chieko take off her clothes and take the initiative to serve him.
Chieko knew that her life was in his hands, so no matter how unreasonable his request was, she could only choose to obey.

chapters.title: Chapter 1464: The Enthusiastic Jeanette Sacks
chapters.content:
Chapter 1464: The Enthusiastic Jeanette Sacks
Of course, Connor would not choose to do so.
After all, he was no longer as interested in women as before. Connor knew that he had to take responsibility for Freya.
"Connor, I don't think you're from Hondoria, right? Are you here for a vacation?"
Jeanette asked Connor softly.
"More or less, yeah."
Connor nodded.
"Do you have any friends in Hondoria? If you don't have any friends, you can hire me as a tour guide. As long as you provide food and accommodation…"
Jeanette continued.
After Eugenia heard Jeanette's words, the expression on her face appeared somewhat helpless. This was because Jeanette was always too passionate no matter who she faced. Actually, this was very dangerous.
However, Eugenia did not say much. This was Jeanette's own business and had nothing to do with her.
"No need, I have friends here!"
Connor smiled and shook his head.
After all, Connor didn't really come to Hondoria for tourism.
her eyes were filled with helplessness.
Jeanette took the initiative to introduce the interesting places in Hondoria.
Although he'd interacted with many girls before, Connor found that Jeanette was very enthusiastic. With such a girl chatting beside him, her was not as bored as before.
But at this moment, the bus suddenly stopped.
A few young men in black singlets with dragon and tiger tattoos on their bodies got into the car.
"These people are all members of the local underworld. They are very powerful. Don't provoke these people!"
Jeanette couldn't help but say in a low voice.
Connor couldn't help but laugh as he said helplessly, "What era is this? There's actually a gang that dares to come out so brazenly?"
"Of course. I heard that these people have very powerful backers…" Jeanette said.
"Haha…"
After Connor heard Jeanette's words, he could not help but laugh.
Chieko said softly, "Actually, these people are just some hooligans. They can't be considered real Black Gang members at all, because real Black Gang members wouldn't appear here so brazenly…"
"So it's like this…"
Connor nodded lightly and didn't say anything.
While Connor and Chieko were chatting, the young men had already gotten into the car and walked up to them.
When the young man in the lead saw Chieko and Eugenia, he was instantly stunned on the spot. Eugenia was a super beauty with an astounding face and figure. Moreover, there was an even sexier Chieko sitting beside Eugenia. This made the young man unable to move.
The young man had never thought that his luck would be so good today. The moment he got on the bus, he ran into two top-grade beauties. Even Eugenia and Jeanette, who was beside Chieko, both looked very good.
Therefore, the young man slowly walked to Connor's side. After glancing at Connor, he said indifferently, "Brat, get up. Let me sit for a while…"
At this moment, the young man's tone when talking to Connor was very disdainful. Because he saw that his figure was not very tall, he gave people the feeling that he was probably an ordinary university student. Therefore, the young man did not take Connor seriously at all.
Connor slowly raised his head and looked at the young man, but did not say anything.
When the young man realized that Connor was ignoring him, his expression was abnormally angry. He said with a straight face, "Kid, I was talking to you just now. Didn't you hear me? I told you to sit at the back…"
"Oi, are you deaf or stupid?"
The people beside the young man also started kicking up a fuss.
Connor's expression was a little irritated. Then, he frowned and said, "Are you talking to me?"
"Why are you pretending to be stupid here?" The young man shouted with his eyes wide open, then continued, "I told you to get up now, but you didn't hear me, did you?"
"Brat, I advise you to mind your own business and get lost. If you anger Brother Long later, you will suffer…"
The underling beside the young man said coldly.
"Why should I give up my seat to you?"
Connor sized up the young man called Brother Long and asked calmly.
"Hehe, why give up your seat to me?" When the young man heard his words, he couldn't help but reveal a disdainful smile. Then, he pointed at Connor and asked, "Kid, do you know who I am? I'm Jecht Long. Go around and ask around. Who doesn't know me?"
"Kid, I advise you not to offend Brother Long. He's in a good mood today, so I've decided to help you a little. If you really anger him, you'll suffer…"
"Yeah, why are you still sitting there? Hurry up and give up your seat to Brother Long..."
"Otherwise, you will regret it later…"
The underlings behind Jecht also began to persuade Connor to quickly move away.
Connor couldn't help but smile lightly because he felt that this scene seemed a little familiar. He couldn't understand why no matter where he went, there would be people standing up to provoke him.
He always encountered such situations, but anyone who provoked him would not have a good ending. Connor could not understand what these people were doing.
He stood up helplessly.
When Eugenia saw Connor stand up, the expression on her face was a little strange.
Although she had not spoken to Connor from the beginning to the end, after hearing the conversation between Jeanette and Connor, she could vaguely feel that his background was not simple. After all, he was able to bring such a beautiful female secretary with him, so he was definitely not an ordinary person.
Just now, Connor was also very stubborn when facing Jecht and the others.
However, the moment Connor stood up, Eugenia felt that she was thinking too much. Connor might really be an ordinary person, and the beauty beside Connor might be someone he'd gotten to put on an act, deceiving a girl like Jeanette who was not familiar with the world.
"If this person is really a rich heir, why would he take a public bus? I'm really thinking too much…"
Eugenia could not help but shake her head and sigh helplessly.
When Jecht saw Connor stand up, his expression was even more proud. He smiled and said, "If you had stood up earlier, wouldn't there be so many things? You made me have to talk nonsense with you. Hurry up and get out of my way…"
After saying this, Jecht reached out and grabbed his shoulder.
However, before Jecht could grab his shoulder with his right hand, Connor grabbed Jecht's wrist and said expressionlessly, "Who told you that I'm giving way to you?"

chapters.title: Chapter 1465: Backup
chapters.content:
Chapter 1465: Backup
"If it's not that, then what do you want?"
Jecht looked at Connor with a puzzled expression.
The expression on Eugenia's face was somewhat puzzled as well. She didn't quite understand what Connor meant.
Jecht's right wrist was grabbed by Connor, and he was a little surprised. He thought Connor had stood up to give up his seat, but he didn't expect that to not be the case.
Connor held Jecht's wrist tightly and said calmly, "I'll give you one chance now. If you know what's good for you, then get out of this car quickly. If you do, I won't hit you. Otherwise, you can forget about this arm…"
"You dare to threaten me—"
When Jecht heard his words, he was instantly furious and shouted at the top of his lungs.
"Crack!"
However, before Jecht could finish his sentence, Connor exerted his strength and broke Jecht's wrist.
Because the environment in the car was very quiet, almost everyone present could clearly hear the sound of bones cracking.
"Ah…"
Jecht couldn't help but let out a scream. His face was filled with pain.
Jecht's lackeys widened their eyes. They never thought that Connor would be so ruthless as to break Jecht's wrist.
The underlings were just ordinary hooligans, so after they saw Connor being so vicious, they naturally dare not take the initiative to provoke him again. If Connor broke their hands, then things would be troublesome.
Of course, Eugenia and Jeanette were also extremely shocked.
They never expected the seemingly gentle boy in front of them to be so vicious as to break Jecht's arm before he could say anything.
Even Eugenia was very shocked at this moment. She was disappointed by Connor's supposed cowardice and thought that he was just bragging. She did not expect that after only a few seconds, Connor would use his actions to tell everyone that he was not bragging.
Connor looked at Jecht who was moaning in pain and asked, "Do you still want to sit in my seat?"
"You actually dare to hit me. I think you're f * cking tired of living…"
Even though Jecht's arm was broken by Connor, he still didn't have the intention to admit defeat and continued to curse.
Connor smiled disdainfully, then raised his leg and kicked Jecht's mouth.
"Bang!"
His kick sent Jecht flying from the middle of the bus to the door. Three of Jecht's front teeth were kicked off by Connor, and blood instantly flowed out of his mouth.
"Brother Long, are you alright?"
"Brother Long!"
Jecht's lackeys didn't seem to have any intention of fighting Connor. Instead, they all ran towards Jecht.
Jecht raised his head and glanced at Connor. Then, he shouted with a ferocious face, "Just you wait, kid. If I don't kill you today, my surname won't be Long…"
Connor looked at Jecht coldly and didn't say anything. Instead, he sat back down.
Seeing that Connor didn't say anything, Jecht shouted at the driver, "Open the f*cking door, I want to get out!"
Connor dared to provoke Jecht, but the driver didn't, so he quickly stepped on the brakes.
After the bus stopped, Jecht got down with the help of his lackeys.
After Jecht and the others got off the bus, the entire bus quieted down. Everyone looked at Connor with a strange look.
After all, in the eyes of ordinary people like them, Connor had just beaten up Jecht. According to Jecht's personality, he would definitely not let Connor off easily.
"Connor, what are you still standing there for? Get the driver to move forward a little and then get out of the bus…"
Jeanette said anxiously to Connor.
