Connor couldn't help but be stunned for a moment when he heard Jeanette's words. Then, he chuckled and said, "I haven't reached my destination yet. Why should I get off?"
"Bro, what time is it now? You still want to go somewhere else? These people are really not to be trifled with. They are all members of the Black Gang. If you don't get out of the bus, you will be stopped by them."
Jeanette was really concerned. In the eyes of an ordinary university student like her, people like Jecht were indeed not to be trifled with.
"Don't worry, they can't do anything to Mr. McDonald!"
Chieko, who hadn't said a word since the beginning, spoke slowly.
"But what if that Jecht finds a helper?"
Jeanette's tone was somewhat helpless as she spoke.
"Even if he gets help, they are not a match for Mr. McDonald. Moreover, these people are just a group of low-level hooligans!" Chieko replied calmly.
At this moment, Chieko looked very calm. After all, she had been trying her best to develop her power in Hondoria to deal with Yaakov. Therefore, even if Connor didn't make a move, Chieko could easily deal with these people with her connections.
Therefore, she did not take those people seriously at all.
After Eugenia heard these words, her expression was a little confused.
She couldn't understand why Chieko was so confident. She started to wonder who Connor and Chieko were.
Connor, on the other hand, had an indifferent look. He had been sitting quietly in his seat the entire time, not saying a word.
After seeing Chieko's confidence, Jeanette didn't say anything else.
The bus continued to move forward.
About half an hour later, the bus driver stopped the bus with a helpless expression.
The mountain road ahead was blocked by several vans, and a large group of people stood beside the vans, as if waiting for someone.
These people were all holding weapons like machetes and steel pipes, and each of them looked like they were about to kill someone.
When the passengers in the bus saw these people, they turned their heads to look at Connor because they knew that these people were all here for him.
Especially Jecht, whose right hand had been broken by Connor.

chapters.title: Chapter 1466: One Mountain Can't Fit Two Tigers
chapters.content:
Chapter 1466: One Mountain Can't Fit Two Tigers
"That reckless brat from earlier, hurry up and get down here!"
Jecht shouted excitedly when he saw the bus stop.
When the passengers on the bus heard Jecht's words, they instantly fell into a panic.
After all, the car was in the mountainous area, where all kinds of vicious crimes often happened. They were also very familiar with these gangsters' usual methods. No one knew if these people would take care of them as well.
The expression on Jeanette's face was also extremely nervous. In her entire life, she had never encountered such a situation.
Therefore, she hurriedly turned her head and asked, "Eugenia, let's quickly think of a way to get out of this. What should we do now?"
After Eugenia heard Jeanette's words, the expression on her face appeared to be somewhat disdainful. She then turned her head to look at Connor indifferently and said in a calm tone, "Weren't those two people very arrogant just now? Don't you think they don't need to get out of the car? I want to see how the two of them plan to deal with these people!"
"Eugenia, things have already come to this. Don't say things out of anger. No matter what, we can be considered to have known Connor. You should help them!"
Jeanette knew that the Bander family had some influence in Honduria. If Eugenia could help, then things might not be as scary as she had imagined.
"What do you think I can do at this time?"
Unfortunately, Eugenia really did not seem to have any intention of helping as she spoke in a cold tone.
After Jeanette heard Eugenia's words, the expression on her face appeared somewhat helpless. She did not know what to do.
At this moment, all the passengers in the car looked at Connor.
"Brat, you should quickly get out of the car and apologize to them. If you apologize to them now, they might even spare your life. Otherwise, it might be troublesome when these people get into the car…"
At this moment, a man shouted at Connor. This man seemed to be Jeanette and Eugenia's classmate.
"That's right. We can't afford to offend these people. You'd better get out of the car quickly!"
Another male student hurriedly added.
"Actually, if it was just Jecht, it wouldn't be a very big issue, but do you see that middle-aged man?"
At this moment, a boy suddenly stood up and pointed at a bearded middle-aged man outside the car.
After Jeanette saw this middle-aged man, her expression became somewhat doubtful. She then frowned and asked, "Who is that man?"
"You don't even know the famous Brother Wolf?"
The young man looked helpless and continued, "That middle-aged man is called Wolf Saab. A few years ago, he was sent to prison, where he got to know a lot of people. After Wolf was released, he gathered all these people together. Now, these people are collecting protection fees everywhere. Even this highway is managed by Wolf. As long as there are cars passing by, they have to pay him. If you don't believe me, you can ask the driver!"
The bus driver hurriedly nodded.
"That's indeed the case. This Wolf is very powerful. Even the boss of our passenger transport company doesn't dare to provoke him…"
"This person is so powerful that not even the boss of the passenger transport company dares fight him?"
After Jeanette heard the driver's words, the expression on her face was a little surprised.
"Wolf used to be a special forces soldier overseas, and he has many underlings. Who would have the time to provoke such a person?" the other boy said helplessly.
"What should we do now?"
The expression on Jeanette's face became even more anxious.
" What else can we do now? Quickly get this person to apologize to Brother Long and compensate him. I heard that people like Brother Wolf are relatively easy to talk to. As long as you have a good attitude, he doesn't want to make things too big..."
The boy turned to look at Connor as he spoke.
In fact, the reason why the boy said so much was very obvious. He just wanted Connor to get out of the car and deal with this matter quickly. He didn't care about what would happen to Connor in the end. He only cared about whether this matter would implicate him.
"Young man, you'd better get out of the car and apologize!"
"That's right. If we delay any longer, it might be too late…"
"No matter what, you were the one who hit him first. It's normal for you to apologize!"
The others in the car seemed to have the same thoughts as the boys. They only hoped that Connor could get out of the car as soon as possible so as not to affect the rest of them.
Jeanette also turned her head to look at Connor, then softly said to Connor, "Connor, what do you plan to do?"
".."
Connor indifferently looked at Jeanette without saying anything.
Eugenia said in a helpless tone, "Sometimes, you have to take responsibility for your actions. It was originally a simple matter, but you had to hit him. Now, you're regretting it, right?"
"Haha…"
Connor looked at Eugenia and laughed coldly. He did not say anything else.
"Mr. McDonald, why don't we go down and take a look?"
Chieko hesitated for a moment before asking Connor.
"Alright, let's go down and take a look!"
Connor didn't say anything more. He nodded and then stood up to walk out of his seat.
When everyone saw that Connor was really planning to get off the car, their expressions were obviously much more relaxed.
Only Jeanette stretched out her hand to stop Connor, then said in a nervous tone, "Connor, you have to think carefully. These people are not so easy to provoke. What if these people don't let you off after you get out of the car?"
"Don't worry, these people won't do anything to me!"
Connor lightly smiled at Jeanette. After all, from the beginning to the end, Connor had never placed these people in his eyes.
"You're still stubborn at a time like this!"
Eugenia couldn't help but laugh coldly. Then, she said arrogantly, "Brat, today's matter is somewhat related to me. Therefore, as long as you beg me, I can help you once…"
"Who do you think you are? Does Mr. McDonald even need to beg such a person?"
Connor ignored Eugenia, but Chieko retorted coldly.
"What did you say?"
After Eugenia heard Chieko's words, her expression became abnormally furious.
After all, these two beauties had looked down on each other for a long time.
As the saying goes, one mountain cannot tolerate two tigers.
And a bus definitely couldn't fit two beauties inside.

chapters.title: Chapter 1467: Love at First Sight
chapters.content:
Chapter 1467: Love at First Sight
"Don't you know what I'm saying?"
Chieko replied calmly before following Connor out of the car.
"I'm so angry. Why is this woman so arrogant? Does she think she's so great just because of her tits and ass?"
Eugenia sat on the spot and shouted angrily.
"Eugenia, things have already come to this point. Don't get angry here. You saw it just now. That Jecht was clearly coming for you. If Connor didn't stand up for you today, Jecht might be harassing you now. You'd better think of a way quickly!"
Jeanette said helplessly.
Eugenia's eyes also flashed with a trace of strangeness. She knew that Connor had indeed saved her today. Otherwise, she might be the one in trouble now.
"Weren't those two people very arrogant just now? Didn't the two of them think that they could resolve this matter? Then let the two of them settle it…" Eugenia said expressionlessly.
"Neither of them are locals. They're just here for a vacation. How can they deal with someone like Wolf?"
Jeanette said helplessly.
"Anyway, I gave them a chance just now, but he didn't appreciate it at all. What can I do now?"
"Eugenia, don't be angry with them. Why don't you just take it as a favor for me?"
After Eugenia heard Jeanette's words, she couldn't help but turn her head to look at Jeanette. Then, she pouted and said, "You just like to poke your nose into other people's business. How many times have I told you? If you can ignore such matters, then don't get involved. Why are you paying attention to these two people?"
"Yes, today's matter is all my fault. I shouldn't have meddled in other people's business. Eugenia, just treat it as helping me once, okay? I definitely won't meddle in other people's business next time…"
Jeanette said helplessly.
Eugenia took a deep breath and said in a low voice, "I'm telling you, this is the last time!"
"Eugenia, don't worry. I promise that this will be the last time. If such a thing happens again in the future, I will definitely not care..." Jeanette vowed.
Eugenia was just trying to find a way out for herself. She looked at Jeanette helplessly and took out her phone. After hesitating for a few seconds, she found a number and dialed it.
"Ding, ding, ding…"
The phone rang for a long time before the other party picked up.
"Hello? Hello!"
An old man's voice came from the other end of the line.
"Uncle Chandler, I'm Eugenia Bander. We met at my cousin's birthday party last time. Do you still remember?" Eugenia said with a smile.
"Eugenia Bander?"
After hearing this name, the other party's tone was a little puzzled, as if he did not remember who she was.
"Uncle Chandler, my father is Horus Bander!"
Eugenia reminded him.
"Ah, so you're Hongwen's daughter. Why did you suddenly call me? Did something happen?"
After the other party knew Eugenia's identity, his tone was still very cold.
Eugenia could naturally feel the other party's indifference. After all, her father, Horus Bander, was just a small figure on the edge of the Bander family. He did not have any influence at all. Therefore, it was very normal for the other party to have such an attitude.
Nonetheless, she continued. "Uncle Chandler, I'm on the mountain road now, but my friend offended someone called Jecht Long. That Jecht asked Wolf Saab to block our path. I..."
"So you've run into trouble!"
The other party came to a realization and then said indifferently, "I know the Wolf you mentioned. Alright, I'll help you solve this problem."
"Thank you, Uncle Chandler!" Eugenia replied happily.
"Your cousin told me about you before, and she even specifically asked me to take care of you. However, you never contacted me, so I forgot about it. But don't worry, Wolf should still give me some face!"
After saying this, the other party hung up the phone.
The expression on Eugenia's face was a little ugly. After all, she had brought up her father just now, but the other party did not change his attitude towards her. The only reason why the other party agreed to help was because of her cousin.
Perhaps this was the difference between people!
Although Eugenia and her cousin were both members of the Bander family, their positions in the Bander family were like heaven and earth.
Now, Eugenia's cousin was already a socialite in the upper class of Honduria. Whenever she was mentioned, she would be associated with the eldest daughter of the Bander family. However, very few people knew about Eugenia.
All of this had a lot to do with Eugenia's background.
Her father was a fringe figure in the Bander family. He was a small manager in the Bander family's company, and the people of the same generation were already general managers and presidents. From this, one could see how low Eugenia's status in the Bander family was.
"Eugenia, how is it?"
At this moment, Jeanette naturally did not know what Eugenia was thinking.
Eugenia turnedto look at Jeanette, then said in a very calm tone, "Are you still worried about me? I've already found someone to help. Connor should be fine…"
"Eugenia, you are indeed a member of the Bander family. You are really amazing. You only needed to make a phone call to settle this matter. I really admire you…"
Jeanette said excitedly.
The expression on Eugenia's face was very helpless. She sighed softly and didn't know what to say.
After all, how could things be as simple as Jeanette imagined? Eugenia's status in the Bander family was very low. The reason why she was able to help this time was all because of his cousin. If there was a next time, she would definitely not get any help like this!
"Alright, stop flattering me. If it were not for you, I would not have gotten into this trouble…" Eugenia chided.
"Yes, yes, yes. This time, it's all my fault. I promise I won't cause you any more trouble next time, okay?"
Jeanette said with a smile.
Eugenia looked at Jeanette helplessly and said softly, "Tell me the truth. Did you fall in love with Connor at first sight?"
"Eugenia, don't talk nonsense here. How could I fall in love with Connor at first sight? How long have we known each other..."
Jeanette hastily retorted.

chapters.title: Chapter 1468: Come With Me For A Week
chapters.content:
Chapter 1468: Come With Me For A Week
"Then why do I feel that you seem to be very concerned about him?"
Eugenia said lightly.
"I'm only concerned about this Connor because I feel that we can get along. Moreover, this matter is somewhat related to us…"
Jeanette paused for a moment before continuing, "And even if I really like Connor, so what? Connor has a super beauty by his side. It's absolutely impossible for him to like me…"
Eugenia looked at Jeanette helplessly and did not say anything else.
"What are we going to do now?"
Jeanette asked softly.
"Go down and see what's going on!"
After Eugenia knew that the old man would help her, she was no longer as afraid as before, so she took the initiative to stand up and get out of the car.
"Eugenia, are you really going to get out of the car?"
Jeanette hurriedly asked.
"What else would I be doing?"
Eugenia replied indifferently.
After Jeanette hesitated for a moment, she hurriedly followed her out of the car.
At the same time, Connor and Chieko had already arrived in front of Jecht, Wolf, and the others. These people immediately surrounded them.
However, most of the people's attention was on Chieko. After all, she was too sexy. Even though she was wearing sunglasses, she was still very attractive.
Chieko didn't care about these people at all, so even though they were staring at her, her expression was very calm.
Wolf took a step forward and asked Connor expressionlessly, "You were the one who broke Jecht's arm just now, right?"
Connor looked at Wolf indifferently. "That's right, I did break this person's arm. What do you want?"
"What do I want?"
Wolf sneered and said in a low voice, "Kid, you're not from Honduria, are you?"
"No…"
Connor lightly shook his head.
"No wonder he is so arrogant…"
Wolf smiled and then continued, "Since you're not a local here, I'll let you off easy. First, you broke my brother's arm, so you should at least pay for his medical fees. Then, you should apologize and let that beauty come with me for a week."
"Haha…"
Connor couldn't help but shake his head and smile.
"What are you laughing at?"
Wolf asked with his eyes wide open.
"Nothing. I just wanted to ask, how much do you think I should pay for the medical expenses?"
Connor asked calmly.
"Jecht, how much do you think we should pay for the medical expenses?"
Wolf turned his head and asked Jecht.
Jecht looked at Connor up and down and said through gritted teeth, "At least one million…"
"Alright, then I'll give you one million. As long as you're willing to fork out this sum of money and let that woman accompany me for a week, this matter will be considered over…"
Wolf said casually.
"A million?"
Connor hesitated for a moment, then nodded and said, "Alright, since you guys want a million, I can give you the money. As for the woman beside me accompanying you for a week, you'll have to ask her for her opinion!"
"Beauty, what do you think?"
Wolf shouted excitedly at Chieko. He didn't expect Connor to agree so readily.
A hint of disdain flashed across Chieko's eyes. She pursed her lips and said, "I feel disgusted just by looking at a person like you. It's better for you to get lost!"
"Bitch, what do you mean?"
Wolf shouted.
"It's simple. She finds you disgusting, so she wants you to get lost…"
Connor chuckled and continued, "Since she thinks you're disgusting, I don't plan on paying this one million dollars either…"
Wolf suddenly turned his head to look at Connor. At this moment, he realized that Connor and Chieko had been playing him.
"Kid, are you playing with me? Do you believe that I'll let you crawl out of here today?"
Wolf gritted his teeth and shouted at Connor with an extremely angry expression.
"If you have the ability, then you can try!"
Connor laughed and replied with a sentence.
"Alright, then I will let you know how powerful I am today…"
Wolf shouted at the top of his lungs.
When everyone heard Wolf's words, they did not hesitate at all. They immediately picked up their weapons and rushed towards Connor's position.
Meanwhile, Chieko casually took out her phone and prepared to make a call.
"Stop!"
However, at this moment, a cold voice came from behind everyone.
After Wolf heard this voice, he turned his head to look behind him.
Very soon, they saw Eugenia and Jeanette who had just gotten out of the car.
When everyone saw Eugenia, they were all shocked.
After all, although Chieko had a sexy figure, she was always wearing sunglasses, so no one could see her face clearly.
However, Eugenia was different. At this moment, she gave off an exceptionally stunning feeling. Wolf was even more defenseless against such a pure and innocent-looking female university student.
"Brother Long, your luck is really good today. You actually met two top-grade beauties at the same time. Once you get these two girls into bed, wouldn't it be even more satisfying?"
Wolf grinned at Jecht.
"That's right, Brother Wolf. After we deal with this kid, you can play with these two girls however you want!"
Jecht quickly replied with a smile.
"Not bad, not bad. I did not work in vain today…"
Wolf rubbed his palms excitedly.
At this moment, Eugenia had already walked in front of Wolf. She sized him up and asked softly, "You should be Brother Wolf, right?"
"That's right, it's me!"
Wolf nodded with a smile.
"This person is my friend. For my sake, let's forget about this matter today. It won't do anyone any good if we continue to make a fuss!"
Eugenia said expressionlessly.
"Are we just going to let this matter go?"
After Wolf heard Eugenia's words, he couldn't help but laugh coldly. Then, he said indifferently, "Beauty, are you confused? Your friend broke my brother's arm, and now you're telling me to let it go? If I really let it go, how am I going to explain it to my brothers?"

chapters.title: Chapter 1469: You Know Chief Cole?
chapters.content:
Chapter 1469: You Know Chief Cole?
"Then what else do you want?"
Eugenia asked Wolf expressionlessly.
"It's very simple. The medical fees of one million dollars cannot be lessened. You and that woman have to serve me for a week. This matter is over. Otherwise, this kid will not be able to leave here today!"
Wolf said expressionlessly.
"Brother Wolf, I…"
Eugenia opened her mouth, wanting to speak, but at this moment, Connor cut off her words.
"I will not give you even a single cent of a million dollars. If you kneel down and apologize to me now, I can choose to let you off…"
In an instant, everyone present turned their heads to look at Connor.
Even Eugenia looked at him in surprise.
"Connor, what nonsense are you talking about?"
Eugenia shouted, eyes wide.
"I'm not spouting nonsense. I can give you one last chance now. If you kneel down and apologize to me now, then today's matter will be over. If you don't apologize, then I can only choose to attack…"
Connor said calmly.
"Who do you think you are? You actually dare to act tough in front of me?"
Jecht shouted at Connor with widened eyes.
"That's right, Brother Wolf, don't waste your breath on this kid. Let's teach this kid a lesson first. After we're done, he'll be obedient…"
"That's right, why waste your breath on such a person!"
Wolf's underlings shouted at the top of their lungs.
Wolf looked at Connor from head to toe, then said expressionlessly, "You brat, you really have the guts to refuse a toast for the chance to drink sewer water. If I don't teach you a lesson today, I think you really don't know your surname."
"Are you planning to make a move?"
Connor asked with a smile.
"Brothers, help me loosen this brat's bones. Let him know how powerful we are…"
Wolf shouted excitedly.
After everyone heard Wolf's words, they rushed towards Connor.
Eugenia, on the other hand, had a helpless look on her face. She could not understand why Connor had said those words just now to deliberately provoke Wolf. Originally, this matter was quite simple. However, after Connor's actions, the matter had become even more complicated.
"This Connor is simply brainless!"
Eugenia called out with a helpless expression, then took a step forward and said loudly, "Wolf, don't tell me you won't even give face to Chandler Cole?"
When Wolf heard Eugenia's words, he couldn't help but be stunned for a moment. Then, he suddenly turned his head to look at Eugenia and asked with a surprised expression, "Who did you just say?"
"You don't know Chandler Cole, do you?"
Eugenia said expressionlessly.
"You actually know Mr. Cole?"
Wolf's expression seemed to be even more shocked.
"Of course I do…"
Eugenia nodded proudly.
Wolf started to hesitate because he knew that Chandler was a big shot in Honduria. He was very influential in both the underworld and the overworld. If he offended Chandler, it would not be a good thing for him.
"How do I know that you don't really know Mr. Cole?"
Wolf said in a low voice after hesitating for a moment.
"Of course I know him. If you don't believe me, I'll call Uncle Chandler now…" Eugenia hurriedly said.
"Alright, you can make the call…"
Wolf nodded.
Eugenia took a deep breath and immediately took out her phone to find Chandler's number and dialed it.
However, after a long time, the other party did not pick up the phone.
Wolf chuckled and said, "Lady, do you really know Mr. Cole?" If you know him, why didn't he pick up your call?"
"Perhaps he is busy with something…"
Eugenia replied helplessly and then continued to call.
But at this moment, Eugenia's phone suddenly received a message.
"I'm in a meeting. My people are already there!"
After Eugenia saw this text message, her expression was a little excited. She hurriedly shouted at Wolf, "This is a text message from Uncle Chandler. He'll be here soon. Wait for a while…"
Wolf subconsciously lowered his head to take a look at the text message on Eugenia's phone. Then, he said expressionlessly, "Alright, then we'll wait here. If no one comes after an hour, I'll teach you a lesson today!"
"Let's wait!"
Eugenia felt that Chandler would not joke about such matters, so she replied directly.
At this time, Connor was not in a hurry to make a move. The reason was very simple: at this time, he did not want to cause trouble and alert the enemy. There were so many people on the enemy's side, so if they really fought and were discovered by the police, his whereabouts would be exposed.
Therefore, Connor felt that it would be best if he could resolve this matter without making a move.
Of course, if the person Eugenia had gotten was really useless, then Connor could only choose to make a move in the end.
Chieko took out her phone and made a call.
She briefly explained the situation with her own group of people, then hung up the phone. She walked over to Connor in her high heels and said gently, "Mr. McDonald, I've already gotten someone to resolve this matter. You don't have to worry…"
"They're just some clowns. There's nothing to worry about. If it weren't for the fact that I don't want to expose my whereabouts, I wouldn't have bothered to talk nonsense with these people!"
Connor turned to Chieko.
"I understand what you mean, Mr. McDonald!"
Chieko hurriedly nodded.
After about ten minutes, a black BMW slowly stopped by the roadside.
When Wolf saw the BMW, his expression was a little confused, because he knew that Chandler's car was not this one, which meant that the person who came was not Chandler at all.
The person Chieko called over was not this car, so everyone could not help but reveal a puzzled expression.
After the BMW stopped, a middle-aged man got out of the car and shouted at Wolf, "Wolf, you really are lawless now? You don't even give Mr. Cole any face. Are you tired of living?"
After Wolf saw the middle-aged man, his expression was a little strange. Then, he frowned and said, "Why are you here?"

chapters.title: Chapter 1470: A Little Man Running Errands
chapters.content:
Chapter 1470: A Little Man Running Errands
"What do you mean? Can't I come?"
The middle-aged man replied with a pout.
Wolf sneered. This middle-aged man was not Chandler's underling at all. Instead, he was a hooligan from Honduria whose original name was Hector Law.
His status was actually similar to Wolf's. He was just a little brother who ran errands for the big shots. He might even be inferior to Wolf.
In recent years, he had become closer to Chandler, which was why he had become arrogant.
However, he was not even Chandler's trusted aide, which was why Chandler had sent him over. That could prove that Chandler did not really value Eugenia. Otherwise, why would he have sent a nobody like Hector over?
When Eugenia saw Hector, her expression was also very disappointed. She had not expected Chandler to look down on her so much. Even if Chandler had sent a chauffeur over today, she would not have said anything!
"Hector, what do you mean?"
Wolf asked Hector expressionlessly.
"Don't you know what I mean?"
Hector replied indifferently. Then, he raised his head to look at Eugenia and said expressionlessly, "Mr. Cole asked me to come over and take this woman away. You'd better not be ungrateful!"
Hector looked at Wu from head to toe. At this moment, he wasn't sure if Wolf wanted to let him go or not.
After all, Chandler didn't give the order at all. Chandler gave the order to his driver, and his driver didn't want to deal with such trivial matters at all, so he sent Hector over.
Wolf looked Hector up and down. Although Eugenia was indeed very beautiful, Chieko was still around, so Wolf felt that there was no need for him to offend Chandler because of this matter.
"Since Mr. Cole asked you to come, I can let you go for today's matter…"
Wolf said expressionlessly.
After Eugenia heard Wolf's words, the expression on her face became a little excited.
Although the person who came today was Hector, as long as she could save Connor, it didn't matter who came.
"Hehe, at least you did it. Then I'll take all these people away?"
Hector said with a smile.
"Take them all away?"
After Wolf heard Hector's words, he couldn't help but be stunned for a moment. Then, he said indifferently, "Ah, Hector. I've already humored you just now, but you should at least do the same to me, right?"
"What do you mean?"
Hector blinked and asked in confusion.
"Don't you know what I mean? Did Mr. Cole ask you to come here today for this woman or for everyone? If you take this woman away now, will you be able to complete your mission? The rest of them shouldn't have anything to do with you, right?"
Wolf said expressionlessly.
"..."
Hector turned his head to look at Eugenia, then said lightly, " You're right. Mr. Cole only told me about a person called Eugenia. The rest of them have nothing to do with me. I only need to take Eugenia away…"
After Eugenia heard Hector's words, she hurriedly said, "Sir, I mentioned my friend to Uncle Chandler on the phone. You can't ignore my friend!"
"Why haven't I heard Chief Cole mention anything about your friends? Why don't you call him now? If Chief Cole says that he wants to take your friends away, then I'll take them away. Otherwise, I can only take you away today!"
Hector said to Eugenia expressionlessly.
Eugenia was dumbfounded when she heard Hector's words. The expression on her face was unusually helpless. She did not know what to do.
"Are you still going to make the call? If you're not going to make a call, then hurry up and leave…"
Hector said to Eugenia.
Eugenia turned her head to look at Jeanette, then bit her lips and said softly, "Wait for me. I'll call Uncle Chandler again..."
After saying this, Eugenia took out her phone and dialed Chandler's number again. However, no one picked up this time.
"How is it? Did Mr. Cole not pick up your call?"
Wolf asked Eugenia with a faint smile.
Eugenia's expression was a little desperate as she said in a low voice, "Wolf, I'm from the Bander family. Eira and Deryn Bander are my cousins. Can you humor me and let my friends go?"
"Hahaha…"
After Wolf heard Eugenia's words, he instantly laughed out loud and said loudly, "Beauty, are you joking with me? If you were really a member of the Bander family, why would Chief Cole have such an attitude towards you? Do you think I'm a fool?"
Hector was not clear about Eugenia's identity, so he did not say much.
"If you want to take this kid away, you can. Tell Mr. and Miss Bander to call me now. If I can get their calls, I will let you all go. Otherwise, this kid won't be able to leave here today…" Wolf said arrogantly.
The expression on Eugenia's face was unusually ugly. After all, even Chandler was not picking up her calls now. She did not have the guts to disturb Eira and Deryn.
Eugenia's status in the Bander family was relatively low. Most people looked down on their family. She did not want to be thick-skinned and beg them for help because of such a small matter. Moreover, even if she asked today, it was uncertain whether they would help.
When she thought of this, Eugenia's expression was unusually ugly. After all, they were both members of the Bander family. The difference in treatment was really a little too big.
"Are you coming with me or not?"
Hector asked Eugenia impatiently.
"If you don't take my friend away today, I won't leave either…"
Eugenia bit her lips.
"Alright, since you are not leaving, then forget it. In any case, I am already here. I cannot care about the rest…"
Hector obviously couldn't be bothered with these matters. He replied to Eugenia coldly and then strode into the car.
Eugenia looked at Hector with an expression of surprise.
No one expected him to drive away just like that!
"Eugenia, why did this person leave? Is he really going to ignore us?"
Jeanette asked Eugenia in surprise.
"Looks like Uncle Chandler doesn't want to bother with my issue at all…"
Eugenia said in a low voice.
"Then what should we do now?"
Jeanette hurriedly asked.
"I don't know. When I called Uncle Chandler back then, he ignored me. Now that I'm calling him, he doesn't even pick up. I don't have any other choice. I can only leave it to fate…"
Eugenia said expressionlessly.

chapters.title: Chapter 1471: Gaius Low
chapters.content:
Chapter 1471: Gaius Low
As for Jeanette, she looked at Connor. She could only place her hopes on Connor alone.
After all, Connor was very confident when he spoke just now.
Thus, Jeanette could only pray that Connor wasn't bragging.
"Kid, Hector has already left. What do you plan to do this time? Do you have any other trump cards?"
Wolf took a step forward with a smile.
Connor glanced at Wolf indifferently without saying anything.
The people on the bus had thought that Connor could escape with Eugenia's help. Unfortunately, no one had expected that Eugenia's help would not be that useful; in the end, they couldn't change the outcome.
"Brothers, let's do it!"
Wolf shouted at the top of his voice.
"Wait a minute. I just called someone over. He's probably coming soon, so I advise you to wait. Otherwise, you'll regret it…"
Chieko suddenly said.
"You called for reinforcements too?"
Wolf sized up Chieko in disdain.
"That's right!"
Chieko nodded.
Wolf said with a smile, "Lady, I'm still wasting your energy. So what if you call someone over? Unless you invite Mr. Deryn Bander over, it's useless for anyone to come…"
"Are you sure?"
Chieko replied calmly.
Wolf felt that Chieko was just an ordinary beauty. If she really had a background, she would have told him long ago. There was no need to wait until now.
However, Wolf still asked Chieko out of caution, "Beauty, what's the name of the person you called?"
"Gaius Low!"
Chieko said calmly.
Everyone was confused when they heard Chieko's words.
"Who is Gaius Low?"
"I've never heard of this name before?"
"That's right. We don't seem to have a big shot with the surname Luo, right?"
Wolf's underlings began to discuss in low voices.
On the other hand, Eugenia's expression was also a little puzzled. No matter what, Eugenia was also a member of the Bander family, so she could come into contact with many big shots. However, she had never heard of the name Gaius Low.
"These two are just tourists. How could they know the big shots in Honduria?"
Eugenia sighed helplessly.
Jecht shouted with disdain, "Who are you talking about? Why haven't I heard of it before?"
"Haven't you heard of it?"
Chieko turned to look at Jecht.
Wolf had been standing in place the whole time. He felt that this name sounded very familiar, but he could not remember who this person was.
"You mean Sheriff Low?"
At this moment, Wolf's expression suddenly changed as he shouted at Chieko excitedly.
"That's right, he's the sheriff!"
Chieko nodded.
For a moment, everyone was stunned on the spot, and the smiles on their faces disappeared.
Very few people knew the name Gaius Low. However, when it came to the name Sheriff Low, it could be said that everyone knew of it. After all, the people that these punks were most afraid of were the people in the police station.
Everyone stared at Chieko with wide eyes. No one expected Chieko to know such a powerful figure.
"Do you really know Gaius Low?"
Wolf asked Chieko nervously.
"Yeah, I called him just now. I think he will be here soon!"
Chieko nodded.
In fact, Chieko didn't need to call Gaius over for such a small matter, but she still chose to do it. Her purpose was to let Connor know that she had some connections in Honduria. If they cooperated, Chieko wouldn't just be using Connor.
Wolf seemed to be a little flustered at this moment.
After all, if the person who came was really Deryn of the Bander family, he might not be so afraid. However, if the person who came was Gaius Low, then things would be troublesome.
Jecht walked to Wolf's side and whispered to him.
"Brother Wolf, I think this woman is just talking nonsense here. Look at her, how could she know Gaius at such a young age?"
"That's right. The people who can get in touch with Gaius are all big shots. This woman definitely doesn't know Gaius. She's obviously scaring us on purpose. Brother Wolf, don't fall for it…"
The rest of the lackeys also followed suit.
After Wolf heard what his little brother said, the expression on his face eased up a little.
At this moment, he also felt that Chieko couldn't possibly know such a powerful person, so Wolf said to her, "Are you lying to me?"
"Do you think I need to lie to you? If you don't believe me, then we'll just wait here…" Chieko said.
"Alright, I'll wait here now. If I find out that you're lying to me later, I'll definitely kill you tonight…"
Wolf said through gritted teeth.
Meanwhile, Connor had been standing there quietly. He knew very well that he didn't need to care about such a small matter. Chieko would definitely be able to handle it.
At this moment, a trace of doubt flashed across Jeanette's eyes. She then turned her head and asked Eugenia softly, "Eugenia, do you know who Gaius is?"
"Gaius is a well-known sheriff in Honduria. It's said that he's very powerful. He's very influential in both the underworld and the overworld. Many big clans in Honduria have to respect him…" Eugenia explained in a low voice.
After Jeanette heard Eugenia's words, the expression on her face seemed to be a little excited. She hurriedly said, "Then Eugenia, if this woman really knows such a powerful big shot, won't we be saved today?"
"You're thinking too much. How could a big shot like Gaius know her? I think she might be stalling for time!"
Eugenia shook her head helplessly.
Jeanette looked at Chieko with a puzzled expression.
Although Jeanette felt that Eugenia's words made sense, the expression on Chieko's face was extremely confident. She did not look like she was stalling for time at all.
"If this woman really doesn't know Gaius, then why is she so confident?"
Jeanette could not help but sigh in her heart. Then, she subconsciously looked at Connor and discovered that he was also very confident at this moment.

chapters.title: Chapter 1472: Provoking Someone You Shouldn't!
chapters.content:
Chapter 1472: Provoking Someone You Shouldn't!
Time passed.
At this moment, everyone was waiting quietly. They were all curious if Gaius would come.
Half an hour later, a black Audi drove over and stopped in front of the bus.
When Wolf saw the Audi, his face was filled with confusion.
Soon, the car door opened.
A middle-aged man got out of the car.
When Wolf saw this man, he was completely dumbfounded. The expression on his face was abnormally incredulous.
This was because the middle-aged man who had appeared was none other than Gaius Low.
Of course, Wolf's lackeys all knew Gaius, so they were all dumbfounded.
"How is that possible? This woman really knew Gaius. Who is she?"
Eugenia also sighed.
After Gaius got out of the car, he quickly walked up to Chieko and said respectfully, "Miss Dullahan, I'm really sorry. I'm a little late…"
Chieko took her mother's surname, which was how she got her current name.
However, Chieko's father's surname was Dullahan, so many people in Honduria still liked to refer to Chieko as Miss Dullahan.
"Sheriff Low, sorry for troubling you to come over personally for such a small matter!"
Chieko replied expressionlessly.
"Miss Dullahan, what are you saying? It's my honor to be able to serve you!" Gaius said with trepidation.
At this moment, everyone present was dumbfounded. They really couldn't understand who Chieko was and why Gaius was so respectful to her. This scene was too strange.
These people probably didn't know that Chieko had been constantly expanding her power in order to take revenge. She had spent a lot of effort to collect a lot of evidence of Gaius's crimes. Once this criminal evidence was handed over, Gaius would die.
Therefore, Gaius listened to Chieko's words obediently
Chieko pointed at Wolf and the others in front of her and said expressionlessly, "These people are blocking my way. How do you think we should deal with them?"
"Miss Dullahan, leave this matter to me!"
Gaius hurriedly replied in a low voice, then walked toward Wolf.
Wolf was completely scared out of his wits. He had never thought that Chieko would really know Gaius. Moreover, Gaius was so respectful to Chieko. All of this proved how noble Chieko's identity was.
Wolf originally thought that Eugenia being able to get to know someone like Chandler was already their biggest trump card. However, who would have thought that Chieko's background was the most terrifying?
"It was you people who blocked Miss Dullahan's way, wasn't it?"
Gaius seemed to have changed into a different person as he shouted coldly at Wolf and the others.
"S-Sheriff Low, I... I didn't know this was Miss Dullahan. I also... I didn't know that she actually knew you. I really didn't know. If I knew, even if I had..."
Wolf stammered as he tried to explain.
"Pa!"
Gaius didn't waste any words and slapped Wolf's face.
Wolf took two steps back and looked at Gaius with a terrified expression, not knowing what to do.
"Did I ask you that?"
Gaius asked Wolf with his eyes wide open.
"No... No…"
Wolf gritted his teeth and shook his head.
At this moment, when everyone present saw this scene, their expressions were also filled with sighs.
No one had expected that Wolf, who had been incomparably arrogant just now, would actually be so humble in front of Gaius at this moment. He did not even dare to say a word.
"I don't care what your reason is. You blocked Miss Dullahan's way just now, that's your problem. Do you understand what I mean?"
Gaius shouted.
"I understand!"
Wolf hurriedly nodded.
"Since you understand, then what the hell are you still standing here for? Hurry up and apologize to Miss Dullahan!"
Gaius glared at him and shouted angrily.
Wolf took a deep breath and ran to Chieko. He said nervously, "Miss Dullahan, I was wrong..."
"Bang!"
Gaius lifted his leg and kicked hisi. Then, he glared at him and shouted, "Kneel down and apologize…"
"Alright, alright…"
Wolf didn't dare to waste any more time and quickly agreed. He then looked at Chieko and said, "Miss Dullahan, it's all my fault today. Can you give me another chance? I really know my mistake now…"
Eugenia, who was standing at the side and watching this scene, was also filled with emotions. Because at this moment, she finally understood why Connor and Chieko were so confident!
A person like Wolf was nothing in their eyes.
"I didn't expect this woman to be so powerful…"
Jeanette couldn't help but sigh softly.
"That's right. If I had known that the two of them were so powerful, I would not have gone through so much trouble…"
Eugenia knew that she was safe now, so her tone was obviously much more relaxed.
"Who are they? They actually know a big shot like Gaius!"
Jeanette continued.
Eugenia could not help but size up Connor. She realized that he had not said much from the beginning to the end, but he gave off the feeling that he was abnormally confident, as if he did not take these things to heart at all.
Gaius saw that Wolf had apologized, so he asked Chieko with a smile, "Miss Dullahan, is this alright?"
"Just now, this person asked me to 'go with him for a week.' I am very disgusted by this sentence!"
Chieko said casually.
"You actually said something like this?"
The expression on Gaius's face instantly changed.
Wolf's eyes flashed with panic. He kowtowed to Chieko and shouted, "Miss Dullahan, I didn't do it on purpose. I really know my mistake. I beg you, let me go. Please don't lower yourself to my level!"
"Sheriff Low, how do you think we should deal with this kind of person?"
Chieko turned her head and asked Gaius.
After hesitating for a moment, Gaius took out his pistol.
When Wolf saw Gaius take out his pistol, his expression seemed to become even more fearful. He stammered, " Sheriff Luo, please don't. I really know that I was wrong…"
"Who told you to provoke someone you shouldn't have!"
Gaius replied in a low voice, then pulled the trigger.

chapters.title: Chapter 1473: The Vile Young Man
chapters.content:
Chapter 1473: The Vile Young Man
"Bang!"
The bullet pierced through Wolf's knee.
"Ah…"
Wolf hugged his knees and wailed in pain.
When everyone saw this scene, they were all dumbfounded because no one expected Gaius to actually shoot.
Even Eugenia and Jeanette did not react to what was going on!
Blood slowly flowed down Wolf's thigh. Wolf's underlings were also scared silly at this time. They stood rooted to the ground and did not dare to move at all. Even if they had great courage, they would not dare to go against a person like Gaius!
"Oh right, there's also that person!"
Chieko pointed at Jecht, who was not far away.
Gaius didn't waste any words and aimed his pistol at Jecht.
"Bang!"
Another gunshot sounded, and the bullet pierced Jecht's thigh.
Jecht also fell to the ground with a thud.
After dealing with Jecht and Wolf, Gaius turned to Chieko and asked, "Miss Dullahan, do you think it's okay now?"
"..."
Chieko ignored Gaius and turned to look at Connor.
Connor knew that this matter was over. He had no intention of continuing to make a fuss, so he walked towards the car.
"Sheriff Low, thank you very much for today. I'll treat you to a meal if I have the chance!"
Chieko gave Gaius a faint smile before she turned around and got into the bus.
Gaius stood rooted to the ground with a strange expression on his face. He realized that Chieko was doing all this because of the young man.
However, Gaius really couldn't figure out who could make a devilish existence like Chieko listen to him so obediently.
"This person doesn't seem ordinary!" Gaius thought, then turned his head and shouted at Wolf's men, "What are you all still standing there for? Hurry up and get lost!"
Hearing Gaius's words, everyone was relieved. They quickly carried Wolf and Jecht into the car and quickly disappeared down the road.
Only then did Eugenia and Jeanette react to what was going on and hurriedly got into the bus.
When Connor and the others returned to the bus, almost everyone looked at Connor with a strange gaze.
Of course, most of the people looked at Connor with respect.
After all, Connor's performance just now was really a little unbelievable.
One had to know that Wolf and the others were already existences that they did not dare to provoke in their lifetime.
Who would have thought that Connor would know someone like Gaius Low at such a young age?
The driver started the car slowly.
Jeanette, who was sitting beside Connor, seemed a little nervous. She subconsciously turned to look at Chieko and whispered, "Sister, you're so amazing. How did you get to know someone like Sheriff Low?"
"I'm from the Dullahan family, so it's normal for me to know Gaius!"
Chieko didn't hide anything.
"So you're from the Dullahan family?"
Eugenia turned her head to look at Chieko and continued, "The Dullahan family could be considered a big family a few decades ago, but they're simply a small family compared to our Bander family!"
"Your Bander family is indeed powerful, but it doesn't mean that you, a member of a branch of the main family, are also powerful. I don't know what you have to be proud of!"
Chieko didn't hold back at all and directly mocked Eugenia.
"Who are you calling a side branch?"
Eugenia shouted indignantly.
"If you're not from a side family, how could you not even be able to get someone like Chandler Cole to join you?"
Chieko said calmly.
"I just don't want to trouble my family!"
Eugenia said angrily.
"You don't want to trouble them? Or do they not want to be troubled by you?"
"That's enough…"
Connor felt that Chieko's words were a little overboard, so he frowned and scolded her.
No matter what, Eugenia had tried to help Connor today. Although it did not have much effect, just wanting to help Connor at such a critical time also showed that this girl's heart was very kind. Otherwise, under normal circumstances, no one would be meddling in other people's business.
".."
After Chieko heard Connor's words, her expression became a little angry. However, she did not dare to disobey his orders, so she could only choose to shut her mouth obediently.
Eugenia saw that Chieko's expression was a little smug after she did not say anything. Her impression of Connor instantly improved. She had originally planned to chat with Connor, but when she turned her head, she realized that his had already closed his eyes and was resting. He did not have any intention of talking to her at all, so she did not take the initiative to talk to him.
About ten minutes later, Eugenia and Jeanette arrived at the place and prepared to get down from the bus.
"Connor, we're going down now!"
Jeanette carefully said.
"Alright, you two be careful!"
Connor replied indifferently, and then looked at Eugenia.
At this moment, Eugenia raised her chin arrogantly, as if she had no intention of talking to him.
Connor smiled helplessly and said softly, "Thank you for today!"
"Humph!"
Eugenia snorted coldly and continued, "At least you have a conscience. You two should be careful in Honduria. Don't think that you're fearless just because you're from the Dullahan family. There are many people who are more powerful than the Dullahan family in Honduria..."
"Got it!"
Connor nodded.
After hesitating for a moment, Eugenia actually took the initiative to exchange phone numbers with Connor. She even instructed him to call her if he encountered any trouble.
Connor knew that Eugenia had good intentions, so he did not reject her.
Eugenia and Jeanette both got out of the car.
Meanwhile, Connor and Chieko continued to rush toward the Dullahan family's villa.
Perhaps it was because Connor did not speak up for Chieko previously that she did not take the initiative to speak to Connor along the way.
…
2 PM.
Connor and Chieko finally arrived at Phoenix Mountain, where the Dullahan family villa was located.
"Mr. McDonald, Phoenix Mountain is just past the small town. The Dullahan family's villa is on Phoenix Mountain!"
Chieko said.
"Alright, let's go to the small town in front and have something to eat first. Then, we'll go to your Dullahan family's house!"
Connor replied indifferently.
"Fine!"
Chieko nodded gently.
As Chieko had lived here for a long time, she was very familiar with the town, so she brought Connor to a restaurant and ordered some food.
But halfway through the meal, Connor heard a commotion coming from the entrance of the restaurant.
Soon after, a young man walked in with four bodyguards.
The young man was wearing a black suit. He wasn't very tall, and looked like a rather wretched person.
Behind the young man were four bodyguards. These four bodyguards were tall and were all martial artists.

chapters.title: Chapter 1474: Surrender Without a Fight
chapters.content:
Chapter 1474: Surrender Without a Fight
Chieko was a little nervous when she saw the young man. She shouted in surprise, "It's Ivan Dullahan!"
Connor turned to look at Chieko and asked, "Do you know this person?"
"This person is my third uncle's son, Ivan Dullahan. He's probably here for the two of us!"
Chieko explained.
"It seems that the news of us coming to Honduria has been leaked…"
Connor replied indifferently while eating. His expression was very calm.
"Mr. McDonald, the four people behind Ivan are all bodyguards of our Dullahan family. They are also martial artists. You have to be careful!"
Chieko whispered.
Although Connor knew that the Dullahan family had already arrived, his expression was still very calm, as if he did not care about these people at all.
At this moment, Chieko was very nervous. After all, her appearance here with Connor meant that she had already told the Dullahan family that she had betrayed them. If the plan failed, all her years of hard work would be in vain.
At this moment, Ivan walked up to Chieko and said with a smile, "Chieko, why didn't you tell us that you were home? I could've asked someone to pick you up!"
Ivan said as he sized up Chieko with a wretched gaze.
Although Ivan was related to Chieko by blood, he had been coveting Chieko's body all these years.
However, Ivan did not dare to do anything to Chieko because the Dullahan family head was prepared to give her to Yaakov Ward.
However, the Dullahan family had already found out that Chieko had betrayed them. Therefore, Chieko was already in Ivan's eyes. As long as he could capture Connor today, he could do whatever he wanted to Chieko.
Ivan looked at Chieko's sexy figure and was a little excited. To be able to get such a beauty into his bed, how exciting was that?!
After Ivan learned that Chieko and Connor had gotten off the car, he led his men to search the entire town. However, he did not expect his luck to be so good that he could find Connor and Chieko so quickly.
"Ivan, what are you doing here?"
Chieko took a deep breath and shouted at him expressionlessly.
She had been developing her own strength without the Dullahan family's knowledge. Therefore, she had her own business empire in Honduria. The rich heirs of the Dullahan family could not compare to her.
"Cousin, don't you know what I want to do? According to the information we have now, you colluded with outsiders to frame our Dullahan family. Therefore, the family head has already ordered me to capture you and bring you back. As for how to deal with you next, that's the family head's business…"
Ivan paused for a moment and then continued, "Chieko, the family head has always been protecting you, so I didn't dare to do anything to you. But now the situation is different. You're the sinner of our Dullahan family. I advise you to surrender quickly."
"Ivan, if you dare to touch me today!"
"Let's try it!" Ivan did not waste any time. He turned around and shouted at the bodyguards behind him, "What are you all still standing there for? Hurry up and arrest the two of them!"
After hearing Ivan's words, the four bodyguards immediately rushed towards Chieko and Connor.
Connor's expression was a little strange. Then, he stood up and said expressionlessly, "You think you can catch me? Ridiculous!"
"Kid, cut the crap!"
One of the bodyguards shouted and reached out to grab Connor's shoulder.
"Bang!"
Connor sent the bodyguard flying with a slap. The bodyguard's body slammed into the table.
One had to know that this bodyguard was extremely tall and weighed at least 200 pounds. As soon as he crashed into the table, he instantly smashed it into pieces.
"Ahh!"
When the customers in the restaurant saw this scene, they instantly fell into a panic, and their expressions were extremely terrified.
Connor looked at the bodyguard who was sent flying by his slap, and his expression was a little surprised. He had never thought his strength would increase by so much after learning the circulation technique.
After all, the person who was sent flying by Connor's slap just now was not an ordinary person. Although he wasn't of a very high rank, he was still a martial artist.
Previously, it was impossible for Connor to knock out a martial artist with one slap.
But just now, though he didn't even use his full strength, he already had such a terrifying effect.
"This old man is indeed something. This circulation technique is really mysterious…" Connor could not help but think.
Ivan seemed to have realized that something was wrong. He hurriedly shouted at the remaining three bodyguards, "What are you three still standing there for? Hurry up and take care of this kid…"
The remaining three bodyguards naturally did not dare to be careless at this time. They directly rushed towards Connor.
Although these three people were all martial artists, when faced with Connor, they were as effective as ants against an anteater.
In less than half a minute, Connor sent all three bodyguards flying.
Chieko had seen Connor's methods before, but she didn't expect him to be so terrifying. He was facing four martial artists alone, and the four martial artists didn't even have a chance to fight back. They were all defeated with a single blow.
Ivan stood on the spot foolishly, the expression on his face fearful.
Just a second ago, he was still fantasizing about how he was going to ravage Chieko, but the next second, his fantasies were shattered.
Connor's terrifying strength instantly woke him up.
"This... Who is this person? How could his strength be so terrifying?"
Ivan looked at Connor, terrified.
When Chieko learned of Connor's true strength, her originally nervous mood instantly calmed down a lot. She crossed her arms and asked Ivan coldly, "Ivan, weren't you planning to capture me just now? Why aren't you making a move now?"
"Chieko, the whole of Honduria is looking for you two. You two will never leave this place. I advise you to surrender without a fight…"
Ivan shouted while trembling.

chapters.title: Chapter 1475: Dullahan Family Villa
chapters.content:
Chapter 1475: Dullahan Family Villa
"Mr. McDonald, he wants us to surrender!"
Chieko turned to Connor.
"Surrender?" Connor sneered, then went forward and grabbed Ivan's collar.
"What are you doing? Let me tell you, I'm a member of the Dullahan family—"
Ivan shouted at Connor with a terrified expression.
"Tell me, what other methods have the Dullahan family prepared to deal with me?"
Connor asked expressionlessly.
"I won't tell you. You'd better let me go now, or you'll die a horrible death!"
Ivan shouted at the top of his lungs.
After Connor heard this sentence, his expression seemed a little helpless. Then, he slapped Ivan's face fiercely.
"Pa!"
Ivan's head tilted to the side, and he directly fainted.
Chieko stepped forward and asked nervously, "Mr. McDonald, what should we do next?"
She had already expected that she and Connor would definitely experience a fierce battle in Honduria, but she did not expect the Dullahan family to react so quickly.
Although the Dullahan family was no longer the same family as the past and couldn't be compared with those real big clans in Honduria, with the help of Yaakov Ward and Rockefeller, the Dullahan family's battle forces couldn't be underestimated.
"Mr. McDonald, what should we do now?"
Chieko asked nervously.
Connor turned his head and said, " It seems that the news of us coming to Honduria has been exposed. Otherwise, the Dullahan family wouldn't have attacked us so quickly. Our only recourse is to go straight to them. Hopefully, Yelena will still be with them…"
"Mr. McDonald, are you planning to go to the Dullahan family just like this?"
Chieko was shocked when she heard Connor's words.
"Is there a problem?" Connor asked.
"Mr. McDonald, I think the Dullahan family must have already made plans to deal with the two of us. If the two of us go to the family villa like this, we will be courting death. We should plan carefully before going to them…"
Chieko said cautiously.
"There's no need…" Connor gently shook his head and said, "The Dullahan family members that you can think of will definitely think the same way as you, but they definitely won't expect the two of us to attack them so quickly..."
"..."
Chieko looked nervous.
After all, Connor didn't know what kind of existence the Dullahan family was, but Chieko knew very well.
"Let's go…"
Connor said.
She took a deep breath and followed behind Connor in her high heels.
At this moment, the people in the restaurant looked at Connor with very strange expressions. After all, the scene of him dealing with Ivan and the other five people alone was too shocking. Even the owner of the restaurant had forgotten to ask him for compensation.
Connor and Chieko walked out of the restaurant with Chieko leading the way. Connor was constantly thinking about what he should do next.
Honduria was very different from Oprana; Thomas Morgan had also warned Connor that Steven Lee's influence here was very small. Although Steven Lee had been trying to expand his influence in Honduria, the effect was minimal because Rockefeller had come here at the right time, at the right place, and with the right people.
This meant that Connor had no one to rely on in Honduria. No matter what happened, he had to solve it himself.
Of course, Chieko had some connections in Honduria, but those connections were nothing in the face of Rockefeller's forces.
At this time, Connor also felt that something was wrong. The Dullahan family had clearly known that Connor and Chieko had come to Honduria in advance, but their reaction had been to attack Connor. This showed that all this might be according to their plans.
"Could it be that Yaakov Ward intentionally leaked this information to me? Did he just want to lure me to Honduria?"
Connor instantly realized what was going on, and his expression was a little strange.
Although Connor knew that all of this was very likely to be part of Yaakov Ward's plan, Connor still did not choose to give up. After all, Yelena was still in the hands of the Dullahan family. Connor would definitely not sit idly by.
About ten minutes later, Chieko suddenly stopped in her tracks.
"We're here already?"
Connor asked.
Chieko hesitated for a moment before asking, "Mr. McDonald, the white villa up ahead is the Dullahan family's manor. Are you sure you want to go in now?"
"..."
Connor slowly looked up at the villa in front of him and said, "Since we're already here, let's go in and take a look…"
Chieko looked helpless when she heard Connor's words. However, she knew that it was useless no matter what she said, especially since Connor had already made up his mind to go in.
…
On the other side, in the Dullahan family manor.
At this moment, the Dullahan family's higher-ups had all gathered in the living room, as if they were discussing something intensely.
However, the middle-aged man sitting at the head of the table was the current head of the Dullahan family, and also Chieko's uncle, Gerald Dullahan.
In fact, Gerald was very mediocre compared to Chieko's father. If it weren't for Yaakov Ward's intervention, the person sitting in this position would be Chieko's father.
After Chieko's father died, Gerald became the head of the Dullahan family.
Under the leadership of Gerald, the Dullahan family declined day by day. As of now, they had completely become Yaakov Ward's subsidiary in Honduria. If it weren't for the fact that Yaakov 's businesses in Honduria needed the Dullahan family's help, they might have already fallen into desolation.
Chieko hated Gerald to the core. If Gerald had not worked with Yaakov to frame her father, her father would not have died. Moreover, Gerald had imprisoned Chieko in the Dullahan family for so many years, all so that he could give her to Yaakov.
Giving herself to her father's murderer would be a huge humiliation.
However, Chieko knew very well that she did not have the ability to directly compete with the Dullahan family and Yaakov, so she had been enduring and waiting for an opportunity to develop her strength.
And now, her chance had finally arrived in the form of Connor!

chapters.title: Chapter 1476: A Debate
chapters.content:
Chapter 1476: A Debate
"Mr. Dullahan, I feel that there's no need for us to be so ruthless. Connor's background is not simple. If we really offend him, it will also be an extremely big trouble for our Dullahan family…" a middle-aged man said to Gerald.
"Personally, I think what you said is wrong, but we have already made a move on Connor's lover, and he's coming over soon. If you go to make peace with him now, how do you plan to explain it to President Ward?"
Another middle-aged man said.
"That's right. One side is a wolf and the other side is a tiger. Our Dullahan family can't afford to offend either side…"
"Even if we can't afford to offend them, we've already done it. Now we have no way out!"
The Dullahan family members once again began to quarrel fiercely.
At this time, the family was roughly divided into two camps: one that was unwilling to offend Connor because they knew of his background, and the other that supported Yaakov Ward because they had already made a move on Yelena, so there was no way out.
Gerald had been thinking about something after hearing what everyone said. He didn't say a word at all.
At this moment, a middle-aged man frowned and asked, "Patriarch, what do you think?"
Gerald couldn't help but turn to look at the middle-aged man after hearing his words. Then, he said expressionlessly, "President Ward has already told us that as long as we can capture Connor, he will give the Haber Corporation to our Dullahan family. I think this is a good opportunity for our Dullahan family to turn things around!"
"Haber Corporation?"
Everyone present was stunned when they heard Gerald's words. Their faces were filled with disbelief.
The middle-aged man who had opposed Connor asked excitedly, "Patriarch, is this true?"
"Of course it's true. You should all know what a Haber Corporation means. It's a listed company worth more than ten billion dollars. If our Dullahan family can really seize this opportunity, it will be a great thing for everyone…"
Gerald said slowly.
At this moment, a middle-aged man said in a low voice, "If President Ward really intends to give the Haber Corporation to us, then I think we can still take a risk..."
"That's right, I think so too!"
"If that's the case, we can't miss this opportunity!"
It was obvious that the Dullahan family didn't want to risk too much without benefits. If they didn't give them some benefits, these people were unwilling to participate in the matters between Connor and Rockefeller.
At this moment, a slightly calmer middle-aged man said expressionlessly, "Patriarch, the temptation of the Haber Corporation is indeed very big, but there is one thing you have to consider carefully: it won't be so easy to deal with Connor. I heard that he seems to be a martial artist!"
"You don't have to worry about this; President Ward has already arranged for help. So what if Connor is a martial artist? The person President Ward sent over is also a martial artist, so we don't have to do anything. We just have to wait and watch the show..." Gerald said lightly.
After hearing Gerald's words, everyone looked relieved and happy.
After all, this was the result they really wanted to see—them not having to do anything, but still be able to sit back and reap the benefits. This was simply a good thing for the Dullahan family.
At this moment, a young man who looked like a bodyguard walked quickly to Gerald and said in a low voice, "Patriarch, we just received news that Mr. Ivan has found Connor and Chieko. He has already brought people over to capture them…"
"Good!"
Gerald nodded his head slightly, a proud expression on his face.
After hearing this, everyone realized that Gerald had already wanted to make a move on Connor, regardless of whether they agreed or not.
However, in this situation, no one would choose to stand up and refute Gerald.
Gerald looked at the crowd and explained with a smile, "I've already asked Ivan to bring people to test Connor's strength. If Connor can't even pass Ivan's test, then it'll be very easy for us to catch him. But even if he passes Ivan's test, we still have the trump card left behind by President Ward!"
"Patriarch, aren't you afraid of alerting the enemy?"
A middle-aged man asked in confusion.
"You don't have to worry about that. We've already investigated Connor beforehand. He's very arrogant. Additionally, his woman is still in our hands. Since he dares to come to Honduria alone, he won't leave easily..."
Gerald said lightly.
At this moment, a young woman said in a cold voice, "I just didn't expect Chieko to betray the Dullahan family so quickly. If I had known earlier, I would have gotten rid of her!"
"Shame that President Ward took a fancy to this woman, or I would have gotten rid of her long ago," Gerald said lightly.
"Patriarch!"
At this moment, another bodyguard rushed into the living room in a panic.
"What happened?"
Gerald frowned when he saw the bodyguard's expression.
"Patriarch, the bodyguards that Mr. Ivan brought with him were all defeated by the young man with Chieko. Connor's strength is extremely terrifying—the four bodyguards could not even withstand a single blow from him. They did not have any chance to retaliate at all!" the bodyguard shouted excitedly.
After Gerald heard the bodyguard's words, the expression on his face changed slightly. He frowned and said, "This Connor is that powerful?"
"Yeah, we didn't expect Connor's skills to be so terrifying!" the bodyguard hurriedly said.
Gerald looked at the bodyguard in front of him with an ugly expression, but he didn't say anything.
At this moment, another bodyguard shouted excitedly.
"Patriarch, Chieko has brought Connor to the entrance of the villa…"
"What is it? Are they already at the door?"
Gerald seemed to have not recovered from the shock just now when he heard another shocking piece of news.
No one expected Connor and Chieko to be so fast as to have already arrived at the entrance of the villa.

chapters.title: Chapter 1477: They're Here!
chapters.content:
Chapter 1477: They're Here!
"This Connor is too bold! He actually delivered himself to my doorstep?"
A middle-aged man from the Dullahan family frowned in surprise.
"That's right. I didn't expect him to be so hasty…" another middle-aged man said.
"Patriarch, didn't you say that President Ward has already sent an expert to deal with Connor? Where is that expert?"
The Dullahan family's seniors asked Gerald anxiously.
After Gerald heard this, his face looked a little helpless. He frowned and said, "President Ward's people hasn't arrived yet..."
"What?"
"Connor has already come to our door, but President Ward's people haven't come yet?"
"Then what should we do now?"
"Isn't this a joke?"
For a moment, all the Dullahan family members present fell into panic, and their expressions were nervous.
After all, the Dullahan family's combat strength was very limited. Without the help of Yaakov Ward, they would be in a very dangerous situation.
At this moment, a young man spoke. "Patriarch, why don't we pretend to surrender and buy some time…"
Gerald frowned, "Connor came for that woman today. If you choose to surrender now, you have to return that woman to Connor…"
".."
For a moment, everyone in the Dullahan family could not help but gasp.
"Now we can only ask our bodyguards to stop Connor and help stall for some time. I think President Ward's people should be here soon…"
Gerald knew very well that he must not panic at this time. After all, if he panicked, the others would definitely panic even more.
Gerald looked at the seniors of the Dullahan family. "Everyone, please rest assured. Although Connor's strength is extraordinary, he's not a god. We have nearly 30 bodyguards. It shouldn't be a problem for these people to stall Connor. When President Ward's people come over, he will die today..."
Although the Dullahan family was worried, they had no better idea since Gerald had already said so. They could only pray in their hearts that Yaakov's reinforcements would come soon.
"Since Connor is already here, let's go out and welcome the guests!"
Gerald took a deep breath and walked out of the door, pretending to be calm.
The Dullahan family's seniors exchanged glances with each other and followed Gerald out.
After all, they had no better choice now. They could only take it one step at a time.
…
On the other side, Connor and Chieko had already entered the Dullahan family's manor.
Although there were bodyguards who stopped them at the door just now, they were sent flying by Connor's slap. After all, those bodyguards at the door were just a few ordinary people. They were nothing in Connor's eyes.
Chieko followed closely behind with a nervous expression.
This was the first time that she had walked into the Dullahan family's manor in such a way.
Right now, Chieko had placed her life in Connor's hands. If he could leave this place alive, she would be able to live. However, if he failed, she would still be in the Dullahan family.
Chieko had been planning to take revenge for many years, but she never thought that this day would come so quickly and suddenly.
"Who is it? How dare you trespass into our Dullahan family?"
At this moment, a bodyguard rushed out and shouted at Connor with an excited expression.
"Ask the head of your Dullahan family to come out and see me!"
Connor said to the bodyguard expressionlessly.
"Do you think you deserve to see the head?"
The bodyguard looked at Connor with a hint of disdain in his eyes.
"Am I not worthy to meet your patriarch, or does he not dare to come out and meet me?"
Connor could not help but sneer.
"I'm not in the mood to talk nonsense with you now. I'll give you one last chance to get lost quickly, or we won't hold back!"
The bodyguard glared at Connor.
"And do what?" Connor could not help but sneer when he heard the bodyguard's words.
"Arrest these two!" the bodyguard shouted.
In an instant, dozens of bodyguards rushed out from the corner.
These bodyguards were all holding weapons in their hands, and Connor could feel that they wre probably all martial artists. Although their ranks were very low, their physical fitness was definitely not something that ordinary people could compare to.
Although the Dullahan family had fallen into desolation, it had to be said that the Dullahan family really had some foundation. Otherwise, it would be impossible to gather so many martial artist bodyguards.
Of course, this was also the difference between Honduria and Oprana.
Most families in Oprana did not pay much attention to martial artists. Moreover, martial artists in Oprana did not even bother to be bodyguards for others and usually chose to join sects like the Purple Cloud Sect. After all, the treatment in the sect was far better than being a bodyguard in a big family. This was why there were very few martial artists in Porthampton, regardless of the size of the family.
Even a big shot like Thomas Morgan had very few martial artists by his side—Carlos Lane was the only one. As a result, the probability of Connor encountering a fighter in Oprana was very low.
However, it was different in Honduria. Generally, big clans would train a lot of warriors to protect themselves. Lower-ranked fighters could be seen everywhere.
Although Chieko had been living in the Dullahan family for a long time, she never expected that there would be so many martial artists in the family.
In an instant, these warriors surrounded them.
Chieko was terrified because she had never seen such a scene before. She whispered nervously, "Mr. McDonald, what should we do now?"
Although Chieko knew that Connor was definitely skilled, he was facing so many martial artists alone. If these people took turns fighting, Connor would definitely not be able to withstand it.
However, Chieko didn't know that although Connor and the bodyguards were martial artists, there was still a huge gap between martial artists.
It was like an eight-foot-tall man facing dozens of three-year-olds. No matter how many three-year-olds there were, they were definitely not a match for the eight-foot-tall man.

chapters.title: Chapter 1478: Confrontation
chapters.content:
Chapter 1478: Confrontation
"If there's a fight later, you'll have to stick close to me. I'll protect you!"
Connor said to Chieko expressionlessly.
"I understand…"
Chieko nodded.
"Brat, I will give you one last chance. If you still do not leave, we'll throw you out!"
The leading bodyguard said arrogantly to Connor.
Connor looked at the bodyguard indifferently and did not say anything.
"So you want to do it the hard way!"
The leading bodyguard snorted. Then, he waved his hand and shouted expressionlessly, "Attack!"
For a moment, countless bodyguards rushed straight to Connor.
When Chieko saw this scene, she instinctively closed her eyes because she did not dare to see what was going to happen next.
Connor rushed into the crowd of bodyguards at a shockingly fast speed. It was not something that these bodyguards could compare to at all.
He promptly punched the bodyguard in front of him, sending the bodyguard flying with a cry.
At this moment, Connor was like a bolt of lightning, shuttling back and forth among these bodyguards. Almost every time he attacked, he would send a bodyguard flying.
Because Connor's speed was too fast, those bodyguards couldn't even see his clothes. They could only feel him shuttling back and forth.
In less than half a minute, seven or eight bodyguards had fallen to the ground.
The moment Chieko opened her eyes, she felt that everything she saw was too unreal.
To think that Connor was able to deal with so many people so easily. This was really unbelievable.
Connor himself did not expect his speed to increase so drastically. When Connor learned how to control the aura in his body, his speed had undergone a huge change, far faster than before.
At this moment, the bodyguards were also a little dumbfounded. They stood on the ground with their mouths agape. Fear was written on their faces; they did not expect Connor's strength to be so terrifying. This had obviously exceeded their understanding.
"Is this guy a black rank?"
One of the bodyguards shouted excitedly.
"Impossible, absolutely impossible, how could there be such a young black rank warrior?"
The captain quickly retorted.
"Boss, this person is too fast! We can't keep up with his speed at all. What should we do now?"
The bodyguard captain hesitated for a moment before gritting his teeth and saying, "Are you all a bunch of trash? So what if he's fast? How many people do we have? Stop this person for me!"
When everyone heard the bodyguard captain's words, they instantly formed a circle, as if they were prepared to use this method to control Connor's actions.
After all, in the eyes of these people, Connor was just faster. If they could restrict him, then no matter how powerful he was, it would be useless.
For a moment, these bodyguards charged at Connor almost at the same time. Then, they raised their weapons and slashed at his head.
"Go to hell!"
One of the bodyguards couldn't help but shout angrily.
"Mr. McDonald, be careful!"
Chieko, who was full of confidence in Connor, was dumbfounded at this moment. She shouted at Connor with a desperate expression.
She felt that although he was powerful, he was still a human, not a god. If he was really hit by these machetes, he would probably die on the spot.
Facing the overwhelming weapons, Connor closed his eyes and started circulating the Chi in his body.
With a loud bang, the Chi in Connor's body gushed out.
He was using his Chi to send the surrounding bodyguards flying.
For a moment, the bodyguards who were originally surrounding Connor were all sent flying.
After the bodyguard captain saw this scene, he couldn't help but stare in disbelief because he had never seen such a situation before!
"This... Who is this kid?"
The bodyguard captain stared at Connor with his eyes wide open, shock on his face. He felt that the scene just now was really unbelievable.
"Isn't Mr. McDonald too powerful?"
Chieko stared at Connor with shock on her face.
Connor's actions had clearly exceeded her understanding of martial artists. Chieko had no idea that martial artists could be so powerful.
She didn't even see what had happened. When she opened her eyes, the bodyguards had already been sent flying
