However, although Connor did send some bodyguards flying, his grasp of the Chi circulation technique was not very stable yet, so some bodyguards were still standing. They continued to rush towards Connor.
The bodyguard at the front raised his hand aimed straight for Connor's head, but Connor's reaction speed was very fast. He hurriedly turned his body to dodge the machete.
However, another bodyguard also rushed up, suddenly locking Connor in a pincer attack.
Although Connor dodged the bodyguard in front of him, the bodyguard on the side slashed his arm.
At this moment of life and death, Connor transferred all the Chi in his body to his arm.
However, because Connor had just released most of the Chi in his body, the Chi he'd transferred to his arm was very weak.
Even so, it still helped block most of the damage.
The machete first broke through the Chi barrier before slashing at Connor's arm.
This also caused most of the force behind the slash to be offset when it landed on Connor's arm, only inflicting a small wound.
For a moment, everyone present was scared silly, and their expressions were extremely shocked.
After all, these people were very clear about how terrifying that slash was. However, no one expected that even such a slash would not be able to cause too much damage to Connor.

chapters.title: Chapter 1479: Mr. Lancaster
chapters.content:
Chapter 1479: Mr. Lancaster
"How is this possible?"
At this moment, the bodyguard captain was also a little dumbfounded. He looked at Connor in surprise.
He didn't know how to describe his feelings now, because this entire situation was really too strange.
Connor raised his leg and kicked the bodyguard in front of him, sending him flying. Then, he turned to the side and punched out, sending the bodyguard who had cut his arm with a machete flying.
After dealing with these two people, the remaining bodyguards had already chosen to give up resisting and looked at Connor with fear.
They knew very clearly that they were not a match for Connor at all. If they continued to attack him now, it would be no different from courting death.
Connor walked towards the villa. These bodyguards did not have the courage to stop him at all.
After a moment of hesitation, Chieko quickly caught up with Connor.
In the quiet manor, it was as if only the sound of their footsteps could be heard.
Who would have thought that even with so many bodyguards, they could not stop a single man?
When the captain of the bodyguards who had been standing in front of the villa saw Connor walking over, he instinctively wanted to take out his weapon to stop him, but Connor did not give him any chance to attack at all. He raised his leg and kicked the captain in the stomach.
The bodyguard captain's body smashed into the wall. He fainted on the spot.
At this moment, Gerald finally led the Dullahan family out of the villa.
When the Dullahan family saw the bodyguards who had been knocked down by Connor, they were all very surprised because they did not expect such an outcome.
Gerald was also very nervous, but he didn't dare to show it. He pretended to be calm and shouted at Chieko in a low voice, "Chieko, you colluded with outsiders to break into my Dullahan family manor. What do you want?"
"It's not what I want to do now, but rather what Mr. McDonald wants. I'm just leading him!"
Perhaps it was because she had seen Connor's true abilities that Chieko's expression was very relaxed at this time. She was also very confident when talking to Gerald.
Gerald took a deep breath, then asked in a low voice, "May I know why this man has come to my Dullahan family? You injured so many of our bodyguards for no reason. Shouldn't you give us an explanation?"
"Don't play dumb here. My name is Connor McDonald. Don't you know why I'm here today?"
Connor said expressionlessly as he sized up the patriarch.
"So you're the infamous Mr. McDonald. I really don't know why you came to our Dullahan family this time…"
Gerald said.
"I don't have time to waste with you now. Hurry up and hand over Yelena, or I'll destroy your Dullahan family today!"
Connor shouted at Gerald coldly.
"..."
After hearing Connor's words, everyone from the Dullahan family looked shocked.
Gerald smiled disdainfully and said lightly, "Mr. McDonald, I've heard about your story. I admit that the legacy left by Mr. Lee really gives you the confidence to say that. However, don't forget that this is Honduria, not Oprana."
Obviously, Gerald was stalling for time.
He had just called the martial artist hired by Yaakov Ward. The other party would be here soon, so Gerald had to stall until the martial artist showed up.
Connor looked at Gerald's face with disgust. Then, in a flash of movement, he appeared in front of Gerald and reached out to grab his neck.
"Bang!"
However, at this moment, a figure suddenly rushed in front of Gerald and slapped Connor's chest.
Connor took two steps back to stabilize his body.
It could be seen that the person blocking Gerald at this time was a martial artist who seemed to be very powerful. If he wasn't, it would be impossible for him to push back Connor with one palm.
Connor slowly raised his head and looked at the middle-aged man in front of him. The man was wearing a black linen robe and a pair of gold-rimmed glasses. He looked very refined, but didn't look like he was a martial artist at all. Instead, he was more like a professor teaching in a university.
Gerald looked at the man in front of him with an excited expression. He hurriedly shouted, "Mr. Lancaster, you're finally here!"
"Patriarch, I'm really sorry to have kept you waiting just now!"
Mr. Lancaster replied expressionlessly.
"Mr. Lancaster, you must teach this Connor and that b*tch Chieko a lesson today. She actually dared to come to our Dullahan family and beat people up!"
"That's right. These two people are really too detestable. Mr. Lancaster, you must not let these two people off today!"
The Dullahan family members knew that this Mr. Lancaster was probably the helper that Yaakov Ward had hired, so at this moment, everyone's expressions were excited. They gritted their teeth as if there was really some great hatred between them and Connor.
Chieko sized up Mr. Lancaster and said, "Mr. McDonald, this Mr. Lancaster is not any other warrior. His real name is Jordan Lancaster, and he's a very famous fighter in Honduria. He's very powerful and has numerous disciples under him. He's very prestigious in the ancient martial arts world of Honduria."
"This person's cultivation is still below mine. He is not considered a powerful man when faced with me…"
Connor said calmly.
"Mr. Lancaster, as long as you can help our Dullahan family overcome this crisis today, our Dullahan family will definitely give you a generous gift in the future!" Gerald hurriedly shouted at Jordan.
Jordan glanced at Gerald and said calmly, "I'm here because an old friend asked me to. Mr. Dullahan, you don't have to be so polite!"
After saying this, Jordan took a step forward and said to Connor, "Mr. McDonald, I hear you're from the Purple Cloud Sect. I originally didn't want to have a conflict with you, but your actions today are obviously not what a martial artist should do, so I advise you to stop and leave this place as soon as possible!"
"I'll leave, but only if the Dullahan family hands over Yelena. Otherwise, no matter who stands in my way today, I won't leave!"
Connor said lightly.

chapters.title: Chapter 1480: A Pyrrhic Victory At Best!
chapters.content:
Chapter 1480: A Pyrrhic Victory At Best!
"The person you're talking about isn't here at all. Stop pestering us!"
Gerald shouted excitedly.
"Looks like you really won't cry until you see the coffin!"
Connor sneered and then walked towards Gerald.
Jordan stood in front of him and said in a low voice, "Mr. McDonald, if you take another step forward, I won't hold back!"
Connor looked at Jordan indifferently, then asked expressionlessly, "And? Is that supposed to be a threat?"
After Jordan heard Connor's words, his expression became a little strange. Then, he pulled out the sword he had brought with him.
Connor had seen a lot of martial artists, but he didn't have the impression that many of them used weapons; after all, in modern society, it would be strange for someone to carry a knife or a sword with them.
However, Jordan was different—he was a very famous fighter in Honduria and had high prestige, so no one would be surprised if he went out with a sword.
Jordan's sword was also not an ordinary item. When the sword was unsheathed, Connor could feel a wave of cold Chi emanating from it.
The white longsword was emitting waves of coldness. Many people in Honduria had been killed by this sword before.
"Mr. Lancaster, you must get rid of this brat today. Let's see if he still dares to be so arrogant!"
"That's right. This kid doesn't think highly of Honduria at all!"
When the Dullahan family saw Jordan draw his sword, they shouted excitedly.
At this moment, a trace of killing intent flashed in Jordan's eyes because he could feel that Connor had indeed not taken him seriously ever since he'd shown up.
When Chieko saw that Jordan was about to attack Connor, she became nervous again.
Although Connor's battle strength was already terrifying, Jordan was not an ordinary person. She could not predict who would win the battle.
However, Chieko knew that there were many people in the Dullahan family who coveted her beauty. If Connor lost to Jordan today, she might become the plaything of the Dullahan family.
It had been so many years, and countless people had evil thoughts about Chieko. However, due to various reasons, they couldn't do anything to her.
However, the situation was different now.
Therefore, Chieko could only pray in her heart that Connor would not lose to Jordan.
Jordan drew his sword and looked at Connor expressionlessly.
"Come!"
Connor challenged.
Jordan did not waste any time. He held his sword and rushed towards Connor, then slashed at his head.
The speed of Jordan's sword attack was very shocking. In the eyes of the Dullahan family, Jordan had already rushed in front of Connor in the blink of an eye. If it was a normal person, it was likely that they would have died tragically under Jordan's sword before they could react to what was going on.
However, Connor wasn't an ordinary person. He was able to defeat so many bodyguards so easily, which showed that he had some skill.
Connor dodged Jordan's long sword, then turned around and punched Jordan's chest.
Jordan easily dodged his attack. The sword collided with Connor's fist
Although Jordan had not injured Connor yet, everyone could feel that Jordan still had the initiative while Connor was being very passive.
Slash!
At this moment, Jordan's sword ore through Connor's clothes.
Blood flowed out slowly from the wound.
Connor's speed was indeed very shocking, but that was only when compared to those bodyguards. When facing Jordan, Connor's speed advantage was not so obvious.
"Mr. McDonald!"
After Chieko saw Connor bleeding, she became even more nervous.
Everyone from the Dullahan family was extremely excited because they felt that Jordan would definitely be able to defeat Connor.
At this moment, some people had even begun to think that once Jordan defeated Connor, their Dullahan family would be able to obtain the Haber Corporation.
One had to know that the Haber Corporation was a listed company worth tens of billions. Once the Dullahan family got this group, it would mean that they had a chance to turn things around.
Furthermore, there was something even more exciting happening right now: those who were interested in Chieko were also imagining how they would humiliate this beautiful character when she became their plaything!
Of course, those who had such thoughts were basically the juniors of the Dullahan family.
It could be said that the juniors of the Dullahan family would fantasize about themselves playing with Chieko almost every night. After all, this woman was too attractive. Any hot-blooded man would have such an impulse.
The Dullahan family members were very happy at this moment, but Jordan's expression was very ugly as he kept staring at Connor.
This was because Jordan felt that Connor did not seem to have used his full strength during the exchange just now. Although he had the upper hand at first glance, this advantage was actually very small. A wound that was less than five centimeters could not prove his true strength!
At this moment, Jordan felt an unprecedented sense of danger.
If it wasn't for Yaakov Ward's ordera, Jordan might have chosen to give up on this battle because he felt that this battle was really dangerous. Even if he could win, it would be a pyrrhic victory at best!
At this moment, Connor rushed towards Jordan and shouted in a low voice, "Seven Stars Big Dipper Fist, Crane Cry!"
After Jordan saw Connor attack, the expression on his face grew nervous because he could feel that the attack was very powerful.
At this moment, Jordan had two choices: to avoid the attack, or to take the blow head-on.
If Jordan chose to take this punch and succeeded, he would get a very good opportunity to counterattack. If he failed, the situation would become very dangerous.
After Jordan thought about it briefly, he chose to avoid the attack. He immediately retreated five meters and finally narrowly dodged Connor's punch.
"I didn't expect your strength to be so terrifying. It's indeed very rare to have such strength at such a young age!"
Jordan commented.

chapters.title: Chapter 1481: Flying Sword!
chapters.content:
Chapter 1481: Flying Sword!
"I have no grudge against you. As long as you stay out of it, I can let you go!"
Connor said to Jordan Lancaster expressionlessly.
When Jordan heard Connor's words, he could not help but be stunned for a moment. Then, he said in a low voice, "I have to take care of this today. It's a matter of loyalty to others!"
"Then, don't blame me for what's about to happen!"
After Connor said this, he rushed toward Jordan again.
When Jordan knew that Connor was about to attack him again, he frowned. He immediately placed his sword in front of him and shouted in a low voice, "Heavenly Flying Sword!"
In an instant, an extremely powerful aura erupted from Jordan's body.
Moreover, the aura was gathered on Jordan's long sword. The flying sword was like a tracking missile as it rushed directly toward Connor.
When the Dullahan Family saw this scene, their eyes widened, and their faces were filled with shock.
This was because they felt that such a scene would only appear in television shows.
"Mr. Lancaster is indeed powerful!"
"That's right. He has such terrifying ability…"
"As expected of Mr. Lancaster…"
Everyone in the Dullahan Family began to discuss in low voices.
On the other hand, Jordan's face darkened. After all, this move could be considered his trump card. Moreover, he had already used all the aura in his body just now. If this move could not kill Connor, then he would be in a very dangerous situation.
The longsword flew toward Connor at lightning speed.
Connor hurriedly released the aura in his body and then enveloped it around his body. This way, he could avoid being accidentally injured by the flying sword.
Connor began to run around in the courtyard, trying to dodge the flying sword.
However, this flying sword seemed to be a tracker. No matter where Connor went, it could lock onto Connor's position.
Moreover, Connor's speed was far inferior to the flying sword's speed. In less than half a minute, Connor's body had already been slashed a few times by the flying sword.
Blood stained Connor's clothes.
Chieko looked at the scene in front of her. Her small hands gripped the corner of her clothes tightly, and she was extremely nervous.
"If we can keep suppressing him like this, Mr. Lancaster will definitely be able to tear this kid into pieces today!"
"Yeah, let's see if this kid still dares to be arrogant!"
Everyone from the Dullahan Family were discussing excitedly.
At this moment, Jordan was still frowning. The reason was very simple. Although Connor seemed to be in a perilous situation, the damage caused by the flying sword was very minimal. It had only caused a few cuts, and Connor had been constantly consuming Jordan's internal strength.
If he could not deal a fatal blow to Connor before Jordan's internal strength was exhausted, then Jordan would be in a very dangerous situation.
As expected, Connor began to feel that Jordan was somewhat unable to hold on for long.
The flying sword's speed was clearly not as shocking as it was at the beginning.
Connor dodged the flying sword as he began to approach Jordan.
Once he was close enough, Connor suddenly exerted his strength and rushed toward Jordan.
Jordan was a little shocked. He hurriedly increased the speed of his flying sword.
The flying sword went straight for Connor's chest.
Connor easily dodged the flying sword with a sidestep and then shouted in a low voice, "Seven-Star Big Dipper Fist, Dragon's Roar!"
Bang!
With a loud bang, Connor's fist smashed heavily into Jordan's chest.
"How is that possible?"
After Jordan forcefully took on Connor's punch, he seemed to be a little afraid because he could feel an incomparably powerful force sweeping through his body.
"Pfft!"
Jordan spat out a mouthful of blood.
When the Dullahan family members saw this scene, they were all scared silly because they did not expect the situation to change so quickly. A second ago, Jordan still had a huge advantage, but who would have thought that in the next second, Connor would hit Jordan and even make him vomit blood.
"Seven-Star Big Dipper Fist, Tiger's Roar!"
Immediately after, Connor roared again and then suddenly threw a punch.
The punch landed viciously on Jordan's chest. Jordan was instantly sent flying and smashed into the wall.
Everyone looked at Jordan in disbelief.
Although Jordan was still breathing weakly, he had already lost the ability to move. He lay on the ground with his eyes wide open, his face filled with unwillingness and anger.
Jordan never thought that he would actually lose to Connor today.
The Dullahan Family members were also scared silly at this time. They stood in place foolishly. There was still fear on their faces. They did not expect such an outcome.
"Mr. McDonald actually won?"
Chieko stared at Connor with her big, watery eyes. Her heart was filled with shock.
When Chieko first saw Jordan, she was terrified. She had heard many things about Jordan. In Chieko's eyes, Jordan was invincible.
However, no one expected Jordan to lose to Connor just like that.
Connor walked in front of Jordan and asked Jordan calmly, "Do you still want to continue?"
"I admit defeat…"
Jordan had nearly used up his last bit of strength to say this.
He admitted defeat because he hoped that Connor would give him a way out.
When Connor heard Jordan's words, he smiled faintly and did not continue to attack Jordan.
Jordan had actually admitted defeat!
This famous ancient martial arts grandmaster in Honduria actually admitted defeat!
The Dullahan family members didn't know how to describe their feelings. They felt like they were on a roller coaster, one second in heaven and the other in hell.
A second ago, they were still feeling excited that Jordan had the upper hand. In the next second, Jordan admitted defeat just like that.
"Connor... Connor is way too terrifying."
Gerald Dullahan sighed with a trembling voice.
Jordan might have been the last hope of their Dullahan Family. If it were not for Jordan, their Dullahan Family would not have any chance to fight back!
"What should we do now?"
"Is there any other way out for us?"
Everyone from the Dullahan Family instantly fell into a panic. They did not know what to do.

chapters.title: Chapter 1482: Why Kidnap Yelena Allen?
chapters.content:
Chapter 1482: Why Kidnap Yelena Allen?
At this moment, the strength that Connor had displayed made them completely lose the thought of resisting!
"I told you we shouldn't have provoked Connor…"
"Yeah, what should we do now?"
At this moment, the Dullahan Family was already in a mess.
Gerald also stood there in a daze, not knowing what to do.
Connor walked toward Gerald. At this point, Connor was all tattered and bloody. The blood from his wound had already dyed his clothes red.
However, Connor was not affected by the wounds at all. He continued to approach Gerald step by step.
Gerald instinctively retreated when he saw Connor walking over. However, after taking two steps back, he was backed against the wall.
Thud!
After hesitating for two seconds, Gerald kneeled on the ground and shouted at Connor, "Mr. McDonald, I know I was wrong. Please let me go…"
"Let you go?"
Connor couldn't help but sneer when he heard Gerald's words. Then, he said lightly, "Why should I let you go?"
"Mr. McDonald, as long as you can spare my life today, I'm willing to give you all of the Dullahan Family's assets. I still have two billion dollars in the Swiss bank. I can give you all of the money…"
Gerald kneeled on the ground and said in fear.
Everyone in the Dullahan Family was stunned when they heard Gerald's words. They were filled with shock.
They did not know that Gerald had so much money. Even the entire Dullahan Family might not be able to fork out such a sum right now.
Connor couldn't help but laugh when he heard Gerald's words. Then, he said lightly, "You should know who I am. Do you think I'd be interested in your money?"
"..."
Gerald was stunned for a moment. He knew that Connor did not lack money now, so he quickly changed his offer and said, "Mr. McDonald, if you like any of the women in our Dullahan Family, I can give them to you. I have three daughters, and each of them is a peerless beauty. I guarantee that you will be satisfied..."
No one expected Gerald to sacrifice his own daughters just to survive.
Connor subconsciously glanced at the three beauties hiding at the side. At this moment, their faces were filled with fear.
Gerald's three daughters were indeed beautiful, but there was still a gap between them and Chieko. Connor wasn't even interested in Chieko, so he naturally wouldn't be interested in these three women.
"Mr. McDonald, as long as you let me go today, I can help you get any woman you want, no matter what kind of woman she is…"
Gerald clamored.
Connor shook his head at Gerald and said expressionlessly, "I'm not very interested in what you're saying. From now on, answer whatever I ask you. Do you understand what I mean?"
"I... I understand, Mr. McDonald. I will answer whatever you ask. I won't dare to hide anything…"
Gerald said nervously to Connor.
"Where is Yelena Allen now?"
Connor asked Gerald softly.
"Yelena Allen?"
Gerald was stunned for a moment and then said in a low voice, "Mr. McDonald, that woman is no longer in the Dullahan Family. Rockefeller's men took her away last night…"
"I asked you where Yelena is!"
Connor repeated in a low voice.
"Mr. McDonald, I'm not sure where Miss Yelena is. I only know that she was taken away by Rockefeller's men…"
Gerald said nervously.
"Do you know the consequences of lying to me?"
Connor said calmly.
"Mr. McDonald, at this point, even if you gave me ten thousand guts, I would never lie to you. Miss Yelena has really been taken away. If you don't believe me, you can ask the other members of the Dullahan Family."
Gerald exclaimed.
Connor glanced at Gerald indifferently. He knew that if Yelena was really in Gerald's hands now, Gerald would definitely use it to exchange for his life. Therefore, Yelena must have been taken away.
"Why did you kidnap Yelena?"
Connor looked at Gerald and asked.
There was a strange look on Gerald's face. Then he said in a low voice, "Mr. McDonald, we are not enemies, and I am not Miss Yelena's enemy either. I have no reason to kidnap Miss Yelena. All of this was done by Yaakov Ward. If I didn't do as he said, the Dullahan Family would have been played to death by Rockefeller."
"Then, do you know why Yaakov Ward kidnapped Yelena?"
Connor looked at Gerald and asked.
Gerald took a deep breath and said in a low voice, "He told me that Miss Yelena is your woman. If Chieko finds out that the Dullahan Family kidnapped Miss Yelena, she will definitely contact you immediately. This way, you will come to Honduria to save Miss Yelena. We will then have a chance to get rid of you in Honduria…"
"As expected."
Connor nodded lightly and did not continue to say anything.
It was exactly as Connor had guessed. Yaakov didn't kidnap Yelena to threaten Connor, but to lure Connor to Honduria.
In Honduria, the influence of Rockefeller was much more extensive, so Connor couldn't make use of his connections. Rachel Wallace, Chelsea Lee, Thomas Morgan, and Jorge Yarrell couldn't really help him.
Yaakov had already done a thorough investigation on Connor. He felt that if Connor did not have the help of these people, Connor would just be an ordinary person.
Unfortunately, Yaakov had underestimated Connor.
The current Connor was no longer the Connor from back then.
After hearing Gerald's words, Chieko was also shocked. She finally realized that she was just a chess piece.
Yaakov already knew all of her plans, but he thought of all sorts of ways to make use of her.
If it wasn't for Connor's terrifying strength, Chieko would have been the cause of Connor's death.
"Mr. McDonald, I've told you everything I know. Can you let me go?"
Gerald asked Connor nervously.
"I don't have any conflict with you, but whether I can let you off or not is not up to me!"
Connor replied expressionlessly. Then, he turned to Chieko and said, "I'll leave these people to you!"
After saying this, Connor left the Dullahan Family's villa.

chapters.title: Chapter 1483: The Enemy
chapters.content:
Chapter 1483: The Enemy
Because he had just experienced a great battle with Jordan Lancaster, Connor was still a little weak. He needed to rest.
Chieko didn't expect Connor to still remember her at this moment. She was extremely touched.
However, a trace of coldness flashed across her eyes.
Chieko walked up to Gerald and looked at him coldly.
After all, she had been waiting for this day for a long time!
"Chieko, what… what are you doing? Don't forget that I'm your biological uncle, your father's biological brother. We're family!"
Gerald could feel the murderous intent in Chieko's eyes, so he yelled at Chieko.
When Chieko heard Gerald's words, she couldn't help but sneer. She then said, "So now you're my biological uncle? Were you my biological uncle when you and Yaakov Ward killed my father? Were you my biological uncle when you were prepared to give me to Yaakov as a plaything? Were you my father's biological brother when you killed my mother?"
Gerald was stunned when he heard Chieko's words. He didn't know that Chieko had already investigated what happened back then.
Even the Dullahan Family did not expect Gerald to collude with Yaakov to kill Chieko's father.
"Chieko, I was really forced to do so. You know what kind of person Yaakov is. If I didn't do what Yaakov wanted, I would have been the one who died. I really had no choice."
Gerald exclaimed.
"You had no choice?"
Chieko sneered and said, "Are you seriously still trying to lie your way out?"
"I'm not lying. All of this was Yaakov's idea. It was Yaakov who wanted to take your mother!"
Gerald said loudly.
"Do you think I'll believe you? You were clearly the one who instigated things between us, and you even drugged Yaakov. That's why Yaakov raped my mother. My father and Yaakov were so close back then, so why would he do such a foolish thing?!"
Chieko's beautiful eyes widened as she shouted angrily.
"..."
Gerald was dumbfounded when he heard Chieko's words. He didn't expect Chieko to know about this.
"Back then, you saw that my father was too close to Yaakov. In addition, my grandfather had always thought highly of my father, so you planned these things to kill my parents and even your father. In order to become the head of the Dullahan Family, you did crazy things like that!"
Chieko shouted.
"What? Father was actually killed by Gerald?"
"Is this true?"
"Why would Gerald do such a thing?"
For a moment, everyone in the Dullahan Family was dumbstruck.
"Do... Do you have any evidence?"
Gerald looked a little nervous as he stammered.
"I don't need any evidence!"
Chieko replied expressionlessly. Then, she took out a pistol and pointed it at Gerald's head.
Gerald was stunned when he saw Chieko take out the gun. He never expected Chieko to have a gun.
Actually, Chieko had been carrying this gun with her all this time. Because the gun was very small, it was very convenient to carry.
However, Chieko didn't carry this gun with her to kill people. Instead, it was to prevent herself from being forced into a corner and becoming someone else's plaything.
However, Chieko never expected that she would actually use this gun. This time, she wasn't trying to commit suicide, but to kill someone.
"Chieko, I think you might have some misunderstanding about what happened back then. It's really not what you think. Can you give me a chance to explain? I can make it up to you. I can do anything you want. Don't kill me. I've been taking care of you all these years, haven't I?"
Gerald knelt on the ground and shouted nervously.
"Didn't you take care of me just to give me to Yaakov to please him? How dare you say that you have been taking care of me? You're really disgusting!"
Chieko shouted in disgust. Without any hesitation, she pulled the trigger.
Bang!
With a loud bang, the bullet instantly penetrated Gerald's head.
Gerald fell to the ground with a thud.
The Dullahan family members were all dumbfounded when they saw this scene. They were very shocked.
Although they knew that Chieko and Gerald had a blood feud, no one expected Chieko to kill Gerald in front of so many Dullahan family members.
Chieko's delicate body was trembling non-stop after she had killed Gerald.
After all, this was her first time killing someone. She didn't know how to control her emotions. There was a joy of revenge on her face, but more than that, there was fear of killing.
"Huff…"
After a long time, Chieko finally recovered from this strange feeling. Then, she looked at the other members of the Dullahan Family expressionlessly.
At this moment, the Dullahan Family looked at Chieko with fear in their eyes. They didn't have a good relationship with Chieko before. Now that Chieko had Connor's support, she might attack them too.
"Chieko, those… those things back then had nothing to do with us. We didn't know about it!"
One of the middle-aged men who had a good relationship with Chieko's father mustered up his courage and shouted.
"..."
Chieko glanced at the middle-aged man and said expressionlessly, "From today onward, I have the final say in the Dullahan Family. Do you have any objections?"
"..."
Everyone looked at each other, but no one dared to speak.
"I asked if you have any objections?"
Chieko repeated coldly.
"We have no objections!"
"Yes, we have no objections!"
"The position of the family head should have belonged to your father back then. So, the position is rightfully yours…"
At this moment, everyone from the Dullahan Family seemed to have become entirely different people as they shook their heads.
Chieko heaved a long sigh of relief when she heard what everyone said. Then, she turned around and walked into the villa.

chapters.title: Chapter 1484: As Predicted
chapters.content:
Chapter 1484: As Predicted
Elsewhere, in a villa in Newtown.
A middle-aged man was sitting on the sofa, watching TV with a serious expression, as if he was thinking about something.
The middle-aged man looked very ordinary. If he was placed in a crowd, he would definitely be able to quickly blend in. To put it simply, this middle-aged man had a common face. Basically, one would forget him at a glance.
However, such an ordinary middle-aged man controlled countless companies in Orilon.
He could change the entire situation of Orilon with just a word.
However, this person was none other than Yaakov Ward, the person in charge of Orilon, whom Connor had been trying his best to find.
Ding dong!
The doorbell rang.
Yaakov glanced at the door indifferently, then turned around and walked into the study. Then, he pressed the switch on the desk.
The door of the villa opened.
Tenner Ward hurriedly walked into the villa and shouted as he was walking, "Mr. Ward, there's news from Honduria. It's not good..."
Although Tenner was Yaakov's spokesperson in name, he had never actually met Yaakov before. The way they met had always been like this. Yaakov was in the study while Tenner stood outside the study. There was a special speaker in the living room so that Tenner could hear Yaakov speak.
Of course, Tenner could only come to this villa a limited number of times.
Yaakov would change his location every once in a while, and even his phone number would change at any time.
Therefore, if Yaakov did not want Tenner to find him, Tenner would not be able to find him.
If it wasn't for the urgency of the situation, Tenner wouldn't have come.
"What's the situation over there now?"
Yaakov asked indifferently.
"Connor McDonald defeated Jordan Lancaster and killed Gerald Dullahan!"
Tenner hurriedly said.
"This Connor guy is quite interesting, but you don't have to worry, all of this is within my expectations!"
Yaakov said calmly.
"It's all within your expectations?"
Tenner was a little surprised.
"That's right. The Dullahan Family and Jordan Lancaster are just testing Connor's strength. I'll leave the rest to the person in charge of Honduria."
Yaakov said softly.
"Mr. Ward, why did you hand Connor over to Honduria? Getting rid of Connor is a great merit. Don't the higher-ups see Connor as a mortal enemy? Why are you giving up on such a good opportunity?"
Tenner asked, seemingly puzzled.
"It is indeed a great merit to eliminate Connor. However, if we fail, we will also bear an extremely great risk. We might even lose our lives. Therefore, this matter itself is a double-edged sword…"
Yaakov paused for a moment and then continued, "I'm old. So what if I get rid of Connor? The chances of climbing up are also very low, so I won't fight with them. I'll just watch the show quietly…"
"So that's what you plan to do, Mr. Ward?"
Tenner could not help but laugh.
Actually, Yaakov's had a simple objective. After eliminating Connor, he would have one less threat. Therefore, he lured Connor to Honduria. Firstly, Connor's influence in Honduria was very small. Secondly, he could get rid of Connor with the help of Honduria. This way, Yaakov could reap the benefits.
"Tenner, I'm old now, and I don't think I can work for many more years. You've been with me for the longest time, and you know the situation in Orilon the best. So, when I retire, I'll recommend you to the headquarters."
Yaakov said slowly.
After hearing Yaakov's words, Tenner became a little excited. He hurriedly nodded and said, "Mr. Ward, I understand what you mean. I will definitely work hard!"
"Okay, if there's nothing else, you can leave now!"
Yaakov said softly.
"Alright!"
Tenner replied before turning to leave.
Tenner had just walked out of the villa when Yaakov walked out of the study and looked out the window expressionlessly.
The glass in Yaakov's villa was made of a special material. People outside couldn't see what was going on inside, and the glass itself was bulletproof.
A moment later, Yaakov took out his phone and dialed the number of the person in charge of Honduria. Then, he briefly explained the situation that Tenner had just mentioned.
"Connor, you're still too naive. Once you enter Honduria, you won't be able to leave alive!"
After putting down his phone, Yaakov sighed softly.
...
Meanwhile, Chieko returned to the villa after dealing with the Dullahan Family.
At this time, the villa was no longer as lively as before because the Dullahan Family did not have the courage to stay here anymore.
Therefore, only Chieko and Connor were left in the villa.
Perhaps it was because the battle just now had consumed too much of Connor's strength, so at this moment, Connor was already lying on the sofa and sleeping.
Seeing that Connor had fallen asleep, Chieko did not disturb him. Instead, she sat quietly beside him and waited for him to wake up.
Chieko knew very well that if it wasn't for Connor, she wouldn't have been able to take revenge so quickly. Therefore, Chieko thanked Connor from the bottom of her heart.
Half an hour later, Connor finally opened his eyes slowly. He turned to look at Chieko and asked expressionlessly, "Has everything been settled?"
"Mr. McDonald, I killed Gerald Dullahan…"
Chieko replied in a low voice.
Hearing Chieko's words, Connor was a little helpless, but he didn't say anything.
After all, this was between Chieko and Gerald. It had nothing to do with Connor.
Seeing that Connor didn't say anything, Chieko continued, "Mr. McDonald, I just bought you new clothes. I've also prepared the bath water for you. You should go take a bath…"
Just now, Connor's body had many wounds from the battle with Jordan. Although these wounds were not fatal, they were still bleeding. Moreover, Connor's clothes were also tattered. The meticulous Chieko had already prepared these things for him.
"Alright…"
Connor nodded gently, then stood up and walked toward the bathroom.
The Dullahan Family's villa was indeed very luxurious. The bathroom area was almost more than 100 square meters, which was even bigger than an ordinary house.
In the middle of the bathroom was a swimming pool filled with steaming hot water.
The swimming pool was also very big, even bigger than the swimming pool in the bathing facility that Connor went to.
What Connor did not expect was that there were a few water beds in the corner of the bathroom. There was stuff that could be used for exercise on the bed in the corner.

chapters.title: Chapter 1485: Chieko's Revenge
chapters.content:
Chapter 1485: Chieko's Revenge
"Looks like Gerald Dullahan knew how to have fun…"
Connor smiled helplessly, then took off his clothes and walked into the pool.
The pool was indeed very comfortable. It was much more comfortable than the bathtub in Connor's house.
Moreover, the swimming pool had its own massage function, allowing you to relax your body and mind.
Just as Connor was enjoying this incomparably luxurious bath, a sound suddenly came from the door.
When Connor heard the commotion, he could not help but be stunned for a moment.
Then, the bathroom door was pulled open from the outside and Chieko walked in barefooted.
At this moment, Chieko was only wearing a white bath towel. Her fair and smooth shoulders, full and alluring breasts, and long and fair legs were exposed for all to see.
Chieko's figure was already very attractive, especially when she was only wearing a bath towel. It made people's hearts race even faster.
Chieko's voluptuous steps caused her breasts to tremble slightly. It was obvious that this woman was not wearing any underwear at all. Once she pulled off the towel, she would be bare naked.
Connor instinctively grabbed a towel and wrapped it around his waist. Then, he asked Chieko with a puzzled expression, "Why are you here?"
"Mr. McDonald, I'm here to help you bathe…"
Chieko looked a little shy as she spoke in a seductive voice.
Although Chieko had a hot body and was dressed sexily, she had always been under Gerald's protection. She had never experienced such a thing before. Naturally, she was a little nervous.
"You're here to help me bathe?"
Connor couldn't help but be stunned when he heard this. Then, he said helplessly, "I don't need help with that. I can do it myself. You should go out!"
"Mr. McDonald, don't you understand what I mean?"
Chieko said as she walked toward Connor flirtatiously.
In fact, Chieko knew very well that the only reason she had the chance to kill Gerald to avenge her parents was because of Connor. Therefore, she was willing to give her body to him.
It wasn't that she was forced to do this, but that she was willing.
That was why Chieko appeared in the bathroom wearing a towel.
At this moment, Chieko's long hair was tied up in a bun. Her full breasts, fair legs, and exquisite face made her look very alluring.
Chieko was very confident in her figure, so she felt that as long as Connor was a normal man, he wouldn't be able to reject her.
Chieko slowly walked toward Connor and then whispered to him, "Mr. McDonald, from now on, I'm yours. I'll listen to you no matter what you want…"
"Don't! Don't do this!"
Connor shouted exasperatedly.
After all, Connor had just ended his relationship with Yelena Allen. Now, Connor could not make any more mistakes, so he naturally could not accept Chieko.
"Mr. McDonald, do you dislike me?"
Chieko asked Connor in confusion.
"It's not that…"
Connor said helplessly.
"Mr. McDonald, I've never slept with another man. This is my first time. My body is very clean..."
Chieko explained to Connor.
"I'm not talking about that now. I admit that you're indeed very beautiful and you are very sexy, but I already have a girlfriend. I don't want to do anything to let my girlfriend down, so you don't have to do this..."
Connor explained to Chieko.
"I see!"
Chieko looked at Connor and noticed his body's reaction. She couldn't help but laugh and said, "Mr. McDonald, your body is still very honest…"
"This is just a normal reaction!"
Connor hurriedly blocked the attack and explained in an awkward manner.
"Mr. McDonald, I can be your lover. Don't worry, won't tell anyone about us…"
Chieko hesitated for a moment before speaking.
"No, thanks…"
Connor waved his hand helplessly.
A hint of disappointment flashed across Chieko's eyes as she said softly, "Mr. McDonald, let me help you bathe…"
"I can do it myself. You should go out first!"
Connor suppressed the urge to push Chieko down and replied in a low voice.
Chieko could sense that Connor was really not interested in her, so she did not say anything more and slowly turned around to walk out of the bathroom.
When Connor saw Chieko walk out of the bathroom, he let out a long sigh of relief. Connor was barely able to control himself just now. After all, a sexy woman like Chieko had come to him willingly. How could anyone reject her?
Connor was also a normal man. He naturally wanted to be with such a cold and beautiful woman.
However, Connor still had a trace of calmness in his heart. In the end, he still controlled his impulse.
Half an hour later, Connor finally came out of the bathroom.
At this time, Chieko was dressed neatly in a white dress. Her curvy and sexy figure was completely exposed, and her beautiful face was enough to make people lose their minds.
At this moment, Connor kind of regretted his decision in the bathroom.
"Mr. McDonald, you're done?"
When Chieko saw him coming out, she quickly got up and went to him. She took out the clothes she had prepared for him and said softly, "Mr. McDonald, let me help you put on your clothes…"
"Alright…"
Connor nodded lightly.
Chieko immediately pulled Connor's towel off.
The moment the towel was pulled down, Connor realized that he was not wearing underwear.
The situation instantly became awkward.
However, Chieko didn't react. She carefully helped Connor put on his clothes, even his underwear.
Getting dressed was a torture for Connor. He was standing naked in front of a sexy woman, and she was only a few centimeters away from him. She would even have physical contact with him from time to time. The faint fragrance of Chieko's body stimulated Connor's nerves, but he couldn't do anything. This feeling was way too torturous.
After getting dressed, Connor sat down on the sofa.

chapters.title: Chapter 1486: The Persons-in-Charge
chapters.content:
Chapter 1486: The Persons-in-Charge
"Mr. McDonald, what do you plan to do next?"
Chieko whispered to Connor.
Connor hesitated for a moment, then said lightly, "Gerald Dullahan said that Yelena Allen is in the hands of Rockefeller's people. Therefore, we must first find the person in charge of Rockefeller, and then find Yelena…"
"Mr. McDonald, just leave it to me. I have some connections in Honduria. Also, Rockefeller has a wide influence in Honduria, so the person-in-charge of Rockefeller doesn't hide his identity like what they do in the inland. It should be easy to find them!"
Chieko replied softly.
"Alright, I'll leave this to you!"
Connor nodded gently, then stood up and said, "I'm a little tired today. I'm going to get some rest now…"
"Alright!"
Chieko nodded gently and took the initiative to bring Connor to the bedroom that she had prepared for him.
After Chieko left, Connor took out his phone and dialed Freya Phillips's number to let her know that he was safe. Then, he communicated with Thomas Morgan.
Although Thomas still suggested that Connor leave Honduria as soon as possible, Connor didn't plan to give up on Yelena. Therefore, Thomas stopped talking about it.
Connor's plan was simple. He wanted to find Yelena and take her away from Honduria before dealing with Yaakov Ward.
Ring, ring, ring…
At this moment, Connor's phone started ringing.
Connor saw that it was a call from Queta Juve, so he picked up the phone.
"Hello?"
"Mr. McDonald, my father just told me that Tenner Ward went to a villa today. That villa is very likely Yaakov's!"
Queta went straight to the point.
"Alright, get someone to monitor that villa 24/7. No matter who comes out of that villa, you have to record it!"
Connor replied excitedly.
"Yes, Mr. McDonald!"
Queta quickly agreed and hung up.
Although it seemed that Connor had never taken the initiative to attack Yaakov, he had actually let Percy Juve get hold of a lot of information about Yaakov. Percy had even sent people to follow Tenner. As expected, Yaakov and Tenner had given themselves away when Connor came to Honduria.
The news that Connor went to the Dullahan Family's place spread across Honduria within a few days.
Although the Dullahan Family was not a big family anymore, it was still rather famous in Honduria. What was more, Connor's identity was special. Many people in Honduria had heard about Connor. Therefore, this news spread at a terrifying speed.
Many people were guessing why Connor was in Honduria.
Even the stock market in Honduria had fluctuated a lot. Some people thought that Connor was going to reshuffle the business circle in Honduria. After all, those who knew Connor's identity knew that he had such power.
Money was indeed omnipotent in the business world.
However, these people might not know that Connor came to Honduria for a woman.
After Rockefeller heard the news, they hurriedly held an internal meeting.
As Rockefeller monopolized the entire business world of Honduria, its situation was also different from that in the inland.
Under normal circumstances, there would be one person in charge in every city and one person in charge in every province.
Although the level of the provincial person-in-charge sounded higher than that of the local person-in-charge, the two sides did not have much contact, and they usually minded their own business.
For example, Percy and Yaakov had never met before, and their business did not have any conflict.
However, Honduria was different.
Rockefeller had five persons-in-charge in Honduria, including four regional persons-in-charge and one main person-in-charge.
The main person-in-charge was the immediate superior and was responsible for managing the people in charge of each region.
In fact, only the four regional persons-in-charge were present in this internal meeting, but the main person-in-charge was not present.
There were four people in the meeting room.
One of them was a middle-aged man in a suit. He was tall and fat and looked simple and honest. He gave off a feeling that he was very friendly. His name was Wesley Yanez, and his nickname was Fat Tiger.
Although Wesley looked very friendly, he was actually very vicious and cruel. Anyone who offended him in Honduria would die.
Sitting next to Wesley was a young man in his twenties. The young man was handsome, but there was a hint of femininity in his eyes. This young man was called Jasper Wilkins.
Although Jasper was young, his mind and shrewdness were definitely not inferior to those middle-aged men. Moreover, Jasper had a wide network of connections. Basically, everyone in Honduria would give face to Jasper whenever his name was mentioned.
Of course, Jasper's biggest weakness was that he liked to gamble.
Sitting opposite Jasper was a beautiful young woman in her thirties. The beautiful young woman was dressed sexily and wore a skin-tight miniskirt that revealed her perfect figure. She had long curly hair. Although she was almost forty years old, her figure was well maintained. Her exquisite face was like a twenty-year-old girl. Her face was charming and seductive, and every frown and smile emitted a seductive aura.
This beautiful young woman was called Jenna Lester, a very famous business genius in Honduria.
Additionally, Jenna was born in a noble family. She was the heir of the Lester Family in Honduria. The Lester Family was a well-known ancient martial arts family in Honduria. It was said that they had cultivated many martial artists.
Beside Jenna was a middle-aged man in his fifties, Franco Perkins.
If one looked at Franco's appearance, many people would think that he was an old man in his sixties, or even more experienced than a sixty-year-old man. However, Franco was only in his early fifties.
Among the four people in charge, this middle-aged man was the most authoritative. The other three people listened to the words of this old man.
"We have underestimated Connor McDonald's strength. Even Jordan Lancaster is not a match for him…"
Franco said.
"Yes, although the Dullahan Family is not a big family, they still have dozens of martial artist bodyguards. However, these people were all defeated by Connor. We can see that Connor McDonald is indeed not simple person!"
Wesley hurriedly said.

chapters.title: Chapter 1487: A Bad Premonition
chapters.content:
Chapter 1487: A Bad Premonition
"I thought that Connor McDonald was just an ordinary person. I didn't think that he would actually be a martial artist…"
Jasper said thoughtfully.
"Then, what should we do next?"
Jenna asked coldly.
"What can we do? Can't we just get someone to get rid of him? Jordan Lancaster is indeed powerful, but he is not the most powerful martial artist in Honduria. So, it should not be difficult for us to get rid of Connor!"
Wesley said loudly.
"I'm worried that this matter isn't that simple…"
Jenna said helplessly.
"Jenna, what do you mean?"
Wesley turned to look at Jenna and asked in a puzzled tone.
Jenna's figure and appearance were top-notch. She had long legs, big breasts, and a big butt. Every frown and smile of hers was very attractive. Therefore, any man would be tempted by a woman like Jenna, even Wesley.
Wesley had always wanted to get Jenna into his bed, but Jenna was a member of Rockefeller, and she was terrifyingly strong. If he really used the same method to deal with Jenna as he did with ordinary women, he might even lose his life in the end. Therefore, Wesley could only look at her, but he could not do anything to her.
"If Connor were really that easy to deal with, why would he dare to come to Honduria so openly?"
Jasper said in a low voice.
"That's right, that's what I mean!"
Jenna added.
"According to the information I have, Connor only brought a woman with him to Honduria this time. Moreover, he hasn't been with anyone since he arrived in Honduria!"
Franco said.
Jenna looked helpless when she heard this, but she didn't say anything.
"I think you two are worrying too much. The person we kidnapped this time is Connor's old lover. He is young and rash. He must have rushed over here on impulse. Now, he probably regrets coming…"
Wesley said with a smile.
"No matter what, it is best to be careful. It is indeed a good thing if we can get rid of Connor. However, if we cannot get rid of him, it will also be a big problem for us…"
Jenna said lightly.
"Yeah, I have already contacted Mr. Landry. He asked us to be careful. So, I was thinking all four of us can find a martial artist each and have them join hands to get rid of Connor. As for us, we will wait and see. You must not act on your own. This is the safest way. If there are any problems, contact us at any time…"
Franco looked at everyone and said.
"Alright, I understand…"
Wesley said casually.
"..."
Jenna was still worried because she felt that Connor must have some trump cards that he didn't reveal in Honduria.
She did not believe that anyone would be so stupid as to come here alone to die.
"Jasper, are you able to send someone to watch Connor's movements?"
Franco said to Jasper.
"Leave this to me. I will have my people keep an eye on Connor. If there is any movement, I will tell all of you immediately!"
Jasper nodded.
"Alright…"
Franco nodded slightly, then looked at Jenna and said softly, "Jenna, your family knows a lot of martial artists, and you have the most connections in this area, so try to find more martial artists. This way, we can get rid of Connor as soon as possible!"
"Alright…"
Jenna nodded lightly.
Wesley couldn't help but take a few more glances at Jenna, his face filled with greed. If he wasn't afraid of Jenna's family's power, Wesley would probably have already made a move on her. Any man wouldn't be able to stand seeing such a sexy beauty in front of him every day.
Franco, Jenna, and the others left after the meeting.
At this time, they only had one thought, that was, to find as many ancient martial artists as possible, and then have these people work together to get rid of Connor.
Although Connor had defeated Jordan Lancaster, this did not mean that Connor was strong enough to really make these four people feel fear.
What these people were really worried about was that Connor might have other trump cards that he hadn't shown, so they chose this safest way to deal with Connor.
However, there was one person who was still very worried about this plan.
And this person was Jenna.
Jenna felt that something was off. Connor knew that he would die if he entered Honduria, but he still chose to come.
Even though Yelena Allen was the bait, Jenna felt that a man like Connor had plenty of women by his side, so why would he take such a big risk just for a lover?
On the surface, it looked like they had set up a trap for Connor, but it was also very likely that Connor was deliberately playing along.
Jenna had a bad feeling about this.
...
In the blink of an eye, three days had passed.
Connor also rested in the Dullahan Family's villa for three days. Of course, Connor did not sit idly by these three days. Instead, he had been working hard to learn the Chi Circulation Scroll.
At this moment, Connor already knew how powerful the Chi Circulation Scroll was, so he wanted to rely on the Chi Circulation Scroll to increase his strength as soon as possible.
Bang bang!
Just as Connor was concentrating on his cultivation, a knock sounded on the door.
"Who is it?"
Connor frowned and asked.
"Mr. McDonald, it's me!"
Chieko's voice rang out.
"Come in…"
Connor replied indifferently.
Chieko opened the door and entered the room. Then, she said softly, "Mr. McDonald, I've already investigated what you asked me to. Here is the information of the four regional persons-in-charge of Rockefeller in Honduria…"
"Already?"
Connor said in surprise.
"The four people didn't hide their identities on purpose. So, it's easy for me to investigate about them. However, I haven't found any information on the main person-in-charge in Honduria yet!"
Chieko replied.
"There's no need to go through so much trouble. As long as we find these four people, I'll have a way to get the identity of the main person-in-charge from them!"
Connor replied indifferently, then casually glanced at the information about the four people.

chapters.title: Chapter 1488: Being Followed
chapters.content:
Chapter 1488: Being Followed
"Mr. McDonald, what do you plan to do next?"
Chieko whispered to Connor.
"Although Gerald Dullahan said that it was Rockefeller's men who took Yelena, he doesn't know who took her. Now, we can only use the simplest and stupidest method, which is to look for them one by one!"
Connor said expressionlessly.
"Search for them one by one?"
Chieko was stunned when she heard this.
Connor picked up a document and said to Chieko, "Help me find out where this person is now. We'll start with him!"
Chieko hesitated for a moment before saying softly, "Mr. McDonald, these four people are all in charge of Rockefeller. They have martial artists protecting them. Are you sure you want to attack them one by one?"
"Do you have a better way?"
Connor turned to Chieko and asked softly.
"I haven't thought of a better way yet, but I think it's too risky for us to do this, Mr. McDonald."
Chieko whispered.
"I've been in Honduria for 3 days, but Rockefeller's people still haven't made any move. Do you know why?"
Connor asked Chieko.
"I'm not sure…"
Chieko shook her head.
"Because they haven't gathered enough people yet. So, this is our best opportunity. If we miss this opportunity and wait for them to gather all their people, we will be in a bad situation!"
Connor said to Chieko.
"I see!"
Chieko was enlightened.
"So, you don't have to worry about anything now. Just do as I say…"
Connor said to Chieko with a smile.
"Alright, I'll help you investigate this person's location!"
Chieko nodded and left with the documents.
Connor looked at Chieko's back and took a deep breath. In fact, Connor knew very well that this method was very risky, but he had no other choice. He could only take the initiative to attack.
The first information Connor gave Chieko was Jasper Wilkins's.
After Chieko received the information, she began to investigate Jasper's exact location.
In less than half an hour, Chieko confirmed that Jasper was currently staying at the resort on Mount Lushmore.
Connor also decided to bring Chieko to Mount Lushmore the next morning to meet Jasper.
The next day, at seven in the morning.
Connor brought Chieko to Mount Lushmore.
Mount Lushmore was very famous in Honduria. Because of its good environment and many temples, many tourists would come here to climb the mountain.
Mount Lushmore's holiday villa was one of Jasper's properties, so Jasper often stayed there. Sometimes, he would even bring some women back. That was why Chieko was able to find out Jasper's current location so quickly.
Connor had not been to Honduria before; neither had he been to Mount Lushmore. Therefore, Connor took this opportunity to have a good trip in Mount Lushmore.
After Connor got off the car, he realized that it was just as Chieko had said. There were indeed many tourists on Mount Lushmore.
Connor and Chieko arrived at 7:30, but there were already many people on Mount Lushmore.
When Chieko, the stunning beauty, appeared, many male tourists turned their attention to her. Some even wanted to take photos with her.
Chieko was a very cold woman, so she was not used to being hit on by these people. In the end, she chose to wear sunglasses and a hat. This way, she and Connor could have some peace.
Connor knew that Mount Lushmore Villa was at the top of Mount Lushmore, so he could only choose to climb up the mountain with Chieko.
But halfway through, Connor suddenly stopped.
"Mr. McDonald, what's wrong?"
Chieko asked Connor softly when she saw him stop.
"Someone is following us…"
Connor replied in a low voice.
"Following us?"
Chieko looked confused.
Connor grabbed Chieko's hand and ran up the mountain.
Sure enough, a young man saw Connor speed up and also hastened to speed up.
Connor knew that this young man was definitely the one who was following him, so he hid in the forest with Chieko.
The young man who had been following closely behind Connor became flustered when he realized that Connor had disappeared. He began to look around as if he wanted to find Connor's position.
Smack!
At this moment, Connor suddenly rushed out of the forest and grabbed the young man by the neck.
The young man was instantly dumbfounded. He looked at Connor with a terrified expression.
"You were following me just now, right?"
Connor asked the young man in a low voice.
The young man looked at Connor's face with some fear, then hurriedly shook his head and said, "I'm just a tourist. I'm not following you…"
When Connor heard the young man's words, he could not help but sneer. Then, he slowly increased the hold of his grip.
The young man knew very well what kind of person Connor was. He was also very worried that Connor would really kill him, so he quickly said, "Big brother, don't kill me. I'm just an errand boy…"
" If I ask you something, you will answer me. Can you do that?"
Connor replied in a low voice.
"Yes, I can…"
The young man nodded without hesitation.
"Who told you to follow me?"
Connor asked the young man in a low voice.
"..."
When the young man heard that, there was strange look on his face.
"I advise you to answer my question honestly. I'm not in the mood to waste time with you now, you understand?"
Connor said in a low voice.
"Mr. Wilkins asked me to follow you…"
The young man gritted his teeth.
"Mr. Wilkins?"
Connor couldn't help but be stunned when he heard this name.
"It must be Jasper Wilkins!"
Chieko reminded.
"So, it's him!"
Connor smiled faintly and continued, "Is Jasper Wilkins on the mountain now?"
"Yes..."
The young man knew that he had already betrayed Jasper, so he did not continue to hide anything.
"Alright, you can get lost now!"
Connor released his grip on the young man's neck and said expressionlessly.
When the young man heard Connor's words, he felt relieved and quickly turned around to run down the mountain.

chapters.title: Chapter 1489: Chance Encounter with Eugenia Bander
chapters.content:
Chapter 1489: Chance Encounter with Eugenia Bander
After the young man left, Chieko looked worried.
She could not help but whisper to Connor, "Mr. McDonald, Jasper Wilkins probably already knows that we're here. Should we change our plan?"
"There's no need to do that. Since he already knows that the two of us are here and has been following us, it means that Jasper Wilkins should be prepared. Let's go up and take a look!"
Connor said lightly.
Chieko did not expect Connor to be so confident. She took a deep breath and could only follow Connor's footsteps.
"I didn't think there would be so many tourists here!"
Connor looked at the tourists at the top of the mountain and sighed softly.
"Of course. I heard that the temples on Mount Lushmore actually bring about good fortune, so many people come to pray to the Gods and deity…"
Chieko hurriedly replied.
"I see!"
Connor nodded and continued walking forward.
"Is there something wrong with you? I've already told you just now that I don't want to go to any bar with you. Hurry up and get out of my way!"
However, Connor and Chieko had only walked for less than ten minutes when they heard a shout coming from ahead.
When Connor heard this sentence, he seemed a little puzzled, because he felt that this voice sounded a little familiar.
"Mr. McDonald, I think it's the two girls we met on the bus!"
Chieko reminded Connor.
"Oh, it's the two of them!"
Connor smiled faintly and said softly, "I didn't think we'd meet here…"
"I guess it's fate!"
Chieko had never had a good impression of Eugenia Bander, so she pursed her lips and replied.
"What are you guys doing? Hurry up and let go of me, do you hear me? If you continue to do this, I'll call the police…"
"Hehe, is there any use in calling the police here? By the time the police arrive, it will be too late!"
Just as Connor and Chieko were talking, the argument seemed to have gotten even more intense.
"Alright, since we've already encountered them, let's go over and take a look. These two people seem to have encountered some trouble!"
Connor sighed softly and then walked forward.
Chieko naturally didn't want to be a busybody, but Connor was already walking over. After hesitating for a moment, Chieko could only follow him.
Connor led Chieko over, only to find a large group of people surrounding the scene.
Connor finally managed to pass through the crowd with great difficulty, and then saw Jeanette Sacks and Eugenia.
Although Eugenia was wearing sunglasses today, her slender legs, hot figure, and cold temperament were enough to make Connor confirm that this girl was Eugenia.
At this moment, Jeanette and Eugenia were surrounded by four to five young man. One of the young men was tugging at Eugenia's arm, while Jeanette was already scared silly, and she was tugging at Eugenia's clothes tightly.
Eugenia kept trying to break free, but she was not as strong as the young man, so she could not break free.
Although there were many people standing at the side and watching the commotion, no one went up to stop these people. They just watched helplessly as the young man was about to take Eugenia away.
"Let go of me now, do you hear me?"
Eugenia shouted.
"Darling, don't be upset anymore. I was wrong, okay…"
The young man replied with a smile.
Connor also understood what was going on after hearing the young man's words.
It was obvious that the young man was deliberately pretending to be Eugenia's boyfriend. This way, the surrounding tourists would think that these two people were having a quarrel between lovers, and no one would step forward and meddle in other people's business.
If Eugenia had not run into an acquaintance, then this situation would actually be very dangerous.
Although Connor didn't want to interfere in other people's business, he wouldn't just watch these young men take Eugenia away. So, after hesitating for a moment, he walked out and shouted expressionlessly, "Who are you? Let go of my friend!"
When Eugenia and Jeanette heard Connor's words, they raised their heads to look at him. Their faces were filled with shock.
Because the two of them did not expect to meet Connor here.
The young man also turned around and looked at Connor. He asked with a frustrated expression, "Kid, who are you? What does my quarrel with my girlfriend have to do with you? Get lost!"
"Quarrel with your girlfriend?"
When Connor heard this, he could not help but laugh coldly. Then, he asked Eugenia, "Is he your boyfriend?"
"Don't listen to this person's nonsense. I don't even know this person. He's just a hooligan…"
Eugenia quickly retorted.
"Darling, don't be angry with me. I know I was wrong..."
The young man hurriedly said.
"Don't be shameless. I don't even know you. Hurry up and let go of me."
Eugenia shouted in an unusually speechless manner.
Connor looked at the young man from head to toe and said indifferently, "Since you said you're her boyfriend, let me ask you, what's her name?"
"I…"
The young man looked a little awkward. Then, he gritted his teeth and said to Connor, "Kid, I advise you to mind your own business, or you will regret it!"
"Let go of my friend and get lost!"
Connor frowned and scolded.
"Who the hell do you think you are? How dare you speak to us like that…"
Another young man cursed and was about to attack Connor.
Connor lifted his leg and kicked the young man in the stomach. The young man flew out and fell to the ground in pain.
"I'm telling you to scram. You don't understand, do you?" Connor said expressionlessly.
The few young men who were originally surrounding Eugenia were dumbfounded when they saw Connor's kick. They could feel that Connor seemed to be rather strong.
The few of them looked at each other and did not hesitate at all. They lifted the young man who was kicked away by Connor and quickly ran away.
As the young men left, the people who had been standing there watching the show also dispersed.
Eugenia walked toward Connor and said softly, "Thank you. If you hadn't saved me, I might have really been taken by those hooligans…"
"You ladies need to be more careful. If you dress so sexily, you'll definitely be targeted!"
Connor glanced at Eugenia's ample breasts and said.

chapters.title: Chapter 1490: Mount Lushmore Villa
chapters.content:
Chapter 1490: Mount Lushmore Villa
"I'm hot. There's nothing I can do about that."
Eugenia thought that Connor was praising her, so she replied proudly.
Connor looked at the expression on Eugenia's face and felt a little helpless. He didn't know what to say.
"Connor, looks like our fate is intertwined. We actually meet again…"
Jeanette ran toward Connor and said to him with an excited expression.
"I guess so. Every time I meet the two of you, nothing good seems to happen…"
Connor replied with a smile.
Although Honduria wasn't very big, Connor still felt that it was rather fated that they were able to meet each other again.
"Yeah. I don't know what's going on. Recently, we keep meeting people who would harass Eugenia…"
Jeanette nodded.
"What are you doing here?"
Connor asked them softly.
"What else? The two of us came here to sketch and then go to the holiday villa on the mountain to rest for the night before leaving tomorrow. However, for some reason, the holiday villa is closed. It seemed that it was waiting to welcome a very important person, so the two of us were going to go down the mountain to find a place to stay. That was when, we met those people just now!"
Jeanette looked at Connor and explained.
"I see!"
Connor lightly nodded.
"By the way, are the two of you going to the villa too? If you're going to the villa, I advise you not to waste your energy. Come down the mountain with us. I heard that there's a restaurant nearby that serves pretty good food. I'll buy the two of you a meal as a thank you for saving me today!"
Eugenia said to Connor.
"Maybe next time. The people in the villa are waiting for me. If I don't go over today, they will probably be very disappointed!"
Connor laughed and replied.
"Stop bragging. Are you saying that this villa is not open to the public because of you?"
Eugenia pursed her lips and said with a speechless expression.
"That's right. They are closed because Mr. McDonald is their guest. You'd better leave as soon as possible!"
Chieko replied expressionlessly.
"See you ladies!"
Connor waved his hand at Eugenia and Jeanette, then continued to walk up the mountain.
"Eugenia, is what Connor said true? Is the villa really closed to welcome him?"
Jeanette blinked and asked Eugenia with a puzzled expression.
"Connor is a braggart. If it wasn't a particularly powerful big shot, how would they have closed the villa? Even the head of my family doesn't have such power. Don't listen to Connor's nonsense!"
Eugenia pouted and replied, then muttered to herself, "I wanted to buy him a meal, but since he doesn't appreciate it, then forget it. More money for me!"
Jeanette looked at the backs of Connor and Chieko, and she was a little hesitant. Then, she whispered to Eugenia, "Eugenia, why do I feel that Connor didn't seem to be joking just now? Were the people of the Mount Lushmore Villa really preparing to welcome Connor?"
"Who do you think that Connor is? The boss of Mount Lushmore Villa has a very terrifying background. He won't make such a big fuss over a foreigner…"
Eugenia said absent-mindedly.
"But the woman beside Connor is not ordinary either. She even knows people like Gaius Low!"
Jeanette said in a low voice.
Eugenia looked a little helpless. Then, she said lightly, "Gaius Low is not a big figure in Honduria at all. It's not a big deal for that woman to know him. Additionally, even if Mount Lushmore Villa is preparing to welcome Connor, it has nothing to do with us. Connor didn't invite us to go there with them."
"That's true. If Connor were really able to enter Mount Lushmore Villa, then he would have invited us to go together!"
Jeanette felt that Eugenia's words were somewhat reasonable, so she nodded lightly and continued, "Then Eugenia, where are we going now?"
"Where else can we go? Let's hurry up and go down the mountain and find a place to stay…"
Eugenia seemed to be angry at Connor for rejecting her, as she pouted and said.
When Jeanette saw Eugenia like this, she could not help but smile lightly. She sighed to herself. This was the first time she had seen Eugenia get angry because of a guy.
...
On the other side, Connor and Chieko continued to walk toward the Mount Lushmore Villa.
At this moment, Chieko was still very nervous because she did not know if Connor would be able to survive this time. After all, people like Jasper Wilkins were not so easy to deal with.
Jasper was a regional person-in-charge of Rockefeller, so his connections were terrifying. Since the other party already knew that Connor was coming, but did not choose to leave, this meant that Jasper was very likely to have already made plans to deal with Connor.
As the two of them got closer and closer to Mount Lushmore Villa, Chieko realized that there were fewer and fewer tourists around.
When the two of them were about to reach the top of the mountain, there was already no one around. They could only hear the faint chirping of birds.
The atmosphere was a little strange, and Chieko couldn't help but feel a chill in her heart. She deliberately slowed down and followed closely behind Connor.
Chieko knew very well that her life was in Connor's hands. If Connor encountered any danger today, she would definitely die.
However, Chieko had no intention of retreating because she knew that following Connor was her only way out.
If not for Connor's help, then she would not have been able to get revenge at all.
A moment later, Connor and Chieko finally arrived at the Mount Lushmore Villa.
In the past, the Mount Lushmore Villa was very lively. Many tourists could be seen coming in and out of the villa. Although the Mount Lushmore Villa was very expensive, the business of the Mount Lushmore Villa had always been very good in Honduria, a place where rich people gathered.
However, the Mount Lushmore Villa was no longer as lively as before. On the contrary, it gave people a very cold feeling.
It was so cold that it made people shudder.
Moreover, because they were at the top of the mountain, the Mount Lushmore Villa gave people the feeling that it was shrouded in a thick fog, which made the Mount Lushmore Villa even more mysterious.
"Jasper Wilkins is here, right?"
Connor turned to Chieko and asked softly.

chapters.title: Chapter 1491: Entering Alone
chapters.content:
Chapter 1491: Entering Alone
"According to the information I obtained, Jasper Wilkins should be in this villa!"
Chieko hurriedly nodded.
"Alright, then let's go in and take a look!"
Connor then continued to walk toward Mount Lushmore Villa.
After a moment of hesitation, Chieko quickly caught up with Connor.
A few seconds later, Connor finally arrived at the entrance of the Mount Lushmore Villa.
At this moment, there were two uniformed bodyguards standing at the door. The bodyguards glanced at Connor indifferently and then said disdainfully, "The Mount Lushmore Villa is receiving a very important guest today, so we're not open for business. You should head down the mountain!"
It was obvious that the bodyguards were treating Connor and Chieko as tourists.
When Connor heard the bodyguard's words, he smiled faintly and said softly, "The important guest you are preparing to welcome should be me!"
"You?"
The bodyguard suddenly turned and sized up Connor. He realized that Connor's appearance, height, and age were indeed similar to what the higher-ups had told him.
"Who are you?"
The bodyguard asked Connor cautiously.
"Connor McDonald!"
Connor replied calmly.
When the bodyguard heard this name, his expression changed drastically. He hurriedly said to Connor, "Wait here for a moment. I'll go and inform them!"
Connor smiled faintly and did not speak.
The bodyguard hurriedly picked up the walkie-talkie beside him and whispered into it.
Because the bodyguard spoke very softly, Connor did not hear what the bodyguard said.
A few seconds later, an old man hurriedly walked out of the villa and shouted at the bodyguards, "Mr. McDonald has come from afar. How can we let him wait outside the door? Hurry up and open the door!"
The two bodyguards did not seem to expect that Connor would really be the guest that the villa was prepared to welcome today, so they quickly ran to the door and opened it.
After the door opened, Connor led Chieko into the villa.
The old man from before walked up to Connor with a smile and said respectfully, "Hello, Mr. McDonald. I am Wilfred Chahine, the general manager of the Mount Lushmore Villa. I welcome you on behalf of the entire Mount Lushmore Villa!"
Wilfred was about 60 years old. However, he looked very energetic. He spoke slowly and calmly. It was obvious that he was used to welcoming big shots in Honduria. Therefore, he had developed such a habit.
"I'm not here for you today. I want to meet the boss of Mount Lushmore Villa!"
Connor whispered to Wilfred.
Wilfred smiled faintly when he heard Connor's words, then said softly, "I know that Mr. McDonald is here for Mr. Wilkins today. Mr. Wilkins has been waiting in the villa for a long time."
After saying this, Wilfred made a gesture of invitation to Connor.
Connor slowly raised his head and looked at the situation in front of Mount Lushmore Villa. He saw that there were already many bodyguards gathered at the entrance of the villa. At this time, these bodyguards were also fully armed, and they were rather nervous. They were ready to deal with the upcoming battle.
When Chieko saw these bodyguards, she became even more nervous because she knew very well that these people were probably used to deal with Connor.
"Jasper Wilkins actually knew that I was coming today. Why didn't he come out to welcome me personally?"
Connor turned and asked Wilfred softly.
Wilfred was obviously stunned when he heard Connor's words. Then, he smiled and said, "Mr. Wilkins never takes the initiative to welcome guests!"
"Haha…"
Connor looked at Wilfred and smiled without saying anything. Instead, he walked toward Mount Lushmore Villa.
When Wilfred saw Connor walk straight into Mount Lushmore Villa, he was a little smug, but he didn't show it on his face. Instead, he covered it up.
Connor and Chieko followed Wilfred around the Mount Lushmore Villa. They had to admit that the environment of the Mount Lushmore Villa was indeed very good. The facilities inside were also complete. Whatever the rich liked, they could find it here.
At this moment, Wilfred believed that Connor was trapped. As long as Connor entered the Mount Lushmore Villa, he would not be able to escape death. Therefore, Wilfred was obviously much more relaxed at this time. From time to time, he would take the initiative to introduce Mount Lushmore Villa to Connor.
Connor also knew that Wilfred was only talking to him about these things to distract Connor.
However, Wilfred did not know that Connor was not an ordinary martial artist. Now that Connor's use of the Chi Observation Technique was as pure as fire, Connor could clearly feel the presence of many martial artists in the Mount Lushmore Villa. These people were hiding in a hidden corner, and their purpose was to catch Connor unprepared.
"Looks like Jasper is already prepared to make sure that I won't be able to return this time!"
Connor couldn't help but sigh to himself, and then revealed a mysterious smile.
Perhaps Jasper still hadn't figured out who was the real hunter and who was the quarry!
A few minutes later, Wilfred brought Connor to a very luxurious villa.
It was obvious that this villa was very different from the other buildings in the Mount Lushmore Villa. It was more luxurious and dignified.
"Mr. McDonald, Mr. Wilkins is waiting for you in this villa!"
Wilfred turned to look at Connor and said with a smile.
"Alright, I got it!"
Connor nodded gently and walked into the villa.
