When Wilfred saw that Connor was really planning to walk in, he was a little surprised. Any normal person could probably see that there were ambushes everywhere in the Mount Lushmore Villa, and these ambushes were probably prepared for Connor.
However, Connor did not notice it at all. This was somewhat unbelievable.
Wilfred didn't know if Connor was really stupid or fearless.
However, just as Connor was about to enter the villa, Chieko, who had been following Connor, was stopped by Wilfred.
"What is it?"
Chieko frowned and asked Wilfred.
"Miss, my apologies. Mr. Wilkins only wants to see Mr. McDonald, so you can't go in!"
Wilfred said to Chieko with a smile.
When Chieko heard this, she looked nervous and quickly looked at Connor.
Connor smiled lightly and said, "It's okay. Just wait for me here!"

chapters.title: Chapter 1492: Jasper Wilkins
chapters.content:
Chapter 1492: Jasper Wilkins
After saying that, Connor walked into the villa.
When Chieko saw Connor leave, she instantly felt empty, and she was especially nervous.
When Chieko saw Wilfred's wretched gaze, the fear in her heart intensified.
It was obvious that Chieko had also noticed that something was wrong with the villa. Chieko felt that since she could sense it, Connor must be able to sense it too.
However, Chieko couldn't understand why Connor would still choose to enter the villa.
Meanwhile, Wilfred was staring at Chieko.
Chieko's figure and looks were the best of the best. Wilfred was already thinking that if Connor died in the villa, he could take Chieko as his own and make her follow his bidding.
Wilfred's expression changed as he thought of this. He stepped forward and whispered to Chieko, "Miss Dullahan, I've already prepared a place for you to rest. Come with me!"
"No thanks, I'll just wait here for Mr. McDonald to come out!"
Chieko could sense that Wilfred was up to no good, so she rejected him without hesitation.
"Alright, since Miss Dullahan wants to wait here, I'll be leaving now!"
Wilfred saw that Chieko didn't want to leave, so he didn't say anything else. He turned around and left.
Chieko stood alone in front of the villa's door. She looked extremely nervous.
On the other side, after Connor entered the villa, he realized that the person who came out to welcome him was a beautiful maid in a dress.
The maid's looks and figure were top-notch. Moreover, she gave off a very charming feeling, as if her entire body was emitting waves of irresistible charm.
However, Connor could feel the unwillingness in the maid's eyes. She did not seem to be willing to serve Jasper here.
"Mr. McDonald, Master is in the inner room. Follow me!"
The maid said gently to Connor.
"Master?"
Connor couldn't help but smile when he heard the way she addressed him, but he didn't say anything. Instead, he followed the maid into the villa.
The interior of the villa was decorated in an ancient style, giving off an ancient feeling. Connor also saw that there were very few electrical appliances in the villa. Even the most common lights were candles.
When you walked into this villa, it was as if you had traveled back in time.
Basically, what you could see in a modern house couldn't be seen here.
A moment later, the maid stopped in front of the door and whispered to Connor, "Mr. McDonald, Master is in the room. Please go in!"
"Thank you so much!"
Connor looked at the maid and smiled faintly. Then, he reached out and pushed open the door.
After entering the room, Connor found a young man sitting on the ground fiddling with the tea set in front of him.
The young man looked about the same age as Connor, but he knew how to handle the tea set. He must be a person who liked drinking tea very much.
Connor had read Jasper's information before, so he could recognize the handsome young man sitting on the ground at a glance. He was Jasper, one of the regional persons-in-charge Honduria.
"Mr. McDonald, please take a seat!"
Jasper slowly raised his head and glanced at Connor as he spoke softly.
"It's really not easy to meet you!"
Connor couldn't help but sigh. Then, he sat directly opposite Jasper.
"I thought that you wouldn't be so patient to come and see me. I didn't expect you to really come and see me!"
Jasper smiled faintly, and then took the initiative to pass a cup of tea to Connor.
Connor glanced at the teacup indifferently, but he did not pick it up because he was not sure if Jasper had drugged the tea.
"I'm not in the mood to talk nonsense with you now. Let's get down to business. Where is Yelena Allen now?"
Connor asked Jasper in a low voice.
"Yelena Allen is not in my hands now, and I don't know where she is!"
Jasper replied indifferently.
"I don't want to fight you today, so I advise you not to play any tricks on me. Otherwise, I'll make you regret it!"
Connor had never had a good impression of the people from Rockefeller, so his tone was naturally very impolite.
Jasper looked at Connor and smiled. He said softly, "Mr. McDonald, I don't think you understand the current situation."
"The current situation?"
Connor smiled faintly when he heard Jasper's words. He then slowly said, "Of course I know the current situation. You have martial artists all around this villa waiting to deal with me, right?"
"You're right. These people are indeed prepared to deal with you!"
Jasper sneered and then said expressionlessly, "From the moment you entered the villa, you have already walked into a trap. I wanted to make the first move to attack you, but I never thought that you would be so bold as to come here on your own volition."
"Do you think those people you invited can kill me?"
Connor narrowed his eyes and asked Jasper softly.
"Aren't those people enough to deal with you?"
Jasper asked directly.
"I don't know if you've thought about this problem, but since I already knew that you've arranged for martial artists to deal with me, why would I still dare to enter this villa so openly? You don't really think I'm a fool, do you?"
Connor said coldly.
"Hahaha…"
Jasper looked at Connor and laughed loudly. Then, he said lightly, "I don't know if you're a fool or not, but I know that you won't be able to return today because I've already made full preparations. Therefore, your best choice now is to surrender."
"I came here today just to give you a chance. If you tell me honestly where Yelena Allen is, I might let you go. But since you are choosing the hard way, I can only use the simplest way to solve the problem!"
Connor gently stretched his back and said to Jasper with a playful expression.
A trace of anger flashed across Jasper's eyes as he whispered, "Connor McDonald, you're way too condescending. You don't understand the situation you're in at all."

chapters.title: Chapter 1493: The Difference?
chapters.content:
Chapter 1493: The Difference?
Just as Jasper finished speaking, an old man walked out of the room.
"Mr. McDonald, this is Hadley Lockhart, a famous ancient martial arts master in Honduria. Don't think that I've only prepared those martial artists outside. I've even specially invited Mr. Lockhart to meet you. Mr. Lockhart is Mr. Lancaster's senior brother."
Jasper exclaimed proudly.
Connor slowly raised his head and looked at Hadley. He had to admit that Hadley was indeed quite capable. He was probably an intermediate black-rank. There was still a huge gap between him and Connor.
"You were the one who crippled my junior brother?"
Hadley asked Connor softly.
"That's right!"
Connor looked at Hadley and nodded slightly.
Connor was still very calm. Although Hadley was a black-rank and Connor was only an advanced yellow-rank martial artist, Connor had already fought a black-rank before, so now he only needed to take the Chi Receiving Pill to deal with a black-rank.
"To have such ability at such a young age, it seems that your talent is indeed pretty good. However, since you dare to cripple my junior brother, let's settle this score today!"
Hadley shouted at Connor expressionlessly.
Hadley was a black rank, which was rare in Honduria. Therefore, he was very famous.
Jasper was so confident because he believed in Hadley's ability.
"Cut the crap. Just attack!"
Connor said to Hadley expressionlessly.
"Brat, although your talent is pretty good, as the saying goes, a tree that stands out in the forest will be destroyed by the wind. Today, I'll let you know the difference between the two of us!"
Hadley shouted.
"The difference?"
When Connor heard Hadley's words, he could not help but sneer. Then, he slowly stood up, took out a Chi Receiving Pill from his clothes, and threw it into his mouth.
Hadley had a strange expression on his face when he saw that Connor had eaten the Chi Receiving Pill.
However, he did not think too much about it. He rushed toward Connor and reached out to grab Connor's shoulder.
Although Hadley's move was not very fast, its lethality was very shocking.
If Hadley grabbed his shoulder, Connor's entire arm would probably be ripped off.
Jasper was somewhat smug when he saw Hadley's attack. He slowly picked up the teacup and had a sip of the tea.
Connor turned around and easily dodged Hadley's attack.
Hadley's palm did not hit Connor. Instead, it hit the chair that Connor had been sitting on.
In an instant, the chair was smashed into smithereens.
From this, one could see how powerful Hadley's palm was.
When Hadley saw that Connor had dodged his attack, he was shocked, and his lips trembled slightly.
He had never thought that Connor would actually be able to dodge this move of his.
"What did you eat just now?"
Hadley frowned and asked Connor.
"What does what I eat have anything to do with you?"
Connor replied in a low voice.
"Looks like you still have something up your sleeve. No wonder Jordan was defeated by you!"
Hadley was obviously much more vigilant now.
Just now, he only treated Connor as an ordinary martial artist. However, he could feel that Connor was definitely not an ordinary martial artist during this exchange with Connor. Otherwise, Connor would not have been able to dodge his move so easily.
"Take my punch!"
At this moment, Connor suddenly sped up and rushed toward Hadley.
A strange look flashed across Hadley's face. However, he did not choose to dodge Connor's punch. Instead, he placed his hands in front of his chest, preparing to take Connor's punch head-on.
"Shattered Earth!"
Connor growled.
Bang!
There was a loud bang.
Connor's fist smashed into Hadley's arm.
Hadley did not expect Connor's punch to be so powerful. He took a few steps back to stabilize his body after taking Connor's punch.
When Jasper saw this scene, he was a little shocked. He hurriedly put down the teacup in his hand and asked Hadley in a low voice, "Mr. Lockhart, are you alright?"
"I'm fine. I underestimated my enemy just now!"
Hadley replied in a low voice. Then, he looked at Connor carefully and said in a low voice, "I didn't expect you to be able to unleash such a stunning punch at such a young age. It's indeed a little surprising, but you can't defeat me with just this kind of fist!"
"Are you that confident that you won't lose to me today?"
Connor asked Hadley softly.
"Although your fist technique is powerful, no matter what, you are still a yellow-rank, and I am a black-rank. The difference between the two of us is not something that a fist technique can make up for…"
Hadley said expressionlessly.
"Hehe, I really don't know where your confidence comes from!"
Connor looked at Hadley with disdain.
As Hadley was a black rank, he had a high status in the ancient martial arts world of Honduria. No junior dared to talk to him in such a manner.
At this moment, Hadley could clearly feel the disdain in Connor's words, which further provoked Hadley.
"Kid, I'll let you see my strength today. Let's see if you still dare to be so arrogant later!"
Hadley roared at Connor and then rushed toward Connor.
Connor didn't have any intention of retreating and went forward.
Connor and Hadley started fighting.
Jasper looked at the two people in front of him, and his expression changed slightly.
Because at this moment, Jasper finally understood why Connor dared to come to the Mount Lushmore Villa alone. If it was not because Jasper invited Hadley, those ordinary martial artists outside might not be able to stop Connor.
"Luckily Mr. Lockhart is here today. Otherwise, I might have really been in danger today…"
Jasper sighed softly.
At this moment, Jasper had already realized that Connor was not as simple as he had imagined.

chapters.title: Chapter 1494: You're Not My Match at All!
chapters.content:
Chapter 1494: You're Not My Match at All!
Meanwhile, outside the villa.
Wilfred Chahine, Chieko, and the bodyguards all heard the sounds of fighting in the villa.
"Looks like Mr. Lockhart has already made his move. Mr. McDonald might be in danger this time…"
Wilfred laughed.
"Mr. Lockhart?"
Chieko couldn't help but be stunned when she heard Wilfred's words. Then, she asked in a puzzled tone, "Who is the Mr. Lockhart you're talking about?"
"Miss Dullahan, don't you know? Mr. Lancaster whom Mr. McDonald defeated a while ago has a senior brother called Hadley Lockhart. He is also in this villa. Mr. McDonald should be fighting with him right now!"
Wilfred said lightly.
"Hadley?"
Chieko was dumbfounded when she heard Wilfred's words. She was extremely shocked.
Jordan Lancaster was already a very powerful martial artist in Honduria, and Hadley was even more terrifying. He was a black-rank martial artist!
Therefore, nobody dared to offend Hadley. Hadley's status in Honduria was very high.
Chieko never expected Jasper to invite Hadley over.
Wilfred was even more pleased with himself when Chieko remained silent.
"Mr. Wilkins wanted to lure Connor to the Mount Lushmore Villa and have us kill him together. However, for some reason, he changed his plan and brought Connor into the villa. He wanted Mr. Lockhart to be the one to deal with Connor. Actually, I feel that there's no need for Mr. Lockhart to personally deal with someone like Connor. The few of us are enough…"
At this moment, a bodyguard walked up to Wilfred and said in a dissatisfied tone.
This bodyguard was the captain of Mount Lushmore Villa's bodyguards, and he was also a yellow-rank martial artist, so his status in the villa was very high. Otherwise, he wouldn't have dared to say this to Wilfred.
"Mr. Chuke, isn't Mr. Wilkins doing this just to be on the safe side?"
Wilfred replied indifferently and then continued, "Moreover, Connor crippled Mr. Lockhart's junior brother some time ago. Mr. Wilkins is doing him a favor by giving this opportunity to Mr. Lockhart!"
"That's true!"
Mr. Chuke nodded expressionlessly and continued, "I just feel that it's an overkill. Mr. Lockhart doesn't need personally do something like this. However, Mr. Wilkins definitely has his own plans…"
"Don't worry, as long as Connor dies in Mount Lushmore Villa today, Mr. Wilkins will reward you handsomely even if you didn't do anything!"
Wilfred comforted him.
Chieko's expression was extremely ugly.
It was because she finally understood that Jasper had not only prepared an ambush outside this time, but there was also an expert like Hadley waiting for Connor inside.
This meant that if Connor entered the villa today, he would die.
Moreover, Chieko knew Hadley well. She felt that there was no way to defeat an expert like Hadley.
For a moment, Chieko was so nervous that she didn't know what to do. She could only stare at the villa, hoping that a miracle would happen.
"Miss Dullahan, I don't think you need to be so nervous because Connor's ending has already been determined from the beginning. Connor is rather stupid. He clearly knew that there was an ambush, but he still dared to come alone."
Wilfred said to Chieko with a smile.
"We don't know yet who will win!"
Chieko bit her lip and said stubbornly.
"Hahaha…"
Everyone burst into laughter when they heard Chieko's words. They looked at Chieko as if she was an idiot.
"Beauty, you're hilarious. It's Mr. Lockhart we're talking about here How could Mr. Lockhart possibly lose to Connor who is a nobody?"
"That's right. How many powerful opponents has Mr. Lockhart encountered over the years? He has never lost before…"
"Unless this kid really is a black-rank, he has no chance of winning!"
Everyone responded one after another.
Chieko became even more nervous when she heard these people's words. She bit her lip and prayed for Connor.
"Miss Dullahan, if you are willing to become my maid, I can ask Mr. Wilkins for mercy. Perhaps you can escape this calamity!"
Wilfred stopped pretending and looked at Chieko with a smile.
"Be your maid?"
Chieko couldn't help but be stunned when she heard this. Then, she became a little disgusted. She frowned and shouted, "Even if I die today, I won't let you have your way!"
"Hahaha…"
Wilfred laughed when he heard Chieko's words. He then said coldly, "Miss Dullahan, I'm afraid that it will not be easy for you to die even if you want to…"
Just as Wilfred was fantasizing about how he was going to ravage Chieko in the future, a loud bang came from the villa's main door.
When everyone heard the sound, they looked up.
Bang!
A figure smashed open the villa's door and flew out.
The figure flew by very quickly. In the blink of an eye, he was out of the door and had smashed heavily onto the ground in front of everyone.
Everyone lowered their heads to look at the figure.
However, when they saw the figure clearly, they were all dumbfounded. They were very shocked.
"How... How is that possible?"
Wilfred stared at Hadley on the ground with his eyes wide open in utter shock.
At this moment, no one expected it to be Hadley.
Then, Connor walked out of the villa. He glanced at Hadley and said expressionlessly, "You're not my match at all!"
"Mr. McDonald!"
Chieko cried out excitedly when she saw Connor.
After all, Chieko was obviously in despair because she thought that Connor would surely die if he entered. However, no one expected Connor to beat Hadley out of the villa. This was rather unbelievable.
At this moment, everyone looked at Connor, and their expressions began to change.
This was because they knew very well how terrifying Hadley was. If even Hadley was not Connor's match, then they would definitely not be Connor's match.

chapters.title: Chapter 1495: True Power
chapters.content:
Chapter 1495: True Power
At this moment, Jasper ran out of the villa and shouted, "Mr. Lockhart, are you alright?"
Hadley struggled to get up from the ground and said with red eyes, "Mr. Wilkins, I have embarrassed myself…"
"Mr. Lockhart, it's good that you're fine!"
Jasper saw that Hadley was still able to stand up and did not seem to be in any serious condition. Hence, his expression softened a little.
The people from the Mount Lushmore Villa also heaved a long sigh of relief.
After all, if Hadley really lost to Connor just like that, they might be in a very dangerous situation.
"Mr. McDonald, are you alright?"
Chieko asked Connor excitedly.
"I'm fine!"
Connor responded.
Hadley stared at Connor and shouted, "Connor, I thought you were just a normal martial artist, but I didn't expect you to use a secret technique to raise your strength to black-rank."
"You're not my match, so get lost!"
Connor said to Hadley in disdain.
"I'm not your match?"
Hadley could not help but laugh when he heard Connor's words. He then shouted, "I think you're really naive. Don't think that you can defeat me just because you sent me flying with one punch."
Connor narrowed his eyes and looked at Hadley without saying anything.
"Looks like Mr. Lockhart is going to get serious this time around…"
Wilfred looked at Hadley and said.
In the next second, Hadley took a step forward and took a deep breath.
Connor could clearly feel that the aura in Hadley's body was circulating crazily. Moreover, Hadley's body seemed to be constantly changing.
Bang!
There was a loud bang.
Hadley's muscles suddenly expanded and tore his clothes.
Hadley was originally only about 1.75 meters tall. However, he had now turned into a giant that was almost two meters tall. His muscles seemed to have undergone a very obvious change. His firm muscles were covered with blue veins, giving people a very strange feeling.
At this moment, Hadley, who was standing in front of Connor, seemed to have changed into a different person.
When Chieko saw this scene, her beautiful eyes were filled with shock. After all, she had never seen such a situation before.
"Mr. McDonald, what's going on?"
Chieko asked Connor with a trembling voice.
"I don't know what's going on either. Hadley must have used some secret technique!"
Connor had not encountered that many martial artists, so it was also the first time that he was seeing such a thing.
"This is Mr. Lockhart's true power. Connor, you're dead meat today!"
Jasper shouted at Connor expressionlessly.
"Connor, don't think that just because you have the strength of a black-rank, you're a real black-rank. Today I'll show you the difference between a black-rank and you!"
Hadley shouted at Connor and then rushed toward Connor.
It was obvious that Hadley's strength and speed had both improved tremendously.
This kind of improvement might even be more terrifying than the boost given by the Chi Receiving Pill.
Previously, Hadley did not take Connor seriously. Therefore, Hadley did not use his full strength to deal with Connor.
However, Connor sent Hadley flying with a punch just now. This had infuriated Hadley, so he used his trump card.
Hadley was only using a very common body-refining technique. This kind of body-refining technique needed to be practiced from a very young age. Once it was mastered, it would be of great help to the improvement of a martial artist's combat strength.
"Connor, I was careless just now, so I was hit by your punch. However, this doesn't mean that you can defeat me."
Hadley shouted with his eyes wide open.
Jasper was also very excited at this moment. He knew that Connor had completely angered Hadley. This would only make Connor die faster.
Chieko looked at Hadley who was like a monster. Her beautiful eyes were filled with fear as she whispered to Connor, "Mr. McDonald, if you think you can't beat this person, then run. Don't worry about me!"
"Run?"
Connor couldn't help but sneer when he heard this. He then said indifferently, "Since I'm already here, why should I run?"
"But…"
Chieko opened her mouth to speak.
In the next second, Connor rushed toward Hadley.
Hadley's eyes also flashed with a trace of surprise because he did not expect Connor to actually choose to take the initiative to attack.
"Seven-Star Big Dipper Fist, Tiger's Roar!"
"Die!" Connor bellowed. Then, he raised his fist and smashed it toward Hadley's head.
Hadley knew that Connor's combat ability could not be underestimated. Therefore, he did not dare to be careless. He hurriedly raised his fist and punched Connor's fist.
Bang!
There was a loud bang.
Connor's fist collided with Hadley's fist.
At this moment, the surrounding people felt as if there was an earthquake, and the ground trembled slightly.
Two extremely powerful forces instantly swept through the entire courtyard.
"Such power!"
Jasper stood still and sighed softly.
Hadley took a step back to stabilize his body. Connor also took a step back.
Hadley stared at Connor in disbelief. It was obvious that the two of them were on par with each other from that punch!
However, Hadley had already used his secret technique. He did not expect Connor to be able to fight him on equal terms. How unbelievable!
Furthermore, Hadley realized that Connor's fist technique was very powerful. He could not help but ask Connor in a low voice, "What kind of fist technique is this? Why is it so powerful?"
"Is that important?"
Connor replied indifferently.
"Brat, as long as you can give me this fist technique, I can spare your life!"
It was obvious that Hadley was very interested in Connor's Seven-Star Big Dipper Fist. That was why he made such a condition.

chapters.title: Chapter 1496: What a Powerful Fist Technique!
chapters.content:
Chapter 1496: What a Powerful Fist Technique!
"Spare me?"
Connor couldn't help but laugh coldly, and then said lightly, "You should think about how to survive!"
"I admit that your fist technique is indeed powerful, but you can't unleash the full power of this fist technique, so you will definitely die today!"
Hadley shouted at Connor coldly.
"Haha…"
Connor could not help but sneer. Then, he rushed toward Hadley again. The two of them instantly started fighting.
Wilfred's expression changed slightly when he saw that Connor and Hadley were evenly matched. He quickly walked to Jasper's side and whispered to him, "Mr. Wilkins, do you want to leave first? Things don't look good here!"
"Don't worry, Mr. Lockhart won't lose!"
Jasper was very confident in Hadley and replied.
"But I still have a bad feeling about this…"
Wilfred whispered.
"Haha…"
Jasper couldn't help but laugh. Then, he said lightly, "Who do you think is more powerful, Connor or Mr. Lockhart?"
"Based on the current situation, it's really hard to tell. I feel that these two people seem to be quite powerful…"
Wilfred said in a low voice.
On the other hand, Jasper revealed a smug expression and said indifferently, "Since you can see that these two are evenly matched, it means that it will be very difficult for these two people to determine the winner in a short period of time. Moreover, once the winner is determined, the winner will have definitely consumed a large portion of his energy. It would ideal if Mr. Lockhart can defeat Connor today. If he loses to Connor, then Connor will definitely have to pay a very high price just to win. Moreover, the reason why Connor is so powerful now is only because he has taken a medicinal pill. Once the effect of the medicinal pill disappears, Connor will be an ordinary martial artist…"
"Mr. Wilkins, are you planning to wait for Mr. Lockhart to exhaust most of Connor's fighting strength before we take action to eliminate Connor?"
Wilfred instantly understood what Jasper meant.
"This is only the worst-case scenario. If Mr. Lockhart can get rid of Connor, that would naturally be the best. But even if he can't get rid of him, Connor will die today!"
Jasper said lightly.
"Mr. Wilkins, you're really smart!"
Wilfred could not help but sigh.
"So, you don't have to worry. The outcome of this battle won't affect our plan at all!"
Jasper looked at Wilfred and smiled.
Although Jasper said all that, he actually hoped that Hadley could defeat Connor. After all, if Hadley defeated Connor, things would be much simpler.
However, the battle between Connor and Hadley had obviously reached its climax.
"Connor, the energy in your body is disappearing, right?"
Hadley said in a low voice.
"Your stamina has almost been exhausted, right?"
Connor replied indifferently.
"Hahaha…"
Hadley could not help but laugh when he heard that. Then, he said expressionlessly, "Connor, it's impossible for you to win against me today!"
"Is that so?"
Connor sneered. He stomped his foot and dashed toward Hadley.
"That depends on whether you can take this punch of mine!"
Connor roared. Everyone could clearly feel that the speed of Connor's punch was clearly many times faster than before, and the power was also very shocking.
At this moment, Connor's punch was like a bolt of lightning as it rushed toward Hadley.
"Seven-Star Big Dipper Fist, Dragon's Roar!"
Connor roared angrily. Then, he rushed toward Hadley. He raised his fist and punched Hadley in the chest.
Perhaps it was because Connor's speed was too fast just now that everyone present did not react in time, Hadley himself did not react in time either.
Moreover, after such an intense battle just now, even if Hadley was able to react, it would be difficult for him to react in time.
Boom!
There was a loud bang.
Connor's fist was like a precise missile as it landed on Hadley's chest.
Hadley's face instantly twisted in pain because the power of Connor's punch was way too terrifying.
"Pfft!"
Although Hadley was still standing, he spat out a mouthful of blood.
When everyone saw this scene, they were all stunned. They stood rooted to the ground in a daze, their eyes filled with disbelief.
No one had expected that Hadley would spit out blood from Connor's punch!
"How is that possible?"
Jasper stared at Conno with his eyes wide open. He was shocked.
Although he was already prepared that Hadley might lose to Connor, he did not expect Hadley to lose in such a way.
The bodyguards of the Mount Lushmore Villa had ugly expressions on their faces.
They all knew that Hadley was a very famous black-rank martial artist in Honduria. In their eyes, Hadley was invincible. They didn't even dare to provoke Hadley. However, they didn't expect that Hadley would be beaten up by Connor with one punch!
"Mr. McDonald is way too amazing. I can't believe it!"
Chieko looked at Connor as if she was looking at a God.
If they didn't see it with their own eyes, nobody would believe that the famous Hadley Lockhart in Honduria could cough up blood because of Connor!
At this moment, the scales of victory had clearly tilted to Connor's side.
"What a powerful fist technique!"
However, at this moment, a voice pulled everyone back from their shock.
Everyone turned to look at Hadley.
Although Hadley had vomited blood just now, he had not completely lost his fighting ability. He was still standing there, looking at Connor angrily.
"Should we continue fighting?"
Connor asked Hadley softly.
"Of course, we have to continue!"
Hadley replied through gritted teeth.
When the people from the Mount Lushmore Villa heard Hadley's words, all of them revealed excited expressions.
These people had seen with their own eyes how terrifying the power of Connor's punch was. In their eyes, if it was an ordinary person, there was no way they could withstand such a powerful attack.
However, Hadley had not given up just yet. This meant that Connor's punch did not cause any fatal damage to Hadley.

chapters.title: Chapter 1497: Bounty of 10 Million!
chapters.content:
Chapter 1497: Bounty of 10 Million!
"As expected of Mr. Lockhart. He clearly vomited blood just now, but he's still acting like nothing happened!"
"That's right, only Mr. Lockhart is able to take on that punch just now. If it were anyone else, they would have died in Connor's hands long ago!"
"Mr. Lockhart is really powerful…"
Everyone could not help but cheer loudly.
Jasper also sneered, then said to Connor expressionlessly, "Connor, you're way too naive. Mr. Lockhart is a well-known powerhouse in Honduria."
Chieko was smiling, but it did not last long. She did not expect Hadley to be so tenacious.
"He's just an arrow at the end of its flight. What's the point of continuing?"
Connor sneered.
"Connor, if I'm not wrong, the strength in your body is about to disappear. How many more punches can you throw with such strength? Once the power in your body is emptied, then you will die!"
Hadley shouted at Connor in a low voice.
"Then, let's see if my strength will be emptied first, or if you will fall first!"
Connor replied expressionlessly and then rushed toward Hadley again.
Bang!
Another loud noise was heard. Connor's fist landed on Hadley's chest again.
Hadley spurted out a mouthful of blood. He took two steps back to steady himself and shouted at Connor, "Looks like I was right. The strength in your body is constantly weakening. Your punch just now was clearly much weaker than the previous one!"
"How long can you last?"
Connor asked in return, then punched again.
Bang!
Although the strength of this punch seemed to be weaker, Hadley's situation was not looking good either. His expression was unusually ugly.
Hadley's plan was very simple. He was prepared to use his body to take on all the attacks from Connor who had consumed the Chi Receiving Pill. Once the effect of the Chi Receiving Pill wore off, it would be very easy for him to deal with Connor.
Connor naturally knew what Hadley was thinking. However, the duration of the Chi Receiving Pill was about to end. Connor had no other choice but to defeat Hadley before the effect of the Chi Receiving Pill wore off.
Bang! Bang!
Connor punched four to five times consecutively. Almost every punch used all of his strength. Moreover, every punch landed on Hadley's body.
However, Hadley gritted his teeth and persevered.
"Connor, the strength in your body is about to disappear, right?"
Hadley shouted.
"Don't worry, it's enough to beat you!"
Connor gritted his teeth and replied. Then, he raised his fist and punched Hadley's chest again.
Connor knew that if he could not defeat Hadley with this punch, he would be in a very dangerous situation. This was because Connor had exhausted all his strength. Moreover, he had only brought one pill with him today. Once the effect of the pill wore off, Connor would be dead.
"Seven-Star Big Dipper Fist, Myriad Heavens!"
Connor used all of his strength to throw out the most ferocious fist technique of the Seven-Star Big Dipper Fist.
Boom!
A loud bang sounded between heaven and earth.
Connor's fist landed on Hadley's chest.
Hadley, who was originally full of confidence, had a drastic change in his expression after taking Connor's punch.
He could feel an extremely powerful force engulfing his body. This force was so terrifying that it was indescribable.
In the next second, Hadley's body was sent flying.
Hadley flew back for nearly ten meters in the air before he crashed into the wall.
Even the wall was cracked by Hadley.
For a moment, everyone fell silent.
Hadley gritted his teeth and wanted to stand up. However, he realized that he could not control his body at all.
After struggling for a while, Hadley closed his eyes and passed out.
Connor heaved a long sigh of relief when he saw Hadley fall unconscious. He was unusually tired.
Because Connor had exhausted all the energy in his body just now. He only had one thought in his mind, which was to find a place to rest.
"How troublesome!"
Connor sighed in a low voice and then took two steps back. His body swayed, and he lost his balance.
When Chieko saw that Connor was about to fall, so she quickly ran to Connor's side and held him up. She asked Connor nervously, "Mr. McDonald, are you alright?"
"I'm fine!"
Connor replied softly.
The people from the Mount Lushmore Villa looked at Connor as if he was a monster. After all, none of them had expected such an ending.
Connor had actually defeated Hadley!
'Hadley, a famous legendary martial artist in Honduria, lost to a twenty-year-old young man. It's really unbelievable.'
Jasper's eyes were also filled with shock. He did not seem to have expected such an outcome.
However, Jasper's eyes quickly flashed with a trace of pride because he could feel that Connor had already consumed a large amount of energy. At this moment, Connor was very weak. In addition, the effect of the Chi Receiving Pill should have disappeared, so Jasper felt that this was the best opportunity to get rid of Connor.
"Hahahaha, the battle just now was really exciting!"
Jasper shouted at Connor.
Connor slowly turned to look at Jasper. There was a strange look on his face. He knew very well that he might not be able to continue fighting in his current state.
Just now, Connor had focused all his energy on Hadley, but he had neglected Jasper.
"Connor, I admit that Rockefeller has underestimated you. You are quite capable. The reason why you are able to live until today is definitely not because you are lucky…"
Jasper sighed.
Connor looked at Jasper and did not speak.
"But what good is that? You're still going to die in Mount Lushmore Villa today."
Jasper sneered and shouted, "Connor is now a cripple. Kill him for me. Whoever can kill him will be rewarded with 10 million!"
Following Jasper's order, more than 50 people rushed out of nowhere and rushed toward Connor.
Moreover, these people were all martial artists. They were Jasper's ambush in the Mount Lushmore Villa to deal with Connor.

chapters.title: Chapter 1498: People from the Purple Cloud Sect?
chapters.content:
Chapter 1498: People from the Purple Cloud Sect?
In the blink of an eye, Connor and Chieko were surrounded by these martial artists.
At this moment, Connor was truly in a desperate situation.
Chieko's face was filled with despair. She instinctively turned to look at Connor and asked in a low voice, "Mr. McDonald, what should we do now?"
Connor took a deep breath and didn't say anything.
The current Connor was as weak as Jasper had said. He might not even be able to deal with an ordinary person, let alone deal with so many martial artists alone.
Jasper was a regional person-in-charge in Rockefeller, so the martial artists he had nurtured over the years were not something that the Dullahan family's martial artists could compare to.
If these people attacked at the same time, even a black-rank martial artist might not be able to take it, let alone Connor.
If Connor still had the Chi Receiving Pill with him, he might be able to kill his way out. However, Connor only had one pill with him. Moreover, he had already eaten it when he was fighting with Hadley.
Chieko did not expect such an outcome. She thought that everything would be over after Connor defeated Hadley. However, no one expected the situation to turn out like this.
Jasper was very smug as he said lightly, "Connor, you're dead this time!"
"Attack!"
The leading martial artist shouted.
In an instant, more than 50 martial artists rushed forward.
Connor seemed to be in despair, standing on the spot, not knowing what to do.
However, at this moment, a commotion suddenly came from the main gate of the Mount Lushmore Villa.
Everyone turned around when they heard the noise.
A dozen people rushed straight to Connor.
"What are these people doing?"
Jasper was shocked when he saw these people.
"I've never seen these people before!"
Wilfred Chahine replied helplessly.
"Could it be Connor's reinforcements?"
Jasper said in a low voice.
"That can't be. This is Honduria. How could Connor have reinforcements?"
Wilfred hurriedly said,
At this moment, Connor also looked at the people who had rushed into the villa with a trace of doubt in his eyes. It was obvious that Connor did not know what these people were doing.
However, these people were all wearing the same clothes, and the leader was a sexy woman with a ponytail.
"Protect Sect Leader McDonald!"
The sexy woman shouted.
For a moment, these people who rushed into the villa surrounded Connor.
Jasper and the others seemed to be a little dumbfounded at this time. They all stopped attacking Connor and stood on the spot, not knowing what to do.
"Sect Leader?"
Connor heard the sexy woman's words clearly, so he couldn't help but think of Jorge Yarrell.
After all, only the people of the Purple Cloud Sect would address Connor like this!
"Who are you? How dare you trespass into the Mount Lushmore Villa?"
Wilfred hesitated for a moment before he shouted at the sexy woman who was leading the group.
When the sexy woman heard Wilfred's words, she looked a little disdainful. She said lightly, "We are from the Purple Cloud Sect. Our Sect Leader is trapped here, so we have come to save him!"
"You are from the Purple Cloud Sect?"
Jasper seemed to be a little angry. Then, he shouted loudly, "How bold of you. The martial artists between Honduria and the mainland have already made a rule. You are not allowed to interfere with the affairs between Honduria's martial artists. Does the Purple Cloud Sect intend to break the rules?"
In the past, there were always conflicts between the martial artists from the mainland and Honduria. Some of the martial artists from the mainland would often come to Honduria to commit crimes.
Therefore, they set the rule that no mainland martial artists could interfere with the affairs of Honduria's martial artists. Additionally, the disciples of the four top sects were not allowed to have conflicts with Honduria's martial artists.
This was also the reason why Rockefeller's people could disregard the fact that Connor was Jorge's disciple and the future leader of the Purple Cloud Sect and attack Connor.
However, it was obvious that the disciples of the Purple Cloud Sect were going to attack Honduria's martial artists. If they really attacked Honduria's martial artists, it might lead to more terrifying consequences.
The sexy woman seemed to have expected Jasper to say this, so she couldn't help but laugh. Then, she said lightly, "The Purple Cloud Sect's sect leader said that no rules are more important than the young sect leader's life. Some people set rules, some people follow rules, but there are some who break rules!"
"Why you…"
Jasper never expected this woman to be so domineering. He shouted, "Then do you know the consequences of doing this?"
"The consequences have nothing to do with me. I'm just following the rules!"
The sexy woman replied lightly.
".."
Jasper looked at the woman in front of him and pondered for a couple of seconds. Then, he gritted his teeth and said, "Since the Purple Cloud Sect broke the rules first, I will not hold back either. Attack!"
In an instant, Jasper's men charged forward again.
The sexy woman brought the disciples of the Purple Cloud Sect to welcome the attacks.
Although Jasper had more people, it was obvious that the Purple Cloud Sect's disciples were more terrifying.
Therefore, the battle between the two sides was completely one-sided.
Jasper's bodyguards were almost unable to resist in front of the Purple Cloud Sect disciples. Their screams were endless.
Connor stood expressionlessly on the spot. He did not seem to have expected the Purple Cloud Sect to actually save him.
Chieko was even more excited because she had already given up all hope. However, she did not expect things to turn around in the end.
Jasper stood on the spot with an unusually ugly expression on his face. He thought that Connor would die for sure today, but he never thought that the Purple Cloud Sect would actually appear. Therefore, the current situation did not seem good.
Wilfred hesitated for a moment before whispering to Jasper, "Mr. Wilkins, our people might not be a match for Connor and the others!"
"They're all a bunch of trash. Tell these people to hold on. I'll call Jenna now…"
Jasper replied in a low voice. Then, he turned around and was about to walk into the villa.
Although Jasper said that he was going to find reinforcements, he had already thought of a way out for himself. After all, it was too late for him to call for reinforcements now.
Connor had been staring at Jasper. When he saw that Jasper was about to escape, he couldn't help but sneer. Then, he rushed toward Jasper.

chapters.title: Chapter 1499: Where is Yelena Allen?
chapters.content:
Chapter 1499: Where is Yelena Allen?
Although Connor had no way to deal with those martial artists now, it was still very easy to deal with Jasper.
Connor rushed toward Jasper and grabbed his collar.
Jasper suddenly turned around and raised his fist to smash toward Connor's face.
Whoosh!
However, before Jasper's fist could hit Connor's face, Chieko took out her pistol and aimed it at Jasper's head.
"Mr. Wilkins, I advise you not to move!"
Chieko said to Jasper expressionlessly.
Jasper stood in place and hesitated for a couple of seconds. He was a little fearful.
He never thought that things would turn out like this. Originally, Jasper planned to take advantage of this opportunity to get rid of Connor, but now he realized that he was not a hunter at all, but a prey in Connor's eyes.
On the other side, the sexy woman and the disciples of the Purple Cloud Sect had already repelled most of the bodyguards.
After all, these bodyguards were paid to do their jobs. Since Jasper wanted to run away, these bodyguards naturally did not have the mood to stay and fight.
In less than two minutes, most of Jasper's bodyguards had run away. The rest could not stand up, so they could only lie on the ground and pretend to be dead. Even Wilfred had run away.
When Jasper saw this scene, he seemed to become even more desperate.
Connor looked at Jasper indifferently and said softly, "Do you have anything else to say now?"
"..."
Jasper looked at Connor and hesitated for a couple of seconds. Then, without any hesitation, he knelt on the ground with a bang and said loudly, "Mr. McDonald, please let me go!"
"Let you go?"
When Connor heard Jasper's words, he could not help but sneer. Then, he said indifferently, "If you had such an attitude when you first saw me, I might have really let you off. However, it might be too late now…"
"Mr. McDonald, I am a person-in-charge of Rockefeller. I have accumulated a lot of wealth over the years. I can give these things to you. As long as you let me go, I will be a dog by your side. I will do whatever you want me to do as long as you let me go…"
Jasper was obviously scared out of his wits as he shouted.
When Chieko saw Jasper kneeling in front of Connor and begging, she had a strange feeling in her heart.
After all, from the moment Chieko came into contact with Connor, she had always wondered if Connor could help her take revenge. However, Connor had proven time and time again that he was not as simple as a rich second-generation heir.
"I don't lack money…"
Connor looked at Jasper and shook his head.
"Sect Leader, Jasper Wilkins is very rich!"
However, at this moment, the sexy woman from the Purple Cloud Sect stepped forward and reminded Connor in a low voice.
"The Purple Cloud Sect seems to like money a lot!"
Connor looked at the sexy woman speechlessly.
This was the first time Connor was looking at this sexy woman so closely.
Connor did not expect the Purple Cloud Sect to have such a beautiful female disciple.
The sexy woman was wearing a tight jacket. Her chest was extremely alluring. She was wearing tight leather pants. Her slender legs were abnormally straight under the outline of the leather pants, and her buttocks were also outlined in a very charming arc. She had an exquisite oval face with beautiful facial features, and her light blue long hair added a bit of charm.
Who would have thought that such a sexy beauty would not show any mercy when facing Jasper's bodyguards? She was extremely fierce when she beat people up.
"We have no choice. The Purple Cloud Sect has a lot of disciples. These disciples need to use a lot of medicinal herbs to cultivate, so the expenses are relatively high!"
The sexy woman hurriedly explained to Connor.
At this moment, this woman wasn't looking for an excuse. It was just that the Purple Cloud Sect's expenses were terrifyingly high. Jorge's money was used on the cultivation of the Purple Cloud Sect's disciples.
After all, the cost of a single pill was several millions. Therefore, the money that Jorge extorted from Connor was nothing at all.
"So, this is what the old man spends money on!"
Connor sighed softly.
"Although the sect leader doesn't really watch over us, he often gives us money!"
The sexy woman hurriedly said.
"I understand. I was wondering why he liked money so much!"
Connor said helplessly.
"However, Sect Leader McDonald, you don't have to worry. Because Sect Leader Yarrell told us that after you inherit the position of Sect Leader, the Purple Cloud Sect might not be short of money…"
The sexy woman said lightly.
When Connor heard the sexy woman's words, he was instantly speechless. He didn't expect that old man Jorge to have such schemes behind his back.
However, these people from the Purple Cloud Sect had saved Connor's life today, so he did not say anything.
"Mr. McDonald, I have a lot of companies under my name, and I also have a lot of assets. As long as you can let me go, I can give you all that…"
Jasper shouted.
"Tell her about the money later. I don't lack money now!"
Connor pointed at the sexy woman beside him.
"Alright, alright…"
Jasper saw that there was still room for discussion and quickly nodded.
"Let me ask you, where is Yelena Allen now?"
Connor asked Jasper expressionlessly.
"I…"
Jasper's expression was hesitant.
After all, Jasper's assets belonged to him, so even if he handed them over to Connor, his life would not be in danger. However, if he told Connor Yelena Allen's location, it would be equivalent to betraying Rockefeller. Once he betrayed Rockefeller, his would have a miserable outcome.
"Do you know who I am?"
Connor suddenly asked Jasper.
Jasper could not help but be stunned when he heard Connor's words. Then, he stuttered, "Of course, I know who you are!"
"If you know, then you should know that I'm probably the only person who dares to go against Rockefeller. So now there are only two paths in front of you. The first is to say nothing and wait for me to kill you. The second is to do whatever I tell you to do. As long as you tell me everything, I'll get someone to bring you to the Purple Cloud Sect. This way, I can guarantee your safety. No matter how powerful Rockefeller's men are, they can't chase after the Purple Cloud Sect and kill you. Do you understand what I mean?"

chapters.title: Chapter 1500: Head of the Bander Family
chapters.content:
Chapter 1500: Head of the Bander Family
Connor knew that Jasper was worried that if he betrayed Rockefeller, he would most likely die.
But at this moment, Connor gave Jasper a second option. That was to tell Connor everything, and Connor would get someone to bring Jasper to the Purple Cloud Sect.
If that was the case, Jasper would still have a chance to live.
"..."
After hesitating for a few seconds, Jasper gritted his teeth and said, "Mr. McDonald, can you really protect me?"
"What do you think?"
Connor asked indifferently.
Jasper took a deep breath and said in a low voice, "Mr. McDonald, Yelena Allen is not in my hands. She is in the hands of the Bander Family!"
"Yelena Allen is in the hands of the Bander Family?"
When Connor heard this, he was a little puzzled, as if he did not quite understand what Jasper meant.
"Mr. McDonald, I'm just a small person in charge of a district. The current head of Bander Family is the main person-in-charge of Rockefeller in Honduria. Therefore, Yelena Allen is in the hands of the Bander Family."
Jasper replied carefully.
"So, the head of the Bander Family is the main person-in-charge of Rockefeller in Honduria. Interesting!"
Connor sighed softly and then continued, "I'll give you one day to prepare the files of the other three persons-in-charge of Rockefeller in Honduria and the files about the Bander Family. After that, give all your properties to the Purple Cloud Sect. Then, I'll have the people of the sect take you away from Honduria."
"Understood…"
Jasper hurriedly nodded.
Connor turned to look at the sexy woman beside him and said softly, "I'll leave this person to you…"
"Alright, Sect Leader!"
The sexy woman hurriedly nodded.
"Thank you for coming to save me today!"
Connor said softly.
"Sect Leader McDonald, you don't have to thank me. I'm just doing things according to Sect Leader Yarrell's wishes!"
The sexy woman smiled.
"By the way, what's your name?"
Only then did Connor realize that he did not know this woman's name.
"Waverly Green!"
The sexy woman replied.
"Alright, I'll remember your name!"
Connor gently nodded and said to Chieko, "Let's go back!"
After saying this, Connor turned around and walked down the mountain.
Chieko hesitated for a moment before quickly catching up to Connor.
Connor's trip to Mount Lushmore Villa was not in vain. At least he now knew the exact location of Yelena. The next step was to wait for Jasper's information and then deal with the main person-in-charge of Rockefeller in Honduria.
Chieko had been following closely behind Connor. At this moment, Chieko seemed to have yet recover from her shock.
After all, what she and Connor had experienced today was too terrifying. If it weren't for the Purple Cloud Sect's timely arrival, Connor and Chieko might have already died in this villa.
Of course, what Connor did in Mount Lushmore Villa today would spread across Honduria at a terrifying speed.
After all, Connor's defeat of Jordan Lancaster had caused a great sensation in the ancient martial arts world of Honduria.
However, Connor had defeated Hadley Lockhart today. This news was probably even more unbelievable than Connor defeating Jordan.
...
Hadley suffered a crushing defeat, and Jasper's whereabouts were unknown.
The news spread across Honduria at a terrifying speed.
When Connor first came to Honduria, many people thought that Connor would reorganize the business world. However, no one expected that Connor would cause a bloody storm in the ancient martial arts world.
The three district leaders of Rockefeller were also shocked when they heard the news.
The three of them did not expect Hadley to be no match for Connor. Of course, they did not expect that the Purple Cloud Sect would disregard the agreement between the martial artists and attack.
This matter was no longer between Connor and Rockefeller. It might even affect the ancient martial arts world.
The head of the Bander Family, Palmer Bander, finally couldn't sit still anymore. He thought that this small matter could be handled by the person in charge of the regions under him, but he never expected that things would turn out like this.
Therefore, after Palmer learned of this news, he immediately gathered the remaining three regional persons-in-charge together.
Inside Honduria's Elegance Club.
This club was where Palmer met with the other four people in charge. However, unless it was a very urgent situation, Palmer would not take the initiative to meet these people.
However, at this time, the person in charge of a region had disappeared. This was considered a very urgent matter, so Palmer personally initiated it.
If this matter wasn't handled properly, the people from Rockefeller would definitely investigate. At that time, Palmer's position would be shaken.
After all, the person in charge of a region had a lot of important information about Rockefeller. This person could die, but he could not disappear.
Otherwise, this person could become a time bomb at any time.
Franco Perkins, Wesley Yanez, and Jenna Lester entered the private room of the Elegance Club first.
At this moment, the three of them had very serious expressions on their faces because none of them had expected such a thing to happen.
The atmosphere in the private room was unusually strange.
"Jasper is really stupid. He actually acted against Connor privately for the sake of greed. And now he's missing. Why is he giving us trouble?"
Wesley broke the silence.
Franco turned and glanced at Wesley, then said lightly, "I told all of you not to act on your own. We were supposed to wait and then work together to take Connor down, but Jasper just doesn't listen, sigh…"
"It's useless to talk about it now. When all of you said that you wanted to kill Connor, I objected to it. He is definitely not as simple as we thought. Otherwise, he would not be so bold to come to Honduria alone. It seems that my previous guess is right. Connor indeed has a trump card that he hasn't shown yet!"
Jenna said slowly.
"Since Connor has already made a move on Jasper, he will definitely make a move on us next. What should we do now?"
Wesley said worriedly.
"Since Mr. Bander asked us to meet here, he must be prepared to discuss countermeasures. So, it's not up to the three of us. Let's wait for Mr. Bander to arrive!"
Franco said calmly.
Wesley couldn't help but sigh when he heard Franco's words. Then, he lowered his head and played with his phone.

chapters.title: Chapter 1501: Conspiracy
chapters.content:
Chapter 1501: Conspiracy
About half an hour later, an old man walked into the private room.
This old man was Palmer Bander, the main person-in-charge of Rockefeller in Honduria and the head of the Bander Family, the largest family in Honduria.
Franco, Jenna, and Wesley saw Palmer enter the private room and quickly stood up.
"Sit!"
Palmer shouted expressionlessly.
The three of them slowly sat down after hearing Palmer's words.
At this time, they were very nervous. After all, the three of them had relied on Palmer's step-by-step promotion to reach their current position. Therefore, these three people had deep respect for Palmer.
"You know about Jasper's disappearance, right?"
Palmer didn't waste any time and went straight to the point.
"I heard…"
"I heard…"
The three of them hurriedly nodded.
"Right now, Jasper's life and death are unknown, but from what I know, Jasper should still be alive. Because after Connor McDonald left the mountain, Jasper transferred all his assets, so it's very likely that he has already joined Connor McDonald!"
Palmer continued.
"What? Jasper actually betrayed Rockefeller?"
Franco was a little shocked.
"Does Jasper not want to live anymore?"
Wesley also shouted.
Jenna looked at Palmer and said nothing.
"Under those circumstances, if Jasper didn't betray Rockefeller, he would be dead, so I don't think it's too surprising that he betrayed us!"
Palmer said lightly.
"Then, Mr. Bander, how do you plan to deal with Jasper?"
Franco asked after a moment of hesitation.
"Let's put Jasper's matter aside for now. After all, he just became the regional person-in-charge not long ago. I didn't really trust him before, and most of the important work was handed over to the three of you, so Jasper's betrayal won't have much of an impact."
Palmer said slowly.
When Franco and Wesley heard Palmer's words, they finally breathed a sigh of relief. After all, Palmer's words implied that he had always trusted the three of them.
However, Jenna knew very well that this was just Palmer's tactic to appease them.
Since Jasper had betrayed them, if someone else continued to betray them, things might become even more difficult to control.
Palmer was indeed quite capable. With just a few words, he managed to stabilize the remaining three people.
Otherwise, if someone else joined Connor at such a critical moment, Palmer might lose his position as the main person-in-charge of Honduria.
"Mr. Bander, how do you plan to deal with Connor?"
Franco asked Palmer softly.
"When Yaakov Ward lured Connor to Honduria, I thought he was really giving me a big gift out of kindness. I never thought that he would actually send me a bomb. He couldn't deal with Connor himself, so he gave me this hot potato..."
When Palmer said this, although he was very calm, the three of them could feel the dissatisfaction in his words.
Jenna and the other two didn't say anything either.
"I called the three of you here today to ask for your opinions and see if you have any way to deal with Connor!"
Palmer spoke again.
Franco, Wesley, and Jenna fell into silence after hearing Palmer's words.
After all, Palmer was asking about the way to deal with Connor, so the three of them did not dare to speak easily. Because once you spoke, your suggestion would be approved by the other two people. In the end, if anything happened, you would definitely bear the responsibility alone.
"Franco, you've been by my side the longest. Tell me if you have any good ideas!"
Palmer turned to Franco and asked expressionlessly.
When Franco heard Palmer's words, he could not help but hesitate for a moment. Then, he said in a low voice, "Mr. Bander, I think we might have underestimated Connor's strength from the very beginning, so the best way for us now is to seek the help of the headquarters. After all, even Hadley Lockhart was not a match for Connor, so the martial artists we can get are naturally not a match for Connor. Therefore, we should still seek the help of the headquarters to find a martial artist who can really deal with Connor!"
"That's right, I think so too. Moreover, Connor isn't alone now. He also has the help of the Purple Cloud Sect. We don't have the ability to deal with him!"
Wesley hurriedly said.
"Of course, I too have considered these options. I've also contacted the people at the headquarters, but the headquarters also needs time to get someone to help us. Also, it takes time for them to get here."
Palmer said lightly.
"Hmm…"
Franco's expression was a little helpless. He shook his head gently and did not continue.
"Since Jasper has already betrayed us, it means that Connor must have already obtained our information. According to Connor's style of doing things, he will definitely make a move against us!"
Jenna said slowly.
After hearing Jenna's words, Wesley became nervous. He then hurriedly asked, "Then, we have to think of a way quickly!"
"Jenna, do you have any good ideas?"
Palmer asked Jenna.
Jenna hesitated for a moment, then said softly, "Mr. Bander, I have an idea, but I don't know if it will work!"
"At this point, we should consider all options. Tell us what you have in mind!"
Wesley shouted anxiously.
Jenna glared at Wesley and said in a low voice, "Don't forget that Connor has offended not only Rockefeller, but also all the martial artists in Honduria!"
"What do you mean?"
Wesley frowned and asked.
"The Purple Cloud Sect came to Honduria and attacked our martial artists. This has violated the agreement between Honduria and the mainland.
"In the past, because of the slow development of the ancient martial arts in Honduria, the realm of the martial artists had always been very low. They were always bullied by the mainland martial artists. Later, an earth-rank martial artist named Faris Jimenez appeared in Honduria.
"Mr. Jimenez fought with an ancient martial arts grandmaster on the mainland for seven days and seven nights, and it ended in a draw. That's why he made this rule. The mainland martial artists are not allowed to fight in Honduria, which prevented those mainland martial artists from bullying the Honduria martial artists. However, Connor and the Purple Cloud Sect broke this rule. The Honduria martial artists must be very angry!"
Jenna said slowly.

chapters.title: Chapter 1502: Mr. Jimenez
chapters.content:
Chapter 1502: Mr. Jimenez
"I've heard about that before!"
Franco nodded gently.
"But what does this have to do with us dealing with Connor?"
Wesley frowned and said.
"Of course, it has everything to do with it. Since Connor dared to make a move in Honduria, it means that he is challenging all the martial artists in Honduria. I believe that we don't even need to personally take care of Connor. We can just use the incident of the Purple Cloud Sect attacking Honduria's martial artists to incite the martial artists here. Some martial artists might even take it upon themselves to deal with Connor. Even if Connor is strong, he is definitely not a match for all of the martial artists in Honduria."
Jenna hurriedly said.
After hesitating for a moment, Palmer said softly, "Jenna, that does sound like a pretty decent plan. However, we might not get the result we want!"
"Mr. Bander, what do you mean?"
Jenna asked after being stunned for a moment.
"Although those martial artists are unhappy with Connor, the news that he defeated Hadley Lockhart has already spread. Many martial artists know that Connor is not an easy opponent, so most people won't have the courage to attack him. Those who have the ability to attack might choose to ignore it because they are worried about the Purple Cloud Sect. If that's the case, then we won't be able to do anything about him…"
Palmer said slowly.
"Then, Mr. Bander, what do you think we should do?"
Jenna knew very well that what Palmer said made sense.
After all, it was not easy to gather all the martial artists to attack Connor. Moreover, it would take time to execute such a plan.
However, Connor didn't give them that much time to prepare.
"I heard that Mr. Jimenez and your grandfather have a good relationship. The Lester Family and the Jimenez Family are considered family friends, right?"
Palmer said softly,
"Mr. Bander, are you planning to invite Mr. Jimenez to personally deal with Connor?"
Jenna looked shocked.
"That's right, you just said that this rule was set by Mr. Jimenez, but now that someone has broken this rule, it's only reasonable for Mr. Jimenez to step in and resolve this matter. Moreover, everyone knows Mr. Jimenez's strength, so letting Mr. Jimenez get rid of Connor is the best option!"
Palmer said slowly.
"But Mr. Jimenez has been in seclusion for many years and has never been bothered about the outside world. I'm worried that Mr. Jimenez won't meddle in this!"
Jenna said with a frown.
"That's because it hasn't been blown up yet. What if we stir up the emotions of the Honduria martial artists? Mr. Jimenez will definitely not sit idly by…"
Palmer paused for a moment and then continued, "If we don't try something, how will you know it's impossible?"
Jenna took a deep breath and said in a low voice, "Mr. Bander, I understand what you mean. I'll talk to my grandfather about this, but I can't guarantee that Mr. Jimenez will make a move this time..."
"Just try your best!"
Palmer looked at Jenna and smiled faintly.
...
Meanwhile, in the Dullahan Family villa.
Because Connor had not obtained the information that Jasper had given him, and because Connor had gone through the great battle with Hadley, the aura in his body was not very stable.
Therefore, Connor did not choose to continue attacking Rockefeller's people. Instead, he rested in the villa for two days.
In these two days, Connor had been learning the Chi Circulation Scroll.
This was because Connor realized that this was the real secret manual of the skill, and it was a terrifying boost to his strength.
Connor's talent was pretty good. He was able to reach the third level with a little bit of practice.
Connor knew that he would experience more fierce battles in Honduria. Therefore, nothing was more important than improving his battle prowess.
Bang! Bang! Bang!
At this moment, there was a knock on the door.
"Who is it?"
Connor asked in a low voice.
"Mr. McDonald, it's me..."
Chieko's voice rang out.
"Yes?"
Connor didn't like to be disturbed when he was cultivating, so even Chieko didn't have the right to enter his room.
"Mr. McDonald, the woman who saved us on Mount Lushmore is here…"
Chieko said slowly.
"Waverly Green?"
Connor was a little puzzled, and then he frowned and said, "I remember that the people of the Purple Cloud Sect have already left Honduria. Why is she here?"
"I'm not sure either. Mr. McDonald, do you want to see her?"
Chieko asked.
"Yes. No matter what, she saved me, and she's from the Purple Cloud Sect. I have to see her!"
Although Connor didn't want to waste his time, he still got up and opened the door. Then, he followed Chieko to the living room.
When he arrived at the living room, Connor found Waverly sitting on the sofa waiting for him.
Today, Waverly was dressed a little more normally. She was wearing a white T-shirt and a short floral skirt. It was simple and fashionable, which was easy on the eyes.
"Sect Leader McDonald!"
Waverly quickly stood up and greeted Connor when she saw him.
"There's no need to be so formal…"
Connor replied indifferently. After all, he was still not quite used to the title of Sect Leader.
"This is the information prepared by Jasper Wilkins. All the persons-in-charge of Rockefeller in Honduria are in this document. Jasper was also brought to the Purple Cloud Sect by our people. Also, he has collected 10 billion dollars in cash. I've handed the money to the elders of the sect. They have expressed their deepest gratitude!"
Waverly gave Connor a brief report.
"There's no need for that. After all, the Purple Cloud Sect saved my life this time!"
Connor said helplessly.
"Protecting you is what we should do!"
Waverly said seriously.
"Since the rest of the Purple Cloud Sect has already returned, why haven't you left yet?"
Connor asked Waverly in confusion.
"I've come here this time to invite you back according to Sect Leader Yarrell's instructions…"
Waverly said softly.
"Invite me back?"
Connor was stunned for a moment, then shook his head and said, "I still have some things to deal with here, so I can't go back for the time being!"
"But Sect Leader McDonald, our people attacked Honduria's martial artists. You're in a very dangerous situation now. Our sect master thinks that you shouldn't stay here any longer. You should leave with me!"
Waverly said helplessly.
"What does that old man know? My friend is still in the hands of the Bander Family. If I don't save my friend, I will never leave!"
Although the people of the Purple Cloud Sect listened to Jorge Yarrell, this did not mean that Connor would also listen to him.

chapters.title: Chapter 1503: The Agreement That Year
chapters.content:
Chapter 1503: The Agreement That Year
The moment Connor came to Honduria, he knew that he would encounter many difficulties; however, he still chose to come here.
Therefore, he naturally had no intention of leaving now.
"Sect Leader, we can think of a way to save her, but you really can't stay in Honduria anymore!"
Waverly exclaimed anxiously.
"Think of a way?"
Connor couldn't help but laugh when he heard Waverly's words. Then, he shook his head and said, "What good ideas do you have? The person I want to save this time is very important to me. I don't want her to be hurt in any way, so no matter what you say today, I won't choose to leave."
When Chieko heard Connor's words, a strange look flashed across her eyes. She could not help but guess what the relationship between Connor and Yelena Allen was.
"Sect Leader McDonald, we really can't act on impulse now!"
Waverly said to Connor helplessly.
"I'm not acting on impulse. From the moment I came to Honduria, I knew that I would encounter a lot of danger. However, I still chose to come here. Also, I already know where Yelena is."
Connor said expressionlessly.
"Then, aren't you afraid of dying here?"
Waverly asked speechlessly.
"Dying here?"
Connor couldn't help but be stunned when he heard Waverly's words. Then, he smiled and said, "If I die here, it might be fate. However, Yelena was captured because of me, so I have to save her no matter what!"
"..."
Waverly looked at Connor with a helpless expression. At this moment, she did not know what else to say.
Waverly never expected Connor to be so stubborn.
"Mr. McDonald, I think you should leave now. We already know Miss Yelena Allen's exact location. We can get someone else to handle this!"
Chieko seemed to be worried about Connor's safety, so she couldn't help but advise him.
"It's useless. I have to save Yelena myself!"
Connor shook his head and said to Waverly, "If there's nothing else, you can leave now!"
"Sect Leader McDonald, if you are not willing to go back with me, then I will go with you to protect you!"
Waverly said expressionlessly.
"You're going to protect me?"
When Connor heard this, he couldn't help but frown. Then, he asked helplessly, "Didn't you just tell me that this place is very dangerous now? Aren't you afraid of dying?"
"This is an order from the sect leader. I have to protect you!"
Waverly replied.
Connor couldn't help but laugh when he heard Waverly's words. He knew that the woman in front of him was very stubborn, and Connor didn't want to waste time on something like this, so he didn't say anything and turned around to leave.
...
After Jenna parted ways with Palmer and the others, she didn't go home immediately. Instead, she drove to a deep mountain in Honduria.
She knew that after Faris Jimenez went into seclusion, the Jimenez Family had been living deep in the mountains. They were unaware of what was happening outside and had never shown their faces in public. If it was not for the good relationship between the Lester Family and the Jimenez Family, she would not have been able to find this mountain.
If they wanted to find Faris, they had to find the descendants of the Jimenez Family first.
Jenna walked around the mountain and finally stopped in front of a house.
Looking at the environment in the courtyard, Jenna sighed because she had not imagined that the descendant of the famous Mr. Jimenez in Honduria would live in such an environment.
Faris was a legendary existence in Honduria, because he represented the peak of the ancient martial arts world of Honduria. After so many years, there was only one earth-rank martial artist in Honduria, and that person was Faris.
Back then, Faris had a very high prestige in Honduria. He even chose to fight with the leader of the Heavenly Sect for three days and three nights for the benefit of Honduria's martial artists.
At that time, the Heavenly Sect was one of the four great sects and had a very high prestige on the mainland.
In the end, Faris and the leader of the Heavenly Sect fought to a draw. Therefore, he protected all the martial artists in Honduria.
Therefore, even now, many martial artists in Honduria still regarded Faris as their idol.
However, Faris chose to cultivate in seclusion because he lost to someone. Moreover, in order to protect his family, Faris moved his family into the mountains.
The Jimenez Family had disappeared for ten years.
"Uncle Huxton!"
Jenna calmed herself down and called out softly.
A few seconds later, a middle-aged man walked out of the house.
This middle-aged man was Faris's son, Huxton Jimenez.
Huxton's talent in ancient martial arts was not as good as his father's, but he was a black-rank martial artist. Even in Honduria, he was a very powerful existence.
However, Huxton was very low-key and reserved. There was not much news about him.
When Huxton saw Jenna, he was a little surprised. He hurriedly opened the door of the courtyard and said enthusiastically, "Jenna, why are you here?"
"Uncle Huxton, there's something I want to see Grandpa Faris about!"
Jenna didn't waste any time and said directly.
"You want to see Father?"
Huxton was stunned for a moment, then said with a helpless expression, "Jenna, my father has been in seclusion all these years. I haven't even had the chance to see him, much less you. Has the Lester Family run into some trouble?"
"Uncle Huxton, this time, it's not my family that is in trouble, but the martial artists of Honduria!"
Jenna said helplessly.
"What? The Honduria martial artists have encountered trouble?"
Huxton's expression changed drastically when he heard this. He hurriedly asked, "Jenna, what's going on?"
Jenna briefly told Huxton about Connor.
After Huxton heard this, he was naturally very angry. He said in a low voice, "My father has only been in closed-door cultivation for a short period of time. How could they forget the agreement that year? They are so untrustworthy!"
"Uncle Huxton, we really don't know what to do now. You know that there aren't many powerful martial artists in Honduria. So, it's very difficult to deal with these people. Additionally, many martial artists are angry but dare not say anything. Everyone is panicking. I really had no other choice. That's why I came to disturb Grandpa Faris. I hope you can let me meet Grandpa Faris. If Grandpa Faris doesn't want to deal with this, I'll give up…"
Jenna didn't mention anything about Connor and herself at all. She just portrayed herself as a martial artist who was standing up for Honduria's martial artists.

chapters.title: Chapter 1504: They Made the First Move
chapters.content:
Chapter 1504: They Made the First Move
After a moment of hesitation, Huxton said in a low voice, "So many years have passed, and my father is already old, so I'm not sure if he will help. But I can bring you to meet my father. If my father is unwilling to help, there's nothing I can do!"
"Grandpa Faris has done so much for Honduria's martial artists. If Grandpa Faris doesn't want to help us, that's perfectly normal!"
Jenna hurriedly said.
"Follow me!"
Huxton led Jenna out of the courtyard.
The two walked around the mountain for a long time before they finally stopped in front of a cave.
"My father has been in seclusion in the cave all these years. Only my son can see my father once a week."
Huxton whispered to Jenna.
"I wonder why Grandpa Faris is in seclusion."
Jenna wondered in confusion.
"Why else? It was all because his father lost to someone, so he chose to go into seclusion to get stronger and prepare for revenge!"
Huxton said slowly.
"I see!"
When Jenna heard these words, she felt much better. Faris had not fought for many years, so she was worried that he was not as strong as he was before. Now, she felt that her worries might have been unnecessary. After all, it seemed that Faris had not given up on ancient martial arts cultivation.
"Jenna, wait here. I'll go in and talk to my father first!"
Huxton said softly.
"Alright!"
Jenna hurriedly nodded.
Huxton then entered the cave.
A moment later, Huxton walked out of the cave and said to Jenna, "Jenna, come in with me!"
Jenna took a deep breath and walked into the cave.
The cave was very dark, and there was no light at all. Jenna followed Huxton for about 100 meters before they finally saw a glimmer of light.
An old man was sitting quietly on the ground with his eyes closed. There was no expression on his face.
The old man's face was extremely weathered. His hair was white, and his body was thin and weak, like a dried corpse.
When Jenna saw the old man, she couldn't help but feel shocked. She didn't expect Mr. Jimenez to look like this.
At this moment, Jenna started to doubt whether Faris really had the ability to defeat Connor.
Jenna took a deep breath, then stepped forward and said respectfully, "Grandpa Faris, I'm here to see you!"
Faris slowly opened his eyes and sized up Jenna.
"So, you're the little girl from the Lester Family. You're all grown up now. You were still a child when I last saw you…"
Faris said calmly.
"I didn't expect you to still remember me, Grandpa Faris!"
Jenna was a little excited.
"Of course, I remember!"
Faris replied in a low voice and then continued to ask, "How's your grandfather?"
"My grandfather is doing well!"
Jenna replied.
"That's good. After I come out of seclusion, I must go and have a few cups of tea with your grandfather. I don't have many friends in my life, but your grandfather can definitely be considered one!"
Faris paused for a moment before continuing, "You came to look for me this time because of something urgent, right?"
"..."
Jenna hesitated.
She was not sure if she should continue when she saw Faris's expression.
After all, the feeling that Faris gave off now was not like an earth-rank martial artist at all. Instead, he was more like a seriously ill old man.
"I haven't left this cave for many years. Since you're here, let's go out and take a look!"
Faris stood up when he saw that Jenna was silent.
Jenna instinctively wanted to help Faris up, but Faris refused.
"Young lady, although I look a little old, my body is still fine!"
Faris said with a smile.
Jenna felt a little awkward. She didn't say anything and followed closely behind Faris.
A moment later, Jenna, Faris, and Huxton walked out of the cave.
"Why are you looking for me?"
Faris asked again.
"Grandpa Faris, a warrior named Connor McDonald came to Honduria a while ago. He defeated Jordan Lancaster and Hadley Lockhart…"
Jenna said.
"If it's just a personal grudge, that's understandable. Although Honduria has made an agreement with the mainland's martial artists, grudges between martial artists can't be avoided. Also, the Honduria martial artists were the ones who started the fight, right?"
Faris asked.
"That's right. It was us who attacked first!"
Jenna nodded.
"Then, there's nothing to talk about. Since Honduria's martial artists made the first move, it's normal for them to fight back."
Faris said with a smile.
"But later on, the Purple Cloud Sect also made a move, and they took the initiative to attack us!"
Jenna hurriedly added.
"Purple Cloud Sect?"
When Faris heard this, his expression finally began to change subtly.
After all, if it was just a personal grudge between martial artists, it would not be a big deal. However, if it involved a disciple of a sect from the mainland who attacked a martial artist from Honduria, the situation would be different.
