"Who is this Connor McDonald? The Purple Cloud Sect actually broke the rules for him? Didn't the Purple Cloud Sect know that their disciples can't attack Honduria's martial artists?"
Faris asked angrily.
"Of course, the disciples of the Purple Cloud Sect know this rule, but they don't care about this rule at all!"
Jenna whispered.
"Who is Connor McDonald?"
Faris asked Jenna.
If this was Connor's personal grudge from the beginning to the end, then Faris wouldn't want to meddle in other people's business. After all, sometimes, when the martial artists of the mainland attacked, it didn't mean that the martial artists of the mainland were provoking them. As long as it didn't involve a deeper level of influence, such a personal grudge was nothing worth noting.
However, if a large number of Purple Cloud Sect disciples attacked together, it was not right.
That was why Faris was so angry.
"Connor is only twenty years old, but his ancient martial arts realm is not that low. Even Hadley is not his match. We also later found out that he is actually the young sect leader of the Purple Cloud Sect!"
Jenna gave a simple introduction.

chapters.title: Chapter 1505: Resolving the Grudge
chapters.content:
Chapter 1505: Resolving the Grudge
"Hadley should be a black-rank martial artist. This guy Connor is really talented to be able to defeat Hadley at such a young age!"
Faris couldn't help but sigh.
"That's right. Connor is indeed very talented!"
Jenna nodded and continued, "Mr. Jimenez, this incident has brought a great impact to Honduria. Many martial artists are filled with resentment toward Connor. The disciples of the Purple Cloud Sect are too arrogant. They dared to attack our martial artists so brazenly."
"Didn't the martial artists of Honduria react in any way?"
Faris asked with a frown.
"Connor is powerful, and he is protected by the other disciples of the Purple Cloud Sect. Most of the martial artists in Honduria dare not say anything…"
Jenna said helplessly.
"They're all useless. When I was in secluded cultivation, very few of the martial artists in Honduria could match me. I didn't think that after such a long time, they would still be bullied by a young guy."
Faris sighed in disappointment.
"Grandpa Faris, I had no choice. That's why I came here today to ask you to personally come out of seclusion to teach Connor a lesson!"
Jenna hurriedly said.
"Hahaha…"
Faris couldn't help but laugh when he heard this. Then, he said indifferently, "I'm already very old, yet you want me to teach a twenty-year-old junior a lesson. If this gets out, won't I become a joke in the eyes of the world? If you can find Connor's master and let me fight him, I can!"
"Connor's master is Jorge Yarrell. He's also a very famous earth-rank martial artist on the mainland!"
Jenna said instinctively.
"..."
Faris and Huxton were stunned when they heard the name Jorge Yarrell. They were shocked.
"Who did you say Connor's master was?"
Faris asked Jenna.
Jenna was stunned for a moment, then whispered, "Jorge Yarrell. What's wrong?"
"..."
Faris was silent for a couple of seconds before he burst out laughing.
On the other hand, Jenna was very puzzled. She hurriedly asked Huxton, "Uncle Huxton, what's wrong with Grandpa Faris? Did I say something wrong just now?"
"Jenna, you might not know this, but my father went into seclusion for so many years because he lost to Jorge Yarrell!"
Huxton explained helplessly.
"Grandpa Faris actually went into seclusion for so many years because of Jorge Yarrell?"
Jenna's face was filled with disbelief when she heard Huxton's words.
Jenna knew that Faris had chosen to go into seclusion for so many years because he had lost to an earth-rank martial artist from the mainland.
However, no one knew who Faris had lost to.
What a coincidence. Back then, Faris lost to Jorge, which was why he chose to cultivate in seclusion. However, after ten years, Jorge's disciple came to Honduria again to cause trouble. It was as if everything was arranged by fate.
Faris narrowed his eyes as he looked at the distant sky. Although he looked calm, Jenna could tell that she had not come here in vain.
"Looks like all of this is fate!"
After a long time, Faris sighed softly.
"Grandpa Faris, are you planning to make a move?"
Jenna hurriedly asked.
Faris shook his head gently and said expressionlessly, "Although Connor is Jorge's disciple, he's still my junior. He's only twenty years old. If I attack him, I'm afraid it'll be a disgrace to others."
"Then, how should we deal with this, Grandpa Faris?"
Jenna's eyes flashed with a hint of helplessness. She thought that Faris would agree to help, but he rejected her in the end.
"I lost to Jorge back then, and I couldn't accept it. After all, I was still a one-star earth-rank martial artist at that time, while Jorge was a two-star earth-rank martial artist. There was a difference in our realms, so I chose to go into seclusion. I was going to fight Jorge after I broke through to the two-star earth-rank. However, I didn't expect Jorge's disciple to come to Honduria first. But this is good. Since Jorge's disciple is here, let my disciple fight with Jorge's disciple then!"
Faris paused for a moment before continuing, "I lost to Jorge that year. Now, let my disciple defeat Jorge's disciple. That way, we will be able to defend the pride of Honduria's martial artists."
"Grandpa Faris, who is your disciple?"
Jenna looked confused because she had never heard of Faris having a disciple.
"My disciple is my grandson, Wadi Jimenez!"
Faris replied indifferently.
"Your grandson?"
Jenna looked surprised.
"Wadi has been with me for many years. His talent in ancient martial arts is amazing. He might even surpass me in the future. He is also the future hope of Honduria martial artists. So, it's apt for Wadi to deal with Jorge's disciple!"
Faris said calmly.
Jenna was excited when she heard this. After all, she wasn't really concerned about who would make a move. She was only concerned about how to deal with Connor.
At this moment, a young man walked up to Faris.
The young man was very handsome, and his resolute face carried a hint of coldness and arrogance. After all, he was Faris's disciple, and his talent in ancient martial arts was amazing. Therefore, it was not surprising for him to be a little aloof.
"Wadi, I'll leave Connor to you!"
Faris whispered to the young man.
"Grandpa, don't worry. I definitely won't let you down!"
Wadi replied lightly.
"Alright!"
Faris nodded lightly and didn't say anything else.
However, Jenna could sense that Faris was very confident in his disciple. He didn't even tell him about Connor.
"Grandpa Faris, when do you think it's appropriate for us to make a move?"
Jenna asked softly after a moment of hesitation.
"First, issue a challenge to Connor. After all, Connor is also a martial artist, so we have to act according to the rules between us martial artists!"
Faris paused for a moment before continuing, "I need to let all the martial artists in the world know about this duel. I want my disciple to defeat Jorge's disciple in front of the entire world!"
It was obvious that Faris wanted to use this opportunity to resolve the grudge in his heart that had been troubling him for many years.
After all, he had lost to Jorge back then. Now, he could only use this method to prove that he was not weaker than Jorge.

chapters.title: Chapter 1506: A Challenge
chapters.content:
Chapter 1506: A Challenge
"Grandpa Faris, don't worry. I'll definitely let the whole world know about this decisive battle!"
Jenna hurriedly said.
"Alright!"
Faris nodded gently.
Jenna was also very excited. Although she didn't manage to get Faris to personally take action, she didn't come in vain as she managed to get Faris's disciple to take action.
As for the promotion of the duel, Jenna would spare no effort. She was even prepared to organize a bet in Honduria, where gamblers would place their bets. This way, Jenna could not only earn money, but also promote the final battle more vigorously.
If Connor really lost to Wadi, it would be a great thing for Jenna and the others.
Jenna was undoubtedly very efficient.
It had only been less than half an hour since she left Faris, but the news had already spread throughout Honduria. Even the mainland had received the news.
Wadi Jimenez, a legendary earth-rank martial artist from Honduria, had challenged Jorge Yarrell's disciple.
This was obviously a battle between two geniuses.
This battle not only represented the strength of Connor and Wadi, but also the strength of Faris and Jorge. More importantly, it was related to the honor of Honduria's martial artists and the mainland's martial artists.
Therefore, such news spread among the martial artists at lightning speed.
After Jenna had a brief discussion with Palmer Bander, she began to set up betting spots in various places. The martial artists would choose between Connor and Wadi.
Even in the mainland, there were many people from Rockefeller who chose this method.
After all, no one would give up such a good opportunity to earn money.
Jenna had also contacted an international live broadcast platform, and she planned to broadcast the battle live after it began.
This series of actions caused the popularity of this decisive battle to reach its peak.
It had been a long time since two martial artists had received so much attention!
Meanwhile, in a casino in Honduria.
Countless gamblers were gathered in the casino. Of course, most of these gamblers were martial artists. They were discussing whether they should bet on Connor or Wadi.
"I didn't expect the legendary Mr. McDonald of Porthampton to be Jorge Yarrell's disciple. This is unbelievable…"
"Yeah. Jorge Yarrell was famous on the mainland back then. Jorge was terrifyingly strong, and he had the best chance of becoming an earth-rank martial artist. However, I've never heard of Jorge Yarrell taking in a disciple!"
"Since Jorge Yarrell took Mr. McDonald as his disciple, Mr. McDonald must be very talented. Otherwise, he wouldn't have caught Jorge's eye!"
"Yeah, I heard that Mr. McDonald defeated Jordan Lancaster and Hadley Lockhart in Honduria. He's so young, but he has such terrifying capabilities. Mr. McDonald will definitely win this time..."
"Then, we'll all bet on Mr. McDonald this time?"
"Yes, we'll all bet on Mr. McDonald. I'm pretty sure he will win…"
A few martial artists who had specially rushed over from the mainland discussed in low voices.
"Who is this Jorge Yarrell you're talking about?"
At this moment, a Honduria martial artist asked with a confused tone.
"Brother, you don't even know Mr. Yarrell?"
A middle-aged man shouted in disbelief.
"I have never heard of this person…"
The Honduria martial artist shook his head.
"Since you don't know, then I'll explain it to you. Back then, Mr. Yarrell was a true earth-rank on the mainland. He was already a black rank when he was twenty, and then he joined the Purple Cloud Sect. Under the guidance of the previous leader of the Purple Cloud Sect, he broke through to earth-rank at the age of forty. Then he started challenging all kinds of ancient martial arts masters, and even created a legend of being undefeated in a hundred consecutive battles. At that time, everyone in the mainland knew the name Jorge Yarrell. However, Mr. Yarrell chose to go into seclusion because he couldn't break through to the next level of earth-rank for a long time. After that, he rarely appeared…"
"That's right. I heard that there was a world-wide ranking of dangerous people at that time. At that time, Mr. Yarrell was said to be ranked in the top ten. Mr. Yarrell was the pride of the mainland's martial artists, a legendary existence!"
At this moment, two martial artists who had some information about Jorge responded.
After hearing their words, all the other martial artists in Honduria were stunned.
"A twenty-year-old black-rank martial artist? A forty-year-old earth-rank martial artist?"
"Undefeated in a hundred consecutive matches?"
"Moreover, he was ranked among the top ten dangerous people in the world. Isn't this person way too powerful?"
"Yeah, I've never heard of this person before. Isn't he way too terrifying?"
Everyone sighed softly.
"Now you know how powerful Mr. Yarrell is. You should choose Mr. McDonald too. Mr. Yarrell doesn't take in disciples easily. Since he took in Mr. McDonald as a disciple, it means that Mr. McDonald is definitely pretty good!"
The mainland martial artist said with a very proud expression.
"Jorge is indeed powerful, but Mr. Jimenez is not weak either!"
However, at this moment, an old man said to everyone expressionlessly.
"Mr. Collier, you're here?"
"Hi. Mr. Collier!"
Everyone seemed to know this old man, so they greeted him.
"Jorge is indeed one of the few geniuses in Oprana, but Mr. Jimenez's talent is not inferior to Mr. Yarrell's. After all, Mr. Jimenez defeated many earth-rank martial artists in the past."
Mr. Collier said expressionlessly.
"That's right. Faris did defeat many of the mainland's experts back then, but didn't he lose to Mr. Yarrell in the end?"
The mainland martial artists retorted.
"That's because Mr. Jimenez challenged Jorge before he even broke through to two-star grandmaster. Mr. Jimenez was too impatient. If Mr. Jimenez had been a little more patient, who knows who would have won that battle!"
Mr. Collier said in a low voice.
"Isn't cultivation a part of strength? Did Faris not break through or was he unable to?"
The martial artist sneered.
"There's no point in discussing this with you now. Moreover, this battle isn't between Mr. Jimenez and Mr. Yarrell. It's a battle between their disciples. There's no point in discussing who's stronger between the two of them!"
Mr. Collier said expressionlessly.
"Then, Mr. Collier, who do you think has a higher chance of winning?"
Everyone hurriedly asked.

chapters.title: Chapter 1507: Bet Five Million
chapters.content:
Chapter 1507: Bet Five Million
"I don't dare to say who has a greater chance of winning, but I can provide you with a few pieces of information for your reference!"
Mr. Collier paused for a moment, then slowly said, "First of all, Connor McDonald has not been a martial artist for long. He only became Mr. Yarrell's disciple a year ago, while Wadi Jimenez has been with Mr. Jimenez since he was young. Therefore, everyone can judge for themselves who has a stronger understanding of ancient martial arts!"
"So, Mr. McDonald only started learning ancient martial arts a year ago?"
"Yeah, I didn't expect Mr. McDonald to barely have any experience in the martial arts world!"
Everyone whispered.
After all, the cultivation of ancient martial arts was a process of accumulation over time, so there was naturally a big gap between those who had been exposed to ancient martial arts since childhood and those who had just been exposed to ancient martial arts.
"This is a very important point!"
"That's right. If that's the case, then Mr. McDonald might not be a match for Wadi Jimenez!"
"Luckily, I didn't place a bet just now…"
Those Honduria martial artists said in a low voice.
"Even though Mr. McDonald has not been a martial artist for a long time, this does not mean that he is weak. After all, he is very talented!"
At this moment, a martial artist from the mainland shouted in dissatisfaction.
"That's right!"
At this moment, another person shouted.
"Although Mr. McDonald has only learned ancient martial arts for less than one year, he could defeat Jordan Lancaster and Hadley Lockhart from Honduria. Isn't that enough to prove how terrifying Mr. McDonald is?"
"If Mr. McDonald had been exposed to ancient martial arts since he was very young, then this decisive battle might not even be a competition!"
When Mr. Collier heard these words, he couldn't help but sneer. Then, he said indifferently, "Don't you know how Connor defeated Hadley?"
"How did you defeat him?"
The middle-aged man was stunned for a moment and asked.
"I heard that Connor took some kind of pill that boosted his combat ability for a short period of time. That's how he defeated Hadley. This kind of method of relying on external forces to improve one's strength can't represent one's true strength!"
Mr. Collier said lightly.
After the middle-aged man heard this, he looked a little embarrassed. He couldn't help but whisper, "So what if Mr. McDonald took a pill? There aren't any rules against eating pills during a battle, right?"
"That's right. If you have pills, you can eat them too!"
The others followed suit.
"Aren't you just being unreasonable?"
Mr. Collier could not help but snort coldly before continuing, "Anyway, that's all I know for now. As for what everyone thinks, it has nothing to do with me. I still think more highly of Wadi Jimenez!"
After saying this, Mr. Collier took out a check and handed it to the casino staff. Then, he said confidently, "Five million!"
When the crowd saw that Mr. Collier had placed a bet of five million on Wadi, they began to follow suit.
And the majority of the cultivators on the mainland still chose to support Connor.
Not far away, Jenna looked at the bustling casino with a hint of pride in her beautiful eyes.
Because she didn't expect Connor's appearance to create such a good business opportunity for her.
"Miss Lester, the amount of bets has already reached 5 billion, but we haven't sent Connor a letter of challenge yet. What if Connor doesn't accept it?"
Jenna's bodyguard said worriedly.
"If Connor doesn't accept it, it means that he's admitting defeat. In other words, he's the loser. Anyway, there are more people betting on Connor now. If Connor loses, we'll earn more!"
Jenna said lightly.
In fact, Jenna had deliberately not sent Connor the challenge letter because she wanted to delay his preparation time. Once everyone was hyped up about the challenge, Connor would have no choice but to brace himself and accept the challenge. She wanted to make sure that Connor had no way to retreat.
...
On the other side, in the main hall of the Purple Cloud Sect.
At this moment, the elders of the Purple Cloud Sect had already received the news that Wadi Jimenez had challenged Connor.
Therefore, everyone was discussing countermeasures. After all, this was going to happen in Honduria, so it was not convenient for the Purple Cloud Sect to intervene.
However, if something really happened to Connor, then they wouldn't be able to explain it to Jorge. Therefore, the elders of the Purple Cloud Sect were troubled.
"Didn't you have Waverly Green bring the young sect leader back? How did this challenge even come about?"
A skinny old man said helplessly.
This old man was the Great Elder of the Purple Cloud Sect. Because Jorge was outside all year round, most of the matters in the Purple Cloud Sect were decided by the Great Elder.
"Great Elder, according to Waverly, Sect Leader McDonald was not willing to come back. No matter how Waverly persuaded him, it was useless. In the end, Waverly really had no other choice, so she is staying by his side!"
The Second Elder explained helplessly.
"Sect Leader McDonald is creating trouble for us. Honduria is such a dangerous place. Why does he insist on staying there?"
The Great Elder called out helplessly, then continued, "Now, almost the whole world knows about this. If Sect Leader McDonald doesn't accept the challenge, it means that the martial artists of the mainland are afraid of the challenge. However, if he accepts the challenge and loses, the consequences will be unimaginable!"
...
At this moment, the elders of the Purple Cloud Sect were first worried about Connor's safety. After all, Jorge had instructed them to protect Connor at all costs.
Of course, these people were also worried that if Connor lost to Wadi, it would have a huge impact on the Purple Cloud Sect.
As for other things, they didn't care at all. They had never even met Connor, so they naturally didn't care about Yelena Allen's life or death.
"Back then, I repeatedly instructed Waverly to persuade the young sect leader to come back no matter what. I didn't think she would fail…"
The Great Elder said in a low voice.
"Sect Leader McDonald has never met us before and doesn't understand the situation of the Purple Cloud Sect. It's not surprising that he turned her down!"
The Third Elder was Waverly's master, so he naturally had to speak up for Waverly.
"Sigh, that's true!"
The Great Elder nodded and said helplessly, "We really don't understand the young sect leader well enough…"
"Great Elder, since things have come to this, let's discuss how to deal with what will happen next!"
At this moment, an old man said.

chapters.title: Chapter 1508: Jenna Lester's Visit
chapters.content:
Chapter 1508: Jenna Lester's Visit
"Which one of you knows Wadi Jimenez?"
Great Elder looked at everyone and asked.
"I heard that Wadi Jimenez is Faris Jimenez's grandson. His talent in ancient martial arts is shocking. Aside from that, I don't know anything else about him…"
The Second Elder replied.
"Faris's grandson is definitely not an ordinary person. Otherwise, Honduria wouldn't have caused such a huge commotion. It's obvious that Faris is not satisfied with his loss to the sect leader, so he wants to take this opportunity to turn the situation around. I heard that he wants to broadcast it live. It's obvious that he doesn't want the people of the Purple Cloud Sect to interfere…"
Great Elder analyzed in a low voice.
"Yeah, Honduria's people have long been ready for it. If it hadn't caused such a big commotion, we could have chosen not to accept the challenge."
An old man sighed softly.
"I feel that this time around, the young sect leader is going to be in danger…"
"If Sect Leader McDonald loses to Wadi, then at most, the Purple Cloud Sect's reputation will take a hit. But no matter what, we have to ensure Sect Leader McDonald's safety!"
The Great Elder paused for a moment and then continued, "So now our most important aim is to protect Sect Leader McDonald!"
"How?"
The Third Elder asked with a frown.
"Waverly alone can't protect him. How about this? I will go to Honduria personally. After this battle, I will find a way to bring the young sect leader back. This way, we will have completed the task assigned by the sect leader..."
The Great Elder looked at everyone and said expressionlessly.
"Great Elder, you need to deal with many things in our sect. You can't leave!"
Third Elder hurriedly shouted.
"That's right, Great Elder, you can't leave!"
The others followed suit.
"Why about this? I'll go over instead!"
At this moment, the Second Elder slowly stood up.
"Second Brother, are you alright?"
Great Elder hesitated for a moment before asking.
"I'm fine. Although I can't fight Faris head-on, it's not a big problem for me to bring the young sect leader back from Honduria!"
The Second Elder said calmly.
"Alright, it's settled then. You will go to Honduria. If the young sect leader encounters any danger, you must bring him back no matter what!"
The Great Elder hesitated for a moment before saying in a low voice.
"Alright!"
The Second Elder nodded gently.
However, at this moment, it was not only the people of the Purple Cloud Sect who were worried about Connor's safety. Thomas Morgan, Kyle Hayes, and the others were also very worried about Connor. At this moment, they were all discussing how to ensure Connor's safety.
However, their influence in Honduria was limited, so they couldn't find a suitable solution.
The battle between Connor and Wadi had attracted a lot of attention. After all, it had been a long time since such a decisive battle had occurred.
Connor and Wadi both represented two top-notch earth-rank martial artists. Therefore, this battle between the two of them was not only related to their personal honor, but also the honor of Jorge and Faris.
Many mainland martial artists had even come to Honduria. They wanted to witness the outcome of the battle.
However, Connor had been focusing on cultivating the Chi Circulation Scroll for the past few days. Chieko wanted to tell Connor about this many times, but she never had the chance.
Waverly was also very anxious, but there was nothing she could do.
However, three days before the final battle, Jenna brought her men to the Dullahan Family's villa.
When Chieko saw Jenna, she looked very nervous. She knew that Jenna was working for Rockefeller, but she didn't know why Jenna was here.
"Hello, Miss Dullahan!"
Jenna greeted Chieko politely.
"Why are you here?"
Chieko played it cool and asked in a low voice.
"I want to see Mr. McDonald. I have something very important to tell him!"
Jenna replied faintly.
Chieko looked at Jenna and hesitated for a couple of seconds before saying expressionlessly, "Okay, wait here for a moment. I'll go and tell Mr. McDonald now!"
"Alright!"
Jenna didn't say anything else. She chose to sit on the sofa and wait quietly.
Chieko didn't dare to delay things any further. She quickly ran to Connor's room and knocked on the door twice before shouting, "Mr. McDonald, someone wants to see you!"
"Who is it?"
Connor asked.
"It's Rockefeller's people!"
Chieko said.
"Rockefeller's people are looking for me?"
Connor was a little puzzled, then he got up and opened the door.
"Did they change their minds? Are they ready to release Yelena and make peace with me?"
Connor frowned and asked Chieko.
"I don't think so…"
Chieko shook her head.
Connor noticed that Chieko seemed a little off and asked softly, "Did something happen in the past few days?"
"Mr. McDonald, I heard that someone wants to challenge you!"
Chieko replied in a low voice.
"What challenge? Did I come here for some kind of duel?!"
Connor was a little helpless, and then he walked toward the living room.
Even if Jenna didn't take the initiative to meet Connor, he had already planned to continue dealing with Rockefeller's people. Since someone had taken the initiative to come to his door, Connor wouldn't show any courtesy.
When Jenna saw Connor come out, she was surprised. Although she knew that Connor was very young, she didn't expect him to be so young.
When Connor saw Jenna, a hint of surprise flashed across his eyes. This was because Jenna was indeed very beautiful, and her temperament was also very attractive. Especially since Jenna was now thirty years old, she had a hint of a mature woman's unique aura.
Jenna was wearing a black office lady uniform today. Her chest was full and attractive, and her straight legs were covered with black stockings. She was wearing a pair of red high heels, and she looked very elegant.
"Hello, Mr. McDonald. My name is Jenna Lester. I'm..."
Jenna wanted to introduce herself.
"Are you one of Rockefeller's people?"
Connor sat on the sofa and interrupted Jenna arrogantly.
"That's right, I'm from Rockefeller!"
Jenna was stunned for a moment before nodding.

chapters.title: Chapter 1509: Big Gamble!
chapters.content:
Chapter 1509: Big Gamble!
"You should know that my friend was kidnapped by Rockefeller's people. I'm here to save her. If you let her go now, I will let bygones be bygones. However, if you don't let her go today, you might not be able to leave this courtyard!"
Connor said frankly.
"Mr. McDonald, I'm not here to release anyone. I'm here to give you something!"
Jenna said softly.
"What is it?"
Connor frowned and asked.
Jenna handed the letter of challenge to Connor.
Connor took the letter of challenge and glanced at it before opening it.
"Three days later, Wadi Jimenez will challenge Mr. McDonald to a battle at the summit of Spring Mountain."
These were the words on the letter.
"Who is Wadi Jimenez?"
When Connor saw this name, he looked disdainful.
"Mr. McDonald, a few days ago, the disciples of the Purple Cloud Sect attacked martial artists from Honduria for no reason, which has aroused the dissatisfaction of many martial artists from Honduria. Therefore, Wadi Jimenez wants to fight you on behalf of all the martial artists from Honduria!"
Jenna explained in a low voice.
"This doesn't have anything to do with me. The people who attacked were from the Purple Cloud Sect. She was the one who brought them there, not me. If you want to challenge someone, challenge her!"
Connor threw the challenge letter on the table as he spoke. It was obvious that he did not intend to accept the challenge.
"Mr. McDonald, are you afraid to accept the challenge?"
Jenna narrowed her eyes and asked Connor softly.
"Afraid to accept the challenge?"
Connor couldn't help but sneer when he heard Jenna's words. Then, he said indifferently, "What do you mean by that? I don't even know who this Wadi Jimenez is. Why should I accept the challenge? Besides, I've already said that I'm here to save someone. I plan to look for Palmer Bander tomorrow. As long as I save my friend, I'll leave. As for anything else, it has nothing to do with me…"
"Mr. McDonald, I know you want to save someone, but if you accept the challenge, you can also save that person!"
Jenna said softly.
"What do you mean by that?"
Connor could not help but be stunned.
"Mr. McDonald, you know that Yelena Allen is in Mr. Bander's hands right now, right?"
Jenna looked at Connor and asked.
"Of course, I know!"
Connor nodded.
"Mr. Bander has already said that as long as Mr. McDonald can defeat Wadi Jimenez, Mr. Bander will let Miss Yelena Allen go. If you don't plan to accept the challenge, then you may never see Miss Yelena again!"
Jenna said softly.
When Connor heard this, he became a little angry. He stood up and grabbed Jenna's fair and slender neck, saying in a low voice, "Are you threatening me?"
"Mr. McDonald, since I dared to come here to look for you, I'm not worried that you'll kill me. However, if I die today, then Miss Yelena Allen's fate may be a hundred times worse than death."
Jenna said expressionlessly.
Connor looked at Jenna and hesitated for a couple of seconds before finally letting go.
At this moment, Connor did not want to take the risk.
"As long as I defeat Wadi Jimenez, you will let Yelena go, right?"
Connor looked at Jenna and asked.
"That's right!"
Jenna nodded.
"Alright, I accept the challenge!"
Connor gritted his teeth.
"Mr. McDonald, don't be in such a hurry to accept the challenge. There's still one more thing I need to tell you..."
Jenna looked at Connor and said slowly.
"What else do you want to tell me?"
Connor frowned and asked.
"You know that I'm a member of Rockefeller, and Mr. Bander is also a member of Rockefeller. Rockefeller always puts profit first, so this time, Mr. Bander has specially prepared 10 billion dollars to bet with you!"
Jenna said slowly.
Ten billion?
When Waverly and Chieko heard the amount, they were shocked.
"And?"
Connor looked at Jenna and asked.
"Mr. Bander has already handed over the money to the Swiss International Bank. If Mr. McDonald intends to accept the challenge, you will also need to prepare 10 billion dollars to hand over to the Swiss Rockefeller. If Mr. McDonald wins, not only will we let Yelena Allen go, but Mr. Bander's 10 billion dollars will also be yours. However, if you lose, then your money will belong to Mr. Bander. Of course, all of this is under the operation of the Swiss Rockefeller. So, you don't have to worry about it being unfair!"
Jenna looked at Connor and said.
"Haha…"
Connor couldn't help but sneer when he heard Jenna's words. He knew that Palmer was obviously planning to take advantage of Connor's death to get some money from him.
However, Palmer was the main person-in-charge of Honduria, so 10 billion dollars was his limit. Otherwise, Palmer might have prepared even more money.
"10 billion is nothing. If you want to bet, then bet a little bigger. What do you think of 100 billion?"
Connor asked Jenna with a smile.
After hearing Connor's words, Jenna couldn't help but be stunned for a moment. Then, she said softly, "Mr. McDonald, I know you're very rich, but 100 billion is too much for Mr. Bander. Mr. Bander won't agree!"
"I'll pay 100 billion. Palmer doesn't have to pay a single cent!"
Connor said lightly.
"Mr. McDonald, what do you mean by that?"
Jenna looked at Connor in confusion.
"I will have someone transfer 100 billion dollars to the Swiss Bank. Palmer doesn't need to pay a single cent. However, he needs to prepare all his shares in Honduria. As long as I win Wadi Jimenez, Palmer's shares will belong to me."
Connor replied expressionlessly.
Obviously, Connor was planning to empty Palmer and cripple him.
In this case, it would be a terrifying blow to Rockefeller.
"You want the entire Bander Family?"
Shock flashed across Jenna's eyes.
"That's right. I've investigated the Bander Family. They're the biggest family in Honduria. Their assets are over 50 billion dollars, not 100 billion dollars. Therefore, it's a good deal for Palmer…"
Connor said lightly.
"Mr. McDonald, I can't make the decision on this matter. I need to communicate with Mr. Bander!"
Jenna didn't expect Connor to be so ambitious. She thought that 10 billion was already scary enough, but no one expected Connor to be so ruthless as to fork out 100 billion dollars.
After all, Connor's net worth had long exceeded a trillion, so 100 billion was really nothing to Connor.

chapters.title: Chapter 1510: Opponent
chapters.content:
Chapter 1510: Opponent
Jenna dialed Palmer Bander's phone number and then repeated what Connor had just said.
Palmer, who was on the other end of the phone, also fell silent after hearing this.
It was obvious that he firmly believed that Wadi would not lose, but he was still very conflicted about paying such a huge price.
If he won, Palmer might become the main person-in-charge of Rockefeller in Oprana.
If that were to happen, what Palmer would have might not be comparable to what he had now, and the Bander Family would no longer be the current Bander Family.
However, if he lost, Palmer might lose everything.
This was a real life and death gamble!
However, Palmer thought about it again. Connor's chances of winning this battle were almost zero. Even if Connor won, Faris would definitely not let him off.
Therefore, he would definitely lose.
"Jenna, tell Connor McDonald that I agree to his conditions!"
Palmer gritted his teeth and said in a low voice.
"Mr. Bander, have you thought it through?"
Jenna couldn't help but ask in a low voice.
"I've already thought it through. Go and tell him!"
Palmer was obviously a gambler.
"Alright, I got it!"
Jenna helplessly agreed, then hung up the phone and walked to Connor's side. She said softly to Connor, "Mr. McDonald, Mr. Bander has agreed to your conditions!"
"I had long guessed that he would agree…"
Connor smiled faintly, then picked up his phone and dialed Thomas Morgan's number.
"Mr. McDonald, is everything alright on your side?"
Thomas had been trying to contact Connor for the past few days, but Connor had not been picking up the phone, so Thomas was very worried about Connor's safety.
"Don't worry, I'm fine. Go prepare 100 billion dollars and transfer it to the Swiss International Bank. Tell them my name and they should know what the money is for!"
Connor said calmly.
"Okay, I got it. I should be able to gather the money this afternoon!"
Thomas didn't ask Connor what he needed the money for.
"Alright!"
Connor nodded and hung up.
After putting down his phone, Connor looked up at Jenna and said, "I'll transfer the money to the Swiss International Bank in the afternoon!"
"Alright, if there's nothing else, I'll take my leave first, Mr. McDonald!"
Jenna didn't say anything else and turned to leave.
Connor looked at Jenna's back and smiled faintly.
After Jenna left with her men, Chieko looked worried. She whispered to Connor, "Mr. McDonald, actually, I've also heard about the challenge. I've been looking for an opportunity to tell you about this!"
"Sect Leader McDonald, you really should not have agreed to accept their challenge…"
Waverly added.
"Why not? They said that as long as I can defeat Wadi, they will let Yelena go. Also, I can get all the assets of the Bander Family. Isn't it better for me this way than to waste my time looking for them one by one?"
Connor said indifferently.
Connor felt that if he really defeated Wadi, not only could he save Yelena, but he could also take this opportunity to have his men in Honduria.
If so, Connor would have the final say in Honduria from now on instead of Rockefeller.
Therefore, this battle was very important to Connor. He could not find any reason to reject it.
"Sect Leader McDonald, do you know that your opponent this time is Faris Jimenez's grandson?"
Waverly said helplessly.
"Who is Faris Jimenez? What does his grandson do?"
Connor was stunned for a moment and asked in a puzzled tone.
"You really don't know Wadi Jimenez's identity. Faris Jimenez is a very famous earth-rank martial artist in Honduria. He is considered the number one ancient martial artist in Honduria. His grandson, Wadi Jimenez, is very talented. So, you might lose this time. If you lose, the people of Rockefeller will definitely kick you when you're down. By then, you might really be in danger..."
Waverly said helplessly.
"I see!"
Connor nodded lightly and said with a smile, "Your worries are unnecessary. After all, the one fighting me is Wadi, not Faris. Although my current realm is not high, it shouldn't be difficult for me to defeat Wadi with the power of the Chi Receiving Pill!"
"Mr. McDonald, it's not as simple as you think. Since Palmer has agreed to the conditions you proposed just now, they must have made sufficient preparations!"
Chieko whispered.
Connor turned to look at Chieko and said calmly, "I know that they are ready, but like I said I came here to save Yelena. If I don't see her, I won't give up. Even if I don't agree to fight today, Wadi will definitely find me on his own."
"But Sect Leader McDonald, you can also choose to stall for time!"
Waverly said helplessly.
"What's the use of stalling for time? And you two heard what Jenna said just now. If I don't accept the challenge, Yelena will be in danger, so this is my only choice!"
Connor said lightly.
Chieko and Waverly fell silent after hearing Connor's words. They knew that since Connor had already agreed, there was no point in talking about it any further.
"Waverly, you're a disciple of the Purple Cloud Sect, right?"
Connor suddenly asked Waverly.
"That's right!"
Waverly hurriedly nodded.
"There's a paragraph on the Chi Circulation Scroll that I don't quite understand. See if you can understand it?"
Connor said as he took out the Chi Circulation Scroll and handed it to Waverly.
At this time, Connor had already cultivated the Chi Circulation Scroll to the fifth level. However, after reaching the fifth level, he realized that he still could not break through to the sixth level. Moreover, there were many specializations that Connor could not understand. He could not ask Jorge Yarrell, so he could only ask Waverly to help take a look.
"Chi Circulation Scroll?"
Waverly looked at the secret manual in her hand with a shocked expression. Then, she hurriedly said to Connor, "Sect Leader McDonald, this Chi Circulation Scroll is the ultimate technique of the Purple Cloud Sect. Only the sect leader can cultivate it. If I read it, it will be a great crime of betraying the sect!"

chapters.title: Chapter 1511: Spring Mountain
chapters.content:
Chapter 1511: Spring Mountain
"This stupid scroll is actually so precious?"
Connor heard Waverly's words. He couldn't help but be stunned.
Waverly was speechless. After all, this Chi Circulation Scroll had caused quite a stir in Oprana back then. In the end, it fell into the hands of the Purple Cloud Sect. Now, Connor was saying that it was a stupid scroll.
"Sect Leader McDonald, this Chi Circulation Scroll is priceless!"
Waverly said helplessly.
"Yeah, the Chi Circulation Technique is indeed quite powerful. I can feel that my strength has improved a lot in the past few days!"
Connor nodded and continued, "Just help me see what that sentence means!"
"Sect Leader McDonald, I really can't!"
Waverly shook her head and refused.
"Why not? I'm the sect leader now. I have the final say. If I ask you to read it, you should read it…"
Connor replied.
"Sect Leader McDonald, only the sect leader can read this!"
Waverly said helplessly.
"Why are there so many rules? Something good like this shouldn't be kept hidden. It doesn't match the style of the Purple Cloud Sect. When I become the sect leader, I'll make a copy for all the disciples so that all of you can become stronger. That way, I can save myself some trouble…"
Connor said casually.
Waverly looked at Connor and didn't know what to say. When Waverly first met Jorge, she felt that Jorge's style of doing things was unrestrained, and he had never followed the rules. Now, Connor was even worse than Jorge.
"Sect Leader McDonald, you have not truly taken over the Purple Cloud Sect yet. You are harming me by letting me read this Chi Circulation Scroll. If the elders know about this, they will definitely punish me. Please don't make things difficult for me…"
Waverly said helplessly.
"But I really don't understand this sentence. Moreover, you're the only martial artist by my side. If you can't look at it, then I won't be able to continue practicing!"
Connor said helplessly.
Waverly hesitated for a couple of seconds when she heard Connor's words. Then, she said indifferently, "Sect Leader McDonald, how about this? You can copy this passage, and I'll try to help you interpret it."
"That would work!"
Connor nodded, then wrote down the words on a piece of paper and handed it to Waverly.
Waverly was considered a rare genius in the Purple Cloud Sect, otherwise she wouldn't have become a black-rank at such a young age. With her help, Connor quickly understood the meaning of that sentence.
…
In the blink of an eye, three days had passed.
The past three days, Connor had been working hard to cultivate the Chi Circulation Technique. Although he looked very relaxed, he actually placed a lot of importance on this battle.
After all, this concerned Yelena Allen's life and death.
Over the three days, Connor's improvement was obvious. After all, with Waverly helping him, Connor was able to achieve twice the result with half the effort.
If it was just Connor alone, even if he were to spend three years, he would not be able to understand those unfamiliar and difficult words on the scroll.
The location of the final battle was Spring Mountain, a very iconic peak in Honduria.
Many ancient martial arts masters had appeared on Spring Mountain. Even Faris lived in Spring Mountain for a long time. Therefore, many martial artists in Honduria regarded Spring Mountain as the holy land of martial artists.
This was also why Wadi decided to set the location of the final battle there.
However, Spring Mountain was still a long distance away from the Dullahan family villa. It would take about half a day to reach the mountain.
Therefore, Connor, Chieko, and Waverly set off at six in the morning. As for the others, Connor did not bring them along. After all, Connor was not familiar with these people. Even if he brought them with him, it would be useless.
Waverly's realm was higher than Connor's, so if anything unexpected were to happen, he could ask Waverly to protect Chieko and Yelena.
As for Chieko, Connor didn't plan to bring her along. However, Chieko insisted on following Connor, so he brought her along. After all, Chieko was familiar with the situation in Honduria, so it would be more convenient for her to stay by his side.
Although he set off early, there were actually some people who were earlier than him.
In order to witness this battle, some of the martial artists from Honduria and the other continents had already arrived yesterday. Therefore, Spring Mountain was already crowded before daybreak.
Fights between martial artists were very rare, and Connor and Wadi's identities were very special. In addition, many martial artists had already placed bets, so they paid special attention to this battle.
Palmer and the others did not expect that Jenna would be able to publicize this challenge to such an extent. At this moment, countless martial artists were gathered at Spring Mountain, including many tourists. This caused the police in Honduria area to feel miserable. In the end, all the police forces were stationed at Spring Mountain.
After all, there were some very dangerous people gathered at Spring Mountain. If these people were to cause trouble, the consequences would be unimaginable.
Of course, what was more important was that Palmer had invited many big figures of Honduria, including some officials, in order to expand the influence of this war. Therefore, the police of Honduria became even more nervous.
After all, if something happened to these big shots, it would be really big news.
At this moment, the entire Spring Mountain was shrouded in a mysterious atmosphere.
Connor was quietly admiring the scenery along the way.
"Mr. McDonald, that is where the challenge will take place!"
At this moment, Chieko pointed at the mountain peak in the distance and whispered to Connor.
"That's a tall mountain."
Connor looked at the mountain peak that was piercing through the clouds in the distance and said with a surprised expression.
"This mountain is the holy land for martial artists. That's why Wadi chose this place. It's said that you can overlook the entire Honduria from this mountain. It's the highest point in Honduria..."
Chieko said softly.
"It seems that this Wadi is ambitious. He's going to use this battle to tell the world that Honduria's martial artists are the ones standing at the top. He's provoking the mainland's martial artists on purpose!"
Connor could not help but sigh.
"It's true that Honduria's martial artists have always wanted to challenge the mainland's martial artists. However, after so many years, it seems that only Wadi's grandpa has succeeded."
Waverly looked at Connor and said.
"Wadi will also fail today!"
Connor replied expressionlessly.

chapters.title: Chapter 1512: It's All Connor's Fault!
chapters.content:
Chapter 1512: It's All Connor's Fault!
Waverly looked at Connor nervously and didn't say anything.
Although Waverly could feel that Connor was very confident, she didn't know where his confidence came from. Even Waverly wouldn't be so confident in front of Wadi, let alone Connor.
However, perhaps because there were too many people gathered at Spring Mountain today, in order to ensure the safety of all forces, the police had no choice but to seal off the entire mountain. Other than martial artists, the rest of the ordinary people were not allowed to enter Spring Mountain.
Among the crowd that was blocked outside, there were two figures that Connor was very familiar with.
These two people were Eugenia Bander and Jeanette Sacks, who were fated with Connor.
Jeanette and Eugenia had purchased tickets to Spring Mountain online last night and were preparing to go up the mountain to sketch.
These few days, the two of them had gone around the entire Honduria, but Eugenia was not very satisfied with her work. Moreover, the homework that she had to hand in this time was mountain scenery, so Eugenia could only pin her hopes on Spring Mountain.
However, she didn't expect to be stopped before she even entered the mountain.
"We both have tickets. Why can't we go in?"
Jeanette raised her voice at the security guard at the door with the ticket in her hand.
"Miss, I've already explained to you just now. Spring Mountain is not open to the public today. You can use your tickets tomorrow. You really can't use them today…"
The security guard explained helplessly.
"But the two of us are leaving tomorrow. Can you just let the two of us in?"
Jeanette said pitifully to the security guard.
"Young lady, it's not that I don't want to let you in, but the police aren't allowing civilians in. Can't you see there are police officers everywhere?"
The security guard said helplessly.
"Police officers?"
When Eugenia heard the security guard's words, she could not help but be stunned for a moment. Then, she asked with a puzzled expression, "Why did the police suddenly seal off the entire Spring Mountain? Did something happen?"
"I'm not very sure, but I heard that some big shot is coming…"
The security guard replied.
"A big shot?"
Eugenia was stunned for a moment. Then, she pouted and said, "Is the big shot Connor?"
"Eugenia, stop trying to be funny. The two of us haven't finished our homework yet. Now that Spring Mountain has been sealed off and we have to return to school tomorrow, what should we do?"
Jeanette asked Eugenia with a dejected expression.
"It's all Connor's fault!"
Eugenia said fiercely.
"It's all Connor's fault?"
When Jeanette heard Eugenia's words, she could not help but be stunned for a moment. Then, she frowned and said, "Eugenia, what do you mean by that? What does this have to do with Connor?"
"What does it have to do with Connor?"
Eugenia couldn't help but curl her lips, and then said softly, "This time, the two of us are unlucky because we met Connor. I've never been harassed before, but because we met Connor, we were harassed and bothered by others. We went to the Mount Lushmore Villa, but it was closed. It's because of him. He's such a jinx…"
"Uh…"
Jeanette appeared somewhat helpless. After which, she softly said, "But Connor has also saved the two of us twice."
"Maybe those people are actors hired by Connor."
Eugenia pouted and spoke.
"Then, why would Connor do this?"
Jeanette asked with a smile.
"Why else? He must be trying to get my attention. This is not the first time someone has done this…"
Eugenia firmly believed that she had it all figured out.
"But Connor has never contacted you before, right? Also, when you offered to buy him a meal, he rejected you."
Jeanette said with a smile.
When Eugenia heard Jeanette's words, she felt somewhat awkward.
"I don't think Connor is the one who likes you. You like him, don't you? I've never seen you talk about a guy all the time…"
Jeanette looked at Eugenia and continued to speak.
Eugenia, who had been exposed by Jeanette, seemed to be a little angry. She tugged at Jeanette and said, "What nonsense are you talking about? I just think that Connor is a jinx. I don't like him. Let's go. There's no point in staying here!"
"Alright, then!"
Jeanette nodded helplessly, then turned around, intending to leave with Eugenia.
However, at this moment, the tourists who were about to leave suddenly stood in two rows.
A fleet of cars drove directly toward the entrance of Spring Mountain.
The cars in this fleet were all luxury cars worth millions.
"Oh my God, why are there so many luxury cars?"
When Jeanette saw this convoy, she couldn't help but cover her mouth and exclaim.
"Yeah, how imposing!"
Eugenia hurriedly added.
Not long after, the fleet of luxury cars stopped at the entrance of Spring Mountain. Then, dozens of bodyguards came out of the cars.
These bodyguards were all wearing black suits and sunglasses. It felt as if it was a scene right out of the movies. After the bodyguards got out of the car, they automatically stood on both sides of the road as if they were waiting for someone to get out of the car.
The surrounding tourists were also stunned. They could not help but widen their eyes and look at these people carefully. However, they could only stand and watch from afar. They did not dare to get close at all.
A few minutes later, a middle-aged man stepped out of the car.
When Jeanette saw the middle-aged man, she was somewhat puzzled. She then frowned and said, "Eugenia, who is this person? I've never seen him before. Why is he making such a scene?"
"Jeanette, shush!"
Eugenia seemed a little nervous as she hurriedly covered Jeanette's mouth.
"Eugenia, what are you doing?"
Jeanette asked with a puzzled tone.
"I know this guy. He's the boss of the underworld in Honduria. If he hears what you said, you might lose your life…"
Eugenia said very carefully.
"Boss of the underworld?"
When Jeanette heard that, she appeared somewhat surprised.
"That's right. Back then, this person went to the birthday banquet of the Bander Family's head. I heard about it from my family…"
Eugenia explained softly.

chapters.title: Chapter 1513: The Big Boss Appears
chapters.content:
Chapter 1513: The Big Boss Appears
"But they wouldn't seal Spring Mountain just for him, right?"
Jeanette seemed to become even more puzzled.
However, at this moment, the other middle-aged men also got out of the car.
When the tourists saw these middle-aged men, they seemed to be even more shocked.
Because all of them were famous big shots in Honduria. Any one of them could make commoners feel scared.
No one had expected that all these people would be gathered together.
Eugenia herself was also a member of the Bander Family, so she naturally knew many big shots. At this moment, she knew 80% of these big shots who had appeared. However, Eugenia had no clue why they were all here.
"These big shots do not like each other. Under normal circumstances, they would not appear at the same time. If they do, they will only appear together for a very important matter."
Eugenia said with a frown.
"If it's a gathering between the big shots, why would the police come? Isn't this a little too brazen?"
Jeanette whispered.
"You're right!"
Eugenia nodded and continued, "Let's not leave first and see what's going on!"
Obviously, the appearance of these people had aroused Eugenia's curiosity. She really wanted to know what was going to happen next.
A moment later, these so-called big shots were all standing in front of a car.
The highest-ranking big shot among them opened the car door very respectfully.
After the car door opened, a pair of slender and fair legs stretched out from the car.
Although no one could see what the person in the car looked like, they could tell from her beautiful legs that she was definitely a beauty.
Sure enough, it was a beautiful woman who walked out of the car.
This woman was none other than Jenna Lester.
This was also the reason why these so-called big shots treated Jenna with such respect.
Today, Jenna was wearing a purple dress. She had a noble temperament, a sexy figure, and a delicate face.
Most of the people present were ordinary people, so they didn't know Jenna at all. Naturally, they didn't know who she was.
However, what was inconceivable was that these so-called big shots were all existences that could suppress a region. However, they were actually so respectful in front of this woman. The civilians around them could not figure things out.
At this moment, everyone was discussing who this woman was and why so many big shots were so respectful to her!
"It's actually her?"
Not far away, Eugenia could not help but reveal a shocked expression when she saw Jenna.
As for Jeanette, she turned to look at Eugenia, then asked Eugenia softly, "Do you know this woman?"
"I've met her a few times before…"
Eugenia replied softly.
"Then, who is she? Why are these big shots so afraid of her?"
Jeanette hurriedly asked.
"I don't know who this woman is, but I know that she's a subordinate of the Bander Family's head!"
Eugenia said expressionlessly.
In fact, Eugenia was still very envious deep down. After all, Jenna was only one of Palmer Bander's subordinates, but she was such a terrifying force that countless people looked up to.
Eugenia was from the Bander Family, but she couldn't even enter the gate of Spring Mountain. This difference was unacceptable to her.
Of course, Jenna's appearance was only the beginning.
Moreover, Jenna did not enter Spring Mountain. Instead, she stood quietly at the entrance and waited.
A few minutes later, Wesley Yanez arrived with a big group of people.
Everyone began to guess what kind of big shot it was. Not only did it alarm the big shots of the underworld, but now even the people from the business world were here.
Moreover, any one of these people was worth more than 100 million dollars. In the past, it was even harder to see one.
Eugenia had naturally seen these people in the Bander Family. However, Eugenia had only met these people before. They did not even have any impression of Eugenia.
Wesley did not choose to enter Spring Mountain after exchanging a few words with Jenna. Instead, he continued to wait quietly.
After a while, Franco Perkins appeared.
Franco had brought all the officials of Honduria with him. Obviously, these officials were more imposing than the businessmen and the so-called underworld bosses.
From this, it could be seen that Franco's status was obviously higher than Wesley and Jenna. After all, the three of them were in charge of different things.
However, after the three of them were gathered, they still did not enter Spring Mountain.
When Eugenia saw this scene, she couldn't help but sigh in her heart. "Is the Bander Family head coming?"
Eugenia knew that these three people were all Palmer's subordinates. Since these three people had already appeared today, it was very likely that Palmer would also appear.
Sure enough, a few minutes later, two black Mercedes-Benz slowly drove over.
The Mercedes-Benz stopped at the gate of Spring Mountain.
The first person to walk down was a handsome guy in a white suit. He was nearly 1.85 meters tall, handsome, and had an extraordinary aura.
Everyone was shocked when they saw the guy, because they all knew that he was Deryn Bander, Palmer's son, who was known as the first young master of Honduria and the future heir of the Bander Family.
Beside Deryn was a cold beauty.
This cold-looking beauty was wearing a long white dress and a pair of white crystal shoes. She gave off the feeling that she was a princess from a fairy tale. Her cold and arrogant face and noble temperament instantly made countless girls pale in comparison.
This girl was Palmer's daughter, Eira Bander.

chapters.title: Chapter 1514: Settle the Score with Connor!
chapters.content:
Chapter 1514: Settle the Score with Connor!
When Eugenia saw Deryn and Eira, she instinctively took a few steps back.
Perhaps it was because she felt inferior, so she did not want the two of them to see her.
Although Eugenia's figure and temperament were considered the best of the best when compared to ordinary people, and her family background was also better than ordinary people, compared to Deryn and Eira, the difference was simply heaven and earth.
Sometimes, Eugenia could not understand why she was treated so differently from Eira and Deryn, who were both descendants of the Bander Family.
A moment later, Palmer also got out of the car.
At this moment, everyone felt that these important figures were waiting for Palmer's arrival.
However, they did not expect Palmer to have no intention of entering Spring Mountain. Instead, he chose to stand at the entrance of Spring Mountain and wait quietly like Jenna and the others.
At this moment, big shots from all walks of life were gathered at the entrance of Spring Mountain. Any one of these big shots was a famous existence.
Therefore, the tourists had no place to stand at all. They could only choose to stand in the far corner. However, these people had no intention of leaving. On the contrary, they continued to stand there and wait because they were all curious about who would come later!
"Eugenia, who are they waiting for?"
At this moment, Jeanette and Eugenia had been waiting for an entire morning, but no one else arrived. Jeanette asked Eugenia anxiously.
"I don't know …"
Eugenia shook her head and continued, "However, I can sense that there is a powerful figure coming. Otherwise, it would be impossible to seal off the entire Spring Mountain. Moreover, there are so many powerful figures waiting here…"
"Could it be a big shot in Honduria?"
Jeanette blinked and said.
"I doubt it…"
At this moment, a guy shook his head gently.
"Why?"
Jeanette was stunned for a moment before asking with a puzzled expression.
"Palmer Bander is the richest man in Honduria, and the Bander Family is also the most powerful family in Honduria. No one in Honduria could make Palmer wait like this. It must be some big shots from the mainland or other countries. Otherwise, Palmer would never wait like this…"
The guy analyzed with a very serious expression.
"I think what he said makes sense…"
Eugenia had some understanding of Palmer, so she nodded in agreement.
When the guy heard Eugenia's words, he could not help but look at her. He was a little stunned as he said with a smile, "Hey there, you're really beautiful. Can I get your number?"
"Number?"
Eugenia couldn't help but laugh when she heard that. Then, she pointed at Palmer and said, "Do you know what I call that person?"
"What?"
The guy asked in a puzzled tone,
"I call him uncle!"
Eugenia replied.
The guy was stunned for a moment, then he scoffed, "If you don't want to give me your number, you don't have to give it to me, but you don't have to find such an excuse to lie to me. If you really call Palmer Bander uncle, you won't be standing here!"
When Eugenia heard the guy's words, a strange look flashed across her eyes. She took a deep breath and did not say anything.
Many people thought that Eugenia would definitely be able to ascend to the heavens if she had a relative like Palmer. However, the viciousness of a big family was not something that ordinary people could imagine.
Palmer had always put profits first. If someone could not bring benefits to Palmer, that person would be of no value. Even if that person was his own son, it would be the same.
Palmer had six sons and three daughters.
However, only Eira and Deryn were known to the public. The rest of them might not even be as good as Eugenia.
This was how cruel Palmer was.
At this time, Eira seemed to be a little impatient. She frowned and said to Palmer, "Dad, is that Connor McDonald guy coming or not? Did he leave Honduria?"
"Impossible. Connor will definitely come today…"
Palmer said confidently.
"Dad, how do you know that he won't run away?"
Deryn was stunned for a moment before asking.
"Connor has already asked someone to transfer 100 billion dollars to the Swiss Bank. Since Connor has put in his money, it means that he will definitely come."
Palmer explained.
When Eira and Deryn heard this, they both revealed shocked expressions. Now, the two of them were curious about who this Connor was. He actually put in 100 billion.
This amount was something that the entire Bander family could not afford!
Moreover, the two of them also heard that Connor was about the same age as them, so they were even more curious.
In the blink of an eye, five hours had passed.
The sky was already gradually darkening.
However, no one chose to leave because those important figures were also waiting quietly.
"I can't take it anymore. I'm starving. I really can't wait any longer. Let's go back!"
Eugenia felt that she was like a fool today. She had actually waited here for an entire day for no reason. Moreover, there were people who kept hitting on her. At this moment, she was obviously unable to take it anymore.
"I've long wanted to leave. I don't know what these people are waiting for here!"
Jeanette herself was not very interested in these things, so when she heard that Eugenia wanted to leave, she hurriedly agreed.
However, just as the two of them were about to turn around and leave, a young man and two women appeared.
Of course, the reason why everyone noticed the three of them was not because of the young man, but because of the two women.
Both Chieko and Waverly Green were top-notch beauties, so everyone's attention was on them.
"Why is Connor here?"
Eugenia exclaimed.
"Yeah, what a good coincidence. It's him again…"
Jeanette hurriedly said.
"I was wondering why I was so unlucky today. So, it's really because of Connor. I'm going to settle the score with him!"
After Eugenia said this, she walked toward Connor.

chapters.title: Chapter 1515: The Patriarch is Angry
chapters.content:
Chapter 1515: The Patriarch is Angry
Jeanette followed behind Eugenia; she was extremely speechless.
Although Eugenia said that Connor was a jinx, she was walking faster than anyone else.
Eugenia angrily ran to Connor and shouted at him, "Connor, why are you here?"
"Why are you here?"
Connor was a little surprised when he saw Eugenia.
Because Connor felt that he and Eugenia were really fated. This was already the third time the two of them met.
"I'm here to sketch. What are you doing here?"
Eugenia asked.
"I'm here to deal with something. Someone is waiting for me here!"
Connor said lightly.
"You should go back. Spring Mountain has already been blocked off. You won't be able to enter…"
Eugenia looked at Connor and said.
"Blocked off?"
Connor couldn't help but be stunned when he heard this. Then, he smiled and said, "Then, they must have blocked off the entrance to the mountain because of me…"
"You sure know how to brag. Who do you think you are? Blocking off the mountain entrance for you? You're really a shameless guy…"
Eugenia said speechlessly.
Connor didn't explain anything else to Eugenia. He brought Chieko and Waverly toward the entrance of Spring Mountain.
"Connor, stop fooling around. There are big shots inside. If you go and provoke them now, you will definitely die…"
Eugenia thought that Connor was joking with her, so she hurriedly stretched out her hand to pull him back.
Chieko looked at Eugenia indifferently and said expressionlessly, "Mr. McDonald is not joking with you. These people are all waiting for Mr. McDonald…"
After saying that, she continued to follow Connor.
The tourists also looked at Connor with a strange gaze.
"Is there something wrong with this kid's head?"
"Yeah. There are so many big shots here. Why is he going over there?"
"If these people are angered, he will definitely not have a good ending!"
"Young man, you should leave now!"
Everyone said.
Connor did not seem to hear these people's words and continued to walk toward the entrance.
Jenna, who was not far away, saw Connor walking over. She looked a little excited and hurriedly said to Palmer, "Mr. Bander, Connor is here..."
Palmer turned and glanced at Connor. He tidied his clothes and then took walked toward Connor.
"Oh, no! Uncle is angry!"
Eugenia saw Palmer walking toward Connor. She thought that Palmer was going to deal with Connor, so she shouted and ran toward him.
"Connor…"
Palmer opened his mouth and was about to speak to Connor.
However, Eugenia suddenly stood in front of Connor and said to Palmer with a nervous expression, "Uncle Palmer, Connor is my friend. He was just joking with me just now. Please don't be angry!"
Palmer was stunned when he heard Eugenia's words.
Palmer sized up Eugenia, who was standing in front of Connor to protect him, and then remembered who Eugenia was. He immediately berated her expressionlessly, "Why are you here? Get out of my way!"
It was obvious that Eugenia's status in the Bander Family was very low. Palmer did not give Eugenia any face at all.
Eugenia couldn't care less at this moment. She gritted her teeth and said, "Uncle, for the sake of my father, don't be angry!"
"What nonsense are you talking about? Hurry up and take her away!"
Palmer berated expressionlessly.
When Palmer's bodyguard heard this, he immediately rushed toward Eugenia, seemingly intending to take her away.
"Palmer Bander, this girl is my friend. Aren't you being a little too unreasonable?"
But at this moment, Connor suddenly said.
When Eugenia heard Connor's words, she was exasperated. She raised her head and looked at Connor, not knowing what to say.
After all, Eugenia was a member of the Bander Family. Palmer could not really do anything to her. However, if Connor offended Palmer, the consequences would be unimaginable!
When Palmer heard Connor's words, he was stunned for a moment. Then, he hurriedly said, "Mr. McDonald, I'm really sorry. I didn't know that this person was your friend."
Eugenia was dumbfounded when she heard Palmer's words. She stared at Connor with wide eyes, her face filled with shock.
She didn't think that Palmer actually knew Connor, and he was even being respectful to Connor.
Jeanette stood rooted to the ground, dumbfounded. She couldn't understand what was going on.
The bodyguards also stopped what they were doing.
"Hello, Mr. McDonald. I'm Palmer Bander, the president of the Bander Corporation. It's nice to meet you. You are indeed young and promising!"
Palmer said to Connor with a smile.
After Palmer finished his sentence, almost everyone present bowed to Connor and said, "Hello, Mr. McDonald!"
In an instant, the entire Spring Mountain fell into a deathly silence.
Everyone stood rooted to the ground in a daze. Eugenia's eyes widened even more.
Because no one expected that these so-called big shots who had been standing here for nearly half a day were actually waiting for this young man!
Eugenia thought that Connor was just joking, but rather, he was very serious.
These people were really waiting for Connor.
"What... What's going on?"
Eugenia's lips trembled slightly as she stuttered.
Jeanette's face was filled with disbelief. Eugenia could not understand what was going on, and Jeanette was even more confused.
Chieko was also shocked because she didn't expect that the big shots of Honduria would treat Connor in such a way.
After all, Connor was the heir to the world's richest man, and he was also Jorge Yarrell's disciple.
Therefore, these people were deliberately putting on a show. They wanted to tell the world that the challenge between Connor and Wadi Jimenez had nothing to do with them. They were just here to watch the show.
The tourists looked at Connor' with puzzled expressions.
"Who is this person?"
"Yeah. What's the background of this person? He can actually make so many big shots stand here and wait for him!"
"Is this person a young master from a big family?"
"That can't be it. Even if he's a young master from a large family, it's impossible for him to receive such a treatment. He might be the son of a certain big shot…"
"What powerful big shot is that? Even his son is able to enjoy such treatment. If he were to personally appear, wouldn't the entire country be celebrating…"
After all, these tourists were just ordinary people. They had no idea what was going to happen next.

chapters.title: Chapter 1516: Waiting for You to Die?
chapters.content:
Chapter 1516: Waiting for You to Die?
But in the eyes of these people, someone respected by Palmer to such an extent was undoubtedly an extremely terrifying presence.
For these individuals, catching a glimpse of Connor even once was already a great honor.
And at this moment, Eugenia too wondered who exactly was Connor?
Previously, she had taken all of his words as mere jokes, not taking them seriously at all.
However, now she was beginning to realize that perhaps his words were not jokes after all; they were serious.
"It seems Mount Lushmore Villa really closed down because of Connor..."
At this point, Jeanette also understood what was going on and whispered to Eugenia.
"Yes, no wonder Connor had such an arrogant personality. It turns out his background is incredibly terrifying!"
Eugenia also sighed along.
"Someone who could make the head of your Bai family wait here for a whole day must be an exceedingly terrifying existence!"
Jeanette's feeling of awe grew stronger as he contemplated.
Eugenia began recalling her earlier conversations with Connor, unable to suppress a shiver. After all, she had offended Connor quite a bit before. If Connor truly intended to retaliate, she would be unable to withstand the revenge from such a powerful figure!
Meanwhile, on the other side, Connor showed no intention of engaging in small talk with Palmer. He simply asked directly, "Yelena is in your hands now, right?"
"Indeed, Miss Yelena is in the mansion. You can rest assured, Mr. Connor!" Palmer quickly responded.
"I've never seen a kidnapper as audacious as you. Once I'm finished with today's business, I'll deal with you properly!"
Connor's expression remained impassive as he spoke.
"If you're still able to leave the mountain today, I might already have lost everything. By that time, Mr. Connor, would you still have the inclination to deal with an ordinary person like me?"
Palmer asked with a chuckle.
"I didn't expect you to be so perceptive!"
Connor couldn't help but sneer.
"Some things, of course, I need to take into perspective. Mr. Jimenez is waiting for you at the summit now. I hope you can descend the mountain!"
Palmer cheerfully expressed.
"I understand..."
Connor nodded lightly and proceeded to move forward.
"Mr. Connor, hello, I am..."
Palmer's son, Deryn, stepped forward as if he intended to speak to Connor.
Yet, Connor seemed to completely ignore Deryn's words and continued walking ahead.
Deryn was immediately stunned in place, his expression exceedingly awkward. He hadn't expected Connor to blatantly disregard him.
It's important to note that throughout his life, wherever he went, he was always respected. This was the first time he had ever experienced being ignored.
Expressionless, he stood motionless, his eyes filled with murderous intent.
Beside him, Eira took a step and softly commented, "It seems this legendary Mr. Connor is indeed exceptional..."
"He'll soon be a dead man. Let's see how arrogant he can be then."
Deryn gritted his teeth and muttered under his breath.
After walking a couple of steps, Connor suddenly came to a halt.
"Mr. Connor, do you need something?"
Jenna hesitated briefly and softly asked Connor.
"Why were those two people stopped outside the gate? They're my friends."
Connor pointed towards Eugenia and Jeanette not far away.
"Mr. Connor, I apologize. I'll immediately have those two individuals come in."
Jenna quickly responded and signaled to the security to allow them inside.
After they entered Spring Mountain, Eugenia hurriedly ran to Connor's side.
Even now, she remained perplexed and puzzled, struggling to make sense of the situation.
With so many influential figures gathered in Honduria, the fact that they were waiting for just Connor was beyond her comprehension. His background must be incredibly terrifying!
"Connor, these people are actually waiting for you?"
Walking up to him, her expression was one of bewilderment.
"Yes, I told you earlier. These people are most likely waiting for me!"
He lightly nodded.
"Who exactly are you? And why are all these people waiting for you?"
Eugenia continued her questioning, growing more hurried.
Upon hearing her question, Connor momentarily paused, then calmly said, "I can't explain who I am right now. As for why these people are waiting for me, I believe they're probably waiting for me to die!"
"Waiting for you to die?"
The more she heard, the more bewildered she became.
"That's right, everyone here is waiting for me to die. Because only when I'm dead will they find peace. If I were to survive, your Bai family might be in jeopardy!"
Connor chuckled heartily.
"Connor, what on earth are you talking about? I'm not joking!"
Eugenia exclaimed, her frustration evident.
"I'm not joking either. Do you think you can handle being the head of the Bander family?" he asked with a playful smile.
"What are you even saying?"
She was starting to feel quite overwhelmed.
"You'll find out soon enough. This place isn't very safe, so it's best you don't follow me."
He replied calmly before resuming his stride forward.
She stared at his retreating figure, her expression a mix of confusion and puzzlement. She couldn't quite grasp the meaning behind his words.
Meanwhile, Connor continued on his way.
It must be acknowledged that the scenery within Spring Mountain was truly breathtaking. Leading the group, Connor reached the foot of the path that led to Spring Mountain.
By now, numerous martial artists had gathered below the mountaintop, as this spot provided an ideal view of the peak's situation.
As soon as these martial artists saw him, they erupted into a chorus of cheers.
Observing the unfamiliar martial artists, his expression held a touch of astonishment. He sighed softly, "I never thought I'd have such popularity..."
"All these martial artists are from the Mudspell. They've come to support you!" Waverly whispered.
"They've come to support me?"
Connor couldn't help but laugh helplessly and remarked, "What's the point of them cheering?"
"Young Master, you're now representing the Mudspell's martial artists in battle. Naturally, they'll be cheering for you. Moreover, your showdown with Wadi will be broadcast live worldwide!"
Waverly explained.

chapters.title: Chapter 1517: Courage
chapters.content:
Chapter 1517: Courage
After hearing this, Connor suddenly looked up and saw several planes in the sky, actually broadcasting live.
"Damn it, why didn't Jenna tell me there's live broadcasting? If this is broadcasted, won't the whole world know that I'm Mr. Connor?"
Connor exclaimed in utter frustration.
He had intentionally kept his identity hidden. If his true identity was exposed, the consequences would be unimaginable!
"No, I need to go get something to disguise myself. If I'm recognized, it'll be troublesome. It's fine if I win, but if I lose, it's going to be really embarrassing..."
Connor turned around, about to search for sunglasses and a hat.
However, Jenna suddenly reached out and stopped him. She then softly explained, "Mr. Connor, you don't need to worry. Not everyone can see this kind of live broadcast. Only martial artists can view it through a special channel; ordinary people can't see it!"
If martial arts battles were broadcasted online, it would surely cause panic. Even Palmer wouldn't be foolish enough to do something like that.
"Ordinary people can't see it?"
Connor paused for a moment, then asked Jenna.
"Yes, ordinarily, regular people can't see it. But if someone knows some martial artists, they might be able to see it," she earnestly replied.
He nodded slightly upon hearing her explanation, visibly relieved.
"If regular people can't see it, then it's alright."
He sighed softly and continued walking.
However, at that moment, Waverly suddenly held out her hand to stop Connor and whispered, "Mr. Connor, Second Elder is here..."
"Second Elder?"
Connor paused, looking puzzled. "Who's the Second Elder?"
"The Second Elder is the Second Elder of our Purple Cloud Sect!"
Waverly explained with a helpless expression, "Mr. Connor, the Second Elder has come to ensure your safety. But the Second Elder cannot show their face, because if they do, Faris might get involved. So, if you feel the situation is unfavorable during your battle with Wadi, just concede directly. The Second Elder should be able to protect you."
"Concede?"
He chuckled upon hearing Waverly's words, then calmly said, "Isn't that a bit humiliating? It's a live broadcast now. How could I possibly concede?"
"I mean, if you feel you can't defeat Wadi, you can choose to concede!"
Waverly repeated with a resigned expression.
"Don't worry, that Wadi can't possibly be my match!"
Connor stated with great confidence.
After a moment, he finally reached the front of the staircase.
"Mr. Connor, if you go up this staircase, you'll meet Mr. Jimenez."
Palmer halted and turned to softly instruct him.
"Okay, got it!"
Connor nodded gently.
"Both of you, please wait here with us!"
Palmer addressed Chieko and Waverly.
Upon hearing his words, Chieko's expression turned slightly worried.
Connor gave a faint smile and replied, "Don't worry, I'll make it out alive."
But just at that moment, Palmer reached out and stopped Connor again. With a smiling demeanor, he said, "Mr. Connor, I apologize, but to ensure a fair contest, you cannot use Chi Receiving Pill. So, I hope you can hand over the Chi Receiving Pill."
"What did you say?"
Upon hearing his words, Waverly's eyes widened, and her expression turned furious.
After all, Connor's greatest reliance at the moment was the Chi Receiving Pill. Without them, he would merely be an advanced Yellow-Rank warrior, far from being a match for Wadi.
"Mr. Jimenez won't use any pills, so naturally Mr. Connor shouldn't either. It's for the sake of fairness!"
