Palmer explained calmly.
"Since when did such a rule exist? I've never heard of not being allowed to use pills in a contest!"
Waverly protested indignantly.
"We've always had this rule in Xiangjiang!"
Palmer answered.
"If you have such a rule, then we won't compete. Mr. Connor, let's go down the mountain now!"
Waverly hurriedly reached out and tugged Connor.
However, Connor remained still.
"Mr. Connor, what do you mean by this?"
Seeing Connor standing still, Waverly appeared puzzled and confused as she asked him.
"Mr. Connor is probably concerned about Miss Yi Yun's safety, right?"
Palmer chuckled.
Connor glanced at him and calmly said, "It's just a few pills. If they don't want me to bring them, then I won't..."
"Mr. Connor, you can't!"
Waverly shouted out loudly upon seeing Connor about to agree to Palmer's request. Her expression was extremely excited.
"Can't? Why not?"
Connor retorted lightly, then reached out and handed the Chi Recieving Pill to Waverly.
"Mr. Connor, without the Chi Recieving Pill, you're definitely doomed if you go up now!"
Waverly shouted loudly to Connor.
"Doomed?"
Connor coldly chuckled upon hearing Waverly's words. He then calmly stated, "Ever since I arrived in Xiangjiang, many people have told me that I was doomed. However, I'm still alive and well. Since this is meant to be a fair duel, I don't need these things. You can take care of them for me!"
"Mr. Connor, you truly live up to being Mr. Jorge's disciple. You have great determination!"
Palmer hadn't anticipated Connor to so readily agree.
Connor turned his head and gave Palmer a faint look. With an expressionless face, he said, "You've really gone all out to deal with me, haven't you?"
"Haha, Mr. Connor, what are you saying!"
Palmer burst into laughter.
Connor didn't bother responding to Palmer. He simply continued walking up the mountain path.
Waverly watched Connor's retreating figure, her expression filled with puzzlement. She couldn't fathom why he had agreed to Palmer's unreasonable demand. Without the Chi Recieving Pill, he was practically walking into death's embrace.

chapters.title: Chapter 1518: Final Battle
chapters.content:
Chapter 1518: Final Battle
Palmer and his group had an extremely smug expression on their faces, as they knew that Connor's strength was largely attributed to the Chi Recieving Pill.
Without it, he would be just an ordinary martial artist. This gave Wadi a slightly higher chance of winning.
Connor continued walking up the mountain path. The reason he chose to give up the Chi Recieving Pill was simple. He understood that this battle didn't just represent himself; it represented the martial artists of the continent and even the Purple Cloud Sect.
He believed that no matter the outcome, he should maintain his dignity. He didn't want others to think that he defeated Wadi solely because of the Chi Recieving Pill, or that he still lost to Wadi even after taking the pills.
Such a situation would bring shame to the martial artists of the continent, to the Purple Cloud Sect, and even to Jorge.
However, without the pill, his chances of winning might significantly decrease.
Yet, he still showed no intention of backing down. He continued moving forward step by step towards the mountaintop.
The martial artists at the foot of the mountain seemed to have learned about Connor's decision to give up the Chi Recieving Pill. At this moment, they were all very concerned for Connor.
After an unknown amount of time, he finally reached the mountaintop.
At the summit sat a young man. He had an exceptionally handsome appearance, although his skin was slightly tanned. His eyes held a resolute glint, and his physique was well-proportioned, giving off a sense of strength without any bulkiness, likely due to years of training.
As Connor's footsteps were heard, the young man slowly opened his eyes. After scrutinizing Connor from top to bottom, he asked in a soft voice, "You're Connor?"
"Yes, that's me."
Connor nodded lightly.
"I thought you wouldn't show up today, but you actually came after all!"
The young man stood up slowly, observing Connor.
"Since I've agreed to the duel, there's no reason for me not to come!"
Connor replied without expression.
"You've disappointed me a bit!"
The young man suddenly spoke.
"Disappointed?"
Connor was momentarily surprised by Wadi's words, then calmly asked, "Why disappointed?"
"Because you're much more ordinary than I imagined. There's a big difference between you and what I had in mind."
Wadi straightforwardly remarked.
"I'm sorry for being so ordinary. I've always been this way, and I can't change that."
Connor smiled helplessly.
Wadi sized him up once again before saying softly, "You're merely an advanced Yellow-Rank warrior. Without the Chi Recieving Pill, you're no match for me. I wonder whether you're brave or just foolish. Despite knowing you're destined to lose, you still came to fight."
"How do you know I'm destined to lose today?"
Connor asked with a chuckle.
"Because you have no chance of defeating me!" he replied coldly.
Connor and Wadi stood at the pinnacle of Spring Mountain.
The lights below illuminated the area, just as Chieko had described. Standing on the mountaintop, one could overlook the entire Honduria, giving the sensation of having the whole city beneath their feet.
Connor squinted at the scenery below, his expression unusually calm.
Wadi, on the other hand, seemed somewhat dissatisfied with his opponent. He couldn't perceive any strength in Connor that would make him a worthy opponent.
"I still need to thank you!"
Just at that moment, Wadi spoke again.
"Thank me?"
Connor was momentarily puzzled by Wadi's words. He asked in a slightly puzzled tone, "Why would you thank me?"
"Because my grandfather lost to your master back then. This incident became his nightmare, something he couldn't accept. So, he's been in seclusion cultivating. At that time, I also lost my freedom. I faced training that ordinary people can't even imagine every day. My grandfather was extremely strict with me, to an unimaginable extent. I've long grown tired of that life. I wanted to be like an ordinary person, but my grandfather never allowed me to leave him..."
Wadi paused for a moment before continuing, "But now you've appeared. I can finally leave the mountains. If I can defeat you today, my grandfather's nightmare might disappear. Then, I'll regain my freedom..."
"I didn't expect you to be quite pitiful..."
Connor laughed and said to Wadi.
"Compared to you all, the things I've experienced are so miserable. But it's these horrendous experiences that have shaped who I am today. That's why I won't lose today!"
Wadi shouted in a low voice.
"Indeed, your situation is quite miserable. However, I think you might need to continue being miserable, because you can't win against me today!"
Connor said calmly.
"Connor, now that you don't have the Chi Recieving Pill, what gives you the audacity to be so arrogant?"
Wadi seemed a bit puzzled.
"Just my determination not to lose today!"
Connor replied.
Upon hearing his words, Wadi couldn't help but burst into laughter. Then, she looked at Connor and said, "Connor, oh Connor, you're truly too arrogant. The world doesn't revolve around you. I've checked your information. I know you're wealthy, but in the world of martial artists, strength is paramount. Money doesn't hold sway!"
"Enough with your nonsense. Are you going to fight or not?"
Connor seemed a bit annoyed as he asked Wadi.
"Alright, today I'll show you how capable I am!"
Wadi's expression seemed disdainful. He charged straight towards Connor's position.
As Connor hadn't taken the Chi Recieving Pill, his reaction speed was noticeably slower.
In an instant, Wadi was already before Connor. He raised his right hand and struck his shoulder forcefully.
"Bang!"
A loud noise echoed.
Connor felt as though a heavy iron hammer had slammed into his shoulder, causing him to fall to the ground.
After witnessing Connor's fall, Wadi's expression appeared somewhat disdainful. He had expected this outcome from the start, given the vast gap between their realms. In a fight against Connor, Wadi probably wouldn't even need to draw his sword.
On the large screens below the mountain, the spectators had witnessed this scene.

chapters.title: Chapter 1519: How Did You Do It?
chapters.content:
Chapter 1519: How Did You Do It?
"What's going on?"
"Has Mr. Connor already lost?"
"This can't be real! He lost so quickly?"
The martial artists from the continent were all wearing expressions of shock. They hadn't expected the battle to end so abruptly, just after it began.
"Without the Chi Receiving Pill, Mr. Connor can't defeat Wadi!"
Waverly whispered softly.
Upon hearing this, Chieko's face turned despondent, and she asked Waverly in a hurry, "What should we do now?"
"Mr. Connor has already stepped onto the stage. I can't stop him now. All we can hope for is that he surrenders quickly. That way, Second Elder can intervene and save him. Otherwise, the final battle has already started, and Second Elder won't have a reason to step in..."
Waverly replied helplessly.
"I never thought Mr. Connor would lose so quickly!"
Chieko exclaimed nervously.
On the other hand, Palmer and the others were extremely pleased. While they hadn't anticipated Connor's defeat to be so swift, they knew that without the Chi Receiving Pill, Connor's strength would be greatly diminished.
On the mountaintop.
Wadi stood in place, looking at the fallen Connor. He spoke calmly, "I haven't even exerted my full strength with that strike just now, and you couldn't bear it. If I were to use my full strength, you'd have no chance. Unlike the people down there, they want me to kill you with my hands. But I have no grudge against you, and I don't want to kill you. Surrender now!"
"Surrender? The battle has just started. Why should I surrender? They've been waiting for me all day. If I give up now, they'll surely be disappointed!"
However, just at that moment, Connor managed to stand up again.
Seeing him stand up once more, the martial artists from the continent let out sighs of relief. They had thought that he might genuinely lose that easily.
Wadi looked at Connor, his expression showing a hint of surprise. He wasn't amazed that Connor could stand again, but rather at how Connor appeared unscathed.
Considering that Wadi was a Profound-Rank warrior, while Connor was merely at the edge of entering Profound-Rank, the gap between their realms was substantial. Wadi's strike before might not have been full strength, but it still carried eight layers of power.
Yet, Connor seemed completely unharmed, only lying on the ground. This was truly unbelievable.
"How did you do that?"
Wadi shouted at Connor in an agitated tone.
"Do I have to explain all that to you? Anyway, even if I told you, you probably wouldn't be able to learn..."
Connor lightly brushed off some dust from his body and replied nonchalantly.
Wadi's face appeared quite agitated, and he dashed toward Connor, raising his fist and striking his chest.
Connor was pushed back a distance of two to three meters, but he managed to steady himself.
"Is this all the strength you have?"
He looked at Wadi with a smile and a disdainful tone.
"Impossible! This can't be happening!"
Wadi shouted angrily.
He felt that his punches from earlier were as effective as hitting cotton. Regardless of his strength, they didn't seem to affect Connor at all.
"How did you manage this?"
Wadi's expression was highly excited as he yelled at Connor.
"Why should I explain to you? In any case, I don't need to eat pills to deal with someone like you."
Connor retorted calmly.
At this point, he seemed to have gone mad, charging towards Connor again and launching one punch after another at his chest.
However, to his frustration, none of these attacks seemed to harm him in any way.
Waverly, watching from below, wore a perplexed expression as well. She also couldn't understand how Connor was able to withstand Wadi's onslaught.
Among the spectators, only the Second Elder wore a self-satisfied smile. He knew that Connor had probably used his luck-based technique. Once the technique was cultivated to the fifth level, it allowed him to protect his meridians and internal organs with his chi, thus resisting most enemy attacks. Of course, this was only effective if the opponents' strength was relatively similar. Against a much stronger foe, it wouldn't work.
"It seems Mr. Connor has probably broken through to the Profound Rank by now. Otherwise, he wouldn't have been able to withstand Wadi's fierce attacks!"
The Second Elder sighed in his mind.
Wadi, after launching multiple punches at Connor and finding no effect, finally stopped her actions.
"Why did you stop?"
Connor grinned at Wadi and asked.
"Do you think that now I can't do anything to you?"
Wadi sneered coldly, then said scornfully, "I think you must have consumed some kind of pill that made your body so resilient. But even if you took a pill, it's useless. I can simply wait until the pill's effects wear off before attacking you. I have plenty of time. Today, no matter what, I will defeat you!"
"A pill?"
Connor's expression turned a bit disdainful as he responded, "Do you really think I need to take a pill to deal with someone like you?"
"What do you mean?"
Wadi couldn't help but be taken aback.
"I've endured so many of your punches just now. Now it's my turn!"
Connor replied calmly and immediately dashed toward Wadi. He raised his fist and struck toward his face.
Wadi didn't anticipate Connor's speed to be so fast. He instinctively raised her right hand to block.
"Boom!"
A loud crash.
The impact between Connor's fist and Wadi's fist resounded like two trucks colliding. Even the people at the foot of the mountain could clearly hear it.
In their previous exchanges, it had always been Wadi attacking and Connor being attacked.
But this time, Connor was taking the initiative.
When Connor's fist collided with Wadi's, his expression underwent a slight change. He took two steps back to steady herself.
On the other hand, Connor only stepped back half a step.
"How is this possible?"
Wadi stared at Connor in disbelief.
He had never expected to be at a disadvantage against Connor in their current exchange.
It was essential to note that Connor's realm was only at the Advanced Yellow Rank, while his was a genuine Profound Rank warrior.
The gap between the two realms was significant.
Typically, there should be no basis for comparison between a Yellow Rank warrior and a Profound Rank warrior. However, Connor had managed to gain the upper hand in this exchange, which was truly unimaginable.

chapters.title: Chapter 1520: Celestial Dragonblade
chapters.content:
Chapter 1520: Celestial Dragonblade
At this point, the martial artists at the foot of the mountain were also wide-eyed with astonishment.
They hadn't expected that Connor's first move would have such an effect.
Waverly, watching Connor from below, revealed a surprised expression. She excitedly said, "So, Mr. Connor has been hiding his true strength all along!"
"Hiding his strength?" Chieko was confused.
"Yes, you can tell from his first punch. Mr. Connor isn't merely a Yellow Rank warrior. A Yellow Rank warrior wouldn't possess such power. No wonder he was willing to forgo the Chi Receiving Pill. It turns out he was hiding his strength!" Waverly explained.
While the Chi Receiving Pill were potent, they had limitations. Their effectiveness diminished as one's strength increased. Once consumed by a warrior at the Black-rank or above, the pills would have no effect. So, Connor's reliance on the pills had decreased significantly.
What puzzled Waverly was when Connor had broken through his realm. When she first met him, he was only at the Yellow Rank.
"Will Mr. Connor's chances of winning improve?"
Chieko, not well-versed in martial matters, asked anxiously.
Waverly pondered for a moment and then softly said, "Even though Mr. Connor was hiding his strength, I don't believe he has reached the Black-rank . Hence, it's still uncertain who will win in the battle against Wadi. However, Mr. Connor's chances of winning have certainly increased."
"That's great news..."
Chieko's face lit up upon hearing this.
On the other hand, Palmer and the others seemed a bit displeased.
It was quite straightforward. They had also deduced that Connor had been hiding his true strength all along.
"Is Connor being too cunning? He was intentionally concealing his strength!"
Deryn's brow furrowed.
"Being able to deceive so many people is also a skill of Connor's!"
Jenna responded calmly.
"Yes, we underestimated Connor. But now, I feel that he's meticulously prepared for everything he does. He's not a fool; he's quite clever!"
Palmer added.
"Even if Connor is hiding his strength, what difference does it make? Wadi will surely defeat him!"
Wesley said nonchalantly.
"Hopefully, that's the case."
Franco sighed softly.
Palmer had been keeping his gaze fixed on Connor the whole time. In his mind, he was already formulating a plan for what he should do if, by any chance, Wadi lost to Connor.
"Wesley, come over here!"
Palmer suddenly spoke.
Wesley hesitated for a moment, then hurriedly followed Palmer to the side.
Jenna looked at Wesley, her expression somewhat strange, but she didn't say much.
A few minutes later, Palmer returned alone, and Wesley had disappeared.
"Mr. White, where's Wesley?"
Jenna asked in a hushed voice.
"I had him take care of something!"
Palmer didn't explain further, responding in a flat tone.
Upon hearing this, Jenna's expression became even stranger. She had a vague sense that what Palmer had tasked Wesley with was related to the battle between Connor and Wadi.
As for the exact nature of the task, Jenna wasn't quite sure.
However, she knew Palmer well. He was the kind of person who would persist until he achieved his goal.
Nonetheless, Palmer was her immediate superior, so even if she had a sense of foreboding, she dared not say much.
On the mountaintop.
Wadi looked at Connor in an odd expression and muttered, "Connor, I never expected you were hiding your true strength all along..."
"If I didn't hide my strength, why would you challenge me? Why would Palmer be so confident in making the wager with me?"
Connor smiled and replied.
"I underestimated you just now..."
Wadi took a deep breath, his expression turning fierce, and he continued, "But even if you're concealing your strength, what difference does it make? Today, you still can't defeat me!"
"Is that so?"
Connor looked at Wadi and asked.
Wadi hesitated for a couple of seconds and then said in a low voice, "I initially thought that dealing with someone like you wouldn't require this. But now, it seems I've underestimated you. Allowing me to use the Celestial Dragonblade is already your great honor, isn't it?"
"The Celestial Dragonblade?"
Connor was momentarily stunned by his words.
Wadi then took out a long blade from behind him.
This blade emitted an eerie green light, giving off a strange sensation, like a venomous snake ready to pierce an enemy's heart at any moment.
"This Celestial Dragonblade was forged by one of the most renowned swordsmiths in Honduria. My grandfather used this blade to defeat numerous grandmasters on your mainland. He passed it down to me yesterday. Initially, I thought I wouldn't need to use this blade against you. However, your performance has exceeded my expectations. It's quite an honor for you that I'm using this blade against you."
Wadi spoke softly.
"It's just a blade. Do you have to make it sound so impressive?"
Connor's tone carried a hint of disdain.
"Hehe..."
Wadi chuckled coldly and added, "You'll regret what you just said..."
"Enough with the chatter. Let's get on with it!"
Connor said expressionlessly.
Wadi's expression turned angry, and he activated his internal energy.
As a Black-rank warrior, Wadi had excellent control over her internal energy. The energy enveloped the Celestial Dragonblade.
Connor squinted at Wadi. Although he had spoken so casually earlier, he hadn't let his guard down. He could sense that the Celestial Dragonblade was indeed dangerous.
"Come at me!"
Wadi roared at Connor.
In an instant, an incredibly astonishing aura burst forth from the Celestial Dragonblade.
Connor could faintly feel this aura rushing toward him at an astonishing speed.
Connor's reaction speed was quick. He sidestepped to dodge the dangerous aura.
The aura struck the rock behind Connor, splitting it in half!

chapters.title: Chapter 1521: Fierce Battle
chapters.content:
Chapter 1521: Fierce Battle
Connor turned his head and glanced at the rocks behind him, his expression showing a hint of shock. He hadn't expected Wadi's blade energy to possess such terrifying destructive power.
Luckily, Connor's reaction was swift just now. If he had been a bit slower, that blade energy could have cleaved him in half.
Connor looked at Wadi before him, sensing that she now harbored a murderous intent.
The onlookers below the mountain witnessed this scene as well. They could all sense that Wadi was genuinely determined to take down Connor.
Waverly stared nervously at the screen, knowing that Wadi had only just begun to take this seriously.
While Connor had indeed concealed his true strength, Wadi was already a Black-rank warrior. Moreover, he wielded the power of the Celestial Dragonblade, giving him a significant advantage.
Palmer's expression also turned solemn. Although he recognized Wadi's advantage, he understood that defeating Connor wouldn't be an easy task for her today.
Even Palmer, who had been confident of his victory, felt a touch of nervousness.
Wadi held the Celestial Dragonblade, calmly watching Connor before him.
At this moment, Wadi's aura had undergone a significant change.
"If you surrender now, I might spare your life. Otherwise, when I make my move, you might not even have a chance to surrender..."
Wadi said to Connor.
"Why do you talk so much?"
Connor retorted coldly and charged directly towards Wadi.
His speed was astonishing, and in an instant, he was already before Wadi.
Wadi's reaction was swift as well. He swung his blade, sending a wave of energy towards Connor.
Seeing the blade energy coming, Connor quickly dodged to the side.
Wadi's face showed a touch of killing intent as he continuously swung the Celestial Dragonblade.
In an instant, one blade energy after another crazily flew toward Connor's position.
Knowing the terrifying power of Wadi's blade energy, Connor didn't dare to confront it head-on. He could only keep evading.
Though he continued to dodge Wadi's attacks, he didn't stop looking for an opportunity. He steadily closed the distance between them.
Connor knew that as long as he got close to Wadi, he wouldn't be able to release his blade energy.
After a few seconds, Connor finally found a suitable opportunity. He charged directly at Wadi and threw a punch at his head.
"Boom!"
Connor's punch created a deafening sonic boom. He had given it his all, leaving no room for himself.
It's important to note that Connor was still a Yellow Realm warrior at this point, not yet breaking through to the Black-rank. However, the power behind this punch could rival that of a Black-rank warrior. It's possible that even some Black-rank warriors might struggle to block this punch.
Connor had deliberately hidden his true strength to lure Palmer and the others into a trap.
But now, his objective was achieved. Yet, he felt somewhat regretful that he hadn't broken through to the Black-rank before this battle began. If he were a Black-rank warrior, dealing with Wadi would be much easier.
After all, he had the Seven-Star Big Dipper Fist and the assistance of Chi Circulation Scroll. In a fair fight, it would be challenging for an ordinary opponent to defeat him.
However, Connor fell short compared to Wadi's level, and there was an inherent difference between Yellow-rank and Black-rank warriors.
Wadi was surprised by the power of his punch. He hadn't expected it to be so overwhelming.
"I want to see if the Celestial Dragonblade can withstand your punch!"
Wadi roared, holding the Celestial Dragonblade horizontally in front of him.
"Bang!"
With a loud bang, Connor's fist struck the back of the Celestial Dragonblade.
Wadi felt his terrifying strength coursing through the blade. If he hadn't been holding the Celestial Dragonblade, it might have shattered from the impact.
He couldn't afford to be complacent. He poured her inner energy into the blade.
Connor continued to increase his strength as well.
Clearly, both were giving it their all.
Connor left a deep pit beneath his feet, and Wadi was also struggling.
"Get up!"
Wadi shouted and exerted more force.
Connor was thrown back by Wadi's strength, stumbling back two steps before regaining his balance.
He looked at Wadi in disbelief. He hadn't imagined Wadi could actually block his previous punch with the Celestial Dragonblade.
Wadi's expression was also serious. During their exchange just now, the Celestial Dragonblade had trembled constantly, and his right hand was tingling. He couldn't understand how Connor, a mere Yellow-rank warrior, possessed such incredible strength.
Yet, Connor's ability to unleash such a fierce punch was due in part to the Seven-Star Big Dipper Fist, an elite technique known for its power. Moreover, Chi Circulation Scroll had played a role, and the Essence Cultivating Pill had enhanced his physical attributes, making him far stronger than an ordinary warrior.
The combined factors had given him the power to contend with Wadi.
"I shall see how long your blade can hold up!"
Connor sneered, charging at Wadi once again.
In an instant, he was before Wadi. He lifted his fist and struck at Wadi's chest.
Clearly, this punch was slower than his previous one, but its power was astonishing.
Seeing Connor's attack, Wadi raised the Celestial Dragonblade once again.

chapters.title: Chapter 1522: Vomiting Blood
chapters.content:
Chapter 1522: Vomiting Blood
"Boom!"
A deafening sound reverberated.
Connor's fist heavily struck the Celestial Dragonblade.
Wadi staggered back two steps before steadying himself.
The Celestial Dragonblade in Wadi's hand trembled incessantly, as if it had endured intense impact.
Wadi felt Connor's punch was exceedingly enigmatic. Sometimes it was astonishingly fast, other times tremendously forceful. He struggled to find a suitable way to counter Connor's unpredictable style.
Thus, he could only rely on the Celestial Dragonblade to withstand Connor's attacks.
However, he had no idea how long the Celestial Dragonblade could endure.
"Seven-Star Big Dipper Fist, Descend the Dragon!"
Connor roared, charging at Wadi once again. His fist struck the Celestial Dragonblade fiercely.
Wadi retreated again.
"Seven-Star Big Dipper Fist, Subdue the Tiger!"
Following his previous move, Connor struck out again.
His fist pounded the Celestial Dragonblade once more, and Wadi stepped back.
"Seven-Star Big Dipper Fist, Myriad Forms!"
He unleashed another punch.
The situation had become incredibly strange. Wadi, who had been dominating, was now struggling against his assault.
Connor's fists relentlessly struck Wadi's body.
Meanwhile, Wadi continuously retreated, and the Celestial Dragonblade continued to tremble.
Connor was giving it his all, leaving no room for any further actions.
After he launched more than ten punches, Wadi's expression turned furious. Yet, he found no way to retaliate; he couldn't find an opening.
Spectators below the mountain had mixed emotions. Supporters of Connor were jubilant, while those favoring Wadi were worried.
Warriors across the continent were ecstatic. They had seen Connor in a passive position, and Wadi had held the upper hand for most of the battle. But now, a shocking reversal had occurred, and Connor was gaining the upper hand.
Jaws dropped as observers whispered:
"Mr. Connor's incredible..."
"Yeah, just now, I thought Mr. Connor might lose, but he's been hiding his strength!"
"I bet fifty thousand on Mr. Connor this time. He has to win!"
The supporters of Connor discussed in hushed tones.
Waverly and Chieko were also thrilled. They realized that if the battle continued like this, Connor had a good chance of defeating Wadi.
The supporters of Wadi wore grim expressions, unprepared for this outcome.
As Wadi kept retreating from Connor's attacks, he found himself backed to the edge of the mountain peak. There was nowhere else to retreat; one more step and he'd fall off the cliff.
But Connor didn't appear to be relenting in his assault.
"Seven-Star Big Dipper Fist, Crane's Cry!"
At that moment, Connor bellowed again, striking out with a ferocious punch.
This punch was even more fierce and astonishingly fast.
He seemed like a bolt of lightning, aiming straight for Wadi's chest.
While his fist hadn't yet hit Wadi, Wadi could still feel the force of the punch. The air around them felt frosty and sharp.
"All this is because of you forced me!"
Wadi shouted at Connor, raising the Celestial Dragonblade above his head.
Clearly, this time, he was not on the defensive. He was launching an offensive against Connor.
In an instant, an incredibly powerful aura burst forth from his body. He lifted the Celestial Dragonblade above his head and swung it down toward Connor's head.
It was evident that he was now prepared to fight desperately.
The current test was who had greater strength and faster speed between the two.
If his blade struck Connor first, Connor would undoubtedly die. But if Connor's fist landed on Wadi's body first, he would plummet down the cliff, facing near-certain death.
Connor stared at Wadi before him, showing no sign of retreat.
And Wadi stared back at Connor, equally unwavering.
All the warriors present widened their eyes, watching the screen intently. They knew that after this move, the battle between the two would likely be decided.
"Boom!"
A tremendous sound echoed through the heavens and earth.
No one dared to blink, afraid of missing a single moment.
Connor's fist had struck Wadi's chest, but the Celestial Dragonblade hadn't hit Connor.
The Celestial Dragonblade hovered just a centimeter above Connor's head, almost cutting him.
Yet, Connor's speed had been slightly faster.
"Splurt..."
Wadi sprayed a mouthful of blood, but he didn't fall off the cliff.
In that critical instant, Wadi had been afraid. He concentrated his energy into his legs, then stomped on the ground, leaving behind two deep craters. This ensured that he didn't tumble off the cliff after taking Connor's punch.
Witnesses were stunned by the sight. No one had expected Connor's punch to force Wadi to cough up blood.
Many had believed Connor couldn't possibly match Wadi, but the current situation exceeded everyone's expectations.
Palmer's expression was particularly grim.
Jenna looked worried, and she noticed Wesley had yet to return since he left. She had a vague inkling of what Wesley might be up to.
"Has Mr. Connor won?" Chieko excitedly asked Waverly.
Waverly glanced up at the mountaintop, then said softly, "It seems like Mr. Connor has won."
"Mr. Connor actually won..."
"Yes, it's unbelievable. Mr. Connor really won..."
"Mr. Connor is truly incredible..."
Warriors from across the continent erupted in cheers, their expressions bursting with excitement.

chapters.title: Chapter 1523: Malfunction
chapters.content:
Chapter 1523: Malfunction
After all, Connor was representing Mudspell's martial artists this time. If he won, it would mean that they had won.
In addition, many Mudspell martial artists had bet on him, so they were naturally very happy at this time.
Compared to those fighters on the mainland, those fighters from Honduria looked pretty awful.
After all, most of them supported Wadi, but no one expected such a result!
"I originally thought that Connor wouldn't be a match for Mr. Wadi without the Chi Receiving Pill, but I didn't expect that he had been hiding his strength all this time!"
"That's right. This Connor is really too cunning…"
"The fighters in Honduria are not as good as those in the mainland. If this event were to spread out, I'm afraid that the fighters in Honduria would be inferior to them again…"
Everyone sighed dejectedly.
The Second Elder of the Purple Cloud Sect narrowed his eyes and looked at the screen. His expression was a little strange because he could feel that Wadi had not lost yet.
Because Wadi's aura was still there, and it had always been at the peak level.
Although Connor's punch had indeed hit Wadi's chest, and Wadi had indeed vomited blood, it did not cause any fatal damage to Wadi.
Connor had also learned this information through the Chi Observation Technique, so he did not dare to be careless at all. He stared at Wadi's position with a serious expression.
"Connor, I admit that you are indeed a powerful opponent. All of us have underestimated you…"
At this moment, Wadi looked at him and sneered.
"It is unexpected that your body is actually so strong…"
Connor said to him in surprise.
"Fortunately, I wore an armor before I went up the mountain. Otherwise, I might have really been knocked down by your punch just now…"
Wadi took off his clothes as she spoke.
When Wadi took off his clothes, Connor realized that he was wearing a suit of armor. The armor was silver-white, as if it was woven from many scales.
However, this armor was also a very famous treasure in Honduria. It could even be named after the Celestial Dragonblade.
If it wasn't for this armor, Wadi would have been pierced through by Connor.
"What's going on?"
"That's right, you didn't let Mr. Connor take the Chi Receiving Pill, but let Wadi secretly put on his armor and held the Celestial Dragonblade. Isn't this bullying an honest person?"
"This Wadi is too shameless. He's a disgrace to Honduria's martial artists…"
When the cultivators on the Mudspell saw the armor on Wadi's body, they began to shout and shout one after another. Their expressions were abnormally angry.
Those Xiangjiang fighters looked very embarrassed. After all, they were the ones who said that Connor couldn't take the elixir. Now, Wadi was wearing armor and holding the Celestial Dragonblade. It was really unreasonable.
However, Palmer's expression was very proud. He didn't care about fairness or unfairness at all. There was only one thought in his mind, and that was that Wadi had to defeat Connor.
After Wadi took off his armor, he threw it aside.
Because this armor had already been smashed into pieces by Connor's punch, there was no need to continue wearing it now.
"Connor, you're the first opponent I've met, but I think you're really strong!"
Wadi looked at Connor and sighed, then continued,"But unfortunately, you're not my match yet!"
After saying this, Wadi evaded the kick.
In an instant, an extremely powerful aura erupted from his body.
It was obvious that the aura in his body was more terrifying than before.
When the aura completely erupted, all the screens at the foot of the mountain turned black.
"What's going on?"
"Yeah, what's going on?"
"Could it be that the screen turned black because Mr. Wadi's aura is too terrifying…"
"What happened? It was fine just now. Why did the screen suddenly turn black?"
The martial artists present shouted excitedly.
Palmer was not very surprised by this situation at this time, because he knew in his heart that Wesley had lost his power.
"Everyone, I'm really sorry. There's a problem with our broadcast line. The staff is currently repairing it. Please wait patiently!"
At this moment, a staff member stood up and explained.
"At such a critical time, something went wrong? How long would it take to fix it?"
"That's right. It didn't break down sooner or later, but it just had to malfunction at this time. Isn't this too disappointing?"
The martial artists present shouted excitedly.
"Everyone, we will fix it as soon as possible!"
The staff member replied with a helpless expression, then turned around and left.
Jenna turned her head to look at Palmer. She realized that his expressions were unusually calm, so calm that it was unbelievable.
Palmer had a bet with Connor. If Wadi lost to Connor, he would only bring shame to the fighters of Honduria.
If Connor won, then the entire Bander family would become Connor's. This was simply a devastating blow to Palmer.
Therefore, he should be more concerned about the outcome of this battle than anyone else.
However, he did not react at all after the screen malfunctioned. He stood quietly in place.
This meant that he had already thought of the possibility of a malfunction.
Jenna quickly remembered Wesley, who had disappeared for a long time.
"Could it be that the malfunction has something to do with Wesley?"
Jenna couldn't help but sigh inwardly.
On Spring Mountain.
Wadi was obviously stimulated by Connor's punch just now, so the battle between the two had entered a white-hot stage.
They chose the most direct close combat. Basically, it was a fight of one punch after another.
However, after a round of hand-to-hand combat, Wadi found that Connor's physical fitness was much stronger than his. He couldn't gain any advantage in close combat with Connor.

chapters.title: Chapter 1524: Twelve-Star Pattern
chapters.content:
Chapter 1524: Twelve-Star Pattern
"What kind of person are you? Why does your body possess such terrifying strength?" Wadi stared at Connor, shouting at him.
"I'm just an ordinary person..." Connor looked at Wadi, his expression calmly replying.
"No... It's absolutely impossible. I started practicing ancient martial arts when I was five years old. I trained diligently day after day to attain the strength I have now. But you've only been practicing ancient martial arts for less than a year. How could you have such a terrifying body? It's absolutely impossible!" Wadi was now shouting loudly at Connor, appearing almost crazed.
It was important to note that Wadi had always been very proud of his physique. However, after experiencing the battle with Connor just now, his self-confidence had been utterly shattered.
So, he was displaying such excitement now.
"I was just an ordinary person at first, but I became a warrior because I ate the Essence Cultivating Pill later on..." Connor also didn't intend to hide anything from Wadi and explained directly.
"Essence Cultivating Pill?"
Wadi was stunned upon hearing Connor's words. After a brief silence, he burst into laughter.
"What are you laughing about?"
Connor looked at him with a puzzled expression.
"You actually ate an Essence Cultivating Pill?"
Wadi repeated quietly.
"Can't you eat that?"
Connor asked casually.
"Nonsense, of course, the Essence Cultivating Pill is precious. It's the elixir that all warriors in the world dream of!"
Wadi said somewhat speechlessly.
"I really didn't know it was so precious at the time. The old man said my aptitude was poor. After eating the Essence Cultivating Pill, my aptitude would improve somewhat, so I ate it..."
Connor explained lightly.
Wadi looked at Connor with an extremely speechless expression. He didn't know what to say now.
Faris had spent his whole life searching for the Essence Cultivating Pill. If Faris had consumed the pill, he might have been able to break through to the Earth-rank level. By that time, he would have possessed the strength to battle Jorge.
For Faris, not being able to gather the medicinal materials needed for the Essence Cultivating Pill had been his greatest regret in life.
If Faris were to find out that Jorge had casually let Connor consume such a precious Essence Cultivating Pill, he would probably be enraged!
"Even if you had taken the Chi Receiving Pill, what difference would it make? Today, you'll still lose to me..." Wadi suddenly shouted at Connor.
"If you have any other abilities, now is the time to use them. I'm afraid you might not have another chance later!" Connor said expressionlessly.
Upon hearing his words, Wadi couldn't help but sneer, then said indifferently, "I really wonder where your confidence comes from!"
After saying this, Wadi gently waved his hand, and the Celestial Dragonblade flew directly into his grasp.
"Connor, if you can withstand this move of mine, I'll admit defeat!" Wadi said softly to Connor.
"Fine!"
Connor nodded lightly.
He took a deep breath and held the Celestial Dragonblade horizontally in front of his chest.
In an instant, countless auras poured into the Celestial Dragonblade in Wadi's hand.
At this moment, he seemed to be lifting a massive elephant. His expression was extremely pained, and his body was trembling continuously.
Connor understood that he had unleashed a force that his body couldn't bear. That's why he appeared like this.
He walked toward Connor's position, step by step.
His steps were extremely difficult, and blood had already begun to slowly trickle from his nose.
Connor knew that this might be his final move. Once he used this move, he probably wouldn't have the strength to continue the fight against him.
"Soul-Devouring Strike!"
At this moment, Wadi suddenly shouted, then vigorously swung the Celestial Dragonblade in his hand.
Connor could clearly see a black blade aura flying towards him at an astonishing speed.
He stood still with an unusually calm expression. After taking a deep breath, he slowly said, "Seven-Star Big Dipper Fist, the final move, King of Ten Thousand Forms!"
As Connor finished speaking, his aura instantly surged out of his body, and the two different colors of auras converged incessantly. Finally, they formed a twelve-star pattern right in front of Connor.
The twelve-star pattern slowly flew towards the black blade aura in Wadi's direction.
"Boom!"
At the moment of impact, an immense sound erupted.
Even the warriors at the foot of the mountain could clearly hear this deafening noise.
Jorge had once told Connor that the final move of the Seven-Star Big Dipper Fist had to be comprehended by Connor himself in the midst of battle. So, he had been continuously testing during the battle just now. But in the end, he suddenly realized that perhaps the final move of the Seven-Star Big Dipper Fist was not an offensive technique.
Clearly, his guess was correct.
The final move of the Seven-Star Big Dipper Fist was not an offensive technique; it was a defensive technique.
At this moment, he was very glad he had realized this point. If he hadn't, it would have been difficult for him to block Wadi's final move.
Wadi stared at the scene in front of him, his expression filled with disbelief. He had discovered that Connor's Twelve-Star Pattern was slowly devouring the power of his black blade aura.
In the end, his black blade aura vanished completely.
"Pfft..."
Wadi had nearly exhausted all his strength to execute this move. Yet, Connor had easily neutralized it.
He spat out a mouthful of blood and then collapsed to the ground.
Connor took slow steps and walked over to where Wadi lay.
"It's impossible. How could I possibly lose to you?" Wadi still seemed unable to accept this reality.
"Do you want to continue fighting?" Connor asked Wadi softly.
Upon hearing his question, Wadi was momentarily stunned. Then, with an expression of despair, he shook his head and said in a low voice, "I can't move anymore now. I'm not your match at all. You've won. Just kill me!"

chapters.title: Chapter 1525: The Victory Has Been Decided!
chapters.content:
Chapter 1525: The Victory Has Been Decided!
"Kill you?"
Connor gave a faint smile and said playfully, "I never intended to kill you!"
"You're not planning to kill me?"
Wadi seemed somewhat surprised as he asked.
"Of course not!"
Connor nodded gently and continued, "We had no grudges or conflicts to begin with. Why should I kill you? It wouldn't benefit me in any way."
"But I was planning to kill you just now..."
Wadi looked at him, still wearing a look of disbelief.
"You wanted to kill me, but you didn't have the ability. I could have killed you, but I don't think it's necessary."
Connor replied lightly, then turned and left.
Wadi lay on the ground, feeling deeply ashamed. He had never expected the outcome to be like this.
Meanwhile, the warriors at the foot of the mountain seemed to be unaware of what had happened on Spring Mountain. After the malfunction, the large screen had not lit up again.
However, these people understood that the victor had already been determined.
Because many warriors were present, they could sense that there was only one person's aura left on the mountain, while the other person's aura had disappeared.
Therefore, the one remaining person was undoubtedly the winner of this battle.
Everyone stared wide-eyed, fixated on the position of the mountain path.
"Who won in the end?"
"Yes, why hasn't anyone come down yet?"
"I'm sure it must be Mr. Wadi who won..."
"Absolutely, that Connor couldn't possibly be a match for Mr. Wadi..."
The warriors from Honduria excitedly shouted.
Even Palmer's expression appeared nervous. He kept his gaze fixed on the mountain path exit.
In an instant, it felt like the whole Spring Mountain had fallen into silence.
"Tap, tap, tap..."
Just then, a series of footsteps broke the silence.
The people present held their breath, knowing that the person who appeared before them at this moment was undoubtedly the winner of the battle.
Palmer had never felt so anxious before.
A few seconds later, a figure entered everyone's line of sight.
As this figure appeared, the onlookers were left dumbfounded.
Because the person descending the mountain was not Wadi at all; it was Connor.
"How... How is this possible?"
"Connor actually won?"
"Mr. Wadi actually lost?"
For a moment, everyone stood still, staring at Connor in astonishment. Their expressions, aside from shock, were still more shock.
"Connor actually won!"
Palmer couldn't help but inhale sharply, then turned to glance at the people beside him, before decisively leaving amidst the confusion.
After a brief hesitation, Jenna also hastened to follow Palmer's footsteps. She knew very well that if Connor defeated Wadi, he would likely target them, the Rockefellers. Therefore, leaving at this moment was the wisest choice.
Upon seeing Connor, the Mudspell's warriors erupted into cheers, their expressions filled with excitement.
No one had expected the outcome to be like this. Connor had truly defeated Wadi.
In an instant, all the Mudspell warriors present were in a state of frenzy, enthusiastically shouting his name.
After all, this battle represented not just Connor himself, but also all the Mudspell warriors. This time, the Mudspell warriors had a chance to hold their heads high.
Chieko quickly approached Connor and excitedly shouted, "Congratulations, Mr. Connor! You actually defeated Wadi!"
"I told you before, not to worry about me. I was definitely going to win this battle..."
Connor replied with a cheerful smile.
"Congratulations, Mr. Connor!"
Waverly also walked up to Connor and said softly.
Upon hearing Waverly's words, Connor instinctively glanced at the people beside him and noticed that Palmer, Jenna, and Franco had all disappeared.
"Waverly, I asked you to keep an eye on those three, but what about the people from the Rockefellers?" he whispered to Waverly.
She hesitated for a moment, then excitedly said, "Mr. Connor, I was so caught up in the excitement that I forgot about it. I'll go find them now..."
"No need!"
He directly stopped her with his hand, then said expressionlessly, "Those three have probably escaped by now. Even if you chase them, you likely won't catch up."
"Then, Mr. Connor, should we go find Palmer now?"
After a brief hesitation, she asked Connor.
"I was injured during the battle with Wadi just now. My physical condition isn't very good at the moment, so there's no rush to settle accounts with Palmer. Let's go rest for now!" he said.
"Alright!"
She quickly nodded.
Connor, along with Waverly and Chieko, walked towards the outskirts of Spring Mountain.
At this moment, countless warriors were shouting his name excitedly. It was as if, in their hearts, he had truly become a hero.
Although these people didn't know what had transpired at the mountain's peak, they understood that defeating Wadi couldn't have been an easy task.
Furthermore, this news would likely spread worldwide soon. By that time, warriors all over the world would learn about his name because of this battle.
Second Elder watched Connor's receding figure with a similarly excited expression. Initially, he had only regarded Connor as a wealthy second generation. In the battle between Connor and Wadi, he had actually leaned more towards Wadi.
But he had never expected the final outcome to be that Connor had truly won.
Connor's victory over Wadi was also a tremendous boon for the Purple Cloud Sect.

chapters.title: Chapter 1526: Falling Off the Cliff
chapters.content:
Chapter 1526: Falling Off the Cliff
Meanwhile, atop Spring Mountain,
Wadi lay on the ground, his expression contorted with intense pain. Although Connor had ultimately chosen not to kill him, the execution of Wadi's Soul-Devouring Slash had inflicted significant damage to his body.
At this moment, hecould hardly muster the strength to stand on his own.
In a nearby corner, a figure had been surreptitiously observing everything transpiring on Spring Mountain. This person was Wesley .
Originally tasked by Palmer, Wesley had arrived early at the summit. He had witnessed the fierce battle between Wadi and Connor, and now, he finally grasped the true extent of Connor's terror. Despite several minutes having passed since Connor descended the mountain, Wesley still couldn't shake off his unease.
Hiding in the shadows for quite some time, Wesley confirmed that Connor had unequivocally left before cautiously emerging from his concealment. He then hastened over to Wadi and fervently exclaimed, "Mr. Wadi, are you alright?"
"Who are you?"
Wadi turned his head and looked at Wesley, his tone tinged with confusion.
"Mr. Wadi, I'm a subordinate of Mr. Palmer!" Wesley hurriedly explained, then clenched his teeth and continued, "That damned Connor has truly left you in this state, which is utterly despicable…"
"Connor's mercy in sparing me today is already an act of righteousness. Help me up," Wadi muttered softly to Wesley.
Upon hearing his words, Wesley's expression took on a peculiar look. He quickly extended his hand and assisted Wadi to his feet.
As Wesley tried to help him forward, he noticed that Wadi seemed unable to exert any strength in his legs and arms.
"Mr. Wadi, perhaps I should carry you down?" Wesley tentatively suggested.
Wadi struggled briefly, realizing he was unable to walk. He sighed with resignation and said, "Thank you for your help."
"It's no trouble. After all, Mr. Wadi, you stepped up for the martial artists of Honduria this time. It's the least I can do," Wesley replied with a hearty chuckle as he lifted Wadi onto his back.
Once Wadi was on his back, Wesley did something unexpected, he didn't head down the mountain but walked directly toward the edge of the cliff.
Wadi began to sense that something was amiss and struggled on Wesley's back.
"Mr. Wadi, didn't I just tell you? I'm taking you down the mountain!"
"Down the mountain?"
Wadi stared in bewilderment.
"Mr. Wadi, I apologize, but Mr. Palmer instructed that if you were to lose to Connor today, you must die here. Furthermore, it must be known to everyone that you were killed by Connor!"
Having said this, Wesley exerted force and flung Wadi off his back, sending him hurtling down the cliff.
Wadi was now completely immobile, so he silently plummeted from Spring Mountain at Wesley's hands.
Spring Mountain's elevation was at least several hundred meters, and falling from such a height would be a challenge for even a Grand Martial Master. For a warrior like Wadi whose meridians were already severed, survival seemed nearly impossible.
Wesley gazed at the steep precipice, took a deep breath, then turned and left along the narrow path.
In fact, Palmer had foreseen the uncertainty of today's battle outcome. There was a possibility that Connor might defeat Wadi.
If Connor emerged victorious, Palmer would lose everything he had. Hence, he couldn't allow such a situation to unfold.
Palmer had arranged for Wesley to wait atop the mountain. Regardless of the victor, Wesley was to eliminate the losing party.
If Connor lost, killing him would eliminate future threats.
If Wadi lost, Wesley would slay him, then frame and implicate Connor. Faris, driven by vengeance, would target him, diverting his attention away from Palmer, ultimately allowing Palmer to escape unscathed.
Of course, the city-wide blackout earlier had been orchestrated by Palmer as well. Since the battle was being live-streamed, he couldn't afford any witnesses to Connor and Wadi's fight details. This way, Wadi's death could be unequivocally pinned on Connor.
Palmer's plan was flawless; regardless of the outcome, he had an escape route.
Just as Wesley departed, Honduria's martial artists arrived to search for Wadi.
However, after scouring the area, they found no trace of him.
Unaware of Wadi's fatal plunge, they assumed he had already left on his own.
Thus concluded today's battle.
News of Connor's victory over Wadi spread across the world in less than half a day.
Henceforth, the name 'Connor or 'Mr. Connor' would be familiar to all martial artists.
As for another shocking revelation, it wasn't long before news of Faris's grandson's death surfaced.
Wadi had fallen beneath Spring Mountain.
Most people attributed this tragedy to Connor. After all, many knew about the fierce battle between Wadi and Connor, and how Connor had emerged victorious and slain Wadi. In the world of warriors, battles had only one outcome: life or death. Numerous warriors met their end in such encounters, so even the police rarely interfered.
Yet, the martial artists of Honduria were well aware that Wadi's death couldn't be that simple.
He was, after all, Faris's grandson!

chapters.title: Chapter 1527: Mr. Connor's Lover
chapters.content:
Chapter 1527: Mr. Connor's Lover
The battle between Connor and Wadi had depleted a significant portion of his energy. Therefore, upon returning to the Dullahan family villa, he immediately lay down on his bed to rest, completely unaware of the events unfolding outside.
When he opened his eyes the next day, he found Waverly and Chieko, two women, standing in his room.
"Why are you two here?" he questioned with a puzzled expression.
"Mr. Connor, how could you be so oblivious?" Waverly exclaimed in desperation.
Hearing her words, he instinctively paused for a moment, then looked at her with confusion. "What are you talking about? How am I being oblivious?"
"Mr. Connor, you shouldn't have killed Wadi. He's Faris's grandson. If you killed him, Faris will undoubtedly seek revenge against us…" Chieko fervently protested.
Connor's body jolted upon hearing this, and he quickly sat up. He stared at Chieko and asked, "What did you say? Wadi is dead?"
"Yes, isn't it you who killed him, Mr. Connor?" She blinked, her expression tinged with doubt.
He briefly recollected the events of the previous night and softly said, "Impossible. Although I defeated Wadi yesterday, he didn't die. Moreover, given Wadi's physical condition, he should have been able to survive..."
"But, Mr. Connor, Wadi was thrown off a cliff and killed. Isn't it possible that you did it?" she continued.
"I met Wadi for the first time, and we had no grudges. Why would I want to kill him?" he explained helplessly.
"Then, what's really going on here?" Chieko's expression became even more perplexed.
Waverly had been observing Connor the whole time. Although she hadn't known him for long, she understood that there was a significant gap between him and ordinary warriors. He didn't seem like the type to resort to lethal means against Wadi.
After all, he had spared the lives of others like Jasper before, instead leaving them with a chance to live.
Upon hearing the news, Waverly already had her doubts.
"Could it be that Wadi, unable to bear the shame of defeat, chose to jump off the cliff?" Chieko innocently asked.
"That's impossible…" Connor shook his head without hesitation, then continued, "When I parted ways with Wadi, he didn't show any signs of wanting to die. Moreover, his meridians were severed; he couldn't even move, let alone jump off a cliff!"
"That's rather strange then," Chieko blinked at Connor.
Connor sat there for a moment, contemplating. He then whispered, "It must be Palmer's doing."
"Why would he want to kill Wadi?" Waverly's expression revealed her confusion.
"Palmer killed Wadi and framed me for it. This way, Faris will take measures against me, and I won't have the resources to deal with him. It's all part of Palmer's plan!" He analyzed calmly.
"Is Palmer really that ruthless?" Chieko's expression showed disbelief.
Waverly also thought Connor's conjecture was reasonable, muttering softly, "Mr. Connor, even if you know Wadi wasn't killed by you, no one outside will believe it, nor will Faris. You must leave Honduria now. It's too dangerous here!"
"If I leave now, it'll give Palmer time to recover. By then, Yelena's situation might become even more perilous. So, I can't leave just yet!" he shouted.
Waverly was at a loss for words as she looked at Connor. While both she and Chieko desperately wanted Connor to leave Honduria, they understood he was too consumed to heed their advice. Trying to persuade him would be futile, so they refrained from saying more.
Waverly, however, was deeply puzzled. She couldn't help but ask Chieko in a hushed voice, "Who exactly is Miss Yelena to Mr. Connor? Why does he hold her in such high regard?"
"I'm not entirely sure, but it seems like she holds significant importance to Mr. Connor. Maybe she's his girlfriend?" Chieko said somewhat enviously.
"Not a girlfriend!" Waverly shook her head without hesitation.
"How can you be so sure?" Chieko looked at Waverly with a puzzled expression.
"Mr. Connor's fiancée is Freya, not Yelena!" Waverly whispered.
Chieko momentarily froze upon hearing this, then said in a subdued tone, "Maybe Yelena is Mr. Connor's lover?"

chapters.title: Chapter 1528: Boundaries
chapters.content:
Chapter 1528: Boundaries
"Lover?"
Upon hearing this, Waverly's face showed a hint of anger. She pouted and muttered, "Men are all the same, not a single good one among them..."
"Men like Connor, even if they have multiple lovers, it's quite normal, isn't it?" Cheiko mused.
As Waverly looked at Cheiko, she couldn't help but be taken aback for a moment. Then she softly asked, "If Connor asked you to be his lover, would you be willing or not?"
"Of course, I would!" Cheiko replied without any hesitation, nodding decisively.
Waverly gave Cheiko a disdainful look.
Cheiko chuckled helplessly and said, "Although I'd be willing, it seems that Connor isn't interested."
Meanwhile, after a brief cleanup, Connor led Cheiko and Waverly towards the location of the Bander family.
...
At the same time, in Honduria, within the Bander family estate.
Though on the surface, the Bander family estate appeared the same as usual, it was actually harboring hundreds of martial arts guards. Even handguns were issued to these guards. They had been brought in overnight from elsewhere by Palmer to ensure his safety.
The senior members of the Bander family were also restricted from leaving. They were effectively under house arrest, not allowed to go outside.
The Bander family was now on a high state of alert.
For so many years, Palmer had never felt such fear and nervousness. He had always considered Connor as his prey, thinking that once Connor entered Honduria, he was as good as dead.
However, he had come to realize just how terrifying an opponent Connor was.
"Yaakov, how dare you deceive me? Are you trying to get me killed?" Palmer angrily shouted into his phone.
"Mr. Palmer, why are you getting so worked up? Connor is just a young brat. Dealing with him should be a straightforward matter, right?" Yaakov's voice sounded calm and composed.
"Mr. Palmer, how could you think of me that way? We've always been on good terms. What benefit would I gain from having Connor get rid of you?" Yaakov asked in a seemingly innocent tone.
"Stop pretending with me. Once I'm done dealing with Connor, I'll settle accounts with you!" Palmer gritted his teeth.
"Haha, sure, I'll be waiting for you!" Yaakov couldn't help but burst into laughter.
Palmer threw his phone to the ground and muttered through clenched teeth, "Yaakov, I'll make sure to get back at you sooner or later..."
Outside the room, Deryn and Eira exchanged helpless glances upon hearing Palmer's outburst. This was the first time they had seen Palmer so agitated in so many years.
"Big sister, Father seems really pushed to his limits this time..." Deryn remarked with a sigh.
"All our shares are currently held in Swiss banks. Once Connor completes the transfer with the bank, the Bander family will truly be left with nothing..." Eira furrowed her brows.
"Is the situation really this dire?" Deryn's expression turned astonished.
"Father believed that Wadi would definitely defeat Connor, which is why he agreed to Connor's challenge initially. It started with a wager of $10 billion, but Connor raised it to $100 billion. Father didn't want to give up on the opportunity, so he staked all our family's assets on the bet. Now, Father has lost..." Eira explained softly.
"Why is Father being so foolish?" Deryn shook her head in disbelief.
"No one could have foreseen just how formidable Connor would turn out to be," Eira sighed and continued, "However, it seems the situation isn't as dire as we imagine. After all, Connor's woman is still in Father's hands, and Connor killed Wadi. Jiang Yifan won't let Connor off easily. So, Father still has a chance to contend with Connor!"
"I never thought this Connor would bring such disaster to our Bander family. We really underestimated him back then!" Deryn said with a furrowed brow.
"Eira,, come in!" Just then, Palmer's voice came from the room, calling Eira inside.
Hearing her father's summons, Eira quickly entered the room. She respectfully inquired, "Father, you called for me? What is it?"
Palmer turned his head to look at her, then said, "Bring the daughter of the Seventh Elder here as well. I need to talk to the two of you."
"Alright..." Eira replied and then left the room.
A few minutes later, Eugenia, accompanied by Eira, entered Palmer's room.
Eugenia was feeling quite nervous at the moment. She had no idea why Palmer had called her here, but she suspected it was related to Connor in some way. Having lived in the Bander family for so many years, this was the first time she had entered Palmer's office.
Palmer, however, was unusually warm towards Eugenia. He smiled and said, "Eugenia, you're becoming more and more beautiful..."
"Thank you for the compliment!" she replied nervously.
"Here's the situation. I've called the two of you here today to discuss something. Are you aware of the wager between Connor and our Bander family?" Palmer asked with a serious expression.
"We are aware," Eira nodded gently.
Eugenia, on the other hand, appeared confused.
"I made a bet with Connor. If he could defeat Wadi, I promised to give him control over all of our family's assets. Now that the results are out, Connor indeed defeated Wadi. Therefore, everything our Bander family possesses might become Connor's at any time," Palmer explained to Eugenia.
Her expression turned extremely incredulous upon hearing this. She had never expected such a wager between Palmer and Connor.
Staring wide-eyed, she couldn't find words to describe her astonishment. She was utterly taken aback and unsure of how to process her current emotions.

chapters.title: Chapter 1529: Beauty Trap
chapters.content:
Chapter 1529: Beauty Trap
Although Eugenia had known for a while that Connor's background was not simple, she never expected it to be so terrifying.
That a single individual could oppose the entire Bander family was truly a frightening concept.
Palmer glanced at Eugenia and then softly asked her, "Eugenia, it seems like you have a good relationship with Connor..."
"I only happened to meet Connor by chance. We don't really have any connection..." she quickly explained.
"Haha..."
Palmer laughed and then said gently, "Eugenia, don't be so nervous. I don't mean anything else. It's our good fortune for you to know Connor!"
"What do you mean?" She appeared puzzled, trying to understand his intentions.
Meanwhile, Eira, who was more perceptive, had already guessed what Palmer wanted to say.
"I'll be straightforward. I've brought you both here today to discuss something. Would you be willing to be given to Connor? Do you want to be his lovers?" Palmer's words were direct and to the point.
"What do you mean by 'given to Connor'?" Eugenia blinked in surprise.
"It means that the two of you would become Connor's mistresses, to serve him well," he clarified even more bluntly.
Eugenia was suddenly frozen in place, unable to comprehend that Palmer's intention was heading in this direction.
Actually, Palmer had already thought through his plan. With Connor being pursued by Faris, he would likely want to leave Honduria as soon as possible due to the danger. Palmer intended to use a seductive approach. He planned to return Yelena to Connor, then offer his own daughter, Eira, and Eugenia to Connor. If that failed, he would compensate Connor with a substantial amount of money.
This way, Connor would be able to rescue Yelena and have beautiful women by his side. Most importantly, Connor could leave Honduria soon, which would be a favorable outcome for him.
Of course, he had one primary objective: to regain control of all the Bander family's shares.
In his view, this transaction wasn't a significant loss for either party. He believed that Connor had no reason to refuse his proposal.
"Eira, what about you?" Palmer turned to Eira and asked.
"Father, as long as it helps you resolve the current crisis, I'm willing to become Connor's lover!" she replied without hesitation.
Eugenia turned to stare at Eira, utterly amazed. She hadn't expected Eira to agree so readily.
However, Eira felt helpless deep down. She realized that she had no choice in the matter.
She had understood from a young age that she was merely a pawn in Palmer's hands, waiting for him to decide when to make use of her.
Even though many people might envy her for being born into such a family and receiving Palmer's attention, only she knew the bittersweet reality.
From a young age, she had come to realize that she had to obey his commands at all times. No matter what he asked her to do, she couldn't refuse.
She knew that one day she would inevitably be given away to someone by Palmer, but it was only a matter of time.
So, she had no choice but to agree readily.
After all, if she were to become Connor's lover, it might actually be better than being given to some old man who was even older than Palmer.
Eugenia, however, couldn't accept this at all. While she did have some feelings for Connor, she couldn't bear the thought of such humiliation.
"Eugenia, what do you think?" Palmer smiled and turned to her.
After hesitating for a moment, she turned to him and shook her head. She said in a calm but resolute tone, "Connor and I are just ordinary friends. I don't want to be his lover."
Palmer chuckled, and then with a gentle smile, he walked over to Eugenia and said, "Eugenia, you're still young, and there are things you may not fully understand. Think about it this way: if our Bander family truly becomes Connor's, what will happen to your parents?"
"My parents?" Eugenia's expression turned perplexed upon hearing this.
"Yesterday, I arranged for your parents to travel abroad on a business trip. If you want to see them again, then it's best you comply with my request. If you become Connor's lover as I suggested, I'll make your parents vice-presidents at our company. By then, nobody in the Bander family will dare to disrespect them. But if you choose not to cooperate, I can't guarantee what might happen..." Palmer's smile remained, but his words carried a clear undertone of threat.
Eugenia was shocked, her eyes widening as she tried to comprehend what Palmer was implying.
She realized that Palmer was serious and capable of doing as he said.
"Master, please spare my parents. I'll do as you ask," Eugenia exclaimed with a mixture of excitement and anxiety.
"Hahaha..."
Palmer laughed heartily as Eugenia agreed, saying, "Eugenia, your words are amusing. How could I possibly harm your parents? As long as you listen to me, I promise they will live a comfortable life..."
While Palmer's laughter echoed, Eugenia was left standing there, stunned by the realization of the extent of Palmer's control over her life.

chapters.title: Chapter 1530: Business Talks?
chapters.content:
Chapter 1530: Business Talks?
"I... I'll definitely comply..." Eugenia clenched her teeth and replied in a low voice.
Although she couldn't accept the situation, she had no choice. Palmer was not someone she could afford to provoke.
"Father!"
Just then, Deryn rushed in.
Palmer raised his head slowly to look at Deryn and asked expressionlessly, "What's going on?"
"Connor is here!" he stammered.
Upon hearing this, Palmer's expression turned somewhat unusual, and he said in a low voice, "I didn't expect Connor to arrive so quickly. Well, this is good. It means he's in a hurry too. Let's go meet him!"
"Father, are you planning to meet Connor?" Deryn's expression showed surprise, and he continued hesitatingly, "Aren't you afraid he might attack you?"
"Connor's enemy is no longer us. He has no interest in dealing with me!" Palmer replied confidently, then walked toward the door.
Eira and Deryn followed closely behind Palmer, and after a moment of hesitation, Eugenia also walked out.
A few minutes later, Palmer and his entourage arrived at the mansion's entrance.
Upon seeing Connor, Palmer hurriedly went forward to greet him, as if he were an old friend he hadn't seen in years. He spoke excitedly, "Mr. Connor, I apologize for not personally welcoming you."
While extending his hand towards Connor, Palmer's gaze fell on Connor's hand, anticipating a handshake.
Connor, however, completely ignored his gesture and said with a straight face, "Don't bother with the fake pleasantries. You must know why I'm here."
"I know, I know..."
He awkwardly withdrew his hand.
"Where is Yelena?" Connor inquired.
"Mr. Connor, let's discuss this inside!" Palmer suggested in a hushed tone.
Connor didn't say much but walked into the Bander family mansion.
A moment later, Connor and Palmer entered a room.
Palmer proactively poured a cup of tea for Connor, then with a smile, he said, "Mr. Connor, this is top-quality tea. Please try it..."
Connor looked at him in a somewhat helpless manner and muttered, "I didn't come here to have tea. Where is Yelena? I want to see her now."
"Connor, why are you so anxious? I wanted to discuss a business deal with you..." He began to say.
"A business deal?" Connor interrupted with a cold smile, "Do you even have the capital to discuss a business deal with me? The entire Bander family is already under my control. What do you have to negotiate with?"
"Connor, your current situation doesn't seem favorable. Wadi is dead..." Palmer said, still trying to keep a jovial tone.
"Wadi was killed by you!" Connor retorted directly.
"Hahaha..."
Palmer burst into laughter upon hearing his words and continued, "Connor, it doesn't matter who killed Wadi anymore. What matters is that everyone believes you killed him. Moreover, the most critical point is that Faris is now preparing to avenge his grandson. Your situation is extremely dangerous!"
Connor's expression slightly darkened at his words. He asked with a hint of irritation, "So, what do you want to tell me?"
Palmer no longer wanted to beat around the bush and directly stated his true intentions.
"Mr. Connor, I can offer you Miss Yelena, and I'm willing to give you my daughter and Eugenia as well. I'm even prepared to offer you a significant sum of money as compensation. However, I have one condition: You must give up all our Bander family's assets!"
After a pause, Palmer continued, "You came to Honduria for Miss Yelena, right? As long as you rescue her, you can leave Honduria, and then Faris won't be able to touch you..."
"Heh..." Connor smiled at him and then calmly said, "I didn't expect you to be concerned about me."
"It's not about confidence. It's because all of the Bander family's assets are now under your control. I genuinely didn't expect you to defeat Wadi..." Palmer felt that the condition he proposed was something Connor wouldn't be able to refuse. Therefore, he was still quite confident.
Connor reached for the teacup on the table and took a sip.
"Mr. Connor, your strength is indeed terrifying. However, there's still a significant gap between you and Faris. That's why the method I'm offering you is the safest way!" he continued.
After a moment of hesitation, Connor smiled and said, "What if I don't want to cooperate with you?"
"If you don't want to cooperate, you might not be able to see Miss Yelena, and you won't be able to leave Honduria either!" he replied expressionlessly.
"You're quite confident, aren't you?" Connor laughed.
"It's not about confidence, but you really have no other choice now!" he replied with a smile.
"That's not my plan..." Connor shook his head at Palmer, then continued, "I don't just want to rescue Yelena. I also want all of your Bander family's assets, and I need to leave Honduria..."
"You won't be able to do that!" Palmer shook his head decisively.
"Heh..." Connor chuckled, then said calmly, "Back before my final showdown with Wadi, weren't you also very confident that I couldn't defeat him? And yet, I defeated him in the end, didn't I? Now you think I can't achieve these things you mentioned. Let me show you whether I can or not!"
After saying this, he stood up and directly grabbed Palmer by the throat.
"What... what are you doing?" Palmer looked at Connor in fear, his expression showing clear unease, and he stammered, "What do you want to do?"
"What do you think I want to do?" Connor coldly chuckled, then continued with a calm tone, "I'll give you a chance. Tell me where Yelena is. If you don't tell the truth, I'll kill you right now!"

chapters.title: Chapter 1531: Well-intentioned
chapters.content:
Chapter 1531: Well-intentioned
"Connor, don't forget that this is our Bander family!"
Palmer shouted loudly.
At that moment, Eugenia, Eria, Deryn, and others rushed into the room upon hearing Palmer's words.
"Connor, it seems like you're tired of living. Let go of my father now!" Deryn shouted with excitement upon witnessing the scene.
Connor paid no attention to Deryn, his expression unchanged, as he asked Palmer, "Where is Yelena?"
"I won't tell you. You won't leave the Bander family today!" Palmer gritted his teeth and replied.
Outside the room, Eugenia shouted, "Someone, help! Quickly!"
"Enough, no need to shout. Your Bander family's subordinates are already defeated. No one can save you now..." Deryn's words were cut short as an elegantly shaped woman entered the room.
This woman was none other than Waverly.
Following behind her were disciples of the Purple Cloud Sect.
In fact, before Connor entered the Bander family estate, he had sensed the ambush. He had instructed Waverly and her team to neutralize the threat.
Now, the Bander family estate was firmly under his control.
"Who are you people?" Deryn's expression turned shocked upon seeing Waverly.
"It doesn't matter who we are," Waverly replied calmly.
Connor continued to grip Palmer's neck tightly. His voice cold, he asked, "Where is Yelena?"
"Connor, even if you kill me today, I won't tell you!" Palmer knew very well that Yelena was his last trump card. Without Yelena, Palmer's fate would be sealed.
Connor's grip on Palmer tightened as he heard these words. Palmer clenched his teeth and continued, "Connor, even if you kill me today, you'll never see that woman again…"
Connor's expression showed a hint of surprise upon hearing Palmer's words.
Waverly approached Connor and said softly, "Mr. Connor, let me handle this. I assure you he'll speak the truth."
Connor glanced at her and said calmly, "Very well, I'll leave it to you."
With that, he released his grip on Palmer's neck.
She led Palmer into another room.
"What do you intend to do with my father?" Deryn's expression turned anxious as he saw Waverly taking Palmer away.
"Smack!"
A disciple of the Purple Cloud Sect slapped Deryn across the face. With an emotionless expression, the disciple said, "You better behave..."
"You dare to hit me?" His eyes widened in disbelief. No one had ever dared to lay a hand on him before.
"Smack!"
The Purple Cloud Sect disciple didn't show any mercy and slapped him again.
"I'll fight you..." Deryn, after being slapped twice, seemed to lose his composure, charging at the Purple Cloud Sect disciple as if he had gone mad.
However, Erin intervened and stopped Deryn, coldly reprimanding him, "Deryn, can't you calm down? Don't you see the situation we're in?"
He hesitated for a moment upon hearing Erin's words. He took a deep breath and looked at the disciples of the Purple Cloud Sect, refraining from taking any further action.
"Ah..."
Just then, a series of agonized screams echoed from the other room. Everyone turned their heads toward the source of the sound.
"Please, don't come near me, I beg you..."
Following that, Palmer's pitiful cries filled the air.
"Ah..."
More screams followed.
Upon hearing Palmer's cries, Deryn and Erin wore grim expressions. They knew they were powerless in this situation.
After about ten minutes, Waverly emerged from the room, dragging Palmer with her. He looked utterly defeated and unrecognizable, a far cry from his former self.
"Mr. Connor, he's cooperative now. Feel free to ask whatever you need," Waverly said softly to Connor.
"Good," Connor nodded slightly and then walked up to him.
"Don't torture me any further. I'll tell you everything. Please, just don't torture me anymore..." Palmer pleaded desperately, his mental state severely compromised.
"Where is Yelena?" Connor's voice was stern.
"Yelena is with Jenna," Palmer replied hastily.
"Where is Jenna?" Connor inquired.
"Jenna is at the Lester family villa," Palmer answered promptly.
"Did you kidnap Yelena at Yaakov's behest?" Connor pressed on.
Palmer's voice quivered as he admitted, "Yes, it was Yaakov who ordered me to do everything. He manipulated me. Without him, I wouldn't have kidnapped Yelena..."
"How did Wadi die?" Connor asked again.
"Wadi was killed by Wesley. I anticipated that you might defeat Wadi, so I had Wesley kill him and frame you..." Palmer's resolve had crumbled entirely.
Connor's cold laughter resonated through the room. "Yaakov, you truly schemed with dedication. Your intentions to harm me run deep."
As the interrogation progressed, Palmer's secrets were laid bare, exposing the manipulations and deceit that had plagued Connor's path. Waverly, an instrument of justice, had unveiled the truth. Now, with the information he needed, Connor's focus shifted to rescuing Yelena from Jenna's clutches.
"Connor, you must rescue Yelena as soon as possible," Waverly said, her eyes filled with determination.
Connor nodded, his resolve hardened. "I won't let anyone harm her. Let's go, Waverly."
"Master, be careful. The Lester family villa may have traps," Waverly warned.
Connor nodded again, and the two of them left the Bai family estate, determined to rescue Yelena and bring an end to this twisted plot.

chapters.title: Chapter 1532: The Cunning Jenna
chapters.content:
Chapter 1532: The Cunning Jenna
After leaving the Bander family, Connor brought Waverly and rushed towards the Lester family.
About an hour later, Connor and Waverly finally found the Lester family's manor.
