For safety reasons, Connor and Waverly didn't enter through the front door. Instead, they climbed over the wall from the back door.
The Lester family's security system was not as comprehensive as the Bander family's, so Connor and Waverly quickly entered Jenna's villa.
It had to be said that Jenna's villa was very luxurious.
All kinds of famous calligraphy and paintings could be seen everywhere.
Connor walked around the villa and found Jenna's room.
After entering the room, Connor didn't see Jenna in the room, but he could hear the sound of running water.
Connor subconsciously glanced at the bathroom. He knew that Jenna was probably taking a shower.
Therefore, Connor didn't rush into the bathroom. Instead, he chose to sit quietly on the sofa and wait for her to come out.
Waverly started to search for Yelena in the villa.
However, she couldn't find Yelena after searching for a long time. In the end, she returned to Connor's side.
Connor sat on the sofa and waited for nearly half an hour before Jenna finally walked out of the bathroom.
At this moment, she didn't know that someone had entered her room, so she walked out naked.
When Connor saw her sexy body, he couldn't help but be stunned. He didn't expect her to have such a perfect figure. Her belly was flat, her breasts were full, and her legs were long and slender.
She also looked at him in disbelief, because she had no idea when he had entered.
"Connor, why are you here?"
" Connor!" Jenna's beautiful face was filled with shock as she shouted at Connor in disbelief.
She was so shocked that she had forgotten that she was not wearing any clothes at all.
"Put on your clothes first!" he shouted.
After hearing his words, she realized that she wasn't wearing any clothes at all. She quickly grabbed a towel and draped it over her chest, then said with an incredulous expression," Connor, why are you here?"
"Hand Yelena over and I won't make things difficult for you!" he said lightly.
"Have you been to the Bander family?"
Jenna blinked and asked in shock.
" I've been there. Palmer told me that Yelena is now in your hands!""
Connor lightly nodded.
Jenna's expression became even more incredulous when she heard this. She knew that Palmer had already set up an inescapable net in the Bander family. Either Connor had chosen to cooperate with Palmer, or he was dead. However, she did not expect him to successfully leave the Bander family. Moreover, Palmer did not inform her to release him, which meant that he had already dealt with those people in the Bander family.
She couldn't understand how he did it!
"How did you leave the Bander family?" She hesitated for a moment before asking him in a low voice.
"How I left has nothing to do with you. Now, you only need to tell me where Yelena is…" he said expressionlessly.
Jenna looked at Connor with a confused expression. She didn't know what to do.
"I forgot to tell you that Palmer has already given up on resisting, so there is no point in continuing to struggle. Since I have already let Palmer go, I will naturally not kill you, but the prerequisite is that you cooperate with me obediently!"
Connor looked at Jenna and continued.
"Impossible, how could Mr. Palmer give up?" she shouted at him.
Jenna knew very well what it would mean if Palmer chose to give up on Yelena.
Palmer would lose everything he had now. Jenna knew his character very well, so she felt that he would never give up.
"If you don't believe me, you can call Palmer now!"
Connor whispered to Jenna.
Jenna hesitated for a moment before reaching out to pick up the phone on the table and making a call.
"Mr. Palmer, Connor is here..."
Jenna said in a low voice.
A few minutes later, she put down her phone with trembling hands and looked at him in disbelief.
At this moment, her eyes were filled with shock, doubt, and a trace of fear.
She had never expected that Palmer would really give up.
She really couldn't understand how Connor did it.
"Since Mr. Palmer has already given up, there's no need for me to continue persisting…"
Jenna looked at Connor and sighed, then continued, "Mr. Connor, please come with me. I'll take you to see Miss Yelena now!"
After hearing her words, he turned to look at Waverly, then walked out of the room.
Jenna was in front, Connor was behind, and Waverly followed behind Connor to help him observe the surroundings.
However, just as Jenna was about to reach the door, she suddenly turned around and picked up a pair of scissors from the dressing table at the door. She threw it at him.
His reaction speed was very fast. He dodged the flying knife with a sidestep.
The throwing knife stabbed into the wall, directly piercing through it.
It could be seen from this slash that Jenna was not a simple woman. She should also be a martial artist. Fortunately, Connor had not let down his guard. Otherwise, the scissors might have pierced through Connor's body.
Jenna was surprised to see Connor dodge the scissors.
Although she knew that his speed was very fast, she did not expect him to be so fast.
"Men, kill the two of them!"
At this moment, the warriors in the villa had already rushed to the corridor in front of Jenna's room.
When those warriors heard her words, they did not hesitate at all. They rushed towards Connor like crazy.
At this time, Connor had not fully recovered from his battle with Wadi.
Therefore, it was still a little troublesome for him to deal with so many martial artists by himself at this time.
More importantly, these martial artists were all holding weapons in their hands.
Almost instantly, the weapons in the hands of these martial artists all slashed towards Connor's position.
He hurriedly took two steps back, dodging these martial artists 'attacks.

chapters.title: Chapter 1533: Grandfather
chapters.content:
Chapter 1533: Grandfather
As Jenna saw Connor dealing with those warriors, she quickly turned and ran towards the downstairs area.
Although the levels of these warriors in front of Connor were not very high, their sheer number made it quite troublesome to handle. Connor had already seen Jenna heading downstairs, but in the current situation, he had no way to catch up.
"Leave these people to me. You go after that woman!" Waverly said.
"Can you handle them?" Connor turned to her and asked softly.
"Don't worry, I can deal with these people without much problem. It'll just take some time!" she replied directly.
"Alright..."
Connor nodded, then kicked one of the warriors in front of him away and immediately chased after Jenna, who had disappeared.
While Waverly was a girl, her cultivation level was at the Black-rank stage, so she found it quite easy to deal with these warriors. She basically sent them flying with a single punch.
Connor didn't have the time to waste on these warriors right now, so he headed straight downstairs.
Jenna, wrapped in a bath towel, rushed out of the villa. She hadn't even had time to put on her shoes. However, this didn't affect her running speed at all. She was well aware that if he caught her, everything would be over.
At this moment, she planned to use Yelena to threaten Connor. Although Palmer had given up resistance, she hadn't. She believed that this was the best opportunity to replace Palmer.
After he lost everything to Connor, it was a significant blow to the Rockefeller family. So, if Jenna could take this chance to snatch back the Bander family from Connor's hands, she could potentially replace Palmer's position.
However, she also understood that her actions were very risky. If she failed, her fate might be even worse than Palmer's.
With these thoughts in mind, her pace quickened noticeably.
It's worth mentioning that her slender and fair legs played a crucial role.
However, after running out of the villa, she didn't choose to run outside the villa but headed straight for the backyard.
After chasing out of the villa, Connor used his Chi Observation Technique to sense her aura and quickly determined her escape direction.
Although he couldn't see her figure at this point, her running had consumed a lot of her energy, so Connor could still judge her direction using the Chi Observation Technique.
Upon reaching the villa's backyard garden, Jenna didn't stop. Instead, she ran to the back door and opened it.
Her villa was nestled against a mountain and by the water, so the back door led directly into the deep mountains.
However, she noticed that Connor was still following closely, so she had only one thought in her mind,to find reinforcements quickly.
"Connor has just been through a big battle. His strength should be significantly weakened. It should be quite easy to defeat him..."
Jenna consoled herself in her mind. She even felt that now was the best opportunity to kill Connor.
So, she deliberately led him in this direction.
Meanwhile, Connor's main focus was to find Yelena quickly, so he had no idea he was falling into Jenna's trap.
Barefoot, Jenna ran through the forest for almost half an hour. Her once-pure white feet were now covered in blood, yet she didn't stop.
Connor, on the other hand, had a much easier time. He could follow Jenna's blood trail to determine her location.
After an unknown amount of time, Jenna finally arrived at the front of a small wooden house.
Seeing the small wooden house, excitement flashed across her face. She pushed the door open and rushed in.
Inside the small wooden house, an old man was sitting on the bed, eyes closed in meditation.
Upon hearing the noise, he slowly opened his eyes and was surprised to see the disheveled Jenna.
The old man's expression showed some astonishment, and he asked with a puzzled tone, "Jenna, why have you come here?"
"Grandfather, someone wants to kill me. Please save me!" Jenna exclaimed in an agitated tone.
"Someone wants to kill you?"
The old man's expression became shocked upon hearing Jenna's words.
And this old man was none other than Jenna's grandfather, Samuel Lester!
Samuel was a well-known martial artist in Honduria. Though he was only at the Black-rank, he held high respect in the martial world. Even Faris would give him some face.
"That's right, this person is named Connor..."
Jenna panted as she spoke.
The old man gave Jenna a faint glance, then said in a calm voice, "Is this Connor related to the girl who's in a coma?"
"Exactly!"
Jenna nodded again and continued, "This Connor is an enemy of the Rockefeller family. He poses a great threat to the Rockefellers. That's why they kidnapped Connor's woman, trying to use her to blackmail him. But Connor came alone to Honduria and defeated people like Jordan and Hadley. Yesterday, he fought with Faris's grandson and killed him!"
"What? Connor actually killed Faris's descendant?"
Samuel's face showed astonishment upon hearing this.
"Yes, this Connor is a merciless killer. Palmer told Connor that the woman is at our Bai family, so Connor intends to kill me. Grandfather, you must save me!"
Jenna recounted everything that had happened recently to Samuel.
After hearing the full story, Samuel's expression became somewhat unusual, and he whispered, "Jenna, although this Connor is indeed a heinous person, I think this situation is your own doing..."
"Grandfather, how can you still speak up for that Connor?" Jenna said with some confusion.
"You kidnapped someone else's friend. Isn't it normal for them to come after you? I think as long as we release Connor's friend now, he shouldn't trouble you further..."
Samuel spoke expressionlessly.

chapters.title: Chapter 1534: I'm Late!
chapters.content:
Chapter 1534: I'm Late!
"But I can't release that woman now!"
Jenna bit her lip and said.
"Why can't you release her?"
Samuel was taken aback, his expression puzzled.
"Kidnapping that girl was a decision from the higher-ups at Rockefeller. We were just following orders. If I release her without authorization, I'd be betraying Rockefeller. Our Lester family might even face extermination!"
Jenna exclaimed emotionally.
"Sigh..."
Samuel sighed and furrowed his brows upon hearing this. He then spoke in a resigned tone, "Actually, I didn't agree with you joining Rockefeller back then, but you were already the head of our Lester family. Since you had made up your mind, I couldn't oppose you. Now, it seems that trouble has come."
"Grandfather, you should know that even though our Lester family comes from a background of ancient martial arts, we haven't produced any other Black-rank martial artists except for you. So, our position in Honduria has been very precarious. Moreover, you chose to go into seclusion. If I hadn't joined Rockefeller, our Lester family might have been divided among other major clans by now. My actions were also to ensure the survival of our Lester family's legacy."
Jenna's expression was full of excitement as she continued, "Grandfather, without Palmer's help over these years, could our Lester family still have maintained such prosperity?"
"It has indeed been difficult for you over these years."
Samuel sighed softly and spoke helplessly.
"Grandfather, this is the best opportunity for our Lester family. Although Connor's strength is terrifying, he's currently heavily injured. If you can kill Connor, it would be a huge advantage for our Lester family. We might even be able to replace the Bander family's position!"
Jenna seized the opportunity to persuade.
"Replace the Bander family's position?"
Samuel was taken aback upon hearing this.
"Grandfather, I know that you've always wanted our Lester family to become the number one clan in Honduria. Now, the opportunity is right in front of us. You must seize it!"
Jenna continued to insist.
After a moment of hesitation, Samuel said in a low voice, "Fine, fine. Perhaps this is fate. Let this old man lend a hand once again!"
"Great! Grandfather, you're finally willing to take action!"
Jenna's face was filled with excitement upon hearing Samuel's agreement.
For her, everything was riding on Samuel's actions. If he could kill Connor, Jenna would replace Palmer, and the Lester family would replace the Bander family. This opportunity was truly rare and valuable in her eyes.
"Take me to meet this Connor."
Samuel sighed softly and began walking toward the door.
A little while later, Samuel and Jenna arrived outside the cabin, just as Connor happened to arrive.
Seeing Samuel next to Jenna, Connor couldn't help but chuckle and said lightly, "I was wondering why you ran in this direction. So, you went to fetch reinforcements, huh?"
"Connor, the person you're looking for isn't here. You better leave quickly, or don't blame me for being rude!"
Jenna glared at Connor with her watery eyes.
"If the person I'm looking for isn't here, then why did you run? Besides, Palmer has already given up resistance. I don't think he'd lie to me. He told me the woman is at our Bander family. So, why did you run?" Connor replied with a faint smile.
Samuel sized up Connor and said calmly, "Young man, Youling didn't lie to you. The person you're looking for is indeed not here at our Lester family. It's best if you leave now."
After casting a glance at Samuel, Connor replied expressionlessly, "I'm not in the mood to waste time with you all. As long as you hand over Yelena, I'll let everything that happened before slide. But if you're not planning to cooperate, then I'll have to resort to some other methods."
"Our Lester family is not a place where you can cause a scene. Let me warn you one last time. If you don't leave, don't blame me for being impolite!"
Samuel warned Connor in a low voice.
"Being impolite? What difference does that make?"
Connor chuckled upon hearing Samuel's words and said lightly, "Old man, how impolite you are won't change anything."
"Young man, today I'll show you that our Lester family isn't easy to mess with!"
Samuel was well aware that a battle was inevitable today. Thus, he didn't waste any more words and charged toward Connor's direction.
Seeing Samuel approaching, Connor's expression turned slightly tense.
After all, his body hadn't fully recovered yet, so he wasn't sure if he could match Samuel's strength.
Samuel's right hand transformed into a palm as he struck directly toward Connor's chest.
However, Connor didn't choose to dodge. He stood his ground without moving.
But in the next second, a figure rushed to Connor's side and launched a punch toward Samuel.
"Boom!"
A loud sound rang out.
Samuel was pushed back several steps, while the person in front of Connor remained motionless.
"Junior Sect Leader, sorry for being late!"
The elderly man in front of Connor turned to him and spoke softly after blocking the punch.
"Second Elder, you didn't leave?"
Connor expressed surprise.
Connor knew that the Second Elder of the Purple Cloud Sect had arrived, so the person in front of him had to be the Second Elder.
"Young Sect Leader, you haven't left Honduria safely yet. Naturally, I couldn't leave either..."
The Second Elder replied with a smile.
"Thank you, Second Elder."
Connor said with a faint smile.
For him, the arrival of the Second Elder was undoubtedly a timely assistance.
"Who are you? Don't meddle in our affairs!"
Jenna, looking at the elderly man in front of Connor, asked with an agitated expression.
"I am the Second Elder of the Purple Cloud Sect."
The old man replied in a calm tone.
"You're from the Purple Cloud Sect?"
Samuel's expression showed even more shock upon hearing this.
Samuel had some past interactions with the Purple Cloud Sect's members.

chapters.title: Chapter 1535: At Your Will
chapters.content:
Chapter 1535: At Your Will
"Indeed, this is our Purple Cloud Sect's Junior Sect Leader. I advise you to be sensible and hand over the person to me. This way, you might suffer a little less!"
The Second Elder chuckled as he spoke to Samuel.
"Our affairs in Honduria don't need your Purple Cloud Sect to meddle. If you want to take that person today, you'll have to pass me first!"
Samuel shouted expressionlessly.
"In that case, don't mind me…"
The Second Elder didn't waste any more words and charged toward Samuel.
Samuel quickly retreated two steps, but the Second Elder's speed was astonishingly fast. In almost the blink of an eye, he had reached Samuel.
"Boom!"
A loud sound echoed.
The Second Elder's fist struck Samuel's chest forcefully, sending him flying. He crashed heavily into a nearby tree.
Upon witnessing this, Jenna's expression turned tense. She shouted loudly, "Grandfather, are you okay?"
"I'm fine…"
Samuel replied softly, then gritted his teeth and got back on his feet.
At this moment, Samuel realized the terrifying strength of the Second Elder.
"Feel my punch!"
Although Samuel understood the gap in strength, he seemed unwilling to give up. He charged toward the Second Elder once again, raising his fist to strike at the Second Elder's head.
The Second Elder's expression held a trace of disdain. He casually flicked his right hand toward Samuel's attack.
Samuel sensed the formidable power behind the Second Elder's strike and quickly retracted his punch, using his arm to block above his head, seemingly preparing to bear the brunt of the attack.
"Boom!"
Another loud sound.
The Second Elder's palm shattered Samuel's arm as it struck.
Samuel dropped to his knees in pain, his face contorted in agony.
Connor, observing this scene, was also shocked. He hadn't anticipated the Second Elder's strength to be this terrifying. After all, Samuel was also a Black-rank martial artist, yet he proved utterly defenseless against the Second Elder.
Even Jenna, despite only having exchanged a couple of moves, realized that Samuel was no match for the Second Elder.
"I told you already, you're no match for me. Why subject yourself to such suffering?"
The Second Elder sighed helplessly.
"I haven't lost yet!"
Samuel gritted his teeth and yelled, preparing to continue fighting.
"Grandfather, please don't continue!"
However, at this moment, Jenna shouted desperately.
She knew that if he kept fighting, it would be a one-way path to death.
Samuel turned his head to look at Jenna, then slowly closed his eyes and muttered, "Perhaps this is fate. Even if the position of Honduria's number one family changes, it won't be our turn, the Lester family."
After a brief hesitation, Jenna knelt in front of Connor and whispered, "Mr. Connor, I surrender. I hope you can spare my grandfather and me."
He glanced at her calmly upon hearing her words.
Taking a deep breath, she mustered the courage to speak to Connor, "Mr. Connor, as long as you spare my grandfather, I'm willing to do whatever you ask."
"Whatever I ask?"
Connor couldn't help but chuckle upon hearing her words. He clearly understood the implications of Jenna's offer.
The Second Elder also understood and turned his head away, as if signaling to Connor that he hadn't heard anything or seen anything.
Seeing the Second Elder's reaction, Connor smiled and walked up to Jenna.
She deliberately struck a provocative pose, her seductive figure fully exposed to him. Part of the towel she had draped around her had slipped off, revealing her ample bosom, making for a captivating yet bittersweet sight.
She was well aware that her body was her greatest asset. In the presence of her enticing figure, almost no man could resist, and she was confident in her allure.
"I'm not interested in you. Hand over all of your family's assets to me and tell me where Yelena is. Then, I might spare you."
Connor spoke softly to Jenna.
"Our family's assets?"
Jenna was momentarily taken aback by Connor's words, and her expression showed a hint of reluctance. After all, she had worked hard for many years to accumulate the Lester family's assets.
"Mr. Connor, from now on, I'll be your servant. I'll do whatever you want. Is that okay?"
Jenna pleaded with Connor.
"What use do I have for a servant like you?"
Connor replied casually.
Jenna was left speechless by his response. She had never imagined that her charming demeanor would be of no value in his eyes. Taking a deep breath, she continued, "Mr. Connor, if I hand over all of our family's assets to you, will you spare me?"
"That's right!"
He nodded gently.
Jenna bit her lip and fell silent for a couple of seconds. Then, she slowly stood up and said, "Mr. Connor, please follow me. I'll sign a contract with you right away."
"Not with me, but with the Second Elder."
Connor turned to the Second Elder and spoke calmly.
He didn't actually need more money. He already had ample wealth, and now that he essentially controlled the entire Bander family, their assets meant little to him. However, Purple Cloud Sect was in need of resources, and the timely intervention of Guan Wen and the Second Elder was a significant factor in quickly bringing Palmer and Jenna to submission. Connor wanted to repay their efforts, which is why he decided not to let them go unrewarded.
"Junior Sect Leader, is this really appropriate?"
The Second Elder feigned concern as he addressed Connor.
"There's nothing inappropriate about it. This amount of money means nothing to me. My Master has been absent and hasn't managed the sect's affairs. Consider this a reward for the help you and the others have provided. There's no need to contribute it to the sect!"
Connor's tone was even and composed.

chapters.title: Chapter 1536: Carefree Pill
chapters.content:
Chapter 1536: Carefree Pill
Upon hearing Connor's words, the Second Elder's expression revealed a hint of excitement. He looked at Connor, unsure of how to express his gratitude.
In theory, martial artists like the Second Elder shouldn't lack money. When they reached their level of cultivation, they would be treated as honored guests wherever they went, and money was merely a number to them.
However, the elders of Purple Cloud Sect needed to manage the sect's affairs within the sect itself. Purple Cloud Sect didn't rely on any major family, so they lacked their own economic sources. Supporting a large number of disciples was financially demanding, and the practice of martial arts required a significant amount of medicinal herbs, which added to their expenses.
This situation meant that while the elders of Purple Cloud Sect seemed glamorous on the surface, they still had concerns about money. After all, the sect's funds were used to train disciples, and the elders also needed resources to improve their own cultivation.
Therefore, the Second Elder was genuinely excited when Connor mentioned distributing the Bander family's assets among the elders. This act would greatly benefit Purple Cloud Sect.
In contrast, a trace of envy flickered in Jenna's eyes. She was beginning to regret her choices. If she had chosen to betray Rockefeller when Connor first arrived in Honduria, she might be in a better situation like Chieko and Second Elder.
"Where is Yelena?"
Connor approached Jenna and softly asked her.
Jenna hesitated for a moment and then whispered, "Mr. Connor, please follow me…"
Connor and the Second Elder followed Jenna into the depths of the mountains.
After about half an hour, Jenna stopped in front of a cave and turned to Connor, saying, "Mr. Connor, Miss Yelena is inside here!"
He entered the cave immediately upon hearing this.
"Junior Sect Leader, I'll go ahead!"
The Second Elder was worried about possible ambushes in the cave, so he stepped in front of Connor and said in a low voice.
He didn't refuse. He knew that the Second Elder's cultivation level was higher, making it safer for him to lead the way.
Inside the cave, he noticed that it was well-lit with candles, and there didn't seem to be any ambushes.
Moments later, he finally saw Yelena lying on a stone bed. However, she was unconscious, her eyes shut tightly.
Seeing her condition, a tint of anger and remorse washed over him. He knew that her current state was a result of his actions.
He approached her and called out softly, "Yelena, I'm here to save you!"
Yelena remained unresponsive on the stone bed.
Connor gently touched her small hand, feeling a chilling coldness.
"What's going on?"
Instantly, his expression turned angry. He turned to Jenna and asked, "Do you have an antidote?"
"Mr. Connor, Miss Yelena was already like this when she arrived. I have no idea what happened. How could I have an antidote?!"
Jenna's expression was one of helplessness as she answered.
"Does Palmer have an antidote?"
Connor continued to inquire.
"I'm not sure..."
She shook her head in response.
"Junior Sect Leader, there's no need to worry. Even if these people don't have the antidote, it's okay. The Carefree Pill isn't a highly poisonous substance. Finding an antidote is relatively simple. Our Purple Cloud Sect can refine the antidote!"
The Second Elder reassured Connor.
"I see."
Connor sighed with relief upon hearing the Second Elder's explanation.
Connor picked Yelena up and turned to Jenna, instructing her, "Go sign the contract with the Second Elder now. Transfer all the assets under your name to him. Once you've sorted the rest, the Second Elder can come and collect them. I hope you won't try any tricks. This is your last chance."
"I won't, I won't..."
Jenna quickly nodded in agreement.
He didn't say more and carried Yelena out of the cave.

chapters.title: Chapter 1537: The Car Broke Down
chapters.content:
Chapter 1537: The Car Broke Down
Half an hour later, Jenna had signed the contract with the Second Elder. Connor, accompanied by Waverly and others, carried Yelena and left the Lester family villa, heading to the Bander family to obtain the antidote.
The car sped along the highway, and Connor continued to look down at Yelena in his arms.
His heart was filled with guilt and self-blame. He regretted deeply getting involved in her life. While he had indeed changed her fate and helped her achieve her dreams, he had also brought significant danger into her life.
It seemed that everyone around him was influenced by him, but at the same time, they were exposed to great risks.
Sitting beside Connor, Waverly couldn't help but examine Yelena closely. This was her first time seeing Yelena, and she had always been curious about the woman who had captured Connor's heart to the point of disregarding his own safety. However, upon seeing Yelena, she couldn't help but feel a hint of disappointment. Not because Yelena wasn't beautiful, but perhaps she didn't appear as exceptional as she had expected.
"Connor, I've been waiting for you!"
Just then, a voice echoed in the minds of everyone present.
Upon hearing the voice, he looked up abruptly, glancing at the road ahead, only to find it empty.
Both the Second Elder and Waverly seemed to have heard the voice as well, their expressions tensed.
"Second Elder, did you also hear that voice just now?" Connor asked the Second Elder in a low voice.
"Sect Leader McDonald, it's not good. It's likely Faris coming!" The Second Elder realized what was happening and hurriedly shouted, instructing the driver, "Turn the car around quickly!"
Although the driver didn't fully understand the situation, he didn't dare to defy the Second Elder's command. He quickly turned the steering wheel to head back.
"Bang! Bang! Bang!"
However, just at that moment, all four wheels of the car suddenly burst, causing the vehicle to come to a halt in the middle of the road.
Passing cars narrowly avoided colliding with Connor's car due to their high speeds.
"We're out of time," the Second Elder exclaimed, his expression turning desperate upon realizing the car was immobilized.
"Second Elder, what should we do now?" Waverly's eyes revealed fear, and she anxiously asked the Second Elder.
Taking a deep breath, the Second Elder whispered to her, "Waverly, take Sect Leader McDonald and run. I'll try to delay them."
"Alright..." She nodded quickly, then opened the car door and turned to Connor, urging, "Sect Leader McDonald, please get out of the car!"
Connor understood that he might not stand a chance against Faris, especially with his current injuries. He had no hesitation and immediately carried Yelena out of the car.
Once out of the car, she led him towards the roadside, running for safety.
"Bang!"
"Bang!"
However, just as he stepped out of the car, two powerful auras flew towards him and Waverly.
Before they could even react, both of them were sent flying.
"Cough, cough..."
Connor felt as though he had been hit by a truck. His face contorted in pain.
Yelena slipped from his arms and fell to the ground.
Struggling with all his strength, he managed to stand up. He picked up Yelena and, upon confirming that she was unharmed, his tense expression relaxed somewhat.
"Connor, I've finally found you," the voice echoed once more.
Abruptly turning around, he saw an elderly man in white hemp clothing walking towards him with unsteady steps.
Although he had never seen this man before, he recognized him as Wadi's grandfather, Faris.
Moments later, Faris reached Connor and rasped, "You should know who I am, right?"
"Mr. Faris, Wadi was not killed by Mr. Connor!" Waverly exclaimed with emotion.
Faris turned his gaze toward Waverly without speaking.
"Mr. Faris, your grandson was not killed by me. It was Palmer..." Connor gritted his teeth and explained.
"He wanted to frame me. He admitted it himself!" Connor added.
"He did? Do you have evidence?" Faris asked calmly.
"I have evidence, but I don't have it with me right now!" he quickly replied.
Connor had recorded Palmer's confession on Chieko's phone, but unfortunately, Chieko wasn't with him at the moment.
"No need. I'm not a detective. I don't have the mood to investigate whether what you say is true or false. Palmer told me that you killed Wadi, and now you're telling me that he killed Wadi. So today, I'll just kill the two of you to avenge my grandson..."
Faris's voice was low as he responded.
Upon hearing his words, a look of despair filled Connor's face. He hadn't anticipated that Faris would be so unreasonable.
At this moment, Connor couldn't fathom Faris's emotions. Wadi represented Fris's greatest hope in life. Faris was well aware that he might not make significant progress anymore, and he might never be able to break through to the level of a Heaven-rank grandmaster. Therefore, he had placed all his hopes on Wadi.
Wadi's innate martial talent was astonishing, having already reached the Black-rank at a young age. If he continued to practice diligently, he might even become a Heaven-rank grandmaster.
It was important to note that whether on the mainland or in Honduria, there had never been a Heaven-rank grandmaster before. The last time a Heaven-rank martial artist emerged was two hundred years ago.
Anyone who managed to become a Heaven-rank grandmaster would truly be considered the top martial artist in all of Oprana.
Initially, Jorge had been the most likely candidate to become a Heaven-rank grandmaster. However, decades had passed since he had reached the Earth Stage, and there were still no signs of him making a breakthrough. Similarly, the leaders of the other three major sects were all Earth Stage Grandmasters. It seemed like their chances for further advancement had been exhausted.
Many believed that Faris's determination was to surpass Jorge. However, his true goal was to become the number one martial artist in Oprana.
Since he might have lost hope for himself, he had placed all his aspirations onto his grandson.
But he never expected that his grandson's debut battle would result in defeat and an inexplicable death.
This shattered all the hopes and dreams Faris had vested in Wadi. It was this utter despair that compelled Faris, regardless of his status as a Grandmaster, to prepare for a bloodbath.

chapters.title: Chapter 1538: The Battle
chapters.content:
Chapter 1538: The Battle
"Mr. Faris, as a Grandmaster of ancient martial arts in Honduria, is it appropriate for you to target a junior like this?"
At this moment, a calm voice slowly echoed.
Faris turned his head to see that the speaker was none other than the Second Elder.
"Who are you?" Faris asked the Second Elder in a low voice.
"I am the Second Elder of the Purple Cloud Sect. If you intend to harm Sect Leader McDonald, you'll have to get through me first," the Second Elder said, striding towards Connor.
"You're just a mere Black-rank martial artist, yet you dare to stand in my way? You truly don't know your own limitations!" Faris coldly snorted with disdain.
Although the gap between Black-rank martial artists and Heaven-rank Grandmasters was substantial, with Black-rank being a level below Heaven-rank, Faris, even as a high-level Black-rank martial artist, was no match for a Grandmaster like Faris.
"Protecting Sect Leader McDonald is my duty. Although I may not be your match, I am willing to stand my ground. If I can delay you, then I've done my part," the Second Elder calmly replied.
"Haha, I appreciate your sincerity if you put it that way. Since you insist on stopping me, I'll give you a chance. I'll use only thirty percent of my strength. If you manage to defeat me today, I'll spare this young man's life a bit longer," Faris said casually.
"Thank you, Mr. Faris," the Second Elder responded, not hesitating. Faris's claim of using only thirty percent of his strength gave him some hope of success.
"Proceed!" Faris said, his tone casual.
Without hesitation, the Second Elder stepped forward and attacked Faris.
"Boom!"
A deafening sound echoed through the air. The Second Elder's fist struck Faris's chest forcefully.
Connor felt as if the earth trembled for a moment.
However, Faris remained standing in place, his expression surprisingly calm.
A trace of astonishment flickered in the Second Elder's eyes as he looked at Faris. He knew that Faris wouldn't go back on his word about using only thirty percent of his strength. Despite being a Black-rank martial artist, Faris was a Grandmaster and wouldn't break his promise over such matters.
What the Second Elder couldn't fathom was that Faris, using only thirty percent of his strength, could withstand his full-force blow.
This left him wondering just how terrifying Faris's strength would be if he used his full power.
"A Grandmaster of ancient martial arts truly lives up to his reputation," the Second Elder silently marveled.
Although the Second Elder was a senior member of the Purple Cloud Sect and had encountered numerous martial artists, this was his first time facing a Grandmaster. He was deeply shocked.
"Do you have only this much strength?" Faris asked with disdain.
"Try again!" The Second Elder roared, raising his fist and striking Faris's chest once more.
However, the result was the same as before – Faris remained immovable.
A hint of despair appeared in the Second Elder's eyes. He was at a loss for words to describe his feelings at this moment. He found Faris's terrifying resilience simply unbelievable. Faris's physical attributes had reached a level that defied comprehension.
Just as the Second Elder was still in shock, Faris suddenly raised his leg and kicked toward the Second Elder.
"Second Elder, be careful!" Waverly couldn't help but shout.
The Second Elder's expression turned wary, and he quickly retreated.
In the blink of an eye, the Second Elder had retreated several meters.
Faris's kick had missed the Second Elder's target.
Connor stood at a distance, watching their battle with a mix of shock and awe. He knew Faris was formidable, but he had never witnessed such a high-level battle before.
Waverly leaned toward Connor and whispered, "Mr. Connor, let's take this chance to escape."
"What about the Second Elder?" He hesitated.
"He will find a way to escape on his own. Right now, staying here only hinders us," she urged.
Upon hearing her words, he hesitated for a moment before nodding subtly. He turned to leave, hoping to escape while Faris was occupied.
However, just as they were about to leave, a surge of energy shot toward them. It struck Waverly's right leg, causing her to cry out in pain and collapse.
"Are you alright, Waverly?" he anxiously asked.
"Mr. Connor, I'm fine..." She gritted her teeth and replied, though the impact had left her unable to move her right leg.
"I advise you both to behave, or I will kill both of you now!" Faris declared, his expression cold.
Connor's heart sank upon hearing these words. He realized that he had no chance of escape now and could only hope that the Second Elder could do something to save them.
Meanwhile, the battle between the Second Elder and Faris intensified. The clash of their blows sent shockwaves through the air.
Although he was using only thirty percent of his strength, his overwhelming power was evident. The Second Elder struggled to keep up.
"Boom!"
At one point, the Second Elder's fist landed on his chest, but he retaliated with an equally powerful strike. However, the outcome was vastly different.
While he remained firmly rooted in place, the Second Elder was sent flying and crashed onto the road below.
Connor's gaze fixed on the fallen Second Elder. He could see that the Second Elder's chest had caved in, indicating that Faris's punch had shattered his ribs.
Despite his injuries, the Second Elder coughed and managed to rise to his feet.

chapters.title: Chapter 1539: Defeat Your Master!
chapters.content:
Chapter 1539: Defeat Your Master!
"Now, even if I use thirty percent of my power, you still won't be my match. Give up already!" Faris said expressionlessly to the Second Elder.
Upon hearing Faris's words, the Second Elder smiled faintly and retorted coldly, "I've already said it before, my duty is to protect Sect Leader McDonald's safety. So, if you want to kill him, you'll have to kill me first!"
"Ignorant fool!" Faris's expression showed disdain, and his tone was contemptuous.
The Second Elder took a deep breath and began to circulate the energy within his body.
After a few seconds, his skin gradually turned golden.
Seeing this, Faris's expression showed some surprise, and he murmured, "You actually practice the Mystic Ascetic Refining Technique?"
"If I didn't have some skill, how could I dare stand in your way!" the Second Elder responded in a low voice, then continued to charge towards Faris.
This time, his speed was noticeably much faster than before, and his aura had changed significantly.
Connor turned his head and asked Waverly in a hushed tone, "What's the Mystic Ascetic Refining Technique?"
"The Mystic Ascetic Refining Technique is the unique skill of our Purple Cloud Sect. It allows a martial artist's body to become as tough as a diamond. The Second Elder's mastery of this technique has reached its highest level, making his physical strength comparable to that of a Grandmaster. With the use of this technique, and considering Faris is only using thirty percent of his strength, the Second Elder still has a good chance of defeating him," Waverly explained.
"I see." He nodded lightly, his attention focused on the battle between Faris and the Second Elder.
It was evident that the Mystic Ascetic Refining Technique had significantly enhanced the Second Elder's combat strength. Although he had been at a disadvantage against Faris earlier, he was now gaining the upper hand.
"The duration of the Mystic Ascetic Refining Technique is quite short. If the Second Elder can't defeat Faris before the technique ends, he will definitely lose," she whispered.
"I hope the Second Elder can defeat Faris," he replied under his breath.
"Take this punch!" Suddenly, the Second Elder shouted and raised his fist, striking powerfully towards Faris's chest.
This punch was exceptionally powerful, like a bomb about to explode.
"A boom!"
A loud sound echoed as the Second Elder's fist struck Faris's chest.
Surprisingly, Faris took three steps back to steady himself.
Before, the Second Elder had been unable to budge Faris no matter how much force he used. However, this punch had made him take three steps back, revealing the terrifying power of the Mystic Ascetic Refining Technique.
The Second Elder's face showed a hint of helplessness. Even though he had used all his strength for that punch, it hadn't achieved the desired effect. Though it forced Faris back, it was clear that this level of attack wouldn't defeat him.
"That punch you just threw was somewhat interesting," Faris smiled at the Second Elder.
The Second Elder remained cautious, silently watching him without saying a word.
"Alright, it's about time to end this," Faris sighed softly, then his figure flashed, appearing directly in front of the Second Elder. He raised his right hand and struck his chest with a fierce punch.
Although this punch from Faris seemed ordinary, its power was astonishing.
"Thud!"
A loud noise resonated as his fist seemed to hit a bronze bell, emitting an eerie sound.
The Second Elder's expression changed, and he was sent flying, crashing down some dozens of meters away before coming to a stop.
"Second Elder!" Connor shouted loudly and rushed to the Second Elder's side.
"Spurt…"
The Second Elder spat out a mouthful of blood, and the golden color on his body gradually faded.
"Second Elder, are you alright?" Connor asked anxiously.
"Sect Leader McDonald, I apologize. I am powerless; I couldn't protect you," the Second Elder weakly said to Connor.
"Second Elder, don't say that. Please hold on, you can't die, do you hear me?" Connor nervously replied.
"Don't worry, I haven't used my full strength just now. He won't die," Faris said calmly as he approached, reassuring Connor.
Connor glanced at Faris and gritted his teeth. "Don't continue fighting. I admit defeat. As long as you spare them three, I'll let you do whatever you want today."
"Sect Leader McDonald!" Waverly shouted upon hearing Connor's words.
"Shut up!" Connor scolded her, then turned to Faris and said, "Did you hear what I said? As long as you let them go, you can kill me if you want."
"Kill me?" He suddenly looked at Connor and sneered. Then, he calmly stated, "I've changed my mind!"
"Changed your mind?" Connor was bewildered by Faris's words. "What do you mean?"
"My original plan was to kill you to avenge my grandson, and then leave Oprana to find a place to live in seclusion. But now, I suddenly feel like there's one more thing I haven't done," Faris said slowly.
"What is it?" Connor asked.
"I haven't defeated your Master yet," Faris replied in a low voice.
"Defeat my Master?" Connor's expression showed surprise.
"Yes, I've always wanted to become the number one martial artist in Oprana. But unfortunately, I met your Master, and at that time, I was too naive and dared to challenge him with only my high-level Profound Stage strength. In the end, I lost to him. That became the biggest regret of my life. Since I'm still alive and I've already tangled with your Purple Cloud Sect, I might as well take this opportunity to challenge Jorge once again. If I can defeat your Master, then I'll have no more regrets in this life," Faris explained.
After finishing his words, Faris turned his gaze toward Yelena and asked calmly, "I heard that you risked your life to come to Honduria because of this woman, right?"

chapters.title: Chapter 1540: The Battle Between Grandmasters
chapters.content:
Chapter 1540: The Battle Between Grandmasters
"Correct..." Connor nodded, his expression puzzled.
"Alright then. I'll take this woman with me now, and I'll give you one day to contact your Master. Tell him to come to Spring Mountain tomorrow at noon for a battle against me. If I don't see your Master tomorrow, I will kill you. If your Master comes tomorrow, regardless of the outcome, I will spare you. How does that sound?" Faris said expressionlessly to Connor.
"This matter has nothing to do with Yelena. Can you just take me instead?" Connor hastily pleaded.
"If I take you, who will contact your Master?" Faris retorted coldly.
He hesitated for a moment, then said softly, "I can't contact my Master either..."
"Then that's your problem, and it has nothing to do with me!" Faris replied indifferently. He then picked up Yelena and turned to leave.
Connor instinctively tried to stop him, but with a wave of his hand, Connor was pushed back by his aura.
In the end, Connor, Waverly, and the Second Elder could only watch as Faris took Yelena away.
Connor couldn't believe that he had just rescued Yelena from Rockefeller's clutches, only to have her taken by Faris. While Connor might have had a chance against Rockefeller's forces, facing Faris, he felt utterly hopeless. He had no idea how to deal with this new threat.
"Sect Leader McDonald, what do we do now?" Waverly anxiously asked Connor.
"Take the Second Elder to the hospital now. The rest isn't your concern," he replied in a low voice. He took out his phone and dialed Thomas's number.
"Ring... Ring..."
After a couple of rings, Thomas answered the call. "Mr. Connor, what can I do for you?"
"Thomas, go see my Master immediately. Tell him to come to Honduria as soon as possible!" Connor said urgently.
Thomas sensed Connor's urgency and agreed, "I understand. I'll go find Master Jorge right away. Don't worry, Mr. Connor."
After hanging up, Connor's face showed extreme despair. He had thought that the situation in Honduria had been resolved, especially after dealing with Rockefeller's people. But Faris's appearance had thrown him into a dire situation once again.
Feeling utterly powerless, he had no idea what to do to face Faris.
Time passed quickly, and a day went by.
The crowd that had previously gathered to watch Connor's battle with Wadi had once again assembled beneath Spring Mountain. This time, it consisted mostly of martial artists, with very few ordinary people present.
The news of Faris challenging Jorge had spread rapidly in the martial arts world. Both Faris and Jorge were renowned grandmasters in the martial arts community, and such figures were rarely seen nowadays. Their challenge was like a battle of legends, garnering the attention of martial artists from far and wide.
"What a surprise, so many people have come!"
"Yeah, it seems they've all received the news..."
"I was actually planning to leave, but I didn't expect Mr. Faris to challenge Mr. Jorge. This is so thrilling! If these two really start fighting, Spring Mountain might be flattened!"
"Absolutely. The number of martial artists is dwindling, and such clashes between grandmasters, let alone ancient martial arts grandmasters, have become extremely rare. It's an honor for us to witness this battle."
As a short while passed, another day had gone by.
The spectators who had come to watch Connor and Wadi's battle had gathered once again beneath Spring Mountain. However, this time, the crowd was composed mostly of martial artists, as word had quickly spread through the martial arts community.
Faris's challenge to Jorge had generated enormous interest, drawing the attention of martial artists from all corners. The opportunity to witness a battle between two grandmasters was exceedingly rare, and many had traveled far to witness this historic event.
Amidst the excited chatter of the crowd, anticipation and tension filled the air as they awaited the upcoming battle between two legendary figures.

chapters.title: Chapter 1541: Familiar Spectators
chapters.content:
Chapter 1541: Familiar Spectators
At this moment, a white-haired old man sighed.
"Although Grandmaster Jimenez lost to Grandmaster Yarrell last time, I wonder who will win this time!"
"That's right. I think that since Grandmaster Jimenez dared to challenge Grandmaster Yarrell, it means that Grandmaster Jimenez is definitely going to win…" a middle-aged man analyzed in a low voice.
"Grandmaster Yarrell was a famous martial artist in Oprana back then. He was already an ancient martial arts grandmaster before the age of thirty. He also represented Oprana and challenged the grandmasters of many countries, but was never defeated. Although he retired later, I think Grandmaster Yarrell's chances of winning this battle should be higher…" another martial artist analyzed.
"It's still not certain who will win this battle!"
The old man said expressionlessly.
Everyone did not say anything else as they walked up the mountain.
At the same time, a few young men and women followed behind these martial artists.
"Harold, where are you taking us?"
A beautiful girl in a white spaghetti skirt asked the boy beside her with a puzzled expression.
This girl was none other than Sadie Colt.
Sabrina Ziegler, Harold Phillips, Sheldon Statton and Henny Kirby were also present.
Originally, these people came to Honduria for fun. However, Harold somehow learned that there would be a duel between ancient martial arts masters at noon today, so he changed his schedule and brought them to Spring Mountain.
"You'll know it later. Let me tell you, we've made the right choice to come to Honduria this time. We can even watch a battle between ancient masters."
Harold said proudly.
"A battle between ancient martial arts grandmasters?"
When Henny heard this, his expression became a little excited.
"That's right, it's a battle between Ancient Martial Grandmasters!"
Harold nodded.
"What do these battles entail?"
Sadie asked with a puzzled expression. Although she knew about the existence of martial artists, she did not know much about ancient martial arts grandmasters.
Harold hesitated for a moment before saying, "Let me put it this way. You should know about martial artists, right?"
"I do!"
Sadie nodded gently.
"Then it'll be easier to explain. In fact, martial artists themselves have different strength levels. Simply put, the more powerful a martial artist is, the higher their level is. The rank of ancient martial arts grandmaster is the highest level amongst existing martial artists, so the battle we're going to watch later is a battle between the two most powerful ones!"
Harold said slowly.
"The battle between the two most powerful fighters?"
Sadie was shocked when she heard this.
"Harold, I heard that ancient martial arts grandmasters are very rare. Their cultivation is only one step away from the Heaven realm. Usually, we can't even see them, let alone a battle between ancient martial arts grandmasters," Sheldon asked after a moment of hesitation.
"You'll know later!"
Harold replied with a smile. Then, he led everyone to a middle-aged man.
When Sheldon, Henny and the others saw this middle-aged man, they were all stunned. This middle-aged man was a very famous wealthy businessman in Honduria. Although they had no business dealings with their families, they all knew him.
This person's net worth was at least tens of billions of dollars. In the eyes of Sheldon and the others, he was already a very terrifying existence.
"Mr. Sacks..."
Harold greeted the middle-aged man with a smile.
"Mr. Phillips, you're here, I see," the middle-aged man replied indifferently. Then, he turned to look at the old man behind him and said in a low voice, "This is Master Li!"
After Harold heard this, he did not hesitate and quickly took the initiative to greet Master Li.
"Master Li, thank you so much for your time. If it weren't for you, I wouldn't have had the opportunity to witness the duel between ancient martial arts grandmasters!"
As Harold spoke, he took out a bank card and handed it to Master Li.
Master Li didn't hesitate and accepted the bank card. Then, he turned to look at the people behind Harold and said indifferently, "When we reach the place, follow me closely and don't talk casually, understand?"
"Yes, understood!"
Harold hurriedly nodded.
"Alright, follow me!"
Master Li replied lightly and then walked forward.
It was obvious that Harold was able to learn of this news because of this middle-aged man. The man had also come to watch the battle with Master Li's help.
Although there were no police officers involved in the battle between Faris Jimenez and Jorge Yarrell, there was a rule among martial artists: to try not to let ordinary people see the battle. Otherwise, the impact it could have on them would be very terrifying. As a result, most of the people who came to watch the battle today were martial artists.
Of course, there were also some rich people who would give money to martial artists they knew and let them bring them in. Everyone tacitly agreed to this situation. After all, this was also a way for many martial artists to make money. One admission ticket for this battle was worth millions, and many martial artists could make a lot of money through this battle.
Moreover, letting those rich people come to watch the battle between Grandmasters could also serve to deter them; it would let these rich people know how terrifying the strength of martial artists was.
Therefore, this could be considered killing two birds with one stone.
…
Harold, Sheldon, Sadie, Sabrina, and the others followed the so-called Master Li to the top of Spring Mountain. However, Master Li's status was very low, so their location was rather far away from the scene of the battle.
However, at this moment, there were already a lot of people gathered at the top of Spring Mountain. When Harold and the others saw these people, they were all dumbfounded. They realized that it was not only the wealthy people from Oprana who had come. There were even many internationally famous wealthy people here.
Moreover, there were martial artists following these rich people.
Master Li casually introduced Harold and Sheldon to these people, and they were already so surprised that they couldn't close their mouths.
This was because everyone here had extremely terrifying backgrounds. If all of these people were gathered together, the energy they formed would be unimaginable. Moreover, this energy would no longer be a matter of radiating the whole of Oprana. It could even radiate to the entire world.
"Just what kind of battle is this? It is actually able to attract the attention of so many big shots…"
Sadie blinked and asked with a puzzled expression.

chapters.title: Chapter 1542: The Main Character
chapters.content:
Chapter 1542: The Main Character
"It should be that person, right?"
Harold replied in a low voice.
When everyone heard this, they all turned their heads to look.
They discovered that there were many people gathered on Spring Mountain, and a white-haired old man was sitting in the middle of the peak.
No one dared to approach within a few meters of the old man. All the martial artists formed a circle at the same time.
"Who is that person?"
Sabrina asked.
"That man is Faris, the ancient martial arts grandmaster of Honduria. He's also the main character of today's battle!"
Master Li explained.
"What about his opponent?" Sabrina hurriedly asked.
"Grandmaster Jimenez's opponent this time is Grandmaster Yarrell. He hasn't appeared yet, but he should be here soon!"
"Grandmaster Yarrell?"
Everyone was confused when they heard this. After all, they were just ordinary people and did not know anything about the ancient martial arts world.
Master Li saw that these young people were confused, but did not explain anything. After all, it was a waste of time to explain to these people.
Sheldon, Harold, and the others were also shocked. They couldn't understand how terrifying the influence of the grandmasters must be to attract so many big shots to watch their battle.
Although they were curious, they did not dare to ask anything. They could only stand at the side and wait quietly.
In the blink of an eye, more than an hour had passed.
Those martial artists were all like primary school students, quietly standing in place and waiting. After all, if they could really see a grandmaster-level battle, they would be willing to stand here and wait for a month.
However, those ordinary people who did not know about the world of ancient martial arts were a little impatient, because they simply could not understand why they had spent so much effort just to watch the two fight.
..
Meanwhile, in the Dullahan family villa.
Connor hadn't rested for the entire night. After Thomas Morgan went to Jorge's house, he realized that Jorge wasn't at home at all. Even Jabba was missing.
Therefore, Connor and Wynn used almost all their strength to find Jorge, but neither Thomas Morgan nor the Purple Cloud Sect could find anything.
"Sect Leader…"
Wynn called out to Connor.
"Is there any news about my master?"
Connor shouted excitedly.
"Just now, the Great Elder sent a message back to us, but we still haven't found the sect leader…"
Wynn shook her head.
After Connor heard Wynn's words, he looked a little disappointed. He looked at his phone and didn't say anything.
"Sect Leader McDonald, I think it's useless even if we contact the leader now. After all, it takes a long time to get to Honduria from Porthampton," Wynn said helplessly.
"Give up?"
Connor was stunned when he heard Wynn's words.
"Mr. McDonald, I feel that we should give up. After all, you've already tried your best, but there's really nothing we can do now. It's not your fault that we can't contact Grandmaster Yarrell!"
Chieko hurriedly said.
"But Yelena is still in Faris's hands. If I can't save her, how can I give up?" Connor frowned.
"But Mr. McDonald, we have no way to save Miss Allen now! You know Faris's strength. We can't defeat him even if we join forces. So, I think your best choice now is to leave Honduria as soon as possible. In this way, Faris won't be able to do anything to you!"
Chieko hurriedly said.
Connor looked at her without saying anything.
"Sect Leader McDonald, things have already come to this point. We can't find any way out at all, so you should leave Honduria as soon as possible. Otherwise, not only will we not be able to save Miss Allen, but you might also die at Faris's hands!"
Wynn shouted.
Connor took a deep breath and slowly stood up.
"Sect Leader McDonald, are you planning to leave Honduria?"
Wynn asked excitedly when she saw Connor stand up.
"No, I want to save Yelena!"
Connor replied indifferently.
"Mr. McDonald, are you crazy? How are you going to save Miss Allen now?"
Chieko shouted helplessly.
"I have a video of Palmer Bander confessing his crimes. I want to show this video to Faris!"
At this moment, Connor seemed to want to make one last attempt. He was really unwilling to give up on Yelena like this.
Chieko stood in front of Connor and shouted excitedly, "Mr. McDonald, even if you show Faris this video, will he believe that it's real?"
Connor looked at her and said expressionlessly, "Whether Faris believes or not has nothing to do with me, but I have to go today…"
"But wouldn't you be asking for death if you go over now?"
Chieko shouted anxiously.
"I'm sorry," Connor replied indifferently, then directly walked out.
Chieko and Wynn stood rooted to the ground with helpless expressions on their faces. They really couldn't understand why Connor wanted to die so badly.
"Is that woman really that important to Mr. McDonald?"
Chieko's expression was extremely puzzled.
Wynn sighed and followed Connor out.
…
On the peak of Spring Mountain.
Everyone waited for the entire morning, but the so-called grandmaster battle still hadn't begun. Moreover, these people didn't even see a silhouette of Jorge at all.
"Are we still going to fight? It had been so long, but is the other guy still not here? How long do we have to wait?"
Sadie asked in a puzzled tone.
"Don't be anxious. They will definitely fight. Otherwise, why would these people be waiting here?" Sheldon asked.
"That's right. There are still so many people waiting here. Since they are not in a hurry, let's continue waiting. In any case, it's not like we have anything to do…" Sabrina added.
At this moment, Harold was also very anxious. After all, he had spent more than a million dollars to come and watch the battle between the grandmasters. If he could not see anything, then his money might really go down the drain.

chapters.title: Chapter 1543: Hidden Depths
chapters.content:
Chapter 1543: Hidden Depths
Time passed.
There were less than ten minutes left before the battle began.
But Jorge still didn't appear.
The martial artists present also began to discuss amongst themselves in low voices.
"Is Grandmaster Yarrell afraid to come?"
"How is that possible? Even if he has a chance of losing, Grandmaster Yarrell would probably still show up, right?"
"That's right. If he doesn't even dare to come, that would be too embarrassing. Wouldn't that ruin his reputation for the rest of his life?"
"But it's almost time. Why hasn't Grandmaster Yarrell appeared yet?"
Everyone present looked puzzled, not knowing what was going on.
However, at this moment, a voice suddenly sounded from the crowd.
"Mr. McDonald is here!"
Everyone turned around when they heard this.
Harold, Sabrina, Sadie, and the others were all shocked when they heard the name Mr. McDonald.
After all, they all knew that Connor was also called Mr. McDonald!
"Could the Mr. McDonald they are talking about be Connor?" Sadie couldn't help but ask.
"How is that possible?" Harold retorted directly and then continued, "Connor has some background in Porthampton, but he is nothing in Honduria. He doesn't deserve to be called Mr. McDonald!"
"That's right, Connor is not from Honduria," Sheldon added.
Sabrina hesitated for a moment, but did not say anything.
However, at this moment, the crowd had already dispersed.
Three people slowly walked out from behind the crowd. The one walking in front was a young man, and the two people following behind the young man were two peerless beauties.
At this moment, there were already quite a number of martial artists who took the initiative to greet the young man.
Sheldon, Harold, Sabrina, Sadie, and the others all looked at the young man. When the four of them saw his appearance, they were all stunned. The expressions on their faces were as shocked as they could be.
They did not expect that the young man who appeared was none other than Connor.
"It's…why is he here?"
Harold's eyes widened as he shouted in disbelief.
"Yeah, why would Connor be here?"
Sheldon hurriedly added.
Henny's expression was also very ugly, but he did not say anything.
Sadie and Sabrina looked at Connor with a myriad of thoughts in their hearts. After all, they had experienced too many things with Connor, but at this time, things had changed.
The two girls looked at Connor, not knowing how to describe their feelings.
They had never thought that they would encounter him again under such circumstances.
At this moment, Connor seemed to be an object of admiration by tens of thousands of people, but to them, he was very ordinary.
Originally, Sadie had already gotten over the matter with Connor, but after seeing him, the regret in her heart seemed to have been ignited again.
"Why is it that no matter where I go, I keep running into him?"
Harold could not help but grit his teeth and sigh.
Sabrina said, "Could it be that Connor is the one fighting with that person today?""
"Impossible, Connor isn't an ancient martial arts grandmaster. The person who's fighting with Grandmaster Jimenez is called Jorge Yarrell, a very famous ancient martial arts grandmaster in Oprana!" Harold replied without thinking.
"Mr. McDonald is Jorge's disciple. A while ago, Mr. McDonald had a huge battle with Faris's disciple, Wadi Jimenez. In the end, Mr. McDonald won, but Wadi died on Spring Mountain. So Grandmaster Jimenez is here today to avenge his grandson!" Master Li explained after hearing their conversation.
"Connor is actually the disciple of an ancient martial arts grandmaster?"
Harold was stunned again after hearing Master Li's words. The expression on his face was unusually shocked.
He knew very well how prestigious the status of a disciple of an ancient martial arts grandmaster was!
He originally thought that Connor was just a rich heir. He thought that if he worked hard enough, he still had a chance to surpass Connor!
However, he never expected that Connor would actually have yet another layer of depth to him.
Sadie, Sabrina, and the rest were also shocked. They could not understand how many secrets Connor had that they did not know!
"Connor is the one who defeated Wadi?"
Henny had heard some news about Connor and Wadi a few days ago, but he only had a rough idea of what had happened. He didn't expect Connor to be the person who defeated Wadi.
"That's right, that person is Mr. McDonald!" Master Li nodded his head gently and said in a puzzled tone, "From your tone, you seem to know Mr. McDonald?"
"In a way, yes!"
Henny nodded helplessly.
Master Li looked at Henny in a different way. He hurriedly said, "I didn't expect you to know such a big shot like Mr. McDonald. Let me tell you, Mr. McDonald is a genius in Opranian ancient martial arts. His future achievements are limitless. You have to get along well with Mr. McDonald."
Harold, Sheldon, and Henny were all dumbfounded when they heard Master Li's words.
The relationship between the three of them and Connor was, simply put, extremely bad. It was already very lucky that Connor did not bother looking for trouble with the three of them.
At this moment, Connor had already walked past Sabrina and the others as he made his way towards Faris.
When Sabrina saw Connor, her expression became a little excited. She shouted, "Brother Connor!"
However, because Sabrina was too far away from Connor, he did not hear her at all.
After Faris knew that Connor was walking over, he slowly opened his eyes and said, "Where's your master?"
"I couldn't contact him!"
Connor replied in a low voice.
When Faris heard Connor's words, he couldn't help but sneer. Then, he said indifferently, "I didn't expect your master to not care about your life. To think that I had always treated him as my opponent."
"The duel between you and my master has nothing to do with me. I came here today to explain things to you clearly!"
Connor took out his phone as he spoke, then said expressionlessly, "There is a video of Palmer Bander confessing his guilt in this phone. All of this was planned by him. He killed Wadi and framed me so that you could get rid of me!"

chapters.title: Chapter 1544: Jorge Yarrell's Arrival
chapters.content:
Chapter 1544: Jorge Yarrell's Arrival
Faris slowly raised his head and looked at Connor, then said expressionlessly, "Didn't I make myself clear to you yesterday? I don't care who killed my grandson now. Palmer Bander must die. If Jorge doesn't come to save you, then you must die today…"
"..."
Connor could not help but be stunned for a moment. Then, he said in a low voice, "You can kill me, but you have to promise me to let Yelena go!"
"That girl has no enmity with me, so I naturally won't kill her!"
Faris replied indifferently.
"Alright, since you want to kill me, then do it!"
After saying this, Connor took out the Chi Gathering Pill that he had prepared beforehand.
..
Although Connor knew that he was no match for Faris, he still wanted to fight the man so that at the very least, he could die with dignity.
However, before Connor could take out the pill, Faris had already rushed in front of him and reached out to strangle him.
When everyone saw this scene, they were all stunned because they thought that today was a battle between Grandmasters. However, no one expected Faris to actually fight with Connor.
"What's going on? Why is Grandmaster Jimenez fighting with Mr. McDonald?"
"That's right. Why did Grandmaster Jimenez attack Mr. McDonald?"
"Mr. McDonald is a junior. Isn't it a little inappropriate for Grandmaster Jimenez to do this?"
At this moment, the expressions on the faces of the martial artists present were very puzzled, and they could not help but discuss amongst themselves in low voices.
"Is Connor in danger?"
Sabrina could tell that something was not right and frowned.
"Who knows what kind of trouble this Connorgot into that made him so arrogant and condescending. Finally, someone can teach him a lesson!" Harold replied coldly.
One had to know that among all the people present, there was probably no one who wanted to see Connor die more than Harold.
Originally, Harold was in a very bad mood after seeing Connor and had even had the thought of leaving. However, he never thought that he would coincidentally see someone trying to kill Connor. Harold instantly felt that he had not come in vain today.
"Mr. Jimenez, the Sect Leader was framed!"
Wynn shouted excitedly when she saw that Faris was really going to attack Connor.
Faris ignored Wynn and squeezed Connor's neck.
In an instant, Connor felt as if he could suffocate at any moment.
Connor struggled crazily, but Faris's strength was too great. Connor had no way to break free.
"Since your master isn't coming to save you, then you can go to hell!"
Faris growled as if he was going to break Connor's neck.
But at this moment, a black beast flew out.
That's right, it wasn't a person, but a chimpanzee that flew out.
The chimpanzee kicked Faris in the face.
Faris instinctively let go of Connor and took two steps back.
After Connor was released by Faris, he started coughing violently, looking like he was in pain.
If Jabba hadn't appeared in time, Connor might have died at Faris's hands.
After Jabba kicked Faris, he seemed to know that he couldn't beat Faris, so he didn't continue attacking. Instead, he jumped beside Connor.
"Brother Connor!"
Sabrina saw that Connor was out of danger and instinctively shouted. Then, she rushed towards Connor.
However, he was stopped by Sheldon and Sadie.
After all, it was very dangerous. Even if Sabrina went over now, she would not be able to help Connor. She would even become a burden to him.
A trace of anger flashed in Harold's eyes. He originally thought that Connor would die today, but he did not expect Connor to be saved by a chimpanzee.
"The Deputy Sect Leader is here?" Wynn shouted excitedly when she saw Jabba.
Chieko was confused. She frowned and said, "You said that this chimpanzee is your deputy sect leader?"
"That's right, this is the Deputy Sect Leader of the Purple Cloud Sect!"
Wynn hurriedly nodded and continued, "The Deputy Sect Leader has always lived with the Sect Leader. Since the Deputy Sect Leader is here, it means that the Sect Leader should be here too!"
"Grandmaster Yarrell has arrived!"
"Grandmaster Yarrell is finally here!"
At this moment, a voice suddenly came from the crowd.
After hearing this, everyone turned their heads to look at the foot of the mountain.
As expected, an old man was walking up the mountain with a wooden stick in his hand.
Everyone was dumbfounded when they saw Jorge's appearance. Jorge looked like an old man with weak legs. He didn't look like an ancient martial arts grandmaster at all.
"How did Grandmaster Yarrell become like this?"
"That's right. Could it be that Grandmaster Yarrell is really old?"
"Looks like time really waits for no man. I didn't expect Grandmaster Yarrell to actually become like this!"
The martial artists present began to discuss in low voices.
Connor also saw Jorge staggering over, and his expression broke down. He stood up and shouted, "Old man, can you hurry up? I was about to die just now, you know? If I die, who will support you in your old age? Who will make money for your Purple Cloud Sect in the future?"
When Jorge heard Connor's words, he slowly raised his head and looked at him. Then, he said indifferently, "You have to pay attention to your attitude when talking to me!"
Jorge was at the foot of the mountain while Connor was at the top.
However, everyone realized that Jorge's voice could be clearly heard by everyone. Moreover, this voice was very calm. He wasn't actually shouting.
"What attitude? Can you come over quickly? Your old rival really wants to kill me!"
Connor shouted.
"Don't worry, no one in the world can kill my disciple!"
Jorge replied indifferently.
It had to be said that Jorge's words were very domineering.
When Connor heard this, he was speechless and said loudly, "What time is it? Can you stop bragging?"
Wynn looked at Connor in front of her with an expression of shock.
This was the first time she had seen someone speak to Jorge like this!
Jorge shook his head with a bitter smile and said lightly, "My disciple really doesn't respect me at all!"

chapters.title: Chapter 1545: Seeking Justice
chapters.content:
Chapter 1545: Seeking Justice
"Hurry up and get up here!"
Connor shouted at the top of his lungs with a broken expression.
Jorge didn't bother with Connor anymore. He threw the wooden stick in his hand to the side and exerted force with his legs.
In an instant, Jorge was like an immortal who was riding on clouds and mist, and rushed towards the top of the mountain.
In just a few seconds, Jorge suddenly appeared at the top of the mountain.
Everyone gasped when they saw this scene.
Before this, they were still secretly thinking in their hearts that Jorge might really be old.
But at this moment, those people were slapped in the face.
One had to know that Jorge was at least tens of meters away from the top of the mountain just now, and yet he'd actually jumped straight up, like he was flying.
Moreover, Jorge had only used a few seconds to fly to the top of the mountain.
Everyone present couldn't understand how Jorge did it!
Jorge's way of making his entrance had already stunned everyone present.
Even Wynn's eyes widened. After all, she had never seen anyone fly up the mountain in such a way.
"Did that person just fly up?" Harold's eyes widened as he shouted in disbelief.
"It…seems so…" Sheldon stuttered.
After Master Li heard what the two of them said, he said in a low voice, "Grandmaster Yarrell is an ancient martial arts grandmaster. It's very normal for an ancient martial arts grandmaster to be able to fly!"
"Something very normal?"
Harold widened his eyes. He didn't know what to say.
He couldn't understand when Connor had gotten such an awesome master!
"As expected of Grandmaster Yarrell!"
"That's right. Grandmaster Yarrell is really too powerful…"
"Looks like today's battle is going to be interesting."
At this moment, everyone looked at Jorge in excitement.
Connor let out a long sigh of relief, and his expression relaxed. After all, Faris had said that as long as Jorge appeared, he wouldn't attack Connor. That way, he wouldn't be in any danger.
As for the battle between Jorge and Faris, Connor didn't care at all. He knew that Jorge definitely wouldn't lose to Faris.
"Old man, I'll leave the rest to you. You shouldn't have any problems, right?"
Connor said to Jorge with a smile.
"No problem!"
Jorge replied to Connor indifferently and then walked towards Faris.
Faris slowly raised his head and looked at Jorge in front of him. Then, he said in a low voice, "Long time no see!"
"It has indeed been a long time since I last saw you!" Jorge replied indifferently.
"Jorge, do you know how many years I've waited for you?"
"Why wait for me?"
"To defeat you, of course!"
Faris replied.
"Haha…" Jorge couldn't help but laugh coldly when he heard this. Then, he said indifferently, "You don't have the ability!"
"Hahaha…"
Faris laughed loudly. "You're still so confident after so many years. I thought you wouldn't show up today. It seems that your feelings for this kid are not ordinary. If it was someone else, it would be really difficult to lure you out!"
"He is my disciple!" Jorge replied simply.
"I didn't expect you to accept a disciple!"
Faris commented.
Jorge frowned and said helplessly, "Oh Faris, I really didn't expect you to be so shameless. You're already so old, and you can be considered a senior in the ancient martial arts world. Now you're bullying a junior, and a martial artist junior at that. Aren't you afraid of being laughed at?"
"Laughed at?"
When Faris heard Jorge's words, he couldn't help but laugh coldly. Then, he said indifferently, "My grandson is already dead. Why would I be afraid of being laughed at?"
"Your grandson is dead?"
Jorge frowned slightly.
Faris gritted his teeth and replied in a low voice. "That's right. Your disciple killed my grandson. I just want to avenge my grandson. Is there anything wrong with that?"
Jorge didn't seem to know much about this matter. He turned his head and asked Connor, "You killed his grandson?"
"It wasn't the Sect Leader who killed the Chief!"
Wynn hurriedly shouted.
"I don't think Connor would kill anyone!"
Jorge nodded lightly and said to Faris, "Whether or not my disciple killed your grandson has nothing to do with me. However, since you dared to bully my disciple just now, I will seek justice for him today!"
It was obvious that Jorge only meant one thing. It didn't matter whether Wadi was killed by Connor or not, but Faris wasn't allowed to bully Jorge's disciple!
In the entirety of Oprana, Jorge was probably the only person who dared to speak to Faris like that.
"Seek justice?" When Faris heard this, he was stunned for a moment. Then, he asked indifferently, "How do you plan to seek justice?"
"What do you think?"
Jorge replied indifferently, then walked towards Faris.
However, every step Jorge took seemed to shake Spring Mountain. Everyone present could feel the intense tremors. It felt like an earthquake.
After Harold and Sadie felt the ground shaking, their faces were filled with fear.
"What's going on?" Sadie shouted.
"Is there going to be an earthquake?"
Sheldon hurriedly added.
Master Li turned to look at them and said calmly, "Don't worry, it's not an earthquake!"
Sadie hesitated for a moment and asked carefully, "Then…Then what's going on?"
"This is only because Grandmaster Yarrell's strength is too strong, which is why Spring Mountain is trembling!"
Master Li explained lightly.
Sadie and the others were dumbfounded when they heard this. They stared at Jorge, who was not far away.
They were not martial artists themselves, so they naturally did not know how powerful an ancient martial arts grandmaster was. However, after they knew that the earthquake was caused by Jorge, they were extremely shocked. They really could not understand how terrifying a person's strength was to be able to cause the entire mountain to tremble.
Now, they finally understood why so many people wanted to watch this battle.

chapters.title: Chapter 1546: Terrifying Strength!
chapters.content:
Chapter 1546: Terrifying Strength!
