Harold looked at Jorge not far away and couldn't help but think, "Is this the power of an ancient martial arts grandmaster?"
At this moment, he was thinking that he could have been able to step on Connor long ago if he had Jorge's strength.
Jorge stopped less than 50 meters away from Faris and said to him expressionlessly, "Faris, you're just trying to lure me out. I know that you've been unconvinced ever since you lost to me back then. I'm giving you a chance to fight me now."
"I've finally waited for this day!"
Faris's expression was a little excited. Then, he rushed towards Jorge.
When Jorge saw Faris make his move, he waved his right hand.
"Boom!"
A huge rock not far away rose into the sky and flew toward Faris.
When Faris saw the huge rock, his expression was a little disdainful. He waved his right hand gently, and in an instant, the huge rock that was still in the air turned into powder and dissipated into the world.
Following that, Faris rushed in front of Jorge and threw a punch. However, Jorge easily dodged the punch.
Everything had happened very quickly. No one had expected the battle to begin just like that.
In the blink of an eye, Jorge and Faris had already finished their first exchange.
When the martial artists present saw this scene, their expressions were extremely shocked because they finally realized how terrifying the power of an ancient martial arts grandmaster could be.
Before this, there were still many martial artists who had never seen an ancient martial arts grandmaster battle.
Even Connor's expression was incredulous. Although he had known Jorge for a long time, he had never seen him fight. Therefore, he naturally did not know how terrifying the power of an ancient martial arts grandmaster was.
However, Jorge and Faris's first fight made Connor understand the gap between him and an ancient martial arts grandmaster. This gap was not something that could be made up by a few Chi pellets.
"So this is a true expert!" Waverly could not help but think.
Faris and Jorge didn't continue to attack after the first exchange.
"Faris, you were no match for me back then, and you are still no match for me now. I advise you not to waste your energy and hurry up to find the murderer who killed your grandson!"
Jorge said expressionlessly.
"That's right, I did lose to you back then, but at that time I was only a Black-rank, and you were an Earth-rank ancient martial arts grandmaster, so it's normal for me to lose to you. Now that I'm an Earth-rank ancient martial arts grandmaster, it's still uncertain who will win today!" Faris replied.
"Over the years, you've indeed improved rapidly, but I've never been stagnant either, so you'll never be able to surpass me!"
Jorge said calmly.
"Whether or not I can surpass you, I still have to try!"
After Faris said this, he rushed towards Jorge again.
Faris's speed was astonishing. In the blink of an eye, he was already in front of Jorge.
When everyone saw this, their eyes were filled with shock.
Faris was so fast that it was almost unbelievable. He was like a bolt of lightning.
Ordinary people like Sadie and the others could not understand how humans could have such terrifying speed.
At this moment, all the martial artists present were stunned, and they were indescribably excited.
They knew that the battle between the ancient martial arts grandmasters was finally about to begin. They had waited so long for this moment.
When Faris rushed in front of Jorge, he threw a punch.
This time, Jorge didn't choose to dodge and instead also threw out a punch.
"Boom!"
There was a loud bang as their fists collided.
For a moment, Spring Mountain began to tremble violently.
The viewers also revealed fearful expressions again because they did not expect the battle between the two to be so terrifying. They even felt that if the two continued to fight like this, Spring Mountain might collapse.
"How terrifying is this power?"
"That's right. When can I have such terrifying power?"
The martial artists present were very envious. After all, all martial artists hoped that one day, they would have the ability to move mountains and rivers like Jorge and Faris.
However, those who could truly reach this level of cultivation were as rare as phoenix feathers! Only one in ten thousand people could ever achieve such a feat!
Jorge and Faris's second exchange of blows were equally matched. Neither of them made the other retreat.
The punch just now was obviously a test of each other's strength, so after the punch, both of them retreated at the same time.
Faris steadied his body and waved his right hand.
In an instant, an aura soared into the sky and flew directly towards Jorge.
Connor knew that as long as he learned how to use his aura, a martial artist would not need any weapons at all, because aura was the best weapon.
Although the aura seemed mysterious and had no power to speak of, its lethality was shocking.
Even if Connor were to unleash his aura, it would be enough to kill an ordinary person.
However, Faris's aura was that of an ancient martial arts grandmaster!
At this moment, even if an armored tank was placed in front of him, it would probably be flattened by his aura in an instant.
Jorge was very calm, however. He also waved his right hand, sending his own aura as a counterattack.
The two auras collided fiercely, but it was obvious that Jorge's aura was stronger.
After Jorge's aura split apart Faris's aura, he flew straight towards Faris.
Faris dodged to the side.
In this third exchange, Jorge seemed to have started to gain the upper hand.
Faris was very familiar with Jorge's abilities, so when Jorge easily neutralized his move, Faris didn't show any surprise at all. Instead, he attacked Jorge again.

chapters.title: Chapter 1547: The Confidence of a Strong Warrior
chapters.content:
Chapter 1547: The Confidence of a Strong Warrior
Faris's figure flashed as he rushed in front of Jorge. He raised his fist and sent a punch at Jorge.
However, Jorge didn't choose to face him head-on this time. Instead, he turned sideways and dodged the punch.
After Faris's punch missed, he raised his hand, and the stones on the ground all flew up.
"Go!" Faris shouted.
Countless stones flew towards Jorge like bullets.
When everyone saw this scene, their expressions were even more shocked.
They did not expect Faris to be able to use the stones on the ground to attack.
When Jorge saw these stones flying over, he couldn't help but laugh coldly. Then, with a flick of his wrist, the ground began to tremble violently. Then, an earthen wall rose up in front of him, blocking the attack.
Almost all of the stones were blocked by the wall in front of Jorge.
Although these stones were very lethal, some of them could even break through the earthen wall. However, most of their power had been lessened by the wall, so even if they did manage to hit Jorge, they wouldn't have any lethality to speak of.
However, when Faris saw this scene, a trace of surprise finally flashed across his eyes.
"It seems that even after so many years, your strength has never regressed!"
Faris said expressionlessly.
"Your power has improved a lot, but you might not be a match for me now!"
Jorge replied.
When Faris heard Jorge's words, he couldn't help but laugh coldly. He said expressionlessly, "It's still too early to say whether I'm a match for you or not!"
"I think you should stop playing these little tricks. It's embarrassing to look at. If you still have any special skills, use them as soon as possible. Otherwise, I'm worried that you won't have this chance later!" Jorge said calmly.
When Faris heard this, he subconsciously took a deep breath. The aura in his body circulated like a huge wave.
"Jorge, what do you think of this move of mine?" Faris roared and thrust his hands out.
In an instant, countless stones flew into the sky.
However, it was obvious that the stones this time were flying faster and were more powerful than the previous ones.
The last time, those stones were all flying towards Jorge from the front, so he could block them by using a wall.
However, it was different this time. These stones flew towards Jorge from all directions at the same time, so Jorge had no room to dodge at all.
When the martial artists present saw this scene, they all looked shocked.
They knew that it would take a lot of energy to move so many stones at the same time. Only Faris could do it. Otherwise, even other ancient martial arts grandmasters would find it difficult to do it.
If the person standing there was not Jorge but themselves, they might not have been able to withstand the attacks of these stones at all. They would have been instantly killed by Faris.
"Is the old man in danger?"
The expression on Connor's face also began to become nervous.
"Don't worry, the sect master can still deal with this little trick!" Waverly reassured.
Connor placed all his attention on Jorge.
At this moment, Jorge started to circulate his aura calmly.
"Rise!"
Jorge called out lightly.
Something unbelievable happened. The stones that were about to hit Jorge suddenly seemed to hit something in midair. They all changed their direction and flew in all directions.
The expression on Faris's face was a little strange. He never thought that Jorge would be able to resolve his move so easily.
However, he knew that he had no time to be shocked. With another flick of his wrist, a huge rock flew towards Jorge at an extremely shocking speed.
Jorge pointed at the rock. A ray of light flashed and directly split it in half.
"Faris, you've been in seclusion for so many years. Is this all you can do?" Jorge asked in disdain.
"Don't worry, this is just the beginning!"
Faris gritted his teeth and continued to attack.
At this moment, Faris could be said to have used all his strength. However, no matter what move he used, Jorge could easily resolve it.
This made Faris extremely angry. He didn't expect Jorge's strength to still be so terrifying after so many years.
Moreover, the pressure that Jorge gave off hadn't changed at all. Jorge had given Faris this feeling back then, and it was still the same now.
Connor looked at Jorge. Only now did he realize how terrifying his master's strength was.
If Faris had used those moves on someone else, they would definitely be overwhelmed even if they managed to endure the onslaught. They definitely wouldn't be as calm as Jorge.
Faris's moves were all fierce and wild. If Connor was not careful, he would die at Faris's hands.
However, Jorge had been standing there with a calm expression since the beginning, as if he was dealing with a very simple matter. The calmness in his eyes was unbelievable.
In the face of such fierce attacks, he could still be so calm and composed. Everyone present could not help but suck in a breath of cold air.
The reason why Jorge could be so calm was not because of his good mental fortitude, but because he was very confident in his own strength. He knew that these moves could not threaten him.
This was the confidence of a true expert!
Faris looked at Jorge in front of him, his expression excited. When he faced Jorge back then, Jorge was just as calm as he was today. He wanted to defeat Jorge like this.
However, there was one thing that Faris couldn't understand. Back then, he felt that Jorge was so calm because he did indeed have a higher rank than him, which was why he could look down on Faris.
But now, his cultivation level was still the same as Jorge's. Why was Jorge still able to remain calm?
"Is he really that confident in his own strength?" Faris couldn't help but think before shouting, " Jorge, for so many years, in order to defeat you, I've been painstakingly studying martial arts. In the end, my efforts have paid off and allowed me to comprehend a move. Today, I want to see if you can take this move of mine!"
Jorge looked at Faris and said expressionlessly, "I hope it's not a half-assed skill, then!"

chapters.title: Chapter 1548: Broadened Horizons
chapters.content:
Chapter 1548: Broadened Horizons
Faris couldn't help but frown. Then, he thrust his hands out.
In an instant, countless violent auras erupted from Faris's body.
However, after the aura left his body, it turned into strands of silk, and these threads kept gathering in the sky.
"What is this?"
Sabrina looked at the thread on her head and shouted in surprise.
"I didn't expect Grandmaster Jimenez's aura to have been cultivated to such a level. This is unbelievable!"
Master Li was not in the mood to explain these things at this time. He sighed with envy.
A moment later, Faris's aura condensed into a large white net.
When everyone saw this scene, their expressions were even more shocked.
"Go!" Faris growled.
In the next second, this huge net flew directly towards Jorge.
When Jorge saw the huge net in front of him, his expression was a little disdainful. Then, he flicked his wrist gently, and a ray of light appeared in the sky, as if he wanted to cut off Faris's huge net.
But what Jorge didn't expect was that after his aura cut through the net, the net healed at an extremely fast speed and then continued to fly towards him.
"This is interesting!"
Jorge couldn't help but laugh.
It must be known that this huge white net was condensed from the aura in Faris's body. Therefore, even if Jorge could break this huge net, Faris could immediately use his own aura to fill the gap. This made it impossible for this huge net to be destroyed.
Moreover, this net was very large, almost covering a few hundred meters around Jorge. Therefore, no matter how fast Jorge was, it was absolutely impossible for him to escape from this net.
Moreover, this huge net could be moved, so it was basically impossible for Jorge to avoid it.
In an instant, Connor's expression became serious. He knew that Jorge's situation was dangerous; if the huge net managed to get ahold of him, even Jorge's body would probably be severely injured.
The surrounding martial artists also knew that Jorge was in great danger. They began to worry for him, but they were more curious about whether him could break Faris's move in the end.
"As expected of an ancient martial arts grandmaster. He's really too powerful…"
"Yeah, such terrifying power is unimaginable!"
"If I were to stand in front of these two people at this moment, I would probably have been instantly killed by them…"
At this moment, a few martial artists could not help but think.
Sabrina and the others were so shocked that they were speechless.
Before this, their understanding of martial artists was that they were only physically stronger than normal people. They thought that powerful martial artists could even easily deal with dozens of ordinary people by themselves, but that was all.
However, this scene was too shocking. They simply could not believe that all of this was real. They felt as if they were dreaming.
As for Henny, he had been gritting his teeth and standing on the spot. It was only now did he realize how terrifying the gap between him and Connor was.
At this moment, Faris's huge net had already completely covered Jorge's body.
The expression on Connor's face became even more solemn.
"Retract!"
Faris shouted.
In an instant, the white net began to shrink violently, as if it wanted to strangle Jorge to death.
After Faris saw the scene, he looked a little proud and sighed softly, "Jorge, I originally thought that you would be able to break this move of mine, but I didn't expect that not even you would be able to break it. You really disappoint me…"
"How do you know I can't?"
Jorge replied to Faris.
"You still dare to speak arrogantly at a time like this?"
The expression on Faris's face was somewhat disdainful.
But at this moment, Jorge suddenly shouted.
"Break!"
Immediately after, a very powerful aura erupted from Jorge's body.
"Bang!"
The huge net that was originally still wrapped around Jorge's body exploded in front of everyone's eyes.
When Faris saw this scene, he also took two steps back. His eyes were filled with disbelief.
He had never thought that Jorge would not only break his move, but also break it in such an effortless way.
He had thought that he would definitely be able to defeat Jorge today, but at this moment, he realized that there was still a large gap between them.
Jorge didn't give Faris much time to think—a sword that was completely formed by Jorge's aura flew towards Faris at an astonishing speed.
When Faris saw the sword flying towards him, his expression was a little angry. He quickly set up a barrier in front of him, planning to block Jorge's sword with it.
However, he had underestimated the power of this longsword.
The long sword easily pierced through the barrie.
Faris's expression was a little shocked. He hurriedly set up another barrier that was many times thicker than the previous one.
However, this barrier only blocked the sword for a few seconds before it was easily broken by the sword.
In the end, Faris had no choice but to use all his strength to block Jorge's sword.
"Bang!"
With a loud bang, the long sword hit Faris's chest.
However, Faris's body was hard, so the long sword could not pierce through his body at all.
The situation was strange. It was like someone was holding a long sword and trying to pierce Faris's body, but couldn't penetrate the skin no matter how hard they tried.
"What a terrifying body!"
"That's right. Grandmaster Jimenez is already in such a state, but he's still unharmed. He's really too strong!"
"As expected of a battle between Grandmasters. Today, I've broadened my horizons!" the surrounding martial artists could not help but think.

chapters.title: Chapter 1549: Death Without Regrets
chapters.content:
Chapter 1549: Death Without Regrets
The expressions on the faces of the viewers present were even more shocked.
They couldn't believe what they were seeing. They felt that this kind of thing only appeared in movies and could not believe that an ordinary human could possess such terrifying power.
In their eyes, Jorge and Faris were like gods.
Perhaps this was a real fight between immortals.
This battle had completely overturned the ordinary people's understanding of martial artists, especially those big shots in the business world. Only now did they know that they really could not afford to offend these martial artists. Once they provoked these martial artists, they might not even know how they died.
Although many of them had known about the existence of martial artists before, they did not have a clear understanding of the power of martial artists and did not know how terrifying they could be.
However, at this moment, they finally understood.
An ancient martial artist at a grandmaster level was something that ordinary humans could not compete with.
"Are these two still human?" Sheldon stammered. Could the two of them be the legendary immortals?"
"Yeah, it's too terrifying. How can an ordinary person have such terrifying power?"
Sadie's eyes were filled with shock.
"Immortal? It's already the 21st century. How could there still be immortals?"
Harold felt like crying when he heard what the two of them said.
All this time, he had been thinking of ways to deal with Connor, but how could he have imagined that Connor had such a god-like figure as his master?
At this moment, Harold had completely given up on the idea of dealing with Connor because he knew that if he continued to try, he would simply be courting death. He and Connor were no longer from the same world.
Connor, however, didn't have the time to care about these things because he'd focused all his attention on Jorge and Faris.
Connor knew that this sword was the key to the battle!
Faris was also shocked by Jorge's attack. He didn't expect Jorge's strength to be so terrifying even after so many years.
Back then, Faris had lost to Jorge. In fact, he was unconvinced. After all, Faris's cultivation level was lower than Jorge's at that time. But now that their cultivation levels were the same, Faris realized that he wasn't Jorge's match.
At this moment, the sword in front of Faris seemed to have the power to destroy the world. If Jorge's opponent was an ordinary martial artist, it was very likely that this person would have died by now.
Connor looked at the battle, shocked because he never thought that Jorge's strength would be so terrifying.
The expressions of the martial artists present were also very solemn at this time, because they all knew that this sword was crucial to today's battle.
At this moment, Faris suddenly shouted.
"Jorge, I admit that your strength is indeed very terrifying. However, I came here today with the determination to die, so even if I lose my life, I will definitely not lose to you!"
Jorge looked at Faris in front of him and sighed helplessly.
"Why are you still in this situation?"
"As long as I can defeat you and me, it doesn't matter even if I die…" Faris replied expressionlessly and then continued, "It has been so many years. You have always been the greatest knot in my heart. If I am able to defeat you, I can die without regrets…"
Jorge looked at Faris with a helpless expression. He sighed softly and didn't say anything because he knew that Hadi Jimenez's death was a terrible blow to Faris. After all, Faris had placed all his hopes on Hadi, who was effectively Faris's reason to live.
But now he was dead. And Faris naturally lost the motivation to continue living.
Faris knew that Hadi might not have died at Connor's hands. However, this was no longer important to him; no matter who killed Hadi, the fact was that his death had a lot to do with Connor. To put it simply, Faris felt that everything that had happened recently was because of Connor, which was why he wanted to settle the score with Connor.
If Faris could really defeat Jorge today, then he would die without regrets.
"Break!"
At this moment, Faris suddenly roared.
The sword that was about to pierce through Faris's body was sent flying.
When everyone saw this, their eyes widened in disbelief.
They did not expect Faris, who had already entered a desperate situation, to erupt with such terrifying combat power. They originally thought that today's battle had ended like this, but after Faris broke the sword attack, it added some suspense to today's battle.
The expression on Connor's face started to become serious, because he knew very clearly that the battle had just begun.
"Jorge, for so many years, I've been painstakingly studying this move. But today, I can finally use it!"
Faris called out.
Jorge's expression was unusually calm, as if he was waiting for Faris to make a move.
"Rise!"
Faris didn't waste any time and stomped his foot.
In an instant, Spring Mountain began to tremble.
Everyone present also felt the trembling, and all of them wore terrified expressions.
"What's going on?"
Sheldon shouted in fear.
Meanwhile, Harold was observing the situation around him. His expression was also very solemn.
Although Spring Mountain had also trembled before, it was a completely different concept from the current trembling. The current trembling was obviously more intense, as if Spring Mountain could collapse at any time, making people feel uneasy.
Moreover, it was not only Spring Mountain that was trembling. It was as if the weather had also undergone a huge change.
Sadie and the rest were completely dumbfounded. After all, they were all ordinary people. When had they ever seen such a scene? Situations like these were far beyond their imaginations!

chapters.title: Chapter 1550: A Shocking Move
chapters.content:
Chapter 1550: A Shocking Move
Connor looked at Jorge with a serious expression and didn't say anything.
Although Connor didn't know what was going to happen next, he could feel that Jorge's expression was very serious. This meant that Faris's move was very terrifying.
"Jorge, this move is specially prepared for you. I was worried that I wouldn't have a chance to use this move, but you didn't let me down. You let me use this move!"
Faris shouted as he looked at Connor. Then, he waved his right hand.
Suddenly, a loud rumble came from the sky.
In an instant, the ground shook even more violently.
What was most surprising was that the stones on the ground slowly floated up.
When everyone saw this, their expressions were filled with shock.
Connor squinted his eyes and looked at Faris.
In less than a moment, the rocks that were originally floating slowly condensed into a small small mountain.
Yes, it was a small mountain.
After the small small mountain was formed, Faris's expression smug.
Even Jorge looked incredulous when he saw this. He knew very well that Faris could condense such a huge mountain with his own aura, which was a very terrifying feat for a martial artist. Even Jorge wasn't confident that he could do this.
"It is unexpected that you have made so many preparations in order to deal with me…"
Jorge whispered to Faris.
When Faris heard Jorge's words, he couldn't help but laugh coldly. Then, he said, "As long as I can defeat you, it will be worth it even if I have to risk my life…"
…
The huge mountain hung above Faris's head, and his face was filled with excitement.
This move was prepared by Faris specifically to defeat Jorge, so it was definitely a blessing for him to be able to use this move.
After Connor saw this, the expression on his face clearly became much more solemn.
Because Connor could feel that Jorge's move was terrifying, he wasn't sure if Jorge really had the confidence to take Faris's move.
"Jorge, I'd like to see how you're going to break my move today!"
Faris shouted at Jorge and flicked his wrist.
In an instant, another loud sound came from the sky.
"Rumble…"
The mountain that was originally hanging above Faris's head flew directly towards Jorge.
When everyone saw this, they all had solemn expressions on their faces.
After all, at this moment, they could feel how terrifying Faris's move was. If Jorge couldn't take it, then he would definitely die today.
Jorge was indeed the number one ancient martial arts grandmaster in Honduria.
Everyone had thought that Faris would lose to Jorge today, but no one had expected the battle to change so drastically. Right now, they all felt that Faris had the advantage and Jorge was at a complete disadvantage.
"I wonder how Grandmaster Yarrell plans to block this move!"
"That's right. I didn't expect Grandmaster Jimenez to have such a trump card that he hasn't used yet. It's really too terrifying…"
"Perhaps this is the power of a Grandmaster!"
At this moment, all the martial artists present also looked on, shockd. The terrifying combat power displayed by these two people had already completely convinced everyone present.
In an instant, everyone's eyes were focused on Jorge. They were all curious about how Jorge planned to counter Faris's move.
Jorge's expression was calm. He looked at the small mountain in front of him with disdain, then suddenly held his hand up. A golden sword appeared in it.
"Go!"
Jorge roared. In an instant, the sword flew towards the mountain.
When Faris saw the long sword, his expression was a little disdainful. He said, "Jorge, you're not naive enough to think that this sword of yours can break this move of mine, are you?"
"Whether or not I can break this move, I still have to try!" Jorge replied.
"Boom!"
In the next second, another loud sound came from the sky as Jorge's sword collided with Faris's small mountain.
After the violent shaking, everyone realized that Jorge's sword didn't seem to have any effect on Faris's mountain. The mountain still flew towards him.
For a moment, everyone's expressions began to change.
Even Connor's eyes were filled with worry because everyone knew that Jorge's was in danger.
However, Jorge didn't show any signs of nervousness. He condensed his aura into a sword again and slashed down fiercely at the small mountain.
"Boom!"
There was another loud noise.
However, Jorge's sword was unable to stop the mountain that covered the sky.
"Jorge, you will definitely lose today!"
When Faris saw this, his expression became even more excited.
Jorge wasn't in the mood to pay attention to Faris. He could only slash at the mountain.
But no matter what, Jorge's sword couldn't split the mountain.
"I'm not in the mood to waste my time with you!"
At this moment, Faris seemed to feel that he would definitely be able to defeat Jorge today, so he shouted in disdain and then suddenly waved his right hand.
In an instant, the mountain that was originally suspended above Jorge's head sped up and smashed towards Jorge.
Jorge didn't seem to give up. He continued to slash at the small mountain.
When everyone saw this, their expressions were nervous.
After all, they all knew that the mountain above Jorge's head had to weigh over a thousand tons. If Jorge didn't split the mountain before it hit him, then he would be killed.

chapters.title: Chapter 1551: The End of the Grandmaster
chapters.content:
Chapter 1551: The End of the Grandmaster
Connor's expression was also very ugly. He wanted to help Jorge do something now.
However, his strength was limited. He didn't know what he could do. At this moment, he could only pray silently in his heart.
"Hey!"
However, after Jorge tried his best to break the small mountain above his head, he sighed helplessly and stood there expressionlessly.
When everyone saw this, their expressions were somewhat shocked.
Because they knew that Jorge's actions meant that he had completely given up on resisting.
"Could Grandmaster Yarrell have lost just like that?"
"Grandmaster Jimenez is really too strong. Grandmaster Yarrell might have underestimated his opponent this time!"
"Didn't expect this to be the end result…"
"That's right, Grandmaster Yarrell shouldn't have come today..."
The martial artists present began to whisper among themselves.
When Sheldon and Harold saw this, they both revealed excited expressions.
At this moment, both of them felt that the reason why Connor was able to become an existence that made countless big shots in Davenport lose face was because he had a master like Jorge. The big shots in Davenport were so afraid of Connor because of Jorge.
However, if Jorge really died in Faris's hands today, then Connor would lose his biggest backer. In this case, Connor would no longer be Mr. McDonald of Davenport. Harold and Sheldon could also take this opportunity to take revenge on him.
They even felt that they didn't have to wait to get their revenge. Once Jorge died, Faris would definitely get rid of Connor.
Therefore, Sheldon and Harold were the only ones who hoped that Jorge would lose to Faris.
..
"Jorge, I admit that you are the only worthy enemy in my life. I couldn't get over it after I lost to you back then. But today, I can finally defeat you, so even if I die, I can die without regrets!"
Faris's tone was very calm as he shouted at Jorge.
However, Jorge slowly raised his head and looked at Faris. His eyes were calm, as if he hadn't heard what Faris said at all.
At this moment, all the martial artists present felt that it was a pity. After all, Jorge could definitely be considered a legendary grandmaster in Oprana. Unfortunately, no one expected that this grandmaster would meet his end in such a way.
The small mountain was getting closer and closer to the top of Jorge's head.
However, Jorge still stood there expressionlessly. His expression was unusually calm, so calm that it seemed unbelievable.
After all, everyone felt that if someone were to encounter such a situation, even if they were to give up resisting, they shouldn't just stand there and wait for death. They could totally choose to escape.
However, these people couldn't understand why Jorge would choose to give up on himself. It was as if he didn't even have the thought of running away.
"Boom!"
At this moment, the small mountain suddenly began to fall.
Under everyone's watchful eyes, the small mountain fell like a meteorite, smashing fiercely on the spot where Jorge had been standing just now.
For a time, Spring Mountain fell into a violent tremor.
"Sect Master!"
After Waverly saw this, she couldn't help but shout.
Connor was also completely dumbfounded. He stood where he was and looked at the place where the small mountain had fallen. Disbelief was all over his face; he did not expect everything to end so suddenly.
"This... How is this possible?"
Connor couldn't believe what he was seeing. He stammered as he rushed towards the small mountain.
He couldn't accept the fact that Jorge was dead.
"Sect Leader McDonald, you can't go over…"
Waverly was also shocked, but when she saw Connor was about to rush over, she quickly reached out to stop him.
"Get out of my way!"
Connor gritted his teeth and shouted at Waverly.
"Sect Leader McDonald, please calm down. You can't go over now…"
Waverly stubbornly stood in front of Connor and shouted excitedly.
"Didn't you hear me asking you to move aside?"
Waverly, on the other hand, stood there expressionlessly as if she hadn't heard Connor's words.
Connor was not in the mood to talk nonsense with Waverly at all. He took a step forward and was about to push Waverly away.
"Rumble…"
However, at this moment, the small mountain that had already smashed into Jorge began to tremble violently.
In an instant, almost everyone turned their attention to the small mountain.
In the beginning, the small mountain only trembled a few times. However, after a few seconds, the trembling of the small mountain became more and more intense.
When Faris saw this, his expression was also very shocked. He could vaguely feel that Jorge didn't seem to be dead.
"Bang!"
As expected, in the next second, the small mountain exploded.
Countless rocks flew in all directions, and the martial artists present hurriedly used their auras to shield them, preventing stones from flying over and smashing them.
"Hide behind me!"
Master Li, who was in front of Sheldon, Harold, and the others, growled and then formed a barrier in front of him.
Sheldon, Sadie, and Sabrina reacted quickly and hid behind him.
However, Harold's reaction was obviously slower than the rest of them. Before he could run behind Master Li, a stone smashed into his right leg.
"Ah!"
Harold screamed.
The rock had broken Harold's right leg.
After Sheldon saw this, his expression was a little fearful.
"Save me…"
Because his right leg was broken by a rock, Harold was sitting on the ground, paralyzed and unable to move at all. However, there were still countless rocks flying towards him.
If he couldn't hide behind Master Li's barrier, then he would definitely be crushed to death by these rocks today.
At this time, Master Li had already focused all his attention on the construction barrier. He had no energy to pay attention to Harold at all.
"Sheldon, help me!" Harold shouted in pain.

chapters.title: Chapter 1552: Not Dead?
chapters.content:
Chapter 1552: Not Dead?
When Sheldon heard Harold's words, he could not help but be stunned.
However, he did not move because Sheldon knew that going to Harold was dangerous.
Once he left Master Li's protection, he would definitely end up like Harold.
As for Henny, it was as if he had not heard anything. He hid behind the crowd with a terrified expression.
When Harold saw that Sheldon and Henny did not seem to have any intention of saving him, the expression on his face became a little desperate.
Harold did not expect them to be so heartless as to abandon him just like that.
"Bang!"
At this moment, another rock smashed into Harold's left leg.
"Ah…"
Harold screamed again.
Sabrina looked at Harold and hesitated for two seconds. In the end, she chose to rush out of Master Li's protection and forcefully dragged Harold behind the barrier set up by Master Li.
Harold might not have expected that Sabrina would save him at such a critical moment.
"Sabrina, thank you for your help…"
Harold in an extremely weak voice.
Sabrina did not say anything.
On the other side, the small mountain was trembling even more violently. Countless stones flew over the small mountain. If it wasn't for the fact that the cultivators present had already set up a barrier, who knew how many innocent people would have died here.
Everyone present focused their attention on the location of the explosion on the small mountain. However, when the dust dispersed, everyone was dumbfounded, shock on their faces.
"Sect Master is still alive?"
Waverly stared into the distance with her big, watery eyes. Her expression was shocked.
It was as if everyone present had the same expression. There was shock and doubt.
One had to know that this small mountain had smashed into Jorge's body in front of everyone's eyes. However, no one expected that Jorge was not dead at all. Not only did Jorge not die, but he was also unharmed.
"How is this possible? How did you do it?"
When Faris saw Jorge appear, his expression was filled with shock. He felt that Jorge would definitely die in that situation. There was no chance of him surviving at all.
But the reality was that Jorge had, indeed, survived.
"Faris, I admit that the power of this move of yours is indeed very shocking, but if you want to rely on this move to kill me, it's far from enough!" Jorge said slowly.
"No, no, no. This is absolutely impossible…" Faris couldn't accept that Jorge had easily dispelled his final trump card. His eyes were filled with disbelief.
"Nothing is impossible in this world!"
Jorge replied. Then, he rushed towards Faris.
Jorge's was very fast. In the blink of an eye, he was already in front of Faris.
At this moment, Faris was still in shock. Even though Jorge had already rushed in front of him, he still didn't have any reaction.
"Take my punch!" Jorge growled.
Jorge's punch was like a cannonball, flying straight towards Faris's chest.
Although this punch looked direct, no one doubted its power. After all, they all knew that the battle had reached the climax. Both Jorge and Faris did not hold back at all. Every move and every move was done with all their strength.
Faris suddenly looked up at Jorge in front of him. By the time he reacted, Jorge's fist was already in front of him.
He instinctively raised his hands in front of his chest, prepared to block Jorge's punch.
However, Jorge's punch was too strong, and Faris's reaction was a little slow, so it was impossible for him to block Jorge's punch.
"Boom!"
Jorge's fist landed on Faris's chest.
Faris spat out a mouthful of blood.
One had to know that Faris was a genuine ancient martial arts grandmaster. However, Jorge's punch was able to directly make him spit out blood. This was enough to prove how terrifying the power of this punch was.
However, Jorge didn't stop at all after this punch. He punched out again, another direct hit on Faris's chest.
Faris's body flew backward in an instant. He glided in the air for nearly ten meters and then smashed into the mountain, leaving a huge crater behind.
For a moment, everyone fell into deep shock after seeing this.
Because they all knew that after this punch, today's battle would be completely over.
"Grandmaster Jimenez lost?" a martial artist shouted in shock.
"That's right. I didn't expect Grandmaster Jimenez to still be defeated by Grandmaster Yarrell after so many years!" another Hondurian fighter stuttered.
At this moment, all the martial artists present did not know how to describe their feelings.
Connor stood on the spot and let out a long breath. After all, Connor was most worried about Jorge's safety. At this moment, Faris was already in such a state and probably couldn't continue to fight anymore. Therefore, Connor's emotions, which were originally constantly on edge, were now completely at ease.
Jorge walked up to Faris.
At this moment, Faris already did not have the strength to stand up at all.
"In the end, I was still defeated by you…"
Faris slowly raised his head and looked at Jorge. His voice was unusually weak.
"You've definitely improved a lot, so much so that I find it rather unbelievable. If this battle had taken place a few years later, your chances of winning might be higher, but now you're still too anxious!" Jorge replied calmly.
When Faris heard Jorge's words, he couldn't help but laugh bitterly and said, "A loss is a loss. You don't have to say such words to comfort me. Forget a few years, I wouldn't be a match for you even if I were given another 20 years!"

chapters.title: Chapter 1553: Lie Low for A While
chapters.content:
Chapter 1553: Lie Low for A While
"Hahaha!"
Jorge laughed.
"Just kill me!"
Faris looked at Jorge in despair.
"Kill you?" When Jorge heard Faris's words, he couldn't help but be stunned for a moment. Then, he shook his head gently and said with a calm expression, "I have no enmity with you, so why would I kill you?"
"You don't plan to kill me?"
Faris asked in shock.
"Killing you will not benefit me…" Jorge shook his head again. Then, he continued, "Your grandson was not killed by my disciple. You should know very well how he died. Therefore, I hope that you will not find trouble with my disciple. It is still unreasonable for such an adult to bully a child…"
"..."
Faris looked at Jorge, his expression a little helpless. He smiled bitterly and said, "Actually, I already knew that my grandson was not killed by your disciple. I merely wanted to use this opportunity to lure you out…"
"Is defeating me really that important to you?" Jorge was puzzled.
"It's more important than my life!"
Faris replied.
Jorge smiled helplessly, then turned around and left.
Faris lay on the ground and looked at Jorge's back. He couldn't help but laugh bitterly and then let out a long sigh.
Jorge walked up to Connor and said, "You should be able to handle the rest yourself, right?"
Connor's eyes were filled with excitement as he looked back at Jorge. He knew that if it wasn't for Jorge's appearance today, he might already be dead by now.
"I can handle it!" he replied.
"That's good!"
Jorge nodded lightly, then turned around and walked down the mountain.
"Old man, where are you going?"
Connor didn't expect Jorge to leave so quickly and hurriedly called out.
"Since you can handle the rest yourself. There's no need for me to stay here!" Jorge replied and continued to walk down the mountain.
As everyone watched on, Jorge slowly walked down Spring Mountain.
Although Jorge had defeated Faris today, he had paid a heavy price for it. He needed to find a quiet place to recuperate.
With Jorge's disappearance, this unprecedented battle had come to an end.
In the end, Jorge still defeated Faris.
Jorge's name had not been mentioned by martial artists for a long time, but after today's battle, his name would once again resound throughout Oprana.
Of course, the relationship between Connor and Jorge would also be known by countless people.
Besides, the battle today was not only between Jorge and Faris, but also between the martial artists from Honduria and the martial artists from Oprana.
After Jorge left, the martial artists present also followed suit.
Faris didn't go back on his word. He told Connor where he hid Yelena.
Connor left Spring Mountain immediately and found her. Because Yelena had consumed the Carefree Pill, she was still unconscious, so Connor decided not ro bring her back to Porthampton for now. Instead, he asked Waverly to bring her to the Purple Cloud Sect—they had the antidote to the Carefree Pill.
As for Palmer Bander and the others, they were all handed over to Chieko to deal with. In the end, Connor had Chieko manage the Bander family's businesses, the Lester family's businesses and the Dullahan family's businesses by herself.
In this case, Chieko would be the only one in charge of Honduria.
Chieko didn't expect that she would suddenly become a business queen of Honduria just because of her decision.
After Connor finished dealing with these matters, he boarded the plane alone and prepared to return to Newtown.
Although the events in Honduria had been dealt with, the real culprit had not been dealt with yet.
Connor knew that all of this was planned by Yaakov Ward, so this time, he would not let Yaakov off, no matter what.
…
Meanwhile, in Newtown.
When Tenner found out that Jorge had defeated Faris, he immediately called Yaakov.
"President Ward, something bad has happened. Faris Jimenez lost to Jorge Yarrell. Now, the whole of Honduria is under Connor's control. Moreover, Connor seems to have boarded the plane and is preparing to return to Newtown," Tenner shouted excitedly as soon as Yaakov picked up the phone.
"Palmer Bander is simply trash. You can lead a cow to water, but you can't make it drink, as they say!"
Yaakov gritted his teeth.
"The main reason is that Connor's strength is really too terrifying. We have really underestimated him…" Tenner hurriedly said after hearing that.
"That's right. I also did not expect that Connor would be able to return alive…" Yaakov replied.
"Then, President Ward, what should we do now? Connor must already know that we're framing him. He'll definitely take revenge on us…"
At this moment, Tenner had already completely understood how terrifying Connor's strength was. Therefore, he was very worried about Connor's revenge.
"You don't have to worry. Even if Connor already knows that all of this was planned by us, he won't be able to find us. During this period of time, don't show your face, and if possible, don't contact anyone. It's best if you lie low…" Yaakov said after thinking for a moment.
"What about you, President Ward?" Tenner asked after a moment of hesitation.
"I happen to have something that needs me to leave Newtown for a while, so don't contact me for the time being. If anything happens, I'll contact you immediately!" Yaakov said slowly.
"Alright, I got it!" Tenner replied helplessly.
After hearing this, Yaakov hung up the phone.
Tenner looked at his phone with an unusually helpless expression. He knew very well that Yaakov might really have no other choice this time, otherwise he would not have chosen to go away and lie low.
After all, what happened to Connor was really unexpected. Tenner originally thought that Connor would definitely die this time, but he did not expect him to survive instead.
Now, all of Yaakov and Tenner's plans had been completely disrupted.

chapters.title: Chapter 1554: Still Charming
chapters.content:
Chapter 1554: Still Charming
"Ding, ding, ding!"
At this moment, Tenner's phone suddenly rang.
When he looked down, he realized that Arthur was the one calling him.
"...."
After hesitating for two seconds, he answered the call.
"Hello?" Tenner said.
"Mr. Ward, something bad has happened. Jorge Yarrell actually defeated Faris Jimenez. Connor might be coming back…"
Arthur shouted excitedly.
"I know about this already…"
"Then, Mr. Ward, what should we do next? Does President Ward have any plans?"
"President Ward wants us to lie low for a while. This happened too suddenly, so he hasn't thought of what to do next..." Tenner said.
"He hasn't thought of what to do next?"
Arthur was dumbfounded when he heard Tenner's words.
"That's right, so don't contact me for the time being. If there's anything on President Ward's side, I'll look for you immediately. Do you understand what I mean?" Tenner said.
"Mr. Ward, don't joke with me!"
Arthur shouted excitedly.
"I'm not joking with you. Wait for my call!"
Tenner replied before hanging up.
On the other side, when Arthur saw that the call had been hung up on, he was dumbfounded. The expression on his face was also very broken.
The reason was very simple: neither Tenner nor Yaakov often showed their faces in public. Therefore, it was very easy for the two of them to lie low for a while. They just needed to find a place to hide.
However, Arthur was different. Most of the Synder family's businesses were under his control. If Arthur chose to leave Newtown, the Synder family would be greatly affected.
Therefore, it was simply impossible for Arthur to go out and hide for a while.
"These two old things, they f * cking ran away when something happened and left me alone…"
Arthur cursed in a low voice, then closed his eyes and began to think about what he should do next.
…
Two days later, Connor returned to Newtown.
Because Newtown was very far from the city, Connor had to spend two whole days to get home.
After arriving home, he found that Rachel was not in the house, but she also had not taken her luggage and clothes with her.
He took out his phone and dialed Rachel's number, but her phone was turned off.
Connor knew that Rachel was very powerful and was a Black-rank warrior herself. Her strength was very terrifying, and ordinary people couldn't do anything to her, so Connor wasn't very worried about her safety.
After washing up briefly, Connor returned to his bedroom and lay on the bed to rest.
Although Connor was a warrior now, he was tired after staying in Honduria for so long.
Connor slept from 10 pm to 9 am the next day.
When he woke up again, he found that Rachel was not back.
He took out his phone and dialed Rachel's number again, but her phone was turned off.
"Where did Rachel go?"
He instinctively muttered, the expression on his face puzzled.
One had to know that Rachel rarely disappeared for such a long time.
After Connor hesitated for a moment, he prepared to do serious things first. After all, Rachel should not be in any danger.
Connor took out his phone and dialed Reena's number.
"Mr. McDonald, you're back, right?"
Reena asked after picking up the call.
"Sure, let's meet!"
Connor replied indifferently.
"Alright, Mr. McDonald, I'll go find you now!"
"No need. Tell me a place and I'll go find you!" Connor said in a low voice.
"Good!"
Reena agreed and then set a meeting place with Connor.
An hour later, Connor arrived at the meeting place, which was a well-decorated clubhouse.
After entering the clubhouse, Connor told the waiter Reena's name and the waiter brought Connor into a private room.
After Connor entered the room, he found Reena making tea.
Today, Reena was wearing a white dress. Her perfect figure was extremely alluring when she was wearing the dress. Her waist was slender, and her legs were long. Coupled with her exquisite face, she looked exceptionally charming and sexy.
"Mr. McDonald, you're here!"
After Reena saw Connor enter the private room, she hurriedly greeted him with a smile.
"Reena, you seem to have become prettier again…"
Connor walked up to Reena and said with a smile.
"I'm an older woman. What's there to be beautiful about…"
Reena was naturally very happy to hear his words, but she remained humble.
"Reena, you're not old at all. Even if you tell me that you're twenty years old, I'd believe you…" Connor chuckled and sat on the chair.
"Mr. McDonald, you're just teasing me like this. If it was someone else, I definitely wouldn't let them off!"
Reena flirtatiously winked.
"Haha…"
Connor smiled and said, "Reena, let's talk about something serious. Have you found out where Yaakov and Tenner are?"
Although Connor had been in Honduria, he knew that Yaakov was the main culprit behind all this. Therefore, he had been asking Reena to investigate the exact location of Yaakov and Tenner.
"Mr. McDonald, I'm really sorry. We lost track of Tenner some time ago. He's very cunning, so I don't know his exact location now!"
Reena seemed to blame herself.
After hearing Reena's words, Connor looked at her helplessly and said, "It's fine. I don't blame you. After all, if it was really so easy to find out their exact location, I wouldn't have been stuck like this for such a long time…"
Although Connor said that, he was actually a little disappointed.
Since he had been in Honduria for a while, he felt that Yaakov and Tenner would definitely let their guard down at some point. This would be the best opportunity to find out the exact location of these two people.
But what Connor never expected was for Yaakov to be so cunning. Even at this time, he did not relax.

chapters.title: Chapter 1555: Go and Find Arthur Synder!
chapters.content:
Chapter 1555: Go and Find Arthur Synder!
"Mr. McDonald, although we haven't found out the location of Tenner and Yaakov, we've been monitoring someone…"
Reena suddenly said.
"Who is it?"
Connor hurriedly asked.
"Arthur Synder!"
Reena replied.
Connor couldn't help but be stunned after hearing this name. "Arthur Synder?" he repeated.
"Mr. McDonald, some time ago, Yaakov Ward and Tenner Ward joined forces with Arthur Synder in order to deal with you. I was thinking that even though we might not be able to find Yaakov and Tenner by ourselves, we might be able to find Tenner Ward through Arthur Synder. Once we do, finding Yaakov Ward will be all the more easier…" Reena analyzed.
Connor hesitated for two seconds. Then, he said in a low voice, "The method you mentioned is indeed the best one. This is the only thing we can do now…"
"Then shall I get someone to investigate Arthur now?"
Reena hurriedly said.
"There's no need. I don't have time to beat around the bush with them now. Just tell me Arthur's address and I'll go find him myself!" Connor said expressionlessly.
Previously, he had been worried that he would alert the enemy if he made too big a move. However, things were different now. Since Yaakov had already taken the initiative to attack Connor, there was no need for him to continue hiding.
"Mr. McDonald, are you planning to look for Arthur now?"
Reena said in surprise.
Connor slowly nodded. "That's right, I don't want to waste time!"
Reena sized up Connor. She knew that his strength was terrifying, so he shouldn't be in any danger, so she told him Arthur's exact location.
After Connor found out the location, he left the club and prepared to meet this old friend.
Now that Yaakov and Tenner were nowhere to be found, and Connor had no intention of letting them go this time, the simplest and most direct way for Connor was to follow the clues and find the melon, starting from Arthur.
As long as Connor could find Arthur, then he would have a way to find Yaakov.
…
Newtown, in a certain luxurious villa.
Arthur was hugging a girl with an extremely hot figure as he sat on the sofa and watched TV.
Although Tenner had already told Arthur to go out and lay low for the time being, the Synder family could not be compared to people like Tenner Ward and Yaakov Ward. Arthur had just recently accepted a big project. If he left now, it would be a huge loss for the Synder family that they could not afford.
Therefore, in the end, Arthur did not choose to leave Newtown. Instead, he planned to hide out in his villa in the suburbs for a few days and leave after the storm passed.
The girl in Arthur's arms looked a little similar to Freya Phillips. He had gotten this girl as a substitute because he had never been able to woo Freya.
"Ding dong!"
At this moment, the doorbell suddenly rang.
After Arthur heard the doorbell ring, the expression on his face became nervous.
He hadn't told anyone that he was here, so he felt that something was wrong when someone suddenly rang the doorbell.
The sexy beauty in his arms did not know Arthur's current situation at all and asked in a puzzled tone, "Darling, what's wrong?"
"Did the doorbell ring just now?"
Arthur said suspiciously.
"Yeah, the doorbell rang. My takeout's probably here…" the girl hurriedly replied.
"Your takeout?"
Arthur was stunned when he heard the girl's words.
"That's right. I'm not used to your nanny's cooking, so I ordered takeout…" the girl explained.
After hearing the girl's words, the expression on Arthur's face relaxed a lot. Then, he said in a low voice, "If you want to eat anything in the future, just ask the nanny to go out and buy it. Don't order takeout…"
"Oh, okay!"
Although the girl didn't know why Arthur did this, she didn't say much. She took off her shoes and went to the door. Then, she looked outside through the peephole and found that it was indeed a delivery man, so she opened the door.
However, just as the girl opened the door, it was kicked open from the outside.
"Ahh!"
The girl screamed instinctively.
Connor let go of the delivery man and walked into the villa.
At this moment, the delivery man was already dumbfounded. He threw down the food in his hands and turned around to run away.
"Who are you?"
The girl shouted at Connor excitedly.
Connor looked at the girl indifferently and didn't say anything, instead walking straight towards Arthur.
Arthur, who was sitting on the sofa, was stunned. He looked at Connor in front of him with a trembling face.
"Arthur, long time no see!"
Connor sat beside Arthur as he spoke.
Arthur did not know how to describe his feelings at this time. After all, he did not expect Connor to come to his door so quickly.
Arthur sat on the sofa as if he was sitting on pins and needles and stammered, "You... What are you doing? Connor, I advise you not to do anything rash. Let me tell you..."
"Don't be so nervous. As long as you behave yourself, I won't hurt you!" Connor laughed.
In his eyes, Arthur was just a shrimp. He felt like it would be a waste of effort to make a move on Arthur at all.
"You... What are you trying to do?"
Arthur shouted nervously.
"Where is Tenner Ward?"
Connor in a low voice.
"I... I don't know..."
Arthur hesitated for a moment before shaking his head at Connor.
"You don't know?"
When Connor heard Arthur's words, he could not help but laugh. Then, he reached out and grabbed Arthur's right hand, then applied a little force and broke one of Arthur's fingers.
"Ahh!"
Arthur couldn't help but let out a miserable cry, a pained expression on his face.
At this moment, the girl standing at the door was already scared silly. She sat on the ground, tears flowing uncontrollably. Her small hands covered her mouth as she tried not to make a sound.
Connor narrowed his eyes and said, "Arthur, I've already made it very clear just now. As long as you're honest, I promise I won't hurt you. But if you play tricks on me, then don't blame me for being rude!"

chapters.title: Chapter 1556: A Clue to Find Tenner Ward
chapters.content:
Chapter 1556: A Clue to Find Tenner Ward
After hearing his words, Arthur's expression was abnormally ferocious. He gritted his teeth and said, "Connor, I really don't know!"
"Snap!"
Connor did not waste any words at all and broke a second finger.
"Where is Tenner?"
Connor asked expressionlessly.
"I... I really don't know!"
Perhaps because of the intense pain, Arthur's voice had already begun to tremble.
"Haha…"
When Connor heard Arthur's words, he could not help but sneer. Then, he said expressionlessly, "I didn't expect you to have such backbone…"
After saying this, Connor suddenly exerted force and broke Arthur's third finger.
"Ah…"
This time, Arthur's scream seemed to be even more painful.
"Where is Tenner?" His voice sounded like a demon in Arthur's ears.
"I beg you, please..."
Arthur shouted at Connor with an abnormally painful expression.
Connor did not react after hearing Arthur's words. Instead, he prepared to break Arthur's fourth finger, but Arthur quickly shouted, "Connor, I really don't know where Tenner is. Even if you beat me to death today, I wouldn't know! If you don't believe me, you can use my phone to call Tenner now!"
After Connor heard Arthur's words, he slowly stopped his actions, then looked up and down at Arthur, and asked expressionlessly, "Do you really not know anything?"
"Mate, if I knew, I would have told you long ago. Why would I still suffer here?"
Arthur held his right hand and shouted with a painful expression.
"Since you don't know anything, I will kill you directly. This way, you will suffer less…" Connor said lightly.
Arthur was instantly dumbfounded when he heard his words because he did not expect Connor to be so ruthless and actually intend to kill him directly.
..
Arthur's home.
After Connor finished speaking, he directly used his right hand to grab Arthur's neck.
"C…Connor…"
Arthur instinctively opened his mouth to speak, but unfortunately, Connor was gripping him very tightly, instantly making him feel suffocated.
This might be the first time Arthur experienced the feeling of death. He began to struggle, a labored expression on his face.
However, Connor did not seem to have the intention of letting Arthur off.
Arthur could feel that Connor might really intend to kill him at this moment.
"Connor, I…Although I don't know where Tenner is now, I… have a way for you to find him…"
Arthur almost used all his strength to say this.
After hearing Arthur's words, Connor revealed a satisfied smile and then slowly released his right hand.
"Cough cough…"
After Arthur was released, he lay on the ground and coughed violently.
Connor did not say anything. In fact, he did not want to kill Arthur at all. He just hoped to use this method to force the truth out of him.
Arthur did not say that he knew Tenner's exact location, which meant that he really did not know anything.
"Just now, you said that you have a way to find Tenner, right?" Connor asked in a low voice.
"Yes, yes, I have a way!"
Arthur no longer dared to play tricks on Connor and could only reply honestly.
"Tell me, what is it?"
"It's like this. Tenner doesn't usually have any special hobbies. He just likes to play with women, and only married women at that. Some time ago, he hooked up with a young woman. The two of them have only known each other for less than half a year, but Tenner likes this young woman very much. He has mentioned this woman to me more than once, so I think that even if Tenner is hiding now, he will definitely find an opportunity to meet up with her. So, if you want to find Tenner, the easiest way is to find this woman first!" Arthur said.
"Tenner actually has such…interests?"
Connor couldn't help but laugh coldly, and then asked indifferently, "What's the name of this woman you're talking about?"
"Michelle Hicks…"
Arthur hurriedly replied, then continued, "This Michelle is a lecturer at Newtown Experimental High School. You can easily find out about her with a casual investigation. As long as you start with this Michelle, I guarantee that you will be able to find Tenner…"
Connor knew that Arthur should not be lying at this time, so he slowly stood up and said to Arthur expressionlessly, "I hope everything you said was real. From today onwards, you will stay here. only when I find Tenner will you leave this place. If I find out that you lied to me or that you triedto sneak away, I will let you know what a life that is worse than death!"
"I'm not lying to you!"
Arthur hurriedly shouted.
Connor glanced at Arthur indifferently and said nothing. Instead, he strode out of the villa.
At this moment, Reena's spies were all outside Arthur's villa, so it was basically impossible for him to leave anyway.
After Connor left the villa, he called Reena and asked her to investigate Tenner's mistress, Michelle Hicks.
Reena was very efficient; in less than two hours, she sent all the information about Michelle to his email.
When Connor got home, he opened his email to check up on this Michelle woman..
To his surprise, she was not a simple woman and had many lovers around her. It wasn't just Tenner, either; her neighbors, colleagues, and even her boss were also related to her.
However, after Michelle got together with Tenner, she cut off all contact with the others.
After all, Tenner was very influential in the city. It would be easy for him to monopolize her.

chapters.title: Chapter 1557: Ms. Michelle Hicks
chapters.content:
Chapter 1557: Ms. Michelle Hicks
Michelle Hicks was an English lecturer at Newtown Experimental High School. She was from a normal family, and her parents were employees of a certain unit.
Michelle, on the other hand, graduated from a normal university, and her grades were average.
However, according to Michelle's situation, she probably wouldn't be able to become a lecturer in Newtown Experimental High School.
After all, that school was very well-known in Newtown. It was only because Michelle had a relationship with a school leader that she was able to become a lecturer to begin with.
Michelle and Tenner met each other in a very simple manner. They fell in love at first sight in a bar and got together.
After all, Tenner often went to bars to hook up with young women, and Michelle liked to go to bars to look for the man she liked, the two of them could be considered to have the same taste.
However, Connor never expected Michelle to have a husband. Even now, she and her husband were still married.
Connor was ready to go to Michelle after reading the information. He knew very well that she was the key to finding Tenner.
When he left the house, Connor found that Rachel still hadn't returned. This made Connor feel that something was wrong. After all, Rachel had never disappeared for such a long time. Even if something had happened, she wouldn't turn off her phone.
Connor called her a few times, but her phone was switched off. However, the only thing he could do was to go and find Michelle first.
After all, there were a lot of things he had to do, so he didn't take Rachel's disappearance to heart just yet.
After leaving his home, Connor drove straight to a residential area in Newtown and found Michelle's home based on the information provided by Reena.
It was already past eight in the evening by now, so Michelle was definitely at home.
Moreover, this place was the house that Tenner and Michelle had bought. The two of them usually went on dates here. Michelle's husband often went on business trips, so Michelle had been staying here recently while waiting for Tenner to come over.
Connor stood in front of the door and hesitated for two seconds before knocking on the door.
"Just a minute!"
Soon, a woman's voice came from the room. Her voice was very pleasant.
"Creak…"
A few seconds later, the door was opened from the inside.
Connor was just about to walk into the room when a fragrance assaulted him.
Because the lights in the corridor had been extinguished, Michelle did not see his face clearly. Instead, she thought that Connor was Tenner. She reached out and hugged him, saying coquettishly, "Hubby, why haven't you come over for a few days? I miss you so much…"
..
"Uh..."
After Connor heard Michelle's words, he looked a little helpless.
Michelle also seemed to feel that something was wrong. She quickly let go of Connor and took two steps back. Then, she turned on the lights in the room.
When Michelle saw Connor in front of her, she asked in surprise, "Who are you?"
Connor did not answer Michelle's question. Instead, he walked into the room and observed the situation inside.
"Who are you? Who let you in? Hurry up and get out!"
Michelle shouted nervously.
Connor glanced at her indifferently. It had to be said that she was indeed the best of the best. Although she was already in her early thirties, she looked like a twenty-year-old girl.
Michelle's face was very delicate and beautiful. Her wavy hair was casually draped over her shoulders. She was wearing a black lace nightgown, and her slender and fair legs were covered with black stockings, coupled with a pair of white high heels. Her perfect figure was faintly discernible, and she was very seductive. It was obvious that Michelle was dressed like this to wait for Tenner.
What are you looking at? Didn't you hear me?"
Michelle noticed that there was something wrong with his eyes. She subconsciously tidied up her clothes and shouted at Connor excitedly.
At this moment, Michelle was also very afraid because she did not know who Connor was. However, since he'd come to her, it meant that he had a purpose for doing so.
After Connor briefly sized up Michelle, he sat on the sofa and smiled. "Ms. Hicks, please take a seat!"
Michelle was stunned again when she heard Zhang Lei's words. Her expression was abnormally shocked because she did not expect the young man in front of her to know her name.
At this moment, Michelle simply wanted to call for help, but she didn't have a phone at all. Her phone was in the bedroom.
Connor pursed his lips. "Ms. Hicks, I advise you not to act rashly. Let's sit down and have a good chat. Otherwise, I can only use other methods. If I want to do something to you, you might not even have the chance to resist!"
Michelle looked at him from head to toe. She knew very well that if he really wanted to do anything to her, she would not be able to escape.
So in the end, Michelle chose to sit opposite him.
Connor looked at Michelle from head to toe and said lightly, "Ms. Hicks, you really are very beautiful. No wonder Tenner is reluctant to part with you…"
"Tenner?"
When Michelle heard Connor mention this name, her expression became even more shocked. She did not expect Connor to know about her relationship with Tenner.
"Who exactly are you? What do you want?" she asked in a low voice.
"Where is Tenner Ward?" Connor immediately asked. He didn't want to waste any more time.
"Where is Tenner Ward?"
Michelle's expression was a little strange, and then she said expressionlessly, "I don't know where Tenner is either!"
"Ms. Hicks, there's no enmity between the two of us. I don't want to hurt you, so you just have to cooperate with me. If you don't cooperate, don't blame me for being rude!"
Connor said expressionlessly.
When Michelle heard his words, she couldn't help but sneer. Then, she said in a low voice, "Since you already know about my relationship with Tenner, I'll be straightforward: you know what kind of person Tenner is. Offending him won't do you any good. I don't know what your purpose for coming here today is, but I advise you to leave now."

chapters.title: Chapter 1558: You? My Lover?
chapters.content:
Chapter 1558: You? My Lover?
Although Michelle did not know what Tenner did for a living, she knew that his power was terrifying.
Therefore, she planned to use her identity as his mistress to scare Connor.
Connor sneered. Then, he said lightly, "Ms. Hicks, are you threatening me?"
"You can interpret it however you want, but I advise you to leave this place quickly!" Michelle said expressionlessly.
"Haha…"
Connor looked at Michelle with a faint smile and then said, "Ms. Hicks, I think you should understand the current situation. I'm here for Tenner, so your threat is useless to me…"
Michelle looked at his face and felt a little strange. She didn't expect Connor to not be afraid at all.
"Ms. Hicks, I know you very well. You have a young and promising husband, and you have a good relationship with him. You even have a daughter together, but because of your husband's work, he needs to go on business trips frequently, while you stay alone in an empty room!"
Connor said slowly.
Michelle looked at his expression and asked in a low voice, "What are you trying to say?"
"It's been so many years. You must have cheated on your husband many times by now, right?"
Connor asked.
"Nonsense!"
Michelle's expression was a little angry as she shouted at him.
"Nonsense, you say?" Connor couldn't help but laugh. Then, he said indifferently, "In the school you teach at, there are already ten people who have slept with you. Do you think I'm talking nonsense?"
"This is slander!"
Michelle didn't seem to want to admit it.
"Whether it's slander or not, I'll show you a video and you'll know the truth!"
After saying this, Connor threw his phone to Michelle.
Although Reena did not manage to find any videos of Michelle and Tenner together, there were many videos of Michelle with other men.
There were three videos in total, all three of them featured Michelle with three different men.
Michelle was dumbfounded when she saw his phone. Her expression was also very incredulous because she herself did not know that these videos existed. She could not figure out where Connor got these videos.
"Ms. Hicks, do you still think I'm talking nonsense?"
Connor asked with a smile.
Michelle's expression was extremely ugly, and her body was trembling slightly. She asked Connor in a low voice, "Who exactly are you? Where did you get these videos?"
Connor slowly said, "Ms. Hicks, it doesn't matter who I am anymore. What's important is what I'm going to tell you next!" Connor declared.
"What exactly do you want?" Michelle asked, biting her lip.
"I know that you have a very good relationship with your husband. You cheated on him only because your husband was often away from home, and you couldn't stand the loneliness, so you fell deeper and deeper," Connor started.
After Michelle heard his words, she couldn't help but slowly raise her head to look at Connor. Then, she asked, "How did you find out about these things?"
"You don't need to know about that," Connor replied indifferently and then continued, "I just need you to tell me Tenner Ward's location now!"
"I don't know where he is!"
Michelle shook her head without any hesitation.
"You don't seem to understand your current situation!"
Connor sighed, then continued, "Ms. Hicks, your husband probably doesn't know that you've cheated on him so many times, right? If I post all these videos online, what will your husband think of you? What would your family and friends think? Are you really planning to be with Tenner Ward forever?"
Michelle's expression changed when she heard his words. She hurriedly shouted at Connor, "Don't…I beg you, don't post them online..."
Although Michelle had cheated on her husband, she only wanted to get something from Tenner. She had no intention of divorcing her husband at all. Once these videos were really uploaded online by Connor, Michelle's life might be ruined.
Moreover, Michelle had another very important reason for being together with Tenner, which was to help her husband's career go smoothly. However, if her husband found out that Michelle had cheated on him with so many men, then he would definitely choose to divorce her.
"Are you scared?"
Connor asked with a smile.
"I'm begging you. As long as you don't post these videos online, I'll do anything you want. I can also be your lover…" Michelle shouted pitifully.
"You? My lover?" Connor couldn't help but laugh when he heard Michelle's words. "I don't lack women…"
"Then what do you want?"
"As I said earlier, I only want to know Tenner Ward's exact location!" Connor said.
After Michelle heard his words, her expression seemed to break down. She bit her lip and said, "I don't know where Tenner is either!"
"You're his mistress. How can you not know where he is?"
Connor could not help but frown slightly.
"I'm indeed Tenner's lover, but Tenner never let me take the initiative to contact him. If he wants to see me, he will send a text message telling me to wait for him here. A few days ago, I called him, but his phone was turned off, so I don't know where Tenner is at all."
Michelle said anxiously.
Connor looked at Michelle's expression helplessly. He did not expect Tenner to be so cautious.
"Ms. Hicks, since you can't contact Tenner, I guess I'll have to post this video online!" he said.
"Don't…!" Michelle hurriedly shouted and continued, "How about this? Although I can't contact Tenner, he'll definitely come look for me after a while. Once that happens, I'll let you know immediately. What do you think?"

chapters.title: Chapter 1559: Rachel Wallace's News
chapters.content:
Chapter 1559: Rachel Wallace's News
Connor looked at Michelle from head to toe. He knew that he had footage of her in his hands now, so she probably wouldn't dare to fool him.
"How do you know that Tenner will definitely contact you?" Connor frowned and asked.
"Tenner has already fallen head over heels for me. Every few days, he will come to look for me, so I know that he will definitely do it again…"
Michelle said with certainty.
"I'll give you five days. If I don't see Tenner within that time frame, I'll post this video on the Internet," Connor said expressionlessly, then gave Michelle his phone number. Then, he stood up and walked out of the room.
Michelle looked at his back, her eyes filled with despair. She might not even know who Connor was, and she could only hope that Tenner would come and find her soon.
…
Connor drove home alone after leaving Michelle's house.
Although Connor had not found Tenner yet, he felt that Michelle should have a way to find him. It was just a matter of time, so he just had to wait patiently.
After reaching home, Connor found that Rachel still hadn't come back.
He felt that something was wrong. Rachel didn't have any friends in Newtown, so there was no reason for her to disappear for so long.
Connor hesitated for a long time. In the end, he took out his phone and dialed Justin's number.
"Justin, have you seen Ms. Wallace recently?" Connor asked.
Justin thought for a moment and replied, "Ms. Wallace seems to have taken leave…"
"Leave?" Connor could not help but be stunned when he heard Justin's words. Then, he asked in a puzzled tone, "Then do you know why she took leave?"
"I'm not too sure about this either…" Justin slowly replied and then continued, "Why are you looking for Ms. Wallace?"
"It's not a big deal…"
Connor explained helplessly.
"Then what do you plan to do back in school?" Justin asked again.
"I've been a little busy recently. I'll hang up first. I'll explain more when I have time," Connor replied in a low voice and then hung up the phone.
After hanging up the phone, Connor felt that Rachel must have something to do before she left, so he took out his phone and dialed her number again.
This time, Rachel's phone didn't tell him that it was turned off, but no one picked up the phone even after it rang for a long time.
"F * ck, why aren't you picking up the phone?"
Connor's expression was a little helpless, and then he dialed the phone again.
He was inwardly very worried. Although Rachel's skills were very terrifying, it didn't mean that she was really invincible. If she encountered someone more powerful than her, then she would definitely be in danger.
So at this time, his expression grew solemn. After all, the matter with Yelena had just passed, and Connor was very worried that the people around him were in danger.
After calling Rachel seven or eight times, the other party did not pick up, so he could only put down his phone helplessly.
"Where did Rachel go?"
Connor looked at his phone and muttered with a puzzled expression.
"Ding, ding, ding…"
But at this moment, his phone suddenly rang.
Connor instinctively looked down and saw that it was Rachel calling, so he picked up the phone without any hesitation.
"Rachel, what are you doing? Why didn't you pick up my calls?" Connor asked anxiously.
"I was on the plane just now, and my phone was turned off!"
Rachel sounded rather troubled.
"Plane?"
When Connor heard Rachel's words, he could not help but be stunned for a moment. Then, he asked in a puzzled tone, Where did you go? What happened?"
"It's something about my family. It has nothing to do with you…" Rachel replied.
"Your family matters?"
After Connor heard Rachel's words, the expression on his face grew even more confused. He hurriedly asked, "What happened to your family? Do you need my help?"
"No need. Alright, I'm hanging up now!"
Rachel said and then promptly hung up the phone.
Connor looked at his phone with an expression of doubt. He could feel that Rachel was very anxious at this time, but he couldn't understand why.
Although Connor and Rachel hadn't known each other for a long time, this was the first time he'd ever seen her be so anxious.
…
On the other side, in York Airport.
After Rachel hung up the phone with Connor, she ran out of the airport in a hurry. She stood in front of the airport and glanced at the crowd in front of her before running towards a young man in his thirties.
"Rachel, you're back?"
The young man shouted anxiously when he saw her.
"How is grandfather?" Rachel hurriedly asked.
"He's in the emergency room. I'm not too sure about the exact situation…" the young man replied.
After Rachel heard the young man's words, her expression grew even more nervous. She hurriedly said, "Get in the car and go to the hospital now!"
"Right!"
The young man didn't waste any time. He opened the door and followed Rachel into a black Audi.
