This young man was Ferdinand Wallace, the eldest son of Rachel's third uncle. He was slightly older than Rachel.
Although Ferdinand was only thirty-five years old, he was already the company commander of a certain military region. It must be known that being able to become a company commander at such a young age was a rare existence. His future was limitless.
Although the Wallace family wasn't very famous in York, their influence was very terrifying. Even the top families in York were insignificant in front of the Wallace family. It was only because the Wallace family had always been very low-key that very few people knew about the Wallace family's background.
At this time, Rachel was sitting in an Audi with a license plate with an unusual number: 499 Ordinary people would never be able to get their hands on such a license plate, and yet to the Wallace family, this was normal—it was usually used by people like Ferdinand, who were third-generation descendants. The license plate numbers used by the elders in the second generation were five, eight, five, and nine.
Rachel sat in the car with an unusually nervous expression.

chapters.title: Chapter 1560: The Pillar of the Wallace Family
chapters.content:
Chapter 1560: The Pillar of the Wallace Family
A few days ago, Rachel suddenly received a call from Ferdinand when she was teaching a class.
On the phone, Ferdinand told her that her grandfather had suddenly fainted and entered the intensive care unit. He wasn't in good condition.
This was also the reason why Rachel suddenly disappeared and took a plane back to York.
Although the Wallace family was an ancient martial arts family, Rachel's grandfather was also a Black-rankmartial artist.
However, he was already ninety years old now. Even martial artists at this age would have various problems with their bodies.
Of course, ancient martial arts grandmasters like Faris Jimenez and Jorge Yarrell didn't count—after all, there was a huge gap between ancient martial arts grandmasters and ordinary people.
Rachel's parents had passed away when she was very young, so she had always lived by her grandfather's side. Rachel's feelings for her grandfather were definitely not something that ordinary people could relate to.
When Rachel was very young, his grandfather had forced her to practice martial arts, not so that she could do something for the Wallace family in the future, but because he hoped that she would have the ability to protect the family when he was not around one day.
In this world, the person Rachel cared about the most was probably her grandfather.
"Grandpa, you need to be fine. I haven't done what I promised you…"
Rachel bit her lips tightly and looked at the scenery outside the car window.
Ferdinand turned his head and glanced at her. At this time, he knew clearly that Rachel must be very anxious, so the car drove very fast.
In less than half an hour, the car stopped in front of the hospital.
After getting out of the car, Rachel hurriedly ran in, but her grandfather, Janson Wallace, had not left the operating room yet.
There were many people standing outside the operating theater right now. All of them were from the Wallace family. Any one of them could be a big shot in York. At this moment, these people's expressions were very anxious.
Rachel walked up to a middle-aged man and asked him nervously, "Uncle, how is Grandpa now?"
"Oh, Rachel, you're here?" The middle-aged man raised his head and glanced at Rachel before saying in a low voice, "We don't know the exact situation now. We have to wait for the doctor to come out…"
After Rachel heard the middle-aged man's words, her expression became a little ugly. Then, she frowned and said, "Uncle, why did grandpa fall sick all of a sudden?"
"He's getting old, and his body is getting worse day by day. Fortunately, his cultivation level is really high, so he can still hold on, if barely. However, this time, I don't think he can hold on for much longer," the middle-aged man explained.
After Rachel heard his words, her expression became even more solemn.
Although the middle-aged man's words were very tactful, Rachel understood what he meant; although her grandfather was a martial artist, he was already over ninety years old. He probably wouldn't be able to hold on for too long.
"Grandpa, you have to hold on. I haven't fulfilled your wish yet!"
Rachel looked at the operating theater and could not help but pray silently in her heart.
…
In front of the operating room of a certain hospital in York, everyone in the Wallace family stood in front of the operating room and waited. At this moment, each and every one of them were very nervous.
Some people were worried about Janson's condition, while others were worried about the impact on them if Janson really died.
Janson had always been the biggest pillar of the Wallace family. He had a very terrifying influence in the political world, the business world, and the military world, and his connections were even more so. This was how the Wallace family had been able to develop smoothly in all walks of life for so many years.
However, if anything happened to Janson, it would have a very big impact on these people of the Wallace family. These people were all worried that their interests would be affected, and there were very few people who really cared about the health of the old man.
Rachel stood in front of the operating room with an unusually nervous expression on her face. She was probably one of the few people who really cared about Janson's health.
After some time, the door of the operating theater was finally opened.
A doctor in a white coat walked out of the operating theater with a tired expression.
After Rachel saw the doctor, she hurriedly stepped forward and asked anxiously, "Doctor, how's my grandfather's condition?"
"Yeah, was the surgery successful?"
"Dr. Cheka, what's going on?"
Everyone from the Wallace family also came forward.
The doctor took out a towel and wiped the sweat off his face. Then, he said, "Everyone, don't worry. This operation was very successful, but because the patient is really too old, there's no way for him to wake up for the time being. It'll probably take a few more days before he wakes up…"
"Doctor, what exactly is wrong with my grandfather?"
Rachel asked the doctor.
"The old man is too old. In addition, there are many old injuries on his body and some blood clots in his brain, so the situation is a little troublesome. We have already helped the old man remove a portion of the blood clots. That said, some of the blood clots are located in sensitive areas. If we were to operate on them, it might cause even greater damage, so we left them in place. We can only rely on medication to treat them at a later date..." the doctor explained.
When Rachel heard the doctor's words, she was stunned. The expression on her face was also very desperate.
Although the doctor didn't say it directly, Rachel could hear what the doctor meant. It was obvious that Janson wouldn't live for long in his current state, so even if the operation was very successful, it was just delaying the inevitable. There was no way to solve the problem at all.
"Everyone, you can go in to see the patriarch later, but try not to let too many people go in at once. Don't disturb the patient's rest!"
The doctor said this to everyone expressionlessly, then turned around and left.
At this moment, the expressions of the Wallace family members were very ugly. After all, if anything happened to Janson, the impact on the Wallace family would be very terrifying.
A moment later, they entered the ward.
However, Janson was unconscious at the moment. In addition, the ward was not very big, so most people only took a look at Janson before leaving.
In the end, only Rachel and her uncle were left in the ward.
"Rachel, you must be tired after just coming back. Why don't you go back and rest?"
Rachel's uncle suggested.
"Uncle, I'm fine. I haven't seen my grandfather in such a long time. Let me stay here to keep him company today…" Rachel replied.
Her uncle was aware of the relationship between Rachel and Janson, so he took a deep breath and did not say anything more, instead turning around and walking out of the ward.

chapters.title: Chapter 1561: Poaching
chapters.content:
Chapter 1561: Poaching
On the other side.
After knowing that Rachel Wallace was fine, Connor did not continue to call her.
If Michelle Hicks wanted to find Tenner Ward, she would need to wait, so Connor wasn't in a hurry.
Connor had not been to Heavens Club recently.
Therefore, since he had nothing to do now, he thought that he should go to Heavens Club to take a look.
Connor then drove to Heavens Club.
Although Connor hadn't been here for a long time, the business at Heavens Club was still very good under Vanessa's management. Of course, this was also due to the famous guests invited by Connor during the opening ceremony.
After Connor entered the clubhouse, he realized that he had not been here for a long time. Many of the new waiters did not know who he was and did not even let Connor in.
In the end, he finally met a waiter who knew him, and the waiter brought him into Heavens Club.
After entering Heavens Club, Connor went straight to Vanessa Canfield's office and knocked on the door cautiously.
"Come in!"
Vanessa's voice rang.
Connor walked into Vanessa's office with a smile.
"Vanessa, long time no see!"
Connor laughed and exclaimed.
When Vanessa heard Connor, she couldn't help but raise her head to look at him. She was somewhat surprised as she said softly, "Mr. McDonald, you actually remember that you have a clubhouse?"
"Vanessa, I had something to deal with a while ago, so I've been in Honduria…"
Connor explained awkwardly.
Today, Vanessa was dressed very beautifully. She was wearing a tight black T-shirt, revealing her perfect collarbone, and a pair of denim shorts. She was wearing a pair of high heels, which matched her beautiful face. She was simply the best of the best.
"Mr. McDonald, you sure are busy. What instructions do you have for me today?"
Vanessa asked lightly.
"What instructions would I have for you? I just wanted to ask if you've encountered any problems recently."
Connor laughed and replied.
"Not at all!"
Vanessa gently shook her head.
After all, Vanessa had been managing Heavens Club for so many years.
Therefore, even though the boss was different, it would not affect Vanessa.
"That's good…"
Connor lightly nodded, then sized up Vanessa and said with a smile, "Vanessa, you've been working in Heavens Club for so many years. Do you have feelings for this place?"
"Of course!"
Vanessa gently nodded.
"That's good…"
When Connor heard Vanessa's answer, he quickly nodded, then continued, "Then, what do you think of me?"
...
"What about you?"
Vanessa was stunned when she heard Connor's words. Then, she looked at him with a puzzled expression as she asked softly, "Why are you suddenly asking me this question?"
"It's nothing. I was just curious…"
Connor said to Vanessa with a smile.
Vanessa looked at Connor with a serious expression, then said with a blank expression, "I think you're just meh."
"Why? How did I offend you?"
Connor exclaimed with a puzzled expression.
"Don't you know what you did to offend me? Anyway, you're just meh to me."
Vanessa said lightly.
When Connor heard Vanessa's words, he felt a bit awkward, and then he said softly, "Vanessa, let's not consider character and personal feelings now. As a boss, what do you think of me?"
"As a boss?"
Vanessa looked at Connor and hesitated for a couple of seconds, then lightly said, "Although you're not responsible as a boss, you're fine, I guess. At least you trust me!"
"That means you think I'm qualified to be a boss, right?"
Connor asked Vanessa excitedly.
"What exactly are you trying to say?"
Vanessa frowned and asked Connor.
"Then, Vanessa, why don't you stay here and be my general manager? I'll give you a portion of the shares. What do you think?"
Connor really couldn't find someone who could replace Vanessa, and even if he found someone, he still felt that Vanessa was the most suitable for the position of general manager of Heavens Club, so Connor didn't plan to let Vanessa leave.
If Vanessa were to leave, then it would definitely be a loss for Connor.
"I don't have the final say in this matter. You should go to Chelsea to discuss this!"
Vanessa replied when she finally understood what Connor meant.
"Vanessa, you are you, and Chelsea is Chelsea. Why should we discuss our matters with her? Just tell me, do you want to stay here? If you're not satisfied with the treatment, you can tell me now. As long as it's within my means, I'll definitely do it…"
Connor's tone was unusually serious as he spoke to Vanessa.
"Connor, you're really unethical. You're actually trying to poach Vanessa while I'm not around!"
But at this moment, a woman's voice suddenly came from Vanessa's bedroom.
Connor was stunned when he heard the voice.
Tap, tap...
Then, there was the sound of high heels hitting the ground.
Chelsea Lee was wearing a white skirt that was wrapped around her hips. She walked out of the bedroom gracefully.
Chelsea was dressed very beautifully today, especially her beautiful legs. They were the best of the best, slender, fair, and straight.
In this world, no woman's legs could be as alluring as Chelsea's.
However, Connor was not in the mood to appreciate these things because he did not know that Chelsea was actually in Vanessa's bedroom.
"Connor, you're really bold for trying to snatch my people!"
Chelsea walked up to Connor in her high heels and shouted at him angrily.
"Why are you here?"
Connor asked Chelsea helplessly.
"Can't I come here to play with Vanessa?"
Chelsea pouted and replied, then continued, "I heard what you said to Vanessa just now. How do you plan to make it up to me?"
"Why do I have to make it up to you?"
Connor asked speechlessly.
"Aren't you going to give me an explanation for the fact that you secretly tried to poach her behind my back?"
Chelsea asked Connor.
"What explanation do you want?"
Connor asked helplessly.

chapters.title: Chapter 1562: Going Somewhere
chapters.content:
Chapter 1562: Going Somewhere
Chelsea looked at Connor, then pursed his lips and said, "How about this? Go somewhere with me later and I'll forgive you…"
"Go somewhere with you?"
When Connor heard Chelsea's words, he could not help but be stunned for a moment. Then, he asked with a puzzled expression, "Where?"
"You will know when you arrive…"
Chelsea was short with him, then turned to Vanessa and said, "Vanessa, there's no point in you staying here. Come with us…"
"No, thanks!"
Vanessa said after a moment of hesitation.
"What's the point of staying here alone? Come and play with us…"
Chelsea pulled Vanessa and said.
Vanessa hesitated for a moment before helplessly nodding. After which, she softly said, "I'll go get changed…"
"Go on…"
Chelsea hurriedly said.
Vanessa turned around and walked into the bedroom.
Chelsea looked at Connor, then asked him with a smile, "Connor, what do you want to do with Vanessa?"
"What else? I just hope that Vanessa can stay with me forever. Other than that, I don't want to do anything else with her!"
Connor retorted.
"Just admit it. If you like her, then so be it. Even a woman like me would be tempted by her figure. If you really like her, I can help matchmake the two of you. I can tell you that she is very, very sexy…"
Chelsea said seductively to Connor.
"No, thanks. I already have a fiancée…"
Connor said helplessly.
"So what if you have a fiancée? You men are all the same. Do you dare to say that you really don't have any desire for Vanessa?"
Chelsea pouted and asked Connor.
Connor felt awkward when he heard what Chelsea said. He really didn't dare to say it.
After all, for a sexy woman like Vanessa, any normal man would want to do something with her. This was the most primitive impulse.
"You men have an impulse toward women with good figures and beautiful looks. You don't have to pretend with me here…"
Seeing that Connor was being quiet, Chelsea continued.
"Don't joke around with me, okay? I don't have any such thoughts about Vanessa!"
Connor said helplessly to Chelsea.
Chelsea looked at Connor, then pursed her lips and said, "Since you have no feelings for Vanessa, why did you secretly peek at her when she was changing?"
"I didn't do it on purpose!"
Connor shouted as he was on the verge of collapse.
Chelsea, on the other hand, showed a very disdainful expression and said indifferently, "You know better than anyone whether you did it on purpose or not."
...
"You…"
Connor was about to retort when he heard footsteps.
Vanessa changed into a black short skirt and walked out of the bedroom. Vanessa was tall and slender, with a pair of slender white legs under the short skirt, emitting a seductive aura.
Connor instinctively glanced at Vanessa's beautiful legs. Vanessa's figure and temperament were comparable to Chelsea's.
However, Chelsea's temperament was more elegant, just like a queen, making it feel as if she was unattainable. Vanessa's figure was sexier, especially her towering breasts and perky buttocks. To men, she was a fatal existence.
Both women had their own strengths.
Chelsea didn't say anything when Vanessa came out. She left the club with Connor and Vanessa.
Connor was in charge of driving, while Chelsea was in charge of navigating.
Half an hour later.
"Connor, just park the car here!"
Chelsea whispered to Connor.
"Okay!"
Connor nodded and stopped the car.
After Chelsea got off the car, she walked straight into a building.
"What is this place?"
Connor followed Chelsea into the building and asked with a puzzled expression.
"You'll know later. What's the rush?"
Chelsea pursed her lips and continued walking forward.
A few minutes later, Chelsea arrived in front of the elevator and walked into it.
Connor had no choice but to follow them into the elevator.
However, after entering the elevator, Chelsea did not press the button. Instead, he took out his phone and made a call.
A few seconds later, the elevator slowly descended.
Connor briefly observed the situation inside the elevator and realized that there were no buttons at all. This made Connor even more curious about where Chelsea was taking him.
Vanessa and Chelsea were still very calm at this point. It seemed that this was not the first time they were here at this place.
Ding dong!
At this moment, the sound of the elevator rang.
The elevator doors slowly opened.
The moment the elevator door opened, Connor heard a very noisy sound.
Connor instinctively looked inside.
Connor looked at the scene in front of him, and he was in disbelief.
"Why did you bring me here?"
Connor asked Chelsea with a very puzzled expression...
Chelsea smiled in response.
"I didn't know you have such a hobby."
Connor said in surprise.
"It's been quite some time."
Chelsea explained with a smile.
Chelsea turned to look at Connor and explained calmly.
"There is a membership system. Those who can come here must be introduced by others. Moreover, they need to review your information to ensure that you have the ability to spend money here before you can come in."
Chelsea continued.

chapters.title: Chapter 1563: Acquiring a Casino
chapters.content:
Chapter 1563: Acquiring a Casino
They were now in a casino. Obviously, this casino was not a place that ordinary people could enter. It was especially for the rich.
"Are you going to tell me that this casino is also your property?"
Connor asked Chelsea speechlessly.
"Of course not!"
Chelsea gently shook her head.
"To be able to open such a big casino, the person must be some big shot!"
Connor once again sighed with admiration.
At this time, Connor already realized that these gamblers were all high officials and dignitaries, and they were placing high bets. This meant that these people were definitely not ordinary people.
If one wanted to run such a big casino, the boss behind it must have a terrifying network of connection.
"The people you see here are all people with a net worth of more than 100 million dollars. They are either the bosses of listed companies or the young masters of large families. The stakes are very high here, so it attracts many people who can't go to Aomiya…"
Chelsea continued explaining to Connor.
"This place must be very profitable, right?"
Connor said after hesitating for a moment.
"Just this table alone has a profit of 200,000 dollars a day…"
Chelsea replied calmly.
"Two hundred thousand?"
When Connor heard this number, he was dumbstruck.
"Yeah!"
Connor glanced at the gambling tables in the hall. There were at least a hundred of them, and that did not include the private rooms. Just these gambling tables in the hall alone had a daily profit of tens of millions of dollars!
This was really unbelievable. It was as if there was nothing in the world that could make more money than this casino.
"The most profitable thing about running a casino is lending money, so this money is just a drop in the ocean for a casino!"
Chelsea looked at Connor and continued.
"Then, how much profit does this casino get?"
Connor asked in disbelief.
"This casino's annual net income should be more than one billion, but 80% of this money needs to be used for public relations. The remaining 20% belongs to the casino owner. Moreover, the casino owner might not be able to get back loans, so I don't know how much money he can earn!"
"I see!"
Connor lightly nodded.
In fact, Chelsea was not exaggerating. After all, if this casino wanted to continue operating, the biggest expenditure was for public relations purposes. As long as a relationship had been established, one could earn money. If there was no relationship, the casino would not be able to continue operating.
"Although the casino is indeed very profitable, I know that you don't lack money…"
Chelsea looked at Connor and continued.
"I really don't lack money."
Connor lightly nodded.
"But this casino also has a very important function!"
Chelsea added softly.
...
"What function?"
Connor was stunned for a moment and asked Chelsea softly.
"Collecting information!"
Chelsea replied.
"Collecting information?"
When Connor heard Chelsea's words, he could not help but be stunned for a moment. He was somewhat puzzled.
"Yeah. There are many people here from all walks of life, and many of them need to borrow money from you to gamble. This way, you can become their debt-holder. Some people will choose to sell the information they know to repay their debts when they can't pay back."
Chelsea explained to Connor very seriously.
"You brought me here today to buy this casino?"
Connor finally understood what Chelsea meant.
"Yes, the owner of this casino is a friend of mine. He's from the U.S., and his family is in the gambling business. However, he recently encountered some trouble and needs a lot of money, so he wants to sell the casino."
Chelsea paused for a moment and then continued, "You should also know that him wanting to sell this place is no easy process. He must find a suitable buyer before he chooses to sell it. Otherwise, he will not reveal himself…"
"And you thought of me, didn't you?"
Connor said with a smile.
"That's right. I think that this casino is very suitable for you. You don't lack money, and you're very rich. The value that this casino can create for you is definitely not something that money can measure!"
Chelsea looked at Connor and said.
"But I don't know how to run a casino, and I don't have any connections in this area!"
Connor said in a low voice.
"The friend of mine in the U.S. told me that there are two ways to cooperate. The first way is for you to pay for 49% of the casino's shares. This money needs to be paid in one lump sum. In the future, the casino will still be operated by the other party, and you will get the dividends and money. You don't need to do anything else!"
Chelsea cleared her throat and continued, "The second way of cooperation is to buy the entire casino. They will introduce you to all the relevant contacts. As for how you manage the casino and maintain those relationships in the future, it's your own problem. So now you can consider how you plan to acquire it..."
"I didn't say that I want to buy this casino, did I?"
Connor said helplessly.
"Acquiring this casino is beneficial to you. You can't find any reason to refuse!"
Chelsea said calmly.
"But it's such a big decision to make. You have to let me think about it!"
Connor said helplessly.
"You only have to consider whether you want to buy the entire casino or only buy 49% of the shares. You don't have to think about anything else!"
Chelsea said in an unusually domineering tone.
"How much does it cost to buy this casino?"
Connor asked after thinking for a moment.
"The other party has offered a price of 20 billion!"
Chelsea replied.
"Then, what do you think of this price?"
Connor looked at Chelsea and asked.
"It's not considered high, but there is a certain risk in a casino. No one can guarantee that once it falls into your hands, it won't close down. If it really closes down, then this money will be wasted. If it remains standing, you have to think about how much you need to earn to get back the money you've spent…"
Chelsea said seriously.
"..."
Connor looked at Chelsea without saying anything.
"The boss of this casino will be coming later. I'll help you negotiate with him. I will try to lower the price to at least 15 billion, so your job is to think about whether you want to purchase it in full or 49% of the shares."
Chelsea whispered to Connor.

chapters.title: Chapter 1564: Cooperation
chapters.content:
Chapter 1564: Cooperation
After thinking for a moment, Connor responded, "If I want to buy it, I'll definitely buy it whole, but I have a request!"
"What request?"
Chelsea asked Connor softly.
"You'll pay half of the money for the acquisition of the casino, and I'll pay the other half. When the time comes, I'll give you 50% of the dividends every year."
Connor said with a smile.
"You're already so rich, yet you're still fussing over this with me!"
Chelsea exclaimed speechlessly.
"I'm not. I'm worried that if I buy this casino myself, the other party might not really introduce all their connections to me. But once you're involved, the other party won't play any tricks on your account."
Connor explained with a smile.
To put it bluntly, Connor pulled Chelsea to buy the shares because of Chelsea's connections.
The owner of this casino was from the U.S.. Connor had far less an influence on them than Chelsea.
Chelsea looked at Connor helplessly and said lightly, "I'm your aunt. Do you think I'll trick you?"
"Just because you won't trick me doesn't mean that your friends won't!"
Connor laughed as he replied.
In fact, Connor had a more important idea at this point. He wanted Chelsea to invest in the company so that he could keep Vanessa Canfield.
At that time, the casino and Heavens Club would be handed over to Vanessa to manage. The casino itself was also considered Chelsea's property, so Connor felt that if he used this as a selling point, Chelsea might be able to accept it.
Chelsea looked at Connor for a moment, then said softly, "Alright, since you want me to invest so much, I'll invest…"
"Are you saying you're in?"
Connor was surprised Chelsea had agreed to his suggestion.
"Yeah. I can't let you eat such a big piece of juicy meat alone…"
Chelsea said lightly.
"Then, when are we going to meet the boss of the casino?"
Connor hurriedly asked.
"Let me make a call!"
As Chelsea spoke, she took out her phone and dialed a number.
"Danny, my friend and I have already arrived at the casino. When can we meet and talk?"
Chelsea asked the person on the other end of the line.
"I'll get someone to pick you up now!"
Chelsea didn't say anything else and hung up the phone.
A few minutes later, a few bodyguards walked to Chelsea's side and asked her softly, "You must be Miss Lee."
"That's right!"
Chelsea gently nodded.
"Please come this way. Mr. Danny has been waiting for you for a long time!"
The burly man replied indifferently, then turned around and led the way.
Connor and Vanessa followed Chelsea to the VIP area of the casino.
A few minutes later, Connor and Chelsea arrived at a private room.
Vanessa stayed outside whereas Connor and Chelsea went in together. After all, it was such a big deal, and Vanessa was not part of it.
After entering the private room, Connor saw that there was only a blond man who was about his age sitting on a chair.
This person was probably the boss of the casino, Danny.
In the casino's private room.
When Chelsea saw the foreign man, he took the initiative to greet him and then whispered to Connor, "Connor, this is my old friend Danny. We met when we were studying in the U.S.…"
"Hello, Connor!"
Connor extended his right hand to Danny after hearing Chelsea's words.
"Hello, Danny..."
Danny shook hands with Connor and invited them to sit down.
Connor observed the foreign young man in front of him. Danny's age was similar to Connor's, and he gave off a very gentlemanly feeling. There was a trace of gentleness in his behavior, as if he was not a casino owner.
Danny was able to control such a big casino at such a young age. This meant that Danny's family background must be very terrifying.
Perhaps because he ran a casino here, Danny seemed very familiar with the area.
It seemed that Chelsea and Danny hadn't seen each other for a long time, so they didn't talk about the casino after they sat down. Instead, they started to chitchat.
Connor sat quietly beside Chelsea and did not say a word.
Chelsea chatted with Danny for about ten minutes before she said, "Danny, Connor is my nephew. He has the funds to buy your casino, so I won't beat around the bush with you. Today, I brought Connor to see you to discuss the acquisition of the casino…"
"Is he the one who wants to buy my casino?"
Danny was shocked to hear Chelsea's words.
When Danny saw Connor just now, he noticed that Connor was not very old, so he thought that Connor was Chelsea's driver or assistant. However, he never expected Connor to be the person who wanted to buy his casino.
"To be exact, we want to buy your casino. Connor and I are partners, but we will each pay half of the funds!"
Chelsea looked at Danny and explained.
"..."
Danny seemed to be a little hesitant when he heard Chelsea's words. He sized up Connor and did not say anything.
After all, a casino was not any ordinary business. One had to be very cautious when dealing with such businesses because there were too many people involved.
If Danny chose the wrong buyer, not only would his family suffer losses, but those who had worked with Danny before would also suffer.
Therefore, Danny was obviously a little worried.
"Danny, Connor has another identity. He's the owner of Heavens Club. I don't know if you've heard about Mr. McDonald from Davenport."
Chelsea knew what Danny was worried about.
"Mr. McDonald from Davenport?"
Danny was surprised when he heard this. He looked at Connor carefully and asked Chelsea softly, "Mr. McDonald is the Mr. McDonald from Davenport?"
"That's right!"
Chelsea nodded.
Danny looked at Connor with a happy smile. Although Danny didn't know much about Connor, he had heard about Connor from various aspects.
If Connor was really Mr. McDonald from Davenport, then Danny had nothing to worry about.

chapters.title: Chapter 1565: Negotiations
chapters.content:
Chapter 1565: Negotiations
"Mr. McDonald, I've heard about you before, so there shouldn't be any problems working with you!"
Danny said to Connor.
"Thank you for trusting me, Mr. Danny!"
Connor replied with a smile.
After a moment of hesitation, Danny said, "Mr. McDonald, I've known Chelsea for many years. When I first came to Oprana, Chelsea provided me with a lot of help. You were introduced to me by Chelsea, and you're also her nephew, so I'll tell you what I have to say and not beat around the bush with you..."
"Alright!"
Connor replied indifferently.
"This is the situation now. I opened this casino secretly without my family's knowledge. At first, I just wanted to give it a try, but I didn't expect this casino to operate well, so I've been staying in Oprana all this while!"
Danny said slowly.
"Then, why are you in a hurry to sell it off now?"
Connor asked in confusion.
"Because some time ago, my grandfather fell ill and was hospitalized. Our family's head may change at any time, and I intend to participate in the competition for the head of the family, so I have no choice but to go back!"
Danny paused for a moment and then continued, "The competing families need a very large sum of money. I've saved a lot of money over the years, but it's far from enough. That's why I want to sell this casino…"
"I see!"
Connor looked at Danny and nodded without saying anything.
"I've prepared two ways to sell the casino. The first way is for me to sell 49% of the casino's shares, but the management rights will still be in my hands. I'll let someone I trust manage the casino. Mr. McDonald, you just need to wait for the money to flow in."
Danny looked at Connor and continued, "There's also the second way to sell the casino. I'll sell the entire casino and introduce all my connections to you. In the future, this casino will have nothing to do with me and will belong to you alone, Mr. McDonald."
"I want to buy the entire casino!"
Connor said without any hesitation.
After hearing Connor's words, Danny nodded slightly and said lightly, "Mr. McDonald, I've been running this casino for a long time, so I still have a deep affection for this casino. Therefore, I personally prefer the first method of acquisition. Of course, if you choose the first method of cooperation, I might also make some concessions in terms of price..."
"..."
When Connor heard Danny's words, he subconsciously turned to look at Chelsea, then asked Chelsea softly, "Which method of cooperation do you think is better?"
Chelsea thought for a moment and then said lightly, "I have the same idea as you do. I think that the second method is better. After all, aren't we buying the casino for the management rights of the casino?"
"That's right, I also think that the second method is better!"
Connor nodded.
"Mr. McDonald, won't you reconsider it?"
Danny seemed to be a little unwilling.
"There is no need to reconsider…"
Connor shook his head at Danny.
...
Danny wasn't a fool. He knew that the casino was a big fat piece of meat. If it wasn't for the fact that he had to return to the U.S. to compete for the position of the family head, he would never sell the casino.
Therefore, Danny tried his best to get Connor to buy 49% of the casino's shares. This way, the casino would still be under Danny's control.
However, Danny never expected Connor to be so determined. He didn't care about the money at all.
He probably did not know that Connor was not buying the casino to earn money. After all, Connor did not lack money at all, so there was no need for him to save this bit of money.
Seeing that Connor had already said that there was no need to reconsider, he naturally felt embarrassed to continue persuading him. He could only say lightly, "Alright, since you've already thought things through, I won't say anything more. Let's talk about the purchase price now!"
"Mr. Danny, how much do you want to sell this casino for?"
Connor asked Danny directly.
Danny looked at Chelsea and said softly, "If someone else were to buy my casino, I would ask for at least 30 billion dollars. But since you're Chelsea's friend, I can give Chelsea face and ask for 25 billion dollars!"
"25 billion?"
Connor couldn't help but be stunned after hearing this amount.
Chelsea was very calm because Chelsea had already asked his subordinates to conduct a very comprehensive evaluation of Danny's casino. The value of this casino was around 20 billion, which was why Chelsea had given Connor an estimate of this amount.
Danny had set the price at 25 billion, which was obviously to give Connor a chance to bargain.
"Danny, isn't 25 billion a little too much?"
Chelsea whispered to Danny.
"Miss Lee, as you know, my casino is very large, and the profit margin is very big, so I believe that the price is reasonable!"
Danny paused for a moment and then continued, "Moreover, the most important thing when it comes to opening a casino is to have connections. I have a complete network of connections in my hands now, so as long as you buy my casino, this network will be yours. But if you open a casino yourself, let alone 25 billion, even 50 billion might not get you all these connections, am I right?"
"But we'll have to take a huge risk to acquire your casino now…"
Chelsea said softly.
"Of course, there are many uncertainties in a casino, so Miss Lee, you can also see this acquisition as an investment!"
Danny said with a smile.
"Since it's an investment, I need to consider whether the future rate of return of my capital is good enough, so I think that the price of 25 billion is a little high!"
Chelsea said with a smile.
When Danny heard Chelsea's words, he looked helpless. He frowned and said, "Miss Lee, since you think that the price of 25 billion is a little high, how much do you think is appropriate?"
"..."
Chelsea frowned and said, "10 billion should be a good price!"

chapters.title: Chapter 1566: I'm His Aunt!
chapters.content:
Chapter 1566: I'm His Aunt!
When Connor and Danny heard Chelsea's proposed amount, they were dumbfounded.
Connor turned to look at Chelsea in utter shock.
He didn't expect Chelsea to be so cutthroat. The moment she opened her mouth, she reduced 25 billion to 10 billion.
"Miss Lee, you must be joking with me!"
Danny said helplessly.
"Danny, you know me. I never joke about such things!"
Chelsea replied indifferently.
"10 billion is far too little!"
Danny shook his head and continued, "Miss Lee, even though you helped me back then, you can't bargain so much. I can at least sell this casino for 20 billion. I can't sell it for less than this price!"
"Danny, don't you know what situation you're in?"
Chelsea asked Danny calmly.
Danny was stunned for a moment when he heard Chelsea's words. He frowned and said, "My situation?"
"That's right, your situation!"
Chelsea nodded gently and continued, "You want to sell this casino because you need a lot of money to compete for the position of the head of your family. Your father's position in your family is rather low, so you don't have much of an advantage in competing for the position of the head of the family. All your hopes are pinned on this casino now. As long as you successfully sell this casino, the probability of you competing for the position of the head of the family may be much higher. However, if you don't sell this casino, the chances of you successfully running for the position of the head of the family will be very low, am I right?"
Danny looked at Chelsea with a serious expression. He did not expect Chelsea to know his situation so well.
"So you need a very large amount of money now, and we can provide you with this money. Buying your casino for 10 billion is indeed a loss for you, but if you can run for the position of the family head, then this deal will be very cost-effective. After all, such a small casino is not worth mentioning compared to the position of the family head!"
Chelsea looked at Danny and continued.
After hearing Chelsea's words, Danny was a little helpless. He frowned and said, "Then, what if I don't get chosen as the head of the family in the end?"
"Our acquisition of your casino is a gamble. There are naturally losses and wins in gambling!"
Chelsea said lightly.
"But 10 billion is too low!"
Danny knew what Chelsea said made sense, but he was still unwilling to sell the casino for 10 billion.
"Danny, you know how my connections are like. I can tell you that if I don't buy your casino, no one in Oprana will dare to buy your casino!"
Chelsea said to Danny in a domineering manner.
Danny looked at Chelsea and was exasperated because Chelsea was way too domineering.
At this moment, Connor was a little dumbfounded. This was the first time he was seeing his aunt being so domineering.
Chelsea was obviously threatening Danny, and Danny couldn't do anything to Chelsea because he knew that Chelsea wasn't joking.
...
Inside the private room.
Danny fell into deep thought after hearing Chelsea's words, while Chelsea waited quietly without saying anything.
"Miss Lee, I admit that what you said is very reasonable. I really need a sum of money to run for the position of the head of the family now, but the price you've offered me is really too low. I really can't accept it. If you're not willing to raise the price, then I can only choose to give up on running for the position of the head of the family!"
Danny said to Chelsea seriously.
"Danny, are you willing to give up the position of the family head just like that?"
Chelsea asked gently.
Danny looked at Chelsea with a vexed expression. He didn't know what to say.
"Miss Lee, 15 billion is my lowest offer!"
Danny gritted his teeth and said to Chelsea.
"10 billion is my lowest offer!"
Chelsea replied calmly.
"Miss Lee, I'll give you one last number. If you can accept it, we'll cooperate. If you don't think we can cooperate, then I have no other choice!"
Danny whispered to Chelsea.
"Alright!"
Chelsea looked at Danny and nodded.
"13 billion!"
Danny gritted his teeth and said this final number. He was really unwilling to accept it, but he really had no other choice when facing a strong woman like Chelsea.
"..."
Chelsea didn't rush to respond after hearing Danny's proposed amount. Instead, she turned and asked Connor softly, "Connor, what do you think of this price?"
"It's good enough…"
Connor hurriedly replied.
At this moment, Connor was very excited. After all, he originally thought that if he wanted to buy this casino, he would have to spend at least 20 billion. However, now that Chelsea was able to lower the price to 13 billion, how could he not be excited?
"Alright, since Connor has agreed, then it's settled!"
Chelsea whispered to Danny.
After hearing Chelsea's words, Danny was extremely helpless, but he had no choice. He sighed softly and said, "I'll go and prepare the procedures in the next few days. We'll sign the contract in three days' time. As for the connections in our casino, Mr. McDonald, you need to find someone to be in charge of maintaining the connections…"
"Alright!"
Connor nodded.
Chelsea turned and glanced at Connor. Then, she whispered to Connor, "Connor, if that's all, you can go out now. I have something to say to Danny alone..."
"Alright!"
Connor then turned to leave.
After seeing Connor leave, a strange look flashed across Danny's face. He whispered to Chelsea, "Miss Lee, what is your relationship with this young man?"
"I'm his aunt!"
Chelsea said lightly.
"Aunt?"
Danny couldn't help but shake his head when he heard that. He said softly, "Why do I feel that the relationship between the two of you aren't as simple as that? I can feel that you treat this young man differently…"
Chelsea looked at Danny with a faint smile and didn't say anything. Instead, she asked him, "We're using 13 billion to buy your casino. Don't you feel a little upset about it?"

chapters.title: Chapter 1567: Exchange of Benefits
chapters.content:
Chapter 1567: Exchange of Benefits
"Of course, I am. It's all because of you. If it were anyone else, I would have asked him to get lost long ago!"
Danny didn't hide his dissatisfaction and whispered to Chelsea.
"I know that the price I offered is indeed a little low, but I can't help it. I'm a businessman, and businessmen focus on profits!"
Chelsea smiled elegantly.
"Sigh…"
Danny sighed and said expressionlessly, "Do you actually want to talk to me about this?"
"Of course, not…"
Chelsea looked at Danny with a faint smile and said softly, "I want to talk to you about your election as the head of the family!"
"The election as the head of the family?"
Danny's eyes lit up when he heard Chelsea's words.
It was obvious that Chelsea wanted to help Danny run for the position of the family head. Danny knew Chelsea's power. He knew that if Chelsea was willing to help, his chances of running for the position of the family head would be greatly increased.
Chelsea knew very well that he had made Danny suffer a loss with the casino, so Danny would definitely be very dissatisfied. That was why Chelsea wanted to talk to Danny about running for the head of the family. The purpose was to let Danny know that although he had sold the casino at a low price, Chelsea could help him get it back in other ways.
Perhaps this was where Chelsea's power was.
She was very clear about what everyone needed, what she could provide to others, and what role she played in others' hearts.
"Danny, I can help you run for the head of the family, but I need you to promise me one thing!"
Chelsea said to Danny.
Danny was stunned for a moment and quickly asked what it was.
"You don't need to know what it is yet. I'll tell you after you're elected as the head of the family!"
Chelsea replied indifferently.
"Alright, alright…"
Danny nodded without hesitation.
"Now, I'll tell you about your election for the head of the family…"
Chelsea said softly.
...
On the other side, after Connor left the private room, he strolled around the casino alone.
In fact, Connor was not very interested in places like casinos, so he could not understand why someone could make himself bankrupt in a casino and even lose his house.
Connor walked to the rest area of the casino. This rest area was very high-end. Not only did it have carefully prepared pastries and red wine, but there was also a professional bartender.
Connor saw Vanessa Canfield sitting on the chair resting, so he walked to Vanessa's side.
Vanessa turned to look at Connor and then asked gently, "How's the acquisition going?"
"It has already been settled…"
Connor replied indifferently.
"Then, why is Miss Lee not with you?"
Vanessa continued to ask.
"She is talking to Danny about something else!"
Connor said as he picked up a piece of pastry and threw it into his mouth.
When Vanessa saw Connor like this, she knew that he was in a very good mood, so she asked, "How much did you buy this casino for?"
"Take a guess!"
Connor said with a smile.
"15 billion?"
Vanessa said.
Connor looked at Vanessa with a surprised expression and then said softly, "I didn't expect your guess to be so accurate. It was 13 billion!"
...
"13 billion?"
When Vanessa heard the amount, she seemed to be even more shocked.
Vanessa had also investigated this casino before; the conservative valuation of this casino was around 20 billion. With Chelsea negotiating, it could be lowered to 15 billion.
However, the price of 13 billion was really much lower than expected.
Danny was the son of a big foreign family, and he managed such a big casino at such a young age. This meant that Danny was smart, so Danny would never sell the casino at such a low price. Since Danny sold it at this price, there must be something else that Vanessa and Connor didn't know.
Vanessa turned to look at Connor, feeling unusually puzzled.
Because Vanessa felt that Chelsea was really good to Connor, so good that it was unbelievable.
The first thing Chelsea did after returning to Oprana was to give Heavens Club to Connor. Now, she helped Connor get the casino at such a low price. These two things proved how important Connor was to Chelsea.
However, Vanessa and Chelsea had known each other for so many years. This was the first time Vanessa had seen Chelsea care so much about someone. She couldn't understand why Chelsea was doing all this.
Vanessa shook her head gently, then took out a box of cigarettes from her bag, turned and asked Connor, "Can I smoke?"
"Of course…"
Connor lightly nodded.
Vanessa found a lighter and lit the cigarette.
Connor turned to look at Vanessa, somewhat puzzled, and said softly, "Vanessa, I didn't know you smoke."
"If a woman like me doesn't smoke or drink, how can I survive in this industry?"
Vanessa replied lightly.
"Hehe, that's true!"
Connor smiled and didn't say anything.
After all, Vanessa needed to protect the guests in the club, so it wasn't peculiar that she was had picked up smoking and drinking.
Connor quietly looked at Vanessa. She looked very elegant while, so elegant that Connor felt like he was dreaming. Her slender fingers were holding the cigarette, and her expression was unusually indifferent and arrogant. It gave people the feeling that she was a painting.
A woman like Vanessa would always exude a mature and elegant aura. This aura was like a poison to men, seducing them wherever it went.
Moreover, Vanessa's every frown and smile exuded a seductive aura. This kind of seductive aura was different from the seductive aura that some women deliberately put on. Vanessa's seductive charm was natural. It was something that she naturally exuded.
In this world, there was a type of woman who could not hide her sexiness no matter how she dressed.
And Vanessa was a woman like this.
Vanessa's figure was perfect, especially under the contrast of the short dress, her curves were exquisite, voluptuous and charming. Coupled with her exquisite facial features, she was simply the best of the best.

chapters.title: Chapter 1568: Vanessa's Decision
chapters.content:
Chapter 1568: Vanessa's Decision
"What are you looking at?"
Vanessa realized that Connor was staring at her and couldn't help but ask him softly.
"Vanessa, you're really sexy!"
Connor didn't hide his thoughts and replied with a smile.
"Sexy?"
When Vanessa heard Connor's words, she couldn't help but be stunned for a moment, then she said with a smile, "I've heard countless compliments in my life, but you're the first one who dares to praise me for being sexy!"
"They don't dare to praise you for being sexy because they have something to hide. But I'm different. I just think that you're sexy and don't have any other ideas in mind, so I dare to say it!"
Connor said with a smile.
"Are you deliberately trying to make me happy?"
Vanessa asked Connor with a smile.
"No…"
Connor gently shook his head and continued, "I've seen many women, but you're one of few that has ever made me so awestruck."
"One of few?"
When Vanessa heard this, she couldn't help but be stunned for a moment. Then, she said in a playful tone, "Looks like you have quite a number of beauties around you!"
"I do!"
Connor did not deny it.
Vanessa was somewhat disappointed, and she said softly, "If you had praised me like this five years ago, I would have definitely been very happy. After all, to be able to obtain the recognition of a young master like you is something to be proud of. However, it's a pity that I'm already old now. I can't compare to the young ladies out there…"
"You're old?"
When Connor heard Vanessa's words, he couldn't help but reveal a helpless smile, and then lightly said, "I can't tell though. There are at least 800 people in Newtown who want to pursue you, right? If you were really old, would these people be infatuated with you?"
"Those people just want to have sex with me. I'll be 30 years old next year. I can't compare to those young ladies out there!"
Vanessa said lightly.
Connor looked at Vanessa, feeling rather speechless, because he really didn't think that Vanessa was old. If Vanessa didn't tell him her age, he wouldn't even believe that Vanessa was already thirty years old.
Vanessa's skin was fair and smooth, and there were no wrinkles on her face. Her breasts were also very full, her waist was slender, and her legs were long. She was not out of shape at all, and she did not look like a 30-year-old woman at all.
"You honestly don't look old at all…"
Connor shook his head.
"You can't tell, but I know I am!"
Vanessa replied lightly.
"Vanessa, have you ever thought about finding a boyfriend?"
Connor hesitated for a moment before asking.
"Boyfriend?"
When Vanessa heard Connor's words, she couldn't help but be stunned for a moment, then lightly said, "I was busy with work before, so I didn't have time to date at all. Now that I'm old, although I have suitors, not many of them are sincere…"
"That's true. It's useless to be anxious about this kind of stuff. As long as fate comes, what will come will come!"
Connor said with a smile.
"What are you two talking about?"
At this moment, Chelsea walked up to them in high heels and asked with a smile.
"Nothing, just chatting!"
Vanessa replied lightly.
"Are the two of you hiding something from me?"
Chelsea blinked and asked thoughtfully.
"What secrets can there be between the two of us?"
Vanessa hurriedly explained.
Chelsea looked at Vanessa, smiled mysteriously, and then said softly, "It's fine if you don't want to tell me. Let's go!"
...
After Chelsea was done talking with Danny, she left the casino with Connor and Vanessa.
"Connor, Danny needs time to prepare the contract. The two of you can come in three days to sign the contract. After you sign the contract, you can transfer the money to Danny. I've already transferred my share to him."
Chelsea whispered to Connor after getting into the car.
"You already gave him the money? Aren't you worried that this guy might run away?"
Connor said in surprise.
"Don't worry. I've known Danny for so many years. He won't run away…"
Chelsea smiled faintly and continued, "By the way, after you sign the contract with Danny, Danny will introduce you to all his connections. Also, the people who can come to this casino are top tycoons. Therefore, the ability of this casino to accumulate connections is not inferior to that of Heavens Club. You must find someone suitable to help you manage this casino. This person has to be very capable and have a high EQ. Otherwise, it will be difficult for you to run this casino…"
"Yes…"
Connor nodded gently and continued, "I've already found a suitable candidate…"
"You've already found a suitable candidate?"
Chelsea could not help but be stunned when he heard Connor's words. Then, she asked softly, "Who is it?"
"Vanessa!"
Connor answered without thinking.
"Me?"
Vanessa was stunned when she heard Connor's words.
"That's right, Vanessa. I think you're the only one who can manage these places. I've already thought it through. I plan to give you 5% of the shares of Heavens Club and 5% of the casino."
Connor said with a smile.
"No!"
Chelsea immediately shouted after hearing Connor's words.
"Why not?"
Connor turned to look at Chelsea and asked in confusion.
"I plan to bring Vanessa overseas. She has to stay by my side. I won't let her stay here to help you…"
Chelsea said to Connor in a very serious tone.
"It's not up to you whether Vanessa stays or not. You're not related to Vanessa. Why should she do whatever you want her to do? I think we should ask Vanessa about this!"
Connor said with a smile.
"Okay, Vanessa, do you plan to stay by Connor's side or go abroad with me?"
Chelsea turned and asked Vanessa.
Vanessa looked at Chelsea, then at Connor and said softly, "I have to consider this properly…"
"Why do you still need to consider this? You have to give me an answer now and make Connor give up!"
Chelsea shouted.
Vanessa looked at Chelsea helplessly and said lightly, "Miss Lee, I have lived in Newtown for so many years. I have long gotten used to the life here. Plus, Heavens Club really needs me. You have so many powerful people by your side, so you don't need me."

chapters.title: Chapter 1569: Please Her
chapters.content:
Chapter 1569: Please Her
"You…"
Chelsea was stunned when she heard that.
"See? Vanessa has already said that she wants to stay here. Is there anything else you want to say?"
Connor turned to look at Chelsea and asked with a smug expression.
"There must be some shady business going on between the two of you!"
Chelsea shouted fiercely.
Connor smiled faintly and didn't explain anything. Actually, Connor could already tell that Vanessa didn't want to leave.
Of course, it wasn't because of Connor that Vanessa didn't want to leave, but because of Heavens Club.
Connor drove Vanessa and Chelsea back home, but this time Vanessa didn't go back to Heavens Club. Instead, she returned to her real home.
Vanessa had long bought a house in Newtown, but she rarely went back.
After Connor sent Vanessa and Chelsea home, he also drove back home.
After returning home, Connor saw that Rachel Wallace was still not back yet, so he tried calling her, but no one picked up.
At this moment, Connor had a bad premonition because Rachel had never disappeared for such a long time.
...
In the blink of an eye, three days had passed.
During these three days, Michelle Hicks did not make any moves, and Connor could not find a better way, so he could only wait patiently.
Three days later, Connor received a call from Danny. The transfer procedures of the casino had already been handled. As long as Connor went over to sign the contract with Danny, the casino would belong to Connor.
Therefore, Connor and Danny set a time to sign the contract.
Of course, Connor would surely bring Vanessa with him to sign the contract.
Because Connor was going to let Vanessa manage the casino alone, she not only needed to connect with Danny's network, but also needed to understand the situation of the casino.
Being able to keep Vanessa was a good thing for Connor. After all, Vanessa was sexy and charming. It would be pleasing to the eye if he kept her by his side. Moreover, Vanessa's ability was definitely not something that ordinary people could compare to. It was impossible for Connor to find someone who could manage Heavens Club and the casino. Therefore, Vanessa staying could save Connor a lot of trouble.
Connor drove to Heavens Club and was ready to pick up Vanessa to go sign the contract.
However, after arriving at the Heavens Club, Connor realized that Vanessa didn't come to work. Vanessa would usually live here, so she was almost always at Heavens Club.
Connor hesitated for a moment before he took out his phone and dialed Vanessa's number.
Ring, ring…
The phone didn't ring twice before Vanessa picked it up and asked weakly, "Mr. McDonald, do you need something?"
"Vanessa, I'm going to sign the contract with Danny later. Where are you now? I'm going to bring you along…"
Connor said lightly.
"Um, I might not be able to go today…"
Vanessa said in a low voice.
"What's wrong with you? Are you sick?"
Connor was stunned for a moment and asked.
"It's nothing serious. I just caught a cold because of the air conditioner last night. I'm worried that I'm not in my best condition, so I better not go…"
Vanessa explained.
"Did you catch a cold? Is it serious? I should go see you!"
Connor thought for a moment before saying.
The entire Heavens Club and casino were waiting for Vanessa to manage, so Connor definitely had to please her.
"You don't have to. I'm fine…"
Vanessa quickly refused.
"I think I should still go see you. Wait for me at home!"
Connor replied in a low voice and then hung up the phone.
When the call ended, Vanessa looked extremely helpless. She secretly thought that her boss was way too enthusiastic.
After Connor found out that Vanessa was sick, he called Danny to cancel today's meeting. After all, Vanessa was very important. There were many things that needed Vanessa to be there to personally contact Danny's people. If there was no Vanessa, it would be meaningless for Connor to go alone.
As Connor had sent Vanessa back home before, he knew where her house was. He drove directly to Vanessa's neighborhood.
The house that she lived in now was not very big, only about 130 square meters. She bought it when she first came to Newtown. Later, Vanessa also bought a villa in the suburbs, but because it was far from Heavens Club, Vanessa rarely went there.
Connor found Vanessa's house and knocked on the door,
A moment later, the door opened, and Vanessa appeared in front of Connor in her pajamas.
At this moment, Vanessa's face was somewhat pale, and she looked very tired.
However, Vanessa was a very beautiful woman, so even though her face was a little pale, it made her look very pitiful. Her pair of watery eyes flickered with a light that made people's heart ache.
"Vanessa, how are you? Is it bad?"
Connor entered Vanessa's house and asked anxiously.
This was Connor's first time at Vanessa's house. Perhaps it was because Vanessa didn't live here often, the decoration was very simple.
"I just feel a little dizzy. Actually, it's not a big deal. I was worried that my condition would affect the signing of the contract today!"
Vanessa softly replied to Connor.
"I see!"
Connor nodded lightly, then continued, "Did you take your medicine?"
"Yeah…"
Vanessa nodded and continued, "What do you want to drink? Let me get you a glass of water!"
After saying that, she was about to walk toward the kitchen, but perhaps because she was sick, her body was very weak, plus she just cleaned up the room since Connor was coming, so before she could walk to the kitchen, she fell down.
Connor was a martial artist, so his reaction speed was very fast. When he saw that Vanessa was about to fall, he rushed over and then used his right hand to hold Vanessa by her waist.
"Just look at you! How is this not a big deal?"
Connor shouted helplessly.
"I'm really fine…"
With Vanessa being held in Connor's arms, a strange feeling suddenly sprouted in her heart, and she quickly whispered back to Connor.

chapters.title: Chapter 1570: I'll Take You to the Hospital
chapters.content:
Chapter 1570: I'll Take You to the Hospital
"Why is your body so hot? Don't tell me you have a fever?"
As Connor was holding Vanessa, he could clearly feel the temperature of her body.
"But I took my temperature just now. I was fine!"
Vanessa whispered.
"..."
Connor hesitated for a moment, then placed his right hand on Vanessa's fair and smooth forehead.
"How can you say that you're fine..."
Connor could clearly feel that Vanessa's forehead was very hot.
"I'm really fine. I'll be fine after I get some sleep tonight…"
Vanessa said as she broke free from Connor's embrace. After all, it was not right for him to hold her like this.
"Why do you not want to go to the hospital? I'll take you to the hospital now…"
Connor supported Vanessa and was about to walk out of the house.
"No. I'm really fine. I'll be fine after resting for a day…"
Vanessa didn't seem to want to go to the hospital.
"If your condition worsens, it'll be troublesome, so you have to go to the hospital now!"
Connor shouted stubbornly.
When Vanessa heard Connor's words, she couldn't help but look at him. She wanted to go to the hospital, but because she was alone, she was willing to just endure it alone. Now that she had Connor, she could only do what he wanted.
"I'll take you to the hospital…"
Connor said as he helped Vanessa out of the house.
"Wait a minute, help me to the bedroom first…"
Vanessa suddenly said.
"To the bedroom?"
Connor heard Vanessa's words and couldn't help but be stunned for a moment, then asked in a puzzled tone, "Why? Why do you need to go to the bedroom?"
"I'm wearing pajamas now. I can't go to the hospital dressed like this!"
Vanessa shouted helplessly.
Connor couldn't help but glance at Vanessa after hearing her words.
He realized that Vanessa was indeed wearing a revealing dress, so he could only help her into the bedroom.
After entering the bedroom, Connor could smell a faint fragrance. This fragrance was the same as Vanessa's body, making people feel very comfortable.
Connor helped Vanessa to the bedside and then said softly, "You shouldn't move around like this. I'll go find you some clothes…"
"I usually live in the company. There aren't many clothes here. They're all in the closet…"
Vanessa thought for a moment and said to Connor.
"Alright, I got it!"
Connor nodded gently, then walked to the wardrobe and opened it. At this time, the wardrobe was also filled with her fragrance. The faint perfume smell mixed with Vanessa's fragrance made people feel like they were in a dream.
Connor took a deep breath and then briefly looked at the clothes in the wardrobe.
This wardrobe was obviously much smaller than the one in Heavens Club. There were clothes on one side and underwear on the other.
When Connor saw Vanessa's underwear, he was stunned. He couldn't help it. The underwear was very sexy. Although Connor had been trying his best to control it, he still couldn't help but take a few glances.
"Bring me that spaghetti strap and denim skirt…"
Vanessa seemed to have noticed that Connor was staring at her underwear, so she couldn't help but whisper.
"You're going to see a doctor. Isn't it inconvenient for you to wear a dress? Let's get something else..."
Connor was stunned for a moment and said to Vanessa softly.
"Me wearing denim skirt has nothing to do with seeing a doctor, does it? I'll wear whatever I like…"
Vanessa said helplessly.
"You might need an injection in your current condition. You'll definitely have to take off your pants when the time comes…"
Connor explained helplessly.
"An injection? Take off my pants?"
When Vanessa heard Connor's words, she couldn't help but be stunned for a moment. Then, she thought for a long time before getting what he meant. She said with a speechless expression, "Hospitals give IV fluids these days. No one gets injections anymore."
"Alright, then!"
Connor nodded helplessly, then handed the strap shirt and denim skirt to Vanessa.
In fact, Vanessa wanted to wear a denim skirt instead of shorts because it was more convenient to go to the bathroom during the infusion, not because she wanted to look good.
Connor handed the clothes to Vanessa.
Vanessa looked at Connor after taking the clothes and realized that he was still standing there, as if he had no intention of leaving.
"Vanessa, what are you doing? Hurry up and get changed. After you change your clothes, we can go to the hospital…"
Connor couldn't help but urge when he saw her sitting there, not intending to move.
"Shouldn't you go out while I change my clothes? Do you want me to change my clothes in front of you?"
Vanessa looked at him and shouted speechlessly.
"I'm sorry, I forgot about that…"
Connor smiled awkwardly at Vanessa, then turned around and walked out of the bedroom.
"It's not like I haven't seen it before."
Connor muttered softly after walking out of the bedroom.
In the room, Vanessa looked at her clothes and seemed to remember that Connor had seen her change before. She seemed to be a little embarrassed and angry. After confirming that Connor wasn't peeking, she began to take off her pajamas.
A few minutes later, Vanessa walked out of the bedroom. After changing, Vanessa looked a little more energetic, but one could still tell that her body was very weak.
Connor helped Vanessa out of the house, then drove to the hospital.
Along the way, Vanessa rested with her eyes closed. There was no other way. She was feeling really uncomfortable now. Even if she wanted to talk to Connor, she couldn't open her eyes.
They then finally reached the hospital. Vanessa realized that she seemed to have motion sickness. Her head was swollen, and she was very nauseous.
"Vanessa, can you walk by yourself?"
Connor saw that she didn't look that good, so he asked Vanessa softly.
"..."
Vanessa gently shook her head.
Connor felt that she was in an even worse situation now, so he didn't dare to delay things any further. He held Vanessa by the waist, and then walked toward the hospital.
After arriving at the hospital, Connor brought her to the emergency ward. After a brief examination, they found that Vanessa had a common cold, but because she did not come in right away, things had gotten worse. She needed to get an IV fluid.

chapters.title: Chapter 1571: Janson Wallace is Awake
chapters.content:
Chapter 1571: Janson Wallace is Awake
Connor then helped Vanessa to the infirmary. As he had the best number in the hospital, the infirmary was also exceptionally high-end. It was not an ordinary infirmary.
After entering the infirmary, the nurse began to give Vanessa an IV drip.
A few minutes later, the nurse left.
Connor sat beside Vanessa and began to wait quietly.
At this time, Vanessa had already fallen asleep, so Connor took out his phone to play with it.
After an unknown amount of time, Vanessa finally opened her eyes slowly. She could feel that she was obviously feeling much better.
Vanessa slowly turned to look at Connor. Perhaps because he was too bored, Connor had already fallen asleep.
At this moment, a strange feeling suddenly rose in Vanessa's heart. She was an orphan herself. Her parents passed away when she was very young. Vanessa grew up with her grandmother. When Vanessa was eighteen, her grandmother also passed away.
Therefore, Vanessa had lived alone since she was young. Five years ago, she was in a relationship, but because the other party only wanted to sleep with Vanessa, she finally chose to break up and never dated again.
Perhaps it was because of this environment that led to Vanessa's independent and self-reliant character.
For so many years, as long as Vanessa was sick, she would choose to take some medicine to get through it. If she really couldn't endure it, she would come to the hospital for an infusion, but no one had ever accompanied her. Connor might be the first person to accompany her for an infusion.
If Connor hadn't appeared, she wouldn't think that there was anything bad about this kind of life. Although it was a little lonely, it wasn't hard. After all, the money she earned every month might not be what others could earn in ten years.
But because of Connor's appearance, Vanessa knew how good it was to have someone to accompany her when she was sick!
Vanessa had never experienced such a feeling before, but today she did.
Vanessa also knew that Connor did not have any feelings for her. Connor did this in the hope that she could stay and help him, but no matter what, his behavior still made her very touched.
"Vanessa, you're awake?"
At this time, Connor suddenly opened his eyes and said to Vanessa with a smile.
"Yes…"
Vanessa looked at Connor and nodded.
"How are you feeling now?"
Connor hurriedly asked.
"I feel much better now…"
Vanessa replied with a smile.
"That's good."
Connor looked at Vanessa and let out a long sigh.
Vanessa looked at Connor and hesitated for a couple of seconds before saying softly, "Connor, thank you for everything!"
"What's there to thank me for? Didn't you get sick because you were too tired from work? I should be the one thanking you!"
Connor replied with a smile.
When Vanessa heard Connor's words, a strange look flashed across her face. Connor's words seemed to tell Vanessa that he was doing all this because she was of use to him.
"It's getting late. Why don't you go back first?"
Vanessa said to Connor after hesitating for a moment.
"Go back?"
When Connor heard Vanessa's words, he couldn't help but be stunned for a moment, then he said with a smile, "You're still on the drip. I'll stay till you're done. I'll send you back when you're done…"
"..."
Vanessa slowly raised her head and looked at Connor, not saying anything.
About half an hour later, Vanessa finally finished her bag of IV fluid. Connor drove Vanessa home and then returned home alone.
When he got home, Connor realized that Rachel Wallace was still not back yet. Connor took out his mobile phone and dialed her number.
Although Rachel didn't turn off her phone, she didn't answer the call either.
"Where did she go? Why is she not contactable?"
At this time, Connor began to worry that Rachel had encountered some trouble.
...
In the high-class ward of the Hudson Hospital of York.
Janson Wallace, who had been unconscious for three days, finally opened his eyes slowly. When he opened his eyes, he saw Rachel sitting beside him. Her exquisite face was filled with fatigue.
During the three days that Janson was unconscious, Rachel slept for three hours almost every day. The rest of the time, she waited for her grandfather to wake up.
When Rachel saw Janson open his eyes, she was a little excited. She shouted softly, "Grandpa, you're awake!"
"I'm awake…"
Janson nodded slightly, then glanced at his ward and saw that Rachel was alone.
Two days ago, the Wallace family was probably still with Rachel in the ward.
However, on the third day, everyone felt that Janson might not wake up for a while. Moreover, these people had their own things to do, so they did not continue to stay in the hospital and went to do what they were supposed to do.
Janson had a clear idea of this situation. After all, in the entire family, only Rachel was really concerned about him. The rest were all concerned about their own interests.
"Rachel, how long have I been asleep?"
Janson asked softly.
"It has been three days…"
Rachel replied with tears in her eyes.
"Silly girl, why are you crying? Aren't I awake now?"
Janson smiled and looked up at the clock. It was already past two in the morning.
"It's already so late. Why aren't you resting yet?"
Janson looked at Rachel and asked.
"I wanted to wait for you to wake up…"
Rachel replied in a low voice.
When Janson heard Rachel's words, he could not help but sigh softly. Then, he said expressionlessly, "You're the only one in the entire family who would do this…"
"Grandpa, are you hungry? I'll go find you something to eat…"
Rachel offered.
"Alright, I'm indeed a little hungry…"
Janson looked at Rachel and nodded.
Rachel rushed out of the ward and went to the cafeteria to get a meal for Janson.
After returning to the ward, Rachel started feeding Janson.
After eating, Janson closed his eyes and was about to rest.
Janson had finally woken up, so her originally worried heart was finally at ease. She lay on the bed and rested.
Perhaps it was because Rachel had been very tired the past few days, she slept until eight o'clock in the morning the next day.
When Rachel woke up. she realized that she was no longer in the ward. Instead, she was in the family lounge next door.

chapters.title: Chapter 1572: A Gift
chapters.content:
Chapter 1572: A Gift
At this moment, Janson's ward was still very lively. All the famous people in York had come to visit Janson.
Janson seemed to be doing very well. His face was ruddy as he greeted these people. The Wallace family members who had disappeared for two days had also returned.
When Rachel saw the people in the ward, she was a little angry. She immediately rushed into the ward and shouted, "What are you all doing? My grandfather has just woken up. He needs to rest now. All of you should leave..."
The guests who came to visit Janson looked a little embarrassed when they heard Rachel's words.
"Rachel, what nonsense are you talking about?"
Rachel's uncle knew that these guests were all big shots in York. The consequences of offending these people were unimaginable!
"How am I spouting nonsense? Grandpa has just recovered and needs time to rest. Hurry up and bring these people out!"
Rachel shouted with a very unyielding attitude.
"Rachel, you…"
Rachel's uncle seemed rather upset. He really could not understand what was wrong with Rachel. She was usually very sensible.
"Alright, alright, I'm indeed a little tired now. You guys should head back now!"
At this moment, Janson suddenly spoke.
"Since you're tired, we shall not disturb you…"
"That's right. Get some rest…"
The guests all spoke up.
A moment later, the guests who came to visit Janson left the ward one after another. Janson asked the Wallace family to leave as well. However, the Wallace family did not leave the hospital. Instead, they stood in the corridor outside the ward and waited.
At this moment, only Janson, Rachel, and Janson's driver were left in the ward.
"Grandpa, are you hungry? I'll get you something to eat, okay? What do you want to eat?"
Rachel walked to Janson's side and asked gently.
"I'm not hungry…"
Janson shook his head at Rachel and continued, "Rachel, grandfather has a gift for you…"
"A gift?"
When Rachel heard Janson's words, she could not help but be stunned for a moment. She seemed to be a little puzzled as she asked softly, "Grandpa, what gift is it?"
"You will know later…"
Janson looked at Rachel and smiled, then said to his driver, "Mr. Levy, give them a call!"
"Alright…"
The driver nodded gently, then took out his phone and walked to the window to make a call.
About ten minutes later, the driver ended the call and returned to Janson's side.
At this moment, Rachel was still very puzzled because she did not know what the gift Janson was talking about was, nor did she know what Janson wanted.
"Grandpa, what gift are you going to give me?"
Rachel asked Janson with a puzzled expression.
"Don't worry, you'll know later!"
Janson smiled faintly and closed his eyes to rest.
About two hours later, a tall middle-aged man walked into the ward.
When the Wallace family saw the middle-aged man, they were all dumbfounded.
This was because they all knew this middle-aged man, and this middle-aged man's influence in the Oprana military scene was extremely terrifying. No one expected that Janson would actually find such a big shot.
The middle-aged man was very polite when facing Janson. He asked about Janson's condition and then sat down to wait quietly.
Soon after, a few middle-aged men with extraordinary bearing arrived. These middle-aged men were not ordinary people either. Some were business tycoons, while others were high officials in the political world.
Rachel didn't understand why Janson had asked these people to come.
"Mr. Wallace, everyone is here…"
The driver walked to Janson's side and whispered to him.
Janson nodded slightly after hearing the driver's words, then smiled and said to the six people present, "The six of you haven't seen me for a long time, right?"
"That's right, Janson. It has been a long time since we last saw you…"
One of the middle-aged men laughed.
When Janson heard the middle-aged man's words, he smiled faintly and said softly, "I'm getting old. My body is getting worse by the day. It is also a little difficult for me to speak. Therefore, I will not waste any time with you. I'm just going to be frank with all of you…"
"Janson, if you have any instructions, feel free to say them…"
"That's right, Janson. If you have anything to say, just say it!"
Everyone said.
"All of you have high statuses in Oprana. The fact that you are able to reach your current position is in large part because of me, am I right?"
Janson said expressionlessly.
"That's right. We were all promoted by you back then, Janson…"
"That's right, my life was given to me by you, Janson!"
"If it weren't for you, we wouldn't be where we are today!"
Everyone said.
"Since you still remember this, then I didn't help you for nothing. I'm already old, and I don't have much time left. The one I can't let go of the most is my granddaughter, so I don't have any other requests. I just hope that you can take good care of my granddaughter in the future."
Janson said frankly.
"Janson, don't worry. If Miss Wallace needs my help in the future, I'll definitely help her!"
A middle-aged man stood up and exclaimed.
"That's right, my life was given to me by you. It's my duty to protect Miss Wallace!"
Another brawny man said.
"Janson, don't worry. We will do it even if you don't tell us!"
"Yeah!"
Everyone shouted.
"Alright, I'm relieved to hear that!"
Janson nodded lightly and continued, "Alright, let me introduce you to my granddaughter!"
"Alright!"
Everyone turned around to walk to Rachel's side.
Rachel still had a puzzled look on her face because she did not know these people.
Everyone took the initiative to introduce themselves to Rachel. When Rachel found out the identities of these people, she was extremely shocked.
Because Rachel never thought that these people's backgrounds would be so terrifying. Any one of them would be an existence that shocked a region. Moreover, these people didn't seem to have much interaction with the Wallace family, so Rachel didn't know these people.

chapters.title: Chapter 1573: Janson's Wishes
chapters.content:
Chapter 1573: Janson's Wishes
