The Wallace family members were also standing in the corridor, observing the situation in the ward.
At this moment, they seemed to have guessed what the old man was going to do, and they were extremely solemn.
"I didn't expect the old man to leave such a big gift for Rachel!"
"Yeah. He dotes on Rachel the most. These people must be a gift for Rachel!"
Everyone began to discuss in low voices.
A moment later, Rachel was more or less familiar with those people.
"Alright, if there's nothing else, you can leave now!"
Janson whispered to everyone.
The six of them bid farewell to Janson and left the ward.
After the six people left, the originally lively ward instantly quieted down.
Rachel looked at Janson on the bed with a puzzled expression and said softly, "Grandpa, what are these people for?"
"These people were all secretly nurtured by me back then. I nurtured the six of them behind everyone's back. Now, the six of them are all strong and powerful figures. Any one of them has a very terrifying influence in their field. So, after I die, if you encounter any trouble, you can go to them for help."
Janson explained softly.
"Grandpa, you left these people for me?"
Rachel said in disbelief.
"That's right. The person I'm most worried about in the entire family is you. If these people protect you, I can be at ease…"
Janson said softly.
"But will these people listen to me?"
Rachel said in confusion.
"Don't worry about that!"
Janson looked at his driver.
The driver took out a hard disk and handed it to Rachel. He said softly, "Miss Wallace, there's information about the six of them in here, as well as the most fatal evidence of their crimes. Master collected evidence about them when he was training them back then, so if these six of them don't listen to you in the future, you can use the evidence here to threaten them!"
Rachel looked at the driver and hesitated for a few seconds. Then, she slowly took the hard disk.
At this moment, Rachel was still very touched because she did not know that her grandfather had actually started to help pave the way many years ago.
"Rachel, grandpa knows that you've always wanted to deal with Rockefeller. Your parents' deaths are indeed related to Rockefeller, so I've been supporting you for so many years. However, grandpa is no longer able to hold on much longer. After I pass away, if you still want to rely on the Wallace family's power to deal with Rockefeller, the other people in the Wallace family will not agree to it. So, I've left these six people behind for you. I hope they can help you in the future…"
Janson said in a low voice.
"Grandpa, what nonsense are you talking about? You can still live for a very, very long time. You will definitely be able to see the day I take revenge…"
Rachel's eyes were red as she sobbed.
"I also want to live until that day, but my body might not be able to hold on till then. I know my body better than these doctors, so you don't have to say these words to comfort me…"
Janson sighed helplessly and continued, "If it wasn't for the fact that I'm a martial artist, I probably wouldn't have been able to live until now. My friends have already left. There's no point in living alone. Birth, old age, illness, and death are things that no one can escape. Everyone needs to experience them. So, I'm ready. There's nothing to be sad about..."
"Grandpa, don't say such things. I will definitely think of a way to let you live…"
Rachel was all choked up as she shouted.
"What else can we do? I've already used all the methods I can think of. Unless I can become a grandmaster, I won't be able to live for long with my black-rank body!"
Janson shook his head and continued, "Actually, I've lived a great life. Many people envy my life. Also, I have you next to me when I'm already so old. I'm a happy old man. So, there's no need to continue tormenting myself. What will come will come…"
Rachel looked at Janson with silent tears flowing down her face and did not know what to say.
"Although I'm old and my brain is a little weak, and those people in our family think that I'm muddle-headed, I'm actually not muddle-headed. It's just that sometimes I'm not willing to fuss over these things with them. I know about the current situation of our family. Once I die, the Wallace family might fall apart. These people's hearts have long been divided…"
Janson looked at Rachel and sighed softly.
Rachel looked at Janson who was lying on the bed and did not say anything because she knew that what Janson said was true. Now, the entire Wallace family was being held together by Janson alone. Once Janson was gone, the Wallace family would also be gone.
"Now that the human relations in this society have become very weak, everyone in the Wallace family lives for their own interests. They won't consider things like blood ties and kinship. So, Rachel, I introduced these six people to you in advance. When I'm no longer around, don't fight with the people in the Wallace family."
Janson said to Rachel in a very serious tone.
"I understand, Grandpa!"
Rachel nodded with a serious expression.
The reason why Janson secretly nurtured these six people was actually because he was worried that after his death, the people from the Wallace family would hurt Rachel in order to compete with her for the inheritance.
Everything Janson did was for Rachel.
"Although I was unconscious for three days, I knew very well that when I entered the operating theater, the people in our family must have been very nervous. They were worried that if I died, the Wallace family might be swallowed up by other big families. They were worried that once I died, they were not ready to fight for the inheritance…"
Janson looked at Rachel and smiled, then continued, "But you're the only one who really cares about me. You're the only one who's worried about my health…"
"..."
Rachel looked at Janson and said nothing.
"Over the years, I have seen the rise and fall of too many large families. Some things are inevitable. In a large family like ours, it is impossible for these people to treat each other with respect. Since they want to fight, let them fight. As long as you do not participate in these matters, it will be fine…"
Janson took a deep breath and continued, "If I didn't leave you with these six people, after I die, they would definitely try all kinds of ways to make you marry those young masters in York for their own benefit. But now you don't have to worry about this. With these six people protecting you, they won't dare to do anything to you!"

chapters.title: Chapter 1574: Getting Connor to Put on a Show
chapters.content:
Chapter 1574: Getting Connor to Put on a Show
"Grandpa, thank you!"
Rachel whispered to Janson.
Janson turned to look at Rachel and said softly, "Rachel, I'm already very old. I don't have any regrets, but I worry the most about you. I heard that you already have a boyfriend, right?"
"I do…"
Rachel nodded helplessly.
"Then, shouldn't you bring your boyfriend to meet Grandpa? This is also my last wish…"
Janson asked with a smile.
"I…"
Rachel looked at the expression on Janson's face and seemed a little embarrassed.
Back then, Janson had been introducing Rachel to all kinds of blind dates. In order to avoid these people, Rachel could only tell Janson that she had a boyfriend, but in fact, she didn't have one at all.
At this moment, Janson actually asked Rachel to bring her boyfriend to meet him. She was instantly dumbfounded.
"What? Is there a problem?"
Janson asked with a smile.
"Grandpa, you haven't fully recovered yet. After you've fully recovered, I'll bring him to meet you. What do you think about that?"
Rachel said helplessly.
"Alright, alright. We'll meet after I recover. I want to see which kid is so lucky to be able to marry my granddaughter!"
Janson said with a smile.
Rachel looked at Janson's helpless face and did not know what to say.
"As long as I can see my future grandson-in-law before I die, then I will really have no regrets in this life. I'm not worried about anything, but I'm worried that you've chosen the wrong person, so I have to help you check him out!"
At this moment, Janson's face was filled with anticipation because he was very curious about what the man Rachel liked looked like and whether he was worthy of his granddaughter.
Rachel was also feeling very helpless. After all, she was not in a relationship at all. She only said this so that Janson would not worry about her.
If Rachel couldn't find someone good enough, Janson would definitely be very disappointed, so she didn't want to disappoint Janson.
'Who can I get to help me?'
Rachel couldn't help but frown. Then, she instinctively looked down at her phone and saw that it was filled with calls from Connor. However, because Rachel didn't want to disturb Janson's rest, her phone was always on silent mode.
When Rachel saw Connor's name, a strange look flashed across her face.
Rachel didn't know many members of the opposite sex. The only one who could be considered a friend was Connor.
"If I have no other choice, I'll have to ask Connor to come and help me put on a show. I just don't know if he will agree…"
Rachel could not help but sigh in her heart.
Thinking of this, Rachel picked up her phone and whispered to Janson, "Grandpa, you must be tired. Why don't you get some rest now?"
"Alright!"
Janson nodded lightly and continued, "Don't forget what you promised me just now!"
"Don't worry, I definitely won't forget. When you get discharged, I'll bring my boyfriend to see you!"
Rachel replied helplessly.
"Alright…"
Janson smiled and nodded. Then, he closed his eyes and rested.
At this moment, Janson's last worry was finally settled.
After Rachel walked out of the ward, she found an empty place and dialed Connor's number.
However, the phone rang for a long time, but no one answered.
"This damn Connor. He always calls me when he has nothing to do. Now that I have something I need help with, he isn't picking up his phone…"
Rachel looked at her phone and cursed angrily.
Rachel also knew that it would take some time for her grandfather to get discharged from the hospital, so she didn't continue to call Connor. It wouldn't be too late for her to contact Connor after Janson was discharged.
But now, the only thing that worried Rachel was whether Connor would agree to help her or not!
The next day in Newtown.
After Vanessa Canfield recovered, Connor brought Vanessa to the casino and signed the contract with Danny.
After signing the contract, Connor asked Thomas Morgan to transfer the money to Danny's account.
From then on, this casino was completely owned by Connor alone.
After Connor took over the casino, it didn't affect him much. After all, most of the things were managed by Vanessa.
Vanessa was indeed very capable. It only took her three days to familiarize herself with the operation of the entire casino. She had also contacted Danny's connections. Overall, Vanessa's work was very efficient. If Connor were to manage these things alone, he would probably have no time to breathe.
Vanessa was now managing two big places, so she transferred a very trusted supervisor to the casino as the vice president. She also promoted a vice president at the Heavens Club. This way, the small things would be managed by these two vice presidents. Only when there were some big things would Vanessa personally appear.
After all, there were a lot of things going on in these two places. If Vanessa were to manage them alone, she definitely wouldn't be able to manage it.
Inside the casino.
Connor and Vanessa stood on the balcony on the second floor and looked at the gamblers downstairs.
"The casino's business looks pretty good!"
Connor turned and whispered to Vanessa.
"Yes, although the casino has changed owners, the business model hasn't changed. Also, it is difficult to find such a big casino in Oprana, so our business is still very good!"
Vanessa looked at Connor and said.
"It's all thanks to you, Vanessa. Without you, it would have been difficult for me to run the casino and Heavens Club…"
Connor said with a smile.
"I'm just doing my job. It's only right for me to work for you if you pay me!"
Vanessa said very calmly.
"That's true!"
Connor smiled and continued, "Alright, since there are no problems with the casino, I'm relieved. I'll be heading back now. If there's anything, just call me..."
After saying that, Connor turned around and was about to leave.
"Connor, wait!"
When Vanessa saw that Connor was about to leave, she quickly stopped him.
"Is there anything else?"
Connor turned and asked Vanessa softly.
"Connor, are you free tomorrow afternoon?"
Vanessa seemed to be in a dilemma.

chapters.title: Chapter 1575: Overslept
chapters.content:
Chapter 1575: Overslept
"Tomorrow afternoon?"
Connor was stunned for a moment, then asked, "I should be free. Is there something going on?"
"To thank you for bringing me to the hospital last time, I'm thinking of buying you lunch tomorrow…"
This was the first time Vanessa had ever invited a boy to dinner, so she was very nervous. She didn't know if Connor would misunderstand her.
"You don't have to thank me over such a small matter…"
Connor said with a smile.
"This is a small matter to you, but to me, it's not. Anyway, since you're free tomorrow afternoon, you can have a meal with me, right?"
Vanessa whispered.
Although taking her to the hospital was a small matter in Connor's eyes, it was a big deal for her. After all, she hadn't been taken care of by someone for a long time, so she wanted to thank him.
"Where do you want to bring me for lunch?"
Connor was also embarrassed to turn her down, so he could only agree to it.
"Why don't you come to my house? I'll personally cook for you. This way, I can show you how sincere I am!"
Vanessa thought for a moment and said to Connor.
"You know how to cook?"
Connor was stunned when he heard Vanessa's words. He asked Vanessa in disbelief.
"What? Are you looking down on me? I've been living alone for so many years. I definitely know how to cook, and the food I cook is very delicious!"
Vanessa said with a bit of pride.
"Haha…"
Connor looked at Vanessa and smiled, then said lightly, "Alright, since you're so sincere in inviting me, I'll go to your house tomorrow to taste your cooking…"
"Okay!"
Vanessa looked at Connor and nodded.
Connor didn't say anything else and turned around to leave.
...
The next day, 10 AM.
Connor drove to the neighborhood where Vanessa's house was located, then found Vanessa's house and knocked on it gently.
Last night, Vanessa stayed in the casino until two in the morning before returning home. After she got home, she took a shower and went to sleep. She was still asleep right now.
After knocking on the door for a long time, there was no movement inside, so he took out his phone and dialed Vanessa's number.
Ring, ring, ring…
After the phone rang for a long time, Vanessa picked up the phone and asked in a daze, "Who is it?"
"It's Connor. Didn't you want to cook me a meal? I'm already at your place. Aren't you home?"
Connor asked in a puzzled tone.
"Connor?"
When Vanessa heard this name, her eyes instantly widened, and she became much more clear-headed. She looked up at the clock on the wall and exclaimed, "Didn't I tell you to come at noon? Why are you here now?"
"I had nothing to do, so I came over early. Is it inconvenient for you?"
Connor said lightly.
"It's not that it's inconvenient. I was still sleeping just now and haven't put on my makeup yet. Wait for me!"
Vanessa said nervously.
"It doesn't matter. We're not dating, so I don't care about you not having makeup on. We're just having a meal together. Hurry up and open the door!"
Connor said speechlessly.
"No, you can't come in yet…"
Vanessa hurriedly shouted.
"Then, what should I do now? I can't just stand outside, right? You're the one who's treating me to a meal today. How can you treat someone to a meal like this?"
Connor said helplessly.
"Well, I came back late last night, so I forgot to buy groceries. Go buy some groceries…"
Vanessa said anxiously.
"What should I get?"
Connor asked.
"Anything. Buy whatever you want to eat. I'm hanging up now!"
Vanessa hung up the phone after saying that.
Outside the door, Connor looked at his phone helplessly. Vanessa said that she would treat him to a meal, but now she actually asked him to buy groceries. What was going on?
However, Connor didn't dare to say anything because Heavens Club and the casino needed Vanessa's management. He could only go to the market near her place to get groceries.
...
Any woman would care about her image in the eyes of the opposite sex.
Vanessa didn't expect Connor to come over so early today. She had just woken up and was still wearing pajamas and didn't put on makeup. She definitely didn't want Connor to see her like this, so after she hung up the phone, she rushed into the bathroom and began to wash up.
Connor ran to the market next to her place and bought some of his favorite vegetables.
When Connor came back after buying the vegetables, he realized that Vanessa was not done yet.
So, Connor could only stand outside the door and wait for about ten minutes before Vanessa finally opened the door.
Although Connor had been waiting for a long time in the corridor, when he saw Vanessa, he felt that his wait was worth it.
Today, Vanessa was dressed very beautifully. She was wearing a sexy tight-fitting spaghetti strap, revealing her seductive collarbone and shoulders. Her soft waist was also wrapped in a knitted sweater, and she was wearing a miniskirt. Her slender and beautiful long legs were exposed to the air. Her pair of exquisite little feet had on white high heels. She looked like a perfect piece of art that was utterly flawless.
"I'm really sorry to have made you wait for so long!"
Vanessa said after seeing Connor.
"It's alright. I was early…"
Connor knew that Vanessa came back late because of the casino, so it was not odd that she slept in.
"What did you buy?"
Vanessa took the groceries from Connor's hands and then carefully examined them.
"I didn't know what you could make, so I just bought some…"
Connor said with a smile.
"Don't worry, I can cook all the common dishes. As an apology, you don't have to worry about anything today. Just wait for me here. I'll go cook for you now!"
As she spoke, Vanessa was about to carry the groceries to the kitchen.
"Can you do it alone? Do you want me to help you?"
Connor asked.
"No. Just sit on the sofa and watch TV. It'll be done soon!"
Vanessa hurriedly replied.
Connor sat on the sofa and watched TV, while Vanessa was busy in the kitchen.
Sometimes, Vanessa would even glance at Connor in the living room, revealing a happy smile.
In fact, Vanessa really like this kind of environment. She had not cooked for others for a long time.

chapters.title: Chapter 1576: A Shameless Man
chapters.content:
Chapter 1576: A Shameless Man
About half an hour later, Vanessa finally finished cooking.
"Come eat. See if you like my cooking!"
Vanessa stood at the dining table and said to Connor with a nervous expression.
When Connor heard this, he walked straight to the dining table and looked at the dishes on the table very seriously. He smiled and said, "I didn't expect you to really know how to cook. I've underestimated you!"
Although Connor still didn't know how the dishes Vanessa made tasted, it looked pretty good.
"Who are you looking down on? My culinary skills are very good. Hurry up and taste the food!"
Vanessa pouted and said to Connor.
Connor picked up a piece of braised pork with chopsticks and put it in his mouth. Then, he tasted it carefully and said to Vanessa, "It's delicious!"
"Really?"
When Vanessa heard Connor say that she seemed a little excited.
"Of course, it's true!"
Connor lightly nodded.
"That's great! I was worried that you wouldn't like it. Sit down and eat!"
Vanessa said happily.
"Okay!"
Connor sat opposite Vanessa and was about to start eating.
However, just as Vanessa was about to sit down, a knock sounded on the door.
"It might be package delivery. I'll go take a look!"
Vanessa explained to Connor, and then she walked to the door in her high heels.
Vanessa cautiously looked outside through the peephole, but when she saw the person outside, she was instantly stunned, and the smile on her face disappeared.
"Vanessa, what's wrong?"
Seeing that Vanessa didn't open the door, he asked softly.
"It's nothing…"
Vanessa replied expressionlessly. Although the knocking did not stop, she had no intention of opening the door and returned to the dining area.
"Vanessa, aren't you going to open the door?"
Connor asked softly.
"No. He's just an annoying person. There's no need to waste time with him. Let's eat. He'll leave on his own in a while…"
Vanessa explained lightly and then sat down to eat.
Connor knew that something was wrong with Vanessa, but he didn't say anything and just ate quietly.
After knocking for a while, the person outside stopped knocking. Instead, he shouted at the top of his voice, "Vanessa, I know you're at home. Open the door. I have something to tell you…"
When Vanessa heard this sentence, her frown deepened, but she still did not move.
Connor knew that since the other party knew Vanessa by name, it meant that this person knew Vanessa.
"Vanessa, who is that?"
Connor asked in confusion.
"My ex-boyfriend…"
Vanessa replied after a moment of hesitation.
"Your ex-boyfriend?"
Connor was stunned when he heard Vanessa's words. He was very surprised.
Although Connor and Vanessa had known each other for a long time, he had never heard her talk about her an ex-boyfriend.
"His name is Tyler Freeman. When I first came to Newtown, I met him. Then, he started to pursue me. At first, I didn't like him very much. However, he pursued me for two years, and we got together…"
Vanessa paused for a moment before continuing, "After Tyler got together with me, he tried all kinds of ways to sleep with me, but I rejected all of his advances…"
"Did the two of you break up because of this?"
Connor was stunned for a moment before asking.
"Actually, it wasn't because of that. Tyler met the daughter of a provincial big shot at a gathering. At that time, he said that he didn't have a girlfriend, so he got together with this girl. Then, Tyler told me that if I still didn't agree to live with him, he would break up with me. I was conflicted for a long time. In the end, I chose to break up with him because I felt that he did not really like me for who I was. He just wanted my body!"
Vanessa took a deep breath and continued, "Later on, I found out that Tyler had actually been living with another woman before he broke up with me. That woman wasn't pretty, but he only got together with her because of his relationship with her father…"
"Then, why is he here looking for you now?"
Connor asked in confusion.
When Vanessa heard Connor's words, she couldn't help but sneer, and then lightly said, "I heard that Tyler and that woman got married. With the help of that woman's father, Tyler's business grew bigger and bigger, with a market value of more than 100 million. However, someone filed a report against Tyler's father-in-law. In the end, he was imprisoned for corruption, but Tyler himself was not affected at all. Later, I investigated and found out that it was Tyler who reported his father-in-law!"
"Reporting his own father-in-law? This guy is really ruthless! Why did he do that?"
Connor asked in confusion.
"Because his father-in-law had always been controlling him. He doesn't want to be controlled by his father-in-law for the rest of his life, so he burned the bridge after crossing it. After that, he divorced that woman. I heard that she didn't get a single cent from Tyler."
Vanessa said slowly.
"What a scumbag!"
Connor replied helplessly.
"Some time ago, at my friend's birthday party, Tyler saw me. He knew that I was the general manager of Heavens Club, so he was hoping that I could help him contact some people, but I rejected him. Then, he started pestering me every day, wanting to get back together with me!"
Vanessa continued.
"I've never seen such a shameless man ever!"
Connor said speechlessly.
"Vanessa, open the door!"
At this moment, Tyler shouted at the top of his voice.
After hesitating for a moment, Connor said softly, "Vanessa, go and open the door for him. Since I'm here today, we can talk it out. Otherwise, it won't be good if he continues to make a fuss…"
When Vanessa heard Connor's words, she slowly raised her head to look at him. If he wasn't here, she definitely wouldn't open the door. After all, she didn't know what Tyler would do.
But now Connor was here, so Vanessa was a lot braver.

chapters.title: Chapter 1577: Ten Billion Dollars
chapters.content:
Chapter 1577: Ten Billion Dollars
Vanessa was staying in an ordinary suite, and there were other neighbors around.
If Tyler continued causing a ruckus like this, it would also affect the others.
Therefore, after hesitating for a moment, Vanessa walked to the door and opened it.
Connor subconsciously looked outside the door and saw a young man in a black suit standing outside the door with a bouquet of roses in his hand.
"Vanessa! Finally!"
Tyler looked at Vanessa and smiled, then strode into the house.
Vanessa reached out her hand to stop Tyler, then said with a cold expression, "Tyler, I've already made it very clear to you last time. Can you stop pestering me? If you continue to pester me like this, I'm really going to call the police!"
"Vanessa, I know I did wrong back then. I regret it now. I hope you can give me another chance. I promise that I won't hurt you this time. As long as you accept me, we can get married anytime."
Tyler shouted excitedly at Vanessa.
"Get married?"
When Vanessa heard that, she couldn't help but sneer. Then, she said expressionlessly, "Tyler, are you being serious right now? The two of us have already broken up for so many years. I no longer have any feelings for you, yet you still want to marry me. I've never seen such a shameless man like you!"
"Vanessa, no matter what you say, I will not give up…"
Tyler shouted at Vanessa.
Vanessa was speechless when she heard Tyler's words, not knowing what to say.
"Vanessa, what's going on?"
At this time, Connor suddenly walked to Vanessa's side.
When Tyler saw Connor, he instinctively froze for a moment. Then, he said in a puzzled tone, "Vanessa, why do you have a man in your house?"
"What does that have to do with you?"
Vanessa pursed her lips and replied.
Tyler ignored Vanessa and pointed at Connor, shouting, "Who are you?"
"My name is Connor McDonald!"
Connor replied indifferently.
"Connor?"
A strange look flashed across Tyler's face, and then he asked, "What's your relationship with Vanessa?"
"Vanessa and I..."
Connor was just about to say that he and Vanessa were working together, but Vanessa suddenly reached out and grabbed Connor's arm, then said softly, "Tyler, Connor is my man. The two of us are together…"
"Your man?"
Tyler was instantly stunned when he heard this sentence. He knew Vanessa very well. He knew that if Vanessa wasn't together with Connor, she definitely wouldn't have brought Connor back home, nor would she be touching Connor like that.
But Tyler didn't understand how a woman like Vanessa would fall for such an ordinary person like Connor.
Tyler took a deep breath, then whispered to Connor, "Brat, do you know who I am?"
"I've never met you before, have I?"
Connor replied indifferently.
"We've never met, but you have probably heard of me. I'm Tyler Freeman, the president of the Freeman Corporation!"
Tyler said with a very proud tone.
The Freeman Corporation was indeed quite famous in Newtown. They mainly dealt in things like milk products. Therefore, many people in Newtown had heard of the Freeman Corporation, just like how most people knew about Nestle.
However, Connor was not from Newtown, so he did not know much about the Freeman Corporation.
"I'm sorry, I don't know you!"
Connor said expressionlessly.
"You don't know me?"
When Tyler heard Connor's words, he appeared somewhat helpless.
"I don't…"
Connor shook his head again.
"Alright, it doesn't matter if you don't know me. I hope you can break up with Vanessa. I'll fulfill any conditions you ask for…"
Tyler was planning to use money to deal with Connor.
"Any condition?"
Connor pretended to be surprised.
"That's right. Tell me, how much do you want?"
Tyler took out a check from his clothes as he spoke, as if he was planning to write a check for Connor.
"..."
Connor looked at Tyler and said nothing.
"Say something. There aren't many opportunities like this. Think carefully about how much money you want!"
Tyler shouted at Connor impatiently.
Connor looked at Tyler indifferently, then laughed and said, "How about 10 billion dollars?"
"..."
Tyler could not help but be stunned for a moment after hearing Connor's words. He then stammered as he asked Connor, "Kid, how much was that?"
"I said 10 billion dollars, did you not hear me?"
Connor repeated indifferently.
"Are you crazy? Do you know how much 10 billion is?"
Tyler shouted speechlessly.
Tyler's entire net worth did not even add up to one billion dollars, so 10 billion was simply an astronomical figure to Tyler.
"Is 10 billion dollars a lot?"
Connor sneered and turned to Vanessa. "Vanessa, tell him whether 10 billion dollars is a lot for me or not."
"It's not!"
Vanessa said honestly.
"Stop putting on a show!"
Tyler felt that Connor was playing with him, so he shouted at the top of his voice.
"Tyler, I'm not putting on a show. I really don't like you. We won't be together, so I hope you can leave right now!"
Vanessa frowned and said to Tyler.
Tyler took a deep breath, gritted his teeth, and said, "Vanessa, I will never give up!"
"How can you be so shameless? Didn't you hear what Vanessa said just now? I'll give you one last chance. Get lost now!"
Connor frowned and said to Tyler.
"What can you do if I don't go?"
Tyler did not seem to take Connor seriously at all and asked Connor with a disdainful expression.
"What can I do?"
Connor couldn't help but laugh when he heard Tyler's words. Then, he raised his fist and took a swing at Tyler's face.
Connor was a martial artist. Although he didn't use his full strength, it was still a very ruthless punch for an ordinary person like Tyler.
Tyler did not have time to react and was knocked down by Connor's punch.
Tyler struggled to stand up after taking the punch. Then, he shouted at Connor with a very agitated expression, "Brat, how dare you hit me?"
"I only used half of my strength in that punch just now. If you continue to cause trouble, don't blame me for what happens next…"
Connor said expressionlessly.
No man would be willing to take a beating in front of the woman he loved and not retaliate, so Tyler was the same.

chapters.title: Chapter 1578: Should We Have Some Wine?
chapters.content:
Chapter 1578: Should We Have Some Wine?
"Today, I'll let you see how powerful I am!"
Tyler shouted with a ferocious expression.
When Tyler was in university, he was the president of the mixed martial arts association. In addition, he had been working out for many years, so he was quite fit.
Although he was knocked down by Connor's punch just now, he felt that he was unprepared, so he let Connor sneak attack him.
If it was a one-on-one, he would definitely be able to defeat Connor. After all, Connor was thin and weak, and he did not look particularly powerful.
"I advise you not to fight me…"
Connor said to Tyler with a smile.
"Cut the crap. Come out…"
Tyler shouted at Connor with his eyes wide open.
Connor was somewhat helpless, and then he walked out of the room.
"Connor, he was the president of the mixed martial arts association before…"
Vanessa seemed to be worried that Connor would be in danger, so she couldn't help but remind him softly.
"Don't worry, even if he's the world champion of mixed martial arts, he's no match for me!"
Connor smiled back at Vanessa.
Vanessa couldn't help but be stunned after hearing Connor's words. She was somewhat puzzled, as if she couldn't understand why Connor was so confident.
At this moment, Tyler raised his fist and smashed it toward Connor's face.
Connor didn't even look at Tyler and easily dodged Tyler's punch. Then, he turned and slapped Tyler fiercely on the face.
Smack!
A crisp sound rang out.
Tyler wasn't able to see how Connor had attacked, and he felt his vision turn pitch black.
Connor's slap was not only fast but also very powerful, sending Tyler flying.
Tyler struggled to stand up, but he lost his balance and fell down the stairs.
Connor strode over to Tyler, then raised his fist and fiercely punched Tyler on the face.
Tyler, who had taken another punch, was completely dumbfounded. He did not think that Connor would be so strong.
Connor stepped on Tyler's chest with one foot. No matter how Tyler struggled, he was unable to stand up.
Connor, on the other hand, slapped Tyler's face again and again.
Smack!
Connor slapped Tyler's face a dozen times before stopping.
At this time, Tyler was already beaten black and blue by Connor. He looked miserable, and he was mumbling non-stop.
"Do you give up?"
Connor asked Tyler softly.
"I give up…"
Tyler did not hesitate and hurriedly nodded at Connor.
"Do you still want to fight me?"
Connor asked.
"No..."
Tyler shook his head and said,
"I'm warning you, if you dare to harass Vanessa again, I'll beat you senseless. Next time, I won't let you off so easily, you understand?"
"Yes…"
Tyler nodded again.
He knew that Connor was strong. He was definitely not Connor's match alone. If he did not give in now, he would probably be beaten up again. That was why Tyler agreed so readily.
"Do you really understand?"
Connor looked at Tyler and smiled.
"I do. I won't harass Vanessa anymore…"
Tyler seemed to be on the verge of collapse as he shouted at Connor.
"I know that you must be very dissatisfied now. You must be thinking about how you can take revenge on me, right?"
Connor said with a smile.
Tyler was instantly dumbfounded after hearing Connor's words. He was very nervous.
"I know that a person like you will not give up so easily. If you want to take revenge on me, you can, but you'd better come at me. Don't make a move on Vanessa. If I find out that you are still harassing Vanessa, I will definitely make you regret it for the rest of your life!"
Connor whispered to Tyler.
"Don't... Don't worry, I definitely won't dare to…"
Tyler stammered as he exclaimed.
"Get lost!"
Connor said to Tyler expressionlessly.
"..."
When Tyler heard Connor's words, he did not hesitate at all. He turned around and ran toward the stairs.
When Vanessa saw Tyler fleeing, she finally eased up a little.
Connor walked to Vanessa's side and then whispered to her, "Vanessa, you don't have to worry. He probably won't dare to bother you anymore. He's already scared out of his wits by me…"
"Then, will he take revenge on you?"
Vanessa hesitated for a moment before asking Connor in a low voice.
"Vanessa, you've known me for a long time. Who am I? Even if he had a hundred guts, he wouldn't dare to find trouble with me!"
Connor said as he brought Vanessa back to her place.
After entering her place, Vanessa hesitated for a moment, then whispered to Connor, "Connor, thank you for what you did…"
"You don't have to thank me. We are friends, and you've helped me a lot by staying in Newtown. This is nothing worth mentioning…"
Connor said to Vanessa with a smile.
Vanessa looked at Connor and hesitated for a moment before saying softly, "Let's and eat. All I wanted to do was to cook you a meal. I didn't expect such a thing to happen…"
"It's fine…"
Connor smiled faintly, then sat down at the dining table and began eating.
Perhaps it was because of what happened just now, Vanessa was a little uneasy and seemed to be rather absent-minded.
Connor didn't say anything and just ate quietly.
"Connor…"
Vanessa called out after hesitating for a long time.
"What's wrong?"
Connor slowly looked up at Vanessa.
Vanessa put down her spoon and whispered to Connor, "I didn't mean anything when I said that you were my boyfriend. I just wanted Tyler to leave. You know that, right?"
"Of course, I know that."
Connor smiled faintly and continued, "This is not the first time I've pretended to be someone else's boyfriend. I'm already used to this kind of thing. You don't have to take it to heart…"
"Alright!"
Vanessa looked at Connor and smiled, then didn't say anything.
"I have to say that you are quite the chef…"
Connor said with a smile.
"If you like it, should we have some wine?"
Vanessa suggested.

chapters.title: Chapter 1579: Making Do for One Night
chapters.content:
Chapter 1579: Making Do for One Night
"Alright, since you want to drink, I'll drink with you…"
Connor nodded.
And because of Tyler's appearance, Vanessa inevitably recalled some bad memories. Now, she was feeling a little uncomfortable, so she wanted to drink some wine.
A moment later, Vanessa took a bottle of expensive Lafite red wine and two wine glasses to the table and sat beside Connor.
Connor and Vanessa were sitting rather close to each other. Connor could even smell the faint fragrance on Vanessa's body. The fragrance on her body was the unique fragrance of a mature woman. Coupled with Vanessa's sexy figure, it was a fatal attraction to Connor. He was even a little worried that if Vanessa drank too much and wanted to do something to him, he would not be able to control himself!
Vanessa poured a glass of wine for Connor, then raised her wine glass and said, "Connor, thank you for today. Let's toast!"
"Alright…"
Connor nodded lightly, then clinked glasses with Vanessa and drank the red wine in the glass.
"Another glass…"
It seemed that Vanessa wanted to get herself drunk, because only then could she forget those bad things.
Connor also knew that Vanessa was in a bad mood today, so he didn't say anything and continued drinking with her.
Connor's alcohol tolerance was very good, so even if he drank with Vanessa for a night, there wouldn't be any problem.
But Connor was very worried about Vanessa, because in just half an hour, Vanessa had already drunk half a bottle of wine.
At this moment, Vanessa's pretty face was slightly red as she softly said to Connor, "Let's continue…"
"Vanessa, that's enough. Let's stop drinking…"
Connor stretched out his hand to stop Vanessa and said softly to her.
"We haven't had much to drink. I haven't drunk in a long time. In the past, it was boring for me to drink alone. Now that there's finally someone to drink with me, we must drink more today…"
Vanessa said softly to Connor.
"I drove here today. It's enough for me…"
Connor said speechlessly.
"So what if you drove here? You can sleep here tonight. There are many rooms here…"
Vanessa said as she poured wine for Connor.
"The main thing is that I'm a little worried about you…"
Connor said helplessly.
"What are you worried about? Are you worried that I'll drink too much and do something to you? You're thinking too much. I'm just in a bad mood, that's why I wanted to drink with you…"
Vanessa smiled and continued, "You might not know this, but my parents passed away when I was very young, so I don't have any relatives by my side. I've been living alone since I was young. I want to find someone who truly loves me to marry and live with him, but I don't know what's wrong with me. I just can't find someone who truly loves me…"
"Maybe it's because you're too beautiful!"
Connor said helplessly.
Do you think I'm beautiful?"
Vanessa asked Connor with a smile.
"Yes…"
Connor nodded without any hesitation.
"Then, why don't you have a drink with me?"
Vanessa seemed to be acting coquettishly.
"Alright, then!"
Connor couldn't bear to refuse seeing Vanessa like this, so he could only nod helplessly.
After more than ten minutes, Vanessa was completely drunk and couldn't even walk steadily.
Connor looked at Vanessa who was already so drunk helplessly. He could only help Vanessa to the bedroom and then take off her shoes.
Originally, Connor wanted to help Vanessa change her clothes, but he thought it might be a little inappropriate, so he didn't do that.
After cleaning up, Connor wanted to go home.
Although he did drink a little, the effect on Connor was actually very small.
But just as Connor was about to reach the door, he suddenly heard Vanessa shouting from the bedroom, "Don't leave. Stay with me…"
Connor couldn't help but be stunned after hearing Vanessa's words.
When Connor heard Vanessa's words, he couldn't help but be stunned. He seemed somewhat helpless.
In fact, Connor didn't have any other thoughts about Vanessa. Although Vanessa was indeed very sexy and very beautiful, Connor had always tried his best to restrain himself and didn't want to do anything out of line. After all, if Connor really did something with Vanessa, then it would be rather problematic.
But at this time, Vanessa was already unconscious, plus just now Tyler came to harass Vanessa, Connor was worried that if he really left like this, then Tyler's return might put Vanessa in danger.
So, Connor hesitated for a couple of seconds and chose to stay. He returned to Vanessa's bedroom and sat on the sofa.
"Looks like I have to stay here for the night…"
Connor looked at Vanessa who was already sleeping on the bed and sighed helplessly.
Although Connor's alcohol tolerance was good, he and Vanessa drank a lot today. In addition, Connor had a lot of things to do recently, so he fell asleep soon after sitting on the sofa.
In the blink of an eye, a night had passed.
When Vanessa woke up again, she found herself lying on the bed. She looked a little nervous, and then she quickly lifted the quilt and looked down at her clothes. After making sure that she was still wearing her clothes, Vanessa's nervous mood eased a little, and then she looked at Connor.
At this moment, Connor was still sleeping soundly on the sofa.
"Did he not leave last night?"
Looking at Connor on the sofa, Vanessa suddenly had an inexplicable feeling in her heart.
Vanessa also found something very embarrassing. She drank too much last night, so the living room was a mess. There were wine bottles everywhere, and wine was spilled all over the ground.
Vanessa was a clean freak. Seeing the living room like this, she must be feeling very uncomfortable.
So, after hesitating for a moment, she quietly walked to the wardrobe and found a set of clothes. Then, she ran into the bathroom to wash up and change into clean clothes.
After changing her clothes, Vanessa began to clean up the living room.
Ten minutes later, Connor opened his eyes slowly, perhaps because he heard the commotion in the living room.
After opening his eyes, Connor glanced at the bedroom and realized that Vanessa was no longer on the bed.
So, he got up and walked to the living room, only to see that Vanessa was cleaning.
The moment Connor saw Vanessa, his eyes widened, and he was stunned.

chapters.title: Chapter 1580: Lost Herself
chapters.content:
Chapter 1580: Lost Herself
Perhaps it was because she was at home, Vanessa was dressed very casually. She did not have the heavy makeup from before, instead there was a lazy charm to the way she was dressed.
She had a head of curly black hair and was wearing a spaghetti strap short skirt. She was tall and sexy, and her beautiful legs were bare under the short skirt. She was wearing a pair of white home slippers, and her chest was so full that it feels as if it was about to burst through her shirt, forming a very beautiful scenery.
Connor was obviously mesmerized by Vanessa's perfect figure. Vanessa's figure was simply the best of the best.
"Connor, you're awake?"
At this moment, Vanessa saw that Connor was awake and called out to him.
"Yes!"
Connor nodded lightly, then walked over to Vanessa's side and said softly, "Vanessa, do you know that you drank too much last night?"
"..."
When Vanessa heard Connor's words, she appeared somewhat shy as she said softly, "I'm really sorry. I had something on my mind last night, so I drank a bit too much. Last night, I didn't... I didn't do anything I shouldn't have, right?"
"You didn't. You fell asleep after drinking too much last night…"
Connor looked at Vanessa and shook his head lightly.
"That's good…"
When Vanessa knew that she didn't do anything to Connor, she let out a long sigh of relief. She looked much more at ease now.
"Vanessa, let me help you clean up!"
Connor thought for a moment before walking to Vanessa's side.
"It's fine. I've already cleaned up most of it. I just need to mop the floor. Sit on the sofa for a while. After I'm done mopping the floor, I'll make breakfast for you…"
Vanessa quickly refused.
After all, she drank too much last night, and it was Connor who took care of her, so Vanessa felt rather embarrassed about it.
Connor saw that there was only a mop in Vanessa's house, so he couldn't help now. He didn't say anything else and just sat on the sofa.
Vanessa was mopping the floor while chatting with Connor. At this time, she was obviously much more awake, so most of the content of the conversation with Connor was about the future development of the casino and Heavens Club.
Vanessa was indeed very business-minded. There were some things that Connor didn't think of, and he was now very relieved that Vanessa was managing the casino and Heavens Club. In the future, these two places were likely to become the key to Connor's fight against Rockefeller.
After all, these two places could help Connor build a network that the Empire World Corporation could not compare to.
More importantly, these two places now belonged to Connor. Empire World Corporation was not part of it at all, so these two places were completely under Connor's control.
While they were chatting, Connor encountered a very embarrassing problem. Vanessa was really too attractive.
Ever since Freya Phillips regained her memories, Connor had already cut off contact with Chloe Lawson, Yelena Allen, and the others. In addition, Maya Phillips had been causing trouble, so he had not touched a woman for a long time.
Vanessa was now mopping the floor in front of Connor. Sometimes, she needed to bend down. When she bent down, her round buttocks would be outlined into an arc that was very alluring. Connor was a normal man. When he saw this scene, his body inevitably reacted.
Although Connor had been trying his best to control it, there were some things that he could not control at all.
"Connor, lift your legs. Let me clean this spot here…"
At this moment, Vanessa walked to Connor's side and said to him softly.
...
Connor was sitting on the sofa, and in front of the sofa was the coffee table. Vanessa wanted to clean the area between the sofa and the coffee table.
Connor heard Vanessa's words and quickly made way for her.
Vanessa gently bent down in front of Connor. He could even clearly smell the fragrance on Vanessa, which made his heartbeat accelerate once more.
Connor hesitated for a moment. He felt that it was not appropriate for him to just sit there, so he wanted to go to the balcony to get some fresh air to calm himself down.
But Connor had just stood up when Vanessa accidentally tripped over the coffee table.
"Ah!"
Vanessa cried out and fell toward the sofa.
Vanessa fell directly into Connor's arms. Connor grabbed hold of her, and they fell onto the sofa together.
As Vanessa fell backwards, she was practically sitting on Connor.
And just now, Connor instinctively reached out and grabbed Vanessa by the waist. He could now clearly smell the alluring fragrance on Vanessa's body. This was the unique smell of a mature woman.
And Vanessa could naturally feel Connor's reaction. Feeling his body's reaction, Vanessa's delicate body trembled unwittingly.
Vanessa was so transfixed by the feeling that she did not want to stand up. It seemed as though she wanted to continue sitting on top of Connor, but her rationality told her that she couldn't do that, so she tried her best to regain control of her body and was about to stand up.
However, the more Vanessa tried to stand up, the more contact they had.
At this moment, Connor was even more affected by the position they were in.
Vanessa was charming. She was sexy and mature. She was truly an amazing woman. Therefore, under such circumstances, no man would be able to control his desires. Connor wasn't a saint, so he naturally couldn't control himself.
Feeling Connor's body react even more strongly, a brief thought of wanting to indulge him flashed across Vanessa's mind. Her body trembled slightly, and she couldn't help but gently pinch Connor.
"Connor, let go of me…"
Vanessa whispered to Connor.
Connor couldn't hear what Vanessa was saying right now. He seemed to have lost all rationality as he was still hugging Vanessa tightly.
Vanessa's beautiful eyes were tightly shut, and her face was flushed.
She could not help but move against his body, as if she had completely lost herself.
When Connor felt Vanessa's delicate body moving slightly against his, he mindlessly stretched his right hand under Vanessa's clothes.

chapters.title: Chapter 1581: Tenner Ward Appears
chapters.content:
Chapter 1581: Tenner Ward Appears
"Connor, don't…"
She didn't know why, but when Vanessa felt the warmth of Connor's right hand, she suddenly regained her senses and hurriedly called out.
However, Connor did not stop what he was doing.
Vanessa's delicate body trembled as she pushed Connor away and said in a low voice, "Connor, stop. We can't do this."
Connor was stunned when he heard Vanessa's words, then he regained his senses and immediately released Vanessa.
When Vanessa realized that Connor had let go of her, she suddenly felt a sense of loss. After all, what she said just now was out of instinct, but when he really let go of her, she felt rather disappointed.
However, Connor seemed to have calmed himself down, so Vanessa quickly stood up.
"Vanessa, I was a little impulsive just now. I'm sorry!"
Connor said to Vanessa softly.
When Vanessa heard Connor's words, a trace of embarrassment flashed across her eyes as she said softly, "It's... It's okay. Let's just pretend that nothing happened. I'll go make breakfast for you now!"
After saying that, Vanessa turned around and ran toward the kitchen.
Connor looked at Vanessa's back, and he seemed somewhat helpless.
"This woman spells danger. Looks like I have to keep a distance from her in the future. Otherwise, I'll easily lose control of myself…"
Connor could not help but sigh deep down.
Half an hour later, Connor and Vanessa finished eating their breakfast, then he left her house alone.
After leaving Vanessa's house, Connor took out his phone to look at the time. He then realized that there was only one day left until the agreed time with Michelle Hicks, so he quickly gave her a call.
Ring, ring, ring…
After the phone rang twice, Michelle answered the call.
"Hello?"
Michelle said warily.
"Miss Hicks, there's one day left to the agreed time. Can you help me find Tenner Ward?"
Connor asked in a low voice.
"Mr. McDonald, Tenner hasn't contacted me for the past few days. Can you give me two more days?"
Michelle pleaded in a tired voice.
After hearing Michelle's words, Connor hesitated for a moment before saying indifferently, "Miss Hicks, exposing those videos of you doesn't benefit me at all. I just want to find Tenner now. I'll give you three more days. If you still can't find Tenner after three days, things will get ugly…"
"Alright, I understand…"
Michelle let out a long sigh of relief before responding.
Connor didn't waste any time and hung up the phone.
...
In Michelle's house.
When Michelle saw that the call had ended, her delicate face looked a little tired because she was also in despair.
Michelle had really tried her best over the past few days. She tried contacting Tenner through various channels, but it was as if he had disappeared from the face of the earth. He did not pick up her calls and could not be found at the places where they went on dates.
Therefore, Michelle could only stay in the house that Tenner had bought for, hoping that a miracle would happen.
Although Michelle often cheated on him, she still had feelings for her husband. She had never thought of leaving her husband. It was just that sometimes, she couldn't control herself.
In the past few days, Michelle had been repenting. She had already thought things through. As long as this whole debacle was over, she would cut off all contact with her lovers and live a proper life with her husband.
Michelle waited anxiously in the room. In the blink of an eye, a day had passed.
As the sky gradually darkened, Michelle became even more desperate.
Because she knew that time was ticking, and her time was almost up.
Bang! Bang!
At this moment, there was a knock on the door.
When Michelle heard the knock on the door, she jolted in surprise. She hurriedly tidied her clothes and hair, then quickly walked to the door and looked out through the peephole.
When Michelle saw that it was Tenner, she opened the door without thinking.
Tenner then strode into the room.
When Michelle saw Tenner, she threw herself into his arms and shouted, "Hubby, where have you been? Do you know how worried I was about you?"
Seeing how enthusiastic Michelle was, Tenner hugged her and whispered, "I've missed you too, you little vixen…"
After saying that, Tenner and Michelle started kissing.
Michelle knew that it was not the right time to inform Connor, so she acted very naturally from the beginning to the end. Tenner did not notice anything strange.
"I'm not leaving today…"
Tenner said smugly.
"Hmph…"
Michelle gently smacked Tenner on the chest and said, "Hubby, what have you been doing recently? Why is your phone turned off?"
"I've been in a bit of trouble recently. Don't contact me. If I miss you, I'll come to you myself!"
Tenner didn't explain anything to Michelle and replied calmly.
"Oh, okay…"
Michelle nodded lightly when she heard what Tenner said.
"Let's continue…"
Michelle quickly reached out and pushed Tenner. Then, she said seductively, "Hubby, I bought a new set of clothes. Wait for me. I'll put it on for you to see…"
"Hehe, you little vixen, you really have many tricks up your sleeve…"
Tenner couldn't help but laugh when he heard Michelle's words. Then, he patted Michelle's butt and said, "Hurry up and go get changed…"
"Wait for me here!"
Michelle kissed Tenner on the cheek, then turned around and walked out of the bedroom.

chapters.title: Chapter 1582: Interrogation
chapters.content:
Chapter 1582: Interrogation
After Michelle left the bedroom, she ran straight to the bathroom and took out her phone to send a message to Connor.
"Tenner is at my house right now. Come over quickly!"
After Connor received the message from Michelle, he replied, "Help me stall for time. I'll be there in half an hour!"
When Michelle saw Connor's message, she looked a little helpless.
However, she had no other choice. She looked for a sexy outfit and went back to the bedroom.
When Tenner saw Michelle's sexy outfit, his eyes widened, and he pressed Michelle onto the bed.
On the other side, after Connor received Michelle's message, he drove straight to her house.
He even gave Reena Satchwell a call and told her to keep an eye on Tenner.
This was the best opportunity for Connor. If he missed this opportunity, it would be impossible for him to capture Tenner again.
Half an hour later, Connor arrived at Michelle's house.
Michelle had already opened the door, so Connor could easily enter the room.
When Connor entered the room, Tenner and Michelle were already done. Tenner was lying on the bed smoking while Michelle was waiting nervously for Connor to appear.
"Mr. Ward, right?"
At this moment, Connor suddenly walked into the room and exclaimed with a smile.
Tenner was stunned when he heard Connor. He stared at Connor with an incredulous expression.
Connor and Tenner had never met before, but they had both read each other's information. Therefore, Tenner recognized the young man who had appeared in Michelle's house at a glance. Connor knew that this person was the Tenner he was looking for.
"You b*tch, how dare you betray me?"
Tenner was a very smart person. He instantly realized what was going on and shouted at Michelle.
"I'm sorry. I was also forced to do so…"
Michelle stood up and ran behind Connor without hesitation.
Connor walked toward Tenner and said with a smile, "Mr. Ward, although the two of us have never met before, I suppose you know who I am…"
"What do you want?"
Tenner tried his best to control his emotions as he asked Connor in a low voice.
"You know very well what I want. Tell me where Yaakov Ward is, and I can spare you!"
Connor was not in the mood to beat around the bush.
"I don't know where Yaakov Ward is!"
Tenner whispered.
"You don't?"
Connor couldn't help but laugh coldly when he heard Tenner's words. He then said lightly, "Tenner, you should know what kind of person I am, and you should also know the way I do things. Therefore, I advise you to cooperate with me. This way, you will not suffer as much. Otherwise, I won't let you off that easily…"
"Of course, I know who you are, but I really don't know where Yaakov Ward is. You got me today. You can kill me or torture me, but don't even think about getting any information about Mr. Ward from me!"
Tenner said expressionlessly.
Tenner was different from Arthur Synder. He knew very well that if he betrayed Yaakov, the outcome would be worse than death. Therefore, he had already made up his mind not to tell Connor anything no matter what.
Meanwhile, Connor sized up Tenner and said calmly, "I didn't expect you to be so loyal!"
"Just kill me!"
Tenner whispered to Connor.
"Wouldn't it be too easy for you if I killed you?"
Connor looked at Tenner and smiled. Then, he said calmly, "I know that it's definitely not that easy to get something from you, but I'm not in a hurry. I have plenty of time to play with you…"
Tenner was stunned when he heard Connor's words. Then, he stood up and ran toward the window like a madman.
It was obvious that Tenner was planning to jump out of the window.
However, Connor did not give Tenner a chance at all. He raised his leg and kicked Tenner on the back.
Bang!
There was a loud bang.
Tenner's body slammed into the wall, and he spat out a mouthful of blood.
Tenner struggled to stand up, but he felt as if he had just been hit by a truck. He could not muster any strength at all.
"Since you're in my hands, don't even think about escaping…"
Connor looked at Tenner on the ground and said expressionlessly.
Tenner looked at Connor with red eyes and said nothing.
Connor took out his phone and dialed a number.
A few minutes later, seven or eight people rushed into Michelle's house.
"Mr. McDonald!"
One of the leading young men walked to Connor's side and greeted him respectfully.
"I'll leave this person to you. Use all the methods you can think of to make this person tell the truth. Do you understand what I mean?"
Connor whispered to the young man.
"Mr. McDonald, don't worry. We will definitely complete the mission!"
The young man said confidently.
Upon hearing the young man's response, Connor turned to look at Michelle and said expressionlessly, "Your mission has been completed. You can leave now!"
Michelle looked at Connor and said in a low voice, "What about the video?"
"Don't worry, releasing those videos won't do me any good. I won't disturb you anymore in the future."
Connor whispered to Michelle.
Michelle took a deep breath when she heard Connor's words. Then, she didn't say anything else. She put on her clothes and left with her things.
After Michelle left, Connor sat on the sofa and played with his phone. Reena's subordinates closed the bedroom door, and Tenner's wailing could be heard from inside.
Tenner was indeed a loyal man.
Reena's subordinates tortured Tenner for nearly three hours, but he still did not give in. During this period of time, these people had used almost all the methods they could think of.
Connor was a little hungry waiting at Michelle's house, so he went out to eat something.
By the time Connor returned to Michelle's house, the wailing had stopped.
"Mr. McDonald!"
The young man saw Connor and hurriedly called out.
"Did he give in?"
Connor asked the young man softly.
"Yes…"
The young man hurriedly nodded.
"Alright, thank you for your hard work!"
Connor patted the young man on the shoulder and walked into the bedroom.

chapters.title: Chapter 1583: What Method?
chapters.content:
Chapter 1583: What Method?
At this moment, Tenner no longer had the arrogance from before. He was lying on the ground like a dead dog, muttering non-stop, "Don't hit me. Please, don't hit me…"
When Connor saw the state Tenner was in, he looked a little helpless and said softly, "Why did you have to do this to yourself? If you had told me the truth earlier, wouldn't things have been fine?"
As for Tenner, it was as if he did not hear Connor's words. He kept repeating the words 'don't hit me'.
Connor walked up to Tenner and whispered to him, "Tell me, where is Yaakov Ward?"
Tenner looked at Connor and stammered, "I don't know where Yaakov is. I've lost contact with him a long time ago…"
"Looks like you still haven't learned your lesson. Then, let's continue!"
After saying that, Connor stood up and was about to leave.
"Don't…"
Tenner hurriedly reached out and hugged Connor's thigh. Then, he shouted with a terrified expression, "Don't let those people in. Please…"
"Haha…"
Connor couldn't help but laugh coldly when he heard Tenner's words. He then said lightly, "If you don't want those people to come in, you have to tell me the truth!"
"I'm telling you the truth. Yaakov ran away when he found out that you are back. I'm no longer in contact with him. I really don't know where he is now."
Tenner looked at Connor and shouted.
"As long as you tell me where Yaakov is, I'll let you go!"
Connor whispered to Tenner.
When Tenner heard Connor's words, he looked like he was about to collapse. He gritted his teeth and said, "If I knew where Yaakov was, I would have told you long ago. There's no need for me to persist until now."
Connor looked at Tenner and hesitated for a couple of seconds before saying softly, "You really don't know where Yaakov is?"
"I really don't know where he is…"
Tenner shook his head at Connor without hesitation.
Connor took a deep breath and said, "It doesn't matter if you don't know where Yaakov is. You can help me find him!"
"How can I help you? I can't contact Yaakov at all!"
Tenner shouted in despair.
"That's your problem. Either you tell me where Yaakov is, or you tell me how to find him."
Connor said expressionlessly.
Tenner looked at Connor, his eyes filled with despair. At this moment, he did not know what to do.
...
In Michelle's house.
Connor looked at Tenner, who was lying on the ground, and hesitated for a couple of seconds. Then, he said calmly, "Tenner, you've been by Yaakov's side for so many years. You're the one who knows him the best. Yaakov must have some weaknesses. As long as you can help me find Yaakov, I'll let you go. If you don't say anything, you'll only be tortured to death by these people."
"Weakness?"
Connor's words seemed to have reminded Tenner of something as his eyes lit up.
"That's right. Do you know what Yaakov's weakness is?"
Connor asked softly.
"..."
Tenner looked at Connor and hesitated for a few seconds, then shook his head and said in a low voice, "I don't know what weakness Yaakov has…"
"Looks like you haven't been tortured enough!"
Connor sneered, then turned around and walked out of the bedroom.
Reena's subordinate entered the bedroom once again, and Tenner's anguished wails could be heard.
"Connor, I will tell you everything. Don't let these people torture me…"
A few minutes later, Tenner could not hold on any longer. He shouted at Connor who was in the living room.
When Connor heard Tenner's words, he smiled faintly and walked into the bedroom.
"Can you tell me now?"
Connor asked Tenner softly.
"Yes, yes, I'll tell you everything. Please, don't let these people torture me anymore…"
Tenner shouted at Connor with a pained expression.
"Tell me, how can we find Yaakov?"
Connor asked Tenner softly.
Tenner looked at Connor and hesitated for a few seconds before saying in a low voice, "Connor, I can tell you how to find Yaakov. Will you let me go as long as I tell you?"
"Not now. As long as I find Yaakov, I will let you go!"
Connor replied indifferently and then continued, "I have nothing against you. I know that Yaakov is the one controlling everything, so I just need to find Yaakov. As for you, I have nothing against you…"
Tenner raised his head and looked at Connor. He knew that if he did not tell the truth now, he would definitely die in the end. However, if he could help Connor find Yaakov, one of them would definitely fall. That way, he would still have a chance to survive.
Therefore, it would be better for Tenner to live for now than to die right away.
"Tenner, my patience is limited. I'm not in the mood to talk nonsense with you, so you'd better hurry up and tell me!"
Seeing that Tenner was unwilling to speak, Connor could not help but frown and urge him.
"Huff…"
Tenner looked at Connor and took a deep breath. Then, he said in a low voice, "Connor, I really don't know where Yaakov is, but I know a way for you to find him!"
"What is it?"
Connor asked.
"Yaakov is a member of Rockefeller. Therefore, he has to record every account, every transaction, and even every crime he has committed in Orilon. These things are usually stored in a hard disk. Yaakov has one in his hand and the headquarters of Rockefeller has one too. Yaakov is responsible for recording his actions and sending them to the headquarters of Rockefeller. This way, the people in the Rockefeller headquarters would know what Yaakov has done and how much profit he has obtained for Rockefeller. At the same time, it would also be convenient for the Rockefeller headquarters to control Yaakov!"
Yaakov said slowly.
"I know about that!"
Connor replied in a low voice.
There were too many people in Rockefeller, and they were spread all over the world. It was not easy to manage these people.
Later on, Rockefeller proposed this method. No matter what the person-in-charge did, it had to be recorded on the hard disk. Only then could the headquarters know what was going on.
Back then, Percy Juve had also mentioned this to Connor.

chapters.title: Chapter 1584: Heavenly Sect
chapters.content:
Chapter 1584: Heavenly Sect
This hard disk was very important to the people of Rockefeller.
This hard disk not only recorded the business transactions of the people in charge of Rockefeller, but it also contained all the evidence of their crimes.
Once it fell into the hands of someone with ill intentions, it would be a fatal blow to these people in charge.
"You actually know about this thing?"
When Tenner heard Connor's words, he was a little surprised.
"What does this thing have to do with finding Yaakov?"
Connor did not answer Tenner's question and asked.
"Half a year ago, a hacker hacked into Yaakov's computer and copied all the data on this hard disk. Although Yaakov found the hacker through various channels and killed the hacker, the hacker had already sold the data on the hard disk before he died…"
Tenner looked at Connor and said.
"Seriously?"
Connor' was somewhat shocked.
"Because Yaakov did a very good job of keeping it a secret, not many people knew about it. Only some of Yaakov's trusted aides and I know about it!"
Tenner looked at Connor and said.
"..."
Connor took a deep breath and didn't say anything.
At this moment, Connor seemed to know the way to find Yaakov.
"After the hacker obtained this data, he sold it to three people. Two of them were found by Yaakov, and he successfully killed them to get back the backup. However, there was still one backup that Yaakov did not get back!"
Tenner paused for a moment, then looked at Connor and continued, "The data in this hard disk is very fatal to Yaakov. It's impossible for you to find Yaakov via any normal methods. However, if you can get the last backup hard disk before Yaakov, then he will definitely find you."
"Where is the last backup hard disk?"
Connor asked Tenner excitedly.
"..."
Tenner slowly raised his head to look at Connor, then whispered, "If I tell you, will you let me go?"
"I can't be sure what you said is true. As long as I can find Yaakov, I'll let you go!"
Connor said softly.
Tenner slowly raised his head to look at Connor, then gritted his teeth and said, "I hope you can keep your word!"
"Cut the crap. Tell me where the last backup hard disk is. Your life is worthless in my eyes. There's no benefit in lying to you!"
Connor replied indifferently.
"The last backup hard disk is in the hands of the Heavenly Sect!"
Tenner whispered to Connor.
"Heavenly Sect?"
Connor was stunned when he heard Tenner's words. He was also very shocked.
This was because Connor had never thought that the Heavenly Sect would actually be involved in this matter.
...
Connor had heard Jorge Yarrell talk about the Heavenly Sect.
The Purple Cloud Sect, the Snow Moon Sect, the Profound Sect, and the Heavenly Sect were the four major sects of ancient martial arts in Oprana. These four major sects were responsible for maintaining the order of ancient martial arts in Oprana.
But what Connor did not expect was that the Heavenly Sect would actually be involved in this.
"What happened?"
Connor asked Tenner in a low voice.
"The sect leader of the Heavenly Sect is the previous head of the Collier family in York, Beau Collier. On the surface, he looks like an ancient martial arts grandmaster, but in fact, the Collier family he belongs to controls a very large business empire and has close cooperation with Rockefeller. Back then, Beau's son, Albert Collier, obtained Yaakov's backup hard disk through some unknown channels and used it to threaten Yaakov!"
Tenner looked at Connor and explained.
"And then?"
Connor continued to ask.
"If it were any other ordinary person, Yaakov would have definitely eliminated him. However, Beau was terrifyingly powerful. Yaakov is afraid of the people from the Heavenly Sect, so he had no choice but to let Albert control him!"
Tenner looked at Connor and said.
Connor hesitated for a moment before asking softly, "Then is this hard disk in Beau's hands or Albert's hands?"
"It should be in Albert's hands!"
Tenner replied.
Connor's expression softened slightly after hearing Tenner's words.
After all, if this hard disk was in Beau's hands, then Connor wouldn't have a chance to get it. After all, Beau was an ancient martial arts grandmaster who was as famous as Ye Juechen. Connor was no match for Beau at all.
" It's been so many years. Albert has been using this hard disk to control Yaakov. This is also Yaakov's biggest worry. Yaakov has tried all kinds of methods to get the hard disk back, but all of them have failed…"
Tenner paused for a moment before continuing,""If you really want to find Yaakov, you have to find this hard disk first. As long as Yaakov knows that the hard disk is in your hands, he will definitely find you!"
"Where is this hard disk?"
Connor looked at Tenner and asked.
"The hard disk should be with the Collier family of York. I heard from Yaakov that the Collier family has a secret room. There is a lot of evidence in this secret room. The Collier family relies on this evidence to control the people outside. However, this secret room is not open to ordinary people. Not only are there martial artists guarding it, but these martial artists also have weapons. Unless an ancient martial arts grandmaster personally takes action, it is difficult to enter this secret room. Yaakov tried many times back then, but he did not succeed…"
Tenner looked at Connor and said.
"Yaakov can't succeed, but that doesn't mean I can't succeed!"
Connor replied indifferently.
"I have already told you everything I know…"
Tenner whispered to Connor.
"You can stay here for the time being. After I find Yaakov, I will let you go!"
Connor said softly.
"..."
After hearing Connor's words, Tenner slowly raised his head and looked at Connor. He took a deep breath and did not say anything.
Tenner knew very well that his life was in Connor's hands. He could only choose to be obedient. He had no right to bargain with Connor at all.
After Connor heard about the hard disk from Tenner, he immediately left Michelle's house.
Tenner had Reena's men watching over him, so Connor did not have to worry about him running away.

chapters.title: Chapter 1585: Personally Taking Action
chapters.content:
Chapter 1585: Personally Taking Action
After reaching home, Connor lay in bed and thought for a long time.
In the end, he still decided to attack York's Collier family.
After all, Connor had come to Newtown for such a long time because he wanted to find Yaakov and find out how his parents died.
Now that the best opportunity was right in front of him, he was not willing to give it up.
Connor took out his phone and dialed Thomas Morgan's number.
Ring, ring...
After the phone rang twice, Thomas picked up the call.
"Mr. Morgan, how much do you know about York's Collier family?"
Connor asked directly.
"York's Collier family?"
When Thomas heard Connor's words, he could not help but be stunned for a moment. Then, he said in a low voice, "Mr. McDonald, why are you suddenly asking about the Collier family?"
"There is something in the hands of the Collier family that is extremely important to me. I want to obtain this thing…"
Connor explained.
"I see!"
Thomas replied softly, then continued, "According to my understanding of the Collier family, because the Collier family has the support of the Heavenly Sect, they are terrifyingly powerful. They can be considered one of the top families in York. If you want to deal with the Collier family, it isn't that easy…"
"I'm not planning to deal with the Collier family. I just want to get what I want!"
Connor said in a low voice.
"If that's the case, then we only have two ways. One is to directly negotiate with the Collier family and see if we can get what you need through normal channels, or we can think of a way to steal what you need!"
Thomas analyzed softly.
"Then, do you know the head of the Collier family?"
Connor hurriedly asked.
"Yes, but our relationship isn't strong. I don't know what you need from the Collier family. If it's not important to the Collier family, I can talk to them!"
Thomas replied.
"The thing I need is evidence of Yaakov Ward's crime!"
Connor said in a low voice.
"That…"
Thomas was vexed by Connor's answer. He said softly, "Mr. McDonald, since it's such an important thing, I don't think the Collier family will give it to us easily. If we want to get it, we'll have to pay a very high price!"
"What I'm worried about now is that if we negotiate with the Collier family, they will be aware of what we want. Not only will we not get the item, but the Collier family will also be on guard…"
Connor thought for a moment and said.
"That's also possible!"
Thomas nodded lightly.
"Then, forget it. Since normal channels won't work, I might as well try it myself. Maybe I can steal it from the Collier family!"
Connor thought for a moment and said.
"Mr. McDonald, are you going to do it yourself?"
Thomas asked in surprise.
"In this situation, I have to personally take action. I don't trust anyone else!"
Connor lightly replied.
On the other side of the phone, Thomas hesitated for a moment before asking softly, "What can I do for you now, Mr. McDonald?"
...
"What can you do for me?"
After hearing Thomas's words, Connor could not help but be stunned for a moment. Then, he said softly, "If you really want to help me, then help me investigate the Collier family. According to the information I received, Yaakov's evidence should be in a secret room belonging to the Collier family. However, I don't know much about the specific situation of the secret room."
"Alright, I'll try my best!"
Thomas replied.
"Alright, then. I'll talk to you later!"
Connor said softly.
"Alright!"
Thomas replied lightly and then hung up the phone.
After putting down his phone, Connor let out a long sigh.
At this moment, Connor was clueless about the situation on the Collier family's side, so he did not know how to start.
"I hope Thomas can find some useful clues!"
Connor sighed softly, then got up and was about to go back to his room to rest.
Ring, ring, ring…"
But at this moment, Connor's phone suddenly started ringing.
Connor couldn't help but be stunned when he heard the phone ring. He then picked up the phone and took a look at it. He saw that it was actually Rachel calling him, so he picked up the phone.
"Connor, what have you been doing recently? Why aren't you picking up my calls?"
Rachel exclaimed.
"Excuse me, miss. I called you so many times. Why didn't you pick up?"
Connor replied helplessly.
"Well... I had serious matters to attend to…"
Rachel retorted.
"If you can have serious matters to attend to, can't I have serious matters to attend to?"
Connor pursed his lips and replied, then asked, "When do you plan to come back?"
"I might not be able to return for the time being…"
Rachel replied indifferently.
"That's good. I feel a lot more peaceful without you…"
Connor said with a smile.
"I need your help with something now!"
Rachel was not in the mood to bicker with Connor.
"You're so resourceful, yet you still need my help?"
Connor laughed.
"I'm being serious right now!"
Rachel shouted helplessly.
Connor could hear that Rachel seemed to be very anxious, so he said softly, "Alright, tell me what serious matter it is!"
"Come to York tomorrow and pretend to be my boyfriend!"
Rachel said.
"Pretend to be your boyfriend again?"
Connor was instantly speechless when he heard Rachel's words. Then, he turned her down. "I've been trying to find Yaakov Ward recently. I really don't have time to pretend to be your boyfriend. You should find someone else…"
"I only know you. Where can I find someone else?"
Rachel pouted and replied, then she said, "You can wait for a while to deal with Yaakov, but you have to help me put on an act!"
"I'm not going. I don't have time!"
Connor rejected again.
"You have to come!"
Rachel seemed to a little anxious as she shouted.
"Why? I'm not related to you. Why should I keep pretending to be your boyfriend?"
Connor exclaimed helplessly.
"Connor, this is really important to me. Can you just do me a favor?"
Rachel seemed to have realized that she was not playing nice, so now she sounded much gentler.

chapters.title: Chapter 1586: York's Wallace Family
chapters.content:
Chapter 1586: York's Wallace Family
When Connor heard Rachel's words, he could not help but be stunned for a moment.
He had known Rachel for a long time, but this was the first time he had heard her speak to him in such a tone.
"It's fine if you want me to help you, but you have to tell me what's going on.
"If you want me to pretend to be your boyfriend again to help you chase away your blind date, then I really don't have the time!"
Connor said faintly.
Rachel hesitated for a moment before she said in a low voice, "I've been in the hospital with my grandfather. My grandfather is sick, and his condition is very serious. According to the current medical standards, he may not live for long. He has been worried about me finding a partner. He wants to see my boyfriend before he dies. I lied because I didn't want my grandfather to worry. I told him that I have a boyfriend, so I called you."
"I see!"
When Connor heard Rachel's words, he finally understood what was going on.
"Connor, this is really very important to me, so can you come and help me?"
Rachel asked sincerely.
"Where did you say your home was?"
Connor suddenly asked.
"York. Why?"
Rachel replied.
"You live in York!"
Connor exclaimed and then continued, "If you really want me to help you, I can, but you have to do me a favor!"
"What favor?"
Rachel asked.
