"I can't explain this over the phone. Let's talk about it when the two of us meet…"
Connor said softly.
"Okay, then come to York tomorrow. I'll wait for you here!"
Rachel replied.
"Okay!"
Connor agreed and then hung up the phone.
Just now, Connor didn't realize that Rachel was from York. Even if Rachel didn't call, Connor himself planned to go to York. After all, the Collier family was in York.
Connor knew about Rachel's capabilities. In addition, Rachel was from York, so Connor decided to help her first, and then have her help him investigate the situation of the Collier family. This way, he could not only help Rachel, but also make it a lot more convenient for him.
Thinking of that, Connor called Reena Satchwell and asked her to keep an eye on Arthur Synder and Tenner Ward. Then, he asked Reena to book a plane ticket to York for him.
After ending the call with Reena, Connor hesitated for a moment before calling Vanessa Canfield.
Perhaps it was because of what happened in Vanessa's house, Connor was not as natural as before when talking to Vanessa.
"Hello?"
Vanessa's voice rang.
"Vanessa, I might have to go to York tomorrow. I'm not sure when I'll be back, so I'll leave Heavens Club and the casino to you."
Connor said softly.
"Alright, no problem!"
Vanessa replied calmly.
"Also... what happened at your house... I really didn't do it on purpose. I hope you aren't angry!"
Connor thought for a moment and said softly.
"I've long forgotten about that. You don't have to take it to heart!"
Vanessa said lightly.
"That's good!"
Connor exhaled and continued, "If there's nothing else, I'll hang up now!"
"Okay!"
Vanessa replied lightly and then hung up the phone.
...
York Airport.
A tall and charming woman stood quietly in the waiting hall of the airport. Her beautiful eyes were fixed on the exit as if she was waiting for someone.
This woman was none other than Rachel.
Today, Rachel was wearing a white spaghetti t-shirt. Her breasts were extremely alluring, as if they would break through the shackles of the clothes at any time. She was wearing a miniskirt. Her slender and fair legs were covered with black stockings, and she was wearing a pair of black high heels.
Rachel's figure was very tall and sexy. Standing in the crowd, she was like a beautiful scenery. Any man who passed by her would involuntarily turn around and take a second look.
After some time, Rachel took out her phone and looked at the time. She knew that Connor would be getting off the plane soon.
Connor had never been to York before. In addition, York was very far from Newtown, so it took a full day's flight before he finally arrived at York.
After getting off the plane, Connor glanced at the people in the airport lobby and saw the stunning Rachel standing in the crowd.
Rachel was just too attractive. Whether it was her figure or her appearance, she was indeed the cream of the crop. Even in the airport where there were many beautiful women, she was considered the most dazzling one there.
"Connor!"
Rachel saw Connor, so she shouted his name.
Connor walked to Rachel's side and said with a smile, "I've come all the way here to help you. How are you going to thank me after it's done?"
"Didn't you say that you need my help? The two of us should take what we need and not owe each other anything, right?"
Rachel replied indifferently.
"Why are you so realistic? No matter what, I came all the way here to help you…"
Connor said speechlessly.
"If it weren't for the fact that you have a favor to ask of me, you wouldn't have come!"
Rachel said indifferently.
"..."
Connor looked at Rachel, not knowing what to say.
"Alright, can you tell me what you need me to do for you?"
Rachel looked at Connor and asked.
"There are many people here. Let's find a quiet place to talk!"
Connor hesitated for a moment before speaking to Rachel.
"Okay!"
Rachel nodded, then led Connor out of the airport.
After they walked out of the airport lobby, Connor and Rachel got into the car. She was worried that he would mess up his acting, so she had to tell Connor some things in advance. She came to pick Connor up alone this time.
Connor sat in the passenger seat and turned to look at Rachel. He smiled and said, "I didn't expect you to be from York!"
"I'm from the Wallace family of York!"
Rachel had never told Connor her true identity before. This time, she did not intend to continue hiding it.

chapters.title: Chapter 1587: Revenge for My Parents!
chapters.content:
Chapter 1587: Revenge for My Parents!
"York's Wallace family?"
A strange look flashed across Connor's face.
"That's right, since the founding of the country, the Wallace family has been the number one family in York. Although we're no longer the number one family in York, we're probably still ranked in the top five!"
Rachel said softly.
"Then, why didn't you tell me your true identity before?"
Connor frowned and asked.
"The reason why I wasn't willing to tell you my true identity was because I was worried that you would get someone to investigate me. The Wallace family's network is very large, even larger than the Empire World Corporation. Once you investigate me, the Wallace family will see you as a key observation target."
Rachel looked at Connor and explained.
"What are you talking about? I'm a little confused. Didn't the Wallace family ask you to deal with Rockefeller?"
Connor frowned and asked Rachel with a puzzled tone.
"The Wallace family asked me to do that?"
When Rachel heard Connor's words, she couldn't help but sneer. After which, she said indifferently, "You're too naive. Why would the Wallace family ask me to deal with Rockefeller for their own benefit? All these years, everything I've done has been hidden from the Wallace family. The only person who really knows what I've done is my grandfather."
"I see!"
Connor nodded thoughtfully. Then, he looked at Rachel and continued to ask, "Then, why do you want to deal with Rockefeller so badly?"
"Because my parents died in the hands of Rockefeller's people. I want to avenge my parents!"
Rachel said in a low voice.
"I didn't expect our fates to be so similar…"
Connor said softly.
"When I was very young, my parents died at the hands of Rockefeller. At that time, the Wallace family was unwilling to offend Rockefeller in order to protect their own interests. Even though my grandfather was the head of the Wallace family, there was nothing he could do. After all, if everyone opposed to it, my grandfather alone would not be able to deal with Rockefeller. I lived with my grandfather since I was young. My grandfather forced me to learn martial arts when I was young. At that time, I was still young. I didn't know why my grandfather wanted me to learn martial arts. Later on, I found out that my grandfather wanted me to ensure that I could survive!"
Rachel took a deep breath and continued, "Later, I went to Porthampton. My grandfather told me that if I wanted to deal with Rockefeller, I had to wait for someone at Porthampton University. This person could help me take revenge. At that time, I didn't know that that person was you. My grandfather told me to wait patiently because if I wanted to take revenge for my parents, I had to wait for this person to appear. Later on, you inherited Steven Lee's inheritance. You should know what happened next..."
"..."
When Connor heard what Rachel said, he was extremely shocked.
He didn't think that Rachel's grandfather had already known that he might inherit Steven Lee's inheritance.
"Are you saying that your grandfather already knew about me?"
Connor asked after a moment of hesitation.
"I think so, yeah!"
Rachel nodded and continued, "Not only does my grandfather know about you, but he should also know you very well. He knows that you will become Steven Lee's heir in the future. I could only choose to cooperate with you to defeat Rockefeller. Otherwise, my grandfather would not have asked me to wait for you at the Porthampton University!"
Connor was extremely shocked after listening to Rachel's explanation because he did not expect Rachel's grandfather to know in advance that he would become Steven Lee's heir.
If it was really like what Rachel said, then it meant that Rachel's grandfather definitely knew some other insider information.
So, Connor had rather complicated feelings. He thought that he was only here to pretend to be Rachel's boyfriend, but he never thought that this matter would be related to Rockefeller.
"How did your grandfather know in advance that I would inherit Steven Lee's inheritance?"
Connor asked Rachel in a puzzled tone.
"I'm not sure about that. You can ask my grandfather yourself when you see him!"
Rachel replied.
Connor took a deep breath and didn't say anything.
Now, Connor finally knew who Rachel really was. Rachel and Connor had the same fate. Both of their parents had died in the hands of Rockefeller, and both of them wanted to take revenge for their parents, so they wanted to deal with Rockefeller.
Rachel's grandfather must know some inside information about what happened back then. Otherwise, he wouldn't have asked Rachel to wait for Connor at the Porthampton University.
Connor had many thoughts running through his head. After all, Rachel's words contained a lot of information. Connor was unable to digest it in a short period of time.
"Connor, didn't you say that you wanted me to do you a favor? What do you want me to do for you?"
Rachel spoke again.
"Phew…"
Connor took a deep breath. He was prepared to put Rachel's matter aside. After all, as long as Connor met Rachel's grandfather, he would be able to ask about the matter.
"The thing is, I need you to help me investigate the Collier family in York!"
Connor looked at Rachel and said.
"Investigate the Collier family?"
Rachel was stunned when she heard Connor's words.
"That's right!"
Connor nodded gently and told Rachel everything he had done in Newtown recently. After all, Rachel had no secrets now, so he trusted Rachel a great deal.
Rachel's grandfather had left something for her, and Steven Lee had left something for Connor. If the two of them joined forces, they might really be able to defeat Rockefeller.
After hearing Connor's words, Rachel was a bit surprised. She said softly, "I didn't expect you to do so many things while I was away."
"You're not the only one who's anxious to deal with Rockefeller. I'm also anxious!"
Connor said lightly.
Rachel looked at Connor and smiled. Then, she said softly, "You mean that Yaakov Ward's hard disk is in the hands of the Collier family, so you came to York to steal it?"
"Yes!"
Connor nodded.
"Alright, I'll help you investigate the Collier family. This shouldn't be difficult for me!"
Rachel immediately agreed.

chapters.title: Chapter 1588: Your Grandfather's Approval?
chapters.content:
Chapter 1588: Your Grandfather's Approval?
"Then, let's hope our cooperation is a success. You help me investigate the Collier family, and I'll pretend to be your boyfriend!"
Connor said to Rachel with a smile.
After hearing Connor's words, Rachel couldn't help but be stunned for a while, then she said in a low voice, "Connor, you're not going to the Wallace family just to pretend to be my boyfriend!"
Rachel spoke again.
"Is there something else?"
Connor was stunned for a moment and asked.
"You need to get my grandfather's approval this time!"
Rachel replied.
"Your grandfather's approval?"
Connor was a little puzzled when he heard this. Then, he frowned and said, "You didn't mention this when you called me."
"My grandfather has been holding on for a long time. The doctor told us that he probably only has about half a year left. So, if you can't get my grandfather's approval, my grandfather will definitely try his best to make me break up with you and find a more suitable person for me. Only then will he be able to leave in peace. So, this time, you have to make my grandfather feel that you are worthy of me!"
Rachel said helplessly.
"Rachel, are you kidding me? The two of us aren't really a couple. I'm just here to act as your boyfriend…"
Connor exclaimed.
"So, not only do you have to cooperate with me and pretend to be my boyfriend, but you also have to make my grandfather think that you can take care of me!"
Rachel said indifferently.
"Then, how can I make your grandfather satisfied?"
Connor asked helplessly.
"This will depend on your performance. But I think my grandfather will not make things too difficult for you. After all, he knows that you are the person I have chosen…"
Rachel said softly.
"I hope so!"
Connor sighed helplessly. He knew in his heart that it wasn't so easy for him to pretend to be Rachel's boyfriend. After all, the Wallace family was different from other ordinary people. Even if they knew that Connor was Steven Lee's heir, they might not think highly of Connor. After all, they were all very rich.
"There's one more thing I have to remind you of. The other people in the Wallace family might not be nice to you, so you don't have to care about what others say or do. You just have to make my grandfather satisfied…"
Rachel looked at Connor and continued.
"Why would they not be nice to me? I'm the son-in-law of the Wallace family!"
Connor frowned.
"Those people from the Wallace family could even ignore the death of my parents for their own interests. They are all cold-blooded and heartless people!"
Rachel slowly said.
"I haven't offended them, so they won't make things too difficult for me, right?"
Connor said in a low voice.
"Not necessarily…"
Rachel shook her head and continued, "The Wallace family has been scheming for so many years to get me to marry someone from another big family in York. This way, I will lose the right to fight for the inheritance with them, and they will get a lot of benefits. However, because my grandfather has always been protecting me, they can only casually mention it and don't dare to force me to go on a blind date. If my grandfather is no longer around, these people will definitely force me to marry someone they think is suitable…"
"I understand what you mean…"
Connor smiled and said, "So, if I go to your house now, it's equivalent to ruining these people's plans, right?"
"That's right, so they definitely won't be nice to you. They might even find fault with you and deliberately make my grandfather think that you're not suitable for me!"
Rachel looked at Connor and nodded.
Connor could not help but smile when he heard Rachel's words. Then, he said indifferently, "I've seen this happen many times, but don't worry, I won't have a problem dealing with these people. I'm just a little worried about how to get your grandfather's approval!"
"You don't have to be too nervous…"
Rachel said softly.
Nervous?
Connor couldn't help but laugh when he heard this. Then, he said indifferently, "What's there to be nervous about? Anyway, even if I screw up, it has nothing to do with me. You should be the one who's really nervous, right?"
"Why you…"
Rachel looked at Connor and was speechless. She didn't know what to say.
"Alright, let's go to your house!"
Connor said to Rachel indifferently.
Rachel hesitated for a moment before starting the car.
Connor looked at the scenery outside the window with an unusually calm expression.
York was the most prosperous place in Oprana. Countless families were born here, and countless families had fallen too.
The game of power and money was going on almost every minute and second. Some people could make a fortune here, while others could fall into the abyss here.
About an hour later, Rachel drove the car into a private manor.
The decoration style of the manor was very simple. There was no luxurious villa or garden, only an ordinary courtyard and a courtyard house that looked like it had been around for a long time.
However, Connor knew very well how terrifying it was to own a manor in the most prosperous area of York. This wasn't something that could be obtained with money.
Rachel took a deep breath and tried her best to calm down. Then, she turned and said to Connor, "We're here. Let's go in!"
"Okay!"
Connor nodded and got out of the car.
After getting off the car, Rachel took the initiative to hold Connor's arm.
Connor could clearly feel that Rachel was still very nervous. Her delicate body was trembling. Of course, Rachel was not nervous because of other things. She was worried about what she would do if her grandfather was dissatisfied with Connor!
"Don't worry, and don't be nervous. I'll do my best to help you put on a good show!"
Connor said to Rachel with a smile.
"..."
When Rachel heard Connor's words, she slowly raised her head and looked at him, then gently nodded.
At this moment, there were not many people in the Wallace family's old manor. After all, the Wallace family did not live here most of the time. They all had their own things to do. Whether it was the military, the business world, or even the political world, the Wallace family would be part of it. These people could not stay in the Wallace family's old manor all the time.
Of course, the Wallace family had long known that Rachel would bring her boyfriend back, so everyone from the Wallace family would come over for dinner tonight.
On the surface, these people would be here to welcome Connor, but in fact, they planned to make things difficult for him. If they could make Connor retreat and give up on being with Rachel, that would be the most ideal outcome.

chapters.title: Chapter 1589: Genius
chapters.content:
Chapter 1589: Genius
Connor was not concerned about the Wallace family members.
He was thinking about how to face Rachel's grandfather.
After all, he was the pillar of the Wallace family. He had lived for nearly a hundred years. What kind of storms had he not seen?
Connor followed Rachel to the courtyard house. At this time, there were a few workers cleaning up the courtyard house.
When one of the middle-aged men saw Rachel, he hurriedly ran toward Rachel and said with a smile, "Miss, you're back?"
Connor briefly sized up the middle-aged man. The middle-aged man was wearing a black suit, giving off a very energetic feeling.
Moreover, Connor knew that this middle-aged man was a martial artist. Moreover, his realm wasn't low. The aura on his body was rather terrifying.
"Yeah, Uncle Simmons. I went to pick up my boyfriend just now!"
Rachel replied with a smile, then pointed at Connor and introduced him. "This is my boyfriend, Connor McDonald!"
"Hello, Mr. McDonald!"
The middle-aged man extended his right hand to Connor politely.
"Hello, Uncle Simmons!"
Connor replied with a smile, then shook hands with the middle-aged man gently.
When Connor's palm and Uncle Simmons's palm touched each other's, Connor could feel an extremely powerful aura coming from Uncle Simmons's palm.
Connor was a martial artist. He knew very well that Uncle Simmons was deliberately testing him right now.
Therefore, Connor also responded.
However, the two of them stopped at a certain point and did not exert too much strength.
"Uncle Simmons, where is my grandfather?"
Rachel was also a black-rank martial artist, so she naturally knew what had happened. However, this was within her expectations, so she didn't mind. After seeing the two let go, she smiled and asked him.
"Mr. Wallace is reading in the study!"
Uncle Simmons replied softly.
"Connor, let's go see my grandpa!"
Rachel held Connor's arm and walked toward the study.
"Who is this Uncle Simmons?"
Connor asked Rachel softly.
"He's the butler of the Wallace family…"
Rachel replied.
"A butler who is that powerful? He's also a martial artist, right?"
Connor said in shock.
"Of course, martial artists are nothing in the Wallace family. We have four black-rank martial artists in the family, and that's not including me!"
Rachel said calmly.
Connor looked at Rachel with an expression of disbelief, not knowing what to say.
"Oh right, what realm are you at now?"
Rachel suddenly asked.
"The last time I saw the old man, he said I was a yellow-rank martial artist, but I think I'm stronger now. If I meet a black rank, I should be able to fight!"
Connor replied after thinking for a moment.
"That's not bad. You're already a black-rank martial artist at such a young age, so my grandpa probably won't say anything about that!"
Rachel slowly nodded.
"You're an intermediate black-rank martial artist, whereas I've barely touched the threshold of the yellow-rank. How is this okay?"
Connor frowned and said.
"You don't have to worry about that. My grandfather knows that you haven't been exposed to ancient martial arts for long!"
Rachel replied.
Connor felt more at ease when he heard this.
Connor was different from Rachel. Rachel had been in contact with ancient martial arts since she was very young. She had practiced martial arts for so many years before she reached the black rank. Connor had only started learning ancient martial arts, so he could be considered a genius to have his current strength.
Just as Connor and Rachel were whispering, Uncle Simmons was also observing Connor.
At this moment, Uncle Simmons was somewhat surprised. He did not expect Connor to have a strength similar to his at such a young age. This was very rare for an ordinary person who was not from an ancient martial arts aristocratic family.
"It seems that Miss's boyfriend is indeed not an ordinary person!"
Uncle Simmons couldn't help but sigh. Then, he turned around and left.
After parting ways with Uncle Simmons, Rachel brought Connor to Janson Wallace's study. Although Janson was already over 90 years old, he had always maintained the habit of reading. As long as he had time, he would read in his study.
Rachel took a deep breath, then gently pushed open the door and turned to look at Connor.
Connor then walked into the study.
After entering the study room, Connor saw an old man sitting in front of the desk reading a book.
Connor had complicated feelings when he saw Rachel's grandfather for the first time. Because he felt that this old man was very different from what he had imagined. Previously, Connor thought that Rachel's grandfather would be a dignified old man with an extraordinary aura. However, when Connor saw Janson, he looked rather ordinary and had a kind look.
Janson was wearing a black suit and a pair of yellowed presbyopic glasses. He was very calm.
After hesitating for a moment, Rachel called out softly, "Grandpa, Connor is here!"
Janson slowly turned to look at Connor after hearing Rachel's words.
"Hello, Grandpa Wallace!"
Connor greeted him.
"You are Connor McDonald?"
Janson's voice sounded a little weak, perhaps because he had just been discharged from the hospital.
"That's right, I'm Connor McDonald!"
Connor lightly nodded.
"Sit down. Don't be shy!"
Janson pointed at the chair opposite him.
Connor sat on the chair after hesitating for a moment, while Rachel sat beside Connor. At this moment, she was ten thousand times more nervous than Connor. After all, she was worried that Connor would mess up.
"Although I have never met you before, I have heard of you. After inheriting Steven Lee's inheritance, you have done quite a lot…"
Janson said to Connor with a smile.
"Grandpa Wallace, the things I've done are not worth mentioning!"
Connor explained softly.
"Haha…"
Janson looked at Connor and smiled, then continued, "If I remember correctly, you seemed to have a fiancée after inheriting Steven Lee's inheritance. Why are you with my granddaughter now?"
"..."
Connor was stunned when he heard Janson's words. He did not expect Janson to know so much about his situation. He even knew about his relationship with Freya Phillips.
Connor wasn't prepared to deal with this question, so he was obviously feeling a little awkward.
"Grandpa, are you sure about that? Didn't I tell you before? Connor's fiancée went abroad, and their engagement was called off!"
Rachel hurriedly said.

chapters.title: Chapter 1590: Testing Strength
chapters.content:
Chapter 1590: Testing Strength
"Right, right. How could I forget about that!"
Janson looked at Rachel and smiled. He did not continue to ask about this matter.
Connor looked at Rachel and heaved a long sigh of relief. Fortunately, Rachel reacted quickly just now. Otherwise, he really didn't know how to explain that away.
"Grandpa Wallace, I heard from Rachel that you seemed to have known long ago that I would inherit Steven Lee's inheritance. What exactly is going on?"
Connor hesitated for a moment before asking the question he wanted to ask the most.
"Steven and I are old acquaintances. We got to know each other when he was in Oprana. He mentioned you to me, so I knew that Steven would definitely leave his inheritance to you in the future!"
Janson explained calmly.
"Steven talked about me"
When Connor heard this, he seemed a little excited. He hurriedly asked, "Then Grandpa Wallace, do you still remember what Steven told you back then?"
"I don't remember. It's been too long!"
Janson shook his head and added, "He probably didn't say anything important. I can only remember your name now…"
Connor looked at Janson and did not say anything. Although Janson did not admit it, Connor could feel that things were definitely not as simple as Janson said. There must be something else. Otherwise, Janson would definitely not be able to confirm that Connor was Steven's heir just by looking at his name.
However, Connor did not dare to continue asking. After all, if Janson did not want to say anything, Connor would not be able to get anything out of him no matter how hard he tried.
"I also heard that you are Jorge Yarrell's disciple?"
At this moment, Janson asked again.
"Yes, I am!"
Connor lightly nodded.
"You're Steven's heir and Jorge's disciple. These two identities put together is of equal status to the Wallace family!"
Janson said softly.
When Rachel heard this sentence, she clearly eased up a lot. After all, this was also a kind of affirmation from Janson toward Connor.
"But as a man, you can't always rely on your relationship with other people. Sometimes, you need to become stronger yourself, because only when you are strong yourself can you be truly strong!"
Janson spoke again.
"Yes, sir!"
Connor hurriedly nodded.
"I don't know if Rachel has told you about her past, but Rachel's fate is the same as yours. She lost her parents when she was very young and has always been by my side. Since Rachel has chosen you, you have to protect her well…"
Janson looked at Connor and said.
"Grandpa Wallace, don't worry. I'll definitely protect Rachel!"
Connor said firmly to Janson.
"Don't be so certain. First of all, these people from the Wallace family have always wanted to marry Rachel off to a young master from a big family. Therefore, your appearance will definitely incite their hatred. You have to be prepared. Also, Rachel's parents died in the hands of Rockefeller's people. Rachel will also become enemies with Rockefeller in the future. Are you sure you're ready to protect her?"
Janson looked at Connor and asked.
"I'm ready!"
Connor nodded.
"..."
Janson looked at Connor and hesitated for a couple of seconds. Then, he smiled and said, "It isn't enough to say that you are. I know you have some background, but your background is not enough to protect Rachel. I need you to prove to me that you have the strength!"
"Grandpa, although Connor hasn't learned ancient martial arts for a long time, he's already a black-rank martial artist. I believe that Connor will be able to protect me in the future!"
Rachel hurriedly said.
"He's already a black-rank martial artist?"
When Janson heard Rachel's words, he was a little surprised.
"That's right, I'm a black rank now!"
Connor lightly nodded.
When Janson found out that Connor was a black-rank martial artist, the way he looked at him changed.
Janson himself was also a black rank, so his understanding of ancient martial arts was definitely deeper than that of ordinary people.
Connor had only been learning ancient martial arts for less than a year. It was very terrifying to reach such a realm in just a year. Even in the entire Oprana, it was very rare.
"You're indeed Jorge's disciple. You've only been exposed to ancient martial arts for such a short time, but you've already reached such a high realm. Why don't you go and compete with my bodyguard and let me see how strong you are?"
Janson asked with a smile.
"Grandpa, what are you doing? Connor has just arrived at our house…"
Rachel seemed to be somewhat dissatisfied as she exclaimed.
"If you're not willing to do it, then forget it It's just a suggestion!"
Janson replied with a smile.
"Since Grandpa Wallace wants to see my strength, then let's give it a try!"
But at this moment, Connor suddenly said.
"..."
Rachel subconsciously turned to look at Connor with a complicated expression.
"Alright, I like your character!"
Janson was very satisfied with Connor and shouted with a smile.
Connor glanced at Rachel indifferently, as if telling her not to worry.
Connor knew very well that Janson was deliberately testing him.
If Connor didn't agree to do it, Janson's perception of him would be greatly affected. If Connor agreed, Janson's impression of Connor would change regardless of the outcome.
"Rachel, let's go to the backyard!"
Janson whispered to Rachel.
"Okay!"
Although Rachel was unwilling to let Connor fight with the Wallace family's people, she had no say in it since Connor had agreed. She could only support Janson as they walked to the backyard.
Connor followed closely behind them.
A moment later, the three of them arrived at the backyard.
Although Janson was also a martial artist, because he was really old, he was already panting after walking for a few minutes.
'I didn't expect that even martial artists would grow old one day!'
Connor could not help but sigh to himself.
Janson sat on the chair and said to the butler, Uncle Simmons, "Simmons, go and ask Ferdinand to come here. Let him compete with Connor!"
"Ferdinand?"
Rachel was stunned when she heard this.
Although Rachel knew that Janson wanted to test Connor's strength, Rachel didn't think that Janson would ask for Ferdinand Wallace.
Ferdinand was considered a very outstanding guy among the three generations of the Wallace family. Although he wasn't as heaven-defying as Rachel, he was now a black-rank martial artist. He was very strong, and he had a great advantage even when facing martial artists of the same level.

chapters.title: Chapter 1591: A Fight
chapters.content:
Chapter 1591: A Fight
"Ferdinand is a black-rank martial artist, Connor is also a black-rank martial artist, so the fight between the two of them is a fair one!"
Janson said with a smile.
"But Connor has just arrived. Grandpa, is it really okay for you to have Ferdinand fight with Connor?"
Rachel frowned and said.
"It's okay. It's just a simple duel."
Janson replied indifferently, then turned and said to the butler Uncle Simmons, "Simmons, go get him!"
"Yes, sir!"
Uncle Simmons nodded, then turned around and walked into the distance.
Rachel looked at Connor with a worried expression, not knowing what to do.
A moment later, the handsome Ferdinand followed Simmons to Janson's side and said respectfully to Janson, "Grandpa, did you call for me?"
"Ferdinand, what do you think of Rachel?"
Janson asked Ferdinand softly.
"Rachel is very good. She's the best girl in the Wallace family!"
Ferdinand whispered.
"Since you also think that Rachel is very good, then you must also hope that she can find a good home in the future, right?"
Janson continued.
"Of course!"
Ferdinand nodded gently.
"You've been by my side for so many years. You're a martial artist that I've nurtured. Connor is Jorge's disciple and will become Rachel's husband in the future. So, I want you to help me test Connor's skills and see if he has the ability to protect Rachel."
Janson said calmly.
"Grandpa, don't worry. I'll do my best!"
Ferdinand said hurriedly.
"Alright!"
Janson nodded lightly.
In the Wallace family, Ferdinand is probably one of the few people who had a good relationship with Rachel.
Ferdinand was the same as Rachel. He had lived with Janson since he was young, so Ferdinand was different from many members of the Wallace family. Ferdinand was easy-going. No matter who it was, he was very kind to them. In addition, Ferdinand's talent in ancient martial arts was pretty good, and he also had a knack for business. He would probably become a great person in the future.
However, Ferdinand's father was Rachel's third uncle, and Ferdinand's father's status in the Wallace family was not high, so it was impossible for him to inherit the Wallace family's property.
Ferdinand walked to Connor and whispered to Connor, "Hello, Connor!"
"Hello!"
Connor replied indifferently, then extended his hand and said, "Let's begin!"
Connor knew that Ferdinand's ancient martial arts realm was the same as his, so Connor wasn't afraid of Ferdinand. This was because Connor still had a certain advantage in the same level. However, Connor was injured in Honduria some time ago, and the injuries on his body hadn't completely healed. Therefore, Connor didn't know if he could defeat Ferdinand in a real fight.
Ferdinand didn't stand on ceremony. After hearing Connor's words, he rushed toward Connor.
Ferdinand was very fast. He was right before Connor almost in an instant, then he raised his fist and smashed it directly toward Connor's chest.
Bang!
There was a loud bang.
Ferdinand's fist smashed Connor in the chest.
However, Ferdinand didn't expect Connor to not even flinch after taking his punch. He just stood there without moving.
When Janson saw this scene, he was shocked.
Janson could clearly see that when Ferdinand's fist hit Connor's body, a thin layer of aura appeared around Connor's body. It was this layer of aura that helped Connor resist most of the power of Ferdinand's punch.
"Connor has such a skilled control over his aura."
Janson could not help but sigh softly.
Janson himself was an advanced black-rank martial artist, so he knew that the more skilled a martial artist was at controlling their aura, the more terrifying their combat power was.
And Connor's control over his aura was already at the black rank, which meant that his talent was truly astonishing.
Connor knew that Ferdinand was a member of the Wallace family, so he wasn't in a hurry to make a move. Instead, he pretended to exchange a few moves with Ferdinand and finally sent Ferdinand flying with a punch.
It was obvious that Connor won the match between Connor and Ferdinand very easily.
Ferdinand was also aware of the gap between him and Connor, so Ferdinand didn't plan to make a move after being sent flying by Connor's punch. He said to Connor, "Connor, I lost!"
Connor looked at Ferdinand with a faint smile and didn't say anything.
Ferdinand walked to Janson's side and said softly, "Grandpa, I'm no match for Connor!"
"It's okay, Connor might not be a black rank yet, but his control over his aura is comparable to a black rank. You losing isn't odd!"
Janson said calmly.
"I told you long ago that Connor is very powerful. Grandpa, you just didn't believe me!"
Rachel said to Janson with a proud expression.
"Yeah, now I know!"
Janson nodded lightly and continued, "Connor is indeed Jorge's disciple. He is indeed very powerful. In two days' time, I will let the most outstanding martial artist of the Wallace family's younger generation compete with you. That competition should be even more interesting!"
"Grandpa, don't tell me you plan to let Yoel fight Connor?"
Rachel shouted in surprise.
"That's right, but Yoel hasn't returned yet. He'll only arrive the day after tomorrow. Let's have Connor wait for two days!"
Janson laughed.
"..."
Rachel looked at Janson, not knowing what to say.
"I'm tired. I want to get some rest now!"
Janson whispered to Rachel.
Rachel had no choice but to help Janson up, and then brought Janson back to the bedroom.
After that, Rachel brought Connor back to the room.
After entering the room, Connor lay on the bed and then asked Rachel with a smile, "So? Did I perform well today?"
"It was pretty good, but there's something I have to remind you!"
Rachel frowned and whispered.
"What is it?"
Connor was stunned for a moment before asking.
"My grandfather wants you to fight Yoel. You won't be able to win as easily as you did today. I'm worried about what will happen when Yoel returns…"
Rachel said helplessly.
"Is this Yoel guy very powerful?"
Connor hesitated for a moment before asking.
"Although Yoel is now an advanced yellow-rank martial artist, his strength is actually on par with mine. He is also the most outstanding young martial artist in the Wallace family. Moreover, my relationship with Yoel has never been very good. It's very likely that he will use this opportunity to hurt you. I'm worried that he will cripple you…"
Rachel said in a low voice.

chapters.title: Chapter 1592: Each With Their Own Ulterior Motives
chapters.content:
Chapter 1592: Each With Their Own Ulterior Motives
"Cripple Me?"
When Connor heard Rachel's words, he couldn't help but laugh. Then, he said casually, "Aren't you underestimating me a little too much? It is not that easy to cripple me…"
"I know your strength very well. I no longer expect you to defeat Yoel. I only hope that you won't be injured when the time comes…"
Rachel said with a serious expression.
"Don't worry, as long as the other party is not an ancient martial arts grandmaster, I have a way to deal with them!"
Connor said lightly.
"Can you stop bragging? It would already be a miracle if you don't get beat up by Yoel…"
Rachel glared fiercely at Connor and then said, "Alright, you should rest. The Wallace family people will come tonight. You still have to deal with those people!"
"Alright!"
Connor looked at Rachel and nodded.
Rachel stood up and left after hesitating for a moment.
After Rachel left, Connor went to his room to rest.
At this moment, Connor was thinking about what Janson had told him previously. Connor could feel that Janson definitely knew something about Steven Lee, but Janson seemed to be unwilling to mention these things to Connor, so Connor did not know how to make Janson tell him everything.
Although Connor had not been in the Wallace family for a long time, he could feel that Janson was very mysterious. Even though he was old, he was definitely not that easy to fool.
"Has Jason already found out about me and Rachel?"
Connor could not help but wonder in his heart.
However, Connor quickly dismissed this idea because he figured that if Janson had really discovered what was going on between him and Rachel, then there was no need for Janson to continue probing Connor, and there was no need to arrange any competition for Connor.
"Forget it. These things have nothing to do with me. So what if he finds out?"
Connor felt that it was useless to think about these things now, so he simply stopped thinking about them and took out his phone to play with it.
...
It was past three in the afternoon.
The members of the Wallace family began to enter the manor one after another. These people were all here for Connor. After all, they were all curious about who could win Rachel's heart.
Rachel also went to Connor's room and softly said to him, "The Wallace family is here to see you. Come out with me!"
"Is this a zoo or what?"
Connor pouted.
"In their eyes, you might not even be on equal status as an animal. If they treat you as an animal, it's probably even better…"
Rachel lightly replied, then held Connor's arm and walked out of the room.
When Connor followed Rachel out of the room, he was shocked by the scene in front of him. He didn't expect so many people from the Wallace family to come. There were nearly a few hundred people, old and young. They almost filled the entire courtyard house.
"The Wallace family actually has so many people?"
Connor asked Rachel in surprise.
"Of course, there are still many people who can't come. If all of them come, this courtyard probably won't be able to fit them all!"
Rachel pouted.
Connor looked at Rachel and blinked. He felt rather helpless.
"Alright, don't just stand there like a fool. Let's go meet them!"
Rachel softly said.
...
Connor was already mentally prepared before this. He knew that the Wallace family that Rachel was in was a big family, so there must be a lot of people.
However, Connor never expected that the Wallace family would actually have so many people.
Nearly a few hundred people were gathered in the courtyard house. There were dozens of tables place there just for dining. What a terrifying family. Even an ordinary family's wedding would not have that many people.
Rachel took a deep breath and then began to introduce them to Connor one by one.
When the Wallace family members greey Connor, they were all very enthusiastic and had smiles on their faces.
However, Connor knew that these people didn't really welcome him. After all, Janson was still around. Therefore, even if these people hated Connor, they definitely didn't dare to show it. If anyone were to cause trouble now, Janson would definitely not let it go.
Rachel could be considered the most beautiful girl in the entire Wallace family, so many people wanted to marry her off to another family. If they could marry Rachel to a big family in York, then everyone present would benefit from it.
But if Rachel married Connor, then not only would they not get any benefits, on the contrary, their own interests might be affected. After all, they had already admitted that they helped introduce Rachel to some young masters of some big families, but now their plans were all in vain.
Therefore, even though these people looked friendly on the surface, they might actually be cursing Connor in their hearts.
Connor followed Rachel around and got to know most of the people in the Wallace family.
"There are too many people in your family. Aren't you tired of facing these people every day?"
Connor finally got a chance to rest. He asked Rachel with a desperate expression.
"That's why I don't like living here. I have to pretend to be friendly with these people every day, but I'm actually not close to them at all!"
Rachel replied indifferently.
"Many people are envious of the descendants of large families like you. However, I now feel that being an ordinary person is actually quite good. At the very least, I don't have to be so tired from all the drama every day…"
Connor whispered.
"That's right. If only I was born in an ordinary family!"
Rachel gently nodded.
There was still time before dinner, so most people were going around chatting with one another.
After a moment of hesitation, a middle-aged woman walked to a young man and deliberately gave him a look.
This beautiful middle-aged woman was Rachel's fifth uncle's wife, Caroline Lott, and the young man beside Caroline was Rachel's fifth uncle's son, Harford Wallace.
Harford wasn't particularly outstanding among the younger generation of the Wallace family, but he was still very good compared to ordinary people. He was now the deputy director of a certain institution in York. His future was boundless. After all, he was already a deputy director at such a young age. In a few years' time, he would definitely continue climbing up the ladder.
Caroline had promised to introduce Rachel to the son of a big shot in York. If she was successful, Harford might not have to wait a few years. He could be promoted to a director tomorrow, and he might have an even brighter future.
Rachel's fifth uncle could also benefit from this marriage.
But before Caroline could tell Janson about it, she found out that Rachel already had a boyfriend and was going to bring him home.

chapters.title: Chapter 1593: A Trick
chapters.content:
Chapter 1593: A Trick
Caroline knew that it was impossible for Connor to break up with Rachel.
However, she still wanted to take revenge on Connor.
If she was able to make Rachel realize that she had a good-for-nothing boyfriend, perhaps when the time came, the two of them would fall apart.
'You want to marry a woman from the Wallace family? It's not that easy.'
Caroline could not help but sigh to herself.
Harford knew what Caroline meant by the look she had given him, so he walked toward Connor.
Harford was not only the deputy director, but he was also a very famous chess expert in York. His chess abilities could even be compared to professional players.
Rachel and Connor being together had a very big impact on Harford, so Harford was rather resentful of Connor.
At this moment, Harford's goal was very simple, that was to get Connor to play chess with him, and then use this to ruthlessly humiliate Connor.
At this moment, most of the Wallace family members were present. It was easy for Harford to embarrass Connor.
At this moment, Caroline also had a wicked smile on her face. She knew that she just had to wait and watch a good show.
A moment later, Harford walked in front of Connor and said with a smile, "Connor, there's still some time before dinner. Do you know how to play chess?"
"Chess?"
Connor was stunned when he heard Harford's words.
"Yeah. Don't tell me you have never played chess before."
Harford laughed mockingly.
"I played chess when I was young, but I haven't played much since then!"
Connor lightly replied.
"Perfect. Anyway, there's still some time before dinner. Do you want to play two rounds with me?"
Harford looked at Connor and said.
"Connor doesn't really play chess. Why don't we forget about it?"
Rachel knew that Harford was very good at chess. She also knew that Harford was looking for trouble, so she hurriedly stopped him.
"Since you have nothing to do now, why not?"
Harford replied with a big smile, then said provocatively, "Connor, do you want to play?"
"Since you want to play, then I'll play with you!"
Connor said calmly.
Seeing that Connor had agreed, she was extremely speechless because Harford was obviously deliberately setting up a trap for Connor. Connor was walking into a trap.
"Uncle Simmons, please bring me the chessboard!"
Harford shouted happily seeing that Connor had agreed.
Uncle Simmons found the chessboard and chess pieces.
Rachel softly said to Connor, "Connor, why did you agree to play? Harford is very good at chess. He's doing this on purpose!"
"I learned chess from my dad when I was young. Although I'm not very good at it, I can still play…"
Connor said lightly.
Rachel looked at Connor helplessly because she knew that this wasn't as simple as playing chess.
A moment later, Connor and Harford sat down and began to set up their chess pieces.
Harford realized that Connor didn't even know how to place the chess pieces, so he became even more smug.
When the people of the Wallace family knew that Connor wanted to play chess with Harford, they surrounded the two of them. At this moment, they already regarded Connor as the Wallace family's enemy, so they all wanted to see him play.
Seeing that her plan had succeeded, Caroline hurriedly said to the crowd, "Playing chess is the best way to test a person's intelligence. Today, let's see how smart Rachel's boyfriend is!"
"That's right, chess is a competition of intelligence and strategy!"
"Yes, Connor should be quite good at chess…"
Everyone agreed.
Rachel's expression turned very ugly because everyone knew what Caroline meant.
If Connor were to lose, it would mean that he wasn't smart. To put it bluntly, Connor was a fool, and Connor's opponent, Harford, was very smart.
The obviously wanted to make Connor look bad.
However, Connor and Harford had already started playing chess. Even if Rachel wanted to stop them, she could not.
In the first game, Harford played very quickly as if he did not need to think at all. As Connor had not played chess for a long time, he was very slow. Sometimes, Connor even asked Harford about the rules of chess.
This also caused the smiles on the faces of the Wallace family members to become even brighter. It was as if everyone was looking at Connor as if they were looking at a fool.
Connor had only played chess a few times. He had only learned from his father for a period of time when he was young, so his chess skills were just average.
However, the current Connor was no longer the Connor from before. Because he had eaten the Essence Cultivating Pill, Connor's reaction speed and brain speed were more than 100 times that of a normal person. Therefore, playing chess was simply child's play for Connor.
Connor's speed was indeed very slow, but in fact, he was analyzing Harford's every move. Connor could even predict how Harford would move the next ten moves.
It felt like an ordinary person playing chess with a computer.
No matter how powerful Harford was, there was absolutely no way he could win against Connor who already knew all of his next moves.
Meanwhile, Harford was starting to feel that something was off.
He realized that Connor seemed to know what he was thinking. No matter how Harford changed his formation, Connor could predict in advance. Harford began to feel pressured.
A few minutes later, Harford and Connor had already reached the final stage of the battle. At this point, there were very few pieces left on the board, and at this time, Connor was clearly at an advantage. After all, it was now even easier to guess Harford's next move.
In less than half a minute, Connor won the first round.
When everyone saw Connor win the first round, they were all dumbfounded.
Because this was completely different from what they had imagined. They thought that Connor would lose very miserably, but no one expected Connor to actually win.
Rachel became excited. She whispered to Caroline, "Aunt Caroline, is Connor smart?"
"I already knew that Connor was a smart person!"
Caroline said awkwardly.
Rachel snorted coldly and did not say anything else.

chapters.title: Chapter 1594: Ashamed of Being Inferior
chapters.content:
Chapter 1594: Ashamed of Being Inferior
Immediately after, it was the second game of chess between Harford and Connor.
Harford felt that he was a little careless in the last round, which was why he lost to Connor.
Therefore, in this game, Harford put in 120% of his energy. Every time he placed a piece, he had to consider it very carefully.
However, no one expected Harford to lose the second round.
Caroline's face had turned dark. She asked Harford to play chess with Connor to humiliate Connor, but now, not only did Harford not humiliate Connor, but he had also been ruthlessly humiliated by Connor. Wasn't this shooting herself in the foot?
At this moment, the way everyone was looking at Connor had also changed. This was because they had only just realized that he might not be as simple as they had imagined.
After the first two games, Connor had basically mastered the general moves of chess.
Therefore, in the third round, Connor changed his previous passive stance and chose to attack.
However, this time, Harford lost badly.
Harford sat on the spot with a dazed expression on his face.
Meanwhile, Caroline was already hiding in a corner, not daring to say a word.
The Wallace family members present could see that Connor's level was far higher than Harford's. After all, Connor had won these three rounds effortlessly.
"I didn't expect Connor to know how to play chess. No wonder he agreed so readily just now!"
Rachel could not help but sigh softly.
"Do you want to continue playing?"
Connor asked Harford with a smile.
"Your skills are indeed amazing. I'm ashamed of my inferiority, so I won't humiliate myself further!"
Harford replied in a low voice.
"Look at what you're saying. The two of us are just bored and playing around. It's not like we're asking for humiliation…"
Connor said with a smile.
Connor's words made Harford lose even more face. He then casually found an excuse and left.
Connor also let out a long sigh of relief after seeing Harford leave. At this time, he realized that it was really not easy for him to pretend to be Rachel's boyfriend. First, he fought with Ferdinand, and then he played chess with Harford. What awaited Connor next was unknown.
A few minutes later, everyone sat down and was ready to eat.
The Wallace family was very disciplined. Everyone would find their own place.
As Connor was the main character today, he sat at the same table as Janson Wallace and the others.
"Is everyone here?"
Janson asked everyone softly.
"Dad, it seems that Jaylen is the only one who hasn't returned yet. The rest have already arrived..."
Janson's eldest son replied.
"Then, call Jaylen and ask him to come over quickly!"
Janson said calmly.
A woman dressed fashionably hurriedly took out her phone and made a call when she heard that.
A moment later, the middle-aged woman put down her phone and whispered to Janson, "Dad, there's something going on in Jaylen's army. He'll probably only be able to come over later. We shouldn't make everyone wait. Let's eat first…"
"That won't do!"
When Caroline heard the middle-aged woman's words, she hurriedly shouted, "Jaylen is the most outstanding child in the Wallace family. Jaylen must be here. Why don't we wait?"
"The main character today isn't Jaylen. Why should we wait? Let's eat!"
The middle-aged woman said with a smile.
"The main character today is indeed not Jaylen, but I heard that Jaylen just won a shooting championship a few days ago. We haven't celebrated with him yet, so we can take this opportunity to celebrate his win!"
Caroline said lightly.
"Jaylen won the shooting competition again this year?"
When Janson heard Caroline's words, he was a little surprised.
"Yes, Dad. He went for the competition when you were hospitalized. At that time, you were in the hospital, so we didn't tell you about this…"
Caroline hurriedly said.
"Jaylen is indeed quite good. He has won the shooting competition for three consecutive years. For the Wallace family to have such a soldier, it's worth celebrating…"
Janson said with satisfaction.
When Jaylen Wallace's mother heard Janson's words, she couldn't help but smile happily. However, this woman was obviously humbler than Caroline. She just smiled and didn't continue to show off.
After hesitating for a moment, Rachel softly said to Connor, "Jaylen is my second uncle's son. He's also the most outstanding member of the younger generation in the Wallace family. He can even be compared to Yoel. However, Yoel has made great achievements in the business world and the ancient martial arts world, while Jaylen has made progress in the military. Jaylen's future is limitless..."
"I see!"
Connor nodded slightly when he heard Rachel's words. He finally understood why Caroline and the others would curry favor with that woman.
After all, Jaylen was likely to compete for the position of the family head in the future, so these people definitely had to get on his good side.
"By the way, what was the shooting competition they were talking about just now?"
Connor was curious about the shooting competition and asked Rachel softly.
"I don't know much about this shooting competition, but I heard that it's the most important shooting competition in our country. The competition is very complicated and difficult. It's held once a year, and all the military regions in the country will select their best shooters to participate in the competition. It will not only be an individual honor, but also an honor for the entire military region if the person wins. It's very important for a shooter!"
Rachel looked at Connor and explained.
"Just now, they said that Jaylen has won the championship of this shooting competition for three consecutive years. He is indeed very talented!"
Connor said softly after finding out what this shooting competition was about.
"Of course, Jaylen is very talented. Otherwise, these people wouldn't be sucking up to Jaylen's mother like this..."
Rachel replied with a helpless expression, then continued, "You have to be careful later. These people were planning to use Harford to embarrass you, but they didn't expect your chess game to be so good. They definitely won't let it go, so they might use Jaylen to suppress you later..."
"Heh, I'll be fine…"
Connor was already used to the Wallace family's little tricks, so he did not take these people seriously.

chapters.title: Chapter 1595: Jaylen Wallace Returns
chapters.content:
Chapter 1595: Jaylen Wallace Returns
The Wallace family members wanted to wait until Jaylen was back before eating, but Janson knew in his heart that these people were doing this to bully Connor.
After all, the main character today was Connor, but these people were waiting for Jaylen to come back. What was going on here?
If it were just a few minutes, that would be fine, but he didn't know when Jaylen would come back.
Therefore, Janson said, "Alright, everyone, don't wait anymore. Let's eat!"
When everyone heard Janson's words, they did not dare to say anything else and could only eat obediently.
Connor was already a little hungry, so he naturally did not stand on ceremony and began to eat in big mouthfuls, as if he did not take the Wallace family seriously at all.
The dishes made by the Wallace family were very delicious and were to Connor's liking.
When the Wallace family saw that Connor had been eating quietly, it seemed that they were ready to make things difficult for Connor again.
Caroline turned to look at Harford.
Harford quickly understood what Caroline meant. He raised his wine glass and smiled at Connor. "Connor, this is your first time coming here for a meal. Let's have a toast!"
"Alright…"
Connor raised his glass without any hesitation, clinked it with Harford's, and then drinking the wine in the glass.
Rachel turned and looked at Connor with a helpless expression, because she knew that the Wallace family was going to make Connor drink.
Connor was a newcomer, so when the Wallace family toasted Connor, he had no reason to refuse. If he refused, it would mean that he was looking down on the Wallace family.
However, what made Rachel somewhat worried was that if so many people of the Wallace family toasted Connor alone, then he would definitely drink too much. They were just trying to make things difficult for him.
Sure enough, Rachel's worries were right.
After Harford and Connor finished drinking, the other members of the Wallace family also raised their glasses and toasted Connor.
There were so many people in the Wallace family. Connor had to drink at least dozens of glasses of wine. Rachel had never seen Connor drink, so she didn't know how well he could take his alcohol.
Janson could naturally see through the thoughts of the Wallace family, but he did not stop them at all. Instead, he quietly continued eating. It seemed that Janson wanted to see how Connor planned to deal with the situation.
However, these people of the Wallace family might not know that because Connor had taken the Essence Cultivating Pill, this bit of wine was like mineral water to him. No matter how the other party toasted him, Connor would accept it with a smile. It was impossible for these people to make Connor drunk with white wine.
In the blink of an eye, half an hour had passed, and about 30 to 40 people had taken the initiative to toast Connor.
However, what the Wallace family did not expect was that Connor was still perfectly fine. From the beginning to the end, he sat on the spot and looked at these people with a smile, as if he hadn't had a glass to drink.
At this moment, everyone present was very surprised. They had attended many dinners and had seen many people who could drink, but this was the first time they were seeing someone who could drink like Connor. They even suspected that Connor had secretly poured the wine away.
After half an hour, the people of the Wallace family began to feel dizzy, but Connor was fine. It was indeed rather strange.
However, these people had come today with the goal of getting Connor drunk, so they had no intention of stopping and continued to toast Connor.
The Wallace family planned to get Connor drunk so that he would make a fool of himself.
However, they never thought that Connor's alcohol tolerance would be so high. Not only did these people not get Connor drunk, but they also felt a little dizzy. Some of their alcohol tolerance wasn't very high, and some of them were already in a stupor.
Janson looked at Connor, who was sitting quietly in the same place, and smiled lightly. He did not say anything.
"Harford, why don't we have another drink?"
Connor knew that the Wallace family was ready to give up on getting him drunk, so he took the initiative to attack.
"..."
Harford was obviously stunned after hearing Connor's words. A strange look flashed across his face. At this moment, Harford was obviously a little drunk, but he didn't think Connor would ask for a toast.
If Harford said that he couldn't drink anymore, then the one who would lose face would be him. However, if he continued to drink, Harford was worried that if he ended up drunk, it might be even more embarrassing. Therefore, at this time, Harford didn't know what to do.
"Connor, Harford probably can't drink anymore. Forget it!"
However, at this moment, Rachel spoke up.
"Can't drink anymore?"
Connor couldn't help but laugh when he heard this. Then, he said indifferently, "Since you can't drink anymore, then forget it!"
Harford looked at Connor and was a little angry. He took a deep breath and didn't say anything.
Not long after, everyone was almost done eating. They stood up and was ready to clean the tables.
Although the Wallace family also had nannies, there were too many people here for dinner today. If they relied on the nannies to clean up, who knew how long it would take? Therefore, the people from the Wallace family were also helping.
However, just as everyone was about to pack up, a black SUV slowly stopped at the entrance of the courtyard.
"Is it Jaylen?"
"It must be Jaylen!"
Everyone shouted when they saw the SUV.
A moment later, the door of the SUV opened, and a handsome young man walked into the courtyard.
Connor glanced at the young man indifferently. He had to admit that Jaylen was indeed very handsome, and he was tall and burly. He must be really attractive to the ladies. Many socialites from big families in York were crazily pursuing Jaylen, but he had never been in a relationship.
Jaylen was considered one of the top young masters in York. Not only was he handsome, but he also had very good character. In addition, he was likely to become the head of the Wallace family in the future. No woman would not be tempted by such an outstanding existence.
"This person is Jaylen. You might have to be careful..."
Rachel softly said to Connor.
"Be careful of what?"
Connor was stunned for a moment and asked in a puzzled tone.
"Jaylen likes me. If he knows that I have a boyfriend, he will definitely try his best to make things difficult for you!"
Rachel said indifferently.

chapters.title: Chapter 1596: Humiliation
chapters.content:
Chapter 1596: Humiliation
"What are you saying?"
After hearing Rachel's words, Connor froze, his expression on his face filled with disbelief.
"Jaylen's feelings for me, not many know about it, but he did pursue me!"
Her tone was somewhat helpless.
"Isn't there a blood relationship between you two?"
Connor's tone was filled with shock.
"Jaylen said he doesn't care, but I'm not interested in him!"
She pouted and replied.
As Connor looked at the tall and handsome Jaylen in front of him, he hesitated for a moment, then sighed softly, "Actually, you're right. You're so beautiful and well-built, it's normal for him to be attracted to you."
"Are you praising me?" she asked lightly.
"I suppose so." he whispered.
Moments later, Jaylen walked up to the group, and unsurprisingly, when he saw Connor standing beside Rachel, his expression turned somewhat angry. His gaze seemed as though he wanted to kill Connor, but because Janson was present, Jaylen didn't dare to show his true emotions.
If Janson were to find out that Jaylen had feelings for Rachel, he would likely lose his eligibility to compete for the position of the family head. The Wallace family, being a prestigious clan, cared deeply about appearances.
Jaylen's original plan was to wait for Janson to pass away, then defeat Yeol to become the family head. By that time, he could openly be with Rachel without anyone obstructing him.
However, what he had never expected was Rachel suddenly announcing that she had a boyfriend. So, he took a leave of absence specifically to come back and see who this boyfriend of hers really was.
He walked up to Janson, and with a soft voice and said, "Grandfather."
"Jaylen, you're back?"
Janson smiled faintly and continued, "Sit down and eat. We haven't finished yet..."
"Alright..."
He nodded lightly and sat down at the table, beginning to eat.
Seeing his return, almost everyone gathered around him, initiating conversations with him.
Janson, however, sat in his chair, closed his eyes, and rested.
At this moment, the people in the Wallace family were most curious about the shooting competition, so they started asking about it.
"I heard you won the shooting competition again today. You've won three times in a row, right?"
Harford smiled and asked Jaylen.
"The competition this year was slightly weaker than before, so I managed to win the championship. It's not worth mentioning."
Jaylen remained modest when facing the Wallace family.
"Jaylen, don't be modest. Winning the shooting competition three years in a row is a remarkable achievement. It's a nationwide competition that gathers the best marksmen from all over the country. You've brought honor to our family..."
"Yes, this is no small competition. All the military districts in the country participated!"
"Jaylen is truly amazing. In our family, perhaps only Yeol can be compared to him..."
The crowd gathered around Jaylen, praising him.
After all, the position of the future head of the Wallace family was likely to fall to either Jaylen or Yeol. So, these people were trying to impress him while they had the chance, hoping it might benefit them in the future.
"Rachel, is this guy really your boyfriend?"
At this moment, unexpectedly, Jaylen turned to Rachel and asked.
The people from the Wallace family were taken aback by his question, then they fell silent one by one. They knew the real show was about to begin.
"Yes, this is my boyfriend, Connor!"
Rachel said softly, linking arms with Connor.
When he saw them together, his expression seemed even more unnatural. He glanced at Connor, then said lightly, "I was curious about who your boyfriend would be, but I didn't expect him to be so ordinary. Rachel, when did your taste become so poor?"
This caused all present to fall into a brief silence, their expressions incredulous.
Although the members of the Wallace family had been subtly provoking Connor before, none of them had been as direct as Jaylen. They had all been very discreet in their provocations.
But no one had expected him to start directly humiliating Connor from the beginning. It was clear that he didn't take Connor seriously at all.
After his words, even Janson didn't say much. After all, comparing Connor to the outstanding Jaylen, calling Connor ordinary was quite normal.
"Jaylen, what do you mean by that?"
Rachel, feeling discontent, shouted at him.
"Isn't my meaning clear enough? This man is simply not worthy of you. If you're with him just because you like him, then I really can't understand what about him attracts you!" he said lightly.
In fact, his intention with these words was quite simple, he couldn't figure out what exactly made him lose to Connor.
"Connor..."
Rachel was about to retort to Jaylen.
But Connor reached out to stop her and said expressionlessly, "There are many things about me that attract Rachel, things that you don't have!"
Clearly, his words were also provocative.
Since entering this courtyard, the members of the Wallace family had been trying various ways to humiliate him, which was beginning to irritate him. While he was impersonating Rachel's boyfriend, being repeatedly humiliated was becoming unbearable.
"I don't have them?"
Upon hearing his words, Jaylen couldn't help but let out a cold laugh, then said lightly, "I really haven't seen any qualities in you that I lack!"
"I heard these people saying you won the shooting competition?"
Connor looked at Jaylen and continued.
Everyone from the Wallace family was stunned upon hearing Connor's words.

chapters.title: Chapter 1597: A Competition
chapters.content:
Chapter 1597: A Competition
"What do you mean 'just okay'? His shooting skills are among the best in the whole of Oprana."
"Although he may not compare to those sharpshooters in Europe, among the younger generation in Oprana, he's definitely at the top!"
At this moment, Jaylen's sister exclaimed excitedly towards Connor.
"That's right. You can't just talk nonsense. Connor, while your chess skills might be decent, chess and shooting are completely different things..."
Harford also chimed in.
"Jaylen is known to be the best shooter!"
Caroline raised her eyebrows and said.
"Acclaimed as the best shooter?"
Upon hearing her words, Connor couldn't help but sneer and then said indifferently, "Who's acclaiming it?"
"Do you even know what shooting is? This shooting competition selects two marksmen from each military region in the entire country. The shooters must be under the age of thirty. Jaylen has won the championship in this competition for three consecutive years. Isn't he the strongest shooter?"
She stared at Connor and shouted.
He gave a faint smile and then expressionlessly said, "It's just a competition between a few military regions. I think a true sharpshooter wouldn't stoop to participate in such a competition. After all, if someone truly has skill, they wouldn't care about such superficial fame."
"Are you implying that among the people you know, there are those who are better than me?"
Jaylen finally couldn't help it and, setting down his chopsticks, asked Connor in a low voice.
Connor turned his head to glance at him, then calmly said, "I believe I will be able to defeat you..."
Upon hearing his words, everyone present was stunned. Their expressions were full of disbelief. They hadn't expected him, who had always been low-key, to be so arrogant now.
"You can defeat me? Have you ever shot a gun?"
Connor's words amused Jaylen, and he asked with a disdainful tone.
"I haven't, but I think it should be simple to defeat you." Connor said calmly.
"Connor, you're really good at boasting, huh?"
"Yeah, you, someone who hasn't even shot a gun, dares to claim that you can defeat Jaylen? Do you even know how difficult shooting competitions are? Some shooters can't even complete a match!"
"That's right! I can't believe how good some people are at bragging. Jaylen, you shouldn't bother with someone like him!"
"I can't believe Rachel found a boyfriend like him. He's such a big bragger. I don't think he's qualified to be with her!"
"If Rachel really marries someone like him, it would be a disgrace to our family!"
The Wallace family members naturally didn't let this opportunity go to waste. They started mocking Connor with one comment after another.
Rachel also looked at Connor's expression with some helplessness. She couldn't understand why he would say such things. Although he was a martial artist, he didn't seem to have any advantage if he were to participate in a shooting competition.
"Am I really boasting? Let's find out by competing!"
Facing the mockery of the crowd, Connor spoke calmly.
Jaylen's expression turned extremely angry upon hearing his words. After all, he had never experienced such humiliation before.
After taking a deep breath, he clenched his teeth and asked Connor in a low voice, "Are you saying you want to challenge me?"
"That's right. If you can provide a competition venue, I'm willing to compete against you!"
Connor nodded lightly.
Upon hearing his words, Jaylen turned his head directly towards Janson's position.
It's worth noting that organizing a shooting competition venue wasn't something just anyone could do. Even for ordinary people, getting into a shooting competition as a spectator was quite challenging, let alone participating. Even Jaylen himself didn't have the qualifications.
However, this matter was a small thing for Janson. After all, he still held significant influence within the military region. If he intervened, the military would surely give face.
After a brief hesitation, he slowly stood up and looked at the crowd, saying, "Sure, since you're all so interested, I'll play along. After being discharged from the hospital, I haven't gone out for activities. Today is a good opportunity..."
Seeing his agreement, Jaylen's expression appeared quite excited. Finally, he could properly teach Connor a lesson.
"Gerogie, call Commander Wonka!"
Janson called out to the butler.
"Yes, sir!"
Gerogie, the butler, quickly responded.
After a while, Gerogie finished the call with Commander Wonka and then arranged for transportation to take everyone to the competition venue.
Naturally, the Wallace family members also planned to follow and watch the excitement. In their eyes, Connor challenging Jaylen to a shooting competition was like courting death. Connor had no chance of winning, and they wouldn't miss this chance to mock him.
The Wallace family members drove in a convoy of over a dozen cars, heading towards the location of the competition venue.
Connor, Rachel, and Janson were in the same car, with Butler Gerogie as the driver.
At this moment, Rachel's mood was still quite nervous. She couldn't understand why Connor would proactively provoke Jaylen like this. Initially, she had wanted to talk to him, but Janson's presence in the car made it inconvenient.
Meanwhile, in another car.
Harford turned her head to look at Jaylen and whispered, "This Connor isn't simple. You need to be careful. If he's daring to challenge you, it means he must be prepared!"
"Don't worry. I know Connor is a martial artist, and his cultivation isn't low. But shooting competitions are about proficiency with handguns. Even if a martial artist joins, it won't be of much use. This time, I'll definitely teach him a lesson!"
Jaylen said confidently.
"Exactly, this time we must give him a good lesson. He's just too arrogant. We need to make sure he can't hold his head up in front of our Wallace family in the future!"
Another young man in the car added.
"Yeah, I really can't understand why Rachel is with this Connor. He's completely unworthy of her..."
Harford said in a low voice.
A hint of fierceness flashed in Jaylen's eyes, and he secretly thought, "He even dares to snatch my woman. Let's see how I'll deal with him this time..."

chapters.title: Chapter 1598: Not a Wise Choice
chapters.content:
Chapter 1598: Not a Wise Choice
Half an hour later, the group of people finally arrived at the shooting competition venue.
After Janson and the others got off the car, they saw a large group of people taking the initiative to welcome them.
"Mr. Janson, you're here?"
One of the middle-aged men said respectfully to Janson.
"Wonka, it's really too troublesome for you to come over personally for such a small matter. The younger generation in the family wanted to come over to play, so I followed them!"
Janson replied indifferently.
"Mr. Janson, you're too polite. This is nothing. If they wanted to come over to play in the future, then just let them come over directly. There was no need to go through so much trouble!"
The middle-aged man hurriedly said.
"Eh, how can this be? We still have to follow the rules. If everyone doesn't follow the rules, won't it be chaotic…"
Janson walked into the arena as he spoke.
After entering the venue, Rachel walked to Connor's side and whispered, "Connor, you're too impulsive. You could have provoked anyone but Jaylen…"
"Relax, I will definitely be able to defeat him…"
Connor said calmly.
"If you were competing with Jaylen, I might still believe you, but you definitely won't win this shooting competition!" she shouted helplessly.
"How do you know I can't win?" he asked with a smile.
"The environment of the competition venue here is very complicated. Jaylen has participated in the competition three times, so he is very familiar with the situation here, so from this point, he has a very big advantage," she said firmly.
"Maybe I'll be lucky enough to beat him!"
Connor replied with a smile.
After she heard his words, she was instantly speechless.
Because she knew very well that this kind of competition was not a matter of luck at all, but a competition of absolute strength.
Connor walked to the front of the venue and found that there was an honor list at the entrance of the venue.
In first place was a person called Frazer Wood, with a time of one minute and thirty seconds.
Jaylen's name was also among them, but his position was relatively far behind. He should be in the top 15 with a score of two minutes and 17 seconds.
"This ranking has been around since the shooting competition was held. As long as you can make it onto this ranking, you are the best shooter in the military region!"
Rachel softly said to Connor.
"Oh, oh!"
Connor nodded and didn't say anything.
"The first place Frazer Wood is from the northern warzone of Oprana. He created this record when he was young, and it has been so many years since it was broken!"
Rachel continued.
"Northern warzone?"
After Connor heard this, the expression on his face seemed to be a little shocked.
"That's right!"
Rachel said softly.
Connor looked at her without saying anything.
"Jaylen wasn't originally on this list, but he has made great progress this year and directly entered the top 15. This means that Jaylen may be one of the top 15 people in the entire military region, so it's really not a wise choice for you to challenge Jaylen this time!"
"I'm just playing around. It doesn't matter even if I lose!"
Connor said with a smile.
After she heard his words, she had a helpless expression and said in a low voice, "Since you knew that you would lose, why did you still come?"
"If I win, won't these people from the Wallace family shut up?"
Connor said to her with a smile.
She stared at him with a helpless expression, not knowing what to say.
..
In the shooting range.
Janson looked at everyone indifferently and asked softly, "Do any of you want to join in the fun?"
Everyone shook their heads when they heard Janson's words. After all, they were here today to see Connor make a fool of himself. Moreover, wouldn't it be embarrassing to compete with Jaylen in shooting?
Therefore, the Wallace family naturally would not participate in the competition.
When he saw that everyone was willing to stand up, his expression was a little disappointed. Sometimes, he admired Connor's character. Although he seemed arrogant, at least Connor was fearless, unlike the Wallace family. No matter what they did, they had to consider the consequences of their family and were afraid of the consequences.
"Since they are not willing to participate, then the two of you can compete!"
Janson said to Connor and Jaylen with a smile.
Jaylen hesitated for a moment, then took a step forward and said arrogantly, "Connor, this is your first time participating in a shooting competition. This kind of competition tests your grasp of the terrain, so I can let you go in and observe the terrain for 15 minutes at most!"
"No need, let's just compete in the real world!"
He refused without thinking.
Jaylen couldn't help but be stunned when he heard Connor's words. He didn't expect him to be so arrogant.
"Connor, are you sure you don't want to go in and take a look?"
Janson frowned and asked Connor.
"There's no need…"
Connor shook his head without thinking.
Jaylen looked at Connor and hesitated for two seconds, then whispered, "Alright, since you don't want to go in and observe the terrain, I'll give you ten seconds. After the final result is out, if the gap between the two of us is within ten seconds, I'll consider it your win!"
"We'll talk if you can beat me!"
Connor replied.
Jaylen looked at his face helplessly.
