"Alright, you two go and change your clothes first!"
Janson said expressionlessly.
Jaylen glanced at Connor indifferently and walked straight to the locker room.
Although it was just a contest between Connor and Jaylen, because the situation in the competition venue was very complicated, Connor and Jaylen had to wear special clothes to ensure that the two of them were not injured. Of course, this was also to ensure the fairness of the competition.
After changing his clothes, Jaylen looked at Connor up and down and whispered, "Connor, you're asking for humiliation!"
"I heard that you like Rachel?"
Connor looked up at Jaylen and asked him with a smile.
Jaylen couldn't help but be stunned when he heard Connor's words.
"Unfortunately, Rachel doesn't seem to like you. Do you know the difference between the two of us?"
Connor looked at Jaylen and continued.

chapters.title: Chapter 1599: Two Minutes and Nineteen Seconds
chapters.content:
Chapter 1599: Two Minutes and Nineteen Seconds
"The difference?"
Jaylen couldn't help but sneer, his expression filled with disdain.
"That's right. It's because I'm better-looking than you that Rachel likes me instead of you!"
Connor said with a grin.
"You're better-looking than me?"
Jaylen was speechless upon hearing his words.
He couldn't fathom where Connor got the courage to say such a thing.
"By the way, not only am I better-looking than you, I'm also wealthier, and most importantly, I'm a better shot than you. So, whether you want to pursue Rachel or wait until your next life, it's up to you!"
Connor patted his shoulder lightly, then walked out of the changing room.
Jaylen stared at Connor's departing figure, his expression incredibly bewildered. He found Connor's words quite laughable.
A moment later, they returned to the entrance of the shooting range.
To ensure fairness in the competition, Janson had brought in a referee.
The referee briefly inspected Connor and Jaylen's attire, then provided them with weapons – a rifle and a submachine gun each.
"Connor is a first-timer. Please explain the rules to him."
Janson whispered to the referee.
"The rules are quite simple. After both participants enter the range, the one who hits all the targets first wins. If a mistake occurs, it's considered a failure. In the event both complete the competition, the one with the shortest time is the winner."
The referee explained softly to Connor.
"Got it!"
Connor nodded, acknowledging the explanation.
Completing this competition was actually very challenging. First, you needed to hit all the targets, which tested a person's marksmanship. If you made a mistake, you would lose the opportunity to continue, and your result would be invalidated. Only hitting all the targets marked the completion of the competition. Afterward, the winner was determined based on the shortest time.
At this point, the members of the Wallace family present believed that he wouldn't be able to complete the competition. Hitting all the targets wasn't an easy feat.
Some targets would appear momentarily, while others would appear in groups of four or five, requiring the shooter to use both guns simultaneously, significantly increasing the difficulty.
Therefore, a shooting competition not only tested a person's marksmanship but also their psychological composure. Only those with strong mental fortitude could become true sharpshooters.
After all, true sharpshooters hit all the targets within a tight timeframe.
According to previous military district tests, even when using robots, the fastest time recorded was one minute and nine seconds. Thus, achieving a time of one minute and thirty seconds in the past was already a miracle, and it was likely a record that would be hard to surpass.
"Which one of you will go first?"
Janson whispered.
"I'll go first. It'll give Connor a chance to observe the terrain."
Jaylen volunteered.
"Alright, you go first then."
Janson nodded gently.
Jaylen walked directly into the shooting range.
At the moment, Jaylen held a significant advantage. Having just finished a previous competition, the terrain hadn't changed, giving him an edge in knowledge. He even knew the specific positions where enemies would appear. As such, he might break his own record this time.
However, this particular competition wouldn't be officially recorded. Only true competitions would be documented.
He also knew that since Connor had challenged him voluntarily, he must have some skills up his sleeve; otherwise, Connor wouldn't have come.
So, he decided to set a remarkable record to surprise him.
By doing so, Connor might become flustered, and he might even make mistakes due to nervousness. Jaylen could then mock him thoroughly.
Meanwhile, Connor's expression remained calm as he focused on Jaylen's position. He seemed entirely devoid of nervousness.
Inside the shooting range.
"Are you ready?"
The referee asked Jaylen softly.
"I'm ready..."
Jaylen nodded lightly.
"321! Begin!"
The referee shouted, and Jaylen immediately rushed into the shooting range with his weapon.
"Bang! Bang! Bang!"
Gunshots followed in quick succession.
Watching from outside the range, the Wallace family members could observe the situation inside on screens. Jaylen's ability to win the shooting competition's championship for three consecutive years demonstrated his skill.
After he entered the shooting range, he hardly missed a shot. He easily took down each target, hitting them all in the head. With his familiarity with the target positions and his smooth movements, Jaylen's performance was flawless.
At this moment, Connor wore a very serious expression. He had been observing Jaylen's every move because the targets that Jaylen hit were the ones he would need to hit next. He had to memorize their locations in a short amount of time.
In the blink of an eye, Jaylen had hit all the targets.
When the final shot was fired, the referee blew the whistle, and the timer stopped at two minutes and nineteen seconds.
Jaylen's previous record was two minutes and thirty seconds. This time, he had shaved off ten seconds – a considerable improvement. It was worth noting that shaving off ten seconds in a competition like this was a significant achievement.
However, upon seeing this result, his expression was somewhat disappointed.
Since he had participated in this competition before, he was very familiar with the terrain. He believed he had a good chance of breaking the two-minute mark this time. Yet, in the end, he achieved a time of two minutes and eight seconds.
This time might be the limit for Jaylen. After all, the next time he participated, the target positions would change, making it unlikely that he could be even faster.
Thinking this, Jaylen couldn't help but respect Frazer, who had set the 1-minute-30-second record.
"Two minutes and nineteen seconds is a great result. In recent years, few have managed to go below two minutes and thirty seconds!"
The referee said cheerfully to Jaylen.
"I was lucky this time. This result isn't my true performance!"
Jaylen modestly said.
Upon hearing this, the referee smiled faintly, then looked at Connor and said softly, "Get ready, it's almost your turn!"
Connor walked up to the front of the shooting range, his steps determined.

chapters.title: Chapter 1600: Shocking Results
chapters.content:
Chapter 1600: Shocking Results
"Next up is Connor. I wonder what his result will be."
"Hmph! What result can he achieve? I bet he won't even finish the competition!"
"I think so too. This kind of competition isn't for just anyone. One mistake and it's a failure. Connor is participating for the first time, and he hasn't received any training before. He's definitely not going to make it..."
"If he can't even complete the competition, I'd like to see how arrogant Connor can be!"
The members of the Wallace family started whispering to each other.
After hesitating for a moment, Rachel walked over to Connor's side and softly said, "Connor, do your best!"
"Don't worry..." he replied with a grin, then quickly adjusted his weapons.
"Begin!"
The referee shouted.
Connor entered the training range with his rifle in hand.
"Bang! Bang! Bang!"
Deafening gunshots echoed.
Everyone's attention was focused on the screens.
However, within seconds, their expressions began to change.
They realized that Connor seemed to be participating in the competition as if it weren't his first time. His movements were remarkably skilled, his marksmanship precise, and even more astonishing was that his speed was noticeably faster than Jaylen's.
Even Jaylen was stunned.
Connor and Jaylen had significantly different shooting styles. Connor fired both guns simultaneously, allowing him to hit targets faster, while Jaylen used only one gun. He would only use two guns when multiple targets appeared.
This led to Connor's significantly faster speed.
"How did he do that? How can he be so precise while firing both guns simultaneously?"
Jaylen's eyes were filled with astonishment.
Before anyone could fully comprehend what was happening, the competition had ended.
Connor's final time was one minute and thirty-one seconds!
Seeing this result, everyone was stunned. The difference between this result and the first-place record on the honor list was just one second.
"It's impossible. How could Connor be this fast?"
Jaylen exclaimed excitedly.
Even the middle-aged man who had received Janson seemed astonished by this result. After all, no one had managed to go below two minutes for the past ten years. Now, Connor had achieved one minute and thirty-one seconds with ease, leaving everyone in disbelief.
"This result must be inaccurate!"
Jaylen shouted at the middle-aged man.
The middle-aged man hesitated for a moment, then turned to his subordinate and said, "Go check and see if all the shots hit their targets."
"Alright!"
The man nodded and ran into the range.
The middle-aged man approached the screen, carefully reviewing the footage of Connor's competition.
A few minutes later, the man returned to the middle-aged man and said solemnly, "Reporting, sir, all shots indeed hit the targets!"
Upon hearing this, the middle-aged man couldn't help but take a deep breath. He then looked up and said to Jaylen, "I've examined the video of Mr. Connor's competition, and there doesn't appear to be any issue. Therefore, his result is valid."
Upon hearing this, everyone present was left dumbfounded. They stood there with bewildered expressions, not knowing how to describe their feelings.
One minute and thirty-one seconds – this result was forty-eight seconds faster than Jaylen's. What an incredible speed!
With just one more second, Connor could have claimed the first place on the honor list.
The first place on the honor list had remained untouched for nearly decades, and no one had come close to breaking it. He was the only one with a chance to achieve that.
After all, this was his first time participating in this competition. He hadn't received any formal training before. If he were to train properly, he could certainly break the record.
The gazes of everyone present shifted as they looked at him.
From the moment Connor arrived at the Wallace family, he faced all sorts of challenges. It seemed as if every member of the Wallace family wanted to see Connor embarrassed.
However, they never expected that he would repeatedly prove them wrong.
At this moment, the expressions on the faces of the Wallace family members were extremely complicated. They found him to be quite extraordinary, capable of achieving the unimaginable. They had attempted to provoke him multiple times, starting with a chess match against Jaylen, then attempting to get him drunk, and even involving Jaylen directly. Yet, each time, he managed to turn the tables on them.
The Wallace family members were starting to feel that he was indeed exceptional, seemingly skilled at everything he did.
Thus, their hopes were now resting on Yeol's shoulders.

chapters.title: Chapter 1601: Cultivating Together
chapters.content:
Chapter 1601: Cultivating Together
After returning to the Wallace family, everyone bid farewell to Janson and went back to their own homes.
Janson, feeling a bit tired after a day of activity, retired to his room to rest.
Rachel accompanied Connor back to their room.
"How was it? Are you satisfied with my performance today?" He grinned and asked her.
"How on earth did you do that? When did your marksmanship become this good?" she asked, puzzled.
"My marksmanship isn't that great..." He chuckled and continued, "But I can use my Chi to control the bullets, so I don't need to aim properly. I can just shoot casually, and that makes me much faster than an ordinary person..."
"Your Chi can control the bullets?" Rachel's expression became even more incredulous upon hearing this.
"What's so strange about that?" he asked, a little surprised.
"I'm currently at the Black-rank level of martial arts, yet I can't even control the flight of bullets with my Chi. You've just recently stepped into the Black-rank, and you're telling me you can control bullet trajectories? Are you joking with me?" she exclaimed, her eyes wide.
"Maybe it's because I practiced the technique that old man gave me. I followed the instructions in that technique to control the bullets!" he explained lightly.
"The technique?"
Rachel hesitated upon hearing his words, then asked with confusion, "What technique is that?"
"It's called the 'Chi Circulation Scroll'!"
As Connor spoke, he took out the Chi Circulation Scroll manual from his clothes.
He usually carried this manual with him and practiced when he had spare time.
"Chi Circulation Scroll?"
Rachel's expression became even more incredulous upon seeing the manual Connor presented.
"Have you heard of Chi Circulation Scroll before?" he asked softly, seeing her reaction.
"It's a supreme technique of the Purple Cloud Sect. I heard that only the head of the Purple Cloud Sect can practice Chi Circulation Scroll. I never thought Jorge would give you Chi Circulation Scroll so early. He's really treating you well, isn't he?" she remarked in amazement.
"Is it really that powerful? I didn't take Chi Circulation Scroll seriously before!" he replied nonchalantly.
"You don't know how many people lost their lives trying to obtain Chi Circulation Scroll in the past. You're really lucky..." She sighed in disbelief.
"But this Chi Circulation Scroll is indeed quite impressive. I felt my strength improve significantly after studying it," Connor looked up at Rachel and continued, "It's just a pity that sometimes I don't fully understand the content. After all, my exposure to ancient martial arts has been relatively short, and there are some things I can't grasp. Besides, Jorge, that old man, doesn't have a phone or anything, so I can't ask him for help in a timely manner!"
"Indeed, ancient martial arts manuals are not something ordinary people can easily comprehend," she replied softly.
"By the way, aren't you a martial artist too? How about practicing the Chi Circulation Scroll with me?" He hesitated and suggested.
"No, it is an exclusive skill of your Purple Cloud Sect. I'm not a member of your sect, so I can't practice it," she replied, shaking her head without hesitation.
"Before, you weren't part of our Purple Cloud Sect, but you are now. I'm thinking of promoting you to be my junior disciple of the Purple Cloud Sect. That way, you'll have the qualification to practice, right?" he said with a cheerful smile.
"A junior disciple of the Purple Cloud Sect?" Rachel's expression showed some confusion upon hearing this.
"I'm the sect leader of the Purple Cloud Sect, and you'd be my junior disciple!" he explained with a smile.
"Are you sure you want me to be your junior disciple?" she asked in a cold tone.
Connor was well aware that Rachel was not an easy person to deal with.
So he quickly explained, "I was just joking with you earlier. But I really do want you to practice the Chi Circulation Scroll!"
"Why do you want me to practice it?" Rachel blinked and asked with a puzzled tone.
"Because now I know your true identity. If your strength can improve, it will greatly help us when we team up to deal with Rockefeller. Besides, there are some parts of the technique that I can't understand. When the time comes, you can help me figure them out!" he explained softly.
Rachel looked at him, hesitated for a couple of seconds, and then said calmly, "I'll hold off on learning the Chi Circulation Scroll for now. After all, the most important thing right now is to improve your strength. You'll be facing Yeol in three days. If you have any questions, just ask me directly. I'll help you."
"Alright!"
Connor nodded and immediately opened the Chi Circulation Scroll manual, starting to study it with Rachel.
The members of the Wallace family were aware that Rachel was in Connor's room. However, now that their relationship was confirmed, no one would say anything even if she spent the night there.
However, the young men of the Wallace family were quite envious. Connor managed to win the heart of a stunning beauty like Rachel.
In the Wallace family, it wasn't just Jaylen who had feelings for Rachel. Almost all the young men in the family fantasized about her. They just lacked the courage to express their feelings.
Now, they watched as the girl they had dreamed about was in a room with another man. One could only imagine their feelings.
...
On the other side, in a villa belonging to the Lee family in York.
An elderly man dressed in black Chinese attire sat on a sofa, reading a newspaper. This man might be one of the few remaining relatives of Connor in this world.
His name was Joseph Lee, the father of Connor's mother, Sharon.
Back when Connor's mother and his father got together, Joseph vehemently opposed it, and their relationship deteriorated to the point of cutting ties.
However, Sharon chose to be with Connor's father.
As a result, Joseph and Sharon had not been in contact for many years, and Joseph hadn't even attended Connor's parents' funerals.
Connor was well aware of Joseph's existence, of course. But his mother had told him never to have any contact with the Lee family, even if he were starving. So he had always kept this in mind, never contacting any member of the Lee family, even during his toughest times.
That's why, initially, he had rejected Chelsea's offer of the Heavens Club.
However, she wasn't truly a member of the Lee family, so he gradually accepted her presence.

chapters.title: Chapter 1602: My Grandson?
chapters.content:
Chapter 1602: My Grandson?
"Old man, why are you all by yourself?"
Just at this moment, a woman wearing a black hip-hugging skirt, with light makeup on her face, exuding an elegant aura and a seductive figure, walked into the living room. With a smile on her face, she called out to Joseph.
"You came back to York without thinking of visiting me, so of course, I'm on my own. It seems you're starting to overlook me more and more!" Joseph turned his head to glance at Chelsea and asked indifferently.
"I didn't have a choice. As soon as I got off the plane, some old friends spotted me and insisted on throwing a welcome dinner for me. I had no choice but to attend!" she explained helplessly.
"Why did you come back to York this time?" he asked directly.
"I have some good news to share with you..." she said with a smile.
"What good news could you possibly have?" He put down the newspaper and said calmly.
"Your grandson has come to York!" she said with a smile.
"My grandson? Which grandson?" Joseph's expression showed confusion upon hearing this.
"Do you think I would bother telling you about someone else? The grandson I'm talking about is none other than Connor, whom you've never met before..." she said slowly.
"Connor?" Joseph's expression turned somewhat strange upon hearing this name, and his right hand visibly began to tremble.
"Are you surprised?" Chelsea asked with a smile.
"He's not my grandson!" Joseph shook his head lightly.
"Alright, there's no one else here. Don't pretend with me. If others don't know, I certainly do. Your little schemes can't be hidden from me. I know that deep down, you couldn't let go of my sister. After she died, you blamed yourself!" she said slowly.
"Everything that happened was her own doing. I had advised her a long time ago that being with that man would be very dangerous, but she didn't listen. In the end, she severed ties with me, so I have nothing to blame myself for!" he said expressionlessly.
"Since you truly have no feelings for Sharon, why have you been inquiring about Connor's whereabouts all these years?" Chelsea pouted and asked.
"How did you know that I had someone investigate Connor's whereabouts?" Joseph seemed somewhat surprised.
"Did you think your little schemes could be hidden from me? I know you've never truly let go of what happened with my sister. You just haven't shown it. Now you have a chance to meet her son, Connor. Are you willing to set aside your pride and meet him?" she said with a smile.
Joseph turned his head to glance at her and then whispered, "Back when your sister and I had our falling out, and given that Connor hasn't contacted me all these years, it suggests that he probably doesn't want to see me. Let it be. He's doing fine now, and there's nothing I can do to help him. It's better if we don't meet..."
"You're afraid that Connor won't want to see you, aren't you?" Chelsea asked.
"Yes!" He nodded gently.
"That's simple. My birthday is coming up in a few days. I'll be hosting a birthday party, and since I have a very good relationship with Connor, I'll invite him over. He won't dare refuse!" she said after thinking for a moment.
"You have a good relationship with Connor?" Joseph's expression showed surprise upon hearing this from her.
"Yes, there's no deep-seated grudge between Connor and me!" she replied with a smile.
He glanced at her helplessly and remained silent.
...
Connor and Rachel had spent the entire night practicing in the room. His progress had been remarkable with her assistance.
At eight in the morning, they both walked out of the room and headed to the dining room for breakfast.
Although he had proved all the Wallace family members wrong yesterday, their attitude towards him hadn't changed significantly.
This was because, while they acknowledged his excellence, it didn't bring any benefits to them. They would only respect those who could benefit them. If you wanted their approval, you had to offer them advantages, and not just ordinary ones at that.
In their eyes, Connor currently couldn't offer them any benefits, so they naturally wouldn't treat him kindly.
Of course, today the members of the Wallace family were on their best behavior. They were well aware that Connor wasn't someone easy to mess with, and they didn't want to make fools of themselves.
After breakfast, Rachel took Connor back to the room.
"Get ready, we're going out later," she said softly to him.
"Why are we going out?" Connor, who had been practicing all night, was feeling tired and just wanted to rest.
"We need to investigate the Collier family's situation, right? I'm taking you to meet someone..." she said calmly.
"You've already found out so quickly?" He was somewhat surprised.
"I got in touch with someone. This person used to work for the Collier family, and I believe they can provide you with some useful information..." she explained.
"Worked for the Collier family?" Connor's expression became even more surprised upon hearing this.
He hadn't expected that her connections would be so extensive to the point that she had directly found someone who used to work for the Collier family. This could make it much easier for him to enter the Collier family.
"I had Georgie prepare a car for us. Don't lie around here, come with me!" she said coldly to him.
"Can't you let me rest a bit?" Connor's expression showed a hint of helplessness. He got up and followed her out of the room.
An hour later, they arrived in front of a club.
After entering the club, she told the waiter her name, and he led both of them into a private room.
Once inside, Rachel ordered a pot of tea and waited for the person she had contacted to arrive.
About ten minutes later, a knock sounded at the door.
"Come in!" Rachel said softly.
The door to the private room was pushed open, revealing a middle-aged man in a black suit. He entered the room with a serious expression.
The man appeared to be around forty years old, with an ordinary appearance, but his eyes were particularly sharp and powerful. Connor could sense that this man was likely a martial artist, and his cultivation level seemed quite high.

chapters.title: Chapter 1603: The Impenetrable Villa
chapters.content:
Chapter 1603: The Impenetrable Villa
"Miss Rachel, greetings!"
The middle-aged man respectfully greeted Rachel.
"Mr. Kingston, hello!" Rachel replied casually, then turned to Connor and said, "Connor, this is Mr. Kingston Jeter!"
"Mr. Connor, greetings!" Kingston, apparently aware of Connor's identity, greeted him proactively.
After a brief exchange of pleasantries, Connor got straight to the point, "Since you've been introduced by Rachel, that means I can trust you. I won't beat around the bush. I heard that you used to work for the Collier family. Can you tell me your exact position?"
"I used to be the captain of the security team at the Collier family," Kingston replied directly.
"Security team captain?" Connor couldn't help but pause upon hearing this.
"Mr. Connor, the Collier family has a considerable number of security personnel. For management convenience, they group every ten security personnel together, with each group having a captain. I was the captain of the third group," Kingston explained.
"Then why did you leave the Collier family?" Connor furrowed his brows.
"I had a conflict with the chief of the security team at the Collier family, so I left on my own accord. Even if I didn't leave voluntarily, they would have found a way to get rid of me," Kingston explained.
"I see," Connor nodded thoughtfully and continued, "Since you were the captain of the security team at the Collier family, you must be very familiar with the family's situation."
"Yes," Kingston affirmed confidently.
"Do you know if the Collier family has a hidden chamber?" Connor looked at him and inquired.
"A hidden chamber?" Kingston seemed momentarily surprised by Connor's question, then instinctively glanced at Rachel.
"Mr. Kingston, you don't need to worry about anything. Just speak your mind," Rachel said casually.
Kingston hesitated for a couple of seconds upon hearing Rachel's words, then lowered his voice and said, "Mr. Connor, the Collier family does indeed have a hidden chamber. However, I haven't been to that chamber myself."
"Do you know where this hidden chamber is located?" Connor asked.
"I have a general idea of its location," Kingston nodded slightly and pulled out a map from his pocket. Pointing to the central spot on the map, he said, "Mr. Connor, this place should be the hidden chamber. But only Beau Collier and Albert Collier have the authority to access it. No one else is permitted to enter."
Connor remained silent, understanding that the mystery surrounding this hidden chamber suggested that it contained something incredibly valuable. Despite the Collier family's substantial influence and power in York, only Beau and Albert were granted access, which further indicated the chamber's importance.
"Do you think I could enter this hidden chamber?" Connor narrowed his eyes and asked him.
Upon hearing this question, Kingston was instantly dumbfounded, wearing an expression of disbelief.
"Mr. Connor, you're not joking, are you? You actually intend to enter the Collier family's hidden chamber by yourself?" Kingston exclaimed, his eyes wide.
"Yes, I want to give it a try." Connor nodded lightly.
"I think, your idea is really too crazy. Unless you're a Grandmaster of martial arts, you simply won't be able to get in," Kingston said directly.
"Why?" Connor asked.
"The security system at the Collier family is very advanced. The entire villa is under surveillance, and there are nearly fifty martial artist security personnel. So, Mr. Connor, trying to break into the Collier family is basically impossible," Kingston answer bluntly.
Connor looked at him without saying a word.
"Mr. Kingston, in your opinion, what's the best way to maximize the chances of entering the secret chamber in the Collier family?" Rachel knew that Connor won't pass up such a good opportunity, so even if there was a significant risk, he definitely would give it a try.
And Rachel had thought it through. If Connor was discovered by the Collier family, she would use the connections of her family to secure his release.
In any case, the Wallace family still wields some influence in York, so saving his life shouldn't be a major issue.
Kingston glanced at Rachel helplessly, then whispered, "Miss Rachel, let me briefly explain the internal situation of the Collier family to you."
"Alright." Rachel nodded gently.
"Firstly, there are about fifty security guards within the Collier family's estate. All of them are martial artists with formidable strength. Every ten guards have a captain, and these captains are likely Black-rank martial artists. If Mr. Connor wants to enter the secret chamber, he must first pass through the estate and enter the villa..."
"Getting into the villa is extremely difficult. If Mr. Connor is fortunate enough to make it through the estate without being detected, he'll have to enter the villa itself. Inside the villa, there's the Chief Security Captain of the Collier family. This Chief Captain's strength is incredibly fearsome. I've met him once, and I found him very enigmatic."
Kingston traced a route on the map for Connor. This route was essentially the only way to enter the estate.
"I understand," Connor said, nodding gently at Kingston.
"Mr. Connor, the entire Collier family villa is covered by surveillance. So, if you appear inside the villa, the Collier family will spot you," Kingston says in a low voice.
"You don't need to worry about that," Connor retorted, then continued, "If I manage to get into the villa, how can I find this secret chamber?"
"This secret chamber should be located behind the Chief Security Captain's room. So, Mr. Connor, if you want to find the secret chamber, you'll have to pass through the security personnel's living quarters," Kingston answered.
"The security personnel's living quarters?" Connor couldn't help but be taken aback.
"Exactly. Because there are so many security guards in the Collier family, for the sake of dealing with emergencies, the area beneath the villa is designated for their living quarters. In other words, the Collier family resides on the top three floors of the villa, while the security personnel live in the bottom two. If anything happens, these security guards can rush up immediately," Kingston explained.
"I didn't expect the Collier family villa to be so intricate," Connor couldn't help but sigh softly.
"This secret chamber is of great importance to the Collier family, so it should be on the last underground floor of the villa," Kingston said slowly.
Connor picked up the blueprint of the Collier family estate and examined it closely.
While the Collier family villa appears to have only three floors above ground, in reality, it has a total of six, three above ground and three below.
The top three floors were where the Collier family resides, while the bottom two floors were allocated for security personnel. The final floor was the secret chamber.

chapters.title: Chapter 1604: Making a Plan
chapters.content:
Chapter 1604: Making a Plan
"If I were to find this secret room, how could I get inside?" Connor looked at Kingston and asked.
"I'm not quite sure about that, as I've never seen this secret room and I've never been inside!" Kingston shook his head and replied.
Upon hearing his words, Connor's expression seemed somewhat helpless.
Firstly, finding the secret room was incredibly difficult for Connor. Even if he managed to locate it, entering the room would likely require a password, fingerprint, or even a more advanced form of biometric authentication like iris scanning.
These were all the challenges he needed to get through.
"Connor, maybe we should give up on this. It's highly unlikely that you'll be able to access the secret room in Collier family's mansion. We can find another way to obtain the hard drive!" Rachel hesitated for a moment before softly addressing Connor.
"I think Miss Qin is right. Trying to forcefully enter the secret room in Collier family's mansion is almost impossible, Mr. Connor. We can find other methods to retrieve the hard drive!" Kingston also added.
He wasn't intentionally discouraging Connor, but rather he knew well the intricacies of Collier family's security system due to his past work there. Thus, he believed that Connor's chances of successfully entering the secret room might be less than one percent.
"I've already come to York, so you should at least let me try. If I can't get in, we can think of another plan later!" Connor replied calmly to Rachel.
"Then I'll go with you. I'm worried you might encounter danger," she hesitated, looking at him.
"You can't come with me. The two of us together would attract too much attention and increase the risk of being discovered!" Connor shook his head directly, then turned to Kingston, saying, "Mr. Kingston, thank you for providing me with this information!"
"No problem. If there's nothing else, I'll be on my way!" Kingston felt that Connor was a bit too audacious, so he wanted to take this opportunity to leave.
"Alright!"
Connor nodded at Kingston's departure.
After Kingston left, Rachel asked Connor with a hint of resignation, "Connor, are you really planning to go to Collier family?"
"Either way, you should let me give it a shot, right?" he replied with a cheerful smile.
"Well, what's your plan then?" she inquired.
"Do you know any hackers?" Connor looked at Rachel and asked.
"I should be able to find some for you!" she replied.
"That's good!"
He nodded, then continued, "Help me find a few reliable hackers. Try to get them to breach Collier family's mansion security system as soon as possible. If they can disable the surveillance, I can get inside the mansion. Once inside, I'll figure out how to locate the secret room!"
"But the mansion has many guards. Can you really find the secret room?" She furrowed her brows and asked.
"I don't know either. We can only try," he said in a low voice.
"Besides hacking the security system, what else can I do?" She hesitated for a moment before looking at him.
"After hacking the security system, find a car. It can't be a car from your Wallace family, as I'm worried about exposing your identity. Park the car outside Collier family's estate. If things seem wrong or if I'm discovered, I'll rush out of the mansion, and you'll be responsible for picking me up!"
After thinking for a moment, Connor added, "Also, for safety, you should carry a gun. Both of us are martial artists, but I'm concerned the other side might have firearms. It's better for us to have some self-defense as well!"
"Leave all of this to me. I should be able to handle it!" Rachel said firmly.
After meeting with Kingston, they discussed and finalized their basic plan. Rachel would handle the security system and act as the getaway driver, while Connor would infiltrate Collier family's estate alone.
Her efficiency was as impressive as ever. After returning to her family, she made a few calls and quickly arranged for the hackers to deal with Collier family's security system.
"I reached out to my contacts in the U.S., and they helped me find a few renowned hackers. They say they can crack Collier family's mansion security system within a day, but they can only disable the surveillance for an hour. So, you must leave the mansion within that time!" she said.
"One hour should be enough!" he replied nonchalantly.
"However, these hackers charge a high price—50 million dollars. Is that okay for you?" Rachel continued.
"50 dollars?"
Upon hearing her words, his expression turned incredulous. He then muttered, "These hackers are incredibly demanding. They're acting as if money falls from the sky!"
"Alright, don't pretend. I know this amount means almost nothing to you. Collier family's security system isn't something just anyone can break. 50 million is actually quite a reasonable price for me. If it were someone else, the starting price would likely be at least a billion!" Rachel said with a hint of helplessness.
"That's really over the top..."
Connor grumbled under his breath, then continued, "I'll have Thomas transfer the money to you later."
"When do you plan to take action?"
Rachel asked in a hushed tone.
"I'll move once the hackers breach Collier family's security system. This is the kind of thing that can't be delayed—too many potential complications if we wait," Connor answered after a moment of thought.
"Alright."
With a somewhat resigned nod, Rachel turned and left Connor's room.
...
After Rachel wired the money to the hackers, they quickly delivered. In just half a day, they managed to crack Collier family's security system.
Knowing that the security system was breached, Connor didn't waste any time. He drove with Rachel to the vicinity of Collier family's mansion.
Driving around the mansion's vicinity, he noticed a forest behind Collier family's estate, an ideal spot for escape. He parked the car at the forest entrance and whispered to her, "You should go back. Leaving you here might make you easy to spot. If both of us get caught, things will get even more complicated. It's better if you leave first!"
"Do you really not want me to wait here for you to come out?"
She hesitated for a moment before whispering to him.
"No need. If you wait here, you might easily be discovered by Collier family's people. If both of us get caught, it would be worse. It's better for you to leave now!" he whispered back.

chapters.title: Chapter 1605: Sneaking into the Villa
chapters.content:
Chapter 1605: Sneaking into the Villa
Rachel looked at Connor and couldn't help but ponder.
She felt that what Connor had said made sense. After all, if both she and Connor were caught by the Collier family, no one would be able to save them.
If she left now, knowing that he was captured, she could immediately use her family's connections to rescue him.
"Alright, then I'll leave first."
Rachel nodded lightly and handed over the pistol she had prepared beforehand to Connor.
It was a specially customized pistol, compact and easy to carry.
"Although this pistol is small, its power is immense. Even Black-rank martial artists wouldn't be able to withstand its force. Unfortunately, the bullets are limited, so use them sparingly," she whispered to him.
"Sure, I understand. Don't worry!"
He took the pistol and discreetly concealed it within his clothing.
After a brief hesitation, she pushed open the car door and stepped out.
Meanwhile, Connor took out a Chi Receiving Pill and swallowed it.
Knowing that Collier family's mansion was filled with skilled individuals, he realized that if he were to be exposed, he might not even get a chance to use a Chi Receiving Pill. Therefore, he preemptively consumed one.
At 8 PM.
Connor sent a text message to Rachel using his phone.
Soon, she replied to him, informing him that Collier family's security system had been compromised.
Now, the security system at Collier family's mansion was under the control of the hackers. The guards watching the surveillance wouldn't notice anything unusual, but the footage was actually from the previous night. Thus, even if he stood right in front of the cameras, the guards wouldn't see him.
Unless there were extremely attentive guards, it would be difficult for them to detect anything amiss.
He took a deep breath and then scaled the wall to enter Collier family's estate.
Once inside, he briefly observed the surroundings.
It had to be admitted that Collier family's mansion was indeed lavish, with numerous villas. Connor's target was the central three-story villa; the other villas were likely occupied by Collier family's branches.
Unlike the Wallace family, Collier family exhibited stronger cohesion. Almost all members of Collier family lived in this mansion.
The central three-story villa was where Albert resided.
There weren't many guards within the courtyard, and with the surveillance under the hackers' control, the patrolling guards would have a hard time spotting Connor.
Connor quietly approached Albert's villa.
After a while, he arrived at the rear of the targeted villa.
There were two guards at the front entrance, and they had been stationed there. It was nearly impossible for Connor to slip past them, so he circled around the villa.
Connor was fortunate; he found a window that was open.
Though the window was on the second floor, thanks to the Chi Receiving Pill, he had no trouble with the height.
Stepping back a couple of paces, he sprinted forward and leaped onto the villa's wall. He gripped the window sill and vaulted inside.
Upon entering, he realized he was in a room.
The room's decoration exuded warmth, with almost everything in shades of pink—pink curtains, pink bedsheets, even the pajamas lying on the bed were pink.
Wary that the room might be occupied, he hid behind the curtains upon entering.
After observing for a few minutes, he noticed that the room's owner wasn't present. Emerging from behind the curtain, he cast a cursory glance around the room. This room seemed to belong to a young woman; a picture frame rested on the bedside table.
The photograph depicted an exceptionally beautiful girl. While she appeared quite young, around ten years old, one could discern that she would grow up into a breathtaking beauty.
However, Connor had no time to be concerned with these details. He continued onward.
Fortune seemed to favor him that day. If the window hadn't been open, or if someone had been in the room, he would likely have been discovered long ago.
Aware that he was on the second floor, whereas the secret room was located on the negative third floor, Connor moved toward the stairs.
However, before he reached the stairs, a guard noticed him.
"Stop!"
Since there were no guests in the villa that day, and Connor wasn't dressed in security attire, he looked suspicious. The guard immediately shouted at him.
He halted upon hearing the guard's words.
The guard approached, scrutinizing Connor from head to toe, and asked in a low voice, "Who are you? You're probably not a guest of Mr. Collier, right? What are you doing here?"
"Who says I'm not a guest?"
Connor retorted.
"Just wait here. I'll verify your status!"
As this was Albert's residence, where his wife and child lived as well, visitors were not uncommon.
Seeing his confident tone, the guard became uncertain if Connor was indeed a guest. He was about to use his walkie-talkie to confirm whether there were any guests entering when Connor abruptly moved forward and punched the guard in the head.
Connor's punch was powerful, and the guard, being a Yellow-ranked martial artist, was unable to withstand it.
The guard lost consciousness, and Connor caught him, dragging him into the pink room he had entered earlier.
Inside the room, he bound the guard's hands and feet with his clothes, gagged him, and stashed him in the wardrobe.
After dealing with the guard, he left the room once again.
However, as he emerged, he noticed that there were several guards patrolling the first floor. If he continued down this path, he would surely be spotted.
Yet, Connor also realized that all the guards were dressed the same.
He returned to the room and took off the clothes of the unconscious guard he had knocked out earlier. Connor put on the guard's uniform and took the guard's walkie-talkie and a dagger.

chapters.title: Chapter 1606: The Main Purpose
chapters.content:
Chapter 1606: The Main Purpose
After changing into the security uniform, Connor found his movements much more convenient.
Given the multitude of guards within the Collier family mansion, they sometimes couldn't distinguish who was new. Furthermore, his demeanor was natural, so no one paid him any attention.
After a few minutes, he successfully reached the negative first floor.
As he arrived on the negative first floor, he was astounded by the scene before him.
The negative first floor wasn't just a resting place for the guards; there were several fighting arenas, exercise equipment scattered around, and many guards engaged in combat training.
It was evident that this place was used for the guards' training.
This indicated that the Collier family had stringent demands for its guards. After all, why would an ordinary wealthy family set up training facilities for their security personnel?
Of course, this might also be attributed to Albert's father, Beau, who was the head of the Heavenly sect. These guards were not only security personnel but also disciples of the Heavenly sect.
Upon arriving on the first floor, Connor noticed an awkward problem, the guards here were all wearing their daily clothes. Since they didn't need to patrol, they only wore the uniform during their rounds.
He was currently wearing the uniform meant for patrolling. If the guards saw him, they might assume he was a slacking guard. They could question him, and things might become complicated. Therefore, he had to do his best to avoid the guards.
He carefully descended the stairs, nervously observing his surroundings.
He was aware that his situation was highly perilous. If he were discovered, the guards would likely attack him together. Despite having taken the Chi Receiving Pill, he wouldn't stand a chance against multiple guards alone.
Taking a deep breath, he tried to relax as much as possible.
His journey thus far had been nerve-wracking.
However, two guards were currently engaged in a duel, capturing most people's attention. This inadvertently created a favorable situation for Connor.
After about ten minutes, he finally found the staircase leading to the negative second floor.
Seeing the staircase, Connor breathed a sigh of relief. He proceeded to descend the stairs slowly.
After arriving on the negative second floor, he noticed that unlike the negative first floor, it was extremely quiet on this floor. The silence was such that he could hear his own breathing.
Based on the information provided by Kingston, the negative second floor was inhabited by the head of the guards and the captains of various teams. These individuals were possibly formidable, and if Connor were discovered here, the consequences would likely be dire.
When dealing with regular guards, he could manage to knock them out without making any noise. However, facing these captain-level guards wouldn't be as easy.
Therefore, Connor had to ensure he remained undetected.
In a corner of the negative second floor, there was a door that led to the secret chamber on the negative third floor.
He became even more cautious. He tried to move as quietly as possible, step by step, towards the end of the negative second floor.
Fortunately, the captain-level guards on the negative second floor didn't seem to consider the possibility of anyone sneaking in. After all, with so many guards in the mansion, even an intruder would be caught. It was almost impossible for someone to make it through the layers of security to their resting area.
So, their vigilance wasn't very high.
He could see some of these captain-level guards resting in their rooms, while others were on the phone or had brought women to their rooms. He could even hear strange sounds occasionally.
After a moment, he finally reached the end of the second floor.
What he didn't anticipate was that the captain who had brought a woman back with him turned out to be the head guard of the Collier family.
The head guard's room was right next to the end of the floor. Moreover, as a Black-rank martial artist, his hearing was exceptionally keen. He should have been able to hear anyone passing by.
However, today, the head guard's attention was entirely focused on the seductive woman. He didn't notice that Connor had secretly made his way to the end of the negative second floor.
Reaching the end, he gently pushed open a door.
He initially thought that the door might require a password or something similar.
However, to his great surprise, the door wasn't locked at all. He effortlessly opened it.
Upon opening the door, he descended the stairs to the third floor.
Upon arriving on the third floor, he felt much more at ease. His main purpose in coming here was to test the Collier family's security measures. By now, he had a general understanding of the security situation.
As for actually entering the secret chamber, he believed it wouldn't be that simple. After all, such secret chambers usually required a password or fingerprint.
As expected, he walked along the corridor for about ten meters, and a large iron door appeared before him.
He briefly examined the door. Because the secret chamber had been constructed fifty years ago, there were no advanced fingerprint locks, just a password lock.
He took out the miniature camera he had prepared and found a very discreet location to place it, directly facing the password lock. This way, whenever Albert used the password to enter the secret chamber, Connor would know the code. This would allow him to find another opportunity to enter the chamber.
His main goal in coming this time was to place the camera while also observing the structure of the secret chamber.
As the saying goes, the most dangerous place is the safest place.
As long as Connor could safely leave the Collier family mansion today, no one would likely discover that he had planted a camera here.
After placing the camera, he intended to leave.
However, just as he was turning around, he suddenly noticed a crack in the iron door in front of him. He could even see light coming from inside.
"Could this door be open?"
His expression held a hint of surprise. Without hesitation, he walked up to the door and pressed his ear against it, but he didn't hear any sound.

chapters.title: Chapter 1607: There's One More Person
chapters.content:
Chapter 1607: There's One More Person
After hesitating for a moment, Connor felt that this might be an opportunity given to him by fate.
After all, if there really was someone inside the secret room, it would definitely be Albert.
And since he wasn't a martial artist, Connor could easily handle him.
If there was no one inside, then it would be even easier for Connor. He could just enter the secret room directly, instead of waiting until another time.
So, he cautiously pushed the iron door.
As he had guessed, the door was actually open.
His emotions were extremely excited as he slowly opened the iron door and walked into the secret room.
Upon entering the room, he found that the lights were on, but there was no one present.
"Could Albert have forgotten to close the door?" he murmured in confusion, then took steps further into the room.
Inside the secret room, he noticed several cabinets containing various kinds of documents.
He picked up a few documents and glanced at them, realizing that they were all related to the Collier family's business, and the contents were quite astonishing. Most of them were records of secretive business transactions.
"I never thought that the Collier family would be involved in arms trafficking..." he sighed softly. "If I were to expose all these documents, even the Collier family might not be able to handle it!"
However, Connor had no deep-seated grudge against the Collier family. He had come here today solely to retrieve Yaakov's backup hard drive, so he wasn't interested in these documents and had no intention of taking them with him.
After flipping through the documents, he finally found a place where the hard drives were stored.
Looking at the dozens of hard drives on the table, Connor's expression became one of frustration. He had no idea which one was Yaakov's.
Initially, he had considered taking all the hard drives with him. However, after some thought, he realized that if he took just one hard drive, the Collier family wouldn't notice within a short period of time.
After all, they wouldn't bother searching for the hard drive unless they needed it to deal with Yaakov. Even if it was lost, it would take some time for them to notice.
So, after a moment of hesitation, he took the hard drives to the computer and began trying them one by one.
But to his surprise, all these hard drives contained evidence of crimes committed by influential individuals.
"I never expected that the Collier family would possess evidence of so many powerful figures' crimes. No wonder their business has thrived so much. If they can control these people, even ordinary individuals wouldn't dare to provoke the Collier family!" he whispered in amazement.
A few minutes later, Connor's expression turned anxious.
He knew that a hacker could control surveillance systems for at most an hour, and after that, the surveillance would return to normal.
It had already been over half an hour since he entered the Collier family's premises. If he continued wasting time like this, he might not be able to leave even after finding the hard drive.
So, he started moving faster.
After trying seven or eight hard drives, he finally found the backup hard drive belonging to Yaakov.
Upon confirming that the contents of this hard drive contained evidence of Yaakov's crimes, his expression turned excited. He placed the hard drive into his clothes and returned the other hard drives to their original places.
With the hard drive in hand, he considered his mission accomplished and turned to leave the room.
"Click, click, click..."
However, at that moment, Connor suddenly heard footsteps.
He hesitated for a moment and then hurried to the door, gently closing the iron door and pressing his ear against it.
He could hear footsteps and faint voices.
"It seems someone is coming..." His expression was one of helplessness. He realized that if he were discovered, he wouldn't be able to leave safely.
So, after a brief hesitation, he rushed to stand in front of a cabinet and opened its door.
As he opened the door, he was utterly surprised.
Because what he didn't expect was that there was another person inside the cabinet – a woman, to be precise.
The woman was exceptionally beautiful, with delicate features that were breathtaking.
However, the woman's expression was tense as she looked at Connor.
He felt that he recognized this woman from somewhere and then remembered seeing a photograph of a little girl when he entered the mansion. The girl in that photo should be the same woman standing before him now.
"Is this woman from the Collier family? Why would a member of the Collier family hide here?"
His expression was puzzled.
By now, he had realized why he was able to enter the secret room so easily.
The door to the secret room had been left unlocked not because Albert forgot to lock it, but because the woman had entered before Connor. She had forgotten to lock the door.
The woman's presence in the cabinet was likely due to her hearing Connor open the door and hiding there to avoid being discovered.
Instinctively, he wanted to close the door and hide in another cabinet.
However, just at that moment, he heard the sound of someone entering the password from outside. Without further thought, he directly entered the cabinet.
Seeing Connor enter, the woman's expression was a mix of surprise. But at this point, she didn't dare make a sound.
The cabinet wasn't very spacious, and there was already one person inside. After he entered, they were squeezed closely together with barely any space.
The woman seemed as though she wanted to say something.
"The person outside is about to come in. I have no other choice. If you don't want to be discovered hiding here, don't make any noise!" he whispered to the woman.
After hearing his words, the woman quickly closed her mouth.
A few seconds later, the iron door was pushed open from the outside.
Both Connor and the woman in the cabinet held their breaths, not daring to make any sound.
However, due to the limited space inside the cabinet, and also to ensure that the cabinet door wasn't accidentally opened from outside, his body was pressed against the woman's body.
The woman had a great figure, and he could even catch the scent of a faint fragrance.
Although he felt quite comfortable, the woman beneath him was feeling a bit uncomfortable.
After all, being pressed by Connor like this was making it difficult for her to breathe.

chapters.title: Chapter 1608: Aida Collier's Plan
chapters.content:
Chapter 1608: Aida Collier's Plan
And as Connor looked at the woman inside the cabinet, his expression was filled with confusion.
He knew that this woman should be from the Collier family, but why would she be here? Could it be that she wasn't actually from the Collier family?
A series of questions swirled in Connor's mind, but he realized that now wasn't the time to consider these questions.
His immediate concern was how to deal with the incoming individuals.
The limited space inside the cabinet and the presence of two people made the situation challenging. Staying in the cabinet for an extended period could lead to a shortage of oxygen, and more importantly, the security system would soon return to normal, which could be fatal for Connor.
The Collier family's mansion was full of experts, and if he were discovered, his chances of escaping alive were slim to none.
Although he could potentially be rescued by Rachel, he wouldn't be able to take Yaakov's hard drive with him. By then, the Collier family would likely have relocated the evidence, making it much harder for Connor to locate the hard drive.
So, his mind was occupied with thoughts on what to do next.
The woman beneath Connor had an even more unpleasant expression.
This woman was Albert's daughter, Aida Collie.
Aida's presence here today was to retrieve a crucial piece of information. This information was likely related to the succession of the Collier family's future head.
Despite being a girl, Aida's business acumen was on par with any of the male members of the Collier family. Unfortunately, both Albert and Beau had never considered Aida a potential successor due to her gender. Instead, they had focused on grooming her younger brother, Cielo, as the heir.
However, Aida and Cielo were half-siblings from different mothers.
Aida's mother had died at the hands of Cielo's mother, which drove Aida to strive for revenge and become the head of the Collier family. Once she became the head, she planned to use her power to deal with Cielo and his mother.
Even Albert, Aida's father, was a part of her revenge plan.
Aside from Aida herself, no one else knew about her true intentions.
Last month, someone had used evidence of Cielo's crimes to extort five billion from Albert. Albert's men retrieved the evidence, and the blackmailer didn't survive.
Instead of destroying the evidence immediately, Albert stored it in the secret room.
So, Aida's plan was to retrieve this evidence and hand it over to the police. This would result in Cielo being imprisoned, and Aida would naturally become the legitimate heir of the Collier family.
Aida's plan was seamless. She had waited for a long time to learn the secret room's password and even employed a beautiful woman to seduce the head of Collier family's security team. Everything had gone smoothly.
However, before Aida could find evidence against Cielo, she heard footsteps.
Assuming it was Albert arriving, she had no choice but to hide in the cabinet to avoid detection.
To her surprise, the person who entered wasn't Albert but an unfamiliar young man.
Although Aida knew Connor was here to steal, she didn't dare come out of the cabinet. Getting involved would only bring trouble.
Unfortunately for her, the situation took an unexpected turn – the man actually opened the cabinet she was hiding in and intended to hide in it himself.
At this point, Albert had entered the secret room with a few of his men. His companion, Andreas, was responsible for some of the Collier family's hidden business dealings, and they were engaged in conversation.
As Aida glanced up, their postures were highly ambiguous. Aida could even sense Connor's body heat.
Never having been in a romantic relationship before, Aida had never been so intimately close to the opposite sex. Being pressed by a stranger in this way made her wish she could kill Connor.
Aida used her gaze to convey to Connor not to touch her body.
However, the limited space in the cabinet meant that if Connor moved, the people outside would likely notice.
Naturally, Aida refrained from moving as well. If she were discovered by Albert, she wouldn't know how to explain herself, and her plan could fail.
In the meantime, Connor was being extremely cautious even in his breathing, as he feared being discovered.
He also silently prayed for Albert to leave quickly.
"How did the last business negotiation go?"
Albert's voice echoed.
"Brother, rest assured. The money from the other party has been received, and I've already coordinated with higher-ups. We just need to hide the goods in the cargo ship. There shouldn't be any issues!" Andreas replied.
"Excellent. Just be cautious with this matter. After all, it's our first trade. If it continues successfully in the long term, it will greatly benefit our Collier family!" Albert said with satisfaction.
"I understand..."
Andreas nodded slightly.
Following this, Albert and Andreas continued to discuss business matters. The conversation was explosive, and Connor was stunned by the revelations. Aida wore an equally surprised expression; these were things she had no knowledge of.
"I brought you here this time mainly to retrieve the information on Cielo..."
Albert whispered.
Aida's expression showed excitement upon hearing this. This was her goal for today.
"Brother, are you planning to have me destroy this evidence against Cielo?"
Andreas hurriedly asked.
"That's right!"
Albert nodded gently and continued, "I've thought it over. I still want Tianyi to inherit our Collier family's legacy. Keeping these things here poses risks. It's better to destroy them directly!"
Andreas looked at Albert without saying a word.
"Do you have any objections to Cielo inheriting the Collier family's legacy?"
Albert inquired when he saw Andreas's silence.

chapters.title: Chapter 1609: Breathing Problem
chapters.content:
Chapter 1609: Breathing Problem
"Brother, do you want to hear my honest thoughts?"
Andreas asked.
"Of course!"
Albert replied casually.
"Cielo is indeed capable, and I don't see any major issues with him inheriting the position of family head in the future. However, his personality is a bit too arrogant. This might be influenced by his mother's upbringing. I'm concerned that his character could become his weakness in the future, just like what happened this time. I'm not sure if it might happen again."
Andreas said calmly.
"Ah..."
Albert let out a sigh after hearing this, then murmured softly, "Yes, but I can't find a more suitable candidate than Cielo at the moment..."
"What about Aida?"
Andreas hurriedly asked.
"Both in terms of character, ability, and even working style, I admire Aida very much. But she's a girl. If she were a boy, I'd definitely choose her. Unfortunately, she's a girl. Eventually, she'll get married. I don't want the Callier family's legacy to end up in the hands of an outsider..."
Albert said calmly.
Upon hearing Albert's words, Andreas let out a helpless smile and whispered, "If that's the case, then we can only choose Cielo!"
Connor had assumed that the conversation would lead to them leaving, but to his surprise, the two started discussing other matters.
Both Connor and Aida were at a loss. The confined space inside the cabinet made breathing difficult, especially as time passed. At first, they thought they could manage, but as time went on, it became increasingly uncomfortable.
Connor felt like he was suffocating, and he noticed that Aida was struggling as well. With her face pressed against the inside of the cabinet, she couldn't move her head to reach the opening. While Connor had managed to get a bit of fresh air when he opened the cabinet earlier, it wasn't enough for Aida.
Feeling on the verge of suffocating, Aida instinctively lifted her small hand, intending to open the cabinet. But he quickly grabbed her wrist and used his legs to pin down her thighs, preventing her from moving.
If she opened the cabinet at this point, his efforts would be in vain.
However, he knew that she couldn't hold on much longer. Suffocation could lead to frantic movements and, consequently, noise. Albert and Andreas would surely notice if someone was inside the cabinet.
Connor's face showed a conflicted expression. He wasn't sure how to handle this situation.
Though he did his best to restrain the woman, he realized that she might not be able to endure much longer. Her struggles were growing stronger, and if she continued, the people in the room would likely discover them.
The woman was likely part of the Callier family, so if she were found, it wouldn't be a big problem. However, if Connor were discovered, his situation would be dire.
He kept pondering how to resolve the issue of the woman's breathing. After hesitating for a moment, he thought of a solution.
"Sorry..."
He sighed inwardly and gently pushed the cabinet door open with his left hand.
With the door open, he positioned his head by the opening, taking a deep breath before closing the door again.
Initially, Aida had a glimmer of hope when she saw the door open, but her expression turned desperate when he closed it once more. She instinctively struggled even harder.
However, he lowered his head and pressed his lips against hers. In that instant, she was stunned. She never expected that, at a time like this, he would dare to kiss her.
But she quickly realized her misunderstanding. He had blown the air he had taken in into her mouth. Immediately, she felt better, the suffocating sensation alleviating.
Despite the relief, she was still angry. After all, she had never had such an intimate encounter with the opposite sex before. Being the eldest princess of the Callier family, she had received the finest education and had grown up in privilege. This had led her to become proud and high-minded. She even aspired to become the future head of the Callier family. Consequently, she had high standards for her future husband. He had to be better than her and even surpass Albert in excellence.
Due to her high standards, Aida had never been in a romantic relationship, and she didn't look at the many eligible bachelors in York with any seriousness. She considered most of them to rely on their family connections for their achievements. Once they lost that backing, they might be worse off than ordinary people.
Thus, her selection criteria for a partner were quite strict.

chapters.title: Chapter 1610: Discovered
chapters.content:
Chapter 1610: Discovered
However, Aida never imagined that her first kiss would be stolen by a stranger like this.
Instinctively, she tried to pull away, but when she felt the oxygen from Connor's mouth, she hesitated to break free. With her breathing on the verge of suffocation, the air Connor blew into her mouth alleviated the near-suffocating feeling.
So, Aida uncontrollably breathed in the oxygen that Connor offered.
In the moment of kissing her, Connor could clearly feel that her lips were incredibly soft and carried a faint fragrance that was quite pleasant.
After a few seconds, the oxygen he had taken in was depleted. He had to open the cabinet door again and take in more air. When he felt his breathing stabilize, he took a deep breath and kissed her lips again.
This time, her response wasn't as intense as before. She understood that he did it to save her.
Inside the hidden room, Albert and Andreas seemed to be considering leaving.
Knowing that they were about to leave, Connor's expression visibly relaxed.
Aida gently pushed him, hinting that she was struggling to breathe.
Helpless, he used his hand to push the door open a little.
Perhaps because Albert and Andreas were about to leave, Connor was less cautious this time. Inadvertently, his arm pressed against Aida's breast.
Which she let out a soft moan instinctively.
When Connor heard this sound, his expression changed instantly. He hadn't expected this woman to be so sensitive.
He didn't know that she had never been touched in that area before. Thus, when he accidentally applied pressure, she couldn't help but make a noise.
Aida's expression turned tense after her accidental moan. She realized she had done something wrong, though she didn't even have the time to consider that Connor had acted inappropriately moments before.
Just as Albert was about to leave, both he and Andreas froze when they heard Aida's noise. They turned their gaze toward the cabinet.
"Who's there?"
Albert shouted expressionlessly.
Connor and Aida held their breath, not making a sound.
"Who's inside? Come out now!"
Albert yelled again.
Connor's brain raced. He knew he had been discovered, and he pondered how to deal with the situation.
Andreas swiftly walked to the door and pressed the alarm button.
Sirens blared loudly.
The security personnel throughout the Collie family's mansion immediately went into high alert mode.
Due to the room's sensitivity, even if alarms were ringing, regular guards wouldn't be allowed to enter. They could only seal off all exits to prevent the intruder from escaping.
Footsteps echoed.
The chief security officer, accompanied by two squad leaders, rushed into the hidden room.
In this unique situation, the chief security officer had the authority to enter. He needed to ensure the safety of both Albert and Andreas.
After entering, the chief security officer seemed highly anxious. He turned to Albert and asked, "Mr. Albert, what's happening?"
"Bill, what kind of chief security officer are you? Someone broke into the hidden room, and you didn't know?" Albert scolded with anger, furrowing his brows.
"Somebody broke in?"
Bill Johnson was dumbfounded by Albert's words. His expression showed disbelief because he had no knowledge of someone entering the hidden room.
"Bill, do you even want to continue being the chief security officer? There's someone in the cabinet!" Andreas also shouted.
"Mr. Albert, I apologize, I will handle this matter properly!" Bill said with extreme nervousness.
After all, the hidden room was the most crucial location in the Collie family's mansion. Bill's primary responsibility was to ensure the safety of the room. That's why his living quarters were situated near the entrance to the hidden room.
However, today Bill had been infatuated with a woman, which caused him to lower his guard.
But he never thought that this one-night stand could lead to such a significant incident.
Bill took a deep breath and approached the cabinet. Despite being a martial artist, he pulled out a handgun to be prepared. He pointed it at the cabinet and said in a low voice, "Who's there? Come out now, or I'll shoot!"
Upon hearing Bill's words, Connor's expression turned helpless. He knew he had been found out, so he decided not to continue the charade. He took a deep breath and slowly stepped out of the cabinet.
When Albert and Andreas saw Connor, their expressions turned puzzled. They had never seen Connor before and had no idea who he was.
Furthermore, he was dressed in a security guard's uniform.
"Is this person from your security team?" Albert turned to Bill.
"He's not one of ours!" Bill shook his head without hesitation.
Although the Collie family had many security guards, Bill, as the chief security officer, needed to approve the recruitment of each new guard. He could tell at a glance that Connor wasn't part of their team.
"Who are you? What are you doing in our Collie family's hidden room?" Albert frowned and questioned Connor.
"Um, I think I got lost..." Connor explained helplessly.
"Lost?"
Albert sneered upon hearing Connor's words.
"There's someone else in the cabinet, come out!" Just at that moment, Bill suddenly yelled.
Upon hearing Bill's words, Aida's expression turned desperate. She had hoped that Connor's exit might divert attention away from her and keep her from being discovered.
But she hadn't expected Bill to be so perceptive, even sensing her presence inside the cabinet.
Realizing that she had no choice but to come out, Aida stepped out of the cabinet.
"Why are you here, Aida?" Albert's expression turned puzzled when he saw Aida, while Bill also looked dumbfounded.
The sight of her hiding in a cabinet with a stranger was quite surreal.
Both Albert and Andreas looked at her, seemingly awaiting an explanation.

chapters.title: Chapter 1611: Reaching An Agreement
chapters.content:
Chapter 1611: Reaching An Agreement
Aida's expression became helpless as she stood in her original spot. At this moment, she wasn't sure how to explain the situation.
Meanwhile, Connor's face displayed an extraordinary sense of astonishment. He hadn't anticipated that the woman before him was none other than Aida, the well-known Princess Aida from the Collier family.
When Connor had been researching information about the Collier family, he had taken note of Aida.
Externally, she was often described as deeply calculating, possessing astonishing methods, and being as cunning as any male member of the Collier family.
Initially, she hadn't been given much attention within the Collier family. Upon returning from studying abroad, due to her stepmother's suppression, she had to manage industries that the Collier family had already abandoned. Among them, the most famous was perhaps the Collier family's Hilton Grand Hotel.
This hotel had originally been a project the Collier family had forsaken. Aida's stepmother, who was Albert's current wife, had handed over the hotel to Aida to make things difficult for her. She had even demanded that within three years, Aida turn the hotel's losses into profits.
Ordinary people saw this task as impossible. Everyone within the Collier family understood the situation and was reluctant to offer any assistance to Aida, even going as far as avoiding her.
However, what no one had expected was that Aida managed to achieve the seemingly impossible in less than two years. She transformed the decaying Hilton Hotel into one of the top luxury hotels in York. Many international elites and A-list celebrities even made it a point to stay at this hotel. The hotel's annual profits now reached billions.
But that was just the beginning. Aida went on to perform many more miracles. Eventually, she earned Albert's recognition, gaining an important role within the Collier family.
Combined with Aida's stunning looks and her frequent attendance at various business events that often caught the attention of paparazzi, she had become the public face of the Collier family. Stories of her accomplishments spread like wildfire across the internet.
So, when Connor learned of this woman's identity, his reaction was quite understandable.
However, Connor couldn't quite grasp why, given Aida's high status within the Collier family, she would sneak into this secret chamber discreetly. She could have entered openly, after all.
But Connor's mind wasn't focused on pondering this right now. He understood that the only way for him to leave this place was through a single method.
He took a step forward and embraced Aida, pressing a dagger he had found on one of the security guards against her delicate, fair neck.
Understanding Aida's esteemed position within the Collier family, Connor realized that Albert wouldn't easily let her go. His only escape route was to kidnap Aida and use her as leverage to threaten the Collier family.
Of course, Connor had also considered kidnapping Albert earlier, not knowing Aida's true identity.
But kidnapping Albert at this point was extremely difficult. Albert was far from Connor's reach, and with Jiang Biao, a martial artist at the Profound Stage, by Albert's side, the chances of Connor getting close were minimal.
Yet, Aida's sudden appearance had solved this problem for Connor. She was the public face of the Collier family, managing many of their businesses. And more importantly, she was Albert's daughter. Connor believed that Albert wouldn't easily give her up.
"Let go of Aida!"
As anticipated, Albert's expression turned tense when he saw Connor kidnapping Aida.
"Heh, I'll release this woman if you let me leave this place first!"
Connor responded calmly.
Aida hesitated for a moment, then shouted coldly at Connor, "Let me go quickly! Earlier, you coerced me into bringing you here. You're surrounded now, and you have no chance of escaping. If you surrender now, you might suffer a little less. Otherwise, your fate is sealed!"
Connor was taken aback by Aida's words.
He hadn't coerced Aida into coming here; in fact, she had arrived before him. Clearly, Aida was remarkably quick-witted, shifting all the blame onto Connor and avoiding the need to explain why she was in the secret chamber. Her plan would remain hidden.
Connor gave Aida a casual glance but didn't expose her. It seemed that Aida and Connor had reached an unspoken understanding.
Albert's eyes glared as he angrily yelled, "Release my daughter now!"
Albert understood that the security system of the Collier family mansion was notoriously strict. Yet, someone had managed to breach it and kidnap his daughter. If this news spread, the Collier family's reputation would be tarnished.
Furthermore, Albert valued Aida greatly, and his expression was now marked with intense anger.
"Suffer? Death might be more fitting."
Upon hearing Albert's words, Connor couldn't help but chuckle before responding calmly, "As long as I can leave here, I'll naturally release this woman…"
"Who are you?"
Albert, somewhat calmer now, asked Connor in a hushed voice.
"Do you think I would tell you who I am?"
Connor retorted in response to Albert's question.
"You managed to infiltrate our Collier family and abduct Xiaowu. This shows your skills are not to be underestimated. However, let me remind you, you're surrounded now, and you have no chance of escaping!"
Albert warned in a low tone.
"Without this woman, I might not be able to escape. But with her, your judgment means nothing!"
Speaking calmly, Connor kept the dagger pressed against Aida's neck. He added, "If any of you dares to make a move against me, I will kill her first. Try me if you don't believe it!"
Jiang Biao narrowed his eyes, observing Connor. He knew that Connor was also a martial artist, making him unwilling to take a reckless risk. If Connor really felt cornered and killed Aida, things would become complicated.
"Kid, I advise you to release my daughter as soon as possible!"
Albert's anger had subsided slightly. He called out to Connor in a low voice.
"I'm not in the mood to chat with you all right now. I suggest you cooperate and let me leave this place. Otherwise, I'll really kill this woman!"
Connor told Albert and the others in an unusually calm manner.

chapters.title: Chapter 1612: Sniper
chapters.content:
Chapter 1612: Sniper
"I would make you wish you were dead if even a single strand of my daughter's hair is harmed!"
Albert's voice strained with anger as he shouted at Connor.
"Well, I'd like to see if you have the capability!"
Connor understood that people like Albert only responded to force, so he moved his right hand slightly.
Instantly, the sharp dagger sliced across Aida's fair neck, and blood began to flow slowly down her neck.
