Connor's mood was extremely tense at this point. After all, he had never killed anyone before, and he didn't know how much force to use to intimidate Albert without harming her.
"Stop! Stop it now!"
Albert turned nervous, and shouted urgently.
"Frightened?"
Connor asked him with a smile.
"What do you want, exactly?"
Albert's eyes were red with anger as he yelled at Connor.
Upon hearing this, he chuckled softly and replied calmly, "Didn't I make myself clear earlier? If you release me, I'll release your daughter. If you don't let me leave, I'll have no choice but to use her as a shield before I die. I'm just an ordinary person. If having the Collie family's young miss accompany me in death is an option, I think it's worth it..."
Albert glared at him with anger filling his eyes. At this moment, he seemed unsure of how to proceed.
Albert was aware that Connor breaking into the secret chamber was motivated by some hidden agenda. Perhaps Connor had already acquired what he was after. If he released Connor now, it could result in significant losses for the Collie family. On the other hand, if he didn't release Connor, Aida's safety would be compromised.
Albert was torn between the interests of the Collie family and the safety of Aida.
After a moment, he took a deep breath and said in a low voice, "Alright, I'll agree to your terms. Just stop hurting Aida..."
"Changing your mind?"
Connor smiled at him.
After hesitating for a couple of seconds, Albert gritted his teeth and said, "I'll go along with your conditions. Just don't hurt Aida anymore..."
"If you'd said that earlier, we wouldn't be in this mess. You're wasting my time here."
Connor retorted with a slight grin. He then held onto Aida and spoke, "Miss Aida, I apologize for the inconvenience. I'll need your help a bit longer..."
She didn't say anything as she looked at him. After all, he had just resolved a big problem for her, and she had no other options but to cooperate.
As Connor and the others distanced themselves a bit, he turned to Aida and said in a low voice, "Miss Aida, I've done you a big favor today, so I hope you can help me out as well."
She frowned upon hearing this, but she didn't say much. She had no choice now.
During the journey, Connor remained alert, as he wasn't sure if the Collie family would become desperate.
The security personnel from the Collie family were all highly skilled, and even though he was holding her, he couldn't afford to let his guard down.
After about ten minutes, he finally exited the Collie family's villa.
Taking a moment to survey his surroundings, he realized that the front of the Collie family estate was an open area. Walking into that space would be dangerous, as he knew the Collie family likely had snipers positioned at vantage points. Exposing himself in an open area would make him an easy target.
Standing at the villa's entrance, he didn't continue forward.
Seeing him stop, Albert's expression turned puzzled, and he asked with a furrowed brow, "Why aren't you leaving?"
"If I'm not mistaken, if I take two more steps forward, a sniper will probably blow my head off, right?"
He smiled and said to Albert.

chapters.title: Chapter 1613: A Terrifying Thing
chapters.content:
Chapter 1613: A Terrifying Thing
After hearing Connor's words, Albert was taken aback, and his expression seemed incredulous. He hadn't expected Connor to be so astute, even knowing about the snipers they had prepared.
"Since I was able to break into your Collie family's secret chamber, that means I'm not a fool. I advise you to be more honest, or your daughter might lose her life," Connor whispered to Albert.
"What exactly do you want?"
Albert clenched his teeth and asked in a low voice.
"Get me a car!"
After thinking for a moment, Connor said.
Albert glanced at him and took a deep breath before saying, "Go get a car ready for this person!"
After a while, a black Mercedes-Benz stopped right in front of Connor.
"I've prepared the car for you. Can you let go of my daughter now?" Albert asked him.
"Not yet!"
Connor shook his head.
"What do you want, then? I've fulfilled your conditions. Don't force me to do something I'll regret!"
Albert yelled angrily, his eyes wide with fury.
"I'm not forcing you. The thing is, I don't know if you've tampered with the car. Plus, I'm not completely safe yet. I've said it before, as soon as I'm truly safe, I'll release your daughter. Otherwise, I won't let her go," Connor replied, his expression calm.
Albert gritted his teeth, staring at Connor with a mixture of anger and frustration. He had never been threatened like this before.
Deep down, Albert had a strong affection for Aida. Therefore, he was unwilling to gamble with her life when it came to dealing with Connor.
"Let this woman get in the car with me. Once I reach my destination, I'll naturally release her. You can rest assured that Miss Aida and I have no grudges. As long as you don't interfere, I won't harm her. If you decide to take action, then I can't guarantee what will happen!" Connor grinned and addressed Albert.
Albert didn't respond, as he had no other choice at the moment. After all, his daughter's life was in Connor's hands.
Connor opened the door of the Mercedes-Benz and had Aida sit in the driver's seat. He then moved to the passenger's seat, ensuring that Aida remained under his control.
Once she was seated in the passenger's seat, he quickly got into the car and closed the door.
"Vroom!"
After getting into the car, he stepped on the gas pedal forcefully, and the car sped towards the outskirts of the Collie family estate.
In a matter of seconds, Connor disappeared from Albert's sight.
After seeing him vanish, Albert's expression turned furious.
"Mr. Albert, what should we do now?"
Bill asked in a low voice.
"What else can we do? Hurry and chase after him with your men. Find a suitable opportunity to kill him. This person absolutely cannot be allowed to live!" Albert gritted his teeth and shouted.
Upon hearing this, Bill swiftly gathered his men and began driving towards the direction Connor had disappeared.
Meanwhile, Albert remained standing in place, his expression extremely grim.
"Brother, don't worry. I don't think that person will harm Aida," Andreas offered a comforting word.
"My concern isn't about that issue. I'm worried that this person will escape alive," Albert replied in a low voice. He continued, "This person already entered the secret chamber earlier. That indicates he must have seen the materials we kept in there. He might have even taken those materials. If those documents were to leak, the consequences would be unimaginable."
Clearly, Albert's greater concern was the potential leakage of sensitive information.
Although he was worried about Aida's safety, he cared more about the confidential documents stored in the secret chamber.
"You know Bill's capabilities. I believe he can handle that person," Andreas reassured him.
"But this person was able to breach the secret chamber, which implies he came prepared. Come with me to the secret chamber and see if anything is missing," Albert suddenly realized something was amiss and quickly headed towards the secret chamber.
Andreas followed closely.
A few minutes later, both Albert and Andreas were back inside the secret chamber.
"Andreas, start sorting from that end, and I'll start from this end," Albert said in a hushed voice.
"Alright!"
Andreas nodded subtly.
The two of them began to carefully examine and organize the materials in the secret chamber.
After about ten minutes, Andreas looked at Albert and said, "Brother, I have all the documents here."
"But I'm missing a hard drive," Albert said in a low voice.
"A hard drive? Which one?" Andreas asked with a puzzled look.
"The one belonging to Yaakov," Albert replied.
"Could Connor be connected to Yaakov?" Andreas's expression displayed astonishment.
"Can't be certain. I made an arrangement with Yaakov a while ago. If he could help me with overseas business, I promised to return that hard drive to him. Yaakov has been continuously dealing with overseas business matters, so he couldn't possibly have sent someone to steal the hard drive at this time," Albert shook his head.
"If this person isn't linked to Yaakov, then maybe they want Yaakov to face trouble," Andreas analyzed in a hushed tone.
"Bang!"
Albert slammed the table hard, his expression furious. Clenching his teeth, he yelled, "If Yaakov finds out that the hard drive has been stolen, the consequences would be unimaginable!"
For so many years, the Collie family had controlled Yaakov using that hard drive, leveraging its contents for various favors. Due to the hard drive's existence, Yaakov hadn't dared to defy Albert's wishes.
However, if he discovered that the hard drive was no longer in the possession of the Collie family, he would undoubtedly seek immediate retaliation against them.
And there was an even more terrifying aspect, many documents in the secret chamber bore signs of being tampered with, indicating that Connor had likely seen their contents. If he had copied those documents, it would be extremely dangerous for the Collie family.
In that moment, Albert felt a sense of suffocation. The potential consequences of this situation were truly horrifying. If not handled properly, it could lead to complete disaster for the entire Collie family.

chapters.title: Chapter 1614: An Unforgettable Day
chapters.content:
Chapter 1614: An Unforgettable Day
"Absolutely cannot let him live, this person must die!"
Albert clenched his teeth and roared angrily, then took out his phone and dialed Bill's number.
"Ring ring..."
After two rings, Bill answered the call.
"Have you caught up with that person?"
Albert asked in a low voice.
"Sir, we are currently tailing that person. However, he hasn't shown any intention to stop his car yet. We're waiting for the right opportunity. Rest assured, he won't get away today!"
Bill quickly replied.
"Good!"
Albert nodded lightly and continued, "Bill, no matter what price you have to pay, you must kill this person for me today. He must not leave alive. Moreover, you need to bring his body back to me. Do you understand?"
"Sir, this might be quite difficult..."
Bill hesitated and replied.
"Why?"
Albert asked in a low voice.
"Miss is still in that person's hands..."
Bill answered.
"This person took the hard drive from the secret room and even looked through a lot of documents. If this information leaks out, the impact on the Collie family would be terrifying. So even if we have to sacrifice Miss, we must retrieve the items and kill this person. Do you understand what I mean?"
Albert gritted his teeth and shouted in an excited tone.
After hearing his words, Bill hesitated for a moment and then said in a low voice, "Sir, I understand your intent."
"Hang up."
Albert replied curtly and hung up the phone.
Andreas, with an expressionless face, watched Albert in silence without saying a word.
For Albert, giving up on Aida was indeed a painful decision. Yet, he had no other options left now.
He had always held deep affection for her. If not for the fact that she was a woman, she would have been the rightful successor to the family leadership.
Even considering her gender, he had contemplated passing on the family leadership to her, contingent on her finding a suitable partner. However, Aida had no intention of marrying anyone, especially not the wealthy men of York, which led him to select Cielo instead.
Nevertheless, she was undoubtedly the most suitable candidate for the family leadership position.
But now, he had no other choice. With Connor having taken away Yaakov's hard drive and seen the family's confidential documents, a mismanaged situation could bring calamity to the entire Collie family.
A decision was forced to choose between Aida and the Collie family?
He could only choose the Collie family and let go of her.
"Andreas, do you think my decision this time is right?"
He turned to Andreas, looking at him and asked in a hushed tone.
"I don't know..."
Andreas shook his head slightly.
"If you were in the same situation, what choice would you make?" he continued to ask.
"I might make the same decision as you. After all, in this situation, we can't afford to lose."
Andreas hesitated for a moment and answered.
"There's one thing I can't figure out. How did that person enter the secret room?"
He furrowed his brow and said.
"Perhaps Miss brought him in."
Andreas replied.
Albert was momentarily taken aback by the response and then walked towards the entrance of the secret room.
However, neither Andreas nor Albert were aware that Connor had entered the secret room without examining other documents. He had come for Yaakov's hard drive.
Meanwhile, he was driving away from the Collie family's estate, heading straight for downtown York. He was still tense because he knew he wasn't completely safe yet. Bill and his men were closely tailing him in their modified vehicles. Although he was speeding and constantly changing his route, he couldn't shake off his pursuers.
He was not only racing against Bill's group; he also had to keep an eye on Aida. He knew that she was not an ordinary hostage, and he couldn't predict her actions.
Earlier, he had used his dagger to cut her neck. Though the bleeding had stopped, her clothes were stained with fresh blood.
Sitting in the passenger seat, her expression was unusually grim.
"Miss Aida, I advise you not to play any tricks with me. There must be a reason for your presence in the secret room today. If you don't want Albert to know you were there before me, then pray that I can shake off these people. Only when I'm safe can you be safe!"
Connor said to Aida.
"Why did you come to the secret room?"
She asked calmly, looking at him.
At this moment, she didn't seem like a hostage. Her tone resembled that of a boss talking to a driver.
"Why did you come to the secret room?" he retorted.
"I asked you first."
She paused and continued, "I am here to steal something."
"I'm here to steal something too."
Connor chuckled softly and added, "Stealing from one's own family is quite interesting."
"You're lucky today. Without me, you wouldn't have left the estate." she continued.
"Your luck is good too. Without me, I suppose your thieving plans would have been exposed?" he retorted.
Aida looked Connor up and down and asked, "What's your name?"
"Connor," he answered.
"I'll remember your name. Today is a day I'll never forget in my life."
Aida paused for a moment and continued, "I've grown up without anyone ever harassing or hurting me. Yet today, you violated me and harmed me."
"I didn't intend to violate you. I did it to save you." he replied helplessly.

chapters.title: Chapter 1615: Worthless!
chapters.content:
Chapter 1615: Worthless!
At this point, Connor didn't want to waste too much time talking to Aida. After all, he needed to focus on dealing with Bill and his pursuers.
Connor was continuously searching for the right opportunity to shake off Bill's pursuit.
"No matter what, you violated me and harmed me," she whispered.
Connor glanced at Aida without saying anything.
He thought that she was indeed very beautiful, but he also knew that she was dangerous. According to the information he had, she had a high IQ and employed ruthless methods. Her deep cunning was terrifying; in York, almost no one dared to offend her. Sometimes, Aida was even scarier than Albert.
On the other hand, her brother, Cielo, was utterly useless compared to her—a world of difference.
"Are you saying all this to tell me that you want revenge?" he asked her in a hushed tone.
"That's right. I will definitely seek revenge on you in the future, so you better be cautious!" She calmly nodded.
"Why are you telling me all this? Your life is in my hands right now. I can kill you anytime," he said with a hint of indifference.
"You won't kill me. You're just a thief. You don't have the courage to kill me. Besides, killing me wouldn't benefit you in any way," she stated.
After hearing this, Connor's expression revealed surprise. He hadn't expected Aida to be so shrewd, to see through his true intentions.
Indeed, he had no intention of killing her. There was no real enmity between him and the Collie family. His intrusion into the Collie residence was to deal with Yaakov. Only under dire circumstances would he be willing to take a life.
"You probably haven't killed anyone before, have you?" she asked him in a soft tone.
"How do you know?" he asked, taken aback by the question.
"Because when you were hurting me earlier, you were very cautious. You had no idea how much force to use to hurt me without killing me, while still being able to threaten Albert. So, I believe you haven't killed anyone," she said calmly.
Connor's expression displayed surprise upon hearing Aida's words. He hadn't anticipated her to be so observant.
Taking a deep breath, he whispered, "Miss Aida, I hold no grudge against you. I didn't want to hurt you, let alone kill you. If I manage to get away safely today, I'll release you. As for your desire for revenge, it doesn't matter to me. I'm not afraid of retribution from your Collie family. Naturally, I'm not afraid of yours either."
Aida glanced at him and didn't continue the conversation, as if pondering something in her mind.
...
Meanwhile, inside the car Bill was in, there were only three people. Bill sat in the passenger seat while the driver was Hardik Sheah, the captain of the Collie family's security team. The third person was Gary Horton.
These three individuals were among the most formidable members of the Collie family's security personnel.
Although Bill knew that Connor was a martial artist, he believed that if the three of them joined forces, killing him would be relatively simple.
"Boss, something's not right. This Connor seems to be heading toward the downtown area!"
Hardik, who was driving, exclaimed excitedly.
"Downtown?" Bill's eyebrows furrowed upon hearing this.
Bill was acutely aware that if Connor drove into the downtown area, attacking him would become much more complicated. With numerous people around, they wouldn't have the convenience to deal with Connor. Additionally, the urban environment was more complex than the outskirts, making it challenging to eliminate Connor once he was there.
"Boss, what should we do now?" Hardik asked with a puzzled expression.
"Can we catch up?" Bill asked in a low voice.
"We can't catch up..." Without hesitation, Hardik shook his head and continued, "Connor's driving skills are excellent. Even though his car isn't as good as ours, he keeps changing routes, making it impossible for us to catch up."
"Worthless!" Bill muttered under his breath after hearing this, then immediately ordered, "Stop the car!"
"Stop?!" Hardik's expression turned puzzled upon hearing this command.
"That's right, stop the car quickly!" Bill urged.
Reluctantly, Hardik brought the car to a halt.
Bill then pushed open the door, took the driver's seat, and Hardik occupied the passenger seat.
He was far better at driving than Hardik. It only took him a few minutes to catch up with Connor's Mercedes.
Upon seeing his car catching up, Connor's expression revealed a touch of surprise. Despite following him for such a long time without closing in, they now seemed poised to overtake him. This indicated that someone else was driving their vehicle.
Connor attempted to accelerate to shake off his pursuers, but Bill's superior driving skills made it impossible for Connor to evade them, no matter how fast he accelerated.
Suddenly, his car shook violently.
Bill's car had rammed into the back of Connor's vehicle.
"Ah!" Aida exclaimed, her head hitting the windshield.
"What kind of driving is this!" She held her head in her hands and glared at him indignantly.
"It was your people from the Collie family who rammed into us!" he retorted in a low voice.
Upon hearing his response, she sat still for a moment, her expression seemingly surprised.
At first, Bill and his team had merely been tailing Connor without taking any direct action. But now, they had actively launched an attack on him.
"You're no longer of any value now!" he sighed softly and continued, "Bill knows you're in my car, but he still chose to attack, which suggests that the Collie family might have abandoned you. You're lucky to have encountered me. If it were any other kidnapper, you would probably be dead by now..."
After hearing his words, she couldn't help but pause. She was an intelligent woman, so naturally, she could discern what was happening.
However, what surprised her was that Albert had given up on her so quickly!

chapters.title: Chapter 1616: A Gamble
chapters.content:
Chapter 1616: A Gamble
At this moment, a sense of disappointment spread across Aida's face. After taking a deep breath, she fell silent.
"Brace yourself, they're coming again..."
Connor suddenly spoke up.
Upon hearing this, Aida grabbed onto the handrail without hesitation.
"Bang!"
A loud noise resounded.
Bill's car once again crashed heavily into the back of Connor's car.
The vehicle shook violently.
Although Connor's Mercedes had good quality, Bill's car had been extensively modified. After enduring two collisions, Bill's car remained unscathed—its appearance unchanged. However, Connor's car had started to deform, with the wheels misaligned, causing his speed to decrease.
"If they keep ramming us like this, we'll both die in this car..." he said.
Upon hearing this, Aida's expression turned helpless. She didn't know what to say at this point.
"I thought I might be able to survive with your help, but I didn't expect Albert to be this ruthless. He's even disregarding his own daughter..."
Gritting his teeth, he continued.
Aida's expression turned exceptionally ugly. She hadn't anticipated this outcome. Her life was now tied to Connor's—if he survived, she might have a chance, but if he died, she would likely perish as well.
"Now, what's your plan?" she asked in a low voice.
"What else can I do? I'll try to drive to a crowded area. With more people around, they won't dare to go too far," he replied helplessly.
He realized that he had made the wrong choice. If he had exchanged the hostage and brought Albert out, the situation wouldn't be so dire.
"Bang!"
Right at that moment, Bill's car once again collided forcefully with his vehicle.
This time, the damage seemed even worse. He knew he might not be able to make it to the downtown area. If his car took another hit, it might become completely unusable.
"We can only take a risk now..."
Connor's expression turned resigned as he sighed, then he made a turn and parked the car by the roadside.
In front of him was a large square. However, since it was nearing midnight, and this area was not part of the downtown, very few people were around. But he had no other options left.
"Miss Aida, you might have to cooperate with me a bit more," he said in a low voice.
"How do you want me to cooperate?" she asked.
Connor reached for the door handle, opened the door, and stepped out of the car. Afterward, he pulled her out of the vehicle and held her close, a dagger pressing against her slender and fair neck.
She looked at him with resignation but didn't resist.
Taking a deep breath, he silently awaited the arrival of Bill and his men.
At this point, he knew his car was completely ruined. It could stall at any moment, or if it didn't stall, it might be rendered immobile by the impact of Bill's car. That's why he had stopped the car and brought Aida out with him.
Now, he was gambling. He wanted to see if Albert truly intended to abandon his daughter.
He couldn't believe that Albert could be so heartless, to disregard even his own daughter's life.
A few seconds later, Bill's car also pulled over by the roadside.
Bill, Hardik, and Gary got out of the car.
The expressions on these three faces were still tense. They didn't know what Connor was planning, so they had to keep a close eye on him.
Bill's gaze was ice-cold as he looked at Connor. He had suffered substantial losses due to Connor's appearance.
After all, he was the captain of the security team, and Connor's intrusion into the secret room was his failure. Therefore, he would be held accountable for this. But if he could kill Connor, Albert might not be too harsh in his punishment for the incident.
Connor was also assessing him. He could sense that Bill wasn't an ordinary person. At the very least, Bill's aura seemed unfathomable, indicating that his cultivation might be advanced.
"Why aren't you running?" Bill assessed Connor with a cold glance and spoke in a low voice.
Connor took a deep breath and replied expressionlessly, "What do you mean?"
"Don't you know what I mean?" Bill retorted coolly.
"I've said it before. As long as I can leave safely, I'll release this woman. But it seems like you have no intention of letting me go," Connor continued.
Upon hearing Connor's words, Bill couldn't help but sneer, then he calmly stated, "Kid, are you a bit too naive? When you intruded into the secret room, you entered Chen's forbidden territory. From the moment you entered that room, you were as good as dead!"
"Aren't you afraid that I'll kill this woman? If you keep following me, I'll kill her right now!" Connor shouted loudly.
Bill looked at Aida helplessly, but didn't say anything.
His attitude made it clear that Albert had genuinely given up on Aida.
Bill didn't want this outcome, as his relationship with Aida had been quite good. If he could save her, that would be the best option. However, if he couldn't rescue her, there was nothing he could do. He was just the captain of the security team, obligated to follow Albert's orders.
Since Albert had decided to abandon Aida, Bill had no choice either.
"Are you planning to abandon this woman?" Connor asked Bill in a low voice.
Taking a deep breath, Bill looked at Aida and said, "Miss, this man took something very important from the secret room. Therefore, Mr. Albert has ordered us to kill him at all costs."
"And you don't care about my life?" Aida asked expressionlessly.
"Miss, this is Mr. Albert's command. I am just following orders," Bill said helplessly.

chapters.title: Chapter 1617: A Fight About To Erupt!
chapters.content:
Chapter 1617: A Fight About To Erupt!
After hearing Bill's words, Aida's expression became one of despair.
She had never expected Albert to truly abandon her.
"Miss, please don't blame me. After all, I'm just following orders. Besides, the item this person took is incredibly important. If he were to leave alive with it, it could put the entire Collie family in danger. So, Mr. Albert had to make this choice, sacrificing you to save the rest of the Collie family," Bill explained further to her.
"Sacrifice me to save the Collie family?" She chuckled bitterly after hearing his words. Her expression was filled with helplessness, unsure of what to say.
Originally, Aida had felt some pressure about confronting Colie and Albert's actions. After all, he was her half-brother, and she had received decent treatment from Albert over the years.
However, hearing Bill's explanation only reinforced her thoughts. She now believed that Albert had no real affection for her. He regarded her as a mere tool. Her life or death didn't matter much in his eyes.
Her mother had been abandoned in a similar manner in the past.
And now, the same thing was happening to her.
If the roles were reversed, if it was Colie instead of her, she was certain Albert wouldn't abandon his own son.
At this point, Aida had made up her mind. If she managed to survive today, she was determined to avenge her mother by getting rid of Colie, Albert, and the others.
"Hardik, Gray, take action!" Bill decided not to waste any more words and shouted expressionlessly.
After hesitating for a moment, Hardik and Gray advanced toward Connor's position.
Since Albert had given up on Aida, they had nothing to worry about anymore. They could simply use the quickest and simplest method to eliminate Connor. As for whether he would harm her, it was no longer their concern.
Seeing Hardik and Gray slowly approaching, Connor's expression turned helpless. He realized he had underestimated Albert.
Albert was truly devoid of humanity, even abandoning his own daughter.
He glanced at Aida with a helpless look. At this point, she was no longer of any use to him.
Under normal circumstances, kidnappers would likely kill Aida directly.
But he hadn't chosen to harm her. There was no enmity between them, and he didn't want to take innocent lives.
He gently released his hold on her and quietly said, "Go, you're no longer needed here."
"Aren't you going to kill me?" She hesitated and asked him softly.
"Why would I kill you? We don't have any grievances between us." He shook his head.
After a brief moment of hesitation, she unexpectedly hugged him.
Seeing this scene, Bill couldn't help but be taken aback. He couldn't understand why she was hugging Connor.
Later on, he assumed that she was probably thanking Connor for sparing her life.
Connor, on the other hand, was puzzled by her actions.
"If you manage to leave here alive, I hope you'll keep my secret. Also, I won't let you off the hook!" she whispered in a voice only audible to them.
"I'm sparing you, and you still want revenge on me?" he sighed helplessly.
"That's a different matter," she replied calmly before letting go of him and walking toward a distance.
A moment later, she reached the area behind Bill and the others. However, she didn't seem intent on leaving. She wanted to see if Connor would survive today.
Meanwhile, Connor kept a blank expression as he stared at Hardik and Gray.
A confrontation was about to erupt!
"It's commendable that you're willing to let Miss Chen go. Now I'll give you a chance. If you surrender and hand over what you've stolen, I'll go easy on you," Bill, surprised that Connor had released Aida, shouted at Connor.
"Do you really think you can kill me today with such confidence?" Connor coldly chuckled.
"Pouring wine without drinking any oneself and forcing others to drink is unfair. Today, I'll show you my strength!" Hardik shouted, charging directly toward Connor's position.
If Connor were only facing Hardik and Gray, with the assistance of the Chi Recieving Pills, he could easily defeat them.
However, the biggest obstacle was Bill. He was a genuine Profound Realm martial artist and his strength might even surpass that of Rachel. Dealing with these three wouldn't be so simple for Connor.
Moreover, Connor couldn't use firearms in this location. If he did, the police would undoubtedly arrive soon, escalating the situation even further.
Hardik mobilized his internal energy, then roared and charged toward Connor's position.
Hardik's fist technique was quite ordinary, but its power was astonishing. Aided by his internal energy, it was akin to a cannonball hurtling forcefully toward Connor.
At this point, Connor couldn't afford to be careless. He immediately popped a Chi Recieving Pill into his mouth.
After swallowing the pill, Connor felt an immensely powerful energy surging through his body.
At this moment, Hardik was less than five meters away from Connor. However, Connor remained standing still in his place, as if he had no intention of dodging.
Seeing Connor's lack of evasion, a smug expression appeared on Hardik's face. He was confident in the power of his punch and believed that if it landed on Connor, he would surely be unable to withstand it.
"Bang!"
Suddenly, at this critical moment, Connor unleashed a punch toward Hardik's position.
Their fists collided with a deafening noise.
But what surprised Bill and the others was that after the collision, Connor remained motionless in his spot, while Hardik was sent flying backward.
Hardik's body flew through the air for nearly five meters before crashing heavily onto the ground.

chapters.title: Chapter 1618: Death Is Certain
chapters.content:
Chapter 1618: Death Is Certain
"This guy is so strong?"
Bill looked at Connor's position with an extremely surprised expression and muttered to himself.
"What kind of fist technique is that?" Hardik, struggling to stand up, excitedly shouted at Connor.
"Seven-Star Big Dipper Fist," Connor calmly replied.
Hardik appeared puzzled by Connor's expression and seemed to be unfamiliar with the set of moves Connor had used.
Just then, Gray rushed toward Connor's position.
Upon seeing him approach, Connor's expression turned somewhat disdainful.
He raised his fist and swung it toward Connor's head, but Connor reacted swiftly, sidestepping to easily dodge Gray's punch.
He hesitated for a moment, then prepared to launch another attack on Connor.
However, Connor didn't give him a chance for a second strike. He struck back with his palm, slapping his face.
Gray felt his vision darken and his entire body was sent flying.
"Bang!"
A loud sound rang out.
Gray's body crashed heavily onto the ground.
Upon witnessing this scene, Bill's expression turned angry.
He realized he had underestimated Connor. He couldn't believe that Connor, despite his young age, possessed such terrifying strength.
"This guy is actually so powerful?"
Aida's expression turned shocked as she observed Connor's position.
At this point, she finally understood why he had dared to infiltrate the secret room of the Collie family. His strength was indeed astonishing.
"Young man, I underestimated you just now," Bill stepped forward and said quietly to him.
Connor looked at Bill without saying a word.
"I didn't expect someone so young to possess such formidable power. It's quite unbelievable. Unfortunately, today, you will still die by my hands!" Bill continued.
"You're this confident that you can kill me today?" Connor coldly chuckled.
"Whether I can kill you or not, I won't know until I try..." Bill replied calmly.
Upon hearing Bill's words, Hardik and Gray understood that Bill intended to take action himself. Therefore, the two of them ceased their attack on Connor and retreated behind Bill.
Bill advanced toward Connor's position, each step carrying a heavy air of pressure.
He stared at Bill, observing his every move.
Taking a deep breath, Bill activated his internal energy and swiftly charged toward Connor's position.
Bill's strength was indeed terrifying. In an instant, he closed the distance between them, then swung his right hand, releasing a dark aura toward Connor's location.
He was a Black-rank martial artist, far beyond the capabilities of Hardik and Gray.
The dark aura flew directly toward Connor. He instinctively extended his arms to shield his chest, attempting to block Bill's attack.
"Bang!"
A deafening sound echoed as the dark aura collided with Connor's arm.
His body was immediately sent flying through the air, sliding for about seven or eight meters before crashing onto the ground.
His expression was one of shock. He hadn't anticipated Bill's strength to be so overwhelming. Despite having taken the Chi Receiving Pill, he couldn't withstand Bill's attack.
Nonetheless, his current realm was already close to that of a Black-tank martial artist. Therefore, the impact of the Chi Receiving Pill on his power was limited.
"It's an honor for you to die by my hand," Bill said coldly.
Connor slowly stood up and looked at him without saying a word.
Observing Connor's expression, Aida seemed nervous. She apparently didn't want to witness Connor's death.
Connor took a deep breath and reached for a Chi Receiving Pill.
However, Bill wouldn't give him the opportunity to consume the pill. He swung his right hand again, sending another dark aura toward his arm. The Chi Receiving Pill fell from him hand to the ground.
Connor's expression turned to despair.
"You're just an ordinary martial artist. When facing Hardik and Gray earlier, you must have consumed some kind of elixir to defeat them so effortlessly. But now, you lack the aid of that elixir. You're doomed today!" Bill had already seen through Connor's secret of taking the Chi Receiving Pill. He coldly spoke to Connor.
At this point, Connor was utterly hopeless. The gap in strength between him and Bill was insurmountable. He had no chance of winning.
"Click, clack..."
Bill walked forward toward Connor's position.
After hesitating for a moment, Connor turned and attempted to escape.
At this point, all Connor could do was flee. If he stayed and confronted Bill head-on, death was inevitable.
However, Bill wasn't going to allow Connor to escape. He swung his hand again.
Another dark aura struck Connor's back, causing his body to be sent flying once more before crashing heavily onto the ground.
Connor struggled to stand, but he felt pain all over his body, unable to muster any strength.
No matter how hard he struggled, Connor couldn't stand up.
"It's over," Bill sneered. In an instant, he dashed toward Connor's position.
In the blink of an eye, Bill had reached Connor. Without hesitation, he raised his right hand and swung it toward Connor's head.
Upon witnessing this scene, Aida couldn't bear to watch. She closed her eyes, knowing that it was the end.
Bill was ruthless and cruel. In this situation, he wouldn't give Connor any chance.
Connor stared at Bill before him, his expression full of despair.
There was no escape. Bill's strength was too terrifying. In fact, he was even more formidable than any Profound Realm martial artist Connor had encountered. Connor had no chance to resist before Bill.
Bill's fist, accompanied by a sharp whistling sound, was about to strike Connor's head.
"Whoosh!"
However, at this critical moment, a cold light flashed by.
Bill's expression turned strange, and he quickly retracted his right hand. A dagger flew past him.

chapters.title: Chapter 1619: The Mysterious Woman
chapters.content:
Chapter 1619: The Mysterious Woman
"You actually have backup?"
Bill looked at Connor on the ground and couldn't help but ask in a low voice.
"Help?"
Upon hearing his words, Connor's expression displayed confusion because he had no idea who could be helping him.
Only Rachel knew that Connor was at the Collie family today, but she probably wasn't aware of his current location.
Even if she knew, she wouldn't be a match for Bill. If she were to come out now, it would be like throwing herself into danger.
"Tap, tap, tap!"
Just then, the sound of high heels tapping the ground echoed.
Connor instinctively turned his head to look.
He saw a seductive figure slowly approaching from a distance.
Soon, he could clearly see the appearance of this figure.
It was a woman, and he had never seen her before.
The woman was tall, wearing high heels that brought her height to nearly 1.8 meters. She had a sexy and attractive figure, wearing a black hip-hugging skirt and crystal high heels. Her makeup was exquisite, her appearance aloof and proud. At this moment, she held a warrior's knife in her hand.
The blade of the knife gleamed coldly under the light, emitting a bone-chilling radiance.
The woman walked gracefully in her high heels toward Connor's location. She gave off an aura that made her seem like an assassin from a movie—sexy, aloof, and oozing with a deadly aura.
He had never seen this woman before and had no idea who she was.
"Who are you?" Bill also seemed unfamiliar with the woman and asked her in a low voice.
"The one who will kill you!" The woman didn't waste any words. She raised the warrior's knife in her hand and charged toward Bill's position.
Meanwhile, Connor lay on the ground, stunned. He didn't recognize this woman, and he didn't know her intentions. Yet, she had saved him, and he felt like he was in a dream.
The woman hadn't revealed her identity since she appeared and had immediately engaged in combat with Bill.
He could sense that the woman was also a martial artist with terrifying strength. After clashing briefly with Bill, the sexy woman showed no sign of weakness.
"Who are you? Why are you meddling?" Bill shouted at the woman with an extremely agitated expression.
After all, Bill was about to kill Connor just now. If this woman hadn't appeared, he would have completed his mission already.
The woman didn't bother answering him. She swung the warrior's knife in her hand and lunged toward Bill's head.
Bill quickly stepped back two paces and then swung his right hand.
Two sharp auras, resembling poisonous snakes, flew toward the woman's position.
The woman's expression appeared somewhat disdainful. She lightly swung the warrior's knife, and Connor could sense a blinding light flashing as the woman effortlessly deflected the two auras.
Seeing this scene, Bill's expression turned to shock. He hadn't expected the woman's strength to be this terrifying.
After parrying the auras, the woman charged directly toward Bill, delivering a succession of strikes with her knife.
At this point, Connor struggled to stand and leave the area. After all, he didn't know this woman and couldn't be of much help by staying. He might as well seize the opportunity to escape.
However, due to Bill's previous fierce attack, Connor felt as if every bone in his body was broken. He couldn't move at all.
Therefore, after struggling a few times, Connor gave up, looking at the woman and Bill's positions.
Connor pondered the woman's identity in his mind, but he couldn't remember who she might be.
"Could it be that Rachel sent someone to help me? But then, why isn't Rachel here?" Connor wondered inwardly.
As he was racking his brain, the unexpected woman and Bill's battle intensified.
Although Bill's combat strength was formidable compared to Connor, he was nothing in front of this woman.
Consequently, the woman faced little pressure while dealing with Bill.
"What are you two standing there for? Hurry up and help!" Bill realized he was no match for the woman and shouted at Hardik and Gary, who weren't far away.
Upon hearing Bill's words, Hardik and Gary charged toward the woman's position.
Meanwhile, Bill turned to run toward Connor.
At this point, Bill's plan was simple. He knew he wasn't the woman's match, and even if the three of them teamed up, they still wouldn't stand a chance. He intended to let Hardik and Gary delay the woman for a bit while he killed Connor. Afterward, he would find an opportunity to escape.
However, before Bill could even reach Connor, Hardik and Gary had already fallen.
The two were nothing before the woman's might and couldn't even put up a fight.
Seeing Bill approaching Connor, the woman's expression appeared somewhat disdainful. She lightly swung her right hand.
The warrior's knife in the woman's hand flew toward Bill's position.
Connor felt as if a cold light had flashed by.
"Splurt!"
The warrior's knife directly pierced through his back.
He stood frozen in place, slowly turning his head to look at the woman behind him.
With a swift motion, the woman stepped forward and reached him. She pulled out the knife from his body.
A glint of the blade.
The woman swung the warrior's knife, cleanly severing his head. Blood sprayed out immediately.
The woman's movements were exceptionally smooth, as if she were performing a trivial task.
After beheading Bill, the woman took out a clean handkerchief and wiped the blood from the blade.
Both Connor and Aida were stunned by this scene.
Connor was slightly better off, as he had witnessed killings before.
Aida, on the other hand, was a different story. She was shocked to the point of trembling uncontrollably. Nevertheless, she managed to maintain consciousness. If it were any other girl, they might have fainted already.

chapters.title: Chapter 1620: You're Not Worth This Money
chapters.content:
Chapter 1620: You're Not Worth This Money
After wiping the blood off the blade of the warrior's knife, the woman turned her head and asked in a soft voice, "Are you Albert's daughter?"
"Yes!"
Aida forced herself to appear composed and replied in a low voice.
"You can go. I'm not here to kill you!"
The woman said calmly.
Aida hesitated for a moment upon hearing this statement, but without further delay, she turned and ran into the distance.
After a while, she had completely disappeared into the night.
Now, the square was only left with Connor, the unfamiliar woman, and the bodies of Bill, Hardik, and Gary.
Connor struggled to stand after hesitating for a moment. He looked at the woman and said, "Thank you for saving me earlier. Are you the helper Rachel sent?"
"Rachel?"
The woman paused upon hearing his question and then shook her head lightly. "I don't know this person."
"You're not the helper Rachel sent? Then who are you?" he continued to ask.
"It's none of your concern who I am."
The woman's voice was icy cold in response.
Connor looked at the woman with a helpless expression. He found her behavior extremely strange. Although she had just saved him, she wasn't willing to reveal her identity.
Taking a deep breath, he said in a low voice, "Fine, regardless of the circumstances, you saved my life. Thank you. I'm leaving now."
At this point, he didn't want to waste any more time with the woman. He wanted to leave this troublesome situation as soon as possible. If the Collie family's members caught up to him, things would become even more complicated.
"Save you?" The woman couldn't help but chuckle upon hearing his words. Then, she said in a soft voice, "I think you might be misunderstanding. I'm not here to save you. Not only will I not save you, but I also just killed someone in front of you. Now, I'm planning to kill you as well."
After saying this, the woman lightly waved her right hand, pointing the warrior's knife at his head.
He was instantly dumbfounded, standing in place with a bewildered expression. He couldn't believe that the woman wasn't here to save him and that she was planning to kill him.
"No, miss, what's going on here? Weren't you helping me just now?" Connor exclaimed with excitement.
"Of course not. I don't know you, so why would I help you?"
The woman knew that he was seriously injured and wasn't worried about him escaping.
"Then why did you kill Bill?" he asked, looking at the woman.
"I'm an assassin. Someone paid me to kill Bill. I've been waiting outside the Collie family's villa for many days. Today, I finally caught him outside, so I killed him. As for what happened between you and Bill, it has nothing to do with me. I never intended to help you!"
The woman explained calmly.
Connor was left speechless upon hearing the woman's explanation. He had thought that the woman was sent by Rachel to help him. When she killed Bill earlier, he had breathed a sigh of relief. However, he couldn't have anticipated that the woman wasn't sent by Rachel and that she had no intention of helping him.
Taking a deep breath, he said, his tone agitated, "Well then, miss, you and I have no enmity, and your target isn't me. Can you spare me? I promise I won't tell anyone about this..."
"No, I can't!"
The woman answered directly.
"Then why did you spare Aida?" Connor's eyes widened, his expression agitated.
"Because she's Albert's daughter. The Collie family is not to be trifled with. I don't want to provoke them," she explained calmly.
"Then how can you spare me?"
He took a deep breath and asked the woman in a soft voice.
"Give me a reason not to kill you," she replied.
He hesitated for a moment, then said, "My name is Connor McDonald..."
"I don't care who you are."
The woman interrupted him.
He was left speechless.
Originally, he had thought that this woman was Rachel's reinforcement, so he had been relieved when she killed Bill. However, to his astonishment, the woman wasn't sent by Rachel, and worse, she intended to kill him.
"I'll give you one more minute. If you can't provide me with a reason not to kill you, I'll take action."
The woman's voice turned ice-cold.
"Wait a moment!" he hurriedly shouted at the woman.
The woman looked at him with an impatient expression, furrowing her brow. "What do you want now?"
"You mentioned that you're an assassin, right?" he asked the woman.
"Yes!" She nodded lightly.
"Since you're an assassin, someone must have paid you to kill Bill, right?" he continued to inquire.
"Yes!"
The woman nodded again.
"In that case, how about this? I'll pay you. Whatever amount you were paid to kill Bill, I'll offer you the same amount to spare me. Just give me a bank account number, and I'll have someone transfer the same amount to you immediately!"
Connor spoke earnestly to the woman.
The woman glanced at Connor up and down, then said calmly, "You're not worth that much money. Give me ten million, and that will suffice."
"You're being a bit unreasonable, don't you think? Why am I not worth eight million? Who decided that?" Connor protested.

chapters.title: Chapter 1621: The Hard Disk Is Missing
chapters.content:
Chapter 1621: The Hard Disk Is Missing
"A rookie like you might not even be worth ten million!" the woman said.
When Connor heard this, he was instantly speechless. He quickly took out his phone and dialed Thomas Morgan's number.
A few minutes later, Connor asked Thomas to transfer 10 million dollars to the woman's bank account.
The woman did not continue to attack Connor, instead turning around and preparing to leave.
"By the way, what's your name?"
Connor shouted at the woman's back.
"You don't need to know!" the woman replied indifferently.
"Since you're an assassin, does that mean that as long as I give you money, you can help me kill people?"
Connor asked again.
"I don't accept any mission. I only kill those who deserve to die!" the woman replied.
"Why don't you leave me your contact information? If I have business in the future, I can contact you..."
Connor shouted.
When the woman heard Connor's words, she smiled disdainfully and turned around to leave.
After Connor saw the woman leave, his expression seemed a little helpless. He sighed and said, "What a freak!"
After saying this, Connor limped to the side of the road, then pulled open the door and got into Bill's car.
As for the bodies of Bill, Hardik, and Gary, they had nothing to do with Connor, so Connor didn't deal with them. He knew that the Collier family would deal with the bodies of these three people when they found out that Bill and the others were dead.
After getting into the car, Connor drove straight back to the Wallace family.
When Rachel saw Connor, her originally hanging heart finally relaxed. She said excitedly, "Connor, you are finally back. I was prepared to confess to my grandfather just now…"
"I ran into some trouble. Fortunately, I didn't die at the hands of the Collier family!" Connor replied in a low voice.
Rachel felt that Connor seemed a little off and asked with a nervous expression, "Are you hurt?"
"It shouldn't be a big problem. I'll be fine after resting for a few days. The bodyguard captain of the Collier family is indeed powerful…"
He replied in a low voice.
Rachel helped Connor to the bedside and then asked, "What exactly happened?"
Connor briefly sorted out his thoughts and then told Rachel what had happened.
"Who is this woman? Why did she kill Bill?"
After Rachel knew what had happened, the expression on her face seemed a little puzzled.
"I don't know who this woman is either. I have never seen her before. I feel that she's very strange…"
Connor said in a low voice.
"..."
Rachel hesitated for a moment before saying, "Perhaps you are lucky. If you had not coincidentally met this woman, you would have died at the hands of that Bill…"
"Yeah, my luck is really good today. If it weren't for Aida Collier being in the secret room, I wouldn't have been able to enter it, and I wouldn't have been able to escape!"
Connor lightly nodded.
"Did you get the thing?"
Rachel asked.
"I got it…"
Connor reached into his clothes.
However, a few seconds later, his expression changed, and a strange look flashed across his eyes.
"What's wrong?" Rachel asked.
"..."
Connor didn't answer Rachel's question. Instead, he took off his clothes.
"Why are you taking off your clothes?"
Rachel frowned and shouted.
Connor still didn't pay attention to her. He turned his clothes upside down and inside out, but he still couldn't find the hard drive.
"It's over, the hard drive is gone…"
Connor said in despair.
"What?"
After Rachel heard Connor's words, she was stunned on the spot. The expression on her face was also very surprised.
Connor sat by the bed with a helpless expression on his face. He didn't expect that the hard drive he had spent so much effort to get would be lost. He'd worked hard for nothing tonight.
"Did you lose it when you were running away?"
Rachel asked.
"No…"
Connor shook his head without thinking.
He had always been very careful with this hard drive. He could remember that it was still in his clothes when he got off the car, so this hard drive was definitely not lost by him.
Connor tried his best to retrace his steps in his mind.
When he got out of the car at the square, the hard drive was there, which meant that the hard drive should have been lost after he got out of the car.
"Aida Collier!"
Connor slowly said.
"What about her?"
Rachel asked in confusion.
"Aida hugged me when we were separated. I didn't understand why, but it seems that she stole my hard drive while she was hugging me…"
Connor gritted his teeth.
"..."
Rachel looked at Connor's expression, speechless. She pursed her lips and said, "Who are you? You fell for a simple honey trap…"
"What kind of a honey trap is this!"
Connor's expression was somewhat helpless, then he whispered, "This Aida is too despicable. I didn't even kill her, but she stole my hard drive…"
"Then what do you plan to do next?" Rachel asked.
Connor hesitated for two seconds before saying, "Aida must have had something to hide from Albert when she went to the secret room, so she doesn't want the Collier family to know that she went there. So I think even if Aida stole this hard drive, she won't give it to the Collier family. She must be planning to use this hard drive to make a deal with me, so the current situation isn't too bad yet. I can find an opportunity to meet Aida and see if she can return the hard drive to me…"
"Yes, Aida has no connection with Yaakov Ward, so there shouldn't be any use for this hard drive!"
Rachel gently nodded.
"Ugh, I spent the whole night trying to get a chance at a higher power, but in the end, it was all for nothing. This Aida is really too despicable!!"
Connor gritted his teeth and said in a low voice.
"It's already good enough that you came back alive. Your current situation isn't particularly bad, so you should rest well for the next few days and then look for an opportunity to meet Aida!"
Rachel said.
Connor hesitated for a moment before looking at her. "I might not be able to fight Yoel Wallace in my current state. Go and tell your grandfather!"
"Alright, I got it. Have a good rest!"
Rachel nodded, then turned around and walked out of the room.

chapters.title: Chapter 1622: A Meeting of the Collier Family
chapters.content:
Chapter 1622: A Meeting of the Collier Family
After Rachel left, Connor lay on the bed, but felt more and more angry the more he thought about the incident.
He had spent so much effort to survive from Bill, but in the end, Aida had stolen the hard drive.
"This woman is not a good person!"
Connor gritted his teeth and cursed in a low voice. Then, he closed his eyes and prepared to rest.
"Ding, ding, ding!"
But at this moment, Connor's phone suddenly rang.
When Connor heard the ringtone, he could not help but be stunned. When he looked over, he realized that it was Chelsea calling.
"Why is Chelsea calling me so late at night?"
Connor's expression was a little puzzled. Then, he picked up the phone and asked, "Is there anything you needed?"
Perhaps it was because of Aida that Connor's tone was rather brusque.
"Little Connor, who offended you?"
Chelsea asked sweetly.
"I'm fine. I'm just in a bad mood!" Connor replied in a low voice.
"What are you doing?"
Chelsea asked again.
"What else would I be doing? I'm getting ready for bed…"
Connor said speechlessly.
"Oh, okay!" Chelsea nodded gently and continued, "I have good news for you. Do you want to hear it?"
"Good news?"
When Connor heard Chelsea's words, he could not help but be stunned for a moment. Then, he frowned and asked, "What good news?"
"I'm going to celebrate my birthday in a few days…" Chelsea said with a smile.
After Connor heard Chelsea's words, his expression was abnormally speechless.
He really couldn't understand why Chelsea's birthday was good news for him.
"Happy birthday to you!"
Connor said, exasperated.
"It's your aunt's birthday, and that's the only thing you have to say? Aren't you a little too lacking in sincerity?" Chelsea shouted angrily.
"Then what do you want me to do?"
"Are you in York now?"
"Yeah, why?"
"What a coincidence! I'm also in York, and I'm going to have a birthday party the day after tomorrow. Come to my party, and don't forget to prepare a gift for me!"
Chelsea said.
"The day after tomorrow?"
When Connor heard this, he couldn't help but be stunned for a moment. Then, he hurriedly said, "Well, I might not have time the day after tomorrow—"
"Cut the crap. If you dare to not show up, you're dead meat. Consider this a warning…" Chelsea said coldly.
"Alright, I'll try my best to go over!"
Connor helplessly agreed and then hung up the phone.
…
Meanwhile, in the Collier family's villa.
Beau Collier sat in the middle of the meeting room with an ugly expression on his face.
Albert, Andreas, and the rest sat beside him.
At this moment, all the higher-ups of the Collier family had gathered together. Even the elders of the Heavenly Sect had come.
After all, the Collier family and the Heavenly Sect were one, so when Beau found out that someone had broken into the secret chamber, he immediately brought the elders of the Heavenly Sect back to the Collier family.
Aida told the Collier family what had happened in the meeting room. She blamed everything on Connor alone, and the Collier family did not suspect anything.
She went back to her room to rest after telling them what had happened.
After listening to Aida's story, Beau's expression turned even uglier. It had been so many years, but the Collier family had never had someone break into the secret chamber before.
What was even more unbelievable was that the three security guards of the Collier family had all been killed.
One had to know that Bill was the son of the third elder of the Heavenly Sect!
Therefore, this matter had a huge impact on both the Collier family and the Heavenly Sect.
Beau turned his head and glanced at Albert. He then asked in a low voice, "Have you investigated the identity of the person who broke into the secret chamber?"
"I've investigated it clearly. This person's background isn't small. His name is Connor McDonald, Steven Lee's heir, and he's also Jorge Yarrell's disciple!" Albert hurriedly replied.
"Jorge Yarrell's disciple?"
Beau's expression was a little shocked when he heard this. He then said in a low voice, "I didn't expect this person to be Jorge Yarrell's disciple. Why did he barge into our Collier family's secret chamber?"
"He took away Yaakov Ward's backup hard drive, which was full of evidence of Mr. Ward's crimes!" Albert replied.
"..."
Beau heaved a long sigh of relief after hearing this. He then said in a low voice, "Connor is Steven Lee's heir, so he wants to get Yaakov Ward's hard drive to deal with Yaakov Ward and Rockefeller. His real target isn't the Collier family, so this should be a good thing for us!"
"But Connor has already seen the information in the secret room. I'm not sure whether he took photos of this information. If this information is leaked, it will have a huge impact on our Collier family!" Albert said in a low voice.
"Connor is Jorge Yarrell's disciple. Jorge Yarrell had a big fight with Faris Jimenez in Honduria because of Connor. According to my understanding, Jorge Yarrell's strength surpasses mine, so the Heavenly Sect can't get involved in these things. Once we get involved, the Purple Cloud Sect and Jorge Yarrell will also get involved. This will be disadvantageous to us!" Beau analyzed.
"Father, how do you plan to deal with this matter?" Albert asked.
"Connor barged into our Collier family's secret room without permission and even stole something and kidnapped my granddaughter. We definitely can't let this matter rest like this. Otherwise, our Collier family will become a laughing stock in the eyes of the other large families. Since our Sky Yuan Sect can't do anything about this matter, then only you can handle this matter. Use our Collier family's connections to pressure Connor and see if you can get him to hand over the thing!"
Beau knew that it was unrealistic for them to kill Connor now. After all, he was Jorge Yarrell's disciple, so if they dared to kill him, then Jorge Yarrell would definitely wipe out the entire Collier family.
Therefore, Beau's current idea was to use other ways to pressure Connor so that he would take the initiative to hand over the item.
"Father, I feel that if we rely only on our connections to get Connor to hand over the thing, that would be a little unrealistic…"
Albert said in a low voice.

chapters.title: Chapter 1623: Testing Intentions
chapters.content:
Chapter 1623: Testing Intentions
"What do you mean?" Beau asked with a frown.
"Connor is Steven Lee's heir, and all of Steven Lee's connections were managed by Thomas Morgan. Thomas Morgan is very loyal to Connor, so his connections are very terrifying. Also, I heard that Connor has some connections with the Wallace family. He seems to have already gotten together with Rachel Wallace, for one."
Albert said in a low voice.
"The Wallace family?"
After Beau heard this, he could not help but be stunned for a moment. Then, he said indifferently, "They're nothing compared to us…"
"..."
Albert raised his head and glanced at Beau, his expression puzzled.
One had to know that the Wallace family and the Collier family's strength were about the same. Albert could not understand why Beau would not take the Wallace family seriously at this time.
"Although the Wallace family's strength is extremely terrifying, they're currently scattered like a plate of loose sand. Janson Wallace won't be able to live for long, so the current Wallace family members all have ulterior motives. Moreover, Rachel's position in the Wallace family is already very awkward…" Beau analyzed.
"That's right!"
Andreas nodded gently and continued, "I heard that the Wallace family has always wanted to marry Rachel off, but Janson Wallace has always disagreed. Therefore, I think that the Wallace family will not help Connor. In fact, they might even stand on our side and help us get rid of Connor. After all, if he falls, they can marry Rachel off to other big families and expand their strength!"
"Andreas, contact the Wallace family tomorrow and try to give them as many benefits as possible. I believe they will definitely stand on our side!" Beau instructed.
"Understood!"
Andreas hurriedly nodded.
"As long as the Wallace family doesn't care about this matter, Connor won't be able to go against our Collier family even with his connections. Even if he is Steven Lee's inheritor, this is York, and Steven Lee's connections are scattered all over the world," Beau said in a low voice.
"But I think there's one more person we need to pay attention to!"
Albert said with a frown.
"Who is it?"
"Chelsea Lee from the Lee family!"
Albert said in a low voice.
"Connor actually knows Chelsea Mee?"
Beau couldn't help but frown when he heard this.
"Connor and Chelsea shouldn't just know each other. I heard that Chelsea just gave her Heavens Club to him. The relationship between the two of them must be extraordinary. That club is worth billions; if they're only acquaintances, why would she give the Heavens Club to Connor for free?" Albert said in a low voice.
Beau's face was filled with shock.
"Then this matter might be a little troublesome!" Andreas said in a low voice.
"The Lee family that Chelsea belongs to could be considered one of the top families in York. Although they have fallen in recent years, they still have a strong base."
Albert paused for a moment before continuing, "Although Chelsea has lived in the Lee family since she was young, Chelsea and Joseph Lee are not related by blood. Moreover, Chelsea is very terrifying; her connections are even more terrifying than the Lee family's. I heard that she is also very influential overseas. Once Chelsea stands on Connor's side, it is very likely to affect our family's business overseas. In that case, our situation might be very bad..."
Beau's expression turned ugly when he heard Albert's words.
"Grandpa, Chelsea will be holding a birthday party the day after tomorrow. I'll attend her birthday party then. I can go and test her intentions!" Cielo suddenly said.
"Alright!"
Beau nodded lightly and continued, "Since Connor might have some relationship with Chelsea, we still have to be more cautious. Let Cielo go and test the situation on Chelsea's side first. If she chooses to help Connor, then we'll think of another way. If Chelsea's relationship with Connor is ordinary, we can directly make a move on him…"
"Understood!"
Everyone nodded.
"By the way, just now, I heard that Bill, Hardik, and Gary were killed by a mysterious person. Did you find out who this person was?"
Beau asked with a frown.
"We have not found out who this person is. However, since this person was able to easily kill Bill, it means that this person's strength must be extremely terrifying…" Albert said in a low voice.
"This person's background is definitely not simple. We have to investigate this person's identity and see who's behind them!" Beau said.
"Alright, I understand…"
Albert hurriedly nodded.
After all, the Collier family was planning to deal with Connor, so they had to understand Connor's situation clearly before making a move on him. Otherwise, if he had any trump cards that they did not know about, things would be very troublesome.
…
In the meantime.
Originally, Janson Wallace had planned to let Connor and Yoel have a martial arts competition. After all, Yoel was the strongest among the younger generation of the Wallace family. If Connor could defeat him, Janson would recognise him.
However, because of the battle between Connor and Bill, Connor was seriously injured and could not fight with Yoel at all. Therefore, Rachel discussed with Janson to postpone the battle for a few days.
Although the duel with Yoel had been postponed, Connor was not idle because Chelsea's birthday was coming up.
Connor originally did not plan to attend Chelsea's birthday party at all; he did not know any of Chelsea's friends, so a birthday party like this would be boring to him.
However, Connor couldn't find any reason to refuse. No matter what, Chelsea was still very good to him; she'd given the Heavens Club to him and helped him get the largest casino in Newtown at a very low price. Connor had seen all these things. No matter what conflicts the Lee family had with Connor, Chelsea was still very good to him.
Connor owed her a lot of favors now, so the least he could do was go attend her birthday party. Moreover, Connor happened to be in York, so it would be unreasonable if he did not go.

chapters.title: Chapter 1624: Birthday Gift
chapters.content:
Chapter 1624: Birthday Gift
However, what gave Connor a headache was that he had to attend Chelsea's birthday party and prepare a birthday gift for her.
Connor gave the matter a lot of thought, but really couldn't think of a suitable gift!
After all, a woman like Chelsea was different from ordinary women. If it was any other ordinary girl, Connor could spend more money to buy an expensive gift.
However, Chelsea did not lack money at all. She had plenty of branded bags and jewelry, and she did not care about these things.
Therefore, Connor felt that giving gifts to such women was the most troublesome thing.
If money could solve the problem, then it wouldn't be a problem to begin with!
Unfortunately, a woman like Chelsea could not be bought with money.
Connor originally planned to ask Rachel for advice, but later he thought about it and gave up on this idea because he knew that Rachel was different from ordinary girls. Chelsea might not like what Rachel liked, so even if he asked, it would be useless.
Connor lay on the bed and thought for a long time, but he still couldn't think of a suitable gift. However, he remembered that Vanessa and Chelsea's relationship was very good, so he could ask for Vanessa's opinion. After all, she definitely knew Chelsea better than did and would probably know what gift Chelsea would like.
Thinking of this, Connor took out his phone and dialed Vanessa's number.
…
Vanessa did not know what was wrong with her lately, but she always couldn't help but think of the things that had happened between her and Connor in her home.
Moreover, she would recall Connor's appearance in her mind. No matter how she diverted her attention, he wouldn't leave her thoughts alone. Therefore, Vanessa's mood had been very irritable recently, and she couldn't concentrate on her work.
Of course, there was another thing that made Vanessa even angrier: that Connor had not taken the initiative to contact her recently.
If it was before, she wouldn't feel anything wrong even if Connor didn't contact her for a month or two, but she did not know what was wrong with her. Connor had not contacted her for such a long time, yet she would get angry for no reason.
"Ding, ding, ding…"
Vanessa, who was doing her makeup, suddenly heard her phone ring. When she picked it up and looked at the screen, she saw that Connor was the one calling her.
When Vanessa saw his name, the expression on her face was a little proud, and her mood instantly became much better. "Looks like you still can't help but take the initiative to contact me…"
Vanessa didn't hurry to answer the call. Instead, she sorted out her emotions before pressing the answer button. Her tone was very calm as she said, "Hello?"
"Vanessa, what are you doing?" Connor asked with a smile.
"Nothing much. Why did you call me?"
"It's Chelsea's birthday tomorrow. Are you coming?" Connor asked.
"I won't be going. There are still many things to do in the clubhouse and casino!"
At this moment, Vanessa's mood was still very good. She felt that Connor wanted to see her, which was why he asked her if she wanted to attend Chelsea's birthday party.
"You're not?" Connor pretended to sound very regretful and then continued, "Well, Vanessa, you're Chelsea's best friend, so you should know her very well, right? What do you think I should give her for her birthday?"
Vanessa couldn't help but be stunned after hearing Connor's words, and then said in a low voice, "You called me to ask me what gift you should give Chelsea, is that so?"
"That's right!"
Connor lightly nodded.
Vanessa's expression changed after hearing this sentence. She didn't expect Connor to not care about her at all.
At this moment, Vanessa was like a completely different person as she spoke in a cold voice.
"Is there anything else? If not, I'm hanging up!"
"No, Vanessa, you haven't told me what Chelsea likes!" Connor hurriedly said.
"I don't know what Chelsea likes either. You can give her whatever you want. It has nothing to do with me!" Vanessa said coldly.
"No…"
Connor opened his mouth and was about to speak, but Vanessa hung up the phone directly.
After Connor saw that the phone was hung up, the expression on his face was a little helpless. Sometimes, he really couldn't understand what these women were thinking in their hearts. A second ago, Vanessa was still very gentle to Connor, but in the next second, it was as if she had changed into a different person.
Connor hesitated for a moment before calling her again. After all, among the people Connor knew, only Vanessa knew Chelsea, so she was quite literally the only one he could ask for advice.
"Ding, ding, ding…"
After the phone rang a few times, Vanessa finally picked up the phone again.
"Vanessa, was the signal bad just now? Why did you cut off the call?" Connor said with a smile.
"It's not that the signal is bad. I just chose to hang up!" Vanessa didn't bother hiding her intentions and replied bluntly.
"Uh..."
Connor was stunned when he heard Vanessa's words, an awkward expression on his face. "Erm, Vanessa, please help me. I know you have the best relationship with Chelsea. You must know what she likes…"
Connor begged.
After Vanessa heard Connor's words, she couldn't help but reveal a proud smile and said: "Do you really want to know what Chelsea likes?"
"Of course!"
Connor hurriedly replied without thinking.
"Chelsea likes perfume. If you really don't know what to give her, then give her perfume!" Vanessa said lightly.
"Perfume?"
When Connor heard this, he couldn't help but be stunned for a moment. Then, the expression on his face grew puzzled. "That's not right. Chelsea seemed to have told me that she had never used perfume before. How could she like perfume?"
Previously, Connor had always been curious about why Chelsea's body was so fragrant, so he asked her what perfume she used. However, she'd told him that she didn't need perfume at all. The fragrance on her body was her own natural musk.
Therefore, Connor still had some recollection of this matter.
"Do you know Chelsea better than I do?" Vanessa directly asked.
Connor couldn't help but be stunned when he heard her words, and then said in an awkward tone, "Then it must be because you understand it better. I don't mean anything else…"
"..."
Vanessa's expression was a little smug as she said, "It's true that Chelsea doesn't use perfume because her scent is already very fragrant. If she uses perfume, it will cover up her scent. However, just because Chelsea doesn't use perfume doesn't mean that she doesn't like it at all. Chelsea likes perfume very much and likes to collect it, so I think it's most suitable for you to give her perfume..."

chapters.title: Chapter 1625: Vanessa's Thoughts
chapters.content:
Chapter 1625: Vanessa's Thoughts
"That's great!"
The expression on Connor's face was a little excited, and then he hurriedly asked, "Then, Vanessa, what perfume do you think is appropriate?"
"Recently, Lancome seems to have released a limited edition perfume. You can just give her that perfume…" Vanessa said lightly.
"Alright, I got it!"
Connor nodded without hesitation.
After knowing what gift to give Chelsea, Connor heaved a long sigh of relief.
"If there's nothing else, I'm hanging up!" Vanessa said.
"Alright!"
Connor agreed and hung up the phone.
After Vanessa saw that the call was hung up, she couldn't help but smile smugly. "Damn you, Connor, you're going to have a good time."
Connor might not know that Vanessa was taking revenge on him, however; Chelsea did not like perfume at all and, more importantly, was allergic to perfume.
Vanessa clearly remembered that there was once a manager in the company who'd given Chelsea a bottle of perfume. Chelsea was allergic to perfume, so she fired the manager and told everyone in the company not to use perfume, especially Lancome perfume. He said that if they dared to use perfume, they would be fired.
Perfume was the most dangerous thing for Chelsea. Almost everyone who knew her knew that she hated perfume.
However, Connor had only known Chelsea for a very short time, so he didn't know her habits very well. He thought that Vanessa was sincerely helping him at this time. If Connor knew that Vanessa was trying to trick him, he would probably go crazy on the spot.
"It's just that I seem to be letting Chelsea down by doing this. I have no choice but to let you suffer a little. When the time comes, you can just teach Connor a lesson…"
At this moment, Vanessa still felt a little guilty. However, when she thought about how Chelsea would teach Connor a lesson because of the perfume, the guilt in her heart was not as strong.
"Damned Connor, you will be in for a good lesson in two days…"
Vanessa muttered.
…
Meanwhile, Connor still didn't know Vanessa's real purpose. He also didn't know how terrible it was to offend a woman like Vanessa. After talking to her on the phone, he went straight to sleep.
The next morning, Connor went straight to a Lancome store and spent a lot of money to buy a bottle of limited edition perfume.
This perfume was a limited edition from Lancome. It was very expensive, and there were only 1,000 bottles in the world. Therefore, Connor felt that Chelsea would be very happy if he gave such a precious perfume to her.
After Connor paid, he specially asked someone to pack the bottle of perfume properly. He planned to give Chelsea a surprise.
After doing all this, Connor returned to the Wallace family's old residence.
In the past few days, Connor had been waiting for Aida Collier to contact him, but what Connor did not expect was that she had no intention of contacting him at all.
Connor was also unable to contact Aida, which made him feel a little anxious. After all, Yaakov Ward's hard drive was still in Aida's hands. Connor didn't come to York to pretend to be Rachel's boyfriend or attend Chelsea's birthday party—his real purpose was to get Yaakov Ward's hard drive. The hard drive that was now in Aida's hands.
Connor didn't know how to get it back. Getting the hard drive back from Aida was a hundred times more difficult than stealing it straight from the Collier family's secret chamber.
He felt that he could not wait like this forever. He planned to wait until Chelsea's birthday party was over before looking for an opportunity to meet Aida. After all, it was not a good idea to drag things out like this.
…
It was past three in the afternoon when Connor left the Wallace family's villa alone and drove to the clubhouse where Chelsea's birthday party was held.
Originally, Connor planned to bring Rachel along, but since Rachel didn't know Chelsea at all, she naturally did not want to attend such a banquet, so she rejected Connor's invitation.
Connor also knew Rachel's character, so he didn't say anything.
Although Chelsea hadn't lived in York for long, her network was still very terrifying.
Therefore, those who attended Chelsea's birthday party this time were probably all upper-class people in York. York was the richest city in the country, so the rich people here were obviously more influential than those in the small cities of Newtown and Porthampton City.
Chelsea's birthday party was held in a clubhouse that she owned.
Connor parked the car at the entrance of the clubhouse and told his name to the receptionist at the door. After a simple verification, the receptionist personally brought Connor into the clubhouse.
After entering the clubhouse, Connor found that the environment inside the clubhouse was very good. It was comparable to the Heavens Club.
Because Connor came late, there were already many guests in the clubhouse. These guests were chatting in groups of three to five in the hall.
After Connor entered the clubhouse, he immediately saw Chelsea in the middle of the hall. She was dressed exceptionally beautifully today, wearing a very expensive and gorgeous evening dress. She looked like a queen from a fairy tale.
Chelsea was a beautiful woman, and her temperament was noble and charming. She was an absolute goddess.
This might be the difference between Chelsea and Vanessa. Although both women were very beautiful, Connor felt that their beauty was of different flavors; Chelsea was more noble, while Vanessa was more sexy. Chelsea was like a queen, and Vanessa was like a princess.
Connor looked at Chelsea with a strange expression on his face. The main character of today's banquet was definitely her.
At this moment, Connor was also very satisfied with the gift he had prepared. He felt that if Chelsea saw his gift, he would definitely be very happy.
Chelsea was probably chatting with the guests at the moment. She had a faint smile on her face as she listened to everyone's flattery.
