In fact, Chelsea was already tired of all the flattery, but for social needs, she could only keep a faint smile on her face.
It couldn't be helped; if you were in an environment where you were in the dark, you would have to learn how to disguise yourself.

chapters.title: Chapter 1626: Do You Still Know Me?
chapters.content:
Chapter 1626: Do You Still Know Me?
Chelsea knew better than anyone else that although these people were trying their best to please her, if the Lee family fell into decline one day, these people might not even look at her.
After all, in modern society, money and benefits are the most important thing. When you have enough strength, you will have many friends around you. But when you fall one day, these people may not even know who you are.
All the so-called successful people present were wearing a hypocritical mask, and behind the mask was a knife at the ready. The person who was smiling at you a second ago would stab you in the back the next second.
At the thought of this, Chelsea felt that Connor was more grounded. At the very least, he would not be as hypocritical as these people.
She looked at the time. Connor should have arrived by now, so she began to look around for him.
Soon, Chelsea saw standing not far away, looking a little happy.
At the same time, Connor saw her too.
However, Chelsea was not in a hurry to talk to Connor. Instead, she winked at him and then began to chat with the people around her.
Connor understood what Chelsea meant, so he did not go over to disturb her.
Connor had attended many banquets like this, but it was his first time attending a banquet of this scale.
Almost all the people who came to attend the banquet today were top-notch figures.
However, Connor was still very calm when facing these people. After all, he did not lack money or connections, so he did not need to curry favor with these people. On the contrary, if these people knew Connor's true identity, they might take the initiative to curry favor with him.
Just the identity of Steven Lee's heir and Jorge Yarrell's disciple was enough for these people to take the initiative to curry favor with him.
However, there were very few people who knew Connor's true identity among the people present.
It was as if everyone had their own small circle. These people chatted in groups of three to five, and Connor was a person who drifted outside of this circle.
Connor simply walked around the hall and then set his eyes on a woman. This woman might be the woman that Connor wanted to see the most.
Aida Collier had actually come to attend Chelsea's birthday party.
At this moment, Aida was chatting with her friend. There was a faint smile on her exquisite face, and there was no trace of it on her fair and slender neck.
"I didn't expect Aida's scar to heal in just two or three days. It's nice to be rich…Even her scar healed so quickly…"
Connor could not help but sigh in his heart.
Connor observed his surroundings briefly and walked towards Aida.
At this moment, Aida seemed to have noticed Connor. Her beautiful eyes were fixed on Connor, and no one knew what she was thinking.
Beside Aida were Albert, Andreas, and Cielo Collier.
At this moment, these two people were also staring at Connor.
"I didn't expect Connor to come to Miss Lee's birthday party. It seems that the relationship between Connor and Chelsea is really not simple!" Andreas said in a low voice.
"Being able to attend Chelsea's birthday party doesn't mean anything, but since this kid dares to come, it means that he probably doesn't put our Collier family in his eyes at all!"
Albert analyzed in a low voice.
"Then what should we do, Father?"
Cielo asked with a frown.
Albert did not say anything because he had come today to test Chelsea's intentions. If Chelsea's relationship with Connor was ordinary, they might have planned to make a move on Connor. If Connor's relationship with Chelsea was not simple, then they might choose to use other methods to deal with Connor.
At this moment, Albert did not know what the relationship between Connor and Chelsea was, so he could not make up his mind.
"I'll have a chat with Miss Lee when I have the chance later!" Albert whispered to Cielo.
"Alright then!"
Cielo nodded helplessly and said nothing more.
Connor didn't think too much at this time. He didn't even think of Albert, Andreas or Cielo; at this moment, he only had Aida in his eyes.
Connor strode towards Aida, ready to talk to her about the hard drive, but at this moment, someone suddenly reached out and grabbed Connor.
Connor was stunned for a moment, then subconsciously looked back and found that the person who grabbed him was actually a woman, and a very beautiful woman.
"..."
Connor looked at the woman behind him and could not help but be stunned for a moment. Then he remembered that he had seen this woman before.
When the Heavens Club opened, this woman had attended his opening ceremony with Chelsea.
Moreover, this woman had a very special name: Yuna Winston.
Yuna was wearing a white dress today. Her exquisite face, full chest, slender waist and beautiful legs looked elegant with a hint of sexiness. She was very charming.
"Connor, do you still know me?"
Yuna asked with a smile.
"Miss Winston, of course I know you…" Connor hurriedly replied.
Connor knew that Yuna's background wasn't simple. However, Chelsea had mentioned that Yuna was very powerful, so Connor had a very deep impression of her.
"I didn't expect you to have such a good memory. You actually remember me!"
After Yuna heard Connor's words, a happy smile crossed her face.
"Miss Winston, you're so beautiful. How could I forget…" Connor said with a smile.
"Quite the smooth talker, are we?" Yuna couldn't help but roll her eyes at Connor before continuing, "Come with me. Chelsea asked me to take you to see someone!"
"Meet someone?"
After Connor heard Yuna's words, he couldn't help but be stunned for a moment before asking, "Who is it?"
"You'll know who he is when you see him later…"
Yuna indifferently replied to Connor, and then walked into the distance.
Connor hesitated for a moment before hurriedly following her.
"Connor, I heard that you seem to be with the eldest daughter of the Wallace family. Is that true?" Yuna asked as she led the way.

chapters.title: Chapter 1627: I'm Your Grandfather
chapters.content:
Chapter 1627: I'm Your Grandfather
"That's right!"
Connor nodded helplessly.
After all, Yuna was from York. If Connor told others that he was pretending to be Rachel's boyfriend, it would have a huge impact on Rachel, so Connor could only act until the end.
"You're really with the eldest daughter of the Wallace family?"
After Yuna heard Connor's words, she looked very surprised, then turned her head and carefully sized up Connor.
"Miss Winston, why are you looking at me like that?"
Connor asked helplessly.
"I'm just a little curious as to how exactly you managed to attract the young lady of the Wallace family..." Yuna replied indifferently.
After Connor heard this, his expression seemed to be somewhat helpless. "Miss Winston, aren't your words a little too hurtful?"
Yuna smiled sweetly. Then, she said, " I don't mean anything else. The eldest daughter of the Wallace family is very famous in York. I don't know how many people are thinking about that woman, but she has never had any scandals with anyone. But you still managed to get her, so I'm a little surprised. I didn't expect you to be so good at chasing girls…"
"Are you praising me?"
Connor asked helplessly.
Yuna nodded. "You can consider it a compliment."
Connor didn't know what to say.
At the same time, Albert and Andreas, who were not far away, also saw Connor and Yuna chatting happily. At this moment, their expressions were unusually ugly.
"This Connor actually knows the Winston family?"
Andreas said in disbelief.
"That shouldn't be. In the information we found, there was no mention of Connor having any interactions with the Winston family!"
Albert hurriedly replied.
"Then why is Connor so close to Yuna Winston? If Connor really is familiar with the Winston family, then this matter might be troublesome!" Andreas hurriedly continued.
"..."
Albert stood there and hesitated for two seconds, then said in a low voice, "Connor knows Chelsea, and her relationship with Yuna is very good. Therefore, it's very likely that Connor met Yuna through Chelsea. It's absolutely impossible for him to have any interactions with the Winston family!"
"It would be best if Connor really has nothing to do with the Winston family. If Connor has something to do with the Winston family, then things might be troublesome!" Andreas said expressionlessly.
Albert stood there without saying a word.
Aida was also sizing up Connor. No one knew what she was thinking.
…
Meanwhile, Yuna brought Connor out of the hall.
After leaving the hall, Connor's expression seemed to be even more confused. He frowned and asked, "Miss Winston, who are you bringing me to see?"
"You'll find out later!"
Yuna replied indifferently.
"Who is it? Why be so mysterious?" Connor asked, exasperated.
"I did it according to her wishes, so don't ask me. I won't tell you anything!"
Connor looked at Yuna helplessly and didn't say anything else.
A moment later, Yuna brought Connor to the door of a room and said, "The person who wants to see you is in here. I've already completed my mission. You can go in now!"
Connor was stunned for a moment before asking, "Aren't you going in?"
"I won't go in. After all, the person inside wants to see you specifically!"
Yuna lightly shook her head, then turned around and left.
After Connor saw her leave, the expression on his face appeared somewhat helpless.
However, he also knew that Yuna would not harm him. Moreover, Connor was also very curious about who this mysterious person who wanted to see him was, so he stretched out his hand and pushed open the door to enter the room.
After entering the room, Connor found that an old man in a white suit was in the room.
The old man should be around 80 years old and looked very kind.
When the old man saw Connor, his face became excited and his body trembled slightly.
Connor was puzzled because he had never seen this old man before, nor did he know who the man was.
"May I know who you are?" He asked the old man with a puzzled tone.
"You must be Connor McDonald?"
The old man asked.
"Yes, I'm Connor McDonald!" Connor lightly nodded.
"Come here, let me take a good look at you!"
The old man waved his hand.
After Connor heard the old man's words, the expression on his face grew even more puzzled.
He didn't know what the old man wanted to do, but Connor knew that this was a meeting arranged by Chelsea, so he didn't say anything and walked directly to the old man.
The old man carefully examined Connor for a moment, then smiled and said, "You look too much like your mother!"
"My mother?" Connor was stunned for a moment, then asked the old man in surprise, "You know my mother?"
"Of course!" The old man nodded.
"Who exactly are you?" Connor frowned.
"I'm your grandfather, and your mother's father!"
Joseph Lee said with a trembling voice.
After Connor heard Joseph's words, he could not help but take two steps back. Then, he looked at the old man in front of him with an incredulous expression. He did not expect that the old man in front of him was actually his grandfather.
"Grandfather?"
Connor took a deep breath and sneered at Joseph.
"I know you don't want to accept my existence, but no matter what, I'm still your grandfather!" Joseph said.
"I don't want to accept your existence?"
Connor could not help but sneer when he heard Joseph's words. Then, he said indifferently, "This is not something I want to accept or not. It's just that my mother said that I don't have a grandfather at all. She said that he died a long time ago. Do you think I'll believe you when you randomly show up and tell me that you're my grandfather?"
"Many people can testify that I am your grandfather!" Joseph said with a trembling voice.
"So what? My mother said that I don't have a grandfather, and I don't have any relatives in this world!"
Connor replied in a low voice.
"It's been so many years. Are you still not sure you can forgive me?"
Joseph asked.

chapters.title: Chapter 1628: Forgive You?
chapters.content:
Chapter 1628: Forgive You?
"Forgive you?"
Connor slowly raised his head and glanced at Joseph, then said with a cold expression, "I've never met you before, and I don't even know who you are. Why should I forgive you? Have you ever done anything to let me down?"
"I let your mother down before, but I did it for her own good!"
Joseph said in a low voice.
"Don't you feel guilty saying this?"
Connor sneered and then said indifferently, "I don't know what happened back then, and I don't know what you did to my mother. I only know that my mother told me that she had no relatives in this world, and I don't have a grandfather."
"Then why can you forgive Chelsea Lee but not me?" Joseph asked.
"What does Chelsea have to do with your Lee family? If I remember correctly, Chelsea isn't from the Lee family, right? Also, when I was born, Chelsea was the only one who went to see my mother. Now that you want me to forgive you, let me ask you, what were you doing when my mother was alive? Why didn't you think of asking my mother to forgive you then?"
Connor shouted.
Joseph was stunned when he heard Connor's words.
"I told you, you don't owe me anything at all. The one you really owe is my mother. If you want to be forgiven, then ask my mother to forgive you!"
Connor said in a low voice.
"Connor, even if you don't forgive me, I'm still your grandfather!" Joseph said with a trembling voice.
"I already said that I don't have a grandfather!"
Connor replied expressionlessly, then turned around and walked out of the room.
"Connor!"
Joseph saw that Connor was about to leave and hurriedly called out, but Connor did not even look at him as he walked out of the room.
Although Connor did not know what happened between his mother Sharon Lee and Joseph, he knew that when he was very young, Shareon had told him that she had no relatives in this world, so Connor should not get close to the Lee family at any time. Even if Connor starved to death, he could not accept the charity of the Lee family.
Connor had already engraved this sentence in his heart, so he would not forgive Joseph at all.
In other words, Connor might never accept Joseph and the Lee family in his life.
Chelsea was the sole exception, and that was only because he treated her more as a friend than a member of the Lee family.
Joseph sat on the spot, his expression unusually helpless. Although this outcome was within his expectations, when it really happened, Joseph still had an indescribable feeling of loss in his heart.
Back then, he had indeed done some things that let Connor's mother down, but he also had his own unspeakable secrets. It was just that there were some things that he could not say now.
Not long after Connor left, Chelsea walked into the room.
Under normal circumstances, Chelsea would never hold a birthday party. After all, such a party was not interesting to her at all. The reason why she held this birthday party was to create an opportunity for Joseph and Connor to meet.
When Chelsea saw the expression on Joseph's face, she knew that things did not go well.
"How did your talk with Connor go?" Chelsea walked to Joseph's side with a smile.
"I probably shouldn't have met Connor at all. I don't think he'll forgive me!" Joseph said dejectedly.
Chelsea hesitated for a moment before speaking. "If you tell Connor everything that happened back then, I think he might be able to forgive you!"
After Joseph heard her words, he took a deep breath and said in a low voice, "I won't tell anyone what happened back then. You also want to know what happened, right?"
"What happened back then has nothing to do with me. If you don't want to say it, then don't!" Chelsea replied indifferently and then continued, "Although I haven't known Connor for a long time, I still know that as long as you treat him sincerely, I think he will forgive you sooner or later!"
"Will he really forgive me?"
Joseph could not help but be stunned when he heard her words.
"I think he will!"
Chelsea gently nodded.
Joseph sighed and did not say anything else.
"Alright, you stay here. I'll go entertain the guests!" Chelsea said.
"Go, then!"
Joseph waved his hand at Chelsea, who then walked gracefully out of the room in her high heels.
…
After Connor met Joseph, his mood was actually very complicated because he could not describe what he was feeling now.
He knew that Joseph was the one who abandoned his mother back then, but he did not know why Joseph abandoned his mother. Moreover, he did not want to know now.
Connor only remembered what his mother had said: no matter what, he should not have any contact with the Lee family.
Therefore, Connor did not want to forgive Joseph at all. Besides Chelsea, he did not plan to have any interactions with the other members of the Lee family.
"Huff…"
Connor took a deep breath and then walked into the hall.
After entering the hall, Connor began to look for Aida. After all, Yaakov Ward's hard disk was still in Aida's hands. Therefore, what Connor wanted to do the most was to talk to her and see if he could get the hard disk back.
Soon, Connor found Aida in the hall, and then he walked straight toward her.
When Albert saw Connor walking toward Aida, he couldn't help but feel strange about this. Because he still didn't know what happened between Connor and Aida, he didn't know why Connor was approaching her.
However, Albert felt that Connor was definitely up to no good, so his expression soured
After hesitating for a moment, Albert stood in front of Aida.
When Connor saw this, he couldn't help but laugh. He said to Albert, "Mr. Collier, what do you mean?"
Albert gritted his teeth.
"Kid, you were the one who barged into our Collier family's villa that day, right?"

chapters.title: Chapter 1629: Only Women and Villains Are Difficult to Raise
chapters.content:
Chapter 1629: Only Women and Villains Are Difficult to Raise
"Breaking into your Collier family's villa?"
After Connor heard Albert's words, he couldn't help but be stunned for a moment. Then, he said with a smile, "Mr. Collier, I don't think we've met before, right? I've never been to your villa before!"
"Don't play dumb with me. If you don't want to make a big deal out of this, get lost!" Albert threatened in a low voice.
"Mr. Collier, if the people here know about what happened that night, I think the one who will be laughed at will not be me, but rather you!"
Connor said lightly.
When Albert heard this, his expression became a little angry.
"That day, in order to kill me, you were even willing to disregard your own daughter's life. If this matter were to spread, I reckon that the entire Collier family's reputation would be swept away, right?" Connor continued.
"What exactly do you want?"
Although Albert had a smile on his face, his tone was unusually cold.
"I don't want to do anything. I just want to chat with Miss Collier. Don't worry, I won't hurt her. After all, I was the one who let her go that night."
Connor calmly replied to Albert, and then walked straight towards Aida's position.
Albert stood there expressionlessly. At this time, he did not dare to stop Connor at all because he was worried that Connor would say what happened that night in front of so many people. Once everyone knew about what happened that night, the Collier family might lose all their dignity.
Besides, Albert also knew that Connor wouldn't do anything to Aida.
Connor walked up to the sexy and tall Aida and said to her with a smile, "Miss Collier, we meet again. Can I buy you a drink?"
Aida was a natural actor in front of Connor. She elegantly raised the goblet in her hand and gently clinked it with Connor's. Then, she took a sip of red wine.
Although Aida was smiling, Connor could still feel the hatred in her eyes.
Even though she had stolen his hard drive, even though he had let her go, Aida still hated Connor.
The reason was very simple. Back then, in the secret room, Connor stole her first kiss and later cut her neck with a knife.
If it was someone else, it might not be a big deal, but for Aida, it was simply unacceptable.
"Miss Collier, I know you hate me for what happened that night, but don't forget that I was the one who let you go when the Collier family gave up on you. I could have killed you that night!" Connor said.
"Then you should be regretting your decision now. Why didn't you kill me back then? I'm the kind of person who won't remember the kindness others have shown me. I will only remember the harm they've inflicted. I can't forgive someone who has hurt me, so I will take revenge on you."
As Aida said this, a faint smile still hung on her delicate face.
"No, why are you so unreasonable?" Connor said with a speechless expression.
"Only women and villains are difficult to raise. Haven't you heard of this saying?" Aida said lightly.
Connor didn't know what to say. He realized that Aida was a little too difficult to handle.
At the same time, Chelsea also returned to the hall.
When Chelsea saw that Connor and Aida were talking, she looked puzzled. She frowned and sighed, "When did Connor meet Aida Collier?"
At this moment, Connor and Aida were speaking quietly, so the surrounding people could not hear what they were talking about.
They also had smiles on their faces, so everyone felt that they were whispering to each other like two good friends.
"What happened that night?"
Connor asked.
"Just wait for my revenge!"
Aida replied without hesitation.
Connor couldn't help but take a deep breath. Then he said in a low voice, "Miss Collier, I did hurt you that day, but I didn't do it on purpose. Moreover, you seem to be fine. You only bled a little. There's no scar on your neck."
Connor was not in a hurry to talk to Aida about the hard disk. After all, he wanted to build a good relationship with her first. That way, it might be easier to talk about the hard disk.
However, Connor had never expected that Aida's attitude towards him would be so unyielding.
"You don't have to explain these things to me. I won't forgive someone who hurt me, nor will I forgive someone who forced a kiss on me!" Aida said calmly.
When Connor heard what Aida said, he could not help but be stunned for a moment. He instantly understood what was going on. It was obvious that Aida did not hate Connor because he hurt her, but because he forced a kiss on her.
"Didn't I kiss you forcefully to save you?"
Connor frowned and said.
You are taking advantage of me!"
Aida replied indifferently.
".."
Connor was speechless. He realized that he couldn't understand this woman at all. She was simply unreasonable.
He took a deep breath and said, "Miss Collier, I've already explained so much to you. Since you don't want to forgive me, I have no choice!"
Aida looked at Connor without saying anything.
"Miss Collier, shouldn't you return my things to me?"
Connor asked.
"Your things?" When Aida heard Connor's words, she could not help but be stunned for a moment. Then, she sneered and said indifferently, "And what are your things?"
"You know very well what I'm talking about. That thing is very important to me, so you have to return it to me!" Connor said in a low voice.
"I'm sorry, I don't know what you're talking about!"
Aida shook her head. Then, she immediately walked forward, but Connor grabbed her wrist without thinking and said in a low voice, "Miss Collier, don't forget that I was your shield that day. If it weren't for me, Albert might have found out that you secretly entered the secret room, right?"
"Let go of me. I don't know what you're talking about!"
Aida seemed to want to break free from his hand.
When Albert saw this scene, his expression grew angry. He took a step forward and was about to rush towards Connor, but at this moment, a beautiful figure blocked Albert's path.

chapters.title: Chapter 1630: Help Me Kill Someone!
chapters.content:
Chapter 1630: Help Me Kill Someone!
"Mr. Collier, long time no see!"
Chelsea said to Albert with a smile.
"Miss Lee?"
When Albert saw Chelsea, he could not help but be stunned for a moment. Then, he smiled and said, "Miss Lee, happy birthday!"
"Mr. Collier, what business have you been busy with recently?" Chelsea asked with a smile.
Albert did not dare to ignore Chelsea, so he could only bite the bullet and chat with her.
Meanwhile, Connor knew that there were too many people in the hall, and he couldn't explain things clearly to Aida, so after a moment of hesitation, he dragged her out of the hall.
Although Aida was struggling, she had no strength to break free.
A moment later, they made it outside.
"There's no one else around now. Can the two of us talk properly now?"
Connor asked.
"About what"
Aida asked expressionlessly.
"Stop pretending to be ignorant. Did you steal the hard drive from me that day? Hand over the hard drive now, or I won't hold back!"
Connor said.
When Aida heard Connor's words, she couldn't help but sneer. Then, she said indifferently, "What hard drive are you talking about? I don't know!"
"Are you still going to pretend to be confused at a time like this? The hard disk that I stole from the Collier family's secret room is now in your hands. That hard disk is useless to you. Hand it over now!"
Aida looked at Connor, then shook her head and said, "Your hard drive is not in my hands at all. Perhaps you lost it yourself!"
"If you don't return the hard drive to me, then I'll tell Albert everything that happened that day!"
Connor gritted his teeth.
"Go ahead and tell him. You can try and see if Albert believes you!"
Aida looked at Connor indifferently.
"..."
Connor was speechless when he heard her words.
"How about this, let's make a deal!" he said.
Aida was stunned when she heard Connor's words. "What deal?"
"I know that you sneaked into the Collier family's secret room that day for something. As long as you can return Yaakov Ward's hard disk to me, I'll help you get what you want," Connor said in a serious tone.
"Do you think you can still enter the Collier family's secret chamber?"
Aida asked expressionlessly.
"If I can go in once, then I can go in a second time. My hard disk is useless in your hands, and you can't return it to Albert now, so making a deal with me is the best choice for you. Even if I can't enter the Collier family's secret room, I can help you solve this problem through other ways!" Connor said.
"..."
Aida blinked. She seemed to be contemplating his offer.
"Aida, this is your best chance. You know very well what kind of person I am. There are some things that you can't do, but that doesn't mean that I can't do it. The two of us entered the secret chamber that day. You have your purpose, and I have mine. So as long as you choose to cooperate with me, the two of us can benefit."
Connor continued to persuade her.
"Alright…"
Aida nodded gently, then said, "I can return your hard drive to you. As long as you can help me kill two people, I'll give it to you!"
"Kill? Who?"
Connor couldn't help but be stunned when he heard Aida's words and asked in a puzzled tone.
"I want you to kill Celio and his mother, Shereen Stevens!" Aida said in a low voice.
"Isn't Celio your brother? Isn't Celio's mother your mother?"
Connor's expression became even more confused. Although he knew that Aida was very ruthless, he did not expect her to be so ruthless that she would even kill her own mother and brother.
"Celio is only my half-brother, and Shereen is the murderer of my mother. I have no blood relationship with her!" Aida said expressionlessly.
"So that's how it is!"
Connor nodded thoughtfully.
"As long as you can help me kill these two people, I can return the hard disk to you!" Aida said.
Connor shook his head after a moment of hesitation and said, "I can't help you with this!"
"Why? Don't you want the hard drive back?"
Aida asked in confusion.
"Of course I want to get the hard drive back, but the two people you mentioned have no enmity with me, so I won't do anything to them!" Connor lightly explained, then continued, "If I'm not wrong, you want to kill Celio because you want to become the head of the Collier family. Celio is Albert's first choice, am I right?"
Connor had also heard the conversation between Albert and Andreas, so he had some understanding of the Collier family's situation.
"That's right!" Aida did not deny it.
"How about this? I'll think of a way to make you the head of the Collier family. After you become the head, you should be able to get rid of these two people yourself. At that time, you can return the hard disk to me," Connor suggested.
Aida was stunned for a moment. Then, she said in a puzzled tone, "You have a way to make me the head of the Collier family?"
"Of course I have a way…"
Connor lightly nodded.
"Alright then. If you can keep your word, then I'll give you back what you want!"
Aida nodded at Connor.
"I hope you won't play any tricks on me. If you dare try anything on me, I will definitely not let you off!" Connor said in a low voice.
"Don't worry!"
Aida replied indifferently, then walked straight to the hall in her high heels.
After hesitating for a moment, Connor followed her back to the hall.
When Albert saw Connor and Aida come back, his face was unusually angry. He said to Andreas, "The relationship between Connor and Chelsea doesn't seem simple. It seems that we can only use the last method!"
"There might be risks in doing this. If Connor survives, we might have to face his revenge!" Andreas said hesitantly.
"Even if we have to deal with his revenge, we don't have any other choice. This is the only way now."
Albert made up his mind.

chapters.title: Chapter 1631: A Chubby Man
chapters.content:
Chapter 1631: A Chubby Man
"Alright then!"
Andreas nodded helplessly, then turned around and left the hall.
Not long after Connor returned, the banquet officially began.
Because today was her birthday party, she was definitely the center of attention.
Everyone gathered around her. Every part of her body was so exquisite that it made people feel suffocated. Coupled with her noble status, many men present dreamed of getting her heart.
her figure and appearance were the best of the best. A woman like her would be very popular even without any background. Moreover, Chelsea had a heaven-defying background.
Chelsea was a member of the Lee family, and the Lee family was one of the top families in York. Even if they were in decline now, they were still much stronger than ordinary families.
Moreover, Chelsea had a very strong network in the country. Even some big shots in the central government of York had a good relationship with her. On top of that, she owned many listed companies around the world. The network resources and funds in her hands were simply incomparable to ordinary families.
Whoever could get their hands on Chelsea would no longer have to struggle in this life. They would immediately stand at the peak of their lives.
At this moment, everyone present was trying their best to please Chelsea, so the gifts they prepared for her were all very precious—any one of them could be worth millions.
Although the perfume that Connor bought was not cheap, there was still a huge gap compared to the gifts these people gave.
Connor made a simple estimate. The value of her birthday gifts this time probably totaled at least 100 million.
100 million!
This amount of money might not be earned by ordinary people in their lifetime, but Chelsea had received so many gifts for her birthday. This might be the difference between the rich and the poor.
Everyone took out the gifts they had prepared and gave them to her.
Connor stood where he was and had no intention of going up because he was prepared to give Chelsea a surprise.
Although his gift was not very expensive, he felt that Chelsea would definitely like his gift very much. Therefore, he had to give this gift to Chelsea alone, not now.
A moment later, almost everyone had given her their gifts.
After Chelsea realized that Connor did not give her a gift, she walked straight up to him in her high heels and asked, "Connor, didn't you prepare a gift for me?"
"What are you talking about? How could I not have prepared a gift for you? This gift of mine is very expensive, so I plan to give it to you alone after the banquet is over. I guarantee that you will like it!"
Connor smiled..
"If you put it that way, I'm really looking forward to it…" Chelsea smiled and replied, then turned around and left.
After everyone gave their gifts, it was time to cut the cake.
Because there were many guests today, her cake was nearly two meters tall. This was the first time Connor had seen such a big cake.
Chelsea made a wish and then began to cut the cake.
Connor hadn't eaten before he came today, so he was a little hungry now. He directly carried the plate to the buffet table and casually picked up some food, then sat in the corner and quietly ate.
At this moment, Connor was like an alien. At this moment, everyone was surrounding Chelsea, trying their best to please her. However, only Connor was sitting quietly in the corner eating his food. Those who could attend the birthday banquet today must have come for Chelsea, so how could these people be in the mood to eat?
Connor had attended many high-end banquets, but such banquets didn't give him a good feeling because the food inside wasn't very delicious.
However, the food in Chelsea's banquet was very suitable for Connor's appetite. After he finished eating the food on the plate, he ran straight back to the buffet table and took another large plate before heading to a random seat and sitting down. He watched the nobles fawn over Chelsea while he was eating quietly.
At this moment, Connor was still very satisfied. At the very least, no one would disturb him.
But at this moment, a voice said in Connor's ear, "Can I sit here?"
Connor couldn't help but be stunned when he heard this. Then, he slowly raised his head and saw a little chubby man standing in front of him.
The man's age was probably around the same as Connor's, but Connor knew that he did not know this person.
"There's no one here. You can sit here!" Connor said.
The chubby man did not hesitate and sat beside him.
"How should I address you?" Connor asked.
"You can just call me Yoel!"
The man said with a smile.
"My name is Connor!" Connor introduced himself.
"Hello, Mr. Connor!" Yoel smiled, then continued, "So many people have gone to flatter Miss Lee. Why aren't you going, too?"
"I don't need to please her!" Connor replied without thinking. Then, he turned to look at Yoel and said, "Aren't you also not trying to please Chelsea? Why aren't you going?"
"You don't have to please her, and I don't have to please her. The two of us are the same…" Yoel smiled and replied.
When Connor heard Yoel's words, he smiled faintly and didn't say anything.
"Mr. Connor, the turkey leg here is the best. Go on, try it..." Yoel said as he handed Connor the turkey leg on his plate.
".."
Connor hesitated for a moment before tasting the drumstick. He found that it tasted very good.
After getting along with each other, Connor found that Yoel's personality was very good. At the very least, he was more interesting than the others in the hall, so they quickly became good friends.
Connor and Yoel ate while admiring the beautiful women in the hall. However, the two of them still felt that Chelsea was the most beautiful. Magnolia Yew was slightly inferior to Chelsea, but not by much.
Ten minutes later, Yoel looked at his phone and smiled at Connor. "Alright, I have to go now. Take your time with your food!"
Connor stood up and said enthusiastically, "You're leaving so soon? Let me send you off!"

chapters.title: Chapter 1632: Wait, You're Yoel Wallace?
chapters.content:
Chapter 1632: Wait, You're Yoel Wallace?
"No need, you can stay here!"
Yoel reached out and patted Connor's shoulder, then smiled and said, "I look forward to the competition with you in the next few days!"
"A competition with me in a few days?"
When Connor heard Yoel's words, he couldn't help but be stunned for a moment. The expression on his face was a little puzzled.
"Yes, my name is Yoel Wallace!"
Yoel said with a smile.
"Wait, you're Yoel Wallace?" When Connor heard this, he was stunned on the spot. The expression on his face of disbelief.
In recent days, Connor often heard the name Yoel Wallace in the Wallace family, but Connor had never seen Yoel himself before. Naturally, he did not know what the man looked like.
However, Connor had heard a lot about Yoel—Yoel could be considered the most outstanding among the three generations of the Wallace family. His ancient martial arts talent and business acumen were both very amazing. In the future, Yoel would definitely inherit the position of the Wallace family's head.
In Connor's impression, the Wallace family was very good-looking in general. Any one of them was a great beauty or a handsome man.
But Connor never thought that the most outstanding Yoel was actually a little chubby.
"You've probably heard of me, right?" Yoel asked Connor with a smile.
"I have!" Connor lightly nodded.
"Before I met you, I didn't have a good impression of you because I felt that you weren't worthy of Rachel at all. However, after spending time with you just now, I feel that you're quite good. At the very least, you're much better than the other rich heirs I've met before, so my impression of you now is also very good," Yoel said with a smile.
"I will also do my best…"
Connor smiled and replied to Yoel.
"That would be great. I look forward to the day I fight you!" Yoel smiled, then continued, "Alright, I still have something to do, so I'm leaving first."
"Alright!"
Connor nodded lightly.
Yoel didn't say anything more. He turned around and walked out of the hall.
Connor looked at Yoel's back and couldn't help but laugh. He sighed and said, "I didn't expect this Yoel to be so interesting!"
Recently, Connor had come into contact with many members of the Wallace family, but only this Yoel made Connor feel a little interested. In his eyes, the other members of the Wallace family were all people who had forsaken righteousness for profit and were not worth being close to at all. However, this Yoel seemed to be a little different.
About half an hour later, Chelsea's birthday party finally came to an end.
Most of the guests had already chosen to leave, and those who stayed were basically all young people. These people were all the rich heirs of York. The boys were probably trying to pursue Chelsea, and the girls were all on good terms with her.
Chelsea had a simple discussion with the others and was ready to bring them to a karaoke bar—after all, young people liked lively places like bars the most.
There were nearly 30 people in total. Everyone had driven their own cars here, so they planned to drive to the bar too.
After leaving the clubhouse, Connor found that there were many luxury cars parked in the parking lot. Any one of them could be worth tens of millions, and the license plate numbers were also very shocking.
Connor came over today, but the Wallace family had prepared a Mercedes-Benz for him, so his car was a little out of place.
At this moment, many rich heirs took the initiative to invite Chelsea into their cars. After all, if Chelsea chose someone's car, it would be a great thing for that person.
However, no one expected Chelsea to bring Yuna to Connor's Mercedes-Benz, the most conspicuous one of them all.
This also made the rich heirs of York feel confused.
Connor could also feel that everyone was staring at him with envy and jealousy, but because of Chelsea, these people did not dare to be too obvious.
Connor followed everyone to the bar and then got them the most luxurious private room.
After entering the private room, everyone began to play games and sing.
However, what made people feel that the situation was a little strange was that Chelsea, who had always been cherished by everyone, seemed to only have Connor in her eyes and had always been by Connor's side. If someone invited her to play games or sing a song, Chelsea wouldn't go as long as Connor did not go.
Moreover, many people took the initiative to invite Chelsea to sing, but they were all rejected.
In the end, Chelsea only sang one song with Connor, and she had to force him to sing.
At this time, the rich heirs began to try guessing who Connor was.
After playing in the bar for an hour, everyone dispersed.
Originally, many people wanted to send Chelsea home, but when they thought of Connor, they gave up on this idea because they knew that it would definitely not be selected to send Chelsea home.
Yuna had a special driver come to pick her up, so she didn't need Connor to send her off.
In the end, Chelsea and Connor were the last to leave the bar.
After everyone had left, Connor said, "Let me send you home!"
"Alright!"
Chelsea nodded gently, then pulled open the door of the Mercedes-Benz and sat in the front passenger seat.
Connor sat in the driver's seat and turned to look at her.
Chelsea seemed to be in a good mood today, so she'd drank a little at the bar.
At this moment, her exquisite face was flushed red. She looked exceptionally alluring, like a ripe peach.
Connor started the car and asked, "Where is your home?"
"You don't want to go to the Lee family's villa, do you?" Chelsea asked calmly.
"Nope!" Connor shook his head without thinking.
"Then send me to Melody Villas. I have a villa there too!"
Chelsea replied after thinking for a moment.
"Good!"
Connor nodded, then took out his phone to search for the place Chelsea had just mentioned. He drove straight to Melody Villas.
It had to be said that Chelsea was indeed very rich.
Melody Villas was the most expensive villa area in York. Not only was it in an excellent location, but the environment was also very elegant. Most importantly, the villas here were not something that you could buy with money alone; everyone had to go through an identity check before buying a villa here.

chapters.title: Chapter 1633: I'll Kill You!
chapters.content:
Chapter 1633: I'll Kill You!
After Connor followed Chelsea into the villa area, he asked, "This villa should be quite expensive, right?"
"I don't know either. Someone bought it for me!" she replied indifferently.
"Who is it? Who's so rich as to give you a villa here?" Connor asked in surprise.
"It must be those people who need my help…" Chelsea replied calmly, then took out the key to open the door of the villa.
After entering the villa, Connor found that the interior was very luxurious, even more so than his previous villa.
Chelsea was a little tired after a busy day, so she didn't care about her image at all as she kicked her high heels aside and jumped onto the sofa barefooted.
"Alright, you're home safely. Can I go now?" Connor asked.
"What are you talking about? You haven't given me my birthday gift yet. Now that there's no one else, can you give me my present?" Chelsea shouted.
"That's right, I forgot about this…"
Connor looked at Chelsea and smiled.
"Wait a moment!" Chelsea suddenly shouted and ran to the kitchen barefooted.
A few minutes later, Chelsea took out a bottle of red wine and smiled at Connor. "Connor, this bottle of red wine has been treasured by me for many years. I have never been willing to open it and drink it until today. It is said that a thousand bottles of this red wine were produced back then, and there are no more than five bottles left now. If the gift you prepared for me today is satisfactory, I will open this bottle of red wine, and the two of us will drink it…"
"What's so good about red wine?" Connor asked.
"Why are you so old-fashioned? It's really a waste to let you drink this red wine…" Chelsea pouted.
"Alright, close your eyes quickly. I'm going to take out the gift…"
Connor said with a smile.
"What kind of gift is it? Why are you acting so mysterious?" Chelsea frowned.
"Hurry up and close your eyes!" Connor urged.
"What exactly is it?"
Chelsea sighed helplessly. Then, she slowly closed her eyes.
Connor saw Chelsea close her eyes, and took out the perfume from his pocket. He sprayed it on her and asked with a smile, "How is it? Doesn't this smell good? I specially chose this for you…"
"What smell?"
Chelsea could not help but frown slightly when he heard Connor's words.
"Perfume!"
"Perfume?"
When Chelsea heard Connor's words, she suddenly opened her eyes and screamed.
"How is it? Do you like the gift I prepared for you?"
Connor thought that she was screaming because she was happy, so he asked Chelsea this with a smug expression.
"Connor, do you want me to die?" Chelsea screamed again.
When Connor heard her words, he could not help but be stunned. Then, he sized up Chelsea and found that her expression was abnormally ugly.
At this moment, Chelsea looked at Connor as if he wanted to kill him.
Something was wrong!
The expression on Connor's face grew puzzled.
Originally, Connor thought that Chelsea would be very excited and happy after seeing the limited edition perfume that he had prepared. However, Connor could feel that she did not seem very happy at this moment. On the contrary, she seemed to be a little angry.
"Doesn't it smell good?"
Connor sprayed the perfume hard and smelled it carefully. He said in a puzzled tone, "It smells so good. Why is your expression like this? Don't you like my gift? Don't you like perfume the most?"
"Connor, I'm going to kill you!"
Chelsea shouted and pounced on Connor, pressing him onto the sofa.
At this moment, Chelsea had completely lost her elegant posture. She was like a shrew riding on Connor's body, pulling his hair with all his might. Her small hands were also grabbing Connor's face.
"What are you doing? Why are you grabbing at me?!" Connor shouted excitedly.
"Why did you spray perfume on me?!"
"Don't you like perfume the most? Don't tell me you don't like the perfume I gave you?!"
Connor asked with a puzzled expression.
"Who told you that I like perfume?" Chelsea gritted her teeth and asked angrily.
Almost everyone who knew Chelsea knew that she was allergic to perfume. Therefore, anyone who was wearing perfume wouldn't dare to approach her.
However, Connor had actually sprayed perfume on her body just now. This was simply courting death.
"Um, can you get off me?"
Connor asked helplessly.
Chelsea hesitated for a moment before getting off Connor's body. She then sat on the sofa and asked oldly, "Who told you that I like perfume?"
"I called Vanessa to prepare a birthday gift for you. She said that you like perfume, so I went to buy you a limited-edition Lancome perfume. It's very difficult to find. I thought I could give you a surprise, but I didn't expect you to not like it at all…"
Connor said with some grievance.
"Don't you know that I'm allergic to perfume?" Chelsea asked coldly.
"Wait, you're allergic?"
Connor was stunned when he heard her words.
At this time, he finally realized that Vanessa had tricked him!
Vanessa and Chelsea had known each other for so many years, so she definitely knew that Chelsea was allergic to perfume. And yet Vanessa still recommended that Connor give Chelsea perfume. She was clearly playing with him!
But what Connor couldn't understand was that he didn't offend Vanessa at all. Why did she do this?
Could it be that there was some conflict between Vanessa and Chelsea?
"You just said that Vanessa recommended you to give me perfume?" Chelsea asked.
"That's right, she recommended it!" Connor hurriedly nodded and continued, "Is there any conflict between you and Vanessa?"
"Why would there be any conflict between the two of us?"
Chelsea replied expressionlessly.
"But if the two of you don't have any conflicts, why would Vanessa want to harm you?"
"Is it Vanessa who wants to harm me, or is it you?" Chelsea sneered.

chapters.title: Chapter 1634: Drinking?
chapters.content:
Chapter 1634: Drinking?
"Of course she wants to harm you!"
Connor didn't even think about it. Then, he continued, "Last night, I called Vanessa. She recommended that I buy perfume. Vanessa has known you for so many years, so she must know that you are allergic to perfume, but she still recommended that I give you perfume."
Chelsea looked at Connor without saying anything.
"I think you'd better call Vanessa now and ask her what's going on. No matter what, the two of us are her bosses. Isn't she too bold?" he said excitedly.
At this time, Connor had no other way but to push all these things to Vanessa.
Chelsea still did not say anything.
When Connor saw that Chelsea still did not speak, the expression on his face became even more nervous. He stuttered, "Why are you looking at me like that? I'm telling the truth, I've really been deceived by Vanessa. You should call her now and ask her about it…"
"I've known Vanessa for so many years, so I know her character very well. There's no conflict between the two of us, so she has no reason to do this…" Chelsea said coldly.
"She has no reason to do this, but do you think I have a reason? If I offend you, what good will it do me?" Connor shouted.
Chelsea hesitated for a moment, then said lightly, "I think Vanessa asked you to give me the perfume not to mess with me, but to mess with you!"
"Trick me?"
After Connor heard her words, the expression on his face became even more puzzled.
"That's right, she's just trying to mess with you. I think you should think carefully about whether you've offended her recently!"
Chelsea said.
After Connor heard this, he instantly reacted to what was going on.
Connor knew that the only time he offended Vanessa was the incident that happened in Vanessa's home, but in fact, that incident couldn't be completely blamed on Connor. After all, if Vanessa didn't take the initiative, Connor wouldn't have been unable to control himself. Moreover, Connor had already apologized to Vanessa, Vanessa shouldn't continue to make things difficult for him!
Although Connor had already guessed in his heart what Vanessa was doing to take revenge on him, Connor definitely wouldn't admit it. After all, if he really admitted it, Chelsea would definitely laugh at him.
"I don't think I've offended Vanessa. The two of us are just ordinary employees and bosses. How could I offend her?"
Connor said in a low voice.
"You should be very clear in your heart whether you have offended Vanessa. There's no need for me to say anything more, right?"
Chelsea replied indifferently.
"Uh..."
his expression was a little awkward, and then he hurriedly continued, "By the way, didn't you just say that you're allergic to perfume? Then why do I see that you look quite normal now? There's nothing wrong with your skin?"
"I'm allergic to perfume, but my skin doesn't have any reaction to it!"
Chelsea said expressionlessly.
"Then where is the reaction?" Connor asked in confusion.
"Perfume will affect my rest and make me lose sleep!" Chelsea said through gritted teeth.
Connor was dumbfounded; he did not expect her allergic reaction to be insomnia of all things.
He stared at her with an unusually helpless expression. He knew that Chelsea had always valued her rest; after all, regular rest was very important to a woman's skin. She was even in the habit of taking an afternoon nap.
Therefore, the quality of sleep must be very important to Chelsea.
She must be very angry now.
However, Connor could not understand why her allergic reaction was so unique.
"Well, it's my fault for what happened today. Don't be angry. It's almost one o'clock now, and it'll be dawn soon. Not sleeping for a night actually doesn't have much of an impact. I myself often stay up late…" Connor said.
"..."
Chelsea turned to look at Connor and said, "Who told you that I can't sleep for one whole night?"
Connor was stunned for a moment and asked, "Isn't it just one night?"
"Last time, I didn't sleep for three whole days because of my perfume allergy!"
Chelsea gritted her teeth.
When Connor heard this, he was instantly dumbfounded. The expression on his face was incredulous.
He didn't expect that Chelsea would have insomnia for such a long time. One had to know that insomnia wasn't a pleasant experience; it meant that one would be very sleepy and not have much energy, but wouldn't be able to sleep and would be very irritable.
If this state lasted for three days, a normal person would probably collapse.
Connor finally knew why Chelsea was so excited after finding out that he had put perfume on her.
He scolded Vanessa several times in his heart. He didn't expect Vanessa to be so bad as to use such a method to take revenge on him. However, the matter had already happened, so no matter how many times he cursed her, it couldn't solve any problem.
"Well, have you thought of other ways to relieve the insomnia?"
Connor asked with a smile.
After Chelsea heard his words, she turned to look at Connor and asked indifferently, "What can I possibly do?"
"Where are the sleeping pills? Have you eaten it before?"
Connor asked after thinking for a moment.
Chelsea shook her head gently.
"I've already tried the last time I had an allergic reaction, but it didn't have any effect at all. It can't solve the problem!"
"How much did you eat? Maybe you ate too little? If it really doesn't work, you can eat a little more. Eating eight to ten pills will definitely have an effect!"
Connor hurriedly said.
"Then I might be dead!" Chelsea shouted helplessly.
"That's true. You can't take too many sleeping pills. If you take too many, something will happen…"
Connor nodded and then subconsciously turned to look at the red wine on the table. He smiled and said, "The two of us can drink. I'll drink with you. Usually, it's easy to fall asleep when you're drunk…"
"Drink?"
her expression was a little helpless, and then he said lightly, "I've tried the method you mentioned. After drinking too much, it will only give me a headache, as if my head is about to explode. However, I still can't fall asleep, so drinking will only make me suffer more…"

chapters.title: Chapter 1635: Stay and Accompany Me!
chapters.content:
Chapter 1635: Stay and Accompany Me!
After Connor heard her words, his expression was extremely exasperated.
He really couldn't understand what her body was made of to have such a strange allergic reaction.
Furthermore, Connor knew that he had to solve her problem. Otherwise, according to her personality, she would definitely not let him off easily.
Connor still had a lot of things to do, so he could not waste time on Chelsea.
Connor hesitated for a moment before asking, "Um, did you go to the hospital for a checkup?"
"Yes, long ago…"
Her expression was a little helpless. "Whether it's a local doctor or a foreign doctor, I've already asked someone to see them, but the doctors can't do anything!"
"Even the doctors can't do anything about it?"
After Connor heard her words, his expression seemed to collapse. Then, he sized up Chelsea and said with a smile, "Actually, I have a way to solve your problem. You might have to suffer a little, though. I don't know if you can accept it!"
"What is it?" Chelsea blinked and asked in a puzzled tone.
"This method is very simple. I'll knock you unconscious so that you don't have to worry about insomnia. I guarantee that you'll be able to sleep very soundly!"
Connor grinned.
After Chelsea heard his words, she glared at Connor and said with a pout, "What kind of method is this? You want to knock me out? Do you even have a conscience? Don't forget that you're the one that triggered my allergy to begin with!"
"I was afraid that you would suffer from insomnia. If you think this method won't work, then I don't have any other choice!" Connor said helplessly.
Chelsea glared at Connor without saying anything.
Connor knew that she might not have much of a reaction now, but if she wanted to sleep and could not, she would definitely be very angry. At that time, she would think of ways to torture him. Therefore, the best choice for Connor now was to leave this place as soon as possible.
"Well, I was wrong today. I'll definitely make it up to you when I have the chance in the future. I have something else to do, so I won't be here with you." After saying this, Connor stood up and walked out of the villa.
Chelsea saw that Connor was about to leave and hurriedly shouted.
"Stop right there!"
Connor's expression was a little helpless as he turned to look at Chelsea and asked with a smile, "Is there anything else?"
"I can't sleep because of you. Are you planning to leave just like that?"
Chelsea asked coldly.
"I have already thought of many ways for you just now, but you feel that they're all useless, so I've run out of ideas. If I stay here, I will definitely annoy you, so I might as well leave first!" Connor explained.
"You can't leave yet!" Chelsea shouted.
"I have to leave. I really have something very important to deal with!"
"There's nothing more important than me now!"
Connor hesitated for a moment before asking, "Then what do you want me to do? Even if I stay here, I can't solve your insomnia problem!"
Chelsea thought for a moment and said, "You really can't solve my insomnia problem, but you can stay with me. If I don't sleep, you don't sleep either. This way, I won't be so bored. When I can fall asleep, you can leave!"
When Connor heard her words, he was stunned on the spot. His expression was abnormally broken as he said in a low voice, "Are you planning to make me accompany you here for three days?"
"That's right!" Chelsea nodded gently.
"No, I really have something very important waiting for me to do. I can't stay here with you!"
Connor shook his head without thinking.
"If you don't want to accompany me, it's fine. You can leave now and leave me here alone!" Chelsea said lightly.
"Are you really letting me go?"
Connor asked in surprise.
"That's right. Since you want to leave so much, then just leave. As long as you feel good about it, as long as you're not worried that I'll take revenge on you in the future!" Chelsea said indifferently.
When Connor heard her words, he was instantly stunned, a helpless expression on his face. Chelsea looked at him and did not know what to say.
Eventually, he frowned. "I think we can discuss this matter!"
"How?"
Chelsea asked.
Connor gritted his teeth. "How about this? I'll come over to accompany you at night. You can do whatever you want during the day!"
"Rejected!"
Chelsea shook her head.
"Then why should I stay here? I can't sit here with you forever, right?"
Connor shouted excitedly.
"There are many things that two people can do…"
"Like what?"
"The two of us can watch TV together!"
"..."
When Connor heard Chelsea's words, he was rendered speechless again because he did not know what to say.
"Cut the crap, sit down and watch TV with me!"
Chelsea took out the remote control and turned on the TV.
In this situation, Connor was sure that he did not dare to leave, so he could only sit beside Chelsea and watch the TV series with him.
…
In the Collier family's villa.
Beau, Albert, Celio, and a few higher-ups of the Collier family gathered together.
At this moment, Beau already knew that Connor and Chelsea's relationship was not simple, so their original plan to use their connections in York to suppress Connor had been rendered completely ineffective.
After all, no matter how terrifying the Collier family's network was, it was definitely not as terrifying as Chelsea's network!
Therefore, the Collier family were contemplating a more extreme method, which was to hire an assassin to kill Connor.
Because of Bill Johnsonn's incident last time, they knew that it wasn't easy to kill Connor with a normal assassin, so this time they chose to use expensive ancient martial artists to kill Connor, all of whom were Black-ranked fighters.
"Have the assassins gone over?"
Beau asked Albert.
"The two of them have already caught up with Connor. They're both Black-ranked fighters, and their strength is definitely above Bill Johnsonn's, so they can definitely kill Connor this time!" Albert hurriedly replied.

chapters.title: Chapter 1636: Assassins
chapters.content:
Chapter 1636: Assassins
"Then why haven't they done anything yet?"
Beau asked in a displeased tone.
"Connor has been staying in her house. If we let the assassins break into her house to kill him, I'm worried that they will hurt Chelsea. This matter has nothing to do with her, so if she's dragged into it, she will definitely investigate us. At that time, we might not only have to face Jorge Yarrell's revenge, but also the Lee family's revenge. So, I'm prepared to wait for Connor to come out before taking action!"
Albert hurriedly said.
"Yes!"
Beau nodded lightly and continued, "His background isn't simple, so no matter what, we can't let others know that we're the ones responsible for killing him!"
"That's right, I think so too!"
Albert nodded lightly.
"How long has Connor been at Chelsea's house?"
Beau asked Albert after a moment of hesitation.
"He's already stayed for an entire night…" Albert replied helplessly.
"What?"
After Beau heard this, his expression was a little shocked. Then, he frowned and said, "Why is Connor staying in her house for so long? What is their relationship?"
"It's very likely that they're in a romantic relationship!"
Albert said in a low voice.
"Isn't his girlfriend Rachel from the Wallace family?" Beau said with a frown.
"I'm not very sure about this, but Connor has indeed stayed at Chelsea's house for the entire night and hasn't come out yet!"
Albert said.
"Are your sources reliable? Could it be that they didn't know that Connor has already left?" Beau asked with a frown.
"Impossible!" Albert shook his head without thinking and continued, "These people are all Black-ranked warriors, and they've been guarding her house all this while. If Connor comes out, they'd definitely be able to see him…"
"Does that mean Connor knows about our plan?" Beau hurriedly asked.
"That shouldn't be the case. Connor hasn't even left Chelsea's house. How can he know that there were assassins waiting outside?"
Albert sounded a little confused.
"But if Connor continues to hide in her house, that's not a solution!" Beau sighed.
After hesitating for a moment, Andreas said expressionlessly, "I think it's better to just get those two to break into her house and kill Connor. We just have to try not to hurt Chelsea. After that, we'll deal with these two assassins. This way, even if Chelsea continues to investigate, she will definitely not find out about us…"
"No!"
After Albert heard this, he shook his head without thinking.
"Why not?"
Andreas asked in confusion.
"The security system in her neighborhood is very good—although some of the people I've hired are Black-ranked fighters, there are also normal fighters around the area. If they try to force a move on Connor, if one of them gets caught by the neighborhood security, then our identities will be exposed, so we'll have to wait until Connor leaves the neighborhood before we act!" Albert said in a low voice.
"..."
Beau hesitated for a moment, then said expressionlessly, "Now it seems that we can only wait. Chelsea Lee is not a simple woman. If we kill Connor in front of her, it will be troublesome in the future!"
Andreas sighed helplessly when he heard Beau's words, but did not say anything else.
…
Meanwhile, outside Chelsea's house, there were four or five people hiding in the woods, observing the situation inside the villa.
These people were all assassins that Albert had hired, and they were all martial artists. Two of them were even Black-ranked martial artists, and their combat strength was very shocking.
One of the young men frowned and asked the middle-aged man beside him, "Big brother, why isn't that kid out yet?"
This middle-aged man was the leader of these assassins. He was known as "Copperhead," and he was a very famous assassin internationally. He had never failed in any of his missions.
Copperhead was a martial artist himself, and his methods were very vicious. As long as he was paid, he would do anything.
He was also very frustrated at this moment. He said in a low voice, "Even if you ask me, who should I ask?"
If it wasn't for the fact that Albert had agreed to give him 100 million dollars, Copperhead would have given up long ago. He had been waiting outside for the entire night, but there was still no movement inside.
"What are these two doing in the room?" the young man asked again.
"What can a man and a woman do?"
Copperhead replied in a low voice.
When the young man heard this, he could not help but be stunned for a moment. Then, he smiled and said, "I didn't expect this kid to be so lucky. I've seen that woman before. She's really f * cking beautiful. If I can play with such a beautiful woman, I'll accept it even if I have to die…"
"You damn well better behave yourself. The higher-ups said that that woman is not to be trifled with. We can't hurt her, and we can't let her discover us…" Copperhead said expressionlessly.
"I know. Our target this time is that kid. But that kid is too good at messing around. I've already waited for an entire night. Why hasn't he come out yet…"
The young man was an ordinary martial artist, so he definitely could not last as long as Copperhead.
"Why the f * ck are you talking so much nonsense? Do you still want to earn money?" Copperhead frowned and asked in a very irritated tone.
"Big brother, I'm really hungry now. Can you let me eat something first?" the young man said helplessly.
"No, just stay here obediently!"
Copperhead replied bluntly.
After the young man heard Copperhead's words, he looked a little helpless, but he did not dare to say anything else. He could only hide behind a tree and continue to observe the situation in the villa.
In the blink of an eye, a day had passed.
Copperhead and the others were still waiting for Connor to appear.
The young man had completely collapsed at this moment. He frowned and shouted, "F * ck, what is this kid doing inside? Why isn't he out yet?"
"Keep your fucking voice down!" Copperhead scolded in a low voice.
"Big Brother, we've already waited for an entire day. Let me eat something, or I might really not be able to hold on any longer!" the young man said in despair.

chapters.title: Chapter 1637: Going Out to Play
chapters.content:
Chapter 1637: Going Out to Play
At this moment, another man also said, "That's right, big brother. Let's go eat something to fill our stomachs first. Otherwise, we'll starve to death here before that kid comes out!"
After hearing their words, Copperhead began to hesitate.
He also knew that the cultivation level of these two subordinates was relatively low, so they were more hungry than he was.
They also hadn't expected to have to wait here for so long.
However, if they left, he was worried that Connor would come out at this time.
Copperhead looked at the young man beside him and said, "How about this: Brother Four, go get some food and water. We'll continue to wait here!"
"Alright…"
After the young man heard Copperhead's words, his expression became a little excited. He hurriedly walked out of the forest.
Copperhead frowned and reminded, "Be careful. Do not let anyone discover you…"
"Big Brother, don't worry. No one will find out!"
The young man grinned and quickly disappeared into the forest.
…
At this moment, Copperhead and the others who were waiting outside were very depressed, but they were definitely not as depressed as Connor was.
After all, there were still a lot of things waiting for Connor to deal with outside, but Chelsea did not let him leave at all. He was forced to accompany Chelsea at home to watch boring youth idol dramas.
Moreover, Connor realized that Chelsea really did not seem to have any intention of sleeping at all. He had not slept for the entire night, so he was extremely sleepy, but Chelsea was still very energetic.
Connor called Rachel to tell her that he had something to deal with, so he might not be able to go back for the next few days. Rachel didn't ask much; she just grunted in acknowledgement and hung up.
"Aren't you sleepy yet?"
Connor yawned.
"Nope!" Chelsea shook her head without thinking.
Connor took out his phone and looked at the time. He realized that only a day had passed. If he really persisted for three days here, he would probably go crazy.
"Well, if you're not sleepy, go back to your room and watch TV. I'm a little sleepy and need to rest first!" Connor said as he lay on the sofa and planned to close his eyes to rest.
"Pa!"
Chelsea raised her little hand and patted Connor's back. Then, she pursed her lips and said, "I haven't slept yet, so you can't sleep either…"
"Ma'am, I beg you, please don't torture me, okay?! I can stay here with you, but you have to let me rest!" Connor shouted, on the verge of tears.
After hearing his words, Chelsea hesitated for a moment before saying, "What should I do if you fall asleep?"
"Watch TV!"
Connor said helplessly.
Chelsea blinked. "Watching TV is too boring. Why don't the two of us go out and play?"
"Go out and play?"
When Connor heard this, his expression seemed a little excited. No matter what, if he could go out for a walk, it would definitely be better than sitting here and watching nothing but TV dramas.
Chelsea nodded. "Yeah, I also think that watching TV is a little boring!"
"Then where do you plan to go?"
Connor asked.
Chelsea thought for a moment and said, "How about I bring you to a very fun place…"
"Alright, let's go!" Connor hurriedly nodded.
He felt that no matter where he went, anywhere was infinitely better than staying here. If he continued to stay like this, he would go crazy.
"Wait a minute, I'll go put on some makeup and change my clothes!"
After saying that, Chelsea walked straight to the bathroom.
Connor knew that her makeup would take a long time, so he did not wait foolishly. Instead, he lay down on the sofa and rested for a bit.
As expected, Chelsea came out of the bathroom after more than half an hour.
After Connor heard the commotion, he quickly opened his eyes and looked at her.
Chelsea had changed into a black spaghetti top, and she was wearing a miniskirt. Her slender, fair legs were covered with black stockings, and she was wearing a pair of high heels. Her exquisite face and devilish figure made it seem as if this woman was perfect to the point that she had no flaws.
The moment Connor saw Chelsea, he felt a lot more energetic. It couldn't be helped; she was really too beautiful.
Chelsea walked around Connor and asked with a smile, "Does it look good?"
"It looks good!"
Connor nodded without thinking.
".."
When Chelsea saw that Connor was charmed, the expression on her face became a little proud. Then, she walked to his side in her high heels and asked, "Then you think I'm pretty, but is your girlfriend prettier?"
"Of course my girlfriend is beautiful!"
Connor replied bluntly, only for him to scream as Chelsea immediately pinched him.
"Ahh! Why did you pinch me?!"
"Were you sleeping just now?"
Chelsea asked fiercely.
"What nonsense are you talking about? Why would I be sleeping? I was just closing my eyes for a while!" Connor hurriedly denied.
"Hmph, you were just sleeping just now. Take my bag and follow me. I'll bring you to see something fun!"
Chelsea snorted and walked out of the villa in her high heels.
Connor helplessly picked up her bag and followed behind her.
A few minutes later, Chelsea brought him to the garage and said, "Choose any one of them!"
"These cars are all yours?" Connor asked in surprise when he saw more than ten luxury cars in the garage.
"These were all given to me by other people, but I don't drive!"
Chelsea replied indifferently.
Connor took a simple glance and found that these cars were all covered in dust. Indeed, no one had driven them for a long time.
In the end, Connor went up to a Ferrari and sat in the driver's seat while Chelsea sat in the passenger seat.
"Where are you going?"
Connor asked.
"To the Nightingale Club!" Chelsea said lightly.
"The Nightingale Club?"
When Connor heard her words, he could not help but be stunned for a moment. Then, he frowned and said, "What is this place?"
"This is the most famous nightclub in York. You just need to navigate your way to it once and you will know the location!" Chelsea replied.
"Ma'am, we haven't eaten for a day. Can we go eat something first before going to the nightclub?" Connor asked, exasperated, only for Chelsea to shake her head.
"I'm not hungry…"

chapters.title: Chapter 1638: I'll Give It to You
chapters.content:
Chapter 1638: I'll Give It to You
"Ma'am, you're not hungry, but I am!"
Connor shouted helplessly.
"There will be food when we get there. Can't you just randomly eat something…" Chelsea said indifferently.
When Connor heard this, his expression seemed a little helpless, but he did not dare to say anything more. He could only start the car.
After the car started, Connor drove straight to the Nightingale Club.
Copperhead and the others were a little excited when they saw Connor and Chelsea driving out of the garage.
"Boss, that kid is finally out. Should we make a move?"
The young man asked in a low voice as he ate his bread.
"Chelsea Lee is also in the car. We can't do anything yet!" Copperhead replied in a low voice.
"Then what should we do? If this brat runs away, it will be troublesome…"
The young man said anxiously.
"It's okay. Follow the two of them. There will definitely be a chance!"
Copperhead threw down the bread in his hand and ran directly to the parking spot in the distance.
…
Inside the car, Connor could smell the faint fragrance on her body. Moreover, Chelsea was dressed very sexily at this moment. Her beautiful legs were covered with black stockings, which was extremely tempting.
Therefore, Connor would always look at her beautiful legs intentionally or unintentionally.
At this moment, his mood was very conflicted. After all, Chelsea was his aunt by name, but in fact, the two of them had nothing to do with each other at all. Moreover, Chelsea was such an attractive woman, so Connor could not help but have some other thoughts in his heart. However, these thoughts could only be suppressed.
After more than half an hour, Connor finally arrived at Nightingale Club.
The Nightingale Club was indeed the largest nightclub in York. The interior decoration was very luxurious, and there were many luxury cars on the roadside.
However, Connor knew that most of these luxury cars were rented by others. Their purpose was to hook up with some gold-digger women.
After Connor parked the car, he followed Chelsea into the clubhouse.
When Connor entered the clubhouse, he was instantly dazzled by a series of laser lights.
When Connor opened his eyes again, he found that there were two hot beauties dancing in the middle of the dance floor.
These two beauties could be considered top-notch in terms of figure and appearance, so most people's attention was on them.
Connor walked to Chelsea's side and asked, "This is the fun place you mentioned?"
"Yeah, isn't it fun here?"
Chelsea replied indifferently.
Connor pouted. "I don't think there's anything fun here…"
Chelsea ignored him and walked straight in.
It seemed that this was not her first time here. A young man who looked like a manager quickly came up to them when he saw Chelsea. Then, he said respectfully, "Miss Lee, you're here?"
"The usual place, please!"
Chelsea said lightly.
"Alright!" The manager agreed and led Chelsea and Connor to a sofa area that was closer to the front.
After Connor and Chelsea sat down, she began to order wine.
In a short while, the coffee table in front of Connor was filled with different glasses of wine. Although Connor didn't like to drink and didn't often go to nightclubs, he knew that the wine Chelsea ordered was not cheap. The wine on this table was at least hundreds of thousands of dollars.
At this moment, Connor did not understand why she had brought him here.
Connor looked at the wine in front of him and said helplessly, "There are only two of us. Why did you order so much wine? Wouldn't it be a waste if we can't finish it?"
"It doesn't matter if you can't finish it. Besides, they don't cost me a lot…" Chelsea replied indifferently. Then, she opened a bottle of red wine and elegantly poured herself a glass before doing the same for Connor.
"Cheers!"
Chelsea said with a smile.
".."
Connor clinked glasses with Chelsea helplessly, then downed the red wine in the glass.
"You know what? This is the largest nightclub in York. Basically, all the young people know this place…"
Chelsea said.
"Business is indeed quite good…"
Connor nodded.
"Then do you know why the manager here is so afraid of me? Why did they give us so much wine?"
Chelsea asked again.
"I don't know. Do you know the boss here?"
Connor replied after thinking for a moment.
"I don't know him!"
Chelsea shook his head gently and continued, "I'm the boss here, that's why he's so afraid of me!"
"What? You're the boss of this place?"
Connor was instantly speechless when he heard her words.
He never thought that the biggest nightclub in York would be owned by Chelsea.
"Which do you think is better, here or the Heavens Club?" Chelsea asked.
"It should be about the same. The people served by these two places are different, but I think they should both be very profitable!"
Connor said lightly.
Chelsea observed her surroundings and said calmly, "You're right, this nightclub is indeed very profitable, perhaps even more profitable than your Heavens Club. After all, this is York, and the spending power here is not something Newtown can compare to!"
"I didn't expect you to be so powerful as to own the biggest nightclub in York!" Connor thought inwardly.
He didn't admire Chelsea because of how much money this place earned, but rather because he felt that it was amazing that Chelsea could rely on her own strength to run so many places and companies.
Connor was not short of money, so he did not envy her for being rich.
However, he was very envious of her ability.
"Of course I'm awesome!" Chelsea proudly replied, then continued, "Do you like this place?"
"I like it!" Connor lightly nodded.
"Then I'll give this place to you. I'm too lazy to manage it anyway!" Chelsea continued.
Connor looked at the helpless expression on her face and said, "Forget it. I don't lack money. There's no use for me to have this place. You can keep it for yourself!"
"Didn't you say that you liked this place just now?" Chelsea pouted.
"I like it, but if you want to give this place to me, I can't take it!"
Connor said seriously.
"Why?"
Chelsea blinked, her expression puzzled.
"You've already given me the Heavens Club and helped me take down that casino. You've already helped me a lot. I'm very grateful to you, so I can't take this place anymore!"
Connor paused for a moment and then continued, "I don't know why you're giving me these things, but I want to tell you that if you're doing these things for Joseph Lee, then you'd better not waste your energy. My mother told me that I don't have a grandfather at all, so no matter what, I will never admit that that man has anything to do with me!"

chapters.title: Chapter 1639: I'm the Boss Here!
chapters.content:
Chapter 1639: I'm the Boss Here!
Chelsea hesitated for a moment. "Why can't you forgive the old man?"
"I don't have any enmity with him, so how can I forgive him? I'm just doing what my mother wants!"
Connor said lightly.
"Alright then!" Chelsea nodded helplessly and continued, "But you can rest assured that I am doing everything only on behalf of myself and not on behalf of Joseph Lee. Your mother helped me back then, so I'm helping you now. This has nothing to do with him, so you don't have to worry!"
"That's good!"
Connor nodded lightly.
"Then are you really not going to take over this club?" Chelsea asked.
"No!"
Connor shook his head without thinking.
