"Forget it. Since you don't want it now, it doesn't matter. Besides, all this will be yours in the future." After Chelsea said this, she stretched her back and said with a smile, "I'm so bored. Let's go dance!"
"What kind of dance?"
Connor could not help but be stunned when he heard this.
"Pole dancing, of course!"
Chelsea replied indifferently and walked straight to the center of the dance floor in her high heels.
Connor looked at her and felt helpless. Sometimes, he admired Chelsea because this woman did whatever she wanted. She never seemed to have any concerns.
Chelsea was the boss here, so she went straight to the manager on duty.
The manager notified the two beauties in the middle of the dance floor to get off the stage, and Chelsea slowly walked up in their stead.
When Chelsea went up on stage, almost everyone's attention was on her. They couldn't help but think that she was too beautiful and sexy.
However, when Chelsea saw the steel pole in the middle of the stage, her expression became a little dissatisfied. Then, she shouted at Connor below the stage. "Connor, come up…"
Connor couldn't help but be stunned when he heard her words. However, he didn't think too much about it and immediately walked onto the stage.
"You'll be the steel pole!" Chelsea said.
Connor was stunned speechless.
However, Chelsea did not give him any time to react; she placed her small hand on his shoulder and her enchanting body began to slowly twist around him.
Connor his heart started to beat faster.
However, Chelsea acted as if nothing was happening as she started dancing very seriously.
The people below the stage looked at Connor with envy. They couldn't understand why his luck was so good.
Copperhead and the others were also observing Connor and Chelsea from below the stage.
"These two people sure know how to play!" the young man said to Copperhead.
"..."
Copperhead took a deep breath and did not say anything.
"Big brother, when are we going to attack?" the young man asked again.
Copperhead hesitated for a moment before saying, "There are too many people here now. If we make a move, we won't be able to escape, and there will be a lot of trouble on top of that. When the two of them go out, we'll make a move and finish that kid with a gun!"
"Alright, I got it!" The young man hurriedly nodded.
On the stage, Connor and Chelsea were having so much fun that they did not seem to realize that danger was gradually approaching them.
A few minutes later, Chelsea ended her dance with a stunning pose.
Connor also heaved a long sigh of relief.
Because of her performance on stage, many men in the hall took the initiative to approach Chelsea.
No matter where she went, a woman like Chelsea would always be the center of attention. Moreover, her pole dance on the stage was too stunning, so the men in the hall would definitely not be able to control their impulses.
Of course, those people also knew that Chelsea came with Connor, but they all felt that he was not very old and did not seem to have much financial strength, so these people naturally did not take him seriously.
"Hello, m'lady. I think you're very beautiful. Can I get to know you?"
Chelsea had just sat down when a young man in a white suit walked over and asked with a smile.
After Chelsea heard the man's words, he slowly raised his head and looked at him. Then, she asked expressionlessly, "You want to chase me?"
"A graceful lady is a gentleman's match. When it comes to a stunner like you, of coursea every man wants to pursue you!"
The young man replied, completely ignoring Connor's presence.
Chelsea gently swirled the goblet in her hand as she asked the young man, "Alright, since you want to pursue me, can I ask you a few questions?"
"Of course!"
The young man felt that Chelsea didn't seem to hate him very much, and the expression on his face became a little proud.
"What do you do? How much is your annual income?" she asked.
"My family is in the real estate business. My annual income is about..."
"Are your assets over 10 billion?"
Chelsea interrupted the young man before he could finish his sentence.
"Ten billion?"
The young man was stunned when he heard her words.
"Look at you. You don't even have more than 10 billion dollars, and you still want to chase me? You'd better work hard to earn money. When your assets exceed 10 billion dollars, come and find me!" Chelsea said casually.
"Miss, isn't your request for the first round too high?"
Facing her rudeness, the young man was still very calm.
"My request isn't too high, right? I'm the boss of this club. Do you think you're qualified to be with me if your assets don't exceed 10 billion?"
Her beautiful eyes sized up the young man, and her tone was calm and natural.
"You're the boss here?"
When the young man heard her words, he was instantly stunned on the spot. The expression on his face became somewhat incredulous.
"If you don't believe me, you can ask the lobby manager now!" Chelsea said expressionlessly.
"About that, I'm sorry to disturb you…"
After the young man found out her true identity, his expression became a little awkward.
After that, he turned around and left.
After that, there were all kinds of people who took the initiative to approach Chelsea, but in the end, they were all sent away by Chelsea with the same words.

chapters.title: Chapter 1640: Boyfriend Selection Standards
chapters.content:
Chapter 1640: Boyfriend Selection Standards
After about half an hour, Chelsea finally calmed down.
She pursed her lips and said, " These people are really annoying. They don't even know what kind of person they are, yet they actually dare to come and talk to me. They don't even have the right to carry my shoes. They really overestimate themselves…"
"Even in the entirety of Oprana, there shouldn't be many people who are worthy of you, right? I think you should lower your expectations. After all, you don't lack money. As long as you can find someone you like, it'll be fine!" Connor said with a smile.
"It's not that easy to find someone you like…"
Chelsea sighed and continued, "Oh right, there's still someone who wants to introduce me to a blind date in a few days. It's really annoying…"
"If you don't like it, you don't have to go. Who can force you to go on a blind date?" Connor said lightly.
"This person is the leader of the higher-ups in York. How can I not at least try to humour him?" Chelsea said helplessly.
"The leader of the higher-ups in York?" When Connor heard her words, he was stunned on the spot. His expression was a little helpless because he knew what she meant.
However, what Connor didn't expect was that the top boss of York would take the initiative to introduce a blind date to Chelsea. This meant that her blind date's background was definitely not simple.
"You're not young anymore. It's time for you to find a boyfriend…" Connor said with a smile.
"Are you saying that I'm old?"
Chelsea's eyes widened as he shouted angrily.
"That's not what I meant!" Connor hurriedly shook his head and continued, "I mean, you're probably not that young anymore, right?"
"I'm only 28 this year!" Chelsea said angrily.
After all, no woman would be willing to admit that she was old, especially a woman like Chelsea.
"Twenty-eight isn't young anymore. You'll be thirty soon. I think you should really consider finding a boyfriend!" Connor said helplessly.
"Do you think I can find a boyfriend as casually as you do? Are you saying as long as he has big boobs, then it's fine?" Chelsea replied with a pout.
"What do you mean by that? I'm not that casual when it comes to women, alright?"
"And what standards do you possibly have? You're fine with anything as long as she has a good figure!"
Connor looked at Chelsea's helpless face and said, "Then what are your requirements for finding a boyfriend?"
He was actually a little curious. What kind of man would a queen-level woman like Chelsea like?
"What are my requirements for a boyfriend?" Chelsea couldn't help but be stunned when he heard his words. Then, she said, "Actually, my requirements for finding a boyfriend are very simple…"
"How simple?"
"First of all, if this person is handsome or too ugly, I definitely won't like him. Also, this person has to be elegant. It won't do if he isn't elegant…" Chelsea said seriously.
"These two requirements of yours shouldn't be very high. After all, there are still many people who are handsome and elegant!" Connor said.
"I still haven't said the most important thing!"
Chelsea hurriedly said.
"What else is there?"
"And the most important point is that this person must be rich, richer than me. If he's not as rich as me, then he should just do what he should be doing!"
Chelsea said lightly.
"Richer than you?"
After Connor heard her words, he was stunned on the spot. The expression on his face was very incredulous.
Although Connor had not been in contact with Chelsea for a long time, he felt that she was indeed very rich, so much so that he felt that her powerful economic strength was unbelievable. Therefore, how many people in the world could be richer than Chelsea?
Her standards basically denied 99% of the men in the world. The remaining people were either old or ugly, and Chelsea did not like them at all.
"If you really look for a man according to your current requirements, I'm worried that you might be single for the rest of your life…" Connor said helplessly.
"Then I'll be single for the rest of my life. I think it's good to be single. Besides, I don't lack money and I don't lack men. If I get married, it will be very troublesome, so I might as well stay single forever!" Chelsea said lightly.
"If that's what you think, then there's nothing wrong with that!"
Connor helplessly replied.
"In a few days, I still have to attend a few blind date banquets. Just thinking about it is annoying, so I plan to travel abroad for a period of time. Do you want to go out and play with me?" Chelsea asked.
"No thanks…" Connor shook his head without thinking and continued, "I'm not as carefree as you. I still have a lot of things I need to do!"
"Forget it. If you don't go, then I will go by myself!"
Chelsea seemed to be a little dissatisfied with his rejection and replied with a pout.
Connor smiled helplessly and continued, "Well, when do you plan to let me go? I really have a lot of things to do over there…"
"Let you go?" Chelsea sneered. "When can I fall asleep? When did I say you could leave?"
Connor was speechless when he heard her words. After all, there was only one full day left before the three days were up. He really couldn't hold on any longer.
Chelsea stood up. "There doesn't seem to be any point in staying here. I'm a little tired, so let's go back…"
"Are you finally going back to sleep?"
Connor asked excitedly.
"Sleep?"
Chelsea smiled disdainfully and said lightly, "Of course not. We're going back to continue the drama series!"
Connor instantly fell into despair when he heard this.
A few minutes later, Connor followed Chelsea out of the Nightingale Club.
When they left the Nightingale Club, Copperhead and the others happened to notice Connor from their position not far away.
"Big brother, that kid is finally out!" the young man beside Copperhead said excitedly.
"..."
Copperhead looked at Connor with a strange expression on his face.
Although Albert had told him not to kill Connor when Chelsea was around, Copperhead could not wait any longer.
Because Connor and Chelsea had been inseparable for the past few days, he was worried that if he did not make a move now, he might not be able to find such a good opportunity in the future!

chapters.title: Chapter 1641: In for a Penny, In for a Pound
chapters.content:
Chapter 1641: In for a Penny, In for a Pound
"Big brother, what should we do now? If you don't make a decision, these two people might leave…"
The young man beside Copperhead exclaimed.
"Go get the car ready!"
After hesitating for a moment, Copperhead finally made up his mind to attack Connor.
"But what about that woman?"
At this moment, another man asked Copperhead.
"Later, we'll follow this kid and find an opportunity to shoot him. That way, that woman won't know who did it. We'll leave after killing him!"
Copperhead said in a low voice.
Although Copperhead did not want to kill Connor in front of Chelsea, he could not wait any longer.
"Okay!"
Everyone hurriedly agreed after hearing Copperhead's words.
"After we're done, we'll take a plane to the U.S.. The money should be transferred over soon…"
Copperhead continued.
After hearing Copperhead's words, everyone began to prepare their weapons.
"Remember, you have to be fast. Also, you must not hurt that woman, understand?"
Copperhead looked at everyone and continued.
"Got it…"
"Got it…"
Everyone hurriedly nodded.
...
On the other side, after Connor and Chelsea got into the car, Connor drove straight to Chelsea's house.
Chelsea turned on the radio in the car and started humming along to the music. She seemed to be in a good mood.
At this moment, many guys were probably envious of Connor. He was driving a limited-edition luxury sports car, and there was a stunning beauty sitting in the front passenger seat. Which man would not envy such a life!
However, they might not know that neither the car nor the beauty belonged to Connor.
"Connor, I'm leaving in a few days. Will you miss me?"
Chelsea turned to look at Connor and asked him softly.
"I'll miss you. Don't worry!"
Connor replied helplessly.
"Hmph, as if I'd believe you!"
Chelsea snorted coldly after hearing Connor's response.
"What do you mean by that? I'm telling the truth. I'll definitely miss you..."
Connor said.
"How did you offend Vanessa by the way? I know Vanessa pretty well. Logically speaking, if you didn't offend her, she wouldn't take revenge on you like this…"
Chelsea looked at Connor and continued.
"I don't know how I offended her. I even gave her the shares of Heavens Club and the casino. I still don't understand why she would do this to me!"
Connor replied helplessly.
"..."
When Chelsea heard Connor's words, a strange look flashed across her face, as if she had already guessed something.
"Be careful!"
However, at this moment, Connor suddenly shouted.
"What's wrong?"
Chelsea shouted in confusion.
Connor did not answer Chelsea's question. He reached out and pushed Chelsea's head down. At the same time, he lowered his head.
Bang bang!
Two gunshots followed.
The bullet directly pierced through the glass in front of Connor.
Chelsea was instantly dumbfounded.
Everything happened to abruptly. If it wasn't for Connor's quick reaction, the two bullets might have penetrated Connor's head.
Both bullets were aimed at Connor, not Chelsea.
After seeing Connor dodge the bullets, Copperhead who was behind Connor's car looked a little angry. He gritted his teeth and cursed in a low voice, "Are the two of you f*cking useless? How did you even miss?"
Such an opportunity was very rare. If they missed this time, then Connor would definitely be on guard. It might not be so easy for them to kill Connor now.
"How is his reaction speed so fast?"
The young man beside Copperhead said helplessly.
"I f*cking told you guys long ago that this person is a martial artist. He won't be so easy to deal with…"
Copperhead's eyes widened as he exclaimed.
In Connor's car, after a short period of shock, Chelsea said to Connor with an incredulous expression, "It seems that there are assassins who want to kill the two of us! Who has the guts to attack me in York?"
"He doesn't want to kill us; he wants to kill me!"
Connor whispered.
The two bullets were all aimed at Connor; none of them were aimed at Chelsea. Therefore, Connor knew very well that the other party was definitely coming at him.
"Did you offend anyone?"
Chelsea frowned and asked Connor.
"..."
Connor narrowed his eyes and did not say anything. At this moment, he had already guessed who had attacked him, but Connor did not intend to tell Chelsea about this.
This was because Connor was worried that if Chelsea knew that he had barged into the Collier family, Chelsea would also be involved in these troubles.
In fact, Connor had already guessed that the Collier family would not let him go just like that. After all, Albert Collier still thought that Yaakov Ward's hard drive was in Connor's hands. Therefore, Connor had been on high alert during this period of time and was constantly paying attention to his surroundings.
When Connor was leaving the club, he realized that a car was following him. However, he was not sure if the car was following him, so he deliberately made a big circle and saw that the car was still following him.
This meant that the car was indeed following them.
Moreover, Connor saw through the rearview mirror that someone in the car behind lifted a gun. It was at the moment when the other party raised his gun that Connor pushed Chelsea's head down and lowered his own head. If Connor did not react in time, he might already be dead by now.
"What should we do now?"
The young man asked Copperhead anxiously now that they had failed.
"Since we've already been discovered by Connor, we might as well go all out!"
Copperhead hesitated for a moment before replying in a low voice.
When Copperhead's underlings heard Copperhead's words, they did not hesitate at all. They aimed at Connor and fired wildly.
However, Connor was already on guard at this time. As he was driving, he circulated the Chi Refining Technique in his body.
Connor was constantly changing the direction of the bullet through the practice of the Chi Refining Technique.
Therefore, no matter how accurate the marksmanship of the people behind him was, the bullets could not hit Connor.
Connor then drove toward the city.

chapters.title: Chapter 1642: Jumping off the Bridge
chapters.content:
Chapter 1642: Jumping off the Bridge
Copperhead and the others had fired more than ten shots in a row, and it seemed as if the bullets were fake as they could not hit their mark.
"How is he so powerful?"
Copperhead was shocked. He was a martial artist after all, and a black rank at that. He could see what was going on.
"This kid is way too powerful. What should we do now?"
The young man beside Copperhead shouted.
When Copperhead heard the young man's words, he could not help but take a deep breath. Then, he said expressionlessly, "We have no choice but to kill that woman as well. Aim for the car and crash it!"
When everyone heard this, they did not hesitate and began to shoot crazily at Connor's car.
If it was just a few bullets, Connor could use his aura to slightly change the direction of the bullets. However, with so many people shooting at the car, Connor could not do anything about it.
A hint of viciousness flashed across Copperhead's eyes. Although he did not want to hurt Chelsea, he could only choose this method to kill Connor in this situation.
Initially, Copperhead thought that if he continued to shoot like this, even if Connor was a God, it would be difficult for him to survive.
However, an unexpected situation happened next.
There was actually a traffic jam in front of them!
Logically speaking, it was already past one in the morning, so there should not be any traffic on the road.
However, this road was the only way to the Nightingale Club, so there was a lot of traffic.
More importantly, there were traffic police officers in front of them checking for drunk driving, which was why there was a traffic jam.
Copperhead looked at the long line of cars in front of him with a look of despair on his face.
There were a few police cars parked in front of them, and there were more than a dozen traffic police officers stopping cars to check for drunk driving. If they continued to shoot, it would definitely cause panic among these people.
Although Copperhead was an assassin, he did not have the guts to shoot in front of so many traffic police. If they were to find out, he would die today.
"Stop shooting!"
Copperhead quickly shouted.
When everyone heard Copperhead's words, they hurriedly stopped shooting at Connor.
At this time, Connor had also noticed the traffic jam in front of him. If he continued to stay in the car, he would definitely die.
Therefore, Connor felt that the best choice now was to get out of the car. After all, in a traffic jam, people might walk faster than cars.
"Get out of the car!"
Connor whispered to Chelsea.
When Chelsea heard Connor's words, she did not hesitate at all. She pushed open the car door and got out.
When Copperhead and the others saw Connor get out of the car, they hurriedly followed him and chased after him with their guns.
But after getting off the car, Connor discovered a very serious problem.
Chelsea was wearing high heels today, and she was not a female martial artist like Rachel Wallace who could run very quickly, so she was running very slowly.
Copperhead and the others were all martial artists, so they were very fast.
"Connor, they are not coming for me. Why not you leave me here?"
Chelsea also knew that she would drag Connor down, so she shouted at Connor.
"..."
Connor could not help but be stunned when he heard Chelsea's words. However, in this situation, Connor definitely could not abandon Chelsea.
Therefore, Connor grabbed Chelsea's hand and began to run in between the cars.
At this moment, Connor only had one thought in his mind, and that was to run to the traffic police as soon as possible. If they were to run to the police officers, those assassins would not dare to continue chasing after them.
However, Chelsea was too slow. Copperhead and the others were about to catch up.
Bang!
A gunshot rang out.
Copperhead raised his pistol and fired at Connor.
However, Connor reacted quickly and bent over to dodge the bullet.
When the surrounding people heard the gunshot, they started screaming. After all, they had never seen such a scene before.
Some people were worried that they might get injured, so they got out of the car and started to flee in all directions.
In an instant, everything turned chaotic.
However, this situation was in Connor's favor. After all, the situation was so chaotic that it was very easy for the assassin to lose Connor.
Connor quickened his pace and rushed forward.
However, Connor soon realized that something was wrong with his surroundings. He then realized they were now on a bridge.
At this time, there were not as many cars on the road.
Moreover, Chelsea was very slow. If the assassins caught up to them, they would be in great danger.
Although the traffic police had already heard the gunshots, they could not rush over so quickly due to the traffic jam.
"That brat is here…"
At this moment, a young man noticed Connor and shouted excitedly.
When Copperhead heard the young man's words, he hurriedly ran toward Connor.
"Aunt Chelsea, go on without me. I'll stay behind to stall them. If I die, you must remember to avenge me. These people are probably assassins hired by the Collier family!"
Connor whispered to Chelsea.
"What nonsense are you talking about? How can I abandon you?"
Chelsea hurriedly replied and then continued, "If there's no other way out, let's jump off the bridge!"
"What? If we jump down, both of us will die…"
Connor looked down the bridge and said helplessly to Chelsea.
"If I remember correctly, there is a small river below us. Even if the two of us jump in, we will fall into the water. We won't die…"
Chelsea looked at Connor and said.
"Are you sure?"
Connor seemed hesitant.
"If we stay here, we are definitely going to die, so why not take the chance?"
Chelsea pursed her lips and said to Connor.
"That's true. Let's give it a try!"
Connor took a deep breath and dragged Chelsea to the side of the bridge.
"Wait a minute, I don't know how to swim, so you have to bring me ashore later…"
When they reached the bridge, Chelsea suddenly remembered that she couldn't swim. She then said to Connor nervously.

chapters.title: Chapter 1643: Drowning
chapters.content:
Chapter 1643: Drowning
"What? You can't swim?"
When Connor heard Chelsea's words, he was shocked.
"Yes..."
Chelsea shook her head gently.
Connor looked at Chelsea and was instantly speechless. He did not know what to say.
However, just as Connor was thinking whether they should jump down or not, Copperhead had already led his men onto the bridge.
When Connor saw Copperhead and the others rush toward them, he could not care less.
Now, he could only take this chance, so he carried Chelsea and jumped down the bridge with her.
When Connor jumped off the bridge, he was shocked.
This was because he realized that the bridge was a long way from the ground. Under normal circumstances, jumping from such a high place would definitely lead to death.
However, if the water below was deep enough, then Connor and Chelsea still had a chance to survive.
Therefore, Connor could only pray that the water below was deep enough.
Perhaps it was because the bridge was too high, Connor could feel his body falling endlessly, while Chelsea, who was in Connor's arms, kept screaming.
Plop!
After some time, Connor and Chelsea finally fell into the water.
The moment they fell into the water, the huge impact forced Connor and Chelsea apart. Connor felt his vision go black, and then his body began to slowly sink into the water.
Copperhead and the others saw Connor jump off the bridge with Chelsea in his arms.
"F*ck, is this kid crazy? Jumping from so high up…"
When the young man saw this scene, his mouth immediately opened wide, and he was extremely shocked.
In his opinion, jumping from such a high place was no different from suicide.
Copperhead stared at the river below the bridge, feeling a little conflicted. He didn't know what to do now.
Copperhead was a black-rank martial artist, so if he jumped from such a high place, he would be fine, but the others around him probably wouldn't have the guts.
Moreover, Copperhead knew that even if he jumped down now, he might not be able to find Connor.
After all, if he were to jump from so high up, who knew where he would land?
More importantly, the traffic police seemed to have received the news and were rushing toward their location. If Copperhead jumped down and was blocked by the traffic police, the situation would be even worse.
Therefore, Copperhead was not sure whether he should go down or not!
"What should we do now? The traffic police are catching up…"
At this moment, a young man suddenly shouted at Copperhead.
Copperhead was stunned when he heard the young man's words. After hesitating for a couple of seconds, he said in a low voice, "We can't catch up to them. Let's go!"
After saying that, Copperhead turned around and left.
Everyone followed Copperhead and left.
...
On the other side, Connor passed out for a short while after pummeling into the water.
Even though Connor was a martial artist, the impact upon hitting the surface of the water was rather great, so he was unable to withstand such a terrifying impact.
After he was knocked unconscious for a moment, he woke up and began swimming toward the surface.
A few seconds later, Connor finally swam up to the surface of the water, taking in big gulps of fresh air.
However, Connor suddenly remembered that Chelsea did not know how to swim, so he began looking around for her.
However, he did not find he after looking around.
"It's over…"
Connor seemed desperate.
Connor himself could not even take the huge impact when he hit the surface of the water. Chelsea was just an ordinary woman, so how could she have been able to withstand that? Connor was afraid that she had already sunk to the bottom of the river. She might already be dead.
Connor was very anxious. He began to swim around, looking for Chelsea.
However, after some time, he still could not find her.
At this moment, Connor was feeling more and more anxious. He even felt a little despair. He did not know where Chelsea was.
However, Connor did not give up looking for her. He trashed around in the water with a sense of urgency.
"Save… Save me…"
At this moment, Connor suddenly heard Chelsea's voice.
He quickly looked up and saw that she was still struggling to stay afloat in the water.
In fact, Chelsea was very lucky. The moment they fell into the water, Connor fell first, while Chelsea was on top of Connor. Therefore, he took on most of the impact, while she barely got hit.
In addition, Chelsea found a wooden board after falling into the water, so she relied on the buoyancy of the wooden board and was able to hold on for a bit. However, Chelsea lost her grip on the wooden board, causing her to trash around as she tried to stay afloat.
Connor swam toward Chelsea like a madman.
However, Connor could hear that Chelsea's voice was getting softer and softer. In the end, it disappeared, and Chelsea was slowly sinking.
Chelsea must have fainted from exhaustion.
Connor swam to the spot where Chelsea had disappeared at the fastest speed possible, then he plunged his head into the water.
After diving into the water, Connor quickly discovered Chelsea, who was gradually sinking. He reached out and grabbed Chelsea's arm, then forcefully pulled her up to the surface.
After Connor dragged Chelsea to the surface of the water, he finally brought her to the shore after much difficulty.
After reaching the shore, Connor finally heaved a long sigh of relief. Fortunately, they were not very far from the shore. If they were very far away, even Connor would not be able to hold on.
Connor was breathing heavily as he tried his best to regain his strength. After all, Connor didn't know if those killers had given up, so he was still highly focused.
A few minutes later, Connor did not sense any movement around him. This meant that those killers had probably given up.
Connor glanced at Chelsea who was lying on the ground. At this moment, Chelsea had already fainted.
Chelsea had probably taken in water as she was down under for some time. When Connor learned how to swim, he had also learned how to save people.
From what he knew, it was necessary to unbutton the victim's clothes at once to ensure that she could breathe normally. Otherwise, her life would be in danger.

chapters.title: Chapter 1644: CPR
chapters.content:
Chapter 1644: CPR
At this moment, Chelsea was lying on the ground with her eyes closed. Her exquisite face was a little pale, but she still looked very beautiful.
Connor looked at Chelsea and hesitated for two seconds. He knew in his heart that it would not be a good idea to not do anything to save her.
Therefore, after hesitating for a moment, Connor took off Chelsea's clothes.
After taking off her clothes, Chelsea's chest, which was wrapped in her bra, was instantly exposed to Connor.
Her fair chest and alluring curves were right before his eyes, but he was not in the mood to appreciate them right now, because the most important thing was to save her.
After all, the bra was the main culprit that restricted Chelsea's breathing.
At this moment, Connor was still a little conflicted, but he knew that saving her was more important, so he did not care too much and just unbuttoned Chelsea's bra.
After doing all that, Connor briefly recalled the method he had learned before. Then, he placed his hands on Chelsea's chest and began to gently press down.
However, after a few presses, Chelsea was still unconscious.
Connor had no choice but to start performing CPR on Chelsea. In such an emergency, Connor had no other thoughts in his mind. He tried his best to perform CPR on Chelsea.
After some time, Chelsea finally came to.
Chelsea first spat out a mouthful of turbid water, then she opened her big watery eyes and coughed violently.
When Connor saw that Chelsea was finally conscious, he heaved a long sigh of relief and sat on the ground.
If something really happened to Chelsea today, Connor might regret it for the rest of his life.
After Chelsea coughed for a while, she seemed much better. She then turned to look at Connor and asked softly, "What happened just now? Was I unconscious?"
"Yeah, we're lucky. The water here is deeper, and I found you before you drowned. Otherwise, you might have died in the water…"
Connor replied softly.
Chelsea looked down briefly, then frowned and asked Connor, "What did you do to me just now?"
"I undid your clothes to save you just now and even gave you mouth-to-mouth resuscitation…"
Connor said very naturally.
"Connor, how dare you take advantage of me? Who told you to take off my clothes? Who told you to give me CPR?"
Chelsea shouted at Connor.
"If I didn't give you mouth-to-mouth resuscitation, you would have died!"
Connor shouted at Chelsea speechlessly.
"You didn't have to do CPR to save me, right?"
Chelsea exclaimed.
"I can't think of any other method other than mouth-to-mouth resuscitation…"
Connor said exasperatedly.
"Then, did you peek when you undid my bra?"
Chelsea hesitated for a moment before asking Connor.
"I was trying to save you just now. Do you think I had the mood to do that? All I was thinking about was making sure you are alive…"
Connor shouted speechlessly.
"You really didn't look?"
Chelsea blinked and asked.
"Definitely not!"
Connor shook his head and continued, "I'm not as shameless as you think…"
"Connor, do you think I'm that easy to fool? Tell me the truth, did you look or not?"
Chelsea shouted at Connor with her big watery eyes.
"I might have looked at it a little, but I definitely didn't do it on purpose…"
Connor replied softly.
"A little?"
Chelsea scoffed when she heard that and asked, "Did you touch it?"
"..."
Connor looked at Chelsea and was instantly speechless. He shouted, "What kind of person do you think I am? That kind of thought didn't even cross my mind!"
Chelsea rolled her eyes at Connor and did not continue asking him any questions.
Chelsea sat on the ground and rested for a while. Then, she tidied up her clothes and asked Connor softly, "What should we do now?"
"We should be safe now. We can leave this place…"
If the assassin did not catch up after such a long time, it meant that the other party must have given up.
"Then, let's go back. My clothes are all wet. I'm so cold…"
Chelsea hugged her shoulders and called out softly.
Connor stood up helplessly and helped Chelsea to the roadside.
When they walked to the side of the road, they happened to see the police who were looking for them.
When the police saw them, they immediately brought the two of them into the police car.
After getting into the police car, Chelsea eased up a little because the two of them were safe now.
"I have to take you to the police station to make a statement later. After all, the two of you are also victims of this shooting!"
One of the police officers said softly to Chelsea and Connor.
"I don't have time to make a statement. What's the use of giving a statement? The assassins have already escaped…"
Chelsea pursed her lips.
"Miss Lee, that's the rule…"
The police officer said helplessly.
"How are the rules more important than my wellbeing? My clothes are all wet now. I'm going home to take a shower and change my clothes. I'll go and give a statement when I'm free…"
Chelsea said lightly.
"Miss Lee…"
The police officer opened his mouth to speak.
"Call your leader now and tell him that I'm Chelsea Lee. He'll tell you what to do!"
Chelsea said to the police in a domineering manner.
When the police heard Chelsea's words, he quickly took out his phone and made a call.
A few minutes later, the police found out who Chelsea was, and how they treated her changed drastically. They immediately got someone to drive Connor and Chelsea back to Chelsea's villa.
After reaching home, Chelsea ran into the bathroom while Connor went to the guest room on the second floor because the guest room also had a bathroom.
After a quick shower, Connor threw all his clothes into the washing machine and then walked out of the bathroom with a towel.
After some time, Chelsea walked out with a towel draped over her shoulders.
At this moment, Chelsea was only wearing a bath towel, which made her look exceptionally sexy.
"Did you touch me today?"
Chelsea asked Connor expressionlessly.
"I swear I didn't!"
Connor replied exasperatedly.
He couldn't understand why Chelsea was harping on that.

chapters.title: Chapter 1645: Dealing With Cielo Collier
chapters.content:
Chapter 1645: Dealing With Cielo Collier
"You swear?"
Chelsea looked Connor up and down and asked with a doubtful expression.
"I swear…"
Connor hurriedly nodded.
"Hmph…"
Chelsea looked at Connor and snorted coldly. Then, she picked up the remote control and turned on the television.
Connor turned and glanced at Chelsea. He asked her softly, "Um, do you have any clothes that I can wear at home? My clothes are in the washing machine. I don't know when they'll be dry…"
"Clothes that you can wear?"
Chelsea could not help but be stunned when she heard Connor's words. Then, she said softly, "Can you wear my clothes?"
"How am I supposed to wear your clothes? Don't you have any men's clothes at home?"
Connor said helplessly.
"I don't have a boyfriend, and no man comes to my house. How could there be men's clothes in my house? You can either wear my clothes or wait for your clothes to dry…"
Chelsea replied indifferently and then continued, "Also, you still have to stay here with me here for a day. So, it doesn't matter even if you dress like this. By the time you leave, your clothes will probably be dry…"
"I can't just stay like this the whole time, right?"
Connor gritted his teeth.
"What's wrong with that? No one is looking at you!"
Chelsea said with pursed lips.
Connor was speechless when he heard Chelsea's words.
Chelsea turned and glanced at Connor before asking him softly, "Previously, you told me that the Collier family wanted to kill you. Do you know why the Collier family wants to kill you?"
"..."
Connor looked at Chelsea and hesitated for a couple of seconds. Then, he briefly told her about how he broke into the Collier family.
When Chelsea heard Connor's words, she was very surprised. She said in disbelief, "You're so bold. You actually barged into the Collier family's secret chamber alone…"
"It was a fruitless attempt. Now that Yaakov Ward's hard disk has been stolen by that woman, Aida Collier, I've done all that work for nothing. Now, I have to face the Collier family's pursuit!"
Connor sighed helplessly.
"Do you need me to help you with this?"
Chelsea hesitated for a moment and asked Connor softly.
"No, I can solve it myself. I don't want you to get involved in this matter!"
Connor shook his head.
"It's a bit difficult for me to help you deal with the entire Collier family. After all, the Collier family has been in York for so many years, and they have a lot of important people in their hands, so it's a bit difficult to deal with them. However, if it's Cielo Collier, it's rather easy."
Chelsea looked at Connor and said.
"You have a way to deal with Cielo Collier?"
When Connor heard Chelsea's words, he seemed a little excited.
"Didn't you already reach an agreement with Aida? As long as you can find a way to deal with Cielo, Aida will return the hard disk to you, and you can use it to deal with Yaakov, right?"
Chelsea asked softly.
"Yes!"
Connor hurriedly nodded.
"Alright then, I'll book a ticket to Yarlford now and help you settle this. Wait to hear from me!"
Chelsea said lightly.
"Can you really find a way to deal with Cielo?"
Connor frowned and asked.
"Don't you know who you're talking to?"
Chelsea pursed her lips and replied, then she continued, "Back then, Cielo studied at a university in Yarlford, and he did a lot of heartless things in Yarlford. However, these things were kept hidden by the Collier family. Some people in Yarlford must have evidence of Cielo. As long as I can find this evidence, wouldn't it be much easier to deal with Cielo?"
"If you really can find evidence of Cielo's crimes, then it is considered as a big help to me…"
Connor said excitedly.
"Don't worry, leave this to me!"
Chelsea replied with a smile and then continued, "Anyway, I'm tired of sitting around. I'll help you settle this at the same time…"
...
In a hotel in York.
Copperhead and the others were not in a good mood because of the failure of this mission.
They were all sitting in their rooms smoking, and there were frowns on their faces.
However, they were not worried about the failure of this mission. They were more worried that their identities might be exposed this time. If their identities were exposed, things would be even more troublesome.
One of the middle-aged men finished smoking and whispered to Copperhead, "Bro, what should we do next?"
"Yeah. Now that Connor has already escaped, it's not going to be easy to deal with him next time…"
Another person added.
"I'm not worried about Connor now. After all, we have plenty of opportunities to kill him in the future. I'm just worried that our identities will be exposed!"
Copperhead narrowed his eyes and said in a low voice.
"We should be safe, right…"
The young man replied in a low voice and then continued, "Before we did anything, we had already destroyed all the cameras on the roadside. Even if the police check the surveillance cameras, they won't be able to find us…"
"The surveillance cameras definitely can't capture us, but there were so many people on the road at that time. If these people's dashcams or mobile phones have our photos, we might be in trouble…"
Copperhead said in a low voice.
Everyone's expressions changed drastically when they heard this because they knew that the possibility of what Copperhead said was very high because there were many people there at that time.
"Worse come to worse, we'll leave. After all, as long as we go overseas, the police won't be able to do anything to us!"
The young man was timid, so he quickly said.
"If we leave now, what about the rest of the money? We haven't killed Connor yet. If this matter gets out, it will have a huge impact on our reputation!"
At this moment, another person spoke.
Everyone fell silent after hearing this.
The Collier family had offered a sky-high price of 100 million dollars to kill Connor.
If they could complete this mission and successfully get the money, they would be able to live comfortably for the rest of their lives.
However, if they gave up on this mission now, not only would they have to return the 10 million deposit that the Collier family had given them, but their reputation would also be greatly affected.

chapters.title: Chapter 1646: Desperate
chapters.content:
Chapter 1646: Desperate
In their line of work, the most important thing was credibility.
After all, as long as their reputation was good, more people would give them work to do. Only then could they get a good commission.
For so many years, Copperhead had never failed.
Therefore, he did not want his reputation to be ruined because of Connor.
However, if they didn't leave York now, they might be arrested, so Copperhead was very vexed.
"Bro, what should we do now? Hurry up and make a decision!"
Seeing that Copperhead had not spoken, the young man shouted at Copperhead anxiously.
"I don't think we need to worry too much about this now. After all, the people who really want to kill Connor are the Collier family. They definitely don't want anything to happen to us, so even if someone took photos of us, the Collier family will definitely think of a way to solve this problem!"
Copperhead paused for a moment, then took out his phone and said softly, "I'll call the Collier family now and see what they want!"
"Alright!"
Everyone hurriedly nodded.
However, before Copperhead could make the call, there was a series of hurried knocks on the door.
When everyone heard the knocking on the door, they became nervous.
After all, they didn't know who was knocking on the door. If it was the police, then they really had no way out.
"Go and take a look!"
Copperhead took out his gun and hid it in his clothes as he whispered to the young man.
"..."
The young man could not help but hesitate for a moment. Then, he walked to the door and looked out through the peephole.
"It's Mr. Collier Jr.!"
The young man said to Copperhead.
After hearing the young man's words, Copperhead seemed to ease up a little. Then, he said softly, "Then why are you still standing there? Hurry up and open the door!"
The young man hurriedly opened the door.
Cielo strode into the room and sized up everyone. He then shouted angrily, "Are you guys f*cking crazy? Why did you do that in front of so many people? Didn't I tell you guys to keep it down low? Do you know how much trouble it will cause if your identities are exposed?"
After hearing Cielo's words, Copperhead was very helpless. He said softly, "Mr. Collier Jr., we didn't want this to happen, but that kid is really cunning…"
"..."
Cielo glanced at Copperhead and asked expressionlessly, "So what's the situation now? Did you expose yourselves?"
"We didn't expose ourselves because most of the cameras on the roadside had been destroyed by us. However, there were many cars at that time. I'm not sure if anyone took photos of us or used a dashcam to record us!"
Copperhead looked at Cielo and whispered.
"You…"
Cielo was speechless when he heard Copperhead's words. He really did not know what to say.
"Mr. Collier Jr., we really had no other options then. We just wanted to complete the mission!"
Copperhead said to Cielo with a frown.
When Cielo heard Copperhead's words, he looked a little helpless. However, he couldn't do much about it. After all, the Collier family was still counting on these people to kill Connor.
"Mr. Collier Jr., what do you think we should do now? Should we still try to kill Connor, or should we hide?"
Copperhead asked Cielo softly after a moment of hesitation.
Cielo took a deep breath and said in a low voice, "Connor will probably leave York. Once he leaves York, it won't be easy for you to make a move, so you must kill him before he leaves!"
The Collier family could not find a better assassin to deal with Connor. If they wanted to replace Copperhead and his group, it would take some time. The Collier family was worried that Connor might leave York soon, so they had to kill him before he left.
"You can't leave York yet!"
Cielo whispered to Copperhead.
"But we're worried that the police will find us!"
Copperhead replied helplessly.
Cielo hesitated for a couple of seconds after hearing Copperhead's words. Then, he said softly, "You don't have to worry about that, I will help you deal with it. Although Chelsea is also very influential in York, it shouldn't be difficult to handle this!"
"Thank you so much, Mr. Collier Jr.…"
Copperhead looked excited after hearing Cielo's words.
"Don't be in a hurry to thank me, hurry up and think of a way to get rid of Connor. As long as you get rid of him, the money will be transferred to you immediately, and I will arrange for you to leave York immediately!"
Cielo said as he looked at Copperhead.
"Alright, don't worry. Next time we will definitely get rid of Connor!"
Copperhead said confidently.
Cielo looked at Copperhead helplessly, then turned around and walked out of the room.
Copperhead let out a long sigh of relief after Cielo left.
...
As Chelsea needed to go to Yarlford to help Connor investigate Cielo, Chelsea did not keep Connor in her house the next day. Connor was relieved.
After he was freed, Connor returned to the Wallace family's place immediately.
When Rachel Wallace saw Connor, she was shocked because he looked haggard.
"Where have you been these past few days?"
Rachel asked Connor in confusion.
"Where else? I've been with Chelsea all this time..."
Connor helplessly explained what had happened in the past two days to Rachel. When Rachel heard what happened, she scoffed. She didn't have any sympathy for Connor at all.
"Since you haven't rested for two days, then you should rest well. Tomorrow is the day you compete with Yoel!"
Rachel softly said.
"I have totally forgotten about that. I saw Yoel Wallace at Chelsea's birthday party, and he even took the initiative to talk to me!"
Connor softly said.
"You've already met Yoel?"
When Rachel heard Connor's words, she was a little surprised. Then, she looked at Connor and asked, "Then what do you think of him?"

chapters.title: Chapter 1647: Martial Arts Competition
chapters.content:
Chapter 1647: Martial Arts Competition
"He's a good person. At least, he's better than the other members of the Wallace family!"
Connor commented.
"Yoel looks very kind on the surface, but he's actually very shrewd, so don't be deceived by his facade. He is very dangerous!"
Rachel said softly.
"Why would he lie to me? We're not very close to begin with. I'm only here to help you put on an act this time. After I'm done with the martial arts competition with Yoel, I'll have completed my task, and I can then leave!"
Connor said lightly.
"That's true…"
Rachel looked at Connor and lightly nodded, not continuing to say anything.
Because Connor hadn't rested for two whole days, after Rachel left, Connor lay on the bed and closed his eyes, and he soon fell asleep.
When Connor woke up again, it was already afternoon the next day.
Connor and Yoel's martial arts competition was finally about to begin.
This day was considered a very important day for the Wallace family. After all, Connor had ruthlessly slapped these people in the faces before, so they had always been very resentful. However, they now placed all their hopes on Yoel. They hoped that Yoel could help the Wallace family regain some face.
Therefore, the Wallace family was very lively today. Almost all the Wallace family members were gathered in the courtyard of Janson Wallace's manor, waiting for the start of the competition between Connor and Yoel.
"Connor, why are you still sleeping? Everyone is waiting for you. Get up now!"
Rachel, who was wearing a sexy and charming spaghetti strap dress, ran into Connor's room. When she saw that Connor was still lying on the bed, she shouted helplessly.
"Why?"
Connor asked in a daze.
"What why?"
Rachel was somewhat helpless, and then she continued, "Have you forgotten that today is the day of your duel with Yoel?"
"Oh damn, I forgot about that!"
Connor hurriedly sat up and exclaimed.
When Rachel heard Connor's words, she was unusually speechless. She said softly, "Connor, this is the last hurdle for you here. As long as you pass this hurdle, you will have completed your mission. Don't drop the ball at such a crucial point…"
"Don't worry. I will go and meet Yoel now…"
Connor replied with a smile and then began to put on his clothes.
A few minutes later, Connor followed Rachel to the backyard of the Wallace family manor.
When Connor entered the backyard, he saw that everyone from the Wallace family had already arrived. These people were all be here to watch the show.
"I didn't expect these people to be so curious about the competition between me and Yoel!"
Connor looked at the Wallace family and sighed softly.
"Previously, you slapped the faces of these people, so they will definitely not let go of such a good opportunity!"
Rachel replied indifferently.
"These people might be disappointed again today…"
Connor said with a smile.
"You sure know how to brag. Yoel is quite powerful. Even I might not be able to defeat him. You'd better be careful!"
Rachel said helplessly to Connor.
"Just because you can't defeat Yoel doesn't mean that I can't either. I'm not the same as I was before!"
Connor said with a smile.
"..."
Rachel looked at Connor helplessly and didn't say anything. After all, she supported Connor deep down. If Connor could really defeat Yoel, that would surely be the best possible outcome.
"Grandpa!"
Rachel and Connor walked toward Janson, and she softly greeted him.
"You're here!"
Janson smiled faintly. He then sized up Connor and said softly, "Connor, I heard from Rachel that you were injured. Have you recovered? If you haven't fully recovered, you can wait a few more days. There's no hurry anyway!"
"There's no need for that. I've almost recovered…"
Connor calmly replied.
...
Originally, Rachel was very happy when he heard that Janson wanted to continue delaying the martial arts competition between Connor and Yoel. After all, this could buy more time for Connor.
But what Rachel did not expect was that Connor actually rejected the offer.
Rachel helplessly turned and looked at Connor. She was unusually puzzled because she couldn't understand why Connor would reject Janson.
"Hehe, if you're alright, I'll let you fight with Yoel. I'm very curious about who's stronger between you and Yoel!"
Janson laughed.
"Alright!"
Connor nodded.
"Yoel, are you here?"
Janson asked the crowd.
"Dad, Yoel will be here soon!"
One of the middle-aged men stepped forward and answered.
"Tell him to hurry up. Everyone is waiting anxiously…"
Janson frowned.
After hearing Janson's words, the middle-aged man hurriedly took out his phone and was about to call Yoel.
"Grandpa, I'm here!"
But at this moment, a voice suddenly sounded.
When everyone heard this, they all turned around.
A chubby guy walked up to Janson with a smile and greeted him respectfully.
Connor knew that this chubby guy who had appeared was none other than the most outstanding person among the three generations of the Wallace family.
Everyone from the Wallace family was excited when they saw Yoel.
"Yoel is finally here!"
"Yeah, Yoel is finally here!"
"Yoel will definitely teach Connor a lesson today. Let's see if Connor still dares to be arrogant..."
"That's right. We must let Connor know how powerful the Wallace family is…"
Everyone in the Wallace family began to discuss in low voices.
It was obvious that these people were very confident in Yoel.
"Yoel, this person is Rachel's boyfriend, Connor McDonald. The two of you can get to know each other!"
Janson pointed at Connor and introduced.
"I already know Connor!"
Yoel said with a smile.
"Oh? You two already know each other?"
Janson smiled faintly and continued, "Then, I don't need to introduce you to each other. If the two of you are ready, the martial arts competition can begin now…"
Connor and Yoel walked straight to the middle of the courtyard after hearing that.
"Connor, when you make your move, you must show me mercy!"
Yoel looked at Connor and said with a smile.
"Yoel, please show me some mercy too!"
Connor replied with a smile.
"Alright, alright!"
Yoel nodded lightly.

chapters.title: Chapter 1648: I Have Not lost!
chapters.content:
Chapter 1648: I Have Not lost!
"Alright, let's begin!"
At this moment, Janson suddenly shouted.
When everyone heard this, they all focused their attention on Yoel and Connor.
After all, they had been waiting for this competition for a long time. They wanted to see Yoel defeat Connor and make Connor lose all his face.
Yoel didn't waste any time talking nonsense with Connor. He immediately rushed toward Connor.
Yoel was very fast.
In the blink of an eye, he was already in front of Connor. Then, he raised his fist and punched toward Connor.
Although Yoel was very fast, Connor's reaction speed was also very shocking.
Connor turned sideways and dodged Yoel's punch. Then, he threw a backhand punch.
Yoel did not choose to dodge Connor's punch. Instead, he threw a punch to greet the incoming punch.
Bang!
There was a loud bang.
Connor's fist and Yoel's fist collided fiercely.
Connor did not expect Yoel's strength to be so great. He took three steps back before stabilizing his body.
Yoel was a little shocked. He also took three steps back to stabilize his body.
It was very obvious that this time, Connor and Yoel were evenly matched. The two people did not gain any advantage over the other.
Janson couldn't help but gently nod his head after seeing this scene, as if he was very satisfied with the contest between Connor and Yoel.
After this exchange, Connor adjusted his aura and said to Yoel softly, "You are indeed strong…"
"You're not bad yourself. I rarely meet an opponent like you among my peers of the same age…"
Yoel replied indifferently and then rushed toward Connor again.
Connor was also focused right now, preparing to deal with Yoel.
If it was a few days ago, Connor would definitely not be Yoel's match.
Because Yoel was indeed terrifyingly strong, but these few days Connor had been practicing the Chi Refining Technique, and it was with the help of Rachel.
Therefore, Connor's combat strength had a very obvious increase.
Connor and Yoel punched and kicked each other. It was as if they used all their strength every time they attacked, but each time, the other side could take the hits without any problems.
At this moment, the battle between the two of them was unusually tense.
When the people of the Wallace family saw this scene, their faces turned dark.
After all, in the eyes of these people, Yoel could kill Connor in an instant.
However, no one expected that Connor was actually on par with Yoel.
Rachel finally eased up after seeing this.
She knew that as long as Connor didn't lose too badly today, it would be fine.
Janson would not make things too difficult for Connor.
Bang!
However, at this moment, Connor suddenly turned around and kicked Yoel in the chest.
Yoel retreated three or four steps before stopping.
"Connor, your strength really surprises me!"
Yoel said to Connor with a smile.
"You surprised me a little too!"
Connor replied indifferently.
Yoel did not say anything else. He took off his clothes and threw them to the side. Then, he rushed toward Connor again.
"Go, Yoel!"
"Yoel, you can do it!"
"Yoel, you can do it!"
Everyone from the Wallace family shouted.
This time, Yoel was even more serious. Almost every time he attacked, he seemed to use all his strength.
However, what made Yoel feel despair was that Connor's reaction speed was way too fast. It was so fast that it was unbelievable. Therefore, no matter how many times Yoel attacked Connor, Connor could easily meet his attacks. This gave Yoel a headache.
Moreover, because Yoel really wanted to defeat Connor, Yoel had already consumed most of the aura in his body, which also caused Yoel's speed to gradually slow down.
However, Connor was not affected in the slightest. From the beginning to the end, he had a calm and composed appearance.
Yoel felt that Connor was a very dangerous enemy. If he continued to fight like this, he definitely would not be able to hold on. However, Connor was retaining most of his physical strength.
Therefore, Yoel was a little anxious. He wanted to end the duel as soon as possible.
At this moment, Yoel's mentality had also undergone an obvious change.
Yoel attacked Connor like a madman, trying to end the duel as soon as possible.
When Janson saw this scene, he could not help but sigh softly.
Connor happened to grasp Yoel's weakness and continued to delay him.
At this moment, the more anxious Yoel was, the faster he moved, and the more obvious his weakness was.
Connor grasped Yoel's weakness and raised his fist to smash towards Yoel's chest.
Bang!
There was a loud bang.
Just now, Yoel was thinking about how to defeat Connor, so he put most of his energy on attacking Connor. He had no intention of defending himself at all.
When Connor's punch was launched, Yoel did not have the time to defend at all.
Therefore, Yoel was sent flying by Connor's punch.
Everyone from the Wallace family was dumbfounded when they saw this scene because they had never expected such a situation to happen.
Yoel, who they had always regarded as their pride, was actually sent flying by Connor's punch. The Wallace family members seemed to be unable to accept this fact. Each and every one of them stared at Yoel with wide eyes, shock written all over their faces.
Even Rachel was very shocked, because she never thought that Connor would actually improve so much.
Yoel lay on the ground and struggled for a while. Then, he stood up and was about to rush toward Connor.
"Stop!"
At that moment, Janson suddenly shouted.
Yoel suddenly turned and looked at Janson, as if he did not quite understand what Janson meant.
"Yoel, you've lost. Connor has won this competition!"
Janson said expressionlessly.
When everyone heard Janson's words, they all revealed an incredulous expression.
"Grandpa, I haven't lost yet!"
Yoel gritted his teeth and shouted in a low voice.
"That's right, Dad. Yoel hasn't lost yet, right? We can't say that Yoel has lost just because of that punch just now, right?"
"That's right, Yoel can continue fighting!"
The Wallace family seemed to be very dissatisfied with the result and shouted at Janson.

chapters.title: Chapter 1649: Task Completion
chapters.content:
Chapter 1649: Task Completion
Janson was a little helpless as he said softly, "Yoel has indeed lost. Even if he continues to fight now, he will just be humiliated. He is not Connor's match at all…"
"But…"
Everyone wanted to defend Yoel.
"But what?"
Janson exclaimed expressionlessly, then continued, "Have you all forgotten that Connor has an old injury on his body?"
Everyone was stunned when they heard Janson's words.
"Connor is injured, yet he can still fight with Yoel. If Connor wasn't injured, Yoel would have lost long ago, so there's no need to continue fighting."
Janson looked at the crowd and exclaimed.
After hearing Janson's words, everyone fell silent. Although they were very unwilling to accept that verdict, what Janson said made sense.
Connor was still able to fight Yoel to such an extent even when he was injured.
If Connor was not injured, then Yoel would definitely lose.
"Connor is indeed powerful. I admit defeat!"
Yoel whispered.
"Yoel, you're the one who showed me mercy!"
Connor smiled and replied.
"Since Connor is injured, let's call it a day. I'll continue to train hard. When there's a chance, we'll fight again!"
Yoel looked at Connor and said.
"Okay!"
Connor lightly nodded.
Yoel turned and glanced at Janson. Then, he said in a low voice, "Grandpa, I have embarrassed you today..."
"You have not embarrassed me. After all, Connor is Jorge Yarrell's disciple. Moreover, Connor's current strength has clearly improved compared to his strength a few days ago. So, it's okay for you to lose."
Janson did not seem to have any intention of reprimanding Yoel as he replied with a smile.
"I will work hard!"
Yoel had been some who strived for excellence since he was young, so no matter what it was, Yoel wanted to do his best. However, losing to Connor today was a big blow to Yoel, so he turned around and left after saying that.
When the people of the Wallace family saw Yoel leave, their faces darkened.
Because today, Connor had once again ruthlessly humiliated them.
From the moment Connor entered the Wallace family manor, these people had been trying to make things difficult for Connor, but they had not succeeded till now.
Whether it was chess, shooting, or ancient martial arts, Connor was better than the best people in the Wallace family.
Therefore, at this moment, no one knew how to make things difficult for Connor.
Or rather, they could no longer find any way to humiliate Connor.
At this moment, Rachel heaved a long sigh of relief. After all, as long as they passed this hurdle, the rest of the matter would be easy to discuss.
The fact that Connor could defeat Yoel was indeed beyond Rachel's expectations.
At this moment, Rachel was also staring at Connor. He was improving much too quickly. The current Connor seemed to be no longer the Connor she had just met.
Connor seemed to have been reborn.
Who would have thought that Connor was still an ordinary university student a year ago?
And now, even if Connor was placed in the Wallace family, he would definitely be considered an existence that stood out among the flock of chickens.
"Grandpa, Connor's performance was alright, right?"
Rachel turned and asked Janson softly.
"Yeah. I'm very satisfied. He does have the ability to protect you. I can be at ease handing you over to someone like Connor!"
Janson smiled and nodded.
Rachel let out a long sigh of relief after hearing Janson's words. After all, it must have been very difficult for Janson to say this.
Connor also heaved a long sigh of relief because he knew that he had completed his task.
"Alright, you guys can leave now. I have something to talk to Connor about!"
At this moment, Janson spoke again.
Everyone turned around and left after hearing Janson's words. Rachel also left after hesitating for a moment.
At this moment, only Connor and Janson were left in the backyard.
After everyone from the Wallace family left, Janson gestured at Connor and said with a smile, "Connor, sit over here!"
Connor hesitated for a moment before walking to Janson and sitting down.
Janson looked at Connor from head to toe, then he said softly, "When I first saw you, I thought that you were a very ordinary child. If it weren't for the fact that you inherited Steven Lee's inheritance, you might not even be comparable to an ordinary person. However, after interacting with you for the past few days, I realized that you don't seem to be as ordinary as I thought…"
"Grandpa Wallace, are you complimenting me?"
Connor smiled and replied.
"Of course, I'm complimenting you. Your performance has surprised me. I believe you're worthy of my granddaughter!"
Janson whispered to Connor.
"It's my honor to be acknowledged by Grandpa Wallace!"
Connor said lightly.
Janson couldn't help but laugh when he heard Connor's words. Then, he said indifferently, "A few days ago, you barged into the Collier family's secret chamber. I didn't expect you to be able to leave alive. You have quite the luck."
Connor was stunned when he heard Janson's words. He was shocked because Rachel would never tell Janson about this. Connor did not know how Janson knew about this.
"You don't have to be so surprised. Your every move is known to me. In York, no matter what you do, I will know!"
Janson smiled and said to Connor.
Connor looked at Janson and did not say anything. He realized that he might have underestimated Janson.
No matter what, the Wallace family was one of the top families in York. At that time, Connor had caused quite a commotion in the Collier family, so it was not odd that Janson knew about this.
Of course, there was a more important point. Rachel had once brought Connor to meet Kingston Jeter, so it was very likely that Kingston had leaked the news. After all, all the connections that Rachel could use were Janson's people, so Kingston must have told Janson about this matter after the incident.
"I heard that you kidnapped Aida Collier that day, so that's why you left the Collier family?"
Janson looked at Connor and continued.

chapters.title: Chapter 1650: The Jig is Up
chapters.content:
Chapter 1650: The Jig is Up
"Yes!"
Connor nodded lightly.
"Then, how did you survive from Bill Johnsonn?"
Janson was somewhat puzzled. After all, he had an idea of how powerful Bill was.
Moreover, Bill had many subordinates with extraordinary strength. Connor went to the Collier family alone, so he felt that Connor was not a match for Bill at all. This was also what Janson was most curious about.
"It was a woman who saved me. That woman was terrifyingly strong. She killed Bill and his subordinates!"
Connor looked at Janson and replied.
"A woman?"
When Janson heard Connor's words, he could not help but frown slightly. Then, he said softly, "Do you know this woman?"
"I don't!"
Connor gently shook his head and continued, "This woman doesn't seem to know me. She said that she was an assassin. Someone gave her money to kill Bill. It was only by chance that she saved me that day."
"I see. Tell me what that woman looks like!"
Connor briefly recalled how she looked and told Janson about the woman.
After listening to Connor's description, Janson smiled faintly and said softly, "The woman you met is called Lia Hopkins!"
"Lia Hopkins?"
When Connor heard this name, he could not help but frown, and he was somewhat puzzled.
"That's right, the only person who has the guts to take on the mission of killing Bill is Lia!"
Janson said softly.
"Who is she?"
Connor asked Janson doubtfully.
"I don't know who Lia is, but she is known as the number one assassin in York. However, her whereabouts have always been very mysterious, and it is not easy to contact her!"
Janson paused for a moment and then continued, "The other big families in York must want to make a move on the Collier family, but they were worried about Bill's strength, so they had Lia kill Bill."
"I see!"
Connor nodded thoughtfully.
"No matter what, you're really bold. Not only did you break into the Collier family's secret chamber, but you also kidnapped Aida Collier. If it were anyone else, they would probably die countless times!"
Janson smiled and said to Connor.
"My luck is indeed pretty good!"
Connor replied softly.
"..."
Janson turned to look at Connor and continued, "I hope you can protect my granddaughter in the future. I don't have much time left. The person I am worried about the most in this world is probably my granddaughter!"
"Grandpa Wallace, don't worry. I'll definitely protect Rachel!"
Connor hurriedly said.
Janson took a deep breath and continued, "I know that you and Rachel are not in a relationship. You came here this time to help Rachel put on an act. This silly girl just wants me to be at ease, but how can I not see through your little tricks?"
When Connor heard Janson's words, he was stunned. His eyes were filled with shock because Connor did not expect Janson to know everything. He had even seen through his act.
"You know!"
Connor sighed softly.
"It doesn't matter. Some things can't be forced!"
Janson sighed softly and continued, "Although you're not Rachel's boyfriend, since Rachel brought you here, it means that she still trusts you very much, so I hope you can protect her well in the future!"
"I will!"
Connor hurriedly nodded.
"Also, there's no need to let Rachel know about this conversation between the two of us. Since Rachel wants to put on an act for me, I'll just pretend that I don't know anything. Otherwise, she'll feel bad…"
Janson looked at Connor and continued.
Connor looked at the old man in front of him and suddenly felt a sense of guilt. He felt that he should not have lied to this old man.
But now that it had already happened, it was useless for him to regret it.
"Alright, if there's nothing else, you can leave now. It's time for me to rest!"
Janson said with a tired voice.
...
After Connor left, he returned to his room.
Connor had just entered the room when Rachel followed him in. Then, she asked Connor with a nervous expression, "What did my grandfather say to you just now?"
"..."
Connor slowly raised his head and looked at Rachel. He felt that it was better not to tell Rachel what Janson said. Otherwise, Rachel would definitely feel very guilty.
"Actually, he didn't say anything to me. He just told me to protect you. You don't have to worry so much…"
Connor said to Rachel with a smile.
"That's good…"
Rachel let out a long sigh of relief after hearing Connor's words, and then continued, "You've completed your task, so you can go back now…"
"I just helped you solve a problem, and you're already chasing me away?"
Connor asked Rachel speechlessly.
"I'm not chasing you away. I'm just worried that you'll be exposed if you continue to stay here. I plan to stay in the Wallace family manor with my grandfather for a few more days before going back…"
Rachel softly said to Connor.
"I might not be able to leave for the time being. I haven't gotten Yaakov Ward's hard drive yet. I'll leave after I get his hard drive!"
Connor had nowhere to go even if he left the Wallace family manor. Moreover, Janson knew about their act. In addition, there were assassins from the Collier family who wanted to kill Connor, so he felt that it was the best choice for him to stay in the Wallace family manor. After all, those assassins from the Collier family would definitely not dare to come to the Wallace family to kill him.
"Alright then, you can stay for a few more days!"
Rachel said helplessly.
"Is there anything else? If there's nothing else, you can go out now. I'm tired..."
Connor yawned and said to Rachel softly.
"..."
Rachel fiercely glared at Connor, then turned around and walked out of the room.
After Rachel left, Connor lay on the bed and was about to rest.
After all, he had been tormented by Chelsea Lee for two days and two nights, so he had to make up for it now.

chapters.title: Chapter 1651: A Call from Yuna Winston
chapters.content:
Chapter 1651: A Call from Yuna Winston
Ring, ring, ring!
However, just as Connor was about to lie down and sleep, his phone suddenly rang.
When Connor heard the ringtone, he quickly picked up the phone and took a look. He saw that it was an unfamiliar number.
After hesitating for a moment, Connor picked up the phone and asked softly, "Hello, may I know who you are?"
"Yuna Winston!"
A very elegant voice sounded on the other end of the phone.
"Miss Winston?"
When Connor heard this, he was a little surprised, and then he hurriedly said, "Miss Winston, why are you calling me? Are you looking for Chelsea? I'm not with Chelsea now!"
"I'm not looking for Chelsea. I'm looking for you!"
Yuna said lightly.
"You're looking for me?"
When Connor heard Yuna's words, he seemed to be even more puzzled.
After all, Connor and Yuna had only met twice. The two of them had no interactions at all. Connor didn't know why Yuna was looking for him.
More importantly, Connor didn't know where Yuna got his contact information.
However, Connor also knew that Yuna was the daughter of a high-ranking leader in Oprana, so Connor did not dare to disregard her.
"That's right. Chelsea just sent me a document. She said that this document is very important to you and asked me to copy it to your hard drive. Why don't we meet up?"
Yuna said lightly.
"Chelsea has already settled it?"
Connor was a little shocked, and then he hurriedly said, "I have time now. Miss Winston, where are you? I'll go and find you now!"
"It might be inconvenient for you to come to my house. Not everyone can come in. How about this? I'll wait for you at Rising Coffee!"
Yuna said after thinking for a moment.
"Alright, I'll go immediately!"
Connor agreed and hung up the phone.
At this moment, Connor was very excited because he didn't expect Chelsea to settle Cielo Collier's matter so quickly. As long as Connor got this hard disk and exchanged it with Aida Collier, Connor would have completed his mission. Then, Connor could return to Newtown to spread the news. Yaakov would probably be eager to contact Connor.
Connor got a car from Rachel. Then, he drove directly to Rising Coffee.
Rising Coffee was a famous coffee shop in York, so it was easy to find.
Soon, Connor found the coffee shop.
After entering the cafe, Connor saw Yuna sitting in the corner of the room.
Today, Yuna was wearing a black short skirt with a white shirt on top. Her chest was full and extremely alluring. Under the short skirt, her beautiful legs were wrapped in stockings, and she was wearing a pair of high heels. Her pretty face had light makeup on, but even so, she was very sexy and charming.
However, Yuna was a sexy woman with a hint of dignity, so people would not approach her that easily.
This might be her innate temperament.
At this moment, Yuna rested her chin on her hands as if she was thinking about something.
"Miss Winston!"
Connor walked toward Yuna and greeted her with a smile.
"Connor, you're here?"
Yuna raised her head and looked at Connor, then softly said, "Sit down!"
Connor sat directly opposite Yuna.
Yuna didn't waste any time as she took out a hard disk from her bag and handed it to Connor. She whispered to Connor, "This is what Chelsea wants me to pass to you!"
Connor was extremely excited after taking the hard drive. He knew that he only needed to meet Aida once before he could get Yaakov's hard drive.
"Miss Winston, thank you so much. If there's a chance in the future, I'll buy you a meal!"
Connor took the hard disk and was about to leave. He just wanted to meet Aida and get what he needed.
"We don't have to wait till the future. I rarely come out. You don't have to buy me a meal. Go buy something with me. I didn't bring my driver and bodyguard with me today, so you'll be in charge of being my driver and bodyguard!"
Yuna said lightly.
After hearing Yuna's words, Connor was stunned. He didn't expect this woman to be so rude. Connor was just being polite, but who would have thought that Yuna would actually take it seriously.
Although Connor was not in the mood to go shopping with Yuna, she had done him a big favor this time. In addition, Yuna's identity was quite special. Connor felt that it was a good thing to have a good relationship with her, so he did not turn her down.
After all, Connor had already gotten the hard drive, so it didn't make any difference whether he met Aida today or tomorrow.
"Alright, Miss Winston. Where do you want to go? I'll take you there now!"
Connor agreed happily.
"Let's go to Grand Mall!"
Yuna said lightly.
"Alright!"
Connor nodded in agreement.
Yuna then carried her bag and walked out of the coffee shop. Connor followed behind Yuna like a bodyguard.
A few minutes later, the two of them got into the car and drove straight to the shopping mall.
Connor turned to look at Yuna as he drove. After hesitating for a couple of seconds, he whispered to Yuna, "Miss Winston, I heard from Chelsea that your father is..."
"That's right…"
Yuna seemed to have already guessed what Connor wanted to ask and nodded.
"I didn't expect your background to be so terrifying!"
Connor said with a smile.
"What's so terrifying about it?"
Yuna replied indifferently and then continued, "On the surface, it looks pretty impressive, but in fact, I'm like a canary locked in a cage. I can't do anything. Sometimes, I envy people like you and Chelsea. At least you can do what you want!"
"Let's envy each other then!"
Connor smiled.
"You weren't born into a family like mine. If you were born into a family like mine, you definitely wouldn't say those words!"
Yuna looked at Connor and said softly.
"I don't have such a chance!"
Connor looked at Yuna and sighed lightly.
Yuna smiled faintly and did not say anything else.

chapters.title: Chapter 1652: An Awkward Matter
chapters.content:
Chapter 1652: An Awkward Matter
Half an hour later, Connor arrived at the shopping mall with Yuna.
After entering the shopping mall, Yuna let herself go crazy and started shopping. Connor followed behind Yuna and was responsible for carrying her bags.
Of course, Connor also helped Yuna pay the bill.
After all, this amount of money was nothing to Connor. Yuna had helped Connor a lot this time.
Of course, Yuna wouldn't argue with Connor about these things, so she let him pay for her stuff.
The two of them strolled around the mall for nearly an hour. Finally, Yuna looked at her spoils of war with a very satisfied expression. She whispered to Connor, "Alright, Connor, thank you for today. We can go back now!"
Connor heaved a sigh of relief when he heard what Yuna said. He could finally leave the mall. Otherwise, he would go crazy if he continued to shop like this.
Yuna brought Connor to the stairs.
However, before he could even take a few steps, a strange expression suddenly flashed across Yuna's face. Then, she squatted on the ground with her hands over her stomach. She seemed to be in pain.
When Connor saw that something was wrong with Yuna, he hurriedly ran to her side and then whispered to her, "Miss Winston, what's wrong?"
"I... I'm fine..."
Yuna's pretty face blushed as she bit her lips and replied in a low voice.
"Why are you squatting on the ground?"
Connor hurriedly asked.
"I'm really fine. Why don't you leave first Connor?"
Yuna whispered.
"Miss Winston, what's wrong with you? How am I supposed to leave you in this state? Are you feeling unwell? Why don't I send you to the hospital?"
Connor could feel that something was amiss with Yuna, so he definitely wouldn't leave her here.
"I'm really fine. You can leave first!"
Yuna bit her lips and whispered to Connor.
