"Miss Winston, what's wrong with you? If you don't tell me what's going on, I really can't leave now. What's wrong with you?"
Connor was really concerned about Yuna.
Yuna slowly raised her head to look at Connor and said in a low voice, "Connor, I think I'm having my period. I'm not feeling very well."
"You're on your period?"
Connor let out a long sigh of relief when he heard Yuna's words. Then, he smiled and said, "You really scared me to death just now. I thought that something was wrong, but it's just your period? What's the big deal? I'll send you home…"
After saying that, Connor stretched out his hand to help Yuna up.
"Don't touch me!"
Yuna's face was red as she shouted at Connor.
Connor instinctively lowered his head to look at Yuna, and then he froze on the spot.
Because he saw that there was a patch of blood on Yuna's clothes. Although Yuna was squatting on the ground, Connor could still see it.
Connor finally understood why Yuna kept urging him to leave.
When Yuna noticed that Connor's gaze was a little off, she felt even more awkward.
"Miss Winston, what should we do now?"
Connor asked Yuna helplessly.
"I don't know what to do now. You can't tell anyone about this, okay?"
Yuna didn't expect such a situation to actually happen. In addition, Yuna wasn't very close to Connor to begin with, so she was utterly embarrassed.
"Miss Winston, don't worry. I won't tell anyone about this!"
Connor hurriedly said.
"..."
Yuna took a deep breath and looked at Connor without saying anything.
"Miss Winston, you should stand up first. You can't just squat here like this!"
Connor said softly.
"..."
He was right. After all, if she kept squatting like this, it would cause misunderstandings. So, she slowly stood up and leaned against the wall. This way, she could prevent others from seeing her back.
"Connor, Chelsea has always praised you for being smart. Hurry up and think of a way!"
Yuna knew that Connor had already seen the patch of blood, so she did not continue hiding it from Connor. She could only hope that Connor would take her away as soon as possible.
Otherwise, it would be troublesome if someone found out and took photos and posted them online.
It would be fine if Yuna was an ordinary girl, but her identity was very special. She was also very famous among the rich young people in York. This mall was full of international brands, so many rich young people came here.
At this moment, Yuna was very worried that she would run into someone familiar. That would be way too awkward.
"Hmm…"
When Connor heard Yuna's words, he appeared somewhat helpless. At this time, he couldn't think of any good ideas.
At this moment, there were still many people in the mall. Yuna and Connor were at least tens of meters away from the elevator. If they walked over, they would definitely be seen.
The toilet was even further away from the two of them, so it was impossible for Yuna to go to the toilet to change her clothes.
Connor wanted to find a path with fewer people, but no matter which direction it was, there were a lot of people, so now she could not move at all. As long as she moved, she would be discovered.
"Connor, what should we do?"
Yuna saw Connor standing there without saying anything and frowned as she shouted anxiously.
"..."
Connor hesitated for a moment before looking at the clothes that Yuna had bought and hurriedly said, "Miss Winston, why don't you change into another set of clothes?"
"Are you crazy? Do you want me to change in front of so many people?"
Yuna said with a frown.
"You can wrap your clothes around your waist. Wouldn't that block the blood?"
Connor hurriedly continued.
"No, I'm wearing a dress today. If I wrap anything around my body, people will definitely notice that something's wrong. If I bump into someone familiar, that would not be good…"
Yuna shook her head again.
Connor looked at Yuna's short skirt. It was rather odd if she were to put something on around her waist. It would attract other people's attention instead.
"Maybe you can cover your head with your clothes. That way, no one will notice that something is wrong…"
Connor looked at Yuna and suggested.

chapters.title: Chapter 1653: Holding Me
chapters.content:
Chapter 1653: Holding Me
When Yuna heard Connor's suggestion, she was extremely speechless.
"Can you give me some useful advice?" she asked with a frown. "Even if I cover my head with clothes, people will think that I'm sick. If they think that I've stolen something, wouldn't that be even more troublesome…"
"Then, what do you think we should do now?"
Connor didn't have any other ideas and asked Yuna helplessly.
"I don't know either…"
Yuna was also very anxious.
Although Connor really wanted to do well in front of Yuna, his ideas kept getting rejected by her. Now, Connor couldn't think of any good ideas.
Time flew by, and it was getting closer and closer to the end of the day.
If he waited until after work, there would definitely be more people.
"Connor, have you thought of any good ideas?"
Yuna asked Connor softly.
"No..."
Connor shook his head helplessly.
"It's all your fault. If I had known earlier, I wouldn't have come out to give you that hard drive…"
Yuna shouted at Connor with a helpless expression.
Connor raised his head and glanced at Yuna. He was somewhat helpless, but he did not say anything.
In fact, Yuna had already thought of a way, but she barely knew Connor, so she felt that this way wasn't very appropriate. She was also embarrassed to tell him what it was.
Originally, Yuna thought that Connor would be able to think of this. However, she did not expect Connor to be so stupid. After such a long time, he was still clueless.
In the end, they wasted time where they were without doing anything.
As time passed, Yuna became more and more anxious because there were more and more people in the mall now.
Connor gave a few more suggestions, but Yuna felt that none of them would work. At this moment, Connor was desperate.
"Connor, maybe you can carry me out of this mall!"
At this moment, Yuna finally couldn't hold it in any longer. She blushed as she whispered to Connor.
Connor couldn't help but be stunned for a moment after hearing Yuna's words. He then stuttered, "Miss Winston, what did you say just now? You want me to carry you out of here?"
"Yeah, this seems to be the only way now, right?"
Yuna blushed and whispered.
Connor looked at Yuna without saying anything.
"If you hold me, no one will be able to see the blood on my clothes. Moreover, I can bury my head in your arms, and no one will be able to see who I am. I think that this is the best way now…"
Yuna looked at Connor and continued.
"But I think it's a little inappropriate for the two of us to do that."
Connor said helplessly.
"Do you think I want to do that? There's nothing we can do now. That's the only way for us to leave the mall. Otherwise, we can only stand here until the mall closes. But now, there are even more people in the mall. I'm worried that we'll meet someone I know!"
Yuna said with a helpless expression.
At this time, Yuna did not want to use this method, but she really could not think of any other way.
Connor looked at Yuna from head to toe. Although Yuna was a very beautiful woman, if Connor were to hold her, it was nothing to him. After all, who wouldn't be happy to have a chance to be in close contact with a beauty?
However, Connor knew that Yuna had a special identity, so he was very hesitant.
Seeing that Connor didn't immediately agree, she was somewhat helpless. He said softly, "If you don't want to do that, then I'll think of another way. At most, I'll just stand here and wait!"
"It's not like we can just wait here all day. Let me carry you out!"
Connor said helplessly.
"You don't seem willing to do it..."
Yuna blinked and said softly.
"It's not that I'm not willing, but it's rather awkward for us to be so close to one another. If your boyfriend finds out, he will definitely be unhappy…"
Connor explained.
"Don't worry, I don't have a boyfriend!"
Yuna replied indifferently.
"Alright then. Since you don't have a boyfriend, then let's do it!"
After Connor said that, he stretched out his hands and carried Yuna by the waist.
At this moment, the two of them were in a very ambiguous position. Connor held Yuna's slender and soft waist with one hand, while the other hand was holding Yuna's beautiful legs.
It was as if this was the first time Yuna was being carried like this, so she was a little nervous.
Connor then walked toward the elevator.
Yuna hid her head in front of Connor's chest. She was very worried about meeting someone she knew.
At this moment, Connor could clearly smell the faint fragrance on Yuna's body. It was very alluring. Connor was trying his best to control his thoughts from running wild.
Along the way, Connor and Yuna were both on tenterhooks.
However, the two of them were very lucky and did not meet any familiar faces.
Connor finally successfully left the mall with Yuna and returned to the car.
After getting on the car, Yuna let out a long sigh of relief, then she whispered to Connor, "Drive me home!"
"Isn't it a little inconvenient to go back to your house? Can my car go in?"
Connor hesitated for a moment and asked Yuna.
Yuna was stunned for a moment after hearing what he said, and then she whispered, "You're right. You won't be able to drive in, and I can't go back on my own like this!"
"Miss Winston, why don't I send you to a hotel? You can go to the hotel to take a shower and change your clothes before going home!"
Connor knew that Yuna had bought a lot of clothes today. They just needed to find a place where she could change her clothes.
"Alright, take me to a hotel!"
Yuna lightly nodded.
Connor started the car and found a hotel that looked decent near the mall.
Connor first entered the hotel alone and booked a room. Then, he carried Yuna into the hotel room.
After entering the room, Yuna's face twisted in pain. She clutched her stomach and lay on the bed.
"Miss Winston, are you having stomach cramps?"
Connor asked Yuna softly.
"Yeah…"
Yuna looked at Connor and lightly nodded.
"Wait for me!"
After saying that, Connor turned around and walked out of the room.
Yuna ignored Connor because of her stomach cramps.

chapters.title: Chapter 1654: The Deal
chapters.content:
Chapter 1654: The Deal
A few minutes later, Connor returned to his room.
At this moment, Connor was holding a few packets of sanitary pads and brown sugar ginger tea.
As Connor had booked a presidential suite, there was a kitchen inside.
Connor went into the kitchen and boiled a cup of brown sugar ginger tea for Yuna. Then, he carried the brown sugar water to Yuna and said softly to Yuna, "Miss Winston, this is brown sugar ginger tea. You should feel better after drinking it!"
"..."
When Yuna heard Connor's words, she slowly raised her head and looked at Connor, then softly said, "Thank you!"
"It's not a problem. It was my fault to begin with. If I didn't ask you to pass me the hard drive, all this wouldn't have happened!"
Connor replied with a smile and then continued, "I bought sanitary pads for you too, but I didn't know what brand you wanted, so I bought one of each…"
"I didn't expect you to be so thoughtful!"
Yuna faintly smiled after hearing Connor's words.
"Not really!"
Connor smiled and continued, "If you're okay now, I'll be leaving now. If you need anything, just call me!"
"Okay!"
Yuna looked at Connor and lightly nodded.
Connor knew that there was nothing he could do here, so he turned around and left the room.
When Yuna saw Connor leave, she couldn't help but laugh. Then, she sighed softly, "I didn't expect Chelsea's nephew to be such a caring man!"
...
Although the incident between Connor and Yuna was quite awkward, he didn't have time to think about it. The most important thing for him now was to contact Aida Collier and meet her to get Yaakov Ward's hard disk back.
Therefore, Connor drove directly back to the Wallace family manor. After arriving at the manor, Connor asked Rachel Wallace for a laptop.
Connor inserted the hard drive into the laptop and saw that there were two videos on the hard drive.
Connor opened the first video.
The first video was the scene of Cielo Collier killing someone. The video was exceptionally clear. Cielo's face and the victim's face could be seen.
Connor knew that this video alone was enough to send Cielo to jail. As long as he handed this video to the police, it would be useless no matter how powerful the Collier family was. Cielo would definitely go to jail.
Rachel was also surprised after watching the video. She asked Connor softly, "Where did you get this video?"
"I'm not sure either. Chelsea gave it to me!"
Connor replied indifferently.
"What is the second video?"
Rachel pointed at the screen and said.
Connor hesitated for a moment before opening the second video.
When Connor and Rachel saw the second video, they were both stunned.
It was a video of Cielo raping a girl and killing her with his own hands.
In the video, the girl kept begging for mercy, but Cielo still chose to kill her.
"He's a beast!"
Rachel shouted angrily after watching the video.
"These two videos should be enough. Can you help me get Aida's number?"
Connor asked Rachel.
"I'll call and ask!"
Rachel replied in a low voice. Then, she took out her phone and started to make a call.
A few minutes later, Rachel gave Connor Aida's number.
After getting Aida's phone number, Connor immediately dialed her number.
Ring, ring, ring…
The phone rang for a long time before Aida picked it up. Then, she said coldly, "Who is it?"
"It's me, Connor McDonald!"
Connor replied in a low voice.
Aida couldn't help but be stunned when she heard Connor's words. Then, she said in surprise, "How did you get my number?"
"It isn't difficult to get your number!"
Connor smiled and replied.
"Is there something you need?"
Aida asked softly.
"When are you free? Let's meet up. I've already found evidence of Cielo's crimes."
Connor said calmly.
When Aida heard Connor's words, she couldn't help but be stunned. She said in surprise, "You've found evidence of Cielo's crimes?"
"Yes!"
Connor nodded lightly.
"Alright, then let's meet at the Old Well Teahouse in the suburbs at ten o'clock tomorrow morning!"
Aida didn't say anything else and told Connor the time and place of the meeting.
"Alright!"
Connor agreed and then hung up.
The next morning.
Connor drove straight to the Old Well Teahouse that Aida mentioned.
As Connor and Aida had special identities, the place where they were meeting had to be very secluded.
Otherwise, if someone found out, it would be very troublesome for both Aida and Connor.
After Connor entered the Old Well Teahouse, he told the waiter the private room number.
When the waiter of the Old Well Teahouse knew that Connor was going to meet Aida, he brought Connor to a private room.
"Miss Collier is inside…"
The waiter brought Connor to a private room and then whispered to Connor.
"Okay, thank you!"
Connor looked at the waiter and nodded gently. Then, he walked into the private room.
After entering the room, Connor saw that Aida was alone in the room. At this time, she was playing with her phone with her head lowered.
Aida had obviously put in a lot of effort to dress up today. Her pretty face was covered with cold makeup, and her large, watery eyes were covered with light eyeshadow. She was wearing a black, tight-fitting dress, and her slender, fair legs were covered with black stockings. She was wearing a pair of red high heels, and she looked extremely sexy and charming.
When Aida saw Connor walk in, she quickly stood up. Her chest bounced slightly with her abrupt movement, then she walked toward Connor in an alluring manner. She whispered to him, "You're here?"
"Yeah!"
Connor nodded lightly.
"Please sit!"
Aida pointed at the chair opposite her and said calmly.
Connor didn't stand on ceremony and sat directly opposite Aida.
Aida poured a cup of tea for Connor.
Although Connor didn't really like tea, he could tell from Aida's movements that she was someone who liked tea very much.

chapters.title: Chapter 1655: An Empty Hard Disk
chapters.content:
Chapter 1655: An Empty Hard Disk
"This is top-notch black tea. You can try it and see how it tastes!"
Aida whispered to Connor.
"Aida, we don't know each other that well, so there's no need for the small talks. I'm not here to drink tea today. Let's just get straight to the point!"
Connor was not in the mood to talk nonsense with Aida at this time.
"Alright, let's get down to business!"
Aida looked at Connor and nodded gently, then continued, "Mr. McDonald, I didn't expect you to act so fast. In less than three days, you've already gotten evidence of Cielo's crime!"
"Your younger brother has done many heartless things in Yarlford. It's not difficult to find evidence of his crimes!"
Connor said calmly.
"Back then, I also investigated Cielo, but I didn't find any useful information at all. So, Mr. McDonald, your methods are much more brilliant!"
Aida said with a smile.
"There's one thing I don't understand!"
Connor looked at Aida and said.
"What is it?"
Aida asked.
"Although Cielo is not your biological brother, the two of you are still siblings. I don't understand why you would attack your own brother."
Connor looked at Aida and asked.
After hearing Connor's words, Aida could not help but hesitate for a couple of seconds before saying softly, "Cielo's mother killed my mother. Although Albert knew about this, he was afraid of the power of Cielo's mother's family, so he didn't dare to make a public announcement and even sided with Cielo's mother. There's actually no conflict between Cielo and me, and I don't want to do anything to him. I just want to become the head of the Collier family and avenge my mother. Now that Cielo has become my stumbling block, I want to get rid of him!"
"So, it's an internal strife in your family!"
Connor smiled faintly after hearing Aida's words, and then continued, "Since it's internal strife, I shouldn't have asked. Did you bring what I wanted?"
"Of course!"
Aida nodded gently, then looked at Connor and asked, "But I need to see what I want first!"
"No problem!"
Connor didn't waste any time. He took out a hard disk from his pocket and threw it on the table.
Aida picked up the hard drive and said softly, "Mr. McDonald, may I check this hard drive?"
"Of course!"
Connor nodded lightly.
Aida took out a laptop from behind her back and plugged the hard drive into it.
A few minutes later, Aida slowly closed her laptop and whispered to Connor, "Mr. McDonald, you're really resourceful!"
"If these two videos are handed over to the police, no matter how powerful the Collier family is, it will definitely be enough to put Cielo in jail for a few years. So, it shouldn't be too difficult for you to use this hard disk to get rid of Cielo!"
Connor said calmly to Aida.
"Of course!"
Aida nodded.
"Then, can you give me what I need?"
Connor looked at Aida and asked.
Aida smiled faintly after hearing Connor's words. Then, she took out a hard drive and placed it on the table. She whispered to Connor, "Mr. McDonald, this is what you want!"
Connor picked up the hard drive, feeling a little excited.
After all, Connor had worked so hard for so long just to get this hard disk.
"Alright, since you've already gotten what you want, and I've also gotten what I want, then the two of us will go our separate ways in the future. I'll be leaving now!"
Connor stood up and whispered to Aida.
"Goodbye!"
When Aida saw Connor leave, she smiled faintly.
Connor turned around and leave.
Aida looked at Connor's back and revealed a smug smile.
However, just as Connor was about to leave the room, he suddenly stopped and turned to look at Aida.
"Is there anything else?"
Aida asked Connor softly.
"Miss Collier, I seem to have forgotten to do something..."
Connor said with a smile.
"What is it?"
Aida's expression changed.
"Just now, you checked the hard drive I gave you, but I haven't checked the hard drive you gave me. Do you mind letting me use your laptop?"
Connor said with a smile.
"Of course not!"
Aida gently shook her head.
Connor was so excited after getting Yaakov Ward's hard disk that he forgot the most important thing.
He did not check the contents of the hard drive.
Aida wasn't a simple woman. Connor couldn't trust this woman 100%, so he had to check the hard disk in front of Aida. Otherwise, when Connor walked out of the private room, Aida would definitely deny it.
Connor walked up to Aida, took the laptop, and plugged the hard drive into the laptop.
Aida saw Connor plug in the hard drive, and a strange look flashed across her face. Her right hand slowly touched her inner thigh.
Connor tapped twice on the laptop and smiled helplessly.
"Miss Collier, isn't this a little unethical? You actually used an empty hard drive to fool me?"
Connor slowly raised his head and looked at Aida.
Connor's guess was right.
As expected, Aida did not intend to trade with Connor. The hard disk that Aida had given Connor was empty.
After hearing Connor's words, Aida revealed a shocked expression and said in a surprised tone, "Mr. McDonald, you must be joking. How can the hard drive be empty?"
"Take a look for yourself!"
Connor pushed the laptop in front of Aida and whispered to her.
Aida took the laptop and clicked on it casually. Then, she smiled at Connor and said, "Mr. McDonald, aren't you being too careless? The hard disk wasn't fully read when you plugged it in, but it's done now. Take a look!"
Aida said as she pushed the laptop in front of Connor.
"Is that so?"
Connor was a little puzzled, and then he looked down the laptop screen.
However, there was still no content on the hard drive.

chapters.title: Chapter 1656: Are You a Martial Artist Too?
chapters.content:
Chapter 1656: Are You a Martial Artist Too?
"Miss Collier, do you think I'm a fool?"
Connor frowned angrily, and then he suddenly looked at Aida.
However, the moment Connor raised his head, Aida took out the pistol she had prepared beforehand and aimed it at his head.
When Connor saw the pistol in Aida's hand, he couldn't help but sneer. Then he said lightly, "You're indeed an unethical person. You never planned to make a deal with me from the beginning, right? You're using me!"
"Looks like I've underestimated you. I didn't expect you to find out that this hard disk is empty. I was hoping you'd take the empty hard disk and leave, but I didn't expect you to find out. Since you've already found out, I can only kill you now!"
Aida said calmly to Connor.
"A woman's heart is really poisonous!"
Connor could not help but sigh softly, then continued, "I worked so hard to help you collect evidence of Cielo's crime, and this is how you treat me? Don't you feel bad?"
"You're too naive. The reason why I'm able to get to where I am today is because I have no conscience. In this society, conscience is the most useless thing!"
Aida said expressionlessly.
"Have you ever thought about the consequences if you kill me now? Aren't you worried that my people will take revenge on you?"
Connor looked at Aida and asked.
"I am!"
Aida nodded gently and continued, "But I believe the Collier family will help me deal with all this!"
"Do you think Albert Collier will help you?"
Connor couldn't help but laugh coldly. Then, he said expressionlessly, "Don't forget that I let you go that day, and Albert had already given up on you. If I hadn't been merciful at that time, you would be dead now. I really should have killed you then. If I had killed you, things would have been much easier!"
"It's a pity that you didn't kill me!"
Aida smiled disdainfully and continued, "I will kill you now and return the hard drive to Albert. This way, I will help Albert solve a big problem. Albert will definitely protect me."
"Looks like you've planned all of this!"
Connor was more or less shocked.
Although Connor knew that Aida wasn't a simple woman and was very shrewd, this was the first time he was seeing it for himself.
Aida had never intended to let Connor go from the start. Everything was part of her plan.
Once Connor died, Aida would not only be the hero of the Collier family, but no one would know that she had sneaked into the secret room and worked with Connor.
Therefore, Aida's plan was rather flawless.
"Are you that confident that you can kill me?"
Connor looked at Aida and asked.
"The gun is in my hand. If I want to kill you now, it's just a matter of moving my finger!"
Aida said lightly.
"Haha…"
When Connor heard Aida's words, he couldn't help but sneer. Then, he said indifferently, "You really underestimate me!"
"..."
A strange look flashed across Aida's face. She felt that Connor was stalling for time.
Therefore, she did not intend to continue talking nonsense with Connor and pulled the trigger.
Bang!
There was a loud bang.
The bullet flew directly toward Connor.
What happened next shocked Aida.
Because the bullet did not hit Connor.
"What's going on?"
Aida's face was filled with disbelief.
She had clearly aimed at Connor's head, but for some reason, the bullet seemed to have eyes and flew past Connor's head.
"Do you still think you can kill me now?"
Connor asked Aida expressionlessly.
"This is impossible!"
Aida shouted at Connor and pulled the trigger again.
But this time, the result was the same. The bullet brushed past Connor's head again.
After Connor finished cultivating the Chi Refining Technique, he could use the aura in his body to control the direction of the bullet. However, this could only change the direction of the bullet slightly. Moreover, it was only when the number of bullets was very small. If the number of bullets were to increase, Connor would not be able to do anything.
That was why Connor was so calm when he saw Aida take out her gun.
Because Connor knew that Aida's gun couldn't hurt him.
Aida couldn't understand why she couldn't hit him.
Aida felt as if she had seen a ghost.
"This is impossible!"
Aida shouted and then continued to pull the trigger.
However, the bullets still could not hit Connor.
"Do you still think you can kill me now?"
Connor asked Aida expressionlessly.
"..."
Aida looked at Connor and then grabbed the teapot on the table without thinking.
Aida's graceful and slender wrist gently flicked, and the teapot flew toward Connor.
However, Connor's reaction speed was also very fast. He turned his head slightly and then dodged the teapot.
"You're actually a martial artist too?"
Connor looked at Aida with a shocked expression. He knew that the teapot's flying speed and strength were very terrifying. A normal person would never have such great strength.
So the only explanation was that Aida was also a martial artist.
"That's right, I'm also a martial artist!"
Aida looked at Connor and nodded gently. Then, she reached out and slammed the table.
The table flew toward Connor.
Connor couldn't care less about the fact that Aida was a martial artist. He lifted his leg and kicked the table hard. The table that was flying toward Connor changed its direction and smashed toward Aida.
Aida's reaction speed was very fast. Her figure flashed, and she dodged the table.
Connor now knew that Aida had been acting in the secret room that day. With this woman's skills, she definitely would have been able to break free from him that day.
However, Aida did not want to expose the fact that she was also a martial artist, so she pretended to be weak.

chapters.title: Chapter 1657: I Don't Like Killing People
chapters.content:
Chapter 1657: I Don't Like Killing People
Connor hesitated for a moment before rushing toward Aida.
Aida lifted her slender and fair legs and wanted to kick Connor.
Bang!
With a loud bang, Connor grabbed Aida's ankle.
Aida was a little nervous because she did not expect Connor to improve so quickly.
If Connor was still the same as he was a few days ago, then Aida would still have a chance to defeat him.
But now, Aida had no chance at all.
After Connor grabbed Aida's ankle, he lifted her and flung her aside.
Aida was flung aside by Connor, and then her entire body smashed into the wall.
Aida struggled to stand up, but Connor didn't give her a chance. He lowered himself on top of Aida and grabbed her neck with his right hand.
In an instant, a suffocating feeling assaulted her.
Aida stared at Connor with her big watery eyes. She had completely given up resisting because she knew that Connor could break her neck with just a little force.
Connor used his body to press down on Aida's body. At this moment, Connor could clearly feel the temperature of Aida's body and her alluring fragrance.
Aida's body was very soft.
At this moment, Connor's chest was pressed against Aida's chest, and he could clearly feel Aida's fullness.
However, Connor was not in the mood to think about those things because he knew that this woman was very dangerous. If he was not careful, he would die in her hands.
"Do you still have any trump cards that you haven't shown?"
Connor whispered to Aida.
"I didn't expect you to be so powerful. It seems that I've underestimated you!"
Aida said coldly to Connor.
"I planned to make this deal with you, but I didn't expect you to plot against me. You asked for it!"
Connor said expressionlessly.
"..."
Aida looked at Connor without saying anything, as if she was thinking of a way to escape.
Where is Yaakov's hard drive?"
Connor looked at Aida and asked.
"If I give you the hard drive, are you going to kill me?"
Aida asked calmly.
"If you give me the hard drive now, I might let you go. Killing you won't do me any good. I don't like killing people!"
Connor replied.
"What if I don't give you the hard drive?"
Aida looked at Connor and asked.
"Then, I can only think of a way to get you to tell me the location of the hard drive!"
Connor replied indifferently.
"If you dare to touch me, I guarantee that you will never see this hard disk!"
Aida was a little angry as she shouted at Connor.
"Aida, do you really think I can't do anything to you? I don't intend to kill you, but I have a way to make you wish you were dead!"
Connor knew that ordinary methods would not work against a woman like Aida. Because Aida was not an ordinary person, Connor had made preparations before coming here.
And all that he was preparing for was to face situations like this.
"Connor, no matter what method you use, I won't tell you where the hard disk is!"
Aida didn't know if Connor would let her go if she told him the location of the hard disk, but she knew that as long as she didn't give the hard disk to Connor, he would never kill her.
Connor ignored Aida and took out a pill from his clothes and stuffed it into her mouth.
Connor pinched Aida's throat, and she swallowed the pill instinctively.
After seeing Aida eat the pill, Connor did not continue to control Aida. Instead, he let go of her and sat on the chair.
"What did you make me eat just now?"
Aida's face was filled with fear as she shouted at Connor.
"You'll know later. But don't worry, this pill won't take your life, but it will make you suffer!"
Connor replied with a smile.
After all, this was not the first time Connor had used this kind of medicinal pill. He was very familiar with the effect of this medicinal pill. No one could persist in front of this medicinal pill at all.
Aida was also a martial artist. She naturally knew that the pill she took was not something good, so she wanted to spit out the pill.
However, before she could spit out the pill, a sharp pain swept through her body.
"Ah…"
Aida hugged her head and screamed. She was filled with pain.
Aida did not expect Connor's pill to take effect so quickly. At this moment, Aida did not know how to describe her feelings.
Waves of heart-wrenrenching pain continued to engulf her body.
This kind of pain was not something that a normal person could withstand.
Aida was experiencing what it meant to be in a state where one's life was worse than death.
Connor was sitting on a chair, leisurely drinking tea. He was very calm.
Aida was rolling on the ground. Her face was twisted in agony. She no longer had the haughty look she had from before.
A few minutes later, Aida was about to collapse from the torture. She hugged Connor's thigh and begged him, "Please kill me!"
Connor glanced at Aida without saying anything.
Seeing that Connor was ignoring her, she wanted to end her own life. She slammed her head against the wall like a madman.
But Aida couldn't use any strength at the moment, so she naturally couldn't use this method to commit suicide.
"Help! Help!"
Aida began to shout like a madman.
However, she had already instructed the people in the teahouse not to let anyone in no matter what happened. Therefore, even if the people in the teahouse heard Aida scream, they would not dare to come in.
"I advise you not to waste your energy!"
Connor whispered to Aida.
"What... What do you want?"
Aida shouted at Connor.
"As long as you give me Yaakov's hard disk, I will give you the antidote!"
Connor said to Aida expressionlessly.
"Hard drive?"
Upon hearing Connor's words, a strange look flashed across Aida's face. Then, she gritted her teeth and said, "I won't give you the hard drive. Just kill me!"

chapters.title: Chapter 1658: Teaching Vanessa Canfield a lesson
chapters.content:
Chapter 1658: Teaching Vanessa Canfield a lesson
"Haha…"
Connor couldn't help but sneer when he heard Aida's words.
"Ah…"
At this moment, Aida let out another scream.
A few seconds later, Aida finally could not hold on any longer.
Her lips trembled as she shouted at Connor, "The hard disk is in my bag. Give me the antidote now!"
"Are you playing tricks on me again?"
Connor looked at Aida and asked.
"I'm not. I'm begging you, please give me the antidote!"
Aida begged in agony.
Connor didn't give the antidote to Aida first. Instead, he found the hard disk in Aida's bag and plugged it into the laptop. After taking a brief look, Connor took out the antidote.
After Aida received the antidote, she immediately threw it into her mouth.
A few seconds later, the pain in Aida's body disappeared. Then, her entire body went limp on the ground, and she looked extremely miserable.
Connor glanced at Aida and said expressionlessly, "If you had given me the hard drive in the first place, you wouldn't have had to suffer all this…"
"You better kill me now. Otherwise, I will never let you go!"
Aida whispered to Connor.
"I told you; I won't kill anyone!"
Connor expressionlessly replied, then walked out of the private room.
"Ah…"
Connor had just left when he heard Aida's scream.
It seemed that Aida had never suffered at the hands of anyone before; Connor was the first.
After getting Yaakov's hard disk, Connor went straight back to the Wallace family and told Rachel Wallace about his plans to return to Newtown.
After all, Connor had already gotten the hard drive, so there was no need for him to waste any more time in York.
Rachel wanted to stay in the Wallace family manor with Janson Wallace. After all, Janson might not have much time left, so she did not go back with Connor.
At two o'clock in the afternoon, Connor boarded the plane to Newtown alone.
When Connor arrived at Newtown, it was already past one in the morning.
However, Connor didn't go straight home. Instead, he called Reena Satchwell.
Fortunately, Reena wasn't resting, so Connor asked to meet her somewhere.
Once they met up, Connor had her make a copy of the contents of the hard drive and pick out evidence that wasn't important.
"Mr. McDonald, why do you want me to copy the contents of this hard disk?"
After copying the contents of the hard drive, Reena looked at Connor in confusion.
"I know you know a lot of people in Newtown. Send the contents I've picked out to those people!"
Connor replied expressionlessly.
"Alright, I got it!"
Reena looked at Connor and nodded lightly.
Connor wanted Reena to release the contents of the hard drive. After all, Connor had no way of contacting Yaakov now. If Yaakov saw the contents of the hard drive, he would definitely know that the hard drive had been leaked. Then, Yaakov would surely ask to meet Connor.
Moreover, the contents that Connor had picked out was not fatal to Yaakov, so Connor was not worried that the police would find Yaakov.
"Alright, if there's nothing else, I'll be leaving now. Sorry for making you meet me so late!"
Connor looked at Reena and said.
"Don't worry about it!"
Reena smiled as she replied.
Connor smiled faintly and then turned around to leave.
After that, Connor knew that the only thing he needed to do now was to wait patiently.
The contents of the hard drive were extremely lethal to Yaakov. Therefore, Connor knew that Yaakov wouldn't be able to sit still after seeing what Reena had released.
Connor could finally relax after being busy for such a long time, so he slept very soundly.
The next day.
After Connor woke up, he washed up briefly and then drove straight to the casino.
Connor had two things to do when he returned to Newtown.
The first thing was to deal with Yaakov. After all, Yaakov knew a lot about what happened back then. Therefore, Connor had to deal with Yaakov no matter what and ask him how his parents died back then.
The second thing was also very important to Connor, which was to deal with Vanessa Canfield.
Because Vanessa deliberately tricked Connor to send Chelsea Lee perfume. This had caused Connor to suffer a great deal, so he had to settle the score with Vanessa.
...
The casino that Connor had previously purchased was not open for business 247.
After all, if it was open 24 hours a day, it would attract a lot of unnecessary trouble. Even if this casino had solid background, Connor did not dare to be too arrogant, because if he went too far, it would definitely attract the dissatisfaction of the higher-ups.
Under normal circumstances, this casino would be open at night. It would open at eight o'clock in the evening and close at dawn the next day.
After the guests left, the staff began to clean up.
Heavens Club was already running perfectly, so Vanessa didn't need to watch over it.
But Connor had just bought the casino, so Vanessa put most of her energy on the casino.
When Connor found out that Vanessa was in the casino, he drove over there. He was determined to teach Vanessa a lesson today.
When Connor arrived at the casino, it was just past eight o'clock. The casino had just opened for business, so there were not many customers inside. Only after twelve o'clock midnight would there be more customers.
The employees in the casino also knew that the casino had changed owners, but in fact, very few people had actually seen Connor. On the contrary, they had seen Vanessa many times.
Therefore, when the waiter in the casino saw Connor, he thought that Connor was a guest, and Connor did not explain anything to the waiter.
However, when the lobby manager of the casino saw Connor, he was a little shocked. Although it was his first time meeting Connor, he had seen Connor's photo before, so he quickly walked up to him and said with a smile, "Mr. McDonald, you're here?"
"You know me?"
Connor asked the manager in confusion.
"Yes, of course I do…"
The manager nodded without thinking.

chapters.title: Chapter 1659: You Made a Mistake
chapters.content:
Chapter 1659: You Made a Mistake
"Where's Miss Canfield?"
Connor asked the manager.
"Miss Canfield is not here yet. She usually comes around midnight. After all, there aren't many customers now…"
The manager looked at Connor and said with a smile.
"Alright, I got it…"
Connor nodded lightly.
"Mr. McDonald, should I let you know when Miss Canfield arrives?"
The manager asked Connor with a smile.
All the employees felt that there was a special relationship between Vanessa and Connor. If it was just an ordinary superior-subordinate relationship, then why would Connor hand over such a large casino to Vanessa to manage?
Moreover, Vanessa was very sexy and beautiful. Any man who saw Vanessa would be tempted, so the employees in the casino all felt that Vanessa was Connor's lover.
"No. Go get busy!"
Connor looked at the manager and said.
"Alright…"
The manager nodded and turned to leave.
After the manager left, Connor began to wander around the casino alone.
At this time, there were not many customers in the casino. Most of them were small gamblers, and the real big gamblers would only come at midnight.
Connor had nothing better to do, so he exchanged some chips at the front desk and sat in front of the slot machine.
About two hours later, Connor had lost almost all his chips. He stood up helplessly and sighed softly, "My luck is pretty bad today…"
Connor had just finished speaking when he saw Vanessa walking into the casino in her high heels.
Today, Vanessa was still dressed very sexily. She was wearing a tight T-shirt and white denim shorts, revealing her sexy and seductive figure.
After entering the casino, Vanessa greeted everyone and then walked toward her office in her high heels.
Vanessa didn't like to wear uniforms. After all, uniforms weren't very comfortable, so she would wear her own clothes. She would only change into her uniform when she arrived at the casino.
Therefore, the first thing Vanessa did when she arrived at the casino was to change her clothes.
Connor hesitated for a moment before following Vanessa to the office.
Vanessa didn't know that Connor had returned to Newtown, so she didn't notice him.
After entering the office, Vanessa put down her bag and turned around to walk into the lounge.
Connor hesitated for a moment and didn't knock on the door. Instead, he went straight into Vanessa's office.
After entering Vanessa's office, Connor observed the situation in the office and noticed that there was no one in the office, so he placed his attention on the lounge.
At this moment, the office was very quiet. Connor could even hear the sound of clothes rustling.
"Is she changing again?"
Connor was a little puzzled, and then he walked over.
Connor walked to the door of the lounge. After hesitating for a couple of seconds, he reached out and pushed the door open.
When Connor pushed the door open, he realized that Vanessa was indeed changing.
Connor didn't know why, but every time he came looking for Vanessa, she was always getting changed.
Vanessa was currently wearing a very sexy lace underwear. In Connor's eyes, Vanessa's figure was simply the best among the best, as if her entire body was illustrating the word sexy. She was extremely alluring.
Vanessa didn't notice Connor at the door. She picked a pair of black stockings and walked to the bed, ready to put them on.
Connor hesitated for a moment. Since Vanessa played a trick on him, he was ready to make Vanessa embarrassed.
Connor reached out and pushed open the door of the lounge.
When Vanessa heard the sound of the door opening, she almost instinctively picked up the quilt at the side and turned to look in the direction of the door. After discovering that it was Connor, Vanessa was a little surprised. She didn't know when Connor had returned.
"Vanessa, you're here? I've been looking for you the whole night!"
Connor laughed and shouted at Vanessa.
"Connor, why did you come in? And why didn't you knock?"
Vanessa put the quilt in front of her and shouted at Connor.
"Well, I was looking for you, but I couldn't find you. I saw that the lights in this office weren't turned on, so I thought that there was no one here, that's why I came in..."
Connor said with a smile.
"..."
Vanessa was a little angry. She knew that Connor was talking nonsense, but she didn't want to argue with him about these things. She said expressionlessly, "Um, can you go out now? I'm changing, so I can't talk right now."
"Vanessa, I have something very important to tell you!"
Connor looked at Vanessa and said.
"Something very important?"
Vanessa couldn't help but be stunned for a moment after hearing Connor's words, then she frowned and said, "Can't you see that I'm changing now? Can't you wait until I'm done changing?"
"I can't…"
Connor didn't even think about it and shook his head, then walked over to Vanessa and said with a serious expression, "Vanessa, do you know that you've made a mistake?"
"I've made a mistake?"
When Vanessa heard Connor's words, she seemed to be even more puzzled.
However, on second thought, she knew what was going on. Connor must be talking about Chelsea's gift. He wanted to take revenge on her.
Vanessa looked at Connor and sneered, then said expressionlessly, "I really don't know what mistake I've made…"
It was obvious that Vanessa was also very curious about what excuse Connor would find to take revenge on her.
"You're late!"
Connor said seriously.
When Vanessa heard Connor's words, she was unusually speechless.
Because she didn't expect that Connor would find such a low-level excuse to take revenge on her.
"Being late isn't a big deal, right?"
Vanessa tidied up the quilt on her body and said expressionlessly.
"If you are only late once or twice, it might not be a big deal, but if you are late almost every day, then it becomes a big deal!"
Connor replied righteously, then took out his phone and said, "Our casino's rule is that you have to come to work at nine o'clock every night, but I didn't see you just now. You arrived at almost eleven o'clock. If all the employees come late like you, then how can we run our casino. We'll probably close down because of that…"

chapters.title: Chapter 1660: Intentionally Making Things Difficult
chapters.content:
Chapter 1660: Intentionally Making Things Difficult
When Vanessa heard Connor's words, she couldn't help but frown and then whispered, "It's not such a big deal, is it?"
"You're still arguing with me? You better give me an explanation now. Why are you late every day? You can't do whatever you want just because you're the general manager of the casino, right?"
Connor exclaimed.
Vanessa looked at Connor, and she was exasperated.
She knew that Connor was intentionally making things difficult for her.
Not only did she have to manage the casino business, but she also had to manage the club, so it was normal for her to be late.
Besides, it was not something she had not been doing all this while. Connor knew that she would only come in at such hours, but he had never said anything about. Now, he was intentionally making things difficult for her. If this wasn't intentional, what was it?
However, Vanessa didn't want to be too calculative with Connor about these things. All she wanted now was to get him out of here so that she could get changed. After all, she wasn't wearing anything now. If she kept on talking to Connor like this, it would be way too awkward.
So, Vanessa took a deep breath and tried to calm herself down. Then she said to Connor softly, "I'll explain this to you later. Can you leave now? I'm going to get changed…"
"No, you have to give me an explanation now!"
Connor shook his head. He had no intention of leaving.
In fact, Connor knew that Vanessa was not wearing any clothes now. He wanted to make Vanessa embarrassed.
After all, when Vanessa asked Connor to give Chelsea the perfume, it caused him to suffer.
He came here today to take revenge on Vanessa, and now was the best chance to do it.
Vanessa took a deep breath and then shouted at Connor, "Can you stop messing around? You should know better than anyone that I not only need to manage the casino but also the club. I'm in charge of the business of two companies alone, so can you really blame me for not making it to work on time? If you want me to come on time every day, that's fine. You can find someone else to manage the club or the casino. Do whatever you want…"
It was obvious that Vanessa was a little angry.
"If you're late, you're late. Don't use other things as an excuse. Besides, I heard that the club is being handled by others. You don't have much to do there."
Connor said seriously.
When Vanessa heard his response, she seemed even angrier. Her lips trembled as she said, "Are you really intentionally making things difficult for me because I'm late?"
"What else?"
Connor asked.
"I think you're just taking revenge on me. I asked you to give Chelsea the perfume, that's why you want to take revenge on me. I really didn't expect you to be so petty. You're so petty that you're making things difficult for me over being late…"
Vanessa looked at Connor and said.
"I'm petty?"
Connor was stunned for a moment, then he gritted his teeth and said, "Now that you mentioned it, then I'll be straightforward. Why did you play me for a fool? Do you know how badly that incident has affected me?"
"You deserved it!"
Vanessa pouted.
"How do I deserve it?"
In fact, Connor didn't understand how he had offended Vanessa, making her hate him so much.
"That's your own business. It has nothing to do with me. I have already explained everything to Chelsea. She also told me that if you dare to come and cause trouble for me, she will teach you a lesson. So, you better leave now. Otherwise, you can wait for Chelsea to come and teach you a lesson!"
Vanessa said haughtily.
"How dare you threaten me?"
Connor was a little angry when he heard her response.
"What can you do to me if I threaten you?"
Vanessa asked disdainfully.
"I have to teach you a lesson today. Otherwise, you won't know how powerful I am!"
Connor shouted, then without thinking, he reached out and pulled the quilt off Vanessa.
"Ah…"
Vanessa screamed instinctively.
She never thought that Connor would be so bold as to snatch the quilt off her body.
At this time, Connor didn't have any other thoughts in his mind. He just wanted to teach Vanessa a lesson, so he reached out and hugged Vanessa's slender and soft waist. Then he turned her over and lay her down on the bed,
Vanessa was only wearing underwear; her round buttocks were exposed to Connor's line of sight.
Connor's head heated up, but he didn't think too much about it. He then slapped Vanessa's butt.
"Who asked you to trick me…"
Connor slapped Vanessa's buttocks while cursing in a low voice.
In an instant, the sound of Connor slapping Vanessa's butt and his shouts resounded throughout the office.
After an unknown number of smacks, Connor finally vented his anger.
At this time, Vanessa's round buttocks was already all red.
Seeing that Connor had stopped, Vanessa struggled to get up. Then she stretched out her hands and scratched Connor's face.
Connor subconsciously resisted, but she pressed him down on the bed. She raised her small fist and smashed it against Connor's chest like crazy.
However, after hitting him a few times, Vanessa realized that Connor was unperturbed, so she grabbed Connor's arm and bit down hard.
"Ah…"
Connor screamed and then shouted at Vanessa, "Why are you biting me?"
"Connor, you're a scumbag. I was kind enough to help you manage the casino and club business, but you're actually bullying me like this. I quit. Go find someone else…"
After saying this, Vanessa buried her head between her legs and started crying softly.
Connor regained his composure after seeing Vanessa cry, and he became a little nervous.
He had never thought that things would turn out this way.
Connor had wanted to teach Vanessa a lesson and didn't have any other intentions.
But maybe it was because of Vanessa's disdainful attitude, Connor couldn't control his emotions.

chapters.title: Chapter 1661: Resignation
chapters.content:
Chapter 1661: Resignation
Vanessa was a very sexy woman, and with her tear-stained face, she looked extremely pitiful.
Connor felt bad. He regretted being so heavy-handed. He should not have gone so far.
"Vanessa, I'm sorry. I didn't control my emotions just now, but I didn't mean anything else. Can you forgive me?"
Connor said nervously.
Vanessa turned to look at Connor, then said coldly, "Connor, I won't be working for you anymore. You can go find someone else…"
"Vanessa, you don't have to resign just because of that. Aren't you being a little too impulsive? I admit that what I did just now was indeed wrong. Why not you hit me a few times or think of another way to get back at me? As long as you can vent your anger…"
Connor hurriedly said.
Vanessa wiped the tears from her face and said firmly, "I don't want to talk to you now. I've already made up my mind. Don't try to dissuade me. It's useless no matter what you say now…"
Connor was dumbfounded after seeing Vanessa's firm attitude.
It was only then that he realized that he had made a huge mistake.
Vanessa was obviously a very capable person. If she really were to resign, who would deal with the casino and the club?
Connor could not find a more suitable candidate.
In order to keep Vanessa, Connor did not forget to please Vanessa, but today, because of his impulse, Vanessa had to resign. How could Connor not be anxious?
If Vanessa really resigned, then it would be troublesome, so Connor sat in the same place, somewhat at a loss, not knowing what to do.
"What are you still sitting here for? Hurry up and get out!"
At this moment, Vanessa shouted at Connor.
"Okay, okay…"
At this time, Connor didn't dare to offend Vanessa. After saying that, he walked out of the lounge.
After leaving the lounge, Connor sat alone on the sofa in the office, waiting for Vanessa to come out.
He wanted to explain to Vanessa. After all, he didn't want to see Vanessa resign.
Connor sat on the sofa in the office and waited for almost half an hour. Vanessa finally came out of the lounge.
Vanessa had already changed into her uniform. She still looked very sexy and beautiful, but her eyes were a little red, probably because she had cried just now.
When Vanessa saw Connor, she shouted, "Why are you still here? Get out…"
"Vanessa, can you let me explain…"
Connor said helplessly.
"I don't want to hear anything right now, and I don't want to see you either. Please leave right this instant…"
Vanessa pointed at the door of the office and said to Connor with her big watery eyes.
Connor sighed helplessly. He also knew that Vanessa was angry. If he continued to talk to her, it would be counterproductive. It would be better to leave first and wait for her to calm down. Then, he would explain to Vanessa.
Therefore, Connor didn't say anything else and left the office.
Although it was wrong for Vanessa to ask Connor to give Chelsea the perfume, he felt that he had indeed crossed the line. Moreover, whether it was the casino or the club, these two places needed Vanessa, so Connor had to make her forgive him and continue to work by his side.
Sometimes, Connor felt very sad when he thought about it. A boss actually had to please his subordinates. What was going on?
Connor had nothing to do, so he walked around the hall.
He felt that he was all out of luck today, so he did not go to the casino to try his luck.
After all, Connor was not very interested in such things.
About an hour later, Connor finally saw Vanessa walk out of the office.
However, at this moment, Vanessa was accompanied by a staff member, and they looked very serious. They must be going to deal with something.
Connor also knew that there were many things going on in the casino now, and Vanessa definitely wasn't in the mood to talk to him, so he didn't take the initiative to talk to her.
Not long after, Vanessa had finished dealing with what was going on in the casino and was ready to return to her office.
But at this time, a man suddenly stopped Vanessa. Connor couldn't help but be stunned when he saw this man because Connor had seen this man at Vanessa's home. This man was Vanessa's ex-boyfriend, Tyler Freeman.
Tyler had been constantly harassing Vanessa, and at that time, Connor had even ruthlessly taught Tyler a lesson because of that, and he told Tyler not to harass Vanessa anymore.
However, a person like Tyler would never change. Today, he came to the casino to harass Vanessa.
Furthermore, Connor also noticed that there were two more bodyguards behind Tyler this time. He must have been scared after being beaten up by Connor last time, so he brought two bodyguards to boost his courage. Without these two bodyguards, Tyler would definitely not dare to come.
"Vanessa, please forgive me. I've made a huge mistake…"
Tyler stood in front of Vanessa and spoke to her with a very sincere tone.
"Tyler, are you done? Didn't I make myself clear to you last time? There's no longer any possibility between the two of us. Can you stop harassing me?!"
One could hear the disgust in Vanessa's tone.
"Can't you give me another chance? As long as you can be with me, I can give you anything. I can give you anything you want. You can live a life that everyone envies."
Tyler shouted.
When Vanessa heard Tyler's words, she looked somewhat disdainful as she said lightly, "Those things of yours are not attractive to me. You should go tell your lies to other little girls. Don't harass me anymore…"
"Vanessa, why can't you forgive me? It was indeed my fault back then. I regret it very much now. I hope you can forgive me. I swear that I will treat you well in the future…"
Tyler said relentlessly.

chapters.title: Chapter 1662: Mr. McDonald is Our Boss!
chapters.content:
Chapter 1662: Mr. McDonald is Our Boss!
"Why are you so disgusting? How many times have I told you that it's impossible for us to be together ever again? Get out of my way…"
After saying that, Vanessa turned around and wanted to leave.
Tyler grabbed Vanessa and exclaimed, "Vanessa, I'm begging you. Please give me another chance. Can you forgive me?"
Vanessa looked at Tyler, her eyes filled with helplessness. At this moment, she was speechless.
"Tyler, I don't want to make things ugly for you since we know each other. But you'd better let go of me. Otherwise, I will no longer hold back!"
Vanessa was not joking. After all, she was the general manager of this casino.
Now, as long as Vanessa said the word, the security guards in the casino would come to her aid.
However, Vanessa felt that this was her private matter and had nothing to do with the casino. In order not to disturb other guests, she would not do this unless it was absolutely necessary.
"Vanessa, if you don't forgive me today, I won't leave!"
Tyler shouted.
When Connor saw this scene, he knew that he had finally found a chance to make Vanessa forgive him, so he walked in front of Tyler and said to Tyler with a smile, "Looks like you've not learned your lesson from the last time I beat you up. Who gave you the courage to harass Vanessa?"
"It's you? Why are you here?"
Tyler looked at Connor and appeared somewhat surprised.
"Let go!"
Connor looked at Tyler and said expressionlessly.
"I won't let go!"
Tyler replied in a low voice.
"You won't let go?"
Connor laughed coldly, then picked up the fruit knife at the side and stabbed at Tyler's arm without thinking.
Tyler was shocked by Connor's action and hurriedly withdrew his hand. Then, he shouted at Connor, "Are you f*cking crazy?"
"I'm not in the mood to talk nonsense with you now. Last time, I warned you not to harass Vanessa again, but you are quite a disobedient guy."
Connor walked toward Tyler as he spoke.
The two bodyguards behind Tyler blocked Connor's path.
"What do you mean by this?"
Connor looked at the two bodyguards in front of Tyler and asked.
"Connor, we're in the casino. If you dare to make a move here, the two of us will be thrown out by the people in the casino."
Tyler pointed at Connor and shouted.
"Haha…"
Connor could not help but sneer when he heard Tyler's words.
At this moment, Tyler still did not know that Connor was the boss of this casino. Even if he beat Tyler up, the security guards in the casino would not dare to do anything to Connor. They might even help Connor beat him up.
"Tyler, leave right now!"
Vanessa frowned and said to Tyler.
Tyler sized up Connor and said in a low voice, "Vanessa, you don't want to be with me because of this poor loser?"
"This matter has nothing to do with Connor!"
Vanessa said helplessly.
"It must be related to this person!"
Tyler shouted.
"I'm asking you to leave this place now. Otherwise, you will regret it!"
Connor wasn't in the mood to explain these things to Tyler and said to Tyler expressionlessly.
When Tyler heard Connor's words, he couldn't help but be stunned for a moment. Then, he said in a disdainful tone, "Who do you think you are? Do you think I'll leave just because you ask me to? Do you know what this place is? If you dare to attack me, I guarantee that you won't be able to bear the consequences…"
When Tyler said this, he looked very arrogant.
After all, Tyler knew that this casino's boss had a very terrifying background, so he figured that Connor would not dare to make a move on him here.
Smack!
However, before Tyler could finish speaking, Connor ruthlessly slapped Tyler across the face.
Tyler was stunned. He was dumbfounded.
"How dare you hit me?"
Tyler's eyes widened as he shouted at Connor in shock.
"I already did. What can you do about it?"
Connor looked at Tyler and asked indifferently.
Tyler thought that no matter how bold Connor was, he would not lay a finger on him in this place.
But Tyler did not expect Connor to really make a move on him. Furthermore, it was a solid slap.
Vanessa looked at Tyler, feeling very helpless. She really couldn't understand why Tyler would always fall into Connor's hands.
"What are the security guards in this casino doing? Didn't you see this person hit me just now?"
Tyler knew that if he made a move, this matter would blow up.
Therefore, he did not let his bodyguards do anything. Instead, he shouted at the security guards outside.
When the security guards heard Tyler's words, they all revealed helpless smiles. Each and every one of them stood quietly on the spot, with no intention of making a move on Connor.
After all, they knew very well that Connor was the boss of this casino. Even if they were given a hundred guts, they would never dare to lay a hand on their boss!
When Tyler saw that the security guards outside did not move an inch, the expression on his face began to change. He could not understand what was going on. This casino had never allowed fights to happen in the casino, but Connor had clearly slapped him in front of these people just now, yet none of them reacted in any way. This was really too strange.
"What are you all standing there for? Just now, this kid slapped me, and you guys are pretending you didn't see it?"
Tyler shouted at the security guards present.
"Mr. McDonald is the boss of our casino. Just now, you were causing trouble in our casino and harassing our general manager. Mr. McDonald gave you a slap as a warning."
The security captain said to Tyler expressionlessly.
When Tyler heard the security captain's words, he was instantly stunned. He stared at Connor with wide eyes, and he was utterly shocked.
"What... What did you just say?"
Tyler stammered as he asked the security captain.
"I said that Mr. McDonald is the boss of our casino!"
The security captain replied indifferently.

chapters.title: Chapter 1663: A Small Lesson
chapters.content:
Chapter 1663: A Small Lesson
Tyler slowly turned to look at Connor. His face darkened considerably.
At this moment, Tyler didn't even know how to describe his feelings.
Originally, Tyler thought that Connor was just a poor loser and did not have any background to speak of.
If it wasn't for Vanessa, Tyler might not have had any interaction with a loser like Connor in his life.
But it had never even crossed Tyler's mind that Connor's background was actually so terrifying. Connor was actually the boss of this casino!
For a moment, Tyler was completely dumbfounded. He did not even know what he should do.
"Co... Connor, there might be a misunderstanding between the two of us. I'm really sorry. I'll leave with my people now…"
Tyler was not a fool. He knew very well that this casino was Connor's territory. If he continued to stay here and argue with Connor, then the one who would suffer in the end would definitely be him. Therefore, there was only one thought in Tyler's mind now, and that was to leave this casino.
Meanwhile, Connor looked at Tyler expressionlessly. He was extremely calm.
Tyler took a deep breath when he saw that Connor did not speak. He then turned and whispered to the person beside him, "Let's go!"
Tyler's bodyguards already knew what was going on, so they followed Tyler out of the casino without any hesitation.
"Tyler, isn't it too late for you to leave now?"
But at this moment, Connor's voice suddenly sounded from behind Tyler.
When Tyler heard Connor's words, his body could not help but tremble slightly. Then, he turned to look at Connor in trepidation and asked Connor in a low voice, "Is there anything else?"
"Have you forgotten what I told you last time?"
Connor asked Tyler coldly.
"What... What did you tell me?"
Tyler stuttered.
"I told you, if you dare to harass Vanessa again, I will break your legs!"
Connor replied softly.
"..."
When Tyler heard Connor's words, he was utterly stunned. He was scared. He hurriedly shouted loudly, "Connor, this all a misunderstanding. Please let me explain…"
"I'm not in the mood to listen to your explanation now. I've already warned you back then. You didn't know how to cherish the opportunity."
Connor replied indifferently and then said to the security captain, "Break this person's legs and throw him out!"
"Yes, sir!"
The security captain did not seem to have expected his new boss to be so cruel. However, he did not say much and led his men toward Tyler.
"Connor, please give me a chance."
"Vanessa, can you help me plead for mercy? I promise I won't come and harass you again…"
Tyler was completely dumbfounded when he saw the security guards walking toward him. He then shouted at Connor and Vanessa.
Vanessa knew in her heart that if they didn't teach Tyler a small lesson today, then Tyler would definitely continue to harass her in the future. Therefore, after Vanessa took a deep breath, she acted as if she didn't hear Tyler and turned around to walk upstairs.
Connor hesitated for a while before leaving with Vanessa. He knew that the security guards in the casino would be able to handle the rest.
When Tyler saw Connor and Vanessa leave just like that, he was stunned as he stood foolishly on the spot with despair.
"Ah!"
A few seconds later, Tyler let out a scream and was thrown out of the casino by the security guards.
After Tyler was thrown out by the security guards, the entire casino fell into silence.
Although Connor's way of dealing with Tyler today was a little cruel, he also wanted to take this opportunity to warn the others to not cause trouble in the casino.
After all, he had just taken over the casino. There must be a lot of people who were not sure about Connor's capabilities now. However, after this incident, Connor felt that those people in the casino would think twice before doing anything they would regret. This would make it easier for Vanessa to manage the casino in the future.
After dealing with Tyler, Connor followed Vanessa back to the office.
Although Vanessa knew that Connor had just helped her deal with Tyler, she still had not forgiven Connor. Seeing Connor follow her into the office, she said in an unusually cold voice, "Who told you to come in?"
"Vanessa, are you still angry with me?"
Connor smiled and asked Vanessa.
"I will never forgive you!"
Vanessa sat on the chair and said in a serious tone.
"Vanessa, I was wrong. I didn't control my emotions well just now. I've already apologized to you…"
Connor looked at Vanessa and explained helplessly.
"Do you think an apology is enough?"
Vanessa's beautiful eyes widened as she said angrily.
"I did go overboard just now, but Vanessa, I only did that because I was too emotional. If you knew what I had experienced, you wouldn't be so angry!"
Connor said with a very sincere attitude.
Vanessa couldn't help but be stunned after hearing Connor's words, and then she frowned and asked Connor, "What did you experience?"
"Chelsea lost sleep after smelling the perfume, and she didn't allow me to leave, so I could only stay at her house and be by her side. However, the two of us couldn't stand staying at home anymore, so we went out. However, we didn't expect to encounter assassins."
Connor looked at Vanessa and told her what happened.
"You two encountered an assassin?"
When Vanessa heard Connor's words, she appeared somewhat shocked.
"Yeah. If you don't believe me, you can call Chelsea now!"
Connor hurriedly said.
Vanessa looked at Connor, and she seemed to feel rather guilty about what happened.
After all, she asked Connor to deliver the perfume to Chelsea just to get revenge on him. However, she had never thought that it would cause such a big trouble.

chapters.title: Chapter 1664: Even
chapters.content:
Chapter 1664: Even
Connor saw the expression on Vanessa's face and knew that what he said just now was very effective.
So, he quickly told Vanessa about what happened. Connor deliberately made it sound very serious, which made Vanessa blame herself even more.
"Vanessa, you should know how capable I am. If it was under normal circumstances, those assassins would definitely not be my match. However, at that time, Chelsea and I had not slept for a day and a night. I was in no shape to deal with those assassins!"
Connor looked at Vanessa and continued.
At this time, Vanessa realized that her joke had gone a little too far, so she was very guilty. She asked Connor nervously, "Then… were you and Chelsea injured?"
"We didn't suffer any serious injuries. Chelsea almost drowned and was later rescued by me. The two of us were quite lucky. If not, we would have probably died…"
Connor hurriedly replied.
"This is all my fault. If I hadn't asked you to give Chelsea the perfume, things wouldn't have turned out like this. I was just joking at that time..."
Vanessa said to Connor with a guilty expression.
Connor looked at Vanessa and hesitated for a couple of seconds before saying softly, "Vanessa, there is actually something that I don't get…"
"What is it?"
Vanessa blinked and asked Connor.
"I have never offended you, and I didn't do anything to let you down. Why did you want to harm me?"
Connor asked in confusion.
"It's because..."
Vanessa was so anxious that she almost told him the truth, but she quickly calmed down and said lightly, "Actually, I didn't mean to harm you. I was just joking with you, but I didn't expect you to not even know that Chelsea was allergic to perfume…"
"I see…"
Connor could feel that Vanessa wasn't telling him the truth, but he didn't intend to continue asking. After all, the most important thing now was to coax Vanessa. Otherwise, if Vanessa really resigned, Connor really didn't know who would be able to manage the casino and the club.
"Vanessa, no matter what, I was indeed a little too impulsive today and even hit you. What can I do to make you forgive me?"
Connor asked Vanessa sincerely.
When Vanessa heard Connor's words, a strange look appeared on her face.
She felt ashamed whenever she thought about how Connor had slapped her butt.
"Although you've done something wrong, I did something wrong too. I've caused such a huge problem for you, so we're even now…"
Vanessa said softly to Connor.
Connor couldn't help but be stunned for a moment after hearing Vanessa's words. He then hurriedly said, "Vanessa, does that mean you'll forgive me?"
"I guess!"
Vanessa nodded lightly.
"Then, are you still planning to resign? This casino and the club really can't live without you now!"
Connor asked Vanessa.
Vanessa looked at Connor from head to toe and said with a smile, "I've already forgiven you. How can I resign?"
"That's great…"
Connor was really happy. Connor would do anything to keep Vanessa.
Seeing that Vanessa's mood seemed to have improved a lot, he took the initiative to chat with her for a while. When it was almost time, Connor asked, "Vanessa, why don't I send you home?"
"You won't say things like me leaving early, will you?"
Vanessa took out her phone and asked Connor softly.
"Vanessa, I was just joking with you. Don't take it seriously. After all, you have to take care of both the club and the casino. It doesn't matter if you're late or if you leave early…"
Connor hurriedly explained with a smile.
"Forget it. If you use this to make things difficult for me again, I won't be able to stand it!"
Vanessa pouted and said to Connor.
"Vanessa, I was really joking with you. Don't take it seriously. Anyway, there's nothing else to do in the casino now."
Connor advised softly.
Hearing Connor's words, Vanessa hesitated for a couple of seconds, then she said lightly, "Alright. Wait for me for a while. I'll go get changed!"
"Okay!"
Connor nodded.
Vanessa turned around and walked into the lounge. In order to prevent Connor from suddenly coming in, Vanessa locked the door this time.
When Connor heard the sound of the door locking, he seemed a little helpless. He sighed softly and said, "I've seen most of what I need to see. What's the use of locking the door now?"
Although Connor said so, he actually didn't have any intentions of peeping at Vanessa.
About ten minutes later, Connor left the casino with Vanessa, and then he drove her home.
Vanessa invited Connor to go upstairs to sit, but when he thought about them being alone, and her being so very alluring, he decided against it. If he were to go up, he might not be able to control himself, so Connor found an excuse to turn her down.
Connor then drove home alone.
Rachel Wallace was still in York with Janson Wallace, so no one was at home. Connor didn't know why, but it felt strange that Rachel wasn't at home. The room was very quiet.
Connor washed up and then lay on the bed to rest.
After settling Vanessa's matter, Connor only had one thing to do, and that was to wait for Yaakov Ward to contact him.
Yaakov was different from Tenner Ward. Connor had very little information about Yaakov now. Connor had never met Yaakov before. Even Tenner could not find Yaakov. Therefore, the easiest way was to wait for Yaakov to take the initiative to find Connor.
After all, Yaakov's hard drive was still in Connor's hands. Moreover, Connor had already asked Reena Satchwell to release a portion of the contents. Yaakov would definitely know that the hard drive was in Connor's hands. Connor felt that Yaakov would definitely take the initiative to contact him.
While thinking about all that, Connor slowly entered dreamland.

chapters.title: Chapter 1665: Mr. Ward's People
chapters.content:
Chapter 1665: Mr. Ward's People
The next day, 9 AM.
Connor was woken up by his phone.
"Hello?"
Connor answered the phone in a daze.
"Hello, Mr. McDonald!"
An unfamiliar woman's voice sounded on the other end of the phone.
"Who are you?"
Connor did not know the person on the other end of the phone, so he was a little more clear-headed.
"Mr. McDonald, you don't need to know who I am. There's someone who wants to meet you now."
The woman on the other end of the phone said very calmly.
"Someone wants to meet me?"
Connor was obviously stunned after hearing the woman's words. Then, he frowned and said, "Who exactly are you? Who wants to meet me?"
"Mr. McDonald, who is the person you want to see the most right now?"
The woman said lightly.
"You're working for Yaakov Ward?"
Connor asked in surprise.
"..."
After hearing Connor's words, the woman on the other end of the phone did not answer if she was working for Yaakov. Instead, she fell into silence.
"If you don't tell me who you are, I won't meet you!"
Connor said in a low voice.
"Mr. McDonald, I'm just a messenger. I'm not very clear about the specific situation. I don't know who wants to see you. My task is to tell you about it. If you don't want to meet the person, it's fine."
The woman said calmly.
"..."
Connor hesitated for a couple of seconds after hearing the woman's words. He felt that Yaakov had always been very cautious. Even if Yaakov wanted to meet him, he would never contact Connor personally. Moreover, he would not tell this woman his identity.
"When will we meet? Where should we meet?"
Connor asked in a low voice.
"Tonight, at eight o'clock, there will be a car picking you up at the central garden of Newtown. You can communicate with the driver then. You can only go alone. If you bring someone else with you, you won't be able to see the person you want to see!"
The woman said softly.
"Alright, I got it!"
Connor replied indifferently.
The woman hung up the phone after hearing Connor's words.
After putting down his phone, Connor sat on the bed alone with a conflicted expression on his face.
After all, Connor didn't know who the other party was, and he didn't know what their purpose was.
Connor considered for a long time whether he should call Thomas Morgan, but even if he called Thomas now, he wouldn't be able to come over immediately from Porthampton, and he couldn't help much, so Connor finally gave up the idea.
Although it would be very dangerous for Connor to go alone, he was not willing to give up this opportunity.
Connor stayed at home for an entire day. After all, there were indeed a lot of things that happened a while ago. Connor did not have the chance to rest well at all.
At 7 pm, Connor left the house alone and hailed a taxi to the central garden of Newtown.
The central garden of Newtown was considered a landmark in Newtown. It occupied a very large area, and the scenery inside was very beautiful.
At night, many people would go there for a stroll, including many young men and women who came out for dates.
Connor had been in Newtown for a long time. He had naturally heard of this place, but he had never been here before.
After arriving at the central garden, Connor stood at the entrance of the park and waited quietly.
Because Connor came out earlier, it was only around 7:30 pm. There was still half an hour left before they were supposed to meet.
Connor waited while observing the crowd coming and going.
In fact, sometimes Connor was very envious of these ordinary people. Although they were not as rich as him, they did not have Connor's troubles.
After Connor inherited Steven Lee's inheritance, although it greatly improved his life, it also brought a lot of trouble to him.
Sometimes, money was not everything in this world.
There were many things that money couldn't solve.
Money might be very important to ordinary people, but to people like Connor, it is just a number.
Connor waited quietly at the entrance of the central garden. Time passed by.
In the blink of an eye, half an hour had passed.
Connor took out his phone and looked at the time. He realized that it was already eight o'clock in the evening, but the other party still had not appeared.
"Am I being played?"
Connor was somewhat puzzled. At this moment, he was thinking whether he should leave this place first.
Because Connor felt that something was off. If the other party was not Yaakov's men, but the Collier family's men, then he might be in a perilous situation.
Just as Connor was hesitating, a black Mercedes-Benz slowly stopped beside him.
Connor looked at the Mercedes-Benz, but he didn't move.
The window of the Mercedes-Benz slowly rolled down. A middle-aged man sized up Connor and then asked softly, "You're waiting for someone, right?"
"Who are you?"
Connor asked the driver cautiously.
"I'm here to pick you up!"
The driver replied calmly.
"Who asked you to come and pick me up?"
Connor looked at the driver and continued to ask.
"Well…"
The driver looked a little awkward, as if he was unwilling to answer Connor's question.
"If you don't tell me who asked you to pick me up, I won't leave with you!"
Connor whispered to the driver.
The driver hesitated for a moment before saying softly, "I'm working for Mr. Ward. Mr. Ward asked me to come and pick you up!"
"Yaakov Ward?"
Connor was a little excited when he heard the driver's words.
"That's right!"
The driver didn't hide anything and nodded.
"Where is Yaakov now?"
Connor looked at the driver and asked.
"You'll know where Mr. Ward is waiting for you later. My task is to send you to Mr. Ward!"
The driver looked at Connor and said.
