Connor sized up the driver and didn't say anything. Although Connor didn't know what trick Yaakov was playing, he knew that this was the best chance for him to meet Yaakov. If he didn't meet Yaakov now, it wouldn't be easy to find him in the future.
"Mr. McDonald, please get in the car!"
Seeing that Connor was quiet, he invited him to get into the car.

chapters.title: Chapter 1666: Make Peace
chapters.content:
Chapter 1666: Make Peace
Connor looked at the driver and hesitated for a couple of seconds.
In the end, he chose to get into the Mercedes-Benz.
After getting into the car, the driver did not continue to talk to Connor. Instead, he started driving with a serious expression.
At this moment, Connor was still a little nervous. After all, he had been busy for so long, and he could finally see the person he wanted to see the most.
After all, Yaakov was the only person who might know how his parents died back then!
Connor had come to Newtown for two reasons. The first was to find Freya Phillips. Now that Freya had been found and her memories had been restored, Connor had completed his mission.
The second purpose was to find out why his parents died.
At this moment, Connor's mind was filled with a myriad of thoughts. He had been thinking about the various situations that he might encounter next and how he should deal with the possible situations.
Connor had a Chi Receiving Pill in his pocket, and his current cultivation level was comparable to a black-rank martial artist. As long as Yaakov didn't have an ancient martial arts grandmaster with him, Connor was confident that he could escape unscathed.
Even in the entire Oprana, the number of ancient martial arts grandmasters could be counted on one's fingers. Therefore, Connor felt that although Yaakov had a very terrifying network and background, he definitely did not have the ability to hire an ancient martial arts grandmaster to help him kill someone. If Yaakov really had such ability, then Yaakov did not need to meet him at all. He could just hire an ancient martial arts grandmaster to kill him.
Therefore, Connor felt that Yaakov wanted to meet him this time to negotiate with him.
This was also the reason why Connor dared to come alone.
Connor thought about these questions in his mind while observing the surrounding situation.
It was obvious that the driver had no intention of taking Connor around, nor did he want to blindfold Connor.
After Connor got into the car, the driver didn't say a word to Connor anymore. He just drove quietly.
Connor knew that he and the driver had arrived at the outskirts of Newtown.
Soon, the car stopped in front of a villa.
Connor subconsciously glanced at the villa. The villa was brightly lit and seemed very lively.
"Mr. McDonald, Mr. Ward is waiting for you here!"
The driver turned to look at Connor and said softly.
Connor took a deep breath, then reached out to push open the car door and got out.
The driver sat quietly on the spot, as if he had no intention of getting out of the car at all.
After getting off the car, Connor walked into the courtyard of the villa. The courtyard of the villa was very large. There was a swimming pool and a garden. Anything that you would expect to find in a luxurious villa could be found here.
However, Connor was not in the mood to appreciate these things at this time. He had been observing the situation in the villa with the Chi Observation Technique.
However, what surprised Connor was that there weren't many martial artists in this villa. At most, there were only five or six of them, and most of them were in low realms. This meant that there weren't any ambushes in this villa.
"Is Yaakov really planning to negotiate with me this time?"
Connor could not help but sigh to himself, then continued to walk forward.
After a while, Connor finally walked to the front door of the villa.
"Huff…"
Connor took a deep breath and slowly pressed the doorbell.
Connor was very nervous at this moment. After all, after waiting for such a long time, Connor was finally going to meet Yaakov. He seemed to be getting closer and closer to the truth of his parents' death.
Ding dong!
After the doorbell rang for a while, the door of the villa slowly opened.
A young man who looked like a bodyguard appeared in front of Connor. After sizing him up, he said softly, "Connor McDonald, right?"
"Where is Yaakov Ward?"
Connor was not in the mood to talk nonsense with this bodyguard and asked right away.
"Mr. Ward has been waiting in the villa for a long time. Please come in!"
The young man said to Connor very politely.
Connor hesitated for a moment and did not say anything else. He then walked into the villa.
After Connor entered the villa, he found a middle-aged man sitting on the sofa in the living room of the villa. The middle-aged man was staring at the TV in front of him. A football match was playing on the TV.
Behind the middle-aged man stood four bodyguards. These four bodyguards weren't very old, and they were all yellow-rank martial artists. They weren't very strong.
Connor knew that the middle-aged man sitting on the sofa was the person he had been looking for, Yaakov Ward, the person in charge of Rockefeller in Orilon!
Yaakov's appearance was actually very ordinary, and his temperament was also very easy-going. It was as if he did not look like someone who could rule the world in Orilon. On the contrary, he looked like an ordinary businessman.
This was Connor's first time meeting Yaakov, so he had a complicated feeling.
At this moment, Yaakov seemed to have noticed Connor. He slowly turned and looked at Connor. Then, he stood up and said to Connor with a smile, "Mr. McDonald, this is the first time we're meeting. Please forgive me for not welcoming you!"
"You are Yaakov Ward?"
Connor asked the middle-aged man expressionlessly.
The middle-aged man faintly smiled, then extended his right hand toward Connor and softly said, "That's right, I'm Yaakov Ward!"
Although there were many conflicts between Connor and Yaakov, the middle-aged man was still very polite to Connor. He even wanted to shake his hand.
However, Connor had no intention of shaking hands with Yaakov. Instead, he sat on the sofa.
When Yaakov saw how arrogant Connor was, a strange look flashed across his face, but he didn't say anything and sat down on the sofa.
"Didn't think you'd be in the mood to watch the game."
Connor turned to look at the TV and asked Yaakov with a smile.
"Mr. McDonald, what do you mean by that?"
Yaakov narrowed his eyes and asked softly.
"You know very well what I mean. Although we have never met, you should know very well why I came to Newtown and what you have done to me…"
Connor calmly replied to Yaakov.
Yaakov hesitated for a moment and said in a low voice, "Since you are being so straightforward, then I won't beat around the bush with you. The reason I invited you here today is to make peace."

chapters.title: Chapter 1667: What are the Benefits?
chapters.content:
Chapter 1667: What are the Benefits?
"Make peace with me?"
When Connor heard Yaakov's words, he couldn't help but laugh. Then, he said lightly, "How do you plan to make peace with me?"
"Mr. McDonald, your real enemy isn't me, but the entire Rockefeller. Everything I'm doing now is just following the instructions of the higher-ups in Rockefeller. To put it bluntly, there's no enmity between us."
Yaakov said with a smile.
Connor looked at Yaakov indifferently without saying anything. He was waiting for Yaakov to state his conditions.
"Mr. McDonald, I know that my hard disk is in your hands now. As long as you can return the hard disk to me, I can guarantee that I won't interfere in whatever the Empire World Corporation does in Orilon in the future."
Yaakov looked at Connor and continued.
When Connor heard Yaakov's words, he could not help but sneer, and then said indifferently, "Mr. Ward, didn't you say it yourself? What you did before was instructed by Rockefeller. If I return the hard disk to you now, how will you reject Rockefeller if they ask you to deal with me in the future?"
"Well…"
After hearing Connor's words, Yaakov was a little hesitant. It seemed that he did not know how to answer Connor's question, so he subconsciously looked at the bodyguards behind him.
When Connor saw this scene, he could not help but sneer. Then, he said indifferently, "Mr. Ward, since you already know that the hard drive is in my hands, and you invited me here today to make peace, then you should come forward and talk to me personally. Isn't it a little inappropriate to get a substitute to negotiate with me?"
The expression of the middle-aged man sitting on the sofa changed when he heard Connor's words.
"Mr. McDonald, what… what do you mean by that?"
The middle-aged man asked Connor nervously.
"Don't you know what I mean?"
Connor coldly asked, then continued, "You're not the real Yaakov Ward, so stop acting in front of me. Have Yaakov come out and talk to me personally!"
"..."
The middle-aged man looked at Connor and was dumbfounded. It seemed that he did not know how to deal with the current situation.
A bodyguard standing behind the middle-aged man smiled faintly and walked to the middle-aged man's side. He said in a low voice, "Looks like your acting skills are not up to standard. You can leave now!"
"Mr. Ward, I..."
The middle-aged man became even more nervous.
"I told you to leave!"
The bodyguard said coldly.
The middle-aged man took a deep breath and left helplessly.
Yaakov, who had been playing the role of a bodyguard, sat opposite Connor and said with a smile, "I didn't expect you to be able to tell that the person just now wasn't me. You aren't like what the rumors say. You aren't just a rich second-generation heir!"
"If I were really just an ordinary rich second-generation heir, would I have been able to force you to reveal yourself?"
Connor replied with a smile.
"That's true. From the beginning, all of us have underestimated you. This is also the reason why we've come this far!"
Yaakov looked at Connor and nodded lightly.
"Now, can the two of us have a good chat?"
Connor looked at Yaakov and asked.
"Of course!"
Yaakov agreed and continued, "Mr. McDonald, my hard disk is in your hands now. This hard disk is very important to me, so I hope you can return it to me!"
"What benefits can I get if I return the hard drive to you?"
Connor narrowed his eyes and asked Yaakov.
"Of course, there are benefits."
Yaakov looked at Connor and smiled, then continued, "Mr. McDonald, as long as you can return the hard disk to me, I can guarantee that my people will never hurt you and the people around you again. We will mind our own business in the future, and I will not obstruct the Empire World Corporation's development in Orilon!"
"If the people of Rockefeller want you to deal with me, what do you plan to do?"
Connor looked at Yaakov and asked.
In fact, from the moment he entered the villa, Connor had already noticed that the middle-aged man sitting on the sofa was not the real Yaakov.
The reason was very simple. If the middle-aged man on the sofa was really Yaakov, he wouldn't be so nervous when he saw Connor for the first time.
No matter what, for Yaakov to be able to reach this point, he would definitely not be so easily perturbed. Therefore, even though he knew that Connor had a hard disk that could kill him, him asking to meet Connor on his own terms was something that ordinary people could not do.
The reason why the middle-aged man was so nervous was because he was worried that his identity would be seen through by Connor.
Of course, this didn't mean that the middle-aged man wasn't Yaakov.
More importantly, this middle-aged man shook hands with Connor on his own accord. Connor felt that if the middle-aged man was really Yaakov, he would not be the one offering to take Connor's hand.
Because the more proactive one was, the more disadvantaged they would be in the upcoming negotiations.
From the beginning, Yaakov had been pressuring Connor, trying to tell Connor that he had not really walked onto a dead end and had not completely admitted defeat.
Therefore, Connor felt that the middle-aged man was showing weakness by taking the initiative to shake his hand. This was not Yaakov's style at all.
Just because of these two reasons, Connor was certain that the middle-aged man was not Yaakov.
The real Yaakov was also in this living room.
After hearing Connor's question, Yaakov hesitated for a few seconds and said softly, "Mr. McDonald, I am one of Rockefeller's men. It is my job to carry out the orders of the higher-ups, so if the higher-ups want me to deal with you, then I have no other choice. I can only choose to deal with you, but as for whether I can complete the task given to me by the higher-ups, isn't that another matter altogether?"
Connor smiled faintly after hearing Yaakov's words. Actually, what Yaakov meant was simple. In the future, Yaakov would definitely do things according to Rockefeller's instructions. However, he could inform Connor in advance. This way, he could complete the mission given by Rockefeller without hurting Connor. This was indeed the best of both worlds.
"It doesn't matter if you fail once, but if you fail too many times, aren't you worried that the people in Rockefeller will suspect you?"
Connor asked Yaakov expressionlessly.

chapters.title: Chapter 1668: My Parents' Cause of Death
chapters.content:
Chapter 1668: My Parents' Cause of Death
"Mr. McDonald, you don't have to worry about this. The upper echelons of Rockefeller already realized that it won't be easy to deal with you.
"So even if I fail again and again, they won't suspect anything!
Yaakov paused for a moment and then continued, "Moreover, Mr. McDonald, your real objective is to deal with the entire Rockefeller, so I don't think you will stay in Newtown for too long. Therefore, I won't have a lot of chances to attack you!"
"Haha…"
Connor couldn't help but laugh when he heard Yaakov's words. Then, he said indifferently, "Mr. Ward, you're indeed very thoughtful!"
"Mr. McDonald, we did have some conflicts with each other, but in the end, I was only doing things for Rockefeller. There is no personal grudge between the two of us, so I hope that through today's meeting, the two of us can resolve all the misunderstandings we h ave. This is good for both of us, don't you think so?"
Yaakov said calmly to Connor.
Connor looked at Yaakov and hesitated for a couple of seconds before saying softly, "Mr. Ward, I don't know if you've ever considered one problem."
"What is it?"
Yaakov asked calmly.
"If I didn't return the hard drive to you and kept it in my hands, would I be able to achieve the same effect as before? I could use this hard drive to threaten you."
Connor said with a smile.
"You can't threaten me with this hard disk!"
Yaakov lightly shook his head.
"Why?"
Connor asked in confusion.
"Mr. McDonald, the contents of this hard disk are indeed fatal to me. However, don't forget that no one in the entire Orilon knows who I am. Moreover, my influence in Orilon is beyond your imagination…
"If you hand over the hard drive to the police, I can find someone to help me take the blame. This way, it won't affect me very much. So, if you plan to use this hard drive to threaten me, I'm afraid it might disappoint you!"
Yaakov explained with a smile.
Connor smiled faintly and didn't say anything.
In fact, Connor had long realized that this hard disk might not be able to kill Yaakov.
"Mr. McDonald, the cooperation method I just mentioned is probably the best method we have, so I hope you can consider it carefully!"
Yaakov looked at Connor and continued.
After hearing Yaakov's words, Connor could not help but hesitate for a couple of seconds before saying softly, "Mr. Ward, the real reason I came to Newtown is not to deal with Rockefeller, but to find out the truth about something!"
"What is it?"
Yaakov was stunned for a moment and asked Connor softly.
"I want to know how my parents died back then!"
Connor replied.
"..."
When Yaakov heard Connor's words, he was instantly stunned. A strange look flashed across his face.
"All the evidence I have now points to you killing my parents. If that's the case, I will avenge my parents no matter what price I have to pay. If you didn't kill my parents, I might let you go."
Connor said to Yaakov expressionlessly.
"..."
Yaakov sized up Connor and said in a low voice, "Do you know that your father, Dawson McDonald, was one of Rockefeller's people?"
"Yes!"
Connor nodded.
"Your father's death involves many internal matters in Rockefeller, so I can't tell you what happened!"
Yaakov looked at Connor and continued.
"Does my parents' death have anything to do with you?"
Connor looked at Yaakov and asked.
"No comment!"
Yaakov shook his head.
"It seems that you don't intend to negotiate with me properly..."
Connor gritted his teeth and said in a low voice.
"Mr. McDonald, I know that you came to Newtown to investigate the cause of your parents' death, but I still have to say this. There are some things that I can say, but there are some things that I can't. If I reveal the secrets of Rockefeller to you now, then I will really die. So, if you intend to use this hard disk to exchange for the cause of your parents' death, then that's just too naive of you!"
Yaakov said to Connor with a serious tone.
The hard disk in Connor's hand was very important to Yaakov, and it would cause his downfall.
However, if Yaakov betrayed Rockefeller, it would also cause his downfall.
Yaakov had always been very careful in protecting his identity, so not many people in Oprana knew his true identity.
However, Rockefeller had a very comprehensive grasp of Yaakov's information. It would be very easy for them to deal with Yaakov.
"Mr. Ward, you might not know what the current situation entails. I admit that the hard drive in my hand might not be able to kill you, but don't forget that I'm sitting in front of you now. If I want to kill you, I can do so very easily. The bodyguards you have here will not be able to stop me."
Connor seemed to be a little agitated as he shouted at Yaakov.
"Mr. McDonald, I think it's better for you to cooperate with me. This will benefit both of us!"
Yaakov said calmly to Connor.
"Looks like I have to use force with you!"
Connor replied in a low voice and then slowly stood up.
Connor knew that there was no point in continuing to talk to Yaakov like this. The reason why he went through so much trouble to find the hard disk was not to use it to deal with Yaakov. He never intended to use the hard disk to make Yaakov tell the truth.
Connor's true goal was to lure Yaakov out and then deal with him.
Seeing Connor stand up, all the bodyguards behind Yaakov stood in front of him.
"Mr. McDonald, I advise you to calm down!"
Yaakov expressionlessly said to Connor.
As for Connor, it was as if he did not hear Yaakov's words. He continued to walk toward Yaakov.
"What are you doing? You better stop, or else we won't hold back!"
One of the bodyguards shouted at Connor when he saw that Connor was still approaching Yaakov.

chapters.title: Chapter 1669: Disciples of the Heavenly Sect
chapters.content:
Chapter 1669: Disciples of the Heavenly Sect
"You think you can stop me with just you people?"
Connor looked at the bodyguards standing in front of Yaakov with disdain.
"Attack!"
One of the bodyguards shouted after hearing Connor's words.
In an instant, more than a dozen bodyguards rushed toward Connor.
The leader of the bodyguards was the strongest, a true advanced yellow-rank martial artist.
After the bodyguard rushed in front of Connor, he raised his fist and smashed it toward Connor's head.
Bang!
However, at this moment, Connor raised his leg and kicked the bodyguard in the stomach.
The bodyguard's body flew out in an instant and then smashed into Yaakov's feet.
The bodyguard groaned as he struggled to stand up.
However, no matter how he struggled, he could not get up. In the end, he fainted.
When the bodyguards saw this scene, they all revealed shocked expressions.
They did not think that Connor would have such terrifying strength at such a young age.
However, these people did not give up and continued to rush toward Connor.
These bodyguards were all martial artists. Even in the entire Orilon, few people had the ability to find so many martial artists as bodyguards.
Any one of these bodyguards would be a very powerful existence in Orilon. It was already very impressive for an ordinary rich man to have such a bodyguard protecting him.
However, no one expected that these bodyguards would be so vulnerable in front of Connor.
In less than half a minute, Yaakov's bodyguards were all lying on the ground, their faces twisted in pain.
When Yaakov saw this scene, a strange look flashed across his face, but he seemed to have been mentally prepared for this.
After all, Yaakov knew that Connor had defeated Wadi Jimenez, so Connor's strength was naturally not to be underestimated.
Connor walked up to Yaakov and sized him up. He said to Yaakov softly, "Can you tell me the truth now?"
"Mr. McDonald, do you think I didn't consider that you would attack me when I invited you here today?"
Yaakov sat on the sofa and replied calmly.
"Of course, I've considered that!"
Connor nodded gently and continued, "I know you have other trump cards in your hands that you haven't shown yet, but since I dared to come to you alone today, it means that I've already prepared myself to deal with all your methods. So, if you still have any trump cards, I advise you to quickly show them now. Otherwise, you might not have this chance later!"
"He's really young and frivolous!"
Just as Connor finished speaking, a voice sounded in the living room.
Connor slowly raised his head and looked over. He realized that it was actually a middle-aged man walking over slowly.
The middle-aged man looked very ordinary, but the aura on his body was extraordinary. Connor could feel that this middle-aged man's ancient martial arts realm was probably higher than his. This person was probably Yaakov's trump card.
"Mr. McDonald, you're here?"
When Yaakov saw the middle-aged man, he quickly stood up and greeted him.
From this, it could be seen that this middle-aged man was not Yaakov's subordinate. Otherwise, Yaakov would not have such an attitude.
"Mr. Ward, leave the kid to me!"
The middle-aged man said to Yaakov softly.
"Alright!"
Yaakov hurriedly nodded.
The middle-aged man walked up to Connor, sized him up and said softly, "You are Connor McDonald?"
"That's right!"
Connor lightly nodded.
"You probably don't know who I am. Let me introduce myself. My name is Maurice Collier, and my master is Beau Collier!"
The middle-aged man said expressionlessly.
"Are you from the Heavenly Sect?"
Connor asked in a low voice.
"That's right, I'm a disciple of the Heavenly Sect!"
Maurice nodded and continued, "The hard drive in your hand was stolen from the Collier family's secret chamber. If you return the hard drive to me now, I can spare your life today. If you're not willing to hand over the hard drive, then be prepared for what's about to happen!"
Connor looked at Maurice and didn't say anything. At this moment, he already knew that the Collier family had already joined forces with Yaakov.
The Collier family had a lot of influence in York, but not in Newtown.
Therefore, the Collier family was responsible for sending people, and Yaakov was responsible for luring Connor out.
The purpose was to kill Connor and take back the hard disk.
To put it simply, Yaakov felt that the hard drive was far more dangerous in Connor's hands than in the hands of the Collier family. After all, Connor intended to kill Yaakov, while the Collier family only hoped to obtain some benefits through the hard drive. Therefore, choosing to cooperate with the Collier family was his best choice.
"You're Mr. Yarrell's disciple. The Heavenly Sect doesn't want to have any conflicts with the Purple Cloud Sect. So as long as you can return the hard disk to us, the Collier family can let bygones be bygones!"
Maurice was still a little afraid of Connor's identity as the young sect leader of the Purple Cloud Sect, so he was not willing to really attack Connor.
"If Beau had told me this personally, I might have considered it, but you don't have the right to say such things to me!"
Connor said to Maurice expressionlessly.
"I don't have the right?"
When Maurice heard Connor's words, he couldn't help but sneer. Then, he said in a low voice, "Looks like you won't be afraid unless you're about to die. Today, I'll let you see if I have the right!"
After saying that, Maurice soared into the air and rushed toward Connor. Then, he turned and slapped Connor on the chest.
Although this was only the first time the two of them were fighting, Maurice knew that Connor was strong. Therefore, he used all his strength this time. Moreover, the move he used was also the unique move of the Heavenly Sect, the Vajra Palm.
Maurice's speed was very fast, and the power of his palm strike was also very shocking.
Connor didn't even have time to eat the Chi Receiving Pill as Maurice had already rushed in front of him.
Connor didn't hesitate at all and placed his hands in front of his chest.
Bang!
There was a loud bang.
Maurice's palm landed on Connor's arm.
Connor took a few steps back to stabilize his body, and a huge hole appeared in the wall behind him.

chapters.title: Chapter 1670: Killing Mercilessly
chapters.content:
Chapter 1670: Killing Mercilessly
It was obvious that Chen Ming's Vajra Palm was very powerful.
Not only did it pass through Connor's body, but it also caused such terrifying damage.
Fortunately, there was no one behind Connor. If there was someone standing behind Connor, he would probably die on the spot under this palm.
When Maurice saw that Connor had blocked his palm, he was a little shocked. He said in a low voice, "You broke through to black rank?"
According to the Collier family's information, although Connor's strength was extraordinary, he hadn't broken through to black rank yet.
But if Connor wasn't a black rank, he definitely wouldn't have been able to block his palm.
"He was a yellow rank, but now he's a black rank!"
Connor said as he took out three Chi Receiving Pills and threw them into his mouth.
Connor's level had been rising very quickly recently, and he was already at the peak of the yellow rank. However, he was still a bit away from the black rank, so he could only use the Chi Receiving Pill to increase his ancient martial arts level.
"How is this possible?"
Maurice's expression was one of shock.
After all, Maurice was a real black rank and had been training with Beau since he was young. He only broke through to black rank at the age of forty, and this achievement was considered above average for normal martial artists. Although it couldn't be compared to those ancient martial geniuses, it was still a pretty good achievement for a normal person.
However, Maurice never expected Connor to become a black rank at such a young age.
Such achievements were rare even in the entire Oprana ancient martial arts world!
Yaakov had a strange look on his face. Although he wasn't a martial artist, he knew what it meant for Connor to become a black rank at such a young age.
If this person was Yaakov's friend, then Yaakov would definitely be very happy. After all, Connor's future in ancient martial arts would definitely be limitless.
However, this person was Yaakov's enemy.
Therefore, Yaakov only had one thought in his mind, and that was to get rid of Connor immediately no matter what. Otherwise, Connor would definitely become a huge threat to him in the future.
"I didn't expect you to reach such a level at such a young age. No wonder Jorge Yarrell took you in as his disciple. If you were given a few more years, I'm afraid even I wouldn't be your match. It's a pity that you're not my match yet!"
Maurice said to Connor expressionlessly.
"Whether or not I'm your opponent is not up to you to decide. Stop talking nonsense and let's fight!"
Connor didn't want to waste the Chi Receiving Pill, so he replied coldly.
"Brat, today I'll let you experience what it means to meet someone better than you!"
Maurice growled and immediately rushed toward Connor.
Connor took a deep breath and stepped forward.
At this moment, Connor only had one goal. Although Maurice's strength was indeed very terrifying, he still had the strength to fight with Maurice after taking the Chi Receiving Pill. Even if he couldn't defeat Maurice today, he would definitely be able to retreat unscathed. Therefore, Connor didn't have the slightest bit of fear in his heart at this moment.
Boom!
There was a loud bang.
Connor's fist and Maurice's fist collided fiercely. An incomparably powerful aura erupted from their bodies, and the things around them were instantly sent flying by this aura.
When Yaakov saw this scene, he could not help but take a deep breath.
He knew clearly in his heart that the strength of a martial artist was not something that ordinary people could imagine at all.
Whether it was Connor or Yaakov, the combat strength of these two people could instantly kill him.
Sometimes, no matter how much power and wealth one had, in the face of absolute strength, all those things did not matter.
However, after the second exchange between Connor and Maurice, Maurice seemed to be even more shocked. He could clearly feel that Connor's strength was even more terrifying than before.
Maurice quickly recalled the pill that Connor had just consumed and the words that Connor had just said.
However, Maurice was no longer in the mood to think about these things. After the first exchange, he launched a second attack on Connor.
Maurice was a genuine black rank, and he was at the peak of the intermediate stage. He was only one step away from the advanced stage, so his strength was very terrifying.
Maurice waved his right hand, and a black aura flew toward Connor.
Connor could tell that Maurice's aura was very destructive. Maurice was also a martial artist whose strength was second only to Faris Jimenez and Bill Johnsonn.
Therefore, Connor did not dare to be careless. He hurriedly turned to dodge Maurice's aura.
Boom!
There was a loud bang.
Although the black aura did not hit Connor, it hit the wall behind him.
The bodyguards who had been knocked unconscious by Connor were unfortunately hit by this aura.
These bodyguards were all yellow-rank martial artists, but they were defenseless against the black aura.
In less than a moment, they were swept up by this black aura and instantly crushed into powder.
When Connor saw this scene, a strange look flashed across his face.
He had never expected Maurice to be so ruthless to the point where he did not even intend to let these bodyguards off.
These bodyguards were all Yaakov's bodyguards!
Even when Connor fought with these bodyguards, he did not kill them. After all, the matter between him and Yaakov had nothing to do with these bodyguards.
However, Maurice did not even blink and killed these bodyguards. Maurice was indeed ruthless.
Of course, in Maurice's eyes, his purpose this time was to protect Yaakov and take back the hard disk from Connor.
As for the life and death of the others, they had nothing to do with Maurice. Therefore, Maurice did not even consider whether his attack would affect the others.
Connor hesitated for a moment before rushing toward Maurice again. He raised his right hand and punched Maurice in the chest.
Maurice did not expect Connor's speed to be so shocking, nor did he expect Connor's strength to be so terrifying.

chapters.title: Chapter 1671: Ensnaring Heavenly Dragon!
chapters.content:
Chapter 1671: Ensnaring Heavenly Dragon!
Boom!
There was a loud bang.
Connor's fist landed directly on Maurice's chest.
Maurice took a few steps back before he managed to stabilize his body.
When Yaakov saw this scene, he appeared a little nervous.
This was because he had originally thought that Maurice would be able to easily get rid of Connor if he were to personally take action.
However, he never expected Connor's strength to be so terrifying. He could even fight back and forth with Maurice.
Yaakov was extremely worried. If Maurice really lost to Connor, then he would end up in a miserable state.
After a brief observation of his surroundings, he felt that even if he stayed here, he would not be of much help. He might even implicate Maurice, so he turned around and ran out of the villa.
When Connor saw that Yaakov was about to escape, a strange look flashed across his face. Then, he waved his right hand.
A rock was thrown at Yaakov.
Bang!
The rock smashed into Yaakov's thigh.
"Ah…"
Yaakov screamed out of instinct and fell to the ground. His face was twisted in pain.
Connor glanced at Yaakov indifferently and ignored him.
At this moment, Yaakov's legs had already been broken by Connor, so Connor was not worried that Yaakov would escape. This way, he could focus on dealing with Maurice.
Maurice turned and glanced at Yaakov. After confirming that Yaakov was not seriously injured, he did not continue to pay attention to him. Instead, he waved his right hand.
In an instant, an incomparably powerful aura surged between heaven and earth.
Under the control of this aura, all the tables and chairs in Yaakov's house flew toward Connor.
Although the furniture was very ordinary, because Maurice was controlling it, the force of the furniture was still very shocking. It could instantly kill a martial artist below the yellow rank.
When Connor saw the furniture flying toward him, he was still very calm. His aura rushed out from his body and split the furniture in front of him into two halves.
When Maurice saw this scene, he frowned. He realized that he had underestimated Connor.
Connor's improvement had far exceeded the information he had obtained from the Collier family.
At that time, Maurice thought that Connor was just an ordinary martial artist. However, he did not expect Connor to have such terrifying progress in less than half a month.
However, just as Maurice was in shock, Connor had already rushed in front of him and thrown a punch.
Maurice hurriedly condensed an aura to shield his body.
Bang!
Connor's fist ruthlessly smashed into the aura in front of Maurice. At this moment, Connor felt as if his fist had smashed into an iron plate.
"Your meagre strength can't hurt me!"
Maurice looked at Connor with disdain.
"Is that so?"
Connor couldn't help but sneer when he heard Maurice's words.
In the next second, the black aura that was originally blocking Maurice's path turned into countless fragments.
However, it wasn't broken by Connor's punch.
It was Maurice who shattered it. The fragments flew toward Connor like bullets.
Connor was somewhat shocked. He hurriedly turned his body to dodge these fragments.
However, the number of these fragments was too shocking. Connor had no way to avoid all of them.
For a moment, countless fragments flew past Connor's body.
Connor's body was cut by these fragments, and there were many wounds that were oozing with blood.
When Yaakov saw that, he looked a little excited.
After all, Maurice had been fighting with Connor for a long time. This was the first time Maurice had the upper hand.
However, when Maurice saw this scene, he became a little solemn. Although the shards did hurt Connor, it was only a small scratch. These injuries could not take Connor's life. They could not even seriously injure Connor. This was not the effect that Maurice wanted.
"You really do have some skills…"
Maurice looked at Connor and sighed softly.
"I've also underestimated your ability!"
Connor whispered back to Maurice.
When Maurice heard Connor's words, he could not help but sneer. Then, he said indifferently, "Don't be so naive as to think that I can't do anything to you today just because you dodged my move…"
After saying that, Maurice raised his hands above his head.
Countless black auras began to gather above Maurice's head.
Connor narrowed his eyes and looked at Maurice. He became somewhat nervous because he could clearly feel that the aura above Maurice's head was extremely powerful. Even the aura around Connor's body began to gradually change and surge.
A few seconds later, the aura above Maurice's head slowly formed a ball.
However, the size of the ball was still shrinking. This meant that Maurice had been continuously condensing the aura. Once the aura exploded, it would be like a bomb that could raze the entire villa to the ground.
Connor was vexed because this was the first time he was facing such a move.
None of the martial artists Connor had encountered before were able to condense their aura to this extent.
"Connor, take this!"
Maurice shouted at Connor.
In an instant, the black sphere was like a time bomb, smashing toward Connor.
Connor knew very well that if he chose to fight head-on, even if he could resolve Maurice's move, he would definitely be seriously injured.
Maurice did not use this move to defeat Connor. On the contrary, he was using it to exhaust Connor.
"I wonder if the Seven-Star Big Dipper Fist can resolve this move!"
Connor took a deep breath, and then began to circulate the Seven-Star Big Dipper Fist in his body.
Connor's body started to slowly flow with his breath.
Maurice narrowed his eyes and looked at Connor. At this moment, he was still very curious about how Connor planned to resolve this move.
"Seven-Star Big Dipper Fist, Ensnaring Heavenly Dragon!"
Connor growled.
In an instant, countless white auras condensed on Connor's fist.
Connor's figure flashed as he charged toward the black ball. Then, he violently punched the black ball.

chapters.title: Chapter 1672: Terrifying Power
chapters.content:
Chapter 1672: Terrifying Power
Boom!
There was another loud noise.
Connor's fist collided with the black sphere.
However, what Maurice did not expect was that when his black sphere came into contact with Connor, it did not explode. Instead, it changed its direction and flew toward him.
"What move is this?"
Maurice seemed to be completely shocked by the scene in front of him. He was in disbelief.
Originally, Maurice planned to use this move to exhaust Connor's stamina. However, he didn't expect Connor to be able to send this aura back to him intact.
"Mr. Maurice, be careful!"
Yaakov hurriedly shouted with a nervous expression on his face when he saw Maurice standing still.
Since Maurice could use this move, he definitely had a way to counter it.
Therefore, Maurice quickly waved his right hand and a cold light flashed.
This cold light cut his black ball into two halves.
Boom!
The black sphere exploded instantly, giving off the feeling that it was a time bomb that had exploded.
The originally magnificent villa collapsed instantly. It was razed to the ground by this bomb, and countless sand and dust flew in all directions.
Even the people within a hundred miles could clearly hear the explosion.
In just an instant, a three-story villa that occupied nearly a few thousand square meters was blown into powder. How terrifying was this power!
A moment later, the smoke and dust gradually dispersed.
Connor was still standing at his original position. He was extremely calm, as if he was not affected by the explosion at all.
Maurice stood opposite Connor with a calm expression.
Maurice had used his aura to protect Yaakov during the explosion, so Yaakov was fine. As for the others in the villa, they were probably already dead.
Yaakov stared at Maurice and Connor with his eyes wide open, fear written all over his face.
At this moment, Yaakov finally realized how terrifying a black rank was.
Although Yaakov often came into contact with black-rank martial artists, he didn't have an understanding of their true strength.
This time, he finally understood that a black rank could kill him with a simple flick of his finger.
If Maurice had not helped him withstand the impact of the explosion just now, he might have died like the bodyguards.
Perhaps it was because the sound of the explosion was too loud that it attracted the attention of many people.
The sound of the explosion just now sounded like a bomb or a meteorite that had smashed into Yaakov's villa.
However, even with such a terrifying explosion, no police came over to take a look. This was because Yaakov had already informed them that no matter what happened, the police were not to interfere.
Yaakov was an influential figure in Newtown, so having that done was not difficult for him.
"You are indeed powerful. If I had not made sufficient preparations, I might have really lost to you today…"
Maurice said to Connor expressionlessly.
"You can't beat me today. I already know how strong you are!"
Connor replied indifferently.
"Do you think that was my full strength just now?"
Maurice sneered and said, "You are really too naive…"
"Isn't it true?"
Connor looked at Maurice and asked softly.
"Today, I'll let you know the difference between the two of us!"
Maurice replied expressionlessly and then rushed toward Connor.
Connor and Maurice were once again entangled in battle. At this time, it was a competition of their reaction speed and the toughness of their bodies.
In the forest not far from the villa, a sexy woman in a tight black shirt stood beside an old man, nervously observing the situation inside the villa.
At this moment, the battle between Connor and Maurice seemed to have entered its climax.
"When are we going to attack?"
Waverly Green could feel that Connor was at a disadvantage right now. After all, Maurice was a true black-rank martial artist, and Connor was only at the peak of the yellow rank. Although Connor could fight with Maurice with the help of the Chi Receiving Pill, he was still at a disadvantage. If this continued on, Connor would definitely lose to Maurice in the end.
"Sect Leader asked us to come and protect Sect Leader McDonald, but he is not in any danger now, so we don't have to rush to attack!"
The Second Elder replied indifferently.
"But if something really happens to Sect Leader McDonald, wouldn't it be too late for the two of us to make a move?"
Waverly hurriedly said.
"Don't worry, Sect Leader McDonald should be able to hold on for a while longer. Although he is at a disadvantage now, this doesn't mean that he will definitely lose today!"
The Second Elder analyzed in a low voice.
When Waverly heard this, her expression softened a little.
"I didn't expect that in just a short two months of not meeting, Sect Leader McDonald's strength has already improved to such a terrifying realm!"
The Second Elder continued to sigh.
"Sect Leader McDonald's control over the Chi Refining Technique is also becoming more and more proficient. No wonder Sect Leader Yarrell would take Sect Leader McDonald as a disciple. Although Sect Leader McDonald isn't hardworking enough, his talent is definitely one of the best!"
Waverly couldn't help but comment.
After all, Connor had made great progress compared to his previous self in Honduria.
"Sect Leader Yarrell is the person I admire the most in my life. The person he fancies is definitely someone capable!"
The Second Elder paused for a moment and then continued, "And this battle is very important to the Sect Leader McDonald. If he can defeat Maurice, then he can break through to black rank. Sect Leader McDonald's chances in actual combat are good, so unless it's absolutely necessary, you and I shouldn't interfere!"
"Sect Leader McDonald only started practicing ancient martial arts a while back, and he's already a black rank. It's rather unbelievable!"
Waverly said in surprise.
"Sect Leader McDonald is the future hope of the Purple Cloud Sect. Just this bit of achievement is far from enough. Sooner or later, he will be able to amaze the entire Oprana ancient martial arts world!"
The second elder commented with a very serious expression.
When Waverly heard Second Elder's words, she could not help but be stunned for a moment. She was a little shocked.

chapters.title: Chapter 1673: Heavenly Dragon Transformation!
chapters.content:
Chapter 1673: Heavenly Dragon Transformation!
Boom!
However, just as Waverly was about to speak, another loud sound came from the villa.
Connor and Maurice both retreated. Although Maurice had the upper hand in the battle just now, he did not gain any advantage.
Maurice felt that if he continued to fight with Connor like this, it would be very disadvantageous for him. Because Connor had the Chi Receiving Pill in his body, Connor's aura was inexhaustible. However, Maurice was constantly consuming his aura. This was definitely not a good thing for him, so he chose to stay away from Connor.
After they parted, Connor adjusted the aura in his body.
Meanwhile, Maurice took a deep breath. Countless black auras gathered like a tide.
Maurice, as a black rank, was very skilled in controlling the aura of the world. He could even compare to an ancient grandmaster.
A moment later, the black aura gradually condensed into the shape of a giant dragon.
"Connor, I'll show you the ultimate technique of the Heavenly Sect today!"
Maurice sneered and then shouted in a low voice, "Heavenly Dragon Transformation!"
After Maurice shouted, the giant dragon that was completely condensed from Maurice's aura charged toward Connor.
This dragon gave off a feeling as if it had an aura that could destroy the world.
In an instant, Connor heard the sound of ten thousand horses galloping.
"This must be your trump card."
Connor narrowed his eyes and looked at the dragon in front of him as he asked in a low voice.
"..."
Maurice looked at Connor without saying anything.
In the next second, Connor did not choose to dodge. Instead, he rushed toward the black dragon.
When Maurice saw Connor charging at the dragon, he looked a little proud. Although the dragon looked illusory, it was actually formed by the aura in Maurice's body. Its toughness was even comparable to a tank.
Therefore, Connor's current behavior of charging at the dragon gave people the feeling that he was an ordinary person trying to stop a tank with his bare hands. He was overestimating himself.
"Forget about a cultivator, even a thousand soldiers and horses can forget about stopping this Heavenly Dragon. Connor, you will definitely lose today!"
Maurice looked at Connor and sighed softly.
When Waverly and Second Elder saw this scene, they seemed to be very worried.
"Second Elder, do you think Sect Leader McDonald can withstand Maurice's move?"
Waverly turned to look at Second Elder and asked nervously.
"I'm not very sure either, but if I were to face this move, I definitely wouldn't be able to use this method to break it…"
Second Elder said slowly.
After hearing Second Elder's words, Waverly seemed to become even more anxious. After all, if even Second Elder could not break this move, Connor would definitely not be able to block it either.
"But you don't have to worry too much now. Since Sect Leader McDonald has chosen such a method, he must be very confident!"
Second Elder seemed to sense Waverly's worries, so he gently responded.
"What confidence? Second Elder, even you can't block this move, so how could Sect Leader McDonald possibly block it?"
Waverly shouted anxiously.
"You don't…"
Second Elder wanted to convince Waverly, but before he could say anything, he heard Connor's furious roar.
"Seven-Star Big Dipper Fist, Tiger's Roar!"
In the next second, Connor's fist smashed onto the dragon head.
In an instant, it was as if the entire world had become quiet.
Connor stood in front of the dragon and punched the head of the dragon.
Yaakov, Second Elder, Waverly, and Maurice both focused their attention on Connor.
However, a few seconds later, Maurice's giant dragon let out a roar. The black aura surrounding the giant dragon's body began to slowly dissipate.
"How... How is this possible?"
When Maurice saw this scene, his face was filled with disbelief.
This was because he could clearly sense that the dragon's energy was beginning to rapidly disappear.
"Break!"
However, at this moment, Connor suddenly shouted.
Boom!
The giant dragon that was originally blocking Connor's path actually exploded in an instant, then turned into streams of black aura that dissipated between heaven and earth.
Maurice stared at Connor with wide eyes, as if he could not believe his eyes. He was very clear about the power of his move. Even an ancient martial arts grandmaster standing in front of him wouldn't be able to resolve this move so easily.
However, he never expected Connor to resolve it in such a way.
"Sect Leader McDonald is actually so powerful?"
Waverly could not help but exclaim.
Second Elder heard Waverly's words, and his face was filled with pride. He then laughed and said to Waverly, "I have already told you not to worry. The young sect leader chose to use this method to deal with Maurice's move, which means that he must be very confident…"
"Yeah, my worries just now might have been a little unnecessary!"
Waverly nodded excitedly.
"Connor, how did you do it just now?"
Maurice shouted at with his eyes wide open.
"You should be concerned about how you're going to take my next move!"
Connor replied indifferently.
"Seven-Star Big Dipper Fist, Crane's Cry!"
Connor was like a bolt of lightning as he charged toward Maurice.
At this moment, Maurice still seemed shocked by how Connor had done it, so he did not react at all to the fact that Connor had already rushed in front of him.
Boom!
Connor's fist landed directly on Maurice's chest.
Maurice's body was instantly sent flying.
In the next second, Connor leaned forward and punched out again.
Connor's actions were extremely coherent, not giving Maurice any chance to react.
In just an instant, Maurice took two punches from Connor.
Boom!
Maurice's body slammed into the ground.
Yaakov's face was filled with fear when he saw this scene. He didn't expect Connor to beat Maurice to the ground.
After Maurice fell to the ground, Connor didn't even give him a chance to get up. He swiftly landed, and then he lifted his leg and stepped on Maurice's head.

chapters.title: Chapter 1674: Main Person-in-Charge
chapters.content:
Chapter 1674: Main Person-in-Charge
No one had expected Maurice to be like a dead dog and be trampled under Connor's feet.
Initially, Yaakov thought that Maurice was his last hope. However, he had not expected Maurice to be defeated in such a manner.
Maurice struggled to stand up, but Connor was too strong. In addition, he had just taken two punches from Connor, so he did not have the strength to stand up at all.
"You lost!"
Connor whispered to Maurice.
"I didn't think I would lose to you!"
Maurice gritted his teeth and shouted at Connor.
"I told you long ago that you're not my match!"
Connor replied expressionlessly. Then, he reached into his clothes and took out a pistol, aiming it at Maurice's head.
When Maurice saw the pistol that Connor took out, he was a little fearful. He stammered and asked Connor, "What are you doing?"
"Don't you know what I'm doing?"
Connor asked Maurice coldly.
"Connor, I told you that my master is Beau Collier, and I'm from the Collier family of York. I'm a disciple of the Heavenly Sect. If you dare to kill me, you won't have a good ending!"
Maurice had never thought that Connor would actually want to kill him. He hurriedly shouted at Connor.
"I won't have a good ending?"
Connor couldn't help but sneer when he heard Maurice's words. Then, he said indifferently, "I'm really curious about what will happen!"
Bang!
After saying that, Connor raised his right foot high and stomped on Maurice's head.
Originally, Connor wanted to use his gun to kill Maurice. However, he felt that there was no need to waste time on such a person, so he chose the simplest and most direct method.
Yaakov stared at Connor with wide eyes, fear written all over his face.
He had never thought that Connor would be so bold as to kill Maurice.
After Waverly and Second Elder saw Connor kill Maurice, they quickly walked to his side.
"Waverly, Second Elder, when did you two arrive?"
When Connor saw these two people who suddenly appeared, he seemed to be a little surprised.
After all, he didn't tell anyone that he wanted to meet with Yaakov. Even Rachel Wallace and Thomas Morgan didn't know about this.
"Sect Leader McDonald, the two of us have been secretly protecting you to prevent any accidents from happening!"
Second Elder explained respectfully.
"I see!"
Connor nodded lightly, then turned to look at Maurice's corpse and said in a low voice, "Do the two of you have a way to deal with this person?"
"Of course!"
Second Elder nodded gently and took out a small jade bottle from his clothes. He poured the liquid in the bottle onto Maurice's body.
In just a few moments, Maurice's corpse completely disappeared from this world.
Yaakov became even more fearful when he saw this scene.
Connor ignored what happened. He slowly walked up to Yaakov.
At this moment, Yaakov's legs had been broken by the rock, and he could not stand up at all.
"Connor, what… what do you want?"
Yaakov asked Connor with a trembling voice.
"Although this is the first time the two of us are meeting, it's not the first time you've set me up. Moreover, you even attacked the people around me, so you should know very well what I want to do!"
Connor replied indifferently.
"Connor, listen to me. I did set you up, but those things were done by Rockefeller's people. It has nothing to do with me…"
Yaakov explained anxiously.
"No matter if it's you or those people in Rockefeller, I won't let you off!"
Connor paused for a moment and then continued, "I'll give you a chance now. Tell me everything you know. If I'm in a good mood, I might spare your life. If you don't cooperate with me…"
"What... what do you want to know?"
Yaakov swallowed hard and asked Connor nervously.
"Were you the one who planned my parents' car accident back then?"
Connor looked at Yaakov and asked.
"No…"
Yaakov hurriedly shook his head.
"Haha…"
Connor couldn't help but sneer when he heard Yaakov's words. Then, he turned to Second Elder and asked, "Second Elder, is there any way to make this person tell me the truth?"
"Of course, there is a way…"
Second Elder replied with a smile and then walked toward Yaakov.
When Yaakov saw Second Elder walking over, he seemed to become even more scared. He hurriedly shouted, "Connor, don't torture me. I can tell you anything you want to know. There's really no need for me to lie to you at this point…"
Connor looked at Yaakov indifferently, then said softly, "I just want to know how my parents died back then!"
"..."
Yaakov looked at Connor and hesitated for a moment. Then, he gritted his teeth and said in a low voice, "Your father was also a member of Rockefeller. You know that, right?"
"Yes!"
Connor nodded.
"Back then, your father and I were indeed competing for the position of the person-in-charge of Orilon. There were some conflicts between the two of us, but no matter what, I was not bold enough to kill your father."
Yaakov said to Connor with trepidation.
"Who killed my father?!"
Connor gritted his teeth and asked in a low voice.
"This person… This person is the main person-in-charge of Rockefeller in Oprana!"
Yaakov said helplessly.
"The main person-in-charge of Rockefeller in Oprana?"
When Connor heard Yaakov's words, he frowned.
"That's right. The main person-in-charge of Rockefeller in Oprana is called Yamino Gomez. The people in charge of our other provinces are all managed by him. Your father was also Yamino Gomez's subordinate back then…"
Yaakov looked at Connor and said.
"Then, why did he kill my father?"
Connor frowned and asked.
Connor still couldn't believe Yaakov.
"This…"
Yaakov looked at Connor and seemed a little troubled.

chapters.title: Chapter 1675: Interrogation
chapters.content:
Chapter 1675: Interrogation
"My patience is limited!"
Connor coldly reminded.
"Huff…"
Yaakov took a deep breath and said in a low voice, "Your father's car accident was indeed arranged by me, but it was not my intention. I was just following Yamino's instructions. Yamino promised me that as long as I arranged the car accident and killed your father, I would be able to become the person-in-charge of Honduria. At that time, I was only a small city person-in-charge. I did not have the courage to go against Yamino's wishes, so that car accident happened because of that!"
"Let me ask you this, as the person-in-charge of Oprana, why did Yamino attack my father?"
Connor asked Yaakov in a low voice.
"Because your father threatened his position at that time, and your father had a lot of information about Yamino. Once your father handed this information to the people at the headquarters, Yamino's position as the main person-in-charge would be lost. That's why Yamino killed your father!"
Yaakov looked at Connor as he explained.
After hearing Yaakov's words, Connor was in disbelief. Because he thought that the death of his parents might have been caused by Yaakov alone in order to compete for the position of the person-in-charge of Honduria. However, he had never imagined that there was an even more unbelievable truth behind all this.
The person who really wanted to kill his father was not Yaakov, but the main person-in-charge of Rockefeller in Oprana, Yamino Gomez.
"Connor, I'm telling you the truth. Back then, your father and I were just competitors. The two of us weren't about to kill each other because of that!"
Seeing that Connor didn't say anything, Yaakov hurriedly shouted at Connor.
"You just said that Yamino asked you to kill my father. Do you have any evidence to prove this?"
Connor looked at Yaakov and asked.
"Evidence?"
Upon hearing Connor's words, Yaakov could not help but be stunned for a moment. Then, he said in a low voice, "How could I have any evidence? But what I said is true. At this point, there's no need for me to lie to you. After all, I've already admitted that I was the one who arranged your father's car accident…"
"If Yamino really wanted to attack my father, why didn't he do it himself? Why did he ask you to do it?"
Connor then asked.
"Yamino is the main person-in-charge of Rockefeller in Oprana. At that time, the headquarters had already heard about the relationship between your father and Yamino. If Yamino were to get rid of your father himself, then he would surely be the main suspect. If Oprana's Rockefeller were to find out, Yamino might not be able to keep his position, but if I did it, then Yamino could use his connections to protect me."
Yaakov explained without thinking.
Connor looked at Yaakov and fell into deep thought.
At this moment, Connor had a rather complicated feeling. He thought that Yaakov was the culprit who killed his parents, but he never expected that there would be a higher-level figure involved in this.
Therefore, Connor didn't know what to do now. He couldn't even tell if what Yaakov said was true or false.
"Connor, believe me. Everything I said is true. I really have no reason to lie to you now…"
Yaakov seemed to know that Connor didn't believe him, so he hurriedly shouted at Connor.
Connor looked at Yaakov indifferently and didn't say anything.
"Sect Leader McDonald!"
Waverly suddenly exclaimed.
"What's wrong?"
Connor turned to look at Waverly.
"Sect Leader McDonald, if you are not sure whether this person is telling the truth or not, I have an idea…"
Waverly said softly.
"What is it?"
Connor asked.
"There is a kind of pill in the Purple Cloud Sect that is specially refined for interrogating criminals. As long as someone eats the pill, no matter what you ask him, he will tell the truth."
Waverly said softly.
After hearing Waverly's words, Yaakov became scared. He hurriedly shouted, "Connor, I've already told you everything I know. Don't let these people take me away!"
"I can't be sure if what you said is true or not. Now, I have a chance to prove it to you. I think Waverly's suggestion is a good one!"
Connor replied indifferently, then turned to Waverly and said, "Since the Purple Cloud Sect has a way to make this person tell the truth, then I'll have to trouble you and Second Elder to bring this person to the Purple Cloud Sect!"
"Alright!"
Waverly hurriedly nodded.
"Connor, you can't let these people take me away. If I go missing, the people of Rockefeller will definitely notice!"
Yaakov yelled desperately.
"Even if I don't let them take you away now and leave you behind, Rockefeller's people will definitely find a way to find you. So, you might as well follow the two of them back to the Purple Cloud Sect. At the very least, you don't have to worry about being chased by Rockefeller's people!"
Connor softly explained to Yaakov.
When Yaakov heard Connor's words, a strange look flashed across his face. He felt that what Connor said was very reasonable.
No matter what, if he went to the Purple Cloud Sect, his life would not be in danger.
Therefore, Yaakov thought for a moment and didn't say anything else.
"Sect Leader McDonald, there is no time to lose. If there is nothing else, Waverly and I will leave with this person!"
Second Elder knew that the fight between Connor and Maurice had caused quite a commotion, so he felt that Connor and the others should not stay in this place for too long.
"Okay!"
Connor looked at Second Elder and nodded.
Second Elder walked up to Yaakov and slashed at his neck with his hand. Yaakov instantly fainted.
Then, Second Elder carried Yaakov and walked toward the parking lot in the distance.
Waverly hesitated for a moment before she whispered to Connor, "Sect Leader McDonald, we'll take our leave now!"
"Waverly and Second Elder, thank you!"
Connor said softly.
"Sect Leader McDonald, you don't have to thank us! Protecting you is our responsibility!"
Waverly hurriedly smiled and replied.
"By the way, how is Yelena Allen?"
Connor suddenly asked.

chapters.title: Chapter 1676: The Collie Family's Benefits
chapters.content:
Chapter 1676: The Collie Family's Benefits
Ever since Connor's last departure from Honduria, he had been engrossed in researching ways to confront Yaakov. Consequently, he remained oblivious to Yelena's situation.
Waverly's tone was tinged with confusion as she addressed Connor, "Miss Yelena took the recovery medicine upon her arrival at Purple Cloud Sect. After resting for a few days, she woke up. I explained the situation to her, and after expressing her gratitude, she left the Purple Cloud Sect. It seems she has gone abroad. Has she not contacted you, Sect Leader McDonald?"
Connor gazed at her and gently shook his head. He knew his previous conversation with Yelena had been rather harsh, and she probably wanted nothing to do with him now.
"Oh, I see," Waverly nodded slightly and continued, "Sect Leader McDonald, even though I'm not certain about your relationship with Miss Yelena, I know her feelings for you run quite deep."
Perplexed, he asked, "Why do you say that?"
"When Miss Yelena was unconscious, she kept calling out your name," she softly replied.
Upon hearing her words, he fell into silence.
With a cheerful smile, she said, "Well then, Sect Leader McDonald, if there's nothing else, shall we leave?"
"Sure." He nodded, acknowledging her with a faint smile.
After a moment's hesitation, Waverly turned and departed.
Left alone, Connor stood in the same spot, his mind in turmoil. He had initially believed that finding Yaakov would lead to avenging his parents. However, upon hearing Yaakov's revelations, he now suspected a deeper conspiracy behind their deaths. Seeking revenge for his parents seemed far more complicated than he had imagined. But he wasn't certain whether Yaakov's words were truthful or deceptive. So, he had no choice but to patiently await news from the Second Elder.
After Second Elder and Waverly took Yaakov and left, Connor departed Yaakov's mansion alone.
The mansion lay in ruins, a scene of desolation. However, he wasn't concerned; he knew someone would clean up the mess.
...
On the other side, within the Collier family's mansion in York.
The mansion was aglow with lights, its grandeur unmatched. The top echelons of the Collier family had gathered, recognizing the significance of this evening.
Beau instructed Maurice to eliminate Connor. If he succeeded, tranquility would be restored. But if he failed, it would spell calamity for them.
Hence, anxiety etched the faces of the Collier family's high-ranking members.
Standing before a window, Beau stared outside with a grave expression, his thoughts hidden.
"Mr. Beau, there's bad news!" At that very moment, a suited bodyguard burst into the room, his voice tinged with anxiousness.
Taken aback by the bodyguard's words, Beau's expression turned unusual. He quickly turned and asked, "Is there news from Maurice?"
"Maurice is dead!" The bodyguard's words were grim, his teeth clenched.
"What? Maurice is dead?"
"How's that possible? How could Maurice die?"
Shock washed over everyone in the Collier family. Their expressions held disbelief, even Albert's face displayed astonishment.
"How did Maurice die? Did Connor kill him?"
Beau tried to control his emotions and asked the bodyguard in a low voice.
The bodyguard hesitated before answering in a hushed tone, "Yes. Maurice was killed by Connor. Maurice was no match for him..."
Upon hearing this, the expressions on the faces of the Collier family members grew even more astonished, bordering on incredulity.
"How is that possible? Maurice couldn't even match that brat's prowess?"
"Exactly, Maurice is a Black-rank martial artist. Could Connor really surpass him?"
Doubt clouded their expressions.
However, Aida's face held confusion. She knew more about Connor than the others in the Collier family. Still, she hadn't expected that even Maurice wouldn't be a match for him.
"Did Connor defeat Maurice on his own, or did someone secretly aid him?" Beau asked the bodyguard with hesitation.
"Connor defeated Maurice on his own. However, members of the Purple Cloud Sect were present, though they didn't intervene," the bodyguard replied.
"It turns out that the Purple Cloud Sect had been aware of our plans against Connor!" Beau's voice resonated with a hint of excitement.
"Master, what do we do now?"
"Yes, master. If we don't eliminate Connor, he will undoubtedly become a significant threat!"
The family members turned to Beau with worried expressions.
"Quiet!" Beau thundered, then continued, "Do you all think I don't want to get rid of Connor and avenge Maurice? But tell me, how do we eliminate Connor now? Who among you has the ability to do so?"
The family members stood frozen, their faces awkward. They didn't know how to respond.
"Trying to eliminate Connor through conventional means is already impossible. Unless I take action personally, no one can kill him. But if I step in, the Purple Cloud Sect will certainly intervene. Then, this matter will escalate into a conflict between our Heavenly Sect and the Purple Cloud Sect!"
Beau paused briefly before continuing, "Though our Heavenly Sect has made significant progress in recent years, confronting the Purple Cloud Sect would lead to disastrous consequences. Do you understand?"
The individuals present lowered their heads, silenced by the gravity of the situation.
After all, the Collier family's influence in York stemmed entirely from the Heavenly Sect's existence.
They knew that if the Heavenly Sect faced trouble, their interests would inevitably suffer greatly.
Earlier, the Collier family members had all been resolute about eliminating Connor for Maurice's sake. That was because they believed their interests wouldn't be impacted. However, if their interests were at stake, they would undoubtedly resist Beau's plans to deal with Connor.

chapters.title: Chapter 1677: The Number One Family
chapters.content:
Chapter 1677: The Number One Family
"Father, what do you think we should do now?" After a moment of hesitation, Albert softly inquired of Beau.
Beau took a deep breath and said, "I never anticipated that Connor would be this difficult to deal with. Given the situation, if our Collie family continues to act against him, it will undoubtedly have a significant impact. It might even involve the Heavenly Sect. For now, let's put this matter on hold and strike when the right opportunity arises."
The people present fell into silence upon hearing Beau's words. They knew that Beau was afraid, effectively bowing down to Connor.
Aida remained seated, her face mirroring disbelief. After all, this was the first time she had seen Beau voluntarily retreat.
It was noteworthy that even if anyone else had killed a disciple of the Heavenly Sect, Beau would have made sure that person paid the price. However, Connor was an exception due to his terrifying background.
Connor returned to his home after leaving Yaakov's mansion.
Once home, he lay on his bed, pondering the words Yaakov had spoken earlier that day. Uncertain about their veracity, he refrained from sharing the news with anyone.
All he could do now was await news from the Purple Cloud Sect. He had to confirm whether Yaakov's words were true. If they were, he could ascertain that Yamino was indeed responsible for his parents' deaths.
Three days passed in the blink of an eye.
During this time, Connor remained at home alone, not venturing anywhere. His mind was consumed by thoughts of his parents.
"Ring, ring..."
After waiting for three days by himself at home, he finally received a call from Waverly.
Seeing her name on the screen, his face showed excitement. He hurriedly answered the call.
"Waverly, how did things go with Yaakov?" His voice trembled with excitement.
"Sect Leader McDonald, Yaakov has revealed everything he knows," she said slowly.
"How did my parents die back then?" He quickly followed up.
"Yaakov didn't lie. His accounts to you earlier were consistent with what he told us. It was indeed Yamino who had Yaakov kill your parents," she responded.
"So it was truly Yamino who killed my parents?" Connor's expression was furious.
After so much investigation, he had finally learned the true identity of his enemy.
"Did Yaakov reveal any other significant information?" He hastily inquired.
"No, he shared everything he knew. There's nothing else of significance. However, he mentioned that your father's identity seemed mysterious, but he didn't know the specifics," she replied.
"My father's identity is mysterious?" Connor's expression held confusion.
"Yes, as for other matters, Yaakov seemed rather clueless. He mostly mentioned inconsequential details."
He took a deep breath upon hearing her words, remaining silent.
"Sect Leader McDonald Zhang, how do you plan to handle Yaakov?" she asked.
"Yaakov still has some use for the time being. Let's keep him under the Purple Cloud Sect's watch. We must ensure he doesn't escape," he said in a hushed tone.
"Alright, understood!"
"If there's nothing else, I'll hang up. Keep me informed about any developments on your end," he said lightly.
"Sure!" she replied softly before disconnecting the call.
After putting down his phone, Connor sat alone on the couch, contemplating his next steps.
After an indeterminate amount of time, he let out a long sigh and dialed Thomas's number.
"Ring, ring..."
After two rings, Thomas picked up the call.
"Mr. Connor!"
Thomas's voice came through.
"Thomas, do you know someone named Yamino Gomez?" Connor asked softly.
"Yamino Gomez?"
Thomas's tone became slightly more serious upon hearing the name. He then asked with evident confusion, "Mr. Connor, why are you suddenly inquiring about this person?"
Connor hesitated for a moment but ultimately decided not to hide anything from Thomas. After all, Thomas was one of the people he trusted most. So, he recounted the events involving Yaakov just as they had occurred.
"So, Yamino is the head of Rockefeller in Oprana. It's truly unbelievable..." Thomas exclaimed softly after learning the truth.
"You seem to be quite familiar with this Yamino?" Connor asked gently.
"Of course I am!"
Thomas responded with a touch of helplessness, continuing, "Mr. Connor, the Yamino you're talking about is the head of the Gomez family in Yarlford. And not just in Yarlford, even across all of Oprana, the Gomez family could easily be counted among the top ten. Yamino is the family head, so how could I not know about him?"
"The Gomez family, where Yamino is from, is the number one family in Oprana?" Connor's voice was filled with astonishment.
"Even on a global scale, the Gomez family ranks among the top ten. So, Mr. Connor, if you want to avenge your parents, it won't be an easy task," Thomas sighed softly.
"I understand it's not simple. Otherwise, I wouldn't be calling you. I want to ask if you have any good ideas for dealing with Yamino?" Connor inquired softly.
"The Gomez mansion, where Yamino resides, has a martial arts grandmaster presiding over it. I'm not sure who's stronger between them and Mr. Jorge. So, if you want to directly kill Yamino, it won't be easy," Thomas slowly replied.
"The Gomez family has a martial arts grandmaster too?" Connor's expression revealed shock.
He was aware that since the Gomez family had a martial arts grandmaster, his plan to kill Yamino for revenge wasn't going to be easy.

chapters.title: Chapter 1678: Setting Up My Own Company
chapters.content:
Chapter 1678: Setting Up My Own Company
"If we utilize the connections of our Empire World Corporation to undermine the Gomez family?" Connor proposed a second option.
"This approach might be even more difficult than directly killing Yamino. Our Empire World Corporation has been striving to enter Yarlford for years, but every attempt has ended in failure. Currently, there are no branches of our Empire World Corporation in the entire country except for Honduria and Yarlford. Even when Mr. Steven was around, he couldn't establish a branch in Yarlford. So, your method might not be feasible either..." Thomas explained slowly.
Connor was left speechless after hearing Thomas's words. He hadn't anticipated that the Gomez family, where Yamino was from, had such formidable strength.
"For external companies, entering Yarlford is indeed quite challenging. The Gomez family possesses an intricate web of connections. Without their consent, you'll find it difficult to make any progress in Yarlford. I attempted to establish a branch in Yarlford back then, but Yamino is affiliated with the Rockefellers. Naturally, he wouldn't allow the Empire World Corporation to enter the Yarlford market. So, our branch closed two years later," Thomas further explained.
"I never thought Yamino would be this formidable!" Connor sighed softly.
"To become the head of the Rockefellers in Oprana, he's certainly not an ordinary person. Moreover, the Gomez family's foundation is incredibly deep. Yamino has been Mr. Steven's longstanding rival for years. Even Mr. Steven couldn't find a solution against him. So, I believe that at the moment, it's not advisable for you to directly face Yamino," Thomas advised gently.
Although he knew that Yamino was responsible for killing Connor's parents, he thought that given the current situation of the Empire World Corporation and Connor's capabilities, directly confronting Yamino would have no chance of success.
After a moment of hesitation, Connor softly asked, "What do you suggest then?"
"I think you should consider going to other cities first. Following the strategy you used against Yaakov, systematically weaken the heads of the Rockefellers' branches in various provinces. Afterward, we can focus our strength on dealing with Yamino. I believe this is the best option," Thomas suggested.
"I don't have the mood to bother with those small fish from the Rockefellers. What I want now is to avenge my parents by dealing with Yamino!" Connor stated firmly.
"Since you're determined, then follow your plan. If you need my help, you can contact me anytime. However, I still think directly facing Yamino in Yarlford isn't a wise move," Thomas, being the one who knew Connor best, realized that once Connor made up his mind, it was hard to change it. He didn't continue to dissuade Connor from confronting Yamino.
"Just now, you mentioned that the Empire World Corporation has no connections in Yarlford. Moreover, Yamino has a martial arts grandmaster protecting him. So, neither of these paths is feasible for me. Thus, I have to choose my own path!" Connor said softly.
"But... what exactly do you mean?" Thomas seemed somewhat puzzled by his words. After a brief moment of confusion, he asked.
"My intention is simple. Since I can't use the Empire World Corporation or the Purple Cloud Sect to deal with Yamino, then I'll rely on myself to handle him. I'm planning to take some people to Yarlford, establish my own company there, and find a way to undermine the Gomez family!" Connor said calmly.
"Mr. Connor, if you want to establish your own company, it will take a long time. Even if you manage to establish the company, the Gomez family won't allow you to develop in Yangcheng. After all, Yamino probably knows your identity!" Thomas hurriedly interjected.
"Establishing a company might not be easy for ordinary people, but don't forget, I'm Connor. I might not have much else, but I have money. If there's a problem, I'll just throw money at it. I refuse to believe that even if I invest all my assets in Yangcheng's company, I can't create a large company that can stand against the Gomez family," Connor's tone was resolute.
"Mr. Connor, your idea is too naive. The Gomez family won't give you that opportunity," Thomas said helplessly.
"Whether they give me the opportunity or not, it's not up to the Gomez family to decide. Yamino has his network of connections, and I have mine!" Connor retorted.
"But have you considered that if you lose, you might end up empty-handed?" Thomas still seemed concerned that Connor's approach was too risky.
"Mr. Thomas, do you remember what you told me before? I inherited Steven's legacy, which means I have the responsibility to bring down the Rockefellers and reclaim what belongs to them. The person I'm dealing with now is the head of the Rockefellers in Oprana. If I bring down the Gomez family, we can drive the Rockefellers out of Oprana!" Connor explained softly.
"But we can take our time dealing with the Rockefellers' matter!" Thomas said helplessly.
"We can't take our time. Even if I want to slow down, the Rockefellers won't. After Wei Yong's incident, they will undoubtedly do everything in their power to eliminate me. So, I can't just sit back and wait any longer!" Connor responded.
...
After a brief silence on the other end of the call, Thomas let out a soft sigh, sounding resigned. "Alright, since you're so determined, I won't persuade you further. If you need anything, just give me a call."
"Okay."
Connor nodded slightly before directly hanging up the phone.
After putting down his phone, Connor let out a long sigh of relief.
Initially, he intended to consult Thomas about the situation regarding the Gomez family. But he hadn't expected the Gomez family's background to be so terrifying. Right now, he doesn't have the means to deal with Yamino.
Therefore, he came up with a bold decision to establish his own company in Yarlford, gradually strengthen it, and shake the Gomez family's position in the city.
Facing the formidable Gomez family directly might be challenging, but if Connor could undermine their position in Yarlford, things would become much easier.
He couldn't wait a single minute longer to deal with Yamino!

chapters.title: Chapter 1679: The Right Person
chapters.content:
Chapter 1679: The Right Person
He knew very well in his heart that the Empire World Corporation had no resources whatsoever over in Yarlford.
If Connor were to develop in Yarlford, it would be like starting from scratch.
