And when it came to business, Connor was utterly clueless. If he were to manage a company alone, it would have taken at least eight to ten years to develop into a conglomerate that could rival the Gomez family. However, he simply couldn't have waited that long.
Therefore, he believed that he should bring someone with more management experience to help him run the company.
After a brief moment of contemplation in his mind, he thought of several candidates.
The first was Vanessa. Her managerial skills needed no explanation, but he felt that both Heavens Club and the casino couldn't function without her in the picture.
If he took Vanessa away, these establishments would have been left without a leader. Moreover, he couldn't have found any other suitable candidates at the moment.
Adding to that, she didn't have much experience in company management. Thus, having her accompany him to Yarlford seemed unrealistic.
As he pondered, Connor's mind settled on the second candidate: Reena.
Reena was the head of the Empire World Corporation's branch in Newtown, so she was undoubtedly capable of managing a company.
However, he felt that his acquaintance with Reena was relatively short, and they didn't know each other well. Also, while she was skilled, she wasn't at the absolute top tier.
So, he sensed that she might not be the best fit to accompany him to Yarlford.
With this in mind, he dialed her number on his phone.
Although he deemed Reena unsuitable to join him in Yarlford, he had already gained control over Yaakov, the head of Rockefeller in Orilon. As a result, Orilon was leaderless now. Connor believed it was time for Reena to seize the businesses under Yaakov's control.
He was about to head to Yarlford, where he would need a significant amount of money to develop his company. So, if the Empire World Corporation could control Orilon, it would greatly aid him.
The phone rang a few times before Reena answered the call.
"Miss Reena, are you resting?" Connor asked softly.
"Not yet. Is there something you need, Mr. Connor?" Reena inquired gently.
"Miss Reena, here's the situation. I've gained control over Yaakov. As a result, the Rockefeller group is now in disarray. Contact Percy and try to take over all of Rockefeller's businesses in Orilon within three months. Is that possible?" he calmly explained.
"You've really gained control over Yaakov?" Her tone was filled with incredulity.
"That's right. Yaakov is now under my control. I'll give you his contact. Ask him to provide details about Rockefeller's business divisions in Orilon and strive to drive them out as soon as possible," he elaborated.
"Alright... I understand!" She seemed shaken by the news that he had taken control of Yaakov. The idea that he managed to eliminate Yaakov, a figure she knew to be fearsome after living in Orilon for so many years, was almost unbelievable.
"During this time, it might be challenging for you, Miss Reena. Once you've taken over all of Rockefeller's businesses, I'll have Mr. Thomas allocate a portion of our Empire World Corporation's subsidiary shares to you as a reward," Connor assured.
"Mr. Connor, it's my duty. You don't need to be so polite!" Reena's voice grew more excited upon hearing Connor's intention to offer her shares. She hastened to add, "It's what I should do!"
"You deserve it," he chuckled and continued, "Well, I won't disturb you further. If you have any questions, just give me a call."
"Alright, I understand!" She agreed hurriedly.
Connor ended the call and sent Reena Percy's number.
He believed that with Reena and Percy working together, along with the intelligence provided by Yaakov, ousting Rockefeller from Orilon within three months shouldn't be too difficult.
By then, Empire World Corporation would have control over not only Orilon but also Davenport and Honduria, making it an advantageous safeguard against Yamino.
After hanging up, Connor continued to contemplate who was best suited to accompany him to Yarlford.
The third candidate that came to Connor's mind was Freya.
Freya was undoubtedly the most suitable choice in terms of ability and various other aspects. After all, she had singlehandedly managed Travio Corporation. Her managerial skills were unquestionable.
However, he was hesitant to take Freya with him due to the incident with Yelena. Because of that incident, he was wary of proactively involving Freya, as he didn't know what the Rockefeller faction might do.
Of course, she also had her own goals. She was dedicated to developing her cosmetics company, and he didn't want to disrupt her pace.
Thus, he ultimately dismissed the idea of bringing her to Yarlford.
As for Thomas, he was responsible for Davenport and Empire World Corporation's affairs nationwide. His workload was already substantial, making it even more unrealistic for him to join Connor in Yarlford.
After careful consideration, he finally thought of the most suitable candidate to accompany him to Yarlford.
Connor retrieved his phone, dialed a number, and waited for the call to connect.
"Ring... ring..."
After two rings, the call was answered. The voice on the other end was respectful as it said, "Mr. Connor, do you need something?"
"Do you have time now? I'd like to meet with you!" he replied in a hushed tone.
"Of course, I have time!" Without hesitation, the person responded.
"Good, wait for me at your house. I'll come to you directly!" Connor informed.
"Alright!"
The person agreed and hung up.
Connor changed into different clothes and left his house.
After about half an hour, he arrived at a luxurious villa by taxi.
At this moment, a sexy woman dressed in a white dress stood before the villa gate, waiting for him.
And this woman was none other than Queta, the self-proclaimed Business Empress of Newtown!

chapters.title: Chapter 1680: Give You the Antidote
chapters.content:
Chapter 1680: Give You the Antidote
Back then, Connor and Queta had some conflicts.
However, later, he had her ingest poison, causing her to take an antidote each month to avoid suffering.
Her loyalty to him was absolute now.
Moreover, running such a large business empire in Newtown , Connor believed that if he provided Queta with enough resources, she could undoubtedly help him establish a business empire in a short time that could rival the Gomez family.
So, he thought she was the best candidate.
It had been quite a while since they had seen each other. She seemed even more beautiful now, dressed in a white gown that revealed her alluring figure. Her delicate oval face was lightly adorned with makeup, exuding an air of noble charm. She was the epitome of the woman most men dreamt of.
"Mr. Connor, you're here!" Queta proactively greeted him, walking up to his side and speaking softly.
"No need to be so nervous. I came here this time because I need your help with something…" He could tell that she still had some fear of him.
"Mr. Connor, my life belongs to you. Just give me your orders!" she said in a sweet voice.
"Hehe…" Upon hearing these words from her, he couldn't help but chuckle. He then said casually, "Alright, don't stand here. Let's go inside and talk."
"Okay!" She agreed and quickly opened the villa's gate.
Connor entered the villa with steady steps. It had to be admitted that the villa she lived in was very luxurious, with a decor full of modern technology.
"Mr. Connor, would you like something to drink?" Queta proactively asked Connor.
"Whatever is fine!" As Connor looked around the environment inside the villa, he replied.
She hesitated for a moment before pouring him a cup of tea.
"Mr. Connor, did you come to see me today for something specific?" She sat beside him, speaking softly.
"Did you hear about Yaakov's situation?" he asked, looking at Queta.
"I... I just heard…" she replied.
"Yaakov is now under my control. It won't take long before my people have control over the entire Orilon. So, I plan to leave Orilon!" Connor was straightforward, not beating around the bush.
"Mr. Connor, you plan to leave?" Queta's expression seemed surprised.
"Yes, not only am I leaving, but I also intend to take you with me!" Connor took a sip of tea and calmly stated.
"You... You want to take me somewhere?" Her expression carried a touch of confusion.
"I'm planning to take you to Yarlford. There, I'll establish a company entirely managed by you. I'll also allocate ten percent of the company's shares to you!" Connor answered.
"Yarlford?" Queta's expression still held some confusion.
"Why? Are you unwilling to go to Yarlford with me?" He put down his tea cup, smiled, and asked Queta.
"No... No, it's not that…" She hurriedly shook her head and continued, "I just can't understand why. You've already defeated Yaakov, and the entire Orilon will be under your control. Why would you choose to leave at this moment? If you go to Yarlford, won't you be starting from scratch? "
"Exactly, I want to start from scratch!" Connor nodded lightly and continued, "Have you heard of Yamino from the Gomez family in Yarlford?"
"I... I've heard of him. He's the head of the Gomez family, the largest family in Yarlford!" she answered.
"I'm going to Yarlford because I hope you can help me quickly create a business empire that can rival the entire Gomez family. My real target is Yamino of the Gomez family!" Connor also didn't intend to hide anything from Queta and straightforwardly stated.
"Mr. Connor, you actually plan to go against the Gomez family?" Queta looked even more surprised as she looked at Connor's expression. She hadn't expected Connor's appetite to be this big. Just after getting rid of Yaakov, he wanted to target someone like Yamino.
"That's right, I plan to go against the Gomez family!" Connor nodded gently.
"Mr. Connor, please consider this carefully. I've heard that the Gomez family holds significant influence in Yarlford. If we go against them there, it won't be an easy task!" Queta said to Connor.
"I'm well aware that this won't be easy. Otherwise, I wouldn't have asked for your help. Don't worry, your responsibility will be to manage the company's operations. You don't need to worry about anything else; I'll handle all other matters. Your task is to rapidly expand the company's presence in Yarlford!" Connor said slowly.
"I'm willing to help you in Yarlford, Mr. Connor, but I'm worried I might not be able to complete this task…" Queta whispered.
Connor smiled at Queta. In fact, he understood that Queta probably didn't want to abandon her business empire in Newtown and start from scratch in Yarlford with him. He could understand her point of view.
"As long as you can complete the task I give you, I will provide you with the antidote. You can completely rid your body of the toxin. And whatever you have in Newtown right now, I will return to you. Additionally, you'll have ten percent of the shares in the company in Yarlford. Imagine how significant that ten percent could be if you manage to develop the company to rival the Gomez family!" Connor told Queta.
"If I go to Yarlford with you, you'll provide me with the antidote?" Queta's expression seemed excited, and she hurriedly asked Connor.
"That's right, whether you can complete the task or not, I will give you the antidote!" He looked at her and said.
"That's wonderful! Mr. Connor, I'm willing to go to Yarlford with you!" She didn't hesitate at all and directly said to him.
"Great, over the next few days, wrap up your affairs here, and then head to Yarlford to set up a real estate company. The Gomez family's main business is real estate, and that's where I plan to start!" He looked at her and said.
"Okay, I'll start working on these things tomorrow!" she said without any hesitation.
"Well, if there's nothing else, I'll head back for now. You can think about how to manage the company!" Connor looked at Queta and said.

chapters.title: Chapter 1681: Farewell to Vanessa
chapters.content:
Chapter 1681: Farewell to Vanessa
"Alright!"
Queta hurriedly nodded in agreement.
Connor stood up and walked out of the villa.
After she sent him out of the villa, she returned to her room and began to search for information.
Queta was a woman with a deep background, but her talent in business was definitely top-notch. This was also why he chose her.
Because of the poison in her body, she always felt that she was living in Connor's hands. He could cut off the antidote at any time and take her life. Therefore, in order to get the real antidote, she was willing to try even if she knew that it was risky to help him go to Yarlford to deal with Yamino. After all, this was her best chance to get the antidote.
Connor was in a much better mood after leaving. After all, the matter of the candidate had been settled. He just had to wait for Queta to set up a company before going over.
After leaving her villa, he took out his phone to look at the time. It was already past one in the morning.
At this time, the casino's business was at its best, so he stopped a taxi and came to the casino.
After entering the casino, Connor found that the business of this casino was more prosperous than before under the management of Vanessa. Moreover, she also arranged some sexy and beautiful waitresses in the casino. These waitresses could also help the casino attract a lot of customers.
Connor simply walked around the casino and then went straight to her office.
The waiters in the casino saw Connor go to Vanessa's office and smiled tacitly.
Because in the eyes of these people, Vanessa was definitely his lover, otherwise he would not have been indifferent to the casino business, as long as he went to the casino, he would go directly to her office.
However, they also felt that this was understandable. After all, she was such a beautiful woman. It was reasonable for something to happen between them.
Connor came to the door of Vanessa's office. In order to prevent the previous awkward situation from happening again, he deliberately knocked on the door.
"Please come in!"
Vanessa's crisp and sexy voice rang out.
"Vanessa, are you still busy?"
Connor pushed open the door and walked into the office, smiling as he asked her.
"Of course, the casino's business is getting better and better now, and the boss is not around every day. As a part-time worker, of course I have to do more things. Otherwise, who knows if the boss will come and find trouble with me again when he's in a bad mood!"
She pouted.
He couldn't help but laugh awkwardly when he heard her words.
She was wearing a black uniform uniform, high heels, and stockings on her beautiful legs. She looked exceptionally sexy and charming.
"Why are you looking for me?"
She put down the documents in her hands and asked him softly.
"Vanessa, I came here this time to bid farewell to you…"
Connor said after hesitating for a moment.
"Farewell?"
After she heard his words, she couldn't help but be stunned for a moment. The expression on her face was somewhat puzzled, and then she frowned and said, "What do you mean by that?"
"I might be leaving Newtown in a few days. I plan to go to Yarlford!"
Connor said in a low voice.
"You want to go to Yarlford? How long will you be gone?"
Vanessa was stunned as she looked at him and asked.
"I might not know about this either. It might take a very long time…" he replied.
Vanessa looked at Connor and hesitated for a few seconds before biting her lips and saying, "Connor, what do you mean? You made me stay behind and didn't let me leave with Chelsea. In the end, you actually told me that you were leaving. Are you playing with me?"
"Vanessa, don't say that. I'm really not playing with you. I really have something very important to do. I don't want to leave this place either, but I have no choice."
Connor looked at Vanessa and said.
She took a deep breath and bit her lips, "Alright, if you leave, then I'll resign tomorrow. The reason why I chose to stay is because of you. If you're no longer around, then I won't do it either!"
"Don't. The casino and the clubhouse need you now. If you leave, what will happen to the casino and the clubhouse?" he hurriedly said.
"I don't care. If you're leaving, I'll leave too!"
Vanessa was like a little girl who was bullied at this moment, and her tone was rude.
"Vanessa, I left for a reason!"
He looked at her and said.
"Reason? What's the reason?"
"I... I now know who killed my parents. I want to go to Yarlford to avenge my parents. However, this person is very difficult to deal with. I don't know how long it will take for me to take revenge. That's why I came to say goodbye to you!"
Connor explained seriously.
"You want to avenge your parents?"
The expression on Vanessa's face was somewhat surprised.
After all, he rarely mentioned his background to others, so she was not clear about his situation.
"Yes, my parents were killed when I was in elementary school. I came to Nanyuan City to find the murderer who killed my parents. Now that I know who killed my parents, I have to take revenge no matter what!"
Connor took a deep breath and continued,"Sister Wanqing, the casino needs you very much now. Don't leave, okay?"
"Then I can accompany you to Yarlford!"
Vanessa's emotions seemed to have calmed down a lot as she suggested to Connor.
"It will be very dangerous for me to go to Yarlford this time. If you go with me, I'm worried that you will also be in danger. So, as long as you stay in Newtown and help me manage this casino and clubhouse, it will be the greatest help to me!"
He looked at her and said.
She hesitated for two seconds before nodding her head and saying in a low voice, "Alright, since you have something you want to do, I won't stop you. Protect yourself in Yarlford!"
"I know!"
Connor looked at Vanessa and nodded lightly
"Well, if there's nothing else, I'll leave first!"
Connor stood up and said.
Vanessa nodded.
He took a deep breath. He felt that the current atmosphere was really suffocating.
He didn't know why, but he always felt that he had let her down, so he could only choose to leave as soon as possible.

chapters.title: Chapter 1682: I Will Be responsible for You!
chapters.content:
Chapter 1682: I Will Be responsible for You!
Connor walked to the door, opened it with his hand, and was about to leave. But at that moment, Vanessa suddenly exclaimed, "Connor, didn't you always want to know why I lied to you about giving perfume to Chelsea?"
"Yeah!" Connor turned his head and glanced at Vanessa.
"Then I'll tell you now!" Vanessa mustered her courage and walked up to Connor. She looked at him and said, "I deliberately lied to you back then because I liked you. When I heard you say you were going to give another woman a gift, I felt jealous. Did you know?"
He was completely stunned after hearing her words. He stuttered, "Vanessa, what kind of joke are you making? Are you... maybe a little drunk?"
"I haven't drunk anything. Everything I'm saying now is serious. I don't know when I started liking you, but I can be certain that I've truly fallen in love with you. That's why I stayed, and that's why I felt jealous because of you!" she exclaimed passionately.
"Uh..." He was at a loss for words, his mind reeling. "Vanessa, you might be a bit too tipsy right now."
She hesitated for a moment, then decisively rushed into his embrace, wrapping her arms around him tightly. Her fragrant scent enveloped him once again.
"Connor, I'll show you I'm not drunk!"
As she spoke, she kissed him passionately, pressing her sensual, rosy lips against his.
He couldn't believe what was happening; he was surprised by her forceful kiss. In this moment, his mind went blank. Vanessa was a truly seductive and exquisite woman, and being kissed like this by her, Connor struggled to control his own emotions.
Her breath was ragged, her scent intoxicating.
In this moment, she only had one thought which was to face her own feelings head-on. After all, he had decided to leave, and she wanted to indulge with him one last time.
Time seemed to blur as the night progressed, and for the two of them, it was a night of sheer madness.
...
The next morning, a little after nine o'clock.
Connor slowly opened his eyes and saw Vanessa sound asleep, her face wearing a contented expression as she clung to him.
However, he felt helpless, knowing that he shouldn't have let their relationship take such a turn.
But given last night's circumstances and her unexpected aggressiveness, he found it incredibly hard to keep his emotions in check.
Taking a deep breath, he was unsure about how to handle the situation between him and Vanessa.
However, at that moment, she slowly opened her eyes, realizing he was awake. She softly said, "You're awake?"
"Yes," he replied, looking at her and nodding gently.
Seeing that she wasn't dressed, Vanessa let go of Connor and immediately began to put on her clothes. As she dressed, she said to Connor, "Connor, what happened last night was due to my inability to control my emotions. I know you already have a girlfriend, and I didn't mean to interfere with your family. Let's pretend nothing happened last night; I won't bother you. Don't worry."
Hearing her words, he smiled helplessly. He reached out from behind and embraced her, softly saying, "You're already my woman now. I'll take responsibility for you."
Vanessa froze upon hearing his words, then her body began to tremble slightly.
Connor knew she might be crying, so he held her in his arms and comforted, "Alright, silly girl, don't cry. Although I can't marry you, I'll still take care of you."
"Really?" She looked at him and asked.
"Of course!" He nodded gently.
Vanessa cried even harder upon hearing Connor's words, her voice choked as she said, "Connor, I don't care if you can marry me or not. I don't care about social status. As long as you can spend time with me..."
"I know." He nodded gently and then kissed Vanessa's forehead affectionately. He continued, "Why are you putting on your clothes? I haven't had enough yet..."
Upon hearing his words, she blushed with shyness. She softly scolded him, "You're annoying..."
"Take your clothes off," he commanded.
She hesitated for two seconds, then slowly took off the clothes she had just put on.
A while later...
Around noon, after spending more intimate moments together and taking a shower, the two of them left the casino.
After leaving the casino, Vanessa needed to attend a meeting at the club. Connor didn't choose to go with her; instead, he took a taxi to Newtown University.
Walking through the campus, Connor looked at the familiar playground and classrooms. The thought that he was about to leave this place made him feel a bit reluctant.
Connor wandered around the school for a while and finally arrived at the classroom where their class was held.
At this moment, the students in the classroom were all in class, so Connor didn't go in. He just stood quietly in the corridor outside the classroom, waiting.

chapters.title: Chapter 1683: Arrange The Work
chapters.content:
Chapter 1683: Arrange The Work
Half an hour later, the bell for the end of class finally rang.
Justin, Brooks, and Joel walked out of the classroom.
"Justin, where should we go to eat later?" Brooks asked.
"Let's go to the cafeteria. I don't have much money lately, so saving a bit is a good idea..." Justin replied helplessly.
"Why didn't you call me if you were out of money?" At that moment, a voice came from behind the three.
Justin, Brooks, and Joel turned around to see Connor and were instantly surprised.
"Connor, when did you come?" Justin asked excitedly.
"I just arrived not long ago..." Connor replied with a smile.
"Why didn't you let me know when you came back to the school?" Justin playfully complained.
"Alright, don't pretend with me. I overheard you saying you're out of money, so let me treat the three of you to a meal!" Connor said while leading them outside the school.
Five minutes later, the four of them arrived at a restaurant outside the school and ordered some dishes.
"Connor, why did you have time to come see the three of us today?" Justin asked while chuckling.
"I'm leaving Newtown in a few days, so I came to see you guys!" Connor explained.
"You're leaving?" Justin asked in surprise.
"Yes, I've pretty much wrapped up things in Newtown, so it's time for me to leave!" Connor nodded gently.
Justin sighed softly upon hearing this.
"I've forgotten that we're going to be seniors next year and this semester is about to end. After we become seniors, we'll need to go for internships, so we'll be separated!" Brooks explained.
"Even if you didn't mention it, I would've forgotten. We'll be seniors next year!" Connor smiled.
"My family arranged a job for me in my hometown. Brooks found an internship, and Joel is planning to stay in the school for postgraduate studies. So, I won't be leaving Newtown for now!" Justin explained.
"I see," Connor nodded thoughtfully.
"By the way, Connor, where are you planning to go after leaving Newtown?" Brooks asked.
"Yarlford!" Connor replied softly.
"Yarlford is great. I've heard that the girls there are pretty..." Brooks grinned.
"Why is everything in your mind so inappropriate?" Justin scolded him, rolling her eyes.
"Hehe..." Connor chuckled, then said, "Since the three of you are planning to intern, how about joining me in Yarlford? I'm planning to start a real estate company there. You can help out, and as for salary and benefits, rest assured, they'll be much better than what your families arranged for you."
"What?!" Justin, Brooks, and Joel were all surprised and exchanged incredulous glances.
"I've recognized you, Connor, as the richest second-generation entrepreneur I know. If I follow you, you definitely won't treat me unfairly. Plus, I've heard that the girls in Yarlford are beautiful. I'll just consider it a vacation..." Brooks explained with a grin. "But let me tell you, Connor, I don't know anything, and I learn slowly. You can't kick me out later!"
"Don't worry, I won't..." Connor shook his head.
Looking at Justin, he asked with a smile, "And you, what do you think?"
"I..." Justin hesitated with a thoughtful expression.
"Just say whatever's on your mind. No need to beat around the bush," Connor said with a smile.
"Connor, I know you're well-intentioned, but your company in Yarlford is newly established too. I'm worried that I won't be of any help and might burden you," Justin expressed her concerns.
"Don't worry about that. I'm inviting you guys because I want you to learn and grow. I know your family is well-off, and you're certainly not lacking in money. But I believe that if you work well in my company, you'll learn a lot. Once you truly understand how to run a company, you can consider other options," Connor explained gently.
Justin looked at Connor hesitantly for a moment, then nodded and said, "Alright, since you put it that way, I'll give it a try and join you in Yarlford."
"Great! Once I have everything set up in the company, we'll head over together. I'll take care of things here at school for you guys," Connor confirmed.
"Sounds good!" Justin and Brooks both nodded in agreement.

chapters.title: Chapter 1684: Heading to Yarlford
chapters.content:
Chapter 1684: Heading to Yarlford
Half an hour later, everyone had finished eating.
Connor took out his phone and called Reena, asking her to handle the matters at school. After all, Justin and Brook needed the school's permission to leave since they were still in class.
After a few hours of hustle, Connor finally helped Justin and Brook sort out the school-related issues. Then, he called Dominic and Spencer.
He knew that they were also about to go for internships. Originally, he had planned to directly arrange them into Thomas's company. However, he realized he needed trustworthy people and also wanted them to gain valuable experience. So, he invited them to join him in Yarlford.
Dominic and Spencer were Connor's most important friends, so when they received his call, they immediately agreed without hesitation.
After a full day of busy work, he finally had some time to rest. But even before he got back home, he received a call from Vanessa.
"Connor, what are you busy with?" she asked in a soft voice.
"Miss me already?" he playfully asked.
"I've already cooked. Are you planning to eat at my place or something?" she continued.
"Wait for me at home. I'll come over right now!" he said.
"Sure!" She laughed happily and hung up the phone.
Connor knew that once he went to Yarlford, he might not be able to return for a long time. After all, Yarlford was far from Newtown, and Vanessa was managing the club and casino. So, he decided to spend quality time with her.
Although he knew he was being unfair to Freya by doing this, sometimes he couldn't control himself. Since things had already happened, he had to take responsibility for Vanessa.
...
In the blink of an eye, two days passed.
Connor stayed at Vanessa's place for two days. Meanwhile, Queta's efficiency was astonishing. The company was registered, named "Stormbound Real Estate," and had already set up operations. She had brought some capable subordinates she trusted to Yarlford, so Stormbound Real Estate was not lacking staff for now. Moreover, she had directly rented an office building in the most prosperous area of Yarlford, which would serve as the headquarters.
Once Connor learned that everything was ready on Queta's end, he didn't delay any further. He brought Justin, Brook, Dominic, Spencer, and others to Yarlford by plane.
He knew he was about to face the most powerful opponent he had encountered so far. As a result, he was quite nervous throughout the journey.
On the other hand, Justin, Brook, Dominic, and Spencer were very relaxed. Coupled with their youthful vigor, the four quickly bonded.
Flying from Newtown to Yarlford took about half a day. Since they departed in the morning, by the time they arrived, it was already three or four in the afternoon.
After landing, Connor called Queta and informed her that he had arrived.
She had already brought some people to wait outside the airport.
Although he knew she was coming to pick him up, he wasn't sure about the cars' arrangement. This scene might not have surprised him if it happened in Newtown, but this was Yarlford's airport. Logically, she had just arrived in Yarlford, so there shouldn't be such a grand reception.
"These cars are here to pick... to pick us up?" Justin stammered, looking at Connor.
"I don't know..." he replied helplessly.
On the road in front of the airport waiting hall, over a dozen Mercedes-Benz G-Wagons were neatly parked, each accompanied by two bodyguards. They exuded an exceptionally imposing aura.
"This is quite a show, isn't it? Quite impressive," Brook said excitedly.
"Yeah, Connor, it's just the few of us. You didn't have to make such a big fuss, did you?" Dominic also commented.
"Why would I need so many cars to pick you guys up? I didn't arrange these cars. Let me make a call." After saying this, Connor was about to take out his phone to make a call.
"Move aside! Clear the way for those guys ahead!" However, at that moment, a voice sounded behind Connor's group.
Connor was briefly taken aback, then turned to look. A group of bodyguards in black suits hurried toward them.
The leading bodyguard pushed Justin and the others aside.
Before Connor and the others could comprehend what was happening, these bodyguards had already formed two rows, creating a passage in the middle.
"What are these people doing? Why do they have the right to push us aside?" Dominic, who was pushed to the side, seemed somewhat discontented.
"Yeah, who are these people?" Justin also seemed to be a bit frustrated.
However, the next moment, an extremely stunning woman with a fit body slowly walked out of the crowd, holding a brown teddy bear.
The appearance of the alluring woman instantly attracted the attention of the male onlookers. It was clear that she was the person these bodyguards were welcoming.
The woman's attire was quite alluring. She had light makeup on her face, delicate and enticing features. Her long, wavy hair cascaded casually down her shoulders, revealing her fair and slender neck. She wore a white fitted skirt with a black waistband, accentuating her already slender waist, and she had high-heeled shoes on her feet. Her exquisite face combined with the black wavy hair gave off an indescribable allure.

chapters.title: Chapter 1685: Charis Yaeger
chapters.content:
Chapter 1685: Charis Yaeger
Just a while ago, Dominic and Justin, who had unpleasant expressions, suddenly had their eyes gleaming.
They didn't have any mood to pay attention to being pushed aside by others; instead, all their focus was now directed at this woman.
The woman's figure was extremely seductive, emitting an alluring aura with every move.
However, her expression was exceedingly arrogant. She didn't even spare a glance for the men around her.
Escorted by bodyguards, she walked out of the hall with her head held high and then got into the Mercedes-Benz G-Class.
After a moment, the Mercedes convoy left under the gazes of the crowd.
Once all the vehicles had vanished, Spencer finally realized and stuttered, "Connor, weren't these cars here to pick us up?"
"Probably not..."
Connor replied helplessly.
"Damn, got all excited for nothing. I thought they were here for me!"
Helpless, Brook exclaimed, then continued, "But that woman from earlier was way too sexy, right? When can I find a girlfriend like that..."
"You'll find a girlfriend like that in your dreams at night. In reality, women like that have no connection to you!"
Justin directly crushed his hopes.
However, at that moment, Queta arrived with two bodyguards and approached Connor, saying softly, "Mr. Connor, you've arrived?"
Seeing Queta, Brook, Justin, Dominic, Spencer, and the others were dumbfounded once again.
Although the woman from earlier was indeed stunning, her face was hidden behind her shades, so they couldn't clearly see her true appearance.
But Queta was different. She was standing right in front of them, both in figure and appearance not inferior to the woman from earlier. This left them utterly astounded.
"Miss Queta, these are my friends. I plan to arrange positions for them at Stormbound Real Estate. Once we're at the company, you can assess what roles suit them. They've all just graduated from university, coming here mainly for learning, so arrange them as you see fit!"
Connor said softly to Queta.
"Alright, when we get to the company, I'll have a chat with them to see what positions might suit them."
Queta nodded gently and then proceeded to introduce herself to Justin and the others.
Justin and Brook were locals of Newtown, so they had naturally heard of her name. Their expressions became incredibly incredulous when they learned her true identity. They couldn't have imagined that Connor was so influential that he could directly employ her in his company.
As for Spencer and Dominic, although they didn't know her, they could sense that she was no ordinary person.
After some brief pleasantries, they arrived at the parking area.
Connor's guess was correct. Queta was still maintaining a low profile since she had recently come to Yarlford. She had arranged just two Honda sedans to pick up Connor.
Connor sat in one car with Queta, while Dominic, Spencer, Justin, Brook, and the others sat in the car behind.
"Mr. Connor, I've bought a villa for you in Yarlford. Are you planning to rest there first, or would you like to visit the company's headquarters?"
Queta asked Connor softly.
"Let's go to the company first."
He replied and continued, "Justin, Brook, Spencer, Dominic, and the others are my best friends. I intend to have them work at our Stormbound Real Estate. Once we're there, you can assess which roles suit them. They've just graduated from university, so they're here to learn. You can arrange accordingly!"
"Sure, when we get to the company, I'll have a chat with them and see which roles might be suitable."
Queta nodded gently and then proceeded to make accommodations for Justin, Brook, Spencer, and Dominic, arranging a place for them to stay.
After the call, Connor hesitated for a moment, then softly asked Queta, "The woman we encountered at the airport earlier, who is she? Is she from the Gomez family?"
Connor had a lasting impression of the woman he had encountered at the airport. Creating such a commotion at Yarlford Airport indicated that she was no ordinary person. This led him to suspect that she might be from the Gomez family.
"No, she's not!"
Queta shook her head gently and continued, "I've been getting to know the situation in Yarlford over the past few days. The Gomez family is undoubtedly the number one family in Yarlford. Beneath them are four major families, all of which rely on the Gomez family's strength. The woman you saw is the eldest princess of one of these four families, the Yaeger family, named Charis Yaeger."
"Charis Yaeger?"
He was momentarily taken aback by the name.
"Exactly. Based on the information I've gathered so far, Charis isn't an ordinary woman. Despite her young age, she gained control of the entire Yaeger family after returning from studying abroad. Currently, apart from her grandfather, Charis holds a higher status in the Yaeger family than anyone else. She mainly oversees the real estate business of the Yaeger family, and their real estate business has always been in cooperation with the Gomez family. So, this Yeager family might become one of our company's biggest competitors!"
"Haha..."
Connor chuckled upon hearing Queta's words, then said softly, "I didn't expect you to be so well-informed about Yarlford's situation now."
"I've only done some preliminary research. If we want to thoroughly investigate the Gomez family and the four major families, it'll take more time," she replied.
"No rush. Our purpose in coming to Yarlford this time is to have a good play with the Gomez family. Although the Gomez family seems all-powerful in Yarlford, I believe the situation is more complex than we think. Given enough time, we'll definitely find their weaknesses!" he said softly.
"Yes, dealing with the Gomez family won't be accomplished in just a day or two."
Queta looked at Connor and nodded gently.

chapters.title: Chapter 1686: The Gomez Family
chapters.content:
Chapter 1686: The Gomez Family
A few minutes later, the car slowly stopped in front of the Stormbound Tower.
After Justin and the others got out of the car, they couldn't help but look up at the building in front of them and were instantly dumbfounded.
Although they knew Connor was wealthy and his background wasn't simple, this time they were deeply shocked.
Buying a multi-story building like this in Yarlford wasn't something ordinary people could achieve.
Connor's astonishing financial ability left them astounded once again.
Led by Queta, Connor and the others entered the building and took a brief look around. Since the company had just been established, there weren't many people inside.
However, she was currently in the process of recruiting, and it wouldn't take long for the company to be up and running normally. Given Connor's wealth, it was quite simple for her to attract talent from other companies.
After wandering around the building, Connor was quite satisfied, so they left. Since Justin, Brook, Spencer, and the others hadn't been accommodated yet, he took them to the villa prepared by Queta.
However, the villa she had arranged was located in the most luxurious villa complex in the entire Yarlford. Upon entering the villa, Justin, Brook, Spencer, and the others were once again dumbfounded.
The interior decoration of the villa was excessively lavish, something beyond the imagination of ordinary people.
Even Connor felt it was unnecessary, considering he would be the sole occupant. Queta really didn't need to buy such a large villa for him.
"Connor, although I knew you were wealthy, I didn't expect you to be this wealthy!"
Brook looked at the villa's interior, his expression excited.
"Yeah, Connor, I truly have a different understanding of you now. To have Queta working for you, and to be able to buy such a large building, and now living in this luxurious villa—how much money do you actually have?"
Justin added.
"The wealthiest person in our Davenport, Thomas, works for Connor. You think he has so much money?"
Dominic scoffed.
"My goodness, I originally thought you were already rich, Connor, but I never thought you'd be this wealthy. It's a good thing I followed you to Yarlford; otherwise, I'd regret it to death!"
Brook shouted with excitement.
"Alright, stop flattering me here. As long as you work well with Queta, in a few years, you'll probably be able to buy an even more luxurious villa than this one!"
Connor replied helplessly.
"Really?"
Brook asked eagerly.
"Of course!"
Connor patted Brook's shoulder and continued, "Alright, it's getting late. You've all had a busy day following me around. There are plenty of rooms in this villa; just pick whichever you like, no need to be polite!"
"Got it!"
Everyone agreed and started looking for their rooms.
Connor went to the master bedroom, entered the bathroom to freshen up, then called Freya to let her know he had arrived in Yarlford.
After ending the call, he lay down on the bed to rest.
...
On the other side, within an estate in Yarlford.
This estate could be said to be the most luxurious in all of Yarlford. It spanned thousands of square meters and included three villas, a golf course, a private pool, and astonishingly, a private zoo. This estate was the property of the Gomez family, the number one family in Yarlford.
Most members of the Gomez family's main lineage lived in this estate, while some peripheral members didn't have the privilege.
Residing here was a symbol of status and position.
Although Yamino was Rockefeller's head in the Oprana region, his approach was quite different from that of other Rockefeller people.
Take Yaakov, for instance. Although he wielded tremendous influence in Davenport, he still didn't dare to show his face. Most matters were left to Tenner.
Yamino, however, was different. He never thought about concealing his identity.
In Yarlford, no one could threaten him. Naturally, he had no qualms.
Currently, in the living room of Yamino's home, a group of people were having a meal and chatting.
Seated at the head of the table was a middle-aged man, Yamino himself. The rest were high-ranking members of the Gomez family.
"Master, have they found Yaakov?"
A well-dressed man in a suit asked Yamino softly.
This person was Melvin Gomez, Yamino's younger brother.
Although they were blood-related, one could tell that Melvin spoke to Yamino in a highly respectful manner. It didn't seem like a conversation between brothers.
In fact, most of the people present were related to Yamino by blood. However, they didn't even have the courage to speak loudly to him. They knew that Yamino would never tolerate their mistakes due to family ties. So, these people were extremely cautious around him, not daring to make any mistakes.
"Yaakov should be under Connor's control now."
Yamino was well-informed. He was well aware of the events that took place that night.
"I didn't expect this successor chosen by Li Xiugan to be so capable. Even Yaakov isn't his match!"
Melvin exclaimed.
"Yaakov himself lacked ability. If it wasn't for a lack of more suitable candidates back then, I would never have let him become the head of Davenport."
Yamino commented casually.
"Master, this Connor is no simple character. Not only is he Steven's successor, but he's also that man's son. If Yaakov is controlled by Connor, then he probably already knows that his father was killed by our Gomez family. Shouldn't we take action to eliminate Connor as well?"
At this moment, another middle-aged man spoke up.
Yamino sighed softly upon hearing these words, refraining from responding.
Seeing his silence, the expressions on the faces of those present turned extremely anxious. They couldn't fathom his intentions and didn't know how he planned to handle Connor.

chapters.title: Chapter 1687: Playing With Fire
chapters.content:
Chapter 1687: Playing With Fire
"Mr. Juan, you're back?"
At this moment, a servant's voice greeted from outside the estate.
A tall and handsome man walked into the dining room.
"Juan is back?"
"Yes, Juan, where have you been during this time?"
Upon seeing this man, everyone in the room stood up and greeted him.
This man was named Juan Gomez, the eldest son of Yamino. He held a high position within the Gomez family as well.
"Uncle and Second Uncle, you're both here?"
Juan greeted them with a smile.
"Juan, please take a seat!"
Melvin offered his own seat to Juan.
Juan naturally didn't hesitate and sat directly beside Yamino.
From this, one could tell that the highest status within the Gomez family was held by the father-son duo, Yamino and Juan.
"Juan, how are the matters I asked you to investigate?"
Yamino asked Juan expressionlessly.
"Father, I've mostly sorted out the situation. Maurice from the Collie family indeed died at Connor's hands, and Yaakov was taken away by the people from the Purple Cloud Sect. Currently, Yaakov is with the Purple Cloud Sect, so it's unlikely we can rescue him."
Juan quickly replied.
"How is the situation in Davenport?"
Yamino continued to inquire.
"Due to Yaakov's disappearance, many of our Rockefeller people in Davenport are feeling uneasy. Percy, who is in charge of Newtown, has teamed up with Connor's people. As a result, Connor's Empire World Corporation has already taken over most of Rockefeller's business in Davenport. Many of our people have also fallen under Empire World Corporation's control."
Juan answered.
"It's as I expected."
Yamino nodded lightly.
"Father, should we send someone over to clean up the mess in Davenport?"
Juan asked proactively.
"The situation in Davenport has settled down. Regaining control over Davenport's operations in the short term won't be so simple. I need to carefully consider this matter."
Yamino replied slowly.
Juan hesitated for a moment and then continued, "Father, I have another very important piece of news."
"What news?"
Yamino inquired.
"Connor has come to Yarlford!"
Juan said slowly.
Upon hearing this from Juan, the expressions of everyone from the Gomez family turned to shock.
Because they never expected Connor to be so audacious as to actively come to Yarlford.
"Why has he come to Yarlford?"
Yamino also seemed puzzled.
"It seems that Connor is here to deal with our Gomez family. He has set up a company called 'Stormbound Real Estate' with his subordinates. As for his plans, I'm not sure."
Juan explained slowly.
"Hahaha..."
Upon hearing this, Yamino burst into laughter, then said in a low voice, "This Connor is quite interesting. I haven't gone to Davenport to deal with him, and he actually took the initiative to come to Yarlford to deal with me. He's really overestimating himself. Does he think that inheriting Steven's legacy and becoming Jorge's disciple, along with the support of the Empire World Corporation and the Purple Cloud Sect, are enough to take on our Gomez family?"
"This Connor is truly overestimating his capabilities!"
"Absolutely, this Connor is completely ignorant!"
Various voices chimed in.
"Father, should I take action to eliminate Connor and prevent future troubles?"
Juan asked softly after thinking for a moment.
However, Yamino lightly shook his head and smiled, saying, "I don't know why, but I always find my old friend's son quite interesting. I've been keeping an eye on him even before he inherited Steven's legacy. His journey to this point is quite unexpected. Since Connor has the audacity to confront our Gomez family in Yarlford, I'll give him this opportunity. Let's see how big of a wave he can create in our Yarlford. I'm curious!"
"Father, aren't you worried about nurturing a future threat?"
Juan frowned.
"I've been in Yarlford for so many years, and I've never encountered an opponent, nor has anyone dared to go against me, Yamino. It's gotten a bit boring. The appearance of this young Connor could add some excitement to my life. It wouldn't be fun to get rid of him too soon!"
Yamino laughed and replied.
Upon hearing his words, Juan couldn't help but furrow his brows slightly, but he didn't say much.
After all, once he made a decision, no one could change it.
Juan dared not continue trying to persuade him, and naturally, the others in the Gomez family didn't dare either.
"Juan, I intend to give Connor some time to develop. Once his company has grown, you can then deal with him. Consider it a test for you. How do you feel about that?"
Yamino looked at Juan and asked.
"Of course, no problem!"
Juan readily agreed without hesitation.
"Hahaha!"
Yamino burst into laughter and then slowly got up, walking towards the exit of the dining room.
"Old friend, back then, you nearly pulled me down from the position of being the head of Rockefeller. But unfortunately, you stumbled and lost to me. Now, your son has come to Yarlford. Let's wait and see if your son can achieve what you couldn't back then!"
Yamino looked at the starry sky outside the window and sighed to himself.
...
The next day, a little after 8 AM.
Connor, along with Justin, Brook, Dominic, Glasses, and others, arrived at Stormbound Real Estate. Since Justin and the others had just arrived and the company didn't have much business at the moment, Queta had assigned them the task of conducting interviews.
Justin and the others were excited to have the opportunity to interview recent college graduates. Normally, they would have been the ones being interviewed. But now, they had suddenly become interviewers, which naturally put them in good spirits.
Once Justin and the others left, Connor turned to Queta and asked in a low voice, "Miss Queta, how do you plan to develop our company further?"
Queta looked at Connor, smiled, and said softly, "Mr. Zhang, you don't need to be so formal with me. From now on, you can call me Queta. It sounds strange when you keep addressing me as Miss Queta."

chapters.title: Chapter 1688: Land Auction
chapters.content:
Chapter 1688: Land Auction
"Alright!"
Connor nodded helplessly.
Queta reached into a drawer and took out a map. She explained softly to Connor, "Mr. Connor, the timing of our arrival is quite good. Take a look at this location."
While talking, Queta marked a spot on the map.
Connor glanced at it briefly and asked in a low voice, "Isn't this the industrial area of Yarlford?"
Although Connor wasn't very familiar with Yarlford's situation, he had done some research before coming here. He was well aware of the geography of Yarlford.
"Exactly, it's indeed the industrial area of Yarlford. Many well-established factories in Yarlford are concentrated in this area. However, because the city's development is getting faster, these factories occupying such prime locations isn't very reasonable. So, Yarlford is developing a suburban area, and all these factories will move there. This empty land will become commercial property!" she explained while looking at him.
"Are you saying this land will be auctioned?"
His voice was filled with excitement as he asked.
"Yes, the auction is likely to take place soon..."
She nodded lightly.
He hesitated for a moment as he looked at Queta, then said in a low voice, "The location of this area is fantastic. If it's going to be auctioned, many companies will surely participate, right?"
"Many companies will indeed participate, but I think in the end, about ninety percent of it will fall into the hands of the Gomez family. Even if it doesn't end up with the Gomez family, one of the four major families will likely acquire it..." she replied helplessly.
"So, you're interested in this piece of land now?" he asked.
"If we can secure this land, it would be the best. The value this land can bring to our company is beyond imagination..." she quickly responded.
"What would you do if our company manages to secure this land?" he asked.
Queta hesitated for a moment, then answered, "Mr. Connor, my plan is simple. The reason you established this company was to deal with the Gomez family. If we follow the normal real estate development route, we won't have enough time, and we're not here just to make money. As long as we avoid significant losses..."
"Go on..." he urged.
"My current idea is that if you want our real estate company to compete with the Gomez family, we need to build a landmark building that belongs to our company!"
While speaking, Queta took out a plan and said earnestly, "I plan to build a luxurious high-end villa district on this land. After all, this land is adjacent to Yarlford's most famous villa district. Once this project becomes a reality, our Stormbound Real Estate's reputation will spread. This will greatly influence our company's future development."
She paused for a moment, then continued, "What our company currently lacks the most in Yarlford is influence. This land can compensate for that weakness."
"Are you suggesting creating a high-end residential villa district on this land?" he whispered.
"Exactly, that's my idea!"
Queta nodded, then continued, "Of course, it won't just be residential villas. We'll also have high-end hotels and some landmark buildings. Whenever people come to Yarlford, they will associate this place with us, much like how people think of the Oriental Pearl Tower in Shanghai!"
"Your suggestion is indeed excellent!"
Connor nodded lightly.
"Mr. Connor, if we can implement my plan, residents of this villa district will have to pass a strict identity verification process. The villas will be no smaller than five hundred square meters and will be furnished with the best international decorations and property management services. We need this district to establish our company's reputation. Look at this location, our district will face the river and is very close to the commercial street. Outside the villa district, we plan to build a commercial complex. All of this is part of my plan!"
She continued and handed over some documents. She said in a soft voice, "This contains information about some high-end districts in Yarlford. If we can truly execute this project, we can profit at least over a billion. This single project could place our company among the top five in the domestic real estate industry. This way, it will be much quicker for you to achieve your goals, Mr. Connor..."
"This does seem like a fantastic opportunity!"
After listening to her words, he was also deeply tempted. He couldn't help but sigh softly.
"Although it's a great opportunity, there are many challenges for us."
Her expression seemed somewhat helpless.
"What challenges are there? I'll find solutions. No matter what, we must secure this land, and then we'll proceed as you've just described!" he said.
"I won't discuss what happens after we secure the land for now. After all, it's a bit early to talk about that. The biggest challenge we face right now is how to secure this land!"
Queta looked at Connor.
"Is it a financial issue?" he asked.
"Of course not a financial issue!"
Queta quickly shook her head, then added with a helpless tone, "If it were a financial issue, things would be simple. After all, we're lacking everything right now, except money!"
"Then what's the problem?" he asked, a bit puzzled.
"The problem is that our company doesn't have the qualification to participate in this bidding. In simple terms, even if we have the money, we can't spend it!" she replied.
"There's no qualification to participate in the bidding?"
Upon hearing her words, his expression seemed even more puzzled. He thought that any company could participate in such a bidding.
"Although this land is being auctioned publicly, to participate in the bidding, companies need to pass a qualification review. Our company isn't part of the Gomez family's network, so our company might not even have the qualification to attend the auction," she explained.
"I see, that's how it is."
He nodded as if lost in thought.

chapters.title: Chapter 1689: How Do You Know Everything?
chapters.content:
Chapter 1689: How Do You Know Everything?
In fact, Connor had long known about the astonishing influence of the Gomez family in Yarlford.
If you didn't cooperate with the Gomez family, you might not even have the qualification to participate in the auction.
Any company qualified to bid was one that had some kind of cooperation with the Gomez family.
This arrangement allowed them to ensure that no matter which company acquired the land, they could still profit alongside them.
Moreover, Yomino was the overall leader of Rockefeller in the Huaxia region. So, in essence, anyone participating in the bidding process was, for the most part, linked to the Rockefeller family.
To put it simply, the Gomez family allowed its competitors to participate in the bidding from the very beginning. So, even before you had the chance to compete against the Gomez family, you would already be at a disadvantage.
Perhaps this was the most terrifying aspect of the Gomez family's influence.
"Leave this matter to me."
Connor said softly to Queta.
"Leave it to you?"
Queta looked puzzled upon hearing his words as if she didn't quite understand his intention.
"I'll find a way to secure our qualification for the bidding!" he said slowly.
"Mr. Connor, you're not kidding, are you? I've already asked the people around me. If we don't have the Gomez family's approval, our company won't even have the qualification to participate in the bidding," she replied with a helpless tone.
"Not qualified to participate in the bidding without the Gomez family's approval?"
After hearing her words, he couldn't help but let out a cold laugh, and then said lightly, "Although the Gomez family holds significant power in Yarlford, not everything is within their control. I will find a way to make our company participate in this bidding..."
Queta looked at Connor without speaking.
Although she couldn't quite fathom why he was so confident, she could sense that he wasn't joking when he said that. He seemed very serious.
"Queta, you don't need to focus on other matters for now. Just work on the planning for this piece of land and prepare for the bidding."
Connor said softly to her.
"Understood."
She quickly nodded.
After parting ways with her, Connor went to his own office and began to contemplate how to handle the matter of the company's participation in the bidding.
In fact, the reason why the Gomez family could control which companies could participate in the bidding process was largely due to their relationship with the organizers. Whether a company was qualified to participate in the bidding was entirely at the discretion of the organizers. In simpler terms, if the organizers decided that a company wasn't qualified to participate, they wouldn't even send an invitation. The company's representatives wouldn't have the qualification to enter the bidding site. So, even if a company had substantial funds, they wouldn't be able to secure the land.
It was highly likely that Yomino already knew about Connor's arrival in Yarlford and the establishment of Stormbound Real Estate. Therefore, he believed that the Gomez family wouldn't allow Stormbound Real Estate to participate in the bidding.
Since he couldn't approach this through the Gomez family, Connor could only approach it through the organizers.
Currently, this piece of land should still be under the jurisdiction of the Yarlford Government, so the organizers of the bidding process should be the Urban Planning Bureau of Yarlford.
Connor had just arrived in Yarlford, and he had no personal connections here. Although Thomas had some friends in Yarlford, these friends of his likely wouldn't dare to go up against a tyrant like the Gomez family.
Although the Wallace family where Rachel was situated had formidable connections, Connor believed that the Wallace family probably couldn't infiltrate the connections into Yarlford. After all, under the control of the Gomez family, Yarlford was like a fortress, and they wouldn't allow any other families to establish networks in the city.
"Seems like I can't count on Rachel. It looks like there's only one choice left!"
Connor sighed softly and then pulled out his phone to make a call.
"Ring, ring..."
After a couple of rings, the call was picked up on the other end.
"Chelsea, what are you up to?"
Connor asked with a cheerful tone.
"For the umpteenth time, call me Auntie Chelsea!"
Chelsea replied with a slightly annoyed tone.
"If I call you Auntie Chelsea, but then you seem older than you actually are. I think calling you Chelsea is more appropriate..." he quickly explained.
"Forget it, call me whatever you want. I'm skiing in the Chamdon Peaks right now. What's the matter? Get to the point."
Chelsea seemed genuinely disinterested in chit-chatting with Connor and directly asked about the reason for his call.
"Why did you go to the Chamdon Peaks?"
Connor sounded a bit confused.
"To escape the pressure of getting married at home. I've almost traveled all over Europe by now. Once the pressure to get married dies down, I'll head back."
Chelsea explained helplessly.
"You're quite carefree..."
Connor sighed softly.
"Did you call me for something?" she asked.
"Yeah, I've found out who killed my parents."
Connor whispered.
"Was it Yomino from Yarlford?"
Chelsea asked directly.
Upon hearing her words, Connor's expression turned surprised. He sounded almost incredulous as he said, "How did you know?"
"In fact, I've known for a while. Although Yaakov had been competing with your father, he wouldn't have had the guts to kill him without a bigger force backing him. And at that time, the only person who could have opposed your father was probably Yomino," she explained calmly.
"If you had already guessed that Yomino was responsible for my father's death, why didn't you tell me?" he asked, somewhat perplexed.
"While I had a strong suspicion that it might be Yomino, I didn't have any evidence. What if I had told you, and it turned out not to be him? I would have caused harm to you, right?" she explained.
"What you're saying does make sense."
Connor nodded in agreement.
"If I'm not mistaken, you're currently in Yarlford, right?"
Chelsea continued.
"Yes..."
"You're planning to confront Yomino, aren't you?" she asked again.
"Are you monitoring me or something? How do you know everything?" he cried out somewhat exasperatedly.

chapters.title: Chapter 1690: You Know This Person
chapters.content:
Chapter 1690: You Know This Person
"I didn't actually have someone monitoring you; I just know you too well. I can easily guess what you're up to..."
Chelsea chuckled proudly, then continued, "Actually, Connor, I don't recommend going after Gong Sun Yan at this moment. His influence is really terrifying. But I also understand that it's too late for my advice now. So, go ahead and do whatever you want. If you need help, just let me know!"
Connor was moved by Chelsea's words.
After hesitating for a moment, he briefly explained the bidding process to Chelsea.
"So, you want to secure this piece of land?"
Chelsea said softly after understanding the situation.
"Yes, due to the Gomez family's influence, my company might not even have the qualification to participate in the bidding. So, I called you to see if you could help me use your connections over there."
Connor nodded.
"This matter is quite complicated. While I know some people in Yarlford, they might not have the capability to secure your participation in the bidding..."
Chelsea said, sounding a bit hesitant.
"You can't help with this either?"
Connor felt despair instantly.
After all, if even she couldn't help, he didn't know who else he could turn to.
"You're underestimating me, aren't you? While I might not be able to directly secure your participation in the bidding, I know someone who probably can!" she said slowly.
"Who is it?" he asked, surprised.
"Who else could it be? And you've met this person too. It's my good friend Yuna!"
Chelsea said helplessly.
"Yuna Winston?"
Connor was surprised by Chelsea's words. Then he recalled the incident where Yuna gave him a hard drive and suddenly got her period.
He couldn't help but think that both of them were very embarrassed by that situation.
"Yuna's father, I've mentioned his occupation to you before. So, she is quite influential in Yarlford. If she's willing to help you, there shouldn't be a big issue!"
Chelsea explained calmly.
"Um, well, Chelsea, I've only met her a few times. We're not very familiar. Maybe it's better if you talk to her about this..."
He worried that if he personally approached Yuna, she might not agree.
"Alright, since you're seeking revenge for your parents, I'll definitely help you with this favor. I'll give her a call after I'm done skiing!"
Chelsea readily agreed.
"The bidding is about to start. Can you please hurry and get this done for me?"
Connor sounded anxious.
"Oh, come on, a few more hours won't make much of a difference. Just wait for my message!"
Chelsea exclaimed impatiently.
Connor felt speechless but didn't dare to say much. After all, he was asking for a favor.
"By the way, the Gomez family can be ruthless. So, be careful while you're in Yarlford. Don't end up sacrificing yourself before you've avenged your parents!"
Chelsea cautioned softly.
"I understand..."
He replied in a low voice, then continued, "I'm really in a hurry with this matter. Please do your best..."
Before he finished speaking, she hung up the phone directly.
He looked at his phone with an extremely speechless expression. However, he had nothing to worry about now. As long as Chelsea agreed to help, given her personality, it was almost certain that she would come through.
He let out a long sigh of relief.
At this point, he could clearly feel the pressure coming from the Gomez family.
Unfortunately, the influence of the Gomez family in Yarlford was truly terrifying. As Thomas had said, in Yarlford, without the support of the Gomez family, any company would find it extremely difficult to make progress.
Connor had the opportunity to participate in this bidding through his acquaintance with Chelsea. However, just for this small favor, he had already used up his most important connections. So, if anything else came up, he truly didn't know who he could turn to for help.
Sitting alone in his office with nothing to do, his mind was focused on waiting for Chelsea's response.
After about three hours, his phone finally rang.
He picked up his phone and saw that the incoming call was from an unfamiliar number.
His expression seemed puzzled, but he still answered the call.
"Hello, who is this?"
Connor asked softly.
"Guess who I am?"
A woman's voice came from the other end of the line.
Upon hearing the voice, he was taken aback for a moment. He felt that the voice was incredibly familiar, but he couldn't remember who it belonged to.
"It hasn't been that long since we met. You haven't forgotten me, have you?"
The person on the other end of the call sounded a bit annoyed.
"Miss Yuna?" he asked in astonishment.
"That's right, it's me!" Her voice was cheerful.
"Wait, I remember saving your number. Did you change your phone?" he hurriedly asked.
"Yes, due to my special status, I have to change my phone number regularly to ensure that no one can track me!" she explained.
"I see..."
Connor nodded.
"Connor, if you need something, why don't you just contact me directly? There's no need to involve Chelsea and have her ask me for help..." she continued.
"I was worried that you wouldn't be willing to help..."
He didn't hide anything and spoke honestly.
"You're quite straightforward. I heard from Chelsea that you're in Yarlford now, right?" she asked softly.
"Yes..."
Connor nodded.
"Since you're already planning to ask for my help, don't you think you should treat me to a meal?"
Yuna asked playfully.
"Miss Yuna, you're also in Yarlford?" he said in surprise.
"That's right. I came over a few days ago for a friend's wedding, and I haven't left yet!"
"Well, that's fantastic. What kind of food would you like? You can choose the place, and I'll come find you!"
Since Connor wasn't very familiar with Yarlford, he let her pick the restaurant.
"Alright, I'll send you the location in a moment. You can come find me!"
Yuna readily agreed and then hung up the phone.

chapters.title: Chapter 1691: Why Should I Help You?
chapters.content:
Chapter 1691: Why Should I Help You?
After seeing the call being disconnected, Connor's expression was still very excited. He could sense from Yuna's tone that she was likely willing to help.
A few minutes later, Connor received the location sent by Yuna. He directly grabbed a set of car keys from Queta and drove to the restaurant where Yuna was.
Knowing that he was wealthy, Yuna didn't hold back and chose one of the most famous restaurants in Yarlford. The minimum spending there was upwards of fifty thousand dollars, far beyond what an ordinary person could afford.
Upon entering the restaurant, Connor found the private room where Yuna was. The table in the room was already filled with dishes, and she was enjoying the feast alone.
Seeing the abundance of dishes on the table, his expression seemed a bit helpless. However, he wasn't worried at all. If she could truly help him secure the bid, the cost of this meal was insignificant to him.
She seemed to have dressed up carefully for the occasion. She wore a white short dress that accentuated her graceful figure, complemented by her delicate facial features. While she might not possess the perfect appearance and body of women like Vanessa or Chelsea, her aura, perhaps due to her status, was unmatched by ordinary women. Even Chelseea's demeanor couldn't compare to hers.
Among all the women Connor had known, she had the most outstanding temperament. This was why, despite any imperfections in her appearance or figure, he still considered her a stunning beauty.
"You're late. So, I went ahead and ordered the dishes. Hope you don't mind!"
She smiled at him as he arrived.
"It's fine, it's fine..."
He quickly replied and then sat down across from Yuna, smiling, "Miss Yuna, are these dishes enough? If you feel they're not sufficient, I can order more..."
"Wealthy people are really something. All these dishes combined probably cost over a hundred thousand, and you're still considering ordering more?" she said softly.
"What's a little money when I'm treating you to a meal?"
He grinned.
"After not seeing each other for so long, you're still as slick as ever..."
She pouted and continued, "Now I understand why Vanessa likes you so much. It's because of your silver tongue..."
Hearing this, he couldn't help but chuckle, feeling a bit embarrassed.
"Alright, I won't be able to eat much anyway. Let's discuss serious matters!" she said in a hushed voice.
"Sure!"
He nodded quickly.
"Chelsea already told me about your situation. You want your company to participate in the bidding for the land in Yarlford, right?" she asked.
"Yes!"
He nodded again.
"I've looked into the situation of that land. I have both good news and bad news. Which one do you want to hear first?"
"Let's start with the good news," he replied in a low voice.
"The good news is that you have a good eye. That land is in high demand. Many real estate companies in Yarlford are eyeing it, and it seems that the Gomez family doesn't plan to participate in the bidding this time. You're missing a formidable opponent because once the Gomez family enters the competition, you might not have a chance..." she said slowly.
"Gomez family won't take such a lucrative opportunity?" he asked, puzzled.
"Although the land is excellent, the Gomez family acquired an even better piece of land recently. So, to avoid suspicion, they withdrew from this bidding. That's how they usually operate. While they are the number one family in Yarlford, they can't claim all the good opportunities. Otherwise, other major families in Yarlford would unite against them sooner or later!" she explained.
"I see..."
He nodded slightly and then continued, "And what's the bad news?"
"The bad news is that while the Gomez family isn't participating, the Yaeger family and the Maverick family might enter the bidding. Their strength is not as great as the Gomez family's, but they are still significant players. Snatching that land from these two families won't be easy!" she said, looking at Connor.
"You don't need to worry about this. As long as I can participate in the bidding and it's fair, I don't mind spending a bit more money. I'll make sure to secure that land no matter what," he said earnestly to Yuna.
She observed him and hesitated for two seconds and then softly said, "Connor, I can use my connections to get you into the bidding, and I can ensure it's a fair competition. But have you considered that even if you secure the land at a high price, your profits will be limited? You might even end up losing money after the whole project!"
"Miss Yuna, I don't plan on making money from this land. I want to leverage its advantages to expand my company's influence!" he argued.
"Alright, even if you manage to secure the land, how do you ensure that your project can proceed smoothly? Aren't you worried that the Gomez family or other major families might obstruct you?"
She continued to question.
As he listened to her words, his expression showed a hint of helplessness. He answered in a low voice, "Miss Yuna, I haven't thought that far ahead. My primary focus is to secure the land first. As for what comes after, I'll find a solution."
"Alright, you don't have to consider these problems now. But have you ever thought about why I should help you?" she questioned him softly.
"Well..."
Upon hearing her question, he was instantly taken aback, his expression becoming somewhat awkward. He wasn't sure how to answer.
"Connor, you're not dealing with ordinary people this time; you're dealing with the Gomez family, a major clan. Even if it were me, I'd feel the pressure. Moreover, if I help you, I'd become an enemy of the entire Yarlford. Why should I take such a big risk for you?"
She continued after seeing his hesitation.

chapters.title: Chapter 1692: The Condition
chapters.content:
Chapter 1692: The Condition
Connor took a deep breath and replied with a helpless expression, "Miss Yuna, what you said makes sense. We haven't known each other for long, and our relationship isn't deep. You indeed have no reason to become an enemy of the entire Yarlford for my sake. How about this, if you have any conditions, just let me know. As long as it's within my capacity, I'll do my best to fulfill them for you!"
"My conditions?" Yuna smiled and then said softly, "My conditions are quite simple. I want 20% of your company's shares."
Instantly, he was taken aback by Yuna's words.
"As long as you give me 20% of the shares, I'll become the second-largest shareholder of your company. The things I'm doing are for my own benefit, not just to help you. It's not unreasonable for me to become an enemy of the whole Yarlford for my own gain," she said with a smile.
For a moment, he didn't know how to respond to her request. While directly giving her 20% of his company's shares seemed unreasonable, he understood that she was genuinely trying to help.
If she became a shareholder of his company, it would deter Yarlford's major families and the Gomez family from easily taking actions against his company. Even the formidable Gomez family wouldn't dare to target her, who would be tied to his company.
This way, his company would have a powerful background. Yuna's involvement could potentially shield his company from any serious threats.
While giving her 20% of the shares was a tremendous benefit for him, he still felt a bit awkward. Thus, he gently persuaded, "Miss Yuna, I'm not naive. I understand your intentions. If you really need shares, I could even offer you 80%. But I don't want my issues to burden you."
She sighed lightly and said in a low voice, "Do you think I want this? I've said it before, I need a reason to help you. Otherwise, how can I explain this to my father? I can't just help you out of nowhere. What would that look like?"
"But, Miss Yuna, have you considered that if I give you shares, my company's future endeavors might involve you as well?" he said softly.
"That's not a problem. After all, I'm not your company's legal representative. I'm just a shareholder. If I ever find that your company's situation isn't favorable, I can easily distance myself. No one would dare to harm me anyway," she casually replied.
"Then, are you really not reconsidering?" he asked again.
"What? Are you having second thoughts about my help?"
Yuna frowned.
"I want it!"
Connor responded quickly.
"Then why are you wasting time? Have your people bring over the share transfer contract. My flight is at 7 o'clock tonight. If you delay, you'll regret it..."
She looked at her phone and ordered him.
He hesitated for two seconds, then softly said, "Miss Yuna, thank you!"
"Why are you thanking me? If you want to thank someone, thank Chelsea. Without her, how could I help you with such a huge favor?"
Yuna continued to eat while speaking softly.
"I will."
Connor nodded, then took out his phone and called Queta to bring over the share transfer contract. He needed to prepare for Yuna to become a shareholder.
Once Yuna joined as a shareholder, Connor's company would have three shareholders: Connor with 70% of the shares, Yuna with 20%, and Queta with 10%. Queta would remain the legal representative of the company.
He planned to distribute another 8% of the shares to Justin, Dominic, Spencer, and Brook, giving each of them 2%. In the end, Connor would still hold the majority shares, 52%, making him the largest controlling shareholder.
After signing the contract with Yuna, he took her to the airport personally. Once she left, Queta looked puzzled and asked, "Mr. Connor, why did you give 20% of the shares to that woman?"
"Do you know how many companies in this world would want to give shares to this woman, but she wouldn't even look at them? Forget our company, even the Gomez family would gladly give her 20% of the shares if they could..." he replied softly.
"Who is this woman anyway?" Queta, after hearing his response, appeared even more bewildered.
"Her surname is Winston. Once she becomes a shareholder of our company, even the Gomez family won't dare to easily mess with us. Who do you think this woman is?" Connor said lightly.
"Winston?" She was momentarily stunned but quickly realized. Her tone was full of disbelief as she said, "Mr. Connor, could this woman be...?"
"That's right. This woman is the daughter of the person you're thinking of!" He nodded gently, then opened the car door and got in.
Queta stood still, completely stunned. Her eyes were a mixture of shock and disbelief. At this moment, she finally understood why Connor had the audacity to come to Yarlford and confront people like Yamino.
"How many more secrets does Mr. Connor have that I don't know?" she murmured, gazing at his departing figure, her eyes filled with astonishment.

chapters.title: Chapter 1693: Father's Bodyguard
chapters.content:
Chapter 1693: Father's Bodyguard
Half an hour later, Connor drove Queta back to her home, and then he headed back home alone.
However, just as he had left her villa for less than ten minutes, he suddenly noticed a person standing in the middle of the road, blocking his path.
He could sense that this person was not an ordinary individual, so he hesitated about whether he should stop the car. He was aware that his presence in Yarlford wasn't a secret, so it was possible that this person was sent by the Gomez family to deal with him.
After a moment's contemplation, he decided against stopping the car. Instead of hitting the brakes, he firmly pressed down on the gas pedal, attempting to drive past the person.
"Bang!"
