However, just as he was about to pass by the person, they shifted their position and stood directly in front of his car.
He instinctively attempted to hit the brakes, but it was too late. The car had been traveling too fast, and it couldn't come to a halt immediately. Connor had thought that he would run over the person, but something unexpected happened—the person used one hand to stop the car.
The car left deep tire marks on the road, skidding for over ten meters before finally coming to a stop.
The person standing in front of the car appeared unaffected, as if nothing had happened.
Connor, seeing this scene, immediately sensed that the person was likely a martial artist and probably at a higher level than him. Despite being a Black-tier martial artist, Connor hadn't brought any Chi Receiving Pills with him. Engaging this person in a fight at this moment would be a life-threatening situation.
"Did the Gomez family send such a formidable person to kill me?" Connor sat in the car, his expression a mix of helplessness, mentally planning how to escape the situation.
But in the next second, the person who had been blocking his way actually opened the car door and got inside.
He instinctively wanting to open the door and get out but was stopped by the person's hand. They spoke in a low voice, "Don't be afraid, I'm not here to harm you."
He was momentarily taken aback by this statement, then turned to look at the person sitting in the passenger seat.
The middle-aged person appeared to be around forty years old, wearing linen clothes. His physique was sturdy, and his appearance was ordinary, but his face bore a fierce scar, and his eyes held a deep gaze.
"You... Who are you?" After a brief hesitation, he chose not to exit the car.
Because he felt that this person probably didn't have any malicious intentions toward him. Otherwise, when the person had stopped his car earlier, they could have attacked him then. However, they had refrained from doing so.
"Are you Connor?" The middle-aged person didn't answer his question but asked in a hoarse voice.
"I asked you first. Who are you?" Connor said helplessly.
"Are you Connor or not?" The middle-aged person continued to ask.
"No, seriously, is something wrong with your brain? You stop my car in the middle of the night, and you don't even tell me who you are? What exactly do you want?" he exclaimed in frustration.
"I just want to know if you're Connor," the middle-aged person replied.
He looked at the middle-aged person and took a deep breath. He then said in a low voice, "I'm not Connor. You've got the wrong person."
"Oh!" The middle-aged person nodded slightly and reached out to open the car door, as if intending to get out.
Connor, seeing this, became even more perplexed. He hadn't expected this person to be so easily fooled. He said he wasn't Connor, and the person just believed him.
Connor sensed that this middle-aged person truly meant no harm. So, right at the moment when the person was about to leave the car, he spoke up, "I am Connor. Do you have something to discuss with me?"
Upon hearing his words, the middle-aged person turned his head slightly, glanced at Connor, and then asked in a soft voice, "How can you prove you're Connor?"
"Come on, seriously? You ask if I'm Connor, I admit it, and you're still asking how I can prove it? What do you want from me?" He was on the verge of exasperation.
After a brief hesitation, the middle-aged person took out an old photograph from his clothes. The person in the photo was indeed Connor, but he was only five or six years old at the time.
Seeing the photograph, his expression turned even more shocked. He quickly asked, "Where did you get this photo?"
"Mr. Dawson gave it to me..." the middle-aged person calmly explained, then earnestly examined Connor for a moment before nodding and saying, "You didn't lie to me. You are Connor, Mr. Dawson's son."
"So, you're saying that Mr. Dawson is my father?" Connor asked in a puzzled manner.
"Yes," the middle-aged person nodded gently.
"Who are you then? How do you know my father?" Connor inquired.
"I'm Mr. Dawson's bodyguard. You can call me Yama. As for my real name, I no longer remember it!" the middle-aged person replied.
"You're my father's bodyguard?" Connor's facial expression seemed even more stunned. He continued, "Is what you're saying really true?"
"The photo is from Mr. Dawson. He brought me here many years ago and told me to wait here. He said that twenty years later, his descendant would appear. So, I've been waiting here for you for twenty years," the middle-aged person said, looking at Connor.
"But my father has been dead for over a decade. What's the purpose of you waiting for me here?" Connor inquired further.
"I am here to protect you," Yama answered.
"Who needs your protection? How do I know if what you're saying is true? Who are you really?" Connor frowned.
"I am Yama, Mr. Dawson's bodyguard. This photo is proof of my words," he replied solemnly.
"Seriously, can you stop repeating yourself like a broken record? Don't you have any other evidence? Since you claim to be my father's bodyguard, you should know a lot about him, right? Why don't you tell me something about my father..."

chapters.title: Chapter 1694: Identity Verification
chapters.content:
Chapter 1694: Identity Verification
"I don't remember much about the past..."
The middle-aged man shook his head gently at Connor's question.
"Don't remember?"
Upon hearing this, Connor couldn't help but smile, then said softly, "What do you mean you don't remember?"
"I have amnesia now, so I don't remember anything from before. I only remember that I need to wait for you here and protect your safety. I used to be Mr. Dawson's bodyguard, and now that Mr. Dawson is gone, I'm your bodyguard," the middle-aged man explained.
"Heh..."
Connor chuckled upon hearing this, then spoke softly, "Well, here's the thing. I don't really know who you are right now, so I can't keep you with me. What if you're someone sent by my enemies to spy on me? That would be troublesome, don't you think?"
Connor seriously explained his perspective to Yama.
"Alright, if you don't want me to follow you, that's fine. But I still have to protect you!" Yama nodded gently.
"That's fine then. Give me a phone number. If I really need your help, I'll give you a call. How does that sound?" Connor suggested.
"I don't have a phone. I had one before, but I didn't know how to use it, so I got rid of it!" Yama replied.
Connor was left speechless by his response. He sighed and said, "Alright, here's what we'll do. I'll take you to buy a phone. That way, I can contact you when needed."
"Okay!"
Yama nodded in agreement.
After this decision, Connor started the car and took Yama to a 24-hour cellphone store. He bought Yama a basic phone designed for elderly users. Given Yama's amnesia, he thought a simple phone would be more suitable for him.
Once the purchase was done, he stored his own phone number in Yama's new phone and explained how to make and receive calls. Though Yama had lost his memories, he was still quite intelligent. Connor only had to demonstrate once, and Yama quickly learned how to use the phone.
With the phone sorted out, they returned to the car.
"You can use this phone to contact me from now on. If you have something important, feel free to call me. And if I need to reach you, I'll do the same," Connor told Yama as he got back into the car.
"Alright!"
Yama glanced at his phone and nodded softly.
"It's getting late now. Let me drop you off at your place. Where do you live?" Connor asked Yama.
"I don't have a place to live. I usually sleep on the streets," Yama replied.
"Really? I saw you have some good martial skills. You should be a Black-rank martial artist, right? How did you end up in such a situation?" Connor asked with a hint of disbelief.
"I've been waiting for you all these years, and to avoid revealing my identity, I had to scavenge for a living," Yama said in a low voice.
Connor cast a side glance at Yama, feeling somewhat touched by his dedication. If Yama was indeed his father's bodyguard and had waited for him in Yarlford for so many years, it was truly moving.
However, he still had many questions unanswered. According to Yama, Connor's father had asked him to wait for Connor, implying that his father had known about Connor's arrival in Yarlford twenty years ago.
This raised suspicions. Did Connor's father know about his potential capture by the Gomez family twenty years in advance?
The more he thought about it, the more uneasy he felt. But Yama's amnesia left him with no way to find the answers from this man.
However, at this moment, Connor suddenly remembered that Chelsea had a good relationship with his parents back in the day. If Yama truly was his father's bodyguard, Chelsea would likely know about Yama's existence.
He took out his phone and dialed Chelsea's number without hesitation.
"Ring ring..."
After a few rings, she picked up the phone.
"Little Connor, is everything settled? Are you calling to thank me?" Her voice sounded cheerful.
"Thank you. After all, if it weren't for you, I wouldn't have been able to sort out the auction matter so quickly," he replied softly. Then he continued, "But I have something I want to ask you..."
"What is it?" she asked curiously.
"Here's the thing, I encountered someone on the road today, and that person is in my car now. He claims to be my father's bodyguard. I wanted to ask if you know anything about my father having a bodyguard named Yama?" he inquired directly.
At this moment, Yama was still busy inspecting his old-age cellphone. He didn't react to the conversation he overheard.
"Yama?" Her tone changed upon hearing the name.
"Yes, he told me his name is Yama, but he doesn't know his real name. He has amnesia now, and he's a skilled martial artist, likely a Black-rank," Connor answered softly.
"It's true that your father did have a bodyguard named Yama. I met this person once, but it's been so long that I can't recall his appearance. However, I heard that Yama passed away twenty years ago. After that, he disappeared," she explained slowly.
Taking a deep breath upon hearing this, he spoke softly, "I see. I understand now. I'll hang up. Thanks."
"Sure."
Chelsea agreed and then hung up the phone directly.

chapters.title: Chapter 1695: Participating in the Auction
chapters.content:
Chapter 1695: Participating in the Auction
After putting down his phone, Connor glanced at Yama beside him.
Based on what Chelsea had just said, Connor could confirm that his father indeed had a bodyguard named Yama. However, as Yama himself had mentioned, he had already passed away twenty years ago. This matched the information he received from Yama.
Thus, Connor suspected that the person beside him might indeed be his father's bodyguard. The fact that this person had never shown hostility and had multiple opportunities to harm Connor lent some credibility to his story.
Though he was leaning towards believing Yama's claim, he still couldn't fully trust him. With a gentle tone, he said, "Since you've found me now, you don't need to continue scavenging for a living. I'll take you to a hotel and get you a room. You can stay there."
"Sure!" Yama replied without hesitation.
After a while, Connor found a hotel with high-end decor and excellent security. His purpose in arranging Yama in a hotel was to observe him closely. The hotel corridors and entrances were monitored, so he would be able to know what Yama was doing at any given time.
He got Yama a suite, and he paid for six months upfront. To him, the cost was negligible at this point.
The chosen suite directly faced a corridor camera on the eighteenth floor. If Yama wanted to leave the suite, he would have to go through the corridor, giving Connor a clear view of his activities.
"From now on, you'll stay here," Connor said softly after entering the room.
"Alright!" Yama nodded in agreement.
"This hotel has its own restaurant. If you get hungry, you can go to the lobby on the ground floor. I've allocated a dining budget of one hundred thousand yuan for you. So, after you eat, you won't need to pay; just give them your room number," Connor said as he placed some cash on the table. He continued, "This money is for you. Keep it for emergencies."
"Alright!"
In response to his monotonous agreement, Connor joked, "Is 'alright' the only word you know? I spent so much money on you, and you can't even say 'thank you'?"
"I'll repay you in the future, so I don't need to say thank you now," he replied.
"You don't even know who you are right now, and you're talking about repaying me?" Connor chuckled and continued, "Alright, I'm leaving. Stay here and let me know if you need anything."
"Okay!"
He sighed internally at Yama's unchanging response and walked out of the room.
After leaving Yama's room, he headed straight for the hotel manager.
"Sir, is there something you need?" The hotel manager treated Connor with exceptional politeness, knowing that he had just booked a six-month stay with a substantial meal budget.
"Starting today, I want you to monitor the guest in room 1802. Keep track of when he leaves and if anyone visits him. Document everything, and I'll find you in a month," Connor instructed the manager in a low voice.
"Sir, I'm sorry, but this involves our guests' privacy…" the manager began to object.
Connor cut him off, saying expressionlessly, "Give me your bank account number."
"Sir, what do you mean?" The manager was bewildered.
"Stop the nonsense and give me your bank account number," Connor repeated impatiently.
After a moment of hesitation, the manager reluctantly provided his bank account number. Connor transferred fifty thousand yuan to the manager's account through mobile banking and said, "Consider this a deposit. I'll send another fifty thousand in a month. Is a total of one hundred thousand dollars enough?"
"It's… enough…" The manager was left dumbfounded by Connor's offer. He stammered his reply.
The manager definitely would accept this deal. He didn't have to do much—just watch Yama for a month and get paid a hundred thousand yuan. Such a windfall was hard to come by.
Connor smiled at the manager, then walked away.
With Yama's situation taken care of, Connor returned home. After a busy day, things were falling into place, especially with Yuna becoming a shareholder in Connor's company.
The organizers of the bidding event wouldn't dare ignore Yuna, and his company secured the qualification to participate with ease.
The other companies participating in the bidding were indifferent towards Connor's Stormbound Real Estate. They were unaware of the formidable background supporting the company and perceived it as just another recently established small firm.
A week passed quickly. The bidding event was finally about to begin.
At 8 AM, Connor and Queta left Stormbound Tower and headed straight to the venue of the bidding event.
"Qiaoqiao, how much do you think the other major families will bid for this piece of land?" he asked her as he drove.
She hesitated for a moment after hearing the question, then whispered, "I think they might offer up to eight billion dollars at most..."
"Eight billion?"
His expression showed a touch of surprise upon hearing this number. He hadn't expected the land to be worth so much.
"This piece of land has the best location and is the largest in Yarlford right now. If we secure it, we can earn a significant profit no matter what we do with it. However, the condition is that the land acquisition cost needs to stay under eight billion dollars. Going beyond that would leave very little profit margin for the company. Moreover, it's crucial to consider that a significant initial investment in land acquisition might burden these companies financially. While your Empire World Corporation is financially strong enough to handle it, other companies in Yarlford wouldn't have the same luxury," she explained.
"Since they can offer a maximum of eight billion, what if I raise the bid to one hundred billion? Do you think we can still make a profit after securing the land?" he asked solemnly.

chapters.title: Chapter 1696: Long Time No See
chapters.content:
Chapter 1696: Long Time No See
"Hundred billion?"
Upon hearing Connor's words, Queta's expression turned incredulous. She shook her head with a hint of helplessness and said, "Mr. Connor, if you really plan to secure the land with that price, we'll be losing at least ten billion dollars. Even if the land promises substantial profits, we would still be incurring significant losses..."
"No worries, let's go with a hundred billion," Connor said contentedly.
"But, Mr. Connor..."
Queta seemed concerned.
"No 'buts.' Didn't you already mention it? Even if we secure the land at a hundred billion, we would lose over ten billion. I don't believe any company would be willing to endure such losses just to obtain this land. My goal in acquiring the land isn't solely for profits, so it doesn't matter even if we incur losses," he said in a relaxed tone.
"However, there's still a substantial risk involved," she gently advised.
"I'm well aware of the risk. But if we don't bid with this price, do you think we have any chance of winning this land?" he replied softly.
Queta sighed inwardly, understanding that Connor seemed determined. Her attempts to dissuade him at this point would likely be in vain.
A little while later, they finally arrived at the bidding venue.
The bidding was originally scheduled to start at 10 AM, and they had arrived an hour earlier.
Connor thought they might have been a bit early, but to his surprise, some people had already arrived before them. The parking lot in front of the venue was packed with cars. Yarlford had a significant number of affluent individuals, and given the value of the land, missing this opportunity wasn't something anyone would want.
Though the Yaeger family might currently be the most powerful candidate, that didn't guarantee an uncontested outcome. Anyone who attended the bidding was connected to the Gomez family in some way. Hence, the Yaeger family didn't hold a significant advantage in this aspect.
Given the high level of public interest in the land, reporters were present to cover the bidding results. This meant that the highest bidder would secure the land; there were no predetermined deals. This was why so many people had come to participate.
Connor and Queta weren't familiar with the local elites of Yarlford, so they didn't recognize many faces.
People were mingling in groups of three to five, creating a lively atmosphere. Under these circumstances, many commercial groups had formed alliances spontaneously. They intended to collaborate to bid for the land—only together could they have a chance. Bidding independently would leave them no match for families like the Yaeger's.
Queta's attractive appearance drew attention, causing several individuals to approach her. Connor, on the other hand, was largely ignored and assumed to be her driver.
However, as word spread that she was from Stormbound Real Estate, people's expressions changed abruptly. Many had never heard of this company before.
She felt a bit uncomfortable under these circumstances. Back when she was in Orilon, she had been highly regarded everywhere she went. She hadn't faced such disdain before.
"Don't bother with these people. After today's bidding is over, they'll all come to butter you up. Then, everyone will know about Stormbound Real Estate," Connor consoled her in a low voice.
"Yeah." She nodded softly in response.
As none of the people present were familiar with them, the two found a quiet corner to sit.
With time passing, more and more people filled the venue.
When a woman entered the scene, most of the attendees stood up and approached her to greet her.
"It's her?"
Upon seeing the woman, Connor couldn't help but be taken aback. It was none other than Aida, the heiress of the Collie family he had met in York.
Beside Aida was a young man, Cielo. Connor knew that this young man was Albert's son.
"Why would the Collie family attend the bidding event?" Connor looked puzzled.
"Mr. Connor, do you know this woman?" Queta asked softly upon hearing Connor's words.
"Sort of," Connor replied with a slight nod.
Meanwhile, Aida seemed to have noticed Connor and looked over, her expression peculiar.
Taking a deep breath, Connor stood up and walked through the crowd towards Aida.
A moment later, he arrived in front of her, who was dressed elegantly and provocatively. He smiled and said, "Miss Aida, long time no see!"
Aida glanced at Connor with an indifferent expression. She recalled how he had tormented her with poison in the past, so her face showed a hint of hostility.
Indeed, he had used poison to torment her, but she had already taken the antidote long ago. Thus, she wasn't afraid of him anymore.
"It has indeed been a while," she replied coldly.
"Miss Aida, there's something I'd like to discuss with you. Do you have some time?" he asked calmly while observing Aida's reaction. Cielo, who was next to her, also drew his attention.
She hesitated for a moment before saying softly, "Alright."
Seeing that she agreed, he turned and walked towards the exit of the bidding hall. She briefly greeted those around her before following him.
As Cielo hadn't seen Connor before, he didn't recognize the young man who had appeared. Thus, he didn't realize that the person in front of him was the Collie family's most formidable enemy—Connor.
Aida followed Connor out of the hall.
They reached the end of the corridor, and Connor turned to Aida. "You've already obtained evidence of Cielo's crimes, right? Why is he still here?"
"Our Collie family has undergone significant changes due to your actions. Beau has been in the family all along. If I were to act against Cielo now, Beau would spare no expense to protect his grandson. So, I can't make a move at the moment," Aida explained.

chapters.title: Chapter 1697: The Heiress of the Yaeger Family
chapters.content:
Chapter 1697: The Heiress of the Yaeger Family
"After I killed Maurice, how did the Collie family react?"
Connor continued to ask.
"Haven't you already seen the Collie family's reaction? Beau had already found a way to deal with you, so he chose to join forces with the Gomez family at this time. Otherwise, I wouldn't have appeared at this auction!"
Aida continued.
"I see!"
Connor smiled faintly and said softly,"Then Miss Aida, the two of us have to continue working together in the future!"
"Work together?"
She couldn't help but sneer when she heard his words. Then, she said indifferently, "I'm sorry, you're really too dangerous. I don't want to join forces with you!"
"Do you have any other choice?" he asked expressionlessly.
"I can completely rely on myself to complete what I want to do!" she said.
"Hehe, Miss Aida, I think you're too naive. If the Collie family and the Gomez family join hands to get rid of me, then the Gomez family will attack your Collie family next."
He paused for a moment and then continued, "Of course, this is just my suggestion. You can think about it yourself. If you join forces with me, it will be beneficial to you. Now, even in the entire Oprana, you won't be able to find a second person who can help you deal with the Collie family!"
"I'm sorry, I don't need to think about it. No matter what, I won't join hands with someone like you, because you're even more terrifying than those people from the Collie family!"
Aida said to Connor with an unusually cold expression.
"Don't be in such a hurry to reject me. You'll understand sooner or later!"
He looked at her and smiled, then walked into the hall.
"This bastard!"
She stared at his back and cursed under her breath.
At this moment, she had no intention of forgiving him at all. Therefore, she had long regarded him as a target for her revenge. She would never choose to cooperate with him.
When Connor returned to the hall, he found that the auction was about to begin, so he walked over to Queta and sat down.
A few minutes later, the host went on stage to give a speech.
After a few simple words, the bidding finally officially began.
However, when he saw the starting price, he could not help but be shocked. The starting price was actually five billion!
This price could be considered the highest starting price for the land auction in Yarlford.
Moreover, the land auction was different from ordinary auctions. The rules of the auction were not very detailed. In any case, as long as the bidding price was higher than the starting price, whoever paid more money in the end would be able to get the land.
When everyone saw the price, they all sucked in a breath of cold air and began to discuss softly.
"5.2 billion!"
At this moment, the CEO of a company raised the sign in his hand and shouted.
"5.3 billion!"
Soon, a second person made a bid.
"5.1 billion!"
Soon, the third person made a bid.
The scene instantly became lively.
Connor and Queta looked at this lively scene with calm expressions. From the beginning to the end, they had no intention of bidding. After all, they knew that it was not the time for them to bid.
After a round of intense bidding, the final price was fixed at 6.5 billion.
This price had clearly exceeded the expectations of the CEOs present, so most of them fell silent.
"Mr. Coin of Dragon Age has bid 6.5 billion. Is there anyone who wants to bid?"
At this moment, the emcee shouted expressionlessly.
For a moment, the entire auction hall fell silent.
Cielo turned to look at Aida, who nodded gently.
"6.2 billion!"
He did not waste any time and shouted.
After everyone heard his words, they were stunned. They all turned to look at the sky, their faces filled with shock.
Mr. Coin could not help but frown. Then, he shouted in a low voice, "6.3 billion!"
Seeing this situation, everyone gave up on the idea of continuing the auction. The moment they opened their mouths, they increased the bid by 100 million. The purpose of doing so was obviously to suppress the opponent and make the opponent retreat.
"6.5 billion!"
He chuckled.
When everyone heard this number, they all sucked in a breath of cold air. They could not help but sigh in their hearts that this piece of land had no fate with them.
"6.7 billion!"
Mr. Carter gritted his teeth and shouted.
"7 billion!"
Cielo did not hesitate at all and said this number very naturally.
When Mr. Carter heard this number, he was dumbfounded.
He looked at Cielo helplessly and did not say anything. It was obvious that this person had already chosen to give up.
"Mr. Cielo has bid seven billion. Is there anyone who wants to continue bidding?"
the host asked softly.
Everyone quieted down again.
Queta turned her head and glanced at Connor, as if she was asking for his opinion.
"It's almost time to start!"
Connor felt that Cielo's price was about to reach the limit that the Collie family could afford, so it was time for him to make a move.
After Queta understood what he meant, she opened her mouth to bid.
"7.3 billion!"
However, at this moment, a very clear sound rang out in the hall.
When everyone heard this voice, they all looked up at the entrance of the venue.
A tall and beautiful woman, accompanied by bodyguards, slowly walked into the venue.
This tall beauty was none other than the eldest daughter of the Yaeger family, Charis, whom Connor had met at the airport.
At this moment, she was wearing a short black skirt that wrapped around her hips. Her sexy figure looked especially charming under the short skirt. Her slender and fair legs were of moderate thickness. She was wearing black stockings and a pair of high heels. Her exquisite face matched with her big, wavy black hair, giving off an indescribable temptation.
When the man in the venue saw her, he quickly stood up and made way for Charis.
Charis did not stand on ceremony and directly sat in the front row.
After hearing her bid, Cielo took a deep breath and said in a low voice,""7.5 billion!"
"7.8 billion!"
She had no intention of wasting his breath on Cielo. He directly shouted out a price that everyone found unbelievable.
Almost all the companies present had predicted that once the price of this land exceeded 8 billion, the profit margin would be very small. If they were not careful, they might suffer losses. More importantly, taking out so much money at once was a very big burden for any company.
The price that Charis quoted was already the highest price.

chapters.title: Chapter 1698: Acquiring the Land
chapters.content:
Chapter 1698: Acquiring the Land
As Cielo heard this new bid, his expression became hesitant. He couldn't help but glance at Aida.
"According to the instructions from home, even if we face losses, we need to secure this land. After all, this is the best opportunity for our Collie family to expand into Yarlford's real estate market. As long as the price stays under eighty-one billion, our family can accept it," Aida reminded Cielo softly, understanding his thoughts.
"I understand," Cielo nodded slightly at Aida's reminder, then called out, "Eighty billion!"
Charis listened to this new bid and sneered, "Lacking the courage to go all out, yet daring to compete with me for this land, how laughable."
"Eighty-two billion!" Charis's voice echoed again.
Everyone in the room was stunned. The expressions on their faces were filled with disbelief. Eighty billion was already considered the limit, but no one expected Charis to bid eighty-two billion.
This bid reflected her determination to claim this land, even if it meant incurring losses.
Cielo shot her an angry look, but he was in a difficult situation. Her bid had clearly exceeded what the Collie family could afford. If he continued bidding, Beau might not agree.
Cielo's expression remained hesitant. He wasn't sure what to do.
"If you keep bidding, Charis will probably keep bidding as well. Let it go," Aida advised in a hushed tone.
Although he felt unwilling, he had no other choice. He lowered his head slowly.
Upon seeing that he didn't place another bid, Charis smirked triumphantly. She was confident that she would secure the land.
The host also knew that Charis's bid was likely the limit. He called out, "Eighty-two billion, going once!"
"Eighty-two billion, going twice!"
The host raised his small hammer as he announced the final warning.
"Eighty-five billion!"
To everyone's surprise, another bid came in at this moment.
All eyes turned to the source of the bid, which was none other than Queta.
People in the room were puzzled by her bid. Most of them didn't recognize her.
Even Charis cast a quick glance at her.
Chaos erupted in the room as people whispered among themselves. The price of eighty-five billion was staggering.
"Who is this woman?"
"I don't know. It seems like we've never seen her before..."
"Exactly! She's bidding eighty-five billion directly. Is she looking to lose money?"
"Who would have thought there are so many wealthy people in Yarlford..."
The voices of the crowd gradually filled the air.
Charis hesitated for two seconds and then shouted, "Eighty-eight billion!"
"Ninety billion!" Queta didn't give anyone a chance to be surprised. She almost immediately followed Charis's bid with her own.
Now, Charis was taken aback. She stood up abruptly and looked at Queta behind her.
"Host, does this person have the qualifications to participate? Isn't she causing trouble?" Charis questioned.
"Miss Charis, this person is the General Manager of Stormbound Real Estate. She does indeed have the qualifications to participate," the host confirmed Queta's identity and explained in a low voice.
"What nonsense is Stormbound Real Estate? Why haven't I heard of it before?" Charis angrily exclaimed.
"Miss, whether you've heard of Strombound Real Estate is not important. It might be your own lack of awareness. But is it reasonable to resort to insults when bidding? Is this how the Yaeger family conducts business?" Connor, still sitting in his seat, asked Charis with a smile.
"Who are you? Who gave you the right to speak here?" Charis replied disdainfully.
"He is the Chairwoman of Stormbound Real Estate," Queta calmly clarified.
The crowd turned their gazes to him with astonishment. They could tell that he wasn't very old. To become the Chairman of Strombound Real Estate at such a young age was impressive. If Strombound Real Estate were just a small company, it wouldn't have been noteworthy. However, considering that it was a major corporation bidding ninety billion, it piqued their curiosity about his background.
"Miss Charis, would you like to continue bidding?" The host softly asked Charis.
Charis hesitated for a moment as she glanced at Connor's position. Then, without a word, she stood up and walked out of the auction hall.
Eighty-eight billion had already been her limit. She couldn't continue bidding.
While the auction hadn't concluded yet, many attendees were already approaching Queta. They recognized that Strombound Real Estate securing the land would mean the company would have a significant presence in Yarlford's real estate market.
Queta and Cielo might have lost the bid, but since the final price was far beyond their budget, they had some explanations to provide when they returned to their respective families. However, it wasn't too much of a blow.
Yet, Charis was in a different situation. She had been determined to obtain this land. However, she hadn't anticipated that it would be snatched by Strombound Real Estate, which seemingly appeared out of nowhere. This land was crucial to the Yaeger family, so after leaving the bidding hall, she still felt uneasy. She ordered the driver to turn the car around and come back.

chapters.title: Chapter 1699: Looking For The Chairman
chapters.content:
Chapter 1699: Looking For The Chairman
It didn't take long for Connor and Queta to complete the procedures.
From now on, this piece of land belongs to them.
Queta felt like she was in a dream. Initially, she had spoken to Connor with the hope of securing this land, but she hadn't expected that he would actually succeed.
"Mr. Connor, with this land, in less than two years, Strombound Real Estate can establish itself as a top-tier real estate enterprise in Yarlford!" she exclaimed.
"Two years is too slow. I can give you at most a year and a half to achieve this goal. Of course, you don't have to worry about funds. If you need money, just talk to Thomas," he replied casually.
"Alright, I'll do my best!" She nodded lightly.
"Are you the Chairman of Strombound Real Estate?" At this moment, a crisp voice sounded.
Connor was taken aback by this question, and he slowly looked up to find Charisa standing in front of him.
She was wearing high-heeled shoes that made her even taller than Connor.
"Yes, it's me." He nodded slightly at her question.
"I want to talk to you now!" she said arrogantly.
"Talk?" He was momentarily surprised by her request, then responded expressionlessly, "I'm sorry, I don't know you, and we have nothing to talk about."
After saying this, he turned to her and said, "Let's go!"
She hadn't anticipated that he would reject her. She took off her sunglasses, revealing her face.
Seeing Charisa without her sunglasses, Connor got a clear look at her for the first time. Not only she had a great figure but also an attractive appearance. However, her temper seemed to be a bit challenging. Marrying someone like her would be a challenge.
"I told you earlier, I want to talk to you!" Charisa stood in Connor's way, her voice cold.
"I also told you earlier, I don't have time!" he replied with the same cold tone.
He then led her towards the parking area.
Left standing alone, Charisa's eyes turned from anger to fury. As a member of the Yaeger family, she had never experienced such a situation before.
Connor and Queta got into their car and left. They continued discussing matters related to the land development while in the car. Upon arriving at the company, she immediately gathered the team for a meeting. After all, they had successfully acquired the land, and the entire company needed to start working on it.
However, Connor, not very interested in attending meetings, planned to take Dominic and others out to eat as a celebration for securing the land. Unfortunately, him and others had to stay behind for the meeting, leaving Connor alone in his office playing with his phone.
Accompanying Connor and Queta to Stormbound Tower, Charisa observed the building briefly and expressed her surprise, "I never expected that the company of that bastard could be this big. How come I haven't heard about a real estate company like this in Yarlford?"
After making the observation, she walked into Stormbound Tower.
"Hello, who are you looking for?" the receptionist, a young woman, asked proactively when she saw Charisa.
"I'm looking for the Chairman of Strombound Real Estate," Charisa replied expressionlessly.
"Oh, please wait a moment. Let me call Mr. Connor..." The receptionist picked up the phone to call Connor's office.
She glared at the receptionist and directly walked towards the elevator.
"Miss, I'm sorry, but I need to get approval from Mr. Connor before you can go in!" the receptionist tried to stop Charisa, not understanding what she was trying to do.
"Do you know who I am?" she asked the receptionist.
"I... I don't know..." The receptionist was taken aback, then shook her head lightly.
"Here's my business card!" She reached into her bag and handed a business card to the receptionist.
The receptionist took Charisa's business card, her expression showing surprise. She understood the position of the Yaeger family in Yarlford, but she hadn't expected that the person in front of her was the General Manager of Yaeger Group in Yarlford.
"Miss Liu, I'm terribly sorry for not recognizing you earlier..."
Understanding that offending someone from the Yaeger family in Yarlford would mean trouble, the receptionist's attitude changed significantly.
"Can I go in now?" Charisa asked the receptionist without a change in her expression.
"Of course you can!" The receptionist didn't dare to stop Charisa now, considering her importance.
"Which floor is your Chairman's office on?" she asked calmly.
"On the eighteenth floor!" The receptionist answered.
"Thank you!" Charisa smiled lightly at the receptionist and then walked into the elevator.
Connor and Queta returned to the company after a while. Queta immediately gathered the team for a meeting, as they needed to kickstart the development process for the newly acquired land. However, Connor wasn't very interested in attending the meeting and instead thought about treating Dominic and others to a meal to celebrate the successful acquisition. Nevertheless, since Dominic and his team had to stay for the meeting, Connor found himself alone in his office, playing with his phone.
While accompanying Connor and Queta to Stormbound Tower, Charisa observed the building briefly and expressed her surprise, "I never expected that the company of that bastard could be this big. How come I haven't heard about a real estate company like this in Yarlford?"
After making the observation, Charisa walked into Stormbound Tower.
"Hello, who are you looking for?" the receptionist, a young woman, asked proactively when she saw Charisa.
"I'm looking for the Chairman of Strombound Real Estate," Charisa replied expressionlessly.
"Oh, please wait a moment. Let me call Mr. Zhang..." The receptionist picked up the phone to call Connor's office.
"...," Charisa looked at the receptionist and directly walked towards the elevator.
"Miss, I'm sorry, but I need to get approval from Mr. Zhang before you can go in!" the receptionist tried to stop Charisa, not understanding what she was trying to do.
"Do you know who I am?" Charisa asked the receptionist.
"I... I don't know..." The receptionist was taken aback, then shook her head lightly.
"Here's my business card!" Charisa reached into her bag and handed a business card to the receptionist.
The receptionist took Charisa's business card, her expression showing surprise. She understood the position of the Yaeger family in Yarlford, but she hadn't expected that the person in front of her was the General Manager of Ye Group in Yarlford.
"Miss Liu, I'm terribly sorry for not recognizing you earlier..."
Understanding that offending someone from the Yaeger family in Yarlford would mean trouble, the receptionist's attitude changed significantly.
"Can I go in now?" Charisa asked the receptionist without a change in her expression.
"Of course you can!" The receptionist didn't dare to stop Charisa now, considering her importance.
"Which floor is your Chairman's office on?" Charisa asked calmly.
"On the eighteenth floor!" The receptionist answered.
"Thank you!" Charisa smiled lightly at the receptionist and then walked into the elevator.

chapters.title: Chapter 1700: The Right to Be Arrogant!
chapters.content:
Chapter 1700: The Right to Be Arrogant!
After entering the elevator, Charisa pressed the button for the eighteenth floor.
Not long after, the elevator doors opened.
She stepped out of the elevator directly, and with a stride, she walked out of the elevator. At a glance, she saw the CEO's office at the front.
Perhaps due to her overwhelming anger, she didn't bother knocking and just pushed the door open and entered Connor's office.
When he saw her coming in and hesitated in surprise, he furrowed his brows and asked, "How did you get in?"
"I want to talk to you," she said expressionlessly.
"Talk? Haven't I made it clear to you before? I don't think there's any need for us to talk further," he said somewhat speechlessly.
"I haven't told you what it's about yet. How do you know there's no need to talk?" she said as she spoke, she naturally sat on the sofa, her long and fair legs crossed together, giving the impression that she and Connor weren't meeting for the first time.
He looked at her, hesitated for a moment, and then smiled as he said, "Sure, since you want to talk to me, I'll give you the opportunity. Go ahead and tell me what you want to talk about."
"The piece of land you acquired today is very important to me. Name your price, and transfer the land to me," she said directly without wasting any words.
"Heh, why would I transfer the land to you when I just acquired it?" He couldn't help but chuckle at Charisa's words. He continued, "But if you really want that land, you can have it—for 150 billion. As long as you can come up with that money, I can give you the land anytime."
"You!" Her expression turned angry upon hearing this. She lowered her voice and said, "You bought that land for 9 billion, and now you're asking for 150 billion? Do you think I'm a fool? If I had that much money, why didn't I just bid for it myself?"
"Didn't you just tell me to make any offer?" he replied indifferently, then continued, "Your tone seemed quite arrogant earlier. I thought you had some real power, but it seems you're just lacking money!"
"I don't want to waste any more words with you. You bought this land for 9 billion before, and now I'll buy it back from you at the same price. But I can only pay you 8.5 billion now, and I'll give you the rest within a year. What do you think?" She adjusted her emotions and softly asked him.
"Do you think I'm stupid, or is it your brain that's malfunctioning? I bought that land for 9 billion. Why should I sell it back to you for the same price now? What's my motivation?" he asked in confusion.
"Do you know who I am?" she asked him in a hushed voice.
"Not really!" Connor shook his head.
"I'm from the Yaeger family. If you agree to the conditions I mentioned earlier, it's like I owe you a favor. If you ever need my help in the future, I'll assist you!" she said proudly.
At this moment, Charisa's confidence stemmed largely from her belief that being from the Yaeger family carried significant weight. After leaving the Gomez family, she thought that no one in Yarlford would dare to provoke the Yaeger family. On the contrary, they would go to great lengths to please them.
Therefore, she believed that just by mentioning this condition, he would definitely agree to her request.
"I don't need your help with anything!" However, what she didn't anticipate was that Connor, upon hearing her words, chose to refuse once again.
Upon hearing his response, her composure wavered. She suddenly stood up, glared at him with wide angry eyes, and shouted, "Do you even know who I am?"
"Now I know who you are. You're from the Yaeger family. But does that have anything to do with this matter?" Connor replied calmly, "Even if you're from the Yaeger family, so what? Do you think I'll give up this land just because you're from the Yaeger family? Aren't you overestimating the influence of your Yaeger family?"
She was left speechless by his retort, not knowing how to respond.
"Maybe others are afraid of your Yaeger family, but I'm not!," Connor paused before continuing, "By the way, your Yaeger family means nothing to me!"
Given that he knew the Yaeger family was essentially a lapdog of the Gomez family, and Charisa's arrogance from the start, he wasn't about to give her any face.
After a brief once-over, she whispered, "Let me warn you. If you offend our Yaeger family here in Yarlford, you won't survive for more than three months!"
"Are you threatening me?" he asked her with a smile.
"Yes, I'm threatening you!" Charisa nodded firmly.
"Alright then, since you've brought it this far, let's make a bet: whether I can survive in Yarlford for three months!" Connor said softly.
"What kind of background do you have to be this arrogant?" Charisa simply couldn't fathom why Connor was so confident, daring to challenge her Yaeger family so openly.
Connor hesitated for a moment and then said in a calm tone, "Let alone your little Yaeger family, even the Gomez family isn't worth my consideration. So if you have any tricks up your sleeve, go ahead and use them. Let's see if I can establish myself firmly in Yarlford."
"You don't even care about the Gomez family?" Charisa's expression became even more incredulous upon hearing Connor's words. She sneered and said, "I've never seen anyone as arrogant as you!"
"I'm arrogant because I have the capital for it," Connor replied calmly.
"You'll regret your decision today!" Charisa was fully aware that continuing to converse with Connor had become pointless, so after saying this, she turned around and headed for the exit of Connor's office.
Connor, on the other hand, sat quietly in his place, seemingly not intending to stop her.
However, just as Charisa was about to exit Connor's office, she suddenly stopped in her tracks, turned back, and glared at Connor fiercely.
"Do you have anything else to say?" Connor asked Charisa in a soft voice.
After hesitating for a moment, Charisa reached into her bag, took out a business card, and threw it to Connor. With an expressionless face, she said, "This is my business card. I'll give you three days to think it over. If I don't receive your call after three days, then be prepared for retaliation from our Yaeger family!"
"No need for three days. I can tell you clearly right now unless your Yaeger family is willing to purchase this piece of land for 150 billion, I won't give it to your Yaeger family under any circumstances!" he said expressionlessly to him.

chapters.title: Chapter 1701: Special Method
chapters.content:
Chapter 1701: Special Method
"You…"
When Charis heard his words, her expression was extremely ugly.
She took a deep breath, then pushed open the door and walked out of his office.
Connor looked at Charis's back and smiled faintly. He felt that this woman was too naive.
She didn't even know the relationship between Connor, Gomez family, and Yaeger family and had even planned to use the Yaeger family to threaten Connor.
Connor wanted to deal with the Yaeger family and Gomez family, but how could he be threatened by Charis's words?
…
After Charis left Stormbound Tower, the more she thought about it, the more she felt that something was wrong.
She felt that Connor's attitude was a little too arrogant. His words were telling her that he did not take the Yaeger family seriously at all.
Originally, Charis thought that Connor was just an ordinary competitor, so as long as she offered some benefits to him, he would obediently give up this piece of land.
However, the current situation might not be as simple as she thought.
The chauffeur saw Charis getting into the car and asked, "Miss, where are we going now?"
"Back home!"
Charis replied expressionlessly.
"Alright!"
The chauffeur agreed and then hurriedly started the car.
Half an hour later, Charis returned to the Yaeger family villa.
At this time, the higher-ups of the Yaeger family had already known that Charis had failed the bid, so they were all gathered in the villa.
This piece of land was very important to the future development of the Yaeger family. Originally, the Yaeger family members thought that this piece of land would definitely be in their pocket, but no one expected that this piece of land would be taken away in the end. This immediately disrupted the Yaeger family's plans for the next three years. Therefore, the senior members of the Yaeger family all had anxious expressions on their faces.
When Charis appeared in the villa, all the higher-ups of the Yaeger family surrounded Charis and began to ask about the land.
However, Charis was not in the mood to explain these things. He walked directly to the Yaeger family's head, Styrmir Yaeger, and muttered, "Grandpa, I didn't get that piece of land!"
"I have already heard about the matter…"
Compared to the other higher-ups of the Yaeger family, Styrmir's expression was very calm. After all, he was also a person who had gone through a lot of tribulations. He would not be at a loss over such a small matter.
Charis gritted her teeth and said excitedly, "That Connor is really too despicable. They actually used 9 billion to buy that piece of land. Isn't this clearly going against the Yaeger family?"
"Connor doesn't want to go against our Yaeger family, but rather the Gomez family!" Styrmir said expressionlessly.
"The Gomez family?" Charis could not help but be stunned when she heard Styrmir's words. The expression on her face became a little puzzled.
When the other higher-ups of the Yaeger family heard this, they all revealed shocked expressions.
After all, if one were to go against the Gomez family in a place like Yarlford, one would be courting death.
"I've already called Yamino Gomez just now. Yamino told me Connor's identity. It's expected that you can't get this piece of land!" Styrmir said again.
"Grandpa, who is Connor?" Charis asked with a puzzled expression.
"His background is not simple…" Styrmir sighed and continued, "Connor is the heir of Steven Lee, the Chairman of the Empire World Corporation, and the disciple of the ancient martial arts grandmaster Jorge Yarrel. Now, Davenport, Orilon, and Honduria are all under his control, so his financial resources are unimaginable. Even if you look at this on a global scale, you can't find a person richer than him. That's why Connor would rather lose money than take this land. After all, this small amount of money is simply nothing to Connor..."
"This… his background is actually so terrifying?"
The higher-ups of the Yaeger family couldn't help but gasp when they heard Styrmir's words.
Charis was a little dumbfounded. She never thought that Connor would have such a terrifying background. She finally understood why his attitude was so arrogant when she went to see him.
With such a terrifying background as support, then it was very normal for Connor to not bother with the Yaeger family at all.
"Grandpa, what about the Gomez family?"
Charis asked Styrmir in a low voice.
"Yamino Gomez's intention is for our Yaeger family to snatch back this piece of land from his hands within a month. He doesn't care how we do it!" Styrmir replied lightly. "The Gomez family is the number one family in Yarlford. If the Gomez family chooses to attack Connor, then no matter how rich he is, he won't be able to develop this piece of land."
The expression on Charis's face became even more puzzled. After all, if the Gomez family were to deal with Connor, things would be much simpler.
"Yamino Gomez can't use the Gomez family's connections in Yarlford to suppress Connor now because Connor's company has an even more terrifying power. Even the Gomez family doesn't dare to deal with this person. Therefore, if we want to take back this piece of land from his hands, we can only choose other methods!" Styrmir said slowly.
"Other methods?"
Charis was stunned when she heard his words.
"That's right!"
Styrmir nodded and continued, "Connor should have made sufficient preparations before entering the city. Therefore, using our connections to suppress Connor is an impossible task, so we can only choose to use some other methods at this time. No matter what, the Gomez family cannot lose this piece of land!"
Charis knew very well what Styrmir's special method was, but she had no intention of opposing it.
After all, the business world had always been dangerous. When facing different opponents, they had to use different methods. The reason why the Yaeger family could get to where they were today was because they had countless methods to deal with their opponents. Charis was already used to this.
"Grandpa, didn't you just say that Connor is the disciple of an ancient martial arts grandmaster? Then he's probably pretty skilled, right?" Charis said.
"Connor may be skilled, but we don't necessarily have to start from him!" Styrmir replied indifferently.
"..."
Charis said nothing.
"I have already arranged for someone to do this. Although we haven't found a suitable candidate yet, we still have a month's time, so there's no hurry," Styrmir continued.
After Charis hesitated for a moment, she did not say anything. After all, Styrmir's words meant that he would handle this matter now and did not need Charis to care about it.

chapters.title: Chapter 1702: Chrissie
chapters.content:
Chapter 1702: Chrissie
Meanwhile, Queta held a staff meeting after returning to the company.
The meeting lasted for a full two hours before everyone's mission was roughly determined.
It was not easy to use this piece of land to build a high-end villa community. Moreover, this project was the first major project of Stormbound Corporation. It was very important for the future development of the corporation. Therefore, Queta did not dare to be careless; she made sure to handle all the matters herself, whether big or small.
When Connor saw Queta walk out of the conference room with a tired face, he quickly walked to her side and said, "Thank you for your hard work!"
Queta smiled at Connor and replied, "Actually, it's not very hard. It's just that it's my first time doing such a big project and I'm a little stressed. I'm just worried that I won't do it well!"
Connor hesitated for a moment and felt that he should do something as a boss. "It's getting late. You should rest too. How about I treat you to a meal?"
"There's no need…" Queta shook her head gently and continued, "I still have some things to deal with here. Mr. McDonald, if there's nothing else, you can go back first."
"Alright then!"
Connor nodded helplessly after hearing Queta's words, then turned around and left the office.
…
Because Queta was managing the company, Connor could relax a lot. She was pretty much the only person managing the company's affairs Connor was basically just a decoration. There was nothing he could do.
After Charis went to look for Connor once, there was no more news from her. The Gomez family and the Yaeger family did not seem to make any moves either. Therefore, after Connor got the land, he basically played mobile games in the company every day. He was not even as busy as Dominic, Spencer and the others.
Such days made Connor feel a little uneasy because he knew that the Yaeger family would definitely not give up this piece of land so easily. The quieter the Yaeger family was now, the bigger their next move would be.
In the blink of an eye, a week had passed.
In this week, Queta had already perfected most of the details of the land development project. She had also found a construction company in Newtown to be responsible for the construction.
The most important part of a real estate project was the construction. If the quality of the project could not be guaranteed, there would be endless problems.
Therefore, Queta was still very cautious. She did not look for a local construction company in Yarlford, but instead went for a company in Newtown that she had worked with before. In this way, she did not have to worry about the Gomez family and the Yaeger family doing anything to the construction.
When the construction company entered the site, the project would officially start.
However, it would take some time for the construction company to enter the site. After all, such a large project required a lot of preparation in the early stages, so the employees of Stormbound Corporation had nothing to do during this period of time.
Connor also knew that the people in the company were different from him. In order to complete this project as soon as possible, most of the employees worked overtime. They were busy from nine in the morning to twelve in the morning almost every day. Therefore, Connor considerately gave all employees three days off so that everyone could have a good rest.
Because the company was on holiday, Connor did not go there. Instead, he went with Dominic, Spencer, Justin, Brooks, and the others to have a good time in Yarlford.
After all, they had come to Yarlford for some time, but because there were too many things to do in the company, they did not have time to go out and play. Now, they could take advantage of these three days to have a good time.
During the day, Connor followed Dominic and the others to a few of the more famous scenic spots in Yarlford. At night, Justin arranged to go to a bar to see beautiful women. Brooks would definitely support him greatly.
Connor was not very interested in places like bars, but he did not want to spoil the mood at this time, so he agreed to go with Justin and the others.
He drove Justin and the others to the largest bar in Yarlford.
It had to be said that the bars in Yarlford were indeed of higher quality than the bars in Newtown; whether it was the decorations or the number of beauties inside, they were not on the same level as those in Newtown.
Spencer, Dominic Justin, and the other three couldn't hold themselves back anymore after seeing so many beautiful girls on the dance floor. They rushed onto the dance floor without thinking.
Connor chose to sit alone in a quiet corner, watching the men and women on the dance floor.
After a long time, a woman with a very hot figure walked to his side in high heels. Then, she pointed to the seat beside Connor and asked gently, "Handsome, can I sit here?"
Connor turned his head and looked at the woman. He couldn't help but think that this woman was indeed very beautiful, like she was a reincarnation of a femme fatale, giving off a seductive aura at all times. Any normal man would be unable to hold back after seeing this woman. Moreover, the woman was dressed in a short skirt, and her slender legs and chest were completely visible.
Connor knew that a place like a bar would definitely be filled with all kinds of romantic encounters. As long as you were good-looking, someone would take the initiative to strike up a conversation with you.
If they were in Newtown now, Connor might not think too much about it. He would think of this woman as a gold digger who wanted to hook up with a rich heir.
After all, his clothes alone were worth more than 100,000 dollars, so anyone who knew a little about luxury goods could tell that Connor was very rich. In addition, his looks were not bad, so it was normal for women to take the initiative to seduce him.
Unfortunately, this was Yarlford, so Connor could not help but be vigilant.
He had too many enemies here, and he did not know what this woman's true purpose was.
Although he was vigilant, Connor did not show it on his face. Instead, he said, "There's no one here!"
"That's great…"
The sexy woman smiled happily and then took the initiative to sit beside Connor. She snapped her fingers at the waiter and asked for a glass of whiskey.
The woman chatted with Connor while drinking.
After a simple chat, Connor found out that this woman was called Chrissie. As for her real name and age, he couldn't find out.

chapters.title: Chapter 1703: Not That Easy to Deal With
chapters.content:
Chapter 1703: Not That Easy to Deal With
After Chrissie put down the wine glass in her hand, she seemed a little drunk.
She took the opportunity to lean against his side and said with a coquettish look, "Handsome, do you want to dance with me?"
"Dance?" Connor couldn't help but be stunned when he heard Chrissie's words. Then, he shook his head gently and said, "I don't know how to dance!"
At this moment, Chrissie was very proactive, but Connor was not sure if it was because all the women in the Yarlford Bar were like this, or rather because this woman had other motives.
"If you don't know how to, I can teach you. I'm not a bad person. I won't do anything to you…"
Chrissie pouted, then took the initiative to hold his hand and pulled him into the dance floor.
"I really don't know how to dance…"
Connor said helplessly.
"I've already said that I'll teach you. It's very simple…"
Chrissie spoke as she leaned against him, but she took the initiative to make his hand hug her slender and soft waist.
At this moment, the position of the two was very ambiguous. Connor could even clearly smell the faint fragrance on the woman's body. This fragrance had a very strange scent, as if it could easily stir his nerves.
Connor took a deep breath and tried to calm himself down.
As the dynamic music played, Chrissie's actions were even bolder. She hugged Connor tightly, as if she was going to take off his clothes at any time.
However, Connor was very calm and tried his best to keep calm
Chrissie tried her best to seduce Connor, but he did not have any reaction. After a while, she could only give up helplessly and said, "Looks like you really don't like dancing. Why don't the two of us go for a drink?"
"Alright!"
Connor nodded lightly.
A moment later, Connor left the dance floor with Chrissie.
As Chrissie failed to seduce him on the dance floor, she began to plan on getting him drunk.
However, more than ten minutes passed, but she realized that Connor did not seem to be drunk at all. Her head, however, began to ache.
Chrissie knew that she couldn't continue drinking with Connor or she might pass out before she could get him drunk. Therefore, she pretended to be drunk and collapsed in his arms. She stared at him with her beautiful eyes and said with a sigh, "Handsome, this place is really too messy. Why don't the two of us go out and have a good chat somewhere?"
Almost any man would know what Chrissie meant. It was obvious that she was taking the initiative to invite Connor to a hotel room.
When Connor heard this, he couldn't help but sneer. Then, he said indifferently, "I'm sorry. I still have something else to do today. I can't leave now…"
"What's the matter? Things are already like this. Is there anything more important than me?"
Chrissie became a little dissatisfied.
"This matter is very important to me!" Connor said expressionlessly.
"..."
Chrissie sighed. Then, she said coquettishly, "Then I'll wait for you to settle your matters before we have a good chat. How about that?"
"There's no need…"
Connor lightly shook his head.
Chrissie instantly sobered up after hearing his words. She stood up and shouted at Connor, "You really don't know what's good for you!"
"Haha!"
Connor smiled.
Chrissie didn't seem to want to continue talking to Connor. She walked out of the bar in her high heels.
Connor continued to sit quietly on the spot. His expression was very calm.
Although Connor was not sure what Chrissie was going to do, he knew that this woman was very likely not simply trying to hit on him.
Therefore, after hesitating for a moment, Connor followed her out of the bar.
After Chrissie left the bar, she got into a black Rolls-Royce.
When Connor saw this car, he instantly understood what was going on. Connor had seen this car before—the license plate number of this car ended with four sixes. When Charis Yaeger went to his company to see him, she'd also driven this car.
"Looks like my guess was right. This woman was really sent by Charis!"
Connor sighed, but he didn't take the initiative to expose Charis. Instead, he turned around and returned to the bar.
…
Inside the Rolls-Royce.
Charis saw Chrissie get into the car and quickly asked, "How's the situation? How was your chat with Connor?"
"Miss Charis, is Connor a man or not?" Chrissie asked, exasperated.
"Wait, you failed?"
Charis said in surprise.
"It's more than a failure. This is simply an insult to me!"
"What's going on? Logically speaking, since you've already made a move, no man should be able to hold back, right?"
Charis said in confusion.
Charis had known this woman named Chrissie for a long time. Moreover, it was not the first time that Charis had used such a honey trap. Normally, any kind of man would eventually fall under Chrissie's skirt. It was just that some men could resist for a longer time, while others could resist for a shorter time.
However, it was the first time that someone had been able to completely refuse Chrissie's charms.
"Miss Charis, I used all the methods available to me today, but Connor just wouldn't take the bait. I almost told him directly that I wanted to sleep with him. I even took the initiative to invite him to a hotel, but he actually rejected me. This is really the first time I've met such a man. There must be something wrong with Connor!" Chrissie said excitedly.
After Charis heard Chrissie's words, her expression was a little helpless. Then, she sighed, "I didn't expect Connor to be so difficult to deal with!"
"Miss Charis, since I have already failed, I think the honey trap will definitely not work. You should think of another way!" Chrissie said.
"It doesn't matter. Although you failed this time, the problem isn't with you, so I promised you that I wouldn't lose a single cent. I'll get someone to transfer the money to your card later!" Charis said calmly.
"Forget it. I don't lack this bit of money now. The main thing is that the incident today is really too embarrassing. To think there's actually a man who's not interested in me at all…." Chrissie muttered.
Charis took a deep breath. "It seems that Grandpa was right. Connor is really not that easy to deal with!"
After saying this, Charis asked the driver to drive away.

chapters.title: Chapter 1704: Betrothed to Juan Gomez
chapters.content:
Chapter 1704: Betrothed to Juan Gomez
Meanwhile, after Connor returned to the bar, he continued to sit quietly in the corner and watch the situation on the dance floor.
Justin, Brooks, and the others seemed to be having a lot of fun today, so the four of them had no intention of leaving at all.
Connor didn't hurry the four of them and just sat there quietly.
"Ding, ding, ding…"
But at this moment, his phone suddenly rang.
Connor was stunned for a moment, then he took out his phone and looked at it. He realized that it was Aida calling him.
"Why is this woman calling me?"
Connor couldn't help but sigh, but he still chose to pick up the phone in the end.
"Miss Collier, why are you calling me?" he asked with a smile.
"Where are you now? I want to meet you!"
Aida didn't waste any words.
"I'm at the Twilight Bar in Yarlford now!" Connor replied after thinking for a moment.
"Alright, wait for me. I'll be right there!"
Aida hung up the phone after saying that.
Connor looked at his phone with a puzzled expression because he didn't know why Aida was so anxious to see him.
However, Connor also knew that she would not harm him. After all, in this situation, Aida had no reason to harm him.
Connor waited in the bar for about ten minutes before Aida appeared at the entrance of the bar wearing a hat and sunglasses.
Although he couldn't see her face clearly, Connor could confirm that the woman who walked into the bar was indeed Aida based on her figure.
She was dressed in a cool and sexy way, wearing a white short-sleeved T-shirt and a black miniskirt. Her slender and fair legs were exposed to the air. Although these kinds of clothes were very common in the nightclub, because of Aida's heaven-defying figure, when she appeared, countless men's gazes fell on her.
However, Aida didn't look at the others at all; she walked straight to Connor, who was sitting in the corner.
Connor saw her walking over and stood up, then said with a smile, "Miss Collier, you're here?"
"It's not convenient to talk here. Let's talk somewhere else!" Aida said.
"Alright!"
Connor felt that Aida must have something serious to say to him, so he didn't waste any time. He walked directly to the waiter and asked the waiter to get a private room for him.
A moment later, Connor and Aida entered the private room, after which she took off her sunglasses and hat, revealing her beautiful face.
"Do you want to drink?"
Connor asked.
"No…"
Aida shook her head gently.
"Alright, let's get straight to the point. Why did you come to me in such a hurry?"
Connor asked.
"I want to cooperate with you!"
Aida said bluntly.
"Cooperate?"
Connor couldn't help but laugh when he heard Aida's words. Then, he said, "Miss Collier, if I remember correctly, a week ago, you swore to me that you would never work with someone like me, but why did you change your mind now? Why are you still planning to cooperate with me?"
"The situation is different now. Tell me, do you want to cooperate with me or not?" Aida asked in a stiff tone. She didn't seem to be in the mood to explain much.
"Of course I want to work with you, but I have to know why you suddenly changed your mind. If you don't explain this to me, I'm sorry, but I can't work with you!" Connor said slowly.
"Do I need a reason to change my mind?"
Aida asked with a frown.
"Of course!"
Connor nodded his head and continued, "Back then, you rejected me very firmly, but now you suddenly changed your mind. I feel that something must have happened during this period of time, so if you don't tell me clearly, I won't be able to believe you!"
Aida hesitated for two seconds. Then, she picked up the glass and poured herself a glass of wine, then drank it in one elegant gulp.
"What exactly happened?"
Connor asked Aida.
Aida took a deep breath and muttered, "Beau Collier intends to marry me off to Yamino Gomez's son, Juan Gomez. I don't want to be with Juan; once I marry him, I won't be able to inherit the position of the Collier family's head. I won't be able to avenge my mother either…"
"Beau wants you to marry Juan Gomez?"
When Connor heard Aida's words, he was stunned on the spot. The expression on his face was very incredulous.
"Yes. Because of the incident with you, the Collier family and the Gomez family have already joined forces. In order to strengthen the relationship between the two families, Beau decided to have me marry Juan. Although I have already expressed my resistance against the matter, Beau will not listen to me," Aida said seriously.
"..."
However, Connor looked at her without saying anything.
"What do you need now?"
Aida asked Connor with a frown.
"Nothing. I don't know if what you said is true…" Connor said slowly.
"Things are already like this. Is there a need for me to lie to you?"
Aida became a little exasperated as she shouted.
"..."
Connor hesitated for a moment, then said, "You can cooperate with me, but I need you to show some sincerity. If you can't prove that you really want to cooperate with me to defeat the Collier family and the Gomez family, then I can't trust you 100%!"
"What sincerity do you want?"
Aida asked with a frown.
"It's up to you, as long as it's useful to me. Of course, the more valuable the information you provide me, the more I'll believe you!" Connor said lightly.
"This is unfair to me. You didn't provide me with any valuable information, right?"
Aida said.
"I don't need to prove anything because I came to Yarlford to deal with the Gomez family. But I don't know what you're thinking now. What if you're a spy sent by the Collier family?"
Connor said with a smile.

chapters.title: Chapter 1705: I Missed You!
chapters.content:
Chapter 1705: I Missed You!
Aida hesitated for two seconds. Then she said, "Alright, give me some time. When I have any important news, I will tell you immediately. I hope you won't disappoint me!"
"Don't worry. The more beneficial the information you provide is to me, the closer it will be to the day when I defeat the Gomez family. As long as the Gomez family falls, the Collier family is nothing in my eyes!"
Connor said slowly.
"Hah…"
Aida took a deep breath and continued, "I don't want anyone to know about our cooperation, so if anything happens, I'll contact you immediately. You can't contact me on your own, or I might get exposed. If that happens, the Gomez family and Collier family will definitely be wary of me!"
"I understand. Don't worry!" Connor nodded.
"If there's nothing else, I'll leave first!"
After saying that, Aida put on her hat and sunglasses and walked out of the room.
Connor looked at Aida's back and smiled happily. He had never thought that Beau would actually want Aida to marry Yamino's son.
Beau was undoubtedly helping Connor in secret—after all, if Aida really did want to cooperate with him, then with her position in the Collier family, she could grasp the actions of the Collier family and the Gomez family as soon as possible. This was a good thing for Connor.
A moment later, he also left the room.
When he arrived at the hall, he found that Justin, Brooks, Dominic, and the others were looking for Connor everywhere.
"Connor, what did you do just now? The four of us couldn't find you for a long time. We thought you had already left!" Dominic shouted excitedly.
"I went to the toilet just now…"
Connor explained with a smile.
"Damn, why did you take so long to go to the toilet? Did he go to the toilet with some pretty girl?"
Spencer asked, baring his teeth.
"Get lost!"
Connor kicked Spencer and asked the others, "Are you guys planning to go back now?"
"Yeah. I'm tired from playing…"
Justin nodded gently.
"Alright, I'll drive you back. You can all have a good rest tomorrow!"
After Connor finished speaking, he walked out of the bar.
After leaving the bar, Connor drove Justin, Dominic, and the others straight back before driving back home alone.
However, Connor had just reached home when his phone rang.
When he looked at it, he saw that it was actually a call from Vanessa.
As soon as he saw her name, he answered the call without thinking.
"Connor, what are you doing?" Vanessa asked gently.
"I'm fine. Why did you call me so late at night? Did something happen at the casino?"
Connor asked with a smile.
"The casino and the clubhouse are fine, but I have something to do here!"
"What's wrong? Did your ex-boyfriend harass you again?"
Connor asked nervously.
"I miss you!" Vanessa said shyly.
"That was it? I thought it was something else. It scared me to death…"
Connor let out a long sigh of relief when he heard Vanessa's words.
"Then do you miss me?"
Vanessa hurriedly asked.
"Of course I do!"
"Then I have good news to tell you!"
Connor was stunned for a moment before asking, "What good news?"
"I'm at the airport now. I'll be getting on the plane later and should be able to arrive in Yarlford tomorrow morning. Remember to come and pick me up then!" Vanessa said in a seductive tone.
"Really?"
He was naturally happy when he found out Vanessa was coming to visit him.
"Yes, really. Alright, I'm boarding the plane. Don't forget to pick me up tomorrow!"
Vanessa hurriedly finished her sentence and then hung up the phone.
After putting down the phone, Connor was extremely excited. He didn't expect Vanessa to take the initiative to come and find him.
At this time, he only needed to think about Vanessa's appearance on the bed to feel a little excited, wishing he could see her as soon as possible.
…
The next day, at seven o'clock in the morning.
Connor woke up early in the morning, changed into a clean set of clothes, and drove to Yarlford Airport alone.
Connor waited at the airport for almost an hour before the flight that Vanessa took finally arrived in Yarlford.
A little while later, the passengers disembarked, and Connor began to search for Vanessa in the crowd.
Soon, Connor found the incomparably beautiful Vanessa. This woman was so outstanding that he could see her in the crowd at a glance.
At this moment, Vanessa was wearing a long white dress. Her sexy figure was exceptionally attractive when accentuated with the dress. With her exquisite face, cold temperament, and seductive figure, such a woman would be eye-catching no matter where she was.
At this time, Vanessa also seemed to be looking for Connor. When she saw him, she ran towards him in her high heels.
After Vanessa made it to him, she immediately gave him a big hug.
"Connor, I missed you so much!" Vanessa said.
"I missed you too!"
Vanessa hesitated for a moment and reluctantly let him go. She knew her identity might attract attention, and she didn't want to trouble Connor.
Connor took the initiative to take Vanessa's luggage and said, "Let's go. Get in the car. I'll take you to the hotel!"
"Alright!"
When Vanessa heard his words, her expression was a little shy as she nodded gently.
After all, Connor didn't have any other thoughts in his heart. He just wanted to take Vanessa to the hotel and enjoy this sexy woman.
However, they didn't notice that there was a woman not far from the airport staring at them.
The woman stared at Connor's and Vanessa's backs with a puzzled expression.
"Why did Vanessa Canfield come to Yarlford?"
The woman muttered to herself, confused.
A moment later, the woman's expression became a little strange. She said, "The relationship between Vanessa and Connor is definitely not simple…"

chapters.title: Chapter 1706: We're Being Followed
chapters.content:
Chapter 1706: We're Being Followed
After saying this, the woman ran straight to the street and stopped a taxi. Then, she said to the taxi driver, "Sir, please help me keep up with the Mercedes-Benz in front!"
"..."
When the taxi driver heard the woman's words, he couldn't help but be stunned.
The woman didn't waste any time and took out a stack of cash from her bag. She said to the driver, "As long as you keep up with that Mercedes-Benz and don't get discovered by them, this money will be yours!"
"No problem, boss!"
After the driver heard the woman's words, his expression was obviously a little excited. Then, he started the car without thinking.
Meanwhile, Connor was imagining the scene of him and Vanessa in the hotel while driving.
However, Vanessa's beauty was too alluring, especially the faint fragrance on her body, which was fatal to Connor, so he extended his right hand to Vanessa's sexy legs.
Vanessa was wearing a dress today which was very convenient for him.
"What are you doing? I'm driving, can you stop fooling around..." Vanessa pouted.
"Didn't you miss me?"
Connor replied with a smile, then continued to be restless.
Vanessa seemed to be enjoying it very much, so she didn't continue to stop Connor.
A few minutes later, Connor suddenly took his hand away from Vanessa's leg, and the expression on his face became a little nervous.
Vanessa felt that something was wrong with him and hurriedly asked, "What's wrong?"
"We seem to be being followed…"
Connor replied in a low voice.
