Although Connor really wanted to go to the hotel at this time, he had been observing the surrounding situation. After all, this was Yarlford, and Connor did not dare to relax at all.
He realized that a taxi seemed to be following them this entire time, and it kept a distance of less than 300 meters. This situation was very strange.
"How did you know that someone was following us?" Vanessa asked in confusion.
"I'm not sure whether they're following us or not, but we won't know until we try…" Connor replied in a low voice, then turned the steering wheel and changed the direction, driving the car into a small road.
At this moment, he was thinking that the taxi behind him was really following him, then no matter where Connor went, the taxi should follow him. However, if it was just a coincidence, the taxi would not change its direction just because Connor changed his direction.
At this moment, the path that Connor chose was very remote. It was absolutely impossible for a normal person to take this path.
When the taxi driver saw Connor turn left, he instinctively wanted to turn left as well, but the woman behind him suddenly shouted, "Master, don't turn left. Just keep driving forward!"
"Miss, didn't you want to follow that car?"
The driver asked in confusion.
"He realized that someone is following him, so he is deliberately testing us. Continue driving forward and slow down. He will drive back in a while…" the woman said confidently.
"Then don't blame me if you lose him!" the driver said helplessly.
"Don't worry, I won't!"
The driver didn't say anything after hearing the woman's words and continued driving forward.
After Connor drove the car to the small road, he realized that the taxi did not follow him. Instead, it continued to drive forward.
"It didn't follow me. Is this car really not following me?"
After Connor saw the taxi drive past, his expression seemed a little puzzled.
"Who would have the time to track you? I think you're just worried that your fiancée will find out about us. This road is the main road, so it's normal for there to be more cars on the road…"
Vanessa said, exasperated.
"I'm not worried about being discovered by my fiancée. I'm just worried that my enemies in Yarlford are following me!"
Connor explained in a low voice and then continued, "It's best if they're not following us. Otherwise, I'll have to worry about your safety!" After saying this, Connor directly returned the way he came.
This time, Connor had nothing to worry about, so he sped up the car.
The Mercedes-Benz quickly overtook the taxi that the woman was in. This time, the taxi could also follow his car openly.
At this moment, Connor didn't want to waste a minute or a second, so he drove very fast.
About half an hour later, Connor finally arrived at the hotel where he had booked a room.
After Connor parked the car, he brought Vanessa into the hotel.
However, just as they entered the hotel, a taxi stopped at the entrance of the hotel.
A very beautiful woman got out of the taxi with a smug smile on her face.
"Connor and Vanessa actually came to the hotel to check in. This means that my guess is right. If there is no other relationship between the two of them, why would she take the initiative to come to Yarlford?" the woman muttered to herself and walked straight into the hotel.
After entering the hotel, the woman did not speak to the receptionist. Instead, she took out her phone and dialed a number.
A moment later, the hotel manager hurriedly ran to the lobby and received the woman with an unusually respectful attitude.
Meanwhile, Connor and Vanessa were already in a heated relationship, so the two of them hurriedly entered the room.
After entering the room, they kissed.
A woman like Vanessa was simply a stunner that men dreamed of, so Connor was now very obsessed with her body.
The two kissed from the living room to the bedroom, and Connor took off Vanessa's clothes while kissing.
A few minutes later, Connor finally took off her long dress, and she also took the initiative to help Connor take off his clothes.
But just as Vanessa was about to take off his pants, there was a hurried knock on the door.
Connor was stunned when he heard the knocking. After all, this was a hotel. Under normal circumstances, no one would knock on the door.
"Is it someone from the hotel?"
Vanessa asked nervously.
"Probably. This is too disappointing. Wait for me. I'll go and see what's going on!"
Because Vanessa wasn't wearing any clothes, she couldn't open the door, so Connor had to open it.

chapters.title: Chapter 1707: I'll Room With You!
chapters.content:
Chapter 1707: I'll Room With You!
Connor hurriedly ran to the door of the suite.
However, out of caution, Connor did not speak or open the door immediately. Because he didn't know who was knocking on the door, he looked outside through the peephole.
When he saw the woman standing at the door, he was instantly stunned, an expression of disbelief on his face.
The woman standing outside the door was none other than Chelsea Lee!
"Vanessa, bad news. Chelsea's here…"
Connor hurriedly ran to the bedroom and began to put on his clothes.
Vanessa was also stunned for a moment, and she asked with a very puzzled expression, "Isn't Chelsea overseas now? Why is she here? And how did she know that the two of us were in this hotel?"
"I don't know what's going on either. Hurry up and put on your clothes…" Connor said.
When Vanessa heard this, she realized that she was not wearing any clothes at all, so she quickly picked up her long dress.
Although Connor was also very confused, he was no longer in the mood to think about these problems.
Meanwhile, Chelsea kept knocking on the door.
"Connor, what should we do now? We can't let Chelsea know about our relationship. If she finds out, I won't be able to live…"
Vanessa said nervously.
"I don't want Chelsea to know about our relationship either. Let's just pretend that we didn't hear the knock on the door and don't do anything!"
Connor felt that as long as he did not open the door, she would not be able to enter.
"Vanessa, I know you're inside. Hurry up and open the door for me!"
However, at this moment, Chelsea's voice rang out again.
Vanessa couldn't help but be stunned when she heard Chelsea's words. She quickly turned her head to look at Connor and said in a puzzled tone, "Chelsea actually came to look for me? How did she know I was in Yarlford?"
"I don't know either!"
Connor replied helplessly.
Vanessa thought for a while and then said, "Well, it's not a good idea for me not to open the door. Why don't you hide first? I'll open the door for her!"
Connor briefly observed the situation in the room. Although his room was a presidential suite, the layout inside was very simple. There was no space under the bed at all, and the window had anti-theft railings, so he didn't know where to hide.
"Go to the bathroom!"
Vanessa pointed at the bathroom as she whisper-shouted at Connor.
After hesitating for a moment, he could only helplessly enter the bathroom.
After entering the bathroom, he found that there was a big bathtub in the bathroom, so he could hide there.
After Vanessa saw that Connor had already hidden, she quickly recomposed herself and stood in front of the mirror and tidied up her clothes, trying her best to calm down.
A few seconds later, Vanessa walked to the door and opened it.
"Vanessa, you're really here!"
After Chelsea saw Vanessa, she gave her a big hug.
Vanessa was obviously at a loss. She stuttered and asked, "Chelsea, weren't you overseas? Why did you come to Yarlford? And how did you know I was here?"
"I wonder…"
Chelsea waved her little hand and walked into the room while explaining, "I originally planned to go to the Netherlands for a vacation, but I heard that there would be heavy rain there, so I decided not to go. I had nothing better to do, so I came here to look for my friend…"
Vanessa followed behind Chelsea and asked carefully, "Then how did you know about my hotel?"
"Vanessa, have you forgotten? The last time I brought you to Yarlford, I stayed at this hotel. I'm a diamond member of this hotel and am good friends with the owner of this hotel. Just now, I met the manager of the hotel as soon as I came in. He has a good memory and said that he saw my friend coming over. I've only brought you to this hotel before, so I thought it was definitely you. Which is why I'm here…"
Chelsea looked around the room and did not see Connor anywhere. She looked a little proud of herself, but she didn't continue to look for him, instead sitting on Vanessa's bed.
After Vanessa heard Chelsea's explanation, her expression was unusually helpless because she did not expect things to be so coincidental.
Chelsea gently stretched his back and said to Vanessa in a very natural tone, "Just now, I was wondering if it would be a little boring to stay in a hotel alone. Now that I've bumped into you, I don't have to get a room. I'll just stay with you…"
Vanessa was dumbfounded when she heard what Chelsea said; she didn't expect Chelsea to want to stay in the same room as her.
Chelsea valued the quality of her sleep very much. Under normal circumstances, even if Vanessa went on a business trip with Chelsea, the two of them would each have a separate room. Otherwise, if there was any movement from Vanessa, Chelsea would not be able to sleep well.
Yet for some reason, Chelsea actually planned to sleep in the same room as Vanessa today.
If this was a normal situation, Vanessa wouldn't say anything, but Connor was still in the bathroom.
If Chelsea really planned to stay here, wouldn't Connor have to spend the night in the bathroom?
Chelsea was a very light sleeper, so even after she fell asleep, Connor could not leave because the bathroom door was in the bedroom. As long as Connor opened the door, Chelsea would hear him.
Chelsea saw that Vanessa didn't say anything and asked, "What's wrong? Do you not want me to room with you?"
"It's not that I'm unwilling…" Vanessa gently shook her head and continued, "I'm just worried that I might disturb you since you're such a light sleeper…"
"You don't have to worry about this…"
Chelsea smiled and continued, "I haven't had a good rest these past few days, so I'm about to die of exhaustion. You definitely won't affect me today…"
After Chelsea said that, she actually took off her high heels and lay on the bed.
After Connor heard Chelsea's words, he felt terrible.
He had never thought that Chelsea would actually plan to stay with Vanessa.
If the two of them really wanted to stay here for the night, Chelsea would definitely come to the bathroom. At that time, Connor would definitely be discovered.
Moreover, Connor had been hiding in the bathtub all this time.

chapters.title: Chapter 1708: Excuses
chapters.content:
Chapter 1708: Excuses
At this moment, Connor was hiding in the bathtub, not daring to move at all.
He was afraid that Chelsea would hear him if he made any noise.
If Chelsea found out about his relationship with Vanessa, then things would be really troublesome.
Connor could only place all his hopes on Vanessa. He hoped that she could find a reasonable excuse to lure Chelsea away as soon as possible so that he could leave this room.
Vanessa was also thinking about this problem, but she really couldn't think of an excuse to get rid of Chelsea.
Chelsea was even more pleased with herself after seeing the conflicted expression on Vanessa's face. "Oh!" she suddenly exclaimed.
"What's wrong?" Vanessa asked, having been startled for a moment.
"Why did you come to Yarlford?" Chelsea casually asked.
"Well, there's something I needed to deal with at the casino, so I came over..."
Vanessa hurriedly explained, not missing a beat.
"But I just heard from the hotel manager that you seemed to have followed a man in here. Who is that man? Is it Connor?" Chelsea pressed.
Vanessa's expression changed when she heard Chelsea's words. She didn't expect Chelsea to know that Connor had come with her.
At this moment, Connor was also very regretful of his actions. If he had known that Chelsea had discovered him, he would not have hidden in the bathroom and would have met Chelsea openly. After all, as long as he was not caught in bed, it did not mean anything.
However, the situation at that time was really a bit urgent. In addition, Connor and Vanessa were very guilty, so it was normal for the two of them not to think of this.
If Connor went out now, it would be a bit of a loss, so he couldn't go out no matter what.
"Connor did send me here, but he has already left…"
Vanessa said after hesitating for a moment.
"So that's how it is!" Chelsea nodded gently, then continued, "Then why didn't I see him when I came up just now?"
"I'm not very sure about this…"
Vanessa shook her head helplessly.
Chelsea suddenly sat up and asked with a serious expression, "Vanessa, tell me honestly. What do you think of Connor?"
"About Connor?"
Vanessa looked at her with a puzzled expression.
Chelsea nodded. "Yeah, what do you think of Connor?"
"Nothing, really…"
Vanessa was worried that Chelsea would suspect her, so she shook her head.
Chelsea couldn't help but laugh when he heard Vanessa's words. She secretly sighed in his heart that she was still putting on an act with him at this time.
"Since you don't think much of Connor, why did you choose to stay in Newtown instead of leaving with me?" She pretended not to know anything and asked Vanessa in a very natural tone.
Vanessa couldn't help but be stunned when she heard Chelsea's words. She then said, "Actually, I didn't think too much about it at that time. I just felt that I was the one who's been managing the Heavens Club, and I have a lot of feelings for that club, so I didn't want to leave!"
"Do you have feelings for that club, or for a certain someone?"
Chelsea asked with a smile.
"Why are you talking about this today? If you continue to joke with me, I'll get angry..."
Vanessa pouted.
"Don't get angry. I'm just casually chatting with you…"
Chelsea saw that Vanessa seemed to be really angry and quickly reached out to stop her.
At this moment, Vanessa only wanted to think of a suitable excuse to get rid of Chelsea. "I'm a little hungry. Why don't we go out and eat something? I remember the hotpot restaurant you took me to when we went for a business trip last time. It was pretty good…"
"No thank you…"
Chelsea shook her head without thinking and continued, "I'm already exhausted from flying for a day and a night. I'm not in the mood to eat hotpot with you at all. If you're hungry, you can order something!"
"But I just want to eat hotpot now!" Vanessa said helplessly to Chelsea.
Chelsea hesitated for a moment when he heard Vanessa's words, and then said, "If you want to go and eat hotpot, you can go by yourself. I'm going to rest..."
Vanessa looked at the expression on Chelsea's face, speechless. If Chelsea didn't leave, then wouldn't Connor be in more danger when she left?
So, she took a deep breath and said helplessly, "Alright, if you don't want to go, then I won't go either…"
"Aren't you hungry?"
Chelsea blinked.
"I'm alright. I'm trying to lose weight anyway!"
Vanessa replied helplessly.
"Oh right, you should have brought pajamas this time, right? Mind lending me a pair? I won't go back to my own room to get mine. I'm going to take a shower and get ready to sleep…" Chelsea spoke again.
Vanessa was dumbfounded when she found out that Chelsea was about to take a shower. After all, there was only one bathroom in this room. Once Chelsea entered the bathroom, she would definitely see Connor.
"I was in a hurry this time, and I was only staying for one night, so I didn't bring my pajamas at all. Why don't I accompany you back to your room to get them? You can lend me a set too…"
Vanessa was quick-witted and quickly thought up an excuse. "Stop lying. I 've known you for so many years. I don't believe that you didn't bring your pajamas," Chelsea said as she got off the bed and opened Vanessa's suitcase.
"No!"
Vanessa saw that Chelsea was about to open her luggage and quickly shouted, but it was too late.
Chelsea quickly opened the suitcase.
There were pajamas in Vanessa's suitcase, and there was more than one set.
The most embarrassing thing was that there were several sets of sexy lingerie in Vanessa's suitcase.
Of course, these undergarments were prepared by Vanessa for Connor.
Vanessa's expression was unusually awkward. She didn't know what to do for a moment.
After Chelsea saw the sexy lingerie, ahe understood what was going on.
However, she was worried that Vanessa would be embarrassed, so she didn't say anything. Instead, she picked up a nightgown and smiled, "Vanessa, don't you have pajamas here? Why are you still lying to me?"
"Maybe I remembered wrongly!"
Vanessa explained awkwardly.
"Your undergarments are pretty nice too. Where did you buy them? If there's a chance in the future, you can bring me along to buy a few too…"
Chelsea said with a smile.

chapters.title: Chapter 1709: I'm Here to Repair the Tap
chapters.content:
Chapter 1709: I'm Here to Repair the Tap
"A-Alright!"
Vanessa nodded helplessly.
"Alright, I'm going to take a shower…"
Chelsea said as she walked toward the bathroom with the pajamas.
Vanessa didn't even think about it and quickly reached out to stop Chelsea. Then, she said nervously, "Well, Chelsea, the hotel staff told me that the bathroom is broken and there's no hot water. It can't be used yet. It'll take a while to fix it. Why don't you wait for a while? Or you can go to your room to take a shower..."
"Is the bathroom broken?"
Chelsea couldn't help but be stunned when he heard Vanessa's words. Then, she pouted and said, "What a coincidence! This hotel is really too much. Since the bathroom is broken, why did they arrange for you to stay in this room?"
"At that time, the hotel staff had already told me about this situation, but I didn't think it was a big deal. After all, it would be repaired in a while, so I decided to moved in…"
Vanessa explained helplessly.
"Alright then, I won't bathe first…"
Chelsea threw her pajamas aside and sat on the bed.
Vanessa let out a long sigh of relief when she saw Chelsea sitting down. No matter what, she had managed to fool Chelsea.
At this time, Vanessa was thinking about what kind of excuse she could conjure up to make Chelsea leave her room.
However, at this moment, Chelsea suddenly stood up and walked to the bathroom door. He pushed it open and said, "Vanessa, I need to go to the toilet!"
"Don't go in—"
Vanessa quickly reached out to stop Chelsea, but it was too late. Chelsea had already pushed the door open.
"We're finished!"
Vanessa saw that Chelsea had already pushed the door open. Her entire being was in despair.
"Connor? Why are you here?"
After Chelsea entered the bathroom, she found Connor hiding inside.
In fact, Chelsea already knew that Connor was inside. After all, there was no other place in this room to hide other than the bathroom. However, she still pretended to be surprised.
"I-I was fixing the water outlet for Vanessa. The hotel staff said that there was no hot water because of the tap, you see…"
Connor heard the conversation between Chelsea and Vanessa, so he hurriedly thought of an excuse to explain himself.
Chelsea blinked and asked gently, "I see. Then have you fixed it?"
"It's already repaired…"
Connor turned on the tap as he spoke. Hot water quickly flowed out.
"Little Connor, I didn't expect you to be so amazing. You even know how to fix the water pipe. You must be tired after fixing it for so long. Come out and rest!"
Although Chelsea knew that Connor was acting, she did not choose to expose him because she wanted to see Connor continue acting.
"I've already fixed the faucet. If there's nothing else, I'll take my leave first…"
Perhaps because he was too nervous, his forehead was covered in sweat. He reached out to wipe his sweat and turned around to leave.
However, Chelsea did not seem to have any intention of letting Connor leave. She reached out and grabbed him. "Don't go. It's still early anyway. The two of us haven't seen each other for such a long time. I miss you a little. Stay and chat with me!"
Vanessa's expression was as ugly as it could be, because she knew that Chelsea was a very smart woman. She must have guessed what was going on.
"By the way, I was asking Vanessa about you just now. She said that you had already left. Why are you here?"
Chelsea asked in confusion.
What is that?
Connor hesitated for a moment before saying, "See, I had already left, but I heard from the hotel staff that the hot water was broken. I remembered that Vanessa came to Yarlford this time for the casino and was already very tired, so she definitely wanted to rest immediately. If the hot water was broken, she would have to wait for someone to fix it, so I came back to help her with it. When I came in, she must have gone to talk to the hotel staff about the hot water, so she didn't know that I was in the bathroom..."
Connor could only randomly spit out an excuse to deal with Chelsea, but he knew that no one with normal intelligence would believe his excuse.
But no matter what, it was better than admitting that he was here to get a room with Vanessa!
"So that's how it is!" Chelsea nodded lightly.
Although Chelsea already knew what was going on, she didn't expose Connor and Vanessa. No matter what, she had to spare her best friend some dignity.
"Well, I've already fixed the hot water. If there's nothing else, I'll leave first!"
Connor felt that if he continued to stay here, it would be too awkward, so he might as well leave quickly.
"Don't go. I'm a little hungry. Vanessa said that she wanted to eat hotpot just now. Why don't the three of us go and have some?"
Chelsea called out.
Vanessa was not in the mood to eat hotpot because of today's incident, so she quickly said, "I don't want to go out now. My body is a little uncomfortable…"
Chelsea turned to look at her and said, "Alright, since Vanessa isn't going, then Connor, come with me!"
Although Connor didn't want to go, he also knew that the reason why Yuna Winston had helped him was because of Chelsea. Chelsea had also helped him a lot in this matter. If he didn't go, then it would be a bit unreasonable.
So in the end, he could only accompany Chelsea out of the room.
After the two of them left the hotel, Chelsea walked directly to Connor's car.
"How do you know this is my car?"
Connor asked in confusion.
"Because I've been following the two of you from the airport to here!"
Chelsea replied indifferently.
Connor was stunned again when he heard Chelsea's words. He said in disbelief, "You've been following me all this time? Was that taxi your car?"
"Yes, you're right."
Chelsea nodded gently, then opened the door and sat in the passenger seat.
Connor quickly followed her into the car and asked in a puzzled tone, "No, what's going on?"
"Haven't you figured it out?"
Chelsea rolled his eyes at Connor helplessly and continued, "Actually, all of this is a coincidence. I originally planned to give you a surprise, so I took a plane to Yarlford. However, I didn't expect to see you pick up Vanessa as soon as I got off the plane. Moreover, I felt that the relationship between the two of you was very ambiguous; it didn't seem like a normal superior-subordinate relationship at all, so I was sure that there must be something between you and Vanessa…"
Connor gritted his teeth and muttered, "Then you followed us and ran into Vanessa's room to tease us, right?"

chapters.title: Chapter 1710: Break Your Legs
chapters.content:
Chapter 1710: Break Your Legs
"That's right. Who asked the two of you to hide something from me? I'll definitely take revenge on the two of you!"
Chelsea said proudly to Connor.
"..."
Connor was speechless.
"What are you waiting for? Hurry up and drive!" Chelsea said.
Connor had no choice but to start the car.
"How far have you progressed with Vanessa?"
Chelsea blinked and asked.
"Our relationship is not what you think it is…"
At this moment, Connor still seemed to want to defend himself.
"You've already gone to bed together, right?" Chelsea continued.
"Uh..."
Connor's expression was a little awkward. He didn't know what to say.
"Since you didn't deny it, and since Vanessa came to look for you, it means that the two of you must have slept together. What were the two of you doing when I knocked on the door just now?"
Chelsea asked curiously.
"What else would we be doing? We were just chatting…"
Connor said, exasperated.
"Stop lying here. The two of you have already booked a hotel room. How can you still chat? Did you two take off your clothes?"
Chelsea asked with a pout.
"No..."
Connor hurriedly shook his head.
"Humph!"
Chelsea pursed his lips and snorted coldly. Then, she said indifferently, "Forget it. If you don't want to tell me, I won't ask. However, I have to warn you: Since you have already slept with Vanessa, you have to take responsibility…"
"Don't worry about this. I will definitely be responsible!" Connor hurriedly said.
"But you already have a fiancée. How are you going to be responsible for Vanessa? Are you going to break up with your fiancée and get together with Vanessa?" Chelsea asked bluntly.
"..."
Connor lknew how to answer this question.
To be honest, the person Connor loved the most was still Freya, so no matter what, Connor would never break up with her. Vanessa was just an accident to him.
"Looks like you still can't let go of your fiancée!"
At this moment, Connor did not say anything, but Chelsea already understood what he meant.
"Blame me for being too impulsive. I didn't want this to happen either!" Connor said helplessly.
"It's okay. I can understand you. After all, Vanessa is so sexy and beautiful. Moreover, Vanessa likes you from the bottom of her heart. As long as she takes the initiative a little, you will definitely not be able to control yourself!" Chelsea said casually.
"You already knew that Vanessa liked me?"
Connor asked in surprise.
"Of course! I know so much about Vanessa, so I can tell at a glance!"
Chelsea paused for a moment and then continued, "Moreover, you were able to hold out for so long before falling. I think you are already very powerful. If I were a man, I probably wouldn't be as good as you…"
Connor smiled awkwardly without saying anything.
"Although I don't have any objections, your fiancée might not be able to forgive you. I think you should keep it a secret…" Chelsea said slowly.
When Connor heard Chelsea's words, he was shocked. He said in confusion, "You actually don't plan to separate me from Vanessa?"
"What does the matter between the two of you have to do with me? I can't be bothered to care about your stupid things. Men are all fickle, but I can at least be at ease when you're with Vanessa. If you hook up with those indecent women outside, it'll be even more troublesome…"
Chelsea said lightly.
"If only you were my fiancée…" Connor said, somewhat touched.
"Me? Your fiancée?" Chelsea could not help but sneer when she heard his words. Then, she said indifferently, "If I were your fiancée, you would never dare to hookup with another woman behind my back. I would break all three of your legs. Would there be a woman more attractive than me in the world?"
"Uh..."
Connor looked at Chelsea's face and did not know what to say.
A few minutes later, Connor drove Chelsea to a very famous hotpot restaurant in Yarlford.
Chelsea did not continue to talk about Vanessa with Connor during dinner. After all, this was just a relationship problem for him, and she did not want to interfere with these things. Everyone had their own choices.
Vanessa also knew that Connor would not marry her, but she was still willing to be his lover. This was Vanessa's choice.
During dinner, Chelsea and Connor talked a lot about the company's developments. After all, this company would become his most important weapon against the Gomez family, so Chelsea was still very concerned about the company's matters.
Connor originally wanted to invite Chelsea to his company, but she rejected him. After all, she still had her own company to manage.
If Chelsea could join forces with Queta Juve, then her company would probably be able to fight the Gomez family head-on in no time.
However, Chelsea did not have such thoughts for the time being.
She also reminded Connor that he could not just do real estate projects. If he really planned to use this company to defeat the Gomez family, then the most important thing was that his company could completely replace the Gomez family's position in Yarlford. This meant that as long as the Gomez family was involved in the business sphere, Connor had to do the same, and he had to be able to compete with the Gomez family.
The Gomez family's business didn't just include real estate, but also a variety of companies such as medical, auto, and daily necessity companies.
Therefore, Connor decided to find some time to talk to Queta. He should seize the time to expand the company's business.
Besides, he did not lack money. As long as he had enough money, it would be easy to do these businesses.
It wasn't easy to start a profitable business, but it was easy to start a losing business. As long as Connor could choose to give up the benefits, he would definitely be able to snatch the Gomez family's market in a short period of time.
Therefore, the meal that Connor and Chelsea had was very meaningful to Connor. At the very least, she had provided him with a very good direction on where to take his companies in. As for how he would operate next, it still depended on his own ability.
Connor and Chelsea chatted in the hotpot restaurant for almost two hours. During these two hours, Connor couldn't help but admire Chelsea's business acumen.
It had to be said that Chelsea was indeed a business genius.
In terms of business, he and Chelsea were worlds apart.
After the two of them finished eating, Connor took the initiative to pay the bill.
Meanwhile, Chelsea took her bag and went to the bathroom to touch up her makeup.
However, just as Chelsea walked into the bathroom, a figure rushed to her side and pointed a pistol at her waist. He muttered, "Don't make any noise. Come with me now!"

chapters.title: Chapter 1711: Chelsea Was Kidnapped
chapters.content:
Chapter 1711: Chelsea Was Kidnapped
Chelsea instantly realized that the person behind her was planning to kidnap her.
However, Chelsea was also very experienced. She knew that she could only cooperate with the kidnappers now, or they would actually shoot her for real.
"Don't be nervous, I'll cooperate with you!"
Chelsea said calmly to the kidnapper.
"Cut the crap and follow me!"
The kidnapper ordered in a low voice and left with Chelsea.
Because the kidnappers were very secretive, no one noticed that Chelsea was taken away.
After Connor paid the bill and came back, he sat in the same place and waited for a few minutes, but Chelsea did not return. Connor felt that something was wrong and hurriedly ran to the front desk to ask about the situation.
After knowing that Chelsea had left, Connor realized that something was wrong.
The both of them had been chatting happily just now, so why would she leave early?
"Could Chelsea have been kidnapped?"
A bad thought flashed across his mind, and he quickly took out his phone to call her.
..
At the same time.
Chelsea had already been taken to a black Volkswagen by the kidnappers.
At this moment, there were three people in the car. One of them was driving, the other was sitting in the passenger seat, and the person holding Chelsea was sitting next to her.
"Ding, ding, ding…"
At this moment, Chelsea's phone rang.
When the kidnapper heard the ringtone, he said, "Give me your phone!"
Chelsea looked hesitant.
"I advise you to behave yourself. I don't want to lay a hand on you. Our target is that kid, so as long as you cooperate with us, I guarantee that nothing will happen to you!" the kidnapper muttered.
Chelsea glanced at him without saying anything.
The kidnapper took out Chelsea's phone from her bag and answered the call.
"Chelsea, where are you?" Connor asked excitedly.
"You should be Connor McDonald, right?" the kidnapper asked in a low voice.
When Connor heard the kidnapper's words, he could not help but be stunned for a moment. The expression on his face was a little puzzled because he did not expect the kidnapper to dare answer the phone after kidnapping Chelsea. Moreover, the first thing he asked was if he was Connor. This meant that the kidnapper was obviously not here for Chelsea, but rather for Connor.
"Who are you?"
Connor hesitated for a moment before muttering.
"Who I am has nothing to do with you. I'll give you an address now. If you don't want to see your little lover die in our hands, then hurry up and come over!" the kidnapper said calmly.
Connor could feel from the kidnapper's tone that this person was likely a very professional kidnapper, or he would never speak in such a calm tone.
"I know you're not here for that woman, so I hope you can protect her!"
What Connor was thinking about now was to protect Chelsea's safety. No matter what, he could not let her get hurt.
"Don't worry. As long as you don't play any tricks with us, we can still guarantee this woman's safety…" the kidnapper said calmly.
When Connor heard that, he heaved a long sigh of relief. After all, under such circumstances, ensuring Chelsea's safety was still the most important thing.
"Huff…"
Connor took a deep breath and tried to calm himself down.
"I hope you can remember every word I say next, because this will affect this woman's fate. Do you understand what I mean?"
At this moment, the kidnapper spoke again.
"Alright, go ahead…"
Connor lightly nodded.
"If you want to save this woman, go to the warehouse next to Unity Road in Cumulo District in two hours. You can only come alone and can't bring anyone else. Also, you can't call the police. If I find anything wrong, I'll kill this woman immediately," the kidnapper said calmly.
"Alright, I understand…"
Connor replied in a low voice.
Connor knew that the kidnappers did not know Chelsea's true identity. Otherwise, the kidnappers would not have the guts to kidnap her. It was obvious that the kidnappers treated Chelsea as his lover and wanted to threaten him by kidnapping her.
"See you in two hours!"
The kidnapper smiled before hanging up the phone.
..
At the same time, in Chelsea's car.
Chelsea had already heard what the kidnapper said, so she asked, "You guys aren't here for me, but Connor, right?"
"You're of no value to us, so as long as you behave yourself, we won't do anything to you!"
The kidnappers sized up Chelsea's sexy figure as they spoke, but they had no intention of taking advantage of her. This was because these kidnappers were all professionals; they would not ruin their business because of a moment of lust.
"Since you're here for Connor, why don't you kidnap him? Why did you kidnap me?"
Chelsea asked, exasperated.
"Haha…"
The kidnapper couldn't help but laugh when he heard Chelsea's words. Then, he said lightly, "We have investigated his information before. Connor is not a simple person. If we want to make a move on him, it will definitely cause a lot of commotion and we might not succeed. However, you are different. You are an ordinary person. It is much easier to control you…"
Chelsea frowned. "But what if Connor doesn't come to save me?"
"No, you're his lover. Connor probably won't give up on his lover!"
The kidnapper shook his head confidently.
Chelsea looked at the kidnapper's expression and felt a little helpless. Only then did she realize that the kidnapper had mistaken her for Vanessa.
The kidnapper's goal wasn't to kidnap her at all, but to control Connor by attacking Vanessa. However, he had kidnapped her by accident.
"So it's like this…"
Chelsea couldn't help but laugh coldly. She inwardly thought that she'd taken the disaster in place of Vanessa.
A few minutes later, the car slowly stopped in front of a few warehouses.
However, Chelsea realized that her current location was not the same as the location that the kidnapper had given Connor over the phone.
Although Chelsea did not live in Yarlford, she had a company here, so she knew a little about the situation in Yarlford.
"Have you caught her?"
At this moment, a foreigner walked up to the car and asked in a low voice.
"I've already caught her. Just now, I used this woman to call Connor and asked him to go to Unity Road in two hours…"
The person who kidnapped Chelsea replied with a smile.
"Alright…"
The foreigner nodded lightly.

chapters.title: Chapter 1712: Calling for Help
chapters.content:
Chapter 1712: Calling for Help
"Since you don't plan to take me to Unity Road, why did you tell Connor that I'm there? What do you want?" Chelsea frowned and shouted in confusion.
"Haha…"
The foreigner smiled, then said lightly, "Beauty, you're too naive. We're kidnappers. How could we really expose our location? Now that we have people on Unity Road, if Connor dares to bring the police or anyone else over, we'll take something from you as a warning to Connor. Only then will Connor be completely honest…"
When Chelsea heard this, she could not help but take a deep breath.
At this moment, she realized that the kidnappers who appeared this time were not ordinary kidnappers at all. They were very experienced in doing things, and there were foreigners, so this gang was very likely an international criminal organization.
"Do you know who I am?" Chelsea asked.
"No. We only know that you're his lover!"
The foreigner shook his head lightly.
"I'm not his lover at all. My name is Chelsea Lee. I advise you to figure out my identity, or you'll regret it!"
Chelsea wanted to use her identity to put some pressure on the kidnappers.
When the foreigner heard Chelsea's words, he couldn't help but shake his head gently. Then, he said indifferently, "I don't need to investigate your identity, because as long as you're important to Connor and can lure him here, it'll be fine. Anyway, we'll leave Oprana after we finish this case. At that time, you won't be able to find us no matter how capable you are, so we don't have to worry about anything…"
Chelsea looked helpless when she heard the foreigner's words. She took a deep breath and did not say anything.
…
Meanwhile, Connor was in an extremely irritable mood after talking to the kidnappers on the phone.
This was because he had not expected that someone would attack him in just a month after he arrived in Yarlford.
Connor had many enemies, but only the Gomez family and the Yaeger family had the guts to attack him in Yarlford.
If it was the Yaeger family, Connor felt that things might be a little simpler. After all, the Yaeger family would not really do anything to Connor. They just wanted that piece of land.
However, if it was the Gomez family, then things might be a little troublesome.
Connor was no longer in the mood to think about who did it, because the most important thing now was to save Chelsea.
He knew that the kidnappers who attacked this time were very logical. This meant that the other party must have come prepared. They must have made plans to deal with him.
If Connor went over alone, it was very likely that he would die.
Therefore, Connor decided to find some helpers after some simple consideration.
But unfortunately, this was Yarlford, not Newtown or Porthampton. The helpers that Connor could find for the time being were still very few in number.
Waverly and the Second Elder of the Purple Cloud Sect had already returned to the sect, so it was basically impossible for Connor to call for these two people.
Therefore, after hesitating for a long time, Connor could only call Yama.
Although Connor wasn't sure what Yama was doing, and he wasn't sure if what Yama said to him was true or not, it was indeed a fact that Yama's skills were indeed extraordinary.
Now, Connor could only take a gamble.
After Yama picked up the phone, Connor briefly explained the situation on his side. Yama agreed to come over immediately.
After calling Yama, Connor felt that it was still a little unreliable. If Yama could not find the place or was in cahoots with the other party, Chelsea would be in danger.
So, Connor tried to find Aida's number.
Connor called Aida for a very simple reason: she was also a martial artist, and a skilled one at that. She could help him when the time came.
Moreover, Aida was from the Collier family, and Juan liked Aida. If he had no choice, Connor could use the same trick to hold Aida hostage to stall for time.
Of course, the most important thing was that Connor could use this opportunity to test whether Aida really wanted to cooperate with him.
If Aida really wanted to cooperate with him, then she would definitely come out to help. After all, this matter might directly affect his life and death.
Thinking of this, Connor took out his phone and dialed Aida's number.
"Ding, ding, ding…"
The phone rang a few times before Aida answered.
"Is it convenient for you to talk now?" Connor asked in a low voice.
"I'm having dinner with Juan Gomez," Aida said.
"It's like this. A group of people have kidnapped Chelsea Lee. I suspect that they might be from the Gomez family, so I need your help now!" Connor said quickly.
"The Gomez family kidnapped Chelsea Lee?"
When Aida heard this, she couldn't help but feel a little surprised and hurriedly said, "It can't be done by the Gomez family. Juan is having dinner with me, and he just said that the Gomez family has no intention to touch you for the time being!"
"How do you know Juan didn't lie to you?"
Connor asked in a low voice.
Aida was stunned when she heard his words. She frowned and asked, "Alright, even if the Gomez family did something to you, why would you call me?"
"I need your help now!" Connor said helplessly.
"You need my help?"
Aida couldn't help but feel surprised when she heard his words. "The kidnapping of Chelsea by the Gomez family has nothing to do with me. Moreover, I don't seem to be able to help you now, right?" she said coldly after hearing his words.
"I know this has nothing to do with you, but don't forget that the two of us are now in a cooperative relationship. The Gomez family's kidnapping of Chelsea is obviously aimed at me. I know very few people in Yarlford, and I can't call anyone else to help me now..." Connor explained.
"But I'm having dinner with Juan now. I can't leave at all…"
Aida said helplessly.
Connor wasn't in the mood to talk nonsense with Aida and said bluntly, "That's your problem and has nothing to do with me. I want to remind you that if I die, you will lose your most beneficial ally. Even if I can survive today, I won't be able to trust you, so whether you want to help or not is up to you!"

chapters.title: Chapter 1713: I'll Go With You
chapters.content:
Chapter 1713: I'll Go With You
Aida was stunned for a moment.
She knew very well that Connor was planning to use this matter to test her. If she did not agree, then she would lose his trust in her.
"I'll try my best to get away and help you!"
Aida naturally did not want to lose Connor as an ally. If something happened to Connor, her position in the Collier family would be in danger. Connor might be her only hope now.
"Alright!"
Connor didn't say anything after seeing Aida agree and hung up the phone.
After Aida saw that the call had been hung up, she looked helpless. She couldn't help but take a deep breath.
If Aida was alone, she would definitely go over to help. However, she was eating with Juan now. If she wanted to suddenly leave, she would have to think of a reasonable excuse.
Aida thought for a moment before she turned around and walked out of the bathroom back to Juan's side.
"Mr. Gomez, I'm really sorry. I might have to leave now…"
Aida said.
After Juan heard Aida's words, his expression was somewhat puzzled. He muttered, "Miss Collier, it's already so late. What are you going to do?"
Aida and Juan had just had their meal. Juan would definitely feel that something was wrong if she suddenly left.
"My friend just called me. She seems to have encountered some trouble. The situation is quite urgent. I need to go over immediately to see what's going on…" Aida explained.
"Is your friend in trouble?"
Juan's expression was a bit strange. He quickly stood up and said, "What trouble? Why don't I go with you?"
"No, there's no need. It should be just a small matter…"
Aida had never expected Juan to go with her. If he was with her, then Aida's rescue mission would definitely be exposed.
"It's alright. I don't have anything to do anyway. Besides, I know the situation in Yarlford very well. If I were to settle some matters, it would be faster…" Juan said with a smile.
Aida looked at Juan with a helpless expression. She was also very anxious because she knew that Juan was a very smart person. If she continued to refuse, Juan would definitely be suspicious. At that time, things would be even more troublesome.
Therefore, Aida thought about it for two seconds and nodded. "Then I'll have to trouble you, Mr. Gomez!"
"What trouble is there? Your friend is my friend. I still have some power in Yarlford. With me around, things will be much simpler!" Juan said with a smile.
"Alright, let's set off now!"
Aida nodded gently, then picked up her bag and walked out of the restaurant.
Juan hesitated for a moment before following her.
Aida walked in front with an anxious look on her face, while Juan followed behind her.
Juan's expression was a little strange as he looked at the sexy body of Aida.
In fact, Juan had liked Aida for a long time. However, because the Collier family had never agreed to the marriage at that time, and the Gomez family did not dare to force the Collier family, Juan had no chance to pursue her.
However, the situation was different now. The Collier family had taken the initiative to join forces with the Gomez family and had even agreed to this marriage. Juan was naturally very excited at finally having the chance to court her.
The cooperation between the Collier family and the Gomez family would bring great benefits to the Gomez family. Additionally, Juan could get the beauty he'd always coveted. It was like killing two birds with one stone.
A moment later, Aida and Juan got into a black Porsche sports car that belonged to Aida.
Juan didn't know what had happened and didn't know where to go, so Aida was in charge of driving.
Aida was thinking about how she could get rid of Juan while driving.
Juan, who was sitting in the front passenger seat, asked, "Miss Collier, what happened to make you leave in such a hurry?"
"See, a friend of mine just broke up with her boyfriend some time ago, but her boyfriend didn't seem to give up. Today, he brought a large group of people and blocked my best friend's door. She's very afraid that her ex-boyfriend will do something impulsive, so she asked me to go over…"
Aida had already thought of how to deal with Juan's question, so she pretended to be anxious and answered.
"So that's what happened!" Juan nodded slightly, then said with a puzzled tone, "If it's just because of such a small matter, you wouldn't be so anxious, right?"
"You don't know, but my best friend's boyfriend seems to be from the underworld of Yarlford. If you provoke such a person, he can do anything..." Aida hurriedly said.
"I understand…"
Juan nodded slightly and said with a smile, "Miss Collier, you don't have to worry too much. If the other party is really someone from the Yarlford underworld, then I should still be able to say something. At that time, I just need to know who the other party is with and I can settle it with a simple phone call..."
"Thank you so much, Mr. Gomez…" Aida said excitedly.
Juan smiled faintly and said, "Why are you still so polite to me?"
"Should I not?" Aida said helplessly.
Juan hesitated for a moment and said, "Miss Collier, have you thought about what I told you before?"
"What is it?"
Aida pretended to know nothing.
"It's about the matter of the two of us being together. You should also know that my feelings are sincere. I really want to be with you. Therefore, I still hope that you can properly consider what I said earlier…"
Juan said seriously.
"I will seriously consider what you said!"
Aida nodded helplessly.
"That's good…"
Juan replied with a smile.
Aida didn't say anything. She continued to think about how she could get rid of Juan.

chapters.title: Chapter 1714: Alone
chapters.content:
Chapter 1714: Alone
"Ding, ding, ding…"
At this moment, Juan's phone suddenly rang.
Juan hesitated for a moment, and then he wanted to take out his phone to answer the call.
Aida saw Juan looking down for his phone. Without any hesitation, she stepped on the accelerator.
There was a loud bang as Aida's car crashed into the back of the car that was waiting for the traffic light.
When the other party felt that his car had been hit, he immediately got out of the car and shouted, "How the hell are you driving?"
Juan seemed to be startled as well. He only realized what was going on after two seconds.
"Mr. Gomez, I'm really sorry. I... I was a little anxious just now, so I mistook the accelerator for the brake…"
Aida bit her lips, looking like she was blaming herself.
"It's okay. I'll go down and see what's going on!"
Juan tidied up his clothes and got out of the car.
He had just gotten out of the car when the people in the other car surrounded him.
Although Juan was the eldest son of the Gomez family, he was very introverted and not as arrogant as other rich heirs.
He knew that this was due to Aida's mistake, so he quickly took the initiative to explain what had happened.
Aida also got out of the car and said to Juan, "Mr. Gomez, my friend is really in a hurry. Why don't you stay behind and help me deal with this matter? I'll go look for her first…"
"..."
Juan looked at Aida helplessly, then at the other party's car.
The other party's car was badly damaged, so it was definitely not something that could be settled with money. Naturally, someone needed to stay behind to deal with this matter.
Juan saw that Aida seemed to be really anxious, and he was too embarrassed to say anything more. He could only gently nod and say, "Alright then. I'll stay and handle this matter. You can go and do your work first!"
Seeing Juan agree to stay behind to help deal with this matter, Aida's face was a little excited. After thanking Juan twice, she reached out and hailed a taxi.
A moment later, Aida left. Juan started to call his people to come over and solve this problem.
After getting into the taxi, Aida briefly observed her surroundings for a while and found that Juan wasn't following her, so she took out her mobile phone and dialed Connor's phone.
Connor quickly picked up the call.
"Where are you now?"
Aida asked immediately.
"You don't have to come and look for me. Just come to the warehouse beside Unity Road…" Connor replied in a low voice.
"Alright!"
Aida then hung up.
Meanwhile, Connor never thought that Aida would actually come out to help him. This made Connor feel a little surprised.
Of course, from this point, it could be seen that Aida really intended to cooperate with Connor. Otherwise, she would definitely not help.
Connor was not in the mood to think about these things now, however, because he was about to reach Unity Road.
Because the other party had said that Connor was not allowed to bring anyone else over, Connor did not choose to come with Aida and Yama. Instead, he came over by himself first. In this case, once the kidnapper saw that Connor was alone, he would let down his guard. Additionally, Yama and Aida already knew the location of the warehouse, so even if Connor could not save Chelsea for the time being, the two of them could catch the kidnapper off guard.
After Connor parked the car, he observed the situation around the warehouse.
Although the other party's camera was hidden very well, Connor was a martial artist, so he could easily find the location of it.
"Looks like the other party had planned all of this long ago…" Connor thought.
At the same time, someone in the warehouse was staring at the computer screen. He realized that Connor seemed to have come alone because there was no one else around.
One had to know that the kidnappers were using infrared cameras this time, and they even had a heat sensor system.
Therefore, if Connor brought other people along, even if those people hid themselves, the kidnappers could still observe them through the surveillance cameras.
The kidnapper in the warehouse picked up his phone and muttered, "Mike, Connor is here..."
"Did he come by yourself?" the person on the other end of the phone hurriedly asked.
"He should have come alone. I didn't expect this kid to be so bold as to actually do it!" the kidnapper said with a smile.
"It can only mean that we didn't kidnap the wrong person this time. This woman should be very important to Connor!" the other party said slowly.
"Mike, now that this kid hasn't discovered me, I have a chance to kill him directly..."
As the kidnapper spoke, he took out his pistol and slowly aimed it at Connor's position.
"Don't do anything yet!" Mike hurriedly shouted.
"Why?"
"Are you f * cking stupid? This kid hasn't signed the contract yet. Our most important goal this time is to get Connor to sign the contract. After he signs it, we can kill him!" Mike said, exasperated.
"Ah, I forgot about that!"
The kidnapper slowly put down his pistol.
"Go and meet Connor now. If he really came alone, then bring him to our side. Now that this woman is still under our control, I think he will definitely not dare to play any tricks with us even if he has the guts to do so!"
Mike said calmly.
"Alright, I know what to do. You guys should also be prepared. I will bring him over in a while…"
The kidnapper replied indifferently and hung up the phone.
At this moment, Connor had already walked to the front of the warehouse door and shouted at the top of his voice.
"Is anyone there?"
After hearing his words, the kidnapper could not help but hesitate for a moment. Then, he pressed the button to open the warehouse.
After a series of loud noises, the warehouse door slowly opened.
"You're here?"
The kidnapper walked in front of Connor and asked him with a smile.
"..."
Connor briefly observed the situation in the warehouse, but he didn't see anyone else. He knew that since the other party was so thorough, it meant that it wasn't a single person involved, but rather a team.
However, there was no one else in the warehouse except the kidnapper.

chapters.title: Chapter 1715: Foreign Kidnappers
chapters.content:
Chapter 1715: Foreign Kidnappers
"Where are my friends?"
Connor asked the kidnapper in front of him expressionlessly.
"Your friend?"
When the kidnapper heard his words, he could not help but sneer. Then, he said indifferently, "Is your friend here now?"
"Are you kidding me?"
Connor shouted excitedly at the kidnapper.
The kidnapper sneered and said indifferently, "Mr. McDonald, you don't need to be so nervous..."
"Don't f * cking talk nonsense with me. I'm asking you, where is my friend now?" Connor shouted angrily.
"Mr. McDonald, your friend is indeed not with me now, but you can rest assured that that woman is very safe now. As long as you behave yourself, we will definitely let that woman go…"
The kidnapper explained with a smile.
However, this was just an excuse. From the beginning, they had no intention of letting Chelsea go because they were worried that she would expose their identities.
However, they had yet to achieve their goal, so they could only choose to use Chelsea to threaten Connor.
"..."
Connor stood on the spot and hesitated for two seconds. Then, he asked the kidnapper in a low voice, "Now that I'm here, what can I do to make you let that woman go?"
"It's very simple. You come with me to see our boss!"
The kidnapper said calmly.
"Fine!"
Connor looked at the kidnapper and nodded slightly.
The kidnapper took out a pistol and walked out of the warehouse.
At this moment, the kidnapper had no intention of holding Connor hostage at all because he knew that Connor should not dare to play any tricks now.
"Mr. McDonald, your woman is in our hands now, so I advise you to be honest and not do anything impulsive. Otherwise, you and that woman will die today. Do you understand what I mean?"
The kidnapper said as he walked out.
"Where do you plan to take me?"
Connor asked expressionlessly.
"You'll know where I'm bringing you soon…" the kidnapper replied to Connor indifferently. Then, as if he suddenly remembered something, he said, "Give me your phone!"
Connor looked at the kidnapper helplessly. At this time, he did not dare to easily anger the kidnapper because he had not found Chelsea yet, so he could only hand the phone over.
After the kidnapper took Connor's phone, he turned it off and continued to walk forward.
Connor followed closely behind.
After leaving the warehouse, the kidnapper did not seem to have any intention of letting Connor get into the car. This meant that Chelsea's current location was likely not far from his location, the kidnapper would definitely drive there.
However, there was still a very important problem: Connor told Yama and Aida that he was currently in the warehouse of Unity Road. They had no idea where Connor was going next.
Therefore, Connor had to find a way to inform Aida and Yama.
his phone was in the hands of the kidnappers. It was impossible for Connor to send a message to Aida.
Therefore, after thinking for a moment, Connor deliberately increased the strength of his feet.
His movements were very subtle. He secretly put more strength into his steps and left his footprints deep on the ground. Because the surrounding environment was very dark, and the kidnapper was walking in front, he did not notice his small movements.
The footprints he left behind looked very blurry, no different from the footprints left by a normal person. If one did not look carefully, one would not even be able to notice it, but the footprint from his right foot was obviously deeper. Aida and Yama should be able to clearly see the mark that Connor left for them.
About ten minutes later, Connor and the kidnapper still hadn't arrived at Chelsea's place.
At this time, Connor was a little anxious. He couldn't help but ask, "Where is Chelsea now? How long have we been walking for? Why haven't we arrived yet?"
"Brat, why do you have so much nonsense to say? We will arrive in a moment…" the kidnapper replied to Connor impatiently.
Connor's expression was a little helpless. Because they were walking for so long, even if he had left a mark for Aida, Connor was not sure if she could find it.
A few minutes later, the kidnapper finally stopped. He walked to the door of a warehouse and gently knocked on it.
The shutter door was opened from the inside.
The person who opened the door was a middle-aged man. The man glanced at Connor and the kidnapper and muttered, "Come in!"
After Connor heard this, he hurriedly walked into the warehouse.
After entering the warehouse, the middle-aged man closed the door.
The environment in the warehouse was quite good, and there were all the things that should be available.
Moreover, Connor also saw a foreigner sitting on the sofa watching TV. This foreigner had blond hair and blue eyes. He was around 30 years old and was also a martial artist with more strength than Connor.
Connor didn't bring the Chi Receiving pill with him this time, so if they really got into a fight later, he might be at a disadvantage.
At this moment, Connor could only pray silently in his heart that Aida and Yama would hurry over.
"Hello, Mr. McDonald!"
At this moment, the foreigner took the initiative to stand up and walk in front of Connor. Then, he slowly said, "My name is Mike!"
"Where are my friends?"
Connor asked in a low voice.
"Your friend is very safe!"
Mike replied to Connor with a smile.
"I want to see my friend now and make sure she's safe!"
Connor was most worried about Chelsea's safety.
"No problem!"
Mike nodded and said to the people around him, "Bring that woman here!"
"Yes, Boss!"
Mike's subordinate nodded, then turned around and walked into the warehouse.
A few seconds later, the kidnapper brought Chelsea to Connor.
Although Chelsea's hands and feet were tied up, Connor could see that these people probably did not do anything to her and had only sealed her mouth so that she could not speak now.
"Mr. McDonald, we have also investigated your background before. I know that you are a martial artist with very high strength, but I advise you to give up the idea of resisting!"
Mike paused for a moment and continued, "We are also martial artists, and our ranks may be above yours. The most important thing is that this woman is now in our hands. If you dare to resist, we will kill this woman."

chapters.title: Chapter 1716: Orders From Above
chapters.content:
Chapter 1716: Orders From Above
"Understood…"
Connor nodded lightly.
"Hehe, it seems that you still value this woman very much. All Opranian people have a common problem, and that is that they place too much emphasis on relationships. If it were people from our country, no one would take such a big risk for a woman!"
Mike continued.
"This can only prove that we Opranians are more humane than you!"
Connor replied to Mike in a low voice and continued, "I'm not in the mood to talk nonsense with you people now. You kidnapped Chelsea just to lure me here. Now that your goal has been achieved, what do you want?"
"You'll know what we want to do very soon. However, in order to prevent you from really playing any tricks, I think it's better to let you be handcuffed…"
As Mike spoke, he took out a pair of handcuffs and handed them to Connor.
Connor lowered his head and looked at the handcuffs in front of him. He knew that if he wore this thing, he might really have no chance to resist.
Connor frowned and asked, "I'm already here. Is there a need for you to do this?"
"It's better to be careful. You can choose to bring it or not. If you don't, I'll scratch this woman's face. I'll give you ten seconds to think about it!"
Mike said slowly.
Connor looked at Mike with a hint of anger in his eyes.
"Mr. McDonald, I have to say that Opranian women are really beautiful, especially your lover. She's the most beautiful Opranian woman I've ever seen. It would be a pity if such a beautiful face was scratched!" Mike said with a smile.
Chelsea kept shaking her head at Connor. She was not worried that Mike would scratch her face, but she wanted to tell Connor not to put on handcuffs. If Connor put on handcuffs, then the two of them would die today.
Mike felt that Chelsea was about to say something, so he tore off the tape on Chelsea's mouth.
"Connor, don't put on the handcuffs!"
Chelsea shouted at Connor.
"Aren't you afraid of your face being scratched?"
Mike asked Chelsea in confusion.
"Connor, listen to me. Don't put on handcuffs. If you do—"
Before Chelsea could finish her sentence, Connor picked up the handcuffs and took the initiative to cuff his own hands.
Chelsea was speechless when she saw Connor handcuffed. "Connor, are you crazy? If you handcuff us now, the two of us will die. These people have no intention of letting the two of us off!"
"It's okay, they promised me that they would let you go!"
Connor replied in a low voice.
At this moment, Connor knew very well that a person like Mike could do anything, so he did not dare to provoke these people or Mike would really scratch Chelsea's face. Then, even if they could leave alive today, Chelsea's life would be ruined.
How could a girl who loved beauty, who would usually die even if she had a pimple on her face, accept such a huge blow?
Moreover, these things were all caused by Connor, so he would also keep blaming himself.
After Mike saw Connor put on the handcuffs, the expression on his face relaxed a lot. Then, he smiled and said, "Mr. McDonald, let me tell you the truth. The few of us have no enmity with you, so we don't want to make things too difficult for you. The one who really wants to kidnap you is someone else. We're also waiting for a face-to-face call now."
"You can do whatever you want to me, but I beg you, can you let that woman go? That woman had nothing to do with this!"
Connor said.
Mike could not help but hesitate when he heard Connor's words. Then, he said, "Alright, this woman is indeed not my target. I can promise you that if the family doesn't ask to kill this woman, we will let her go!"
In fact, an assassin like Mike was still very professional. Basically, as long as someone was not his target, he would not make a move on them.
"Thank you!"
Connor said to Mike in a low voice.
"You're welcome. I'm just doing this for a living. If it wasn't for this, I wouldn't want to provoke you people!" Mike said slowly.
"..."
Connor looked at Mike indifferently and did not say anything.
"Mr. McDonald, please wait a moment. The higher-ups haven't called us yet. I don't know how to deal with you. I need to wait for the orders from the higher-ups!" Mike said.
After Connor heard Mike's words, the expression on his face seemed a little excited, because this would be enough to buy some time for Aida and Yama.
…
Meanwhile, in the Yaeger family villa.
After Charis learned that Connor had been subdued by Mike, the expression on her face was abnormally excited as she hurriedly ran to Styrmir Yarger's room.
"Charis, it's already so late. Why are you here?"
At this moment, Styrmir was holding a Go manual. He was playing Go while reading the manual.
Styrmir was not only a very famous entrepreneur in Yarlford, but he was also very skilled in Go. Juan Gomez also liked to play Go very much. Several big shots from the upper circle of Yarlford would occasionally play with them.
"Grandpa, I have good news to tell you!" Charis said excitedly.
"Good news?"
Styrmir couldn't help but be stunned when he heard this. Then he slowly put down the Go piece in his hand and asked, "What good news?"
"A few days ago, I hired a foreign assassin organization. Now, these people have already gotten Connor McDonald under control!" Charis hurriedly said.
"What?"
Styrmir looked shocked. He whispered to Charis, "You mean you've already caught Connor?"
"That's right. I came over to ask you how you plan to deal with Connor!"
Charis asked Styrmir.
"Oh Charis, why are you so muddle-headed? The Gomez family has already told me not to touch Connor for the time being. Although I don't know what the Gomez family's intentions are, Yamino Gomez definitely has his reasons for not touching Connor!" Styrmir shouted helplessly.

chapters.title: Chapter 1717: In For A Penny, In For A Pound!
chapters.content:
Chapter 1717: In For A Penny, In For A Pound!
"But that bastard Connor snatched that piece of land from our Yaeger family. Grandpa, you should know better than me how important that piece of land is to us!"
Charis paused for a moment before continuing, "And grandpa, I don't plan to do anything to Connor. I just plan to take back that piece of land from Connor's hands!"
"Things are not as simple as you think!"
Styrmir looked at Charis and shook his head gently. Then, he said in a low voice, "Right now, only our Yaeger family is competing with Connor for this piece of land. As long as you expose your purpose, Connor will definitely know that it was our Yaeger family who did it. Connor will definitely take revenge on us crazily in the future!"
Charis pursed her lips and said indifferently, "If he wants to take revenge, then let him! In any case, our family is not afraid of him—"
"If Connor was really that easy to deal with, Yamino Gomez would have gotten rid of him long ago. Connor wasn't able to reach this step by relying on luck!" Styrmir said lightly.
"Grandpa, what should we do now? Connor has already been subdued. We can't just let him go like this, right?" Charis said with a frown.
"It's definitely not possible to let Connor go. Right now, it seems that we can only go all out. First, make Connor sign the contract and get that piece of land. Then, we'll get rid of him. I'll explain the rest to Yamino Gomez!"
Styrmir said after thinking for a moment.
When Charis heard this, she was stunned on the spot, disbelief on her face. She did not expect Styrmir to actually plan to kill Connor just like that.
Although Charis planned all these things by herself, she had no intention of killing Connor at all. She just wanted to take back that piece of land.
"If that brat Connor doesn't die, then there will be endless trouble in the future. Since you've already made a move on Connor, then you can only kill him to prevent future trouble!" Styrmir said expressionlessly.
"But…"
Charis seemed to want to say something.
"No buts. Since you've already done this, you might as well go all out and get rid of Connor!"
Styrmir said firmly.
After a moment of hesitation, Charis nodded and said, "Alright, I'll call the kidnappers now!"
"Go ahead…"
Styrmir nodded slightly.
…
On the other side, after Chelsea saw that Connor had been handcuffed, her expression was one of despair.
"Connor, are you crazy? Do you think that they will really let me go just because you cooperate with them? Let me tell you, these people are here to kill you today. No matter what you do, they won't let the two of us go!"
Chelsea shouted excitedly.
"If I cooperate with them, you might still have a way out!"
Connor said lightly.
"Is there something wrong with your brain? Why did you come here when you knew it was dangerous?"
"I can't leave you alone. After all, this matter was caused by me!"
Chelsea did not know what to say. Tears flowed out of ers eyes.
"Ding, ding, ding…"
However, at this moment, Mike's phone suddenly rang.
When Mike heard the phone ring, he quickly took out his phone and answered the call.
"Alright…I understand. Don't worry, I'll definitely handle this matter well. Alright, alright..."
Mike said a few words into the phone and then hung up.
After putting down the phone, Mike walked up to Connor and said to Connor, "Mr. McDonald, the higher-ups have already called me and told me that as long as you sign this contract, we will let you go!"
"Contract?"
Connor could not help but be stunned when he heard Mike's words. Then, he frowned and asked Mike, "What contract?"
"I'm not sure what the contract is exactly!"
As Mike spoke, he took out a folder and took out a contract and a pen.
Connor took the contract and took a look. He realized that it was about the transfer of land.
When Connor saw the contract, he instantly understood what was going on.
It was obvious that this contract was prepared by the Yaeger family.
Connor also knew that these kidnappers were really not sent by the Gomez family, but by the Yaeger family.
"As long as I sign this contract, you will let me go, right?"
Connor asked.
"That's right. As long as you sign the contract, the two of you can leave!" Mike nodded slightly.
".."
Connor looked at the contract in his hand with a conflicted expression.
"I can sign this contract, but I have a request!"
Connor said in a low voice.
"What request? You're saying that
"Let Chelsea go first. As long as she's safe, I'll sign the contract!"
Connor turned to look at Chelsea and said calmly.
"Mr. McDonald, I can't satisfy your request. If we let this woman go, what if she calls the police?"
Mike said very cautiously.
Connor sneered and said indifferently, "If you don't let her go now, I won't sign this contract. I already know who did this to me. The other party cares about this contract very much, so if I don't sign it, your mission won't be completed, and you won't be able to kill me!"
Mike did not expect Connor's attitude to be so tough. He gritted his teeth and asked in a low voice, "Aren't you afraid of this woman's face getting mutilated?"
"If you dare to touch this woman, I won't sign this document even if I die!" Connor replied without thinking.
When Mike heard Connor's words, the expression on his face seemed to be a little hesitant. At this moment, he could feel Connor's determination, so he did not dare to act rashly.
Mike hesitated for two seconds. Then, he said expressionlessly, "Mr. McDonald, I originally didn't intend to hurt you, but since you've already said so, I have no choice. I can not do anything to this woman, but I can do it to you. I will definitely make you sign this document!"
"What do you want?"
Chelsea shouted excitedly.
"Now that Mr. McDonald doesn't intend to cooperate with us, we can only use a little trick to make him listen!"
Mike replied in a low voice, then shouted at the people around him, "Go and prepare the things!"
"Alright!"
The kidnapper beside Mike nodded and turned to leave.

chapters.title: Chapter 1718: A Tramp
chapters.content:
Chapter 1718: A Tramp
"Mr. McDonald, we didn't want this to happen, but since you're unwilling to cooperate with us, we can't do anything about it. We're just trying to make money!"
Mike said with a smile while waiting for his subordinates to prepare.
"I know that you're doing this for money. It just so happens that I'm very rich. Why don't you let the two of us go now? No matter how much the other party offers, I can pay you double."
Chelsea shouted excitedly.
"Double the money?"
Mike could not help but smile when he heard Chelsea's words. Then, he said indifferently, "Miss Lee, I have to say that the price you gave me is indeed very tempting. But I'm sorry, we have our own rules in this industry. If I accept your money, we will be wanted, and our reputation will be affected. In that case, no one will look for us in the future…"
"The money I give you is enough for you to live for the rest of your life. In this way, you don't have to continue being assassins and can live the life you want!" Chelsea hurriedly continued.
"I'm sorry, I still can't accept your condition because our family is still in the hands of the organization. If I accept your money, then my family will all die!"
Mike shook his head again.
Chelsea's eyes were filled with despair. She did not know what to do.
At this time, Connor was silently praying for Aida and Yama to hurry over. He could only place all his hopes on these two people.
A few minutes later, Mike's men had already prepared the tools.
Mike walked up to Connor and said with a smile, "Mr. McDonald, I didn't prepare these things for you. If you sign now, I can let you suffer less. However, if you still don't cooperate with me, don't blame me for being rude…"
"Stop talking nonsense. Hurry up and do what you want!"
Connor replied to Mike coldly.
At this moment, Connor only wanted to help Aida and Yama stall for a little more time.
"Mr. McDonald, have you really thought about it? I have to remind you that if these things are used, even a man of iron won't be able to withstand it…"
Mike continued to threaten Connor.
"Connor, hurry up and sign it. Isn't it just a piece of land? So what if you give it to them?"
Chelsea shouted anxiously.
Connor looked at Chelsea indifferently and did not say anything.
Connor knew that this was not as simple as a piece of land; once he signed the contract, it meant that Connor and Chelsea had no value to these kidnappers. At that time, they would definitely kill the two of them.
Therefore, Connor had already made up his mind that he could not sign the contract no matter what.
…
Yama had lived in Yarlford for so many years. He usually made a living by picking up trash, so he knew the situation in Yarlford very well.
After he hung up the phone with Connor, he immediately went to the warehouse beside Unity Road.
Yama wandered around the warehouse, but could not find Connor. However, he saw Connor's car. From this alone, he deduced that Connor must have gone somewhere else, and that location was where the kidnappers were.
Yama carefully observed the surroundings and finally found Connor's footprints.
It had to be said that Yama was very experienced.
Under such circumstances, he could tell at a glance that these footprints on the ground were the secret signal that Connor had left for him.
Therefore, he followed these secret signals and fumbled forward bit by bit.
Yama also noticed that there was a woman following him not far away.
This woman was none other than Aida Collier.
Yama knew very well that this woman didn't seem to have any ill intentions towards him. She was probably following him all this time to find Connor.
Therefore, Yama ignored her.
About half an hour later, Yama finally found Connor and Chelsea's current location.
However, because there was a road in front of the warehouse, Connor could not leave any traces there.
But this was enough for Yama. After all, there was only one building on both sides of the road: the warehouse. This meant that Connor was definitely in the warehouse now.
That said, there was still a very important problem: there was only one door to enter the warehouse, and it was a shutter door at that. There was no way to open this door from the outside.
Yama had no way to force his way into the warehouse to save them.
"Looks like my only option is to lure these people out first…"
Yama sighed and walked towards the warehouse.
Aida, on the other hand, hid in the darkness and did not make a move. She did not know what was going on, and she had a special position, so she did not dare to act rashly.
…
Inside the warehouse.
Mike began to torture Connor, using every torture method on TV on him.
Meanwhile, Chelsea kept crying. At this moment, her heart ached for Connor, but she could not do anything.
Now, she was filled with nothing but regret for coming to Yarlford. If it was not for her carelessness, Connor would not have to suffer.
Connor, who had been tortured to a miserable state, endured the pain in his body after seeing Chelsea cry. He smiled and said, "I'm fine, you don't have to be afraid!"
When Chelsea heard Connor's words, however, she cried even harder.
"Peng, peng, peng…"
At this moment, there was a sudden loud bang outside the warehouse.
Mike subconsciously looked at the computer screen when he heard the sound of the door being smashed. He found that it was actually a tramp smashing the door with a stone.
Connor also noticed this tramp. His expression was a little excited because he knew that this tramp was none other than Yama.
"George, go and get rid of this person!"
Mike did not think too much about it and shouted at his subordinates.
"Alright!"
The kidnapper named George nodded slightly and walked out of the warehouse.
After all, if this tramp smashed the door, it would definitely attract the attention of the police.
Therefore, Mike did not even think about it and simply asked his subordinates to get rid of the people outside.
The kidnapper named George didn't seem to realize the danger as he opened the door and walked out of the warehouse.
"What are you doing? Hurry up and get lost or else!"
George pointed at Yama and shouted.

chapters.title: Chapter 1719: The Excited Mike
chapters.content:
Chapter 1719: The Excited Mike
Yama slowly raised his head and looked at George. Then, without any hesitation, he rushed in front of George and grabbed his neck with both hands.
"Snap!"
A crisp sound rang out.
In less than a few seconds, Yama had taken care of a kidnapper.
After Aida, who was hiding not far away, saw this scene, her expression was one of incredulity. She did not expect Connor to get such a powerful expert to help.
Mike and the others did not seem to notice what was happening at the entrance of the warehouse. They were still torturing Connor.
After a moment of hesitation, Yama took off George's coat and put it on himself.
A moment later, he walked into the warehouse wearing George's clothes.
The others did not seem to notice anything strange, but Chelsea realized that the person who came in was not the same person as the kidnapper who went out. She instantly realized what was going on.
"George, have you dealt with the homeless man outside?"
Mike asked calmly as he tortured Connor.
"I've dealt with it…"
Yama replied in a low voice.
