After Mike heard Yama's words, he instantly realized that something was wrong. Then, he suddenly turned his head to look at Yama.
Yama's reaction speed was very fast. He strode forward and was about to rush towards Mike.
Mike hurriedly took two steps back, and the other two kidnappers in the warehouse seemed to have realized what was happening and rushed towards Yama.
However, these two kidnappers were no match for Yama at all—in less than two seconds, Yama easily dealt with the other two kidnappers.
After seeing this scene, Connor's expression was a little excited. He knew that he had not gambled wrongly. Yama's skills were indeed very terrifying, and he was not a member of the Gomez family or the Yaeger family, or he would not have appeared to save Connor.
After Mike saw that his two subordinates had been killed by Yama, he knew in his heart that he was definitely not a match for Yama. Even if he was a Black-rank martial artist, he would not be able to deal with Yama.
However, there was only one door in the warehouse. If he wanted to run now, it would definitely be too late.
After thinking for a moment, Mike rushed to Chelsea.
"Ahh!"
Chelsea screamed. Mike held a dagger and pressed it against her neck.
"I advise you not to move, or I'll kill this woman right now!"
Mike shouted.
Yama did not care about Chelsea's life or death at all, however; after all, he came here to save Connor.
Therefore, Yama continued to approach Mike.
"Yama, don't move!"
Connor was worried that Mike would really kill Chelsea, so he quickly shouted.
Yama slowly stopped after hearing his words.
Mike's eyes were filled with anger because he did not expect someone to appear and disrupt his plan at this time.
Yama stood there and hesitated for two seconds. Then, he bent down and picked up a pistol from the ground before walking up to Connor and fired a shot at his handcuffs.
"Kang!"
The bullet instantly pierced through the chain.
Connor flexed his hands and then slowly stood up.
Mike sized up Yama and said in a low voice, "Connor, you were deliberately stalling for time just now, right?"
"That's right!"
Connor nodded gently and continued, "I will now give you a chance to live. As long as you let Chelsea go, I will let you go…"
"Hahaha…"
Mike could not help but laugh when he heard Connor's words. Then, he said in a very arrogant tone, "Connor, do you think I'm a three-year-old child? I tortured you to such a state just now. If I let this woman go now, will you really let me go?"
"What do you plan to do now?"
Connor asked Mike.
"It's very simple. I want you to prepare a car for me now, or I'll kill this woman immediately!"
Mike shouted excitedly.
At this moment, Mike only had one thought in his mind, and that was to survive.
This was because his companions had already lost, and Yama's combat strength was also very shocking. It was basically impossible for him to kill Connor and complete the mission now. However, he also knew that Connor cared very much about Chelsea, so he could only use Chelsea as a shield.
"I've already said that as long as you let Chelsea go, I'll let you leave immediately. However, if you dare to touch her, I'll make you wish you were dead!"
Connor said expressionlessly.
"Cut the crap. Before I leave this place, I won't let this woman go. I have no grudge against you, killing this woman won't do me any good, I just want to live!" Mike shouted at Connor.
"Charis Yaeger asked you to kidnap me, right?"
Connor suddenly asked.
"That's right, the Yaeger family asked me to kidnap you. This matter has nothing to do with me, and I don't want to be your enemy, so as long as you do as I say, I won't hurt this woman!"
Mike hurriedly said.
"Hehe, alright!"
Connor gently nodded his head and then asked calmly, "You need a car now, right?"
"Yes, prepare a car for me!"
Mike shouted.
"I'll go get you a car now. Don't be rash!"
Connor took out his phone as he spoke.
When Mike saw that Connor was about to make a call, the expression on his face seemed to relax a little.
"Bang!"
However, at this critical moment, a gunshot rang out.
The bullet directly pierced through Mike's head.
Connor, who was about to make a call, was stunned when he saw this scene.
Connor turned around and realized that Aida Collier was the one who fired the gun.
Just now, Aida had been hiding outside the warehouse, and Mike's attention was on Connor and Yama, so he did not notice her at all.
Originally, Aida didn't intend to continue participating in this matter because Yama had already saved Connor.
But then, Aida thought that if she didn't do something, Connor wouldn't be able to trust her completely, so she chose to shoot.
After Mike fell, Chelsea hurriedly ran to Connor's side, then hugged him and cried.
Aida walked to Mike's body and carefully examined it. "This person is already dead," she declared.
"Thank you!"
Connor didn't expect Aida to save him at this time.

chapters.title: Chapter 1720: You Need Care
chapters.content:
Chapter 1720: You Need Care
"I told you before that I really want to work with you. Now, you can believe me, right?"
Aida replied indifferently.
"Of course!"
Connor's voice was a little weak.
Aida looked at the wounds on Connor's body and could not help but frown slightly. She then said, "You're already in such a state. Hurry up and go to the hospital. I can't stay here anymore. Gongsun Yujie still needs me to explain!"
"Alright, hurry up and leave. We don't need you here anymore!"
Connor hurriedly nodded.
Aida hesitated for a moment before glancing at Chelsea. She frowned and said, "These people won't tell anyone about our cooperation, right?"
"Don't worry, I won't tell anyone!"
Connor hurriedly replied.
"That's good!"
Aida nodded without saying anything. She turned around and left.
Connor looked at Aida's back and did not say anything. After experiencing this incident, Connor knew that Aida must have sincerely wanted to cooperate with him. Otherwise, Aida would never have taken such a big risk to save him.
"Connor, let's go to the hospital quickly!"
After Aida left, Chelsea said excitedly to Connor.
"Good!"
Connor lightly nodded.
Yama walked in front of Connor and whispered, "You shouldn't be able to walk like this. Let me carry you!"
Connor looked at Yama helplessly. Although Connor felt that it was a bit embarrassing, he really did not have the strength to walk. He could only choose to let Yama carry him and leave.
A few minutes later, Yama returned to the place where he parked the car and drove Chelsea and Connor to the hospital.
Chelsea knew a lot of people in Yarlford, so after entering the hospital, she went straight to the hospital's director and asked for the best doctor to treat Connor.
It had to be said that Chelsea was indeed very prestigious. The hospital director immediately got the most famous surgeon to operate on Connor.
Fortunately, the injuries on Connor's body were only superficial injuries. There were no fatal injuries, so he only needed some sutures.
After more than an hour, Connor's physical examination and surgery were finally over.
Actually, he could recover from these injuries even without surgery because he was a fighter, and a Black-rank at that. However, Chelsea was worried and insisted on him getting surgery.
Connor was stubborn, but he could only do as she wanted.
Yama had been standing at the door from the beginning to the end. He didn't leave or say anything to anyone and only stood there like a robot. Even the nurses in the hospital would feel a little afraid when they saw him.
Chelsea sat beside Connor's bed and quietly sat with him.
Connor turned to look at her and said in an unusually helpless tone, "Can you not look at me like that? I really don't have anything else to do. Go do what you should do…"
"You're already in a bad state, yet you're still showing off!" Chelsea pouted and replied to Connor, then continued, "If it wasn't for you showing off, you wouldn't have to suffer all this…"
"If I don't suffer a little, the person who will suffer might be you…"
Connor said helplessly.
When Chelsea heard Connor's words, he could not help but be stunned for a moment. The expression on his face seemed a little gentle.
Chelsea had never encountered such a thing since she was young. After all, many people in the circle of York knew her identity, so it was impossible for anyone to kidnap her.
Today was Chelsea's first time experiencing such a thing. However, Connor's actions had deeply moved her.
Chelsea knew that everything Connor did was to protect her. If it wasn't for her, Connor would never have been hurt.
At this moment, Chelsea only had one thought in her heart, and that was that everything she did for Connor was worth it. Many people could not understand why she was so good to Connor, but his actions today were also an answer to Chelsea.
Although Connor had already finished the surgery, Chelsea refused to let him be discharged because he had not completely recovered.
Connor knew that he could not be as stubborn as her, so he did not say anything and quietly lay on the bed with an IV drip.
Chelsea sat beside Connor with a gentle expression. At this moment, the expression on her face made Connor feel a little uncomfortable. This was because he felt that her concern for him was not the same as an aunt's concern for his nephew. It was as if there was something else.
Yama stood alone outside the ward, so the atmosphere was inevitably a little awkward.
Connor hesitated for a moment before whispering to Chelsea, "Chelsea, you must be scared out of your wits by what happened today. Why don't you go back and rest early? There's no problem with me anymore!"
"If I were to leave, I'd be the one to take care of you. I'd rather stay here with you!"
Chelsea said lightly as she peeled an orange for Connor.
"Uh..."
When Connor heard her words, his expression seemed a little helpless. Then, he said, "Well, actually, I don't need anyone to take care of me now…"
"You're already injured to this extent, though? Why don't you need someone to take care of you?"
As Chelsea spoke, she stuffed the orange into Connor's mouth.
Connor looked at her abnormal breakdown and took a deep breath before saying in a low voice, "Oh right, you shouldn't tell Vanessa about this. I'm afraid she'll be worried. Also, find an opportunity to take Vanessa away. Yarlford isn't safe now."
"Alright, I'll find an excuse to take Vanessa away tomorrow, don't worry!"
Chelsea nodded.
Chelsea did not argue with Connor about this because she knew very well that Connor was right. Yarlford was indeed not safe now. If they stayed in Yarlford, they would be causing trouble for Connor.
If it wasn't for him today, Connor wouldn't have fallen into the kidnappers' trap.
"You probably know who did this to you now, right?" Chelsea asked.
"I know…"
Connor nodded gently and continued, "The one who attacked me this time probably isn't the Gomez family, but the Yaeger family. They're here for the land I have!"
"Then what do you plan to do next?"
Chelsea asked.

chapters.title: Chapter 1721: You? With Me?
chapters.content:
Chapter 1721: You? With Me?
Connor hesitated for a moment before answering. "I haven't thought about what to do next. The Yaeger family isn't that easy to deal with, so I have to think carefully before I make a move or I'll only alert the enemy!"
Chelsea nodded lightly. Then, she said expressionlessly, "You have your own ideas. Do whatever you want. If you need my help, just call me!"
It was obvious that Chelsea was telling Connor that she did not intend to interfere in this matter.
Although Chelsea could take revenge on the Yaeger family directly, the Yaeger family was not Connor's target; the ones he really wanted to deal with were the Gomez family. He would definitely not mess up all his plans because of the Yaeger family.
"Alright, I got it!"
Connor nodded lightly.
"Oh right, there's still something I don't understand!" Chelsea suddenly said.
"What is it?"
"If I remember correctly, the woman who came to save you today is Albert Collier's daughter, right? Why is she working with you? What's going on between the two of you?"
Chelsea asked in confusion.
"Aida has indeed joined forces with me. She wants to avenge her mother who was killed by Cielo's mother, who is now Albert's wife. The matter sounds complicated, and I'm not very sure as to what happened. Previously, I was also wondering if Aida sincerely wanted to cooperate with me or not. Today's incident can be considered as a test for her. It seems that Aida really does want to cooperate with me!" Connor slowly explained.
"I see. I've always heard that Aida of the Collier family is not a simple woman, but it seems that she is extraordinary. Now that the Collier family and the Gomez family have joined forces, it is indeed a good thing if you have her as your spy in the Collier family. However, you have to be careful!" Chelsea said.
"Don't worry, I can't trust Aida 100% because she's very shrewd. I don't know what she's planning to do!"
Connor nodded.
"Hm. At least you know. I'm just worried that you'll catch a glimpse of leg and then completely fall under her spell," Chelsea pouted.
"What do you mean? Am I that kind of person?" Connor hurriedly defended himself.
"If you're not that kind of person, why are you involved with Vanessa? I'm telling you, Vanessa is my best friend. You can't hurt her, understand?" Chelsea said seriously.
"I won't…"
"Then how are you going to explain this to your fiancée?" Chelsea pressed.
"Why are you talking about this topic again?"
Connor said exasperatedly.
"I'm worried about you. I'm a woman too, so I know women very well. If I were to get together with you, and you still decided to hook up with other women, I'd definitely hate you very much. Not only that, I'd think of ways to take revenge on you, so you have to deal with your relationship problems well," Chelsea said very seriously.
"You? Get together with me?"
When Connor heard her words, his eyes instantly widened. The expression on his face was also one of disbelief. "About that, you better not joke with me about this kind of thing…"
"Who's joking with you? I'm very serious…" Chelsea replied calmly.
"What are you so serious about? Don't forget our relationship. Good thing there are only the two of us here. What if outsiders hear this?"
Connor had already felt that there was something wrong with her gaze when he looked at him. In addition, he had just saved Chelsea today, so Connor was very worried that she would develop some other feelings for him because of this matter. If that was really the case, it would be troublesome.
Although Chelsea was indeed very beautiful and very attractive, Connor and Chelsea were not much different in age, and the two of them were not related by blood.
However, Connor still felt that it was inappropriate for Chelsea to joke around like this.
Chelsea's words were just a casual remark and she did not think much of them, but when she saw Connor's nervous expression, she felt inexplicably uncomfortable because she felt that he might despise her.
"Little Connor, you seem to be very excited!"
Chelsea whispered.
"I was just reminding you!" Connor replied helplessly.
Chelsea saw that Connor seemed even more nervous and replied with a smile. "The two of us have nothing to do with each other at all. Have you forgotten? I'm not your mother's biological sister, so it's not impossible for the two of us to be together…"
"What is impossible? You really can't joke about this kind of thing…"
Connor said exasperatedly.
"Are you looking down on me?"
Chelsea blinked at Connor and continued, "Although I'm a few years older than you, I think I've taken good care of myself. Don't tell me you think I'm not worthy of you?"
As Chelsea spoke, she deliberately approached Connor. Her exquisite and charming face directly moved in front of Connor's face.
At this moment, he could clearly smell her fatal scent.
"I'm not worthy of you…"
Connor said to Chelsea, his composure crumbling.
"Do you think I'm pretty?"
Chelsea asked seductively.
"Yes"
Connor said truthfully.
"Then who do you think is more beautiful, me or Vanessa?"
"You…"
Connor replied in an exasperated manner.
"Then why can you be with Vanessa but not me?"
"I give up! I was wrong, okay? Don't tease me!"
Connor was tortured by Chelsea until he broke down.
When Chelsea saw Connor's expression, she immediately laughed and said, "Why are you so nervous? I was just joking with you…"
"Don't joke around like this!"
He said helplessly.
"Don't worry, it's impossible for me to like you. The person I like must be a handsome man. You don't meet this condition…"
"I know I don't meet your conditions, but you don't have to be so straightforward, right? Don't you know that you're hurting someone's self-esteem?"

chapters.title: Chapter 1722: Yama's Identity
chapters.content:
Chapter 1722: Yama's Identity
"What self-esteem?"
Chelsea said disdainfully.
Connor looked at her face. He did not know what to say.
Chelsea turned to look at Yama, who was standing outside the ward, and asked with a puzzled expression, "What does that wooden man do? Did you bring him from Newtown?"
"He said that he was my father's former bodyguard, but now he has lost his memory, so he doesn't even remember his real name. He only knows that he is called Yama. Moreover, he said that he has been waiting for me in Yarlford for twenty years."
Connor said lightly.
"He's actually Yama?"
After Chelsea heard Connor's words, the expression on his face was a little shocked. Then, he hurriedly walked to the window and looked at Yama very carefully.
"I still have some doubts about what he told me before. After all, he doesn't have any evidence to prove his identity. However, after today's incident, I feel that he shouldn't be lying to me. He might really be my father's bodyguard!"
Connor said.
"Don't think things are so simple. After all, you can't completely trust this person just because of this matter. What if this person isn't your father's bodyguard, but a chess piece placed by the Gomez family to be by your side?"
Chelsea said cautiously.
"Then what should I do now?"
Connor asked as he frowned
Chelsea hesitated for two seconds before saying, "Although I know that your father does have a bodyguard named Yama, I was still very young at that time, and I don't remember his appearance, so I can't be sure if this person is your father's bodyguard!"
"It's the same as not saying anything..."
Connor said exasperatedly.
"Although I have no way to confirm this person's identity, I know someone who can confirm it…"
As Chelsea spoke, she took out the phone that had been confiscated by the kidnapper from her bag and walked out of the ward.
Connor lay on the bed and looked at the door, not knowing what Chelsea was going to do.
"Just now, Connor told me that you are Yama?"
Chelsea asked Yama directly.
"That's right, I'm Yama!"
Yama nodded.
"Words are useless, and you can't produce any evidence now, so would you mind if I take a photo with you to let those who know Yama see if you're real?"
Chelsea took out his phone as she spoke.
"Do you need me to strike a pose?"
Yama asked seriously.
"No? You can just stand here obediently!"
Chelsea shouted exasperatedly when she heard Yama's words.
"Alright then!"
Yama nodded and stood there with a serious expression.
Chelsea took two photos of Yama's face and then returned to Connor's ward.
"You just said that someone knows Yama. Who are you talking about?"
Connor asked.
"Who else could it be but Joseph Lee?" Chelsea replied and continued, "I was only three or four years old when I met Yama. At that time, you weren't even born yet. I met him when your father came to our Lee family to propose his marriage to your mother, so I didn't have any impression of him at all. It was only later that I heard that he had died. However, Joseph was different. He has seen Yama before, so he could recognize him at a glance..."
"Forget it. I don't want to have any contact with the Lee family!"
When Connor heard her words, his tone was a little stiff.
"You're not the one contacting Joseph, what are you afraid of?"
Chelsea replied calmly and sent the photo.
A few minutes later, Chelsea received a call from Joseph.
"Chelsea, how did you get that photo just now?" Joseph asked excitedly.
"Do you know the person in the photo?"
Chelsea asked calmly.
"If I remember correctly, this man should be the bodyguard of Connor's father, Yama. But I remember Yama died 20 years ago. Did you really take this photo?"
Joseph asked in confusion.
"Of course, Yama is right beside me. He's not dead, but he has lost his memory. He's here for Connor now, but Connor and I aren't sure of his identity, so I took a photo to show you. Since you said that he's Yama, it means that this person shouldn't be lying!" Chelsea explained.
"I didn't expect Yama to still be alive. Then he…"
Joseph seemed to want to ask something else. However, Chelsea did not give Joseph the chance to continue speaking. "Alright, Joseph, I'm not in the mood to chat with you right now. I still have other things to do here. I'll hang up first!"
She hung up the phone without thinking and then said, "Alright, you can rest assured now. This Yama is the real deal…"
"You're the one who was worried, okay? If Yama was from the Gomez family, he wouldn't have saved me today!" Connor said exasperatedly.
"Isn't this for your own good? Why are you so ungrateful?"
Chelsea pouted.
Connor looked at her indifferently and did not say anything. It seemed that he was still angry because Chelsea had contacted Joseph.
Chelsea saw that his mood seemed to be a little off and quickly asked, "Connor, are you unhappy that I called Joseph just now?"
Connor turned his head and looked at her without saying anything.
"Actually, Connor, there is no conflict between you and the Lee family. You don't have to be like this. The Lee family has no hostility towards you!" Chelsea said.
"My mother told me before that even if I starve to death, I can't ask the Lee family for help!""
Connor said expressionlessly.
"Then I'm also a member of the Lee family. You even saved me today!" Chelsea said helplessly.
"You're different from the Lee family. My mother didn't include you in the Lee family. Although I don't know what happened back then, I remember what my mother said to me!" Connor said coldly.
Chelsea sighed, then said helplessly, "Then you really don't intend to forgive the Lee family, right?"
"Yes!"
Connor nodded lightly.
"Actually, there are some things that cannot be blamed on Joseph. After all, he also wanted to protect your mother's safety back then and did not want your mother to leave with your father. Your mother felt that your father was doing this for her own benefit, so she did her best to stop Joseph. There is indeed a misunderstanding between the father and daughter, but these things have nothing to do with you…"
Chelsea still seemed to be trying to explain Joseph's side of the story

chapters.title: Chapter 1723: A Special Method
chapters.content:
Chapter 1723: A Special Method
"I told you, I don't want to investigate what happened back then. I'm just doing what my mother told me to!" Connor interrupted.
After Chelsea saw Connor's unyielding attitude, she could not continue to say anything. He could only reply indifferently, "Forget it. Since you don't want to hear me say these things, I won't say anymore. Anyway, you should rest well!"
"..."
Connor turned to Chelsea, then slowly closed his eyes to rest.
The next morning, Connor was discharged after confirming that there was really no problem with his body.
After he was discharged from the hospital, he returned to his own home. Chelsea also knew that Yarlford was very unsafe now, so she thought up an excuse to take Vanessa away.
After the two women left, Connor began to plan his revenge on the Yaeger family.
After all, the kidnapping of Chelsea had crossed Connor's bottom line, so he would never let the Yaeger family off now.
However, because of the close relationship between the Yaeger family and the Gomez family, Connor could not use the normal method to take revenge on them. He had to think of a more suitable way to take revenge.
..
At the same time.
Charis had been trying to contact Mike for the entire night, but she had not been able to contact him, so she sent someone to the warehouse early the next morning to take a look.
After Charis learned that Mike and the others were dead, she hurriedly ran to the courtyard in front of the Yaeger family villa.
"Grandfather, something bad has happened!"
At this moment, Styrmir was doing some morning exercises.
When Styrmir heard this, he slowly stopped what he was doing, then turned to look at Charis and asked, "What's the matter? Why are you so flustered?"
"Grandpa, I just got someone to take a look at the warehouse. Mike and the others are already dead. Connor has also disappeared."
Charis hurriedly said,
"What?"
Styrmir's expression changed when he heard this. He quickly walked up to Charis and said in a low voice, "Didn't you tell me yesterday that Connor has been controlled by your people? How could she have been rescued?"
"I'm not sure what exactly happened, but Connor has indeed been taken away…"
Charis replied helplessly.
"..."
Styrmir looked at the ugly expression on Charis's face and asked in a low voice, "Does Connor know that it was our Yaeger family who made a move?"
"He should know…"
Charis said helplessly.
"Sigh…"
Styrmir couldn't help but sigh when he heard Charis's words. He then said in a low voice, "Charis, you've really disappointed me. If I had known earlier that you were going to attack Connor, I would not have agreed at all!"
"Grandpa, I already know my mistake, but I didn't expect Connor to be so capable. He was already captured, but he managed to get out of it!"
Charis was also very regretful, thinking that she should not have acted on her own.
"..."
Styrmir stood there and thought for two seconds, then said in a low voice, "However, things should not be as bad as you imagine…"
"Grandpa, what do you mean?"
Charis asked Styrmir in confusion.
"Although Connor already knows that it was our Yaeger family who did it, no matter what, our Yaeger family has some foundation in Yarlford for so many years. Moreover, we have a relationship with the Gomez family. Therefore, even if Connor knows that it was us who did it, I don't think he will take revenge on us openly."
Styrmir analyzed in a low voice.
"Special means?
The expression on Charis's face was a little strange.
"That's right, just like how you dealt with Connor!"
Styrmir nodded and continued, "Go and inform everyone in the Yaeger family now. From today onwards, as long as they go out, they must bring bodyguards with them."
"Understood. I'll go inform him now!"
Charis hurriedly agreed and then turned to leave.
Styrmir hesitated for two seconds, then took out his phone and made a call.
"Ding, ding, ding…"
The phone rang twice before the other party picked up.
"Master Luanne, our Yaeger family might have encountered some trouble. I wonder if you have time? I'll have to trouble you to come back and stay with us for a few days…" Styrmir said respectfully after the other party picked up the phone.
"Mr. Yarger, your words are too polite. I happen to have something to deal with in Yarlford. When the time comes, I'll choose to stay with family!"
The person on the other end of the phone replied with a smile.
"Good, good, good. That's great. Master Luanne, when are you coming over? I'll get someone to pick you up!"
Styrmir said excitedly.
"In two days!"
"Alright, I got it!"
Styrmir hung up the phone.
Although Styrmir and Charis were still very calm, he was actually a little worried about Connor's revenge. After all, he knew that Connor was a Black-rank fighter. If he really took revenge on the Yaeger family, they might not even have the chance to fight back.
That was why Styrmir had called the person on the other end of the phone. The person on the other end was also a Black-rank fighter. He had worked with Styrmir a few times before, and his strength was very terrifying.
Styrmir was planning to invite this Black-rank back to the Yaeger family to protect them.
As for Yamino Gomez, Styrmir did not contact him at all and did not tell him about this matter. The reason was very simple: Yamino had already informed him not to deal with Connor for the time being, and Charis's decision had already gone against Yamino's wishes. Therefore, if Yamino knew about this, not only would he not help, but he would also blame Styrmir for not disciplining Charis properly.
At that time, things would become troublesome.
…
After Connor sent Vanessa and Chelsea away, he didn't rush to take revenge on the Yaeger family.
The reason was very simple: Mason Yaeger knew that Connor would definitely take revenge on him after the previous failure, so the Yaeger family must be in a highly nervous state now. Connor had no chance to attack them at all.
Connor planned to wait for the Yaeger family to let down their guard before making a move.
Meanwhile, the construction company that Queta had hired in Newtown had finally arrived in Yarlford. Stormbound Corporation's first real estate project had officially begun.
Before the construction started, Connor specially held a foundation laying ceremony.
However, due to the power of the Gomez family and the Yaeger family in Yarlford, there were very few guests attending the groundbreaking ceremony.
However, Connor didn't really care about these things now; after all, if he really wanted more important guests, he could call Yuna Winston over. Those people in Yarlford may not bother humoring Connor, but they would definitely allow Yuna to do what she wanted.
However, Connor felt that this was a little superfluous because he was doing real estate to deal with the Gomez family, not to make money.
After the ceremony, the project officially started.

chapters.title: Chapter 1724: Acquiring the Companies
chapters.content:
Chapter 1724: Acquiring the Companies
The Yaeger family had been more well-behaved recently and did not continue to deal with Connor, so the progress of the project was relatively smooth.
When Connor chatted with Chelsea the last time, she told him that if he really wanted to deal with the Gomez family, he would not only need to set up a real estate company, but he would also need to start from other industries. If he did all this, he could really cut off the Gomez family's source of income.
Once the Gomez family lost the financial support of these companies, it would be very easy to destroy them. Otherwise, even if Connor managed to become the largest real estate company in Oprana, he would not be able to shake the foundation of the Gomez family.
Connor felt that Chelsea's suggestion was very good, so he began to ask Queta to find some good pharmaceutical companies and car companies in Yarlford.
Now Connor's idea was very simple. If the manufacturing industry such as pharmaceutical companies and auto companies started from scratch, it would definitely be very troublesome. Moreover, there were still many things that Connor was not clear about, so Connor planned to directly acquire them and then expand the scale of the company.
As for the Yaeger family, Connor had no plans to make a move on the Yaeger family for the time being. He was waiting for a suitable opportunity to make a move.
…
In the blink of an eye, a month passed.
This month was considered very peaceful for Connor. He basically spent most of his time in the office in Stormbound Tower.
Rachel Wallace seemed to still be in York with her grandfather, so she had not returned.
At this time, Connor, who was playing with his phone in the office, suddenly heard a knock on the door.
"Please come in!"
Connor put away his phone and shouted.
Queta walked into Connor's office in a black professional dress and high heels.
"What's wrong? Did something come up?"
Connor asked.
"Mr. McDonald, didn't you ask me to sort out the information of the local manufacturing companies in Yarlford? I've been sorting it out the past few days. At present, these five companies are suitable for our company to acquire, and they are willing to sell them to us. You can take a look at their information!"
Queta passed the documents to Connor as she spoke.
Connor took the information that Queta handed over and flipped through. He found that these companies were basically in a state of bankruptcy due to poor management, but their business scopes were still very wide, and they were very suitable for Connor to acquire.
"If I buy all these companies and give you enough capital, how long do you think it will take for them to develop into the top three large groups in the industry?" Connor asked.
"I can't guarantee you how long it will take, but as long as there are sufficient funds, I believe that it won't take long for them to develop into the three major corporations. After all, these companies themselves don't have any problems," Queta replied.
"Alright, I'm relieved to hear that. Go and talk to these companies about the acquisition!"
Connor said happily.
"Mr. McDonald, I've been in contact with this company, but they seem to want to discuss the acquisition with you! Personally," Queta said helplessly.
"They want to talk to me about the acquisition?"
When Connor heard Queta's words, his expression was a little puzzled. He frowned and said, "Most of the matters in our company are up to you. What's the difference between talking to me or talking to you?"
"I don't know what these people are thinking either. In any case, they just want to talk to you personally, Mr. McDonald…"
"..."
Connor hesitated for two seconds before saying, "Alright, since these people want to talk to me, then I'll treat them to a meal. When the time comes, call these people over. I'll talk to them all at once…"
"All at once?"
Queta asked in surprise.
"That's right. I don't have time to see them one by one, so I might as well talk to them directly. When the time comes, I'll buy all five companies in one go, then I won't have to worry…"
Connor said with a smile.
"Then…Alright then…"
Queta nodded helplessly. "Mr. McDonald, when do you plan to meet these people?"
Connor thought for a moment and said, "Let's do it tonight since I happen to be free then!"
"Alright, I'll call these people now!"
Queta stood up and left after saying that.
Meanwhile, Connor picked up his phone and continued to play some games on it.
…
It was past seven in the evening.
When it was time to meet the bosses of the five companies, Connor and Queta drove straight to the most famous five-star hotel in Yarlford.
"We want to buy their company, but we have to treat them to a meal, and it's in such an expensive restaurant…"
Connor curled his lips slightly after getting out of the car. The expression on his face seemed to be a little dissatisfied.
Queta smiled helplessly. She said, "Mr. McDonald, you might not know this, but although these companies are on the verge of bankruptcy, because their technology is still very mature and they have specialized factories, they are very popular in the market. Many large enterprises and even international groups have plans to acquire them..."
"Since they're about to close down, it means that they must be very short of money now. So as long as we pay more than others, they will definitely sell the company to us…"
Connor said confidently.
"..."
Queta looked worried when she heard Connor's words, but she didn't say anything.
Because Queta had been in contact with the bosses of these companies during this period of time, she knew in her heart that it was not easy to acquire these five companies. Connor had never been in contact with these people, so he naturally thought things would be so simple.
A few minutes later, Connor and Queta entered the hotel room.
However, what Connor never expected was that none of the CEOs of these five companies showed up. At this moment, there was no one in the private room.
"Did the two of us enter the wrong room?"
Connor frowned.
"That shouldn't be the case. Every time I eat with a client, I'll be in this private room. There's no way I'll go wrong…"
Queta hurriedly shook her head.
"Did you get the time wrong?"
Connor continued to ask.
"That's impossible. I sent them a text message saying that we'll have a meal at eight o'clock tonight!"
As Queta spoke, she took out her phone to confirm this. She found that there was no problem with the time and place.
Connor didn't say much when he heard Queta's words. Instead, he took out his phone and looked at the time. He found that there was less than half an hour left before 8 o'clock, so he said to Queta, "It should be because those people haven't come yet. Let's wait a little longer!"

chapters.title: Chapter 1725: A Familiar Stranger
chapters.content:
Chapter 1725: A Familiar Stranger
"Alright…!"
Queta nodded helplessly, then sat on the chair and waited.
In the blink of an eye, half an hour had passed.
It was already past eight in the evening, but none of the five bosses came.
Connor faintly felt that something was wrong, so he frowned and asked, "Queta, what's with these people? Do they really want to sell their company?"
"Well, Mr. McDonald, I'll call these five people now and ask them what they mean!"
Queta hurriedly turned to Connor and took out her phone to call them.
"Hello, President Wendon, I'm already at the Emperor Hotel. Why aren't you here yet?" Queta asked immediately after the other party picked up the call.
"Miss Juve, I'm really sorry. I won't be able to attend today's dinner…" President Wendon muttered.
"You're not coming? Why? Didn't you want to talk to our company's boss about the acquisition?" Queta asked in confusion.
"Miss Juve, you just called me this afternoon, but after that our company was acquired by someone. So even if I go, I can't change anything!"
President Wendon explained.
"Your company has been acquired? By whom?"
Queta's expression became even more puzzled when she heard this.
"It was bought by the Yaeger Group. The price they offered was much higher than yours. It was really difficult for me to reject it, so I signed the contract!"
President Wendon paused for a moment and then continued, "Alright, Miss Juve, I still have something to do, so I'll hang up!"
"Oh…Alright then…"
Queta replied helplessly and then put down the phone.
Connor saw that there was something wrong with Queta's expression and hurriedly asked, "What happened?"
"Luster Pharmaceuticals has been acquired by the Yaeger Group. It happened this afternoon. We were one step slower…" Queta said.
"The Yaeger Group?"
When Connor heard this name, he couldn't help but sneer. Then, he said expressionlessly, "I didn't expect the Yaeger family to be interested in this company…"
"Mr. McDonald, this is my fault!"
Queta blamed herself for her mistake, so her expression was a little ugly.
Connor laughed. "This is not your fault. If I had met up with those people earlier, perhaps none of this would have happened!"
"I'll ask the others what's going on!" Queta said.
"Okay, go ahead."
Connor lightly nodded.
Queta took out her phone and started to call the others. However, they never expected that they would receive the same answer. These five companies had been acquired by someone this afternoon. What was even more unexpected was that the Yaeger family had acquired all five companies.
"If it was just one company that was taken away by the Yaeger family, I might think it was a coincidence. But the fact is that all five of these companies were taken away by the Yaeger family. This means that they are deliberately targeting us!"
Connor thought.
"That's right. Isn't the Yaeger family getting a little too brave? Didn't we just snatch a piece of land from them? Do they have to target us like this?" Queta said with a frown.
"This is not as simple as just a piece of land. I originally planned to let them continue to run around for a couple more days, but I didn't expect them to be so ungrateful. I guess I'll have to go have a good talk with them!"
Connor said expressionlessly.
Queta couldn't help but be stunned when she heard his words. Then, she asked in confusion, "Mr. McDonald, what do you mean?"
"You don't have to know. In any case, these five companies will soon be ours!" Connor replied indifferently, then stood up and walked out of the private room.
A moment later, Connor and Queta walked out of the hotel.
Connor asked Queta to go back alone while he took out his phone and dialed Yama's number.
"I'm in front of the Emperor Hotel now. Come with me on an errand!"
Connor muttered.
"Alright, I'll go over now!" Yama hung up the phone after agreeing.
Connor stood at the entrance of the hotel and waited quietly.
However, a few minutes later, Connor suddenly heard a commotion. He instinctively turned around and saw a large group of young men and women walking out of the hotel. Moreover, these people seemed to be cursing all the time, as if there was some conflict.
A few seconds later, the group of people walked out of the hotel.
Connor did not want to provoke such people, so he took the initiative to make way for this group of people.
However, Connor never expected that this group of people would start punching and kicking a girl after leaving the hotel.
The girl looked very pitiful as she lay on the ground. She hugged her head with both hands and did not dare to make a sound.
"Who told you to seduce my husband?!"
"Harlot, if you dare to seduce my husband again, I'll smash your face…"
"B*tch!"
Everyone shouted as they fought.
At this moment, a man in a bathrobe rushed out of the hotel. However, after seeing the woman beaten up like this, he chose to remain silent and did not go up to stop her.
Connor stood at the side and watched the commotion quietly. Although he didn't know what was going on, just listening to what these people were saying, Connor knew that the first wife had caught someone's mistress.
Although the girl who was beaten up was very pitiful, Connor did not have any intention of meddling in other people's business. After all, this had nothing to do with him.
After a long time, these people finally finished venting their anger and left. Even the robed man left with them, leaving the girl lying on the ground.
The girl lay there for a long time before she slowly stood up. Then, she checked her body and turned around to leave.
However, the moment the girl turned around, Connor and the girl looked at each other and were stunned.
"Connor?"
The girl shouted in disbelief.
"I didn't expect it to be you," Connor replied indifferently.
"What a coincidence. You're also in Yarlford?"
The girl walked up to Connor as she spoke, but she seemed to have thought of something and hurriedly took two steps back.

chapters.title: Chapter 1726: I Walked Right In!
chapters.content:
Chapter 1726: I Walked Right In!
Connor looked at the girl in front of him, feeling very uncomfortable.
This girl was none other than his ex-girlfriend at Porthampton University, Mandy.
Originally, Connor thought that Mandy would completely disappear from his life, but he never expected to meet this woman again.
This woman had an extraordinary meaning to Connor. If Mandy had not dumped him, he would not have gotten Steven Lee's inheritance.
To a certain extent, Mandy was the one who made Connor who he was today.
"Long time no see. Why are you in Yarlford?"
Connor asked.
"I'm here with a friend…"
Mandy explained.
"I didn't expect you to still not change your personality even after so many years. Sometimes, it's not wrong for a woman to be materialistic, but you have to pay attention to the means to obtain material things!"
Connor said.
After Mandy heard Connor's words, she couldn't help but smile bitterly. Then, she said lightly, "Actually, I'm feeling quite regretful now…"
"Regret what?"
Connor asked.
Mandy bit her lip and said, "I regret breaking up with you back then. If I hadn't broken up with you, I wouldn't be living such a miserable life now…"
"Whether you break up with me or not has nothing to do with your current life. All of this is the result of your own choices. The only reason you regret it is that you know I'm rich. If I was still the poor loser from back then, you would still look down on me and choose to leave me!"
Connor hit the nail on the head.
"..."
Mandy was speechless.
However, at this moment, Yama walked over from afar.
"The person I've been waiting for is here."
Connor didn't want to continue chatting with Mandy, so he walked straight to Yama.
"Connor, you can't help me. I know you're very rich now. As long as you're willing to help me, I'll do anything you want."
Mandy shouted.
Connor heard her words and slowly stopped. Then, he turned his head to look at her and said expressionlessly, "Don't you think it's ridiculous for you to say this? You've never f*cking loved me. You've always been using me, yet now you have the nerve to say that you've loved me. How can you be so shameless?"
Mandy was dumbfounded. For a moment, she did not know how to refute Connor.
Connor didn't waste any time and brought Yama into the car.
After getting into the car, Yama did not seem to care about Mandy at all. Instead, he asked, "What errand are you carrying out?"
"I'm going to the Yaeger family to have a good chat with them!"
Connor replied indifferently.
"..."
Yama didn't say anything else.
…
Half an hour later, Connor parked the car at the entrance of the Yaeger family villa.
Today was Charis's birthday, so all the higher-ups of the Yaeger family gathered in the Yaeger family villa to celebrate.
As the main character of the day, Charis was in a good mood. She had just snatched those five companies from Connor's hands and thought that she'd more or less avenged her own shortcomings.=.
Of course, the Yaeger family might have long forgotten that Connor wanted to take revenge on them.
Connor had not reacted for such a long time, so in the eyes of these people, Connor had already admitted defeat. They thought that he did not dare to attack them at all, so the bodyguards of the Yaeger family also let down their guard.
After Connor parked the car, he pointed at the two bodyguards at the entrance of the villa and asked Yama, "There shouldn't be any problems dealing with these two, right?"
"No problem!"
Yama nodded gently, then directly pushed open the car door and got out.
A few seconds later, Yama finished off the two bodyguards without a sound.
Connor also got out of the car and said to Yama, "Wait for me here!"
"Understood!"
Yama hurriedly nodded.
Connor walked into the villa.
At this moment, the Yaeger family did not seem to know what was happening outside.
At this moment, a beautiful young woman said, "Charis, it's time for us to make a wish and blow out the candles!"
"That's right, Charis hasn't made a wish yet. Hurry up and put the candle in!"
Styrmir also called out with a smile.
After everyone heard this, they began to get busy. Some turned off the lights and others lit the candles.
A few minutes later, the villa that was originally brightly lit suddenly turned dark. Only the flickering flames of candles could be seen.
Charis slowly closed her eyes, then put her palms together in front of her chest and began to make a wish.
After a while, Charis finished her wish and blew out all the candles on the cake.
After the candles were blown out, everyone hurriedly turned on the lights in the room.
However, the moment the lights were turned on, Charis froze on the spot. She stared at Connor, who was standing in front of the cake. At this moment, she looked like she had seen a ghost.
"You... Why are you here?"
Charis pointed at Connor and shouted in disbelief.
"So today is your birthday. Happy birthday!"
Connor replied with a smile.
The people of the Yaeger family looked at Connor with very puzzled expressions because other than Charis, no one else in the Yaeger family had seen Connor.
At this moment, they naturally did not know his identity.
"Who is this person?"
"How did he get in?"
Everyone began to discuss in low voices.
"Who are you? How did you enter our Yaeger family?"
A middle-aged man stepped forward and questioned Connor with a serious expression.
"I walked right in!"
Connor said as he picked up the knife and prepared to cut a piece of cake for himself.
At this moment, Charis was obviously a little scared silly. She stood on the spot, trembling all over, not daring to say a word.
"You walked in? What do you want? Do you think you can enter our Yaeger family as you please?" the middle-aged man shouted.
"Is there anything different about your Yaeger family that's so special? I can come in if I want to…" Connor said lightly.
"Someone come! Hurry up and catch this person…"
The middle-aged man shouted at the top of his lungs.
"Alright, stop shouting…"
Connor sat on the top of the chair and interrupted the middle-aged man, then said expressionlessly, "The bodyguards outside your Yaeger family have been taken care of by me, so no matter how much you shout, no one will come over!"
"You... Who exactly are you?"
The middle-aged man's expression was somewhat panicked as he asked in a low voice.
"I'm here to take your lives!"
Connor said with a smile.
Styrmir, who had been silent all this time, suddenly asked, "Are you an assassin?"

chapters.title: Chapter 1727: Misunderstanding?
chapters.content:
Chapter 1727: Misunderstanding?
"You could say that."
Connor nodded lightly.
"Young man, don't think that you can do whatever you want in our Yaeger family just because you can deal with those bodyguards outside. I advise you to get out of our villa now, or I'll make you pay a painful price!"
Styrmir's expression was still calm as he spoke to Connor.
"Pay a painful price?"
Connor couldn't help but sneer when he heard Styrmir's words. Then, he said indifferently, "If you say that, I'm a little curious. What price can your Yaeger family make me pay?"
At this moment, Charis's expression was abnormally nervous, and her body was trembling non-stop. She originally wanted to tell everyone who this was, but perhaps because she was too shocked just now, she could not speak at all.
"Bang!"
Styrmir suddenly slammed the table and shouted, "Who exactly are you? What do you want to do by coming to our Yaeger family?"
"Back then, it was your Yaeger family who kidnapped my friend and planned to kill me. Then, you snatched five companies that were on the verge of bankruptcy from my company. Now, you're asking me who I am?" Connor replied indifferently.
Styrmir asked in disbelief, "Are you Connor McDonald?"
"Grandpa, this is Connor McDonald!" Charis hurriedly shouted.
Everyone from the Yaeger family quietened down after hearing Charis's words. They stared at Connor with disbelief.
They had heard a lot about Connor during this period of time. Some time ago, because of this Connor guy, they all had to bring bodyguards wherever they went. Only in the past few days did their nervousness ease a little.
No one had expected that Connor would actually swagger into their villa alone when they thought that he might have given up on taking revenge!
"Connor? It really is you!"
Styrmir looked at his face with anger.
The other members of the Yaeger family were not as calm as Styrmir. They had more or less heard about Connor, so they looked at him with fear.
"Why wouldn't it be me?" Connor asked Styrmir with a smile as he sat on the chair and ate the cake.
Styrmir hesitated for a moment before asking in a low voice, "What do you want to do in our Yaeger family?"
"Hehe, shouldn't you already know?"
Connor smiled and glanced at the Yaeger family members who had already stood up. He said lightly, "Why are you all so nervous? Weren't you all happy when I wasn't around just now? Hurry up and sit down. Don't let me disturb your festivities…"
Although the Yaeger family members were very afraid of Connor, they chose to sit on the spot after hearing his words.
Styrmir sized up Connor and muttered, "Connor, I know that you might have some misunderstandings with our Yaeger family. Since you're here today, we can take this opportunity to resolve all the misunderstandings!"
"Misunderstandings?" Connor sneered, then said lightly, "You really have the nerve to say that? Is the matter between me and the Yaeger family as simple as a misunderstanding?"
"Connor, what do you want?"
Charis finally couldn't take it anymore. She glared at Connor with an excited expression.
No matter what, the Yaeger family was one of the four great families in Yarlford. Other than the Gomez family, no other family dared to treat the Yaeger family with such an arrogant attitude.
However, at this moment, Connor's attitude was abnormally arrogant, as if he did not take the Yaeger family members seriously at all.
Charis had been pampered since she was young, so she naturally could not control the emotions in his heart at this moment.
Although Styrmir's expression was calm, he was actually thinking about how to call for reinforcements.
After all, Master Luanne, whom Styrmir had invited over a while ago, had just left the Yaeger family yesterday, and Connor showed up here tonight. It was too much of a coincidence.
Styrmir originally thought that Connor was deliberately avoiding Master Luanne so he could attack the Yaeger family, but in fact, Connor didn't think that much about this; he didn't even know that the Yaeger family was hiding a Black-ranked fighter.
All of this was just a coincidence.
"What do I want to do?"
Connor smiled faintly, then said expressionlessly, "Your Yaeger family had someone kidnap my friend. If it weren't for my luck, I might have died long ago. How do you think we should settle this score?"
"When did our Yaeger family kidnap you? Do you have any evidence?"
Styrmir hurriedly stood up and shouted.
At the same time, he had already used his eyes to signal the people around him to call for Master Luanne.
At this moment, Styrmir wanted to buy some time.
"Do you still need evidence for this kind of thing? Back then, the kidnappers personally admitted that it was your Yaeger family who paid them to do it!"
Connor replied calmly while eating the dishes on the table.
"Does the kidnapper admit that it was our Yaeger family who did it? Can't it be that someone else wants to frame our Yaeger family?"
Styrmir hurriedly continued.
"Framed your Yaeger family?"
Connor couldn't help but sneer when he heard Styrmir's words. Then, he said indifferently, "Your Yaeger family is one of the four great families of Yarlford. Who has the guts to frame you?"
"Perhaps Mr. McDonald, you directed the incident and acted it out yourself. You just wanted an excuse to attack our Yaeger family!" Styrmir said coldly.
Connor looked at Styrmir with disdain and said, "If I really wanted to attack your Yaeger family, I would not need any reason…"
"You…"
Styrmir glared at Connor with an angry expression. He didn't expect Connor to be so arrogant.
"Alright, since the Yaeger family doesn't admit to the kidnapping, how do you plan to explain the fact that the Yaeger family snatched the company that Stormbound Corporation was about to acquire today? Are you going to tell me that you guys didn't do this?"
Connor asked.
Styrmir took a deep breath and said calmly, "Mr. McDonald, this incident was indeed done by our Yaeger family, but this is just a normal competition. Didn't you also snatch a piece of land from our Yaeger family back then? This is how business works. Whoever pays more money and has more ability will earn money. Do you not allow our Yaeger family to compete with your Stormbound Corporation?"

chapters.title: Chapter 1728: Yaeger Family's Reinforcements
chapters.content:
Chapter 1728: Yaeger Family's Reinforcements
"What you said just now was very good. Whoever is more capable can earn money. I agree with you very much!" Connor said with a smile.
Styrmir hesitated for a moment and muttered, "Mr. McDonald, since you've already said that, I'll be frank with you. Today is my granddaughter's birthday, and I don't want to have any conflict with you, so please leave!"
"Why are you in such a hurry for me to leave?"
Connor smiled.
"The matter has already been explained clearly. What else do you want?"
Charis frowned and shouted at Connor angrily.
Connor put down the wine glass in his hand. "I want your Yaeger family to pay the price!" he said calmly.
"Pay the price?"
The expression on Charis's face was a little puzzled.
At this moment, the expressions on the faces of the Yaeger family members were a little nervous. After all, they had heard a lot about Connor. At this moment, these people of the Yaeger family did not know what he was planning to do.
"Mr. McDonald, didn't I explain everything clearly to you just now?" Styrmir asked with a doubtful tone.
"The problem has been explained clearly, but I didn't come here today to listen to you explain these things!" Connor said lightly.
"Then what do you want to do?"
Styrmir asked with a frown.
"The Yaeger family kidnapping my friend is already a capital offense, but I wasn't in a hurry to settle the score with you. I didn't expect you to not know how to restrain yourselves and steal business from our Stormbound Corporation."
Connor paused for a moment and then continued, "First of all, your Yaeger family must give the five companies that you acquired to Stormbound Corporation. Secondly, from today onwards, your Yaeger family will be my lapdogs. You will do whatever I ask you to do. If you dare to disobey me or have any other thoughts, you will bear the consequences!"
"Bang!"
Styrmir slammed the table when he heard Zhang's words. Then, he widened his eyes and shouted, "Connor, aren't you being a little too arrogant? What do you take our Yaeger family for?"
"Didn't I say it just now? From now on, your Yaeger family will be my lapdogs!"
Connor replied calmly.
"Our Yaeger family has been in Yarlford for so many years, but we have never been humiliated like this!" Styrmir shouted with his eyes wide open.
"I'll give you some time to think about it. If you don't agree with my suggestion just now, then I will use other methods to make you agree!"
After saying this, Connor lowered his head and began to eat.
Styrmir looked at Connor angrily, but he didn't reject him directly because he was trying to buy time for Master Luanne.
Everyone from the Yaeger family had their heads lowered, deep in thought. The originally bustling Yaeger family villa suddenly quieted down, and the atmosphere was unusually strange.
At this moment, a commotion suddenly came from the door.
A large group of people rushed towards the Yaeger family's villa.
Styrmir looked excited when he saw the large group of people because he knew that his reinforcements had arrived.
"Connor, your death date has arrived. Today, you walked right into the trap!"
Styrmir shouted excitedly.
Connor slowly raised his head and looked at Styrmir, then said indifferently, " Are you sure it's my death date?"
"You're still stubborn even after you're dead. I'll see if you can still be so arrogant later!"
Styrmir walked to the door of the villa after saying that.
However, before the Yaeger family could leave the villa, Yama blocked Styrmir and the others and muttered, "Mr. McDonald won't let you leave, so you can't leave!"
A young man from the Yaeger family saw that his reinforcements had arrived and instantly became a little arrogant. He shouted, "Who do you think you are? This is our Yaeger family. It's not up to someone like you to say…"
Yama looked at the young man indifferently, then slapped the young man's face.
The young man's body was instantly sent flying into the wall.
He spat out a mouthful of blood. His body twitched twice before he completely stopped moving.
One had to know that Yama was not Connor. When Connor attacked, he usually did not like to take people's lives. However, Yama would readily kill without blinking, befitting of his name.
"Laurie, are you alright?"
A beautiful young woman saw her son being sent flying by Yama's slap and quickly ran to the young man's side. A few seconds later, the woman burst into tears.
No one had expected that Yama's slap would actually kill this young man.
Even Styrmir and Charis were in disbelief.
"Whoever dares to step out of this door today will end up like that person!"
Yama warned the Yaeger family coldly.
The Yaeger family did not realize the seriousness of the situation when they faced Connor previously. However, they only realized now that Connor had every intention of settling the score with them today.
Only now did Charis realize what a terrifying opponent she had provoked. She even regretted taking the initiative to deal with Connor.
"I suggest that you all sit back down honestly. Yama is different from me. He's not so easy to talk to!"
Connor said to the Yaeger family while eating.
Styrmir hesitated for two seconds and then shouted in a low voice, "Let's go back!"
Everyone in the Yaeger family was just an ordinary person. They had no way to deal with someone like Yama, so they could only choose to obey.
On the other side, the Yaeger family's reinforcements had already rushed to the entrance of the villa.
These reinforcements were all Master Luanne's disciples, and they were all martial artists. Most of them were below Yellow rank.
Connor's expression was somewhat disdainful after seeing these people because it was basically impossible for them to deal with Yama.
Styrmir stared nervously at the entrance of the villa. He knew that the people outside would be the ones who would make it out alive today.
One of the young men leading the way was about to rush into the villa, but Yama reached out his hand to stop the young man and said expressionlessly, "Without Mr. McDonald's permission, no one is allowed to enter this villa!"
The young man raised his head and looked at Yama. Then, he said disdainfully, "Who do you think you are? Do you know who I am?"

chapters.title: Chapter 1729: Let's Attack Together!
chapters.content:
Chapter 1729: Let's Attack Together!
"I don't know!"
Yama shook his head at the young man.
"I'm the disciple of Master Cyril Luanne!. If you don't want to die, then get lost! I'm not in the mood to talk to you now!" the young man shouted at Yama arrogantly.
"Without Mr. McDonald's permission, none of you can enter!"
Yama repeated like a robot.
"Is there something wrong with your brain? Didn't you hear what I just said?"
As the young man spoke, he reached out his hand and pulled at Yama's clothes, as if he was planning to pull Yama to the side.
However, the moment the young man stretched out his hand, Yama grabbed his wrist.
It was then that the young man finally realized that something was wrong. Yama's reaction speed was obviously not the same as a normal person.
"Are you a martial artist too?"
The young man asked Yama with his eyes wide open.
However, in the next second, Yama threw the young man in front of him away.
The young man glided for more than ten meters in the air before he finally crashed heavily onto the ground.
Seeing this scene, everyone from the Yaeger family was once again dumbfounded.
This young man weighed 70 to 80 kilograms. How terrifying was this man's strength to throw him over a dozen meters into the air? The ordinary people of the Yaeger family simply did not dare to think about it!
Connor, on the other hand, had a calm expression on his face as he ate quietly.
This time, Connor came to the Yaeger family not only to take revenge on the Yaeger family, but he also planned to use this opportunity to test the true strength of Yama.
Although Connor already knew that Yama was very strong, he still didn't know exactly how strong he was.
The young man who was thrown out by Yama struggled on the ground for a while before standing up. After all, this young man was not an ordinary person. He would not die just by being thrown like that.
The young man's eyes were filled with anger. After a low growl, he rushed towards Yama.
A moment later, the young man had already arrived in front of Yama.
Yama's eyes flashed with disdain. He slowly raised his right hand and punched out.
"Bang!"
His fist pierced through the young man's body.
The young man spat out a mouthful of blood and slowly closed his eyes.
For a moment, the entire Yaeger family villa fell silent again.
This was the second person that Yama had killed.
The rest of Master Luanne's disciples stared at Yama with their eyes wide open. Their faces were filled with disbelief and their hearts were filled with shock.
That young man was a true Golden class advanced fighter, and among Master Luanne's disciples, he was considered one of the best. However, no one expected this young man to be so weak when facing Yama.
With just one punch, his body was pierced through!
"Could this person be a Black-rank?"
"His strength is probably even more terrifying than a Black-rank!"
"How is that possible? This person's strength was terrifying, right?"
Master Luanne's disciples couldn't help but whisper among themselves.
However, at this moment, a disciple suddenly shouted, "Don't be afraid, so what if he's a Black-rank? We have so many people here. I don't believe that this person can deal with so many of us at the same time. Master is about to arrive. We have to buy some time for him!"
Soon, the other disciples responded.
"That's right, even if he's a Black-rank, he's no match for so many of us!"
Nearly twenty martial artists seemed to have gone mad as they rushed towards Yama.
Obviously, these martial artists felt that they had the advantage in numbers, so even though Yama had displayed a very terrifying strength just now, they were still not afraid.
More importantly, they were working for the Yaeger family.
The Yaeger family was one of the top families in Yarlford. If they could handle this matter well, they would definitely be recognized by them. At that time, they might even be able to become the bodyguards of the Yaeger family. This was a very good motivator to them.
At this time, Connor also walked to the entrance of the villa with a glass of wine in his hand, looking at Yama with interest.
Everyone stood beside Connor, their eyes filled with fear. They couldn't understand why he was still so calm at this moment.
Even someone like Styrmir could not help but feel a trace of fear.
He had heard many things about Connor before, but he felt that those rumors probably weren't true. After all, Connor was only a 20-year-old youth; Styrmir felt that a young man definitely could not have the temperament and wisdom as the rumors said. A large part of those rumors were probably exaggerated.
But now, Styrmir realized that those things were not exaggerated at all. Although Connor was young, he was very mature.
Yama's expression was a little disdainful when facing so many people attacking him at the same time. Then, he exerted strength with his right foot and charged into the crowd.
There was a loud bang as Yama punched the young man in front of him again.
Connor realized that Yama's fighting style was similar to his own, relying on the simplest fist techniques.
However, Connor was relying on the power of the Seven Stars Big Dipper Fist, while Yama was completely relying on his own physical strength.
When Master Luanne's disciples saw their companions die in the hands of Yama, their eyes turned red, and they rushed towards him.
Connor had to admit that he admired these people. After all, if it were anyone else, they would have been scared away by Yama. However, these people did not seem to have any intention of escaping. They rushed towards Yama while shouting for revenge for their companions.
"Yama, these people have no enmity with us."
Connor also felt that Yama was too cruel just now. The purpose of their visit today was to deal with the Yaeger family, not to kill them. Therefore, Connor wanted to remind Yama to control his strength and not to continue killing.
After hearing Connor's words, Yama turned his head and looked at Connor, then muttered, "Alright, I got it!"
After saying this, Yama rushed into the crowd again.
This time, Yama didn't choose to use his full strength when facing these people, but even so, no one could resist Yama's fist techniques.
In just a few seconds, more than half of the people fell to the ground, howling in pain.

chapters.title: Chapter 1730: Master Luanne Arrives
chapters.content:
Chapter 1730: Master Luanne Arrives
When Styrmir, Charis, and the others saw this scene, they all looked shocked.
They felt that Yama's strength was too terrifying.
"Grandpa, what should we do now?"
Charis asked Styrmir with trembling lips.
"We can only wait for Master Luanne to hurry over. Otherwise, no one will be able to stop this person…" Styrmir said helplessly.
"You actually dared to kill my disciple. Today, I will definitely make you pay with blood!"
However, at this moment, an angry roar suddenly came from the villa's entrance.
When everyone heard this, they looked up at the entrance of the Yaeger family villa and saw a middle-aged man rushing towards Yama.
"Master Luanne has finally appeared…"
Styrmir looked excited when he saw the middle-aged man.
This man was very likely the last hope of the Yaeger family.
When Connor saw this middle-aged man, his expression was a little strange because he could feel that this man's aura was very terrifying. He might even be an ancient martial arts grandmaster.
"I didn't expect the Yaeger family to have such an expert!" Connor couldn't help but think. Then, he walked to Yama and said to him, "This person seems to be very strong. Will you have any problems?"
Yama replied indifferently.
"Probably not!"
"That's good!"
Connor nodded lightly and didn't say anything else.
Since Yama said that there would be no problems, then Connor naturally would not interfere.
Soon, the middle-aged man arrived in front of Yama. He shouted with red eyes, "How dare you kill my disciple! Today, I will kill you to avenge him!"
"You probably don't have the ability to kill me!" Yama said expressionlessly.
"Then we'll fight now to see whether I can or not!"
At this moment, Master Luanne didn't seem to have any intention to continue talking nonsense with Yama. After a low growl, he directly rushed towards Yama.
Yama took a deep breath and rushed towards Master Luanne as well.
The Yaeger family members were excited when they saw this scene. Styrmir knew that Cyril Luanne was a Black-rank and was only one step away from becoming a Grandmaster. As long as Yama wasn't a Grandmaster, he wouldn't be able to fight Cyril.
"Boom!"
At this moment, Cyril's fist collided with Yama's fist.
For a moment, it was as if the entire Yaeger family villa trembled slightly. An extremely powerful force erupted from their bodies.
After Connor saw this scene, the expression on his face seemed a little strange.
This was because Connor could feel that the strength of these two people should be above his.
Connor was already a Black-rank beginner, while Yama and Cyril should be around a Black-rank advanced level.
Therefore, Connor was more or less glad that his father had left him Yama, or he might not even be able to deal with the Yaeger family today. If he couldn't even deal with them, then it would be a fool's dream for him to deal with the Gomez family.
After the first exchange of blows between Yama and Cyril, the two of them didn't continue to attack. Instead, they took two steps back.
Cyril sized up Yama and said expressionlessly, "I didn't expect you to be a Black-rank martial artist!"
"I don't know my realm!" Yama replied indifferently.
"I, Cyril Luanne, have not met an opponent like you for a long time. Today, I can fight to my heart's content!"
Cyril, as a Black-rank advanced fighter, had very few opponents who were on par with him. They were all either too weak or were Grandmasters. Fighting these two types of people was not beneficial to Cyril at all.
That was why Cyril was so excited; in the eyes of a Black-rank, meeting an opponent who was on par with them was more fun than getting an ancient martial art manual or a magic treasure.
And after Connor heard what Cyril said, he also knew that Yama's true realm was likely around Black-rank advanced-level.
This was a good thing for Connor. after all, having such a powerful bodyguard could save him a lot of trouble.
"Continue!"
At this moment, Cyril roared again and rushed towards Yama.
Connor found that Cyril's body seemed to have undergone some changes. His originally yellow skin was now a terrifying blood-red color. Connor felt that he could see the blood flowing in Cyril's body.
Cyril must have used some ancient martial arts secret method to strengthen his body.
However, Yama didn't react. He was still calmly waiting for Cyril to rush over.
Following a series of loud bangs, Cyril and Yama started fighting again.
The two of them punched each other, competing with each other in terms of the toughness of their bodies.
The Yaeger family looked at the scene in front of them. Besides shock, there was also fear on their faces. Many of them had never seen two Black-ranks fight, so they didn't know how terrifying a Black-rank's strength could be.
But now, they had a clear understanding of the situation.
Every time Yama and Cyril fought, they would make violent sounds that didn't sound human at all—they were like the sound of two pieces of steel colliding.
"Bang!"
At this moment, Yama punched Cyril's shoulder.
Cyril also punched Yama's chest.
The two of them retreated almost at the same time.
After stabilizing his body, Cyril adjusted his breathing and looked at Yama from head to toe. Then, he muttered, "I didn't expect that there would be an expert like you in Yarlford! What's your name?"
"Yama!"
Cyril looked at Yama and hesitated for two seconds before rushing forward again.
Because the difference in strength between Yama and Cyril wasn't very big, the two of them were in a stalemate for a very long time.
Connor's expression was actually very calm. He was not worried about Yama at all.
After all, even if Yama was defeated by Cyril, Connor himself could still make a move. If he and Yama attacked together, Cyril would definitely be defeated.

chapters.title: Chapter 1731: I Can't Help You
chapters.content:
Chapter 1731: I Can't Help You
At this moment, the expressions on the Yaeger family members' faces seemed to be a little ugly.
They had never expected that their last hope, Cyril, would be helpless against Yama.
The battle between Yama and Cyril lasted for more than an hour. However, neither side had gained any advantage.
"Today's fight is really enjoyable. Let's continue!"
Cyril shouted excitedly at Yama with red eyes.
Yama looked at Cyril without saying anything.
"There's no need to continue!"
However, at this moment, Connor suddenly shouted.
When the Yaeger family heard Connor's words, they turned to look at him. They were very puzzled, as if they did not understand what Connor meant.
Cyril was stunned when he heard Connor's words. He then looked at Connor expressionlessly.
Connor walked up to Cyril and sized him up. He said in a low voice, "I have seen how strong you are. It's quite difficult to determine the winner between you and Yama right now. However, the purpose of our visit today is not to compete with you, but to settle some personal grudges between me and the Yaeger family. So, why don't we fight another day?"
Connor already knew how strong Yama was. He did not want Yama to continue to waste time with Cyril. If he really wanted to decide the victor between Yama and Cyril, the winner would probably be heavily injured. Therefore, Connor didn't want Yama to continue fighting.
"I'm here today to protect the Yaeger family and avenge my disciple. You want me to stop fighting just because you say so?"
Cyril frowned and asked Connor.
"You must not know what situation you're in right now!"
Connor released the aura in his body as he spoke.
Everyone in the Yaeger family was an ordinary person, so they naturally couldn't sense the aura in Connor's body. However, Cyril could sense it.
"You're a black rank too?"
Cyril stared at Connor in disbelief.
"That's right!"
Connor smiled and nodded, then continued, "Although I'm not an advanced black rank, I'm still a black rank. If I join hands with Yama, you'll lose today, and you might even die in my hands. However, I have no grudges against you, so I don't want to kill you. I just want to settle the conflict between me and the Yaeger family. As long as you leave now, no one will stop you…"
Connor's voice wasn't loud, so only he and Cyril could hear him.
After hesitating for a while, Cyril seemed to understand what Connor meant.
Indeed, Yama couldn't defeat him within a short period of time. However, if Connor also made a move, then Cyril would definitely lose today. After all, Cyril couldn't find anyone else to help him.
Connor's current proposal was beneficial to both of them.
Connor could help Yama save his energy, and Cyril could avoid death.
Cyril and Styrmir had a good relationship. They had worked together many times. However, Cyril was not willing to take the risk with the Yaeger family since his life might be in danger this time.
"Mr. McDonald, how do you plan to settle the matter of this person killing my disciple?"
Cyril hesitated for a moment before asking Connor in a low voice.
"Ten million for a death, two million for injuries!"
Connor said lightly.
"Alright, Mr. McDonald. I shall not bother you any longer. If there's a chance, I'll spar with this person again!"
The reason why Cyril was able to help the Yaeger family was nothing more than money, so Connor chose to use the simplest way to deal with this matter.
As expected, this move was indeed effective.
Cyril readily agreed, then turned around and shouted at the disciples behind him, "Let's go!"
When Styrmir heard Cyril's words, he was instantly dumbfounded. He was in disbelief because he never thought that Cyril would give up on the Yaeger family so easily.
"What are you doing?!"
Charis was also shocked. He shouted at Cyril excitedly.
"You saw the situation just now. It's not that easy to defeat this person. Moreover, my disciples have also suffered heavy casualties today. If we continue to fight, I might also be deeply involved, so I can't help anymore today!"
Cyril was already angry because the Yaeger family had caused him such a big trouble, so he did not want to say anything more at this time. After a few perfunctory words, he led his people out of the villa.
Styrmir and the others were completely dumbfounded when they saw that Cyril had really left.
It was as if no one had expected such an ending.
Originally, the Yaeger family thought that they could rely on Cyril to resist Connor, but who would have thought that Cyril would actually leave after fighting.
Connor turned to look at Styrmir and asked with a smile, "Does the Yaeger family still have any trump cards that you haven't shown yet?"
Styrmir looked angrily at Connor. He had lived for so many years and experienced all kinds of storms, but he was defeated by a young man today.
"Connor, I was the one who kidnapped your friend back then. I was also the one who bought those five companies. I'll take responsibility for what I did. If you have anything to say, come at me."
Charis took a step forward and shouted at Connor with her big watery eyes.
"How could you have done all this without the help of the Yaeger family?"
Connor asked indifferently.
Charis looked at Connor and wanted to say something, but Styrmir reached out and stopped her. Then, he asked Connor in a low voice, "Connor, what do you want?"
"First of all, the Yaeger family needs to return those five companies to me!"
Connor said softly.
"No problem. As long as you let us go today, I can give you all five companies!"
Styrmir nodded.
"Also, from now on, I have the final say in the affairs of your Yaeger family. You will do whatever I tell you to do. If you dare to disobey my orders, I will have Yama destroy your entire Yaeger family!"
Connor continued.
