chapters.title: Chapter 1732: Controlling the Yaeger Family
chapters.content:
Chapter 1732: Controlling the Yaeger Family
It was very obvious that Connor did not really want to get rid of the Yaeger family.
The reason was very simple. The Yaeger family was just a dog by the Gomez family's side.
Even if Connor got rid of the Yaeger family now, the Gomez family would soon nurture a second Yaeger family. This would have little impact on the Gomez family.
Therefore, Connor felt that it was better to have the Yaeger family become his spy. This way, it would be much more convenient for Connor to deal with the Gomez family in the future.
"..."
Styrmir's expression changed when he heard Connor's words.
"Connor, isn't your request a little too much?"
Charis shouted at Connor.
"You have no right to negotiate with me now. You can either agree to my conditions or disappear from this world completely. There are only two paths in front of you now."
Connor said calmly.
"Yamino Gomez will definitely not agree to this. You're courting death by doing this!"
Styrmir gritted his teeth and shouted at Connor.
"No one else will know what happened today!"
Connor said lightly.
"..."
Styrmir looked at Connor and hesitated for two seconds before asking in a low voice, "As long as we listen to you, you will let us off, right?"
"That's right!"
Connor lightly nodded.
"..."
Styrmir took a deep breath and said in a low voice, "Alright, I agree to your request. In the future, we will do whatever you want us to do!"
Under such circumstances, Styrmir had no choice but to lower his head to Connor for the sake of the lives of everyone in the Yaeger family.
"Grandpa, why did you agree to this person's conditions?"
Charis was unhappy as she shouted at Styrmir.
"Do we have any other choice now?"
Styrmir exclaimed in return.
Charis was instantly stunned. She looked extremely dejected.
She knew in her heart that this was all because of her. If she had not been thinking of ways to go against Connor, things would not have come to this.
"Although you've promised me, you're actually thinking about how to deal with me, right?"
Connor asked Styrmir with a smile.
"No..."
Styrmir helplessly shook his head at Connor.
Connor smiled faintly, then took out a pill from his pocket and handed it to Styrmir.
"What is this?"
Styrmir looked at the pill in Connor's hand and asked in confusion.
"Poison!"
Connor replied with a smile.
Everyone from the Yaeger family was stunned when they heard Connor's words.
"Connor, what do you want now? My grandfather has already agreed to your request. Why do you still want my grandfather to take the poison?"
Charis shouted.
"Don't worry, although this is a poison, it won't take your grandfather's life. As long as your grandfather takes the antidote on time every month, then his body won't be affected at all. However, if he can't take the antidote on time, then he will experience unimaginable pain and finally die from torture!"
Connor explained expressionlessly.
"You... You're a demon!"
Charis shouted at Connor with a terrified expression.
"I have no other choice. I can't trust your family 100% now. In order to prevent your family from playing any tricks, I can only choose to use this method to control you. Since you have already agreed to my requests, it shouldn't be a problem for you to take this pill, right?"
Connor asked Styrmir.
Styrmir stared at Connor with his eyes wide open. His face was filled with disbelief. He didn't expect Connor to be so meticulous to the point where he had even prepared poison for him.
"It seems that you have already thought of how to deal with our family!"
Styrmir said with a bitter smile.
"I never wanted to deal with the Yaeger family because there's no strife between your family and me. It's you who provoked me time and time again!"
Connor replied indifferently.
"Connor, is it our family provoking you or are you the one provoking our family? That piece of land originally belonged to the Yaeger family. It was you who suddenly appeared and snatched that piece of land!"
Charis shouted indignantly.
"We relied on our own abilities for the bidding, but you failed to get what you wanted, you kidnapped my friend."
Connor said expressionlessly.
"Even so, you can't use such a method to humiliate my grandfather!"
Charis said loudly.
"I'm not humiliating him. I just want him to be obedient. This pill won't have any effect on his body, so he can eat it without any worries!"
Connor looked at Styrmir as he said that.
"Huff…"
Styrmir looked at Connor and took a deep breath, then said in a low voice, "Forget it. This might be fate. I didn't expect that I would have this day!"
After saying that, Styrmir reached out to take Connor's pill and threw it into his mouth.
The people of the Yaeger family looked at Styrmir's face with an unusually worried expression. However, they were helpless at the moment because they knew that their family had provoked someone they shouldn't have.
Styrmir waited for a long time after taking the pill, but his body didn't seem to have any reaction.
On the contrary, Styrmir felt that his tired body was much more relaxed. There was a magical power filling his body.
"Why do I feel like my body is heating up?"
Styrmir asked Connor in confusion.
"Although this pill is poisonous, as long as you take the antidote on time, not only will it not cause any harm to your body, but it will also help you strengthen your body and prolong your life. Therefore, these pills are very helpful to your body!"
Connor explained softly.
Styrmir had a strange look on his face. Then, he moved his legs.
He realized that Connor was not lying to him because Styrmir's right leg had always been suffering from serious rheumatism. When it was serious, it would be very difficult for him to even walk. Usually, it would also hurt faintly. However, after he took Connor's pill, he realized that his right leg seemed to be much better, and the dull pain had disappeared.
"Grandpa, are you really okay?"
Charis ran to Styrmir's side and asked him worriedly.

chapters.title: Chapter 1733: Yamino Gomez's Phone Call
chapters.content:
Chapter 1733: Yamino Gomez's Phone Call
"I'm fine…"
Styrmir nodded gently.
"Don't worry, as long as the Yaeger family is obedient, I won't hurt you!"
Connor said in a low voice.
Styrmir looked at Connor and asked expressionlessly, "What do you need the Yaeger family to do for you now?"
"Transfer the five companies that the Yaeger family acquired to Stormbound Corporation. Bring the contract to Queta Juve tomorrow and sign the transfer contract…"
Connor looked at Charis and said.
Charis knew that her life was now in Connor's hands, so she no longer dared to be as arrogant as before. She said expressionlessly, "Alright…"
"As for the other things, I haven't thought of them yet. Wait for my call. If there's anything I need you to do, I'll contact you immediately!"
Connor thought for a moment before continuing.
"Alright!"
Styrmir looked at Connor and nodded.
Connor glanced at Styrmir and said softly, "Yamino probably knows that I came to your place. You should know how to explain to Yamino, right?"
"Yes!"
Styrmir hurriedly replied.
"Then, that's all. Yama, let's go!"
After saying that, Connor walked out of the Yaeger family villa.
Yama looked at the Yaeger family members indifferently and then left with Connor.
When Charis saw Connor leave, he knelt in front of Styrmir and exclaimed, "Grandpa, it's all my fault. If I didn't provoke Connor, our wouldn't have ended up like this!"
"It has already happened. What's the use of apologizing now?"
Styrmir glanced at Charis, his eyes filled with helplessness.
Styrmir didn't understand why Yamino specifically told him not to attack Connor. He didn't even put Connor in his eyes at that time, but now he understood what Yamino's warning meant.
Although Connor was young, the Yaeger family did not have the capital to compete with Connor.
"Grandpa, what should we do next? Is the Yaeger family really going to be Connor's lackey?"
Charis hurriedly continued to ask.
"Do we have any other choice now? All of our lives are in Connor's hands. If Connor finds out that we betrayed him, we will die…"
Styrmir said helplessly.
"But if the Gomez family finds out, we will also die!"
Charis exclaimed.
"Then, we don't let the Gomez family find out!"
Styrmir said expressionlessly and then barked at the other members of the Yaeger family, "If you want to live, then you will not say a word of what happened today to anyone. No one can let outsiders know about the relationship between the Yaeger family and Connor."
"We understand..."
Everyone hurriedly nodded in agreement.
Styrmir looked at the crowd and sighed helplessly. If the Yaeger family could find someone who was slightly more capable, they wouldn't have been bullied by Connor.
Charis knelt on the ground with a face full of guilt and regret. She knew very well that all of this was caused by her. If it wasn't for her, things wouldn't have turned out this way.
A moment later, Styrmir returned to his room. He calmed himself down and took out his phone to call Yamino.
"Styrmir, I heard that Connor went to your place."
Yamino seemed to have been waiting for Styrmir's call, so he asked right after the call was connected.
"Yes, Connor brought people over!"
Styrmir nodded slightly.
"Why did he go there for no reason?"
Yamino hurriedly continued to ask.
"Connor's company has been planning to acquire other companies recently. Charis was unhappy that Connor's Stormbound Corporation had snatched that piece of land away, so she bought those five companies before Connor did. I didn't take this matter seriously at first, but I didn't expect Connor to come looking for me, and he even brought an ancient martial arts expert with him…"
Styrmir deliberately hid the fact that Charis had kidnapped Connor. After all, Yamino had told him before that if Yamino found out that the Yaeger family had acted on their own accord, Yamino would definitely blame him.
"Then, what did you do?"
Yamino asked.
"The ancient martial arts master beside Connor is very terrifying. Even Cyril Luanne couldn't defeat that person, so in the end, I could only give those five companies to Connor for free. He then left after that!"
Styrmir said helplessly.
"He didn't do anything to you?"
Yamino asked in surprise.
"Connor came here this time for the five companies. He just arrived in Yarlford not long ago, and his foundation is not stable. In addition, he knows about the relationship between us, so he didn't make a move on us!"
Styrmir explained.
"Styrmir, didn't I tell you long ago not to provoke Connor? If you really want to deal with him, I'll think of a way. If this matter gets out, it's going to be embarrassing."
Yamino seemed to believe Styrmir and berated him helplessly.
"Yamino, I really didn't expect that Connor would dare to come to my door. I can't take this lying down!"
Styrmir gritted his teeth and said in a low voice.
"I can understand how you feel. He has been in Yarlford for some time. He must be full of himself because I haven't made a move against him all this while. I'm planning to do something to remind him who's the boss here. I will surely avenge you. Just wait patiently."
Yamino said after hesitating for a moment.
"Yamino, are you planning to deal with Connor?"
Styrmir was shocked when he heard Yamino's words.
"Connor's background isn't simple, and he has the Purple Cloud Sect backing him up. It's not easy to deal with him, but it's not a problem to remind him where he stands!"
Yamino said slowly.
"Alright, I understand. Then, I'll wait for a good show!"
Styrmir replied indifferently and continued, "I've already promised to give those five companies to Connor. Do you think I should really give these five companies to him?"
"It's just five companies that are on the verge of bankruptcy. So what if you give them to him?"
Yamino said disdainfully.
"I understand!"
Styrmir nodded.
"Alright, if there's nothing else, I'll talk to you next time!"
"Alright!"
Styrmir answered and hung up the phone.

chapters.title: Chapter 1734: The Woman Who is Always Haunting Him
chapters.content:
Chapter 1734: The Woman Who is Always Haunting Him
After hanging up the phone, Styrmir took out a tissue and wiped the sweat off his forehead. He looked extremely nervous.
After all, this was the first time he had lied to Yamino.
For the Yaeger family to be able to reach this stage today, it was all thanks to Yamino's help.
Therefore, Yamino would never have thought that Styrmir would betray him. This was also why Yamino did not suspect anything just now.
...
On the other side, after Connor and Yama left the Yaeger family villa, they drove straight back to the hotel where Yama was staying.
"Thank you so much for today!"
After Yama got out of the car, Connor whispered to Yama.
If it wasn't for Yama's terrifying performance today, the Yaeger family would never be so obedient.
"All in a day's work. I've waited for you for so many years just to help you deal with these people!"
Yama replied to Connor indifferently.
"Oh right, take this bottle of medicinal pills. In the future, send medicine to Styrmir every half a month…"
Connor said as he handed a porcelain bottle to Yama.
After Yama took the porcelain bottle, a strange look flashed across his face.
"This isn't the antidote, right? It looks like an ordinary pill!"
Yama whispered to Connor.
"Of course, it's not an antidote. Where can I get so many poisons? This is just an ordinary Body Tempering Pill. I said all that just to scare Styrmir. If I didn't do that, he would surely stab me behind my back."
Connor laughed and explained.
In fact, Connor had long discovered that sometimes using pills to scare people was more effective than any other method. He could easily control him, and he didn't have to worry about him betraying him.
Connor had only thought of this method when he was at the Yaeger family's place just now, so he used the Body Tempering Pill as a fake poison.
Back then, Diana Murphy had indeed given Connor some pills that could make people wish they were dead, but those pills had long been used up by Connor.
And Connor discovered that when dealing with those ordinary people who were not martial artists, even if they were given ordinary pills, they would not be able to tell the difference.
This would also save Connor a lot of trouble.
Yama looked at Connor and smiled, then said softly, "You do have a lot of ideas!"
"If you don't know how to suck up, then don't do it. I'm going back now!"
Connor waved his hand at Yama and drove straight back to his home.
After Connor parked his car, he suddenly felt that something was off.
He remembered that he had locked the door when he went out, but the door was open now and the lights in the room were on.
This meant that there was someone in the villa.
Not many people knew that Connor lived here. Even Chelsea Lee and Vanessa Canfield didn't know.
Moreover, if someone wanted to assassinate him, they would definitely not turn on the lights so blatantly.
"Are Justin Spielberg and the others here?"
Connor thought for a long time and could only think of this possibility.
Because this villa was bought by Queta Juve. She definitely would not dare to enter his villa without Connor's permission. Justin, Brooks Hunt, and the others had been here before, so they had the courage to enter without Connor's permission.
Connor hesitated for a moment before walking into the villa.
Connor was very careful because he was not sure if the people in the villa were Justin and the others.
Splash!
At this moment, Connor suddenly heard the sound of running water coming from upstairs.
"Taking a shower at my house?"
Connor's expression was somewhat speechless, and then he walked toward the second floor.
Connor had just reached the second floor when the bathroom door was pushed open.
When Connor saw the woman walking out of the bathroom, he was instantly stunned. He was in disbelief.
"Why are you here?"
Connor exclaimed with his eyes wide open.
"Can't I be here?"
The woman replied calmly as she wiped her hair with a towel.
Connor's face was filled with speechlessness.
Because the person who appeared in Connor's house was none other than Rachel Wallace.
Rachel was wearing a white bath towel, and her graceful figure was faintly discernible. Eighty percent of her slender and fair legs were exposed. Perhaps it was because she had just taken a shower, but her fair skin was slightly ruddy, and she looked extremely sexy and charming.
However, Connor wasn't in the mood to admire Rachel's figure. He had admired Rachel's figure more than twice. When he was in Newtown, Rachel would sit on the sofa and watch TV like this almost every day. Sometimes, she would wear a bath towel and sometimes, she would wear pajamas.
"When did you come back? Shouldn't you be in York?"
Connor asked Rachel.
"My grandfather is fine now, and his condition has stabilized a lot, so I came to look for you. I heard that you plan to deal with Yamino Gomez."
Rachel replied while drying her hair.
"Then, how did you find out that I live here?"
Connor hurriedly asked.
"Justin and the others brought me here. I called you but you didn't pick up, so I went to look for Justin and Brooks!"
Rachel explained in a very natural tone.
"..."
Connor looked at Rachel and hesitated for a couple of seconds before saying softly, "What are you planning to do in Yarlford?"
"I was able to get a job as a lecturer at a university in Yarlford through some of my connections. I can report to school tomorrow!"
Rachel said softly.
"I see!"
Connor nodded gently and then hurriedly continued, "Well, I heard that the universities in Yarlford are very good. They must have already arranged a dormitory for you, right? Tell me when you're moving. I'll help you..."
"I didn't ask the school to arrange a dormitory for me!"
Rachel said softly.
"That's fine. I'll rent a house for you off-campus. I'll pay for the rent. You can choose any place you want!"
Connor gritted his teeth.
"No, thanks. I like it here, and it's very close to the university, so I plan to stay here. There are many rooms in your house anyway. I can stay anywhere, so you don't have to worry."
Rachel looked at Connor and said.
When Connor heard Rachel's words, he was utterly exasperated.
Connor thought that he could finally get rid of Rachel after coming to Yarlford, but he never thought that she actually planned to live with him here.
Connor really did not want to live in the same house as this woman.

chapters.title: Chapter 1735: Birthday Banquet Invitation
chapters.content:
Chapter 1735: Birthday Banquet Invitation
"You used to live in my house because your house in Newtown hadn't been renovated yet. Why are you living in my house this time?"
Connor was speechless as he asked Rachel.
"It just feels comfortable living here. I mean, it's not like it will affect you in any way. You can do whatever you want."
Rachel said indifferently.
"I'm really not used to you living in my house, do you know that?"
Connor was exasperated.
"You've lived with me for so long. What's there to be unaccustomed to? I can protect you when I'm here. Isn't it the best of both worlds?"
Rachel said indifferently.
"Do you think I still need your protection?"
Connor gritted his teeth and asked Rachel.
"It doesn't matter if you don't need my protection. Anyway, I came to Yarlford because of you. You can't chase me away, right?"
Rachel asked with a smile.
"Even if I chase you away, will you leave?"
Connor replied helplessly.
"No!"
Rachel shook her head without thinking.
Connor stood there speechlessly, not knowing what to say.
"Alright, it's getting late. I have to report to school early tomorrow."
Rachel waved at Connor, then turned around and returned to the room.
Connor looked at Rachel's back and felt helpless. He thought he could be alone for a few days, but he didn't expect Rachel to come back so soon.
…
The next day, at nine o'clock in the morning.
When Connor woke up, Rachel had already left. He washed up and then drove to Stormbound Corporation.
When Connor arrived at the company, Queta Juve was in a meeting. Connor did not disturb her and went straight to his office to wait for her.
About an hour later, Queta finally finished her meeting and went to Connor's office immediately.
"Mr. McDonald, Charis Yaeger from the Yaeger family is here today…"
After Queta entered the office, she immediately told Connor.
"Did Charis give the five companies to us?"
Connor asked softly.
"Yes, Mr. McDonald. What's going on? Why would the Yaeger family be so kind and give us all these companies?"
Queta asked Connor in confusion.
"It doesn't matter why. Since we've already gotten the five companies, you'll have your hands full in the future…"
Connor said with a smile.
"Mr. McDonald, you don't have to worry about that. I'm going to visit these companies this afternoon and inspect their factories. I'll try to get these companies to resume production and business in the shortest time possible. I also plan to transfer my employees from Newtown over. After all, they're all my own people."
Queta looked at Connor and said.
"Thank you for your hard work!"
Connor said with a smile.
"It's not hard. As long as funding isn't a problem, it shouldn't be a problem for these companies to resume normal operations. I've already investigated these companies."
Queta said seriously.
"Don't worry, there won't be any problems with funding!"
Connor said confidently.
After all, the thing that Connor did not lack the most now was money.
"That's good!"
Queta looked at Connor and nodded lightly. Then, she took out an invitation letter and handed it to Connor.
"What is this?"
Connor looked at the invitation letter Queta handed over and asked in confusion.
"This is an invitation letter from the Zook family of Yarlford. Tomorrow is the birthday banquet of the Zook family's head, Christian Zook. They want you to attend it!"
Queta looked at Connor and explained.
"Christian Zook?"
Connor couldn't help but frown when he heard this name. Then, he said softly, "Our company doesn't have any dealings with the Zook family. Why is he inviting me to attend?"
"I'm not very sure about that…"
Queta shook her head at Connor and continued, "The Zook family is the same as the Yaeger family. They are both dependent on the Gomez family and are also one of the four biggest families in Yarlford."
"Alright…"
Connor nodded lightly.
"Will you be attending?"
Queta asked.
"Let me make a quick call!"
Connor took out his phone and dialed Styrmir's number.
Ring! Ring!
The phone rang twice before Styrmir picked it up.
"Tomorrow is Christian Zook's birthday banquet, do you know that?"
Connor asked the moment Styrmir picked up.
"Yes!"
Styrmir replied.
"He also sent me an invitation. Do you know why?"
Connor continued to ask.
Styrmir hesitated for a moment, then said softly, "Mr. McDonald, if there's no connection between you and Christian, then this should be Yamino's intention!"
"Yamino?"
Connor couldn't help but frown when he heard that.
"Yes, when I called Yamino yesterday, he told me that he wanted to find an opportunity to show you who's the boss. Tomorrow, there will be many big shots from Yarlford attending Christian's birthday banquet. They must be planning to humiliate you at the birthday banquet, so it's better you don't attend!"
Styrmir said in a low voice.
"So it's a trap!"
Connor couldn't help but sneer when he heard Styrmir's words. Then, he said indifferently, "If you didn't tell me about this, I might not have accepted the invitation. However, since you've already told me what's going on, I'm a little curious about how these people plan to show me who's boss!"
"Mr. McDonald, are you planning to attend?"
Styrmir asked in confusion.
"That's right. Since they've specially set up a banquet for me, I'll go and see what they want!"
Connor replied softly and then hung up.
Queta looked at Connor putting down his phone with a puzzled look and said softly, "Mr. McDonald, you clearly know that it will be dangerous if you go. Why do you still want to go?"
"They plan to use this opportunity to humiliate me, so not only do I have to go, but I also have to let them know that it's not so easy to bully me!"
Connor explained with a smile.
Queta looked at Connor helplessly, not knowing what to say.
…

chapters.title: Chapter 1736: Eliminate Aida Collier
chapters.content:
Chapter 1736: Eliminate Aida Collier
On the other side.
In the Collier family's villa in York.
Albert Collier had just received Christian Zook's invitation.
"Cielo, come here!"
After hesitating for a moment, Albert shouted upstairs.
Cielo Collier rushed downstairs after hearing Albert call for him. He then asked Albert respectfully, "Father, what's the matter?"
"Tomorrow is the birthday banquet of Christian Zook, the head of the Zook family. I don't have time to attend, so you and Aida go in my stead."
Albert said softly.
"Alright, I understand…"
Cielo nodded gently and took the invitation letter.
"Alright, go do your work!"
Albert waved at Cielo.
After hesitating for a moment, Cielo asked Albert softly, "Dad, where's Aida?"
"She's discussing a project with someone outside. You should learn from your sister. You shouldn't be at home all the time. Now, most of the Collier family's business is being managed by your sister. If I'm not around in the future and your sister gets married, can you manage the Collier family's business?"
Albert said lightly.
"Dad, I want to learn from Aida, but sometimes she doesn't even bring me along. I can't do anything about it!"
Cielo said helplessly.
"..."
Albert hesitated for a couple of seconds when he heard Cielo's words. Then, he said in a low voice, "I'll tell your sister about this when she comes back…"
"Alright…"
Cielo nodded gently and returned to his room.
Cielo had just entered the room when his mother followed him in.
Cielo's mother was called Shereen Stevens. Although this woman was not in charge of any business in the Collier family, she was very scheming. Otherwise, she would never have gotten rid of Aida's mother and taken her spot.
"Mom, what's going on?"
Cielo looked at Shereen and asked.
"Did you hear what your father said just now?"
Shereen asked Cielo with a frown.
"Yeah, what about it? I'm not as capable as Aida, and the company's matters are all managed by Aida. She is constantly on guard against me, so I have no chance to interfere in the company's matters. Do you think I want to stay at home all the time?"
Cielo said helplessly.
"There are some things that I didn't intend to tell you, but since things have already come to this, I have to remind you of something!"
Shereen whispered.
"Mom, what is it?"
Cielo frowned and asked in confusion.
"Aida is a very smart woman. She's so smart that it's scary. Besides, you know how good she is in doing business. Now, most of our family's businesses are under her control. When your father steps down one day, your grandfather might choose her to inherit your father's position."
Shereen said in a low voice.
"Mom, that's preposterous. Aida is a woman. How could she become the head of the Collier family?"
Cielo said disdainfully.
"I thought the same way you did at the beginning. But now, the situation is different. Your father wants Aida to marry Juan Gomez. He is the eldest son of Gomez family. If they really get together, Aida will get Gomez family's help. In the end, she will try her best to become the head of the Collier family. Once she becomes the head of Collier family, our positions in the Collier family will be in danger!"
Shereen said with a frown.
"..."
Cielo fell silent after hearing Shereen's words.
It was true that Aida did not have the ability to become the head of the Collier family. However, Aida had no choice but to be with Juan, which meant that there was the Gomez family behind Aida.
The Gomez family would definitely find a way to make Aida the head of the Collier family, which would make it easier for the Gomez family to swallow the Collier family.
"Mom, what do you mean by that?"
Cielo seemed to have realized the danger he was in and hurriedly asked Shereen.
"I originally thought that Aida would be fine as long as she got married, but I never thought that she would marry into the Gomez family. The Gomez family's ambitions are much greater than Aida's, so no matter what, we can't let this marriage succeed. The best way is to get rid of her!"
Shereen said coldly.
"Mom, isn't it a little too risky to get rid of Aida?"
Cielo asked in a low voice.
"If you don't get rid of Aida now, do you think you'll still have a chance to get rid of her after she marries Juan?"
Shereen paused for a moment before continuing, "If you don't get rid of Aida now, then she will definitely get rid of you!"
"..."
Cielo lowered his head and said nothing.
"Think about it yourself!"
Shereen said helplessly.
"I don't need to think about it. I think you're right. I have to get rid of Aida to secure my position, but I don't know what to do now. If she dies, I'll become the biggest suspect!"
Cielo said with some distress.
"Didn't your dad ask you to go to Yarlford with Aida? I heard that our family has an enemy called Connor McDonald. You can take this opportunity to get rid of Aida and then frame Connor. Wouldn't things be much simpler this way?"
Shereen had already planned everything out.
"That's right, why didn't I think of that!"
Cielo was a little excited.
"Son, this is all I can do for you now. The rest is up to you. If you can get rid of Aida this time, then your position in the Collier family will be safe. After all, there is no other heir besides you. If you fail, then both of us may be in danger!"
Shereen said earnestly.
"Mom, don't worry. Aida doesn't know that I am thinking about doing something to her, so it's easy for me to get rid of her!"
Cielo said confidently.
"I hope you can succeed this time!"
Shereen let out a long sigh of relief, then turned around and left Cielo's room.
Meanwhile, Cielo began to think about how he should act against Aida without arousing any suspicion and also frame Connor.
...

chapters.title: Chapter 1737: The Birthday Banquet Begins
chapters.content:
Chapter 1737: The Birthday Banquet Begins
A day passed quickly.
Today was a very lively day for Yarlford. After all, it was the birthday banquet of the head of the Zook family, one of the four biggest families. Many big shots of Yarlford would surely come to attend.
Christian Zook had booked the largest hotel in Yarlford for the banquet.
This hotel had a total of five floors. If an ordinary person came to hold a birthday banquet, it would be very impressive if they could book an entire floor.
However, Christian actually booked the entire hotel this time. From this point, it could be seen how terrifying the scale of Christian's birthday banquet was.
Connor didn't plan to attend. But when he heard that Yamino Gomez was planning to use this opportunity to teach him a lesson, then Connor suddenly became interested.
Therefore, Connor went to the hotel where Christian's birthday banquet was held early in the morning.
The invitation stated that Connor could bring a female companion, so Connor brought Queta Juve with him.
Queta was considered a top-notch existence in all aspects, be it her figure or her temperament. Therefore, Connor felt that it was very prestigious to bring such a female companion with him.
Originally, Connor thought that he had arrived early, but he never expected that some people would be even more anxious than him. It was already past ten in the morning, but the road in front of the hotel had been blocked by all kinds of luxury cars.
Connor and Queta had driven here, but there was a traffic jam in front of them, so Connor had no choice but to park the car at the side and walk into the hotel with Queta.
The Zook family was already standing at the door to welcome them.
Because there were many people attending the birthday banquet this time, there was a specific seating arrangement for the guests.
The higher the status of the person, the higher the floor.
This also meant that only those who could go to the fifth floor were the real big shots of Yarlford, and those who sat on the first to third floors were just some small bosses.
Connor brought the sexy and charming Queta into the hotel.
"Sir, please show me your invitation!"
The security guard at the entrance of the hotel said to Connor very politely.
Connor handed his invitation letter to the bodyguard.
After a careful inspection, the security guard hurriedly said to the server beside him, "This is a VIP on the fifth floor. Bring him up now!"
When the server heard the security guard's words, she was also surprised. After all, those who could go up to the fifth floor were the top bosses in Yarlford!
Connor looked so young, but he was qualified to go to the fifth floor. It was rather unbelievable.
Although the serve was shocked, she didn't show it on her face. She respectfully walked to Connor and said softly, "Mr. McDonald, this way please!"
Connor and Queta followed the server to the fifth floor.
"I didn't expect Christian to give you so much face, Mr. McDonald. He actually arranged for you to be on the fifth floor!"
Queta whispered to Connor.
"This time, the Gomez family is planning to embarrass me in front of all the rich people in Yarlford. They will definitely arrange for me to be on the fifth floor because the fifth floor is filled with the truly powerful people in Yarlford. Only by embarrassing me in front of these people would it be the most effective!"
Connor replied indifferently.
"Since you knew that they wanted to harm you, why did you still come?"
Queta asked in confusion.
"Who knows who will be the one who's embarrassed today!"
Connor replied coldly and then found his seat.
Queta chose to sit beside Connor.
There were not many guests on the fifth floor, so the hall was rather quiet.
At this moment, Connor suddenly saw a familiar figure walking up to him.
"Aida Collier is also here?"
Connor could not help but sigh.
Beside Aida was Cielo.
When the bosses in the hall saw Aida enter, they quickly surrounded her and greeted her, but Cielo was left out in the cold.
This caused Cielo's expression to turn even uglier.
Aida had been chatting with the people around her, so she naturally did not notice Cielo's expression.
However, Connor, as a bystander, could see it very clearly.
"It seems that Aida is in a very dangerous situation now!"
Connor could not help but sigh softly.
It was obvious that Connor had noticed that Cielo was not following Aida like before. Cielo's mentality was also gradually changing.
After exchanging a few words with the crowd, Aida began to look for her seat.
However, no one expected that Aida and Cielo would be sitting at the same table as Connor.
The Zook family was very particular about the seating arrangements. Even though they were on the fifth floor, the seating arrangements were naturally different due to their different identities.
If their statuses were almost the same, then the young people would be arranged to sit at the same table, while the middle-aged man would sit at the same table.
When Aida saw Connor, a strange look flashed across her face, but she didn't talk to Connor. Connor knew what Aida meant, so he didn't say anything. Everyone sat down quietly.
Cielo sized up Connor from head to toe. In his plan, he wanted to get rid of Aida and make Connor his scapegoat.
Therefore, Cielo was observing Connor very seriously.
At this moment, the members of the Yaeger family appeared in the hall.
However, Charis Yaeger and another elder of the Yaeger family were also sitting at Connor's table.
Everyone in the Yaeger family felt a trace of fear when they saw Connor, especially the young man beside Charis who had been trembling ever since he saw Connor. Charis was still considered at ease as she sat in her seat expressionlessly.
Connor didn't pay attention to these people. He took out his phone and started playing with it.
Half an hour later, everyone at Connor's table had arrived.
However, other than the juniors of the Zook family, the descendants of the Yaeger family, Hackett family, and Gardner family were all sitting at Connor's table.
At this moment, these young masters from the big families were all looking at Connor with interest. After all, in their eyes, Connor was not qualified to sit with them. However, these people also knew that Connor was not so easy to provoke, so they did not have the intention to provoke him. Instead, they chatted amongst each other in a low voice.
Connor realized that these people were actually very different from the young masters he knew. In Connor's impression, these rich second-generation heirs usually liked to talk about women and cars. However, at this time, these people were actually talking about business, and there were some things that Connor didn't understand. This changed Connor's impression of these rich second-generation heirs.
After all, these people would have to inherit their family's business in the future. There were many children in large families, so the competition was naturally very fierce. If these people did not know how to work hard, they would be eliminated sooner or later.

chapters.title: Chapter 1738: Provoke
chapters.content:
Chapter 1738: Provoke
While these people were chatting, Connor also noticed Cielo sitting on the left side of Aida.
The seat on her right was empty, which meant that it was prepared for Juan Gomez.
As expected, there was a commotion in the crowd.
A middle-aged man brought a handsome young man into the hall.
"Mr. Gomez, you're here?"
An old man walked out from the backstage and exclaimed with an excited expression.
When everyone at Connor's table saw the middle-aged man, they all stood up and welcomed him. Only Connor and Queta sat where they were.
"Mr. McDonald, that white-haired old man is the head of the Zook family, Christian Zook, and that middle-aged man is Yamino Gomez. The young man beside Yamino is Juan Gomez!"
Queta knew that Connor had never met the Gomez family before, so she told him who they were.
Connor narrowed his eyes as he looked at Juan and Yamino. This was the first time he was meeting his father's murderer.
Connor was very calm on the surface, but waves were set off in his heart.
At this moment, there was only one thought in Connor's mind, and that was to rush up and kill Yamino to avenge his parents.
However, Connor discovered that there was a martial artist following Yamino, and this martial artist's realm was definitely above Connor's. Therefore, Connor did not have the ability to directly kill Yamino now.
The moment Yamino appeared, he became the center of attention. Everyone took the initiative to chat with Yamino.
Ten minutes later, the people sitting at Connor's table returned to their seats.
Juan sat beside Aida.
However, Juan couldn't help but be stunned when he saw Connor. Then, he smiled and asked Connor, "You must be Connor McDonald?"
When Connor heard Juan's words, he slowly raised his head and looked at Juan. However, in the next second, Connor chose to ignore Juan. He had no intention of responding to Juan at all.
It instantly became awkward.
Even Aida was speechless. She didn't expect Connor to be so arrogant. Juan took the initiative to talk to him, but he didn't even look at him.
Queta seemed to be a little surprised by Connor's actions, and her eyes were filled with nervousness.
Juan took a deep breath and said with a smile, "It seems that Mr. McDonald of Davenport is indeed worthy of his reputation. Today, I have learned a lesson!"
It was obvious that Juan's words had a deeper meaning, and he wanted to sit next to Aida after saying this.
However, at this moment, Connor suddenly stood up and walked straight to Juan. He stopped Juan from sitting down.
"Mr. McDonald, what do you mean by this?"
When Connor stopped him, Juan was somewhat puzzled.
"My seat is facing the air-conditioner, so it's too cold. I want to sit here now!"
After saying that, Connor didn't care whether Juan agreed or not. He then sat beside Aida.
This time, the situation seemed even more awkward.
After all, everyone had deliberately left Aida's position next to Juan empty because the entire Yarlford knew about the marriage between the Collier family and Gomez family. Although Aida and Juan had not confirmed their relationship, everyone felt that it was already a certainty.
One was the princess of the Collier family, and the other was the young master of the largest family in Yarlford.
It was only natural that the two of them would be together.
However, no one expected Connor to not give Juan any face. He sat directly beside Aida. Wasn't this clearly a slap to Juan's face?
Originally, Connor was planning to pay attention to Juan. After all, in Connor's eyes, his real opponent was Yamino and not Juan.
However, Juan started to provoke Connor the moment he saw him, so Connor didn't mind giving Juan a taste of his own medicine.
"Mr. McDonald, this seat belongs to Mr. Juan. Isn't it inappropriate for you to sit here?"
At this moment, a young man said to Connor expressionlessly.
"How is it inappropriate?"
Connor asked.
"That's Mr. Juan's position. Is it not inappropriate for you to take his seat?"
The young man said speechlessly.
"Mr. Juan's position?"
Connor couldn't help but sneer when he heard the young man's words. Then, he said indifferently, "First of all, there's no name written on this seat, right? What proof do you have that this is his seat?"
"Why you…"
The young man looked at Connor with a frown.
"Alright, alright. Since he wants to sit there, then let him sit there!"
However, at this moment, Juan suddenly reached out to stop the young man, then walked over to Queta and sat down.
After all, today was Christian's birthday banquet, and there were many people in the hall, so Juan didn't want to have too much conflict with people like Connor. After all, today's good show was still to come.
However, after Connor sat beside Aida, he started chatting with Aida.
Aida looked at Connor helplessly. She didn't want to expose her relationship with Connor, so she didn't say much.
Connor didn't care whether Aida was speaking to him or not. He was just talking to himself.
Juan's face turned even uglier when he saw this.
After all, he was already very upset when Connor stole his seat. Now that Connor was harassing the woman he liked, Juan was even more upset.
This situation lasted for nearly ten minutes.
The birthday banquet finally began.
Christian walked up to the stage and said a few simple words of courtesy, then began to serve the dishes.
One had to know that those who could go up to the fifth floor to eat were all existences worth tens of billions. What good food had these people not eaten before?
Therefore, after the dishes were served, these people did not really eat. Most of them were holding wine glasses and chatting with each other.
However, Connor was different. He ate one dish after another. Moreover, he didn't just eat by himself. When he had nothing to do, he even took food for Aida.
Aida looked at Connor speechlessly. She knew that Connor was doing this on purpose, but she couldn't figure out why.
Almost all the dishes on the table were eaten by Connor alone. The others didn't even touch their cutlery.
Meanwhile, Christian brought his grandson to the table to make a toast to everyone.
Juan had been observing the situation on Christian's side. He knew that as long as Christian walked to his table, the show would begin.

chapters.title: Chapter 1739: Not Worthy to Fight with Me
chapters.content:
Chapter 1739: Not Worthy to Fight with Me
Sure enough, a few minutes later, Christian finally arrived at Connor's table.
When Juan and the others saw Christian walking over, they hurriedly stood up and greeted him.
As for Connor, it was as if he did not see anything. He continued to eat with his head lowered.
Christian noticed that Connor didn't stand up, and a strange look flashed across his face, but he didn't say anything.
A few minutes later, Christian had finished chatting with the others. He walked to Connor and asked with a smile, "You must be the famous Mr. McDonald from Porthampton, right?"
"That's right!"
Connor looked at Christian and nodded lightly. Then, he continued, "Today is your birthday?"
"Yes!"
Christian smiled and continued, "Mr. McDonald, I heard that you're the disciple of Mr. Jorge Yarrell. I've met Mr. Yarrell once before. Mr. Yarrell is really a god-like figure!"
"Why haven't I heard my master mention you before?"
Connor knew that Christian was deliberately making things difficult for him today, so at this time, he sounded impolite.
"How could someone like Mr. Yarrell remember me?"
Christian didn't expect that Connor would be so disrespectful, so he smiled awkwardly.
"Mr. Zook, is this kid really Mr. Yarrell's disciple?"
However, at this moment, a burly man stood up and shouted loudly.
"That's right, this is Mr. Yarrell's disciple, Connor McDonald!"
Christian nodded lightly.
"I don't think there's anything special about this kid. When did Mr. Yarrell's standards go so low? He actually accepted such a mediocre disciple!"
The brawny man said disdainfully.
Because the brawny man's voice was relatively loud, everyone in the hall could hear him clearly.
For a moment, everyone's attention was focused on the burly man and Connor.
Connor sized up the brawny man and could not help but sneer to himself.
Initially, Connor was still thinking about what method Yamino planned to use today to humiliate him. He did not expect that it would actually be such a low-level method.
"Laith, don't spout nonsense!"
Christian hurriedly scolded in a low voice, then continued, "Mr. McDonald is indeed Mr. Yarrell's disciple. There's no mistake about that!"
"I don't think this kid is Mr. Yarrell's disciple. How can Mr. Yarrell's disciple be so weak looking!"
The burly man pointed at Connor and shouted.
"That's right. This kid looks like a loser. He's definitely not Mr. Yarrell's disciple. All martial artists know that Mr. Yarrell has very high standards. It's impossible for him to take such a loser as his disciple!"
At this moment, a young man stood up and shouted with disdain.
When Connor heard the conversation between the two people, he smiled faintly and did not explain anything.
"This person might be using the name of Mr. Yarrell's disciple to swindle people. The Zook family's banquet doesn't welcome people like you. You'd better hurry up and get lost!"
The brawny man shouted.
No one else present seemed to know what was going on. After all, very few people knew Connor, so no one stood up to help him.
Aida looked at Connor helplessly. Although she knew what was going on, Aida would never speak up for Connor.
"Laith, shut up!"
Christian pretended to be angry and shouted.
"Uncle, what I said is true. Mr. Yarrell would never take such a person as a disciple. He must be a liar. He might not even know what Mr. Yarrell looks like!"
The brawny man named Laith said with his eyes wide open.
This brawny man's name was Laith Zook. He was also a martial artist, and he was Christian's nephew.
Everything that happened at this moment was actually planned by Yamino and Christian. Their goal was to humiliate Connor in public so that Connor could not help but defend himself. In the end, Laith would teach Connor a lesson.
Laith was a beginner black rank. Yamino and Christian didn't know Connor's true strength. Although they had heard that Connor was rather strong, they thought it was just a rumor. If Connor didn't have the Purple Cloud Sect and Jorge Yarrell backing him up, he wouldn't be anything at all, so it was probably easy for Laith to teach him a lesson.
"Mr. McDonald, I'm really sorry. My nephew might have had a little too much to drink just now, so he's being arrogant. Please don't lower yourself to his level!"
Christian explained to Connor with a smile.
"Uncle, why are you apologizing to this person? If this kid is really Mr. Yarrell's disciple, then let him exchange a few moves with me and let me test his ability, won't that do?"
Laith shouted at the top of his lungs.
"That's right. If Connor is really Mr. Yarrell's disciple, his skills must be extraordinary. Why don't we let Laith spar with him!"
"At this point, there's no harm in exchanging a few blows, right?"
Everyone chimed in.
Christian looked to be in a difficult position. He was deliberately waiting for Connor to answer.
However, Connor had a calm expression and did not have the intention to pay attention to Laith at all.
"Brat, why are you not speaking? Are you afraid? If you don't dare to compete with me, it means that you're an imposter. Get out of this hotel!"
Laith shouted at Connor with his eyes wide open.
Connor turned to look at Laith and said calmly, "You are not worthy of fighting me!"
"What... What did you say?"
Laith's eyes widened when he heard Connor's words. His expression was one of disbelief.
"I said that you are not worthy to fight with me. Don't you understand what I mean?"
Connor repeated softly.
"You're really arrogant, kid. I'm a beginner black rank, and you're saying I don't deserve to fight you? This is ridiculous!"
Laith shouted angrily.
"Mr. McDonald, my nephew Laith may have a bad temper, but he's still a black-rank martial artist, and you're saying he's not worthy of fighting you?"
Christian did not intend to continue acting and asked Connor coldly.
"I'm not an ancient martial arts grandmaster, but this person is indeed not qualified to fight with me. If you want to make things difficult for me, then I suggest you find someone more powerful."
Connor spoke without mercy.

chapters.title: Chapter 1740: What Can You Do?
chapters.content:
Chapter 1740: What Can You Do?
"Mr. McDonald, the Zook family has no intention of making things difficult for you!"
Christian whispered to Connor.
"You know very well whether you're making things difficult for me or not. If this is all you have, then I'm really disappointed. I thought that you'd try something else, but this is all you got?"
Connor sighed softly and turned to Queta. "Alright, we're done eating. Let's go!"
After saying that, Connor wanted to walk downstairs.
"Kid, this place is not a place where you can come and go as you please. Since you look down on me so much, I'll let you see how strong I am today!"
Laith seemed to have been provoked by Connor's words. After a low growl, he rushed toward Connor.
Everyone revealed a shocked expression after seeing this scene. No one had expected Laith to really attack Connor.
Yamino and the others watched the show quietly. After all, everything was a part of their plans.
But what Yamino didn't expect was that Connor was actually so calm. Moreover, Connor seemed to already know that all this was done to deal with Connor.
Although Laith had a burly body, his speed was extremely fast. He was like a crossbow bolt rushing toward Connor. Then, he raised his fist and smashed down fiercely.
"Ah…"
When Queta saw this scene, she instinctively yelled.
"Laith's punch is shockingly powerful!"
"Yeah. If this hits an ordinary person, it will probably kill him!"
"It's all Connor's fault for being too arrogant. Of all people, he had to offend someone like Laith!"
At this moment, the onlookers in the hall who did not know the truth began to discuss in low voices.
Bang!
But the next second, everyone was stunned.
Just as Laith's fist was about to land on Connor's face, Connor raised his right hand and easily blocked Laith's punch.
Even Laith himself was shocked.
Because he did not expect Connor to actually be so capable.
In the next second, Connor raised his right leg and kicked at Laith's right leg.
Crack!
A crisp sound rang out.
Connor's kick had shattered Laith's kneecap.
"Ah…"
Laith screamed before he even realized what had happened.
However, in the next second, Connor kicked fiercely again.
Connor's kick landed on Laith's left leg.
"Ah…"
Laith screamed again.
Connor slowly loosened his grip on Laith's fist.
Bang!
Laith's legs were broken by Connor, so he fell in front of Connor.
All of this happened too suddenly. No one had expected such a situation to happen in the end.
Yamino, Christian, and the others were confident in Laith. After all, Laith was a beginner black rank, and Connor was young, so they felt that Laith was the most suitable person to deal with Connor.
However, no one expected Laith to be so weak in front of Connor.
In less than half a minute, Laith had been beaten to the ground.
"I told you. You're not worthy!"
Connor looked at Laith and said calmly.
Everyone fell silent.
Previously, when Connor said this, everyone thought that he was bragging. However, now they knew that Connor was not bragging.
Christian looked at Laith who was kneeling on the ground with his face twisted angrily. After all, he had originally planned to embarrass Connor, but now, it had actually become their Zook family's embarrassment.
The Zook family took the initiative to provoke Connor during the banquet. In the end, they were humiliated. If this were to spread, wouldn't the Zook family become a laughing stock?
"This young man is not simple!"
However, at this moment, the bodyguard beside Yamino suddenly sighed.
"What do you mean?"
Yamino hesitated for a moment and asked the bodyguard in confusion.
"Mr. Gomez, although he looks like a beginner black rank on the surface, his strength is far beyond that of a beginner black rank. Even an intermediate black rank might not be his opponent. I don't understand why his strength is so terrifying, but to have such capabilities at such a young age, it will be a big problem if he were allowed to advance even further!"
The bodyguard said expressionlessly.
"If you fight him, what are your chances of winning?"
Yamino asked after a moment of hesitation.
"He's not my match!"
The bodyguard said confidently.
"Alright then, go and teach this person a lesson later. Be careful and don't kill him!"
Yamino said slowly.
"No problem!"
The bodyguard nodded.
On the other side, after Connor finished dealing with Laith, he looked at Christian with a calm expression and asked Christian softly, "Didn't you want me to fight with your nephew just now? Now that we've already fought, do you have any other moves? Just use them all!"
"You're way too arrogant. I only asked you to spar with my nephew, but you actually broke his legs. You don't put the Zook family in your eyes!"
Christian shouted at Connor with a trembling voice.
Connor looked at Christian indifferently and said, "What can you do about that?"
"Why you…"
Christian stared at Connor with his eyes wide open. His eyes were filled with anger. He had never expected Connor to be so arrogant.
"If that's all you got, I'll be leaving now!"
After saying that, Connor walked out of the hall.
"Wait a minute!"
However, at this moment, Yamino suddenly shouted.
When Connor heard Yamino's words, he slowly turned his head to look at Yamino and could not help but sneer to himself. "Looks like you can't hold it in anymore!"
"Mr. McDonald, you've injured someone at the Zook family's birthday banquet. Isn't it a little inappropriate for you to just leave like that?"
Yamino sat on the spot and spoke calmly, but his voice wasn't authoritative.
When Aida heard Yamino's words, she was a little helpless because she knew that Connor had blown things up.
If Yamino was also involved in this matter, then today's matter might not end so easily.
"They were the ones who insisted on competing with me. I've already told them he's not worthy of being my opponent, but they didn't listen to me."
Connor said lightly.

chapters.title: Chapter 1741: What Will Come Will Come Eventually
chapters.content:
Chapter 1741: What Will Come Will Come Eventually
"No matter what, you've hurt someone!"
Yamino frowned.
"So what?"
When facing Yamino, Connor did not show the slightest bit of fear.
"If you don't give the Zook family an explanation today, don't even think about leaving this place!"
Yamino said clearly.
"Haha…"
Connor laughed disdainfully when he heard Yamino's words, then he said indifferently, "If I want to leave, no one can stop me!"
After saying that, Connor walked out of the hall.
Yamino turned to look at the bodyguard beside him.
The bodyguard understood what Yamino meant, so he rushed toward Connor.
Everyone knew in their hearts that today's matter was going to blow up. If Yamino were to interfere in this matter, then Connor would definitely have to pay a price before he could leave.
The bodyguard was very fast. In the blink of an eye, he rushed behind Connor and grabbed Connor's clothes.
Bang!
However, at this moment, a figure rushed out and grabbed the bodyguard's wrist.
The bodyguard looked a little surprised because the figure that rushed out was way too fast. He could not react in time.
Connor turned and glanced at Yama in front of him. He then said softly, "I'll leave this place to you. It won't be a problem for you, right?"
"Mr. McDonald, don't worry!"
Yama replied in a low voice.
Connor didn't say anything and continued walking forward.
When Yamino saw Yama, he was a little shocked, because he immediately recognized this person as the bodyguard killer, Yama, under Connor's father who he had been searching for for many years.
Back then, after Yamino killed Connor's parents, he had been searching for the whereabouts of Yama.
Although there were many rumors that said that Yama was already dead, Yamino still felt uneasy. He felt that the Yama was still alive, so he had not given up on searching for the Yama for so many years.
However, Yamino never expected that Yama would appear in front of him here today.
Yamino's bodyguard seemed to be planning to fight with Yama after seeing Connor leave.
"Hadrian, you are no match for this person. Stop!"
Yamino shouted expressionlessly.
Hadrian understood what Yamino meant, so he took two steps back and returned to Yamino's side.
Yama looked at everyone expressionlessly and said in a low voice, "If anyone dares to make things difficult for Mr. McDonald, I will destroy your entire family!"
"Who is this person?"
"How arrogant!"
"Yeah. Why have I never seen this person before?"
Everyone looked at Yama and began to discuss in low voices.
However, Yama was not in the mood to pay attention to these people. After saying that, he turned around and left.
Yamino stood in place and looked at the Yama's back for two seconds before sighing softly, "What will come will eventually come…"
...
After Connor and Queta left the hotel, Queta seemed to have not recovered from the incident just now. Her beautiful face was filled with panic.
Because that scene just now was really dangerous. If it wasn't for the timely arrival of the Yama, Connor and she would have been in danger.
"Mr. McDonald, aren't you going a little too far today? Although Laith's status in the Zook family isn't high, you broke his legs at Christian's birthday banquet. The Zook family will definitely not let this go…"
Queta hesitated for a moment before speaking to Connor.
"Do you know why Yamino invited me to attend this banquet?"
Connor whispered to Queta.
"I... I don't..."
Queta shook her head gently.
"Their real purpose isn't to humiliate me, but to show me how powerful they are. They want me to feel that I can't win against them and back off. So, no matter what, I had to attend this birthday banquet today. I also wanted to give these people a fierce slap in the face and let them know that I'm not that easy to bully."
Connor explained in a low voice.
"I see!"
Queta looked at Connor and nodded thoughtfully.
"The four big families are one with the Gomez family. If I want to deal with the Gomez family, I have to deal with the four big families. Therefore, we will become enemies with them sooner or later. Even if today's incident didn't happen, the Zook family wouldn't let us go."
Connor continued.
Queta couldn't help but take a deep breath. It was only then that she realized that all of this was part of Connor's plan.
Although Connor seemed nonchalant, in fact, everything he did had its own purpose.
...
Christian's birthday banquet ended on bad terms because of Connor's appearance.
After all, no one expected Connor to be so ruthless as to break Laith's legs.
Originally, Zook family and Gomez family had planned to use this matter to suppress Connor.
However, they didn't expect that Connor would be so arrogant in the end.
After this matter was over, the entire Yarlford would probably know the name Connor McDonald.
Fighting against the entire Zook family and Gomez family with one's own strength was something that had never happened before.
However, what worried Yamino the most was the appearance of Yama.
As for Connor's arrogance at the birthday banquet today, he did not take it seriously.
Aida Collier and Cielo Collier planned to fly back to York after attending the birthday banquet.
However, Cielo had been looking for an opportunity to make a move on Aida. Once she returned to York, it would be very difficult for him to make a move on her.
After hesitating for a long time, Cielo finally thought of a suitable excuse.
Previously, the Collier family cooperated with a company in Gevada. However, there was a problem with the contract some time ago. Albert wanted Cielo to handle this matter and train him at the same time.
Cielo also wanted to use this opportunity to perform well, so he agreed.
Cielo decided to leave this matter to Aida and return to York alone.
This way, not only could he clear his name, but he could also find an opportunity to make a move on Aida.
After some consideration, Cielo felt that this was the simplest way. He went straight to Aida's room and knocked lightly.
"Who is it?"
Aida's voice rang out.
"It's me!"
Cielo whispered.
"Wait a moment!"
Aida replied indifferently, then she opened the door and asked softly, "What's going on?"
Even though Aida and Cielo both wanted to kill each other, they still appeared to be on good terms on the surface.

chapters.title: Chapter 1742: Can't Escape Death
chapters.content:
Chapter 1742: Can't Escape Death
"Can you do me a favor?"
Cielo said with a smile.
Aida looked at Cielo expressionlessly and asked with a smile, "Are you short of money again? How much do you want this time?"
Cielo was usually not in charge of the Collier family's business. Most of the time, he would wait for Albert to give him pocket money. Cielo was a spendthrift person and spent a lot of money, so he often borrowed money from Aida.
In order to show that she had no hostility toward Cielo, Aida granted all his requests. After all, it was the Collier family's money, so Aida did not feel any heartache at all.
"This time, it's not about money…"
Cielo hurriedly replied, then continued, "Some time ago, Dad asked me to go to Gevada to deal with the contract. It's almost time to settle that contract, but I got myself a girlfriend some time ago. Her birthday is the day after tomorrow, and you know that I don't know much about business, so I was thinking you could go instead…"
Aida looked at Cielo helplessly and asked with a smile, "You came to me because of this?"
"Yeah, what else would it be about?"
Cielo nodded nervously.
"Alright, I'll help you with this, but remember that you owe me a favor!"
Aida did not expect Cielo to be scheming against her, so she readily agreed.
"Really?"
Cielo shouted excitedly seeing that Aida had agreed.
"Of course!"
Aida nodded and continued to ask, "When will I go to Gevada?"
"You can leave the day after tomorrow!"
Cielo said after some thought.
"Okay, then I won't go back to York. I can relax in Yarlford for a few days!"
Aida had already packed her luggage and was ready to leave the next day. However, because of Cielo, she could only give up on the idea of going back.
"Okay, it's settled then. I'll go back alone tomorrow!"
Cielo did not expect things to go so smoothly and said happily.
"Alright"
Aida nodded.
After hesitating for a moment, Cielo felt that he shouldn't continue talking to Aida. It would be troublesome if he spilled the beans, so he found an excuse to leave Aida's room.
Cielo had just returned to his room when he took out his phone and dialed his mother's number.
"Mom, I've already thought of a way to get Aida to stay in Yarlford. How are the preparations on your side?"
Cielo asked in a low voice.
"I've already contacted the people on my side for you. They should reach Yarlford in two days. At that time, we can make a move on Aida!"
The other party hurriedly said.
"That's great. This time, Aida will definitely die!"
Cielo said excitedly.
However, Cielo did not notice that Aida was standing outside his room.
Aida did not come here on purpose to eavesdrop on Cielo's phone call. After all, no one expected Cielo to be so impatient that he would call Shereen Stevens the moment he left Aida's room.
Aida's face was filled with shock when she heard what Cielo said.
After Aida agreed to help, she suddenly remembered that she had already booked her plane tickets. Moreover, all these tickets were booked by Cielo, so Aida wanted to ask Cielo to get a refund for her tickets.
However, just as she walked to Cielo's door, she heard Cielo talking to someone on the phone. Out of curiosity, Aida did not knock on the door. Instead, she stuck her ear to the door to listen to what Cielo was saying.
Who would have thought that she would hear such shocking things!
Cielo and Shereen were planning to get rid of her.
Aida had been looking for an opportunity to attack Cielo, but she never expected him to take the first step.
For a moment, Aida became nervous.
She didn't know how to deal with this situation because she didn't expect Cielo to do this right now.
Aida took a deep breath and quickly returned to her room.
After returning to her room, Aida sat on the bed and tried to calm herself down. Then she began to think of a way to deal with it.
"Did Cielo and Shereen find out about my collaboration with Connor?"
This was the first question that flashed across Aida's mind.
Because she could not find any other reason for Cielo to make a move against her.
However, Aida quickly shook her head. She knew that if the Collier family had found out about her relationship with Connor, it would not be Cielo who was doing this to her. Albert would probably be the one doing that.
"Shereen must have been afraid that I would compete with Cielo for the position of the family head, so she decided to strike first!"
Soon, Aida thought of the second answer.
Obviously, this answer was more reasonable than the previous one.
Aida hesitated for a couple of seconds and was about to take out her phone to call Connor, but she gave up on the idea after observing the situation in the room.
She knew very well that since Cielo had already planned to make a move against her, her room might be under Cielo's surveillance. If she contacted Connor at this time, she would be walking into a trap.
Although Aida already knew Cielo's true purpose, she could not choose to leave immediately. If she left now, it would mean that she knew what Cielo wanted to do, which would only make things worse.
At this moment, Aida was very frustrated. After all, Cielo's sudden attack had caught her off guard.
...
On the other side, after Connor left the Zook family's birthday party, he followed Queta back to the company.
After all, the Yaeger family had already transferred all five companies to Connor. Hence, Stormbound Real Estate could no longer focus all their energy on real estate development. They needed to put some effort into running these five companies.
Fortunately, Queta had already found her subordinates in Newtown in advance. With the help of these people, it should not be a big problem to run these five companies well.
Connor and Queta had a full day of meetings in the company. Most of the time, they were discussing how to run these five companies.
By the time Connor, Queta, and the others finished their meeting, it was already past five in the afternoon.
Connor packed up his things and was ready to go home.
Ring! Ring!
But at this moment, Connor's phone suddenly rang.
Connor took out his phone and saw that it was Rachel Wallace calling, so he answered the call.

chapters.title: Chapter 1743: The Fortune Teller
chapters.content:
Chapter 1743: The Fortune Teller
"Yes?"
Connor asked impatiently.
"I'll be getting off work soon. Come pick me up!"
Rachel said softly.
"Can't you take a taxi?"
Connor asked speechlessly.
"If I could take a taxi, why would I call you? I forgot to bring money when I left today. Also, Connor, what's with your attitude? Have you forgotten how I helped you with the Collier family? If it wasn't for my help, would you have been able to get Yaakov Ward's hard drive?"
Rachel shouted.
After Connor heard Rachel's words, he had a helpless expression and immediately said in a low voice, "Alright, I got it. I'll go pick you up now!"
After saying that, Connor hung up the phone.
"This lady sure knows how to order me around!"
Connor complained speechlessly and then walked out of the office.
Rachel's university wasn't very far from Stormbound Tower. Connor took about ten minutes to reach the school's gate.
It was time for school to end, so many students walked out of the school.
Yarlford University had a lot of beautiful ladies. A beauty would walk past every one or two minutes.
The car that Connor was driving today was the company's car. It was a Mercedes-Benz that was worth millions.
Although this kind of car was not particularly rare on the road, Connor was driving this kind of car at such a young age, so it attracted the attention of many students.
There were even girls who took the initiative to strike up a conversation with Connor.
If it was before he inherited Steven Lee's inheritance, Connor would definitely be very happy to be hit on by so many beautiful women. However, Connor was no longer in the mood to deal with these students. After all, he already had many women around him. Connor got a headache whenever he thought about these things. How would he still have the mood to hook up with other girls?
After a long time, Rachel finally walked out of the school dressed sexily and beautifully.
Rachel's appearance instantly made all the girls pale in comparison. Rachel was simply too beautiful. Whether it was her figure or her temperament, she was the best of the best. Her dignified and elegant white dress accentuated her graceful figure. However, since it was her first day at school, she had dressed up a little more seriously and was less sexy.
If Rachel dressed like she usually did, she would probably make the boys drool.
Even though she was dressed like this, Rachel still attracted the attention of countless boys.
Soon, Rachel noticed Connor standing by the roadside. Then, she walked gracefully to Connor's side in her high heels.
"Get in the car!"
At this time, Connor seemed to be angry because Rachel was living in his house, so he was being very short with her.
"Do you have to be so angry just because I asked you to pick me up?"
Rachel pouted and responded.
"It isn't about that!"
Connor replied in a low voice.
"Then, what is it about?"
Rachel opened the car door and asked Connor.
"Don't you know why?"
Connor replied indifferently and then was about to start the car.
Boom! Boom! Boom!
However, at this moment, someone suddenly reached out and knocked on Connor's car window.
Connor was stunned for a moment. Then, he looked outside and found a very sloppily dressed man standing beside his car. Moreover, he was smiling at Connor.
Connor looked at the man and hesitated for a couple of seconds. He felt that this man was a beggar, so he didn't think too much about it. He rolled down the window and asked, "Is there something you need?"
"Young man, I'm a fortune teller. Do you want me to read your fortune?"
The man bared his teeth and asked Connor.
"No!"
Connor shook his head without thinking and was about to close the window.
However, the man stopped Connor and said with a smile, "I think you should let me read your fortune!"
Connor looked at the man helplessly. He felt that this man was probably planning to use the excuse of fortune-telling to get some money from him. Connor did not intend to waste time with this man and said, "You want money, right? Here's a hundred, take the money and leave!"
The man looked at the money Connor handed to him and smiled. Then, he said softly, "Young man, money is just a worldly possession. I don't need this kind of stuff!"
"Then, what do you want?"
Connor asked speechlessly.
"I want to give you a divination!"
The man said lightly.
Connor looked at the man helplessly. He felt that this person was really strange. He didn't want money but wanted to read his fortune.
"Since he wants to read your fortune, then let him do it. Otherwise, if he continues to cling to you, you won't be able to leave..."
Rachel said casually while touching up her makeup in the mirror.
Connor felt that Rachel's words made sense. If he didn't let this strange man read his fortune, he would probably be stuck here. Therefore, Connor said impatiently, "Alright, if you want to tell my fortune, then do it!"
"Get out of the car!"
The man looked at Connor and said.
"What do you want?"
Connor asked the man speechlessly.
"Young man, don't worry. I don't have any ill intentions toward you. I just want to read your fortune."
The man explained with a smile.
After hesitating for a moment, Connor pushed open the door and got out of the car.
"Can you do it now?"
Connor asked the man impatiently.
"Young man, it's not convenient to talk here. Let's go somewhere else!"
As the man spoke, he reached out and grabbed Connor.
Connor looked at the man helplessly and then followed him to the side.
"Sir, I'm a busy person. Just tell me what you want!"
Connor said exasperatedly when he saw the man stop in his tracks.
"Young man, the woman beside you is very dangerous. Do you know that?"
The man said mysteriously.
"The one who was sitting in the car just now?"
Connor was stunned for a moment before asking.
"That's right!"
The man looked at Connor and nodded.
"What exactly do you want to tell me?"
Connor asked in confusion.
"Actually, when I passed by the two of you just now, I had already noticed that there was something wrong with your faces…"
The man said in a serious tone.
"There's something wrong with our faces?"
Connor was somewhat puzzled.

chapters.title: Chapter 1744: Fate Intertwined
chapters.content:
Chapter 1744: Fate Intertwined
"Young man, can you let me take a look at your palm?"
The man asked Connor.
Connor hesitated for a moment, but still reached out his right hand to the man.
The man frowned and observed with a serious expression. Then, he said softly, "If I'm not wrong, you're extremely lucky. You have inherited a fortune for no reason. Moreover, you came to Yarlford to get revenge…"
"How did you know that?"
When Connor heard the man's words, he was a little shocked. He was in disbelief.
"I'm able to tell!"
The man smiled and replied.
"Who exactly are you?"
When Connor realized that this man knew him so well, his expression began to change because he was not sure what this man wanted to do.
After all, there were no more than five people who knew that he had inherited Steven Lee's inheritance and that he had come to Yarlford to avenge his parents.
But now, this strange man in front of him knew about these two things. It meant that this man was a little strange.
"Young man, you don't have to be so nervous. I'm just an ordinary fortune-teller. I don't have any ill intentions toward you. If I wanted to hurt you, I would have done it a long time ago."
The man said softly.
Connor looked at the man. He felt that what the man said made sense, so he hesitated for a couple of seconds and asked softly, "What exactly do you want to tell me?"
"The fact that you and I can meet today is considered fate bestowed by the heavens, so I have something to tell you!"
The man said lightly.
"Tell me!"
Connor replied in a low voice.
"First of all, the woman sitting in the car is very dangerous because the two of you are destined to be enemies!"
The man said slowly.
"Andn?"
Connor did not take the man's words seriously at all.
"And... If I'm not wrong, the two of you will fall in love in the future, and this woman will give birth to your child. However, because the two of you are destined to be enemies, one of you will die because of the other…"
The man said with a very serious expression.
When Connor heard the man's words, he was rather helpless.
He frowned and said disdainfully, "What's all this nonsense? I'm not in a relationship with that woman. We're going to fall in love and one of us will die because of the other? Do you think we're acting in a television drama?"
"This is all karma that the heavens have set for you. I'm just a person who can unveil your destiny. You can choose not to believe it!"
The man did not get angry because of Connor's words. Instead, he replied very calmly.
"I think you're a scammer. Just now, you said that I came to Yarlford to get revenge. Then tell me, will I succeed?"
Connor asked the man curiously.
"I can't divine that for the time being. Maybe next time I see you, I'll be able to tell you…"
The man said with a smile.
"Alright, stop playing tricks with me. How much money do you want? Just tell me. I'll take it as doing a good deed!"
Connor took out his wallet as he spoke.
"Since you don't believe what I said just now, I won't take your money!"
The man replied indifferently, then turned around and left.
Connor looked at the man's back and was even more puzzled because he didn't expect this man to not want money.
Originally, Connor thought that this fortune-teller was a swindler who wanted to get some money from him. However, when Connor wanted to give this man money, he did not take a single cent. Connor was confused and lost in his thoughts.
Rachel, who was sitting in the car, saw Connor standing there alone. She was a little puzzled, and then she whispered to Connor, "What are you still standing there for? Didn't that person already leave?"
Connor turned and glanced at Rachel, then got back into the car.
After getting into the car, Connor started the car.
Rachel sized up Connor and then asked him softly, "Did that man say something to you just now?"
"He knew that I came to Yarlford for revenge!"
Connor replied in a low voice.
"There is quite a number of people who know that you plan to get revenge. Moreover, you even caused a scene at Christian Zook's birthday banquet. Now, many people here know about you!"
Rachel said indifferently.
"How did you know that I caused a ruckus at Christian's birthday banquet?"
Connor asked in confusion.
"How can I not know what you're doing? Don't forget who I am. It's not something that's difficult to find out."
Rachel pursed her lips and responded.
"Oh, I see!"
Connor nodded thoughtfully and did not continue to say anything.
"If that man only told you that, you wouldn't have reacted like this. Did he say something else?"
Rachel looked at Connor and continued to ask.
"He also said that our fates are intertwined and countering each other. Moreover, you will give birth to a child for me in the future. However, one of us will die because of the other…"
Connor said slowly.
"Really?"
Rachel asked in surprise.
"Yeah!"
Connor nodded helplessly.
Rachel looked at Connor and hesitated for a couple of seconds before laughing out loud.
Connor looked at Rachel speechlessly and asked softly, "What are you laughing at?"
"I'm laughing at how naive you are to believe such words. How could I possibly fall for you? This is hilarious. If you're worried about this, then I advise you not to worry. I'll never fall in love with you, and we won't have a relationship together."
Rachel looked at Connor and said with a smile.
"What do you mean by that? You're saying as if I'm interested in you."
Connor hurriedly retorted.
"You don't like me, and I don't like you. Then, what are you worried about?"
Rachel pouted and asked.
