Connor turned and looked at Rachel without saying anything. He continued driving seriously.
...

chapters.title: Chapter 1745: Best Friend
chapters.content:
Chapter 1745: Best Friend
On the other side.
Aida Collier sat alone in the room and hesitated for a long time. She felt that her only hope of survival was to seek Connor's help.
Although Aida was a martial artist, her combat ability was not very high. If Cielo Collier managed to find a professional assassin, Aida would definitely die.
However, Aida didn't know how to contact Connor.
Her room was probably being monitored by Cielo, and her phone might have been tapped. If she were to contact Connor, not only would she not get Connor's help, but she would also expose her relationship with him.
Therefore, Aida was very anxious. She didn't know what she should do.
Ring! Ring!
However, at this moment, Aida's phone suddenly rang.
When Aida heard the ringtone, she instantly became nervous, because she was worried that Connor would call her.
Aida took a deep breath and took out her phone.
When Aida saw the name on the phone screen, she was instantly relaxed.
Because the person who called Aida was not Connor, but her best friend.
Aida calmed herself down and answered the call. She asked softly, "Sofia?"
"Aida, I heard that you're in Yarlford."
The other party asked with a smile.
"Yeah. I came to Yarlford to attend a birthday banquet…"
Aida nodded.
"What a coincidence. You haven't left Yarlford yet, right?"
The other party asked excitedly.
"I haven't left yet. Are you also in Yarlford?"
Aida asked in confusion.
"Yeah, I just came back yesterday. I heard from my friend that you're in Yarlford, so I called you. I didn't expect you to really be here. We haven't seen each other for a long time. Do you want to meet up now?"
The other party asked her warmly.
"Alright!"
Aida had been looking for a suitable opportunity to leave the room, so she immediately agreed to the invitation.
"I'll wait for you at Pure K Bar!"
The woman said happily.
"Alright, I'll go there now!"
Aida agreed and hung up the phone.
After putting down her phone, Aida tidied up her bag and left the room.
After leaving the room, Aida hesitated for a couple of seconds before knocking on Cielo's door.
Cielo opened the door and asked Aida softly, "Aida, what's wrong?"
"Cielo, you wanted me to go to Gevada in your stead, right? So, can you help me get a refund for my tickets back to Yarlford?"
Aida whispered to Cielo.
"Alright, I got it!"
Cielo hurriedly nodded and sized up Aida. He then asked in confusion, "Are you going out?"
"Yeah. Sofia Lyon called me just now. She's in Yarlford and wants to meet me…"
Aida told him.
"Oh. I haven't seen her in a long time. Why don't I drive you there?"
Cielo pretended to be happy.
"It's okay. You're going back tomorrow. You'd better hurry up and pack your things!"
Aida quickly refused.
After hesitating for a moment, Cielo didn't say anything else. After all, he was about to make a move on Aida. He felt that if he acted too enthusiastically now, it might arouse Aida's suspicion.
"Alright, then be careful!"
Cielo said with a smile.
"I know. Don't worry!"
Aida nodded and turned to leave.
However, just as Aida stepped out of the hotel, Cielo took out his phone and made a call.
"Mr. Cielo, do you have any orders?"
The other party asked in a low voice.
"Aida just left the hotel. Follow her and see who she's going to meet!"
Cielo said expressionlessly.
"Alright, I understand…"
The other party agreed and hung up the phone.
...
On the other side, after Aida left the hotel, she drove straight to the bar.
Perhaps because she knew that Cielo was about to attack her, Aida paid extra attention to her surroundings.
Sure enough, Aida soon discovered that a black Audi was closely following her.
Aida was a little helpless. She had originally planned to take this opportunity to look for Connor, but now that someone was following her, she could only give up on this idea and drive to the place she had agreed to meet with her best friend.
After entering the bar, Aida walked around the bar, but she did not find her best friend, so she sat alone in a corner and waited.
The few people who had been following Aida entered the bar as well. They then sat down less than ten meters away from Aida, constantly observing her.
Aida hesitated for a moment before taking out her phone to call her best friend.
But at this moment, a woman in a tight black skirt and high heels walked up to Aida.
The woman appeared very flirtatious. Her wine-red long hair added an alluring aura. Her seductive figure coupled with her sexy short skirt made her look exceptionally charming.
"Sofia, you're here!"
When Aida saw the woman, she quickly waved.
"Darling, we haven't seen each other for two years, right?"
Sofia went up and gave Aida a big hug.
"That's right. I can't believe you've been overseas for two years, and I didn't have time to look for you!"
Aida replied softly.
"Aida, you're even more beautiful now. When can I be as beautiful as you?"
Sofia looked at Aida's delicate face and tall figure and said with envy.
"Don't flatter me. You're much prettier than me…"
Aida replied with a smile, then continued to ask, "By the way, I heard that you set up a company in the U.K.. How's it going?"
"It's pretty good. Although I don't earn much, at the very least, I don't need my father to invest money in it. I think I should be able to make a profit in a few more years…"
Sofia said happily.
"That's good…"
Aida nodded gently.

chapters.title: Chapter 1746: Seeking Help
chapters.content:
Chapter 1746: Seeking Help
"I heard a lot of things about you when I returned to Yarlford this time. They all said that you are with Juan Gomez of the Gomez family."
"Don't listen to their nonsense. Juan and I are just ordinary friends!"
Aida denied.
"That's too bad, then. Juan is a well-known young master in Yarlford. There are countless women in Yarlford who want to marry him. If there is such an opportunity, you must seize it!"
Sofia said to Aida with an unusually serious expression.
Aida looked at Sofia and sighed softly. Then, she said expressionlessly, "Others may not understand me, but do you not understand me? I'm not interested in people like Juan at all, and I won't sacrifice my happiness for the Collier family…"
"What do you mean? Do you already have a boyfriend?"
Sofia blinked and asked.
"I don't have a boyfriend…"
Aida rolled her eyes at Sofia.
At this time, Aida had been observing those people who were monitoring her. She knew that she could not ask Sofia for help yet.
"If you don't have a boyfriend, then you must have someone you like!"
Sofia said with a smile.
"I don't have anyone I like either!"
Aida shook her head.
"How is that possible? Are you going to tell me that you haven't been in a relationship while I was abroad?"
Sofia asked in surprise.
"Yeah. I've not been in a relationship…"
Aida said helplessly.
"Isn't it a pity for a beauty like you not to be in a relationship? Do you not want to find a boyfriend? Does that mean that your first kiss hasn't been taken yet?"
Sofia asked Aida curiously.
Aida couldn't help but be stunned when she heard this. She suddenly remembered how Connor had forced a kiss on her in the Collier family's place.
Aida cared a lot about her first kiss, so whenever she thought about how her first kiss had been taken away, she felt a little angry.
Sofia noticed that there was something wrong with Aida's expression. She quickly smiled and said, "Aida, is your first kiss gone? Then, who did you give it to? Did you have a secret relationship with some man? I knew it. You're not a child. How can you not think about that…"
"What are you talking about?"
Aida blushed as she shouted speechlessly.
"You know very well what I'm talking about. Who did you give your first kiss to? Quickly tell me, I'm a little curious about who was so lucky to be able to catch your eye!"
Sofia asked as she drank.
"Don't spout nonsense here…"
Aida said helplessly.
"Alright, stop hiding it from me. We're best friends, so I know you well. When I was talking about this just now, you frowned a little. This means that your first kiss must have been taken by someone. But you said that you've never been in a relationship, so you must..."
Sofia analyzed confidently.
"Must what?"
Aida asked in confusion.
"You must have had a one-night stand with someone, right?"
Sofia asked sweetly.
"What are you talking about? Do you think I'm that kind of person?"
After hearing Sofia's words, Aida was even more exasperated.
"What are you embarrassed about? This is very normal overseas. You don't have a boyfriend, and at our age, it's normal to get a little impatient. I've done that with someone before, and it was very exciting. Also, it didn't affect my life. I think this is very normal. You don't have to feel embarrassed!"
Sofia said casually.
"Don't spout nonsense here. I've never had a one-night stand…"
Aida explained in despair.
Aida's way of thinking was very different from Sofia's. She was a more traditional woman, so she had always done her best to protect her body. She would only give herself to the person she loved once she had found him. Therefore, before that, Aida would not have sex with any man.
Of course, Aida was also very concerned about her first kiss. That was why her expression turned ugly when she heard Sofia's words.
Because her first kiss was taken away by Connor.
Sofia saw that there was something wrong with Aida's expression, so she stopped joking and said softly, "That's strange. Since you didn't have a one-night stand, and you haven't been in a relationship, what happened to your first kiss?"
"This is all because of an accident…"
Aida said helplessly.
"What happened? I'm very curious about who stole your first kiss. Hurry up and tell me!"
Sofia asked Aida curiously.
"Forget it. Let's talk about something else. I don't want to talk about this now…"
Aida said softly.
"Alright, alright. Since you don't want to tell me, forget it!"
Sofia seemed to be able to feel that Aida was not in a good mood, so she did not continue to ask.
"Aida, did something happen to you? Why do I feel like you're not very happy? Did I say something wrong just now?"
Sofia asked Aida softly.
Aida instinctively looked at the people who had been watching her. She saw that those people were drinking.
It seemed that they knew that Aida had come out to meet a woman, so they had let down their guard.
"Sofia, I need your help with something!"
Aida seized the opportunity to speak quickly.
"What is it? Tell me. As long as it's something I can help you with, I'll definitely do my best!"
Sofia agreed without thinking.
"Someone wants to kill me…"
Aida said in a low voice.
When Sofia heard Aida's words, she couldn't help but be stunned for a moment.
However, this woman was not an ordinary person. Her family was quite influential overseas. In addition, she knew very well what kind of situation Aida's family was in. Even if someone really wanted to kill Aida, Sofia would not think it was odd.
Sofia quickly calmed herself down. She said in a low voice, "Aida, what's going on?"
"There are two people behind us who are drinking and chatting with each other. They were sent by Cielo to spy on me!"
Aida replied in a low voice.

chapters.title: Chapter 1747: Who Are You?
chapters.content:
Chapter 1747: Who Are You?
"So it's Cielo who wants to kill you!"
Sofia instantly understood what was going on.
"Cielo doesn't have the guts to do so. It must be Shereen Stevens's idea. They think that I'll marry Juan, so they're worried that it might affect Cielo's inheritance of the Collier family's business. That's why they're planning to make a move on me in advance!"
Aida said nonchalantly as she sipped her red wine.
"Isn't Shereen Stevens much too ruthless for wanting to kill you? How could she do something like this!"
Sofia took a deep breath and continued, "Then what do you need me to do now? Our family only has power in the U.K.. If I help you find someone now, will it be too late?"
"It's definitely too late now. If we wait until you find someone, I will surely die in Cielo's hands!"
Aida shook her head gently.
"What should we do now?"
When Sofia heard Aida's words, she was very anxious.
She was really worried about Aida.
"You don't have to worry. The assassins that Cielo hired should be here tomorrow. They might choose to attack me in Yarlford or Gevada, so I still have some time!"
Aida paused for a moment before continuing, "Sofia, there is only one person in Yarlford who can save me now. But because my phone is being tapped, and no matter where I go, there are people following me, if I shake off these people, Cielo will know that I've found out he wants to kill me. So, I can't shake off these people yet..."
"Then, what can I do?"
Sofia hurriedly asked.
"I'll send a text message to your phone later. It's a phone number. Help me contact this person and tell him to meet me in Room 402 of this bar at three o'clock tomorrow afternoon. Tell him that it's something very important and he will most probably come!"
Aida had already thought of a solution and told Sofia.
"Alright, I got it!"
Sofia hurriedly nodded.
"Oh right, remember to tell that person to come at three o'clock. Because Cielo will have just boarded the plane at that time, so he probably won't be monitoring me that closely."
Aida continued.
"Alright, I'll remember that!"
Sofia nodded again.
"Then, tomorrow afternoon at around 2:00 pm, you find a way to enter the hotel I'm staying at from the back door. Then, you wear my clothes and go out. You can help me lure away the person who's watching me. I'll meet that person and tell him about the situation. Do you understand what I mean?"
Aida was about the same height as Sofia, and their figures were similar. As long as Sofia wore Aida's clothes, a hat, and sunglasses, ordinary people would not be able to tell them apart.
Therefore, Aida's idea was to have Sofia distract the people who were following her, and then she would meet Connor to seek help.
"I got it. I'll call this guy later. Then, I'll book a room at the hotel you're staying at tonight. That way, I don't have to sneak in. I'll just wait to get my clothes from you tomorrow afternoon!"
Sofia thought for a moment and said softly to Aida.
"Alright, thank you, Sofia!"
Aida said gratefully.
"There's no need to thank me. No matter what, this concerns your life and death. I might not be able to help you with other things, but I can still help you with such a small matter!"
Sofia said with a smile.
Aida looked at Sofia and felt a little helpless. Her family had always been thinking about how to kill her, but her friend was the one saving her.
Sometimes, Aida felt that such a life was actually quite miserable.
Aida left the bar after briefly explaining her plan to Sofia.
Sofia did not leave with Aida to avoid attracting the attention of the people following her. Instead, she stayed in the bar for a while.
Sofia walked out of the bar alone after Aida returned to the hotel.
After leaving the bar, Sofia hailed a taxi back to the hotel where she was staying in. Then, she called her friend and asked her friend to book a room at the hotel where Aida was staying.
By the time everything was done, it was already past eleven o'clock at night.
Sofia felt that no one was following her now, so she saved the number that Aida had sent her and dialed it.
Ring, ring, ring…
The phone rang several times before Connor picked up the call.
"Who is it?"
At this time, Connor had already fallen asleep and asked in a daze.
"Are you Aida's friend?"
Sofia asked cautiously.
"Aida?"
Connor couldn't help but be stunned for a moment when he heard this sentence. Then, he instantly sobered up and asked in a low voice, "Who are you?"
"I'm Aida's best friend. Aida asked me to call you!"
Sofia said softly.
"Did something happen?"
Connor frowned and asked.
"Aida wants you to meet her at Pure K Bar's Room 402 at 3 p.m. tomorrow. She has something very important to tell you."
Sofia said seriously.
"What exactly is it?"
Connor asked.
I can't tell you the details over the phone. Anyway, this is really important. You must go there at three tomorrow!"
As Aida said that she couldn't tell Connor everything, Sofia couldn't tell him what had happened.
After hearing Sofia's words, Connor hesitated for a couple of seconds before asking softly, "How can you prove that you are Aida's friend?"
"How am I supposed to prove that? If I wasn't Aida's friend, why would I have your phone number? I'm not joking with you right now, this matter concerns her life and death, so you must go tomorrow!"
Sofia shouted helplessly.
"Why didn't Aida contact me personally?"
Connor continued to ask.
"Aida's phone is being tapped, so she can only rely on me to contact you!"
Sofia hurriedly said.
"Alright, I understand…"
Connor nodded lightly.
"Will you be there tomorrow?"
Sofia seemed to be a little worried as she asked in a low voice.
"Mhm, I'll be there!"
Connor agreed and hung up the phone.
Connor had no way to confirm if the person who called him was Aida's friend.
However, Connor felt that the other party was really anxious. Moreover, not many people knew about Connor's relationship with Aida, so Connor chose to believe this woman's words and would be going to the Pure K Bar tomorrow to see what was going on.
...

chapters.title: Chapter 1748: Using Tricks to Escape
chapters.content:
Chapter 1748: Using Tricks to Escape
The next day, at two o'clock in the afternoon.
Sofia followed Aida's instructions and changed into Aida's clothes. Then, she drove Aida's car and left the hotel.
The two men who had been lying in ambush at the entrance of the hotel saw Aida leave and immediately followed her.
But the real Aida was standing in front of the window of the hotel room.
In fact, Aida knew that it would be dangerous for Sofia to impersonate her, but Cielo had just boarded the plane and had not returned home yet, so he definitely would not attack her right now.
After Sofia had completely lured away Cielo's assassins, Aida put on her hat and sunglasses and walked out of the hotel alone.
After leaving the hotel, Aida hailed a taxi.
"Miss, where are you going?"
The taxi driver asked softly.
"Pure K Bar!"
Aida replied in a low voice.
"Alright!"
The taxi driver then started the car.
Aida was feeling very complicated because all her hopes were on Connor. If Connor went to the bar today and agreed to help her, then she might have a chance of survival.
However, if Connor didn't go to the bar at all, or if he didn't agree to help, then Aida would die.
Because Aida could not find anyone else to help her now.
The bar had just opened for business, so there were not many customers inside.
When Aida appeared in the bar, she instantly attracted the attention of countless men. Even though Aida was wearing sunglasses and a hat, her temperament was not something that could be blocked by these things. Therefore, many people wanted to strike up a conversation with Aida.
But Aida didn't even look at them and walked straight to the bar manager.
"Hello, beautiful. How can I help you?"
The bar manager asked Aida politely.
"Is there anyone in room 402 now?"
Aida asked softly.
"No."
The manager replied.
"Open it for me…"
As Aida spoke, she took out a bank card and continued, "Order me the most expensive wine set in your bar. Then, give me a bottle of red wine. There's no need to serve the rest of the wine..."
"What do you mean?"
The bar manager looked at Aida with a puzzled expression.
After all, the most expensive wine set in their bar cost at least 100,000 dollars. It was the first time he had met such a customer.
"I don't want anyone to enter that private room and disturb me before four o'clock..."
Aida said expressionlessly.
"Alright…"
After hearing Aida's words, the bar manager understood what was going on and quickly nodded.
A moment later, Aida followed the manager into the private room.
After entering the private room, Aida poured herself a glass of red wine, then sat on the sofa and waited quietly.
At this moment, Aida was very nervous. After all, her life was in Connor's hands.
Time passed, but Connor still did not appear.
Aida began to become anxious. She took out her phone and was about to call Connor, but she remembered that her phone was being tapped. If she called Connor, everything would be exposed.
Therefore, Aida had no other choice but to continue waiting.
However, Aida did not know that Connor was actually outside the bar, but he did not get out of the car for a long time.
Because Connor was still not sure if Aida was the one who wanted to see him.
If Aida's identity had been exposed and it was a trap set up by the Collier family, it would be troublesome.
However, after hesitating for a long time, Connor finally decided to walk into the bar.
After entering the bar, Connor went straight to Room 402 and knocked on the door gently.
When Aida heard the knock on the door, she became a little excited. She immediately ran to the door and opened the door that she had locked.
Connor looked at Aida from head to toe. Today, Aida was dressed in a casual manner. She was wearing a pure white T-shirt, a pair of denim shorts, and a pair of black high heels.
Even though she was dressed casual, Aida was charming enough.
Aida was indeed very beautiful. Her figure and face were considered perfect. Otherwise, she would definitely not be able to charm Juan Gomez.
Of course, the most charming thing about Aida was her temperament.
Perhaps it was because of her background, but Aida really gave off the feeling of a princess. Even in this situation, she still exuded waves of arrogance.
Under normal circumstances, such a woman was more likely to attract men, because whoever could have such a woman as his own was something to be proud of.
"Is there something you need from me?"
Connor asked Aida softly.
"I've been waiting for so long! Time is of the essence..."
Aida exclaimed.
"You didn't tell me what happened, did you? Besides, I don't know if the woman who called me was your friend or not. I waited outside the bar for a long time before coming in. If it wasn't for you helping me last time, I wouldn't have come today…"
Connor replied indifferently.
"What…"
Aida was speechless after hearing Connor's words.
Connor walked over to the sofa and sat down. Then he poured himself a glass of red wine and said to Aida with a smile, "Alright, just tell me what you want from me…"
"Connor, I helped you out last time. You trust me now, right?"
Aida asked Connor softly.
"I'm sorry, but I still can't trust you 100%!"
Connor lightly shook his head.
"Why? Do you know how much risk I took to help you last time?"
Aida shouted.
"You did help me last time, but that doesn't mean anything. After all, the person who kidnapped me last time was the Yaeger family, not your family or the Gomez family, so that can't be a reason for you to really want to cooperate with me!"
Connor paused for a moment and then continued, "Besides, I kissed you and threatened you last time. Most importantly, you even stole Yaakov Ward's hard drive. You even lied to me with an empty hard drive. You're too cunning. I really can't trust that you'll sincerely cooperate with me."

chapters.title: Chapter 1749: Being a Bodyguard
chapters.content:
Chapter 1749: Being a Bodyguard
Aida was belittled by Connor's words. She was a little angry, and she subconsciously clenched her fists.
She originally thought that after the previous incident, Connor would trust her, but she did not expect him to be so cautious.
Of course, Connor couldn't be blamed for this. After all, Aida had indeed lied to Connor several times.
Connor would never completely trust this woman.
Although Aida was furious, she didn't dare to show it because she needed Connor's help.
"Alright, tell me, why are you looking for me?"
Connor asked Aida softly.
"I need your help!"
Aida said in a low voice.
"Of course, I know you need my help. Otherwise, you wouldn't be in such a rush. But I don't know what you need my help with!"
Connor replied indifferently.
"I need you to go to Gevada with me and then send me back to York!"
Aida told him.
"Haha…"
Connor couldn't help but sneer when he heard Aida's words. Then he said indifferently, "Miss Aida, do you think I have nothing to do? I'm not your bodyguard. Why should I accompany you to Gevada? I have a lot of things to do now. If you really need someone to protect you, you can find a professional bodyguard!"
Connor was very speechless because he never thought that Aida would ask him to be her bodyguard.
"Connor, you don't have to talk to me like this. If it's not my last resort, I definitely won't ask you for help!"
Aida finally couldn't help but shout. "If you help me this time, it won't be for nothing. If you have any conditions, you can tell me…"
"This isn't about that. Besides, I just don't understand. If you really need bodyguards, you can get them using money. Why do you have to come to me? I'm not a bodyguard!"
Connor asked Aida in confusion.
"Where am I going to find a bodyguard now? If I wait until I find a bodyguard, I might already be dead. Moreover, the bodyguards that can be found on the market now can't protect me."
Aida said in despair.
"Oh yeah, if you didn't mention it, I would have forgotten. Aren't you a martial artist yourself? You don't need anyone to protect you!"
Connor said with a smile.
At this moment, Aida was completely speechless. She looked at Connor and didn't know what to say.
If it wasn't because she really didn't have any other way, she really wouldn't have come to beg Connor.
Aida had chosen Connor for a simple reason. Connor was strong, so even if Cielo found an assassin to deal with her, Connor could handle that person. Moreover, Cielo's intention to kill her could not be known to too many people, or else the Collier family would definitely be in chaos. Therefore, she could only choose Connor.
"If I could protect myself, I wouldn't have come to you!"
Aida looked at Connor and said.
"What exactly happened?"
Connor hesitated for a moment before asking Aida.
"Someone is trying to kill me, so I need your protection!"
Aida didn't intend to hide anything from Connor and directly said.
Connor couldn't help but laugh when he heard Aida's words. Then, he said calmly, "Don't joke with me. If you had told me this before I came to Yarlford, I might have believed you. But you are now Juan's girlfriend. Who would dare to kill you?"
"Juan and I are not together!"
Aida emphasized.
"But the outside world seems to already think so. No one in Yarlford would dare to attack you!"
Connor said lightly.
"The people who want to kill me are Cielo and his mother, Shereen Stevens!"
Aida explained helplessly.
"Haha…"
Connor looked at Aida and smiled, then said lightly, "I didn't expect you two siblings to be so interesting. You're so focused on dealing with Cielo now, and Cielo is also planning to deal with you now. Children from big families are really different. You don't think about how to deal with enemies outside, but how to deal with your own family..."
"Cielo thinks that I will be with Juan. That way, I will have the support of the Gomez family. Therefore, he wants to get rid of me first so that he can inherit the Collier family's assets in peace..."
Aida said expressionlessly.
"I get it now. You're killing each other for the Collier family's business."
Connor replied indifferently and then continued, "But this is an internal matter of the Collier family. It has nothing to do with me. I have no reason to help you!"
"But didn't you already cooperate with me once before?"
Aida said with a frown.
"That's right, I wanted to work with you, but I can't help you with this!"
"Why?"
Aida asked in confusion.
"It's very simple. I can't trust you!"
Connor replied seriously.
"What does this have to do with whether you trust me or not?"
Aida looked at Connor and frowned slightly.
"You are a shrewd woman. I don't know which side you are on now. I just offended the Gomez family and the Zook family yesterday. They will definitely think of a way to deal with me now. However, you're now asking me to go with you to Gevada. For all I know, you may have joined forces with the Gomez family."
Connor said expressionlessly.
"I'm not lying to you. Cielo is really going to kill me. There's no benefit in lying to you now!"
Aida hurriedly explained.
"Even if you aren't lying to me, I don't intend to get involved with the Collier family!"
Connor shook his head at Aida.
"Connor, do you think that if you don't get involved in these things, these things will really have nothing to do with you?"
Aida suddenly asked Connor coldly.
"What do you mean by that?"
Connor frowned and asked.
"Cielo plans to attack me in Yarlford. He has already left Yarlford. If anything happens to me, everyone in the Collier family will think that you were the one who did it. At that time, the Collier family will definitely do everything they can to get rid of you. You're able to advance further right now, but once I die, the Collier family and the Gomez family will not give you any more time!"
Aida paused for a moment before continuing, "Don't forget that Juan saw what you were doing with me at the birthday banquet of the Zook family. I'm not only the daughter of the Collier family, but also the future daughter-in-law of the Gomez family!"

chapters.title: Chapter 1750: I Just Want to Live
chapters.content:
Chapter 1750: I Just Want to Live
"If the Collier family and the Gomez family want to deal with me, then let them deal with me. Anyway, I came to Yarlford this time for them!"
Connor said indifferently.
"If you really have the ability to deal with the Gomez family now, why don't you do it?"
Aida asked coldly.
Connor was stunned when he heard Aida's words.
"You can't deal with the Gomez family now, so once I die, it will just make things even more difficult for you. Also, if I'm alive, I can cooperate with you from the inside and outside. This way, you can deal with the Gomez family faster. I know that your company is developing very fast now, but without my help, it'll be a dream for you to get rid of Yamino Gomez!"
Aida paused for a moment, then looked at Connor and continued, "There's only one person in this world who can help you now, and that person is me!
"If I die, it won't do you any good. Also, if I die, you will definitely fall faster. If I live, the probability of you overthrowing the Gomez family will be much higher!"
"Are you threatening me?"
Connor said with a smile.
"Why would I threaten you? I'm just analyzing the current situation with you. If you still don't believe me, then there's nothing I can do!"
Aida let out a long sigh after saying that.
Connor looked at Aida and hesitated for a couple of seconds, then smiled and said, "What you said sounds reasonable. I'm also a little tempted by what you said. But I still think that it's too dangerous to work with a woman like you. Why don't you find someone else…"
"After all that, why are you still rejecting me? Do you really not see the seriousness of the situation?"
Aida asked Connor with a frown.
"I understand what you're saying, but I don't want to take this risk!"
Connor said lightly.
"There's no risk to you in this matter!"
Aida hurriedly said.
"There's no risk to me?"
When Connor heard Aida's words, he couldn't help but sneer. Then, he said indifferently, "What kind of joke are you playing with me here? Cielo has found an assassin to kill you. Why would I get involved when I have nothing better to do? What if I accidentally die? Just because of your request, I have to take the risk to go to Gevada with you? I'm not stupid, you know."
"..."
Aida looked at Connor without saying anything.
"If you were my friend or we had some other relationship, I might consider helping you. But the two of us are not even friends. Also, you've schemed against me twice. Who knows what tricks you're planning this time? I'm telling you, I won't be fooled!"
Connor said to Aida very seriously.
After taking a deep breath, Aida said in a low voice, "But I did help you back then!"
"You've helped me and harmed me before. The two of us are considered even now!"
Connor replied lightly.
"You're so shameless. Cielo only hired ordinary assassins. You have no problem dealing with those assassins. Besides, don't you have a very powerful bodyguard by your side?"
At this moment, Aida finally couldn't control her emotions and shouted at Connor.
"My bodyguard is here to protect me, not you. Besides, I can't bring him to Gevada with you. You should find someone else. I'm not going…"
Connor continued to shake his head.
Aida looked at Connor from head to toe. She knew very well that although Connor had been rejecting her all this while, he had not left yet. This meant that Connor was waiting for something he wanted.
As long as she could give Connor something he wanted, he would definitely agree to it.
"Connor, you just acquired five companies a few days ago, right?"
Aida asked Connor softly.
"Yes!"
Connor nodded.
"That's great. I also have two companies in my hands now. These two companies have always been cooperating with the Gomez family. If you can promise to protect me, I can stop the cooperation between these two companies and the Gomez family and instead cooperate with your company!"
Aida whispered to Connor.
"Aren't you afraid of being discovered by the Collier family and the Gomez family?"
Connor asked in confusion.
"These two companies are run by my family. No one knows that these two companies are mine, so it doesn't matter if I cooperate with you!"
Aida explained.
Connor hesitated for a moment, then shook his head and said, "That won't do either. I don't think it's worth it to take such a big risk just for the cooperation with the two companies…"
Aida sized Connor up and said in a low voice, "The market value of these two companies is over 100 million. I can give these two companies to you now. How about that?"
"You sure about that?"
Connor was surprised to hear Aida's words.
"I just want to live!"
When Aida said this, she was obviously a little desolate. These two companies were her blood and sweat. If it was not her last resort, she would not have been willing to give them up.
Aida's reaction also made Connor realize that she really needed his help.
"I still don't think it's right for me to help you. If there's nothing else, I'll be leaving now..."
After saying that, Connor stood up and wanted to leave.
"Connor, I'm begging you. Will you just help me this time?"
Aida, who had always been high and mighty, finally put down her dignity and shouted at Connor.
"..."
Connor turned and glanced at Aida without saying anything.
"If I really had any other options, I wouldn't have asked you for help. Now, most of the Collier family is on Cielo's side. Even Beau Collier supports Cielo as the next head of the Collier family."
Aida exclaimed.
"You can go to Juan!"
Connor replied indifferently.
"Juan?
Aida shook her head lightly when she heard the name. Then, she said in a low voice, "If I ask Juan for help, I will have to stay with Juan. In the future, I will also become Juan's puppet."
Connor looked at Aida and said nothing.

chapters.title: Chapter 1751: An Absurd Request
chapters.content:
Chapter 1751: An Absurd Request
"Connor, you should know that most of the Collier family's businesses are now under my control. I have a lot of funds and resources. If I survive, you will only gain benefits from our cooperation. As long as you can help me, I can agree to any conditions!"
Seeing that Connor was still silent, Aida hurriedly shouted.
"If I still choose not to help you, won't that be a little too heartless?"
Connor said with a smile.
"Does that mean you're going to help me?"
Aida asked excitedly.
"You've never been in a relationship, right?"
Connor asked Aida softly.
"Yeah, why?"
Aida asked in confusion.
"How about this? As long as you give me your first time, I'll help you."
Connor said calmly.
Aida was stunned for a moment after hearing Connor's words, and then she immediately scoffed.
"What are you laughing at?"
Connor asked Aida.
"I didn't expect you to be so wretched!"
Aida said disdainfully.
Aida had been forcefully kissed by Connor before, but she had always felt that he did not do it on purpose. After all, the situation at that time was particularly urgent.
However, when Aida heard Connor's request, she felt that Connor must be doing it on purpose.
Aida intended to leave her body to her future lover, so she would not agree to Connor's outrageous request no matter what.
At this moment, Aida wanted to kill Connor because she felt that he was deliberately humiliating her.
Aida had never met such a shameless man.
"Miss Aida, it doesn't matter if you think I'm wretched or shameless. Anyway, this is my condition. As long as you agree to it, I can help you. If you don't agree to it, then you can find someone else!"
Connor said to Aida with a smile.
Aida looked at Connor and took a deep breath. Then, she said in a low voice, "Stop dreaming. I will never agree to your condition."
"You're rejecting me just like that?"
Connor smiled and said, "It's good that you rejected me. I don't have to get myself into trouble with you. You should think of another way to deal with your own matters. I'm not in the mood to waste time with you here..."
"Can you change your condition?"
Aida whispered to Connor.
"No!"
Connor shook his head and smiled. "Actually, you just need to take off your clothes and lie on the bed with me for a night. After all, I have to risk my life to protect you. If I can sleep with a woman like you for a night, even death is worth it. I mean, it's not that big a price to pay, right? After all, it's human nature to want to do it. You're not going to stay single forever, right?"
In fact, Connor was deliberately making things sound so unpleasant.
Besides, Connor didn't really intend to do anything with Aida. The reason why Connor proposed this condition was very simple. He was testing Aida's reaction.
In the end, Connor still couldn't trust Aida. He was not able to tell if Aida was telling the truth and was really asking him for help.
That was why Connor had made such a ridiculous request. Aida cared about her body very much. If Aida could agree to this request, it meant that she had really reached a dead end.
However, if Aida did not agree to this request, Connor would have to consider whether he should help her.
Aida looked at Connor and took a deep breath. She tried to calm herself down and said in a low voice, "Connor, do you have to play around with me right now? As long as you propose a normal condition, I will agree to it!"
"Is the condition I proposed not normal enough? I'm a man, and I'm definitely interested in a beauty like you. You using your body for one night to exchange for your life isn't that big of an ask, is it?"
Connor was still deliberately provoking Aida.
"Other than this condition, I can agree to anything else!"
Aida bit her lips and whispered to Connor.
"I'm sorry. I just want to experience your unknown elegance, Miss Aida. So, other than this condition, I won't agree to any other conditions!"
Connor pretended to stare at Aida with a lecherous look as he spoke.
Aida looked at Connor angrily and didn't say anything.
"Since you don't agree to my condition, then forget it. I still have a lot of things waiting for me to deal with. I'll be leaving now!"
Connor hesitated for a moment before getting up, wanting to leave.
When Aida saw that Connor was really leaving, she was very anxious.
She knew that without Connor's help, she wouldn't be able to return to York alive. Cielo's men might attack her tonight. Aida hadn't avenged her mother yet, so she really didn't want to die like this. In the face of death, anyone would feel fear in their hearts.
Aida was the same.
However, Connor's request was too much. Aida really couldn't agree to it.
"Connor, can't you change your condition?"
Aida shouted anxiously.
"I can't…"
Connor lightly shook his head.
At this moment, Connor felt that there was nothing better than this to test whether Aida was really in trouble, so he could not change his condition.
"Miss Aida, to be honest with you, a figure like yours and a face like yours are the best of the best. Also, you've always looked high and mighty. If I can get you, it will definitely be very exciting!"
Connor said with a smile.
"Connor, I didn't expect you to be so shameless. Even if I die, I won't agree to your request!"
Aida was completely enraged by Connor's words. She shouted at Connor angrily.
"Since you're so unwilling, then I won't force you to accept my condition. I guess it's just not meant to be!"
Connor sighed softly and then strode away, intending to leave.
"Connor, wait a moment!"
Aida hurriedly shouted at Connor.
"Have you changed your mind?"
Connor turned and asked Aida.
"I can tell you a piece of news that is very important to you!"
Aida whispered to Connor.

chapters.title: Chapter 1752: Hostess?
chapters.content:
Chapter 1752: Hostess?
"Is there any news that will attract me more than your body?"
Connor said faintly.
"This news concerns your parents. Are you really not interested at all?"
Aida looked at Connor and said.
"My parents?"
When Connor heard Aida's words, his expression shifted.
"That's right, this matter might be related to your father's identity and why Yamino Gomez killed your father. I don't believe that you're not interested in all that!"
Aida said coldly.
"What are you trying to say?"
Connor looked at Aida and frowned slightly.
"Back then, Yamino had a right-hand man by his side. This person had been by Yamino's side for many years. I don't know his name, but many people called him a Grand Master. Many things in the Gomez family were done by his Grand Master to help Yamino. However, later on, for some reason, this person embezzled a large sum of money from the Gomez family and then disappeared. No one knows where he went. Yamino has been looking for this person for so many years. Because this person knows too many business secrets of the Gomez family!"
Aida said slowly.
"And?"
Connor frowned and asked.
"A few days ago, I suddenly heard Juan bring this person up to Yamino, and they seem to know the exact location of this person. Now, the Gomez family is preparing to look for this person!"
Aida paused for a moment before continuing, "As long as you can protect my safety, as a deal, I can do everything I can to help you find out the whereabouts of this Grand Master!"
"So what if we find this person?"
Connor pretended to be indifferent and said indifferently.
"At that time, this person's position was second only to Yamino. If you can find this person, then you will know what happened back then. Do you really think Yamino killed your father because he threatened his position? Let me tell you, it's definitely not that simple. There are many things that you don't know about!"
Aida was intentionally making this person sound important as her goal was to get Connor to help her.
"Why didn't you tell me about this earlier?"
Connor looked at Aida and asked.
"I only found out about this when I came to Yarlford this time. Also, I've been monitored by Cielo all this while. I didn't have the chance to see you at all."
Aida's reaction was very fast as she hurriedly explained.
However, Aida didn't plan to tell Connor about this because she was waiting for a suitable opportunity to tell him about it.
Unfortunately, Aida couldn't find any more valuable information, so she could only tell him in advance.
"If you really wanted to tell me about this, then you would have found a way to tell me. But you didn't tell me before, which means that you were planning to use this information to threaten me in the future, right?"
Connor asked with a smile.
When Aida heard Connor's words, she could not help but be stunned for a moment. Then, she said expressionlessly, "Anyway, I've already told you this news. As long as you can help me this time, I'll help you find this Grand Master!"
"I can go and find him myself…"
Connor said lightly.
"Find him yourself?"
Aida couldn't help but sneer when she heard Connor's words. Then, she said indifferently, "Connor, who do you think you are? Even if Yamino had such a large network of connections in Oprana, it would still take him many years to find a bit of information about the Grand Master. If you want to find him yourself, you might not even be able to find him in ten years!"
"..."
Connor looked at Aida and said nothing.
"However, I can help you find out the latest news from the Gomez family. This way, you can know whatever is happening in the Gomez family. As long as you find this person, you can not only ask what happened in the past, but also find some evidence of Yamino's crime. Although I can't guarantee that I can touch Yamino, it will definitely be of great help to you!"
Aida looked at Connor and continued.
"What if you go back on your word after I help you?"
Connor asked softly.
"I am not that kind of person. As long as it's something I've promised you, I will definitely do my best to fulfill it!"
Aida said helplessly.
"Alright, since you've said so, I have no reason to reject you!"
Connor looked at Aida and smiled.
"So, you're going to help me?"
Aida asked in surprise.
"Yeah, I can escort you to Gevada. You are responsible for helping me find out the location of the Grand Master from the Gomez family and sleeping with me for a night."
Connor said with a smile.
"I've already agreed to help you find out the Grand Master's whereabouts, yet you still want me to sleep with you. How can you be so shameless?"
Aida shouted at Connor with her big watery eyes.
"Haven't I always been shameless?"
Connor smiled at Aida.
"I can agree to any condition of yours, but I won't sleep with you!"
Aida bit her lip and said.
Connor could tell that Aida really didn't want to agree to his request. However, if Aida didn't agree, he couldn't be sure if Aida was lying to him.
Therefore, Connor hesitated for a moment before saying softly, "Miss Aida, are you really not going to consider my condition?"
"I will never consider your request. If you want me to sleep with you, I'd rather die!"
Aida said seriously.
"Alright, it's fine if you don't sleep with me. Then, I'll change my request..."
Connor was prepared to take a step back.
"Do you have any other requests?"
Aida looked at Connor and asked.
"First of all, you need to help me investigate the exact location of this Grand Master!"
Connor said softly.
"That's not a problem!"
Aida readily agreed.
"Also, you have to be my hostess for the night. As long as you can complete the mission and make it enjoyable for me, I'll agree to your request. What do you think about that?"
Connor said with a smile.
"A hostess?
Aida couldn't help but be stunned when she heard Connor's words. Then she frowned and said, "What's the difference between this and sleeping with you for a night? You actually want me to be your hostess? Are you crazy?"
Aida felt that Connor's new request was even more excessive. She might as well just sleep with Connor.

chapters.title: Chapter 1753: Agreed
chapters.content:
Chapter 1753: Agreed
"I can tell that you haven't been to nightclubs much…"
Connor smiled faintly when he saw how riled up Aida was.
"Why would a woman like me go to a nightclub? Do you think I'm as wretched as you?"
Aida pouted.
"Let me explain it to you. Although a hostess sounds similar to a prostitute, the hostess in a bar is only responsible for drinking and not having sex with the customers. Do you understand what I mean?"
Connor was prepared to use this method to test Aida. If she could accept such a thing, then she really had no other choice.
"Do you mean that I can just drink with you?"
Aida blinked and asked Connor softly.
"You can say that, but…"
Connor hesitated.
"But what?"
Aida asked Connor with a frown.
"But under normal circumstances, in order to make the guests happy, the hostess would have to do something other than drinking…"
Connor stared at Aida's slender and fair legs and said with a smile.
"What is that something?"
Aida asked in confusion.
"For example, if I want to take advantage of you, not only can you not reject me, but you also have to let me do it. Only then will I be happy, right?"
Connor said with a smile.
Aida understood what Connor meant after hearing his words, and her expression instantly turned ugly.
To put it bluntly, Connor still planned to take advantage of her, but she did not need to sleep with him.
Aida really couldn't understand how Connor could come up with such a shameless request. If it was just to accompany Connor to drink, Aida wouldn't think much of it. However, if he were to take advantage of her, who knew what Connor would do. Therefore, Aida still felt that she couldn't accept it.
"What do you mean by taking advantage of me?"
Aida asked Connor softly.
"Wait a moment!"
Connor didn't answer Aida's question. Instead, he walked out of the room.
Aida sat on the sofa alone, feeling extremely vexed. If it wasn't for Cielo's sudden attack, she wouldn't have been bullied like this by Connor.
A few minutes later, Connor walked into the private room with a woman dressed very sexily.
"Connor, what are you doing?"
Aida hurriedly stood up and asked Connor.
"This is the bar's hostess. Tell Miss Aida what the guests usually do to you!"
Connor said with a smile.
"Actually, the guests who come here to play are just here for simpler things. They kiss, hug, and touch our thighs. There's nothing else. After all, our guests here are very polite…"
The woman said softly.
When Aida heard the woman's words, her face twisted into a frown.
Although this was nothing in the eyes of the hostess, Aida felt that it would be more painful than killing herself if someone she hated treated her like this.
"Alright, you can leave now!"
Connor took out a few banknotes and handed them to the woman.
The woman was naturally very happy. She didn't have to do anything and just said a few words to get a few hundred dollars. She hurriedly thanked Connor and turned around to leave the room.
"Miss Aida, you should know what you need to do now. What say you? Do you agree to my condition?"
Connor asked Aida with a smile.
Aida took a deep breath and said in a low voice, "Connor, you're really too much!"
"I've already made a concession. If you still can't accept that, then there's nothing I can do!"
Connor said lightly.
"How about this? I'll help you find the Grand Master's whereabouts, then I'll give you my two companies. In the end, I'll give you one billion in cash. What do you think?"
Aida asked in a low voice.
"No, I don't lack money!"
Connor shook his head.
"My two companies are worth hundreds of millions, and I have one billion in cash. You don't want them? With this money, you can find a hundred beauties who are prettier than me, and you can play with them as long as you want. Why do you have to take advantage of me?"
Aida really couldn't understand why Connor wanted to do this.
However, Connor didn't really intend to take advantage of her, so he needed to use this method to test Aida.
Therefore, no matter how much Aida offered, Connor would not agree.
Moreover, Aida's money was not enough to tempt Connor.
"I'll give you another 500 million!"
Aida said through gritted teeth.
"No…"
Connor shook his head.
Aida was a little desperate now. This amount of money was already her limit. She couldn't take out more money, not to mention that Connor might not agree to it.
"Am I really that attractive to you?"
Aida asked Connor in confusion.
Because she felt that her conditions were already very good. Any normal person would not reject her.
"It's very exciting to have the woman Juan is pursuing drink with me. Therefore, I won't change my mind no matter how much money you give me!"
Connor said to Aida with a smile.
Aida took a deep breath and didn't say anything.
"Miss Aida, if you don't say anything now, it means that you don't agree. If you don't agree, then forget it. I'm going home..."
After Connor finished speaking, he stood up and walked out of the private room.
"Ah…"
Aida screamed and pointed at Connor, shouting, "You're a bastard!"
"Haha…"
Connor smiled.
"I agree to your conditions, okay?"
Aida shouted in despair.
"You agree?"
Connor asked Aida in surprise.
"Yes, I agree. I agree to your request!"
Aida bit her lips and said coldly.
Aida had no other choice now. She had wasted too much time on Connor. It was too late for her to seek help from others. Cielo might have already found out that his men had lost Aida, so it was very likely that he would make a move on her tonight.
Although Aida was very unwilling to let Connor take advantage of her, it was still much better than sleeping with Connor.
Furthermore, Connor had also taken advantage of her when they were in the Collier family and had even forcefully kissed her.
So, since things had reached this point, she had no choice but to accept his conditions.

chapters.title: Chapter 1754: As Long as You're Happy!
chapters.content:
Chapter 1754: As Long as You're Happy!
However, Aida seemed to be unable to overcome this hurdle.
After all, she had been the center of attention since she was young. When had she ever been humiliated like this?
In order to survive and avenge her mother, Aida had only one choice.
However, Aida also secretly swore that if she became the head of the Collier family and got rid of Cielo, she would personally kill that bastard Connor.
If Connor had not gone to the Collier family's place, the Collier family would not have joined hands with the Gomez family. Juan would not have set his eyes on her, and Cielo would not choose to make a move against her.
This was all because of Connor.
At this moment, Aida's hatred for Connor was no less than Cielo and his mother. However, she could not show it because she still had to rely on Connor to protect her and survive.
Connor didn't expect Aida to agree to such an unreasonable request.
After all, Connor was just testing Aida. He felt that if Aida wasn't really in danger, she definitely wouldn't sell herself like that.
'Does Aida really need my help? Is she really not lying to me this time?'
Connor frowned as he thought to himself. He was rather cautious about this whole thing.
'I can't be fooled so easily. This woman definitely doesn't have any good intentions!'
Connor calmed himself down.
Originally, he planned to tell Aida the truth and tell her that he was testing her. However, if Aida had guessed that he was testing her and pretended to agree to his request, wouldn't he be fooled once more?
After hesitating for a moment, Connor walked up to Aida and asked with a smile, "Miss Aida, have you thought things through?"
"Why do you talk so much nonsense? If I say I agree to it, then it means that I've agreed to it. You want me to drink with you, right? Let's do it!"
Aida shouted exasperatedly.
"What if I want to take advantage of you?"
Connor asked in surprise.
"I will not resist…"
Aida said in a low voice.
"Then, it's okay if I touch your thighs, right?"
Connor continued to ask.
Aida couldn't help but grit her teeth when she heard Connor's words. Then, she said in a low voice, "Whatever. As long as you're happy!"
This time, Connor was somewhat dumbfounded, because he did not expect Aida to actually agree to everything.
Connor looked at the time and said with a smile, "Okay, it's six o'clock. The two of us will leave here at ten o'clock. If you serve me well, as long as I'm satisfied, I'll protect you."
"As long as you don't make any excessive requests, I'll try my best to satisfy you!"
Aida said coldly.
"Don't worry about that. We are all civilized people. I definitely won't make any excessive requests…"
Connor smiled and sized up Aida.
Although Aida was dressed very casual today, she was still very sexy. Her waist was slender, and her legs were long. She was also wearing a pair of exquisite high heels. She looked exceptionally charming.
If it wasn't for the fact that this woman was really dangerous, Connor might have had other thoughts about Aida.
However, Connor knew that this woman was like a poisonous snake. If he got too close to this woman, he would be bitten by this woman sooner or later and die without knowing what happened.
Connor sat beside Aida. Aida instinctively turned to look at Connor, but she did not say anything.
As Connor was very close to Aida, he could clearly smell the fragrance on Aida. The fragrance on Aida was different from a mature woman's fragrance like Vanessa Canfield. This smell was not fatal, but it was very attractive, and it made people happy.
"I didn't expect you to have to do something like this!"
Connor purposely provoked Aida.
"You don't have to humiliate me…"
Aida whispered back to Connor.
Connor smiled and pulled Aida into his arms. His right hand hugged Aida's soft and slender waist.
Aida had never been in a relationship before, so naturally, she had never had any contact with the opposite sex.
The last time she was with Connor, it was the first time she had such close contact with the opposite sex. When Connor hugged her, Aida almost instinctively wanted to stand up and leave, but in the end, she chose to resist this urge.
Aida seemed to be very nervous. Her body was trembling.
"Miss Aida, why are you so nervous? Don't worry, I won't do anything to you. I won't do anything to you when you're in such a state…"
Connor said to Aida with a smile.
Although Aida had already agreed to Connor's request, he was still testing her. He had to make sure that she was really forced into a corner before he helped her.
"I'm not nervous."
Aida replied in a low voice.
"Then, why are you trembling?"
Connor asked with a smile.
"Maybe I'm just feeling a little uncomfortable!"
Aida replied monotonously.
"You look like a dead person now. Do you think I'll be happy? If I'm unhappy, your sacrifice today might be in vain!"
Connor whispered to Aida.
After hearing Connor's words, Aida became a little angry. Then, she shouted at him, "What do you want from me?"
"Smile for me..."
Connor said with a smile.
"I don't think I can still smile in my current state."
Aida said placidly.
"True. You won't be able to smile knowing that your half-brother wants to kill you! Forget it, then."
Connor nodded his head gently. Then, he released his right hand from Aida's waist and poured himself a glass of wine. Then, he poured another glass for Aida.
Seeing that Connor had loosened his grip, Aida secretly heaved a sigh of relief.
"Miss Aida, let's have a drink!"
Connor whispered to Aida.
"Alright…"
Aida did not dare to resist. She could only pick up her wine glass and lightly clinked it with Connor's.
Connor took a sip of red wine and asked Aida, "Miss Aida, you smell really good. What perfume are you using?"
After saying that, Connor deliberately put his head in front of Aida's chest.
At this moment, they were in a rather suggestive position.

chapters.title: Chapter 1755: Why Didn't You Kiss Me?
chapters.content:
Chapter 1755: Why Didn't You Kiss Me?
Aida's body trembled again. She subconsciously grabbed her clothes with her slender fingers, and she said in a low voice, "I don't usually wear perfume…"
"Beautiful women have their own body fragrance. It seems that this saying is true!"
Connor nodded lightly.
"..."
Aida hesitated for a moment before asking Connor softly, "Do you still need me to do anything now?"
"It's only been ten minutes and you can't take it anymore?"
Connor asked with a smile.
"It might be ten minutes to you, but to me, it feels like months!"
Aida said through gritted teeth.
"Hehe, do you know how to sing?"
Connor asked softly.
"Not really."
Aida said helplessly.
"It's okay. There's no one else here anyway. Sing for me!"
Connor said lightly.
Aida hesitated for a moment, then got up and walked to the place where the songs were selected.
Connor looked at Aida's back with a helpless expression. Although she was in great pain, he was also suffering.
He didn't dare to take advantage of Aida. What he said before was just to scare Aida, but Connor still had to act like a pervert to make her break down. This way, she would not be able to stand it and choose to give up.
Therefore, Connor did not feel very good about it either.
A few minutes later, Aida chose a song that she was good at, and then very sensibly returned to Connor's side.
Aida didn't usually like to sing, but her voice was actually quite good. It was just that she had to manage the company's business most of the time, so she didn't have time to sing at all. She even had to arrange a time in advance for her gatherings with her friends. Otherwise, she might not even have the chance to gather with her best friends.
Aida had worked so hard just to avenge her mother.
Aida was very similar to Connor in this aspect.
However, Connor had better luck, while Aida relied on her own efforts.
Connor had a lot of people backing him up, but Aida had no one backing her.
In the beginning, Aida sang very well. However, after a while, Aida's voice changed, and she started to go out of tune.
"You sang quite well in the beginning. Why is it so bad now?"
Connor asked Aida in confusion.
"Don't you know why I sing so badly?"
Aida coldly replied to Connor, then lowered her head to look at her beautiful legs.
At this moment, Connor's right hand was placed on Aida's thigh.
Aida could not sing well because of Connor's actions.
However, she didn't dare to stop Connor. She was about to break down.
Aida's thighs were soft to the touch.
After touching it for a while, Aida still didn't stop him, so he gave up on this method.
He had never thought that she would tolerate him touching her leg.
"Miss Aida, you sound so bad. Why don't you stop singing..."
Connor took his hand away from Aida's thigh and said with a look of disgust.
"If it weren't for you interfering, do you think I would sing so badly?"
Aida shouted at Connor angrily.
"I just touched your leg. Is this considered interfering?"
Connor smiled and continued, "How about this? Let's play some games. It's boring listening to you sing…"
"Play games?"
Aida was stunned when she heard Connor's words. She frowned and asked, "What game do you want to play?"
"Let's roll the dice. Each of us will roll the dice once. Whoever gets the highest number wins…"
Connor took out two dice cups as he spoke.
"Then, will there be a punishment if I lose?"
Aida knew that Connor would not be so kind as to play games with her, so she asked cautiously.
"Of course. If I win, I'll kiss you. How about that?"
Connor said with a smile.
"What if I win?"
Aida hurriedly asked.
"If you win, I can let you kiss me too. That will be fair!"
Connor replied smugly.
Aida was speechless when she heard Connor's words. She felt that he was being too shameless. It didn't matter if he won or lost.
"This game is unfair. I don't want to play…"
Aida pouted.
"Miss Aida, have you forgotten your identity? If you don't want to play, it doesn't matter. Then, I might have to do something else to you. Anyway, you can't resist whatever approach I take!"
Connor spoke as he approached Aida.
"You're so shameless. I've never met someone like you!"
Aida shouted and took the cup from Connor.
Aida shook it a few times before she stopped and looked at Connor.
Connor also shook a few times.
"Here comes the exciting moment!"
Connor said to Aida with a smile.
"What's so exciting about it? Regardless of the results, you're going to take advantage of me!"
Aida gritted her teeth and said to Connor.
Connor ignored Aida and opened the dice cups.
Connor had two fourths and one five, which added up to thirteen points.
On the other hand, Aida had two twoes and one five, which added up to nine points.
"Miss Aida, I'm really sorry. I won…"
Aida looked at Connor with a dark expression.
Connor looked at Aida's pretty face and hesitated for a couple of seconds, then smiled and said, "Which part of you do you think I should kiss?"
"Kiss my hand…"
Aida said in a low voice.
"That's no fun. Why don't I kiss you on the lips?"
After saying that, Connor kissed Aida's sexy lips.
Aida didn't dare to dodge either. She could only clench her teeth and close her eyes.
Connor didn't expect Aida to actually let him kiss her. This was enough to prove that Aida was really being forced into a dead end.
Connor now truly believed what Aida had told him, so he did not continue to kiss her but stopped kissing her.
After waiting for a long time, Aida realized that Connor didn't kiss her. She opened her eyes and asked Connor in confusion, "Why didn't you kiss me?"

chapters.title: Chapter 1756: Go to the Hotel and Get a Room
chapters.content:
Chapter 1756: Go to the Hotel and Get a Room
"What? Aren't you happy I didn't kiss you?"
Connor laughed and replied.
"This is not you!"
Aida thought that Connor had changed his mind and hurriedly continued, "Connor, I've already done whatever you asked of me. If you go back on your word now, then you're not a man!"
"Did I say that I'm going back on my word?"
Connor replied indifferently, then poured a glass of wine for Aida and said softly, "Drink this glass of wine!"
"What are you trying to do?"
Aida felt a little uneasy seeing that Connor didn't continue to tease her.
After all, she had endured so much humiliation today just to have Connor protect her. However, Connor was acting rather strangely now.
"I'm not trying to do anything. Actually, I was testing you from the very beginning. I had no choice. You lied to me twice in York last time. I didn't dare to believe you, so I used such a shameless method to test you. Now, I have my answer. You are indeed in danger. Otherwise, you would have avoided me when I tried to kiss you just now…"
Connor said calmly to Aida.
"You have been testing me?"
A strange look flashed across Aida's face.
"Yeah, I was testing you!"
Connor nodded lightly.
"So, you promise to protect me?"
Aida hurriedly asked.
"Yes. If I cooperate with you, it will indeed bring me a lot of benefits. Moreover, you can also help me investigate the whereabouts of that Grand Master, so I don't want you to die now…"
Connor nodded again.
After hearing Connor's words, Aida couldn't help but take a deep breath. Although the process was very complicated, the ending was a good one. As long as Connor agreed to protect her, then she still had a chance of survival.
"When are you going to Gevada?"
Connor looked at Aida and asked.
"We'll set off tomorrow!"
Aida replied.
"Alright, I got it. I'll look for you at the hotel tomorrow and send you to Gevada."
Connor replied softly, then stood up and walked out of the private room.
"Wait a minute!"
Aida hurriedly called out when she saw Connor leaving.
Connor was stunned for a moment when he heard Aida's words. Then, he turned to look at Aida and asked in a puzzled tone, "What is it? Miss Aida, are you not done being a hostess? Do you want to continue playing with me? I'm sorry, I don't have any other intentions toward you. I was really testing you just now…"
"You're the one who's not done!"
Aida glared at Connor and continued, "In order to meet you today, I asked my friend to impersonate me and lure Cielo's men away. So now, Cielo probably knows that I've disappeared. I'm worried that he might make a move tonight, so..."
"So I have to stay by your side tonight to protect you, right?"
Connor frowned and asked Aida.
"That's right. I've already agreed to your previous conditions. You have to protect me now!"
Aida nodded and continued, "I've already booked a flight for tomorrow morning, so we can go to Gevada tomorrow!"
"So what if we reach Gevada? It's still not safe..."
Connor sighed softly.
"..."
Aida looked at Connor without saying anything.
"Alright, since I've already promised you, I'll definitely protect you well. But you can't go to my house because there are other people at my house…"
Connor said softly.
"Your girlfriend?"
Aida was stunned for a moment before asking.
"No. We're just ordinary friends…"
Connor said speechlessly.
"Then what do you plan to do?"
Aida looked at Connor and asked.
"There's no other choice in this situation. I'll bring you to a hotel room. Then, the two of us will stay in the same room."
Connor thought for a moment and said.
"A hotel?"
Aida's expression changed when she heard this. After all, Connor had been asking her to have sex with him. So now, Aida was a little worried that if she really went to a hotel with Connor, what if he couldn't control himself and did something to her?
Last time in York, Aida fought with Connor. Aida wasn't Connor's match at that time.
And now, he was much stronger than he was in York, so she was definitely no match for him.
Once Connor's bestial nature was unleashed, Aida would not be able to stop him at all.
Connor seemed to have noticed that there was something wrong with Aida's gaze, so he frowned and asked Aida, "What is it? Do you not want to?"
"Who knows what you want to do to me there?"
Aida responded softly.
"Haha…"
Connor couldn't help but sneer when he heard Aida's words. Then, he said expressionlessly, "So, you don't believe me? That's fine. I don't want to go to the hotel with you anyway. How about this? I'll go home now, and you can think of a way to go back yourself. Go wherever you think is safe. If you encounter any accidents, just call me…"
"If I really encounter an accident, won't it be too late to call you?"
Aida shouted with her big watery eyes.
"Then, what else can I do? You refuse to go to a hotel with me. If there's no other way, I'll send you to the police station. That place is definitely the safest…"
Connor also shouted speechlessly.
"..."
Aida knew that Connor was not a good person, but she also knew how dangerous her current situation was.
If Connor really left, then she would definitely be dead.
After hesitating for a couple of seconds, Aida gritted her teeth and said, "Can't you think of a more suitable place now?"
"I can't think of it. I'm not in the mood to think about it!"
Connor replied indifferently.
"How about this? Let's go to the airport. There are more people at the airport. I don't think Cielo will dare to attack me at the airport…"
Aida said to Connor seriously.
Connor was speechless when he heard Aida's words. He said in a low voice, "Miss, are you joking with me? We'll be facing assassins for the next few days. It's not like you'll be fine just because you escaped tonight. If I don't sleep tonight, how can I have the energy to protect you for the next few days?"

chapters.title: Chapter 1757: Lost Her
chapters.content:
Chapter 1757: Lost Her
"You can sleep during the day and protect me at night…"
Aida thought for a moment and said loudly.
"No way. I have to rest well today. Otherwise, I won't be able to go to Gevada. Either you come with me to the hotel, or I'll go home by myself."
Connor looked at Aida and said.
After hesitating for a couple of seconds, Aida whispered to Connor, "Alright, I'll go to the hotel with you!"
"You should have just agreed earlier."
Connor replied speechlessly, then walked out of the private room.
Aida followed Connor with mixed feelings. She didn't know why he wanted to bring her to a hotel.
However, she had no other choice but to leave the bar with Connor.
Just as Connor and Aida were about to leave the bar, he suddenly stopped and turned to look at Aida, saying in a low voice, "If Cielo Collier's men see you walking out with me, won't our relationship be exposed? By then, can you still help me find out the whereabouts of the Grand Master?"
"You don't have to worry about that. I have already thought about how to explain it to the Collier family…"
Aida whispered to Connor.
"How do you plan to explain it?"
Connor asked.
"I'll tell them that you kidnapped me. When the time comes, the two of us just need to put on an act. The Collier family wouldn't be suspicious then…"
Aida said slowly.
"Kidnap you?"
Connor couldn't help but be stunned when he heard Aida's words. Then, he frowned and said, "I don't think there's any reason to kidnap you now, right?"
"Of course, there's a reason. You can ask the Collier family for money. The Collier family will give you whatever amount you want."
Aida said lightly.
"This is a good thing, I guess. I can still get money when the time comes…"
Connor said with a smile.
"When the time comes, we'll split the money equally between the two of us…"
Aida reminded Connor softly.
"Why should I give you half?"
Connor frowned and asked.
"Why else? If it weren't for me, you would have never gotten this money, so shouldn't you give me half?"
Aida said in a low voice.
Connor hesitated for a moment before nodding and said expressionlessly, "Let's just deal with what's to come first. We might not even be able to survive…"
When Aida heard Connor's words, a strange look flashed across her face.
Connor then held Aida's hand.
"What are you doing?"
Aida cried out in surprise and instinctively tried to pull her hand away.
"If you put on your sunglasses and hat now, Cielo's men might not be able to recognize you. Then, they will think that you and I are a couple who came to the bar to have fun. Moreover, if you stay closer to me, I can protect you. That way, it will be safer..."
Connor reminded Aida softly.
"..."
When Aida heard Connor's words, she slowly raised her head and looked at Connor. After hesitating for a while, she did not say anything else.
She had already let Connor take advantage of her in the private room. Now, even if he held her hand, it was nothing.
In the villa of the Collier family in York.
Cielo had just returned when he found out that his men had lost Aida. Cielo was extremely angry, and he kept making calls on his phone.
Shereen Stevens was also sitting beside Cielo, her face full of worry.
After all, this plan was very important to the mother and son. If there were any mistakes and Aida found out that the two of them were about to make a move, it would be troublesome.
"These people are a bunch of trash. How can they lose her…"
Cielo shouted with his eyes wide open.
He thought that his plan was flawless. The assassins would arrive in Yarlford tonight, and he had just returned to York. It was obvious that attacking Aida tonight was the best move.
Ring, ring, ring…
At this moment, Cielo's phone suddenly rang.
When Cielo heard his phone ring, he quickly picked it up.
"Dane, what's the situation on your side now? How did you lose Aida?"
Cielo asked in a low voice.
"Mr. Cielo, a woman left the hotel in Miss Aida's car wearing her clothes. My men thought that the woman was Miss Aida, so they followed her. They didn't realize that she wasn't Miss Aida. She went to the mall for a walk. When our men came back, they realized that Miss Aida was missing..."
Cielo's subordinate, Dane Weiss, hurriedly explained.
"Did you do anything to that woman?"
Cielo was a little nervous.
"Didn't you say that we shouldn't act rashly before the assassin comes? That's why we didn't do anything…"
Dane replied.
"That's good…"
Cielo heaved a long sigh of relief when he found out that his men had not made a move. Cielo felt that it was very likely that Aida was testing him.
If his men made a move, Aida would definitely know what he was up to.
"What's the situation on your side now?"
Cielo continued to ask.
"Our people are trying their best to find Aida. Yarlford is not big, and we have spies everywhere. As long as Aida shows up, it should be easy to find her!"
Dane replied.
"The assassin will arrive at Yarlford today. Tonight is the best opportunity to attack Aida, so you must find herfor me, you understand?"
Cielo shouted in a low voice.
"Don't worry, Mr. Cielo. Since I've already received your money, I'll definitely do a good job!"
Dane replied indifferently.
"Alright, I'll hang up for now. If there's anything, call me!"
Cielo replied softly before hanging up.
Shereen saw Cielo put down his phone and hurriedly asked, "Son, what's the situation now?"
"Mom, don't worry. Aida probably didn't realize anything. They just followed the wrong person today. These people have some connections in Yarlford. I reckon that as soon as Aida shows up, they will soon find out."
Cielo said confidently.
This time, in order to deal with Aida, he had specially found a gang in Yarlford, and this gang's greatest skill was tracking.
Because many of the gang members were scattered all over Yarlford, as long as they were still in Yarlford, they would not be able to escape their sight.

chapters.title: Chapter 1758: What Relationship?
chapters.content:
Chapter 1758: What Relationship?
"Do you think Aida has figured out what we want to do?"
Shereen thought for a moment and asked Cielo softly.
"No way…"
Cielo shook his head without hesitation and continued, "I'm sure Aida doesn't know…"
"Aida is very shrewd. We should be careful…"
Shereen reminded in a low voice.
"Mom, don't worry. I did it flawlessly this time. No one will find out. Aida probably just realized that someone was following her, so she deliberately shook off the person who was following her."
Cielo whispered.
"That's good…"
Shereen said expressionlessly.
...
On the other side, Connor and Aida got into Connor's car after leaving the bar.
However, Aida and Connor did not expect that it would take less than half a minute to walk from the bar to the car. Moreover, Aida had disguised herself, but she still could not escape the eyes of Dane's subordinates.
Aida had been to the bar yesterday, so Dane had sent people to the bar to look for her after finding out that she was missing.
As expected, they really found her.
Connor started the car and Dane's underling followed behind him.
However, because the road in front of the bar was very crowded, after all, this bar was very famous in Yarlford, so Connor could not sense that someone was following them.
The lackey took out his cell phone and dialed Dane's number. He briefly explained the situation to Dane.
When Dane got wind that his men was following Aida, he quickly called Cielo.
"Dane, do you have any news?"
Cielo asked excitedly after picking up the call.
"Mr. Cielo, my men have already caught up with Aida, but I have something to tell you!"
Dane said slowly.
"What is it?"
Cielo asked in a low voice.
"There's a man with Aida now. It seems that they are in some kind of a relationship. They left the bar hand-in-hand…"
Dane told Cielo what his underling had told him.
"Aida walked out of the bar hand-in-hand with a man?"
After hearing that, Cielo became even more confused.
"Is it Juan Gomez?"
Cielo quickly asked.
"He's not from the Gomez family. I met Juan Gomez once. If he were Juan Gomez, I would be able to recognize him at a glance!"
Dane responded.
"Then, who could this person be?"
Cielo would never have thought that the man beside Aida was Connor!
Cielo knew Aida very well. If it wasn't someone Aida liked, then she would never do something like this, not even holding hands. If the man beside Aida was Juan, then everything would make sense. Unfortunately, that man wasn't Juan.
"Is Aida secretly dating another man behind the back of the Gomez family?"
Cielo was rather gleeful.
If this was really the case, then if he could take a photo of Aida dating this man, even if he couldn't get rid of Aida, he could give this photo to Beau Collier or Juan and make Aida lose everything she had now.
It was not a small matter to make Juan a cuckold!
"Get your underlings to follow Aida closely and find a way to take a photo of that man for me, you understand?"
Cielo whispered.
"Alright, I understand…"
Dane hurriedly replied.
Cielo hung up the phone and sat there with his eyes narrowed, deep in thought.
...
On the other side, Connor's car finally drove out of the congested road in front of the bar.
Aida was sitting in the front passenger seat with a nervous expression on her face, because she knew that her life was now in Connor's hands.
Connor turned to look at Aida, then said with a smile, "You seem very nervous now!"
"If you encounter something like this, won't you feel nervous?"
Aida replied helplessly.
