"I live like this almost every day. I don't even know how many people in Yarlford want my life…"
Connor said lightly.
"That's because you are too arrogant. You humiliated Yamino Gomez and Christian Zook in front of so many people. It's already a miracle that you're still alive!"
Aida said expressionlessly.
"Hehe, you're right. It's a miracle that I'm still alive!"
Connor lightly nodded.
"By the way, who is your bodyguard? Why did Yamino seem to be very afraid of him at the Zook family's birthday banquet that day?"
Aida was curious about Yama.
"I don't know who he is. He said he lost his memory!"
Connor replied.
"That person seems to be quite powerful. Do you want to call him over? This way, it will be much easier for the two of us to deal with those assassins…"
Aida said softly.
"Nah…"
Connor shook his head and continued, "I can deal with those hitmen alone. Moreover, if I ask Yama to come now, he might not be able to make it in time…"
"Alright, then…"
Aida didn't say anything after seeing Connor's confidence.
"It seems like you're right. Cielo is really planning to make a move on you tonight. There's a car following us. They must have discovered you by now…"
Connor said calmly.
"How did they find me?"
Aida was shocked when she heard Connor's words.
"I don't know how they found you, but this car has been following us the whole time…"
Connor said lightly.
"Then, hurry up and shake them off!"
Aida said nervously.
"It's not very useful to shake them off now. Since you disguised yourself so well just now and you have already shaken them off before, but they can still find you, this means that the other party is not acting alone. They have set up an inescapable net in Yarlford. So, as long as the two of us are still in Yarlford, even if we shake them off, our location will still be exposed…"
Connor analyzed softly,
"Then, what do you plan to do?"
Aida hurriedly asked.
"What else can we do? We'll just go to hotel first and wait for them to make a move on you. Then, I'll deal with them. This is the easiest way!"
Connor said slowly.
Aida looked at Connor helplessly and didn't say anything. She knew that her life was in Connor's hands. Moreover, Connor was more experienced in dealing with these people than she was, so she could only do as he said.

chapters.title: Chapter 1759: The Third Possibility
chapters.content:
Chapter 1759: The Third Possibility
Ten minutes later, Connor parked the car in front of the Hilton Hotel.
"Miss Aida, the bed in this hotel seems to be very comfortable. When the time comes, the two of us can experience it!"
Connor said to Aida with a smile.
"You're still in the mood to joke with me at a time like this?!"
Aida rolled her eyes at Connor helplessly.
"Haha…"
Connor smiled faintly, then pulled Aida's hand and walked into the hotel.
There was a young man sitting in the car that had been following Connor. When the young man saw Connor get out of the car, he took out his phone and took a few photos of Connor, then sent them to Dane.
After Dane received the photo his subordinate sent, he sent it to Cielo without hesitation.
Cielo, who had been waiting anxiously at home, had a complicated expression on his face when he saw the photo of Connor holding Aida's hand and walking into the hotel. There was shock, confusion, and surprise.
He had never thought that the man beside Aida would be Connor.
This was explosive news for Cielo.
"What... What is going on? Why did Aida get together with Connor McDonald? Has Aida fallen in love with him? That's impossible!"
Cielo muttered to himself.
"What's wrong?"
Shereen Stevens asked Cielo softly.
Cielo handed the photo to Shereen without hesitation.
Shereen had a complicated expression on her face after seeing these photos.
"How could Aida date Connor? What is their relationship with each other?"
Shereen asked in confusion.
"Aida would never fall in love with Connor!"
Cielo shook his head.
Shereen hesitated for a moment before saying in a low voice, "Cielo, there are only three explanations for this situation!"
Cielo turned to look at Shereen.
"First possibility is that Aida has fallen in love with Connor. The two of them are a couple!"
Shereen was wrong about the first possibility.
"That's impossible. It's impossible for Aida to like someone like Connor!"
Cielo shook his head without thinking.
"The second possibility is that Aida already knows that we want to make a move on him, so she went to Connor for help and wants him to protect her!"
Shereen continued,
"That's impossible too…"
Cielo shook his head again and said in a low voice, "If Aida has really found out that we want to make a move on her, her best choice now is to ask Juan Gomez for help. After all, once Juan gets involved in this matter, no one in Yarlford will dare to touch him…"
"Then, there is only the third possibility left…"
Shereen took a deep breath and whispered, "The third possibility is that Connor has kidnapped Aida…"
When Cielo heard what Shereen said, he looked rather nervous.
"What exactly is going on? I'll get someone to investigate, then we'll know…"
As Cielo spoke, he took out his phone and dialed Dane's number.
"Mr. Cielo, what are your orders?"
Dane quickly picked up the phone.
"Help me check if Connor and Aida are staying in the same room!"
Cielo whispered.
"Alright, I'll get someone to investigate now!"
Dane hurriedly replied and then hung up.
Cielo felt that if Aida was asking Connor to protect her, then the two of them would stay in two separate rooms. After all, it was only for protection. Aida could not possibly live in the same room as Connor.
If the two of them lived in the same room, then either they were really together and were having an affair, or Connor had kidnapped Aida.
A few minutes later, Cielo's phone rang.
"Mr. Cielo, Connor and Aida are staying in the same room. They booked a room with a big bed!"
Dane reported.
"Alright, I got it!"
Cielo replied in a low voice before hanging up.
"Mom, you're right. Connor might have really kidnapped Aida. Otherwise, the two of them definitely wouldn't be living in the same room!"
Cielo looked at Shereen and said.
"But why would Connor kidnap Aida?"
Shereen couldn't help but frown when she heard this.
"I don't have the mood to think about these things now. Connor kidnapping Aida is definitely a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity for me. I can kill Aida tonight and show Grandpa the photo of Connor and Aida entering the hotel. That way, everyone will think that Connor killed Aida…"
Cielo said excitedly.
Cielo's original plan was to kill Aida and frame Connor.
Now that Connor had taken the initiative to deliver himself to him, how could Cielo not be excited?
"Are you planning to make a move today?"
Shereen asked.
"Yes, we have to do it tonight!"
Cielo nodded and took out his phone to call the hitman.
"Mr. Serrano, have your men already arrived in Yarlford?"
Cielo asked after the other party picked up the call.
In order to deal with Aida, Cielo had spent a lot of money this time. He had found three top-notch assassins from overseas.
The most powerful one was the one who was talking to Cielo. His original name was Zaki Serrano, and he was very famous in the assassin organization overseas. He was also a martial artist and had almost never failed a mission.
The other two were Zaki's disciples. Cielo didn't know their names, but they were nicknamed Baby Shakes and Baby Don. They were also very strong.
"The three of us have already arrived at Yarlford…"
Zaki replied in a low voice.
"Aida is currently staying in Room 506 of the Hilton Hotel. You will kill Aida tonight!"
Cielo told Zaki about the situation with Aida.
"Alright, no problem!"
Zaki agreed.
"By the way, Mr. Serrano, there are some changes in the situation there. I have to inform you in advance!"
Cielo hurriedly said.
"What's the situation?"
"Aida has probably been kidnapped by someone. This person is quite strong. In order to not cause more trouble, you don't have to worry about this person. Just kill Aida…"
Cielo whispered.
"Is he a martial artist?"
Zaki asked.
"I think he is. He is strong, so you must be careful when you attack!"
Cielo replied.

chapters.title: Chapter 1760: Knockout Drug?
chapters.content:
Chapter 1760: Knockout Drug?
"It's okay. I'll get Baby Shakes and Baby Don to deal with this woman tonight!"
Zaki said lightly.
"Mr. Serrano, what do you mean by that? Don't you plan to do it yourself? Can the two of them do it?"
Cielo asked with a frown.
"I haven't reached Yarlford yet. I'll only arrive at ten o'clock tomorrow morning. So, if you're in a hurry to make a move tonight, I'll have to get them to a move first!"
Zaki said slowly.
"But I'm worried they…"
Cielo said helplessly.
"You don't have to worry. I've already informed the two of them. Moreover, the two of them have prepared knockout drugs in advance. When the time comes, the two of them will first knock out that woman and that man before killing that woman. Therefore, there shouldn't be any problems…"
Zaki said confidently.
"Knockout drug?"
Cielo was stunned when he heard that.
"That's right!"
Zaki nodded and continued, "This kind of knockout drug is used by the assassin organization. As long as a normal person inhales the knockout drug, they will be unconscious for at least three hours. As for martial artists, they will be unconscious for more than an hour. Therefore, when the person is unconscious, Baby Shakes and Baby Don will have enough time to kill the target. Mr. Cielo, you don't have to worry. Since we have accepted your mission, we will definitely complete it!""
"There's actually such a powerful knockout powder?"
Cielo said in surprise.
"Ordinary people like you can't touch this kind of thing, but assassins like us will definitely carry some kind of poison with us. After all, sometimes poisoning people is the simplest and most direct way!"
Zaki said lightly.
"Alright, if that's the case, I won't say anything more. Let's do it tonight. I don't care what method you use, as long as you can kill Aida for me!"
Cielo said excitedly.
"I'll call you after it's done. I'll have to trouble you to transfer the rest of the money to me!"
Zaki said.
"Don't worry, money is a small matter. If you can kill Aida today, I can give you another million!"
Cielo responded.
"Haha…"
Zaki laughed and hung up.
Cielo put down his phone. His face was filled with excitement because he felt that everything was going very smoothly. All he had to do now was wait for the good news from Zaki.
On the other side, Connor and Aida had entered the room.
This room was the largest presidential suite in the hotel. Not only did it have a kitchen and living room, but it also had two bedrooms and two toilets.
Therefore, it was a good room for them.
After entering the room, Connor walked straight into the largest bedroom.
Aida was a little helpless, but she did not say anything and quietly walked into the slightly smaller bedroom.
After entering the bedroom, Aida locked the door and sat on the bed to rest.
Boom! Boom! Boom!
At this moment, there was a knock on the door.
"What is it?"
Aida asked with a frown.
"Open the door. Why did you lock it?"
Connor asked in confusion.
"It's just us two in here. Of course, I have to lock the door…"
Aida replied softly.
"Do you not know what situation you're in? Do you think you'll be safe just by locking the door? If the killer comes in through the window, how will I come in to save you?"
Connor shouted speechlessly.
Aida looked at the window helplessly. Although there was an anti-theft net in their room, these things were not an obstacle in the eyes of the assassins.
Aida opened the door.
Connor entered Aida's room and observed it briefly. Then, he said to Aida, "Go to my room…"
"Why?"
Aida shouted and continued, "Connor, I will definitely do what I promised you, but I didn't promise to sleep with you. Why should I go to your room? Are you planning to force yourself on me?"
Aida was very nervous from the moment she entered the room because she was worried that Connor would have any ill intentions toward her.
After Connor said that, Aida felt that the thing she was most worried about was about to happen.
"So, I'm such a person in your eyes!"
Connor said to Aida with a smile.
"Otherwise, do you think you're a good person?"
Aida asked coldly.
"I've already told you before that I'm not interested in you at all. I have never lacked women. Even if I wanted a woman, I wouldn't want you. You're flat…"
Connor said expressionlessly.
"Who are you calling flat?"
Aida shouted with her big watery eyes.
"You know who I'm talking about…"
Connor said as he sized up Aida's figure.
In fact, Aida's figure was very good, at least compared to ordinary women. However, if compared to Vanessa Canfield, the fullness of her chest was naturally lacking.
Connor said this on purpose.
"Since you don't like me, why do you want me to go to your room?"
Aida looked at Connor and asked.
"I'm doing this to protect you!"
Connor replied helplessly, then continued, "Cielo's men will attack you tonight, and he must have hired professional assassins. These people have a hundred ways to kill you, so your room is not very safe. If you stay in the same room as me, I can protect you immediately if anything happens. If you insist on staying in this room alone, it's fine. Then, I might not be able to protect you..."
"These two rooms are so close to each other. You can easily come and save me!"
Aida thought for a moment and said to Connor.
"Do you think those killers are fools? They might not even give you the chance to ask for help. Moreover, even if they did, I might not be able to hear them…"
Connor said lightly.
Aida looked at Connor without saying anything.
"Alright, I've already told you what could happen. You can choose what you want to do!"
Connor didn't want to waste his breath on Aida, so he walked out of her room.

chapters.title: Chapter 1761: Being in the Same Room
chapters.content:
Chapter 1761: Being in the Same Room
Aida sat on the bed, looking extremely down.
This was because she felt like she had been led by the nose by Connor since the beginning. She did not like the feeling of being dominated by him, but Aida could not find any other way because Connor was right.
If the assassin really entered her room, even though Aida was also a martial artist, her realm was relatively low. The other party could kill her off easily.
By the time Connor ran out of the room, she might have already died in the hands of the killer.
However, if she really stayed in the same room as Connor, she was a little worried that he would do something to her.
Therefore, Aida was very conflicted. She did not know what to do.
A few minutes later, Aida took a deep breath and walked into Connor's room.
Connor ignored Aida and walked straight into the bathroom to take a shower.
Aida heard the sound of running water in the bathroom, and she was as nervous as she could be.
Because she knew that she had no ability to resist in front of Connor. If Connor really wanted to do something to her, then she felt that she might as well die!
Therefore, Aida didn't know what she could do.
Originally, she had a pistol in her suitcase, but because she was in a hurry this time, she did not bring her pistol with her.
"Even if I die today, I will definitely not let this bastard succeed!"
Aida looked at the toilet and made up her mind.
A few minutes later, Connor came out of the bathroom and asked Aida with a smile, "Have you thought about it?"
"Connor, I can sleep in this room, but if you dare to do anything to me, I will leave this room immediately. I will not let you succeed even if I die!"
Aida shouted at Connor.
"I've already said that I'm not interested in you. Moreover, I won't force you to do anything. But if you're interested in me, I can consider you. However, I might not agree to it. After all, I have very high requirements for my other half..."
Connor said with a smile.
"Stop dreaming. Who would want to have anything to do with someone like you?"
Aida shouted speechlessly.
"Do you want to take a shower?"
Connor suddenly asked.
"Are you planning to peek at me while I shower?"
Aida quickly asked.
"Why would I? There's nothing particularly attractive about your body. I'm just asking. If you're not going to shower, then go to sleep!"
Connor said speechlessly.
Aida had been taken advantage of by Connor in the bar today, so she wanted to take a good shower.
However, she seemed to be a little worried that Connor would peek at her.
After hesitating for a while, Aida still chose to walk into the bathroom.
Connor didn't have any feelings for Aida at all, so he naturally wouldn't peek at her. He lay in bed playing with his phone.
Half an hour later, Aida came out of the bathroom, dressed neatly.
Connor raised his head and looked at Aida without saying anything. After taking a shower, Aida was completely barefaced, but she looked even more beautiful.
Aida looked around the room and found that there was a bed and a small sofa in the room. At this time, Connor was lying on the bed, so she could only sleep on the sofa.
"Get up!"
Aida shouted at Connor.
"Why?"
Connor asked in confusion.
"Well, I have insomnia. I can't sleep on the sofa. I want to sleep on the bed!"
Aida tried her best to speak to Connor in a calm tone.
"Do you want to sleep on the bed?"
Connor smiled and continued, "That's true. There's only one bed in this room. I can't let you sleep on the sofa…"
Aida didn't expect Connor to be so easy to talk to.
"But I can't sleep on the sofa either. Why don't we do this? The two of us can sleep on the bed. Anyway, I won't do anything to you. The two of us can just make do for one night…"
Connor said with a smile.
Aida was speechless when she heard Connor's words.
"This bed is so big. It's definitely not a problem for the two of us to sleep on it together. I promise I won't touch you!"
Connor looked at Aida and continued.
"Can't you be a gentleman?"
Aida bit her lip and shouted.
"I think I'm quite a gentleman…"
Connor replied indifferently and then continued, "Anyway, I've saved a place for you. If you want to sleep on the bed, then sleep on the bed. If you don't want to sleep on the bed, then forget it. I don't care…"
After saying that, Connor covered himself with the blanket and was about to rest.
Aida stood in front of Connor, her eyes filled with anger.
She wouldn't believe Connor's words. It would be strange if nothing happened between a man and a woman sleeping alone in the same bed. Moreover, Connor was so shameless.
After taking a deep breath, Aida walked to the sofa and sat down.
Aida thought for a moment and felt that she might as well not sleep since she couldn't sleep anyway. If anything happened, she would be the first to react.
Connor was already a little tired after a day of torment, so he really lay on the bed to rest.
When Aida found out that Connor had fallen asleep, she looked a little helpless.
"What's wrong with this person? You clearly know that the assassin is going to attack me tonight, but you still have the mood to sleep?"
Aida looked at Connor on the bed with a speechless expression.
However, at the same time.
Two people walked into the hotel one after another.
After entering the hotel, the two of them briefly observed the location of the hotel's surveillance cameras and then entered the security room.
The security guard in the surveillance room was knocked unconscious before he could react.
After dealing with the security guards, the two of them turned off the entire hotel's surveillance system.
Then, they began to search for the room where Connor and Aida were.
A few minutes later, the two of them arrived at the door of the room.
At this time, Aida was sitting on the sofa and looking at her phone, dealing with some work matters.
Aida had always been a workaholic. She would never forget her company's matters no matter where she was. Therefore, she would usually choose to use her phone to review documents and then contact her assistant.
Aida, who was handling the contract, suddenly smelled a very strange smell.
When she smelled the scent, she felt that something was wrong, so she got up and went to the door to see what was going on.
Unfortunately, before Aida could stand up, she fainted.

chapters.title: Chapter 1762: Execution of the Plan
chapters.content:
Chapter 1762: Execution of the Plan
Aida was also a martial artist, and her realm was not particularly low. The power of this knockout powder was indeed very strong.
Aida didn't even have time to react. She took two breaths and fainted.
And Connor naturally smelled this scent at this moment, so his first reaction was to hold his breath.
Because Connor had eaten the Essence Cultivating Pill, his body was not something that ordinary martial artists could compare to. Even though Connor had taken two breaths just now, he only felt a little dizzy but did not faint.
Although Connor didn't faint immediately, it didn't mean that he could hold his breath for a long time. Therefore, he hurriedly ran into the bathroom, opened the bathroom window, and took two deep breaths. Then, he wet his clothes and covered his nose.
Connor's method could resist the smoke to a certain extent.
A few minutes later, Connor chose a suitable place to hide.
The killer outside seemed to be very cautious and did not rush in. He waited outside for about ten minutes before taking out his tools to open the door.
When Connor heard the sound of the door opening, he became nervous.
Because he didn't know how strong the killer was this time!
Although Connor had been joking with Aida before, he didn't want to see her die. As long as Aida could cooperate with him sincerely, she would become an important chess piece in Connor's hands, which would be of great help to him in dealing with the Gomez family.
Thud! Thud!
At this time, the footsteps were getting clearer and clearer. Connor knew that the killer had already entered the room.
Moreover, Connor could tell from the footsteps that there were two people who came in this time.
At this moment, Connor was in a 1v2 situation.
If Aida had not fainted, Connor would have been able to relax a lot with her help.
However, this woman had already fainted, so Connor could only rely on himself.
"Bro, these two people seem to have already fainted…"
After Baby Shakes and Baby Don entered the room, they whispered to each other.
"Boss gave us the order to kill that woman first and then frame that man. So, we don't have to worry about that man. Just kill that woman…"
At this moment, another person spoke.
"Alright, I understand…"
Baby Don nodded gently and continued to walk toward the bedroom.
However, Connor, who was hiding in the corner, had been listening to these two people's conversation and distinguishing the auras of these two people.
It was very obvious that these two people were martial artists.
And they were all black rank. They were only at the beginner stage. Their strength wasn't particularly terrifying, so if Connor could catch them off guard, it wouldn't be a problem to deal with them.
In the hotel room.
Baby Shakes and Baby Don were both Zaki Serrano's disciples. They had been with him for many years, so they had experienced many incidents like this.
As professional assassins, they knew that the most important thing for assassins was to complete the mission. No matter what method they used, completing the mission was the most important thing for them.
So, these two were very cautious. The knockout powder they used before was specially made, and even black rank martial artists couldn't resist the power of this knockout powder.
However, this poison could only knock people out for a short period of time and could not kill them. If it could kill them, the power of this poison would be too terrifying, and it was not suitable for assassins to use.
When assassins like them carried out their missions, they always held the principle of not hurting the innocent, so they did not want to blow things up.
It was already past one in the morning.
This was definitely the time when people were the sleepiest, so the two of them chose to attack at this time.
Moreover, Connor and Aida lived in the same room, so the two of them also felt that something must have happened between Connor and Aida. Now was the time when the two of them let their guard down the most.
Everything seemed to have gone according to their plan. After all, it was not the first time they had carried out such a mission.
However, the two of them might not have considered the possibility that because Connor had taken the Essence Cultivating Pill, his body was very different from the body of an ordinary martial artist. Therefore, at this time, Connor was still conscious. He was hiding in the room, waiting for these two people to take the bait.
Connor hid in the corner and controlled his breathing, trying not to let the two killers find him.
Baby Shakes and Baby Don were already at ease and did not properly observe their surroundings.
After the two of them entered the room, they split up.
After all, there were two bedrooms in the presidential suite. They couldn't be sure which room Aida was in.
When Connor sense the two of them moving separately, he knew that his chance had come.
Connor stood behind the bedroom door, quietly waiting for someone to walk in.
The realms of these two people were not low. If Connor wanted to finish off the two of them in one go, then he had to deal with one first, and then deal with the other.
If the two of them attacked together, Connor would be in great danger.
A few seconds later, Baby Don slowly walked into Connor's bedroom with a dagger in his hand.
Connor became nervous.
A few seconds later, Baby Don walked into the bedroom and reached out to turn on the bedroom light.
However, at this moment, Connor suddenly rushed in front of Baby Don and reached out to grab his neck.
Baby Don did not expect that there would be someone who could still move in this room.
He subconsciously raised the dagger in his hand and stabbed at Connor.
However, Connor did not give Baby Don this chance. He dodged the dagger very easily and then exerted strength with both hands.
Crack!
A crisp sound rang out.
Connor easily broke Baby Don's neck.
Baby Don did not even have the chance to inform his companion before he fell to the ground.
Although Baby Don was also a martial artist, under the circumstances just now, no one could use their aura. It was a split-second reaction.
If a martial artist did not use his aura, then he was no different from an ordinary person.
Although Connor dealt with Baby Don very quickly, it still caused some noise.

chapters.title: Chapter 1763: Teasing Aida
chapters.content:
Chapter 1763: Teasing Aida
Baby Shakes quickly realized that something was wrong and rushed toward Connor's bedroom.
When Baby Shakes saw Connor, he raised the pistol in his hand and aimed it at Connor. Then, without any hesitation, he pulled the trigger.
Under the current situation, Baby Shakes would definitely not choose to waste his breath on Connor. The most important thing was to get rid of Connor first.
Bang!
A gunshot rang out.
The bullet flew straight at Connor.
However, Connor was already prepared. He used his aura to change the trajectory of the bullet.
The bullet did not hit Connor, but the wall behind him.
Baby Shakes was shocked when he saw this because he was very confident in his marksmanship. In this situation, there was no reason for him to miss Connor.
Connor did not give Baby Shakes any time to react. He rushed in front of Baby Shakes and punched him in the chest.
"Pfft!"
Baby Shakes spat out a mouthful of blood.
He did not expect Connor to be so strong.
Following that, Connor wrapped his arms around Baby Shakes's neck and used the same method to get rid of him.
Connor knew that these two people were professional killers, and he also knew who sent them here, so he didn't leave any survivors. Killing these two people would be considered as eliminating evil for the people.
In less than a minute, Baby Shakes and Baby Don had fallen.
Connor looked at the corpses on the ground with a helpless expression. He didn't want to kill them, but in that situation, if he didn't kill them, they would definitely find a way to kill him.
Connor took a deep breath and carried the two bodies into another bedroom. Then, he ran downstairs and got a new room.
After checking in, Connor carried the unconscious Aida to the new room.
As for Baby Shakes and Baby Don's bodies, Connor wasn't worried at all. Cielo Collier didn't want the two of them to be seen by the police, so as long as Cielo knew that the two of them had failed their mission, he would definitely dispose of their bodies as soon as possible.
After tidying up everything, Connor sat on the bed alone.
Aida was still unconscious.
Connor turned and looked at Aida. He couldn't help but laugh and said softly, "You probably don't even know what happened tonight!"
After saying that, Connor was about to rest on the sofa.
However, he suddenly thought of Aida's attitude toward him in the room and her disgusted expression. Connor suddenly wanted to tease this woman.
Connor took off Aida's clothes, leaving only her underwear. Aida's figure was indeed very good.
Connor looked at Aida's delicate body, and a thought suddenly flashed through his mind. However, he quickly calmed himself down because he knew how dangerous Aida was. If he really did something with this woman, it might bring him a lot of trouble. Moreover, Aida was unconscious now. If Connor took advantage of her, it would be a little too unreasonable. Connor would not do such a thing.
Therefore, Connor only wanted to tease Aida and did not intend to take advantage of her.
Connor took off his shirt, but he didn't take off his pants. Then, he lay down beside Aida.
After everything was done, Connor turned to look at Aida and smiled with satisfaction.
Now Connor was curious about how Aida would react when she woke up the next morning.
"Who asked you to look down on me…"
Connor smiled and called out, then closed his eyes to rest.
Connor knew that he had failed today's mission. Cielo would definitely not find someone to attack him so quickly, so he was safe tonight. He could sleep in peace.
...
The Collier family's place in York.
Connor could sleep peacefully, but someone might not be able to sleep tonight.
Cielo had been waiting for Zaki's call in his room, but there was no news from him.
Cielo had a vague feeling that something was wrong.
Ring, ring, ring…
At this moment, Cielo's phone suddenly rang.
Without any hesitation, he picked up the phone and asked excitedly, "Mr. Serrano, what's the situation on your side now?"
"Mr. Cielo, I'm really sorry. Baby Shakes and Baby Don have probably failed…"
Zaki said in a low voice.
"What did you say?"
Cielo's eyes widened when he heard Zaki's words. He looked devastated.
"I've been trying to call the two of them, but no one is picking up. If they haven't contacted me after such a long time, it means that something must have happened to the two of them..."
Zaki said slowly.
"What should we do now?"
Cielo asked, feeling like he was about to collapse.
"Mr. Cielo, don't worry. I'll be able to arrive in Yarlford tomorrow. Get someone to keep an eye on the hotel. As long as they find the location of these two people, I'll personally take care of them!"
Zaki said in a low voice.
"Mr. Serrano, I don't want any mishaps to happen tomorrow…"
Cielo said expressionlessly.
"Don't worry, we don't want that to happen either. After all, Baby Shakes and Baby Don have been by my side for so many years. I will avenge their deaths!"
Zaki's tone was very calm when he said this, but Cielo could feel a trace of anger.
"Alright, let's keep in touch when you arrive in Yarlford tomorrow!"
Cielo knew that Zaki wasn't in a good mood, so he didn't continue to blame him. He replied in a low voice and hung up the phone.
The next day, around 8 AM.
Connor slowly opened his eyes, but when he saw the woman in front of him, he was stunned.
Aida's beautiful face was less than five centimeters away from Connor.
It was Connor's first time observing Aida so closely. He had to admit that this woman's face was indeed perfect. Her facial features were also very exquisite. There was no flaw at all.
However, Aida and Connor were in a very suggestive position.
Aida was hugging Connor's neck with both hands, and her slender and fair legs were also placed on Connor's waist. She was hugging him like an octopus.
Moreover, Aida was still asleep.
Connor looked a little exasperated because he had never expected this to happen. He had only wanted to tease Aida last night.

chapters.title: Chapter 1764: An Explanation
chapters.content:
Chapter 1764: An Explanation
Connor looked down at his pants and realized that he was still wearing them. This meant that nothing happened between the two of them last night.
Moreover, Aida was the one hugging him, not him. Even if Aida woke up, it wouldn't matter.
So, Connor didn't wake Aida up. Instead, he continued to lie on the bed and wait for the show to start.
At this moment, Connor was still looking forward to Aida's reaction when she woke up.
In the blink of an eye, half an hour had passed, and Aida's body moved slightly.
Connor knew that Aida was about to wake up, so he quickly closed his eyes and pretended to be asleep.
Sure enough, a few minutes later, Aida opened her eyes with great difficulty.
Because she had fainted yesterday, she still had a headache.
Aida shook her head, trying her best to wake herself up. However, the next second, she froze on the spot.
Because she realized that she was hugging a man, and this man was none other than Connor, who she hated the most.
When Aida saw Connor's face, she was shocked. She quickly lifted the blanket and looked at her clothes. Although her underwear was still there, her other clothes were gone.
Aida was about to have a mental breakdown, but she didn't choose to scream. On the contrary, she was very calm.
Aida moved her hands and legs away from Connor's body, then sat on the bed and recalled what she had experienced last night!
"That's not right. I was sleeping on the sofa last night, and then I suddenly fell asleep. But why am I sleeping on the bed? Who took off my clothes? What exactly is going on?"
Aida thought about these questions as she reached out to touch her bra. She realized that her bra had not been touched, which meant that nothing happened between her and Connor.
"Is this bastard deliberately trying to mess with me?"
Aida was indeed very smart. She quickly realized what was going on!
Aida was a little angry. She then reached out and pinched Connor's thigh.
"Ah!"
Connor, who was pretending to be asleep, shouted loudly. Then, he turned and shouted at Aida, "Are you crazy? Why did you pinch me?"
"What's going on?"
Aida covered her body with the blanket and asked Connor angrily.
"What do you mean?"
Connor pretended not to know anything.
"Where are my clothes? Why am I lying on the bed?"
Aida shouted in despair.
Connor was stunned for a moment, then hurriedly said, "Yeah, Miss Aida. Why are you on the bed? Didn't you sleep on the sofa yesterday? What's going on? Did you do something to me?"
"Are you still acting like you don't know what happened?"
Aida asked Connor coldly.
"Who's acting?"
Connor replied helplessly, then continued, "The two of us clearly agreed that I would sleep on the bed, and you didn't want to sleep with me, so you slept on the sofa. But now, you suddenly appeared on the bed next to me. Yet you're saying that I'm acting?"
"You must have taken off my clothes and thrown me on the bed!"
Aida said with certainty.
"Why would I do that?"
Connor asked speechlessly.
"Who knows? In any case, I would never get into bed with you!"
Aida said weakly.
"Were you sleepwalking?"
Connor hesitated for a moment before asking Aida.
"Get lost! I don't sleepwalk!"
Aida said as she stood up with the blanket wrapped around her. Then, she took her clothes and went into the bathroom.
Aida didn't want to continue talking about this with Connor.
When Connor saw Aida run to the bathroom, he smiled proudly.
A few minutes later, Aida had put on her clothes and walked out of the bathroom. Then she angrily shouted at Connor, "Connor, this is not the room we were staying in. What's going on?"
Aida had left her bag in the bathroom when she was taking a shower last night. However, when she went in just now, she realized that all her things were gone. Moreover, the bathroom was very clean. It didn't seem like anyone had used it.
"Yeah, I forgot to tell you that two assassins came last night, but I took care of them. I was just worried that sleeping in the same room with a dead person would be a little taboo, so I got us another room!"
Connor looked at Aida and explained.
"Then, why didn't I know about this? Why can't I remember anything now?"
Aida asked with a frown.
"The two assassins used knockout powder before entering the room, so you were knocked out!"
Connor paused for a moment before continuing, "I know why you're on my bed!"
"Why?"
Aida asked in confusion.
"Because the knockout powder that the two killers used on you had another effect. After I put you on the sofa last night, the drug took effect. Then, you took off your clothes and ran to my bed, wanting to do something with me, but I refused!"
Connor said seriously.
"Nonsense!"
Aida seemed to believe Connor's words and retorted huffily.
"If you don't believe me, I'll bring you to the previous room to take a look…"
Connor said as he dragged Aida out of the room.
A moment later, the two of them arrived at the previous room. Baby Shakes and Baby Don's bodies were indeed still on the bed in the bedroom.
Aida's face was filled with fear when she saw the two bodies.
"Do you believe me now?"
Connor asked Aida with a smile.
"Did… did assassins really come yesterday?"
Aida asked Connor in surprise.
"Don't you see the bodies on the bed?"
Connor replied indifferently.
Aida turned and glanced at Connor. At this moment, she did not know how to describe her feelings.
She didn't expect Connor to be serious. All of this was actually true. If it wasn't for Connor's presence last night, Aida might not even know how she died.

chapters.title: Chapter 1765: Returning to York
chapters.content:
Chapter 1765: Returning to York
"Thank you so much for saving me last night!"
Aida looked at Connor and thanked him from the bottom of her heart.
"You're welcome. Since I've already promised to help you, I'll definitely do my best to protect you!"
Connor replied indifferently.
"Then, what should we do next? What should we do with these two bodies?"
Aida now fully trusted Connor.
"Let's go back to the room first!"
Connor turned around and walked out of the room.
A few minutes later, Connor and Aida returned to the room.
This time, Aida's attitude toward Connor had changed drastically.
"You don't have to worry about this. I reckon that after we leave this hotel, someone will probably deal with it…"
Connor paused for a moment and then continued, "However, there's a very tricky problem before us now!"
"What is it?"
Aida blinked and asked Connor.
"Cielo Collier must already know that you and I are together, but our relationship can't be discovered yet, so you might not be able to go to Gevada now…"
Connor said in a low voice.
"Then, where will we go?"
Aida asked with a frown.
"Let me send you back to York!"
Connor thought for a moment and said.
"Back to York?"
Aida looked confused.
"That's right. I'll contact the Collier family as soon as I get to York. I'll tell them that I've kidnapped you. That way, we can dissolve any speculations about our relationship. Only then can you continue to stay in the Collier family and help me gather information..."
Connor said expressionlessly.
"Will it work? Won't the Collier family find out?"
Aida asked in a low voice.
"First of all, Cielo already knows that the two of us are together and that we are living in the same room. If you go to Gevada, it will only prove one thing; that I am here to protect you. If they know that I am protecting you, they will definitely suspect our relationship. So, the best option now is for you to pretend to be kidnapped by me."
Connor said in a low voice.
"I guess there aren't any other options now!"
Aida looked at Connor and sighed.
"Go and book the plane tickets. The two of us will go straight back to York!"
Connor said lightly.
"Alright!"
Aida agreed and took out her phone to book the plane tickets.
A few minutes later, Aida looked at Connor and said, "The next flight will be in three hours…"
"That's perfect timing. Let's go eat something first before going to the airport!"
Connor said.
"How do you still have the appetite?"
Aida asked Connor speechlessly.
"I'll only have energy after I eat. Also, eating won't cause us any problems, right? I still have a lot of enemies to deal with next. I have to ensure that I eat and drink well!"
Connor said with a smile.
Aida looked at Connor speechlessly, but she didn't say anything. She stood up and followed him out of the room.
After leaving the hotel, Connor began to look for a place to eat.
Along the way, Connor noticed that there were people following him, but Connor didn't care because he knew that these people weren't professional killers. They were just responsible for following him.
After more than ten minutes, he got off the car in front of a relatively high-end restaurant.
This restaurant was very famous in Yarlford, and it was also the property of the Gomez family, so Connor felt that Cielo's people would definitely not choose to make a move in this restaurant.
After entering the restaurant, Connor ordered a large table of dishes. Since he didn't need to spend money now, he would definitely eat whatever was expensive.
Aida was not in the mood to eat, so she sat beside Connor with a heavy heart.
She was still feeling very vexed, especially after seeing the two bodies. She did not expect Cielo to really want to kill her.
After more than an hour, Connor was almost done eating. He looked at the time and said to Aida softly, "Alright, let's go to the airport now!"
"Are you thinking of bringing me back alone?"
Aida asked Connor doubtfully.
"What else?"
Connor asked.
"York is very dangerous right now. I think it's safer for you to bring your bodyguard back with me."
Aida said softly.
"There's no need for that!"
Connor replied casually and then continued, "Yama doesn't even know his own name, and he definitely doesn't have an ID card on him. We won't even be able to buy him a plane ticket. It'll be more troublesome if we bring him along…"
"But Cielo failed this time. Next time, he will definitely find a stronger assassin to deal with you. I'm worried that you won't be able to protect me!"
Aida still seemed a little worried.
"I won't joke with you with my life. Since I said that it won't be a problem, it won't be a problem. I'll definitely send you back to the Collier family safe and sound."
Connor said lightly.
"After we reach the Collier family's place, Cielo probably won't dare to lay a hand on me!"
Aida heaved a long sigh of relief.
"You should think of a way to get rid of Cielo. Otherwise, I won't be able to protect you forever…"
Connor looked at Aida and said.
"I'm also looking for an opportunity, but it's just not the right time yet!"
Aida shook her head and said.
Connor hesitated for a moment and didn't say anything else. He pulled Aida out of the restaurant.
After leaving the hotel, Connor brought Aida to the airport and waited for the flight.
Connor was very relaxed in the airport because there were many police officers at the airport. Cielo's men definitely did not have the courage to make a move in the airport.
However, once they got on the plane, it would be a little hard to say.
No one knew what kind of crazy things the killer hired by Cielo would do.
...
On the other side, in the Collier family of York.
"Dane, what's the situation on your side? Have the bodies in the hotel been disposed of?"
Cielo asked after receiving Dane Weiss's call.
"The corpses have already been disposed of…"
Dane replied.
"That's good. What's the situation with Connor and Aida?"
Cielo hurriedly asked.
"The two of them are in the airport now. They are preparing to board the plane!"
Dane said indifferently as he observed Connor who was not far away.
"Are they getting on the plane?"
Cielo had a strange look on his face as he asked, "Do you know which flight they are taking?"
"I just went to ask. The two of them are on a flight from Yarlford to York. It will take off at two in the afternoon…"
Dane replied.

chapters.title: Chapter 1766: That Person Is the Assassin!
chapters.content:
Chapter 1766: That Person Is the Assassin!
"Aida is going back to York?"
Cielo's expression immediately turned somewhat ugly upon hearing this.
He knew that once Aida returned to York, he wouldn't be able to act against her. Even though Beau supported him to succeed the position of the family head in the future, Aida was crucial to the Collie family. Most of the business operations were managed by her. If Beau found out that he had killed her, he would be in trouble.
"We absolutely can't let this woman return to York!"
Cielo yelled without any expression on his face, then continued asking, "Dane, besides Connor, is there anyone else with Aida?"
"I'll check right now!" Dane replied briefly before hanging up the phone directly.
A few minutes later, Cielo received Dane's message that there was only Connor by her side. She had purchased two plane tickets—one for herself and the other for Connor.
The information was quite accurate as Dane had obtained it from the flight manager.
Upon learning that Connor was the only one with Aida, Cielo's mood improved significantly. He immediately dialed Zaki's phone number.
"Mr. Zaki, Connor and Aida are boarding a flight today at 2 o'clock. It's from Yarlford to York. I want you to deal with that woman on the plane. She must not be allowed to get off the plane. Do you have any issues?" Cielo said directly.
"How many people are around that woman?" Zaki asked.
"Probably just Connor," Cielo answered.
"Shouldn't be a problem. I'll head to the airport now!"
"Good, I'll book the flight for you!" Cielo replied in a low voice before hanging up the phone.
Connor and Aida waited at the airport for almost an hour, and finally, it was time to board.
However, he noticed that she had booked a first-class ticket.
"Why did you get a first-class ticket?" he asked with some confusion.
"I don't like economy class. It's too crowded," she replied casually.
"Given the situation you're in, are you still worrying about how crowded it is?" His expression was incredibly bewildered as he continued, "First-class cabins have fewer people. If an assassin gets in, we might not even have a chance to escape..."
"What should we do now? Should I switch seats?"
"Forget it, changing seats now might draw more attention, and the assassin might not have chosen first class..." He shook his head helplessly and found his seat.
To ensure her safety, he had her sit next to the window.
A few minutes later, the plane took off.
While she gazed at the scenery outside and put on her headphones, apparently intending to rest, he removed her headphones and whispered, "Are you crazy?"
"What are you doing?" she responded agitatedly.
"The assassin is very likely on this plane. With your headphones on and eyes closed, how can you observe your surroundings? You need to stay highly alert right now. If anything happens, you need to be ready to react!" he explained helplessly.
She paused for a moment, then directly took off her headphones.
"Loosen your seatbelt too. It's not convenient for you to escape with it on..." he continued.
She didn't argue, and released her seatbelt as told.
He began to carefully observe all the passengers in the cabin.
"Didn't expect you to be quite smart..." Aida suddenly spoke to Connor.
"Why do you say that?" he asked calmly.
"I feel like even though you don't look very serious, you're being quite careful at a time like this!" she softly said.
"That's because I've encountered many situations like this before. I've already gotten used to it. There's a high chance that the assassin is on this flight. Try to spot..." he continued.
She was taken aback upon hearing his words, and her expression turned incredibly incredulous. She asked, "Are you kidding? You're saying the assassin is on this flight?"
"Yes, see if you can find them." He softly nodded.
Aida suddenly turned to look behind her.
"Move more discreetly, don't attract the assassin's attention!" he whispered helplessly to her.
After taking a deep breath, she began to observe the people around her.
However, after a thorough search, she didn't find anyone suspicious, nor did she notice anyone staring at her consistently.
She thought that if there really was an assassin, they would be constantly watching her.
"Found them?" he asked softly.
"No, I didn't see anyone who looks like an assassin..." She shook her head after scanning around.
"Heh..." Connor chuckled upon hearing her words, then whispered, "There's a middle-aged man with glasses in front of you. That person is the assassin!"
"How do you know?" she asked, clearly puzzled.
"This person's aura is different from an ordinary person's. Although he deliberately controlled and concealed his aura from the beginning, I can still sense a significant gap between his aura and that of an ordinary person. A regular person's weak aura is naturally weak, but his weak aura is a result of deliberate control. This is something that can't be concealed..." he explained calmly.
"This person might be a martial artist, but that doesn't prove he's an assassin, does it?" she whispered.
"Of course, we can't conclude he's an assassin just based on this."
"Exactly, he's even more cautious," Connor replied, then continued, "This person's gaze is different from a regular person's. There's a trace of killing intent in his eyes. Moreover, there are so many people in the cabin, and all the men subconsciously glance at you. Some longer, some shorter. But all men would look at you—it's a man's nature..."
"But this man hasn't looked at you even once. This also shows he's deliberately concealing himself."
"I see now!" Aida suddenly understood.
"Now do you believe that person is an assassin?" Connor asked softly.
"I believe!"
Aida looked at Connor and nodded.

chapters.title: Chapter 1767: Can't Hold It In Anymore
chapters.content:
Chapter 1767: Can't Hold It In Anymore
"Hahaha..."
Connor suddenly chuckled and whispered, "I was just joking with you. Those things I said earlier were just random words, I didn't expect you to actually believe them..."
"You!" Aida couldn't believe that at this moment, Connor would still be in the mood to play around. Her eyes were filled with anger.
"Don't be mad, I saw you were so nervous just now, so I wanted you to relax a bit..." He chuckled and said.
"Do you think it's fun to make such jokes right now?" she asked coldly.
"Flight attendant!" Connor was about to say something, but the middle-aged man with glasses suddenly called out.
"Sir, is there something you need?" The flight attendant hurriedly walked over to the middle-aged man, smiling.
"I need a glass of water!" the man replied.
"Of course, please wait a moment!" The flight attendant agreed and then turned away.
Moments later, she handed a glass of water to the middle-aged man.
Connor had been observing this person all along. When the man extended his right hand, his suspicions were confirmed.
Because the plane was a bit turbulent, the water in the glass was shaking continuously. However, as soon as the man held the glass, the water immediately stopped moving.
This might have been a natural action for a man, but it exposed that he was not an ordinary person at all.
If this man was not an assassin but rather a martial artist, he had no reason to hide his aura continuously. Since he was concealing his aura, it meant he was hiding something.
Although he was quite confident in this assessment, he didn't tell Aida. He was worried that her excessive nervousness would disrupt their judgment.
As he was pondering these issues, she suddenly stood up.
He quickly reached out and pulled her back into her seat, furrowing his brows, "Have you gone mad? Why are you standing up now?"
She turned to look at him without saying a word.
"I'm asking you a question. What are you doing standing up? Sit down!" He scolded as he pushed Aida back into her seat.
"What are you doing? I just want to go to the restroom. Is this how you're going to react?" she asked, frustrated.
"To the restroom?" Connor's expression seemed somewhat exasperated upon hearing Aida's words. He whispered, "There's someone on this plane trying to kill you. They're probably struggling to find an opportunity to act. If you go to the restroom right now, you're practically handing them a chance."
"I needed to use the restroom even before we boarded. But you kept stopping me, and now... I just really need to go!" Her face turned red as she explained.
He looked at her for a moment, at a loss for words. He was starting to regret not letting her go to the restroom at the airport. At least it would have been safer back then.
"Can't you hold it for a little longer? We'll be able to get off the plane in two hours!" he said to her.
"Hold it?!" She was utterly speechless upon hearing his words. She lowered her voice and said, "You're really being unsympathetic. How can I hold it in a situation like this?"
"It's just going to the restroom, what's the big deal? Hold on for a bit, and it'll pass..." he said nonchalantly.
"I can't. I really need to go now..." Aida looked at Connor and said.
"You can't hold it in?"
He glanced at her, speaking quite directly.
"You..."
She was at loss for words.
"Could it be a health issue?" he continued to ask.
"What health issue? I just need to use the restroom. Do you or do you not want to come with me?" she asked in desperation.
"Fine, considering you can't hold it in, I'll accompany you." He reluctantly nodded and stood up, wrapping his arm around her shoulder.
"What are you doing?" She was momentarily stunned, looking at him with a puzzled expression.
"If we're going to the restroom, we have to pass by that man's seat. The aisle is narrow, whether you walk in front or I do, he'll have an opportunity to attack you. The best option is for us to walk side by side. I need to have my arm around you to ensure we can pass without any issues. Got it?" he explained helplessly.
Aida turned to look at Connor, her expression seeming somewhat peculiar.
However, considering they had already spent last night together, this wasn't a big deal for her. Thus, she didn't continue the conversation.
As they passed by the man's seat, Connor was extremely tense. He was closely observing the man's reactions. If the man made any sudden movements, he was ready to react immediately.
Aida seemed to sense his nervousness and did her best to cooperate, striving not to be a burden.
But soon he realized he might have overthought it. The man wasn't paying any attention to them at all; he remained quietly sipping his water, his expression very calm.

chapters.title: Chapter 1768: There Is Only One Way
chapters.content:
Chapter 1768: There Is Only One Way
"Could I have overthought things?"
Connor couldn't help but mutter to himself.
"It seems like this man might not be an assassin after all," Aida whispered to him.
"It's not certain. Maybe he thought the timing wasn't right earlier, so he didn't make a move. We can't let our guard down!" he said in a low voice.
"You just want to take advantage of me..." She looked at his hand wrapped around her waist and spoke angrily.
"Who's taking advantage of whom? Didn't you strip naked and climb into my bed yesterday? It's not like I forced you," he retorted.
"Of course, something must have happened between us!" She couldn't believe she could do such a thing, so naturally, she wouldn't believe his words.
A few seconds later, they arrived at the restroom door.
She opened the door and was about to enter.
"Wait a moment!" He reached out and stopped her.
"What's wrong?" she asked anxiously.
"You need to think this through. If the assassin is in the restroom right now, the moment you go in, it's certain death," he whispered to her.
"Then you go in first!" Realizing Connor's intention, She quickly stepped back.
"What can I do by going in first? What if the killer is hiding above or below the restroom? Don't forget, airplane restrooms are accessible from the cabin, which makes it easy to hide either above or below. If that's the case, going in alone won't solve anything..." he calmly explained.
"So, what should we do?" She frowned.
"At the moment, there's only one solution..." he whispered.
"Don't waste time. What solution are you talking about?" she urgently asked.
"The solution is for me to accompany you inside. But rest assured, I won't peek. You can consider it. If you're still not at ease, you can go in alone, and I'll wait outside. If anything happens, just call for me!" Connor's expression was serious as he explained.
Aida seemed to find his words reasonable, so after hesitating for a moment, she said, "Come with me inside..."
"Why are you so readily agreeing this time?" he asked in surprise.
"In order to return safely, I've let you kiss me, touch me, and even... last night..." She took a deep breath and continued, "I've paid such a high price. I can't give up because of something like this. If the killer is really in there as you said, it would mean all my previous efforts were in vain."
She had already figured it out. At this point, as long as she could ensure her safety, she didn't care about anything else.
"If you had figured this out earlier, I wouldn't have needed to say so much. After all, I really don't intend to take advantage of you!" he said indifferently.
"Enough talking. Come in!" she urged in a low voice, eager to use the restroom.
He walked up to her, pushed open the restroom door with caution, and after confirming that it was safe, he entered. She hesitated for a moment and followed him inside.
However, she didn't notice that as she entered the restroom, a flight attendant passed by.
She witnessed them talking and then entering the restroom together.
The flight attendant found Aida's demeanor quite extraordinary and concluded that Connor might be some scion of a wealthy family. Otherwise, he wouldn't have invited such a beautiful woman to do something so daring in the airplane restroom.
However, the flight attendant was used to such situations on the plane and didn't choose to disturb them.
The restroom in first class was quite spacious. Connor stood in a corner, turning his back to Aida.
"Are you sure you won't peek?" she asked nervously.
"It's not exactly the right time for me to be peeking at you. If I wanted to, I had plenty of opportunities last night. Why would I choose to peek now? Do you want to use the restroom or not?" Connor's exasperation was evident in his tone.
She found his reasoning sensible and stopped arguing. She took off her pants and sat down on the toilet seat.
A few minutes later, he heard the sound of flushing and asked, "Are you done?"
"Yes..." she replied in a low voice.
Upon hearing this, he quickly turned around and glanced at her. This was the first time he had encountered such a situation, and her flushed face was quite unusual.
"Connor, let me make this clear. You can't tell anyone about this!" She threatened him anxiously.
"Tell anyone? Why would I go around telling people about this? Besides, even if I did, who would believe me? Even if I said I saw Miss Aida from the Collie family using the restroom, it's not like it's something to be proud of. I'm still Mr. Connor from Davenport, not some big pervert," he replied, his expression showing a touch of helplessness.
Aida gave Connor a casual glance, thinking that his words made sense. She also realized that even if this matter were disclosed, nobody would believe it, so she relaxed a bit.
"Let's go out!" he said in a low voice.
She pushed the door open immediately.
They walked out of the restroom one after the other.
However, the flight attendant who had seen them enter the restroom was still standing at the door. She looked at them in shock as they emerged and then checked the time.
"Less than a minute? That was really quick!" The flight attendant couldn't help but sigh, her expression complex as she looked at Connor.
He didn't notice the flight attendant's gaze. He continued to hold onto Aida as they walked forward.
Soon, they passed by the middle-aged man, but the man still made no moves, nor did he even glance at Connor. This only deepened Connor confusion.
According to reason, this man was the most suspicious person on the plane. If it wasn't him, then who else could it be?

chapters.title: Chapter 1769: Are You Crazy?
chapters.content:
Chapter 1769: Are You Crazy?
"Could it be that the assassin never boarded the plane in the first place? Is he planning to attack us after we land?"
Connor contemplated in his mind.
At this moment, he had reached his seat.
Instinctively, he stepped aside to let Aida in.
However, in that split second, he felt a powerful aura erupting within the cabin.
He quickly turned his head for a glance.
The middle-aged man stood up directly.
This time, he was absolutely certain that the middle-aged man was the assassin.
The man didn't take action, but instead pulled out a handgun and aimed it directly at Aida.
"Get down!" Connor shouted loudly upon seeing the gun, then he forcefully pushed Aida.
"Ah!"
"Bang!"
Immediately after, a gunshot rang out.
Since everything had happened so suddenly, Connor didn't have a chance to manipulate the bullet's trajectory using his aura.
However, he was fortunate. The man had aimed at Aida, not him. And due to his push, the bullet missed her but grazed his arm.
The bullet hadn't pierced through his arm; it had just grazed him, causing his arm to bleed, but the injury wasn't severe.
The entire cabin erupted into chaos.
Screams filled the air.
The middle-aged man's expression seemed a bit surprised, as he hadn't expected Connor to react in the midst of the situation.
But despite his surprise, as a professional assassin, he remained composed. Instead of attacking Connor again, he focused his attention on her and aimed the gun at her once more.
"Move!" Connor shouted urgently upon seeing the man with the gun, and with a strong push, he sent Aida towards the floor.
"Crash!"
Following his command, the sound of gunfire followed.
Due to the confined space, Connor couldn't change the bullet's trajectory in time using his aura.
However, in the next instant, he decided to manipulate the bullet's path.
The bullet directly pierced through the furniture in front of Connor, missing him.
The middle-aged man's expression changed slightly. He finally understood why his two disciples had failed earlier. Connor's abilities were indeed formidable.
The man pulled out a dagger from his belt and rapidly approached him.
With limited space within the aircraft cabin, Connor and the man were forced into close-quarters combat.
The man's martial arts skills were clearly higher than Connor's, giving him the upper hand from the start.
But his body was exceptional due to the Essence Cultivating Pill he had consumed, and he possessed physical qualities beyond that of an average person.
The two engaged in close combat, punch after punch, yet the passengers around them screamed in disbelief. Aida stared at Connor with wide eyes, her expression incredulous.
At this moment, she finally realized how right her decision to ask for his help had been. Without him, she might have died yesterday night, or even now.
However, she couldn't understand why Cielo's subordinate would be so audacious, attempting to attack her on the plane. Even if he succeeded, he wouldn't be able to escape afterward.
"Thud!"
Suddenly, Connor couldn't hold on any longer. He was kicked and sent flying by the middle-aged man.
After kicking Connor away, the man didn't continue to attack him. Instead, he swiftly moved towards Aida's position.
He was acutely aware that killing Connor wasn't going to be an easy task, and his true objective this time was Aida. He believed that killing her was more crucial.
Upon seeing the middle-aged man preparing to harm Aida, Connor quickly stood up and positioned himself between them.
"Kid, you're not my match. Get out of my way!" The middle-aged man shouted impatiently at Connor.
"I know I'm not your match. But if you want to kill this woman today, you'll have to get through me first," Connor replied in a low voice.
Upon hearing Connor's words, Aida felt a slight touch of emotion. She hadn't expected Connor to go to such lengths and not give up on her, standing in front of her instead.
"Have you gone mad?" The middle-aged man snapped irritably.
"Tap, tap, tap..."
However, at that moment, the middle-aged man heard a series of urgent footsteps.
He quickly glanced outside the plane, only to realize that the plane had already landed.
Upon hearing the gunshots, the pilot had realized that something was amiss and had immediately contacted headquarters, choosing the nearest airport for an emergency landing.
The middle-aged man knew that the police would likely arrive soon. He had already wasted too much time dealing with Connor.
If he continued to fight with Connor, even if he managed to kill Aida, he wouldn't be able to escape the plane.
With this realization, the man took out a smoke bomb from his pocket and threw it on the ground.
"Bang!"
A loud explosion echoed.
The entire cabin was instantly filled with smoke.
Connor quickly held Aida in his arms, worried that the assassin might take advantage of the smoke to attack her.
However, the assassin didn't waste any time and seized the opportunity to escape.
After all, he was hired by Cielo. If he failed, he wouldn't get paid. But if he got caught by the police, he would lose everything. So, sacrificing himself just for this one task wasn't an option.
During the explosion of the smoke bomb, he did have a 50% chance to kill Aida, but he wasn't willing to take that risk.
Thus, he chose the safest approach and immediately fled to the economy class section of the plane.

chapters.title: Chapter 1770: Relying on Yourself
chapters.content:
Chapter 1770: Relying on Yourself
After the smoke completely dissipated, Connor noticed a human skin mask on the ground. It was evident that the assassin hadn't revealed their true face, making it difficult to identify them.
"Connor, are you okay?" Aida looked at his bleeding arm with concern, her expression nervous.
While he had previously left a negative impression on her, after the recent events, she realized that he was trustworthy. She acknowledged that he had proven himself through his actions, even though she had deceived him multiple times before. His behavior during the crisis had shifted her perception of him.
"I'm more resilient than you'd think, and you seem to be quite resilient too. We should both be safe…" he replied with a calm expression.
She nodded in relief. "That's good to hear."
"Sir, I have some gauze here. Let me help you bandage your arm," a flight attendant hurriedly approached Connor, offering assistance.
"No need, I'll take care of it myself. You should go attend to other matters," he replied, taking the first aid kit from the flight attendant and starting to bandage his arm.
As he tended to his wound, Aida observed him with a mix of emotions. She felt she was unable to contribute much at the moment and realized that he had saved her life, even though their relationship had been strained. She had underestimated his character and capabilities.
"You seem quite skilled at this," she commented softly.
Connor chuckled at her words, then whispered, "You might not know, but before inheriting Steven's legacy, I did all sorts of jobs just to survive. I even worked as a hospital orderly, earning 80 dollars an hour. But the work was exhausting, so I switched to handing out flyers…"
"You've done such jobs?" She was surprised.
"Yeah, I've done all sorts of odd jobs. Unlike you, I grew up without my parents. I've managed to survive until now through my own efforts," he stated in a nonchalant manner.
"I never realized…" Her expression was full of disbelief.
Meanwhile, the flight attendant began to reassure the passengers.
Although the passengers had quieted down, the tension in the air remained. They knew that the shooter was on the plane, and their nerves were still on edge.
"Connor, what should we do now?" Aida whispered to him.
"Stay put. Don't do anything, just stay here," he responded in a low voice.
"Is that person still on the plane?" she continued to inquire.
"Yes, he probably bought two tickets and used a human skin mask. So he's currently in the economy class section. Here is the safest place for us. If you wander around, you might give him an opportunity. The best course of action is to sit tight," he advised.
"Okay, got it…" She nodded.
About ten minutes later, the police finally arrived.
Connor's expression became resigned upon seeing the police officers. He knew that they wouldn't be able to unravel the truth behind the incident.
The police quickly found a corpse in the restroom, which bore a striking resemblance to the middle-aged man the flight attendant had seen. They concluded that the individual had committed suicide.
However, he was aware that the man was just a scapegoat, and the real assassin was among the passengers. Even though he knew the truth, he chose not to interfere further.
When the police realized Connor was a victim, they found him and intended to take him to the local police station for questioning. However, he wasn't in the mood for such procedures. Additionally, he knew that getting off the plane would only complicate matters. Moreover, he was already well aware that the actual threat to Aida's life was Cielo. Even if the police investigated, what significant outcome could they achieve?
He called Rachel and quickly got the situation under control.
The police on the plane apologized to him once they understood his situation and removed the corpse from the aircraft.
After all these matters were settled, the plane took off again.
However, most of the passengers had already chosen to disembark and take alternative flights to York.
Connor was aware that the true assassin must have also left the plane, making the current flight the safest option. If he and Aida were to choose another flight at this point, it would take a long time, and who knows what might happen in the meantime.
An hour later, they safely arrived in York.
As they disembarked, Aida breathed a sigh of relief and turned to Connor, asking, "Are we finally safe now?"
"It's not certain," He shook his head gently and continued, "Who knows if Cielo might still target you?"
"What do you think we should do now?" she inquired anxiously.
"For now, let's find a hotel. Then I'll get in touch with the Collie family, informing them that you've been kidnapped and demanding a substantial ransom. We'll wait for Albert to bring the money and ensure your safety," he hesitated before speaking softly.
"Alright, I'll follow your lead," she agreed quickly.
Connor cast a slightly helpless look at Aida, silently noting her swift change in demeanor.
Knowing that York was the territory of the Collie family, he refrained from taking any rash actions and once again sought Rachel's assistance.
Rachel arranged accommodation for him and arranged for someone to pick him up.
By 5 PM that evening, Connor and Aida had arrived at the location Rachel had arranged for them.

chapters.title: Chapter 1771: Are You Asleep?
chapters.content:
Chapter 1771: Are You Asleep?
There were many people in the hotel, and it was very easy for the Collie family to find out, so Rachel Wallace found a small area for Connor.
There weren't many people in this neighborhood, and the environment was also very good. Most importantly, there was very little security in this neighborhood. No one could monitor them at all.
Connor's plan was to settle Aida in this place first, and then he would communicate with Albert about rescuing her.
On the other side, after learning of Zaki's failure, Cielo drove directly to a hotel. He entered the hotel and went straight to Zaki's room, knocking on the door.
The door opened quickly, and Cielo stepped into the room.
"Mr. Cielo, I'm really sorry, my mission failed..." Zaki's expression was grim. Both of his disciples were dead, and he hadn't managed to kill Aida. This time, he felt like he had been wasting his time.
"Zaki, Zaki, what can I say to you?" Cielo's face displayed extreme frustration, almost gritting his teeth as he spoke.
"It was my carelessness; I didn't expect that kid Connor to be so formidable. When I shot at Aida twice, he managed to dodge both times. I even had a confrontation with him..." Zaki said in a hushed tone.
"What's Connor's skill level like?" Cielo hurriedly asked.
"Considering his age, his skills are exceptional, but he's not my match..." Zaki replied.
Upon hearing this, Cielo's expression seemed even more incredulous. He asked, "If you're saying Connor wasn't your match, why didn't you kill him? Even if you couldn't get Aida, eliminating Connor would have been enough!"
"Because the situation was extremely urgent at the time, I simply didn't have the time. If I had more time, I could have killed him for sure!" Zaki explained.
"Back then, I was worried you might mess this up, and I told you to be careful. But in the end, you still botched it..." Cielo sighed.
"Mr. Cielo, you shouldn't worry too much. Right now, that kid Connor should still be in Yanjing. I still have a chance!" Zaki's expression was still, and he seemed deeply unsatisfied.
"If you try to harm Aida now, won't everyone know it's me who wants her dead? You've failed twice in a row; I'm afraid Connor is now prepared. If you go now, you might just be walking into a trap. Wait for my instructions!" Cielo commanded.
"Alright..." Zaki had no choice but to agree and nodded lightly.
Cielo cast a helpless look at Zaki and then walked out of the room.
Half an hour later, Cielo returned to the Collie family residence.
Shereen knew Cielo had returned and rushed to his room, asking softly, "Cielo, how did things go?"
"What else could happen? That Zaki is simply useless. He had such a great opportunity, and he still managed to fail. I'm truly exasperated!" he said, deeply dejected.
"What? He failed?" Her expression showed surprise.
"Yes, Aida was rescued by Connor. I don't understand what's going on with these two. Could it be that Aida has really teamed up with Connor?" He couldn't comprehend the situation.
Shereen, looking at Cielo hesitated for a couple of seconds before saying, "If that's really the case, I have a way to deal with Aida."
"What method?" he asked.
"It's quite simple. Don't you have the pictures of Connor and Aida going to the hotel together? Just show those pictures to your grandfather. He despises Connor so much that if he finds out his granddaughter is involved with someone like Connor, he definitely won't spare Aida. By then, even if she doesn't die, she won't pose a threat to you anymore!" Shereen, being rather clever, quickly thought of a countermeasure.
"But I think Aida will definitely find an excuse to explain the situation. She's not stupid; how could she admit to such a thing?" he said somewhat puzzled.
"Now that Aida isn't home, she doesn't have the opportunity to explain anything," she replied calmly.
"Right, Aida has no chance to explain things now!" He nodded in agreement.
"You must get those pictures to your grandfather before Aida returns. But you mustn't let him know that you handed over the pictures personally..." she advised.
"Why not?" he asked.
"My dear son, why do you think? Your grandfather has always been aware of the competition between you and Aida. If he finds out that you sent these pictures, he might think you're deliberately framing Aida. The results could backfire. So, it's better if you keep it from him," she explained helplessly.
"Well, Mom, you're indeed very clever..." He chuckled when he heard Shereen's words.
"Alright, you better get going and handle these matters quickly," she said calmly.
Cielo immediately took out his phone and began making calls.
On the other side, Connor and Aida stayed in the place arranged by Qin Lan. The house had two bedrooms, and there were Rachel's people nearby. Therefore, he finally felt he could relax and get a good night's sleep.
Due to the relatively safe situation, and because Cielo had no idea that they were staying there, Connor and Aida didn't share the same room. However, she found it difficult to sleep alone. After everything they had been through in the past few days, she felt anxious every time she closed her eyes.
After tossing and turning for several minutes, she put on her shoes and walked to his room. She hesitated for a long time before finally knocking on the door.
"Connor, are you asleep?" she asked softly.
"I just fell asleep, but you woke me up. What's the matter?" he asked.
"Well, you see, I'm feeling a bit scared being alone in my room. Can I sleep in your room?" she asked cautiously.

chapters.title: Chapter 1772: The Past
chapters.content:
Chapter 1772: The Past
Upon hearing Aida's request, Connor couldn't help but pause for a moment, then smiled and said, "Are you implying that you have no ulterior motives towards me, Miss Aida?"
"Who has any motives for you? I'm really just scared! Do you think I would actually like someone like you?" Aida replied with exasperation.
"Back when I suggested sharing a room, you adamantly refused. Now, you're voluntarily asking to share a room. You're quite a strange person," he commented, shaking his head in amusement.
"Are you agreeing or not? If you're not, I'll go back to my room!" she asked hesitantly.
"Alright, I see you're quite pitiful. The door isn't locked; come in!" he said casually.
Upon hearing his response, she quickly entered his room.
"Let me make it clear; I won't sleep on the couch. If you want to sleep on the bed, go back to your room," he told her as he turned on the light.
"No need; I'll just sit on the couch for the night," she said, knowing she couldn't compete for the bed.
"Are you planning to sneak into my bed again in the middle of the night?" he asked cautiously.
"Get lost!" she retorted, rolling her eyes at Connor. She then took out her phone and started checking her emails.
Connor glanced at her and asked, "What are you doing?"
"Working!" Aida replied.
He was momentarily speechless upon hearing this. He frowned and said, "Sometimes, I find you quite pitiable. You've been hunted down by your own family, and although I used to envy having a family, if they're like your family, I'd rather not. Plus, you're working even at a time like this. I really admire you!"
"In any case, I can't sleep, so I might as well check my emails to pass the time!" she said casually.
"Well, don't you have any other hobbies? You can play mobile games; I can recommend one. I've spent over a hundred thousand in it, and it's really fun..." Connor suggested, taking out his own phone.
"No thanks!" She declined.
"Suit yourself..." He lay down on the bed, opened his mobile game, and started playing seriously.
Connor lay on the bed and opened his mobile game. Then, he began playing it seriously.
Aida turned to look at Connor and was surprised to see that he was actually playing a game. Her expression seemed somewhat helpless, and she softly said, "You're quite amusing, you know. Sometimes, I think you're quite scheming, but other times, you seem really childish..."
"No choice, if I don't have a bit of cunning when dealing with people like you, I'd have been played to death by all of you a long time ago..."
