"But I don't like this kind of life. I still think my previous life was better. We may not have had much money, but we were happy. We didn't have to live every day in suspense and manipulation..."
"Take playing games, for example. Back then, I could be happy all night just by casually getting a better piece of equipment. But now, I don't have that feeling anymore because no matter what equipment I want, I can buy it with money!"
Connor said with a chuckle.
"Can you tell me about your past?"
Aida suddenly became curious and asked Connor.
"My past?"
Connor couldn't help but pause when he heard Aida's question.
"Yes, I'm quite curious about what you've been through. I did some research on your background, and I know you inherited Steven's legacy and became Jorge's disciple. But I'm not very clear about what happened before that, so I'm curious..."
Aida said softly.
"The past is in the past, and I don't want to dwell on those things anymore..."
Connor didn't intend to tell Aida about his past because he always felt that this woman was too dangerous. The more she knew about him, the more she might use it to her advantage.
"It seems you still don't truly trust me, even now."
Aida sighed softly as she looked at Connor.
"You're a very cunning woman..."
Connor said directly.
"You..."
Aida glanced at him, feeling somewhat helpless. She then changed the subject and asked, "So, what's your plan for the next steps?"
"What else can I do? Tomorrow, I'll call Albert and let him know that you're in my hands, and I'll ask for money in exchange for your safety," Connor replied, pausing for a moment before continuing, "At that time, I'll need you to act in front of them, try to convince them. This way, we both get the money, and you can continue to gather information about Collie's and Gomez's families."
"But you mustn't let Shereen or Cielo know about this!" Aida said after thinking for a moment.
"Why?" Connor asked with a furrowed brow.
"Because both of them want me dead. Even if they find out that you've kidnapped me, they won't pay to save me. On the contrary, they might choose to conceal the information. By then, both of us will be in a very passive position..." she explained.
"Rest assured, I'll try to contact Beau or Albert directly. I believe they should care about your life and death!" He nodded.
"Albert might agree to save me, but only if the price isn't too high. If it exceeds the value I can bring to the Chen family, he'll choose to abandon me," she said, sounding somewhat sad.
"So, how much money do you think would be appropriate?" he asked.
"If the price you ask for is too high, Albert definitely won't agree. But if it's too low, it will make the Chen family suspicious of your true motives. So, you must choose the right price!" After a brief pause, Aida answered, "I think Albert would be willing to pay up to 2 billion. Without this project I have, he'd probably only offer up to 1 billion."
"2 billion?" Connor was momentarily surprised.
"Yes, I have a project now, and its profits are at least over 1 billion. However, without me, the Chen family would lose at least 3 billion. So, in such a critical situation, Albert would definitely not want anything to happen to me. If you ask for 2 billion, he should agree," she analyzed.
"What if this project of yours didn't exist? How much do you think they'd be willing to pay at most?" he asked.
"Probably only 1 billion," she replied after some consideration.

chapters.title: Chapter 1773: Some Pictures
chapters.content:
Chapter 1773: Some Pictures
"Hehe..."
Connor couldn't help but let out a cold laugh and then said lightly, "I didn't expect Albert's heart to be so ruthless, valuing his own daughter at only one billion!"
"Well, sometimes I'm not that important in the Collier family..."
Aida's expression seemed somewhat unpleasant, and she continued, "If the same thing happened to Cielo, even if it meant bankrupting Albert, he would rescue Cielo..."
"Let's not talk about this. Tomorrow, I'll find a suitable warehouse and call Albert to arrange the deal," he said softly.
"No need to go to the warehouse. I can wait here," she replied casually.
"Then, should you cooperate with me by putting on some makeup and showing that you're in a miserable state?"
He felt that he needed to provide some evidence; otherwise, the Collier family wouldn't believe him. So, he needed her cooperation.
"Tomorrow, okay? I'm a bit tired today..." she said softly.
"Alright."
Connor nodded and closed his eyes to rest.
...
The next day, at 7:00 in the morning.
Beau, who had just gotten up, received a parcel sent by Cielo. Beau wasn't particularly interested in the parcel, so he didn't pay much attention to it and didn't open it right away.
During breakfast, Cielo kept observing Beau's expression. To his surprise, Beau showed no reaction at all. This puzzled him because he thought that if Beau saw the photos inside the parcel, there would definitely be a reaction.
After finishing breakfast, the Collier family members dispersed.
Cielo realized that he couldn't bring up the topic of the parcel himself, as it would increase suspicion. So, he found the Collier family's steward and instructed him regarding the parcel.
The steward had a good relationship with both Cielo and Shereen and her son, so he agreed to help.
After finishing breakfast, Beau sat on the sofa and started reading the newspaper.
About ten minutes later, he put down the newspaper and got up to leave.
The steward noticed that Beau was about to leave and quickly asked, "Master, is this parcel yours?"
"I received it this morning, and I'm not sure what's inside. Open it and take a look for me."
Beau, reminded by the steward, remembered the parcel and replied casually.
"Alright."
The steward nodded and proceeded to open the parcel.
However, when he opened it, he froze in place. The parcel contained only photos of Aida and Connor.
Because of the previous incident when Connor intruded into the Collier household, the steward had some impression of him. Additionally, Cielo had informed him about reminding Beau of the parcel, so the steward quickly pieced together what was happening.
"What's inside?"
Beau asked the steward in a hushed tone.
"It's... it's some photos of Miss and that person!"
The steward replied in a low voice.
"Photos? What photos?"
Beau's expression seemed puzzled, as he noticed that something was amiss with the steward's expression.
"They are photos of Miss with that person!"
The steward said quietly.
Beau paused for a moment, then quickly picked up the photos and examined them closely. After a few seconds, his expression became extremely unpleasant. His own granddaughter had not only associated with their greatest enemy, Connor, but they had also been seen entering a hotel together hand in hand. How could this happen?
Furthermore, Beau had been trying to match Aida with Juan. Once the Gomez family discovered this, it would complicate matters even more.
"Phew..."
Beau couldn't help but take a deep breath and then said in a low voice to the steward, "Ask Albert and Cielo to come to my study immediately. I have something very important to discuss with them."
"Yes, sir."
The steward agreed and left.
A few minutes later, Albert, who was about to leave the house, was stopped by the steward and hurriedly made his way to Beau's study.
Upon hearing that his plan had succeeded, Cielo also arrived at Beau's study.
"Father, Grandfather, why did you call me here? What's going on?"
Cielo pretended not to know anything and asked Beau.
"What's going on?!"
Beau let out a cold laugh and then, with an emotionless expression, placed the photos on the table, glaring at his son and grandson. "Take a look at what your daughter has done!"
Albert paused and then quickly lowered his head to look at the photos on the table. His expression became unbelievably puzzled.
"How... how is this possible? How could Aida be involved with someone like Connor?"
Albert said in a low voice.
"Albert, how did you become the head of the Collier family? You can't even control your own daughter. Connor is our Collier family's biggest enemy, and yet, your daughter is getting involved with him. How do you explain this?"
Beau questioned him directly.
"Grandfather, is there some misunderstanding in this matter?"
Cielo pretended to be concerned.
"Misunderstanding?"
Beau let out a cold laugh and continued in a low voice, "When that kid Connor intruded into the secret room, I already felt something was off. We have so many guards outside the secret room, and there are many password-protected doors. An ordinary person couldn't have entered, but Connor did, and he even kidnapped Aida before leaving. It shows that all of this was planned by Connor and Aida was an inside agent in our Collier family!"
"Father, Aida couldn't possibly have any reason to do such things! Besides, she didn't even know Connor before!"
Albert nervously argued.
"No reason to do this?"
Beau let out a cold laugh and said with a straight face, "These photos are the reason, aren't they? Your daughter has fallen for Connor, so she helped him enter our Collier family's secret room!"

chapters.title: Chapter 1774: Blackmail
chapters.content:
Chapter 1774: Blackmail
"Th-this..."
Albert's expression became extremely unpleasant upon hearing Beau's words.
However, at this moment, he didn't know how to defend himself.
"How do you plan to handle this matter? If the Gomez family finds out about this, they will believe that our Collier family is in cahoots with Connor. Our alliance with the Gomez family will be seen as helping Connor gather information. You must handle this matter properly!" Beau said coldly to Albert.
Though Aida's collaboration with Connor angered Beau, he considered it a minor issue compared to the potential consequences of the Gomez family misunderstanding their true intentions.
"Dad, I'll call Aida right now and find out what's going on!" Albert hesitated for a moment and then took out his phone to call Aida.
Beau watched Albert attentively.
Soon, Albert put down his phone and whispered to Beau, "she didn't answer the call."
"She probably realized that her actions had been exposed, so she ran away," Colie suggested after a moment of thought.
After hesitating for two seconds, Albert asked softly, "Dad, where did you get these photos from?"
"I received a package this morning, and these photos were inside it!" Beau replied.
Upon hearing this, Albert's expression seemed even more puzzled because he couldn't understand where these photos came from and what the purpose behind sending them to Beau was.
"Albert, how do you plan to handle this matter?" Beau, currently preoccupied, asked.
"Dad, don't worry; I'll definitely handle this. I have someone start searching for Aida's whereabouts right away!" Albert hastily replied.
"Then what are you waiting for? Go find her for me now. I must confront Aida and find out why she betrays our family for an outsider!" Clearly, Beau was furious about his granddaughter's betrayal.
Although Beau supports Cielo to become the future head of the Collier family, he still cares about Aida. If not, she wouldn't have so much influence over the family business.
Upon hearing Beau's words, Albert wasted no time and immediately headed towards the door.
Just then, Albert's phone suddenly rang.
He hurriedly took out his phone, noticing it was a call from Aida. He answered it eagerly and asked, "Aida, where are you now?"
"Mr. Albert, I'm not Aida!" Connor's voice echoed.
Albert found Connor's voice somewhat familiar, but since he had only met him once, he furrowed his brow and asked, "Who are you?"
"Mr. Albert, you haven't forgotten me so soon, have you? You teamed up with the Gomez family to deal with me, didn't you?" Connor said, grinning.
"Connor?" Albert's expression turned angry.
In this world, Connor was the person Albert hated the most. If it weren't for Connor, the Collier family wouldn't be in such turmoil.
Beau also gazed at Albert with a faint expression.
Cielo's face showed signs of change as he struggled to comprehend why Connor would call Albert now.
"Connor, why are you calling me? And how did you get Aida's phone?" Albert asked anxiously.
"Mr. Albert, your daughter Aida is in my hands right now. You see, it's quite a coincidence. I bumped into your daughter in York, and I even brought her to Yanjing. Shouldn't you thank me?" Connor said with a sly smile.
"You kidnapped Aida?" Albert asked, bewildered.
"Let's not use such harsh words. Your daughter is merely in my custody. It doesn't really count as kidnapping…" Connor said softly.
"What do you want, then?" Albert shouted in agitation.
"Here's the deal: some things can't be discussed over the phone. Tonight at 5 o'clock, let's meet at the Imperial Restaurant. It's a safe place. If I don't see your people there, you can forget about seeing Aida again!" Connor said before hanging up.
Albert stared at his phone, looking somewhat dazed.
"What's going on?" Beau looked at Albert and asked.
"Dad, it seems we misunderstood Aida. She hasn't done anything wrong. Connor kidnapped her, and he just called to extort us…" Albert explained in a hushed tone.
Connor's call had left Albert with mixed feelings—relieved that Aida hadn't betrayed the family but worried about her safety in Connor's hands.
Beau listened and then looked down at the photos on the table, saying softly, "If it's really Connor who kidnapped Aida, then these photos start to make sense…"
"Exactly, Dad. Aida has been busy managing the Collier family business all these years. She couldn't possibly have any connection with Connor." Albert quickly added.
Cielo's expression underwent some changes upon hearing the conversation between Beau and Albert. He couldn't believe that Connor was shadowing Aida all this time.
Beau, with a low voice, said, "Wenzhuo, since it appears that Connor is responsible for Aida's situation, you should go and handle this matter. No matter what, we must rescue Aida. After all, she's been in charge of the oil field project, and if anything happens to her, it'll be a huge loss for the Collier family."
"I understand," Albert replied softly, nodding.
"Both of you, leave now," Beau waved his hand.
Albert silently breathed a sigh of relief, then turned and exited the study.

chapters.title: Chapter 1775: Shereen's Condition
chapters.content:
Chapter 1775: Shereen's Condition
On the other side.
Connor and Aida stayed in the room for a whole day.
She had been busy with her own business. However, she was not busy with the Collier family's business, but with her own company.
Aida had been kidnapped by Connor. If the Collier family knew that she could still handle business, then the plan would be ruined.
Meanwhile, Connor played with his phone for the whole day. When it was past four in the evening, he left the room and drove to the Emperor Hotel alone.
The Emperor Hotel was a very famous hotel in York. It was said that the owner of this hotel had a very terrifying background, so Connor decided to set the place here. This way, Albert would not attack him.
As for calling the police, Connor knew that he would never call the police.
This was because a large family like theirs knew that if the police intervened in this matter, it would not do them any any good. Moreover, sometimes the police would even mess things up.
When he arrived at the Emperor Hotel, it was exactly five o'clock at night.
He chose this time because there were more people at this time. If he really encountered any sudden situation, according to his skills, he still had a good chance of escaping.
Connor entered the hotel alone.
However, when the hotel's front desk lady saw him, she hurriedly walked in front of Connor and said softly to him ,"Mr. Connor, the Collier family has been waiting for you in the Heaven-class box for a long time!"
"Good!"
Connor lightly nodded.
The boss of this hotel had a special relationship with the Wallace family, so Connor had come to this hotel last night and instructed the front desk to keep an eye on the Collier family.
"How many of them are there?"
Connor hesitated for a moment before asking the receptionist.
"There are a total of five people with two bodyguards!" the receptionist replied.
"Could it be that Beau came personally?"
Connor's expression was a little doubtful. He knew that Beau was an ancient martial arts grandmaster. If he attacked him, he might be in danger today.
However, Connor remembered that Aida was in his hands. Even if Beau came, he wouldn't do anything to him.
Therefore, he tidied up his clothes and directly walked into the Heaven-class private room.
After entering the private room, he found that there were indeed five people in the private room.
There were two bodyguards, and the other three were Albert, Colie, and a beautiful woman in her forties.
It was obvious that this beautiful young woman was Colie's mother, Shereen.
However, Connor had only heard of Shereen's name, but he had never seen this woman before.
When she saw him, she was also a little surprised. She had never expected him to be so young.
"Connor, you actually came alone!"
Albert shouted at Connor coldly.
"Your daughter is in my hands. I know that you won't dare to do anything to me…"
Connor replied to Albert lightly and then sat on the sofa very casually.
Albert stood up abruptly, pointed at Connor and shouted,""Kid, where is my daughter? If you know what's good for you, you'd better let my daughter go now…"
Albert was still very emotional, but he was not really worried about Aida's safety. He was worried that if something happened to Aida, the Collier family would suffer a huge loss.
Albert seemed to have no feelings at all. In his eyes, there was only profit. This was also the reason why Aida chose to betray the Collier family and cooperate with Connor.
Aida felt that only when Connor was by her side would she know what it meant to feel safe.
This sense of security was something that no one in the Collier family could give her.
"Mr. Albert, aren't you a little too naive?"
Connor looked at Albert and sneered. Then, he said expressionlessly, "Do you know how much effort I put in to bring your daughter from York? I almost died on the plane, and now you want me to let Aida go?"
Albert looked at Connor up and down, then frowned and asked, "What exactly do you want?"
"You know very well what I want. She's is in my hands now, and she's doing very well. So, as long as you can give me a satisfactory condition, I'll naturally let her go. If you don't show me your sincerity, then I'm sorry..."
Connor said with a smile.
Albert took a deep breath and said in a low voice,""How can you prove that my daughter is in your hands?"
"Since I have already come, I naturally have a way to prove it…"
Connor looked at Albert and smiled. Then, he took out his phone and found a video.
"Take a look at this video!"
Connor handed the phone to Albert.
Albert hurriedly took Connor's phone. At this time, the person on the video was Aida.
Aida looked very embarrassed. Her hands and feet were tied up by Connor, and there were all kinds of wounds on her body. It was obvious that she had been abused.
Of course, this was the result of Aida's own makeup. It was just to make the scene more realistic.
After watching the video, Albert did not feel sorry for Aida at all. Instead, he said in a low voice, "Aida is actually in your hands…"
"Do you believe me now? Can we talk about conditions now?"
Connor smiled and asked Albert.
"What are your conditions?"
Albert said in a low voice.
"There's something I have to remind you of. I'm here today to negotiate with you. If we can negotiate well, Miss Aida will be able to return to the Collier family very soon. Moreover, I can guarantee that she will not be hurt in any way. However, if we don't have a happy negotiation, or if you have any other thoughts, then..."
Connor hesitated.
"What?"
Shereen asked Connor.
"She might suffer a little. She is so beautiful, and she's the woman Juan likes. If I disfigure Miss Chen, Juan will definitely come to you for punishment. At that time, how are you going to explain this to the Gomez family…"
Connor said with a smile.

chapters.title: Chapter 1776: Ransom
chapters.content:
Chapter 1776: Ransom
"Connor, if you dare to harm Aida in any way, I will never let you off!" Albert exclaimed anxiously upon hearing Connor's words.
"Didn't you say something similar when I broke into the secret room of your Collier family? Even if I hadn't kidnapped Miss Aida, you probably wouldn't let me go. So, your threats don't work on me," Connor replied calmly.
Albert looked momentarily stunned, then asked in a low voice, "Just state your conditions; I don't have the patience for this."
"Alright, since you're so eager, I won't waste any more time. I recently acquired a piece of land in Yarlford, and what I lack now is funds. So, as long as you give me the money, I can release Aida!" Connor knew that asking for anything else from Albert was futile. His main goal was to help her clear her name, and asking for money was the simplest method.
"Money..." Albert sneered and then asked, "How much do you want?"
"How much do you think your daughter is worth?" he countered.
Albert hesitated for a moment and then said, "Let's say I give you two billion, and you release my daughter."
"Hahaha..." Connor burst into laughter upon hearing his offer and then said with a low voice, "Mr. Albert, you're quite stingy. From what I know, the value Aida brings to your family every year is far greater than that. You're trying to trick me with just two billion? Do you think I've never seen money before?"
"Then how much do you want?" Albert asked impatiently.
Connor hesitated for a moment and then said casually, "Multiply the price you mentioned by twenty, and when the money is in my account, I'll release Miss Aida immediately."
"Forty billion? Are you out of your mind?" Shereen exclaimed upon hearing Connor's words.
"Connor, do you think we're all fools?" Colie joined in.
Clearly, Shereen and Colie had not come here to rescue Aida; they were doing everything they could to sabotage the deal and possibly even have Connor kill her.
"That amount is too much, and we can't produce that kind of money," she said agitatedly.
"Exactly, Dad, this Connor is just being outrageous. You must not fall for it!" Colie added.
"Both of you, be quiet!" Albert shouted, then looked at Connor and asked in a low voice, "Twenty billion, will you accept my offer?"
Connor realized that the time for his act was almost over. If he pushed Albert too far and he refused to pay, Connor would be in trouble. So, he said, "When will the money be transferred?"
"It will definitely be transferred before midnight tonight!" Albert said firmly.
"Alright, since Mr. Albert is showing sincerity, I'll wait for your good news!" He smiled and left the VIP suite.
After Connor left, Colie and Shereen wore extremely displeased expressions, while Albert took out his phone and started making a call.
"Albert, I have some other matters to attend to; I'll leave first," Shereen said hesitantly.
"Alright," Albert didn't inquire further, thinking that she might be unhappy with the large sum he had agreed to pay, and she left the suite.
Meanwhile, Connor got into his car and was about to leave when he noticed someone opening the car door. It was Shereen, Colie's mother, who had gotten into his car.
"What are you doing?" Connor frowned and asked Shereen.
"Don't speak, just keep driving forward. Find a place where no one is around; I need to talk to you," she said softly.
"You got into my car so openly. Aren't you afraid of being seen by Albert?" He started the car and asked with a smile.
"He's busy trying to gather the money right now and doesn't have the time to keep an eye on these things," she replied.
"Heh..." He chuckled, then drove to a tea house a few minutes away.
Inside the tea house, Connor and Shereen entered a private room. After entering, Connor poured himself a cup of tea, downed it in one gulp, and then looked at Shereen, asking, "Haven't we finished discussing Aida's situation? What do you want to talk to me about now?"

chapters.title: Chapter 1777: A Good Opportunity to Make Money
chapters.content:
Chapter 1777: A Good Opportunity to Make Money
"You should know that Aida is not my biological daughter, right?" Shereen looked at Connor and asked.
"Of course, I know!" He nodded.
"So, whether Aida lives or dies, it doesn't concern me. I found you to ask about your relationship with Aida!" She didn't waste time and asked directly.
"What's my relationship with Aida?" He hesitated for a moment, then smiled and said, "We're just kidnapper and hostage."
"Impossible. You've protected Aida so many times; your relationship with her can't be that simple!" She shook her head firmly.
He gave a wry smile and said, "It seems like you're admitting that the assassin you sent on the plane to kill Aida was indeed your doing?"
"Yes, I hired that assassin, and I have no qualms admitting it." She nodded.
"I see..." He pretended not to know anything and nodded lightly.
"Do you really have no connection with Aida?" Shereen asked, looking at Connor.
"No, I kidnapped her for money, and I'm protecting her for the same reason. After all, if Aida dies, I won't be able to get the money from Albert!" Connor said naturally.
She stared at him for a moment, seemingly starting to believe his explanation. She couldn't fathom that he would cooperate with Aida.
"Alright, since you say you want to make money, I'll give you a good opportunity to do so now," she said softly to him.
"A chance to make money?" He furrowed his brow upon hearing this. "What do you mean by that?"
"I can give you a sum of money, on the condition that you help me kill Aida," Shereen, now consumed by her obsession, stated.
"Hmm..." He chuckled upon hearing this and then said mildly, "You two have an interesting dynamic. One person pays me to release her, and the other person pays me to kill her. What exactly do you both want?"
"We don't need to concern you with what we want. Albert gave you twenty billion earlier, and now I'll give you another twenty billion. However, you won't release Aida; instead, you'll kill her. With this, you'll get forty billion. What do you think?" she asked seriously.
"Do you hate Aida that much?" He raised an eyebrow.
"This woman must die," Shereen replied calmly.
"Women's hearts are truly the most venomous," Connor coldly sneered.
He never expected that, just after negotiating the price with Albert, Shereen would find him again. What astonished him even more was that her purpose in finding him wasn't to save someone but to get him to kill.
His sole purpose in all of this was to help Aida clear her name, so he would naturally not admit to any cooperation with her.
"You want me to kill Aida, right?" he asked.
"That's right. As long as you can kill Aida, you'll not only get Albert's twenty billion but also my twenty billion. It's a deal that guarantees you a profit," Shereen believed that Connor was in York either to protect Aida or for money.
Since he denied any relationship with Aida, she assumed his motives were all about money. Thus, as long as the price she offered was reasonable, she believed he would accept her proposal.
"Aren't you worried that I'll talk about today's events?" he asked Shereen.
Shereen couldn't help but chuckle at his question. She then calmly replied, "Don't be naive. You're the biggest enemy of the Collier family right now. Even if you do talk, do you think anyone would believe you?"
"That's a good point," Connor nodded lightly, then continued, "I admit I was tempted by what you said earlier. But, I've already promised Albert to let Aida go. If I take your money now and kill Aida, my conscience might not let me sleep at night."
"You, with a conscience?" She sneered, utterly amazed.
"Why can't I have a conscience?" He retorted, his lips curling. "It's just that my conscience can be bought with money."
"How much do you want?" she asked in a hushed voice.
"Letting her go is a good deed for me, but killing someone isn't. Letting her go will cost you twenty billion, but for killing, it's a minimum of forty billion," he replied after a moment's thought.
"You..." Shereen was left speechless upon hearing Connor's demand. She hadn't expected his appetite to be so massive, asking for forty billion.
"I don't have that much money. I can offer you thirty billion at most. Will that do?" Shereen furrowed her brow.
"Thirty billion, huh?" Connor appeared somewhat hesitant upon hearing Shereen's offer. He then asked, puzzled, "Are you really this wealthy?"
"My maternal family is also a prominent family in Yanjing. I'll need to borrow the money from them, but I can't gather forty billion. I can only offer you thirty billion," Shereen explained.
"Heh, fine, thirty billion it is. After all, it's all free money to me..." Connor chuckled and continued, "First, Albert's money needs to be transferred to me, and then yours. Once I see both of these sums, I'll kill Aida right away!"
"You won't go back on your word, will you?" She seemed somewhat uneasy.
"Why would I? I've gone to great lengths to bring Aida to Yarlford. I'm doing it all for the money. Why would I back out now?" He countered with a question.

chapters.title: Chapter 1778: The Final Winner
chapters.content:
Chapter 1778: The Final Winner
"Alright, tonight I'll transfer the money to you, but I'll only send half of it. The remaining half will be given to you after Aida is truly dead," Shereen said after considering for a moment.
"No, I can't accept that," Connor shook his head upon hearing Shereen's proposal. He then softly added, "I don't trust people like you. You have to transfer all the money to me directly. What if I kill Aida, and you refuse to pay up?"
"What if I transfer the money to you, and you don't kill Aida?" she countered.
"Heh," He couldn't help but sneer at Shereen's question, then calmly said, "Since I can bring Aida back safely, I certainly have the capability to kill her. If you don't trust me, that's fine too. I can just forget about this money. After all, I don't want to take the risk of killing someone; it might keep me awake at night for days."
She took a deep breath and replied in a hushed tone, "Alright, I'll transfer the money to you first, but I hope you won't go back on your word."
"I've always been a person of integrity." He smiled and then got up and left the private room.
Shereen sat there, her expression conflicted. She knew this might be her last chance to have Aida killed. She had to trust that Connor's sole motivation was money.
After parting ways with her, Connor drove straight back to where Aida was located.
"Is it settled?" she asked eagerly as she saw him enter the room.
"It's settled." He nodded lightly.
"How much did you ask for?" she continued to inquire.
"Albert agreed to give me twenty billion, and Shereen promised me thirty billion," Connor said with a smile.
"Shereen offered you thirty billion? How is that possible? Why would she be so generous with her money?" Aida's expression was filled with disbelief because she was convinced that Shereen wanted her dead more than anyone.
"Albert is giving me twenty billion to save you, and Shereen is offering thirty billion to have me kill you. I must say, people from your Collier family are quite interesting," he remarked lightly.
"It seems Shereen isn't giving up," She chuckled coldly. She then asked, "So, did you agree to her offer?"
"Of course, I agreed. After all, it's free money. I didn't have to do anything and yet received forty billion!" he said with a smile.
"So, that means you'll not only get twenty billion from Albert but also thirty billion from Shereen. You'll have a total of fifty billion?" She was surprised.
"Yes, but I want to make it clear. I can split Albert's twenty billion with you, ten billion each. However, the thirty billion from Shereen is my own achievement, so I won't split that with you," He said seriously.
"I don't care about that money. What I'm worried about is whether the Collier family will continue to trust me when I return," she said softly.
"You don't need to worry about that. The Collier family undoubtedly believes in you now. I can tell Albert has no doubts, but that woman Shereen is somewhat suspicious of our relationship," Connor said casually.
"It doesn't matter if Shereen is suspicious. After all, her opinion doesn't hold much weight in the Collier family. As long as Albert and Beau don't suspect me, it's enough," she replied.
"When the money arrives, you can leave, and I can go back to Yarlford. My mission is essentially completed!" he sighed softly as he lay down on the bed.
Aida looked at Connor, a hint of frustration in her eyes. She couldn't help but feel that she was at a disadvantage in this Collier family power struggle. However, she also knew that without Connor, she wouldn't have made it this far, so she didn't say anything.
In the blink of an eye, it was already past ten o'clock at night.
He finally received the transfer notification from Albert. Given the large sum involved, it had taken Albert quite some time to prepare, and he had to rely on his relationship with the bank manager to facilitate the transfer. Such a large sum of money couldn't be transferred so quickly otherwise.
After the money arrived, Albert called immediately.
"Connor, I've transferred the money to you. Can you release her now?" Albert asked in a low voice.
"Mr. Albert, you can rest assured. I, Connor, will definitely keep my word. In an hour, you'll be able to see your daughter!" Connor said with a cheerful tone.
"Good!" Albert replied and then hung up the phone.
As soon as he ended the call, Shereen's money arrived half an hour later.
Connor looked at the numbers on his phone with a happy smile and then turned to Aida, saying, "I never thought making money could be so easy. I didn't have to do anything, and I just earned forty billion!"
"Now what are you going to do?" Aida didn't share Connor's enthusiasm, her voice trembling.
"What else can I do? Of course, I'll release you. You're completely free now. You can go back..." Connor replied casually.
"Am I just going back like this?" Aida asked, excitement in her voice.
"What else can you do? Do you want me to escort you back? I'm currently the biggest enemy of your Collier family. If I escort you back, it would be extremely dangerous for me. But you have no more danger. Shereen already thinks you're as good as dead, so you can go back openly and without fear," Connor said in a low voice.
Aida hesitated for two seconds, standing still and not saying anything.
"Why are you still standing there? Go on, your money will be transferred to you, don't worry. I won't take it all for myself..." Connor said when he saw Aida didn't move.
"Connor, I really appreciate what you've done this time," Aida said seriously.
"Appreciate me?" Connor was a bit stunned by Aida's words. He then smiled and said, "You suddenly being so polite makes me a bit uncomfortable. We both got what we wanted. You don't need to thank me. As long as you can help me find out where Master is, you don't owe me anything!"

chapters.title: Chapter 1779: Tricked
chapters.content:
Chapter 1779: Tricked
"Rest assured, this time you've helped me so much, I won't go back on my word!" Aida replied to Connor with exceptional seriousness. Then she turned and left the room.
After Aida left, Connor took out his phone and made a call to Queta, asking her to book a flight ticket from York to Yarlford immediately.
After all, this time Connor had outwitted everyone in the Collier family family, so he didn't want to linger in York. Returning to Yarlford immediately was the best choice.
Queta quickly arranged for a private jet since it was already quite late, and there were no suitable commercial flights. The private jet was scheduled to depart at 2 AM.
He didn't mind spending some money on chartering the plane, considering the substantial amount he had swindled from the Collier family family. So, he went ahead with the arrangement without hesitation.
...
On the other side, the Collier family members gathered anxiously in the villa after learning that Connor had released Aida.
However, none of them were genuinely anxious; they were merely putting on a facade.
Shereen and Cielo were also quite nervous at the moment. After all, Shereen had already transferred the money to Connor. If Aida didn't return alive tonight, it meant that Connor hadn't kept his word.
But if she did return, all the money Shereen had paid would be in vain.
So, they were all waiting for an outcome.
At 11 o'clock in the evening...
They had been waiting at the Collier family's villa for more than an hour. Albert had been sitting on the sofa the whole time, with no expression on his face.
The other members of the Collier family seemed a bit impatient.
"Big brother, do you think Connor tricked us? It's been over an hour, why hasn't Aida returned yet?"
"Yeah, did Connor really release her?"
"I think he must be playing with us!"
Everyone shouted at Albert.
Albert's expression seemed somewhat strange, and he couldn't guarantee that Connor would actually keep his promise to release Aida.
On the other hand, Shereen's expression had relaxed a bit. She thought he might have already killed Aida.
"Don't worry, if Connor dares to play with our Collier family, I will personally take action. Even if I have to face retaliation from Jorge, I will never let Connor off!" Albert suddenly said.
Previously, he had been unable to personally deal with Connor because he was afraid that if he killed Connor, Jorge would seek revenge. He knew he was no match for Jorge. But if Connor dared to mock the Collier family like this, Albert would teach him a lesson.
Upon hearing Albert's words, Shereen not only felt no worries but was rather delighted. If Connor had truly killed Aida, then he would deal with Connor, and she would be rid of her major concerns. Her son could also become the heir of the Collier family.
While she was secretly rejoicing, a young man suddenly rushed into the villa.
"Sir, Aida is back..." The young man excitedly shouted.
Upon hearing this, Shereen was stunned.
"Where is she?" Albert abruptly stood up and asked in a low voice.
"She has already been taken to our Collier family's medical room. Aida is injured, and it seems quite serious. She's currently unconscious..." The young man hurriedly explained.
"Let's go see her!" Albert immediately headed toward the medical room outside, and the other Collier family members followed suit.
Only Shereen and Cielo remained in place, their faces showing a grim expression.
"Mom, what's going on? Didn't you say Connor would definitely kill Aida?" Cielo asked his mother with a furrowed brow.
"Connor played us!" Shereen replied through gritted teeth and continued, "Let's first check if Aida is really alive..."
"All right!" Cielo agreed and then rushed toward the medical room.
A few minutes later, everyone had arrived at the Collier family's medical room.
At this moment, she was completely unconscious, covered in injuries that seemed quite severe.
Seeing this scene, Albert was convinced that Connor had indeed kidnapped her.
However, he might not be aware that Aida's injuries were all self-inflicted. Aida, being the ruthless woman she was, believed that if she returned to the Collier family in good health, they would be suspicious, especially since she had looked so pitiful in the video. Therefore, she had spent money to hire ten homeless men to beat her severely before taking a taxi back to the Collier family.
Shereen, watching the unconscious Aida, was filled with anger. She returned to her room, took out her phone, and dialed Connor's number.
"Ring ring..."
After two rings, he answered the phone.
"Connor, what are you up to? Why isn't Aida dead yet?" Shereen asked almost through clenched teeth.
"Isn't she dead?" He chuckled and continued, "Oh, I forgot to tell you, I really intended to kill Aida, but she offered me five billion, so I changed my mind and let her go..."
"But you've already taken my money..." she said in a somewhat desperate tone.
"Yes, I took your money, but your offer was less than what Aida offered. That's just how I am. I listen to whoever pays more..." he laughed.
She took a deep breath and then said in a low voice, "Okay, since you didn't kill Aida, shouldn't you return my money?"
"Do you think that's possible?" he asked.
"What do you mean?" She was bewildered.
"No special meaning. Since I already have the money, there's no reason to give it back. I won't say more. We'll meet again if fate allows it!" he replied casually and then hung up the phone.
"Ah..." She shouted in frustration, throwing her phone to the ground, shattering it.
"Mom, what's going on?" Cielo walked in at that moment, looking puzzled.
"I will kill Connor for playing with me!" she said somewhat hysterically."

chapters.title: Chapter 1780: A Battle Between Warriors
chapters.content:
Chapter 1780: A Battle Between Warriors
"Connor should still be in York. If he wants to leave York, he will definitely go to the airport. Should I send someone to the airport to watch for Connor?" Cielo asked, furrowing his brow.
"Alright, I'll have someone go and kill Connor now. No matter the cost, he must be eliminated!" Shereen said through gritted teeth.
He hesitated for a moment, then took out his phone and dialed Zaki's number.
"Zaki, Connor is likely to leave York today. Go to the airport and make sure you take care of him, alright?" Cielo said directly.
"Don't worry, Mr. Cielo. As long as I find him, I will definitely kill him!" he replied confidently.
"Good, just make sure you don't mess this up for me..." Cielo said.
"Understood!"
Cielo hung up the phone after that and turned to Shereen. "Mom, I've arranged it. If Connor goes to the airport today, he's a dead man!"
"Good!" Her emotions had calmed down slightly.
Originally, Shereen had intended to use Zaki to deal with Aida, but now she thought that Connor was even more despicable than Aida, so she planned to get rid of him first.
"How is Aida doing?" she asked in a hushed voice.
"Just some superficial injuries. It should heal in a few days..." he replied helplessly.
"This wretched woman is surprisingly lucky to survive. But she won't live for long; one day, I will get rid of her..." Her expression turned cold as she cursed, then she quickly adjusted her clothes and said softly, "Take me to see that wretch..."
...
On the other side, after finishing the call with Shereen, Connor left the location arranged by Rachel and hailed a taxi to the airport.
As he got into the taxi, he noticed that it had started to rain outside.
The place she had arranged was not very close to the airport, and it would take more than half an hour to reach.
He knew he was relatively safe for the time being. Even if the Collier family intended to deal with him, it would likely happen at the airport. So, he took this opportunity to get some rest and closed his eyes for a nap.
When he woke up, he realized that he had already arrived at the airport. He paid the taxi fare and got out of the car.
It was now raining even harder, and the square in front of the airport was deserted due to the late hour.
He walked toward the airport terminal, but after taking just a couple of steps, he suddenly stopped and squinted at something in front of him.
In front of him, in the central part of the airport square, stood a person. Despite the heavy rain, the ground around this person was dry, indicating that they were also using their chi to avoid getting wet.
Connor assessed the man for a moment. Although the man's appearance had changed, he could still recognize him. This person was the assassin he had encountered on the plane.
"Didn't expect the Collier family to move so quickly!" he muttered to himself.
The man seemed to have noticed Connor as well and stood still without moving.
He knew that trying to run at this point might be too late, so he prepared for a confrontation.
He approached the man and asked, "Are you sent by the Collier family?"
"Yes." Zaki nodded quietly.
"Do you want to kill me?" Connor continued.
"Yes, last time on the plane, I let you escape. But today, there's no way I'm letting you get away from me!" Zaki's voice was deep and resolute.
"You were the one who let me escape last time, weren't you?" Connor couldn't help but sneer.
"Don't waste time talking. I know you're a martial artist. Come at me!" Zaki shouted.
Connor's expression appeared somewhat unusual. Without any hesitation, he suddenly exerted force with his right foot, and his body moved like an arrow leaving the bowstring, charging towards Zaki's position with astonishing speed.
Zaki saw Connor's attack and was visibly shocked. He silently marveled at Connor's incredible skills at such a young age, thinking that given more time, Connor could become renowned in the world of martial arts in Oprana.
However, what he didn't know was that even at his current level, Connor had already gained fame in the world of martial arts.
Zaki was not a traditional martial artist; his true profession was that of an assassin. As a result, he spent most of his time on missions and did not usually reside in Oprana.
He had very limited information about Connor. Their previous encounter on the plane had been in a confined space, limiting their battle to close combat, making it impossible to unleash their full potential.
But now, with ample space around them, he had the opportunity to utilize his full strength. Connor also knew that this was a true battle between martial artists.
Upon seeing Connor charging towards him, he reached into his clothing and pulled out a dagger.
Connor's expression looked somewhat unusual when he saw the dagger in Zaki's hand. Even in the dark, the blade emitted a peculiar light, indicating that this dagger was far from ordinary.
Zaki suddenly swung the dagger.
The raindrops in the sky seemed to respond to his command, and they all flew toward Connor's position.
Connor tried to change the direction of the raindrops with his chi, but to his surprise, their power and speed far exceeded that of bullets, making it impossible for him to change their trajectory.
The raindrops were like countless bullets flying toward Connor. If an ordinary person were in his place, they would likely be instantly pierced.
Connor realized he couldn't change the direction of the raindrops, so he had no choice but to use his chi to protect his body. His speed slowed down, but he continued to move toward Zaki.

chapters.title: Chapter 1781: Turning Against Each Other
chapters.content:
Chapter 1781: Turning Against Each Other
"I didn't expect that you can resist this!" Zaki, seeing this scene, had a somewhat astonished expression.
He couldn't believe that Connor, just a Black rank martial artist, could withstand these raindrops. But what he didn't know was that Connor's strength far exceeded his level.
In the next moment, he had already rushed to Zaki and delivered a powerful punch to his chest.
However, in that critical moment, Zaki created a barrier in front of him using the rainwater.
Although Connor shattered the barrier with his punch, most of his strength was dissipated by it. In return, Zaki delivered a palm strike to his chest.
Instantly, Connor was sent flying and skidded on the ground for several dozen meters before he managed to stabilize himself.
In the meantime, at the Collier family's medical room, after the family members visited Aida, they left one by one. It was only after they had left that Aida opened her eyes.
However, the next moment, someone walked into the medical room.
"You're awake?" Cielo greeted Aida with a smile.
"Yes." She nodded.
"I didn't expect your luck to be this good. I hired so many assassins to kill you, but in the end, you managed to survive," he said, not hiding his intentions anymore.
"Cielo, I've been good to you. Why would you want to harm me?" she asked coldly.
"Why would I want to harm you?" He smirked when he heard her question. Then, he continued, "Why do you think I want to harm you?"
She stared at him expressionlessly without saying a word.
"But you're safe now. After all, this is York. If I were to kill you, Grandfather would definitely suspect me. So, I won't continue to target you," he explained, pausing briefly. "However, the one who's been protecting you might not be as lucky."
"What are you trying to say?" She seemed to sense that something was amiss and hesitated.
"Let me tell you the truth," Cielo said smugly. "I've already arranged assassins at the airport. If Connor dares to go to the airport today, he's a dead man. The assassins I hired are Black-rank martial artists, and no matter how skilled Connor is, he won't survive."
Aida adjusted her emotions and said, "Connor kidnapped me. If you can kill him, that would be a way to relieve my anger."
"Is that really the case?" Cielo laughed heartily.
"Why would I worry about Connor's life or death?" she asked expressionlessly.
"I thought you might worry. Right now, I want to go to the airport to witness the spectacle. If what you said is true, and you hate Connor so much, wouldn't you also like to see him die with your own eyes? Do you want to come with me?" he asked.
Aida hesitated for a moment after hearing Cielo's words. She was concerned that he might have ulterior motives and might harm her.
"Don't worry. It's impossible for me to harm you at this moment. Moreover, if you go with me to the airport, everyone in the Collier family will know that I took you away. If I don't bring you back, how can I explain it to Grandfather?" He reassured her.
"Alright, I'll go with you. I also want to witness Connor's demise," She finally agreed, concerned about Connor's situation.
"Let's go!" Cielo appeared quite pleased and walked out. Aida followed him.
Back at the airport square, Connor and Zaki had been exchanging blows, and Connor was consistently at a disadvantage. Connor noticed that Zaki, a martial artist, was different from those he had encountered before.
"Something's wrong..." Connor shouted at Zaki.
"What's wrong?" Zaki calmly replied, "Hasn't anyone told you that sometimes you can control everything without using your chi?"
"How did you do it then?" Connor asked curiously.
During their previous fight, Connor had noticed that Zaki didn't seem to use chi, yet he could control the raindrops. Connor had practiced the Chi Refining Technique and knew that true Black-rank martial artists could manipulate the world using their chi, as demonstrated by Faris and Jorge in their battle.
But Zaki seemed different. He controlled the raindrops without visible signs of using chi.
"Are you really curious? If you can withstand one of my punches, I'll tell you," Zaki coldly said, raising his dagger again.
Before him, the rainwater transformed into a fist-shaped object, gradually enlarging as it flew toward Connor. When it reached him, the water-formed fist was the size of a person.
Seeing this entirely water-based fist in front of him, Connor's eyes revealed a hint of astonishment. Then, he roared, "Seven-Star Big Dipper Fist, Sky Splitter!"
He unleashed a powerful punch that struck the watery fist head-on.

chapters.title: Chapter 1782: Artifacts
chapters.content:
Chapter 1782: Artifacts
"Boom!"
A loud noise.
Connor's punch shattered Zaki's fist.
Seeing this scene, Zaki couldn't help but sneer and said, "I didn't expect you to have some skills, actually able to withstand my punch."
"Now, can you tell me how you did it?" Connor adjusted his breath and asked him in a low voice.
He glanced at Connor, then said softly, "Well, today I'll let you understand. Have you seen the dagger in my hand?"
"Yes," Connor replied in a low voice.
"This dagger is a family heirloom of the Serrano family. It's called the Five Elements Dagger, capable of controlling the power of the five elements of heaven and earth. So, as long as I use this dagger, I possess this power. I can control the forces of wind, water, thunder, fire, and earth, even without using my own aura. Do you understand now?" Zaki explained while looking at Connor.
"Such a thing actually exists in this world?" Connor's face showed astonishment after hearing his words.
"As a martial artist, you don't even know the existence of artifacts? That's quite laughable!" Zaki couldn't help but sneer.
"Artifacts..." Connor's expression looked unusual because he truly had no knowledge of the existence of such weapons in this world. Even Jorge had never mentioned it to him.
"All right, I've answered your question. Now, you can die!" Zaki said with a determined look and then waved his hand.
A violent hurricane rushed forward, accompanied by a powerful force, heading straight for Connor's position.
Knowing he couldn't withstand this hurricane, Connor had no choice but to evade it. The hurricane was incredibly fast, but Connor was even faster. In the blink of an eye, he disappeared from Zaki's sight.
Zaki appeared surprised by Connor's speed.
"Seven-Star Big Dipper Fist, Dragon's Charge!" Connor shouted, and then a punch was launched straight towards Zaki. The force behind his fist was like a mighty beast emerging from the void, carrying an aura of destruction.
"Boom!"
A loud noise.
Connor's fist struck Zaki's chest fiercely. He took three consecutive steps backward to stabilize himself, wearing an expression of disbelief.
"What martial art are you using? How can you possess such terrifying power?" Zaki asked him.
"No time for chit-chat, take another punch!" He didn't have the mood to deal with his questions. He turned around and charged at him once again.
"Seven-Star Big Dipper Fist, Sonic Break!" Connor roared.
Zaki glanced at Connor calmly, realizing that Connor was a much more formidable opponent than he had initially thought. He couldn't afford to be careless.
"Lightning Rider!" Zaki shouted.
The next moment, a thunderbolt struck directly towards Connor's location.
"Boom!"
A thunderous sound.
Connor's fist clashed with the thunderbolt. However, his power was still insufficient to contend with heavenly thunder. After the deafening noise, his body was sent flying.
In that instant, he felt like he had been hit by a cannonball. Despite his aura protecting his body, it was unable to withstand the terrifying force.
Just as this happened, Aida and Cielo, who had just arrived at the airport, witnessed the scene. Both of them were left in shock, unable to believe that the battle between Connor and Zaki had escalated to such an intense level.
Connor was sent flying nearly ten meters through the air and crashed into the ground, leaving a massive crater.
However, he quickly stood up and charged toward Zaki's position once more.
At this point, it was pouring rain, and his figure looked solitary yet determined in the rain. He showed no intention of backing down.
Aida's expression was filled with astonishment. She couldn't fathom how a person could fall from such a height and immediately get up to continue fighting. Even as a martial artist herself, she found it incredible.
She had seen him in action on the plane, and she thought that his combat abilities were already astonishing. It even exceeded her understanding of an ordinary human being's capabilities.
However, witnessing the scene just now left her even more bewildered. The battle between Connor and Zaki had become indescribably intense, like a battle between immortals.
Although she was a martial artist, her level of ancient martial arts was quite low, just slightly stronger than an ordinary person. She had never encountered genuine ancient martial arts before.
It was only now that she realized the incredible power a true transcendent-level martial artist possessed.
After Connor fell and then stood up again, he charged toward Zaki's position once more.
He put all his strength into this punch, but Zaki didn't take any chances. He concentrated all his aura around his chest.
"Boom!"
Another thunderous sound.
Connor's fist struck Zaki's chest forcefully. A tremendously powerful energy rippled through the entire square, and even Aida and Cielo, who were inside the car, could feel the horrifying impact.
Once the shockwave subsided, Zaki remained in his original position, unwavering. Connor, on the other hand, showed a hint of surprise in his eyes. He could clearly sense that Zaki's combat power had increased several times compared to before.
Perhaps due to the energy shockwaves caused by the battle between Connor and Zaki, many martial artists in York were drawn to the scene. These martial artists could identify the battle's location by sensing the energy auras emanating from it.
As a result, numerous martial artists from Yanjing were now rushing toward the airport. None of them wanted to miss this extraordinarily thrilling battle.
A thunderclap resounded throughout the sky. Perhaps it was because Zaki had utilized the power of the Five Elements Dagger, but the previously mild rain had turned into a heavy downpour. Lightning streaked across the sky, strong winds blew, and the surrounding trees swayed wildly.

chapters.title: Chapter 1783: Talk to You
chapters.content:
Chapter 1783: Talk to You
After realizing his punch had no effect on Zaki, Connor quickly took two steps back. He wiped the rainwater off his face and said in a low voice, "I didn't expect your strength to be so terrifying."
"I can use the Five Elements Dagger to enhance my strength, so today, you are undoubtedly doomed. If you surrender now, I might make your suffering less painful," Zaki replied calmly.
Although it was pouring rain around them, the ground beneath Zaki's feet remained dry. This indicated that he might not have used all his strength yet. Otherwise, he wouldn't be concerned about the rain.
"Why do you choose to work for others when you have such abilities?" Connor asked with a furrowed brow.
"Because I need money," Zaki replied candidly, without trying to make excuses.
Connor glanced at Zaki with a hint of understanding. He knew that he needed a significant amount of money, and he could potentially use money to persuade Zaki to spare him. However, Connor believed that he wouldn't agree.
Today, there was no way for him to avoid this battle.
"Don't waste time. Let's get on with it!" Zaki shouted.
Taking a deep breath, Connor's body moved like lightning, charging toward Zaki's position. His punch was incredibly fast and powerful.
"Wind Shield!" Zaki waved the Five Elements Dagger in his hand as a gust of wind suddenly formed a protective wall in front of him.
Connor's punch struck the wind wall, but it remained as solid as a mountain, showing no signs of breaking.
Connor's expression became somewhat unusual as he realized the difference in strength between him and Zaki. If he didn't have the Five Elements Dagger, Connor was confident he could defeat him. However, with the terrifying power of the dagger, his combat strength had doubled, making Connor no match for him.
Aida seemed to have noticed this as well, and her expression was tense. On the other hand, Cielo wore a smug look. In his eyes, Connor was undoubtedly doomed today. If he died, she wouldn't pose any threat to him.
After his punch had no effect, Connor had no choice but to take several steps back to steady himself.
"You can't win against me today," Zaki said emotionlessly.
Connor couldn't help but take a deep breath when he heard Zaki's words. Then he started contemplating a way to deal with Zaki in his mind.
But Zaki had no intention of wasting any more time on Connor, so he muttered, "You've thrown so many punches at me earlier, shouldn't you take one from me now?"
Upon hearing Zaki's words, Connor abruptly looked at him. In the next moment, Zaki's body flew towards Connor's position like a cannonball.
Perhaps it was because of the Five Elements Dagger, but Zaki's speed was astonishing. He reached Connor in almost an instant and then raised his fist, smashing it towards Connor's chest.
"Boom!"
A loud sound.
Zaki's punch landed squarely on Connor's chest.
Connor's body was sent flying again, covering nearly dozens of meters in the air before crashing violently onto the ground.
"Bang!"
Connor's body left a massive crater in the ground.
Upon witnessing this scene, Aida's expression appeared despondent. She knew that it was all over.
Initially, upon returning to Yanjing, Aida had made up her mind to cooperate with Connor. After all, Connor had displayed abilities that could help her seek revenge. However, she had never expected that her actions would end up harming Connor.
"Cielo, if I ask you right now, can you make that person release Connor?" Aida suddenly turned to Cielo, her tone extremely serious.
Cielo couldn't help but sneer upon hearing Aida's words. He said emotionlessly, "Sister, are you confused? Connor is the biggest enemy of our Chen family now. If I can get rid of him today, it would be a great accomplishment. Grandfather and Father will trust me even more..."
"Besides, once Connor is dead, you won't be able to threaten me anymore. But if I let Connor go, it would be an endless problem. Do you think I would let him go?"
Aida looked at Cielo's despairing expression and knew that he was right. Cielo had no reason to spare Connor, especially since it offered him no benefit.
At this moment, Aida seemed even more hopeless. She had finally seen a glimmer of hope in Connor, but now even that hope had been shattered.
Meanwhile, Zaki's figure flashed, and he appeared right in front of Connor.
Perhaps due to the terrifying power of his previous punch, Connor felt as if all the muscles and veins in his body had been severed.
He instinctively struggled to get up but found that he had no strength left.
Connor lay on the ground, watching Zaki approach him slowly.
"Connor, you have such terrifying combat abilities at such a young age. It's truly remarkable. However, today, you will still die by my hands. I've been an assassin for so many years, and no one has ever survived. You won't be an exception!" Zaki said emotionlessly to Connor.
"I want to talk to you..." Connor's voice was weak as he spoke to Zaki.
"Talk?" Zaki sneered upon hearing Connor's words and said expressionlessly, "Connor, given the circumstances, do you really think we have anything to talk about?"
Connor remained silent as he watched Zaki.
Zaki slowly raised the Five Elements Dagger in his hand.
And Connor, facing Zaki in front of him, felt a deep sense of unwillingness. He was not ready to die like this; there were still many things he hadn't accomplished.

chapters.title: Chapter 1784: Counterattack
chapters.content:
Chapter 1784: Counterattack
But Connor couldn't find any way to counterattack. At this moment, he had lost all his fighting capability.
Sitting in the car, Aida's expression was filled with anxiety. She didn't know what she could do now.
Torrential rain poured down as Zaki's Five Elements Dagger slowly descended towards Connor's chest.
"Ah!"
However, just as the dagger was about to pierce Connor's chest, he suddenly shouted.
A blinding light erupted around his body, like a protective shield, guarding him.
Zaki instinctively paused when he saw this scene, then tried to finish the battle quickly. After all, he had no intention of wasting more time on Connor.
But what he never expected was that, as the dagger made contact with Connor's body, a tremendous force surged back at him.
"Boom!"
A loud noise.
Zaki hadn't grasped what had just happened when he was sent flying by the immense power emanating from Connor's body.
He was flung by the powerful aura surrounding Connor. He slid through the air for nearly tens of meters before finally regaining his footing.
Both Cielo and Aida, who were initially sitting in the car, wore expressions of shock. They had thought the battle between Connor and Zaki had concluded moments ago. After all, he had been severely injured and seemingly powerless against Zaki.
However, what nobody had expected was that Connor's body would suddenly unleash such incredible energy, propelling Zaki away.
"What... what just happened?" Cielo exclaimed with wide eyes, his expression filled with disbelief.
Aida, on the other hand, couldn't help but inhale deeply. She had been silently praying for a miracle, and now it seemed that a miracle had indeed occurred.
Zaki, after stabilizing himself, focused on Connor's location. His expression also reflected astonishment, as he could feel the overwhelming power that had burst from Connor's body. It was a power beyond Connor's control.
"Could this kid have some hidden skill?" Zaki mumbled to himself, then cautiously approached Connor, holding his Five Elements Dagger.
At this moment, Connor felt a powerful force slowly flowing into his body. Even he was unsure of what had just transpired, as he didn't understand the nature of the energy he had released.
All he could sense was his body gradually healing, with a continuous influx of formidable energy. It felt like he had just consumed a Chi Receiving Pill, but as a Black-rank martial artist, such pills provided negligible benefits. He no longer needed to rely on them.
"What's happening?" Connor's expression displayed confusion. He instinctively looked down beside him.
To his surprise, the jade pendant that Jorge had given him was emitting a bright and blinding light.
"Could this pendant be related to what just occurred?" Connor muttered to himself.
This jade pendant was a gift from Jorge, who had merely mentioned that it represented his identity. Any martial artist who saw it would recognize Connor's connection to Jorge. He had never considered it anything special.
Though he didn't attach much importance to the pendant, he couldn't have imagined that it would save him today.
The energy contained within the pendant was formidable. In less than a minute, he felt completely rejuvenated. What surprised him even more was that the pendant continued to channel energy into his body.
He took a deep breath and then slowly stood up.
Seeing Connor rise, Cielo was even more astounded. He had believed the battle between Connor and Zaki was over, thinking that Connor, who had been severely beaten moments ago, had no chance to recover.
Aida's expression was filled with excitement.
Zaki, too, noticed that something was amiss with the jade pendant and asked Connor in a low voice, "What is that pendant of yours?"
"I don't know," Connor replied, shaking his head gently.
"Could it be a divine artifact, just like mine?" Zaki continued.
"This pendant was given to me by someone else. I have no idea what it is," Connor calmly explained.
Zaki, upon hearing Connor's response, sneered and said lightly, "I never expected to have an unexpected gain today. Your pendant seems to be no ordinary divine artifact..."
Connor glanced at Zaki when he heard this and could tell that Zaki's intentions had turned greedy.
"Even with a divine artifact aiding you today, you still can't possibly be my match!" Zaki declared with a cold smile and rushed toward Connor.
Connor took a deep breath and met him head-on.
This time, Zaki appeared to opt not to use his Five Elements Dagger. Instead, he threw a thunderous punch at Connor. The power behind the punch was truly astonishing.
However, Connor retaliated with a seemingly ordinary punch, both in terms of power and technique, appearing weaker compared to Zaki's strike.
Cielo and Aida became extremely nervous when they witnessed this scene. They knew that this punch could very well determine the outcome of the battle.
"Boom!"
A deafening sound reverberated through the air.
Connor's fist clashed forcefully with Zaki's, creating a massive crater in the surrounding ground. This crater alone testified to the terrifying energy both combatants had unleashed.

chapters.title: Chapter 1785: Ten Thousand Heavenly Dipper!
chapters.content:
Chapter 1785: Ten Thousand Heavenly Dipper!
"Who... who won?" Cielo, even while sitting in the car, could feel the intense tremors just now, so he asked nervously.
Aida turned to look at Cielo but remained silent.
Meanwhile, Zaki and Connor were still standing in their original positions, but their expressions were somewhat peculiar.
Zaki hadn't expected Connor's power to become so terrifying. In their previous exchange, they had seemed evenly matched. He had been dominating thanks to the assistance of the Five Elements Dagger, even though their martial realms were the same.
However, in the last exchange, Connor had blocked his attack and sent him flying. He realized that Connor's strength had greatly increased due to the pendant's help.
Connor also seemed surprised. This was the first time he had used the pendant's power, and he didn't understand its function.
But after that last punch, he realized how powerful the pendant Jorge had given him truly was.
"Do you still think you can kill me today?" Connor looked at Zaki with a cold smile.
"Even with the pendant's help, what difference can it make? Today, you will still die by my hands!" Zaki replied with an emotionless expression and rushed toward him again.
His Five Elements Dagger carried a formidable force as it directly aimed for Connor's chest. However, just as the dagger was about to pierce Connor's chest, the pendant emitted another dazzling light, blocking Zaki's attack and sending him flying once more.
Seeing this, Connor's expression became even more excited because he knew that Jorge had once again saved him.
After being sent flying by the pendant's power, Zaki's expression also changed slightly. He no longer seemed as confident as before because he could sense the terrifying power contained within Connor's pendant. It even surpassed the Five Elements Dagger in terms of strength.
Cielo, witnessing the sudden turn of events, displayed mixed emotions on his face and began to worry for Zaki. If he couldn't kill Connor today, it would become much more challenging to find another opportunity, and his situation would become perilous.
Aida's expression was equally serious. The battle between them had already exceeded her understanding of martial power. Until the very end, she couldn't predict the victor.
At this moment, Connor had already charged in front of Zaki and delivered a punch to his chest.
Zaki quickly raised his arm to block his chest.
"Boom!"
A loud noise.
Initially, the wind wall in front of Zaki didn't seem to change, remaining undisturbed.
Seeing this, he felt a slight relief. He had thought that Connor's power, with the help of the pendant, might break through his wind wall, but it seemed that his worries were unfounded.
However, just as Zaki had begun to relax...
"Break!"
Connor suddenly shouted.
"Boom!"
The wind wall in front of Zaki exploded.
In the instant the wind wall shattered, it was as if a missile had exploded in place. The ground around them trembled violently.
Although Aida and Cielo were inside the car, they could still feel the shockwave caused by the wind wall's explosion.
"How... How is this possible?" Zaki's expression appeared shocked. He had never expected that Connor's punch would shatter his wind wall.
Connor's attack had shattered the wind wall that Zaki had thought was impenetrable.
"This... How is this possible?" Zaki stared wide-eyed, his face displaying shock and disbelief, as if he couldn't believe what he had just witnessed.
Connor didn't give Zaki much time to be shocked. Following the shattering of the wind wall, Connor's punch struck Zaki's chest.
"Pfft!"
Zaki spewed out a mouthful of blood and was sent flying backward, crashing to the ground.
Cielo, upon witnessing this scene, wore a look of despair. He could sense that the battle might be reaching its conclusion.
His speculation was correct. Zaki had been sent flying for nearly dozens of meters in the air and was now lying on the ground. His aura was extremely weak, as Connor's punch had severed all of Zaki's meridians. This punch's power was beyond what he could withstand.
Connor's figure flashed, and he appeared right in front of Zaki.

chapters.title: Chapter 1786: I Don't Have Time to Talk to You
chapters.content:
Chapter 1786: I Don't Have Time to Talk to You
Zaki lifted his head and glanced at Connor, struggling as if trying to stand up. However, he found himself completely powerless, just like Connor had been moments ago. The difference was that Connor had the pendant to help him recover, whereas Zaki's Five Elements Dagger didn't possess that capability.
He looked at Connor with a despairing expression on his face and said through gritted teeth, "I never thought I'd lose to someone like you today."
"You're not satisfied?" Connor replied indifferently.
"Of course, I'm not satisfied! If it weren't for your pendant, you'd be dead by my hands right now!" Zaki said agitatedly.
Connor couldn't help but chuckle upon hearing his words and said calmly, "Even without the pendant, if you didn't have that Five Elements Dagger, you wouldn't be my match."
Zaki remained silent upon hearing this.
"You've been an assassin for many years, right? So, if I kill you today, it's like removing a threat to the public," Connor said softly.
Zaki, upon hearing Connor's words, suddenly looked at him and asked in a low voice, "You actually plan to kill me?"
"If you came here today to kill me, then there's no reason for me to spare you," he replied calmly.
Zaki took a deep breath and said through gritted teeth, "Connor, if you spare my life today, I'm willing to agree to any request you have!"
Zaki was, after all, just an assassin. He had taken the mission to assassinate Connor for the money. If it meant risking his life, he wouldn't go through with it.
"No matter what request I have?"
Upon hearing Zaki's words, he couldn't help but sneer and said calmly, "I have no requests. Besides, there's nothing you can do for me. If I spare you today, it would be like releasing a tiger back into the wild. So today, you're undoubtedly going to die."
"You..." Zaki was momentarily stunned.
"I don't have time to talk to you anymore!" Connor didn't want to continue conversing with Zaki. He bent down and picked up a dagger from the ground.
"Splurt!"
With a light wave of Connor's right hand, the Five Elements Dagger pierced through Zaki's heart.
After jerking a couple of times, Zaki's body lost its vitality.
Facing someone like Zaki, Connor couldn't afford to be merciful. If he spared him today, there was a risk that Zaki would come after him again, and Connor didn't want to leave such a big threat behind.
Cielo and Aida, sitting in the car, witnessed Connor killing Zaki.
His face showed immense shock. He had never expected Connor to be so ruthless as to kill Zaki.
Aida's expression remained calm. After all, Connor's survival was more advantageous to her.
"Cielo, you never expected this outcome today, did you?" She turned to look at him and asked softly.
Instantly, he turned to look at Aida and replied through gritted teeth, "Aida, don't be too happy too soon. It's just one Zaki who died today. Connor was lucky today, but the real show is yet to come!"
Even though Zaki's loss had surprised him, he could accept it. After all, Zaki was just an assassin, and if he couldn't kill Connor, he could always find a more powerful assassin to do the job later. So, Cielo didn't show extreme despair at this point.
Aida didn't say anything but merely looked at Cielo. Their relationship had been clearly defined, and the competition for the position of Chen Family Patriarch was now based on their abilities.
"This Zaki was a useless choice. He failed to kill you on the plane, and now he's been killed by this Connor. I should never have hired him in the first place!" Cielo muttered to himself with frustration.
Just as he was about to start the car and leave, a figure suddenly appeared in front of the vehicle.
Cielo was startled by this unexpected presence and instinctively hit the brakes.
Aida looked up and saw Connor standing in front of the car.
Cielo's face displayed nervousness upon seeing him blocking the car because he knew exactly what Connor intended to do in this situation.
Taking a deep breath, Cielo pressed the accelerator.
"Vroom!"
The car's engine roared loudly as it charged toward Connor.
Although he knew that it was impossible to kill Connor with the car, he had no other choice. If he got out of the car, his fate would likely be the same as Zaki's.
"Bang!"
However, just as the car was about to collide with Connor, he extended his right hand and pressed it against the car's hood.
"Vroom vroom vroom..."
He seemed to be driving madly, but no matter how hard he pressed on the accelerator, the car remained stationary.
After a few seconds and an exasperated shout from Cielo, the car's engine finally died down.
Connor walked calmly to the car window, smashed it with a punch, and opened the car door.
"Con... Connor, what... what are you doing?" Cielo stammered, his face filled with fear. He hadn't expected Connor to find him.
Aida remained silent as she watched the unfolding scene. Their relationship had been defined, and now it was a matter of individual competence in the competition for the position of the Collier Family patriarch.
"This Zaki was a useless choice. He failed to kill you on the plane, and now he's been killed by this Connor. I should never have hired him in the first place!" Cielo muttered to himself in frustration.
Just as Cielo was about to start the car and leave, a figure suddenly appeared in front of the vehicle.
Cielo was startled by this unexpected presence and instinctively hit the brakes.
Aida looked up and saw Connor standing in front of the car.
Cielo's face displayed nervousness upon seeing Connor blocking the car because he knew exactly what Connor intended to do in this situation.
Taking a deep breath, Cielo pressed the accelerator.
"Vroom!"
The car's engine roared loudly as it charged toward Connor.
Although Cielo knew that it was impossible to kill Connor with the car, he had no other choice. If he got out of the car, his fate would likely be the same as Zaki's.
"Bang!"
However, just as the car was about to collide with Connor, he extended his right hand and pressed it against the car's hood.
"Vroom vroom vroom..."
Cielo seemed to be driving madly, but no matter how hard he pressed on the accelerator, the car remained stationary.
After a few seconds and an exasperated shout from Cielo, the car's engine finally died down.
Connor walked slowly to the car window, then shattered the glass with a punch, his expression devoid of emotion as he opened the car door.
"Con... Connor, what... what are you doing?" Cielo stammered, his face filled with fear.
"This assassin was hired by you, wasn't he?" Connor asked Cielo softly.
Cielo looked at him in silence, knowing that admitting or denying it was meaningless at this point.
"Since you hired an assassin to kill me, I might as well take care of you both today," Connor said as he reached out and pulled Cielo out of the car.
Cielo, now completely terrified, had become limp as he was pulled out of the car. Fear was evident on his face, as he had never anticipated that Connor would discover his involvement.

chapters.title: Chapter 1787: Kill Me Personally?
chapters.content:
Chapter 1787: Kill Me Personally?
While Aida sat in the passenger seat, she stared expressionlessly at Connor, her thoughts hidden.
Cielo lay on the ground, looking at Connor with a face filled with fear.
"Do you have anything else to say?" he asked Cielo softly.
Cielo took a deep breath upon hearing his question, trying to calm his emotions.
"If you don't have anything else to say, then go ahead and die!" Connor said, taking steps toward Cielo.
