"Don't kill me, please, don't kill me..." Cielo quickly shifted his body backward and stammered, "Con... Connor, don't forget, I am Beau's grandson, I am the future head of the Collier family. If you kill me today, my grandfather will never spare you..."
"Even if I don't kill you today, do you think your family family will spare me?" Connor responds, his face expressionless.
Upon hearing his words, Cielo instinctively hesitated, seemingly unsure how to respond.
"It seems you have nothing else to say now," Connor said as he raised the dagger in his hand.
Fear was evident on Cielo's face, he quickly turned to look at Aida in the car and pleaded, "Aida, I know you're in cahoots with this Connor. If I die today, you won't escape either. Please help me plead with Connor to spare me..."
Clearly, he was pinning all his hopes on her at this moment. If she's willing to intercede, he might have a chance to survive. If not, his fate was sealed today.
Aida, seated in the passenger seat, watched Cielo for a moment, then spoke to Connor, "Connor, if you kill this man now, Beau will undoubtedly seek revenge at any cost. The Collier family, won't let you go either. I know you're not afraid of us, but don't forget my grandfather, Beau, was a legendary martial artist. If he was determined to kill you at any cost, even Jorge wouldn't have been able to save you."
At this point, she didn't want him to know about her relationship with Connor, so she reluctantly pleaded on his behalf.
Of course, her words were also meant for Connor's benefit. Given the current situation, while Connor had conflicts with the Collier family, these conflicts had not escalated to a point of no return. Beau, considering Jorge's presence, would have resorted to other means to deal with Connor rather than a direct assassination.
For Connor, provoking the Collier family's wrath at this juncture wasn't advantageous. His primary adversary was the Gongsun family of Yangcheng, not the Collier family. If he intensified his enmity with the Collier family now, it might affect his plans for revenge against the Gomez family.
So, she believed that it wasn't a good choice for himto kill Cielo right now.
"That's right, Connor. If you dare to kill me today, my grandfather will never let you off!" Cielo seemed to have realized the situation and quickly nodded.
"Although I can't kill you today, I won't let you off so easily for hiring an assassin to kill me. I always settle scores," Connor said softly to Cielo.
"What do you want?" Cielo asked, looking puzzled.
Connor gave Cielo a cold smile and didn't waste any time. He lifted his leg and stomped it directly on Cielo's thigh.
"Ah..." Cielo screamed in agony and started writhing on the ground while holding his leg.
Seeing this, Aida's expression appeared somewhat shocked and incredulous. She didn't expect him to be so ruthless, directly breaking Cielo's leg.
"Since I can't kill you today, I'll just break your legs and feet. Consider it a lesson!"
"Connor, I won't let you off for this! Sooner or later, I'll kill you with my own hands!" Cielo howled in pain.
"Kill me with your own hands?" Connor chuckled upon hearing his words and said, "I think you might not get that chance."
"You..." Cielo tried to say something, but Connor didn't give him a chance. He lifted his leg and stomped on Cielo's other leg.
"Crack!" Another crisp sound, and Connor had just broken Cielo's other leg.
Seeing Cielo faint from the excruciating pain, Connor didn't continue. Instead, he turned his gaze to Aida.
"By maiming Cielo like this, I won't be able to explain it to the Collier family when I return," Aida said to Connor, speaking in a low voice.

chapters.title: Chapter 1788: Revenge for You
chapters.content:
Chapter 1788: Revenge for You
"I've already given you face. If it weren't for you pleading for Cielo, I might have killed him today," Connor replied calmly to Aida.
Aida, looking somewhat helpless at Connor's expression, then asked softly, "What do you plan to do next?"
"There's not much I can do here in York. This is your Collier family's territory, and it's not safe for me to stay here any longer. I'd rather go back to Yarlford for now," he said in a calm tone.
After hearing his words, she hesitated for a couple of seconds and then nodded gently, saying, "You're right. Yarlford is definitely safer than York."
"Take care of yourself!" He didn't intend to continue the conversation and turned to walk towards the airport.
Sitting in the car, Aida watched Connor's departing figure with a somewhat unusual expression on her face. After taking a deep breath, she didn't say much.
At this moment, she seemed to have placed all her hopes on Connor. She wasn't sure if her choice was right or wrong, but she knew that without him, she might have already died at the hands of Cielo and Shereen.
After hesitating for a couple of seconds, Aida took out her phone and dialed 999. After all, Cielo's condition was still very critical.
About ten minutes later, Cielo and Aida were taken away in an ambulance.
As for Zaki's body, Connor knew that the Collier family would handle it, so he didn't need to worry about it.
For Connor, the most important thing now was to deal with the Gomez family, not the Collier family. He didn't want to waste any more time in York. Since his relationship with Aida hadn't been exposed, he believed that she would find a way to help him locate the person known as "Grandmaster" based on the information they provided. According to Aida, this "Grandmaster" had been by Yamino's side for many years and knew a lot about him. If Connor could find this person, he could gather valuable information about Yamino.
After the intense battle with Zaki, Connor's body was not in stable condition. Even with the help of the jade pendant, he could feel the significant toll the battle had taken on him. It would take several months at least to fully recover.
However, the battle hadn't been without gains. Connor now possessed Zaki's Five Elements Dagger, a weapon with tremendous power. Although he didn't yet understand how to use it to its full potential, he decided to keep it for now.
Once he was on the plane, Connor unconsciously took out the jade pendant that Jorge had given him. The jade pendant had returned to its normal state and appeared to be an ordinary piece of jewelry.
"I didn't expect the old man to give me such a powerful treasure. If it weren't for this jade pendant today, I might have died at Zaki's hands," Connor murmured to himself.
At this moment, Connor still didn't know what the jade pendant was or how to use it. His ability to harness its power had been a fortunate accident. He planned to find Jorge when he had the time to learn more about it.
On the other side, outside a high-level ward at a hospital in York, nearly all of the Collier family's high-ranking members had gathered in the corridor. Their expressions were grim.
These past few days had been a turbulent period for the Collier family. First, someone had intruded into their secret chamber, and then Aida had been kidnapped. Now that she had returned, Cielo had been seriously injured, and his life hung in the balance.
The Collier family had been one of the most prominent families in York for many years, and very few dared to provoke them. Those who did usually didn't cross the line so blatantly. Cielo had been in the emergency room for over an hour, and his fate remained uncertain.
As the family members waited anxiously, Aida, as a witness, explained the events leading up to the incident.
Albert, upon hearing that Connor was responsible for Cielo's condition, wore an even more troubled expression. After all, Cielo was his only son, and he had planned for him to inherit the family business. The fact that Connor had taken such extreme actions was beyond their expectations.
Cielo's mother, Shereen, wept as if she were a tearful person. She regretted her earlier decision to involve Connor in eliminating Aida and had given him a substantial amount of money. She realized now that she had been played by Connor.
She had planned to have Zaki kill Connor before he left York, but she never expected that Zaki would die at Connor's hands. Now her son had been brutally injured.
Shereen was filled with regret for her past actions. She had never expected to bring such disaster upon her family by involving Connor.
"What exactly happened? Who had the audacity to do this to Cielo?" Beau, filled with anger, approached the group and asked.
Upon hearing his question, Aida quickly walked over and whispered, "Grandfather, it was Connor who did this to Cielo."
"Connor?" He hesitated upon hearing her words. Then he furrowed his brows and asked, "Aida, how do you know this?"
"Grandfather, it's like this. When you all left earlier, Cielo suddenly came to the medical room to find me. He told me that he had located Connor and wanted to seek revenge," she explained.
"How was he planning to seek revenge?" he asked in a low voice.
"He arranged for a Black-ranked warrior to assassinate Connor at the airport, but that person was no match for Connor and was killed by him. Cielo was discovered by Connor, who then broke both of Cielo's legs and arms before leaving," she summarized the events.

chapters.title: Chapter 1789: The Position of Family Head
chapters.content:
Chapter 1789: The Position of Family Head
Upon hearing Aida's words, Beau was trembling with anger. He clenched his teeth and said in a low voice, "How could Cielo be so foolish? I've told him countless times that Connor is not someone to be taken lightly. If Connor were easy to deal with, he wouldn't have survived until now!"
"Grandfather, I don't think we can entirely blame Cielo for this. After all, he only wanted to avenge me. But who could have expected that Connor's skills would be so terrifying!" Aida hurriedly explained.
"Yes, Father, this situation can't be entirely blamed on Cielo. We should blame that Connor for not respecting our Collier family. He went so far as to leave Cielo in such a state!" Albert ground his teeth and said in a low voice.
Beau took a deep breath and then furrowed his brows as he asked, "What is Cielo's current condition?"
"We don't know Cielo's exact condition yet. The doctor said he's no longer in a life-threatening situation, but we can't be certain about his future. He's lost the use of both his legs and arms, and while we performed surgery immediately, given the extent of the damage, it's doubtful that even our best efforts can completely restore him. So, we need to arrange for him to receive treatment abroad as soon as possible. There might still be a glimmer of hope..." Albert answered.
"Both his legs and arms are broken?" Beau took a step back instinctively upon hearing this, then gritted his teeth and said, "Are you saying that my grandson's best-case scenario is to become a cripple? That there's no hope of a full recovery?"
"Recovery to normal functioning is highly unlikely, considering the severity of the fractures, but with good rehabilitation, he might be able to perform some basic activities," the doctor cautiously replied.
Beau's expression grew even more furious upon hearing this news. He had never imagined that Connor would be so ruthless.
"Father, are you alright?" Albert noticed that Beau's expression seemed off and quickly walked over. He asked respectfully, "Is there something you want to discuss with me?"
"I'm not... not alright..." Beau waved his hand in response and then sat down on a bench in the corridor.
Albert's face wore a similarly grim expression. The impact of this incident on the Collier family was enormous. Both he and his father had hoped to groom Cielo as the future successor of the Collier family. However, with Cielo now in this condition, he couldn't possibly take on such a responsibility.
Beau sat in silence for about two to three minutes before slowly standing up and saying to Albert, "Albert, come with me."
"Alright,. Albert nodded and followed Beau into a hospital room.
After entering the room, Beau instructed Albert to close the door.
"Father, why did you call me in here?" Albert asked respectfully.
"Albert, I know you must be very upset about Cielo's situation, but what's done is done. We can't dwell on the pain," he began.
"I understand your point," Albert replied.
"I called you in here for two reasons. First, we need to arrange for Cielo to go abroad as soon as possible. His condition is beyond our capacity to treat, and we must place our hopes on foreign hospitals. If there's a chance for him to recover, we must take it," he said with an expressionless face.
"Understood," Albert nodded.
"Secondly, I've been hesitant about who should be the one to succeed in the Collier family between Cielo and Aida. Aida is strong, but she's still a woman. Cielo is more suitable, but with his current condition, he can't bear the responsibility. So, for now, you should start grooming Aida as the future successor of the Collier family," Beau stated.
"Father, this decision may affect many people. Are you really planning to groom Aida and give up on Cielo?" Albert asked with a hint of helplessness in his expression.
"Well..." Beau's expression remained indifferent. "Do you have a better choice now?"
Albert's face showed a touch of frustration. After all, he only had two children, Aida and Cielo. If neither of them were suitable to inherit the family's leadership, they might have to consider the children of Beau's brothers as alternatives. Beau was not willing to let his hard-earned family business go to someone else, so he hoped that one of his own children could step up as the successor.
"Alright, considering the current situation, we will follow your plan," Albert conceded.

chapters.title: Chapter 1790: The Opening Ceremony
chapters.content:
Chapter 1790: The Opening Ceremony
Upon hearing Albert's words, Beau couldn't help but let out a cold laugh. He then said expressionlessly, "This Connor truly doesn't regard our Collier family highly. Rest assured, this matter won't be let go so easily. I will definitely find him to seek an explanation."
"His skills are not simple. If we try to deal with him through assassins, it won't be easy," Albert sighed softly.
"That's right, I underestimated him at first. I thought we could take care of him with a few assassins, but I didn't expect his progress to be so rapid. Even Maurice is not his match. It seems that I'll have to take matters into my own hands this time," Beau said slowly.
"You... you intend to personally handle this?" Albert's expression appeared shocked, and he asked incredulously.
"Yes, given the current situation, I have no choice but to deal with it personally," Beau nodded lightly.
"Connor is a disciple of Jorge. If you truly harm him, Jorge won't let it go easily," Albert reminded cautiously.
"I'm currently no match for Jorge. If it comes to a showdown with him, I won't have much chance of winning. So, I don't plan to kill Connor. I'll teach him a lesson instead. This way, we can make our position clear," Beau explained.
"Teach Connor a lesson?" Albert was taken aback.
"What I'll do next is not something you need to concern yourself with. I have a plan. Your current task is to keep our Collier family members stable. No matter what happens to Cielo, Collier family must remain united," Beau said in a low voice.
"Alright, I understand," Albert conceded, although he was curious about Beau's plan to deal with Connor. He decided not to press for more information.
"Tit for tat. Connor, you've been targeting our Collier family at every turn. If I don't give you a taste of your own medicine, you might think that our Collier family is easy to bully," Beau murmured while looking out of the window.
After Albert exited the room, Beau continued to contemplate his plan.
On the other side, although Connor had boarded the flight to Yarlford, he remained cautious throughout the journey, constantly observing the people around him. He was worried that Collier family might continue to send assassins after him during the flight.
However, as the night passed, he realized that his concerns were unfounded. They did not make any further attempts on his life.
The next day, around nine in the morning, Connor's flight finally arrived in Yarlford.
After disembarking from the plane, he took a taxi back to his home.
Despite the life-threatening ordeal he had faced in York, he also recognized the advantages. He now had complete trust in Aida, who could play a crucial role in his future plans.
Upon arriving home, Connor noticed that Rachel was not there, probably attending her classes.
After spending the whole night without sleep and the intense battle with Zaki, his body was weak. He went into his room, rested, and fell asleep.
When he woke up, it was already past three in the afternoon.
Connor went to the bathroom for a quick wash, changed into clean clothes, and then drove to Stormbound Tower.
Due to Aida's situation, he had not been in touch with Queta for a while, and he was unsure about the current situation at the company.
Stormbound Tower had recently acquired a new piece of real estate, and the employees were working long hours to develop the property. Despite the heavy workload, the employees were well compensated, making Stormbound Corporation one of the highest-paying companies in Yarlford.
Upon arriving at Stormbound Tower, Connor noticed that Queta was in the middle of a meeting in the conference room. He didn't want to interrupt her, so he decided to wait in her office.
While waiting, he couldn't help but pick up some of the documents on her desk and perused them. Many of the documents contained information that he couldn't fully understand.
He realized that he was fortunate to have brought her to Yarlford. If he had to handle all these matters himself, he would be completely overwhelmed. He had a newfound appreciation for the complexities of managing a company.
However, Connor's priority at the moment was dealing with the Collier and Gomez families. With the threats they posed, he had little time to focus on learning how to manage a company.
After a while, Queta finally finished her meeting and returned to her office. She appeared elegant and beautiful as always, dressed in a black business suit with high heels.
Connor noticed that she seemed a bit tired.
"Mr. Connor, you're back," she said with a smile. "I didn't know you were coming today. I've been in a meeting."
"No problem, I came to check on the situation at the company. I heard the opening ceremony for the real estate project went well, but I couldn't attend due to being away," he replied with a smile.
"Yes, the project is proceeding smoothly, and the construction company has already started work. We even held an opening ceremony yesterday. However, since you were not in Yarlford, I didn't bother to inform you," she explained.
"It's fine. Opening ceremonies are just for show, and I trust you to handle things here," he said with a grin.

chapters.title: Chapter 1791: The Zook Family
chapters.content:
Chapter 1791: The Zook Family
"That's true!"
Queta nodded and continued, "Although the real estate project is going smoothly, it's not looking good for the situation of the six companies that our company took over from the Yaeger family…"
Connor was stunned for a moment and asked in confusion, "What do you mean?"
"Although we've already taken over these six companies, due to various problems, we can't start operations, so all the factories from these companies have already stopped working. If this continues, it will only be a waste of time…" Queta said helplessly.
"Are there a lot of problems that can't be solved?"
Connor frowned when he heard Queta's words.
"Some factories have problems with raw materials, others have problems with workers, and even the firefighters will come to find trouble with us. Anyway, these problems are just small problems, but if they pile up, the impact will be very big…" Queta said slowly.
"Someone must be deliberately sabotaging us!"
Connor said in a low voice.
"I also got someone to investigate. It's probably the Zook family that's behind this!"
Queta said, not intending to hide anything.
"The Zook family?"
Connor could not help but sneer when he heard this.
"Last time, Mr. McDonald, you embarrassed the Zook family at Watson Zook's birthday banquet. They will definitely think of ways to deal with us. If it was in Orilon, I could think of ways to solve these problems. But this is Yarlford, and there are many connections that I don't need. I was in a meeting just now to discuss countermeasures with the heads of various companies, but they are also my subordinates in Orilon. They can't find a suitable solution in Yarlford..."
Queta paused for a moment before continuing, "Mr. McDonald, if the six companies that we acquired remain in this state, it will be a huge burden for Stormbound Corporation. If it really doesn't work out, the only thing we can do is give up on these companies and declare bankruptcy!"
"Why give up on these companies? Even if there's no way to make the factories produce normally, we can't just give up, right?" Connor frowned.
Connor had spent a lot of effort to get these companies from the Yaeger family. He would definitely not be willing to give up now.
"Things are not as simple as you think…" Queta shook her head gently and said in a low voice, "When we took over these companies, they still had business. Some companies even had many orders that had not been completed. But now, some of the companies' raw material suppliers have directly broken their contracts, and we can't find any new suppliers in a short period of time..."
"If we can't find any new supplier, we won't be able to complete the order. If this continues, we'll have to face a lot of compensation in the end. Mr. McDonald, although you don't care about money, we didn't accept these companies to lose money!"
Connor understood what was going on after hearing Queta's words.
Originally, his goal of taking over these companies was to build them into an existence that could compete with the industries under the Gomez family in the shortest time possible. In this case, not only could his Stormbound Corporation compete for the Gomez family's market share in real estate, but also in other industries. This would have the greatest impact on the Gomez family.
However, these companies could no longer compete with the Gomez family for the market. They might not even be able to operate normally. These companies had effectively become a hot potato no one wanted to touch.
"The biggest reason for these problems is the Zook family. They must've used their connections to deal with us!" Connor said expressionlessly.
"That's right. The Zook family is one of the four great families in Yarlford. Their influence is very terrifying, so those suppliers don't dare to go against them at all!"
Queta nodded lightly.
"If we can't solve the problem of the supplier, then we'll think of a way to get rid of the Zook family. As long as we get rid of them, the rest will be much easier!" Connor said.
Queta was obviously stunned when she heard his words. Then, she said in surprise, "Mr. McDonald, are you joking with me? The Zook family is not so easy to deal with!"
"If I could deal with the Yaeger family back then, I will have a way to deal with the Zook family now. Moreover, the Zook family is the dog of the Gomez family. If I want to deal with the Gomez family, I have to deal with the Zook family sooner or later. Now that the Zook family has come to my doorstep, I'll make a move on them first!" Connor said with a smile.
Queta hesitated for a moment before saying, "Mr. McDonald, don't forget that the Zook family also has a Black-rank fighter. If you want to use the same method you used against the Yaeger family to deal with the Zook family, then I think you'll be in great danger!"
"I know the Zook family has a Black-rank fighter, so we can't deal with them like we did with the Yaeger family. I'll think of another way!" Connor said lightly.
Queta opened her mouth to speak. "But…"
"No buts. I came to Yarlford to deal with these people, so I'll have to deal with them sooner or later!"
Connor seemed to have guessed what Queta wanted to say, so he interrupted her.
Queta looked at Connor helplessly, took a deep breath, and didn't continue.
"Is there anything else other than the situation of these six companies?"
Connor asked.
"At present, these six companies are the most pressing issue. I can solve the rest on my own!" Queta replied after thinking for a moment.
"Alright, don't worry about the Zook family's matters. I'll think of a way to resolve it. It must've been hard on you in this period of time. If there's nothing else on the real estate project, you should rest too…" Connor said.
"I…"
Queta was stunned for a moment. Then, she smiled and said, "Mr. McDonald, you don't have to worry about me. I'm just a little worried about the development of our group. I'm not very tired…"
"That's good. In any case, you should rest on your own time. Don't let yourself work too hard…"
Connor said with a smile.
Queta's expression was a little dazed as she said, "I didn't expect you to care about me, Mr. McDonald!"
"You're my employee now. Of course I care about you!"
Connor smiled and then turned around and walked out of the office.
Queta looked at his back and smiled. Then, she started to work.

chapters.title: Chapter 1792: A Peaceful Life
chapters.content:
Chapter 1792: A Peaceful Life
After Connor left Queta's office, he went straight to Dominic, Spencer and the others and brought them out for a meal.
Now, Dominic, Spencer and the others had their own things to do under Queta. However, they had not worked for a long time, so there were many things that they were not familiar with. Therefore, Connor planned to let them go to other companies as managers after they had trained enough.
Connor did not have many friends around him, so he wanted to do his best to help Dominic and the others.
After dinner, Connor returned home alone.
When he arrived home, he found that Rachel had already returned. She was sitting on the sofa watching a TV series.
"Connor, you're back?"
Rachel asked in surprise after seeing him.
"If I don't come back, will you treat this place as your home?" Connor asked, exasperated.
"That's not the case. I'm only temporarily staying at your house…" Rachel smiled faintly and continued to ask, "What have you been busy with these past few days?"
"I sent Aida Collier to York. Fortunately, she didn't die at the hands of the Collier family…"
Connor walked to Rachel's side while talking.
"What's going on? Why did you send Aida Collier to York?"
Rachel blinked and asked in confusion.
Connor hesitated for a moment and then told Rachel about what had happened in the past few days. After Rachel found out that the amethyst pendant that Jorge Yarrell gave Connor had such a powerful effect, she immediately took the pendant and studied it.
However, after examining it for a long time, he still could not figure out how to use the pendant.
"Although I've heard of quite a few Divine Artifacts, I've never heard of this amethyst pendant. If there's a chance, I can ask someone for you. I know a lot of High grade martial artists who like to study Divine Artifacts…"
Rachel returned the amethyst pendant to Connor.
"This amethyst pendant is not the main point. The most important thing for me now is to deal with those people from the Zook family. See if you can help me think of a way!"
Connor said.
"Dealing with the Zook family?"
Rachel couldn't help but be stunned when she heard his words. Then, she said helplessly, "This Zook family is really not that easy to deal with. They're also an ancient martial arts aristocratic family. Many members of the Zook family are also martial artists, so if you want to use violent means to deal with them, it's basically impossible…"
"Is there any other way?"
Connor frowned slightly after hearing Rachel's words.
Rachel thought for a moment.
"How about this? I'll think of a way to help you investigate the situation of the Zook family over the next few days. If I find anything, I'll let you know…"
"Alright!"
Connor nodded his head lightly. Then, he didn't say anything else and returned to his room.
After returning to his room, Connor planned to rest, but before he could lie down on the bed, his phone rang.
Connor picked up his phone and took a look at the screen. He realized that it was Aida calling him, so he picked up the call.
"Hello?"
Aida didn't waste any time and said, "Connor, I called you today to thank you…"
"Thank me?"
Connor couldn't help but be stunned for a moment when he heard Aida's words. Then, he smiled and said, "Didn't you already thank me when I sent you back to York?"
"I'm not thanking you for sending me back to York!"
"Then what's the reason?" Connor asked in confusion.
"I'm thanking you because you broke Cielo's legs and hands…"
Aida paused for a moment before continuing, "You broke Cielo's legs and hands, so he has become a cripple. Albert and Beau Collier plan to groom me as the heir of the Collier family…"
"Isn't that good? I just wanted to teach Cielo a lesson, but I didn't expect it to have such an effect. However, you have to be careful; after all, Cielo might already know about our relationship…" Connor reminded Aida.
"You don't have to worry about that. Cielo has already been sent to a hospital overseas, so it's no longer important whether he knows about our relationship!"
Aida said slowly.
"Then you won't go back on your word, right?"
Connor frowned.
"I, Aida Collier, have always been a woman of my word. I will help you investigate the Grand Master's whereabouts as soon as I can. After all, I also hope that you can get rid of the Gomez family as soon as possible."
"Alright, then!" Connor nodded and continued, "You didn't just call me to thank me today, did you? Do you have something else to do?"
"That's right. I also want to remind you to pay attention to your safety during this period of time. Beau Collier is very angry because you broke Cielo's legs and arms. He wants to teach you a lesson and will personally take action," Aida said.
"Okay, thank you for your reminder. I'll be careful!"
Connor replied indifferently.
"If anything happens on your side, contact me at any time!" Aida continued.
"Alright!"
Connor agreed and hung up the phone. Then, he lay on the bed and rested.
Through this phone call, Connor knew that Aida really wanted to work with him. Otherwise, according to this woman's personality, she would never take the initiative to remind Connor to watch out for his own safety.
Although Connor knew that Beau Collier and the Collier family might be preparing to take revenge on him, Connor was not in the mood to think about these things. He was only thinking about how to deal with the Zook family.
…
In the blink of an eye, Connor had been back in Yarlford for nearly a week.
In this week, Connor had still not found any suitable opportunity to deal with the Zook family, and Beau Collier had never come to take revenge on Connor.
Therefore, Connor had been very calm during this period of time. He spent most of his time learning how to manage the company from Queta in Stormbound Tower.
It had to be said that with Queta, the business queen, as a lecturer, Connor could still learn a lot of useful knowledge; after all, she had a very high status in the business world.

chapters.title: Chapter 1793: Rich Heir
chapters.content:
Chapter 1793: Rich Heir
"Ding, ding, ding…"
In the conference room, Queta, who was in the middle of a meeting, was suddenly interrupted by a ringtone.
Queta could not help but frown when she heard the ringtone.
Because when she was in a meeting, everyone's cell phone had to be turned off.
What she hated the most was the ringing of her phone interrupting her thoughts during meetings.
The employees in the meeting room had ugly expressions on their faces, as if they were worried that they had forgotten to turn off their phones.
However, after checking, everyone found that their phones were all turned off.
A moment later, everyone turned their attention.
When Connor saw that everyone in the conference room was looking at him, he suddenly realized that his phone was ringing. He quickly took out his phone and saw that it was Rachel calling him.
Connor smiled awkwardly at Queta and walked out of the meeting room with his phone.
After walking out of the conference room, Connor picked up the phone and said helplessly, "Why did you call me?"
"Wait for me at the entrance of Yarlford University at five o'clock tonight…"
Rachel said.
"Wait for you at the entrance of Yarlford University?"
When Connor heard Rachel's words, he couldn't help but be stunned for a moment. Then, he frowned and asked, "Why?"
"Why do you have so many questions? Just come over if I tell you to. It's a good thing anyway. If you don't come over, you'll definitely regret it…"
Rachel said indifferently.
"..."
Connor could feel that Rachel's tone was very serious. She probably wasn't joking, so he thought for a moment and said, "Alright, I'll come look for you when the time comes!"
"Sure!"
Rachel replied and then hung up the phone.
Connor didn't think much after Rachel hung up the phone. He turned around and returned to the meeting room.
…
At five o'clock in the afternoon, at the entrance of Yarlford University.
At this moment, there were many students gathered at the entrance. It was obvious that something had happened, or it would not have attracted so many people.
"Which rich heir has taken a fancy to a girl from our school?"
"I don't know. However, this person looks quite good…"
"His car seems to be worth a few million dollars, right? He must be an heir from a big family…"
The students present began to discuss in low voices.
However, there were two cars in the middle of these students. One was a Mercedes-Benz G63 worth more than three million dollars, and the other was a Bentley. These two cars were luxury cars worth millions. In the eyes of these ordinary students, they were naturally very unbelievable existences.
In the eyes of ordinary people, anyone who could drive such a luxury car was definitely not an ordinary person.
However, there were four or five young men standing in front of the two cars. Their temperaments and the way they dressed were enough to prove their family background.
It was obvious that the main character today was the young man in a white Armani suit who was holding flowers.
"Mr. Zook, just what kind of woman is able to charm you to such an extent…"
"That's right, Peyton. If you really like a girl, can't you just tell her your identity? Why did you make such a big commotion?" a few friends beside the young man asked.
This young man was called Peyton Zook. He was also a very famous heir in Yarlford.
As for the people around Peyton, they were all heirs from large families.
"You guys don't know. The woman I want to pursue this time is different from ordinary women. If I don't make a big scene, it'll probably be very difficult to move her…" Peyton replied.
"If you say so, I'm a little curious about what that woman looks like!"
"That's right. I'm also very curious now…" Everyone laughed.
"When you see her later, you will know why I did this…" Peyton said lightly.
In fact, Peyton had a girlfriend at Yarlford University, and his girlfriend could definitely be considered the school belle.
A few days ago, Peyton came here to look for his girlfriend when he accidentally saw a woman. Peyton was instantly attracted to her and broke up with his girlfriend when he went back.
After some investigation, Peyton knew that this woman was called Rachel Wallace. She was not a student of Yarlford University, but rather a lecturer.
Peyton tried every means to contact Rachel, but ikept failing.
Peyton also found out that there were many rich heirs in Yarlford University who were crazily pursuing Rachel.
However, this Rachel did not seem to fall for the tricks of the rich heirs. She might not even look at luxury cars, watches, and bags. Many rich heirs had already suffered because of her.
Peyton knew that if he were to use the same method he used to deal with those normal female university students, it would be useless. He could only choose to use romantic attacks to deal with Rachel.
Time passed by.
Peyton stood quietly beside the car with flowers in his hand, waiting for Rachel to come out.
After a long time, the woman who Peyton had been dreaming of for days finally walked out of the school in her high heels.
"It's this woman!"
Peyton hurriedly turned his head and said to his friend beside him.
After hearing Peyton's words, everyone raised their heads and looked at Rachel. Then, everyone was stunned on the spot, and their expressions were all of shock.
"She's a top-grade beauty!"
"D * mn, isn't this too nice?"
"No wonder he was able to charm Mr. Zook to such an extent. This is simply the best among the best…"
Everyone looked in Rachel's direction and said excitedly.
Peyton's expression was a little smug. He knew that any normal man would definitely be tempted after seeing Rachel.
Peyton tidied up his clothes and walked towards her.
When Rachel saw Peyton walking towards her, her expression was a little strange. Then, she began to look for Connor in the crowd.
But Rachel didn't expect that Connor hadn't come yet.
"Why isn't this bastard here yet?"
Rachel frowned and could not help but curse in her heart. Then, she took out her phone and dialed his number.
"Connor, why haven't you come to Yarlford University yet?"
Rachel directly questioned.
"Ma'am, there's a traffic jam here. Wait for me for a while. I'll be there in seven or eight minutes…"
Connor said, exasperated.
"I'll give you ten minutes. If you still aren't here in ten minutes, you'll definitely regret it…" Rachel threatened.

chapters.title: Chapter 1794: He Was Someone from The Zook Family?
chapters.content:
Chapter 1794: He Was Someone from The Zook Family?
"Alright, I got it!"
Connor replied impatiently and then hung up.
After putting down her phone, Rachel took a deep breath and walked forward.
When Peyton saw Rachel walk over, he revealed a smile that he thought was very gentlemanly and warm. Then, he stopped in front of Rachel and said to Rachel, "Ms. Wallace, I've liked you for a long time. I wonder if you have time tonight. I want to treat you to a meal!"
When everyone saw Peyton block Rachel, they all revealed relieved expressions.
Although Rachel hadn't been at Yarlford University for long, she had already charmed the boys of Yarlford University. Almost every day, someone would take the initiative to confess to her.
However, Rachel would never look at these people seriously.
Therefore, many students of Yarlford University thought that Rachel might already be taken. Of course, there were also some who thought that Rachel was a lily.
Rachel could not help but be stunned when she heard Peyton's words. Then, she asked, "Who are you? The two of us don't seem to know each other, right?"
Everyone's expression seemed to be even more shocked after hearing Rachel's words.
Because in their impression, Rachel never said a word of nonsense to her pursuers. Most of the time, she would choose to walk away.
However, Rachel actually took the initiative to talk to Peyton. This was obviously not normal!
"Could it be that Ms. Wallace is interested in this person?"
"I think this guy is quite handsome, and he looks like he's pretty good…"
"It's over, it's over. Our new goddess from Yarlford University has been snatched away just like that. I wonder how many boys are crying silently…"
The surrounding students began to discuss in low voices.
Peyton did not expect Rachel to take the initiative to talk to him, so he was very excited at this time. He hurriedly said, "Ms. Wallace, my name is Peyton Zook. We really don't know each other, but I saw you a few days ago..."
"Mr. Zook is the general manager of the Zook family's cable company…"
"Yes, Mr. Zook is one of the top heirs in Yarlford!"
Peyton's friends quickly gassed him up.
The expressions on the faces of everyone present seemed to become even more shocked when they heard these words.
"What is it? This person is actually from the Zook family?"
"No wonder they could make such a big scene. It turns out that they're from the Zook family!"
"Although the Zook Corporation isn't a big company, it's still a business of the Zook family. This person is the general manager of the Zook Corporation, which means that he must be from the Zook family!"
"Oh my god, Ms. Wallace's charm is too great. She actually attracted the heirs of the four great families!"
After all, this was Yarlford, so almost everyone knew what kind of existence the Zook family was.
In the eyes of many girls, if they could date the heirs of the four great families, it would be considered as the peak of their lives.
However, Rachel was calm after hearing these words. She said to Peyton, "I'm sorry, I don't know you. Can you move aside?"
All the students had thought that Rachel would look at Peyton differently after knowing his true identity. However, no one expected the result to be the same; Rachel was still as cold as ever, as if there was no change in her emotions at all.
"..."
Peyton couldn't help but be stunned when he heard Rachel's words. Then, he hurriedly said, "Ms. Wallace, I know you might not know me, but I met you a few days ago. From the first time I saw you, I knew that you were the woman I've been looking for. I really hope that you can give me a chance. The two of us can start off as friends…"
Peyton seemed to have expected such a situation to happen, so his behavior was relatively natural.
"Am I really the woman you've been looking for?"
Rachel couldn't help but laugh when she heard what Peyton said.
When Peyton saw Rachel smile, he seemed to think that he still had a chance. He hurriedly said, "That's right, you're the woman I'm looking for. I fell in love with you from the first time I saw you…"
"I'm really sorry. I don't know if I'm the woman you're looking for, but I know you're definitely not the man I'm looking for. I already have a boyfriend!"
Rachel said.
"You... You already have a boyfriend?"
Peyton was stunned when he heard Rachel's words.
Actually, Peyton wasn't the only one who was stunned. Almost everyone present was in a similar state.
This was the first time Rachel admitted that she already had a boyfriend in front of so many people.
"I have a very good relationship with my boyfriend, so can you move away now?" Rachel continued.
Peyton couldn't help but take a deep breath, then said, "Ms. Wallace, it doesn't matter even if you have a boyfriend. I can compete with him!"
"You? Compete with my boyfriend?"
Rachel couldn't help but sneer when he heard Peyton's words. Then, she said indifferently, "Stop joking. I don't think you're qualified to compete with my boyfriend at all!"
Peyton looked at Rachel with a shocked expression.
After all, he had just told Rachel his identity. Although Peyton's status in the Zook family was not high, and he was the general manager of the most inconspicuous company in the Zook family, Peyton was still a true member of the Zook family!
Just the name of the Zook family could easily crush most of the upper echelons of Yarlford, even if he didn't have a high status in it.
Peyton himself was quite good-looking, so he was very confident in himself.
And yet, in Rachel's eyes, he didn't even have the right to compete with her boyfriend. This really provoked Peyton.
"Who is your boyfriend? You saying even Mr. Zook is not qualified to compete with him?"
At this moment, one of Peyton's friends couldn't stand it anymore and shouted at Rachel.
Rachel turned her head and glanced at that person before saying, "What my boyfriend does has nothing to do with you. Anyway, this person is not qualified to be compared to my boyfriend. I advise you to quickly move aside!"
"Ms. Wallace, it seems that you like your boyfriend very much!"
Peyton's expression was a little ugly.
"I don't really like him, but compared to you, I still want to be with my current boyfriend!"
Rachel replied calmly.

chapters.title: Chapter 1795: To The Rescue!
chapters.content:
Chapter 1795: To The Rescue!
Peyton's expression turned even uglier after hearing Rachel's words.
Peyton had never encountered such a situation before. This was simply belittling him to the point of being worthless!
"Alright, I've said what I need to say. Can you move aside now? I forgot to tell you just now. My boyfriend will be coming to pick me up in a while!"
Rachel saw that Peyton didn't say anything and continued to speak.
"Your boyfriend is coming over later?"
Peyton's expression was a little excited, and then he hurriedly said, "Then I want to see just who this boyfriend of yours is. Saying that I don't even have the qualifications to compete with him fairly…"
"I advise you not to bother. My boyfriend has always had a bad temper. If he sees you harassing me, he might beat you up…"
Rachel pretended to be kind.
"Ms. Wallace, I just want to treat you to a meal now. It's not harassment at all. Also..."
Peyton paused for a moment and then said lightly, "In a place like Yarlford, no one dares to touch me, Peyton Zook, so Ms. Wallace, don't worry about me!"
"That's right, what kind of person is Mr. Zook? Does your boyfriend want to die? You're saying he'd dare lay a finger on Mr. Zook?"
"This is ridiculous. Do you think your boyfriend is Juan Gomez of all people?"
The people around Peyton shouted disdainfully.
"Even if the person standing in front of me today was Juan Gomez, my boyfriend would still dare to hit him!"
Rachel said calmly.
"Haha…"
Peyton couldn't help but sneer. Then, he said in a low voice, "Ms. Wallace, if you put it that way, then I'm even more curious about the background of your boyfriend…"
"Since you want to wait to see him, then just wait!"
Rachel looked at Peyton and didn't say anything.
Everyone present seemed to be very curious about Rachel's mysterious boyfriend, so they didn't have the intention of leaving just yet. They stood where they were and waited to watch the show.
Everyone waited for about five or six minutes before a black Audi slowly stopped at the gate of Yarlford University.
The market price of this Audi was at most 400,000 to 500,000 dollars. In the big city of Yarlford, where the rich were everywhere, it was not considered a luxury car at all. It could only be considered an ordinary car, so this car did not attract much attention.
After Connor parked the car, he got out of the car and walked towards Rachel.
When Connor saw Peyton who was holding flowers in front of Rachel, he understood what was going on.
"She actually asked me to come over and be her shield again…"
Connor muttered with some dissatisfaction, but he did not say anything more and walked directly to Rachel.
"Darling, you're here?"
Rachel smiled sweetly when she saw Connor.
"My dear!"
When everyone heard Rachel address Connor as such, they were all stunned on the spot. The expressions on their faces was very incredulous.
After all, when Connor got out of the car, everyone thought that he was just an ordinary student from Yarlford University. However, no one expected that this young man, who was dressed very ordinarily, was actually Rachel's boyfriend.
For a moment, everyone felt a little disappointed.
After all, Rachel had bragged a lot just now. She even said that Peyton was not qualified to be compared.
However, when the two of them compared each other, it was like heaven and earth!
Peyton's car was worth several million dollars, and he was from the Zook family. His appearance was even more impressive. Although Connor's appearance was not bad, he was still inferior to Peyton.
If these two people were placed together, anyone with normal eyes should be able to tell who was taller and who was shorter.
Of course, Connor had some heaven-defying identity.
However, how heaven-defying could a person who drove a car worth 400,000 to 500,000 have?
Peyton was also observing Connor at this time. He felt that Connor seemed a little familiar. He should have seen this guy somewhere, but he couldn't remember.
Connor had already understood what was going on when he saw the situation here, so he didn't waste any time. He directly walked to Rachel's side and said, "Come back with me!"
"Honey, this person has been pestering me to treat me to a meal. Do you agree to it or not?"
Rachel seemed to be acting sweet on purpose.
"Treat you to a meal?"
When Connor heard this, he could not help but be stunned. Then, he sized up Peyton and said expressionlessly, "You want to treat my girlfriend to a meal?"
At this moment, Connor did not know that Peyton was a member of the Zook family, nor did he know the true purpose of Rachel calling him over, so he thought that she just wanted him to deal with an admirer.
"Yes, I want to treat Ms. Wallace to a meal!"
Peyton did not take Connor seriously at all and replied in an arrogant tone.
"Get lost. You don't have the right to do so. If you have time, spend it on the other girls in this school. Don't eye my girlfriend!"
Connor was not in the mood to talk nonsense with Peyton, so his tone was very tough.
"What did you say?"
Peyton did not expect Connor to be so arrogant.
"I told you to get lost, didn't you understand?"
Connor expressionlessly repeated himself, then dragged Rachel away, intending to leave.
Peyton was stunned for a moment. He stepped forward and stopped Connor, then said with a gloomy expression, "Kid, do you know who I am? You actually dare to tell me to get lost?"
Peyton was a member of the Zook family. He had lived in Yarlford for so many years. No matter where he went, he was a respected existence. No one dared to speak to him like that.
"Connor, hit him!"
Peyton had just finished speaking when Rachel said to Connor in a low voice, "Hit him?"
Connor's expression was a little puzzled. "We don't have to fight over such a small matter, right?"
Although his attitude was tough, he just wanted to settle this matter as soon as possible. He had no intention of hitting anyone at all.
"I told you to hit him, so just do it!" Rachel said.
"Alright, if he continues to pester me, I'll make a move!"
Connor didn't understand why Rachel wanted him to hit someone, but he could feel that she wasn't joking, so he agreed.
"Brat, if you break up with Ms. Wallace now, I might let you go if I'm in a good mood. Otherwise, I won't let this matter go!"
Peyton shouted excitedly.
"You won't let this matter go?"
Connor couldn't help but laugh coldly, and then turned his hand to slap him.

chapters.title: Chapter 1796: Investigating the Zook Family
chapters.content:
Chapter 1796: Investigating the Zook Family
"Pa!"
A crisp sound rang out.
Connor didn't use his full strength in this slap, but Peyton still couldn't take it. He took a few steps back and sat on the ground.
"You actually dare to hit Mr. Zook?! Are you tired of living?"
Peyton's friends rushed over after seeing him get beaten up.
These people were all ordinary people. How could they be his match?
Connor had only slapped Peyton once and sent him flying.
Peyton stared at Connor with an angry expression. He knew that this man definitely was skilled. If they continued to fight, he might be the one to suffer.
"I told you that my boyfriend would hit you, but you didn't believe me. Now you're getting beaten up, right?"
Rachel mocked.
Peyton took a deep breath, then gritted his teeth and asked Connor in a low voice, "Brat, do you dare to tell me your name? I must demand an explanation for today's matter!"
Peyton felt that it was impossible for him to deal with Connor now because his friends around him were all good-for-nothings. He was prepared to find out his name before thinking of a way to take revenge on him.
There was no one in Yarlford that the Zook family could not deal with!
"My name is Connor McDonald!"
Connor faintly replied, and then took Rachel to the car.
Soon, his Audi disappeared under everyone's shocked gazes.
When Peyton heard the name, he was stunned as if he had been petrified.
"He... He was actually…It's Connor McDonald!"
Peyton stammered.
Peyton himself was a member of the Zook family, so he'd also attended Watson's birthday banquet that day. Naturally, that was where he'd seen Connor, which was why Peyton felt that he looked familiar.
Connor could be said to be the biggest enemy of the Zook family now. It wasn't just the Zook family, too— the relationship between Connor and the Gomez family was also very strained.
Peyton did not expect Rachel's boyfriend to have such a powerful background!
If it was an ordinary person, Peyton would definitely do everything he could to deal with them.
However, if the other party was Connor McDonald, then Peyton would be in a difficult position. This was because Connor was an existence that even the Gomez family and the Zook family did not dare to easily deal with!
A person who could contend with the Gomez family was not someone that an heir from a large family like him could deal with.
"Mr. Zook, this kid is too arrogant. How do you plan to deal with him next?"
A young man shouted at Peyton indignantly.
"How do we deal with him?"
When Peyton heard this, he could not help but sneer. Then, he gritted his teeth and said, "Are you f * cking crazy? Didn't you hear? That person is Connor McDonald!"
"What about him?"
The young man blinked his eyes and asked in confusion.
"What's up with him?"
Peyton smiled helplessly and said in a low voice, "Call your father now and ask him who he is. Then, talk to me!"
After saying this, Peyton turned around and left.
Everyone present was also dumbfounded. They did not understand what was going on.
Meanwhile, Connor and Rachel drove straight home.
Today, Rachel was dressed more formally. She was wearing a black uniform and a short skirt. Her slender and fair legs seemed to have some magic, attracting his attention.
Connor tried to calm himself down and drove expressionlessly.
"Can you not make me come for such things in the future? How many people have I offended because of you?"
Connor turned his head to look at Rachel and complained as if he was somewhat dissatisfied.
At this moment, Connor thought that she had called him over today to deal with an admirer.
"Do you think I asked you to come here today to pretend to be my boyfriend?"
Rachel replied indifferently.
"What else?"
"If it's just an admirer, I have my own ways to solve it. I asked you to come here today to help you!" Rachel said.
"Help me?"
When Connor heard Rachel's words, his expression seemed to be even more puzzled. He frowned and said, "What are you helping me with?"
"Do you know who the person you hit just now was?"
Rachel asked.
"I don't know."
Connor shook his head.
"Big brother, I really have to hand it to you. What have you been busy with in Yarlford to the point where you don't even know the situation of your enemy?"
Rachel muttered in an unusually exasperated manner.
"Can you stop keeping me in suspense? Who is that person?"
Connor asked with a puzzled expression.
"That person's name is Peyton. He's from the Zook family!"
Rachel said.
"The Zook family?"
Connor suddenly turned his head and looked at Rachel with an excited expression.
"Haven't you been trying to deal with the Zook family recently? You don't even know who their members are, so how are you going to deal with them?"
Rachel was exasperated.
"I've been investigating the six companies recently to see if I can find any loopholes. I didn't pay attention to the Zook family at all!"
Connor explained.
Rachel glanced at Connor indifferently, after which she said, "In the beginning, I had the same idea as you. I wanted to start from the Zook family's companies. However, after investigating a lot, I found that the Zook family's systems are very perfect. Even if there are any loopholes, outsiders can't get in touch with them. Moreover, these things can't bring down the entire Zook family at all, nor can they solve your current problem..."
"So you started investigating the Zook family?"
Rachel gently nodded.
"That's right. I started to investigate everyone in the Zook family, one by one. In the end, I felt that this Peyton was a very good breakthrough!"
"Why?"
"You don't understand the specific situation of the Zook family. In fact, they could be considered a super big family in Yarlford back then. Moreover, the Zook family at that time was not attached to the Gomez family and was instead was an independent big family. The previous head of the Zook family was called Hudson Zook!"
Rachel paused for a moment before continuing, "Hudson Zook has three sons. The eldest son is called Yuri Zook, and the second son is called Watson. I don't know what the third son's name is, but he passed away when he was very young!"
"I know all this. Later on, Yuri also passed away, and then Watson replaced Hudson as the head of the Zook family!"
Connor said.
"Then do you know how Yuri Zook died?"
Rachel asked.

chapters.title: Chapter 1797: Cooperation
chapters.content:
Chapter 1797: Cooperation
"I'm not very sure about that!"
Connor lightly shook his head.
"If the news I received is correct, Yuri was killed by the Gomez family. Yamino Gomez had someone kill Yuri, and then Watson became the head of the Zook family and attached himself to the Gomez family!
Rachel said.
"You mean to say that Watson and Yamino worked together to get rid of Yuri?"
After Connor understood Rachel's words, the expression on his face was very surprised.
"Yes. Yuri's ability was far above Watson's back then. Moreover, Yuri was Hudson Zook's eldest son. Logically speaking, he should have inherited the position of the Zook family's head. However, Yuri died at the most important time of the competition. This is definitely not a coincidence!"
Rachel said seriously.
Connor looked at Rachel and didn't say anything. If it was before, Connor might wonder if Rachel's news was true or not, but now Connor didn't doubt it.
After all, the competition between the big families had always been very cruel; Cielo and Aida were also trying to kill each other.
In the face of real benefits, any kinship or friendship was nonsense.
"But even if I know these things, how are they related to me dealing with the Zook family?"
Connor frowned.
"Then do you know who the person you just hit is?"
Rachel said with a smile.
"I don't know."
Connor lightly shook his head.
"The person I asked you to beat up just now was none other than Yuri Zook's biological son!" Rachel replied.
Connor was stunned when he heard Rachel's words.
"When Yuri died back then, Hudson had already sensed that something was wrong. After all, Hudson was not an ordinary person who could lead the Zook family to where it is today, so he was very aware of many things. He was worried that Watson and Yamino Gomez would go crazy and attack him, so when Watson became the head of the Zook family, Hudson left 51% of the shares for himself. The remaining 49% of the shares were distributed to the other members of the Zook family…" Rachel continued.
"Then Hudson should still be in charge of the Zook family now, right?"
Connor hurriedly asked.
"Of course not!"
Rachel gently shook her head and continued, "The current head of the Zook family, Watson, holds most of the power in his hands, while Hudson no longer cares about the Zook family. As long as Watson doesn't do anything overboard, after Hudson dies, his shares will still belong to Watson…"
"This old man is giving himself a way out!"
Connor sighed.
"Although this is an internal matter of the Zook family, it can provide you with a very good opportunity. Because Hudson has 51% of the shares, Hudson has the ability to make Watson step down!"
Rachel continued.
"Hudson does have the ability to make Watson step down, but how can I move Hudson? After all, Hudson wanted to deal with his own son!"
Connor said speechlessly.
"I've already said so much. Why don't you understand what I mean?"
Rachel looked at Connor with a broken expression.
"What do you mean?"
"You really can't convince Hudson, but you might be able to convince Peyton!"
Rachel paused for a moment before continuing, "Watson is Peyton's father's murderer. Moreover, Peyton has been completely sidelined in the Zook family now. If we take the initiative to propose a willingness to cooperate with him, I don't think he has any reason to refuse!"
Connor only understood Rachel's true intentions after hearing her words. He said in a low voice, "I know what to do. You want me to work with Peyton and support him to replace Watson's position in the Zook family."
"Yes!"
Rachel saw that Connor understood her meaning and let out a long sigh of relief.
"Your idea is not bad. Not only can it solve my current problem, but it can also weaken the strength of the Gomez family. Most importantly, it can also strengthen my power."
Connor laughed. His mood instantly improved.
"Do you think I called you over today just to get you to help me get rid of an admirer?"
Rachel muttered.
"But it's not that easy to support Peyton in a takeover, right?"
Connor felt a headache coming on.
"I've already told you how to do so. As for what you want to do next, it has nothing to do with me!"
Rachel said casually.
"Since you've already considered letting me work with Peyton, why did you get me to hit him today?" Connor frowned and asked.
"If you don't slap him, how will he know his place? Your slap is telling him the difference between the two of you. This way, you can have more leverage when you talk to him about cooperation. It will be very helpful to you!" Rachel explained.
Connor turned his head and looked at Rachel. He was still very grateful in his heart because if it wasn't for her, he wouldn't have thought of such a good method.
"Thank you!"
Connor said seriously.
"Why are you suddenly so polite to me? I didn't do these things for you, but for myself. Don't forget that my enemy is also Rockefeller…"
Rachel said casually.
"Haha…"
Connor looked at Rachel with a faint smile and then did not continue to say anything.
Ten minutes later, Connor sent Rachel home and drove to Stormbound Tower alone.
It was already past seven o'clock in the evening, but most of the employees were still working.
Connor went straight to Queta's office and told her about the plan he had discussed with Rachel.
"Mr. McDonald, I think this is the most feasible solution at the moment. Peyton Zook has already been sidelined in the Zook family. He must have already realized this in his heart. If we give him suitable conditions, he will definitely agree!" Queta said after hearing Connor's words.
"Since you don't think there's any problem, then let's do it this way. Can you find Peyton's contact information now?"
Connor asked.
"It should be possible. He's from the Zook family, so it shouldn't be difficult to find his contact information!"
Queta picked up her phone and dialed a number.

chapters.title: Chapter 1798: The One Who Killed Your Father
chapters.content:
Chapter 1798: The One Who Killed Your Father
A few minutes later, Queta gave Connor Peyton's phone number.
Connor didn't want to waste a second, so he called Peyton immediately.
"Ding, ding, ding…"
The phone rang for a long time before Peyton picked up.
"Who is it?"
Peyton wasn't in a good mood at the moment, so his tone was very rough.
"Mr. Zook, we met at the entrance of Yarlford University today. You won't forget me so quickly, right?"
Connor said with a smile.
When Peyton heard Connor's words, he could not help but be stunned for a moment. Then, he gritted his teeth and said, "Are you Connor McDonald?"
"That's right, it's me!"
"Why are you calling me? Let me tell you, we won't let you off for slapping me today!"
Peyton said in a low voice.
"Mr. Zook, stop pretending in front of me. Others may not understand you, but do you think I don't? You're just a small fry in the Zook family. I don't even care about Watson Zook, so why would I care about you?"
Connor said calmly.
"Did you call me today to humiliate me?" Peyton shouted excitedly.
"I'm not trying to humiliate you. I'm trying to help you!"
"Help me?"
Peyton was stunned for a moment, then asked in confusion, "What exactly do you want to help me with"
"You should know what happened at the Zook family's birthday banquet last time. The Zook family and I are in a state of irreconcilable enmity now. On top of that, the Gomez family also wants to kill me. Therefore, I want to deal with them…" Connor said slowly.
"This is your business. What does it have to do with me?"
Peyton asked in confusion.
"I want to deal with the enemy who killed your father. Don't tell me it has nothing to do with you?" Connor asked.
"McDonald, don't spout nonsense here!"
"You know very well whether I'm talking nonsense or not. You know very well how your father died back then and who killed him. But you're alone now and can't deal with them at all. Therefore, you can only choose to pretend that you don't know anything…" Connor said directly.
"What nonsense…"
Peyton's tone did not seem to be as tough as before, though.
"Mr. Zook, you know your current situation. Your grandfather still has 51% of the shares. This is your last chance. Once your grandfather dies, the entire Zook family will belong to Watson. Do you think Watson will still keep you by his side when that time comes?"
Connor said lightly.
"You…"
Connor's words left Peyton speechless.
"Mr. Zook, this is your best opportunity. If you cannot grasp this, you will never have the chance to turn the tables around in this lifetime…"
Peyton held his phone with a conflicted expression. He knew that Connor's words were very reasonable.
Hudson still had 51% of his shares that he hadn't handed over, so Watson didn't dare to do anything to him. Now, Watson would still send him money every month and let him be the general manager of Zook Cable Company's cable company. However, if Hudson died, it might not be possible for Peyton to survive.
Not to mention, Peyton wanted to avenge his father.
Peyton had never given up on revenge, but he was too weak; he was no match for the Gomez family and Watson combined. All these years, he could only pretend not to know anything.
"Mr. Zook, I have already said what I should say. As for what you plan to do, that is your business…"
Connor saw that Peyton didn't say anything for a long time and was about to hang up the phone.
"How do you plan to cooperate with me?" Peyton suddenly asked.
"Let's talk about the details of the cooperation face to face. Things might not be clear over the phone..."
"Alright, you decide on the time and place!"
Peyton said in a low voice.
"I'll contact you when the time comes!"
Connor replied happily and then hung up the phone.
After putting down the phone, Connor heaved a long sigh of relief and said, "As long as we can deal with this Peyton, the rest will be simple!"
"Mr. McDonald, Peyton Zook has agreed to cooperate, right?"
Queta asked excitedly.
"Does he have any other choice?"
Connor turned his head and glanced at Queta.
"That's great…"
Queta's expression was a little excited.
"Book a restaurant at seven o'clock tomorrow night. Then, the two of us will go and talk to Peyton about cooperation face-to-face…" Connor continued.
"Alright, I'll go and book a restaurant now!"
Queta quickly agreed.
After Connor saw Queta book a restaurant, he did not stay in her office. Instead, he stood up and left.
…
The next day, at seven o'clock in the evening.
Connor and Queta walked into the largest restaurant in Yarlford. After entering the restaurant, there was a waiter who was in charge of receiving them. He directly brought Connor and Queta to a private room.
Peyton had been waiting in the private room for more than half an hour.
Connor couldn't help but smile when he saw Peyton. From this, it could be seen that Peyton really wanted to cooperate with Connor.
"Mr. Zook, you came so early?"
Connor said to Peyton with a smile.
"I also just arrived…"
Peyton replied in a low voice.
"Mr. Zook, we got to know each other through fighting. There was a small misunderstanding at the entrance of Yarlford University previously. I hope you don't take it to heart!"
As the saying goes, one should not hit a smiling person. Connor saw that Peyton's attitude towards him was still very good, so he did not continue to give him a hard time.
"Mr. McDonald, that matter is already in the past. Moreover, I was the one who harassed your girlfriend. I was in the wrong, so let's not mention it!"
When Peyton saw that Connor had taken the initiative to apologize to him, his mood instantly improved a lot and he hurriedly replied with a smile.
"Alright, alright. Since you're not going to pursue this matter, I won't say anything more. What do you want to eat?"
Connor sat on the main seat while talking, while Queta chose to sit next to Connor.
"I'm fine with anything. Mr. McDonald, please order!"
Peyton handed the menu to him.
It was Connor's first time at this restaurant, so he didn't know what to order and ended up handing the menu to Queta.
Queta could read the room—she picked up the menu and walked out of the private room, leaving Connor and Peyton alone to talk.

chapters.title: Chapter 1799: I Have Nothing But Money
chapters.content:
Chapter 1799: I Have Nothing But Money
"Mr. Zook, the main reason why I met you this time is to talk about cooperation, so I don't intend to beat around the bush with you!"
Connor whispered.
"Mr. McDonald, how do you plan to cooperate with me?"
Peyton asked cautiously.
"Watson Zook is the man who killed your father. Moreover, the Gomez family was also involved in this matter back then, so Yamino naturally couldn't get away with it. Watson and Yamino are also in a state of irreconcilable hatred, so both of us have the same goal, which is to get rid of these two people!"
Connor said calmly.
"..."
Peyton couldn't help but gasp when he heard Connor's words. The expression on his face was a little strange.
After all, not many people in the entire country would dare to say that they could get rid of people like Watson and Yamino.
Of course, Peyton also knew that Connor was not joking at this time, because he did have the ability to do so.
"Mr. McDonald, if I really help you take down these two people, what can I get?"
Peyton asked the question he wanted to ask the most.
"It's very simple. I will support you in becoming the head of the Zook family. You will hold 10% of the Zook family's shares!"
Connor looked at Peyton calmly.
"Ten percent?"
Peyton was stunned when he heard Connor's words. Then, he smiled and said, "Mr. McDonald, are you joking with me? If I only get 10% of the shares after getting rid of Watson, wouldn't I be working for nothing?"
"If you don't cooperate with me, you won't even get this 10% share!"
Connor said lightly.
"That won't do. 10% of the shares is too little. Mr. McDonald, if you want to cooperate, then I don't think there's a need for us to cooperate anymore!"
Peyton did not seem to be able to accept this condition at all. He stood up and prepared to leave.
"Mr. Zook, you can leave now, but if you leave now, then still want to cooperate with me after, you can only have that 5% of shares!"
Connor did not fall for Peyton's trick at all. He still sat on the spot expressionlessly.
"..."
Peyton could not help but be stunned for a moment. He did not expect Connor to be so domineering.
"Let me help you analyze your current situation. Your position in the Zook family is already very precarious. Although you are the general manager of the Zook Cable Company in name, you are not the one who can make the controlling decisions. Watson has not touched you for so many years because Hudson is still alive. Hudson has 51% of the shares, but if he dies, Watson will definitely get rid of you immediately…"
Connor paused for a moment and then continued, "I admit that giving you 10% of the shares is indeed not much, but it's not too little compared to your current situation. Moreover, if it weren't for me, you might not even be able to get this 10%. In the end, you may be played to death by Watson, so you must think carefully before making a decision."
"Then the shares you gave me are too little…"
Peyton gritted his teeth.
"It's true that I gave you a little, but how much would Watson give you?"
Connor smiled and continued, "And don't forget that I'm making you the head of the Zook family. Although you only have 10% of the shares, you're still the head of the Zook family no matter what. You'll have the final say in the entire Zook family. Isn't this enough to attract you?"
Peyton gritted his teeth.
"Twenty percent!"
"You have no right to bargain with me!"
Connor said.
"..."
Peyton stared at Connor with his eyes wide open. His expression was very angry, but there was nothing he could do because Connor's attitude was too unyielding. It was as if he didn't give him any room for negotiation at all.
"Mr. Zook, if you think this kind of cooperation is unacceptable, you can leave now!"
Connor reminded Peyton.
"If I agree to your conditions, how do you plan to deal with Watson?"
Peyton asked in a low voice.
"You're a member of the Zook family, so I hope you can help me find some dirt on Watson so that someone can cause the Zook Cable Company's stock to plummet. In the end, your grandfather, Hudson, will save the situation. At that time, Hudson will definitely remove Watson's position as the head of the Zook family and let you become the head!"
Connor said.
"You want me to find dirt on Watson? Your request is surprisingly uncomplicated, isn't it?" Peyton said helplessly.
"You're a member of the Zook family. It shouldn't be difficult for you to find some dirt on Watson, right?" Connor said expressionlessly.
"You've already said it just now. I've already been sidelined by those people from the Zook family. I don't know much about them, and I can't get in touch with the people around Watson."
Peyton shook his head.
Connor narrowed his eyes and asked, "What if we use money to deal with the people around Watson?"
"Money?"
The expression on Peyton's face was a little strange.
"That's right, money!"
Connor nodded and continued, "According to my understanding, there were actually many people in the Zook family who supported your father back then. These people were also your father's trusted aides. It was only because your father died that they chose to stand on Watson's side."
"..."
Peyton hesitated for two seconds before saying, "The method you mentioned is indeed possible, but it might take a lot of money to bribe these people. I can't take out that much money now!"
"You don't have to worry about money. I, Connor McDonald, have nothing but money. As long as you can gather dirt on Watson, then no matter how much money you need, you can just contact Queta directly!" Connor said in a domineering manner.
"Really?"
Peyton's expression was a little excited.
"Do you think I would joke with you like this?"
Connor replied indifferently and then continued, "But I have to remind you that every sum of money I gave you will be used to bribe the people around Watson. If I find out that you used this money to do something else, I will definitely not let you off…"
"You don't have to worry about that. I don't lack money. I want to deal with Watson now!"
Peyton said excitedly.

chapters.title: Chapter 1800: What Wrong Would I Do?
chapters.content:
Chapter 1800: What Wrong Would I Do?
"If I give you enough money, how long will it take you to collect useful dirt?"
Connor asked.
"I can't guarantee this, but I estimate that I will be able to collect the dirt in less than three months. After all, those people around Watson are also working for him for money. As long as we take out enough money, I believe these people will definitely stand on our side!" Peyton replied after thinking for a moment.
"That's good!"
Connor lightly nodded.
An hour later, Connor and Queta left the hotel.
In order to prevent being discovered by the Zook family, Peyton left after the two of them.
Inside the car.
Queta turned to look at Connor and asked, "Mr. McDonald, what if this Peyton runs away with our money or joins hands with Watson to scam us?"
"You don't have to worry about that. I don't think Peyton has the guts to do that…" Connor replied indifferently and then continued, "I'll get someone to keep an eye on Peyton around the clock. If he does anything abnormal, I'll be the first to find out!"
In fact, Connor had also considered this problem; after all, he had not known Peyton for a long time. He could not guarantee that Peyton was 100% sincere in wanting to cooperate with him, so he specially asked Yama to follow Peyton around.
Peyton himself was not a martial artist, and Connor was very familiar with Yama's skills, so it was impossible for Peyton to discover that someone was following him!
After Queta heard Connor's words, she knew that Connor had a way to deal with Peyton, so she did not ask any more questions.
"Oh right, I've already promised Peyton that I'll provide him with funds, so if Peyton asks you for money, just give it to him and let me know…" Connor said.
"Alright!"
Queta nodded.
Connor looked at the scenery outside the window and did not say anything. Now, he had done everything he could. The last thing to do was wait for news from Peyton.
As long as Peyton could obtain some crucial evidence, Connor was confident that he could defeat Watson.
Although Watson was the head of the Zook family on the surface, he was not without any weaknesses.
Watson's real weakness was the 51% shares in Hudson's hands.
Connor's real plan was to let Peyton collect evidence of Watson first, then think of a way to make Hudson give his 51% shares to Peyton. This way, Peyton could replace Watson's position in the Zook family.
Although the plan was like this, Connor also knew that it was not easy to implement it.
However, it seemed that this method was the simplest and easiest way to deal with the Gomez family. It would be even more difficult to use other methods.
…
Half an hour later, Connor returned home.
It was already past nine o'clock in the evening, and Rachel had already returned from school.
Connor walked to Rachel's side and said, "I went to see Peyton Zook today…"
"How did it go?"
Rachel asked absent-mindedly as she ate her snacks.
"The discussion was not bad. Peyton has already agreed to cooperate with me, but I'm not sure whether he can help me collect useful evidence or not..." Connor said lightly.
"It is already very good that you managed such a thing. After all, you are not familiar with the people and places in Yarlford. It is not easy to deal with a large family like the Zooks…"
Rachel turned her head to look at Connor. In fact, she also knew that Connor was very anxious now. However, anxiety could not solve any problems.
Previously, Connor could easily solve the problems he encountered in Davenport or Orilon by relying on the connections left behind by Steven Lee. However, the person Connor had to deal with now was the general manager of Rockefeller in Oprana, Yamino Gomez. Therefore, some things were not as simple as Connor had imagined.
"Ding, ding, ding…"
Just as Connor opened his mouth to continue speaking, his phone suddenly rang.
Connor thought that Queta was looking for him for something, so he took out his phone to take a look. However, when Connor saw the name on the phone, he was stunned.
At this moment, the person who called Connor was actually Freya {hillips.
Freya rarely took the initiative to call Connor in order not to disturb him. Connor would only call her when he had nothing to do.
However, Freya had actually taken the initiative to call Connor, which meant that something must have happened.
Connor hesitated for a moment before taking the phone back to his room and answering the call.
"Connor, what are you doing? Why did you only pick up the phone now?" Freya asked with a smile.
