"I just met someone to talk about something and just got home. Why are you calling me?"
Connor asked with a smile.
"Can't I call you? Did you do something behind my back?" Freya asked jokingly.
"What wrong would I do…"
Connor replied awkwardly.
At this moment, whenever Connor thought of the women around him, he would have a headache. He did not want to do anything to let Freya down, but sometimes, he could not control his body.
He was also very conflicted.
"It's good that you didn't do anything wrong!"
Freya smiled and continued, "I called you today because I have something to tell you…"
"What is it?"
Connor asked.
"I might have to go to Europe tomorrow. My company has a project that I need to discuss in person. I wanted to ask if you have time," Freya asked tentatively.
"You want me to go to Europe with you?"
Connor understood Freya's meaning and asked with a smile.
"Yes, that's it!" Freya hurriedly nodded and continued, "Of course, it's okay if you don't have time. Actually, it's not a big deal for me to go to Europe this time. I'm just going to discuss a collaboration with someone. I thought that since the two of us haven't seen each other for a long time, I called you to ask if you could come over…"
"..."
When Connor heard Freya's words, he felt a little guilty. It had indeed been a long time since he went to see her.
Freya had suggested coming to Yarlford to meet Connor, but he had refused her suggestions.
This was not because Connor did not want to see Freya, but rather because the situation in Yarlford was very dangerous, so he didn't want to expose her to danger.

chapters.title: Chapter 1801: Going to Europe
chapters.content:
Chapter 1801: Going to Europe
"How long do you plan to stay in Europe?"
Connor asked after a moment of hesitation.
"It shouldn't be for long. At most, it'll be about a week!"
Freya replied after thinking for a moment.
"A week…"
Connor had just started working with Peyton. It could be said that this was the most crucial time to deal with the Zook family, so he was hesitant about accompanying Freya to Europe.
Freya saw Connor's hesitation and quickly said, "If you don't have time, then forget it. It's just a casual invitation!"
Connor thought for a moment before deciding to agree.
"It's okay. I haven't had anything to do recently. I'll book a plane ticket to Porthampton to see you later!"
"Really? Are you really going to Europe with me?"
Freya shouted excitedly.
"That's right. The two of us haven't seen each other for a long time, and I miss you too. I can take this opportunity to play with you…"
Connor said with a smile.
"That's great. I'll pick you up at Porthampton's airport tomorrow!"
Freya said happily.
"Good!"
Connor replied and then hung up.
After putting down his phone, Connor walked out of the bedroom and whispered to Rachel, "Well, I might have to go to Europe tomorrow. I guess I'll have to wait for a week before I can come back…"
"You don't have to report to me what you want to do. Just don't forget about the serious matters!"
Rachel didn't seem to care about what Connor was going to do, and casually replied.
"I'm not reporting to you. I'm just telling you that no matter what, the two of us are considered roommates!"
Connor said, exasperated.
"Roommates?"
Rachel couldn't help but smile when she heard these two words. She didn't continue to say anything.
Connor didn't bother with Rachel. He went back to his room and called Queta, telling her about his trip to Europe and asking her to book a plane ticket for him.
After dealing with these matters, Connor lay on the bed to rest.
"I've already done what I should do. The rest is to wait for news from Peyton. I can take advantage of this time to accompany Freya!"
Connor sighed and then closed his eyes to rest.
…
The next day, around 8 AM.
Connor boarded the flight to Porthampton.
Perhaps it was because of the incident with Aida last time, Connor had been very careful when he was on the plane, afraid that an assassin would attack him.
However, Connor's worries were unnecessary this time. Nothing unexpected happened until the plane landed.
After getting off the plane, Connor came to the airport lobby. At this time, there were many people in the lobby, but Connor found Freya in the crowd at a glance.
It had been a long time since they last met, but Freya was as sexy and beautiful as ever.
Today, Freya was dressed in a long white dress. Her long black hair was tied up high, revealing her fair and slender neck. Her exquisite face was covered with light makeup, and her perfect figure was faintly discernible under the contrast of the dress. Finally, with her noble temperament, she looked like a goddess descending to the mortal world.
Freya seemed to have seen Connor as well, and she ran towards him in her high heels.
A few seconds later, Freya rushed in front of Connor and gave him a big hug while being watched by everyone.
Connor wrapped his arms around Freya's slender waist and lowered his head to kiss her.
At this moment, many men were envious of Connor. If they could find a woman like Freya as a girlfriend, they were willing to live ten years less!
After some time, Freya used her small hands to gently push Connor away. Then, she blushed and whispered, "Are you trying to kill me?"
"I can't help it. I missed you too much…"
Connor laughed and replied with a sentence.
"You have a glib tongue. If I wasn't in Yarlford, who would know how many women you've hooked up with?"
Freya rolled her eyes at Connor.
Connor felt a little guilty after hearing Freya's words. He quickly changed the topic and asked, "Aren't you going to let me accompany you to Europe? When are we leaving?"
Freya took out her phone to check the time, then said, "The flight's at 3 p.m. in the afternoon. It's almost 2 p.m now, let's just wait here!"
"You're going to Europe without bringing anything?"
Connor couldn't help but ask when he realized that Freya didn't bring any luggage.
"My things are with my assistant. She will bring my luggage onto the plane!"
Freya said with a smile.
"So that's how it is!"
Connor nodded and continued, "Alright then, let's go find a place to rest now!"
"Alright!"
Freya was in a good mood when she saw Connor. She held his arm and led him to a cafe not far away.
After arriving at the cafe, they found a quiet spot to sit down.
Then, Freya roughly told Connor about what she had done recently. Her cosmetics company was doing quite well now, and she had already found a foreign investor. Freya's main purpose for going to Europe this time was to discuss collaborations. She planned to collaborate with a European cosmetics company and use that company's international influence to expand the popularity of her cosmetics brand.
"I didn't expect your company to have grown to such a scale in such a short period of time!"
Connor said in surprise.
"How is it? Aren't I awesome?"
Freya asked proudly.
Connor laughed.
"Yes, very awesome!"
Freya's expression changed slightly when she thought of Connor's matters. She asked, "How's the situation on your side? Is the Gomez family very difficult to deal with?"
"The situation on my side is alright. Although I can't make a move on Yamino Gomez for the time being, the situation isn't particularly bad. It's only a matter of time before I deal with Yamino Gomez!"
Connor said to Freya after hesitating for a moment.
"It's good that you're fine!"
Freya seemed to be relieved after hearing Connor's words. She picked up her phone to check the time and whispered to Connor, "We're about to board the plane. Let's go over together!"

chapters.title: Chapter 1802: The Auction
chapters.content:
Chapter 1802: The Auction
"Right!"
Connor nodded and left the cafe with Freya.
As Freya and Connor had booked first-class seats, there was a special passage for them to board the plane, so they didn't take too much time when boarding.
After boarding the plane, Freya did not continue chatting with Connor. Instead, she took out her laptop and started dealing with company matters.
Connor had nothing to do, so he could only close his eyes and rest.
When Connor opened his eyes again, more than three hours had passed.
He instinctively turned to look at Freya and realized that she was working.
Seeing her working so hard, he felt his heart ache.
"Your husband is already so rich. There's no need for you to work so hard, right?"
"Your money is the money of the understates, and it has nothing to do with me. I'm working so hard just to prove that I'm worthy of you. If you ever run into trouble, I hope I can help you!" Freya replied.
When Connor heard Freya's words, he felt even more touched.
Looking at Freya's exquisite face, Connor had already decided that he would hold their wedding as soon as he was done with the matters in Yarlford.
Although Connor had many women by his side, he loved Freya the most. Although his feelings for other women were real, he had never thought of marrying those women. The only woman he really wanted to marry was Freya.
Connor saw that Freya had been working hard, so he did not continue to disturb her. Instead, he closed his eyes and continued to rest.
…
The next day, around 8 AM.
Connor and Freya finally arrived in Europe.
After they got off the plane, there was a private car that sent them directly to the hotel.
The hotel that Connor Freya were staying at could be considered one of the most luxurious hotels in Europe. After all, Freya's company was worth at least a few hundred million dollars, so this small amount of money was nothing to her.
As for Connor, after seeing the environment inside the hotel, he could not help but sigh, "A few years ago, I might not have the courage to enter such a hotel. I might not even have the qualifications to be a attendant in such a hotel. However, when I look at this hotel now, I don't feel anything at all…"
"You're so rich. You definitely don't have any feelings for this kind of hotel!"
Freya replied.
"Are you hungry? Should we go eat something first and then rest?"
Connor knew that Freya had been dealing with company matters on the plane and had not slept for the entire night. She probably needed to get over the jet lag, so he took the initiative to ask for her opinion.
"No need, I'll go and rest first!"
Freya replied.
"Alright…"
Connor nodded and followed her into the room.
Freya was already exhausted after an entire day of toiling, so she took a simple shower before returning to her bedroom to rest.
Connor didn't have the heart to disturb Freya, so he practiced the Chi Refining Technique in the living room.
Because of the last battle with Zaki Serrano, Connor's aura had been unstable. Therefore, after returning to Yarlford, Connor had to take some time out to practice the Chi Refining Technique almost every day to stabilize his aura.
It was past four in the afternoon when Freya finally woke up and walked out of the bedroom in a daze.
"You're awake?"
Connor asked with a smile when he saw Freya coming out of the bedroom.
Although Freya had just woken up, she looked beautiful and charming. Her hazy eyes gave people a strange feeling of confusion.
"What time is it now?"
Freya walked to Connor's side and poured him a glass of water.
"It should be around four in the afternoon in Europe…"
Connor said lightly.
"What?"
Freya could not help but scream when she heard Connor's words.
Connor felt that Freya's reaction was a little off and could not help but ask, "What's wrong?"
"I have to attend an auction at five o'clock tonight. This auction is extremely important to me. If I miss it, I'll be dead meat…"
Freya replied, on the verge of a breakdown, before hurriedly running into the bedroom.
A few minutes later, Freya ran back with a suit in her hands. She said, "Hurry up and change into this, then follow me to the auction…"
"Do I have to go over too?"
Connor frowned.
"Of course you have to go…"
Freya didn't have time to explain too much. After saying this, she ran back to her room.
Ten minutes later, Freya walked out of the bedroom in a white dress.
When Connor saw Freya, he was stunned. At this moment, he could only use the word 'amazing' to describe this woman in front of him.
Freya walked up to Connor and helped him tidy up his suit. She said in satisfaction, "I didn't expect you to look so handsome in a suit…"
"You're also very beautiful!" Connor laughed and replied.
"Alright, let's not praise each other here. Hurry up and go downstairs. My assistant has already gotten a car and is waiting for us downstairs!"
Freya took the initiative to hold onto Connor's arm and followed him out of the room in her high heels.
A few minutes later, they got into a Mercedes-Benz.
The car was equipped with a special driver. Freya's assistant sat in the front passenger seat, while Connor and Freya sat in the back.
"Freya, I heard you say that this auction is very important. Why exactly is it important?"
Connor knew that Freya had come to Europe to discuss a collaboration, but he couldn't figure out what the collaboration between the companies had to do with this auction.
"You don't know this, but the organizer of this auction is the CEO of the company I want to cooperate with. He didn't organize this auction for the sake of it, but to test the financial strength of those who want to cooperate with their company. If you can spend more money on the auction, it will make others feel that your financial strength is not a problem, and it will be very helpful for the subsequent negotiations…" Freya explained.

chapters.title: Chapter 1803: It's That Valuable?
chapters.content:
Chapter 1803: It's That Valuable?
Connor frowned and asked, "You mean you're not the only one who wants to work with this company now?"
"If only I was alone…"
Freya couldn't help but sigh before continuing, "According to the information I have now, there are at least twenty cosmetic companies that want to compete with me. They all hope to work with Serena. After all, as long as we can work with Serena, it will have a huge impact on our cosmetic companies. No one wants to give up such a good opportunity…"
"The company you want to work with is Serena!"
Connor could not help but sigh.
"That's right!"
Freya nodded lightly.
Although Connor didn't know much about cosmetics, he had heard of the Serena brand. It was indeed one of the top companies in the world!
However, Selena had always been in the perfume business. Their perfume was known as the most expensive perfume in the world. Even some of the more famous international perfume companies could not compare to it. This company could be considered the true king of the perfume industry.
However, this company had always been in the perfume business and had never entered the cosmetics field.
Now, the company had set its sights on cosmetics and wanted to create a luxury cosmetic product. This led to many cosmetics companies fighting to cooperate with Serena.
Once this collaboration was successful, Freya's cosmetics company's market value would increase by more than ten times.
"Then what do you think the chances of your company working with Serena are?"
Connor asked Freya.
"I'm not very sure now. I came here with the intention of giving it a try…"
Freya smiled awkwardly.
In fact, Freya knew that her company did not have any advantage over her competitors, whether it was the size of the company, the influence of the brand, or even her personal relationship with the CEO. It would be very difficult for her to win this auction.
However, Freya had no intention of giving up. On the plane, she had been sorting out the information and doing her best to fight for it.
Connor turned his head and glanced at Freya. He could feel that she was very concerned about this opportunity. She was just acting very relaxed in front of Connor.
A moment later, the car slowly stopped in front of a building.
Connor and Freya got off the car and entered the building.
The interior of the building was decorated in gold and jade. It was obvious that those who could enter this building were either rich or noble, or even both.
Freya showed her invitation card to the attendant, who brought her and Connor into a hall.
As Freya and Connor had arrived rather late, there were already many people in the hall. However, most of them were foreigners.
Connor looked at the men and women in the hall and said in surprise, "There are so many people here to participate in the auction!"
"This is Serena's influence. 80% of these people are probably my competitors…"
Freya said helplessly.
"So many people?"
Connor was so shocked that he did not know what to say.
"That's right. When I came, I didn't expect that there would be so many people competing. If I had known that there would be so many people, I wouldn't have come…"
Freya said dejectedly.
"It doesn't matter. Just treat it as the two of us coming here for a vacation. It doesn't matter if we can't get Serena's cooperation!"
Connor said with a smile.
"That's true. I'll treat it as a vacation with you…"
Freya's mood seemed to improve after hearing Connor's words. She smiled happily.
"Let's go find a place to sit down!"
Connor said as he patted her shoulder.
"Alright!"
Freya nodded and brought Connor to her seat.
Perhaps it was because she knew that there was no hope of working with Serena anymore, so Freya no longer worried about these things. Her entire state of mind was clearly much more relaxed.
Connor casually picked up a picture album and started reading it.
This album introduced all the items that were going to be auctioned today.
Although Connor had participated in an auction before, it was his first time participating in such a huge auction. When Connor saw the collection in the album, he was stunned.
This was because almost all of the items here had a starting price of tens of millions. There were even items with a starting price of more than 100 million.
"These things are so valuable!"
Connor could not help but think.
"These things are all collectibles, so of course they are valuable…" Freya replied.
"Then do you have anything you like? I can auction it off and give it to you…"
Connor said with a smile.
"I originally thought that I would auction off one or two of my collections after working with Serena. After all, even if I buy these things, I can sell them. I won't lose too much, and I can also make the CEO of Serena's company have a good impression of me. However, now that I've given up on working with Serena, there's no need to go through so much trouble…"
Freya said with a smile.
Connor smiled, but he didn't say anything.
About ten minutes later, a middle-aged foreign woman walked onto the stage and greeted everyone in fluent English.
Connor's English was passable. At the very least, he had no problem understanding the host's words.
After the host got through the formalities, the auction officially began.
One item after another was brought out for auction. At the beginning, the items were not considered rare, and the prices were not particularly expensive. However, as time passed, the items brought out by the host became rarer and rarer, and the prices also became more and more shocking.
Even a simple painting was auctioned off at a price of 50 million. Connor really could not understand what these people were thinking.
In terms of money, almost no one present could be richer than him, but he would never take out 50 million to buy a painting because he really couldn't appreciate such things, nor could he understand their value.
Freya had completely given up on working with Serena, so she did not bid at all. She had been chatting with Connor and introducing the backgrounds of those items to him.

chapters.title: Chapter 1804: Serena Family
chapters.content:
Chapter 1804: Serena Family
In the blink of an eye, an hour had passed.
The long auction was finally coming to an end.
The host smiled and shouted at the crowd, "Alright, we're now at the most important part of our auction. This item is provided by the organizer of this auction and the general manager of Serena Corporation, Miss Monica. Now, let's invite Miss Monica up on stage to introduce the item to everyone!"
After knowing that the general manager of Serena Corporation was going to make an appearance, all the people present were very excited. After all, they came to this auction today for this woman.
A moment later, a beautiful woman in a black evening dress slowly walked onto the stage.
Connor instinctively glanced at the woman. This woman was indeed very beautiful. She had blonde hair and blue eyes. She was tall and sexy, and her face was exquisite and charming. She was like an angel in a TV series. She exuded the unique charm of a Europe woman. Moreover, this woman's temperament made people feel very noble.
"I didn't expect Serena's general manager to be so young!"
Connor whispered to Freya.
"Monica is the 13th generation heir of the Serena family. The Serena family has always passed down the line of inheritance to women and not men. Moreover, Monica's style of doing things is very radical. If she hadn't become Serena's general manager, Serena probably wouldn't have entered the cosmetics market!"
Freya explained.
"I see!"
Connor lightly nodded.
After Monica went on stage, she made some simple greetings with the crowd and then began to introduce her collection.
"This treasure was accidentally obtained by my Great-Grandma when she went to Oprana. My Great-Grandma thought that this treasure could protect our family, so it has always been regarded as a family heirloom by our family, ready to be passed down from generation to generation..." Monica said.
Everyone was shocked when they heard Monica's words.
This was because no one had expected Monica to take out the Serena family's heirloom for auction.
At this moment, a middle-aged man stood up and asked, "Miss Monica, why are you auctioning off such a valuable item?"
Monica couldn't help but smile after hearing the man's words. "See, some time ago, my grandmother had a dream. She dreamed that this treasure hoped to find its true owner, so my grandmother asked me to take this treasure out for auction. I hope to find a suitably fated person for this treasure. This way, I won't let it down for protecting our family for so many years…"
"What is it?"
"Yeah, what kind of treasure is this?"
Everyone seemed to be even more curious after hearing Monica's words.
"Everyone, wait a moment!"
At this moment, Monica suddenly shouted at everyone.
In an instant, the entire hall fell silent.
Monica waved at the attendant not far away.
Soon, the attendant brought an exquisite box onto the stage. Monica received the box respectfully and opened the lid.
When the lid was opened, everyone realized that the treasure Monica was talking about was just an ordinary amethyst pendant.
The amethyst pendant emitted waves of gentle light, giving people the feeling that it was not an ordinary amethyst pendant.
Connor sized up the amethyst pendant in the box, but he did not find anything special about it.
"I think this woman is lying here. Wasn't it just an ordinary amethyst pendant? Is there a need to make it sound so magical?"
Connor said to Freya, somewhat speechless.
"I don't know if Monica is lying, but I know that someone will definitely bid crazily later. Basically, whoever can get this amethyst pendant will be equivalent to getting the project with Serena…"
Freya whispered.
"Then how about I help you auction off this amethyst pendant?"
Connor hesitated for a moment before asking with a smile.
"There's no need. Even if you help me get this amethyst pendant, I might not be able to get this project. Moreover, this amethyst pendant shouldn't be very valuable. If you get it at an extremely high price, it would really be a little inappropriate…"
Freya shook her head without thinking.
Connor smiled when he heard Freya's words and didn't say anything.
In fact, Connor had already thought about helping Freya win the project with Serena. However, Connor was not sure if he could really help, so he did not tell Freya about this.
Of course, Connor also knew that if Freya knew about it in advance, she would definitely stop him. Therefore, Connor planned to tell her after this matter was settled.
"I've already introduced the origin of this treasure to everyone. Now, I'll get the attendant to bring this treasure down for a walk. Everyone can also observe it up close so that it'll be convenient for everyone to bid…"
Monica looked at everyone and continued.
After the attendant heard Monica's words, he walked off the stage with the box and began to shuttle between the crowd.
Connor and Freya were not interested in this pendant, so they did not go forward to take a look.
A few minutes later, the attendant passed by Connor with the box.
However, the moment the attendant passed by, Connor's expression instantly changed.
Because Connor felt that the pendant that Jorge gave him seemed to have some reaction.
Connor hurriedly took out his amethyst pendant from his clothes. At this moment, the pendant was actually emitting a faint light. However, this light was very subtle. If one did not observe it up close, it would be very difficult for ordinary people to see this light.
Connor himself was a martial artist, so he could easily observe the changes in the pendant.
Moreover, it was not only Connor's pendant that reacted at this time. The amethyst pendant in the box was also emitting light.
"Hello, can I take a look at this pendant?"
Connor hurriedly said to the attendant.
"Of course!"
The attendant smiled at Connor and then walked to Connor with the box.
When the attendant approached Connor, Connor could feel that the light emitted by the amethyst pendant was even stronger. However, the surrounding people did not notice the change in the pendant.
"Could it be that this amethyst pendant has something to do with the pendant that Jorge gave me?"
The expression on Connor's face was somewhat excited.

chapters.title: Chapter 1805: The Mysterious Amethyst Pendant
chapters.content:
Chapter 1805: The Mysterious Amethyst Pendant
Connor had been studying Jorge's amethyst pendant all this time.
However, he'd never been able to find anything out of the ordinary with it.
At this moment, the amethyst pendant in the box was reacting with Jorge's pendant. This could prove that his pendant was not an ordinary pendant.
The attendant saw that Connor was in a daze and asked, "Sir, are you done?"
"Yes…"
Connor nodded at the attendant.
The attendant smiled and left with the box.
Freya could sense that something was up, so she asked him, "Connor, what's wrong? Do you recognize this pendant?"
"I don't really know, but I feel that this amethyst pendant isn't any ordinary pendant. I'm going to buy it!" Connor said in a low voice.
"Buy it?" Freya could not help but be stunned when she heard Connor's words. Then, she hurriedly asked, "Connor, don't tell me you want to buy this pendant because of me?"
"This matter has nothing to do with you…"
Connor lightly shook his head.
Although Connor did have Freya's intentions in mind, the reason he wanted to buy it had nothing to do with her..
After all, even if Connor really bought off this pendant, it would increase Monica's favorability towards him, but would not really allow Freya to get this project. This was a solution that only treated the symptoms but not the root cause.
Connor wanted this jade because it had a reaction with Jorge's pendant.
At this moment, Monica suddenly asked, "Alright, has everyone seen it?"
"Yes!" everyone replied.
"The auction method for this amethyst pendant is different from other auctions. This pendant doesn't have a starting price. As long as you are interested in this amethyst pendant, you can provide us with a sum of money," Monica said to everyone.
When everyone heard her words, they were all stunned and began to discuss amongst themselves.
Although this auction method seemed unreasonable on the surface, Monica's choice to use this method could maximize her own interests.
If someone was really interested in this amethyst pendant, they would definitely write down the highest price they could afford. However, in order to ensure that there was no mistake, it was very likely that someone would offer a higher price. This would form a psychological war, and the price offered by those present would far exceed the bidding price.
If it was a normal auction, it would give everyone time to think.
However, if this was the bidding method, everyone would not have the time to think at all. They would immediately bid based on the highest price they could afford.
The attendant walked down the hall with the price list. Anyone who was interested in this amethyst pendant would take a paper slip and write down their price on it.
Connor hesitated for a moment before getting a slip from the attendant. However, when Connor got the slip, he hesitated because he didn't know how much he should write.
He hesitated for a moment before asking Freya, "How much money do you think these people will spend on this project?"
"Probably at most 100 million. If it exceeds 100 million, it will be a little inappropriate…" Freya replied.
"100 million!"
Connor's expression was a little shocked when he heard Freya's words. The 100 million that Freya was talking about was in US dollars!
Someone was willing to pay 100 million just to win Monica's favor. Connor felt that these people were really too crazy. If it was Connor himself, he would definitely not be willing to pay so much money.
However, Connor didn't want this amethyst pendant for Monica's project. Instead, he felt that the pendant that Monica took out likely had something to do with the pendant that Jorge gave him. That was why he wanted to get it.
Connor took a deep breath and wrote down his own price on the slip.
Freya looked at Connor's price list curiously and then froze on the spot. She said in disbelief, "Connor, are you crazy?"
"I have my reasons for offering this price, but you don't have to worry. I didn't spend this money because I want to help you win this project…" Connor explained with a smile.
Freya looked at Connor with a complicated expression. She could not understand why Connor would offer such a high price.
The price Connor wrote on the price list was 500 million.
After writing the price, Connor handed it to the staff.
The staff member was very professional. He didn't look at Connor's slip, but instead put it away.
After all, this was needed to protect the privacy of every customer. If Connor's price was exposed and the other customers knew, then things would be troublesome.
At this moment, there were about a hundred people in the hall. Almost everyone had bid on the amethyst pendant because they were all desperate for the project in Monica's hands.
The auction staff worked for about half an hour before they finally collected all the bids.
After collecting all the paper slips, the staff began to calculate who was the highest, all while the crowd waited nervously.
"Connor, why did you offer such a high price? I think that even if you want to buy that pendant, 200 million should be enough. You don't need to spend so much money at all…"
Freya asked Connor in confusion.
Connor smiled faintly when he heard Freya's words. He then said, "This amethyst pendant is extremely important to me. Therefore, I cannot allow any accidents to happen. I must ensure that I can obtain this pendant without any mistakes…"
"Is this pendant very important to you?"
A hint of confusion flashed across Freya's eyes, and the expression on her face became even more puzzled.
"Yes!"
Connor nodded lightly before continuing, "There are some things that I can't explain to you clearly now, but this amethyst pendant is really important to me!"
Freya looked at Connor helplessly. She knew that he definitely had his reasons for doing so.
However, he was not willing to tell them to her now, so she did not continue asking.

chapters.title: Chapter 1806: A Foreign Beauty
chapters.content:
Chapter 1806: A Foreign Beauty
Ten minutes later, Monica walked onto the stage again.
Everyone looked at the sexy and beautiful Monica on the stage with indescribable excitement on their faces because they knew that she was about to announce the results.
Monica looked at everyone and said, "I'm sorry to have made everyone wait for so long. I really didn't expect everyone to be so interested in the family heirloom of our Serena family. There were many people who bid, so it took a little longer to calculate the price. However, the results have been calculated now…"
."Miss Monica, don't keep us in suspense. Who exactly took this amethyst pendant?" a middle-aged man asked impatiently.
Monica smiled faintly when she heard this, then said, "Alright, then I won't waste any more time with everyone. The person who won this treasure today is Miss Freya Phillips!"
"Freya Phillips?"
"Who is that?"
In an instant, the entire hall fell into chaos.
Because Freya was not European, very few people in Europe knew her. When everyone heard her name, they were very confused.
Of course, there were also some people who looked incredulous.
"How is that possible? I offered 230 million, and someone actually offered more than me?" a middle-aged man shouted excitedly.
At this moment, another beautiful young woman in her forties said with a pout, "What is 230 million? I offered 300 million…"
"300 million and she didn't even get it. How much did this Freya Phillips bid?"
The expressions on everyone's faces seemed to be even more shocked.
Monica looked at everyone and asked with a smile, "Is everyone very curious now? How much did Miss Freya Phillips bid for this amethyst pendant?"
"That's right. How much did she spend?"
Everyone below hurriedly shouted.
Monica hesitated for a moment, then said, "Ms. Freya's bid this time is 500 million US dollars, so she has become the owner of this treasure!"
"My God, 500 million!"
"Where did this woman come from? She's so rich!"
In an instant, everyone's attention was on Freya, shock in their eyes. It was as if this number was too terrifying for them.
After all, in the eyes of these people, this amethyst pendant wasn't worth that much at all. They were only offering such a high price to please Monica.
However, there should be a limit to how much they could please Monica. Previously, Freya had estimated that these people would at most offer a price of 100 million. Some people even raised the price to 300 million in order to be safe.
However, no one had ever thought of directly raising the price to 500 million.
If they spent so much money, it would be difficult for them to earn it back even if they won the project with Monica.
At this moment, the auctioneer suddenly shouted. "Next, let's invite Miss Freya Phillips up on stage!"
Freya couldn't help but be stunned when she heard this. Then, she turned to look at Connor.
Connor nodded lightly at her, indicating that she could go up.
Freya's expression seemed a little nervous, but after hesitating for two seconds, she walked onto the stage.
The moment Freya stood on stage, everyone present finally knew who the person who spent 500 million USD to buy that amethyst pendant was!
Monica was extremely beautiful. If it was an ordinary beauty standing next to Monica, she would definitely look dull. However, Freya didn't feel that way when she stood next to Monica. On the contrary, the two women had their own advantages in terms of figure, appearance, and temperament. It was difficult to tell who was more beautiful.
Monica was a very standard beauty. She had blonde hair and blue eyes, giving off an exotic feeling, while Freya was a standard Opranian beauty, with an elegant temperament and delicate features.
Therefore, according to Connor's standards, Freya was more beautiful.
Perhaps beauty was in the eye of the beholder.
"Congratulations, Miss Phillips, for buying the Serena family's heirloom for 500 million. I hope this amethyst pendant will bring you good luck!"
Monica said to her.
When Freya heard Monica's words, a hint of hesitation flashed across her eyes. She then said, "Actually, this amethyst pendant was not bought by me. It was bought by my boyfriend…"
"So you already have a boyfriend, Miss Phillips?"
Monica was stunned for a moment, then she hurriedly said, "May I know who your boyfriend is?"
Freya turned her head and looked at Connor.
Monica seemed to have noticed Connor, who was sitting below the stage and hurriedly gestured for him to go on stage.
However, Connor smiled and shook his head. He had come to this auction today to accompany Freya. He had no intention of befriending Monica, so he did not plan to show his face in public.
Monica saw that Connor really didn't intend to go on stage, and her expression was a little strange. However, she didn't say anything and simply handed the amethyst pendant to Freya.
Freya took the amethyst pendant and returned to Connor's side.
Because the last treasure had been auctioned, the auction was over.
After the auction ended, Connor and Freya went backstage to make the payment.
Although the people who came to the auction today were all rich, some of the auction items were very expensive. The auction usually required the payment to be made on the spot. They would not allow the payment to happen the next day.
Although 500 million USD was a lot for ordinary rich people, it was not a lot for Connor.
Connor directly handed the Opranian Dragon Card that Thomas Morgan had given him to the staff member. A few seconds later, the staff member returned to Connor's side and told him that the payment had been made.
After paying, Connor planned to leave with Freya, but before the two of them could walk out of the building where the auction was held, a middle-aged man stopped Connor.
"Hello, Miss Phillips and Mr. McDonald!"
The middle-aged man bowed politely to Freya and Connor, a true example of European etiquette.

chapters.title: Chapter 1807: Meet Me?
chapters.content:
Chapter 1807: Meet Me?
"Hello, what's the matter?"
Connor sized up the middle-aged man and found that this man was just an ordinary person.
Moreover, he didn't seem to have any ill intentions towards him, so Connor's expression was very calm.
"Mr. McDonald, I'm Miss Monica's personal butler. Miss Monica is very curious about your investment of 500 million dollars to buy the Serena family's heirloom. She hopes to meet you at 2 p.m. tomorrow. I wonder if you have the time?"
The man's tone was very polite because he knew that since Connor was able to take out 500 million dollars to buy an amethyst pendant, this meant that he was definitely not an ordinary person, so he did not dare to offend him.
"She wants to meet me?"
Connor hesitated for a moment, then nodded and said, "Sure, I have something to ask her anyway. Where are we meeting tomorrow afternoon?"
"Mr. McDonald, tell me the hotel you're staying at. I'll get someone to pick you up tomorrow!"
The middle-aged man hurriedly said.
Connor didn't think too much about it and told the middle-aged man the location of the hotel where he and Freya were staying.
The middle-aged man left after exchanging a few words with Connor.
"I wonder why Monica wants to see you?" Freya muttered as she looked at the man's back.
"We'll know when we go over tomorrow. It's getting late. Let's go back too!" Connor replied indifferently before holding Freya's hand and walking into the distance.
Half an hour later, Connor and Freya returned to the hotel.
After returning to the hotel, Connor finally couldn't hold back his emotions and hugged and kissed her.
Freya had not seen Connor for a long time, so she naturally responded to him crazily.
The two of them kissed passionately in the living room, and Connor planned to take a step closer. He pulled on Freya's clothes and carried her towards the bedroom.
However, just as Connor was about to take off Freya's clothes, she suddenly reached out and pushed him away. "Connor, you can't…"
Connor was stunned for a moment before asking Freya in confusion, "Why not?"
"Well, I'm on my period…"
Freya looked at him shyly.
When Connor heard Freya's words, he fell into despair.
He had originally thought that since he had come to Europe alone with Freya, without Maya Phillips's interference, everything would be smooth sailing.
However, he had never thought that things would be so coincidental that her period just had to come at this time!
Connor sat by the bed and asked Freya in a depressed tone, "Are you lying to me?"
"Why would I lie to you?"
Freya pursed her lips and replied, before continuing, "I don't know why things are so coincidental either. I didn't think my period just had to come at this time…"
"..."
Connor watched as Freya seemed to grow despondent. "Connor, are you angry?" she asked.
"What's there to be angry about? Maybe it's just my bad luck!"
Connor sighed helplessly, then stood up and said, "Since you're on your period, I'd better stay away from you so that I won't be troubled by you…"
Freya laughed when she heard his words.
Connor suppressed the evil thoughts in his heart, then turned around and left the bedroom.
After leaving the bedroom, the more Connor thought about it, the angrier he got. He had already planned everything out, but who would have thought that things would be so coincidental?
Connor even suspected that Freya was playing with him.
However, it was useless for Connor to suspect her. If Freya really did not intend to sleep with him, he could not do anything about it.
Freya had been on the plane for an entire day and night, so even though she had taken a nap in the afternoon, she had not been able to catch up on her sleep. After Connor left the bedroom, she took a simple shower and fell asleep in bed.
Connor was alone in the living room, studying the amethyst pendant that he had bought from Monica.
Connor took out Monica's amethyst pendant and placed it on the table. Then, he took out the amethyst pendant that Jorge gave him.
When Connor put the two pendants together, they reacted and began to emit waves of gentle light.
Moreover, Connor also discovered that these two pendants originally did not have any patterns. They were completely purple.
However, when the two pendants were put together, a dragon pattern appeared on Jorge's pendant, while a phoenix pattern appeared on Monica's pendant.
"Are these two amethyst pendants a pair?"
The expression on Connor's face was somewhat excited.
After the dragon and phoenix patterns appeared, Connor was even more certain that these two amethyst pendants were definitely related.
However, he could not figure out how to use these two amethyst pendants after looking at them for a long time.
When Connor fought with Zaki Serrano, Jorge's dragon pendant had released a very powerful force, but he didn't know how to use it. This was what he was most concerned about.
If Connor could master how to use the dragon pendant, then his combat power would definitely increase by a level. Even ancient martial art grandmasters might not be able to threaten him at that point.
"Looks like I have to find a chance to ask Jorge what's going on with this amethyst pendant!"
Connor sighed and then put away the two amethyst pendants.
Last time, Jorge had disappeared after defeating Faris Jimenez. Connor had called Waverly and Thomas to ask about Jorge's whereabouts, but Jorge had never returned to the Purple Cloud Sect. Thomas had also searched the entirety of Porthampton, but could not find him.
In addition, Jorge didn't use anything like a phone, so Connor didn't know where he was at all.
After putting away the amethyst pendants, Connor went to the bedroom and found that Freya had fallen asleep. He took out his phone and dialed Chelsea Lee's number.
"Ding, ding, ding…"
After the phone rang twice, Chelsea picked up the call.
"Little Connor, what's the matter?" she asked.
"How did you know that I had something to tell you?" Connor asked with a smile.
"Why would you call me if there's nothing going on? Alright, if you have something to say, say it quickly. I'm busy here!" Chelsea said impatiently.

chapters.title: Chapter 1808: Monica's Manor
chapters.content:
Chapter 1808: Monica's Manor
"Well, I do have something I need your help with. I remember you said that you have a good relationship with people in Europe. Do you know anyone from the Serena family?"
Connor and Chelsea did not have much to say, so he went straight to the point.
"Anyone from the Serena family?"
When Chelsea heard Connor's words, she could not help but be stunned for a moment. Then, she pursed her small mouth and said, "Little Connor, don't tell me you've taken a fancy to the Serena family's eldest daughter, Monica? You want me to help you pull strings?"
"No, I have a project that I want to work on with the Serena family..."
Connor replied helplessly. Then, he told Chelsea about Freya.
"So that's how it is!"
Chelsea sighed after he understood what was going on.
"How is it? Can you help me with this?"
Connor asked directly.
"I can help you, but I'm not sure if I can help you 100%. Why don't I make a few calls and ask around for you? It'll be best if I can help you."
Chelsea replied.
"Alright, thank you!"
Connor said excitedly after seeing Chelsea agree.
"Don't be in such a hurry to thank me. I won't help you for nothing. I have a request!"
Chelsea said lightly.
"Request?"
Connor couldn't help but be stunned when he heard this. Then, he frowned and asked, "Do you have any requests?"
"My request is very simple. In a few months, I plan to bring you to the Yaeger family's birthday banquet!"
Chelsea said.
"What does the Yaeger family's birthday banquet have to do with me?"
Connor replied in a low voice.
"If you agree to attend the birthday banquet with me, I'll help you. If you don't agree, I won't help you!" Chelsea said firmly.
"..."
Connor hesitated for two seconds, then said in a low voice, "I'm not sure if you can help me, but help me with this first: if Freya's company can really get this project, I'll consider attending the Yaeger family's birthday banquet."
"Alright, then it's settled!"
Chelsea agreed happily.
"I'm hanging up first!"
Perhaps it was because Chelsea mentioned the Yaeger family, Connor was not in a good mood. After saying this, he hung up the phone.
Although Connor had agreed to Chelsea's request on the surface, Connor actually had no intention of attending Joseph Lee's birthday banquet at all. He only wanted Chelsea to settle Freya's matter first. Once Freya got the Serena family's project, he would go back on his word, and Chelsea could not do anything to him.
After putting down his phone, Connor walked straight into the second bedroom and lay on the bed to rest.
…
The next day, at eight o'clock in the morning.
Connor, who was sound asleep, was woken up by Freya.
When Connor opened his eyes, he realized that Freya had already changed her clothes and put on makeup. She looked very exquisite and beautiful.
Connor stretched his back and asked, "Are you going out?"
"That's right. I specially came over to tell you so that you won't have to worry about me when you wake up and can't find me…" Freya replied.
"What are you going out for?"
"I'm going to meet with a few European clients. Although I don't have much hope for the Serena family's project now, I can't come to Europe for nothing this time. My friend introduced me to a few bosses who do cosmetics business in Europe, so I plan to meet them and see if I can expand our company's market here…"
Freya explained.
"Then how long will it take for you to come back? Aren't we going to meet Monica in the afternoon?"
Connor asked.
"I might not be able to come back in the afternoon. Besides, the person Monica wants to see is you, not me. I won't go."
Freya said calmly.
"Haha…"
Connor couldn't help but laugh when he heard Freya's words. Then, he said jokingly, "Then aren't you worried that Monica and I will run away?"
"Tsk, if you really have this ability, then I'll admire you!"
Freya rolled her eyes and was about to continue speaking when her phone rang.
She took out her phone and glanced at it. Then, she muttered to Connor, "Alright, I won't talk to you anymore. You can continue to rest. My driver has already arrived at the hotel entrance."
Connor nodded. "Alright, then go to your place!"
Freya gave him a light peck on the cheek before turning to leave.
After she left, Connor lay on the bed alone and slept for a while, only waking up at 10 a.m.
When he woke up, Connor began to cultivate the Chi Refining Techniqye.
In the blink of an eye, it was already past one in the afternoon.
It was about time for him to leave now, so Connor changed his clothes and left the hotel.
Connor had just walked out of the hotel when he saw a black Rolls-Royce slowly driving towards him.
A few seconds later, the car stopped beside Connor. The middle-aged Europe man who spoke to Connor yesterday got out of the car and said respectfully, "Hello, Mr. McDonald!"
"What a coincidence. I just went downstairs and you're already here…"
Connor looked at the man and smiled.
"I've been waiting here for a long time!" the man explained and then took the initiative to help Connor open the car door.
He didn't think much about it and directly got into the car.
Connor didn't talk to the middle-aged man after getting into the car. Instead, he quietly looked at the streets outside. The street scenery in Europe was very good. There were well-built architectural buildings everywhere, and the streets were very clean, giving off a very hospitable feeling.
This was Connor's first time in Europe, so he was very curious about many things in the city.
About half an hour later, the car drove into a manor.
This manor wasn't the manor of the Serena family, but Monica's private manor.
The manor covered an area of nearly 10 hectares, including two underground wine cellars, a garden, three swimming pools, a golf course, and a large forest. According to Butler Monica's introduction, there were many precious things raised in the forest, which were usually prepared for guests who liked to hunt.
Monica usually didn't live here. She would only come here when receiving very important guests; after all, this manor was a little too big, and it would take a long time to drive from the villa to the main gate. It was not suitable for Monica to live normally.

chapters.title: Chapter 1809: Golf
chapters.content:
Chapter 1809: Golf
The environment within the manor was very good. Connor sat in the car and listened to the butler's introduction of the manor while admiring the scenery.
A moment later, the car arrived in front of a golf course.
The butler took the initiative to get out of the car and help open the car door. Then, he muttered, "Mr. McDonald, Miss Monica is here. You can go over now!"
"Thank you so much!"
Connor nodded at the butler and then directly stepped out of the car.
After getting out of the car, Connor noticed that Monica was wearing a set of white sportswear and swinging the golf club in her hand.
Monica's figure was already very good. When she put on the tight-fitting sportswear, her graceful and sexy figure was even more obvious. Coupled with her exquisite face that was full of exotic charm, it gave Connor, who was usually used to seeing Opranian beauties, a different kind of feeling.
Connor walked towards her.
Monica didn't seem to notice that he had already come over. She continued to swing the club in her hand.
Connor didn't have any intention of disturbing Monica and stood quietly behind her.
After playing a few rounds of golf, Monica seemed to be unsatisfied with her results and turned around to rest, but when she turned around, she found Connor standing behind her.
Monica was stunned for a moment when she saw Connor and quickly said with a smile, "Mr. McDonald, you're here?"
"I just arrived. I saw that you were having so much fun, so I didn't want to disturb you!"
Connor replied.
"I'm really sorry. I was a little engrossed in the game just now and didn't notice you, Mr. McDonald!" Monica smiled awkwardly. Then, she sized up Connor and said, "Mr. McDonald, why didn't your girlfriend, Miss Phillips, come along?"
"She went to deal with other things!"
Connor replied.
"Oh, I see!"
Monica nodded lightly. She did not continue to press further, but said, "Mr. McDonald, do you usually play golf?"
"Not really…"
Connor lightly shook his head and smiled, "I'm not very interested in sports that rich people like yourself tend to like!"
"Rich people like us?"
Monica couldn't help but purse her lips and smile when she heard Connor's words. She then said, "Mr. McDonald, you are really humble. Mr. Steven Lee was also very famous in Europe back then, and many of our European companies have shares of his companies. You're Mr. Lee's heir, but you actually said that I am rich? You're making fun of me on purpose!"
"Before I inherited Steven Lee's inheritance, I was just an ordinary person!" Connor explained.
"I see!"
Monica nodded gently, then took the initiative to pass the golf club to Connor and said, "Mr. McDonald, do you want to try? If you're interested, I can use this afternoon to teach you for free…"
Monica had obviously investigated Connor's identity, so her attitude towards him was very good.
"No need. I'm not interested in this kind of thing because it's not difficult for me!"
Connor shook his head at Monica.
"Not difficult, you say?"
Monica couldn't help but frown slightly when she heard Connor's words. The expression on her face seemed a little strange.
Golfing was indeed Monica's favorite sport, but she felt that Connor's words were a little too arrogant. Although he was probably joking with her, Monica didn't really like such jokes.
In Monica's eyes Opranian people had always been very humble. This was also the reason why she liked to make friends with them.
However, Monica did not see such a quality in Connor. At this moment, she even regretted inviting him over.
"Any sport has its charm. You're free to dislike it, but you should respect it!"
Monica originally had a good impression of Connor, but at this moment, she was already prepared to ask him to leave her manor.
"Miss Monica, do you think I'm disrespecting golf by saying that this sport is not difficult for me?" Connor asked with a smile.
"I think Mr. McDonald is joking, but I don't like it!"
Monica was European, and as such was rather direct with her words.
"I'm not joking with you!"
Connor walked straight to Monica's side and took the club from her hand.
"..."
Monica looked at Connor with a puzzled expression. She didn't understand what he wanted to do.
Connor simply swung the club and asked, "Miss Monica, the rule of golf is to find a way to hit the ball into the hole, right?"
"That's right!"
Monica nodded lightly.
Connor observed the surrounding situation and found that there was a hole less than 50 meters away from him. There was a small flag inserted at the hole to make it easier to see the position of the hole.
Connor took a deep breath and swung his club.
"Bang!"
The club hit the golf ball.
Monica quickly looked up and was stunned the next second.
The golf ball fell into the hole in a perfect arc.
The ball was at least 50 meters away from the hole.
Even a professional golf player might not be able to score a hole-in-one at such a distance!
However, Connor had just easily hit the ball into the hole. Although his movements were not very standard, the ball did go into the hole.
"This... How is that possible?"
Monica's expression seemed to be in disbelief. She secretly thought that Connor's luck was too good. One shot could not prove anything; after all, this kind of thing could happen very easily.
Even if Connor wasn't lucky, he had no right to say that golf wasn't difficult for him.
Connor also saw through Monica's thoughts. He smiled faintly and waved at the caddie not far away.
The caddie quickly ran to Connor with a golf ball and placed it on the ground.
"Miss Monica, the cave entrance just now was a little close. Is it a little further?"
Connor asked.
Monica only came back to herself when she heard Connor's words. She hurriedly pointed at the cave entrance in the distance and said, "Mr. McDonald, if you want to challenge a further distance, that hole is 100 meters away from where we are now. Even a real professional golf player is not 100% sure that he can hit it in one shot…"
"Then I'll give it a try!"
Connor replied indifferently and then observed the cave entrance in the distance.

chapters.title: Chapter 1810: Two Reasons
chapters.content:
Chapter 1810: Two Reasons
"Bang!"
Connor swung the club in his hand.
This time, the golf ball accurately fell into the hole again.
Monica couldn't believe her eyes, because she might have thought that Connor was just lucky and got a hole-in-one.
However, that swing was from a distance of 100 meters!
Under normal circumstances, a person who had never played golf might not be able to hit such a long distance, let alone hit a hole in one.
Two consecutive hole-in-one shots made Monica vaguely feel that Connor's previous words might not be as simple as a joke.
At this moment, Connor asked again, "Are there any further holes?"
"Mr. McDonald, do you want to go even further?"
Monica asked with a shocked expression.
"I want to prove to you that I wasn't joking when I said that this sport wasn't difficult for me!"
Connor replied indifferently.
Monica hesitated for a moment, then pointed to the edge of the field and said, "Mr. McDonald, that hole is about 300 meters away from us. You can try!"
"Three hundred meters?"
Connor narrowed his eyes and looked at the sky, then said, "Alright, I'll give it a try!"
After saying this, he did not make any preparations at all and directly swung his club.
But this time, Connor didn't consider the wind speed, so the golf ball landed less than five meters away from the hole.
However, the golf ball did not stop after landing. Instead, it slowly rolled into the hole.
"Oh my god!"
Monica covered her mouth with an expression of disbelief. At this moment, she felt that everything was so unreal.
The Guinness World Record for the furthest hole-in-one in golf was only 400 meters.
Connor's shot was 300 meters.
He had made three consecutive shots without a single failure. All of them were hole-in-one shots.
At this moment, Monica finally believed what Connor said just now.
For Connor, golf was really not a difficult sport!
"Mr. McDonald, I want to take back what I said to you before!"
Monica hurriedly apologized.
"It's alright!"
Connor put down his golf club and replied indifferently.
Monica walked to Connor's side and said, "Mr. McDonald, have you really never played golf before? You must be lying to me, right? You must have undergone professional training!"
"This is my first time playing golf. I haven't had any training. This thing is not difficult for me!"
Connor said. He couldn't tell Monica that he could even change the direction of a bullet, so he could naturally change the direction of the golf ball.
As long as he calculated the distance and used the appropriate amount of strength, he could use his breath to change the direction of the ball and ensure that the ball could enter the hole in one shot every time.
However, because the last shot was far away and there was the influence of the wind, Connor used a little less strength and let the ball fall to the ground early.
Monica felt that Connor didn't seem to want to tell her this, so she didn't continue to ask any further.
"Mr. McDonald, please wait for me in the villa's dining room for a while. I'll go change my clothes..."
Monica muttered.
"Good!"
Connor lightly nodded.
Monica's butler took the initiative to walk in front of Connor and brought him to a villa in the manor.
After entering the villa, Connor found that the interior was decorated in a European style. It looked very luxurious, and there were all kinds of servants shuttling back and forth in the villa.
Although Monica didn't live here often, there were servants on duty almost 24 hours a day.
Connor and the butler came to the dining room. Connor sat on a chair and waited quietly.
About half an hour later, Monica appeared in front of Connor in a long black dress and said to the butler, "The dishes can be served now!"
"Yes, Miss!"
The butler hurriedly nodded and began to order the servants to serve the dishes.
A few minutes later, the dining table was filled with all kinds of sumptuous dishes, but most of them were western cold dishes such as steak, foie gras, caviar, etc., so Connor was not very interested in these dishes.
Monica took the initiative to pour a glass of red wine for Connor and said, "Mr. McDonald, this is the red wine brewed by the Serena family. It has been stored in the wine cellar for more than a hundred years."
"I don't really know how to drink red wine…"
Connor replied indifferently, but he picked up the wine glass and took a sip.
"How is it?"
Monica asked with a smile.
At this moment, Monica didn't dare to underestimate Connor. After all, he had just said that he didn't know how to play golf. However, Monica was completely shocked by him on the golf course. When she changed her clothes just now, the three shots that Connor had played kept appearing in her mind.
"It's not bad!"
Connor replied, then put down his wine glass and asked, "I wonder why you invited me over today, Miss Monica?"
Monica looked up at him and said very directly, "Actually, I invited you here for two main reasons. The first is to get to know you; after all, you are Mr. Steven Lee's heir."
"What's the other reason?"
"The second reason is that I want to ask you why you were willing to spend so much money to buy that amethyst pendant."
"..."
Connor hesitated for a moment, but did not say anything.
"I know that you were different from the others at the auction yesterday. The reason why they wanted to buy that amethyst pendant was to please me and then get the Serena family's cooperation on a project. However, you, Mr. McDonald, probably don't have this motive in mind, so I'm very curious!" Monica continued to explain.
"Before I answer your question, I have something to ask you!"
Connor said.
"What is it? Mr. McDonald, you can ask directly. If I can answer, I won't hide anything!"
Monica elegantly took a sip of red wine as she cut the steak on her plate.

chapters.title: Chapter 1811: The Origin of the Pendant
chapters.content:
Chapter 1811: The Origin of the Pendant
"I want to know the true origin of this amethyst pendant!"
Connor said in a low voice.
"The true origin of this amethyst pendant?"
After Monica heard Connor's words, she couldn't help but be stunned for a moment, then she said, "Why are you curious about this?"
"Because I feel that this amethyst pendant seems to have some kind of connection with me!" Connor said lightly.
"As far as I know, this amethyst pendant was accidentally obtained by the founder of the Serena family, my great-grandmother, when she went to Oprana. It seems to have been given to her by a noble person, but as for how Great-Grandma got this amethyst pendant and who gave it to her, I'm not very clear..." Monica slowly explained.
"Does that mean that this amethyst pendant belongs to Oprana?" Connor frowned and asked.
"You can say that!"
Monica nodded.
"Then do you know anything else about this amethyst pendant?"
Monica shook her head. "No, I don't know anything else…"
".."
Connor narrowed his eyes and looked at her without saying anything.
If what Monica said was true, then it meant that the amethyst pendant that Jorge gave Connor was likely obtained through some method. These two amethyst pendants should have existed for at least a hundred years.
But Monica's words didn't help Connor solve the secret of these two pieces at all because she didn't know how her great-grandmother got this amethyst pendant.
"Mr. McDonald, you seem to be very curious about this amethyst pendant?" Monica asked.
"From the first time I saw this pendant, I felt something pulling me to it. Or rather, I felt that there was some telepathy between me and this pendant, which is why I spent so much money to buy it!"
Connor couldn't completely trust Monica. After all, he had only met this woman twice, so he couldn't tell her everything about him.
"I see!"
Monica nodded lightly.
Connor didn't continue to talk about this topic and started to talk about other things with Monica.
She was very knowledgeable and seemed to be very interested in any topic, so she and Connor had a very harmonious meal.
However, just as the two of them were halfway through their meal, the butler rushed to Monica's side and muttered something to her.
Monica's expression changed when she heard the butler's words. Then, she stood up and said, "Mr. McDonald, I'm really sorry. I have a very important call that I need to answer. I'll have to trouble you to wait for a moment!"
"It's okay. You can go!"
Connor lightly nodded.
Monica smiled apologetically when she heard Connor's words. Then, she stood up and walked out of the dining room.
A few minutes later, Monica went to a room. The butler handed her the phone.
"Hello, Mr. Mark!"
Monica said respectfully.
A middle-aged man's voice came from the other end of the line. "Monica, I heard that the Serena family is going to start a cosmetics project recently?"
"That's right. Mr. Mark, do you have any companies to recommend?"
Monica was a very smart woman. She knew very well why the other party took the initiative to ask about this matter.
"If that's the case, I have a friend from Oprana who called me yesterday. She said that her friend seems to be planning to cooperate with your Serena family. I called you to ask whether you've already started collaborating with another company!" the other party said slowly.
"Our family plans to hold a public bidding for this collaboration. The bidding will be held in three days, so we haven't made the final decision yet. If you have any recommendations, you can tell me. I can help you keep an eye on this company!" Monica hurriedly said.
"The boss of the company that my friend recommended to me is Opranian. Her name is Freya Phillips."
The other party did not seem to be polite and directly said Freya's name.
"Miss Phillips?"
The expression on Monica's face was a little shocked.
"You know this person?" the other party asked.
"We don't really know each other, but we've met once. Moreover, Miss Phillips's boyfriend is having dinner with me right now!" Monica replied.
"That's great. Since you all know each other, this matter should be much easier to handle, right?"
The other party smiled.
"Mr. Mark, since you've taken the initiative to call me, I'll definitely consider your request. Don't worry, as long as there's no problem with Miss Phillips's company, I'll try my best to persuade the rest of my family to work with her!"
Monica said with a smile.
"Alright!"
The other party simply agreed and then hung up.
Monica looked at her phone with a shocked expression. She did not expect Connor's power to be so terrifying that he could directly contact the Mark family.
The Mark family was considered a top-notch family in Europe—even the Serena family was inferior to the. Moreover, many of the Serena family's businesses needed the Mark family to take care of them, so Monica would definitely not ignore them..
Monica recomposed herself and returned to the dining table.
"Mr. McDonald, I'm really sorry to have kept you waiting!" she smiled.
"It's alright…"
Connor replied calmly.
"Mr. McDonald, the person who called me just now was Mr. Mark. I didn't expect you to know him. If I knew earlier, you wouldn't have to go through so much trouble to contact him!" Monica continued.
"Mah Ke?"
Connor was stunned for a moment, and the expression on his face seemed to be somewhat puzzled.
"Didn't you contact Mr. Mark and ask our Serena family to give the cosmetics project to Miss Phillips's company?"
Monica was also puzzled when she saw his reaction.
".."
Connor sized Monica up and said, "I don't know this Mah Ke guy you just mentioned, but I did ask my friend to help me with this. My girlfriend came for your family's project!"

chapters.title: Chapter 1812: More Friends
chapters.content:
Chapter 1812: More Friends
"I see!"
Monica nodded, then said with a smile, "Actually, Mr. McDonald, if you really want to help your girlfriend, you can tell me about this personally. There's no need to look for anyone else!"
"If I were to mention this to you, it would be equivalent to me owing your Serena family a favor. Moreover, you've only met me twice and eaten a meal with me today," Connor said slowly.
"That's true. After all, many people are eyeing this project now. With our relationship alone, I really can't give this project to Miss Phillips internally!"
Monica also nodded very frankly and continued, "But since Mr. Mark has already called me, I definitely can't ignore him. Mr. McDonald, don't worry. I'll cancel the bidding in three days and sign the contract with Miss Phillips directly!"
"There's no need to cancel the bidding!" Connor hurriedly said.
"Why?"
Monica's expression was a little puzzled.
"My girlfriend doesn't want me to use my connections to help her, so you can hold this auction as usual and assess all the companies according to the actual situation. If you think that my girlfriend's company isn't too different from other companies, then sign a contract with her. If you think there's a more suitable choice, then you can also sign a contract with other companies!"
Connor did not want to make things too obvious because he understood Freya's character. She definitely did not want to receive his help at this time.
Monica understood Connor's meaning and said with a smile, "Miss Phillips is really a strong-willed woman. She already has an outstanding boyfriend like Mr. McDonald, but she's still so hardworking. Moreover, you seem to love your girlfriend very much, Mr. McDonald. I envy the two of you!"
"My girlfriend's company has just started to improve. I don't want to hurt her at this time, so I have to ask you not to be too obvious!" Connor said slowly.
Monica nodded. "Mr. McDonald, don't worry. I know what to do!"
"Thank you so much!" Connor stood up and continued, "If there's nothing else, I won't disturb you anymore."
"Mr. McDonald, I've already asked someone to transfer back the 500 million USD you spent on the amethyst pendant. Just treat that amethyst pendant as my gift to you!"
Monica said, also standing up.
"Isn't this gift a little too expensive?" Connor asked, stunned.
"500 million US dollars may be a huge sum of money for ordinary people, but it shouldn't be a big sum of money for the Serena family or you. However, if we can use this opportunity to let the Serena family be friends with someone like you, it's very cost-effective!" Monica explained with a smile.
"Friends?"
Connor smiled faintly, the expression on his face somewhat strange, but he did not refuse. After all, Monica was the one who took the initiative to express her goodwill to him. It was not a bad thing to have more friends, so hewould not refuse.
A few minutes later, Connor got into the car accompanied by Monica and was sent directly to his hotel entrance.
Originally, Connor went to see Monica today to ask her about some things related to the amethyst pendant. However, because this amethyst pendant was too old, and Monica's great-grandmother had passed away long ago, he did not get any useful information at all.
Although they did not find any clues about the amethyst pendant, Connor had settled the matter with Freya's company, so it was not a wasted trip today.
When Connor returned to the hotel, he found that Freya had already returned. She was sitting on the sofa alone and looking at her laptop. Her expression did not seem very happy.
"Connor, you're back?"
When Freya heard the sound of the door opening, she quickly ran to his side.
Connor could feel that she was in a bad mood, so he took the initiative to ask, "How was your meeting with the clients today?"
Freya could not help but sigh when she heard his words.
When Connor saw that, he knew what was going on. "What's wrong? It didn't go very well?"
"Don't mention it. It didn't go very smoothly. After I met these people, they all asked me about the collaboration with the Serena Family. If I can't get the Serena Family's project this time, they won't choose to collaborate with me…" Freya said dejectedly.
"Those people are greedy. Sooner or later, they will regret it…" Connor said with a smile.
"Actually, it's not that they look down on others. They're not wrong to decide this; after all, these people are all businessmen. They will definitely put their interests first…"
Freya looked at Connor helplessly, as if she was comforting herself.
"You don't have to be too sad. After all, the Serena family's auction hasn't ended yet. It's uncertain who will get this project in the end!"
Connor hesitated for a moment, but didn't say that he had already helped Freya settle this project.
"Even if the auction is not over, my company has no hope. I heard that a very large cosmetics company in Europe is also competing for this project, and the boss of this company has a very good relationship with Monica of the Serena family…"
Freya paused for a moment before raising her head to look at Connor. She asked, "By the way, how was your meeting with Monica today? What did you two talk about?"
"We didn't talk about anything. She just asked me why I paid so much money to buy that amethyst pendant!" Connor replied.
Freya blinked and asked with a puzzled expression, "Yeah, actually, I don't understand why you suddenly paid so much money to buy that amethyst pendant. What does that pendant mean to you?"
Connor knew that there were some things that he couldn't explain to Freya, so he didn't say much. Instead, he took out Monica's phoenix pendant and handed it to her. "You can also understand it this way…"
"What do you mean?"
"I think this amethyst pendant suits you very well. You should always carry it with you. It might bring you good luck!" Connor said with a smile.

chapters.title: Chapter 1813: The Auction
chapters.content:
Chapter 1813: The Auction
Although Connor had yet to figure out the origin of these two amethyst pendants, he had already seen the power of the dragon pendant.
Moreover, he couldn't find Jorge now, so he planned to have Freya take care of the Phoenix Pendant first. Perhaps it could protect her at a critical moment.
"Bring me good luck?"
Freya couldn't help but laugh when she heard his words. She then extended her hand to take the pendant and placed it in her palm to carefully observe it. She said, "If only this amethyst pendant could let me get the Serena family's project..."
"Maybe it really can!"
Connor said lightly.
"If that's really the case, then I must thank you properly!"
Freya seemed to be in a much better mood. After accepting the pendant, she stood up and returned to her bedroom.
Connor knew that Freya was on her period, and he couldn't do anything even if he went to the bedroom with her. Being unable to do anything with such a beauty by his side was a form of torture for Connor, so he didn't choose to go into the bedroom with Freya.
Instead, he went to the guest bedroom alone.
The next day, at nine o'clock in the morning.
After Connor and Freya woke up, they went straight to the hotel's restaurant for breakfast.
Connor felt that the European atmosphere was very good, but the only thing that made him dissatisfied was the food. There were too few Opranian dishes, and even if there were, they were not very delicious. This was a big torment for Connor who was used to eating Opranian food.
"What are you planning to do today?"
Connor asked while he ate spaghetti while gazing at the charming Freya in front of him.
"For what?" Freya hesitated for two seconds before saying, "I don't have any work arrangements today. Why don't you accompany me for some shopping?"
Freya was a girl who loved to look beautiful, so she naturally liked to go shopping. However, she didn't have time to go because of work.
Connor was definitely not interested in things like shopping, but he felt that he had indeed been neglecting Freya recently. He had not been able to accompany her properly, so after thinking for a moment, he nodded gently. Then, he smiled and said, "Alright, since you want to go shopping, I'll go with you…"
"You're agreeing so easily?"
Freya asked in surprise after hearing his words.
"That's right. Besides, I came to Europe this time to accompany you. I'll do whatever you want to do…" Connor said with a smile.
Freya was as happy as a little girl as she said excitedly, "That's great. Let's eat quickly and go shopping!"
Connor smiled, not saying anything.
Half an hour later, Connor and Freya arrived at the most famous shopping mall in Europe.
This mall was very famous on a global scale, and the things inside were all very expensive. Ordinary people might not have the courage to enter.
However, there was no pressure on Connor here; after all, he was a top-notch tycoon who could casually spend 500 million USD to buy an amethyst pendant. He did not lack money at all.
Freya's company's annual profits were also very good, so even if she did not want Connor to pay the bill, she could afford it herself.
Connor ended up following Freya around the mall for an entire day. Not only did she buy a lot of clothes for herself, she also bought a few sets for Connor.
As this mall only served rich and important customers, the service provided was also very good. You only needed to pay and leave your address with the attendants, and someone would deliver the clothes to you that night. Therefore, Connor did not need to be Freya's personal bag carrier—he just needed to follow Freya around.
After the two of them strolled around the mall for a day, Freya brought Connor to a very famous European bar to taste the cocktails made by the world's top bartenders.
For the next two days, Connor and Freya had a good time relaxing and went to all the more famous scenic spots.
Connor and Freya had been together for a long time, but the two of them spent most of their time apart. This time, the two of them could be considered to have made up for the regret of not seeing each other often.
Moreover, Connor was relatively relaxed in Europe because he knew that no matter how terrifying the power of the Gomez family was, they would never use Rockefeller's power in Europe to deal with him. Therefore, he didn't need to worry about being chased by the Gomez family.
Freya seemed to be enjoying the vacation as well.
Two days later, the Serena family's auction conference was finally about to begin.
Initially, Freya did not plan to participate in this auction because she felt that even if she went, there would be no hope. However, Connor strongly advised her to participate. After all, he had already paved the road for her, so if Freya did not go, then his efforts during this period of time would have been in vain.
In the end, Freya could only agree in the fact of Connor's persistence.
The two of them changed into the clothes they had bought at the mall. Connor already looked naturally good, so he looked even more energetic after changing into an expensive suit.
As for Freya, there was no need to talk about her—she was a natural beauty. No matter what she wore, she was so exquisite and beautiful. Moreover, Connor realized that the current Freya seemed to have changed a little from the Freya he knew back then. Her temperament was more mature, and she seemed to be more attractive.
After the two of them changed their clothes, they left the hotel and took a bus to the Serena Corporation's headquarters.
As Freya and Connor had been discussing whether they should come to participate in the auction meeting, they had been delayed for a while, so when the two of them arrived, most of the representatives of the companies participating in the auction meeting had already arrived.
Today, the headquarters of Serena Corporation was overcrowded with people of all skin colors.
