"The number of people who came today might be more than the number of people who participated in the auction that day…" Connor looked at the people in the hall and thought to himself.
Freya explained, "Of course, those who attended the auction that day were all small figures and small companies. If they were really big companies, they wouldn't have needed to use the auction to please Monica…"

chapters.title: Chapter 1814: Announcement of the Results
chapters.content:
Chapter 1814: Announcement of the Results
"So that's how it is!"
Connor nodded thoughtfully.
"Let's go find a place to sit!" Freya said.
"Yes!"
Connor agreed and brought her to a quiet corner to sit down.
After sitting down, Freya took the laptop from her assistant and started reading it seriously.
Although she had already given up on this bid, since she was already here, she had to give it her all. Therefore, she was a little nervous at the moment.
Connor, on the other hand, was indifferent because he already knew the outcome.
A few minutes later, there was a sudden commotion in the hall. The people who were originally waiting walked forward.
Connor also looked up and saw Monica walking in, slowly accompanied by a few middle-aged men.
"I'm really sorry to have made everyone wait!"
After Monica walked into the hall, she smiled at everyone.
"We didn't wait long!"
"Yes, Miss Monica. There's half an hour before the auction starts. You're not considered late!"
Everyone present said.
"It seems that everyone is looking forward to today's auction meeting!"
Monica looked at everyone briefly and continued, "Today, our Serena Corporation's auction will be one-on-one. I will give each company ten minutes. All you need to do is to convince me to choose to cooperate with you in these ten minutes…"
When Connor heard her words, he couldn't help but be stunned for a moment. Then, he turned to Freya and said, "Why is her auction like an interview?"
"You can also treat this auction meeting as an interview, with the Serena Corporation interviewing you. After all, Serena Corp is very concerned about our brand image, so they must be very careful when choosing a partner company!" Freya explained.
"So that's how it is!"
Connor nodded lightly, not saying anything else.
After Monica finished speaking, she led her team into the office.
The expressions on the faces of everyone present began to become nervous, because they knew in their hearts that the real auction would begin soon.
A few minutes later, all the preparations were done.
Monica's secretary walked out of the office and said, "The first bidder is Miss Belinka from Gill Company!"
A middle-aged woman hurriedly stood up after hearing this and walked into her office.
Ten minutes later, the middle-aged woman walked out of the office with a depressed expression.
Next, the second and third bidders entered the office.
As time passed, in just one morning, nearly 30 companies had completed their auction interviews. However, these people did not choose to leave because Monica did not tell them the results at all. The results would only be announced after Monica finished interviewing all the bidders.
At three in the afternoon, her secretary finally called out Freya's name.
Freya's expression became even more nervous when she heard her name, and she subconsciously glanced at Connor.
"I believe you!"
Connor smiled at Freya.
After hearing his words, Freya took out the amethyst pendant that Connor had given her and said, "I hope you're not lying to me by saying this amethyst pendant can bring me good luck!"
"Don't worry, I'm definitely not lying to you!"
Connor said with a smile.
Freya took a deep breath and walked straight into Monica's office.
After entering the office, Freya realized that there were four other people besides Monica. Freya had investigated Serena Corporation's information and knew that these four people were the vice presidents of the corporation. Their status in Serena Corporation was second only to Monica.
"Miss Freya Phillips, right?" Monica asked.
"Hello, Miss Monica!" Freya replied in a neither servile nor overbearing manner.
"The two of us have met before, so there's no need to introduce ourselves. Now you have ten minutes. You need to explain the advantages of working with your company in these ten minutes and think of a way to convince me to choose your company among so many contenders!"
Monica was completely business-like at this moment. Even Freya did not realize that Monica had already given this project to her internally.
Freya turned on her laptop and began to explain the information she had prepared.
Ten minutes later, Freya left the office.
Connor hurriedly went up to her and asked Freya, "How was it?"
"I'm not sure…" Freya shook her head lightly and continued, "I've already told them all the information I prepared, but Monica and the others don't seem to have any reaction. I think there's no hope!"
"Not necessarily. Since we're already here and have already participated in the auction, we just have to wait for the results in peace!"
Connor said with a smile.
"That's true. Anyway, I've already done what I should do. There's nothing to regret now. The rest is just waiting for the results!" Freya replied.
..
Connor and Freya waited at Serena Corporation for an entire day.
Monica was very efficient, even though there were many people participating in the auction interview.
She finished interviewing all the contenders in a day.
At five o'clock in the evening, Monica brought her team out of the office.
When everyone saw her come out, almost everyone stood up and looked at her excitedly because they knew that she was about to announce the auction results.
"I'm really sorry. There were too many companies participating in the auction today, so I've delayed everyone for an entire day. I know that everyone is definitely not in the mood to listen to my nonsense, so I'll announce the results right now!"
Monica paused for a moment and then continued, "This time, the company that Serena Corporation has chosen to cooperate with is Ms. Freya Phillips's Freya Cosmetics Co. Ltd!"
"Freya Cosmetics Co. Ltd.?"
"Why haven't I heard of it before?"
"Yeah, which company is so lucky?"
After everyone heard her words, they all revealed puzzled expressions.

chapters.title: Chapter 1815: The Cruise Party
chapters.content:
Chapter 1815: The Cruise Party
Those big companies that were originally confident that they could definitely win this project were also shocked at this moment.
They originally thought that Serena Corporation would definitely choose between them, but no one expected Monica to choose a small company that they had never heard of.
Freya stood rooted to the ground with a shocked expression. She subconsciously stammered, "Connor, am I dreaming? I actually won?"
"I heard it very clearly just now. Serena Corporation has chosen your company!" Connor replied with a smile.
"Isn't this too unbelievable? Could it be that your amethyst pendant really helped me?"
Freya couldn't believe this.
"It's not that my amethyst pendant helped you, but rather that your company and you are both very outstanding. This is the result of your hard work!"
Seeing Freya so excited, Connor felt that his efforts were not in vain, so he was very happy.
"I feel like I'm dreaming. It's unbelievable!"
Freya said as she covered her mouth.
At this moment, Monica suddenly said, "Miss Phillips, please come up. I want to introduce our newest partner to everyone!"
Freya was stunned for a moment before she hurriedly walked to Monica's side in her high heels.
Freya was a peerless beauty, and Monica was not at a disadvantage, either. Thus, when the two of them stood together, they formed a very beautiful scenery, and many of the men present could not help but be dumbfounded.
Monica first introduced Freya's identity, then explained the reason why she had chosen her company.
Connor could tell that Monica seemed to be very satisfied with Freya's company; otherwise, she wouldn't have mentioned so many reasons for choosing her company.
After Monica finished speaking, it was time for Freya to speak.
Although Freya was in a state of extreme shock, she was very calm and composed when she spoke.
Now that the outcome had been decided, although many people could not accept this result, after Freya finished speaking, everyone applauded symbolically.
"I feel very bad for delaying everyone's time today, so I'm holding a cocktail party on our Serena Corporation's yacht. I hope everyone can attend!" Monica called out to everyone.
When everyone heard her words, they all agreed. After all, the Serena Corporation wouldn't only have this one project. There would definitely be other projects in the future. Therefore, even if everyone present did not get the cosmetics project, they had to stay in Monica's good graces.
Being able to have a good relationship with the Serena Corporation in Europe would give a lot of benefits to them.
As the biggest winner today, Freya naturally had to participate.
The banquet was held on Serena Corporation's yacht, and everyone was picked up by a private car.
After Connor and Freya boarded the yacht, Connor briefly observed the situation of the yacht. This yacht could be considered extremely luxurious. Although he had been to many luxurious places, Connor felt that it was inferior to this yacht.
After entering the yacht, there was a very spacious hall. There were all kinds of food in the hall, and there was a song and dance performance at the front of the hall.
It could be seen that Monica had prepared very carefully for this banquet.
The main character of the banquet was none other than Freya.
After all, she had just gotten the Serena Corporation's project, so her status had naturally risen. Many people planned to use this opportunity to curry favor with her.
Freya naturally wouldn't give up on this opportunity to make friends, so she didn't reject anyone and greeted them politely.
As Freya had to deal with those people, she naturally had no time to deal with Connor, so he could only wander around the yacht alone.
Just as Connor was about to pick up a piece of dessert, a voice called out from behind him.
"Mr. McDonald, do you have time to talk?"
When Connor heard this, he couldn't help but be stunned. Then, he turned around and saw Monica standing behind him.
Connor smiled. "Thank you for today!"
"Thank you?"
Monica couldn't help but be stunned for a moment, then she shook her head and said, "Mr. McDonald, you don't have to thank me. Miss Phillips's company and she herself are very outstanding. Part of the reason why I chose Miss Phillips is to give face to Mr. Mark, but more importantly, it's because she meets the requirements of our group!"
"No matter what, you've helped me this time. If your Serena Corporation needs any help in the future, you can contact me…" Connor said.
"Alright…"
Monica and Connor didn't hesitate and nodded lightly.
Connor saw that Monica did not seem to have any intention of leaving, so he could not help but ask, "Is there anything else?"
"Mr. McDonald, there's actually something that I can't understand…"
Monica said as she sized up Connor.
"What is it?"
"It's about the last time you played golf in my manor. I've asked a few golfing players these past few days. When they heard about you, they all felt that it was unbelievable. They even said that it was impossible…"
Monica paused for a moment and then continued, "So I want to ask you, how did you do it?"
"There are some things that I can't explain to you clearly…" Connor laughed and replied.
If Connor told Monica about how he used his aura to control the golf ball, she would probably think that he was joking with her. After all, it was really difficult for an ordinary person to understand these things.
"Mr. McDonald, it's okay if you don't want to say it. I won't disturb you anymore!"
Monica's expression was a little disappointed, but she didn't say anything more and chose to turn around and leave.
After more than two hours, the banquet finally came to an end.
Connor and Freya sat in the car arranged by Monica and returned to the hotel.
Freya was very happy along the way; after all, she had already given up on this project, so now that she had miraculously obtained this project, she was naturally very excited.
She nestled in Connor's arms and said excitedly, "Connor, this amethyst pendant you gave me is really too magical. In the future, I must carry this pendant with me every day and let it bless me!"

chapters.title: Chapter 1816: An Abnormal Driver
chapters.content:
Chapter 1816: An Abnormal Driver
"Didn't I tell you? This matter has nothing to do with that amethyst pendant. It's all because you're very outstanding!"
Connor helplessly replied to Freya.
"No, I think it must have something to do with this amethyst pendant. I feel that after wearing this amethyst pendant, my mental state seems to have improved a lot. Moreover, I don't get tired as easily as before…" Freya said with a serious expression.
When Connor heard her words, he could not help but be stunned. He seemed to be able to feel that this amethyst pendant could indeed have the effect of nourishing people. However, sometimes Connor felt that this was just a psychological effect, so he did not take it too seriously.
"Since you think this amethyst pendant is so magical, then wear it!" Connor smiled and continued, "What do you plan to do in Europe next?"
"I'm going back tomorrow. After all, I just got the collaboration with Serena Corporation. There are many things waiting for me to do back at the company!" Freya said reluctantly.
"You're going back so soon?"
Connor said in surprise.
"That's right. I came here this time for this project. Now that I've gotten this project, of course I have to go back..."
Freya raised her head and glanced at Connor before continuing, "However, I have already been very happy these past few days. You have accompanied me to so many places, and I have even completed my mission…"
"Alright, since you want to go back, then go back!"
Connor said helplessly.
"You seem a little unhappy," Freya noted with a smile.
"The two of us haven't finished our serious business yet, and you're already going back. I wonder when we'll have such a good opportunity next time…" Connor pouted.
"Serious business?"
Freya's expression was a little doubtful.
"It's about the matter that was delayed by your period…"
Connor gritted his teeth.
"Aiya, what are you thinking about? Can you stop spouting nonsense…"
Freya's face turned red as she pinched Connor with her small hand.
Connor instinctively screamed.
…
Although Connor felt a little regretful to go back like this, there were many things waiting for him in Yarlford, so he did not plan to continue wasting time in Europe.
The next morning, Connor and Freya boarded a plane from Europe to Porthampton.
Connor planned to send Freya back to Porthampton first before taking a plane back to Yarlford.
By the time they arrived at Porthampton, it was already past midnight the next day.
However, because it was too late, Connor couldn't book a flight back to Yarlford immediately. He could only go to Freya's house to rest for the night and then wait until tomorrow morning to take a flight.
After getting off the plane, Freya muttered, "My chauffeur should be here by now. He's waiting for us outside the airport!"
"Why did you ask your chauffeur to come over so late at night? The two of us can take a taxi back ourselves…"
Connor replied as he carried her luggage.
"That's what I told him too, but he insisted on coming over. There's nothing I could do!"
Freya said helplessly.
"Your chauffeur is quite dedicated!"
Connor smiled and didn't say anything.
A few minutes later, Connor and Freya walked out of the airport.
A young man quickly ran towards Freya and greeted her and Connor nervously. Then, he took the initiative to take their luggage.
Connor could feel that her chauffeur seemed to be very nervous, especially the way he looked at him.
However, Connor felt that it might be because the chauffeur knew his identity that he was so nervous, so he didn't think too much about it.
As it was already quite late, and Freya and Connor had been on the plane for such a long time, Freya felt a little tired after getting into the car. She directly lay on Connor's lap to rest.
Connor had nothing to do, so he closed his eyes and rested too.
About ten minutes later, Freya slowly raised her head and looked out of the car window. There was something wrong with her expression.
"What's wrong?"
Connor asked after sensing that her expression was not right.
"There's no way. Usually, it takes me at most ten minutes to get home from the airport. It's been almost half an hour today," Freya muttered.
When her chauffeur heard this, he immediately stepped on the accelerator, and the car instantly sped up.
Freya only realized that Harry had taken the wrong road after she had a clear look at the surrounding buildings. She frowned and scolded him. "No, this isn't the way home at all. What's wrong with you, Harry? Did you go the wrong way?"
However, the chauffeur did not seem to hear her words and continued to step on the accelerator.
"Harry, what are you doing? Didn't you hear me?"
Freya shouted with her big watery eyes.
"Miss Phillips, I didn't go the wrong way…"
The chauffeur, Harry, replied in a low voice and continued to step on the accelerator.
Because it was already past one in the morning, there were very few cars on the street.
The speed of the car was abnormally fast, rushing straight through red lights.
"Harry, what are you doing?" Freya shouted excitedly.
"Miss Phillips, I'm sorry. I didn't want this to happen…" the chauffeur replied nervously.
"Harry, what are you talking about?"
Freya's expression became even more puzzled.
"Miss Phillips, a few days ago, someone kidnapped my wife and my child. He told me to bring you to him when you came back, or he would kill my wife and my child. I really had no choice…" the chauffeur explained with tears in his eyes.
"You…"
Freya was stunned when she heard this words.
Connor was calmer than Freya. He asked, "Who made you do this?"
"I don't know who the other party is either. He has been contacting me by phone!" the chauffeur hurriedly replied.
Freya took out her phone and scolded coldly, "Harry, stop the car right now, or I'll call the police!"

chapters.title: Chapter 1817: The Old Man's Identity
chapters.content:
Chapter 1817: The Old Man's Identity
"Miss Phillips, don't waste your time. I've already installed a signal jammer in the car. Your phone is now a piece of scrap metal!" the chauffeur said in a low voice.
Freya was stunned for a moment before she hurriedly lowered her head to look at her phone. She realized that there was really no signal.
Connor looked at the chauffeur, his expression even more solemn.
He finally understood why the chauffeur looked at him so nervously just now. It was not because of his identity.
Moreover, all of this seemed to have been planned out long ago. This meant that the other party had come prepared.
However, Connor couldn't figure out if the other party was doing this for Freya, or for him.
If the other party was here for Freya, things would be much simpler; after all, Freya was just a weak woman, and the other party definitely wouldn't have made too many preparations. Connor alone could handle the threat.
However, if the other party was here for Connor, then they were very likely to be from the Gomez family or the Collier family.
The Collier family and Gomez Family were very aware of his strength, so they would definitely be very well-prepared.
Thinking of this, the expression on Connor's face grew solemn.
Freya looked up at Connor and asked in a low voice, "Connor, what should we do now?"
Connor instinctively looked out of the window. Because there were very few cars on the road, the car was now moving very fast, reaching more than 150 miles per hour.
At such a speed, it would be impossible for Connor to jump out of the car with Freya safely. Moreover, the chauffeur had already locked the windows and doors.
Connor could also choose to get rid of the chauffeur, but once he did, the car would instantly go out of control. At that time, Connor might be fine, but Freya would be in great danger.
Moreover, Connor was a little curious about who the other party was.
Therefore, after thinking for a moment, Connor muttered, "You don't have to be nervous. I'm here. I'll protect you!"
Freya's nervous mood eased a lot when she heard his words. Then, she nodded at Connor.
Connor was worried that the chauffeur would get into an accident because he was too nervous, so he reminded, "Harry, you don't have to be so nervous. The two of us will follow you to see that person."
"Mr. McDonald and Miss Phillips, I was forced to do this. I really had no choice. Please don't blame me!"
The chauffeur said with a choked voice.
"Don't worry, I won't blame you…"
Connor replied indifferently.
In fact, Connor also knew that the chauffeur was also involved in these things innocently, so he certainly did not have the intention of taking revenge on him. However, Connor was curious about the person who made the chauffeur do these things!
Freya held onto his hand tightly, as if this would calm her down a little.
After experiencing so many things, Freya was no longer the same from before. Naturally, she could not be at a loss because of such a small matter.
Freya had always believed that as long as Connor was by her side, there was nothing that could not be resolved.
The chauffeur, Harry, seemed to have calmed down a little. The car slowed down a little.
About ten minutes later, the chauffeur, Harry, drove the car into a park.
At this moment, the park was pitch-black, and only a few street lamps could be seen faintly.
The chauffeur stopped the car in front of a huge statue of a great man and stammered, "M... Mr. McDonald, Miss Phillips, here…We've arrived..."
Freya heard the chauffeur's words and looked up at Connor.
"Sit in the car and don't move. I'll get out and take a look…"
Connor muttered.
"..."
Freya was stunned for a moment when she heard his words. Then, she nodded.
Connor took a deep breath, then reached out to push open the car door and walk out.
At this moment, there was no one in the park. A few street lamps emitted a dim light. Coupled with the cool breeze that slowly blew past, the scenery gave off an unwelcoming feeling.
Connor took a deep breath and slowly got out of the car.
Freya, who was in the car, looked very nervous because she did not know who would be around to welcome Connor.
After Connor got out of the car, he found an old man in a white robe sitting on the bench in front of the statue. The old man sat there quietly without moving. If it wasn't for Connor's vigilance, it would be difficult to notice that there was a person sitting there.
Connor knew that this old man should be the initiator of all this, so he stopped less than 50 meters away from the old man and asked expressionlessly, "Who are you? To bribe my girlfriend's chauffeur to lure her here?"
The old man heard his words and slowly raised his head to look at Connor. He then said, "You're Jorge Yarrell's disciple, Connor McDonald?"
"It's me!"
Connor lightly nodded.
"I originally planned to kill your fiancée to teach you a lesson, but I didn't expect you to follow along. But it doesn't matter, I won't kill you for Jorge's sake!"
The old man said.
"..."
Connor's expression was a little strange when he heard the old man's words. He understood that all of this was related to him. The other party was not here for Freya, but for him.
Connor sized up the old man. He did not remember seeing this person before, nor did he know who he was.
However, he was also secretly glad that he had followed Freya to Porthampton. If Freya had been alone today, she would definitely have died.
"What deep hatred do you have with me that makes you want to kill my fiancée?" Connor asked in a low voice.
"What deep hatred do I have with you?"
When the old man heard his words, he could not help but sneer. Then, he said indifferently, "You broke into the Collier family's secret room and stole confidential documents. You kidnapped my granddaughter, Aida, and extorted money from the Collier family. If it were anyone else, I would have punished them a hundred times already. But I didn't care about these things because of your relationship with Jorge…"
"..."
Connor looked at the old man in front of him. He had already guessed the man's identity.
"I could still ignore the two things just now, but..."
The old man suddenly stood up, then shouted, "But I didn't expect you to look down on my Collier family. You broke my grandson's arms and legs and turned him into a cripple. If I choose to sit back and do nothing, then my Collier family will become a laughing stock."

chapters.title: Chapter 1818: Newborn Calves Don't Fear Tigers
chapters.content:
Chapter 1818: Newborn Calves Don't Fear Tigers
"Are you Beau Collier?"
Connor asked the man expressionlessly.
"That's right, this old man is Beau Collier!"
Beau nodded.
After Connor heard this, he could not help but suck in a breath of cold air, and the expression on his face began to become nervous.
In fact, Aida had warned Connor a long time ago that Beau might personally deal with him, but he had never taken this matter to heart.
This was because Connor felt that Beau was the sect leader of the Heavenly Yuan Sect, and Connor was the young sect leader of the Purple Cloud Sect. If Beau attacked him, it would cause a conflict between the two sects. At that time, even Beau would not be able to bear the responsibility.
Moreover, Beau's strength was inferior to Jorge's. Beau definitely had to consider the consequences before making a move on Connor.
Unfortunately, Connor did not expect Beau to actually plan to take revenge on Freya.
Beau had no intention of attacking Connor. He looked at Connor calmly and said, "Connor, I won't kill you today, but your fiancée must die. This is the price for breaking my grandson's limbs!"
"If you want to kill my fiancée, then you'll have to step over me first!"
Connor muttered back.
"Do you think you can stop me?"
The expression on Beau's face was somewhat disdainful.
"We'll just have to find out," Connor gritted his teeth and replied.
Although Connor knew that Beau was an ancient martial arts grandmaster, he could not abandon Freya in this situation. He could only choose to fight Beau.
"Newborn calves really aren't afraid of tigers. If your master, Jorge Yarrell, was standing in front of me and saying this, I might have to think twice. It's a pity that your master isn't here now!"
Beau said with a smile.
Connor didn't say anything. He knew that Beau must have done his investigations and confirmed that Jorge wasn't in Porthampton. That was why he attacked Freya, otherwise he wouldn't have done so.
"Even if my master isn't here, don't even think about hurting my fiancée!"
Connor gritted his teeth.
"You brat, you really overestimate yourself!"
Beau smiled disdainfully and waved his right hand.
In an instant, an incomparably powerful energy rushed straight towards his position.
Connor's reaction was also very fast. He hurriedly took out the Five Elements Dagger and shouted, "Wind Shield!"
In the next second, a gust of wind suddenly rose, forming a wind wall around his body.
When Beau saw the Five Elements Dagger, his expression was a little shocked. Then, he sighed and said, "I didn't expect you to have such a treasure in your hands!"
"Bang!"
Beau's aura slammed into the wind wall in front of Connor.
In the beginning, Connor's Wind Wall was barely able to withstand it. However, the energy contained in Beau's aura was too terrifying. It was not something that the Wind Wall could withstand.
Soon, the wind wall in front of Connor was shattered by Beau's aura, which hit Connor directly. Connor's body was instantly sent flying, and then he smashed into a wall not far away.
The wall collapsed instantly.
"Connor!"
When Freya saw this, she could not help but cover her mouth and scream. She had not expected Beau's strength to be so terrifying.
But in the next second, Connor actually stood up again.
Beau noticed that Connor had stood up and couldn't help but laugh. He then said lightly, "Jorge's disciple is indeed different. Although I only used 20% of my strength just now, any ordinary Black-rank would have died. But you can still stand up."
Connor looked at Beau expressionlessly. He had fought Faris Jimenez before, and at that time, Connor's strength was very different from the current him. Therefore, he had thought that his strength had improved greatly. Moreover, with the help of the Five Elements Dagger, he might really be able to fight Beau.
However, Connor had never expected that he would be completely defenseless against Beau. The difference between the two was simply too great, and nothing could make up for it.
"Seven Stars Big Dipper Fist! Sky Splitter!"
Although he knew that the difference in strength was terrifying, Connor did not seem to have any intention of giving up. He growled and charged towards Beau.
When Beau saw Connor rushing over, his expression was filled with disdain. He waved his right hand lightly.
Another aura flew out.
After Connor was hit by the aura, he flew out again.
The same scene appeared in front of Freya again.
Before Connor could even get close to Beau, he was sent flying by his aura.
However, before Freya could react, Connor stood up again and rushed towards Beau.
Just like that, Connor was sent flying again and again, and then stood up again and again.
Connor kept repeating the same movements, but even Freya, who had never come into contact with ancient martial arts, could tell that he was no match for Beau.
After trying more than ten times, Connor was already in a very sorry state. His expensive suit was already in tatters. Every impact would bring a lot of burden to his body. Blood slowly flowed from his body that was cut by the stone.
Freya's face was already covered in tears as she gritted her teeth and watched everything that was happening outside the car window.
Connor stood up again.
Beau looked at his seat with a strange expression on his face. He then said in a low voice, "Connor, I only used 20% of my strength now, but you can't even get close to me. Do you think you need to persist? I've already made myself clear. I'm not here to kill you, but to teach you a lesson. So I advise you to give up as soon as possible. With your current level, it's impossible for you to stop me!"
"Cut the crap. If you want to kill Freya, then kill me first!"
Connor growled with reddened eyes, then continued to rush towards Beau.
Connor couldn't think of any way to stop Beau because his strength was too terrifying. Unless Jorge appeared, no one could stop him.
However, Connor couldn't just watch Freya die in Beau's hands. He could only struggle for a moment.

chapters.title: Chapter 1819: Freya Is Dead?
chapters.content:
Chapter 1819: Freya Is Dead?
"Connor, stop!"
However, at this moment, a figure suddenly rushed in front of Connor and opened its arms to shield him.
When Connor heard this, he could not help but be stunned. Then, he slowly raised his head and saw that the person standing in front of him was Freya.
Freya was already very aware about the current situation. The other party clearly wanted to kill her to punish Connor.
Everything Connor was doing now was to protect her.
However, Freya could tell that Connor was not a match for this person. If he continued to be like this, the two of them might be the ones who would die.
"Freya, what are you doing out here? Didn't I tell you to stay in the car?"
Connor looked at Freya in front of him and shouted excitedly.
"Connor, I've seen everything you've done for me. I'm very touched. I didn't choose the wrong man. Being with you is the best decision I've ever made in my life. The only pity is that I haven't given you a child yet…"
Freya said as tears streamed down her face.
"Freya, what nonsense are you spouting here? Hurry up and get back in the car. These things have nothing to do with you!"
Connor shouted excitedly.
"I've already heard what that person said. He doesn't want to kill you, he's coming for me. Since he wants to kill me, then kill me as long as you can live!"
After saying that, Freya turned around resolutely and looked at Beau, who was not far away. She shouted, "Didn't you want to kill me? You can do it now!"
Beau glanced at Freya indifferently and sighed, "You're a good girl, but it's a pity that you chose the wrong person. You shouldn't be with someone like Connor!"
Freya gritted her teeth and replied, "I've already said that being with Connor was the best decision I've made in my life!"
"Even if you die, you won't regret it?"
Beau asked calmly.
"That's right! I won't regret it!"
Freya nodded without hesitation.
Beau couldn't help but laugh coldly. Then, he said expressionlessly, "Alright, seeing that you have some backbone, I'll leave your corpse intact…"
After saying this, Beau waved his right hand lightly.
An aura flew straight towards Freya.
"Freya, no!"
Connor shouted with reddened eyes, and then rushed towards Freya.
However, Connor was s little slower than the speed of Beau's aura. After all, Connor had already consumed a large amount of aura just now.
"Bang!"
Beau's aura struck Freya's body.
Because Beau had said that he would leave her corpse intact, he had only used 10% of his strength to release this aura.
However, 10% of the strength of an ancient martial arts grandmaster was equivalent to the force of a huge truck crashing into an ordinary person at a terrifying speed.
Freya was instantly sent flying, her body smashing into a statue not far away.
"Freya!"
Connor could not help but roar when he saw this scene.
On the other hand, Beau's face was cold. He knew that Freya was just an ordinary person. Even a martial artist would not be able to survive such a collision.
Connor rushed to Freya and hugged her as he shouted, "Freya, why are you so stupid? Why did you go and die? If I die, he won't kill you…"
"You... You... I have to live well, I... I really don't regret it... To be with you…"
Blood trickled down the corner of Freya's mouth, as if she was using her last bit of strength to say those words.
"Why?"
Connor hugged Freya and roared at the sky.
Freya quietly watched and forced a smile before slowly closing her eyes.
"Freya? Freya?"
Connor shook her body like a madman, but Freya did not react at all.
Not far away, Beau couldn't help but laugh coldly when he saw this scene. It was as if all of this had nothing to do with him.
Beau knew that after what Connor had experienced today, it would be difficult for him to recover from the pain in a short period of time. Therefore, even if he did not kill Connor, he had achieved his goal.
Killing a person wasn't scary. What was really scary was killing the person's heart.
Once a person's heart was dead, he would be like a walking corpse, no longer able to pose a threat to anyone.
"What a pity for this girl!"
Beau sighed, then turned around and left.
Meanwhile, Connor had been immersed in the pain of her death and had not paid any attention to Beau. He was not in the mood to care about that.
The chauffeur had also realized that something was wrong, so he had already run away.
Connor was the only one left in the quiet park.
Connor hugged Freya's body and wailed. He had never collapsed like this before, and had never been so desperate.
Originally, Connor thought that after he inherited Steven Lee's inheritance, his life could change.
After all, in today's society, money was everything.
However, when he really had money, Connor realized that money might be omnipotent for an ordinary person, but for him, there were many problems that money could not solve.
Connor felt that everything he experienced today was so unreal!
Freya had actually died in front of him!
He didn't know how to express his emotions, so he could only choose a simple way to vent his anger and sadness.
After an unknown period of time, Connor could no longer cry. Only tears slowly flowed out of his eyes.
Even now, Connor could not accept the fact that Freya was dead.
"Swoosh!"
At this moment, a dazzling light directly shone on his body.
However, Connor did not have any reaction. He sat on the ground with a numb expression.
A moment later, a black Mercedes stopped in front of Connor.
Thomas Morgan, Carlos, and Diana ran down from the car.
"Mr. McDonald, are you alright?"
Thomas quickly rushed to Connor. When he saw Freya in Connor's arms, he was stunned.
Diana and Carlos were also in disbelief.

chapters.title: Chapter 1820: The Power of the Amethyst Pendants
chapters.content:
Chapter 1820: The Power of the Amethyst Pendants
"Then.. Miss Phillips is dead?"
Carlos stammered.
"This…"
Thomas stood rooted to the ground, as if he didn't know what to say.
Among the three of them, only Diana had a strange expression on her face. She quickly ran to Connor and said, "Mr. McDonald, Miss Phillips doesn't seem to be dead yet!"
"What did you say?"
When Connor heard Diana's words, he suddenly looked up at her, his voice hoarse and scary.
"Mr. McDonald, let me examine Miss Phillips!"
Diana replied in a low voice before placing her right hand on Freya's chest.
A few seconds later, Diana said excitedly to Connor, "Mr. McDonald, Miss Phillips's heart is beating. She's not dead yet!"
Connor's eyes flashed with a glimmer of light again, and he hurriedly reached out to touch Freya's chest.
Although Freya was no longer breathing and had no pulse, Connor realized that her heart was beating.
"Freya is alive. She's actually alive…"
Connor seemed to have gone crazy. He picked up Freya and ran out of the park.
Thomas hurriedly stopped Connor and said anxiously, "Mr. McDonald, get in the car. Let's send Miss Phillips to the hospital quickly…"
"Yes, to the hospital, to the hospital…"
Connor seemed to be dumbfounded as he kept repeating this sentence.
Ten minutes later, Freya and Connor were sent to the First Hospital of Porthampton.
After entering the hospital, Freya was immediately pushed into the operating theater.
Connor's injuries were also very serious, but he refused the treatment and sat on the bench outside the operating room with a numb expression.
At this moment, his emotions had already calmed down a little. He no longer had any extravagant desires in his heart. He only hoped that Freya could survive.
Thomas and the others stood beside Connor and waited anxiously.
…
In the blink of an eye, five to six hours had passed.
The doctor walked out of the operating theater with a tired face.
When Connor saw the doctor come out, he quickly stood up and asked, "Doctor, how's my girlfriend? Is she out of danger now?"
"..."
The doctor shook his head helplessly after hearing his words. Then, he said in a low voice, "Mr. McDonald, this is the first time I've encountered such a situation. Miss Phillips's body has completely lost her vital signs. From a medical point of view, she is already dead…"
"..."
Connor's expression was a little desperate when he heard the doctor's words.
"Impossible, Miss Phillips's heart is beating!"
Diana shouted.
"This is also what I find strange. Although Miss Phillips's body has no signs of life, her heartbeat is there. It's just that it's very weak. I've never encountered such a situation, so I don't know what's going on!" the doctor said.
"..."
Thomas hesitated for two seconds before asking in a low voice, "Has there been a similar situation in history?"
"I'm not sure about that yet. I can go back and check the records!"
"Thank you!"
Thomas said as he took out a bank card and handed it to the doctor.
The doctor did not hesitate. He took the bank card and turned to leave.
After Connor saw the doctor leave, he directly walked into the ward.
Freya lay quietly on the hospital bed. Her face was pale, and all kinds of equipment were hooked up to her body.
However, only the heart monitor showed any signs of activity. The rest of the equipment were inactive.
Connor looked at the expression on her face in confusion. He couldn't understand what was going on. After all, if Beau's attack were to hit an ordinary person, they would definitely die.
But why was Freya's heart beating?
Connor turned his head to look at Thomas and the others and said in a low voice, "All of you can go out. Let me be alone with Freya for a while!"
"Good!"
The others heard his words and turned around to leave the ward.
Connor sat beside Freya and looked at her quietly. At this moment, there were many things he wanted to say to her, but he could no longer say them because his voice was completely hoarse from crying.
A few minutes later, Connor seemed to have thought of something. He stood up and unbuttoned her shirt.
The phoenix pendant that Connor had given Freya was hanging around her neck, and it was shining.
"Could it be that her heartbeat is related to this amethyst pendant?"
The expression on his face was excited.
Although Connor had never figured out the use of these two amethyst pendants, or even how to use them, he knew that these two amethyst pendants were definitely not ordinary things.
Back then, Connor had survived the battle with Zaki Serrano because of the power of his amethyst pendant.
Therefore, Connor felt that it was very likely that this pendant had also saved Freya.
Furthermore, Connor noticed that the pendant seemed to be flashing in time with Freya's heartbeat.
The more Connor thought about it, the more incredulous he felt. He hurriedly took out his dragon pendant and placed it on her chest.
A few seconds later, the dragon pendant also began to shine.
Freya's heartbeat also started to speed up, from a dozen beats per minute to more than thirty.
What made Connor feel the most unbelievable was that numbers began to appear on the equipment around the bed. This meant that her body was gradually recovering its vital signs.
"Doctor! Quickly call the doctor over!"
Connor shouted excitedly at the door.
When Thomas heard his words, he hurriedly called the doctor to the ward.
When the doctor saw the numbers on the instrument, his expression seemed to be even more shocked.
Freya's body had completely lost all signs of life, but her heart was beating a little. This situation was already unbelievable to the doctor.
However, he had never expected that her internal organs were also gradually recovering!
"This is really amazing. I've been a doctor for so many years, but this is the first time I've encountered such a situation!"
The doctor said excitedly to Connor.
"Doctor, do you have any way to cure my girlfriend now?" Connor asked.

chapters.title: Chapter 1821: Diana Murphy's Grandfather
chapters.content:
Chapter 1821: Diana Murphy's Grandfather
"Mr. McDonald, we really can't do anything about this because we don't know what's wrong with Miss Phillips. We don't know where to start!"
The doctor said to Connor helplessly.
"Then, what should we do now?"
Connor hurriedly asked.
"I think we should observe for now and see if Miss Phillips's body can continue to recover on its own. After all, although she has vital signs now, they are very weak. In the medical standpoint, she is but a living body. As such, Miss Phillips is not out of danger."
The doctor replied cautiously.
"I understand…"
Connor looked at the doctor and nodded. He did not say anything else.
At this moment, Connor knew that the reason why Freya could still maintain her vital signs was entirely because of the two jade pendants. If not for the jade pendants, Freya might already be dead.
Now, Connor was very glad that he had bought Monica's jade pendant and given it to Freya. If not for these coincidences, Freya would have died no matter what.
"Mr. McDonald…"
At this moment, Diana Murphy suddenly walked to Connor's side and called out softly.
"Yes?"
Connor turned to look at Diana and asked in a low voice.
"Mr. McDonald, I think I might have a way to bring Miss Phillips back to life…"
Diana said to Connor in a serious tone.
"You can bring Freya back to life?"
Connor was excited. After all, there was nothing else that could arouse his interest.
"Mr. McDonald, I should have told you before that my grandfather is an alchemist. When I was very young, I heard my grandfather say that there is a pill in this world that can bring the dead back to life. Although my grandfather said that bringing the dead back to life doesn't really bring the dead back to life, it can allow a dying person to escape from danger. Perhaps that pill might be able to save Miss Phillips…"
Diana looked at Connor and said.
"Where is your grandfather now?"
Connor excitedly asked Diana.
Connor knew that pills were indeed very magical. When Freya lost her memory, all the hospitals said that they could not help Freya recover her memory. In the end, Connor relied on pills to help her recover her memory.
So when Connor heard Diana's suggestion, he instantly had hope.
If he could really refine the pill that Diana had mentioned, he might really be able to save Freya.
"Mr. McDonald, my grandfather is in his hometown. I can call my grandfather and ask him to come over…"
Diana hurriedly said.
"Thank you. If your grandfather can really refine a pill that can save Freya, I will agree to anything you ask for!"
Connor looked at Diana and said excitedly.
"Mr. McDonald, this is what I should do!"
Diana smiled and continued, "I'll go call my grandfather right now…"
"Go ahead…"
Connor hurriedly nodded.
Diana took her phone and walked out of the ward.
About ten minutes later, Diana returned to Connor's side and whispered, "Mr. McDonald, I just called my grandfather and told him about Miss Phillips's situation. My grandfather said that the pill can't save just anyone, so he needs to come over and take a look at Miss Phillips's condition first..."
"I'll go and pick him up now!"
Connor turned around and walked out of the ward without thinking.
"Mr. McDonald, Mr. Morgan has already sent Carlos over. You just have to wait here patiently. My grandfather will only be here tomorrow at the earliest!"
Diana quickly reached out to stop Connor.
"Carlos is already there?"
Connor stopped in his tracks when he heard this.
"Yes…"
Diana looked at Connor and nodded.
Connor took a deep breath and slowly sat on the chair.
"Mr. McDonald, you don't have to be too sad. After all, Miss Phillips is still alive, so there's definitely a way to cure her…"
Diana saw that Connor was rather listless and couldn't help but advise him.
"I will pay whatever price to make sure Freya stays alive…"
Connor gritted his teeth and said in a low voice.
"She will definitely get better!"
Diana said softly.
Connor turned to look at Diana but didn't say anything.
"Mr. McDonald, if there's nothing else, I'll be waiting outside…"
Diana knew that Connor wasn't in a good mood, so she didn't want to disturb him.
Connor nodded at Diana but didn't say anything.
In the blink of an eye, a day had passed.
Throughout the day, Connor sat beside Freya's bed. He was still wearing the same set of clothes. He sat there expressionlessly like a block of wood.
Anyone could see how much of a blow Freya's accident had dealt to Connor.
"Mr. McDonald, my grandfather is here!"
At this moment, Diana brought a white-haired old man into the ward.
This white-haired old man was Diana's grandfather, Josiah Murphy.
When Connor heard that, he quickly stood up and walked to Diana's grandfather. He then said excitedly, "Hello, Mr. Murphy!"
"Mr. McDonald, you don't have to be so polite with me. I heard that you took great care of my granddaughter, so I came to see if I could help you…"
Josiah hurriedly waved at Connor.
"She is the patient!"
Connor wasn't in the mood to talk nonsense with Josiah. He then brought Josiah to Freya's bed.
Josiah walked to the bedside and touched Freya's forehead. Then, he took Freya's pulse and turned to Connor. "Mr. McDonald, Miss Phillips is already a dead person…"
"Dead person?"
Connor couldn't help but be stunned when he heard Josiah's words.
"That's right. Although Miss Phillips has a pulse and a heartbeat, she is indeed a dead person. If I'm not wrong, you must have used some kind of divine artifact to keep Miss Phillips's body alive, right?"
Josiah hit the nail on the head.
"..."
Connor looked at Josiah and hesitated for a moment, then said in a low voice, "Mr. Murphy, it might be because of these two jade pendants!"
After saying that, Connor immediately took out the two jade pendants on Freya's neck.

chapters.title: Chapter 1822: Soul Returning Pill
chapters.content:
Chapter 1822: Soul Returning Pill
Josiah carefully looked at the jade pendant on Freya's neck.
However, as he was afraid of affecting Freya, Josiah did not reach out to touch the jade pendant. He just looked at it quietly.
"Mr. Murphy, do you recognize these two jade pendants?"
Connor hesitated for a moment and asked Josiah softly.
"I am not a martial artist, so I don't know much about the divine artifacts of martial artists. However, this is the first time I've heard of such a thing. It can actually restore the signs of life of a dead person."
Josiah shook his head gently.
When Connor heard Josiah's words, he became desperate. He could feel from Josiah's reaction that it wouldn't be easy to save Freya.
"Grandpa, I remember you telling me that there is a pill that can bring back the dead. Can that pill save Miss Phillips?"
Diana asked Josiah.
"The pill you're talking about is called the Soul Returning Pill. I've also seen it in an ancient book. That pill is indeed very magical. It can save a dying person from danger. However, I can't guarantee that it can save Miss Phillips. After all, I've never refined that pill before, nor have I seen anyone use it…"
Josiah said slowly.
"Mr. Murphy, can you refine that kind of pill?"
Connor hurriedly asked.
"I do have the pill formula to refine the Soul Returning Pill, but…"
Josiah seemed a little hesitant.
"Mr. Murphy, I can't find any other way now. I can only pin my hopes on the Soul Returning Pill. If you're willing to help me refine the pill, I can agree to anything you ask for!"
Connor exclaimed.
Josiah waved his hand at Connor and said with a smile, "Mr. McDonald, what are you saying? I'm old, and I have long lost interest in worldly possessions. I am very interested in a top-grade medicinal pill like the Soul Returning Pill. If I can refine a Soul Returning Pill, I will die without regrets…"
"Grandpa, does it mean that you'll do it?"
Diana asked excitedly after hearing Josiah's words.
"Let's not be hasty. I have to explain the situation to Mr. McDonald…"
Josiah stretched out his hand to stop Diana, then said to Connor, "Mr. McDonald, first of all, I'm not sure what the effects of the Soul Returning Pill are. I'm also not sure if it can save Miss Phillips, so you have to consider it carefully!"
"I don't have any other options now. I'm willing to try!"
Connor replied without any hesitation.
"One more thing is that the Soul Returning Pill is a top-notch existence among pills. The refining method is very complicated. I have limited knowledge, so I can't guarantee that I can refine it 100%. I think it is better to have your master, Mr. Yarrell, refine it."
Josiah looked at Connor and continued.
"I don't know where my master is now. I don't know when he will come back, so I hope that you can help me!"
Connor looked at Josiah and said sincerely.
"Mr. McDonald, if you are not worried that the Soul Returning Pill might be ineffective and that I might fail to refine it, then I am willing to help!"
Josiah said with a smile.
"Thank you so much…"
Seeing that Josiah had agreed, Connor looked rather excited.
"Mr. McDonald, don't have to thank me first. Refining the Soul Recovery Pill isn't that simple. It requires hundreds of medicinal ingredients…"
Josiah interrupted Connor.
"Mr. Murphy, you can tell me what herbs you need. I'll get someone to buy them!"
Right now, Connor did not want to waste a single second. After all, the longer he dragged on, the more dangerous Freya's situation would be.
When Connor heard Josiah say that he was going to help refine the pill, he was naturally very excited. After all, Jorge Yarrell's whereabouts were unknown, and Connor couldn't find any other way to save Freya. Therefore, the pill refined by Josiah might be Connor's greatest hope now.
Even though Josiah had already explained the situation to Connor, Connor still wanted to refine the Soul Returning Pill.
"Mr. Murphy, what kind of herbs do you need to refine the Soul Returning Pill?"
Connor asked Josiah anxiously.
After hearing Connor's words, Josiah hesitated for two seconds and then said softly, "Mr. McDonald, there are many types of pills needed to refine the Soul Returning Pill, but I can help you gather most of them. After all, I have been an alchemist for so many years, and my family has collected quite a number of pills!"
"That's great. Mr. Murphy, please let me know how much they cost. I'll buy them from you at double the price!"
Connor felt that Josiah was already giving him face by agreeing to help him, so Connor definitely wouldn't take advantage of him.
"That can be discussed. I actually have my own selfish motives for helping you refine the pill. After all, I also want to be able to refine a top-notch pill like the Soul Returning Pill, so even if you want me to take out some of my own herbs, I'm willing to do so!"
Josiah waved his hand at Connor.
"No matter what, I will definitely give you money for them…"
Connor said seriously.
"It's not too late for us to talk about money later…"
Josiah looked at Connor and smiled, then continued, "Mr. McDonald, although I can gather most of the medicinal ingredients, there is one medicinal ingredient that you need to find personally…"
"What medicinal ingredient?"
Connor was stunned for a moment and asked Josiah with a puzzled expression.
"This herb is called the Soul Returning Fruit. It is the most important herb to refine the pill!"
Josiah replied indifferently and then continued, "According to the ancient records, the Soul Returning Fruit is usually grown in extremely cold places. Moreover, it requires a hundred years of spiritual energy to nurture it. The Soul Returning Fruit contains the spiritual energy of life. This kind of spiritual energy can extend the lifespan of ordinary people and eliminate all diseases. For martial artists, it can stabilize their foundation and increase their cultivation. It is an extremely rare medicinal ingredient..."
"Then, where can I find this kind of medicinal herb?"
Connor hurriedly asked after hearing Josiah's words.
"I have only heard of the existence of such a medicinal ingredient. However, I have never seen such a medicinal ingredient. I have also never heard of anyone obtaining such a medicinal ingredient…"
Josiah whispered back to Connor.

chapters.title: Chapter 1823: Medicinal Herb Merchant
chapters.content:
Chapter 1823: Medicinal Herb Merchant
Connor seemed somewhat helpless, because he knew that the most important thing in refining the Soul Returning Pill was the Soul Returning Fruit.
If he couldn't find the Soul Returning Fruit, then everything would be in vain.
"Mr. McDonald, I can help you with the other medicinal ingredients and preparations. However, I really don't have any way to help you with this Soul Returning Fruit. I have been an alchemist for so many years. Although I have heard many rumors about the Soul Returning Fruit, I have never seen it with my own eyes. I have never heard of anyone actually finding the Soul Returning Fruit…"
Josiah said to Connor with a helpless expression.
When Connor heard Josiah's words, he fell into despair again, and he looked dejected.
The hope that had just ignited in Connor's heart was instantly extinguished.
If Connor knew the exact location of the Soul Returning Fruit, then the chances of making the pill were much higher.
However, Connor didn't know where to find the Soul Returning Fruit. If he started investigating now, he didn't know how long it would take. Moreover, he would need to waste time to find the Soul Returning Fruit. This would definitely take a lot of time.
Connor didn't know if Freya could hold on until then.
"Mr. McDonald, the Soul Returning Fruit is the most important medicinal ingredient for refining the Soul Returning Pill. If we cannot find the Soul Returning Fruit, all of this will be empty talk…"
Josiah looked at Connor and reminded him.
"I understand…"
Connor replied in a low voice, and he seemed to be somewhat desperate.
"Mr. McDonald, I know many merchants who sell medicinal herbs. I'll go and ask around for you now to see if I can find any clues about the Soul Returning Fruit…"
Diana hurriedly said.
"Alright…"
Connor nodded absent-mindedly.
At this moment, Connor knew that the medicinal herb merchants that Diana knew were just ordinary people. If he were to rely on those people to find the whereabouts of the Soul Returning Fruit, it would be like fishing in the ocean.
Thomas Morgan, who had been standing at the side without saying a word, hesitated for a couple of seconds before he suddenly walked to Connor's side and said softly to Connor, "Mr. McDonald, I might have some clues about the Soul Returning Fruit…"
"What did you say?"
Connor was stunned for a moment after hearing Thomas's words. Then, he suddenly turned around and looked at Thomas with a shocked expression.
"I said that I might be able to find some clues about the Soul Returning Fruit…"
Thomas softly replied to Connor, then continued, "Some time ago, a medicinal herb merchant came to me and said that he wanted to sell me some clues about a divine herb. What he described seemed to be somewhat similar to the Soul Returning Fruit that Mr. Murphy mentioned earlier. That medicinal herb also grows in extremely cold places. However, I was not very interested in medicinal herbs at that time. Moreover, that person asked me for 50 million just for a clue. I felt that it was not worth it, so I rejected him…"
"Where is the person you mentioned now? Can you still find that person?"
Thomas's words seemed to have ignited the hope in Connor's heart again. He asked Thomas excitedly.
"That person is a medicinal herb merchant in Porthampton. It should not be difficult to find him…"
Thomas hurriedly said.
"Well? Hurry up and help me contact this person. Let alone 50 million, I can even give him 100 million…"
Connor was not willing to let go of any news related to the Soul Returning Fruit. Money was not a problem for him at all.
"I'll call that person now…"
Thomas nodded and left.
About ten minutes later, Thomas returned to the ward with his phone and whispered to Connor, "Mr. McDonald, I've already made an appointment with the other party. We'll meet at a restaurant called Havana in Porthampton in an hour..."
"Alright, let's go there now!"
Connor agreed excitedly. Then, he turned to look at Josiah and said softly, "Mr. Murphy, we do not know much about the Soul Returning Fruit. We are also unable to confirm if the medicinal ingredient that the other party talked about is the Soul Returning Fruit. Therefore, we will have to trouble you to come with us to help identify it…"
"No problem…"
Josiah nodded without hesitation.
Connor then turned to look at Diana and Carlos Lane and said softly, "Diana, Carlos, the two of you stay in the ward and take care of Freya. No one is allowed to enter the ward, and no one is allowed to touch Freya's jade pendant, not even the doctor…"
"Mr. McDonald, don't worry. With the two of us here, no one will be able to get close to Miss Phillips!"
Carlos said hurriedly.
"Thank you…"
Connor replied in a low voice, then left the ward with Thomas and Josiah.
After leaving the ward, Thomas took out the clothes he had specially prepared for Connor. After all, Connor's clothes were already tattered. However, Connor had been listless, so Thomas had never told Connor about changing his clothes.
Connor randomly found a ward and changed into new clothes. Then, he left the hospital and went to Havana.
...
Ten minutes later, Connor, Thomas and Josiah arrived at the private room of Havana.
A burly middle-aged man was sitting in a private room with an anxious expression. When the middle-aged man saw Thomas, Connor, and Josiah, he hurriedly stood up and said to Thomas, "Mr. Morgan, you're finally here..."
"I'm sorry. I was delayed by something just now…"
Thomas replied indifferently, then turned to Connor and said, "Mr. McDonald, this is Porthampton's medicinal herb merchant, Jeffrey Zacharia. Back then, he was the one who wanted to provide me with clues about the medicinal herb…"
"Hello…"
Connor nodded at Jeffrey.
Jeffrey looked at Connor with a puzzled expression because he couldn't think of anyone in Porthampton who could make Thomas be so respectful.
Thomas seemed to have seen through Jeffrey's doubts and said softly, "Mr. Zacharia, let me introduce you to Mr. McDonald. This is the chairman of the Empire World Corporation, Connor McDonald!"
"Mr... Mr. McDonald?"
Jeffrey was stunned when he heard Thomas's words. He was in disbelief.
Jeffrey was from Porthampton, so he had naturally heard a lot about Connor. However, a businessman of his level would never have the chance to meet Connor, so he had never seen Connor before.

chapters.title: Chapter 1824: Searching for the Fruit
chapters.content:
Chapter 1824: Searching for the Fruit
"Mr. McDonald, hello..."
Jeffrey exclaimed.
"There's no need to be so polite. Let's get down to business!"
At this moment, Connor was not in the mood to talk nonsense with Jeffrey at all. He sat on the chair and then poured himself a cup of tea.
Jeffrey also sat down after hesitating for a moment.
"I heard that you know something about a divine herb. I'm very interested in the divine herb you mentioned. Can you tell me about it?"
Connor asked Jeffrey softly after drinking a mouthful of water.
"Mr. McDonald, I wasn't the one who discovered the divine herb, but my family's workers accidentally found it when they went to the mountains to pick herbs. They felt that the herb was very strange, so they took a photo and sent it to me for identification. I didn't recognize the herb after seeing the photo, so I went to ask my master. My master found out that the herb was called the Soul Returning Fruit after looking through many ancient books…"
Jeffrey looked at Connor nervously.
"Are you saying that you have a photo of that medicinal herb in your hand?"
When Josiah heard Jeffrey's words, he seemed a little excited.
"Yes!"
Jeffrey nodded lightly.
"Then, can I see it?"
Josiah continued.
"Well…"
Jeffrey seemed a little hesitant.
Connor knew what Jeffrey was hesitating about, so he said, "Tell me, how much do you want?"
"Mr. McDonald, the price I negotiated with Mr. Morgan was 50 million, but Mr. Morgan didn't agree to it. Since you came personally today, 20 million will do!"
Jeffrey replied softly.
"If the medicinal herb you mentioned is really the Soul Returning Fruit, I'll give you 50 million. If not, I'll give you 20 million!"
Connor said lightly.
"You are really generous, Mr. McDonald!"
Jeffrey was overjoyed when he heard Connor's words. He quickly took out his phone and looked for the photo to pass to Josiah.
Josiah looked at the photo on his phone seriously.
The surrounding environment of this photo was the same as the environment where the Soul Returning Fruit grew as described by Josiah. It was in a snowy mountain, and in the vast white snow, there was a red plant that was rather obvious.
There was a whole fruit at the top of the red plant. This fruit was completely red and the size of a cherry. It looked very strange.
After all, normal plants would not survive in such a cold environment.
However, this one was actually able to survive and bear fruit. It was really unbelievable.
Josiah carefully looked at the photo several times, then said excitedly to Connor, "Mr. McDonald, this medicinal herb is the Soul Returning Fruit. It's exactly the same as what was recorded in the ancient book..."
"Of course, it's the Soul Returning Fruit. My master also read a lot of information before he could confirm it."
Jeffrey grinned and said.
"..."
Connor was somewhat excited because he didn't expect to find the Soul Returning Fruit so quickly.
"Then, where is this Soul Returning Fruit now? Did your workers bring back the fruit?"
Connor hurriedly asked Jeffrey.
"Well…"
The expression on Jeffrey's face appeared somewhat helpless when he heard Connor's words.
"If you're willing to sell me the Soul Returning Fruit, I'll buy it no matter how much it costs!"
Connor said directly.
"Mr. McDonald, this really isn't a matter of money. Back then, my family's workers discovered this medicinal herb when they were picking herbs. However, because the medicinal herb was quite far from their location, it might have been dangerous if they went over, so they took this photo of me first to ask me if this medicinal herb was valuable…"
Jeffrey said slowly.
"And then?"
Connor hurriedly asked.
"However, because I didn't get back to them quick enough, they were attacked by some wild beasts when they returned to look for that medicinal ingredient. In the end, only one of them returned. The rest were eaten by the wild beasts…"
Jeffrey said sadly.
"Wild beasts?"
Connor frowned when he heard that.
"Mr. McDonald, all top-notch divine herbs are usually protected by wild beasts. After all, these medicinal herbs can emit spiritual energy. Those wild beasts will rely on absorbing this spiritual energy to survive. Therefore, they will definitely not let anyone take the medicinal herbs that easily. Once someone takes the medicinal herbs, it will be equivalent to taking their lives…"
Josiah looked at Connor and explained.
"I see…"
Connor looked at Josiah and nodded without saying anything.
"Later on, I found out the value of this Soul Returning Fruit. Therefore, I sent people to search for it a few more times. However, there was no result in the end. My people never came out after entering that mountain…"
Jeffrey said to Connor.
"Didn't you say that one of them survived? Where is that person now?"
Connor looked at Jeffrey and asked.
"That person seemed to have been scared silly by that incident. After he came back, he fell seriously ill and was unwilling to go out. I looked for him several times, but he avoided me!"
Jeffrey said slowly.
"It must be due to excessive shock…"
Connor replied indifferently and then continued, "Give that person a call now and tell him that as long as he's willing to come and tell me everything that happened that day in detail, no matter how much money he wants I can give it to him…"
"Alright, I'll make the call now!"
Jeffrey hurriedly nodded.
Connor knew that the easiest way to deal with ordinary people was to use money.
Although that person was depressed because of what happened last time, he had to live on no matter what. Therefore, as long as Connor gave him enough money, that person would definitely come.
As expected, Jeffrey returned to Connor's side very quickly and then said softly to Connor, "Mr. McDonald, he said that he wants five million dollars before he's willing to come…"
"Agree to it…"
Connor nodded without thinking.
Jeffrey did not seem to have expected Connor to agree so readily. After being stunned for a moment, he hurriedly took his phone and walked out of the private room.
"Mr. McDonald, if what Jeffrey said is true, then it is really possible for us to refine the Soul Returning Pill…"
Josiah was also very excited.
"I don't think he has the guts to lie to me. After all, he's from Porthampton. Once I find out that he is lying to me, he knows very well what his fate will be…"
Connor said slowly.
"I think so too. After all, it was Jeffrey who came to me first. He probably didn't have the ability to bring the Soul Returning Fruit back, but he was unwilling to give up such a good opportunity to earn money, so he came to me. What he said should be credible…"
Thomas added.
"I hope I can find the Soul Returning Fruit!"
Connor sighed softly.

chapters.title: Chapter 1825: It's Not about Money
chapters.content:
Chapter 1825: It's Not about Money
Nearly ten minutes later.
Jeffrey brought a person into the private room.
"Mr. McDonald, this is the only person who survived after discovering the Soul Returning Fruit. His name is Henrik Whitaker!"
Jeffrey looked at Connor and introduced him to everyone.
Connor slowly raised his head and looked at Henrik. Henrik's face was pale, and he was as thin as a stick. He looked very dispirited and didn't look like a young man at all.
However, Connor could understand. After all, all his companions had died in the mouths of the wild beasts, and only he survived. A normal person would definitely not be able to withstand such a thing, and it would cause a very big psychological trauma.
"Hello…"
Connor said to Henrik.
"He... Hello..."
Henrik looked at Connor. His eyes seemed to be a little dull. When he spoke, his body kept trembling as if he was afraid of something.
"I want to ask you what happened after you found the Soul Returning Fruit!"
Connor said softly.
After hearing Connor's words, Henrik became even more scared, and his body trembled even more violently.
"You don't have to be so afraid. Just say whatever you have to say. After all, it's already in the past. It's useless even if you're afraid now…"
Connor said helplessly after seeing Henrik's reaction.
"Where's the money you promised me?"
Henrik took a deep breath, then gritted his teeth and asked Connor.
Connor turned and glanced at Thomas.
"Give me your bank account number now. I'll get someone to transfer the money to you..."
Thomas said calmly as he took out his phone.
"..."
Henrik hesitated for a moment, then handed the bank card he had prepared beforehand to Thomas.
Thomas didn't waste any time and asked his company to transfer the money to Henrik.
Henrik was relieved to see that the money had been transferred to his account. He then sat down on the chair.
"Do you want some water?"
Connor asked Henrik.
Henrik picked up the teapot and took a big gulp of tea. Then he looked at Connor and said slowly, "Back then, the few of us were workers in Mr. Zacharia's family. We were usually in charge of searching for rare medicinal herbs in various deep mountains and forests. My captain got news from somewhere that there were rare medicinal herbs on a mountain, so he brought us into the Crimson Peak..."
"Crimson Peak?"
Connor couldn't help but be stunned when he heard the name.
"Mr. McDonald, Crimson Peak is located in the northernmost part of Oprana, in the province of Bremette. The temperature there is below zero all year round, and it's very cold. There are very few people there, but the people there are tough. Crimson Peak is also the most famous mountain in Bremette because it's frozen all year round…"
Jeffrey hurriedly explained.
As Jeffrey was a medicinal herb merchant himself, he often needed to go to various deep mountains and forests to search for medicinal herbs. Therefore, he was very familiar with many places in Oprana. He was considered a living map.
"I see."
Connor nodded lightly, then turned to Henrik and said, "Go on, what happened after that?"
"We knew that the environment in the Crimson Peak was very harsh, and there were all kinds of wild beasts there. The environment there causes the wild beasts in the Crimson Peak to be very cruel, so we specially prepared equipment like hunting rifles..."
Henrik paused for a moment and then continued, "After entering the Crimson Peak, we did find a lot of precious medicinal herbs. Those medicinal herbs added together were worth at least a few million. All of us were very happy. After all, we didn't work in vain. Later, when we were about to return, we found the Soul Returning Fruit. However, because the Soul Returning Fruit was quite far from our location, we weren't sure if the medicinal herb was worth anything, so we contacted Mr. Zacharia immediately..."
"..."
Connor looked at Henrik without saying anything.
"After that, Mr. Zacharia told us to bring that medicinal herb back. We started to approach the location of the medicinal herb. However, before we could get close to the medicinal herb, a large group of wild beasts rushed out. These wild beasts were very ferocious. In the blink of an eye, they ate all my companions. I accidentally fell, and my body was covered in snow, so I was lucky enough to survive..."
Henrik's body was trembling as he said this.
"Then, did you see clearly what kind of wild beast attacked you?"
Connor frowned and asked.
"I didn't see it clearly. When I heard my teammate's screams, I didn't dare to move at all. I was hiding in the snow the whole time. When everything was completely silent, I came out from under the snow and ran away…"
Henrik shook his head.
Connor looked at Henrik and hesitated for a couple of seconds. He didn't say anything.
At this time, Connor had no way to determine what those beasts were, but he didn't really care about that. After all, if it was a normal person facing those beasts, they wouldn't have any ability to resist. However, Connor was a black rank martial artist, so it shouldn't be too much of a problem for him to deal with a group of beasts.
"If I let you take me to Crimson Peak now, can you still find that place?"
Connor asked Henrik.
"..."
After hearing Connor's words, Henrik was stunned. Then, he said in disbelief, "Mr... Mr. McDonald, are you joking with me? You actually want to go to that place?"
"If I don't go, how can I get that Soul Returning Fruit?"
Connor asked.
Although Connor could also have others go there to look for the Soul Returning Fruit, he felt that it was a waste of time doing that. Moreover, the Crimson Peak was very dangerous. It was very difficult for ordinary people to survive there, so it was safer for him to go personally to look for the Soul Returning Fruit.
"I will never go to that place again in my life…"
Henrik gritted his teeth and said to Connor.
"I can give you money…"
Connor said to Henrik expressionlessly.
"Mr. McDonald, this is not about money. I'm just worried that I won't be able to come out alive if I go there…"
Henrik gritted his teeth.
"You don't have to worry about that. I can protect you. Also, you can't work now, right? Even if you don't think about yourself, you should think about your wife and children. If this goes on, how are they going to survive?"
Connor asked Henrik.
After hearing Connor's words, Henrik was stunned, and he seemed to be a little conflicted.
"I'll pay you 20 million. As long as you bring me to the fruit, I'll let you go, and I'll protect you!"
Connor said directly.
"If I die, you have to give my wife 50 million!"
Henrik thought for a moment and said to Connor.

chapters.title: Chapter 1826: Exploration Team
chapters.content:
Chapter 1826: Exploration Team
"No problem…"
Connor nodded without thinking.
Henrik didn't expect Connor to agree so quickly. After hesitating for a while, he asked Connor, "Then, when do you plan to leave?"
"We'll set off tonight!"
Connor didn't want to waste any more time.
"Why are you in such a hurry?"
Henrik's face was filled with shock.
"I need this Soul Returning Fruit to save someone, so I don't want to waste time!"
Connor explained.
"..."
Henrik looked at Connor and hesitated for a couple of seconds, then whispered, "Alright then. Anyway, I'm basically selling my life to you now. You can leave whenever you want!"
Seeing that Henrik had agreed, Connor turned to Jeffrey and asked him softly, "Do you want to go with me?"
Connor invited Jeffrey over because he was quite familiar with all the places. If he had such a person by his side, it could save a lot of trouble.
"Mr. McDonald, as long as you give me money, of course I'll be willing to go with you…"
Jeffrey replied with a smile.
"Alright, after this is done, I will definitely give you money!"
Connor immediately agreed, then looked at Thomas and said, "Mr. Morgan, I'll have to trouble you with Freya during this period of time. You must help me protect Freya. No one is allowed to approach her ward..."
"Mr. McDonald, don't worry!"
Thomas nodded and replied.
Connor looked at Josiah Murphy and said softly, "Mr. Murphy, I'll go look for the Soul Returning Fruit. You can prepare the other herbs for the Soul Returning Pill first. When I come back with the Soul Returning Fruit, we can start refining!"
"Mr. McDonald, I heard that the Crimson Peak is very dangerous. You must be careful!"
Josiah hurriedly said to Connor.
"Don't worry. Unless it's an ancient martial arts grandmaster, no one can hurt me!"
Connor replied indifferently.
Josiah nodded slowly when he heard Connor's words.
After settling everything, Connor didn't waste any more time. He asked Thomas to book a plane ticket and was ready to fly to Bremette that night.
...
It was past nine in the evening.
Connor went to the hospital to visit Freya Phillips, then brought Henrik, Jeffrey, and the others to Porthampton Airport.
"Mr. McDonald, I've already arranged your schedule. Let's take a plane to Bremette first, then take a bus to the nearest city, Comtar. After we reach Comtar, we'll rest for a while before going to Crimson Peak."
After arriving at the airport, Jeffrey told Connor.
"Let's do as you say…"
Connor lightly nodded.
After all, he did not know much about Bremette, so he could only follow Jeffrey's arrangements.
Half an hour later, Connor and the others boarded the plane.
After boarding the plane, Connor rested with his eyes closed because he knew that there would be a lot of things waiting for him to do. Moreover, if Connor really wanted to find the Soul Returning Fruit, it would not be so easy.
The next day, at three in the afternoon.
The plane slowly landed, and Connor and the others finally arrived at Bremette.
After getting off the plane, Jeffrey's car was already waiting outside the airport.
Therefore, Connor and the others got into the car and drove toward Comtar, the northernmost city in Bremette.
Comtar was located in the northernmost part of Oprana. It had a small population, but its people were tough. Moreover, the temperature in Comtar was below zero all year round. This caused the physical fitness of the residents of Comtar to be much higher than that of people in other places. Their ability to withstand cold was also extraordinary.
At 10 pm, Connor and the others finally arrived at Comtar.
Connor felt the bone-piercing cold as soon as he got off the car. However, he was a black rank now, so he could use his aura to keep out the cold.
Jeffrey and Henrik were both ordinary people, so they had to wear thick down jackets. Even so, they were still shivering from the cold.
Connor observed the pedestrians on the street. He realized that the people of Comtar were not wearing thick clothes, but these people did not seem to feel particularly cold.
"What's your plan?"
Connor turned to look at Jeffrey and asked him softly.
"Mr. McDonald, I plan to go to a hotel in Comtar to rest for the night. After all, we've already taken such a long flight…"
Jeffrey replied while panting and trembling.
"Alright…"
Connor lightly nodded.
Although Connor didn't feel tired at the moment, Henrik and Jeffrey were both ordinary people. They couldn't withstand such a long journey, so Connor felt that it was better to let them rest.
When Jeffrey saw that Connor had agreed, he hurriedly got someone to drive the car to the hotel.
After entering the hotel, Connor, Jeffrey, and Henrik first ate something in the hotel's restaurant. Then, they returned to their rooms to rest for the night and continue their journey the next morning.
After Connor returned to his room, he lay on the bed and rested.
However, before Connor could fall asleep, he heard a knock on the door.
"Who is it?"
Connor frowned and asked.
"Mr. McDonald, it's me!"
Jeffrey's voice sounded.
