Connor hesitated for a moment before walking to the door and opening it. Then, he looked at Jeffrey and asked, "It's late. Do you need something?"
"Mr. McDonald, I suddenly recalled something that I want to discuss with you…"
Jeffrey looked at Connor and said.
"What is it?"
Connor frowned and asked.
"Mr. McDonald, we're still a few hundred kilometers away from Crimson Peak. If we drive tomorrow, we should be able to reach the vicinity of Crimson Peak. However, Crimson Peak is covered in snow, and there are no buildings there. Moreover, we might need a long time to find the Soul Returning Fruit after entering Crimson Peak. I wanted to discuss with you whether we should hire a local team from Comtar..."
Jeffrey said with a smile.
"Hire a team from Comtar?"
When Connor heard Jeffrey's words, he could not help but be stunned for a moment, looking somewhat puzzled.
"That's right. If we hire a local exploration team from Comtar, they can drive in front to scout the way for us. After all, they are all locals and know the situation here very well. Moreover, these people can also carry some supplies in their cars. This way, we don't have to worry about the lack of supplies after entering Crimson Peak…"
Jeffrey said with a smile.

chapters.title: Chapter 1827: The Felton Family!
chapters.content:
Chapter 1827: The Felton Family!
"You really have thought things through…"
Connor said faintly.
"This isn't my first time at the Crimson Peak after all. I do know a thing or two. If you are okay with it, then I'll contact the exploration team!"
Jeffrey said with a smile.
"Alright, I'll leave this matter to you!"
Connor lightly nodded.
"Then, I won't disturb your rest now, Mr. McDonald…"
Jeffrey replied with a smile, then turned around and left.
Connor closed the door and lay on the bed. In fact, he knew that Jeffrey wanted to hire a local expedition team because he was worried about his safety. Connor himself was not willing to bring so many people into the mountain. After all, if there were more people, it would be more troublesome.
However, Connor was also worried that if he really brought Jeffrey and Henrik into the mountain, if something were to happen to them, Connor might not be able to find the Soul Returning Fruit alone. He might not even be able to leave Crimson Peak.
As Crimson Peak was a snowy mountain, wherever one looked, it was all snow. This was also the reason why Jeffrey had found two groups of people to enter Crimson Peak, but in the end, they all died in Crimson Peak.
The next day, Connor and the others woke up early.
After Connor left the hotel, he realized that Jeffrey had already found a local exploration team in Comtar in advance.
This exploration team was not small. There were more than 30 people in total, all of whom were young and middle-aged. The leader of the exploration team was a middle-aged man with a big beard and a tough-looking body.
"Mr. McDonald, this is the captain of the exploration team, Jayson Hardy. He will lead us into the Crimson Peak!"
Jeffrey hurriedly introduced Connor to him after seeing him walk out of the hotel.
"Hello, Mr. McDonald. My name is Jayson Hardy!"
The middle-aged man greeted Connor.
"Hello…"
Connor replied softly and then continued, "Has your team ever been to the Crimson Peak?"
"We go almost every year!"
Jayson replied.
"Then, you should be very familiar with the Crimson Peak, right?"
Connor hurriedly asked.
"Not really…"
Jayson shook his head gently and continued, "Mr. McDonald, you might not know much about the situation inside the Crimson Peak. The interior of the Crimson Peak is very, very large, and a portion of it is outside the border of Oprana. Most people enter the Crimson Peak and only stay around the outermost layer. As for the deeper parts of the mountain, we don't know much about it. Just now, I talked to Jeffrey. I think the place you're looking for this time is very likely in the deeper parts of the Crimson Peak…"
"I see!"
Connor looked at Jeffrey and nodded, then asked in a low voice, "Then, are you confident that you can lead us to that place?"
"I'm not sure about that. I can only try my best. Moreover, our team is not here to help you find the place. What we need to do is to bring you into the Crimson Peak and then bring you out of the Crimson Peak. As for what you want to do and where you want to go after entering the Crimson Peak, that has nothing to do with us…"
Jayson said to Connor very seriously.
"Alright!"
Connor replied helplessly, then asked Jeffrey, "Have you prepared all the supplies?"
"Mr. McDonald, don't worry, everything is ready!"
Jeffrey hurriedly said.
"Then, let's set off now!"
Connor replied indifferently, then strode into Jeffrey's car.
A few minutes later, more than ten off-road vehicles drove in the direction of Crimson Peak.
At this moment, Connor and the others had not entered the Crimson Peak, so Jeffrey's car could still be used. However, once they entered the Crimson Peak, they would need to change to Jayson and the others' cars.
Their cars had been professionally modified, so they could drive in the snow. If an ordinary car entered the Crimson Peak, it would be difficult to move an inch.
Connor sat in Jeffrey's car and looked at the scenery outside the window expressionlessly. He was very calm.
Although Freya's matter had dealt a huge blow to him, he had already found a way to save her, so he was much calmer now.
As the journey was relatively long, Connor had to spend most of his time in the car.
Connor also knew that it would not be easy for him to obtain the Soul Returning Fruit on this trip to the Crimson Peak, so he used this period of time to start cultivating the Chi Refining Technique.
Before Freya's incident, Connor was very satisfied with his current realm. He felt that as long as he did not encounter an ancient martial arts grandmaster, he would have the ability to fight.
However, after experiencing the events of the past few days, Connor realized how weak he was. When he was in real danger, he could not even protect the person he loved the most.
At this moment, Connor finally understood that the only thing that could solve any problem in this world was not money but power.
In the face of absolute power, no matter how rich you were, it was useless.
Therefore, Connor was almost unwilling to waste a minute and a second. As long as he was free, he would choose to cultivate to increase his strength.
In the blink of an eye, half a day had passed.
Connor felt a very obvious brake, and then the car suddenly stopped.
"What happened?"
Connor slowly opened his eyes and asked Jeffrey softly.
"Mr. McDonald, there seems to be someone blocking the road ahead. I'll go down and see what's going on!"
Jeffrey replied in a low voice, then opened the car door and got out.
Connor hesitated for a moment before getting out of the car as well.
At this moment, Jayson was talking to a middle-aged man. The middle-aged man was very tall and muscular. Moreover, Connor could feel that this middle-aged man was not an ordinary person but a martial artist. However, his realm was probably not very high.
"Who are they?"
Connor turned and asked Jeffrey.
"Mr. McDonald, these people are probably from the Felton family!"
Jeffrey hurriedly replied.
"The Felton family?"
Connor's expression was a little puzzled when he heard this.
"That's right, it's the Felton family. The Felton family is the number one family in Comtar, and the intersection they're blocking is the only intersection that leads to Crimson Peak. No one would dare to block the path here except for them..."
Jeffrey said slowly.
"Do they want money? If they want money, just give them the money. I'm not in the mood to waste time with them now…"
Connor said in a low voice.

chapters.title: Chapter 1828: The Richest Man in Davenport?
chapters.content:
Chapter 1828: The Richest Man in Davenport?
"I'll go and see what's going on…"
Jeffrey replied softly, then walked to Jayson's side.
After hesitating for a moment, Connor followed him.
"Cohen Felton, what are you doing? Crimson Peak doesn't belong to the Felton family, so why can't we enter?"
Jayson shouted at the middle-aged man in front of him.
It was obvious that Jayson, as a citizen of Comtar, knew this middle-aged man.
Although this middle-aged man also had the surname Felton, he was only a side branch of the Felton family. He was not considered a proper member of the Felton family. This was also the reason why Jayson was so impolite.
"Jayson, didn't I explain it clearly to you just now? The Felton family head has ordered that from today onward, no one is allowed to enter the Crimson Peak. You'd better go back!"
Cohen frowned and said disdainfully.
"Just because you want us to go back, we should? Who do you think you are? I'm entering the mountain today. Let's see what you can do to me!"
Jayson was so angry that his entire body trembled as he shouted.
In fact, under normal circumstances, Jayson would not be so angry. However, Connor and Jeffrey gave him a very high price. If he could complete this mission, then Jayson could also earn a lot of money.
Recently, due to the frequent accidents at the Crimson Peak, the business of Jayson's exploration team was not good. Now that they finally had a big business, they were stopped before they even entered the Crimson Peak. How could Jayson not be angry?
"What can I do to you?"
Cohen looked at Jayson and sneered. Then, he shouted at the top of his voice, "Brothers, tell him what we can do to him!"
Whoosh!
More than 30 people rushed out and surrounded Jayson.
Jayson was dumbfounded when he saw these people. He did not expect Cohen to be serious this time.
"Cohen, aren't you being too much of a bully? Why can't we enter Crimson Peak?"
Jayson knew that his people couldn't beat Cohen's people, so he gritted his teeth and shouted unwillingly.
"I'm not in the mood to waste my breath on you. Scram right now. I won't make things difficult for you on the account that we sort of know each other…"
Cohen waved his hand and said with a disdainful expression.
"..."
Jayson stood there without saying a word.
Connor walked to Jayson's side and asked him softly, "Jayson, what's going on?"
"Mr. McDonald, these people are blocking our way and not allowing us to enter the Crimson Peak. This is the only way from Comtar to the Crimson Peak…"
Jayson replied in a low voice.
"Alright, I understand…"
Connor nodded, then sized up Cohen and said, "Brother, give us a number. How much will it cost for us to pass?"
"What? You're quite rich, aren't you?"
Cohen asked Connor.
"Mr. McDonald is the richest man in Davenport. Stop talking nonsense. Just tell me how much you want!"
Jeffrey shouted at the top of his lungs.
"The richest man in Davenport?"
Cohen could not help but be stunned for a moment. Then, he licked his dry lips and said softly, "I didn't expect the people from Davenport to come. Hehe, no matter how much money you give me today, it won't do."
"Aren't you blocking the way here for money?"
Connor asked with a puzzled expression.
"Of course, it's not for the money. I'm doing this according to the instructions of the higher-ups in the family. If you really want to go in, then go and discuss it with the head of the Felton family. I can only let you in after receiving orders from the head of the family…"
Cohen replied.
"I don't have the time. If you don't plan to make way, then I can only force my way in!"
Connor said in a low voice.
"Hahaha…"
When Cohen heard Connor's words, he laughed out loud and said at the top of his voice, "You want to force your way in? Let me see you try that!"
Whoosh!
In an instant, more than 30 people rushed toward Connor.
Connor swept a simple glance at everyone and found that most of these people were ordinary people. Therefore, he gently waved his right hand, and an aura flew toward them.
Before everyone could react, those who were charging at Connor were all sent flying and smashed onto the ground, moaning in pain.
Connor waved his hand and sent all of Cohen's subordinates flying.
Jeffrey, Jayson, and the others were instantly dumbfounded. They stood rooted to the ground in a daze, and they were dumbstruck.
How could they have imagined that Connor was actually so terrifyingly strong!
"You... You're a martial artist?"
When Cohen saw what happened, he instantly exclaimed. He widened his eyes and shouted at Connor.
"That's right, I'm a martial artist!"
Connor nodded his head and continued, "Can my people enter now?"
"Even if you're a martial artist, you can't enter!"
Cohen shouted with his eyes wide open. Then, he took out a pistol from his pocket.
Connor's reaction speed was very fast. Before Cohen could take out his gun, he rushed to Cohen and grabbed his right hand.
Crack!
A crisp sound rang out.
Connor broke Cohen's right arm.
"Ah…"
Cohen screamed and then fell to the ground.
Connor stepped on Cohen's chest with one foot and asked Cohen expressionlessly, "Can my people enter now?"
"Yes… yes..."
Cohen hurriedly nodded without thinking. The pain on his arm made his entire body tremble. Cohen's subordinates also knew how terrifying Connor's strength was, so they did not dare to attack Connor.
"Oh right, I have something to ask you…"
Connor suddenly said.
"What… What is it?"
Cohen stuttered.
"Why does the Felton family not allow people to enter the Crimson Peak?"
Connor asked.
"Well…"
Cohen looked hesitant.
Connor raised his right foot and stepped on Cohen's wrist.
"Ah…"
Cohen was in even more pain as he let out a heart-wrenching roar.
"I'll talk, I'll talk. Stop hurting me…"
Cohen shouted at the top of his lungs.
Connor looked at Cohen without saying anything.
"Some time ago, someone found a very precious medicinal herb in the Crimson Peak, so many martial artists entered the Crimson Peak. The Felton family head is also very interested in finding this medicinal herb. In order to prevent too many people from competing for the medicinal herb, he asked me to bring some people here to block the way. No one is allowed to enter…"
Cohen hurriedly explained.

chapters.title: Chapter 1829: Resting for a Day
chapters.content:
Chapter 1829: Resting for a Day
"There's actually someone else who's interested in the Soul Returning Fruit?"
A strange look flashed across Connor's face. Then, he turned to look at Jeffrey who was not far away.
"Mr. McDonald, I didn't leak this news. Other than you and Mr. Morgan, I haven't told anyone else about this…"
Jeffrey hurriedly exclaimed.
"Are you here for the Soul Returning Fruit?"
Jayson suddenly asked.
"You know about the Soul Returning Fruit?"
Connor was stunned for a moment and asked Jayson.
"Of course. This matter is not a secret in Comtar. Many people know that there is a Soul Returning Fruit in the Crimson Peak. Moreover, many people have indeed entered the Crimson Peak during this period of time!"
Jayson replied softly.
"Looks like someone must have discovered it and leaked the news…"
Connor sighed lightly, then moved his right foot away from Cohen's wrist. He turned and said to Jayson and Jeffrey, "Since there is already someone who wants to fight with us for the Soul Returning Fruit, let's not waste any more time. Let's hurry up and head to the Crimson Peak…"
"Alright…"
Jayson and Jeffrey agreed, then got into the car and drove toward the Crimson Peak.
In the beginning, Connor could still see some villages and tribes. As time passed, the surrounding scenery became more and more desolate. In the end, he could only see a large piece of wasteland.
And Connor used this time to cultivate the Chi Refining Technique.
In the blink of an eye, two days had passed.
Connor's motorcade moved forward 24 hours a day. There were three drivers in each car, and they took turns driving. This way, they could ensure that they could reach the Crimson Peak at the fastest speed.
"Mr. McDonald, there is a small village in front of us. Jayson plans to go to the village to replenish some supplies and add some fuel to the cars. At the same time, he will let the drivers rest and wait until tomorrow before setting off."
Jeffrey suddenly told Connor.
When Connor heard Jeffrey's words, he could not help but be stunned for a moment. Then, he asked in a low voice, "How much longer do we need to reach the Crimson Peak?"
"We should still have a day's journey…"
Jeffrey replied after thinking for a moment.
"We can replenish my supplies and refuel. As for rest, forget it. After all, someone has already arrived at the Crimson Peak before us. I don't want to waste time!"
Connor said in a low voice.
"Mr. McDonald, this might be the closest village to the Crimson Peak. If we forgo this village, there will be no place to rest next…"
Jeffrey said helplessly.
"..."
Connor hesitated for a couple seconds when he heard Jeffrey's words. He knew that most of the people in the convoy had come because they wanted to earn money. They were different from Connor. Only Connor had come to save Freya Phillips.
Therefore, Connor shouldn't use his own standards to demand that of others. If he kept letting these people run at a high load, it wouldn't take long for these people to collapse.
Moreover, Connor also knew that it was not easy to enter the Crimson Peak to find the Soul Returning Fruit. It was definitely not something that could be done in a day or two. At that time, if these people were not in a good state of being, then things would be even more troublesome.
"Let everyone rest for the night and then set off tomorrow!"
Connor looked at Jeffrey and said.
"You're alright with this, Mr. McDonald?"
Jeffrey asked Connor in surprise.
"Mhm, after all, none of us are made of iron. It will be even more difficult after we enter the Crimson Peak. So, we should take this opportunity to rest…"
Connor said softly.
"Alright, I'll inform Jayson now…"
Jeffrey replied with a smile. Then, he took out his phone and called Jayson.
About an hour later, Connor's convoy stopped in a small village.
The village was not very big. There were only a few dozen households, and most of the villagers were older than 50 years old. The young people had already left.
There was only one inn in the village that could provide accommodation and meals.
Jayson first brought the motorcade to the village to find out who was responsible for providing fuel. He filled up all the cars with fuel and then bought some supplies that could be used.
After all, this was not Jayson's first time going to the Crimson Peak, so he knew very well what he needed.
After all the preparations were done, Jayson brought Connor and the others to the only inn in the village.
"Jayson, you're here again?"
The hotel owner greeted Jayson with a smile.
"Mr. Livingston, hurry up and prepare some beef and white wine for my brothers. We've been on the road for two whole days, and our brothers are exhausted…"
Jayson exclaimed at the top of his lungs.
"Alright, I'll get someone to prepare it now. Wait a moment!"
The boss, Mr. Livingston, nodded and replied. Then, he ordered the people in the kitchen to start cooking.
Half an hour later, everyone could finally eat something warm.
Mr. Livingston and Jayson seemed to have known each other for many years, so he sat at the table where Connor, Jayson, and Jeffrey were sitting, chatting and drinking with Jayson.
"Mr. Livingston, how's business recently?"
Jayson asked Mr. Livingston.
"My business has been very good recently. There are people coming almost every day, and they are all big shots…"
Mr. Livingston took a sip of white wine and said with a smile.
"Big shots?"
Jayson looked slightly confused.
"That's right, big shots…"
Mr. Livingston nodded and continued, "For example, the Sherman family, Warner family, and Judkins family of Comtar were here. They have probably already entered the mountain by now."
"The people from these families are actually here? Looks like the allure of the Soul Returning Fruit is really great…"
Jayson said in surprise.
"What's up with these families?"
Connor asked Jayson softly.
"Mr. McDonald, you might not know this, but the families that Mr. Livingston mentioned just now are all famous ancient martial arts families in Comtar. They must have come to Crimson Peak Mountain for the Soul Returning Fruit this time…"
Jayson explained in a low voice.
"..."
Connor narrowed his eyes and looked at Jayson without saying anything.
"Are you also here for the Soul Returning Fruit?"
Mr. Livingston suddenly asked.
"Yes, I want to find the Soul Returning Fruit!"
Connor nodded at Mr. Livingston.
"..."
Mr. Livingston winked at Connor and said in a low voice, "Young man, I see that you look quite familiar. Also, I've drunk a lot, but you did not even frown. Let me give you some advice. It's best not to go to the Crimson Peak…"

chapters.title: Chapter 1830: Snow Wolf
chapters.content:
Chapter 1830: Snow Wolf
"Why?"
Connor was stunned for a moment and asked.
"The current Crimson Peak is very dangerous. It is said that there are snow wolves around, so most of the people who go in have a hard time coming out alive. Previously, the people in our village would go around the Crimson Peak, but it is said that even the outermost layer of the Crimson Peak has snow wolves now…"
Mr. Livingston said slowly.
"What is a snow wolf?"
Connor asked in confusion.
"The term 'snow wolf' was left behind by an old man in our village. It refers to a ferocious beast unique to the Crimson Peak. This ferocious beast has the body of a wolf, but it has a pair of red eyes. Moreover, the snow wolf is very cruel. Once you are targeted by the snow wolf, it will chase you until you are exhausted and then eat you..."
Mr. Livingston said in a low voice.
"Back… Back then, in the Crimson Peak... the monster we encountered might have been the snow wolf…"
Henrik Whitaker suddenly stuttered.
"Are you sure?"
Connor turned and asked.
"Although I didn't see the ferocious beasts clearly, I heard someone shout 'red-eyed wolf'..."
Henrik replied in a low voice.
Connor hesitated for a moment but didn't say anything.
In fact, Connor wasn't particularly afraid of snow wolves because he felt that no matter how fierce the snow wolf was, it was just a wild beast.
What really worried Connor was the people sent by the ancient martial arts families in Comtar.
Since the people of these big families knew that the Crimson Peak was dangerous, then the people of these families must also be martial artists. Therefore, if these people found the Soul Returning Fruit first, it would be a little troublesome.
"Mr. Livingston, thank you for your advice, but this Soul Returning Fruit is more important to me than my life, so I have to find it no matter what!"
Connor tipped his wine glass at Mr. Livingston.
"Haha, I'm just giving you a reminder. As for what you plan to do, that's your own business!"
Mr. Livingston smiled faintly after hearing Connor's words.
After more than an hour, everyone was almost done eating. Then, they went to rest in Mr. Livingston's hotel.
Although the room was very ordinary and simple, it was good enough for these people who were already exhausted to have a place to sleep.
Early the next morning, Connor and the others set off again.
After a whole day and night, Connor's convoy finally arrived at the foot of Crimson Peak.
Connor looked at the snow-capped mountain peak in front of him and turned to ask Jayson, "This is the Crimson Peak?"
"This can't be considered the real Crimson Peak. This is just a mountain peak of the Crimson Peak. The interior of the Crimson Peak is very large. I don't know exactly how large it is…"
Jayson replied softly.
"I see."
Connor lightly nodded, then looked at everyone and said, "We are about to enter the Crimson Peak. Everyone, get some rest first. We will enter the mountain when dawn comes!"
"Alright!"
Everyone responded.
As the weather outside was really bad, people would probably freeze into popsicles if they stood outside for half an hour. Therefore, it was impossible for them to get out of the car to rest. They could only get some rest in the car.
Jayson and the others' cars had been modified to be very cold-resistant. They could also turn on the heater, so the temperature inside the car was acceptable for ordinary people.
Everyone had a simple meal in the car and rested for a while.
About three hours later, they drove into the Crimson Peak.
When the car entered Crimson Peak, Connor was shocked by the scene in the mountain.
Because Connor could only see a vast expanse of white. Other than the white snow that filled the area, there was nothing else.
However, Jayson and the others could find the location Henrik pointed out on the map and then drive toward the place where Henrik and the others found the Soul Returning Fruit.
At this moment, Connor was very glad that he had asked Jeffrey to hire Jayson and the others. If Connor, Jeffrey, and Henrik had entered the Crimson Peak, they would probably not have been able to find the Soul Returning Fruit even if they were given a year.
As Jayson and the others were leading the way, Connor could rest in the car.
In the blink of an eye, five to six days had passed.
In these five to six days, everyone spent most of their time on the road.
Other than the mountains and the snow, there was nothing else in the surroundings.
This was a great torment for an ordinary person.
Jeffrey was obviously already somewhat unable to take it anymore. He looked muddleheaded all day long.
As for Jayson's people, they were slightly better off. After all, this was not the first time they had entered the Crimson Peak. They seemed to have long been used to such an environment.
As for the so-called snow wolf that Mr. Livingston mentioned, Connor and the others had yet to encounter one.
"Mr. McDonald, good news!"
Jeffrey turned and shouted at Connor after receiving a call.
"What good news?"
Connor opened his eyes and asked Jeffrey in confusion.
"Jayson called me just now. He said that they seem to have found the valley where Henrik and the others found the Soul Returning Fruit. It's less than ten kilometers away from us. We should be able to reach it in ten minutes…"
Jeffrey said excitedly.
"That's great. We've finally found it…"
Connor was somewhat excited.
In fact, Connor had been very frustrated these few days. After all, he had been in Crimson Peak for so long, but there was no progress at all. Connor was very anxious.
"If Henrik's memories are right, we should be able to find the Soul Returning Fruit soon…"
Jeffrey gritted his teeth and continued.
Connor glanced at Jeffrey indifferently and did not speak.
Because Connor knew very well that it was not so easy to find the Soul Returning Fruit.
About ten minutes later, the convoy finally stopped.
"Mr. McDonald, we've arrived. Let's go down and take a look!"
Jeffrey said excitedly to Connor.
"Yeah, let's go down and take a look!"
Connor nodded gently, then pushed open the door and got out of the car.
After getting out of the car, Connor felt a bone-piercing cold. This kind of cold was not comparable to the cold in Comtar. Even if Connor used his breath to keep out the cold, he would still feel a little cold.
Needless to say, Jeffrey's entire body trembled the moment he got out of the car, and his face turned pale.

chapters.title: Chapter 1831: Go With You
chapters.content:
Chapter 1831: Go With You
"What the hell is this place? It's so cold…"
Jeffrey said while shivering.
"Mr. Zacharia, if you can't stand the cold, then go back into the car..."
At this moment, Jayson walked to Connor's side and said to Jeffrey with a smile.
"I'll be okay…"
Jeffrey replied in a low voice.
"..."
Jayson looked at Jeffrey indifferently and did not say anything. Instead, he turned and said to Connor, "Mr. McDonald, based on what Henrik said, the Soul Returning Fruit you are looking for is probably in this valley. However, the roads in the valley are perilous. There is no way to drive in by car. We can only walk in…"
"How far away are we from the Soul Returning Fruit?"
Connor asked in a low voice.
"If we walk, we will need at least three hours…"
Jayson replied.
"Three hours?"
Connor was stunned when he heard this.
Connor knew that the environment in the valley was terrible. Ordinary people would not be able to stand it even if they were to stand here for a short while. If these people were to walk in such an environment for more than three hours, more than half of them would collapse.
"It's really cold here. If everyone goes in, they will definitely not be able to come out alive. Maybe I should go in alone…"
Connor thought for a moment and whispered to Jayson.
"Mr. McDonald, if you go in alone, you might not be able to find the location of the Soul Returning Fruit. Even if you find it, you might not be able to walk out of this valley alive. Why don't I go with you?"
Jayson hurriedly said.
"You want to go with me?"
Connor couldn't help but be stunned for a moment after hearing Jayson's words. Then, he smiled and said, "Aren't you afraid of dying in this valley?"
"I've lived in such an environment since I was young. This temperature is nothing to me. Moreover, you've paid me for the job, Mr. McDonald. My mission is to bring you into the mountains and out of the mountains…"
Jayson said seriously.
"If I can really find the Soul Returning Fruit, you will be well-compensated!"
Connor felt that it was indeed very dangerous for him to enter the valley alone. Moreover, Connor did not know the way. If Jayson were with him, it would be able to save him a lot of trouble.
As for the others, they could stay where they were and wait for the two of them to return.
Connor told Jeffrey about the situation. Jeffrey wanted to follow Connor into the valley, but it was freezing out there, so he chose not to go.
Jayson prepared some emergency food and water, then led Connor into the valley.
The situation inside the valley was worse than that on the outside.
Moreover, they could not find any footprints, nor did he find any traces of humans having passed by. This meant that the few big families of Comtar had not been here yet, so it was possible that they had not found the Soul Returning Fruit.
Although Connor and the others entered the mountain late, because Henrik knew the exact location of the Soul Returning Fruit, they were able to get ahead.
Jayson led Connor in with difficulty against the howling cold wind. Connor was doing fine. After all, he was a martial artist and could still use his aura to resist the cold. Therefore, walking was not particularly strenuous.
However, Jayson was just an ordinary person. Even though he lived in such an environment all year round, it was getting difficult for him.
Connor hesitated for a moment and used his aura to cover Jayson's body. This way, Jayson would feel much better.
Jayson felt the change in his body and was shocked. He turned to look at Connor.
"What's wrong?"
Connor asked Jayson with a smile.
"Mr. McDonald, why do I feel much lighter and warmer now?"
Jayson asked in surprise.
"I used my aura to help you. This way, you should be able to save some of your energy…"
Connor replied indifferently.
"Mr. McDonald, you are an angel in disguise! This is the first time I've encountered such a thing…"
Jayson was very surprised by the changes in his body.
"Angel?"
Connor couldn't help but laugh bitterly when he heard Jayson's words. Then, he said lightly, "If only I were an angel, I would be able to save my girlfriend…"
"Mr. McDonald, you're doing all this just to save your girlfriend?"
Jayson asked curiously.
"Yes!"
Connor nodded lightly.
"I'm actually quite curious about your identity. Why don't you tell me about yourself?"
Perhaps it was because of Connor's help, Jayson was feeling much better. At this moment, he was even in the mood to chat with Connor.
Connor had nothing better to do, so he chatted with Jayson and roughly told him what he had been through.
As their attention was diverted while chatting, three hours passed very quickly.
Jayson took out the map and studied it carefully. Then, he frowned and said to Connor, "Mr. McDonald, something is wrong!"
"What's wrong?"
Connor looked at Jayson and asked.
"Henrik said that they found the Soul Returning Fruit after walking around for three hours, but they are all ordinary people, so their walking speed can't be compared to ours. But now, three hours have passed, and we still haven't seen the Soul Returning Fruit."
Jayson said in a puzzled tone.
"This place is covered in snow all year round. It's very likely that the two of us missed the location of the Soul Returning Fruit…"
Connor said in a low voice.
"That's no good. Should we continue walking or go back for now?"
Jayson asked with a frown.
Connor hesitated for a couple of seconds after hearing Jayson's words, then slowly closed his eyes.
Connor felt that the Soul Returning Fruit was a divine herb nurtured by heaven and earth, so the Soul Returning Fruit would definitely emit a different aura from ordinary herbs. Connor planned to use the Chi Observation Technique to see if he could find the location of the Soul Returning Fruit.
A moment later, Connor suddenly felt as if something in his northeast direction was constantly emitting spiritual energy.
"Follow me…"
Connor said to Jayson expressionlessly.
Jayson was stunned for a moment, but he did not ask anything more and hurriedly followed Connor's pace.
Connor quickly walked northeast. After about ten minutes, Connor stopped.
This was because there was a mountain peak in front of him, and the mountain peak was blocking his path.

chapters.title: Chapter 1832: Soul Returning Fruit
chapters.content:
Chapter 1832: Soul Returning Fruit
"Mr. McDonald, we seem to have reached a dead end…"
Jayson said dejectedly.
"That's not right. The aura is clearly in front of us. There must be another way in!"
Connor replied in a low voice and then began to observe the surrounding environment.
A few minutes later, Connor suddenly found a fallen tree.
Connor hurriedly walked to the side of the big tree. After observing it in silence, Connor noticed that the tree seemed to have been pushed down by someone and not blown down by the wind.
"Did something bring me here?"
Connor seemed a little puzzled, and he hurriedly moved the tree trunk.
After the tree trunk had been moved, Connor was a little excited because the tree was blocking a cave entrance. After passing through this cave, he might find the Soul Returning Fruit.
"Let's go in and take a look!"
Connor turned and said to Jayson.
"Alright…"
Jayson hurriedly nodded, and then followed Connor into the cave.
At this time, the cave was pitch black and nothing could be seen. Fortunately, Jayson had prepared a flashlight.
When Jayson turned on the flashlight, he and Connor were stunned. They were in disbelief.
The cave was filled with human corpses.
"Mr... Mr. McDonald, what's going on?"
Jayson stuttered as he asked Connor.
Connor looked at the bones on the ground and hesitated for a couple of seconds. Then, he said in a low voice, "These people have not been dead for long. They should be Henrik's companions..."
"Henrik's companions?"
When Jayson heard Connor's words, he seemed even more puzzled.
Connor finally understood what was going on with the big tree at the entrance of the cave and the bones in the cave.
Obviously, Henrik Whitaker hadn't told Connor the truth.
Henrik and the others might have indeed found the Soul Returning Fruit and encountered wild beasts. However, Henrik didn't survive because he was hiding in the snow and was not discovered by the wild beasts.
He had chosen to sacrifice his companions so that he could survive.
At that time, when they found the wild beasts, they ran to the cave. However, Henrik ran faster than the others. After he ran out of the cave, he was worried that the wild beasts would chase after him, so he tried to push the tree at the entrance of the cave to block the cave.
In this case, not only would the wild beasts be unable to escape, Henrik's companions would also be unable to escape.
Although his companions could move the tree trunk away, they were in a dire situation. Even if they stopped for a moment, they would be eaten by the wild beasts immediately, let alone push the tree trunk at the entrance of the cave.
"I didn't expect Henrik to be so ruthless…"
Connor could not help but sigh.
"Mr. McDonald, what are you talking about?"
Jayson asked Connor in confusion.
"It's nothing…"
Connor lightly shook his head.
Although Connor found Henrik's actions very hard to understand, in a life and death situation, people would put their own survival over others. It was every man for himself.
Everyone had their own choices to make.
Connor took a deep breath and continued walking into the cave.
The cave that Connor and Jayson walked into was actually not very long. It was only about 100 meters long at most. However, because the cave was filled with skeletons, it added a rather terrifying atmosphere to the originally dark cave.
Fortunately, Jayson had a flashlight with him. If he were to walk through the cave in the dark, it would be very scary.
A few minutes later, Connor and Jayson walked out of the cave.
When the two of them walked out of the cave, they were instantly shocked by the scene in front of them.
Because it was snowing outside the cave, there was only a large patch of white as far as the eye could see.
However, there was no wind in this valley, and the temperature seemed to be much higher than it was outside, reaching one or two degrees above zero.
"Isn't this magical?"
Jayson could not help but sigh softly.
Anyone with a little common sense would know that snowflakes would melt if the temperature was above zero degrees celsius.
The temperature in this valley was definitely above zero degrees celsius, but the snowflakes in the valley were not melting.
"Mr. McDonald, that should be the Soul Returning Fruit you're looking for, right?"
At this moment, Jayson suddenly shouted.
Connor hurriedly turned to look at the place where Jayson's finger was pointing. An emerald green plant was there, looking very prominent on the white snow, and at the top of the plant was a fruit. This fruit was exactly the same as the fruit in Jeffrey Zacharia's photo.
"That's right, that's the Soul Returning Fruit!"
Connor replied excitedly.
After so many days of running around, Connor finally found the Soul Returning Fruit. At this moment, Connor felt that his previous efforts were not in vain.
"Mr. McDonald, let's go over there!"
Jayson pulled Connor and shouted.
"Be careful. If what Henrik said is true, then there must be some kind of beast protecting this Soul Returning Fruit…"
Connor was not in a hurry to take the Soul Returning Fruit, but reminded Jayson in a low voice.
"I understand…"
Jayson looked at Connor and nodded his head gently. Then, he slowed down his footsteps and tried his best not to make any sound.
Connor and Jayson carefully walked toward the location of the Soul Returning Fruit.
After more than ten minutes, Connor was less than 100 meters away from the Soul Returning Fruit. At this time, he could finally see what the Soul Returning Fruit looked like.
Roar…
However, just as Connor was about to get closer to the Soul Returning Fruit, a roar suddenly came from the valley.
Thud! Thud!
What followed was the sound of something running.
Moreover, this sound was not made by a person, but the sound of thousands of horses running at the same time.
A few seconds later, Connor and Jayson were both stunned. They were in utter shock.
This was because what appeared in front of them was a wolf-shaped monster that was nearly two meters tall.
Under normal circumstances, a wolf was about one meter tall.
However, the wolf that appeared in front of Connor was at least three to four times the size of an ordinary person.
Moreover, this wolf was just like Mr. Livingston's description. It had a pair of blood-red eyes and white fur. It gave off a very terrifying aura.
"What a huge wolf! Do snow wolves really exist in this world?"
Jayson was filled with fear as he stammered.

chapters.title: Chapter 1833: You Give Up Now?
chapters.content:
Chapter 1833: You Give Up Now?
"Be careful…"
Connor knew that the snow wolf would attack him soon, so he reminded Jayson in a low voice.
"Mr. McDonald, we should leave for now. There seems to be more than one snow wolf here!"
Jayson hurriedly replied.
Connor instinctively looked around him. Jayson was right. At this moment, there was not only one snow wolf, but countless snow wolves were slowly approaching them.
However, the snow wolves around them were not very big. They were about the same size as ordinary wolves, except that their fur was white and their eyes were red.
Right now, the snow wolf in front of Connor was the largest, and it was probably the strongest.
"Mr. McDonald, let's get out of here. Otherwise, we're done for…"
Jayson did not choose to escape alone. Instead, he reached out and pulled Connor.
However, Connor did not budge.
"Mr. McDonald, don't be stupid. We can't deal with these snow wolves…"
Jayson was really anxious.
"I have put in so much effort to find the Soul Returning Fruit. I can't just leave without it!"
Connor whispered back.
"But…"
Jayson opened his mouth and was about to speak.
Roar…
But the next second, the Snow Wolf King suddenly let out a low roar.
In an instant, countless snow wolves charged toward Connor and Jayson.
"Protect yourself!"
Connor shouted at Jayson and immediately rushed forward.
When Jayson saw this scene, he was scared silly. After all, in such a situation, the first thought in a normal person's mind would definitely be to escape. However, Connor was rushing head first into danger.
Bang! Bang!
Connor was very fast. In the blink of an eye, he kicked away two snow wolves.
Connor knew that these snow wolves were very ferocious, so he did not hold back at all when he attacked. Almost every time he attacked, he used all his strength.
In less than half a minute, more than ten snow wolves had been sent flying by Connor.
However, Connor also knew that he would die of exhaustion if he continued fighting like this, so he took out the Five Elements Dagger and roared, "Lightning Rider!"
Boom!
In the next second, a loud bang sounded between heaven and earth.
Countless bolts of lightning descended from the sky and struck the snow wolves around Connor.
Not far away, Jayson stared at Connor who was in the midst of lightning and thunder. At this moment, in Jayson's eyes, Connor was like a deity in a TV series.
Otherwise, he did not know how to explain the fact that Connor could actually use the power of lightning.
"Who is Mr. McDonald?"
Jayson could not help but stutter and sigh.
Perhaps it was because of the deterrent effect of the lightning, but all the snow wolves actually stopped attacking Connor and stared at him with fear.
Roar…
When the Snow Wolf King saw this scene, it let out a furious roar and immediately rushed toward Connor.
The moment the Snow Wolf King attacked, Jayson felt as if a tank had started moving.
The Snow Wolf King opened its bloody mouth and pounced at Connor.
Connor was very fast. He dodged the Snow Wolf King's attack and raised his fist to smash the Snow Wolf King's head.
After the Snow Wolf King took Connor's punch, it paused slightly, but it did not seem to be affected. It continued to rush toward Connor.
However, this time, Connor stood where he was and did not choose to dodge.
Just as the Snow Wolf King's bloody mouth was about to bite Connor, Connor exerted strength on his legs and soared into the air, then landed on the Snow Wolf King's back.
After landing on the Snow Wolf King's back, Connor held the Snow Wolf King's head tightly with one hand, and clenched his other hand into a fist. Then, he punched at the Snow Wolf King's head, one punch after another.
The Snow Wolf King seemed to have gone crazy and was running around, as if it wanted to throw Connor off its body.
However, Connor did not give the Snow Wolf King a chance at all. He punched the Snow Wolf King's head again and again.
He was now a true black rank martial artist and this punch of his could kill a martial artist. One could imagine how terrifying the strength of his fist was.
In the beginning, the Snow Wolf King could barely hold on for a while, but after Connor punched more than ten times in a row, the Snow Wolf King was no longer as crazy as before. Its movements were obviously much slower.
"If you admit defeat now, I can let you off…"
Connor said in a low voice.
Perhaps it was because it had lived beside the Soul Returning Fruit all year round, this Snow Wolf King had some spiritual energy in it, so it seemed to be able to understand Connor. It growled at Connor and then rushed toward the mountain peak not far away.
Boom!
With a loud bang, the Snow Wolf King crashed into the mountain peak.
However, it still could not throw Connor off its body.
"How relentless!"
Connor shouted and once again swung his fist toward the head of the Snow Wolf King.
After Connor punched seven or eight times, the Snow Wolf King finally couldn't hold on any longer and fell to the ground with a bang.
"You give up now?"
Connor looked at the Snow Wolf King and asked.
The Snow Wolf King lay on the ground without making a sound.
Connor stood up after hesitating for a moment, and then said expressionlessly, "You are not my match. This Soul Returning Fruit is extremely important to me. If you admit defeat now, I can let you off. If you do not want to admit defeat, then stand up and continue fighting with me…"
The Snow Wolf King stared at Connor with its red eyes, but it didn't stand up.
"You can leave with your companions…"
To Connor, everything in the world had a spirit, so he did not want to kill the wolf.
Moreover, Connor knew that if he took away the Soul Returning Fruit, it would be equivalent to taking away what these snow wolves relied on to survive. He pitied them.
The reason why these snow wolves gathered here to protect the fruit was because the spiritual energy released by the fruit allowed them to survive without eating anything. Otherwise, it was impossible for so many snow wolves to survive in this world of ice and snow. They had no source of food at all.

chapters.title: Chapter 1834: The Lopez Family
chapters.content:
Chapter 1834: The Lopez Family
The Snow Wolf King looked at Connor and could not help but hesitate.
It slowly stood up and limped away.
Seeing that the wolf king was about to leave, the other snow wolves followed behind him.
For some reason, Connor looked at the backs of these snow wolves and felt a little sorry for them. Because Connor knew that once he took the Soul Returning Fruit, the snow wolves might go extinct.
However, Connor could only selfishly take the Soul Returning Fruit for Freya Phillips.
"Mr. McDonald, you were so amazing just now! Who exactly are you?"
When Jayson saw that all the snow wolves had left, he ran to Connor's side with an excited expression.
"I'm a martial artist. Although there are a lot of snow wolves, they aren't that strong. It might be difficult for ordinary people to deal with these snow wolves, but it's nothing to a martial artist!"
Connor replied in a low voice.
"I've heard a lot about martial artists in the past, but I didn't expect martial artists to be so powerful. You are all like immortals…"
Jayson looked at Connor and said.
"Immortals?"
Connor could not help but laugh when he heard Jayson's words. Then, he sighed softly and said, "It would be great if we martial artists really had the ability of immortals…"
After saying that, Connor walked toward the Soul Returning Fruit.
Without the snow wolf's obstruction, Connor and Jayson quickly walked to the Soul Returning Fruit.
Connor looked at the red fruit in front of him, and he was a little excited. Then, he sighed softly, "I have finally found it…"
After saying that, Connor reached out and plucked the Soul Returning Fruit.
After plucking the Soul Returning Fruit, he took out the container he had prepared in advance and placed the Soul Returning Fruit inside.
When Connor left Porthampton, Josiah Murphy gave him a jade box. This box could ensure that the Soul Returning Fruit would not go bad for a short period of time.
Although the Soul Returning Fruit was a divine herb, it would take Connor a few days to return to Porthampton, so no one could guarantee that the Soul Returning Fruit would not change during this period of time.
However, the jade box that Josiah gave Connor was made of a very special type of jade. It was specially used to store various precious medicinal herbs.
"Jayson, thank you so much for today. If it wasn't for you leading the way, I would never have found the Soul Returning Fruit so easily!"
After putting away the Soul Returning Fruit, Connor whispered to Jayson.
"Mr. McDonald, you're being too polite. I merely led the way. Also, you've also paid me. This is what I should do…"
Jayson said with a smile.
At this moment, he lowered his head in admiration.
"When we get out of here, I'll get my people to give you a large sum of money as a reward!"
Connor said softly.
"Thank you in advance, Mr. McDonald…"
Jayson had always been a straightforward person, so he didn't talk nonsense with Connor.
"Alright, now that I have obtained the Soul Returning Fruit, we can leave this place…"
Connor looked at Jayson and said.
"Yes…"
Jayson nodded gently, then turned around and walked in the direction they came from.
However, before Connor and Jayson could reach the cave, Connor felt an aura approaching them.
However, because the distance was relatively far, Connor could not be sure of the other party's strength.
"Someone is coming…"
Connor told Jayson in a low voice.
Jayson couldn't help but be stunned when he heard Connor's words. Then, he frowned and said, "Mr. McDonald, how do you know that?"
"I can sense the auras of these people…"
Connor said in a low voice.
"Then…Then what should we do now?"
Jayson asked Connor nervously.
"We'll deal with whatever comes our way. Be careful!"
Connor could not find a better way now, so he could only continue walking forward.
A few minutes later, Connor and Jayson finally arrived at the cave.
However, before Connor and Jayson could enter the cave, a group of people walked in from outside.
The leaders were a young man and a woman. These people were all wearing thick down jackets. When they saw Connor and Jayson, they were all stunned.
Connor observed these people briefly and realized that the strongest among them was only a black rank, while the rest were below the yellow rank.
Knowing, Connor relaxed a lot. After all, he was a little worried that there would be martial artists at the grandmaster level. If there were martial artists at the grandmaster level, then things would get troublesome.
"Who are you?"
The young man in the lead sized up Jayson and asked him disdainfully.
"I'm from Comtar. I'm here to pick herbs…"
Jayson saw that there were many people on the other side, so he spoke very politely.
"You can't be here. Get lost!"
The young man scolded in a low voice.
When Jayson heard the young man's words, he became a little angry. He opened his mouth and was about to speak.
However, Connor reached out and pulled Jayson, then said in a low voice, "Let's go!"
At this moment, Connor had already obtained the Soul Returning Fruit. He didn't want to complicate things. Now, he wanted to return to Porthampton as soon as possible and ask Josiah to refine the Soul Returning Pill for Freya.
Jayson hesitated for a moment before walking out of the cave.
The young man didn't seem to know that Connor had already taken the Soul Returning Fruit, so he didn't pay attention to Connor. He only treated Connor and Jayson as ordinary adventurers who came to pick herbs, so he let them go.
When Connor and Jayson walked out of the cave, Connor whispered to Jayson, "Hurry up and run. These people are probably here for the Soul Returning Fruit. If these people discover that the Soul Returning Fruit is missing, they will definitely chase after the two of us…"
"Got it…"
Jayson nodded at Connor and then started running.
After Connor and Jayson left, the young man brought his men and continued to walk into the valley.
This young man was called Cruz Lopez, and he was from the Lopez family of Comtar.
The Lopez family was considered an ancient martial arts family in Comtar. Although they didn't have any ancient martial arts grandmasters, they had a few black ranks.
Cruz was considered one of the best among the younger generation of the Lopez Family.

chapters.title: Chapter 1835: I'm Not Interested In You
chapters.content:
Chapter 1835: I'm Not Interested In You
Some time ago, Cruz had accidentally heard rumors about the Soul Returning Fruit.
Therefore, he found a person who had seen the Soul Returning Fruit before and came to Crimson Peak to search for it.
However, when Cruz saw the branch of the Soul Returning Fruit, he was stunned.
Because the branch of the Soul Returning Fruit was still there, but the Soul Returning Fruit was gone.
"Are you f*cking kidding me? Where is the Soul Returning Fruit?"
Cruz turned around and shouted at the middle-aged man beside him.
"Mr. Cruz, please calm down. I saw the Soul Returning Fruit here back then. But, I don't know why it has disappeared…"
The middle-aged man explained nervously.
"Cruz, it's very likely that those two people stole the Soul Returning Fruit just now…"
At this moment, the girl beside Cruz said.
This woman was Cruz's older sister, Fabiola Lopez. She was also a martial artist.
Fabiola was considered an infamous harlot in Comtar. It was said that she changed partners very often.
However, because of Fabiola's family background, sexy figure, and charming looks, even though many people knew about Fabiola's character, they were still willing to climb into Fabiola's bed and be toyed with by her.
"Yeah. It must be them who stole it. They must want to die badly. They actually dare to steal something that I have my eyes on…"
Cruz suddenly realized something and shouted at his men, "What are you guys still standing there for? Hurry up and chase after them…"
After hearing Cruz's words, everyone turned around and ran toward the cave.
Although Jayson was not a slow runner, he was still a little slower than those martial artists. As Connor did not know the way, he could only follow behind Jayson, which was why Connor was also slowed down by a lot.
About half an hour later, Connor once again felt an aura running in their direction.
"They have caught up…"
Connor whispered to Jayson.
"Then, what should we do, Mr. McDonald?"
Jayson asked nervously.
"What else? We have to get rid of these people. Otherwise, things will get even more troublesome…"
Connor whispered.
"You two, stop right there!"
Just as Connor had finished speaking, Cruz's voice sounded from behind him.
Connor stopped in his tracks helplessly and turned to look at Cruz. He asked Cruz softly, "Is there something you need?"
Cruz sized up Connor and whispered, "Kid, did you take something from the valley just now?"
"Crimson Peak doesn't belong to your family, right? What I have taken has nothing to do with you, right?"
Connor knew that today's battle could not be avoided, so he was being very impolite.
"You're quite arrogant, aren't you? I told you that I'm from the Lopez family of Comtar. You must have taken the Soul Returning Fruit in the valley, right? If you hand over the Soul Returning Fruit to me, I can spare your life today. If you don't hand it over, you will regret it…"
Cruz did not know how strong Connor was. At this moment, he thought that Connor was an ordinary person.
After hearing Cruz's words, Connor sneered and said indifferently, "If you get out of my way now, I can spare your life!"
"What the f*ck did you say?"
After hearing Connor's words, Cruz's expression instantly changed. He glared at Connor and shouted.
"Didn't you hear what I said just now?"
Connor replied indifferently.
"Alright, you brat, I've tried giving you a way out, but you didn't take it. Let me show you how powerful I am today…"
After saying that, Cruz rushed toward Connor.
However, Fabiola suddenly reached out to stop Cruz and said in a coquettish voice, "Cruz, this handsome boy is quite to my liking. Let me have a chat with him…"
"..."
Cruz looked at Fabiola helplessly and did not say anything.
Fabiola walked up to Connor and sized him up. Then, she said sweetly, "Hey handsome, even if you take the Soul Returning Fruit, it won't be of much use to you. At most, you'll get money for it. How about this? Give me the Soul Returning Fruit, and I'll bring you back to Comtar and serve you well for a night. I guarantee that I'll make you feel really good…"
Connor glanced at Fabiola indifferently. Although Fabiola was wearing a thick down jacket, he could still feel that this woman's figure was very hot and sexy. Also, her appearance was also very charming. Her every frown, smile, and action emitted waves of seduction.
"I'm sorry, I'm not interested in a woman like you…"
Connor said placidly.
"Are you sure you're not interested?"
Fabiola smiled and said softly, "I've never met a man who's not interested in me!"
"Tell your people to get lost right now. Don't waste time here. You can't take the Soul Returning Fruit from me today!"
Connor said to Fabiola impatiently.
The expression on Fabiola's face changed slightly, and she said in a low voice, "Handsome boy, it seems like you want to do things the hard way!"
"..."
Connor looked at Fabiola without saying anything.
"Alright, since you think that I'm weak, I'll show you how strong I am…"
Fabiola shouted expressionlessly. Then, she took out a dagger and charged at Connor.
Connor glanced at Fabiola indifferently and stood there without budging.
Cruz looked indifferent. He believed that Connor was just an ordinary person. It would be very easy for Fabiola to deal with an ordinary person.
"Go to hell!"
After Fabiola rushed in front of Connor, she raised the dagger in her hand and stabbed it at Connor's neck.
Fabiola was indeed a very ruthless woman. Her first move was to target the vital parts. It was obvious that she wanted to finish off Connor with one strike.
However, she didn't expect Connor to react so quickly.
Bang!
Just as the dagger was about to pierce Connor's neck, he reached out and grabbed Fabiola's wrist.
Fabiola's expression was one of shock, and she wanted to stab him with all her might.
However, she realized that Connor was way too strong. No matter how hard she tried, she could not move the dagger at all.

chapters.title: Chapter 1836: You Killed My Brother?
chapters.content:
Chapter 1836: You Killed My Brother?
"You think you can kill me?"
Connor's expression was filled with disdain. He then lifted his leg and kicked Fabiola in the stomach.
Fabiola was instantly sent flying and smashed into a tree trunk.
"Pfft!"
Fabiola spat out a mouthful of blood after landing on the ground. She didn't expect Connor to be so strong.
She couldn't even withstand Connor's kick.
Cruz was also shocked when he saw Connor's attack. He did not expect Connor to be a martial artist.
"Who are you? Are you from the Sherman family?"
Cruz glared at Connor and asked.
"Who I am has nothing to do with you. Now, hurry up and get lost. Otherwise, I won't hold back…"
Connor replied indifferently.
Cruz couldn't help but be stunned when he heard Connor's words. Then, he said in a low voice, "Do you think I'm afraid of you just because you're a martial artist?"
"..."
Connor looked at Cruz indifferently and did not say anything.
"Brat, I will let you know how strong I am today…"
Cruz shouted and rushed toward Connor.
Cruz was pretty fast. In the blink of an eye, he had already arrived in front of Connor.
A trace of helplessness flashed across Connor's eyes. After sighing softly, he sent a punch flying.
Cruz did not dare to be careless after seeing Connor's punch. He also threw a punch to meet Connor's incoming fist.
Bang!
There was a loud bang.
Connor's fist collided with Cruz's fist.
However, Connor stood still on the spot, whereas Cruz's body flew backward.
After Connor saw Cruz's body fly backward, he immediately ran after him. Then, he raised his leg and stomped on Cruz's chest.
Bang!
In the next second, Cruz's body crashed into the ground, creating a huge pit.
"Pfft…"
Cruz spat out a mouthful of blood and stared at Connor with an incredulous expression.
Cruz wanted to say something, but before he could say anything, he stopped breathing and was lifeless.
When everyone saw this scene, they were all stunned. They were in disbelief because they did not expect Connor to actually kill Cruz.
"You killed my brother?"
Fabiola pointed at Connor and shouted.
"I already gave you a chance just now, but you didn't know how to cherish it!"
Connor replied in a low voice.
Actually, Connor did not intend to kill Cruz, but these people kept pestering Connor and refused to let him leave. Connor could only kill him as a warning to the others.
"What are you people still standing there for? Hurry up and kill this person!"
Fabiola shouted.
Cruz's subordinates looked at Connor with great fear on their faces. They had already witnessed Connor's ability just now, and they knew how terrifyingly strong Connor was.
Although they had more people on their side, if they really fought, they might not be Connor's match.
These people were hired by Cruz and had no personal relationships with thim. Therefore, they were naturally unwilling to die for him.
"If anyone can kill this person today, I'll reward them with five million dollars, and he can sleep with me for a week!"
Fabiola shouted at the top of her lungs when she saw that everyone was unwilling to make a move.
When the crowd heard Fabiola's words, they all rushed toward Connor as if they had been injected with stimulants.
However, these people were of lower realms than Connor. Even if they attacked Connor together, they were not Connor's match.
In less than a minute, these people were all lying on the ground, rolling around in pain.
Connor had been merciful when facing these people. He did not exert his full strength, so these people were only slightly injured at most.
Fabiola looked at Connor in a daze, utter shock written all over her face.
She didn't think that this young man would have such terrifying combat strength.
"Do you still want the Soul Returning Fruit?"
Connor walked up to Fabiola and asked her expressionlessly.
"Who... Who exactly are you?"
Fabiola stuttered as she asked Connor.
"Who I am has nothing to do with you. If you don't want the Soul Returning Fruit, then I'll be leaving now!"
Connor replied indifferently, then turned around and wanted to leave.
Thud! Thud!
However, the moment Connor turned around, a series of footsteps sounded.
Connor narrowed his eyes and looked ahead.
The three of them walked toward Connor.
The three of them were about the same age as Connor. One of them had dark skin, a strong body, and a rough appearance. The other one looked ordinary but was very tall, almost two meters tall. The last one was very handsome and had red hair.
Connor was a bit shocked when he saw them. They were all black rank.
"The people from the three big families are here?"
Jayson was shocked when he saw the three of them.
Connor turned and looked at Jayson indifferently. He asked Jayson softly, "What three big families?"
"Mr... Mr. McDonald, you are probably not familiar with the families in Comtar. There are a total of four big families in Comtar. Among them, Cohen Felton, who we met before, is from the Felton family. The Felton family is the strongest of them all. There are also the Sherman family, the Warner family, and the Judkins. The three families are slightly weaker than the Felton family, but they are also very powerful…"
"I see!"
Connor replied softly.
"I've seen all three of them before. The dark-skinned one is called Kian Sherman, the tallest one is called Levi Warner, and the blonde is called Marcel Judkins. They are all very strong."
Jayson said nervously.
"I got it…"
Connor looked at Jayson and nodded lightly, not saying anything.
A moment later, Levi, Marcel and Kian walked toward Connor.
When Fabiola saw the three of them, she looked a little excited. She quickly shouted, "Kian, Levi, Marcel, you are finally here. You must avenge my brother!"

chapters.title: Chapter 1837: You'll Know Once You Try
chapters.content:
Chapter 1837: You'll Know Once You Try
When Kian heard Fabiola's words, he slowly raised his head and glanced at her. Then, he frowned and asked, "Fabiola, what happened to your brother?"
"This person snatched the Soul Returning Fruit from Cruz and then killed him…"
Fabiola shouted as she pointed at Connor.
Connor looked helpless when he heard Fabiola's words. Cruz had clearly tried to snatch the Soul Returning Fruit from him and was killed by him, how was it the other way round?
However, Connor was not in the mood to explain these things to these people.
Kian's expression changed when he heard Fabiola's words. He immediately asked Connor, "Brat, the Soul Returning Fruit is in your hands now?"
"What does it have to do with you?"
Connor looked at Kian and asked calmly.
"..."
When Kian heard Connor's words, he was obviously stunned for a moment. He did not expect Connor to be so arrogant.
"How should I address you, brother?"
Marcel hesitated for a moment before asking Connor with a smile.
"Connor McDonald!"
Connor replied indifferently.
"Connor McDonald?"
Marcel, Kian and Levi were stunned when they heard this name.
"Where are you from?"
Levi stepped forward and asked Connor.
"Porthampton, Davenport!"
Connor said softly.
"What?"
In an instant, the three of them widened their eyes, and they were in disbelief.
"You... You're Connor McDonald from Porthampton?"
Kian asked Connor.
"Do you know me?"
Connor felt that Kian's reaction was a little off, so he asked him back.
"How could I not know you? You're the disciple of the famous Jorge Yarrell. You're very famous in the ancient martial arts world of Oprana…"
Kian said sarcastically.
"..."
Connor looked at Kian without saying anything.
"Mr. McDonald, I've heard a lot about you!"
Marcel greeted Connor and then continued, "Just now, Fabiola said that you killed her younger brother, Cruz. Cruz is considered a friend of ours."
"It's true. I did kill Cruz!"
Connor replied.
"Well, since you killed Cruz, you have to give us an explanation!"
Marcel looked at Connor and continued.
"Give you an explanation?"
Connor couldn't help but sneer when he heard this. Then, he said indifferently, "What kind of explanation do you want?"
"Since you're Mr. Yarrell's disciple, we have to give him some face. How about this? Return the fruit that you snatched from Cruz to Fabiola, and we'll let this matter go."
Marcel looked at Fabiola after saying that.
Fabiola hesitated for a couple of seconds. She also knew that Connor was not someone to be trifled with. If she continued to cause trouble, it would not benefit her. Moreover, Cruz's death did not have much of an impact on her. As long as she could get the Soul Returning Fruit, it would be fine.
"I have no objections!"
Fabiola exclaimed.
"You have no objections?"
Connor couldn't help but laugh when he heard Fabiola's words. Then, he said calmly, "You are disregarding your younger brother's death for the sake of a Soul Returning Fruit…"
"Cut the crap. As long as you return the Soul Returning Fruit to me, I'll let you go. Otherwise, don't even think about leaving Crimson Peak today!"
Fabiola shouted at Connor.
"Whether or not I can walk out of here is not up to you guys to decide!"
Connor replied indifferently, and then said to Jayson, "Let's go!"
After saying that, Connor walked forward.
However, Levi, Kian and Marcel stood in front of Connor.
Connor slowly raised his head and looked at the three of them. Then, he said expressionlessly, "If the three of you don't want to die here like Cruz, then get lost!"
When Levi, Marcel, and Kian heard Connor's words, their expressions changed.
The three of them had just received the order from their families to go to the Crimson Peak to look for the Soul Returning Fruit. However, the three of them did not expect to be a step too late. The Soul Returning Fruit had already been taken by Connor.
The three of them were all ancient martial arts practitioners, so they had heard a lot about Connor during this period of time. They knew how strong Connor was.
Therefore, Levi and the others were polite to Connor when they approached him. They were prepared to take the Soul Returning Fruit from Connor's hands without making a move.
However, they never thought that Connor would be so unyielding. Even when facing the three of them alone, he didn't show any fear. On the contrary, he was very arrogant.
Marcel hesitated for a moment before whispering to Connor, "Mr. McDonald, I know that you are strong, but you killed our people in the Crimson Peak and even snatched the Soul Returning Fruit. This isn't right. The three of us are only letting you off on account of Mr. Yarrell. Perhaps it's best you consider the current situation you are in…"
"Yeah, Connor, no matter how strong you are, you're just a black rank martial artist, and the three of us are also black rank. Are you planning to kill all three of us? Are you able to do that?"
Kian shouted with disdain.
"The three of you will know if I am able to do that or not if you try…"
If it was under normal circumstances, Connor would not want to have any conflict with these three people. However, the Soul Returning Fruit was the only hope to save Freya Phillips. Therefore, even if Connor had to risk his life, he would not give up on the Soul Returning Fruit.
"You are really arrogant!"
Levi looked at Connor and sighed softly.
"Alright, let's stop talking nonsense with this brat. Since we are nothing to him, we'll have to show him with our skills…"
Kian said in a low voice.
"Looks like this is the only way…"
Marcel nodded helplessly.
The Soul Returning Fruit was too tempting for cultivators. Kian, Marcel, and Levi had already discussed it beforehand. Once they obtained the Soul Returning Fruit, the three of them would find the best alchemist in Comtar to refine the Soul Returning Fruit into three pills. Then, the three of them would each take one.
But now that Connor wanted to monopolize the Soul Returning Fruit, these people definitely wouldn't let Connor leave.
Of course, if Connor proposed to share the Soul Returning Fruit with the three of them, perhaps the three of them would consider it.

chapters.title: Chapter 1838: Power of Lightning
chapters.content:
Chapter 1838: Power of Lightning
When Fabiola heard what they said, she looked a little excited.
Because she felt that Connor was definitely not a match for these three people. If Connor died, then she might be able to get a portion of the Soul Returning Fruit. This was a great thing for her.
Although Cruz was dead, it didn't matter to Fabiola whether he was dead or not.
"I've long heard that Mr. Yarrell's disciple is very powerful. Even Wadi Jimenez, the grandson of Faris Jimenez, the No. 1 master in Honduria, couldn't defeat him."
Kian shouted as he walked toward Connor.
Recently, there had been a lot of rumors about Connor in the ancient martial arts world. Many martial artists felt that Connor was the number one person among the younger generation of ancient martial arts in Oprana.
This also caused many young martial artists to be somewhat dissatisfied with Connor. They all wanted to find an opportunity to challenge Connor.
Kian and the others were the most outstanding young martial artists in Comtar, so they naturally had such thoughts in their hearts.
"Kian, be careful…"
Marcel couldn't help but remind Kian.
"Relax. I will never be careless when facing such an opponent…"
Kian replied indifferently. Then, he took out a long sword from his back.
When Levi saw this scene, he could not help but laugh. Then, he sighed softly and said, "Looks like Kian is really serious today. He's taking out their Sherman family's Sky Lightning Sword…"
"Connor, you asked for all of this. Don't blame me for not giving you a chance…"
Kian growled and swung his sword.
Boom!
A clap of thunder sounded between heaven and earth.
Immediately after, a bolt of lightning struck Connor's position.
Jayson was dumbstruck when he saw the lightning, because Connor had also used this move against the snow wolves.
However, Kian's lightning seemed to be more destructive than Connor's.
When Connor saw the lightning coming toward him, he quickly dodged the lightning attack.
Connor narrowed his eyes as he looked at Kian. He knew that the sword in Kian's hand was also a divine weapon and had the ability to control lightning. As Connor had the Five Elements Dagger, he was not as surprised that Kian could control lightning.
After all, Connor could use the Five Elements Dagger to control the invisible force. As such, other martial artists would definitely be able to use divine weapons to control various forces.
When Kian saw that Connor had dodged the lightning, a strange look flashed across his face. He said softly, "It seems that you really are quite capable seeing that you were able to react to that…"
"..."
Connor looked at Kian expressionlessly without saying anything.
At this moment, Connor knew that he was facing three enemies and not just Kian alone. Therefore, he had to be careful and not reveal any flaws. Otherwise, if these three people seized the opportunity, Connor would be in a very bad situation.
"Lightning Sword!"
Kian suddenly shouted and stabbed his sword at Connor.
At this moment, the sword in Kian's hand was filled with the power of lightning. Waves of lightning flashed, giving off an extremely terrifying feeling.
Not far away, Fabiola was a little shocked when she saw this scene. She could feel how terrifying the difference in strength between her and Kian was. Just this sword strike alone was enough to take her life.
Kian was a black rank martial artist, and he had the Sky Lightning Sword in his hand. His capabilities were naturally not something a normal martial artist like Fabiola could compare to.
Of course, this was not the most terrifying thing.
The most terrifying thing was that Connor would not only have to face Kian alone today. Marcel and Levi were watching coldly from the sidelines and had not made a move. Once these two people made a move, even an ancient martial arts grandmaster would have to avoid them!
When Connor saw the sword in Kian's hand stabbing toward him, he was very calm. This time, he did not choose to dodge, but instead, he fiercely punched toward Kian.
Connor's punch was not very fast, but it contained extremely terrifying power. Moreover, with the help of the Five Elements Dagger, Connor's fist also contained the power of lightning.
Boom!
Connor's fist collided with Kian's sword. The collision of the two forces produced a terrifying impact, and the surrounding snow instantly flew into the air.
However, Connor did not seem to be affected too much. He stood there expressionlessly.
Kian stared at Connor with an incredulous expression.
"You can actually use the power of lightning?"
Kian took two steps back and shouted.
Connor glanced at Kian without saying anything.
"Kian, be careful. He seems to have some kind of divine artifact protecting him…"
Levi reminded him.
"I got it…"
Kian shouted through gritted teeth, and then rushed toward Connor again.
Kian held his sword and slashed down toward Connor's head.
Although Kian's move looked very simple and unadorned, the energy contained in this sword was even more terrifying than the previous one.
When Connor saw Kian attack again, he immediately took out the Five Elements Dagger and shielded himself.
Bang!
Kian's Sky Lightning Sword and Connor's Five Elemental Dagger collided fiercely.
Connor took a step back, and Kian was also shocked by his own strength. He took two steps back before stabilizing himself.
Marcel narrowed his eyes and looked at the dagger in Connor's hand. He could not help but sigh softly, "This is why he is so arrogant. It turns out that he actually has the Five Elements Dagger!"
"How did the Five Elements Dagger end up in Connor's hands?"
Levi was in disbelief.
"I'm not sure…"
Marcel shook his head.
"Fire Fist!"
At this moment, Connor suddenly roared and charged toward Kian.
At this moment, Connor's fist was already ignited with flames. This scene was really magical in the eyes of an ordinary person like Jayson.
Kian suddenly raised his head and looked at Connor. As Connor was shockingly fast, he did not have any time to dodge. He could only block using the Sky Lightning Sword.

chapters.title: Chapter 1839: What Fist Technique is This?
chapters.content:
Chapter 1839: What Fist Technique is This?
Bang!
Connor's fist fiercely smashed onto the Sky Lightning Sword.
Rumble…
A huge energy impact instantly swept across everyone present.
When Marcel and Levi felt the power of Connor's punch, their faces were filled with shock because they did not expect Connor's strength to be so terrifying.
Kian was able to hold on for a while at the beginning, but as the energy impact became stronger and stronger, he seemed to be unable to hold on any longer.
"Break!"
Connor shouted and punched Kian again.
Although the power of this punch was not as strong as the previous one, it was still very terrifying.
Kian's body was instantly sent flying, and he smashed into the ground, creating a huge pit.
Marcel and Levi looked at Kian, who had fallen to the ground, with eyes wide open.
The three of them thought that Connor was just a black rank, and that his strength wasn't too far off from theirs. As such, they did not think much of him. Now, things had changed.
"This is why the rumors about him are insanely wild. He really is capable!"
Marcel could not help but sigh softly.
"Yeah, to be chosen by someone like Mr. Yarrell, he must be an existence with extraordinary talent!"
Levi nodded lightly.
However, at this moment, Kian stood up from the ground. He looked to be in a sorry state with his clothes all tattered.
"Kian, are you alright?"
Marcel hesitated for a moment before calling out to Kian.
"I was careless earlier…"
Kian gritted his teeth and replied.
Connor narrowed his eyes and looked at Kian without saying anything.
After taking a deep breath, Kian whispered to Connor, "Connor, I have indeed underestimated you earlier. Today, I will show you how strong I am…"
After saying that, Kian took out a pill from his clothes and threw it into his mouth.
"Lightning Gathering Pill!"
Marcel was shocked when he saw Kian eat the pill.
"I didn't expect Kian to take the Lightning Gathering Pill. Looks like he is really serious today…"
Levi said expressionlessly.
The Lightning Gathering Pill was a pill created by the Sherman family. Moreover, only the Sherman family members could take it because most of the Sherman family's martial artists have learned the power of lightning. Once they took the pill, it was equivalent to letting the power of lightning flow through their meridians.
Ordinary martial artists could not withstand the power of lightning at all, but because the martial artists of the Sherman family had been exposed to the power of lightning since they were young, not only could they withstand it, but it could also increase their strength greatly.
The Lightning Gathering Pill was actually the same thing as the Chi Receiving Pill that Connor had. It could allow a martial artist's strength to skyrocket for a short period of time, but it would also have a considerable impact on the martial artist's body.
Originally, Levi and Marcel were already prepared to help, but when they saw Kian taking the Lightning Gathering Pill, they forgo that idea.
Soon, lightning began to appear around Kian's body, making people feel as if he was being electrocuted. The current flowed through Kian's body like blood.
"What kind of monsters are these people?"
Jayson, who was not far away, widened his eyes when he saw this scene. He was extremely shocked.
