Jayson couldn't understand how a person could still be alive after being filled with electricity!
"Connor, I will let you experience my strength today…"
Kian shouted at Connor at the top of his lungs and then rushed toward Connor.
It was obvious that Kian's speed was many times faster than before. In the blink of an eye, he had arrived in front of Connor.
Connor did not show any fear when facing Kian. On the contrary, he was very calm.
After Kian rushed in front of Connor, he raised his fist and smashed it toward Connor's chest.
Bang!
The fist ruthlessly smashed into Connor's chest. Connor took two steps back, and then without any hesitation, he let out a punch.
At this moment, Kian and Connor were ready for close combat.
Their speed was very shocking. In the blink of an eye, they had thrown more than ten punches at each other.
The expressions of Levi and Marcel, who were standing at the side and watching the show, turned ugly. This was because the two of them knew how terrifying Kian's strength was after consuming the Lightning Gathering Pill. Even the two of them might not be able to defeat Kian.
However, Connor was actually able to fight Kian back and forth. They were completely on par. This was enough to prove how terrifying Connor's strength was.
"The power of lightning in Kian's body is gradually weakening. If this continues on, he might lose!"
Marcel said in a low voice.
"Yeah, maybe I should help him out."
Levi said slowly.
However, before Levi could make a move, Connor suddenly roared in anger. Then, he raised his fist and ruthlessly smashed it on Kian's chest.
Boom!
A muffled sound.
Connor's punch made a very strange sound as if it had hit an ancient bell.
After Kian took Connor's punch head-on, he realized that the power of Connor's punch was not particularly shocking, so he was somewhat puzzled.
However, in the next second, Kian's expression began to change.
He could feel an extremely powerful force flowing crazily in his body.
"Break!"
At this moment, Connor suddenly called out.
Bang!
With a loud bang, an extremely powerful force exploded in Kian's body.
It felt like a bomb had been placed inside Kian's body. At first, he couldn't feel how terrifying the bomb was, but when the bomb exploded, he realized how terrifying Connor's punch was.
"Pfft…"
Kian spat out a mouthful of blood and took a few steps back. He almost fell to the ground.
"What fist technique is this?"
Kian shouted at Connor.
Just now, he had clearly eaten the Lightning Gathering Pill, but he realized that he was still not Connor's match. Although Kian's realm was slightly lower than Connor's, the Lightning Gathering Pill could completely make up for the difference in realm.
However, what Kian couldn't understand was why he still couldn't defeat Connor.

chapters.title: Chapter 1840: Go to Hell!
chapters.content:
Chapter 1840: Go to Hell!
Connor looked at Kian indifferently and didn't answer his question. Instead, he charged at Kian again.
Kian was filled with fear. He instinctively wanted to dodge Connor's punch.
However, what he didn't expect was that the power of Connor's punch was way too terrifying. The power of lightning in Kian's body had all been scattered. Although Kian could still move at this moment, it was absolutely impossible for him to dodge Connor's punch with his speed.
"It's over…"
Kian's face was filled with fear.
Connor's punch just now almost took half of his life. If he was hit by Connor's punch, then he would probably die.
"Kian, let me help you!"
However, at this moment, Levi, who was not far away, shouted.
Kian hurriedly turned around and saw Levi rushing in front of him. With a wave of his right hand, countless auras erupted from Levi's body, forming a protective barrier around Kian.
Bang!
With a loud bang, Connor's fist smashed into Kian's body.
However, because of Levi's protection, most of the power of Connor's punch was offset by the protective barrier, and Kian barely withstood Connor's punch.
After Kian took Connor's punch, he took two steps back and stared at Connor with a solemn expression.
"You're next?"
Connor slowly raised his head and looked at Levi in front of him.
"Kian was a little careless just now. Let me fight you!"
Levi replied indifferently.
"You are my opponent now?"
Connor couldn't help but laugh coldly. He then took out the Five Elements Dagger and shouted in a low voice, "Fire Controlling Technique!"
In an instant, countless fireballs flew across the sky, and then they flew crazily toward Levi like bombs.
A strange look flashed across Levi's face when he saw that. Then, he shouted in a low voice, "Snow Wall!"
In the next second, the snow on the ground flew up and quickly formed a high wall in front of Levi.
It was obvious that Levi was using his aura to control these snowflakes.
Countless fireballs hit the snow wall.
These fireballs were like bombs. When the fireballs hit the wall, they exploded instantly, and the snow wall trembled slightly.
Levi was somewhat shocked, because he didn't expect Connor's fireballs to be so powerful.
A few minutes later, the snow wall in front of Levi began to shake violently, as if it would collapse at any time.
Marcel narrowed his eyes and looked at Levi. He looked very serious because he knew Levi's strength very well. If Levi's snow wall could not block Connor's fireballs, then the three of them might really be in big trouble today.
However, as Connor's last fireball smashed into the snow wall, the snow wall that was in danger still persisted.
Levi saw that Connor's fireballs had already disappeared and let out a long sigh of relief. He knew that if there had been more of Connor's fireballs, he might not have been able to hold on.
"Levi, I heard from my grandfather that although the power of the Five Elements Dagger is terrifying, the Five Elements Dagger can't be used at any time. After releasing these fireballs, the Five Elements Dagger can't continue to use the power of the five elements for a short period of time…"
Marcel reminded Levi in a low voice.
"Alright…"
Levi nodded his head lightly and then rushed toward Connor.
Connor also knew that the Five Elements Dagger could no longer be used, so he put away the Five Elements Dagger and began to fight with Levi.
Levi seemed to be slightly stronger than Kian. His speed and strength were also very shocking. In addition, Connor had used up a portion of his aura when facing Kian. Therefore, Connor did not have any advantage in the battle between Levi and Connor. On the contrary, Connor had been deliberately stalling for time to allow his body to recover a little.
Levi seemed to have noticed that Connor was deliberately stalling for time, so he did not intend to give Connor a chance at all and increased his attack speed.
Bang! Bang!
In the blink of an eye, Levi had punched out more than ten times in a row.
Levi used his full strength for almost every punch. After Connor forcefully took Levi's punches, he retreated seven or eight steps before stabilizing his body.
"Huff…"
Connor leaned against a big tree, panting heavily. He seemed a little tired.
"Levi, well done!"
Kian shouted excitedly at Levi when he saw this scene.
On the other hand, Levi ignored Kian. Although he had the upper hand just now, Levi knew in his heart that his attacks did not seem to bring any substantial damage to Connor. It only consumed a portion of Connor's physical strength.
'What kind of monster is this person? Why is he so much stronger than me when there's not a big difference between our cultivation levels…'
Levi could not help but sigh deep down.
At this time, Connor seemed to have recovered and walked toward Levi.
"Today, I'll show you how strong I am!"
Levi was a little angry. Then, he suddenly waved his right hand.
In an instant, countless icicles shot out from the sky.
"Go to hell!"
Levi growled.
The icicles were like bullets, flying toward Connor.
"Just in time…"
Connor couldn't help but sneer when he saw these icicles. Then, he began to circulate the Chi Circulation Technique in his body.
"Chi Circulation Technique, ninth move, Twisting Heaven and Earth!"
Connor growled.
In the next second, an extremely terrifying aura erupted from Connor's body.
When Levi felt the aura inside Connor's body, his face was filled with fear. He felt that the aura that Connor was releasing wasn't something a black rank could have.
However, in the next second, Levi was even more shocked.
He didn't know what method Connor used to make those icicles that were originally flying toward him change directions.
Those icicles were now all flying toward Levi.
"How is that possible?"
Kian was shocked when he saw this scene from afar.
Even Marcel revealed a rare trace of surprise because he had never encountered such a move.

chapters.title: Chapter 1841: Body Refining Technique
chapters.content:
Chapter 1841: Body Refining Technique
Recently, Connor had already practiced the Chi Circulation Technique to the ninth level.
However, the ninth level of the Chi Circulation Technique was precisely this move, twisting Heaven and Earth. It could use one's aura to transform the enemy's move into one's own move.
Levi knew how strong his icicles were, so he did not dare to be careless at all. He hurriedly erected a snow wall in front of him.
Countless icicles smashed into the snow wall.
In the beginning, the snow wall was able to resist it, but later on, the snow wall exploded.
Levi had no choice but to dodge the icicles in the air. Although Levi's reaction speed was very shocking, the icicles were too fast and there were too many of them. Therefore, Levi's body was still scratched by the icicles.
Connor took advantage of the time when Levi was focusing most of his energy on dealing with the icicles to rush in front of Levi. Then, he raised his fist and fiercely smashed it on Levi's chest.
Bang!
There was then a loud bang.
Levi felt as if he had been hit by a truck. His body flew out in an instant and finally smashed into a big tree.
"Levi!"
When Kian saw that Levi was in danger, he roared angrily and rushed toward Connor again.
Levi took Connor's punch head-on. Although he didn't lose his fighting strength, he was still heavily injured. However, he didn't have the mood to care about all that at the moment. He could only grit his teeth and continue to rush toward Connor.
At this moment, Connor was facing Levi and Kian alone.
However, because these two people had been seriously injured, it was impossible for these two people to be Connor's match. Even if it was a 1v2 situation, these two people still did not have any advantage over him.
Fabiola Lopez stood in the distance and looked at Connor. She was utterly shocked. She didn't expect Connor to be so terrifyingly strong.
In the beginning, Fabiola treated Connor as an ordinary black rank, but now she realized that Connor's combat power wasn't as simple as she had imagined.
Bang!
At this moment, Connor kicked Kian in the stomach.
Kian was sent flying once again before he crashed into a huge tree.
Immediately after, Connor's fist smashed into Levi's face, and Levi was also sent flying.
Levi and Kian, who were already heavily injured, were not Connor's match at all.
Kian stared at Marcel with his eyes wide open. Then, he shouted at the top of his lungs, "Marcel, what are you doing?! Are you going to just watch as the two of us fall in Connor's hands?"
"Kian, what are you saying? How could I watch the two of you die?"
Marcel replied with a smile. Then, he reached out and took out a porcelain bottle from his clothes and threw it to Kian. He said indifferently, "This is our family's Essence Replenishing Pill. You and Levi should take a rest for now. I'll fight this guy!"
"Essence Replenishing Pill?"
When Kian heard Marcel's words, he perked up. Then, he hurriedly poured out the pills in the bottle and ate one himself. Then, he threw another one to Levi.
In the eyes of martial artists, the Essence Replenishing Pill was also considered a very top-notch medicinal pill. As long as a martial artist who was seriously injured consumed the Essence Replenishing Pill, it would take at most two hours for him to recover to his original state.
Kian and Levi did not expect Marcel to be so generous this time to offer them the pill.
However, Marcel also had his own plans. According to the battle just now, Marcel knew that Connor was terrifyingly strong. If they fought alone, the three of them would not be Connor's match. Even if the two of them joined forces, they might not be able to defeat Connor. Therefore, if the three of them wanted to defeat Connor today, they had to attack together and use their full strength.
Now that Kian and Levi had suffered such serious injuries, they did not have any combat strength to speak of at all. Therefore, Marcel could only bear the pain and offer them the Essence Replenishing Pill.
Compared to the Soul Returning Fruit, the Essence Replenishing Pill was very insignificant.
In order to buy some time for Kian and Levi, Marcel walked in front of Connor and said to Connor with a smile, "Mr. McDonald, your opponent is me now!"
"Stop talking nonsense and just attack!"
Connor replied expressionlessly.
Marcel took a deep breath and began to circulate the aura in his body.
A moment later, Marcel's body emitted bursts of golden light, and his skin seemed to gradually turn golden.
"Body Refining Technique?"
When Connor saw the changes in Marcel's body, he could not help but frown slightly.
Back then, Connor heard from Jorge Yarrell that many martial artists started to practice body refining techniques at a very young age. Once they practiced body refining techniques to a certain extent, their bodies would undergo changes. According to the different types of body refining techniques, the degree of changes in their bodies would also be different.
However, most body refining techniques could allow the human body to undergo a qualitative change. They could even allow the body to reach the hardness of steel.
"That's right. It's the body refining technique!"
Marcel looked at Connor with a faint smile and then rushed toward Connor.
Connor did not hesitate after seeing Marcel attack and rushed forward.
A long saber had appeared in Marcel's hand, but Connor knew that it was not a real saber. It was formed by the aura in Marcel's body.
The long saber slashed down toward Connor, bringing with it a sharp and whistling cold wind. It gave people the feeling that it could cut through everything in the world.
A strange look flashed across Connor's face. Then, he flashed and dodged the long saber that was coming at him. He then turned around and punched Marcel's body.
Bang!
There was a loud bang.
After Connor's fist smashed onto Marcel's body, it gave Connor the feeling as if he had smashed onto a huge rock. The other party did not react at all. On the contrary, his hands were shaking to the point where it hurt.
"Your body is so tough…"
Connor's expression changed as he whispered to Marcel.
"Even a bullet can't penetrate my body, much less your fist…"
Marcel said proudly.
"Even bullets can't penetrate your body?"
Connor could not help but sneer when he heard Marcel's words. Then, he said indifferently, "Then I want to see if I can penetrate your body today…"

chapters.title: Chapter 1842: Are You Threatening Me?
chapters.content:
Chapter 1842: Are You Threatening Me?
After saying that, Connor rushed toward Marcel again.
"Seven-Star Big Dipper Fist, Heaven Breaking!"
"Die!" Connor roared. Then, he used all his strength to punch Marcel in the chest.
However, Marcel only took two steps back. He was still very calm, as if he was not affected at all.
At this moment, Marcel had no intention of attacking Connor because he felt that it was absolutely impossible for him to defeat Connor alone. If he attacked now, it would only be a waste of his strength.
Therefore, Marcel planned to use his body to stall for time. He was very confident in his body refining technique. In a short period of time, Connor would not be able to hurt him at all.
He was prepared to wait for Levi and Kian to recover, then the three of them would work together to get rid of Connor.
Connor naturally knew what Marcel was planning, but he had no choice but to think of a way to get rid of Marcel first.
Boom! Boom! Boom!
Connor punched Marcel in the chest seven or eight times in a row. At first, Marcel didn't seem to have any reaction, but as Connor's fists gradually landed on his body, he vaguely felt that something was wrong.
Because he realized that his body did not seem to be as strong as before.
"What's going on?"
Marcel looked confused.
Bang!
At this moment, Connor once again punched Marcel's body.
Marcel took two steps back and looked down at his chest. He realized that there was a deep hole in his chest.
"You can actually hurt me?"
Marcel roared at Connor.
"Before absolute strength, nothing is invincible!"
Connor replied indifferently.
"What kind of fist technique is this?"
Marcel had never thought that he would not be able to hold on for more than two minutes when facing Connor, and his body was already unable to hold on any longer.
"That has nothing to do with you!"
Connor replied in a low voice. Then, he raised his fist and smashed it toward Marcel's chest again.
Bang!
There was a loud bang.
Connor's punch landed heavily on Marcel's chest.
Marcel was instantly sent flying, and then he crashed heavily onto the ground.
After landing on the ground, the golden light on Marcel's body gradually dimmed, and he seemed to be in pain. He held his chest with his right hand and struggled to stand up, but the power of Connor's punch was too terrifying.
At this moment, Marcel could not stand up at all.
"Marcel!"
"Marcel!"
Kian and Levi, who were still resting, shouted when they saw this scene.
The two of them thought that Marcel would be able to hold on for a while against Connor and buy them some time. However, they didn't expect Marcel to fall so quickly.
"And you two!"
Connor knew that Marcel had completely lost the ability to resist, so he turned to look at Kian and Levi.
"Kian, what should we do now?"
Levi asked Kian nervously.
"Think of a way to escape. Marcel is in no state to fight. Even if the two of us join hands, we might not be a match for Connor…"
Kian gritted his teeth and replied in a low voice.
Levi sighed helplessly.
At this moment, Connor had already rushed toward the two of them.
Levi suddenly waved his right hand, and a gust of wind suddenly rose. It was mixed with countless snowflakes that were directed toward Connor.
"Kian, run!"
Levi shouted, then stood up and ran into the distance.
However, Connor had no intention of letting these two people go. He reached out and grabbed Levi's arm, then flung him hard.
Levi's body was flung like a rubber ball by Connor, and then he smashed into a tree not far away.
"Pfft"
Levi spat out a mouthful of blood. He was in great pain.
On the other side, Connor saw that Levi had already lost his fighting strength and did not continue to attack. Instead, he rushed toward Kian.
Kian, who was already heavily injured, was far slower than Connor.
"It might be too late to run now!"
After catching up to Kian, Connor raised his fist and smashed it toward Kian's back.
Bang!
There was a loud bang.
Kian staggered a couple of steps and fell to the ground.
In the blink of an eye, Kian, Levi, and Marcel all fell to the ground. Moreover, the three of them had completely lost their ability to fight.
Marcel looked at Connor with an expression of despair on his face. He thought that he could hold on and stall for some time, but it was because of his wrong decision that the three of them ended up like this.
If the three of them had attacked together from the beginning, they might have had some chance of winning.
However, it was too late for the three of them to regret now.
Fabiola Lopez stood in the distance and looked at Connor with fear written all over her face. She didn't expect the three most famous martial artists of the younger generation in Comtar to not be able to defeat Connor even after joining forces. One could imagine how terrifying Connor's strength was.
"Mr. McDonald, the three of us have lost today. I hope that you can let the three of us off for the sake of our families!"
Marcel knew that the winner was king. If they still refuse to admit defeat, then they might all die at Connor's hands today.
Connor couldn't help but laugh when he heard Marcel's words. Then, he said indifferently, "You seem quite happy to admit defeat…"
"..."
Marcel had never been insulted like this before, but the current situation did not allow him to speak freely, so he looked at Connor and did not say anything.
"Mr. McDonald, the three of us are from the ancient martial arts aristocratic families of Comtar. If you kill the three of us today, even if you can walk out of Crimson Peak, you can forget about walking out of Comtar!"
Levi gritted his teeth and said.
"Are you threatening me?"
Connor glanced at Levi indifferently.
"I'm not threatening you. I'm just reminding you not to go too far. It won't do you any good!"
Levi said in a low voice.
Connor looked at Levi and hesitated for a couple of seconds. Then, he said expressionlessly, "If I let the three of you go today, when the three of you walk out of the Crimson Peak, the whole world will know that the Soul Returning Fruit is in my hands. It means that I will be bringing even more trouble to myself. However, if I kill you now, no one will know that I took the Soul Returning Fruit, and no one will know that I killed you!"

chapters.title: Chapter 1843: The Felton Family Head
chapters.content:
Chapter 1843: The Felton Family Head
Connor didn't want to kill them as he didn't have any grudges against Levi, Kian, Marcel. There was no need to kill them.
However, this matter was different from other things. The Soul Returning Fruit was very important to Connor.
No matter what price he had to pay, Connor had to bring the Soul Returning Fruit back to Porthampton.
When Levi and the other two heard Connor's words, they were stunned. They stared at Connor with their eyes wide open and didn't say anything.
"If you were in the same situation, what would the three of you choose?"
Connor asked again.
"Mr. McDonald, as long as you don't kill the three of us today, we will agree to any conditions you propose!"
Marcel shouted nervously.
"I'm sorry, but the three of you have no value in my eyes!"
Connor lightly shook his head.
When Marcel saw Connor's firm attitude, his face showed some despair.
At this moment, Marcel was filled with regret. He regretted that he should not have provoked Connor. If he had known that Connor's strength was so terrifying, he would not have dared to attack Connor even if he had ten thousand guts!
Kian and Levi were naturally in despair, but they couldn't find any way to make Connor let them go.
Connor took out the Five Elements Dagger and walked toward Marcel.
"..."
Marcel stared at Connor and shouted in a low voice, "Connor, if you dare to kill me today, the Judkins family will definitely not let you off…"
"It's useless for you to threaten me now…"
Connor replied indifferently. Then, he raised his dagger and was about to stab Marcel in the chest.
However, the moment Connor's dagger was about to land, a cold light flashed.
Bang!
A stone hit Connor's wrist. Connor's wrist shook and the Five Elements Dagger fell to the ground.
"Who's there?"
Connor felt an extremely powerful aura slowly approaching. He became somewhat vigilant.
"Young man, don't be too ruthless!"
Although Connor didn't see anyone approaching, he could clearly hear this person's voice.
Connor looked around to determine the other party's location, but the other party's strength seemed to be far above Connor. Connor had no way to determine where this person's aura was coming from.
Marcel, Levi, and Kian were also very confused because they had no idea who had saved them.
Thud! Thud!
At this moment, footsteps sounded.
An old man in a white robe slowly walked over from afar.
Right now, the temperature in the Crimson Peak was at least -10 °C. Even a black rank like Connor and Marcel needed to wear a down jacket and use their breathing to keep warm.
However, the old man who was walking over was only wearing a long robe. He looked really thin, but the old man was walking very quickly. He was also very calm, as if he did not feel the cold at all.
"Grandpa Felton!"
When Marcel saw the old man, he was a little excited.
"It's Grandpa Felton. We're saved…"
Levi also shouted.
"Connor, you're dead today. Grandpa Felton is here!"
Kian gritted his teeth and shouted at Connor.
"Grandpa Felton?"
Connor's expression was a little puzzled hearing the words of these three people.
After hesitating for a couple of seconds, Jayson Hardy, "Mr. McDonald, I've seen this person before. He's the head of the Felton family, the number one family in Comtar!"
"..."
Connor turned to look at Jayson, took a deep breath, and didn't say anything.
At this moment, Connor could feel that Draco Felton's strength was far above his. Draco was most probably a genuine ancient martial arts grandmaster.
As long as Connor didn't encounter any ancient martial arts grandmaster, he could fight anyone. However, the combat power of an ancient martial arts grandmaster was way too terrifying. Even if Connor had the help of the dragon pendant and the Five Elements Dagger, he was still not a match for an ancient martial arts grandmaster.
Connor began to plan what he should do next.
At this moment, Draco had already walked up to Connor. Then, he sized Connor up and said with a smile, "Young people are truly remarkable. As Mr. Yarrell's disciple, you are indeed extraordinary. You defeated three of Comtar's young talents by yourself."
"Are you the Feltons' family head?"
Connor asked in a low voice.
"That's right, I'm Draco Felton, the head of the Felton family in Comtar!"
Draco nodded gently and continued, "Mr. McDonald, I have met your master once. The families of these three people are considered friends with the Felton family, so I wonder if Mr. McDonald can give me face and let them go?"
Connor sized up Draco. He knew very well that if he fought with Draco, he had no chance of winning. If he let Marcel and the other two go and Draco let him leave, that would be the best outcome.
"Since Mr. Felton has already spoken, I will definitely give you face…"
Connor said in a low voice.
"Thank you, Mr. McDonald, for giving me face!"
Draco smiled happily.
Connor hesitated for a moment, then said to Jayson behind him, "Let's go!"
At this moment, Connor only had one thought in his heart, and that was to seize the chance to leave this troublesome place.
"Alright…"
Jayson then quickly followed Connor.
"Mr. McDonald, have you forgotten one thing?"
However, Connor had only walked less than ten meters when Draco's voice sounded again.
After hearing Draco's words, Connor paused slightly and then stopped in his tracks.
In fact, he had long guessed that Draco would not let him go easily.
"Is there anything else?"
Connor turned to look at Draco and asked Draco expressionlessly.
"Mr. McDonald, the Soul Returning Fruit is in your hands, right?"
Draco asked with a smile.
"..."
Connor looked at Draco without saying anything.
"The Soul Returning Fruit is a sacred item in the Crimson Peak of Comtar. No one can take the Soul Returning Fruit out of the Crimson Peak, so I hope that you can hand over the Soul Returning Fruit. As long as you hand over the Soul Returning Fruit, no one will pursue what you have done today!"
Draco's tone was very calm when he said this, but Connor could hear that Draco was threatening him.

chapters.title: Chapter 1844: Entrusted by Someone
chapters.content:
Chapter 1844: Entrusted by Someone
"Mr. Felton, I've taken the Soul Returning Fruit to save someone."
"If you let me take the Soul Returning Fruit today, I will agree to any request you make in the future!"
Connor knew that he was not Draco's match, so he was not going to turn hostile either.
"I only have one request now, and that is to hand over the Soul Returning Fruit in your hand!"
Draco said lightly.
"Then, what if I don't hand it over?"
Connor gritted his teeth and asked.
"Mr. McDonald, if you are unwilling to hand over the Soul Returning Fruit, then I have no choice but to take it from you…"
After saying that, Draco released the aura in his body.
In an instant, the wind around Draco's body howled, and waves of powerful energy fluctuations flew in all directions.
It was very obvious that Draco was deliberately intimidating Connor.
At this time, Connor knew that Draco was actually waiting to reap the benefits.
The news of the Soul Returning Fruit had long spread in Comtar, so many martial artists could not resist the temptation of the Soul Returning Fruit and entered this Crimson Peak.
However, they didn't know that the news was released by the Felton family.
The purpose of the Felton family releasing this news was to attract martial artists to come and look for the Soul Returning Fruit. But in the end, no matter who found the Soul Returning Fruit, Draco would take it away.
This way, the Felton family could save most of their manpower and resources to find the Soul Returning Fruit.
"..."
Connor looked at Draco with a nervous expression.
At this moment, Connor did not know what to do. If they were to fight, Connor's chances of winning were almost zero.
But if he didn't fight, then Connor would have to hand over the Soul Returning Fruit.
The Soul Returning Fruit was the key to saving Freya Phillips. Connor was naturally unwilling to hand over the Soul Returning Fruit that he had painstakingly found just like that.
"Mr. Felton, is there no room for negotiation? You should know what kind of person I am. Whether it's money or all kinds of rare treasures, as long as you tell me, I will think of a way to fulfill your requests, but I can't give you this Soul Returning Fruit!"
Connor tried his best to humble himself before Draco and whispered to Draco.
"Mr. McDonald, of course I know who you are. In fact, I don't want to be your enemy. However, I was entrusted by someone this time, so I only want the Soul Returning Fruit."
Draco replied indifferently.
"What do you mean by entrusted?"
Connor asked in confusion.
"Actually, this is all your own doing, Mr. McDonald!"
Draco sighed softly.
"What do you mean?"
Connor frowned and asked.
"Some time ago, you beat Beau Collier's grandson, Cielo Collier, into a cripple. In order to help his grandson recover, Beau Collier specially asked me to help him find the Soul Returning Fruit in the Crimson Peak to refine the Soul Returning Pill. Beau Collier was kind to the Felton family back then. In addition, Beau Collier is stronger than I am, so I do not dare to offend him easily, so I agreed. If I were to let you take the fruit with you, the Felton family will be the one suffering…"
Draco looked at Connor and explained.
When Connor heard Draco's words, he was instantly stunned. Only at this moment did he realize what was going on.
It turned out that he was not the only one looking for the Soul Returning Fruit. The Collier family was also looking for the Soul Returning Fruit.
Thinking of this, Connor began to blame himself again, because all of this was actually because of Connor's impulse.
If Connor hadn't broken Cielo's arms and legs at York Airport, none of this would have happened.
"Mr. McDonald, I know what situation you are in. I can only say that all of this is a karma cycle, so you should hand over the Soul Returning Fruit. As long as you hand over the Soul Returning Fruit, I won't make things difficult for you!"
Draco looked at Connor as he said that.
Connor hesitated for a couple of seconds then said in a low voice, "If you want the Soul Returning Fruit, you can have it, but you have to kill me first!"
"Mr. McDonald, do you think I won't dare to kill you?"
Draco's expression changed as he asked Connor in a low voice.
"..."
Connor looked at Draco without saying anything.
This was because Connor had originally considered giving the Soul Returning Fruit to Draco first. After all, he was really not Draco's match. Continuing to persist would only lead to death.
If he gave the Soul Returning Fruit to Draco first, he could think of a way to take it back from Draco after that.
However, the person who really wanted the Soul Returning Fruit was not Draco, but Beau.
If Connor handed over the Soul Returning Fruit, Freya might really die.
Therefore, Connor had already made up his mind that he could not hand over the Soul Returning Fruit no matter what.
"Mr. McDonald, are you still unwilling to hand over the Soul Returning Fruit?"
Draco took a step forward and asked Connor softly.
"Kill me first if you want the Soul Returning Fruit!"
Connor replied in a low voice.
"Stubborn!"
Draco could not help but shake his head and sigh softly. Then, he rushed toward Connor.
A strange look flitted across Connor's face. Then, he gritted his teeth and rushed toward Draco.
"Is he crazy? He actually wants to fight with an ancient martial arts grandmaster?"
When Marcel saw this scene, he was in disbelief.
There was an insurmountable gap between a black rank and an ancient grandmaster.
Normal martial artists, even if they were a bit lacking in talent, as long as they worked hard enough, could break through to black rank one day.
However, it was different for ancient martial arts grandmasters. Some people were destined from birth to never become an ancient martial arts grandmaster.
This was because if a martial artist wanted to break through to the realm of ancient martial arts grandmaster, not only did it require diligence, but it also required extraordinary talent.
Nothing could make up for the difference between a grandmaster and a black rank.
"He is really crazy!"
Kian could not help but shake his head and sigh.
Rumble…
At this moment, Connor's fist and Draco's fist collided fiercely.
In an instant, it was as if the entire Crimson Peak was trembling.
Draco stood still, while Connor was sent flying. He only stopped after smashing seven or eight trees in the air.
"Cough cough…"
After Connor stabilized himself, he coughed and spat out a mouthful of blood.
"He is really strong…"
"Yeah, maybe this is the difference between us and the ancient martial arts grandmasters!"
Levi and Marcel sighed softly.

chapters.title: Chapter 1845: Remnant Soul
chapters.content:
Chapter 1845: Remnant Soul
When the three of them faced Connor just now, even if they used all their strength, they could not defeat Connor.
But now, Draco had just casually punched out and made Connor vomit blood.
The difference in strength was too obvious.
"Mr. McDonald, you are no match for me. Do you think it is necessary to continue?"
Draco looked at Connor and asked.
"If you want the Soul Returning Fruit, kill me first!"
Connor gritted his teeth and replied.
"Alright, I'll fulfill your wish today!"
Draco's figure flashed and disappeared from Connor's sight.
Connor was a little nervous.
In the next second, Draco appeared behind Connor and placed his right hand on Connor's back.
Connor suddenly turned around and glanced at Draco.
"Break!"
Draco growled.
An incomparably powerful energy instantly swept through Connor's body.
"Ah…"
Connor felt an indescribable pain.
It was as if all of Connor's bones, meridians, organs, and organs had exploded.
Connor spat out a mouthful of blood and fell to the ground with a thud.
When Marcel saw this scene, he could not help but frown slightly, unable to take in the scene.
The intense pain made Connor unable to stand up at all. He tried to condense his aura, but unfortunately, Connor's meridians were all broken, so he could not condense any aura. He did not even have the strength to move his fingers.
"Mr. McDonald, why are you doing this?"
Draco couldn't help but shake his head and sigh when he saw Connor like this.
Connor stared at Draco in front of him. He wanted to open his mouth to speak, but he couldn't.
This was the first time Connor experienced what despair felt like.
The last time Connor had such a feeling was when he was facing Beau.
No matter what one did, one could not face such crushing strength. At this moment, Connor's heart had endless fear and despair.
Draco slowly walked to Connor's side and then took out the jade box containing the Soul Returning Fruit from Connor's clothes.
Connor really wanted to stop Draco, but unfortunately, his body could not move, nor could he speak.
After Draco found the jade box, he carefully checked the Soul Returning Fruit inside. After confirming that there was no problem with it, he turned to Marcel, Kian, and Levi and said, "Throw him down the cliff. Don't let anyone find his corpse…"
"Yes…"
At this moment, Marcel and the others knew how strong Draco was. They were also afraid of Draco from the bottom of their hearts and did not dare to disobey Draco's orders.
Marcel and Kian walked to Connor and lifted him up.
Jayson, who was not far away, hesitated for two seconds when he saw this scene. Then, he gritted his teeth and shouted, "Mr. Felton, you already have the Soul Returning Fruit. Why do you still have to kill Mr. McDonald?"
"If we don't get rid of this person, there will definitely be future troubles!"
Draco replied indifferently, then waved his right hand gently.
A cold light flashed and pierced through Jayson's forehead.
Jayson stared at Draco in front of him. His body stiffened for a moment, and then he slowly fell.
When Connor saw this scene, he was furious. However, he could only watch helplessly as Jayson died in Draco's hands as he could not do anything.
Marcel and Kian carried Connor to the edge of a cliff and threw him down.
Connor could feel the sound of the wind ringing in his ears. Other than the sound of the wind, he could not hear anything else.
After an unknown amount of time, Connor slowly closed his eyes, as if he was already prepared for the arrival of death.
...
"Young man, wake up…"
After an unknown period of time, Connor heard a voice.
When Connor heard this voice, he seemed to instantly regain consciousness and suddenly opened his eyes.
After opening his eyes, Connor observed his surroundings and realized that he was actually in a cave.
The cave was empty.
Connor wanted to move, but he still could not move.
"You're awake?"
At this moment, a white-haired old man walked up to Connor and asked with a smile.
"Am I already dead? Who are you?"
Connor could speak now. He hurriedly asked the old man.
"You are not dead yet. However, you will die very soon…"
The old man replied indifferently.
"What do you mean by dying soon?"
Connor asked in confusion.
"You have quite the luck. You just happened to meet me. So, I allowed you to live a little longer…"
The old man chuckled.
"You let me live a little longer? Who exactly are you?"
Connor's expression became even more puzzled as he frowned and asked.
"Who am I?"
The old man heard Connor's words and hesitated for a moment before saying softly, "To be precise, I am not human…"
"If you aren't human, then what are you?"
The more Connor looked at the old man, the more he felt that something was off. Because Connor didn't know what this person was talking about. According to Connor's memory, he was thrown down from the cliff. He should have died.
"Am I hallucinating?"
Connor could not help but sigh deep down.
"It's not an illusion. I really exist!"
The old man said softly.
"How can you know what I'm thinking?"
Connor looked at the old man's face and seemed to be even more surprised.
"It's easy to know what you're thinking…"
The old man replied indifferently and then continued, "I'm not human. I'm a remnant soul. It's a remnant soul that I left behind before I left this world…"
"Remnant soul?"
Connor looked at the old man and seemed to be even more puzzled. He simply could not understand what the old man was saying.
"I have already waited for several hundred years in this world. I have always hoped to meet a fated person. However, after so many years, you are the first person to enter this cave…"
The old man looked at Connor and continued.
"Who exactly are you? What do you want to do?"
Connor frowned and asked the old man.
"I have waited here for so many years because I have been waiting for a body. Unfortunately, my spiritual strength has become weaker and weaker with the flow of time. Even though you have finally appeared, I will no longer be able to occupy your body…"
The old man said with disappointment.
"Occupy my body?"
Connor was stunned.

chapters.title: Chapter 1846: Make a Deal
chapters.content:
Chapter 1846: Make a Deal
"That's right. Back then, I was hunted by my enemies. I had no choice but to leave this remnant soul behind. I hoped that one day, someone would fall off the cliff and I could take the opportunity to occupy his body and revive myself.
"Unfortunately, I have waited for so many years, but no one had ever fallen. Now, you have finally appeared. However, I am unable to occupy your body…"
The old man looked at Connor with a disappointed expression.
"Are you telling me a ghost story? Who exactly are you?"
Connor shouted in despair.
"You are a martial artist too, right?"
The old man asked Connor softly.
"Yes, sir!"
Connor nodded.
"What realm are you at?"
The old man looked at Connor and continued to ask.
"Black rank!"
Connor replied.
"What's black rank?"
The old man was somewhat puzzled. He then stretched out his right hand and touched Connor's forehead. He then said with disdain, "So you're only at the Foundation Realm..."
"What Foundation Realm?"
Connor looked at the old man and asked.
"A few hundred years ago, the realms of martial artists were divided into the Chi Refining Realm, the Foundation Realm, the Nascent Soul Realm, the Soul Formation Realm, and the Immortal Realm after the tribulation!"
The old man slowly explained.
"We are now divided into yellow, black, earth and heaven rank!"
Connor said.
"In our times, you are at the Foundation Realm..."
The old man said softly.
"Are you also a martial artist? What realm are you at?"
Connor asked curiously.
"My main body is at the Immortal realm, but I'm only a remnant soul now. Therefore, my current realm should be at the Nascent Soul realm…"
The old man said slowly.
Connor was a little confused by the old man's words because he didn't know what this person wanted to say.
"What you see now is just a remnant soul I had left behind. Back then, after I successfully transcended the tribulation, I broke through to the Immortal Realm. The other ancient martial arts sects in Oprana were afraid of my strength, so they joined forces to attack me. In the end, I had no choice but to escape. I left behind a remnant soul, hoping to use this remnant soul to make a comeback in the future. However, after waiting for so many years, the power of my remnant soul became weaker and weaker. It has already reached the point where it is impossible to occupy another person's body…"
The old man looked at Connor and explained.
"You mean you can separate your soul from your body?"
Connor seemed to understand what the old man meant.
"Of course!"
The old man nodded and continued, "The souls of Immortal Realm cultivators will never dissipate. Even if my physical body is destroyed, I can still allow my soul to occupy someone else's body. The remnant soul is a part of my soul. Its strength is merely slightly weaker than my true soul…"
"Then, where is your soul now?"
Connor looked at the old man and asked.
"I'm not sure…"
The old man shook his head and continued, "My enemy must have used some method to seal my soul. Otherwise, he would definitely come and take back my remnant soul after I was reborn…"
"I still don't understand what you're saying…"
Connor said helplessly.
"Of course, you don't. After all, ancient martial arts have regressed to the point where there are only three realms left. Some things might not be something you can come into contact with!"
The old man said indifferently.
"Although I don't understand what you said, you seem very powerful. Didn't you say that I was going to die soon? Do you have any way to save me?"
Connor looked at the old man and asked.
"You don't want to die?"
The old man asked with a smile.
"Of course! Who would want to die? Someone threw me off the cliff…"
Connor said speechlessly.
The old man sized up Connor and asked softly, "You said just now that the most powerful martial artist now is only at the Nascent Soul Realm, right?"
"I think so..."
Connor lightly nodded.
"Hehe, why don't the two of us make a deal?"
The old man looked at Connor and continued to ask.
"Deal?"
Connor couldn't help but be stunned when he heard the old man's words. Then, he frowned and asked, "What deal?"
"I can no longer occupy other people's bodies, so there's no point in leaving this remnant soul of mine here. Since you don't want to die now, I can give you the power of my remnant soul. This way, you can live. Moreover, after you absorb the power of my remnant soul, at the very least, you can break through to the Nascent Soul Realm. Then, no one in this world will be your match…"
The old man said slowly.
"Are you just pulling my leg? Does such a thing really exist?"
Connor frowned.
"You're already a dead man now. Why would I lie to you? Moreover, I'm only a remnant soul. I won't get any benefits from lying to you…"
The old man chuckled.
"Didn't you say that you wanted to make a deal with me just now? Then, what do I need to do?"
Connor asked cautiously.
"After you obtain my strength, help me find my true soul. Then, help me find a corpse and revive me…"
The old man stated his purpose.
"It's been so many years. Your soul is probably long gone, right?"
Connor frowned and asked.
"Impossible…"
The old man shook his head without thinking and continued, "My soul will not dissipate. If my soul has already dissipated, then this remnant soul of mine will also dissipate. Since you can see this remnant soul of mine, it means that my soul is still in this world!"
"..."
Connor looked at the old man and said nothing.
"In any case, the choice is in your hands now. I can save your life, and you can save mine. The two of us are exchanging a life for a life…"
Seeing that Connor was quiet, the old man continued.
"I agree to your condition. As long as you can save me, I will find a way to find your soul!"
Connor said without thinking.
"Aren't you going to consider it? If I'm a bad person and you resurrect me, you might get into big trouble…"
The old man chuckled.
"I don't even care about those things now. I have to survive because only if I survive can my girlfriend have a chance of survival!"
Connor said seriously.
"Alright then, the deal between the two of us is set!"
The old man nodded.
"If you save me now, aren't you afraid that I'll go back on my word and not save you in the future?"
Connor suddenly asked the old man.

chapters.title: Chapter 1847: Resurrection
chapters.content:
Chapter 1847: Resurrection
"That is not even a concern for me at all.
"Because what I can do now is to resurrect you and let you possess the strength of the Nascent Soul Realm.
"After you get out, if you want to become even stronger, you have to find me. Right now, not many people in this world know how to break through from the Nascent Soul Realm to the Soul Formation Realm…"
The old man said confidently.
"..."
Connor looked at the old man and said nothing.
In the old man's eyes, there was no limit to the pursuit of power by humans.
Although the most powerful martial artist in the world was an ancient martial arts grandmaster, there would actually be more powerful people appearing. It was just that Connor could not come into contact with those people now. Once Connor came into contact with those people, if he wanted to obtain more powerful strength, he would have to find his own soul to resurrect himself.
"How are you going to give me your power?"
Connor looked at the old man and asked.
"You don't have to do anything!"
The old man replied indifferently, then placed his right hand on Connor's forehead.
In an instant, Connor felt an incomparably powerful force slowly flowing into his body, and Connor's originally broken meridians began to gradually recover.
Connor was a bit shocked, because he felt that this feeling was magical. He even felt that all of this was like a dream.
After an unknown amount of time, Connor slowly closed his eyes.
When Connor opened his eyes again, he realized that he was still lying in the cave from before.
However, the old man who spoke to Connor earlier had already disappeared.
In order to confirm whether he was dreaming or not, Connor moved his arms. He could actually move!
Connor's meridians were broken by Draco Felton. Let alone gathering spiritual energy, Connor could not even complete simple activities.
However, Connor could still move his body at this moment. This meant that everything that had happened just now was not a dream.
Connor took a deep breath and stood up.
When Connor stood up, he noticed that his body seemed to have undergone a huge change. He seemed to have gained terrifying strength.
Connor instinctively released an aura.
The aura flew toward the mountain peak in the distance and then fiercely collided with the mountain peak.
Rumble…
With a loud bang, the mountain peak not far away began to tremble violently.
A few seconds later, the mountain collapsed.
When Connor saw this scene, he was extremely shocked. He never thought that everything that had happened just now was actually true. At this moment, not only did Connor come back to life, but he also possessed the strength of an ancient martial arts grandmaster.
"Could all of this be a dream?"
Connor looked at his hands and sighed with a puzzled expression.
Although Connor had no way to determine whether he was still alive or not, and he also didn't know whether everything that happened to him was true or not, he only had one thing to do now, and that was to leave Crimson Peak as soon as possible. Only by leaving could Connor be sure whether what happened just now was true or not.
Connor took a deep breath and then walked out of the cave.
After walking out of the cave, Connor found a small path in front of him. At this time, Connor did not know which direction he should go to leave Crimson Peak, so he could only follow the small path forward.
After an unknown amount of time, Connor finally reached the end of the path.
At this moment, there was only endless snow and mountains in front of Connor. He could not see anything else.
Jayson Hardy had been the one leading the way for Connor. Connor didn't know how to leave this place on his own.
"I can't possibly die here again, can I?"
Connor looked at the white snow that filled the sky and sighed with despair.
Roar…
However, at this moment, Connor suddenly heard a wolf cry from afar.
Connor subconsciously looked over and saw that it was actually the snow wolf he had met when getting the Soul Returning Fruit.
The Snow Wolf King walked up to Connor, but it didn't seem to have any ill intentions toward Connor.
"Can you take me out of Crimson Peak?"
Connor asked the Snow Wolf King.
The Snow Wolf King seemed to be able to understand Connor's words and turned around and started walking.
Connor hesitated for a moment before following the Snow Wolf King.
Connor never dreamed that he would be saved by the Snow Wolf King.
At this moment, it was snowing heavily in the Crimson Peak. Other than the white snow, one could not see anything at all. If it was not for Jayson leading the way for Connor, it would have been absolutely impossible for Connor to find the Soul Returning Fruit.
Later, Connor fell off the cliff, so he didn't know where he was at all.
Fortunately, Connor met the Snow Wolf King.
The Snow Wolf King had lived in the Crimson Peak for nearly a hundred years, so he knew the Crimson Peak like the back of his paw.
Just like that, a wolf and a human walked through the cold snow. The scene was unusually spectacular.
At this time, Connor was still not sure if he was really still alive. He also did not know if everything he was experiencing was his own illusion or reality.
Anyway, all he could do now was to follow the Snow Wolf King.
Originally, Connor entered the Crimson Peak by car. When they reached the entrance of the valley, Connor and Jayson got off the car.
But at this time, Connor could no longer find Jeffrey Zacharia and the others, so he could only walk out of Crimson Peak.
Fortunately, Connor was already an ancient martial arts grandmaster, so even though the temperature on the Crimson Peak was very low, it did not have much effect on Connor's body.
Connor followed the Snow Wolf King for nearly a day and a night, but the scenery around him still did not change.
Connor suspected that he might actually be dead. Everything around him was just something he was imagining.
Roar…
However, just as Connor was about to give up and continue walking, the Snow Wolf King suddenly roared.
Connor turned to look at the Snow Wolf King and saw that the Snow Wolf King had stopped.
"Can't walk anymore?"
Connor walked to the Snow Wolf King's side and stroked its silver fur.
Roar…
The Snow Wolf King roared again.
Connor was stunned for a moment, and then he hurriedly raised his head to look into the distance.
"There's actually someone here?"
Connor was a little excited because he saw several snowmobiles speeding on the snow in front of him.
Connor was just thinking that all of this was an illusion, but when he saw those snowmobiles, he felt that all of this might not be a fantasy, but reality.

chapters.title: Chapter 1848: A Mixed-Blood Beauty
chapters.content:
Chapter 1848: A Mixed-Blood Beauty
"Am I really not dead?"
Connor shouted excitedly.
The Snow Wolf King turned and looked at Connor. It did not choose to continue walking forward, but turned around and walked in the direction it came from.
Connor knew that the Snow Wolf King didn't want to get close to humans. In his eyes, humans were probably the most dangerous existence.
"Thank you. After I leave, I will get someone to bring you food!"
Connor shouted in the direction where the Snow Wolf King had left.
The Snow Wolf King seemed to be able to understand Connor's words. It turned around and looked at Connor before disappearing into the snow.
After seeing the Snow Wolf King leave, Connor immediately ran in the direction of the snowmobiles because those snowmobiles might be his only hope of leaving this place.
...
On the other side, inside the snowmobile.
A mixed-blood beauty sat quietly in her seat, admiring the scenery outside. From time to time, she would take out her camera to take a few photos.
The mixed-blood beauty was very beautiful, combining the beauties of both Eastern and Western women. She had exquisite facial features, blue eyes, golden hair, and a hot figure that could still be seen even though she was wrapped tightly. She was a sexy beauty.
Roar…
But at this moment, a roar shocked the mixed-blood beauty.
The beauty's expression changed, and she hurriedly asked the driver, "Uncle Sadlon, I think I heard something just now. It sounded like an animal's roar."
"I heard it too…"
The driver replied in a low voice, clearly a little nervous.
"What is it?"
The beauty frowned and asked.
"There must be snow wolves around. We have to hurry up and leave this place!"
The driver replied in a low voice. Then, he took out the walkie-talkie and shouted, "Change direction now. All of us will head northwest…"
"Roger!"
"Roger!"
Soon, responses came from the walkie-talkie.
The driver changed his direction and stepped on the accelerator. After all, in the eyes of people like him, the snow wolf was the most dangerous existence in the snow. Once they encountered the snow wolf, their chances of survival were almost zero.
"Uncle Sadlon, wait a moment…"
But at this moment, the beauty suddenly shouted.
"Miss Langlie, what's wrong?"
The driver frowned and asked.
"I think I saw someone in the snow just now. Stop the car, and I'll go take a look…"
The beauty shouted anxiously.
A hint of helplessness flashed across the driver's eyes as he said in a low voice, "Miss Langlie, how can someone be here in such heavy snow? Even if someone is here, they would have frozen to death long ago. You shouldn't go out there…"
"I'm not joking. I really saw someone running in our position. He was very fast…"
The beauty said quickly.
"Miss Langlie, even if there's really someone, I can't stop the car now…"
The driver said helplessly.
"Why?"
"Didn't you hear the snow wolf's roar just now? The snow wolf's roar means that it has discovered us and is gathering its companions. If we stay here, everyone will die. I can't kill everyone because of someone who has nothing to do with us…"
The driver explained.
After hearing the driver's words, the beauty was a little helpless. Before entering the Crimson Peak, the driver had told them that the most dangerous creature in the Crimson Peak was the snow wolf. Once they encountered the snow wolf, the first thing to do was to run away quickly and ignore anyone else.
Therefore, the driver was doing the right thing.
Connor, who was not far away, saw that all the snowmobiles had changed their direction and were driving away. He was a little helpless.
"Did I scare them away?"
Connor sighed softly, then sped and chased after the snowmobile's tire marks.
On the other side, the snowmobiles finally stopped after driving for about half an hour.
The driver, Mr. Sadlon, wiped the sweat off his forehead, then turned to the beauty beside him and said, "Miss Langlie, we really had a narrow escape just now. If the snow wolves had really found us, we would have probably died there!"
"Uncle Sadlon, don't be so nervous. I didn't see any snow wolf at all!"
The beauty replied indifferently.
"Miss Langlie, seven years ago, I encountered a snow wolf in the Crimson Peak. My wife died here. So, I know what I heard. The roar just now came from a snow wolf…"
Mr. Sadlon said expressionlessly.
"Your wife…"
The beauty was stunned when she heard this.
Initially, she was angry because Mr. Sadlon did not choose to stop the car. She felt that he was too cold-blooded.
However, when she heard Mr. Sadlon's words, she finally understood why Mr. Sadlon was so afraid of the snow wolf.
"Miss Langlie, do you know why I'm so afraid of snow wolves, yet I still bring the adventurers to Crimson Peak every year?"
At this moment, Mr. Sadlon looked at the beauty and asked.
"I don't."
The beauty shook her head gently.
"Because I want to find my wife's body…"
Mr. Sadlon said calmly.
The beauty was stunned again after hearing this.
"Mr. Sadlon, we found a cave up front. Do you want to go and get some rest there?"
At this moment, Mr. Sadlon's walkie-talkie suddenly rang.
"Let's rest for now…"
Mr. Sadlon picked up the walkie-talkie and replied.
"Alright!"
A response came from the walkie-talkie.
Mr. Sadlon put down his walkie-talkie and turned to the beauty. "Miss Langlie, there happens to be a cave in front. We can go and rest for a while…"
"Uncle Sadlon, I'm sorry about what happened just now!"
The beauty said with a guilty tone.
"It's fine…"
Mr. Sadlon smiled and didn't say anything.
A moment later, everyone entered the cave.
The cave wasn't very big, but it was able to accommodate these people.
They lit a fire in the cave and then used special equipment to block the entrance of the cave, leaving only a space the size of a window for easy ventilation.
At this moment, most of the people in the cave were young people. There were more guys than girls.
From the way these people were dressed, it could be seen that they were young people from rich families. This time, some of them came to Crimson Peak for adventure, while others came for photography.
The mixed-blood beauty who was talking to Mr. Sadlon earlier was here for photography. She was a local of Comtar, and her name was Leah Langlie.
Leah came from a good family. Her father was a very famous wealthy businessman in Comtar, and his family was mainly in the steel business.
Everyone sat by the fire and chatted while warming themselves up. Some people took out food and placed it on the fire to roast.

chapters.title: Chapter 1849: Going Back
chapters.content:
Chapter 1849: Going Back
"Mr. Sadlon, how many more days do we need to cross the Crimson Peak?"
At this moment, a man walked to Mr. Sadlon's side and asked him softly.
"Cross Crimson Peak?"
When Mr. Sadlon heard the man's words, he could not help but be stunned for a moment. Then, he frowned and said, "Young man, that's not possible. We have only walked less than one-tenth of the distance. If we continue walking we will not have enough supplies. We can only return the way we came…"
"Only one-tenth?"
The man was speechless when he heard this.
"I have lived here for so many years and brought countless people into the Crimson Peak, but I have never been able to cross the Crimson Peak, so I advise that you give up on this idea!"
Mr. Sadlon said calmly.
The man's expression was a little helpless. He walked to Leah's side and asked with a smile, "Leah, have you taken any good photos? Let me see…"
"No..."
Leah shook her head lightly.
At this moment, Leah still seemed to be troubled by the fact that she had seen a person in the snow just now. If she had really seen a person at that time, it meant that she had left him in the lurch.
"Leah, do you want to eat something?"
At this moment, the man asked again.
"I'm not hungry now…"
Leah shook her head lightly.
"Leah, what happened to you? Why are you acting strange?"
The man frowned and asked.
"I…"
Leah was about to speak when she suddenly heard footsteps.
"Is anyone there?"
At this moment, a voice sounded.
Mr. Sadlon could not help but be stunned when he heard that. Then, he hurriedly took out his weapon and looked at the cave entrance with a nervous expression.
"Is anyone there?"
At this moment, Connor's voice sounded again.
"Who is it?"
Mr. Sadlon asked with a frown.
"I got separated from my companions. Can you bring me out of Crimson Peak?"
Connor said as he walked into the cave.
When everyone saw that Connor was just an ordinary youth, they instantly eased up a lot.
After all, Connor had a refined appearance and a thin figure. He was probably not a threat to them.
"Are you planning to leave Crimson Peak?"
Mr. Sadlon walked up to Connor and asked him softly.
"Yes, I have something very important to do, so I have to leave this place immediately!"
Connor lightly nodded.
"We're an adventurer team. If you want to follow us, you can. However, we'll only be able to return the day after tomorrow at the earliest…"
Mr. Sadlon looked at Connor and said.
The day after tomorrow?
When Connor heard Mr. Sadlon's words, he frowned slightly and said in a low voice, "How about this? I can give you money, as long as you can lead me out of here immediately!"
"No…"
Mr. Sadlon shook his head stubbornly and continued, "I have my own rules. If I don't reach the location I'm heading toward, I will definitely not return…"
Mr. Sadlon had entered Crimson Peak to search for his wife's corpse. Moreover, he only had one chance every year, so no matter what, he would not choose to give up.
Connor was somewhat helpless because the current situation was very urgent. The Soul Returning Fruit was still in Draco Felton's hands. If Connor continued to waste time on Crimson Peak, the Soul Returning Fruit would very likely fall into the hands of the Collier family.
At that time, it would be too late.
"Are you planning to go to Comtar?"
However, at this moment, Leah suddenly asked Connor.
"That's right, I want to go to Comtar!"
Connor looked at Leah and nodded.
Leah hesitated for a moment before saying to Mr. Sadlon, "Uncle Sadlon, how about this? I don't plan to continue going further into Crimson Peak. I'll drive a snowmobile and leave with this person."
"Miss Langlie, are you sure you know the way back?"
Mr. Sadlon asked with a frown.
"Yeah, Leah, you don't even know who this person is. What if you encounter danger?"
The boy who had been talking to Leah also shouted,
"I don't think this person is a bad person. Moreover, I've taken quite a number of photos along the way. I sort of know the way back…"
Leah said softly.
Mr. Sadlon hesitated for a moment before saying softly, "Miss Langlie, if you leave with this person, you might be in great danger, so you have to think about it carefully!"
"I've already thought things through…"
Leah nodded seriously.
"Alright, I'll prepare some food and water for you. You can go with this person!"
Leah seemed determined, so Mr. Sadlon did not continue to stop her.
Leah turned to look at Connor and asked him softly, "Do you know how to drive?"
"Yes!"
Connor nodded.
"That's great. The two of us can take turns driving. That way, we can get back faster!"
Leah said softly.
Connor looked at the beautiful girl in front of him with a puzzled expression, because he couldn't understand why this girl seemed to be more anxious to leave than him.
"Leah, why don't I go back with the two of you? That way, I can protect you!"
A young man walked up to Leah and whispered to her.
"You don't have to do that. You'll only be a burden if you follow the two of us. You should follow Uncle Sadlon and the others!"
Leah knew the young man well. If she brought this young man along with her, it would be very troublesome.
When the young man heard Leah's words, he looked a little awkward. He sighed helplessly and did not say anything else.
A few minutes later, Mr. Sadlon helped Connor and Leah prepare a snowmobile and some food. When they parted ways, Mr. Sadlon took out a pistol and handed it to Leah, as if he was worried that Leah would encounter some danger.
Leah didn't refuse and accepted the pistol.
Just like that, Connor and the mixed-blood beauty drove the snowmobile toward the exit of Crimson Peak.
The temperature in the car was rather warm, so Leah didn't wear a thick down jacket when she drove. Instead, she had on a tight sweater.

chapters.title: Chapter 1850: Help Me Kill Someone
chapters.content:
Chapter 1850: Help Me Kill Someone
Not only did Leah have exquisite looks, but she also had a nice figure. Her ample chest formed a very attractive arc under the outline of the sweater.
However, Connor was not in the mood to appreciate these things at all. His mind was only thinking about the Soul Returning Fruit.
It had been two days since Connor was thrown off the cliff. If they were travelling at a normal speed, Draco Felton and the others would still be on the Crimson Peak.
Therefore, Connor planned to snatch back the Soul Returning Fruit before Draco left the Crimson Peak. This way, he could save a lot of trouble. Once Draco returned to Comtar, things would get a little troublesome.
"What's your name?"
Leah asked Connor as she drove.
"Connor McDonald…"
Connor replied in a low voice.
"My name is Leah Langlie. You don't look like you're from Comtar. What are you doing here at the Crimson Peak?"
Leah looked at Connor and asked.
"Looking for medicinal ingredients…"
Connor's tone was very cold.
Seeing that Connor didn't seem to want to talk to her, Leah pouted slightly. However, she didn't say anything and continued to drive seriously.
"How long will it take for the two of us to get out of Crimson Peak?"
At this moment, Connor suddenly asked.
"How long will it take to get out?"
When Leah heard this, she couldn't help but be stunned for a moment. Then, she said softly, "I'm not very sure about this either. When we came in, it took us seven days to get to where we were just now. The two of us will probably be faster, but it will take at least five days!"
"Five days?"
Connor frowned slightly and said in a low voice, "Is there any faster way out?"
"No..."
Leah shook her head, then looked at Connor and asked, "You seem to be in a hurry. What's going on?"
"Someone took something from me. I need to get it back…"
Connor replied indifferently.
"I see!"
Leah nodded.
"..."
Connor looked at Leah without saying anything.
Although Connor was very anxious now, he knew that it was useless to be anxious. If he wanted to leave Crimson Peak, he had to follow this woman.
Perhaps because she knew that Connor was in a hurry, Leah picked up speed.
A few hours later, Leah seemed to be a little tired. Connor then changed seats with Leah to let her rest.
As for Leah, she needed to give directions, so she couldn't really rest.
Just like that, Connor and Leah drove for three days and three nights in the Crimson Peak and finally arrived at the entrance of the Crimson Peak.
After driving the car out of the Crimson Peak, Leah let out a long sigh of relief. Then, she turned to Connor and said, "We are really something. We used seven days to travel, but now, we only took three days…"
"Thank you so much…"
Connor looked at Leah and said.
"..."
Leah hesitated for a moment after hearing Connor's words, then said softly, "Actually, you don't have to thank me. The reason why I helped you is because I have my own reasons!"
"Just tell me what it is!"
After observing for a few days, Connor realized that Leah wasn't simply helping him. She probably had something to ask of him.
"I saw a person running in the snow before we met, and he was running very fast. That person was you, right?"
Leah asked Connor softly.
"That's right, it was me!"
Connor lightly nodded.
"Since you were able to run in that environment and not freeze to death, this means that you're not an ordinary person. You are a martial artist, right?"
Leah looked at Connor and continued to ask.
"Yes!"
Connor nodded again.
"That's great…"
Leah was a little excited. Then, she looked at Connor and said, "I have something that I need your help with. Take it as my reward for bringing you out of the Crimson Peak…"
"What is it?"
Connor looked at Leah and asked.
"I... I want you to help me kill someone…"
Leah said hesitantly.
"Help you kill someone?"
Connor seemed to be somewhat puzzled.
"That's right. This person killed my sister. I want to avenge my sister!"
Leah said in a serious tone.
"You can look for an assassin for that. There's no need to ask me…"
Connor replied helplessly.
"Ordinary people can't kill him. Only martial artists can kill him because he's also a martial artist. I've already helped you out. You're not going to reject me, are you?"
Leah asked Connor.
Connor hesitated for a moment, then said softly, "I can help you, but I still have a lot of things to do before I can help you. After I'm done with everything, I'll help you kill this person…"
"Then, where do you plan to go next?"
Leah hurriedly asked.
"Comtar!"
Connor replied.
"That's great. My enemy is also in Comtar. Why don't I go with you? I'm very familiar with Comtar…"
Leah said excitedly to Connor.
"..."
Connor looked at Leah and hesitated for a couple of seconds, then nodded lightly.
He felt that it would save him a lot of trouble if he had someone familiar with Comtar by his side, so he didn't refuse.
Leah was even happier seeing that Connor had agreed. She immediately started the car and drove toward Comtar.
At this moment, Connor was at least three days away from Comtar.
However, Connor knew that Draco and the others were on their way now, so he did not waste too much time. He would probably be able to reach Comtar before Draco gave the Soul Returning Fruit to Beau Collier.
Two days later.
Connor and Leah once again passed by the small village where he, Jeffrey Zacharia, and the others stopped by to get some rest.
What Connor did not expect was that Jeffrey and the others' cars were actually parked at the village entrance.
Connor hesitated for a moment before saying to Leah, "Drive the car into the village. I want to see someone…"
"Alright…"
Leah seemed to be a little tired, so she wanted to take this opportunity to rest.
A few minutes later, Leah parked the car in front of the inn where Mr. Livingston was at.
After hesitating for a moment, Connor brought Leah into the inn.
After entering the inn, Connor discovered that Jeffrey and Jayson Hardy's subordinates were all in the inn.
Jeffrey, who was drinking and chatting with Mr. Livingston, was dumbfounded when he saw Connor. The wine glass in his hand instantly fell to the ground. At this moment, he looked at Connor as if he had seen a ghost.

chapters.title: Chapter 1851: The Same Enemy
chapters.content:
Chapter 1851: The Same Enemy
"Mr... Mr. McDonald, you... you're still alive?"
Jeffrey stammered as he asked Connor.
"How did you know I was dead?"
Connor replied expressionlessly.
When Jeffrey heard Connor's words, he realized that he had said the wrong thing just now, so he hurriedly explained, "Mr. McDonald, these people and I waited for you at the entrance of the valley for three whole days, but you and Jayson didn't come out. We thought you were already dead, so we came out first, but I didn't expect you... You're actually still alive…"
"Alright, stop with the act. You left with your men the moment Jayson and I entered the valley, right?"
Connor walked up to Jeffrey and asked in a low voice.
"How is that possible? We were waiting for you outside…"
Jeffrey said nervously.
Smack!
Connor stretched out his hand and grabbed Jeffrey's neck. Then, he said expressionlessly, "Jeffrey, do you think I'm a fool?"
"Mr... Mr. McDonald, what... what are you doing?"
It was very difficult for him to speak as he was being chokehold by Connor.
"Did you tell the Collier family about the Soul Returning Fruit?"
Connor asked Jeffrey expressionlessly.
"I…"
Jeffrey opened his mouth to speak.
"I advise you to tell me the truth, or I'll break your neck!"
Connor reminded in a low voice.
"Yes, sir!"
Jeffrey could only grit his teeth and nod helplessly.
"After Jayson and I entered the valley, did you tell Draco Felton my location?"
Connor continued to ask.
"..."
Jeffrey hesitated for a moment before nodding again.
Connor could not help but sneer when he saw Jeffrey nod his head. Then, he said indifferently, "If that's the case, then everything makes sense. I was wondering why Draco would coincidentally appear at that time and place. It turns out that you've been playing tricks behind the scenes all along…"
"Mr. McDonald, I'm sorry. I was possessed at that time. I didn't expect you to find the Soul Returning Fruit. I'm really sorry. Please let me go…"
Jeffrey begged Connor with a terrified expression.
"You didn't expect me to come out alive, did you?"
Connor said lightly.
"Mr. McDonald, I'm sorry. Please let me go on account that we're both from Porthampton!"
Jeffrey shouted excitedly at Connor.
"Where is Draco Felton now?"
Connor looked at Jeffrey and asked.
"Draco and the others just left here yesterday. They probably haven't arrived in Comtar yet!"
Jeffrey hurriedly said.
"Alright, I understand…"
Connor lightly nodded his head, and then his right hand suddenly exerted force.
A crisp sound rang out.
Connor broke Jeffrey's neck.
When Leah saw Connor kill Jeffrey, her beautiful eyes instantly widened, and she was in disbelief.
She never thought that this gentleman-looking boy would actually have the guts to kill someone!
Everyone in the inn stared at Connor with their eyes wide open, as if they did not even dare to breathe loudly. In their eyes, Connor was even more terrifying than a demon.
"If anyone tells anyone about what happened just now, you'll end up like him!"
Connor looked at everyone indifferently and said expressionlessly.
When everyone heard Connor's words, they all lowered their heads, as if they did not dare to look at Connor.
Connor did not continue to waste time on these people and walked out of the hotel.
Mr. Livingston trembled as he stood on the spot, not knowing what to do. How could he have expected that Connor, who chatted and drank with him, would suddenly become a different person?
At this moment, the aura on Connor's body made people shudder.
After hesitating for a moment, Leah followed Connor out of the hotel.
A moment later, the two of them returned to the car.
Connor turned and glanced at Leah, then asked Leah softly, "You know what kind of person I am now, right?"
"Ye... yes!"
Leah stuttered.
"Then, do you still want to follow me?"
Connor asked.
"Of course, I want to follow you. I'm looking for someone like you!"
Leah hurriedly nodded.
Connor looked at Leah and smiled but didn't say anything.
Leah hesitated for a moment before starting the car.
The car once again drove toward Comtar.
Although Leah said that she would continue to stay by Connor's side, Connor could actually feel that Leah was very afraid of him. Previously, when they were at Crimson Peak, Leah would take the initiative to talk to Connor from time to time. However, after Leah saw Connor kill Jeffrey, she no longer took the initiative to talk to Connor. She had been driving carefully.
And Connor could also have a lot of peace and quiet.
At this moment, Connor could already confirm that what happened to him was not a dream, but reality.
Although Connor still did not know who the old man was, he knew that he had become much stronger. However, he was still not sure if he had reached the realm of an ancient martial arts grandmaster.
In the blink of an eye, another three days had passed.
Connor and Leah finally arrived at Comtar.
When they arrived at Comtar, Leah turned and glanced at Connor. Then, she asked Connor carefully, "Where do you plan to go next?"
"Do you know the Felton family in Comtar?"
Connor looked at Leah and asked.
"The Felton family?"
Leah was a little shocked.
"My enemy is Draco Felton, the head of the Felton family in Comtar!"
Connor said slowly.
"..."
Leah looked at Connor and hesitated for a couple of seconds before saying softly, "What a coincidence. My... My enemy is also from the Felton family!"
"Your enemy is also from the Felton family?"
When Connor heard Leah's words, he was a little surprised.
"Yes…"
Leah nodded lightly and said in a low voice, "Three years ago, Draco's grandson, Lexus Felton, raped my sister and then killed her. Although the police found evidence immediately...
"The Felton family is too powerful. Our family is no match for the Felton family at all. In the end, Lexus Felton was acquitted and released. My father's business was also greatly affected because of this. I've always wanted to find an opportunity to avenge my sister, but Lexus Felton is a martial artist. Ordinary people can't kill him at all. That's why I took the initiative to come out with you when I saw you at the Crimson Peak. I wanted you to help me kill Lexus Felton!"
Leah cried as she told Connor all that. It was obvious that Leah was very sad.
Connor looked at Leah and hesitated for a couple of seconds before saying softly, "Don't worry, I'll help you get revenge!"

chapters.title: Chapter 1852: Making a Move Tonight
chapters.content:
Chapter 1852: Making a Move Tonight
"Really?"
Leah looked up at Connor and asked him excitedly.
"Of course!"
Connor lightly nodded.
"Then, when do you plan to make your move?"
Leah hurriedly asked.
"We'll do it tonight!"
Connor replied.
He did not know what was going on with Freya Phillips, so he did not want to waste even a second. He only wanted to get rid of Draco as soon as possible and take out the Soul Returning Fruit.
"We're going to make a move tonight? Don't you need to rest?"
Leah asked in confusion.
Connor had not rested since he left the Crimson Peak. He had been driving most of the time.
Sometimes, Leah wondered if Connor was a robot. Otherwise, how could he be so energetic after not sleeping for three days and three nights?
"No…"
Connor lightly shook his head.
Connor also realized that his body seemed to have undergone some changes. Previously, although his body was stronger than ordinary people, he still needed to rest and eat. But now, even if Connor did not sleep or eat for a long time, he would not feel tired or hungry. Sometimes, Connor even wondered if he was really dead.
However, Connor found that he still had a heartbeat and pulse, which meant that he was still a normal person.
"Then what do you plan to do next?"
