Leah hesitated for a moment before asking Connor softly.
"Can you find Draco now?"
Connor asked in a low voice.
"The Felton family has a lot of power in our Comtar. It's not easy to find out where Draco is. However, the two of us can go and find Lexus first. Lexus will definitely have a way to find Draco…"
Leah answered after thinking for a moment.
"Alright, then we'll do as you say. Find Lexus first, then ask Lexus for Draco's location!"
Connor lightly nodded.
"Then, I'll call my friend now!"
Leah agreed and took out her phone to make a call.
A few minutes later, Leah got Lexus's location from her friend.
Connor drove straight to the bar where Lexus was at.
Now, Connor didn't want to alert the enemy, so he had to be 100% sure of Draco's location before he chose to attack. Otherwise, once Draco knew that he was still alive, Draco might move the fruit away in advance. At that time, it would only waste more of Connor's time.
That was why Connor agreed to Leah's method and was prepared to make a move on Lexus first.
Half an hour later, Connor parked the car in front of a bar in Comtar.
However, Connor did not choose to enter the bar because there were too many people in the bar. It was not convenient for Connor to attack Lexus. He wanted to wait for Lexus to come out.
"Are you sure Lexus is in this bar?"
Connor turned and asked Leah.
"Yes, my friend just saw Lexus in this bar!"
Leah nodded lightly.
"Then, let's wait here. There are too many people in the bar. It's not easy to make a move…"
Connor replied in a low voice.
Leah looked at Connor without saying anything.
The two of them waited in the car for about an hour before a young man walked out of the bar with a sexy woman in his arms.
When Leah saw this young man, her expression changed instantly. She whispered to Connor, "That's Lexus!"
"Alright…"
Connor replied expressionlessly.
A moment later, Lexus got into the car with the woman and drove away.
Connor also started the car and followed closely behind Lexus's car.
At this moment, Leah was very nervous because she did not know if Connor could kill Lexus.
After Lexus left the bar, Connor started the car and followed closely behind Lexus's car.
Connor could feel that Leah seemed to be very nervous. After all, this girl was just an ordinary person. Although she had always wanted to avenge her sister, now that it was happening, she couldn't calm herself down.
Meanwhile, Connor was very calm. He had been driving quietly.
Perhaps it was because of what he had experienced in Crimson Peak, or perhaps it was because of what had happened to Freya Phillips, it had caused Connor's temperament to undergo a very large change.
Previously, Connor had always felt that as long as it was someone who had no enmity with him, he did not need to kill them.
But now, Connor had already thought about it. When facing some people, if you were soft-hearted toward them, you would only harm yourself in the end.
About ten minutes later, Lexus's car stopped in front of a hotel in Comtar. Lexus brought the sexy girl into the hotel, talking and laughing.
Because the Felton family was the number one family in Comtar, and Lexus himself was a martial artist, he didn't pay attention to the car that had been following him. In Lexus's eyes, it might just be a coincidence. After all, no one in Comtar dared to attack him.
"What should we do?"
Leah asked Connor nervously after seeing Lexus enter the hotel.
"Let's go in…"
Connor replied indifferently.
"But even if the two of us go in, we don't know which room Lexus is in now."
Leah hurriedly said.
"I have a way to find him…"
After saying that, Connor stepped out of the car.
After hesitating for a couple of seconds, Leah followed Connor out of the car.
A moment later, the two of them walked into the hotel.
After entering the hotel, Connor used the Chi Observation Technique to observe the entire hotel.
The range of Connor's Chi Observation Technique was very small. At most, it was only a few dozen meters away. If it was too far away, the Chi Observation Technique would be useless.
However, Connor's realm had increased, so he could use the Chi Observation Technique to observe the entire hotel.
Because there were not many martial artists, Connor could clearly distinguish how many martial artists were in the building and where they were.
The number of martial artists in Comtar was indeed a little more than the other cities that Connor had stayed in. There were seven or eight martial artists in this hotel alone, but the realms of these martial artists were very low.
Lexus was most probably black rank, so Connor could easily determine his current location.
"Sir, do you want to book a room?"
When the hotel receptionist saw that Connor and Leah were about the same age, she instinctively thought that the two of them were a couple who came to book a room.

chapters.title: Chapter 1853: A Threat
chapters.content:
Chapter 1853: A Threat
"We're here to find someone!"
Connor replied placidly to the receptionist, then turned to Leah and said, "Follow me!"
"..."
Leah was stunned for a moment before she hurriedly followed Connor.
A few minutes later, Connor came to a room on the fifth floor of the hotel. He sensed briefly and confirmed that Lexus was in the room.
Connor took a deep breath and kicked the door.
Bang!
There was a loud bang.
Connor kicked the door open.
Lexus, who was in the room, had just taken off the woman's clothes. When he heard Connor kicking the door, he was instantly shocked and quickly turned to look at the door.
"Ah…"
The girl in the room screamed instinctively.
Connor brought Leah into the room slowly.
When Lexus saw Connor, he couldn't help but be stunned for a moment. Then, he frowned and shouted at Connor, "What the f*ck are you doing?"
Connor ignored Lexus and turned to Leah, who was beside him, and asked, "Is it this person?"
"Yes!"
Leah nodded without hesitating.
Lexus instinctively raised his head and glanced at Leah. Then, he said in a low voice, "Are you Fawn Langlie's sister?"
"..."
Leah stared at Lexus coldly and didn't say anything.
Lexus raised his head and looked at Connor. Then, he sneered and said indifferently, "I'm guessing the two of you are here to avenge Fawn Langlie."
"You admit that you killed my sister?"
Leah bit her lips and asked in a low voice.
"Yeah, why wouldn't I?"
Lexus replied with a smile, then continued, "I killed your sister, and I raped her before killing her. What can you do to me?"
"You bastard!"
When Leah heard Lexus's words, she immediately took out the pistol that Old Li had given her, aimed it at Lexus, and pulled the trigger.
Bang!
Gunshots.
However, because it was Leah's first time using a gun, her aim was not very accurate. Therefore, she did not hit Lexus but hit the ceiling instead.
"Ah…"
The woman who was lying on the bed screamed again when she saw Leah shoot. Then, she shouted at the top of her lungs, "Murder! Help!"
Connor frowned slightly when he heard the woman's scream. Then, he waved his right hand gently and the woman instantly fainted.
"You actually dare to shoot me?"
Lexus looked at Leah with an angry expression.
"I came here today to kill you…"
Leah bit her lips and yelled.
"Haha…"
Lexus could not help but sneer when he heard that. Then, he said indifferently, "If you want to kill me, you need to have the ability to do so…"
After saying that, Lexus suddenly waved his hand.
A cold light flashed.
Connor reached out and tugged at Leah.
A flying knife flew past Leah's ear.
Leah was instantly scared silly because she knew that if it wasn't for Connor's quick reaction, she might have died in Lexus's hands.
This was the difference between a martial artist and an ordinary person. If it wasn't for Connor, Leah might not have been able to avenge her sister in this lifetime.
When Lexus saw Connor's reaction speed, a strange look flashed across his face. Then, he sized up Connor and asked expressionlessly, "Are you a martial artist too, kid?"
Connor glanced at Lexus indifferently, then his figure flashed.
In the next second, Connor appeared in front of Lexus.
Lexus was shocked by Connor. He did not expect Connor to be so fast.
Bang!
Connor raised his hand and punched Lexus in the chest.
The arrogant Lexus was sent flying by Connor's punch and spat out a mouthful of blood.
Lexus was also a black rank martial artist, and it was already very impressive for him to be able to reach this level at his age. In Comtar, there weren't many young people who could be his match, not even Marcel Judkins and the others.
Therefore, when Lexus saw that Connor was not very old, he was very relaxed because he felt that Connor was young. Even if Connor was a martial artist, he would definitely not be his opponent.
However, he only started panicking after receiving Connor's punch. Connor's realm was far higher than his. Just now, Connor had merely casually released a punch, but it had scattered the aura in his body. This was a complete suppression of his realm.
"Who are you?"
Lexus shouted as he lay on the ground.
"It doesn't matter who I am…"
Connor replied in a low voice. Then, he placed his right foot on Lexus's chest and said in a low voice, "You should know that if I exert any force now, I can crush your heart. At that time, even God will not be able to save you…"
"Who exactly are you? What do you want?"
At this moment, a trace of fear finally flashed across Lexus's eyes. How could he have expected Leah to find such a powerful expert to deal with him?
Although Lexus didn't know Connor's true realm, he could feel that if Connor wanted to kill him, it was as easy as killing an ant.
"Call Draco Felton and ask for his current location!"
Connor whispered to Lexus.
Lexus couldn't help but be stunned when he heard Connor's words. Then, he frowned and asked, "Why are you looking for my grandfather?"
"Do you think I need to explain this to you?"
Connor replied indifferently and then continued, "Your life is now in my hands. I advise you to obediently do as I say. If I find out that you said something wrong or even uttered one wrong word, I will kill you."
"..."
Lexus looked at Connor and hesitated for a couple of seconds. Then, he stuttered, "Um, don't be agitated. I'll call my grandfather now…"
Lexus knew that Connor was not joking with him. Connor might really kill him.
"..."
Connor looked at Lexus without saying anything.
Lexus took a deep breath and took out his phone. He found Draco's number and dialed it.
Ring, ring, ring…
The phone rang several times before Draco picked it up.
"Lexus, is everything okay?"
Draco asked with a smile.
"Grandpa, where are you now? I heard that you are back from the Crimson Peak?"
Lexus asked softly.

chapters.title: Chapter 1854: The Felton Family Villa
chapters.content:
Chapter 1854: The Felton Family Villa
"I just got home!"
Draco replied.
"Oh, okay. I have something to discuss with you. I'll go see you later!"
Lexus hurriedly said.
"Alright…"
Draco agreed and then hung up the phone.
Connor saw Lexus put down his phone and asked softly, "Where is Draco now?"
"My grandfather should be at our Felton family's villa now…"
Lexus hurriedly replied.
"A more specific location!"
Connor asked again.
Lexus looked at Connor and told him the exact location of the Felton family villa.
After knowing where Draco was, Connor slowly moved his right foot away.
"Can you let me go now?"
Lexus whispered to Connor.
"The matter between the two of us has been resolved. The rest is between you and her!"
As Connor spoke, he turned to look at Leah and asked softly, "How do you plan to deal with this person?"
"I want to kill him…"
Leah bit her lips and exclaimed.
"Then, kill him!"
Connor replied indifferently, then waved his right hand gently.
An aura pierced through Lexus's forehead. Before Lexus could react, he died in Connor's hands.
Leah stared at Lexus's corpse, as if she was still dissatisfied. She then raised her pistol and fired several shots at Lexus's corpse.
Leah shot as she cried, as if she was venting the anger in her heart.
A few seconds later, all the bullets in Leah's pistol were gone.
Leah knelt on the ground and cried.
After hesitating for a moment, Connor walked to Leah's side and whispered to her, "Just now, the sound of you firing was a little loud. Someone will be here soon. We have to leave now!"
Leah looked at Connor and asked nervously, "The two of us killed someone here. Can we still run away?"
"Yes!"
Connor nodded lightly, then walked to the window and opened it.
"What are you doing? This is the fifth floor. If you jump down from here, you'll die…"
Leah said to Connor with her big watery eyes.
"Trust me, you won't die…"
Connor replied indifferently, then carried Leah up and jumped for life.
"Ah…"
Leah screamed instinctively and closed her eyes.
When Leah opened her eyes again, she realized that she and Connor had already landed outside the hotel building.
Leah stared at Connor with her big, watery eyes. Her face was filled with disbelief because she really wanted to understand how Connor could jump down from such a high place and still be fine.
However, when Leah thought about what Connor had done in the past few days when she was in contact with him, it did not seem so strange.
Connor put Leah down and said to her softly, "I've already killed your enemy for you. You don't have to follow me anymore; I have to settle my own stuff!"
"..."
Leah stood rooted to the ground and didn't say anything. She felt as if everything she had experienced was a dream.
She had been planning to kill Lexus to avenge her sister for a long time, but every time she carried it out, she would encounter all kinds of difficulties. Leah had wanted to give up on this idea.
However, she never expected that all of this would really happen and that it would be so easy.
Just as Leah was still in shock from what had just happened, Connor had already walked to the car and opened the door to get in.
Connor turned the car key and started the car. Then, he was about to leave.
However, at this moment, the door of the passenger seat was suddenly pulled open.
Connor instinctively turned and saw that it was Leah who had gotten into the car.
"Why are you here?"
Connor asked Leah in confusion.
"I don't know where I should go now. If I go home, I'm worried that I'll implicate my parents, so I might as well follow you!"
Leah replied softly.
"You can find a place to hide for the time being. What I'm going to do later will be very dangerous."
Connor advised in a low voice.
"You helped me a lot just now, so I should help you too. You're not familiar with Comtar, and it's not easy to find the Felton family's villa. But I know where the Felton family's villa is, and I can take you there!"
Leah said to Connor in a serious tone.
"Aren't you afraid of death?"
Connor asked with a smile.
"You're so strong. I won't die by your side, right?"
Leah said softly.
"..."
When Connor heard Leah's words, he smiled helplessly and sighed softly, "If I was really that strong, I would not have appeared here…"
Connor didn't want to bring Leah along. Since it was between him and Draco, he didn't want to implicate Leah. However, since Leah didn't want to leave and could even lead the way for Connor, he didn't continue to persuade Leah to get out of the car.
Leah seemed to be very familiar with Comtar. In less than half an hour, the two of them found the Felton family's villa.
Today, the Felton family's villa was brightly lit, and laughter could be heard from time to time.
Through the conversation between Lexus and Draco, Connor knew that Draco had just arrived home, so the Soul Returning Fruit must be in Draco's hands now.
"Wait for me here!"
Connor turned and said to Leah.
"I want to go in with you…"
Leah said to Connor in a serious tone.
"You want to go in with me?"
Connor couldn't help but be stunned when he heard Leah's words. Then, he smiled and said, "I can't even protect myself. Do you want to die with me?"
"Since you know that you can't even protect yourself, why are you still going in?"
Leah asked Connor in confusion.
"Because there are some things that I have to do!"
Connor didn't explain too much to Leah and walked into the Felton family villa.
After hesitating for a couple of seconds, Leah followed Connor into the Felton family's villa.
The Felton family villa was livelier than usual today.
This was because Draco had killed Connor and saved Marcel Judkins, Levi Warner, Kian Sherman and Fabiola Lopez.
Therefore, the heads of the Judkins, the Warner and Sherman families all came to thank Draco.
Basically, the heads of several famous ancient martial arts families in Comtar were gathered here, so he came at the wrong time today.
However, Connor was not in the mood to think about all that.
What he wanted now was to get the Soul Returning Fruit back as soon as possible.

chapters.title: Chapter 1855: Something is Wrong
chapters.content:
Chapter 1855: Something is Wrong
In the dining room of the Felton family villa.
At this moment, there were about twenty people standing in the dining hall.
These people were all famous martial artists in Comtar, and any one of them was a black rank.
These people basically represented the peak of ancient martial arts in the entire Comtar.
Javier Lopez, the head of the Lopez family, raised his wine glass and smiled at Draco. "Draco, thank you so much for what happened in Crimson Peak a few days ago. If you hadn't intervened, my granddaughter, Fabiola, would have died in Connor's hands…"
"Yes, Draco, my son told me about it after he came back. It's really all thanks to you, Draco!"
Kian's grandfather, Tarun Sherman, also hurriedly said.
"This Connor guy is really ruthless. Marcel has become a cripple because of him…"
Keaton Judkins gritted his teeth and said.
"Tell me about it. My son will probably only be an ordinary person in this lifetime…"
Gideon Warner, the head of the Warner family, sighed expressionlessly.
"Everyone, there's no need to be too sad. I've already discussed this matter with Mr. Zadra. He has agreed to have the alchemists of the Heavenly Sect refine a few Essence Cultivating Pills for your juniors. When the time comes, as long as they eat the Essence Cultivating Pills, their bodies will recover. Who knows, their strength might even improve a little…"
Draco said with a smile.
"Draco, is what you said true?"
Tarun was a little excited as he hurriedly asked Draco.
"Yes, Draco. If this is true, then I will repay your kindness even if I have to work like a cow or a horse for the rest of my life!"
Gideon shouted.
"How could I joke about this kind of thing with you? Although the Essence Cultivating Pill is precious, it's not a big deal to Mr. Zadra Moreover, I helped him find the Soul Returning Fruit this time. He owes me a big favor. So, him refining a few Essence Cultivating Pills is nothing..."
Draco said with a smile while drinking.
"That's really great…"
Everyone looked at Draco and shed tears of gratitude. They were so excited that they did not know how to express their emotions.
The other martial artists looked very envious. After all, the Essence Cultivating Pill was a divine medicine. It was something that many martial artists dreamed of!
"By the way, Draco, if Jorge Yarrell finds out that you killed Connor McDonald, I'm afraid he won't let it go!"
Javier suddenly reminded him.
"How could Jorge Yarrell know that I killed his disciple? Only everyone here knows about this matter. If anyone dares to tell anyone about this, you know what will happen…"
Draco said lightly.
"Draco, what are you saying? How could we betray you?"
"Yeah, how would we have the guts?"
"In the future, we need you to take care of us!"
Everyone hurriedly expressed their loyalty.
Draco looked at everyone and smiled, then said expressionlessly, "I was just joking with everyone. In fact, even if you spread this new, it doesn't matter. I killed Connor to help Beau Collier get the Soul Returning Fruit. If Jorge Yarrell really wants to take revenge on me, then Beau Collier won't sit idly by…"
"That's right. Draco is now backed by the Collier family. Even Jorge Yarrell wouldn't dare to do anything to Draco!"
Gideon said with a smile.
"Yeah, it's just Jorge Yarrell."
Draco sneered disdainfully.
"If my master were in front of you right now, would you have the guts to say all that?"
However, at this moment, a very discordant voice sounded in the dining hall.
The people who were chatting and laughing all quieted down when they heard this. Then, they turned to look at the entrance.
A young man in black slowly walked in, followed by a mixed-blood beauty.
However, the mixed-blood beauty seemed a little nervous when she saw so many important people gathered together.
Draco suddenly raised his head to look at the young man, and then shouted with an incredulous expression, "Connor McDonald? How are you still alive?"
"What? This person is Connor McDonald?"
"How is that possible? I heard that Connor was thrown off a ten-thousand-meter cliff."
"What is going on?"
Everyone began to discuss in low voices.
"What? You didn't expect me to come back alive, did you?"
Connor looked at Draco and asked calmly.
"Impossible, you are definitely not Connor…"
Draco shouted because he clearly remembered that he had broken all the meridians in Connor's body. At that time, Connor was already a cripple. Later, he was thrown off the ten-thousand-meter cliff by the others.
Under such circumstances, even an ancient martial arts grandmaster would have no chance of survival.
However, at this moment, Connor had actually appeared in front of him alive and kicking. Draco felt as if he had seen a ghost.
"Actually, I want to thank you. If it weren't for you, how could I have my current strength?"
Connor was not in the mood to talk nonsense with Draco. He released the aura in his body.
In an instant, Connor's black hair fluttered in the wind, and the color of his skin also underwent some subtle changes, giving people the feeling that he was a God who had descended upon the mortal world.
Even Leah found it unbelievable when she saw Connor like that.
Draco stared at Connor with his eyes wide open. He could feel that Connor, who was standing in front of him, seemed to be many times stronger than before.
Even if Draco racked his brains, he still could not understand what was going on!
"Draco, this kid is the one who crippled my grandson?"
At this moment, Keaton suddenly asked Draco.
"It's him. But I clearly broke all his meridians, so how could he still be alive?"
Draco did not understand what was going on.
"Maybe it's because this kid is lucky. Since he personally crippled my grandson, it just gives me a good chance to take revenge. Draco, you just came out of the Crimson Peak, so let me deal with him."
Keaton shouted expressionlessly.
"Keaton, there seems to be something off with this kid. Be careful!"
Draco could not help but remind him softly.
"He's nothing more than a young boy. Today, I must kill him personally to avenge my grandson!"
Keaton shouted and stood up.
After Keaton stood up, Connor realized that Keaton was almost two meters tall and had a very burly figure.

chapters.title: Chapter 1856: Instant Kill!
chapters.content:
Chapter 1856: Instant Kill!
"Brat, prepare to die!"
Keaton shouted angrily at Connor.
The next moment, his skin began to turn golden.
Clearly, Keaton was using the same Body Refining Technique as Marcel, but it was evident that Keaton's technique was more skilled, and the hardness of his body couldn't be compared.
After using the Body Refining Technique, Marcel's skin would become close to the color of steel, but Keaton's skin was now closer to gold.
With determined steps, Keaton charged toward Connor. With each step, he left behind a massive footprint on the ground, demonstrating the terrifying extent of his strength.
Seconds later, he had reached Connor, and he raised his fist, prepared to split him in half.
However, Connor's figure disappeared in an instant.
Seeing him vanish, Keaton's expression showed surprise because he hadn't expected Connor's speed to be so astonishing.
"Keaton, be careful!"
However, at that moment, Javier suddenly yelled.
Keaton abruptly turned around.
Connor had already appeared behind him.
He raised his fist and struck Keaton's back.
Connor's punch seemed ordinary, but upon hitting Keaton, it produced a deafening sound.
Perhaps because the noise was too loud, the glasses, plates, and even the windows in the restaurant shattered almost simultaneously.
In the midst of everyone's shocked expressions, Keaton staggered back two steps and then sat down on the ground with a thud.
Everyone was familiar with Keaton's Body Refining Technique and knew how terrifyingly strong he was. But Connor had just knocked him down with a single punch, which seemed incredible.
He sat on the ground, feeling intense pain in his chest, almost as if he was about to cough up blood. However, he managed to suppress the surging sensation within him.
If he were to spit blood after that punch, he would become a laughingstock.
Draco also looked bewildered as he watched Connor's position. He could clearly see that Connor's punch had left an imprint on Keaton's body. This indicated the incredible power behind his punch.
Back when they were on Crimson Peak, Draco had sparred with Connor, so he knew Connor's strength well. If Connor had possessed this level of combat power back then, he wouldn't have been able to easily break his meridians.
Draco couldn't fathom what had happened; he felt like the person standing before him now was a completely different man.
"Keaton, this guy is no ordinary opponent; let me help you!"
Sudden shouts from Tarun Sherman, the head of the Sherman family, filled the air. He waved his right hand, sending a sphere of boundless lightning power directly toward Connor's location.
This move was Tarun's signature technique, and the power within the sphere couldn't be compared to ordinary explosives. Once it exploded, it would likely turn the entire courtyard into ashes.
Seeing the sphere approaching him, Connor lightly waved his right hand, sending a burst of energy toward Leah's location. He knew that if the sphere exploded, she would certainly perish.
Tarun felt his anger welling up when he saw Connor seemingly still caring about someone amidst the chaos
But in the next moment, he was dumbfounded.
Because Connor had directly caught the lightning sphere with both hands, and the sphere didn't explode in his grasp.
"Go!"
He pushed both hands forward, sending the sphere hurtling toward Tarun.
"Boom!"
The sphere exploded.
In the next moment, the Felton family's villa, unable to withstand the tremendous impact, began to crumble.
"Everyone, run! The villa is about to collapse!"
Someone shouted, and all the martial artists present immediately rushed outside.
Connor reached Leah's side, picked her up, and disappeared from the villa.
A moment later, the Felton family's villa had turned into ruins.
During that instant, countless innocent Felton family servants perished within the villa.
The martial artists who had fled the villa now stood safely in the yard outside.
Leah looked at Connor in front of her, her expression a mix of shock and astonishment. What had just happened shattered her understanding of human strength once again.
"Let's all attack together; this guy is not ordinary!"
At that moment, Javier suddenly shouted.
All the martial artists present rushed toward Connor.
In an instant, over a dozen martial artists surrounded him and launched simultaneous attacks.
Draco had been observing Connor from a distance the whole time, finding it hard to believe the incredible transformation in his combat strength in less than ten days.
These martial artists attacking Connor, while not at the level of martial arts grandmaster, were still among the most formidable martial artists in Comtar. Even a martial arts grandmaster would find them challenging.
Yet, he appeared at ease in the face of their attacks, as if he didn't regard them seriously.
The first to reach Connor was Javier, the head of the Lopez family. However, before he could get close to him, Connor slapped him across the face.
Javier spewed blood and was sent flying.
The second martial artist to approach Connor was struck by a single punch, and his body was instantly pierced, lifeless.
The scene in the courtyard of the Felton family villa resembled a battlefield of demons and gods, with martial artists continuously rushing at Connor only to be instantly killed.
In less than half a minute, seven or eight martial artists lay dead at Connor's feet.

chapters.title: Chapter 1857: Zen Palm
chapters.content:
Chapter 1857: Zen Palm
Perhaps it was because Connor had suddenly gained the old man's power, so he wasn't very skilled at controlling his own strength.
Even if he didn't want to kill these people, sometimes he still struck too hard.
After witnessing his terrifying combat power, the martial artists present seemed to calm down a bit, and their gazes toward him became very wary.
After all, no one wanted to die in vain.
"What kind of monster is this kid? Why is he so powerful?"
"Yeah, could it be that this kid is a martial arts grandmaster?"
"It shouldn't be, how could there be such a young martial arts grandmaster?"
The crowd couldn't help but discuss in hushed tones as they looked at his position.
"Rubbish! Are you telling me that so many of us can't defeat a brat like him?"
However, at this moment, Keaton suddenly shouted and rushed directly toward Connor's position.
Upon seeing Keaton charging at him, Connor had a somewhat disdainful expression on his face and said lightly, "You think you can kill me?"
After saying this, he rushed forward and threw a punch.
"Bang!"
His fist struck Keaton's chest with incredible force.
Keaton took two consecutive steps back, then fell to the ground with a loud thud.
At this moment, he could feel that Connor's punch had shattered all his meridians. He instinctively tried to get up, but he couldn't move because his meridians were completely severed.
The head of the Judkins family in Comtar lay in front of Connor.
When Connor struck Keaton, it seemed as if he were effortlessly dealing with an ordinary person who had no strength.
After dealing with Keaton, he turned his attention to Javier and said expressionlessly, "Now it's your turn..."
Upon hearing these words, Javier's expression appeared fearful because he knew he was no match for him.
"Keaton, help me!"
Javier couldn't help but shout.
Tarun and Gideon, upon hearing this, both simultaneously attacked Connor.
It could be said that these three individuals were the most formidable martial artists in Comtar under Draco.
However, even when these three martial artists attacked Connor together with all their might, they couldn't harm him in the slightest.
In fact, Connor hadn't used any flashy martial techniques from start to finish; he relied solely on his fists to carve a path of blood.
Javier was the first to be knocked down by him.
After he fell, the gazes of the onlookers completely changed. In their eyes, Connor was now invincible. The combat power he displayed was simply terrifying.
But he didn't stop there; he plunged into the crowd again, and one formidable opponent after another fell before him.
In less than ten minutes, countless ancient martial experts lay at his feet.
These experts were dominant figures in Comtar, and neither Tarun nor Gideon could even get close to Connor to harm him.
Who would have thought that such a young martial artist could possess such terrifying combat power?
Before, they thought Connor had come to the Felton family to meet his death, but now they no longer had such thoughts. The gazes of the onlookers were filled only with endless fear when they looked at Connor.
And at this moment, only Draco remained standing.
Gideon stared at Draco and said through gritted teeth, "Draco, you're deceiving us! This Connor is not at the martial arts grandmaster level. Why did you say you had already killed him?"
"Back in Crimson Peak, the Connor I encountered was at the Black-rank level!"
Draco couldn't fathom what was happening now and said through gritted teeth.
Originally, these martial artists from Comtar had intended to please Draco on this occasion, but they never expected Connor's combat power to be so terrifying. Even when so many of them joined forces, they still couldn't match him.
Moreover, they hadn't even had a chance to face him directly.
At this moment, Connor had made it clear to them what true invincibility meant.
As for Keaton, Tarun, and the others, they now felt like they had been deceived by Draco. Connor's combat power far exceeded what a martial arts grandmaster could possess.
Draco was equally perplexed. He couldn't understand how Connor's strength had grown so dramatically in just a few days.
"What kind of person are you?" asked Draco, his expression devoid of emotion.
"Do you not know it?" Connor replied calmly.
"You are not Connor. I killed Connor, and you are... who are you?" Draco shouted angrily, glaring at him.
"You shouldn't be dwelling on that question right now. You should be thinking about how you're going to survive today," Connor said disdainfully.
"How am I going to survive?" Draco sneered when he heard this and then shouted, "Connor, do you think that by defeating these people, I'll be afraid of you?"
Connor remained silent, watching Draco.
"Back in Crimson Peak, I killed you. Today, I will kill you again!" Draco roared, releasing a powerful aura.
Though Draco wasn't on the same level as Beau or Jorge, he was still at the martial arts grandmaster level. After years of cultivation in Comtar, his strength was not to be underestimated. In all of Oprana, there were probably less than ten people capable of defeating him.
This was where Draco got his confidence.
And now, after causing a commotion at the Felton family, he had to eliminate Connor, no matter what the cost, to save face and prevent future trouble.
As for Connor's increased strength and how he had survived, Draco no longer cared.
"Prepare to die!" Draco roared, and in an instant, a giant palm descended toward Connor's position.
"The Zen Palm?" The crowd was shocked when they saw the massive palm. They hadn't expected Draco to use his most powerful technique right from the start.

chapters.title: Chapter 1858: Who Are You?
chapters.content:
Chapter 1858: Who Are You?
Zen Palm can be said to be Draco's ultimate skill.
He used his own breath to draw in the spiritual energy of heaven and earth into his body, finally condensing it into the shape of his palm. The power was astonishing, making it impossible for martial artists below the grandmaster level to withstand it.
When Connor saw that gigantic palm, his expression appeared somewhat disdainful.
If this were the previous Connor, he would probably have been overwhelmed by the aura of this palm long ago. But now, the power of this palm was simply negligible to him.
Without hesitation, he punched directly at the palm.
His fist carried a golden light forming a fist seal, heading straight for Draco's palm.
Although his fist didn't seem as imposing as Draco's palm, everyone could still feel its power.
"Could this Connor really be a martial arts grandmaster?"
Tarun couldn't help but mutter quietly.
"Boom!"
At this moment, Connor's fist seal collided fiercely with Draco's Zen Palm.
It's important to note that both of them were using techniques derived from their breath, so when they clashed, they instantly created an immensely powerful energy fluctuation.
If anyone were unfortunate enough to be struck by this powerful energy wave, they would likely die on the spot.
However, the first encounter between them was evenly matched.
This led to even more incredulous expressions on the faces of those present.
They knew very well that if Connor could compete evenly with Draco, it meant that he was definitely a martial arts grandmaster!
"Who are you, really?"
Draco roared when he saw Connor.
Connor completely ignored him and charged directly toward him.
He raised his hand and threw a punch toward Draco's position, while Draco blocked the punch with his palm.
The two engaged in close combat.
In just an instant, they had exchanged blows more than ten times.
Connor's fist and Draco's palm seemed to be in a constant back-and-forth, and onlookers couldn't tell who had the upper hand.
Due to their incredible speed, even those with slightly lower martial arts levels couldn't follow their movements closely.
Both Connor and Draco were martial arts grandmasters, so there was a tremendous aura around that that affected everyone present. This forced everyone to continuously retreat to avoid getting caught in the energy fluctuations.
"I never thought there would be such a young martial arts grandmaster in the world. It's truly unbelievable!"
"Indeed, how old is this Connor? To become a martial arts grandmaster at his age is already extraordinary!"
"I wonder who will win this battle today..."
The crowd was filled with excitement and amazement.
Leah kept her beautiful eyes fixed on Connor's position. Even though she couldn't see Connor and Draco anymore, she couldn't bring herself to look away.
Among the people present, she was probably the only one silently praying for Connor's victory.
"Boom!"
At that moment, the crowd heard a different sound.
Connor's punch struck Draco's chest directly, causing him to retreat more than ten meters before steadying himself.
Draco lowered his head and glanced at his shoulder, feeling a subtle pain.
Clearly, Connor's punch had pierced through his protective aura.
While Draco hadn't suffered any actual injuries, the fact that his punch had penetrated a Grandmaster's protective aura was shocking in itself.
Before, Connor had relied on the Chi Circulation Technique and the Seven-Star Big Dipper Fist in his battles. These two martial techniques were exclusive to the Purple Cloud Sect and possessed formidable power. However, due to his low cultivation level at the time, he couldn't fully unleash their potential.
After gaining power from the old man, his cultivation level was now comparable to that of a true martial arts grandmaster. He could truly appreciate the terrifying power of these two martial techniques.
"Who are you really?"
Draco, feeling suppressed by Connor from start to finish, couldn't help but shout, "Are you Jorge?"
"I am Connor!" he replied in a low voice.
"This can't be!"
Draco's eyes widened upon hearing his response.
In the next moment, Draco's body underwent a rapid transformation.
An extremely chilling wind blew, and he stomped his feet before soaring into the sky.
Connor slowly raised his head and watched Draco.
His body continued to ascend, and his speed was astonishing, reminiscent of a rocket shooting into the sky.
"Is Draco running away?"
Tarun saw this scene and instinctively thought that Draco might be retreating because he couldn't defeat Connor.
However, the next second left everyone stunned.
Draco's body was plummeting rapidly. He had been like a rocket before, but now he resembled a falling missile.
He extended his hand forward, striking toward Connor in an eerie manner.
Seeing this, Connor's expression appeared somewhat unusual. He immediately gathered both hands over his head.
"Boom!"
A loud explosion echoed.
Draco's palm and Connor's palm collided directly.
Beneath Connor's feet, a massive crater appeared instantly.
His legs were also driven into the ground.
Everyone present was left in awe of Draco's technique. The power was simply terrifying.
If anyone else had been standing there instead of Connor, they would likely have been turned into a pile of flesh by Draco's strike.
After Draco's palm struck, the onlookers seemed to have lost their vision temporarily.
"Your palm is indeed formidable, but it still can't kill me!"
With nearly half of his body buried in the ground, Connor spoke slowly.
Upon hearing this, Draco widened his eyes.
In the next second, Connor exerted force with his legs, leaping into the air.
"Seven-Star Big Dipper Fist, Sky Splitter!"
He roared, and with a powerful punch, he struck Draco's palm.

chapters.title: Chapter 1859: He Actually Lost?
chapters.content:
Chapter 1859: He Actually Lost?
Draco hadn't even had a chance to react when he felt an immensely powerful force surging through his palm and into his body. He quickly tried to resist Connor's power, but Connor's strength was overwhelming. Before he could gather his energy, his body was sent flying.
Seizing the opportunity, Connor pursued and delivered a powerful punch to his chest. It was as if a divine force struck, shattering the protective energy around him and piercing through his entire body.
A deafening crash echoed as his body slammed into the ground, creating a massive crater.
The onlookers were left wide-eyed, their expressions filled with disbelief. None of them had anticipated this outcome. Draco seemed utterly defenseless against Connor.
"At this rate, Draco is really going to lose." Gideon couldn't help but mutter.
"Even if he doesn't lose, it seems his luck today is running thin," Javier added.
In their hearts, they all knew that if Draco lost to Connor, they wouldn't escape Connor's clutches either.
But just then, a figure soared out of the deep crater. Draco stood suspended in mid-air, gazing down at Connor like a deity.
"Draco hasn't lost yet!" Gideon exclaimed excitedly.
Although he appeared battered, his aura hadn't diminished; in fact, it seemed even stronger than before.
"Connor, I didn't expect you could push me to this extent!" Draco spoke softly, looking down at Connor.
Connor remained silent when he heard this.
"I thought I could easily handle you, but now I realize I underestimated you. It's been years since I faced an opponent like you. Today, I'll test the power of the martial arts I've dedicated years to perfecting!" Draco shouted, raising his hands.
In the next moment, a vortex formed around his body, seemingly devouring something. After a few seconds, ice crystals appeared on his body. His appearance resembled that of a long-frozen corpse, sending shivers down everyone's spine.
"Draco seems to be absorbing the cold air around him," the crowd muttered, puzzled as they felt the temperature rising.
"Yes, he is practicing the 'Froststeel Flow' technique. He's actually learned it!" Gideon's voice quivered.
"Froststeel Flow?" Everyone present widened their eyes in shock. The Froststeel Flow technique was the most elite body-refining method in Comtar's martial world. It was said to make a person's body even tougher than ice, greatly enhancing their combat prowess. However, because of its demanding requirements and the life-threatening consequences of failure, very few dared to attempt it.
In the past, some martial artists in Comtar had practiced it to increase their combat power, but they had either perished from the intense cold or suffered severe bodily damage while using the technique.
Froststeel Flow had become a forbidden technique in Comtar, known only to a handful of martial artists who never dared to try it.
No one expected Draco to secretly practice this technique.
"Is Draco throwing his life away?" Tarunn's voice trembled.
"Yeah, once he uses Froststeel Flow, even if he's a martial arts grandmaster, it'll be hard for him to withstand the backlash of the cold energy!" Javier added.
"If Draco doesn't use this move today, he might die at Connor's hands. Using it might give him a chance..." Keaton whispered.
Sighs escaped from everyone's lips as they conversed.
Unbeknownst to them, Draco's body had turned a corpse-like shade, and Connor sensed that although Draco's heart still beat, it did so at an agonizingly slow pace. His body was on the brink of collapse.
"Today, I'll show you my true power!" he roared at Connor, charging toward him like a monstrous force.
His speed was astonishing; it seemed he reached Connor's position in an instant. He raised his fist and struck Connor's chest.
"Thud!"
Instantly, Connor was sent flying.
Before he could regain his footing, Draco was already in front of him, lifting his leg and ruthlessly stomping down on Connor's body.
Perhaps due to the earlier punch he received, Connor's body was now affected by the frigid energy, causing his speed to be noticeably slower.
"Thud!"
Draco's foot landed on his chest.
Connor spat out a mouthful of blood, which froze instantly.
"I didn't expect there would be such a technique in this world!" Connor gritted his teeth, enduring the churning energy within him.
"In my eyes, you're nothing more than an ant. No matter how you gained such power, you'll meet your end today!" Draco coldly declared, staring at him.

chapters.title: Chapter 1860: Ruthless and Cruel
chapters.content:
Chapter 1860: Ruthless and Cruel
"Is that so?"
Connor's expression seemed somewhat unusual, but he didn't waste any words. Instead, he swiftly rose to his feet and, like an arrow released from a bow, charged directly toward Draco's position.
"Bang!"
His fist struck directly at Draco's chest.
After taking the punch, Draco only took two steps back before steadying himself.
"You won't be able to kill me today..."
His expression seemed somewhat triumphant.
"Whether I can kill you or not, we'll only know if I try!"
Connor took a deep breath and began to channel the energy within his body.
"Chi Circulation Technique Level Ten, VVital Flow!" he roared.
Immediately after, countless streams of energy crazily surged into Connor's body.
The onlookers were even more astonished when they witnessed this scene.
Just a moment ago, Draco was only absorbing the cold energy between heaven and earth. But now, Connor was actually absorbing all the various types of energy present in the world.
It's important to note that the energy between heaven and earth contained nearly dozens of different types, and besides spiritual energy, most of the other energies were harmful to martial artists.
However, he was now attempting to absorb all of these energies into his own body, a move that was clearly even more insane than Draco's previous actions.
"I'm lucky to witness such an exciting battle, even if I die, I'll die without regrets..."
At this moment, an elderly man couldn't help but exclaim with a trembling voice.
"Yes, we may never reach this level in our entire lives!"
The people around him nodded in agreement.
Connor's speed in absorbing the energy was extremely fast, leaving Draco with hardly any time to prepare.
"Seven-Star Big Dipper Fist, Blazing Sun!"
After a low roar, he rushed directly to Draco.
In an instant, everyone felt an intensely dazzling light bursting from his body, and some had to shield their eyes with their arms.
Draco, seemingly awed by the burst of light from Connor's body, instinctively raised his arms to protect his chest.
"Bang!"
Connor's fist directly struck Draco's arm.
Draco was sent flying, but this was just the beginning. After his body fell, Connor quickly caught up with him and unleashed a series of seven or eight punches.
Each of Connor's punches was powered by his full strength, and the tremendous noise they generated resembled bomb explosions. The terrifying energy waves rippled through the sky.
Draco, who had been holding his ground somewhat earlier, was now completely suppressed by Connor. He had almost no opportunity to retaliate because his speed was simply terrifying.
"It's over!"
At this moment, Connor roared again and punched directly into Draco's heart.
He groaned, and then his body was forcefully slammed down from the sky by Connor's punch.
"Boom!"
His body crashed onto the ground, creating a crater ten times larger than the previous one.
This time, when Draco's body landed, everyone fell silent because they could clearly feel how astonishing the power of Connor's punch was.
"Draco is in a dire situation this time..."
Javier sat on the ground, his expression filled with despair.
The faces of the others looked extremely grim as they didn't know what to say.
Several seconds later, Connor slowly descended to the ground.
His condition didn't seem very good at the moment because he had forcefully absorbed too much energy. His body was unstable.
He took slow steps toward Draco's position.
"I never thought I'd actually lose to you. Who are you really?"
Draco coughed heavily and trembled as he asked.
"I am who I am..."
Connor replied in a low voice.
"It's impossible. If you had such terrifying strength, why didn't you just kill me back on Crimson Peak?"
Draco, now injured all over, questioned with a frown.
"If you hadn't thrown me off that cliff that day, I might have already died on Crimson Peak. It's precisely because you wanted to eradicate me that I've become who I am now. I think I should thank you!"
Connor said softly to Draco.
"Could it be you've had some extraordinary encounters?"
Draco realized what had happened and looked somewhat shocked.
"That's right..."
Connor nodded slightly.
Draco bit his lip and looked at Connor, not knowing how to describe his feelings. He regretted not personally taking action to kill Connor back then.
"I don't have time to talk with you now. Hand over the Soul Returning Fruit!"
Connor said to Draco in a low voice.
After hearing this, Draco paused for a moment and then asked with a furrowed brow, "If I hand over the Soul Returning Fruit, will you spare me?"
"No..."
Connor didn't hesitate and shook his head.
"Since you won't spare me, why should I give it to you?"
Draco gritted his teeth and asked.
"Although I won't spare you, I can spare the other members of the Felton family. If you don't want to hand over the Soul Returning Fruit, then I'll have to kill every member of the Felton family. Even if I have to turn the entire Comtar upside down, I will find it!"
Connor said each word with determination.
Upon hearing this, Draco hesitated for a moment, then gritted his teeth and said softly, "Connor, you're truly ruthless!"

chapters.title: Chapter 1861: Unconscious
chapters.content:
Chapter 1861: Unconscious
"I am ruthless and merciless?" Connor said lightly, with an emotionless expression. "If we're really comparing ruthlessness and mercilessness, then I am nothing compared to you."
Draco coughed twice and then gritted his teeth, saying, "Alright, alright, since I've already lost to you today, I'll give you the Soul Returning Fruit back."
Even though Draco knew that Connor would never let him go today, he had no choice. He knew that if he didn't hand over the Soul Returning Fruit, the entire Felton family would suffer.
With trembling hands, he took the jade box containing the Soul Returning Fruit from his chest and placed it in front of Connor.
With a wave of his hand, Connor caught the jade box.
After confirming that the Soul Returning Fruit was still inside, Connor let out a long sigh of relief. He then looked at Draco and said, "If you had only taken the Soul Returning Fruit from my hands, I might not have killed you. Even if you had thrown me off the cliff, I might have spared you. But you killed Jayson. He was just an ordinary person with no connection to any of this, and yet you killed him. So, I cannot let you go."
"You killed me because of that person?" Draco asked in astonishment.
"Yes," Connor replied, nodding. He then waved his right hand.
A cold light flashed.
The Five Elements Dagger pierced through Draco's chest in an instant.
He didn't even have a chance to say his last words before he died in front of Connor.
Connor waved his hand again, and the Five Elements Dagger returned to his hand.
Carrying the dagger, he walked up to Gideon and the others. By now, they were all dumbfounded, staring at him with nervous expressions.
"What do you think is an appropriate punishment for all of you?" Connor asked, wiping the blood from the dagger.
"Mr. Connor, we originally had no grievances with you. We only wanted to avenge our family's younger generation, so we attacked you. Now, we've learned our lesson. Please spare us," Gideon said, his tone filled with excitement.
"Yes, Mr. Connor, even if I survive, I'll be a useless person. A useless person poses no threat to you," Keaton added quickly.
"Mr. Connor, please, spare us. We were blind to offend you," others in the group pleaded fervently.
After hearing their pleas, Connor sighed softly, his expression unchanged. "I don't want anyone to know about what happened today. If anyone else finds out that Draco died by my hand, I will personally come after each of you."
"Mr. Connor, you can rest assured. We will never speak of it," they all said eagerly.
Connor gave them a brief look, then turned away without saying anything more. He walked over to where Leah was standing nearby.
"Alright, let's go," Connor said to her.
Leah hesitated for a moment but quickly followed Connor's steps.
A little while later, Connor and Leah returned to the car. Those who had been watching the scene from a distance breathed a sigh of relief when they saw Connor leaving. After all, they had narrowly escaped a grim fate.
On the other side, once they were inside the car, Connor had Leah sit in the driver's seat. He spoke to her in a low voice, "Hurry, drive away from here."
"Connor, what's wrong with you? Your face looks pale. Are you okay?" She turned to look at him, her voice trembling with concern.
"Don't worry about me. Just drive," he urged in a low voice.
"Okay..."
She hesitated for a moment and then started the car. However, before the car could even drive a hundred meters away, he suddenly spat out a mouthful of blood, staining the car window red.
"Ah..."
She let out a scream and quickly stopped the car and turned to him, asking anxiously, "Connor, what's wrong with you? Are you seriously injured? Should I take you to the hospital?"
"Do not go to the hospital. Take me..." He couldn't finish his sentence before he passed out.
Seeing him faint, she became even more panicked. After hesitating for two seconds, she quickly started the car and drove away.
Although he had accidentally obtained the power of the old man's remnant soul, these powers did not belong to him originally. Furthermore, while his strength had increased, his body remained the same as before. In addition, he had already been seriously injured in the battle at the Crimson Peak, and his body had just started to recover. After experiencing such an intense battle and absorbing a large amount of energy, it put a significant strain on his body. This was why he fainted.
Fortunately, he had brought Leah with him. If it had not been for her, he might have collapsed right at the doorstep of the Felton family mansion.
As for the incident involving the death of the Comtar's top martial artist, it had spread throughout Oprana overnight. Draco, a martial arts grandmaster and the head of the Felton family, had met a tragic end at the hands of a mysterious martial artist. This news had sent shockwaves throughout the martial arts world, as Comtar was known for its martial arts heritage.
The fact that such a prominent figure had been killed and many other martial artists had been severely injured in one night had shaken the martial arts community. Comtar, previously renowned for its martial arts, had suddenly fallen into a state of turmoil.
People were eager to know the identity of this mysterious martial artist, but those who had survived the encounter were unwilling to talk about it. The mystery surrounding this figure only deepened, and various speculations circulated. However, given the limited number of individuals capable of defeating Draco, the list of potential suspects remained relatively small.

chapters.title: Chapter 1862: Haverhead Hill
chapters.content:
Chapter 1862: Haverhead Hill
The Collier mansion in York.
Beau's expression was extremely shocked when he learned of Draco's death. He had originally planned to depart today for Comtar to retrieve the Soul Returning Fruit. However, he never expected that someone would beat him to it, killing Draco and taking the Soul Returning Fruit.
"Father, who do you think killed Draco?" Albert's expression was equally frustrated. After all, they had just located the Soul Returning Fruit, and now it had been snatched away, dashing Cielo's hopes of recovery.
"Ah..." Aida's expression appeared somewhat unusual. She had heard Beau mention half a month ago that Draco had killed Connor. At that time, she found it hard to accept because she had just gained his trust, and he had died.
Now, in a matter of days, Draco had also died, and the Soul Returning Fruit had been taken by someone else. However, the theft of the Soul Returning Fruit could be considered a blessing for Aida. As long as Cielo did not recover, her chances of becoming the Collier family head would still be high.
"Father, apart from our Collier family, do any others know that Connor is dead?" Albert hesitated and asked Beau.
"The heads of the families in Yarlford also know about it," Beau replied emotionlessly.
"Could it be that those people in Yarlford leaked the news and Jorge found out that Connor is dead?" Albert continued.
Upon hearing this, Beau was stunned for a moment. He suddenly turned to Albert and asked in a low voice, "Are you suggesting that Jorge killed Draco?"
"Father, even if we look at the entire country, how many people do you think could have killed Draco? Moreover, Draco had no grudges with anyone else, and no one would go to such lengths, right?" Albert analyzed with a furrowed brow.
"What are those people in Yarlford thinking? They leaked the news so quickly. They are causing harm to me!" Beau exclaimed with a trembling voice.
"Father, please think of a solution. If Draco was indeed killed by Jorge, then he must have already betrayed our Collier family. I think Jorge is very likely to come after us soon!" Albert said with desperation.
Beau couldn't help but take a deep breath and then spoke in a low voice, "We don't have many other options. Go and inform all members of our Collier family to pack their belongings and come with me to Haverhead Hill!"
"Are you planning to take all of our Collier family to hide in Haverhead Hill?" Albert asked after hesitating.
"Besides this method, what other options do you have?" Beau replied with a cold tone.
Albert looked at him without saying a word.
"I'm not Jorge's match right now. If he comes for us, all members of our Collier family will die by his hand. Heavenly Sect has many disciples, and with the help of several elders, I might have a chance to stand against Jorge. Besides, I don't think he would dare to easily go to Haverhead Hill, so that place is the safest for us!" Beau added in a hushed tone.
Albert was also very worried about the possibility of Jorge coming for them. After a moment of hesitation, he nodded and said, "It seems that this is the only way now. I will inform all members of the Collier family."
"Go ahead," Beau replied with a nod.
In reality, his heart was filled with complex emotions. He knew that if he took all the members of the Collier family to leave York and go to Haverhead Hill, it would result in significant losses for the family. Moreover, for a prestigious family like the Collier family, this would be a great disgrace. But apart from this method, he really didn't know what else to do.
"I thought that killing Connor would put an end to everything, but I never expected it to bring even greater troubles to our Collier family," Beau lamented quietly.
Aida, who had been listening, quietly approached Beau and said in a low voice, "Grandfather, if all the members of our Collier family go to Haverhead Hill, who will manage the company?"
"For now, let the outsiders in our company take care of things. I can't think about these matters at the moment..." Beau replied with a sigh.
"But, Grandfather, we don't know when we'll be able to return to York. If we stay in Haverhead Hill for a year or longer, our Collier family's hard-earned business may be ruined..." Aida expressed her concerns.
"Father, what if we leave behind some trusted subordinates to manage the company in our absence?" Albert suggested.
"That might be possible... We will have to consider it," Beau said, his mind filled with worries.
In this dire situation, Beau couldn't help but feel a sense of powerlessness. He knew that taking the entire Collier family into hiding was a difficult decision, but it seemed like the safest course of action in the face of Jorge's potential threat.

chapters.title: Chapter 1863: The Box
chapters.content:
Chapter 1863: The Box
Beau turned to look at Aida, his tone puzzled as he asked, "What do you mean?"
"Grandfather, how about this? You both go to Haverhead Hill, and I'll stay behind," she suggested. She saw this as the perfect opportunity to take control of the entire Collier family business. If both Albert and Beau were away at Haverhead Hill, she would have ample time and opportunity to firmly grasp control of all of Collier family's business ventures.
At that point, Aida would truly have the final say in the Collier family, even if Cielo managed to recover, he wouldn't have the qualifications to compete with her for the position of Collier family head.
"Aida, you actually want to stay behind?" Beau was unaware of her intentions and thought she wanted to stay behind to protect the family's assets.
"All those people in the company are scheming individuals. If we truly hand over the company to them, it won't be long before our Collier family is ruined. So, I'm willing to stay behind. After all, as long as I'm here, they shouldn't dare to overstep their bounds too much," she earnestly stated.
"But aren't you afraid that Jorge will come looking for you?"
"I'm definitely afraid," Aida nodded, then continued, "but I'm just an ordinary person, and this has nothing to do with me. No matter what, he is a martial arts grandmaster. I believe he won't harm me."
Aida knew a lot about Connor, so even if Jorge did come looking for her, she believed she could explain things to him. She felt that staying behind wouldn't pose too great a danger.
"Aida, if you're willing to stay behind, I must thank you sincerely," Beau said, somewhat moved.
"Grandfather, please don't say that. After all, I'm also part of the Collier family. Now that the Collier family is in trouble, I naturally need to contribute," she replied with a smile.
"All right, then. If you have no objections, I'll have your father hold a board meeting when he returns. At that time, I will appoint you as the new chairman of Collier Group, and I will also announce that you will inherit the position of Collier family head in the future."
"Grandfather, isn't it a bit too early to mention the family head position?"
Aida was excited, but she tried to maintain a composed demeanor.
"Your brother is in his current state, so he won't be able to inherit the position in the future. It's most appropriate for you to take on the role. Also, announcing your future position as the head of the Collier family will help stabilize the situation."
"Very well..."
She nodded gently.
"I hope that when I return, the Collier family will still be the same as it is now," Beau sighed softly, as if intentionally saying it for Aida's ears.
"Grandfather, rest assured, I will do my best to safeguard the family's assets."
"You have the capability."
He nodded gently, then continued, "By the way, if you encounter any trouble in business in the future, contact the Xylon family. Regardless of the circumstances, Zakir Xylon still has feelings for you. Don't waste such a good opportunity. If you can really be with him in the future, it will also be a good thing for our Collier family."
"I understand..."
She nodded in resignation.
"All right, if you have nothing else, you can leave now."
He waved his hand towards her.
After parting ways with him, Aida returned to her room alone and took out her phone to call Connor. During this time, she never stopped trying to contact Connor because she couldn't believe he would die so easily. She even suspected that the person who killed Draco might be Connor himself.
However, she knew that Draco's strength was terrifying, so such a scenario was unlikely.
The phone rang for a long time, but he still did not answer.
"Could you really be dead?"
She couldn't help but sigh softly and put down her phone.
For some reason, she always felt that something was amiss about his death.
Meanwhile, in another part of Comtar, in a certain residential area, Connor slowly opened his eyes after a prolonged period of unconsciousness.
Upon waking up, he instinctively observed his surroundings. He realized that he was lying in a bedroom. The bedroom had a warm and cozy atmosphere, with everything, from the bedsheet to the curtains, in shades of pink. It appeared to be a girl's room.
"Soul Returning Fruit!"
Connor quickly reached out to touch his clothes but discovered that the jade box containing the fruit was missing.
His heart raced, and he immediately got up and rushed out of the room.
"Connor, you're awake!" Leah, who was in the kitchen preparing food, saw Connor and exclaimed excitedly.
"The Soul Returning Fruit! Where is it?" Connor asked urgently.
"What is the Soul Returning Fruit?" Leah blinked her eyes, her expression puzzled.
"I'm asking you, where's the Soul Returning Fruit?" Connor's emotions were running high; he couldn't calm down.
She hesitated for a moment, then said, "Connor, you've just woken up. Can you please not be so agitated? Did you lose something? I can help you look for it..."
"The Soul Returning Fruit! It's the jade box I had," he clarified.
"Ah, you mean that box?" she asked.
"Yes, that box."
"Don't worry, I've put that box away for you. It's not lost." She reassured him, then went to the bedroom where Connor had been earlier, retrieved the jade box, and handed it to him.
Connor took the jade box, checked it to confirm that the Soul Returning Fruit was inside, and finally relaxed.
"Thank goodness it didn't get lost. Otherwise, everything I did would have been in vain..."
He sat down on the sofa, and his expression became much more at ease.

chapters.title: Chapter 1864: Accompany You to Porthampton
chapters.content:
Chapter 1864: Accompany You to Porthampton
"This thing, what's its purpose? Is it very important to you?"
Leah poured a glass of water for Connor and asked him softly.
"This thing can save my fiancée's life," Connor replied in a low voice.
"Your fiancée?" Leah's expression appeared somewhat peculiar upon hearing this. She then whispered, "You actually have a fiancée?"
"Yes, my fiancée suffered serious injuries some time ago because of me. I need this Resurrection Fruit to save her," he explained calmly.
"I see." She nodded thoughtfully, then continued, "No wonder you've been so determined. It's all for your fiancée."
"Where are we right now?" He briefly examined the room's surroundings and asked in a low voice.
"This is my home," she promptly replied.
"Your home?" He paused for a moment and furrowed his brow, saying, "What about your family?"
"This is my own place. My family doesn't live here. I'm a photography student at Hogsfeet University, and I bought this house near the campus for convenience," she explained.
"I see." Connor nodded gently, not saying much.
"After you came out of the Felton family's mansion, you immediately fell unconscious, and you also told me not to take you to the hospital. I didn't know where your home was, so I had no choice but to bring you here. I was worried you wouldn't wake up," Leah said, looking at Connor.
"Thank you," he replied sincerely.
"Why are you thanking me? If it weren't for you, I wouldn't have been able to deal with Feng Lin like that. I should be thanking you!" She smiled.
"How long have I been unconscious?" He hesitated for a moment before asking.
"It's been three days," she replied.
"Three days?" His expression revealed some shock upon hearing this, and he quickly got up and headed out of the room.
"Connor, you've just woken up. Where are you going?" She saw that he was about to leave and reached out to stop him.
"My fiancée's life is hanging in the balance. I need to go back urgently," he explained hastily.
"You're in no condition to leave yet. Besides, you have no money on you. How do you plan to get back?" Her expression showed concern as she spoke.
"My clothes and phone, where are they?" he asked, feeling perplexed.
"Your clothes were covered in blood, so I threw them away. I bought you a new set of clothes. As for your phone, I'm not sure. It might have been lost at Crimson Peak or at the Felton family's place," she explained.
He was left speechless upon hearing this. His phone was important to him, as he rarely carried cash and preferred using cards for transactions. For situations like booking plane tickets, he would have someone else do it for him.
"What are you thinking?" She asked as she noticed his silence.
"Um, can you help me book a flight to Porthampton? I have something very important to attend to there," he requested.
"You've done me a big favor, so I can definitely help you book a flight. However, I'm worried about your safety. You've just woken up, and if you're in a rush to get to Porthampton, then let me accompany you," she suggested.
"You don't need to worry about me. My body is perfectly fine now." He reassured her.
"Are you sure your body is really fine? Let me remind you, in case you suddenly faint again, you won't even know if someone takes your jade box," She teased him with a pout.
Connor felt that Leah had a point. He didn't know the current state of his own body.
"Do you have time to accompany me to Porthampton?" he asked after a moment of contemplation.
"I have the time. I'm on vacation now, and I haven't been to Porthampton before. I can treat it as a trip and take some photos," she replied with a beaming smile.
"Alright, then. Thank you for your help." He agreed.
"Why be so polite with me? Don't forget, you're my great benefactor. You can ask me for anything," she said with a smile before retrieving her car keys and leading him to her car.
The car Leah was driving at the moment wasn't the snowmobile Connor had driven out of Crimson Peak. It was a black Lamborghini sports car worth several million, indicating that Leah came from a well-off family.
"What do you think? Is my car cool?" she asked as she opened the car door.
"You come from a wealthy family, don't you?" Connor observed as he got into the car.
"My family is well-off, but I earned the money for this car myself," she replied proudly.
"You earned it yourself?" He was surprised to hear this.
"Yes, I won an award for one of my photos, worth one million. Then, someone bought the copyright for my photo, earning me more than three hundred thousand. So, I bought this car!" she explained.
"I see." He nodded, impressed by Leah's accomplishments.
"You need to earn a lot of money too," she teased as she started the car.
Connor smiled and didn't say anything more.

chapters.title: Chapter 1865: Your Company?
chapters.content:
Chapter 1865: Your Company?
If it was the old Connor, he would have been extremely excited to see such an expensive car.
However, he had come to realize that in this world, his own strength was the most important, not wealth. Only ordinary people considered money to be the most important thing in the world, not realizing that there was something that could surpass it.
"I wonder who that old man really is. Why does he possess such terrifying power with just a remnant soul? If he were to resurrect himself, how powerful would he be?" Connor contemplated.
He now understood that everything that had happened under the cliff wasn't a dream but a reality. A remnant soul that had experienced over a hundred years of existence had not only brought him back to life but had also given him combat abilities comparable to a martial arts grandmaster. Just thinking about it sent shivers down his spine.
"Could that old man be a legendary immortal?" he couldn't help but exclaim in his heart.
Although he didn't know the exact identity of the old man, he had made a decision that once he resolved the current situation, he would help the old man find his lost soul. Regardless of whether the old man was good or bad, he had saved Connor's life, and Connor felt obligated to honor his promise.
"Connor, we've arrived at the airport!" Leah called out to him.
He looked up and realized that they had unknowingly arrived at the airport's underground parking lot.
They got out of the car and entered the airport. Since Leah was a VIP of a certain airline, they quickly found the airline's counter and booked two tickets for a flight to Porthampton that afternoon.
"Connor, are you hungry? We have over two hours before boarding. Let's grab something to eat!" she suggested.
"I'm not hungry. You go ahead and eat," he replied in a low voice.
"Alright then, I won't eat either. Let's just wait here!" She sat beside him, feeling a bit helpless.
Connor closed his eyes and continued to meditate. Although he had woken up, he felt that the chi in his body was still unstable, occasionally surging uncontrollably. So, he decided to use this time to adjust his body.
Two hours later, they boarded the flight to Porthampton.
On the plane, Leah had initially wanted to strike up a conversation with Connor, as she was still very curious about him. However, she noticed that he seemed uninterested in talking to her, so she decided not to disturb him and instead played with her phone.
The whole day passed, and they spent it on the plane.
Throughout the flight, he kept his eyes closed, maintaining the same posture.
At first, she thought he had fallen unconscious again, so she would occasionally speak to him to make sure he was okay and responsive. But later, she realized that he appeared to be fine, so she refrained from bothering him.
The next day, around 10 o'clock in the morning, the plane finally landed.
Connor and Leah left the airport and took a taxi to the hospital where Freya had been admitted.
However, when they arrived at the hospital, he discovered that she had already been discharged.
He inquired with the doctors and learned that she hadn't regained consciousness, but she had been discharged a week ago and taken away by someone.
This news made him nervous because he had no idea what had happened during this time in Porthampton.
"What are you going to do now?" Leah asked quietly.
"I can only go find Thomas..." Connor replied softly and started walking towards the hospital's exit.
Connor wanted to contact Thomas, but his phone was lost, and he couldn't remember Thomas's phone number. So, he decided to take Leah to the headquarters of the Empire World Corporation to find someone.
Half an hour later, Connor and Leah arrived at the Empire World Corporation.
When she saw the Empire Building, her expression appeared somewhat shocked, and she asked in a low voice, "What is this place?"
"This is my company," he replied quietly.
"Your company?"
Upon hearing his remark, her expression froze, and she appeared extremely incredulous.
Connor, however, was not in the mood to pay attention to Leah. He walked straight into the Empire Building.
"Hello, sir. How may I assist you?" the receptionist asked when she noticed Connor.
"Is Mr. Thomas in the company? I'm here to see him," Connor replied in a low voice, heading towards the elevator.
"I'm sorry, sir, but there is no Mr. Thomas at our company. Are you sure you're looking for the right person?" the receptionist hurriedly interjected, blocking Connor's path.
"What do you mean there's no Mr. Thomas?" Connor's expression turned angry, and he gritted his teeth. "Don't you recognize Thomas Morgan, the General Manager of the Empire World Corporation?"
"Thomas Morgan?" The receptionist appeared even more puzzled upon hearing this name. She shook her head and said, "I'm sorry, sir, but our General Manager is Mr. Judkins, not Mr. Thomas. I have no idea who you're referring to as Mr. Thomas."
"You..." Connor looked at the girl in front of him and found himself at a loss for words. He couldn't tell whether he was confused or if she was mistaken.
The General Manager of the Empire World Corporation was not Thomas?
"Are you absolutely certain that your company's General Manager is not Thomas?" Connor couldn't help but shout at the receptionist.
Hearing his outburst, the security team rushed over.
"What's going on? Who dares to cause trouble at the Empire World Corporation?" the head of the security team exclaimed.
Connor turned to the security team leader, who was stunned upon seeing him. Stammering, he said, "Mr. Connor, you... you're not dead? You..."
"Do you recognize me?" Connor asked the security team leader, his brows furrowing.
"I... I met you once..." the security team leader replied hesitantly.

chapters.title: Chapter 1866: The New Boss
chapters.content:
Chapter 1866: The New Boss
After Connor heard this sentence, he confirmed that he wasn't dreaming, and he hadn't come to the wrong place.
This was the Empire World Corporation, but something seemed to have happened to the company recently.
"You come with me..."
Connor waved to the head of security and walked away.
After a moment, he, accompanied by the head of security, reached a quiet spot.
"What's your name?" he asked the security head.
"Mr. Connor, you can call me Dave..."
The head of security nervously replied.
"Is Thomas no longer the CEO of Empire World Corporation?"
Connor asked in a low voice.
"Yes, Mr. Connor, some time ago, the company suddenly received a notice that the CEO had changed. Not only did the CEO change but everyone in our company was replaced. Even the receptionist was changed. Only us security guards were not replaced because, after all, we're here to guard the entrance, and changing us wouldn't make much sense..." Dave replied.
After hearing his words, Connor finally understood why the receptionist didn't recognize Thomas earlier.
"Do you know what exactly happened in the company?" he continued to inquire.
"I'm not sure about that..."
Dave shook his head directly.
"You said I was dead. What's that all about?"
"Well..."
Dave hesitated with an uncertain expression and then said softly, "Mr. Connor, I heard some rumors. It's said that you seemed to have died, and our Empire World Corporation's owner changed. So, Thomas left the company. The new owner wanted to prevent any of Thomas's connections from staying in the company, so they directly dismissed everyone and replaced them with their own people..."
"The new owner?"
Connor's expression appeared strange, and he coldly chuckled, saying, "Is this new owner surnamed Lee?"
"I'm not very sure about that..."
Dave shook his head.
"Do you have Thomas's contact information?"
Connor asked Dave in a low voice.
"Yes..."
Dave nodded and then took out his phone to find Thomas's phone number.
Thomas's phone number was not a secret within the Empire World Corporation; almost everyone had it. Thomas also kept the numbers of all employees, making it easy to reach them in case of emergencies.
After Connor had Leah write down Thomas's phone number, he left the building.
"Connor, what's going on? Why doesn't anyone in your company recognize you?"
After leaving with him, she asked in a puzzled tone.
"It seems someone got the news of my death and took over Empire World Corporation..."
Connor replied casually and then used Leah's phone to dial Thomas's phone number.
"Ring... ring..."
After a long time, Thomas finally answered the phone.
"Hello, may I ask who's calling?"
Thomas's voice sounded.
"Thomas, it's me, Connor!"
Connor said calmly.
On the other end of the phone, Thomas was silent for two seconds after hearing this, and then his voice trembled as he said, "Mr. Connor, you're really not dead?"
"I'm perfectly fine now. Where are you? I'll come to find you!"
Connor asked.
Thomas quickly told Connor his location.
Half an hour later,
Connor and Leah arrived at Thomas's villa.
Upon seeing Connor, Thomas was exceptionally excited. He gave Connor a big hug.
