Connor felt somewhat puzzled by his sudden emotional outburst because he had never seen this side of Thomas before.
"Thomas, that's enough. I told you I'm not dead. What's with all this?" Connor said with a hint of helplessness as Thomas kept holding onto him.
"Mr. Connor, it's just incredible that you're alive," Thomas finally let go of Connor and said with excitement in his voice.
"Where is Freya now?" Connor's primary concern was Freya's whereabouts.
"Mr. Connor, Miss Freya is currently at Diana's residence, protected by Diana and Carlos. She's very safe; you don't need to worry," Thomas said.
"How is her condition?" Connor continued to inquire.
"Miss Freya's condition has remained unchanged, just like when you left," Thomas replied.
"That's good," Connor sighed with relief. At this point, he wasn't expecting Freya to wake up on her own. As long as her condition didn't deteriorate, it was already a positive sign.
"What exactly happened with the company?" Connor asked Thomas.
Thomas, noticing Connor's slightly frustrated expression, began to explain, "A week ago, the nephew of the former chairman, Yannick, suddenly arrived in Porthampton with a group of people. He found me and told me that you had died in Crimson Peak. I initially didn't believe the news, but I tried calling you many times, and you didn't answer. Yannick was very confident that the news was true, so I began to consider the possibility..."
Thomas paused for a moment before continuing, "Originally, the inheritance should have gone to you after the former chairman's passing. However, since you hadn't married Miss Freya, the chairman's properties were technically still under his name. But if you were indeed dead, then Yannick would inherit the assets..."
"So he forcibly took over the inheritance?" Connor furrowed his brow.
"Not exactly," Thomas gently shook his head. "I couldn't be completely sure that you were dead, and there was no evidence of your body. Therefore, I absolutely couldn't allow Yannick to inherit the assets. But I was concerned that he might have ill intentions toward me because if I were to die, there would be no one to stop him from taking control of the former chairman's properties."
"To appease his emotions, I voluntarily handed over control of Empire World Corporation in Porthampton to him. I told him that if I could confirm your death, I would let him inherit all the assets."
"You were stalling for time, weren't you?" Connor chuckled.
"More or less," Thomas smiled. "At that time, I didn't have a clear understanding of what had happened. All I could do was try to buy you some time. Fortunately, you returned just in time. Yannick just recently took over Empire World Corporation, so the situation could be recovered."

chapters.title: Chapter 1867: I Killed Draco!
chapters.content:
Chapter 1867: I Killed Draco!
"How did Yannick know I was dead?"
Connor's expression showed some confusion.
"Mr. Connor, what exactly is going on here? When Yannick said you were already dead, it didn't seem like he was lying to me. He appeared very confident..."
Thomas was no fool, and he couldn't simply believe Yannick's claim that Connor was dead. However, everything that had happened seemed too coincidental. He had lost contact with Connor for a few days, and that's when Yannick showed up. Moreover, Yannick knew that Connor had gone to Crimson Peak.
"I ran into Draco from Comtar inside Crimson Peak. He almost killed me, but I was lucky enough to survive..."
Connor replied casually.
"I see!"
Thomas nodded thoughtfully and continued, "So, how did Yannick come to know that you were in trouble, Mr. Connor?"
"That's what puzzles me..."
He sighed softly and continued, "Draco was searching for the Soul Returning Fruit for the McDonald family, so they must have known I was in danger. If the McDonald family knew, they would have informed Flitch Xylon. So, I guess Yannick must have chosen to ally with Flitch. After all, if he helps Yannick gets Steven's heritance, the biggest enemy of the Silver Merchant in Oprana would disappear."
"Mr. Connor, your reasoning makes sense!"
Thomas quickly nodded.
"Unfortunately, Flitch didn't expect that I didn't die in Crimson Peak..."
Connor couldn't help but sneer.
"So, Mr. Connor, what's your plan now?"
Thomas asked, looking at him.
"This Yannick is just a small player. There's no rush to deal with him. Let him revel for a couple of days. I'll handle him after I sort out Freya's situation."
At this moment, Connor didn't really consider Yannick a significant threat. After all, Yannick was just a puppet in Flitch's hands.
"Alright..."
Thomas nodded in agreement.
"Where is Freya now? Take me to see her."
Connor told Thomas.
"I'll take you there right now."
Thomas agreed and began to walk towards the exit of the villa.
However, when he saw Leah, he couldn't help but pause and softly say, "Why does this beautiful lady look familiar?"
"Hello, I'm Leah Langlie!"
Leah introduced herself promptly.
"I remember now. Miss Leah, you seem familiar to me!"
He chuckled.
"Do you know me?"
She blinked her eyes, her tone puzzled.
"I know your father. He's in the steel business. Back then, I had a chance to visit your Comtar with Mr. Steven. There was a young man in dire straits who wanted to commit suicide, but Mr. Steven saved him and even provided him with money to start a business. That young man should be your father, Ferb Langlie. You bear some resemblance to him, so when I saw you, I felt a sense of familiarity."
Connor was surprised to hear this story from Thomas because he didn't expect that the woman he had met by chance, Leah, had a connection with Steven.
"That's right. My father is indeed in the steel business, and he told me about the person who helped him when he was struggling. However, he never met that person again after that."
Leah's expression also became excited, and she spoke softly, "My father often mentioned that someone had shown great kindness to him during his most difficult time. What a small world!"
"Indeed, it's a small world!"
Thomas chuckled and continued to lead Connor out of the villa.
"Mr. Connor, please follow me."
After leaving Thomas's villa, Connor followed him to Josiah's house.
Diana, Carlos, Waverly, and others had been living in Josiah's house 24/7 to protect Freya. Her ward was off-limits to anyone else to ensure her safety.
When Diana and the others saw Connor again, their expressions were full of excitement. They had also heard the rumors that be had died in Crimson Peak, but they never believed it. In their eyes, he could not have died so easily.
"Mr. Connor, I knew you wouldn't die..."
Diana said with excitement in his voice.
"Yeah. There are rumors outside that you're already dead, but I never believed it..."
Waverly quickly added.
"In Crimson Peak, I did indeed face a life-or-death situation, but I was lucky enough to come back alive..."
Connor replied with a smile.
"Mr. Connor, I heard that Draco from Comtar might have died. Do you know who did it?"
Waverly hesitated for a moment and asked Connor in a low voice.
"I killed Draco..."
Connor said calmly.

chapters.title: Chapter 1868: Divine Weapon
chapters.content:
Chapter 1868: Divine Weapon
Upon hearing Connor's words, Waverly was instantly frozen in place, her expression filled with disbelief.
She stammered, "Mr. Connor, you can't be joking with me, right? You killed Draco?"
"Draco is indeed dead by my hand," Connor replied, looking at her.
"Mr. Connor, Draco was a martial arts grandmaster. How did you manage to kill him?" she asked, her expression shocked.
He hesitated for a moment, then walked up to her and softly said, "Extend your hand."
Waverly's expression showed some hesitation, but she eventually placed her right hand in front of Connor.
He gently grasped her hand and released his internal energy. As she felt the energy radiating from him, she was instantly stunned, her expression becoming even more shocked.
"What... What is happening here?" she stuttered.
"There are some things I can't explain right now, but just remember that the current me is not the same as the old me. Draco is nothing in my eyes," he calmly stated.
She looked at him with a complex expression. She could feel that the energy he had just displayed was far beyond what a martial arts grandmaster could possess, indicating that Connor's martial level might have reached that of a martial arts grandmaster.
If he were indeed a martial arts grandmaster, then he would have the capability to kill Draco. However, what puzzled her was how he had achieved such a significant improvement in just a few months since she had last seen him.
"Is Freya in this room?" Connor asked as he walked up to Carlos.
"Yes, she's in this room," Carlos replied, nodding.
"You've all worked hard during this time," Connor said, patting Carlos's shoulder.
He was genuinely grateful to these people. In such a situation, they were the only ones who could help him, as he couldn't rely on anyone else.
After entering the room, he found Freya lying on the hospital bed, surrounded by various medical devices. The numbers on the devices didn't show much improvement since he had left, indicating that her condition hadn't worsened but also hadn't improved significantly.
"Is she your fiancée?" Leah walked up to Connor and asked softly.
"Yes, she's my fiancée," he replied with a soft nod.
"She's really beautiful," she exclaimed softly after seeing Freya.
Connor smiled at Leah but didn't say anything.
At that moment, Thomas cleared his throat and said, "Well, let's leave them alone for a while. Mr. Connor and Miss Freya can have some time together..."
"Alright." Everyone nodded and left the room.
After a moment of hesitation, Leah also followed the others out.
Thomas could sense that Leah had feelings for Connor, but he knew that Connor's heart was firmly with Freya. So, after leaving the room, Thomas said softly to Leah, "Miss Leah, Connor has many women around him, but Freya is the one he truly wishes to marry."
"Mr. Thomas, I understand your meaning," she replied softly.
"Good, that's good." Thomas smiled faintly and then left.
Leah stood there, sighing softly. Her face bore a hint of disappointment.
...
Connor spent the entire night in Freya's hospital room, recounting everything that had happened to him in Crimson Peak over the past few months.
Unbeknownst to him, by the time he left the room, the sun had risen.
Carlos was still guarding the door, like an unyielding sentinel.
"I've returned, you don't need to guard here every day. Go get some rest," Connor said softly to Carlos.
"Protecting Miss Freya is the task you entrusted to me. No matter when or under what circumstances, I must ensure her safety. Her current situation is due to my negligence. I won't be careless in the future," Carlos said with utmost seriousness.
"The one who attacked Freya was Beau, and even if you were present, there wouldn't have been much you could do," Connor said.
Carlos remained silent.
After a moment of thought, Connor took out the Five Elements Dagger and handed it to Carlos.
"Mr. Connor, what is this?" he asked with some confusion.
"This is the Five Elements Dagger, capable of using the power of the Five Elements. It will greatly enhance your combat abilities. I don't need it anymore, so you can have it," Connor explained.
"Is this a divine weapon?" Carlos asked, astonished.
"Yes, it's a divine weapon." He confirmed with a nod.
"Mr. Connor, isn't this too precious?" Carlos furrowed his brows.
"Why do you talk so much nonsense? Just take it," Connor said, tossing the Five Elements Dagger to him before walking away.
After receiving the Five Elements Dagger, Carlos's expression became incredibly excited. He understood how much a divine weapon could improve a martial artist's strength.
After parting ways with Carlos, Connor went to find Josiah.
"Mr. Connor!" Josiah had seemingly been waiting for Connor. He stood up and greeted him.
"How is Freya's condition now?" Connor asked him in a soft voice.

chapters.title: Chapter 1869: A New Situation
chapters.content:
Chapter 1869: A New Situation
"Based on my observations over the past few days, Miss Freya's condition has remained stable. It's all thanks to those two jade bracelets."
"If it weren't for those two jade bracelets, Miss Freya would probably not have held on until now," Josiah said slowly.
"Freya's life isn't supposed to end!" Connor replied in a low voice. He then took out a jade box and placed it in front of Josiah, saying softly, "Inside here is the Soul Returning Fruit."
Josiah was momentarily stunned but quickly opened the jade box and carefully examined the Soul Returning Fruit. He excitedly said, "Yes, this is indeed the Soul Returning Fruit. The patterns on it match exactly with the records in ancient books. This is great! I didn't expect that you would actually find it."
"I risked my life to obtain this fruit. The rest is up to you," Connor said with a smile.
"Mr. Connor, rest assured. Even if I have to risk my life, I will help you refine the Soul Returning Pill!" Josiah said with a trembling voice.
"Do you have all the preparations ready?" Connor asked him in a hushed tone.
"Everything has been prepared for a long time. I've been waiting for you to bring back the Soul Returning Fruit," Josiah hurriedly replied.
"Very well." Connor nodded gently. He continued, "How long will it take to refine the Soul Returning Fruit, and is there anything I need to do?"
"Refining the Soul Returning Fruit will take fourteen days. During this time, I need to monitor the alchemical process constantly, controlling different temperatures at various times. Since you're not an alchemist, there's nothing for you to do. Let Diana assist me when needed," Josiah explained.
"That long?" Connor's expression showed a hint of frustration.
"Yes, because the Soul Returning Pill is no ordinary elixir, it naturally takes a longer time to refine. However, I believe that given Miss Freya's current condition, she should be able to hold on for over ten days," Josiah said softly.
"Alright, I trust you. Just do your best," Connor said, understanding that rushing the process would be counterproductive.
"I will give my all!" Josiah replied earnestly.
"Good, go ahead and get to work," Connor said, and Josiah left the room.
Once Josiah was gone, Connor let out a long sigh. He had done everything he could for now, and all that remained was to wait for the Soul Returning Pill to be refined.
"Connor..."
At that moment, Thomas approached Connor.
"What is it?" Connor asked softly.
"Miss Leah has just left Porthampton by plane. She mentioned something urgent happening in her family, so she didn't say goodbye to you. She asked me to inform you," he explained.
"She left in such a hurry?" Connor was surprised.
"Yes, it seemed like she was in a hurry when she left. Something must have happened." Thomas nodded.
Connor hesitated for a moment and then asked, "Did you tell her something about me?"
"I only conveyed some words that you would be willing to say. Nothing more," Thomas replied calmly.
Connor sighed and said, "Well, if she wants to leave, then let her go. Getting too close to me won't benefit her. When there's an opportunity in the future, you can offer some assistance to the Langlie family. This time, she has indeed done me a favor."
"You don't need to worry about that, I understand what to do," Thomas replied.
"As long as you understand," Connor said with a slight nod.
"There's one more thing I want to tell you."
"What is it?" he asked.
"There have been new developments on Yannick's side," Thomas said and handed an invitation letter to him.
Connor glanced at the invitation letter and saw that it was for a banquet, with Yannick as the host.
"What does this mean?" Connor asked in a low voice.
"During the recent period, I tried to appease Yannick's emotions while helping you delay some time. I voluntarily transferred the control of Empire World Corporation to Yannick. However, it seems that Yannick is now completely convinced that you are dead. His ambitions go beyond just controlling Empire World Corporation. He has invited all the prominent figures from the four provinces to this banquet. His intention is likely to announce that he will take over control of the four provinces, aiming to replace you as the chairman. He wants to take away your control over the four provinces!" Thomas explained.
Connor couldn't help but smile when he heard this. "It seems that Yannick has quite ambitious plans. He intends to replace me as the chairman."
He understood that the four provinces were even more important to him than any other place. The headquarters of Empire World Corporation was in Davenport, and it was in the four provinces where he had initially established himself. The major families and companies in the four provinces were all under his influence, providing him with substantial annual funds.
These funds were Connor's most critical weapons in dealing with Ferb.
"If I lose the support of the four provinces, it's like cutting off my hands and feet. By then, dealing with Ferb won't be so simple," he said with a hint of frustration.
"Yannick probably doesn't have such grand ambitions. After all, what he truly values is the legacy left behind by Steven, not my influence in the four provinces. I believe there's someone behind the scenes manipulating him!" Connor said.
"You're right, that's what I suspect too," Thomas nodded.
"Thank you for letting me know. I'll think about how to handle this situation," Connor said, looking at the invitation letter.

chapters.title: Chapter 1870: A Trusted Aide
chapters.content:
Chapter 1870: A Trusted Aide
"Then let's wait for a couple of days before I meet with this Yannick," Connor said.
"I'm curious to see who they've sent over this time and what gives Yannick such confidence."
He had a disdainful smile on his face as he spoke with a stoic expression.
"Alright, I understand," Thomas replied and turned to leave.
Although Connor could take action against Yannick now, he believed that the best timing was to confront Yannick openly in front of the prominent figures from the four provinces. He wanted to make it clear to everyone that the four provinces were his bottom line, and no one could encroach upon them.
Two days later, the day of Yannick's banquet arrived.
Yannick's main goal for this banquet was to consolidate control over the various forces in the four provinces and replace Connor's influence. Therefore, the scale of this banquet was quite large, with almost all prominent figures from the four provinces attending.
Connor, Thomas, and their group arrived at the hotel where the banquet was being held.
"Connor, should we go in directly?" Thomas asked quietly.
"Not for now," he replied. "I believe the mastermind behind Yannick won't appear until the banquet officially begins. Let's find a place to wait."
Connor's main objective in attending the banquet was not Yannick, as he considered him a relatively insignificant figure. Instead, he was focused on the person behind Yannick.
He had already figured out that Yannick, despite being the current chairman of Empire World Corporation, was likely just a puppet. The real power in the group was held by others, and even Yannick didn't have much say in important matters.
"Got it." Thomas nodded.
After a while, the three of them entered the hotel.
The manager of the hotel, upon seeing Thomas, was quite surprised by his presence. Although Thomas was no longer the CEO of Empire World Corporation, very few people were aware of this fact. Furthermore, he used to frequent this hotel for meals, and the manager recognized him.
"Mr. Thomas, you're here?" The hotel manager approached him with a friendly smile.
"Do you have any available private rooms?" Thomas asked.
"Mr. Thomas, aren't you here to attend the banquet organized by Empire World Corporation?" The manager seemed puzzled.
"No," he replied curtly.
"In that case, I'm afraid I have to apologize. We've received instructions from above to ensure the safety of the guests attending the banquet, so the hotel is not open to the public right now," the manager explained.
"You're not giving me face?" Thomas raised an eyebrow.
"Mr. Thomas, these are all orders from higher-ups, and I can't make the decision. How about this, please wait for a moment, and I'll call to inquire," the hotel manager said, clearly feeling uncomfortable.
"Why don't you call the owner of this hotel directly!" Thomas asserted dominantly.
He was confident that the owner of this hotel owed his success to Thomas assistance in the past and would grant him this favor.
"Alright, I'll call Mr. Leo, the owner," the manager agreed and reached for his phone.
"There's no need for that!"
But just at that moment, a voice came from the entrance of the hotel. The manager looked up and saw a young man with several bodyguards walking briskly towards Thomas's group. This young man was Morgan Judkins, Yannick's right-hand man, who had taken Thomas's place as the CEO of Empire World Corporation.
Upon seeing this newcomer, Thomas couldn't help but furrow his brow. He then whispered to Connor, "Mr. Connor, this is Morgan Judkins, Yannick's trusted aide. He's the one who replaced me as the CEO of Empire World Corporation."
"You mean to tell me that this young man is now in charge of the vast business empire of Empire World Corporation? Can he handle it?" Connor said with a touch of disdain.
"This Morgan is just a puppet. Empire World Corporation should still have other people in control, and even Yannick doesn't have much authority," Thomas explained.
"I see," Connor nodded without saying more.
Morgan walked up to Thomas's group and seemed unaware of Connor's identity, as he had never met him before.
"I was wondering who it was. Turns out it's Mr. Thomas," Morgan sneered. "Mr. Thomas, aren't you supposed to be retired and enjoying your days at home? Why are you embarrassing yourself here?"
"I don't need to explain myself to you," Thomas replied in a low voice.
"That's right. You don't need to explain anything to me. But if you want to dine at this restaurant, then it does concern me," Morgan provocatively said.
"Morgan, watch your words," Thomas said with an irritated expression.
"Watch my words? Should I be cautious in front of you?" Morgan sneered as he assessed Thomas. "Thomas, do you still think you're the same as you used to be? Now, you're just an ordinary person. What right do you have to talk to me? If you really want to enter this restaurant, here's my proposal. This lady," he leered at Waverly, "seems to be your mistress, right? She has a good figure and a pretty face. How about you let your mistress spend a night with me, and I'll allow you to enter the restaurant. What do you say?"
Morgan's words were not only disrespectful to Thomas but also highly inappropriate and offensive to Waverly.

chapters.title: Chapter 1871: Something Big Is About to Happened
chapters.content:
Chapter 1871: Something Big Is About to Happened
When Waverly heard this, her expression became a little angry.
Meanwhile, Connor felt a bit worried about Morgan's intelligence. He could taunt Thomas if he wanted, after all, Thomas was just an ordinary person. But why provoke Waverly for no reason?
According to her personality, she wouldn't let Morgan go just like that.
"Do you want me to accompany you tonight?" Waverly asked Morgan, her expression emotionless.
"Yeah, beautiful, what benefit can you get from being with that old man Thomas? How about you and I have a good chat tonight? I can make you feel heavenly..." He lewdly addressed her.
Upon hearing his words, she couldn't help but chuckle, then she swiftly moved and appeared right in front of him.
He was startled by her speed, and he was about to speak, but she didn't give him a chance. She backhandedly slapped him across the face.
Waverly was a genuine martial arts expert, while Morgan was just an ordinary person. So when she slapped him, his body flew backward like a ball and crashed hard into the wall.
He instantly fell unconscious.
"Mr. Morgan!" The bodyguards present yelled when they saw Morgan being thrown.
"How dare you hit Mr. Morgan!" A few other bodyguards rushed toward her.
However, these bodyguards were no match for Waverly. In less than half a minute, they were all lying on the ground, groaning in pain.
The hotel manager was also somewhat shocked because he had never seen such a scene before. He couldn't have imagined that this seemingly attractive young woman would be so brutally efficient.
"Mr. Thomas, what should we do?" The hotel manager, looking helpless, asked Thomas.
"Go arrange a private room for us now and then send these people to the hospital. I will take full responsibility for any consequences," Thomas replied directly.
The hotel manager, though reluctant, couldn't defy Thomas's wishes. He quickly arranged a private room for Connor and had Morgan and the others transported to the hospital.
Throughout the ordeal, Connor had remained silent. In the eyes of the hotel manager, he was a minor player and not worth much attention.
Once they entered the private room, they quietly waited.
On the other side, Morgan had regained consciousness before reaching the hospital.
"Mr. Morgan, you're awake?" The hotel manager asked anxiously.
"Where's that woman who just hit me?" he asked with an agitated expression.
"They... they've already left," the hotel manager lied, not wanting to escalate the situation.
Seeing that the hotel manager's expression seemed off, he became furious. He grabbed the manager's collar and stared at him, demanding, "Did those people really leave?"
"N-no, they're in Room 107 right now," the manager admitted, changing his story.
"In the room, huh? I'm going to settle the score with them right now. I've never suffered such a humiliation!" he shouted angrily, then took a step toward the private room where Connor and the others were.
But at that moment, one of his bodyguards blocked Morgan's path and nervously said, "Mr. Morgan, that woman is no ordinary opponent. If we go now, we might get beaten again."
Morgan glared at the bodyguard and, with clenched teeth, said, "Are you telling me that I pay you all this money just to watch me get beaten up every day?"
"Mainly, that woman is really powerful..."
The bodyguard replied helplessly.
After a brief hesitation, Morgan muttered, "I'm going to get a gun. I don't believe she can be stronger than a gun."
The hotel manager was shocked to hear the mention of using a gun. He hadn't expected the situation to escalate to this point.
The bodyguards couldn't stop Morgan, so they had no choice but to follow him. They left the hotel to fetch a gun.
Back in the private room, the hotel manager rushed to inform Thomas.
"Thomas, we have a serious problem..."
"What's wrong?" Thomas asked calmly.
"I heard that Mr. Morgan is planning to bring a gun. I suggest you leave now. I'm genuinely worried that he'll come here looking for you," the hotel manager urgently advised.
"Bring a gun?" Connor chuckled upon hearing this and said, "I didn't expect Morgan to be this audacious, openly resorting to firearms in broad daylight."
"That's right, Morgan is getting too bold, relying on his connection with Yannick," Thomas added.
"Mr. Thomas, do you plan to leave or stay here?" The hotel manager asked, still bewildered by Connor's nonchalant attitude.
"Since Morgan wants to bring a gun to us, let's wait here," Connor said calmly.
The hotel manager couldn't comprehend Connor's identity and why he wasn't afraid, even though he knew Morgan was bringing a gun.
On the other hand, in another part of the banquet hall, some guests were already present, although they were not high-ranking individuals. The truly influential figures were expected to arrive later.
"Mr. Wilcon, you're attending the banquet as well?"
"Of course, how could I miss an event by the Empire World Corporation? I didn't expect this banquet to be so grand, with so many old friends attending."
"I've heard rumors that something big is going to happen at the Empire World Corporation. It could affect our future."
A few middle-aged men discussed the gathering as they sipped their wine.

chapters.title: Chapter 1872: Changes
chapters.content:
Chapter 1872: Changes
"Mr. Colson, have you received any news on your end?" A middle-aged man furrowed his brows and asked.
"No, do you guys really not know, or are you pretending not to know?" Mr. Colson, a middle-aged man, responded with a puzzled tone.
"We genuinely don't know. Why would we ask if we knew?" Another person replied.
"Exactly, Mr. Colson, you usually have the most up-to-date information, and you're from Porthampton. You must have received some news, right?" Others chimed in.
Mr. Colson hesitated for a moment, then spoke in a low voice, "Let me tell you, recently, the Empire World Corporation has undergone a major shakeup. Connor, the young master of the Empire World Corporation and the heir, seems to have died. The Lee family has taken over, and Thomas is no longer the CEO of the Empire World Corporation."
"What?" The group of people reacted with shock. It seemed like they didn't entirely believe Mr. Colson's words.
"I can't just be making this up," Mr. Colson said with a somewhat helpless expression. He continued, "What I'm telling you is the truth. You're not from Porthampton, so you might not be aware. I've also heard that this Lee family has some powerful backing now, which makes their influence terrifying. I think this banquet today is probably about discussing the change of leadership in the Empire World Corporation."
"If Connor is gone, what will happen to us?" Some in the group were concerned.
"Yes, we've relied on Connor..."
These small family businesses and company owners had received significant help from Thomas and Connor. Under Thomas's management, the Empire World Corporation had acquired shares in many companies belonging to these families, bringing them substantial profits.
"Even if Connor is gone, what does it have to do with you guys?" Mr. Colson raised an eyebrow and continued, "As I said earlier, the Empire World Corporation has been assisting us recently, but we've also been paying them a significant amount each year. I don't think our treatment will change even if the Empire World Corporation changes ownership."
The group seemed to relax upon hearing this.
"It's a pity that Connor, such a young talent, has passed away."
"Yes, I wonder how he died."
They seemed genuinely saddened and sighed softly.
"I think we all have some ideas on why he die. These are power struggles among the big shots, and it has nothing to do with us," Mr. Colson responded calmly. He continued, "Based on the information I have, all the major families in Porthampton have chosen to cooperate with Mr. Yannick, so our Four Provinces are about to undergo a significant change."
"Do you know who's behind Mr. Yannick? Can we trust him?" A middle-aged man asked.
"I don't know who's behind him for sure, but I've heard rumors that he's the scion of a prominent family in Yarlford, a family with significant influence," Mr. Colson replied slowly.
"The Zook family from Yarlford!"
At that moment, an elderly man walked up to them and spoke expressionlessly.
"The Zook family?"
The group was stunned.
"That's right, the Zook family!"
The elderly man nodded lightly and continued, "This time, it seems the Zook family is supporting Mr. Yannick, which gives him the confidence to try and replace Connor in our Four Provinces. Otherwise, with his influence alone, I doubt the major families in our Four Provinces would agree. After all, Connor is not someone who can be easily replaced."
"I can't believe it's the Zook family!"
"And the Zook family is one of the four major families in Yarlford!"
"With such a powerful backing, it's no wonder the major families in our Four Provinces are too afraid to speak out!"
The group nodded in agreement.
While significant events were unfolding, these individuals didn't feel particularly uneasy. The outcome of who would be the true leader in the Four Provinces didn't matter much to these small family businesses and company owners. They would align themselves with whoever could offer them the best benefits.
The major families would be the ones most affected by this change. Even though Yannick had the Zook family's support, Connor had considerable influence in the Four Provinces. Despite the news of Connor's possible demise spreading, some still held out hope for his return.
Yannick had organized this banquet to persuade those who were uncertain.
"Let's not talk anymore; it seems that Yannick is here..." A middle-aged man whispered, drawing everyone's attention.
They turned to the entrance of the hall, where Yannick was making his way inside with a group of people.
"Even the Zook, Jacob, Wess, and Sherman families are siding with Yannick?"
Seeing the prominent families behind Yannick, the group was once again shocked. These families had achieved their current status with the help and guidance of Thomas and Connor.
But now, these influential figures were all standing with Yannick, indicating that Connor's possible demise was a reality.
The change in the Four Provinces was a confirmed fact.
"Who's that young man next to Yannick?"
"Yeah, how come we've never seen him before?"
It was only at this moment that the group noticed the young man accompanying Yannick. The young man had a handsome face, wore a custom-made Armani suit, had a well-proportioned body, and exuded an extraordinary aura. Standing among the crowd, he seemed to stand out.

chapters.title: Chapter 1873: Old Friend
chapters.content:
Chapter 1873: Old Friend
What the crowd noticed was that when facing this young man, Yannick's expression became noticeably tense, and his steps seemed to falter slightly. This detail suggested that among the people present, the young man held the highest status, not Yannick.
"Could this young man be from the Zook family in Yarlford?"
"It seems so..."
The crowd whispered their speculations.
Not far away, a strikingly beautiful woman in an elegant gown was also observing Yannick and his group. She had a beautiful face, a sexy figure, and her ample bosom and long, fair legs were accentuated by a pair of ten-centimeter-high heels, making her look incredibly alluring. This woman was none other than Wilvera Flora.
Wilvera had originally been in charge of the Silver Corporation in Porthampton but had chosen to cooperate with Connor. With the help of Thomas, her family's influence had grown significantly, and the Wilvera family had become one of the top-ranking major families in Porthampton.
Upon seeing Yannick and the others, Wilvera's expression seemed somewhat unusual, and she secretly thought, "Could it be that Mr. Connor has truly perished on Crimson Peak?"
In the face of the major events in the Four Provinces, she had maintained a neutral stance. She hadn't chosen to align with Yannick like the other major families nor oppose him. She had been observing the situation closely, ready to make a decision if Connor's demise was confirmed.
At the same time, another group of people was also keeping a close watch on Yannick. These people were likely the most familiar with Connor. They were Sabrina, Sadie, Sheldon, Harold, Jovan and Henny had all gathered.
Initially, Harold thought that he might never be able to compete with Connor in his lifetime. Connor possessed a business empire worth trillions and was a direct disciple of Thomas, a grand martial arts master. Witnessing Connor's battle against Jorge and Faris in Honduria had left him in awe, making him give up any thoughts of challenging Connor. He believed that he could never be Connor's equal.
However, life had its twists and turns. Connor had suddenly widened the gap between them, and there was no way for Harold to catch up.
Unfortunately, he had fallen like a shooting star.
As for Sabrina and Sadie, they found it difficult to accept Connor's death. Sabrina's trust in him ran deep, and Sadie couldn't explain her inability to accept this fact. She had always believed that extraordinary things could happen around him.
As more guests arrived, the banquet was about to begin. Yannick took the stage with the extraordinary young man and addressed the crowd, "Please quiet down for a moment, everyone..."
The guests turned their attention to Yannick.
"I understand that most of you attending this banquet today don't know me, so let me introduce myself briefly. I'm Yannick, the nephew of the former chairman of Empire World Corperation, Steven."
Yannick paused, then continued, "My uncle left a will before he passed away, appointing Connor as the sole beneficiary of his estate. Unfortunately, Connor's life took an unfortunate turn, and he passed away before inheriting the estate. Therefore, from a legal perspective, I am now my uncle's only heir..."
"Mr. Yannick, does this mean you've already inherited the estate?" A middle-aged man asked.
"I haven't inherited the estate yet, but my legal team has initiated the necessary procedures. It won't be long before I can legitimately claim the inheritance, and Empire World Corperation will become my property," Yannick said with a grin.
After hearing his words, the crowd began to murmur among themselves, as there were still many doubts in their minds. The most significant issue was Connor's death.
Yannick had declared Connor's death without providing any concrete evidence. Despite their doubts, these small family business owners and company executives dared not oppose Yannick directly.
"You're talking nonsense! Connor hasn't died!"
Suddenly, Sabrina shouted at him.
Yannick glanced at her with an expressionless face and replied, "Miss Sabrina, I understand that Connor's death has been a significant blow to you, but this is the reality. Someone witnessed Connor falling from a cliff thousands of meters high. Do you really think someone could survive such a fall?"
"But the police haven't found his body!" she retorted.
"The location where Connor supposedly died is Crimson Peak, and you should be aware of how treacherous the terrain there is. The police didn't need to search for Connor's body. If he doesn't return within half a month, the police will officially consider him deceased," he replied, suppressing his inner anger.
Sabrina trembled with anger but hesitated for a moment before choosing not to say anything further.
Yannick, seeing Sabrina's silence, appeared somewhat satisfied. He then continued, "Now, let me introduce the young master by my side..."
The crowd's attention turned to the young man beside Yannick.
"This is Mr. Saul Zook of the Zook family in Yarlford..."
Yannick introduced with a smile.

chapters.title: Chapter 1874: Mr. Saul Zook
chapters.content:
Chapter 1874: Mr. Saul Zook
Upon hearing this, the crowd once again displayed shocked expressions.
"This person is actually the heir of the Zook family!"
"Yes, I didn't expect Mr. Saul of Yarlford to be here..."
"I heard that he was studying abroad. Why did he suddenly return?"
"The Lee family is already formidable, and now a member of the Zook family has come. It seems that something significant is about to happen in Porthampton..."
"I wonder what brings Mr. Saul here!"
The people in attendance began to engage in hushed discussions, and their expressions towards Saul were filled with suspicion.
Although most of these people were from the Four Provinces, they had heard about the Zook family to some extent. In their eyes, the Zook family and themselves were not on the same level, so they regarded Saul with a certain level of apprehension.
"You may not know me, but that's alright. I will be staying in Porthampton for a while, and we can gradually get to know each other," Saul suddenly spoke up, addressing the crowd.
"Mr. Saul, your family's businesses are primarily in Yarlford. What brings you to Porthampton?" someone asked.
"That's an excellent question," Saul smiled faintly and continued, "From my understanding, about 80% of you here rely on Empire World Corporation. Over the years, Empire World Corporation has provided you with substantial assistance, and, of course, you have contributed significant funds in return. Both parties have been in a cooperative relationship. However, now that Mr. Yannick has taken over the company, the Zook family intends to cooperate with Mr. Yannick..."
"How do you plan to cooperate?" the crowd inquired.
"The Zook family and Empire World Corporation intend to merge all your companies and enterprises into a large alliance. This will make management more convenient, and once all these companies unite, our influence will grow, not only in Oprana but also internationally," Saul said with a smile.
Suddenly, everyone present was left stunned. They had not expected the Zook family and Yannick to have such grand ambitions.
Initially, when Connor was in charge, these people had a different arrangement. They held 50% of their companies' shares while Empire World Corporation held the other half. Connor did not interfere with their companies' management. Essentially, they only had to give 50% of their profits to Empire World Corporation each year, but their companies remained under their control.
In simpler terms, they were the owners of their companies, and everything was decided by them. Empire World Corporation, in return, provided them with significant support. With this support, many of these companies saw their annual profits increase several times over, even after giving away half their earnings.
However, Saul's words indicated a completely different approach. If they agreed to his demands, it would mean surrendering their companies without receiving a single penny in return. They would effectively become employees under Saul's and Yannick's control.
The two forms of cooperation may sound similar, but in practice, they were worlds apart.
"I never expected the Zook family to have such grand ambitions!" Wilvera couldn't help but sigh softly.
"Mr. Saul, are you suggesting that all our companies will be merged to form a new conglomerate?" an expressionless old man asked.
"That's right. That's what I mean." Saul did not deny it and nodded.
"In that case, we don't know what benefits there will be for us," someone else commented.
"Yes, if we all merge, will our companies still be under our control?" another person inquired.
"And how will the company's shares be distributed?"
The crowd bombarded him with questions.
"I understand that you all have concerns. If you agree to merge, then all the shares of your companies will belong to me and Mr. Yannick. Of course, you can continue to operate your companies, but the profit distribution will be based on your annual production output..."
Saul smiled as he explained.
The entire audience remained stunned and shocked by his audacious proposal. If they agreed to this, it would mean that they were giving away their companies without receiving any compensation. In the end, they would have to work under Saul's and Yannick's control.
Only a few were willing to accept this offer, and the majority couldn't fathom surrendering their hard-earned companies in such a manner. They had just realized how crucial Connor had been to them.
If Connor were still around, they wouldn't be in such a predicament, as he had allowed them to maintain ownership and control over their companies. However, now that Connor was gone, they were facing the threat of being consumed by Empire World Corporation.
Saul's confidence stemmed from their heavy dependence on Empire World Corporation. If they refused this offer, they would likely be crushed by Empire World Corporation in less than half a month.
"Does everyone understand my proposal?" Saul asked again, unperturbed by the reactions of the crowd.
"We understand, but I believe no one here will agree to your proposal!" a middle-aged man exclaimed.
"Ah, hahaha..."
In response to this remark, Saul didn't get angry; instead, he burst into laughter. Then, he said calmly, "I see you might not quite understand. I only wish to unite everyone; whether you agree or not, it's your choice!"
"This is not even worth considering. I don't think anyone will accept your proposal," another middle-aged man added.
"I think Mr. Saul's proposal isn't bad. I'm willing to form an alliance with Empire World Corporation," a senior suddenly spoke up.

chapters.title: Chapter 1875: Resisting Strength
chapters.content:
Chapter 1875: Resisting Strength
After hearing the unexpected support from several prominent figures, the crowd turned their heads in surprise. It turned out that the person speaking was Sebastian Wheeler, the head of the Wei family in Porthampton.
The Wei family was one of the most influential clans in Porthampton, so Sebastian's support carried significant weight.
"Mr. Sebastian, what do you mean by this?" The others were puzzled by Sebastian's expression.
"It's nothing. I just think that Mr. Saul's words make sense, and merging is the way forward. I advise everyone not to struggle further," Sebastian said expressionlessly.
"Yes, I agree," another leader from a different prominent family chimed in.
"I also agree..."
In no time, representatives from seven or eight major families chose to stand on Saul's side. It was evident that they had been persuaded or bought off by him in advance.
"I didn't expect these major families to willingly accept the merger. If it goes through, their losses might even be greater than ours!"
"Yes, are these people out of their minds?"
"I think they might have had no other choice. After all, with the Zook family and Empire World Corporation joining forces, there's hardly anyone in the Four Provinces who can oppose them!"
"If only Mr. Connor were still alive, we wouldn't have ended up like this..."
The expressions on their faces were filled with frustration and helplessness, and they continued to whisper among themselves.
"I understand that this situation has come suddenly, and you might need some time to think it over. I'll give you that time. An hour from now, I hope you can give me a clear answer, either agree or disagree. Once today is over, there won't be any opportunity for regrets," Saul told them.
The crowd looked at him with a sense of despair, unsure of how to proceed.
"What are your plans, Miss Wilvera?" At this moment, a middle-aged man approached Wilvera and asked softly.
"At this point, merging seems to be the prevailing trend. Several major families in Davenport have already chosen to merge, and the rest are just smaller companies. If these small companies can unite, they might be able to resist for a while. However, if they lack unity, they'll likely face the same fate," she replied, taking a sip of her wine, her eyes flashing with a hint of resignation.
Although she was unwilling to see her company being merged like this, she didn't know how to resist these powerful individuals. Empire World Corporation alone was already formidable, and now there was the backing of the Zook family in Yang City.
"Saul's tactics are too ruthless. He's left us with no way out!" Another person commented.
"It's not that Saul's tactics are ruthless; it's that Connor was too soft on us. If Connor had wanted to use Empire World Corporation to acquire and merge your companies, you would have had no way out long ago..." she remarked.
"That might be true. Without Mr. Connor's help over the years, many of us wouldn't have survived until now..."
The middle-aged man nodded in agreement.
"But don't be too pessimistic. There might still be a chance..." she said.
"A chance?" The crowd looked bewildered upon hearing her words, their expressions filled with confusion.
"What do you mean, Miss Wilvera?" the middle-aged man asked.
"You shouldn't forget that, while some people are willing to merge with Empire World Corporation, others don't want to see it happen. Their loyalty to Connor is beyond what we can imagine. If those people show up today, we might still have a glimmer of hope..." Wilvera said with an impassive expression.
"Miss Wilvera, what exactly are you saying?" The crowd remained puzzled, their expressions reflecting their lack of understanding.
"You'll find out when the time comes..." she replied.
On the other side, after finishing his speech, Saul returned to the private room with Yannick. Yannick was still visibly excited and said with a grin, "Mr. Saul, you're amazing! I didn't expect you could convince Sebastian and the others. Now that these major families have declared their support, I believe the remaining small company owners will also choose to merge with us..."
"It's quite easy to deal with these major families in Porthampton," Saul replied casually.
"From now on, the Four Provinces will be ours!" Yannick grinned.
"Don't oversimplify things. Truly gaining control over the entire Four Provinces won't be so easy," Saul warned.
"Control the Four Provinces? What do you mean, Mr. Saul?" Yannick looked even more puzzled. "I'm having trouble understanding your words..."
"Your're too naive," Saul said with a hint of helplessness. "Haven't you noticed that some people didn't show up today?"
Yannick paused, then whispered, "You mean the figures from the underworld in the Four Provinces?"
"Exactly, those people." Saul nodded.
"They're just gangsters. What can they do if they don't show up?" Yannick shrugged casually.
"They're not just gangsters. They control resources far greater than those major families. If they refuse to merge with us, we'll only be able to secure half of the Four Provinces. The other half will remain under their control. If they unite, they could pose a formidable challenge to us. It could become troublesome," Saul sighed.
"Mr. Saul, do you have any suitable methods to deal with these people?" Yannick asked.

chapters.title: Chapter 1876: You Want to Kill Me?
chapters.content:
Chapter 1876: You Want to Kill Me?
"Deal with these people?"
Saul sneered, then said lightly, "If they are sensible, that would be the best. If they are not, we'll have to get rid of them. Although I don't want to kill, once these people stay, they will become a menace."
Yannick blinked as he looked at Saul, his expression appearing somewhat fearful.
Because he knew very well that if Saul could say such words, he would definitely act on them.
Yannick had known Saul for a short time, but he had some understanding of Saul's bloody methods.
"After we get rid of these people, things will become much simpler. The Four Provinces will be firmly under my control..."
Saul said expressionlessly.
"Yes, yes..."
Yannick nodded hastily and continued, "Mr. Saul, once this is done, my task will be complete. Please don't forget what you promised me!"
"Don't worry; I won't withhold a single penny of the money I promised you. After all, you've done me a great favor..."
Saul replied softly.
"That's good, that's good..."
Yannick smiled.
...
On the other side, Connor and Waverly sat in the private room, enjoying a lavish meal. Meanwhile, after briefly understanding the situation at the banquet, Thomas also returned to the private room.
"What's the situation at the banquet now?" Connor asked quietly as he saw Thomas return.
"Mr. Connor, the people behind Yannick have shown up," Thomas hurriedly replied.
"Are they from the Gomez family?" Connor asked as he put down his fork.
"No, they are from the Zook family in Yarlford," Thomas answered.
"The Zook family?" Connor was surprised by this revelation. "I didn't expect Yamino to be so cautious, knowing that I'm supposedly dead, and still bringing the Zook family to devour Porthampton..."
"Perhaps that's the frightening aspect of Yamino. He's always extremely cautious and never exposes his weaknesses," Thomas said calmly.
"What's the Zook family's purpose in coming here?" Connor inquired further.
"This time, the Zook family not only plans to replace you in the Four Provinces but also intends to let Yannick control the Empire World Corporation. Then, they will use the influence of Empire World Corporation to swallow up all the major families and companies in the Four Provinces. The Zook family's goal is to control the Four Provinces single-handedly," Thomas explained.
"The Zook family's ambitions are surprisingly grand. It's beyond my expectations," Connor sighed softly.
"Yes, they don't care about the feelings of those families at all. They are using Empire World Corporation to exert pressure. After all, if these families leave the Empire World Corporation's support, they'll have no way out. Moreover, they spread the news of your supposed death, making them believe there's no hope left. So, several major families in Porthampton have already agreed to be absorbed," Thomas continued.
"The Zook family's move is indeed ruthless. They plan to dismantle my foundations in the Four Provinces. Even if I survive, I won't have the qualifications to compete with the Gomez family," Connor said softly.
"Mr. Connor, what should we do now? Should we continue to wait?" Thomas hesitated for a moment and then asked quietly.
"No rush. I haven't finished my meal yet. After I finish eating, I'll deal with these people..." Connor replied calmly.
Thomas was very anxious, but seeing Connor's demeanor, he didn't dare to say more. He could only sit beside Connor and watch him eat.
"Bang!"
At that moment, the door of the private room was suddenly kicked open from the outside. It was Morgan, the man Connor's group had encountered at the hotel entrance. He barged in with a handgun in hand and stared at Waverly, shouting, "It was you, the woman who slapped me, right?"
Connor, who had been silent throughout, gave Morgan a helpless look and then whispered to Waverly, "You caused this trouble; you deal with it."
"Alright..."
Waverly, as if reluctantly, put down her fork, stepped forward, and confronted him, saying disdainfully, "What do you want? Planning to shoot me?"
"You better apologize to me now, or I'll shoot you!" He glared at her and shouted.
"Kill me?"
She coldly chuckled at his words and then said casually, "Do you think you're capable of that?"
"You...!"
He was about to say something when she reached out and grabbed his wrist, then exerted force.
"Ah..."
He let out a painful scream, his face contorted in agony.
"Just you want to kill me?" she said with disdain, then lifted her leg and kicked him in the stomach.
He was sent flying out of the private room by her kick.
He struggled to get up after landing on the ground, then glared at Waverly and shouted, "You bitch, just wait; I won't let you off the hook today..."
After being beaten by Waverly twice in a row, he was trembling with anger. He then ran towards the banquet hall.
...
Once inside the banquet hall, Morgan searched everywhere for Yannick but couldn't find him. So, he burst into the private room.
"Mr. Yannick, I was beaten up by a woman brought by Thomas..." Morgan shouted as he entered the room.
"Beaten up by a woman?"
Upon hearing this, Yannick was momentarily stunned, his brows furrowing. He asked, "Did Thomas come to the banquet too?"
"Thomas didn't attend the banquet; he brought people to have a meal here. I had a conflict with him, and he let the woman with him beat me up. That woman is incredibly skilled; my bodyguards couldn't match her at all..." Morgan hastily explained.
"Is Thomas deliberately causing trouble?" Yannick's expression turned angry, then he turned to Saul and said, "Mr. Saul, please excuse me for a moment..."
"In just an hour, your scheduled time will be up soon. There's no need to rush. Let my bodyguards check out the situation first," Saul reached out to stop Yannick.
"Alright..."
Yannick nodded gently.

chapters.title: Chapter 1877: Some Changes
chapters.content:
Chapter 1877: Some Changes
Saul turned to look at the young man behind him, then said expressionlessly, "Kai, you go and see what's going on. If there's trouble, just break their legs and throw them out for me."
"Got it."
The young man, who appeared to be a bodyguard, responded and then walked over to Morgan.
"Where is the troublemaker? Show me."
Morgan glanced at Kai and furrowed his brow. He said, "Mr. Yannick, Mr. Saul, that woman is extremely skilled. Can he handle her alone?"
"Kai is a martial arts expert. Dealing with one martial artist shouldn't be a problem," Saul replied calmly.
"That's good to hear. I want to see if that woman still dares to be arrogant with me now," Morgan said with a smirk, then raised his voice and shouted, "We've got a situation here!"
"Kai, deal with the woman who slapped Yannick. You need to explain this to us," he said to Kai in a low voice.
"What kind of explanation do you want?" Looking Kai up and down, Waverly, who sensed Kai was a formidable opponent, wore a cautious expression.
"I want to break your leg and throw you out of here," he replied casually.
"You don't have to break this woman's leg. If she's willing to spend a night with me, I might consider letting her go," Morgan said softly.
"Up to you," Kai replied emotionlessly, then moved swiftly towards Waverly.
He was fast, and in almost no time, he reached her. He raised his leg and kicked her in the stomach.
She staggered back a couple of steps before stabilizing herself, her eyes showing a hint of pain. Clearly, she hadn't expected him to act so quickly.
She took a deep breath and prepared to retaliate.
"Waverly, you're no match for him. Let me handle this," but just at that moment, Connor suddenly reached out and stopped Waverly.
"Alright." She stopped in her tracks after hearing Connor's words, standing quietly in place.
Connor then calmly stood up and addressed Kai, "A man who bullies a woman, what kind of martial artist is that? Your opponent is me."
Kai hesitated for a moment, and then suddenly lifted his leg, sending a table flying towards Connor.
The table flew towards Connor, but he easily evaded it. In a flash, he closed the distance between him and Kai.
Kai seemed shocked by Connor's speed, his expression showing surprise. However, in the next moment, Connor unleashes a powerful punch.
"Bang!"
Kai's body was sent flying, crashing into the wall with a loud thud.
On the sidelines, Waverly stared at Connor with wide, watery eyes, her expression filled with disbelief. While she knew that he had improved his skills, she hadn't expected him to become this formidable.
He had reached a level where he could defeat a martial arts expert like Kai with a single punch.
"Connor's strength has become terrifying," she whispered to herself.
On the other side, Morgan was in shock after witnessing Connor's single punch that incapacitated Kai. He had initially thought Connor was the least remarkable of the three, but now he realized that Connor was the most terrifying of them all.
"Someone's been killed! There's a murder!" Morgan suddenly screamed, then ran out of the room as if he had gone mad.
Back in the private room, Connor's expression appeared somewhat helpless. He waved his hand lightly, and a chopstick pierced through Morgan's neck, causing blood to spray out.
Thomas stood there, stunned, and watched Connor in disbelief. He had known Connor's character the longest and was well aware of what had caused Connor's personality transformation.
"Dispose of the bodies," Connor said calmly, turning to Thomas.
"I understand."
He hastily agreed and took out his phone to make a call.
Connor sat quietly in his place, seemingly disinterested in attending the banquet.
"Mr. Connor, aren't you planning to attend the banquet?" Waverly hesitated for a moment and asked Connor in a low voice.
"I'll wait a bit," he replied calmly.
...
Inside the banquet hall, Saul and Yannick had no knowledge of what had transpired with Morgan. When they entered the hall, the expressions on the faces of the attendees became exceedingly complex.
They were aware that the time frame Saul had given them to make a decision had come to an end. The people in the hall had divided into two camps, one side reluctantly accepted the terms of the merger, while the other vehemently refused to relinquish their interests under any circumstances.
There was also a small group of individuals who remained indecisive, and uncertain about which choice to make.
For those who had agreed to his conditions among the attendees, the situation in the Four Provinces became significantly clearer. The remaining dissenting parties were rendered powerless, as they couldn't contend with his faction. In the end, they would be pushed to their demise by the power of the Empire World Corporation.

chapters.title: Chapter 1878: Kyle Hayes's Arrival
chapters.content:
Chapter 1878: Kyle Hayes's Arrival
"Unexpectedly, Connor's arrival has caused such a significant change," murmured Wilvera, looking at the people in the hall.
Originally, during the period when Connor was absent from Davenport, many believed that his influence in the Four Provinces had diminished. However, they now realized just how crucial he was to these people in the Four Provinces.
"I wonder what's your plans to deal with this now?" At that moment, a middle-aged man approached her and asked softly.
"How do I plan to deal with this?" She paused upon hearing the question and then spoke softly, "What I'm considering right now isn't very important. Unless those people appear, Saul's takeover of our companies is already a fait accompli. I can't change anything by myself."
"I didn't expect things to turn out like this in the end," the middle-aged man sighed, seeming to have accepted this reality.
Just then, Saul walked onto the stage and smiled as he asked the crowd below, "So, how have you all decided?"
The attendees turned their attention to Saul, their expressions notably troubled.
"I've given you all quite some time to consider," he continued. "I believe you should have made your decisions by now. If you agree to cooperate with me, step forward and tell me. If you don't, you can leave now."
Clearly, he was issuing his final ultimatum, as he had no intention of wasting more time. Regardless of whether these people ultimately agreed or disagreed with cooperation, he had the means to acquire their companies.
"Could you at least let us return and think it over properly?" one person pleaded with him.
"What is there to think about in such a trivial matter?" he sneered.
"This may be a small matter to you, but it's a matter of life and death for us!" the crowd lamented.
"Yes, if we agree to your conditions, it's as if we're working for you!"
"Exactly, if you want to cooperate with us, you must provide conditions that satisfy us!"
"Even Mr. Connor didn't behave as arrogantly as you!"
"Mr. Connor?" Yannick couldn't help but sneer upon hearing this and then said expressionlessly, "Why are you guys are still mentioning that useless Connor? Don't you know that Connor is already dead? In the Four Provinces now, it's me and Saul who call the shots."
"Since when did our Davenport become subject to your authority?" But at that moment, a voice rang out in the hall.
Upon hearing this voice, everyone turned to look toward the entrance, curious to see who had the audacity to openly challenge Yannick and Saul.
A few seconds later, the crowd naturally made way for someone.
Kyle walked out expressionlessly.
When Wilvera saw him, her expression showed signs of excitement. The person she had been waiting for had finally arrived.
Connor had two trusted lieutenants by his side: Thomas from the business world and Kyle from the underworld.
While Thomas had lost control over thecompany, Kyle had never made an appearance. She believed that if he could unite all the underworld forces in the Four Provinces, there might still be a chance to counter Saul's power. After all, the influence of the underworld could not be underestimated in the Four Provinces.
"I thought someone important had arrived. It turns out to be Mr. Kyle," Yannick sneered upon seeing Kyle, then asked dismissively, "Mr. Kyle, what do you mean by this?"
"In Davenport, it has always been Mr. Connor who called the shots. Without his orders, no one can replace him," Kyle said emotionlessly.
"Kyle, Connor has long been dead. Don't you know that?" Yannick widened his eyes and retorted.
"Without Mr. Connor's orders, no one can replace Mr. Connor. Otherwise, even if I, Kyle, must die, I will still make sure you all pay the price!" Kyle calmly responded.
"Mr. Kyle, do you really think your meager strength can stand against everyone in the Four Provinces?" Yannick laughed scornfully.
"With your limited strength, why don't you consider including me?" Another voice chimed in.
The crowd turned to look, and then froze in place.
"It' Jonathan Steel! I never expected that Mr. Jonathan would also come," someone exclaimed.
"Yes, Mr. Jonathan is here too."
The attendees began whispering among themselves.

chapters.title: Chapter 1879: You Won't Know Until You Try
chapters.content:
Chapter 1879: You Won't Know Until You Try
"Jonathan, what do you mean by this?" Yannick glared at Jonathan and shouted.
"In San Diego, we only acknowledge Mr. Connor. No one else can take his place. If Mr. Connor isn't around, I, Jonathan, won't listen to anyone else," he said calmly.
"You're completely delusional..." Yannick said in disbelief.
"Whether I'm delusional or not is my own business. I don't need you to worry about it," Jonathan replied disdainfully.
"You..." Yannick was about to say something more, but Saul stopped him with a gesture.
Saul looked at Jonathan and Kyle with a faint smile and said softly, "Do you want to cooperate with us or not? It's your choice. We won't force you. Is there anyone else who refuses to cooperate? You can leave now."
"Mr. Connor once did me a favor, so count me in," Yakov Chakin stepped forward.
"Me too," Jaxon, accompanied by Jaxon, walked to Kyle's side.
Seeing this, the crowd was stunned. Kyle from Davenport, Jonathan from San Diego, Yakov from San Francisco, and Jaxon from San Antonio—the four of them were the top figures in the underworld of the Four Provinces. Their status and influence were formidable, and no one had expected that all four would stand together.
Wilvera had finally gotten the opportunity she had been waiting for and walked to Kyle's side, saying softly, "Mr. Connor's fate is still unknown. I believe some people are too eager to replace him. If we hand our companies over to such individuals, who knows what might happen next."
"That's right, I firmly refuse to cooperate with such people."
"Yes..."
Perhaps because they had influential figures like Kyle backing them up, those who had originally been against the takeover stood up, their expressions filled with determination.
Even some of those who had previously agreed to cooperate changed their minds and returned to Kyle's side.
Wilvera's guess had been correct. The reason no one had dared to openly oppose Saul and Yannick earlier was because they lacked leadership and didn't know who to rely on. But now that they had found allies, they had the courage to resist Saul.
Yannick, seeing so many people changing their minds, looked nervous. He turned to Saul and asked, "Mr. Saul, what do we do now?"
Saul looked at the crowd, smiled faintly, and sighed, "I gave you a chance, but you didn't appreciate it."
"What do you mean?" Kyle furrowed his brow and asked.
"I originally intended to have a discussion with you and make you willingly accept the takeover. That way, at least I could leave you with a way out. But I didn't expect you to be so ungrateful. So now, I'll use some special methods to make you surrender your companies," Saul said.
At this point, he had revealed his true intentions. He had no intention of continuing to negotiate with these people. He wanted to resolve the matter as quickly as possible, and the most straightforward way was to use force to intimidate them.
The crowd realized that he had planned everything. By gathering everyone here, he had made it easier to deal with them.
"Saul, are you out of your mind? If all of us die at your hands today, even with the Zook family backing you, you won't escape the consequences. You'll have nowhere to hide," Wilvera shouted, realizing the gravity of the situation.
"At this point, you should think about yourselves first. You don't need to worry about me," Saul sneered.
All the people fell silent, unsure of what to do.
Kyle took a deep breath and said emotionlessly, "I will never hand over my company to you. If you dare to kill me today, then go ahead!"
Saul looked at him with a faint smile and said softly, "Mr. Kyle, you really have some nerve. Since you're so eager to die, I'll fulfill your wish."
With those words, Saul turned his gaze to a young man standing beside him and said softly, "Truman, Kai is out handling other matters. This one is up to you."
"Alright..." Truman nodded slightly in response and then began walking toward Kyle.
Saul seemed unconcerned as if he had already anticipated this situation. He didn't need to kill all the people in the hall; he just had to eliminate Kyle, and the rest would fall in line.
In simpler terms, he was using Kyle as an example to intimidate the others.
As Truman approached Kyle, a young man stood in front of him, blocking his path, and said in a low voice, "If you want to kill Mr. Kyle, you'll have to get through me first."
Kyle seemed to predict that he would be in danger today, so he brought a martial artist bodyguard with him.
Truman glanced at the bodyguard and said disdainfully, "You're no match for me. Get out of the way."
"Whether I'm a match for you or not, you'll have to find out for yourself!" The bodyguard replied in a low voice and then charged toward Truman.
As Truman saw the bodyguard charging toward him, he reached out and casually removed his suit jacket, revealing his extraordinarily muscular physique.

chapters.title: Chapter 1880: Mr. Connor Is Back!
chapters.content:
Chapter 1880: Mr. Connor Is Back!
"Bang!"
Right at this moment, Truman stomped his foot fiercely, directly stomping out two deep pits on the ground.
When everyone saw this scene, their expressions seemed to be even more shocked.
This was because they could not imagine that a person's strength could be so terrifying.
With just a stomp, he could directly crush the marble floor and leave a deep pit the size of a footprint on the cement floor.
Even Kyle's bodyguard was surprised to see this.
In the next second, the bodyguard rushed in front of Truman.
The bodyguard raised his fist and smashed it towards his head. However, he did not dodge at all and took the bodyguard's punch head-on.
What the bodyguard did not expect was that after his fist landed on Truman's head, he did not seem to have any reaction at all. His body did not even move.
"What…"
The bodyguard did not know how to describe his feelings.
However, in the next second, Truman punched the bodyguard's stomach.
The bodyguard was instantly sent flying and smashed into the crowd.
After the bodyguard fell to the ground, his expression was very painful. He struggled to stand up, but unfortunately, he did not have the strength at all.
Kyle's expression was very ugly when he saw his bodyguard being punched by Truman.
"Mr. Kyle, have you changed your mind?"
Saul shouted at Kyle.
"Even if you kill me today, I will never change my mind!"
Kyle shouted.
"Alright then, I'll kill you today!"
Saul said lightly.
Truman immediately walked towards Kyle's seat after hearing Saul's words.
Kyle stood there expressionlessly. His expression was very calm, as if he did not take Saul's threat seriously.
Saul also squinted at Kyle. He couldn't understand where Kyle got his courage from. Even in the face of such a threat, he was still so calm.
"Go to hell!"
At this moment, Truman shouted at Kyle and raised his fist to smash Kyle's head.
Kyle didn't even blink from the beginning to the end.
"Bang!"
There was a loud bang.
Even Wilvera, who was standing beside Kyle, couldn't help but close her eyes. She couldn't bear to see what was going to happen next.
However, when she opened her eyes again, she was stunned.
Because a hand was blocking in front of Kyle, and at this time, that hand happened to hold Truman's fist tightly.
Wilvera slowly shifted her gaze and finally set her eyes on the owner of the hand.
"Con.. Connor?"
For a moment, her eyes widened as she covered her mouth and exclaimed.
She never expected Connor to appear in front of Kyle at this critical moment.
Wilvera wasn't the only one who was shocked. Almost everyone present was stunned on the spot.
No one had expected that Connor, who Yannick said was dead, would appear in front of them again.
Sabrina and the others thought that everything was over. However, Connor's appearance changed the course of events.
"Yes, Mr. Connor is still alive…"
"Great, Mr. Connor is back!"
Everyone present began to shout. For a moment, these people were as excited as if they had seen a god.
Yannick was staring at Connor's position with his eyes wide open. He didn't know how to describe his feelings. He stuttered, "Impossible, how can Connor still be alive?"
"This person is Connor?"
Saul hurriedly asked Yannick.
"That's right, this person is Connor. Shouldn't he have already died in Crimson Peak? He... Why is he still alive? What's going on?"
Yannick stuttered.
At this time, Saul also began to become excited. After all, he had long received the news that Connor had died in the Crimson Peak. However, Connor had actually appeared in front of him at this time. he could not understand what was going on.
More importantly, if Connor was still alive, all his plans would be in vain.
He stood rooted to the ground, not knowing how to describe his feelings.
On the other side, Kyle was also excited when he saw Connor. He exclaimed to Connor, "Mr. Connor, you're actually not dead. That's great…"
"Don't be so impulsive next time. If I hadn't come in time, you might have died in this person's hands!"
Although Connor was touched by his loyalty, he also felt that his actions were too radical.
"I just want to protect your things, Mr. Connor!"
Kyle said expressionlessly.
"I know!"
Connor nodded at Kyle.
Jaxon and the others looked at Connor's position and were naturally very excited. After all, as long as he returned, the rest of the matter would be much simpler.
"Who are you?"
Truman could feel that Connor's strength was extremely terrifying. He widened his eyes and asked Connor.
"Kneel down and talk to me!"
Connor indifferently replied to Truman.
"Kneel down?"
The expression on Truman's face was somewhat puzzled.
However, in the next second, Connor directly released the aura in his body.
After all, Connor was a true ancient martial arts grandmaster, and Truman was only a mystic class.
When Truman felt Connor aura pressing down on him like a huge mountain, his knees involuntarily bent, and then he knelt on the ground with a bang.
His knee directly smashed a huge pit on the ground.
When everyone present saw this scene, there was nothing on their faces other than shock.
Who would have thought that the arrogant Truman would actually kneel in front of Connor?
"What did you do to me?"
Truman shouted at him with his eyes wide open.
At this moment, he felt as if there was a heavy object weighing a thousand pounds on his shoulder. No matter how hard he tried, he could not stand up.
"You want to kill my men?"
Connor looked at Truman and smiled disdainfully. Then, he turned his hand and slapped him.
Truman's body spun in the air like a rubber ball before crashing heavily onto the ground.
After he landed on the ground, he spat out a mouthful of blood and died.

chapters.title: Chapter 1881: Settling the Score
chapters.content:
Chapter 1881: Settling the Score
No one had expected that Connor would directly finish off Truman with a single move.
At this moment, the strength that Connor displayed already could not be described as terrifying.
They felt that this was too unbelievable.
"Truman is actually dead?"
On the stage, Saul's eyes were also wide open, and the expression on his face was abnormally shocked.
According to the information he had, Connor was only an ancient martial arts expert with a realm similar to Truman's. However, when Connor killed Truman just now, he did not use any strength at all. Truman did not have any ability to resist when faced with him.
"Who is this Connor?" Saul could not help but think.
Yannick was also dumbfounded; after all, Connor was just an ordinary person when Yannick saw him last time. If it wasn't for the help of Thomas Morgan and the others, Connor wouldn't be his opponent.
However, only two years had passed, yet Yannick felt that Connor was no longer the same as before. Although his appearance hadn't changed, his temperament had changed greatly.
"As expected of Mr. McDonald!"
"Yeah, with Mr. McDonald around, I want to see who dares to be arrogant in our Davenport!"
"Mr. McDonald is finally back…"
Everyone who had originally chosen to stand on Saul's side almost all ran to Connor's side at once.
After all, the reason why they agreed to Saul's requests before was only because they had no other choice. Now that Connor was back, they were not willing to let Saul snatch their company away.
The people from the big families who were standing on Saul's side also walked to Connor's side.
"Mr. McDonald, you're finally back. Saul is really too much. He used my family's life as a threat. My Wheeler family really didn't want to betray you!"
Sebastian Wheeler even knelt in front of Connor and shouted at Connor with an unusually excited expression.
Connor looked at him indifferently and then said softly, "Mr. Wheeler, you don't have to do this. I know what kind of person you are!"
"Thank you, Mr. McDonald, thank you, Mr. McDonald…"
After Sebastian heard Connor's words, he was extremely excited and tears flowed down his face.
The other families also knelt in front of Connor and begged for his forgiveness.
Connor knew in his heart that these people might not be really loyal to him, but they were definitely unwilling to cooperate with people like Saul.
Because if they cooperated with Saul, it would be equivalent to giving their company to the Zook family for nothing.
If the Zook family did not use some special methods, no one would agree to this condition at all.
At this moment, the situation had undergone a shocking reversal. There was no one standing behind Saul and Yannick.
Saul stared at Connor. He could not understand why Connor had such great influence. Without saying a word, all these people ran to his side.
"Could it be that these people trust Connor so much? I haven't lost yet!" Saul gritted his teeth and said in a low voice.
"Mr. Zook, you should think of something now. Truman is already dead. How are the two of us going to walk out of this hall today?" Yannick said anxiously.
"Kai is still around even if Truman is dead. Kai will be back soon…"
Saul said in a low voice.
"I just received news that Morgan Judkins and Kai have already died at Connor's hands…" Yannick hurriedly said.
"What did you say?"
Saul was stunned when he heard this. He stared at Yannick with wide eyes, his face full of shock.
Saul had only brought two experts, Kai and Truman, with him to Porthampton this time. When he saw Truman die, he had placed all his hopes on Kai.
However, he never expected that even Kai would die at Connor's hands.
At this moment, Saul had lost his last trump card, and only Yannick was left. He didn't know what to do.
After Connor comforted the people of the few large families, he walked straight towards Saul.
Some debts were finally settled!
Yannick felt that something was wrong and quickly hid behind Saul.
When Saul saw Connor walking over, he couldn't help but suck in a breath of cold air. Then, he took a step forward and muttered to Connor, "You must be Mr. Connor McDonald, right?"
