"That's right!" Connor nodded lightly, then continued to ask, "You're the one who wants to replace my position in the four provinces? You're the one who tried so hard to annex these companies?"
Saul had long lost his previous arrogance when facing Connor. He said in a very nervous tone, "I just wanted to cooperate with these people…"
"You don't want to cooperate with us! You clearly want to annex us!"
"That's right, you just want to annex us. It's not cooperation at all!"
"Mr. McDonald, you must help us!" everyone shouted excitedly.
Connor waved his hand at the crowd.
Everyone instantly fell silent.
Connor sized up Saul from head to toe, then said in a disdainful tone, "You want to replace my position in the four provinces with just you? Your Zook family is really laughable. I originally thought that Watson Zook would come personally. I didn't expect him to be a coward and have you come instead…"
Saul finally couldn't take it anymore and shouted at Connor with his eyes wide open.
"Mr. McDonald, our Zook family has no enmity with you. You just killed my family member and now you're insulting my family's head. What do you mean? Could it be that you intend to become an enemy of us?"
Connor sneered. "Haven't I always been an enemy of your Zook family?"
Yannick, who was hiding behind Saul, shouted, "Connor, let me tell you. Don't be too arrogant. Don't think that we are easy to provoke. If you really provoke us, you won't have a good ending…"
After hearing Yannick's words, Connor smiled faintly and said in a low voice, "If you didn't say anything, I would have forgotten about you. You're quite bold to snatch the Empire World Corporation from me and chase Thomas out. Do you know what will happen to you if you do this?"
Yannick was stunned for a moment and asked with a puzzled tone, "What?"

chapters.title: Chapter 1882: Master
chapters.content:
Chapter 1882: Master
"Die, of course!"
Connor replied expressionlessly.
"Connor, you dare to kill me? Do you know that I..."
Yannick was about to speak, but Connor didn't give him the chance to continue. He waved his right hand lightly.
A stream of Chi flew towards Yannick.
It was like a bullet that pierced through Yannick's forehead. Yannick stared at Connor with wide eyes.
He never would have thought that Connor actually really dared to make a move to kill him!
"Clang!"
Yannick's body fell in front of Saul.
"You…"
Saul was stunned when he saw Yannick's death.
"What about you?"
Connor asked Saul softly.
"Yannick is Steven Lee's nephew. How dare you kill him? Are you crazy?"
Saul said with his eyes wide open.
"So what if he's Steven Lee's nephew? This person has provoked me more than once or twice. Anyone who provokes me will only die!"
Connor had killed Yannick just to avoid future troubles. Otherwise, he felt that the Lee Family would never give up on Steven Lee's inheritance. If the Lee family knew that Connor had killed Yannick, they would never dare to fight with him for the inheritance.
Harold and the others looked at Connor, and their expressions seemed to be very shocked.
They could feel that the Connor they saw at this moment might not be the Connor they once knew.
Previously, Kyle and the others were also constantly provoking Connor, but they were fine.
If they still kept provoking Connor, they would probably end up like Yannick.
Saul hesitated for a moment, then gritted his teeth and muttered, "Mr. McDonald, I originally thought that you had already died in Crimson Peak, so I came to Porthampton. Since you are not dead, then I apologize to you for today's matter. I hope that you can give face to my father and not lower yourself to my level!"
"On account of your father?"
Connor couldn't help but sneer when he heard Saul's words. Then, he said indifferently, "Who does your father think he is? Why should I give him face?"
"You…"
Saul did not expect Connor to be so arrogant as to not even think highly of Watson.
"Mr. McDonald, don't think that my Zook family is really afraid of you. If you dare to kill me today, we will definitely not let you off!"
Saul gritted his teeth.
"After I'm done with you, I'll naturally go and deal with the other members of the Zook family. Since you have the guts to come to Porthampton, you should be prepared to die here!" Connor said softly.
".."
Saul hesitated for two seconds. Then, he gritted his teeth and asked in a low voice, "Connor, what can I do to make you let me go?"
"No matter what, I will not let you off today…"
Connor replied indifferently and then raised his right hand.
"Stop!"
But at this moment, a voice called out.
After hearing this, Connor slowly turned around and took a look.
A middle-aged man holding a sword slowly walked over.
When Saul saw the middle-aged man, his expression became a little excited. He quickly ran to the middle-aged man's side and said excitedly, "Master, you're finally here. This person wants to kill me!"
The middle-aged man looked at Saul indifferently and said in a low voice, "Saul, leave the rest to me!"
"Alright, alright…"
After hearing this, Saul also felt relieved and hurriedly nodded.
"Mr. McDonald, I am Saul's master, Stellan Scott. What Saul did today was indeed inappropriate. I hope that Mr. McDonald can forgive me if I have offended you in any way!"
Stellan said politely.
"Are you here to save him?"
Connor asked softly.
"That's right. I'm here under the orders of the Zook family's head. As long as Mr. McDonald can let Mr. Zook off today, I can discuss any conditions you propose with the Zook family's head…"
Stellan said.
"You're going to discuss it with the Zook family head?"
Connor couldn't help but laugh when he heard this. Then, he asked softly, "Then if I want the entire Zook family, do you think this matter can be discussed?"
"Mr. McDonald, do you mean that you don't plan to let her go?"
Stellan asked coldly.
Connor did not show the slightest fear when facing Stellan who had suddenly appeared.
He could feel that Stellan was only a Black-rank. He was still a step away from breaking through to Grandmaster.
However, Connor could even fight against a grandmaster now-how could he be afraid of a mere Black-rank?
"From the moment this person stepped into Porthampton, he should have already prepared himself for the inevitability of not being able to leave…" Connor said.
"Mr. McDonald sure has big words. Don't think that the Zook family is so easy to bully!"
Stellan seemed to be planning to use the Zook family to threaten Connor.
"I will settle this score with the Zook family sooner or later. Today, I will use this kid to teach them a lesson…"
Connor replied expressionlessly.
After hesitating for two seconds, Stellan said in a low voice, "The purpose of my coming here this time around is to protect Mr. Zook. If you insist on killing him, then you will have to go through me first…"
"Do you think you're a match for me?"
Connor asked Stellan softly.
"We'll only know after we try!"
At this time, Stellan did not know Connor's true level at all. He felt that Connor was at most twenty years old, so no matter how powerful he was, it was impossible for him to be more powerful than a martial artist who had cultivated his skill for half his life.
Sometimes, a martial artist's strength was accumulated by accumulating cultivation over time.
"He doesn't know the immensity of heaven and earth!"
Connor could not help but sigh softly.
Stellan hesitated for two seconds. Then, he pulled out the long sword on his back.
The moment the sword was unsheathed, a cold light flashed, causing everyone present to feel a chill in their hearts.
Everyone knew that Stellan was going to fight Connor, so they took the initiative to make way for them.
Connor stood on the stage and looked at Stellan with narrowed eyes. He sighed softly, "You are only one step away from becoming an ancient martial arts grandmaster. At your age, your future is limitless, yet you want to ruin your future because of this person."
"I owe the Zook family a favor. No matter what, I have to protect Mr. Zook's safety today!"
Stellan said to Connor expressionlessly.

chapters.title: Chapter 1883: Protective Crystal
chapters.content:
Chapter 1883: Protective Crystal
After Connor heard Stellan's words, he couldn't help but laugh and not say anything else.
"Take this!"
Stellan shouted, then he held his long sword and headed straight for him.
At this moment, Stellan was like a bolt of lightning. His sword had also turned into a ray of light, as if it could cut through everything in the world.
When everyone saw this scene, they were all shocked in their hearts.
If the person Stellan wanted to deal with at this moment was them, then they probably wouldn't even be able to react to what was going on and would have already died at his hands.
Moreover, there was also a group of people who were very worried about Connor at this time. This was because they knew in their hearts that if Connor lost to Stellan, they would definitely fall into Saul's hands again. At that time, there might be no one who could save them.
"I wonder if Mr. McDonald can defeat this Stellan!"
"It should be possible…"
Everyone could not help but discuss worriedly.
"Clang!"
However, at this moment, Connor gently stretched out his hand, using his fingers to clamp Stellan's sword.
After seeing this scene, Stellan was stunned. How could he have expected Connor's strength to be so terrifying that he easily blocked a full-powered attack with just two fingers?
Waverly, who was not far away, stared at Connor with her beautiful eyes. This was already the second time Connor had shocked her.
Other than ancient martial arts grandmasters, no other practitioner could block Stellan's sword.
However, in front of Connor, it was like a child's punch. It had no power at all.
"I told you, you are no match for me now!"
Connor muttered.
"This... How is this possible?"
Stellan looked at Connor in front of him and widened his eyes. The expression on his face was very unbelievable, as if he could not believe this fact at all.
"Bang!"
In the next second, Connor's fingers gently exerted force and broke Stellan's sword.
When Stellan saw that his sword was broken, he fell into despair.
Only now did he know how terrifying Connor's strength was. It was impossible for him to be a match at all.
After Connor easily broke the sword, he raised his leg and kicked Stellan's stomach.
Stellan was instantly sent flying and smashed into the crowd.
Immediately after, Connor thrust out his right hand lightly.
The long sword that had been broken into two flew towards Stellan.
When Stellan saw this, his expression was a little strange. He quickly reached out and crushed the crystal on his neck.
The moment the crystal broke, a golden light enveloped Stellan's body.
Connor's expression turned to interest after seeing this scene. In the next second, the broken sword had already flown in front of Stellan, but it was blocked by the light around his body. There was no way to get close to Stellan now.
"What was that crystal you crushed just now?" Connor asked in a low voice.
"That's my Scott family's protective crystal!"
Stellan replied indifferently.
After hesitating for a moment, Connor rushed in front of Stellan and punched the golden light.
However, the golden light was abnormally strong and blocked most of the strength of Connor's punch.
At this moment, Connor could feel that Stellan's crystal pendant was very similar to the one that Jorge had given him and the one that Connor had bought from Monica. It was just that the functions were slightly different.
Immediately after, Connor continued to punch at the light
In the beginning, the light could barely hold on. However, after Connor threw out his eighth punch, the light exploded.
When Stellan saw that the light around his body had completely dissipated, the expression on his face turned desperate. He did not expect Connor's strength to be so terrifying that even his protective crystal could not withstand Connor's attack.
Connor's fist landed directly on Stellan's chest. Stellan spat out a mouthful of blood and collapsed.
"Master!"
When Saul saw Stellan fall, he roared out.
"I didn't expect that I would really lose to you. How can you have such terrifying strength at such a young age?"
Stellan lay on the ground and looked at Connor. The expression on his face was of disbelief because he could not understand why Connor's strength was so strong.
"This is not something you should be concerned about right now!"
Connor muttered back.
After Stellan heard Connor's words, he could not help but laugh bitterly. Then, he said indifferently, "That's right. This is indeed not a question that a dying person like me should be concerned about. Since I have already lost to you, you can kill me or cut me up. I can be considered to have completed my mission…"
Connor glanced at Stellan and muttered to Kyle, "Take these two away. I still have some use for their lives!"
"Understood!"
Kyle quickly agreed, then asked his men to tie up Saul and Stellan and bring them out of the banquet hall.
At this moment, Saul was still very shocked because he did not expect Connor to spare his life.
However, Saul was not a fool. He knew very well in his heart that even if Connor did not kill him now, it was absolutely impossible for him to let him off unscathed.
After Kyle's men took Saul and Stellan away, Connor walked onto the stage and looked at the crowd expressionlessly.
At this moment, everyone was also staring at him. In their eyes, he was really like a savior who had appeared in front of them.
Sheldon and the others were also extremely shocked. After all, they thought that Connor had only relied on Thomas, Jorge, and the others to reach the position of Davenport's Mr. McDonald. They all felt that Connor himself did not have any strength at all and was just a little luckier than them.
But now, Connor had used his actions to tell them that Connor no longer needed to rely on anyone. On the contrary, these rich people in the four provinces all had to rely on Connor because without his protection, these people could only be trampled on.

chapters.title: Chapter 1884: Savior
chapters.content:
Chapter 1884: Savior
"I'm afraid that I will never be able to catch up to Connor in this lifetime…" Harold thought.
"Connor is currently standing at the top of the four provinces. No one can shake his position. Even if you and I work hard for our entire lives, it's impossible for us to reach his current position!" Sheldon said in a low voice.
The expression on Harold's face was a little unwilling, and then it gave way to helplessness.
"Today's matter has shocked everyone…"
Connor looked at everyone with a faint smile and then continued, "But now, the problem has been solved. As long as I, Connor McDonald, am still alive, our four provinces will remain the same. Nobody will change the order of the four provinces. Nobody can replace my position in the four provinces. Your interests will never be affected for as long as I live!"
"Mr. McDonald is mighty!"
"We will follow Mr. McDonald for the rest of our lives!"
Everyone shouted excitedly.
Thomas looked at Connor on the stage with a look of relief, because he knew that Connor had grown up unknowingly.
The current Connor was no longer the Connor who had to rely on him and Kyle to solve any problems.
On the contrary, he and Kyle could no longer do what Connor could do now.
Moreover, after this incident, these people in the four provinces would probably be more united. No matter what, these people would become Connor's strongest asset.
Connor left with Thomas and the others after exchanging a few simple greetings with everyone.
The banquet was finally over.
Originally, Saul and Yannick planned to take advantage of the relationship between Yannick and the Empire World Corporation to take over the four provinces during Connor's absence. However, their plan had completely failed.
After Connor left the banquet, he went straight to the place where Stellan and Saul were imprisoned.
At this time, Stellan was already seriously injured, so it was not difficult to imprison him. Even an ordinary person could easily subdue him.
Connor entered the room where Stellan was locked up. He was tied up with a rope and looked very embarrassed.
"Why don't you just kill me?"
Stellan asked.
"I originally planned to kill you, but when I saw you use that crystal pendant, I changed my mind. I have something to ask you now!"
Connor replied indifferently.
When Stellan heard his words, he could not help but be stunned for a moment. Then, he gritted his teeth and said, "No matter what you ask me, I won't tell you!"
"If you answer my question, I might let you and Saul off!" Connor said lightly.
Stellan was stunned for a moment after hearing Connor's words. Then, he asked in a low voice, "Is that true?"
"Of course…"
".."
Stellan hesitated for two seconds before asking in a low voice, "What do you want to ask me?"
"What's with that crystal pendant of yours?"
Connor had just discovered that Stellan could form a very powerful protective shield after crushing the crystal pendant. This seemed to be similar to the power that erupted from the dragon pendant when Connor was facing Saif Song at the most dangerous moment. Therefore, Connor wanted to see if he could ask Stellan about the crystal pendant.
"My crystal pendant?"
Stellan could not help but be stunned after hearing Connor's words.
"That's right, the crystal pendant that you crushed in the hall!"
"I don't know what's going on with that crystal pendant either. It was given to me by my father. He told me that it could save my life in times of danger. However, I'm not too sure what that pendant is either…" Stellan said.
After hearing this, Connor's expression was somewhat helpless. Then, he asked in a low voice, "Where is your father now?"
"What are you planning?"
Stellan asked warily.
"I just want to ask about the crystal pendant. You don't have to be so nervous!"
"My father is in the Zook family. If you have the guts, go and ask him!" Stellan said coldly.
"Haha…"
Connor smiled faintly and didn't say anything. He turned around and walked out of the room.
After leaving the room, Connor called Kyle over and told him to look after these two people no matter what. If Connor planned to deal with the Zook family, these two people would play a very important role in his plans.
…
Meanwhile, the news that Saul was captured by Connor spread to the Zook family in almost half a day.
Watson was extremely shocked when he heard the news. He didn't expect Connor to still be alive. What was even more unexpected was that Stellan was actually not a match for Connor at all, and now Stellan and Saul were both under his control.
"Didn't this Connor already die in Crimson Peaks? Why is he still alive? What's going on?" Watson shouted excitedly after putting down his phone.
At this moment, a young man walked up to Watson and asked in a low voice, "Dad, what happened with my brother?"
Watson had two sons. One was Saul, and the other was the young man beside Watson, Wilford Zook.
"Your brother is currently in Connor's hands, and it's unknown whether he's dead or alive. Stellan has also been captured by Connor!" Watson replied in a low voice.
"Wasn't Connor already dead?"
Wilford's expression was a little shocked when he heard this.
Watson was very frustrated. He gritted his teeth and replied in a low voice, "I don't know what's going on either!"
"Father, did the Gomez family trick us?" Wilford asked after a moment of hesitation.
"What good can Yamino Gomez get by playing with me now?"
Watson asked with a frown.
When Wilford heard this, he couldn't help but be stunned for a moment, but didn't say anything.
"What are you waiting for? Hurry up and think of a way to save your brother!" Watson shouted with his eyes wide open.
After Wilford heard this, the expression on his face was a little helpless, and then he said softly, "Since you have already said that Stellan is not Connor's opponent, then what can we do? Unless Stellan's father makes a move, the others won't be a match for Connor at all!"

chapters.title: Chapter 1885: Let Me Retrieve The Pill!
chapters.content:
Chapter 1885: Let Me Retrieve The Pill!
"Your grandfather doesn't know that Saul went to Porthampton, but if he finds out about this, it'll be troublesome!"
Watson muttered.
"Since we can't let my grandfather know, then we can only seek help from the Gomez family. After all, this information was provided by them," Wilford continued.
"Yamino Gomez has already left the country. I don't know when he'll be back. Even if I ask him now, he won't be able to solve any problems…" Watson said with a broken expression.
"Oh…"
Wilford was instantly speechless after hearing this sentence. At this time, he could not think of any way to save Saul from Connor's hands.
"A single misstep has caused a thousand years of regret. I should not have let Saul go to Porthampton back then. I was too greedy…"
Watson could not help but sigh softly.
Wilford hesitated for a moment before asking softly, "Father, what do you plan to do now?"
"Hm…"
Watson couldn't help but take a deep breath when he heard this. Then, he said in a low voice, "Since Connor did not kill your brother directly, it means that he does not have the intention to kill Leo Canter. We can only wait patiently for Yamino Gomez to return before thinking of a way to save your brother…"
"That's the only way…"
Wilford naturally couldn't think of any other way, so he nodded helplessly.
Although the power of the Zook family was in Watson's hands, the most important trump card of the Zook family was the expert beside Hudson Zook. At this time, Watson was not qualified to use this trump card at all.
In addition, the relationship between Watson and Hudson was still very subtle. Hudson himself did not agree to Saul going to Porthampton. All of this had been secretly manipulated by Watson. He naturally did not have the courage to tell Hudson the actual situation.
Once Hudson found out that something had happened to Saul in Porthampton, Watson's position as the family head might be lost. Therefore, even if Watson was worried about Saul's safety, he could not do anything. He could only wait for Yamino Gomez to return and find a solution.
…
Connor originally thought that he could get some information about the crystal pendant from Stellan, but what he did not expect was that Stellan actually did not know what was going on.
However, Connor chose not to kill Stellan and Saul because he knew that these two people could play a very important role in his next fight against the Zook family.
After separating from Kyle and the others, he returned to Josiah's house.
Josiah and Diana were refining the Soul Returning Pill while Connor went to Freya's ward to accompany her.
In the blink of an eye, more than ten days had passed.
In these ten days, Connor spent most of his time in Freya's ward while Thomas and Kyle were stabilizing the situation in the four provinces.
Now that the Empire World Corporation was under Thomas's control again, the family companies in the four provinces had also started new collaborations with the corporation.
With Thomas and Kyle around, Connor didn't need to worry about the four provinces. Now, he was most worried about whether Josiah could successfully refine the Soul Returning Pill.
"Mr. McDonald, Mr. McDonald!"
Diana rushed into Freya's room and shouted excitedly at Connor.
Connor stood up after seeing Diana and asked, "What's wrong? Did you refine the Soul Returning Pill?"
"Yes, it's done now…"
Diana hurriedly said.
"That's great. Quickly bring me to take a look…"
Connor did not expect Josiah to actually refine the Soul Returning Pill so smoothly.
After that, Diana brought Connor into the pill refining room.
At this moment, Josiah was staring excitedly at the alchemy furnace in front of him.
Connor stepped forward. "Mr. Murphy, where is the Soul Returning Pill?"
"Mr. McDonald, don't be anxious. The Soul Returning Pill is still in the pill furnace and can't be taken out for the time being!"
Josiah muttered back.
Connor couldn't help but be stunned when he heard this. Then, he frowned and asked, "Since the Soul Returning Pill has already been refined, why can't we take it out?"
"If you want to take out the Soul Returning Pill, you still need one last step!" Josiah said in a low voice.
"Mr. Murphy, don't keep me in suspense. What else do you need to do? Or what can I do now? Just tell me!"
Connor shouted anxiously.
The expression on Josiah's face was a little strange, and then he said helplessly, "Mr. McDonald, the Soul Returning Pill is a divine-grade pill. This kind of pill itself is not allowed to appear under normal circumstances. Therefore, if you want to take the Soul Returning Pill out of this pill furnace, you may suffer the wrath of heaven. In the words of the ancient book, you need a Pill Tribulation!"
"Pill Tribulation?"
Connor's expression was a little puzzled when he heard this.
"That's right, a Pill Tribulation!" Josiah nodded gently and continued, "If one wishes to take out the 'Soul Returning Pill' from the pill refining furnace, the person who takes the pill will have to experience a pain that is a hundred times greater than the pain that these medicinal ingredients endure during the refining process. Therefore, it is impossible for an ordinary person to take out the 'Soul Returning Pill'…"
"You mean to say that you need to experience some pain before you can take out the pill, right?"
Connor asked Josiah.
"Mr. McDonald, you can understand it that way. However, the pain I experienced when extracting the pill was not ordinary. This old man is just an ordinary person, so this kind of pain might not be something I can withstand!"
Josiah paused for a moment, then continued, "Moreover, I only have one chance to retrieve the pill. If I fail, the Soul Returning Pill will shatter, so I don't dare to try so rashly!"
"Then let me retrieve the pill!"
Connor replied without thinking.
"Mr. McDonald, you have to think carefully. The pain of taking the pill is really not something that ordinary people can withstand, and on top of that, you only have one chance to retrieve it. I think it is safer to wait until Master Yarrell returns before retrieving the pill. After all, he refined the Essence Cultivating Pill for you back then. He should be able to withstand this pain!" Josiah hurriedly advised.
"Do you also need to experience this kind of pain when refining the Essence Cultivating Pill?" Connor asked.
Josiah nodded lightly. "Of course. The Essence Cultivating Pill and the Soul Returning Pill are both divine-grade medicinal pills. Naturally, one needs to experience a Pill Tribulation when retrieving them!"

chapters.title: Chapter 1886: Terrifying Temperatures
chapters.content:
Chapter 1886: Terrifying Temperatures
"I didn't expect that the old man had to suffer so much in order to refine the Essence Cultivating Pill for me. Looks like I misunderstood him back then…"
Connor sighed softly and then said to Josiah, "Since my master was able to endure such pain back then, I should be able to endure it too. Moreover, I don't know when my master will return. I can't wait that long."
"Mr. McDonald, you only have one chance," Josiah said cautiously.
"I've already thought it through. For Freya, I'm willing to endure any pain!" Connor said expressionlessly.
Seeing that Connor seemed to have made up his mind, Josiah could only nod and say, "Since you've already said so, I won't persuade you anymore. However, Mr. McDonald, you must remember that if you feel that you can't take it anymore, you must choose to give up immediately. Many people have lost their lives because they couldn't take the torture of the Pill Tribulation…"
"I understand…"
Connor lightly nodded.
"Diana, open the furnace!"
Josiah turned his head and shouted.
The expression on Diana's face was a little strange when she heard this. She frowned and asked, "Mr. McDonald, have you really thought it through? Once the pill furnace is opened, there will be no room for regret!"
"I've already thought it through!"
Connor replied expressionlessly.
Although Freya's condition had not changed at all, Connor was not sure how long the two crystal pendants would be able to maintain her current state. Once the power in the crystal pendants was exhausted, even if he took out the Soul Returning Pill, it would be useless.
Therefore, Connor was not willing to waste another second.
Diana hesitated for a moment before opening the lid of the pill furnace.
When the lid was opened, Connor saw a red medicinal pill in the pill furnace.
At this moment, this medicinal pill emitted waves of gentle light that felt full of vitality.
"Can I just reach out and take this Soul Returning Pill?"
Connor asked Josiah.
"That's right, just take it out!"
Josiah nodded.
Connor took a deep breath, and his expression grew nervous. After all, this would affect Freya's life and death.
In order to save Freya, Connor had almost died. He was just one step away from this, so no matter what, he would not allow himself to make any mistakes.
His right hand slowly reached into the pill furnace.
At the beginning, Connor did not feel any pain. It was as if his hand was close to a brazier. He could clearly feel the heat emitted by the Soul Returning Pill, but it was not torture for him at all.
Therefore, Connor's mood relaxed a lot. He felt that perhaps it was because he was an ancient martial arts grandmaster that he could easily withstand such a temperature. If it was an ordinary person, they might feel pain.
However, as Connor gradually approached the Soul Returning Pill, he realized that something was wrong.
He could feel that the Soul Returning Pill seemed to be repelling him, and the heat it released was also very terrifying.
This heat was not as simple as a brazier. He felt like he had been put into a furnace with a temperature of hundreds of degrees.
Connor could barely withstand it now.
But then, his expression began to change.
As his right hand continued to approach the Soul-Returning Pill, the temperature released by the pill became more and more terrifying. Connor only moved a few centimeters, yet he felt as if he had touched a piece of red-hot iron.
Connor gritted his teeth and continued to approach.
He felt as if he had directly put his hand into red-hot molten iron.
If it was an ordinary person, they probably wouldn't be able to withstand it; after all, no one could really put their hands into molten iron.
Connor circulated his aura desperately, condensing it into his right hand to resist the temperature released by the Soul Returning Pill.
At this moment, Connor finally understood what Josiah was talking about.
However, Connor did not have the intention of giving up. On the contrary, he continued to approach the Soul Returning Pill, and the temperature that he endured naturally became higher and higher.
Connor couldn't describe the temperature he felt in his right hand because he couldn't think of anything that could release such terrifying power.
Diana and Josiah looked at Connor with nervous expressions. However, they didn't dare to say a word because they were worried that their voices would affect his concentration.
A few seconds later, Connor finally moved his right hand in front of the Soul Returning Pill.
The heat released by the Soul Returning Pill seemed to have reached its peak.
Connor's expression began to distort, and fine beads of sweat began to appear on his forehead.
At this moment, Connor was secretly glad that he had encountered the remnant soul of the old man at the bottom of the cliff of Crimson Peak. If it was not because Connor had inherited the power of the remnant soul, then even if he could bring back the Soul Returning Fruit, he probably would not be able to take out the Soul Returning Pill from the pill furnace.
Even though Connor was now an ancient martial arts grandmaster, he still felt that the temperature he felt in his right hand was unbearable.
"Ah…"
Connor seemed to want to directly reach out and grab the Soul Returning Pill.
However, he had only moved forward by less than a centimeter, and the temperature had increased by thousands of times.
"Mr. McDonald, if you can't hold on any longer, stop. You'll really die!"
Josiah shouted after seeing Connor's expression.
"No…"
However, at this moment, Connor moved his right hand again. An excruciating pain swept through his body.
He gritted his teeth and reached out his hand until it was right in front of the Soul Returning Pill. Then, he used force to directly grab the pill.
After Josiah saw this scene, his body couldn't help but tremble slightly because he knew very well what kind of pain Connor was experiencing at this time.
When Connor held the Soul Returning Pill in his right hand, he felt the heat released by the pill instantly fill his body. This feeling was really like a heavenly fire burning his body.
However, this heat was invisible and would not really burn Connor's body.
He could feel that the meridians in his body seemed to be unable to withstand this terrifying temperature. It was as if his blood was literally boiling.

chapters.title: Chapter 1887: Successful Pill Refinement
chapters.content:
Chapter 1887: Successful Pill Refinement
Connor wanted to quickly take his right hand out of the furnace, but no matter how hard he tried, his right hand wouldn't move at all.
Josiah felt that Connor seemed to have reached his limit, so he advised with a trembling voice, "Mr. McDonald, give up…"
"Even if I die in front of this pill furnace today, I will take you out!"
Connor roared.
In an instant, an incomparably terrifying aura erupted from his body.
"Bang!"
The pill furnace seemed to be unable to withstand the energy that erupted from Connor's body and exploded.
The moment the furnace exploded, the entire alchemy room was directly razed to the ground.
Diana's reaction was very fast. She immediately pounced on Josiah and used her own aura to block most of the impact.
"It's over, everything is over…"
When Josiah saw the mess in front of him, he shouted in despair.
He knew that if the pill furnace exploded, it would mean that Connor had failed.
"Mr. McDonald!"
Diana shouted after she recovered, and then began to search for Connor in the ruins.
A moment later, she finally found Connor, who was buried in stone and cement.
At this moment, Connor's aura was extremely weak.
"Mr. McDonald, are you alright?"
Diana moved the stone on Connor's body as she shouted at him with a choked voice.
"I... I'm fine..."
Connor smiled.
"Mr. McDonald, didn't my grandfather already tell you? If you can't hold on, then give up! Why do you have to show off?!"
Diana shouted.
"No matter what, I have to save Freya!" Connor calmly replied, then slowly opened his right hand and asked Diana, "Is the Soul Returning Pill still here?"
When Diana heard Connor's words, she quickly looked down at Connor's palm. What she never expected was that the Soul Returning Pill had been successfully retrieved.
Grandpa, Mr. McDonald has succeeded!"
Diana shouted excitedly.
Josiah couldn't help but be stunned when he heard Diana's words. He quickly ran to Connor and picked up the Soul Returning Pill in Connor's hand.
A moment later, Josiah's body trembled as he said to Connor, "Mr. McDonald, you did it. You really took out the Soul Returning Pill!"
"It's good that I succeeded. Quickly save Freya…"
Connor smiled when he heard Josiah's words, then slowly closed his eyes.
Josiah quickly ran to Connor and examined him.
"Grandpa, is Mr. McDonald alright?"
Diana asked nervously.
"It's nothing serious. He's just fainted. He will probably wake up very soon…" Josiah replied with a smile.
"That's good…"
After knowing that Connor's body was fine, Diana let out a long sigh. If Connor lost his life because of this pill, it would be a life for a life. It was really not worth it.
"Hurry up and send Mr. McDonald to his room. I'll go and prepare the things that Miss Phillips needs to take the Soul Returning Pill. When Mr. McDonald wakes up, we can let Miss Phillips take the Soul Returning Pill!"
Josiah hurriedly said to Diana.
"Alright, I got it!"
Diana quickly agreed and carried Connor to her room.
In fact, if it was just the pill tribulation, it would not be enough to make Connor faint. After all, the pill tribulation had no physical effect on a person's body. The most terrifying thing about the pill tribulation was that it could make you hallucinate.
Therefore, what Connor experienced just now was just an illusion.
The real pill furnace was not as hot as Connor had imagined, but because the Soul Returning Pill made him hallucinate, he had experienced that indescribable heat and pain.
These things could quickly destroy a person's spirit, making you feel that you were experiencing great torture when in fact, your body was not being hurt at all.
Otherwise, even if Connor was an ancient martial arts grandmaster, his arm would have been turned into ashes under such high temperatures.
The reason why Connor had fainted was because the mental pressure he had suffered was too great. In addition, he had been seriously injured in the battle with Draco Felton and had not fully recovered yet. Still, his body had erupted with a force that he could not withstand, causing Connor to faint.
Of course, what Connor experienced today was also very beneficial to him. It could train his mental power.
…
Connor was unconscious for about two to three hours before he woke up. When he woke up, he asked Diana excitedly, "How's Freya's condition now?"
Diana felt extremely jealous of Freya. She could feel that there was nothing more important to Connor in this world.
"Miss Phillips is doing quite well…" Diana replied softly before continuing, "Mr. McDonald, you were unconscious just now, so my grandfather did not give Miss Phillips the Soul Returning Pill yet. Instead, he went to prepare other things. Now, he should be almost done…"
"I'm fine…"
Connor stood up as he spoke and walked towards Freya's ward.
A moment later, Connor and Diana arrived at the ward.
At this moment, Josiah had already prepared everything that he needed. He was just waiting for Connor to wake up and give Freya the Soul Returning Pill.
Josiah took the initiative to walk in front of Connor and asked him softly, "Mr. McDonald, you're awake?"
"Old Man Murphy, you've worked hard during this period of time…" Connor said gratefully.
"It's nothing more than a small matter. It's not worth mentioning. If it wasn't for you, Mr. McDonald, who brought back the Soul Returning Fruit and experienced the pill tribulation, I probably wouldn't have been able to refine a divine-grade pill in my life!" Josiah said with a smile.
Connor hesitated for a moment, then looked at Freya on the bed and muttered, "Can you give Freya the Soul Returning Pill now?"
"Of course…"
Josiah nodded gently and continued, "However, Miss Phillips's body might be very weak now. I'm worried that consuming the Soul Returning Pill directly might bring a huge burden to Miss Phillips's body, so I specially prepared some medicinal pills to nourish her body in advance…"
"You know more about this than me. As long as you think it's okay, we'll do as you say!"
Connor replied in a low voice.

chapters.title: Chapter 1888: It Worked
chapters.content:
Chapter 1888: It Worked
"Alright, alright…"
Josiah agreed. Then, he took the pill and walked in front of Freya before putting the pill into her mouth.
After she finished consuming the first pill, Josiah hurriedly fed her the second pill.
Connor knew that Josiah would never harm Freya, so he didn't stop him.
A few minutes later, Josiah turned to look at Connor and said softly, "Mr. McDonald, I've already given Miss Phillips the required pills. It should be time for her to consume the Soul Returning Pill…"
"Yes…"
Connor nodded.
Josiah took out the Soul Returning Pill with a trembling hand. After hesitating for two seconds, he put it into Freya's mouth.
At this moment, Connor's expression was also very nervous because he knew that Freya's life or death depended on this Soul Returning Pill.
However, after Freya ate the Soul Returning Pill, her body did not seem to have any reaction. The numbers displayed on the device did not change either.
The expression on Connor's face grew even more anxious. He stared at Freya on the bed, not daring to move his gaze at all.
A few minutes passed, but Freya still had no reaction.
Connor took a deep breath and asked Josiah in a low voice, "Old Mr. Murphy, is the Soul Returning Pill useless?"
"Mr. McDonald, before I refined the Soul Returning Pill, I told you that I don't know what the effects of the pill are. Moreover, Miss Phillips's situation is quite special, so..." Josiah trailed off.
"It's fine, even if the Soul Returning Pill doesn't work, I can still find other ways to save Freya!"
Connor interrupted.
The expression on Josiah's face seemed to be filled with self-blame. This was because he knew better than anyone what Connor had gone through to refine this Soul Returning Pill. If the Soul Returning Pill really had no effect on Freya, Josiah would feel very apologetic.
Everyone stood in the ward and waited for about ten minutes, but the numbers on the machine still did not change. Freya did not react either.
Connor felt that it was probably because the Soul Returning Pill did not have any effect, so he directly said to Josiah and Diana, "There's no need to wait any longer. The two of you can go out first!"
Josiah and Diana looked at Connor helplessly, then turned around and walked out of the ward.
Connor stood by the bed alone with a pained expression on his face. He did not expect that after he had spent so much effort to finally refine the Soul Returning Pill, it would end up like this.
"Freya, don't worry. It's okay if the Soul Returning Pill is useless. I will find other ways to save you. No matter what the price is, I will save you!"
Connor said softly.
"Beep…"
However, just as Connor finished speaking, the instrument emitted an ear-piercing sound.
Connor quickly looked up at the monitor beside the bed.
At this moment, Freya's heartbeat was gradually recovering, and it was getting faster and faster!
"Old Man Murphy!!"
Connor hurriedly shouted after seeing this.
Josiah and Diana rushed into the ward.
When Josiah saw the number on the instrument, his expression was very excited. His voice trembled as he said to Connor, "Mr. McDonald, this is great. Miss Phillips's body is gradually recovering. It's really blessed by the heavens. This is great…"
"Are you saying that the Soul Returning Pill is working?"
Connor asked excitedly.
"It should be…"
Josiah nodded lightly.
"..."
Connor looked at Josiah, who was so excited that he didn't know what to say.
A moment later, Freya's heartbeat and blood pressure had returned to normal.
Josiah walked up to Freya and checked her pulse. He turned to Connor and said, "Mr. McDonald, Miss Phillips's body has completely recovered. She will probably wake up soon…"
Connor let out a long sigh after hearing Josiah's words. He didn't even know how to describe his feelings.
No matter what, his hard work during this period of time was finally not in vain.
As long as he could wake Freya up, Connor felt that whatever he did would be worth it.
Connor composed himself and asked Josiah in a low voice, "Is there anything I can do now?"
"Mr. McDonald, you don't have to do anything now. Just wait for Miss Phillips to wake up…"
Josiah said with a smile.
"Alright, I understand…"
Connor hurriedly nodded.
Josiah and Diana had nothing else to do in the ward, so they turned around and left.
Connor sat quietly beside the bed, waiting for Freya to wake up.
In the blink of an eye, two days had passed.
In these two days, Connor did not leave the ward or rest. He sat beside Freya like a block of wood, waiting for her to wake up.
Diana walked into the ward with a bowl of rice and muttered, "Mr. McDonald, please eat something!"
"I'm not eating anymore. Take it out…"
Connor replied indifferently.
After hearing Connor's words, Diana's expression became somewhat helpless. She then said softly, "Mr. McDonald, my grandfather has already said that Miss Phillips's situation is quite complicated, but she will wake up at some point. You, on the other hand, haven't eaten for two days. If you continue like this, you might have starved to death by the time Miss Phillips wakes up…"
Connor said helplessly, "Then I'll just eat a little!"
After saying this, he stood up.
But at that moment, he suddenly saw Freya's fingers move.
Connor hurriedly stopped what he was doing and stared at Freya who was lying on the bed.
Freya's long eyelashes fluttered slightly.
"Freya…"
Connor hurriedly shouted.
Freya slowly opened her eyes and looked at him.
"Freya, you're awake?"
Connor shouted excitedly.
When Diana heard this, she quickly ran to Freya's side and found that she had actually opened her eyes.
"Mr. McDonald, I'll go call my grandfather now!"
Diana happily said.

chapters.title: Chapter 1889: He's Called Justin Spielberg!
chapters.content:
Chapter 1889: He's Called Justin Spielberg!
"Alright! Hurry!!"
Connor hurriedly replied.
After Freya opened her eyes, she seemed to need some time to adjust to her surroundings, so she didn't say anything.
Connor stood beside her with an excited expression.
"Connor, where am I?" she asked weakly.
"You are now in a very safe place. How do you feel?"
Connor hurriedly asked.
"I don't feel strong. I had a very long dream. I dreamed that I went to a beautiful place, but you weren't there. I looked for you everywhere, but no matter how I shouted and looked, I couldn't find you. I was really scared at that time…"
Freya said softly.
Connor bit his lips and said with a choked voice, "That was just a dream. Now that you've woken up, you're fine…"
Freya smiled when she heard his words. She then continued, "I thought that I was already dead. It's great that I am able to see you again…"
Connor could tell that Freya was very tired when she said this, so he took the initiative to ask, "Freya, are you feeling very tired? Do you want to rest for a while?"
"Can I still see you when I open my eyes again?"
Freya asked, seemingly reluctant to sleep again.
"Of course!"
Connor nodded vigorously.
Hearing that, Freya smiled and slowly closed her eyes.
When Josiah arrived at the ward, she had already fainted again.
Josiah checked Freya's body. At this moment, he could confirm that her body had returned to normal. However, because she had been unconscious for so long and had been relying on the power of the amethyst pendant to maintain her life, her body was very weak.
However, this was also very good news for Connor. After all, as long as Freya could wake up, then it was a good thing.
..
In the next few days, Freya would wake up for a while almost every day, but would soon fall unconscious again.
Connor stayed by her side until she woke up.
After she woke up, although her body was still very weak, there were no other abnormalities. She could chat with Connor and eat normally.
Josiah had also taken out all of his medicinal assets. All the medicinal herbs that were beneficial to Freya's body were given to her.
Connor told Freya everything that had happened recently. After she found out that Connor had gone through so much to save her, she was very touched.
Perhaps because Connor wanted to make up with Freya, he put down everything he was doing and stayed by her side almost every day.
As time passed, Freya's body gradually recovered. She could now move her body normally, and could complete some small tasks on her own.
This half a month was probably the happiest time Freya and Connor had spent together. After all, the two of them had never been alone for so long, and they were together all the time.
However, Connor knew that he could not stay with her for too long because he still had many things to do.
Sometimes, Connor thought that if he could just let go of the hatred in his heart and stay with Freya, spending the rest of his life so carefree, it would actually be a very blissful thing.
However, even if he was willing to let go of these enemies, the people of Yarlford were not so willing to let him go.
..
A month later.
Connor accompanied Freya for a walk in the garden of Josiah's house.
Because Josiah was an alchemist himself, he opened up a piece of land in his backyard. Although the area was not big, it was enough for Josiah to plant some herbs. Diana planted some flowers next to the medicinal field.
This place would make one feel that they had transmigrated to a paradise that was isolated from the world. The scenery was very beautiful and pleasant.
"Connor, my body should have almost recovered, so I don't need your care anymore. When do you plan to return to Yarlford to deal with your matters?"
Freya knew that it was already very difficult for Connor to accompany her for so long, but she did not want him to stay by her side forever since he also had many things waiting for him to do.
"There shouldn't be anything going on in Yarlford now, so I won't go back first. I'll stay here with you for a while!" Connor calmly replied.
Freya turned her head and looked at Connor, speaking to him in a very serious tone. "I really don't need you to accompany me. I don't want you to delay your matters because of me!"
"You're not delaying me. Yamino Gomez has been overseas all this time, so there shouldn't be any problems in Yarlford…" Connor said with a smile.
A hint of helplessness flashed across Freya's face, and she said softly, "Anyway, you have to think about your own matters!"
"You don't want me to stay by your side? Are you chasing me away?"
"Of course I want you to stay with me all the time, but I know that before you finish some things, you won't be happy even if you stay by my side!"
Connor turned to look at Freya. Just as he was about to speak, his phone rang.
Freya smiled when she heard Connor's ringtone and said softly, "Now, it should not be a matter of whether you want to leave or not. Instead, someone needs you to leave…"
Connor's expression was also somewhat helpless. Because Connor's phone was lost in Crimson Peak, not many people knew his new number. Thomas Kyle, and the others also knew that Connor was here with Freya, so if there was nothing important, these people would definitely not call him.
Connor took out his phone and saw that it was Thomas calling, so he picked up the phone and asked softly, "President Morgan, what's the matter?"
"Mr. McDonald, someone found me just now and said that he wanted to see you. Moreover, he seemed to be in a hurry…"
Thomas hurriedly said.
"What's that person's name?"
Connor frowned and asked.
"He's called Justin Spielberg!"
Connor's expression changed slightly when he heard this because he had not contacted Queta and the others recently.
Saul and Stellan were still in Connor's hands, and Yamino Gomez was not in Yarlford, so Connor felt that their side should be relatively safe.
However, Justin had actually come to Porthampton to look for him. This meant that something big had definitely happened.

chapters.title: Chapter 1890: What Happened to Queta?
chapters.content:
Chapter 1890: What Happened to Queta?
"Bring him to Josiah's house to see me now!"
Connor said in a low voice.
"Good!"
Thomas agreed and then hung up.
Freya smiled faintly when she saw Connor put down his phone. Then, she said softly, "Go and do your thing. You don't need to worry about me…"
"Yes!"
Connor nodded and walked towards the front yard.
More than ten minutes later, Thomas brought Justin to Josiah's house.
When Justin saw Connor, he gave him a big hug and said excitedly, "Connor, why didn't you tell us that you were alive? Do you know how worried we have been about you recently?"
"I have a lot of things to do recently, so I didn't have the time to inform you…" Connor replied in a low voice, then asked, "Did something happen? Why are you in such a hurry to come look for me in Porthampton?"
"Something happened to President Juve!"
Justin shouted.
"What happened to Queta?"
The expression on Connor's face was a little strange, and then he hurriedly said, "Justin, what exactly is going on? Tell me in detail…"
Justin took a deep breath, then organized his words and said to Connor, "Some time ago, there were rumors that you were dead in Yarlford. Furthermore, President Juve couldn't contact the people in Porthampton, so our company's capital chain had a problem. However, President Juve sold her company in Highland, and with Bernie Phillips's help, a portion of the capital problem was solved..."
When Connor heard this, he looked at Thomas and frowned as he asked, "You haven't contacted Queta recently?"
"No, I've been dealing with the problems of our four provinces' companies recently. Moreover, Yannick fired all the people in the Empire World Corporation some time ago, so the vice president responsible for connecting with President Juve hasn't come back yet!" Thomas said.
After Connor heard Thomas's words, the expression on his face grew a little helpless. He'd actually forgot such an important thing.
Previously, Stormbound Corporation's funds were all provided by the Empire World Corporation. Thomas was usually busy, so he could not be in charge of these matters personally. As a result, he'd handed this matter to the vice president of the Empire World Corporation's finance department.
However, this vice president had been fired some time ago, so Queta couldn't contact anyone from the corporation. In addition, the situation in Porthampton was not very clear, so Queta naturally did not dare to come to Porthampton personally.
"Is there a problem with the funds?"
Connor asked.
"The problem of funding has been temporarily resolved. However, an explosion occurred at the construction site the day before yesterday. A few workers died, so the police took President Juve away. Spencer, Dominic, Brooks and the others were also arrested because they were related to this project. I was lucky enough to escape first. Then, I went to look for Bernie Phillips first. Director Lin said that you were still alive, so I came to Porthampton…"
Justin told Connor about what had happened intermittently.
After hearing Justin's words, Connor stood up and said in a low voice, "Why would the construction site suddenly explode?"
"Someone must have deliberately sabotaged President Juve. Normally, such a thing would never happen at our construction site…" Justin hurriedly said.
"Looks like those people from Yarlford still haven't given up!"
Connor sighed softly, then turned to Thomas and said, "President Morgan, please book me two tickets to Yarlford as soon as possible. I'll go and think of a way to save Queta first!"
"Alright…"
Thomas nodded in agreement.
Meanwhile, Connor found Freya and briefly explained the situation to her.
Freya naturally understood. She only reminded him to be careful and did not say anything else.
Connor felt that he owed Freya a little, but unfortunately, such a big thing had already happened in Yarlford, so even if he wanted to keep staying in Porthampton, he could not.
…
3 PM.
Connor and Justin flew from Porthampton to Yarlford.
After getting off the plane, Connor went to Stormbound Corporation immediately.
However, what Connor did not expect was that Stormbound Tower was now empty. Most of the employees already knew that Queta had been arrested. They were probably worried that this would implicate them, so they chose to run away immediately.
"Connor, what should we do now?"
Justin asked anxiously.
"Don't worry, I have a way!"
Connor replied indifferently, then said to Justin, "Go find a safe place to hide now. Don't be discovered by the police. Leave the rest to me!"
"Alright…"
Justin nodded at Connor and left Stormbound Tower.
After Justin left, Connor went to his office alone and found the share transfer contract he signed with Yuna Winston.
Because Connor's phone had changed, he didn't know Yuna's phone number at all. However, he remembered that Yuna's phone number should be on this contract.
Soon, Connor found the number and dialed it.
"Hello, who is it?" Yuna asked coldly.
"Yuna, it's me!"
Connor said in a low voice.
"Little Connor, why are you calling me with this number?"
Because Yuna had been in York recently, and she didn't care much about the situation in Yarlford, she didn't know that Connor was presumed dead.
"Yuna, I don't have time to explain this to you now. Queta Juve from our company has been arrested by the police because of an explosion in the company. However, this explosion definitely has nothing to do with us."
Connor knew how terrifying Yuna's influence in the system was, going straight to her would be more effective than going to anyone else.
"I'll make a call to ask about the situation!" Yuna softly replied after understanding Connor's meaning.
"Alright!"
Connor nodded and then hung up.
About an hour later, his phone rang. When Connor saw that it was Yuna calling, he quickly answered the call and asked in an urgent tone, "Yuna, how is it?"
"Connor, I just made a few calls to ask about the situation. Because more people died at your construction site, the impact of this matter is still very big. The police might not be able to release them for the time being!" Yuna said helplessly.

chapters.title: Chapter 1891: The Zook Family Did It
chapters.content:
Chapter 1891: The Zook Family Did It
"Yuna, are your connections useless?"
Connor asked.
"The main reason is that the impact of this matter is too great. Many families of the workers are paying attention to this matter. If we release them now, I'm afraid it will cause an even greater social reaction. Therefore, the person in charge in Yarlford is also very difficult to deal with…"
Yuna said softly.
After hearing this, Connor's expression was a little helpless because he knew very well that if Yuna couldn't save Queta, then it would be useless no matter who he looked for.
Although Connor was already an ancient martial arts grandmaster, it did not mean that an ancient martial arts grandmaster could solve any problem. No matter how powerful you were, you could not go against the police!
"Although I can't ask the police to let her go directly, I've gotten you a chance to meet Queta. I think the most important thing for you now is to investigate what's going on!"
Yuna said softly.
"Okay, I got it. When can I meet Queta?"
Connor asked.
"Anytime. Queta should be at the government office now. When you get there, just mention my name to Chief Condor…"
Connor knew that Yuna had already done her best, so he said sincerely, "Yuna, thank you!"
"There's no need to be so polite…"
Yuna lightly replied before hanging up.
After the call was hung up, Connor drove to the government office without any hesitation and asked for the Chief Condor that Yuna had mentioned.
After Chief Condor found out about the relationship between Connor and Yuna, he was very polite to Connor. He directly arranged for Connor to meet Queta.
…
In the interrogation room.
When Queta saw Connor, she was also very excited because she did not expect him to be alive. She also did not expect him to come to see her so soon.
"It must've been hard on you during this period of time…"
Connor said guiltily when he saw Queta.
After all, if Connor hadn't taken the initiative to contact Queta, none of this would have happened.
"It's great to see you again, Mr. McDonald…"
Queta smiled at Connor as if she had no intention of blaming him.
"Don't worry, I'll definitely think of a way to save you!" Connor said softly.
"Yes!"
Queta nodded.
At this moment, Connor was not in the mood to chat with Queta, so he asked directly, "What's going on? Do you know who caused the explosion at the construction site?"
"The Zook family did it!"
Queta blurted out without thinking.
"How do you know it was the Zook family?"
"A month ago, the Zook family went to me and told me that Mr. McDonald was dead. They wanted to use a large sum of money to buy Stormbound Corporation, but I didn't agree to their terms. Later on, the Zook family started to think of ways to deal with me. The few factories we bought previously have all stopped working. The explosion at the construction site must have been arranged by the Zook family…"
Queta said slowly.
"Watson's son is in my hands. Why would he have the guts to deal with you? Aren't they afraid that I'll kill Saul directly?"
The expression on Connor's face was somewhat puzzled.
This was because he originally thought that with Saul in his hands, the Zook family should stop their activities. However, what Connor did not expect was that the Zook family had actually become even more aggressive.
"I'm not very sure about this…"
Queta shook her head.
"Alright, I already know the general situation now. I've already helped you build some connections. Although I might not be able to release you for the time being, you shouldn't suffer much here. Give me a little more time, I'll definitely save you!" Connor said softly.
"Mr. McDonald, you don't have to worry about me. I'm fine!"
Queta said with a smile.
Connor hesitated for two seconds, then stood up and walked out of the interrogation room.
"Mr. McDonald, you're out?"
Chief Condor, who had been waiting outside, asked with a smile when he saw Connor come out.
" Chief Condor, I hope you can help me take good care of this person. Nothing can happen to her here…"
Connor said expressionlessly.
"Mr. McDonald, you don't have to worry about that. I will take good care of Miss Juve even if it's because of your relationship with Miss Winston!" Chief Condor said hurriedly.
Connor thought for a moment before continuing. "Oh right, I heard that you have also arrested some people from Stormbound Corporation. Those people have nothing to do with this matter. They are not in charge of the construction site project, so I have to trouble you to release those people…"
"This…"
After Chief Condor heard Connor's words, his expression seemed to be a little awkward.
"Chief Condor, don't worry. I've given you a lot of things. I just want you to let go of a few unimportant people. It shouldn't be difficult for you, right?" Connor said softly.
"Mr. McDonald, I understand what you mean. These people should be released tomorrow!"
Chief Condor grinned.
Connor looked at Chief Condor indifferently and did not say anything, instead walking out of the government office.
After Connor left the government office, he drove straight home.
Because it was already past eight o'clock in the evening, Rachel had already returned home.
When Connor opened the door and entered the room, Rachel only turned her head to look at him and then asked casually, "You're back?"
"Why aren't you surprised to see me?"
Connor asked with a puzzled expression.
"What's there to be surprised about? Surprised that you came back from the dead?"
Rachel asked with a smile.
Connor sat beside Rachel and asked with a frown, "You knew I wasn't dead?"
"Have you forgotten who I am? My connections in Porthampton are no less than yours. I'm also very aware about what you did in Porthampton, so I already knew that you weren't dead. Of course I wouldn't be surprised..." Rachel lightly explained, then asked, "But I'm a little curious about how you survived, and you were actually able to kill Draco Felton. This is the thing that makes me a little surprised!"
Connor hesitated for a moment, then roughly told Rachel what he experienced in Crimson Peak Mountain.

chapters.title: Chapter 1892: Losing an Ally
chapters.content:
Chapter 1892: Losing an Ally
After Rachel heard Connor's story, her expression became even more shocked.
This was because she was also very puzzled about the remnant soul. After all, this kind of thing was really too unbelievable.
However, Connor was not in the mood to discuss these things with Rachel. He wanted her to think of a way to save Queta as soon as possible.
"Are you very puzzled as to why the Zook family dared to attack your Stormbound Corporation when they knew that Saul was in your hands?" Rachel said.
Connor hurriedly nodded. "That's right. I thought that Saul and Stellan were in my hands, so the Zook family should have stopped now!"
"The reason why the Zook family attacked your Stormbound Corporation is because they want to use it as a bargaining chip!" Rachel muttered to Connor while eating potato chips.
"What do you mean?"
"A lot of things happened in Yarlford while you were away. First of all, your Stormbound Corporation's capital chain has broken. The Zook family plans to use this opportunity to bribe Queta and make her transfer Stormbound Corporation to the Zook family…"
"But they didn't expect Queta to be so loyal to you. She would rather sell her business in Highland than let Stormbound Corporation continue to operate. That's why their first plan fell through…" Rachel slowly said.
"And then?"
"Then there was the explosion at the construction site. The Zook family is probably the mastermind behind this explosion! And I also know that they have a very complete set of evidence in their hands. As long as they hand over this evidence to the police, Queta can be cleared of suspicion, but only if you let Saul and Stellan go," Rachel said.
"Did you analyze all these things?"
At this moment, Connor was already shocked by Rachel's intelligence. Because if everything had happened according to what she said, then everything that the Zook family did could be explained.
"I don't have time to analyze these things. Don't forget that we have a spy in the Zook family now," Rachel said with a smile. "Peyton Zook!"
Connor couldn't help but be stunned when he heard this name. Then, he said in a low voice, "I didn't expect you to be in contact with Peyton Zook…"
"Even if you die, I have to deal with those people from the silver merchants, so I haven't been idle during this period of time!"
Rachel lightly rolled her eyes at Connor.
Connor looked at the expression on Rachel's face, a little embarrassed.
"Have you thought about what to do next?"
Rachel asked when she saw Connor not speaking.
"The Zook family is planning to use Queta in exchange for Saul and Stellan. Although those two people are indeed useless to me, I don't want to let them go just like that…" Connor replied in a low voice and then continued, "I didn't come back this time to make a deal with the Zook family. I want to get rid of the entire family!"
"Of course you can. After all, you're now an ancient martial arts grandmaster. Although the Zook family also has an ancient martial arts grandmaster, that person has always been by Hudson Zook's side. It should be very easy for you to make a move on Watson!"
Rachel gently nodded.
"That's right. I'm too lazy to scheme against the Zook family now. Wouldn't it be easier to kill Watson and get the evidence to save Queta?"
The current Connor no longer considered things like before. Perhaps this was because his strength had caused some changes in his style of doing things.
"Although the method you mentioned is the simplest method, I don't think you should!"
Rachel suddenly said.
"Why?" Connor asked in confusion.
He did not expect Rachel to disagree with his approach.
One had to know that the current Zook family basically did not pose any threat to Connor. Previously, he did not dare to use this method on the Zook family because he was not strong enough.
But now that Connor already had the strength to flatten the entire Zook family, he naturally would not have any scruples.
"Connor, your true opponent is the Gomez family, not the Zook family. If you get rid of the Zook family now, it will only cause the Gomez family to lose an ally. However, if you can make the Zook family your strength, the blow to the Gomez family might be even greater…" Rachel said softly.
Connor understood Rachel's meaning and asked softly, "You intend to support Peyton to become the head of the Zook family?"
"That's right."
Rachel lightly nodded at Connor and then analyzed, "Although you can indeed kill Watson now, doing so might not solve your current problem. Yamino Gomez will soon be able to nurture a second Watson, so killing Watson won't do you much good. As long as the Zook Corporation is around, your problem will always exist!"
"But it's not that easy to support Peyton to become the head of the Zook family!" Connor said with a frown.
"It might not have been easy in the past, but it's much easier now…"
Rachel smiled. Then, she slowly said, "I told you before that Hudson Zook has 51% of the Zook family's shares. As long as you can get Hudson to take out this 51% of the shares, won't the rest be much simpler?"
"Ma'am, do you think everything is as simple as you say?"
The expression on Connor's face was somewhat helpless. Then, he said, "Why in the world would Hudson want to take out those shares so I can deal with his son? Even if he's not satisfied with Watson, he's not that stupid!"
"Of course Hudson isn't stupid. But if it's for the safety of the entire Zook Corporation, then he has no choice!"
Rachel took out a file and threw it in front of Connor.
"What is this?" Connor asked with some doubt.
"This is the information that Peyton has collected recently. Most of it is evidence of Watson Zook's crimes. Once this information is handed over to the police, the Zook Corporation will definitely be investigated. They have done many shameful things for so many years, so they won't be able to withstand the investigation at all. Therefore, it'll only be a matter of time before the Zook Corporation goes bankrupt…"
Rachel paused for a moment before continuing, "Hudson founded the Zook Corporation single-handedly. He won't just watch the Zook family fall like this. Moreover, many members of the Zook family will be implicated. Therefore, I think that as long as you put this information in front of Hudson, he should know what to do!"

chapters.title: Chapter 1893: Zook Manor
chapters.content:
Chapter 1893: Zook Manor
Hearing this, Connor hesitated for a moment.
He opened the folder and looked at the information inside very carefully.
A moment later, Connor put down the information in his hand and sighed softly, "I didn't expect Watson to have done so many things over the years. It really surprised me!"
"If it weren't for Peyton, we wouldn't have been able to collect this information!"
Rachel said softly.
"Yes, the information provided by Peyton is indeed very important. I can talk to Hudson using your method first. If Hudson takes the initiative to give up his shares, that would naturally be the best. After all, this way, the Zook family will be controlled by us," Connor said with a smile.
"If Hudson is unwilling to give up his shares, then you can hand this information to the police first. As for how Watson should be dealt with, that's up to you!" Rachel said indifferently.
"Thank you!"
After saying this, Connor picked up the file and walked towards his room.
He felt that Rachel was more thorough than him when considering problems.
Watson was just a person standing in front of the Zook Corporation. Even if Connor killed him and saved Queta, he could not shake the foundation of the Zook Corporation; soon, a new family head would appear, and at that time, the Zook family's revenge on Connor might be even crazier.
Therefore, Rachel's suggestion of supporting Peyton was obviously more reliable.
…
The next day at 8 AM.
Connor drove alone to Hudson's manor.
Hudson was considered to be a famous person in Yarlford. He did not come from a good family. When he was young, he made a living by buying fertilizer in Yarlford. Later on in life, he had many opportunities to achieve his current achievements and even founded the Zook Corporation.
Moreover, Hudson's personality was slightly different from Watson's.
Hudson had always been arrogant and hated to associate with people like Yamino Gomez.
Back then, it was only after Hudson abdicated that the Zook family and the Gomez family walked together.
Hudson saw that the Zook Corporation was rising steadily under Watson's leadership, so he did not interfere in the matters between the Zook family and the Gomez family.
However, deep down in his bones, he looked down on people like Yamino Gomez. He felt that Yamino Gomez would use any means to achieve his goal, which was really a little shameful.
Connor stood in front of the Zook Manor and hesitated for two seconds before walking in.
"I'm sorry, this is a private residence. Without Mr. Zook's permission, no one is allowed to enter!"
However, just as Connor walked through the gate of the Zook family manor, a security guard reached out and stopped him.
"Do you know who I am?" Connor asked the security guard softly.
"I don't know…"
The security guard shook his head gently.
"My name is Connor McDonald!"
The security guard was confused when he heard Connor's name.
"I'm here to look for Hudson Zook today. I advise you not to stop me. It won't be worth it to lose your life because of such a small matter…"
Connor reached out and patted the security guard's shoulder gently. Then, he walked into the Zook Manor.
"Stop right there!"
The security guard shouted when he saw Connor barge in. Then, he reached out and grabbed his clothes.
The aura in Connor's body was released. Before the security guard could get close to Connor, he was sent flying by his aura.
The security guard lay on the ground and moaned in pain.
Connor looked at the security guard indifferently and said, "I already advised you. You're the one who doesn't know what's good for you!"
After saying this, he walked forward.
After he entered the Zook Manor, no one stopped him.
The environment in the Zook Manor was quite good. It gave people the feeling that they had traveled back in time to the mansion of an ancient prince. There were all kinds of Opranian architecture everywhere, and there were gardens and rockery.
Connor did not find Hudson after walking around the Zook Manor, so he casually went up to a security guard and asked, "May I ask where Hudson Zook is?"
"Are you here to look for Mr. Zook? He should be in the garden now, I think."
The security guard saw that Connor's attitude was polite, so he did not doubt Connor's identity and replied with a smile.
"Thank you so much!"
Connor smiled at the security guard and walked straight to the garden.
A few minutes later, Connor arrived at the garden.
He saw an old man in a white robe practicing taichi in the middle of the garden.
Judging from the old man's movements and posture, this person should also be a martial artist, but was not at a particularly high.
Moreover, Connor also discovered that there were several bodyguards accompanying the old man, so he could confirm that this person should be Hudson Zook.
Connor did not directly go and talk to Hudson. Instead, he went to the pavilion by himself and casually poured himself a cup of tea before waiting quietly.
About half an hour later, Hudson finally finished his taichi. He took a towel from the bodyguard and gently wiped his face before walking towards the pavilion.
When Hudson saw Connor, his expression was a little surprised. Then, he asked, "Who are you? I don't think I've seen you before!"
Connor took a sip of tea and replied with a smile. "My name is Connor McDonald. You should have heard of my name, right, Mr. Zook?"
"Connor McDonald?"
When Hudson heard this name, he frowned slightly and then said indifferently, "You should be the Mr. Connor McDonald who has been causing chaos in my Zook family lately, right?"
"That's right, it's me!"
Connor lightly nodded.
"I didn't expect Mr. McDonald to be as young as the rumors say. May I know why you have come today?"
After Hudson found out Connor's true identity, he didn't show any shock. On the contrary, he sat beside Connor like an old friend who hadn't seen him for many years.
"You should know very well why I'm here, right?"
Connor narrowed his eyes.
Hudson smiled faintly and said in a low voice, "Mr. McDonald, you should know that the matters of the Zook family are all decided by the juniors. I, an old man, am just an idle person. I have long stopped caring about the outside world."

chapters.title: Chapter 1894: A Win-Win Situation
chapters.content:
Chapter 1894: A Win-Win Situation
At this moment, Hudson thought that Connor was here to find trouble because there was a conflict between the Zook family and him.
"Mr. Zook, I'm here for you today. Moreover, it's useless for me to look for anyone else for this matter," Connor said lightly.
"Then if you have anything to say, just say it!"
Hudson took a sip of tea and replied softly.
"I want the 51% of the Zook Corporation's shares that you hold!"
Connor didn't waste any words.
"Hahaha!"
When Hudson heard Connor's words, he immediately laughed out loud. "Mr. McDonald, although this old man doesn't care about other people's business, I also know your relationship with the Zook family. You asked me for the shares of our Zook Corporation. Do you think I would give it to you?"
"It's possible!"
Connor nodded his head lightly and placed the folder Rachel had given him in front of Hudson. "Mr. Zook, you can take a look at this information first. After you're done, it's not too late for the two of us to talk about the shares!"
Hudson looked at Connor with some doubt. Then, he picked up the information on the table and put on his glasses to read it carefully.
A few minutes later, Hudson put down the documents with a trembling hand. He frowned and asked Connor, "Where did you get these?"
"This is not something you should be concerned about, Mr. Zook!" Connor replied indifferently and then continued, "I can assure you that all of this information is true. If I hand this information to the police now, Watson will be imprisoned very quickly, and it will probably be difficult for your Zook Corporation to escape this storm. At that time, the shares in your hands may become a burden…"
"What exactly do you want?"
Hudson could no longer maintain his composure because he did not know that Watson had done so many shady things behind his back for so many years.
It could be said that this information could not only take Watson's life, but it could also take the lives of more than half of the Zook family.
"Didn't I make myself clear just now? I want your 51% shares in the Zook Corporation!" Connor replied indifferently.
"How can I give my Zook Corporation's shares to an outsider like you? There's no room for negotiation!" Hudson refused without thinking.
"Aren't you afraid that I'll hand this information to the police?"
Connor asked in a low voice.
"You…"
Hudson stared at Connor with a furious expression.
At the beginning, he did not think too highly of Connor, but now he could see that Connor had come prepared!
"Mr. Zook, there are only two options in front of you now: either you give me the shares in your hands, or you wait for me to hand this information to the police. Then, you can watch your son and all the key members of the Zook Corporation go to jail!"
Connor slowly stood up and looked at the scenery in the courtyard. He sighed softly, "At that time, I'm afraid you won't even be able to live in this old house of yours, right? The Zook family will disappear from Yarlford forever…"
"Even if I give you the shares of the Zook Corporation, won't the result be the same? I'd rather watch the Zook Corporation collapse than give it to an outsider like you!"
Hudson gritted his teeth.
"I never said that I want your Zook Corporation. As long as you give me your shares, I'll let your grandson, Peyton Zook, become the new head of the Zook family. Other than Watson, no one else in the Zook family will be affected," Connor lsaid.
Hudson only understood Connor's meaning after hearing his words. He then sneered and lightly said, "So you came here today to support Peyton!"
