"If Peyton takes over, the Zook family and my Stormbound Corporation will be in a cooperative relationship. This way, not only can we solve the Zook family's problems, but we can also solve my company's problems," Connor said with a smile.
"It's a win-win situation?"
Hudson couldn't help but sneer. Then, he said expressionlessly, "Peyton is just a puppet in your hands. At that time, won't our Zook family fall into your hands?"
"But the head of the Zook family is still from your family. The Zook Corporation will also be managed by your family. I'm only taking a little bonus. Is this a loss to you?"
Connor said and then continued, "Are you really going to watch the Zook Corporation and the Zook family be wiped out by me?"
"McDonald, you have such big words!"
Hudson slapped the table hard and said with his eyes wide open, "I originally didn't plan to care about those things outside, but I didn't expect you to actually bully me. You even dare to take my shares. I think you've really overstepped this time. If you can walk out of the Zook Manor today, I, Hudson, will give you the shares with both hands!"
"Do you mean it?"
Connor had already expected Hudson to have such a reaction. After all, at this moment, Hudson had one last trump card in his hand that had not been revealed.
Before his last hope was shattered, Hudson would definitely not give in.
"That's right, I mean it!"
Hudson nodded.
The bodyguards who had been standing by Hudson's side all this while took out their pistols and aimed at Connor's position.
Hudson looked at Connor expressionlessly.
"You want to kill me with just a few bodyguards?"
Connor's expression was a little disdainful, and then he waved his right hand.
A powerful aura flew straight towards the bodyguards behind Hudson. Those bodyguards did not even have time to react to what was going on before they were all sent flying. They did not even have the chance to shoot.
Hudson did not panic when he saw the bodyguards behind him fall. On the contrary, he praised Connor. "Everyone says that you're Jorge Yarrell's disciple and that you're skilled."
Connor took a sip of tea and said calmly, "I know that there is an expert in the Zook Manor. Let him out. If I don't kill him today, you probably won't give up!"
"Brother Francis, it's time for you to make your move!"
Hudson calmly put down the teacup in his hand and called out expressionlessly.

chapters.title: Chapter 1895: Francis Scott
chapters.content:
Chapter 1895: Francis Scott
As soon as Hudson finished speaking, a figure descended from the sky and landed steadily in the middle of the garden like a meteor.
Connor raised his head and looked over. He saw that it was actually an old man with a head full of white hair and a long sword.
The old man was about the same age as Hudson, and his appearance was somewhat similar to Stellan.
Connor could feel that the aura in this old man's body was very terrifying, even above Draco Felton.
This person was an expert who had been hidden in the Zook family for many years. If it was not for the help of this person by Hudson's side, the Zook family would definitely not have such achievements today.
The old man sized up Connor and asked softly, "You are Jorge Yarrell's disciple?"
"That's right!"
Connor nodded.
"My name is Francis Scott. I fought with your master a few times in the past, but unfortunately, I was never a match for him. Today, I will give you a chance on account of your master," Francis said.
"There's no need. If I don't get the shares in Mr. Zook's hands today, I definitely won't leave!"
Connor replied to Francis lightly.
"I heard that my son couldn't even last two moves against you. Today, I want to see just how capable you are to look down on us!"
After Francis said this, he rushed towards Connor.
Hudson sat quietly in the same place and drank tea. It could be seen that Hudson was very confident in Francis's skills.
Connor and Francis were both ancient martial arts grandmasters, so the two of them fought almost instantly.
Connor's punch carried an extremely powerful aura and went straight to Francis's chest. Francis's expression was a little shocked after seeing his punch. He finally understood that his son Stellan would lose to him.
The power contained in Connor's punch was something that even ancient grandmasters would have to avoid, let alone Stellan, who was only a black-rank.
"Good fist technique!" Francis laughed and waved his hand.
An aura that was like a long sword flew straight towards Connor.
Connor's fist collided with the sword, but it did not affect his speed at all.
The expression on Francis's face seemed a little strange. He condensed his chi into a sword again. This time, it was not a single sword, but rather countless swords that were completely formed by Francis's aura. They flew toward Connor like rain.
When Connor's body collided with these auras, his speed became slower and slower because most of his energy had been offset by these auras.
By the time Connor rushed in front of Francis, the power of this punch had already been offset by nearly half.
Connor punched Francis's chest, but Francis only smiled contemptuously and then thrust a hand out.
Connor took two steps back to stabilize his body.
It was obvious that Francis had the upper hand in the first fight.
However, Francis was also shocked by Connor's strength at this time. After all, the power of the aura he released just now was very shocking, but Connor had used his own body to forcefully withstand it. This was enough to prove that Connor really had the strength to fight with him.
"I didn't expect you to be so capable at such a young age. Even Jorge from back then probably wasn't even at one-tenth of your strength!" Francis thought.
One had to know that Jorge's talent in ancient martial arts was already shocking enough. However, even if Jorge was compared to Connor, he was inferior.
After all, Connor had the strength he had today because he had obtained the power of the remnant soul. If he had not devoured the remnant soul, then he might not even be qualified to stand in front of Francis.
"Seven Stars Big Dipper Fist, Earth Render!"
Connor ignored Francis and rushed toward him again.
At this moment, Connor borrowed the power of the five elements, and a raging fire burned on his fist. His aura was extremely shocking.
Connor, who had broken through to the ancient martial arts grandmaster level, could easily use the power of the five elements even without the help of the five elements dagger.
After Francis saw Connor's punch, the expression on his face was a little strange. He could feel that Connor's punch was over ten times more terrifying than the previous one.
Therefore, after taking a deep breath, he slowly pulled out the sword on his back.
After the sword was unsheathed, an extremely powerful force was released from Francis's body.
When Hudson saw this scene, his expression was a little shocked. Then, he sighed softly, "He forced Brother Francis's Dragon Sword out with just two punches. This Connor really has some ability. What ability does Jorge have to nurture such a stunning disciple!"
With the Dragon Sword in hand, Francis's aura seemed to have undergone a great change.
"Sword chi, rise!" Francis growled.
A streak of sword chi shot towards Connor.
Francis's sword chi collided with Connor's fist.
Connor could barely hold on for a while at the beginning, but the power of Francis's sword chi was too shocking.
Even Connor seemed to be unable to hold on, retreating more than ten meters before barely stabilizing his body.
"This sword of yours is quite interesting!"
Connor muttered to Francis.
"You're so young and you already have such abilities. If you leave now, you'll be invincible in Oprana in another ten years!" Francis commented.
"Unfortunately, I can't wait that long…"
Connor replied indifferently, then rushed towards Francis's position again.
Francis wanted to use the same trick after seeing Connor attack, but Connor's figure flashed as he dodged the sword chi. Francis could only raise his Dragon Sword.
"Bang!"
Connor's fist collided with the dragon sword, creating a loud sound.
Even the fake mountain behind Francis exploded because of the power of Connor's punch, but Francis stood still.
The expression on Connor's face was a little strange. He then raised his fist and smashed it against the Dragon Sword again.
This time, Francis took three steps back.
Connor struck while the iron was hot and punched Francis seven times in a row.
Unfortunately, it did not cause any harm to Francis; it only caused the Dragon Sword in Francis's hand to let out waves of sorrowful cries.
Francis held the Dragon Sword in his hand, and his expression was full of surprise. He had never thought that he would be beaten back by Connor.
Even Hudson, who was at the side, found the scene unbelievable.

chapters.title: Chapter 1896: You Have Some Skills
chapters.content:
Chapter 1896: You Have Some Skills
"Today, I'll let you see how powerful I am!"
Francis roared and swung the sword in his hand at Connor.
Connor hurriedly retreated a few meters and narrowly avoided Francis's sword.
However, Francis did not give Connor any chance to react. He waved the Dragon Sword in his hand continuously, and more sword chi shot towards Connor.
Connor took a deep breath and then condensed his aura into a shield in front of him.
When Francis's sword Chi collided with his shield, a terrifying sound was heard.
Following the attack, the shield in front of Connor also began to crack.
After Connor saw this, the expression on his face seemed a little troubled.
"Bang!"
At this moment, his shield exploded, and a sword Chi slashed fiercely at his chest. He retreated for nearly a dozen meters, smashing through countless fake mountains and walls, leaving behind a mess in his wake. In the end, he crashed into a hundred-year-old tree before stabilizing his body.
Connor could feel the bloodline in his body actually starting to surge again.
The last time Connor had such a feeling was when he fought with Draco Felton.
Only when his body could not withstand an overly powerful force would such a situation occur.
Connor hurriedly circulated the Chi in his body, trying to adjust his aura.
However, Francis did not give Connor this opportunity at all. He held her sword and rushed straight to him.
In an instant, Francis had already rushed in front of Connor.
Connor had no choice but to accept the challenge.
The two of them were extremely fast, and the people in the Zook Manor could not see the battle clearly at all. They could only see the fake mountains around the two of them exploding one after another. Even the ground had huge cracks left in it.
The security guard who was sent flying by his aura also saw this scene. There was shock on his face. He never thought that he would have offended such a terrifying existence just now.
After Connor and Francis fought for a while, Francis actually took the initiative to stop.
This was because he could feel that the aura in Connor's body was very terrifying. This level of terror was something that an ancient martial arts grandmaster could not have.
Therefore, he did not want to continue to tangle with Connor and planned to defeat him in one move.
"Connor, my sword almost took your master's life back then, but unfortunately, it was blocked by him. Today, I want to see if his disciple can take my sword!"
Francis shouted.
Connor looked at Francis with a calm expression.
"Sword of the Yellow Court!" Francis growled. Then, his body seemed to fuse with the dragon sword, turning into a cold light and heading straight for Connor.
This Sword of the Yellow Court technique was Francis's ultimate skill. Its power was even a hundred times more terrifying than ordinary sword techniques.
Even Hudson, who was far away, was extremely shocked at this time. How could he have thought that Connor would actually force Francis into such a situation, even using his trump card skills.
Connor slowly raised his right hand and said softly, "Seven Stars Big Dipper Fist, Ten Directions Dharma World!"
After saying this, Connor slowly punched out.
His punch did not seem to have any power or momentum at all, resembling a casual punch from an ordinary person.
Hudson smiled disdainfully when he saw his punch, but the smile on his face quickly froze.
Because after Connor finished this punch, a large column of holy light erupted behind him.
It was as if the entire Zook Manor was enveloped by the light behind Connor.
"Bang!"
Connor's fist collided with Francis's Dragon Sword.
However, the Dragon Sword seemed to be unable to withstand the power contained in his punch. After trembling violently, it directly turned into countless fragments that flew in all directions.
"Puchi!"
Francis also spat out a mouthful of blood and flew backward with his head raised.
"This... How is this possible?"
Hudson stood up abruptly and looked at Connor with a dull gaze.
When Hudson saw Francis fly out, he was stunned, shock on his face.
Hudson never thought that his ordinary punch could have such terrifying power. Even Francis could not take his punch.
At this moment, Hudson's expression began to grow solemn because he knew in his heart that Connor actually dared to come alone today to threaten him to hand over the Zook family's shares. This meant that Connor had already made full preparations beforehand, or he would not have been so bold.
"Connor was just an ordinary Black-rank a while ago, so why does he have such terrifying power now?"
Hudson could not help but wonder.
Although he said that he didn't care much about the outside world, he knew everything that happened in Yarlford as long as it was related to the Zook family.
Connor was the biggest opponent of the Zook family and Gomez family, so Hudson had naturally investigated his situation.
Hudson felt that his biggest background was that he obtained Steven Lee's inheritance and became Jorge Yarrell's disciple. If Connor didn't have these two identities, he wouldn't have the right to wrestle with the Gomez and Zook families.
But at this moment, Hudson realized that he might have underestimated Connor.
Connor's current strength wasn't something a normal Black-rank warrior could have.
After Francis forcefully received his punch, although he spat out blood, he did not seem to have completely lost his fighting strength. On the contrary, he slowly stood up.
"As expected, you have some skills. You can actually stand up after taking my punch!"
Connor said lightly after seeing Francis stand up.
"Young man, I really didn't expect you to be so capable at such a young age, but don't underestimate this old man. If I, Francis Scott, really lose to you like this, wouldn't I become the laughing stock of the ancient martial arts world?" Francis replied in a low voice and then gently opened his arms.
Connor could feel a very powerful aura circulating in Francis's body. Moreover, the aura was obviously dozens of times more terrifying than before.
In just a few seconds, Francis's body began to emit bursts of green light, giving people the feeling that he was a piece of top-quality jade.

chapters.title: Chapter 1897: Who Are You?
chapters.content:
Chapter 1897: Who Are You?
"Rise!"
Francis roared.
In an instant, an extremely powerful force erupted from Francis's body.
These auras began to devour the surrounding Worldly Spiritual Energy.
Connor narrowed his eyes and looked at Francis. He knew that any martial artist who could become an ancient martial arts grandmaster could easily control the spiritual energy between heaven and earth and use it to improve their combat strength. Francis was naturally the same.
Hudson was a little excited after seeing this scene because he knew that Francis was finally serious at this moment.
Previously, Francis had always treated Connor as a junior, so he naturally disdained fighting at full strength with him. After all, even if he defeated Connor, it would be somewhat unreasonable.
However, Connor's punch had completely awakened Francis. Francis knew very well that if he didn't give it his all today, it would be impossible for him to defeat Connor.
Francis's body slowly left the ground and floated in the air.
Endless spiritual energy began to pour into Francis's body. It was as if he was like a black hole, crazily devouring all the spiritual energy around him.
Connor narrowed his eyes and looked at Francis. The expression on his face was very calm.
Although Francis was an ancient martial arts grandmaster, the amount of spiritual energy he could control was limited. However, Francis couldn't think of this now; he knew that he could only defeat Connor with all his strength.
After a few seconds, Francis's body seemed to be unable to withstand any more spiritual Chi. His body began to tremble slightly. However, he still did not choose to stop.
"Brother Scott, be careful!"
Although Hudson was not a martial artist, he also noticed that Francis's situation was not quite right, so he hurriedly opened his mouth to call out to him.
Francis's expression was a little strange after hearing Hudson's words. Then, he slowly stopped devouring the surrounding Worldly Spiritual Energy.
"Die!"
Francis looked at his position and roared, then waved his right hand.
In an instant, the Spiritual Energy that was originally accumulated in Francis's body rushed out at once, like a tidal wave threatening to consume Connor.
The energy contained in the Chi was very terrifying. After all, Francis himself could not bear it just now. If it hit Connor, the power would be unimaginable.
When the Worldly Spiritual Energy surged out, it formed a huge gully on the ground. It was as if even the ground could not withstand this terrifying energy at this moment. The entire Zook Manor began to tremble violently.
The people in the Zook Manor were very afraid. They never thought that Francis could explode with such shocking energy that it could make the earth tremble.
"This is a true immortal!"
"That's right. I didn't expect that Grandmaster Scott's strength would be so terrifying…"
"Just now, I thought Grandmaster Scott would lose to this person. It seems that I was thinking too much!"
Everyone in the Zook Manor started discussing in low voices.
Hudson's expression was very serious at this time. Although he knew that Francis's move was indeed very terrifying, he felt that Connor should not be defeated so easily.
As expected, when the terrifying Worldly Spiritual Energy surged in front of Connor.
Connor suddenly punched out.
"Boom!"
Connor's fist collided with Francis's aura, and his body began to retreat.
In just a moment, his body had already retreated a hundred meters.
A deep ravine was left on the ground.
However, after Connor retreated a hundred meters, he actually successfully stabilized his body.
After everyone saw Connor stop unharmed, the expressions on their faces seemed to be even more unbelievable.
No one had expected Connor to be able to remain unharmed in the face of such a terrifying attack from Francis. This really made people feel that it was a little too terrifying.
"This... How is that possible?"
Everyone stared at Connor with wide eyes, as if they did not know how to describe their current feelings.
After Connor adjusted his aura, he slowly raised his head and looked at Francis in the distance.
It was obvious that Francis's expression was also very ugly at this moment.
This was because Francis originally thought that even if he could not defeat Connor with this move, he would definitely be able to severely injure Connor.
However, Francis never expected that Connor could block it so easily.
Francis started to get excited. He gritted her teeth and shouted, "Who exactly are you?"
"You should know very well what kind of person I am!"
Connor simply replied to Francis expressionlessly.
When Francis heard his words, his expression became a little strange. Then, he said coldly, "How can you have such a terrifying level at such a young age? What's going on?"
After all, with the gradual decline of ancient martial arts, the number of modern people who could become martial artists was already one in ten thousand.
Moreover, it was extremely rare for an ordinary martial artist to become an ancient martial arts grandmaster, even in the entire Oprana.
Moreover, the reason why people like Francis could become ancient martial arts grandmasters was that they had gone through decades of hard training to reach such a realm.
Even Jorge Yarrell, who was known as the greatest genius in the Opranian martial arts world, only became an ancient martial arts grandmaster after the age of 40.
However, Connor, who was standing in front of Francis at this time, already had the combat strength of an ancient martial arts grandmaster at such a young age. Francis could not understand how Connor did it. He did not believe that anyone in this world could have such terrifying talent.
"The reason why I can have such power is all thanks to my enemies!"
Connor replied.
One had to know that he was not joking.
After all, when Connor took Jorge Yarrell as his master, he didn't really aim to become an ancient martial arts grandmaster. On the contrary, in his eyes, it was enough as long as he had the ability to protect the people around him.
However, those people from the silver merchants were pressing on Connor little by little, which led to his strength continuously increasing.
Back then in the Crimson Peaks, if it wasn't because the McDonald Clan had tried to kill him, how could he possibly possess the strength he had today?

chapters.title: Chapter 1898: Admit Defeat?
chapters.content:
Chapter 1898: Admit Defeat?
To put it bluntly, the reason why Connor could become so powerful was his enemies.
If it wasn't for these people, he might still be an ordinary martial artist, never thinking of really becoming an ancient martial arts grandmaster.
Francis hesitated for two seconds before rushing towards him.
In just a moment, Francis rushed in front of Connor, then raised the Dragon Sword in his hand and chopped down on his head.
At this time, Francis was obviously a little flustered.
However, Connor dodged Francis's sword. In the next second, when Francis reacted, Connor had already appeared behind him.
Connor threw a punch at Francis's back.
"Boom!"
With a terrifying bang, Francis was sent flying.
When Hudson saw this scene, his expression began to turn ugly. His body could not help but tremble slightly because he had not expected such a situation at all.
Francis flipped his body back around in the air after he was sent flying, and then rushed toward Connor again.
In fact, Francis had already used all the trump cards that he could use at this time. However, Connor's strength was a little too terrifying. He knew that it was not so easy to defeat Connor.
However, Francis did not choose to admit defeat at this time. If he really admitted defeat like this, his reputation in this lifetime would be ruined.
This might be Francis's last act of desperation as an ancient martial arts grandmaster.
Connor and Francis continued to fight. Their speed was very fast, so fast that ordinary people could not even observe their battle.
Hudson's expression was very anxious because this battle might affect the future of their Zook family. If Francis lost to Connor, the biggest loss would not be Francis, but their Zook family.
"Bang!"
At this moment, Hudson heard another loud sound. He hurriedly raised his head and looked into the distance.
Connor was standing in place without any injuries, while Francis's body had already flown a hundred meters away and finally smashed onto the ground.
When Hudson saw this scene, he suddenly stood up. His expression was very nervous.
"Cough cough…"
After falling to the ground, Francis coughed twice and spat out a mouthful of blood.
Hudson and Francis had known each other for many years, so Hudson naturally knew Francis's ability very well. He never thought that things would turn out like this.
After struggling for a moment, Francis slowly stood up and walked towards Connor.
It was obvious that Francis's aura was very weak at this time. Even Connor could feel that he could no longer continue fighting.
Connor narrowed his eyes and asked softly, "Still not planning to admit defeat?"
"Admit defeat?" Francis sneered when he heard his words, and then said indifferently, "Unless you kill me today, I won't admit defeat!"
"Kill you?"
Connor smiled faintly and then said in a low voice, "Since you want to die so much, I'll fulfill your wish!"
After saying this, his figure flashed and rushed directly towards Francis.
When Hudson saw that Connor was really planning to make a move, he hurriedly shouted, "Mr. McDonald, stop!"
However, Connor did not seem to hear Hudson's words and continued to rush towards Francis.
Francis also gave up resisting and slowly closed her eyes.
"Clang!"
Just as his fist was about to hit Francis, Hudson actually knelt on the ground and shouted with a trembling voice, "Mr. McDonald, I, Hudson Zook, am convinced. Please be magnanimous and let Brother Scott go!"
Hudson and Francis had known each other for many years. Their relationship was not that of a business partner, but more of a friend.
Therefore, Hudson did not want to watch Connor kill Francis. Moreover, if Connor killed Francis, the shares in his hands would definitely be in his pocket. If he admitted defeat now, he might be able to exchange the shares for Francis's life.
Connor saw Hudson kneeling on the ground and slowly turned around to look at Hudson. Then, he stopped what he was doing.
"Mr. McDonald, I agree to your conditions. I can give you all the shares of the Zook Corporation in my hands. I hope you can let Brother Scott go!" Hudson hurriedly shouted when he saw Connor stop.
Connor indifferently sized up Hudson and asked, "Are you willing to give up your shares now?"
"I was a fool before. Mr. McDonald, there's no enmity between the two of us, so I hope you can be magnanimous!"
Even if Hudson was reluctant to give up to Connor, he had no other choice at this moment because his strength was really too terrifying.
If even Francis was not Connor's match, then he was just an ant-like existence in front of Connor.
Connor took a deep breath and did not choose to continue attacking Francis. Instead, he slowly walked to Hudson's side.
Hudson raised his head and looked at Connor. His expression was very nervous because he didn't know what Connor was planning to do.
"If you had handed over the shares in your hands earlier, all this wouldn't have happened, would it?" Connor muttered.
"I can't accept this!"
Hudson gritted his teeth and said in a low voice.
"You're unwilling?" Connor could not help but laugh when he heard Hudson's words. Then, he said indifferently, "Do you think that I really want those shares in your hands just to get your family business?"
"What else could it be for?"
The expression on Hudson's face was somewhat puzzled.
"You know very well what kind of person I am. Your family business is just a drop in the ocean to me. I don't care about your family's things at all. I want the shares in your hands just to deal with the Zook family!" Connor said lightly.
"Do you think you have the right to deal with people like Yamino just because you have our Zook family?"
Hudson replied in a low voice.
"Just your Zook family alone is definitely not enough. But what if I add the Lee family?"
Connor asked softly.
"Lee family?"
After Hudson heard his words, the expression on his face seemed a little strange.
"That's right, it's the Lee family. Now, the Lee family is also under my control!"
Connor nodded lightly at Hudson.

chapters.title: Chapter 1899: The Transfer of the Shares
chapters.content:
Chapter 1899: The Transfer of the Shares
Hudson was extremely shocked.
He never thought that the Lee family would actually be under Connor's control.
At this time, Hudson suddenly had a thought in his heart, and that was that Connor might really be able to contend with Yamino Gomez.
However, this thought only flashed across his mind.
"Although I can give you the shares in my hands, I advise you not to make a move on people like Yamino Gomez. Yaminos terror is not something you can imagine. I admit that you're very powerful—our Zook family may not be your match—but it's not that easy for you to deal with the Gomez family!"
Hudson advised in a low voice.
"If it's not to deal with the Gomez family, then what's the point of me dealing with your Zook family?" Connor asked Hudson with a smile.
When Hudson heard his words, he could not help but take a deep breath. However, he did not continue to persuade Connor because he knew very well that even if he tried, Connor would not listen.
"What do you plan to do after you get these shares from me?"
Hudson asked curiously.
"The reason why Yamino has such great influence in Yarlford is because your four great families have been serving him. Without the help of your four great families, Yamino's influence in Yarlford will be reduced by half. So you should be clear about what I'm going to do next, right?"
Connor replied indifferently.
Hudson was a smart person. He knew very well what Connor meant by this. Moreover, Hudson had personally witnessed his strength today, so the fate of the remaining two families of the four great families should be the same as their Zook family and Lee family.
Although Hudson believed that Connor had the ability to take down the remaining two large families, he still did not believe that Connor could completely topple Yamino at this moment.
"After you get my shares, how do you plan to deal with the Zook family?"
Hudson hesitated for a moment before asking Connor.
Connor did not hide anything from Hudson and said, "Don't worry, I won't hurt the interests of the Zook family. In the future, the businesses of the Zook family will still be managed by your family. I won't interfere in the matters of the Zook Corporation."
"Are you planning to let Peyton Zook be the head of the Zook family?" Hudson asked.
"That's right!"
Connor lightly nodded.
Hudson took a deep breath and didn't say anything. He knew very well that he was no longer qualified to negotiate with Connor.
"Is there anything else you want to ask?" Connor asked softly.
"There's nothing else…"
Hudson shook his head. Then, he said expressionlessly, "As long as you let Brother Scott go, all the shares in my hands will be yours. As for how you plan to deal with our Zook Corporation, that's your own business. I only hope that you don't hurt our Zook family!"
"You mean your son, Watson?" Connor asked indifferently.
"Yes…"
Hudson nodded lightly.
After Connor heard Hudson's words, he could not help but laugh. Then, he said softly, "If Watson is sensible, I might give him a way out. However, if he is not sensible, then don't blame me for being rude…"
Hudson gritted his teeth. "Watson didn't seem to have offended you, right? You can get everything you want right now, so why attack Watson?"
"You think he never offended me?" Connor smiled faintly and said softly, "What did Watson do to me? I think you should ask him!"
Hudson sized up Connor with an uncertain expression. His expression was very helpless because he knew that there must be some grudge between Connor and Watson, otherwise under such circumstances, Connor wouldn't have had to make a move on Watson. He would have just driven Watson out of the position of the Zook family's head.
"Alright, I'm not in the mood to explain these things to you now. Get your people to prepare the contract. I want to sign the share transfer contract with you now!" Connor said.
Hudson slowly turned his head to look at Francis, then nodded helplessly and said softly, "Alright, I'll get someone to prepare the contract for you now!"
"Brother Zook!"
Francis hurriedly shouted when he heard this.
Hudson waved his hand gently at Francis and said indifferently, "Brother Scott, you don't have to say anything. I was the one who dragged you into today's matter, so I can't watch you die in this person's hands. These shares of the Zook Corporation are just some worldly possessions to me. I'll just give them to him…"
When Francis heard this, the expression on his face seemed a little helpless. This was because he knew how important Hudson's shares were to him. As long as these shares were still in his hands, the Zook family would still be under his control, so he must be very unwilling to take out these shares at this time.
"Brother Zook, I'm sorry for being so useless!"
Francis said in a very heavy tone.
"This matter has nothing to do with you. It's the Zook family who provoked someone we shouldn't have!"
Hudson waved his hand gently and took out his phone to make a call.
Connor looked at Hudson indifferently and did not stop him. He knew very well that Hudson could not find any reinforcements in this situation, so he should not be planning to play any tricks.
Sure enough, a few minutes later, a middle-aged man who looked like a lawyer hurried to Hudson's side and asked him in a low voice, "Mr. Zook, have you really thought it through? Are you really planning to transfer all your shares?"
"I don't have any other choice now…"
Hudson replied in a low voice.
"But if you…"
The lawyer opened his mouth to speak, but Hudson interrupted him.
"Did you bring the contract?"
"Mr. Zook, have you really thought it through?"
The lawyer asked softly.
"Why are you talking so much nonsense? I asked you if you brought the contract."
Hudson called out expressionlessly.
After hesitating for two seconds, the lawyer took out two contracts from his briefcase and whispered to Hudson, "Mr. Zook, if you really sign this contract, the shares of the Zook Corporation will not belong to you anymore..."

chapters.title: Chapter 1900: Yellow-rank Ancient Martial Artist Grandmaster
chapters.content:
Chapter 1900: Yellow-rank Ancient Martial Artist Grandmaster
Hudson ignored the lawyer and took the contract.
He handed the contract to Connor and said softly to Connor, "Mr. McDonald, please check this contract. If there's no problem, we'll sign it…"
When the lawyer heard this, he quickly looked up at Connor with an incredulous expression. He did not expect Hudson to actually intend to give his shares to an outsider.
"There's no need to check anything. Just sign the contract!"
Connor indifferently replied to Hudson, because he knew in his heart that Hudson would absolutely not play any word games with him at this time.
Hudson slowly raised his head and looked at Connor without saying anything. Connor picked up the contract and signed his name on it.
After Hudson saw Connor write his name, he seemed to be trembling all over. His face was also very pale. He had worked hard in Yarlford for so many years before finally owning the family business of the Zook family. However, at this moment, Connor was actually asking him to give up this family business just like that. He was definitely very unwilling to do this.
But he was helpless.
In front of Connor, he had no ability to resist at all.
"Hu…"
Hudson took a deep breath, then slowly picked up the pen and wrote his name on the contract with trembling hands.
The lawyer quietly watched everything that was happening in front of him. He was very puzzled because he could not understand the situation. Hudson had controlled these shares for so many years and had never given these shares to his own son, but now, he had actually given these shares to an outsider for nothing.
This was really incomprehensible.
"Now, our Zook family is yours…"
Hudson put down the fountain pen in his hand and whispered to Connor.
Connor slowly raised his head to look at Hudson, then said softly, "Don't worry, I will keep my promise. As long as your Zook family members cooperate with me obediently, I won't hurt them!"
"What do you plan to do next?"
Hudson asked expressionlessly.
"Inform everyone in the Zook family to go to the Zook Corporation's headquarters for a board meeting at 8 am tomorrow!"
Connor declared, then turned around and walked out of the Zook Manor.
There was no deep hatred between Connor and the Zook family. The only conflict he'd had was with Watson. However, in his eyes, Watson was just a small ant, so Connor did not lie to Hudson. As long as the Zook family was obedient, he did not have any intention of hurting them.
"Then can Saul and Stellan come back?"
Hudson suddenly remembered that Saul and Stellan Scott were still in Connor's hands. He hurriedly stood up and shouted at Connor.
"I will let them go!" Connor replied indifferently.
After all, the Zook family's shares were already in his hands. Those two people had no value to Connor, so he might as well let them go.
When Hudson heard his words, the expression on his face seemed to ease up a little. He took a deep breath and slowly sat down on the spot.
Francis walked to Hudson's side and whispered to Hudson, "Brother Zook, why are you so muddle-headed? You shouldn't have given those shares to Connor!"
"Brother Scott, do I have any other choice now? If I continue to hold on to the shares in my hands, the final result will be that you and I will die in the hands of this Connor today. This might be the fate of our Zook family…"
Hudson replied in a low voice.
After Francis heard Hudson's words, her expression seemed to be a little ugly. She said in a low voice, "It's all my fault for being useless. I didn't expect Connor to possess such terrifying strength at such a young age."
"Brother Scott, you don't have to blame yourself too much…"
Hudson waved his hand lightly. "Actually, this matter has nothing to do with you. All these years, I've been persuading Watson not to get too close to people like Yamino, but Watson just wouldn't listen. In the end, he brought such a huge disaster to our Zook family. I don't care about the shares anymore. As long as Connor can keep his promise and not continue to attack our Zook family, I'll be satisfied…"
Francis let out a long sigh and didn't know what to say.
Originally, in Hudson and Francis's plan, the two of them would wait for Connor to take the initiative to come to them. Then, Francis would take action to get rid of him. In that case, the biggest threat to the Zook family would disappear.
However, what these two people never expected was that Connor's strength could not be controlled to such an extent. Even Francis was not an opponent to him.
"Brother Scott, I'm not an ancient martial arts practitioner to begin with. I don't know much about the matters between you martial arts practitioners, but there's something that I'm very puzzled about…"
Hudson suddenly said.
"What is it, Brother Zook?"
Francis hurriedly replied.
"Isn't Connor's strength too terrifying?"
Hudson asked in a low voice.
When Francis heard this, he couldn't help but be stunned for a moment. Then, he said in a low voice, "Brother Zook, I might be a lower-rank ancient martial arts grandmaster, but even I didn't have any chance of winning against Connor. This means that his strength is very likely to be close to a yellow-rank ancient martial arts grandmaster!"
"What does that mean?" Hudson hurriedly asked.
"His master, Jorge Yarrell, is an ancient martial arts grandmaster that shook Oprana. Jorge Yarrell is only a yellow-rank ancient martial arts grandmaster!" Francis said helplessly.
When Hudson heard this, he was stunned on the spot. The expression on his face was also very incredulous.
Although he didn't know what the ancient martial arts levels were, he didn't expect his current strength to be comparable to someone like Jorge Yarrell. This was really unbelievable.
"How can he have such terrifying strength at such a young age?"
Hudson asked excitedly.
Francis took a deep breath and said helplessly, "This is also what I'm most curious about. I've been in contact with ancient martial arts for so many years, but I've never met such an ancient martial arts genius. I feel that this Connor must be hiding some unknown secret…"
"..."
Hudson looked at Francis and hesitated for two seconds. Then, he asked expressionlessly, "Then Brother Scott, do you think that Connor already possesses the qualifications to fight with Yamino?"

chapters.title: Chapter 1901: A Fight Between Immortals
chapters.content:
Chapter 1901: A Fight Between Immortals
"Not necessarily…"
Francis shook his head without any hesitation.
"Why?"
Hudson hurriedly asked.
"Brother Zook, you're really underestimating Yamino. As far as I know, the Gomez family has three one-star grandmasters and a two-star grandmaster at their disposal. Moreover, Yamino is a member of Rockefeller, so Rockefeller's headquarters will also provide Yamino with a lot of backup. If Connor wants to use the method of your Zook family to deal with the Gomez family, he is basically courting death!"
Francis looked at Hudson and said slowly.
When Hudson heard this, he could not help but suck in a breath of cold air, disbelief on his face. After all, he had lived in Yarlford for so many years, and yet he did not expect that the Gomez family would actually hide so many ancient martial arts experts.
"The power of the Gomez family itself is already very terrifying, so most of the time, Yamino doesn't need to use ancient martial arts to deal with problems. This also leads to many people not knowing the true strength of the Gomez family!"
Francis seemed to see through the doubts in Hudson's heart.
"Originally, I was already very terrifying because of Francis's strength, but I never thought that Yamino Gomez would be even more terrifying. Perhaps this is a true battle between gods!"
Hudson couldn't help but laugh bitterly. He knew in his heart that the Zook family was just a pawn in the game between Connor and Yamino.
Previously, their Zook family was controlled by the Gomez family, but now, they were being controlled by Connor.
In the end, no matter who won or lost, it was the same for the Zook family.
"In front of these true experts, we are just ants!" Hudson thought.
Francis sighed softly and did not say anything.
…
Meanwhile, Connor returned home after leaving the Zook Manor.
It was three o'clock in the afternoon, so Rachel hadn't come back yet. Connor ended up deciding to cultivate his chi by himself.
As his level got higher and higher, he also realized how important strength was in this society. If he was just a normal Black-rank fighter today, he definitely wouldn't be able to get these shares from Hudson. It would definitely not be that easy to deal with the Zook family!
But now that Connor had the combat strength of a Yellow-rank ancient martial arts grandmaster, it made it much easier for him to do many things.
"Ding, ding, ding…"
Just as Connor was concentrating on his cultivation, his phone suddenly rang.
He picked up his phone and saw that it was a call from Aida Collier.
He answered the call. "Hey!"
"Connor, have you returned to Yarlford?" Aida asked.
"Yes!"
Connor nodded his head lightly and continued to ask, "Did you call me because you have some important news?"
"Beau Collier has already brought everyone from the McDonald family to Haverhead Hill to hide. Right now, the entire McDonald family is under my control. I've been trying my best to help you find the grandmaster's whereabouts for the past few days, but there hasn't been any progress…" Aida said helplessly.
"Then why did you call me?"
Connor asked in confusion.
"Even though I didn't manage to find out Grand Master's whereabouts for you, I managed to learn something very important from Zakir Xylon!" Aida hurriedly said.
"What news?"
"Yamino is going to attend a meeting at Rockefeller's headquarters this time. This meeting is held once a year and will affect Rockefeller's development in the next year, so the meeting will take a long time. It is very likely that Yamino will not be able to return to Yarlford in such a short period of time!"
"This should be good news for me. I can use this time to deal with the few big families in Yarlford, then I'll wait until Yamino returns before making a move on him!" Connor said lightly.
"Yamino's participation in the meeting this time is indeed good news for you. However, I also heard from Zakir that Rockefeller no longer intends to waste time with you because the higher-ups of Rockefeller feel that you've been improving faster than their expectations. As such, once Yamino returns to Yarlford, he will most likely make a move on you!" Aida said seriously.
"The people from Rockefeller can't wait any longer, can they?"
"That seems to be the case. After all, the news of you killing Draco Felton has already reached their ears!"
Connor was still very confident in his current strength, so he did not show the slightest fear. "Since the people of Rockefeller want to make a move on me, then let's them! It just so happens that I also want to understand everything from them!"
Aida seemed to have already guessed his reaction and quickly said, "You're overthinking things. The Gomez family has a lot of ancient martial arts experts, and this time, the headquarters of Rockefeller will also give Yamino some help. They might even send out their ability users to deal with you, so once you really fight Yamino, your chances of winning will be very low!"
"Ability users?"
Connor's expression was a little puzzled after hearing Aida's words.
"That's right, it's an ability user!" Aida replied in a low voice, then continued, "This is what I heard from Zakir. The user should be a martial artist from Oprana, but the way he's addressed overseas has changed!"
"I understand…"
Connor nodded thoughtfully.
"So I think you have to be careful now. Moreover, don't think that you can easily deal with the Gomez family just because you've become stronger. If the Gomez family was really so easy to deal with, Yamino wouldn't have been able to dominate Yarlford for so many years!"
"..."
Connor hesitated for two seconds, then whispered, "I have never thought of using force to deal with the Gomez family. I want to make them lose everything they have first, and then only make a move on them. In this way, the Gomez family will never have a chance to turn things around, and Rockefeller's control over Yarlford will completely disappear!"
"It's great that you think that way. I'm just worried that you'll choose to attack Yamino Gomez on impulse. If that's really the case, you might end up in trouble!"
Aida let out a long sigh as soon as she understood what he meant.

chapters.title: Chapter 1902: Rachel's Complaints
chapters.content:
Chapter 1902: Rachel's Complaints
"You don't have to worry about these things. The most important thing for you now is to help me find out where the advisor beside Yamino Gomez is. I need to find this person!"
Connor said expressionlessly.
"Alright, I understand…"
Aida then hung up the phone.
Connor slowly put down his phone and narrowed his eyes to look out the window.
In fact, Connor knew what Aida was worried about; his strength was already very terrifying, so she was probably worried that Connor would choose to deal with Yamino the same way he dealt with Draco Felton, Hudson Zook, and the others.
But in fact, Connor did not intend to do that at all.
The reason was very simple: what Connor wanted to deal with wasn't just Yamino Gomez, but the entirety of Rockefeller.
Now, even if Connor had the chance to directly get rid of Yamino, then he would not make a move either. Even if Yamino died in his hands, Rockefeller would soon find an even more powerful person to replace him. In this case, this was equivalent to treating the symptoms but not the root cause.
What Connor wanted to do was to destroy all of Rockefeller's industrial chains in Yarlford and finally get rid of Yamino Gomez. Once that happened, Rockefeller would lose its influence in Yarlford, and once that happened, its control over other parts of Oprana would also instantly disappear.
Only in this way could Connor completely eliminate Rockefeller from Oprana.
Although Connor had never thought of taking back Rockefeller before, this matter was too far away for him. Moreover, taking back Rockefeller was not an easy thing to do.
However, the current situation had already changed. The current Connor was no longer the Connor from before. His way of thinkinghad also changed greatly.
Connor knew that if he wanted everyone around him to be safe, he had to get rid of Rockefeller. Otherwise, everyone around him would live in danger.
Previously, Connor might not have thought of taking back Rockefeller or dealing with them, but their actions made him realize that he and Rockefeller's people were in a state of immiscible conflict. Even if he was willing to reconcile with Rockefeller, Rockefeller's people might not be willing to reconcile with him.
Connor took a deep breath, then slowly closed his eyes and prepared to continue cultivating.
"Creak!"
However, at this moment, the sound of the door opening could be heard.
Connor knew that Rachel had returned, so he got up and walked out of the bedroom.
Sure enough, Rachel walked into the living room in high heels. After entering the living room, she kicked her high heels to the side and jumped onto the sofa barefooted. She pouted and complained to Connor, "I had to teach four classes today. I'm really exhausted…"
"You don't need money. If you don't want to keep teaching, you don't have to!"
Connor softly replied.
Rachel lightly rolled her eyes. "If I don't go to school to be a lecturer, what can I do? Stay at home and watch TV every day?"
"You can work at my company!"
Connor said with a smile.
"Work at your company?" Rachel couldn't help but be stunned when she heard this. Then, she pursed her small mouth and said, "Why are you dreaming? Why should I work for you…"
"What's wrong with working for me?"
"Nothing, but I don't want to work for you!" Rachel replied bluntly and then continued, "You should have seen Hudson today, right? How's the situation?"
"I've already obtained 51% of Hudson's shares, so the Zook Corporation is now under my control. Give Peyton Zook a call and ask him to attend the Zook Corporation's board meeting tomorrow!" Connor said with a smile.
"I didn't expect you to move so quickly. In just a day, you got those shares from Hudson!" Rachel said in surprise.
"I fought with the people around Hudson, and then he obediently gave me the shares!" Connor said casually.
When Rachel heard his words, she couldn't help but be stunned for a moment. Then, she frowned and said, "Then didn't the information I gave you work?"
"It wasn't too useful…"
Connor lightly shook his head.
"I thought that as long as you showed those documents to Hudson, he would give you everything. I didn't expect that you still had to rely on your fists to solve the problem!"
Rachel seemed to be a little disappointed. After all, she had spent a lot of effort to collect this information.
"Hudson seemed to have guessed that I would go back to look for him, so he was prepared in advance. He planned to kill me and snatch the information!" Connor replied indifferently and then continued, "However, Hudson did not expect my strength to improve so quickly. If not for the fact that I already possess the strength of an ancient martial arts grandmaster, I reckon that I would have died…"
"Your improvement in strength is indeed very shocking. Without mentioning those outsiders, even I can't understand what's going on!"
"If you don't understand, then don't think about it. Besides, now is not the time to think about these things!" Connor replied indifferently.
Rachel looked at Connor helplessly and didn't say anything. Instead, she took out her phone and found Peyton's number to send a message.
After sending the text message, Rachel turned to Connor. "I just informed Peyton to attend the Zook Corporation's board meeting tomorrow..."
"Good!"
Connor lightly nodded.
Rachel saw Connor standing beside her, so she asked, "Is there anything else you need?"
No…"
Rachel waved her hand at Connor and said in an annoyed tone, "Since there's nothing else, why are you still standing here? Go do what you should do. Don't stand here and delay me from watching my TV…"
When Connor heard Rachel's words, a helpless expression crossed his face. He said in a low voice, "This is clearly my house. Why do you make it seem like I'm living in your house…"
Rachel rolled her eyes at Connor, then picked up the remote control and turned on the TV.
Connor stood there and hesitated for two seconds before turning around and returning to his room.
..

chapters.title: Chapter 1903: The Board of Directors' Meeting
chapters.content:
Chapter 1903: The Board of Directors' Meeting
The next day, 9 AM.
Today was a big day for the Zook Corporation and everyone in the Zook family.
Hudson Zook, who had been living in seclusion for many years, was actually holding a board meeting!
Ever since Hudson stepped down as the Chairman of the Zook Corporation, he had never been involved in the Zook Corporation's matters, nor had he ever participated in board meetings.
But this time, he actually took the initiative to hold a board meeting and invited all the shareholders of the Zook Corporation. Even some of the Zook family's side branches had received the news and rushed over from other places.
Such a situation had never happened since the establishment of the Zook Corporation. Even at Watson's birthday banquet, there were not so many people from the Zook family who had come.
Therefore, the Zook Corporation was particularly lively today.
…
Meanwhile, in Watson's office.
Watson and Wilford's expressions were very ugly at this time because the two of them had no idea what had happened. Why would Hudson suddenly hold a board meeting, and such a large-scale board meeting at that?
"Dad, what is Grandpa trying to do?"
Wilford asked with a frown.
After hearing Wilford's words, Watson's expression also seemed a little helpless. Then, he frowned and said, "If you ask me now, who the f * ck should I ask?"
Wilford noticed that Watson's tone seemed a little off, and the expression on his face also seemed a little strange.
"Dad, didn't you go to see Grandfather this morning?"
"When I found out that your grandfather was going to hold a board meeting, I went to look for him immediately to ask what was going on, but your grandfather didn't even want to see me…" Watson said with a frown.
"He didn't want to see you?"
The expression on Wilford's face grew even uglier because he knew that if Hudson did not want to see Watson, it meant that this meeting must have something to do with Watson.
He hesitated for a moment before walking up to Watson and asking him in a low voice, "Dad, could it be that my grandfather found out about what you did to my uncle?"
When Watson heard Wilford's words, a strange expression flashed across his face. Then, he frowned and said in a low voice, "It's definitely not because of this matter…"
"Why?"
The expression on Wilford's face grew puzzled.
At this time, Wilford couldn't think of any other possibility; after all, Hudson hadn't asked about the Zook Corporation for so many years. It was definitely not normal for him to suddenly make such a big commotion.
"Your grandfather is not a fool. He knows better than anyone what I did to your uncle back then. This is also the reason why he has always controlled 51% of the shares all these years. Moreover, he doesn't wash his dirty linen in public. If he really did it because of these things, there's no need for him to make such a big fuss…" Watson said expressionlessly.
"What else could it be?"
Wilford asked softly.
"When I went to look for your grandpa, I met Leonardo, the steward. Although he didn't tell me the reason, he said that a young man went to see your grandpa yesterday," Watson said slowly.
"A young man?"
When Wilford heard this, he could not help but be stunned for a moment. Then, he said expressionlessly, "Dad, is this young man Peyton Zook?"
"Impossible. I asked Leonardo if he was from the Zook family, but he shook his head..." Watson muttered.
"If he's not from our Zook family, then who else can he be?"
Wilford slowly raised his head and glanced at Watson. The expression on his face seemed a little strange, and he quickly said, "Dad, the person who went to look for Grandfather couldn't be Connor McDonald, right?"
"I thought the same. If the person who went to see your grandfather was really Connor, then what did Connor say to him? What does your grandfather's board meeting have to do with Connor…" Watson said with an ugly expression.
After hearing this, Wilford's expression began to become nervous because he did not associate this series of things with Connor at all.
However, if all these things were really related to Connor, it meant that Watson might have encountered big trouble this time.
"Peng peng…"
At this moment, there was a knock on the door.
"Come in…"
Watson shouted in a low voice.
A beautiful girl who looked like a secretary walked into Watson's office and said softly to Watson, "Mr. Zook, all the shareholders who came to attend the board meeting are here. Do you want to go over?"
"Is the old Chairman here?" Watson hurriedly asked.
"He... Not yet..."
The secretary hurriedly shook her head.
Watson's expression was a little strange when he heard this, but he didn't say anything. He stood up and walked out of the office.
Wilford hesitated for a moment before following him.
A moment later, Watson brought Wilford to the meeting room.
At this moment, the conference room was already overcrowded. Other than the few important seats in front, the rest of the conference room, that could accommodate more than a hundred people, was already full.
When everyone saw Watson enter the meeting room, they took the initiative to surround him and ask about the purpose of Hudson's board meeting.
However, what surprised these people was that even Watson didn't know what was going on.
Watson walked to the front of the meeting room after a simple greeting. However, he hesitated for two seconds and didn't choose to sit there. Instead, he sat on the right side of the seat.
Watson knew that this seat belonged to Hudson.
Everyone sat in the conference room and chatted while waiting for the real head to appear.
At this moment, Watson's mood was also very complicated. He had been staring at the door, waiting for Hudson to appear.
In the blink of an eye, an entire hour had passed.
But Hudson still did not appear.
At this moment, a shareholder finally couldn't wait any longer. He stood up and frowned as he asked, "Mr. Zook, what's going on? Didn't the old Chairman say that he was going to hold a shareholders 'meeting? But why wasn't the old Chairman here yet?"
After Watson heard the shareholder's words, he looked a little helpless and said in a low voice, "Everyone, calm down. My father probably still has some unfinished business. Everyone, please wait a moment!"

chapters.title: Chapter 1904: I Call the shots!
chapters.content:
Chapter 1904: I Call the shots!
When everyone heard Watson's words, they began to whisper.
However, because they were afraid of Watson's authority, they only discussed in whispers. No one dared to stand up and say anything.
Just like that, everyone waited for a few minutes.
The door of the conference room was finally pushed open from the outside.
When everyone heard the commotion, they stood up and looked at the door.
Unfortunately, to their disappointment, the person who walked in was not Hudson, but rather Peyton Zook.
When everyone saw Peyton, their faces were filled with anger.
"Peyton, the board meeting was supposed to be held at nine o'clock. Why are you only here now?"
Wilford asked coldly.
When Peyton heard Wilford's words, his expression was a little disdainful. He said expressionlessly, "What does it have to do with you what time I come over?"
"..."
Wilford was stunned for a moment, then asked in a very puzzled tone, "Peyton, what did you say to me just now?"
One had to know that Wilford had relied on his father's power to bully Peyton for so many years, and Peyton had always chosen to swallow his anger. After all, Watson and his son had controlled the entire Zook family back then, so Peyton did not have the guts to go against Wilford at all.
However, Peyton actually dared to contradict Wilford at this time. This made Wilford somewhat surprised.
Peyton did not give Wilford any face at all and replied very bluntly, "Didn't you hear what I said just now?"
"Peyton, you're quite bold to speak to me that way!"
The expression on Wilford's face grew angry. Then, he walked towards Peyton.
However, Watson felt that something was wrong. He stretched out his hand to stop Wilford, then said to Peyton expressionlessly, "Peyton, we're holding a board meeting of the Zook Corporation today. You don't have any shares of the Zook Corporation, right? Besides, you don't have any position in the corporation. What are you doing here?"
"It's true that I don't have any shares in the Zook Corporation now, and I don't hold any position. However, after this board meeting is over, that might not be the case…"
Peyton replied expressionlessly.
"..."
When Watson heard Peyton's words, he could not help but be stunned for a moment. Then, he frowned and asked, "What do you mean by that?"
"You will know what I mean later…"
Peyton smiled, then looked at everyone and continued, "If I'm not wrong, are you all waiting for my grandfather to come?"
"That's right. When can the Chairman come over?"
"Could it be that the Chairman is here today?" everyone asked.
"You don't have to wait here. My grandfather doesn't plan to come over today at all…"
Peyton looked at everyone and said with a smile.
Wilford stepped forward and shouted excitedly, "Peyton, what are you trying to say? How do you know that Grandpa won't come today?"
"Because from now on, the Zook Corporation has nothing to do with Hudson Zook!"
However, at this moment, a voice rang out in the meeting room.
When everyone heard this voice, they all looked up at the door.
A young man slowly walked into the meeting room, followed by a middle-aged man dressed as a lawyer.
When everyone present saw this young man, they were all stunned on the spot. Their expressions were as shocked as they could be.
They had never expected this person to appear on the board of directors of the Zook Corporation.
Watson looked as if he had seen a ghost. His face was filled with fear.
For a moment, it was as if the entire conference room had fallen silent.
"Connor, what are you doing here?"
Watson was probably the first to react. He stood up and shouted at Connor with his eyes wide open.
"Your Zook Corporation?"
After Connor heard Watson's words, he could not help but sneer. Then, he said indifferently, "I'm sorry, but I should be the one in charge of this company now!"
"You have the final say? Who do you think you are…"
Wilford opened his mouth and was about to speak, but Connor suddenly turned his head to look at him, and an aura immediately flew towards Wilford.
Before anyone could react, Wilford's body flew out and smashed onto the table in the conference room.
"Mr. Zook, are you alright?"
"Mr. Zook, what's wrong?"
Everyone present instantly fell into chaos and ran to Wilford's side.
Meanwhile, Wilford had already fainted.
Peyton could not help but sneer when he saw this scene. He had wanted to take revenge on Wilford for a long time. At this time, he was naturally very happy to see Wilford beaten up by Connor.
After everyone found out that Wilford was unconscious, some people carried him out of the meeting room.
Watson's expression was also very angry at this moment. He gritted his teeth and shouted, "Connor, you broke into our Zook Corporation without permission and injured my son. What do you want to do?"
Connor looked at Watson indifferently and said, "I only taught him a small lesson just now. If there is a next time, I will kill him without hesitation!"
"Connor, how dare you! Do you not think of our family at all?" Watson roared.
"That's right, I don't!"
Connor nodded.
"What do you mean?"
"You're here to find trouble today, right?"
"Where are the security guards? Hurry up and send someone to chase him out!"
Connor's words seemed to have instantly ignited all the members of the Zook family present. They stood up and shouted at Connor.
Peyton's expression grew a little nervous when he saw this scene.
After all, with so many people present, every one of them was worth more than 100 million. Moreover, they were all very influential in their own territory. It wasn't a good thing for Connor to anger so many people at once.
However, Connor's expression was very calm at this time. After all, these people were just ant-like existences in Connor's eyes. It was impossible for him to take them seriously at all.
"Mr. Solana!"
Connor turned his head and shouted at the lawyer behind him.
Mr. Solana hesitated for a moment before taking out a document and said to everyone, "Everyone, please be quiet. I have a document to show you!"
"A document?"
When Watson heard this, he could not help but be stunned for a moment. Then, he asked in a low voice, "What document?"
Mr. Solana glanced at Watson indifferently and said, "Yesterday, Mr. Hudson signed a share transfer contract with Mr. McDonald. Mr. Hudson transferred all of the five billion shares he held in the Zook Corporation to Mr. Connor McDonald, so Mr. McDonald now holds 51% of the Zook Corporation's shares!"

chapters.title: Chapter 1905: Benefits
chapters.content:
Chapter 1905: Benefits
"What?"
"Impossible!"
"How could the old Chairman transfer his shares to an outsider for no reason?"
"No matter how muddle-headed the old Chairman is, he wouldn't do that, right?"
After hearing the lawyer's words, everyone's eyes instantly widened, and their expressions were extremely incredulous.
At this moment, Watson's expression was also very ugly.
Although he had long guessed that this board meeting might have something to do with Connor, he never expected it to end up like this, with his father actually transferring all the shares of the company to Connor.
This was an outcome that Watson could not accept at all.
It wasn't just him—almost everyone present could not accept this result.
In their eyes, although there were some differences between Watson and Hudson, no matter what, Hudson would not give his business to an outsider for no reason.
"You're talking nonsense. How could the old Chairman give his shares to this person?"
A member of a branch of the Zook family had seen Connor at Watson's birthday banquet. He knew very well the relationship between Connor and the Zook family, so he could not believe this fact at all.
Mr. Solana placed a copy of the contract on the table and said to everyone expressionlessly, "This is a copy of the contract. If you don't believe me, you can take a look now. Mr. Connor and Mr. Hudson have already completed the shareholder certificate. You can also go to the industrial and commercial bureau to check for yourself!"
When everyone heard Mr. Solana's words, they hurriedly picked up the contract and read it carefully.
"Did the old Chairman really transfer his shares? How is that possible?"
"Yeah, and it's an unconditional transfer. What is the old Chairman doing?"
"Could it be that the old Chairman was threatened?"
After confirming that there were no problems with the contract, everyone began to discuss in low voices.
Watson sat there quietly because he knew that since Connor had brought his lawyer, it meant that Hudson's shares had indeed been transferred.
But he couldn't understand why his father would do this!
"Do you still think that I'm not qualified to come here?"
Connor asked calmly.
For a moment, everyone present quieted down and looked at him expressionlessly.
Connor saw that everyone was silent, so he walked straight to the chair in front and sat down quietly.
At this moment, the Zook family members were at a loss when facing Connor. They all turned their heads to look at Watson.
However, Watson kept his head lowered. No one knew what he was thinking.
"Legally speaking, Mr. McDonald is now the largest shareholder of the Zook Corporation. He has the right to hold a board meeting. As the majority shareholder, Mr. McDonald also has the right to change the personnel arrangements of the Zook Corporation!" Mr. Solana said expressionlessly.
When everyone heard Mr. Solana's words, they finally realized what the real purpose of this board meeting was!
Watson looked at Connor coldly and said in a low voice, "Connor, do you think that the Zook Corporation is yours just because you got 51% of the shares from my father?"
"What else would I think?" "Don't forget that we still have 49% of the shares. If we withdraw our shares collectively, you will face a large amount of equity fees," Watson said as he gritted his teeth.
"Do you think money is a problem for me?" Connor asked with a smile.
When Watson heard Connor's words, he was instantly dumbfounded. After hesitating for two seconds, he gritted his teeth and said in a low voice, "Alright, since you're so rich, I'll withdraw my shares!"
"Do it, then!" Connor lightly nodded, then narrowed his eyes and looked at the others present, asking, "And what about you people? Are you planning to withdraw your shares as well?"
"That's right. Since Mr. Zook has already chosen to withdraw his shares, I'll withdraw my shares too!"
"Yes, withdraw the shares!"
"I'll withdraw my shares too!"
Everyone present felt that once Connor controlled the entire Zook Corporation, their good days would come to an end. Therefore, they might as well take this opportunity to force Connor to abdicate. Even if they could not change the fact that Connor held 51% of the shares, they could not let Connor get the Zook Corporation so easily.
When Peyton saw that so many people were planning to withdraw their shares, his expression began to turn ugly.
After all, the entire Zook Corporation was worth more than 100 billion dollars. If all these people withdrew their shares, they would have to face a huge amount of compensation.
They still didn't know the financial situation of the Zook Corporation, but no matter what, the Zook Corporation's funds were definitely not enough to compensate these people.
Therefore, once they agreed to let these people withdraw their shares, they could only split the Zook Corporation into two.
Watson was obviously burning his bridges. Since he could not change the fact that Connor was the largest shareholder of the Zook Corporation, he could only choose to split up. This way, he could still ensure that half of the Zook Corporation was under his control.
When Watson saw that so many people wanted to withdraw their shares, he looked a little proud.
Connor, on the other hand, had an indifferent expression. He looked at everyone and said, "I can agree to withdraw your shares now, but I think you should listen to me first before considering withdrawing your shares…"
"What do you want to say?" everyone hurriedly asked.
"Although I'm the largest shareholder of the Zook Corporation now, I've never wanted to change the current structure of the Zook Corporation…" Connor paused for a moment and then continued, "What I mean is that if you want to continue staying in the Zook Corporation, I can guarantee that your positions will not change. Whatever you can get in the Zook Corporation before, you can get the same in the future. You might even get more…"
After everyone understood Connor's meaning, their expressions grew a little strange.
After all, the reason why these people chose to withdraw their shares was actually because they were worried that their positions would be lost. However, if Connor could agree to them and let their interests not be affected in any way, then these people were actually very willing to stay.
After all, withdrawing their shares was only a last resort for them.
Everyone began to discuss amongst themselves in low voices.

chapters.title: Chapter 1906: I Want to Stay
chapters.content:
Chapter 1906: I Want to Stay
At this moment, a man in a suit stood up and shouted at Watson excitedly. "Mr. Zook, you can't be serious!"
"That's right, Mr. Zook. If you give the shares in your hands to this person, then our Zook Corporation will really be finished!"
"Mr. Zook, you have to think carefully!" everyone shouted.
Watson sat there expressionlessly. Of course he didn't want to hand over his shares, but Connor had evidence that could kill him, so he didn't know what to do for a moment.
Previously, Watson had never taken Connor seriously because he felt that Connor was just a young boy. He thought that although Connor had some ability, he definitely could not threaten the Zook and Gomez families' statuses in Yarlford.
But at this moment, Watson realized how terrifying the opponent he had encountered was.
"Mr. Zook, have you thought about it?"
Connor asked.
Watson took a deep breath and muttered, "I can agree to any other condition except for this. I can't just give you my shares for free!"
"Do you think you have any value to me other than the shares in your hands?"
Connor replied indifferently.
"You…"
Watson raised his head and glared at Connor. He gritted his teeth and said, "Connor, are you planning to force me to a dead end?"
"Mr. Zook, what are you saying? It seems that you never planned to let me go from the beginning, right? If we were to switch places today, do you think you would let me live?"
Connor paused for a moment and continued, "Don't forget, this is a chance that your father fought hard for you. If it weren't for him, I might have already handed this information to the police…"
Watson suddenly looked up. His expression was abnormally angry, but he was helpless. He didn't know what to do.
"I'll give you one last minute to consider!"
Connor shouted when he saw that Watson was not saying anything.
Watson took a deep breath, then gritted his teeth and said, "Alright, since you want my shares, I'll give them to you!"
At this moment, he had no chance to fight back. He had no other choice but to hand over his shares in exchange for his life.
"If you had done this earlier, you wouldn't have had to say so much nonsense."
Connor looked at Watson with a faint smile, then turned to look at Mr. Solana.
It was obvious that Mr. Solana had prepared the contract in advance; he took out two copies of the contract and handed one to Connor and the other to Watson.
Watson looked at the contract that had been prepared in advance and couldn't help but smile bitterly. It was because he realized that everything was going according to Connor's plans.
As for everyone present, their expressions were also very ugly because they did not expect Watson to really transfer his shares to Connor.
These people wanted to persuade Watson, but Watson didn't wait for them to speak. He directly wrote his name on the contract, then gritted his teeth and said, "Can you give me that information now?"
Connor slowly raised his head and looked at Watson, then said, "When did I say I was going to give you that information?"
"Connor, what do you mean? Are you kidding me?"
Watson was instantly furious and shouted at Connor.
"I'm not in the mood to play with you. You gave me your shares, and I can promise not to hand these documents to the police, but I never said that I would give these documents to you or destroy them!"
Connor looked at Watson indifferently and continued, "However, you can rest assured that as long as you don't do anything that threatens me, I won't hand over this information. As long as you behave yourself in the future, you will be safe!"
Watson stared at Connor with his eyes wide open. The expression on his face was as angry as it could be. It was because at this moment, he realized that Connor was planning to use this information to blackmail him for the rest of his life.
This also meant that Watson would never have a chance to make a comeback in front of Connor.
"Connor McDonald, you're really ruthless!"
Watson said with a trembling voice.
"Ruthless?"
Connor could not help but sneer when he heard Watson's words. Then, he said indifferently, "If I am really ruthless, you would already be a dead person by now…"
Watson looked at him angrily, not knowing what to say.
He had no chance to turn the tables. He had already lost, and he had lost completely at that.
Watson only had endless regret in his heart. He regretted that he shouldn't have taken the initiative to provoke Connor. If he hadn't done so, perhaps none of these things would have happened.
After Connor saw that Watson did not continue to speak, he did not waste time on him anymore. Instead, he raised his head and looked at the other people in the conference room.
At this moment, everyone looked at Connor with expressions of reluctance on their faces. They knew that Connor would deal with them after dealing with Watson.
"Just now, it seemed that some of you wanted to withdraw your shares, right? I'll sign the contract with you now. No matter how many shares you hold, I'll buy them back according to the current market value of the Zook Corporation!"
Connor said calmly.
After all, the biggest problem, Watson, had been solved, and now Connor controlled 80% of the shares alone. The remaining 20% of the shares were not a problem for him at all.
The small shareholders in the meeting room had very ugly expressions on their faces. After all, they had chosen to withdraw their shares because Watson was backing them up. But now that Watson no longer had any shares, them doing the same would not solve any problem at all!
"...Mr. McDonald, you said that if we were willing to stay in the Zook Corporation, our position would change. Is that true?" a middle-aged man asked carefully.
"That's right!"
Connor nodded and continued, "As long as you're willing to stay in the Zook Corporation, I won't make any large-scale changes in personnel!"
"Then I won't withdraw my shares. I want to stay…"
The middle-aged man shouted without any hesitation.
"I won't withdraw my shares either. I'll stay too!"
The other small shareholders present seized this opportunity.

chapters.title: Chapter 1907: Evidence
chapters.content:
Chapter 1907: Evidence
When Watson saw that everyone seemed to be tempted, he could not help but turn to look at the middle-aged man behind him.
The middle-aged man seemed to understand Watson's meaning. He stood up and said, "You're making it sound nice now, but how can you guarantee that you'll fulfill what you said just now?"
"Yeah? How can you guarantee that?"
"What if you're just using us? Wait until we are of no use to you before kicking us out?"
"We must not trust this person. At the very least, we can take some things away if we withdraw our shares now, but if we trust this person, we might not get anything in the end!"
Connor smiled disdainfully after hearing everyone's words, then said expressionlessly, "What do you think you can get by withdrawing your shares now?"
"Don't you need to compensate us for withdrawing our shares?"
A middle-aged man shouted excitedly.
"Of course I will give you compensation, but whether you can get it in the end is your business!"
Connor replied indifferently and then looked at Watson expressionlessly.
"What do you mean by that?" Watson muttered.
"I originally promised Hudson that as long as you cooperate with me obediently, I might let you off. However, if you don't cooperate with me, don't blame me for being rude…" Connor said in a low voice.
"Haha…"
Watson could not help but sneer when he heard Connor's words. Then, he said indifferently, "Connor, are you threatening me? Do you dare to kill me?"
"Of course I do, but I don't think it's necessary!"
After Connor said this, he turned to look at Mr. Solana beside him.
Mr. Solana took out a document and handed it to Watson after he understood what Connor meant.
Watson didn't open the folder immediately. Instead, he asked, "What is this?"
"You'll know what's inside if you take a look yourself…" Connor replied.
After hesitating for two seconds, Watson opened the folder and took out the information inside.
